papers.title: OctoTools: A Multi-Agent Framework with Extensible Tools for Complex Reasoning
papers.title_zh: OctoTools：一种多智能体框架，拥有可扩展的工具，适用于复杂推理任务
papers.authors: Pan Lu, Bowen Chen, Sheng Liu, Rahul Thapa, Joseph Boen, James Zou
papers.abstract: Solving complex reasoning tasks may involve visual understanding, domain knowledge retrieval, numerical calculation, and multi-step reasoning. Existing methods augment large language models (LLMs) with external tools but are restricted to specialized domains, limited tool types, or require additional training data. In this paper, we introduce OctoTools, a training-free, user-friendly, and easily extensible multi-agent framework designed to tackle complex reasoning across diverse domains. OctoTools introduces standardized tool cards to encapsulate tool functionality, a planner for both high-level and low-level planning, and an executor to carry out tool usage. We validate OctoTools’ generality across 16 diverse tasks (including MathVista, MMLU-Pro, MedQA, and GAIA-Text), achieving substantial average accuracy gains of 9.3% over GPT-4o. Furthermore, OctoTools also outperforms AutoGen, GPT-Functions, and LangChain by up to 10.6% when given the same set of tools. Through comprehensive analysi, ablations, and robustness tests with compact backbones and noisy tool environments, OctoTools demonstrates advantages in task planning, effective tool usage, and multi-step problem solving. Code, demos, and visualization are publicly available at https://octotools.github.io/.
papers.abstract_zh: 解决复杂的推理任务可能涉及视觉理解、领域知识检索、数值计算以及多步骤推理。现有的方法通常会将大语言模型与外部工具相结合，但这些方法往往局限于特定领域、工具类型有限，或者需要额外的训练数据。在本文中，我们介绍了OctoTools——一个无需训练、用户友好且易于扩展的多智能体框架，旨在应对不同领域的复杂推理问题。OctoTools采用了标准化的工具卡片来封装工具功能，同时拥有用于高层和底层规划的规划器，以及用于执行工具使用的执行器。我们通过16种不同的任务来验证OctoTools的通用性（包括MathVista、MMLU-Pro、MedQA和GAIA-Text），结果显示，与GPT-4o相比，OctoTools的平均准确率提升了9.3%。此外，当使用相同的工具集时，OctoTools的表现甚至优于AutoGen、GPT-Functions和LangChain，优势高达10.6%。通过全面的分析、消融实验以及针对小型骨干模型和噪声工具环境的鲁棒性测试，OctoTools在任务规划、有效工具使用以及多步骤问题解决方面表现出显著的优势。代码、演示以及可视化资料均可在此处获取：https://octotools.github.io/
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: No Reader Left Behind: Multi-Agent Summaries Everyone Can Understand
papers.title_zh: 不让任何读者掉队：让所有人都能理解的多智能体摘要
papers.authors: Jimin Jung, MyoungJin Kim, Jaehyung Seo, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: The Plain Writing Act in the United States requires government documents to be written in clear and simple language. However, existing summarization systems struggle to address diverse linguistic and cognitive barriers among general readers. We propose NRLB (No Reader Left Behind), a unified multi-agent framework for plain language summarization that simulates three representative reader groups: elementary school students, non-native speakers, and readers with attention deficits. NRLB integrates template-based planning with an iterative feedback loop guided by simulated readers and domain expert revision to address comprehension barriers such as unknown terms, missing contexts, and confusing sentences. Evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in both readability and factuality. Human evaluation further supports these findings, with annotator preference rates ranging from 55% to 76%, highlighting NRLB’s ability to generate summaries that are both faithful to the source and accessible to a wide range of readers.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国的《简明写作法》要求政府文件使用清晰简洁的语言编写。然而，现有的摘要系统难以解决普通读者在语言能力和认知方面的差异问题。我们提出了NRLB（不让任何读者掉队）这一统一的多智能体框架，用于实现简明语言的摘要生成。该框架模拟了三种典型的读者群体：小学生、非母语使用者以及注意力缺陷的读者。NRLB将基于模板的规划与由模拟读者反馈和领域专家修订组成的迭代机制相结合，从而克服诸如术语不理解、上下文缺失以及句子混乱等理解障碍。在多个数据集上的评估结果显示，NRLB在可读性和信息准确性方面都取得了显著的提升。人工评估也进一步证实了这些发现，评测者的偏好率达到了55%到76%，这表明NRLB能够生成既忠实于原文又能被广泛读者理解的摘要。

papers.title: Discover and Prove: An Open-source Agentic Framework for Hard Mode Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
papers.title_zh: 发现与证明：面向 Lean 4 高难模式自动定理证明的开源智能体框架
papers.authors: Chengwu Liu, Yichun Yin, Ye Yuan, Jiaxuan Xie, Botao Li, Siqi Li, Jianhao Shen, Yan Xu, Lifeng Shang, Ming Zhang
papers.abstract: Most ATP benchmarks embed the final answer within the formal statement — a convention we call “Easy Mode” — a design that simplifies the task relative to what human competitors face and may lead to optimistic estimates of model capability.We call the stricter, more realistic setting “Hard Mode”: the system must independently discover the answer before constructing a formal proof.To enable Hard Mode research, we make two contributions.First, we release MiniF2F-Hard and FIMO-Hard, expert-reannotated Hard Mode variants of two widely-used ATP benchmarks.Second, we introduce Discover And Prove (DAP), an agentic framework that uses LLM natural-language reasoning with explicit self-reflection to discover answers, then rewrites Hard Mode statements into Easy Mode ones for existing ATP provers.DAP sets the state of the art: on CombiBench it raises solved problems from 7 (previous SOTA, Pass@16) to 10; on PutnamBench it is the first system to formally prove 36 theorems in Hard Mode — while simultaneously revealing that state-of-the-art LLMs exceed 80% answer accuracy on the same problems where formal provers manage under 10%, exposing a substantial gap that Hard Mode benchmarks are uniquely suited to measure.
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数ATP基准测试都将最终答案嵌入到正式陈述中——我们将其称为“简单模式”。这种设计使任务比人类参赛者面对的任务更简单，可能会使得对模型能力的估计更为乐观。而我们则采用更严格、更现实的“困难模式”：系统必须在构建正式证明之前独立地找到答案。为了支持困难模式的研究，我们做出了两项贡献。首先，我们发布了MiniF2F-Hard和FIMO-Hard，这两种工具是两种广泛使用的ATP基准测试的改进版本，由专家重新注释以适应困难模式。其次，我们引入了Discover And Prove（DAP）这一智能体框架，该框架利用LLM的自然语言推理能力以及明确的自我反思机制来寻找答案，然后将困难模式的陈述转化为简单模式的陈述，以便现有的 ATP 定理证明器能够进行处理。DAP已经达到了当前的最高水平：在 CombiBench 测试中，它将解决的题目数从此前最佳方法的 7 道（Pass@16）提高到 10 道，而在PutnamBench测试中，它是第一个能够在困难模式下正式证明36个定理的系统——同时表明，最先进的LLM在同一问题上能够达到80%以上的答案准确率，而形式化证明器在这些问题上的证明成功率则不足 10%。这揭示了一个巨大的差距，而困难模式基准测试正是用来衡量这一差距的最佳工具。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Your Inference Request Will Become a Black Box: Confidential Inference for Cloud-based Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 让推理请求成为黑盒：云端大语言模型的保密推理
papers.authors: Chung-ju Huang, Huiqiang Zhao, Yuanpeng He, Lijian Li, Wenpin Jiao, Zhi Jin, Peixuan Chen, Leye Wang
papers.abstract: The increasing reliance on cloud-hosted Large Language Models (LLMs) exposes sensitive client data, such as prompts and responses, to potential privacy breaches by service providers.Existing approaches fail to ensure privacy, maintain model performance, and preserve computational efficiency simultaneously.To address this challenge, we propose Talaria, a confidential inference framework that partitions the LLM pipeline between a client-verified Confidential Virtual Machine (CVM) and the public cloud to protect client data without compromising the cloud’s model intellectual property or inference quality.The interaction between the CVM and the cloud is secured by our Reversible Masked Outsourcing (ReMO) protocol, which uses a hybrid masking technique to reversibly obscure intermediate data before outsourcing computations.Extensive evaluations show that Talaria can defend against state-of-the-art token inference attacks, reducing token reconstruction accuracy from over 97.5% to an average of 1.34%, all while being a lossless mechanism that guarantees output identical to the original model without significantly decreasing efficiency and scalability.To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that ensures clients’ prompts and responses remain inaccessible to the cloud, while also preserving model privacy, performance, and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 对云托管的大语言模型（LLM）的依赖日益增加，使得诸如提示和回复等敏感客户数据面临被服务提供商泄露隐私的风险。现有的方法无法同时确保隐私安全、维持模型性能以及保持计算效率。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Talaria——一个保密推理框架。该框架将LLM的推理过程分为两部分：一部分在客户端验证过的机密虚拟机（CVM）中进行，另一部分则在公共云中运行，从而在不影响云的模型知识产权或推理质量的前提下保护客户数据。我们使用的可逆掩码外包（ReMO）协议能够确保机密虚拟机和公共云之间的数据交互安全。该协议采用混合掩码技术，可以在外包计算之前可逆地隐藏中间数据。广泛的测试表明，Talaria能够有效抵御最先进的词元推断攻击，将词元重建的准确性从超过97.5%降低到平均1.34%。同时，这种机制是一种无损机制，能够保证输出结果与原始模型完全一致，而不会显著降低效率和可扩展性。据我们所知，这是首个既能保护客户提示和回复不被云访问，又能同时维护模型隐私、性能和效率的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Rhetorical Questions in LLM Representations: A Linear Probing Study
papers.title_zh: 大语言模型表征中的反问句：一项线性探测研究
papers.authors: Louie Hong Yao, Vishesh Anand, Yuan Zhuang, Tianyu Jiang
papers.abstract: Rhetorical questions are asked not to seek information but to persuade or signal stance. How large language models internally represent them remains unclear. We analyze rhetorical questions in LLM representations using linear probes on two social-media datasets with different discourse contexts, and find that rhetorical signals emerge early and are most stably captured by last-token representations. Rhetorical questions are linearly separable from information-seeking questions within datasets, and remain detectable under cross-dataset transfer, reaching AUROC around 0.7-0.8. However, we demonstrate that transferability does not simply imply a shared representation. Probes trained on different datasets produce different rankings when applied to the same target corpus, with overlap among the top-ranked instances often below 0.2. Qualitative analysis shows that these divergences correspond to distinct rhetorical phenomena: some probes capture discourse-level rhetorical stance embedded in extended argumentation, while others emphasize localized, syntax-driven interrogative acts. Together, these findings suggest that rhetorical questions in LLM representations are encoded by multiple linear directions emphasizing different cues, rather than a single shared direction.
papers.abstract_zh: 修辞问句并非为了获取信息而提出，而是为了说服或表明立场。目前尚不清楚大语言模型在内部是如何表示这些修辞问句的。我们通过在两个具有不同话语背景的社交媒体数据集上使用线性探针来分析LLM中的修辞问句，发现修辞信号在早期就出现了，并且最能被最后一个词元的表示稳定地捕捉到。在数据集内，修辞问句与信息寻求问句可以线性分离，并且在跨数据集迁移时仍然可以被检测到，其AUROC值约为0.7-0.8。然而，我们发现可迁移性并不意味着存在共享的表示方式。在不同数据集上训练的探针在应用于同一目标语料库时会产生不同的排序结果，其中排名靠前的实例之间的重叠通常低于0.2。定性分析表明，这些差异对应于不同的修辞现象：一些探针能够捕捉到嵌入在扩展论证中的话语层面的修辞立场，而另一些则强调局部化的、由语法驱动的疑问行为。总的来说，这些发现表明，LLM表示中的修辞问句是通过多个线性方向来编码的，这些方向强调的是不同的线索，而不是单一的共享方向。

papers.title: Dual-Axis Generative Reward Model Toward Semantic and Turn-taking Robustness in Interactive Spoken Dialogue Models
papers.title_zh: 双轴生成式奖励模型：提升交互式语音对话模型的语义与轮次转换鲁棒性
papers.authors: Yifu Chen, Shengpeng Ji, Zhengqing Liu, Qian Chen, Wen Wang, Ziqing Wang, Yangzhuo Li, Tianle Liang, Zhou Zhao
papers.abstract: Achieving seamless, human-like interaction remains a key challenge for full-duplex spoken dialogue models (SDMs). Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially enhanced text- and vision-language models, while well-designed reward signals are crucial for the performance of RL. We consider RL a promising strategy to address the key challenge for SDMs. However, a fundamental barrier persists: prevailing automated metrics for assessing interaction quality rely on superficial proxies, such as behavioral statistics or timing-prediction accuracy, failing to provide reliable reward signals for RL. On the other hand, human evaluations, despite their richness, remain costly, inconsistent, and difficult to scale. We tackle this critical barrier by proposing a Dual-Axis Generative Reward Model, which is trained to understand complex interaction dynamics using a detailed taxonomy and an annotated dataset, produces a single score and, crucially, provides separate evaluations for semantic quality and interaction timing. Such dual outputs furnish precise diagnostic feedback for SDMs and deliver a dependable, instructive reward signal suitable for online reinforcement learning. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on interaction-quality assessment across a wide spectrum of datasets, spanning synthetic dialogues and complex real-world interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 实现无缝、类似人类的交互体验，仍然是全双工语音对话模型面临的关键挑战。强化学习在提升文本和视觉语言模型方面发挥了重要作用，而设计良好的奖励机制对于强化学习的性能提升至关重要。我们认为强化学习是一种解决这一关键问题的有前景的策略。然而，仍然存在一个根本性的障碍：目前用于评估交互质量的自动化指标依赖于一些表面的替代指标，如行为统计或时间预测准确性，这些指标无法为强化学习提供可靠的奖励信号。另一方面，人类评估虽然具有丰富的信息，但过程成本高昂、缺乏一致性，且难以大规模实施。为了克服这一难题，我们提出了一种双轴生成式奖励模型。该模型通过详细的分类体系和标注数据集进行训练，能够理解复杂的交互动态，并生成一个单一的评分结果。更重要的是，该模型还能分别评估语义质量和交互时机。这样的双重输出能够为语音对话模型提供精确的反馈，从而为在线强化学习提供可靠且具有指导意义的奖励信号。我们的模型在多种数据集上的交互质量评估表现均处于领先水平，涵盖了合成对话和复杂的现实世界交互场景。

papers.title: Different types of syntactic agreement recruit the same units within large language models
papers.title_zh: 不同类型的句法一致关系在大语言模型中调用相同的单元
papers.authors: Daria Kryvosheieva, Andrea Gregor de Varda, Evelina Fedorenko, Greta Tuckute
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can reliably distinguish grammatical from ungrammatical sentences, but how grammatical knowledge is represented within the model remains an open question. We investigate whether different syntactic phenomena recruit shared or distinct components in LLMs. Using a functional localization approach inspired by cognitive neuroscience, we identify the LLM units most responsive to 67 English syntactic phenomena in seven open-weight models. These units are consistently recruited across sentence instances and causally support model performance. Critically, different types of syntactic agreement (e.g., subject-verb, anaphor, determiner-noun) recruit overlapping sets of units, suggesting that agreement constitutes a meaningful functional category in LLMs. This pattern holds in Russian and Chinese, and further, across languages: in a cross-lingual analysis of 57 languages, syntactically similar languages share more units for subject-verb agreement. Taken together, these findings reveal that syntactic agreement—a critical marker of syntactic dependencies—constitutes a meaningful category within LLMs’ representational spaces.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够可靠地区分合乎语法规则与不合语法规则的句子，但语法知识在模型中是如何被表示的，仍然是一个未解之谜。我们研究了不同的句法现象在大语言模型中是调用了共同的成分还是不同的成分。借鉴认知神经科学的功能定位方法，我们确定了在七种开放权重模型中，对67种英语句法现象反应最灵敏的模型单元。这些单元在不同句子实例中都能被一致地调用，并且对模型的性能有因果性的支持。关键的是，不同类型的句法一致性（例如主谓一致、指代关系、限定词与名词的一致性）调用了重叠的单元集，这表明句法一致性在大语言模型中构成了一个有意义的功能类别。这种模式在俄语和中文中同样存在，而且在不同语言中也有体现：在对57种语言的跨语言分析中发现，句法上相似的语言在主谓一致方面共享更多的单元。总的来说，这些发现表明，句法一致性作为句法依赖关系的一个关键标志，在大语言模型的表示空间中确实构成一个有意义的类别。

papers.title: Empowering Tabular Data Preparation with Language Models: Why and How?
papers.title_zh: 利用语言模型改进表格数据准备：为何以及如何实现？
papers.authors: Mengshi Chen, Yuxiang Sun, Tengchao Li, Jianwei Wang, Kai Wang, Xuemin Lin, Ying Zhang, Wenjie Zhang
papers.abstract: Data preparation is a critical step in enhancing the usability of tabular data and thus boosts downstream data-driven tasks. Traditional methods often face challenges in capturing the intricate relationships within tables and adapting to the tasks involved. Recent advances in Language Models (LMs), especially in Large Language Models (LLMs), offer new opportunities to automate and support tabular data preparation. However, why LMs suit tabular data preparation (i.e., how their capabilities match task demands) and how to use them effectively across phases still remain to be systematically explored. In this survey, we systematically analyze the role of LMs in enhancing tabular data preparation processes, focusing on four core phases: data acquisition, integration, cleaning, and transformation. For each phase, we present an integrated analysis of how LMs can be combined with other components for different preparation tasks, highlight key advancements, and outline prospective pipelines.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据准备是提升表格数据可用性的关键步骤，从而推动后续的数据驱动任务。传统方法在捕捉表格中的复杂关系以及适应各种任务需求方面往往面临挑战。最近在语言模型领域取得的进展，尤其是大语言模型的发展，为自动化和辅助表格数据准备提供了新的机会。然而，为什么语言模型适合用于表格数据准备（即它们的能力如何满足任务需求），以及如何在各个阶段有效使用它们，这些问题仍有待系统性的研究。在这项调查中，我们系统地分析了语言模型在增强表格数据准备过程中的作用，重点关注四个核心阶段：数据获取、整合、清洗和转换。对于每个阶段，我们提出了如何将语言模型与其他组件结合以完成不同准备任务的方案，强调了关键进展，并概述了未来的处理流程。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Learning Diverse Responses with Prefix-Conditioned Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 通过前缀条件化监督微调学习多样化响应
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Fan, Guanqiao Chen, Yanyi Huang, Mingkuan Zhao, Dadi Guo, Yi R. Fung
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on hard reasoning and general instruction-following tasks. However, when sampling multiple outputs for the same prompt, they often produce highly homogeneous, repetitive responses, resulting in inefficient exploration. This limits the gains from test-time scaling and constrains the upper bound of RL training. We attribute this issue in part to supervised fine-tuning (SFT): when a single prompt is paired with multiple reference responses, the model is trained to generate diverse outputs under the same prior condition, which induces optimization interference and can lead to diversity collapse. To address this, we propose Prefix-Conditioned SFT (P-SFT), a simple yet effective method that constructs semantically consistent yet distributionally distinct prior contents to different responses, thereby projecting the instruction into distinct latent regions to establish diverse prior distributions and decouple the one-to-many mapping. Experiments on large reasoning language models show that our approach improves absolute performance by 5.3% and increases generation diversity by 198.3% on average, while substantially enhancing output diversity and test-time scaling. Notably, even without any additional training, our prefixing strategy can be applied at inference time alone and still yields significant gains in both diversity and reasoning performance for instruction-tuned LLMs and reasoning-enhanced models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂的推理任务和一般的指令遵循任务上表现优异。然而，当为同一个提示生成多个输出时，它们往往会产生高度同质化的、重复性的响应，从而导致探索效率低下。这限制了测试时间扩展带来的收益，并限制了强化学习训练的上限。我们认为这一问题部分源于有监督微调技术：当单个提示与多个参考响应配对时，模型会在相同的先验条件下训练以生成多样化的输出，这会引发优化干扰，导致多样性下降。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了前缀条件化微调方法——P-SFT。该方法通过为不同的响应构建语义一致但分布不同的先验内容，从而将指令映射到不同的潜在区域，建立多样化的先验分布，并分离一对多的映射关系。在大型推理语言模型上的实验表明，我们的方法平均提升了5.3%的绝对性能，并将生成多样性提高了198.3%，同时显著增强了输出的多样性和测试时间扩展能力。值得注意的是，即使不进行额外的训练，我们的前缀策略也可以仅在推理阶段应用，仍然能够为经过指令调整的LLM和增强推理能力的模型带来显著的多样性和推理性能提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EASE: Entity-Aware Sub-table Generation for Real-world Multi-table QA
papers.title_zh: EASE：基于实体感知的子表生成技术，适用于现实世界中的多表问答场景
papers.authors: Myunghoon Kang, Dahyun Jung, Suhyune Son, Seonmin Koo, Changwoo Chun, Daniel Rim, Haeyoung Kwon, Yuna Hur, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in table-based question answering (table QA) have been driven by the development of table-specific reasoning strategies for leveraging large language models. Previous works employ sub-table-based reasoning, which involves matching query-relevant table values and aggregating them into sub-tables for precise reasoning. However, these approaches are limited to scenarios with query-relevant single tables, failing to handle real-world table QA settings that involve noisy multi-table sets. To address the challenges of real-world table QA, we propose EASE: Entity-Aware Sub-table Generation for REal-world Multi-table QA framework. Given a noisy multi-table set, EASE first extracts key entities from the question to construct a sub-table schema. It then populates this schema by utilizing a selected set of column values from the noisy multi-table set, thereby facilitating efficient and effective sub-table-based reasoning. We introduce a Noisy Multi-table QA dataset and conduct extensive experiments to evaluate EASE’s effectiveness on real-world table QA. Our results demonstrate that EASE effectively filters out irrelevant information while incorporating pertinent table values, leading to efficient and effective performance on real-world table QA. Our dataset can be found https://github.com/Metalchaos8527/ease_noisy_multi-table_qa.git
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在基于表格的问题回答领域取得的进展，得益于针对大语言模型开发的特定于表格的推理策略。以往的研究采用基于子表的推理方式，即匹配与查询相关的表格值，并将这些值汇总到子表中以实现精确的推理。然而，这些方法仅限于涉及单一相关表格的场景，无法处理包含多个噪声表格的现实世界表格问题回答场景。为了应对现实世界表格问题回答中的挑战，我们提出了EASE：实体感知的子表生成技术，用于现实世界多表问题回答。对于包含多个噪声表格的场景，EASE首先从问题中提取关键实体以构建子表结构，然后利用从噪声表格中提取的某些列值来填充该结构，从而实现高效且有效的子表推理。我们创建了一个名为“Noisy Multi-table QA”的数据集，并进行了大量实验来评估EASE在现实世界表格问题回答中的效果。我们的结果表明，EASE能够有效过滤掉无关信息，同时整合相关表格值，从而在现实世界表格问题回答中表现出高效且有效的性能。我们的数据集可以在以下链接下载：https://github.com/Metalchaos8527/ease_noisy_multi-table_qa.git
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM’s Capability in Reasoning over Conflicting Web References
papers.title_zh: 评测大语言模型对相互冲突的网络引用进行推理的能力
papers.authors: Yizhen Yuan, Rui Kong, Dongze Li, Yuanchun Li, Yunxin Liu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) integrated with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) have become a dominant framework for building intelligent assistants. In real-world applications such as ChatGPT with web search, the retrieved document often comes from diverse, potentially unreliable sources and may contain inconsistent claims. Unlike traditional search engines that rely on users to manually compare information, LLM-based systems typically feed all retrieved content into the model’s context, requiring LLMs to autonomously identify, differentiate, and reason over conflicting viewpoints. Unlike mainstream LLM evaluation tasks like math and code generation that are primarily focused on reasoning with factual context, question-answering with multi-source references requires fundamentally different capabilities to identify and reason over knowledge contradictions. In this paper, we introduce ConfRAG, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs’ reasoning capability over real-world conflicting documents retrieved from the web. It consists of 1,814 real-world questions, each paired with an average of 9.58 retrieved paragraphs from heterogeneous online sources. A total of 57.2% of the questions exhibit explicit contradictions. We further propose three structured evaluation tasks, answer clustering, answer coverage, and reason coverage, to quantify a model’s ability to organize and explain contradictory content. Experiments with state-of-the-art models such as GPT-4.1 and Claude-3-7-Sonnet reveal substantial performance gaps, highlighting the need for more targeted research in contradiction-aware question answering. To the best of our knowledge, ConfRAG is the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate contradiction-aware reasoning on real-world long web documents.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）与检索增强生成技术相结合，已成为构建智能助手的主要框架。在现实应用场景中，如结合网络搜索的ChatGPT，检索到的文档往往来自多种、可能不可靠的来源，并且可能包含不一致的信息。与依赖用户手动比较信息的传统搜索引擎不同，基于LLM的系统通常会将所有检索到的内容纳入模型的语境中，这就要求LLM能够自主识别、区分并处理相互矛盾的观点。与主要专注于利用事实语境进行推理的主流LLM评估任务不同，涉及多源参考的问答任务需要完全不同的能力来识别和处理知识上的矛盾。在本文中，我们提出了ConfRAG这一基准测试，用于评估LLM对从网络上检索到的具有矛盾性的真实文档的推理能力。该测试包含1,814个真实问题，每个问题都与来自不同在线来源的平均 9.58 段文本相关联。其中57.2%的问题存在明显的矛盾点。我们还提出了三种结构化的评估任务：答案聚类、答案覆盖率和推理覆盖率，以量化模型组织和解释矛盾内容的能力。对GPT-4.1和Claude-3-7-Sonnet等先进模型的实验表明，它们在性能上存在显著差距，这凸显了在矛盾感知问答领域进行更针对性研究的必要性。据我们所知，ConfRAG是首个专门设计用于评估对真实长文档中的矛盾信息进行处理的推理能力的基准测试。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Parallel Universes, Parallel Languages: A Comprehensive Study on LLM-based Multilingual Counterfactual Example Generation
papers.title_zh: 平行宇宙、平行语言：基于大语言模型的多语言反事实示例生成研究
papers.authors: Qianli Wang, Van Bach Nguyen, Yihong Liu, Fedor Splitt, Nils Feldhus, Christin Seifert, Hinrich Schuetze, Sebastian Möller, Vera Schmitt
papers.abstract: Counterfactuals refer to minimally edited inputs that cause a model’s prediction to change, serving as a promising approach to explaining the model’s behavior. Large language models (LLMs) excel at generating English counterfactuals and demonstrate multilingual proficiency. However, their effectiveness in generating multilingual counterfactuals remains unclear. To this end, we conduct a comprehensive study on multilingual counterfactuals. We first conduct automatic evaluations on both directly generated counterfactuals in the target languages and those derived via English translation across six languages. Although translation-based counterfactuals offer higher validity than their directly generated counterparts, they demand substantially more modifications and still fall short of matching the quality of the original English counterfactuals. Second, we find the patterns of edits applied to high-resource European-language counterfactuals to be remarkably similar, suggesting that cross-lingual perturbations follow common strategic principles. Third, we reveal that multilingual counterfactual data augmentation (CDA) yields larger model performance improvements than cross-lingual CDA, especially for lower-resource languages. Yet, the imperfections of the generated counterfactuals limit gains in model performance and robustness. Finally, we identify and categorize four main types of errors that consistently appear in the generated counterfactuals across languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 反事实指的是经过少量编辑的输入，这些输入能够改变模型的预测结果，因此是一种解释模型行为的有效方法。大语言模型在生成英语反事实方面表现出色，并且具备多语言处理能力。然而，它们在生成多语言反事实方面的效果仍不明确。为此，我们进行了关于多语言反事实的全面研究。首先，我们对以目标语言直接生成的反事实以及通过英语翻译得到的六种语言中的反事实进行了自动评估。虽然基于翻译的反事实比直接生成的反事实具有更高的有效性，但它们需要更多的修改工作，且质量仍然无法与原始英语反事实相媲美。其次，我们发现对高资源欧洲语言反事实进行编辑的模式非常相似，这表明跨语言的处理方式遵循着共同的策略原则。第三，我们发现多语言反事实数据增强方法能够带来更大的模型性能提升，尤其是在低资源语言中。不过，生成的反事实存在的缺陷限制了模型性能和鲁棒性的提升。最后，我们识别出四种在多种语言中生成的反事实中常见的错误类型，并对它们进行了分类。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CLEAR: Cross-Lingual Enhancement in Retrieval via Reverse-training
papers.title_zh: CLEAR：通过反向训练实现跨语言检索能力的提升
papers.authors: Seungyoon Lee, Minhyuk Kim, Seongtae Hong, Youngjoon Jang, Dongsuk Oh, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Existing multilingual embedding models often encounter challenges in cross-lingual scenarios due to imbalanced linguistic resources and less consideration of cross-lingual alignment during training. Although standardized contrastive learning approaches for cross-lingual adaptation are widely adopted, they may struggle to capture fundamental alignment between languages and degrade performance in well-aligned languages such as English. To address these challenges, we propose Cross-Lingual Enhancement in RetrievAl via Reverse-training (CLEAR), a novel loss function utilizing a reverse training scheme to improve retrieval performance across diverse cross-lingual retrieval scenarios. CLEAR leverages an English passage as a bridge to strengthen alignments between the target language and English, ensuring robust performance in the cross-lingual retrieval task. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that CLEAR achieves notable improvements in cross-lingual scenarios, with gains up to 15%, particularly in low-resource languages, while minimizing performance degradation in English. Furthermore, our findings highlight that CLEAR offers promising effectiveness even in multilingual training, suggesting its potential for broad application and scalability. We release the code at https://github.com/dltmddbs100/CLEAR.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的多语言嵌入模型在跨语言场景中常常面临挑战，这些挑战源于语言资源的不平衡以及训练过程中对跨语言对齐的忽视。尽管已经广泛采用了标准化的对比学习方法来处理跨语言适应问题，但这些方法在捕捉不同语言之间的基本对齐关系时可能会遇到困难，并且在像英语这样对齐良好的语言中性能会下降。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为“通过反向训练实现跨语言增强”的新损失函数CLEAR。该损失函数采用反向训练方案，以提高在不同跨语言检索场景中的检索性能。CLEAR利用英文段落作为桥梁，加强目标语言与英语之间的对齐关系，从而确保在跨语言检索任务中取得良好的性能。我们的大量实验表明，CLEAR在跨语言场景中取得了显著的改进，尤其是在资源匮乏的语言中，性能提升了高达15%，同时避免了在英语中的性能下降。此外，我们的研究还表明，CLEAR在多语言训练中同样具有很好的效果，这预示着它有着广泛的应用前景和可扩展性。我们将代码发布在https://github.com/dltmddbs100/CLEAR上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Aligning Language Models with Real-time Knowledge Editing
papers.title_zh: 通过实时知识编辑对齐语言模型
papers.authors: Chenming Tang, Yutong Yang, Kexue Wang, Yunfang Wu
papers.abstract: Knowledge editing aims to modify outdated knowledge in language models efficiently while retaining their original capabilities. Mainstream datasets for knowledge editing are predominantly static and fail to keep in pace with the evolving real-world knowledge. In this work, we introduce CRAFT, an ever-evolving real-world dataset for knowledge editing. It evaluates models on temporal locality, common-sense locality, composite portability and alias portability, providing a comprehensive and challenging evaluation for knowledge editing, on which previous methods hardly achieve balanced performance. Towards flexible real-time knowledge editing, we propose KEDAS, a novel paradigm of knowledge editing alignment featuring diverse edit augmentation and self-adaptive post-alignment inference, exhibiting significant performance gain on both CRAFT and traditional datasets compared to previous methods. We hope this work may serve as a catalyst for shifting the focus of knowledge editing from static update to dynamic evolution.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识编辑的目的是高效地修改语言模型中的过时知识，同时保留其原有的功能。目前用于知识编辑的主流数据集大多为静态的，无法跟上现实世界知识的不断发展。在这项研究中，我们提出了CRAFT——一个不断发展的、适用于知识编辑的现实世界数据集。该数据集在时间局部性、常识性局部性、复合可移植性和别名可移植性方面对模型进行了评估，为知识编辑提供了全面而具有挑战性的评价标准。与以往的方法相比，我们的方法在CRAFT和传统数据集上的表现更为出色。我们希望这项工作能够推动知识编辑的重点从静态更新转向动态演化。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PosterForest: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Collaboration for Scientific Poster Generation
papers.title_zh: PosterForest：用于科学海报制作的层次化多智能体协作系统
papers.authors: Jiho Choi, Seojeong Park, Seongjong Song, Hyunjung Shim
papers.abstract: Automating scientific poster generation requires hierarchical document understanding and coherent content-layout planning.Existing methods often rely on flat summarization or optimize content and layout separately.As a result, they often suffer from information loss, weak logical flow, and poor visual balance.We present PosterForest, a training-free framework for scientific poster generation.Our method introduces the Poster Tree, a structured intermediate representation that captures document hierarchy and visual-textual semantics across multiple levels.Building on this representation, content and layout agents perform hierarchical reasoning and recursive refinement, progressively optimizing the poster from global organization to local composition.This joint optimization improves semantic coherence, logical flow, and visual harmony.Experiments show that PosterForest outperforms prior methods in both automatic and human evaluations, without additional training or domain-specific supervision.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化科学海报生成需要层次化的文档理解以及连贯的内容与布局规划。现有的方法往往依赖于简单的摘要处理，或者分别优化内容和布局。因此，这些方法常常存在信息丢失、逻辑流程不畅以及视觉平衡不佳的问题。我们提出了PosterForest这一无需训练的科学研究海报生成框架。我们的方法引入了“海报树”这一概念，这是一种结构化的中间表示形式，能够捕捉文档的层次结构以及跨多个层面的视觉与文本语义关系。基于这种表示形式，内容和布局处理模块可以进行层次化推理和递归优化，逐步从全局组织到局部细节对海报进行优化。这种联合优化方式提升了海报的语义一致性、逻辑流畅性和视觉美感。实验表明，PosterForest在自动评估和人机评估中均优于现有方法，且无需额外的训练或特定领域的监督即可实现这一目标。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SLR: Automated Synthesis for Scalable Logical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: SLR：用于可扩展逻辑推理的自动化合成技术
papers.authors: Lukas Helff, Ahmad Omar, Felix Friedrich, Antonia Wüst, Hikaru Shindo, Rupert Mitchell, Tim Woydt, Patrick Schramowski, Wolfgang Stammer, Kristian Kersting
papers.abstract: We introduce SLR, an end-to-end framework for systematic evaluation and training of Large Language Models (LLMs) via Scalable Logical Reasoning. Given a user’s task specification, SLR automatically synthesizes (i) an instruction prompt for an inductive reasoning task, (ii) a validation program, executable on model outputs to provide verifiable rewards, and (iii) the latent ground-truth rule. This process is fully automated, scalable, requires no human annotations, and offers precise control over task difficulty. Using SLR, we create SLR-Bench, a benchmark comprising 19k prompts organized into 20 curriculum levels that progressively increase in relational, arithmetic, and recursive complexity. Large-scale evaluation reveals that contemporary LLMs readily produce syntactically valid rules, yet often fail at correct logical inference. Recent reasoning LLMs demonstrate improved performance but incur very high test-time computation, with costs exceeding 300 for just 1,000 prompts. Finally, curriculum learning via SLR doubles Llama-3-8B accuracy on SLR-Bench, achieving parity with Gemini-Flash-Thinking at a fraction of computational cost. Moreover, these reasoning capabilities generalize to a wide range of established benchmarks, underscoring the effectiveness of SLR for downstream reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了SLR这一端到端的框架，用于通过可扩展的逻辑推理对大语言模型进行系统性的评估与训练。根据用户的任务要求，SLR能够自动生成以下内容：(i) 用于归纳推理任务的指令提示；(ii) 可在模型输出上执行的验证程序，以提供可验证的奖励；(iii) 潜在的真实规则。这一过程完全自动化且可扩展性高，无需人工注释，同时能够精确控制任务难度。利用SLR，我们创建了SLR-Bench基准测试，该测试包含19,000个提示，分为20个难度等级，这些等级在关系、算术和递归复杂性方面逐步增加。大规模评估结果显示，当前的语言模型能够生成语法上有效的规则，但在逻辑推理方面往往表现不佳。最近的推理语言模型虽然性能有所提升，但计算成本非常高，仅处理1,000个提示就需要超过300秒的时间。最后，通过SLR进行课程学习后，Llama-3-8B在SLR-Bench上的准确率提升了两倍，其计算成本仅为Gemini-Flash-Thinking的一小部分。此外，这些推理能力可以推广到多种成熟的基准测试中，这充分证明了SLR在下游推理方面的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can Continual Pretraining Bridge the Performance Gap between General-purpose and Specialized Language Models in the Medical Domain?
papers.title_zh: 持续预训练能否缩小通用与专业语言模型在医学领域的性能差距？
papers.authors: Niclas Doll, Jasper Schulze Buschhoff, Shalaka Satheesh, Hammam Abdelwahab, Héctor Allende-Cid, Katrin Klug
papers.abstract: This paper narrows the performance gap between small, specialized models and significantly larger general-purpose models through domain adaptation via continual pre-training and merging. We address the scarcity of specialized non-English data by constructing a high-quality German medical corpus (FineMed-de) from FineWeb2. This corpus is used to continually pre-train and merge three well-known LLMs (ranging from 7B to 24B parameters), creating the DeFineMed model family. A comprehensive evaluation confirms that specialization dramatically enhances 7B model performance on German medical benchmarks. Furthermore, the pairwise win-rate analysis of the Qwen2.5-based models demonstrates an approximately 3.5-fold increase in the win-rate against the much larger Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct through domain adaptation. This evidence positions specialized 7B models as a competitive, resource-efficient solution for complex medical instruction-following tasks. While model merging successfully restores instruction-following abilities, a subsequent failure mode analysis reveals inherent trade-offs, including the introduction of language mixing and increased verbosity, highlighting the need for more targeted fine-tuning in future work. This research provides a robust, compliant methodology for developing specialized LLMs, serving as the foundation for practical use in German-speaking healthcare contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文通过持续预训练和合并技术，缩小了小型专业模型与规模更大的通用模型之间的性能差距。为解决非英语数据的稀缺问题，我们从FineWeb2中构建了一个高质量的德语医学语料库（FineMed-de）。该语料库被用于持续预训练并合并三个知名的大语言模型（参数范围从7B到24B），从而创建了DeFineMed模型系列。全面的评估表明，专业化的设计显著提升了7B模型在德语医学领域的性能。此外，基于Qwen2.5的模型的成对胜率分析显示，通过领域适应技术，这些模型在与规模更大的Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct模型的胜率上提高了约3.5倍。这一结果表明，专业的7B模型可以成为处理复杂医疗指令任务的具有竞争力且资源高效的解决方案。虽然模型合并成功恢复了模型的处理能力，但后续的分析发现存在一些固有的权衡问题，包括语言混合现象的出现以及文本冗长的增加，这提示未来研究需要更精确的微调策略。本研究为开发专业大语言模型提供了一种稳健且合规的方法论，为德语医疗领域的实际应用奠定了基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MINTQA: A Multi-Hop Question Answering Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on New and Long-tail Knowledge
papers.title_zh: MINTQA：评测大语言模型处理新知识与长尾知识能力的多跳问答基准
papers.authors: Jie He, Nan Hu, Wanqiu Long, Jiaoyan Chen, Jeff Z. Pan
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge, enabling them to tackle knowledge-intensive tasks. However, limited research has explored how LLMs effectively leverage RAG techniques for multi-hop question answering (QA), particularly when handling knowledge with with varying degrees of familiarity. In this paper, we introduce MINTQA (Multi-hop Question Answering on New and Tail Knowledge), a benchmark designed to evaluate multi-hop QA performance on questions involving 10,479 question-answer pairs for evaluating old/new knowledge and 17,887 pairs for assessing popular/unpopular knowledge, with each question equipped with corresponding sub-questions and answers. This benchmark primarily evaluates the multi-hop reasoning ability of LLMs and their capacity to handle knowledge with varying levels of familiarity during the reasoning process. We evaluate 22 state-of-the-art LLMs using three distinct QA strategies: LLM-based parameterized knowledge QA, direct RAG-enhanced QA, and multi-hop RAG-enhanced QA. Our experiments reveal key challenges in how LLMs handle knowledge with different familiarity and offer insights into improving their multi-hop reasoning capabilities when combined with RAG techniques.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合外部知识来增强大语言模型的能力，使其能够处理需要大量知识的任务。然而，目前关于LLM如何有效利用RAG技术进行多跳问答的研究还较为有限，尤其是在处理具有不同熟悉程度的知识时。在本文中，我们提出了MINTQA（多跳问答：针对新旧知识的问题），这是一个用于评估多跳问答性能的基准测试。该测试包含10,479对问题-答案对，用于评估新旧知识；同时还有17,887对问题-答案对，用于评估热门/冷门知识。每个问题都配有相应的子问题和答案。这个基准测试主要评估LLM的多跳推理能力以及它们在推理过程中处理不同熟悉程度知识的能力。我们使用三种不同的问答策略对22种先进的LLM进行了评估：基于LLM的参数化知识问答、直接利用RAG技术的问答，以及多跳利用RAG技术的问答。实验结果表明，LLM在处理不同熟悉程度的知识时存在一些关键挑战，同时也为结合RAG技术提升其多跳推理能力提供了一些见解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Sense and Sensitivity: Examining the Influence of Semantic Recall on Long Context Code Understanding
papers.title_zh: 意义与敏感度：语义回忆对长上下文代码理解的影响
papers.authors: Adam Štorek, Mukur Gupta, Samira Hajizadeh, Prashast Srivastava, Suman Jana
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for understanding large codebases, but whether they understand operational semantics of long code context or rely on pattern matching shortcuts remains unclear. We distinguish between lexical recall (retrieving code verbatim) and semantic recall (understanding operational semantics). Evaluating 10 state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that while frontier models achieve near-perfect, position-independent lexical recall, semantic recall degrades severely when code is centrally positioned in long contexts. We introduce semantic recall sensitivity to measure whether tasks require understanding of code’s operational semantics vs. permit pattern matching shortcuts. Through a novel counterfactual measurement method, we show that models rely heavily on pattern matching shortcuts to solve existing code understanding benchmarks. We propose a new task SemTrace, which achieves high semantic recall sensitivity through unpredictable operations; LLMs’ accuracy exhibits severe positional effects, with median accuracy drops of 92.73% versus CRUXEval’s 53.36% as the relevant code snippet approaches the middle of the input code context. Our findings suggest current evaluations substantially underestimate semantic recall failures in long context code understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在理解庞大代码库方面得到了广泛应用，但尚不清楚这些模型是真正理解了长代码上下文中的操作语义，还是依赖于模式匹配捷径。我们将词汇检索（逐字提取代码）与语义检索（理解操作语义）区分开来。通过对10种最先进的语言模型进行评估，我们发现，虽然前沿模型能够实现近乎完美的、与位置无关的词汇检索，但当代码位于长文本的中间位置时，其语义检索能力会严重下降。我们引入了语义检索敏感性这一指标，以衡量任务是否需要理解代码的操作语义，还是允许使用模式匹配捷径。通过一种新颖的反事实测量方法，我们发现模型在解决现有的代码理解任务时，很大程度上依赖模式匹配捷径。我们提出了新的任务SemTrace，该任务通过不可预测的操作实现了高语义检索敏感性；语言模型的准确性表现出严重的位置效应，当相关代码片段接近输入文本的中间位置时，其准确率的中位数下降了92.73%，而CRUXEval的准确率仅为53.36%。我们的研究结果表明，当前的评估方法严重低估了长文本代码中语义检索失败的情况。

papers.title: SenseRel: A Sense-Level Benchmark for Denotational and Connotational Meaning Relations
papers.title_zh: SenseRel：面向外延与内涵意义关系的词义级基准
papers.authors: Pierluigi Cassotti, Naomi Baes, Stefano De Pascale, Jáder Martins Camboim de Sá, Francesco Periti, Nick Haslam, Dirk Geeraerts, Nina Tahmasebi
papers.abstract: Polysemy enables a single word to convey multiple related meanings, reflecting the conceptual and emotional aspects of the evolution of the senses. We introduce the first sense-level benchmark, SenseRel, for modeling semantic relations between word senses, uniting denotational and connotational aspects of meaning. SenseRel distinguishes denotational relations, such as generalization or metaphor, as well as two connotational dimensions: valence and arousal. We evaluate large language models (LLMs), GPT-4o, Llama 3.1, and DeepSeek, in zero-shot and fine-tuned settings. Results show that GPT-4o best aligns with human affective judgments, while a fine-tuned RoBERTa model excels at classifying denotational relations.
papers.abstract_zh: 多义性使得一个单词能够表达多种相关的含义，这反映了感官概念和情感方面的演变。我们推出了首个用于建模单词不同含义之间语义关系的基准工具——SenseRel。该工具同时考虑了意义的指称性和内涵性特征。SenseRel区分了指称关系，如概括或隐喻，以及两个内涵维度： valence和 arousal。我们对大语言模型（LLM）如GPT-4o、Llama 3.1和DeepSeek进行了零样本训练和微调测试。结果表明，GPT-4o在符合人类情感判断方面表现最佳，而经过微调的RoBERTa模型则在处理指称关系分类方面表现出色。

papers.title: WebSTAR: Scalable Data Synthesis for Computer Use Agents with Step-Level Filtering
papers.title_zh: WebSTAR：通过步骤级过滤为计算机使用智能体合成可扩展数据
papers.authors: Yifei He, Pranit Chawla, Yaser Souri, Subhojit Som, Xia Song
papers.abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs) can operate real-world digital interfaces but remain difficult to train due to the high cost of graphical user interface (GUI) interaction and the scarcity of high-quality trajectory data. Existing datasets rely on human demonstrations, limiting scalability. A natural alternative is to synthesize data from strong CUAs, yet their rollouts are highly noisy, with incorrect or suboptimal actions consisting a large proportion of the steps, making naive imitation ineffective. To tackle this challenge, we introduce a scalable data synthesis pipeline that transforms noisy rollouts into reliable supervision without human annotation. The core idea is step-level filtering, which evaluates actions individually to retain only correct steps, complemented by reasoning augmentation for improved planning. Using this pipeline, we construct WebSTAR, a dataset of 13.3K trajectories and 267K graded, reasoning-rich steps synthesized from OpenAI’s computer-use-preview model. We train Qwen-2.5-VL-Instruct models (7B and 32B) on WebSTAR. On WebVoyager, our 7B model surpasses SoTA open-source CUA model UI-TARS-1.5-7B by more than 15% with only supervised finetuning. Building on step-level grading, we further create WebSCORE, a dataset of graded step-level actions, and train StepRM, a 7B multimodal reward model distilled from o4-mini, which matches its grading quality while being far more efficient to deploy at scale. Our results establish step-level filtering as a key principle for scalable CUA training and construct two new datasets (WebSTAR, WebSCORE) and a lightweight reward model (StepRM) as practical tools to advance robust and efficient CUAs.
papers.abstract_zh: 计算机使用代理（CUAs）能够操作现实世界中的数字接口，但由于图形用户界面交互的成本高昂以及高质量轨迹数据的稀缺性，它们的训练过程仍然非常困难。现有的数据集依赖于人类示范数据，这限制了其可扩展性。一种自然的替代方法是从优秀的CUAs中合成数据，然而这些合成的示范数据往往存在噪声，其中很大一部分动作都是错误或不理想的，这使得简单的模仿变得无效。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种可扩展的数据合成流程，该流程能够将带有噪声的示范数据转化为无需人工注释即可使用的可靠监督数据。其核心思想是对每个步骤进行单独评估，只保留正确的步骤，并通过推理增强来改进规划过程。利用这一流程，我们构建了WebSTAR数据集，该数据集包含13.3K条轨迹和267K个具有丰富推理功能的分级步骤，这些数据是从OpenAI的计算机使用预览模型中合成出来的。我们在WebSTAR上训练了Qwen-2.5-VL-Instruct模型（7B和32B规模）。在WebVoyager测试中，我们的7B模型仅通过有监督的微调，就比开源CUA模型UI-TARS-1.5-7B的性能提升了超过15%。在此基础上，我们进一步创建了WebSCORE数据集，该数据集包含了分级的级步骤动作，并训练了StepRM模型，这是一个从o4-mini模型中提炼出的7B多模态奖励模型。该模型的性能与其分级质量相当，但在大规模部署时效率更高。我们的研究结果表明，级步骤过滤是可扩展CUA训练的关键原则，同时我们还构建了两个新的数据集（WebSTAR、WebSCORE）以及一个轻量级奖励模型（StepRM），这些工具有助于推动稳健且高效的CUAs的发展。

papers.title: PR-XAI: PageRank-Based Feature Attribution for Transformers
papers.title_zh: PR-XAI：基于PageRank的特征归因技术，适用于Transformer模型
papers.authors: Behrooz Azarkhalili, Linyi Li, Maxwell W. Libbrecht
papers.abstract: We introduce PR-XAI, a feature attribution method for transformer models based on the PageRank algorithm. The proposed PR-XAI models the attention mechanism as a directed graph, with weights derived from attention weights and their gradients. Evaluations across five well-known text classification datasets and three different architectures show that PR-AG, one variant of PR-XAI, outperforms state-of-the-art attribution methods in faithfulness and classification metrics, with significant gains on long-form text.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了PR-XAI这一基于PageRank算法的Transformer模型特征归因方法。该模型将注意力机制建模为有向图，权重来源于注意力权重及其梯度。在五个知名文本分类数据集和三种不同架构上的评估结果显示，PR-XAI的一个变体——PR-AG，在准确性和分类指标方面优于现有的归因方法，尤其在长文本处理上取得了显著优势。

papers.title: CAPruner: Conceptual-Adjacent Scene Graph Pruner for Enhancing 3D Spatial Reasoning of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: CAPruner：一种概念性相邻场景图剪枝算法，旨在提升大型语言模型的3D空间推理能力
papers.authors: Shengli Zhou, Xiangchen Wang, Guanhua Chen, Feng Zheng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to 3D vision-language (3D-VL) tasks, which require spatial reasoning to identify target objects relative to anchors. Scene graphs are commonly employed to represent such relations, but reasoning over complete graphs incurs high token costs and computational inefficiencies, motivating the need for pruning. Existing pruning methods primarily rely on spatial proximity and often remove task-relevant relations, thereby undermining reliable spatial reasoning. To address these limitations, we derive a key requirement for scene graph pruning: preserving spatial relations that are most pertinent to the specific 3D-VL task. Guided by this insight, we propose the Conceptual-Adjacent Scene Graph Pruner (CAPruner). CAPruner integrates fuzzy semantic relevance with spatial proximity to estimate the importance of relations, enabling the selection of critical relations in a task-specific context. Moreover, to avoid costly relation-level annotations, CAPruner is trained by supervising the aggregated scores of each node’s incident edges. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAPruner effectively preserves relations essential for spatial reasoning, leading to substantial performance improvements of LLMs on 3D-VL tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/fz-zsl/CAPruner.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）最近被应用于3D视觉语言任务中，这些任务需要空间推理来识别相对于锚点的目标物体。场景图常被用来表示这种关系，但对整个场景图的推理会带来较高的标记成本和计算效率问题，因此有必要进行剪枝操作。现有的剪枝方法主要依赖于空间邻近性，往往会移除与任务相关的关系，从而破坏可靠的空间推理能力。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种场景图剪枝的关键要求：保留与特定3D视觉语言任务最相关的空间关系。基于这一洞察，我们提出了概念相邻场景图剪枝器（CAPruner）。CAPruner将模糊语义相关性与空间邻近性结合起来，以评估关系的重要性，从而能够在特定任务的背景下选择关键关系。此外，为了避免昂贵的关系级注释，CAPruner通过监督每个节点所连接的边的聚合得分来进行训练。大量实验表明，CAPruner能够有效保留对空间推理至关重要的关系，从而显著提升了LLM在3D视觉语言任务上的性能。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/fz-zsl/CAPruner。

papers.title: MauBERT: Universal Phonetic Inductive Biases for Few-Shot Acoustic Units Discovery
papers.title_zh: MauBERT：面向少样本声学单元发现的通用语音归纳偏置
papers.authors: Angelo Ortiz Tandazo, Manel Khentout, Youssef Benchekroun, Thomas Hueber, Emmanuel Dupoux
papers.abstract: This paper introduces MauBERT, a multilingual extension of HuBERT that leverages articulatory features for robust cross-lingual phonetic representation learning. We continue HuBERT pre-training with supervision based on a phonetic-to-articulatory feature mapping in 55 languages. Our models learn from multilingual data to predict articulatory features or phones, resulting in language-independent representations that capture multilingual phonetic properties. Through comprehensive ABX discriminability testing, we show MauBERT models produce more context-invariant representations than state-of-the-art multilingual self-supervised learning models. Additionally, the models effectively adapt to unseen languages and casual speech with minimal self-supervised fine-tuning (10 hours of speech). This establishes an effective approach for instilling linguistic inductive biases in self-supervised speech models.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了MauBERT，它是HuBERT的多语言扩展版本，利用发音特征进行跨语言语音表示学习。我们在55种语言的语音到发音特征的映射基础上，继续对HuBERT进行预训练。我们的模型从多语言数据中学习发音特征或音位，从而得到能够捕捉多语言语音特性的、与语言无关的表示。通过全面的ABX可区分性测试，我们发现MauBERT模型产生的表示比目前最先进的多语言自监督学习模型具有更强的上下文不变性。此外，这些模型能够在几乎没有自监督微调的情况下（仅10小时的语音数据），有效适应新的语言和日常口语。这证明了这是一种在自监督语音模型中引入语言归纳偏见的有效方法。

papers.title: Your Reasoning Model Knows What Counts: Self-Guided Chain-of-Thought Pruning for Efficient Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 推理模型自知何者重要：通过自引导思维链剪枝实现高效推理
papers.authors: Zi-Ao Ma, Xian-Ling Mao, Tian Lan, Chen Xu, Zhijing Wu
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning is crucial for the performance of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) but is often hindered by redundant and distracting segments, which incur excessive inference costs and degrade robustness. Existing approaches try to solve this problem by enforcing brevity through external supervision, such as length-based penalties or heuristic truncation. However, these approaches often degrade performance because they disregard the model’s intrinsic reasoning dependency and thus fail to distinguish between essential and redundant CoT segments. To address this problem, we propose SGP-CoT, a novel Self-Guided Pruning framework that leverages the model’s intrinsic likelihood landscape to identify segments that are extraneous to its specific reasoning pattern. Specifically, SGP-CoT treats the reasoning trajectory as a sequence of semantic units and assesses the necessity of each one via internal likelihood signals, measuring its contribution to the answer and local coherence. Based on this, it selectively removes non-essential segments and then forms high-quality pruning-based preference pairs, enabling the model to learn focused reasoning via self-optimization. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed SGP-CoT significantly reduces output length while maintaining or improving accuracy. These results validate that LRMs intrinsically possess the capability to discern reasoning utility, positioning SGP-CoT as a robust pathway toward scalable inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链推理对于大型推理模型的性能提升至关重要，但往往受到冗余和干扰性片段的阻碍，这些片段会导致过高的推理成本并降低模型的鲁棒性。现有方法试图通过外部监督来强制简洁性，例如基于长度的惩罚或启发式截断。然而，这些方法往往会降低模型性能，因为它们忽略了模型内在的推理依赖性，因此无法区分重要的和冗余的思维链片段。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SGP-CoT这一新型的自引导剪枝框架。该框架利用模型内在的似然分布来识别与其特定推理模式无关的片段。具体来说，SGP-CoT将推理过程视为一系列语义单元，并通过内部似然信号来评估每个单元的必要性，同时衡量其对答案的贡献以及局部一致性。基于这些评估结果，SGP-CoT能够选择性地移除非必要的片段，然后形成高质量的剪枝偏好对，使模型能够通过自我优化实现专注的推理。在多种基准测试中的广泛实验表明，所提出的SGP-CoT能够在保持或提高准确性的同时显著减少输出长度。这些结果验证了大型推理模型本质上具备辨别推理有用性的能力，使得SGP-CoT成为实现可扩展推理的可靠途径。

papers.title: ImReasoner: Improving Memory-based Language Models for Reasoning-in-a-Haystack Tasks
papers.title_zh: ImReasoner：改进基于记忆的语言模型以解决干草堆推理任务
papers.authors: Ching-Yun Ko, Payel Das, Sihui Dai, Georgios Kollias, Subhajit Chaudhury, Aurelie C. Lozano, Pin-Yu Chen
papers.abstract: Reasoning over long contexts remains a major challenge for language models, particularly when solving tasks that require integrating multiple facts in sequence or generalizing to new distributions. We argue that this difficulty stems from a lack of structural inductive bias. Recently, alternative frameworks have been proposed to explicitly encode contexts as ordered memory and perform iterative retrieval to construct reasoning chains. Despite the promising results shown in prior arts, they are still heavily reliant on intermediate chain supervision and fall short in showing emergent reasoning generalization in the presence of hard distractions in reasoning-in-a-haystack tasks. Furthermore, we discover that as the amount of distractions increases, traditional episodic memory reads suffer from ill-conditioning problems, which lead to inaccurate context retrievals. In this work, we formalize the motivation for necessary inductive bias in reasoning-in-a-Haystack tasks, propose inference-time memory update procedures mimicking the “identify and remove unnecessary and unrelated details” in constructively responsive reading, introduce staged training inspired by human conceptual understanding, and finally demonstrate the possibilities and limits of such framework in the weakly supervised scenario.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于语言模型来说，处理长文本上下文仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是在需要整合多个事实或将其推广到新情境的任务中。我们认为，这一困难源于缺乏结构性归纳偏见。最近，一些替代框架被提出来，旨在将上下文作为有序的记忆进行编码，并通过迭代检索来构建推理链。尽管这些方法在先前的研究中取得了一些有希望的成果，但它们仍然严重依赖中间阶段的监督机制，并且在处理复杂任务时无法表现出有效的推理泛化能力。此外，我们发现，随着干扰因素的增加，传统的情景记忆机制会出现条件化问题，从而导致不准确的上下文检索。在这项研究中，我们明确了在“海堆推理”任务中必要归纳偏见的必要性，提出了类似于“识别并剔除不必要的无关细节”的推理时间记忆更新方法，引入了受人类概念理解启发的分阶段训练策略，并最终展示了这种框架在弱监督场景下的可能性和局限性。

papers.title: How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior
papers.title_zh: 记忆管理如何影响大语言模型智能体：经验遵循行为的实证研究
papers.authors: Zidi Xiong, Yuping Lin, Wenya Xie, Pengfei He, Zirui Liu, Jiliang Tang, Himabindu Lakkaraju, Zhen Xiang
papers.abstract: Memory is a critical component in large language model (LLM)-based agents, enabling them to store and retrieve past executions to improve task performance over time. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study on how memory management choices impact the LLM agents’ behavior, especially their long-term performance. Specifically, we focus on two fundamental memory management operations that are widely used by many agent frameworks—memory addition and deletion—to systematically study their impact on the agent behavior. Through our quantitative analysis, we find that LLM agents display an experience-following property: high similarity between a task input and the input in a retrieved memory record often results in highly similar agent outputs. Our analysis further reveals two significant challenges associated with this property: error propagation, where inaccuracies in past experiences compound and degrade future performance, and misaligned experience replay, where some seemingly correct executions can provide limited or even misleading value as experiences. Through controlled experiments, we demonstrate the importance of regulating experience quality within the memory bank and show that future task evaluations can serve as free quality labels for stored memory. Our findings offer insights into the behavioral dynamics of LLM agent memory systems and provide practical guidance for designing memory components that support robust, long-term agent performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 内存是基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体中的关键组件，它使得智能体能够存储和检索过去的执行结果，从而随着时间的推移提升任务性能。在本文中，我们进行了实证研究，探讨内存管理策略对LLM智能体行为的影响，尤其是它们长期性能的表现。具体来说，我们重点关注了许多智能体框架广泛使用的两种基本内存管理操作——内存添加和删除，以系统地研究它们对智能体行为的影响。通过我们的定量分析，我们发现LLM智能体具有一种“经验跟随”的特性：当任务输入与检索到的记忆记录中的输入高度相似时，智能体的输出也往往非常相似。我们的分析还揭示了与这一特性相关的两个主要挑战：错误传播，即过去经历中的不准确信息会不断累积并降低未来的性能；以及不匹配的经验重放，即某些看似正确的执行结果可能只能提供有限甚至误导性的价值。通过控制实验，我们证明了在内存库中调节经验质量的重要性，并表明未来的任务评估可以作为存储记忆的质量标签。我们的研究发现为理解LLM智能体内存系统的行为动态提供了重要见解，并为设计能够支持智能体长期稳定性能的记忆组件提供了实用指导。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SACTOR: LLM-Driven Correct and Idiomatic C to Rust Translation with Static Analysis and FFI-Based Verification
papers.title_zh: SACTOR：结合静态分析与外部函数接口验证的准确且地道的 C 到 Rust 语言模型翻译
papers.authors: Tianyang Zhou, Ziyi Zhang, Haowen Lin, Somesh Jha, Mihai Christodorescu, Kirill Levchenko, Varun Chandrasekaran
papers.abstract: Translating software written in C to Rust has significant benefits in improving memory safety. However, manual translation is cumbersome, error-prone, and often produces unidiomatic code. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated promise in producing idiomatic translations, but offer no correctness guarantees. We propose SACTOR, an LLM-driven C-to-Rust translation tool that employs a two-step process: an initial “unidiomatic” translation to preserve semantics, followed by an “idiomatic” refinement to align with Rust standards. SACTOR leverages static analysis of the C source to handle pointer semantics and dependency resolution. To validate correctness of our function-wise incremental translation that mixes C and Rust, we use end-to-end testing via the foreign function interface. We evaluate SACTOR on 200 programs from two public datasets and on two more complex scenarios (a 50-sample subset of CRust-Bench and the libogg library), comparing multiple LLMs. Across datasets, SACTOR delivers high end-to-end correctness and produces safe, idiomatic Rust with up to 7\times fewer Clippy warnings; On CRust-Bench, SACTOR achieves an average (across samples) of 85% unidiomatic and 52% idiomatic success, and on libogg it attains full unidiomatic and up to 78% idiomatic coverage on GPT-5.
papers.abstract_zh: 将用C语言编写的软件翻译成Rust语言在提升内存安全性方面具有显著优势。然而，手动翻译过程繁琐且容易出错，往往会产生不符合Rust语法的代码。大语言模型在生成符合Rust语法的翻译方面表现出一定的潜力，但无法保证翻译结果的准确性。我们提出了SACTOR这一由大语言模型驱动的C到Rust翻译工具，该工具采用两步流程：第一步是进行“非规范化”的翻译以保留原有语义，第二步则是进行“规范化”处理以符合Rust标准。SACTOR利用对C源代码的静态分析来处理指针语义和依赖关系解析问题。为了验证我们的增量式翻译方法的正确性，我们通过外部函数接口进行了端到端测试。我们在两个公开的数据集中的200个程序上评估了SACTOR的性能，并在另外两个复杂场景（CRust-Bench数据集中的50个样本子集以及libogg库）中进行了测试，同时比较了多种大语言模型的表现。在不同数据集上，SACTOR都展现了较高的端到端正确性，并且生成的Rust代码更加安全、符合语法规则，其Clippy警告的数量减少了多达7倍。在CRust-Bench数据集上，SACTOR在非规范化的翻译方面平均成功率为85%，而在规范化处理方面则达到了52%。在libogg库上，SACTOR在GPT-5模型上实现了100%的非规范化和高达78%的规范化处理覆盖率。

papers.title: IntrAgent: An LLM Agent for Content-Grounded Information Retrieval through Literature Review
papers.title_zh: IntrAgent：通过文献综述进行内容依据型信息检索的大语言模型智能体
papers.authors: Fengbo Ma, Zixin Rao, Xiaoting Li, Zhetao Chen, Hongyue Sun, Yiping Zhao, Xianyan Chen, Zhen Xiang
papers.abstract: Scientific research relies on accurate information retrieval from literature to support analytical decisions.In this work, we introduce a new task, INformation reTRieval through literAture reVIEW (IntraView), which aims to automate fine-grained information retrieval faithfully grounded in the provided content in response to research-driven queries, and propose IntrAgent, an LLM-based agent that addresses this challenging task.In particular, IntrAgent is designed to mimic human behaviors when reading literature for information retrieval - identifying relevant sections and then iteratively extracting key details to refine the retrieved information.It follows a two-stage pipeline: a Section Ranking stage that prioritizes relevant literature sections through structural-knowledge-enabled reasoning, and an Iterative Reading stage that continuously extracts details and synthesizes them into concise, contextually grounded answers.To support rigorous evaluation, we introduce IntraBench, a new benchmark consisting of 315 test instances built from expert-authored questions paired with literature spanning five STEM domains.Across seven backbone LLMs, IntrAgent achieves on average 13.2% higher cross-domain accuracy than state-of-the-art RAG and research-agent baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学研究依赖于从文献中准确检索信息，以支持分析决策。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新的任务——通过文献检索进行信息检索（IntraView）。该任务的目的是自动化对提供内容进行细粒度的信息检索，以响应研究驱动的查询。同时，我们提出了IntrAgent这一基于大语言模型的智能体，用于完成这项具有挑战性的任务。特别地，IntrAgent旨在模仿人类在检索信息时的行为模式——识别相关章节，然后逐步提取关键细节以完善所检索到的信息。它的工作流程分为两个阶段：第一阶段是章节排序阶段，通过结构知识辅助的推理来优先选择相关的文献章节；第二阶段是迭代阅读阶段，持续提取细节并将它们整合成简洁、符合上下文的回答。为了支持严格的评估，我们引入了新的基准测试IntraBench，该测试包含315个测试实例，这些实例由专家提出的问题与涵盖五个STEM领域的文献组成。在七种主流大语言模型中，IntrAgent的平均跨领域准确率比现有的RAG技术和研究智能体基线高出13.2%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reasoning over Precedents Alongside Statutes: Case-Augmented Deliberative Alignment for LLM Safety
papers.title_zh: 结合法规推理先例：面向大语言模型安全的案例增强审议对齐
papers.authors: Can Jin, Rui Wu, Tong Che, Qixin Zhang, Hongwu Peng, Jiahui Zhao, Zhenting Wang, Wenqi Wei, Ligong Han, Zhao Zhang, Yuan Cao, Ruixiang Tang, Dimitris N. Metaxas
papers.abstract: Ensuring that Large Language Models (LLMs) adhere to safety principles without refusing benign requests remains a significant challenge. While OpenAI introduces deliberative alignment (DA) to enhance the safety of its o-series models through reasoning over detailed “code-like” safety rules, the effectiveness of this approach in open-source LLMs, which typically lack advanced reasoning capabilities, is understudied. In this work, we systematically evaluate the impact of explicitly specifying extensive safety codes versus demonstrating them through illustrative cases. We find that referencing explicit codes inconsistently improves harmlessness and systematically degrades helpfulness, whereas training on case-augmented simple codes yields more robust and generalized safety behaviors. By guiding LLMs with case-augmented reasoning instead of extensive code-like safety rules, we avoid rigid adherence to narrowly enumerated rules and enable broader adaptability. Building on these insights, we propose CADA, a case-augmented deliberative alignment method for LLMs utilizing reinforcement learning on self-generated safety reasoning chains. CADA effectively enhances harmlessness, improves robustness against attacks, and reduces over-refusal while preserving utility across diverse benchmarks, offering a practical alternative to rule-only DA for improving safety while maintaining helpfulness.
papers.abstract_zh: 确保大语言模型遵循安全原则，同时不会拒绝有益的请求，仍然是一个重大挑战。虽然OpenAI引入了“审议式对齐”机制，通过推理详细的“类似代码”的安全规则来提高其o系列模型的安全性，但这种方法在缺乏高级推理能力开源语言模型中是否有效，尚未得到充分研究。在这项研究中，我们系统地评估了明确指定广泛的安全规则与通过示例案例来展示这些规则的影响。我们发现，明确引用安全规则虽然能提升模型的无害性，但会系统性地降低其实用性；而通过案例训练来制定简单的安全规则则能产生更稳健、更具通用性的安全行为。通过用案例推理来指导语言模型，而不是依赖复杂的类似代码的安全规则，我们可以避免僵化地遵循有限的规则，从而实现更广泛的适应性。基于这些发现，我们提出了CADA方法——一种利用强化学习对自生成的安全推理链进行处理的、针对语言模型的审议式对齐方法。CADA能够有效提升模型的无害性，增强其对攻击的抵抗力，并减少过度拒绝的情况，同时在各种基准测试中保持良好的实用性，为仅依赖规则的审议式对齐方法提供了一种实用的替代方案，从而在提升安全性的同时保持实用性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Hybrid Autoregressive-Diffusion Model for Real-Time Sign Language Production
papers.title_zh: 用于实时手语合成的混合自回归-扩散模型
papers.authors: Maoxiao Ye, Xinfeng Ye, Sathiamoorthy Manoharan
papers.abstract: Earlier Sign Language Production (SLP) models typically relied on autoregressive methods that generate output tokens one by one, which inherently provide temporal alignment. Although techniques like Teacher Forcing can prevent model collapse during training, they still cannot solve the problem of error accumulation during inference, since ground truth is unavailable at that stage. In contrast, more recent approaches based on diffusion models leverage step-by-step denoising to enable high-quality generation. However, the iterative nature of these models and the requirement to denoise entire sequences limit their applicability in real-time tasks like SLP. To address it, we propose a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion model for Sign Language Production (SLP), combining sequential dependency modeling with iterative refinement. A Multi-Scale Pose Representation module captures fine-grained articulator features, while a Confidence-Aware Causal Attention mechanism guides generation using joint-level confidence scores. Experiments on PHOENIX14T and How2Sign show improved generation quality and real-time efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 早期的手语生成模型通常依赖于自回归方法，这些方法会依次生成输出符号，从而实现了时间上的对齐。虽然像“教师强制”这样的技术可以在训练过程中防止模型崩溃，但它们仍然无法解决推理阶段错误累积的问题，因为此时无法获得准确的真实数据。相比之下，基于扩散模型的较新方法通过逐步去噪来实现高质量的生成。然而，这些模型的迭代特性以及需要对整个序列进行去噪的要求，限制了它们在实时手语生成任务中的适用性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种混合自回归-扩散模型用于手语生成，该模型结合了序列依赖建模和迭代优化技术。多尺度姿态表示模块能够捕捉精细的发音器官特征，而基于置信度的因果注意力机制则利用联合层面的置信度来指导生成过程。在PHOENIX14T和How2Sign数据集上的实验表明，这种模型在生成质量和实时效率方面都取得了显著改善。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Augur: Modeling Covariate Causal Associations in Time Series via Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: Augur：利用大型语言模型来建模时间序列中的协变量与因果关系
papers.authors: Zhiqing Cui, Binwu Wang, Qingxiang Liu, Yeqiang Wang, Zhengyang Zhou, Yuxuan Liang, Yang Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLM) have emerged as a promising avenue for time series forecasting, offering the potential to integrate multimodal data. However, existing LLM-based approaches face notable limitations—such as marginalized role in model architectures, reliance on coarse statistical text prompts, and lack of interpretability. In this work, we introduce Augur, a fully LLM driven time series forecasting framework that exploits LLM causal reasoning to discover and use directed causal associations among covariates. Augur uses a two stage teacher student architecture where a powerful teacher LLM infers a directed causal graph from time series using heuristic search together with pairwise causality testing. A lightweight student agent then refines the graph and fine tune on high confidence causal associations that are encoded as rich textual prompts to perform forecasting. This design improves predictive accuracy while yielding transparent, traceable reasoning about variable interactions. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets with 25 baselines demonstrate that Augur achieves competitive performance and robust zero-shot generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在时间序列预测领域展现出巨大的潜力，它们能够整合多种模态的数据。然而，现有的基于语言模型的预测方法存在诸多局限性：例如在模型架构中的角色较为边缘化，依赖粗糙的统计文本提示，且缺乏可解释性。在这项研究中，我们提出了Augur这一完全由语言模型驱动的时间序列预测框架。该框架利用语言模型的因果推理能力，来发现并利用协变量之间的有向因果关系。Augur采用两阶段的教学-学生架构：强大的教师语言模型通过启发式搜索和成对因果关系测试，从时间序列中推断出有向因果图；而轻量级的学生代理则对这张图进行优化，并专注于那些被编码为丰富文本提示的高置信度因果关系，从而进行预测。这种设计不仅提升了预测准确性，还使得变量之间关系的推理过程更加透明且可追溯。在真实世界数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，Augur在性能方面表现出色，并且具备出色的零样本泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AgentRouter: A Knowledge-Graph-Guided LLM Router for Collaborative Multi-Agent Question Answering
papers.title_zh: AgentRouter：一种基于知识图谱的LLM路由系统，适用于协作式多智能体问答场景
papers.authors: Zheyuan Zhang, Kaiwen Shi, Zhengqing Yuan, Zehong Wang, Tianyi Ma, Keerthiram Murugesan, Vincent Galassi, Chuxu Zhang, Yanfang Ye
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and agent-based frameworks have advanced rapidly, enabling diverse applications. Yet, with the proliferation of models and agentic strategies, practitioners face substantial uncertainty in selecting the best configuration for a downstream task. Prior studies show that different agents and backbones exhibit complementary strengths, and that larger models are not always superior, underscoring the need for adaptive routing mechanisms. Existing approaches to agent routing, however, often emphasize cost efficiency while overlooking the fine-grained contextual and relational structure inherent in QA tasks. In this paper, we propose AgentRouter, a framework that formulates multi-agent QA as a knowledge-graph–guided routing problem supervised by empirical performance signals. Specifically, we convert QA instance into a heterogeneous knowledge graph that jointly encodes queries, contextual entities, and agents, and then train a heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) to propagate information across node types and produce task-aware routing distributions over agents. By leveraging soft supervision and weighted aggregation of agent outputs, AgentRouter learns principled collaboration schemes that capture the complementary strengths of diverse agents. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms single-agent and ensemble baselines, while generalizing across benchmarks and LLM backbones. These results highlight the effectiveness and robustness of graph-supervised multi-agent routing for question answering. Our code repo is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgentRouter.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）和基于代理的框架已经取得了飞速的发展，使得各种应用成为可能。然而，随着模型和代理策略的日益增多，实践者在选择最适合特定任务的配置时面临着巨大的不确定性。先前的研究表明，不同的代理和主干模型具有互补的优势，而较大的模型并不总是更优，这凸显了需要自适应路由机制的需求。不过，现有的代理路由方法往往注重成本效率，而忽视了问答任务中固有的细粒度上下文和关系结构。在本文中，我们提出了AgentRouter这一框架，它将多智能体问答问题转化为一个由知识图谱引导的路由问题，并通过实证性能信号来进行监督。具体来说，我们将问答实例转换为一个异构的知识图谱，该图谱同时编码了查询、上下文实体和代理，然后训练一个异构图神经网络来传播信息，并生成针对代理的任务感知路由分布。通过利用软监督和代理输出的加权聚合，AgentRouter能够学习到捕捉不同代理互补优势的协作方案。大量的实验表明，我们的框架始终优于单代理和集成基线方法，而且在不同基准测试和LLM主干模型上都能表现出良好的性能。这些结果充分证明了图结构监督下的多智能体路由在问答任务中的有效性和鲁棒性。我们的代码仓库可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgentRouter获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MoCa: Modality-aware Continual Pre-training Makes Better Bidirectional Multimodal Embeddings
papers.title_zh: MoCa：基于模式感知的持续预训练技术，能够生成更优秀的双向多模态嵌入向量
papers.authors: Haonan Chen, Hong Liu, Yuping Luo, Liang Wang, Nan Yang, Furu Wei, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Multimodal embedding models, built upon causal Vision Language Models (VLMs), have shown promise in various tasks. However, current approaches face three limitations: causal attention in VLM backbones is suboptimal for embedding tasks; scalability issues due to reliance on high-quality labeled paired data for contrastive learning; and limited diversity in training objectives and data. To address these issues, we propose MoCa, a two-stage framework for transforming pre-trained VLMs into bidirectional multimodal embedding models. The first stage, Modality-aware Continual Pre-training, introduces a joint reconstruction objective that simultaneously denoises interleaved texts and images, enhancing bidirectional context-aware reasoning. The second stage, Heterogeneous Contrastive Fine-tuning, leverages diverse, semantically rich multimodal data beyond simple image-caption pairs to enhance generalization and alignment. Our method addresses the stated limitations by introducing bidirectional attention through continual pre-training, scaling effectively with massive unlabeled datasets via joint reconstruction objectives, and utilizing diverse multimodal data for enhanced representation robustness. Experiments demonstrate that MoCa consistently improves performance across MMEB and ViDoRe-v2 benchmarks, achieving new state-of-the-arts, and exhibits strong scalability with both model size and training data on MMEB.We have released the model weights and data on our project page https://haon-chen.github.io/MoCa/.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于因果视觉语言模型的多模态嵌入模型在多种任务中表现出良好的性能。然而，当前的方法存在三个局限性：视觉语言模型中的因果注意力对于嵌入任务来说效果不佳；由于依赖高质量的标记配对数据来进行对比学习，因此存在可扩展性问题；此外，训练目标和数据的多样性也有限。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了MoCa这一两阶段框架，用于将预训练的视觉语言模型转换为双向多模态嵌入模型。第一阶段是“模态感知持续预训练”，该阶段引入了一个联合重建目标，能够同时去噪文本和图像之间的干扰信息，从而增强双向上下文感知能力。第二阶段是“异构对比式微调”，该阶段利用多样化的、语义丰富的多模态数据，而不仅仅是简单的图像-文字对，以提高模型的泛化能力和对齐效果。我们的方法通过持续预训练引入双向注意力机制，能够有效扩展至大规模无标签数据集，并利用多样化的多模态数据来提高模型的鲁棒性。实验表明，MoCa在MMEB和ViDoRe-v2基准测试中始终表现出良好的性能，达到了最新的技术水平，并且在模型规模和训练数据方面都具有很强的可扩展性。我们已经在项目的页面上发布了模型权重和数据，地址为https://haon-chen.github.io/MoCa/。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ReEx-SQL: Reasoning with Execution-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: ReEx-SQL：基于执行感知的强化学习技术，用于文本与SQL语句的转换
papers.authors: Yaxun Dai, Wenxuan Xie, Xialie Zhuang, Tianyu Yang, Ziyi Liu, Haiqin Yang, Yiying Yang, Yuhang Zhao, Pingfu Chao, Wenhao Jiang
papers.abstract: Current Text-to-SQL reasoning models often lack integrated execution feedback during generation, and most existing approaches utilize feedback only for post-hoc correction. This separation not only limits real-time error correction, but may also introduce mistakes by altering otherwise correct SQL queries. To address these challenges, we present ReEx-SQL (Reasoning with Execution-Aware Reinforcement Learning), a Text-to-SQL framework that interacts with the SQL execution engine during decoding and dynamically adjusts reasoning based on execution feedback, thereby enabling context-sensitive query refinement and improved accuracy. ReEx-SQL achieves this through structured prompts with markup tags and a stepwise rollout strategy that incorporates execution feedback at each generation stage. For policy supervision, we design a composite reward function—featuring an exploration reward—to explicitly encourage effective interaction with the database. Furthermore, ReEx-SQL adopts a tree-based decoding strategy to facilitate exploratory reasoning and primarily aims to enhance parallel decoding efficiency. Notably, ReEx-SQL achieves 89.1% accuracy on Spider and 65.3% on BIRD at the 7B scale, surpassing baseline models by 2.7% and 2.6%, respectively. In addition, its tree-based decoding accelerates inference by 51.9% compared to linear decoding during sampling.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的文本转SQL推理模型在生成过程中往往缺乏整合的执行反馈，而大多数现有方法仅使用事后反馈来进行修正。这种分离不仅限制了实时错误修正的能力，还可能通过修改原本正确的SQL查询来引入错误。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ReEx-SQL（基于执行感知的强化学习推理系统），这是一个在解码过程中与SQL执行引擎交互的文本转SQL框架，它能够根据执行反馈动态调整推理过程，从而实现针对上下文的查询优化和更高的准确性。ReEx-SQL通过带有标记标签的结构化提示以及分阶段实施策略来实现这一目标，该策略在每一阶段都融入了执行反馈。在策略监督方面，我们设计了一个复合奖励函数——包含探索奖励——以明确鼓励与数据库的有效互动。此外，ReEx-SQL采用基于树的解码策略来促进探索性推理，其主要目标是提高并行解码效率。值得注意的是，ReEx-SQL在7B规模的数据集上取得了89.1%的准确率，而在BIRD数据集上的准确率为65.3%，分别比基线模型高出2.7%和2.6%。另外，其基于树的结构化解码方式使得推理速度比线性解码快了51.9%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DecIF: Improving Instruction-Following through Decomposition
papers.title_zh: DecIF：通过分解来提高遵循指示的能力
papers.authors: Tingfeng Hui, Pengyu Zhu, Bowen Ping, Ling Tang, Guanting Dong, Yaqi Zhang, Sen Su
papers.abstract: We propose a novel data synthesis framework, DecIF, which automatically generates accurate and diverse instruction-following data from scratch for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), leveraging large language models (LLMs) and minimal external resources. By decomposing the data synthesis pipeline into fine-grained steps, DecIF achieves meticulous quality and diversity control over generated instruction-following data. Extensive experiments across both SFT and RL demonstrate DecIF’s strong capability to flexibly synthesize accurate instruction-following data for both paradigms compared to comprehensive baselines. Further analysis demonstrates the framework’s robustness, scalability, and computational efficiency in instruction-following data generation, while its modular design ensures straightforward implementation and reproducibility.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的数据合成框架——DecIF。该框架能够自动从零开始生成准确且多样化的指令遵循数据，用于监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）任务。它利用大语言模型（LLM）以及极少的外部资源来实现这一功能。通过将数据合成流程分解为多个细粒度步骤，DecIF能够实现对生成数据的精确质量和多样性控制。在SFT和RL领域的广泛实验中，我们发现DecIF在灵活合成准确指令遵循数据方面表现出强大的能力，其性能优于现有的综合基准算法。进一步的分析表明，该框架在指令遵循数据生成方面具有鲁棒性、可扩展性和计算效率高等优点。同时，其模块化设计确保了实施的简便性和结果的可重复性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: NavA^3: Understanding Any Instruction, Navigating Anywhere, Finding Anything
papers.title_zh: NavA^3：理解任何指令，畅游任何地方，找到任何东西
papers.authors: Lingfeng Zhang, Xiaoshuai Hao, Yingbo Tang, Haoxiang Fu, Xinyu Zheng, Pengwei Wang, Zhongyuan Wang, Wenbo Ding, Shanghang Zhang
papers.abstract: Embodied navigation is a fundamental capability of embodied intelligence, enabling robots to move and interact within physical environments. However, existing navigation tasks primarily focus on predefined object navigation or instruction following, which significantly differs from human needs in real-world scenarios involving complex, open-ended scenes. To bridge this gap, we introduce a challenging long-horizon navigation task that requires understanding high-level human instructions and performing spatial-aware object navigation in real-world environments. Existing embodied navigation methods struggle with such tasks due to their limitations in comprehending high-level human instructions and localizing objects with an open vocabulary. In this paper, we propose NavA^3, a hierarchical framework divided into two stages: global and local policies. In the global policy, we leverage the reasoning capabilities of Reasoning-VLM to parse high-level human instructions and integrate them with global 3D scene views. This allows us to reason and navigate to regions most likely to contain the goal object. In the local policy, we have collected a dataset of 1.0 million samples of spatial-aware object affordances to train the NaviAfford model (PointingVLM), which provides robust open-vocabulary object localization and spatial awareness for precise goal identification and navigation in complex environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NavA^3 achieves SOTA results in navigation performance and can successfully complete long-horizon navigation tasks across different robot embodiments in real-world settings, paving the way for universal embodied navigation. The dataset and code will be made available.
papers.abstract_zh: 具身导航是具身智能的一项基本能力，它使机器人能够在物理环境中移动和互动。然而，现有的导航任务主要集中在预定义的物体导航或指令遵循上，这与人类在现实世界中的需求有很大差异，因为现实世界中的场景往往具有复杂性且需要灵活应对。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种具有挑战性的长视距导航任务，该任务要求机器人理解人类的高层次指令，并在现实环境中进行具有空间感知能力的物体导航。现有的具身导航方法在应对此类任务时存在困难，因为它们在理解人类高层次指令以及定位具有开放词汇表的物体方面存在局限性。在本文中，我们提出了NavA^3框架，该框架分为两个阶段：全局策略和局部策略。在全局策略阶段，我们利用Reasoning-VLM的推理能力来解析人类的高层次指令，并将其与全局3D场景视图相结合。这样，我们就可以推理并导航到最有可能包含目标物体的区域。在局部策略阶段，我们收集了100万个具有空间感知能力的物体行为的样本数据，用于训练NaviAfford模型（PointingVLM）。该模型能够实现对具有开放词汇表的物体的精确定位以及空间感知能力，从而在复杂环境中实现目标的精准识别与导航。大量的实验表明，NavA^3在导航性能方面取得了卓越的成绩，并且能够在现实世界中成功完成各种机器人形态的长时间距离导航任务，为通用型具身导航技术的发展铺平了道路。我们的数据集和代码将会被公开提供。
