papers.title: FastV-RAG: Towards Fast and Fine-Grained Video QA with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: FastV-RAG：通过检索增强生成技术实现快速且细粒度的视频问答系统
papers.authors: Gen Li, Peiyu Liu
papers.abstract: Vision–Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual reasoning but still struggle with external knowledge integration. Retrieval-Augmented Generation(RAG) is a promising solution, but current methods remain inefficient and often fail to maintain high answer quality. To address these challenges, we propose VideoSpeculateRAG, an efficient VLM-based RAG framework built on two key ideas. First, we introduce a speculative decoding pipeline: a lightweight draft model quickly generates multiple answer candidates, which are then verified and refined by a more accurate heavyweight model, substantially reducing inference latency without sacrificing correctness. Second, we identify a major source of error, incorrect entity recognition in retrieved knowledge, and mitigate it with a simple yet effective similarity-based filtering strategy that improves entity alignment and boosts overall answer accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that VideoSpeculateRAG achieves comparable or higher accuracy than standard RAG approaches, while speeding up the inference by approximately 2x. Our framework highlights the potential of combining speculative decoding with retrieval-augmented reasoning to enhance efficiency and reliability in complex, knowledge-intensive multimodal tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型在视觉推理方面表现出色，但在外部知识整合方面仍然存在困难。检索增强生成是一种有前景的解决方案，但当前的方法效率较低，且常常无法保持较高的答案质量。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了VideoSpeculateRAG这一基于视觉-语言模型的检索增强生成框架。该框架基于两个关键思想构建：首先，我们引入了一种推测性解码流程：一个轻量级的草稿模型能够快速生成多个答案候选方案，然后由更精确的重型模型对这些候选方案进行验证和修正，从而大幅降低推理延迟，同时不牺牲准确性。其次，我们发现了一个主要的错误来源——检索到的知识中存在错误的实体识别问题，我们通过一种简单而有效的基于相似性的过滤策略来解决这个问题，该策略能够改善实体对齐效果，并提高整体答案的准确性。实验表明，VideoSpeculateRAG在准确性和速度方面均优于传统的检索增强生成方法，其推理速度大约提高了2倍。我们的框架展示了将推测性解码与检索增强推理相结合的可能性，这种组合方式能够在复杂、知识密集型的多模态任务中提升效率和可靠性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Efficient Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography via Range Coding
papers.title_zh: 通过范围编码实现高效且安全的语言隐写技术
papers.authors: Ruiyi Yan, Yugo Murawaki
papers.abstract: Linguistic steganography involves embedding secret messages within seemingly innocuous texts to enable covert communication. Provable security, which is a long-standing goal and key motivation, has been extended to language-model-based steganography. Previous provably secure approaches have achieved perfect imperceptibility, measured by zero Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, but at the expense of embedding capacity. In this paper, we attempt to directly use a classic entropy coding method (range coding) to achieve secure steganography, and then propose an efficient and provably secure linguistic steganographic method with a rotation mechanism. Experiments across various language models show that our method achieves around 100% entropy utilization (embedding efficiency) for embedding capacity, outperforming the existing baseline methods. Moreover, it achieves high embedding speeds (up to 1554.66 bits/s on GPT-2). The code is available at github.com/ryehr/RRC_steganography.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言隐写术涉及将秘密信息嵌入看似无用的文本中，以实现隐蔽通信。可证明的安全性一直是一个长期的目标和关键动机，这一理念已被应用于基于语言模型的隐写技术中。以往那些被证明安全的算法能够实现完美的不可察觉性，其衡量标准是零的Kullback-Leibler散度，但代价是牺牲了嵌入容量。在本文中，我们尝试直接使用经典的熵编码方法（范围编码）来实现安全隐写，并提出了一种高效且可证明安全的语言隐写方法，该方法包含旋转机制。实验表明，我们的方法在嵌入容量方面实现了约100%的熵利用率，优于现有的基线方法。此外，该方法还具备较高的嵌入速度，在GPT-2上可达到1554.66比特每秒。代码可在github.com/ryehr/RRC_steganography获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Uni-MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Unified Benchmark
papers.title_zh: Uni-MMMU：一个庞大的多学科、多模态统一基准测试平台
papers.authors: Kai Zou, Ziqi Huang, Yuhao Dong, Shulin Tian, Dian Zheng, Hongbo Liu, Jingwen He, Bin Liu, Yu Qiao, Ziwei Liu
papers.abstract: Unified multimodal models aim to jointly enable visual understanding and generation, yet current benchmarks rarely examine their true integration. Existing evaluations either treat the two abilities in isolation or overlook tasks that inherently couple them. To address this gap, we present Uni-MMMU, a comprehensive and discipline-aware benchmark that systematically unfolds the bidirectional synergy between generation and understanding across eight reasoning-centric domains, including science, coding, mathematics, and puzzles. Each task is bidirectionally coupled, demanding models to (i) leverage conceptual understanding to guide precise visual synthesis, or (ii) utilize generation as a cognitive scaffold for analytical reasoning. Uni-MMMU incorporates verifiable intermediate reasoning steps, unique ground truths, and a reproducible scoring protocol for both textual and visual outputs. Through extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art unified, generation-only, and understanding-only models, we reveal substantial performance disparities and cross-modal dependencies, offering new insights into when and how these abilities reinforce one another, and establishing a reliable foundation for advancing unified models.
papers.abstract_zh: 统一多模态模型旨在实现视觉理解与生成的协同运作，但目前的评估标准很少关注它们之间的真正整合情况。现有的评估方法要么单独对待这两种能力，要么忽略了那些将两者紧密联系起来的任务。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Uni-MMMU——一个全面且考虑学科特性的评估基准。该基准系统地考察了生成与理解之间的双向协同效应，涵盖了科学、编程、数学和谜题等八个领域。每个任务都包含双向耦合特性，要求模型能够：(i) 利用概念理解来指导精确的视觉合成；(ii) 将生成过程作为分析推理的认知基础。Uni-MMMU包含了可验证的中间推理步骤、独特的真实值，以及适用于文本和视觉输出的可重复评分方案。通过对最先进的单一生成模型、单一理解模型和双重功能模型进行广泛评估，我们发现这些模型在性能上存在显著差异，并且存在跨模态依赖性。这些发现为我们揭示了这些能力何时以及如何相互强化，为推进统一模型的发展提供了可靠的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MemSearch-o1: Empowering Large Language Models with Reasoning-Aligned Memory Growth in Agentic Search
papers.title_zh: MemSearch-o1：通过符合推理逻辑的记忆扩展机制，助力大型语言模型在智能搜索领域发挥更强的能力
papers.authors: Sheng Zhang, Junyi Li, Yingyi Zhang, Pengyue Jia, Yichao Wang, Xiaowei Qian, Wenlin Zhang, Maolin Wang, Yong Liu, Xiangyu Zhao
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have scaled the potential for reasoning and agentic search, wherein models autonomously plan, retrieve, and reason over external knowledge to answer complex queries. However, the iterative think–search loop accumulates long system memories, leading to memory dilution problem. In addition, existing memory management methods struggle to capture fine-grained semantic relations between queries and documents and often lose substantial information. Therefore, we propose MemSearch-o1, an agentic search framework built on reasoning-aligned memory growth and retracing. MemSearch-o1 dynamically grows fine-grained memory fragments from memory seed tokens from the queries, then retraces and deeply refines the memory via a contribution function, and finally reorganizes a globally connected memory path. This shifts memory management from stream-like concatenation to structured, token-level growth with path-based reasoning. Experiments on eight benchmark datasets show that MemSearch-o1 substantially mitigates memory dilution, and more effectively activates the reasoning potential of diverse LLMs, establishing a solid foundation for memory-aware agentic intelligence.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展极大地提升了推理和智能搜索的能力。这些模型能够自主规划、检索并利用外部知识来回答复杂的查询问题。然而，这种迭代式的思考与搜索过程会积累大量的系统内存，从而导致内存稀释的问题。此外，现有的内存管理方法在捕捉查询与文档之间的细微语义关系方面存在困难，常常会导致大量信息的丢失。因此，我们提出了MemSearch-o1这一智能搜索框架。该框架基于与推理相一致的记忆增长和回溯机制运作。MemSearch-o1能够从查询中生成的记忆种子节点动态生成细粒度的记忆片段，然后通过贡献函数对记忆进行深度优化，最后重新组织成一条具有全局连接性的记忆路径。这样，内存管理就从类似流式的串联方式转变为结构化的、以节点级增长的模式进行，同时还能实现基于路径的推理功能。在八个基准数据集上的实验表明，MemSearch-o1显著减少了内存稀释的问题，并更有效地激活了各种LLM的推理能力，为具备记忆意识的智能体提供了坚实的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CAPC-CG: A Large-Scale, Expert-Directed LLM-Annotated Corpus of Adaptive Policy Communication in China
papers.title_zh: CAPC-CG：一个大规模的、由专家审核的LLM注释语料库，专注于中国领域的自适应政策沟通相关文本
papers.authors: Bolun Sun, Charles Chang, Yuen Yuen Ang, Ruotong Mu, Yuchen Xu, Zhengxin Zhang, Pingxu Hao
papers.abstract: We introduce CAPC-CG, the Chinese Adaptive Policy Communication (Central Government) Corpus, the first open dataset of Chinese policy directives annotated with a five-color typology of policy signals, capturing clarity and ambiguity, grounded in the theory of adaptive policy communication. Spanning 1949–2023, this corpus includes laws, regulations, and rules issued by Chinese central authorities, segmented into 3.3 million paragraph units. We further propose and validate an expert-directed LLM annotation method that integrates codebook design, structured training, a two-step workflow, and LLM-based scaling. Alongside the corpus, we release metadata and a gold-standard labeled set developed by trained coders. Inter-annotator agreement achieves a Fleiss’ kappa of κ = 0.86 on directive labels, indicating high reliability. We provide baseline classification results with several large language models (LLMs), together with our codebook, and describe patterns from the data. This release enables downstream tasks and multilingual NLP research in communication strategies under complexity and uncertainty.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了CAPC-CG——中文自适应政策沟通语料库，这是首个开放的中文政策指令数据集，其中使用了五种颜色来表示政策信号的类型学，以体现政策的清晰性与模糊性，这一研究基于自适应政策沟通理论。该语料库涵盖了1949年至2023年间由中国中央政府发布的法律法规，被划分为330万个段落单元。我们还提出了一种由专家指导的大语言模型注释方法，该方法包括代码书设计、结构化训练、两步工作流程以及基于大语言模型的扩展机制。除了语料库之外，我们还发布了元数据，以及由训练有素的数据员们创建的权威标注集。不同注释者之间的一致性达到了Fleiss的κ=0.86，表明标注结果的可靠性很高。我们提供了使用多种大语言模型进行分类的结果，同时附上了我们的代码书，并描述了数据中的模式。这个发布为后续任务以及在多语言环境下对沟通策略的研究提供了支持，尤其是在复杂性和不确定性较高的情境下。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MathFlow: Enhancing the Perceptual Flow of MLLMs for Visual Mathematical Problems
papers.title_zh: MathFlow：提升视觉数学问题处理中的感知流畅性
papers.authors: Shuhang Chen, Hangjie Yuan, Yunqiu Xu, Pengwei Liu, Tao Feng, Jun Cen, Zeying Huang, Yi Yang
papers.abstract: Despite strong results on many tasks, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still underperform on visual mathematical problem solving, especially in reliably perceiving and interpreting diagrams. Inspired by human problem-solving, we hypothesize that the ability to extract meaningful information from diagrams is pivotal, as it directly conditions subsequent inference.Hence, we introduce FlowVerse, a comprehensive benchmark that provides a fine-grained evaluation of MLLMs’ perception and reasoning capabilities. Our preliminary results on FlowVerse reveal that existing MLLMs exhibit substantial limitations when extracting essential information and reasoned properties from diagrams and performing complex reasoning based on these visual inputs. In response, we introduce MathFlow, a modular problem-solving pipeline that decouples perception and inference into distinct stages, thereby optimizing each independently. Given the perceptual limitations observed in current MLLMs, we trained MathFlow-P-7B as a dedicated perception model.Experimental results indicate that MathFlow-P-7B yields substantial performance gains when integrated with various closed-source and open-source inference models. This demonstrates the effectiveness of the MathFlow pipeline and its compatibility with diverse inference frameworks. Project page: https://github.com/MathFlow-zju/MathFlow.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在许多任务上取得了优异的成绩，但多模态大语言模型在解决视觉数学问题方面仍然表现不佳，尤其是在可靠地感知和解释图表方面。受人类解决问题能力的启发，我们认为从图表中提取有意义信息的能力至关重要，因为这直接决定了后续的推理过程。因此，我们推出了FlowVerse这一全面的基准测试工具，它能够对大语言模型的感知能力和推理能力进行细致评估。我们在FlowVerse上的初步测试结果显示，现有的大语言模型在从图表中提取关键信息和基于这些视觉输入进行复杂推理方面存在显著局限性。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了MathFlow这一模块化问题解决流程，它将感知和推理过程分离为不同的阶段，从而分别优化每个环节。鉴于当前大语言模型在感知方面的局限性，我们训练了MathFlow-P-7B作为专门的感知模型。实验结果表明，当MathFlow-P-7B与各种闭源和开源推理模型结合使用时，其性能得到了显著提升。这证明了MathFlow流程的有效性以及它与多种推理框架的兼容性。项目页面：https://github.com/MathFlow-zju/MathFlow。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Anchored Sliding Window: Toward Robust and Imperceptible Linguistic Steganography
papers.title_zh: 锚定滑动窗口：实现稳健且难以被察觉的语言隐写技术
papers.authors: Ruiyi Yan, Shiao Meng, Yugo Murawaki
papers.abstract: Linguistic steganography based on language models typically assumes that steganographic texts are transmitted without alteration, making them fragile to even minor modifications. While previous work mitigates this fragility by limiting the context window, it significantly compromises text quality. In this paper, we propose the anchored sliding window (ASW) framework to improve imperceptibility and robustness. In addition to the latest tokens, the prompt and a bridge context are anchored within the context window, encouraging the model to compensate for the excluded tokens. We formulate the optimization of the bridge context as a variant of prompt distillation, which we further extend using self-distillation strategies. Experiments show that our ASW significantly and consistently outperforms the baseline method in text quality, imperceptibility, and robustness across diverse settings. The code is available at github.com/ryehr/ASW_steganography.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于语言模型的语言隐写技术通常假设隐写文本在传输过程中不会发生改变，因此即使进行微小的修改也会使文本变得脆弱。虽然之前的研究通过限制上下文窗口来减轻这种脆弱性，但这会显著降低文本的质量。在本文中，我们提出了锚定滑动窗口框架（ASW），以提高隐写文本的不可感知性和鲁棒性。除了最新的标记外，提示语和桥梁上下文也被固定在上下文窗口内，这有助于模型对被排除的标记进行补偿。我们将桥梁上下文的优化问题转化为提示语蒸馏的变体，并进一步采用自蒸馏策略对其进行扩展。实验表明，我们的ASW在文本质量、不可感知性和鲁棒性方面均显著优于基线方法，且在不同环境下都能表现出良好的性能。代码可在github.com/ryehr/ASW_steganography获取。

papers.title: What Makes Good Instruction-Tuning Data? An In-Context Learning Perspective
papers.title_zh: 什么才是优质的教学调整数据？从情境学习的角度来审视这个问题
papers.authors: Guangzeng Han, Xiaolei Huang
papers.abstract: Instruction-tuning datasets often contain substantial redundancy and low-quality samples, necessitating effective data selection methods. We propose an instruction data selection framework based on weighted in-context influence (wICI), which measures how effectively each candidate example reduces instruction-following difficulty for semantically related peers. Through systematic experiments, we address three key questions: what constitutes effective instruction tuning data from an in-context perspective, whether sample difficulty correlates with in-context influence, and how in-context influence translates to instruction tuning effectiveness. Experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing baselines under constrained data budgets, while empirically showing that sample difficulty negatively correlates with in-context influence.
papers.abstract_zh: 指令调整数据集通常包含大量冗余和低质量的样本，因此需要有效的数据选择方法。我们提出了一种基于加权上下文影响力（wICI）的指令数据选择框架，该框架能够衡量每个候选样本在降低语义相关样本的指令遵循难度方面的效果。通过系统的实验，我们探讨了三个关键问题：从上下文影响的角度来看，什么才算是有效的指令调整数据；样本难度是否与上下文影响力有关；上下文影响力如何转化为指令调整的效果。在多个模型和基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法在有限的数据预算下始终优于现有的基线方法，同时实证结果显示样本难度与上下文影响力呈负相关。

papers.title: RoBSA: RoPE-based Blockwise Sparse Multi-head Latent Attention
papers.title_zh: RoBSA：基于RoPE的块式稀疏多头潜在注意力机制
papers.authors: Xinyu Shi, Kairong Luo, Zhen Zheng, Wenguang Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have rapidly advanced in recent years, scaling up in both parameter count and context length. However, as context windows extend from thousands to hundreds of thousands of tokens, attention computation becomes the dominant source of memory usage and runtime in decoding stages, severely limiting the efficiency and scalability of long-context LLMs. Sparse attention has emerged as a promising solution, reducing complexity by computing attention over only a subset of context tokens. However, the sparse attention for Multi-head Latent Attention(MLA) which is a variant of standard MHA is rarely studied. In this paper, we introduce RoPE-based Blockwise Sparse Attention (RoBSA), a method designed specifically for MLA during the decoding stage of model inference. RoBSA leverages the decoupled nature of RoPE within MLA to implement token selection in a blockwise manner. RoBSA is a lightweight, training-free, and layer-aware algorithm that can be integrated in a plug-and-play fashion. Our method significantly reduces end-to-end inference latency in the decoding stage by up to 2.55x with minimal accuracy loss compared to full attention in long-context scenarios for very large models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在近年来取得了显著的进展，其参数数量和上下文长度都得到了极大的扩展。然而，当上下文窗口从数千个令牌扩展到数十万个令牌时，注意力计算就成为了解码阶段内存使用和运行时间的主要来源，这严重限制了长上下文LLM的效率和可扩展性。稀疏注意力作为一种有前景的解决方案出现了，它通过仅对部分上下文令牌进行计算来降低计算复杂度。不过，针对多头潜在注意力机制（MLA）的稀疏注意力机制却很少被研究。在本文中，我们提出了基于RoPE的块状稀疏注意力机制（RoBSA），这是一种专为MLA在模型推理的解码阶段设计的算法。RoBSA利用了RoPE在MLA中的解耦特性，以块状方式实现令牌选择。RoBSA是一种轻量级、无需训练且考虑层级的算法，可以轻松集成到系统中。与全注意力机制相比，我们的方法在长上下文场景下能够显著减少端到端推理的延迟，延迟减少了2.55倍，同时几乎不会造成精度损失。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: XtraGPT: Context-Aware and Controllable Academic Paper Revision via Human-AI Collaboration
papers.title_zh: XtraGPT：通过人类与人工智能的协作实现上下文感知且可控制的学术论文修改工作
papers.authors: Nuo Chen, Andre Lin HuiKai, Jiaying Wu, Junyi Hou, Zining Zhang, Qian Wang, Xidong Wang, Bingsheng He
papers.abstract: Despite the growing adoption of large language models (LLMs) in academic workflows, their capabilities remain limited in supporting high-quality scientific writing. Most existing systems are designed for general-purpose scientific text generation and fail to meet the sophisticated demands of research communication beyond surface-level polishing, for example, maintaining conceptual coherence across sections. Furthermore, academic writing is inherently iterative and revision-driven, a process that is not well supported by direct prompting-based paradigms. To address these scenarios, we propose a human-AI collaboration framework for academic paper revision, centered on criteria-guided intent alignment and context-aware modeling. To validate the framework, we curate a dataset of 7,000 research papers from top-tier venues, annotated with 140,000 instruction–response pairs that reflect realistic, section-level scientific revisions. We instantiate the framework in XtraGPT, the first suite of open-source LLMs (1.5B to 14B parameters) specifically fine-tuned for context-aware academic paper revision. Extensive experiments show that XtraGPT significantly outperforms same-scale baselines and rivals the quality of proprietary counterparts. Both automated preference assessments and human evaluations confirm the effectiveness of XtraGPT in improving scientific drafts. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/Xtra-Computing/XtraGPT and https://huggingface.co/collections/Xtra-Computing/xtragpt.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在学术工作流程中的应用日益广泛，但其能力在支持高质量科学写作方面仍然有限。大多数现有系统都是为通用科学文本生成而设计的，无法满足研究交流中超出表面润色的需求，例如保持各章节之间的概念连贯性。此外，学术写作本质上是迭代性和修订驱动的，而基于直接提示的范式并不能很好地支持这一过程。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了一种人类与人工智能协作的论文修订框架，该框架以基于标准引导的意图对齐和上下文感知建模为核心。为了验证这一框架的有效性，我们从顶级期刊中收集了7,000篇研究论文的数据集，并对这些论文进行了140,000对指令-响应注释，这些注释反映了真实的、针对章节层面的科学修订过程。我们在XtraGPT中实现了这一框架，XtraGPT是一套开源的大语言模型（参数范围从1.5B到14B），专门针对上下文感知的论文修订进行了微调。广泛的实验表明，XtraGPT在性能上显著优于同规模的其他基线模型，其质量甚至可以与专有模型相媲美。无论是自动偏好评估还是人工评估都证实了XtraGPT在改进科学草稿方面的有效性。我们的代码和模型可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/Xtra-Computing/XtraGPT 和 https://huggingface.co/collections/Xtra-Computing/xtragpt。

papers.title: Learn to Relax with Large Language Models: Solving Constraint Optimization Problems via Bidirectional Coevolution
papers.title_zh: 通过双向共同进化来学习如何放松：利用大型语言模型解决约束优化问题
papers.authors: Beidan Liu, Zhengqiu Zhu, Chen Gao, Tianle Pu, Yong Zhao, Wei Qi, Quanjun Yin
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based optimization has recently shown promise for autonomous problem solving, yet most approaches still cast LLMs as passive constraint checkers rather than proactive strategy designers, limiting their effectiveness on complex Constraint Optimization Problems (COPs). To address this, we present AutoCO, an end-to-end Automated Constraint Optimization method that tightly couples operations-research principles of constraint relaxation with LLM reasoning. A core innovation is a unified triple-representation that binds relaxation strategies, algorithmic principles, and executable codes. This design enables the LLM to synthesize, justify, and instantiate relaxation strategies that are both principled and executable. To navigate fragmented solution spaces, AutoCO employs a bidirectional global–local coevolution mechanism, synergistically coupling Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for global relaxation-trajectory exploration with Evolutionary Algorithms (EAs) for local solution intensification. This continuous exchange of priors and feedback explicitly balances diversification and intensification, thus preventing premature convergence. Extensive experiments on three challenging COP benchmarks validate AutoCO’s consistent effectiveness and superior performance, especially in hard regimes where current methods degrade. Results highlight AutoCO as a principled and effective path toward proactive, verifiable LLM-driven optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的优化方法在自主问题解决方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，目前大多数方法仍然将LLM视为被动的约束检查器，而非主动的策略设计者，这限制了它们在复杂约束优化问题上的效果。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了AutoCO——一种端到端的自动化约束优化方法。该方法将约束松弛的操作性研究原则与LLM推理相结合。我们的核心创新在于采用统一的三重表示机制，将松弛策略、算法原理以及可执行代码紧密结合起来。这种设计使得LLM能够综合、论证并实例化出既符合原则又具有可实施性的松弛策略。为了应对复杂的解决方案空间，AutoCO采用了一种双向的全局-局部协同进化机制：通过蒙特卡洛树搜索来探索全局松弛轨迹，同时通过进化算法来强化局部解决方案的优化。这种持续的先验信息与反馈交换机制能够有效平衡多样性和针对性，从而避免过早收敛。在三个具有挑战性的约束优化基准测试上进行的广泛实验验证了AutoCO的持续有效性和卓越性能，尤其是在当前方法表现不佳的困难情况下。这些结果表明，AutoCO是一种既遵循原则又具备有效性的方法，能够为LLM驱动的主动优化提供有力的支持。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Game-Theoretic Negotiation Framework for Cross-Cultural Consensus
papers.title_zh: 一种用于促进跨文化共识的博弈论协商框架
papers.authors: Guoxi Zhang, Jiawei Chen, Tianzhuo Yang, Jiaming Ji, Yaodong Yang, Juntao Dai
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are shaping global values, yet they frequently exhibit a pronounced WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) cultural bias, marginalizing diverse viewpoints and posing challenges for reconciling diverse populations with varying cultural backgrounds and value systems. In this work, we move beyond simple alignment methods to propose a new paradigm for cross-cultural fairness. We introduce a Nash Consensus Negotiation framework under the formulation of cross-cultural consensus as a Nash Equilibrium. Each LLM iteratively proposes and refines natural-language guidelines, guided by a utility function balancing self-consistency with mutual acceptance, while penalizing redundancy. The process expands the proposal space and converges to a consensus, yielding fair and interpretable consensus outcomes. We evaluate our framework against baselines using quantitative metrics, qualitative analysis, and large-scale human studies. Experiments demonstrate that our framework generates higher-quality and more balanced consensus, effectively mitigating assimilation toward WEIRD values. Furthermore, we finetune diverse LLM architectures with negotiation data via preference optimization and supervised reasoning, reducing cultural distances by up to 95.53%. Overall, our work offers a systematic path to mitigate cultural bias in LLMs by guiding them toward self-consistency, mutually-acceptable equilibria.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正在塑造全球价值观，但它们往往表现出明显的西方化、教育程度高、工业化、富裕和民主的文化偏见，这导致不同观点被边缘化，同时也给协调具有不同文化背景和价值观的多样化人群带来了挑战。在这项研究中，我们超越了简单的对齐方法，提出了一种实现跨文化公平的新范式。我们引入了一种纳什共识协商框架，将跨文化共识视为一个纳什均衡。每个语言模型都会迭代地提出并完善自然语言指南，这一过程由一个效用函数指导，该函数平衡了自我一致性与相互接受性，同时避免了冗余信息的产生。这个过程扩展了提案空间，最终达成共识，从而得出公平且可解释的共识结果。我们通过定量指标、定性分析和大规模人类研究来评估我们的框架与基准方法的差异。实验表明，我们的框架能够生成质量更高、更平衡的共识结果，有效缓解了向西方化、教育程度高、工业化、富裕和民主价值观的融合趋势。此外，我们还通过偏好优化和监督推理技术，利用协商数据对多种语言模型架构进行了微调，使得文化差距减少了高达95.53%。总体而言，我们的研究为通过引导语言模型走向自我一致性、相互可接受的均衡状态，来减轻文化偏见提供了系统性的途径。

papers.title: Focusing Condition: Inference-Time Self-Contrastive Steering Elicits Better Conditional Text Embeddings in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 聚焦条件：推理时刻的自对比导向方法能够确保在大语言模型中得到更优质的条件文本嵌入效果
papers.authors: Zifeng Cheng, Lingyun Qian, Zhiwei Jiang, Cong Wang, Yafeng Yin, Fei Shen, Ao Zhou, Qing Gu
papers.abstract: Extracting conditional text embeddings from large language models (LLMs) is a promising paradigm, as it requires neither additional data nor fine-tuning. Existing methods incorporate conditions into prompts to guide LLMs to focus on specific aspects and elicit conditional text embeddings. However, relying solely on prompts often fails to produce high-quality conditional text embeddings, as they remain entangled with general text embeddings, ultimately degrading their quality. To this end, we propose an inference-time, plug-and-play Self-Contrastive Steering (SCS) method that constructs unconditional general text embeddings and uses them to refine conditional text embeddings, making them more focused on the target condition. Specifically, we modify the attention mask and positional encodings to mask the condition, thereby obtaining unconditional text embeddings and intervening in the multi-head self-attention computation process. Notably, our method is highly efficient, requiring only a single additional multi-head self-attention computation at inference time. Extensive experiments on clustering, Semantic Textual Similarity, and triplet alignment datasets demonstrate that our method can seamlessly improve the performance of existing prompt-based methods across different LLMs in a training-free and plug-and-play manner.
papers.abstract_zh: 从大语言模型中提取条件文本嵌入是一种有前景的方法，因为它不需要额外的数据或微调。现有的方法通过将条件因素纳入提示中，引导大语言模型专注于特定方面，从而获取条件文本嵌入。然而，仅仅依赖提示往往无法获得高质量的条件文本嵌入，因为这些嵌入仍然与通用文本嵌入交织在一起，最终导致其质量下降。为此，我们提出了一种推理时即插使用的自对比导向方法，该方法能够构建无条件的通用文本嵌入，并利用这些嵌入来优化条件文本嵌入，使其更加聚焦于目标条件。具体来说，我们通过修改注意力掩码和位置编码来屏蔽条件信息，从而获得无条件的文本嵌入，并介入多头自注意力计算过程。值得注意的是，我们的方法非常高效，仅在推理時に进行一次多头自注意力计算即可。在聚类、语义文本相似性和三元组对齐数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法能够在无需训练的情况下，以即插使用的方式显著提升不同大语言模型中现有基于提示的方法的性能。

papers.title: Exploring Attention Attractors in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 探索大型语言模型中的注意力吸引因素
papers.authors: Ziheng Wang, Zihao Yue, Wenxuan Wang, Qin Jin
papers.abstract: This paper explores attention attractors—tokens that draw significantly high attention—in large language models. We analyze them from three perspectives: (1) Functionality: We demonstrate their role in aggregating information from preceding contexts to facilitate future predictions. (2) Distribution: Through layer-wise and token-wise analysis, we reveal that attention attractors are widely distributed across layers but predominantly originate from low-semantic words like “_the”. (3) Mechanism: We demonstrate the correlation between attention weights allocated to tokens with their specific activation dimension values. We hope these findings provide new insights into the attention mechanisms of large language models and inspire further exploration. Code will be released at https://github.com/luyouqi233/AttentionAttractor.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了大语言模型中的注意力吸引子——那些能够吸引大量关注的词汇。我们从三个角度对其进行分析：(1) 功能特性：我们揭示了这些词汇在整合先前上下文信息以辅助未来预测中的作用。(2) 分布特征：通过逐层及逐词汇的分析，我们发现注意力吸引子在各个层次中都有广泛分布，但主要来源于像“_the”这样的低语义词汇。(3) 机制原理：我们证明了分配给特定词汇的注意力权重与其具体的激活维度值之间存在关联。我们希望这些发现能为理解大语言模型的注意力机制提供新的见解，并激发进一步的探索。代码可访问https://github.com/luyouqi233/AttentionAttractor。

papers.title: Identifying the Periodicity of Information in Natural Language
papers.title_zh: 识别自然语言中信息的周期性特征
papers.authors: Yulin OU, Yu Wang, Yang Xu, Hendrik Buschmeier
papers.abstract: Recent theoretical advancement of information density in natural language has brought the following question on desk: To what degree does natural language exhibit periodicity pattern in its encoded information? We address this question by introducing a new method called AutoPeriod of Surprisal (APS). APS adopts a canonical periodicity detection algorithm and is able to identify any significant periods that exist in the surprisal sequence of a single document. By applying the algorithm to a set of corpora, we have obtained the following interesting results: Firstly, a considerable proportion of human language demonstrates a strong pattern of periodicity in information; Secondly, new periods that are outside the distributions of typical structural units in text (e.g., sentence boundaries, elementary discourse units, etc.) are found and further confirmed via harmonic regression modeling. We conclude that the periodicity of information in language is a joint outcome from both structured factors and other driving factors that take effect at longer distances. The advantages of our periodicity detection method and its potentials in LLM-generation detection are further discussed.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近关于自然语言信息密度理论的研究取得了以下进展：自然语言在编码的信息中究竟表现出多少周期性模式？我们通过引入一种名为“自动周期性检测算法”（AutoPeriod of Surprisal，简称APS）的新方法来解决这个问题。该算法采用了一种标准的周期性检测算法，能够识别出单个文档中的任何显著周期性模式。通过对一组语料库应用该算法，我们得到了以下有趣的结果：首先，人类语言中有相当大比例的信息呈现出明显的周期性模式；其次，我们发现了一些位于文本中典型结构单元分布之外的新的周期性模式（例如句子边界、基本话语单位等），并通过谐波回归建模进一步证实了这些发现。我们认为，语言中信息的周期性是由结构化因素和其他在更长距离上起作用的驱动因素共同导致的。此外，我们还讨论了我们的周期性检测方法在LLM生成检测中的优势及其潜在应用前景。

papers.title: EmoHarbor: Evaluating Personalized Emotional Support by Simulating the User’s Internal World
papers.title_zh: EmoHarbor：通过模拟用户的内心世界来评估个性化的情感支持服务
papers.authors: Jing Ye, Lu Xiang, Yaping Zhang, Chengqing Zong
papers.abstract: Current evaluation paradigms for emotional support conversations tend to reward generic empathetic responses, yet they fail to assess whether the support is genuinely personalized to users’ unique psychological profiles and contextual needs. We introduce EmoHarbor, an automated evaluation framework that adopts a User-as-a-Judge paradigm by simulating the user’s inner world. EmoHarbor employs a Chain-of-Agent architecture that decomposes users’ internal processes into three specialized roles, enabling agents to interact with supporters and complete assessments in a manner similar to human users. We instantiate this benchmark using 100 real-world user profiles that cover diverse personality traits and situations, and define 10 evaluation dimensions of personalized support quality. Comprehensive evaluation of 20 advanced LLMs on EmoHarbor reveals a critical insight: while these models excel at generating empathetic responses, they consistently fail to tailor support to individual user contexts. This finding reframes the central challenge, shifting research focus from merely enhancing generic empathy to developing truly user-aware emotional support. EmoHarbor provides a reproducible and scalable framework to guide the development and evaluation of more nuanced and user-aware emotional support systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，对于情感支持对话的评估方式往往倾向于奖励那些泛化的、缺乏个性化的回应。然而，这些评估方式无法判断所提供的支持是否真正符合用户的独特心理特征和情境需求。我们提出了EmoHarbor这一自动化评估框架，它采用“用户作为评判者”的模式，通过模拟用户的内部世界来进行评估。EmoHarbor采用了一种“代理链”架构，将用户的内部过程分解为三个专门的角色，使得代理能够像人类用户一样与支持者互动并完成评估任务。我们使用了100个真实世界的用户档案来构建这个评估基准，这些档案涵盖了 다양한性格特征和环境情况，同时定义了10个用于评估个性化支持质量的维度。对20个先进的大语言模型在EmoHarbor上的评估结果显示了一个关键发现：虽然这些模型在生成富有同情心的回应方面表现出色，但它们始终无法根据每个用户的特定情境来定制支持方案。这一发现重新定义了核心挑战，使研究重点从单纯提升泛化同理心转向开发真正考虑到用户需求的情感支持系统。EmoHarbor提供了一个可复制且可扩展的框架，有助于推动更加细致且考虑用户需求的情感支持系统的开发和评估。

papers.title: ReasonEmbed: Enhanced Text Embeddings for Reasoning-Intensive Document Retrieval
papers.title_zh: ReasonEmbed：适用于需要大量推理的文档检索的增强型文本嵌入技术
papers.authors: Jianlyu Chen, Junwei Lan, Chaofan Li, Defu Lian, Zheng Liu
papers.abstract: In this paper, we introduce ReasonEmbed, a novel text embedding model developed for reasoning-intensive document retrieval. Our work includes three key technical contributions. First, we propose ReMixer, a new data synthesis method that overcomes the triviality problem prevalent in previous synthetic datasets, enabling large-scale production of 82K high-quality training samples. Second, we design Redapter, a self-adaptive learning algorithm that dynamically adjusts training each sample’s weight based on its reasoning intensity. This allows the model to effectively capture the complex semantic relationships between queries and documents. Third, we implement ReasonEmbed across multiple backbones of varying sizes, all of which achieve superior performance on reasoning-intensive retrieval tasks. Notably, our ReasonEmbed-Qwen3-8B model offers a record-high nDCG@10 score of 38.1 on the BRIGHT benchmark, which significantly outperforms existing text embedding models. We will fully open-source our created resource in ReasonEmbed to push forward the research advancement in this field.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了ReasonEmbed这一新型文本嵌入模型，该模型专为需要推理能力的文档检索而设计。我们的研究包含三个关键的技术创新点。首先，我们提出了ReMixer这一新的数据合成方法，该方法解决了以往合成数据集中存在的问题，能够大规模生成82K个高质量训练样本。其次，我们设计了Redapter这一自适应学习算法，它能够根据每个样本的推理强度动态调整其权重，从而让模型能够有效捕捉查询与文档之间的复杂语义关系。第三，我们将ReasonEmbed应用于多种不同规模的基模型中，这些模型在需要推理能力的检索任务上均表现出卓越的性能。值得注意的是，我们的ReasonEmbed-Qwen3-8B模型在BRIGHT基准测试中的nDCG@10得分达到了38.1的纪录，这一成绩显著优于现有的文本嵌入模型。我们将完全开源我们的ReasonEmbed资源，以推动该领域的研究进展。

papers.title: SPAGBias: Uncovering and Tracing Structured Spatial Gender Bias in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SPAGBias：揭示并追踪大型语言模型中的结构化空间性别偏见
papers.authors: Binxian Su, Haoye Lou, Shucheng Zhu, Weikang Wang, Ying Liu, Dong Yu, Pengyuan Liu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are being increasingly used in urban planning, but since gendered space theory highlights how gender hierarchies are embedded in spatial organization, there is concern that LLMs may reproduce or amplify such biases. We introduce SPAGBias — the first systematic framework to evaluate spatial gender bias in LLMs. It combines a taxonomy of 62 urban micro-spaces, a prompt library, and three diagnostic layers: explicit (forced-choice resampling), probabilistic (token-level asymmetry), and constructional (semantic and narrative role analysis). Testing six representative models, we identify structured gender-space associations that go beyond the public-private divide, forming nuanced micro-level mappings. Story generation reveals how emotion, wording, and social roles jointly shape “spatial gender narratives”. We also examine how prompt design, temperature, and model scale influence bias expression. Tracing experiments indicate that these patterns are embedded and reinforced across the model pipeline (pre-training, instruction tuning, and reward modeling), with model associations found to substantially exceed real-world distributions. Downstream experiments further reveal that such biases produce concrete failures in both normative and descriptive application settings. This work connects sociological theory with computational analysis, extending bias research into the spatial domain and uncovering how LLMs encode social gender cognition through language.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在城市规划领域得到了越来越多的应用。然而，由于性别空间理论指出性别等级是如何嵌入到空间组织中的，人们担心这些模型可能会复制或放大这种偏见。我们提出了SPAGBias——首个用于评估语言模型中性别偏见的系统框架。该框架结合了62种城市微空间的分类、提示库以及三个诊断层次：显性层面（强制选择的重采样）、概率层面（词元级别的不对称性）以及构建层面（语义和叙事角色分析）。通过对六个代表性模型的测试，我们发现存在结构化的性别与空间关联，这些关联超越了公共与私人的界限，形成了细致入微的微观层面的映射关系。故事生成过程揭示了情感、措辞和社会角色如何共同塑造“空间性别叙事”。我们还研究了提示设计、温度参数以及模型规模对偏见表达的影响。实验结果表明，这些模式贯穿于模型的整个训练流程中，并且模型所建立的关联远远超出了现实世界的分布情况。后续实验进一步表明，这种偏见会在规范性和描述性应用场景中导致具体的失败现象。这项工作将社会学理论与计算分析相结合，将偏见研究扩展到空间领域，并揭示了语言模型如何通过语言表达社会性别认知。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VALU: A Benchmark for Video Anomaly Temporal Localization and Understanding at Multiple Semantic Levels
papers.title_zh: VALU：一种用于视频异常检测的时间局部化及多语义层次理解的方法论基准
papers.authors: Yixiao He, Menghao Zhang, Haifeng Sun, Jing Wang, Kangheng Lin, Jinghan Wang, Chenye Xu, Pengfei Ren, Qi Qi, Jingyu Wang
papers.abstract: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) is critical for real-world scenarios. Recent advances in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) enhance the ability of VAU models to describe and interpret anomalies. However, progress in anomaly localization is still limited by two key issues. First, most existing video anomaly datasets only annotate segments that are clearly inconsistent with the context, often omitting subsequent segments that are semantically part of the same abnormal event. Second, the field lacks systematic evaluation protocols. To bridge these gaps, we introduce VALU, a new benchmark that explicitly defines anomalies across five semantic levels and provides comprehensive temporal boundaries and detailed textual descriptions for each. Based on these annotations, we design three evaluation tasks that comprehensively assess models’ capabilities across different dimensions, including temporal grounding, anomaly localization, and anomaly detail discrimination. Evaluation results reveal persistent challenges in current models’ capabilities on VAU. We further analyze and discuss these findings, and hope that both VALU and insights will advance research in VAU and the development of Video-LLMs. Our benchmark will be publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频异常理解技术在实际应用中至关重要。近年来，视频大语言模型在异常描述与解释能力方面取得了显著进展，但异常定位方面的进展仍受到两个关键问题的限制。首先，现有的视频异常数据集通常只标注那些与上下文明显不符的片段，而往往忽略了那些在语义上属于同一异常事件的后续片段。其次，该领域缺乏系统的评估协议。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了VALU这一新的基准测试，该测试明确定义了五个语义层面的异常，并为每个异常提供了完整的时间边界和详细的文本描述。基于这些注释，我们设计了三项评估任务，以全面评估模型在不同维度上的能力，包括时间定位、异常定位以及异常细节识别等方面。评估结果显示，当前模型在视频异常理解方面的能力仍存在诸多挑战。我们将进一步分析和讨论这些发现，希望VALU及其研究成果能够推动视频异常理解领域的研究发展，并促进视频大语言模型的开发。我们的基准测试将公开提供。

papers.title: CoreGaze: Core Subgraph-Driven Visual Gaze Diffusion for Training-Free Referring Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: CoreGaze：基于核心子图驱动的视觉注视扩散技术，用于无需训练的跨模态大语言模型训练
papers.authors: Xiaoyang Yi, Jing Chen, Yuru Bao, Jian Zhang
papers.abstract: Referring multimodal large language models enable users to ground queries to specific image regions via spatial prompts, supporting fine-grained referring dialogue. However, existing methods rely on extensive fine-tuning to mitigate attention distraction, which incurs high computational costs and limits adaptability. Without sufficient training data, irrelevant regions in single images easily divert model focus, leading to redundant outputs or hallucinations. To address this, we propose CoreGaze, a training-free framework that simulates human visual gaze diffusion for fine-grained comprehension. First, CoreGaze constructs a sparse semantic graph from visual tokens, modeling region-wise affinities via thresholded similarity. It then maps the user’s visual prompt to a core subgraph with amplified initial influence, which drives a degree-normalized diffusion process using restart-equipped random walks to propagate relevance to contextual neighborhoods. This process prunes irrelevant tokens while preserving user-indicated targets and semantically linked context, distilling a focused yet comprehensive subgraph. Finally, CoreGaze fuses this subgraph with prompt tokens in the frozen large language model decoder, facilitating fine-grained referring generation. Experimental results show that CoreGaze achieves outstanding performance in multiple referring dialogue tasks, showcasing its effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型能够让用户通过空间提示将查询定位到特定的图像区域，从而实现细粒度的引用对话。然而，现有方法依赖于大量的微调来减少注意力分散的问题，但这会带来较高的计算成本，并限制模型的适应性。如果没有足够的训练数据，单个图像中的无关区域很容易干扰模型的注意力，导致冗余的输出或幻觉现象。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CoreGaze这一无需训练的框架，它能够模拟人类视觉注视的扩散过程，以实现细粒度的理解。首先，CoreGaze从视觉标记中构建出一个稀疏的语义图，通过阈值化相似度来建模不同区域的关联性。然后，它将用户的视觉提示映射到一个核心子图中，该子图具有增强的初始影响力，从而利用带有重启机制的随机游走来传播相关性到上下文环境中。这个过程会剔除无关的标记，同时保留用户指定的目标和语义相关的上下文信息，最终得到一个既集中又全面的子图。最后，CoreGaze将这个子图与冻结的大语言模型解码器中的提示标记融合在一起，从而实现细粒度的引用生成。实验结果表明，CoreGaze在多个引用对话任务中表现优异，证明了其有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RespiraMFM: A Multimodal Foundation Model with Contrastive Audio-Language Alignment for Respiratory Disease Identification
papers.title_zh: RespiraMFM：一种基于多模态基础模型的方法，通过对比音频-语言对齐技术来识别呼吸系统疾病
papers.authors: Shakhrul Iman Siam, Tiantian Feng, Jiankun Zhang, Shrikanth Narayanan, Mi Zhang
papers.abstract: Respiratory diseases remain a leading cause of global mortality, where timely and accurate diagnosis is critical to improving patient outcomes and reducing healthcare burdens. While prior work has explored audio-based models for respiratory disease detection, such unimodal approaches often suffer from limited generalizability and diagnostic precision. In this paper, we propose RespiraMFM, a Multimodal Foundation Model that integrates respiratory sounds with patient medical history and symptoms to enhance diagnostic accuracy and disease detection capabilities. We introduce an effective contrastive alignment strategy for audio-text multimodal integration, allowing the model to learn better cross-modal representations between respiratory sounds and corresponding textual clinical information. We evaluate RespiraMFM across five major respiratory diseases using seven real-world datasets in both supervised fine-tuning and zero-shot settings, achieving a 9.15% improvement in AUROC on supervised tasks and a 20.98% gain on zero-shot tasks over existing baselines. These findings underscore the potential of our framework to advance early diagnosis and improve clinical decision-making in respiratory disease management.
papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸系统疾病仍然是全球死亡的主要原因之一，及时准确的诊断对于改善患者预后和减轻医疗负担至关重要。虽然之前的研究已经探索了基于音频的呼吸系统疾病检测模型，但这种单一模式的方法往往存在泛化能力有限和诊断精度不足的问题。在本文中，我们提出了RespiraMFM这一多模态基础模型，该模型将呼吸声音与患者的病史和症状相结合，以提高诊断准确性和疾病检测能力。我们提出了一种有效的音频-文本多模态整合对比对齐策略，使模型能够更好地理解呼吸声音与相应文本临床信息之间的跨模态表示关系。我们在七个真实世界数据集上评估了RespiraMFM在五种主要呼吸系统疾病中的性能，无论是在监督式微调还是零样本模式下，该模型在监督任务上的AUROC提升了9.15%，在零样本任务上则提升了20.98%。这些研究结果凸显了我们框架在促进早期诊断和改善呼吸系统疾病管理中的临床决策制定方面的潜力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Detection: Evaluating Fallacy Awareness of LLMs in Interactive Scenarios
papers.title_zh: 超越检测范围：评估大型语言模型在互动场景中的谬误识别能力
papers.authors: Conghui Niu, Ningxin Wu, Ziran Zhao, Dong Yu, Chen Kang, Pengyuan Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often fail to recognize fallacious reasoning in real-world interactions, despite strong performance on static fallacy detection tasks. We define this ability as fallacy awareness, the capacity to autonomously perceive and resist fallacies in dynamic, pragmatic contexts. To study this, we introduce ISFallacy, a large-scale Chinese benchmark of 50K interactive scenarios spanning six fallacy types, five social interaction settings, diverse role relationships, and personality traits. We further propose FATE, a two-stage evaluation framework that assesses fallacy awareness without explicit cues, combining natural dialogue responses and reasoning-based decisions. Experiments on five representative LLMs reveal a substantial gap between fallacy classification and awareness, with models particularly vulnerable to emotion-driven fallacies and scenarios involving cooperative or trust-based relationships. Deeper analysis uncovers a cognition–behavior gap and fragile internal representations underlying awareness failures. Our work establishes a foundation for evaluating and enhancing the robustness of LLMs against fallacious reasoning in interactive settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在应对现实世界中的错误推理时往往表现不佳，尽管它们在静态的错误检测任务上表现出色。我们将这种能力定义为“错误意识”，即能够在动态、实用的情境中自主感知并抵制错误的能力。为了研究这一点，我们引入了ISFallacy这一大规模的中文基准测试，该测试包含5万个互动场景，涵盖了六种类型的错误、五种社交互动环境、多样化的角色关系以及不同的性格特征。我们还提出了FATE这一两阶段评估框架，该框架无需明确提示即可评估错误意识，同时结合自然对话回应和基于推理的决策。对五款代表性大语言模型的实验表明，错误分类与错误意识之间存在显著差距，某些模型特别容易受到情绪驱动的错误的影响，而涉及合作或信任关系的场景则更容易出现错误。更深入的分析揭示了认知与行为之间的差距，以及导致错误意识失败的内在表征问题。我们的工作为评估和提升大语言模型在互动环境中的抗错误推理能力奠定了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Crosscoding Through Time: Tracking Emergence & Consolidation Of Linguistic Representations Throughout LLM Pretraining
papers.title_zh: 随时间变化的交叉编码：在大型语言模型预训练过程中追踪语言表示的出现与巩固过程
papers.authors: Deniz Bayazit, Aaron Mueller, Antoine Bosselut
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) learn non-trivial abstractions during pretraining, such as detecting irregular plural noun subjects. However, because traditional evaluation methods (e.g., benchmarking) fail to reveal how models acquire these concepts and capabilities, it is not well understood when and how these specific linguistic abilities emerge. To bridge this gap and better understand model training at the concept level, we use sparse crosscoders to discover and align features across model checkpoints. Using this approach, we track the evolution of linguistic features during pretraining. We train crosscoders between open-sourced checkpoint triplets with significant performance and representation shifts, and introduce a novel metric, Relative Indirect Effects (RelIE), to trace training stages at which individual features become causally important for task performance. We show that crosscoders can detect feature emergence, maintenance, and discontinuation during pretraining. Our approach is architecture-agnostic and scalable, offering a promising path toward more interpretable and fine-grained analysis of representation learning throughout pretraining.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在预训练过程中会学习到一些复杂的抽象概念，比如识别不规则的复数名词主语。然而，由于传统的评估方法无法揭示模型是如何获得这些概念和能力的，因此人们并不清楚这些特定的语言能力究竟何时以及如何产生的。为了填补这一空白，更好地理解模型在概念层面的训练过程，我们采用了稀疏交叉编码器技术来发现并对齐不同模型检查点之间的特征。通过这种方法，我们可以追踪预训练过程中语言特征的演变过程。我们在那些具有显著性能提升和特征变化的开源检查点对之间训练交叉编码器，并引入了一种新的度量指标——相对间接效应（RelIE），以追踪那些个体特征对任务性能产生因果影响的训练阶段。我们的研究表明，交叉编码器能够检测到特征在预训练过程中的出现、维持以及消失。我们的方法不依赖于具体的架构，且具有可扩展性，为更易于理解和精细分析预训练过程中的表示学习提供了可能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Is EEG-to-Text Feasible in Real-World Scenarios? An In-Depth Analysis Using a Neuropsychology-Inspired Benchmark
papers.title_zh: 在现实场景中，将脑电图数据转化为文本形式是否可行？基于神经心理学理论的深入分析
papers.authors: Zihan Zhang, Yu Bao, Xiao Ding, Tianyi Jiang, Kai Xiong
papers.abstract: Translating brain signals into text could restore communication for people with severe paralysis, yet practically usable systems to date rely on invasive electrocorticography (ECoG). Electroencephalography (EEG) offers a non-invasive alternative, and EEG-to-text (EEG2Text) has been widely explored. Interestingly, however, EEG2Text models generally rely on teacher-forcing evaluation; without it, they fail to generate meaningful decoding. This reliance prevents EEG2Text from being applied in real-world, non-academic settings. This has fueled numerous debates about whether EEG2Text is a meaningful direction, by extension, and whether EEG truly contains decodable linguistic information. Here, using a neuropsychology-informed paradigm, we find that existing EEG2Text benchmarks have neglected EEG instability, a flaw that has confounded inference and sparked debate. Our experiments furnish key evidence for the feasibility of teacher-forcing-free EEG2Text decoding. Accordingly, we assemble the Corpus OF Eeg-To-Text (COFETT) using a 128-channel high-density EEG cap, providing a benchmark dedicated to evaluating EEG2Text models. In comparisons with multiple existing benchmarks, COFETT achieves SOTA ability to distinguish among model performances and enables robust, teacher-forcing-free evaluation, thereby opening a path toward practical EEG2Text applications. COFETT is open sourced in https://github.com/baoyudu/COFETT.
papers.abstract_zh: 将脑信号转化为文本有可能为严重瘫痪患者恢复沟通能力。不过，目前实际可用的系统大多依赖于侵入性的皮层脑电图检测。而脑电图则提供了一种非侵入性的替代方法，因此“从脑电图到文本”的技术已经被广泛研究。然而有趣的是，现有的EEG2Text模型通常依赖于教师引导的评估方式；如果没有这种评估方式，这些模型就无法生成有意义的解码结果。这种依赖性使得EEG2Text无法应用于现实世界中的非学术场景。这引发了诸多关于EEG2Text是否是一种有意义的研究方向，以及脑电图是否真的包含可解码的语言信息的争论。在这里，我们采用一种基于神经心理学的方法论，发现现有的EEG2Text基准测试忽略了脑电图的不稳定性这一缺陷——这一缺陷不仅影响了推理过程，还引发了诸多争议。我们的实验为无教师引导的EEG2Text解码提供了关键证据。因此，我们使用128通道的高密度脑电图帽构建了一个名为COFETT的语料库，该语料库专门用于评估EEG2Text模型的表现。与多个现有基准测试相比，COFETT在区分不同模型性能方面表现出色，并且能够实现无教师引导的可靠评估，从而为EEG2Text的实际应用铺平了道路。COFETT已开源，地址为https://github.com/baoyudu/COFETT。

papers.title: ControlAudio: Tackling Text-Guided, Timing-Indicated and Intelligible Audio Generation via Progressive Diffusion Modeling
papers.title_zh: ControlAudio：通过渐进式扩散模型来处理文本引导、时间提示以及可理解音频的生成问题
papers.authors: Yuxuan Jiang, Zehua Chen, Zeqian Ju, Yusheng Dai, Weibei Dou, Jun Zhu
papers.abstract: Recent efforts on text-to-audio (TTA) generation are starting to explore fine-grained controllability, e.g., precise timing control, with innovations on conditioning techniques or training-free latent manipulations. However, constrained by data scarcity, their generation performance at scale is still limited. In this study, we recast high-controllability TTA generation as a multi-task learning problem, and introduce a progressive diffusion modeling approach, ControlAudio. Our method adeptly fits distributions conditioned on fine-grained information, including text, timing, and phoneme features, through a step-by-step strategy. First, we propose a data construction method spanning both annotation and simulation, augmenting condition information in the sequence of text, timing, and phoneme. Second, at the model training stage, we pretrain a scalable diffusion transformer (DiT) on large-scale text-audio pairs, achieving high-fidelity TTA generation, and then incrementally integrate the timing and phoneme features, expanding controllability. Finally, at the inference stage, we propose progressively guided generation, which sequentially emphasizes more fine-grained information, aligning inherently with the coarse-to-fine sampling nature of DiT. Extensive experiments show that ControlAudio achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of temporal accuracy and speech clarity, significantly outperforming existing methods on both objective and subjective evaluations. Demo samples are available at: https://control-audio.github.io/Control-Audio.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在文本转语音生成领域的研究开始探索更精细的控制能力，例如精确的时间控制，通过改进条件技术或无需训练的潜在操控方法来实现。然而，由于数据稀缺的限制，这类技术的规模化生成性能仍然有限。在本研究中，我们将高控制能力的文本转语音生成问题重新定义为一个多任务学习问题，并提出了一种渐进式扩散建模方法——ControlAudio。我们的方法能够巧妙地利用基于细粒度信息的分布进行建模，包括文本、时间和音素特征，通过逐步的策略实现这一目标。首先，我们提出了一种结合注释和模拟的数据构建方法，在文本、时间和音素序列中增加条件信息。其次，在模型训练阶段，我们在大规模文本-语音对上预训练了一个可扩展的扩散变换器（DiT），从而实现高保真度的文本转语音生成，然后逐步整合时间信息和音素特征，从而提升控制能力。最后，在推理阶段，我们采用了渐进式引导生成的方法，依次强调更细粒度的信息，这与DiT从粗到细的采样特性相契合。大量实验表明，ControlAudio在时间准确性和语音清晰度方面取得了领先的性能，无论是在客观还是主观评估中都显著优于现有方法。演示样本可以在以下链接查看：https://control-audio.github.io/Control-Audio

papers.title: PrefixNLI: Detecting Factual Inconsistencies as Soon as They Arise
papers.title_zh: PrefixNLI：在不一致现象出现时立即进行识别
papers.authors: Sapir Harary, Eran Hirsch, Aviv Slobodkin, David Wan, Mohit Bansal, Ido Dagan
papers.abstract: Natural Language Inference (NLI) models have been used in various ways to improve the factuality of LLM outputs. This is typically done by applying an NLI model to judge whether the model output is entailed from the supposed evidence, triggering some corrective actions, such as beam reranking at inference time or RL rewards during training. While NLI models are trained to detect factual inconsistencies over complete sentences, decisions in the common autoregressive generation architecture are made for each evolving text prefix, during decoding. Addressing this setting, we generalize the entailment detection task to apply over arbitrary text prefixes, and suggest its utility for improving generation faithfulness. Providing suitable evaluation and training datasets for this task, we train MiniTruePrefixes, a novel specialized model that better detects factual inconsistencies over text prefixes, outperforming comparable baseline NLI models by 5-14 F1 points in prefix-level entailment. We further demonstrate that integrating MiniTruePrefixes into a controlled decoding framework substantially improves factual consistency in abstractive summarization. When guided by MiniTruePrefixes, LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct matches the faithfulness and runtime of the 8B model from the same model family, while using only half the memory.
papers.abstract_zh: 自然语言推理（NLI）模型已被用于多种方式来提升大语言模型输出的真实性。这通常是通过应用NLI模型来判断模型输出是否可以从给定的证据中推导出来，从而触发一些纠正措施，比如在推理时重新排序候选答案，或在训练过程中给予强化奖励。虽然NLI模型被训练用来检测整个句子的事实一致性问题，但在常见的自回归生成架构中，决策是在解码过程中针对每个不断生成的文本前缀来做出的。为了解决这一问题，我们将蕴含检测任务推广到任意文本前缀上，并证明了其对于提高生成结果的真实性具有积极作用。通过提供合适的评估训练和数据集，我们训练出了MiniTruePrefixes这一新型专用模型。该模型能够更有效地检测文本前缀层面的事实不一致性，其在前缀级蕴含方面的表现比同类基线NLI模型高出5到14个F1分数。此外，我们还证明了将MiniTruePrefixes整合到受控的解码框架中，可以显著改善抽象式总结中的事实一致性。在MiniTruePrefixes的引导下，LaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct模型的准确性和运行时间与同一模型家族中的8B模型相当，而内存占用却只有后者的二分之一。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RAM-SD: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-agent framework for Sarcasm Detection
papers.title_zh: RAM-SD：一种基于检索增强的多智能体框架，用于讽刺检测
papers.authors: Ziyang Zhou, Ziqi Liu, Yan Wang, Yiming Lin, Yangbin Chen
papers.abstract: Sarcasm detection remains a significant challenge due to its reliance on nuanced contextual understanding, world knowledge, and multi-faceted linguistic cues that vary substantially across different sarcastic expressions. Existing approaches, from fine-tuned transformers to large language models, apply a uniform reasoning strategy to all inputs, struggling to address the diverse analytical demands of sarcasm. These demands range from modeling contextual expectation violations to requiring external knowledge grounding or recognizing specific rhetorical patterns. To address this limitation, we introduce RAM-SD, a Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent framework for Sarcasm Detection. The framework operates through four stages: (1) contextual retrieval grounds the query in both sarcastic and non-sarcastic exemplars; (2) a meta-planner classifies the sarcasm type and selects an optimal reasoning plan from a predefined set; (3) an ensemble of specialized agents performs complementary, multi-view analysis; and (4) an integrator synthesizes these analyses into a final, interpretable judgment with a natural language explanation. Evaluated on four standard benchmarks, RAM-SD achieves a state-of-the-art Macro-F1 of 77.74%, outperforming the strong GPT-4o+CoC baseline by 7.01 points. Our framework not only sets a new performance benchmark but also provides transparent and interpretable reasoning traces, illuminating the cognitive processes behind sarcasm comprehension.
papers.abstract_zh: 讽刺检测仍然是一个重大挑战，因为它依赖于细致的背景理解、世界知识以及在不同讽刺表达中差异显著的多种语言线索。现有的方法，无论是经过微调的Transformer还是大语言模型，都采用统一的推理策略来处理所有输入，这难以满足讽刺检测的多样化分析需求。这些需求包括建模背景预期违反情况，到需要外部知识支持或识别特定的修辞模式。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了RAM-SD——一种用于讽刺检测的检索增强多智能体框架。该框架通过四个阶段运作：（1）背景检索将查询与讽刺和非讽刺的例子进行关联；（2）元规划器对讽刺类型进行分类，并从预定义的集合中选择最优的推理方案；（3）由多个专业智能体组成的集成系统执行互补的多视角分析；（4）整合器将这些分析结果综合成最终的、可解释的判决结果，并附上自然语言解释。在四个标准基准测试中的表现表明，RAM-SD取得了先进的Macro-F1值77.74%，比强大的GPT-4o+CoC基线高出7.01个百分点。我们的框架不仅创造了新的性能标杆，还提供了透明且可解释的推理过程，揭示了理解讽刺背后的认知机制。

papers.title: On the Emergence and Test-Time Use of Structural Information in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 关于结构信息在大型语言模型中的出现及其在测试阶段的运用
papers.authors: Michelle Chao Chen, Moritz Miller, Bernhard Schölkopf, Siyuan Guo
papers.abstract: Learning structural information from observational data is central to producing new knowledge outside the training corpus. This holds for mechanistic understanding in scientific discovery as well as flexible test-time compositional generation. We thus study how language models learn abstract structures and utilize the learnt structural information at test-time. To ensure a controlled setup, we design a natural language dataset based on linguistic structural transformations. We empirically show that the emergence of learning structural information correlates with complex reasoning tasks, and that the ability to perform test-time compositional generation remains limited.
papers.abstract_zh: 从观测数据中学习结构信息对于在训练语料库之外产生新知识至关重要。这一点在科学发现中的机制理解以及测试时灵活的组合生成中同样适用。因此，我们研究语言模型如何学习抽象结构，并在测试时利用所学习到的结构信息。为了获得可控的实验环境，我们设计了一个基于语言结构变换的自然语言数据集。我们通过实证表明，学习结构信息的出现与复杂的推理任务密切相关，而进行测试时组合生成的能力仍然有限。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SAGE: A Search-AuGmented Evaluation of Large Language Models on Free-Form QA
papers.title_zh: SAGE：一种基于搜索的大型语言模型评估方法，适用于自由形式的问题解答场景
papers.authors: Sher Badshah, Ali Emami, Hassan Sajjad
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly used for question-answering (QA), relying on static, pre-annotated references for evaluation poses significant challenges in cost, scalability, and completeness. Meanwhile, using LLMs themselves as evaluators without external grounding remains unreliable for objective tasks, as they systematically over-accept incorrect answers, fabricate supporting rationales, and degrade sharply on questions that fall outside their training data. We propose Search-AuGmented Evaluation (SAGE), a framework to assess LLM outputs without fixed ground-truth answers. Unlike conventional metrics that compare to static references or depend solely on LLM-as-a-judge knowledge, SAGE acts as an agent that actively retrieves and synthesizes external evidence. It iteratively generates web queries, collects information, summarizes findings, and refines subsequent searches through reflection. By reducing dependence on static reference-driven evaluation protocols, SAGE offers a scalable and adaptive alternative for evaluating the factuality of LLMs. Experimental results on multiple free-form QA benchmarks show that SAGE achieves substantial to perfect agreement with human evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在问答任务中的应用日益广泛，依赖静态、预先注释过的参考数据进行评估在成本、可扩展性和完整性方面带来了显著挑战。同时，仅使用语言模型本身作为评估工具也是不可靠的，因为它们会系统性地过度接受错误的答案，编造支持性理由，并且在处理那些超出其训练数据的题目时表现严重下降。我们提出了一种名为“搜索增强评估”的框架，该框架可以在没有固定真实答案的情况下评估语言模型的输出。与那些依赖于静态参考或完全依赖语言模型自身判断能力的传统评估方法不同，SAGE作为一个智能体，能够主动检索和合成外部证据。它通过迭代生成网络查询、收集信息、总结发现结果，并通过反思来优化后续搜索。通过减少对静态参考驱动评估协议的依赖，SAGE为评估语言模型的事实性提供了可扩展且适应性强的替代方案。在多个自由形式问答基准测试中的实验结果表明，SAGE与人类评估的结果具有相当甚至完美的一致性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: J4R: Learning to Judge with Equivalent Initial State Group Relative Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: J4R：通过等效初始状态组相对策略优化来学习判断方法
papers.authors: Austin Xu, Yilun Zhou, Xuan-Phi Nguyen, Caiming Xiong, Shafiq Joty
papers.abstract: To keep pace with the increasing velocity of large language models (LLM) development, model output evaluation has transitioned away from time-consuming human evaluation to automatic evaluation, where LLMs themselves are tasked with assessing and critiquing other model outputs. LLM-as-judge models are a class of generative evaluators that excel in evaluating relatively simple domains, like chat quality, but struggle in reasoning intensive domains where model responses contain more substantive and challenging content. To remedy existing judge shortcomings, we explore training judges with reinforcement learning (RL). We make three key contributions: (1) We propose the Equivalent Initial State Group Relative Policy Optimization (EIS-GRPO) algorithm, which allows us to train our judge to be robust to positional biases that arise in more complex evaluation settings. (2) We introduce ReasoningJudgeBench, a benchmark that evaluates judges in diverse reasoning settings not covered by prior work. (3) We train Judge for Reasoning (J4R), a 7B judge trained with EIS-GRPO that outperforms GPT-4o and the next best small judge by 6.7% and 9%, matching or exceeding the performance of larger GRPO-trained judges on both JudgeBench and ReasoningJudgeBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了跟上大语言模型发展的速度，模型输出的评估方式已经从耗时的人工评估转变为自动评估。在这种新模式下，大语言模型本身被赋予了评估和评判其他模型输出的任务。以语言模型作为评判者的模型属于生成式评估器的一类，这类模型在评估相对简单的领域时表现优异，比如聊天质量方面的评估；但在需要复杂推理能力的领域则表现不佳，因为在这些领域中模型的回答往往包含更为复杂和具有挑战性的内容。为了弥补现有评判者存在的不足，我们采用了强化学习的方法来训练评判者。我们的研究有三项重要贡献：(1) 我们提出了等效初始状态组相对策略优化算法，该算法使我们能够训练出对复杂评估环境中出现的位置偏见具有鲁棒性的评判者。(2) 我们引入了ReasoningJudgeBench这一基准测试工具，它能够在不同于以往研究的推理场景中评估评判者性能。(3) 我们训练出了Judge for Reasoning（J4R）这一拥有70亿参数的评判者模型，其性能分别比GPT-4o和下一个最好的小型评判者模型高出6.7%和9%。在JudgeBench和ReasoningJudgeBench这两个基准测试中的表现，都达到了或超过了那些使用GRPO方法训练的更大规模评判者的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Functionality-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating Web Agents in E-commerce Domains
papers.title_zh: 一种基于功能性的评估标准，用于评价电子商务领域中的网络代理性能
papers.authors: Xianren Zhang, Shreyas Prasad, Di Wang, Qiuhai Zeng, Suhang Wang, Wenbo Yan, Mat Hans
papers.abstract: Web agents have shown great promise in performing many tasks on e-commerce websites. To assess their capabilities, several benchmarks have been introduced. However, current benchmarks in the e-commerce domain face two major problems. First, they primarily focus on product search tasks (e.g., “Find an Apple Watch”), failing to capture the broader range of functionalities offered by real-world e-commerce services such as Amazon, including account management and gift card operations. Second, existing benchmarks typically evaluate whether the agent completes the user query, but ignore the potential risks involved. In practice, web agents can make unintended changes that negatively impact the user’s account or status. For instance, an agent might purchase the wrong item, delete a saved address, or incorrectly configure an auto-reload setting. To address these gaps, we propose a new benchmark called Amazon-Bench. To generate user queries that cover a broad range of tasks, we propose a data generation pipeline that leverages webpage content and interactive elements (e.g., buttons, check boxes) to create diverse, functionality-grounded user queries covering tasks such as address management, wishlist management, and brand store following. To enhance agent evaluation, we propose an automated evaluation framework that assesses both the performance and safety of web agents. We systematically evaluate various agents, finding that current agents struggle with complex queries and pose safety risks. These results highlight the need for developing more robust and reliable web agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络代理在电子商务网站上的多项任务执行中表现出巨大的潜力。为了评估它们的能力，人们提出了一些基准测试。然而，当前在电子商务领域的基准测试存在两个主要问题。首先，这些基准测试主要关注产品搜索任务（例如，“查找苹果手表”），而未能涵盖现实世界中的电子商务服务所提供的一系列功能，比如亚马逊提供的账户管理和礼品卡操作功能。其次，现有的基准测试通常只评估代理是否能够完成用户的查询，却忽略了其中可能存在的风险。实际上，网络代理可能会做出一些非预期的操作，从而对用户账户或状态产生负面影响。例如，代理可能会购买错误的商品、删除保存的地址，或者错误地配置自动充值设置。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新的基准测试——Amazon-Bench。为了生成涵盖各种任务的用户查询，我们设计了一个数据生成流程，该流程利用网页内容和交互元素（如按钮、复选框）来创建多样化的、基于功能的用户查询，这些查询涵盖了地址管理、愿望清单管理和品牌店铺关注等任务。为了提升代理评估的准确性，我们提出了一个自动化评估框架，能够同时评估网络代理的性能和安全性。我们对各种代理进行了系统性的评估，发现当前的代理在处理复杂查询时存在困难，并且存在安全风险。这些结果凸显了开发更强大、更可靠的网络代理的必要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving Agent with Skill Library
papers.title_zh: 基于技能库的自主智能体强化学习
papers.authors: Jiongxiao Wang, Qiaojing Yan, Yawei Wang, Yijun Tian, Soumya Smruti Mishra, Zhichao Xu, Megha Gandhi, Panpan Xu, Lin Lee Cheong
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex reasoning and multi-turn interactions but struggle to continuously improve and adapt when deployed in new environments. One promising approach is implementing skill libraries that allow agents to learn, validate, and apply new skills. However, current skill library approaches rely primarily on LLM prompting, making consistent skill library implementation challenging. To overcome these challenges, we propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based approach to enhance agents’ self-improvement capabilities with a skill library. Specifically, we introduce Skill Augmented GRPO for self-Evolution (SAGE), a novel RL framework that systematically incorporates skills into learning. The framework’s key component, Sequential Rollout, iteratively deploys agents across a chain of similar tasks for each rollout. As agents navigate through the task chain, skills generated from previous tasks accumulate in the library and become available for subsequent tasks. Additionally, the framework enhances skill generation and utilization through a Skill-integrated Reward that complements the original outcome-based rewards. Experimental results on AppWorld demonstrate that SAGE, when applied to supervised-finetuned model with expert experience, achieves 8.9% higher Scenario Goal Completion while requiring 26% fewer interaction steps and generating 59% fewer tokens, substantially outperforming existing approaches in both accuracy and efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/amazon-science/SAGE.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在复杂推理和多轮交互方面展现出了卓越的能力，但在部署到新环境中时，它们难以持续改进和适应。一种有前景的方法是实施技能库，让智能体能够学习、验证和应用新的技能。然而，目前的技能库方法主要依赖于LLM的提示机制，这使得技能库的持续实现变得困难。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于强化学习的解决方案，以利用技能库提升智能体的自我改进能力。具体来说，我们提出了“技能增强的自进化算法”（SAGE），这是一种创新的强化学习框架，它能够系统地将技能融入学习过程中。该框架的核心组件是“顺序展开”，它通过迭代地将智能体分配到一系列类似的任务中来进行训练。随着智能体在任务链中的推进，之前任务产生的技能会不断积累到技能库中，从而为后续任务提供可用技能。此外，该框架还通过“技能整合奖励”机制来增强技能的生成和利用，这种奖励方式能够补充原有的基于结果的奖励方式。在AppWorld上的实验结果表明，当SAGE应用于经过专家经验训练的模型时，其场景目标完成率提高了8.9%，同时所需的互动步骤减少了26%，生成的令牌数量也减少了59%。在准确性和效率方面，SAGE都显著优于现有的方法。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/amazon-science/SAGE下载。

papers.title: CachePrune: Teaching LLMs What Not to Follow via KV-Cache Editing
papers.title_zh: CachePrune：通过键值存储编辑来教大型语言模型不该遵循的行为
papers.authors: Rui Wang, Junda Wu, Yu Xia, Tong Yu, Ruiyi Zhang, Ryan A. Rossi, Subrata Mitra, Lina Yao, Julian McAuley
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are susceptible to indirect prompt injection attack, where the model inadvertently responds to instructions injected into the prompt context. This vulnerability stems from LLMs’ inability to distinguish between data and instructions within a prompt. We propose CachePrune that defends against this attack by identifying and pruning neurons associated with instruction-following, during KV cache encoding of the prompt context. The pruning steers the LLM toward interpreting the context purely as data rather than as instructions to follow. To identify these neurons, we introduce a neural attribution mechanism guided by a preferential attribution loss, and theoretically connect this loss to an upper bound of the Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) objective. Further, we improve on the fidelity of neural attribution by leveraging an observed triggering effect in instruction-following. Our approach does not interfere with prompt formatting or incur test-time overhead in response generation. Experiments show that CachePrune significantly reduces the attack success rate while preserving the LLM’s ability to follow user instructions.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）容易受到间接提示注入攻击的影响，即模型会无意中响应被注入到提示上下文中的指令。这种漏洞源于LLM无法区分提示中的数据和指令。我们提出了CachePrune算法，通过识别并修剪与遵循指令相关的神经元，从而在KV缓存编码过程中防御这种攻击。这种修剪操作使得LLM将上下文纯粹视为数据而非需要遵循的指令。为了识别这些神经元，我们引入了一种由优先归因损失引导的神经归因机制，并从理论上将这一损失与直接偏好优化目标的上界联系起来。此外，我们通过利用在指令遵循过程中观察到的触发效应，提高了神经归因的精确度。我们的方法不会干扰提示的格式，也不会在响应生成过程中产生额外的测试时间开销。实验表明，CachePrune算法能够显著降低攻击的成功率，同时保留LLM遵循用户指令的能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Flip-Flop Consistency: Unsupervised Training for Robustness to Prompt Perturbations in LLMs
papers.title_zh: Flip-Flop一致性：无监督训练在提高大语言模型对提示扰动的鲁棒性方面的应用
papers.authors: Parsa Hejabi, Elnaz Rahmati, Alireza Salkhordeh Ziabari, Morteza Dehghani
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often produce inconsistent answers when faced with different phrasings of the same prompt. In this paper, we propose Flip-Flop Consistency (F^2C), an unsupervised training method that improves robustness to such perturbations. F^2C is composed of two key components. The first, Consensus Cross-Entropy (CCE), uses a majority vote across prompt variations to create a hard pseudo-label. The second is a representation alignment loss that pulls lower-confidence and non-majority predictors toward the consensus established by high-confidence, majority-voting variations. We evaluate our method on 11 datasets spanning four NLP tasks, with 4–15 prompt variations per dataset. On average, F^2C raises observed agreement by 11.62%, improves mean F_1 by 8.94%, and reduces performance variance across formats by 3.29%. In out-of-domain evaluations, F^2C generalizes effectively, increasing \overline{F_1} and agreement while decreasing variance across most source-target pairs. Finally, when trained on only a subset of prompt perturbations and evaluated on held-out formats, F^2C consistently improves both performance and agreement while reducing variance. These findings highlight F^2C as an effective unsupervised method for enhancing LLM consistency, performance, and generalization under prompt perturbations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在面对同一提示的不同表述时，往往会产生不一致的答案。在本文中，我们提出了Flip-Flop Consistency（F^2C）这一无监督训练方法，该方法能够提升模型对这类干扰的鲁棒性。F^2C由两个关键组件构成：第一个是共识交叉熵（CCE），它通过对不同提示版本进行多数投票来生成硬伪标签；第二个是表示对齐损失，它会将那些置信度较低且不属于多数派的预测结果引导到由高置信度、多数投票版本所建立的共识方向上。我们在涵盖四项自然语言处理任务、每个数据集包含4至15种提示版本的11个数据集上进行了方法评估，结果显示：F^2C平均使观测到的一致性提升了11.62%，平均F_1分数提高了8.94%，同时将不同格式下的性能方差降低了 3.29%。在跨领域评估中，F^2C表现出良好的泛化能力，不仅提升了平均F_1分数和一致性，还降低了大多数源目标对之间的性能差异。最后，当仅在部分提示版本上进行训练并在保留的格式上进行评估时，F^2C仍然能够持续提升性能和一致性，同时降低性能波动。这些研究结果表明，F^2C是一种有效的无监督方法，能够有效提升语言模型在提示干扰下的稳定性、性能和泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Leave My Images Alone: Preventing Multi-Modal Large Language Models from Analyzing Images via Visual Prompt Injection
papers.title_zh: 让我的图像独享：防止多模态大语言模型通过视觉提示注入来分析图像
papers.authors: Zedian Shao, Hongbin Liu, Yuepeng Hu, Neil Zhenqiang Gong
papers.abstract: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for analyzing Internet-scale image data, offering significant benefits but also raising critical safety and societal concerns. In particular, these models may be misused to extract sensitive information from personal images, such as identifying individuals or revealing locations. In this work, we propose ImageProtector, a method designed to protect images from unauthorized analysis by MLLMs. Before an image is shared online, ImageProtector embeds a carefully crafted, nearly imperceptible perturbation that acts as a visual prompt injection attack on MLLMs. Consequently, when a malicious actor downloads and queries a protected image, the MLLM is consistently misled into generating a refusal response such as “I’m sorry, I can’t help with that request.” We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of ImageProtector across six MLLMs and four datasets. Additionally, we evaluate three potential countermeasures, Gaussian noise, DiffPure, and adversarial training, and show that while they partially mitigate the impact of ImageProtector, they simultaneously degrade model accuracy and/or efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型已成为分析互联网规模图像数据的强大工具，它们带来了显著的优势，但同时也引发了重要的安全和社会问题。特别是，这些模型可能会被滥用，从个人图像中提取敏感信息，比如识别个人身份或揭示位置信息。在这项研究中，我们提出了ImageProtector方法，旨在保护图像免受多模态大语言模型的未经授权分析。在图像被在线分享之前，ImageProtector会嵌入一种精心设计的、几乎无法察觉的扰动机制，这种扰动机制可以作为一种视觉提示攻击来干扰多模态大语言模型。因此，当恶意行为者下载并查询受保护的图像时，多模态大语言模型会始终被误导，从而生成诸如“对不起，我无法处理该请求”这样的拒绝响应。我们通过实验验证了ImageProtector在六种多模态大语言模型和四个数据集上的有效性。此外，我们还评估了三种潜在的对抗措施：高斯噪声、DiffPure以及对抗性训练。结果表明，虽然这些措施能够部分减轻ImageProtector的影响，但它们同时会降低模型的准确性和/或效率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
