papers.title: Logic Matters in Lightweight Hallucination Classification for RAG System
papers.title_zh: 在RAG系统的轻度幻觉分类中，逻辑因素非常重要
papers.authors: Ningyuan Yang, Kaizhu Huang
papers.abstract: We propose a lightweight, modular framework for hallucination detection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, addressing the critical challenge where logical dependencies span across fragmented retrieval results. To address the inherent limitations of compact models in processing long-context information and performing multi-hop reasoning, our approach systematically analyzes the logical relationships among retrieved documents within the vector space. By capturing these geometric patterns through a novel feature extraction framework, the proposed classifier significantly enhances context-aware hallucination detection without requiring complex architectures or pre-training on datasets. Meanwhile, to evaluate multi-document reasoning, we release HotPotQA-derived, a hallucination dataset preserving separate retrieved texts. Experimental results on HotPotQA-derived and several open-source datasets demonstrate that our framework can achieve results comparable to or even surpassing those of large language models (LLMs) on the task of hallucination detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个轻量级、模块化框架，用于检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的幻觉检测。该框架旨在解决逻辑依赖关系跨越碎片化检索结果这一关键挑战。为了克服紧凑模型在处理长上下文信息以及进行多跳推理时的固有局限性，我们的方法系统地分析了向量空间中检索到的文档之间的逻辑关系。通过一种新颖的特征提取框架来捕捉这些几何模式，所提出的分类器能够显著提升上下文感知的幻觉检测能力，而无需复杂的架构或针对数据集的预训练。同时，为了评估多文档推理能力，我们开发了基于HotPotQA的幻觉数据集，该数据集保留了独立的检索文本。在HotPotQA衍生数据集以及几个开源数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的框架在幻觉检测任务上能够取得与大语言模型相当甚至更好的性能。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Harnessing Negative Signals: Reinforcement Distillation from Teacher Data for LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 利用负面信号：基于教师数据的强化蒸馏技术用于大型语言模型的推理
papers.authors: Shuyao Xu, Cheng Peng, Jiangxuan Long, Weidi Xu, Wei Chu, Yuan Qi
papers.abstract: Recent advances in model distillation show that data from advanced reasoning models can effectively train smaller student models. However, standard practices discard incorrect reasoning traces—valuable, yet underutilized data. This paper addresses the critical question: How can both positive and negative distilled reasoning traces be effectively leveraged to maximize LLM reasoning performance in an offline setting? We employ a two-stage training recipe: first, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on positive traces, followed by a refinement stage using both positive and negative traces. We find that a simple REINFORCE-style objective, which we term the Reinforcement Distillation (REDI) objective, outperforms established preference optimization methods like DPO and SimPO in this distillation context. Our empirical evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach. Notably, our Qwen-REDI-1.5B model, trained on just 131k traces from the open Open-R1 dataset, achieves an 83.1% score on MATH-500. Its performance matches that of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, a model trained on 800k proprietary data. This result showcases the remarkable data efficiency of utilizing previously discarded negative traces.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型蒸馏领域的最新研究表明，来自高级推理模型的数据能够有效训练出规模较小的学生模型。然而，传统的训练方法往往会丢弃那些错误的推理轨迹——这些轨迹虽然具有价值，但却被忽视了。本文旨在探讨一个关键问题：如何有效利用正面和负面的推理轨迹，从而在离线环境中最大化大语言模型的推理性能？我们采用了一种两阶段训练方案：首先，对正面推理轨迹进行有监督的微调；然后，结合正面和负面推理轨迹来进行进一步优化。我们发现，一种简单的强化式目标——即强化蒸馏目标，在这种蒸馏场景中表现优于传统的偏好优化方法，如DPO和SimPO。我们的实证评估证明了这种方法的有效性。值得注意的是，我们的Qwen-REDI-1.5B模型仅基于开放开源数据集Open-R1中的13.1万条轨迹进行训练，却在MATH-500任务上取得了83.1%的准确率。其性能与基于80万专有数据训练的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B模型相当。这一结果表明，利用之前被丢弃的负面推理轨迹确实具有很高的数据利用效率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Grammar Search for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 多智能体系统的语法搜索
papers.authors: Mayank Singh, Vikas Yadav, Shiva Krishna Reddy Malay, Shravan Nayak, Sai Rajeswar, Sathwik Tejaswi Madhusudhan, Eduardo Blanco
papers.abstract: Automatic search for Multi-Agent Systems has recently emerged as a key focus in agentic AI research. Several prior approaches have relied on LLM-based free-form search over the code space. In this work, we propose a more structured framework that explores the same space through a fixed set of composable components. We show that, despite lacking the generative flexibility of LLMs during the candidate generation stage, our method outperforms prior approaches on a majority of evaluated benchmarks across two backbone LLMs and two domains: mathematics and question answering. Furthermore, our method offers additional advantages, including a more cost-efficient search process and the generation of modular, interpretable multi-agent systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动搜索多智能体系统最近已成为智能体人工智能研究中的一个重点方向。以往的方法大多依赖于基于大语言模型的自由形式搜索来遍历代码空间。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种结构化的框架，通过一组固定的可组合组件来探索相同的空间。我们发现，尽管在候选生成阶段缺乏大语言模型那样的生成灵活性，我们的方法在两大主流大语言模型以及数学和问答两个领域评估的多数基准测试中均优于以往的方法。此外，我们的方法还具有其他优势，比如更高效的搜索过程，以及能够生成模块化、可解释的多个智能体系统。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ZoomR: Memory Efficient Reasoning through Multi-Granularity Key Value Retrieval
papers.title_zh: ZoomR：通过多粒度键值检索实现内存高效的推理
papers.authors: David H. Yang, Yuxuan Zhu, Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri, Keerthiram Murugesan, Tejaswini Pedapati, Subhajit Chaudhury, Pin-Yu Chen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great performance on complex reasoning tasks but often require generating long intermediate thoughts before reaching a final answer. During generation, LLMs rely on a key-value (KV) cache for autoregressive decoding. However, the memory footprint of the KV cache grows with output length. Prior work on KV cache optimization mostly focus on compressing the long input context, while retaining the full KV cache for decoding. For tasks requiring long output generation, this leads to increased computational and memory costs. In this paper, we introduce ZoomR, a novel approach that enables LLMs to adaptively compress verbose reasoning thoughts into summaries and uses a dynamic KV cache selection policy that leverages these summaries while also strategically “zooming in” on fine-grained details. By using summary keys as a coarse-grained index during decoding, ZoomR uses the query to retrieve details for only the most important thoughts. This hierarchical strategy significantly reduces memory usage by avoiding full-cache attention at each step. Experiments across math and reasoning tasks show that our approach achieves competitive performance compared to baselines, while reducing inference memory requirements by more than 4 \times. These results demonstrate that a multi-granularity KV selection enables more memory efficient decoding, especially for long output generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂的推理任务上表现优异，但通常在得出最终答案之前需要生成较长的中间思路。在生成过程中，这些模型依赖键值缓存进行自回归解码。然而，键值缓存的内存占用会随着输出长度的增加而增长。以往关于键值缓存优化的研究大多集中在压缩长输入内容上，同时保留完整的键值缓存以供解码使用。对于需要生成较长输出的任务来说，这种方式会导致计算成本和内存成本的增加。在本文中，我们提出了ZoomR这一创新方法。该方法使语言模型能够自适应地将冗长的推理思路压缩成摘要，并采用动态键值缓存选择策略，利用这些摘要来加速解码过程，同时有针对性地关注细节部分。通过在解码过程中使用摘要作为粗粒度索引，ZoomR仅针对最重要的思路提取详细信息。这种分层策略通过避免每一步都使用完整缓存来显著减少内存占用。在数学和推理任务的实验中，我们的方法取得了与基线算法相当的性能，同时将推理所需的内存需求减少了4倍以上。这些结果表明，多粒度键值选择能够实现更高效的内存使用，尤其是在处理长输出时。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Explicit Trait Inference for Multi-Agent Coordination
papers.title_zh: 多智能体协调中的显式特征推断
papers.authors: Suhaib Abdurahman, Etsuko Ishii, Katerina Margatina, Divya Bhargavi, Monica Sunkara, Yi Zhang
papers.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) show promise on complex tasks but remain prone to coordination failures such as goal drift, error cascades, and misaligned behaviors. We propose Explicit Trait Inference (ETI), a psychologically grounded method for improving coordination. ETI enables agents to infer and track partner characteristics along two established psychological dimensions—warmth (e.g., trust) and competence (e.g., skill)—from interaction histories to guide decisions. We evaluate ETI in controlled settings (economic games), where it reduces payoff loss by 45–77%, and in more realistic, complex multi-agent settings (MultiAgentBench), where it improves performance by 3–29% depending on the scenario and model, relative to a CoT baseline. Additional analysis shows that gains are closely linked to trait inference: ETI profiles predict agents’ actions, and informative profiles drive improvements. These results highlight ETI as a lightweight and robust mechanism for improving coordination in diverse multi-agent settings, and provide the first systematic evidence that LLM agents can (i) reliably infer others’ traits from interaction histories and (ii) leverage structured awareness of others’ traits for coordination.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在复杂任务中展现出巨大潜力，但依然容易出现协调问题，如目标偏离、错误连锁反应以及行为不协调等。我们提出了显式特征推理方法，这是一种基于心理学的协调改进手段。该方法使智能体能够从交互历史中推断出并跟踪伙伴的特征，从而依据两个明确的心理维度——温暖度（例如信任）和能力（例如技能）——来指导决策。我们在受控环境中进行评估，例如在经济博弈中，显式特征推理能够将收益损失减少45%至77%；在更现实、更复杂的多智能体环境中，根据具体情况和模型的不同，其性能提升幅度可达3%至29%。进一步分析表明，这些提升效果与特征推理密切相关：显式特征推理能够预测智能体的行为，而富有信息量的特征描述则有助于改善协调效果。这些结果凸显了显式特征推理作为一种轻量级且高效的协调机制，适用于各种多智能体环境。同时，这些研究也为首个系统性证据提供了支持，证明大语言模型智能体能够：(i) 从交互历史中可靠地推断出他人的特征；(ii) 利用对他人特征的结构化认知来实现协调。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SFTMix: Elevating Language Model Instruction Tuning with Mixup Recipe
papers.title_zh: SFTMix：通过Mixup方法提升语言模型调优效果
papers.authors: Yuxin Xiao, Shujian Zhang, Marzyeh Ghassemi, Wenxuan Zhou
papers.abstract: To acquire instruction-following capabilities, large language models (LLMs) undergo instruction tuning, where they are trained on instruction-response pairs using next-token prediction (NTP). Efforts to improve instruction tuning often focus on higher-quality supervised fine-tuning (SFT) datasets, typically requiring data filtering with proprietary LLMs or human annotation. In this paper, we take a different approach by proposing SFTMix, a novel Mixup-based recipe that elevates LLM instruction tuning without relying on well-curated datasets. We observe that LLMs exhibit uneven confidence across the semantic representation space. We argue that examples with different confidence levels should play distinct roles in instruction tuning: Confident data is prone to overfitting, while unconfident data is harder to generalize. Based on this insight, SFTMix leverages training dynamics to identify examples with varying confidence levels. We then interpolate them to bridge the confidence gap and apply a Mixup-based regularization to support learning on these additional, interpolated examples. We demonstrate the effectiveness of SFTMix in both instruction-following and healthcare-specific SFT tasks, with consistent improvements across LLM families and SFT datasets of varying sizes and qualities. Extensive analyses across six directions highlight SFTMix’s compatibility with data selection, adaptability to compute-constrained scenarios, and scalability to broader applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了获得遵循指令的能力，大语言模型会经过指令调整训练，通过利用下一个词元的预测来训练模型，使其能够在指令响应对上进行学习。在改进指令调整方面，人们通常致力于构建更高质量的监督微调数据集，这通常需要使用专有的语言模型进行数据筛选，或者依赖人工注释。在本文中，我们采取了不同的方法，提出了SFTMix这一基于Mixup的算法。该算法无需依赖精心挑选的数据集，就能提升语言模型的指令调整能力。我们发现，语言模型在语义表示空间中表现出不同的置信度。我们认为，具有不同置信度的样本在指令调整中应扮演不同的角色：置信度高的样本容易导致过拟合，而不置信度的样本则更难进行泛化。基于这一洞察，SFTMix利用训练动态来识别具有不同置信度的样本。然后，我们对这些样本进行插值处理，以填补置信度之间的差距，并应用基于Mixup的正则化方法来支持对这些额外插值样本的学习。我们证明了SFTMix在遵循指令和医疗领域微调任务中的有效性，且在不同类型和质量的语言模型及微调数据集上都能取得持续的改进。通过对六个方向的广泛分析，我们发现SFTMix在数据选择、适应计算受限的场景以及扩展应用到更广泛领域方面都具有很高的兼容性。

papers.title: Psychological Steering in LLMs: An Evaluation of Effectiveness and Trustworthiness
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型中应用心理驱动机制：对其有效性和可信度的评估
papers.authors: Amin Banayeeanzade, Ala N. Tak, Fatemeh Bahrani, Anahita Bolourani, Leonardo Blas, Emilio Ferrara, Jonathan Gratch, Sai Praneeth Karimireddy
papers.abstract: The ability to control LLMs’ emulated emotional states and personality traits is an essential step in enabling rich, human-centered interactions in socially interactive settings. We introduce PsySET, a Psychologically-informed benchmark to evaluate LLM Steering Effectiveness and Trustworthiness across the emotion and personality domains. Our study spans four models from different LLM families paired with various steering strategies, including prompting, fine-tuning, and representation engineering. Our results indicate that prompting is consistently effective but limited in intensity control, whereas vector injections achieve finer controllability while slightly reducing output quality. Moreover, we explore the trustworthiness of steered LLMs by assessing safety, truthfulness, fairness, and ethics, highlighting potential side effects and behavioral shifts. Notably, we observe idiosyncratic effects; for instance, even a positive emotion like joy can degrade robustness to adversarial factuality, lower privacy awareness, and increase preferential bias. Meanwhile, anger predictably elevates toxicity yet strengthens leakage resistance. Our framework establishes the first holistic evaluation of emotion and personality steering, offering insights into its interpretability and reliability for socially interactive applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 控制大语言模型模拟的情绪状态和性格特征，是实现在社交互动环境中丰富、以人类为中心的互动的关键步骤。我们提出了PsySET这一基于心理学的评估基准，用于评估大语言模型在情绪和性格领域的引导效果与可信度。我们的研究涵盖了来自不同大语言模型家族的四种模型，并采用了多种引导策略，包括提示、微调以及表示工程等。研究结果表明，提示方法始终有效，但在强度控制方面存在局限性；而向量注入则能实现更精细的控制，同时略微降低了输出质量。此外，我们还通过评估安全性、真实性、公平性和伦理性来探讨被引导的大语言模型的可靠性，从而发现潜在的副作用和行为变化。值得注意的是，我们观察到一些特殊效应：例如，即使是像快乐这样的积极情绪，也会降低模型对对抗性事实的鲁棒性，降低隐私意识，并增加偏好性偏差。与此同时，愤怒情绪则会提升模型的毒性，但也能增强其抵御泄露的能力。我们的框架首次对情绪和性格引导进行了全面评估，为社交互动应用中的可解释性和可靠性提供了重要见解。

papers.title: Hierarchical Policy Optimization for Simultaneous Translation of Unbounded Speech
papers.title_zh: 用于无限长度语音同时翻译的层次式策略优化方法
papers.authors: Siqi Ouyang, Shuoyang Ding, Oleksii Hrinchuk, Vitaly Lavrukhin, Brian Yan, Boris Ginsburg, Lei Li
papers.abstract: Simultaneous speech translation (SST) generates translations while receiving partial speech input. Recent advances show that large language models (LLMs) can substantially improve SST quality, but at the cost of high computational overhead. To reduce this cost, prior work reformulates SST as a multi-turn dialogue task, enabling full reuse of the LLM’s key–value (KV) cache and eliminating redundant feature recomputation. However, this approach relies on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data in dialogue form, for which few human annotations exist, and existing synthesis methods cannot guarantee data quality. In this work, we propose a Hierarchical Policy Optimization (HPO) approach that post-train models trained on imperfect SFT data. We introduce a hierarchical reward that balances translation quality and latency objectives. Experiments on English to Chinese/German/Japanese demonstrate improvements of over +7 COMET score and +1.25 MetricX score at a latency of 1.5 seconds. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of different quality rewards, hierarchical reward formulations, and segmentation strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 同时语音翻译（SST）在接收部分语音输入时就能生成翻译结果。最近的研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）可以显著提升SST的翻译质量，但这一过程需要较高的计算资源。为了降低这一成本，先前的研究将SST重新设计为多轮对话任务，从而能够完全复用LLM的键值缓存机制，并避免重复计算相同特征。不过，这种方法依赖于以对话形式呈现的监督式微调数据，而这类数据的注释量相对较少，而且现有的合成方法也无法保证数据的质量。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种分层策略优化方法，即针对基于不完美微调数据训练的模型进行后训练。我们引入了一种分层奖励机制，该机制兼顾了翻译质量和延迟这两个目标。在英译中/德译日方面的实验表明，使用该方法可以在1.5秒的延迟时间内提升超过7分的COMET评分和1.25分的MetricX评分。全面的消融研究进一步验证了不同质量奖励机制、分层奖励结构以及分割策略的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Act as you think: Reinforcing Consistent Reasoning in Medical Visual Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 按照你的想法行事：在医学视觉问答系统中强化一致的推理逻辑
papers.authors: Songtao Jiang, Yuan Wang, Ruizhe Chen, Yan Zhang, Ruilin Luo, Bohan Lei, Yeying Jin, Sibo Song, ZhiBo Yang, Jimeng Sun, Jian Wu, Zuozhu Liu
papers.abstract: While reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been proven highly effective for enhancing reasoning, its application to medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) is hampered by models producing reasoning inconsistent with either the visual evidence or the final answer. Our analysis reveals a critical flaw in RLVR training: it paradoxically encourages models to disregard visual evidence and generate answers that contradict their own reasoning. This degradation is most pronounced in specialized medical modalities (e.g., Fundus, Ultrasound) where base VLMs lack robust understanding, a failure we attribute to a flawed reward mechanism exacerbated by the scarcity of diverse training data. To tackle this, we introduce Med-Zero-17K, a large-scale dataset spanning over 30 modalities and 24 clinically relevant tasks, and the Multi-Consistency Reward (MCR) framework, which explicitly rewards both perceptual grounding and logical coherence. Extensive experiments validate our approach: integrating MCR into the RLVR framework delivers robust performance gains. This success stems from our crucial finding that rewarding internal consistency is significantly more effective than attempting to judge reasoning correctness. Furthermore, MCR proves highly versatile, exhibiting strong generalization across diverse VLM backbones, compatibility with RL algorithms like GRPO and DPO, and extending its effectiveness to 3D VQA tasks and R1-style training paradigms. Code and dataset will be released.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于可验证奖励的强化学习在提升推理能力方面已被证明非常有效，但其在医学视觉问题回答领域中的应用却受到了模型产生的推理结果与视觉证据或最终答案不一致的问题的阻碍。我们的分析揭示了强化学习训练中的一个关键缺陷：它反而促使模型忽略视觉证据，生成与自身推理相悖的答案。这种退化现象在专门的医学领域（如眼底检查、超声诊断）中尤为明显，因为这些领域的基线视觉模型缺乏足够的理解能力。我们认为这一问题的原因在于奖励机制的缺陷，再加上训练数据的匮乏，进一步加剧了这一问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Med-Zero-17K这个大规模数据集，该数据集涵盖了30种医学模式和24项具有临床意义的任务。我们还提出了多一致性奖励框架，该框架同时奖励感知基础知识和逻辑一致性。大量的实验验证了我们的方法的有效性：将多一致性奖励框架整合到强化学习框架中，能够显著提高模型的性能。这一成功源于我们的一个重要发现：奖励内部一致性比试图判断推理的正确性要有效得多。此外，多一致性奖励框架还具有很强的通用性，能够在不同的视觉模型基础上实现良好的泛化能力，并且能够与GRPO和DPO等强化学习算法兼容，其有效性还扩展到了3D视觉问题回答任务和R1风格的训练范式。我们的代码和数据集即将发布。

papers.title: CRISP: Persistent Concept Unlearning via Sparse Autoencoders
papers.title_zh: CRISP：通过稀疏自编码器实现持续的概念遗忘
papers.authors: Tomer Ashuach, Dana Arad, Aaron Mueller, Martin Tutek, Yonatan Belinkov
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, the need to selectively remove unwanted knowledge while preserving model utility has become paramount. Recent work has explored sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to perform precise interventions on monosemantic features. However, most SAE-based methods operate at inference time, which does not create persistent changes in the model’s parameters. Such interventions can be bypassed or reversed by malicious actors with parameter access. We introduce CRISP, a parameter-efficient method for persistent concept unlearning using SAEs. CRISP automatically identifies salient SAE features across multiple layers and suppresses their activations. We experiment with two LLMs and show that our method outperforms prior approaches on safety-critical unlearning tasks from the WMDP benchmark, successfully removing harmful knowledge while preserving general and in-domain capabilities. Feature-level analysis reveals that CRISP achieves semantically coherent separation between target and benign concepts, allowing precise suppression of the target features.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在现实应用中的广泛应用，选择性地去除不需要的知识同时保留模型的实用性变得至关重要。最近的研究采用了稀疏自编码器技术来对单义特征进行精确干预。然而，大多数基于稀疏自编码器的方法都是在推理阶段进行的，这并不能在模型参数上产生持久性的变化。这样的干预可以被具有参数访问权限的恶意行为者绕过或逆转。我们提出了CRISP这一方法，它是一种利用稀疏自编码器实现持久性概念遗忘的参数高效方法。CRISP能够自动识别多层中的显著稀疏自编码器特征，并抑制这些特征的激活。我们对两种语言模型进行了实验，结果表明，我们的方法在WMDP基准测试中的安全关键遗忘任务上表现优于以往的方法，能够成功去除有害知识，同时保留一般性和领域内的能力。特征级分析显示，CRISP能够在目标和良性概念之间实现语义上的清晰区分，从而精确地抑制目标特征。

papers.title: LongSpec: Long-Context Lossless Speculative Decoding with Efficient Drafting and Verification
papers.title_zh: LongSpec：一种针对长上下文范围的无损推测解码技术，同时具备高效的编码与验证功能
papers.authors: Penghui Yang, Cunxiao Du, Fengzhuo Zhang, Haonan Wang, Tianyu Pang, Chao Du, Bo An
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) can now process extremely long contexts, efficient inference over these extended inputs has become increasingly important, especially for emerging applications like LLM agents that highly depend on this capability. Speculative decoding (SD) offers a promising lossless acceleration technique compared to lossy alternatives such as quantization and model cascades. However, most state-of-the-art SD methods are trained on short texts (typically fewer than 4k tokens), making them unsuitable for long-context scenarios. Specifically, adapting these methods to long contexts presents three key challenges: (1) the excessive memory demands posed by draft models due to large Key-Value (KV) cache; (2) performance degradation resulting from the mismatch between short-context training and long-context inference; and (3) inefficiencies in tree attention mechanisms when managing long token sequences. This work introduces LongSpec, a framework that addresses these challenges through three core innovations: a memory-efficient draft model with a constant-sized KV cache; novel position indices that mitigate the training–inference mismatch; and an attention aggregation strategy that combines fast prefix computation with standard tree attention to enable efficient decoding. Experimental results confirm the effectiveness of LongSpec, achieving up to a 3.26x speedup over strong Flash Attention baselines across five long-context understanding datasets, as well as a 2.34x reduction in wall-clock time on four math reasoning tasks with the QwQ model, demonstrating significant latency improvements for long-context applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）能够处理极其长的上下文信息，对这些扩展输入进行高效推理变得越来越重要，尤其是在那些高度依赖此能力的应用中，比如LLM代理。推测解码是一种很有前景的无损加速技术，相比有损的替代方法如量化和模型级联来说更为理想。然而，目前大多数先进的推测解码方法都是针对短文本训练的（通常少于4000个令牌），因此不适合处理长上下文场景。具体来说，将这些方法适应于长上下文环境面临着三个主要挑战：（1）由于KV缓存规模庞大，草稿模型带来的过度内存需求；（2）由于短上下文训练与长上下文推理之间的不匹配导致的性能下降；（3）在处理长令牌序列时，树状注意力机制的效率低下。本研究提出了LongSpec框架，通过三项核心创新来应对这些挑战：一种内存效率高的草稿模型，其KV缓存大小保持不变；新的位置索引机制，能够缓解训练与推理之间的不匹配问题；以及一种注意力聚合策略，该策略结合了快速前缀计算与标准树状注意力机制，从而实现高效解码。实验结果表明，LongSpec在五个长上下文理解数据集上的性能显著提升，比强大的Flash Attention基线模型快了3.26倍。此外，在四个数学推理任务中，使用QwQ模型时，LongSpec的耗时减少了2.34倍，这表明其在长上下文应用场景中显著降低了延迟问题。

papers.title: Using Perspectival Words Is Harder Than Vocabulary Words for Humans —and Even More So for Multimodal Language Models
papers.title_zh: 使用视角性词汇比处理人类常用的词汇要困难得多——对于多模态语言模型来说，这种难度更是不可逾越
papers.authors: Dota Tianai Dong, Yifan Luo, Po-Ya Angela Wang, Asli Ozyurek, Paula Rubio-Fernandez
papers.abstract: Multimodal language models (MLMs) increasingly demonstrate human-like communication, yet their use of everyday perspectival words remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we compare humans and MLMs in their use of three word types, which we predict impose increasing cognitive demands: vocabulary (e.g., ’boat’ or ’cup’), possessives (e.g., ’mine’ vs. ’yours’), and demonstratives (e.g., ’this one’ vs. ’that one’). Testing seven MLMs against human participants, we find that perspectival words are harder than vocabulary words for both groups. The gap is even larger for MLMs: while models approach human-level performance on using vocabulary, they exhibit clear deficits with possessives and even greater difficulties with demonstratives. Ablation analyses point to limitations in perspective-taking and spatial reasoning as key sources of these gaps in MLMs. Instruction-based prompting helps close the gap for possessives but still leaves demonstratives far below human performance. These results show that, unlike vocabulary, perspectival words pose a greater challenge in human communication—and this difficulty is further amplified in MLMs, revealing a crucial shortfall in their pragmatic and social-cognitive abilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型在表现人类般的沟通能力方面已经取得了显著进展，然而它们在使用日常表达性词汇方面的能力仍然不被充分理解。为了填补这一空白，我们对比了人类和多模态语言模型在三种词类上的使用情况：词汇词（如“船”或“杯子”）、所有格词（如“我的”与“你的”）以及指示代词（如“这个”与“那个”）。通过对七种多模态语言模型与人类参与者进行测试，我们发现，无论是对于人类还是多模态语言模型来说，表达性词汇的使用都比词汇词更为困难。对于多模态语言模型而言，这种差距更为明显：虽然这些模型在使用词汇词时已经接近人类水平，但在处理所有格词时仍存在明显不足，而处理指示代词时的困难则更为严重。消融分析表明，多模态语言模型在视角转换和空间推理方面的能力不足是造成这些差异的主要原因。通过指导性提示可以弥补所有格词的不足，但指示代词的处理能力仍然远远低于人类水平。这些结果表明，与词汇词不同，表达性词汇在人类沟通中带来了更大的挑战——而在多模态语言模型中，这种难度被进一步放大，这揭示了它们在语用和社会认知能力方面的重大缺陷。

papers.title: CHIMERA: A Knowledge Base of Scientific Idea Recombinations for Research Analysis and Ideation
papers.title_zh: 奇美拉：用于研究分析与创意产生的科学思想重组知识库
papers.authors: Noy Sternlicht, Tom Hope
papers.abstract: A hallmark of human innovation is recombination—the creation of novel ideas by integrating elements from existing concepts and mechanisms. In this work, we introduce CHIMERA, the first large-scale Knowledge Base (KB) of recombination examples automatically mined from the scientific literature. CHIMERA enables empirical analysis of how scientists recombine concepts and draw inspiration from different areas, and enables training models that propose cross-disciplinary research directions. To construct this KB, we define a new information extraction task: identifying recombination instances in papers. We curate an expert-annotated dataset and use it to fine-tune an LLM-based extraction model, which we apply to a broad corpus of AI papers. We also demonstrate generalization to a biological domain. We showcase the utility of CHIMERA through two applications. First, we analyze patterns of recombination across AI subfields. Second, we train a scientific hypothesis generation model using the KB, showing that it can propose directions that researchers rate as inspiring.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类创新的显著特征就是重组——通过整合现有概念和机制中的元素来创造新的想法。在这项研究中，我们推出了CHIMERA，这是首个从科学文献中自动挖掘出的大规模重组案例知识库。CHIMERA能够帮助我们实证分析科学家如何重组概念，并从不同领域获取灵感，还能帮助训练出能够提出跨学科研究方向的模型。为了构建这个知识库，我们定义了一个新的信息提取任务：识别论文中的重组实例。我们整理了一个由专家标注的数据集，并利用它来微调基于大语言模型的提取模型，然后将该模型应用于大量的人工智能相关论文。我们还展示了该模型在生物领域的泛化能力。我们通过两个应用展示了CHIMERA的实用性。首先，我们分析了不同人工智能子领域中的重组模式。其次，我们使用该知识库训练了一个科学假设生成模型，结果表明该模型能够提出研究人员认为有启发性的研究方向。

papers.title: Towards Robust Real-World Spreadsheet Understanding with Multi-Agent Multi-Format Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 致力于通过多智能体、多格式推理来实现对真实世界电子表格数据的稳健理解
papers.authors: Houxing Ren, Mingjie Zhan, Zimu Lu, Ke Wang, Yunqiao Yang, Haotian Hou, Hongsheng Li
papers.abstract: Spreadsheets are central to real-world applications such as enterprise reporting, auditing, and scientific data management. Despite their ubiquity, existing large language model based approaches typically treat tables as plain text, overlooking critical layout cues and visual semantics. Moreover, real-world spreadsheets are often massive in scale, exceeding the input length that LLMs can efficiently process. To address these challenges, we propose SpreadsheetAgent, a two-stage multi-agent framework for spreadsheet understanding that adopts a step-by-step reading and reasoning paradigm. Instead of loading the entire spreadsheet at once, SpreadsheetAgent incrementally interprets localized regions through multiple modalities, including code execution results, images, and LaTeX tables. The method first constructs a structural sketch and row/column summaries, and then performs task-driven reasoning over this intermediate representation in the Solving Stage. To further enhance reliability, we design a verification module that validates extracted structures via targeted inspections, reducing error propagation and ensuring trustworthy inputs for downstream reasoning. Extensive experiments on two spreadsheet datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. With GPT-OSS-120B, SpreadsheetAgent achieves 38.16% on Spreadsheet Bench, outperforming the ChatGPT Agent baseline (35.27%) by 2.89 absolute points. These results highlight the potential of SpreadsheetAgent to advance robust and scalable spreadsheet understanding in real-world applications. Code is available at https://github.com/renhouxing/SpreadsheetAgent.
papers.abstract_zh: 电子表格在诸如企业报告、审计和科学数据管理等实际应用中占据核心地位。尽管电子表格无处不在，但现有的基于大语言模型的方法通常将表格视为普通文本，忽略了重要的布局线索和视觉语义信息。此外，现实世界中的电子表格往往规模庞大，其输入长度远远超过大语言模型能够高效处理的范围。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SpreadsheetAgent这一两阶段多智能体框架，该框架采用逐步读取和推理的范式来处理电子表格。SpreadsheetAgent不是一次性加载整个电子表格，而是通过多种方式逐步解析局部区域，包括代码执行结果、图像以及LaTeX表格。该方法首先构建结构草图和行/列摘要，然后在解决阶段对这种中间表示进行任务驱动的推理。为了进一步提高可靠性，我们设计了一个验证模块，通过有针对性的检查来验证提取出的结构，从而减少错误传播，确保下游推理的输入具有可信性。在两个电子表格数据集上的广泛实验证明了我们的方法的有效性。使用GPT-OSS-120B模型，SpreadsheetAgent在Spreadsheet Bench测试中的表现达到了38.16%，比ChatGPT Agent基线模型的35.27%高出2.89个百分点。这些结果凸显了SpreadsheetAgent在提升现实应用中电子表格理解的可靠性和可扩展性方面的潜力。代码可在https://github.com/renhouxing/SpreadsheetAgent下载。

papers.title: GATE: Graph-based Adaptive Tool Evolution Across Diverse Tasks
papers.title_zh: GATE：基于图的自适应工具进化技术，适用于多种任务场景
papers.authors: Jianwen Luo, Yiming Huang, Jinxiang Meng, Fangyu Lei, Shizhu He, Xiao Liu, Shanshan Jiang, Bin Dong, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great promise in tool-making, yet existing frameworks often struggle to efficiently construct reliable toolsets and are limited to single-task settings. To address these challenges, we propose GATE (Graph-based Adaptive Tool Evolution), an adaptive framework that dynamically constructs and evolves a hierarchical graph of reusable tools across multiple scenarios. We evaluate GATE on open-ended tasks (Minecraft), agent-based tasks (TextCraft, DABench), and code generation tasks (MATH, Date, TabMWP). Our results show that GATE achieves up to 4.3× faster milestone completion in Minecraft compared to the previous state-of-the-art method, and provides an average improvement of 9.23% over existing tool-making methods in code generation tasks and 10.03% in agent tasks. Further analysis shows that GATE exhibits strong adaptive evolution capabilities, effectively balancing tool quantity, complexity, and functionality while maintaining high efficiency. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ayanami2003/GATE.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在工具构建方面展现出巨大的潜力，然而现有的框架往往难以高效地构建可靠的工具集，且仅限于单一任务场景。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了GATE（基于图的自适应工具演化）这一自适应框架。该框架能够动态构建并演化出适用于多种场景的可复用工具层次结构图。我们在开放式任务（如Minecraft）、基于代理的任务（如TextCraft、DABench）以及代码生成任务（如MATH、Date、TabMWP）上对GATE进行了评估。结果表明，与现有的最先进方法相比，GATE在Minecraft中的任务完成速度提高了4.3倍；在代码生成任务中，GATE的平均改进幅度为9.23%，在基于代理的任务中则达到了10.03%。进一步分析表明，GATE具有强大的自适应演化能力，能够在保持高效率的同时，有效平衡工具的数量、复杂性和功能特性。相关的代码和数据可访问于https://github.com/ayanami2003/GATE。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Erasing Without Remembering: Implicit Knowledge Forgetting in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 无需记忆的擦除：大型语言模型中的隐性知识遗忘问题
papers.authors: Huazheng Wang, Yongcheng Jing, Haifeng Sun, Yingjie Wang, Jingyu Wang, Jianxin Liao, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate knowledge forgetting in large language models with a focus on its generalisation—ensuring that models forget not only specific training samples but also related implicit knowledge. To this end, we begin by identifying a broader unlearning scope that includes both target data and logically associated samples, including rephrased, subject-replaced, relation-reversed, and one-hop reasoned data. We then conduct a rigorous evaluation of 15 state-of-the-art methods across three datasets, revealing that unlearned models still recall paraphrased answers and retain target facts in their intermediate layers. This motivates us to take a preliminary step toward more generalised implicit knowledge forgetting by proposing PERMU—a novel probability perturbation-based unlearning paradigm. PERMU simulates adversarial unlearning samples to eliminate fact-related tokens from the logit distribution, collectively reducing the probabilities of all answer-associated tokens. Experiments are conducted on a diverse range of datasets, including TOFU, Harry Potter, ZsRE, WMDP, and MUSE, using models ranging from 1.3B to 13B in scale. The results demonstrate that PERMU delivers up to a 50.40% improvement in unlearning vanilla target data while maintaining a 40.73% boost in forgetting implicit knowledge. Our code can be found in the supplementary material.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了大语言模型中的知识遗忘问题，重点关注其泛化特性——确保模型不仅会遗忘特定的训练样本，还会遗忘相关的隐性知识。为此，我们首先确定了更广泛的遗忘范围，包括目标数据以及逻辑上相关的样本，比如重新表述的答案、主题被替换的样本、关系被反转的样本，以及一跳推理得到的样本。随后，我们对15种先进的方法进行了严格的评估，测试了它们在三个数据集上的表现。结果表明，即使经过遗忘处理，模型仍然能够回忆起重新表述的答案，并在中间层保留目标事实。这促使我们尝试一种更通用的隐性知识遗忘方法，提出了PERMU这一基于概率扰动的遗忘范式。PERMU通过模拟对抗性遗忘样本，来消除与事实相关的标记，从而显著降低所有与答案相关的标记的概率。实验在多种不同的数据集上进行，包括TOFU、哈利·波特、ZsRE、WMDP和MUSE等，使用的模型规模从13亿到130亿不等。实验结果显示，PERMU在遗忘原始目标数据方面取得了高达50.40%的提升，而在遗忘隐性知识方面则提升了40.73%。我们的代码可以在补充材料中找到。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models without Performance Degradation
papers.title_zh: 在不会降低模型性能的前提下，减轻大型视觉语言模型中的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Xingyu Zhu, Junfeng Fang, Shuo Wang, Beier Zhu, Zhicai Wang, Yonghui Yang, Xiangnan He
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit powerful generative capabilities but frequently produce hallucinations that compromise output reliability. Fine tuning on annotated data devoid of hallucinations offers the most direct solution, while its high computational cost motivates recent representation-based methods, which focus on mitigating hallucinatory components within hidden representations. Though efficient, we empirically observe that these methods degrade general generation capacity due to incomplete extraction of hallucination components and non-selective parameter updates. To address these limitations, we propose MPD, a dual-stage framework for mitigating hallucinations without performance degradation. Specifically, our MPD relies on two essential factors: (1) semantic-aware component disentanglement to extract pure hallucination components, and (2) interpretable parameter updates that selectively modify parameters most relevant to hallucination. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MPD achieves state-of-the-art performance, reducing hallucinations by 23.4% while maintaining 97.4% of general generative capability as evaluated on LLaVA-Bench and MME, with no additional computational cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型具有强大的生成能力，但往往会产生幻觉，这会降低模型的输出可靠性。在没有幻觉的标注数据上进行微调是最直接的解决方案，不过这种方法的计算成本很高，因此最近出现了基于表示的方法，这些方法致力于减少隐藏表示中的幻觉成分。尽管这些方法效率较高，但我们通过实验发现，由于无法完全提取幻觉成分以及非选择性地更新参数，这些方法的整体生成能力会下降。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了MPD这一双阶段框架，旨在在不降低性能的情况下减少幻觉现象。具体来说，MPD依赖于两个关键因素：(1) 语义感知的成分分离技术，以提取纯粹的幻觉成分；(2) 可解释的参数更新机制，能够选择性地调整与幻觉最相关的参数。大量实验表明，MPD取得了出色的性能表现：在LLaVA-Bench和MME评估中，幻觉发生率降低了23.4%，同时保持了97.4%的整体生成能力，且无需额外的计算成本。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: APB-V: Accelerating Long-Video Understanding via Sequence-Parallelism-aware Approximate Attention
papers.title_zh: APB-V：通过支持序列并行性的近似注意力机制，加速长视频理解过程
papers.authors: Yuxiang Huang, Mingye Li, Xu Han, Chaojun Xiao, Weilin Zhao, Ao Sun, Ziqi Yuan, Hao Zhou, Fandong Meng, Zhiyuan Liu
papers.abstract: The efficiency of long-video inference remains a critical bottleneck, mainly due to the dense computation in the prefill stage of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). Existing methods either compress visual embeddings or apply sparse attention on a single GPU, yielding limited acceleration or degraded performance and restricting LMMs from handling longer, more complex videos. To overcome these issues, we propose APB-V, a sequence-parallel framework with optimized attention that accelerates long-video inference across multiple GPUs. By distributing approximate attention, APB-V reduces computation and increases parallelism, enabling efficient processing of more visual embeddings without compression and thereby improving task performance. System-level optimizations, such as load balancing and fused forward passes, further unleash the potential of APB-V, delivering speedups of 12.72x, 1.70x, and 1.18x over FlashAttn, ZigZagRing, and APB, without notable performance loss.
papers.abstract_zh: 长视频推理的效率仍然是一个关键的瓶颈问题，这主要源于大型多模态模型在预填充阶段需要进行大量的计算操作。现有的方法要么压缩视觉嵌入数据，要么在单个GPU上采用稀疏注意力机制进行处理，这种处理方式要么加速效果有限，要么会导致性能下降，从而限制了大型多模态模型处理更长、更复杂的视频的能力。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了APB-V这一序列并行框架，该框架采用了优化的注意力机制，能够跨多个GPU加速长视频推理过程。通过分布式近似注意力机制，APB-V减少了计算量并提升了并行性，使得在不进行压缩的情况下也能高效处理更多的视觉嵌入数据，进而提高了任务处理效率。此外，系统级的优化措施，如负载均衡和融合前向传递等，进一步释放了APB-V的潜力，使其在处理速度上分别比FlashAttn快12.72倍、1.70倍和1.18倍，同时不会造成明显的性能损失。

papers.title: AraVQA: Building a New Arabic Factoid Visual Question Answering Dataset from Wikipedia
papers.title_zh: AraVQA：基于维基百科构建新的阿拉伯语事实问答数据集
papers.authors: Sultan Alrowili, Younes Samih, Abed Alhakim Freihat, Mathan Kumar Eswaran
papers.abstract: The development of large-scale Visual Question Answering (VQA) datasets has traditionally relied on resource-intensive manual annotation. In addition, most of the existing Arabic VQA datasets focus on culturally-specific and dialect-aware domains. To address these limitations, we propose a new pipeline that leverages Wikipedia template tags to extract the relevant information for each image, which is subsequently utilized by the Large Language Model (LLM) to synthetically generate a new visual question answering dataset. Using this pipeline, we have constructed AraVQA, the most comprehensive Arabic Factoid Visual Question Answering dataset, containing more than 50,000 questions and covering over 20 varied primary subjects within Arabic general knowledge. Our detailed analysis shows that our dataset can serve as a post-training dataset to enhance the performance of existing Visual Language Models (VLMs) on Arabic VQA tasks. Furthermore, we present a novel benchmark, derived from our dataset and validated through manual annotation, that poses more challenges to Arabic VLMs than existing Arabic VQA datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模视觉问答数据集的开发传统上依赖于资源密集型的手动标注工作。此外，目前大多数阿拉伯语视觉问答数据集都专注于特定文化环境和方言相关的领域。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种新的处理流程：利用维基百科模板标签来提取每张图片的相关信息，然后由大语言模型利用这些信息合成新的视觉问答数据集。通过这一流程，我们构建了AraVQA——最全面的阿拉伯语事实性视觉问答数据集，该数据集包含超过5万个问题，涵盖了阿拉伯语常识领域的20多个不同主题。我们的详细分析表明，该数据集可以作为后训练数据集，提升现有视觉语言模型在阿拉伯语视觉问答任务上的性能。此外，我们还提出了一个新的基准测试，该测试基于我们的数据集构建，并通过手动标注进行了验证，它给阿拉伯语视觉语言模型带来了比现有阿拉伯语视觉问答数据集更大的挑战。

papers.title: What is a protest anyway? Codebook conceptualization is still a first-order concern in LLM-era classification
papers.title_zh: 那么，什么是抗议呢？在大型语言模型时代，对“代码本”概念的理解仍然是一个首要的问题
papers.authors: Andrew Halterman, Katherine A. Keith
papers.abstract: Generative large language models (LLMs) are now used extensively for text classification in computational social science (CSS). In this work, we focus on the steps before and after LLM prompting: conceptualization of the categories to classify and using LLM predictions in downstream statistical inference. We argue these steps have been overlooked in much of LLM-era CSS and LLMs can tempt analysts to skip conceptualization altogether. For example, a political scientist classifying “protest” with LLMs may never be forced to craft a definition: unlike human annotators who would ask clarifying questions, an LLM can silently accept an underspecified concept to classify and return plausible-looking labels. Using simulations, we show that conceptualization failures induce downstream inferential bias that cannot be corrected solely by a more accurate LLM or post-hoc bias correction methods. We conclude by reminding CSS analysts that conceptualization is still a first-order concern in the LLM-era and provide concrete advice for pursuing low-cost, unbiased, low-variance downstream estimates.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式大语言模型如今被广泛用于计算社会科学中的文本分类任务。在本研究中，我们重点关注了使用LLM进行文本分类之前和之后的步骤：对要分类的类别进行概念化处理，以及利用LLM的预测结果来进行后续的统计推断。我们认为，在LLM时代，这些步骤往往被忽视了，而LLM可能会诱使分析师完全跳过概念化的环节。例如，一位政治学家使用LLM来分类“抗议活动”，他可能永远不必去制定一个明确的定义；与人类注释者不同，LLM可以默默地接受那些定义不明确的概念，并给出看似合理的标签。通过模拟实验，我们发现概念化方面的失误会导致后续的推断偏差，而这种偏差仅靠更精确的LLM或事后修正方法是无法解决的。最后，我们提醒计算社会科学的分析师们，在LLM时代，概念化仍然是一个重要的考虑因素，并提供了一些具体的建议，以帮助他们以低成本、无偏见且低方差的方式获得后续分析结果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When Misinformation Speaks and Converses: Rethinking Fact-Checking in Audio Platforms
papers.title_zh: 当错误信息被传播和讨论时：重新思考音频平台上的事实核查工作
papers.authors: Chaewan Chun, Delvin Ce Zhang, Dongwon Lee
papers.abstract: Audio platforms have evolved beyond entertainment. They have become central to public discourse, from podcasts and radio to WhatsApp voice notes and live streams. With millions of shows and hundreds of millions of listeners, audio platforms are now a major channel for misinformation. Yet existing fact-checking pipelines are mostly designed for written claims, overlooking the unique properties of spoken media. We argue that audio misinformation is not merely textual content with transcripts: it is structurally different because it is both spoken—carrying persuasive force through prosody, pacing, and emotion—and conversational—unfolding across turns, speakers, and episodes. These dual properties introduce verification difficulties that traditional methods rarely face. This position paper synthesizes evidence across modalities and platforms, examines datasets and methods, and highlights why existing pipelines fail on audio. We argue that advancing fact-checking requires rethinking verification pipelines around the spoken and conversational realities of audio.
papers.abstract_zh: 音频平台已经超越了娱乐范畴，成为公共讨论的核心工具。从播客和广播到WhatsApp语音笔记和直播，音频平台在信息传播中发挥着重要作用。如今，有数以百万计的内容创作者和数亿听众，音频平台也成了错误信息传播的主要渠道。然而，现有的事实核查流程大多是针对书面内容设计的，忽视了口语媒体的独特特性。我们认为，音频中的错误信息并非仅仅是带有文字记录的内容：它的结构与众不同，因为它既包含口语表达——通过语调、节奏和情感传递说服力——又具有对话性质——以轮流发言、不同说话者和不同情节的形式呈现。这两种特性带来了传统方法难以解决的验证难题。这篇立场论文综合了各种模式和平台的证据，分析了相关数据集和方法，并指出了现有流程在应对音频信息时的局限性。我们认为，要推进事实核查工作，就需要重新思考针对音频中口语和对话特性的核查流程。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Contextual Relevance and Adaptive Sampling for LLM-Based Document Reranking
papers.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的文档重新排序中的上下文相关性分析与自适应采样技术
papers.authors: Jerry Huang, Siddarth Madala, Cheng Niu, Julia Hockenmaier, Tong Zhang
papers.abstract: Reranking algorithms have made progress in improving document retrieval quality by efficiently aggregating relevance judgments generated by large language models (LLMs). However, identifying relevant documents for queries that require in-depth reasoning remains a major challenge. Reasoning-intensive queries often exhibit multifaceted information needs and nuanced interpretations, rendering document relevance inherently context dependent and often noisy. To address this, we propose contextual relevance, which we define as the probability that a document is relevant to a given query, marginalized over the distribution of different reranking contexts it may appear in (i.e., the set of candidate documents it is ranked alongside and the order in which the documents are presented to a reranking model). While prior works have studied methods to mitigate the positional bias LLMs exhibit by accounting for the ordering of documents, we empirically show that batch composition also materially affects relevance judgments. To efficiently estimate contextual relevance, we propose TS-SetRank, a sampling-based, uncertainty-aware reranking algorithm. Empirically, TS-SetRank improves nDCG@10 over retrieval and reranking baselines by 15–25% on BRIGHT and 6–21% on BEIR, highlighting the importance of modeling relevance as context-dependent.
papers.abstract_zh: 重新排序算法在提高文档检索质量方面取得了显著进展，它能够高效地整合大语言模型生成的相关性判断。然而，对于那些需要深入推理的查询来说，识别相关文档仍然是一个重大挑战。这类需要复杂推理的查询往往具有多方面的信息需求和细微的语义解读，这使得文档的相关性本质上依赖于上下文，且常常存在噪声。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了“上下文相关性”这一概念——它指的是一个文档与特定查询相关的概率，该概率是在文档可能出现的不同重新排序上下文分布上进行边缘化处理得到的（即，该文档被排在前面的候选文档列表以及这些文档在重新排序模型中的呈现顺序）。虽然之前的研究已经探讨了通过考虑文档的顺序来减轻大语言模型所表现出的位置偏见的方法，但我们的实验表明，批量组合方式也会对相关性判断产生重要影响。为了有效估计上下文相关性，我们提出了TS-SetRank这一基于采样且具备不确定性感知能力的重新排序算法。通过实验验证，TS-SetRank在BRIGHT基准测试中的nDCG@10指标比传统方法提高了15-25%，在BEIR基准测试中的提升幅度达到了6-21%，这充分说明了将相关性建模为依赖上下文的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Quantifying Aleatoric Uncertainty of In-Context Learning for Robust Measure of LLM Prediction Confidence
papers.title_zh: 量化上下文学习中的随机不确定性，以准确衡量大语言模型预测的可靠性
papers.authors: Jinseok Chung, Minkyoung Song, Hyunji Jung, Namhoon Lee
papers.abstract: In-Context Learning (ICL) allows large language models to adapt to new tasks from a few demonstrations, but its reliability remains a concern: predictions are highly sensitive to both prompt design and the model’s ability to understand the context, obscuring whether failures arise from data properties or model limitations. Uncertainty decomposition—separating aleatoric from epistemic sources—is particularly crucial in this setting, yet existing methods, designed for standard generation tasks, fail to capture the unique dynamics of ICL. To address this, we introduce a concept of self-function vectors, built upon Bayesian views and the mechanistic interpretability of ICL. These vectors leverage internal model representations to model the latent concept learned during in-context prompting, thereby enabling a direct estimation of aleatoric uncertainty within a Bayesian framework and circumventing the reliance on brittle input or decoding manipulations. Given the lack of established benchmarks and suitable evaluation protocols, we also propose the first and rigorous evaluation framework, initially grounded in synthetic tasks for conceptual development and subsequently extended to real-world datasets, in which aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty can be quantified separately under controlled settings. Moreover, we show it can be used as a practical tool for trustworthy-related applications, such as hallucination detection. Our findings pave a new direction for connecting the quantitative view of uncertainty with the mechanistic understanding of model behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 情境学习（ICL）使得大语言模型能够在少量示范数据的基础上适应新任务，但其可靠性仍是一个值得关注的问题：预测结果对提示设计以及模型对上下文的理解能力都极为敏感，这就使得我们无法确定失败是由于数据特性还是模型限制造成的。在这种情境下，将随机性不确定性与认知性不确定性分离开来尤为重要，然而现有的方法主要针对标准生成任务而设计，无法捕捉到ICL的独特动态特征。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种基于贝叶斯观点且能体现ICL机制可解释性的自函数向量概念。这些向量利用内部模型表示来模拟在情境提示过程中学到的潜在概念，从而能够在贝叶斯框架内直接估计随机性不确定性，同时避免了对脆弱输入或解码操作的依赖。由于目前缺乏成熟的评估基准和合适的评估方案，我们还提出了首个严谨的评估框架。该框架最初基于概念发展的合成任务进行验证，随后扩展到真实世界的数据集，在这些场景中，可以在受控环境下分别量化随机性和认知性不确定性。此外，我们还展示了这一方法可以作为可信相关应用中的实用工具，例如幻觉检测。我们的研究为将不确定性的定量分析与模型行为的机制理解相结合开辟了新的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SATQuest: A Verifier for Logical Reasoning Evaluation and Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of LLMs
papers.title_zh: SATQuest：一种用于逻辑推理评估的验证工具，可帮助优化大型语言模型的性能
papers.authors: Yanxiao Zhao, Yaqian Li, Zihao Bo, Rinyoichi Takezoe, Haojia Hui, Mo Guang, Lei Ren, Xiaolin Qin, Kaiwen Long
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general reasoning, yet the community lacks controllable, scalable, and verifiable tools to analyze and improve these abilities. We present SATQuest, a verifier that generates diverse SAT-based reasoning tasks directly from Conjunctive Normal Form (CNF) instances and checks answers objectively with PySAT. SATQuest factorizes evaluation along three orthogonal dimensions—instance, problem type, and question format—enabling fine-grained, multi-dimensional analysis and reinforcement fine-tuning. Randomized CNF generation mitigates memorization and supports reproducible experiments. Using SATQuest, we benchmark a range of open- and closed-weight LLMs and uncover persistent gaps in logical reasoning, particularly on higher-complexity tasks and in transfer beyond familiar mathematical notation to machine or narrative formats. We further show that reinforcement fine-tuning with SATQuest rewards substantially boosts targeted performance and generalizes to larger instances, while cross-format robustness remains challenging. Collectively, SATQuest provides verifier-backed infrastructure for controlled, scalable, and reproducible empirical research on LLM logical reasoning and its training.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型展现出强大的通用推理能力，但相关领域缺乏能够控制、可扩展且可验证的工具来分析和改进这些能力。我们提出了SATQuest这一验证工具，它能够直接从合取范式实例生成多种基于SAT的推理任务，并通过PySAT客观地验证答案的正确性。SATQuest通过三个正交维度——实例、问题类型以及问题格式——对评估进行分解，从而实现细粒度的多维分析与微调。随机生成的合取范式实例能够有效避免记忆负担，并支持可复现的实验设计。通过使用SATQuest，我们对一系列开放式和封闭式权重语言模型进行了基准测试，发现它们在逻辑推理方面存在持续的不足，尤其是在处理更高复杂度的任务时，以及在将逻辑推理从熟悉的数学符号形式转化为机器或叙述形式时。此外，我们还发现，使用SATQuest进行微调可以显著提高模型的性能，并且这种提升可以泛化到更大的实例上。不过，跨格式的稳定性仍然是一个挑战。总体而言，SATQuest为关于语言模型逻辑推理及其训练的受控、可扩展且可复现的实证研究提供了可靠的验证基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Not All Directions Matter: Towards Structured and Task-Aware Low-Rank Model Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 并非所有方向都重要：迈向结构化且面向任务的低秩模型适配方法
papers.authors: Xi Xiao, Chenrui Ma, Yunbei Zhang, Chen Liu, Zhuxuanzi Wang, Yanshu Li, Lin Zhao, Guosheng Hu, Tianyang Wang, Hao Xu
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a cornerstone of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). Yet, its efficacy is hampered by two fundamental limitations: \textit{semantic drift}, arising from treating all update directions with equal importance, and \textit{structural incoherence}, due to adapting layers independently, resulting in uncoordinated and suboptimal updates. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{StructLoRA}, a framework that tackles both limitations through a principled dual-component design: (1) an Information Bottleneck-guided filter that prunes task-irrelevant directions to mitigate semantic drift, and (2) a lightweight, training-only graph-based coordinator that enforces inter-layer consistency to resolve structural incoherence. Extensive experiments across large language models, vision language models, and vision models (including LLaMA, LLaVA, and ViT) demonstrate that \textbf{StructLoRA} consistently establishes a new state of the art, outperforming not only vanilla LoRA but also advanced dynamic rank allocation and sparsity-based methods. Notably, the gains are particularly pronounced in challenging low-rank and low-data regimes. Crucially, since the proposed modules operate only during training, \textbf{StructLoRA} improves performance with \textbf{zero additional inference cost}, shifting the focus of PEFT from mere parameter compression to a more holistic optimization of information quality and structural integrity.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）已成为参数高效微调（PEFT）的核心技术。然而，其有效性受到了两个根本性的限制：一是“语义漂移”，这是由于对所有更新方向赋予同等重要性所导致的；二是“结构不连贯性”，这是由于各层独立进行适应更新，导致更新过程缺乏协调性和优化性。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了**StructLoRA**框架。该框架通过双组件设计来解决这两个问题：(1) 一个基于信息瓶颈的过滤器，它能够剔除与任务无关的方向，从而减轻语义漂移的影响；(2) 一个轻量级的、仅用于训练的基于图的结构化协调器，它能够确保各层之间的一致性，从而解决结构不连贯性问题。在大语言模型、视觉语言模型和视觉模型（包括LLaMA、LLaVA和ViT）上的广泛实验表明，**StructLoRA**始终能够保持领先水平，其性能不仅优于普通的LoRA，还优于先进的动态秩分配方法和基于稀疏性的方法。值得注意的是，在低秩和低数据环境下，其性能提升尤为明显。最关键的是，由于这些模块仅在训练期间发挥作用，因此**StructLoRA**能够在**零额外推理成本**的情况下提升性能，使得PEFT的关注点从单纯的参数压缩转向了对信息质量和结构完整性的整体优化。

papers.title: ReContraster: Making Your Posters Stand Out with Regional Contrast
papers.title_zh: ReContraster：利用区域对比效果让您的海报更加引人注目
papers.authors: Peixuan Zhang, Zijian Jia, Ziqi Cai, Shuchen Weng, Si Li, Boxin Shi
papers.abstract: Effective poster design requires rapidly capturing attention and clearly conveying messages. Inspired by the “contrast effects” principle, we propose ReContraster, the first training-free model to leverage regional contrast to make posters stand out. By emulating the cognitive behaviors of a poster designer, ReContraster introduces the compositional multi-agent system to identify elements, organize layout, and evaluate generated poster candidates. To further ensure harmonious transitions across region boundaries, ReContraster integrates the hybrid denoising strategy during the diffusion process. We additionally contribute a new benchmark dataset for comprehensive evaluation. Seven quantitative metrics and four user studies confirm its superiority over relevant state-of-the-art methods, producing visually striking and aesthetically appealing posters.
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的海报设计需要能够迅速吸引注意力并清晰传达信息。受“对比效果”原理的启发，我们提出了ReContraster模型——这是首个无需训练的模型，它通过利用区域对比来使海报更加引人注目。通过模仿海报设计师的认知行为，ReContraster引入了一种组合式多智能体系统，用于识别元素、组织布局以及评估生成的海报候选作品。为了确保在各个区域之间实现和谐的过渡，ReContraster在扩散过程中采用了混合去噪策略。我们还提供了一个新的基准数据集，以便进行全面评估。七项定量指标和四项用户研究都证明了该模型相较于现有最先进方法的优越性，能够创造出视觉上引人注目且美观的海报。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability Should Prioritize Feature Consistency in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.title_zh: 机制性可解释性应该强调在稀疏自编码器中特征的一致性问题
papers.authors: Xiangchen Song, Aashiq Muhamed, Yujia Zheng, Lingjing Kong, Zeyu Tang, Mona T. Diab, Virginia Smith, Kun Zhang
papers.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are a prominent tool in mechanistic interpretability (MI) for decomposing neural network activations into interpretable features. However, the aspiration to identify a canonical set of features is challenged by the observed inconsistency of learned SAE features across different training runs, undermining reproducibility and complicating model comparison. We study run-to-run feature consistency in SAEs and argue that it should be reported as a standard evaluation axis alongside reconstruction and sparsity. We propose the Pairwise Dictionary Mean Correlation Coefficient (PW-MCC) as an assignment-based metric to quantify consistency and demonstrate that high levels are achievable (PW-MCC ≈ 0.80 for TopK SAEs on LLM activations) with appropriate architectural choices.Our contributions include: (i) theoretical grounding for strong consistency in the idealized setting of TopK SAEs; (ii) synthetic validation using a model organism, which verifies PW-MCC as a reliable proxy for ground-truth recovery; and (iii) empirical analysis on LLM activations, where PW-MCC correlates with the similarity of automatically generated natural-language feature explanations.
papers.abstract_zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）是机械可解释性领域中的重要工具，它能够将神经网络的激活信号分解为可解释的特征。然而，要确定一组标准特征却面临着挑战——因为在不同训练过程中，SAE所提取的特征往往存在不一致性，这影响了模型的复现性，也使得模型之间的比较变得复杂。我们研究了SAE在不同训练过程中的特征一致性问题，并认为应该将这一指标作为与重建能力和稀疏性并列的标准评估指标来报告。我们提出了“成对字典均值相关系数”作为衡量一致性的基于分配关系的度量方法，并证明通过适当的架构选择可以实现较高的相关系数（对于基于LLM激活信号的TopK SAE，PW-MCC约为0.80）。我们的贡献包括：(i) 在理想化的TopK SAE场景中为强一致性提供了理论依据；(ii) 使用模型生物进行合成验证，证明了PW-MCC可以作为真实特征恢复的可靠代理指标；(iii) 对LLM激活信号进行的实证分析表明，PW-MCC与自动生成的自然语言特征解释的准确性之间存在相关性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EquivPruner: Boosting Efficiency and Quality in LLM-Based Search via Action Pruning
papers.title_zh: EquivPruner：通过动作剪枝提升基于大语言模型的搜索系统的效率和质量
papers.authors: Jiawei Liu, Qisi Chen, Jianshu Zhang, Quan Liu, Defu Lian
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at complex reasoning through search algorithms, yet current strategies often suffer from massive token consumption due to redundant exploration of semantically equivalent steps. Existing semantic similarity methods struggle to accurately identify such equivalence in domain-specific contexts like mathematical reasoning. To address this, we propose EquivPruner, a simple yet effective approach that identifies and prunes semantically equivalent actions during LLM reasoning search. We also introduce MathEquiv, the first dataset we created for mathematical statement equivalence, which enables the training of a lightweight equivalence detector. Extensive experiments across various models and tasks demonstrate that EquivPruner significantly reduces token consumption, improving searching efficiency and often bolstering reasoning accuracy. For instance, when applied to Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct on GSM8K, EquivPruner reduced token consumption by 48.1% while also improving accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lolo1222/EquivPruner.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在通过搜索算法进行复杂推理方面表现出色，但目前的策略往往由于对语义上等价步骤的冗余探索而导致大量令牌消耗。现有的语义相似性方法在识别数学推理等特定领域中的等价性时存在困难。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了EquivPruner这一简单而有效的方法，它能够在语言模型推理过程中识别并剪除语义上等价的行为。我们还引入了MathEquiv数据集，这是我们为数学语句等价性而创建的第一个数据集，它使得训练一个轻量级的等价检测器成为可能。通过在不同模型和任务上进行的大量实验表明，EquivPruner显著减少了令牌消耗，提高了搜索效率，并且通常提升了推理的准确性。例如，当应用于Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct模型并在GSM8K数据集上进行测试时，EquivPruner将令牌消耗减少了48.1%，同时提升了推理准确性。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Lolo1222/EquivPruner下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Data-Centric to Sample-Centric: Enhancing LLM Reasoning via Progressive Optimization
papers.title_zh: 从以数据为中心转向以样本为中心：通过渐进式优化提升大语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Xinjie Chen, Minpeng Liao, Guoxin Chen, Chengxi Li, Biao Fu, Kai Fan, Xinggao Liu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently advanced the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). We investigate RLVR from a sample-centric perspective and introduce LPPO (Learning-Progress and Prefix-guided Optimization), a framework of progressive optimization techniques. Our work addresses a critical question: how to best leverage a small set of trusted, high-quality demonstrations, rather than simply scaling up data volume. First, motivated by how hints aid human problem-solving, we propose prefix-guided sampling, an online data augmentation method that incorporates partial solution prefixes from expert demonstrations to guide the policy, particularly for challenging instances. Second, inspired by how humans focus on important questions aligned with their current capabilities, we introduce learning-progress weighting, a dynamic strategy that adjusts each training sample’s influence based on model progression. We estimate sample-level learning progress via an exponential moving average of per-sample pass rates, promoting samples that foster learning and de-emphasizing stagnant ones. Experiments on mathematical-reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our methods outperform strong baselines, yielding faster convergence and a higher performance ceiling, with these gains proving robust across diverse model architectures, scales, and reinforcement learning optimizers.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）最近在提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力方面取得了显著进展。我们从样本中心的角度对RLVR进行了研究，并提出了LPPO框架——一种渐进式优化技术。我们的工作解决了一个关键问题：如何充分利用少量且高质量的可靠示例，而不是单纯增加数据量。首先，受提示对人类问题解决帮助的启发，我们提出了前缀引导采样方法，这是一种在线数据增强技术，它利用专家示范中的部分解决方案前缀来指导策略的执行，尤其是在处理复杂任务时。其次，借鉴人类会根据自身当前的能力来关注重要问题的做法，我们引入了学习进度加权策略，这是一种动态策略，能够根据模型的进步程度调整每个训练样本的影响力。我们通过计算每个样本通过率的指数移动平均值来估计样本级别的学习进度，从而促进那些有助于学习的样本的发展，同时减少那些停滞不前的样本的影响。在数学推理基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法优于强大的基线算法，能够实现更快的收敛速度和更高的性能水平。这些优势在不同模型架构、规模以及强化学习优化器上都得到了验证。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CARES: Context-Aware Resolution Selector for VLMs
papers.title_zh: CARES：用于视觉里程计的上下文感知分辨率选择器
papers.authors: Moshe Kimhi, Nimrod Shabtay, Raja Giryes, Chaim Baskin, Eli Schwartz
papers.abstract: Large vision–language models (VLMs) commonly process images at native or high resolution to remain effective across tasks. This inflates visual tokens to 97-99% of total tokens, resulting in high compute and latency, even when low-resolution images would suffice. We introduce CARES—a Context-Aware Resolution Selector, a lightweight preprocessing module that, given an image–query pair, predicts the minimal sufficient input resolution. CARES uses a compact VLM (350M) to extract features and predict when a target pretrained VLM’s response converges to its peak ability to answer correctly. Though trained as a discrete classifier over a set of optional resolutions, CARES interpolates continuous resolutions at inference for fine-grained control. Across five multimodal benchmarks spanning documents and natural images, as well as diverse target VLMs, CARES preserves task performance while reducing compute by up to 80%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型通常以原生或高分辨率处理图像，以确保其在各种任务中的有效性。这导致视觉标记占总标记的比例达到97-99%，从而增加了计算量和延迟。不过，即使使用低分辨率图像也能满足需求。我们提出了CARES——一种上下文感知的分辨率选择器，它是一个轻量级的预处理模块。该模块能够根据给定的图像-查询对，预测出最小足够的输入分辨率。CARES利用一个紧凑型视觉-语言模型（350百万参数）来提取特征，并判断目标预训练视觉-语言模型的响应何时达到最佳回答准确率。虽然CARES被训练为在一系列可选分辨率上执行离散分类任务，但在推理过程中，它能够对连续分辨率进行插值处理，从而实现更精细的控制。在涵盖文档、自然图像以及多种目标视觉-语言模型的五个多模态基准测试中，CARES能够在保持任务性能的同时，将计算量减少多达80%。

papers.title: ChatR1: Reinforcement Learning for Conversational Reasoning and Retrieval Augmented Question Answering
papers.title_zh: ChatR1：用于对话推理的强化学习技术，以及增强式问答系统
papers.authors: Simon Lupart, Mohammad Aliannejadi, Evangelos Kanoulas
papers.abstract: We present ChatR1, a reasoning framework based on reinforcement learning (RL) for conversational question answering (CQA). Reasoning plays an important role in CQA, where user intent evolves across dialogue turns, and utterances are often underspecified, requiring contextual interpretation, query reformulation, and dynamic coordination between retrieval and generation. Unlike static ‘rewrite, retrieve, and generate’ pipelines, ChatR1 interleaves search and reasoning across turns, enabling exploratory and adaptive behaviors learned through RL. To address the challenge of sparse and delayed rewards in RL, we propose an intent-aware reward that provides turn-level feedback by aligning retrieval and reasoning with evolving user goals. ChatR1 demonstrates strong performance on both 3B and 7B model backbones, outperforming competitive models on five CQA datasets, measured by different metrics (F1, BERTScore, and LLM-as-judge). We include a diverse set of CQA datasets to cover topic shifts, evolving intents, mixed-initiative dialogues, and multi-document grounding, testing ChatR1’s performance from various aspects. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of the intent-aware reward. Our analyses further reveal diverse reasoning trajectories and effective use of the search tool. ChatR1 also generalizes robustly across domains, demonstrating that RL-based reasoning enables more flexible and context-aware behavior than static CQA pipelines.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了ChatR1，这是一个基于强化学习的推理框架，用于对话式问答任务。在对话式问答中，推理起着至关重要的作用——用户的意图会在对话过程中不断演变，而用户的话语往往不够明确，因此需要上下文的解析、问题的重新表述，以及检索与生成之间的动态协调。与传统的“搜索→检索→生成”流程不同，ChatR1将搜索与推理过程交织在一起，使得系统能够展现出通过强化学习获得的探索性和适应性行为。为了解决强化学习中奖励稀疏且延迟的问题，我们提出了一种基于意图的奖励机制，该机制通过使检索与推理与用户不断变化的目标保持一致，从而提供逐轮反馈。ChatR1在3B和7B模型框架下都表现出强大的性能，在五个对话式问答数据集上的表现优于同类模型，这些成绩是通过不同的指标（如F1分数、BERTScore以及LLM作为评判标准）来衡量的。我们包含了多种对话式问答数据集，涵盖了话题变化、意图演变、混合发起的对话以及多文档推理等场景，从多个角度测试了ChatR1的性能。消融研究证实了这种基于意图的奖励机制的有效性。我们的分析还揭示了多样化的推理路径以及搜索工具的有效使用方式。此外，ChatR1在不同领域中也表现出强大的泛化能力，这表明基于强化学习的推理方式能够实现比传统对话式问答流程更为灵活且注重上下文的行为。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Think in Sentences: Explicit Sentence Boundaries Enhance Language Model’s Capabilities
papers.title_zh: 用句子思考：明确的句子边界能提升语言模型的能力
papers.authors: Zhichen Liu, Yongyuan Li, Yang Xu
papers.abstract: Researchers have explored ways to improve large language models (LLMs)’ capabilities via dummy token insertion in contexts. However, existing works focus solely on the dummy tokens themselves, but failed to leverage the inherent sentence-level structure of natural language. This is a critical oversight, as LLMs acquire linguistic capabilities through exposure to human-generated texts, which are inherently structured at the sentence level. Motivated by the gap, we proposed a method that inserts delimiters at sentence boundaries. Our method not only integrates dummy tokens into contexts, but also enables LLMs with sentence-by-sentence processing behavior during reasoning. Two approaches are proposed: (1). In-context learning and (2). Supervised fine-tuning are experimented from 7B LLMs to 600B Deepseek-V3. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements in various tasks, with notable gains of up to 7.7% on GSM8k and 12.5% on DROP. Furthermore, LLMs fine-tuned via our strategy further incorporate sentence awareness into their inner representations. Our work establishes a simple yet effective technique for enhancing LLM’s capabilities, offering promising directions for cognitive-inspired LLM enhancement paradigm.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究人员探索了通过在上下文中添加虚拟标记来提升大语言模型能力的途径。然而，现有的研究仅关注于虚拟标记本身，而未能充分利用自然语言固有的句子级结构。这是一个重要的疏忽，因为大语言模型是通过接触人类生成的文本来获得语言能力的，而这些文本本质上是以句子为单位进行结构的。鉴于这一不足，我们提出了一种在句子边界处插入分隔符的方法。我们的方法不仅将虚拟标记融入上下文，还使大语言模型能够在推理过程中以句子为单位进行处理。我们提出了两种方法：(1) 上下文内学习；(2) 监督式微调。实验结果显示，这两种方法在不同任务上都能带来显著的改进，例如在GSM8k任务上的提升幅度达到了7.7%，在DROP任务上的提升幅度达到了12.5%。此外，通过我们的策略进行微调的大语言模型还能进一步将其对句子的感知能力融入到其内部表示中。我们的工作提供了一种简单而有效的技术，用于提升大语言模型的能力，为基于认知的LLM增强范式提供了有希望的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MORPHOGEN: A Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Gender-Aware Morphological Generation
papers.title_zh: 形态生成器：一种用于评估性别感知形态生成的多语言基准工具
papers.authors: Mehul Agarwal, Aditya Aggarwal, Arnav Goel, Medha Hira, Anubha Gupta
papers.abstract: While multilingual large language models (LLMs) perform well on high-level tasks like translation and question answering, their ability to handle grammatical gender and morphological agreement remains underexplored. In morphologically rich languages, gender influences verb conjugation, pronouns, and even first-person constructions with explicit and implicit mentions of gender. We introduce MORPHOGEN, a morphologically grounded large-scale benchmark dataset for evaluating gender-aware generation in three typologically diverse grammatically gendered languages: French, Arabic, and Hindi. The core task, GENFORM, requires models to rewrite a first-person sentence in the opposite gender while preserving its meaning and structure. We construct a high-quality synthetic dataset spanning these three languages and benchmark 15 popular multilingual LLMs (2B–70B) on their ability to perform this transformation. Our results reveal significant gaps and interesting insights into how current models handle morphological gender. MORPHOGEN provides a focused diagnostic lens for gender-aware language modeling and lays the groundwork for future research on inclusive and morphology-sensitive NLP.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然多语言大语言模型在翻译和问答等高级任务上表现良好，但它们在处理语法上的性别和形态一致性方面的能力仍未被充分探索。在形态丰富的语言中，性别会影响动词的变形、代词的使用，甚至第一人称的表达方式，这些都会涉及到对性别的明示或暗示。我们提出了MORPHOGEN这一基于形态的大型基准数据集，用于评估三种类型学差异较大且存在性别区分的语言——法语、阿拉伯语和印地语中的性别意识生成能力。核心任务GENFORM要求模型能够以相反性别的形式重写第一人称句子，同时保留其含义和结构。我们构建了一个涵盖这三种语言的高质量合成数据集，并对15种流行的多语言大语言模型（容量从20亿到700亿参数）进行了性能测试。我们的研究结果揭示了当前模型在处理形态学上的性别问题时的显著不足，同时也提供了一些有趣的见解。MORPHOGEN为性别意识的语言建模提供了一个有针对性的诊断工具，为未来关于包容性和形态敏感的自然语言处理研究奠定了基础。

papers.title: TeRA: Vector-based Random Tensor Network for High-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: TeRA：基于向量的随机张量网络，适用于大型语言模型的高阶适配问题
papers.authors: Yuxuan Gu, Wuyang Zhou, Giorgos Iacovides, Danilo Mandic
papers.abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods, such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), have significantly reduced the number of trainable parameters needed in fine-tuning large language models (LLMs). The developments of LoRA-style adapters have considered two main directions: (1) enhancing model expressivity with high-rank adapters, and (2) aiming for further parameter reduction, as exemplified by vector-based methods. However, these approaches come with a trade-off, as achieving the expressivity of high-rank weight updates typically comes at the cost of sacrificing the extreme parameter efficiency offered by vector-based techniques. To address this issue, we propose a vector-based random Tensor network for high-Rank Adaptation (TeRA), a novel PEFT method that achieves high-rank weight updates while retaining the parameter efficiency of vector-based PEFT adapters. This is achieved by parametrizing the tensorized weight update matrix as a Tucker-like tensor network (TN), whereby large randomly initialized factors are frozen and shared across layers, while only small layer-specific scaling vectors, corresponding to diagonal entries of factor matrices, are trained. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that TeRA matches or even outperforms existing high-rank adapters, while requiring as few trainable parameters as vector-based methods. Theoretical analysis and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed TeRA method. The code is available at https://github.com/guyuxuan9/TeRA.
papers.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法，如低秩适应（LoRA），显著减少了对大语言模型进行微调时所需的可训练参数的数量。LoRA风格的适配器的发展主要朝着两个方向进行：一是通过高秩适配器提升模型的表达能力；二是进一步降低参数数量，例如基于向量的方法。然而，这些方法存在权衡问题，因为实现高秩权重更新的表达能力通常是以牺牲基于向量技术的极高参数效率为代价的。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于向量的随机张量网络用于高秩适应（TeRA），这是一种新的PEFT方法，能够在保持基于向量的PEFT适配器参数效率的同时实现高秩权重更新。这是通过将权重更新矩阵参数化为类似Tucker张量网络来实现的，其中大量随机初始化的因子被冻结并跨层共享，而只有与因子矩阵的对角线元素相对应的少量层特定缩放向量被训练出来。全面的实验表明，TeRA在性能上甚至优于现有的高秩适配器，同时所需的可训练参数数量与基于向量的方法相当。理论分析和消融研究验证了所提出的TeRA方法的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/guyuxuan9/TeRA获取。

papers.title: GenDis: Generative-Discriminative Dual-View Co-Training for Generalized Category Discovery
papers.title_zh: GenDis：生成式与判别式双视图协同训练方法，用于广义类别发现
papers.authors: Xi Chen, Chuan Qin, Jinpeng Li, Shasha Hu, Chao Wang, Hengshu Zhu, Hui Xiong
papers.abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to identify both known and novel categories from partially labeled data, reflecting more realistic open-world learning scenarios. However, most existing methods rely solely on one-hot discriminative supervision, leading to overfitting on seen classes and poor generalization to unseen ones. Recent advances introduce large language models (LLMs) to incorporate external semantics, yet they often suffer from semantic–label misalignment and weak semantic integration during training. We propose GenDis, a Generative–Discriminative Dual-View Co-Training framework that unifies discriminative classification and semantic label generation within an LLM. Discriminative pseudo-labels guide the formation of a separable generative latent space, enabling semantically meaningful supervision for novel classes. To ensure consistency between the two views, we employ Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA)-based alignment and a curriculum-guided, dispersion-aware pseudo-labeling strategy for iterative refinement. Extensive experiments on five GCD benchmarks demonstrate that GenDis substantially outperforms prior methods, validating the effectiveness of dual-view co-training with semantically enriched supervision. The anonymized repository is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GenDis.
papers.abstract_zh: 广义类别发现（GCD）旨在从部分标注的数据中识别已知和新的类别，从而反映更现实的开源学习场景。然而，大多数现有方法仅依赖独热判别式监督机制，这会导致对已见过类别的过度拟合，以及对未见类别的泛化能力较差。最近的研究引入了大语言模型（LLM），以结合外部语义信息，但这些模型往往存在语义标签不一致的问题，且在训练过程中语义整合效果较弱。我们提出了GenDis这一生成式-判别式双视图协同训练框架，该框架在LLM内部实现了判别性分类与语义标签生成的统一。判别性伪标签有助于形成可分离的生成潜在空间，从而为新类别提供具有语义意义的监督。为了确保两种视图之间的一致性，我们采用了基于典型相关分析（CCA）的对齐方法，以及一种基于课程驱动的、注重分散度的伪标签策略来进行迭代优化。在五个GCD基准测试上的广泛实验表明，GenDis在性能上显著优于以往的方法，这验证了双视图协同训练结合语义丰富监督的有效性。该框架的匿名存储库可在以下链接获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GenDis。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CodeHacker: Automated Test Case Generation for Detecting Vulnerabilities in Competitive Programming Solutions
papers.title_zh: CodeHacker：用于检测竞赛编程解决方案中漏洞的自动化测试用例生成工具
papers.authors: Jingwei Shi, Xinxiang Yin, Jing Huang, Shengyu Tao, Jinman Zhao
papers.abstract: The evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation relies heavily on the quality and robustness of test cases. However, existing benchmarks often lack coverage for subtle corner cases, allowing incorrect solutions to pass. To bridge this gap, we propose CodeHacker, an automated agent framework dedicated to generating targeted adversarial test cases that expose latent vulnerabilities in program submissions. Mimicking the hack mechanism in competitive programming, CodeHacker employs a multi-strategy approach—including stress testing, anti-hash attacks, and logic-specific targeting to break specific code submissions. To ensure the validity and reliability of these attacks, we introduce a Calibration Phase, where the agent iteratively refines its own Validator and Checker via self-generated adversarial probes before evaluating contestant code. Experiments demonstrate that CodeHacker significantly improves the True Negative Rate (TNR) of existing datasets, effectively filtering out incorrect solutions that were previously accepted. Furthermore, generated adversarial cases prove to be superior training data, boosting the performance of RL-trained models on benchmarks like LiveCodeBench. All code, datasets, and evaluation scripts will be open-sourced to promote further investigation in LLMs for competitive programming.
papers.abstract_zh: 对大语言模型在代码生成方面的评估，很大程度上取决于测试案例的质量和鲁棒性。然而，现有的基准测试往往缺乏对细微情况的覆盖，导致错误的解决方案能够通过评估。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了CodeHacker——一个自动化代理框架，专门用于生成有针对性的对抗性测试用例，以揭示程序提交中的潜在漏洞。CodeHacker模仿了竞技编程中的破解机制，采用多种策略来进行攻击，包括压力测试、反哈希攻击以及针对特定逻辑目标的攻击，以破坏特定的代码提交。为了确保这些攻击的有效性和可靠性，我们引入了一个校准阶段，在该阶段中，代理会通过自生成的对抗性样本来迭代优化自己的验证器和检查器，然后再对参赛者的代码进行评估。实验表明，CodeHacker显著提高了现有数据集的真负率（TNR），有效过滤掉了之前被接受的错误解决方案。此外，生成的对抗性案例还被证明是优秀的训练数据，提升了基于强化学习训练的模型在如LiveCodeBench这样的基准测试中的性能。所有代码、数据集和评估脚本都将开源，以便进一步研究大语言模型在竞技编程中的应用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Identifying Bias in Machine-generated Text Detection
papers.title_zh: 识别机器生成文本中的偏见
papers.authors: Kevin Stowe, Svetlana Afanaseva, Rodolfo C. Raimundo, Yitao Sun, Kailash Patil
papers.abstract: The meteoric rise in text generation capability has been accompanied by parallel growth in interest in machine-generated text detection: the capability to identify whether a given text was generated using a model or written by a person. While detection models show strong performance, they have the capacity to cause significant negative impacts. We explore potential biases in English machine-generated text detection systems. We curate a dataset of student essays and assess 16 different detection systems for bias across four attributes: gender, race/ethnicity, English-language learner (ELL) status, and economic status. We evaluate these attributes using regression-based models to determine the significance and power of the effects, as well as performing subgroup analysis. We find that while biases are generally inconsistent across systems, there are several key issues: several models tend to classify disadvantaged groups as machine-generated, ELL essays are more likely to be classified as machine-generated, economically disadvantaged students’ essays are less likely to be classified as machine-generated, and non-White ELL essays are disproportionately classified as machine-generated relative to their White counterparts. Finally, we perform human annotation and find that while humans perform generally poorly at the detection task, they show no significant biases on the studied attributes.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本生成能力的迅速提升，也伴随着对机器生成文本检测需求的不断增长：即判断某段文本是模型生成的还是由人类撰写的。虽然检测模型表现优异，但它们也可能带来严重的负面影响。我们研究了英语机器生成文本检测系统中可能存在的偏见问题。我们收集了学生作文的数据集，并针对四个属性——性别、种族/民族、英语学习者状态以及经济状况——对16种不同的检测系统进行了偏见评估。我们通过基于回归的模型来评估这些属性的重要性及影响程度，同时进行了子组分析。研究发现，尽管不同系统的偏见表现并不一致，但存在几个关键问题：一些模型倾向于将弱势群体归类为机器生成文本；英语学习者撰写的作文更容易被归类为机器生成文本；经济条件较差的学生撰写的作文则不太可能被归类为机器生成文本；而非白人英语学习者的作文相比白人同类作品，更常被归类为机器生成文本。最后，我们进行了人工标注，发现虽然人类在文本检测任务上的表现普遍较差，但在所研究的属性方面并没有表现出显著的偏见。

papers.title: DE-CLIP: Few-Shot Anomaly Detection via Difference-Guided Embedding Editing
papers.title_zh: DE-CLIP：基于差异引导的嵌入编辑技术，用于少量样本异常检测
papers.authors: Yage Zhang, Yukun Jiang, Michael Backes, Yang Zhang
papers.abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) plays a critical role in applications such as automated industrial inspection and medical image analysis. Empowered by the strong pre-trained vision-language model, CLIP, recent years have witnessed the emergence of several CLIP-based few-shot AD methods.Due to the overlap between the embedding distributions of normal and anomalous samples, many existing approaches introduce additional model training for more discriminative text embeddings.However, we demonstrate that such training is not necessary.Specifically, we find that this embedding overlap can be separated by introducing a \underline{\text{Diff}}erence-guided vector for embedding \underline{\text{Edit}}ing (DiffEdit).Based on this finding, we propose DE-CLIP, a simple yet effective framework based on DiffEdit, which directly edits text embeddings based on the textual and visual differences between normal and anomalous samples, resulting in more discriminative embeddings for AD.Extensive experiments on industrial and medical datasets demonstrate the superiority of our proposed DE-CLIP compared with existing baselines.For instance, on MVTec dataset, DE-CLIP achieves 96.6% and 96.7% AUROC on anomaly classification and segmentation, surpassing both training-based and training-free methods.In addition, we observe that introducing DiffEdit into other training-free baselines could also significantly improve their performance, highlighting the potential of DiffEdit to promote better AD.
papers.abstract_zh: 异常检测在自动化工业检测、医学图像分析等应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。得益于强大的预训练视觉语言模型CLIP的助力，近年来出现了多种基于CLIP的少样本异常检测方法。由于正常样本和异常样本的嵌入分布存在重叠，许多现有方法需要额外的模型训练来生成更具区分性的文本嵌入。然而，我们证明这种训练并非必要。具体来说，我们发现可以通过引入一种差异引导向量来进行嵌入编辑，从而分离出这种嵌入重叠部分。基于这一发现，我们提出了DE-CLIP这一简单而有效的框架。该框架基于差异编辑技术，直接对正常样本与异常样本之间的文本和视觉差异进行编辑，从而生成更具区分性的嵌入，用于异常检测。在工业和医学数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的DE-CLIP相比现有的基线方法具有显著优势。例如，在MVTec数据集上，DE-CLIP在异常分类和分割任务上的AUROC分别达到了96.6%和96.7%，超越了所有基于训练和无需训练的方法。此外，我们还观察到，将差异编辑技术引入其他无需训练的基线方法中，也能显著提高它们的性能，这凸显了差异编辑技术在提升异常检测效果方面的巨大潜力。

papers.title: Culinary Crossroads: A RAG Framework for Enhancing Diversity in Cross-Cultural Recipe Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 烹饪的十字路口：一种促进跨文化食谱改编多样性的框架
papers.authors: Tianyi Hu, Andrea Morales-Garzón, Jingyi Zheng, Maria Maistro, Daniel Hershcovich
papers.abstract: In cross-cultural recipe adaptation, the goal is not only to ensure cultural appropriateness and retain the original dish’s essence, but also to provide diverse options for various dietary needs and preferences. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a promising approach, combining the retrieval of real recipes from the target cuisine for cultural adaptability with large language models (LLMs) for relevance. However, it remains unclear whether RAG can generate diverse adaptation results. Our analysis shows that RAG tends to overly rely on a limited portion of the context across generations, failing to produce diverse outputs even when provided with varied contextual inputs. This reveals a key limitation of RAG in creative tasks with multiple valid answers: it fails to leverage contextual diversity for generating varied responses. To address this issue, we propose CARRIAGE, A plug-and-play RAG framework for cross-cultural recipe adaptation that enhances diversity in both retrieval and context organization. To our knowledge, this is the first RAG framework that explicitly aims to generate highly diverse outputs to accommodate multiple user preferences. Our experiments show that CARRIAGE achieves Pareto efficiency in terms of diversity and quality of recipe adaptation compared to closed-book LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在跨文化食谱改编中，目标不仅是确保文化的适应性并保留原食谱的精髓，还要为不同的饮食需求和偏好提供多样化的选择。检索增强生成（RAG）是一种有前景的方法，它结合了从目标菜系中检索真实食谱以实现文化适应性，以及利用大语言模型来确保相关性。然而，目前尚不清楚RAG是否能够产生多样化的改编结果。我们的分析表明，RAG往往过度依赖有限的上下文信息，即使提供了多样化的上下文输入，也无法产生多样化的输出。这揭示了RAG在具有多个有效答案的创造性任务中的关键局限性：它无法利用上下文的多样性来生成多样化的响应。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CARRIAGE这一即插即用型RAG框架，该框架能够提升检索和上下文组织方面的多样性。据我们所知，这是第一个明确旨在生成高度多样化输出以满足多种用户偏好的RAG框架。我们的实验表明，与闭源语言模型相比，CARRIAGE在食谱改编的多样性和质量方面实现了帕累托效率。
