papers.title: Mixture-of-Minds: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Table Understanding
papers.title_zh: 多智能体混合：用于表格理解的强化学习算法
papers.authors: Yuhang Zhou, Mingrui Zhang, Ke Li, Mingyi Wang, Qiao Liu, Qifei Wang, Jiayi Liu, Fei Liu, Serena Li, Weiwei LI, Mingze Gao, Abhishek Kumar, Xiangjun Fan, Zhuokai Zhao, Lizhu Zhang
papers.abstract: Understanding and reasoning over tables is a critical capability for many real-world applications. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise on this task, but current approaches remain limited. Fine-tuning based methods strengthen language reasoning; yet they are prone to arithmetic errors and hallucination. In contrast, tool-based methods enable precise table manipulation but rely on rigid schemas and lack semantic understanding. These complementary drawbacks highlight the need for approaches that integrate robust reasoning with reliable table processing. In this work, we propose MIXTURE-OF-MINDS, a multi-agent framework that decomposes table reasoning into three specialized roles: planning, coding, and answering. This design enables each agent to focus on a specific aspect of the task while leveraging code execution for precise table manipulation. Building on this workflow, we introduce a self-improvement training framework that employs Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) rollouts to generate pseudo-gold trajectories and optimize agents with reinforcement learning (RL). Extensive experiments show that MIXTURE-OF-MINDS delivers substantial gains, reaching 62.13% on TableBench and surpassing GPT-o3-mini. These results demonstrate the promise of combining structured multi-agent workflows with RL to advance table understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解和推理表格是许多现实应用场景中的关键能力。大语言模型在这项任务上表现出一定的潜力，但当前的方法仍然存在局限性。基于微调的方法能够增强语言推理能力，但它们容易出现算术错误和幻觉现象。相比之下，基于工具的方法能够实现精确的表格操作，但依赖于固定的模式，且缺乏语义理解能力。这些互补的缺点凸显了需要一种能够将强大的推理能力与可靠的表格处理相结合的方法。在这项研究中，我们提出了MIXTURE-OF-MINDS这一多智能体框架，它将表格推理分解为三个专门的角色：规划、编码和回答。这种设计使得每个智能体可以专注于任务的特定方面，同时通过代码执行来实现精确的表格操作。在此基础上，我们引入了一个自我改进训练框架，该框架采用蒙特卡洛树搜索算法来生成伪金路径，并通过强化学习来优化智能体性能。大量实验表明，MIXTURE-OF-MINDS取得了显著的成效，在TableBench测试上的准确率达到了62.13%，超过了GPT-o3-mini。这些结果证明了将结构化多智能体工作流程与强化学习相结合，对于提升表格理解能力具有巨大的潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MMCLIP: Cross-Modal Attention Masked Modelling for Medical Language-Image Pre-Training
papers.title_zh: MMCLIP：跨模态注意力掩码建模技术，用于医学语言与图像数据的预训练
papers.authors: Biao Wu, Yutong Xie, Zeyu Zhang, Vu Minh Hieu Phan, Qi Chen, Ling Chen, Qi Wu
papers.abstract: Vision-and-language pretraining (VLP) in medicine leverages contrastive learning on image–text pairs, often enhanced with masked modeling. However, existing methods face two challenges: difficulty reconstructing key pathological features due to limited data, and reliance on either paired or image-only datasets without combining both. To address this, we propose MMCLIP (Masked Medical Contrastive Language–Image Pre-training), which introduces two modules: AttMIM: Masks image features highly correlated with text to improve reconstruction of fine medical details. EntMLM: Masks key medical entities in text and reconstructs them using visual cues. Furthermore, MMCLIP incorporates unpaired data through disease-kind prompts, achieving state-of-the-art performance in zero-shot and fine-tuning across five benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 在医学领域，视觉与语言预训练方法通过图像-文本对进行对比学习，并常采用掩蔽建模技术来提升效果。然而，现有方法面临两个挑战：由于数据有限，难以重建关键的病理特征；同时，要么依赖配对数据集，要么仅使用图像数据集，未能有效结合两者优势。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了MMCLIP（掩蔽医学对比语言-图像预训练）方法。该方法包含两个模块：AttMIM，用于掩蔽与文本高度相关的图像特征，从而改善对精细医学细节的重建能力；EntMLM，用于掩蔽文本中的关键医学实体，并利用视觉线索对其进行重建。此外，MMCLIP还引入了基于疾病类型的非配对数据，从而在零样本训练和微调方面取得了领先的性能表现，并在五个基准测试中均表现出色。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MMSearch-R1: Incentivizing LMMs to Search
papers.title_zh: MMSearch-R1：激励逻辑模型进行搜索工作
papers.authors: Jinming Wu, Zihao Deng, Wei Li, Yiding Liu, Bo You, Bo Li, Zejun MA, Ziwei Liu
papers.abstract: Robust deployment of large multimodal models (LMMs) in real-world scenarios requires access to external knowledge sources, given the complexity and dynamic nature of real-world information. Existing approaches such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and prompt engineered search agents rely on rigid pipelines, often leading to inefficient or excessive search behaviors. We present MMSearch-R1, the first end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that enables LMMs to perform on-demand, multi-turn search in real-world Internet environments. Our framework integrates both image and text search tools, allowing the model to reason about when and how to invoke them guided by an outcome-based reward with a search penalty. To support training, We collect a multimodal search VQA dataset through a semi-automated pipeline that covers diverse visual and textual knowledge needs and curate a search-balanced subset with both search-required and search-free samples, which proves essential for shaping efficient and on-demand search behavior. Extensive experiments on knowledge-intensive and info-seeking VQA tasks show that our model not only outperforms traditional RAG-based baselines of the same model size, but also matches the performance of a larger RAG-based model while reducing search calls by over 30%. We further analyze key empirical findings to offer actionable insights for advancing research in multimodal search.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界场景中部署大型多模态模型（LMMs）需要获取外部知识资源，因为现实世界的信息具有复杂性和动态性。现有的方法如检索增强生成（RAG）和提示工程化搜索代理，都依赖于固定的流程，这往往会导致搜索效率低下或过度搜索的行为。我们提出了MMSearch-R1，这是第一个端到端强化学习框架，使得LMMs能够在现实世界的互联网环境中进行按需、多轮次的搜索。我们的框架整合了图像搜索和文本搜索工具，使模型能够根据基于结果的奖励来决定何时以及如何使用这些工具，同时还有搜索惩罚机制来约束其行为。为了支持训练，我们通过半自动化的流程收集了一个多模态搜索VQA数据集，该数据集涵盖了多样化的视觉和文本知识需求。我们还整理出了一个平衡了搜索需求的子集，其中包含需要搜索的样本和不需要搜索的样本，这对于塑造高效且按需的搜索行为非常重要。在涉及大量知识和信息检索的VQA任务上进行的广泛实验表明，我们的模型不仅性能优于相同规模的传统RAG基模型，而且其性能与更大的RAG基模型相当，同时减少了超过30%的搜索调用次数。我们还分析了关键的实证结果，为推进多模态搜索领域的研究提供了有价值的见解。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Toward Secure Tuning: Mitigating Security Risks from Instruction Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 迈向安全调优：减轻指令微调带来的安全风险
papers.authors: Yanrui Du, Fenglei Fan, Sendong Zhao, Jiawei Cao, Ming Ma, Danyang Zhao, Shuren Qi, Ting Liu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Instruction Fine-Tuning (IFT) has emerged as a critical technique for customizing Large Language Models (LLMs) to meet diverse downstream applications. However, recent studies have revealed that IFT can compromise the built-in security mechanisms of LLMs, thereby posing significant security risks. Although defense methods targeting various training stages have been proposed, they either face challenges in practical deployment or exhibit instability and limited performance gains. In our study, we propose a novel SWAT method that introduces a key idea: shifting more of the learning burden onto security-robust parameters. To this end, our study investigates how module-level parameters affect LLMs’ internal security feature space, aiming to uncover robustness patterns in parameters. Guided by this analysis, we identify a robust module set (Mods_Rob) that exhibits minimal effects on LLMs’ security feature space. Leveraging this insight, SWAT proceeds in two phases: (1) a warm-up phase that preferentially trains Mods_Rob to learn low-level features with minimal security risk, followed by (2) standard tuning to achieve optimal task performance. Across diverse knowledge-intensive datasets, scenarios, and LLMs, SWAT substantially reduces security risks without sacrificing task performance gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 指令微调（IFT）已成为定制大语言模型以满足各种下游应用需求的关键技术。然而，最近的研究表明，IFT可能会破坏大语言模型的内置安全机制，从而带来显著的安全风险。尽管已经提出了针对不同训练阶段的防御方法，但这些方法在实际部署时面临挑战，或者表现出不稳定性和有限的性能提升效果。在我们的研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的SWAT方法，该方法的核心思想是将更多的学习负担转移到具有强安全性的参数上。为此，我们的研究探讨了模块级参数如何影响大语言模型的内部安全特征空间，以揭示参数中的鲁棒性模式。基于这一分析，我们确定了一个鲁棒模块集（Mods_Rob），该模块集对大语言模型的安全特征空间影响最小。利用这一洞察，SWAT分为两个阶段进行：第一阶段是预热阶段，该阶段优先训练Mods_Rob以学习低级别的特征，同时尽可能降低安全风险；第二阶段则是标准微调阶段，以实现最佳任务性能。在多种知识密集型数据集、场景和大语言模型中，SWAT显著降低了安全风险，同时并未牺牲任务性能的提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SDE-SQL: Enhancing Text-to-SQL Generation in Large Language Models via Self-Driven Exploration with SQL Probes
papers.title_zh: SDE-SQL：通过SQL探针实现的自主探索技术，提升大型语言模型中文本转SQL生成能力的优化
papers.authors: Wenxuan Xie, Yaxun Dai, Wenhao Jiang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led to substantial progress on the Text-to-SQL task. However, existing approaches typically depend on static, pre-processed database information supplied at inference time, which restricts the model’s capacity to deeply comprehend the underlying database content. In the absence of dynamic interaction, LLMs are limited to fixed, human-curated context and lack the ability to autonomously query or explore the data. To overcome this limitation, we introduce \textbf{SDE-SQL}, a novel framework that empowers LLMs to perform \textbf{Self-Driven Exploration} of databases during inference. This is achieved through the generation and execution of \textbf{SQL probes}, enabling the model to actively retrieve information and iteratively refine its understanding of the database. Unlike prior methods, \textbf{SDE-SQL} operates in a \textbf{zero-shot} setting, requiring no in-context demonstrations or question-SQL pairs. Evaluated on the BIRD benchmark with Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, \textbf{SDE-SQL} achieves an \textbf{8.02} % relative improvement in execution accuracy over the vanilla Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct baseline, establishing a new state-of-the-art among open-source methods without supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or model ensembling. Furthermore, when combined with SFT, \textbf{SDE-SQL} delivers an additional \textbf{0.52} % performance gain.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展在文本转SQL任务上取得了显著突破。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于在推理时提供的静态、预处理的数据库信息，这限制了模型深入理解底层数据库内容的能力。由于缺乏动态交互，大语言模型只能依赖固定的人工策划的上下文，无法自主查询或探索数据。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了**SDE-SQL**框架，该框架使大语言模型能够在推理过程中进行**自主探索**。这是通过生成和执行**SQL查询语句**来实现的，从而使模型能够主动检索信息并逐步完善对数据库的理解。与以往的方法不同，**SDE-SQL**采用**零样本训练**方式，无需上下文演示或问题-SQL对。在BIRD基准测试中使用Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct进行评估时，**SDE-SQL**在执行准确率方面比传统的Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct基线提升了**8.02%**，这在没有监督微调或模型集成的情况下，开创了开源方法的全新纪录。此外，当与监督微调结合使用时，**SDE-SQL**还能进一步提升**0.52%**的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Splits! Flexible Sociocultural Linguistic Investigation at Scale
papers.title_zh: 分割！大规模灵活的社会文化语言研究
papers.authors: Eylon Caplan, Tania Chakraborty, Dan Goldwasser
papers.abstract: Variation in language use, shaped by speakers’ sociocultural background and specific context of use, offers a rich lens into cultural perspectives, values, and opinions. For example, Chinese students discuss healthy eating with words like timing, regularity, and digestion, whereas Americans use vocabulary like balancing food groups and avoiding fat and sugar, reflecting distinct cultural models of nutrition (Banna et al., 2016). The computational study of these Sociocultural Linguistic Phenomena (SLP) has traditionally been done in NLP via tailored analyses of specific groups or topics, requiring specialized data collection and experimental operationalization—a process not well-suited to quick hypothesis exploration and prototyping. To address this, we propose constructing a “sandbox” designed for systematic and flexible sociolinguistic research. Using our method, we construct a demographically/topically split Reddit dataset, Splits!, validated by self-identification and by replicating several known SLPs from existing literature. We showcase the sandbox’s utility with a scalable, two-stage process that filters large collections of potential SLPs (PSLPs) to surface the most promising candidates for deeper, qualitative investigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言使用的差异受到说话者的社会文化背景和具体使用情境的影响，这为了解文化视角、价值观和观点提供了丰富的线索。例如，中国学生在讨论健康饮食时会使用“时机”、“规律性”和“消化”等词汇，而美国人则使用“平衡食物种类”以及“避免脂肪和糖分”等词汇，这反映了不同的营养观念（Banna等人，2016年）。对这类社会文化语言现象的计算研究传统上是通过自然语言处理技术来进行的，需要针对特定群体或主题进行专门的分析，这需要专门的数据收集和实验操作——这一过程并不适合快速提出假设和进行原型设计。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种用于系统化和灵活开展社会语言研究的“沙盒”方法。利用我们的方法，我们构建了一个按人口统计和主题划分的Reddit数据集Splits！该数据集通过自我识别以及复制现有文献中的多个已知社会文化语言现象来验证其有效性。我们通过一个可扩展的两阶段流程展示了这个沙盒的实用性，该流程能够过滤大量潜在的社会文化语言现象，从而筛选出最值得进一步深入研究的候选现象。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Thinking beyond the anthropomorphic paradigm benefits LLM research
papers.title_zh: 超越人类形象的范式思考有助于大型语言模型的研究发展
papers.authors: Lujain Ibrahim, Myra Cheng
papers.abstract: Anthropomorphism, or the attribution of human traits to technology, is an automatic and unconscious response that occurs even in those with advanced technical expertise. In this position paper, we analyze hundreds of thousands of research articles to present empirical evidence of the prevalence and growth of anthropomorphic terminology in research on large language models (LLMs). We argue for challenging the deeper assumptions reflected in this terminology — which, though often useful, may inadvertently constrain LLM development — and broadening beyond them to open new pathways for understanding and improving LLMs. Specifically, we identify and examine five anthropomorphic assumptions that shape research across the LLM development lifecycle. For each assumption (e.g., that LLMs must use natural language for reasoning, or that they should be evaluated on benchmarks originally meant for humans), we demonstrate empirical, non-anthropomorphic alternatives that remain under-explored yet offer promising directions for LLM research and development.
papers.abstract_zh: 拟人化，即把人类的特征赋予技术，是一种自动且无意识的反应，即使是在拥有高级技术专长的人身上也会发生这种情况。在这篇论文中，我们分析了数十万篇研究文章，以实证证据展示拟人化术语在大语言模型研究中的普遍性和增长趋势。我们认为有必要挑战这种术语所反映的深层假设——尽管这些假设通常很有用，但可能会无意中限制语言模型的开发。我们应该超越这些假设，开辟新的途径来理解和改进语言模型。具体来说，我们识别出五个影响语言模型开发周期的研究中的拟人化假设。对于每一个假设（例如，语言模型必须使用自然语言进行推理，或者它们应该根据原本用于人类的基准进行测试），我们都提出了一些非拟人化的替代方案，这些方案尚未得到充分探索，但为语言模型的研发提供了有希望的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Coordinating Search-Informed Reasoning and Reasoning-Guided Search in Claim Verification
papers.title_zh: 在索赔验证过程中协调基于搜索的推理与由推理引导的搜索行为
papers.authors: Qisheng Hu, Quanyu Long, Wenya Wang
papers.abstract: Multi-hop claim verification is inherently challenging, requiring multi-step reasoning to construct verification chains while iteratively searching for information to uncover hidden bridging facts. This process is fundamentally interleaved, as effective reasoning relies on dynamically retrieved evidence, while effective search demands reasoning to refine queries based on partial information. To achieve this, we propose Hierarchical Agent Reasoning and Information Search (HARIS), explicitly modeling the coordinated process of reasoning-driven searching and search-informed reasoning. HARIS consists of a high-level reasoning agent that focuses on constructing the main verification chain, generating factual questions when more information is needed, and a low-level search agent that iteratively retrieves more information, refining its search based on intermediate findings. This design allows each agent to specialize in its respective task, enhancing verification accuracy and interpretability. HARIS is trained using reinforcement learning with outcome-based rewards. Experimental results on the EX-FEVER and HOVER benchmarks demonstrate that HARIS achieves strong performance, greatly advancing multi-hop claim verification.
papers.abstract_zh: 多跳索赔验证本质上具有挑战性，需要多步推理来构建验证链，同时不断搜索信息以揭示隐藏的桥梁事实。这一过程是交织在一起的，因为有效的推理依赖于动态检索到的证据，而有效的搜索则需要根据部分信息来优化查询。为了实现这一点，我们提出了分层代理推理与信息搜索算法（HARIS），该算法明确模拟了由推理驱动搜索和基于搜索的推理之间的协调过程。HARIS由一个高级推理代理组成，该代理负责构建主要的验证链，在需要更多信息时生成事实性问题；还有一个低级搜索代理，它不断检索更多信息，并根据中间发现结果来优化搜索策略。这种设计使得每个代理能够专注于自己的任务，从而提高验证的准确性和可解释性。HARIS通过基于结果的强化学习进行训练。在EX-FEVER和HOVER基准测试中的实验结果表明，HARIS表现非常出色，显著提升了多跳索赔验证的能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Breaking the Generator Barrier: Disentangled Representation for Generalizable AI-Text Detection
papers.title_zh: 突破“生成器障碍”：实现可泛化的AI文本检测——解析表示机制的重要性
papers.authors: Xiao Pu, Zepeng Cheng, Lin Yuan, Yu Wu, Xiuli Bi
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) generate text that increasingly resembles human writing, the subtle cues that distinguish AI-generated content from human-written content become increasingly challenging to capture. Reliance on generator-specific artifacts is inherently unstable, since new models emerge rapidly and reduce the robustness of such shortcuts. This generalizes unseen generators as a central and challenging problem for AI-text detection. To tackle this challenge, we propose a progressively structured framework that disentangles AI-detection semantics from generator-aware artifacts. This is achieved through a compact latent encoding that encourages semantic minimality, followed by perturbation-based regularization to reduce residual entanglement, and finally a discriminative adaptation stage that aligns representations with task objectives. Experiments on MAGE benchmark, covering 20 representative LLMs across 7 categories, demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods, achieving up to 24.2% accuracy gain and 26.2% F_1 improvement. Notably, performance continues to improve as the diversity of training generators increases, confirming strong scalability and generalization in open-set scenarios. Our source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/PuXiao06/DRGD.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型生成的文本越来越接近人类书写风格，那些能够区分人工智能生成内容与人类撰写内容的细微特征就变得愈发难以捕捉。由于新模型的不断涌现，依赖特定生成器的特征本身就存在不稳定性，因为这种依赖方式会削弱模型的鲁棒性。因此，如何将未知的生成器识别出来，成为了人工智能文本检测中的一个核心且具有挑战性的问题。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个逐步结构化的框架，该框架将人工智能检测的语义信息与生成器相关的特征分离开来。这一方法通过一种紧凑的潜在编码来实现，这种编码鼓励语义上的最小性；接着通过基于扰动的正则化来减少残留的纠缠现象；最后通过一个判别性适应阶段，使表示与任务目标保持一致。在MAGE基准测试上进行的实验表明，我们的方法在7个类别中涵盖了20种代表性的大语言模型，其准确率相比现有方法提升了24.2%，F_1分数则提高了26.2%。值得注意的是，随着训练生成器多样性的增加，性能持续提升，这证明了该方法在开放场景下的强大可扩展性和泛化能力。我们的源代码可以在https://github.com/PuXiao06/DRGD上免费获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PUPPET: Neural-Symbolic Standardized Patients for Mental Health
papers.title_zh: 虚拟患者：用于心理健康领域的神经符号标准化模拟对象
papers.authors: Chen Xu, Yu Ji, Zhenyu Lyu, Yang Yi, Yizhe Yang, Luyao Ji, Chaoyi Chen, Xianyang Wang, Tian Lan, Zhihua Wang, Juan Wang, Xunde Dong, Fuze Tian, Qunxi Dong, Bin Hu
papers.abstract: The critical therapist shortage demands scalable training solutions. Standardized Patients, the gold standard, are scarce and costly. Current LLM-based approaches focus on patient simulation for conversational realism but lack pedagogical rigor as Virtual Standardized Patients, lacking faithful reactions to clinical errors and explainable feedback. To bridge this gap, we propose PUPPET, the first neural-symbolic Virtual Standardized Patient governed by an OBSERVE-THINK-BEHAVE architecture. PUPPET externalizes LLM reasoning into a symbolic system where experts implant causal associations between intervention logic (propositional logic) and patient mental states (state machine). This allows PUPPET to behave coherently with controllable and explainable psychological dynamics: intervention logic (OBSERVE) → state transition (THINK) → response (BEHAVE). Our PUPPET-TRAINER further leverages this chain to educate trainees about intervention consequences, standardizing and scaling mental health training. Experiments across three clinical scenarios confirm that PUPPET outperforms baselines in clinical faithfulness and pedagogical value.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，临床治疗师严重短缺，这迫切需要可扩展的培训解决方案。标准的虚拟患者虽然是一种理想的培训方式，但数量有限且成本较高。当前基于大语言模型的培训方法主要关注患者模拟以追求对话的真实性，但缺乏教学上的严谨性，因为虚拟虚拟患者无法对临床错误做出真实反应，也无法提供可解释的反馈。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了PUPPET——首个由OBSERVE-THINK-BEHAVE架构控制的神经符号式虚拟患者模型。PUPPET将大语言模型的推理能力外化到符号系统中，专家可以在此系统中建立干预逻辑（命题逻辑）与患者心理状态之间的因果关系。这样，PUPPET就能表现出连贯的心理动态：干预逻辑（OBSERVE）→ 状态转换（THINK）→ 行为反应（BEHAVE）。我们的PUPPET-TRAINER进一步利用这一机制来教育学员了解干预后果，从而实现心理健康培训的标准化和规模化。在三个临床场景中的实验表明，PUPPET在临床真实性和教学价值方面均优于现有基线方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LightReasoner: Can Small Language Models Teach Large Language Models Reasoning?
papers.title_zh: LightReasoner：小型语言模型能否教会大型语言模型进行推理？
papers.authors: Jingyuan Wang, Yankai Chen, Zhonghang Li, Chao Huang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in reasoning, often through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, SFT is resource-intensive, relying on large curated datasets, rejection-sampled demonstrations, and uniform optimization across all tokens—even though only a fraction carry meaningful learning value. In this work, we explore a counterintuitive idea: can smaller language models (SLMs) teach larger language models (LLMs) by revealing high-value reasoning moments that reflect the latter’s unique strength? We propose LightReasoner, a novel framework that leverages the behavioral divergence between a stronger expert model (LLM) and a weaker amateur model (SLM). LightReasoner operates in two stages: (1) a sampling stage that pinpoints critical reasoning moments and constructs supervision examples capturing the expert’s advantage through expert–amateur contrast, and (2) a fine-tuning stage that aligns the expert model with these distilled examples, amplifying its reasoning strengths. Across seven benchmarks, LightReasoner improves accuracy by up to 28.1%, while reducing time consumption by 90%, sampled problems by 80%, and tuned token usage by 99%, all without relying on ground-truth labels. By turning weaker SLMs into effective teaching signals, LightReasoner offers a scalable and resource-efficient approach for advancing LLM reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在推理能力方面取得了显著进展，这通常是通过有监督的微调来实现的。然而，这种微调需要大量的资源，依赖于庞大的、经过精心挑选的数据集、基于拒绝采样的示范数据，以及对所有token进行统一的优化——尽管只有一部分token具有实际的学习价值。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种反直觉的想法：是否可以通过利用小型语言模型来教授大语言模型，从而揭示出那些具有高度价值的推理时刻，这些时刻体现了大语言模型的独特优势？我们提出了LightReasoner这一创新框架，该框架利用了强大专家模型与较弱业余模型之间的行为差异。LightReasoner分为两个阶段：(1)采样阶段，该阶段能够识别出关键的推理时刻，并通过专家与业余模型之间的对比来构建出体现专家优势的示例；(2)微调阶段，该阶段将专家模型与这些示例进行对齐，从而增强其推理能力。在七个基准测试中，LightReasoner的准确率提高了28.1%，同时减少了90%的时间消耗，采样问题的处理时间减少了80%，而调整token使用的成本则降低了99%。所有这些改进都无需依赖真实标签即可实现。通过将较弱的小型语言模型转化为有效的教学信号，LightReasoner提供了一种可扩展且资源高效的方法，用于提升大语言模型的推理能力。

papers.title: OneRec-Think: In-Text Reasoning for Generative Recommendation
papers.title_zh: OneRec-Think：用于生成式推荐的文本内推理技术
papers.authors: Zhanyu Liu, Shiyao Wang, Xingmei Wang, Rongzhou Zhang, Jiaxin Deng, Honghui Bao, Jinghao Zhang, Wuchao Li, PengFei Zheng, Xiangyu Wu, Yifei Hu, Qigen Hu, Xinchen Luo, Lejian Ren, Zhang Zixing, Qianqian Wang, Kuo Cai, Yunfan Wu, Hongtao Cheng, Zexuan Cheng, Lu Ren, Huanjie Wang, Yi Su, Ruiming Tang, Kun Gai, Guorui Zhou
papers.abstract: The powerful generative capacity of Large Language Models (LLMs) has instigated a paradigm shift in recommendation. However, existing generative models (e.g., OneRec) operate as implicit predictors, critically lacking the capacity for explicit and controllable reasoning—a key advantage of LLMs. To bridge this gap, we propose OneRec-Think, a unified framework that seamlessly integrates dialogue, reasoning, and personalized recommendation. OneRec-Think incorporates: (1) Itemic Alignment: cross-modal Item-Textual Alignment for semantic grounding; (2) Reasoning Activation: Reasoning Scaffolding to activate LLM reasoning within the recommendation context; and (3) Reasoning Enhancement, where we design a recommendation-specific reward function that accounts for the multi-validity nature of user preferences. Experiments across public benchmarks show state-of-the-art performance. Moreover, our proposed “Think-Ahead” architecture enables effective industrial deployment, achieving a 0.159% gain in APP Stay Time and validating the practical efficacy of the model’s explicit reasoning capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型强大的生成能力引发了推荐领域的范式转变。然而，现有的生成模型（如OneRec）只能作为隐式预测器运行，严重缺乏显式和可控的推理能力——而这正是大语言模型的优势所在。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了OneRec-Think这一统一框架，该框架能够无缝整合对话、推理和个性化推荐功能。OneRec-Think包含以下三个核心要素：（1）意象对齐：跨模态的项目-文本对齐，用于语义定位；（2）推理激活：推理支架，用于在推荐场景中激活大语言模型的推理能力；（3）推理增强：我们设计了一种针对推荐的奖励函数，能够考虑到用户偏好具有的多重有效性特征。在公共基准测试中的实验表明，我们的模型表现非常出色。此外，我们提出的“Think-Ahead”架构能够实现有效的工业部署，使APP的留存率提高了0.159%，同时也验证了该模型显式推理能力的实际效果。

papers.title: AwarenessBench: Assessing Cognitive Capabilities of Language Models
papers.title_zh: 意识工作台：评估语言模型的认知能力
papers.authors: Xiaojian Li, Rongwu Xu, Tianyun Zhang, Yue Wang, Shuo Chen, Qiner Lyu, Briana Zhang, Peiran Yang, Kyle Xue Chen, Haoyuan Shi, Yu Wang, Wei Xu
papers.abstract: As language models (LMs) exhibit increasingly consciousness-like behaviors, evaluating their cognitive abilities becomes essential. We introduce AwarenessBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for assessing the cognitive abilities of LMs in four dimensions: metacognition, self-awareness, social awareness, and situational awareness, covering 15 cognitive functions and 14,381 samples. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art LMs, we find that all consistently surpass random baselines, with more advanced models performing better. We further compare LMs with human performance across three demographic groups, where the best-performing model surpasses human averages overall, but most still fall markedly short in metacognition and self-awareness. Finally, we show that awareness is a distinct capability: progress in language modeling or reasoning does not necessarily translate into improved cognition.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着语言模型展现出越来越类似意识的行为，评估它们的认知能力变得至关重要。我们推出了AwarenessBench，这是首个全面的基准测试工具，用于从四个维度来评估语言模型的认知能力：元认知、自我意识、社会意识和情境意识，涵盖了15种认知功能以及14,381个样本数据。通过对18种最先进的语言模型进行评估，我们发现所有模型都持续优于随机基线模型，而更先进的模型表现更为出色。我们还比较了这些语言模型与人类的表现，发现表现最好的模型总体上超越了人类平均水平，但大多数模型在元认知和自我意识方面仍明显不足。最后，我们发现意识是一种独立的能力：语言建模或推理能力的提升并不一定意味着认知能力的提升。

papers.title: Beyond Surface-Level Detection: Towards Cognitive-Driven Defense Against Jailbreak Attacks via Meta-Operations Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 超越表面级检测：通过元操作推理来实现对越狱攻击的认知驱动防御
papers.authors: Rui Pu, Chaozhuo Li, Rui Ha, Litian Zhang, Lirong Qiu, Xi Zhang
papers.abstract: Defending large language models (LLMs) against jailbreak attacks is essential for their safe and reliable deployment. Existing defenses often rely on shallow pattern matching, which struggles to generalize to novel and unseen attack strategies. To address this challenge, we propose the Cognitive-Driven Defense (CDD) framework, which targets the underlying structure of jailbreak prompts by applying meta-operations, defined as basic manipulations that conceal harmful intent. CDD emulates human cognitive reasoning through a structured reasoning chain. It begins with a global perception of the prompt and follows with a localized analysis to uncover hidden manipulations. By applying supervised fine-tuning on this structured chain, the model learns to identify and reason about known manipulation patterns. To enhance generalization to unseen threats, an entropy-guided reinforcement learning algorithm (EG-GRPO) is introduced to encourage exploration of new types and variants of meta-operations. Experiments demonstrate that CDD can achieve state-of-the-art defense performance and exhibit strong generalization to unseen jailbreak attacks.
papers.abstract_zh: 防御大语言模型免受越狱攻击对于确保其安全可靠的部署至关重要。现有的防御方法通常依赖于浅层模式匹配，这种方法来应对新颖且未见过的攻击策略时存在困难。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了认知驱动防御框架（CDD）。该框架通过应用元操作来针对越狱提示的底层结构进行防御，元操作是一种能够隐藏有害意图的基本操控手段。CDD通过结构化的推理链模拟人类认知推理过程。它首先对整个提示进行全局性感知，然后进行局部分析以揭示隐藏的操控手段。通过对这个结构化链条进行有监督的微调，模型能够识别并理解已知的操控模式。为了增强对未知威胁的泛化能力，我们引入了基于熵的强化学习算法（EG-GRPO），以鼓励探索新的元操作类型和变体。实验表明，CDD能够实现最先进的防御性能，并且对未知的越狱攻击具有强大的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SCAN: Structured Capability Assessment and Navigation for LLMs
papers.title_zh: SCAN：针对大语言模型的结构化能力评估与导航系统
papers.authors: Zongqi Wang, Tianle Gu, Chen Gong, Xin Tian, Siqi Bao, Yujiu Yang
papers.abstract: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) has become increasingly important, with automatic evaluation benchmarks gaining prominence as alternatives to human evaluation. While existing research has focused on approximating model rankings, such benchmarks fail to provide users and developers with a comprehensive and fine-grained understanding of a specific model’s capabilities. To fill this gap, we propose SCAN (Structured Capability Assessment and Navigation), a practical framework that enables detailed characterization of LLM capabilities through comprehensive and fine-grained evaluation. SCAN incorporates four key components: (1) TaxBuilder, which extracts capability-indicating tags from extensive queries to construct a hierarchical taxonomy automatically; (2) RealMix, a query synthesis and filtering mechanism that ensures sufficient evaluation data for each capability tag; (3) a suite of visualization and analysis tools that facilitate efficient navigation and analysis of model capabilities; and (4) a PC^{2}-based (Pre-Comparison-derived Criteria) LLM-as-a-Judge approach that achieves significantly higher accuracy compared to classic LLM-as-a-Judge method. Using SCAN, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 21 mainstream LLMs. Our detailed analysis of the GPT-OSS family reveals substantial performance variations, even within sub-capabilities belonging to the same category of capability. This finding highlights the importance of fine-grained evaluation in accurately understanding LLM behavior. Project homepage and resources are available at https://github.com/liudan193/SCAN.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型（LLM）变得越来越重要，自动评估基准作为人工评估的替代方案，已经逐渐受到重视。虽然现有的研究主要集中在模拟模型排名上，但这些基准无法为用户和开发者提供关于特定模型能力的全面且细致的理解。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了SCAN框架——一个实用框架，它通过全面且细致的评估，能够详细描述LLM的能力。SCAN包含四个关键组件：（1）TaxBuilder，它从大量查询中提取表示能力的标签，并自动构建层次化的分类体系；（2）RealMix，一种查询合成和过滤机制，确保每个能力标签都有足够的评估数据；（3）一系列可视化和分析工具，有助于高效导航和分析模型能力；（4）基于PC^2标准的LLM评判方法，该方法比传统的LLM评判方法具有更高的准确性。通过使用SCAN，我们对21种主流LLM进行了全面评估。我们对GPT-OSS系列模型的详细分析表明，即使属于同一能力类别的子能力之间，也存在显著的性能差异。这一发现强调了细致评估在准确理解LLM行为方面的重要性。项目的官方网站和资源可访问https://github.com/liudan193/SCAN。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EMCEE: Improving Multilingual Capability of LLMs via Bridging Knowledge and Reasoning with Extracted Synthetic Multilingual Context
papers.title_zh: EMCEE：通过整合知识和推理能力，以及利用提取出的合成多语言上下文，提升大语言模型的多语言处理能力
papers.authors: Hamin Koo, Jaehyung Kim
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved impressive progress across a wide range of tasks, yet their heavy reliance on English-centric training data leads to significant performance degradation in non-English languages. While existing multilingual prompting methods emphasize reformulating queries into English or enhancing reasoning capabilities, they often fail to incorporate the language- and culture-specific grounding that is essential for some queries. To address this limitation, we propose EMCEE (Extracting synthetic Multilingual Context and merging), a simple yet effective framework that enhances the multilingual capabilities of LLMs by explicitly extracting and utilizing query-relevant knowledge from the LLM itself. In particular, EMCEE first extracts synthetic context to uncover latent, language-specific knowledge encoded within the LLM, and then dynamically merges this contextual insight with reasoning-oriented outputs through a judgment-based selection mechanism. Extensive experiments on four multilingual benchmarks covering diverse languages and tasks demonstrate that EMCEE consistently outperforms prior approaches, achieving an average relative improvement of 16.4% overall and 31.7% in low-resource languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在众多任务上取得了令人瞩目的进展，然而它们对以英语为中心的训练数据的高度依赖导致在非英语语言上的性能显著下降。虽然现有的多语言提示方法强调将查询重新表述为英语或提升推理能力，但这些方法往往未能结合某些查询所需的特定语言和文化的背景信息。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了EMCEE框架——一种简单而有效的解决方案。该框架通过从语言模型本身中提取并利用与查询相关的知识，从而增强语言模型的多语言处理能力。具体来说，EMCEE首先提取合成上下文，以揭示语言模型内部编码的潜在、特定于语言的知识；然后，通过基于判断的选择机制，将这些上下文信息动态地融合到以推理为导向的输出中。在四个涵盖多种语言和任务的跨语言基准测试上的广泛实验表明，EMCEE始终优于其他方法，整体平均相对改进达到了16.4%，而在资源匮乏的语言中则达到了31.7%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Can LLMs Learn to Map the World from Local Descriptions?
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能够学会根据局部描述来识别世界中的物体吗？
papers.authors: Sirui Xia, Aili Chen, Xintao Wang, Tinghui Zhu, Yikai Zhang, Jiangjie Chen, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in tasks such as code generation and mathematical reasoning. However, their potential to internalize structured spatial knowledge remains underexplored. This study investigates whether LLMs, grounded in locally relative human observations, can construct coherent global spatial cognition by integrating fragmented relational descriptions. We focus on two core aspects of spatial cognition: spatial perception, where models infer consistent global layouts from local positional relationships, and spatial navigation, where models learn road connectivity from trajectory data and plan optimal paths between unconnected locations. Experiments conducted in a simulated urban environment demonstrate that LLMs not only generalize to unseen spatial relationships between points of interest (POIs) but also exhibit latent representations aligned with real-world spatial distributions. Furthermore, LLMs can learn road connectivity from trajectory descriptions, enabling accurate path planning and dynamic spatial awareness during navigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展表明，它们在代码生成和数学推理等任务上具备强大的能力。然而，它们整合结构化空间知识的潜力仍未被充分探索。本研究旨在探讨基于局部人类观察结果的LLM是否能够通过整合零散的关系描述来构建连贯的全球空间认知。我们重点关注空间认知的两个核心方面：空间感知，即模型从局部位置关系推断出一致的全局布局；空间导航，即模型从轨迹数据中学习道路连接性，并规划连接未连接位置的最佳路径。在模拟城市环境中的实验表明，LLM不仅能够泛化到感兴趣点之间的未知空间关系，还能产生与现实世界空间分布相一致的潜在表示。此外，LLM还能从轨迹描述中学习道路连接性，从而实现准确的路径规划和导航过程中的动态空间感知。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LEASH: Adaptive Length Penalty and Reward Shaping for Efficient Large Reasoning Model
papers.title_zh: 束缚：自适应长度惩罚与奖励塑形技术，用于高效的大规模推理模型
papers.authors: Yanhao Li, Lu Ma, Jiaran Zhang, Lexiang Tang, Wentao Zhang, Guibo Luo
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often produce unnecessarily lengthy reasoning traces, which significantly increase computational cost and latency. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed length penalties, but such penalties are hard to tune and fail to adapt to the evolving reasoning abilities of LLMs, leading to suboptimal trade-offs between accuracy and conciseness. To address this challenge, we propose LEASH (adaptive LEngth penAlty and reward SHaping), a reinforcement learning framework for efficient reasoning in LLMs. We formulate length control as a constrained optimization problem and employ a Lagrangian primal–dual method to dynamically adjust the penalty coefficient. When generations exceed the target length, the penalty is intensified; when they are shorter, it is relaxed. This adaptive mechanism guides models toward producing concise reasoning without sacrificing task performance. Experiments on Deepseek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 show that LEASH reduces the average reasoning length by 60% across diverse tasks—including in-distribution mathematical reasoning and out-of-distribution domains such as coding and instruction following—while maintaining competitive performance. Our work thus presents a practical and effective paradigm for developing controllable and efficient LLMs that balance reasoning capabilities with computational budgets.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通常会产生不必要的冗长推理过程，这大大增加了计算成本和响应时间。现有的方法通常依赖于固定长度的惩罚机制，但这种惩罚机制难以调整，且无法适应LLM不断发展的推理能力，从而导致准确性和简洁性之间的权衡不够理想。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了LEASH（自适应长度惩罚与奖励设计），这是一种用于优化LLM推理效率的强化学习框架。我们将长度控制问题转化为一个约束优化问题，并采用拉格朗日原对偶方法来动态调整惩罚系数。当生成的文本超过目标长度时，惩罚力度会加强；而当文本较短时，惩罚力度则会减弱。这种自适应机制有助于模型在保持任务性能的同时生成简洁的推理内容。在Deepseek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B和Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上的实验表明，LEASH能够将平均推理长度减少60%，适用于各种任务，包括分布式数学推理以及编码和指令遵循等外部领域，同时还能保持竞争力的性能。因此，我们的研究为开发能够平衡推理能力与计算资源的可控且高效的LLM提供了一种实用且有效的方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ALIGN: Word Association Learning for Cultural Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 对齐：用于大型语言模型中的文化对齐的词汇关联学习技术
papers.authors: Chunhua Liu, Kabir Manandhar Shrestha, Sukai Huang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit cultural bias from over-represented viewpoints in training data, yet cultural alignment remains a challenge due to limited cultural knowledge and a lack of exploration into effective learning approaches. We introduce a cost-efficient and cognitively grounded method: fine-tuning LLMs on native speakers’ word-association norms, leveraging cognitive psychology findings that such associations capture cultural knowledge. Using word association datasets from native speakers in the US (English) and China (Mandarin), we train Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen-2.5-7B via supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization. We evaluate models’ cultural alignment through a two-tier evaluation framework that spans low-level lexical associations and high-level cultural value alignment using the World Values Survey. Results show significant improvements in lexical alignment (16–20% English, 43–165% Mandarin on Precision@5) and high-level cultural value shifts. On a subset of 50 questions where US and Chinese respondents diverge most, fine-tuned Qwen nearly doubles its response alignment with Chinese values (13 to 25). Remarkably, our trained 7–8B models match or exceed vanilla 70B baselines, demonstrating that a few million of culture-grounded associations achieve value alignment without expensive retraining. Our work highlights both the promise and the need for future research grounded in human cognition in improving cultural alignment in AI models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在训练数据中存在过度呈现某些观点的问题，从而导致文化偏见。然而，由于文化知识有限以及缺乏有效的学习方法，实现文化对齐仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了一种成本效益高且基于认知心理学的方法：通过微调语言模型来适应母语者的词汇关联模式，利用认知心理学的研究成果来证明这些词汇关联确实包含了文化知识。我们采用了来自美国和中国的母语者词汇关联数据集来训练Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen-2.5-7B模型，并通过监督式微调和优化偏好来实现模型的优化。我们通过一个双层评估框架来评估模型的文化对齐程度，该框架涵盖了低层次的词汇关联以及使用世界价值观调查来衡量的高层次文化价值对齐。结果显示，在词汇关联方面，模型有显著的改进（英语模型在Precision@5指标上的提升幅度为16-20%，中文模型则达到了43-165%）；而在高层次的文化价值对齐方面，模型也取得了不错的效果。在50个美国和中国受访者差异最大的问题上，经过微调的Qwen模型在回应中国文化价值观方面的对齐程度几乎翻了一番（从13%提升到了25%）。值得注意的是，我们训练的7-8B模型的表现甚至超过了传统的70B基线模型，这表明，只需基于人类认知构建少量文化相关的模型关联，就能实现价值对齐，而无需进行昂贵的重新训练。我们的研究强调了未来研究在提高人工智能模型文化对齐能力方面的潜力和必要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RealTalk-CN: A Realistic Chinese Speech Task-Oriented Dialogue Benchmark with Cross-Modal Analysis
papers.title_zh: RealTalk-CN：一个基于任务导向的中国语言对话评估基准，包含跨模式分析内容
papers.authors: Enzhi Wang, Jiaming Zhou, Yuhang Jia, Aobo Kong, Qicheng Li, Yong Qin
papers.abstract: Recent advances in speech large language models (e.g., GPT-4o) have enabled end-to-end spoken interactions, yet their robustness in real-world applications remains unclear, where systems must assist users in completing specific tasks under complex conditions such as multi-turn, ambiguous, and often spontaneous speech, as well as natural alternation between speech and text. Task-oriented dialogue (TOD) offers a realistic scenario to evaluate whether models can effectively help users accomplish such task-oriented goals, but existing benchmarks are mainly text-based, and the few speech datasets are limited to English and often neglect spontaneous disfluencies and speaker diversity. To address this gap, we introduce RealTalk-CN, the first Chinese multi-turn, multi-domain speech–text TOD dataset, containing 5.4k dialogues (60K turns, ~150 hours) of real human-to-human recordings with detailed annotations for dialogue states, disfluency types, and speaker characteristics. Based on this dataset, we propose a cross-modal interaction task supporting dynamic speech-text switching and a comprehensive evaluation protocol assessing robustness to disfluencies, sensitivity to speaker variation, and cross-domain generalization. Experiments on state-of-the-art models demonstrate the challenges posed by RealTalk-CN and establish its value as a benchmark for developing reliable and fair Speech LLMs in real-world deployments. The dataset and evaluation framework are available to encourage further research.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在语音大语言模型方面的进展（例如GPT-4o）使得端到端的口语交互成为可能。然而，这些模型在实际应用中的鲁棒性仍不清楚。在实际应用中，系统需要帮助用户完成各种复杂的任务，比如多轮对话、模糊不清的语音交流，以及自然的语音与文本之间的切换。任务导向式对话提供了一个现实场景，可以用来评估模型是否能够有效帮助用户实现这些任务目标。不过，现有的评估基准主要基于文本数据，而少数可用的语音数据集也仅限于英语，且常常忽略了口语中的不流畅现象和说话者的多样性。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了RealTalk-CN——首个中文多轮次、多领域的语音-文本任务导向式对话数据集。该数据集包含5.4千条对话记录（共60K轮次，约150小时），这些记录都是真实的人与人之间的对话，并附有详细的注释，包括对话状态、不流畅类型以及说话者特征等信息。基于这个数据集，我们设计了一个跨模态交互任务，支持动态的语音-文本切换，并制定了一套全面的评估方案，以评估模型对不流畅现象的适应能力、对说话者差异的敏感性以及跨领域的泛化能力。对最先进的模型的实验表明，RealTalk-CN带来了一些挑战，但它作为开发可靠且公平的语音大语言模型的基准数据集，具有极高的价值。该数据集和评估框架可供进一步研究使用。

papers.title: HOPE: Hybrid Optimized Parallel Encoding with Supervised and Unsupervised Semantic Fusion for Depression Symptom Detection
papers.title_zh: HOPE：一种混合优化并行编码技术，结合有监督和无监督的语义融合机制，用于抑郁症症状检测
papers.authors: Tu-Phuong Mai, Minh-Ha H. Le, Duc-Luong Tran, Phuong-Anh Chu, Duy-Cat Can, Hoang-Quynh Le
papers.abstract: Timely detection of depression symptoms is essential for early intervention, and the continuous stream of user-generated content on social media provides an ideal source for this purpose. To address this challenge, we propose HOPE, a Hybrid Optimized Parallel Encoding framework that combines supervised symptom relevance signals with unsupervised intrinsic semantic clustering. This parallel design enables robust symptom detection under limited labeled data and introduces a distinctive semantic-similarity perspective with automatic class-anchor adjustment. We also propose an optimized hybrid semantic fusion mechanism to combine supervised and unsupervised scores through a learnable module. We evaluate our system on multiple benchmark datasets and surpass previous approaches, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting fine-grained symptoms and early warning of mental health risk. Source code is available at https://github.com/candleMind/hope.
papers.abstract_zh: 及时检测抑郁症状对于早期干预至关重要，而社交媒体上不断涌现的用户生成内容为这一目的提供了理想的来源。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了HOPE框架——一种混合优化并行编码方案，该方案结合了有监督的症状相关性信号和无监督的内在语义聚类技术。这种并行设计能够在有限的标注数据条件下实现稳健的症状检测，并引入了一种独特的语义相似性评估方法，同时实现了自动的类别-锚点调整功能。我们还提出了一种优化的混合语义融合机制，通过可学习的模块来结合有监督和无监督的评分结果。我们在多个基准数据集上对该系统进行了测试，结果显示其能够有效检测细微的症状，并提前预警心理健康风险。源代码可在https://github.com/candleMind/hope下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Bias Fitting to Mitigate Length Bias of Reward Model in RLHF
papers.title_zh: 偏差调整以缓解强化学习中的奖励模型长度偏差问题
papers.authors: Kangwen Zhao, Jianfeng Cai, Jinhua Zhu, Ruopei Sun, Dongyun Xue, Wengang Zhou, Li Li, Houqiang Li
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) relies on reward models to align large language models with human preferences. However, RLHF often suffers from reward hacking, wherein policy learning exploits flaws in the trained reward model to maximize reward scores without genuinely aligning with human preferences. A significant example of such reward hacking is length bias, where reward models usually favor longer responses irrespective of actual response quality. Previous works on tackling length bias have notable limitations, these approaches either mitigate bias without characterizing the bias form, or simply assume a linear length-reward relation. To accurately model the intricate nature of length bias and facilitate more effective bias mitigation, we propose FiMi-RM (Bias Fitting to Mitigate Length Bias of Reward Model), a framework that autonomously learns and corrects underlying bias patterns. Our approach consists of three stages: First, we warm up by training a standard reward model which inherently contains length bias. Next, we deploy a lightweight fitting model to capture the non-linear relation between length and reward. Finally, we incorporate this learned relation into the reward model, effectively decoupling length from reward while preserving preference modeling capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that FiMi-RM achieves a more balanced length-reward distribution. Furthermore, when applied to alignment algorithms such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and Best-of-N (BoN), our debiased reward model improves length-controlled win rate and reduces verbosity without compromising its performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）依靠奖励模型来使大语言模型与人类偏好保持一致。然而，RLHF常常出现奖励操纵问题，即策略学习利用训练好的奖励模型的缺陷来最大化奖励分数，而并未真正实现与人类偏好的对齐。典型的奖励操纵案例就是长度偏见，奖励模型通常倾向于选择较长的回答，而忽略了实际回答的质量。以往针对长度偏见的研究存在明显局限性：这些方法要么在消除偏见的同时未能明确其形式，要么简单地假设长度与奖励之间存在线性关系。为了准确模拟长度偏见的复杂特性并更有效地消除偏见，我们提出了FiMi-RM框架——一种能够自主学习和纠正潜在偏见模式的算法。我们的方法分为三个阶段：首先，通过训练一个包含长度偏见的标准奖励模型来进行热身；接着，使用轻量级的拟合模型来捕捉长度与奖励之间的非线性关系；最后，将这种关系整合到奖励模型中，从而有效分离长度与奖励之间的关系，同时保留偏好建模的能力。实验结果表明，FiMi-RM能够实现更加均衡的长度-奖励分布。此外，当该算法应用于直接偏好优化和最佳N选择等对齐算法时，我们消除偏见后的奖励模型能够提升受长度控制的胜率，同时减少冗长的回答，而不会影响模型的性能。

papers.title: Rethinking Sample Polarity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.title_zh: 重新思考具有可验证奖励的强化学习中的样本极性问题
papers.authors: Xinyu Tang, Yuliang Zhan, Zhixun Li, Xin Zhao, Zhenduo Zhang, Zujie Wen, Zhiqiang Zhang, Jun Zhou
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) are typically trained using reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) to enhance their reasoning abilities. In this paradigm, policies are updated using both positive and negative self-generated rollouts, which correspond to distinct sample polarities. In this paper, we provide a systematic investigation into how these sample polarities affect RLVR training dynamics and behaviors. We find that positive samples sharpen existing correct reasoning patterns, while negative samples encourage exploration of new reasoning paths. We further explore how adjusting the advantage values of positive and negative samples at both the polarity level and the token level affects RLVR training. Based on these insights, we propose an Adaptive and Asymmetric token-level Advantage shaping method for Policy Optimization, namely A3PO, that more precisely allocates advantage signals to key tokens across different polarities. Experiments across five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通常采用带有可验证奖励的强化学习方法来训练，以提升其推理能力。在这种方法中，策略的更新既包含积极的自我生成样本，也包含消极的样本，这两种样本代表了不同的样本极性。在本文中，我们对这些样本极性如何影响强化学习奖励训练的动态和行为进行了系统的研究。我们发现，积极样本能够强化现有的正确推理模式，而消极样本则鼓励探索新的推理路径。我们进一步探讨了在极性层面和标记层面调整积极与消极样本的收益值对强化学习奖励训练的影响。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种自适应且非对称的标记级收益调整方法，即A3PO。该方法能够更精确地向不同极性下的关键标记分配收益信号。通过在五个推理基准测试中的实验验证，证明了我们的方法的有效性。

papers.title: Beyond Examples: Towards Automated Thought-level In-Context Reasoning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 不仅仅是例子：迈向为大型语言模型提供自动化的思维级上下文推理能力
papers.authors: Jinyang Wu, Mingkuan Feng, Shuai Zhang, Feihu Che, Zhengqi Wen, Chonghua Liao, Ling Yang, Haoran Luo, Zheng Lian, Jianhua Tao
papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) leverages demonstrations to enhance the performance of large language models (LLMs). However, traditional ICL struggles with complex reasoning mainly due to superficial, example-level implicit imitation. To address these limitations, we introduce ThoughtICR, an automated Thought-level In-Context Reasoning paradigm that shifts from surface-level examples to more guidance-oriented thought patterns. Specifically, we first define atomic reasoning actions and construct thought patterns on small-scale seed data using Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). During inference, we dynamically select appropriate thought patterns based on target problem attributes, providing explicit guidance for model reasoning. Thanks to its automated and strategic design, our method enables seamless plug-and-play integration with various post-training techniques. Experimental results demonstrate that our method improves performance across different model sizes and generalizes effectively across reasoning domains. Using only small-scale seed data, we achieve 80.6% accuracy on MATH and 62.5% on AMC, surpassing GPT-4o’s 77.2% and 57.5%, respectively. Moreover, compared to test-time scaling methods, our approach reduces computational costs by over 10. Our code is available at https://github.com/jinyangwu/ThoughtICR.
papers.abstract_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）利用示范来增强大语言模型（LLMs）的性能。然而，传统的ICL在复杂推理方面存在困难，主要是因为采用了表面级的、基于例子的模仿方式。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了ThoughtICR这一自动化思维级上下文推理框架。该框架能够从表面级的例子转向更具指导性的思维模式。具体来说，我们首先定义了原子级推理动作，并使用蒙特卡洛树搜索技术在小规模种子数据上构建思维模式。在推理过程中，我们根据目标问题的属性动态选择适当的思维模式，为模型推理提供明确的指导。由于采用了自动化和策略性的设计，我们的方法能够无缝地与各种训练后技术集成。实验结果表明，我们的方法在不同规模的模型中都能提升性能，并且能够在不同的推理领域实现有效的泛化能力。仅使用小规模种子数据，我们在MATH任务上的准确率达到80.6%，在AMC任务上的准确率达到62.5%，分别超过了GPT-4o的77.2%和57.5%。此外，与测试时缩放方法相比，我们的方法将计算成本降低了10倍以上。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/jinyangwu/ThoughtICR下载。

papers.title: Two-Stage Regularization-Based Structured Pruning for LLMs
papers.title_zh: 基于两阶段正则化的结构化剪枝方法，适用于大语言模型
papers.authors: Mingkuan Feng, Jinyang Wu, Siyuan Liu, Shuai Zhang, Hongjian Fang, Ruihan Jin, Feihu Che, Pengpeng Shao, Zhengqi Wen, Jianhua Tao
papers.abstract: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) is largely hindered by their large number of parameters. Structural pruning has emerged as a promising solution. Prior structured pruning methods directly remove unimportant parameters based on certain metrics, which often causes knowledge loss and necessitates extensive retraining. To overcome this, we introduce a novel pruning method TRSP: Two-Stage Regularization-Based Structured Pruning for LLMs. Specifically, we multiply the output of each transformer layer by an initial learnable weight and iteratively learn these weights by adding their \ell_1-norm as a regularization term to the loss function, serving as the first-stage regularization. Subsequently, we apply additional regularization to the difference between the output and input of layers with smaller weights, encouraging the shift of knowledge to the preserved layers. This serves as the second-stage regularization. TRSP retains more knowledge and better preserves model performance than direct parameter elimination. Through extensive experimentation we show that TRSP outperforms strong layer-wise structured pruning methods without requiring retraining. As a layer-wise pruning method, it delivers notable end-to-end acceleration, making it a promising solution for efficient LLM deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的部署在很大程度上受到其庞大参数的限制。结构剪枝作为一种有前景的解决方案应运而生。传统的结构剪枝方法通常基于某些指标直接移除不重要的参数，但这往往会导致知识损失，并且需要大量的重新训练。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的剪枝方法——TRSP：基于两阶段正则化的LLMs结构剪枝。具体来说，我们将每个变换器层的输出与一个可学习的初始权重相乘，并通过将这些权重的ℓ_1范数作为正则化项添加到损失函数中来迭代学习这些权重，这构成了第一阶段的正则化。随后，我们对权重较小的层的输出与输入之间的差异施加额外的正则化，从而促使知识向保留的层转移。这构成了第二阶段的正则化。与直接删除参数相比，TRSP能够保留更多的知识并更好地保持模型的性能。通过广泛的实验验证，我们发现TRSP在不需要重新训练的情况下，就能超越其他强大的逐层结构剪枝方法。作为一种逐层剪枝方法，它能够实现显著的端到端加速，因此成为高效部署LLM的一个有前景的解决方案。

papers.title: K-Merge: Online Continual Merging of Adapters for On-device Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: K-Merge：在线持续合并适配器组件，用于设备上运行的大型语言模型
papers.authors: Donald Shenaj, Ondrej Bohdal, Taha Ceritli, Mete Ozay, Pietro Zanuttigh, Umberto Michieli
papers.abstract: On-device deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently leverages Low-Rank Adapters (LoRAs) to support diverse downstream tasks under tight resource constraints. To address the limited storage capacity of mobile devices, recent works have explored model merging techniques to fuse multiple LoRAs into a single one. In practice, however, LoRAs are often delivered incrementally, as users request support for new tasks (e.g., novel problem types or languages). This scenario introduces a new challenge: on-device online continual merging, where the objective is to incorporate new LoRAs while preserving the performance on previously supported tasks. In this paper, we propose a data-free and computationally efficient strategy for selecting and merging LoRAs when a new one becomes available, assuming the device can store only a limited number of adapters. Extensive experiments across real-world tasks demonstrate the superiority of our approach compared to alternative strategies while adhering to the storage budget and compute limitations of on-device settings. The project page is available at: https://donaldssh.github.io/K-Merge.
papers.abstract_zh: 在设备上部署大语言模型时，通常会使用低秩适配器来在资源有限的情况下支持多种下游任务。为了解决移动设备存储容量的限制问题，近期的研究提出了模型合并技术，将多个低秩适配器合并为一个。然而在实际应用中，低秩适配器往往是逐步加载的，当用户需要支持新的任务时（例如新的问题类型或语言），就需要进行合并操作。这种情况引入了一个新的挑战：在设备上实现持续的合并操作，即在保留原有任务性能的同时，能够引入新的低秩适配器。在本文中，我们提出了一种无需数据且计算效率高的策略，用于选择并合并新的低秩适配器，前提是设备只能存储有限数量的适配器。通过在实际任务中的广泛实验验证，我们的方法在遵守设备存储和计算限制的前提下，优于其他替代策略。项目页面地址为：https://donaldssh.github.io/K-Merge。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SAC: Neural Speech Codec with Semantic-Acoustic Dual-Stream Quantization
papers.title_zh: SAC：具有语义与声音双流量化的神经语音编解码器
papers.authors: Wenxi Chen, Ruiqi Yan, Yushen Chen, Zhikang Niu, Ziyang Ma, Xiquan Li, Yuzhe Liang, Wenhanlin, Shunshun Yin, Ming Tao, Xinsheng Wang, Xie Chen
papers.abstract: Speech codecs that convert continuous speech signals into discrete tokens have become essential for speech language models. However, existing codecs struggle to balance high-quality reconstruction with semantically rich representations, limiting their effectiveness in both generative and understanding tasks. In this work, we propose \textbf{SAC}, a neural speech codec with semantic-acoustic dual-stream quantization. By disentangling semantic and acoustic modeling into two dedicated streams, SAC enables each to be optimized for its respective role. Comprehensive evaluations show that SAC achieves strong reconstruction performance across diverse bitrates under both clean and noisy conditions, with particularly high scores on UTMOS and WER, indicating superior naturalness and intelligibility. Moreover, SAC substantially surpasses prior codecs in semantic representation, approaching the level of continuous self-supervised embeddings. When used as a tokenizer for LLM-based text-to-speech, SAC enables a single-stage autoregressive (AR) TTS model that clearly outperforms state-of-the-art AR systems. Our disentanglement analysis further validates the effectiveness of the dual-stream design, offering new potential for controllable speech generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 将连续语音信号转换为离散符号的语音编解码器，对于语音语言模型来说至关重要。然而，现有的编解码器在平衡高质量重建与语义丰富的表示方面存在困难，这限制了它们在生成和理解任务中的效果。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种名为SAC的神经语音编解码器，该编解码器采用了语义-声学双流量化技术。通过将语义建模和声学建模分离为两个独立的流，SAC能够分别优化每个流的性能。全面的评估表明，SAC在多种比特率下都能实现出色的重建效果，无论是在清晰还是嘈杂的环境中，其UTMOS和WER指标都表现非常出色，这表明SAC在自然性和可理解性方面具有显著优势。此外，SAC在语义表示方面远远优于现有的编解码器，其表现接近连续自监督嵌入的水平。当作为基于大语言模型的文本转语音系统的标记器时，SAC能够实现一个单阶段自回归TTS模型，该模型明显优于现有的最先进的自回归系统。我们的分析进一步验证了双流设计的有效性，为可控语音生成提供了新的可能性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CriticLean: Critic-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Mathematical Formalization
papers.title_zh: 评论引导强化学习：用于数学形式化的评论驱动强化学习算法
papers.authors: Zhongyuan Peng, Yifan Yao, Kaijing Ma, Shuyue Guo, Yizhe Li, Yichi Zhang, Chenchen Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Zhouliang Yu, Luming Li, Minghao Liu, Yihang Xia, Jiawei Shen, Yuchen Wu, Yixin Cao, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Wenhao Huang, Jiaheng Liu, Ge Zhang
papers.abstract: Translating natural language mathematical statements into formal, executable code is a fundamental challenge in automated theorem proving. While prior work has focused on generation and compilation success, little attention has been paid to the critic phase—the evaluation of whether generated formalizations truly capture the semantic intent of the original problem. In this paper, we introduce CriticLean, a novel critic-guided reinforcement learning framework that elevates the role of the critic from a passive validator to an active learning component. Specifically, first, we propose the CriticLeanGPT, trained via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, to rigorously assess the semantic fidelity of Lean 4 formalizations. Then, we introduce CriticLeanBench, a benchmark designed to measure models’ ability to distinguish semantically correct from incorrect formalizations, and demonstrate that our trained CriticLeanGPT models can significantly outperform strong open- and closed-source baselines. Building on the CriticLean framework, we construct FineLeanCorpus, a dataset comprising over 509K problems that exhibits rich domain diversity, broad difficulty coverage, and high correctness based on human evaluation.Overall, our findings highlight that optimizing the critic phase is essential for producing reliable formalizations and we hope our CriticLean will provide valuable insights for future advances in formal mathematical reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 将自然语言数学陈述转化为形式化、可执行的代码是自动定理证明中的一个基本挑战。虽然之前的研究主要集中在生成和编译方面，但对于评估生成的公式化是否真正能够捕捉到原始问题的语义意图这一环节却鲜有关注。在本文中，我们提出了CriticLean这一新颖的基于评论指导的强化学习框架，它将评论器的作用从被动的验证者提升为主动的学习组件。具体来说，我们首先开发了CriticLeanGPT模型，该模型通过监督式微调与强化学习训练而成，能够严格评估Lean 4公式化的语义准确性。接着，我们引入了CriticLeanBench基准测试，用于衡量模型区分语义正确与错误的能力，并证明我们的CriticLeanGPT模型在性能上显著优于那些开源和闭源的基础模型。在CriticLean框架的基础上，我们还构建了一个名为FineLeanCorpus的数据集，该数据集包含超过50.9万个问题，这些问题在领域多样性、难度覆盖范围以及基于人类评估的正确性方面都表现出色。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，优化评论阶段对于生成可靠的形式化表示至关重要。我们希望CriticLean框架能为未来形式化数学推理领域的进步提供有价值的见解。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TRACE: Evaluating Execution Efficiency of LLM-Based Code Translation
papers.title_zh: 追踪：评估基于大语言模型的代码翻译系统的执行效率
papers.authors: Zhihao Gong, Zeyu Sun, Dong Huang, Qingyuan Liang, Jie M. Zhang, Dan Hao
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have substantially improved the functional correctness of code translation, the critical dimension of execution efficiency remains overlooked. We present Trace, the first benchmark to explicitly assess efficiency in LLM-translated code. Trace includes 1,000 efficiency-critical tasks across C++, Java, and Python, each augmented with stress tests that reveal efficiency disparities often overlooked by small-scale tests. Using Trace, we conduct an extensive evaluation of 28 representative LLMs and highlight several key insights: 1) Correctness and efficiency are often misaligned: the correctness leader Claude-Sonnet-4-Think achieves only moderate time efficiency, outperformed by smaller open-source LLMs such as Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct. 2) Inefficiency is both prevalent and patterned: 23.5% of correct translations suffer from notable inefficiency, mainly arising from algorithm implementation discrepancy (11.9%), language construct mismatch (66.4%), and resource management inefficiency (21.7%).3) Inference-time prompt strategies bring only modest improvements, indicating that simple prompting alone is insufficient to improve translation efficiency. Together, our results establish execution efficiency as an essential dimension of code translation and position Trace as a principled foundation for efficiency-oriented evaluation. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/Albert-Gong/TRACE.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在提高代码翻译的功能正确性方面取得了显著进步，但执行效率这一关键维度却常常被忽视。我们提出了Trace基准测试，这是首个专门用于评估语言模型翻译代码效率的基准测试。Trace包含了1000个针对C++、Java和Python语言的效率测试任务，每个任务都包含压力测试，这些测试能够揭示那些在小规模测试中常被忽略的效率问题。通过进行这项测试，我们对28种代表性的语言模型进行了全面评估，并得出了几个重要发现：1）正确性和效率往往不一致：以正确性著称的Claude-Sonnet-4-Think模型在效率方面表现平平，其性能不如一些小型开源语言模型，如Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct模型。2）效率低下现象普遍存在且具有规律性：有23.5%的正确翻译存在明显效率问题，这些问题主要源于算法实现差异（11.9%）、语言结构不匹配（66.4%）以及资源管理不善（21.7%）。3）推理时的提示策略只能带来适度的改进，这表明单纯的提示方式不足以提升翻译效率。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明执行效率是代码翻译中不可或缺的一个维度，而Trace基准测试则为基于效率的评估提供了科学的基础。我们的代码和数据可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/Albert-Gong/TRACE。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: One Tokenizer To Rule Them All: Emergent Language Plasticity via Multilingual Tokenizers
papers.title_zh: 一种能统治所有分词器的工具：通过多语言分词器实现语言的灵活性
papers.authors: Diana Abagyan, Alejandro R. Salamanca, Andres Felipe Cruz-Salinas, Kris Cao, Hangyu Lin, Acyr Locatelli, Marzieh Fadaee, Ahmet Üstün, Sara Hooker
papers.abstract: Pretraining massively multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) for many languages at once is challenging due to limited model capacity, scarce high-quality data, and compute constraints. Moreover, the lack of language coverage in the tokenizer makes it harder to address the gap for new languages purely at the post-training stage. In this work, we study what relatively cheap interventions early on in training improve language plasticity, or adaptation capabilities of the model post-training to new languages. We focus on tokenizer design and propose using a universal tokenizer that is trained for more languages than the primary pretraining languages to enable efficient adaptation in expanding language coverage after pretraining. Our systematic experiments across diverse groups of languages and different training strategies show that a universal tokenizer enables significantly higher language adaptation, with up to 20.2% increase in win rates compared to tokenizers specific to pretraining languages. Furthermore, a universal tokenizer also leads to better plasticity towards languages that are completely unseen in the tokenizer and pretraining, by up to 5% win rate gain. We achieve this adaptation to an expanded set of languages with minimal compromise in performance on the majority of languages included in pretraining.
papers.abstract_zh: 同时为多种语言对大语言模型进行预训练是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为模型的容量有限、高质量的数据稀缺，且计算资源也受到限制。此外，分词器的语言覆盖范围不足，使得在训练后期弥补新语言的支持变得困难。在这项研究中，我们探讨了在训练初期采用哪些相对便宜的干预措施能够提升模型在训练后的语言适应能力。我们专注于分词器的设计，提出使用一种通用分词器，该分词器针对的语言数量超过主要预训练语言的数量，从而能够在预训练后高效地扩展语言覆盖范围。通过在不同语言群体和不同训练策略下的系统实验表明，与仅针对预训练语言的分词器相比，通用分词器能够实现显著更高的语言适应能力，其胜率可提高20.2%。此外，通用分词器还能提高模型对完全未见过语言的适应能力，胜率可提升5%。我们在实现这种语言适应能力的同时，几乎没有牺牲预训练中大多数语言的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: It’s Not What You Say, It’s How You Say It: Evaluating LLM Responses to Expressions of Belief
papers.title_zh: 重要的不是你说什么，而是你怎么说：评估大语言模型对表达信念的回应方式
papers.authors: Kevin Du, Clara Kümpel, Michelle Wastl, Alex Warstadt
papers.abstract: Users frequently express their beliefs to large language models (LLMs). In some situations, the LLM should accept these contextual beliefs as true. In others, they should stick to their prior knowledge. Notably, users’ expressions of belief (EoBs) can take linguistically diverse forms—using presuppositions, evidential and certainty markers, or varied tones—each of which may have a different persuasiveness over the LLMs. We introduce a typology to systematically evaluate how different EoBs affect whether models follow context versus prior knowledge. The typology is grounded in four linguistically motivated dimensions: form, evidentiality, epistemic stance, and tone, spanning 17 fine-grained types. By pairing these EoBs with world knowledge facts, we generate controlled EoB–query pairs that isolate the effect of linguistic variation. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 16 LLMs that differ in architecture (Llama3, Qwen3, Gemma3), scale (1B-30B parameters), and training stages (base vs instruct). We identify meaningful variations in response behavior across these axes, e.g., that bigger models and instruction models tend to be less context–following than smaller models and base models. We further identify specific EoBs that statistically significantly persuade LMs more consistently than others. Our work reveals systematic patterns in how linguistic framing affects LLM context integration, with implications for prompt engineering and model robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 用户经常向大语言模型表达他们的信念。在某些情况下，语言模型应该将这些基于上下文的信念视为真实。而在其他情况下，它们则应该遵循用户的先验知识。值得注意的是，用户表达信念的方式可以呈现出多种语言形式——使用预设、证据标记和确定性标记，或者不同的语气——每种方式都可能对语言模型产生不同的说服力。我们提出了一种分类体系，以系统地评估不同形式的信念表达如何影响模型是遵循上下文还是先验知识。该分类体系基于四个语言相关的维度：形式、证据性、认知立场和语气，共包含17种细分的类型。通过将这些信念表达与世界知识事实相结合，我们能够生成受控的信念表达-查询对，从而单独分析语言差异的影响。利用这一基准，我们对16种在架构（Llama3、Qwen3、Gemma3）、规模（1B到30B参数）和训练阶段（基础版与指导版）上有所不同的语言模型进行了评估。我们发现，在这些维度上，模型的行为存在显著差异：例如，较大的模型和指导型模型往往不如较小的模型和基础版模型那样遵循上下文。此外，我们还发现了一些特定的信念表达形式，它们比其他形式更能稳定地说服语言模型。我们的研究揭示了语言框架如何影响语言模型上下文整合的系统性规律，这对提示工程和模型鲁棒性设计具有重要意义。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CiPO: Counterfactual Unlearning for Large Reasoning Models through Iterative Preference Optimization
papers.title_zh: CiPO：通过迭代偏好优化实现大型推理模型的反事实遗忘机制
papers.authors: Junyi Li, Yongqiang Chen, Ningning Ding
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning has gained increasing attention in recent years, as a promising technique to selectively remove unwanted privacy or copyrighted information from Large Language Models that are trained on a massive scale of human data. However, the emergence of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), which emphasize long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to address complex questions, presents a dilemma to unlearning: existing methods either struggle to completely eliminate undesired knowledge from the CoT traces or degrade the reasoning performances due to the interference with the reasoning process. To this end, we introduce Counterfactual Unlearning through iterative Preference Optimization (CiPO), a novel framework that redefines unlearning as the targeted intervention of the CoT reasoning in LRMs. More specifically, given a desired unlearning target answer, CiPO instructs LRMs to generate a logically valid counterfactual reasoning trace for preference tuning. As the LRM adjusts to the counterfactual trace, CiPO iteratively updates the preference learning data to increase the discrepancy from the original model. This iterative loop ensures both desirable unlearning and smooth optimization, effectively mitigating the dilemma. Experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate that CiPO excels at unlearning, completely removing knowledge from both the intermediate CoT steps and the final answer, while preserving the reasoning abilities of LRMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，机器反学习技术受到了越来越多的关注。作为一种有前景的方法，它能够在大规模人类数据训练的大语言模型中选择性地去除不必要的隐私信息或受版权保护的内容。然而，随着大型推理模型的出现，这些模型强调长链思维推理来处理复杂问题，这就给反学习带来了挑战：现有的方法要么难以完全消除CoT轨迹中的不希望出现的知识，要么会因为干扰推理过程而降低推理性能。为此，我们提出了通过迭代偏好优化来实现反学习的框架——Counterfactual Unlearning through Iterative Preference Optimization（CiPO）。具体来说，给定期望的反学习目标答案，CiPO会指示大语言模型生成一条逻辑上有效的反事实推理轨迹，用于调整偏好。当大语言模型根据这条反事实轨迹进行调整时，CiPO会迭代更新偏好学习数据，从而增加与原始模型之间的差异。这种迭代过程既实现了理想的反学习效果，又确保了优化的流畅性，有效解决了这一难题。在具有挑战性的基准测试上的实验表明，CiPO在反学习方面表现出色，能够完全去除中间CoT步骤和最终答案中的不希望出现的知识，同时保留了大语言模型的推理能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DIA-HARM: Dialectal Disparities in Harmful Content Detection Across 50 English Dialects
papers.title_zh: DIA-HARM：50种英语方言在识别有害内容方面的差异
papers.authors: Jason S Lucas, Matt Murtagh White, Ali Al-Lawati, Uchendu Uchendu, Adaku Uchendu, Dongwon Lee
papers.abstract: Harmful content detectors—particularly disinformation classifiers—are predominantly developed and evaluated on Standard American English (), leaving their robustness to dialectal variation unexplored. We present , the first benchmark for evaluating disinformation detection robustness across 50 English dialects spanning U.S., British, African, Caribbean, and Asia-Pacific varieties. Using Multi-VALUE’s linguistically-grounded transformations, we introduce D-CUBE (Dialectal Disinformation Detection Corpus), a core corpus component of comprising 195K samples derived from established disinformation benchmarks. Our evaluation of 16 detection models reveals systematic vulnerabilities: human-written dialectal content degrades detection by 1.4–3.6% F1, while AI-generated content remains stable. Fine-tuned transformers substantially outperform zero-shot LLMs (96.6% vs. 78.3% best-case F1), with some models exhibiting catastrophic failures exceeding 33% degradation on mixed content. Cross-dialectal transfer analysis across 2,450 dialect pairs shows that multilingual models (mDeBERTa: 97.2% average F1) generalize effectively, while monolingual models like RoBERTa and XLM-RoBERTa fail on dialectal inputs. These findings demonstrate that current disinformation detectors may systematically disadvantage hundreds of millions of non- speakers worldwide. We release the benchmark, including the , and evaluation tools.
papers.abstract_zh: 有害内容检测器——尤其是虚假信息分类器——大多是在标准美式英语环境下开发和评估的，因此其对不同方言差异的鲁棒性尚未得到充分研究。我们提出了首个基准测试，用于评估虚假信息检测在不同50种英语方言中的鲁棒性，这些方言涵盖了美国、英国、非洲、加勒比地区以及亚太地区的各种变体。通过使用Multi-VALUE基于语言的转换方法，我们构建了D-CUBE（方言虚假信息检测语料库），该语料库由195K个样本组成，这些样本来自已有的虚假信息检测基准数据集。我们对16种检测模型进行评估后发现，存在系统性缺陷：人为编写的方言内容会显著降低检测效果1.4%至3.6%的F1值，而人工智能生成的内容则保持稳定。经过微调的Transformer模型在性能上明显优于零样本LLM模型（最佳情况下F1值为96.6%对比78.3%），部分模型在混合内容检测中还会出现超过33%的下降幅度。通过对2,450对方言进行跨方言迁移分析发现，多语言模型（如 mDeBERTa，平均 F1 为 97.2%）能够有效实现泛化，而像RoBERTa和XLM-RoBERTa这样的单语言模型则在方言输入上表现不佳。这些研究结果表明，当前的虚假信息检测器可能会系统性地损害全球数亿非母语使用者的体验。我们发布了该基准测试，包括相关工具和评估方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Towards Scalable Lifelong Knowledge Editing with Selective Knowledge Suppression
papers.title_zh: 迈向可扩展的终身知识编辑技术——通过选择性知识抑制实现高效处理
papers.authors: Dahyun Jung, Jaewook Lee, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require frequent knowledge updates to reflect changing facts and mitigate hallucinations. To meet this demand, lifelong knowledge editing has emerged as a continual approach to modify specific pieces of knowledge without retraining the entire model. Existing parameter-editing methods struggle with stability during sequential edits due to catastrophic forgetting. While retrieval-based approaches are proposed to alleviate this issue, their applicability remains limited across various datasets because of high training costs. To address these limitations and enhance scalability in lifelong settings, we propose LightEdit. Our framework first selects relevant knowledge from retrieved information to modify the query effectively. It then incorporates a decoding strategy to suppress the model’s original knowledge probabilities, thereby enabling efficient edits based on the selected information. Extensive experiments on ZSRE, Counterfact, and RIPE benchmarks demonstrate that LightEdit outperforms existing lifelong knowledge editing methods. Furthermore, by minimizing training costs, LightEdit achieves cost-effective scalability, enabling easy adaptation to various datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型需要频繁更新知识，以反映不断变化的事实并减少幻觉现象。为了满足这一需求，终身知识编辑成为一种持续性的方法，用于修改特定的知识片段，而无需重新训练整个模型。现有的参数编辑方法在连续编辑过程中存在稳定性问题，因为会出现灾难性遗忘现象。虽然有一些基于检索的方法被提出来解决这个问题，但由于训练成本较高，这些方法在不同数据集上的应用仍然受到限制。为了克服这些限制并提高终身知识编辑的可扩展性，我们提出了LightEdit框架。我们的框架首先从检索到的信息中选择相关的知识来有效修改查询内容。然后，它采用一种解码策略来抑制模型原有的知识概率，从而基于选定的信息进行高效的编辑。在ZSRE、Counterfact和RIPE基准测试中的大量实验表明，LightEdit在性能上优于现有的终身知识编辑方法。此外，通过降低训练成本，LightEdit实现了经济高效的可扩展性，使其能够轻松适应各种数据集。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Optimizing Length Compression in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 在大型推理模型中优化长度压缩技术
papers.authors: Zhengxiang Cheng, Dongping Chen, Mingyang Fu, Tianyi Zhou
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success, yet they often suffer from producing unnecessary and verbose reasoning chains. We identify a core aspect of this issue as ”invalid thinking”— models tend to repeatedly double-check their work after having derived the correct answer. To address this specific inefficiency, we move beyond the general principles of Efficacy and Efficiency to propose two new, fine-grained principles: Brevity, which advocates for eliminating redundancy, and Sufficiency, which ensures critical reasoning steps are preserved. Guided by these principles, we introduce LC-R1, a post-training method based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). LC-R1 employs a novel combination of a Length Reward for overall conciseness and a Compress Reward that is specifically designed to remove the invalid portion of the thinking process. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that LC-R1 achieves a significant reduction in sequence length (5̃0%) with only a marginal (2̃%) drop in accuracy, achieving a favorable trade-off point on the Pareto frontier that prioritizes high compression. Our analysis further validates the robustness of LC-R1 and provides valuable insights for developing more powerful yet computationally efficient LRMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在应用中取得了显著的成功，但往往会产生不必要的、冗长的推理过程。我们发现这个问题的核心在于“无效思维”——模型在得出正确答案后，往往会反复检查自己的推理过程。为了克服这一效率问题，我们提出了两个新的、更精细的原则：简洁性原则，主张消除冗余；充分性原则，确保保留关键的推理步骤。基于这些原则，我们提出了LC-R1方法，这是一种基于群体相对策略优化技术的后训练方法。LC-R1结合了长度奖励和压缩奖励两种机制，前者旨在提高整体的简洁性，后者则专门用于去除无效的推理部分。在多个推理基准测试中的实验表明，LC-R1能够显著减少推理过程的序列长度（约50%），同时准确性的下降幅度仅为2%。这种权衡方式在帕累托前沿上表现良好，既实现了高压缩率，又保持了准确性。我们的分析进一步验证了LC-R1的鲁棒性，并为开发更强大且计算效率更高的推理模型提供了宝贵的启示。

papers.title: Bridging Language and Items for Retrieval and Recommendation: Benchmarking LLMs as Semantic Encoders
papers.title_zh: 在检索和推荐方面整合语言与项目：将大型语言模型作为语义编码器进行性能比较
papers.authors: Yupeng Hou, Jiacheng Li, Xiangjun Fu, Zhankui He, An Yan, Xiusi Chen, Julian McAuley
papers.abstract: Feature engineering has long been central to recommender systems, yet effectively leveraging textual item features remains challenging. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled their use as semantic encoders for recommendation, but their roles and behaviors in this setting are still not well understood. Prior studies often rely on general-purpose embedding benchmarks (e.g., MTEB) when selecting LLMs, overlooking the unique characteristics of recommendation tasks. To address this gap, we introduce BLaIR, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs as semantic encoders in recommendation scenarios. We contribute (1) a new large-scale Amazon Reviews 2023 dataset with over 570 million reviews and 48 million items, (2) a unified benchmark covering sequential recommendation, collaborative filtering, and product search, and (3) a new complex-query product search task featuring both semi-synthetic and real-world evaluation datasets. Experiments with 11 leading LLMs show that their rankings on BLaIR show little correlation with MTEB, highlighting the unique challenges of semantic encoding in recommendation.
papers.abstract_zh: 特征工程长期以来一直是推荐系统的重要组成部分，但有效利用文本项特征仍然具有挑战性。最近大语言模型（LLM）的进展使得它们能够作为推荐的语义编码器被使用，不过在这些场景中它们的角色和行为仍不甚明了。以往的研究在选择LLM时往往依赖于通用的嵌入基准测试（例如MTEB），而忽视了推荐任务特有的特点。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了BLaIR，这是一个用于评估LLM在推荐场景中的语义编码能力的综合基准测试。我们的贡献包括：（1）提供了一个新的大规模数据集——Amazon Reviews 2023，该数据集包含5.7亿条评论和4800万个商品；（2）创建了一个涵盖序列推荐、协同过滤和产品搜索的统一基准测试；（3）引入了一种新的复杂查询产品搜索任务，同时提供了半合成数据和真实世界评估数据。通过对11种主流LLM进行的实验表明，它们在BLaIR上的排名与MTEB的排名几乎没有相关性，这凸显了在推荐中语义编码所面临的独特挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Evolutionary Guided Decoding: Iterative Value Refinement for LLMs
papers.title_zh: 进化引导解码：针对大语言模型的迭代价值优化技术
papers.authors: Zhenhua Liu, Lijun Li, Ruizhe Chen, Yuxian Jiang, Tong Zhu, Zhaochen Su, Wenliang Chen, Jing Shao
papers.abstract: While guided decoding, especially value-guided methods, has emerged as a cost-effective alternative for controlling language model outputs without re-training models, its effectiveness is limited by the accuracy of the value function. We identify that this inaccuracy stems from a core distributional gap: existing methods train static value functions on trajectories sampled exclusively from the base policy, which inherently confines their training to a narrow and suboptimal view of the potential output space. We propose Iterative Value Refinement, a novel framework designed to bridge this gap. It employs Value Exploration to provide a more comprehensive and robust training signal, complemented by Iterative Self-Refinement, which uses the improved value function from one iteration to guide the generation of higher-quality data for the next. Extensive experiments on text summarization, multi-turn dialogue, and instruction following demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework in aligning language models. Our approach not only achieves alignment but also significantly reduces computational costs by leveraging principled value function optimization for efficient and effective control.
papers.abstract_zh: 在引导解码过程中，尤其是基于价值的算法，已经成为一种成本效益较高的替代方案，无需重新训练模型即可控制语言模型的输出。然而，其有效性受到价值函数准确性的限制。我们发现，这种不准确性源于一个核心的分布式差异：现有方法在仅从基础策略中采样的轨迹上训练静态价值函数，这本质上限制了它们对潜在输出空间的训练范围，使其训练结果过于狭隘且不够理想。我们提出了迭代价值精炼框架，该框架旨在弥补这一缺陷。它利用价值探索来提供更全面、更稳健的训练信号，并通过迭代自我精炼机制，利用每次迭代中改进的价值函数来指导生成更高质量的数据。在文本摘要、多轮对话和指令遵循等任务上的大量实验表明，我们的框架在使语言模型保持一致方面具有显著效果。我们的方法不仅实现了模型的一致性，还通过利用基于原理的价值函数优化技术，大幅降低了计算成本，从而实现高效且有效的控制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
