papers.title: CRAFT: Training-Free Cascaded Retrieval for Tabular QA
papers.title_zh: CRAFT：无需训练的层次式检索方法，适用于表格型问答场景
papers.authors: Adarsh Singh, Kushal Raj Bhandari, Jianxi Gao, Soham Dan, Vivek Gupta
papers.abstract: Open-Domain Table Question Answering (TQA) involves retrieving relevant tables from a large corpus to answer natural language queries. Traditional dense retrieval models, such as DTR and DPR, not only incur high computational costs for large-scale retrieval tasks but also require retraining or fine-tuning on new datasets, limiting their adaptability to evolving domains and knowledge. In this work, we propose CRAFT, a zero-shot, cascaded retrieval approach that first uses a sparse retrieval model to filter a subset of candidate tables before applying more computationally expensive dense models as re-rankers.To improve retrieval quality, we enrich table representations with descriptive titles and summaries generated by Gemini Flash 1.5, enabling richer semantic matching between queries and tabular structures. Our method outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) sparse, dense, and hybrid retrievers on the NQ-Tables dataset. It also demonstrates strong zero-shot performance on the more challenging OTT-QA benchmark, achieving competitive results at higher recall thresholds, where the task requires multi-hop reasoning across both textual passages and relational tables.This work establishes a scalable and adaptable paradigm for table retrieval, bridging the gap between fine-tuned architectures and lightweight, plug-and-play retrieval systems. Code and data are available at: https://coral-lab-asu.github.io/CRAFT/
papers.abstract_zh: 开放域表格问答（TQA）涉及从大量数据集中检索相关表格以回答自然语言查询。传统的密集检索模型，如DTR和DPR，不仅在大规模检索任务中会产生较高的计算成本，还需要在新的数据集上进行重新训练或微调，这限制了它们对不断变化的领域和知识的适应能力。在这项研究中，我们提出了CRAFT方法，这是一种零样本、级联式检索方法。该方法首先使用稀疏检索模型来筛选一部分候选表格，然后再使用计算成本更高的密集模型进行重新排序。为了提高检索质量，我们通过使用Gemini Flash 1.5生成的描述性标题和摘要来丰富表格表示，从而实现查询与表格结构之间更丰富的语义匹配。我们的方法在NQ-Tables数据集上的表现优于最先进的稀疏、密集和混合检索模型。此外，它在更具挑战性的OTT-QA基准测试中也表现出强大的零样本性能，能够在较高的召回率阈值下取得有竞争力的结果，因为该任务需要跨文本段落和关系表进行多跳推理。这项工作为表格检索建立了一个可扩展且适应性强的范式，弥合了精细化架构与轻量级、即插即用检索系统之间的差距。代码和数据可在以下链接获取：https://coral-lab-asu.github.io/CRAFT/
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evaluating Legal Reasoning Traces with Legal Issue Tree Rubrics
papers.title_zh: 评估法律推理的合理性——使用法律问题树评分标准
papers.authors: Jinu Lee, Kyoung-Woon On, Sophia Simeng Han, Arman Cohan, Julia Hockenmaier
papers.abstract: Evaluating the quality of LLM-generated reasoning traces in expert domains (e.g., law) is essential for ensuring credibility and explainability, yet remains challenging due to the inherent complexity of such reasoning tasks. We introduce LEGIT (LEGal Issue Trees), a novel large-scale (24K instances) expert-level legal reasoning dataset with an emphasis on reasoning trace evaluation. We convert court judgments into hierarchical trees of opposing parties’ arguments and the court’s conclusions, which serve as rubrics for evaluating the issue coverage and correctness of the reasoning traces. We verify the reliability of these rubrics via human expert annotations and comparison with coarse, less informative rubrics. Using the LEGIT dataset, we show that (1) LLMs’ legal reasoning ability is seriously affected by both legal issue coverage and correctness, and that (2) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and RL with rubrics bring complementary benefits for legal reasoning abilities, where RAG improves overall reasoning capability, whereas RL improves correctness albeit with reduced coverage.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型在专家领域（如法律领域）生成的推理痕迹的质量，对于确保其可信度和可解释性至关重要。然而，由于此类推理任务的固有复杂性，这一任务仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了LEGIT数据集，这是一个大规模的数据集，包含24K个实例，专注于推理痕迹的评估。我们将法庭判决转化为对手双方论点以及法院结论的层次结构树，这些结构树被用作评估推理痕迹的覆盖范围和正确性的标准。我们通过人类专家的注释以及与信息量较少的标准进行对比，来验证这些标准的可靠性。利用LEGIT数据集，我们发现：(1) 大语言模型的法律推理能力受到法律问题的覆盖范围和正确性的严重影响；(2) 基于检索增强的生成方法和带有标准的强化学习方法，能够为法律推理能力带来互补的效果——其中，基于检索增强的生成能够提升整体推理能力，而带有标准的强化学习方法则能提升推理的正确性，尽管其覆盖范围有所减少。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: KG-MuLQA: A Framework for KG-based Multi-Level QA Extraction and Long-Context LLM Evaluation
papers.title_zh: KG-MuLQA：一种基于层次化问答提取以及长上下文智能体评估的框架
papers.authors: Nikita Tatarinov, Vidhyakshaya Kannan, Haricharana Srinivasa, Arnav Raj, Harpreet Singh Anand, Varun Singh, Aditya Luthra, Ravij Lade, Agam Shah, Sudheer Chava
papers.abstract: We introduce KG-MuLQA (Knowledge-Graph-based Multi-Level Question-Answer Extraction): a framework that (1) extracts QA pairs at multiple complexity levels (2) along three key dimensions – multi-hop retrieval, set operations, and answer plurality, (3) by leveraging knowledge-graph-based document representations. This approach enables fine-grained assessment of model performance across controlled difficulty levels. Using this framework, we construct a dataset of 20,139 QA pairs based on financial credit agreements and evaluate 16 proprietary and open-weight Large Language Models, observing that even the best-performing models struggle with set-based comparisons and multi-hop reasoning over long contexts. Our analysis reveals systematic failure modes tied to semantic misinterpretation and inability to handle implicit relations.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了KG-MuLQA（基于知识图谱的多层次问答提取）框架：该框架能够（1）在多个复杂程度上提取问答对；（2）沿着三个关键维度进行处理——多跳检索、集合运算以及答案多样性；（3）通过利用基于知识图谱的文档表示来实现。这种方法使得可以在可控的难度级别下对模型性能进行细致评估。利用这一框架，我们构建了一个包含20,139对问答对的数据集，这些问答对基于金融信用协议。我们评估了16种专有和开源的大语言模型，发现即使是最优秀的模型也难以处理基于集合的比较以及长上下文下的多跳推理问题。我们的分析揭示了与语义误解以及无法处理隐含关系相关的系统性故障模式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: COMPASS: Enhancing Agent Long-Horizon Reasoning with Evolving Context
papers.title_zh: COMPASS：通过不断变化的上下文增强代理的长期推理能力
papers.authors: Guangya Wan, Mingyang Ling, Xiaoqi Ren, Rujun Han, Sheng Li, Zizhao Zhang
papers.abstract: Long-horizon tasks that require sustained reasoning and multiple tool interactions remain challenging for LLM agents: small errors compound across steps, and even state-of-the-art models often hallucinate or lose coherence. We identify context management as the central bottleneck—extended histories cause agents to overlook critical evidence or become distracted by irrelevant information, thus failing to replan or reflect from previous mistakes. To address this, we propose COMPASS (Context-Organized Multi-Agent Planning and Strategy System), a lightweight hierarchical framework that separates tactical execution, strategic oversight, and context organization into three specialized components: (1) a Main Agent that performs reasoning and tool use, (2) a Meta-Thinker that monitors progress and issues strategic interventions, and (3) a Context Manager that maintains concise, relevant progress briefs for different reasoning stages. Across three challenging benchmarks—GAIA, BrowseComp, and Humanity’s Last Exam—COMPASS improves accuracy by up to 20% relative to both single- and multi-agent baselines. We further introduce a test-time scaling extension that elevates performance to match established DeepResearch agents, and a post-training pipeline that delegates context management to smaller models for enhanced efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 需要持续推理和多种工具交互的长期任务对大语言模型代理来说仍然具有挑战性：小的错误会在多个步骤中累积，即使是最先进的模型也常常出现幻觉或失去连贯性。我们发现，上下文管理是其中的核心瓶颈——冗长的历史记录会导致代理忽略关键证据，或者被无关信息分散注意力，从而无法重新规划或从之前的错误中吸取教训。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了COMPASS（上下文组织型多智能体规划与策略系统），这是一个轻量级的分层框架，将战术执行、战略监督和上下文管理分解为三个专门的组件：（1）主代理负责推理和工具使用；（2）元思考者负责监控进度并实施战略干预；（3）上下文管理器负责为不同的推理阶段维护简洁相关的进展报告。在GAIA、BrowseComp和Humanity’s Last Exam这三个具有挑战性的基准测试中，COMPASS的准确率比单代理和多智能体基线提高了20%。我们还引入了一种测试时扩展方案，使性能达到与成熟的DeepResearch代理相当的水平；此外，我们还设计了训练后流程，将上下文管理任务委托给更小的模型，以提高效率。

papers.title: BracketRank: Large Language Model Document Ranking via Reasoning-based Competitive Elimination
papers.title_zh: 括号排序：通过基于推理的竞争性淘汰法来实现大型语言模型文档的排序
papers.authors: Abdelrahman Abdallah, Mohammed Ali, Bhawna Piryani, Adam Jatowt
papers.abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong potential for zero-shot document ranking, current listwise approaches face three critical limitations. First, context length constraints prevent processing many documents simultaneously. Second, sequential generation creates bottlenecks that cannot run in parallel. Third, ranking results depend heavily on initial document order, leading to inconsistent performance. We introduce BracketRank, a reasoning-driven competitive elimination framework that addresses these challenges through systematic group competition. Our method uses adaptive grouping to automatically optimise group sizes based on LLM context limits, reasoning-enhanced prompts that require explicit relevance explanations, and bracket-style elimination where documents compete through winner and loser brackets. This structure ensures every document has fair advancement opportunities regardless of initial positioning while allowing for parallel processing across competition stages. We evaluate BracketRank on TREC DL 19, TREC DL 20, and eight BEIR benchmark datasets. Results show that BracketRank achieves 77.90 NDCG@5 on TREC DL 19 and 75.85 NDCG@5 on TREC DL 20, outperforming RankGPT and other state-of-the-art methods. On BEIR datasets, BracketRank reaches 54.66 average NDCG@10, demonstrating robust performance across diverse domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在零样本文档排序方面具有巨大潜力，但目前的列表式方法存在三个关键限制。首先，上下文长度的限制使得无法同时处理大量文档。其次，序列生成过程会产生瓶颈问题，无法并行处理。第三，排序结果严重依赖于文档的初始顺序，从而导致性能不稳定。我们提出了BracketRank这一基于推理的竞争性淘汰框架，通过系统的分组竞争来应对这些挑战。我们的方法采用自适应分组策略，根据语言模型的上下文限制自动优化分组规模；使用需要明确相关性解释的增强型提示；并通过“胜者组”和“败者组”的竞争方式来实现文档的淘汰。这种结构确保每个文档都有公平的发展机会，同时允许在不同竞争阶段进行并行处理。我们在TREC DL 19、TREC DL 20以及八个BEIR基准数据集上对BracketRank进行了评估。结果表明，BracketRank在TREC DL 19上的NDCG@5达到了77.90，在TREC DL 20上达到了75.85，优于RankGPT和其他最先进的方法。在BEIR数据集上，BracketRank的平均NDCG@10达到了54.66，显示出其在不同领域的强大性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Multi-component Causal Tracing in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中的多成分因果追踪机制
papers.authors: Zirui Yan, Dennis Wei, Dmitriy A Katz, Prasanna Sattigeri, Ali Tajer
papers.abstract: Causal tracing systematically intervenes on a large language model’s (LLM’s) internal representations to uncover and quantify the causal pathways linking specific inputs or computations to specific metrics of interest, quantifying the LLM’s behavior. Building on previous single-component or single-layer studies, this paper presents a unified framework for causally tracing multiple components simultaneously. This framework systematically identifies the subsets of components (e.g., attention heads and multi-layer perceptron neurons) most critical to a desired target performance metric (e.g., accuracy and fairness). This is achieved by incorporating flexible interventions applied to a wide range of desired metrics. To address the combinatorial complexity of the multi-component problem, an efficient algorithm is designed that leverages soft interventions and a carefully designed metric transformation, converting the combinatorial search problem into a continuous one that can be solved efficiently under proper constraints, thereby generating proper binary decisions for selecting components. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method efficiently identifies subsets of the model’s components that have a high impact on the target metric, outperforming existing baseline approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 因果追踪系统地对大语言模型的内部表示进行干预，以揭示并量化将特定输入或计算与特定指标联系起来的因果路径，从而量化语言模型的行为。在之前针对单一组件或单一层的研究基础上，本文提出了一种用于同时追踪多个组件的统一框架。该框架能够系统地识别出对目标性能指标（如准确性和公平性）最为关键的组件子集。这是通过采用灵活的干预手段来实现的，这些干预手段可以应用于各种期望的指标上。为了应对多组件问题的组合复杂性，我们设计了一种高效的算法，该算法利用软性干预措施以及精心设计的指标转换方法，将组合搜索问题转化为连续性问题，从而在适当的约束条件下高效求解，进而生成用于选择组件的合理二元决策。实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够高效地识别出对目标指标有重大影响的部分模型组件，其性能优于现有的基线方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Sparse Feature Coactivation Reveals Causal Semantic Modules in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 稀疏特征激活揭示了大型语言模型中的因果语义模块
papers.authors: Ruixuan Deng, Xiaoyang Hu, Miles Gilberti, Shane Storks, Aman Taxali, Mike Angstadt, Chandra Sripada, Joyce Chai
papers.abstract: We identify semantically coherent, context-consistent network components in large language models (LLMs) using coactivation of sparse autoencoder (SAE) features collected from just a handful of prompts. Focusing on concept-relation prediction tasks, we show that ablating these components for concepts (e.g., countries and words) and relations (e.g., capital city and translation language) changes model outputs in predictable ways, while amplifying these components induces counterfactual responses. Notably, composing relation and concept components yields compound counterfactual outputs. Further analysis reveals that while most concept components emerge from the very first layer, more abstract relation components are concentrated in later layers. Lastly, we show that extracted components more comprehensively capture concepts and relations than individual features while maintaining specificity. Overall, our findings suggest a modular organization of knowledge and advance methods for efficient, targeted LLM manipulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过激活从少量提示中收集的稀疏自编码器的特征，识别出大语言模型中的语义上连贯、上下文上一致的网络组件。在概念-关系预测任务中，我们发现，对概念和关系进行分离处理（例如，对国家与单词的关系，以及首都与翻译语言的关系）会以可预测的方式改变模型的输出结果；而同时保留这些组件则会导致产生反事实的响应。值得注意的是，将关系和概念组件结合起来会产生复合的反事实输出。进一步分析表明，虽然大多数概念组件都出现在最底层，但更抽象的关系组件则集中在后续层次中。最后，我们发现，提取出的组件能够比单独的特征更全面地捕捉概念和关系，同时还能保持其特异性。总体而言，我们的研究发现揭示了知识的模块化组织方式，并为高效、有针对性的语言模型操控提供了方法支持。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TensorLens: End-to-End Transformer Analysis via High-Order Attention Tensors
papers.title_zh: TensorLens：通过高阶注意力矩阵实现端到端变换分析
papers.authors: Ido Andrew Atad, Itamar Zimerman, Shahar Katz, Lior Wolf
papers.abstract: Attention matrices are fundamental to transformer research, supporting a broad range of applications including interpretability, visualization, manipulation, and distillation. Yet, most existing analyses focus on individual attention heads or layers, failing to account for the model’s global behavior. While prior efforts have extended attention formulations across multiple heads via averaging and matrix multiplications or incorporated components such as normalization and FFNs, a unified and complete representation that encapsulates all transformer blocks is still lacking. We address this gap by introducing TensorLens, a novel formulation that captures the entire transformer as a single, input-dependent linear operator expressed through a high-order attention-interaction tensor. This tensor jointly encodes attention, FFNs, activations, normalizations, and residual connections, offering a theoretically coherent and expressive linear representation of the model’s computation. TensorLens is theoretically grounded and our empirical validation shows that it yields richer representations than previous attention-aggregation methods. Our experiments demonstrate that the attention tensor can serve as a powerful foundation for developing tools aimed at interpretability and model understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 注意力矩阵是Transformer研究的基础，它支持多种应用，包括可解释性、可视化、操控和蒸馏等。然而，目前大多数分析都集中在单个注意力头或层上，未能考虑到模型的全局行为。虽然之前的研究通过平均和矩阵乘法将注意力机制扩展到多个头部，或者加入了归一化和FFNs等组件，但仍然缺乏一种能够涵盖所有Transformer模块的统一且完整的表示方式。我们通过引入TensorLens来解决这个问题——这是一种新的表示方法，它将整个Transformer视为一个单一的、依赖于输入的线性算子，该算子通过高阶注意力交互张量来表示。这个张量同时包含了注意力、FFNs、激活值、归一化值和残差连接等信息，为模型的计算提供了一个理论上连贯且富有表现力的线性表示。TensorLens在理论上是合理的，我们的实证验证表明，它比之前的注意力聚合方法能提供更丰富的表示。我们的实验表明，注意力张量可以作为开发旨在提高可解释性和模型理解能力的工具的强大基础。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Inferring Events from Time Series using Language Models
papers.title_zh: 利用语言模型从时间序列中推断事件发生情况
papers.authors: Mingtian Tan, Mike A Merrill, Zachary Gottesman, Tim Althoff, David Evans, Thomas Hartvigsen
papers.abstract: A common goal in analyzing time series data is to understand how events cause observed variations. We study whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can infer natural language events associated with time series data.We introduce an automated method for generating tasks that test a model’s ability to reason about events associated with time series data based on sports data, and develop a new benchmarking method. In experiments spanning 18 LLMs, we prompt LLMs to infer unobserved events given time series data and observe surprising successes, even when providing minimal context. We then show that combining distillation with Reinforcement Learning (RL) can improve the performance for small language models to approach that of large proprietary reasoning models. All resources needed to reproduce our work are available: https://github.com/hartvigsen-group/GAMETime.
papers.abstract_zh: 分析时间序列数据的一个常见目标是理解事件是如何导致观察到的变化的。我们研究大语言模型是否能够推断出与时间序列数据相关的自然语言事件。我们提出了一种自动化方法，用于生成任务来测试模型基于体育数据对时间序列数据中相关事件的推理能力，并开发了一种新的基准测试方法。在涉及18种大语言模型的实验中，我们让这些模型根据时间序列数据推断未观察到的事件，结果令人惊讶地取得了成功，即使提供的上下文信息非常有限。我们还表明，将蒸馏技术与强化学习相结合，可以提高小型语言模型的性能，使其接近大型专有推理模型的水平。所有用于复现我们的工作所需的资源都可以在以下链接找到：https://github.com/hartvigsen-group/GAMETime。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: OASIS: Online Sample Selection for Continual Instruction Tuning
papers.title_zh: OASIS：用于持续教学调整的在线样本选择机制
papers.authors: Minjae Lee, Minhyuk Seo, Tingyu Qu, Tinne Tuytelaars, Jonghyun Choi
papers.abstract: In continual instruction tuning (CIT) scenarios, where new instruction tuning data continuously arrive in an online streaming manner, training delays from large-scale data significantly hinder real-time adaptation. Data selection can mitigate this overhead, but existing strategies often rely on pre-trained reference models, which are impractical in CIT setups since future data are unknown. Recent reference model-free online sample selection methods address this, but typically select a fixed number of samples per batch (e.g., top-k), making them vulnerable to distribution shifts where informativeness varies across batches. To address these limitations, we propose OASIS, an adaptive online sample selection approach for CIT that (1) selects informative samples by estimating each sample’s informativeness relative to all previously seen data, beyond batch-level constraints, and (2) minimizes informative redundancy of selected samples through iterative selection score updates. Experiments on various large foundation models show that , using only 25% of the data, achieves comparable performance to full-data training and outperforms the state-of-the-art sampling methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 在持续指令调优场景中，新的指令调优数据以在线流式方式不断涌入，大规模数据的训练延迟严重阻碍了实时适应能力的提升。数据选择可以减轻这一负担，但现有的策略通常依赖于预训练的参考模型，而在持续指令调优设置中，由于未来数据未知，这种依赖是不可行的。最近出现的无需参考模型的在线样本选择方法解决了这个问题，但这些方法通常每批只选择固定数量的样本（例如，前k个），这使得它们在批次间信息量变化的情况下容易受到分布偏移的影响。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了OASIS算法，这是一种适用于持续指令调优的自适应在线样本选择方法。该算法能够：(1)通过估计每个样本相对于所有已见过数据的信息量来选择合适的样本，而不受批次级别约束的限制；(2)通过迭代更新选择得分，最小化所选样本的信息冗余度。在多种大型基础模型上的实验表明，仅使用25%的数据就能达到与全数据训练相当的性能，并且其表现优于现有的最先进采样方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Make Mechanistic Interpretability Auditable: A Call to Develop Guidelines via Continuous Collaborative Reviewing
papers.title_zh: 使机制性可解释性具有可审核性：通过持续协作审查来制定相关指南的呼吁
papers.authors: Michael Lan, Narmeen Fatimah Oozeer, Chaithanya Bandi, Philip Quirke, Austin Meek, Fazl Barez, Amir Abdullah
papers.abstract: While mechanistic interpretability (MI) has produced important insights into neural network internals, the field has yet to establish a standardized system to audit experiments. As such, many of its findings remain underutilized in safety-critical applications such as medical AI and autonomous systems, as stakeholders cannot certify their validity. Recent work demonstrates this concretely: two papers found conflicting conclusions for the same behavior, and a third study revealed that both were partially correct but incomparable due to methodological inconsistencies. Without standardized auditing, such ambiguities hinder adoption in high-stakes contexts requiring strong correctness guarantees. We call for the MI community to work towards developing a novel reviewing system that complements peer review via: (1) Continuous reviewing supported by a Collaborative Reviewing Platform where meta-science results and discussions (such as critiques, negative results, post-hoc extensions, reproductions, replications, and partial results) that fit outside of papers are organized and discussed, allowing for comments and revisions to be made at any time (2) Generalizing good practices found on this platform into expert-verified guidelines and protocols to improve auditing efficiency, and (3) Source-based auditing systems that track arguments which claims depend on. This position paper encourages constructive debate over the necessity, design and implementation of such a framework, providing early concrete examples to help catalyze these dialogues. Overall, we propose that auditing MI itself is essential for its application in AI safety, industry, and governance.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然机制可解释性研究为理解神经网络的内部机制提供了重要启示，但该领域尚未建立起一套标准化的实验审核体系。因此，许多研究成果在诸如医疗人工智能和自动驾驶系统这类对准确性要求极高的应用中并未得到充分利用，因为相关方无法对其有效性进行验证。最近的研究具体证明了这一点：有两篇论文对同一现象得出了相互矛盾的结论，而第三项研究则表明，这两篇论文的观点都有部分正确性，但由于方法上的不一致性，它们的结论并不具有可比性。如果没有标准化的审核机制，这种模糊性会阻碍这些研究成果在需要严格保证正确性的高风险场景中的应用。我们呼吁机制可解释性研究领域的学者们努力开发一种新的审核系统，以补充同行评审工作，具体做法包括：(1) 通过协作式审核平台进行持续审核，将那些超出论文范围的研究成果和讨论内容（如批评意见、负面结果、后续扩展研究、重复实验等）进行整理和讨论，从而随时可以进行评论和修订；(2) 将该平台上发现的良好实践推广为经过专家验证的指南和协议，以提高审核效率；(3) 建立基于来源的审核系统，能够追踪那些依赖于特定论据的主张。这篇立场论文鼓励就此类框架的必要性、设计和实施展开建设性讨论，并提供一些具体的例子来推动这些对话的开展。总体而言，我们认为，对于人工智能安全、行业发展和治理等领域来说，对机制可解释性研究的审核是至关重要的。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Mitigating Context Interference for Reliable and Efficient Search Agents
papers.title_zh: 减少上下文干扰，以实现可靠高效的搜索代理
papers.authors: Boyang Xue, Bin Wu, Shuofei Qiao, Sheng Wang, Rui Wang, Yiming Du, Hongru Wang, Jeff Z. Pan, Emine Yilmaz, Kam-Fai Wong, Aldo Lipani
papers.abstract: Recent research empowers Large Language Models (LLMs) as multi-turn search agents to iteratively retrieve and generate outputs until complex tasks are solved. However, the contexts of multi-turn search agents are lengthy and complex. For example, the retrieved set of documents in each turn would inevitably introduce irrelevant information that distracts LLMs, referring to context interference, potentially hindering the reliability and efficiency of search agents. Therefore, we conduct a systematic study on context interference in multi-turn search agents, focusing on investigating i) which parts of the context of search agents will contribute to the context interference, ii) how to refine the contexts of search agents to mitigate the interference, and iii) can incorporating context refinement into search agent training yield further improvements. We reveal that interference primarily arises from the latest retrieved documents. Based on the explored findings, we then introduce a distill-based context refiner to dynamically mitigate context interference for multi-turn search agents. Finally, we validate that incorporating context refinement into RL training pipelines of search agents can significantly enhance both reliability and efficiency. This study highlights the importance of mitigating context interference of search agents, inspiring a novel paradigm of “refine context and then generate” for AI agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，大语言模型可以作为多轮搜索代理来迭代地检索和生成输出，从而解决复杂的任务。然而，多轮搜索代理的上下文往往非常复杂且冗长。例如，每一轮中检索到的文档集可能会引入无关信息，这些信息会分散大语言模型的注意力，这种现象被称为上下文干扰，可能会降低搜索代理的可靠性和效率。因此，我们对多轮搜索代理中的上下文干扰进行了系统的研究，重点探讨以下问题：i) 搜索代理的哪些上下文部分会导致上下文干扰；ii) 如何优化搜索代理的上下文以减轻这种干扰；iii) 是否可以通过在训练过程中加入上下文优化来进一步提升搜索代理的性能。研究发现，干扰主要来自于最新检索到的文档。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种基于蒸馏的上下文优化方法，用于动态减轻多轮搜索代理的上下文干扰。最后，我们验证了在搜索代理的强化学习训练流程中加入上下文优化可以显著提高其可靠性和效率。这项研究强调了减轻搜索代理上下文干扰的重要性，并为人工智能代理提供了一种新的优化策略——“先优化上下文，再生成输出”。

papers.title: Chunks as Arms: Multi-Armed Bandit-Guided Sampling for Long-Context LLM Preference Optimization
papers.title_zh: 以块状方式作为“武器”：基于多臂老虎机模型的采样方法，用于长上下文LLM偏好优化
papers.authors: Shaohua Duan, Pengcheng Huang, Xinze Li, Zhenghao Liu, Xiaoyuan Yi, Yukun Yan, Shuo Wang, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Long-context modeling is critical for a wide range of real-world tasks, including long-context question answering, summarization, and complex reasoning tasks. Recent studies have explored fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) with synthetic data to enhance their long-context capabilities. However, the effectiveness of such approaches is often limited by the low diversity and factual inconsistencies in the generated data. To address these challenges, we propose LongMab, a novel framework that leverages a Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) rollout strategy to identify the most informative chunks from the given long context for sampling high-quality and diverse responses and constructing preference data pairs for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) training. Specifically, we treat context chunks as arms of MAB, select chunks based on their expected reward scores to input into LLMs to generate responses, and iteratively update these scores based on reward feedback. Both exploration and exploitation during the rollout process enable the LLM to focus on the most relevant context segments, thereby generating and collecting high-quality and diverse responses. Experimental results on both Llama and Qwen show the effectiveness of LongMab by achieving more than a 4% improvement on long-context reasoning benchmarks. All data and code will be released on https://github.com/NEUIR/LongMab-PO.
papers.abstract_zh: 长上下文建模对于许多现实世界任务来说至关重要，包括长上下文问答、摘要生成以及复杂推理任务。最近的研究探索了使用合成数据对大语言模型进行微调，以提高其长上下文处理能力。然而，这种方法的有效性往往受到生成数据的多样性低和事实不一致性的限制。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了LongMab这一创新框架。该框架利用多臂老虎机策略，从给定的长上下文中筛选出最具信息量的部分，用于生成高质量且多样化的响应，并构建用于直接偏好优化训练的偏好数据对。具体来说，我们将上下文片段视为多臂老虎机的“臂”，根据它们预期的奖励分数来选择片段输入到语言模型中以生成响应，并根据奖励反馈不断更新这些分数。在滚动过程中，通过探索与利用相结合的方式，语言模型能够专注于最相关的上下文片段，从而生成并收集高质量且多样化的响应。在Llama和Qwen上的实验结果表明，LongMab的有效性得到了验证，其在长上下文推理基准测试中的表现提升了超过4%。所有数据和代码均可在https://github.com/NEUIR/LongMab-PO下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Long Context Modeling with Ranked Memory-Augmented Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 基于排序记忆增强检索的长上下文建模
papers.authors: Ghadir Alselwi, Hao Xue, Shoaib Jameel, Basem Suleiman, Flora D. Salim, Imran Razzak
papers.abstract: Effective long-term memory management is crucial for language models handling extended contexts. We introduce the Enhanced Ranked Memory Augmented Retrieval ERMAR framework, which dynamically ranks memory entries based on relevance. Unlike prior models, ERMAR employs a novel relevance scoring mechanism and a pointwise re-ranking model for key-value embeddings, inspired by learning-to-rank techniques in information retrieval. By integrating historical usage patterns and adaptive retrieval, ERMAR achieves state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks, demonstrating superior scalability and performance in long-context tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的长期记忆管理对于处理复杂上下文的语言模型来说至关重要。我们提出了Enhanced Ranked Memory Augmented Retrieval（ERMAR）框架，该框架能够根据相关性动态对记忆条目进行排序。与以往模型不同，ERMAR采用了一种新颖的相关性评分机制，以及基于信息检索中的学习排序技术的逐点重新排序模型来处理键值嵌入数据。通过整合历史使用模式和自适应检索机制，ERMAR在标准基准测试中取得了领先的成绩，展现了其在长上下文任务中的卓越可扩展性和性能表现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Comprehensive Survey of Process Reward Models: Data Generation, Model Construction, and Usage
papers.title_zh: 关于过程奖励模型的全面研究：数据生成、模型构建及应用方式
papers.authors: Congmin Zheng, Jiachen Zhu, Zhuoying Ou, Yuxiang Chen, Kangning Zhang, Rong Shan, Zeyu Zheng, Mengyue Yang, Jianghao Lin, Yong Yu, Weinan Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced reasoning ability, yet conventional alignment remains dominated by outcome reward models (ORMs) that judge only final answers. Process Reward Models(PRMs) address this gap by evaluating and guiding reasoning at the step or trajectory level. This survey provides a systematic overview of PRMs through the full loop: how to generate process data, build PRMs, and use PRMs for test-time scaling and reinforcement learning. We summarize applications across math, code, text, multimodal reasoning, robotics, and agents, and review emerging benchmarks. Our goal is to clarify design spaces, reveal open challenges, and guide future research toward fine-grained, robust reasoning alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在推理能力方面取得了显著进步，然而传统的对齐方法仍然主要依赖于结果奖励模型，这些模型仅对最终答案进行评判。过程奖励模型则通过评估和指导推理过程在步骤或轨迹层面来实现这一突破。本综述系统地介绍了过程奖励模型的设计方法：如何生成过程数据、构建过程奖励模型，以及如何利用这些模型进行测试时的扩展和强化学习。我们总结了该模型在数学、代码、文本、多模态推理、机器人技术和智能体等领域的应用案例，并回顾了相关的新兴基准测试。我们的目标是明确设计思路，揭示存在的挑战，并引导未来的研究朝着实现更精细、更稳健的推理对齐方向发展。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CODERL+: Improving Code Generation via Reinforcement with Execution Semantics Alignment
papers.title_zh: CODERL+：通过强化学习优化代码生成过程，并实现执行语义的同步处理
papers.authors: Xue Jiang, Yihong Dong, Mengyang Liu, Deng Hongyi, Tian Wang, Yongding Tao, Zhi Jin, Wenpin Jiao, Ge Li
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at code generation by learning from vast code corpora, a fundamental semantic gap remains between their training on textual patterns and the goal of functional correctness, which is governed by formal execution semantics. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) approaches attempt to bridge this gap using outcome rewards from executing test cases. However, solely relying on binary pass/fail signals is inefficient for establishing a well-aligned connection between the textual representation of code and its execution semantics, especially for subtle logical errors within the code. In this paper, we propose CODERL+, a novel approach that integrates execution semantics alignment into the RLVR training pipeline for code generation. CODERL+ enables the model to infer variable-level execution trajectory, providing a direct learning signal of execution semantics. CODERL+ can construct execution semantics alignment directly using existing on-policy rollouts and integrates seamlessly with various RL algorithms. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CODERL+ outperforms post-training baselines (including RLVR and Distillation), achieving a 4.6% average relative improvement in pass@1. CODERL+ generalizes effectively to other coding tasks, yielding 15.5% and 4.4% higher accuracy on code-reasoning and test-output-generation benchmarks, respectively. CODERL+ shows strong applicability across diverse RL algorithms and LLMs. Furthermore, probe analyses provide compelling evidence that CODERL+ strengthens the alignment between code’s textual representations and its underlying execution semantics.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型能够通过学习庞大的代码语料库来生成代码，但它们在文本模式训练与功能正确性目标之间仍存在本质上的语义鸿沟。功能正确性由正式的执行语义所决定。强化学习带可验证奖励方法试图通过执行测试案例的结果奖励来弥合这一差距。然而，仅仅依赖二元性的通过/失败信号，无法有效地建立代码文本表示与其执行语义之间的紧密联系，尤其是对于代码中细微的逻辑错误而言。在本文中，我们提出了CODERL+这一创新方法，它将执行语义对齐整合到代码生成的强化学习带可验证奖励训练流程中。CODERL+能够让模型推断出变量级别的执行轨迹，从而直接提供执行语义的学习信号。CODERL+可以直接利用现有的在线策略展开技术来构建执行语义对齐，并且可以无缝地与各种强化学习算法结合使用。大量实验表明，CODERL+在训练后的表现优于其他基线方法（包括RLVR和蒸馏方法），在pass@1指标上实现了4.6%的平均相对提升。此外，CODERL+在其他编码任务中也表现出良好的泛化能力，在代码推理和测试输出生成基准测试中分别提高了15.5%和4.4%的准确率。CODERL+在不同强化学习算法和大语言模型中的适用性都非常强。进一步的探针分析提供了有力的证据，证明CODERL+确实增强了代码文本表示与其底层执行语义之间的对齐程度。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Saber: Efficient Sampling with Adaptive Acceleration and Backtracking Enhanced Remasking for Diffusion Language Model in Code Generation
papers.title_zh: Saber：基于自适应加速与回溯技术的高效采样方法，为代码生成中的扩散语言模型提供改进的重新掩码处理机制
papers.authors: Yihong Dong, Zhaoyu Ma, Xue Jiang, Zhiyuan Fan, Jiaru Qian, Yongmin Li, Jianha Xiao, Zhi Jin, Ge Li
papers.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as a compelling alternative to the dominant autoregressive paradigm, offering inherent advantages in parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling. However, for the tasks with strict structural constraints such as code generation, DLMs face a critical trade-off between inference speed and output quality, where accelerating generation by reducing sampling steps often leads to catastrophic performance collapse.We find that the fundamental reasons are: 1) the generation difficulty is uneven in the structured sequence decoding steps, making DLM’s static acceleration strategy suboptimal; 2) the context of tokens generated by DLM evolves continuously, causing early high-confidence predictions to turn into irreversible errors.In this paper, we introduce efficient Sampling with Adaptive acceleration and Backtracking Enhanced Remasking (i.e., Saber), a novel training-free sampling algorithm for DLMs that the first to improve both inference speed and output quality in code generation. Saber dynamically adjusts the number of tokens unmasked per step based on the model’s evolving confidence, and utilizes a backtracking mechanism to revert tokens whose confidence drops as new context emerges, with its effectiveness supported by theoretical analysis.Extensive experiments on multiple mainstream code generation benchmarks show that Saber boosts Pass@1 accuracy by an average of 1.9% over mainstream DLM sampling methods, while achieving an average 251.4% inference speedup. By leveraging the inherent advantages of DLMs, our work significantly narrows the performance gap with autoregressive models in code generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）正逐渐成为替代主流自回归模型的有力选择，其在并行生成和双向上下文建模方面具有显著优势。然而，对于具有严格结构约束的任务，如代码生成，DLM在推理速度和输出质量之间面临着关键权衡问题——通过减少采样步长来加速生成过程，往往会导致性能严重下降。我们发现，造成这一问题的根本原因如下：1）在结构化序列解码过程中，生成的难度分布不均，使得DLM的静态加速策略不够理想；2）DLM生成的令牌上下文会持续演变，导致早期高置信度的预测变成不可逆转的错误。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为Saber的高效采样算法。这是一种无需训练的采样方法，它能够同时提升推理速度和代码生成的输出质量。Saber根据模型不断变化的置信度动态调整每一步中未被解密的令牌数量，并利用回溯机制来修正那些因新上下文出现而置信度下降的令牌。我们的算法通过理论分析证明了其有效性。在多个主流代码生成基准测试中的广泛实验表明，与主流DLM采样方法相比，Saber平均能将Pass@1准确率提高1.9%，同时实现平均251.4%的推理速度提升。通过充分利用DLM的优势，我们的研究显著缩小了在代码生成领域与自回归模型之间的性能差距。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Debiased Orthogonal Boundary-Driven Efficient Noise Mitigation
papers.title_zh: 去偏置正交边界驱动的高效噪声抑制方法
papers.authors: Hao Li, Jiayang Gu, Jingkuan Song, An Zhang, Lianli Gao
papers.abstract: Mitigating the detrimental effects of noisy labels on the training process has become increasingly critical, as obtaining entirely clean or human-annotated samples for large-scale pre-training tasks is often impractical. Nonetheless, existing noise mitigation methods often encounter limitations in practical applications due to their task-specific design, model dependency, and significant computational overhead. In this work, we exploit the properties of high-dimensional orthogonality to identify a robust and effective boundary in cone space for separating clean and noisy samples. Building on this, we propose One-Step Anti-noise (OSA), a model-agnostic noisy label mitigation paradigm that employs an estimator model and a scoring function to assess the noise level of input pairs through just one-step inference. We empirically validate the superiority of OSA, demonstrating its enhanced training robustness, improved task transferability, streamlined deployment, and reduced computational overhead across diverse benchmarks, models, and tasks. Our code is released at https://github.com/leolee99/OSA.
papers.abstract_zh: 减轻噪声标签对训练过程的负面影响已经变得至关重要，因为为大规模预训练任务获取完全干净或有人标注的样本往往是不切实际的。然而，现有的噪声缓解方法在实际应用中常常受到局限，因为它们具有特定任务的特性、依赖于具体模型，并且需要大量的计算资源。在这项工作中，我们利用了高维正交性的特性，设计了一种在锥体空间中有效区分干净样本和噪声样本的边界。在此基础上，我们提出了一种名为“一步式噪声抑制”的方法，这是一种与模型无关的噪声标签缓解方案，它利用估计模型和评分函数来仅通过一步推理就能评估输入对的噪声水平。我们通过实验验证了该方法的优越性，证明了它在提高训练鲁棒性、增强任务可迁移性、简化部署流程以及降低计算开销方面的优势。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/leolee99/OSA下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Collaborative Chain-of-Agents for Parametric-Retrieved Knowledge Synergy
papers.title_zh: 用于参数化检索知识的协作式代理链机制
papers.authors: Yi Jiang, Sendong Zhao, Jianbo Li, Haochun Wang, Lizhe Zhang, Yan Liu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs), especially for knowledge-intensive tasks. Despite its advantages, current RAG methods often struggle to fully exploit knowledge during generation. In particular, the synergy between the model’s internal parametric knowledge and external retrieved knowledge remains limited. Retrieved contents may sometimes mislead generation, while certain generated content can guide the model toward more accurate outputs. In this work, we propose Collaborative Chain-of-Agents, a framework designed to enhance explicitly synergy over both parametric and retrieved knowledge. Specifically, we first introduce CoCoA-zero, a multi-agent RAG framework that first performs conditional knowledge induction and then reasons answers. Building on this, we develop CoCoA, a long-chain training strategy that synthesizes extended multi-agent reasoning trajectories from CoCoA-zero to fine-tune the LLM. This strategy enhances the model’s capability to explicitly integrate and jointly leverage parametric and retrieved knowledge. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of CoCoA in open-domain QA and multi-hop QA.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术能够提升大语言模型的能力，尤其是在需要大量知识的任务中。尽管RAG具有诸多优势，但目前的RAG方法在利用知识进行生成时往往存在不足。具体而言，模型内部参数化知识与外部检索到的知识之间的协同效应仍然有限。有时，检索到的内容可能会误导生成过程，而某些生成的文本则可以帮助模型得出更准确的输出。在这项研究中，我们提出了协作式多智能体框架——CoCoA-zero，该框架旨在明确提升参数化知识和检索到的知识之间的协同作用。具体来说，我们首先介绍了CoCoA-zero这一多智能体RAG框架，它首先执行条件性知识提取，然后对答案进行推理。在此基础上，我们开发了CoCoA这一长链训练策略，该策略能够从CoCoA-zero开始，逐步构建出复杂的多智能体推理流程，从而进一步优化大语言模型。这一策略显著提升了模型整合参数化知识和检索到的知识的能力。实验结果表明，CoCoA在开放域问答和多跳问答任务中表现出卓越的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: APPSI-139: A Parallel Corpus of English Application Privacy Policy Summarization and Interpretation
papers.title_zh: APPSI-139：英语应用隐私政策摘要与解读的平行语料库
papers.authors: Pengyun Zhu, Qiheng Sun, Long Wen, Yanbo Wang, Yang Cao, Junxu Liu, Deyi Xiong, Jinfei Liu, Zhibo Wang, Kui Ren
papers.abstract: Privacy policies are essential for users to understand how service providers handle their personal data. However, these documents are often long and complex, as well as filled with technobabble and legalese, causing users to unknowingly accept terms that may even contradict the law. While summarizing and interpreting these privacy policies is crucial, there is a lack of high-quality English parallel corpus optimized for legal clarity and readability. To address this issue, we introduce APPSI-139, a high-quality English privacy policy corpus meticulously annotated by domain experts, specifically designed for summarization and interpretation tasks. The corpus includes 139 English privacy policies, 15,692 rewritten parallel corpora, and 36,351 fine-grained annotation labels across 11 data practice categories. Concurrently, we propose TCSI-pp-V2, a hybrid privacy policy summarization and interpretation framework that employs an alternating training strategy and coordinates multiple expert modules to effectively balance computational efficiency and accuracy. Experimental results show that the hybrid summarization system built on APPSI-139 corpus and the TCSI-pp-V2 framework outperform large language models, such as GPT-4o and LLaMA-3-70B, in terms of readability and reliability. The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/EnlightenedAI/APPSI-139.
papers.abstract_zh: 隐私政策对于用户了解服务提供商如何处理他们的个人数据至关重要。然而，这些文件往往篇幅冗长且复杂，还充斥着技术术语和法律条文，导致用户在不自觉的情况下接受一些可能违反法律的条款。虽然对隐私政策进行总结与解读非常重要，但目前缺乏能够提升法律清晰度与可读性的高质量英文平行语料库。为了解决这一问题，我们推出了APPSI-139，这是一个由领域专家精心标注的高质量英文隐私政策语料库，专为总结与解读任务而设计。该语料库包含139份英文隐私政策、15,692个重新编写的平行语料库，以及涵盖11个数据类别的36,351个细粒度注释标签。同时，我们还提出了TCSI-pp-V2这一混合式隐私政策总结与解读框架，该框架采用交替训练策略，并协调多个专家模块，以有效平衡计算效率和准确性。实验结果表明，基于APPSI-139语料库构建的混合式总结系统以及TCSI-pp-V2框架在可读性和可靠性方面均优于GPT-4o和LLaMA-3-70B等大语言模型。该系统的源代码和数据集可在https://github.com/EnlightenedAI/APPSI-139获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Compressing then Matching: An Efficient Pre-training Paradigm for Multimodal Embedding
papers.title_zh: 压缩后再进行匹配：一种高效的多模态嵌入预训练方法
papers.authors: Da Li, Yuxiao Luo, Keping Bi, Jiafeng Guo, Wei Yuan, Biao Yang, Yan Wang, Fan Yang, Tingting Gao, Guorui Zhou
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models advance multimodal representation learning by acquiring transferable semantic embeddings, thereby substantially enhancing performance across a range of vision-language tasks, including cross-modal retrieval, clustering, and classification. An effective embedding is expected to comprehensively preserve the semantic content of the input while simultaneously emphasizing features that are discriminative for downstream tasks. Recent approaches demonstrate that MLLMs can be adapted into competitive embedding models via large-scale contrastive learning, enabling the simultaneous optimization of two complementary objectives. We argue that the two aforementioned objectives can be decoupled: a comprehensive understanding of the input enables the embedding model to achieve superior performance on downstream tasks via contrastive learning. In this paper, we propose CoMa, a compressed pre-training phase, which serves as a warm-up stage for contrastive learning. Experiments demonstrate that with only a small amount of pre-training data, we can transform an MLLM into a competitive embedding model. CoMa achieves new state-of-the-art results among MLLMs of comparable size on the MMEB, realizing optimization in both efficiency and effectiveness. Our project is available at https://github.com/Trustworthy-Information-Access/CoMa.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型通过获取可迁移的语义嵌入，推动了多模态表示学习的发展。这种技术显著提升了多种视觉-语言任务的性能，包括跨模态检索、聚类以及分类等任务。有效的嵌入方法能够全面保留输入的语义内容，同时强调那些对下游任务具有区分性的特征。最近的研究表明，通过大规模对比学习，多模态大语言模型可以转变为具有竞争力的嵌入模型，从而同时实现两个互补目标的优化。我们认为，这两个目标是可以分离的：对输入内容的全面理解使得嵌入模型能够通过对比学习在下游任务中取得更好的性能。在本文中，我们提出了CoMa这一压缩预训练阶段，它作为对比学习的预热阶段。实验结果表明，仅使用少量的预训练数据，我们就能将多模态大语言模型转化为具有竞争力的嵌入模型。CoMa在同等规模的多模态记忆检索基准测试中取得了新的最佳成绩，实现了效率和效果的双提升。我们的项目可以在https://github.com/Trustworthy-Information-Access/CoMa下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLM-XTM: Enhancing Cross-Lingual Topic Models with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: LLM-XTM：利用大型语言模型提升跨语言主题模型的效果
papers.authors: Minh Chu Xuan, Tien-Phat Nguyen, Linh Ngo Van, Dinh Viet Sang, Nguyen Thi Ngoc Diep, Trung Le
papers.abstract: Cross-lingual topic modeling aims to discover shared semantic structures across languages, yet existing models depend on sparse bilingual resources and often yield incoherent or weakly aligned topics. Recent LLM-based refinements improve interpretability but are costly, document-level, and prone to hallucination, with prior white-box approaches requiring inaccessible token probabilities. We propose LLM-XTM, a framework that integrates LLM-guided topic refinement with self-consistency uncertainty quantification, enabling black-box, stable, and scalable enhancement of cross-lingual topic models. Experiments on multilingual corpora show that LLM-XTM achieves superior topic coherence and alignment while reducing reliance on bilingual dictionaries and expensive LLM calls.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨语言主题建模旨在发现不同语言之间的共同语义结构，但现有的模型依赖于稀疏的双语资源，往往会产生不连贯或对齐度较低的主题。最近基于大语言模型的改进提高了模型的可解释性，但这些方法成本高昂、需要处理文档级数据，且容易产生幻觉。而传统的白盒方法则需要获取难以处理的令牌概率信息。我们提出了LLM-XTM框架，该框架将大语言模型引导的主题细化技术与自洽的不确定性量化技术相结合，从而实现跨语言主题模型的黑盒化、稳定性和可扩展性提升。在多语言语料库上的实验表明，LLM-XTM在保持主题连贯性和对齐度的同时，减少了对双语词典的依赖以及昂贵的语言模型调用需求。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Open Your Model’s Eyes: Video and Context-Aware Multimodal Backchannel Prediction
papers.title_zh: 睁开你的模型之眼：基于视频与上下文感知的多模态反馈预测技术
papers.authors: Min-Jae Kim, Jun-Yeong Moon, Mujeen Sung, Gyeong-Moon Park
papers.abstract: Backchannels, which signal listener states like empathy and understanding, are fundamental to natural human interaction. However, current approaches rely solely on audio and text. This omits crucial visual cues, such as facial expressions and gestures, as well as broader conversational contexts, which are necessary for accurate prediction. In this paper, we introduce Context-Aware Multimodal Alignment for Backchannel Prediction (CAMA-BC), a novel framework that leverages visual information through Multi-layer Multimodal Alignment (MMA). Our alignment process comprises two stages. First, Context Alignment (MMA-CA) utilizes unlabeled dialogues with videos to capture conversational contexts. Next, Backchannel Alignment (MMA-BA) fine-tunes the representations specifically for backchannel prediction. Experimental results show that CAMA-BC significantly outperforms both existing methods and simple multimodal baselines, with particular effectiveness in recognizing complex backchannels such as empathy.
papers.abstract_zh: 反馈通道能够传达出听众的同情和理解等情感状态，这是人类自然交流中的基本要素。然而，目前的方法仅依赖于音频和文本信息，这忽略了面部表情、手势等重要的视觉线索，以及更广泛的对话背景信息，而这些信息对于准确预测听众情感至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“上下文感知的多模态对齐用于反馈通道预测”的新框架（CAMA-BC）。该框架通过多层多模态对齐技术来利用视觉信息。我们的对齐过程分为两个阶段：第一阶段是上下文对齐（MMA-CA），它利用未标注的对话视频来捕捉对话背景信息；第二阶段是反馈通道对齐（MMA-BA），它专门针对反馈通道预测对表示进行微调。实验结果表明，CAMA-BC在性能上显著优于现有的方法和简单的多模态基线方法，尤其是在识别复杂的反馈通道情感方面表现尤为出色。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Bringing Real-World Relations into Video Generation with Graph-Structured Knowledge
papers.title_zh: 利用结构化图状知识将现实世界关系转化为视频内容
papers.authors: Joonhyung Park, Jaeyun Song, Sihwan Park, Eunho Yang
papers.abstract: Recent proprietary video generation models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in synthesizing highly realistic videos from textual instructions. Most open-source text-to-video models, however, still struggle to accurately simulate real-world physics and dynamic entity interactions. Existing approaches rely on scaling laws and large-scale, high-quality video datasets to implicitly learn physical dynamics, yet this paradigm is constrained by prohibitive costs and the burdensome demands of data curation. Motivated by this, we propose a novel framework that integrates graph-structured temporal knowledge into video latent diffusion models to enhance compositional generation and interaction fidelity. Our framework constructs video scene graphs specifically designed to capture entity relationships, temporal dynamics, and global scene context. These graph-structured representations guide the generation process through cross-attention mechanisms. Additionally, we introduce Graph-Aligned Denoising Loss (GADL), a training objective that ensures adherence to conditioned graphs by incorporating node modification tasks within the denoising process, leveraging synchronized edited video-graph pairs. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that incorporating graph-structured knowledge significantly enhances compositionality and the accurate portrayal of real-world interactions in generated videos.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的专有视频生成模型在根据文本指令合成高度逼真的视频方面表现出惊人的能力。然而，大多数开源的文本到视频模型仍然难以准确模拟现实世界的物理现象和动态实体的相互作用。现有的方法依赖于缩放定律以及大规模、高质量的视频数据集来隐式学习物理动力学，但这种方法受到高昂的成本和数据整理工作的限制。基于这一考虑，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架将图结构的时间知识整合到视频潜在扩散模型中，以提高组合生成能力和交互的真实性。我们的框架构建了专门用于捕捉实体关系、时间动态以及全局场景上下文的视频场景图。这些图结构表示通过交叉注意力机制来指导生成过程。此外，我们引入了图对齐去噪损失（GADL）这一训练目标，该目标通过在去噪过程中加入节点修改任务来确保图结构的正确性，并利用同步编辑过的视频-图对来进行训练。全面的评估表明，引入图结构知识显著提升了生成的视频在组合性以及真实世界交互的准确再现方面的表现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FC-TTS: Style and Timbre Control in Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech with Disentangled Speech Representations
papers.title_zh: FC-TTS：在零样本文本转语音过程中，通过分解式语音表示来实现风格与音质控制
papers.authors: Yoonhyung Lee, Hyunsin Park, Jinhwan Park, Jinkyu Lee
papers.abstract: Recent advances in zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) have enabled accurate imitation of reference speech in terms of both speaking style and speaker timbre. However, achieving disentangled control over these aspects from separate references remains a challenging task. Several studies have proposed disentangled speech representations that decompose speech into interpretable attributes (\textit{e.g.}, timbre, prosody, and content), providing a promising foundation for TTS with attribute control from separate references. Yet, how to effectively integrate such representations into TTS systems to achieve independent and precise control remains underexplored. In this paper, we present FC-TTS, a zero-shot TTS framework that enables disentangled control of style and timbre by conditioning on two distinct reference utterances. Unlike existing systems that inherit limitations from those pre-trained disentangled representations, FC-TTS introduces key design strategies, including architectural choices, training framework, and auxiliary training objectives, which improve the reliability of attribute separation and dual-reference control. Experiments show that FC-TTS achieves high-fidelity synthesis and competitive zero-shot naturalness, while uniquely supporting consistent and independent manipulation of style and timbre. Audio samples are available at https://qualcomm-ai-research.github.io/fc-tts
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在零样本文本转语音技术方面的进展，使得在说话风格和声音特征方面能够准确模仿参考语音。然而，如何将这些特征与独立的参考语音分离开来，仍然是一个具有挑战性的任务。一些研究提出了将语音分解为可解释属性的方法，例如声音特征、韵律和情感内容等，这为基于这些属性进行零样本语音合成提供了有力的基础。不过，如何将这样的表示有效地整合到语音合成系统中，以实现独立且精确的控制，目前尚未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们提出了FC-TTS框架，该框架通过基于两个不同的参考语音来进行风格和声音特征的独立控制，从而实现了对语音的精准操控。与那些依赖于预训练表示的传统系统不同，FC-TTS采用了一些关键的设计策略，包括架构选择、训练框架以及辅助训练目标，这些策略提高了属性分离和双参考控制的可靠性。实验表明，FC-TTS能够实现高保真度的语音合成，并且其自然度也相当出色，同时还能实现风格和声音特征的独立调整。音频样本可以在https://qualcomm-ai-research.github.io/fc-tts获取。

papers.title: SAGE: Sparse Adaptive Guidance for Dependency-Aware Tabular Data Generation
papers.title_zh: SAGE：用于生成依赖关系明确的数据表的稀疏自适应引导方法
papers.authors: Shuo Yang, Zheyu Zhang, Bardh Prenkaj, Gjergji Kasneci
papers.abstract: Generating high-fidelity synthetic tabular data remains a critical challenge for enhancing data availability in privacy-sensitive and low-resource domains. Recent approaches leverage LLMs by representing table rows as sequences, yet suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) they model feature dependencies densely, introducing spurious correlations; and (2) they assume static relationships between features, ignoring how these dependencies vary with feature values. To overcome these limitations, we introduce SAGE (Sparse Adaptive Guidance), a novel LLM-based generation framework that enforces sparse and dynamic dependency guidance. SAGE discretizes features into value-aware pseudo-features and constructs a mutual information-based sparse dependency graph. This graph adaptively guides generation through explicit context selection or implicit logit correction, enabling LLMs to focus on truly relevant information during synthesis. Our extensive experiments across six datasets and multiple tasks reveal that SAGE not only improves data fidelity and downstream utility, boosting F1 scores by 10% compared to previous LLM-based methods, but also reduces policy violations by one point. These results highlight the importance of adaptive structure in tabular data generation and provide new insights into context-sensitive control of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成高保真度的合成表格数据仍然是提高在隐私敏感和资源匮乏领域的数据可用性的关键挑战。近期的一些方法利用大语言模型将表格行表示为序列形式来生成数据，但这些方法存在两个根本性的局限性：(1)它们会密集地建模特征之间的依赖关系，从而引入虚假的相关性；(2)它们假设特征之间的关系是静态的，而忽略了这些依赖关系如何随着特征值的变化而变化。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了SAGE这一基于大语言模型的新型生成框架。该框架采用稀疏且动态的依赖指导机制，将特征离散化为具有价值感知的伪特征，并构建基于互信息的稀疏依赖图。该图通过显式的上下文选择或隐式的逻辑回归校正来自适应地指导生成过程，使得大语言模型在合成过程中能够专注于真正相关的信息。我们在六个数据集和多个任务上的广泛实验表明，SAGE不仅提高了数据的真实性和下游应用效果，其F1分数比以往基于大语言模型的方法高出10%，同时还减少了政策违规的情况。这些结果凸显了在表格数据生成中自适应结构的重要性，并为大语言模型中的上下文敏感控制提供了新的见解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mask-to-Correct^+: Leveraging Retriever Diversity for Masking-guided Faithful Fact Correction
papers.title_zh: 掩蔽校正法：利用检索器的多样性来实现基于掩蔽的精确事实修正
papers.authors: Payel Santra, Lavisha Sharma, Madhusudan Ghosh, Partha Basuchowdhuri
papers.abstract: The rapid spread of misinformation on social media highlights the need for robust, automated fact correction frameworks. However, existing works rely on supervised learning from manually annotated claim-evidence pairs, which are scarce and prone to biases, limiting their generalization across domains. Moreover, these methods overlook semantic faithfulness in their correction process. To address these challenges, we propose Mask-to-Correct (M_2C), a training-free, inference-only Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) based framework that leverages diversity-aware masking to identify erroneous spans of claims and evaluate the faithfulness of corrections using retrieved evidence. However, the effectiveness of RAG heavily depends on the choice of retriever, which may vary across queries. To mitigate this, we further introduce M_2C^+, an ensemble-based framework that combines corrections across multiple rankers to reduce retrieval bias and improve robustness. Extensive experiments on the benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed frameworks consistently outperform all baselines, achieving up to 14% improvement in SARI scores, without using gold evidence.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体上错误信息的迅速传播凸显了建立强大、自动化的事实修正框架的必要性。然而，现有的方法依赖于从手动标注的声明-证据对中进行监督学习，而这些标注数据十分稀缺且容易受到偏见的影响，这限制了这些方法在不同领域的泛化能力。此外，这些方法在修正过程中忽视了语义的准确性问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Mask-to-Correct（M_2C）框架——这是一个无需训练的、仅基于推理的检索增强生成框架。该框架利用多样性感知的遮罩技术来识别错误的声明片段，并通过检索到的证据来评估修正的准确性。不过，RAG的有效性在很大程度上取决于检索器的选择，而不同查询可能需要使用不同的检索器。为了缓解这一问题，我们进一步提出了M_2C^+框架——这是一个基于集成方法的框架，它结合了多个检索器的修正结果，以减少检索偏差并提高模型的鲁棒性。在基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们提出的框架始终优于所有基线方法，在不使用真实证据的情况下，SARI分数提升了高达14%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Native Hybrid Attention for Efficient Sequence Modeling
papers.title_zh: 原生混合注意力机制：用于高效序列建模的技术
papers.authors: Jusen Du, Jiaxi Hu, Zhang Tao, Weigao Sun, Yu Cheng
papers.abstract: Transformers excel at sequence modeling but face quadratic complexity, while linear attention offers improved efficiency but often compromises recall accuracy over long contexts. In this work, we introduce Native Hybrid Attention (NHA), a novel hybrid architecture of linear and full attention that integrates both intra inter-layer hybridization into a unified layer design. NHA maintains long-term context in key–value slots updated by a linear RNN, and augments them with short-term tokens from a sliding window. A single softmax attention operation is then applied over all keys and values, enabling per-token and per-head context-dependent weighting without requiring additional fusion parameters. The inter-layer behavior is controlled through a single hyperparameter, the sliding window size, which allows smooth adjustment between purely linear and full attention while keeping all layers structurally uniform. Experimental results show that NHA surpasses Transformers and other hybrid baselines on recall-intensive and commonsense reasoning tasks. Furthermore, pretrained LLMs can be structurally hybridized with NHA, achieving competitive accuracy while delivering significant efficiency gains. Code is available at https://github.com/JusenD/NHA.
papers.abstract_zh: Transformer模型在序列建模方面表现出色，但面临二次复杂度的问题。而线性注意力机制则能提升效率，但往往会在处理长上下文时牺牲召回率。在这项研究中，我们提出了Native Hybrid Attention（NHA）这一新型混合架构，它将线性注意力与全注意力相结合，实现了层内层的深度融合。NHA通过线性RNN来维护键值槽中的长期上下文信息，同时利用滑动窗口获取短期信息来补充这些长期信息。随后，对所有键和值进行单一的softmax注意力计算，从而实现每个标记和每个头部都具备上下文依赖性的权重分配，而无需额外的融合参数。层间行为的控制通过一个超参数——滑动窗口大小来实现，该参数可以平滑地调整线性注意力与全注意力之间的切换，同时保持所有层的结构一致性。实验结果表明，NHA在需要高召回率的常识推理任务上优于Transformer和其他混合架构的基线模型。此外，预训练的LLM也可以与NHA进行结构上的混合，从而在保持较高准确度的同时，显著提升效率。代码可访问于https://github.com/JusenD/NHA。

papers.title: UniversalRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Corpora of Diverse Modalities and Granularities
papers.title_zh: UniversalRAG：基于多样化模式和细度特征的语料库检索增强生成技术
papers.authors: Woongyeong Yeo, Kangsan Kim, Soyeong Jeong, Jinheon Baek, Sung Ju Hwang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has shown substantial promise in improving factual accuracy by grounding model responses with external knowledge relevant to queries. However, most existing approaches are limited to a text-only corpus, and while recent efforts have extended RAG to other modalities such as images and videos, they typically operate over a single modality-specific corpus. In contrast, real-world queries vary widely in the type of knowledge they require, which a single type of knowledge source cannot address. To address this, we introduce UniversalRAG, an any-to-any RAG framework designed to retrieve and integrate knowledge from heterogeneous sources with diverse modalities and granularities. Specifically, motivated by the observation that forcing all modalities into a unified representation space derived from a single aggregated corpus causes a modality gap, where the retrieval tends to favor items from the same modality as the query, we propose modality-aware routing, which dynamically identifies the most appropriate modality-specific corpus and performs targeted retrieval within it, and further justify its effectiveness with a theoretical analysis. Moreover, beyond modality, we organize each modality into multiple granularity levels, enabling fine-tuned retrieval tailored to the complexity and scope of the query. We validate UniversalRAG on 10 benchmarks of multiple modalities, showing its superiority over various modality-specific and unified baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术在提高事实准确性方面表现出巨大的潜力，因为它可以通过将模型响应与与查询相关的外部知识相结合来实现这一目标。然而，目前大多数方法仅限于纯文本语料库。虽然最近有一些努力将RAG扩展到图像和视频等其他模态，但这些方法通常只针对单一模态的语料库进行操作。相比之下，现实世界中的查询在所需的知识类型上差异很大，而单一类型的知识来源无法满足这种需求。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了UniversalRAG这一通用RAG框架，该框架旨在从各种模态和不同粒度的异构源中检索并整合知识。具体来说，由于观察到将所有模态强制纳入由单一聚合语料库生成的统一表示空间会导致模态间的差距，即检索结果往往更倾向于选择与查询相同模态的内容，因此我们提出了一种基于模态意识的路由机制，该机制能够动态识别最合适的特定模态的语料库，并在其中进行有针对性的检索。此外，我们还通过理论分析证明了该机制的有效性。更重要的是，除了考虑模态之外，我们还将每个模态划分为多个粒度级别，从而能够根据查询的复杂性和范围进行精细化的检索。我们在10个不同模态的基准测试上对UniversalRAG进行了验证，结果显示其优于各种特定模态的基准模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Crossing the Reward Bridge: Expanding Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards Across Diverse Domains
papers.title_zh: 跨越“奖励之桥”：通过可验证的奖励将强化学习扩展到不同的领域
papers.authors: Yi Su, Dian Yu, Linfeng Song, Juntao Li, Haitao Mi, Zhaopeng Tu, Min Zhang, Dong Yu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been effective on tasks with structured solutions like math and coding, but its reliance on simple, rule-based verifiers creates a fundamental bottleneck. We find their applicability is surprisingly narrow even in structured domains, a limitation that is compounded at scale: rule-based systems can paradoxically degrade in performance as multi-domain, free-form training data increases. To overcome these challenges, we propose a new RLVR framework that uses a generative verifier to provide soft, probabilistic rewards. Our key insight is that powerful LLMs show high agreement with human evaluators when judging answer correctness given a ground-truth reference, allowing us to automate reward generation without costly human annotation. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach. We show that a compact 7B generative reward model can guide a 7B policy model to decisively outperform models up to 10x its size, including the 72B Qwen2.5-Instruct (by a margin of +8.6%). This effectiveness is robust, holding true across diverse training datasets with answers sourced from experts, web users, and other LLMs, and generalizes strongly to seven out-of-distribution benchmarks. Our work provides a scalable and effective framework for extending RLVR beyond the limitations of pattern-based verification to complex, noisy, real-world domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在具有结构化解决方案的任务中表现良好，比如数学和编程领域。然而，这种学习方法依赖于简单的、基于规则的验证方式，这构成了一个根本性的瓶颈。我们发现，即使在结构化领域中，RLVR的适用性也相当有限，而且这种局限性在大规模应用中会更加明显：随着多领域、自由形式训练数据的增加，基于规则的系统性能反而会下降。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种新的RLVR框架，该框架使用生成式验证器来提供软性、概率性的奖励。我们的关键发现是，强大的大语言模型在判断答案正确性时，与人类评估者有着高度一致的结果，这使我们能够无需昂贵的人工标注即可自动生成奖励。我们的实验证明了这种方法的有效性。我们发现，一个仅包含70亿参数的生成式奖励模型，就能引导一个同样拥有70亿参数的策略模型，其性能可以远远超过那些规模达10倍甚至更大的模型，包括那个拥有720亿参数的Qwen2.5-Instruct模型，优势高达+8.6%。这种有效性是稳健的，即使在不同的训练数据集上也能得到验证，这些数据集中的答案来自专家、网络用户以及其他大语言模型。此外，该方法还能很好地适用于七种非分布式的基准测试场景。我们的工作为扩展RLVR提供了一个可扩展且有效的框架，使其能够突破基于模式的验证方式的限制，从而应用于复杂、嘈杂的现实世界领域。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From ID to LLM: Rethinking Representation Learning for Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 从身份识别到大型语言模型：重新思考用于推荐的表示学习技术
papers.authors: Song-Li Wu, Zhaocheng Du, Weinan Gan, Jingyi Wang, Xianquan Wang
papers.abstract: Recent studies indicate a fundamental incompatibility between ID representations and language model (LM) representations, as they capture behavioral and semantic spaces respectively. This mismatch leads LM representations to consistently underperform ID representations in recommendation tasks. In this work, we revisit this problem and show, from an information-theoretic perspective, that LLM representations retain all discriminative information in ID representations. Based on this, we introduce a Profile-then-Embedding (PtE) framework for recommendation, consisting of a Profile Stage, in which semantic user and item profiles are generated jointly through LLM-based bidirectional reasoning over user-item interactions, and a Personalized Embedding Stage, which encodes these profiles into task-aligned recommendation embeddings. We demonstrate PtE’s effectiveness across three benchmark datasets, including cold-start and long-tail scenarios, achieving substantial gains in both discriminative and generative recommendation models.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，智能体表示与语言模型表示之间存在根本性的不兼容性，因为它们分别捕捉了行为和语义信息。这种不匹配导致语言模型表示在推荐任务中的表现始终低于智能体表示。在这项研究中，我们重新审视了这个问题，并从信息论的角度证明，大语言模型表示能够保留智能体表示中的所有区分性信息。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种名为“先分析再嵌入”的推荐框架。该框架包括两个阶段：第一阶段是通过基于大语言模型的双向推理来生成用户和物品的语义特征；第二阶段则是将这些特征编码成与任务相关的推荐嵌入。我们在三个基准数据集上验证了该框架的有效性，包括在冷启动和长尾场景下的表现，结果显示该框架在区分性和生成式推荐模型中都取得了显著的提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DMHM: Density-aware Manifold Learning and Hybrid Mahalanobis Energy for LLMs-generated Text Detection
papers.title_zh: DMHM：一种考虑密度因素的流形学习方法，结合混合马氏距离算法用于检测大型语言模型生成的文本
papers.authors: Tianle Liu, Zhiliang Tian, Zhen Huang, Tianlun Liu, Jingyuan Huang, Zhaoning Zhang, Chengcheng Shao, Dongsheng Li
papers.abstract: As the text generated by large language models (LLMs) increasingly resembles human-written text (HWT), detecting LLM-generated text (LGT) is crucial to avoid malicious use of LGT. Recent research treats LGT detection as an out-of-distribution (OOD) detection problem and views HWT as the OOD. However, existing OOD detection methods assume that LGT is a single homogeneous distribution. In practice, LGT exhibits different characteristics under different generation conditions. Text from weaker LLMs tends to form distinct clusters and is easy to detect, whereas text from stronger models significantly overlaps with HWTs and is hard to detect. To address the issue, in this paper, we propose an LGT detection framework based on density-aware manifold learning and the construction of hybrid Mahalanobis energy. We apply density-aware manifold learning with Laplacian smoothness and density regularization in embedding space, amplifying differences between LGT and HWT. We further propose a density-adaptive hybrid Mahalanobis metric that combines global and local covariance via density weighting, enabling adaptation to the manifold-aware embedding space. Finally, based on the metric, we define the distribution energy as a measure of distribution discrepancy, and we employ energy learning and contrastive learning to separate distributions hierarchically, establishing a clear OOD decision boundary. Experiments show that our method outperforms strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型生成的文本越来越接近人类撰写的文本，检测由这些模型生成的文本就变得至关重要，以避免其被恶意使用。近期的研究将文本检测问题视为一种异常检测问题，并将人类撰写的文本视为异常样本。然而，现有的异常检测方法通常假设生成的文本属于单一的分布类型。实际上，不同生成条件下的文本具有不同的特征：来自较弱模型的文本容易形成明显的聚类，因此易于检测；而来自较强模型的文本则与人类撰写的文本有显著的重叠，因此难以检测。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种基于密度感知流形学习的LGT检测框架，并采用了混合马氏距离度量方法。我们在嵌入空间中应用了带有拉普拉斯平滑性和密度正则化的密度感知流形学习技术，从而增强LGT与人类撰写文本之间的差异。此外，我们还提出了一种密度自适应混合马氏距离度量方法，该方法通过密度加权实现了全局与局部协方差的结合，使得模型能够适应流形感知的嵌入空间。最后，基于这种度量方法，我们将分布能量定义为衡量分布差异的指标，并利用能量学习和对比学习来分层区分不同分布，从而建立清晰的异常检测边界。实验结果表明，我们的方法优于现有的强基线算法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Dynamic Emotion and Personality Profiling for Multimodal Deception Detection
papers.title_zh: 用于多模态欺骗检测的动态情绪与个性分析技术
papers.authors: Li Zheng, Yanyi Luo, Hao Fei, Yuzhe Ding, Yujie Huang, Fei Li, Chong Teng, Donghong Ji
papers.abstract: Deception detection is of great significance for ensuring information security and conducting public opinion analysis, with personality factors and emotion cues playing a critical role. However, existing methods lack sample-level dynamic annotations for emotions and personality. In this paper, we propose an innovative multi-model multi-prompt annotation scheme and a strict label quality evaluation standard, and establish a multimodal joint detection dataset DDEP for deception, emotion, and personality. Meanwhile, we propose Rel-DDEP, an adaptive reliability-weighted fusion framework. Our framework quantifies uncertainty by mapping modal features to a high-dimensional Gaussian distribution space. It then performs reliability-weighted fusion and incorporates an alignment module and a sorting constraint module to achieve joint detection of deception, emotion, and personality. Experimental results on the MDPE and DDEP datasets show that our Rel-DDEP significantly outperforms the existing state-of-the-art baseline models in three tasks. The F1 score of the deception detection increases by 2.53%, that of the emotion detection increases by 2.66%, and that of the personality detection increases by 9.30%. The experiments fully verify the necessity of annotating dynamic emotion and personality labels for each sample and the effectiveness of reliability-weighted fusion.
papers.abstract_zh: 欺骗检测对于保障信息安全以及进行舆论分析具有重要意义，其中个性因素和情绪线索起着关键作用。然而，现有的方法在情绪和个性的标注上缺乏样本级别的动态标注。在本文中，我们提出了一种创新的多模型多提示标注方案，并制定了严格的标签质量评估标准。同时，我们还提出了Rel-DDEP这一自适应可靠性加权融合框架。我们的框架通过将模态特征映射到高维高斯分布空间来量化不确定性，然后进行可靠性加权融合，并加入对齐模块和排序约束模块以实现对欺骗、情绪和个性的联合检测。在MDPE和DDEP数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的Rel-DDEP在三个任务中的表现均优于现有的最先进基线模型。欺骗检测的F1分数提高了2.53%，情绪检测的F1分数提高了2.66%，而个性检测的F1分数则提高了9.30%。这些实验充分证明了为每个样本标注动态情绪和个性标签的必要性，以及可靠性加权融合的有效性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can We Predict Before Executing Machine Learning Agents?
papers.title_zh: 我们能否在执行机器学习代理之前进行预测？
papers.authors: Jingsheng Zheng, Jintian Zhang, Yujie Luo, Yuren Mao, Yunjun Gao, Lun Du, Huajun Chen, Ningyu Zhang
papers.abstract: Autonomous machine learning agents have revolutionized scientific discovery, yet they remain constrained by a Generate-Execute-Feedback paradigm. Previous approaches suffers from a severe Execution Bottleneck, as hypothesis evaluation relies strictly on expensive physical execution. To bypass these physical constraints, we internalize execution priors to substitute costly runtime checks with instantaneous predictive reasoning, drawing inspiration from World Models. In this work, we formalize the task of Data-centric Solution Preference and construct a comprehensive corpus of 18,438 pairwise comparisons. We demonstrate that LLMs exhibit significant predictive capabilities when primed with a Verified Data Analysis Report, achieving 61.5% accuracy and robust confidence calibration. Finally, we instantiate this framework in ForeAgent, an agent that employs a Predict-then-Verify loop, achieving a 6x acceleration in convergence while surpassing execution-based baselines by +6%.
papers.abstract_zh: 自主机器学习智能体已经彻底改变了科学发现的方式，但它们仍然受到“生成-执行-反馈”模式的限制。以往的方法存在严重的执行瓶颈问题，因为假设评估完全依赖于昂贵的物理执行过程。为了突破这些物理限制，我们引入了执行先验知识，用即时的预测推理替代了耗时的运行时检查，这一方法借鉴了世界模型的思想。在这项研究中，我们将以数据为中心的解决方案偏好任务形式化，并构建了一个包含18,438对比较结果的综合数据集。我们的研究表明，当LLM被赋予经过验证的数据分析报告时，它们能够展现出显著的预测能力，准确率达到61.5%，并且具有稳定的置信度校准能力。最后，我们在ForeAgent中实现了这一框架，该智能体采用了预测-验证循环机制，使得收敛速度提高了6倍，同时其性能也比基于执行的基线方法提升了6%。

papers.title: IMPACT: Importance-Aware Activation Space Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: 影响：考虑重要性的激活空间重构
papers.authors: Md Mokarram Chowdhury, Daniel Agyei Asante, Ernie Chang, Yang Li
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse domains but remain difficult to deploy in resource-constrained environments due to their size. Low-rank compression is a common remedy, typically minimizing weight reconstruction error under the assumption that weights are low-rank. However, this assumption often does not hold in LLMs. In contrast, LLM activations exhibit a more pronounced low-rank structure, motivating approaches that minimize activation reconstruction error.This shift alone, however, is not sufficient: different activation dimensions contribute unequally to model performance, and treating them uniformly can lead to accuracy loss. We introduce IMPACT, an importance-aware activation reconstruction framework that links compression to its effect on model performance. IMPACT formulates compression as an optimization problem that integrates activation structure with gradient-based importance, deriving a closed-form solution where reconstruction bases arise from an importance-weighted activation covariance matrix. This yields low-rank compression explicitly optimized for accuracy preservation. Experiments across multiple models and tasks demonstrate that IMPACT achieves up to 55.4% greater model size reduction while maintaining accuracy comparable to or better than state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多个领域都表现出强大的性能，但由于其庞大的规模，在资源有限的环境中部署仍然非常困难。低秩压缩是一种常见的解决方案，它通常是在假设权重具有低秩的情况下，最小化权重重构误差。然而，这种假设在语言模型中往往不成立。相比之下，语言模型的激活函数表现出更为明显的低秩结构，这促使人们提出了一些方法来最小化激活重构误差。然而，仅仅改变这种结构是不够的：不同的激活维度对模型性能的贡献是不均匀的，如果采用统一的处理方式，可能会导致准确性下降。我们提出了IMPACT框架，这是一个注重重要性的激活重构框架，它将压缩技术与模型性能的影响相结合。IMPACT将压缩问题转化为一个优化问题，该问题将激活结构与基于梯度的重要性结合起来，从而得出一个封闭形式的解决方案，其中重构基来自于一个基于重要性加权的激活协方差矩阵。这样就能实现针对准确性进行优化的低秩压缩。通过多种模型和任务的实验表明，IMPACT在保持与最先进基线相当或更好的准确性的同时，能够将模型大小减少高达55.4%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SOS-LoRA: Static Orthogonal-Subspace Low-Rank Adaptation with Fixed Multi-Scale Scaling
papers.title_zh: SOS-LoRA：静态正交子空间低秩适应算法，采用固定的多尺度缩放方法
papers.authors: Yupeng Chang, Yuan Wu, Yi Chang
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method for large language models. Under a fixed rank budget, LoRA parameterizes each adapted weight through a single low-dimensional input-side pathway, which may couple heterogeneous behaviors through shared input directions and induce interference during optimization. We propose Static Orthogonal Subspace LoRA (SOS-LoRA), a drop-in extension that reparameterizes a rank-r_{\text{tot}} update as a sum of K static (always-on, non-routed) low-rank experts. SOS-LoRA (i) decomposes the total rank across experts, (ii) applies a fixed multi-scale scaling scheme to encourage scale-separated optimization dynamics, and (iii) promotes diverse input-side directions via cross-expert orthogonal initialization and a lightweight regularizer. SOS-LoRA remains fully mergeable, adding no inference-time parameters or latency after merging. Experiments on reasoning and knowledge-intensive benchmarks (Llama 2/3), encoder-based NLU (GLUE), and math reasoning (GSM8K/MATH) show consistent gains over matched-budget LoRA baselines and recent variants.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）是一种广泛应用于大语言模型的参数高效微调方法。在固定的秩预算下，LoRA通过单一的低维输入侧路径来参数化每个适应的权重，这可能会通过共享的输入方向使不同行为相互耦合，并在优化过程中产生干扰。我们提出了静态正交子空间LoRA（SOS-LoRA），这是一种可无缝替换的扩展方法，它将秩为r_{\text{tot}}的更新重新参数化为K个静态（始终开启、无路由约束）低秩专家的贡献之和。SOS-LoRA能够分解各专家的总秩；(ii) 采用固定的多尺度缩放方案，以促进不同尺度的优化过程；(iii) 通过跨专家的正交初始化和轻量级正则化器，促进多样化的输入侧方向。SOS-LoRA可以完全合并，合并后不会增加任何推理时间参数或延迟。在推理和知识密集型基准测试（如Llama 2/3）、基于编码器的自然语言理解任务（GLUE）以及数学推理任务（GSM8K/MATH）上的实验表明，SOS-LoRA在性能上优于相同预算下的LoRA基线及近期出现的变体。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SDiaReward: Modeling and Benchmarking Spoken Dialogue Rewards with Modality and Colloquialness
papers.title_zh: SDiaReward：基于模态和口语化特征的语音对话奖励建模与对比分析
papers.authors: Jingyu Lu, Yuhan Wang, Fan Zhuo, Xize Cheng, Changhao Pan, Xueyi Pu, Yifu Chen, Chenyuhao Wen, Tianle Liang, Zhou Zhao
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of end-to-end spoken dialogue systems demands transcending mere textual semantics to incorporate paralinguistic nuances and the spontaneous nature of human conversation. However, current methods struggle with two critical gaps: the modality gap, involving prosody and emotion, and the colloquialness gap, distinguishing written scripts from natural speech. To address these challenges, we introduce SDiaReward, an end-to-end multi-turn reward model trained on SDiaReward-Dataset, a novel collection of episode-level preference pairs explicitly targeting these gaps. It operates directly on full multi-turn speech episodes and is optimized with pairwise preference supervision, enabling joint assessment of modality and colloquialness in a single evaluator. We further establish ESDR-Bench, a stratified benchmark for robust episode-level evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that SDiaReward achieves state-of-the-art pairwise preference accuracy, significantly outperforming general-purpose audio LLMs. Further analysis suggests that SDiaReward captures relative conversational expressiveness beyond superficial synthesis cues, improving generalization across domains and recording conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 端到端语音对话系统的快速发展要求超越单纯的文本语义，融入副语言细微差别以及人类对话的即兴特性。然而，当前的方法在两个方面存在关键缺陷：一是模态差异问题，涉及韵律和情绪；二是口语化问题，即如何将书面脚本与自然语音区分开来。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SDiaReward——一种端到端的多轮奖励模型，该模型基于SDiaReward数据集进行训练。该数据集专门收集了针对这些问题的偏好对样本。SDiaReward可以直接处理完整的多轮语音片段，并通过成对偏好监督进行优化，从而能够在单一评估器中同时评估模态和口语化特征。我们还建立了ESDR-Bench这一分层基准测试平台，用于进行全面的篇章级评估。实验表明，SDiaReward在成对偏好识别方面达到了最先进的水平，其性能显著优于通用的音频语言模型。进一步分析表明，SDiaReward能够捕捉到相对复杂的对话表达性，而不仅仅是表面的合成线索，从而在不同领域和录音条件下都能实现更好的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Looking at Radiology Report Generation through a Causal Lens: A Survey
papers.title_zh: 从因果关系的角度审视放射科报告生成：一项调查
papers.authors: Satyam Kumar, Kaustubh Shivshankar Shejole, Pushpak Bhattacharyya
papers.abstract: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) has emerged as a promising approach to reduce clinicians’ workload, yet existing systems are vulnerable to biases induced by spurious correlations across data, models, and evaluation pipelines. Such biases raise serious fairness concerns and may adversely affect patient care, making their mitigation critical in clinical settings. Leveraging causal inference to identify true cause-effect relationships can mitigate many biases and yield fair, reliable systems with clinically meaningful outputs. Existing surveys on RRG primarily emphasize deep learning approaches while overlooking the critical role of causality. This survey addresses this gap by analyzing bias across the RRG pipeline, formalizing RRG as a causal modeling problem, and reviewing representative causal techniques from the literature. Based on the level of intervention, we organize existing mitigation strategies into a three-tier taxonomy. We further examine commonly used public medical imaging datasets and evaluation metrics through a causal lens, revealing their biases and limitations in capturing causal alignment and clinical fidelity. To address these limitations, we advocate broader demographic coverage and causal-aware evaluation metrics to improve fairness and reliability, and identify important directions for future work.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动放射学报告生成技术已成为减轻临床医生工作负担的有效方法。然而，现有的系统容易受到数据、模型以及评估流程中虚假相关性带来的偏见影响。这种偏见会引发严重的公平性问题，并可能对患者护理产生不利影响，因此在这些场景中消除这些偏见至关重要。利用因果推断来识别真正的因果关系，可以消除许多偏见，从而构建出公平、可靠且具有临床意义的系统。目前关于自动放射学报告生成的研究大多集中在深度学习方法上，而忽视了因果关系的核心作用。本综述通过分析自动放射学报告生成过程中的各种偏见，将自动放射学报告生成问题明确为因果建模问题，并回顾了相关文献中的代表性因果技术。根据干预程度的不同，我们将现有的缓解策略分为三个层次进行分类。我们还从因果的角度审视了常用的公共医学影像数据集和评估指标，发现它们在捕捉因果关联性和临床准确性方面存在偏见和局限性。为了克服这些限制，我们建议采用更广泛的人群覆盖范围和更加考虑因果关系的评估指标，以提高系统的公平性和可靠性，并为未来的研究工作指明重要方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CTTA-T: Continual Test-Time Adaptation for Text Understanding via Teacher-Student with a Domain-aware and Generalized Teacher
papers.title_zh: CTTA-T：通过教师与学生之间的互动来实现持续性的文本理解能力调整，该系统具有领域感知能力，并且其算法具有通用性
papers.authors: Tianlun Liu, Zhiliang Tian, Zhen Huang, Xingzhi Zhou, Wanlong Yu, Tianle Liu, Feng Liu, Dongsheng Li
papers.abstract: Text understanding application often suffers from domain shifts. To handle testing domains, domain adaptation (DA) is trained to adapt to a fixed and observed testing domain; a more challenging paradigm, test-time adaptation (TTA), cannot access the testing domain during training and online adapts to the testing samples during testing, where the samples are from a fixed domain. We aim to explore a more practical and underexplored scenario, continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) for text understanding, which involves a sequence of testing (unobserved) domains in testing. Current CTTA methods struggle in reducing error accumulation over domains and enhancing generalization to handle unobserved domains: 1) Noise-filtering reduces accumulated errors but discards useful information, and 2) accumulating historical domains enhances generalization, but it is hard to achieve adaptive accumulation. In this paper, we propose a CTTA-T (continual test-time adaptation for text understanding) framework adaptable to evolving target domains: CTTA-T adopts a teacher-student framework, where the teacher is equipped with domain awareness and generalization for evolving domains. To improve teacher predictions, we propose a refine-then-filter based on dropout-driven consistency, which calibrates predictions and removes unreliable guidance. For the adaptation–generalization trade-off, we construct a domain-aware teacher by dynamically accumulating cross-domain semantics via incremental PCA, which continuously tracks domain shifts. Experiments show CTTA-T excels baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本理解应用常常面临领域变化的问题。为了处理测试领域，人们训练了领域适应算法，使其能够适应已经观测到的测试领域；而更具挑战性的测试时适应算法则无法在训练过程中访问测试领域，而是在测试过程中根据测试样本进行自适应调整，这些测试样本来自固定的领域。我们旨在探索一种更实用且尚未充分研究的场景——持续测试时适应算法，该算法涉及一系列在测试过程中出现的（未观测到的）领域。目前的持续测试时适应算法在减少跨领域的误差积累以及提高对未观测领域的泛化能力方面存在困难：1）噪声过滤可以减少累积误差，但会丢失有用的信息；2）积累历史领域数据可以提高泛化能力，但实现自适应积累却很困难。在本文中，我们提出了一种持续测试时适应算法框架，该框架能够适应不断变化的目标领域。该框架采用了师生模式，其中教师具备对不断变化领域的感知能力和泛化能力。为了改进教师的预测效果，我们提出了一种基于dropout驱动的一致性机制的精细化处理与过滤策略，该策略可以校准预测结果并去除不可靠的引导信息。对于适应性与泛化能力的权衡问题，我们通过增量PCA动态积累跨领域的语义信息，从而持续跟踪领域的变化。实验结果表明，持续测试时适应算法在性能上优于传统方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Adam’s Law: Textual Frequency Law on Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 亚当定律：大型语言模型中的文本频率规律
papers.authors: Hongyuan Lu, Zixuan Li, Zefan Zhang, Bowen Cao, Wai Lam
papers.abstract: While textual frequency has been validated as relevant to human cognition in reading speed, its relatedness to Large Language Models (LLMs) is seldom studied. We propose a novel research direction in terms of textual data frequency, which is an understudied topic. to the best of our knowledge. Our framework is composed of three units. First, this paper proposes Textual Frequency Law (TFL), which indicates that frequent textual data should be preferred for LLMs for both prompting and fine-tuning. Since many LLMs are closed-source in their training data, we propose using online resources to estimate the sentence-level frequency. We can then use an input paraphraser to paraphrase the input into a more frequent textual expression. Next, we propose Textual Frequency Distillation (TFD) by querying LLMs to conduct story completion by further extending the sentences in the datasets, and the resulting corpora are used to adjust the initial estimation. Finally, we propose Curriculum Textual Frequency Training (CTFT) that fine-tunes LLMs in an increasing order of sentence-level frequency. Experiments are conducted on our curated dataset Textual Frequency Paired Dataset (TFPD) on math reasoning and machine translation. Results indicate the effectiveness of our framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然文本频率已被证实与人类阅读速度的认知有关，但其与大语言模型的相关性却很少被研究。我们提出了一种关于文本数据频率的新研究方向，这一领域目前尚未得到充分研究。据我们所知，我们的框架由三个部分组成。首先，本文提出了文本频率法则，该法则指出在提示和微调过程中，应优先使用频率较高的文本数据。由于许多大语言模型的训练数据都是闭源资源，因此我们建议利用在线资源来估算句子级别的频率。然后，我们可以使用输入释义器将输入文本转化为频率更高的表达形式。接下来，我们提出了文本频率蒸馏技术，通过向大语言模型发起查询，以完成故事内容的补充工作，从而进一步扩展数据集中的句子内容。最后，我们提出了课程式文本频率训练方法，该方法按照句子级别的频率递增顺序对大语言模型进行微调。我们在精心挑选的数学推理和机器翻译数据集上进行了实验，结果表明我们的框架是有效的。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
