papers.title: Disco-RAG: Discourse-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 话语感知的检索增强生成：通过检索机制来提升生成文本的质量
papers.authors: Dongqi Liu, Hang Ding, Qiming Feng, Xurong Xie, Zhucun Xue, Chengjie Wang, Jian Li, Jiangning Zhang, Yabiao Wang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as an important means of enhancing the performance of large language models (LLMs) in knowledge-intensive tasks. However, most existing RAG strategies treat retrieved passages in a flat and unstructured way, which prevents the model from capturing structural cues and constrains its ability to synthesize knowledge from dispersed evidence across documents. To overcome these limitations, we propose Disco-RAG, a discourse-aware framework that explicitly injects discourse signals into the generation process. Our method constructs intra-chunk discourse trees to capture local hierarchies and builds inter-chunk rhetorical graphs to model cross-passage coherence. These structures are jointly integrated into a planning blueprint that conditions the generation. Experiments on question answering and long-document summarization benchmarks show the efficacy of our approach. Disco-RAG achieves state-of-the-art results on the benchmarks without fine-tuning. These findings underscore the important role of discourse structure in advancing RAG systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为提升大语言模型在知识密集型任务中性能的重要手段。然而，目前大多数RAG策略都是以一种扁平且无结构的方式处理检索到的段落，这限制了模型捕捉结构线索的能力，也制约了模型从文档中的分散信息中提取知识的能力。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了Disco-RAG这一注重话语结构的框架，该框架能够明确地将话语信号融入生成过程。我们的方法通过构建段落内的话语树来捕捉局部层次结构，并通过构建段落间的修辞图来模拟跨段落的连贯性。这些结构被整合到一个规划模型中，以指导生成过程。在问答和长文档总结方面的实验表明，我们的方法具有高效性。Disco-RAG能够在无需微调的情况下取得最先进的实验结果。这些发现凸显了话语结构在改进RAG系统中的重要作用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Stable Language Guidance for Vision–Language–Action Models
papers.title_zh: 适用于视觉-语言-动作模型的稳定语言指导机制
papers.authors: Zhihao Zhan, Yuhao Chen, Jiaying Zhou, Qinhan Lyu, Hao Liu, Keze Wang, Liang Lin, Guangrun Wang
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generalized robotic control; however, they remain notoriously brittle to linguistic perturbations. We identify a critical "modality collapse” phenomenon where strong visual priors overwhelm sparse linguistic signals, causing agents to overfit to specific instruction phrasings while ignoring the underlying semantic intent. To address this, we propose Residual Semantic Steering (RSS), a probabilistic framework that disentangles physical affordance from semantic execution. RSS introduces two theoretical innovations: (1) Monte Carlo Syntactic Integration, which approximates the true semantic posterior via dense, LLM-driven distributional expansion, and (2) Residual Affordance Steering, a dual-stream decoding mechanism that explicitly isolates the causal influence of language by subtracting the visual affordance prior. Theoretical analysis suggests that RSS effectively maximizes the mutual information between action and intent while suppressing visual distractors. Empirical results across diverse manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that RSS achieves state-of-the-art robustness, maintaining performance even under adversarial linguistic perturbations.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人控制方面展现出了令人印象深刻的性能；然而，它们对语言干扰的敏感性却一直备受关注。我们发现了一个关键的“模态崩溃”现象：强大的视觉先验会掩盖稀少的语言信号，导致智能体过度拟合于特定的指令表述，而忽略了潜在的语义意图。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了残差语义引导（RSS）这一概率框架。该框架将物理可操作性与语义执行分离开来。RSS包含两个理论创新点：（1）蒙特卡洛句法整合，通过密集的、由大语言模型驱动的分布扩展来近似真实的语义后验；（2）残差可操作性引导，这是一种双流解码机制，通过减去视觉可操作性的先验来明确分离语言的因果影响。理论分析表明，RSS能够有效最大化动作与意图之间的互信息，同时抑制视觉干扰因素。在多种操控基准测试中的实证结果表明，RSS具备出色的鲁棒性，即使在受到语言干扰的情况下也能保持高性能。

papers.title: Controlling Multimodal Conversational Agents with Coverage-Enhanced Latent Actions
papers.title_zh: 利用增强覆盖能力的潜行动来控制多模态对话代理
papers.authors: Yongqi Li, Hao Lang, Tieyun Qian, Yongbin Li
papers.abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly employed as multimodal conversational agents (MCAs) for diverse conversational tasks. Recently, reinforcement learning (RL) has been widely explored for adapting MCAs to various human-AI interaction scenarios. Despite showing great enhancement in generalization performance, fine-tuning MCAs via RL still faces challenges in handling the extremely large text token space. To address this, we learn a compact latent action space for RL fine-tuning instead. Specifically, we adopt the learning from observation mechanism to construct the codebook for the latent action space, where future observations are leveraged to estimate current latent actions that could further be used to reconstruct future observations. However, the scarcity of paired image-text data hinders learning a codebook with sufficient coverage. Thus, we leverage both paired image-text data and text-only data to construct the latent action space, using a cross-modal projector for transforming text embeddings into image-text embeddings. We initialize the cross-modal projector on paired image-text data, and further train it on massive text-only data with a novel cycle consistency loss to enhance its robustness. We show that our latent action based method outperforms competitive baselines on two conversation tasks across various RL algorithms. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/DAMO-ConvAI/tree/main/MMLatentAction.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型被越来越多地用于多模态对话代理，以处理各种对话任务。最近，强化学习被广泛应用于使对话代理适应各种人机交互场景。尽管强化学习在泛化性能上取得了显著提升，但通过强化学习来微调对话代理在处理庞大的文本令牌空间时仍然存在挑战。为了应对这一问题，我们采用了一种紧凑的潜在动作空间来进行强化学习微调。具体来说，我们采用从观测中学习的方法来构建潜在动作空间的代码簿，利用未来的观测数据来估计当前的潜在动作，进而用于重建未来的观测数据。然而，由于图像-文本数据的稀缺性，很难构建一个具有足够覆盖范围的代码簿。因此，我们同时利用图像-文本数据和纯文本数据来构建潜在动作空间，并使用跨模态投影器将文本嵌入转换为图像-文本嵌入。我们将跨模态投影器初始化为基于图像-文本数据的模型，然后在此基础上进一步训练它，使用一种新的循环一致性损失函数来增强其鲁棒性。我们的研究表明，基于潜在动作的方法在两种对话任务上的表现优于其他竞争基线方法，这些任务涉及多种强化学习算法。代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/DAMO-ConvAI/tree/main/MMLatentAction下载。

papers.title: Guaranteeing Knowledge Integration with Joint Decoding for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 确保知识整合与联合解码的结合，以实现基于检索增强的生成技术
papers.authors: Zhengyi Zhao, Shubo Zhang, Zezhong Wang, Yuxi Zhang, Huimin Wang, Yutian Zhao, Yefeng Zheng, Binyang Li, Kam-Fai Wong, Xian Wu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by providing access to external knowledge. However, current research primarily focuses on retrieval quality, often overlooking the critical ”integration bottleneck”: even when relevant documents are retrieved, LLMs frequently fail to utilize them effectively due to conflicts with their internal parametric knowledge. In this paper, we argue that implicitly resolving this conflict in a single generation pass is suboptimal. We introduce GuarantRAG, a framework that explicitly decouples reasoning from evidence integration. First, we generate an ”Inner-Answer” based solely on parametric knowledge to capture the model’s reasoning flow. Second, to guarantee faithful evidence extraction, we generate a ”Refer-Answer” using a novel Contrastive DPO objective. This objective treats the parametric Inner-Answer as a negative constraint and the retrieved documents as positive ground truth, forcing the model to suppress internal hallucinations in favor of external evidence during this phase. Finally, rather than naive concatenation or using the DPO trained model directly, we propose a joint decoding mechanism that dynamically fuses the logical coherence of the Inner-Answer with the factual precision of the Refer-Answer at the token level. Experiments on five QA benchmarks demonstrate that GuarantRAG improves accuracy by up to 12.1% and reduces hallucinations by 16.3% compared to standard and dynamic RAG baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过提供对外部知识的访问能力，显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）的性能。然而，当前的研究主要集中在检索质量上，而忽略了至关重要的“集成瓶颈”：即使检索到了相关文档，由于与模型内部的参数化知识发生冲突，LLM往往无法有效利用这些文档。在本文中，我们认为在单次生成过程中隐式解决这种冲突是不理想的。我们提出了GuarantRAG框架，该框架明确地将推理与证据整合分离开来。首先，我们仅基于参数化知识生成“内部答案”，以捕捉模型的推理流程。其次，为了确保证据的准确提取，我们使用一种新颖的对比度DPO目标来生成“参考答案”。该目标将参数化的内部答案视为负面约束条件，而将检索到的文档视为正面真实值，从而迫使模型在这个阶段抑制内部幻觉，转而依赖外部证据。最后，我们提出了一种联合解码机制，该机制在令牌级别动态融合内部答案的逻辑连贯性与参考答案的事实准确性。在五个问答基准测试中的实验表明，与标准和动态RAG基线相比，GuarantRAG的准确率提高了12.1%，幻觉率降低了16.3%。

papers.title: Are Emotion and Rhetoric Neurons in LLM? Neuron Recognition and Adaptive Masking for Emotion-Rhetoric Prediction Steering
papers.title_zh: 情感和修辞因素是否也是大型语言模型中的神经元？利用神经元识别技术以及自适应掩蔽方法来实现情感和修辞因素的预测与指导
papers.authors: Li Zheng, Xin Zhang, Shuyi He, Fei Li, Chong Teng, Jiang-Ming Yang, Donghong Ji, Zhuang Li
papers.abstract: Accurate comprehension and controllable generation of emotion and rhetoric are pivotal for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Existing studies mostly rely on external optimizations, lacking in-depth exploration of internal representation mechanisms, thus failing to achieve fine-grained steering at the neuron level. A handful of works on neurons are confined to emotions, neglecting rhetoric neurons and their intrinsic connections. Traditional neuron masking also exhibits counterintuitive phenomena, making reliable verification of neuron functionality infeasible. To address these issues, we systematically investigate the neurons representation mechanisms and inherent associations of 6 emotion categories and 4 core rhetorical devices. We propose a neuron identification framework that integrates multi-dimensional screening, and design an adaptive masking method incorporating dynamic filtering, attenuation masking, and feedback optimization, enabling reliable functional validation of neuron functionality. Through neuron regulation, we achieve directed induction of non-target sentences and enhancement of emotion tasks via rhetoric neurons. Experiments on 5 commonly used datasets validate the effectiveness of our method, providing a novel paradigm for the fine-grained steering of emotion and rhetoric expressions in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确理解并可控地生成情感和修辞表达，对于提升大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力至关重要。现有的研究大多依赖于外部优化手段，缺乏对内部表征机制的深入探索，因此无法在神经元层面实现精细的引导控制。少数关于神经元的研究仅局限于情感领域，而忽略了修辞神经元及其内在联系。传统的神经元掩蔽方法还会产生反直觉的现象，使得验证神经元功能变得不可行。为了解决这些问题，我们系统地研究了6种情感类别和4种核心修辞手法的神经元表征机制及其内在关联。我们提出了一种神经元识别框架，该框架结合了多维筛选技术，并设计了自适应掩蔽方法，该方法包含动态过滤、衰减掩蔽以及反馈优化等机制，从而能够可靠地验证神经元的功能性。通过神经元调控，我们能够有目的地诱导非目标句子的生成，并通过修辞神经元增强情感任务的表达效果。在5个常用数据集上的实验验证了我们的方法的有效性，为LLMs中情感和修辞表达的精细引导提供了一种新的范式。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Towards Fine-Grained and Multi-Granular Contrastive Language-Speech Pre-training
papers.title_zh: 面向细粒度与多层次对比语言语音预训练
papers.authors: Yifan Yang, Bing Han, Hui Wang, Wei Wang, Ziyang Ma, Long Zhou, Zengrui Jin, Guanrou Yang, Tianrui Wang, Xu Tan, Xie Chen
papers.abstract: Modeling fine-grained speaking styles remains challenging for language-speech representation pre-training, as existing speech-text models are typically trained with coarse captions or task-specific supervision, and scalable fine-grained style annotations are unavailable. We present FCaps, a large-scale dataset with fine-grained free-text style descriptions, encompassing 47k hours of speech and 19M fine-grained captions annotated via a novel end-to-end pipeline that directly grounds detailed captions in audio, thereby avoiding the error propagation caused by LLM-based rewriting in existing cascaded pipelines. Evaluations using LLM-as-a-judge demonstrate that our annotations surpass existing cascaded annotations in terms of correctness, coverage, and naturalness. Building on FCaps, we propose CLSP, a contrastive language-speech pre-trained model that integrates global and fine-grained supervision, enabling unified representations across multiple granularities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CLSP learns fine-grained and multi-granular speech-text representations that perform reliably across global and fine-grained speech-text retrieval, zero-shot paralinguistic classification, and speech style similarity scoring, with strong alignment to human judgments. Code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/yfyeung/CLSP.
papers.abstract_zh: 对细粒度说话风格进行建模在语言-语音表示预训练中仍然具有挑战性。因为现有的语音-文本模型通常是通过粗略的标注或特定任务的监督来训练的，而且缺乏可扩展的细粒度风格注释数据。我们提出了FCaps，这是一个大规模数据集，包含详细的自由文本风格描述，涵盖了47千小时的语音数据和1900万条细粒度注释。这些注释是通过一种新颖的端到端流程生成的，该流程直接将详细注释与音频相结合，从而避免了现有级联流程中基于大语言模型的重写所带来的错误传播问题。使用大语言模型作为评判标准进行的评估表明，我们的注释在正确性、覆盖率和自然度方面都优于现有的级联注释。在FCaps的基础上，我们提出了CLSP，这是一种对比式语言-语音预训练模型，它结合了全局和细粒度的监督信息，使得能够在多个粒度级别上实现统一的表示。大量的实验表明，CLSP能够学习出细粒度和多粒度的语音-文本表示，这些表示在全局和细粒度的语音-文本检索、零样本副语言分类以及语音风格相似性评分等方面都能表现出可靠的性能，并且与人类判断高度一致。代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/yfyeung/CLSP上免费获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Are We Using the Right Benchmark: An Evaluation Framework for Visual Token Compression Methods
papers.title_zh: 我们使用的基准是否正确？——一种用于评估视觉令牌压缩方法的框架
papers.authors: Chenfei Liao, Wensong Wang, Zichen Wen, Xu Zheng, Yiyu Wang, Haocong He, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Lutao Jiang, Xin Zou, Yuqian Fu, Bin Ren, Linfeng Zhang, Xuming Hu
papers.abstract: Recent efforts to accelerate inference in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have largely focused on visual token compression. The effectiveness of these methods is commonly evaluated by measuring the accuracy drop on existing MLLM benchmarks before and after compression. However, these benchmarks are originally designed to assess general perception and reasoning abilities, rather than the specific challenges posed by visual token compression, leading to a fundamental task mismatch. In this work, we uncover a counterintuitive yet consistent phenomenon: simple image downsampling outperforms many advanced visual token compression methods across multiple widely used benchmarks. Through a comprehensive empirical study spanning eight popular benchmarks and multiple state-of-the-art compression techniques, we show that (i) current benchmarks contain substantial noise (task-irrelevant samples) for evaluating visual token compression, and (ii) downsampling can act as an effective data filter that distinguishes between simple and difficult samples with respect to compression sensitivity. Motivated by these findings, we propose VTC-Bench, an evaluation framework that explicitly leverages downsampling as a discriminator to denoise existing benchmarks, enabling a fairer and more meaningful additional assessment of visual token compression methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在加速多模态大语言模型推理方面的努力，主要集中在视觉令牌压缩上。这些方法的有效性通常是通过测量压缩前后现有MLLM基准测试中的准确率下降来评估的。然而，这些基准测试最初是为了评估一般的感知和推理能力而设计的，而不是针对视觉令牌压缩所带来的特定挑战，这就导致了任务设计上的不匹配。在这项研究中，我们发现了一个反直觉但一致的现象：简单的图像下采样在许多广泛使用的基准测试中，其效果优于许多先进的视觉令牌压缩方法。通过一项涵盖八个热门基准测试和多种先进压缩技术的全面实证研究，我们证明了：(i) 当前的基准测试中存在大量噪声（与任务无关的样本），这会影响对视觉令牌压缩效果的评估；(ii) 下采样可以作为一种有效的数据筛选工具，能够区分简单和复杂的样本，从而判断压缩的敏感性。基于这些发现，我们提出了VTC-Bench这一评估框架，该框架明确利用下采样作为判别器来去除现有基准测试中的噪声，从而更公平、更有意义地评估视觉令牌压缩方法的效果。

papers.title: Retrieval as Generation: A Unified Framework with Self-Triggered Information Planning
papers.title_zh: 以生成为目的的检索：一个包含自触发信息规划的统一框架
papers.authors: Bo Li, Mingda Wang, Gexiang Fang, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
papers.abstract: We revisit retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) by embedding retrieval control directly into generation. Instead of treating retrieval as an external intervention, we express retrieval decisions within token-level decoding, enabling end-to-end coordination without additional controllers or classifiers. Under the paradigm of Retrieval as Generation, we propose GRIP (Generation-guided Retrieval with Information Planning), a unified framework in which the model regulates retrieval behavior through control-token emission. Central to GRIP is Self-Triggered Information Planning, which allows the model to decide when to retrieve, how to reformulate queries, and when to terminate, all within a single autoregressive trajectory. This design tightly couples retrieval and reasoning and supports dynamic multi-step inference with on-the-fly evidence integration. To supervise these behaviors, we construct a structured training set covering answerable, partially answerable, and multi-hop queries, each aligned with specific token patterns. Experiments on five QA benchmarks show that GRIP surpasses strong RAG baselines and is competitive with GPT-4o while using substantially fewer parameters. Code and resources are provided in the supplementary materials.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了基于检索增强的生成技术，通过将检索控制直接融入生成过程。与将检索视为外部干预不同，我们在令牌级解码过程中处理检索决策，从而实现无需额外控制器或分类器的端到端协调。在“以生成为导向的检索”这一理念下，我们提出了GRIP（以生成为导向的检索与信息规划结合），这是一个统一的框架，模型通过控制令牌的发出来调节检索行为。GRIP的核心技术是自触发信息规划，它使模型能够决定何时进行检索、如何重新表述查询以及何时终止检索，所有这些都在一个自回归轨迹中完成。这种设计将检索与推理紧密结合起来，支持动态的多步推理过程，并能够实时整合证据。为了监督这些行为，我们构建了一个结构化的训练集，涵盖了可回答的、部分可回答的以及多跳查询，每个查询都与特定的令牌模式相对应。在五个问答基准测试上的实验表明，GRIP超越了强大的RAG基线算法，并且在参数数量大幅减少的情况下，其性能与GPT-4o相当。相关的代码和资源都包含在补充材料中。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place: The Tension Between Ethical Reasoning and Safety Alignment in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 进退两难：大语言模型中的伦理推理与安全性之间的冲突
papers.authors: Shei Pern Chua, Zhen Leng Thai, Kai Jun Teh, Xiao Li, Qibing Ren, Xiaolin Hu
papers.abstract: Large Language Model safety alignment predominantly operates on a binary assumption that requests are either safe or unsafe. This classification proves insufficient when models encounter ethical dilemmas, where the capacity to reason through moral trade-offs creates a distinct attack surface. We formalize this vulnerability through TRIAL, a multi-turn red-teaming methodology that embeds harmful requests within ethical framings. TRIAL achieves consistently high attack success rates across models by exploiting the model’s own ethical reasoning to frame harmful actions as morally necessary compromises. Building on these insights, we introduce ERR (Ethical Reasoning Robustness), a defense framework that distinguishes between instrumental responses that enable harmful outcomes and explanatory responses that analyze ethical frameworks without endorsing harmful acts. ERR employs a Layer-Stratified Harm-Gated LoRA architecture, achieving robust defense against reasoning-based attacks while preserving model utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的安全对齐通常基于一个二元假设，即请求要么是安全的，要么是不安全的。然而，当模型面临伦理困境时，这种分类方式就变得不够充分了——因为能够推理出道德上的权衡，反而为攻击提供了机会。我们通过TRIAL这一多轮协作方法来形式化这种漏洞，该方法将有害请求纳入到符合伦理的框架中。TRIAL通过利用模型自身的伦理推理能力，将有害行为转化为道德上必要的妥协，从而在不同模型中实现高攻击成功率。在此基础上，我们提出了ERR（伦理推理鲁棒性）防御框架，该框架能够区分那些导致有害结果的工具性反应，以及那些在分析伦理框架的同时不认可有害行为的解释性反应。ERR采用了分层式伤害门控LoRA架构，能够在保护模型实用性的同时，有效抵御基于推理的攻击。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EventWeave: A Dynamic Framework for Capturing Core and Supporting Events in Dialogue Systems
papers.title_zh: EventWeave：一种用于捕捉对话系统中核心事件及辅助事件的动态框架
papers.authors: Zhengyi Zhao, Shubo Zhang, Yiming Du, Bin Liang, Baojun Wang, Zhongyang Li, Binyang Li, Kam-Fai Wong
papers.abstract: Large language models have improved dialogue systems, but often process conversational turns in isolation, overlooking the event structures that guide natural interactions. Hence we introduce EventWeave, a framework that explicitly models relationships between conversational events to generate more contextually appropriate dialogue responses. EventWeave constructs a dynamic event graph that distinguishes between core events (main goals) and supporting events (interconnected details), employing a multi-head attention mechanism to selectively determine which events are most relevant to the current turn. Unlike summarization or standard graph-based approaches, our method captures three distinct relationship types between events, allowing for more nuanced context modeling. Experiments on three dialogue datasets demonstrate that EventWeave produces more natural and contextually appropriate responses while requiring less computational overhead than models processing the entire dialogue history. Ablation studies confirm improvements stem from better event relationship modeling rather than increased information density. Our approach effectively balances comprehensive context understanding with generating concise responses, maintaining strong performance across various dialogue lengths through targeted optimization techniques.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型确实提升了对话系统的性能，但它们通常只处理单个对话轮次，而忽略了引导自然交互的事件结构。因此，我们提出了EventWeave这一框架，该框架能够明确建模对话事件之间的关系，从而生成更具上下文相关性的对话回应。EventWeave构建了一个动态事件图，将核心事件（主要目标）与辅助事件（相互关联的细节）区分开来。通过采用多头注意力机制，我们可以选择性地确定哪些事件与当前轮次最为相关。与摘要处理或传统的基于图的方法不同，我们的方法能够捕捉事件之间的三种不同类型的关系，从而实现更精细的上下文建模。在三个对话数据集上的实验表明，EventWeave能够产生更自然、更符合上下文的回应，同时所需的计算资源也少于那些需要处理整个对话历史的模型。消融研究证实，我们的改进源于更好的事件关系建模，而非信息密度的增加。我们的方法有效地平衡了全面理解上下文与生成简洁回应之间的平衡，并通过有针对性的优化技术，在各种对话长度下都保持了良好的性能。

papers.title: Deliberative Searcher: Improving LLM Reliability via Reinforcement Learning with Constraints
papers.title_zh: 审议型搜索器：通过带有约束条件的强化学习来提高大语言模型的可靠性
papers.authors: Zhenyun Yin, Shujie Wang, Xuhong Wang, Xingjun Ma, Yingchun Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models with search capabilities frequently exhibit miscalibrated confidence, producing incorrect answers with high certainty. We present Deliberative Searcher, a reasoning-primary framework that integrates search operations into chain-of-thought generation while maintaining explicit confidence calibration. Our method employs constrained reinforcement learning with adaptive Lagrangian multipliers to jointly optimize correctness and reliability. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements: our 7B model reduces average false-certain rates from 54% in baselines to 2%, while our 72B variant achieves competitive accuracy with closed-source models and reduces false-certain rates to 9%. The well-calibrated confidence scores also enable more efficient test-time compute: instead of standard majority voting, we use confidence-weighted aggregation and match the performance of 16-sample majority voting with only 4 samples, a 4\times reduction in inference compute. These results establish calibrated confidence as a foundation for both trustworthy outputs and adaptive test-time compute, demonstrating the value of the proposed constrained RL framework in search-augmented language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 具有搜索功能的大语言模型常常出现校准错误的置信度问题，导致以高确定性得出错误的答案。我们提出了Deliberative Searcher这一以推理为核心的框架，该框架在将搜索操作融入思维链生成的同时，仍能保持明确的置信度校准。我们的方法采用带有自适应拉格朗日乘数的约束强化学习技术，来共同优化正确性和可靠性。在五个基准测试中的实验结果表明，我们的7B模型将平均错误置信率从基线的54%降低到2%；而72B版本的模型则取得了与开源模型相当的准确性，并将错误置信率降低到9%。经过良好校准的置信度分数还使得测试时的计算更加高效：我们不再使用标准的最大多数投票算法，而是采用基于置信度的加权聚合方式，其性能仅相当于使用4个样本进行的最大多数投票，即推理计算效率提升了4倍。这些结果表明，校准置信度是获得可信输出和灵活处理测试时计算需求的基础，也证明了所提出的约束强化学习框架在增强搜索功能的语言模型中的价值。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Thermometer of Thoughts: Enhancing LLM’s Exploration via Attention Temperature Modulation
papers.title_zh: 思维温度计：通过注意力温度调节来提升大语言模型的探索能力
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Yu, Shijian Xiao, Cam-Tu Nguyen, Zhangyue Yin, Lekai Xing, Wenzhong Li, Sanglu Lu
papers.abstract: Improving the exploration of reasoning is essential for advancing Large Language Models’ (LLMs) problem-solving performance. Current methods primarily rely on output-level stochasticity, which decode within fixed reasoning patterns of LLM and suffer from insufficient exploration. In this paper, we introduce adjusting attention temperature to directly modulate the model’s internal focus during reasoning, which enables a dynamic shift between exploratory and focused processing. We reveal that moderate adjustments preserve LLM’s reasoning capability while producing problem hardness-dependent benefits: higher temperatures facilitate solving complex tasks by encouraging wider exploration, whereas lower temperatures mitigate overthinking on simpler problems. Leveraging this insight, we propose a two-stage inference strategy: first, attention temperature scaling modulates the LLM’s reasoning patterns to diversify the reasoning traces; then, a difficulty-aware aggregation scheme is introduced to effectively identify the most reliable solution from the generated candidates. Extensive evaluations show that our method improves Pass@10 by 6.78–14.20% and aggregation accuracy by 9.74% across 7 reasoning benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 改进推理机制的探索对于提升大语言模型的问题解决能力至关重要。当前的方法主要依赖于输出层面的随机性，这种随机性是在固定的推理模式内进行的，因此缺乏足够的探索性。在本文中，我们提出了一种调整注意力温度的方法，可以直接调节模型在推理过程中的内部焦点，从而实现从探索性处理到专注性处理的动态切换。我们发现，适度的温度调整能够保留模型的推理能力，同时带来与问题难度相关的优势：较高的温度可以通过促进更广泛的探索来帮助解决复杂问题，而较低的温度则有助于避免对简单问题的过度思考。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一种两阶段推理策略：首先，通过调整注意力温度来改变模型的推理模式，从而多样化推理路径；然后，引入一种基于问题难度的聚合机制，以有效筛选出最可靠的解决方案。广泛的测试表明，我们的方法在7个推理基准测试中，将Pass@10的准确率提高了6.78%至14.20%，同时聚合准确率也提升了9.74%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CodeFlowBench: A Multi-turn, Iterative Benchmark for Complex Code Generation
papers.title_zh: CodeFlowBench：一种用于复杂代码生成的多轮迭代测试工具
papers.authors: Sizhe Wang, Zhengren Wang, Dongsheng Ma, Yongan Yu, Rui Ling, Zhiyu li, Feiyu Xiong, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: Modern software development demands code that is maintainable, testable, and scalable by organizing the implementation into modular components with iterative reuse of existing codes. We formalize this iterative, multi-turn paradigm as codeflow and introduce CodeFlowBench, the first benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate LLMs’ ability to perform codeflow - implementing new functionality by reusing existing functions over multiple turns. CodeFlowBench comprises two complementary components: CodeFlowBench-Comp, a core collection of 5,000+ competitive programming problems from Codeforces updated via an automated pipeline and CodeFlowBench-Repo, which is sourced from GitHub repositories to better reflect real-world scenarios. Furthermore, a novel evaluation framework featured dual assessment protocol and structural metrics derived from dependency trees is introduced. Extensive experiments reveal significant performance degradation in multi-turn codeflow scenarios. Furthermore, our in-depth analysis illustrates that model performance inversely correlates with dependency complexity. These findings not only highlight the critical challenges for supporting real-world workflows, but also establish CodeFlowBench as an essential tool for advancing code generation research.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代软件开发要求代码具有可维护性、可测试性以及可扩展性。为此，需要将代码分解为模块化组件，并通过对现有代码的迭代复用来实现功能的扩展。我们将这种迭代式的多轮处理模式正式命名为“代码流”，并推出了首个用于全面评估大语言模型执行代码流的基准测试工具——CodeFlowBench。该工具能够利用现有函数通过多轮迭代来实现新功能。CodeFlowBench由两个互补的组件组成：CodeFlowBench-Comp，这是一个包含5000多个来自Codeforces的竞赛编程问题的核心集合，这些题目通过自动化流程进行更新；而CodeFlowBench-Repo则来源于GitHub上的各种代码库，以更好地反映现实世界中的场景。此外，我们还引入了一种新的评估框架，该框架采用双评估协议，并通过从依赖树中提取的结构化指标来进行评估。大量实验表明，在多轮代码流场景中，模型的性能会出现显著下降。进一步深入分析发现，模型性能与依赖关系的复杂性呈负相关。这些发现不仅揭示了支持现实世界工作流程所面临的重大挑战，还使得CodeFlowBench成为推动代码生成研究的重要工具。

papers.title: REFLEX: Self-Refining Explainable Fact-Checking via Verdict-Anchored Style Control
papers.title_zh: 反射：通过基于判决的风格控制来实现自我精炼、可解释的事实核查
papers.authors: Chuyi Kong, Wei Gao, Jing Ma, Hongzhan Lin, Yuxi Sun
papers.abstract: The prevalence of fake news on social media calls for automated fact-checking systems that deliver not only accurate verdicts but also faithful explanations. However, existing large language model (LLM)-based methods often overlook deceptive misinformation styles in generated explanations, producing unfaithful rationales that may mislead human judgment. They also rely heavily on external knowledge sources, which can introduce hallucinations and incur substantial latency, undermining both reliability and responsiveness in real-time settings. To address these limitations, we propose REason-guided Fact-checking with Latent EXplanations (REFLEX), a self-refining framework that explicitly controls reasoning style by anchoring explanations to the predicted verdict. REFLEX leverages self-disagreement veracity signals between a backbone model and its fine-tuned variant to construct steering vectors, thereby naturally disentangling factual content from stylistic cues. Experiments on a real-world benchmark show that REFLEX achieves state-of-the-art performance under LLaMA-series models using only 465 self-refined samples. Owing to its transferability, REFLEX also yields gains of up to 7.54 Macro-F1 points on in-the-wild data. Further analysis shows that our method effectively mitigates faithful hallucination, leading to both more reliable explanations and more accurate verdicts than prior explainable fact-checking approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体上虚假新闻的泛滥，迫切需要自动化的事实核查系统，这些系统不仅能给出准确的结果，还能提供可信的解释。然而，现有的基于大语言模型的方法往往忽略了生成解释中的欺骗性错误信息，导致产生的理由不够可信，可能会误导人类判断。此外，这些方法严重依赖外部知识来源，这可能会引发幻觉现象，并导致显著的延迟，从而影响实时环境中的可靠性和响应能力。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种名为“带有潜在解释的理性引导事实核查”框架（REFLEX）。该框架通过让解释与预测结果紧密结合，从而明确控制推理方式。REFLEX利用主干模型与其微调版本之间的自我不一致性信息来构建引导向量，从而自然地将事实内容与风格特征区分开来。在真实世界的基准测试中的实验表明，仅使用465个自精炼样本，REFLEX就能在LaMA系列模型下达到最先进的表现。由于其可迁移性，REFLEX在真实数据上的性能提升幅度高达7.54个宏观F1分数。进一步分析显示，我们的方法能够有效减少幻觉现象，从而提供更可靠的解释和更准确的结果，优于以往的可解释性事实核查方法。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Illusions of Confidence? Diagnosing LLM Truthfulness via Neighborhood Consistency
papers.title_zh: 自信的幻觉？通过邻域一致性来诊断大语言模型的真实性
papers.authors: Haoming Xu, Ningyuan Zhao, Yunzhi Yao, Weihong Xu, Hongru Wang, Xinle Deng, Shumin Deng, Jeff Z. Pan, Huajun Chen, Ningyu Zhang
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, correctness alone is insufficient. Reliable deployment requires maintaining truthful beliefs under contextual perturbations. Existing evaluations largely rely on point-wise confidence like Self-Consistency, which can mask brittle belief. We show that even facts answered with perfect self-consistency can rapidly collapse under mild contextual interference. To address this gap, we propose Neighbor-Consistency Belief (NCB), a structural measure of belief robustness that evaluates response coherence across a conceptual neighborhood. To validate the efficiency of NCB, we introduce a new cognitive stress-testing protocol that probes outputs stability under contextual interference. Experiments across multiple LLMs show that the performance of high-NCB data is relatively more resistant to interference. Finally, we present Structure-Aware Training (SAT), which optimizes context-invariant belief structure and reduces long-tail knowledge brittleness by approximately 30%.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在现实世界中的广泛应用，仅仅保证正确性已经远远不够。要实现可靠的部署，还需要在上下文干扰下保持真实可信的信念。现有的评估方法主要依赖于诸如自我一致性这样的逐点置信度评估方式，但这可能会掩盖信念的脆弱性。我们发现，即使那些以完美自我一致性回答的事实，在轻微的上下文干扰下也可能迅速崩溃。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了邻域一致性信念（Neighbor-Consistency Belief，NCB）这一衡量信念鲁棒性的结构化指标，该指标能够评估在概念邻域内响应的连贯性。为了验证NCB的有效性，我们引入了一种新的认知压力测试协议，用于检测在上下文干扰下的输出稳定性。通过对多个语言模型的实验分析，我们发现具有高NCB的数据在受到干扰时表现出相对更强的抗干扰能力。最后，我们提出了结构感知训练（Structure-Aware Training，SAT）方法，该方法能够优化上下文不变的信念结构，并将长尾知识的脆弱性降低约30%。

papers.title: Scaling Beyond Context: A Survey of Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Document Understanding
papers.title_zh: 超越上下文的限制：关于利用多模态检索技术提升文档理解能力的研究综述
papers.authors: Sensen Gao, Shanshan Zhao, Xu Jiang, Lunhao Duan, Yong Xien Chng, Qing-Guo Chen, Weihua Luo, Kaifu Zhang, Jia-Wang Bian, Mingming Gong
papers.abstract: Document understanding is critical for applications from financial analysis to scientific discovery. Current approaches, whether OCR-based pipelines feeding Large Language Models (LLMs) or native Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), face key limitations: the former loses structural detail, while the latter struggles with context modeling. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) helps ground models in external data, but documents’ multimodal nature, i.e., combining text, tables, charts, and layout, demands a more advanced paradigm: Multimodal RAG. This approach enables holistic retrieval and reasoning across all modalities, unlocking comprehensive document intelligence. Recognizing its importance, this paper presents a systematic survey of Multimodal RAG for document understanding. We propose a taxonomy based on domain, retrieval modality, and granularity, and review advances involving graph structures and agentic frameworks. We also summarize key datasets, benchmarks, and applications, and highlight open challenges in efficiency, fine-grained representation, and robustness, providing a roadmap for future progress in document AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 文档理解在从财务分析到科学发现的各种应用中至关重要。目前的方法，无论是基于OCR的流程来驱动大语言模型，还是使用原生多模态语言模型，都存在一些关键限制：前者会丢失结构细节，而后者则在上下文建模方面存在困难。检索增强生成技术可以帮助模型基于外部数据进行推理，但文档的多模态特性——即文本、表格、图表和布局的结合——需要一种更先进的范式：多模态检索增强生成。这种方法能够实现所有模态的全面检索和推理，从而实现全面的文档智能。鉴于其重要性，本文对多模态检索增强生成技术在文档理解中的应用进行了系统的综述。我们提出了一种基于领域、检索模式和粒度的分类体系，并回顾了涉及图结构和代理框架的相关进展。我们还总结了关键的数据集、评估基准和应用案例，同时指出了在效率、细粒度表示和鲁棒性方面的挑战，为未来文档人工智能的发展提供了方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Literal Mapping: Benchmarking and Improving Non-Literal Translation Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 超越字面翻译：基准测试与提升非字面翻译评估水平
papers.authors: Yanzhi Tian, Cunxiang Wang, Zeming Liu, Heyan Huang, Wenbo Yu, Dawei Song, Jie Tang, Yuhang Guo
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced Machine Translation (MT), applying them to linguistically complex domains-such as Social Network Services, literature etc. In these scenarios, translations often require handling non-literal expressions, leading to the inaccuracy of MT metrics. To systematically investigate the reliability of MT metrics, we first curate a meta-evaluation dataset focused on non-literal translations, namely MENT. MENT encompasses four non-literal translation domains and features source sentences paired with translations from diverse MT systems, with 7,530 human-annotated scores on translation quality. Experimental results reveal the inaccuracies of traditional MT metrics and the limitations of LLM-as-a-Judge, particularly the knowledge cutoff and score inconsistency problem. To mitigate these limitations, we propose RATE, a novel agentic translation evaluation framework, centered by a reflective Core Agent that dynamically invokes specialized sub-agents. Experimental results indicate the efficacy of RATE, achieving an improvement of at least 3.2 points in combined system- and segment-level correlation with human judgments compared with current methods. Further experiments demonstrate the robustness of RATE to general-domain MT evaluation. Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/BITHLP/RATE.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）极大地提升了机器翻译的能力，将其应用于语言复杂的领域，如社交网络服务、文学等领域。在这些场景中，翻译往往需要处理非字面意义的表达，这导致了机器翻译指标的误差。为了系统地评估机器翻译指标的可靠性，我们首先构建了一个专注于非字面意义翻译的元评估数据集，即MENT。MENT包含了四个非字面意义翻译的领域，这些领域包含源文本以及来自不同机器翻译系统的翻译结果，共有7,530条由人类标注的翻译质量评分。实验结果表明，传统的机器翻译指标存在误差，而LLM作为评估工具也存在局限性，尤其是知识截止点和评分不一致的问题。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了RATE这一新的代理式翻译评估框架。该框架以一个具有反思能力的核心代理为中心，该代理可以动态调用专门的子代理。实验结果显示，RATE在系统级和片段级相关性方面取得了显著改进，与现有方法相比，其准确率提高了至少3.2个百分点。进一步的实验表明，RATE对于通用领域的机器翻译评估具有很好的鲁棒性。相关的代码和数据集可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/BITHLP/RATE。

papers.title: G^2RPO-A: Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization with Adaptive Guidance
papers.title_zh: G^2RPO-A：基于自适应引导的群体相对策略优化方法
papers.authors: Yongxin Guo, Wenbo Deng, Zhenglin Cheng, Xiaoying Tang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has markedly enhanced the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs). Its success, however, largely depends on strong base models with rich world knowledge, yielding only modest improvements for small-size language models (SLMs). To address this limitation, we investigate Guided GRPO, which injects ground-truth reasoning steps into roll-out trajectories to compensate for SLMs’ inherent weaknesses. Through a comprehensive study of various guidance configurations, we find that naively adding guidance delivers limited gains. These insights motivate G^2RPO-A, an adaptive algorithm that automatically adjusts guidance strength in response to the model’s evolving training dynamics. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks confirm that G^2RPO-A substantially outperforms vanilla GRPO. Our code and models at available at https://github.com/T-Lab-CUHKSZ/G2RPO-A.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，其成功在很大程度上依赖于具有丰富世界知识的强大基础模型，这仅能带来适度的改进，对于小型语言模型（SLM）来说则效果有限。为了克服这一限制，我们研究了引导式GRPO算法，该算法在滚动过程中加入真实世界的推理步骤，以弥补SLM的固有缺陷。通过对各种引导配置进行深入研究，我们发现单纯添加引导措施并不能带来显著的提升。这些发现促使我们提出了G^2RPO-A算法，这是一种自适应算法，能够根据模型的训练动态自动调整引导强度。在数学推理和代码生成方面的实验表明，G^2RPO-A的性能明显优于传统的GRPO算法。我们的代码和模型可以在https://github.com/T-Lab-CUHKSZ/G2RPO-A下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Efficient Low-Resource Language Adaptation via Multi-Source Dynamic Logit Fusion
papers.title_zh: 通过多源动态逻辑回归融合实现高效低资源语言适配
papers.authors: Chen Zhang, Jiuheng Lin, Zhiyuan Liao, Yansong Feng
papers.abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to low-resource languages (LRLs) is constrained by the scarcity of task data and computational resources. Although Proxy Tuning offers a logit-level strategy for introducing scaling effects, it often fails in LRL settings because the large model’s weak LRL competence might overwhelm the knowledge of specialized smaller models. We thus propose TriMix, a test-time logit fusion framework that dynamically balances capabilities from three different sources: LRL competence from a continually pretrained small model, task competence from high-resource language instruction tuning, and the scaling benefits of large models. It is data- and compute-efficient, requiring no LRL task annotations, and only continual pretraining on a small model. Experiments across four model families and eight LRLs show that TriMix consistently outperforms single-model baselines and Proxy Tuning. Our analysis reveals that prioritizing the small LRL-specialized model’s logits is crucial for success, challenging the prevalent large-model-dominant assumption.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型应用于资源匮乏的语言时，会受到任务数据稀缺和计算资源限制的影响。虽然代理调优提供了一种基于逻辑回归的策略来引入扩展效果，但在资源匮乏的语言环境中，这种策略往往难以奏效，因为大型模型的有限能力可能无法弥补专业小型模型的知识优势。因此，我们提出了TriMix这一测试时逻辑融合框架，该框架能够动态平衡来自三个不同来源的能力：持续预训练的小型模型所具备的资源匮乏语言处理能力、高资源语言指令调优所赋予的任务处理能力，以及大型模型的扩展优势。该框架在数据和计算资源方面都非常高效，无需额外的资源匮乏语言任务注释，只需对小型模型进行持续预训练即可。通过对四个模型家族和八种资源匮乏语言的实验验证，我们发现TriMix始终优于单一模型基线和代理调优方案。我们的分析表明，优先考虑资源匮乏语言专业小型模型的逻辑输出对于取得成功至关重要，这挑战了目前普遍存在的以大型模型为主导的假设。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Open Schrödinger’s Closed Box: Identifying Retrieval Augmented Generation in API-Accessible Large Language Model Services
papers.title_zh: 打开薛定谔的“封闭盒子”：在可访问的大型语言模型服务中识别检索增强生成机制
papers.authors: Yukun Jiang, Xinyue Shen, Michael Backes, Zheng Li, Yang Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are powerful at question-answering but prone to hallucinations due to limited domain-specific or up-to-date knowledge. Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this by adding an external retriever and knowledge database, yet RAG remains vulnerable to targeted attacks that degrade outputs or manipulate opinions. Prior attacks typically assume adversaries know the service is RAG-enhanced and may even know deployment details, an assumption often invalid for real-world commercial LLMs that expose only black-box APIs.This opacity also risks misleading users about system capabilities. This work aims to bridge this gap by proposing RAG-ID, a framework for \underline{\text{ID}}entifying \underline{\text{RAG}} properties in LLM services.We classify adversaries into three knowledge levels and design six attack methods. Experiments show these attacks reliably detect RAG — up to 99.97% accuracy with partial or no optional knowledge, and nearly 100% when the LLM and database are known. After detection, RAG-ID can infer finer RAG properties (e.g., deployed LLM and knowledge database). We consider RAG-ID a reconnaissance tool for attackers, a way to facilitate users’ transparent selection of LLM services, and a guide for RAG developers in refining security measures.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在问答方面非常强大，但由于缺乏特定领域或最新知识，容易出现幻觉现象。检索增强生成技术通过引入外部检索器和知识数据库来缓解这一问题，但RAG仍然容易受到针对性攻击的影响，这些攻击可能会破坏输出结果或操纵用户观点。以往的攻击通常假设攻击者知道服务采用了RAG技术，甚至可能了解部署细节。然而，对于现实中的商业LLM来说，这种假设往往不成立，因为它们只暴露了黑盒API。这种不透明性还可能误导用户对系统能力的理解。本研究旨在填补这一空白，提出了RAG-ID框架，该框架能够识别LLM服务中的RAG特性。我们将攻击者分为三个知识水平，并设计了六种攻击方法。实验表明，这些攻击能够可靠地检测RAG技术——在部分或完全未知的情况下，准确率高达99.97%；而当知道LLM和数据库的具体信息时，准确率接近100%。在检测到RAG技术后，RAG-ID还能进一步推断出更详细的RAG属性（例如，部署的LLM和知识数据库）。我们认为RAG-ID是攻击者的侦察工具，也是帮助用户透明选择LLM服务的手段，同时还是RAG开发者完善安全措施的指南。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AFT-Tab: Adversarial Fine-Tuning for Tabular Data Synthesis with Long Text Columns
papers.title_zh: AFT-Tab：针对包含长文本列的表格数据生成的对抗性微调方法
papers.authors: Yuhao Zhang, Liang Yan, Shaoming Duan, Xinyu Zha, Jinhang Su, Peiyi Han, Chuanyi Liu
papers.abstract: Traditional tabular data synthesis methods often overlook the cross-modal heterogeneity of real-world tables, where structured continuous and discrete attributes coexist with unstructured long-text columns. Existing synthesis approaches struggle to simultaneously achieve accurate statistical fidelity for non-textual attributes and consistent semantic constraints between textual and non-textual attributes. In this work, we establish the first benchmark for long-text tabular data synthesis and introduce a novel metric, termed Textual Column Correlation Fidelity (TCCF), to quantify cross-modal semantic alignment. We propose AFT-Tab, an adversarial fine-tuning framework that synergistically trains an LLM-based text generator and a deep-learning-based non-textual generator. Through a dual-feedback mechanism guided by an LLM discriminator, AFT-Tab ensures both precise statistical distributions and rigorous semantic constraints. Experimental results show that AFT-Tab significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in statistical fidelity, TCCF, diversity, and downstream task utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的表格数据合成方法往往忽略了现实世界中表格的跨模态异质性，即结构化连续属性和离散属性与非结构化的长文本列共存的情况。现有的合成方法难以同时实现非文本属性的准确统计精度以及文本与非文本属性之间的一致性语义约束。在这项研究中，我们建立了首个针对长文本表格数据合成的基准测试，并引入了一种新的度量指标——文本列相关性精度（TCCF），用于量化跨模态的语义对齐效果。我们提出了AFT-Tab这一对抗性微调框架，该框架能够协同训练基于大语言模型的文本生成器与基于深度学习的非文本生成器。通过由大语言模型判别器引导的双重反馈机制，AFT-Tab确保了精确的统计分布和严格的语义约束。实验结果表明，AFT-Tab在统计精度、TCCF指标、多样性以及下游任务实用性方面均显著优于现有最先进的基线方法。

papers.title: Revisiting a Pain in the Neck: A Semantic Reasoning Benchmark for Language Models
papers.title_zh: 重新审视那个令人头疼的问题：一种用于语言模型的语义推理基准测试
papers.authors: Yang Liu, Hongming Li, Melissa Xiaohui Qin, Chao Huang, Qiankun Liu
papers.abstract: We present SemanticQA, an evaluation suite designed to assess language models (LMs) in semantic phrase processing tasks. The benchmark consolidates existing multiword expression (MwE) resources and reorganizes them into a unified testbed. It covers both general lexical phenomena, such as lexical collocations, and three fine-grained categories: idiomatic expressions, noun compounds, and verbal constructions. Through SemanticQA, we assess LMs of diverse architectures and scales in extraction, classification, and interpretation tasks, as well as sequential task compositions. We reveal substantial performance variation, particularly on tasks requiring semantic reasoning, highlighting differences in reasoning efficacy and semantic understanding of LMs, providing insights for pushing LMs with stronger comprehension on non-trivial semantic phrases. The evaluation harness and data of SemanticQA are available at https://github.com/jacklanda/SemanticQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了SemanticQA这一评估工具，旨在评估语言模型在语义短语处理任务中的表现。该基准测试整合了现有的多词表达资源，并将其整合成一个统一的测试平台。它涵盖了一般的词汇现象，如词汇搭配，以及三个细分的类别：习语表达、名词复合词和动词结构。通过SemanticQA，我们可以评估不同架构和规模的语言模型在提取、分类和解释任务上的表现，以及序列任务的组合效果。我们发现，在需要语义推理的任务上，语言模型的性能存在显著差异，这凸显了它们在推理效率和语义理解方面的差异。这些发现为提升语言模型对非平凡语义短语的理解能力提供了重要线索。SemanticQA的评估工具和相关数据可在此链接下载：https://github.com/jacklanda/SemanticQA。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Timely Machine: Awareness of Time Makes Test-Time Scaling Agentic
papers.title_zh: 及时机器：对时间的认知使得测试时间的调整变得更加有目的性
papers.authors: Yichuan Ma, Linyang Li, Yongkang Chen, Peiji Li, Xiaozhe Li, Qipeng Guo, Dahua Lin, Kai Chen
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly tackle complex reasoning tasks, test-time scaling has become critical for enhancing capabilities. However, in agentic scenarios with frequent tool calls, the traditional generation-length-based definition breaks down: tool latency decouples inference time from generation length. We propose Timely Machine, redefining test-time as wall-clock time, where models dynamically adjust strategies based on time budgets. We introduce Timely-Eval, a benchmark spanning high-frequency tool calls, low-frequency tool calls, and time-constrained reasoning. By varying tool latency, we find smaller models excel with fast feedback through more interactions, while larger models dominate high-latency settings via superior interaction quality. Moreover, existing models fail to adapt reasoning to time budgets. We propose Timely-RL to address this gap. After cold-start supervised fine-tuning, we use reinforcement learning to enhance temporal planning. Timely-RL improves time budget awareness and consistently boosts performance across Timely-Eval. We hope our work offers a new perspective on test-time scaling for the agentic era.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在处理复杂推理任务方面的能力不断提升，测试时间的可扩展性已成为提升模型性能的关键因素。然而，在需要频繁调用工具的智能体场景中，传统的基于生成时长的定义方式不再适用：工具调用的延迟使得推理时间与生成时长分离。我们提出了Timely Machine这一方案，将测试时间重新定义为实际运行时间，模型可以根据时间预算动态调整策略。我们还引入了Timely-Eval这一基准测试，该测试涵盖了高频工具调用、低频工具调用以及时间受限的推理场景。通过改变工具调用的延迟特性，我们发现较小的模型在快速反馈的情况下表现更优，而较大的模型则能在高延迟环境下凭借更好的交互质量取得优势。此外，现有的模型无法根据时间预算来调整推理策略。为此，我们提出了Timely-RL来解决这个问题。在经过冷启动后的监督微调之后，我们利用强化学习来提升模型的时序规划能力。Timely-RL能够增强模型对时间预算的感知能力，并在Timely-Eval测试中持续提升性能。我们希望我们的研究能够为智能体时代的测试时间可扩展性提供新的思路。

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Semantic Revision for Large Language Model Distillation
papers.title_zh: 适用于大型语言模型蒸馏的多粒度语义修正技术
papers.authors: Xiaoyu Liu, Yun Zhang, Wei Li, Simiao Li, Xudong Huang, Hanting Chen, Yehui Tang, Jie Hu, Zhiwei Xiong, Yunhe Wang
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation is crucial for compressing Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling smaller student models to learn from larger teacher models. However, existing LLM distillation methods overly rely on student-generated outputs, which may introduce generation errors and misguide the distillation process. Moreover, existing distillation loss functions struggle to align the most informative part due to the complex output distributions of LLMs. To address these problems, we propose a multi-granularity semantic revision method for LLM distillation. At the sequence level, we propose a sequence correction and re-generation (SCRG) strategy. SCRG identifies error tokens by calculating the semantic cognitive difference between teacher and student outputs, corrects them using teacher-generated tokens, and re-generates the sequence to minimize errors. At the token level, we design a distribution adaptive clipping Kullback-Leibler (DAC-KL) loss, which uses a learnable sub-network to focus on semantically dense areas of the teacher’s output, reducing the impact of redundant information. At the span level, we utilize span priors to compute probability correlations within sequences, ensuring consistency between teacher and student outputs to enhance semantic information transfer. Extensive experiments on models ranging from 0.1B to 13B parameters demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach compared to existing methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏对于压缩大语言模型至关重要，它使得较小的学生模型能够从较大的教师模型中学习。然而，现有的LLM蒸馏方法过度依赖学生生成的输出，这可能会引入生成错误，并误导蒸馏过程。此外，现有的蒸馏损失函数难以对齐最具信息量的部分，因为LLM的输出分布非常复杂。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种多粒度语义修正方法用于LLM蒸馏。在序列层面，我们提出了一种序列校正与重新生成策略。该策略通过计算教师输出与学生输出之间的语义认知差异来识别错误令牌，并使用教师生成的令牌进行校正，然后重新生成序列以最小化错误。在令牌层面，我们设计了一种分布自适应裁剪的Kullback-Leibler损失函数，该函数利用一个可学习的子网络来关注教师输出的语义密集区域，从而减少冗余信息的影响。在跨度层面，我们利用跨度先验来计算序列内的概率相关性，确保教师输出与学生输出之间的一致性，从而增强语义信息的传递。我们在参数从0.1B到13B的各种模型上进行了大量实验，结果表明我们的方法比现有方法更为有效。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RADO: Reasoning Audit-Driven Optimization for Rigorous Reasoning in High-Stakes Domains
papers.title_zh: RADO：基于推理的优化方法——在高风险领域实现严谨的推理能力
papers.authors: Zhijie Tan, Xu Chu, Guanyu Wang, Ziyu Li, Weiping Li, Tong Mo
papers.abstract: High-stakes domains such as finance, law, and biomedicine demand both accurate results and rigorous reasoning. Current reinforcement learning paradigms primarily rely on outcome-based rewards, often overlooking latent logical fallacies in intermediate steps. Leveraging the cognitive asymmetry where falsifying local errors is more efficient than generating global correctness, we propose RADO (Reasoning Audit-Driven Optimization). RADO introduces a specialized audit model augmented with external tools to identify local logical ruptures and calibrate reward signals. By integrating Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), our framework enables explicit supervision over reasoning paths. Experimental results demonstrate that RADO consistently improves final accuracy while significantly enhancing logical rigor in high-stakes domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 在金融、法律和生物医学等高风险领域，不仅需要准确的结果，还需要严谨的推理过程。目前的强化学习范式主要依赖基于结果的奖励机制，往往忽略了中间步骤中存在的逻辑错误。我们借鉴了认知不对称原理——即纠正局部错误比追求全局正确性更为高效，因此提出了RADO（基于推理审计的优化方法）。RADO引入了一种专门的审计模型，并结合外部工具来识别局部的逻辑错误并调整奖励信号。通过将直接偏好优化与群体相对策略优化相结合，我们的框架能够实现对推理过程的明确监督。实验结果表明，RADO能够显著提高最终结果的准确性，同时大幅提升高风险领域的逻辑严谨性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Instruction Data Selection via Answer Divergence
papers.title_zh: 通过答案差异来选择指令数据
papers.authors: Bo Li, Mingda Wang, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
papers.abstract: Instruction tuning relies on large instruction–response corpora whose quality and composition strongly affect downstream performance. We propose Answer Divergence-Guided Selection (ADG), which selects instruction data based on the geometric structure of multi-sample outputs. ADG draws several high-temperature generations per instruction, maps responses into an embedding space, and computes an output divergence score that jointly encodes dispersion magnitude and shape anisotropy. High scores correspond to instructions whose answers are both far apart and multi-modal, rather than clustered paraphrases along a single direction. Across two backbones and three public instruction pools, fine-tuning on only 10K ADG-selected examples consistently outperforms strong selectors on six benchmarks spanning reasoning, knowledge, and coding. Analyses further show that both dispersion magnitude and shape anisotropy are necessary, supporting answer divergence as a practical signal for instruction data selection. Code and appendix are included in the supplementary materials.
papers.abstract_zh: 指令调优依赖于庞大的指令-响应语料库，其质量和构成对下游性能有着重要影响。我们提出了基于答案差异引导选择的算法（Answer Divergence-Guided Selection，ADG），该算法根据多样本输出的几何结构来选取指令数据。ADG会为每个指令生成多个高温生成模型，将回答映射到一个嵌入空间中，并计算出一个输出差异得分，该得分同时包含了离散程度的幅度和形状各向异性。得分较高的指令意味着其答案既具有较大的差异性，又具有多种模式，而不是集中在单一方向上的重复表述。在两个基础模型和三个公共指令库上进行的微调实验表明，仅使用10K个由ADG选出的示例进行训练时，该算法在六个评估指标上的表现均优于其他强大的选择方法，这些评估指标涵盖了推理、知识和编程等领域。进一步的分析表明，离散程度的幅度和形状各向异性都是必要的因素，这进一步证明了答案差异作为指令数据选择指标的实用性。代码和附录附在补充材料中。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Interpretable Safety Alignment via SAE-Constructed Low-Rank Subspace Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 通过SAE构建的低秩子空间适应实现可解释的安全性对齐
papers.authors: Dianyun Wang, Qingsen Ma, Yuhu Shang, Zhifeng Lu, Zhenbo Xu, Lechen Ning, Huijia Wu, Zhaofeng He
papers.abstract: Safety alignment—training large language models (LLMs) to refuse harmful requests while remaining helpful—is critical for responsible deployment. Prior work established that safety behaviors are governed by low-rank structures, suggesting parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) should be well-suited for alignment. However, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) consistently underperforms full fine-tuning and reinforcement learning on safety benchmarks. We attribute this gap to semantic entanglement: safety-relevant directions are intertwined with unrelated concepts due to polysemanticity, impeding implicit subspace identification. To address this, we propose SAILS (Safety Alignment via Interpretable Low-rank Subspace), which leverages Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to disentangle representations into monosemantic features, constructs an interpretable safety subspace from SAE decoder directions, and uses it to initialize LoRA adapters. Theoretically, we prove that SAE-based identification achieves arbitrarily small recovery error under monosemanticity assumptions, while direct identification suffers an irreducible error floor. Empirically, SAILS achieves up to 99.6% safety rates across multiple model families and scales, exceeding full fine-tuning and matching RLHF-based models, with only 0.2% of parameters updated and providing interpretability.
papers.abstract_zh: 安全对齐——训练大语言模型，使其能够在保持有用性的同时拒绝有害请求——对于负责任地部署这些模型至关重要。先前的研究表明，安全行为是由低秩结构控制的，这意味着参数高效微调方法非常适合用于安全对齐任务。然而，低秩自适应算法在安全性基准测试中的表现始终不如全量微调或强化学习。我们将这种差距归因于语义纠缠：由于多义性，与安全相关的方向会与无关概念交织在一起，从而阻碍隐式子空间的识别。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SAILS（通过可解释的低秩子空间进行安全对齐）方法。该方法利用稀疏自编码器将表示分解为单义特征，从自编码器解码器的方向中构建出一个可解释的安全子空间，并用它来初始化低秩自适应算法中的适配器。理论上，我们证明在单义性假设下，基于自编码器的识别方法能够实现任意小的恢复误差，而直接识别则存在无法消除的误差问题。实证结果表明，SAILS在多种模型家族和规模上实现了高达99.6%的安全率，其更新参数仅为0.2%，同时提供了可解释性，其性能优于全量微调以及基于强化学习的模型。

papers.title: D^2Plan: Dual-Agent Dynamic Global Planning for Complex Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
papers.title_zh: D^2Plan：用于复杂检索增强推理的双智能体动态全局规划方法
papers.authors: Kangcheng Luo, Tinglang Wu, Yansong Feng
papers.abstract: Recent search-augmented LLMs trained with reinforcement learning (RL) can interleave searching and reasoning for multi-hop reasoning tasks. However, they face two critical failure modes as the accumulating context becomes flooded with both crucial evidence and irrelevant information: (1) ineffective search chain construction that produces incorrect queries or omits retrieval of critical information, and (2) reasoning hijacking by peripheral evidence that causes models to misidentify distractors as valid evidence.To address these challenges, we propose D²Plan, a Dual-agent Dynamic global Planning paradigm for complex retrieval-augmented reasoning. D²Plan operates through the collaboration of a Reasoner and a Purifier: the Reasoner constructs explicit global plans during reasoning and dynamically adapts them based on retrieval feedback; the Purifier assesses retrieval relevance and condenses key information for the Reasoner.We further introduce a two-stage training framework consisting of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) cold-start on synthesized trajectories and RL with plan-oriented rewards to teach LLMs to master the D²Plan paradigm. Extensive experiments demonstrate that D²Plan enables more coherent multi-step reasoning and stronger resilience to irrelevant information, thereby achieving superior performance on challenging QA benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近训练的、采用强化学习方法的大语言模型能够同时处理搜索和推理任务，实现多跳推理。然而，这类模型面临两个主要问题：随着上下文信息的不断增加，模型可能会遇到两种情况——要么搜索链构建效果不佳，导致生成错误的查询或遗漏了关键信息；要么外围证据干扰了模型的推理过程，使模型将无关信息误判为有效证据。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了D²Plan这一双代理动态全局规划框架。该框架由推理器与净化器两部分组成：推理器在推理过程中构建明确的全局计划，并根据检索到的反馈动态调整这些计划；净化器则负责评估检索到的信息的相关性，并提取关键信息供推理器使用。我们还提出了一个两阶段训练框架，包括对合成轨迹进行有监督的微调，以及采用以计划为导向的奖励机制进行强化学习训练，以帮助大语言模型掌握D²Plan框架的使用方法。大量实验表明，D²Plan能够提供更连贯的多步推理能力，并且能够更好地应对无关信息的影响，从而在复杂的问答任务中取得更好的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Instructions are all you need: Self-supervised Reinforcement Learning for Instruction Following
papers.title_zh: 你所需要的只是一些指导方针：用于指令遵循的自监督强化学习
papers.authors: Qingyu Ren, Qianyu He, Powei Chang, Jie Zeng, Zeye Sun, Fei Yu, Jiaqing Liang, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: Language models often struggle to follow multi-constraint instructions that are crucial for real-world applications. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches suffer from dependency on external supervision and sparse reward signals from multi-constraint tasks. We propose a label-free self-supervised RL framework that eliminates dependency on external supervision by deriving reward signals directly from instructions and generating pseudo-labels for reward model training. Our approach introduces constraint decomposition strategies and efficient constraint-wise binary classification to address sparse reward challenges while maintaining computational efficiency. Experiments show that our approach generalizes well, achieving strong improvements across 3 in-domain and 5 out-of-domain datasets, including challenging agentic and multi-turn instruction following. We will open-source our code and data to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型在遵循多约束指令时常常遇到困难，而这些指令对于现实世界的应用来说至关重要。现有的强化学习方法依赖于外部监督，并且从多约束任务中获得的奖励信号较为稀疏。我们提出了一种无标签的自监督强化学习框架，该框架通过直接从指令中推导奖励信号，并为奖励模型训练生成伪标签，从而消除了对外部监督的依赖。我们的方法引入了约束分解策略以及高效的基于约束的二元分类技术，以有效应对奖励信号稀疏的问题，同时保持良好的计算效率。实验表明，我们的方法具有很好的泛化能力，在3个领域内的数据集和5个外部领域的数据集上都取得了显著的改进，包括复杂的代理行为和多轮指令遵循任务。我们将开源我们的代码和数据，以便促进未来的研究。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Analytical FFN-to-MoE Restructuring via Activation Pattern Analysis
papers.title_zh: 通过激活模式分析实现FFN与MoE的分析性重构
papers.authors: Zehua Pei, Hui-Ling Zhen, Lancheng Zou, Xianzhi Yu, Wulong Liu, Sinno Jialin Pan, Mingxuan Yuan, Bei Yu
papers.abstract: Scaling large language models (LLMs) improves performance but significantly increases inference costs, with feed-forward networks (FFNs) consuming the majority of computational resources. While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can reduce this cost through sparse activation, restructuring existing dense models into MoEs typically requires extensive retraining on hundreds of billions of tokens.We propose an analytical post-training framework that rapidly restructures FFNs into sparse MoE architectures using only a small calibration dataset. The method analyzes neuron activation patterns to partition neurons into always-active shared experts and conditionally activated routed experts, then constructs a router analytically from representative neuron statistics, enabling immediate deployment or optional lightweight fine-tuning. This approach applies both to dense models and recursively to existing MoE models for hierarchical sparsity.Experiments demonstrate up to 1.17\times speedup in compute-bound scenarios with only minutes of processing and 2k-sample fine-tuning, outperforming methods requiring orders of magnitude more resources.
papers.abstract_zh: 对大语言模型进行扩展可以提高性能，但会显著增加推理成本。其中，前馈网络占用了大部分计算资源。而混合专家架构可以通过稀疏激活来降低这种成本，不过将现有的密集模型重构为混合专家架构通常需要对数千亿个令牌进行大量重新训练。我们提出了一种分析性训练后框架，该框架仅使用少量校准数据集即可快速将前馈网络重构为稀疏混合专家架构。该方法通过分析神经元激活模式，将神经元划分为始终活跃的共享专家和条件激活的路由专家，然后从代表性神经元统计数据中解析地构建路由器，从而实现即时部署或可选的轻量级微调。这种方法既适用于密集模型，也适用于现有的混合专家模型，以实现分层稀疏性。实验表明，在计算资源有限的情况下，该方法仅需几分钟的处理时间和2k样本的训练时间，就能实现高达1.17倍的性能提升，其所需资源比其他方法少几个数量级。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Towards Order Fairness: Mitigating LLMs Order Sensitivity through Dual Group Advantage Optimization
papers.title_zh: 迈向秩序公平性：通过双组优势优化来减轻大语言模型对排序的敏感性
papers.authors: Xu Chu, Guanyu Wang, Zhijie Tan, Xinrong Chen, Ziyu Li, Tong Mo, Weiping Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) suffer from order bias, where their performance is affected by the arrangement order of input elements. This unfairness limits the model’s applications in scenarios such as in-context learning and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Recent studies attempt to obtain optimal or suboptimal arrangements based on statistical results or using dataset-based search, but these methods increase inference overhead while leaving the model’s inherent order bias unresolved. Other studies mitigate order sensitivity through supervised fine-tuning using augmented training sets with multiple order variants, but often at the cost of accuracy, trapping the model in consistent yet incorrect hallucinations. In this paper, we propose Dual Group Advantage Optimization (DGAO), which aims to improve model accuracy and order stability simultaneously. DGAO calculates and balances intra-group relative accuracy advantage and inter-group relative stability advantage, rewarding the policy model for generating order-stable and correct outputs while penalizing order-sensitive or incorrect responses. This marks the first time reinforcement learning has been used to mitigate LLMs’ order sensitivity. We also propose two new metrics, Consistency Rate and Overconfidence Rate, to reveal the pseudo-stability of previous methods and guide more comprehensive evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DGAO achieves superior order fairness while improving performance on RAG, mathematical reasoning, and classification tasks. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DGAO-A481/
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型存在顺序偏见问题，即模型的性能会受到输入元素排列顺序的影响。这种不公平性限制了模型在上下文学习、检索增强生成等场景中的应用。近期的研究试图基于统计结果或使用数据集搜索来寻找最优或次优的排列方式，但这些方法会增加推理负担，同时未能解决模型固有的顺序偏见问题。另一些研究则通过使用包含多种顺序变体的增强训练集进行有监督微调来减轻顺序敏感性问题，但这种方法往往以牺牲准确性为代价，导致模型陷入一致但不正确的幻觉状态。在本文中，我们提出了双组优势优化算法，该算法旨在同时提高模型准确性和顺序稳定性。双组优势优化算法通过计算并平衡组内相对准确性优势和组间相对稳定性优势，对生成顺序稳定且正确的输出给予奖励，而对顺序敏感或错误的响应则进行惩罚。这是首次使用强化学习方法来缓解大语言模型的顺序敏感性问题。我们还提出了两个新的指标：一致性率和过度自信率，这些指标可用于揭示现有方法的伪稳定性，并为更全面的评估提供指导。大量实验表明，双组优势优化算法在提高检索增强生成、数学推理和分类任务性能的同时，还能实现更好的顺序公平性。我们的代码可在此处获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DGAO-A481/
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Revitalizing Black-Box Interpretability: Actionable Interpretability for LLMs via Proxy Models
papers.title_zh: 提升黑盒可解释性：通过代理模型为大型语言模型提供实用的可解释性方案
papers.authors: Junhao Liu, Haonan Yu, Zhenyu Yan, Xin Zhang
papers.abstract: Post-hoc explanations provide transparency and are essential for guiding model optimization, such as prompt engineering and data sanitation. However, applying model-agnostic techniques to Large Language Models (LLMs) is hindered by prohibitive computational costs, rendering these tools dormant for real-world applications. To revitalize model-agnostic interpretability, we propose a budget-friendly proxy framework that leverages efficient models to approximate the decision boundaries of expensive LLMs. We introduce a screen-and-apply mechanism to statistically verify local alignment before deployment. Our empirical evaluation confirms that proxy explanations achieve over 90% fidelity with only 9.5% of the oracle’s cost. Building on this foundation, we demonstrate the actionable utility of our framework in prompt compression and poisoned example removal. Results show that reliable proxy explanations effectively guide optimization, transforming interpretability from a passive observation tool into a scalable primitive for LLM development. Additionally, we open-source code and datasets to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 事后解释能够提供透明度，对于指导模型优化至关重要，比如提示工程和数据清洗等方面。然而，由于计算成本过高，将模型不可知的技术应用于大语言模型（LLM）变得困难，这使得这些工具在现实世界的应用中难以发挥作用。为了重新激活模型不可知的可解释性，我们提出了一个经济实惠的代理框架，该框架利用高效的模型来近似昂贵的LLM的决策边界。我们引入了一种筛选和应用的机制，以便在部署前统计验证局部一致性。我们的实证评估表明，代理解释能够实现超过90%的保真度，而成本仅相当于真实解释的9.5%。在此基础上，我们展示了该框架在提示压缩和恶意示例移除方面的实用价值。结果表明，可靠的代理解释能够有效地指导优化过程，将可解释性从一种被动的观察工具转变为LLM开发中的可扩展基础。此外，我们还开源了相关代码和数据集，以促进未来的研究。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MedMCP-Calc: Benchmarking LLMs for Realistic Medical Calculator Scenarios via MCP Integration
papers.title_zh: MedMCP-Calc：通过MCP集成，在真实医疗计算场景中对大型语言模型进行性能评估
papers.authors: Yakun Zhu, Yutong Huang, Shengqian Qin, Zhongzhen Huang, Shaoting Zhang, Xiaofan Zhang
papers.abstract: Medical calculators are fundamental to quantitative, evidence-based clinical practice. However, their real-world use is an adaptive, multi-stage process, requiring proactive EHR data acquisition, scenario-dependent calculator selection, and multi-step computation, whereas current benchmarks focus only on static single-step calculations with explicit instructions. To address these limitations, we introduce MedMCP-Calc, the first benchmark for evaluating LLMs in realistic medical calculator scenarios through Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration. MedMCP-Calc comprises 118 scenario tasks across 4 clinical domains, featuring fuzzy task descriptions mimicking natural queries, structured EHR database interaction, external reference retrieval, and process-level evaluation. Our evaluation of 23 leading models reveals critical limitations: even top performers like GPT-5 exhibit substantial gaps, including difficulty selecting appropriate calculators for end-to-end workflows given fuzzy queries, poor performance in iterative SQL-based database interactions, and marked reluctance to leverage external tools for numerical computation. Performance also varies considerably across clinical domains. Building on these findings, we develop CalcMate, a fine-tuned model incorporating scenario planning and tool augmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open-source models.
papers.abstract_zh: 医学计算工具是定量、基于证据的临床实践中的基础工具。然而，其在现实中的应用是一个需要多阶段、自适应性的过程，包括主动获取电子健康记录数据、根据具体情况选择合适的计算工具以及进行多步骤的计算。而目前的评估标准仅关注于带有明确说明的静态单步计算。为了克服这些限制，我们推出了MedMCP-Calc——这是首个通过模型上下文协议来评估大语言模型在真实医学计算场景中的性能的基准测试工具。MedMCP-Calc包含4个临床领域中的118个场景任务，这些任务具有模糊的任务描述，能够模拟自然查询；同时它还支持与结构化电子健康记录数据库的交互、外部参考数据的检索以及过程级的评估。我们对23种领先模型的评估发现，它们存在许多关键缺陷：即使是像GPT-5这样的顶尖模型也存在着明显的问题，比如难以为端到端工作流程选择合适的计算工具，在基于SQL的迭代式数据库交互中表现不佳，而且不愿意使用外部工具来进行数值计算。不同临床领域的性能差异也很大。基于这些发现，我们开发了CalcMate——一个经过微调的模型，它结合了场景规划和工具增强功能，在开源模型中取得了最先进的性能表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Uncovering Temporal Framing in the News
papers.title_zh: 揭示新闻中的时间框架现象
papers.authors: Tarek Mahmoud, Veronika Solopova, Premtim Sahitaj, Ariana Sahitaj, Max Upravitelev, Mervat Abassy, Hana Fatima Shaikh, Neda Foroutan, Vera Schmitt, Preslav Nakov
papers.abstract: Temporal language does more than place events on a timeline. In news discourse, references to the past, present, and future can function as rhetorical devices that shape interpretation and persuasion. Here, we study temporal framing, defined as the persuasive use of time-related language to structure meaning rather than to report chronology. We propose a taxonomy of eight temporal frames grounded in prior work on temporality and framing, and we realize it through expert annotation of a multilingual news corpus. The resulting dataset includes 458 English and German news articles, with over 2K temporally framed sentences and approximately 3K temporal framing annotations identified from a corpus of more than 20K sentences. We analyze frame prevalence, co-occurrence patterns, and lexical cues, and evaluate temporal framing detection using supervised fine-tuning and zero-shot classification. Our experiments show that temporal framing is learnable at the sentence level, with supervised models substantially outperforming zero-shot approaches. We publicly release the corpus to support future research on temporal framing: https://mbzuai-nlp.github.io/temporal-framing/.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间性语言的作用不仅仅是将事件按时间顺序排列。在新闻话语中，对过去、现在和未来的提及可以作为一种修辞手段，来塑造人们的理解和认知。在这里，我们研究了时间框架的概念，即利用与时间相关的语言来构建意义，而不是单纯地记录时间顺序。我们根据之前关于时间性和框架的研究，提出了一种包含八种时间框架的分类体系。我们通过专家对多语言新闻语料库进行标注来实现这一分类体系。最终得到的数据集包括458篇英语和德语新闻文章，其中包含超过2000个具有时间框架的句子，以及大约3000条关于时间框架的注释。我们对这些框架的普遍性、共现模式以及词汇线索进行了分析，并采用监督式微调技术和零样本分类方法来评估时间框架的检测效果。实验结果表明，时间框架可以在句子层面被学习到，而使用监督式方法的模型在性能上明显优于零样本方法。我们将该语料库公开供未来研究使用：https://mbzuai-nlp.github.io/temporal-framing/
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Simple-VGC: Enhancing Visual Grounding in Multimodal Reasoning via Adaptive Tool Composition
papers.title_zh: 简单-VGC：通过自适应工具组合增强多模态推理中的视觉基础能力
papers.authors: Ye Wang, Qianglong Chen, Siyuan Wang, Zejun Li, Shijie Guo, Zhirui Zhang, Zhongyu Wei
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on vision-language tasks, yet often fail to preserve and effectively leverage visual evidence throughout generation. We identify three fundamental types of visual grounding failures: Long-Context Grounding Error, where visual information gradually decays over long sequences; Fine-Grained Grounding Error, where low-resolution or degraded inputs hinder the recovery of detailed visual information; and Regional Grounding Error, where spatially diffuse attention weakens region-level vision-language alignment. To address these issues, we propose a tool-augmented reasoning framework with three targeted compensation strategies: reuse, which re-injects the original image to mitigate visual forgetting; focus_area, which constrains attention to task-relevant regions; and zoom_in, which enhances visual resolution for fine-grained perception. We further construct the TWI-Tools-146K dataset and develop Simple-VGC, a tool-augmented MLLM that interleaves visual and textual tokens. Extensive experiments show that each tool yields targeted improvements for its corresponding grounding error, while their combination produces synergistic gains in visual reasoning. Beyond performance, our analysis provides mechanistic insights into how tool-based interventions improve visual grounding, pointing toward more reliable multimodal reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在视觉-语言任务上取得了出色的性能，但往往无法在生成过程中有效保留和利用视觉信息。我们识别出三种主要的视觉定位错误类型：长上下文定位错误，即视觉信息在长时间序列中逐渐衰减；细粒度定位错误，即低分辨率或劣化的输入阻碍了详细视觉信息的恢复；区域定位错误，即空间上的注意力分散削弱了区域级别的视觉-语言对齐。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种工具增强推理框架，并提出了三种针对性的补偿策略：重用策略，通过重新注入原始图像来减轻视觉遗忘；聚焦区域策略，将注意力集中在与任务相关的区域上；放大策略，提高视觉分辨能力以实现细粒度的感知。我们还构建了TWI-Tools-146K数据集，并开发了Simple-VGC，这是一种结合了视觉和文本令牌的工具增强型多模态语言模型。大量实验表明，每种工具都能针对相应的定位错误提供有针对性的改进，而它们的组合则能在视觉推理方面产生协同效应。除了性能提升之外，我们的分析还提供了关于基于工具的干预措施如何改善视觉定位的机理性见解，为更可靠的多模态推理提供了方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Enhancing Lexical Relation Mining with Structured Sememe Knowledge
papers.title_zh: 利用结构化语素知识提升词汇关系挖掘能力
papers.authors: Hansi Wang, Qiliang Liang, Yue Wang, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Lexical Relation Mining (LRM) aims to identify and classify lexical relations between word pairs. In this paper, we focus on two subtypes of LRM: Lexical Relation Classification (LRC) and Lexical Entailment (LE). Existing top-performing methods for them rely heavily on Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) yet fail to distinguish nuanced lexical relations. From a linguistic perspective, intralexical tree-structured sememe information can reflect interlexical relations. Inspired by this, we are motivated to explore leveraging such structured knowledge to enhance LRC and LE. We first propose an automated Sememe Tree Construction (STC) pipeline to predict sememe trees; Then, we present the SememeLRM method to fully leverage structured sememe knowledge; Experimental results show that it achieves a notable 1.6% improvement on average across benchmarks, even outperforming Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods that contain 20 times more parameters on most benchmarks. Further results also suggest that sememe trees predicted by our pipeline can rival the gold-standard in HowNet, extending their applicability to lexico-semantic computing. Overall, this paper presents a potentially generalizable framework for leveraging complete sememe trees and makes significant progress, helping to unlock the value of such intralexical knowledge in downstream tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 词汇关系挖掘（LRM）旨在识别并分类词语对之间的词汇关系。在本文中，我们重点关注两种类型的LRM：词汇关系分类（LRC）和词汇蕴含（LE）。目前最先进的方法大多依赖于预训练语言模型，但难以区分复杂的词汇关系。从语言学角度来看，内部词汇的树状结构语义信息可以反映词汇之间的关系。受此启发，我们决心利用这种结构化知识来提升LRC和LE的性能。我们首先提出了一种自动构建语义树的方法；然后，我们提出了SememeLRM方法，以充分利用结构化语义知识。实验结果表明，该方法在大多数基准测试中的平均提升幅度达到了1.6%，甚至优于那些参数数量多20倍的大语言模型基方法。进一步的研究表明，我们方法预测的语义树可以与HowNet中的黄金标准相媲美，从而将其应用范围扩展到词义计算领域。总体而言，本文提出了一个具有普遍适用性的框架，能够充分利用完整的语义树，并在提升词汇关系挖掘性能方面取得了显著进展，有助于释放这种内部词汇知识的价值，为后续任务提供助力。

papers.title: Look Less, Reason More: Rollout-Guided Adaptive Pixel-Space Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 少看一些，多思考一些：基于推广策略的自适应像素空间推理
papers.authors: Xuchen Li, Xuzhao Li, Jiahui Gao, Renjie Pi, Shiyu Hu, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at many multimodal tasks, yet they frequently struggle with tasks requiring precise understanding and handling of fine-grained visual elements. This is mainly due to information loss during image encoding or insufficient attention to critical regions. Recent work has shown promise by incorporating pixel-level visual information into the reasoning process, enabling VLMs to access high-resolution visual details during their thought process. However, this pixel-level information is often overused, leading to inefficiency and distraction from irrelevant visual details. To address these challenges, we propose the first framework for adaptive pixel reasoning that dynamically determines necessary pixel-level operations based on the input query. Specifically, we first apply operation-aware supervised fine-tuning to establish baseline competence in textual reasoning and visual operations, then design a novel rollout-guided reinforcement learning framework relying on feedback of the model’s own responses, which enables the VLM to determine when pixel operations should be invoked based on query difficulty. Experiments on extensive multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that our model achieves superior performance while significantly reducing unnecessary visual operations. Impressively, our model achieves 73.4% accuracy on HR-Bench 4K while maintaining a tool usage ratio of only 20.1%, improving accuracy and simultaneously reducing tool usage by 66.5% compared to the previous methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在多种多模态任务中表现出色，但在需要精确理解和处理细微视觉元素的任务上却常常遇到困难。这主要是由于在图像编码过程中信息丢失，或者没有充分关注关键区域所致。最近的研究表明，通过将像素级别的视觉信息纳入推理过程，可以使得视觉语言模型在思考过程中能够获取高分辨率的视觉细节。然而，这种像素级别的信息经常被过度使用，导致效率低下，并且会分散注意力，无法专注于无关的视觉细节。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了首个自适应像素推理框架，该框架能够根据输入查询动态确定必要的像素级别操作。具体来说，我们首先采用基于操作的监督式微调技术，以建立文本推理和视觉操作方面的基础能力；然后，我们设计了一种新的基于反馈的强化学习框架，该框架依靠模型自身反应的反馈来指导何时执行像素操作。实验结果表明，我们的模型在减少不必要的视觉操作的同时，仍然取得了出色的性能。令人印象深刻的是，我们的模型在HR-Bench 4K测试集上的准确率为73.4%，同时工具使用率仅为20.1%，与之前的方法相比，不仅提高了准确性，还减少了66.5%的工具使用量。

papers.title: Conditional Memory via Scalable Lookup: A New Axis of Sparsity for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于可扩展查找表的条件性记忆机制：大型语言模型稀疏性的新方向
papers.authors: Xin Cheng, Wangding Zeng, Damai Dai, Qinyu Chen, Bingxuan Wang, Zhenda Xie, Kezhao Huang, Xingkai Yu, Zhewen Hao, Han Zhang, Yu-Kun Li, Huishuai Zhang, Dongyan Zhao, Wenfeng Liang
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales capacity via conditional computation, but Transformers lack a native knowledge lookup primitive. We introduce conditional memory, instantiated via Deep Sparse Embedding (DSE), which indexes a massive embedding table using local n-grams for retrieval. We formalize sparsity allocation problem—how to split a fixed parameter budget between MoE experts and DSE memory—and find a U-shaped scaling law that identifies an optimal balance. Scaling to 27B parameters, DSE outperform an iso-parameter and iso-FLOPs MoE baseline across knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, and achieve markedly stronger long-context performance. Mechanistic analyses show that DSE offloads early-layer static recall into memory, freeing effective depth and attention for higher-level reasoning. DSE is also infrastructure-efficient: its deterministic hashing enables offloading massive parameters into host memory during inference with negligible throughput overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合模型（Mixture-of-Experts，MoE）通过条件计算来扩展能力，但Transformer模型缺乏原生知识检索机制。我们提出了条件记忆机制，该机制通过深度稀疏嵌入（Deep Sparse Embedding，DSE）来实现。DSE利用局部n-gram技术对庞大的嵌入表进行索引，从而实现快速检索。我们还将稀疏分配问题形式化——即如何在MoE专家和DSE内存之间分配固定的参数预算。研究发现，存在一个U形缩放规律，可以找到最优的分配比例。当参数数量达到270亿时，DSE在各类知识和推理测试中的表现均优于参数和FLOPs固定的MoE模型，并且在处理长上下文信息方面表现出显著的优势。机制分析表明，DSE将早期层的静态检索任务卸载到内存中，从而释放了有效深度和注意力资源用于更高层次的推理任务。此外，DSE还具有高效的基础设施特性：其确定性哈希算法使得在推理过程中可以将大量参数卸载到主机内存中，而几乎不会增加吞吐量开销。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PII-Bench: Evaluating Query-Aware Privacy Protection Systems
papers.title_zh: PII-Bench：评估基于查询的隐私保护系统
papers.authors: Hao Shen, Zhouhong Gu, Haokai Hong, Weili Han, Hongfeng Chai
papers.abstract: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has raised significant privacy concerns regarding the exposure of personally identifiable information (PII) in user prompts. To address this challenge, we propose a query-unrelated PII masking strategy and introduce PII-Bench, the first comprehensive evaluation framework for assessing privacy protection systems. PII-Bench comprises 2,842 test samples across 7 PII types with 55 fine-grained subcategories, featuring diverse scenarios from single-subject descriptions to complex multi-party interactions. Each sample is carefully crafted with a user query, context description, and standard answer indicating query-relevant PII. Our empirical evaluation reveals that while current models perform adequately in basic PII detection, they show significant limitations in determining PII query relevance. Even advanced LLMs struggle with this task, particularly in handling complex multi-subject scenarios, indicating substantial room for improvement in achieving intelligent PII masking.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用引发了关于用户提示中个人可识别信息（PII）泄露的重大隐私问题。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种与查询无关的PII掩蔽策略，并开发了PII-Bench——首个用于评估隐私保护系统的综合评估框架。PII-Bench包含2,842个测试样本，涵盖7种类型的PII，每种类型下又有55个细分类别。这些样本涵盖了从单一主体描述到复杂多主体交互的各种场景。每个样本都精心设计，包含用户查询、上下文描述以及表示与查询相关的PII的标准答案。我们的实证评估显示，虽然当前模型在基本PII检测方面表现良好，但在判断查询相关性方面存在显著局限性。即使是先进的LLM也在这方面存在困难，尤其是在处理复杂的多主体场景时。这表明在实现智能PII掩蔽方面还有很大的改进空间。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GenProve: Learning to Generate Text with Fine-Grained Provenance
papers.title_zh: GenProve：学习生成具有明确来源说明的文本
papers.authors: Jingxuan Wei, Xingyue Wang, Yanghaoyu Liao, Jie Dong, Yuchen Liu, Caijun Jia, Bihui Yu, Junnan Zhu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLM) often hallucinate, and while adding citations is a common solution, it is frequently insufficient for accountability as users struggle to verify how a cited source supports a generated claim. Existing methods are typically coarse-grained and fail to distinguish between direct quotes and complex reasoning. In this paper, we introduce Generation-time Fine-grained Provenance, a task where models must generate fluent answers while simultaneously producing structured, sentence-level provenance triples. To enable this, we present ReFInE (Relation-aware Fine-grained Interpretability Evidence), a dataset featuring expert-verified annotations that distinguish between Quotation, Compression, and Inference. Building on ReFInE, we propose GenProve, a framework that combines Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). By optimizing a composite reward for answer fidelity and provenance correctness, GenProve significantly outperforms 14 strong LLMs in joint evaluation. Crucially, our analysis uncovers a reasoning gap where models excel at surface-level quotation but struggle significantly with inference-based provenance, suggesting that verifiable reasoning remains a frontier challenge distinct from surface-level citation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型常常出现幻觉现象。虽然添加引用是一种常见的解决方案，但这种方法往往不足以确保信息的可靠性，因为用户难以验证所引用的来源是否真正支持了生成的内容。现有的方法通常过于粗略，无法区分直接引用与复杂的推理过程。在本文中，我们提出了“生成式细粒度来源标注”这一任务——模型需要在生成流畅回答的同时，还能提供结构化的、句子级别的来源信息。为了实现这一目标，我们开发了ReFInE（关系感知的细粒度可解释性证据）数据集，该数据集包含由专家验证的注释，能够区分引用、压缩和推理等不同层次的信息。在ReFInE的基础上，我们提出了GenProve框架，该框架结合了监督式微调技术和群体相对策略优化技术。通过为答案的准确性和来源的准确性设计综合奖励机制，GenProve在联合评估中显著优于14种强大的语言模型。关键的是，我们的分析发现了一个推理方面的差距：模型在表面层次的引用方面表现优异，但在基于推理的来源标注方面则存在明显不足。这表明，可验证的推理仍然是一个前沿挑战，它与表面层次的引用有所不同。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
