papers.title: Rethinking Meeting Effectiveness: A Benchmark and Framework for Temporal Fine-grained Automatic Meeting Effectiveness Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 重新思考会议效果评估：一个基准与框架，用于进行时间上极为精细的自动会议效果评估
papers.authors: Yihang Li, Chenhui Chu
papers.abstract: Evaluating meeting effectiveness is crucial for improving organizational productivity. Current approaches rely on post-hoc surveys that yield a single coarse-grained score for an entire meeting. The reliance on manual assessment is inherently limited in scalability, cost, and reproducibility. Moreover, a single score fails to capture the dynamic nature of collaborative discussions. We propose a new paradigm for evaluating meeting effectiveness centered on novel criteria and temporal fine-grained approach. We define effectiveness as the rate of objective achievement over time and assess it for individual topical segments within a meeting. To support this task, we introduce the AMI Meeting Effectiveness (AMI-ME) dataset, a new meta-evaluation dataset containing 2,459 human-annotated segments from 130 AMI Corpus meetings. We also develop an automatic effectiveness evaluation framework that uses a Large Language Model (LLM) as a judge to score each segment’s effectiveness relative to the overall meeting objectives. Through substantial experiments, we establish a comprehensive benchmark for this new task and evaluate the framework’s generalizability across distinct meeting types, ranging from business scenarios to unstructured discussions. Furthermore, we benchmark end-to-end performance starting from raw speech to measure the capabilities of a complete system. Our results validate the framework’s effectiveness and provide strong baselines to facilitate future research in meeting analysis and multi-party dialogue. Our dataset and code will be publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估会议效果对于提高组织生产力至关重要。目前的方法依赖于事后的调查，这种方式只能为整个会议给出一个粗略的评分。而依赖人工评估在可扩展性、成本和可重复性方面存在明显限制。此外，单一的评分无法捕捉到协作讨论的动态特性。我们提出了一种新的评估会议效果的方法论，该方法以新的标准和时间上的细粒度分析为基础。我们将会议效果定义为随时间推移目标达成率的指标，并针对会议中的各个主题部分进行单独评估。为了支持这一任务，我们引入了AMI会议效果数据集，这是一个新的元评估数据集，包含来自130个AMI语料库会议的2,459个有人工标注的片段。我们还开发了一个自动评估框架，该框架利用大语言模型作为评判标准，来评估每个片段相对于整体会议目标的成效。通过大量的实验，我们为这项新任务建立了一个全面的基准，并评估了该框架在不同类型的会议中的泛化能力，包括商业场景和非结构化讨论等。此外，我们还从原始语音数据开始，对系统的端到端性能进行了测试，以衡量其能力。我们的研究结果验证了该框架的有效性，并为未来关于会议分析和多方对话的研究提供了强有力的基础。我们的数据集和代码将公开提供。

papers.title: AgentOCR: Reimagining Agent History via Optical Self-Compression
papers.title_zh: AgentOCR：通过光学自压缩技术重新构想代理历史记录
papers.authors: Lang Feng, Fuchao Yang, Feng Chen, Xin Cheng, Haiyang Xu, Zhenglin Wan, Ming Yan, Bo An
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable agentic systems trained with reinforcement learning (RL) over multi-turn interaction, but practical deployment is bottlenecked by rapidly growing textual histories that inflate token and memory costs. We introduce AgentOCR, a framework that exploits visual tokens’ superior information density by representing the accumulated observation-action history as a compact rendered image. To make multi-turn rollouts scalable, AgentOCR proposes segment optical caching. By decomposing history into hashable segments and maintaining a visual cache, this mechanism eliminates redundant re-rendering. Beyond fixed rendering, AgentOCR introduces agentic self-compression, where the agent actively emits a compression rate and is trained with compression-aware reward to adaptively balance task success and token efficiency. We conduct extensive experiments on challenging agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and search-based QA. Remarkably, AgentOCR preserves over 95% of text-based agent performance while substantially reducing token consumption (>50%), yielding consistent token and memory efficiency. Further analysis validates a 20\times rendering speedup from optical caching and effective self-compression balancing. Our code is available at https://github.com/langfengQ/AgentOCR.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在大语言模型领域取得的进展，使得能够通过强化学习训练出能够在多轮交互中运行的智能体系统。然而，实际部署却受到文本历史数据不断增长的瓶颈限制，这导致令牌消耗和内存成本上升。我们提出了AgentOCR框架，该框架通过将累积的观测-动作历史表示为一个紧凑的渲染图像，从而利用视觉令牌更高的信息密度。为了使得多轮交互式的部署具有可扩展性，AgentOCR采用了分段光学缓存技术。通过将历史数据分解为可哈希的片段，并维护一个视觉缓存，这种机制避免了冗余的重新渲染。除了固定渲染方式外，AgentOCR还引入了智能体自压缩技术，即智能体主动输出压缩率，并通过基于压缩意识的奖励进行训练，以自适应地平衡任务成功率和令牌效率。我们在ALFWorld和基于搜索的QA等具有挑战性的基准测试上进行了广泛的实验。结果表明，AgentOCR能够保留超过95%的文本型智能体性能，同时大幅减少令牌消耗（超过50%），从而实现了稳定的令牌消耗和内存效率。进一步分析表明，光学缓存技术使渲染速度提高了20倍，而有效的自压缩技术也起到了良好的平衡作用。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/langfengQ/AgentOCR下载。

papers.title: MCP-Flow: Facilitating LLM Agents to Master Real-World, Diverse and Scaling MCP Tools
papers.title_zh: MCP-Flow：帮助大型语言模型代理掌握各种现实中的、多样化的且需要处理的复杂任务处理工具
papers.authors: WenHao Wang, Peizhi Niu, Zhao Xu, Zhaoyu Chen, Jian Du, Yaxin Du, Xianghe Pang, Keduan Huang, Yanfeng Wang, Qiang Yan, Siheng Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on external tools to perform complex, realistic tasks, yet their ability to utilize the rapidly expanding Model Contextual Protocol (MCP) ecosystem remains limited. Existing MCP research covers few servers, depends on costly manual curation, and lacks training support, hindering progress toward real-world deployment. To overcome these limitations, we introduce MCP-Flow, an automated web-agent-driven pipeline for large-scale server discovery, data synthesis, and model training. MCP-Flow collects and filters data from 1166 servers and 11536 tools, producing 68733 high-quality instruction-function call pairs and 6439 trajectories, far exceeding prior work in scale and diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate MCP-Flow’s effectiveness in driving superior MCP tool selection, function-call generation, and enhanced agentic task performance. MCP-Flow thus provides a scalable foundation for advancing LLM agents’ proficiency in real-world MCP environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在执行复杂、逼真任务时，越来越依赖外部工具。然而，它们利用不断扩展的模型上下文协议生态系统的能力仍然有限。现有的模型上下文协议研究涉及的服务器数量较少，依赖于昂贵的手动筛选工作，且缺乏训练支持，这阻碍了其在现实世界中的部署进程。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了MCP-Flow这一自动化网络代理驱动的流程，用于大规模服务器的发现、数据的合成以及模型的训练。MCP-Flow能够收集并过滤来自1166台服务器和11536种工具的数据，最终生成了68733对高质量的函数调用对以及6439条任务轨迹，其规模与多样性都远超以往的研究。大量的实验表明，MCP-Flow在引导高效的模型上下文协议工具选择、函数调用生成以及提升代理任务性能方面具有显著效果。因此，MCP-Flow为提升大语言模型代理在现实世界中的能力提供了可扩展的基础。

papers.title: Everyone is unique: Towards Behaviorally Heterogeneous Negotiation Dialogue Systems for Debt Collection
papers.title_zh: 每个人都是独一无二的：因此，我们需要开发具有行为多样性的协商对话系统来用于催收工作
papers.authors: Yuhang Yang, Kai Tang, Chao Ye, Haobo Wang, Qiqi Luo, Jin Guang Zheng, Zhixin Zhang
papers.abstract: Debt collection is a critical negotiation task in the financial industry, with strong practical relevance and exceptional academic value as a behaviorally rich, high-stakes testbed for human-centered dialogue systems. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in dialogue and negotiation, effectively evaluating their performance in this complex scenarios remains a major challenge: existing benchmarks uniformly assume users to be static, rational agents with fixed preferences, failing to capture the rich behavioral heterogeneity inherent in real-world debt collection. To bridge this gap, we propose DebtBench, the first public persona-enriched debt collection benchmark, that highlights behavioral heterogeneity in negotiation. Moreover, we develop DebtGPT, a debt collection agent trained to jointly optimize financial recovery and interaction experience. Our experimental results, using 16 state-of-the-art LLMs, find that most existing models struggle in this complex but realistic scenarios, whereas DebtGPT outperforms all open-source baselines and achieves performance on par with GPT-4o. The code and data are available at https://github.com/yyuhhhh13/DebtNegotiation.
papers.abstract_zh: 债务催收是金融领域一项至关重要的谈判任务，它具有极强的实际意义，同时作为行为丰富、风险极高的测试平台，在以人为本的对话系统中具有卓越的学术价值。虽然大语言模型在对话和谈判方面表现出一定的潜力，但如何有效评估它们在复杂场景下的表现仍然是一个重大挑战：现有的基准测试通常假设用户是静态的、理性的主体，拥有固定的偏好，这无法捕捉到现实世界债务催收中存在的丰富行为多样性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了DebtBench——首个以行为多样性为特色的公开债务催收基准测试工具。此外，我们还开发了DebtGPT，这是一种经过训练的债务催收智能体，能够同时优化财务回收效果和交互体验。我们的实验结果表明，使用16种先进语言模型的测试中发现，大多数现有模型在如此复杂且真实的场景中表现不佳，而DebtGPT则超越了所有开源基准模型，其性能与GPT-4o相当。相关的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/yyuhhhh13/DebtNegotiation下载。

papers.title: Beyond the Crowd: LLM-Augmented Community Notes for Governing Health Misinformation
papers.title_zh: 超越人群之外：利用大型语言模型增强的社区评论在治理健康 misinformation 中的作用
papers.authors: Jiaying Wu, Zihang Fu, Haonan Wang, Fanxiao Li, Jiafeng Guo, Preslav Nakov, Min-Yen Kan
papers.abstract: Community Notes, the crowd-sourced misinformation governance system on X (formerly Twitter), allows users to flag misleading posts, attach contextual notes, and rate the notes’ helpfulness. However, our empirical analysis of 30.8K health-related notes reveals substantial latency, with a median delay of 17.6 hours before notes receive a helpfulness status. To improve responsiveness during real-world misinformation surges, we propose CrowdNotes+, a unified LLM-based framework that augments Community Notes for faster and more reliable health misinformation governance. CrowdNotes+ integrates two modes: (1) evidence-grounded note augmentation and (2) utility-guided note automation, supported by a hierarchical three-stage evaluation of relevance, correctness, and helpfulness. We instantiate the framework with HealthNotes, a benchmark of 1.2K health notes annotated for helpfulness, and a fine-tuned helpfulness judge. Our analysis first uncovers a key loophole in current crowd-sourced governance: voters frequently conflate stylistic fluency with factual accuracy. Addressing this via our hierarchical evaluation, experiments across 15 representative LLMs demonstrate that CrowdNotes+ significantly outperforms human contributors in note correctness, helpfulness, and evidence utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 社区笔记是X平台（原Twitter）上的一项众包式错误信息治理系统，用户可以通过该系统标记误导性帖子、附加相关说明，并评估这些说明的实用性。然而，我们对3.08万条与健康相关的笔记进行的实证分析发现，信息在获得实用性评级之前存在显著的延迟，平均延迟时间为17.6小时。为了在实际应对错误信息激增时提高响应速度，我们提出了CrowdNotes+这一基于大语言模型的统一框架。该框架结合了两种模式：(1)以证据为基础的笔记增强；(2)以效用为导向的笔记自动化处理。我们通过一个分层的三阶段评估体系来评估信息的相关性、准确性和实用性。我们以HealthNotes作为实验案例，该数据集包含1.2万条经过标注的与健康相关的笔记，以及一个经过微调的实用性评估模型。我们的分析首先揭示了当前众包治理方式中的一个关键问题：参与者常常将风格的流畅性与事实的准确性混淆在一起。通过我们的分层评估体系，我们在15种代表性的大语言模型中进行了实验验证，结果表明CrowdNotes+在笔记的准确性、实用性和证据效用方面明显优于人类贡献者。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BaseCal: Unsupervised Confidence Calibration via Base Model Signals
papers.title_zh: BaseCal：基于基础模型信号的无监督置信度校准方法
papers.authors: Hexiang Tan, Wanli Yang, Junwei Zhang, Xin Chen, Rui Tang, Du Su, Jingang Wang, Yuanzhuo Wang, Fei Sun, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Reliable confidence is essential for trusting the outputs of LLMs, yet widely deployed post-trained LLMs (PoLLMs) typically compromise this trust with severe overconfidence. In contrast, we observe that their corresponding base LLMs often remain well-calibrated. This naturally motivates us to calibrate PoLLM confidence using the base LLM as a reference. This work proposes two ways to achieve this. A straightforward solution, BaseCal-ReEval, evaluates PoLLM’s responses by feeding them into the base LLM to get average probabilities as confidence. While effective, this approach introduces additional inference overhead. To address this, we propose BaseCal-Proj, which trains a lightweight projection to map the final-layer hidden states of PoLLMs back to those of their base LLMs. These projected states are then processed by the base LLM’s output layer to derive base-calibrated confidence for PoLLM’s responses. Notably, BaseCal is an unsupervised, plug-and-play solution that operates without human labels or LLM modifications. Experiments across five datasets and three LLM families demonstrate the effectiveness of BaseCal, reducing Expected Calibration Error (ECE) by an average of 42.90% compared to the best unsupervised baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 可靠的置信度对于信任大语言模型的输出至关重要。然而，广泛部署后的大语言模型通常会因过度自信而破坏这种信任。相比之下，我们发现相应的基础大语言模型往往仍然保持良好的校准状态。这自然促使我们采用以基础大语言模型为参考来校准PoLLM的置信度。本研究提出了两种实现这一目标的方法。一种简单的解决方案是BaseCal-ReEval，它通过将PoLLM的响应输入到基础大语言模型中，来获取作为置信度的平均概率。虽然这种方法有效，但它会引入额外的推理开销。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了BaseCal-Proj方法，该方法训练了一个轻量级的投影算法，将PoLLM的最终层隐藏状态映射回其基础大语言模型的相应状态。然后，这些投影后的状态由基础大语言模型的输出层处理，从而得出PoLLM响应的基础校准置信度。值得注意的是，BaseCal是一种无监督的即插即用解决方案，无需人工标注或修改大语言模型即可运行。在五个数据集和三个大语言模型家族上的实验表明，BaseCal的有效性显著，与最好的无监督基线相比，平均减少了42.90%的预期校准误差。

papers.title: Beyond the Final Actor: Modeling the Dual Roles of Creator and Editor for Fine-Grained LLM-Generated Text Detection
papers.title_zh: 超越最终执行者：模拟创造者与编辑在精细粒度大语言模型生成文本检测中的双重角色
papers.authors: Yang Li, Qiang Sheng, Zhengjia Wang, Yehan Yang, Danding Wang, Juan Cao
papers.abstract: The misuse of large language models (LLMs) requires precise detection of synthetic text. Existing works mainly follow binary or ternary classification settings, which can only distinguish pure human/LLM text or collaborative text at best. This remains insufficient for the nuanced regulation, as the LLM-polished human text and humanized LLM text often trigger different policy consequences. In this paper, we explore fine-grained LLM-generated text detection under a rigorous four-class setting. To handle such complexities, we propose RACE (Rhetorical Analysis for Creator-Editor Modeling), a fine-grained detection method that characterizes the distinct signatures of creator and editor. Specifically, RACE utilizes Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST) to construct a logic graph for the creator’s foundation while extracting Elementary Discourse Unit (EDU)-level features for the editor’s style. Experiments show that RACE outperforms 12 baselines in identifying fine-grained types with low false alarms, offering a policy-aligned solution for LLM regulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的滥用需要精确检测合成文本。现有的方法主要采用二元或三元分类方式，这种分类方式最多只能区分纯人工文本与LLM生成的文本，或者协作生成的文本。然而，这种方式对于细致的监管来说仍然不够充分，因为经过LLM处理的合成文本与具有人情味的LLM文本往往会导致不同的政策后果。在本文中，我们在一个严格的四类分类框架下，探索了对LLM生成文本的细粒度检测方法。为了应对这些复杂性问题，我们提出了RACE（Rhetorical Analysis for Creator-Editor Modeling）这一细粒度检测方法。该方法能够区分创作者和编辑者的不同特征。具体来说，RACE利用修辞结构理论来构建创作者的基础逻辑图，同时提取编辑风格的基本话语单元特征。实验表明，RACE在识别细粒度类型方面优于12种基线方法，且误报率较低，为LLM的监管提供了符合政策的解决方案。

papers.title: PILOT: Planning via Internalized Latent Optimization Trajectories for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 试点项目：通过内部化的潜在优化路径来规划大型语言模型的发展
papers.authors: Haoyu Zheng, Yun Zhu, Yuqian Yuan, Bo Yuan, Wenqiao Zhang, Siliang Tang, Jun Xiao
papers.abstract: Strategic planning is critical for multi-step reasoning, yet compact Language Language Models (LLMs) often lack the capacity to formulate global strategies, leading to error propagation in long-horizon tasks. Our analysis reveals that LLMs possess latent reasoning capabilities that can be unlocked when conditioned on explicit plans from a teacher model; however, runtime reliance on external guidance is often impractical due to latency and availability constraints. To bridge this gap, we propose PILOT (Planning via Internalized Latent Optimization Trajectories), a non-invasive framework designed to internalize the strategic oversight of large models into intrinsic Latent Guidance. Instead of altering backbone weights, PILOT employs a lightweight Hyper-Network to synthesize a query-conditioned Latent Guidance. This vector acts as an internal steering mechanism, guiding the model’s representations toward optimal reasoning paths. Extensive experiments on mathematical and coding benchmarks demonstrate that PILOT effectively stabilizes reasoning trajectories, consistently outperforming strong baselines (e.g., +8.9% on MATH500) with negligible inference latency. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PILOT-B266
papers.abstract_zh: 战略规划对于多步骤推理至关重要，然而，紧凑型语言模型通常缺乏制定全局策略的能力，这会导致在长视域任务中出现错误传播现象。我们的分析表明，当以教师模型的明确计划为条件时，语言模型具备潜在的推理能力；然而，由于延迟和可用性限制，依赖外部指导进行运行时操作往往不切实际。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了PILOT（通过内部化潜在优化轨迹进行规划）这一非侵入式框架。该框架旨在将大型模型的战略监督内化为内在的潜在指导机制。PILOT并不改变主干权重，而是利用轻量级的超网络来合成一个基于查询条件的潜在指导向量。这个向量充当内部引导机制，引导模型的表示朝着最优的推理路径发展。在数学和编程基准测试中的大量实验表明，PILOT能够有效稳定推理轨迹，其性能始终优于强大的基线模型（例如在MATH500上的提升幅度达到+8.9%），同时推理延迟极低。我们的代码可在此处获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PILOT-B266

papers.title: Miner: Mining Intrinsic Mastery for Data-Efficient RL in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 矿工：在大规模推理模型中，挖掘用于高效数据处理的强化学习内在技巧
papers.authors: Shuyang Jiang, Yuhao Wang, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Yu Wang
papers.abstract: Current critic-free RL methods for large reasoning models suffer from severe inefficiency when training on positive homogeneous prompts (where all rollouts are correct), resulting in waste of rollouts due to zero advantage estimates. We introduce a radically simple yet powerful solution to Mine intrinsic mastery (Miner), that repurposes the policy’s intrinsic uncertainty as a self-supervised reward signal, with no external supervision, auxiliary models, or additional inference cost. Our method pioneers two key innovations: (1) a token-level focal credit assignment mechanism that dynamically amplifies gradients on critical uncertain tokens while suppressing overconfident ones, and (2) adaptive advantage calibration to seamlessly integrate intrinsic and verifiable rewards. Evaluated across six reasoning benchmarks on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B base models, Miner achieves state-of-the-art performance among the other four algorithms, yielding up to 4.58 absolute gains in Pass@1 and 6.66 gains in Pass@K compared to GRPO. Comparison with other methods targeted at exploration enhancement further discloses the superiority of the two newly proposed innovations. This demonstrates that latent uncertainty exploitation is both necessary and sufficient for efficient and scalable RL training of reasoning models. Code is available at https://github.com/pixas/Miner.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前用于大型推理模型的无评论强化学习方法，在训练时使用正面且同质的提示时存在严重的效率问题——因为所有尝试都正确，导致由于无法获得有效的优势估计而浪费了尝试机会。我们提出了一种极其简单但高效的解决方案来改进Mine算法：将策略的内在不确定性作为自监督的奖励信号，无需外部监督、辅助模型或额外的推理成本。我们的方法实现了两项关键创新：(1) 一种基于令牌级别的焦点信用分配机制，能够动态放大关键不确定令牌上的梯度，同时抑制过于自信的令牌；(2) 自适应优势校准机制，能够无缝整合内在性和可验证性奖励。在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B基础模型上进行的六项推理基准测试中，Mine算法在其他四种算法中表现最为出色，其Pass@1指标的绝对增益高达4.58，而Pass@K指标的增益则达到了6.66，相比GRPO算法有显著优势。与其他旨在提升探索能力的方法相比，进一步证明了这两项新提出的创新成果的优越性。这表明，利用潜在的不确定性是高效且可扩展的推理模型强化学习训练所必需的充分条件。代码可在https://github.com/pixas/Miner获取。

papers.title: CEDAR: A Chinese Evaluation Dataset for Computational Argumentation
papers.title_zh: CEDAR：一个用于计算性论证的中文评估数据集
papers.authors: Tian Lan, Jiang Li, Rong Yan, Feilong Bao, Weihua Wang, Guanglai Gao, Xiangdong Su
papers.abstract: Computational argumentation has received increasing attention in recent years. However, existing debate datasets neglect some important labels for argument mining, generation, and evaluation. Meanwhile, the lack of comprehensively annotated Chinese oral debate datasets hinders progress in this field. To address these gaps, we introduce a comprehensive Chinese Evaluation Dataset for Computational Argumentation, named CEDAR. Compared to previous datasets, CEDAR includes the essential labels of computational argumentation (claim, stance, evidence) and five additional crucial labels: rhetorical figures, debater roles, modal words, utterance time, and debate results. Moreover, it offers complete transcripts of each debate, including speeches from the Pro and Con sides. Thus, the proposed CEDAR not only supports common argument mining and generation tasks, but also provides resources for rhetorical figure detection, argument quality evaluation, and debate result prediction. This dataset covers 600 debates about 318 topics from Chinese debate competitions. Besides providing a dataset for research, we conduct experiments on common computational argument tasks and a novel task (rhetorical figure detection), in which we also evaluate LLMs. The experimental results highlight the challenging nature of the dataset. Our corpus is available at https://github.com/VelikayaScarlet/CEDAR.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，计算论证领域受到了越来越多的关注。然而，现有的辩论数据集在用于论证挖掘、生成和评估时，存在一些重要的标签被忽略了。同时，缺乏全面标注的中文口头辩论数据集也阻碍了该领域的进展。为了弥补这些不足，我们引入了一个全面的中文计算论证评估数据集，名为CEDAR。与以往的数据集相比，CEDAR包含了计算论证所需的基本标签（主张、立场、证据）以及五个额外的关键标签：修辞手法、辩论者角色、模态词、发言时间以及辩论结果。此外，该数据集还提供了每场辩论的完整记录，包括正反双方的发言内容。因此，CEDAR不仅支持常见的论证挖掘和生成任务，还为修辞手法检测、论证质量评估以及辩论结果预测提供了资源。该数据集涵盖了来自中国辩论比赛的600场辩论，涉及318个主题。除了作为研究数据外，我们还对常见的计算论证任务以及一项新的任务——修辞手法检测进行了实验，并在实验中评估了大语言模型的表现。实验结果凸显了该数据集的复杂性。我们的数据集可以在https://github.com/VelikayaScarlet/CEDAR下载。

papers.title: MSEarth: A Multimodal Benchmark for Earth Science Phenomenon Discovery with MLLMs
papers.title_zh: MSEarth：一种用于地球科学现象发现的多模态基准测试平台，采用大型语言模型进行推理
papers.authors: Xiangyu Zhao, Wanghan Xu, Bo Liu, Yuhao Zhou, Fenghua Ling, Ben Fei, Xiaoyu Yue, Lei Bai, Wenlong Zhang, Xiao-Ming Wu
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offers new opportunities for complex scientific challenges, yet their application in earth science—especially at the graduate level—remains underexplored due to a lack of benchmarks reflecting the depth and complexity of geoscientific reasoning. Existing datasets often rely on synthetic data or simple figure-caption pairs, failing to capture the nuanced reasoning required for real-world applications. To address this, we introduce MSEarth, a multimodal scientific dataset and benchmark curated from high-quality, open-access publications. Covering the five major spheres of Earth science—atmosphere, cryosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere, and biosphere—MSEarth features over 289K figures with refined captions enriched by contextual discussions and reasoning from the original papers. The benchmark supports tasks such as scientific figure captioning, multiple choice questions, and open-ended reasoning, providing a scalable, high-fidelity resource for developing and evaluating MLLMs in scientific reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型的快速发展为复杂的科学挑战带来了新的机遇。然而，在地球科学领域——尤其是在研究生阶段——它们的应用仍然没有得到充分探索，因为缺乏能够反映地质科学推理深度和复杂性的基准数据集。现有的数据集往往依赖于合成数据或简单的图例描述，无法涵盖现实应用中所需的精细推理能力。为了应对这一问题，我们推出了MSEarth这一多模态科学数据集和基准测试平台，该数据集来自高质量、开放获取的出版物。MSEarth涵盖了地球科学的五个主要领域：大气圈、冰冻圈、水圈、岩石圈和生物圈，包含超过28.9万张带有详细图例的图表，这些图例还包含了来自原始论文中的上下文描述和推理内容。该基准测试支持科学图表描述、选择题以及开放式推理等任务，为开发和评估多模态大语言模型在科学推理方面的性能提供了可扩展且高精度的资源。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Reasoning Structure Matters for Safety Alignment of Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 推理结构对推理模型的安全性至关重要
papers.authors: Yeonjun In, Wonjoong Kim, Sangwu Park, Chanyoung Park
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks but often generate harmful responses to malicious user queries. This paper investigates the underlying cause of these safety risks and shows that the issue lies in the reasoning structure itself. Based on this insight, we claim that effective safety alignment can be achieved by altering the reasoning structure. We propose AltTrain, a simple yet effective post-training method that explicitly alters the reasoning structure of LRMs. AltTrain is both practical and generalizable, requiring no complex reinforcement learning (RL) training or reward design—only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with a lightweight 1K training examples. Experiments across LRM backbones and model sizes demon strate strong safety alignment, along with robust generalization across reasoning, QA, summarization, and multilingual setting.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在复杂的推理任务上表现优异，但往往会对恶意用户查询产生有害的响应。本文探讨了这些安全风险的根本原因，发现问题出在推理结构本身。基于这一洞察，我们认为通过改变推理结构可以实现有效的安全对齐。我们提出了AltTrain这一简单而有效的后训练方法，它能够直接修改LRM的推理结构。AltTrain既实用又具有通用性，无需复杂的强化学习训练或奖励设计——只需使用轻量级的1K训练样本进行有监督的微调即可。实验表明，无论是针对不同的LRM框架还是不同规模的模型，AltTrain都能实现强大的安全对齐效果，同时还能在推理、问答、摘要和多语言场景中实现稳健的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Investigating the Representation of Backchannels and Fillers in Fine-tuned Language Models
papers.title_zh: 探究精细调优语言模型中辅助通道与填充词的呈现方式
papers.authors: Yu Wang, Leyi Lao, Langchu Huang, Gabriel Skantze, Yang Xu, Hendrik Buschmeier
papers.abstract: Backchannels and fillers are important linguistic expressions in dialogue, but often treated as “noise” to be bypassed in modern transformer-based language models. Our work studies the representation of them in language models using three fine-tuning strategies. The models are trained on three dialogue corpora in English and Japanese, where backchannels and fillers are preserved and annotated, to investigate how fine-tuning can help LMs learn their representations. We first apply clustering analysis to the learnt representation of backchannels and fillers, and have found increased silhouette scores in representations from fine-tuned models, which suggests that fine-tuning enables LMs to distinguish the nuanced semantic variation in different backchannel and filler use. We also use natural language generation (NLG) metrics and qualitative analysis to confirm that the utterances generated by fine-tuned language models resemble human-produced utterances more closely. Our findings suggest the potentials of transforming general LMs into conversational LMs that are more capable of producing human-like languages adequately.
papers.abstract_zh: 在对话中，回话和填充词是重要的语言表达形式，但在现代基于Transformer的语言模型中，它们往往被视作需要忽略的“噪音”。我们的研究通过三种微调策略，探讨了这些词汇在语言模型中的表示方式。这些模型是在包含英语和日语对话数据的三个语料库上训练的，其中回话和填充词被保留并进行了标注，以此来探究微调如何帮助语言模型学习它们的表示方式。我们首先对回话和填充词的表示结果进行了聚类分析，发现经过微调的模型的表示结果在轮廓得分上有所提升，这表明微调使得语言模型能够区分不同回话和填充词使用方式下的细微语义差异。我们还使用了自然语言生成指标和定性分析来验证，经过微调的语言模型生成的文本与人类生成的文本更为相似。我们的研究结果表明，将普通语言模型转化为更擅长生成类似人类语言的对话式语言模型具有巨大潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Retrievals Can Be Detrimental: Unveiling the Backdoor Vulnerability of Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Models
papers.title_zh: 检索操作可能带来危害：揭示基于检索增强扩散模型的隐藏漏洞
papers.authors: Hao Fang, Xiaohang Sui, Hongyao Yu, Kuofeng Gao, Jiawei Kong, Sijin Yu, Bin Chen, Shu-Tao Xia
papers.abstract: Diffusion models (DMs) have recently exhibited impressive generation capability. However, their training generally requires huge computational resources and large-scale datasets. To solve these, recent studies empower DMs with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), yielding retrieval-augmented diffusion models (RDMs) that enhance performance with reduced parameters. Despite the success, RAG may introduce novel security issues that warrant further investigation. In this paper, we propose BadRDM, the first poisoning framework targeting RDMs, to systematically investigate their vulnerability to backdoor attacks. Our framework fully considers RAG’s characteristics by manipulating the retrieved items for specific text triggers to ultimately control the generated outputs. Specifically, we first insert a tiny portion of images into the retrieval database as target toxicity surrogates. We then exploit the contrastive learning mechanism underlying retrieval models by designing a malicious variant that establishes robust shortcuts from triggers to toxicity surrogates. In addition, we introduce novel entropy-based selection and generative augmentation strategies for better toxicity surrogates. Extensive experiments on two mainstream tasks show that the proposed method achieves outstanding attack effects while preserving benign utility. Notably, BadRDM remains effective even under common defense strategies, further highlighting serious security concerns for RDMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散模型最近展现出了令人印象深刻的生成能力。然而，其训练通常需要巨大的计算资源以及大规模的数据集。为了解决这些问题，近期的研究将检索增强生成技术应用于扩散模型，从而产生了检索增强扩散模型，这种模型能够在减少参数的同时提升性能。尽管取得了成功，但检索增强技术也可能引入新的安全问题，这些问题值得进一步研究。在本文中，我们提出了BadRDM这一首个针对扩散模型的注入攻击框架，旨在系统地研究它们对后门攻击的脆弱性。我们的框架通过操纵检索到的项目以响应特定的文本触发器，从而完全考虑了检索增强技术的特性，进而能够控制生成的输出结果。具体来说，我们首先在检索数据库中插入少量图像作为目标毒性代理。然后，我们通过设计一种恶意变体来利用检索模型背后的对比学习机制，从而从触发器到毒性代理之间建立可靠的捷径。此外，我们还引入了基于熵的选择方法和生成增强策略，以得到更好的毒性代理效果。在两项主流任务上的广泛实验表明，所提出的方法在保持良性功能的同时，能够实现出色的攻击效果。值得注意的是，即使在常见的防御策略下，BadRDM仍然有效，这进一步凸显了扩散模型存在严重的安全隐患。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Theoretically Grounded Approach to Summarizing Conversation Dynamics for Forecasting the Derailment of Online Conversations
papers.title_zh: 一种基于理论的方法，用于总结对话中的动态信息，从而预测在线对话中可能出现的中断情况
papers.authors: Yingxue Fu, Anaïs Ollagnier
papers.abstract: Conversation derailment prediction represents a new paradigm of toxicity detection, where a system predicts from the start of a conversation whether it will derail into toxic exchanges, allowing moderators and users to act preemptively before harm is done. This approach requires a deep understanding of conversation dynamics. Previous work relies on linguistic features rooted in linguistic and social theories. While these features provide signals of conversation dynamics, they are exploratory in nature and potentially reflect a fraction of the overall pragmatic devices shaping the conversation trajectory. To capture the pragmatic dimension of conversations systematically, we start with a framework for annotating pragmatic information of conversations systematically and design summary generation methods to capture conversation trajectory dynamically. We achieve about 10% performance increase over a simple baseline, and 6.47% increase over a strong baseline on a dataset, and a slight performance increase on a benchmark dataset for the task of summarizing conversation dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 对话偏离预测是一种新的毒性检测方法。该系统能够从对话开始阶段就预测是否会出现偏离正常轨道的恶性交流，从而让管理员和用户在伤害发生之前采取预防措施。这种方法需要深入理解对话的动态变化。以往的研究依赖于基于语言和社会理论的语言特征分析。虽然这些特征能够反映对话的动态变化，但它们本质上属于探索性研究，可能只能捕捉到影响对话进程的部分因素。为了系统地捕捉对话中的实用维度，我们首先构建了一个系统化的标注工具，用于记录对话中的实用信息；同时设计了动态总结方法，以实时捕捉对话的演变过程。在测试数据集上，我们的性能相比简单的基线方法提升了约10%，而在强大的基线数据集上则提升了6.47%。在总结对话动态的基准测试任务中，我们的性能也有轻微提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DPDV: Dual-Pathway and Dual-View Representation Learning for Bridging Information Asymmetry in Text-Video Retrieval
papers.title_zh: DPDV：双路径与双视图表示学习，用于解决文本与视频检索中的信息不对称问题
papers.authors: Zequn Xie, Xin Liu, Fangming Feng, Boyun Zhang, Tao Jin
papers.abstract: In recent years, CLIP-based text-video retrieval methods have developed rapidly, with research focusing on constructing diverse features and achieving effective interactions. However, the asymmetry of cross-modal information poses a challenge to accurately establishing retrieval relationships. To overcome this challenge, we propose a novel video retrieval framework, termed the Dual-Pathway and Dual-View model (DPDV), which consists of the Dual-Pathway Partitioning Module (DPPM) for constructing features at an appropriate granularity and the Dual-View Interaction Module (DVIM) for performing effective feature interactions. For DPPM, we simulate a human macro-level cognitive perspective by partitioning visual features into two categories based on their relevance to the text query and supplementing less relevant features with additional textual information. For DVIM, we simulate a human alignment strategy from macro to micro levels, focusing on local visual features while comprehensively modeling fine-grained interactions. We evaluate DPDV on five benchmark datasets, achieving leading retrieval performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，基于CLIP的文本-视频检索方法发展迅速，相关研究主要集中在构建多样化的特征以及实现有效的特征交互上。然而，跨模态信息的不对称性给准确建立检索关系带来了挑战。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的视频检索框架——双路径与双视图模型（DPDV）。该模型包含双路径分割模块（DPPM），用于以适当的粒度构建特征；以及双视图交互模块（DVIM），用于实现有效的特征交互。对于DPPM模块，我们通过将视觉特征根据其与文本查询的相关性分为两类，并补充较少相关的特征以额外的文本信息，从而模拟人类宏观层面的认知视角。对于DVIM模块，我们模拟了从宏观到微观层面的人类对齐策略，重点关注局部视觉特征，同时全面建模细粒度的交互。我们在五个基准数据集上对DPDV进行了评估，取得了领先的检索性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Who Wrote This Line? Evaluating the Detection of LLM-Generated Classical Chinese Poetry
papers.title_zh: 是谁写了这句诗？评估大语言模型生成的中国古典诗歌的识别能力
papers.authors: Jiang Li, Tian Lan, Shanshan Wang, Dongxing Zhang, Dianqing Lin, Guanglai Gao, Derek F. Wong, Xiangdong Su
papers.abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has extended text generation tasks into the literary domain. However, AI-generated literary creations has raised increasingly prominent issues of creative authenticity and ethics in literary world, making the detection of LLM-generated literary texts essential and urgent. While previous works have made significant progress in detecting AI-generated text, it has yet to address classical Chinese poetry. Due to the unique linguistic features of classical Chinese poetry, such as strict metrical regularity, a shared system of poetic imagery, and flexible syntax, distinguishing whether a poem is authored by AI presents a substantial challenge. To address these issues, we introduce ChangAn, a benchmark for detecting LLM-generated classical Chinese poetry that containing total 30,664 poems, 10,276 are human-written poems and 20,388 poems are generated by four popular LLMs. Based on ChangAn, we conducted a systematic evaluation of 12 AI detectors, investigating their performance variations across different text granularities and generation strategies. Our findings highlight the limitations of current Chinese text detectors, which fail to serve as reliable tools for detecting LLM-generated classical Chinese poetry. These results validate the effectiveness and necessity of our proposed ChangAn benchmark. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/VelikayaScarlet/ChangAn.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展将文本生成任务拓展到了文学领域。然而，人工智能生成的文学作品在创意真实性和伦理方面引发了日益严重的问题，因此检测由LLM生成的文学文本变得至关重要且紧迫。虽然之前的研究在检测人工智能生成的文本方面取得了显著进展，但至今仍未解决古典汉语诗歌的检测问题。由于古典汉语诗歌具有独特的语言特征，如严格的韵律规律、统一的诗意意象体系以及灵活的句法结构，判断一首诗是否由人工智能生成面临着巨大的挑战。为了应对这些问题，我们开发了ChangAn这一用于检测由LLM生成的古典汉语诗歌的基准测试平台。该平台包含30,664首诗歌，其中10,276首是人工创作的，20,388首是由四种流行的LLM生成的。基于ChangAn，我们对12种人工智能检测器进行了系统评估，研究了它们在不同文本粒度和生成策略下的性能表现。我们的研究发现揭示了当前中文文本检测器的局限性，它们无法作为检测由LLM生成的古典汉语诗歌的可靠工具。这些结果验证了我们所提出的ChangAn基准测试平台的有效性和必要性。我们的数据集和代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/VelikayaScarlet/ChangAn
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Representation Interventions Enable Lifelong Knowledge Memory Control in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 代表性干预机制使得大语言模型能够长期掌控知识记忆的存储与处理
papers.authors: Xuyuan Liu, Shengyu Chen, Xinshuai Dong, Yanchi Liu, Xujiang Zhao, Haoyu Wang, Yujun Yan, Haifeng Chen, Zhengzhang Chen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often produce incorrect or outdated content. Updating their knowledge efficiently and accurately without costly retraining is a major challenge. This problem is particularly challenging for complex, unstructured knowledge in lifelong settings, where many edits must coexist without interference. We introduce RILKE (Representation Intervention for Lifelong KnowledgE Control), a robust and scalable method that treats knowledge control as interventions within the model’s representation space. Leveraging representation-space expressiveness, we identify two key properties enabling RILKE to achieve fine-grained control over complex, unstructured knowledge while maintaining general utility with frozen base weights. During training, RILKE learns paraphrase-robust and edit-localized modules that limit each update to a low-dimensional subspace to minimize cross-edit interference. In inference, a query-adaptive router selects the appropriate module to guide the model’s generation. Across LLaMA and Qwen models, RILKE scales effectively to large-scale benchmarks, demonstrating high edit success and strong paraphrase generalization while preserving general utility with modest memory overhead. These results show RILKE is an effective and scalable solution for lifelong knowledge control in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常常产生错误或过时的内容。高效地、准确地更新它们的知识，同时避免昂贵的重新训练，是一个巨大的挑战。对于复杂且无结构的知识来说，这个问题尤为棘手，因为在这些环境中，许多编辑内容必须共存而不产生干扰。我们提出了RILKE（终身知识控制表示干预法），这是一种强大且可扩展的方法，它将知识控制视为模型表示空间中的干预措施。通过利用表示空间的表达能力，我们发现了两个关键特性，使得RILKE能够实现对复杂无结构知识的精细控制，同时保持基本权重固定的通用性。在训练过程中，RILKE学习了能够处理不同释义的模块，并且将每次更新限制在低维子空间中，以最小化不同编辑之间的干扰。在推理阶段，一个自适应查询路由器会选择合适的模块来指导模型的生成。无论是在LaLAMA还是Qwen模型中，RILKE都能有效扩展到大规模基准测试中，显示出高编辑成功率、良好的释义泛化能力，同时保持了通用性，且内存开销较小。这些结果表明，RILKE是LLM中一种有效且可扩展的终身知识控制解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SLoRA: Balancing Plasticity and Forgetting in Large Language Models for Continual Learning
papers.title_zh: SLoRA：在大型语言模型中平衡可塑性与遗忘机制，以实现持续学习
papers.authors: Lina Yang, Yusheng Liao, Yanfeng Wang, Yu Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks through large-scale pretraining. However, they remain prone to catastrophic forgetting in continual learning. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to identify noise accumulation in LoRA updates as a key cause of forgetting in continual learning. A preliminary two-task experiment demonstrates that removing less important components of the second task’s LoRA parameters improves performance on the first task, suggesting that later updates introduce noisy interference. Building on this insight, we propose Subspace-Denoised Low-Rank Adaptation (SLoRA), a simple and effective framework that filters noisy components from LoRA updates via subspace similarity with the base model. SLoRA is a regularization-free method without accessing data or gradients from previous tasks or modifying the training process. It offers two variants, SLoRA-Pre and SLoRA-Post, for online and offline continual learning, respectively. Extensive experiments across tasks and models validate the effectiveness of SLoRA. It improves final accuracy by up to 12%, reduces forgetting by 29%, and filters out over 30% of LoRA parameters identified as noisy. Our code is available at https://github.com/alina1031/SLoRA.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在大规模预训练的基础上，已经在多种任务中取得了显著的成果。然而，它们在持续学习过程中仍然容易出现灾难性遗忘问题。据我们所知，这是第一项将LoRA更新中的噪声积累视为持续学习遗忘问题的关键原因的研究。一项初步的双任务实验表明，去除第二任务LoRA参数中不太重要的成分可以提高第一任务的性能，这表明后续的更新引入了噪声干扰。基于这一发现，我们提出了Subspace-Denoised Low-Rank Adaptation（SLoRA）框架。这是一种简单有效的方法，通过与基础模型的子空间相似性来过滤LoRA更新中的噪声成分。SLoRA是一种无需访问先前任务的数据或梯度、也不修改训练过程的方法。它提供了两种变体：SLoRA-Pre和SLoRA-Post，分别适用于在线和离线的持续学习场景。在多种任务和模型上的广泛实验验证了SLoRA的有效性。它可以将最终准确率提高多达12%，减少29%的遗忘现象，并过滤掉超过30%被识别为噪声的LoRA参数。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/alina1031/SLoRA下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: G-Cap: A Game Character Caption Generator
papers.title_zh: G-Cap：游戏角色标题生成器
papers.authors: Yang Yang, Feng Hu, Haiming Zhang, XU Cheng, Gui Zheng, Liang Yao, Wenqi Ren
papers.abstract: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in image captioning, existing research primarily focuses on real-world scenarios, leaving surreal, highly stylized, and semantically hybrid virtual-world scenarios significantly underexplored. In this work, we introduce Game Character Captioning, a novel task designed to evaluate LVLMs’ capability to perceive and describe game character from the virtual-world. To facilitate evaluation, we establish GC-Bench, a manually annotated benchmark, and propose Graph-F1 to effectively assess performance on this task. Our evaluation reveals that: (1) current state-of-the-art LVLMs, including closed-source giants such as Gemini 3 Pro and GPT-5.1, struggle to maintain the high performance seen in real-world scenarios; and (2) a notable gap exists between open-source and closed-source models. To bridge this gap, we construct GC-148K, a large-scale dataset generated via a specialized data pipeline, and develop the G-Cap series. Experiments demonstrate that G-Cap series rivals the performance of advanced closed-source models at a lower cost, offering an efficient solution for industrial-grade production environment.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大型视觉语言模型在图像描述任务上表现出色，但现有研究主要聚焦于现实世界场景，而那些具有超现实性、高度风格化且语义复杂的虚拟世界场景却鲜被探索。在这项研究中，我们提出了“游戏角色描述”这一新任务，旨在评估视觉语言模型从虚拟世界中感知和描述游戏角色的能力。为了便于评估，我们建立了GC-Bench这个带有手动标注的基准测试集，并提出了Graph-F1算法来有效评估该任务的性能。我们的评估结果显示：(1)当前最先进的视觉语言模型，包括像Gemini 3 Pro和GPT-5.1这样的开源大模型，在维持现实世界场景中的高性能方面存在困难；(2)开源模型和闭源模型之间存在明显的性能差距。为了弥补这一差距，我们构建了一个名为GC-148K的大规模数据集，并通过专门的数据处理流程生成了G-Cap系列模型。实验表明，G-Cap系列模型能够在较低的成本下达到与先进闭源模型相当的性能水平，为工业级生产环境提供了一种高效的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Common to Whom? Regional Cultural Commonsense and LLM Bias in India
papers.title_zh: 属于谁的公共资源？印度的地区性文化常识与大型语言模型偏见
papers.authors: Sangmitra Madhusudan, Trush Shashank More, Steph Buongiorno, Renata Dividino, Jad Kabbara, Ali Emami
papers.abstract: Existing cultural commonsense benchmarks treat nations as monolithic, assuming uniform practices within national boundaries. But does cultural commonsense hold uniformly within a nation, or does it vary at the sub-national level? We introduce Indica, the first benchmark designed to test LLMs’ ability to address this question, focusing on India—a nation of 28 states, 8 union territories, and 22 official languages. We collect human-annotated answers from five Indian regions (North, South, East, West, and Central) across 515 questions spanning 8 domains of everyday life, yielding 1,630 region-specific question-answer pairs. Strikingly, only 39.4% of questions elicit agreement across all five regions, demonstrating that cultural commonsense in India is predominantly regional, not national. We evaluate eight state-of-the-art LLMs and find two critical gaps: models achieve only 13.4%–20.9% accuracy on region-specific questions, and they exhibit geographic bias, over-selecting Central and North India as the “default” (selected 30-40% more often than expected) while under-representing East and West. Beyond India, our methodology provides a generalizable framework for evaluating cultural commonsense in any culturally heterogeneous nation, from question design grounded in anthropological taxonomy, to regional data collection, to bias measurement.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的文化常识基准将各个国家视为单一整体，假设国家边界内的做法都是统一的。但是，文化常识在单个国家内部是否也保持一致呢？还是在不同地区之间存在差异呢？我们推出了Indica这一基准工具，它旨在测试大语言模型解决这个问题的能力。我们的研究重点是在印度这个由28个邦、8个联邦领土和22种官方语言组成的国家中进行。我们从印度的五个地区（北部、南部、东部、西部和中部）收集了人类标注的答案，涉及515个问题，涵盖日常生活的八个领域，最终得到了1,630对地区特定的问题-答案对。令人惊讶的是，只有39.4%的问题在五个地区都能得到一致的答案，这表明印度的文化常识主要是地区性的，而非全国性的。我们评估了八种最先进的大语言模型，发现两个关键问题：这些模型在针对地区特定问题的准确率仅为13.4%至20.9%，并且存在地理偏见，即模型更倾向于将中部和北部地区作为“默认答案”（被选中的频率比预期高出30%-40%），而忽视了东部和西部地区的代表性。除了印度之外，我们的方法可以为评估任何具有不同文化的国家的文化常识提供一个通用的框架，从基于人类学分类的问题设计，到地区性数据的收集，再到偏见的测量，都可以通过我们的方法来实现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Stackelberg Speaker: Optimizing Persuasive Communication in Social Deduction Games
papers.title_zh: 斯塔克伯格发言人：在社交推理游戏中优化说服性沟通策略
papers.authors: Zhang Zheng, Deheng Ye, Peilin Zhao, Hao Wang
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown remarkable progress in social deduction games (SDGs). However, existing approaches primarily focus on information processing and strategy selection, overlooking the significance of persuasive communication in influencing other players’ beliefs and responses. In SDGs, success depends not only on making correct deductions but also on convincing others to respond in alignment with one’s intent. To address this limitation, we formalize turn-based dialogue in SDGs as a Stackelberg competition, where the current player acts as the leader who strategically influences the follower’s response. Building on this theoretical foundation, we propose a reinforcement learning framework that trains agents to optimize utterances for persuasive impact. Through comprehensive experiments across four diverse social deduction benchmarks, we demonstrate that our agents significantly outperform baselines. This work represents a significant step toward developing AI agents capable of strategic social influence, with implications extending to scenarios requiring persuasive communication. Our code and data are available at https://3dagentworld.github.io/leader_follower.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理在社交推理游戏中取得了显著进展。然而，现有的方法主要集中在信息处理和策略选择上，而忽视了有说服力的沟通在影响其他玩家信念和反应方面的重要性。在社交推理游戏中，成功不仅取决于做出正确的推理，还取决于能否说服他人按照自己的意图行事。为了克服这一局限性，我们将社交推理中的回合式对话形式抽象为斯塔克伯格竞争模型，其中当前玩家扮演领导者角色，通过策略性影响追随者的反应来实现目标。基于这一理论框架，我们提出了一种强化学习框架，该框架能够训练代理优化话语以产生有说服力的效果。通过针对四个不同社交推理基准进行的全面实验，我们发现我们的代理表现明显优于现有基线方法。这项工作标志着向开发具备战略性社会影响力的AI代理迈出重要一步，其应用范围可扩展到需要有说服力沟通的情境。我们的代码和数据可在https://3dagentworld.github.io/leader_follower获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GuideDog: A Real-World Egocentric Multimodal Dataset for Blind and Low-Vision Accessibility-Aware Guidance
papers.title_zh: GuideDog：一个基于现实场景的、以自我为中心的多模态数据集，适用于盲人和低视力用户的导航需求——提供易于理解的引导信息
papers.authors: Junhyeok Kim, Jaewoo Park, Junhee Park, Sangeyl Lee, Jiwan Chung, Jisung Kim, Ji Hoon Joung, Youngjae Yu
papers.abstract: For people affected by blindness and low vision (BLV), safe and independent navigation remains a major challenge, impacting over 2.2 billion individuals worldwide. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer new opportunities for assistive navigation, progress has been limited by the scarcity of accessibility-aware datasets, requiring labor-intensive, expert annotation. To this end, we introduce GuideDog, a novel dataset containing 22K image-description pairs (2K human-verified) capturing real-world pedestrian scenes across 46 countries. Our human-AI pipeline shifts annotation from generation to verification, grounded in established BLV guidance standards from experts and research, improving scalability while maintaining quality. We also present GuideDogQA, an 818-sample benchmark evaluating object recognition and depth perception. Experiments reveal that depth perception and adherence to these standards remain challenging for current MLLMs. Code and dataset will be publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于患有失明和低视力问题的人来说，安全且独立的导航仍然是一个重大挑战，全球有超过22亿人受到此问题的影响。虽然多模态大语言模型为辅助导航提供了新的机会，但由于可访问性相关数据集的稀缺性，这一进展受到了限制，需要大量的人工注释工作。为此，我们提出了GuideDog这个新颖的数据集，其中包含22K对图像描述对（其中2K是对人类验证过的），这些场景来自46个国家的真实环境。我们的AI与人类协作的标注流程将标注从生成阶段转移到验证阶段，这一流程基于专家和研究界制定的失明和低视力指导标准，从而提升了标注的可扩展性，同时保持了标注质量。我们还提出了GuideDogQA这个包含818个样本的标准测试集，用于评估物体识别能力和深度感知能力。实验结果表明，对于当前的多模态大语言模型来说，深度感知以及遵循这些标准仍然是一项挑战。我们的代码和数据集将公开提供。

papers.title: LogicPoison: Logical Attacks on Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 逻辑毒药：针对图检索增强生成的逻辑攻击
papers.authors: Yilin Xiao, Jin Chen, Qinggang Zhang, Yujing Zhang, Chuang Zhou, Longhao Yang, Lingfei Ren, Xin Yang, Xiao Huang
papers.abstract: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) enhances the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding their responses in structured knowledge graphs. Leveraging community detection and relation filtering techniques, GraphRAG systems demonstrate inherent resistance to traditional RAG attacks, such as text poisoning and prompt injection. However, in this paper, we find that the security of GraphRAG systems fundamentally relies on the topological integrity of the underlying graph, which can be undermined by implicitly corrupting the logical connections, without altering surface-level text semantics. To exploit this vulnerability, we propose LogicPoison, a novel attack framework that targets logical reasoning rather than injecting false contents. Specifically, LogicPoison employs a type-preserving entity swapping mechanism to perturb both global logic hubs for disrupting overall graph connectivity and query-specific reasoning bridges for severing essential multi-hop inference paths. This approach effectively reroutes valid reasoning into dead ends while maintaining surface-level textual plausibility. Comprehensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that LogicPoison successfully bypasses GraphRAG’s defenses, significantly degrading performance and outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in both effectiveness and stealth. Our code is available at https://github.com/Jord8061/logicPoison.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过将大语言模型（LLM）的响应建立在结构化的知识图谱中，提升了这些模型的推理能力。利用社区检测与关系过滤技术，GraphRAG系统能够有效抵御传统的RAG攻击，如文本污染和提示注入等攻击方式。然而，在本文中我们发现，GraphRAG系统的安全性从根本上取决于底层图的拓扑完整性，而这一完整性可能会因隐性破坏逻辑连接而被破坏，而表面层的文本语义则不会受到影响。为了利用这一漏洞，我们提出了LogicPoison这一新型攻击框架，该框架针对的是逻辑推理机制，而非注入虚假内容。具体来说，LogicPoison采用一种保持类型不变的实体替换机制，来干扰全局逻辑枢纽，从而破坏整个图的连通性；同时，它也通过干扰特定查询的推理桥梁，切断重要的多跳推理路径。这种方法能够有效地将有效的推理引导到死胡同中，同时保持表面层文本的合理性。通过多个基准测试的实验表明，LogicPoison成功突破了GraphRAG的防御机制，显著降低了模型的性能，并且在效果和隐蔽性方面均优于现有的最先进基线方法。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Jord8061/logicPoison下载。

papers.title: Par-ITA: Benchmarking Seq2Seq and LLMs on a Human-Supervised Parallel Corpus for Italian Hyperpartisan Neutralization
papers.title_zh: Par-ITA：在包含人类标注数据的平行语料库上，对Seq2Seq模型和大型语言模型进行性能比较，以实现意大利语超党派信息的中立处理
papers.authors: Michele Joshua Maggini, Søren Fomsgaard, Michele Maestroni, Gaël Dias, Pablo Gamallo
papers.abstract: Neutralizing hyperpartisan content is essential for mitigating online polarization, yet research has largely focused on English. We present Par-ITA, a curated subset from Semeval 2023 task 3, consisting in the first human-supervised parallel corpus for Italian hyperpartisan neutralization of 2,475 paragraph pairs. The dataset is constructed using a rigorous three-stage pipeline: (1) expert-led preliminary selection of LLMs for high-quality generation, (2) human-supervised data production with high editing rates (32–68%), and (3) post-hoc human validation. We establish extensive benchmarks for this task across seq2seq and decoder-only architectures, evaluating standard fine-tuning, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and in-context learning. Our analysis highlights that while DPO effectively maximizes neutrality scores in seq2seq models, automated evaluators like GPT-4o-mini exhibit systematic biases, specifically over-penalizing sensitive political topics compared to human experts. Par-ITA provides a foundational resource for non-English neutralization and a reproducible framework for developing high-quality datasets in subjective domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 中和极端党派内容对于缓解网络两极分化至关重要，不过相关研究大多集中在英语领域。我们提出了Par-ITA，这是从Semeval 2023任务3中提取的精选数据集，它是首个由人类监督的意大利语极端党派内容中立化处理数据集，包含2,475对段落样本。该数据集是通过严格的三个阶段流程构建的：(1)由专家主导的LLM初步筛选，以选取出具有高质量生成能力的模型；(2)由人类监督的数据生成过程，其中人类的编辑率高达32%至68%；(3)事后的人工验证。我们为这项任务建立了广泛的基准测试，涵盖了seq2seq架构和仅使用解码器的架构，并评估了标准微调、直接偏好优化以及上下文学习等方法的效果。我们的分析表明，虽然DPO能够在seq2seq模型中有效提升中立性得分，但像GPT-4o-mini这样的自动化评估工具却存在系统性偏差，尤其是过度惩罚敏感的政治话题，这与人类专家的判断存在差异。Par-ITA为非英语文本的中立化处理提供了基础资源，同时也为在主观领域开发高质量数据集提供了一个可复用的框架。

papers.title: Incentivizing Parametric Knowledge via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Cross-Cultural Entity Translation
papers.title_zh: 通过带有可验证奖励的强化学习来激励参数化知识的运用，以实现跨文化实体之间的翻译任务
papers.authors: Jiang Zhou, Xiaohu Zhao, Xinwei Wu, Tianyu Dong, Hao Wang, Yangyang Liu, Heng Liu, Linlong Xu, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Cross-cultural entity translation remains challenging for large language models (LLMs) as literal or phonetic renderings are usually yielded instead of culturally appropriate translations in context. However, relevant knowledge may already be encoded in model parameters during large-scale pre-training. To incentivize the effective use of parametric knowledge, we propose EA-RLVR (Entity-Anchored Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards), a training framework that optimizes cross-cultural entity translation without relying on external knowledge bases. EA-RLVR anchors supervision on a verifiable, entity-level reward signal and incorporates lightweight structural gates to stabilize optimization. This design steers the model toward learning a robust reasoning process rather than merely imitating reference translations. We evaluate EA-RLVR on XC-Translate and observe consistent improvements in both entity translation accuracy and out-of-domain generalization. Specifically, training on merely 7k samples boosts Qwen3-14B’s entity translation accuracy from 23.66% to 31.87% on a 50k test set comprising entirely unseen entities. The learned entity translation ability also transfers to general translation, yielding +1.35 XCOMET on WMT24pp, which scales to +1.59 with extended optimization. Extensive analyses of pass@k dynamics and reward formulations attribute these gains to superior sampling efficiency and a stable optimization landscape.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于大语言模型来说，跨文化实体翻译仍然是一个挑战，因为通常得到的只是逐字的或音标化的翻译结果，而非在特定语境下具有文化适应性的翻译。然而，在大规模预训练过程中，相关知识可能已经编码在模型参数中。为了激励模型有效利用这些参数化知识，我们提出了EA-RLVR这一训练框架——一种无需依赖外部知识库即可优化跨文化实体翻译的方法。EA-RLVR以可验证的实体级奖励信号作为监督手段，并采用轻量级的结构化门控机制来稳定优化过程。这种设计使得模型能够学习出一种稳健的推理能力，而不仅仅是模仿参考翻译的结果。我们在XC-Translate任务上对EA-RLVR进行了评估，发现其在实体翻译准确性和领域泛化能力方面都取得了显著的提升。具体来说，仅使用7k个样本进行训练后，Qwen3-14B在包含完全陌生实体的50k测试集上的实体翻译准确率从23.66%提升到了31.87%。所学习的实体翻译能力也扩展到了通用翻译任务中，在WMT24pp任务上实现了+1.35 XCOMET的改进，而通过进一步优化后，这一数值进一步提升到了+1.59。通过对pass@k动态和奖励机制的深入分析，我们认为这些改进得益于更高效的采样能力和稳定的优化环境。

papers.title: Writing-RL: Advancing Long-form Writing via Adaptive Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 写作强化学习：通过自适应课程强化学习推动长文写作能力的提升
papers.authors: Xuanyu Lei, Chenliang Li, Yuning Wu, Kaiming Liu, Weizhou Shen, Peng Li, Ming Yan, Fei Huang, Ya-Qin Zhang, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled strong performance in long-form writing, but current training paradigms remain limited: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) remains constrained by data saturation and performance ceilings, while Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR), though successful in verifiable domains like math and code, cannot be directly migrated to open-ended long-form writing due to a lack of ground-truths. To further advance long-form writing, we present Writing-RL: an Adaptive Curriculum Reinforcement Learning framework to advance long-form writing capabilities beyond SFT. The framework consists of three key components: Margin-aware Data Selection strategy that prioritizes samples with high learning potential, Pairwise Comparison Reward mechanism that provides discriminative learning signals in the absence of verifiable rewards, and Dynamic Reference Scheduling approach, which plays a critical role by adaptively adjusting task difficulty based on evolving model performance. Experiments on 7B-scale writer models show that Writing-RL effectively improves long-form writing performance over strong SFT baselines. Furthermore, we observe that models trained with long-output RL generalize surprisingly well to long-input reasoning tasks, potentially offering a promising perspective for rethinking long-context training.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展在长文本写作方面取得了显著的性能提升，但当前的训练方法仍然存在局限性：监督式微调受到数据饱和和性能上限的限制；而带有可验证奖励的强化学习虽然能在数学和代码等可验证领域取得良好效果，但由于缺乏真实数据支持，无法直接应用于开放式的长文本写作。为了进一步提升长文本写作能力，我们提出了Writing-RL这一自适应强化学习框架，旨在超越监督式微调的水平。该框架包含三个关键组件：基于边际感知的数据选择策略，用于优先处理具有高学习潜力的样本；成对比较奖励机制，可在缺乏可验证奖励的情况下提供区分性学习信号；以及动态参考调度方法，该方法能够根据模型性能的变化自适应调整任务难度。在7B规模写作模型上的实验表明，Writing-RL能够有效提升长文本写作性能，优于传统的监督式微调方法。此外，我们还观察到，使用长输出强化学习的模型在长输入推理任务上的泛化能力非常强，这为重新思考长上下文训练的方式提供了希望。

papers.title: Spec-o3: A Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Agent for Rare Celestial Object Candidate Vetting via Automated Spectral Inspection
papers.title_zh: Spec-o3：一种基于工具辅助的视觉-语言交互代理，用于通过自动化光谱分析来筛选稀有的天体候选对象
papers.authors: Minghui Jia, Qichao Zhang, Ali Luo, Linjing Li, Shuo Ye, Hailing Lu, Wen Hou, Dongbin Zhao
papers.abstract: Due to the limited generalization and interpretability of deep learning classifiers, the final vetting of rare celestial object candidates still relies on manually intensive expert visual inspection, which has become a primary bottleneck as modern spectroscopic surveys continue to scale.To bridge this gap, we propose Spec-o3, a tool-augmented vision-language agent that performs astronomer-aligned spectral inspection via interleaved multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning.Spec-o3 is trained with a two-stage post-training recipe: cold-start supervised fine-tuning on expert inspection trajectories followed by outcome-based reinforcement learning on rare-type verification tasks.Evaluated on five rare-object identification tasks from LAMOST, Spec-o3 establishes a new State-of-the-Art, boosting the macro-F1 score from 28.3 to 76.5 with a 7B parameter base model and outperforming both proprietary VLMs and specialized deep models. Beyond accuracy, Spec-o3 processes spectra at \sim0.2 s per sample on an 8\timesH100 server, a \sim50\times throughput gain over expert manual inspection. The agent also demonstrates strong generalization to unseen inspection tasks across survey shifts (from LAMOST to SDSS/DESI). Expert evaluations further confirm that its reasoning traces are coherent and physically consistent, supporting transparent and trustworthy decision-making.Code, data, and models are available at Project HomePage.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于深度学习分类器的泛化能力和可解释性有限，对罕见天体候选对象的最终筛选仍然依赖于人工密集的专家视觉检查，这已成为现代光谱调查不断扩展过程中主要的瓶颈。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了Spec-o3这一工具辅助的视觉语言代理，它通过混合多模态的推理方式，执行与天文学家一致的光谱检查工作。Spec-o3的训练采用了两阶段的方法：首先是在专家检查数据上进行冷启动式的监督微调，然后是在罕见类型验证任务上进行基于结果的强化学习训练。在LAMOST提供的五个罕见天体识别任务上进行了评估，Spec-o3取得了新的最佳性能，其宏观F1分数从28.3提升到了76.5，而基础模型的参数数量为7B。与现有的VLM和专用深度模型相比，Spec-o3在准确性之外，还能在8×H100服务器上以每样本约0.2秒的速度处理光谱数据，比专家手动检查的效率提高了约50倍。该代理还表现出对未见过检查任务的强大泛化能力，即使是在不同调查项目之间（如从LAMOST转移到SDSS/DESI），其推理过程依然保持一致且符合物理逻辑，从而支持透明且可信的决策制定。代码、数据和模型均可访问项目主页。

papers.title: ROSE: An Intent-Centered Evaluation Metric for NL2SQL
papers.title_zh: ROSE：一种以意图为中心的评价指标，适用于NL2SQL系统
papers.authors: Wenqi Pei, Shizheng Hou, Boyan Li, Chen Han, Zhichao Shi, Yuyu Luo
papers.abstract: Execution Accuracy (EX), the widely used metric for evaluating the effectiveness of Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) solutions, is becoming increasingly unreliable. It is sensitive to syntactic variation, ignores that questions may admit multiple interpretations, and is easily misled by erroneous ground-truth SQL. To address this, we introduce ROSE, an intent-centered metric that focuses on whether the predicted SQL answers the question, rather than consistency with the ground-truth SQL under the reference-dependent paradigm. ROSE employs an adversarial Prover-Refuter cascade: SQL Prover assesses the semantic correctness of a predicted SQL against the user’s intent independently, while Adversarial Refuter uses the ground-truth SQL as evidence to challenge and refine this judgment. On our expert-aligned validation set ROSE-VEC, ROSE achieves the best agreement with human experts, outperforming the next-best metric by nearly 24% in Cohen’s Kappa. We also conduct a large-scale re-evaluation of 19 NL2SQL methods, revealing four valuable insights. We release ROSE and ROSE-VEC to facilitate more reliable NL2SQL research.
papers.abstract_zh: 执行准确性（EX）是一种常用于评估自然语言与SQL转换解决方案有效性的指标，但这一指标的可信度正在逐渐下降。该指标对语法上的变化非常敏感，忽略了问题可能存在多种解释的情况，同时也容易受到错误基准SQL的影响而产生误判。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了ROSE这一以意图为中心的评估指标。ROSE的重点是预测出的SQL是否能够回答用户的问题，而不是其是否与基准SQL在一致性方面一致。ROSE采用了一种对抗性证明者-反驳者级联机制：SQL证明者独立地评估预测出的SQL的语义正确性，而对抗性反驳者则利用基准SQL作为证据来挑战和修正这一判断。在我们的专家验证集ROSE-VEC上，ROSE与人类专家的评估结果最为一致，其Cohen’s Kappa值比第二名指标高出近24%。我们还对19种NL2SQL方法进行了大规模重新评估，得出了四个有价值的发现。我们发布ROSE和ROSE-VEC，旨在促进更可靠的NL2SQL研究。

papers.title: Compete to Complete: Co-opetition Adversarial Learning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 竞争以完成任务：合作竞争、对抗性学习在检索增强生成中的应用
papers.authors: Xin Liu, Yu-An Liu, Ruqing Zhang, Yixing Fan, Lixin Su, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising paradigm for mitigating hallucinations in large language models (LLMs).However, the intrinsic heterogeneity between the retriever and the generator often leads to a mismatch between retrieved evidence and generation needs, hindering effective coordination.We argue that competition between discriminative retrieval and generative modeling can more effectively expose their mutual weaknesses and induce deeper interaction. Motivated by this insight, we propose CARL (Co-opetition AdveRsarial Learning), a framework that formulates retriever–generator training in RAG as a minimax game. In this game, the retriever is optimized to retrieve both useful and adversarially useless documents to challenge the generator, while the generator learns to identify useful evidence and remain robust to misleading retrievals to produce accurate answers.Experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that CARL consistently improves RAG performance, validating the effectiveness of adversarial co-opetition in enhancing retriever–generator synergy.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为缓解大语言模型（LLM）中幻觉问题的一种有前景的方法。然而，检索器与生成器之间的固有差异往往导致检索到的证据与生成需求之间存在不匹配，从而阻碍有效的协作。我们认为，通过让判别性检索与生成建模相互竞争，可以更有效地揭示各自的弱点，并促进更深入的互动。基于这一见解，我们提出了CARL（竞争对抗学习）框架，该框架将RAG中的检索器-生成器训练表述为一个极小极大博弈。在这个博弈中，检索器被优化为既能检索到有用的信息，也能检索到对生成器来说无用的信息，以此来挑战生成器；而生成器则学会识别有用的信息，同时对误导性检索保持警惕，以产生准确的答案。在七个基准数据集上的实验表明，CARL能够持续提升RAG的性能，这验证了对抗性竞争在提升检索器-生成器协同效应方面的有效性。

papers.title: Demystifying Uncertainty in LLMs: Active Calibration between Concepts and Human Evaluations
papers.title_zh: 揭开大语言模型中不确定性的神秘面纱：在概念与人类评估之间实现主动校准
papers.authors: Pengqi Li, Lizhong Ding, Zhehao Zhou, Chunhui Zhang, Jiarun Fu, Hao Li, Ye Yuan, Guoren Wang
papers.abstract: Hallucinations arise when large language models (LLMs) guess rather than acknowledge their underlying uncertainty. Existing static strategies for mitigating hallucinations have been only partially successful, largely because they do not explicitly model the information gain from interacting with the external environment. Researchers need a general method to proactively steer users toward informative clarifications, thereby unlocking the model’s effective capacity under underspecified inputs. We model the uncertainty of LLMs in interactive settings and uncover the mechanism of active calibration between model concepts and human evaluations, improving reliability. We show that calibration error in LLMs density estimation admits a non-vanishing lower bound under non-interactive learning, while interaction empirically reduces it. We further characterize that calibration error identifies informative queries and that calibration can be accelerated by shifting query distributions from imbalanced to balanced regimes. Guided by these insights, we propose a calibration-driven Interactive Learning Strategy (ILS) that selects clarification queries by optimizing calibration error, providing both theoretical guarantees and empirical gains for reliability. Code and data are available at https://github.com/zhouyeah215/Demystifying_Uncertainty.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉现象的出现，是由于大语言模型在试图预测时未能充分考虑到其中的不确定性。目前用于减轻幻觉的静态策略仅取得了部分成功，主要是因为这些策略没有明确模拟与外部环境互动所带来的信息增益。研究人员需要一种通用的方法，能够主动引导用户进行必要的澄清，从而在输入信息不明确的情况下提升模型的性能。我们模拟了大语言模型在交互环境中的不确定性，并揭示了模型概念与人类评估之间积极校准的机制，从而提高了模型的可靠性。我们发现，在非交互式学习条件下，大语言模型在密度估计中的校准误差存在一个非零的下限，而交互式学习则能够降低这一误差。此外，我们还发现校准误差有助于识别有信息价值的查询，并且通过将查询分布从不平衡状态转变为平衡状态，可以加速校准过程。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种以校准为驱动的互动学习策略，该策略通过优化校准误差来选择具有信息价值的查询，从而既提供了理论上的保证，又提升了模型的可靠性。相关代码和数据可访问于https://github.com/zhouyeah215/Demystifying_Uncertainty。

papers.title: LLM-VA: Resolving the Jailbreak-Overrefusal Trade-off via Vector Alignment
papers.title_zh: LLM-VA：通过向量对齐解决越狱与拒绝之间的权衡问题
papers.authors: Haonan Zhang, Dongxia Wang, Yi Liu, Kexin Chen, Wenhai Wang
papers.abstract: Safety-aligned LLMs suffer from two failure modes: jailbreak (responding to harmful inputs) and over-refusal (declining benign queries). Existing vector steering methods adjust the magnitude of answer vectors, but this creates a fundamental trade-off—reducing jailbreak increases over-refusal and vice versa. We identify the root cause: LLMs encode the decision to respond (answer vector v_a) and the judgment of input safety (benign vector v_b) as nearly orthogonal directions, treating them as independent processes. We propose LLM-VA, which aligns v_a with v_b through closed-form weight updates, making the model’s willingness to respond causally dependent on its safety assessment—without fine-tuning or architectural changes. Our method identifies vectors at each layer using SVMs, selects safety-relevant layers, and iteratively aligns vectors via minimum-norm weight modifications. Experiments on 12 LLMs demonstrate that LLM-VA achieves 11.45% higher F1 than the best baseline while preserving 95.92% utility, and automatically adapts to each model’s safety bias without manual tuning.Code and models are available at https://hotbento.github.io/LLM-VA-Web/.
papers.abstract_zh: 那些注重安全性的大语言模型存在两种失败模式：对有害输入做出反应（即“越狱”）以及拒绝处理良性查询。现有的向量引导方法会调整答案向量的大小，但这会导致一个根本性的问题——减少“越狱”行为会导致过度拒绝良性查询的情况出现，反之亦然。我们找到了问题的根源：大语言模型将决定如何响应（答案向量v_a）与判断输入安全性（良性向量v_b）这两个因素视为几乎正交的方向，将它们视为独立的进程。我们提出了LLM-VA方法，通过闭式权重更新将v_a与v_b对齐，使得模型是否愿意响应能够依赖于其安全性评估——而无需进行精细调整或架构变更。我们的方法利用SVM在每一层识别相关向量，选择与安全相关的层，并通过最小范数权重调整来逐步对齐这些向量。在12个大语言模型上的实验表明，使用LLM-VA方法能够获得比最佳基线模型高11.45%的F1分数，同时还能保留95.92%的效用值。此外，该方法能够自动适应每个模型的安全偏见，而无需手动调整。代码和模型可访问于https://hotbento.github.io/LLM-VA-Web/。

papers.title: TiKMiX: Efficient Semi-Dynamic Data Mixture via Data Influence for LLM Pre-training
papers.title_zh: TiKMiX：通过数据影响实现高效的半动态数据混合技术，用于大语言模型预训练
papers.authors: Yifan Wang, Binbinliu, Fengze Liu, Yuanfan Guo, Jiyao Deng, Xuecheng Wu, Weidong Zhou, Xiaohuan Zhou, Taifeng Wang
papers.abstract: The data mixture used in the pre-training of a language model is a cornerstone of its final performance. Static data mixing strategies in Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training are often suboptimal as they fail to adapt to the model’s evolving learning states. Conversely, fully online dynamic updates, while adaptive, incur prohibitive computational costs. To bridge this gap, we propose TiKMiX, an efficient semi-dynamic data mixing framework. Our approach is grounded in a key observation of influence ranking invariance: the relative importance of data domains exhibits strong temporal stability over long training intervals. Leveraging this insight, we propose Group Influence, an efficient approach for quantifying domain impact, and formulate data mixing as a periodic, low-overhead influence maximization problem. Compared with REGMIX, the proposed method reduces computational overhead by 80% and achieves an average performance gain of 2% across nine downstream benchmarks, thereby effectively mitigating data under-digestion.
papers.abstract_zh: 在语言模型预训练中使用的数据混合方式是其最终性能的关键所在。在大语言模型预训练中，静态的数据混合策略往往不够理想，因为它们无法适应模型不断变化的训练状态。相反，完全在线动态更新虽然具有适应性，但会带来过高的计算成本。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了TiKMiX这一高效的半动态数据混合框架。我们的方法基于一个关键观察：不同数据领域的相对重要性在长时间的训练过程中表现出很强的稳定性。利用这一洞察，我们提出了“群体影响”这一概念，这是一种高效量化领域影响的方法，并将数据混合问题转化为一个周期性的、低开销的影响最大化问题。与REGMIX相比，我们的方法将计算开销减少了80%，并且在九个下游基准测试中实现了平均2%的性能提升，从而有效避免了数据消化不良的问题。

papers.title: Revisit What You See: Revealing Visual Semantics in Vision Tokens to Guide LVLM Decoding
papers.title_zh: 重新审视你所看到的：揭示视觉令牌中的视觉语义信息，以辅助LVLM的解码过程
papers.authors: Beomsik Cho, Jaehyung Kim
papers.abstract: Large Vision–Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance across multimodal tasks by integrating visual perception with language understanding. However, how vision information contributes to the model’s decoding process remains under-explored, as reflected in frequent hallucinations. Through a series of analyses, we found that (i) vision tokens provide meaningful visual information even when hallucinations occur, and (ii) their semantics are encoded in the textual space and become explicit under appropriate vocabulary constraints. Building on these observations, we propose ReVisiT, a simple training-free decoding method that guides text generation in LVLMs by Referencing Vision Tokens. Our approach leverages the semantic information embedded within vision tokens by projecting them into the text token distribution. Specifically, ReVisiT dynamically selects the most relevant vision token at each decoding step via context-aware constrained divergence minimization. Then, ReVisiT uses its constrained projection to refine the output distribution to better incorporate visual semantics. Across five benchmarks on recent LVLMs, ReVisiT consistently enhances visual grounding with minimal computational overhead, and achieves competitive or superior results to state-of-the-art decoding baselines while reducing computational cost by up to 2\times.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型在多模态任务中表现出强大的性能，因为它们能够将视觉感知与语言理解相结合。然而，视觉信息如何参与模型的解码过程仍然有待进一步研究，这表现为频繁出现的幻觉现象。通过一系列分析，我们发现：(i)即使出现幻觉现象，视觉标记也能提供有意义的视觉信息；(ii)它们的语义被编码在文本空间中，并且在适当的词汇约束下变得清晰可辨。基于这些发现，我们提出了ReVisiT这一无需训练即可用于指导LVLM中文本生成的解码方法。我们的方法通过将视觉标记投影到文本标记分布中，从而利用嵌入在视觉标记中的语义信息。具体来说，ReVisiT通过基于上下文的受限差异最小化算法，在每次解码步骤中动态选择最相关的视觉标记。然后，ReVisiT利用其受限投影来优化输出分布，以更好地融入视觉语义。在最近五个针对LVLM的基准测试中，ReVisiT始终能够在不增加计算开销的情况下提升视觉定位的准确性，并且其性能优于现有的最先进解码基线方法，同时还将计算成本降低了高达2倍。

papers.title: FlexGuard: Continuous Risk Scoring for Strictness-Adaptive LLM Content Moderation
papers.title_zh: FlexGuard：针对严格适应性大语言模型内容审核的持续风险评估系统
papers.authors: Zhihao Ding, Jinming Li, Ze Lu, Jieming Shi
papers.abstract: Ensuring the safety of LLM-generated content is essential for real-world deployment. Most existing guardrail models formulate moderation as a fixed binary classification task, implicitly assuming a fixed definition of harmfulness. In practice, enforcement strictness—how conservatively harmfulness is defined and enforced—varies across platforms and evolves over time, making binary moderators brittle under shifting requirements. In this paper, we introduce FlexBench, a strictness-adaptive LLM moderation benchmark that enables controlled evaluation under multiple strictness regimes. Experiments on FlexBench reveal substantial cross-strictness inconsistency in existing moderators: models that perform well under one regime can degrade substantially under others, limiting their practical usability. To address this, we propose FlexGuard, an LLM-based moderator that outputs a calibrated continuous risk score reflecting risk severity and supports strictness-specific decisions via thresholding. We train FlexGuard via risk-alignment optimization to improve score–severity consistency and provide practical threshold selection strategies to adapt to target strictness at deployment. Experiments on FlexBench and public benchmarks demonstrate that FlexGuard achieves higher moderation accuracy and substantially improved robustness under varying strictness.
papers.abstract_zh: 确保LLM生成内容的安全性对于实际部署至关重要。目前大多数监管模型都将审核任务视为一个固定的二元分类问题，这隐含着对有害性的固定定义。实际上，不同平台对有害性的界定和执行标准各不相同，且随着时间推移而发生变化，这使得基于二元的审核机制在面对不断变化的需求时显得脆弱不堪。在本文中，我们提出了FlexBench这一基于严格度自适应调整的LLM审核基准测试，它能够在不同严格度环境下进行可控的评估。在FlexBench上的实验表明，现有的审核模型在不同严格度环境下存在显著的不一致性：在某些环境下表现良好的模型在其他环境下可能会大幅下降性能，从而限制了其实际应用价值。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了FlexGuard这一基于LLM的审核工具。该工具能够输出一个经过校准的连续风险评分，反映风险的严重程度，并通过设定阈值来支持针对特定严格度的决策。我们通过风险对齐优化方法来训练FlexGuard，以提高评分与严重程度的一致性，并提供实用的阈值选择策略，以便在实际部署时能够适应不同的严格度要求。在FlexBench和公开基准测试中的实验表明，FlexGuard在不同严格度环境下能够实现更高的审核精度，并且其鲁棒性也得到了显著提升。

papers.title: Modeling Human-Like Cognition for Stance Detection: Integrating Intuitive Judgment and Analytical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 模拟人类式的认知机制以进行姿态检测：结合直觉判断与分析推理能力
papers.authors: Zhaodan Zhang, Jin Zhang, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Stance detection aims to identify the attitude expressed in text towards a given target, with applications in public opinion analysis and misinformation mitigation. Despite recent advances in large language models (LLMs), two key challenges remain: (1) spurious correlations between superficial features and stance labels, and (2) lack of cognitive modeling that simulates the transition from intuitive perception to deliberate reasoning. To address these issues, we propose Cognitive-Driven Stance Detection (CDSD), inspired by Kahneman’s Dual-Process Theory. CDSD integrates fast intuitive judgment (System 1) and analytical reasoning (System 2), enhanced by three key modules: attention-based cognitive alignment to compare system focus, uncertainty-aware belief update using Bayesian inference, and self-doubt-triggered counterfactual reasoning for re-evaluation under low consistency or high uncertainty. Experimental results on SEM16, P-Stance, and VAST show that CDSD outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple LLMs. Notably, CDSD exhibits strong robustness against textual perturbations such as emotional word removal and rhetorical restructuring. By integrating cognitive theory with NLP, our work provides a promising path toward more reliable and interpretable stance detection systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 姿态检测的目的是识别文本中对某个目标所表达的态度，这一技术广泛应用于舆论分析和错误信息缓解领域。尽管大语言模型在最近取得了显著进展，但仍然存在两个主要挑战：(1)表面特征与姿态标签之间的虚假关联；(2)缺乏能够模拟从直观感知到深思熟虑的推理过程的认知建模。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了基于认知驱动的姿态检测算法（CDSD），该算法借鉴了卡尼曼的双过程理论。CDSD结合了快速直观判断（系统1）和分析性推理（系统2），并通过三个关键模块加以增强：基于注意力的认知对齐以比较系统焦点、利用贝叶斯推断进行的不确定性感知信念更新，以及针对低一致性或高不确定性情况下进行重新评估的自疑触发反事实推理。在SEM16、P-Stance和VAST数据集上的实验结果表明，CDSD在多种大语言模型上均优于现有方法。值得注意的是，CDSD对诸如情感词移除和修辞结构重组等文本扰动具有极强的鲁棒性。通过将认知理论与自然语言处理相结合，我们的工作为构建更可靠且可解释的姿态检测系统提供了有希望的路径。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: FinSight: Towards Real-World Financial Deep Research
papers.title_zh: FinSight：迈向真实的金融深度研究领域
papers.authors: Jiajie Jin, Yuyao Zhang, Yimeng Xu, Hongjin Qian, Yutao Zhu, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Professional financial reports serve as the cornerstone of investment decisions, demanding deep reasoning and multimodal synthesis. While recent deep research systems excel in open-domain search, they struggle with financial reporting, specifically in handling financial data, ensuring analytical depth, and integrating professional visualizations. To address this, we introduce FinSight , the first multi-agent framework for automate end-to-end professional, multimodal financial report. At its core, we propose the Code Agent with Variable Memory architecture, which unifies data, tools, and agents into a programmable variable space, enabling flexible data manipulation and reasoning through executable code. To guarantee report quality, FinSight incorporates a Two-Stage Writing Framework with Generative Retrieval. This mechanism first distills raw data into structured Chain-of-Analysis segments, and then progressively synthesizes them into a coherent, citation-aware, and multimodal narrative. Additionally, an Iterative Vision-Enhanced Mechanism leverages visual feedback to refine code-generated charts to expert standards. Experiments on company and industry-level tasks demonstrate that FinSight significantly outperforms leading deep research systems in factual accuracy, analytical depth, and presentation quality, demonstrating a clear path toward generating professional financial reports. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FinSight-5841.
papers.abstract_zh: 专业的财务报告是投资决策的基石，需要深入的推理和多方面的综合处理。虽然最近的一些深度研究系统在开放域搜索方面表现出色，但在处理财务数据、确保分析深度以及整合专业可视化效果方面却存在困难。为了应对这一问题，我们推出了FinSight——首个用于自动化生成专业多模态财务报告的跨代理框架。其核心是采用具有可变内存结构的Code Agent架构，它将数据、工具和代理统一成一个可编程的变量空间，从而实现通过可执行代码进行灵活的数据操作和推理。为了保证报告的质量，FinSight采用了两阶段写作框架和生成式检索机制。该机制首先将原始数据提炼成结构化的分析环节，然后逐步将其整合成一个连贯、具有引用标识且包含多模态信息的报告。此外，还采用了迭代式视觉增强机制，利用视觉反馈来优化代码生成的图表，使其达到专家级的标准。在公司和行业层面的任务测试中，我们发现FinSight在事实准确性、分析深度和呈现质量方面均显著优于现有的深度研究系统，这表明它为实现专业财务报告提供了明确的方向。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FinSight-5841获取。

papers.title: Dual-Cluster Memory Agent: Resolving Multi-Paradigm Ambiguity in Optimization Problem Solving
papers.title_zh: 双集群内存代理：解决优化问题中的多种范式混淆问题
papers.authors: Xinyu Zhang, Yuchen Wan, Boxuan Zhang, Zesheng Yang, Lingling Zhang, Bifan Wei, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with structural ambiguity in optimization problems, where a single problem admits multiple related but conflicting modeling paradigms, hindering effective solution generation. To address this, we propose Dual-Cluster Memory Agent (DCM-Agent) to enhance performance by leveraging historical solutions in a training-free manner. Central to this is Dual-Cluster Memory Construction. This agent assigns historical solutions to modeling and coding clusters, then distills each cluster’s content into three structured types: Approach, Checklist, and Pitfall. This process derives generalizable guidance knowledge. Furthermore, this agent introduces Memory-augmented Inference to dynamically navigate solution paths, detect and repair errors, and adaptively switch reasoning paths with structured knowledge. The experiments across seven optimization benchmarks demonstrate that DCM-Agent achieves an average performance improvement of 11%- 21%. Notably, our analysis reveals a “knowledge inheritance” phenomenon: memory constructed by larger models can guide smaller models toward superior performance, highlighting the framework’s scalability and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在优化问题中常常面临结构模糊性的问题，即一个问题可能包含多种相关但相互矛盾的建模范式，这阻碍了有效解决方案的生成。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了双集群记忆代理（DCM-Agent），通过以无需训练的方式利用历史解决方案来提高性能。其核心在于双集群记忆的构建。该代理将历史解决方案分配给建模和编码两个集群，然后将每个集群的内容分解为三种结构化类型：方法、检查清单和陷阱。这一过程产生了可推广的指导知识。此外，该代理还引入了记忆增强推理机制，能够动态导航解决方案路径、检测并修复错误，并借助结构化知识自适应地切换推理路径。在七个优化基准测试中的实验表明，DCM-Agent的平均性能提升了11%至21%。值得注意的是，我们的分析揭示了“知识传承”现象：由较大模型构建的记忆可以指导较小模型取得更好的性能，这凸显了该框架的可扩展性和效率。

papers.title: AfriqueLLM: How Data Mixing and Model Architecture Impact Continued Pre-training for African Languages
papers.title_zh: AfriqueLLM：数据混合与模型架构如何影响非洲语言的持续预训练过程
papers.authors: Hao Yu, Tianyi Xu, Michael A. Hedderich, Wassim Hamidouche, Syed Waqas Zamir, David Ifeoluwa Adelani
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly multilingual, yet open models continue to underperform relative to proprietary systems, with the gap most pronounced for African languages. Continued pre-training (CPT) offers a practical route to language adaptation, but improvements on demanding capabilities such as mathematical reasoning often remain limited. This limitation is driven in part by the uneven domain coverage and missing task-relevant knowledge that characterize many low-resource language corpora. We present AfriqueLLM, a suite of open LLMs adapted to 20 African languages through CPT on 26B tokens. We perform a comprehensive empirical study across five base models spanning sizes and architectures, including Llama 3.1, Gemma 3, and Qwen 3, and systematically analyze how CPT data composition shapes downstream performance. In particular, we vary mixtures that include math, code, and synthetic translated data, and evaluate the resulting models on a range of multilingual benchmarks. Our results identify data composition as the primary driver of CPT gains. Adding math, code, and synthetic translated data yields consistent improvements, including on reasoning-oriented evaluations. Within a fixed architecture, larger models typically improve performance, but architectural choices dominate scale when comparing across model families. Moreover, strong multilingual performance in the base model does not reliably predict post-CPT outcomes; robust architectures coupled with task-aligned data provide a more dependable recipe. Finally, our best models improve long-context performance, including document-level translation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正逐渐具备多语言处理能力，但与专有系统相比，开放式的语言模型在性能上仍然存在差距，尤其是在处理非洲语言时这种差距更为明显。持续的前向训练确实为语言适应性提供了可行的途径，但在诸如数学推理等复杂任务上的改进往往仍然有限。这一限制部分源于许多低资源语言语料库在领域覆盖范围和任务相关知识方面的不足。我们提出了AfriqueLLM，这是一套经过前向训练适配的开放式语言模型，能够处理20种非洲语言，所使用的语料库包含260亿个词元。我们对五种不同规模、不同架构的基础模型进行了全面实证研究，包括Llama 3.1、Gemma 3和Qwen 3。我们系统地分析了前向训练数据组合对下游性能的影响。具体来说，我们改变了包含数学、代码和合成翻译数据的混合数据集，并在一系列多语言基准测试中评估了这些新模型的性能。我们的研究结果表明，数据组合是提升前向训练效果的关键因素。加入数学、代码和合成翻译数据后，模型的性能得到了持续改善，尤其是在推理类任务上的表现。在相同的架构下，更大的模型通常能提升性能，但在不同模型家族之间进行比较时，架构选择则起着决定性作用。此外，基础模型中强大的多语言性能并不能可靠地预测前向训练后的结果；而具有健壮架构且包含任务相关数据的模型则能提供更可靠的解决方案。最后，我们的最佳模型在长上下文处理方面也表现出色，包括文档级别的翻译能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
