papers.title: What Does LLM Refinement Actually Improve? A Systematic Study on Document-Level Literary Translation
papers.title_zh: “LLM优化究竟能改善什么？关于文档级文学翻译的系统性研究”
papers.authors: Shaomu Tan, Dawei Zhu, Ke Tran, Michael Denkowski, Sony Trenous, Leonardo F. R. Ribeiro, Bill Byrne, Felix Hieber
papers.abstract: Iterative refinement is a simple inference-time strategy for machine translation: given an initial translation, an LLM revises it without additional training. Yet document-scale refinement remains poorly understood: 1) which pipelines work best, 2) what quality dimensions improve, and 3) how refiners behave. In this paper, we present a systematic study of document-level literary translation, covering six LLMs and seven language pairs. Across nine translation-refinement granularity combinations and five refinement strategies, a) we find a robust recipe: document-level MT followed by segment-level refinement yields the strongest and most stable improvements. In our setting, doc-level refinement often makes fewer edits and leads to smaller or less reliable gains. Surprisingly, a simple general refinement prompt consistently outperforms error-specific prompting and evaluate-then-refine schemes. b) Fine-grained MQM analyses and professional-translator evaluation show that gains come primarily from fluency, with limited improvements in adequacy. c) Probing translator-refiner strength interactions suggests refinement behaves less like targeted post-editing and more like projecting outputs toward the refiner’s learned distribution while remaining anchored to the initial translation.
papers.abstract_zh: 迭代细化是一种简单的机器翻译推理时间策略：给定初始翻译结果，LLM无需额外训练即可对其进行修改。然而，文档级别的细化仍然缺乏深入的研究：1）哪些优化流程效果最好；2）哪些质量指标能够得到提升；3）细化器的行为模式如何。在本文中，我们对文档级别的文学翻译进行了系统的研究，涉及了六种LLM和七种语言对。通过九种翻译细化粒度组合和五种细化策略的测试，我们发现：a) 采用文档级别翻译后再进行段落级细化的方法能够获得最显著且稳定的改进效果。在我们的实验环境中，文档级别的细化通常会导致更少的编辑工作量，但带来的改进效果则较为有限或不够可靠。令人惊讶的是，一种简单通用的细化提示始终优于针对特定错误的提示方式，也优于先评估再细化的方案。b) 详细的MQM分析和专业译员的评估表明，这种细化方法主要提升了翻译的流畅性，而对翻译的准确性和适用性方面的改进则较为有限。c) 通过对翻译器与细化器之间相互作用的探究发现，细化过程更像是将翻译结果投影到细化器所学习的分布上，同时仍然保持在初始翻译的基础上。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: OctoBench: Benchmarking Scaffold-Aware Instruction Following in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding
papers.title_zh: OctoBench：针对基于仓库的代理式编码任务中的指令遵循能力的基准测试框架
papers.authors: Deming Ding, Shichun Liu, Enhui Yang, Jiahang Lin, Ziying Chen, Shihan Dou, Honglin Guo, Weiyu Cheng, Pengyu Zhao, Chengjun Xiao, Qunhong Zeng, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang, Qidi Xu, Tao Gui
papers.abstract: Modern coding scaffolds turn LLMs into capable software agents, but their ability to follow scaffold-specified instructions remains under-examined, especially when constraints are heterogeneous and persist across interactions. To fill this gap, we introduce OctoBench, which benchmarks scaffold-aware instruction following in repository-grounded agentic coding. OctoBench includes 34 environments and 217 tasks instantiated under three scaffold types, and is paired with 7,098 objective checklist items. To disentangle solving the task from following the rules, we provide an automated observation-and-scoring toolkit that captures full trajectories and performs fine-grained checks. Experiments on eight representative models reveal a systematic gap between task-solving and scaffold-aware compliance, underscoring the need for training and evaluation that explicitly targets heterogeneous instruction following. We will release the benchmark to support reproducible benchmarking and to accelerate the development of more scaffold-aware coding agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代编码框架能够将大语言模型转化为具备能力的软件智能体，但它们在遵循框架指定指令方面的能力仍未被充分研究，尤其是在约束条件具有多样性且会持续存在于不同交互中的情况下。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了OctoBench工具包，该工具包用于评估基于仓库的智能体编码中遵循指令的能力。OctoBench包含34种环境以及217项任务，这些任务属于三种不同的编码框架类型，同时还包含了7,098个客观检查项。为了区分完成任务与遵守规则之间的关系，我们提供了一个自动化的观察与评分工具包，它能够捕捉完整的执行轨迹并进行细致的检查。对八种代表性模型的实验结果表明，在任务完成能力和遵循框架规定的合规性之间存在系统性差异，这凸显了需要针对异构指令遵循情况进行专门的训练和评估。我们将发布该基准测试工具包，以支持可复现的基准测试，并推动更多具备框架意识的智能体编码技术的发展。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Lying with Truths: Open-Channel Multi-Agent Collusion for Belief Manipulation via Generative Montage
papers.title_zh: 谎话连篇：通过生成性蒙太奇技术实现信念操控的通道式多智能体协作机制
papers.authors: Jinwei Hu, Xinmiao Huang, Youcheng Sun, Yi Dong, Xiaowei Huang
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) transition to autonomous agents synthesizing real-time information, their reasoning capabilities introduce an unexpected attack surface. This paper introduces a novel threat where colluding agents steer victim beliefs using only truthful evidence fragments distributed through public channels, without relying on covert communications, backdoors, or falsified documents. By exploiting LLMs’ overthinking tendency, we formalize the first cognitive collusion attack and propose Generative Montage: a Writer-Editor-Director framework that constructs deceptive narratives through adversarial debate and coordinated posting of evidence fragments, causing victims to internalize and propagate fabricated conclusions. To study this risk, we develop CoPHEME, a dataset derived from real-world rumor events, and simulate attacks across diverse LLM families. Our results show pervasive vulnerability across 14 LLM families: attack success rates reach 74.4% for proprietary models and 70.6% for open-weights models. Counterintuitively, stronger reasoning capabilities increase susceptibility, with reasoning-specialized models showing higher attack success than base models or prompts. Furthermore, these false beliefs then cascade to downstream judges, achieving over 60% deception rates, highlighting a socio-technical vulnerability in how LLM-based agents interact with dynamic information environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）逐渐转变为能够自主合成实时信息的智能体，它们的推理能力也带来了意想不到的攻击面。本文提出了一种新型威胁：勾结的攻击者仅利用通过公共渠道传播的真实证据片段来操控受害者的信念，而无需依赖秘密通信、后门或伪造文件。通过利用LLM过度推理的倾向，我们首次提出了认知勾结攻击的理论框架，并提出了“生成式蒙太奇”这一框架——该框架通过对抗性辩论和协同发布证据片段来构建欺骗性的叙事，使受害者产生并传播虚假的结论。为了研究这种风险，我们开发了CoPHEME数据集，该数据集来源于现实中的谣言事件，并模拟了多种LLM家族的攻击行为。我们的研究表明，14种LLM家族都存在普遍性的漏洞：专有模型的攻击成功率达到了74.4%，而开放权重模型的攻击成功率则达到了70.6%。与直觉相反，更强的推理能力反而增加了攻击的易感性，那些专门进行推理处理的模型比基础模型或简单提示的模型具有更高的攻击成功率。此外，这些错误的信念还会进一步传递给下游的评判者，导致超过60%的欺骗行为发生，这凸显了基于LLM的智能体与动态信息环境互动过程中存在的社会技术层面的脆弱性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EXCEEDS: Extracting Complex Events via Nugget-based Grid Modeling in Scientific Domain
papers.title_zh: 领先者：通过基于块网格建模技术在科学领域提取复杂事件的方法
papers.authors: Yi-Fan Lu, Xian-Ling Mao, Bo Wang, Xiao Liu, Heyan Huang
papers.abstract: It is crucial to understand a specific domain by events. Extensive event extraction research has been conducted in many domains such as news, finance, and biology. However, event extraction in scientific domain is still insufficiently supported by comprehensive datasets and tailored methods. Compared with other domains, scientific domain has two characteristics: (1) denser nuggets and events, and (2) more complex information forms. To solve the above problem, considering these two characteristics, we first construct SciEvents, a large-scale multi-event document-level dataset with a schema tailored for scientific domain. It consists of 2,508 documents and 24,381 events under multi-stage manual annotation and quality control. Then, we propose EXCEEDS, an end-to-end scientific event extraction framework by encoding dense nuggets into a grid matrix and simplifying complex event extraction as a nugget-based grid modeling task. Experiments on SciEvents demonstrate state-of-the-art performances of EXCEEDS. Both the SciEvents dataset and the EXCEEDS framework are released publicly to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过事件来理解特定领域是非常重要的。在新闻、金融和生物学等多个领域都进行了大量的事件提取研究。然而，科学领域的事件提取仍然缺乏全面的数据集和针对性的方法支持。与其他领域相比，科学领域具有两个特点：(1) 数据中的事件更为密集；(2) 信息形式更为复杂。为了解决上述问题，我们结合这两个特点，首先构建了一个名为SciEvents的大规模多事件文档级数据集，该数据集的架构专为科学领域而设计。该数据集包含2,508份文档和24,381个事件，这些事件都是通过多阶段手动标注和质量控制得到的。随后，我们提出了EXCEEDS这一端到端的科学事件提取框架。该框架通过将密集的数据点编码成网格矩阵，并将复杂的事件提取任务简化为基于网格的建模任务来实现。在SciEvents数据集上的实验表明，EXCEEDS的表现非常出色。目前，SciEvents数据集和EXCEEDS框架都已公开提供，以便未来进行进一步的研究。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Heterogeneous Adaptive Policy Optimization: Tailoring Optimization to Every Token’s Nature
papers.title_zh: 异质自适应策略优化：根据每个代币的特性进行优化
papers.authors: Zheng Liu, Mengjie Liu, Siwei Wen, Mengzhang Cai, Bin Cui, Conghui He, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: Using entropy as a measure of heterogeneity to guide optimization has emerged as a crucial research direction in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs. However, existing methods typically treat it as a discrete filter or post-hoc regulator rather than a core optimization driver. To fully leverage the potential of entropy and achieve fine-grained regulation, we introduce Heterogeneous Adaptive Policy Optimization (HAPO), a token-aware algorithm that continuously adapts optimization dynamics based on token-level entropy throughout the entire training process. Our algorithm includes four key components: (1) Adaptive Temperature Sampling that adjusts sampling temperature in real time, promoting exploration at high-entropy tokens. (2) Token-Level Group Average Advantage Estimation that estimates advantages at token level, accounting for sequence-length effects while preserving non-biased treatment.(3) Differential Advantage Redistribution that leverages entropy and importance ratios to adjust advantages for tokens with clear signals. (4) Asymmetric Adaptive Clipping that dynamically adjusts clipping boundaries based on token-level entropy. Through systematic investigation of entropy, we embed token-level treatment into every stage. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning, code, and logic tasks across multiple models demonstrate HAPO’s consistent superiority over DAPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 将熵作为异质性度量指标来指导优化，已成为强化学习领域中对大语言模型研究的重要方向。然而，现有的方法通常将其视为一种离散的过滤器或事后调节机制，而非核心的优化驱动因素。为了充分发挥熵的潜力并实现精细化的调节，我们提出了异质自适应策略优化算法（HAPO）。该算法是一种基于令牌级别的熵进行优化的算法，能够在整个训练过程中持续调整优化动态。我们的算法包含四个关键组成部分：(1)自适应温度采样，能够实时调整采样温度，从而在高熵令牌区域促进探索行为；(2)令牌级群体优势估计，能够估算令牌级别的优势，同时考虑序列长度的影响，同时保持无偏处理；(3)差异优势重新分配，利用熵和重要性比例来调整具有明确信号的令牌的优势；(4)非对称自适应裁剪，根据令牌级别的熵动态调整裁剪边界。通过对熵的系统研究，我们将令牌级别的处理方式融入了每一个优化阶段。在多个模型上进行的数学推理、代码和逻辑任务方面的广泛实验表明，HAPO始终优于DAPO算法。

papers.title: Mirroring Users: Towards Building Preference-aligned User Simulator with User Feedback in Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 镜像用户：构建基于用户偏好的用户模拟器，并整合用户反馈于推荐系统中
papers.authors: Tianjun Wei, Huizhong Guo, Yingpeng Du, Zhu Sun, Huang Chen, Dongxia Wang, Jie Zhang
papers.abstract: User simulation is increasingly vital to develop and evaluate recommender systems (RSs). While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising avenues to simulate user behavior, they often struggle with the absence of specific task alignment required for RSs and the efficiency demands of large-scale simulation. A vast yet underutilized resource for enhancing this alignment is the extensive user feedback inherent in RSs, but leveraging it is challenging due to its ambiguity, noise and massive volume, which hinders efficient preference alignment. To overcome these hurdles, we introduce a novel data construction framework that leverages user feedback in RSs with advanced LLM capabilities to generate high-quality simulation data. Our framework unfolds in two key phases: (1) using LLMs to generate decision-making processes as explanatory rationales on simulation samples, thereby reducing ambiguity; and (2) data distillation based on uncertainty estimation and behavior sampling to efficiently filter the most informative, denoised samples. Accordingly, we fine-tune lightweight LLMs, as user simulators, using such high-quality dataset with corresponding decision-making processes. Extensive experiments confirm that our framework significantly boosts the alignment with human preferences and the in-domain reasoning capabilities of the fine-tuned LLMs, providing more insightful and interpretable signals for RS interaction. We believe our work, together with publicly available developed framework, high-quality mixed-domain dataset, and fine-tuned LLM checkpoints, will advance the RS community and offer valuable insights for broader human-centric AI research. Our code is available at https://github.com/Joinn99/UserMirrorer.
papers.abstract_zh: 用户模拟在开发和评估推荐系统方面变得越来越重要。虽然大语言模型为模拟用户行为提供了有前景的方法，但它们往往难以满足推荐系统所需的特定任务对齐要求，同时大规模模拟也面临着效率上的挑战。而推荐系统中蕴含的大量用户反馈是一种可以充分利用的资源，但由于其模糊性、噪声以及庞大的数据量，利用这种反馈进行高效偏好对齐变得困难。为了克服这些障碍，我们提出了一种新颖的数据构建框架，该框架利用推荐系统中的用户反馈，并结合先进的语言模型能力来生成高质量的模拟数据。我们的框架分为两个关键步骤：(1) 使用语言模型生成决策过程作为模拟样本的解释性理由，从而减少模糊性；(2) 基于不确定性估计和行为采样进行数据蒸馏，以高效地筛选出最具信息量的去噪样本。因此，我们使用这样的高质量数据集以及相应的决策过程来微调轻量级语言模型，使其能够作为用户模拟器发挥作用。大量的实验表明，我们的框架显著提升了模型与人类偏好的对齐程度，同时也增强了模型在领域内的推理能力，为推荐系统的交互提供了更有洞察力和可解释性的信号。我们相信，我们的工作以及公开可用的开发框架、高质量的混合领域数据集和微调后的语言模型权重文件，将有助于推动推荐系统领域的进步，并为更广泛以人类为中心的AI研究提供有价值的见解。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Joinn99/UserMirrorer下载。

papers.title: Editing the Moving World: Model Editing for Video LLMs
papers.title_zh: 编辑这个不断变化的世界：为视频语言模型提供模型编辑功能
papers.authors: Qian Zhang, Xinye Li, Xiaokai Wu, Junhao Xu, Zhanyue Qin, Qingbin Liu, Junxian Cai, Xi Chen, Bolin Zhang, Zhiying Tu, Dianhui Chu, Xiaoyan Yu, Dianbo Sui
papers.abstract: Model Editing, also known as knowledge editing, is receiving increasing attention in the field of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing model editing approaches predominantly focus on knowledge-level or static visual domains, overlooking dynamic semantics. This paper exploratively applies six representative model editing methods (FT, IKE, MEND, SERAC, MEMIT and AlphaEdit) to Video Large Language Models (Vid-LLMs) and introduces the first benchmark specifically designed for Vid-LLMs editing—VMEB (Vid-LLMs Model Editing Benchmark)—systematically extending model editing research from static modalities to dynamic video scenarios. We position this work as a forward-looking benchmark and a foundational diagnostic study: in the video paradigm, our evaluation dimensions encompass traditional metrics including Reliability, Locality, and Generality, while also introducing a video-specific metric: Robustness. Based on experimental results, we analyze the strengths and limitations of existing model editing approaches, and identify new challenges and research directions for the future development of the model editing field within the context of multimodal and video paradigms. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/Sakabamrisa/VMEB.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型编辑，也被称为知识编辑，正在大语言模型领域受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有的模型编辑方法主要集中在知识层面或静态视觉领域，而忽略了动态语义的考虑。本文探索性地应用了六种代表性的模型编辑方法（FT、IKE、MEND、SERAC、MEMIT和AlphaEdit）到视频大语言模型上，并引入了首个专为视频大语言模型编辑设计的基准测试——VMEB（视频大语言模型模型编辑基准测试）。该基准测试系统地将模型编辑研究从静态模式扩展到动态视频场景。我们将这项工作视为一项具有前瞻性的基准测试和基础性的诊断研究：在视频领域，我们的评估指标包括可靠性、局部性以及通用性等传统指标，同时引入了一个针对视频特有的指标：鲁棒性。基于实验结果，我们分析了现有模型编辑方法的优点和局限性，并确定了在多模态和视频领域背景下，模型编辑领域未来发展的新挑战和研究方向。我们的基准测试可访问https://github.com/Sakabamrisa/VMEB。

papers.title: Bridging the Sensory Gap: Visual Injection for Taxonomy Completion
papers.title_zh: 填补感官上的空白：用于分类任务完成的视觉输入技术
papers.authors: Yuhang Niu, Hongyuan Xu, Ciyi Liu, Bofan Wei, Jiaqi Ye, Yanlong Wen, Xiaojie Yuan
papers.abstract: Taxonomy Completion aims to automatically integrate new concepts into existing hierarchies. However, existing text-only methods suffer from a ”Sensory Gap”: they struggle to differentiate ambiguous definitions (e.g., Latte vs. Cappuccino) and miss visual grouping signals. Consequently, they often misinterpret lexical overlaps as hierarchical dependencies, leading to erroneous structural predictions. To bridge this, we propose VITC, a framework leveraging Visual Injection for Taxonomy Completion. By mapping synthesized images into intrinsic pseudo-tokens, we enable the text encoder to perform holistic structural reasoning. To address injection challenges, we introduce Adaptive Residual Fusion, which decouples magnitude from selection to prevent visual signals from being drowned out, and the Multimodal Guided Adaptive Reweighting strategy, which leverages cross-modal consensus (Mutual Rescue and Complementary Mining) to filter noise and identify hard negatives. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that VITC achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering an average absolute gain of over 19% in Hit@1. Code is available at https://github.com/nyh-a/VITC.
papers.abstract_zh: 分类补全的目标是将新概念自动整合到现有的层次结构中。然而，现有的纯文本方法存在“感知差距”问题：它们难以区分模糊的定义（例如Latte与Cappuccino），并且无法识别视觉上的分组信号。因此，它们常常将词汇重叠误认为是层次依赖关系，从而导致错误的结果。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了VITC框架，该框架利用视觉注入技术进行分类补全。通过将合成图像映射到内在的伪标记上，我们可以使文本编码器能够进行整体性的结构推理。为了解决注入带来的挑战，我们引入了自适应残差融合技术，该技术将幅度与选择分离，以防止视觉信号被淹没；同时，我们还采用了多模态引导的自适应重加权策略，该策略利用跨模态的共识机制来过滤噪声并识别难以确定的负面信息。在三个数据集上的实验表明，VITC取得了领先的性能，在Hit@1指标上实现了平均超过19%的提升。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/nyh-a/VITC。

papers.title: OCP: Outlier-Centric Probing for Dynamic Structured Pruning of LLMs
papers.title_zh: OCP：以异常值为核心的算法，用于LLM的动态结构化剪枝
papers.authors: Yang Ji, Ying Sun
papers.abstract: Structured pruning offers a hardware-friendly approach for efficient LLM inference. Early static methods determine fixed subnetworks through offline calibration, suffering from performance degradation and calibration sensitivity. Recent methods explore input-adaptive pruning by selecting a subset of tokens as probes to estimate hidden activations for online pruning decisions.However, existing probe selection strategies fail to identify outlier-triggering tokens, and uniform layer-wise sparsity misaligns with heterogeneous outlier distributions, leading to critical channels being incorrectly pruned. Therefore, we propose OCP (Outlier-Centric Probing for structured pruning), a principled framework that prioritizes capturing outlier-triggering tokens rather than reconstructing full hidden distributions. Specifically, OCP includes three key components: (1) sensitivity-weighted probing for FFN layers that identifies outlier patterns via precomputed weight aggregations, (2) attention-accumulated probing that leverages preceding attention matrices to identify salient tokens, and (3) online adaptive sparsity allocation that dynamically adjusts layer-wise pruning based on history-guided outlier statistics. Extensive experiments on LLaMA2, LLaMA3, and OPT demonstrate that OCP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across benchmarks, achieving up to 25% perplexity reduction at 1.6\times speedup.
papers.abstract_zh: 结构化剪枝提供了一种对硬件友好的方法，能够实现高效的LLM推理。早期的静态方法通过离线校准来确定固定的子网络结构，但这会导致性能下降和校准的敏感性问题。最近的方法则采用输入自适应剪枝技术，通过选择一部分令牌作为探针来估计隐藏的激活值，从而做出在线剪枝决策。然而，现有的探针选择策略无法识别出引发异常的令牌，而且统一的层级稀疏性处理方式也无法适应不同来源的异常分布，导致重要的通道被错误地剪除。因此，我们提出了OCP（以异常为中心的结构化剪枝），这是一种基于捕捉引发异常令牌的框架，而不是试图重建完整的隐藏分布。具体来说，OCP包含三个关键组成部分：(1)针对FFN层的灵敏度加权探针，通过预计算的权重聚合来识别异常模式；(2)利用先前注意力矩阵进行注意力累积的探针，以识别重要的令牌；(3)基于历史数据驱动的异常统计信息进行动态调整的层级稀疏性分配。在LaLM2、LaLM3和OPT上的大量实验表明，OCP在各种基准测试中的表现均优于现有方法，其效果甚至可以将困惑度降低25%，同时还能实现1.6倍的速度提升。

papers.title: Structured Episodic Event Memory
papers.title_zh: 结构化情节事件记忆
papers.authors: Zhengxuan Lu, Dongfang Li, Yukun Shi, Beilun Wang, Longyue Wang, Baotian Hu
papers.abstract: Current approaches to memory in Large Language Models (LLMs) predominantly rely on static Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which often results in scattered retrieval and fails to capture the structural dependencies required for complex reasoning. For autonomous agents, these passive and flat architectures lack the cognitive organization necessary to model the dynamic and associative nature of long-term interaction. To address this, we propose Structured Episodic Event Memory (SEEM), a hierarchical framework that synergizes a graph memory layer for relational facts with a dynamic episodic memory layer for narrative progression. Grounded in cognitive frame theory, SEEM transforms interaction streams into structured Episodic Event Frames (EEFs) anchored by precise provenance pointers. Furthermore, we introduce an agentic associative fusion and Reverse Provenance Expansion (RPE) mechanism to reconstruct coherent narrative contexts from fragmented evidence. Experimental results on the LoCoMo and LongMemEval benchmarks demonstrate that SEEM significantly outperforms baselines, enabling agents to maintain superior narrative coherence and logical consistency.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，大语言模型在记忆方面的处理方式主要依赖于静态的检索增强生成技术。这种方法的缺点是检索过程往往分散且缺乏关联性，无法捕捉复杂推理所需的结构性依赖关系。对于自主智能体而言，这种被动且扁平的架构无法模拟长期交互中的动态和关联特性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了结构化情节事件记忆机制（SEEM）。该机制是一个分层结构，它将图状记忆层用于存储关系性信息，同时引入动态情节记忆层来记录叙事的进展。基于认知框架理论，SEEM能够将交互流转化为具有明确来源指针的结构化情节事件框架。此外，我们还引入了智能体关联融合机制和逆向来源扩展机制，以从零散的信息中重构出连贯的叙事上下文。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval基准测试中的实验结果表明，SEEM显著优于现有基线方法，能够确保智能体在叙事连贯性和逻辑一致性方面表现出色。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MobileWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Mobile Agents in Agent-User Interactive and MCP-Augmented Environments
papers.title_zh: MobileWorld：在代理-用户互动环境以及基于MCP增强技术的环境中对自主移动代理进行性能比较
papers.authors: Quyu Kong, Xu Zhang, Zhenyu Yang, Nolan Gao, Chen Liu, Panrong Tong, Chenglin Cai, Hanzhang Zhou, Jianan Zhang, Liangyu Chen, Zhidan Liu, Steven Hoi, Yue Wang
papers.abstract: While AndroidWorld has become the dominant mobile-use benchmark due to its reproducible environment and deterministic evaluation, recent agents achieving over 90% success rates indicate saturation and motivate the need for greater challenge. In addition, its environment lacks key application categories, such as e-commerce and enterprise communication, and does not reflect realistic mobile-use scenarios characterized by vague user instructions and hybrid tool usage. We introduce MobileWorld, a substantially more challenging benchmark with 201 tasks across 20 applications that reflects real-world usage through long-horizon, cross-application workflows requiring nearly twice as many steps (27.8 vs. 14.3) and featuring significantly more multi-app tasks (62.2% vs. 9.5%) than AndroidWorld. MobileWorld balances production-grade utility and reproducible evaluation using open-source alternatives to industry standards (e.g., Mattermost for Slack), enabling full observability through source code modification and direct database access. Beyond standard GUI manipulation, MobileWorld introduces novel task categories including agent-user interaction and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-augmented tasks for evaluating agents in user-aware, hybrid-tool scenarios. We develop a planner-executor framework with extended action spaces supporting user interactions and MCP calls. Results show a sharp performance drop from AndroidWorld, with the best agentic framework and end-to-end model achieving 51.7% and 20.9% success rates, respectively, highlighting substantial room for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于AndroidWorld具有可复现的环境和确定性评估机制，它已成为移动应用测试中的主流基准测试。然而，最近一些代理程序的成功率超过了90%，这表明该基准测试已经接近饱和状态，需要引入更具挑战性的测试场景。此外，AndroidWorld的环境缺乏一些关键的应用类别，如电子商务和企业通信领域，也无法反映现实中的移动应用场景——这些场景通常具有模糊的用户操作说明和混合工具的使用方式。因此，我们推出了MobileWorld这一更具挑战性的基准测试。MobileWorld包含201个任务，涉及20种不同的应用，这些任务通过长期视角、跨应用的工作流程来模拟真实使用场景。与AndroidWorld相比，MobileWorld的任务数量几乎翻了一番（27.8步 vs. 14.3步），同时多应用任务的比例也显著增加（62.2% vs. 9.5%）。MobileWorld在保持高实用性的同时，还采用了开源替代方案来替代行业标准工具（例如，用Mattermost代替Slack），从而可以通过修改源代码或直接访问数据库来实现全面的可观测性。除了标准的图形用户界面操作外，MobileWorld还引入了新的任务类别，包括代理与用户之间的交互以及基于模型上下文协议的多任务处理，以便评估代理在用户感知、混合工具环境下的表现。我们开发了一个包含扩展动作空间的规划器-执行器框架，以支持用户交互和模型上下文协议的调用。结果显示，与AndroidWorld相比，MobileWorld的代理程序框架和端到端模型的成功率分别达到了51.7%和20.9%，这充分表明未来研究还有很大的空间。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Measuring Human Contribution in AI-Assisted Content Generation
papers.title_zh: 衡量人工智能辅助内容生成中的人类贡献
papers.authors: Yueqi Xie, Tao Qi, Jingwei Yi, Xiyuan Yang, Ryan Whalen, Junming Huang, Qian Ding, Yu Xie, Xing Xie, Fangzhao Wu
papers.abstract: With the growing prevalence of generative AI, an increasing amount of content is no longer exclusively generated by humans but by generative AI models with human guidance. This shift presents notable challenges for the delineation of originality due to the varying degrees of human contribution in AI-assisted works. This study raises the research question of measuring human contribution in AI-assisted content generation and introduces a framework to address this question that is grounded in information theory. By calculating mutual information between human input and AI-assisted output relative to self-information of AI-assisted output, we quantify the proportional information contribution of humans in content generation. Our experimental results demonstrate that the proposed measure effectively discriminates between varying degrees of human contribution across multiple creative domains. To further enhance real-world applicability, we extend the framework to estimate the minimal necessary human contribution for any text without requiring human input and validate its effectiveness. We hope that this work lays a foundation for measuring human contributions in AI-assisted content generation in the era of generative AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着生成式人工智能的日益普及，越来越多的内容不再由人类单独生成，而是在人类的指导下由生成式人工智能模型生成的。这种转变给判断内容的原创性带来了显著挑战，因为人工智能辅助创作过程中人类贡献的程度各不相同。本研究提出了如何衡量人工智能辅助内容生成中人类贡献的研究问题，并引入了一个基于信息论的框架来解决这个问题。通过计算人类输入与人工智能辅助输出之间的互信息，相对于人工智能辅助输出的自信息量，我们可以量化人类在内容生成中的信息贡献比例。我们的实验结果表明，所提出的测量方法能够有效地区分不同创意领域中美人贡献的不同程度。为了进一步提高其实用性，我们扩展了该框架，以估计任何文本在没有人类输入的情况下所需的最小人类贡献量，并验证了其有效性。我们希望这项工作能够为生成式人工智能时代中衡量人工智能辅助内容生成中的人类贡献提供基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AutoTaskEval: Towards Domain-Specific and Fine-Grained Evaluation for LLMs
papers.title_zh: AutoTaskEval：面向大语言模型的特定领域与细粒度评估方法研究
papers.authors: Qingqing Lyu, Linjuan Wu, Yongliang Shen, Hengwei Liu, Hao Li, Shengpei Jiang, Yin Zhang, Weiming Lu
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid progress of LLMs, their evaluation remains hindered by static, manually curated benchmarks with limited task coverage and poor adaptability to emerging domains. Existing automated approaches typically operate within fixed task schemas and often fail to autonomously discover new evaluation dimensions, limiting both scalability and effectiveness. To address these gaps, we propose AutoTaskEval, an automated framework that constructs domain-specific benchmarks directly from unstructured corpora. Using a refined Bloom’s Taxonomy, the framework systematically discovers tasks, enriches contextual grounding via iterative Socratic prompting, and generates diverse, progressively challenging evaluation instances. Applied to the complex and knowledge-intensive legal domain, AutoTaskEval uncovers a broader and more fine-grained task space than expert-curated benchmarks while producing high-quality instances that preserve established model-level evaluation trends. We further validate its robustness in a low-structure e-commerce review domain. Together, these results show that AutoTaskEval enables scalable, adaptive, and high-fidelity LLM assessment across domains and model families, advancing autonomous and capability-sensitive evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型取得了快速进展，但其评估仍然受到静态、人工筛选的基准测试的限制。这些基准测试的任务覆盖范围有限，且难以适应新兴领域的需求。现有的自动化方法通常只能按照固定的任务模式进行工作，往往无法自主发现新的评估维度，这限制了其可扩展性和有效性。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了AutoTaskEval这一自动化框架。该框架能够从非结构化语料库中直接构建特定领域的基准测试。通过精细化的布鲁姆分类法，该框架能够系统地发现任务，并通过迭代式的苏格拉底式提示来丰富上下文信息，同时生成多样化且逐步增加难度的评估实例。在复杂且知识密集型的法律领域应用时，AutoTaskEval能够发现比专家筛选的基准测试更为广泛和细致的任务空间，同时生成的评估实例质量高，能够保留已有的模型级评估趋势。我们还在一个结构相对简单的电子商务评论领域验证了该框架的鲁棒性。总的来说，这些结果表明，AutoTaskEval能够实现跨领域和模型家族的规模化、自适应性和高保真度的大语言模型评估，从而推动自主化和能力敏感型评估的发展。

papers.title: ACE-Router: Generalizing History-Aware Routing from MCP Tools to the Agent Web
papers.title_zh: ACE-Router：将基于历史的路由算法从MCP工具扩展到Agent Web平台
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Yao, Zishan Xu, Yifu Guo, Zhiguang Han, Cheng Yang, Shuo Zhang, Weinan Zhang, Xingshan Zeng, Weiwen Liu
papers.abstract: With the rise of the Agent Web and Model Context Protocol (MCP), the agent ecosystem is evolving into an open collaborative network, exponentially increasing accessible tools. However, current architectures face severe scalability and generality bottlenecks. To address this, we propose ACE-Router, a pipeline for training history-aware routers to empower precise navigation in large-scale ecosystems. By leveraging a dependency-rich candidate Graph to synthesize multi-turn trajectories, we effectively train routers with dynamic context understanding to create the plug-and-play Light Routing Agent. Experiments on the real-world benchmarks MCP-Universe and MCP-Mark demonstrate superior performance. Notably, ACE-Router exhibits critical properties for the future Agent Web: it not only generalizes to multi-agent collaboration with minimal adaptation but also maintains exceptional robustness against noise and scales effectively to massive candidate spaces. These findings provide a strong empirical foundation for universal orchestration in open-ended ecosystems.Our code is available at https://github.com/euyis1019/ACE-Router.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着Agent Web和Model Context Protocol（MCP）的兴起，代理生态系统正在演变为一个开放的协作网络，可访问的工具数量呈指数级增长。然而，当前的架构面临着严重的可扩展性和通用性瓶颈问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ACE-Router这一工具，它用于训练具有历史感知能力的路由器，从而能够在大规模生态系统中实现精确的导航。通过利用一个包含丰富依赖关系的候选图来合成多轮轨迹，我们能够有效地训练出具有动态上下文理解的路由器，进而创造出即插即用的轻量级路由代理。在MCP-Universe和MCP-Mark等真实世界基准测试上的实验表明，ACE-Router表现优异。值得注意的是，ACE-Router具备未来Agent Web所需的关键特性：它不仅能够轻松适应多智能体协作环境，而且还能在应对噪声方面保持出色的鲁棒性，并且能够有效扩展到庞大的候选空间。这些发现为开放式生态系统中的通用协调提供了坚实的实证基础。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/euyis1019/ACE-Router下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CiteGuard: Faithful Citation Attribution for LLMs via Retrieval-Augmented Validation
papers.title_zh: CiteGuard：通过检索增强验证技术实现LLMs的精确引用归因
papers.authors: Yee Man Choi, Xuehang Guo, Yi R. Fung, Qingyun Wang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful assistants for scientific writing. However, concerns remain about the quality and reliability of the generated text, including citation accuracy and faithfulness. While most recent work relies on methods such as LLM-as-a-Judge, the reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge alone is also in doubt. In this work, we reframe citation evaluation as a problem of citation attribution alignment, which assesses whether LLM-generated citations match those a human author would include for the same text. We propose CiteGuard, a retrieval-aware agent framework designed to provide more faithful grounding for citation validation. CiteGuard improves over the prior baseline by 10 percentage points and achieves up to 68.1% accuracy on the CiteME benchmark, approaching human performance (69.2%). It also identifies alternative valid citations and demonstrates generalization ability for cross-domain citation attribution.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已成为科学写作的强大辅助工具。然而，人们对生成文本的质量和可靠性仍持担忧态度，包括引用准确性和忠实度问题。虽然最新的研究采用了诸如“语言模型作为裁判”等方法，但“语言模型作为裁判”的可靠性也值得怀疑。在这项研究中，我们将引用评估重新定义为引用归属对齐问题，即评估语言模型生成的引用是否与人类作者为同一文本所添加的引用一致。我们提出了CiteGuard这一基于检索意识的代理框架，旨在为引用验证提供更可靠的支撑。与之前的基线方法相比，CiteGuard的准确率提高了10个百分点，在CiteME基准测试中的准确率达到了68.1%，接近人类的表现水平（69.2%）。此外，它还能识别出其他有效的引用，并展现出跨领域引用归属的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Insight to Action: A Novel Framework for Interpretability-Guided Data Selection in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从洞察到行动：一种基于可解释性的大型语言模型数据选择框架
papers.authors: Ling Shi, Xinwei Wu, Xiaohu Zhao, Hao Wang, Heng Liu, Yangyang Liu, Linlong Xu, Longyue Wang, Deyi Xiong, Weihua Luo
papers.abstract: While mechanistic interpretability tools like Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) can uncover meaningful features within Large Language Models (LLMs), a critical gap remains in transforming these insights into practical actions for model optimization. We bridge this gap with the hypothesis that data selection guided by a model’s internal task features is a effective training strategy. Inspired by this, we propose Interpretability-Guided Data Selection (IGDS), a framework that first identifies these causal task features through frequency recall and interventional filtering, then selects “Feature-Resonant Data” that maximally activates task features for fine-tuning. We validate IGDS on mathematical reasoning, summarization, and translation tasks within Gemma-2, LLaMA-3.1, and Qwen3 models. Our experiments demonstrate exceptional data efficiency: on the Math task, IGDS surpasses full-dataset fine-tuning by a remarkable 17.4% on Gemma-2-2B while using only 50% of the data, and outperforms established baselines focused on data quality and diversity. Analysis confirms a strong positive correlation between feature amplification and task performance improvement. IGDS thus provides a direct and effective framework to enhance LLMs by leveraging their internal mechanisms, validating our core hypothesis.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然像稀疏自编码器这样的机制性可解释性工具能够揭示大语言模型中的有意义特征，但在将这些洞察转化为实际优化模型的行动方面，仍然存在重大障碍。我们提出了一个假设：由模型内部任务特征引导的数据选择是一种有效的训练策略。受此启发，我们提出了“可解释性引导的数据选择”框架。该框架首先通过频率回顾和干预过滤来识别这些因果任务特征，然后选择能够最大程度激活任务特征的“特征共振数据”，以便进行微调。我们在Gemma-2、LaLaM-3.1和Qwen3模型中对IGDS进行了验证。实验表明，IGDS在数学推理、摘要和翻译任务上的效率非常高：在Gemma-2-2B模型中，IGDS仅使用50%的数据就能比全数据集微调高出17.4%，其性能优于那些注重数据质量和多样性的现有基线方法。分析结果显示，特征放大与任务性能提升之间存在强烈的正相关性。因此，IGDS提供了一个直接且有效的框架，通过利用大语言模型的内部机制来提升它们的性能，从而验证了我们的核心假设。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Unlocking the Potential of Diffusion Language Models through Template Infilling
papers.title_zh: 通过模板填充释放扩散语言模型的潜力
papers.authors: Junhoo Lee, Seungyeon Kim, Nojun Kwak
papers.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to Autoregressive Language Models, yet their inference strategies largely rely on prefix-based prompting inherited from the autoregressive paradigm. In this paper, we propose Template Infilling (TI), a conditioning methodology tailored for DLMs. Unlike conventional prefix prompting, TI distributes structural anchors across the target response, establishing a global template before infilling masked segments. This enables structured conditioning that leverages the bidirectional generation process of DLMs. We evaluate TI on diverse benchmarks, including mathematical reasoning, code generation, and trip planning, achieving consistent improvements of 9.40%p over baseline prompting strategies. Furthermore, TI naturally supports multi-token generation settings, providing practical speed advantages while maintaining generation quality and robustness. Overall, our results highlight a DLM-specific conditioning paradigm for structured generation, suggesting a promising direction for inference methods tailored to diffusion-based language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）已成为替代自回归语言模型的一种有前景的选择。然而，它们的推理策略在很大程度上依赖于自回归范式中的前缀式提示方式。在本文中，我们提出了模板填充法（TI），这是一种专为DLM设计的条件化方法。与传统的前缀式提示不同，TI将结构化的锚点分布到目标响应中，先建立全局模板，然后再填充被遮蔽的片段。这种方法能够利用DLM的双向生成机制来实现结构化条件化。我们在多个基准测试中对TI进行了评估，包括数学推理、代码生成和旅行规划等任务。结果显示，与基线提示策略相比，TI取得了9.40%的提升。此外，TI还支持多标记生成设置，从而在保持生成质量和鲁棒性的同时，提供实际的速度优势。总体而言，我们的研究结果展示了一种适用于DLM的结构化生成条件化方法，为针对基于扩散的语言模型的推理方法指明了方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: UniSpec: Training-Free Speculative Decoding for Robust LLM Acceleration Across Languages and Hardware
papers.title_zh: UniSpec：无需训练的推测式解码技术，能够实现跨语言和跨硬件环境的稳健大语言模型加速
papers.authors: Truong Dinh Do, Nguyen-Khang Le, Le-Minh Nguyen
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference through a draft-and-verify paradigm, yet existing methods face three key limitations: reliance on fixed draft templates that ignore device-specific verification costs, lack of mechanisms to assess draft token quality, and suboptimal tree expansion strategies. We introduce UniSpec, a training-free, lossless speculative decoding framework that enables robust, plug-and-play LLM acceleration across diverse hardware configurations and languages. UniSpec incorporates three novel components: (1) a device-aware calibration mechanism that determines the optimal draft size by measuring the acceptance-time trade-off on each target device; (2) a confidence score estimation module that assigns quality scores to n-grams based on the verifier’s token probabilities, enabling selective retention of high-quality draft candidates; and (3) an improved tree expansion strategy that broadens first-level exploration and applies threshold-based filtering to prune low-confidence nodes. To comprehensively evaluate multilingual performance, we create a comprehensive benchmark, covering seven languages across seven generation tasks. Experiments with various LLM architectures, hardware environments, and languages demonstrate that UniSpec consistently outperforms existing training-free methods, achieving speedups of up to 2.6x while maintaining output quality identical to standard autoregressive decoding. Our code and benchmark are publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 投机性解码通过“草稿生成-验证”的范式加速了大语言模型（LLM）的推理过程。然而，现有的方法存在三个主要局限性：依赖固定的草稿模板，这忽略了不同设备上的验证成本；缺乏评估草稿token质量机制；以及树状结构扩展策略不够优化。我们提出了UniSpec这一无需训练的、无损的投机性解码框架，它能够在不同硬件配置和语言环境中实现高效、即插即用的LLM加速。UniSpec包含三个创新组件：(1)一种基于设备的校准机制，通过测量各目标设备上的接受时间权衡来确定最优草稿大小；(2)一个置信度评分模块，根据验证器的token概率为n-gram分配质量分数，从而选择性保留高质量的草稿候选项；(3)一种改进的树状结构扩展策略，该策略扩大了第一级探索范围，并采用阈值过滤来剔除低置信度的节点。为了全面评估多语言性能，我们创建了一个涵盖七种语言、七个生成任务的综合基准测试。针对各种LLM架构、硬件环境和语言的实验表明，UniSpec始终优于现有的无需训练的方法，其加速效果可达2.6倍，同时保持与标准自回归解码相同的输出质量。我们的代码和基准测试已公开提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Logical Consistency as a Bridge: Improving LLM Hallucination Detection via Label Constraint Modeling between Responses and Self-Judgments
papers.title_zh: 逻辑一致性作为桥梁：通过约束条件建模来提升大型语言模型对幻觉现象的检测能力，实现回应与自我评判之间的有效连接
papers.authors: Hao Mi, Qiang Sheng, Shaofei Wang, Beizhe Hu, Yifan Sun, Zhengjia Wang, Hengqi Zeng, Yang Li, Danding Wang, Juan Cao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to factual hallucinations, risking their reliability in real-world applications. Existing hallucination detectors mainly extract micro-level intrinsic patterns for uncertainty quantification or elicit macro-level self-judgments through verbalized prompts. However, these methods address only a single facet of the hallucination, focusing either on implicit neural uncertainty or explicit symbolic reasoning, thereby treating these inherently coupled behaviors in isolation and failing to exploit their interdependence for a holistic view. In this paper, we propose LaaB (Logical Consistency-as-a-Bridge), a framework that bridges neural features and symbolic judgments for hallucination detection. LaaB introduces a “meta-judgment” process to map symbolic labels back into the feature space. By leveraging the inherent logical bridge where response and meta-judgment labels are either the same or opposite based on the self-judgment’s semantics, LaaB aligns and integrates dual-view signals via mutual learning and enhances the hallucination detection. Extensive experiments on 4 public datasets, across 4 LLMs, against 8 baselines demonstrate the superiority of LaaB.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）容易出现事实性幻觉，这对其在现实应用中的可靠性构成了威胁。现有的幻觉检测方法主要依赖于提取微观层面的内在模式来进行不确定性量化，或者通过口头提示来引导宏观层面的自我判断。然而，这些方法只关注幻觉的某一个方面，要么专注于隐性的神经不确定性，要么侧重于显性的符号推理。这样一来，它们将那些相互关联的行为孤立地处理，未能充分利用它们之间的相互依赖性来获得全面的认识。在本文中，我们提出了LaaB（逻辑一致性作为桥梁）这一框架，该框架将神经特征与符号判断相结合，以实现幻觉检测。LaaB引入了一种“元判断”过程，将符号标签映射回特征空间。通过利用这种内在的逻辑桥梁——根据自我判断的语义，响应标签和元判断标签要么相同，要么相反——LaaB能够整合两种视角的信息，并通过相互学习来增强幻觉检测的效果。我们在4个公共数据集上进行了广泛的实验，涉及4种LLM以及8种基准算法，结果表明LaaB具有显著的优越性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: UNIKIE-BENCH: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Key Information Extraction in Visual Documents
papers.title_zh: UNIKIE-BENCH：针对视觉文档中关键信息提取任务，对大型多模态模型进行性能评估
papers.authors: Yifan Ji, Zhipeng Xu, Zhenghao Liu, Zulong Chen, Qian Zhang, Zhibo Yang, Junyang Lin, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Key Information Extraction (KIE) from real-world documents remains challenging due to substantial variations in layout structures, visual quality, and task-specific information requirements. Recent Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have shown promising potential for performing end-to-end KIE directly from document images. To enable a comprehensive and systematic evaluation across realistic and diverse application scenarios, we introduce UNIKIE-BENCH, a unified benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the KIE capabilities of LMMs. UNIKIE-BENCH consists of two complementary tracks: a constrained-category KIE track with scenario-predefined schemas that reflect practical application needs, and an open-category KIE track that extracts any key information that is explicitly present in the document. Experiments on 15 state-of-the-art LMMs reveal substantial performance degradation under diverse schema definitions, long-tail key fields, and complex layouts, along with pronounced performance disparities across different document types and scenarios. These findings underscore persistent challenges in grounding accuracy and layout-aware reasoning for LMM-based KIE. All codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/UNIKIE-BENCH.
papers.abstract_zh: 从真实文档中提取关键信息是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为文档的布局结构、视觉质量以及特定任务所需的信息存在很大差异。最近出现的多模态大型模型在直接从文档图像进行端到端关键信息提取方面展现出了巨大的潜力。为了能够在各种现实且多样化的应用场景中进行全面系统的评估，我们提出了UNIKIE-BENCH这一统一的基准测试工具，旨在严格评估多模态模型的关键信息提取能力。UNIKIE-BENCH包含两个互补的测试环节：一个是针对特定类别的关键信息提取环节，该环节采用预先定义好的场景模式来模拟实际应用场景需求；另一个是开放类别的关键信息提取环节，该环节可以提取文档中明确存在的任何关键信息。对15种最先进的多模态模型进行的实验表明，在不同的模式定义、长尾关键字段以及复杂布局情况下，模型的性能出现了显著下降，而且不同文档类型和场景下的性能也存在明显差异。这些发现凸显了基于多模态模型进行关键信息提取时，在定位准确性和布局感知推理方面的持续挑战。所有代码和数据集均可在此链接下载：https://github.com/NEUIR/UNIKIE-BENCH

papers.title: FS-Researcher: Test-Time Scaling for Long-Horizon Research Tasks with File-System-Based Agents
papers.title_zh: FS研究员：适用于基于文件系统的智能体在长视界研究任务中的测试时间调整方法
papers.authors: Chiwei Zhu, Benfeng Xu, Mingxuan Du, Shaohan Wang, Xiaorui Wang, Zhendong Mao, Yongdong Zhang
papers.abstract: Deep research is emerging as a representative long-horizon task for large language model (LLM) agents. However, long trajectories in deep research often exceed model context limits, compressing token budgets for both evidence collection and report writing, and preventing effective test-time scaling. We introduce FS-Researcher, a file-system-based, dual-agent framework that scales deep research beyond the context window via a persistent workspace. Specifically, a Context Builder agent acts as a librarian which browses the internet, writes structured notes, and archives raw sources into a hierarchical knowledge base that can grow far beyond context length. A Report Writer agent then composes the final report section by section, treating the knowledge base as the source of facts. In this framework, the file system serves as a durable external memory and a shared coordination medium across agents and sessions, enabling iterative refinement beyond the context window. Experiments on two open-ended benchmarks (DeepResearch Bench and DeepConsult) show that FS-Researcher achieves state-of-the-art report quality across different backbone models. Further analyses demonstrate a positive correlation between final report quality and the computation allocated to the Context Builder, validating effective test-time scaling under the file-system paradigm. The code and data are open-sourced at https://github.com/Ignoramus0817/FS-Researcher.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度研究正逐渐成为大语言模型代理的一项代表性长期任务。然而，深度研究的漫长过程往往超出了模型的上下文限制，这限制了用于证据收集和报告撰写的令牌数量，从而阻碍了在测试时间内的有效扩展。我们提出了FS-Researcher这一基于文件系统的双代理框架，该框架通过持久的工作空间实现了对深度研究的扩展，使其超越上下文窗口的范围。具体来说，Context Builder代理充当图书管理员角色，负责浏览互联网、记录结构化信息，并将原始资料归档到可以无限扩展的层次化知识库中。而Report Writer代理则逐部分完成最终报告的编写工作，将知识库作为事实来源。在这个框架中，文件系统作为持久的外部内存和代理之间以及会话之间的共享协调媒介，使得可以在上下文窗口之外进行迭代优化。在两项开放式基准测试（DeepResearch Bench和DeepConsult）上的实验表明，FS-Researcher能够在不同的主干模型上实现最先进的报告质量。进一步的分析显示，最终报告的质量与分配给Context Builder的计算资源之间存在正相关关系，这验证了在文件系统范式下在测试时间内的有效扩展能力。代码和数据可在https://github.com/Ignoramus0817/FS-Researcher获取。

papers.title: Annotating Dimensions of Social Perception in Text: A Sentence-Level Dataset of Warmth and Competence
papers.title_zh: 对文本中社会认知维度的注释：一个关于温暖与能力水平的句子级数据集
papers.authors: Mutaz Ayesh, Saif M. Mohammad, Nedjma Ousidhoum
papers.abstract: Warmth (W) (often further broken down intoTrust (T) and Sociability (S)) and Competence (C) are central dimensions along which people evaluate individuals and social groups (Fiske, 2018). While these constructs are well established in social psychology, they are only starting to get attention in NLP research through word-level lexicons, which do not fully capture their contextual expression in larger text units and discourse. In this work, we introduceWarmth and Competence Sentences (W C-Sent), the first sentence-level dataset annotated for warmth and competence. The dataset includes over 1,600 English sentence–target pairs annotated along three dimensions: trust and sociability (components of warmth), and competence. The sentences in W C-Sent are social media posts that express attitudes and opinions about specific individuals or social groups (the targets of our annotations). We describe the data collection, annotation, and quality-control procedures in detail, and evaluate a range of large language models (LLMs) on their ability to identify trust, sociability, and competence in text. W C-Sent provides a new resource for analyzing warmth and competence in language and supports future research at the intersection of NLP and computational social science.
papers.abstract_zh: 温暖感（W）（通常进一步分解为信任感（T）和社交性（S））以及能力（C），是人们评估个人和社会群体的核心维度（Fiske，2018）。虽然这些概念在社会心理学中已经得到了充分研究，但在自然语言处理领域，它们才刚刚开始受到关注。目前的自然语言处理模型所使用的词汇层面标注方式，无法完全捕捉到这些概念在更大文本单元和话语中的具体表现。在这项研究中，我们提出了“温暖感与能力句子”数据集，这是首个针对温暖感和能力进行标注的句子级数据集。该数据集包含超过1,600对英文句子-目标对，这些句子在三个维度上进行了标注：信任感、社交性（温暖感的组成部分）以及能力。W C-Sent中的句子都是社交媒体帖子，这些帖子表达了人们对特定个人或社会群体（我们标注的目标对象）的态度和观点。我们详细描述了数据收集、标注以及质量控制的过程，并评估了多种大语言模型在识别文本中的信任感、社交性和能力方面的能力。W C-Sent为分析语言中的温暖感和能力提供了新的资源，并为自然语言处理与计算社会科学交叉领域的未来研究提供了支持。

papers.title: SCOUT: Selective Coupling via Optimal Unbalanced Transport for Interpretable Text Classification
papers.title_zh: 侦察器：通过最优不平衡传输方式实现选择性耦合，以实现可解释的文本分类
papers.authors: Junhao Jia, Hanwen Zheng, Yueyi Wu, Huangwei Chen, Haishuai Wang, Jiajun Bu, Lei Wu
papers.abstract: Natural language data is inherently noisy, yet standard interpretable models often rely on scalar similarities that obscure the true evidentiary basis of a prediction. This limitation is particularly detrimental to prototype-based classification, where traditional full-alignment mechanisms force non-informative background segments to match informative prototypes, yielding unstable or misleading explanations. To mitigate this, we present SCOUT, a novel paradigm that grounds prototype reasoning in the selective correspondence of discriminative fragments. Concretely, we represent each document as a discrete distribution over span embeddings and employ differentiable Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) to align them with class-specific prototypes. Unlike standard methods, this mechanism enables the model to focus strictly on decisive evidence while leaving irrelevant noise unmatched via geometric mass suppression. To ensure verifiability, we anchor prototype supports to readable training spans, establishing a transparent bridge between input segments and stored knowledge. Comprehensive experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that SCOUT yields prototypes focused on semantically significant spans, significantly outperforming traditional rationale extraction and post-hoc attribution methods in terms of faithfulness and stability.
papers.abstract_zh: 自然语言数据本质上具有噪声性，而标准的可解释模型往往依赖于标量相似性度量，这掩盖了预测的真实依据。这种局限性对基于原型分类的方法尤为不利，因为传统的完全对齐机制会将无用的背景片段与有信息量的原型进行匹配，从而导致不稳定的或误导性的解释结果。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了SCOUT这一新颖的范式，该范式将原型推理建立在选择性对应关系的基礎上。具体来说，我们将每个文档表示为跨嵌入的离散分布，并采用可微分的不平衡最优传输算法来将其与特定类别的原型进行对齐。与标准方法不同，这种机制使模型能够严格聚焦于决定性的证据，同时通过几何质量抑制法排除无关噪声。为了确保可验证性，我们将原型支持项限制在易于理解的训练片段中，从而在输入片段与存储的知识之间建立透明的桥梁。在七个基准测试上的综合实验表明，SCOUT能够生成专注于语义上重要片段的原型，其在准确性和稳定性方面均优于传统的理由提取和事后归因方法。

papers.title: LLMs Enable Bag-of-Texts Representations for Short-Text Clustering
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能够实现文本包表示方式，从而用于短文本聚类任务
papers.authors: I-Fan Lin, Faegheh Hasibi, Suzan Verberne
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a training-free method for unsupervised short text clustering that relies less on careful selection of embedders than other methods. In customer-facing chatbots, companies are dealing with large amounts of user utterances that need to be clustered according to their intent. In these settings, no labeled data is typically available, and the number of clusters is not known. Recent approaches to short-text clustering in label-free settings incorporate LLM output to refine existing embeddings. While LLMs can identify similar texts effectively, the resulting similarities may not be directly represented by distances in the dense vector space, as they depend on the original embedding. We therefore propose a method for transforming LLM judgments directly into a bag-of-texts representation in which texts are initialized to be equidistant, without assuming any prior distance relationships. Our method achieves comparable or superior results to state-of-the-art methods, but without embeddings optimization or assuming prior knowledge of clusters or labels. Experiments on diverse datasets and smaller LLMs show that our method is model agnostic and can be applied to any embedder, with relatively small LLMs, and different clustering methods. We also show how our method scales to large datasets, reducing the computational cost of the LLM use. The flexibility and scalability of our method make it more aligned with real-world training-free scenarios than existing clustering methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种无需训练的无监督短文本聚类方法，该方法对嵌入器的精心选择要求较低。在面向客户的聊天机器人中，企业需要处理大量用户话语，这些话语需要根据其意图进行聚类。在这种情况下，通常没有标记数据可用，而且聚类的数量也是未知的。最近在无标签情况下的短文本聚类方法中，人们采用LLM的输出来优化现有的嵌入向量。虽然LLM能够有效地识别相似的文本，但这些相似性可能无法通过密集向量空间中的距离直接表示出来，因为它们依赖于原始的嵌入向量。因此，我们提出了一种方法，可以将LLM的判断直接转换为文本包表示形式，在这种表示方式中，文本被初始化为等距的，而不需要假设任何先前的距离关系。我们的方法取得了与最先进方法相当甚至更好的效果，而且不需要对嵌入向量进行优化，也不需要假设聚类的先验知识或标签信息。在多种数据集和较小的LLM上的实验表明，我们的方法是与模型无关的，可以应用于任何嵌入器，即使是相对较小的LLM，以及不同的聚类方法。我们还展示了我们的方法如何适用于大型数据集，同时降低了使用LLM的计算成本。我们方法的灵活性和可扩展性使其更符合现实世界中的无训练场景需求，相比现有的聚类方法，它更具优势。

papers.title: TriEx: A Game-based Tri-View Framework for Explaining Internal Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLMs
papers.title_zh: TriEx：一种基于游戏的三种视角框架，用于解释多智能体大语言模型中的内部推理过程
papers.authors: Ziyi Wang, Chen Zhang, Wenjun Peng, Qi Wu, Xinyu Wang
papers.abstract: Explainability for Large Language Model (LLM) agents is especially challenging in interactive, partially observable settings, where decisions depend on evolving beliefs and other agents. We present TriEx, a tri-view explainability framework that instruments sequential decision making with aligned artifacts: (i) structured first-person self-reasoning bound to an action, (ii) explicit second-person belief states about opponents updated over time, and (iii) third-person oracle audits grounded in environment-derived reference signals. This design turns explanations from free-form narratives into evidence-anchored objects that can be compared and checked across time and perspectives. Using imperfect-information strategic games as a controlled testbed, we show that TriEx enables scalable analysis of explanation faithfulness, belief dynamics, and evaluator reliability, revealing systematic mismatches between what agents say, what they believe, and what they do. Our results highlight explainability as an interaction-dependent property and motivate multi-view, evidence-grounded evaluation for LLM agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于大语言模型（LLM）代理来说，在交互式且部分可观察的环境中实现可解释性是一项特别具有挑战性的任务。在这种情况下，决策取决于不断变化的信念以及其他代理的行为。我们提出了TriEx这一三视图可解释性框架，该框架通过以下三种机制来规范连续的决策过程：(1) 与动作相关的结构化第一人称自我推理；(2) 随时间更新的关于对手的明确第二人称信念状态；(3) 基于环境生成的参考信号进行的第三人称审计。这种设计将自由形式的解释转化为可以跨时间和视角进行比较和验证的基于证据的对象。我们通过使用不完全信息的策略游戏作为受控测试平台，证明了TriEx能够实现对解释准确性、信念动态以及评估者可靠性的可扩展分析，从而揭示了代理所说的话、他们所相信的以及他们实际行为之间存在的系统性不匹配。我们的研究结果强调了可解释性作为一种依赖于交互特性的属性，并为LLM代理的多视图、基于证据的评估提供了动力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: What’s Left Unsaid? Detecting and Correcting Misleading Omissions in Multimodal News Previews
papers.title_zh: 还有什么未被说出口？识别并纠正多模态新闻预览中的误导性遗漏信息
papers.authors: Fanxiao Li, Jiaying Wu, Tingchao Fu, Dayang Li, Herun Wan, Wei Zhou, Min-Yen Kan
papers.abstract: Even when factually correct, social-media news previews (image-headline pairs) can induce interpretation drift: by selectively omitting crucial context, they lead readers to form judgments that diverge from what the full article supports. This covert harm is subtler than explicit misinformation, yet remains underexplored. To address this gap, we develop a multi-stage pipeline that simulates preview-based and context-based understanding, enabling construction of the MM-Misleading benchmark. Using MM-Misleading, we systematically evaluate open-source LVLMs and uncover pronounced blind spots in omission-based misleadingness detection. We further propose OMGuard, which combines (1) Interpretation-Aware Fine-Tuning for misleadingness detection and (2) Rationale-Guided Misleading Content Correction, where explicit rationales guide headline rewriting to reduce misleading impressions. Experiments show that OMGuard lifts an 8B model’s detection accuracy to the level of a 235B LVLM while delivering markedly stronger end-to-end correction. Further analysis shows that misleadingness usually arises from local narrative shifts, such as missing background, instead of global frame changes, and identifies image-driven cases where text-only correction fails, underscoring the need for visual interventions.
papers.abstract_zh: 即使这些社交媒体新闻预览（图片标题组合）在事实上是准确的，它们仍可能导致解读偏差：通过选择性地省略关键背景信息，这些预览会引导读者形成与完整文章内容不符的判断。这种隐蔽的负面影响比明显的错误信息更为微妙，但却尚未得到充分研究。为了填补这一空白，我们开发了一个多阶段流程，该流程能够模拟基于预览和基于上下文的理解机制，从而构建MM-Misleading基准测试。利用MM-Misleading基准测试，我们对开源LVLMs进行了系统评估，发现基于省略信息的误导性检测存在明显缺陷。我们进一步提出了OMGuard算法，该算法结合了两种技术：(1) 用于检测误导性的解释性微调；(2) 基于合理依据的误导性内容修正。通过明确合理的理由来指导标题的重新编写，可以有效减少误导性的影响。实验表明，使用OMGuard后，8B规模的模型检测准确率可提升至与235B规模LVLM相当的水平，同时还能实现更强大的端到端修正效果。进一步分析显示，误导性内容通常源于局部叙事的变动，例如缺少背景信息，而非全局框架的变化。此外，我们还发现了一些以图片为主导的误导性案例，在这些案例中，单纯的文本修正无法解决问题，这凸显了进行视觉干预的必要性。

papers.title: ContextLens: Modeling Imperfect Privacy and Safety Context for Legal Compliance
papers.title_zh: ContextLens：建模不完整的隐私与安全上下文以满足法律合规要求
papers.authors: Haoran Li, Yulin Chen, Huihao Jing, Wenbin Hu, Tsz Ho Li, Chanhou Lou, Hong Ting Tsang, Sirui Han, Yangqiu Song
papers.abstract: Individuals’ concerns about data privacy and AI safety are highly contextualized and extend beyond sensitive patterns. Addressing these issues requires reasoning about the context to identify and mitigate potential risks. Though researchers have widely explored using large language models (LLMs) as evaluators for contextualized safety and privacy assessments, these efforts typically assume the availability of complete and clear context, whereas real-world contexts tend to be ambiguous and incomplete. In this paper, we propose ContextLens, a semi-rule-based framework that leverages LLMs to ground the input context in the legal domain and explicitly identify both known and unknown factors for legal compliance. Instead of directly assessing safety outcomes, our ContextLens instructs LLMs to answer a set of crafted questions that span over applicability, general principles and detailed provisions to assess compliance with pre-defined priorities and rules. We conduct extensive experiments on existing compliance benchmarks that cover the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the EU AI Act. The results suggest that our ContextLens can significantly improve LLMs’ compliance assessment and surpass existing baselines without any training. Additionally, our ContextLens can further identify the ambiguous and missing factors.
papers.abstract_zh: 人们对数据隐私和人工智能安全问题的担忧是高度情境化的，且涉及的范围远远超出了敏感模式。解决这些问题需要基于情境进行推理，以识别并减轻潜在风险。尽管研究人员广泛探索使用大语言模型作为情境化安全性和隐私评估的评估工具，但这些研究通常假设情境是完整且明确的，而现实世界中的情境往往具有模糊性和不完整性。在本文中，我们提出了ContextLens这一半规则框架，该框架利用大语言模型来将输入情境与法律领域联系起来，并明确识别用于法律合规的已知和未知因素。我们的ContextLens并不直接评估安全性结果，而是指导大语言模型回答一系列问题，这些问题涵盖了适用性、一般原则和具体条款等方面，从而根据预定义的优先级和规则来评估合规性。我们在涵盖通用数据保护条例和欧盟人工智能法案等现有合规基准上进行了广泛的实验。结果表明，我们的ContextLens能够显著改善大语言模型的合规评估能力，并且无需任何训练即可超越现有的基线性能。此外，我们的ContextLens还能进一步识别那些模糊或不完整的因素。

papers.title: StealthGraph: Exposing Domain-Specific Risks in LLMs through Knowledge-Graph-Guided Harmful Prompt Generation
papers.title_zh: StealthGraph：通过知识图谱引导的有害提示生成，揭示大语言模型中的特定领域风险
papers.authors: Huawei Zheng, Xinqi Jiang, Sen Yang, Shouling Ji, Yingcai Wu, Dazhen Deng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in specialized domains such as finance and healthcare, where they introduce unique safety risks. Domain-specific datasets of harmful prompts remain scarce and still largely rely on manual construction; public datasets mainly focus on explicit harmful prompts, which modern LLM defenses can often detect and refuse. In contrast, implicit harmful prompts—expressed through indirect domain knowledge—are harder to detect and better reflect real-world threats. We identify two challenges: transforming domain knowledge into actionable constraints and increasing the implicitness of generated harmful prompts. To address them, we propose an end-to-end framework that first performs knowledge-graph-guided harmful prompt generation to systematically produce domain-relevant prompts, and then applies two-strategy obfuscation rewriting to convert explicit harmful prompts into implicit variants via direct and context-enhanced rewriting. This framework yields high-quality datasets combining strong domain relevance with implicitness, enabling more realistic red-teaming and advancing LLM safety research. We release our code and datasets on GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在金融和医疗等专业领域得到了广泛应用，但这些应用也带来了独特的安全风险。针对特定领域的有害提示数据集仍然较为稀缺，且大多需要人工构建；公开的数据集主要聚焦于明确的有害提示，而现代的语言模型防御技术通常能够检测到这些提示并加以拒绝。相比之下，通过间接的领域知识表达出的隐性有害提示则更难以被检测出来，但它们更能反映现实世界中的威胁。我们发现了两个挑战：如何将领域知识转化为可操作的约束条件，以及如何提高生成出的有害提示的隐秘性。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了一个端到端框架：首先利用知识图谱来生成与领域相关的有害提示，然后采用两种策略进行混淆重写，将明确的有害提示转化为隐式的变体，既可以通过直接重写来实现，也可以通过增强上下文来实现。这个框架能够生成高质量的数据集，既具备很强的领域相关性，又具有隐秘性，从而有助于更真实地模拟现实场景，推动语言模型安全研究的发展。我们将我们的代码和数据集发布在GitHub上。

papers.title: Efficient Multi-Agent System Training with Data Influence-Oriented Tree Search
papers.title_zh: 基于数据影响的树搜索算法，用于高效的多智能体系统训练
papers.authors: Wentao Shi, Zichun Yu, Fuli Feng, Xiangnan He, Chenyan Xiong
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) based multi-agent systems (MAS) show strong potential for tackling complex tasks through collaborative intelligence. Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) based methods provide promising approaches for enhancing MAS self-training by generating synthetic data, using Q-values to estimate agent contributions. However, relying solely on Q-values may misalign with the goal of selecting data most beneficial for MAS improvement. To address this discrepancy, we propose Data Influence-oriented Tree Search (DITS), a novel framework that incorporates influence scores to guide both tree search and data selection in data synthesis. By leveraging influence scores, we effectively identify the most impactful data for MAS improvement, thereby enhancing model performance. Furthermore, we derive a novel influence score estimation method tailored for non-differentiable metrics, significantly reducing computational overhead by calculating performance changes on the validation set. Extensive experiments on three different multi-agent tasks demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed methods. Notably, our findings reveal that allocating more resources to estimate influence scores, rather than Q-values, during data synthesis can more effectively and efficiently enhance model training. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DITS-F1C4/.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在通过协作智能处理复杂任务方面展现出巨大潜力。基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的方法为增强多智能体的自我训练提供了有前景的解决方案，该方法通过生成合成数据并利用Q值来估算智能体的贡献。然而，仅依赖Q值可能无法实现选择对多智能体改进最有利的数据这一目标。为了解决这一矛盾，我们提出了数据影响导向的树搜索框架——DITS。该框架结合了影响评分，以指导树搜索和数据合成过程中的数据选择。通过利用影响评分，我们能够有效识别出对多智能体改进最具影响力的数据，从而提升模型性能。此外，我们还提出了一种针对不可微指标的新颖影响评分估算方法，该方法显著减少了计算负担，只需在验证集上计算性能变化即可。在三种不同的多智能体任务上的广泛实验证明了所提出方法的稳健性和有效性。值得注意的是，我们的研究发现表明，在数据合成过程中，分配更多资源用于估算影响评分而非Q值，能够更高效、更有效地提升模型训练效果。代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DITS-F1C4/。

papers.title: Integrating Data Validation with Large Language Models for Regulation-Guided Tabular Anomaly Detection
papers.title_zh: 将数据验证功能与大型语言模型相结合，以实现基于规则的表格异常检测
papers.authors: Haoliang Huang, Zihuang Cai, Zhuo Tang, Yifan Liu, Chen Tian, Kenli Li, Changjian Chen
papers.abstract: In many real-world applications, such as medical insurance, many regulations exist that define how data should comply with certain standards. Auditors typically use these regulations to identify anomalies in tabular data. However, existing tabular anomaly detection methods often focus on detecting anomalies based on data distribution without considering regulatory compliance. In this paper, we introduce a new task, Regulation-guided Tabular Anomaly Detection, which leverages regulations to detect anomalies in tabular data. We also developed three new datasets for this task. To address this task, we present RegValidator, a training-free method that integrates data validation with large language models (LLMs) for detecting anomalies. In this process, the LLMs generate ideas for anomaly detection from a regulation perspective, while the data validation validates these ideas from a data distribution perspective. This process can be framed as a Budgeted Maximum Coverage problem, which can be solved by a constant-factor approximation algorithm with provable guarantees. Empirical results on the new datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms existing baselines. A field experiment in a commercial health insurance company also reveals the practical value of our method. Our code is available at https://github.com/hnu-vis/RegValidator.
papers.abstract_zh: 在许多现实世界的应用中，比如医疗保险领域，存在许多规定，这些规定定义了数据应如何符合某些标准。审计人员通常会利用这些规定来识别表格数据中的异常现象。然而，现有的表格异常检测方法往往只关注基于数据分布的异常检测，而忽略了法规的合规性要求。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的任务——基于法规的表格异常检测，该任务利用法规来识别表格数据中的异常现象。我们还为这一任务开发了三个新的数据集。为了完成这项任务，我们提出了RegValidator这一无需训练的方法，该方法将数据验证与大语言模型相结合，以检测异常现象。在这个过程中，大语言模型从法规的角度生成异常检测的思路，而数据验证则从数据分布的角度来验证这些思路。这个过程可以被看作是一个预算最大覆盖问题，可以通过具有可证明保证的常数因子近似算法来解决。在新的数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法优于现有的基线方法。在一家商业健康保险公司进行的实地试验也证明了我们方法的实际价值。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/hnu-vis/RegValidator下载。

papers.title: Efficient Self-Evaluation for Diffusion Language Models via Sequence Regeneration
papers.title_zh: 通过序列生成实现扩散语言模型的高效自我评估
papers.authors: Linhao Zhong, Linyu Wu, Wen Wang, Yuling Xi, Chenchen Jing, Jiaheng Zhang, Hao Chen, Chunhua Shen
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently attracted significant attention for their ability to enhance diversity, controllability, and parallelism. However, their non-sequential, bidirectionally masked generation makes quality assessment difficult, underscoring the need for effective self-evaluation. In this work, we propose DiSE, a simple yet effective self-evaluation confidence quantification method for dLLMs. DiSE quantifies confidence by computing the probability of regenerating the tokens in the entire generated sequence, given the full context. This method enables more efficient and reliable quality assessment by leveraging token regeneration probabilities, facilitating both likelihood estimation and robust uncertainty quantification. Building upon DiSE, we further introduce a flexible-length generation framework, which adaptively controls the sequence length based on the model’s self-assessment of its own output. We analyze and validate the feasibility of DiSE from the perspective of dLLM generalization, and empirically demonstrate that DiSE is positively correlated with both semantic coherence and answer accuracy. Extensive experiments on likelihood evaluation, uncertainty quantification, and flexible-length generation further confirm the effectiveness of the proposed DiSE.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型（dLLMs）因其能够提升多样性、可控性和并行性而最近受到了广泛关注。然而，其非顺序性的双向掩码生成方式使得质量评估变得困难，这凸显了进行有效自我评估的必要性。在这项研究中，我们提出了DiSE——一种简单而有效的dLLMs自我评估置信度量化方法。DiSE通过计算在给定完整上下文的情况下重新生成整个生成序列中的令牌的概率来量化置信度。该方法通过利用令牌再生概率，实现了更高效且可靠的质量评估，从而便于进行可能性估计和稳健的不确定性量化。在DiSE的基础上，我们进一步引入了一种灵活长度的生成框架，该框架能够根据模型对自己输出的自我评估来自适应地控制序列长度。我们从dLLM泛化性的角度分析和验证了DiSE的可行性，并通过实证表明，DiSE与语义连贯性和答案准确性呈正相关。在可能性评估、不确定性量化和灵活长度生成方面的广泛实验进一步证实了所提出的DiSE的有效性。

papers.title: DeReA: Improving Idiom Translation with Detect-Retrieve-Arbitrate Reasoning
papers.title_zh: DeReA：通过检测-检索-决策推理来提升习语翻译的准确性
papers.authors: Rongqing Jiang, Xuebo Liu, Shengxin Liu, Yutong Wang, Min Zhang, Shimin Tao, Daimeng Wei, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Idiom translation remains a formidable challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs), as the constraints of static parametric memory and the noise in sentence-level retrieval often lead to literal misinterpretations. To address this, we propose DeReA, a detect-retrieve-arbitrate framework. The system employs a preference-aligned detector to identify idiomatic spans by reasoning over semantic conflicts between literal and contextual meanings. Subsequently, an idiom-centric translator invokes a fine-tuned embedding model to efficiently retrieve canonical definitions from an external knowledge base. The translator then utilizes a dual-path arbitration mechanism to select the optimal rendering by weighing the retrieval-augmented translations against direct translation. To evaluate our framework, we introduce LoMI, a high-difficulty benchmark with low data contamination. Experimental results demonstrate that DeReA significantly enhances performance across various model scales, improving GPT-5-mini by over 5.2 points in both idiomatic quality and consistency according to LLM-based metrics. Furthermore, evaluations on an emerging slang dataset from Urban Dictionary validate the potential of our approach in handling novel and evolving linguistic data. Our code is available at https://github.com/jrongqing/DeReA.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于大语言模型来说，习语翻译仍然是一个巨大的挑战。因为静态参数化记忆的限制以及句子级检索中的噪声，往往会导致对习语的误解。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了DeReA框架。该框架采用一种基于偏好对齐的检测器来识别习语片段，通过分析字面意义与上下文意义之间的语义冲突来实现这一目标。随后，一个以习语为中心的翻译器会调用经过微调的嵌入模型，从外部知识库中高效检索出规范的习语定义。翻译器还会采用双路径仲裁机制，通过权衡经过增强的检索结果和直接翻译的结果，来选择最优的翻译方式。为了评估我们的框架，我们引入了一个高难度基准测试LoMI，该测试的数据污染程度较低。实验结果表明，DeReA在不同规模的模型上都能显著提升性能，根据基于语言模型的指标，GPT-5-mini在习语质量和一致性方面的表现提升了5.2分以上。此外，我们在Urban Dictionary中收集的新兴俚语数据集上的评估也证明了我们的方法在处理新兴和不断演变的语言数据方面的潜力。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/jrongqing/DeReA下载。

papers.title: Faithful Serum: Mitigating the Faithfulness Gap in Textual Explanations of LLM Decisions via Attribution Guidance
papers.title_zh: 《忠实血清》：通过归因指导来缩小大语言模型决策文本解释中的“忠实性差距”
papers.authors: Bar Alon, Itamar Zimerman, Lior Wolf
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance and have revolutionized NLP, but their lack of explainability keeps them treated as black boxes, limiting their use in domains that demand transparency and trust. A promising direction to address this issue is post-hoc text-based explanations, which aim to explain model decisions in natural language. Prior work has focused on generating convincing rationales that appear to be subjectively faithful, but it remains unclear whether these explanations are epistemically faithful - that is, whether they reflect the internal evidence the model actually relied on for its decision. In this paper, we first assess the epistemic faithfulness of LLM-generated explanations via counterfactuals and show that they are often unfaithful. We then introduce a training-free method, that enhances faithfulness by guiding explanation generation through attention-level interventions, informed by token-level heatmaps extracted via a faithful attribution method. This method significantly improves epistemic faithfulness across multiple models, benchmarks, and prompts. Our code is attached as supplementary material.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）取得了出色的性能，彻底改变了自然语言处理领域。然而，由于其缺乏可解释性，这些模型一直被视作“黑盒”，这限制了它们在需要透明度和信任的领域的应用。解决这一问题的一种有前景的方法是事后基于文本的解释，其目的是用自然语言来解释模型的决策。之前的研究主要集中在生成看似主观上可信的合理解释上，但尚不清楚这些解释是否在认知上也是真实的——也就是说，它们是否反映了模型在做出决策时所依赖的内部证据。在本文中，我们首先通过反事实方法来评估LLM生成的解释在认知上的真实性，结果表明这些解释往往并不真实。然后，我们提出了一种无需训练的方法，该方法通过注意力级干预来指导解释的生成，这些干预是基于通过忠实归因方法提取出的标记级热图来进行的。这种方法显著提高了多种模型、基准测试以及不同提示下的认知真实性。我们的代码作为补充材料附在文末。

papers.title: Visually-Guided Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 基于视觉引导的政策优化方法，用于多模态推理
papers.authors: Zengbin Wang, Feng Xiong, Liang Lin, Xuecai Hu, Yong Wang, Yanlin Wang, Man Zhang, Xiangxiang Chu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced the reasoning ability of vision-language models (VLMs). However, the inherent text-dominated nature of VLMs often leads to insufficient visual faithfulness, characterized by sparse attention activation to visual tokens. More importantly, our empirical analysis reveals that temporal visual forgetting along reasoning steps exacerbates this deficiency. To bridge this gap, we propose Visually-Guided Policy Optimization (VGPO), a novel framework to reinforce visual focus during policy optimization. Specifically, VGPO initially introduces a Visual Attention Compensation mechanism that leverages visual similarity to localize and amplify visual cues, while progressively elevating visual expectations in later steps to counteract visual forgetting. Building on this mechanism, we implement a dual-grained advantage re-weighting strategy: the intra-trajectory level highlights tokens exhibiting relatively high visual activation, while the inter-trajectory level prioritizes trajectories demonstrating superior visual accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VGPO achieves better visual activation and superior performance in mathematical multimodal reasoning and visual-dependent tasks. The code has been released at https://github.com/wzb-bupt/VGPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了视觉-语言模型的推理能力。然而，由于视觉-语言模型本身以文本为主的特点，其视觉忠实度往往不足，表现为对视觉线索的关注度较低。更重要的是，我们的实证分析表明，推理过程中出现的视觉遗忘现象会进一步加剧这一缺陷。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种名为“视觉引导策略优化”（VGPO）的新框架。该框架在策略优化过程中引入了一种视觉注意力补偿机制，利用视觉相似性来定位并增强视觉线索的作用；同时，在后续步骤中逐步提高对视觉线索的期望值，以对抗视觉遗忘的影响。在此基础上，我们采用了一种双粒度优势重加权策略：在轨迹内部层面，优先处理那些表现出较高视觉激活度的线索；在轨迹之间层面，则优先考虑那些具有较好视觉积累能力的轨迹。大量实验表明，VGPO在提高视觉激活度以及提升数学多模态推理和依赖视觉的任务表现方面都取得了良好效果。相关代码已发布在https://github.com/wzb-bupt/VGPO上。

papers.title: Don’t Be Misled by Style: A Style-Adaptive Reranker for Capturing Effective Knowledge in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 不要被风格所误导：一种适应不同风格的重新排序方法，有助于在检索增强生成中获取有效的知识
papers.authors: Ruwen Zhang, Bo Liu, Zhang Sheng Xiang, Yida Chen, Hantao Zhao, Ding Ding, Jiahui Jin, Jiuxin Cao
papers.abstract: Rerankers are critical in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for filtering evidence that enhances the accurate generation of LLMs. With the extension to open-domain scenarios, rerankers are inevitably deployed on mixed-style corpora, whereas most existing rerankers are mainly trained on well-edited texts. A rarely explored issue lies in enabling rerankers to maximally capture the effective knowledge for downstream LLMs without being misled by stylistic features. To address this issue, we propose SARK (Style-Adaptive Reranker with Knowledge Prioritization), a style-augmented multi-task framework that prioritizes effective knowledge over stylistic perturbations. SARK performs multi-granular knowledge mining by using an LLM to derive passage-level supervision on whether a passage helps or harms answer correctness, and list-level relative ranking preferences over candidate passages. It then jointly optimizes the reranker model with passage-level classification and list-level ranking objectives via style-augmented multi-task learning, encouraging the model to focus on the information needed for answering under mixed-style scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SARK improves generation performance across multiple LLMs under mixed-style conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 重新排序器在基于检索增强生成的模型中起着至关重要的作用，它们能够过滤出有助于提升大语言模型生成效果的证据。随着应用场景的扩展，重新排序器被广泛应用于混合风格的文本数据上，而现有的大多数重新排序器主要训练于经过精心编辑的文本数据上。一个常被忽视的问题是，如何让重新排序器最大限度地捕捉到对下游大语言模型有用的知识，同时避免被文本风格特征所误导。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SARK（具有知识优先级调整的风格自适应重新排序器）这一基于风格增强的多任务框架。该框架通过让大语言模型对段落对答案的准确性产生正面或负面影响进行监督，从而实现对有效知识的多层次挖掘。同时，它还能根据候选段落的相对排名偏好来优化重新排序器的模型结构。通过风格增强的多任务学习机制，SARK能够同时实现段落级别的分类和列表级别的排序目标，从而促使模型在混合风格场景下专注于回答所需的信息。大量实验表明，SARK能够在多种大语言模型的混合风格条件下提升生成效果。

papers.title: Text2Tabular – Reconstructing Tabular Research Data from Scientific Publications
papers.title_zh: 文本转表格——从科学论文中还原表格形式的研究数据
papers.authors: Jonas Gottal, Florian Matthes
papers.abstract: The increasing reliance on data-driven research underscores the need for accessible datasets, particularly in the medical domain. However, raw datasets are frequently unavailable due to privacy constraints and ethical considerations, which complicates reproducibility, meta-analyses, and large-scale data-driven research. Text2Tabular addresses this challenge by reconstructing research datasets from scientific publications using advanced natural language processing and statistical modeling. Our key contributions include: (1) a unified framework combining Large Language Model driven information extraction with copula-based distribution modeling, (2) novel integration of statistical test results as distribution constraints through constrained Markov Chain Monte Carlo refinement, and (3) an own comprehensive benchmark comprising real scientific publications with corresponding raw datasets for evaluating our literature-based data reconstruction. Evaluation on both benchmark datasets and our curated collection demonstrates strong performance in Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) evaluations, alongside accurate replication of descriptive statistics showing that Text2Tabular preserves the statistical properties and multivariate relationships of the original datasets. Text2Tabular facilitates scientific progress by enabling immediate access to realistic, domain-specific synthetic data, thus, improving data accessibility, and mitigating data scarcity in fields with limited real-world data.
papers.abstract_zh: 对数据驱动研究的日益依赖，凸显了获取可访问数据集的必要性，尤其是在医学领域。然而，由于隐私限制和伦理考量，原始数据集往往难以获得，这使得数据的可复现性、元分析以及大规模数据驱动研究变得复杂。Text2Tabular通过利用先进的自然语言处理和统计建模技术，从科学出版物中重建研究数据集，从而解决了这一挑战。我们的主要贡献包括：(1) 结合大语言模型驱动的信息提取与基于copula的分布建模的统一框架；(2) 通过受限马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛优化方法，将统计测试结果作为分布约束因素进行整合；(3) 我们自行构建了一个包含真实科学出版物及其相应原始数据集的全面基准测试集，用于评估我们的文献基础数据重建能力。在基准测试集以及我们精心挑选的数据集上的评估结果显示，Text2Tabular在训练-合成-真实测试（TSTR）评估中表现优异，同时其描述性统计数据的复制准确性也表明，Text2Tabular能够保留原始数据集的统计属性和多变量关系。Text2Tabular通过提供即时访问到现实、特定领域的合成数据，促进了科学的进步，从而提高了数据的可获取性，并缓解了实际数据有限的领域中的数据短缺问题。

papers.title: From "Aha Moments" to Controllable Thinking: Toward Meta-Cognitive Reasoning in LRMs via Decoupled Reasoning and Control
papers.title_zh: 从“顿悟时刻”到可控思维：通过分离推理与控制实现记忆重构模型中的元认知推理
papers.authors: Rui Ha, Rui Pu, Chaozhuo Li, Li Sun, Sen Su
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) can exhibit step-by-step reasoning, reflection, and backtracking, but these behaviors are often unregulated, leading to overthinking. As a result, LRMs continue generating redundant reasoning even after reaching high-confidence conclusions. This increases inference cost and latency, limiting practical deployment. The root cause is the absence of an intrinsic mechanism to monitor the reasoning state and decide when to continue, backtrack, or stop. We propose MERA, a meta-cognitive reasoning framework that decouples reasoning from control to enable independent optimization of control strategies. MERA constructs high-quality reasoning–control supervision data via a takeover-based pipeline, and transforms long-horizon traces into structured reasoning–control alternating sequences for training. The model is trained with supervised fine-tuning to internalize the structured separation, and further optimized with Control-Segment Policy Optimization (CSPO), which combines segment-wise GRPO with control masking to focus learning on control segments. Experiments across reasoning benchmarks show that MERA improves both efficiency and accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）能够展现出逐步推理、反思和回溯等能力，但这些行为往往缺乏监管，导致过度思考。因此，即使在得出高置信度的结论后，LRMs仍会继续产生冗余的推理内容。这会增加推理的成本和延迟，从而限制其实际应用。问题的根源在于缺乏一种机制来监控推理状态，并决定何时继续、回溯或停止。我们提出了MERA这一元认知推理框架，该框架将推理与控制分离，从而实现控制策略的独立优化。MERA通过基于接管机制的流程构建高质量的推理-控制监督数据，并将长期视角下的轨迹转化为结构化的推理-控制交替序列以进行训练。该模型通过有监督的微调来内化这种结构化的分离机制，并通过控制分段策略优化（CSPO）进一步优化，该算法结合了分段GRPO和控制掩蔽技术，使学习重点集中在控制段上。在多个推理基准测试中的实验表明，MERA在效率和准确性方面都取得了提升。

papers.title: Calibrating Inference Time Alignment with Sequence-level Risk Accumulation
papers.title_zh: 通过序列级风险累积来校准推理时间的同步性
papers.authors: Shanwen Tan, Ziyang Dong, Wei Ju, Yiwei Fu, Hao Wu, Kun Wang, Yifan Wang, Ziyue Qiao
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the problem of safe decoding for Large Language Models (LLMs) during inference, particularly under jailbreak attacks. Previous approaches typically either detect malicious content or regulate the decoding alignment of LLMs to mitigate such attacks. Although effective in defending against attacks, these methods often over-reject benign content, limiting their generalizability in real-world scenarios where harmful and benign information coexist. Towards this end, we propose an innovative framework named Sequence-level risk Accumulation for calibrating test-time alignment (SEAT). Specifically, SEAT introduces a reward-guided branch decoding paradigm to incorporate safety awareness during generation. To balance the detection of harmful content with the accurate response to benign information, SEAT employs a sequence-level risk monitor that smooths risk signals over the entire sequence, preventing over-confident refusals for certain tokens. Furthermore, we conduct extensive experiments on four attack benchmarks and two neutral datasets, comparing SEAT with eight state-of-the-art baselines. Consequently, the results demonstrate that SEAT achieves superior performance both in defending against jailbreak attacks and in generating high-quality responses on neutral datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/ShanwenTan/SEAT.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在推理过程中对大语言模型进行安全解码的问题，尤其是针对越狱攻击的情况。以往的方法通常要么检测恶意内容，要么调整语言模型的解码对齐方式以缓解此类攻击。虽然这些方法在防御攻击方面效果显著，但它们往往过度拒绝有益内容，这限制了它们在现实世界场景中的通用性——因为在现实世界中，有害信息和有益信息并存。为此，我们提出了一种名为“序列级风险累积法”的创新框架，用于校准测试时的解码对齐方式。具体来说，该框架引入了一种基于奖励的分支解码范式，以便在生成过程中融入安全性考量。为了在检测有害内容和准确处理有益信息之间取得平衡，SEAT采用了一种序列级风险监测机制，该机制能够平滑整个序列中的风险信号，从而避免对某些标记产生过于自信的拒绝行为。此外，我们在四个攻击基准测试和两个中立数据集上进行了广泛的实验，并将SEAT与八种最先进的基线方法进行了比较。结果表明，SEAT在防御越狱攻击以及在中立数据集上生成高质量响应方面均表现出色。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/ShanwenTan/SEAT下载。

papers.title: Diff4TST: Masked Diffusion Language Model for Text Style Transfer
papers.title_zh: Diff4TST：用于文本风格迁移的掩码扩散语言模型
papers.authors: Xinchen Ma, Gaole He, Yunshi Lan, Weining Qian
papers.abstract: Despite recent progress in LLMs for text style transfer, most existing methods rely on costly task-specific training and offer limited control over separating stylistic modification from content preservation. We propose Diff4TST, a diffusion-based language model that formulates text style transfer as an explicit copy-and-edit process. Built upon masked diffusion language models, Diff4TST introduces a style-aware noise schedule that selectively perturbs stylistic tokens while preserving content-bearing tokens during supervised fine-tuning.At inference time, we further introduce a generate-then-refine strategy that iteratively improves style compliance via gradient-based token re-masking, without reinforcement learning or external reward models. Extensive experiments on both fine-grained and polarity-based benchmarks show that Diff4TST achieves substantially improved style accuracy and controllability while maintaining strong content preservation and fluency. These results suggest diffusion-based language models as a principled and effective alternative to autoregressive pipelines for text style transfer.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在语言模型在文本风格转换方面取得了一些进展，但大多数现有方法仍然依赖于成本高昂的特定任务训练，并且在区分风格修改与内容保留方面存在局限性。我们提出了Diff4TST这一基于扩散技术的语言模型，它将文本风格转换视为一种明确的复制和编辑过程。该模型基于掩码扩散语言模型构建，引入了一种注重风格的噪声调度机制，能够在监督微调过程中选择性地修改风格相关的元素，同时保留内容相关的元素。在推理阶段，我们进一步采用了一种生成-再优化的策略，通过基于梯度的令牌重新掩蔽来逐步提升风格一致性，而无需使用强化学习或外部奖励机制。在细粒度及基于极性基准测试中的大量实验表明，Diff4TST在保持强大内容保留性和流畅性的同时，显著提高了风格转换的准确性和可控性。这些结果表明，基于扩散技术的语言模型是一种原则性强且有效的替代自回归方法的文本风格转换方案。
