papers.title: In-depth Research Impact Summarization through Fine-Grained Temporal Citation Analysis
papers.title_zh: 通过细致的时间引用分析来总结深度研究的影响成果
papers.authors: Hiba Arnaout, Noy Sternlicht, Tom Hope, Iryna Gurevych
papers.abstract: Understanding the impact of scientific publications is crucial for identifying breakthroughs and guiding future research. Traditional metrics based on citation counts often miss the nuanced ways a paper contributes to its field. In this work, we propose a new task: generating nuanced, expressive, and time-aware impact summaries that capture both praise (confirmation citations) and critique (correction citations) through the evolution of fine-grained citation intents. We introduce an evaluation framework tailored to this task, showing moderate to strong human correlation on subjective metrics such as insightfulness. Expert feedback from professors reveals a strong interest in these summaries and suggests future improvements. Data and code are made available.
papers.abstract_zh: 了解科学出版物的影响对于识别突破性成果和指导未来的研究至关重要。传统的基于引用次数的评估方法往往无法捕捉到一篇论文对其所在领域的细微贡献。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新的任务：生成细致、富有表现力且考虑时间因素的影响力总结，通过精细化的引用意图来同时捕捉正面评价和负面评价。我们为此设计了一个专门的评估框架，结果显示在诸如洞察力这样的主观指标上，人类的评估结果与模型预测有中等到强的相关性。来自教授们的反馈表明，他们对这些总结非常感兴趣，并提出了一些改进的建议。相关数据和方法代码已公开提供。

papers.title: QuantileMark: A Message-Symmetric Multi-bit Watermark for LLMs
papers.title_zh: QuantileMark：一种适用于大型语言模型的消息对称多比特水印技术
papers.authors: Junlin Zhu, Baizhou Huang, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: As large language models become standard backends for content generation, practical provenance increasingly requires multi-bit watermarking. In provider-internal deployments, a key requirement is message symmetry: the message itself should not systematically affect either text quality or verification outcomes.Vocabulary-partition watermarks can break message symmetry in low-entropy decoding: some messages are assigned most of the probability mass, while others are forced to use tail tokens. This makes embedding quality and message decoding accuracy message-dependent.We propose QuantileMark, a white-box multi-bit watermark that embeds messages within the continuous cumulative probability interval [0, 1).At each step, QuantileMark partitions this interval into M equal-mass bins and samples strictly from the bin assigned to the target symbol, ensuring a fixed 1/M probability budget regardless of context entropy.For detection, the verifier reconstructs the same partition under teacher forcing, computes posteriors over latent bins, and aggregates evidence for verification.We prove message-unbiasedness, a property ensuring that the base distribution is recovered when averaging over messages. This provides a theoretical foundation for generation-side symmetry, while the equal-mass design additionally promotes uniform evidence strength across messages on the detection side.Empirical results on C4 continuation and LFQA show improved multi-bit recovery and detection robustness over strong baselines, with negligible impact on generation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型成为内容生成的标准后端，实际的来源验证越来越需要采用多比特水印技术。在供应商内部的部署中，一个关键要求是消息的对称性：消息本身不应系统地影响文本质量或验证结果。词汇分割水印会在低熵解码过程中破坏消息的对称性：一些消息被分配了大部分概率权重，而其他消息则被迫使用尾部令牌。这导致嵌入质量和消息解码精度依赖于消息本身。我们提出了QuantileMark，这是一种白盒多比特水印技术，它将消息嵌入到连续累积概率区间[0, 1)内。在每个步骤中，QuantileMark将这个区间划分为M个等质量的区间，并严格从目标符号所分配的区间内抽取样本，从而确保无论上下文熵如何变化，概率分配始终为1/M。在检测阶段，验证器在教师驱动下重建相同的分区结构，计算潜在区间的后验概率，并汇总证据以进行验证。我们证明了QuantileMark具有消息无偏性，这一特性确保了在平均处理消息时能够恢复原始分布。这为生成端的对称性提供了理论基础，而等质量的设计还使得在检测端各个消息的证据强度保持一致。在C4延续任务和LFQA任务上的实验结果表明，与强大的基线方法相比，QuantileMark在多比特恢复和检测鲁棒性方面表现更好，且对生成质量的影响微乎其微。

papers.title: Standard-to-Dialect Transfer Trends Differ across Text and Speech: A Case Study on Intent and Topic Classification in German Dialects
papers.title_zh: 标准语与方言之间的转换趋势在文本和语音方面存在差异：以德语方言中的意图识别与主题分类为例进行的研究
papers.authors: Verena Blaschke, Miriam Winkler, Barbara Plank
papers.abstract: Research on cross-dialectal transfer from a standard to a non-standard dialect variety has typically focused on text data. However, dialects are primarily spoken, and non-standard spellings cause issues in text processing. We compare standard-to-dialect transfer in three settings: text models, speech models, and cascaded systems where speech first gets automatically transcribed and then further processed by a text model. We focus on German dialects in the context of written and spoken intent classification – releasing the first dialectal audio intent classification dataset – with supporting experiments on topic classification. The speech-only setup provides the best results on the dialect data while the text-only setup works best on the standard data. While the cascaded systems lag behind the text-only models for German, they perform relatively well on the dialectal data if the transcription system generates normalized, standard-like output.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于从标准方言到非标准方言的跨方言转换研究，通常集中在文本数据上。然而，方言主要是用口语表达的，而非标准的拼写方式会在文本处理过程中引发问题。我们在三种环境下对比了从标准方言到非标准方言的转换：文本模型、语音模型和级联系统。在级联系统中，语音首先被自动转录，然后由文本模型进行进一步处理。我们专注于德语方言在书面和口语意图分类中的应用——发布了首个基于方言音频的意图分类数据集，并进行了相关主题分类实验。仅使用语音环境的设置在处理方言数据时表现最佳，而仅使用文本环境的设置则在处理标准方言数据时效果最好。虽然对于德语来说，级联系统在处理方言数据时不如纯文本模型，但如果转录系统能够生成标准化、类似标准的结果，那么级联系统在方言数据处理方面也能表现出相对良好的性能。

papers.title: Don’t Click That: Teaching Web Agents to Resist Deceptive Interfaces
papers.title_zh: 不要点击那个链接：教会网络代理抵抗欺骗性界面设计
papers.authors: Yilin Zhang, Yingkai Hua, Chunyu Wei, Xin Wang, Yueguo Chen
papers.abstract: Vision-language model (VLM) based web agents demonstrate impressive autonomous GUI interaction but remain vulnerable to deceptive interface elements. Existing approaches either detect deception without task integration or document attacks without proposing defenses. We formalize deception-aware web agent defense and propose DUDE (Deceptive UI Detector Evaluator), a two-stage framework combining hybrid-reward learning with asymmetric penalties and experience summarization to distill failure patterns into transferable guidance. We introduce RUC (Real UI Clickboxes), a benchmark of 1,407 scenarios spanning four domains and deception categories. Experiments show DUDE reduces deception susceptibility by 53.8% while maintaining task performance, establishing an effective foundation for robust web agent deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于视觉-语言模型的网络代理能够展现出出色的自主图形用户界面交互能力，但依然容易受到欺骗性界面元素的攻击。现有的方法要么无法在任务执行过程中检测欺骗行为，要么只能记录攻击行为而未能提出防御措施。我们提出了一种具有欺骗识别能力的网络代理防御机制，并开发了DUDE（欺骗性用户界面检测器与评估器）这一两阶段框架。该框架结合了混合奖励机制、不对称惩罚策略以及经验总结技术，从而能够总结出可迁移的防御策略。我们还引入了RUC（真实用户界面点击框）这一基准测试，该测试涵盖了四个领域和多种欺骗类型，共计1,407个场景。实验结果表明，DUDE能够将欺骗行为的易感性降低53.8%，同时还能保持任务执行性能，为构建稳健的网络代理提供了有效的基础。

papers.title: Empirical Analysis of Decoding Biases in Masked Diffusion Models
papers.title_zh: 关于掩码扩散模型中解码偏差的实证分析
papers.authors: Pengcheng Huang, Tianming Liu, Zhenghao Liu, Yukun Yan, Shuo Wang, Tong Xiao, Zulong Chen, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) have recently emerged as a promising non-autoregressive paradigm for sequence generation. However, their performance is highly sensitive to the choice of decoding strategy. In this work, we reveal that prevalent uncertainty-based decoding strategies induce two decoding biases in MDMs: rigid boundary bias and trivial token bias. These biases limit the model’s reasoning ability and ultimately degrade generation quality. To address these challenges, we propose UNmasking Calibration for DecOding DEbiasing (UNCODE), a decoding calibration framework that regularizes uncertainty-based decoding by incorporating two complementary priors to shape global decoding trajectories and promote content informativeness. Extensive experiments on three advanced MDMs across seven reasoning- and planning-intensive benchmarks demonstrate that UNCODE consistently outperforms existing decoding strategies by more than 7%, while achieving performance comparable to autoregressive models of similar parameter scales. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/NEUIR/Uncode.
papers.abstract_zh: 掩蔽扩散模型（MDMs）最近成为一种有前景的非自回归序列生成方法。然而，其性能对解码策略的选择非常敏感。在这项研究中，我们发现常见的基于不确定性的解码策略会在MDMs中引发两种解码偏差：刚性边界偏差和琐碎标记偏差。这些偏差限制了模型的推理能力，最终降低了生成的品质。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为“解码去偏差的掩蔽校准”的方法（UNCODE）。该校准框架通过引入两个互补的先验信息来规范基于不确定性的解码过程，从而塑造全局解码轨迹并提升内容的信息性。在七个涉及推理和规划的高阶MDMs上进行的大量实验表明，UNCODE在性能上始终优于现有的解码策略，其性能提升了7%以上，同时还能达到与参数规模相近的自回归模型相当的水平。该代码的下载链接为https://github.com/NEUIR/Uncode。

papers.title: LAFaCT: Attribution-based Localization and Focused Sequential Analysis of Fact-Critical Tokens for Hallucination Detection
papers.title_zh: LAFaCT：基于属性分配的局部化处理以及针对幻觉检测的关键事实的序列分析
papers.authors: Xin Wang, Jiahao Li, Licheng Zhang, Zhendong Mao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) suffer from hallucinations, severely undermining their reliability. While white-box hallucination detection methods that leverage hidden states prevail, they fail to identify and focus on fact-critical information when analyzing token sequences. To address this, we propose LAFaCT, a Localize-then-Analyze detection framework. It first localizes fact-critical tokens using Factual Criticality, a novel metric derived from feature attribution. A subsequent stage then performs a focused sequential analysis on their hidden states. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks and multiple model families confirm LAFaCT as the new state-of-the-art, with in-depth analyses validating the effectiveness of its core token-localization strategy.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型存在幻觉问题，这严重影响了它们的可靠性。虽然有一些基于隐藏状态的白盒幻觉检测方法，但这些方法在分析令牌序列时无法准确识别并关注关键事实信息。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了LAFaCT这一检测框架。该框架首先使用“事实关键性”这一新型指标来定位关键事实令牌，然后再对它们的隐藏状态进行有针对性的分析。在八个基准测试和多款模型上的广泛实验表明，LAFaCT确实达到了最先进的水平，深入的分析也验证了其核心的令牌定位策略的有效性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: DPC: Training-Free Text-to-SQL Candidate Selection via Dual-Paradigm Consistency
papers.title_zh: DPC：基于双范式一致性的无需训练的文本转SQL候选者选择方法
papers.authors: Boyan Li, Ou Ocean Kun Hei, Yue Yu, Yuyu Luo
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive proficiency in generating SQL queries, they fundamentally lack the capability to self-evaluate correctness without an execution oracle. This limitation creates a stark Generation-Selection Gap, where high potential accuracy (Pass@K) fails to translate into execution accuracy (Pass@1). Although supervised verifiers offer mitigation, they incur prohibitive annotation costs and suffer from domain fragility. Consequently, recent research has pivoted to the training-free setting. However, existing methods—such as Self-Consistency or LLM-as-a-Judge—remain hampered by systematic bias (consensus on hallucinations) and symbolic blindness (inability to simulate execution states). We introduce DPC (Dual-Paradigm Consistency), a multi-agent framework that reformulates SQL selection from a probabilistic guessing task on hidden data into a deterministic verification task on visible data. Specifically, DPC employs a Slicer and a Tester agent to collaboratively construct a Minimal Distinguishing Database (MDD)—an adversarial, fully observable micro-environment engineered to expose logical discrepancies between candidates. To break the self-correction bias, a Solver agent then verifies the SQL candidates by cross-referencing their execution against a parallel Python/Pandas solution. By validating execution consistency between declarative (SQL) and imperative (Python) paradigms, DPC robustly discriminates correct logic from systematic hallucinations. Experiments on BIRD and Spider across multiple LLMs demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing selection baselines, achieving absolute accuracy improvements of up to 2.2% over strong competitors like Self-Consistency.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在生成SQL查询方面表现出色，但它们从根本上缺乏在没有执行验证器的情况下自我评估正确性的能力。这一限制导致了“生成与选择之间的差距”，即高潜在准确率（Pass@K）无法转化为实际执行中的准确率（Pass@1）。尽管有监督验证方法可以缓解这一问题，但这些方法会带来高昂的标注成本，并且容易受到领域限制的影响。因此，最近的研究转向了无需训练的方法。然而，现有的方法，如自一致性或LLM作为裁判的方法，仍然受到系统性偏差（对幻觉的共识问题）和符号盲点（无法模拟执行状态）的困扰。我们提出了DPC（双范式一致性）方法，这是一种多智能体框架，它将SQL选择的任务从对隐藏数据的概率性猜测转变为对可见数据的确定性验证。具体来说，DPC利用Slicer和Tester智能体共同构建一个最小区分数据库——一个完全可观察的微环境，用于揭示候选语句之间的逻辑差异。为了打破自我修正的偏差，Solve智能体会通过对比SQL候选语句的执行结果与平行运行的Python/Pandas解决方案来验证它们。通过验证声明式（SQL）和命令式（Python）范式之间的执行一致性，DPC能够稳健地区分正确的逻辑和系统性幻觉。在多个LLM上进行的BIRD和Spider实验表明，我们的方法始终优于现有的选择基准算法，其绝对准确率提升了2.2%，超过了诸如自一致性这样的强大竞争对手。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Metaphor Reasoning is Meta-reasoning
papers.title_zh: 隐喻推理属于元推理范畴
papers.authors: Qianyu He, Junting Lu, Yikai Zhang, Siyu Yuan, Xiaojun Meng, Jiansheng Wei, Jiaqing Liang, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: Metaphor reasoning is an essential cognitive ability that maps knowledge from familiar domains to more abstract domains. This ability functions as a meta-ability underlying many types of reasoning. However, existing work rarely investigates how metaphor reasoning affects other reasoning abilities. To bridge this gap, we systematically study how metaphor reasoning, particularly through metaphorical riddles, can enhance broader reasoning abilities in large language models. We propose MetaR, an automated system for synthesizing metaphorical riddles that satisfy five quality dimensions: diverse, balanced, reasoning-oriented, challenging, and verifiable. Leveraging that answer categories determine riddle categories, we employ a hierarchical answer taxonomy for the former three criteria and a multi-agent refinement framework for the latter two, generating a high-quality dataset. Training with reinforcement learning on verifiable rewards using only thousands of metaphorical riddles, we demonstrate improvements across six out-of-distribution reasoning domains. Analysis reveals transfer effectiveness depends on model scale and pattern-target domain alignment. The datasets and code are publicly available at https://github.com/Abbey4799/MetaR.
papers.abstract_zh: 隐喻推理是一种重要的认知能力，它能够将知识从熟悉的领域映射到更抽象的领域。这种能力作为一种元能力，支撑着许多类型的推理过程。然而，现有的研究很少探讨隐喻推理如何影响其他推理能力。为了填补这一空白，我们系统地研究了如何通过隐喻谜题来提升大语言模型的综合推理能力。我们提出了MetaR系统，这是一个自动生成符合五个质量标准的隐喻谜题的系统：多样性、平衡性、以推理为导向、具有挑战性以及可验证性。通过利用答案类别来确定谜题类别，我们对前三个标准采用层次化的答案分类方法，对后两个标准则采用多智能体细化框架，从而生成了高质量的数据集。通过仅使用数千个隐喻谜题进行强化学习训练，并在可验证的奖励下进行训练，我们发现在六个非分布式推理领域中都取得了改进效果。分析表明，这种能力的迁移效果取决于模型规模以及模式与目标领域的对齐程度。这些数据集和代码可以在https://github.com/Abbey4799/MetaR上免费获取。

papers.title: Beyond Hard Masks: Progressive Token Evolution for Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越硬mask：渐进式代币机制对扩散语言模型的革新影响
papers.authors: Linhao Zhong, Linyu Wu, Bozhen Fang, Tianjian Feng, Chenchen Jing, Wen Wang, Jiaheng Zhang, Hao Chen, Chunhua Shen
papers.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer a promising alternative for language modeling by enabling parallel decoding through iterative refinement. However, most DLMs rely on hard binary masking and discrete token assignments, which hinder the revision of early decisions and underutilize intermediate probabilistic representations. In this paper, we propose EvoToken-DLM, a novel diffusion-based language modeling approach that replaces hard binary masks with evolving soft token distributions. EvoToken-DLM enables a progressive transition from masked states to discrete outputs, supporting revisable decoding. To effectively support this evolution, we introduce continuous trajectory supervision, which aligns training objectives with iterative probabilistic updates. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that EvoToken-DLM consistently achieves superior performance, outperforming strong diffusion-based and masked DLM baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/aim-uofa/EvoTokenDLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）通过实现迭代优化下的并行解码，为语言建模提供了有前景的替代方案。然而，大多数DLM依赖于硬二进制掩码和离散令牌分配方式，这限制了早期决策的修正，同时也没有充分利用中间的概率表示。在本文中，我们提出了EvoToken-DLM这一基于扩散技术的新型语言建模方法。该方法用不断变化的软令牌分布取代了硬二进制掩码，从而实现从掩码状态到离散输出的逐步过渡，并支持可修正的解码过程。为了有效支持这种演变过程，我们引入了连续轨迹监督机制，使训练目标与迭代概率更新保持一致。在多个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，EvoToken-DLM始终表现出卓越的性能，其表现优于许多强大的基于扩散技术和掩码技术的DLM基线模型。我们的代码可在https://github.com/aim-uofa/EvoTokenDLM获取。

papers.title: MAS-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Shortcut-Augmented Hybrid Mobile GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: MAS-Bench：一种针对带有捷径功能的混合式移动图形用户界面智能体的统一测试基准
papers.authors: Pengxiang Zhao, Guangyi Liu, Yaozhen Liang, Weiqing He, Zhengxi Lu, WenHao Wang, Yuehao Huang, Yuxiang Chai, Zhaolu Kang, Yaxuan Guo, Hao Wang, Kexin Zhang, Liang Liu, Yong Liu
papers.abstract: Shortcuts such as APIs and deep-links have emerged as efficient complements to flexible GUI operations, fostering a promising hybrid paradigm for MLLM-based mobile automation. However, systematic evaluation of GUI–shortcut hybrid agents remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MAS-Bench, a benchmark that pioneers the evaluation of GUI-shortcut hybrid agents with a specific focus on the mobile domain. Beyond merely using predefined shortcuts, MAS-Bench assesses an agent’s capability to autonomously generate shortcuts by discovering and creating reusable, low-cost workflows. It features 139 complex tasks across 11 real-world applications, a knowledge base of 88 predefined shortcuts (APIs, deep-links, RPA scripts), and 9 evaluation metrics. Experiments demonstrate that hybrid agents achieve up to 68.3% success rate and 39% greater execution efficiency than GUI-only counterparts. Furthermore, our evaluation framework effectively reveals the quality gap between predefined and agent-generated shortcuts, validating its capability to assess shortcut generation methods. MAS-Bench addresses the lack of systematic benchmarks for GUI-shortcut hybrid mobile agents, providing a foundational platform for future advancements in creating more efficient and robust intelligent agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 诸如API和深度链接之类的快捷方式已经成为了灵活GUI操作的有效补充，为基于MLLM的移动自动化提供了一种有前景的混合式解决方案。然而，对GUI-快捷方式混合代理的系统性评估仍然鲜有研究。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了MAS-Bench这个基准测试工具，它专门致力于评估移动领域的GUI-快捷方式混合代理。除了使用预定义的快捷方式外，MAS-Bench还评估了代理自主生成快捷方式的能力，通过发现并创建可复用的、低成本的工作流程来实现这一目标。该基准测试包含139个复杂任务，涉及11个真实应用场景，拥有88种预定义的快捷方式（包括API、深度链接和RPA脚本），以及9个评估指标。实验结果表明，混合代理的成功率高达68.3%，执行效率也比仅使用GUI的代理高出39%。此外，我们的评估框架能够有效揭示预定义快捷方式与代理生成的快捷方式之间的质量差异，从而验证了其评估快捷方式生成方法的能力。MAS-Bench解决了缺乏针对GUI-快捷方式混合移动代理的系统性基准测试的问题，为未来开发更高效、更强大的智能代理提供了基础平台。

papers.title: HoWToBench: Holistic Evaluation for LLM’s Capability in Human-level Writing using Tree of Writing
papers.title_zh: HoWToBench：基于整体评估的方法，用于判断大型语言模型在人类水平写作能力方面的表现，该方法运用了“写作树”模型
papers.authors: Andrew Zhuoer Feng, Cunxiang Wang, Yu Luo, Lin Fan, Irene Zhou, Zikang Wang, Xiaotao Gu, Jie Tang, Hongning Wang, Minlie Huang
papers.abstract: Evaluating the writing capabilities of large language models (LLMs) remains a significant challenge due to the multidimensional nature of writing skills and the limitations of existing metrics. LLM’s performance in thousand-words level and open-ended writing is inadequately assessed by traditional reference-based metrics or modern LLM-as-a-judge methods. We propose Tree-of-Writing (ToW), to resolve the implicit inconsistency often found when LLM-as-a-judge aggregates all sub-features in text evaluation. ToW incorporates a tree-structured workflow by explicitly modeling the aggregation weights of sub-features. We also present HowToBench, a large-scale Chinese writing benchmark encompassing 12 genres and 1302 instructions across three task categories: contextual completion, outline-guided writing, and open-ended generation. ToW successfully mitigates the biases, achieving a 0.93 Pearson correlation with human judgments. Furthermore, we detect that both overlap-based text generation metrics and popular LLM-as-a-judge practices are vulnerable to textual disturbances, while ToW is robust to them. We also uncover a negative correlation between input length and content-related scores in the Guide task, showcasing that it cannot be simply improved by input-side information piling.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型（LLM）的写作能力仍然是一个重大挑战，因为写作技能具有多维度特性，而现有的评估指标也存在局限性。传统基于参考的评估方法以及现代的语言模型作为裁判的方法，都未能充分评估LLM在千字级写作和开放式写作方面的表现。我们提出了“写作树”模型来解决这个问题，该模型能够解决在语言模型作为裁判时出现的隐性不一致性问题，这种不一致性通常源于对文本中所有子特征的聚合处理。写作树模型通过构建树状工作流程，明确建模了子特征的聚合权重。我们还介绍了HowToBench，这是一个大规模的中文写作基准测试，涵盖了12种文体和1302条任务指令，涉及三种任务类别：上下文补全、大纲引导写作和开放式生成。写作树模型成功地减少了这些评估中的偏差，与人类判断的皮尔逊相关系数达到了0.93。此外，我们发现，基于重叠的文本生成评估指标以及流行的语言模型作为裁判的方法都容易受到文本干扰的影响，而写作树模型则对这些干扰具有更强的抵抗力。我们还发现，在指导任务中，输入长度与内容相关得分之间存在负相关关系，这表明单纯通过增加输入信息并不能有效提升性能。

papers.title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Step-Level Transitions for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 基于层次强化学习的语言模型智能体技术，包含增强的步级转换机制
papers.authors: Shuai Zhen, Yanhua Yu, Ruopei Guo, Nan Cheng, Yang Deng
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex interactive decision-making tasks. However, existing LLM agents typically rely on increasingly long interaction histories, resulting in high computational cost and limited scalability. In this paper, we propose STEP-HRL, a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that enables step-level learning by conditioning only on single-step transitions rather than full interaction histories. STEP-HRL structures tasks hierarchically, using completed subtasks to represent global progress of overall task. By introducing a local progress module, it also iteratively and selectively summarizes interaction history within each subtask to produce a compact summary of local progress. Together, these components yield augmented step-level transitions for both high-level and low-level policies. Experimental results on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld benchmarks consistently demonstrate that STEP-HRL substantially outperforms baselines in terms of performance and generalization while reducing token usage. Our code is available at https://github.com/TonyStark042/STEP-HRL.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理在复杂的互动决策任务中展现出了强大的能力。然而，现有的LLM代理通常依赖于越来越长的交互历史数据，这导致了较高的计算成本以及有限的可扩展性。在本文中，我们提出了STEP-HRL这一分层强化学习框架。该框架通过仅基于单步转换而非完整的交互历史来进行步骤级学习，从而实现了高效的决策过程。STEP-HRL以分层的方式构建任务结构，利用已完成的子任务来反映整个任务的全局进展。此外，该框架还引入了局部进展模块，能够迭代地、有选择地总结每个子任务中的交互历史，从而生成简洁的局部进展摘要。这些组件共同为高层和低层策略提供了更优化的步骤级转换方式。在ScienceWorld和ALFWorld基准测试中的实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，STEP-HRL在性能和泛化能力方面均表现出显著优势，同时还能减少令牌的使用量。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/TonyStark042/STEP-HRL下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Two Streams, One Sarcasm: Orthogonal Expert Tuning for Holistic Multimodal Sarcasm Understanding
papers.title_zh: 两股流，一种讽刺手法：用于整体多模态讽刺理解的正交式专家调优方法
papers.authors: Diandian Guo, Cong Cao, Fangfang Yuan, Pin Xu, Cheng Hu, Zhicheng Zhang, Yu Liu, Yanbing Liu
papers.abstract: Multimodal Sarcasm Understanding (MSU) comprises multiple subtasks, demanding both incongruity perception and intent reasoning. However, this progress is impeded by two bottlenecks. First, the lack of a unified benchmark for holistic satirical cognition hinders comprehensive evaluation of MSU. Second, jointly modeling these heterogeneous subtasks often leads to feature entanglement. Specifically, while subtasks share a dependence on incongruity, they diverge in granular focus, causing specific execution patterns to erode the fundamental perception capability. To address these challenges, we make two contributions. First, we introduce DocMSU-PLUS, a comprehensive benchmark covering five cognitive dimensions of MSU. All tasks are reformulated into multiple-choice questions (MCQs), enabling a unified accuracy-based evaluation. Second, we propose the Dual Orthogonal Stream Experts (DOSE) framework. DOSE structurally decouples experts into orthogonal shared perception and private execution streams to physically block gradient interference between tasks. Experiments demonstrate that DOSE achieves superior performance on DocMSU-PLUS, effectively balancing general perception with task-specific adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态讽刺理解（MSU）包含多个子任务，需要同时具备不一致性感知和意图推理能力。然而，这一进展受到两个瓶颈的阻碍。首先，缺乏一个统一的整体讽刺认知基准，阻碍了MSU的全面评估。其次，对这些异构子任务进行联合建模往往会导致特征纠缠现象。具体来说，虽然各子任务都依赖于不一致性感知，但在细节关注点上却存在差异，这会导致特定执行模式侵蚀基本的感知能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了两项创新方案。首先，我们引入了DocMSU-PLUS基准测试，该测试涵盖了MSU的五个认知维度。所有任务都被重新设计成选择题形式，从而实现基于准确度的统一评估。其次，我们提出了双正交流专家框架（DOSE）。该框架将专家分解为正交共享感知流和私有执行流，从而有效避免任务之间的梯度干扰。实验表明，DOSE在DocMSU-PLUS基准测试中表现出卓越性能，能够很好地平衡一般感知能力与任务特异性适应。

papers.title: SeLaR: Selective Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SeLaR：大型语言模型中的选择性潜在推理机制
papers.authors: Renyu Fu, Guibo Luo
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has become a cornerstone of reasoning in large language models, yet its effectiveness is constrained by the limited expressiveness of discrete token sampling. Recent latent reasoning approaches attempt to alleviate this limitation by replacing discrete tokens with soft embeddings (probability-weighted mixtures of token embeddings) or hidden states, but they commonly suffer from two issues: (1) global activation injects perturbations into high-confidence steps, impairing reasoning stability; and (2) soft embeddings quickly collapse toward the highest-probability token, limiting exploration of alternative trajectories. To address these challenges, we propose SeLaR (Selective Latent Reasoning), a lightweight and training-free framework. SeLaR introduces an entropy-gated mechanism that activates soft embeddings only at low-confidence steps, while preserving discrete decoding at high-confidence steps. Additionally, we propose an entropy-aware contrastive regularization that pushes soft embeddings away from the highest-probability token’s direction, encouraging sustained exploration of multiple latent reasoning paths. Experiments on five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SeLaR consistently outperforms standard CoT and state-of-the-art training-free methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链（CoT）已成为大语言模型推理的基石，但其有效性受到离散令牌采样表达能力有限的限制。最近的一些潜在推理方法试图通过用软嵌入（即令牌嵌入的概率加权混合）或隐藏状态来替代离散令牌，以缓解这一限制，但这些方法通常存在两个问题：（1）全局激活会向高置信度步骤注入扰动，从而影响推理的稳定性；（2）软嵌入会迅速向概率最高的令牌方向收敛，限制了对其他路径的探索。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SeLaR——一个轻量级且无需训练的框架。SeLaR引入了一种熵门控机制，仅在低置信度步骤激活软嵌入，同时在高置信度步骤仍保持离散解码。此外，我们还提出了一种基于熵的对比正则化方法，使软嵌入远离概率最高的令牌方向，从而鼓励对多个潜在推理路径的持续探索。在五个推理基准测试上的实验表明，SeLaR始终优于标准的CoT以及最先进的无需训练的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: STRIDE-ED: A Strategy-Grounded Stepwise Reasoning Framework for Empathetic Dialogue Systems
papers.title_zh: STRIDE-ED：一种基于策略的逐步推理框架，适用于共情对话系统
papers.authors: Hongru Ji, Yuyin Fan, Meng Zhao, Xianghua Li, Lianwei Wu, Chao Gao
papers.abstract: Empathetic dialogue requires not only recognizing a user’s emotional state but also making strategy-aware, context-sensitive decisions throughout response generation.However, the lack of a comprehensive empathy strategy framework, explicit task-aligned multi-stage reasoning, and high-quality strategy-aware data fundamentally limits existing approaches, preventing them from effectively modeling empathetic dialogue as a complex, multi-stage cognitive and decision-making process.To address these challenges, we propose STRIDE-ED, a STRategy-grounded, Interpretable, and DEep reasoning framework that models Empathetic Dialogue through structured, strategy-conditioned reasoning.To support effective learning, we develop a strategy-aware data refinement pipeline integrating LLM-based annotation, multi-model consistency-weighted evaluation, and dynamic sampling to construct high-quality training data aligned with empathetic strategies.Furthermore, we adopt a two-stage training paradigm that combines supervised fine-tuning with multi-objective reinforcement learning to better align model behaviors with target emotions, empathetic strategies, and response formats.Extensive experiments demonstrate that STRIDE-ED generalizes across diverse open-source LLMs and consistently outperforms existing methods on both automatic metrics and human evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: 富有同理心的对话不仅需要识别用户的情绪状态，还需要在响应生成过程中做出具有策略意识且符合上下文需求的决策。然而，由于缺乏一套全面的同理心策略框架、明确的目标导向的多阶段推理机制，以及高质量的策略相关数据，现有的方法根本无法有效模拟富有同理心的对话这一复杂且多阶段的认知与决策过程。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了STRIDE-ED框架。该框架以策略为驱动，具备可解释性，并通过结构化、基于策略的推理来模拟富有同理心的对话。为了支持有效的学习过程，我们开发了一种策略相关的数据精炼流程，该流程结合了基于大语言模型的注释处理、多模型一致性加权评估以及动态采样技术，从而构建出与富有同理心的策略相一致的高质量训练数据。此外，我们采用了两阶段训练范式，将监督式微调与多目标强化学习相结合，从而更好地使模型的行为与目标情绪、富有同理心的策略以及响应格式保持一致。大量的实验表明，STRIDE-ED框架能够在不同的开源大语言模型上实现通用性，并且在自动评估指标和人工评估方面都优于现有方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GRAPHIA: Harnessing Social Graph Data to Enhance LLM-Based Social Simulation
papers.title_zh: GRAPHIA：利用社交网络数据提升基于大语言模型的社交模拟效果
papers.authors: Jiarui Ji, Zehua Zhang, Zhewei Wei, Bin Tong, Guan Wang, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in simulating human-like social behaviors. Social graphs provide high-quality supervision signals that encode both local interactions and global network structure, yet they remain underutilized for LLM training. To address this gap, we propose Graphia, the first general LLM-based social graph simulation framework that leverages graph data as supervision for LLM post-training via reinforcement learning. With GNN-based structural rewards, Graphia trains specialized agents to predict whom to interact with (destination selection) and how to interact (edge generation), followed by designed graph generation pipelines. We evaluate Graphia under two settings: Transductive Dynamic Graph Generation (TDGG), a micro-level task with our proposed node-wise interaction alignment metrics; and Inductive Dynamic Graph Generation (IDGG), a macro-level task with our proposed metrics for aligning emergent network properties. On three real-world networks, Graphia improves micro-level alignment by 6.1% in the composite destination selection score, 12% in edge classification accuracy, and 27.9% in edge content BERTScore over the strongest baseline. For macro-level alignment, it achieves 35.98% higher structural similarity and 28.71% better replication of social phenomena such as power laws and echo chambers. Our results show that social graphs can serve as high-quality supervision signals for LLM post-training, closing the gap between agent behaviors and network dynamics for LLM-based simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/Ji-Cather/Graphia.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在模拟人类社交行为方面展现出巨大潜力。社交网络提供了高质量的监督信号，这些信号既包含了局部互动信息，也涵盖了全局网络结构信息。然而，这些资源在语言模型训练中的应用仍然不足。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了Graphia——首个基于语言模型的社交网络模拟框架。该框架利用图数据作为监督信号，通过强化学习来实现语言模型训练后的优化。通过基于GNN的结构化奖励机制，Graphia能够训练出专门的智能体，以预测与谁进行互动（目标选择）以及如何互动（边生成）。随后，系统还会生成相应的社交网络结构。我们在两种场景下对Graphia进行了评估：一种是微层次的任务——传导性动态图生成，我们使用提出的节点级互动对齐指标来进行评估；另一种是宏观层次的任务——归纳性动态图生成，我们使用提出的指标来对齐网络的涌现特性。在三个真实世界网络上的实验表明，Graphia在微层次上的对齐效果提升了6.1%，在边分类准确率上提升了12%，在边内容BERTScore上的提升达到了27.9%。在宏观层次上，Graphia实现了35.98%更高的结构相似性，以及28.71%更好的社交现象复制能力，例如幂律分布和回音室效应等。我们的结果表明，社交网络可以作为语言模型训练后的高质量监督信号，从而缩小基于语言模型的模拟中智能体行为与网络动态之间的差距。相关代码可访问https://github.com/Ji-Cather/Graphia.git。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SharedRequest: Privacy-Preserving Model-Agnostic Inference for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 共享请求：适用于大型语言模型的隐私保护模型中立推理方法
papers.authors: Peihua Mai, Xuanrong Gao, Youlong Ding, Xianglong Du, Wei Liu, Yan Pang
papers.abstract: With the widespread deployment of public large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, protecting user prompt privacy has become an increasingly critical issue. Existing privacy-preserving inference methods sacrifice either utility or efficiency, and often require model-specific modifications that limit their compatibility. In this paper, we propose SharedRequest, a model-agnostic framework for privacy-preserving LLM inference that reformulates privacy protection at the batch level rather than the individual-prompt level. The key idea is to obscure sensitive information by mixing original prompts with noisy variants, while grouping semantically equivalent instructions to amortize the inference cost over a large batch of queries with minimal impact on LLM response quality. This design is independent of the LLM architecture, requiring no access to model parameters or architectural modification. Empirical results demonstrate that SharedRequest achieves over 20% higher utility compared to prior differential privacy baselines, and its shared-prompt mechanism reduces query cost by up to 5\times compared to non-batched inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着像ChatGPT这样的公共大语言模型被广泛部署，保护用户提示的隐私已成为一个日益重要的问题。现有的隐私保护推理方法要么牺牲了实用性，要么降低了效率，而且通常需要对模型进行特定修改，这限制了它们的兼容性。在本文中，我们提出了SharedRequest这一与模型无关的框架，用于实现隐私保护的大语言模型推理。该框架在批量级别而不是单个提示级别上实现隐私保护。其核心思想是通过将原始提示与噪声变体混合来隐藏敏感信息，同时将语义相似的指令组合在一起，从而将推理成本分摊到大量查询上，同时将对大语言模型响应质量的影响降到最低。这种设计不依赖于大语言模型的架构，无需访问模型参数或进行架构修改。实验结果表明，与之前的差分隐私基线相比，SharedRequest的实用性提高了20%以上，而其共享提示机制使得查询成本减少了5倍。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Efficient Learned Data Compression via Dual-Stream Feature Decoupling
papers.title_zh: 通过双流特征分离实现高效的学习式数据压缩技术
papers.authors: Huidong Ma, Xinyan Shi, Sun Hui, Xiaofei Yue, Xiaoguang Liu, Gang Wang, Wentong Cai
papers.abstract: While Learned Data Compression (LDC) has achieved superior compression ratios, balancing precise probability modeling with system efficiency remains challenging. Crucially, uniform single-stream architectures struggle to simultaneously capture micro-syntactic and macro-semantic features, necessitating deep serial stacking that exacerbates latency. Compounding this, heterogeneous systems are constrained by device speed mismatches, where throughput is capped by Amdahl’s Law due to serial processing. To this end, we propose a Dual-Stream Multi-Scale Decoupler that disentangles local and global contexts to replace deep serial processing with shallow parallel streams, and incorporate a Hierarchical Gated Refiner for adaptive feature refinement and precise probability modeling. Furthermore, we design a Concurrent Stream-Parallel Pipeline, which overcomes systemic bottlenecks to achieve full-pipeline parallelism. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both compression ratio and throughput, while maintaining the lowest latency and memory usage. The code is available at https://github.com/huidong-ma/FADE.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然学习式数据压缩技术已经取得了出色的压缩效果，但在精确的概率建模与系统效率之间找到平衡仍然是一个挑战。关键问题是，单一流架构难以同时捕捉微观句法和宏观语义特征，这就需要采用深度串行处理，而这会进一步增加延迟。此外，异构系统还受到设备速度不匹配的限制，由于串行处理的原因，系统的吞吐量会受到阿姆达尔定律的限制。为此，我们提出了一种双流多尺度解耦器，它能够分离局部和全局上下文，用浅层并行流替代深度串行处理，并引入分层门控细化器来实现自适应特征细化和精确的概率建模。此外，我们还设计了一种并发流并行管道结构，能够克服系统瓶颈，实现全管道级别的并行处理。大量实验表明，我们的方法在压缩率和吞吐量方面都达到了最先进的水平，同时还能保持最低的延迟和内存使用量。代码可以在https://github.com/huidong-ma/FADE下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Planning-Guided Tutoring with Assessment-Driven Memory for Pedagogical LLM Tutors
papers.title_zh: 基于规划的辅导服务，结合评估驱动的记忆机制，为教育领域的大型语言模型导师提供支持
papers.authors: Zechen Li, Qiannan Zhu, Mei Wang, Jia Li, Hua Huang
papers.abstract: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with pedagogical tutoring capabilities holds significant promise for education. Existing approaches simulate tutor behaviors or preferences and use them to prompt or fine-tune LLMs for dialogue tutoring. However, such methods often fail to sustain high-quality pedagogical conversations that provide explicit stepwise scaffolding and adapt to learners’ evolving cognitive states. To address this, we propose ScaffoldLM, a planning-guided tutoring framework with an assessment-driven memory for multi-turn math dialogue tutoring. ScaffoldLM first generates a stepwise pedagogical plan from solution steps, which serves as a stable backbone for explicit scaffolding. During tutoring, the tutoring memory is updated by an assessment-driven control loop that infers the learner’s cognitive state, evaluates whether the current step target is met, and adaptively selects tutoring actions. The plan, step-level progress, inferred learner states, and dialogue history are maintained in memory to support coherent multi-turn guidance. Experiments on multi-turn math tutoring benchmarks demonstrate that ScaffoldLM substantially improves pedagogical tutoring quality over strong baselines. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/BNU-ERC-ITEA/ScaffoldLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 为大语言模型配备教学辅导功能，对教育领域具有巨大的潜力。现有的方法通过模拟导师的行为或偏好，来提示或微调语言模型以实现对话式辅导。然而，这些方法往往难以实现高质量的教学对话，无法提供明确的逐步指导，也无法适应学习者的认知状态变化。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ScaffoldLM这一基于规划引导的辅导框架，该框架拥有以评估为驱动的记忆机制，适用于多轮数学对话辅导。ScaffoldLM首先根据解题步骤生成逐步的教学计划，作为明确指导的基础。在辅导过程中，辅导记忆会通过一个以评估为驱动的控制循环进行更新，该循环能够推断学习者的认知状态，评估当前步骤目标是否达成，并自适应地选择相应的辅导措施。教学计划、步骤级进展、推断出的学习者状态以及对话历史都被保存在记忆中，以支持连贯的多轮指导。在多轮数学辅导基准测试中的实验表明，ScaffoldLM显著提升了教学辅导的质量，优于现有的优秀基线方法。相关代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/BNU-ERC-ITEA/ScaffoldLM
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MixKVQ: Query-Aware Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MixKVQ：一种基于查询需求的混合精度KV缓存量化技术，适用于长上下文推理场景
papers.authors: Tao Zhang, Ziqian Zeng, Hao Peng, Huiping Zhuang, Cen Chen
papers.abstract: Long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly advanced the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), but this progress is accompanied by substantial memory and latency overhead from the extensive Key-Value (KV) cache. Although KV cache quantization is a promising compression technique, existing low-bit quantization methods often exhibit severe performance degradation on complex reasoning tasks. Fixed-precision quantization struggles to handle outlier channels in the key cache, while current mixed-precision strategies fail to accurately identify components requiring high-precision representation. We find that an effective low-bit KV cache quantization strategy must consider two factors: a key channel’s intrinsic quantization difficulty and its relevance to the query. Based on this insight, we propose MixKVQ, a novel plug-and-play method that introduces a lightweight, query-aware algorithm to identify and preserve critical key channels that need higher precision, while applying per-token quantization for value cache. Experiments on complex reasoning datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing low-bit methods, achieving performance comparable to a full-precision baseline at a substantially reduced memory footprint.
papers.abstract_zh: 长文本推理能力极大地提升了大语言模型的能力，但这一进步伴随着来自庞大键值缓存的巨大内存和延迟负担。虽然键值缓存量化是一种有前景的压缩技术，但现有的低比特量化方法在复杂的推理任务上往往会出现严重的性能下降问题。固定精度量化在处理键值缓存中的异常值方面存在困难，而当前的混合精度策略则无法准确识别需要高精度表示的组件。我们发现，有效的低比特键值缓存量化策略必须考虑两个因素：键通道本身的量化难度以及它与查询的相关性。基于这一洞察，我们提出了MixKVQ这一新型即插即用方法。该方法引入了一种轻量级、注重查询的算法，以识别并保留需要更高精度的关键键通道，同时针对值缓存采用按标记进行量化的方式。在复杂推理数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法显著优于现有的低比特方法，其性能与全精度基线相当，同时大幅减少了内存占用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When KV Cache Reuse Fails in Multi-Agent Systems: Cross-Candidate Interaction is Crucial for LLM Judges
papers.title_zh: 在多智能体系统中，当尝试复用KV缓存失败时：不同方案之间的协作对于LLM的评估至关重要
papers.authors: Sichu Liang, Zhenglin Wang, Chujiajia, Pengfei Xia, Hui Zang, Deyu Zhou
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems routinely generate multiple candidate responses that are aggregated by an LLM judge. To reduce the dominant prefill cost in such pipelines, recent work advocates KV cache reuse across partially shared contexts and reports substantial speedups for generation agents. In this work, we show that these efficiency gains do not transfer uniformly to judge-centric inference. Across GSM8K, MMLU, and HumanEval, we find that reuse strategies that are effective for execution agents can severely perturb judge behavior: end-task accuracy may appear stable, yet the judge’s selection becomes highly inconsistent with dense prefill. We quantify this risk using Judge Consistency Rate (JCR) and provide diagnostics showing that reuse systematically weakens cross-candidate attention, especially for later candidate blocks. Our ablation further demonstrates that explicit cross-candidate interaction is crucial for preserving dense-prefill decisions. Overall, our results identify a previously overlooked failure mode of KV cache reuse and highlight judge-centric inference as a distinct regime that demands dedicated, risk-aware system design.
papers.abstract_zh: 多智能体LLM系统通常会生成多个候选答案，这些答案由LLM裁判进行汇总。为了降低此类系统中的主导预填充成本，近期的研究提倡在部分共享的上下文环境中重复使用KV缓存，并发现这种方法能够显著提升生成代理的性能。在本研究中，我们发现这些效率提升并不适用于以裁判为中心的推理过程。通过GSM8K、MMLU和HumanEval等数据集的测试，我们发现那些对执行代理有效的重用策略可能会严重干扰裁判的行为：任务结束时的准确率可能看起来保持稳定，但裁判的选择却变得极不连贯，这与密集预填充的情况不符。我们通过“裁判一致性率”这一指标来量化这种风险，并提供了诊断数据，表明重用机制会系统性地削弱候选答案之间的注意力分配，尤其是对于后续出现的候选答案而言。进一步的实验表明，明确的跨候选答案交互对于保持密集预填充的决策至关重要。总体而言，我们的研究结果揭示了一种之前被忽视的KV缓存重用问题，并强调了以裁判为中心的推理过程需要专门的、注重风险的系统设计。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reducing Token Redundancy in LVLMs: A Systematic Review of Token Pruning Methods
papers.title_zh: 减少大视觉语言模型中的词元冗余：词元剪枝方法综述
papers.authors: Hanzhang Yuan, Mengxuan Hu, Wenhao Zhang, Tianlong Wang, Zhongliang Zhou, Jiasen Lu, Sheng Li
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) excel at visual understanding but face severe computational bottlenecks when processing high-resolution images and long videos due to massive visual token counts. Token pruning mitigates this by selectively removing less informative tokens while maintaining performance. However, existing methods vary widely in pruning location (vision encoder vs. LLM decoder), importance criteria (attention vs. similarity vs. learned scores), and application strategy, lacking systematic comparison. This survey presents the first comprehensive review of token pruning for LVLMs. We propose a taxonomy categorizing methods into vision-side, LLM-side, and hybrid paradigms, systematically analyze token selection mechanisms and pruning strategy. We further discuss evaluation protocols and identify key challenges including prompt-adaptive pruning and hardware-aware design. Our survey provides a structured foundation for this rapidly growing research area.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型在视觉理解方面表现出色，但在处理高分辨率图像和长视频时却面临严重的计算瓶颈，这是由于需要处理的视觉标记数量巨大所导致的。标记修剪可以通过选择性地移除信息量较少的标记来减轻这一问题，同时还能保持模型的性能。然而，现有的标记修剪方法在修剪位置（视觉编码器与语言模型解码器之间）、重要性评判标准（注意力机制、相似性算法或学习到的分数）以及应用策略方面存在很大差异，缺乏系统的比较。本综述首次对视觉-语言模型中的标记修剪进行了全面的回顾。我们提出了一种分类方法，将方法分为视觉侧、语言模型侧和混合范式三种类型，并系统地分析了标记选择机制和修剪策略。此外，我们还讨论了评估方案，并指出了一些关键挑战，包括提示自适应修剪和硬件优化设计。我们的综述为这一快速发展的研究领域提供了结构化的基础。

papers.title: STEM: Structure-Tracing Evidence Mining for Knowledge Graphs-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: STEM：用于知识图谱驱动的检索增强生成的结构追踪证据挖掘
papers.authors: Peng Yu, En Xu, Bin Chen, Haibiao Chen, Yinfei Xu
papers.abstract: Knowledge Graph-based Question Answering (KGQA) plays a pivotal role in complex reasoning tasks but remains constrained by two persistent challenges: the structural heterogeneity of Knowledge Graphs(KGs) often leads to semantic mismatch during retrieval, while existing reasoning path retrieval methods lack a global structural perspective. To address these issues, we propose Structure-Tracing Evidence Mining (STEM), a novel framework that reframes multi-hop reasoning as a schema-guided graph search task. First, we design a Semantic-to-Structural Projection pipeline that leverages KG structural priors to decompose queries into atomic relational assertions and construct an adaptive query schema graph. Subsequently, we execute globally-aware node anchoring and subgraph retrieval to obtain the final evidence reasoning graph from KG. To more effectively integrate global structural information during the graph construction process, we design a Triple-Dependent GNN (Triple-GNN) to generate a Global Guidance Subgraph (Guidance Graph) that guides the construction. STEM significantly improves both the accuracy and evidence completeness of multi-hop reasoning graph retrieval, and achieves State-of-the-Art performance on multiple multi-hop benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于知识图谱的问答系统（KGQA）在复杂推理任务中发挥着重要作用，但仍然存在两个长期存在的挑战：知识图谱的结构异质性往往导致检索过程中的语义不匹配，而现有的推理路径检索方法缺乏全局结构视角。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为“结构追踪证据挖掘”的新框架。该框架将多跳推理重新定义为一种基于模式的图搜索任务。首先，我们设计了一种从语义到结构的投影流程，利用知识图谱的结构先验信息将查询分解为原子关系断言，并构建自适应查询模式图。随后，我们通过全局感知的节点锚定和子图检索技术，从知识图谱中获取最终的证据推理图。为了在图构建过程中更有效地整合全局结构信息，我们设计了一种三元组依赖型图神经网络（Triple-GNN），以生成用于指导构建的全局引导子图。与传统的问答系统相比，STEM显著提高了多跳推理图的检索准确性和证据完整性，并在多个多跳基准测试上取得了领先性能。

papers.title: Evo-Attacker: Memory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tool Attacks on LLM-MAS
papers.title_zh: 进化攻击者：基于记忆增强的强化学习，用于针对大型语言模型的长远攻击策略研究
papers.authors: Bingyu Yan, Xiaoming Zhang, JinYu Hou, Chaozhuo Li, Ziyi Zhou, Yiming Hei, Litian Zhang
papers.abstract: While Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MAS) demonstrate remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks by orchestrating specialized agents and external tools, the implicit trust in tool outputs creates a critical attack surface. Existing tool attacks are limited by domain specificity or fixed and static templates. To address these challenges, we propose Evo-Attacker, which formulates the tool attack as a self-evolving, memory-augmented reinforcement learning process. Evo-Attacker constructs a dynamic attack memory and employs deliberative reasoning to retrieve adversarial patterns and strategize modifying interventions at critical moments. Furthermore, we introduce Attack-Flow GRPO to optimize intermediate reasoning steps via terminal outcomes, addressing the long-horizon credit assignment challenge. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Evo-Attacker consistently outperforms baselines, highlighting its generalization and evolutionary capabilities and the urgent need for defensive tool safeguards.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）在通过协调专业智能体和外部工具来解决复杂任务方面展现出卓越的能力。然而，对工具输出的隐性信任也构成了重要的攻击面。现有的工具攻击手段受到领域特异性或固定、静态模板的限制。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Evo-Attacker这一方法。该方法将工具攻击过程构建为一个自我演化、具有记忆功能的强化学习过程。Evo-Attacker能够构建一个动态攻击记忆库，并利用审慎的推理方式来识别敌对模式，并在关键时刻制定修改干预策略。此外，我们还引入了Attack-Flow GRPO算法，通过终端结果来优化中间推理步骤，从而解决长期信用分配问题。全面的实验表明，Evo-Attacker始终优于其他基线方法，这充分体现了其泛化能力和进化能力，同时也凸显了防御性工具保护的紧迫性。

papers.title: Beyond Timestamps: Bridging Forward and Backward Reasoning in Temporal Numerical and Relational Understanding
papers.title_zh: 超越时间戳：连接正向推理与反向推理在时间、数值及关系理解中的应用
papers.authors: Xinying Qian, Ying Zhang, Xuhui Sui, Yu Zhao, Baohang Zhou, Jeff Z. Pan
papers.abstract: Temporal reasoning remains a critical challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly when it requires encompassing relational dependencies and numerical constraints. Yet, existing benchmarks largely overlook the joint consideration of these two dimensions and primarily rely on single-task evaluation paradigms, making it difficult to assess whether correct answers reflect grounded reasoning or arise from superficial statistical recall. To address these gaps, we introduce TNR, a benchmark designed to evaluate both Temporal Numerical and Relational reasoning. We propose a bi-directional evaluation framework consisting of forward generation via Question Answering (QA) and backward verification via Fact Verification (FV). By measuring the alignment between QA and FV, we introduce a Consistency Rate to quantify the robustness of reasoning across these two directions. Experiments on a range of LLMs reveal notable discrepancies between QA and FV performance, particularly in numerical and interval-based tasks. Moreover, our bi-directional error analysis demonstrates that these inconsistencies often stem from heuristic shortcuts and statistical co-occurrences rather than grounded logical deduction, flaws that are frequently masked in standard single-task evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间推理仍然是大语言模型面临的一个关键挑战，尤其是在需要处理关系依赖性和数值约束时。然而，现有的评估基准大多忽略了这两个维度的综合考虑，主要依赖于单一任务的评估方式，这使得难以判断正确答案是否体现了基于逻辑的推理，还是仅仅基于表面的统计记忆。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了TNR这一评估基准，旨在同时评估时间推理和数值推理能力。我们提出了一个双向评估框架，包括通过问答式生成进行前向推理，以及通过事实验证进行后向验证。通过衡量问答式推理与事实验证之间的一致性，我们引入了一致性指标来量化这两种推理方式的稳健性。在一系列大语言模型的实验中发现，问答式推理与事实验证在性能上存在显著差异，尤其是在涉及数值和区间任务的情况下。此外，我们的双向错误分析表明，这些不一致性通常源于启发式捷径和统计关联，而非基于逻辑推导的推理过程。这些缺陷在标准单一任务评估中往往被掩盖了。

papers.title: Reasoning Over Space: Enabling Geographic Reasoning for LLM-Based Generative Next POI Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 关于空间的推理：为基于大语言模型的生成式下一个目的地推荐功能启用地理推理机制
papers.authors: Dongyi Lv, Qiuyu Ding, Heng-Da Xu, Zhaoxu Sun, Zhi Wang, Feng Xiong, Mu Xu
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation with large language models (LLMs) reframes prediction as sequence generation, yet existing LLM-based recommenders remain limited in leveraging geographic signals that are crucial in mobility and local-services scenarios. Here, we present Reasoning Over Space (ROS), a framework that utilizes geography as a vital decision variable within the reasoning process. ROS introduces a Hierarchical Spatial Semantic ID (SID) that discretizes coarse-to-fine locality and POI semantics into compositional tokens, and endows LLM with a three-stage Mobility Chain-of-Thought (CoT) paradigm that models user personality, constructs an intent-aligned candidate space, and performs locality informed pruning. We further align the model with real world geography via spatial-guided Reinforcement Learning (RL). Experiments on three widely used location-based social network (LBSN) datasets show that ROS achieves over 10% relative gains in hit rate over strongest LLM-based baselines and improves cross-city transfer, despite using a smaller backbone model.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型进行生成式推荐，将预测过程重新定义为序列生成。然而，现有的基于语言模型的推荐系统在利用地理信息方面仍然存在局限性，而地理信息在出行和本地服务场景中起着至关重要的作用。在这里，我们提出了“空间推理”框架（Reasoning Over Space，简称ROS），该框架将地理因素作为推理过程中的关键决策变量。ROS引入了一种分层空间语义标识符（Hierarchical Spatial Semantic ID，简称SID），它将粗略到精细的局部性和兴趣点语义离散化为可组合的标记。同时，ROS为语言模型提供了一种三阶段思维链模型（Mobility Chain-of-Thought，简称CoT），该模型能够模拟用户个性、构建与意图一致的候选方案，并实施基于局部性的剪枝操作。此外，我们还通过空间引导的强化学习技术，使模型能够更好地适应现实世界的地理环境。在三个常用的基于位置的社交网络数据集上进行的实验表明，ROS在命中率方面比最强大的基于语言模型的基线系统提升了超过10%，并且即使使用较小的主干模型，也能实现跨城市的数据迁移能力。

papers.title: ET-Agent: Incentivizing Effective Tool-Integrated Reasoning Agent via Behavior Calibration
papers.title_zh: ET-Agent：通过行为校准来激励能够有效运用工具进行推理的智能体
papers.authors: Yifei Chen, Guanting Dong, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can extend their parameter knowledge limits by adopting the Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) paradigm. However, existing LLM-based agent training framework often focuses on answers’ accuracy, overlooking specific alignment for behavior patterns. Consequently, agent often exhibits ineffective actions during TIR tasks, such as redundant and insufficient tool calls. How to calibrate erroneous behavioral patterns when executing TIR tasks, thereby exploring effective trajectories, remains an open-ended problem. In this paper, we propose ET-Agent, a training framework for calibrating agent’s tool-use behavior through two synergistic perspectives: Self-evolving Data Flywheel and Behavior Calibration Training. Specifically, we introduce a self-evolutionary data flywheel to generate enhanced data, used to fine-tune LLM to improve its exploration ability. Based on this, we implement an two-phases behavior-calibration training framework. It is designed to progressively calibrate erroneous behavioral patterns to optimal behaviors. Further in-depth experiments confirm the superiority of ET-Agent across multiple dimensions, including correctness, efficiency, reasoning conciseness, and tool execution accuracy. Our ET-Agent framework provides practical insights for research in the TIR field. Codes can be found in https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/ET-Agent
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型可以通过采用工具集成推理范式来扩展其参数知识的限制。然而，现有的基于语言模型的智能体训练框架往往只关注答案的准确性，而忽视了行为模式的具体对齐问题。因此，在工具集成推理任务中，智能体常常表现出无效的行为，例如重复或不足的工具调用。如何校准在执行工具集成推理任务时出现的错误行为模式，从而探索有效的行为路径，仍然是一个未解决的问题。在本文中，我们提出了ET-Agent这一训练框架，该框架通过两种协同机制来校准智能体的工具使用行为：自进化数据飞轮和行为校准训练。具体来说，我们引入了自进化数据飞轮来生成增强的数据，用于微调语言模型以提高其探索能力。在此基础上，我们实现了一种两阶段的行为校准训练框架，旨在逐步将错误的行为模式校准为最优行为。进一步的实验表明，ET-Agent在多个方面都具有优势，包括正确性、效率、推理的简洁性以及工具执行的准确性。我们的ET-Agent框架为工具集成推理领域的研究提供了实用的指导。代码可以在https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/ET-Agent找到。

papers.title: Spectral Disentanglement: Rank-Aware Task Adaptation for Rehearsal-free Continual Learning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 光谱解耦：基于排名感知的任务适应机制，实现无需重复练习的持续学习在大型语言模型中应用
papers.authors: Huanxuan Liao, Shizhu He, Yupu Hao, Yequan Wang, Wenhao Teng, Xiangwen Liao, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
papers.abstract: Continual Learning (CL) for Large Language Models (LLMs) faces a fundamental Stability-Plasticity Dilemma: balancing the plasticity to acquire new capabilities with the stability to preserve prior knowledge. While Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning methods, such as LoRA, enable efficient adaptation, we identify a critical flaw in current approaches termed Rank-Blindness: the enforcement of a single rank constraint across diverse tasks, which entangles task-shared and task-specific knowledge, leading to catastrophic forgetting of earlier tasks and underfitting on complex new ones. To address this, we propose SpaRTA, a novel rehearsal-free framework guided by a rank-spectrum perspective that explicitly disentangles knowledge into two orthogonal subspaces. Specifically, SpaRTA employs a low-rank branch to capture task-shared representations and a high-rank branch to model task-specific features. To integrate these complementary representations, we introduce a context-aware dynamic router that adaptively fuses the two branches based on input semantics, while an explicit orthogonality constraint minimizes interference between shared and specific parameter subspaces. This design effectively isolates task-specific updates from shared knowledge, preventing the overwriting of prior capabilities while preserving strong adaptation capacity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SpaRTA achieves a superior stability-plasticity balance compared to single-rank baselines. Notably, the proposed spectral disentanglement strategy substantially reduces inter-task interference and yields strong zero-shot generalization on unseen tasks. Our code will be available at https://github.com/Xnhyacinth/SpaRTA.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型持续学习技术面临着一个根本性的稳定性与可塑性矛盾问题：如何在获取新能力的可塑性与保持先前知识的稳定性之间找到平衡。虽然像LoRA这样的参数高效微调方法能够实现高效的适应，但我们发现当前方法存在一个关键缺陷，即“排名盲点”问题：在多种任务中强制执行单一的排名约束，这会混淆任务共享知识与任务特定知识，导致对早期任务的遗忘以及在复杂新任务上的欠拟合。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SpaRTA这一新型无排练框架，该框架以排名谱视角为指导，将知识明确地分解为两个正交的子空间。具体来说，SpaRTA采用低秩分支来捕捉任务共享表示，而高秩分支则用于建模任务特定特征。为了整合这些互补的表示，我们引入了一个上下文感知的动态路由器，它能够根据输入语义自适应地融合这两个分支；同时，明确的正交性约束则最小化了共享知识与特定知识之间的干扰。这种设计有效地将任务特定的更新与共享知识分离开来，避免了先前能力的被覆盖，同时保留了强大的适应能力。大量实验表明，与单一排名基线相比，SpaRTA在稳定性与可塑性之间取得了更好的平衡。值得注意的是，所提出的谱分解策略显著减少了任务间的干扰，并在未见过的任务上实现了强大的零样本泛化能力。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Xnhyacinth/SpaRTA下载。

papers.title: DeepPlanning: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Agentic Planning with Verifiable Constraints
papers.title_zh: DeepPlanning：基于可验证约束的长时间范围智能规划方法对比研究
papers.authors: Yinger Zhang, Shutong Jiang, Renhao Li, Jianhong Tu, Yang Su, Lianghao Deng, Xudong Guo, ChenXu Lv, Junyang Lin
papers.abstract: While agent evaluation has shifted toward long-horizon tasks, most benchmarks still emphasize local, step-level reasoning rather than the global constrained optimization (e.g., time and financial budgets) that demands genuine planning ability. Meanwhile, existing LLM planning benchmarks underrepresent the active information gathering and fine-grained local constraints typical of real-world settings. To address this, we introduce DeepPlanning, a challenging benchmark for practical long-horizon agent planning. It features multi-day travel planning and multi-product shopping tasks that require proactive information acquisition, local constrained reasoning, and global constrained optimization. Evaluations on DeepPlanning show that even frontier agentic LLMs struggle with these problems, highlighting the importance of reliable explicit reasoning patterns and parallel tool use for achieving better effectiveness-efficiency trade-offs. Error analysis further points to promising directions for improving agentic LLMs over long planning horizons. We open-source the code and data to support future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然代理评估已经转向长期规划任务，但大多数基准测试仍然侧重于局部、步骤级的推理，而非需要真正规划能力的全局约束优化（例如时间和财务预算）。与此同时，现有的大语言模型规划基准测试未能充分反映现实场景中典型的主动信息收集以及细粒度的局部约束。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了DeepPlanning这一针对实际长期代理规划的挑战性基准测试。该测试包括多日旅行规划和多产品购物任务，这些任务需要主动的信息获取、局部约束推理以及全局约束优化能力。对DeepPlanning的评估表明，即使是前沿的大语言模型也难以应对这些问题，这凸显了可靠且明确的推理模式以及并行工具使用对于实现更好的效率-效果权衡的重要性。错误分析还指出了改进长期规划的大语言模型的潜在方向。我们将代码和数据开源，以支持未来的研究。

papers.title: Arg-LLaDA: Argument Summarization via Large Language Diffusion Models and Sufficiency-Aware Refinement
papers.title_zh: Arg-LLaDA：利用大型语言扩散模型进行论点总结，并采用充分性优化方法进行改进
papers.authors: Hao Li, Yizheng Sun, Viktor Schlegel, Kailai Yang, Riza Batista-Navarro, Goran Nenadic
papers.abstract: Argument summarization aims to generate concise, structured representations of complex, multi-perspective debates. While recent work has advanced the identification and clustering of argumentative components, the generation stage remains underexplored. Existing approaches typically rely on single-pass generation, offering limited support for factual correction or structural refinement. To address this gap, we introduce Arg-LLaDA, a novel large language diffusion framework that iteratively improves summaries via sufficiency-guided remasking and regeneration. Our method combines a flexible masking controller with a sufficiency-checking module to identify and revise unsupported, redundant, or incomplete spans—yielding more faithful, concise, and coherent outputs. Empirical results on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that Arg-LLaDA surpasses state-of-the-art baselines in 7 out of 10 automatic evaluation metrics. In addition, human evaluations reveal substantial improvements across core dimensions, coverage, faithfulness, and conciseness,validating the effectiveness of our iterative, sufficiency-aware generation strategy.
papers.abstract_zh: 论点总结的目的是生成简洁、结构化的复杂多视角辩论表述。虽然近期的研究在识别和聚类论点成分方面取得了进展，但生成阶段仍然缺乏深入研究。现有方法通常依赖单次生成方式，对于事实修正或结构优化方面的支持有限。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Arg-LLaDA这一新颖的大语言扩散框架。该框架通过基于充分性指导的重新标记和再生过程，逐步改进摘要质量。我们的方法结合了灵活的掩码控制器和充分性检查模块，能够识别并修正那些缺乏支持、冗余或不完整的段落内容，从而得到更真实、简洁且连贯的输出结果。在两个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，Arg-LLaDA在10项自动评估指标中的7项上超越了最先进的基线方法。此外，人工评估结果显示，该框架在真实性、覆盖度、简洁性等方面都取得了显著提升，这验证了我们的迭代式、基于充分性意识的生成策略的有效性。

papers.title: AgencyBench: Benchmarking the Frontiers of Autonomous Agents in 1M-Token Real-World Contexts
papers.title_zh: AgencyBench：在包含100万代币的现实世界环境中，对自主智能体的能力进行基准测试
papers.authors: Keyu Li, Junhao Shi, Yang Xiao, Mohan Jiang, Jie Sun, Yunze Wu, Dayuan Fu, Shijie Xia, Xiaojie Cai, Tianze Xu, Weiye Si, Wenjie Li, Dequan Wang, Pengfei Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) based autonomous agents demonstrate multifaceted capabilities to contribute substantially to economic production. However, existing benchmarks remain focused on single agentic capability, failing to capture long-horizon real-world scenarios. Moreover, the reliance on human-in-the-loop feedback for realistic tasks creates a scalability bottleneck, hindering automated rollout collection and evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce AgencyBench, a comprehensive benchmark derived from daily AI usage, evaluating 6 core agentic capabilities across 32 real-world scenarios, comprising 138 tasks with specific queries, deliverables, and rubrics. These scenarios require an average of 90 tool calls, 1 million tokens, and hours of execution time to resolve. To enable automated evaluation, we employ a user simulation agent to provide iterative feedback, and a Docker sandbox to conduct visual and functional rubric-based assessment. Experiments reveal that closed-source models significantly outperform open-source models (48.4% vs 32.1%). Further analysis reveals significant disparities across models in resource efficiency, feedback-driven self-correction, and specific tool-use preferences.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体展现出多方面的能力，能够显著促进经济生产的发展。然而，现有的评估基准主要集中在单一智能体的能力上，未能涵盖长期现实场景中的挑战。此外，对于实际任务而言，依赖人工反馈的方式会导致可扩展性方面的瓶颈，从而阻碍自动化测试与评估的进行。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了AgencyBench——一个基于日常人工智能应用的全面评估基准。该基准涵盖了32个现实场景中的138项任务，每项任务都包含具体的查询、交付成果以及评估标准。这些场景平均需要90次工具调用、100万个标记，以及数小时的执行时间才能解决。为了实现自动化评估，我们采用了用户模拟智能体来提供迭代式反馈，并利用Docker沙箱进行可视化和功能性的评估。实验结果表明，闭源模型在性能上明显优于开源模型（48.4%对比32.1%）。进一步分析还发现，不同模型在资源利用效率、基于反馈的自我修正能力以及特定工具使用偏好方面存在显著差异。

papers.title: All Languages Matter: Understanding and Mitigating Language Bias in Multilingual RAG
papers.title_zh: 所有语言都重要：理解并消除多语言信息检索中的语言偏见
papers.authors: Dan Wang, Guozhao Mo, Yafei Shi, Cheng Zhang, Bo Zheng, Boxi Cao, Xuanang Chen, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Ben He, Xianpei Han, Le Sun
papers.abstract: Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (mRAG) leverages cross-lingual evidence to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in global knowledge. However, we show that current mRAG systems suffer from a language bias during reranking, systematically favoring English and the query’s native language. By introducing an estimated oracle evidence analysis, we quantify a substantial performance gap between existing rerankers and the achievable upper bound. Further analysis reveals a critical distributional mismatch: while optimal predictions require evidence scattered across multiple languages, current systems systematically suppress such “answer-critical” documents, thereby limiting downstream generation performance. To bridge this gap, we propose Language-Agnostic Utility-driven Reranker Alignment (LAURA), Experiments across diverse languages and generation models show that LAURA effectively mitigates language bias and consistently improves mRAG performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言检索增强生成（mRAG）利用跨语言的证据来为大语言模型提供全球性的知识支持。然而，我们发现当前的mRAG系统在重新排序过程中存在语言偏见，系统总是倾向于选择英语以及查询语言的文档。通过引入估计的“预言家证据分析”，我们量化了现有重新排序算法与理论上的最优性能之间的巨大差距。进一步的分析还揭示了另一个关键的问题：虽然最优预测需要来自多种语言的证据，但当前系统会系统性地忽略那些对结果至关重要的文档，从而限制了下游生成的性能。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了一种“语言中立的效用驱动重新排序对齐”方法。在不同语言和生成模型上的实验表明，LAURA能够有效消除语言偏见，并持续提升mRAG的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: Unveiling Inefficiency Patterns in Tool-Integrated Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 超越准确性：揭示工具集成推理中的低效模式
papers.authors: Qisheng Su, Shiting Huang, Zhen Fang, Ziyan Chen, Zehui Chen, Feng Zhao
papers.abstract: In real-world Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) scenarios, a major source of inefficiency is that the toolcalls create pauses between LLM requests and cause KV-cache eviction. Also, the long, unfiltered response returned by external tools inflates the KV-cache, so each decode step spends more time loading the growing cache and thus becomes steadily slower as context length increases. However, existing efficiency metrics like token counts and toolcall counts fail to capture this real computational cost. To address this, we introduce PTE (Prefill Token Equivalents), a hardware-aware TIR-efficiency metric that unifies internal reasoning and external tool-use costs while explicitly accounting for non-reusable KV-Cache and long-tool-response scenarios, thus better reflects real-world scenarios. We conduct extensive experiments across five TIR benchmarks, quantify their PTE costs, and identify four inefficiency patterns that appear in TIR. In a simulated high-concurrency industrial setting, PTE explains wall-clock latency significantly better than token-count metric. We also discover that trajectories with higher PTE costs tend to have lower reasoning correctness, indicating that simply using more tools does not improve the quality of the answer. PTE offers a new perspective on the efficiency of Tool-Integrated Reasoning. The code is available.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中的工具集成推理场景中，效率低下的主要原因之一是工具调用会在LLM请求之间造成停顿，并导致KV缓存被清除。此外，外部工具返回的冗长、未经过滤的响应会不断填充KV缓存，因此每次解码过程都需要更多时间来加载不断增长的缓存，随着上下文长度的增加，处理速度会逐渐变慢。然而，现有的效率度量指标，如令牌数量和工具调用次数，无法准确反映这种实际的计算成本。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了PTE（预填充令牌等效值）这一基于硬件的工具集成推理效率度量指标。该指标能够统一内部推理和外部工具使用的成本，同时明确考虑不可重复使用的KV缓存以及长工具响应的情况，从而更好地反映现实世界中的场景。我们在五个工具集成推理基准测试中进行了大量实验，量化了它们的PTE成本，并发现了四种在工具集成推理中出现的低效模式。在一个模拟的高并发工业环境中，PTE指标能够比令牌数量指标更精确地描述整体运行延迟。我们还发现，PTE成本较高的场景往往意味着推理的准确性较低，这表明单纯使用更多的工具并不能提高答案的质量。PTE为工具集成推理的效率评估提供了全新的视角。相关代码已公开可供使用。

papers.title: Safety-Utility Conflicts Are Not Global: Surgical Alignment via Head-Level Diagnosis
papers.title_zh: 安全性与实用性之间的冲突并非全球性问题：通过头部诊断来实现手术中的优化
papers.authors: Wang Cai, Yilin Wen, Jinchang Hou, Du Su, Guoqiu Wang, Zhonghou Lv, Chenfu Bao, Yunfang Wu
papers.abstract: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) inherently presents a multi-objective optimization conflict, often accompanied by an unintended degradation of general capabilities. Existing mitigation strategies typically rely on global gradient geometry to resolve these conflicts, yet they overlook Modular Heterogeneity within Transformers, specifically that the functional sensitivity and degree of conflict vary substantially across different attention heads. Such global approaches impose uniform update rules across all parameters, often resulting in suboptimal trade-offs by indiscriminately updating utility sensitive heads that exhibit intense gradient conflicts. To address this limitation, we propose Conflict-Aware Sparse Tuning (CAST), a framework that integrates head-level diagnosis with sparse fine-tuning. CAST first constructs a pre-alignment conflict map by synthesizing Optimization Conflict and Functional Sensitivity, which then guides the selective update of parameters. Experiments reveal that alignment conflicts in LLMs are not uniformly distributed. We find that the drop in general capabilities mainly comes from updating a small group of “high-conflict” heads. By simply skipping these heads during training, we significantly reduce this loss without compromising safety, offering an interpretable and parameter-efficient approach to improving the safety-utility trade-off.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中，安全性对齐本质上存在多目标优化冲突的问题，这往往伴随着通用能力的非预期下降。现有的缓解策略通常依赖全局梯度几何方法来解决这些冲突，但它们忽略了Transformer内部的模块差异性，即不同注意力头的功能敏感性和冲突程度存在显著差异。这种全局方法对所有参数施加统一的更新规则，常常导致通过不区分地更新那些表现出强烈梯度冲突的头部而产生了次优的权衡。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了冲突感知稀疏调优框架CAST，该框架将头部级诊断与稀疏微调相结合。CAST首先通过合成优化冲突和功能敏感性来构建预对齐冲突图，然后据此指导参数的选择性更新。实验表明，LLM中的对齐冲突并非均匀分布。我们发现，通用能力的下降主要来自于对少数“高冲突”头部的更新。通过在训练过程中简单跳过这些头部，我们可以显著减少这种损失，同时不影响安全性，从而提供了一种可解释且高效的改进安全性与实用性权衡的方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VideoPro: Adaptive Program Reasoning for Long Video Understanding
papers.title_zh: VideoPro：用于长视频理解的自适应程序推理技术
papers.authors: Chenglin Li, Feng Han, Yikun Wang, Ruilin Li, Shuai Dong, Haowen Hou, Haitao Li, Qianglong Chen, Feng Tao, Jingqi Tong, Yin Zhang, Jiaqi Wang
papers.abstract: Understanding long videos remains challenging due to the sparsity of visual evidence relevant to a given query. Prior work has explored program-based visual grounding, typically relying on executable programs generated by auxiliary large language models. However, when scaling to long videos, existing approaches face several critical limitations: (1) frame-centric vision modules are often insufficient for long video processing; (2) naively applying program-based reasoning to all queries incurs considerable computational overhead; and (3) errors arising from low-confidence predictions and imperfect program execution are difficult to recover from. To address these challenges, we propose VideoPro, a unified framework that enables VideoLLMs to adaptively reason over long videos and refine their predictions through executable programs. VideoPro first performs adaptive reasoning, dynamically determining whether a query can be resolved directly by the native VideoLLM or requires explicit multi-step program reasoning. For complex queries, the model decomposes the task into executable programs that invoke specialized vision modules for precise temporal and semantic grounding. To further improve robustness, VideoPro incorporates a self-refinement mechanism that leverages execution feedback and confidence signals to correct erroneous executions and refine low-confidence reasoning programs. By tightly integrating adaptive reasoning with self-refinement, VideoPro consistently outperforms prior methods across multiple long-video understanding benchmarks, yielding an average 6.7% improvement for Qwen3-VL-8B.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解长视频仍然具有挑战性，因为与特定查询相关的视觉证据非常有限。之前的研究采用了基于程序的视觉定位方法，通常依赖于由辅助的大语言模型生成的可执行程序。然而，在扩展到长视频时，现有方法存在几个关键限制：(1)以帧为中心的视觉模块往往不足以处理长视频；(2)盲目地将基于程序的推理应用于所有查询会导致相当大的计算开销；(3)由于低置信度的预测和不完美的程序执行而产生的错误很难恢复。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了VideoPro这一统一框架，它使VideoLLMs能够自适应地推理长视频，并通过可执行程序来改进其预测效果。VideoPro首先进行自适应推理，动态确定某个查询是否可以直接由本地的VideoLLM解决，或者需要明确的多步骤程序推理。对于复杂的查询，模型会将任务分解为可执行的程序，这些程序会调用专门的视觉模块来进行精确的时间和语义定位。为了进一步提高鲁棒性，VideoPro还包含了一个自我完善机制，该机制利用执行反馈和置信度信号来纠正错误的执行，并改进低置信度的推理程序。通过将自适应推理与自我完善机制紧密结合，VideoPro在多个长视频理解基准测试中始终表现出优于以往方法的性能，对于Qwen3-VL-8B模型而言，平均提升了6.7%的性能。

papers.title: Parity-Aware Byte-Pair Encoding: Improving Cross-lingual Fairness in Tokenization
papers.title_zh: 基于公平性考虑的字节对编码：提升跨语言分词过程中的公平性
papers.authors: Negar Foroutan, Clara Meister, Debjit Paul, Joel Niklaus, Sina Ahmadi, Antoine Bosselut, Rico Sennrich
papers.abstract: Tokenization is the first—and often least scrutinized—step of most NLP pipelines. Standard algorithms for learning tokenizers rely on frequency-based objectives, which favor languages dominant in the training data and consequently leave lower-resource languages with tokenizations that are disproportionately longer, morphologically implausible, or even riddled with <UNK> placeholders. This phenomenon ultimately amplifies computational and financial inequalities between users from different language backgrounds. To remedy this, we introduce Parity-aware Byte Pair Encoding (BPE), a variant of the widely-used BPE algorithm. At every merge step, Parity-aware BPE applies a fair-max rule that maximizes the compression gain of the currently worst-compressed language, trading a small amount of global compression for cross-lingual parity. We find empirically that Parity-aware BPE reduces tokenization inequality—operationalized by the Gini coefficient of per-language token costs—by up to 89% relative to Classical BPE. This comes with negligible impact on global compression rate and no evidence of systematic degradation in downstream LM performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 标记化是大多数自然语言处理流程中的第一步，但往往也是最容易被忽视的一步。用于学习标记化的标准算法依赖于基于频率的目标，这些目标倾向于优先考虑训练数据中占主导地位的语言，因此导致资源匮乏的语言在标记化处理过程中会出现较长的分词结果、形态上不合理的情况，甚至充斥着大量<UNK>占位符。这种现象最终加剧了不同语言背景的用户之间的计算和财务差异。为了改善这一状况，我们提出了一种名为“公平感知字节对编码”的算法，它是广泛使用的字节对编码算法的一种变体。在每次合并步骤中，公平感知字节对编码都会应用一个公平最大化规则，以最大化当前压缩程度最差的语言的压缩效果，通过牺牲少量全局压缩量来换取跨语言的一致性。我们通过实验发现，与经典字节对编码相比，公平感知字节对编码能够将每种语言的标记化不平等程度降低高达89%。同时，这种算法对全局压缩率的影响微乎其微，也没有证据表明下游语言模型性能会受到系统性下降的影响。

papers.title: Boundary-Guided Policy Optimization for Memory-efficient RL of Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于边界导向的政策优化方法，用于高效内存消耗的扩散语言模型强化学习
papers.authors: Nianyi Lin, Jiajie Zhang, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li
papers.abstract: A key challenge in applying reinforcement learning (RL) to diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is the intractability of their likelihood functions, which are essential for the RL objective, necessitating corresponding approximation during training. While existing methods approximate the log-likelihoods by their evidence lower bounds (ELBOs) via customized Monte Carlo (MC) sampling, they incur significant memory overhead due to the need to retain all MC samples for the gradient computation of non-linear terms in the RL objective, and thus restrict feasible sample sizes, leading to imprecise likelihood approximations and distorted RL objective. To address this, we propose Boundary-Guided Policy Optimization (BGPO), a memory-efficient RL algorithm that maximizes a specially constructed lower bound of the ELBO-based objective. This lower bound is carefully designed to satisfy two key properties: (1) Linearity: it is a linear sum where each term depends only on a single MC sample, thereby enabling gradient accumulation across samples and ensuring constant memory usage; (2) Equivalence: Both the value and gradient of this lower bound are equal to those of the ELBO-based objective in on-policy training, making it also an effective approximation for the original RL objective. These properties allow BGPO to adopt a large MC sample size, improving likelihood approximations and RL objective estimation, which in turn leads to enhanced performance. Experiments show that BGPO significantly outperforms previous RL algorithms for dLLMs in math problem solving, code generation, and planning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 在将强化学习应用于扩散语言模型时，一个关键的挑战是这些模型的似然函数具有难以处理的特点。这些似然函数是实现强化学习目标所必需的，因此在训练过程中需要进行近似处理。目前的方法是通过自定义的蒙特卡洛采样来近似对数似然值，但这种方法会占用大量的内存资源，因为需要保留所有蒙特卡洛样本来进行强化学习目标中非线性项的梯度计算。这就限制了可行样本的数量，导致似然值的近似结果不够精确，强化学习目标也会受到影响。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了边界引导策略优化算法——BGPO。这是一种内存效率高的强化学习算法，它能够最大化基于ELBO目标的特殊构造的下界。这个下界经过精心设计，具备两个关键特性：(1) 线性性：它是一个线性求和，其中每一项都只依赖于一个蒙特卡洛样本，从而实现了跨样本的梯度累积，并确保了恒定的内存使用；(2) 等价性：在这个下界中，价值和梯度在在线策略训练中都与基于ELBO的目标相等，因此它也是原始强化学习目标的有效近似。这些特性使得BGPO能够采用较大的蒙特卡洛样本规模，从而改善似然值的近似效果和强化学习目标的估计精度，进而提升模型的性能。实验表明，BGPO在解决数学问题、代码生成和规划任务等方面，其性能明显优于现有的强化学习算法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ChartVerse: Scaling Chart Reasoning via Reliable Programmatic Synthesis from Scratch
papers.title_zh: ChartVerse：通过可靠的程序化合成技术，从零开始实现图表推理的扩展
papers.authors: Zheng Liu, Honglin Lin, Xiaoyang Wang, Xin Gao, Yu Li, Mengzhang Cai, Yun Zhu, Zhanping Zhong, Qizhi Pei, Zhuoshi Pan, Xiaoran Shang, Conghui He, Bin Cui, Wentao Zhang, Lijun Wu
papers.abstract: Chart reasoning is a critical capability for Vision Language Models (VLMs). However, the development of open-source models is severely hindered by the lack of high-quality training data. Existing datasets suffer from a dual challenge: synthetic charts are often simplistic and repetitive, while the associated QA pairs are prone to hallucinations and lack the reasoning depth required for complex tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose ChartVerse, a scalable framework designed to synthesize complex charts and reliable reasoning data from scratch. (1) To address the bottleneck of simple patterns, we first introduce Rollout Posterior Entropy (RPE), a novel metric that quantifies chart complexity. Guided by RPE, we develop complexity-aware chart coder to autonomously synthesize diverse, high-complexity charts via executable programs. (2) To guarantee reasoning rigor, we develop truth-anchored inverse QA synthesis. Diverging from standard generation, we adopt an answer-first paradigm: we extract deterministic answers directly from the source code, generate questions conditional on these anchors, and enforce strict consistency verification. To further elevate difficulty and reasoning depth, we filter samples based on model fail-rate and distill high-quality Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. We curate ChartVerse-SFT-600K and ChartVerse-RL-40K using Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking as the teacher. Experimental results demonstrate that ChartVerse-8B achieves state-of-the-art performance, notably surpassing its teacher and rivaling the stronger Qwen3-32B-Thinking.
papers.abstract_zh: 图表推理是视觉语言模型的关键能力。然而，由于缺乏高质量的训练数据，开源模型的开发受到了严重阻碍。现有的数据集存在两个问题：合成的图表往往过于简单且重复，而相关的问答对则容易出现幻觉，缺乏完成复杂任务所需的推理深度。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了ChartVerse框架，该框架能够从头开始合成复杂的图表和可靠的推理数据。(1)为了解决简单模式的瓶颈问题，我们首先引入了Rollout Posterior Entropy（RPE）这一新型指标，用于量化图表的复杂性。在RPE的指导下，我们开发了一种考虑复杂性的图表编码器，通过可执行程序自动合成多样化、高复杂度的图表。(2)为了确保推理的严谨性，我们开发了基于真实信息的逆向问答合成方法。与传统的生成方式不同，我们采用了以答案为导向的方法：直接从源代码中提取确定性答案，根据这些答案生成问题，并严格执行一致性验证。为了进一步提升难度和推理深度，我们根据模型失败率来筛选样本，并提取高质量的思维链推理。我们使用Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking作为教师模型，分别构建了ChartVerse-SFT-600K和ChartVerse-RL-40K模型。实验结果表明，ChartVerse-8B模型取得了领先的性能，其表现甚至超过了它的教师模型，与更强大的Qwen3-32B-Thinking模型不相上下。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: NeoAMT: Neologism-Aware Agentic Machine Translation with Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: NeoAMT：具有强化学习功能的新词识别型代理式机器翻译
papers.authors: Zhongtao Miao, Kaiyan Zhao, Masaaki Nagata, Yoshimasa Tsuruoka
papers.abstract: Neologism-aware machine translation aims to translate source sentences containing neologisms into target languages.This field remains underexplored compared with general machine translation (MT).In this paper, we propose an agentic framework, NeoAMT, for neologism-aware machine translation equipped with a Wiktionary-based search toolkit.Specifically, we first construct a dedicated dataset for neologism-aware machine translation and build a search toolkit grounded in Wiktionary.The dataset covers 16 languages and 75 translation directions in total, derived from approximately 10 million records of an English Wiktionary dump.The retrieval corpus of the search toolkit is also constructed from around 3 million cleaned records of the same dump.We then leverage the dataset and toolkit to train a translation agent via reinforcement learning (RL) and to evaluate the accuracy of neologism-aware machine translation.Furthermore, we propose an RL training framework featuring a novel reward design and an adaptive rollout generation strategy that exploits translation difficulty to further improve the translation quality of translation agents using our search toolkit.
papers.abstract_zh: 新词识别意识型机器翻译旨在将包含新词的源语言句子翻译成目标语言。与一般的机器翻译相比，这一领域尚未得到充分研究。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于智能体的框架——NeoAMT，该框架具备新词识别意识型机器翻译功能，并配备了基于维基词典的搜索工具包。具体来说，我们首先为新词识别意识型机器翻译构建了一个专用数据集，并开发了基于维基词典的搜索工具包。该数据集涵盖了16种语言以及75种翻译方向，数据来源于约1000万条英语维基词典记录。搜索工具包的检索语料库也来自同一数据集中约300万条经过清洗的记录。随后，我们利用该数据集和工具包通过强化学习来训练翻译代理，并评估新词识别意识型机器翻译的准确性。此外，我们还提出了一种强化学习训练框架，该框架采用了新颖的奖励设计以及自适应生成策略，这些策略能够利用翻译难度来提高使用我们的搜索工具包的翻译代理的翻译质量。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: arXiv2Table: Toward Realistic Benchmarking and Evaluation for LLM-Based Literature-Review Table Generation
papers.title_zh: arXiv2Table：为基于大语言模型的文献综述表格生成技术打造真实的基准测试与评估方法
papers.authors: Weiqi Wang, Jiefu Ou, Yangqiu Song, Benjamin Van Durme, Daniel Khashabi
papers.abstract: Literature review tables are essential for summarizing and comparing collections of scientific papers. In this paper, we study automatic generation of such tables from a pool of papers to satisfy a user’s information need. Building on recent work (Newman et al., 2024), we move beyond oracle settings by (i) simulating well-specified yet schema-agnostic user demands that avoid leaking gold column names or values, (ii) explicitly modeling retrieval noise via semantically related but out-of-scope distractor papers verified by human annotators, and (iii) introducing a lightweight, annotation-free, utilization-oriented evaluation that decomposes utility (schema coverage, unary cell fidelity, pairwise relational consistency) and measures paper selection via a two-way QA procedure (gold→system and system→gold) with recall, precision, and F1. To support reproducible evaluation, we introduce arXiv2Table, a benchmark of 1,957 tables referencing 7,158 papers, with human-verified distractors and rewritten, schema-agnostic user demands. We also develop an iterative, batch-based generation method that co-refines paper filtering and schema over multiple rounds. We validate the evaluation protocol with human audits and cross-evaluator checks. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently improves over strong baselines, while absolute scores remain modest, underscoring the task’s difficulty. Our data and code is available at https://github.com/JHU-CLSP/arXiv2Table.
papers.abstract_zh: 文献综述表对于总结与比较一系列科学论文非常有用。在本文中，我们研究了如何从大量论文中自动生成此类表格，以满足用户的信息需求。基于最近的研究成果（Newman等人，2024年），我们超越了传统的“预言式”方法，采取了以下措施：(i) 模拟出明确且不受模式限制的用户需求，同时避免泄露黄金列的名称或值；(ii) 通过语义相关但不属于该领域的干扰论文来明确建模检索噪声，这些干扰论文得到了人类注释者的验证；(iii) 引入一种轻量级、无需注释的评估方法，该方法能够评估实用性（模式覆盖度、单元格的精确性、成对关系的一致性），并通过双向问答程序来评估论文选择的效果（从黄金样本到系统，以及从系统到黄金样本），同时考虑召回率、精确度以及F1值。为了支持可复制性的评估过程，我们开发了arXiv2Table这个基准测试工具，该工具包含1,957个表格，涉及7,158篇论文，其中包含了经过人类验证的干扰项以及重新编写的、不受模式限制的用户需求描述。我们还开发了一种迭代式的批量生成方法，该方法能够在多轮过程中不断改进论文过滤和模式匹配的准确性。我们通过人类审核和跨评估者检查来验证该评估协议的有效性。大量的实验表明，我们的方法始终优于强大的基线算法，而绝对分数则保持在一个适度的水平，这进一步凸显了这项任务的难度。我们的数据和代码可以在https://github.com/JHU-CLSP/arXiv2Table上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
