papers.title: Responsible Evaluation of AI for Mental Health
papers.title_zh: 对人工智能在心理健康领域的应用进行负责任性的评估
papers.authors: Hiba Arnaout, Anmol Goel, H. Andrew Schwartz, Steffen T. Eberhardt, Dana Atzil-Slonim, Gavin Doherty, Brian Schwartz, Wolfgang Lutz, Tim Althoff, Munmun De Choudhury, Hamidreza Jamalabadi, Raj Sanjay Shah, Flor Miriam Plaza-del-Arco, Dirk Hovy, Maria Liakata, Iryna Gurevych
papers.abstract: Although artificial intelligence (AI) shows growing promise for mental health care, current approaches to evaluating AI tools in this domain remain fragmented and poorly aligned with clinical practice, social context, and first-hand user experience. This paper argues for a rethinking of responsible evaluation – what is measured, by whom, and for what purpose – by introducing an interdisciplinary framework that integrates clinical soundness, social context, and equity, providing a structured basis for evaluation. Through an analysis of 135 recent *CL publications, we identify recurring limitations, including over-reliance on generic metrics that do not capture clinical validity, therapeutic appropriateness, or user experience, limited participation from mental health professionals, and insufficient attention to safety and equity. To address these gaps, we propose a taxonomy of AI mental health support types – assessment-, intervention-, and information synthesis-oriented – each with distinct risks and evaluative requirements, and illustrate its use through case studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管人工智能在心理健康护理领域展现出巨大的潜力，但目前用于评估该领域人工智能工具的方法仍然较为零散，且未能与临床实践、社会背景以及用户的实际体验有效结合。本文主张重新思考负责性的评估方式——评估的内容、评估的主体以及评估的目的。为此，我们提出了一个跨学科框架，将临床合理性、社会背景以及公平性纳入评估体系，为评估工作提供结构化的基础。通过对135篇最新关于人工智能在心理健康领域的研究的分析，我们发现存在一些共同的局限性，包括过度依赖无法反映临床有效性、治疗适宜性或用户体验的通用指标；心理健康专业人士的参与程度有限；以及对安全性和公平性的关注不足。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了一种人工智能心理健康支持类型的分类体系——包括评估型、干预型和信息综合型三种类型。每种类型都有其独特的风险和评估要求。最后，我们通过案例研究来说明这种分类体系的实际应用价值。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: JPU: Bridging Jailbreak Defense and Unlearning via On-Policy Path Rectification
papers.title_zh: 司法警察局：通过策略性路径修正技术，实现越狱行为辩护与知识更新的结合
papers.authors: Xi Wang, Songlei Jian, Shasha Li, Xiaopeng Li, Zhaoye Li, Bin Ji, Baosheng Wang, Jie Yu
papers.abstract: Despite extensive safety alignment, Large Language Models (LLMs) often fail against jailbreak attacks. While machine unlearning has emerged as a promising defense by erasing specific harmful parameters, current methods remain vulnerable to diverse jailbreaks. We first conduct an empirical study and discover that this failure mechanism is caused by jailbreaks primarily activating non-erased parameters in the intermediate layers. Further, by probing the underlying mechanism through which these circumvented parameters reassemble into the prohibited output, we verify the persistent existence of dynamic jailbreak paths and show that the inability to rectify them constitutes the fundamental gap in existing unlearning defenses. To bridge this gap, we propose Jailbreak Path Unlearning (JPU), which is the first to rectify dynamic jailbreak paths towards safety anchors by dynamically mining on-policy adversarial samples to expose vulnerabilities and identify jailbreak paths. Extensive experiments demonstrate that JPU significantly enhances jailbreak resistance against dynamic attacks while preserving the model’s utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在安全性方面进行了大量优化，但它们仍然容易遭受越狱攻击。虽然机器反学习作为一种有前景的防御手段，可以通过消除某些有害参数来防止攻击，但当前的方法仍然容易受到多种越狱攻击的影响。我们首先进行了一项实证研究，发现这种失败机制是由于越狱攻击主要激活了中间层中未被消除的参数所导致的。进一步分析这些被绕过参数如何重新组合成禁止输出的过程后，我们验证了动态越狱路径的持续存在，并表明无法修复这些路径正是现有反学习防御体系中的根本缺陷。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了“越狱路径反学习”技术。该技术首次通过动态挖掘策略内对抗样本来识别漏洞和越狱路径，从而将动态越狱路径转化为安全的路径。大量的实验表明，该技术在提高模型对动态攻击的抵抗能力的同时，还能保持模型的实用性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SpeechLLM-as-Judges: Towards General and Interpretable Speech Quality Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 以语言模型作为裁判：迈向通用且可解释的语音质量评估方法
papers.authors: Hui Wang, Jinghua Zhao, Yifan Yang, Shujie Liu, Junyang Chen, Yanzhe Zhang, Shiwan Zhao, Jinyu Li, Jiaming Zhou, Haoqin Sun, Yan Lu, Yong Qin
papers.abstract: Generative speech technologies are progressing rapidly, but evaluating the perceptual quality of synthetic speech remains a core challenge. Existing methods typically rely on scalar scores or binary decisions, which lack interpretability and generalization across tasks and languages. We present SpeechLLM-as-Judges, a new paradigm for enabling large language models (LLMs) to conduct structured and explanation-based speech quality evaluation. To support this direction, we introduce SpeechEval, a large-scale dataset containing 32,207 multilingual speech clips and 128,754 annotations spanning four tasks: quality assessment, pairwise comparison, improvement suggestion, and deepfake detection. Based on this resource, we develop SQ-LLM, a speech-quality-aware LLM trained with chain-of-thought reasoning and reward optimization to improve capability. Experimental results show that SQ-LLM delivers strong performance across tasks and languages, revealing the potential of this paradigm for advancing speech quality evaluation. The relevant code, models, and data are publicly available at https://github.com/NKU-HLT/SpeechLLM-as-Judges.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式语音技术正在迅速发展，但评估合成语音的感知质量仍然是一个核心挑战。现有的方法通常依赖于标量评分或二元决策，这些方法缺乏可解释性，且无法在不同任务和语言之间进行泛化。我们提出了SpeechLLM-as-Judges这一新范式，它使得大语言模型能够进行结构化的、基于解释的语音质量评估。为了支持这一方向，我们引入了SpeechEval这一大规模数据集，该数据集包含32,207条多语言语音片段和128,754条注释，涵盖四项任务：质量评估、成对比较、改进建议以及深度伪造检测。基于这一资源，我们开发了SQ-LLM，这是一个具备语音质量意识的语言模型，它通过思维链推理和奖励优化来提升其能力。实验结果表明，SQ-LLM在各类任务和语言中都能表现出强大的性能，这证明了这一范式为提升语音质量评估提供了巨大潜力。相关的代码、模型和数据可在https://github.com/NKU-HLT/SpeechLLM-as-Judges上获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LePREC: Reasoning as Classification over Structured Factors for Assessing Relevance of Legal Issues
papers.title_zh: LePREC：基于结构化因素的分类推理方法，用于评估法律问题的相关性
papers.authors: Fanyu Wang, Xiaoxi Kang, Paul Burgess, Aashish Srivastava, Chetan Arora, Adnan Trakic, Lay-Ki Soon, Md Khalid Hossain, Lizhen Qu
papers.abstract: More than half of the global population struggles to meet their civil justice needs due to limited legal resources. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, significant challenges remain even at the foundational step of legal issue identification. To investigate LLMs’ capabilities in this task, we constructed a dataset from 769 real-world Malaysian Contract Act court cases, using GPT-4o to extract facts and generate candidate legal issues, annotated by senior legal experts, which reveals a critical limitation: while LLMs generate diverse issue candidates, their precision remains inadequate (GPT-4o achieves only 62%). To address this gap, we propose LePREC (Legal Professional-inspired Reasoning Elicitation and Classification), a neuro-symbolic framework combining neural generation with structured statistical reasoning. LePREC consists of: (1) a neuro component leverages LLMs to transform legal descriptions into question-answer pairs representing diverse analytical factors, and (2) a symbolic component applies sparse linear models over these discrete features, learning explicit algebraic weights that identify the most informative reasoning factors. Unlike end-to-end neural approaches, LePREC achieves interpretability through transparent feature weighting while maintaining data efficiency through correlation-based statistical classification. Experiments show a 30-40% improvement over advanced LLM baselines, including GPT-4o and Claude, confirming that correlation-based factor-issue analysis offers a more data-efficient solution for relevance decisions.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于法律资源有限，全球超过一半的人口在满足民事司法需求方面面临困难。虽然大语言模型已经展示了令人印象深刻的推理能力，但在法律问题的识别这一基础步骤上仍然存在重大挑战。为了研究这些模型在这方面的能力，我们收集了769个马来西亚合同法法庭案例的数据集，并使用GPT-4o提取事实并生成可能的法律问题，然后由资深法律专家进行注释。研究发现了一个关键问题：尽管大语言模型能够生成多种法律问题候选方案，但其准确性仍然不足（GPT-4o的准确率仅为62%）。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了LePREC这一基于神经符号的框架，它将神经生成与结构化统计推理相结合。LePREC包括两部分：（1）神经部分利用大语言模型将法律描述转化为问题-答案对，从而涵盖各种分析因素；（2）符号部分则对这些离散特征应用稀疏线性模型，学习出能够识别最具信息量的推理因素的代数权重。与端到端神经方法不同，LePREC通过透明的特征加权实现可解释性，同时通过基于相关性的统计分类方式保持数据效率。实验结果显示，与先进的LLM基线模型相比，LePREC的性能提升了30-40%，其中包括GPT-4o和Claude。这表明，基于相关性的因素-问题分析为相关性决策提供了一种更高效的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: S2O: Early Stopping for Sparse Attention via Online Permutation
papers.title_zh: S2O：一种针对稀疏注意力机制的早期停止方法，采用在线排列策略实现
papers.authors: Yu Zhang, Songwei Liu, Chenqian Yan, Linsheng, Beichen Ning, Fangmin Chen, Xing Wang
papers.abstract: Attention scales quadratically with sequence length, fundamentally limiting long-context inference.Existing block-granularity sparsification can reduce latency, but coarse blocks impose an intrinsic sparsity ceiling, making further improvements difficult even with carefully engineered designs.We present S2O, which performs early stopping for sparse attention via online permutation.Inspired by virtual-to-physical address mapping in memory systems, S2O revisits and factorizes FlashAttention execution, enabling inference to load non-contiguous tokens rather than a contiguous span in the original order.Motivated by fine-grained structures in attention heatmaps, we transform explicit permutation into an online, index-guided, discrete loading policy; with extremely lightweight preprocessing and index-remapping overhead, it concentrates importance on a small set of high-priority blocks.Building on this importance-guided online permutation for loading, S2O further introduces an early-stopping rule: computation proceeds from high to low importance; once the current block score falls below a threshold, S2O terminates early and skips the remaining low-contribution blocks, thereby increasing effective sparsity and reducing computation under a controlled error budget.As a result, S2O substantially raises the practical sparsity ceiling.On Llama-3.1-8B under a 128K context, S2O reduces single-operator MSE by 3.82\times at matched sparsity, and reduces prefill compute density by 3.31\times at matched MSE; meanwhile, it preserves end-to-end accuracy and achieves 7.51\times attention and 3.81\times end-to-end speedups.
papers.abstract_zh: 注意力权重随着序列长度的平方增长，这从根本上限制了长上下文下的推理能力。现有的基于块粒度的稀疏化技术可以降低延迟，但粗糙的块结构会引入固有的稀疏性上限，即使采用精心设计的方案，也很难进一步改进。我们提出了S2O算法，它通过在线排列操作来实现稀疏注意力的提前终止。该算法借鉴了内存系统中虚拟地址到物理地址映射的思想，重新分解了FlashAttention的执行流程，使得推理时能够处理非连续的数据块，而不是以原始顺序处理连续的数据块。考虑到注意力热图中的细粒度结构，我们将显式的排列操作转化为一种在线、基于索引的离散加载策略。这种策略具有极轻量的预处理和索引映射开销，能够将重要性集中在少数高优先级块上。在此基础上，S2O还引入了提前终止规则：计算过程按照重要性从高到低进行；一旦当前块的得分低于某个阈值，S2O就会提前终止，从而跳过那些贡献较低的块，进而提高实际的稀疏性，并在可控的错误预算下减少计算量。因此，S2O显著提升了实际使用的稀疏性上限。在Llama-3.1-8B模型中，当上下文长度为128K时，S2O将单个操作符的均方误差降低了3.82倍，同时还将预填充的计算密度降低了3.31倍；与此同时，它还保持了端到端的准确性，并实现了7.51倍的注意力加速和3.81倍的端到端加速效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DART: Disambiguation-Aware Reasoning for Video-guided Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: DART：基于歧义消除的视频引导机器翻译推理方法
papers.authors: Boyu Guan, Chuang Han, Yang Zhao, Chengqing Zong
papers.abstract: Video-guided Machine Translation (VMT) seeks to enhance translation quality by incorporating contextual information derived from paired short video clips. However, many VMT samples are text-sufficient; even when visual information is needed, only minimal cues are required. Aiming to tackle these issues, we propose a novel framework DART (Disambiguation-Aware Reasoning for Video-guided Machine Translation). Reinforcement learning is used to incorporate multimodal large language models’ multimodal reasoning into VMT. The model dynamically switches between text-only processing and multimodal integration, contingent on the necessity of visual disambiguation. Furthermore, we present TVRF (Translation-oriented Video Relevance Filtering), a systematic pipeline for constructing training data based on multimodal relevance to translation. This pipeline filters samples where video information is translation-relevant, mitigating training collapse caused by video-irrelevant data in conventional VMT. Experimental results show that our approach improves multimodal information utilization in VMT, yielding gains in both translation quality and computational efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频引导机器翻译（VMT）通过结合来自成对短视频片段的上下文信息来提高翻译质量。然而，许多VMT样本仅需要文本信息；即使需要视觉信息，所需的提示也非常有限。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的框架——DART（针对视频引导机器翻译的消歧推理）。该框架利用强化学习将多模态大语言模型的多模态推理功能融入VMT中。模型会根据是否需要视觉消歧，在纯文本处理和多模态整合之间动态切换。此外，我们还提出了TVRF（面向翻译的视频相关性过滤），这是一种基于多模态相关性构建训练数据的系统流程。该流程会筛选出与翻译相关的视频信息，从而避免因视频无关数据而导致的传统VMT中的训练崩溃问题。实验结果表明，我们的方法提高了VMT中多模态信息的利用率，从而在翻译质量和计算效率方面都取得了提升。

papers.title: HCSpec: Two-Tier Horizontal Cascade Speculative Decoding for High-Efficiency Large Language Model Inference
papers.title_zh: HCSpec：双层水平级联推测解码技术，适用于高效的大型语言模型推理
papers.authors: Yizhou Zhang, Siming Chen, Hao Ye, Erhu Feng
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a draft model to propose token candidates for parallel verification by the target model. However, current state-of-the-art self-distilled draft models adopt a homogeneous architecture across all drafting positions, failing to account for a critical empirical observation: the expected utility of drafting decays rapidly after the initial positions. To exploit this imbalance, we propose Two-tier Horizontal Cascade Speculative Decoding (HCSpec), a novel framework that organizes heterogeneous, position-specialized draft modules into a horizontal cascade. The first tier employs a dual-layer, dual-path transformer that enhances early-step fidelity by decoupling token-logit prediction from recurrent feature propagation, while the second tier adopts a lightweight single-layer transformer that deliberately trades marginal accuracy for improved efficiency at later drafting steps. Extensive experiments on Qwen series models and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, across multiple tasks and diverse inference configurations, demonstrate that HCSpec consistently outperforms the previous state-of-the-art (EAGLE-3). It delivers 15–30% higher end-to-end speedup over EAGLE-3 and achieves up to 3.72x acceleration over vanilla autoregressive decoding. Our code is provided in the supplementary materials.
papers.abstract_zh: 投机性解码通过利用草稿模型来提出候选令牌，以便目标模型进行并行验证，从而加速大语言模型（LLM）的推理过程。然而，目前最先进的自蒸馏草稿模型采用统一的架构来处理所有起草位置，这未能考虑到一个重要的经验性观察：在初始位置之后，起草的预期效用会迅速下降。为了利用这种不平衡现象，我们提出了双层水平级联投机性解码技术。该框架将不同功能的、针对特定位置的草稿模块组织成水平级联结构。第一层采用双层双路径变换器，通过将令牌预测与循环特征传播分离开来，从而提高早期阶段的准确性；而第二层则采用轻量级单层变换器，为了在后期起草阶段提高效率而牺牲了一定的准确性。在Qwen系列模型和Llama3.1-8B-Instruct模型上进行的广泛实验表明，HCSpec在多种任务中始终表现出优于现有最先进技术的性能（EAGLE-3）。与EAGLE-3相比，HCSpec在端到端速度上提升了15-30%，并且在加速效果上达到了3.72倍的提升。我们的代码已包含在补充材料中。

papers.title: Revisiting the Reliability of Language Models in Instruction-Following
papers.title_zh: 重新审视语言模型在指令执行中的可靠性
papers.authors: Jianshuo Dong, Yutong Zhang, Liu Yan, Zhenyu Zhong, Tao Wei, Chao Zhang, Han Qiu
papers.abstract: Advanced LLMs have achieved near-ceiling instruction-following accuracy on benchmarks such as IFEval. However, these impressive scores do not necessarily translate to reliable services in real-world use, where users often vary their phrasing, contextual framing, and task formulations. In this paper, we study nuance-oriented reliability: whether models exhibit consistent competence across cousin prompts that convey analogous user intents but with subtle nuances. To quantify this, we introduce a new metric, reliable@k, and develop an automated pipeline that generates high-quality cousin prompts via data augmentation. Building upon this, we construct IFEval++ for systematic evaluation. Across 20 proprietary and 26 open-source LLMs, we find that current models exhibit substantial insufficiency in nuance-oriented reliability—their performance can drop by up to 61.8% with nuanced prompt modifications. What’s more, we characterize it and explore three potential improvement recipes. Our findings highlight nuance-oriented reliability as a crucial yet underexplored next step toward more dependable and trustworthy LLM behavior. Our code and benchmark are accessible: https://github.com/jianshuod/IFEval-pp.
papers.abstract_zh: 先进的大语言模型在诸如IFEval这样的基准测试中已经达到了接近完美的指令遵循准确率。然而，这些令人印象深刻的分数并不一定能转化为实际应用中的可靠服务，因为用户在表达时往往会有所不同，上下文也会有所变化，任务的形式也各不相同。在本文中，我们研究了以细微差别为导向的可靠性问题：即模型在传达类似用户意图但存在微妙差异的提示时，是否能够保持一致的能力。为了量化这一点，我们引入了一个新的指标——reliable@k，并开发了一种自动生成高质量相似提示的流程。在此基础上，我们构建了IFEval++来进行系统性的评估。通过对20个专有模型和26个开源模型进行测试，我们发现当前模型在细微差别导向的可靠性方面存在显著不足——当提示进行修改时，它们的性能可能会下降多达61.8%。此外，我们还对这一问题进行了分析，并探讨了三种潜在的改进方案。我们的研究结果强调了以细微差别为导向的可靠性是一个至关重要但尚未得到充分探索的领域，它有助于提升大语言模型的可靠性和可信度。我们的代码和基准数据可以访问：https://github.com/jianshuod/IFEval-pp。

papers.title: EfficientLLM: Unified Pruning-Aware Pretraining for Auto-Designed Compact Language Models
papers.title_zh: EfficientLLM：一种统一的剪枝技术，用于自动设计的紧凑型语言模型预训练
papers.authors: Xingrun Xing, Zheng Liu, Shitao Xiao, Boyan Gao, Yiming Liang, Haokun Lin, Xianlin Zeng, Guoqi Li, Jiajun Zhang
papers.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) driven by scaling laws achieve emergent intelligence in large model sizes. Recently, the increasing concerns about cloud costs, latency and privacy make it an urgent requirement to develop compact edge language models. Distinguished from direct pretraining that bounded by parameter scaling law, this work proposes the unified pruning-aware pretraining, focusing on pretraining compact models while preserving performance of much larger source models, termed EfficientLLM. It features following characteristics: 1) Pruning in Pretraining Corpus: we introduce minimal parameter groups to decouple LLMs and continuously optimize model architecture with classic pruning methods like LLM-Pruner and SparseGPT during pretraining. We reveal that it achieves top-quality compact language models to scale up LLM pruning to large scale pretraining. 2) Auto-Designed Architecture: the LLM architecture is auto-designed during saliency-driven pruning, unifying pretraining, architectural design, and parameter pruning into a single process. Based on these, EfficientLLM significantly outperforms directly pretrained baselines with 100M \sim 1B parameters, such as MobileLLM, SmolLM, Qwen2.5-0.5B, OLMo-1B, Llama3.2-1B in commen sense benchmarks, which bridges the performance gap between traditional LLM compression and direct pretraining. We open source on https://github.com/Xingrun-Xing2/EfficientLLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代大语言模型（LLMs）通过扩展定律的驱动，在大规模模型中实现了智能涌现。最近，由于对云成本、延迟和隐私问题的日益关注，开发紧凑型边缘语言模型变得十分紧迫。与受参数扩展定律限制的直接预训练不同，本研究提出了一种统一的剪枝感知预训练方法，该方法在保留更大源模型性能的同时，专注于训练出紧凑型模型，该模型被称为EfficientLLM。EfficientLLM具有以下特点：1）预训练过程中的剪枝：我们引入最小参数组来分离LLMs，并在预训练过程中使用LLM-Pruner和SparseGPT等经典剪枝方法进行模型架构的持续优化。我们发现，通过大规模预训练中的LLM剪枝，可以生成出质量极高的紧凑型语言模型。2）自动设计的架构：在基于显著性驱动的剪枝过程中，LLM架构被自动设计出来，将预训练、架构设计和参数剪枝整合为单一过程。基于这些特性，EfficientLLM在100万到1亿参数的基准测试中，其性能显著优于直接预训练的基线模型，如MobileLLM、SmolLM、Qwen2.5-0.5B、OLMo-1B、Llama3.2-1B。这弥补了传统LLM压缩技术与直接预训练之间的性能差距。我们将EfficientLLM的开源代码发布在https://github.com/Xingrun-Xing2/EfficientLLM上。

papers.title: SPPO: Sequence-Level PPO for Long-Horizon Reasoning Tasks
papers.title_zh: SPPO：用于长视界推理任务的序列级PPO算法
papers.authors: Tianyi Wang, Yixia Li, Long Li, Yibiao Chen, Shaohan Huang, Yun Chen, Peng Li, Yang Liu, Guanhua Chen
papers.abstract: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is central to aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) in reasoning tasks with verifiable rewards. However, standard token-level PPO struggles in this setting due to the instability of temporal credit assignment over long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) horizons and the prohibitive memory cost of the value model. While critic-free alternatives like GRPO mitigate these issues, they incur significant computational overhead by requiring multiple samples for baseline estimation, severely limiting training throughput. In this paper, we introduce Sequence-Level PPO (SPPO), a scalable algorithm that harmonizes the sample efficiency of PPO with the stability of outcome-based updates. SPPO reformulates the reasoning process as a Sequence-Level Contextual Bandit problem, employing a decoupled scalar value function to derive low-variance advantage signals without multi-sampling. Extensive experiments on mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that SPPO significantly surpasses standard PPO and matches the performance of computation-heavy group-based methods, offering a resource-efficient framework for aligning reasoning LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 近端策略优化（PPO）在使大语言模型（LLM）的推理任务与可验证的奖励保持一致方面起着至关重要的作用。然而，标准的令牌级PPO在这种环境下存在困难，因为长时间序列思维过程中的时间分配不稳定，而且价值模型的存储成本过高。虽然像GRPO这样的无批评替代方案可以缓解这些问题，但它们需要多个样本来进行基线估计，这会带来显著的计算开销，严重限制了训练效率。在本文中，我们提出了序列级PPO（SPPO），这是一种可扩展的算法，它结合了PPO的样本效率与基于结果的更新稳定性。SPPO将推理过程重新定义为序列级上下文变体问题，采用一个解耦的标量值函数来生成低方差的优势信号，而无需进行多次采样。在数学基准测试上的广泛实验表明，SPPO显著优于标准PPO，并且其性能与那些需要大量计算资源的基于组的算法相当。因此，SPPO为调整推理LLM提供了一种资源高效的框架。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Enhancing the Transferability of Jailbreak Attacks on Large Language Models via Exploiting Reparameterization Invariance
papers.title_zh: 通过利用重参数化的不变性，提升对大型语言模型进行越狱攻击的可转移性
papers.authors: Ao Wang, Xinghao Yang, Yongshun Gong, Wei Liu, Bao-di Liu, Weifeng Liu
papers.abstract: Jailbreak attacks serve as a pivotal technique for evaluating the safety alignment of Large language models. Current token-level attacks have shown remarkable efficacy on open-source models by leveraging gradient-based optimization. However, these attacks suffer from poor cross-model transferability, severely limiting their utility on proprietary ones. To address this limitation, we propose Reparameterization Invariance Gradient-based Jailbreak (RIGJ), a natural gradient based framework designed to improve cross-model transferability. Unlike prior token-level methods whose optimization paths are constrained by model-specific Euclidean geometry, RIGJ defines update directions according to differences in output distributions rather than parameter-space distances. Since language models are trained to capture similar dependency structures of natural language, their output distributions share common geometry across architectures, yielding intrinsically model-agnostic optimization trajectories and substantially stronger jailbreak transferability. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance, increasing the cross-model Attack Success Rate and Average Harmfulness Score by 14.9 and 1.23, respectively. Our code is provided https://github.com/nohuma/AISafety_transfer_jailbreak_RIGJ_2026.
papers.abstract_zh: 越狱攻击是评估大语言模型安全性对齐性的重要手段。目前的令牌级攻击通过利用基于梯度的优化方法，在开源模型上取得了显著的效果。然而，这些攻击存在跨模型的可转移性较差的问题，这严重限制了它们在专有模型上的应用。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种名为“重参数化不变性基于梯度的越狱攻击”（RIGJ）的框架。与那些优化路径受模型特定欧几里得几何约束的先前令牌级方法不同，RIGJ根据输出分布的差异来定义更新方向，而不是基于参数空间的距离。由于语言模型被训练用来捕捉自然语言的相似依赖结构，因此它们的输出分布在不同的架构中具有共同的几何特性，从而产生了本质上不依赖于模型的优化轨迹，并且具有更强的跨模型可转移性。大量的实验表明，该方法的性能更为优越，使得跨模型的攻击成功率和平均危害性得分分别提高了14.9和1.23。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/nohuma/AISafety_transfer_jailbreak_RIGJ_2026下载。

papers.title: GIFT: Guided Fine-Tuning and Transfer for Enhancing Instruction-Tuned Language Models
papers.title_zh: GIFT：引导式微调与迁移学习，用于提升基于教学优化的语言模型性能
papers.authors: Zhiwen Ruan, Yichao Du, Jianjie Zheng, Longyue Wang, Yun Chen, Peng Li, Jinsong Su, Yang Liu, Guanhua Chen
papers.abstract: Instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong instruction-following and generalization abilities, enabled by expensive post-training pipelines. However, adapting them to specific downstream tasks remains challenging: direct fine-tuning often disrupts this delicate balance, while existing adapter-based transfer methods typically treat the instruction-tuned model as a passive target that only participates at the final merging stage. We propose GIFT (Guided Fine-Tuning and Transfer), a simple and efficient framework that incorporates instruction-level guidance into task adaptation. GIFT fine-tunes a low-rank adapter on the pretrained base model using token-level confidence signals derived from the instruction-tuned model. The learned adapter is then merged into the instruction-tuned model, yielding task-specialized models that preserve general instruction-following behavior. We evaluate GIFT on mathematical reasoning and knowledge-intensive benchmarks across multiple model families and scales. Results show that GIFT consistently outperforms direct fine-tuning and representative transfer-based baselines, while maintaining robust generalization and favorable test-time scaling behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 经过精心调优的大语言模型在遵循指令和进行泛化能力方面表现出色，这得益于复杂的后训练流程。然而，将这些模型适配到特定的下游任务仍然具有挑战性：直接微调往往会破坏这种微妙的平衡，而现有的基于适配器的方法通常只是将经过指令调优的模型视为一个被动的目标，仅在其最终合并阶段发挥作用。我们提出了GIFT（引导式微调与迁移），这是一个简单高效的框架，能够将指令级指导融入任务适配过程中。GIFT利用从经过指令调优的模型中获得的令牌级置信度信号，对预训练的基础模型进行低秩适配器微调。然后，学习到的适配器被合并到经过指令调优的模型中，从而生成出既保留通用指令遵循能力，又具备特定任务特性的模型。我们在多个模型家族和规模上对GIFT进行了评估，结果显示，GIFT在数学推理和知识密集型任务上的表现始终优于直接微调以及基于迁移的基线方法，同时还能保持良好的泛化能力和在测试阶段的良好扩展性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AMATA: Adaptive Multi-Agent Trajectory Alignment for Knowledge-Intensive Question Answering
papers.title_zh: AMATA：自适应多智能体轨迹对齐技术，适用于知识密集型问答场景
papers.authors: Taolin Zhang, Dongyang Li, Chen Chen, Qizhou Chen, Jiuheng Wan, Xiaofeng He, Chengyu Wang, Richang Hong
papers.abstract: Despite substantial advances in large language models (LLMs), producing factually consistent responses for knowledge-intensive question answering remains challenging. These difficulties are primarily due to hallucination and the limitations of LLMs in bridging long-tail knowledge gaps. To address this, we propose AMATA, an Adaptive Multi-Agent Trajectory Alignment framework that dynamically integrates external knowledge to improve response interpretability and factual grounding. Our architecture leverages six specialized agents that collaboratively perform structured actions for complex question reasoning. We formalize multi-agent collaboration with external tools as a trajectory preference alignment problem, incorporating question-aware agent customization and inter-agent preference harmonization. AMATA introduces two principal innovations: (1) Intra-Trajectory Preference Learning, which learns objective-oriented preferences to prioritize critical agents, and (2) Inter-Agent Dependency Learning, which captures cross-agent tool dependencies through a novel dependency-aware direct preference optimization technique. Empirical results show that AMATA consistently outperforms baseline approaches, knowledge-augmented frameworks, and LLM-based trajectory systems on five established knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks. Further analysis demonstrates the efficiency of our method in reducing token consumption.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在性能上取得了显著进步，但在处理需要准确事实依据的问答任务时，仍然面临诸多挑战。这些困难主要源于模型的幻觉现象，以及模型在填补知识空白方面的局限性。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了AMATA这一自适应多智能体轨迹对齐框架。该框架能够动态整合外部知识，从而提高回答的可解释性和准确性。我们的架构利用了六个专门化的智能体，它们协同工作以处理复杂的问答问题。我们将多智能体与外部工具的协作过程抽象为轨迹偏好对齐问题，同时考虑了智能体的个性化定制以及不同智能体之间的偏好协调。AMATA具有两项主要创新点：(1) 轨迹内偏好学习，通过这种技术可以学习出有目标的偏好，从而优先选择重要的智能体；(2) 智能体间依赖关系学习，通过一种新颖的依赖性优化技术，可以捕捉到不同智能体之间的工具依赖关系。实验结果表明，AMATA在五个成熟的问答基准测试中的表现均优于传统的基线方法、基于知识的框架以及基于语言模型的轨迹系统。进一步分析表明，我们的方法在减少token消耗方面也表现出高效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ChessArena: A Chess Testbed for Evaluating Strategic Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ChessArena：一个用于评估大型语言模型战略推理能力的棋局测试平台
papers.authors: Jincheng Liu, Sijun He, Jingjing Wu, Xiangsen Wang, Yang Chen, Zhaoqi Kuang, Siqi Bao, Yuan Yao
papers.abstract: Recent large language models (LLMs) have shown strong reasoning capabilities. However, a critical question remains: do these models possess genuine strategic reasoning, or do they primarily excel at pattern recognition? To address this, we present ChessArena, a chess-based testbed for evaluating LLMs. Chess demands strategic reasoning, precise rule adherence, and the ability to track complex game states. ChessArena is a competitive framework where LLMs play against each other under four play modes. We evaluate 13 LLMs across over 800 games, testing basic understanding, move selection, and puzzle solving. Results reveal significant shortcomings: no model beats Maia-1100 (human amateur level), and some lose to random play. We also present a strong baseline: our fine-tuned Qwen3-8B substantially improves performance, approaching much larger state-of-the-art reasoning models.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的大语言模型展现出了强大的推理能力。然而，有一个关键问题仍然存在：这些模型是否真正具备战略性推理能力，还是它们主要擅长模式识别？为了解答这个问题，我们开发了ChessArena这一基于国际象棋的测试平台，用于评估语言模型的表现。国际象棋需要战略性的推理、对规则的精确遵循，以及处理复杂游戏状态的能力。ChessArena是一个竞争性的框架，在这个框架中，语言模型之间会进行对战，共有四种对战模式。我们对13种语言模型进行了超过800场比赛的测试，考察了它们的基本理解能力、棋步选择能力以及解决难题的能力。结果表明，这些模型存在显著的不足：没有任何模型能够击败Maia-1100（相当于人类业余水平），而有些模型在随机对战中也会失败。不过，我们也发现了一个不错的基线模型：经过微调的Qwen3-8B模型性能有了显著提升，其表现已经接近目前最先进的推理模型。

papers.title: From Completion to Editing: Unlocking Context-Aware Code Infilling via Search-and-Replace Instruction Tuning
papers.title_zh: 从完成到编辑：通过调整搜索替换指令来实现上下文感知的代码填充
papers.authors: Jiajun Zhang, Zeyu Cui, Jiaxi Yang, Lei Zhang, Yuheng Jing, Zeyao Ma, Tianyi Bai, Zilei Wang, Qiang Liu, Liang Wang, Binyuan Hui, Junyang Lin
papers.abstract: The dominant Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) paradigm for code completion is constrained by its rigid inability to correct contextual errors and reliance on unaligned, insecure Base models. While Chat LLMs offer safety and Agentic workflows provide flexibility, they suffer from performance degradation and prohibitive latency, respectively. To resolve this dilemma, we propose Search-and-Replace Infilling (SRI), a framework that internalizes the agentic verification-and-editing mechanism into a unified, single-pass inference process. By structurally grounding edits via an explicit search phase, SRI harmonizes completion tasks with the instruction-following priors of Chat LLMs, extending the paradigm from static infilling to dynamic context-aware editing. We synthesize a high-quality dataset, SRI-200K, and fine-tune the SRI-Coder series. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that with minimal data (20k samples), SRI-Coder enables Chat models to surpass the completion performance of their Base counterparts. Crucially, unlike FIM-style tuning, SRI preserves general coding competencies and maintains inference latency comparable to standard FIM. We release our dataset and models, establishing SRI as a robust, secure, and efficient alignment recipe for next-generation interactive development.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前主流的代码补全方法——填充式补全（Fill-in-the-Middle, FIM）模式，其局限性在于无法准确纠正上下文相关的错误，且依赖于不稳固、不可靠的基础模型。而聊天大语言模型则能提供安全性保障，代理式工作流程则具有灵活性，但两者都存在性能下降和延迟过长的问题。为了解决这一困境，我们提出了搜索与替换填充法（Search-and-Replace Infilling, SRI）。该方法的核心思想是将代理式的验证与编辑机制融入到一个统一的、一次性推理过程中。通过明确的搜索阶段来指导编辑操作，SRI能够将代码补全任务与聊天大语言模型的指令遵循机制相结合，从而将这种补全方式从静态的填充转变为动态、基于上下文的编辑。我们构建了一个高质量的数据集SRI-200K，并对SRI-Coder模型进行了优化训练。大量测试表明，即使使用极少的数据量（2万样本），SRI-Coder也能使聊天模型在代码补全性能上超越传统的基础模型。重要的是，与FIM式补全方法不同，SRI能够保留通用的编码能力，同时保持与标准FIM类似的推理延迟。我们已公开了我们的数据集和模型，希望SRI能成为下一代交互式开发的强大、安全且高效的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: What Makes an Ideal Quote? Recommending “Unexpected yet Rational” Quotations via Novelty
papers.title_zh: 什么才是理想的名言警句？推荐那些“出人意料却又合乎逻辑”的名言警句
papers.authors: Powei Chang, Jin Xiao, Guanglei Yue, Qianyu He, Yanghua Xiao, Deqing Yang, Jiaqing Liang
papers.abstract: Quotation recommendation enriches writing by suggesting quotations that fit a given context, but prior systems largely focus on topical relevance and overlook what makes quotes memorable. Based on a user study, we find that preferred quotations are often unexpected yet rational, motivating the goal of selecting quotes that are contextually novel while semantically coherent. We propose NovelQR, which (1) uses a generative label agent to map quotations and contexts into multi-dimensional deep-meaning labels for label-enhanced retrieval, and (2) reranks candidates with a token-level novelty estimator that mitigates auto-regressive continuation bias. Experiments on bilingual datasets across diverse domains show that NovelQR is preferred by human judges and improves overall recommendation quality over strong baselines, while achieving competitive novelty estimation.
papers.abstract_zh: 引用推荐通过提供适合特定上下文的引文来丰富写作内容。然而，现有的系统大多只关注引文的主题相关性，而忽视了那些能够让人难忘的引文。根据用户研究，我们发现人们通常更喜欢那些出人意料却又合乎逻辑的引文。因此，我们的目标就是选择那些在上下文上新颖且在语义上连贯的引文。我们提出了NovelQR算法：首先，使用生成式标签机制将引文和上下文映射成多维的深度含义标签，从而实现基于标签的检索；其次，通过令牌级的新颖性评估器对候选引文进行重新排序，从而减轻自回归延续偏差的影响。在多个领域的双语数据集上的实验表明，NovelQR算法受到人类评审员的青睐，其推荐的引文质量优于一些强大的基线方法，同时其新颖性评估也表现出竞争力。

papers.title: Do Not Step Into the Same River Twice: Learning to Reason from Trial and Error
papers.title_zh: 不要两次踏入同一条河流：学会从错误中吸取教训
papers.authors: Chenming Tang, Hsiu-Yuan Huang, Weijie Liu, Clive Bai, Saiyong Yang, Yunfang Wu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has significantly boosted the reasoning capability of language models (LMs). However, existing RLVR approaches train LMs based on their own on-policy responses and are constrained by the initial capability of LMs, thus prone to exploration stagnation, in which LMs fail to solve more training problems and cannot further learn from the training data. Some approaches try to address this by leveraging off-policy solutions to training problems, but rely on external expert guidance that is limited in availability and scalability. In this work, we propose LTE (Learning to reason from Trial and Error), an approach that hints LMs with their previously self-made mistakes, not requiring any external expert guidance. Experiments validate the effectiveness of LTE, which outperforms the normal group relative policy optimization (GRPO) by 5.02 in Pass@1 and 9.96 in Pass@k on average across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks for Qwen3-8B-Base and even performs better than methods that require external guidance. Further analysis confirms that LTE successfully mitigates exploration stagnation and enhances both exploitation and exploration during training. Our code is available at https://github.com/JamyDon/LTE.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了语言模型的推理能力。然而，现有的RLVR方法是基于模型自身的策略响应来训练语言模型的，并且受到语言模型初始能力的限制，因此容易出现探索停滞的问题——即语言模型无法解决更多的训练问题，也无法从训练数据中进一步学习。一些方法试图通过利用非策略解决方案来解决这一问题，但这些方法依赖于外部专家指导，而外部专家的指导和可用性以及可扩展性都存在局限性。在这项研究中，我们提出了LTE（从错误中学习推理）这一方法，该方法能够向语言模型提示它们之前犯过的错误，而无需依赖任何外部专家指导。实验验证了LTE的有效性：在Qwen3-8B-Base的六个数学推理基准测试中，LTE在Pass@1指标上的表现优于普通组的方法，平均优势为5.02；在Pass@k指标上的优势为9.96。甚至在某些情况下，LTE的表现优于那些需要外部指导的方法。进一步分析表明，LTE成功缓解了探索停滞问题，并在训练过程中提高了语言的利用效率和探索能力。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/JamyDon/LTE下载。

papers.title: iTAG: Inverse Design for Natural Text Generation with Accurate Causal Graph Annotations
papers.title_zh: iTAG：基于逆向设计的自然文本生成方法，能够实现精确因果图注释处理
papers.authors: Wenshuo Wang, Boyu Cao, Nan Zhuang, Wei Li
papers.abstract: A fundamental obstacle to causal discovery from text is the lack of causally annotated text data for use as ground truth, due to high annotation costs. This motivates an important task of generating text with causal graph annotations. Early template-based generation methods sacrifice text naturalness in exchange for high causal graph annotation accuracy. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-dependent methods directly generate natural text from target graphs through LLMs, but do not guarantee causal graph annotation accuracy. Therefore, we propose iTAG, which performs real-world concept assignment to nodes before converting causal graphs into text in existing LLM-dependent methods. iTAG frames this process as an inverse problem with the causal graph as the target, iteratively examining and refining concept selection through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning so that the induced relations between concepts are as consistent as possible with the target causal relationships described by the causal graph. iTAG demonstrates both extremely high annotation accuracy and naturalness across extensive tests, and the results of testing text-based causal discovery algorithms with the generated data show high statistical correlation with real-world data. This suggests that iTAG-generated data can serve as a practical surrogate for scalable benchmarking of text-based causal discovery algorithms.
papers.abstract_zh: 从文本中进行因果发现的一个根本障碍是，由于缺乏用于作为基准真值的因果注释文本数据，导致注释成本过高。这促使人们需要开发能够生成带有因果图注释的文本的方法。早期的基于模板的生成方法为了获得较高的因果图注释精度而牺牲了文本的自然性。最近的一些基于大语言模型的方法能够直接从目标图中生成自然文本，但无法保证因果图注释的准确性。因此，我们提出了 iTAG 算法。该算法在将因果图转换为文本之前，先对节点进行现实世界概念上的分配。 iTAG 将这一过程视为一个逆问题，以因果图为目标，通过思维链推理来迭代地选择和优化概念，从而使概念之间所建立的关联尽可能与因果图所描述的因果关系一致。经过广泛的测试验证，iTAG 算法不仅具有极高的注释准确性，而且文本的自然度也相当高。使用生成的数据进行基于文本的因果发现算法测试的结果表明，这些算法的统计相关性非常高，这表明 iTAG 生成的数据可以作为基于文本的因果发现算法进行可扩展基准测试的有效替代方案。

papers.title: Dynamic Long Context Reasoning over Compressed Memory via End-to-End Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过端到端强化学习来实现对压缩内存的动态长上下文推理
papers.authors: Zhuoen Chen, Dongfang Li, Meishan Zhang, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) face severe challenges in long-context processing, including quadratic computational costs, information forgetting, and the context fragmentation inherent in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). We introduce LycheeMemory, a cognitively inspired framework that enables efficient long-context inference via chunk-wise compression and selective memory recall, rather than processing all raw tokens. LycheeMemory segments the input into chunks and encodes each into compressed KV-cache style representations using a Compressor. A Gate then dynamically selects relevant memory blocks, which a Reasoner iteratively processes with an evolving working memory to solve downstream tasks. The Compressor and Reasoner are jointly optimized via end-to-end reinforcement learning, while the Gate is trained separately as a classifier. Experimental results demonstrate that LycheeMemory achieves competitive accuracy (up to 82% in ablation variants) on multi-hop reasoning benchmarks (e.g., RULER-HQA), successfully extrapolates context length from 7K to 1.75M, and provides a favorable accuracy–efficiency trade-off against strong long-context baselines. Notably, compared to MemAgent, LycheeMemory achieves an average 2× reduction in peak GPU memory usage and a 6× speedup during inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在长上下文处理方面面临严峻挑战，这些问题包括计算成本呈二次方增长、信息遗忘现象，以及检索增强生成技术所带来的上下文碎片化问题。我们提出了LycheeMemory这一基于认知工程的框架，该框架通过分块压缩和选择性记忆调用的方式，实现高效的长上下文推理，而无需处理所有原始令牌。LycheeMemory将输入数据分割成多个块，并使用压缩器将这些块编码成压缩的KV缓存格式。随后，门控模块会动态选择相关的记忆块，而推理器则利用不断发展的工作内存对这些记忆块进行处理，以完成下游任务。压缩器和推理器通过端到端强化学习进行联合优化，而门控模块则作为分类器单独进行训练。实验结果表明，LycheeMemory在多跳推理任务上取得了相当不错的性能（在消融实验中准确率高达82%），能够成功地将上下文长度从7K扩展到175万，并且与强大的长上下文基线模型相比，其准确率与效率之间的权衡更为理想。值得注意的是，与MemAgent相比，LycheeMemory在峰值GPU内存使用量上平均减少了2倍，而在推理过程中的速度则提升了6倍。

papers.title: From Word to World: Can Large Language Models be Implicit Text-based World Models?
papers.title_zh: 从词语到世界：大型语言模型能否成为隐式的基于文本的“世界模型”？
papers.authors: Yixia Li, Hongru Wang, Jiahao Qiu, Zhenfei Yin, Dongdong Zhang, Cheng Qian, Zeping Li, Xiaoteng Ma, Guanhua Chen, Heng Ji
papers.abstract: Agentic learning increasingly hinges on interaction, yet real-world experience is expensive, limited, and often irreversible at inference time. World models promise to mitigate these limitations, but it remains unclear whether large language models can actually serve as reliable world models, and deliver concrete benefits to downstream agents. We investigate these questions in text-based environments, a controlled testbed that reframes language modeling as next-state prediction under interaction. We propose a three-level framework to evaluate LLM-based world models: (i) fidelity and consistency, (ii) scalability and robustness, and (iii) agent utility. Across five representative environments, we show that sufficiently trained world models capture coherent environment dynamics, scale predictably with data and model capacity, and unlock tangible agent improvements—for example, action verification boosts GPT-4o by 5.5% on WebShop, and warm-started RL achieves a 15% gain on SciWorld. Crucially, these benefits hinge on behavioral coverage and environment complexity, sharply characterizing when world modeling meaningfully advances agent learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动学习越来越依赖于交互作用，然而现实世界中的经验往往成本高昂、有限性明显，且在推理过程中常常不可逆转。世界模型有望缓解这些限制，但尚不清楚大语言模型是否真的能够作为可靠的世界模型，并为下游智能体带来实际的好处。我们在基于文本的环境中研究了这些问题，这是一个经过控制的测试平台，它将语言建模重新定义为在交互下的下一状态预测。我们提出了一种三层次的框架来评估基于大语言模型的世界模型：(i) 真实性和一致性；(ii) 可扩展性和鲁棒性；(iii) 智能体的效用。通过五个具有代表性的环境实验，我们发现训练得当的世界模型能够捕捉到连贯的环境动态，其预测能力随着数据和模型容量的增加而得到提升，并且能够显著提升智能体的性能——例如，在WebShop场景中，动作验证功能使GPT-4o的性能提升了5.5%，而在SciWorld场景中，温启动的强化学习算法则实现了15%的性能提升。关键在于，这些好处取决于行为覆盖率和环境复杂性，这些因素明确指出了世界模型在多大程度上能够显著促进智能体的学习。

papers.title: GAMBIT: A Gamified Jailbreak Framework for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: GAMBIT：一种为多模态大语言模型设计的游戏化破解框架
papers.authors: Xiangdong Hu, Yangyang Jiang, Qin Hu, Xiaojun Jia
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have become widely deployed, yet their safety alignment remains fragile under adversarial inputs. Previous work has shown that increasing inference steps can disrupt safety mechanisms and lead MLLMs to generate attacker-desired harmful content. However, most existing attacks focus on increasing the complexity of the modified visual task itself and do not explicitly leverage the model’s own reasoning incentives. This leads to them underperforming on reasoning models (Models with Chain-of-Thoughts) compared to non-reasoning ones (Models without Chain-of-Thoughts). If a model can think like a human, can we influence its cognitive-stage decisions so that it proactively completes a jailbreak? To validate this idea, we propose GAMBIT (Gamified Adversarial Multimodal Breakout via Instructional Traps), a novel multimodal jailbreak framework that decomposes and reassembles harmful visual semantics, then constructs a gamified scene that drives the model to explore, reconstruct intent, and answer as part of winning the game. The resulting structured reasoning chain increases task complexity in both vision and text, positioning the model as a participant whose goal pursuit reduces safety attention and induces it to answer the reconstructed malicious query. Extensive experiments on popular reasoning and non-reasoning MLLMs demonstrate that GAMBIT achieves high Attack Success Rates (ASR), reaching 92.13% on Gemini 2.5 Flash, 91.20% on QvQ-MAX, and 85.87% on GPT-4o, significantly outperforming baselines. Warning: This paper contains unsafe and offensive examples.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型已经得到了广泛的应用，然而在对抗性输入下，它们的安全性仍然很脆弱。先前的研究表明，增加推理步骤可能会破坏安全机制，导致多模态大语言模型生成攻击者期望的有害内容。不过，目前大多数攻击方法都集中在提高修改后的视觉任务的复杂性上，并没有充分利用模型自身的推理机制。这就使得它们在推理模型上的表现不如非推理模型。如果模型能够像人类一样思考，那么我们是否可以影响它的认知阶段决策，使其主动完成“越狱”操作呢？为了验证这一想法，我们提出了GAMBIT——一种新颖的多模态“越狱”框架。该框架通过分解和重组有害的视觉语义信息，然后构建一个游戏化的场景，促使模型进行探索、重构意图并回答问题，从而赢得比赛。这种结构化的推理过程增加了视觉和文本方面的任务难度，使模型成为一个参与者，其目标追求会分散对安全的关注，进而促使它回答出重构后的恶意问题。在流行的推理型和非推理型多模态大语言模型上进行的大量实验表明，GAMBIT取得了较高的攻击成功率：在Gemini 2.5 Flash上达到了92.13%，在QvQ-MAX上达到了91.20%，而在GPT-4o上则达到了85.87%。与基线模型相比，GAMBIT的表现明显更好。警告：本文包含不安全和具有攻击性的示例。

papers.title: Large Language Model-Enhanced Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型增强型多臂老虎机
papers.authors: Jiahang Sun, Zhiyong Wang, Runhan Yang, Chenjun Xiao, John C.S. Lui, Zhongxiang Dai
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been applied to sequential decision-making tasks like multi-armed bandits (MAB), where an LLM is tasked with selecting arms in each iteration. However, this direct arm selection approach is often suboptimal. We propose an alternative method combining classical MAB algorithms with LLMs. Specifically, we use a classical MAB framework and leverage the in-context learning capability of LLMs for reward prediction. First, we integrate the LLM-based predictor into Thompson sampling (TS) with a decaying temperature schedule to balance exploration and exploitation. We also incorporate the predictor into a regression oracle-based MAB algorithm with explicit exploration. Additionally, we extend our TS-based algorithm to dueling bandits, where only preference feedback between arm pairs is available, requiring significant algorithmic modifications. Our empirical evaluations on synthetic MAB tasks show that our algorithms outperform LLM-based direct arm selection. In experiments on real-world text datasets, we demonstrate that, in tasks where arms lack exploitable semantic meaning, our approach delivers significantly better performance than direct arm selection.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已被应用于诸如多臂老虎机这样的序列决策任务中。在这些任务中，语言模型需要在每次迭代中选择相应的“臂”。然而，这种直接选择“臂”的方法往往并不理想。我们提出了一种结合传统多臂老虎机算法和语言模型的替代方法。具体来说，我们采用传统的多臂老虎机框架，并利用语言模型在上下文中的学习能力来进行奖励预测。首先，我们将基于语言模型的预测器整合到汤普森抽样算法中，并通过递减的温度策略来平衡探索与利用的关系。此外，我们还将该预测器融入到基于回归预言器的多臂老虎机算法中，从而实现明确的探索过程。另外，我们将基于汤普森抽样的算法扩展到对决型老虎机的场景中，在这种情况下，只有“臂对”之间的偏好反馈可用，这需要对算法进行显著的修改。我们在合成多臂老虎机任务上的实证评估表明，我们的算法在性能上优于基于语言模型的直接“臂”选择方法。在真实文本数据集上的实验表明，对于那些缺乏可利用语义意义的“臂”的任务来说，我们的方法能够取得比直接选择“臂”更好的性能。

papers.title: Flattery in Motion: Benchmarking and Analyzing Sycophancy in Video-LLMs
papers.title_zh: 奉承与模仿：在视频聊天环境中对谄媚行为的分析与评估
papers.authors: Wenrui Zhou, Mohamed Hendy, Shu Yang, Qingsong Yang, Zikun Guo, Yuyu Luo, Lijie Hu, Di Wang
papers.abstract: As video large language models (Video-LLMs) become increasingly integrated into real-world applications that demand grounded multimodal reasoning, ensuring their factual consistency and reliability is of critical importance. However, sycophancy, the tendency of these models to align with user input even when it contradicts the visual evidence, undermines their trustworthiness in such contexts. Current sycophancy research has largely overlooked its specific manifestations in the video-language domain, resulting in a notable absence of systematic benchmarks and targeted evaluations to understand how Video-LLMs respond under misleading user input. To fill this gap, we propose ViSE (Video-LLM Sycophancy Benchmarking and Evaluation), the first benchmark designed to evaluate sycophantic behavior in state-of-the-art Video-LLMs across diverse question formats, prompt biases, and visual reasoning tasks. Specifically, ViSE pioneeringly brings linguistic perspectives on sycophancy into the video domain, enabling fine-grained analysis across multiple sycophancy types and interaction patterns. Furthermore, we propose two potential training-free mitigation strategies revealing potential paths for reducing sycophantic bias: (i) enhancing visual grounding through interpretable key-frame selection and (ii) steering model behavior away from sycophancy via targeted, inference-time intervention on its internal neural representations. Our code is available at https://github.com/William030422/Video-Sycophancy.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着视频大语言模型越来越多地应用于需要基于多模态推理的实际场景，确保其事实一致性和可靠性变得至关重要。然而，这些模型存在一种倾向，即即使与视觉证据相矛盾时，仍会迎合用户输入，这严重损害了它们的可信度。目前关于这种倾向的研究大多忽略了其在视频-语言领域的具体表现，因此缺乏系统性的基准测试以及针对性评估，以了解视频大语言模型在误导性用户输入下的反应。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ViSE（视频大语言模型迎合行为基准测试与评估），这是首个旨在评估最先进视频大语言模型在不同问题形式、提示偏见和视觉推理任务中的迎合行为的基准测试。具体来说，ViSE首次将语言学视角引入视频领域，能够对多种迎合行为和交互模式进行细致分析。此外，我们还提出了两种无需训练的缓解策略，以减少迎合偏差：(i) 通过可解释的关键帧选择来增强视觉定位；(ii) 通过对模型的内部神经表示进行有针对性的干预，引导模型行为远离迎合行为。我们的代码可在https://github.com/William030422/Video-Sycophancy获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mem2ActBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Utilization in Task-Oriented Autonomous Agents
papers.title_zh: Mem2ActBench：一种用于评估任务导向型自主智能体长期记忆使用情况的基准测试工具
papers.authors: Yiting Shen, Kun Li, Wei Zhou, Songlin Hu
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly deployed for complex, tool-based tasks where long-term memory is critical to driving actions. Existing benchmarks, however, primarily test an agent’s ability to passively retrieve isolated facts in response to explicit questions. They fail to evaluate the more crucial capability of actively applying memory to execute tasks. To address this gap, we introduce Mem2ActBench, a benchmark for evaluating whether agents can proactively leverage long-term memory to execute tool-based actions by selecting appropriate tools and grounding their parameters. The benchmark simulates persistent assistant usage, where users mention the same topic across long, interrupted interactions and expect previously established preferences and task states to be implicitly applied. We build the dataset with an automated pipeline that merges heterogeneous sources (ToolACE, BFCL, OASST1), resolves conflicts via consistency modeling, and synthesizes 2,029 sessions with 12 user–assistant–tool turns on average. From these memory chains, a reverse-generation method produces 400 tool-use tasks, with human evaluation confirming 91.3% are strongly memory-dependent. Experiments on seven memory frameworks show that current systems remain inadequate at actively utilizing memory for parameter grounding, highlighting the need for more effective approaches to evaluate and improve memory application in task execution. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Cantaloupe-M/Mem2ActBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体被越来越多地用于那些需要长期记忆来驱动动作的复杂任务中。然而，现有的评估基准主要测试智能体在接收到明确问题时被动检索孤立信息的能力。这些基准未能评估智能体主动利用记忆来执行任务这一更为关键的能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Mem2ActBench这一评估基准，用于判断智能体是否能够主动利用长期记忆来选择适当的工具并调整其参数以执行基于工具的任务。该基准模拟了持续使用助手的情况，即用户在长时间且断断续续的互动中反复提及同一主题，并期望之前建立的偏好和任务状态能够自动被应用。我们通过自动化流程构建数据集，该流程整合了来自不同来源的数据（ToolACE、BFCL、OASST1），通过一致性建模解决数据冲突，并生成了2,029个会话，每个会话平均包含12个用户-助手-工具的交互。从这些记忆链中，通过反向生成方法产生了400个工具使用任务，人类评估结果显示其中91.3%的任务严重依赖于记忆。在七个不同的记忆框架上的实验表明，当前系统在主动利用记忆进行参数调整方面仍然存在不足，这凸显了需要更有效的方法来评估和改进记忆在任务执行中的应用。代码和数据的下载链接为：https://github.com/Cantaloupe-M/Mem2ActBench。

papers.title: ARK: Answer-Centric Retriever Tuning via KG-augmented Curriculum Learning
papers.title_zh: ARK：基于答案导向的检索器调优方法，通过增强型课程学习实现
papers.authors: Jiawei Zhou, Hang Ding, Haiyun Jiang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful framework for knowledge-intensive tasks, yet its effectiveness in long-context scenarios is often bottlenecked by the retriever’s inability to distinguish sparse yet crucial evidence. Standard retrievers, optimized for query-document similarity, frequently fail to align with the downstream goal of generating a precise answer. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel fine-tuning framework that optimizes the retriever for Answer Alignment. Specifically, we first identify high-quality positive chunks by evaluating their sufficiency to generate the correct answer. We then employ a curriculum-based contrastive learning scheme to fine-tune the retriever. This curriculum leverages LLM-constructed Knowledge Graphs (KGs) to generate augmented queries, which in turn mine progressively challenging hard negatives. This process trains the retriever to distinguish the answer-sufficient positive chunks from these nuanced distractors, enhancing its generalization. Extensive experiments on 10 datasets from the Ultradomain and LongBench benchmarks demonstrate that our fine-tuned retriever achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving 14.5% over the base model without substantial architectural modifications and maintaining strong efficiency for long-context RAG. Our work presents a robust and effective methodology for building truly answer-centric retrievers.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为处理知识密集型任务的强大框架，然而在长上下文场景中，其有效性往往受到检索器无法区分稀疏但至关重要的证据的限制。传统的检索器为了与查询文档的相似性而优化，常常无法与生成精确答案的目标保持一致。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种新颖的微调框架，该框架旨在优化检索器以使其能够准确匹配答案。具体来说，我们首先通过评估这些高质量的正样本是否足以生成正确答案来识别它们。然后，我们采用基于课程对比学习的方案来微调检索器。该课程利用由大语言模型构建的知识图谱来生成增强式查询，进而挖掘出越来越具有挑战性的负面样本。这一过程训练了检索器，使其能够区分那些足以生成正确答案的正样本和那些具有误导性的负面样本，从而提升了其泛化能力。我们在Ultradomain和LongBench基准测试中的10个数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，经过微调的检索器取得了最先进的性能表现，与基础模型相比提升了14.5%，且无需进行重大的架构修改，同时仍然保持了在长上下文RAG场景中的高效性。我们的工作提供了一种稳健且有效的方法来构建真正以答案为核心的检索器。

papers.title: On the Emotion Understanding of Synthesized Speech
papers.title_zh: 关于合成语音的情感理解
papers.authors: Yuan Ge, Haishu Zhao, AoKai Hao, Junxiang Zhang, Bei Li, Xiaoqian Liu, Chenglong Wang, Jianjin Wang, Bingsen Zhou, Bingyu Liu, JingBo Zhu, Zhengtao Yu, Tong Xiao
papers.abstract: Emotion is a core paralinguistic feature in voice interaction. It is widely believed that emotion understanding models learn fundamental representations that transfer to synthesized speech, making emotion understanding results a plausible reward or evaluation metric for assessing emotional expressiveness in speech synthesis. In this work, we critically examine this assumption by systematically evaluating Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) on synthesized speech across datasets, discriminative and generative SER models, and diverse synthesis models. We find that current SER models can not generalize to synthesized speech, largely because speech token prediction during synthesis induces a representation mismatch between synthesized and human speech. Moreover, generative Speech Language Models (SLMs) tend to infer emotion from textual semantics while ignoring paralinguistic cues. Overall, our findings suggest that existing SER models often exploit non-robust shortcuts rather than capturing fundamental features, and paralinguistic understanding in SLMs remains challenging.
papers.abstract_zh: 情绪是语音交互中的一个核心副语言特征。人们普遍认为，情绪理解模型能够学习出一些基本表征，这些表征可以应用于合成语音的生成过程中，因此情绪理解的结果可以被视为评估语音合成中情感表达力的一个合理指标。在这项研究中，我们通过系统地评估不同数据集上合成语音的情绪识别任务，以及各种判别性和生成性情绪识别模型以及不同的合成模型，对这一假设进行了严格的检验。我们发现，当前的情绪识别模型无法很好地泛化到合成语音上，主要是因为在合成过程中，语音标记的预测会导致合成语音与人类语音之间的表征不匹配。此外，生成式语音语言模型倾向于从文本语义中推断情绪，而忽略了副语言线索。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，现有的情绪识别模型往往采用了不稳健的捷径处理方式，而不是捕捉到基本特征；同时，生成式模型在理解副语言方面的能力仍然面临挑战。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Taming "Zombie" Agents: A Markov State-Aware Framework for Resilient Multi-Agent Evolution
papers.title_zh: 驯服“僵尸”代理：一种基于马尔可夫状态的框架，用于实现多智能体系统的稳健进化
papers.authors: Taolin Zhang, Pukun Zhao, Qizhou Chen, Jiuheng Wan, Chen Chen, Xiaofeng He, Chengyu Wang, Richang Hong
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in LLM-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated remarkable collaborative capabilities across complex tasks. To enhance the overall efficiency, existing methods often rely on aggressive graph topology evolution for agents (e.g., node or edge pruning), which risks prematurely discarding valuable agents due to transient issues such as hallucinations or temporary knowledge gaps. However, such hard pruning overlooks the potential for “zombie” agents to recover and contribute in subsequent discussion rounds. In this paper, we propose AgentRevive, a Markov state-aware framework for resilient multi-agent evolution. Our approach dynamically manages agent collaboration through soft state transitions, implemented via two key components: (1) State-Aware Policy Learning: Agent states are divided into “Active”, “Standby”, and “Terminated”, selectively propagating messages based on agent memory. The policy employs a risk estimator to optimize agent state transitions by assessing hallucination risk, minimizing the influence of unreliable nodes while safeguarding valuable ones. (2) State-Aware Edge Optimization: Subgraph edges are pruned according to states learned from the policy, permanently removing “Terminated” nodes and retaining “Standby” nodes for subsequent rounds to observe potential future contributions. Extensive experiments on general reasoning, domain-specific, and hallucination challenge tasks show that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines and significantly reduces token consumption through state-aware agent scheduling.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的最新进展展示了其在复杂任务中的出色协作能力。为了提高整体效率，现有方法通常依赖激进的图拓扑演化来优化智能体的行为（例如节点或边的剪枝），但这可能会导致有价值的智能体因幻觉或临时知识缺失等短暂问题而被过早淘汰。然而，这种硬性剪枝忽略了“僵尸智能体”在后续讨论中恢复并发挥作用的可能性。在本文中，我们提出了AgentRevive框架，这是一个具备马尔可夫状态感知能力的多智能体演化框架。我们的方法通过软状态转换来动态管理智能体的协作关系，这一机制由两个关键组件实现：(1) 状态感知策略学习：智能体的状态被划分为“活跃”、“待命”和“终止”三种状态，根据智能体的记忆选择性地传递信息。该策略采用风险估计方法来优化智能体的状态转换，通过评估幻觉风险来最小化不可靠节点的影响，同时保留有价值的节点。(2) 状态感知边优化：根据策略学习到的状态信息，对子图的边进行剪枝，永久移除“终止”的节点，并保留“待命”的节点以供后续轮次使用，从而观察它们潜在的贡献价值。在通用推理、特定领域任务和幻觉挑战任务上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法始终优于强大的基线算法，并且通过状态感知的智能体调度显著减少了token的消耗。

papers.title: A Survey of Large Language Model-Based Search Agents
papers.title_zh: 基于大型语言模型的搜索代理综述
papers.authors: Yunjia Xi, Jianghao Lin, Yongzhao Xiao, Zheli Zhou, Rong Shan, Te Gao, Jiachen Zhu, Weiwen Liu, Yong Yu, Weinan Zhang
papers.abstract: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) has significantly revolutionized web search. The emergence of LLM-based Search Agents marks a pivotal shift towards deeper, dynamic, autonomous information seeking. These agents can comprehend user intentions and environment context and execute multi-turn retrieval with dynamic planning, extending search capabilities far beyond the web. Leading examples like OpenAI’s Deep Research highlight their potential for deep information mining and real-world applications. This survey provides the first systematic analysis of search agents. We comprehensively analyze and categorize existing works from the perspectives of architecture, optimization, application, and evaluation, ultimately identifying critical open challenges and outlining promising future research directions in this rapidly evolving field.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的出现极大地改变了网络搜索的方式。基于大语言模型的搜索代理的诞生，标志着向更深层、更动态、更自主的信息检索方式的转变。这些代理能够理解用户的意图和周围环境，并能够进行多轮次检索操作，同时具备动态规划能力，从而将搜索功能扩展到网络的边界之外。像OpenAI的Deep Research这样的项目就展示了它们在深度信息挖掘和实际应用方面的潜力。本综述首次对搜索代理进行了系统的分析。我们从架构、优化、应用和评估等多个角度对现有研究进行了全面分析分类，最终确定了该领域面临的关键挑战，并指出了未来研究的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RSDA: Restoring Stale Data Affinity via Dynamic Renovation Strategy for Mitigating Data Scarcity
papers.title_zh: RSDA：通过动态修复策略恢复过时数据，以应对数据短缺问题
papers.authors: Yidan Liang, Jia Zhu, Weijie Shi, Hanghui Guo, Yue Cui, Jiawei Shen, Guoqing Ma, Jingjiang Liu, Qingyu Niu, Yilin Wang, Shimin Di, Jiajie Xu
papers.abstract: High-quality data is the cornerstone of advancing large language models. However, the field currently faces a critical dilemma: the supply of premium data is nearing depletion, while vast stale corpora remain underutilized. Our empirical analysis reveals that training models on such data directly often leads to performance degradation. We attribute this phenomenon to the data affinity gap, a misalignment stemming from the model’s inability to effectively comprehend the data or inherent quality defects. To bridge this gap, we propose Restoring Stale Data Affinity (RSDA) framework. First, utilizing our proposed potential entropy metric, RSDA quantifies the latent value of samples to effectively identify stale data with higher renovation potential. Subsequently, the framework employs a dynamic renovation strategy selection mechanism to determine the optimal component-level strategy for each instance, transforming low-affinity stale samples into high-quality training data. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate that RSDA effectively enhances data affinity, achieving performance improvements using less than 10% of the data volume, thereby underscoring that the latent potential of stale corpora remains largely untapped. The code is available at https://github.com/wenfiii/RSDA.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量的数据是推动大语言模型发展的基石。然而，目前该领域面临着一个关键难题：优质数据的供应正在逐渐枯竭，而大量陈旧的数据集却仍未得到充分利用。我们的实证分析表明，使用这类数据进行模型训练往往会导致性能下降。我们认为这种现象是由于数据亲和性差异造成的——即模型无法有效理解数据或数据本身存在质量缺陷所导致的。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了“恢复陈旧数据亲和性”框架。首先，通过我们提出的潜在熵度量方法，RSDA能够量化样本的价值，从而识别出具有较高更新潜力的陈旧数据。随后，该框架采用动态更新策略选择机制，为每个实例确定最优的组件级更新策略，将低亲和性的陈旧样本转化为高质量的训练数据。全面的实验结果表明，RSDA能够有效提升数据亲和性，即使使用不到10%的数据量也能实现性能提升，这充分说明了陈旧数据集的潜在价值仍有很大未被开发的空间。相关代码可访问https://github.com/wenfiii/RSDA。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Reasoning Trap: How Enhancing LLM Reasoning Amplifies Tool Hallucination
papers.title_zh: 推理的陷阱：如何通过提升大语言模型的推理能力来加剧工具主义的幻想效应
papers.authors: Chenlong Yin, Zeyang Sha, Shiwen Cui, Changhua Meng, Zechao Li
papers.abstract: Enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) is a key strategy for building agents that ”think then act”. However, recent observations, like OpenAI’s o3, suggest a paradox: stronger reasoning often coincides with increased hallucination, yet no prior work has systematically examined whether reasoning enhancement itself causes tool hallucination. We address this gap with the central question: Does strengthening reasoning increase tool hallucination? To answer this, we introduce SimpleToolHalluBench, a diagnostic benchmark measuring tool hallucination in two failure modes: (i) no tool available, and (ii) only distractor tools available. Through controlled experiments, we establish three key findings. First, we demonstrate a causal relationship: progressively enhancing reasoning through RL increases tool hallucination proportionally with task performance gains. Second, this effect transcends overfitting—training on non-tool tasks (e.g., mathematics) still amplifies subsequent tool hallucination. Third, the effect is method-agnostic, appearing when reasoning is instilled via supervised fine-tuning and when it is merely elicited at inference by switching from direct answers to step-by-step thinking. We also evaluate mitigation strategies including Prompt Engineering and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), revealing a fundamental reliability–capability trade-off: reducing hallucination consistently degrades utility. Mechanistically, Reasoning RL disproportionately collapses tool-reliability–related representations, and hallucinations surface as amplified divergences concentrated in late-layer residual streams. These findings reveal that current reasoning enhancement methods inherently amplify tool hallucination, highlighting the need for new training objectives that jointly optimize for capability and reliability. Our implementation is provided at https://github.com/albert-y1n/Reasoning_Trap.
papers.abstract_zh: 提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力是构建“思考后再行动”的智能体的关键策略。然而，最近的一些观察结果，比如OpenAI的o3项目，揭示了一个悖论：更强的推理能力往往伴随着幻觉的增加，但之前的研究并未系统地探讨过推理能力的提升是否会导致工具幻觉的出现。我们试图填补这一空白，核心问题是：加强推理能力是否会增加工具幻觉？为了回答这个问题，我们开发了SimpleToolHalluBench这个诊断基准测试，该测试通过两种失败模式来测量工具幻觉：（i）没有可用的工具；（ii）只有干扰工具可用。通过控制实验，我们得到了三个重要发现。首先，我们证明了因果关系：通过强化强化学习来提升推理能力，会与任务性能的提升成正比地增加工具幻觉。其次，这种效应不受过拟合的影响——即使是在非工具任务上进行训练（例如数学任务），仍然会加剧后续的工具幻觉。第三，这种效应与具体方法无关，无论是在通过监督微调的方式引入推理能力时，还是在通过从直接回答转变为逐步思考的方式在推理过程中激发推理能力时，都会出现这种效应。我们还评估了缓解策略，包括提示工程和直接偏好优化（DPO），发现了一个基本的可靠性与能力之间的权衡：减少幻觉会持续降低效用。从机制上讲，强化学习会不成比例地破坏与工具可靠性相关的表征，而幻觉则表现为在后期残差流中集中的放大差异。这些发现表明，当前的推理增强方法本质上会加剧工具幻觉，这凸显了需要新的训练目标，以同时优化能力和可靠性。我们的实现代码可以在https://github.com/albert-y1n/Reasoning_Trap下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Protecting multimodal large language models against misleading visualizations
papers.title_zh: 保护多模态大语言模型，避免其受到误导性可视化的影响
papers.authors: Jonathan Tonglet, Tinne Tuytelaars, Marie-Francine Moens, Iryna Gurevych
papers.abstract: Visualizations play a pivotal role in daily communication in an increasingly data-driven world. Research on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for automated chart understanding has accelerated massively, with steady improvements on standard benchmarks. However, for MLLMs to be reliable, they must be robust to misleading visualizations, i.e., charts that distort the underlying data, leading readers to draw inaccurate conclusions. Here, we uncover an important vulnerability: MLLM question-answering (QA) accuracy on misleading visualizations drops on average to the level of the random baseline. To address this, we provide the first comparison of six inference-time methods to improve QA performance on misleading visualizations, without compromising accuracy on non-misleading ones. We find that two methods, table-based QA and redrawing the visualization, are effective, with improvements of up to 19.6 percentage points. We make our code and data available.
papers.abstract_zh: 在日益依赖数据的时代，可视化技术在日常沟通中发挥着至关重要的作用。关于多模态大语言模型在自动图表理解方面的研究取得了显著进展，标准基准测试的成绩也在稳步提升。然而，为了使大语言模型能够可靠地运行，它们必须能够抵御那些会误导读者的可视化方式——也就是那些扭曲了原始数据、导致读者得出错误结论的图表。我们发现了一个重要的漏洞：大语言模型在处理这些误导性可视化图表时的问答准确率平均降到了与随机基线相当的水平。为了解决这个问题，我们首次比较了六种在推理阶段改进大语言模型对误导性可视化图表处理能力的算法，同时不牺牲对非误导性可视化图表的处理准确性。研究发现，两种方法——基于表格的问答机制以及重新绘制可视化图的方式——效果显著，其准确率提升了高达19.6个百分点。我们将我们的代码和数据集公开提供给大家。

papers.title: Dual Activation-Weight Sparsity: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Large Language Model Compression
papers.title_zh: 双激活机制与权重稀疏化：一种无需训练的高效大语言模型压缩框架
papers.authors: Luoyang Sun, Guangyan Li, Cheng Deng, Haifeng Zhang, Jian Zhao, Yongqiang Tang, Wensheng Zhang, Jun Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at natural language tasks but face deployment challenges due to computational demands. We introduce Dual Activation-Weight Sparsity (DAWS), a training-free framework that jointly exploits activation and weight sparsity through magnitude-based routing. Systematic analysis of pretrained transformers reveals two key observations: (1) the activation energy is concentrated in a few neurons, and (2) activation and weight sparsity patterns are complementary between attention and FFN layers. DAWS employs a three-tier routing strategy: high-magnitude activations pass through full-precision weights to preserve critical pathways, medium-magnitude activations use magnitude-pruned sparse weights for efficiency, and low-magnitude activations are directly discarded. Unlike prior work that uses activation-aware pruning methods like WANDA, our approach uses direct magnitude-based pruning, which we show is more robust to sample-level variations. Experiments on Llama and Mistral models demonstrate that DAWS maintains >98% of dense model performance at 50% sparsity, outperforming WANDA, TEAL, and R-Sparse.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自然语言任务中表现出色，但由于计算需求方面的挑战，其在部署过程中面临困难。我们提出了一种名为“双激活-权重稀疏性”的框架，该框架无需训练即可通过基于幅度的路由策略，同时利用激活权重稀疏性来提升性能。对预训练Transformer的系统分析揭示了两个关键现象：（1）激活能量集中在少数神经元中；（2）注意力层和FFN层之间的激活权重稀疏性模式是互补的。DAWS采用了三层路由策略：高幅度激活通过全精度权重传递，以保留关键路径；中等幅度激活使用基于幅度修剪的稀疏权重来提高效率；低幅度激活则被直接丢弃。与那些使用激活感知修剪方法的现有技术相比，我们的方法采用直接的基于幅度的修剪策略，并证明这种方法更能应对样本层面的变化。在Llama和Mistral模型上的实验表明，即使在50%的稀疏性条件下，DAWS仍能保持超过98%的密集模型性能，其表现优于WANDA、TEAL和R-Sparse等算法。

papers.title: Repeated Sequences Reveal Gaps between Large Language Models and Natural Language
papers.title_zh: 重复序列揭示了大型语言模型与自然语言之间的差距
papers.authors: Kumiko Tanaka-Ishii
papers.abstract: Evaluating whether large language models (LLMs) capture the structureof natural language beyond local fluency remains an open challenge.Existing evaluation methods, largely based on task performance orshort-context behavior, provide limited insight into the long-rangestatistical organization of generated text.We propose a complementary evaluation framework based on repeatedsubsequences. By analyzing their distribution across scales andrelating it to higher-order Rényi entropies, we probe how textsreuse previously established structure under finite-lengthconditions. Experiments on human-written texts and length-matchedGPT-generated texts show that,while power-law models can describerestricted ranges of block length, the observed entropy growth isoften equally or better characterized by logarithmic–power forms.Across datasets, natural language exhibits stable entropy-growthpatterns over accessible ranges, with consistent average behavior despite variability across individual texts. In contrast,GPT-generated texts show systematic and statistically significantshifts in estimated exponents with model size.These results demonstrate that repeated-subsequence entropyprovides a quantitative structural diagnostic that revealssystematic differences in long-range organization,distinguishing natural language from state-of-the-art LLM outputsbeyond surface-level fluency.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型是否能够捕捉自然语言的结构，而不仅仅是局部流畅性，仍然是一个未解决的挑战。现有的评估方法主要基于任务表现或短上下文行为，这些方法对于理解生成文本的长期统计结构来说，所提供的信息非常有限。我们提出了一种基于重复子序列的补充评估框架。通过分析子序列在不同尺度上的分布，并将其与更高阶的Rényi熵联系起来，我们可以探究文本在有限长度条件下如何重复使用已有的结构。对人类撰写的文本以及与之长度匹配的GPT生成的文本进行的实验表明，虽然幂律模型可以描述有限的块长度范围，但观察到的熵增长通常可以用对数幂形式来更好地描述。在不同的数据集上，自然语言在可访问的范围内表现出稳定的熵增长模式，尽管不同文本之间存在差异，但平均行为是一致的。相比之下，GPT生成的文本在估计的指数上显示出系统性和统计学上显著的随模型大小的变化。这些结果表明，重复子序列熵提供了一种定量结构诊断工具，能够揭示长期组织结构的系统性差异，从而将自然语言与最先进的LLM输出区分开来，而不仅仅是表面上的流畅性。

papers.title: AgentCoMa: A Compositional Benchmark Mixing Commonsense and Mathematical Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios
papers.title_zh: AgentCoMa：一种基于组合方式的基准混合方法——在现实场景中运用常识与数学推理
papers.authors: Lisa Alazraki, Lihu Chen, Ana Brassard, Joe Stacey, Hossein A. Rahmani, Marek Rei
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved high accuracy on complex commonsense and mathematical problems that involve the composition of multiple reasoning steps. However, current compositional benchmarks testing these skills tend to focus on either commonsense or math reasoning, whereas LLM agents solving real-world tasks would require a combination of both. In this work, we introduce an Agentic Commonsense and Math benchmark (AgentCoMa), where each compositional task requires a commonsense reasoning step and a math reasoning step. We test it on 61 LLMs of different sizes, model families, and training strategies. We find that LLMs can usually solve both steps in isolation, yet their accuracy drops by nearly 30% on average when the two are combined. This is a substantially greater performance gap than the one we observe in prior compositional benchmarks that combine multiple steps of the same reasoning type. In contrast, non-expert human annotators can solve the compositional questions and the individual steps in AgentCoMa with similarly high accuracy. Furthermore, we conduct a series of interpretability studies to better understand the performance gap, examining neuron patterns, attention maps and membership inference. Our work underscores a substantial degree of model brittleness in the context of mixed-type compositional reasoning and offers a test bed for future improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在涉及多个推理步骤的复杂常识和数学问题上已经取得了较高的准确率。然而，目前用于测试这些能力的组合式基准测试往往只关注常识或数学推理中的某一个方面。而实际任务中，语言模型需要同时处理这两个方面的问题。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种“代理常识与数学”的基准测试（AgentCoMa），该测试要求每个组合任务都包含常识推理步骤和数学推理步骤。我们对61种不同规模、模型家族和训练策略的语言模型进行了测试。我们发现，通常情况下，语言模型能够独立解决这两个步骤的问题，但当两者结合使用时，其准确率平均下降近30%。这一性能差距比之前那些仅包含同一类型推理步骤的组合式基准测试所观察到的差距要大得多。相比之下，非专业的人类注释者能够以类似的高准确率解决AgentCoMa中的组合问题以及各个单独的步骤。此外，我们还进行了一系列可解释性研究，以更深入地了解这种性能差距的原因，包括分析神经元模式、注意力图以及成员关系推断等。我们的研究强调了在混合类型的组合推理情境下，模型存在相当大的脆弱性，同时也为未来的改进提供了测试平台。

papers.title: HERMES: KV Cache as Hierarchical Memory for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
papers.title_zh: 赫耳墨斯：KV缓存作为分层存储器，实现高效的流媒体视频处理
papers.authors: Haowei Zhang, Shudong Yang, Jinlan Fu, See-Kiong Ng, Xipeng Qiu
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant improvement in offline video understanding. However, extending these capabilities to streaming video inputs, remains challenging, as existing models struggle to simultaneously maintain stable understanding performance, real-time responses, and low GPU memory overhead. To address this challenge, we propose HERMES, a novel training-free architecture for real-time and accurate understanding of video streams. Based on a mechanistic attention investigation, we conceptualize KV cache as a hierarchical memory framework that encapsulates video information across multiple granularities. During inference, HERMES reuses a compact KV cache, enabling efficient streaming understanding under resource constraints. Notably, HERMES requires no auxiliary computations upon the arrival of user queries, thereby guaranteeing real-time responses for continuous video stream interactions. HERMES achieves 10\times faster TTFT compared to prior SOTA. Even when reducing video tokens by up to 68% compared with uniform sampling, HERMES achieves superior or comparable accuracy across all benchmarks, with up to 11.4% gains on streaming datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在多模态大语言模型领域取得的进展表明，其在离线视频理解方面有了显著的提升。然而，将这些能力扩展到流媒体视频输入仍然具有挑战性，因为现有的模型难以同时保持良好的理解性能、实时响应能力以及较低的GPU内存占用。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了HERMES这一全新的无训练架构，它能够实现对视频流的实时且准确的理解。基于机制化的注意力机制设计，我们将KV缓存概念化为一个分层的内存框架，能够跨多个粒度层次封装视频信息。在推理过程中，HERMES会重用紧凑的KV缓存，从而在资源有限的情况下实现高效的流媒体理解。值得注意的是，HERMES在接收到用户查询时不需要进行任何辅助计算，从而确保了连续视频流交互时的实时响应能力。与现有的最佳模型相比，HERMES在视频处理速度上提升了10倍。即使是将视频令牌的数量减少了68%，HERMES在所有基准测试中的准确率依然保持领先或相当的水平，在流媒体数据集上的准确率甚至提高了11.4%。

papers.title: Reasoning with OmniThought: A Large CoT Dataset with Verbosity and Cognitive Difficulty Annotations
papers.title_zh: 与OmniThought进行推理：一个包含详细信息和认知难度注释的大规模CoT数据集
papers.authors: Wenrui Cai, Chengyu Wang, Junbing Yan, Jun Huang, Xiangzhong Fang
papers.abstract: Tasks such as mathematical problem solving and coding require models to leverage chain-of-thought (CoT) processes, enabling human-like reasoning strategies. However, the advancement of large reasoning models (LRMs) is hindered by the lack of comprehensive CoT datasets. Existing resources often fail to provide extensive reasoning problems with coherent CoT processes distilled from multiple teacher models, and do not account for multifaceted properties describing the internal characteristics of CoTs.To address these challenges, we introduce OmniThought, a large-scale dataset featuring 2 million CoT processes generated and validated by multiple powerful LRMs. Each CoT process in OmniThought is annotated with novel Reasoning Verbosity (RV) and Cognitive Difficulty (CD) scores, which characterize the appropriateness of CoT verbosity and the cognitive difficulty level for models to comprehend these reasoning processes. We further establish a self-reliant pipeline to curate this dataset. Extensive experiments using Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 of various sizes demonstrate the positive impact of our RV and CD scores on LRM training effectiveness. Based on the OmniThought dataset, we train and release a series of high-performing LRMs with enhanced reasoning abilities and optimized CoT output length. Our contributions advance the development of LRMs across different scales for solving complex reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 诸如数学问题解决和编程这样的任务，需要模型来利用思维链过程，从而实现类似人类的推理策略。然而，大型推理模型的进步受到缺乏全面的思维链数据集的阻碍。现有的资源往往无法提供具有连贯思维链过程的丰富推理问题，而且也没有考虑到描述思维链内部特性的多方面属性。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了OmniThought这一大规模数据集，该数据集包含由多个强大的推理模型生成并验证的200万个思维链过程。OmniThought中的每个思维链过程都带有新颖的推理复杂度和认知难度评分，这些评分能够反映推理复杂度的适宜性以及模型理解这些推理过程的认知难度水平。我们还建立了一个自主的数据集整理流程。通过使用不同规模的Qwen2.5和Qwen3进行的大量实验表明，我们的推理复杂度和认知难度评分对推理模型的训练效果有着积极的影响。基于OmniThought数据集，我们训练并发布了一系列性能优越的推理模型，这些模型具有更强的推理能力，并且优化了思维链输出的长度。我们的贡献推动了不同规模推理模型的发展，以解决复杂的推理任务。

papers.title: InferenceDynamics: Adaptive LLM Routing through Structured Capability and Knowledge Profiling
papers.title_zh: InferenceDynamics：基于结构化能力和知识分析的自适应大语言模型路由方案
papers.authors: Haochen Shi, Tianshi Zheng, Weiqi Wang, Baixuan Xu, Chunyang Li, Chunkit Chan, Tao Fan, Yangqiu Song
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) routing is a pivotal technique for navigating a diverse landscape of LLMs, enabling the selection of the best-performing LLMs for specific user queries while balancing performance and cost. However, current routing approaches often face limitations in scalability when dealing with a large pool of specialized LLMs, or in their adaptability to extending model scope and evolving capability domains. To overcome those challenges, we propose InferenceDynamics, a flexible and scalable multi-dimensional routing framework by modeling the capability and knowledge of models. We operate it on our comprehensive dataset RouteMix, and demonstrate its effectiveness and generalizability in group-level routing using modern benchmarks including MMLU-Pro, GPQA, BigGenBench, and LiveBench, showcasing its ability to identify and leverage top-performing models for given tasks, leading to superior outcomes with cost efficiency. The broader adoption of InferenceDynamics can empower users to harness the full specialized potential of the LLM ecosystem, and our code will be made publicly available to encourage further research.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型路由是一种关键技术，它有助于在众多语言模型中找到最适合特定用户查询的模型，同时兼顾性能和成本因素。然而，当前的路由方法在处理大量专业语言模型时往往存在可扩展性方面的限制，また在扩展模型范围以及适应不断发展的能力领域方面也存在不足。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了InferenceDynamics这一灵活且可扩展的多维路由框架。该框架通过建模模型的能力与知识来运作，我们将其应用于我们的综合数据集RouteMix上，并通过包括MMLU-Pro、GPQA、BigGenBench和LiveBench等现代基准测试，证明了其在群体级路由中的有效性和通用性。这表明该框架能够识别并利用在特定任务中表现最佳的模型，从而以更低的成本获得更好的结果。如果InferenceDynamics得到更广泛的应用，就能帮助用户充分挖掘语言模型生态系统的专业潜力。我们的代码将被公开提供，以鼓励更多的研究工作。

papers.title: ReportLogic: Evaluating Logical Quality in Deep Research Reports
papers.title_zh: ReportLogic：评估深度研究报告中逻辑性的质量
papers.authors: Jujia Zhao, Zhaoxin Huan, Zihan Wang, Xiaolu Zhang, Jun Zhou, Suzan Verberne, Zhaochun Ren
papers.abstract: Users increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) for Deep Research, using them to synthesize diverse sources into structured reports that support understanding and action. In this context, the practical reliability of such reports hinges on logical quality: whether the report’s claims and arguments are explicitly supported and can be trusted as a basis for downstream use, rather than merely appearing fluent or informative. However, current evaluation frameworks largely overlook this requirement. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReportLogic, a benchmark that quantifies report-level logical quality through a reader-centric lens of auditability. Specifically, ReportLogic adopts a hierarchical taxonomy that evaluates whether readers can (1) trace an on-topic report structure with a unified analytical arc (Macro-Logic), (2) understand the progression with necessary context (Expositional-Logic), and (3) verify conclusions via explicit claim–support (Structural-Logic). Based on this taxonomy, we construct a human-annotated rubric-guided dataset and train an open-source LogicJudge for scalable evaluation. We further evaluate judge robustness via adversarial attacks, showing that off-the-shelf LLM judges are frequently influenced by superficial cues (e.g., verbosity), and reasoning modes can mask broken support relations. Overall, our results provide actionable guidance for building more robust logic evaluators and improving the logical reliability of LLM-generated reports.
papers.abstract_zh: 用户越来越依赖大语言模型来进行深度研究，利用它们将各种信息合成成结构化的报告，以帮助理解和采取行动。在这种情况下，这些报告的实用性可靠性取决于其逻辑质量：报告的陈述和论点是否得到了明确的支持，能否作为后续使用的依据，而不仅仅是看起来流畅或有用而已。然而，目前的评估框架大多忽略了这一要求。为了弥补这一不足，我们引入了ReportLogic这一基准测试工具，它通过以读者为中心的方式来量化报告的logical质量。具体来说，ReportLogic采用了一种分层分类法，用于评估读者是否能够（1）通过统一的分析路径来理解与主题相关的报告结构（宏观逻辑），（2）在必要的背景下理解报告的进展（解释性逻辑），以及（3）通过明确的陈述和证据来验证结论（结构逻辑）。基于这种分类法，我们构建了一个由人类标注的评分数据集，并训练了一个开源的LogicJudge工具，以实现可扩展的评估。我们还通过对抗性攻击来评估评估工具的鲁棒性，结果显示，现成的语言模型评估工具往往受到表面线索的影响（例如，冗长的描述），而推理模式可能会掩盖不连贯的支持关系。总体而言，我们的研究结果为构建更强大的逻辑评估工具提供了可行的指导，并有助于提高语言模型生成的报告的logical可靠性。

papers.title: Detecting RAG Extraction Attack via Dual-Path Runtime Integrity Game
papers.title_zh: 通过双路径运行时完整性机制检测RAG提取攻击
papers.authors: Yuanbo Xie, Yingjie Zhang, Yulin Li, Shouyou Song, Xiaokun Chen, Zhihan Liu, Liya Su, Tingwen Liu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems augment large language models with external knowledge, yet introduce a critical security vulnerability: RAG Knowledge Base Leakage, wherein adversarial prompts can induce the model to divulge retrieved proprietary content. Recent studies reveal that such leakage can be executed through adaptive and iterative attack strategies (named RAG extraction attack), while effective countermeasures remain notably lacking. To bridge this gap, we propose CanaryRAG, a runtime defense mechanism inspired by stack canaries in software security. CanaryRAG embeds carefully designed canary tokens into retrieved chunks and reformulates RAG extraction defense as a dual-path runtime integrity game. Leakage is detected in real time whenever either the target or oracle path violates its expected canary behavior, including under adaptive suppression and obfuscation. Extensive evaluations against existing attacks demonstrate that CanaryRAG provides robust defense, achieving substantially lower chunk recovery rates than state-of-the-art baselines while imposing negligible impact on task performance and inference latency. Moreover, as a plug-and-play solution, CanaryRAG can be seamlessly integrated into arbitrary RAG pipelines without requiring retraining or structural modifications, offering a practical and scalable safeguard for proprietary data.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过结合外部知识来提升大语言模型的性能，但同时也存在严重的安全漏洞：RAG知识库泄露。恶意攻击者可以通过特定的提示诱导模型泄露专有内容。研究表明，这种泄露可以通过自适应和迭代的攻击策略来实现，而有效的防御措施却仍然十分缺乏。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了CanaryRAG——一种基于软件安全中“堆栈警戒标志”原理的运行时防御机制。CanaryRAG在检索到的数据块中嵌入精心设计的“警戒标志”，并将RAG提取防御机制转化为一种双路径的运行时完整性博弈。当目标路径或预言机路径违反其预期的警戒行为时，即可实时检测到泄露现象，即使是在自适应压制和混淆环境下也是如此。针对现有攻击的广泛测试表明，CanaryRAG能够提供强大的防御能力，其数据块恢复率远低于现有的最佳基线方案，同时几乎不会对任务性能和推理延迟产生负面影响。此外，作为一种即插即用的解决方案，CanaryRAG可以无缝集成到任何RAG流程中，无需重新训练或进行结构上的修改，为专有数据的保护提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。
