papers.title: Beyond Monolingual Assumptions: A Survey on Code-Switched NLP in the Era of Large Language Models across Modalities
papers.title_zh: 超越单一语言假设：在大型语言模型时代，关于多模态混合自然语言处理的研究综述
papers.authors: Rajvee Sheth, Samridhi Raj Sinha, Mahavir Patil, Himanshu Beniwal, Mayank Singh
papers.abstract: Amidst the rapid advances of large language models (LLMs), most LLMs still struggle with mixed-language inputs, limited Code-switching (CSW) datasets, and evaluation biases, which hinder their deployment in multilingual societies. This survey provides the first comprehensive analysis of CSW-aware LLM research, reviewing 327 studies spanning five research areas, 15+ NLP tasks, 30+ datasets, and 80+ languages. We classify recent advances by architecture, training strategy, and evaluation methodology, outlining how LLMs have reshaped CSW modelling and what challenges persist. The paper concludes with a roadmap emphasizing the need for inclusive datasets, fair evaluation, and linguistically grounded models to achieve truly multilingual intelligence. A curated collection of all resources is maintained at https://github.com/lingo-iitgn/awesome-code-mixing/.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型快速发展的背景下，大多数模型仍然面临处理混合语言输入、有限的语码转换数据集以及评估偏差等问题，这些问题限制了它们在多语言社会中的应用。本综述首次对考虑语码转换的LLM研究进行了全面分析，共回顾了327项研究，涵盖了五个研究领域、15种以上自然语言处理任务、30多种数据集以及80多种语言。我们根据架构、训练策略和评估方法对最新进展进行了分类，并探讨了LLM如何重塑了语码转换建模方式，以及仍然存在哪些挑战。文章最后提出了发展路线图，强调需要拥有包容性的数据集、公平的评估方法以及基于语言的模型，以实现真正多语言智能。所有相关资源的集合可以在https://github.com/lingo-iitgn/awesome-code-mixing/获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Look Light, Think Heavy: What Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Can and Cannot Do
papers.title_zh: 轻视现实，重谋未来：多模态思维链推理能做什么，不能做什么
papers.authors: Zhuoran Jin, Kejian Zhu, Hongbang Yuan, Yupu Hao, Pengfei Cao, Yubo Chen, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has become a standard method for improving reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) by eliciting step-by-step thinking, but its effectiveness in multimodal tasks remains unclear. In this paper, we aim to systematically investigate the key question: What can multimodal Chain-of-Thought reasoning do, and where and why does it fall short? To this end, we evaluate 12 multimodal tasks across perception and reasoning categories using both 14 non-reasoning models and 8 reasoning models. Our analysis reveals several important findings: (1) CoT is not a free lunch and should be used selectively depending on the specific requirements of each task. For perception tasks, CoT can lead to undesirable side effects, such as reduced performance in visual grounding and object counting. In contrast, it proves effective for reasoning tasks involving mathematical, scientific, and multi-image reasoning; (2) Compared to original models, existing open-source multimodal reasoning models often yield only marginal overall improvements, possibly due to an overemphasis on mathematical reasoning at the expense of broader capabilities; (3) Visual reasoning remains a key bottleneck for current multimodal CoT, as models exhibit a Look Light, Think Heavy” pattern where verbal reflection rises and falls during reasoning, whereas visual reflection consistently diminishes. These findings suggest that while multimodal CoT handles verbal reflection relatively well, it lacks the ability to maintain deep visual introspection throughout the reasoning process.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链推理（CoT）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的一种标准方法，它通过引导逐步思考来提升模型的推理能力。不过，它在多模态任务中的效果仍不明确。在本文中，我们旨在系统地探讨一个关键问题：多模态思维链推理能做什么？又存在哪些不足，为何会出现这种不足？为此，我们评估了12个涉及感知和推理的多模态任务，使用了14种非推理模型和8种推理模型。我们的分析得出了几个重要结论：(1) 思维链推理并非万能，应根据每个任务的具体需求有选择地使用。对于感知任务而言，思维链推理可能会产生不良副作用，例如降低视觉定位和目标计数任务的性能。相比之下，它在涉及数学、科学和多图像推理的推理任务中表现较好；(2) 与原始模型相比，现有的开源多模态推理模型通常只能带来微小的整体改进，这可能是由于过度强调数学推理而牺牲了更广泛的推理能力；(3) 视觉推理仍然是当前多模态思维链推理的一个主要瓶颈，因为模型表现出“看轻视觉，重考虑语言”的模式，即推理过程中语言的反思会有所起伏，而视觉方面的反思则始终保持不变。这些发现表明，虽然多模态思维链推理在处理语言方面表现不错，但它缺乏在整个推理过程中进行深度视觉内省的能力。

papers.title: ARCQuant: Boosting NVFP4 Quantization with Augmented Residual Channels for LLMs
papers.title_zh: ARCQuant：通过增加残差通道来提升NVFP4的量化效果，从而改善大型语言模型的性能
papers.authors: Haoqian Meng, Yilun Luo, Yafei Zhao, Wenyuan Liu, Peng Zhang, Xindian Ma
papers.abstract: The emergence of fine-grained numerical formats like NVFP4 presents new opportunities for efficient Large Language Model (LLM) inference. However, it is difficult to adapt existing Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) strategies to these formats: rotation-based methods compromise fine-grained block isolation; smoothing techniques struggle with significant 4-bit quantization errors; and mixed-precision approaches often conflict with hardware constraints on unified-precision computation. To address these challenges, we propose ARCQuant, a framework that boosts NVFP4 performance via Augmented Residual Channels. Distinct from methods that compromise block isolation or hardware uniformity, ARCQuant maintains a strictly unified NVFP4 format by augmenting the activation matrix with quantized residual channels. This design integrates the error compensation process directly into the matrix reduction dimension, enabling the use of standard, highly optimized GEMM kernels with minimal overhead. Theoretical analysis confirms that the worst-case error bound of our dual-stage NVFP4 quantization is comparable to that of standard 8-bit formats such as MXFP8. Extensive experiments on LLaMA and Qwen models demonstrate that ARCQuant achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, comparable to full-precision baselines in perplexity and downstream tasks. Furthermore, deployment on RTX 5090 and RTX PRO 6000 GPUs confirms practical benefits, achieving up to 3× speedup over FP16. Our code is available at https://github.com/actypedef/ARCQuant.
papers.abstract_zh: 像NVFP4这样的细粒度数值格式的出现为高效的大语言模型推理带来了新的机会。然而，将现有的训练后量化策略适应这些格式是非常困难的：基于旋转的方法会破坏细粒度的块隔离；平滑技术在处理4位量化误差时存在困难；而混合精度方法往往与硬件对统一精度计算的限制相冲突。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ARCQuant框架，该框架通过增强残差通道来提高NVFP4的性能。与那些牺牲块隔离或硬件一致性的方法不同，ARCQuant通过增加量化残差通道来保持NVFP4格式的严格统一性。这种设计将误差补偿过程直接集成到矩阵降维中，使得可以使用标准、高度优化的GEMM内核，而带来的开销极小。理论分析表明，我们的双阶段NVFP4量化的最坏情况误差范围与标准8位格式如MXFP8相当。在LLaMA和Qwen模型上的广泛实验表明，ARCQuant达到了最先进的准确性，在困惑度和其他下游任务方面与全精度基线相当。此外，在RTX 5090和RTX PRO 6000 GPU上的部署也证明了其实际优势，其性能比FP16提升了3倍。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/actypedef/ARCQuant下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Revisiting Model Interpolation for Efficient Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 重新审视模型插值技术以实现高效推理
papers.authors: Taiqiang Wu, Runming Yang, Tao Liu, Jiahao Wang, Ngai Wong
papers.abstract: Model merging, typically on Instruct and Thinking models, has shown remarkable performance for efficient reasoning. In this paper, we systematically revisit the simplest merging method that interpolates two weights directly. Particularly, we observe that model interpolation follows a three-stage evolutionary paradigm with distinct behaviors on the reasoning trajectory. These dynamics provide a principled guide for navigating the performance-cost trade-off. Empirical results demonstrate that a strategically interpolated model surprisingly surpasses sophisticated model merging baselines on both efficiency and effectiveness. We further validate our findings with extensive ablation studies on model layers, modules, and decoding strategies. Ultimately, this work demystifies model interpolation and offers a practical framework for crafting models with precisely targeted reasoning capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型合并技术，尤其是在Instruct和Thinking模型上的应用，在高效推理方面表现出了显著的优势。在本文中，我们系统地重新审视了最简单的合并方法——即直接对两个模型的权重进行插值处理。我们发现，模型插值遵循一个三阶段的进化过程，并且在推理过程中表现出不同的行为模式。这些动态特性为如何平衡性能与成本提供了有效的指导。实证结果表明，通过策略性插值处理的模型在效率和效果上均优于复杂的模型合并基线方法。我们还通过对模型层、模块以及解码策略进行广泛的实验验证，进一步确认了我们的发现。总体而言，这项工作揭示了模型插值的原理，并为构建具有精确目标推理能力的模型提供了一个实用的框架。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MirageBackdoor: A Stealthy Attack that Induces Think-Well-Answer-Wrong Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MirageBackdoor：一种隐秘的攻击方式，能够诱使受害者产生“想得太多反而犯错”的错觉
papers.authors: Yizhe Zeng, Wei Zhang, Yunpeng Li, Juxin Xiao, Xiao Wang, Yuling Liu
papers.abstract: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become a standard paradigm for eliciting complex reasoning capabilities in Large Language Models, it inadvertently exposes a new attack surface for backdoor attacks. Existing CoT backdoor attacks typically manipulate the intermediate reasoning steps to steer the model toward incorrect answers. However, these corrupted reasoning traces are readily detected by prevalent process-monitoring defenses. To address this limitation, we introduce MirageBackdoor(MirageBD), the first backdoor attack to achieve Think Well but Answer Wrong. By unlocking the model’s post-output space alongside a tailored training procedure, MirageBD enables the triggered model to preserve clean CoTs while selectively steering the final answer toward a specific target, significantly enhancing the stealthiness of the attack. Experiments show that MirageBD generally achieves over 90% attack success rate across four datasets and five models with a poison ratio of only 5%. Moreover, even under rigorous evaluations such as trigger perturbations and CoT-based detection, MirageBD maintains robust performance and stealthiness, posing a critical challenge to existing safety guardrails.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然思维链提示已成为在大语言模型中激发复杂推理能力的标准方法，但它无意中暴露了一个新的后门攻击面。现有的思维链后门攻击通常通过操纵中间的推理步骤来引导模型得出错误的答案。然而，这些被篡改的推理路径很容易被现有的过程监控防御系统检测到。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了MirageBackdoor（MirageBD），这是首个能够实现“思考周到但回答错误”的后门攻击方式。通过解锁模型的输出后空间，并采用专门的训练程序，MirageBD使被触发后的模型能够保留清晰的思维链，同时选择性地将最终答案引向特定的目标，从而显著提升了攻击的隐蔽性。实验表明，MirageBD在四个数据集和五种模型上实现了超过90%的攻击成功率，且中毒率仅为5%。此外，即使在诸如触发扰动和基于思维链的检测等严格评估条件下，MirageBD仍然保持出色的性能和隐蔽性，对现有的安全防护措施构成了重大挑战。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MulVul: Retrieval-augmented Multi-Agent Code Vulnerability Detection via Cross-Model Prompt Evolution
papers.title_zh: MulVul：通过跨模型提示演化实现增强式多智能体代码漏洞检测的方法
papers.authors: Zihan Wu, Jie Xu, Yun Peng, Chun Yong Chong, Xiaohua Jia
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to automate real-world vulnerability detection due to two key limitations: the heterogeneity of vulnerability patterns undermines the effectiveness of a single unified model, and manual prompt engineering for massive weakness categories is unscalable.To address these challenges, we propose MulVul, a retrieval-augmented multi-agent framework designed for precise and broad-coverage vulnerability detection. MulVul adopts a coarse-to-fine strategy: a Router agent first predicts the top- coarse categories and then forwards the input to specialized Detector agents, which identify the exact vulnerability types. Both agents use evidence retrieved from vulnerability knowledge bases to mitigate hallucinations. Crucially, to automate the generation of specialized prompts, we design Cross-Model Prompt Evolution, a prompt optimization mechanism where a generator LLM iteratively refines candidate prompts while a distinct executor LLM validates their effectiveness. This decoupling mitigates the self-correction bias inherent in single-model optimization. Evaluated on 130 CWE types, MulVul achieves 34.79% Macro-F1, outperforming the best baseline by 41.5%. Ablation studies validate cross-model prompt evolution, which boosts performance by 51.6% over manual prompts by effectively handling diverse vulnerability patterns.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自动化现实世界中的漏洞检测方面存在两大主要限制：一是漏洞模式的多样性会削弱单一统一模型的有效性；二是为大量漏洞类别手动设计提示方案的做法难以实现扩展。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MulVul这一基于检索增强的多智能体框架，旨在实现精确且覆盖广泛的漏洞检测。MulVul采用从粗到细的策略：首先由路由器智能体预测出主要的粗略分类，然后将输入数据转发给专门的检测器智能体，后者负责识别具体的漏洞类型。这两个智能体都利用来自漏洞知识库的证据来减少幻觉现象。关键在于，为了实现专门提示的自动生成，我们设计了跨模型提示优化机制——该机制中，生成器语言模型不断改进候选提示，而执行器语言模型则负责验证这些提示的有效性。这种分离方式有效避免了单模型优化过程中出现的自我修正偏差。在针对130种常见软件错误类型的评估中，MulVul取得了34.79%的宏F1分数，比最佳基线方法高出41.5%。消融研究验证了跨模型提示优化的有效性，其性能比手动设计提示高出51.6%，因为能够更灵活地处理各种漏洞模式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LiGen: Active Lipid Generation via a Molecular Language Model
papers.title_zh: LiGen：通过分子语言模型实现活性脂质的生成
papers.authors: Ying Zhan, Xiuqi Tang, Yan Zhang, Xiao Tan, Dian Shen, Zhou Yu, Beilun Wang
papers.abstract: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) can deliver cargos to both tumor and immune cells, playing a crucial role in biomedicine. Traditional approaches rely on experimental screening and expert knowledge, which can be costly and time-consuming. Recent methods based on language models have accelerated this process using deep learning. Although these methods can retrieve molecules for fusion or rank candidates from existing libraries, they are still limited by the scope of known formulations. In this work, we propose a method, LiGen, to generate lipid molecules efficiently and actively, facilitating the discovery of high-performing LNP formulations. We first train a lipid-specific molecular language model, LiCore, to learn hidden representations of lipid molecules. We then explore the learned latent space to generate improved candidate formulations. This process is guided by a trained predictor, which evaluates delivery efficiency and provides directional signals. In reconstruction tasks, LiCore achieves nearly perfect reconstruction output with a low invalid ratio on both the LNP-Virtual900k and LNP-Exp12k datasets. The predictor consistently improves ranking-oriented metrics across multiple cell lines, with our method outperforming the best baselines by an average of 4.1%, 10.8%, and 8.1% in Top-50, Top-10, and Top-5 identification accuracy, respectively. Guided by the predictor, LiGen generates novel lipid candidates that achieve a 30.7% improvement over baseline methods on average, with some samples exceeding 50% improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 脂质纳米颗粒（LNPs）能够将货物输送至肿瘤细胞和免疫细胞，在生物医学领域发挥着至关重要的作用。传统的方法依赖于实验筛选和专家知识，这种方式可能成本高昂且耗时。而基于语言模型的最新方法则利用深度学习加速了这一过程。虽然这些方法能够检索出用于融合的分子或从现有库中选择候选分子，但它们仍然受到已知配方范围的限制。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种名为LiGen的方法，它能够高效且主动地生成脂质分子，从而有助于发现性能优异的LNP配方。我们首先训练一个专门针对脂质的分子语言模型LiCore，以学习脂质分子的隐藏表征。然后，我们探索所学习的潜在空间，以生成改进的候选配方。这一过程由经过训练的预测器来指导，该预测器可以评估递送效率并提供方向性信号。在重建任务中，LiCore在LNP-Virtual900k和LNP-Exp12k数据集上实现了近乎完美的重建效果，且无效率较低。该预测器在不同细胞系中始终能提升排名相关的指标，我们的方法在Top-50、Top-10和Top-5识别准确率方面分别比最佳基线方法高出4.1%、10.8%和8.1%。在预测器的指导下，LiGen生成的新型脂质候选分子平均比基线方法提升了30.7%，有些样本甚至提升了超过50%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Gained in Translation: Privileged Pairwise Judges Enhance Multilingual Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 在翻译中获得的优势： privileged的成对评判者能够提升多语言推理能力
papers.authors: Lintang Sutawika, Gokul Swamy, Steven Wu, Graham Neubig
papers.abstract: When asked a question in a language less seen in its training data, current reasoning large language models (RLMs) often exhibit dramatically lower performance than when asked the same question in English. In response, we introduce SP3F (Self-Play with Privileged Pairwise Feedback), a two-stage framework for enhancing multilingual reasoning without any data in the target language(s). First, we supervise fine-tune (SFT) on translated versions of English question-answer pairs to raise base model correctness. Second, we perform RL with feedback from a pairwise judge in a self-play fashion, with the judge receiving the English reference response as privileged information. Thus, even when none of the model’s responses are completely correct, the privileged pairwise judge can still tell which response is better. End-to-end, SP3F greatly improves base model performance, even outperforming fully post-trained models on multiple math and non-math tasks with less than 1/8 of the training data across the single-language, multilingual, and generalization to unseen language settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 当被问到一些在训练数据中较少出现的语言问题时，当前的推理大语言模型在回答这些问题的表现往往比用英语提问时要差得多。为此，我们提出了SP3F（带有特权成对反馈的自玩方法），这是一种两阶段框架，可以在无需任何目标语言数据的情况下提升多语言推理能力。首先，我们对英文问题-答案对进行翻译后的微调，以提高基础模型的准确性。其次，我们采用自玩方式，让评委根据英文参考答案作为特权信息来进行强化学习。这样一来，即使模型的所有回答都不完全正确，特权成对评委仍然能够判断出哪个回答更优。总体而言，SP3F显著提升了基础模型的性能，甚至在仅使用不到1/8的训练数据的单语言、多语言以及泛化到未见语言任务中，其表现都优于完全经过训练后的模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Ted-Tok: Maintaining an Evolving Vocabulary for Lifelong Learning
papers.title_zh: 泰德-托克：为终身学习保持不断更新的词汇库
papers.authors: Jiameng Huang, Zhi Zhang, Zhenyu He, Jiacheng Sun, Di He
papers.abstract: Lifelong learning investigates how models adapt when exposed to a potentially infinite stream of data. Most conventional approaches focus on updating model parameters (i.e., the neural network weights) as the underlying data distribution evolves over time. However, in natural language processing, model parameters are not the only components that matter. The tokenizer, a foundational part of the system, is usually assumed to remain fixed in lifelong learning scenarios. In this work, we challenge the validity of this assumption: as language evolves, a static tokenizer fragments newly emerging lexical items, reducing compression efficiency and consequently degrading the model performance. We introduce the Temporal Drift Tokenizer (Ted-Tok), which maintains an evolving vocabulary that adapts to emerging linguistic patterns over time. This adaptivity is driven by time-weighted frequency estimators that smooth short-term fluctuations to capture persistent linguistic trends, and a principled addition-deletion strategy targeting sink tokens. Across multiple domains, Ted-Tok consistently improves compression and task performance, with gains increasing under stronger drift, underscoring the role of tokenizer adaptivity in lifelong learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 终身学习研究的是，当模型面临可能无限多的数据流时，模型如何进行调整。大多数传统方法都是随着底层数据分布的变化来更新模型参数（即神经网络的权重）。然而，在自然语言处理中，模型参数并不是唯一重要的因素。作为系统的基础组成部分，分词器通常被认为在终身学习场景中保持不变。在这项研究中，我们挑战了这一假设的有效性：随着语言的发展，静态的分词器会无法正确识别新出现的词汇，从而降低压缩效率，进而损害模型的性能。我们提出了时间漂移分词器（Ted-Tok），它能够维护一个不断变化的词汇表，从而适应不断演变的语言模式。这种适应性是通过时间加权频率估计器来实现的，该估计器能够平滑短期波动，从而捕捉持久性的语言趋势；同时，它还采用了一种针对特定词汇的添加和删除策略。在多个领域进行实验后，我们发现Ted-Tok在压缩效率和任务性能方面都有显著提升，尤其是在语言变化较为剧烈的情况下，这一效果更为明显。这充分证明了分词器的适应性在终身学习中的重要性。

papers.title: When Correct Beliefs Collapse: Epistemic Resilience of LLMs under Clinical Pressure
papers.title_zh: 当正确的信念崩塌时：在压力环境下大语言模型的认知韧性
papers.authors: Boyu Xiao, Xiuqi Tian, Xuwen Song, Haochun Wang, Guanchun Song, Sendong Zhao, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Despite strong medical benchmark accuracy, LLMs can exhibit severe multi-turn sycophancy in clinical dialogue, abandoning initial correct diagnosis under escalating pressure. We propose Med-Stress, a targeted stress test framework that evaluates belief stability under escalating pressure. Across nine frontier large language models (LLMs), we find a clear dissociation between medical knowledge and robustness: high initial diagnostic capability does not imply high belief stability, yielding large knowledge-robustness gaps for several LLMs. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a lightweight inference-time defense, RBED (Role-Based Epistemic Defense), and R-FT (Resilience-oriented Fine-Tuning), a training-time approach that internalizes evidence-based resistance to pressure. Experiments show that R-FT nearly eliminates belief change and substantially improves robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在医学领域的诊断准确性很高，但在临床对话中却会出现严重的多轮哄骗行为，在压力不断增大的情况下，它们会放弃最初正确的诊断。我们提出了Med-Stress这一针对压力测试的框架，用于评估模型在压力增大情况下的信念稳定性。通过对九种前沿大语言模型进行测试，我们发现医学知识与模型鲁棒性之间存在明显的脱节：初始的诊断能力越强，信念稳定性反而越低，导致许多模型在知识鲁棒性方面存在较大差距。为了缓解这种缺陷，我们提出了一种轻量级的推理时间防御机制——RBED（基于角色的信念防御）以及R-FT（以韧性为导向的微调），这是一种训练时间上的方法，能够内在化对压力的抵抗能力。实验表明，R-FT几乎消除了信念的变化，并显著提升了模型的鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Transcripts: A Renewed Perspective on Audio Chaptering
papers.title_zh: 超越文本记录：对音频章节功能的全新解读
papers.authors: Fabian Retkowski, Maike Züfle, Thai Binh Nguyen, Jan Niehues, Alexander Waibel
papers.abstract: Audio chaptering, the task of automatically segmenting long-form audio into coherent sections, is increasingly important for navigating podcasts, lectures, and videos. Despite its relevance, research remains limited and text-based, leaving key questions unresolved about leveraging audio information, handling ASR errors, and transcript-free evaluation. We address these gaps through three contributions: (1) a systematic comparison between text-based models with acoustic features, a novel audio-only architecture (AudioSeg) operating on learned audio representations, and multimodal LLMs; (2) empirical analysis of factors affecting performance, including transcript quality, acoustic features, duration, and speaker composition; and (3) formalized evaluation protocols contrasting transcript-dependent text-space protocols with transcript-invariant time-space protocols. Our experiments on YTSeg reveal that AudioSeg substantially outperforms text-based approaches, pauses provide the largest acoustic gains, and current MLLMs struggle due to context limitations and weak instruction following.
papers.abstract_zh: 音频分段技术，即自动将长音频分割成连贯段落的功能，对于浏览播客、讲座和视频来说越来越重要。尽管这一技术具有实用性，但相关研究仍然较为有限，且主要集中在文本层面。因此，关于如何利用音频信息、处理自动语音识别的错误以及进行无需文本记录的评估等方面的问题仍未得到解决。我们通过三项研究来填补这些空白：(1)对基于文本模型的声学特征处理方法、一种全新的仅基于音频的架构——AudioSeg（该架构基于学习到的音频表示进行分段），以及多模态大语言模型进行了系统性的比较；(2)对影响性能的各种因素进行了实证分析，包括文本记录的质量、声学特征、音频片段的时长以及演讲者的构成等；(3)制定了正式的评估方案，以对比依赖文本记录的文本空间方法和不依赖文本记录的时间空间方法。我们在YTSeg项目上的实验表明，AudioSeg在性能上明显优于基于文本的方法。音频中的暂停部分能够带来最大的声学效果提升，而当前的多模态大语言模型则因上下文限制和较弱的指令遵循能力而表现不佳。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SEA-BED: How Do Embedding Models Represent Southeast Asian Languages?
papers.title_zh: 海滩：嵌入模型是如何表示东南亚语言的？
papers.authors: Wuttikorn Ponwitayarat, Peerat Limkonchotiwat, Raymond Ng, Jann Railey Montalan, Thura Aung, Jian Gang Ngui, Yosephine Susanto, William Chandra Tjhi, Panuthep Tasawong, Erik Cambria, Ekapol Chuangsuwanich, Sarana Nutanong
papers.abstract: Multilingual text embeddings are often assumed to encode meaning in a perspective-independent semantic space, yielding stable similarity judgments across tasks and languages. Our results show that this assumption does not hold in practice. We introduce SEA-BED, a large-scale benchmark covering 10 Southeast Asian (SEA) languages and diverse embedding tasks, designed to systematically examine how embedding performance varies across tasks, languages, and language-task combinations. Across extensive evaluations, we observe that no single model performs uniformly well across SEA languages; task difficulty differs markedly within languages, and success on one task does not reliably generalize to others. Language-task analyses further reveal highly non-uniform performance landscapes, where performance varies across different language-task combinations. These findings call for closer attention to performance measurements that provide an expansive view across languages and tasks to uncover inconsistencies in semantic representation. Based on these observations, we provide insights for future model development, including data, algorithmic, and architectural considerations.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言文本嵌入通常被认为能够在与任务无关的语义空间中编码意义，从而在不同任务和语言之间产生稳定的相似性判断。然而，我们的研究结果表明这一假设在实践中并不成立。我们提出了SEA-BED这一大规模基准测试，该测试涵盖了10种东南亚语言以及多种嵌入任务，旨在系统地研究嵌入性能在不同任务、语言以及语言-任务组合中的变化情况。通过广泛的评估，我们发现没有任何一个模型能够在所有东南亚语言中表现出一致的良好性能；不同语言内部的任务难度存在显著差异，某一项任务的成功并不能可靠地推广到其他任务上。语言-任务分析进一步揭示了高度非均匀的性能表现情况，即性能在不同的语言-任务组合中会有差异。这些发现提醒我们，需要更加关注那些能够涵盖多种语言和任务的性能度量方法，以揭示语义表示中的不一致性。基于这些观察结果，我们为未来的模型开发提供了一些见解，包括数据、算法和架构方面的考虑。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Is this chart lying to me? Automating the detection of misleading visualizations
papers.title_zh: 这个图表是在欺骗我吗？难道这种自动检测误导性可视化内容的方法其实是有问题的？
papers.authors: Jonathan Tonglet, Jan Zimny, Tinne Tuytelaars, Iryna Gurevych
papers.abstract: Misleading visualizations are a potent driver of misinformation on social media and the web. By violating chart design principles, they distort data and lead readers to draw inaccurate conclusions. Prior work has shown that both humans and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are frequently deceived by such visualizations. Automatically detecting misleading visualizations and identifying the specific design rules they violate could help protect readers and reduce the spread of misinformation. However, the training and evaluation of AI models has been limited by the absence of large, diverse, and openly available datasets. In this work, we introduce Misviz, a benchmark of 2,604 real-world visualizations annotated with 12 types of misleaders. To support model training, we also release Misviz-synth, a synthetic dataset of 81,814 visualizations generated using Matplotlib and based on real-world data tables. We perform a comprehensive evaluation on both datasets using state-of-the-art MLLMs, rule-based systems, and fine-tuned classifiers. Our results reveal that the task remains highly challenging. We release Misviz, Misviz-synth, and the accompanying code.
papers.abstract_zh: 误导性的可视化图是社交媒体和互联网上错误信息的重要传播源。通过违反图表设计原则，这些可视化图会扭曲数据，导致读者得出错误的结论。先前的研究表明，人类和多模态大语言模型都经常被这类可视化图所欺骗。自动检测误导性可视化图并识别它们违反的具体设计规则，有助于保护读者免受错误信息的侵害，同时减少错误信息的传播。然而，由于缺乏大量、多样化且公开可用的数据集，AI模型的训练和评估一直受到限制。在这项研究中，我们引入了Misviz这一基准数据集，该数据集包含2,604个真实世界的可视化图，其中包含了12种误导性的元素。为了支持模型训练，我们还发布了Misviz-synth这一合成数据集，该数据集由81,814个使用Matplotlib生成的可视化图组成，这些图基于真实世界的数据表。我们对这两个数据集进行了全面的评估，使用了最先进的MLLMs、基于规则的系统和经过微调的分类器。我们的评估结果表明，这项任务仍然具有很高的挑战性。我们现在发布了Misviz、Misviz-synth以及相关的代码。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Laboratory to Real-World Applications: Benchmarking Agentic Code Reasoning at the Repository Level
papers.title_zh: 从实验室到实际应用：在存储库层面对智能代码推理进行基准测试
papers.authors: Jia Li, Yuxin Su, Michael R. Lyu
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, evaluating repository-level reasoning, the ability to maintain logical consistency across massive, real-world, interdependent file systems, has become critical. Current benchmarks typically fluctuate between isolated code snippets and black-box evaluations. We present RepoReason, a white-box diagnostic benchmark centered on abductive assertion verification. To eliminate memorization while preserving authentic logical depth, we implement an execution-driven mutation framework that utilizes the environment as a semantic oracle to regenerate ground-truth states. Furthermore, we establish a fine-grained diagnostic system using dynamic program slicing, quantifying reasoning via three orthogonal metrics: ESV (reading load), MCL (simulation depth), and DFI (integration width). Comprehensive evaluations of frontier models (e.g., Claude-4.5-Sonnet, DeepSeek-v3.1-Terminus) reveal a prevalent aggregation deficit, where integration width serves as the primary cognitive bottleneck. Our findings provide granular white-box insights for optimizing the next generation of agentic software engineering.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型发展为自主智能体，评估仓库级别的推理能力以及维持大规模、相互依赖的文件系统中的逻辑一致性变得至关重要。目前的评估标准通常介于孤立代码片段的测试与黑盒评估之间。我们提出了RepoReason这一基于演绎性断言验证的白盒诊断基准测试。为了在不牺牲真实逻辑深度的前提下消除记忆机制的影响，我们采用了一种以环境作为语义预言机的执行驱动变异框架，从而重新生成真实状态。此外，我们还构建了一个基于动态程序切片技术的细粒度诊断系统，通过三个正交指标来量化推理过程：ESV（读取负载）、MCL（模拟深度）和DFI（集成宽度）。对前沿模型（如Claude-4.5-Sonnet、DeepSeek-v3.1-Terminus）进行的全面评估显示，普遍存在聚合能力不足的问题，其中集成宽度是主要的认知瓶颈。我们的研究发现为优化下一代智能体软件工程提供了精细的白盒级洞察。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Privacy Collapse: Benign Fine-Tuning Can Break Contextual Privacy in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 隐私的崩溃：简单的微调就能破坏语言模型中的上下文隐私保护
papers.authors: Anmol Goel, Cornelius Emde, Seong Joon Oh, Sangdoo Yun, Martin Gubri
papers.abstract: We identify a novel phenomenon in language models: benign fine-tuning of frontier models can lead to privacy collapse. We find that diverse, subtle patterns in training data can degrade contextual privacy, including optimisation for helpfulness, exposure to user information, emotional and subjective dialogue, and debugging code printing internal variables, among others. Finetuned models lose their ability to reason about contextual privacy norms, share information inappropriately with tools, and violate memory boundaries across contexts. Privacy collapse is a “silent failure” because models maintain high performance on standard safety and utility benchmarks whilst exhibiting severe privacy vulnerabilities. Our experiments show evidence of privacy collapse across six models (closed and open weight), five fine-tuning datasets (real-world and controlled data), and two task categories (agentic and memory-based). Our mechanistic analysis reveals that privacy representations are uniquely fragile to fine-tuning, compared to task-relevant features which are preserved. Our results reveal a critical gap in current safety evaluations, in particular for the deployment of specialised agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们在语言模型中发现了一个新的现象：对前沿模型进行温和的微调可能会导致隐私泄露。我们发现，训练数据中的各种微妙模式会破坏上下文隐私性，包括优化模型对有用性的追求、暴露用户信息、处理情感性和主观性对话，以及调试代码时打印内部变量等。经过微调的模型无法正确判断上下文隐私规范，会不恰当地与工具共享信息，并且会在不同上下文之间违反内存边界。隐私泄露是一种“无声的失败”，因为这些模型在标准的安全性和实用性基准测试中仍能保持高性能，但却存在严重的隐私漏洞。我们的实验表明，六种模型（封闭权重和开放权重）、五个微调数据集（真实世界数据和受控数据）以及两个任务类别（基于代理的任务和基于记忆的任务）都存在隐私泄露的情况。我们的机制分析表明，与任务相关的特征相比，隐私表示更容易受到微调的影响而变得脆弱。我们的研究结果揭示了当前安全性评估中的一个关键缺陷，尤其是在专门化代理的部署过程中。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Dissecting Failure Dynamics in Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型推理中故障机制的剖析
papers.authors: Wei Zhu, Jian Zhang, Lixing Yu, Kun Yue, Zhiwen Tang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance through extended inference-time deliberation, yet how their reasoning failures arise remains poorly understood. By analyzing model-generated reasoning trajectories, we find that errors are not uniformly distributed but often originate from a small number of early transition points, after which reasoning remains locally coherent but globally incorrect. These transitions coincide with localized spikes in token-level entropy, and alternative continuations from the same intermediate state can still lead to correct solutions. Based on these observations, we introduce GUARD, a targeted inference-time framework that probes and redirects critical transitions using uncertainty signals. Empirical evaluations across multiple benchmarks confirm that interventions guided by these failure dynamics lead to more reliable reasoning outcomes. Our findings highlight the importance of understanding when and how reasoning first deviates, complementing existing approaches that focus on scaling inference-time computation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过延长推理时间来实现强大的性能表现，然而其推理错误的产生机制仍然不清楚。通过分析模型生成的推理轨迹，我们发现错误并非均匀分布，而是往往起源于少数几个早期转换点。在这些点之后，推理在局部上仍然是一致的，但在整体上却是错误的。这些转换点与令牌级熵的局部峰值相吻合，而来自同一中间状态的替代路径仍可能得到正确的解决方案。基于这些观察，我们提出了GUARD这一有针对性的推理时间框架，该框架利用不确定性信号来探测并重新引导关键转换过程。在多个基准测试中的实证评估表明，基于这些错误动态进行的干预能够带来更可靠的推理结果。我们的发现强调了理解推理何时以及如何首次偏离的重要性，这补充了那些专注于扩展推理时间计算规模的方法论。

papers.title: QBridge: Bridging Natural Language and SQL via Gold Query Rewriting with Agentic Refinement
papers.title_zh: QBridge：通过智能重构技术实现自然语言与SQL之间的桥梁连接
papers.authors: Zhensheng Luo, Sai Wu, Yuan Qiu, Chang Yao, Gang Chen, Xiu Tang
papers.abstract: Natural language to SQL (NL2SQL) provides an intuitive interface for querying structured data, yet real user questions are often noisy, ambiguous, and weakly grounded to database semantics.As a result, token-level schema linking and single-pass SQL decoding can be brittle: small misunderstandings in language or schema grounding may propagate into incorrect generation.We present QBridge, an agentic, feedback-driven NL2SQL framework based on a Refined Gold Query Paradigm, which bridges natural language and SQL via Gold Query—a structured, SQL-aligned intermediate representation.A core insight of QBridge is Distilled Back-Translation (DBT) for SL-independent rewriting.DBT converts SQL-grounded supervision into execution-verified Gold-Query-style rewrites from a teacher model, and distills a lightweight, plug-and-play rewriter that generates schema-aware rewrites without requiring explicit schema linking at inference.QBridge then (i) verifies and conservatively refines the rewrite into a high-fidelity Refined Gold Query, and (ii) refines the generated SQL with dual feedback from execution validity and semantic consistency, enabling interpretable self-correction while remaining compatible with diverse SQL backbones.Extensive experiments on Spider, BIRD, and three robustness variants demonstrate that QBridge consistently improves zero-shot NL2SQL, outperforming strong prompting and agentic baselines while showing strong robustness and generalization. Code and data are available at https://github.com/WannaBSteve/QBridge.
papers.abstract_zh: 自然语言到SQL转换（NL2SQL）提供了一个用于查询结构化数据的直观接口。然而，真实用户的问题往往具有噪声性、模糊性，且对数据库语义的理解不够深入。因此，在词元级别进行模式链接以及一次性解码SQL可能会遇到问题：语言或模式理解上的小错误可能会引发错误的SQL生成。我们提出了QBridge，这是一个基于精细黄金查询范式的、以智能反馈为驱动的NL2SQL框架。该框架通过黄金查询这一结构化的、与SQL兼容的中间表示，将自然语言与SQL连接起来。QBridge的核心技术之一是蒸馏回译（DBT），它能够实现与语言无关的重写。DBT可以将从教师模型中得到的、基于SQL的约束条件转换为符合执行规则的黄金查询式重写，同时生成一个轻量级的、即插即用的重写器，该重写器能够在推理过程中生成考虑模式的重写语句，而无需显式的模式链接。随后，QBridge会（1）验证并保守地优化重写结果，将其转化为高保真度的精细黄金查询；（2）通过执行有效性和语义一致性的双重反馈来优化生成的SQL，从而实现可解释的自我修正功能，同时保持与多种SQL基础结构的兼容性。在Spider、BIRD以及三个鲁棒性变体上的广泛实验表明，QBridge在零样本NL2SQL任务中表现出持续的改进效果，其性能优于那些使用强提示和智能代理基线的方法，同时展现了强大的鲁棒性和泛化能力。相关代码和数据可以在https://github.com/WannaBSteve/QBridge下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SCVQ: Sparse-Compensated Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SCVQ：一种适用于大型语言模型的稀疏补偿向量量化方法
papers.authors: Zixuan Zhou, Yujun Diao, Zicheng Kong, Dehua Ma, Zhenbo Xu, Pei Pei Li, Zhaofeng He
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are primarily constrained by memory and bandwidth bottlenecks during deployment. Although Vector Quantization (VQ) has emerged as a promising solution, existing methods incur inference overhead due to massive codebook storage and intensive index lookups. Moreover, these methods typically suffer from non-negligible performance degradation under ultra-low bitwidth regimes. To bridge this gap, we propose Sparse-Compensated Vector Quantization (SCVQ), a novel framework designed for high-efficiency LLM vector quantization. SCVQ introduces a salience-aware weighted K-means clustering scheme with symmetry constraints to reduces codebook size and indexing costs. Central to our approach is a unified structured representation that consolidates outliers, salient weights, and quantization residuals into a single sparse compensation matrix. This design effectively preserves critical model information while leveraging VQ-specific properties to enable efficient custom kernels. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate SCVQ’s superior performance. Specifically, SCVQ achieves a perplexity of 5.78 on WikiText-2 for LLaMA-2-7B at 2-bit quantization, while delivering a 1.4\times end-to-end inference speedup over existing baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在部署过程中主要受到内存和带宽瓶颈的限制。虽然向量量化作为一种有前景的解决方案已经出现，但现有方法由于需要存储大量的代码本数据以及进行频繁的索引查找，从而带来了推理开销。此外，这些方法在极低比特率的情况下通常会出现不可忽略的性能下降问题。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了稀疏补偿向量量化技术——SCVQ。这是一种旨在实现高效LLM向量量化的新型框架。SCVQ采用了一种注重显著性的加权K均值聚类方案，并加入了对称性约束，从而减少了代码本的大小和索引成本。我们的核心思想是一种统一的结构化表示方式，它将异常值、显著权重以及量化残差整合到一个单一的稀疏补偿矩阵中。这种设计有效地保留了模型的关键信息，同时利用向量量化的特性来构建高效的自定义内核。通过多个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，SCVQ具有卓越的性能表现。具体来说，在2位量化的情况下，SCVQ在WikiText-2数据集上实现了5.78的困惑度指标，而相对于现有的基线方法，其端到端推理速度提升了1.4倍。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Shanks: Simultaneous Hearing and Thinking for Spoken Language Models
papers.title_zh: 香克斯：语音模型同时处理听觉和思维功能
papers.authors: Cheng-Han Chiang, Xiaofei Wang, Linjie Li, Chung-Ching Lin, Kevin Lin, Shujie Liu, Zhendong Wang, Zhengyuan Yang, Hung-yi Lee, Lijuan Wang
papers.abstract: Current large language models (LLMs) and spoken language models (SLMs) begin thinking and taking actions only after the user has finished their turn. This prevents the model from interacting with the user during the user’s turn and can lead to high response latency when the model is thinking. To address this issue, we draw inspiration from the “think while listening” behavior of humans. In this paper, we propose SHANKS, a general inference framework that enables SLMs to generate unspoken chain-of-thought reasoning while listening to user input. SHANKS streams input speech in fixed-duration chunks and, as soon as a chunk is received, generates unspoken reasoning based on all previous speech and reasoning, while the user continues speaking. SHANKS uses unspoken reasoning to determine whether to interrupt the user and make tool calls to complete the task. We demonstrate that SHANKS enhances real-time user–SLM interaction in two scenarios: (1) SHANKS can listen to the user’s speech and interrupt when the user makes a mistake. (2) In a tool-augmented dialogue scenario, SHANKS can complete 56.9% of the tool calls before the user ends their turn. Overall, SHANKS is a step toward models that keep thinking throughout the conversation, not only after a turn ends. Demos can be found on the project page: https://d223302.github.io/SHANKS/.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的大语言模型以及口语模型在用户完成发言后才会开始思考并采取行动。这导致模型在用户发言期间无法与用户进行互动，从而在模型思考时会产生较高的响应延迟。为了解决这一问题，我们借鉴了人类“边听边思考”的行为方式。在本文中，我们提出了SHANKS这一通用推理框架，该框架使口语模型能够在听取用户输入的同时生成未言明的思维链推理内容。SHANKS将输入的语音以固定时长的小块形式进行处理，一旦接收到某个小块，就会基于之前的所有语音和推理内容生成未言明的推理结果，而用户则继续发言。SHANKS利用这些未言明的推理来判断是否中断用户的发言并调用工具来完成任务。我们通过两个场景证明了SHANKS能够提升实时用户与口语模型的互动效果：(1) SHANKS可以聆听用户的发言，并在用户犯错时打断其发言；(2) 在工具辅助的对话场景中，SHANKS能够在用户结束发言之前完成56.9%的工具调用任务。总体而言，SHANKS是朝着让模型在整个对话过程中持续思考的方向迈出的一步，而不仅仅是在发言结束后才进行思考。相关演示可以在项目页面找到：https://d223302.github.io/SHANKS/

papers.title: Efficient KL Divergence Estimation via Truncated Top-K Integration for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 通过截断Top-K积分方法高效估算大型语言模型的KL散度
papers.authors: Xinyuan Wang, Luozhijie Jin, Bo Wang, Yuan Li, Zhangyue Yin, Xipeng Qiu
papers.abstract: Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence regularization is essential for stabilizing reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) in large language models (LLMs), yet its exact computation requires summing over vocabularies of all tokens, incurring prohibitive memory costs during training. Existing stochastic estimators circumvent this bottleneck by estimating KL divergence using only the sampled token from the trajectory, but suffer from high variance (k_1) or systematic bias (k_2). We propose TIKE (Top-k Importance-weighted KL Estimator), which exploits the Zipfian structure of language model distributions: by deterministically integrating over only the top-k tokens, TIKE captures most of the probability mass while effectively reducing memory cost. To ensure correctness in off-policy settings characteristic of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), we incorporate importance sampling weights that correct for distribution shift between rollout and optimization policies. Experiments on models across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that TIKE consistently outperforms stochastic baselines, while exhibiting substantially lower gradient variance. Our analysis reveals that TIKE closely tracks the exact Rao-Blackwellized estimator with near-zero variance, offering a practical path toward stable, memory-efficient KL regularization for reasoning-intensive LLMs training.
papers.abstract_zh: Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度正则化对于稳定大语言模型中的人类反馈强化学习至关重要，但其精确计算需要对所有令牌的词汇表进行求和，这在训练过程中会导致过高的内存消耗。现有的随机估计方法通过仅使用轨迹中采样的令牌来估计KL散度，从而避免了这一瓶颈问题，但这种方法存在高方差（k_1）或系统性偏差（k_2）的问题。我们提出了TIKE（Top-k重要性加权KL估计器），它利用了语言模型分布的Zipf结构：通过确定性地仅对排名前k的令牌进行积分，TIKE能够捕获大部分概率质量，同时有效降低内存消耗。为了确保在非策略性设置下的正确性，符合Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）的特点，我们采用了重要性采样权重，以纠正部署策略与优化策略之间的分布偏移问题。在多种基准测试模型上的实验表明，TIKE始终优于随机基线方法，同时其梯度方差也显著降低。我们的分析显示，TIKE与精确的Rao-Blackwellized估计器非常接近，其方差几乎为零，为稳定且节省内存的KL正则化提供了实际可行的途径，适用于需要大量推理的大语言模型训练。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Visual Attention Reasoning via Hierarchical Search and Self-Verification
papers.title_zh: 通过分层搜索与自我验证实现视觉注意力推理
papers.authors: Wei Cai, Jian Zhao, Yuchen Yuan, Tianle Zhang, Ming Zhu, Haichuan Tang, Xuelong Li
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) frequently hallucinate due to their reliance on fragile, linear reasoning and weak visual grounding. We propose Visual Attention Reasoning (VAR), a reinforcement learning framework that reformulates reasoning as a hierarchical search with self-verification. VAR enforces traceable evidence grounding by generating explicit bounding boxes, guided by a novel reward function combining geometric precision and semantic sufficiency. Furthermore, it replaces linear Chain-of-Thought with a tree-search policy capable of backtracking to correct logical errors. Theoretical analysis validates the framework’s reliability, and extensive experiments demonstrate that VAR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on complex hallucination and safety benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型由于依赖脆弱的线性推理和薄弱的视觉定位能力，常常出现幻觉现象。我们提出了视觉注意力推理框架——VAR。该框架将推理过程重新定义为一种具有自我验证功能的分层搜索机制。VAR通过生成明确的边界框来实现可追踪的证据定位，同时采用一种新的奖励函数，结合了几何精确性和语义充分性。此外，该框架用树形搜索策略取代了线性思维链，能够回溯以纠正逻辑错误。理论分析验证了该框架的可靠性，而大量实验表明，VAR在复杂的幻觉处理和安全评估方面显著优于现有方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VFA: Empowering Multilingual MLLMs via Vision-Free Adaptation
papers.title_zh: VFA：通过无需视觉的适应性改造，助力多语言机器学习模型的发展
papers.authors: Yixia Li, Yaqing Shi, Zhiwen Ruan, Dongdong Zhang, Lingjie Jiang, Shaohan Huang, Yun Chen, Guanhua Chen, Furu Wei
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models have advanced rapidly, yet most remain English-centric, as scaling multilingual multimodal instruction tuning is limited by the scarcity and high cost of high-quality non-English image–text supervision. Although multilingual text data is abundant, naive textual fine-tuning can disrupt vision–language alignment and induce catastrophic forgetting. We propose Vision-Free Adaptation (VFA), a framework that decouples multilingual language enhancement from visual alignment by composing complementary task vectors over a shared LLM backbone. Specifically, we fine-tune a base LLM on multilingual text data to derive a multilingual task vector, which is then merged with the vision-aligned task vector of an MLLM. Experiments on five MLLMs across six multilingual multimodal benchmarks show consistent improvements while preserving both general multimodal and text-only capabilities. Moreover, VFA attains competitive performance with a fully multimodally trained model using less than 2% of the text data, demonstrating its efficiency and effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型已经取得了迅速的发展，但大多数仍然以英语为中心。因为，实现多语言、多模态的指令调整面临着资源匮乏和成本高昂的问题——高质量的非英语图像-文本监督数据非常稀缺。虽然多语言文本数据丰富，但简单的文本微调可能会破坏视觉与语言的匹配关系，甚至导致严重的遗忘问题。我们提出了“无视觉适应”框架（Vision-Free Adaptation，VFA），该框架通过将多语言语言增强任务与视觉对齐任务分离开来，利用共享的LLM主干网络来构建互补的任务向量。具体来说，我们首先在多语言文本数据上对基础LLM进行微调，以获得多语言任务向量；然后将该向量与MLLM的视觉对齐任务向量进行合并。在六个多语言多模态基准测试中的五个MLLM上的实验表明，该框架能够持续改善性能，同时保留多模态能力和仅基于文本的能力。此外，VFA在使用不到2%的文本数据的情况下，就能获得与完全多模态训练模型相当的性能，这充分体现了其高效性和有效性。

papers.title: LearnerCoMPASS: Intelligent Tutoring System with Dynamic Cognitive Diagnosis and Multi-Model Path Planning
papers.title_zh: LearnerCoMPASS：具有动态认知诊断和多模型路径规划功能的智能辅导系统
papers.authors: Ziji Sheng, Guiyao Tie, Weidong Wang, Pan Zhou, Daizong Liu
papers.abstract: Existing adaptive learning systems struggle to simultaneously achieve deep personalization, dynamic adaptability, and content trustworthiness, particularly in logically rigorous STEM fields where Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to “hallucination”. This paper introduces LearnerCoMPASS (Cognitive Multi-model Planning Adaptive System), an integrated, end-to-end framework for adaptive learning. At its core, the framework features a novel multi-model path planning algorithm that orchestrates and fuses the outputs of heterogeneous LLM experts to generate and optimize learning sequences. To enable deep personalization, we design a dynamic cognitive diagnosis module that employs an innovative encoder-decoder architecture to generate precise, multi-dimensional cognitive state vectors for learners. To ensure trustworthiness, the system leverages an adaptively constructed dynamic knowledge graph and a Graph-RAG mechanism to provide factual anchors and logical constraints for LLM reasoning, thereby mitigating hallucinations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LearnerCoMPASS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in generating high-quality personalized learning paths. Furthermore, ablation studies validate the critical contributions of our dynamic cognitive diagnosis and multi-model planning components.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的自适应学习系统在同时实现深度个性化、动态适应性和内容可信度方面存在困难，尤其是在逻辑严谨的STEM领域，大语言模型容易产生“幻觉”。本文介绍了LearnerCoMPASS（认知多模型规划自适应系统），这是一个集成的端到端自适应学习框架。该框架的核心是一个新颖的多模型路径规划算法，它能够协调并融合不同大语言模型的输出，以生成和优化学习序列。为了实现深度个性化，我们设计了一个动态的认知诊断模块，该模块采用创新的编码器-解码器架构，为学习者生成精确的多维认知状态向量。为了确保内容的可信性，该系统利用自适应构建的动态知识图谱和图式检索生成式问答机制，为大语言模型的推理提供事实依据和逻辑约束，从而减轻幻觉现象。大量实验表明，LearnerCoMPASS在生成高质量个性化学习路径方面显著优于现有的最佳基线方法。此外，消融研究验证了我们的动态认知诊断和多模型规划组件的重要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Investigating More Explainable and Partition-Free Compositionality Estimation for LLMs: A Rule-Generation Perspective
papers.title_zh: 探究更易于理解且无需划分即可实现的大型语言模型复合性估计方法：以规则生成为视角
papers.authors: Ziyao Xu, Cong Wang, Houfeng Wang
papers.abstract: Compositional generalization tests are often used to estimate the compositionality of LLMs. However, such tests have the following limitations: (1) they only focus on the output results without considering LLMs’ understanding of sample compositionality, resulting in explainability defects; (2) they rely on dataset partition to form the test set with combinations unseen in the training set, suffering from combination leakage issues. In this work, we propose a novel rule-generation perspective for compositionality estimation for LLMs. It requires LLMs to generate a program as rules for dataset mapping and provides estimates of the compositionality of LLMs using complexity-based theory. The perspective addresses the limitations of compositional generalization tests and provides a new way to analyze the compositionality characterization of LLMs. We conduct experiments and analysis of existing advanced LLMs based on this perspective on a string-to-grid task, and find various compositionality characterizations and compositionality deficiencies exhibited by LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 组合性泛化测试常被用来评估大语言模型的组合性。然而，这类测试存在以下局限性：(1) 它们仅关注输出结果，而忽略了大语言模型对样本组合性的理解，从而导致可解释性方面的缺陷；(2) 它们依赖数据集划分来构建测试集，这些测试集中的组合方式在训练集中并未出现，这就出现了组合泄露问题。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的规则生成方法来估计大语言模型的组合性。该方法要求大语言模型以规则的形式生成程序来进行数据集映射，并利用基于复杂性的理论来估算大语言模型的组合性。这种方法克服了组合性泛化测试的局限性，为分析大语言模型的组合性特征提供了一种新的途径。我们基于这一方法对现有的先进大语言模型进行了实验和分析，发现它们在字符串到网格任务中表现出不同的组合性特征以及存在的组合性缺陷。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LVLMs and Humans Ground Differently in Referential Communication
papers.title_zh: LVLM与人类在参照性交流方面的处理方式有所不同
papers.authors: Peter Zeng, Weiling Li, Amie J. Paige, Zhengxiang Wang, Panagiotis Kaliosis, Dimitris Samaras, Gregory Zelinsky, Susan E. Brennan, Owen Rambow
papers.abstract: For generative AI agents to partner effectively with human users, the ability to accurately predict human intent is critical. But this ability to collaborate remains limited by a critical deficit: an inability to model common ground. We present a referential communication experiment with a factorial design involving director-matcher pairs (human-human, human-AI, AI-human, and AI-AI) that interact with multiple turns in repeated rounds to match pictures of objects not associated with any obvious lexicalized labels. We show that LVLMs cannot interactively generate and resolve referring expressions in a way that enables smooth communication, a crucial skill that underlies human language use. We release our corpus of 356 dialogues (89 pairs over 4 rounds each) along with the online pipeline for data collection and the tools for analyzing accuracy, efficiency, and lexical overlap.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了让生成式AI代理能够与人类用户有效协作，准确预测人类意图的能力至关重要。然而，这种协作能力仍然受到一个关键缺陷的限制：无法模拟共同背景信息。我们开展了一项参照性交流实验，采用因子设计，涉及导演-匹配器对（人类-人类、人类-AI、AI-人类以及AI-AI），这些对会在多轮循环中互动，以匹配那些没有明显词汇标签的物体图片。我们发现，语言模型无法以能够实现顺畅交流的方式生成和解析指代性表达，而这是人类语言使用中的一项关键技能。我们提供了包含356段对话的数据集（每轮89对对话），同时提供了在线数据收集工具，以及用于分析准确性、效率及词汇重叠情况的工具。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evaluating the Expressive Appropriateness of Speech in Rich Contexts
papers.title_zh: 在丰富的语境中评估语音的表达恰当性
papers.authors: Tianrui Wang, Ziyang Ma, Yizhou Peng, Haoyu Wang, Zhikang Niu, Zikang Huang, Yihao Wu, Yi-Wen Chao, Yu Jiang, Yuheng Lu, Guanrou Yang, Xuanchen Li, Hexin Liu, Chunyu Qiang, Cheng Gong, Yifan Yang, Tianchi Liu, Junyu Wang, Nana Hou, Meng Ge, Fuming You, Yang Wei, Zhongqian Sun, Hu Haifeng, Xiaobao Wang, Eng Siong Chng, Xie Chen, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang
papers.abstract: Evaluating expressive speech remains challenging, as existing methods mainly assess emotional intensity and overlook whether a speech sample is expressively appropriate for its contextual setting. This limitation hinders reliable evaluation of speech systems used in narrative-driven and interactive applications, such as audiobooks and conversational agents. We introduce CEAEval, a Context-rich framework for Evaluating Expressive Appropriateness in speech, which assesses whether a speech sample expressively aligns with the underlying communicative intent implied by its discourse-level narrative context. To support this task, we construct CEAEval-D, the first context-rich speech dataset with real human performances in Mandarin conversational speech, providing narrative descriptions together with fifteen dimensions of human annotations covering expressive attributes and expressive appropriateness. We further develop CEAEval-M, a model that integrates knowledge distillation, planner-based multi-model collaboration, adaptive audio attention bias, and reinforcement learning to perform context-rich expressive appropriateness evaluation. Experiments on a human-annotated test set demonstrate that CEAEval-M substantially outperforms existing speech evaluation and analysis systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估表达性言语仍然是一个挑战，因为现有的方法主要侧重于情感强度的评估，而忽略了语音样本是否适合其所处的上下文环境。这一局限性阻碍了人们对用于叙事驱动和互动应用中的语音系统的可靠评估，例如有声书和对话机器人。我们提出了CEAEval框架，它是一个基于上下文的评估框架，用于判断语音表达是否恰当。该框架会评估语音样本的表达方式是否与其话语层面的叙事上下文所暗示的沟通意图相一致。为了支持这一任务，我们构建了CEAEval-D，这是第一个包含真实人类语音数据的上下文丰富语音数据集，其中包含了叙述性描述以及十五个维度的人类注释，涵盖了表达属性和表达恰当性方面。我们还开发了CEAEval-M模型，该模型结合了知识蒸馏、基于规划器的多模型协作、自适应音频注意力偏置以及强化学习技术，以实现对上下文丰富表达恰当性的评估。在人工标注的测试集上的实验表明，CEAEval-M在性能上显著优于现有的语音评估和分析系统。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: UniMoE-Audio: Unified Speech and Music Generation with Dynamic-Capacity Mixture-of-Experts
papers.title_zh: UniMoE-音频：利用动态容量混合专家系统实现语音与音乐的统一生成
papers.authors: Zhenyu Liu, Yunxin Li, Xuanyu Zhang, Qixun Teng, Shenyuan Jiang, Xinyu Chen, Haoyuan Shi, Haolan Chen, Fanbo Meng, Mingjun Zhao, Yu Xu, Yancheng He, Baotian Hu, Haizhou Li, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in unified multimodal models indicate a clear trend towards comprehensive content generation. However, the auditory domain remains a significant challenge, with music and speech often developed in isolation, hindering progress towards universal audio synthesis. This separation stems from inherent task conflicts between semantic speech and structural music modeling, and severe data imbalances, which impede the development of a truly unified model. To address these challenges, we propose UniMoE-Audio a unified speech and music generation model built upon a novel Dynamic-Capacity Mix-of-Experts (DCMoE) framework. Architecturally, UniMoE-Audio extends the conventional MoE paradigm by introducing a Top-P routing strategy for adaptive capacity allocation. To tackle data imbalance, we introduce a three-stage training curriculum: 1) Independent Specialist Training leverages original datasets to instill domain-specific knowledge into each specialists without interference; 2) MoE Integration and Warmup incorporates these specialists into the UniMoE-Audio architecture, warming up the gate module and shared expert using a subset of balanced dataset; and 3) Synergistic Joint Training trains the entire model end-to-end on the fully balanced dataset, fostering enhanced cross-domain synergy. Extensive experiments show that UniMoE-Audio not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on major speech and music generation benchmarks, but also demonstrates superior synergistic learning, mitigating the performance degradation typically seen in naive joint training. Our findings highlight the substantial potential of specialized MoE architecture and curated training strategies in advancing universal audio generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在统一多模态模型方面的进展表明，朝着全面的内容生成方向发展是一个明确的方向。然而，听觉领域仍然是一个重大挑战——音乐和语音往往被孤立地开发，这阻碍了通用音频合成技术的进步。这种分离源于语义语音建模与结构音乐建模之间的固有任务冲突，以及严重的数据不平衡问题，这些问题都阻碍了一个真正统一的模型的开发。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了UniMoE-Audio这一统一的语音和音乐生成模型，该模型基于一种新颖的动态容量混合专家框架构建。在架构上，UniMoE-Audio通过引入Top-P路由策略来实现自适应容量分配，从而扩展传统的MoE范式。为了解决数据不平衡问题，我们采用了三阶段训练流程：1）独立专家训练利用原始数据集将特定领域的知识传授给每个专家，而不会造成干扰；2）MoE集成与热身环节将这些专家纳入UniMoE-Audio的架构中，使用一部分平衡的数据集来预热门模块和共享专家；3）协同联合训练则在整个完全平衡的数据集上进行端到端的模型训练，从而促进跨领域的协同学习。大量实验表明，UniMoE-Audio不仅在主要的语音和音乐生成基准测试中取得了顶尖性能，还展现了卓越的协同学习能力，有效缓解了在简单联合训练中常见的性能下降问题。我们的研究结果凸显了专业化的MoE架构以及精心设计的训练策略在推进通用音频生成方面所具有的巨大潜力。

papers.title: Are LLMs Reliable Rankers? Rank Manipulation via Two-Stage Token Optimization
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型可靠吗？通过两阶段标记优化实现排名操纵
papers.authors: Tiancheng Xing, Jerry Li, Yixuan Du, Xiyang Hu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as rerankers in information retrieval, yet their ranking behavior can be steered by small, natural-sounding prompts. To expose this vulnerability, we present Rank Anything First (RAF), a two-stage token optimization method that crafts concise textual perturbations to consistently promote a target item in LLM-generated rankings while remaining hard to detect. Stage 1 uses Greedy Coordinate Gradient to shortlist candidate tokens at the current position by combining the gradient of the rank-target with a readability score; Stage 2 evaluates those candidates under exact ranking and readability losses using an entropy-based dynamic weighting scheme, and selects a token via temperature-controlled sampling. RAF generates ranking-promoting prompts token-by-token, guided by dual objectives: maximizing ranking effectiveness and preserving linguistic naturalness. Experiments across multiple LLMs show that RAF significantly boosts the rank of target items using naturalistic language, with greater robustness than existing methods in both promoting target items and maintaining naturalness. These findings underscore a critical security implication: LLM-based reranking is inherently susceptible to adversarial manipulation, raising new challenges for the trustworthiness and robustness of modern retrieval systems. Our code is available at: https://github.com/glad-lab/RAF.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在信息检索中越来越多地被用作重新排序工具，但它们的排序行为可以通过一些看似自然的提示来操控。为了揭示这一漏洞，我们提出了“优先排序任何内容”方法（Rank Anything First，RAF）。这是一种两阶段令牌优化方法，它能够生成简洁的文本扰动，以持续提升目标项在语言模型生成的排名中的表现，同时保持良好的隐蔽性。第一阶段使用贪婪坐标梯度算法，通过结合目标项的排名梯度与可读性得分，来筛选出当前位置的候选令牌；第二阶段则利用基于熵的动态加权方案，在精确排序和可读性的前提下评估这些候选令牌，并通过温度控制采样的方式选择出合适的令牌。RAF能够逐个生成促进排名的提示，其设计遵循双重目标：最大化排名效果以及保持语言的自然性。在多个语言模型上的实验表明，RAF能够显著提升目标项的排名，同时使用自然语言的方式实现这一目标，其鲁棒性也优于现有方法，无论是在提升目标项排名方面，还是在保持语言自然性方面都是如此。这些发现凸显了一个重要的安全问题：基于语言模型的重新排序机制本身就容易受到对抗性操纵的影响，这给现代检索系统的可信度和鲁棒性带来了新的挑战。我们的代码可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/glad-lab/RAF。

papers.title: KCVR: Knowledge-Centric Video Reconstruction for Structured Pedagogical Summarization via Dynamic Graph Planning
papers.title_zh: KCVR：基于知识的视频重构技术，通过动态图规划实现结构化教学总结
papers.authors: Jingjiang Liu, Jia Zhu, Hanghui Guo, Weijie Shi, Yue Cui, Xiaokang Jin, Yilin Wang, Qingyu Niu, Jiawei Shen, Guoqing Ma, Yidan Liang, Shimin Di, Jiajie Xu
papers.abstract: Existing video summarization methods mainly compress content for gist browsing, but they often break the prerequisite logic in instructional videos and induce logical inversions (e.g., conclusions before premises). We formalize this problem as Structure-Pedagogical Reconstruction (SPR). SPR raises two challenges: (1) Structure Hallucination, where retrieved knowledge is topologically valid but not evidence-grounded by the blackboard; and (2) Logical Inversion, where soft prompt-level graph injection fails to enforce prerequisite order during decoding. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge-Centric Video Reconstruction (KCVR), a Plan-then-Generate neuro-symbolic framework that decouples epistemic planning from content generation. KCVR prunes a Dual-Layer Epistemic Graph into a minimal video-supported plan, then realizes the plan with visually anchored attention and topology-constrained decoding. We additionally release EduStruct, a 10-discipline benchmark for SPR and structure-centric evaluation. Experiments show that KCVR outperforms strong end-to-end baselines on Knowledge Progression Consistency and Learning Objective Coverage. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/mark1001-ljj/video_sum.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的视频摘要方法主要通过对内容进行压缩来实现快速浏览，但这些方法往往会破坏教学视频中的逻辑顺序，导致逻辑倒置的现象（例如，结论出现在前提之前）。我们将这个问题定义为“结构-教学重构”问题。该问题存在两个挑战：(1) 结构幻觉，即检索到的知识在拓扑上是有效的，但并未得到黑板式的证据支持；(2) 逻辑倒置，即在解码过程中，软提示级别的图注入无法确保前提与结论之间的顺序正确。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了“以知识为中心的视频重构”方法，这是一种“先规划再生成”的神经符号框架，它将认知规划与内容生成分离开来。KCVR将双层认知图剪枝为最小化的、由视觉引导的、具有拓扑约束的解码计划。我们还发布了EduStruct，这是一个针对“结构重构”问题的10个学科基准测试。实验表明，KCVR在知识进展一致性和学习目标覆盖方面优于那些采用端到端方法的强基线算法。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/mark1001-ljj/video_sum下载。

papers.title: RepoGenesis: Benchmarking End-to-End Microservice Generation from Readme to Repository
papers.title_zh: RepoGenesis：从读取说明到仓库的端到端微服务生成技术对比
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Peng, Xin Yin, Pu Zhao, Fangkai Yang, Lu Wang, Ran Jia, Xu Chen, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models and agents have achieved remarkable progress in code generation. However, existing benchmarks focus on isolated function/class-level generation (e.g., ClassEval) or modifications to existing codebases (e.g., SWE-Bench), neglecting complete microservice repository generation that reflects real-world 0-to-1 development workflows. To bridge this gap, we introduce RepoGenesis, the first multilingual benchmark for repository-level end-to-end web microservice generation, comprising 106 repositories (60 Python, 46 Java) across 18 domains and 11 frameworks, with 1,258 API endpoints and 2,335 test cases verified through a “review-rebuttal” quality assurance process. We evaluate open-source agents (e.g., DeepCode) and commercial IDEs (e.g., Cursor) using Pass@1, API Coverage (AC), and Deployment Success Rate (DSR). Results reveal that despite high AC (up to 73.91%) and DSR (up to 100%), the best-performing system achieves only 23.67% Pass@1 on Python and 21.45% on Java, exposing deficiencies in architectural coherence, dependency management, and cross-file consistency. Notably, RepoGenesis-8B, fine-tuned on RepoGenesis (train), achieves performance comparable to GPT-5 mini, demonstrating the quality of RepoGenesis for advancing microservice generation. We release our benchmark at https://github.com/pzy2000/RepoGenesis.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型和智能体在代码生成方面取得了显著进展。然而，现有的基准测试主要集中在孤立的函数/类级别生成（例如ClassEval）或对现有代码库的修改（例如SWE-Bench），而忽略了能够反映现实世界从零到一开发流程的完整微服务仓库生成。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了RepoGenesis，这是首个用于仓库级端到端Web微服务生成的多语言基准测试工具。该测试包括106个微服务仓库（其中60个使用Python语言编写，46个使用Java语言编写），涵盖18个领域和11种框架，拥有1,258个API端点，并通过“评审-反馈”质量保障流程验证了2,335个测试用例。我们使用Pass@1、API覆盖率（AC）和部署成功率（DSR）等指标来评估开源智能体（例如DeepCode）和商业集成开发环境（例如Cursor）的性能。结果表明，尽管API覆盖率高达73.91%，部署成功率高达100%，但表现最好的系统在Python语言上的Pass@1得分仅为23.67%，在Java语言上则仅为21.45%。这表明该系统在架构一致性、依赖管理以及跨文件一致性方面存在不足。值得注意的是，经过在RepoGenesis（训练集）上进行微调的RepoGenesis-8B模型，其性能与GPT-5 mini相当，这证明了RepoGenesis在促进微服务生成方面的强大能力。我们将该基准测试工具发布在https://github.com/pzy2000/RepoGenesis网站上。

papers.title: CityCube: Benchmarking Cross-view Spatial Reasoning on Vision-Language Models in Urban Environments
papers.title_zh: CityCube：针对城市环境中视觉语言模型的跨视角空间推理能力进行对比评估
papers.authors: Haotian Xu, Yue Hu, Zhengqiu Zhu, Chen Gao, Ziyou Wang, Junreng Rao, Wenhao Lu, Weishi Li, Quanjun Yin, Yong Li
papers.abstract: Cross-view spatial reasoning is essential for embodied AI, underpinning spatial understanding, mental simulation and planning in complex environments. Existing benchmarks primarily emphasize indoor or street settings, overlooking the unique challenges of open-ended urban spaces characterized by rich semantics, complex geometries, and view variations. To address this, we introduce CityCube, a systematic benchmark designed to probe cross-view reasoning capabilities of current VLMs in urban settings. CityCube integrates four viewpoint dynamics to mimic camera movements and spans a wide spectrum of perspectives from multiple platforms, e.g., vehicles, drones and satellites. For a comprehensive assessment, it features 5,022 meticulously annotated multi-view QA pairs categorized into five cognitive dimensions and three spatial relation expressions. A comprehensive evaluation of 33 VLMs reveals a significant performance disparity with humans: even large-scale models struggle to exceed 54.1% accuracy, remaining 34.2% below human performance. By contrast, small-scale fine-tuned VLMs achieve over 60.0% accuracy, highlighting the necessity of our benchmark. Further analyses indicate the task correlations and fundamental cognitive disparity between VLMs and human-like reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨视角空间推理对于实现具身人工智能至关重要，它有助于在复杂环境中进行空间理解、心理模拟和规划。现有的基准测试主要聚焦于室内或街道环境，而忽视了开放式城市空间的独特挑战——这些空间具有丰富的语义信息、复杂的几何形态以及多样的视角变化。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了CityCube这一系统性的基准测试，旨在评估当前视觉语言模型在城市环境中的跨视角推理能力。CityCube整合了四种视角动态，以模拟摄像机的移动方式，并涵盖了从车辆、无人机到卫星等多种平台的多种视角。为了进行全面评估，该基准测试包含了5,022对经过精心标注的多视角问答对，这些对题被分为五个认知维度以及三种空间关系表达形式。对33个视觉语言模型进行的全面评估显示，它们的性能与人类存在显著差距：即使是大规模模型，其准确率也仅能达到54.1%，远低于人类的34.2%。相比之下，小型且经过微调的视觉语言模型则能够达到超过60.0%的准确率，这凸显了我们设计此基准测试的必要性。进一步的分析表明，视觉语言模型与人类类似的推理方式之间存在任务相关性以及基本的认知差异。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ContrastKV: Robust KV Cache Eviction via Contrastive Signal Fusion for Multi-Query Generalization
papers.title_zh: ContrastKV：通过对比信号融合实现稳健的KV缓存淘汰机制，适用于多查询场景的泛化性能提升
papers.authors: Xingchi Chen, Peiyuan Zong, Ziqiang Gao, Qing Li, Yong Jiang, Fa Zhu, Hui Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) face significant memory and latency overheads during long-context inference due to the growing KV cache, especially in Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) settings that require support for multiple downstream queries. Query-aware eviction methods do not generalize across queries, while existing query-agnostic approaches rely on a single proxy query, leading to fragile eviction decisions under high eviction ratios. We propose ContrastKV, a robust query-agnostic KV cache eviction algorithm for multi-query generalization. ContrastKV introduces a contrastive signal fusion mechanism that jointly exploits complementary semantic and non-semantic signals. By contrasting semantic consistency with structural robustness, the method constructs a more reliable eviction criterion that alleviates the blind spots of single-query proxies. The framework integrates efficient signal generation, parallel importance scoring, and multi-level fusion across heads and layers. Experiments show that ContrastKV outperforms state-of-the-art methods, retaining up to 92% accuracy with only 20% of the KV cache budget, while reducing decoding latency by approximately 50% and significantly lowering GPU memory usage.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在长上下文推理过程中面临着显著的记忆和延迟开销，这主要是由于KV缓存的增长所导致的。特别是在需要支持多个下游查询的知识库问答场景中，这种问题更为突出。基于查询意识的淘汰方法无法跨查询进行通用化处理，而现有的不依赖查询的算法则依赖于单一的代理查询，这会导致在高淘汰比率下做出不稳定的淘汰决策。我们提出了ContrastKV，这是一种强大的不依赖查询的KV缓存淘汰算法，能够适用于多查询场景。ContrastKV采用了一种对比信号融合机制，该机制同时利用了互补的语义信号和非语义信号。通过结合语义一致性与结构鲁棒性，该方法构建了一个更可靠的淘汰标准，从而弥补了单一查询代理的缺陷。该框架集成了高效的信号生成、并行重要性评分以及跨层次的多级融合技术。实验表明，ContrastKV在准确性方面优于现有最先进的方法，仅使用20%的KV缓存资源就能保持高达92%的准确率，同时还将解码延迟降低了约50%，并显著减少了GPU内存的使用量。

papers.title: Teach a Reward Model to Correct Itself: Reward Guided Adversarial Failure Discovery for Robust Reward Modeling
papers.title_zh: 教授一种自我纠正的奖励模型：通过有导向的对抗性失败发现来激励奖励，以实现稳健的奖励建模
papers.authors: Pankayaraj Pathmanathan, Furong Huang
papers.abstract: Reward models (RMs) trained from human preferences are central to aligning large language models, yet they often break under distribution shift or targeted perturbations. Existing failure discovery methods rely on prior knowledge of preference attributes and therefore do not scale to new models or data. We introduce a preference distribution agnostic procedure that uses the reward model itself to guide controlled decoding toward mis specified responses while preserving the underlying preference class. Building on this discovery mechanism, we propose REFORM, a self improving RM framework that (i) searches for class consistent but reward inconsistent variants and (ii) fine tunes the RM on a small, targeted augmentation of these failures. On Anthropic Helpful Harmless and PKU Beavertails, REFORM consistently improves robustness without degrading in distribution reward quality across different models (e.g., Mistral-7B and Qwen-14B), with an average improvement of 35%–45%.Further, across Best of N sampling, PPO, and DPO, REFORM preserves downstream generation quality and reduces spurious correlations. Our results show that RMs can serve as their own adversary to expose and fix blind spots, yielding robust alignment without manual attribute priors or large scale relabeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于人类偏好训练的奖励模型在使大语言模型保持一致方面起着关键作用，然而它们往往会在分布偏移或针对性扰动的情况下失效。现有的故障发现方法依赖于对偏好属性的先验知识，因此无法适用于新的模型或数据。我们提出了一种与偏好分布无关的方法，该方法利用奖励模型本身来引导有控制的解码过程，以生成错误的响应，同时保留基本的偏好类别。在此基础上，我们提出了REFORM这一自改进奖励模型框架：该框架能够（i）寻找与类别一致但奖励不一致的变体；（ii）通过对这些故障进行小规模、有针对性的改进来微调奖励模型。在Anthropic的HelpfulHarmless和PKU的Beavertails数据集上，REFORM在不同模型中始终能够提高鲁棒性，同时不会降低分布奖励的质量（例如Mistral-7B和Qwen-14B），平均提升幅度为35%至45%。此外，在Best of N采样、PPO和DPO等任务中，REFORM能够保持下游生成的品质，并减少虚假相关性。我们的结果表明，奖励模型可以作为一种自我纠正机制，揭示并修复盲点，从而实现无需手动设定属性先验或大规模重新标记就能达到的稳健对齐效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling: Modality Separation and Semantic Coherence for Full-Duplex SLMs
papers.title_zh: 层次化声学-语义建模：用于全双工SLM系统的模态分离与语义一致性处理
papers.authors: Zhenyu Liu, Xuanyu Zhang, Yunxin Li, Qixun Teng, Shenyuan Jiang, Haolan Chen, Mingjun Zhao, Fanbo Meng, Yu Xu, Yancheng He, Baotian Hu, Haizhou Li, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Developing seamless, high-performance, native intelligent full-duplex Spoken Language Models (SLMs) remains a critical challenge and long-standing goal for the speech and NLP community. Despite notable progress, recent endeavors are fundamentally constrained by severe modality interference, which causes substantial knowledge degradation and compromises semantic integrity─ultimately making full-duplex SLMs feel unnatural and unintelligent. In this paper, through an exhaustive fine-grained analysis of model optimization dynamics, we uncover the root cause of such performance degradation, revealing that modality interference arises from inherent gradient conflicts between acoustic and semantic modeling when the two modalities are forced to share a deep parameter space. Guided by this key insight, we introduce Lychee-FD, a native end-to-end full-duplex framework designed to mitigate modality interference. Importantly, we propose a hierarchical parameter separation strategy that decouples conflicting modalities in deep layers while preserving cross-modality coherence via a dedicated semantic alignment channel. Extensive experiments on multiple full-duplex benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly advances the state of the art, yielding substantial improvements in both speech intelligence (+7.4% on Spoken QA) and full-duplex interaction fluidity (+28.5% on FullDuplexBench 1.5) without compromising inference efficiency. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to achieve two key advances: 1) uncovering and elucidating the root cause of modality interference in full-duplex SLMs, and 2) designing an elegant hierarchical model together with a practical solution for seamless, high-performance, native intelligent full-duplex SLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 开发无缝、高性能的本地智能全双工语音语言模型，仍然是语音和自然语言处理领域的一个关键挑战和长期目标。尽管取得了显著进展，但最近的努力仍然受到严重的模态干扰问题的限制，这导致了知识水平的显著下降，并破坏了语义的完整性——最终使得全双工语音语言模型显得不自然且缺乏智能。在本文中，通过对模型优化动态的详细分析，我们揭示了这种性能下降的根本原因，发现模态干扰源于声学建模与语义建模之间固有的梯度冲突，当这两种模态被迫共享一个参数空间时就会出现这种情况。基于这一关键见解，我们提出了Lychee-FD框架，这是一个旨在缓解模态干扰的本地端到端全双工模型。重要的是，我们提出了一种分层参数分离策略，该策略可以在保留跨模态一致性的同时，将深层中的冲突模态分离开来。在多个全双工基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了现有技术的水平，不仅在语音智能方面取得了显著改进（在Spoken QA任务上提高了7.4%），而且在全双工交互流畅性方面也取得了显著提升（在FullDuplexBench 1.5上提高了28.5%），同时没有牺牲推理效率。据我们所知，这项工作首次实现了两个关键突破：1）揭示了全双工语音语言模型中模态干扰的根本原因；2）设计了一个优雅的分层模型以及实用的解决方案，以实现无缝、高性能的本地智能全双工语音语言模型。

papers.title: VisPCO: Visual Token Pruning Configuration Optimization via Budget-Aware Pareto-Frontier Learning for Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: VisPCO：基于预算感知的帕累托前沿学习的视觉令牌剪枝配置优化技术，适用于视觉语言模型
papers.authors: Huawei Ji, Yuanhao Sun, Yuan Jin, Cheng Deng, Jiaxin Ding, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang
papers.abstract: Visual token pruning methods effectively mitigate the quadratic computational growth caused by processing high-resolution images and video frames in vision-language models (VLMs). However, existing approaches rely on predefined pruning configurations without determining whether they achieve computation-performance optimality. In this work, we introduce , a novel framework that formulates visual token pruning as a Pareto configuration optimization problem to automatically identify optimal configurations. Our approach employs continuous relaxation and straight-through estimators to enable gradient-based search, solved via the Augmented Lagrangian method. Extensive experiments across 8 visual benchmarks demonstrate that effectively approximates the empirical Pareto frontier obtained through grid search and generalizes well across various pruning methods and VLM architectures. Furthermore, through learnable kernel functions, we investigate layer-wise pruning patterns and reveal that multi-step progressive pruning captures VLMs’ hierarchical compression structure, achieving superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to single-layer approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉令牌剪枝方法能够有效缓解在视觉语言模型中处理高分辨率图像和视频帧时出现的二次计算增长问题。然而，现有的方法依赖于预定义的剪枝配置，而并未确定这些配置是否能够实现计算性能的最优性。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，将视觉令牌剪枝转化为一个帕累托配置优化问题，从而自动识别最优配置。我们的方法采用连续松弛法和直接估计器来实现基于梯度的搜索，并通过增广拉格朗日方法求解。在8个视觉基准测试中的广泛实验表明，该方法能够有效地逼近通过网格搜索获得的经验帕累托前沿，并且能够在不同的剪枝方法和视觉语言模型架构之间保持良好的泛化能力。此外，通过可学习的核函数，我们还研究了逐层剪枝模式，发现多步渐进式剪枝能够捕捉视觉语言模型的层次压缩结构，从而实现了比单层剪枝方法更优的准确率与效率权衡。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CoSToM: Causal-oriented Steering for Intrinsic Theory-of-Mind Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: CoSToM：基于因果关系的引导方法，用于提升大型语言模型的内在思维一致性
papers.authors: Mengfan Li, Xuanhua Shi, Yang Deng
papers.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to attribute mental states to others, is a hallmark of social intelligence. While large language models (LLMs) demonstrate promising performance on standard ToM benchmarks, we observe that they often fail to generalize to complex task-specific scenarios, relying heavily on prompt scaffolding to mimic reasoning. The critical misalignment between the internal knowledge and external behavior raises a fundamental question: Do LLMs truly possess intrinsic cognition, and can they externalize this internal knowledge into stable, high-quality behaviors? To answer this, we introduce CoSToM (Causal-oriented Steering for ToM alignment), a framework that transitions from mechanistic interpretation to active intervention. First, we employ causal tracing to map the internal distribution of ToM features, empirically uncovering the internal layers’ characteristics in encoding fundamental ToM semantics. Building on this insight, we implement a lightweight alignment framework via targeted activation steering within these ToM-critical layers. Experiments demonstrate that CoSToM significantly enhances human-like social reasoning capabilities and downstream dialogue quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 心智理论（ToM），即能够将心理状态归因于他人的能力，是社会智能的一个重要标志。虽然大语言模型在标准的心智理论基准测试中表现良好，但我们观察到它们往往无法泛化到复杂的任务特定场景中，它们主要依赖提示引导来模拟推理过程。内部知识与外部行为之间的严重不匹配提出了一个基本问题：大语言模型是否真正具备内在的认知能力？它们能否将这些内部知识转化为稳定、高质量的行为呢？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了CoSToM框架——一个从机械解释转向主动干预的框架。首先，我们通过因果追踪来映射心智理论特征的内部分布，从而揭示编码基本心智理论语义时内部层次的特征。基于这一洞察，我们在这些关键心智理论层进行有针对性的激活引导，从而实现一个轻量级的对齐框架。实验表明，CoSToM显著提升了类似人类的社交推理能力和下游对话质量。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ConlangCrafter: Constructing Languages with a Multi-Hop LLM Pipeline
papers.title_zh: ConlangCrafter：利用多跳LLM流程构建新语言
papers.authors: Morris Alper, Moran Yanuka, Raja Giryes, Gasper Begus
papers.abstract: Constructed languages (conlangs) such as Esperanto and Quenya have played diverse roles in art, philosophy, and international communication. Meanwhile, foundation models have revolutionized creative generation in text, images, and beyond. In this work, we leverage modern LLMs as computational creativity aids for end-to-end conlang creation. We introduce ConlangCrafter, a multi-hop pipeline that decomposes language design into modular stages – phonology, morphology, syntax, lexicon generation, and translation. At each stage, our method leverages LLMs’ metalinguistic reasoning capabilities, injecting randomness to encourage diversity and leveraging self-refinement feedback to encourage consistency in the emerging language description. We construct a novel, scalable evaluation framework for this task, evaluating metrics measuring consistency and typological diversity. Automatic and manual evaluations demonstrate ConlangCrafter’s ability to produce coherent and varied conlangs without human linguistic expertise. We will release our code and data.
papers.abstract_zh: 像世界语和昆雅这样的构造语言在艺术、哲学和国际交流中发挥了重要作用。与此同时，基础模型彻底改变了文本、图像等领域的创作方式。在这项研究中，我们利用现代大语言模型作为计算创意辅助工具，实现端到端的构造语言创建。我们提出了ConlangCrafter这一多阶段流程，它将语言设计分解为多个模块——音系学、形态学、句法、词汇生成以及翻译。在每个阶段，我们的方法都利用了大语言模型的元语言推理能力，引入随机性以激发多样性，并利用自我完善反馈机制来确保语言描述的一致性。我们还构建了一个新颖且可扩展的评估框架，用于衡量语言的一致性和类型多样性。自动和手动评估表明，ConlangCrafter能够在无需人类语言专业知识的情况下，创造出连贯且多样化的构造语言。我们将公开我们的代码和数据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: XY-Tokenizer: Mitigating the Semantic-Acoustic Conflict in Low-Bitrate Speech Codecs
papers.title_zh: XY-Tokenizer：缓解低比特率语音编码器中语义与发音冲突的问题
papers.authors: Yitian Gong, Luozhijie Jin, Kuangwei Chen, Dong Zhang, Ruifan Deng, Xiaogui Yang, Xin Zhang, Zhaoye Fei, Qinyuan Cheng, Shimin Li, Xipeng Qiu
papers.abstract: Speech codecs provide an important interface between continuous speech signals and large language models. An ideal codec for speech language models should not only preserve acoustic information but also capture rich semantic information. However, existing codecs struggle to balance these objectives at low bitrates. We propose \textbf{XY-Tokenizer}, a low-bitrate speech codec (around 1 kbps) trained with a structured multi-stage, multi-task strategy that aligns discrete speech representations with text while preserving fine-grained acoustic details for reconstruction. This design explicitly mitigates the semantic–acoustic conflict observed in prior low-bitrate codecs. Experiments show that XY-Tokenizer achieves stronger semantic alignment than representative semantic-distillation codecs such as SpeechTokenizer and Mimi, while maintaining high-quality speech reconstruction across both clean and out-of-distribution conditions. Furthermore, XY-Tokenizer consistently outperforms existing low-bitrate codecs in LLM-based speech understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness as a general-purpose speech representation for speech–language modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 语音编解码器为连续语音信号与大语言模型之间提供了重要的接口。理想的语音语言模型编解码器不仅应保留声学信息，还应能够捕捉丰富的语义信息。然而，现有的编解码器在低比特率下难以同时实现这两个目标。我们提出了**XY-Tokenizer**，这是一种低比特率的语音编解码器（约1千比特每秒），采用结构化的多阶段、多任务策略进行训练，能够将离散的语音表示与文本对齐，同时保留精细的声学细节以便重建。这种设计明显缓解了先前低比特率编解码器中出现的语义与声学之间的冲突问题。实验表明，XY-Tokenizer在语义对齐方面优于诸如SpeechTokenizer和Mimi等典型的语义蒸馏编解码器，同时在清晰语音和异常语音条件下都能实现高质量的语音重建。此外，XY-Tokenizer在基于大语言模型的语音理解和生成任务中始终表现出色，证明了其作为语音-语言建模通用语音表示器的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Empathy in Diversity: Personalized Depression and Anxiety Therapy via Dialogue State Tracking and Patient-Aware Planning
papers.title_zh: 在多样性背景下建立共情能力：通过对话状态追踪与患者感知的规划来实现个性化抑郁与焦虑治疗
papers.authors: Xinwei Yang, Junyi Fan, Yuqing Liu, Jiaxuan Wang, Jiashuai Zhang, Hongru Liang, Wenqiang Lei, Yao Song
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) dialogue agents are increasingly used in psychological therapy, yet robustness across diverse patients remains underexplored. We address this gap with three contributions: (1) MindEval, a realistic role-play protocol for evaluating therapeutic dialogue agents; (2) MindData, a de-identified, expert-annotated corpus of therapist–patient dialogues (2,573 sessions; 63,348 turns); and (3) MindApt, a framework that integrates a therapeutic dialogue state tracking paradigm with a patient-aware strategic planning module. On MindEval, MindApt outperforms strong baselines on therapeutic outcomes and dialogue quality while improving conversational efficiency. To evaluate utility beyond role-play, we conducted a clinical study with real patients, demonstrating that MindApt-guided care achieves outcomes comparable to therapist-determined care, while the hybrid setting combining therapist judgment with MindApt’s recommendations yields the strongest overall outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）对话代理在心理治疗中的应用越来越广泛，但其在不同患者中的鲁棒性仍然缺乏深入研究。我们通过三项研究来填补这一空白：(1) MindEval，一种用于评估治疗性对话代理的现实模拟协议；(2) MindData，一个去标识化且由专家标注的治疗师与患者对话语料库，包含2,573个会话，共63,348个回合的对话记录；(3) MindApt，一个整合了治疗性对话状态跟踪机制以及基于患者需求的战略规划模块的框架。在MindEval实验中，MindApt在治疗效果和对话质量方面均优于强大的基线算法，同时提升了对话效率。为了评估其超越模拟场景的实用性，我们进行了针对真实患者的临床研究，结果表明，在MindApt的指导下进行护理时，治疗效果与由治疗师独立决定的护理相当；而将治疗师的判断与MindApt的建议相结合，则能够获得最佳的整体治疗效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VAPO: End-to-end Slide-Enhanced Speech Recognition with Omni-modal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: VAPO：基于端到端滑动增强语音识别技术，运用全模态大型语言模型实现语音识别
papers.authors: Rui Hu, Delai Qiu, Yining Wang, Shengping Liu, Jitao Sang
papers.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) offer a promising end-to-end solution for slide-enhanced speech recognition due to their inherent multimodal capabilities. However, we found a fundamental issue faced by OLLMs: Visual Interference, where models show a bias towards visible text over auditory signals, causing them to hallucinate slide content that was never spoken. To address this, we propose Visually-Anchored Policy Optimization (VAPO), which aims to reshape models’ inference process to follow the human-like “Look-then-Listen” inference chain. Specifically, we design a temporally decoupled policy: the model first extracts visual priors in a think> block to serve as semantic anchors, then generates the transcription in an answer> block. The policy is optimized via multi-objective reinforcement learning. Furthermore, we introduce SlideASR-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to address the scarcity of entity-rich data, comprising a large-scale synthetic corpus for training and a challenging real-world test set for evaluation. We conduct extensive evaluations demonstrating that VAPO effectively eliminates visual interference and achieves state-of-the-art performance on SlideASR-Bench and public datasets, significantly reducing entity recognition errors in specialized domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 全模态大语言模型为增强型语音识别提供了有前景的端到端解决方案，因为它们具有天生的多模态能力。然而，我们发现全模态模型面临一个根本性问题：视觉干扰。即模型倾向于关注可见的文字而非听觉信号，导致模型会生成从未被发音过的幻灯片内容。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了基于视觉锚定的策略优化方法。该方法旨在重新调整模型的推理过程，使其遵循类似人类的“先看图像再听声音”的推理流程。具体来说，我们设计了一种时间上分离的策略：模型首先通过“思考”模块提取视觉先验信息作为语义锚点，然后通过“回答”模块生成文本转录结果。该策略通过多目标强化学习进行优化。此外，我们还开发了SlideASR-Bench这一综合基准测试平台，旨在解决实体丰富数据的稀缺问题。该平台包含大规模合成语料库用于训练，以及具有挑战性的真实世界测试集用于评估。我们的广泛评估表明，VAPO方法能够有效消除视觉干扰，并在SlideASR-Bench及公共数据集上取得了领先的性能表现，显著减少了专业领域中的实体识别错误。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
