papers.title: "Newspaper Eat" Means "Not Tasty": A Taxonomy and Benchmark for Coded Language in Real-World Chinese Online Reviews
papers.title_zh: “吃报纸”意味着“并不美味”：一种用于编码语言的分类方法，以及在实际中文在线评论中的应用指南
papers.authors: Ruyuan Wan, Changye Li, Ting-Hao Kenneth Huang
papers.abstract: Coded language is an important part of human communication. It refers to cases where users intentionally encode meaning so that the surface text differs from the intended meaning and must be decoded to be understood. Current language models handle coded language poorly. Progress has been limited by the lack of real-world datasets and clear taxonomies. This paper introduces CodedLang, a dataset of 7,744 Chinese Google Maps reviews, including 900 reviews with span-level annotations of coded language. We developed a seven-class taxonomy that captures common encoding strategies, including phonetic, orthographic, and cross-lingual substitutions. We benchmarked language models on coded language detection, classification, and review rating prediction. Results show that even strong models can fail to identify or understand coded language. Because many coded expressions rely on pronunciation-based strategies, we further conducted a phonetic analysis of coded and decoded forms. Our code and dataset are publicly available. Together, our results highlight coded language as an important and underexplored challenge for real-world NLP systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 编码语言是人类交流的重要组成部分。它指的是用户故意对文字进行编码，使得表面文字与实际含义不同，需要解码才能理解的情况。目前的语言模型在处理编码语言方面表现不佳。这一问题的进展受到了现实世界数据集和清晰分类法缺乏的限制。本文介绍了CodedLang数据集，该数据集包含7,744条中文谷歌地图评论，其中900条评论带有编码语言的层次化注释。我们构建了一个七类分类体系，涵盖了常见的编码策略，包括语音编码、拼写替换以及跨语言替换等。我们对语言模型在编码语言检测、分类以及评论评分预测方面的性能进行了评估。结果表明，即使是强大的模型也可能无法识别或理解编码语言。由于许多编码表达依赖于基于发音的策略，我们还对编码形式和解码形式进行了语音分析。我们的代码和数据集已公开提供。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，编码语言是现实世界自然语言处理系统中一个重要但未被充分探索的挑战领域。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Data Mixing Agent: Learning to Re-weight Domains for Continual Pre-training
papers.title_zh: 数据混合代理：学习如何重新分配领域权重以进行持续预训练
papers.authors: Kailai Yang, Xiao Liu, Lei Ji, Hao Li, Xiao Liang, Zhiwei Liu, Yeyun Gong, Peng Cheng, Mao Yang
papers.abstract: Continual pre-training on small-scale task-specific data is an effective method for improving large language models in new target fields, yet it risks catastrophic forgetting of their original capabilities. A common solution is to re-weight training data mixtures from source and target fields on a domain space to achieve balanced performance. Previous domain reweighting strategies rely on manual designation with certain heuristics based on human intuition or empirical results. In this work, we prove that more general heuristics can be parameterized by proposing Data Mixing Agent, the first model-based, end-to-end framework that learns to re-weight domains. The agent learns generalizable heuristics through reinforcement learning on large quantities of data mixing trajectories with corresponding feedback from an evaluation environment. Experiments in continual pre-training on math reasoning show that Data Mixing Agent outperforms strong baselines in achieving balanced performance across source and target field benchmarks. Furthermore, it generalizes well across unseen source fields, target models, and domain spaces without retraining. Direct application to the code generation field also indicates its adaptability across target domains. Further analysis showcases the agents’ well-aligned heuristics with human intuitions and their efficiency in achieving superior model performance with less source-field data.
papers.abstract_zh: 在小型、特定任务的数据上进行持续预训练是一种有效提升大语言模型在新领域性能的方法，但这种方法存在导致模型原有能力被严重遗忘的风险。常见的解决方案是在源域和目标域的数据混合体上重新分配权重，以实现均衡的性能表现。以往的领域权重调整策略依赖于基于人类直觉或经验结果的手动指定方法。在这项研究中，我们证明了可以通过提出数据混合代理来参数化更通用的启发式规则，这是一种基于模型的端到端框架，能够学习如何重新分配不同领域的权重。该代理通过大量数据混合轨迹的强化学习，并结合评估环境中的反馈，从而学习出具有通用性的启发式规则。在数学推理方面的持续预训练实验表明，数据混合代理在实现源域和目标域之间的均衡性能方面优于其他强大的基线方法。此外，它能够在未经重新训练的情况下，很好地适应不同的源域、目标模型和领域空间。在代码生成领域的应用也表明了其跨领域适应能力。进一步的分析表明，该代理的启发式规则与人类直觉高度契合，而且它能够用较少的源域数据就能实现卓越的模型性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Experience-driven Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning for GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: 基于经验的多轮强化学习，适用于图形用户界面智能体
papers.authors: Zhengxi Lu, Jiabo Ye, Fei Tang, Yongliang Shen, Haiyang Xu, Ziwei Zheng, Weiming Lu, Ming Yan, Fei Huang, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang
papers.abstract: GUI agents have demonstrated remarkable progress in automating complex user interface interactions. However, training such agents for long-horizon tasks remains challenging. Single-turn reinforcement learning conditions on expert histories during training but self-generated histories during deployment, causing distribution mismatch. Online multi-turn methods eliminate this gap via environment interaction but suffer from sparse rewards and prohibitive costs. We propose \underline{\textbf{E}}xperience-driven \underline{\textbf{M}}ulti-turn \underline{\textbf{P}}olicy \underline{\textbf{O}}ptimization (\textbf{EMPO}), which leverages expert trajectories as environment experiences for on-policy multi-turn training. The agent constructs self-generated history throughout rollouts; when actions match expert experiences, the trajectory provides valid state transitions, and a Patch Module recovers mismatched steps to maintain on-policy rollouts. EMPO further incorporates discounted future rewards and dual-level advantage estimation to capture long-horizon dependencies. We also propose \textbf{AndroidControl-Real}, an evaluation metric strongly correlated with real-world performance (R^2=0.934). With only 1K public trajectories as RL experiences, our method achieves substantial gains over the base model (e.g., +12.0% on AndroidWorld and +23.8% on AITW) and achieves competitive performance against strong baselines such as UI-TARS-7B and GPT-4o, demonstrating better generalization than prior single-turn RL approaches. Code available: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UI-S1-0DAF.
papers.abstract_zh: 图形用户界面代理在自动化复杂用户界面交互方面取得了显著进展。然而，训练这些代理以完成长期任务仍然具有挑战性。单轮强化学习要求在训练过程中依赖专家的历史数据，而在部署时则依赖自生成的历史数据，这会导致数据分布不匹配的问题。在线多轮方法通过环境交互解决了这一问题，但存在奖励稀疏和成本过高的问题。我们提出了基于经验的多轮策略优化方法，该方法利用专家轨迹作为环境经验，进行基于策略的多轮训练。代理在每次部署过程中都会生成自己的历史数据；当动作与专家经验相匹配时，该轨迹就能提供有效的状态转换，而补丁模块则能够修复不匹配的步长，以保持基于策略的部署过程。EMPO还结合了折扣后的未来奖励以及双层次优势估计，以捕捉长期依赖性。我们还提出了一种评估指标——AndroidControl-Real，该指标与现实世界性能高度相关（R^2=0.934）。仅使用1K条公开轨迹作为强化学习经验，我们的方法比基础模型取得了显著的提升（例如在AndroidWorld上的性能提升了12.0%，在AITW上的性能提升了23.8%），并且与UI-TARS-7B和GPT-4o等强大的基线模型相比，也取得了有竞争力的性能，显示出比以往单轮强化学习方法更好的泛化能力。代码可访问：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UI-S1-0DAF。

papers.title: UMMF: Protecting Copyright of Large Vision-Language Models through Unlearning-based Multimodal Memorization Fingerprint
papers.title_zh: UMMF：通过基于“去学习”的多模态记忆技术来保护大型视语模型的版权
papers.authors: Xiaofan Zheng, Xinghao Wang, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: Training Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) is costly and resource-intensive, making them valuable assets. To prevent malicious users from unauthorized commercialization of these artificial intelligence assets through fine-tuning and black-box deployment, model fingerprinting techniques aimed at verifying the ownership of LVLMs are receiving widespread attention. Existing fingerprinting techniques rely on adversarial attacks or backdoor attacks to construct trigger images for specific outputs, attributing model ownership by comparing whether the output of trigger images on suspected models matches the predetermined output. However, these methods depend on fixed-form triggers as explicit model fingerprints, which have limitations in terms of stealthiness and robustness. Inspired by unlearning research, we propose Unlearning-based Multimodal Memorization Fingerprint (UMMF). UMMF strengthens the overfitting characteristics of training samples by unlearning neighboring samples of the training samples, thereby introducing detectable regions of poor generalization in the data manifold. Compared with previous methods, our approach leverages the differences in memorization strength of LVLMs on neighboring samples as implicit model fingerprints, rather than relying on specific input-output pairs as explicit triggers. This endows it with stronger stealthiness, robustness, and adaptability. To simulate real application scenarios, we conduct extensive experiments using multiple strategies and different datasets, further demonstrating its superiority in protecting LVLM ownership.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）需要大量的资源和成本，因此这些模型堪称宝贵的资产。为了防止恶意用户通过微调或黑盒部署来未经授权地商业化这些人工智能资产，旨在验证LVLMs所有权的模型指纹技术受到了广泛关注。现有的指纹技术依赖于对抗性攻击或后门攻击来构建特定输出的触发图像，通过比较触发图像在疑似模型上的输出与预设输出是否一致来判断模型的归属权。然而，这些方法依赖固定形式的触发图像作为明确的模型指纹，这在隐蔽性和鲁棒性方面存在局限性。受“遗忘学习”研究的启发，我们提出了基于遗忘学习的多模态记忆指纹技术。该技术通过让训练样本中的邻近样本“遗忘”，从而增强训练样本的过拟合特性，进而在数据空间中引入可检测到的泛化能力较差的区域。与以往的方法相比，我们的方法利用LVLMs在邻近样本上的记忆强度差异作为隐式的模型指纹，而不是依赖特定的输入-输出对作为显式的触发因素。这使得该方法在隐蔽性、鲁棒性和适应性方面具有更强的优势。为了模拟真实应用场景，我们进行了广泛的实验，使用了多种策略和不同的数据集，进一步证明了该方法在保护LVLMs所有权方面的优越性。

papers.title: Automatic Correction of Writing Anomalies in Hausa Texts
papers.title_zh: 乌尔都语文本中书写错误的自动校正系统
papers.authors: Ahmad Mustapha Wali, Sergiu Nisioi
papers.abstract: Hausa texts are often characterized by writing anomalies such as incorrect character substitutions and spacing errors, which sometimes hinder natural language processing (NLP) applications. This paper presents an approach to automatically correct the anomalies by finetuning transformer-based models. Using a corpus gathered from several public sources, we create a large-scale parallel dataset of over 400,000 noisy-clean Hausa sentence pairs by introducing synthetically generated noise to mimic realistic writing errors. Moreover, we finetune several multilingual and African language models, including M2M100, AfriTeVA, NCAIR1/N-ATLaS, UBC-NLP/cheetah-base, and other variants of BART and T5 for this correction task. Our experimental results demonstrate that models such as M2M100 achieve state-of-the-art results despite their smaller size and distinct pretraining, and that correcting errors can have a significant impact in improving downstream tasks such as text classification, machine translation, question answering, and LLM prompting in general. This research provides a methodology, a publicly available dataset, and a comparison of models to improve Hausa text quality, thereby advancing NLP capabilities for the language and offering transferable insights for other low-resource languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 豪萨语文本常常存在书写异常现象，例如字符替换错误和间距错误，这些错误有时会阻碍自然语言处理技术的应用。本文提出了一种方法，通过微调基于Transformer的模型来自动纠正这些异常。我们从一个多个公共数据源中收集了数据，创建了一个包含超过400,000对带有噪声处理的豪萨语句子的大规模平行数据集，这些噪声是人为制造的，旨在模拟真实的书写错误。此外，我们还对多个多语言和非洲语言模型进行了微调，包括M2M100、AfriTeVA、NCAIR1/N-ATLaS、UBC-NLP/cheetah-base，以及BART和T5的其他变体模型。我们的实验结果表明，像M2M100这样的模型尽管规模较小且预训练方式不同，但仍然能够取得顶尖的成绩。而且，纠正这些错误对于提升文本分类、机器翻译、问答任务以及大语言模型提示等下游任务的性能有着显著的影响。这项研究提供了一种方法论、一个公开可用的数据集，并比较了不同模型在改善豪萨语文本质量方面的表现，从而提升了该语言的自然语言处理能力，并为其他资源匮乏的语言提供了可借鉴的经验。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: OS-Sentinel: Towards Safety-Enhanced Mobile GUI Agents via Hybrid Validation in Realistic Workflows
papers.title_zh: OS-Sentinel：通过在实际工作流程中的混合验证，实现安全性能提升的移动GUI代理系统
papers.authors: Qiushi Sun, Mukai Li, Zhoumianze Liu, Zhihui Xie, Fangzhi Xu, Zhangyue Yin, Kanzhi Cheng, Zehao Li, Zichen Ding, Qi Liu, Zhiyong Wu, Zhuosheng Zhang, Ben Kao, Lingpeng Kong
papers.abstract: Computer-using agents powered by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated human-like capabilities in operating digital environments like mobile platforms. While these agents hold great promise for advancing digital automation, their potential for unsafe operations, such as system compromise and privacy leakage, is raising significant concerns. Detecting these safety concerns across the vast and complex operational space of mobile environments presents a formidable challenge that remains critically underexplored. To establish a foundation for mobile agent safety research, we introduce MobileRisk-Live, a dynamic sandbox environment accompanied by a safety detection benchmark comprising realistic trajectories with fine-grained annotations. Built upon this, we propose OS-Sentinel, a novel hybrid safety detection framework that synergistically combines a Formal Verifier for detecting explicit system-level violations with a VLM-based Contextual Judge for assessing contextual risks and agent actions. Experiments show that achieves 10%–30% improvements over existing approaches across multiple metrics. Further analysis provides critical insights that foster the development of safer and more reliable autonomous mobile agents. Our code, environment, and data are available at https://qiushisun.github.io/OS-Sentinel-Home/.
papers.abstract_zh: 由视觉语言模型驱动的计算机化智能体在如移动平台这样的数字环境中展现了类似人类的能力。虽然这些智能体为提升数字自动化水平带来了巨大潜力，但它们可能导致的危险操作，比如系统被攻破和隐私泄露等问题，引发了严重的担忧。在移动环境的庞大而复杂的操作空间中识别这些安全隐患是一项极其艰巨的挑战，目前这一领域的研究还远远不够。为了为移动智能体的安全性研究奠定基础，我们推出了MobileRisk-Live这一动态沙盒环境，同时配套了一个包含详细注释的逼真轨迹的安全检测基准。在此基础上，我们提出了OS-Sentinel这一新型混合式安全检测框架，该框架结合了用于检测系统级违规行为的正式验证器，以及用于评估上下文风险和智能体行为的基于视觉语言模型的上下文判断器。实验表明，与现有方法相比，该框架在多个指标上实现了10%到30%的提升。进一步的分析为我们提供了重要的见解，有助于开发更安全和更可靠的自主移动智能体。我们的代码、环境和数据可以在https://qiushisun.github.io/OS-Sentinel-Home/获取。

papers.title: PAM: Enhancing General Alignment of Large Reasoning Models through Priority-Aware Metacognition
papers.title_zh: PAM：通过优先考虑不同任务来提升大型推理模型的整体性能
papers.authors: Zhihao Xu, Fuzhen Yang, Liang Lin, Xiting Wang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have showcased strong performance across various reasoning tasks by leveraging System-2 thinking capabilities. However, existing studies indicate that this reasoning ability alone does not reliably transfer to the general alignment domain. Inspired by cognitive science and how humans solve tasks, we argue that LRMs must be equipped with metacognitive knowledge to fully utilize their System-2 capabilities. In this paper, we propose Priority-Aware Metacognition (PAM), which guides the model to first identify the top-level human preference (e.g., harmlessness) as a means of understanding the alignment task’s nature, and then apply other kinds of metacognitive knowledge to better monitor and regulate the model’s thinking process. We implement PAM via a two-stage pipeline: a cold-start phase that collects structured metacognitive knowledge based on Flavell’s theoretical framework, and a preference-optimization phase that further reinforces such metacognition. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of PAM. Under the same training pipelines, PAM consistently yields higher performance, improving general domain alignment performance by ~10 points on the helpfulness and harmless benchmarks. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PAM-RM-02DF.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在大型推理模型方面的研究进展表明，通过利用系统二思维能力，这些模型在多种推理任务中表现优异。然而，现有研究表明，这种推理能力本身并不能可靠地应用于一般的一致性评估领域。受认知科学以及人类解决问题方式的启发，我们认为大型推理模型必须具备元认知知识，才能充分发挥其系统二思维能力。在本文中，我们提出了“优先级意识元认知”这一方法。该方法首先引导模型识别人类最重视的要素（例如无害性），以此来理解一致性任务的本质；然后运用其他类型的元认知知识来更好地监控和调节模型的思考过程。我们通过一个两阶段流程来实现PAM：第一阶段是冷启动阶段，该阶段基于Flavell的理论框架收集结构化的元认知知识；第二阶段则是偏好优化阶段，该阶段进一步强化这种元认知能力。大量的实验验证了PAM的有效性。在相同训练流程下，PAM始终能带来更高的性能表现，在帮助性和无害性等基准测试中，其性能提升了约10个百分点。相关代码可访问https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PAM-RM-02DF。

papers.title: One Battle After Another: Probing LLMs’ Limits on Multi-Turn Instruction Following with a Benchmark Evolving Framework
papers.title_zh: 一场又一场的战斗：通过一种不断发展的基准框架来探究大型语言模型在多轮指令执行方面的限制
papers.authors: Qi Jia, Ye Shen, Xiujie Song, Kaiwei Zhang, Shibo Wang, Dun Pei, Xiangyang Zhu, Guangtao Zhai
papers.abstract: Evaluating LLMs’ instruction-following ability in multi-topic dialogues is essential yet challenging. Existing benchmarks are limited to a fixed number of turns, susceptible to saturation and failing to account for users’ interactive experience. In this work, we propose a novel framework featuring a three-layer tracking mechanism and a query synthesis agent to mimic sequential user behaviors. Grounded in Flow Theory, we introduce process-centric metrics and terminate a conversational evaluation only upon exhausting user patience. Leveraging this framework, we present EvolIF, an evolving benchmark covering 12 constraint groups. Our analysis reveals deficiencies in failure recovery and fine-grained instruction following, with performance stratification becoming evident as conversational depth increases. GPT-5 demonstrates the most sustained resilience, maintaining a 66.40% stability score, outperforming Gemini-3-Pro by 5.59%, while other models lag behind.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型在多主题对话中的遵循指令能力是一项至关重要但充满挑战的任务。现有的基准测试仅限于固定数量的对话轮次，容易陷入饱和状态，且无法反映用户的互动体验。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架包含三层跟踪机制以及查询合成代理，以模拟用户的连续行为。基于流理论，我们引入了以流程为中心的评估指标，并且只有在耗尽用户耐心时才会终止对话评估。利用这一框架，我们开发了EvolIF这一不断发展的基准测试，该测试涵盖了12个约束组。我们的分析显示，该模型在失败恢复和细粒度指令遵循方面存在不足，随着对话深度的增加，性能分层现象愈发明显。GPT-5表现出最稳定的性能，其稳定性得分达到了66.40%，比Gemini-3-Pro高出5.59%，而其他模型则表现较差。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AGSC: Adaptive Granularity and Semantic Clustering for Uncertainty Quantification in Long-text Generation
papers.title_zh: AGSC：用于长文本生成中不确定性量化的自适应粒度分析与语义聚类技术
papers.authors: Guanran Luo, Wentao Qiu, Wanru Zhao, Wenhan Lv, Zhongquan Jian, Meihong Wang, Qingqiang Wu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in long-form generation, yet their application is hindered by the hallucination problem. While Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is essential for assessing reliability, the complex structure makes reliable aggregation across heterogeneous themes difficult, in addition, existing methods often overlook the nuance of neutral information and suffer from the high computational cost of fine-grained decomposition. To address these challenges, we propose AGSC (Adaptive Granularity and GMM-based Semantic Clustering), a UQ framework tailored for long-form generation. AGSC first uses NLI neutral probabilities as triggers to distinguish irrelevance from uncertainty, reducing unnecessary computation. It then applies Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) soft clustering to model latent semantic themes and assign topic-aware weights for downstream aggregation. Experiments on BIO and LongFact show that AGSC achieves state-of-the-art correlation with factuality while reducing inference time by about 60% compared to full atomic decomposition.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在长文本生成方面展现出了令人印象深刻的性能，但其应用受到了“幻觉问题”的制约。虽然不确定性量化对于评估模型的可靠性至关重要，但复杂的模型结构使得跨不同主题进行可靠聚合变得困难。此外，现有的方法往往忽略了中性信息的细微差别，并且需要耗费大量计算资源来进行细粒度分解。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AGSC（自适应粒度与基于混合模型的语义聚类）这一专为长文本生成设计的不确定性量化框架。AGSC首先利用自然语言推理中的中性概率作为触发器，来区分无关性和不确定性，从而减少不必要的计算量。接着，它采用高斯混合模型进行软聚类，以模拟潜在的语义主题，并为下游聚合分配具有主题感知的权重。在BIO和LongFact数据集上的实验表明，AGSC在保持事实性与准确性的同时，将推理时间减少了约60%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Tracing the Roots: A Multi-Agent Framework for Uncovering Data Lineage in Post-Training LLMs
papers.title_zh: 追溯根源：一种用于揭示训练后大型语言模型数据链路的多智能体框架
papers.authors: Yu Li, Xiaoran Shang, Qizhi Pei, Yun Zhu, Xin Gao, Honglin Lin, Zhanping Zhong, Zhuoshi Pan, Zheng Liu, Xiaoyang Wang, Conghui He, Dahua Lin, Feng Zhao, Lijun Wu
papers.abstract: Post-training data plays a pivotal role in shaping the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet datasets are often treated as isolated artifacts, overlooking the systemic connections that underlie their evolution. To disentangle these complex relationships, we introduce the concept of data lineage to the LLM ecosystem and propose an automated multi-agent framework to reconstruct the evolutionary graph of dataset development. Through large-scale lineage analysis, we characterize domain-specific structural patterns, such as vertical refinement in Math-oriented datasets and horizontal aggregation in General-domain corpora. Moreover, we uncover pervasive systemic issues, including structural redundancy induced by implicit dataset intersections and the propagation of benchmark contamination along lineage paths. To demonstrate the practical value of lineage analysis for data construction, we leverage the reconstructed lineage graph to create a lineage-aware diversity-oriented dataset. By anchoring instruction sampling at upstream leaf sources, this approach mitigates downstream homogenization and hidden redundancy, yielding a more diverse post-training corpus. We further highlight lineage-centric analysis as an efficient and robust topological alternative to sample-level dataset comparison for large-scale data ecosystems. By grounding data construction in explicit lineage structures, our work advances post-training data curation toward a more systematic and controllable paradigm.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练后的数据在塑造大语言模型的能力方面起着至关重要的作用，然而，数据集往往被视作孤立的实体，而忽视了它们演变过程中存在的系统性联系。为了理清这些复杂的关联关系，我们向大语言模型生态系统中引入了数据溯源的概念，并提出了一种自动化的多智能体框架，用于重建数据集发展的演化图谱。通过大规模的溯源分析，我们发现了一些特定领域的结构模式，例如数学类数据集中的垂直细化现象，以及通用领域语料库中的水平聚合现象。此外，我们还发现了一些普遍的系统性问题，包括由隐含的数据集交叉导致的结构冗余，以及基准测试污染沿着溯源路径的传播。为了证明溯源分析在数据构建中的实际价值，我们利用重建的溯源图谱来创建一种注重多样性的数据集。通过将指令采样集中在上游的源头，这种方法能够避免下游的同质化现象和隐藏的冗余问题，从而生成更加多样化的训练后语料库。我们进一步强调，以溯源为中心的分析是一种高效且可靠的拓扑替代方案，可以替代大规模数据生态系统中的样本级数据集比较方法。通过将数据构建建立在明确的溯源结构上，我们的工作使得训练后数据的整理变得更加系统化和可控化。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Understanding or Memorizing? A Case Study of German Definite Articles in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 理解还是记忆？以德语定冠词在语言模型中的应用为例进行探讨
papers.authors: Jonathan Drechsel, Erisa Bytyqi, Steffen Herbold
papers.abstract: Language models perform well on grammatical agreement, but it is unclear whether this reflects rule-based generalization or memorization. We study this question for German definite singular articles, whose forms depend on gender and case. Using GRADIEND, a gradient-based interpretability method, we learn parameter update directions for gender-case specific article transitions. We find that updates learned for a specific gender-case article transition frequently affect unrelated gender-case settings, with substantial overlap among the most affected neurons across settings. These results argue against a strictly rule-based encoding of German definite articles, indicating that models at least partly rely on memorized associations rather than abstract grammatical rules.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型在语法一致性方面表现良好，但尚不清楚这是否反映了基于规则的泛化能力还是记忆机制的作用。我们对德语定冠词的形式进行了研究，因为这些定冠词的形式取决于性别和格的变化。通过使用GRADIEND这一基于梯度的可解释性方法，我们学会了针对特定性别-格转换的参数更新方向。我们发现，为特定性别-格转换所学习的更新参数，往往会影响到与之无关的性别-格组合情况，而且在不同情况下受到影响的神经元之间存在着显著的重叠。这些结果反驳了德语定冠词完全基于规则编码的观点，表明模型至少部分依赖于记忆中的关联信息，而非抽象的语法规则。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Alloc-MoE: Budget-Aware Expert Activation Allocation for Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Inference
papers.title_zh: Alloc-MoE：基于预算的专家激活分配机制，以实现高效的混合专家推理
papers.authors: Baihui Liu, Kaiyuan Tian, Wei Wang, Zhaoning Zhang, Linbo Qiao, Dongsheng Li
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a dominant architecture for scaling large language models due to their sparse activation mechanism. However, the substantial number of expert activations creates a critical latency bottleneck during inference, especially in resource-constrained deployment scenarios. Existing approaches that reduce expert activations potentially lead to severe model performance degradation. In this work, we introduce the concept of activation budget as a constraint on the number of expert activations and propose Alloc-MoE, a unified framework that optimizes budget allocation coordinately at both the layer and token levels to minimize performance degradation. At the layer level, we introduce Alloc-L, which leverages sensitivity profiling and dynamic programming to determine the optimal allocation of expert activations across layers. At the token level, we propose Alloc-T, which dynamically redistributes activations based on routing scores, optimizing budget allocation without increasing latency. Extensive experiments across multiple MoE models demonstrate that Alloc-MoE maintains model performance under a constrained activation budget. Especially, Alloc-MoE achieves 1.15\times prefill and 1.34\times decode speedups on DeepSeek-V2-Lite at half of the original budget.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合模型（Mixture-of-Experts，MoE）由于其稀疏激活机制，已成为扩展大语言模型的主流架构。然而，大量专家的激活在推理过程中会造成严重的延迟瓶颈，尤其是在资源有限的部署场景中。现有减少专家激活的方法可能会导致模型性能严重下降。在本研究中，我们引入了激活预算这一概念，作为对专家激活数量的限制条件，并提出了Alloc-MoE这一统一框架。该框架能够在层和令牌级别上协调地优化预算分配，以最小化性能下降。在层级层面，我们引入了Alloc-L，它利用敏感性分析和动态规划来确定各层之间专家激活的最佳分配方案。在令牌级别，我们提出了Alloc-T，它根据路由得分动态地重新分配激活，从而在不增加延迟的情况下优化预算分配。通过多种MoE模型的广泛实验表明，Alloc-MoE能够在有限的激活预算下保持模型性能。特别地，在DeepSeek-V2-Lite数据集上，Alloc-MoE在预算减半的情况下，实现了1.15倍的预填充速度和1.34倍的解码速度提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CodeEvo: Interaction-Driven Synthesis of Code-centric Data through Hybrid and Iterative Feedback
papers.title_zh: CodeEvo：通过混合式与迭代式反馈实现以代码为中心的数据交互式合成
papers.authors: Qiushi Sun, Jingyang Gong, Lei Li, Qipeng Guo, Fei Yuan
papers.abstract: Acquiring high-quality instruction-code pairs is essential for training Large Language Models for code generation. While automated synthesis has emerged as an alternative to expensive manual curation, current approaches often rely on rigid heuristics, yielding data that is ungrounded or lacks logical complexity. We propose CodeEvo, a dual-agent architecture comprising a Coder for iterative solution synthesis and a Reviewer to orchestrate the generation trajectory. To transcend the limitations of existing heuristics, the Reviewer formulates a Schema to systematically architect logic and complexity through an interleaved synthesis of instructions and code. This process is further reinforced by a hybrid verification protocol synergizing deterministic compiler feedback with semantic evaluation. Under this framework, we construct CodeEvo-100K, a large-scale dataset of instruction–code pairs with stepped difficulty levels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that models fine-tuned on CodeEvo data significantly outperform established baselines across code generation benchmarks. In-depth analyses further provide insights into effective code-centric data synthesis. Code and data are available at https://github.com/QiushiSun/CodeEvo.
papers.abstract_zh: 获取高质量的指导代码对对于训练用于代码生成的大语言模型至关重要。虽然自动化合成已成为替代昂贵的手动筛选方法的替代方案，但当前的方法往往依赖于僵化的启发式规则，从而产生了缺乏实际依据或逻辑复杂性的数据。我们提出了CodeEvo这一双代理架构，其中包括一个用于迭代解决方案合成的编码器，以及一个负责协调生成过程的审核器。为了克服现有启发式的局限性，审核器会制定一个框架，通过指令和代码的混合合成来系统地构建逻辑和复杂性。这一过程还通过一个混合验证协议得到加强，该协议将确定性编译器的反馈与语义评估相结合。在这个框架下，我们构建了CodeEvo-100K这一大规模的指导代码对数据集，其难度级别是逐步递增的。广泛的实验表明，在CodeEvo数据上训练的模型在代码生成基准测试中显著优于现有的基线模型。深入的分析进一步揭示了有效的以代码为中心的数据合成方法。代码和数据可以在https://github.com/QiushiSun/CodeEvo下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Benchmarking and Learning Real-World Customer Service Dialogue
papers.title_zh: 基准对比与真实客户服务对话的学习
papers.authors: Tianhong Gao, Jundong Shen, Jiapeng Wang, Bei Shi, Ying Ju, Junfeng Yao, Huiyu Yu
papers.abstract: Existing benchmarks and training pipelines for industrial intelligent customer service (ICS) remain misaligned with real-world dialogue requirements, overemphasizing verifiable task success while under-measuring subjective service quality and realistic failure modes, leaving a gap between offline gains and deployable dialogue behavior. We close this gap with a benchmark-to-optimization loop: we first introduce OlaBench, an ICS benchmark spanning retrieval-augmented generation, workflow-based systems, and agentic settings, which evaluates service capability, safety, and latency sensitivity; moreover, motivated by OlaBench results showing state-of-the-art LLMs still fall short, we propose OlaMind, which distills reusable reasoning patterns and service strategies from expert dialogues and applies staged exploration–exploitation reinforcement learning with instance-level rubric-aware guidance to improve model capability. OlaMind surpasses GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro on OlaBench (83.64 vs. 70.58/70.84) and, in online A/B tests, delivers an average +23.67% issue resolution and -6.6% human transfer rate versus the baseline, bridging offline gains to deployment. Together, OlaBench and OlaMind advance ICS systems toward more anthropomorphic, professional, and reliable deployment. The project page and evaluation are available at https://olamind-olabench.github.io.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的工业智能客服基准测试与训练流程与现实世界的对话需求并不匹配。这些测试过于强调可验证的任务完成度，而忽视了主观服务质量和实际可能出现的故障情况，导致线下取得的成果与实际部署中的对话行为之间存在差距。我们通过一个基准测试到优化的循环来弥补这一差距：首先，我们引入了OlaBench这一基准测试，它涵盖了检索增强生成、基于工作流程的系统以及代理式设置等多种场景，能够评估服务的性能、安全性以及响应速度对延迟的敏感度。此外，由于OlaBench的结果表明最先进的大语言模型仍然存在不足，我们提出了OlaMind这一方案。该方案能够从专家对话中提取可复用的推理模式和服务策略，并通过分阶段探索-利用强化学习结合实例级评分标准指导，来提高模型的性能。在OlaBench测试中，OlaMind的表现优于GPT-5.2和Gemini 3 Pro（分别为83.64分和70.58/70.84分）。在在线A/B测试中，OlaMind平均提升了23.67%的问题解决能力，并将人工处理问题的比例降低了6.6%，从而实现了线下成果与实际部署之间的衔接。总的来说，OlaBench和OlaMind为工业智能客服系统带来了更加人性化、专业且可靠的解决方案。相关项目的页面和评估结果可以在https://olamind-olabench.github.io查看。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AdaJudge: Adaptive Multi-Perspective Judging for Reward Modeling
papers.title_zh: AdaJudge：自适应多视角判断算法，用于奖励模型构建
papers.authors: Yongliang Miao, Yangyang Liang, Mengnan Du
papers.abstract: Reward modeling is essential for aligning large language models with human preferences, yet predominant architectures rely on a static pooling strategy to condense sequences into scalar scores. This paradigm, however, suffers from two key limitations: a static inductive bias that misaligns with the task-dependent preference signals, and a representational mismatch, as the backbone’s optimization for generation leaves its representations ill-suited to fine-grained discrimination. To address this, we propose AdaJudge, a unified framework that jointly adapts representation and aggregation. AdaJudge first improves backbone representations into a discrimination-oriented space via gated refinement blocks. It then replaces the static readout with an adaptive multi-view pooling module, which dynamically routes and combines evidence. Extensive experiments on RM-Bench and JudgeBench show that AdaJudge outperforms strong off-the-shelf reward models and traditional pooling baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 奖励建模对于使大语言模型符合人类偏好至关重要，然而目前主流的架构仍然依赖静态池化策略来将序列转化为标量分数。然而，这种范式存在两个主要缺陷：一是静态的归纳偏差会导致模型与任务相关的偏好信号不一致；二是由于主干模型的优化方式过于注重生成效果，其表示方式无法很好地处理细粒度的分类任务。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了AdaJudge这一统一框架，该框架能够同时调整表示方式和聚合方式。AdaJudge首先通过门控细化模块将主干模型的表示转化为以分类为导向的形式；然后，它用自适应多视图池化模块替代了传统的静态池化方式，该模块能够动态地整合各种信息。在RM-Bench和JudgeBench上的大量实验表明，AdaJudge在性能上优于许多现成的奖励模型和传统的池化基线方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: IEvoAgent: Evolving Conversational Agent based on User Implicit Feedback
papers.title_zh: IEvoAgent：基于用户隐式反馈的进化型对话代理
papers.authors: Yichen Cai, Jiayang Li, Junyuan Qiu, Jingya Guo, Weitao You, Changyuan Yang, Lingyun Sun, Pei Chen
papers.abstract: Current conversational agents often follow static learning paradigms and miss the implicit, evolving feedback embedded in users’ follow-up behaviors. We propose IEvoAgent, an evolving conversational agent framework that leverages the structured dependency between agent responses and user reactions. We construct an annotated dataset from LMSYS-Chat-1M and WildChat and find consistent response-conditioned feedback patterns. Based on this finding, IEvoAgent uses a conditional feedback distribution matrix to estimate expected feedback rewards, combining offline KTO alignment with an inference-time prompt-evolution mechanism driven by a dynamic matrix. Experiments on MT-Bench-101, WildBench, and FB-Bench show improvements over open-source baselines, indicating that mining implicit feedback supports better multi-turn alignment under evolving user preferences. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Hualeez/IEvoAgent.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的对话代理通常遵循固定的学习范式，而忽略了用户后续行为中隐含的、不断变化的反馈信息。我们提出了IEvoAgent这一不断进化的对话代理框架，该框架利用了代理回应与用户反应之间的结构化依赖关系。我们从LMSYS-Chat-1M和WildChat中构建了一个带有注释的数据集，发现存在一致的基于回应的反馈模式。基于这一发现，IEvoAgent使用条件反馈分布矩阵来估计预期的反馈奖励，将离线KTO对齐方法与由动态矩阵驱动的推理时间提示进化机制相结合。在MT-Bench-101、WildBench和FB-Bench上的实验表明，与开源基线相比，我们的算法取得了更好的性能，这说明挖掘隐式反馈有助于在不断变化的使用者偏好下实现更好的多轮对话对齐。我们的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/Hualeez/IEvoAgent下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SGPVT: Self-Generated Proximal Visual Tokens for Mitigating Proximal Collateral Damage in MLLM Unlearning
papers.title_zh: SGPVT：自生成的近端视觉令牌，用于减少MLLM遗忘过程中产生的近端附带损害
papers.authors: Jiaqi Li, Zhijing Zhang, Jiahui Geng, Sheng Bi, Chuanyi Zhang, Fan Liu, Guilin Qi
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) aims to remove specific concepts while preserving overall utility. However, existing approaches focus primarily on general utility metrics, overlooking the preservation of semantically related concepts. We present the first systematic analysis of this proximal collateral damage, revealing that forgetting vulnerability correlates strongly with visual embedding similarity in a smooth gradient across the semantic space. Based on this insight, we propose a novel unlearning framework that introduces Self-Generated Proximal Visual Tokens (SGPVTs), which are synthetically perturbed visual representations around the target concept. Our method employs an adaptive cosine-band curriculum with a dual-stream objective: forgetting the target via gradient ascent while distilling knowledge from a frozen teacher model into proximal tokens to prevent degradation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing methods in preserving semantically related concepts while achieving effective target unlearning, eliminating the need for manual retention set curation. Our source code will be released in the near future.
papers.abstract_zh: 在多模态大语言模型中，机器去学习的目的在于去除某些特定概念，同时保留整体的实用性。然而，现有的方法主要关注的是整体实用性指标，而忽视了与概念相关的语义信息的保留。我们首次对这种间接的附带损失进行了系统分析，发现遗忘的脆弱性与视觉嵌入的相似性之间存在强烈的关联，这种关联在语义空间中呈平滑渐变趋势。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种新颖的去学习框架——自生成近邻视觉令牌（SGPVTs），该框架通过合成方式对目标概念周围的视觉表示进行扰动。我们的方法采用自适应余弦带训练策略，并设定了双流目标：通过梯度上升的方式去除目标概念，同时将来自冻结教师模型的知识提取到近邻令牌中，以防止知识退化。大量实验表明，我们的方法在保留与概念相关的语义信息方面显著优于现有方法，同时能够实现有效的目标去学习，无需手动管理保留集。我们的源代码将在不久的将来发布。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VIGIL: Defending LLM Agents Against Tool-Stream Injection via Verify-Before-Commit
papers.title_zh: VIGIL：通过“验证前提交”机制来保护大型语言模型代理免受工具流注入攻击
papers.authors: Junda Lin, Zhaomeng Zhou, Zhi Zheng, Shuochen Liu, Tong Xu, Yong Chen, Enhong Chen
papers.abstract: LLM agents operating in open environments face escalating risks from indirect prompt injection, particularly within the tool stream where manipulated metadata and runtime feedback hijack execution flow. Existing defenses encounter a critical dilemma as advanced models prioritize injected rules due to strict alignment while static protection mechanisms sever the feedback loop required for adaptive reasoning. To reconcile this conflict, we propose VIGIL, a framework that shifts the paradigm from restrictive isolation to a verify-before-commit protocol. By facilitating speculative hypothesis generation and enforcing safety through intent-grounded verification, VIGIL preserves reasoning flexibility while ensuring robust control. We further introduce SIREN, a benchmark comprising 959 tool stream injection cases designed to simulate pervasive threats characterized by dynamic dependencies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VIGIL outperforms state-of-the-art dynamic defenses by reducing the attack success rate by over 22% while more than doubling the utility under attack compared to static baselines, thereby achieving an optimal balance between security and utility. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Touring-686/vigil.
papers.abstract_zh: 在开放环境中运行的大语言模型智能体面临着日益严重的风险，尤其是来自间接指令注入的威胁。在工具流中，被操纵的元数据和运行时的反馈会劫持执行流程。现有的防御机制面临一个关键难题：先进模型倾向于优先执行被注入的规则，因为严格的一致性要求；而静态保护机制则会切断自适应推理所需的反馈回路。为了解决这一矛盾，我们提出了VIGIL框架。该框架将防御模式从严格的隔离转变为“验证后再执行”的策略。通过促进推测性假设的生成，并通过基于意图的验证来确保安全性，VIGIL既保留了推理的灵活性，又确保了强大的控制能力。此外，我们还引入了SIREN基准测试，该测试包含959种工具流注入案例，旨在模拟具有动态依赖关系的各种威胁。大量实验表明，VIGIL与最先进的动态防御机制相比，将攻击成功率降低超过 22%；与静态基线相比，攻击下的效用提高至两倍以上，从而实现了安全性与实用性之间的最佳平衡。我们的代码可以在以下链接查看：https://github.com/Touring-686/vigil
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: “I See What You Did There”: Can Large Vision-Language Models Understand Multimodal Puns?
papers.title_zh: “我明白你的意图了”：大型语言模型能理解多模态双关语吗？
papers.authors: Naen Xu, Jiayi Sheng, Changjiang Li, Chunyi Zhou, Yuyuan Li, Tianyu Du, Jun Wang, Zhihui Fu, Jinbao Li, Shouling Ji
papers.abstract: Puns are a common form of rhetorical wordplay that exploits polysemy and phonetic similarity to create humor. In multimodal puns, visual and textual elements synergize to ground the literal sense and evoke the figurative meaning simultaneously. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely used in multimodal understanding and generation, their ability to understand puns has not been systematically studied due to a scarcity of rigorous benchmarks. To address this, we first propose a multimodal pun generation pipeline. We then introduce MultiPun, a dataset comprising diverse types of puns alongside adversarial non-pun distractors. Our evaluation reveals that most models struggle to distinguish genuine puns from these distractors. Moreover, we propose both prompt-level and model-level strategies to enhance pun comprehension, with an average improvement of 16.5% in F1 scores. Our findings provide valuable insights for developing future VLMs that master the subtleties of human-like humor via cross-modal reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 双关语是一种常见的修辞游戏形式，它利用多义性和语音相似性来创造幽默效果。在多模态双关语中，视觉和文本元素相互协作，既强化字面意义，又同时引发隐喻含义。尽管视觉语言模型在多模态理解和生成方面得到了广泛应用，但由于缺乏严格的评估基准，它们对双关语的理解能力尚未得到系统研究。为此，我们首先提出了一种多模态双关语生成流程。随后，我们引入了MultiPun数据集，该数据集包含了各种类型的双关语以及用于干扰的虚假内容。我们的评估结果显示，大多数模型难以区分真正的双关语和这些虚假内容。此外，我们还提出了一些策略，包括提示级策略和模型级策略，以提升模型对双关语的理解能力，平均提升了16.5%的F1分数。我们的研究结果为开发能够通过跨模态推理来理解人类幽默的视觉语言模型提供了宝贵的启示。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TRACE: Traversal Retrieval-Augmented Chain of Evidence for Document Understanding
papers.title_zh: TRACE：基于遍历检索的文档理解证据链
papers.authors: Liqi He, Zuchao Li, Hao Huang, Ping Wang
papers.abstract: Early Long-context Document Visual Question Answering (DocVQA) methods struggle with preserving visual semantics or handling finite context windows. Conversely, recent RAG-based approaches suffer from “semantic gaps” and “structural disconnections” due to passive retrieval mechanisms that ignore logical dependencies. To address these challenges, we introduce TRACE (Traversal Retrieval-Augmented Chain of Evidence). By navigating a Bi-Layered Graph that encodes both physical adjacency and semantic relevance, TRACE transforms retrieval from static matching into adaptive evidence chain construction. Furthermore, we propose M5BookVQA, a benchmark designed to assess deep, multi-hop reasoning in books, addressing the limitations of existing datasets. Extensive experiments show that TRACE achieves an average accuracy improvement of 14.07% on M5BookVQA and exhibits robust generalization with a 13.38% gain across four established benchmarks. Our source code is available at https://github.com/shimurenhlq/TRACE.
papers.abstract_zh: 早期的Long-context文档视觉问答（DocVQA）方法在保留视觉语义或处理有限上下文窗口方面存在困难。相反，最近的基于RAG的方法由于采用忽略逻辑依赖性的被动检索机制，而出现“语义空白”和“结构脱节”的问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了TRACE（带有检索增强的证据链）。通过遍历一个同时编码物理邻接关系和语义相关性的双层图，TRACE将静态匹配的检索方式转变为自适应证据链构建。此外，我们还提出了M5BookVQA这一基准测试，旨在评估书籍中的深度多跳推理能力，从而弥补现有数据集的局限性。大量实验表明，TRACE在M5BookVQA任务上的平均准确率提升了14.07%，并且在四个已建立的基准测试中表现出13.38%的泛化能力提升。我们的源代码可以在https://github.com/shimurenhlq/TRACE获取。

papers.title: FinKario: Event-Enhanced Automated Construction of Financial Knowledge Graph
papers.title_zh: FinKario：基于事件驱动的金融知识图谱自动构建工具
papers.authors: Xiang Li, Penglei Sun, Wanyun Zhou, Zikai Wei, Yongqi Zhang, Xiaowen Chu
papers.abstract: Individual investors are significantly outnumbered and disadvantaged in financial markets, overwhelmed by abundant information and lacking professional analysis. Equity research reports stand out as crucial resources, offering valuable insights. By leveraging these reports, large language models (LLMs) can enhance investors’ decision-making capabilities and strengthen financial analysis. However, two key challenges limit their effectiveness: (1) the rapid evolution of market events often outpaces the slow update cycles of existing knowledge bases, (2) the long-form and unstructured nature of financial reports further hinders timely and context-aware integration by LLMs. To address these challenges, we tackle both data and methodological aspects. First, we introduce the Event-Enhanced Automated Construction of Financial Knowledge Graph (FinKario), a dataset comprising over 305,360 entities, 210,328 relational triples, and 19 distinct relation types. FinKario automatically integrates real-time company fundamentals and market events through prompt-driven extraction guided by professional institutional templates, providing structured and accessible financial insights for LLMs. Additionally, we propose a Two-Stage, Graph-Based retrieval strategy (FinKario-RAG), optimizing the retrieval of evolving, large-scale financial knowledge to ensure efficient and precise data access. Extensive experiments show that FinKario with FinKario-RAG achieves superior stock trend prediction accuracy, outperforming financial LLMs by 18.81% and institutional strategies by 17.85% on average in backtesting. [Our code is available at https://github.com/Jackson906E/FinKario.]
papers.abstract_zh: 个人投资者在金融市场中处于明显的劣势，他们面临着海量的信息，却缺乏专业的分析能力。因此，股票研究报告成为了非常重要的资源，它们提供了宝贵的洞察力。通过利用这些报告，大语言模型能够提升投资者的决策能力，并加强财务分析的效果。然而，有两个关键问题限制了它们的有效性：(1)市场事件的快速变化往往超过了现有知识库的更新速度；(2)财务报告的长篇性质和非结构化特点，进一步阻碍了语言模型对信息的及时和上下文感知整合。为了应对这些问题，我们同时解决了数据和方法论方面的问题。首先，我们提出了“事件增强型自动构建金融知识图谱”这一数据集，该数据集包含超过305,360个实体、210,328条关系三元组以及19种不同的关系类型。FinKario能够自动整合实时公司的基本信息和市场事件，通过专业机构模板引导的提示式提取方式，为语言模型提供结构化和易于理解的金融信息。此外，我们还提出了一种基于图的双阶段检索策略——FinKario-RAG，该策略优化了对动态变化的海量金融知识的检索，确保了数据的高效和精准获取。大量的实验表明，结合FinKario和FinKario-RAG的模型在股票趋势预测方面表现更为出色，在回测中平均比传统的金融语言模型和机构策略高出18.81%和17.85%的准确率。[我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Jackson906E/FinKario下载。]

papers.title: EvoSci: A Bio-Inspired Multi-Agent Framework for the Evolution of Scientific Discovery
papers.title_zh: EvoSci：一种基于生物启发式的多智能体框架，用于促进科学发现的发展
papers.authors: Xiaoyu Xiong, Yuqi Ren, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs), have shown strong potential in scientific discovery, yet existing methods still face substantial challenges in the design of research workflows and multi-role collaboration mechanisms. To mitigate these issues, we propose EvoSci, a multi-agent scientific collaboration framework, which integrates bio-inspired evolution with knowledge graph modeling. To iteratively generate, evaluate, and refine research ideas, EvoSci incorporates multiple role-based agents, including mentor, researcher, and reviewer. By combining collaborative reasoning, shared memory, and evolutionary feedback, EvoSci significantly enhances the coherence and creativity of scientific exploration. Experiments on real-world research topics demonstrate that EvoSci significantly outperforms strong baselines in LLM-based structured peer-review and comparative ranking evaluations, achieving the highest overall peer-review score (ICLR 4.90) and top ranking (Top-10 = 54). These results suggest its superiority in both scientific idea generation and continuous discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在科学发现方面展现出巨大的潜力，然而现有方法在设计研究工作流程和多角色协作机制方面仍面临诸多挑战。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了EvoSci这一多智能体科学协作框架，该框架将生物启发式进化与知识图谱建模相结合。为了迭代生成、评估和完善研究思路，EvoSci引入了多种基于角色的智能体，包括导师、研究人员和评审员。通过结合协作推理、共享记忆和进化反馈机制，EvoSci显著提升了科学探索的连贯性和创造性。针对现实世界的研究课题进行的实验表明，EvoSci在基于语言模型的结构化同行评审和比较排名评估中表现远超其他强基线算法，取得了最高的整体同行评审分数（ICLR 4.90）以及顶尖排名（前10名中占54位）。这些结果证明了EvoSci在科学思路生成和持续发现方面的卓越性能。

papers.title: DREAM: Deep Research Evaluation with Agentic Metrics
papers.title_zh: 梦想：基于主动式指标的深入研究评估
papers.authors: Elad Ben Avraham, ChangHao Li, Ron Dorfman, Roy Ganz, Oren Nuriel, Amir Dudai, Aviad Aberdam, Noah Flynn, Elman Mansimov, Aditya Kalyanpur, Ron Litman
papers.abstract: Deep Research Agents generate analyst-grade reports, yet evaluating them remains challenging due to the absence of a single ground truth and the multidimensional nature of research quality. Recent benchmarks propose distinct methodologies, yet they suffer from the Mirage of Synthesis, where strong surface-level fluency and citation alignment can obscure underlying factual and reasoning defects. We characterize this gap by introducing a taxonomy across four verticals that exposes a critical capability mismatch: static evaluators inherently lack the tool-use capabilities required to assess temporal validity and factual correctness. To address this, we propose DREAM (Deep Research Evaluation with Agentic Metrics), a framework that instantiates the principle of capability parity by making evaluation itself agentic. DREAM structures assessment through an evaluation protocol combining query-agnostic metrics with adaptive metrics generated by a tool-calling agent, enabling temporally aware coverage, grounded verification, and systematic reasoning probes. Controlled evaluations demonstrate DREAM is significantly more sensitive to factual and temporal decay than existing benchmarks, offering a scalable, reference-free evaluation paradigm.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度研究代理能够生成分析师级别的报告，但由于缺乏统一的基准标准以及研究质量的多维特性，对其进行评估仍然具有挑战性。最近的评估基准提出了不同的方法，但这些方法都存在“合成迷雾”的问题——即表面上的流畅性和引用一致性可能会掩盖潜在的事实错误和推理缺陷。我们通过引入一个涵盖四个方面的分类体系来揭示这一差距：静态评估工具本质上缺乏评估时间有效性和事实正确性的能力。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了DREAM（基于代理指标的深度研究评估）框架。该框架通过让评估过程具有代理性质，实现了能力平等的原则。DREAM通过一种评估协议来组织评估过程，该协议结合了与查询无关的指标和由工具调用代理生成的自适应指标，从而实现时间感知的覆盖、基于事实的验证以及系统的推理测试。经过控制的评估表明，DREAM在识别事实错误和时间推移方面明显优于现有的评估基准，提供了一种可扩展且无需参考的评估范式。

papers.title: ThinkPersona: Thinking with Persona Graphs for Faithful Individualized Role-Playing
papers.title_zh: ThinkPersona：基于人物图的个性化角色扮演游戏解决方案
papers.authors: Yichen Cai, Pei Chen, Jiayang Li, Jingya Guo, Zejian Li, Changyuan Yang, Lingyun Sun
papers.abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly utilized as Role-Playing Agents (RPAs) to simulate personas in interactive settings. However, current RPAs often produce flattened and stereotypical personas with limited depth and fidelity. This limitation arises from two core challenges: insufficient modeling of complex personal histories and internal logic, and ungrounded reasoning that fails to preserve persona coherence as dialogue context evolves. To address these challenges, we propose ThinkPersona, a role-playing agent trained to explicitly ground responses in individual identity. We introduce Persona Graphs as structured representations that encode life trajectories, values, relationships, and events as interconnected knowledge. We construct 1,201 Persona Graphs from real-world interviews and derive a Question–Reasoning–Answer (QRA) dataset of 23,401 samples that supervises reasoning over persona evidence. Fine-tuning on QRA enables ThinkPersona to internalize persona logic and generate persona-consistent responses in long-context dialogues. Experiments on three benchmarks show that ThinkPersona improves role-playing fidelity, behavioral consistency, and grounded reasoning over existing methods, while preserving general instruction-following capabilities. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Hualeez/ThinkPersona.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作角色扮演代理，用于模拟在互动环境中的角色。然而，目前的角色扮演代理往往会产生表面化、刻板化的角色形象，这些角色的深度和真实性都有限。这种局限性源于两个核心问题：对复杂个人经历和内在逻辑建模不足，以及缺乏基于实际情境的推理能力，导致角色连贯性在对话过程中无法得到维护。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了ThinkPersona这一角色扮演代理，它被训练成能够明确地将回应与个体身份联系起来。我们引入了“角色图”这一结构化表示方式，它将人生轨迹、价值观、人际关系和事件编码为相互关联的知识。我们通过真实世界的访谈收集了1,201个角色图，并构建了一个包含23,401个样本的问题-推理-回答数据集，用于监督对角色证据的推理过程。在QRA数据集上进行微调后，ThinkPersona能够内化角色逻辑，并在长文本对话中生成符合角色一致性的回应。在三个基准测试中的实验表明，与现有方法相比，ThinkPersona在角色扮演的真实性、行为一致性以及基于实际情境的推理能力方面都有显著提升，同时仍然保持了基本的指令遵循能力。我们的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/Hualeez/ThinkPersona下载。

papers.title: Sparrow: Text-Anchored Window Attention with Visual-Semantic Glimpsing for Speculative Decoding in Video LLMs
papers.title_zh: 麻雀：基于文本驱动的窗口注意力机制与视觉语义感知的结合，用于视频大语言模型中的推测性解码
papers.authors: Libo Zhang, Zhaoning Zhang, Hongwanyang, Peng Qiao, Dongsheng Li
papers.abstract: Although speculative decoding is widely used to accelerate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) inference, it faces severe performance collapse when applied to Video Large Language Models (Vid-LLMs). The draft model typically falls into the trap of attention dilution and negative visual gain due to key-value cache explosion and context window mismatches. We observe a visual semantic internalization phenomenon in Vid-LLMs, indicating that critical visual semantics are implicitly encoded into text hidden states during deep-layer interactions, which renders raw visual inputs structurally redundant during deep inference. To address this, we propose the Sparrow framework, which first utilizes visually-aware text-anchored window attention via hidden state reuse to fully offload visual computation to the target model, and leverages intermediate-layer visual state bridging to train the draft model with semantic-rich intermediate states, thereby filtering out low-level visual noise. Additionally, a multi-token prediction strategy is introduced to bridge the training-inference distribution shift. Experiments show that Sparrow achieves an average speedup of 2.82x even with 25k visual tokens, effectively resolving the performance degradation in long sequences and offering a practical solution for real-time long video tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管推测性解码被广泛用于加速视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理过程，但当应用于视频大语言模型（Vid-LLMs）时，其性能会严重下降。由于键值缓存爆炸和上下文窗口不匹配的问题，初步模型往往会陷入注意力分散和视觉信息获取不足的困境。我们观察到在Vid-LLMs中存在一种视觉语义内化的现象，即关键视觉语义在深层交互过程中被隐式编码到文本隐藏状态中，这使得原始视觉输入在深度推理过程中出现结构上的冗余。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Sparrow框架：首先通过隐藏状态的重用，利用具有视觉感知能力的文本锚定窗口注意力机制，将视觉计算任务完全转移给目标模型；同时利用中间层的视觉状态桥接技术，以语义丰富的中间状态来训练初步模型，从而过滤掉低级的视觉噪声。此外，我们还引入了多标记预测策略，以应对训练与推理之间的分布差异问题。实验表明，即使在处理25k视觉标记的情况下，Sparrow也能实现2.82倍的加速效果，有效解决了长序列数据中的性能下降问题，为实时处理长视频任务提供了实用的解决方案。

papers.title: SPEAK: Spiking Neurons as an Entropy-Aware Tokenizer for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SPEAK：作为熵感知的标记器，用于大型语言模型中的神经元激活机制
papers.authors: Ming Chen, Wenyao Li, Chao Liang, Shi Gu, Peng Lin, De Ma, Huajin Tang, Qian Zheng, Gang Pan
papers.abstract: Tokenizers play a critical role in large language model studies. Despite recent advances, existing tokenizers fail to explicitly leverage historical tokenization results when making subsequent token decisions, nor do they selectively utilize such history based on contextual relevance. We propose SPEAK, a tokenizer that integrates spiking neurons to explicitly leverage historical tokenization results. Furthermore, we introduce an entropy-aware reset mechanism that selectively leverages history based on contextual relevance, which is determined by token-level entropy. High-entropy tokens are treated as contextual boundaries, whereas low-entropy tokens between consecutive such boundaries exhibit strong contextual relevance. Accordingly, we induce hard reset at high-entropy tokens to discard irrelevant historical tokenization results, and soft reset at low-entropy tokens to preserve and leverage relevant history. Experiments on 2 language models and 5 datasets spanning 16 languages demonstrate superior cross-lingual adaptability, with competitive performance and efficiency. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/zju-bmi-lab/SPEAK.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型研究中，分词器起着至关重要的作用。尽管最近取得了一些进展，但现有的分词器在做出后续分词决策时，并未能够明确地利用历史分词结果，也没有根据上下文相关性选择性地利用这些历史信息。我们提出了SPEAK这一分词器，它整合了尖峰神经元，从而能够明确地利用历史分词结果。此外，我们还引入了一种基于熵的重置机制，该机制能够根据上下文相关性选择性地利用历史信息，而上下文相关性是由词级熵来确定的。高熵的词被视作上下文边界，而连续存在于这些边界之间的低熵词则表现出强烈的上下文相关性。因此，我们在高熵词处进行硬重置，以丢弃无关的历史分词结果；而在低熵词处进行软重置，以保留并利用相关的历史信息。我们在两种语言模型和涵盖16种语言的5个数据集上的实验表明，SPEAK具有出色的跨语言适应性，其性能和效率也相当出色。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/zju-bmi-lab/SPEAK上免费获取。

papers.title: Unlocking Implicit Experience: Synthesizing Tool-Use Trajectories from Text
papers.title_zh: 解锁隐性体验：从文本中整合工具使用轨迹
papers.authors: Zhihao Xu, Rumei Li, Jiahuan Li, Rongxiang Weng, Jingang Wang, Xunliang Cai, Xiting Wang
papers.abstract: Enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to effectively utilize tools in multi-turn interactions is essential for building capable autonomous agents. However, acquiring diverse and realistic multi-turn tool-use data remains a significant challenge. In this work, we propose a novel text-based paradigm. We observe that textual corpora naturally contain rich, multi-step problem-solving experiences, which can serve as an untapped, scalable, and authentic data source for multi-turn tool-use tasks. Based on this insight, we introduce GEM, a data synthesis pipeline that enables the generation and extraction of multi-turn tool-use trajectories from text corpora through a four-stage process: relevance filtering, workflow tool extraction, trajectory grounding, and complexity refinement. To reduce the computational cost, we further train a specialized Trajectory Synthesizer via supervised fine-tuning. This model distills the complex generation pipeline into an efficient, end-to-end trajectory generator. Experiments demonstrate that our GEM-32B achieve a 14.9% improvement on the BFCL V3 Multi-turn benchmark. Our models partially surpass the performance of models trained on -bench (Airline and Retail) in-domain data, highlighting the superior generalization capability derived from our text-based synthesis paradigm. Notably, our Trajectory Synthesizer matches the quality of the full pipeline while significantly reducing inference latency and costs.
papers.abstract_zh: 让大语言模型在多轮交互中有效利用各种工具，对于构建具备自主能力的智能体至关重要。然而，获取多样化且真实的多轮工具使用数据仍然是一个重大挑战。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种基于文本的新方法。我们发现，文本语料库自然包含了丰富、多步骤的问题解决经验，这些经验可以作为多轮工具使用任务的未充分利用、可扩展且真实的数据来源。基于这一发现，我们提出了GEM这一数据合成流程，该流程通过四个阶段来实现从文本语料库中生成和提取多轮工具使用轨迹：相关性过滤、工作流程工具提取、轨迹定位以及复杂性优化。为了降低计算成本，我们还通过监督式微调训练了一个专门的轨迹合成器。这个模型将复杂的生成流程简化为一个高效的端到端轨迹生成器。实验表明，我们的GEM-32B模型在BFCL V3多轮基准测试上取得了14.9%的改进。我们的模型部分超越了在特定领域数据（如航空和零售行业）上训练的模型的性能，这充分体现了我们基于文本的合成方法的卓越泛化能力。值得注意的是，我们的轨迹合成器在保持完整流程质量的同时，显著降低了推理的延迟和成本。

papers.title: A Layer-wise Analysis of Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 有监督微调的逐层分析
papers.authors: Qinghua Zhao, Xueling Gong, Xinyu Chen, Zhongfeng Kang, Xinlu Li
papers.abstract: While critical for alignment, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) incurs the risk of catastrophic forgetting, yet the layer-wise emergence of instruction-following capabilities remains elusive. We investigate this mechanism via a comprehensive analysis utilizing information-theoretic, geometric, and optimization metrics across model scales (1B-32B). Our experiments reveal a distinct depth-dependent pattern: middle layers (20%-80%) are stable, whereas final layers exhibit high sensitivity. Leveraging this insight, we propose Mid-Block Efficient Tuning, which selectively updates these critical intermediate layers. Empirically, our method outperforms standard LoRA up to 10.2% on GSM8K (OLMo2-7B) with reduced parameter overhead, demonstrating that effective alignment is architecturally localized rather than distributed. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lshowway/base.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然监督微调在确保模型对齐方面起着至关重要的作用，但它也面临着灾难性遗忘的风险。此外，模型各层逐渐具备遵循指令的能力这一特性仍然难以捉摸。我们通过全面的分析来研究这一机制，运用了信息论、几何学以及优化等方法来评估模型在不同规模（从10亿到320亿参数）下的表现。实验结果表明，模型的中间层（占20%到80%）具有稳定性，而最后一层则表现出高度敏感性。基于这一发现，我们提出了“中块高效调优”方法，该方法能够选择性地更新这些关键的中间层。实证结果显示，我们的方法在GSM8K数据集上的性能优于传统的LoRA方法，且参数数量减少了10.2%。这表明，有效的模型对齐实际上是局部化的，而非分布式实现的。相关代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/lshowway/base
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Think in Latent Thoughts: A New Paradigm for Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
papers.title_zh: 用潜意识思维进行思考：无口音手语翻译的新模式
papers.authors: Yiyang Jiang, Li Zhang, Xiao-Yong Wei, Li Qing
papers.abstract: Many SLT systems quietly assume that brief chunks of signing map directly to spoken-language words. That assumption breaks down because signers often create meaning on the fly using context, space, and movement. We revisit SLT and argue that it is mainly a cross-modal reasoning task, not just a straightforward video-to-text conversion. We thus introduce a reasoning-driven SLT framework that uses an ordered sequence of latent thoughts as an explicit middle layer between the video and the generated text. These latent thoughts gradually extract and organize meaning over time. On top of this, we use a plan-then-ground decoding method: the model first decides what it wants to say, and then looks back at the video to find the evidence. This separation improves coherence and faithfulness. We also built and released a new large-scale gloss-free SLT dataset with stronger context dependencies and more realistic meanings. Experiments across several benchmarks show consistent gains over existing gloss-free methods. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/fletcherjiang/SignThought.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多手语转换系统都错误地认为，手语中的简短表达可以直接对应到口语词汇。但这种假设并不成立，因为手语使用者往往需要根据上下文、空间以及动作来即兴创造意义。我们重新审视了手语转换技术，认为它本质上是一种跨模态的推理过程，而不仅仅是简单的视频到文本的转换。因此，我们提出了一种基于推理的手语转换框架，该框架将一系列潜在的思想作为视频与生成文本之间的中间层。这些潜在的思想会随着时间的推移逐渐提取并组织出有意义的表达。此外，我们采用了一种“先规划后解码”的方法：模型首先决定要说什么，然后再查看视频中的相关线索来寻找证据。这种分离方式提升了系统的连贯性和准确性。我们还构建并发布了一个新的大规模无字幕手语转换数据集，该数据集具有更强的上下文依赖性以及更真实的意义表达。在多个基准测试中的实验结果表明，我们的方法相较于现有的无字幕方法取得了显著的进步。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/fletcherjiang/SignThought上获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CTRAP: Embedding Collapse Trap to Safeguard Large Language Models from Harmful Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: CTRAP：引入“崩溃陷阱”机制，以保护大型语言模型免受有害的微调行为的影响
papers.authors: Biao Yi, Tiansheng Huang, Baolei Zhang, Tong Li, Lihai Nie, Zheli Liu, Li Shen
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning-as-a-service, while commercially successful for Large Language Model (LLM) providers, exposes models to harmful fine-tuning attacks. As a widely explored defense paradigm against such attacks, unlearning attempts to remove malicious knowledge from LLMs, thereby essentially preventing them from being used to perform malicious tasks. However, we highlight a critical flaw: the inherent general adaptability of LLMs allows them to easily bypass selective unlearning by rapidly relearning or repurposing their general capabilities for harmful tasks. To address this fundamental limitation, we propose a paradigm shift: instead of selective removal, we advocate for inducing model collapse, effectively forcing the model to ”unlearn everything”, specifically in response to updates characteristic of malicious adaptation. This collapse directly neutralizes the very general capabilities that attackers exploit, tackling the core issue unaddressed by selective unlearning. We introduce the Collapse Trap (CTRAP) as a practical mechanism to implement this concept conditionally. Embedded during alignment, CTRAP pre-configures the model’s reaction to subsequent fine-tuning dynamics. If updates during fine-tuning constitute a persistent attempt to reverse safety alignment, the pre-configured trap triggers a progressive degradation of the model’s core language modeling abilities, ultimately rendering it inert and useless for the attacker. Crucially, this collapse mechanism remains dormant during benign fine-tuning, ensuring the model’s utility and general capabilities are preserved.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然“微调服务”模式在大语言模型提供商中取得了商业上的成功，但这种模式也会让模型面临有害的微调攻击。作为一种被广泛采用的防御手段，反学习技术旨在从语言模型中移除恶意知识，从而防止其被用于执行恶意任务。然而，我们指出了一个关键缺陷：语言模型具有极强的通用性，这使得它们能够轻易地通过快速重新学习或重新利用自身能力来执行有害任务，从而绕过反学习机制。为了克服这一根本限制，我们提出了一种全新的解决方案：与其选择性地移除模型知识，不如诱导模型崩溃，迫使模型“忘掉一切”。具体来说，当遇到恶意适应的更新时，模型就会陷入这种崩溃状态。这种崩溃直接削弱了攻击者可以利用的通用能力，从而解决了反学习机制无法解决的核心问题。我们提出了“崩溃陷阱”这一实用机制，用于在特定情况下实现这一目标。该机制会在模型对齐过程中预先配置出对后续微调动态的应对方式。如果微调过程中的更新表明存在持续试图破坏安全对齐的行为，那么预先配置的陷阱会逐步降低模型的核心语言建模能力，最终使模型对攻击者变得毫无用处。重要的是，在正常的微调过程中，这种崩溃机制是处于休眠状态的，从而确保了模型的实用性和通用能力得以保留。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Correct When Paired, Wrong When Split: Decoupling and Editing Modality-Specific Neurons in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: 配对时正确，分离时错误：在MLLMs中分离和编辑特定模态的神经元
papers.authors: Tingchao Fu, Wenkai Wang, Fanxiao Li, Huadong Zhang, Jinhong Zhang, Dayang Li, Yunyun Dong, Renyang Liu, Wei Zhou
papers.abstract: Although Knowledge Editing provides an efficient mechanism for updating the knowledge of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), we find that current paradigms still suffer from an important yet remain underexplored issue : editing decoupling failure, where entity-related knowledge can be updated when the model is triggered by multimodal inputs (text–image query pairs), however, it often reverts to outdated pre-edit facts when the paired inputs are split into unimodal ones. Our in-depth empirical analysis reveals that the entity knowledge in MLLMs is not stored as a unified representation, but is instead distributed across disentangled modality-specific pathways. As a result, updates biased toward multimodal queries fail to propagate effectively to unimodal circuits. To bridge this gap, we propose DECODE, which explicitly disentangles and localizes modality-specific neuron groups for targeted knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DECODE consistently achieves effective knowledge updates under different modality triggers, thereby mitigating editing decoupling failures.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然知识编辑为更新多模态大语言模型的知识提供了一种高效的机制，但我们发现当前的方法仍然存在一个重要且尚未被充分探索的问题：编辑分离失败。即当模型受到多模态输入（文本-图像查询对）的触发时，与实体相关的知识可以被更新，但当这些输入被拆分为单模态输入时，这些知识往往会恢复到过时的预编辑状态。我们的深入实证分析表明，多模态大语言模型中的实体知识并非以统一的格式存储，而是分散在各自独立的模态特定路径中。因此，针对多模态查询进行的更新无法有效地传播到单模态电路中。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了DECODE算法。该算法能够明确分离并定位各模态特定的神经元群，从而实现有针对性的知识更新。大量的实验表明，DECODE在不同模态触发下都能实现有效的知识更新，从而有效解决了编辑分离失败的问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ACIArena: Toward Unified Evaluation for Agent Cascading Injection
papers.title_zh: ACIArena：迈向代理级注入技术统一评估标准
papers.authors: Hengyu An, Minxi Li, Jinghuai Zhang, Naen Xu, Chunyi Zhou, Changjiang Li, Xiaogang Xu, Tianyu Du, Shouling Ji
papers.abstract: Collaboration and information sharing empower Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) but also introduce a critical security risk known as Agent Cascading Injection (ACI). In such attacks, a compromised agent exploits inter-agent trust to propagate malicious instructions, causing cascading failures across the system. However, existing studies consider only limited attack strategies and simplified MAS settings, limiting their generalizability and comprehensive evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce ACIArena, a unified framework for evaluating the robustness of MAS. ACIArena offers systematic evaluation suites spanning multiple attack surfaces (i.e., external inputs, agent profiles, inter-agent messages) and attack objectives (i.e., instruction hijacking, task disruption, information exfiltration). Specifically, ACIArena establishes a unified specification that jointly supports MAS construction and attack–defense modules. It covers six widely used MAS implementations and provides a benchmark of 1,356 test cases for systematically evaluating MAS robustness. Our benchmarking results show that evaluating MAS robustness solely through topology is insufficient; robust MAS require deliberate role design and controlled interaction patterns. Moreover, defenses developed in simplified environments often fail to transfer to real-world settings; narrowly scoped defenses may even introduce new vulnerabilities. ACIArena aims to provide a solid foundation for advancing deeper exploration of MAS design principles.
papers.abstract_zh: 协作与信息共享确实能够提升多智能体系统的性能，但同时也带来了一种严重的安全风险，即智能体级注入攻击。在这种攻击中，被攻破的智能体会利用其他智能体的信任关系来传播恶意指令，导致整个系统出现连锁故障。然而，现有的研究仅考虑了有限的攻击策略以及简化的智能体系统设置，这限制了研究的通用性和全面性评估能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ACIArena框架，它是一个用于评估智能体系统鲁棒性的统一框架。ACIArena提供了涵盖多种攻击面（如外部输入、智能体配置、智能体间通信）和攻击目标（如指令劫持、任务中断、信息窃取）的系统化评估工具。具体来说，ACIArena建立了一个统一的规范体系，既支持智能体系统的构建，也支持攻击与防御模块的设计。该框架涵盖了六种常见的智能体系统实现方式，并提供了1,356个测试案例，以便系统地评估智能体系统的鲁棒性。我们的基准测试结果显示，仅通过拓扑结构来评估智能体系统的鲁棒性是远远不够的；真正的鲁棒智能体系统需要精心设计的角色分工和可控的互动模式。此外，在简化环境下开发的防御措施往往无法适用于现实世界的环境；范围过窄的防御措施甚至可能引入新的漏洞。ACIArena旨在为深入探索智能体系统设计原则提供坚实的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PLAWBENCH: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs in Real-World Legal Practice
papers.title_zh: PLAWBENCH：一种基于评分标准的模型评估方法，用于在实际法律场景中评估大型语言模型的表现
papers.authors: Yuzhen Shi, Huanghai Liu, Yiran HU, Song Gaojie, Xu Xinran, Yubo Ma, Tianyi Tang, Li Zhang, Qingjing Chen, Feng Di, Wenbo Lv, Weiheng Wu, Kexin Yang, Sen Yang, Wei Wang, Rongyao Shi, Qiu Yuanyang, Yuemeng Qi, Zhang Jingwen, Sui Xiaoyu, Yifan Chen, Zhang Yi, An Yang, Bowen Yu, Dayiheng Liu, Junyang Lin, Weixing Shen, Bing Zhao, Charles L. A. Clarke, HU Wei
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to legal domain-specific tasks, evaluating their ability to perform legal work in real-world settings has become essential. However, existing legal benchmarks rely on simplified and highly standardized tasks, failing to capture the ambiguity, complexity, and reasoning demands of real legal practice. Moreover, prior evaluations often adopt coarse, single-dimensional metrics and do not explicitly assess fine-grained legal reasoning. To address these limitations, we introduce PLawBench, a Practical Law Benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs in realistic legal practice scenarios. Grounded in real-world legal workflows, PLawBench models the core processes of legal practitioners through three task categories: public legal consultation, practical case analysis, and legal document generation. These tasks assess a model’s ability to identify legal issues and key facts, perform structured legal reasoning, and generate legally coherent documents. PLawBench comprises 850 questions across 13 practical legal scenarios, with each question accompanied by expert-designed evaluation rubrics, resulting in approximately 12,500 rubric items for fine-grained assessment. Using an LLM-based evaluator aligned with human expert judgments, we evaluate 10 state-of-the-art LLMs. Experimental results show that none achieves strong performance on PLawBench, revealing substantial limitations in the fine-grained legal reasoning capabilities of current LLMs and highlighting important directions for future evaluation and development of legal LLMs. Data is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PLawbench-B524/.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在法律领域特定任务中的应用日益广泛，评估它们在现实环境中进行法律工作的能力变得至关重要。然而，现有的法律基准测试依赖于简化且高度标准化的任务，无法捕捉到真实法律实践中的模糊性、复杂性和推理需求。此外，以往的评估往往采用粗略的、单一维度的指标，并未对精细的法律推理进行明确评估。为了克服这些局限性，我们推出了PLawBench——一个旨在评估大语言模型在实际法律实践场景中的表现的实用法律基准测试。PLawBench基于现实世界的法律工作流程，通过三个任务类别来模拟法律从业者的核心流程：公共法律咨询、实际案例分析和法律文件生成。这些任务分别评估模型识别法律问题及关键事实的能力、进行结构化法律推理的能力，以及生成符合法律规范的文档的能力。PLawBench包含850个问题，涵盖13种实际法律场景，每个问题都附有专家设计的评估标准，从而形成了约12,500个用于精细评估的标准项。我们使用一种与人类专家判断相一致的基于大语言模型的评估工具，对10种最先进的大语言模型进行了评估。实验结果表明，没有任何模型在PLawBench测试中表现出强大的性能，这揭示了当前大语言模型在精细法律推理方面的显著局限性，并为未来评估和发展法律领域的大语言模型指明了重要方向。相关数据可访问于：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PLawbench-B524/
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VoxMind: An End-to-End Agentic Spoken Dialogue System
papers.title_zh: VoxMind：一种端到端的口语对话系统
papers.authors: Tianle Liang, Yifu Chen, Shengpeng Ji, Yijun Chen, Zhiyang Jia, Jingyu Lu, Fan Zhuo, Xueyi Pu, Yangzhuo Li, Zhou Zhao
papers.abstract: Recent end-to-end spoken dialogue models enable natural interaction. However, as user demands become increasingly complex, models that rely solely on conversational abilities often struggle to cope. Incorporating agentic capabilities is therefore essential: by enabling tool use, these models can extend their knowledge boundaries and better solve real-world tasks. Yet, existing research has largely concentrated on core perception and generation, with comparatively limited exploration of such tool-augmented extensions. To bridge this gap, we present VoxMind, an integrated framework designed to equip end-to-end spoken dialogue models with comprehensive agentic abilities. Leveraging our curated 470-hour AgentChat dataset, we incorporate a “Think-before-Speak” mechanism, enabling the model to internalize structured reasoning as a critical prerequisite for planning and response generation. Furthermore, to mitigate latency bottlenecks caused by large-scale tool integration, we propose a Multi-Agent Dynamic Tool Management architecture. By asynchronously delegating retrieval tasks to an auxiliary agent aligned with the main model’s reasoning trajectory, this system effectively decouples inference latency from toolset size. Experimental results confirm that VoxMind achieves significant improvements in agent performance: compared with strong baselines, the task completion rate increases from 34.88% to 74.57%, outperforming Gemini-2.5-Pro on spoken agent tasks while preserving general conversational quality. The source code and associated data are publicly available at https://github.com/MM-Speech/VoxMind.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的端到端语音对话模型能够实现自然的互动。然而，随着用户需求变得越来越复杂，那些仅依赖对话能力的模型往往难以应对这些挑战。因此，加入代理功能至关重要：通过支持工具使用，这些模型可以扩展其知识边界，从而更好地解决现实世界中的任务。不过，现有的研究主要集中在核心的感知和生成能力上，对于这种由工具辅助的扩展功能的探索相对较少。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了VoxMind这个集成框架，旨在为端到端语音对话模型提供全面的代理功能。我们利用了我们精心挑选的470小时AgentChat数据集，并引入了“思考后再发言”的机制，使模型能够内化结构化推理，这是规划和响应生成的关键前提。此外，为了缓解大规模工具整合所带来的延迟问题，我们提出了一种多智能体动态工具管理架构。通过将检索任务异步委托给一个与主模型的推理轨迹一致的辅助代理，该系统有效地将推理延迟与工具集大小分离开来。实验结果表明，VoxMind在代理性能方面取得了显著改进：与强大的基线模型相比，任务完成率从34.88%提高到了74.57%，在语音代理任务上的表现优于Gemini-2.5-Pro，同时保持了良好的对话质量。源代码和相关数据可以在https://github.com/MM-Speech/VoxMind上获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MT^{3}: A Synergistic Multi-Task RL Framework for Specializing MLLMs in Text Image Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: MT^{3）：一种协同工作的多任务强化学习框架，旨在使大语言模型在文本与图像机器翻译领域实现专业化发展
papers.authors: Zhaopeng Feng, Yupu Liang, Shaosheng Cao, Jiayuan Su, Jiahan Ren, Zhijie Zhou, Wenxuan Huang, Jian Wu, Zuozhu Liu
papers.abstract: Text Image Machine Translation (TIMT)—the task of translating textual content embedded in images—is critical for applications in accessibility, cross-lingual information access, and real-world document understanding. However, TIMT remains a complex challenge due to the need for accurate optical character recognition (OCR), robust visual-text reasoning, and high-quality translation, often requiring cascading multi-stage pipelines. Recent advances in large-scale Reinforcement Learning (RL) have improved reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), but their application to end-to-end TIMT is still underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MT^{3}, a novel Multi-Task RL framework to specialize MLLMs into end-to-end expert TIMT models. MT^{3} adopts a synergistic multi-task optimization paradigm targeting three key sub-skills: text recognition, context-aware reasoning, and translation. It is trained using a novel multi-mixed reward mechanism that provides fine-grained feedback, fostering a controllable and transparent optimization process. Furthermore, to facilitate the evaluation of TIMT in authentic cross-cultural and real-world social media contexts, we introduced XHSPost, the first social media TIMT benchmark. Our MT^{3}-7B-Zero achieves state-of-the-art results on the latest in-domain MIT-10M benchmark, outperforming strong baselines such as Qwen2.5-VL-72B and InternVL2.5-78B by notable margins across multiple metrics. Additionally, the model shows strong generalization to out-of-distribution language pairs and datasets. In-depth analyses reveal how multi-task synergy, reinforcement learning initialization, curriculum design, and reward formulation contribute to advancing MLLM-driven TIMT.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本图像机器翻译（TIMT）——即翻译嵌入在图像中的文本内容——对于提高信息可访问性、促进跨语言信息获取以及理解现实世界文档具有重要意义。然而，由于需要精确的光学字符识别（OCR）、强大的视觉-文本推理能力以及高质量的翻译效果，TIMT仍然是一个复杂的挑战，通常需要采用多阶段的多层处理流程。近年来，大规模强化学习领域的进展显著提升了大语言模型（LLMs）和多模态LLMs（MLLMs）的推理能力，但将其应用于端到端TIMT的研究尚不充分。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MT^{3}这一新型的多任务强化学习框架，旨在将MLLMs转化为能够完成端到端专家级TIMT模型的系统。MT^{3}采用了一种协同多任务优化策略，专注于文本识别、上下文感知推理和翻译这三个关键子技能。该模型采用了一种新颖的多混合奖励机制进行训练，能够提供细粒度的反馈，从而确保优化过程的可控性和透明度。此外，为了便于在真实的跨文化和现实世界的社交媒体环境中评估TIMT性能，我们开发了XHSPost这一首个社交媒体场景下的TIMT基准测试。我们的MT^{3}-7B-Zero模型在最新的MIT-10M领域基准测试中取得了领先成绩，其在多个指标上的表现均优于Qwen2.5-VL-72B和InternVL2.5-78B等强基线模型，优势明显。此外，该模型还能很好地泛化到不同语言对和数据集上。深入分析表明，多任务协同效应、强化学习的初始化设置、课程设计以及奖励机制的制定，都对提升MLLM驱动的TIMT性能起到了重要作用。

papers.title: Do LLMs Capture Embodied Cognition and Cultural Variation? Cross-Linguistic Evidence from Demonstratives
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否捕捉到具身认知以及文化差异？来自指示词的跨语言证据
papers.authors: Yu Wang, Emmanuele Chersoni, Chu-Ren Huang
papers.abstract: Do large language models (LLMs) truly acquire embodied cognition and cultural conventions from text? We introduce demonstratives, fundamental spatial expressions like “this/that” in English and “这/那” in Chinese, as a novel probe for grounded knowledge. Using 6,400 responses from 320 native speakers, we establish a human baseline: English speakers reliably distinguish proximal–distal referents but struggle with perspective-taking, while Chinese speakers switch perspectives fluently but tolerate distal ambiguity. In contrast, five state-of-the-art LLMs fail to inherently understand the proximal–distal contrast and show no cultural differences, defaulting to English-centric reasoning. Our study contributes (i) demonstratives as a new lens for evaluating embodied cognition and cultural conventions, (ii) empirical evidence of cross-cultural asymmetries in human interpretation, (iii) a new perspective on the egocentric–sociocentric debate, showing both orientations coexist but vary across languages, and (iv) a call to address individual variation in future model design.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型是否真的能够从文本中习得具身认知和文化习俗呢？我们引入了指示代词这类基本的空间表达，比如英语中的“this/that”和中文中的“这/那”，作为探究具体知识的新型工具。通过收集来自320名母语者的6400条回应数据，我们得出了人类的基本表现：英语使用者能够可靠地区分近处和远处的事物，但在理解视角转换方面存在困难；而中文使用者则能够流畅地切换视角，但能容忍远处事物的模糊性。相比之下，五款最先进的语言模型无法理解近处与远处之间的区别，也没有表现出文化差异，它们仍然采用以英语为中心的推理方式。我们的研究为以下方面提供了贡献：(i) 将指示代词作为评估具身认知和文化习俗的新工具；(ii) 提供关于跨文化人类解释差异的实证证据；(iii) 为关于自我中心与社会中心之争提供了新的视角，表明这两种倾向在语言之间存在共存现象，且表现形式各不相同；(iv) 呼吁在未来的模型设计中考虑个体差异的影响。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Feeling Rules in Language Models: Mapping Norms of Emotional Appropriateness Across Roles, Institutions, and Intensity
papers.title_zh: 语言模型中的情感规则：不同角色、情境以及情感强度下的得体性规范映射
papers.authors: Guangrui Fan, DanDan Liu, Aznul Qalid MD Sabri, Rui Zhang, Pan Lihu
papers.abstract: When asked explicitly, a Large language model (LLM) may validate your anger—but implicitly, it may still judge that anger as inappropriate. We call this divergence the endorsement–exposure gap, and it reveals that LLMs encode hidden norms about which emotions are acceptable in which contexts. To measure these norms systematically, we introduce Feeling Rules Atlas, a benchmark of 1,320 vignettes spanning 6 institutional settings, 12 roles, 7 emotions, and 5 intensity levels. We pair the benchmark with two probes: explicit norm judgments (APPROPRIATE/INAPPROPRIATE/DEPENDS) and implicit acceptability scored by log-likelihood contrast. Across six model families, we find large cross-model variation in sanctioning thresholds and institutional “norm signatures” not reducible to overall strictness; models that appear similarly lenient explicitly can diverge sharply in implicit judgments. These results establish normative affect—context-conditioned judgments of emotional appropriateness—as a distinct alignment axis, and motivate transparent profiling of feeling rules for emotionally sensitive deployments.
papers.abstract_zh: 当被明确询问时，大语言模型可能会认可你的愤怒情绪——但隐式地，它仍然会认为愤怒是不合适的。我们将这种差异称为“认可与排斥的差距”。这一发现表明，大语言模型存储了关于哪些情绪在何种情境下是可接受的隐藏规范。为了系统地测量这些规范，我们引入了“情感规则图谱”这一基准数据集，该数据集包含1,320个案例，涵盖了6种机构环境、12种角色、7种情绪以及5种强度等级。我们将这个基准数据集与两个评估工具相结合：一种是明确的规范判断（合适/不合适/取决于具体情况），另一种是通过对数似然对比来隐式评估可接受性的方法。在六个不同的模型家族中，我们发现对行为的制裁阈值和机构的“规范特征”存在较大的跨模型差异，而这些差异无法归结为整体上的严格程度；那些在明确层面看起来较为宽松的模型，在隐式判断上却可能表现出明显的差异。这些结果表明，规范化的情感判断——即根据情境来判断情绪的适当性——是一个独立的维度，这为在情感敏感的应用场景中，对情感规则进行透明化处理提供了依据。

papers.title: SGT: Securing Open-Source LLMs Against Malicious Fine-tuning via Safety Guidance Trigger
papers.title_zh: SGT：通过安全指导机制来保护开源大语言模型，避免其受到恶意微调的攻击
papers.authors: Sunguk Shin, Fangzhao Wu, Byung-Jun Lee, Meeyoung Cha, Sungwon Park
papers.abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) enable broad customization, but also increase exposure to post-release misuse, including malicious fine-tuning (MFT). To mitigate this risk, many prior defenses aim to improve the robustness of open-weight models to MFT by constraining adversarial fine-tuning dynamics in parameter space or mitigating harmful information encoded in internal representations. Nevertheless, since malicious fine-tuning can still erode safety, developing robust safeguards for open-weight models that fundamentally mitigate this risk remains an open research problem. In this paper, we characterize a safety region for open-weight LLMs and propose Safety Guidance Trigger (SGT), which guides fine-tuning toward the safety manifold to preserve alignment. SGT has two stages: (1) optimizing a safety trigger that steers the base model toward safe responses and (2) training the open-weight model to align its internal features with trigger-induced safety representations. We demonstrate that SGT substantially improves robustness against malicious fine-tuning, requiring adversaries to increase their data budget significantly to compromise safety. Our analysis shows that SGT anchors model representations to a safety region, which remains stable under malicious fine-tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 开放权重的大语言模型能够实现广泛的定制功能，但同时也增加了在发布后受到恶意攻击的风险，包括恶意微调。为了降低这种风险，许多现有的防御措施试图通过限制参数空间中的对抗性微调行为，或者减轻内部表示中编码的有害信息，来提高开放权重模型的鲁棒性。然而，由于恶意微调仍然可能破坏系统的安全性，因此开发能够从根本上缓解这一风险的开放权重模型防护机制仍然是一个尚未解决的研究问题。在本文中，我们定义了一个开放权重语言模型的安全区域，并提出了“安全引导触发器”这一方法。该工具引导微调过程向安全方向进行，以保持模型的一致性。安全引导触发器包含两个阶段：（1）优化一个安全触发点，引导基础模型向安全的响应方向发展；（2）训练开放权重模型，使其内部特征与触发点所引导的安全表示保持一致。我们的分析表明，安全引导触发器显著提高了模型对恶意微调的鲁棒性，使得对手需要大幅增加数据投入才能破坏系统的安全性。我们的分析还显示，安全引导触发器将模型表示锚定在一个安全区域内，即使面对恶意微调，这个区域也能保持稳定。

papers.title: Every Token Counts: Generalizing 16M Ultra-Long Context in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 每一个代币都至关重要：在大型语言模型中泛化1600万条超长上下文数据
papers.authors: Xiang Hu, Zhanchao Zhou, Ruiqi Liang, Zehuan Li, Wei Wu, Jianguo Li
papers.abstract: This work explores efficient ultra-long context modeling. We posit that an effective solution requires three fundamental properties: sparsity, random-access flexibility, and length generalization. To achieve this, we leverage Hierarchical Sparse Attention (HSA), a novel attention mechanism that satisfies all three properties. We integrate HSA into the Transformer architecture to develop HSA-UltraLong, an 8B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model trained on over 8 trillion tokens. We rigorously evaluate the model across tasks with both in-domain and out-of-domain context lengths to validate its capabilities. Our model demonstrates comparable performance to full-attention baselines on in-domain sequence lengths. Crucially, it achieves over 90% accuracy on most in-context retrieval tasks with contexts up to 512 times the pre-training context length. This work reports our findings and remaining issues throughout the experiments, offering insights for future research in ultra-long context modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了高效的长上下文建模方法。我们认为，有效的解决方案需要具备三个基本特性：稀疏性、随机访问的灵活性以及长度上的泛化能力。为了实现这一目标，我们采用了分层稀疏注意力机制（HSA），这是一种能够满足上述所有特性的新型注意力机制。我们将HSA整合到Transformer架构中，从而开发出HSA-UltraLong模型，该模型是一个拥有80亿参数的混合专家模型，训练数据量超过8万亿个标记。我们对该模型在不同任务中的表现进行了严格评估，包括使用内部和外部上下文长度的情况，以验证其性能。我们的模型在内部序列长度上的表现与全注意力基线模型相当。更重要的是，当上下文长度达到预训练上下文长度的512倍时，该模型在大多数上下文检索任务上的准确率超过了90%。本研究报告了我们的研究发现以及实验过程中遇到的挑战，为未来长上下文建模领域的研究提供了有价值的见解。
