papers.title: Self-Reflective Generation at Test Time
papers.title_zh: 考试期间进行自我反思的群体
papers.authors: Jian Mu, Qixin Zhang, Zhiyong Wang, Menglin Yang, Shuang Qiu, Chengwei Qin, Zhongxiang Dai, Yao Shu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly solve complex reasoning tasks via long chain-of-thought, but their forward-only autoregressive generation process is fragile; early token errors can cascade, which creates a clear need for self-reflection mechanisms. However, existing self-reflection either performs revisions over full drafts or learns self-correction via expensive training, both fundamentally reactive and inefficient. To address this, we propose Self-Reflective Generation at Test Time (SRGen), a lightweight test-time framework that reflects before generating at uncertain points. During token generation, SRGen utilizes dynamic entropy thresholding to identify high-uncertainty tokens. For each identified token, it trains a specific corrective vector, which fully exploits the already generated context for a self-reflective generation to correct the token probability distribution. By retrospectively analyzing the partial output, this self-reflection enables more trustworthy decisions, thereby significantly reducing the probability of errors at highly uncertain points. Evaluated on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks and a diverse set of LLMs, SRGen can significantly strengthen model reasoning. Moreover, our findings position SRGen as a plug-and-play method that integrates reflection into the generation process for reliable LLM reasoning, achieving consistent gains with bounded overhead and can be combined with other training-time (e.g., RLHF) and test-time (e.g., SLOT) techniques.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解决复杂推理任务时，往往依赖于长链的思维过程。然而，这些模型仅能进行前向生成，其自回归生成机制存在缺陷：早期的标记错误可能会引发连锁反应，因此迫切需要自我反思机制。不过，现有的自我反思方法要么需要对整个草稿进行修正，要么需要通过昂贵的训练来学习自我纠正方法，这两种方式都缺乏主动性且效率低下。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了“测试时自我反思生成”技术（SRGen）。该技术在不确定节点上进行反思后再进行生成。在标记生成过程中，SRGen利用动态熵阈值来识别高不确定性的标记。对于每一个被识别出的标记，它会训练一个特定的纠正向量，从而充分利用已生成的上下文信息进行自我反思生成，以修正标记的概率分布。通过回顾性地分析部分输出结果，这种自我反思能够做出更可靠的决策，从而显著降低在高度不确定节点出现错误的概率。在具有挑战性的数学推理基准测试和多种语言模型上进行的评估表明，SRGen能够显著增强模型的推理能力。此外，我们的研究结果表明，SRGen是一种即插式的解决方案，可以将反思功能整合到生成过程中，从而实现可靠的语言模型推理。同时，该方法在资源消耗方面具有可控性，还可以与其他训练时间（如强化学习框架）和测试时间（如槽填充算法）技术相结合使用。

papers.title: GKnow: Measuring the Entanglement of Gender Bias and Factual Gender
papers.title_zh: GKnow：衡量性别偏见与事实性性别差异之间的关联程度
papers.authors: Leonor Veloso, Hinrich Schuetze
papers.abstract: Recent works have analyzed the impact of individual components of neural networks on gendered predictions, often with a focus on mitigating gender bias. However, mechanistic interpretations of gender tend to (i) focus on a very specific gender-related task, such as gendered pronoun prediction, or (ii) fail to distinguish between the production of factually gendered outputs (the correct assumption of gender given a word that carries gender as a semantic property) and gender biased outputs (based on a stereotype). To address these issues, we curate Gknow, a benchmark to assess gender knowledge and gender bias in language models across different types of gender-related predictions. Gknow allows us to identify and analyze circuits and individual neurons responsible for gendered predictions. We test the impact of neuron ablation on benchmarks for disentangling stereotypical and factual gender (DiFair and the test set of Gknow), as well as StereoSet. Results show that gender bias and factual gender are severely entangled on the level of both circuits and neurons, entailing that ablation is an unreliable debiasing method. Furthermore, we show that benchmarks for evaluating gender bias can hide the decrease in factual gender knowledge that accompanies neuron ablation. We curate Gknow as a contribution to the continuous development of robust gender bias benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究分析了神经网络中各个组件对性别预测的影响，这些研究通常致力于减轻性别偏见。然而，关于性别的机制性解释往往存在以下问题：其一，过于关注某一特定与性别相关的任务，例如性别相关的代词预测；其二，未能区分基于事实的性别输出（即给定带有性别属性的词语时正确的性别假设）和基于刻板印象的性别偏见输出。为了解决这些问题，我们开发了Gknow这一基准测试工具，用于评估语言模型中不同类型性别相关预测的性别知识和性别偏见情况。Gknow使我们能够识别和分析负责性别预测的电路和单个神经元。我们测试了删除这些神经元对分离刻板印象性和事实性性别预测的影响，包括DiFair以及Gknow的测试集，还有StereoSet。结果表明，在电路和神经元层面，性别偏见和事实性性别之间存在严重的交织现象，因此删除这些神经元并不是一个可靠的去偏见方法。此外，我们还发现，用于评估性别偏见的基准测试可能会掩盖随着神经元删除而出现的实际性别知识的减少现象。我们开发Gknow，旨在为不断完善的强大性别偏见基准测试体系做出贡献。

papers.title: Reinforcing Agentic Search Via Reward Density Optimization
papers.title_zh: 通过奖励密度优化来强化主动搜索机制
papers.authors: Kun Luo, Hongjin Qian, Zheng Liu, Ziyi Xia, Shitao Xiao, Zhao Cao, Siqi Bao, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a promising approach for enhancing agentic search. However, its performance is often hindered by reward sparsity, whereby agents receive very limited positive feedback despite incurring significant exploration costs. In this paper, we formalize this challenge as a new research problem termed Reward Density Optimization, which aims to improve the reward obtained per unit of exploration cost. To address this problem, we introduce InfoFlow, a systematic framework that operates along three complementary dimensions: 1) Sub-goal Scaffolding: which decomposes long-horizon tasks into intermediate objectives and assigns process-level rewards to provide denser learning signals; 2) Pathfinding Hints: which injects corrective guidance into stalled trajectories to increase the ratio of successful trials; and 3) Dual-agent Refinement: which employs a dual-agent architecture to offload the cognitive burden of deep exploration. We evaluate InfoFlow on several popular agentic search benchmarks, where it significantly outperforms strong baselines and enables lightweight LLMs to achieve performance comparable to that of advanced proprietary models.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是一种提升智能体搜索能力的有前景的方法。然而，其性能往往受到奖励稀疏性的限制——尽管智能体需要付出巨大的探索成本，但它们获得的积极反馈却非常有限。在本文中，我们将这一挑战形式化为一个新的研究问题，即奖励密度优化问题。该问题的目标是提高每单位探索成本所获得的奖励量。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了InfoFlow这一系统框架，该框架通过三个互补的维度来实现目标：1）子目标支架：将长期任务分解为中间目标，并分配过程级奖励以提供更密集的学习信号；2）路径引导提示：为停滞的搜索路径注入正确的指导，从而提高成功尝试的比例；3）双智能体优化：采用双智能体架构来分担深度探索所需的认知负担。我们在多个流行的智能体搜索基准测试中对InfoFlow进行了评估，结果表明它在性能上显著优于强大的基线算法，并且使得轻量级大语言模型能够取得与先进专有模型相当的性能。

papers.title: Scaling External Knowledge Input Beyond Context Windows of LLMs via Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.title_zh: 通过多智能体协作，将外部知识输入的范围扩展到大型语言模型所处理的各种上下文环境中
papers.authors: Zijun Liu, Zhennan Wan, Peng Li, Ming Yan, Fei Huang, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of post-training techniques for reasoning and information seeking, large language models (LLMs) can incorporate a large quantity of retrieved knowledge to solve complex tasks. However, the limited context window of LLMs obstructs scaling the amount of external knowledge input, prohibiting further improvement. Existing context window extension methods inevitably cause information loss. LLM-based multi-agent methods emerge as a new paradigm to handle massive input in a distributional manner, where we identify two core bottlenecks in existing agent orchestration designs. In this work, we develop a multi-agent framework, ExtAgents, to overcome the bottlenecks and enable better scalability in inference-time knowledge integration without longer-context training. Benchmarked with our enhanced multi-hop question answering test, \boldsymbol\inftyBench+, and other public test sets including long survey generation, ExtAgents significantly enhances the performance over existing non-training methods with the same amount of external knowledge input, regardless of whether it falls within or exceeds the context window. Moreover, the method maintains efficiency due to high parallelism. We believe further study in the coordination of LLM agents on increasing external knowledge input could benefit real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着推理和信息检索后训练技术的快速发展，大语言模型能够整合大量检索到的知识来解决复杂任务。然而，大语言模型的有限上下文窗口限制了外部知识输入量的扩展，从而阻碍了进一步的改进。现有的上下文窗口扩展方法不可避免地会导致信息丢失。基于大语言模型的多智能体方法作为一种新范式出现，它能够以分布式方式处理大量输入数据。在现有的智能体协调设计中，我们发现了两个核心瓶颈。在这项研究中，我们开发了一个多智能体框架ExtAgents，以克服这些瓶颈，从而在无需长时间上下文训练的情况下，实现更好的推理时间知识整合能力。通过与我们改进的跨层次问答测试集$\boldsymbol\inftyBench+$以及其他公共测试集进行比较，包括长文档生成任务，发现ExtAgents在相同的外部知识输入量下，无论输入数据是否超出上下文窗口，其性能都明显优于现有的非训练方法。此外，由于采用了高并行性策略，该方法还保持了高效性。我们认为，进一步研究在增加外部知识输入情况下对大语言模型智能体的协调控制，将有助于推动现实世界中的应用发展。

papers.title: M^2PO: Multi-Perspective Multi-Pair Preference Optimization for Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: M^2PO：多视角多对偏好优化算法，用于机器翻译
papers.authors: Hao Wang, Linlong Xu, Heng Liu, Yangyang Liu, Xiaohu Zhao, Bo Zeng, Liangying Shao, Yichen Dong, Xinwei Wu, Jiang Zhou, Tianyu Dong, Xiangxiang Zeng, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo
papers.abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) to human preferences is pivotal for Machine Translation (MT), yet current approaches are often hindered by misleading reward signals. Our analysis reveals that prevailing Quality Estimation (QE) models exhibit a systematic blind spot towards partial errors—specifically partial hallucinations and omissions—often favoring superficially fluent but unfaithful translations. To address this, we propose M^2PO (Multi-Perspective Multi-Pair Preference Optimization), a data-centric framework for preference optimization in machine translation. First, to correct the bias towards fluency, M^2PO uses a multi-perspective alignment mechanism that decouples semantic fidelity from fluency, prioritizing faithfulness via a curriculum strategy. Second, with the bias corrected, partial errors fall between perfect and severely incorrect translations, making them inefficient to learn via standard best-versus-worst comparisons. We thus introduce a multi-pair objective that leverages the full candidate list to capture these fine-grained error signals. Experiments on WMT23, WMT24, and FLORES-200 show that M^2PO enables a 9B model to outperform leading open-source baselines and achieve parity with proprietary models like GPT-4o and Gemini-2.0-Flash, demonstrating significant potential for efficient, high-fidelity LLM-based translation.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好对齐对于机器翻译至关重要，然而当前的方法往往受到误导性奖励信号的阻碍。我们的分析表明，现有的质量评估模型在对待部分错误时存在系统性缺陷——具体来说，就是无法正确处理部分幻觉和遗漏情况。因此，我们提出了M^2PO（多视角多对偏好优化）框架，这是一种以数据为核心的机器翻译偏好优化方法。首先，为了纠正对流畅性的偏好偏差，M^2PO采用了一种多视角对齐机制，将语义忠实度与流畅性分离开来，通过课程策略来优先考虑忠实性。其次，一旦偏差得到纠正，部分错误就会处于完美与严重错误之间，这使得通过标准的最佳与最差比较方法来学习这些错误变得效率低下。因此，我们引入了一种多对目标，利用完整的候选列表来捕捉这些细微的错误信号。在WMT23、WMT24和FLORES-200上的实验表明，M^2PO使得一个拥有90亿参数的模型能够超越领先的开源基线模型，并与GPT-4o和Gemini-2.0-Flash等专有模型相媲美，显示出其在高效、高保真度LLM基础翻译方面的巨大潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: An Exploration of Mamba for Speech Self-Supervised Models
papers.title_zh: 针对语音自监督模型的Mamba探索性研究
papers.authors: Tzu-Quan Lin, Heng-Cheng Kuo, Tzu-Chieh Wei, Hsi-Chun Cheng, Chun Wei Chen, Hsien-Fu Hsiao, Yu Tsao, Hung-yi Lee
papers.abstract: While Mamba has demonstrated strong performance in language modeling, its potential as a speech self-supervised learning (SSL) model remains underexplored, with prior studies limited to isolated tasks. To address this, we explore Mamba-based HuBERT models as alternatives to Transformer-based SSL architectures. Leveraging the linear-time Selective State Space, these models enable fine-tuning on long-context ASR with significantly lower compute. Moreover, they show superior performance when fine-tuned for streaming ASR. Beyond fine-tuning, these models show competitive performance on SUPERB probing benchmarks, particularly in causal settings. Our analysis shows that they yield higher-quality quantized representations and capture speaker-related features more distinctly than Transformer-based models. These findings highlight Mamba-based SSL as a promising and complementary direction for long-sequence modeling, real-time speech modeling, and speech unit extraction. The codebase is available at https://github.com/hckuo145/Mamba-based-HuBERT.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然Mamba在语言建模方面表现出强大的性能，但其作为语音自监督学习模型的潜力尚未得到充分探索。以往的研究仅限于孤立任务。为了应对这一问题，我们尝试使用基于Mamba的HuBERT模型来替代基于Transformer的自监督学习架构。这些模型利用线性时间的选择性状态空间特性，能够在计算成本较低的情况下对长上下文的语音识别进行微调。此外，当用于流媒体语音识别时，这些模型的性能更为优越。除了微调功能外，这些模型在SUPERB测试基准上也表现出竞争力，尤其是在因果分析场景中。我们的分析表明，与基于Transformer的模型相比，这些模型能够生成质量更高的量化表示，并且能更清晰地捕捉与说话者相关的特征。这些发现表明，基于Mamba的自监督学习模型是一种有前景且互补的方法，适用于长序列建模、实时语音建模以及语音单元提取等领域。相关代码可以在https://github.com/hckuo145/Mamba-based-HuBERT下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Ready Jurist One: Benchmarking Language Agents for Legal Intelligence in Dynamic Environments
papers.title_zh: 《Ready Jurist One：在动态环境中用于法律智能的语言代理对比研究》
papers.authors: Zheng Jia, Shengbin Yue, Wei Chen, Siyuan Wang, Yidong Liu, Zejun Li, Yun Song, Zhongyu Wei
papers.abstract: The gap between existing benchmarks and the dynamic nature of real-world legal practice poses a key barrier to advancing legal intelligence. To this end, we introduce J1-ENVS, the first interactive and dynamic legal environment tailored for LLM-based agents. Guided by legal experts, it comprises six representative scenarios from Chinese legal practices at three levels of environmental complexity. We further introduce J1-EVAL, a dual-metric evaluation framework, designed to assess both task performance and procedural compliance across varying levels of legal proficiency. Extensive experiments on 17 LLM agents reveal that while many models demonstrate solid legal knowledge, they struggle with procedural execution in dynamic settings. Even the SOTA model is below 60% overall performance . These findings highlight persistent challenges in achieving dynamic legal intelligence and offer valuable insights to guide future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有基准与现实世界法律实践的动态特性之间的差距，是推进法律智能化的主要障碍。为此，我们推出了J1-ENVS——首个专为基于大语言模型的智能体设计的互动式、动态化法律环境。该环境由法律专家指导构建，包含来自中国法律实践中的六个代表性场景，这些场景涵盖了三种不同的环境复杂度水平。此外，我们还提出了J1-EVAL这一双指标评估框架，旨在评估不同法律熟练程度下智能体的任务执行能力和程序合规性。对17种大语言模型智能体的广泛实验表明，虽然许多模型在法律知识方面表现出色，但在动态环境中执行程序时却存在困难。甚至最先进的模型的整体表现也低于60%。这些发现揭示了在实现动态法律智能化方面存在的持续挑战，并为未来的研究提供了宝贵的启示。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When Morphology Hides in Plain Sight: Breaking the Isolation in Vietnamese and Beyond
papers.title_zh: 当“形态学”隐藏在显而易见的事物之中：打破越南语及其他语言中的孤立现象
papers.authors: Anh Trac Duc Dinh, Khang Hoang Nhat Vo, Tai Tien Ta, Vinh Cong Doan, Tho Quan
papers.abstract: In isolating languages such as Vietnamese, core morphological structure is encoded not by inflection but by the composition and ordering of monosyllabic morphemes, yet standard Transformer encoders largely overlook this signal. We introduce HuTieuBERT, a morpheme-aware Transformer that augments a pretrained Vietnamese encoder with two lightweight inductive biases: (i) Adaptive Boundary-Token Fusion, which integrates BMES-based morpheme boundary embeddings into token representations via a learnable gate, and (ii) a Morpheme-Aware Attention Bias, which injects a fixed structural attention matrix into early self-attention layers while minimally perturbing the pretrained attention geometry. Across a suite of Vietnamese POS, NER, and sentence-level classification benchmarks, HuTieuBERT consistently outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains on syntactic tasks. Hyperparameter ablations show a broad regime in which structural biases improve accuracy without destabilizing representations. Applying the same design to ChineseBERT (Chinese-BERT-wwm) yields MAChineseBERT, which improves F_{1} and produces more balanced tag distributions on Chinese POS and NER, suggesting that explicit morpheme-aware attention is a portable and effective strategy for modeling isolating languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 在对待像越南语这样的孤立语言时，其核心形态结构并不是通过词形变化来编码的，而是通过单音节词素的组合与排序来实现的。然而，标准的Transformer编码器往往忽略了这一信号。我们提出了HuTieuBERT，这是一种具备词素感知能力的Transformer模型，它在一个预训练的越南语编码器基础上增加了两种轻量级归纳偏见：(i)自适应边界词元融合，通过可学习的门控机制，将基于BMES的词元边界嵌入整合到词元表示中；(ii)词素感知注意力偏见，它在早期自注意力层中引入固定的结构化注意力矩阵，同时尽可能少地扰动预训练时的注意力结构。在一系列越南语词性标注、命名实体识别以及句子级分类的基准测试中，HuTieuBERT始终表现出优于主流基线的性能，尤其是在句法任务上取得了显著的提升。通过调整超参数，我们发现结构偏见可以在不破坏表示质量的情况下提高准确性。将同样的设计方法应用于ChineseBERT（Chinese-BERT-wwm），便得到了MAChineseBERT，该模型提升了F_{1}值，并且在中文词性标注和命名实体识别方面产生了更加均衡的标签分布，这表明明确运用词素感知注意力机制是一种适用于孤立语言的、有效且可移植的建模策略。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FineLAP: Taming Heterogeneous Supervision for Fine-grained Language-Audio Pretraining
papers.title_zh: FineLAP：融合多种监督方法以实现细粒度语言与音频预训练
papers.authors: Xiquan Li, Xuenan Xu, Ziyang Ma, Wenxi Chen, Haolin He, Qiuqiang Kong, Xie Chen
papers.abstract: Contrastively pretrained audio–language models (e.g., CLAP) excel at clip-level understanding but struggle with frame-level tasks.Existing extensions fail to exploit the varying granularity of real-world audio–text data, where massive clip-level textual descriptions coexist with limited frame-level annotations. This paper proposes Fine-grained Language-Audio Pretraining (FineLAP), a novel training paradigm that advances both clip- and frame-level alignment in CLAP with heterogeneous data.FineLAP introduces a dual-stream sigmoid loss with a cluster-based sampling strategy to jointly learn from clip- and frame-level supervision. To capture both global semantics and local details, FineLAP uses a decoupled audio projector on top of a self-supervised encoder.To alleviate the scarcity of temporally annotated data, we present FineLAP-100k, a large-scale synthetic SED dataset constructed through a scalable curation pipeline.Extensive experiments demonstrate that FineLAP achieves SOTA performance across multiple audio understanding tasks, including retrieval, classification, sound event detection, and text-to-audio grounding. Ablation studies further show that coarse- and fine-grained alignment are mutually beneficial, providing insights for building better audio-language models (ALMs).
papers.abstract_zh: 相比之下，预训练的音频-语言模型（如CLAP）在片段级理解方面表现出色，但在帧级任务上则表现不佳。现有的扩展方法未能充分利用现实世界中的音频-文本数据的不同粒度特性，因为大量的片段级文本描述与有限的帧级注释并存。本文提出了一种名为“细粒度语言-音频预训练”（FineLAP）的新训练范式，该范式能够利用异构数据实现CLAP在片段级和帧级上的对齐。FineLAP采用了双流Sigmoid损失函数以及基于簇的采样策略，以同时学习片段级和帧级的监督信息。为了捕捉全局语义和局部细节，FineLAP在自监督编码器的基础上引入了独立的音频投影器。为了缓解时间标注数据的稀缺性，我们提出了FineLAP-100k这一大规模合成SED数据集，该数据集是通过可扩展的整理流程构建而成的。大量实验表明，FineLAP在多种音频理解任务中取得了领先的性能，包括检索、分类、声音事件检测以及文本到音频的映射等任务。进一步的消融研究表明，粗粒度和细粒度的对齐是相互有益的，这为构建更优秀的音频-语言模型提供了重要启示。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: OCR-Memory: Optical Context Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
papers.title_zh: OCR-记忆：用于长期代理记忆的光学上下文检索技术
papers.authors: Jinze Li, Yang Zhang, Xin Yang, Jiayi QU, Jinfeng Xu, Shuo Yang, Junhua Ding, Edith Cheuk-Han Ngai
papers.abstract: Autonomous LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon, interactive settings where success depends on reusing experience accumulated over extended histories. However, existing agent memory systems are fundamentally constrained by text-context budgets: storing or revisiting raw trajectories is prohibitively token-expensive, while summarization and text-only retrieval trade token savings for information loss and fragmented evidence. To address this limitation, we propose Optical Context Retrieval Memory (OCR-Memory), a memory framework that leverages the visual modality as a high-density representation of agent experience, enabling retention of arbitrarily long histories with minimal prompt overhead at retrieval time. Specifically, OCR-Memory renders historical trajectories into images annotated with unique visual identifiers. OCR-Memory retrieves stored experience via a locate-and-transcribe paradigm that selects relevant regions through visual anchors and retrieves the corresponding verbatim text, avoiding free-form generation and reducing hallucination. Experiments on long-horizon agent benchmarks show consistent gains under strict context limits, demonstrating that optical encoding increases effective memory capacity while preserving faithful evidence recovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 自主的大语言模型代理越来越多地运行在长视距、交互式环境中，其成功与否取决于对长期积累的经验进行复用。然而，现有的代理记忆系统受到文本-上下文资源限制的制约：存储或重新访问原始轨迹需要大量的令牌开销，而摘要处理以及仅文本检索则会在节省令牌的同时导致信息丢失和证据碎片化。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了光学上下文检索记忆技术（OCR-Memory），这是一种利用视觉模态作为代理经验的高密度表示方式的记忆框架。通过这种方式，可以在检索时以最小的提示开销保留任意长的历史记录。具体来说，OCR-Memory将历史轨迹转化为带有独特视觉标识符的图像。该技术的检索方式采用定位与转录的范式，通过视觉锚点选择相关区域，并提取对应的逐字文本，从而避免了自由形式的生成，减少了幻觉现象的发生。在长视距代理基准测试中的实验表明，即使在严格的上下文限制条件下，光学编码也能带来持续的性能提升，证明了光学编码能够增加有效记忆容量，同时还能保持对真实证据的准确恢复。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Past To Path: Masked History Learning for Next-Item Prediction in Generative Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 从过去到未来：利用隐藏的历史信息进行生成式推荐中的项目预测
papers.authors: Kaiwen Wei, Kejun he, Xiaomian Kang, Jie Zhang, Ymyang, Li Jin, Zhenyang Li, Jiang Zhong, Richard He Bai, Junnan Zhu
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation, which directly generates item identifiers, has emerged as a promising paradigm for recommendation systems. However, this left-to-right paradigm inherently biases the model towards local contexts, failing to capture deeper historical dependencies necessary for understanding complex user intents.To address this limitation, we propose Masked History Learning (MHL), a novel training framework that shifts the objective from simple next-step prediction to deep comprehension of history. MHL augments the standard autoregressive objective with an auxiliary task of reconstructing masked historical items, compelling the model to understand "why” an item path is formed from the user’s past behaviors, rather than just "what” item comes next.We introduce two key contributions to enhance this framework: (1) an entropy-guided masking policy that intelligently targets the most informative historical items for reconstruction, and (2) a curriculum learning scheduler that progressively transitions from history reconstruction to future prediction.Experiments on three public datasets show that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art generative models, highlighting that a comprehensive understanding of the past is crucial for accurately predicting a user’s future path. The code is available at https://github.com/CQU-MM-Intelligent-Lab/MHL.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式推荐是一种直接生成项目标识符的推荐方法，它已成为推荐系统中的一个有前景的范式。然而，这种从左到右的范式本质上会使模型偏向于局部上下文，无法捕捉到理解复杂用户意图所需的深层历史依赖关系。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了掩蔽历史学习（MHL）这一新的训练框架。该框架将目标从简单的下一步预测转变为对历史的深入理解。MHL在标准的自回归目标基础上增加了一个辅助任务，即重建被掩蔽的历史项目，从而促使模型理解“为什么”某个项目路径是由用户的过去行为形成的，而不仅仅是“接下来会是什么”项目。我们提出了两个关键改进措施来增强这个框架：(1) 一种基于熵引导的掩蔽策略，能够智能地选择最具信息量的历史项目进行重建；(2) 一种课程学习调度器，能够逐步从历史重建过渡到未来预测。在三个公共数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法显著优于最先进的生成式模型，这充分说明了全面了解过去对于准确预测用户的未来路径至关重要。代码可在https://github.com/CQU-MM-Intelligent-Lab/MHL获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MuSe: Multi-Stage Graph Reasoning via Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: MuSe：基于视觉与语言模型的多阶段图推理技术
papers.authors: Guanyu Wang, Xu Chu, Zhijie Tan, Xinrong Chen, Tong Mo, Weiping Li
papers.abstract: Graph-related tasks are traditionally addressed with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) or graph transformers, but their task-specific training limits generalization. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer stronger generalization, yet encoding graphs as one-dimensional text struggles to capture multi-hop dependencies and two-dimensional topology. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide an alternative by visualizing graphs, but rendering large graphs in a single image causes clutter, occlusion, and distraction, hindering reasoning. We propose MuSe, a novel multi-stage graph reasoning framework based on VLMs. Instead of processing entire graphs at once, MuSe incrementally samples and visualizes task-relevant subgraphs, enabling progressive reasoning. The framework employs a two-stage training paradigm: supervised fine-tuning to acquire local sampling and reasoning skills, followed by reinforcement learning with GRPO to refine the sampling strategy and control dialog length.To support evaluation, we introduce LGVLQA, a new multimodal dataset with larger and more complex graph structures, addressing the scalability limitations of existing benchmarks. Experiments show that MuSe consistently outperforms leading LLM and VLM baselines, demonstrating improved structural understanding and reasoning ability.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的图相关任务通常采用图神经网络或图变换器来解决，但它们的任务特定训练方式限制了泛化能力。大语言模型则具有更强的泛化能力，不过将图编码为一维文本的方式难以捕捉多跳依赖关系和二维拓扑结构。视觉语言模型通过可视化图结构提供了一种替代方案，但将大型图渲染在单个图像中会导致混乱、遮挡和注意力分散，从而妨碍推理过程。我们提出了MuSe这一基于视觉语言模型的新型多阶段图推理框架。MuSe不是一次性处理整个图，而是逐步采样并可视化与任务相关的子图，从而实现渐进式推理。该框架采用两阶段训练范式：首先通过监督微调来掌握局部采样和推理技巧，然后利用GRPO进行强化学习，以优化采样策略和控制对话长度。为了支持评估，我们引入了LGVLQA这一新的多模态数据集，它包含更大、更复杂的图结构，能够解决现有基准测试的可扩展性限制问题。实验表明，MuSe始终优于主流的语言模型和视觉语言模型基线，显示出更好的结构理解和推理能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Where and What: Reasoning Dynamic and Implicit Preferences in Situated Conversational Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 在哪里、什么：在情境化对话推荐中考虑动态与隐性的偏好
papers.authors: Dongding Lin, Jian Wang, Yongqi Li, Wenjie Li
papers.abstract: Situated conversational recommendation (SCR), which utilizes visual scenes grounded in specific environments and natural language dialogue to deliver contextually appropriate recommendations, has emerged as a promising research direction due to its close alignment with real-world scenarios. Compared to traditional recommendations, SCR requires a deeper understanding of dynamic and implicit user preferences, as the surrounding scene often influences users’ underlying interests, while both may evolve across conversations. This complexity significantly impacts the timing and relevance of recommendations. To address this, we propose situated preference reasoning (SiPeR), a novel framework that integrates two core mechanisms: (1) Scene transition estimation, which estimates whether the current scene satisfies user needs, and guides the user toward a more suitable scene when necessary; and (2) Bayesian inverse inference, which leverages the likelihood of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict user preferences about candidate items within the scene. Extensive experiments on two representative benchmarks demonstrate SiPeR’s superiority in both recommendation accuracy and response generation quality. The code and data are available at https://github.com/DongdingLin/SiPeR.
papers.abstract_zh: 情境化对话推荐（Situated Conversational Recommendation，SCR）是一种利用基于特定环境的视觉场景和自然语言对话来提供符合上下文需求的推荐方案。由于它与现实世界场景高度契合，因此成为了一个具有前景的研究方向。与传统的推荐方式相比，SCR需要更深入地理解用户动态且隐性的偏好行为，因为周围的环境往往会影响用户的潜在兴趣，而这些偏好在对话过程中还会不断演变。这种复杂性显著影响了推荐的时间和相关性。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了情境偏好推理（SiPeR）框架，该框架整合了两种核心机制：(1) 场景转换估计，用于判断当前场景是否满足用户需求，并在必要时引导用户进入更合适的场景；(2) 贝叶斯逆推断，利用多模态大语言模型的概率分布来预测用户对场景中候选物品的偏好。在两个代表性基准测试上的广泛实验表明，SiPeR在推荐准确性和响应生成质量方面均表现出优势。相关代码和数据可在https://github.com/DongdingLin/SiPeR下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When Agents Look the Same: Quantifying Distillation-Induced Similarity in Tool-Use Behaviors
papers.title_zh: 当代理的行为看起来相似时：量化工具使用行为中因蒸馏作用而产生的相似性
papers.authors: Chenghao Yang, Yuning Zhang, Zhoufutu Wen, Tao Gong, Jiaheng Liu, Qi Chu, Nenghai Yu
papers.abstract: Model distillation is a primary driver behind the rapid progress of LLM agents, yet it often leads to behavioral homogenization. Many emerging agents share nearly identical reasoning steps and failure modes, suggesting they may be distilled echoes of a few dominant teachers. Existing metrics, however, fail to distinguish mandatory behaviors required for task success from non-mandatory patterns thatreflect a model’s autonomous preferences. We propose two complementary metrics to isolate non-mandatory behavioral patterns: \textbf{Response Pattern Similarity (RPS)} for verbal alignment and \textbf{Action Graph Similarity (AGS)} for tool-use habits modeled as directed graphs. Evaluating 18 models from 8 providers on \tau-Bench and \tau^2-Bench against Claude Sonnet 4.5 (thinking), we find that within-family model pairs score 5.9 pp higher in AGS than cross-family pairs, and that Kimi-K2 (thinking) reaches 82.6% S_{\text{node}} and 94.7% S_{\text{dep}}, exceeding Anthropic’s own Opus 4.1. A controlled distillation experiment further confirms that AGS distinguishes teacher-specific convergence from general improvement. RPS and AGS capture distinct behavioral dimensions (Pearson r = 0.491), providing complementary diagnostic signals for behavioral convergence in the agent ecosystem.Our code is available at https://github.com/Syuchin/AgentEcho.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型蒸馏是大语言模型快速发展的主要驱动力，然而它往往会导致行为的一致性。许多新出现的模型具有几乎相同的推理步骤和失败模式，这表明它们可能是少数主导模型的复制品。然而，现有的评估指标无法区分任务成功所需的强制性行为和反映模型自主偏好的非强制性模式。我们提出了两种互补的评估指标来分离非强制性的行为模式：用于语言对齐的**响应模式相似性（RPS）**，以及用于以有向图形式建模的工具使用习惯的**动作图相似性（AGS）**。我们在\tau-Bench和\tau^2-Bench上对来自8个提供商的18个模型进行了评估，这些模型都基于Claude Sonnet 4.5（思维能力）进行测试。结果发现，同一家族内的模型在对AGS评分方面比跨家族的模型高出5.9个百分点；而Kimi-K2（思维能力）的S_{\text{node}}达到了82.6%，S_{\text{dep}}达到了94.7%，超过了Anthropic自己的Opus 4.1版本。一项受控的蒸馏实验进一步证实，AGS能够区分特定于教师的收敛性和一般的改进性。RPS和AGS分别捕捉了不同的行为维度（Pearson r = 0.491），为模型生态系统中的行为收敛提供了互补的诊断信号。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Syuchin/AgentEcho下载。

papers.title: Mind the (DH) Gap! A Contrast in Risky Choices Between Reasoning and Conversational LLMs
papers.title_zh: 注意“思维与对话”之间的差距！在理性决策与口语式大语言模型之间的选择上存在差异
papers.authors: Luise Ge, Yongyan Zhang, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik
papers.abstract: The use of large language models either as decision support systems, or in agentic workflows, is rapidly transforming the digital ecosystem. However, the understanding of LLM decision-making under uncertainty remains limited. We initiate a comparative study of LLM risky choices along two dimensions: (1) prospect representation (explicit vs. experience-based) and (2) decision rationale (explanation). Our study, which involves 20 frontier and open LLMs, is complemented by a matched human subjects experiment, which provides one reference point, while an expected payoff maximizing rational agent model provides another. We find that LLMs cluster into two categories: reasoning models (RMs) and conversational models (CMs). RMs tend towards rational behavior, are insensitive to the order of prospects, gain/loss framing, and explanations, and behave similarly whether prospects are explicit or presented via experience history. CMs are significantly less rational, slightly more human-like, sensitive to prospect ordering, framing, and explanation, and exhibit a large description-history gap. Paired comparisons of open LLMs suggest that a key factor differentiating RMs and CMs is training for mathematical reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型被用作决策支持系统或代理工作流程中的工具，正在迅速改变数字生态系统。然而，对于LLM在不确定性情境下的决策机制的理解仍然有限。我们开始对LLM的冒险决策进行两方面的比较研究：（1）前景表征方式（显性vs.基于经验的）；（2）决策依据（解释性）。我们的研究涉及20种前沿且开放的LLM模型，并辅以人类受试者的实验作为补充，这些实验提供了另一个参考点，而期望收益最大化型理性代理模型则提供了另一个依据。我们发现，LLM可以分为两类：推理型模型和对话型模型。推理型模型倾向于采取理性行为，对前景的顺序、损失框架以及解释并不敏感，无论前景是显式的还是通过经验历史呈现，其行为都相似。而对话型模型则明显缺乏理性，更接近人类行为特征，对前景的顺序、框架和解释更为敏感，并且存在较大的描述与历史信息之间的差距。对开放型LLM进行的配对比较表明，区分推理型模型和对话型模型的一个关键因素是数学推理能力的训练情况。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Single-View Detection: A Dual-Space Reasoning Framework for Interpretable Harmful Meme Understanding
papers.title_zh: 超越单一视图检测：一种基于双空间推理的框架，旨在实现可解释的有害模因识别
papers.authors: Wenqing Hou, Hongkui Tu, Ye Wang, Yue Zhang, Yuying Liu, Dong Zhu, Liqun Gao, Bin Zhou
papers.abstract: The identification of harmful memes extends beyond a mere classification task, encompassing challenges related to multi-perspective semantic comprehension and hierarchical reasoning. Prevailing approaches predominantly depend on modal alignment or black-box classifiers, which fail to capture implicit biases and lack interpretability. In this study, we propose BPDMoE-Hate, a novel framework grounded in dual-space mixture-of-experts, which innovatively conceptualizes harmful meme detection as an integrated process of “viewpoint decoupling and hierarchical fusion”. Our approach generates adversarial binary perspectives via Visual-Language Models (VLMs) and incorporates an adaptive viewpoint gating to facilitate viewpoint selection, thereby enabling the model to autonomously discern implicit semantic inclinations. Moreover, we propose the Hyperbolic-Euclidean space expert to effectively capture the hierarchical structural relationships and semantic correlations between multimodal and viewpoint features, thereby enabling interpretable reasoning at the geometric representation level. Empirical evaluations conducted on three mainstream datasets demonstrate that BPDMoE-Hate not only substantially surpasses existing methodologies in performance but also offers visual explanations for viewpoint selection and hierarchical structuring, thereby advancing the field of interpretable multimodal content analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 识别有害模因不仅仅是一个简单的分类任务，它还涉及到多视角语义理解和层次化推理方面的挑战。目前的主流方法主要依赖于模态对齐或黑盒分类器，这些方法无法捕捉到隐性偏见，且缺乏可解释性。在这项研究中，我们提出了BPDMoE-Hate这一创新框架，该框架基于双空间混合专家模型，将有害模因检测过程定义为“视角分离与层次化融合”的集成过程。我们的方法通过视觉-语言模型生成对立的二元视角，并采用自适应视角门控机制来辅助视角选择，从而使模型能够自主识别隐式的语义倾向。此外，我们还引入了超双曲欧几里得空间专家模型，以有效捕捉多模态特征与视角特征之间的层次结构关系和语义关联，从而在几何表示层面实现可解释的推理。在三个主流数据集上的实证评估表明，BPDMoE-Hate不仅在性能上显著优于现有方法，还能为视角选择和层次化结构分析提供可视化解释，从而推动了可解释的多模态内容分析领域的发展。

papers.title: From Experts to Bases: Orthogonal Subspace Mixture for Continual Multimodal Instruction Tuning
papers.title_zh: 从专家到基础：用于连续多模态教学调优的正交子空间混合方法
papers.authors: Pei Chen, Xilai Wang, Shiqixu, Zejian Li, Lingyun Sun
papers.abstract: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) is essential for adapting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to dynamic data streams, yet preventing catastrophic forgetting remains a major challenge. Existing parameter-efficient approaches often face a dilemma: fixed architectures suffer from knowledge interference, while dynamic strategies incur inefficient capacity expansion, limiting scalability. We propose MoBLoRA (Mixture-of-Bases LoRA), a novel framework for MCIT. Motivated by our geometric analysis revealing subspace redundancy across sequential tasks, MoBLoRA shifts the paradigm from expert selection to subspace mixing: it decomposes adaptation weights into a globally shared pool of orthonormal bases to capture task-invariant knowledge, and lightweight mixing matrices to encode task-specific variations. This design effectively decouples knowledge accumulation from task reconstruction. Experiments on standard benchmarks show MoBLoRA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while maintaining superior parameter efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态持续训练调整（MCIT）对于使多模态大语言模型适应动态数据流至关重要，但防止灾难性遗忘仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的参数高效方法常常面临两难境地：固定架构会导致知识干扰，而动态策略则会导致容量扩展效率低下，从而限制可扩展性。我们提出了MoBLoRA这一新颖的MCIT框架。基于我们的几何分析发现不同任务之间存在子空间冗余，MoBLoRA将范式从专家选择转变为子空间混合：它将适应权重分解为一组全局共享的正交基，以捕获任务不变的知识，并使用轻量级混合矩阵来编码任务特定的变化。这种设计有效地将知识积累与任务重建分离开来。在标准基准测试上的实验表明，MoBLoRA在保持较高参数效率的同时，显著优于现有最先进的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Distilling Large Embeddings via Hyperspherical Householder Quantization
papers.title_zh: 通过超球面霍斯勒德量化技术对大型嵌入数据进行压缩处理
papers.authors: Yihang Wang, Bin Wu, Yueyang Su, Tianfu Zhang, Yiqi Du, Lei Yu, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Large embedding models have become the backbone of modern retrieval systems, offering strong semantic representations at the cost of substantial storage and computation. While recent work explores quantizing embeddings into discrete document identifiers for generative retrieval, most existing approaches rely on Euclidean quantization, which is poorly aligned with the angular geometry induced by contrastive embedding training and often requires long identifier sequences to preserve semantic fidelity. In this work, we propose Hyperspherical Householder Quantization (HHQ), a geometry-aware distillation method that compresses large embeddings into short discrete representations via iterative Householder transformations on the unit hypersphere. By explicitly preserving cosine similarity at each step, HHQ distills semantic structure into compact identifiers that remain faithful to the original embedding space. To support reliable generation of these identifiers, we introduce constrained supervised fine-tuning and tree-aware dynamic masking to enforce structural validity during training and inference. Experiments on NQ and MS MARCO show that HHQ achieves competitive or superior retrieval performance using only five tokens per document, substantially reducing decoding cost while retaining strong semantic retrieval accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型嵌入模型已成为现代检索系统的核心组成部分，它们能够以较高的存储和计算成本提供强大的语义表示。虽然最近的研究尝试将嵌入数据量化为离散的文档标识符以用于生成式检索，但大多数现有方法仍然依赖于欧几里得量化方式。这种方式与对比嵌入训练所产生的角度几何结构并不匹配，而且通常需要较长的标识符序列来保持语义的忠实性。在这项研究中，我们提出了超球面霍斯勒尔量化技术（Hyperspherical Householder Quantization，简称HHQ）。这是一种基于几何结构的蒸馏方法，它通过在单位超球面上进行迭代的霍斯勒尔变换，将大型嵌入数据压缩为短小的离散表示。通过每一步都明确保留余弦相似性，HHQ能够将语义结构转化为紧凑的标识符，同时仍保持对原始嵌入空间的忠实性。为了支持这些标识符的可靠生成，我们引入了约束式监督微调技术和树状结构感知的动态掩蔽技术，以在训练和推理过程中确保结构的有效性。在NQ和MS MARCO数据集上的实验表明，HHQ仅使用每个文档五个标记就能达到具有竞争力的检索性能，同时大幅降低了解码成本，并保持了出色的语义检索精度。

papers.title: Masked by Consensus: Disentangling Privileged Knowledge in LLM Correctness
papers.title_zh: 被共识所掩盖：解析大型语言模型正确性中的特权知识
papers.authors: Tomer Ashuach, Shai Gretz, Yoav Katz, Yonatan Belinkov, Liat Ein-Dor
papers.abstract: Humans use introspection to evaluate their understanding through private internal states inaccessible to external observers. We investigate whether large language models possess similar privileged knowledge about answer correctness, information unavailable through external observation. We train correctness classifiers on question representations from both a model’s own hidden states and external models, testing whether self-representations provide a performance advantage. On standard evaluation, we find no advantage: self-probes perform comparably to peer-model probes. We hypothesize this is due to high inter-model agreement of answer correctness. To isolate genuine privileged knowledge, we evaluate on disagreement subsets, where models produce conflicting predictions. Here, we discover domain-specific privileged knowledge: self-representations consistently outperform peer representations in factual knowledge tasks, but show no advantage in math reasoning. We further localize this domain asymmetry across model layers, finding that the factual advantage emerges progressively from early-to-mid layers onward, consistent with model-specific memory retrieval, while math reasoning shows no consistent advantage at any depth.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类通过内省来评估自己的理解能力，这种理解是建立在内部状态之上的，而这些状态是外部观察者无法触及的。我们研究大语言模型是否也拥有类似的特权知识，能够判断答案的正确性——这些知识是无法通过外部观察获得的。我们在模型的隐藏状态和外部模型的表示上进行正确性分类器的训练，测试自我表征是否能带来性能优势。在标准评估中，我们没有发现任何优势：自我表征的表现与同类模型表征相当。我们认为这可能是由于不同模型在答案正确性的判断上高度一致。为了验证是否存在真正的特权知识，我们在模型产生冲突预测的情况下进行了评估。结果发现，在事实知识任务中，自我表征始终优于同类模型表征，但在数学推理方面则没有显示出任何优势。我们进一步发现了这种领域特异性差异在不同模型层级的分布情况：在事实知识任务中，优势逐渐从早期到中期出现，这与特定于模型的记忆检索机制相符；而在数学推理方面，则没有任何深度上的明显优势。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Unified Thinker: A General Reasoning Core for Image Generation
papers.title_zh: 统一思考者：用于图像生成的通用推理核心
papers.authors: Sashuai Zhou, Qiang Zhou, Jijin Hu, Hanqing Yang, Yue Cao, Junpeng Ma, Yinchao Ma, Jun Song, Tiezheng Ge, Cheng Yu, Bo Zheng, Zhou Zhao
papers.abstract: Despite impressive progress in high-fidelity image synthesis, generative models still struggle with logic-intensive instruction following, exposing a persistent reasoning–execution gap. Meanwhile, closed-source systems (e.g., Nano Banana) have demonstrated strong reasoning-driven image generation, highlighting a substantial gap to current open-source models. We argue that closing this gap requires not merely better visual generators, but executable reasoning: decomposing high-level intents into grounded, verifiable plans that directly steer the generative process. To this end, we propose Unified Thinker, a task-agnostic reasoning architecture for general image generation, designed as a unified planning core that can plug into diverse generators and workflows. Unified Thinker decouples a dedicated Thinker from the image Generator, enabling modular upgrades of reasoning without retraining the entire generative model. We further introduce a two-stage training paradigm: we first build a structured planning interface for the Thinker, then apply reinforcement learning to ground its policy in pixel-level feedback, encouraging plans that optimize visual correctness over textual plausibility. Extensive experiments on text-to-image generation and image editing show that Unified Thinker substantially improves image reasoning and generation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在高保真图像合成方面取得了显著进展，但生成模型在需要逻辑处理的指令执行方面仍然存在困难，这导致推理与执行的差距一直存在。与此同时，一些闭源系统（如Nano Banana）已经展示了强大的基于推理的图像生成能力，这表明与当前开源模型相比还有很大的提升空间。我们认为，要缩小这一差距，不仅需要更好的视觉生成器，还需要可执行的推理机制——即将高级意图分解为具体、可验证的计划，从而直接指导生成过程。为此，我们提出了“统一思考者”这一适用于各种任务的推理架构。该架构作为一个统一的规划核心，可以接入多种生成器和工作流程中。通过这种设计，我们可以将专门的“思考者”模块与图像生成器分离开来，从而实现无需重新训练整个生成模型即可对推理机制进行模块化升级。我们还引入了两阶段训练范式：首先为“思考者”构建结构化的规划接口，然后利用强化学习来根据像素级别的反馈调整其策略，从而促使它优先优化视觉上的正确性而非文本上的合理性。在文本到图像生成以及图像编辑方面的广泛实验表明，“统一思考者”显著提升了图像推理和生成的质量。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Visual and Memory–Augmented Soccer Commentary Generation
papers.title_zh: 基于视觉与记忆技术的足球解说系统开发
papers.authors: Haoran Sun, Natthawut Kertkeidkachorn, Kiyoaki Shirai
papers.abstract: Automatic soccer commentary generation aims to bridge the gap between raw visual content and professional, tactical commentary. However, existing datasets tend to produce incomplete commentary that lacks semantic richness and fails to convey the full visual information present in standard video clips. To address these limitations, we propose two manually curated datasets: SN-Short, which enhances scene-level semantic descriptions, and SN-Long, which captures event continuity for context-aware commentary.Based on these, we design a commentary augmentation pipeline that transforms incomplete annotations into MatchText, a semantically complete and structurally standardized dataset. Leveraging this supervision, we introduce MatchAware, a generation model that incorporates contextual cues from previous events to produce coherent commentary aligned with the visual flow of the game. Experimental results show that proposed approach significantly outperforms existing baselines on the constructed datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动足球评论生成旨在填补原始视觉内容与专业、战术性评论之间的差距。然而，现有的数据集往往会产生不完整的评论，缺乏语义丰富性，也无法充分传达标准视频片段中的全部视觉信息。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了两个经过人工筛选的数据集：SN-Short，它能够增强场景级别的语义描述；以及SN-Long，它能够捕捉事件的连续性，从而实现基于上下文的评论生成。基于这两个数据集，我们设计了一套评论增强流程，将不完整的注释转化为MatchText，这是一个语义完整且结构标准化的数据集。利用这一监督机制，我们引入了MatchAware模型，该模型能够结合之前事件中的上下文线索，生成与比赛视觉流程相一致的连贯评论。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在构建的数据集上显著优于现有的基线方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: InstructDiff: Domain-Adaptive Data Selection via Contrastive Entropy for Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: InstructDiff：利用对比熵进行领域自适应数据选择，以实现高效的LLM微调
papers.authors: Junyou Su, He Zhu, Xiao Luo, Liyu Zhang, Hong-Yu Zhou, Yun Chen, Peng Li, Yang Liu, Guanhua Chen
papers.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is fundamental to adapting large language models, yet training on complete datasets incurs prohibitive costs with diminishing returns. Existing data selection methods suffer from severe domain specificity: techniques optimized for general instruction-following fail on reasoning tasks, and vice versa. We observe that measuring contrastive entropy between base models and minimally instruction-tuned calibrated models reveals a pattern—samples with the lowest contrastive entropy consistently yield optimal performance across domains, yet this principle manifests domain-adaptively: reasoning tasks favor entropy increase (cognitive expansion), while general tasks favor entropy decrease (cognitive compression). We introduce InstructDiff, a unified framework that operationalizes contrastive entropy as a domain-adaptive selection criterion through warmup calibration, bi-directional NLL filtering, and entropy-based ranking. Extensive experiments show that InstructDiff achieves 17% relative improvement over full data training on mathematical reasoning and 52% for general instruction-following, outperforming prior baselines while using only 10% of the data.
papers.abstract_zh: 监督式微调（SFT）是调整大语言模型的基础技术，然而在完整数据集上进行训练会带来过高的成本，且收益递减。现有的数据选择方法存在严重的领域特异性问题：为通用指令遵循任务优化的技术在处理推理任务时表现不佳，反之亦然。我们发现，通过测量基础模型与经过最小程度指令调整的校准模型之间的对比熵，可以发现一种规律——对比熵最低的样本在不同领域都能表现出最佳性能。不过这一原理具有领域适应性：推理任务更倾向于熵的增加（认知扩展），而通用任务则更倾向于熵的减少（认知压缩）。我们提出了InstructDiff这一统一框架，该框架通过将对比熵作为领域适应性选择标准，通过预热校准、双向NLL过滤以及基于熵的排序机制来实现这一目标。大量实验表明，InstructDiff在数学推理方面比全数据训练有17%的相对提升效果，而在通用指令遵循任务上则提升了52%。与之前的基线算法相比，InstructDiff仅使用了10%的数据就能取得如此好的效果。

papers.title: Jakiro: Boosting Speculative Decoding via Decoupled MoE
papers.title_zh: 雅基罗：通过解耦的马尔可夫模型增强推测性解码能力
papers.authors: Haiduo Huang, Fuwei Yang, Zhenhua Liu, Pengju Ren
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has emerged as a promising technique to accelerate large language model inference by employing a smaller draft model to predict multiple tokens, which are then verified in parallel by the larger target model. However, existing approaches face a fundamental limitation: candidates at the same tree layer share identical feature representations, constraining diversity and diminishing overall effectiveness. We identify this as an intra-layer coupling problem that limits prediction accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose Jakiro, which introduces decoupled Mixture of Experts (MoE) into the draft model, enabling different experts to generate diverse candidate tokens from distinct feature spaces. We further propose Contrastive-Enhanced Parallel Decoding (CEPD) that combines autoregressive and parallel decoding with a contrastive mechanism to reduce inference steps while maintaining accuracy. Extensive experiments across diverse models and tasks demonstrate that Jakiro achieves significant speedups over strong baselines, with particularly notable improvements in non-greedy decoding scenarios where token diversity is crucial.
papers.abstract_zh: 投机式解码作为一种有前景的技术，通过采用更小型的草稿模型来预测多个标记，然后由更大的目标模型进行并行验证，从而加速大语言模型的推理过程。然而，现有的方法存在一个根本性的局限性：同一树层的候选者拥有相同的特征表示，这限制了多样性并降低了整体效率。我们认为这是一个层内耦合问题，它限制了预测的准确性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Jakiro算法。该算法在草稿模型中引入了分离的混合专家结构，使得不同的专家能够从不同的特征空间生成多样化的候选标记。我们还提出了对比增强并行解码技术，它将自回归推理与并行解码相结合，并通过对比机制来减少推理步骤，同时保持良好的准确性。通过在不同模型和任务上的广泛实验表明，Jakiro算法相较于其他强大的基线算法实现了显著的性能提升，尤其是在需要高度多样化标记的场合中，其效果尤为显著。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Word Boundaries: A Hebrew Coreference Benchmark and an Evaluation Protocol for Morphologically Complex Text
papers.title_zh: 超越词汇界限：一种用于复杂形态文本的核心指涉方法及其评估协议
papers.authors: Refael Shaked Greenfeld, Reut Tsarfaty
papers.abstract: Coreference Resolution (CR) is a fundamental NLP task critical for long-form tasks as information extraction, summarization, and many business applications. However, CR methods originally designed for English struggle with Morphologically Rich Languages (MRLs), where mention boundaries do not necessarily align with word boundaries, and a single token may consist of multiple anaphors. CR modeling and evaluation protocols standardly assume that, as in English, words and mentions mostly align. However, this assumption breaks down in MRLs, particularly in the context of LLMs’ raw-text processing and end-to-end tasks. To assess and address this challenge, we introduce KibutzR, the first comprehensive CR dataset for Modern Hebrew, an MRL rich with complex words and pronominal clitics. We deliver an annotated dataset that identifies mentions at word, sub-word and multi-word levels, and propose an evaluation protocol that directly addresses word/morpheme boundary discrepancies. Our experiments show that contemporary LLMs perform significantly worse on Hebrew than on English, and that performance degrades on raw unsegmented text. Crucially, we show an inverse performance-trend in Hebrew relative to English, where smaller encoders perform far better than contemporary decoder models, leaving ample space for investigation and improvement. We deliver a new benchmark for Hebrew coreference resolution and a segmentation-aware evaluation protocol to inform future work on other MRLs.
papers.abstract_zh: 共指消解（Coreference Resolution，简称CR）是自然语言处理中的一个基础任务，它在信息提取、摘要生成以及许多商业应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，最初为英语设计的CR方法在词汇丰富型语言（Morphologically Rich Languages，简称MRLs）中遇到了困难——在这些语言中，提及的边界往往与单词的边界不一致，而且一个词符可能包含多个指代对象。传统的CR建模和评估方案都假设单词和提及的边界是一致的，但这一假设在MRLs中并不成立，尤其是在大语言模型处理原始文本和端到端任务中。为了应对这一挑战，我们推出了KibutzR数据集，这是首个针对现代希伯来语的综合性CR数据集。现代希伯来语是一种词汇复杂且代词使用频繁的MRLs语言。我们提供了一份带有注释的数据集，能够识别单词、子单词以及多单词级别的提及；同时，我们提出了一种直接解决单词/音位边界问题的评估方案。我们的实验表明，当前的大语言模型在处理希伯来语时的表现明显不如处理英语时，而且在未经分割的原始文本上，其性能还会进一步下降。值得注意的是，希伯来语的表现趋势与英语相反：较小的编码器模型的表现远优于当前的解码器模型，这为后续的研究和改进提供了广阔的空间。我们为希伯来语的共指消解提供了一个新的基准测试，同时也提出了一种注重分割的评估方案，为其他MRLs的相关研究提供了参考依据。

papers.title: Reasoning with Ontology Graph: Toward Type-Constrained Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 基于本体图的推理：实现类型约束的知识图谱问答技术
papers.authors: Yongxue Shan, Jie Peng, Zixuan Dong, Fei Hu, Xiaodong Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced knowledge graph question answering (KGQA), but current methods tend to rely on LLM-induced type systems with inconsistent granularity, or perform multi-hop reasoning without explicit target-type constraints. We introduce OntGQA, a type-constrained KGQA framework that reasons over a relation-centric ontology graph, where each relation is labeled with its head and tail entity types to provide a stable schema backbone. Built on this graph, OntGQA adopts a planner–judge architecture with generative backoff: a type planner proposes plausible head–tail type pairs, a judge verifies retrieved candidates and their paths, and a generator is invoked only when all candidates are rejected. By constraining both endpoints of reasoning in type space, OntGQA achieves state-of-the-art performance and produces ontology-grounded reasoning chains, with substantial Hit@1 gains (87.7%→91.5% on WebQSP and 67.6%→74.6% on CWQ).
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在知识图谱问答领域取得了显著进展，但目前的方法往往依赖于由语言模型生成的类型系统，这些系统的粒度不一致；或者采用多跳推理方式，而并未对目标类型进行明确约束。我们提出了OntGQA这一基于类型约束的知识图谱问答框架，该框架以关系为中心的本体图为基础进行推理。在每种关系中，都标明了其头部和尾部实体的类型，从而提供了稳定的模式框架。OntGQA采用一种规划者-评判者架构，并采用生成式回退策略：类型规划器会提出可能的头部-尾部类型组合，评判者则会对这些候选方案及其路径进行验证，只有当所有候选方案都被排除后，才会调用生成器。通过限制推理过程中两个端点的类型空间，OntGQA实现了最先进的性能表现，并且能够生成基于本体的推理链，其准确率有了显著提升（在WebQSP任务上的准确率从87.7%提升到了91.5%，在CWQ任务上的准确率从67.6%提升到了74.6%）。

papers.title: Visual Self-Fulfilling Alignment: Shaping Safety-Oriented Personas via Threat-Related Images
papers.title_zh: 视觉自我验证对齐：通过与威胁相关的图像来塑造以安全为导向的角色形象
papers.authors: Qishun Yang, Shu Yang, Lijie Hu, Di Wang
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) face safety misalignment where visual inputs enable harmful outputs. Existing methods require explicit safety labels or contrastive data, yet threat-related concepts are concrete and visually depictable, while safety concepts like helpfulness are abstract and lack visual referents. Inspired by self-fulfilling mechanism underlying emergent misalignment, we propose Visual Self-Fulfilling Alignment (VSFA). VSFA fine-tunes vision-language models (VLMs) on neutral VQA tasks constructed around threat-related images, without any safety labels. Through repeated exposure to threat-related visual content, models internalize implicit semantics of vigilance and caution, shaping safety-oriented personas. Experiments across multiple VLMs and safety benchmarks demonstrate that VSFA reduces attack success rate, improves response quality, and mitigates over-refusal while preserving general capabilities. Our work extends self-fulfilling mechanism from text to visual modalities, offering a label-free approach to VLMs alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型面临一种安全问题——即视觉输入可能导致有害的输出。现有的方法需要明确的安全标签或对比数据，但与威胁相关的概念是具体且可视觉化的，而像“有帮助”这样的安全概念则是抽象的，缺乏视觉参照物。受潜在的错误对齐现象背后的自我实现机制的启发，我们提出了视觉自我实现对齐算法。该算法在没有任何安全标签的情况下，针对与威胁相关的图像进行视觉-语言模型的微调。通过反复接触与威胁相关的视觉内容，模型能够内化出警惕和谨慎的隐含语义，从而塑造出以安全为导向的人物形象。在多个视觉-语言模型和安全基准测试中的实验表明，该算法能够降低攻击成功率、提升响应质量，同时减少过度拒绝的情况，同时保持了模型的一般能力。我们的工作将自我实现机制从文本领域扩展到了视觉领域，提供了一种无需标签即可实现视觉-语言模型对齐的方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GRASPrune: Global Gating for Budgeted Structured Pruning of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: GRASPrune：用于大规模语言模型结构化剪枝的全局门控技术
papers.authors: Ziyang Wang, Jiangfeng Xiao, Chuan Xiao, Ruoxiang LI, Rui Mao, Jianbin Qin
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are expensive to serve because dense FFN blocks, multi-head attention, and KV caches dominate memory, making structured pruning a natural way to reduce serving costs under tight parameter and memory budgets. We present GRASPrune, a global budgeted structured pruning framework applied post-hoc to a pretrained model that jointly prunes FFN channels and attention KV head groups under a single global parameter budget. GRASPrune attaches lightweight learnable gates to prunable units and optimizes only these gates on a small unlabeled language-modeling calibration set, keeping all backbone weights frozen while enforcing the target sparsity at every step. A final budget-preserving scaling calibration reweights the surviving channels and heads to correct scale shifts introduced by pruning. On LLaMA-2-7B, GRASPrune removes 50% of parameters and achieves 12.18 perplexity on WikiText-2 while maintaining competitive average zero-shot accuracy on five downstream benchmarks, using a short calibration run of four epochs on 512 unlabeled sequences on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU, all without any full-model fine-tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的运营成本很高，因为密集的FFN模块、多头注意力机制以及KV缓存占据了大量的内存资源。因此，在参数和内存预算有限的情况下，采用结构化剪枝是一种有效的降低成本的方法。我们提出了GRASPrune框架，它是一个全局预算化的结构化剪枝方法，可以事后应用于预训练模型，同时能够联合剪除FFN通道和注意力KV头部模块，而整个剪枝过程遵循单一的全局参数预算约束。GRASPrune为可剪枝单元添加了轻量级的可学习门控，并仅在小型未标记的语言模型校准集上进行这些门控的优化调整，同时保持所有主干权重不变，并在每一步都强制执行目标稀疏性。最后，通过重新加权剩余的通道和头部，可以纠正由剪枝引入的尺度偏移问题。在LaMA-2-7B模型上，GRASPrune成功剪除了50%的参数，同时在WikiText-2数据集上达到了12.18的困惑度指标。此外，该算法在五个下游基准测试上保持了具有竞争力的零样本准确率。整个优化过程仅需要在单个NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU上，对512个未标记的序列进行四轮短暂的校准训练，而无需对整个模型进行精细调优。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: All That Glisters Is Not Gold: A Benchmark for Reference-Free Counterfactual Financial Misinformation Detection
papers.title_zh: 并非所有闪亮的东西都是黄金：一种无需参考即可检测虚假金融信息的基准方法
papers.authors: Yuechen Jiang, Zhiwei Liu, Yupeng Cao, Yueru He, Ziyang Xu, Chen Xu, Zhiyang Deng, Prayag Tiwari, Xi Chen, Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Jimin Huang, Junichi Tsujii, Sophia Ananiadou
papers.abstract: We introduce RFC-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating large language models on financial misinformation under realistic news. RFC-Bench operates at the paragraph level and captures the contextual complexity of financial news where meaning emerges from dispersed cues. The benchmark defines two complementary tasks: reference-free misinformation detection and comparison-based diagnosis using paired original–perturbed inputs. Experiments reveal a consistent pattern: performance is substantially stronger when comparative context is available, while reference-free settings expose significant weaknesses, including unstable predictions and elevated invalid outputs. These results indicate that current models struggle to maintain coherent belief states without external grounding. By highlighting this gap, RFC-Bench provides a structured testbed for studying reference-free reasoning and advancing more reliable financial misinformation detection in real-world settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了RFC-Bench这一基准测试工具，用于评估大语言模型在真实新闻场景中对金融错误信息进行处理的能力。该测试工具以段落为单位进行评估，能够捕捉金融新闻中的上下文复杂性，因为信息的意义往往源自于分散的线索。该基准测试包含两项互补的任务：无参考的错误信息检测，以及利用成对的原版与扰动版本输入进行对比分析。实验结果表明，当存在可比的上下文信息时，模型的性能会显著提升；而在没有参考信息的情况下，模型则会出现明显的问题，比如预测不稳定以及产生大量无效的输出结果。这些结果表明，当前模型在没有外部引导的情况下，难以保持连贯的信念状态。通过揭示这一缺陷，RFC-Bench为研究无参考推理机制提供了有效的测试平台，有助于在现实场景中实现更可靠的金融错误信息检测。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Musical Score Understanding Benchmark: Evaluating Large Language Models’ Comprehension of Complete Musical Scores
papers.title_zh: 音乐谱理解基准：评估大型语言模型对完整音乐谱的理解能力
papers.authors: Congren Dai, Yue Yang, Krinos Li, Huichi Zhou, Shijie Liang, Bo Zhang, Enyang Liu, Ge Jin, Hongran An, Haosen Zhang, Peiyuan Jing, Kinhei Lee, Zhenxuan Zhang, Xiaobing Li, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Understanding complete musical scores entails integrated reasoning over pitch, rhythm, harmony, and large-scale structure, yet the ability of Large Language Models and Vision–Language Models to interpret full musical notation remains insufficiently examined.We introduce Musical Score Understanding Benchmark (MSU-Bench), a human-curated benchmark for score-level musical understanding across textual (ABC notation) and visual (PDF) modalities. MSU-Bench contains 1,800 generative question–answer pairs from works by Bach, Beethoven, Chopin, Debussy, and others, organised into four levels of increasing difficulty, ranging from onset information to texture and form. Evaluations of more than fifteen state-of-the-art models, in both zero-shot and fine-tuned settings, reveal pronounced modality gaps, unstable level-wise performance, and challenges in maintaining multilevel correctness. Fine-tuning substantially improves results across modalities while preserving general knowledge, positioning MSU-Bench as a robust foundation for future research in multimodal reasoning. The benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/Congren-Dai/MSU-Bench.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解完整的乐谱需要综合考虑音高、节奏、和声以及整体结构等方面。然而，大语言模型和视觉-语言模型在解读完整乐谱方面的能力仍缺乏足够的研究。我们推出了“乐谱理解基准测试”（MSU-Bench），这是一个由人类精心挑选的基准测试，涵盖了文本（ABC记谱法）和视觉（PDF格式）两种形式下的乐谱理解任务。MSU-Bench包含了1800对生成式的问题-答案对，这些例子来自巴赫、贝多芬、肖邦、德彪西等人的作品，测试内容分为四个难度等级，从音符起始信息到音乐的和声与结构都有涉及。对15种先进模型的评估结果显示，这些模型在零样本训练和微调模式下都存在明显的模式差异、性能不稳定等问题，同时也难以保持多层次的正确性。通过微调训练后，这些模型在不同模态上的表现有了显著提升，同时还能保持良好的通用知识水平。因此，MSU-Bench为未来多模态推理领域的研究提供了坚实的基础。该基准测试和代码可访问于https://github.com/Congren-Dai/MSU-Bench。

papers.title: EchoVLM: Dynamic Mixture-of-Experts Vision-Language Model for Universal Ultrasound Intelligence
papers.title_zh: EchoVLM：一种动态专家混合式视觉语言模型，旨在实现通用超声智能应用
papers.authors: Chaoyin She, Ruifang Lu, Lida Chen, Wei Wang, Qinghua Huang
papers.abstract: Ultrasound is the preferred early cancer screening modality due to non-ionizing radiation, cost-effectiveness, and real-time imaging, yet conventional diagnosis relies heavily on physician expertise, causing significant subjectivity and limited efficiency. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show promise but lack ultrasound-specific knowledge and multi-organ generalization. We propose EchoVLM, the first open-source 10-billion-parameter ultrasound-tailored VLM with a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture. It is infused with knowledge across seven anatomical systems, trained on 208,941 clinical cases, 1.47 million ultrasound key-frame images, and over 100 diseases or imaging findings. Supporting clinical report generation, diagnosis prediction, and Visual Question Answering (VQA), it outperforms Qwen2-VL by 7.58 BLEU-1 and 3.45 ROUGE-1 points in report generation. This work shows substantial potential for establishing a general-purpose ultrasound VLM and lays a technical foundation for clinical translation. Source code and model weights are available at https://github.com/Asunatan/EchoVLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 超声是一种优选的早期癌症筛查方式，因为它具有非电离辐射特性、成本效益高且能够实时成像。然而，传统的诊断方式严重依赖医生的专业知识，这导致了很大的主观性以及效率低下的问题。视觉语言模型在这方面显示出潜力，但缺乏针对超声的专门知识以及多器官识别的能力。我们提出了EchoVLM，这是第一个开源的、拥有100亿参数的超声专用视觉语言模型，采用混合专家架构设计。该模型包含了关于七个解剖系统的知识，并在208,941个临床病例、147万张超声关键帧图像以及超过100种疾病或影像表现上进行训练。EchoVLM能够支持临床报告生成、诊断预测以及视觉问答任务，其在报告生成方面的性能优于Qwen2-VL，分别高出7.58 BLEU-1和3.45 ROUGE-1分。这项工作展示了构建通用超声视觉语言模型的巨大潜力，并为临床应用提供了技术基础。源代码和模型权重可在此处获取：https://github.com/Asunatan/EchoVLM
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Critical-CoT: A Robust Defense Framework against Reasoning-Level Backdoor Attacks in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: Critical-CoT：一种针对大型语言模型中推理级后门攻击的稳健防御框架
papers.authors: Vu Tuan Truong, Long Bao Le
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), despite its impressive capabilities across domains, have been shown to be vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Prior backdoor strategies predominantly operate at the token level, where an injected trigger causes the model to generate a specific target word, choice, or class (depending on the task). Recent advances, however, exploit the long-form reasoning tendencies of modern LLMs to conduct reasoning-level backdoors: once triggered, the victim model inserts one or more malicious reasoning steps into its chain-of-thought (CoT). These attacks are substantially harder to detect, as the backdoored answer remains plausible and consistent with the poisoned reasoning trajectory. Yet, defenses tailored to this type of backdoor remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose Critical-CoT, a novel defense mechanism that conducts a two-stage fine-tuning (FT) on LLMs to develop critical thinking behaviors, enabling them to automatically identify potential backdoors and refuse to generate malicious reasoning steps. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and datasets demonstrate that Critical-CoT provides strong robustness against both in-context learning-based and FT-based backdoor attacks. Notably, Critical-CoT exhibits strong cross-domain and cross-task generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/tuanvu171/Critical-CoT.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在多个领域展现出强大的能力，但它们也容易被后门攻击所利用。以往的后门攻击主要停留在词元层面，通过注入特定的触发因素，使模型生成特定的目标单词、选项或类别（具体取决于任务类型）。然而，最近的研究利用了现代语言模型在长形式推理方面的特性，实现了基于推理层面的后门攻击：一旦被触发，被攻击的模型就会在其思维链中插入一个或多个恶意推理步骤。这种攻击很难被检测出来，因为被植入的后门答案看起来是合理且符合原有的推理轨迹的。不过，针对这种类型后门的防御措施目前仍缺乏深入的研究。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Critical-CoT这一新型防御机制。该机制通过对语言模型进行两阶段的微调，使其能够自动识别潜在的后门攻击，并拒绝生成恶意推理步骤。在多个语言模型和数据集上的广泛实验表明，Critical-CoT对基于上下文学习和基于微调的后门攻击都具有很强的鲁棒性。值得注意的是，Critical-CoT还表现出出色的跨领域和跨任务泛化能力。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/tuanvu171/Critical-CoT下载。

papers.title: How Do LLMs and VLMs Understand Viewpoint Rotation Without Vision? An Interpretability Study
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型与超大型语言模型如何在不具备视觉感知能力的情况下理解视角切换？一项可解释性研究
papers.authors: Zhen Yang, Ping Jian, Zhongbin Guo, Zuming Zhang, Chengzhi Li, Yonghong Deng, Xinyue Zhang, Wenpeng Lu
papers.abstract: Over the past year, spatial intelligence has drawn increasing attention. Many prior works study it from the perspective of visual-spatial intelligence, where models have access to visuospatial information from visual inputs. However, in the absence of visual information, whether linguistic intelligence alone is sufficient to endow models with spatial intelligence, and how models perform relevant tasks with text-only inputs still remain unexplored. Therefore, in this paper, we focus on a fundamental and critical capability in spatial intelligence from a linguistic perspective: viewpoint rotation understanding (VRU). Specifically, LLMs and VLMs are asked to infer their final viewpoint and predict the corresponding observation in an environment given textual description of viewpoint rotation and observation over multiple steps. We find that both LLMs and VLMs perform poorly on our proposed dataset while human can easily achieve 100% accuracy, indicating a substantial gap between current model capabilities and the requirements of spatial intelligence. To uncover the underlying mechanisms, we conduct a layer-wise probing analysis and head-wise causal intervention. Our findings reveal that although models encode viewpoint information in the hidden states, they appear to struggle to bind the viewpoint position with corresponding observation, resulting in a hallucination in final layers. Finally, we selectively fine-tune the key attention heads identified by causal intervention to improve VRU performance. Experimental results demonstrate that such selective fine-tuning achieves improved VRU performance while avoiding catastrophic forgetting of generic abilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 在过去的一年中，空间智能受到了越来越多的关注。许多先前的研究都是从视觉-空间智能的角度来研究这一领域的，这些模型能够获取来自视觉输入的空间信息。然而，在缺乏视觉信息的情况下，仅靠语言智能是否足以使模型具备空间智能，以及模型在仅使用文本输入的情况下如何完成相关任务，这些问题仍然有待探索。因此，在本文中，我们从语言的角度出发，重点研究空间智能中的一个基本且关键的能力：视角旋转理解能力。具体来说，我们让大语言模型和视觉语言模型在给定关于视角旋转和观察的描述的情况下，逐步推断出最终视角并预测相应的观察结果。我们发现，无论是大语言模型还是视觉语言模型在我们的实验数据集上的表现都很差，而人类则能够轻松达到100%的准确率，这表明当前模型的能力与空间智能的要求之间存在显著差距。为了揭示其背后的机制，我们对模型的不同注意力头进行了逐层分析以及因果干预实验。我们的研究发现，尽管模型在隐藏状态中编码了视角信息，但它们在将视角位置与相应观察结果联系起来的过程中存在困难，导致最终层的输出出现了幻觉现象。最后，我们通过因果干预确定了关键注意力头，并对它们进行了选择性微调，从而提升了视角旋转理解能力的表现。实验结果表明，这种选择性微调能够改善视角旋转理解能力的表现，同时避免了通用能力的灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: Sycophants in the Courtroom: Are LLMs Fragile to Juridical Authority and Evolving Legal Standards?
papers.title_zh: 法庭上的谄媚者：大型语言模型是否容易受到司法权威的影响？法律标准是否正在发生变化？
papers.authors: Lorenzo Molfetta, Alessio Cocchieri, Luca Ragazzi, Ilaria Bartolini, Marco Patella, Gianluca Moro
papers.abstract: In medicine, claims remain valid when supported by empirical evidence grounded in stable biological reality. In law, by contrast, truth is contingent, defined by jurisdiction, temporal validity, and the hierarchy of authoritative sources. The recent success of large language models (LLMs) on medical licensing examinations has encouraged an expectation of comparable legal competence. This analogy, however, obscures a critical distinction between domains. Unlike in medicine, legal performance often depends less on inference than on determining when external authority is applicable, valid, and non-contradictory. We introduce a comparative diagnostic framework evaluating legal reasoning against medical baselines along four axes (knowledge recall, grounding, confidence, and robustness), uncovering a sharp domain asymmetry when applied to a new benchmark that encodes temporal validity and normative relationships. While medical LLMs reliably benefit from verified sources, legal LLMs struggle to assess when retrieved citations are useful or misleading, exhibiting overconfidence in perturbed contexts and sensitivity to superficial formatting cues. Increased model scale amplifies this tendency, revealing that stronger instruction following can coincide with weaker resistance to authoritative perturbations. These findings show that LLMs treat law as unstructured text rather than binding precedent, while revealing a tendency to over-trust authoritative but false information when external references conflict with a model’s internal knowledge.
papers.abstract_zh: 在医学领域，当某些主张得到基于稳定生物学事实的实证支持时，这些主张仍然具有有效性。而在法律领域，真相则取决于司法管辖范围、时间效力以及权威来源的层级关系。大语言模型在医学执照考试中的成功表现，让人们期待在法律领域也能实现类似的能力水平。然而，这种类比忽略了一个关键的区别：与医学领域不同，法律领域的表现更多地依赖于判断外部权威信息的适用性和合法性，而非单纯的推理能力。我们提出了一个比较性诊断框架，通过四个维度（知识回忆、基础验证、信心度以及鲁棒性）来评估法律推理能力与医学基准之间的差距。研究发现，当应用于包含时间效力和规范关系的新型基准时，法律领域的表现存在明显的领域不对称现象。虽然医学领域的语言模型能够可靠地利用经过验证的信息来源，但法律领域的模型在判断引用内容的有用性或误导性方面却表现得较为困难，它们在受到干扰的情况下容易表现出过度自信，同时也对表面的格式提示非常敏感。随着模型规模的增加，这种倾向愈发明显，表明更强的指令遵循能力可能伴随着对权威信息干扰的较弱抵抗力。这些发现表明，语言模型将法律视为非结构化文本，而非具有约束力的先例，同时当外部参考信息与模型内部知识发生冲突时，它们倾向于过度信任权威信息，而忽视那些虚假的信息。

papers.title: Valid Survey Simulations with Limited Human Data: The Roles of Prompting, Fine-Tuning, and Rectification
papers.title_zh: 在有限的人类数据条件下进行有效的调查模拟：提示、微调与修正的作用
papers.authors: Stefan Krsteski, Giuseppe Russo, Serina Chang, Robert West, Kristina Gligorić
papers.abstract: Surveys provide valuable insights into public opinion and behavior, but their execution is costly and slow. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as a scalable, low-cost substitute for human respondents, but their outputs are often biased and yield invalid estimates. We study the interplay between synthesis methods that use LLMs to generate survey responses and rectification methods that debias population estimates, and explore how human responses are best allocated between them. Using two panel surveys with questions on nutrition, politics, and economics, we find that synthesis alone introduces substantial bias (24–86%), whereas combining it with rectification reduces bias below 5% and increases effective sample size by up to 14%. Overall, we challenge the common practice of using all human responses for fine-tuning, showing that under a fixed budget, allocating most to rectification results in far more effective estimation.
papers.abstract_zh: 调查能够为我们提供关于公众意见和行为的宝贵信息，但其实施过程既昂贵又耗时。大语言模型被提出作为替代人工回答者的可扩展且低成本的方法，但模型的输出往往存在偏差，导致估计结果不准确。我们研究了使用大语言模型生成调查回答的合成方法与修正偏差的校正方法之间的相互作用，并探讨了如何最合理地分配人类回答到这两种方法之中。通过两项涉及营养、政治和经济问题的调查，我们发现仅使用合成方法会导致显著的偏差（24%至86%），而结合校正方法则能将偏差降低到5%以下，同时还能使有效样本量增加多达14%。总体而言，我们挑战了采用全部人类回答进行微调的常见做法，表明在固定预算的情况下，将大部分回答用于校正方法能够获得更为有效的估计结果。

papers.title: ODUTQA-MDC: A Task for Open-Domain Underspecified Tabular QA with Multi-turn Dialogue-based Clarification
papers.title_zh: ODUTQA-MDC：一项基于多轮对话的开放域模糊表格问答任务，旨在提供更为精准的解答
papers.authors: Zhensheng Wang, ZhanTeng Lin, Wenmian Yang, Kun Zhou, Yiquan Zhang, Weijia Jia
papers.abstract: The advancement of large language models (LLMs) has enhanced tabular question answering (Tabular QA), yet they struggle with open-domain queries exhibiting underspecified or uncertain expressions. To address this, we introduce the ODUTQA-MDC task and the first comprehensive benchmark to tackle it. This benchmark includes: (1) a large-scale ODUTQA dataset with 209 tables and 25,105 QA pairs; (2) a fine-grained labeling scheme for detailed evaluation; and (3) a dynamic clarification interface that simulates user feedback for interactive assessment. We also propose MAIC-TQA, a multi-agent framework that excels at detecting ambiguities, clarifying them through dialogue, and refining answers. Experiments validate our benchmark and framework, establishing them as a key resource for advancing conversational, underspecification-aware Tabular QA research.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的发展提升了表格问答的能力，但它们在处理开放域问题时存在困难，因为这些问题往往具有模糊或不确定的表述。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了ODUTQA-MDC任务，这是首个用于解决该问题的综合性基准测试。该基准测试包括：(1)一个包含209个表格和25,105对问答对的大规模ODUTQA数据集；(2)一种细粒度的标注方案，以便进行详细评估；(3)一个动态澄清界面，可以模拟用户反馈，实现交互式评估。我们还提出了MAIC-TQA框架，这是一个多智能体框架，能够有效识别歧义、通过对话进行澄清，并完善答案。实验验证了我们的基准测试和框架的有效性，使其成为推进基于对话且能处理模糊表述的表格问答研究的重要工具。

papers.title: CuBridge: An LLM-Based Framework for Understanding and Reconstructing High-Performance Attention Kernels
papers.title_zh: CuBridge：一种基于长语言模型的框架，用于理解和重构高性能注意力核函数
papers.authors: Xing Ma, Yangjie Zhou, Wu Sun, Zihan Liu, Jingwen Leng, Yun Lin, Shixuan Sun, Minyi Guo, Jin Song Dong
papers.abstract: Efficient CUDA implementations of attention mechanisms are critical to modern deep learning systems, yet supporting diverse and evolving attention variants remains challenging. Existing frameworks and compilers trade performance for flexibility, while expert-written kernels achieve high efficiency but are difficult to adapt. Recent work explores large language models (LLMs) for GPU kernel generation, but prior studies report unstable correctness and significant performance gaps for complex operators such as attention.We present CuBridge, an LLM-based framework that adapts expert-written attention kernels through a structured lift–transfer–lower workflow. CuBridge starts from expert-written CUDA attention kernels and lifts them into an executable intermediate representation that makes execution orchestration explicit while abstracting low-level CUDA syntax. Given a user-provided PyTorch specification, CuBridge generates and verifies a target IR program, then reconstructs optimized CUDA code via reference-guided lowering. Across diverse attention variants and GPU platforms, CuBridge consistently produces correct kernels and substantially outperforms general frameworks, compiler-based approaches, and prior LLM-based methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 高效的CUDA实现注意力机制对于现代深度学习系统至关重要，然而支持多种多样且不断发展的注意力变体仍然具有挑战性。现有的框架和编译器往往以性能为代价来换取灵活性，而由专家编写的内核虽然效率很高，但难以进行适配。最近的研究探索了利用大语言模型来生成GPU内核，但先前的研究表明，这类方法在复杂算子如注意力计算方面存在不稳定的正确性和显著的性能差距。我们提出了CuBridge这一基于大语言模型的框架，它通过结构化的“提升-转换-降低”工作流程，将专家编写的关注内核转化为可执行的中间表示。CuBridge从专家编写的CUDA注意力内核开始，将其提升为可执行的中间表示，使得执行过程更加明确，同时抽象出低级别的CUDA语法。根据用户提供的PyTorch规范，CuBridge能够生成并验证目标中间程序，然后通过参考引导的降阶过程重构出优化的CUDA代码。在多种注意力变体和不同的GPU平台上，CuBridge始终能够生成正确的内核，其性能明显优于一般的框架、基于编译器的方法以及之前基于大语言模型的方法。

papers.title: Learning from Contrasts: Synthesizing Reasoning Paths from Diverse Search Trajectories
papers.title_zh: 从差异中学习：整合来自不同搜索路径的推理路径
papers.authors: Peiyang Liu, Zhirui Chen, Xi Wang, Di Liang, Youru Li, Zhi Cai, Wei Ye
papers.abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) has been widely used for automated reasoning data exploration, but current supervision extraction methods remain inefficient. Standard approaches retain only the single highest-reward trajectory, discarding the comparative signals present in the many explored paths. Here we introduce Contrastive Reasoning Path Synthesis (CRPS), a framework that transforms supervision extraction from a filtering process into a synthesis procedure. CRPS uses a structured reflective process to analyze the differences between high- and low-quality search trajectories, extracting explicit information about strategic pivots and local failure modes. These insights guide the synthesis of reasoning chains that incorporate success patterns while avoiding identified pitfalls. We show empirically that models fine-tuned on just 60K CRPS-synthesized examples match or exceed the performance of baselines trained on 590K examples derived from standard rejection sampling, a 20\times reduction in dataset size. Furthermore, CRPS improves generalization on out-of-domain benchmarks, demonstrating that learning from the contrast between success and failure produces more transferable reasoning capabilities than learning from success alone.
papers.abstract_zh: 蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）已被广泛用于自动化推理和数据探索领域，但目前的监督提取方法仍然效率低下。传统方法只保留奖励最高的那条路径，而忽略了众多探索路径中存在的比较信息。在这里，我们提出了对比推理路径合成（CRPS）框架，该框架将监督提取从过滤过程转变为合成过程。CRPS采用结构化的反思性过程来分析高质量与低质量搜索路径之间的差异，提取关于战略转折点和局部失败模式的明确信息。这些洞察有助于合成推理链，使其能够在避免已识别的陷阱的同时融入成功的模式。我们通过实证研究表明，仅基于60K条CRPS合成示例进行训练的模型，其性能可以与基于590K个示例进行训练的基线模型相媲美甚至超越它们。此外，CRPS在跨领域基准测试中的泛化能力也得到了提升，这表明从成功与失败的对比中学习，比仅从成功中学习更能产生可转移的推理能力。

papers.title: Defenses Against Prompt Attacks Learn Surface Heuristics
papers.title_zh: 防御快速攻击的方法——学习表面启发式算法
papers.authors: Li Li, Chenxiao Yu, Zhiyu Ni, Hao Li, Charith Peris, Chaowei Xiao, Yue Zhao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in security-sensitive applications, where they must follow system- or developer-specified instructions that define the intended task behavior, while completing benign user requests. When adversarial instructions appear in user queries or externally retrieved content, models may override intended logic. Recent defenses rely on supervised fine-tuning with benign and malicious labels. Although these methods achieve high attack rejection rates, we find that they rely on narrow correlations in defense data rather than harmful intent, leading to systematic rejection of safe inputs. We analyze three recurring shortcut behaviors induced by defense fine-tuning. Position bias arises when benign content placed later in a prompt is rejected at much higher rates; across reasoning benchmarks, suffix-task rejection rises from below 10% to as high as 90%. Token trigger bias occurs when strings common in attack data raise rejection probability even in benign contexts; inserting a single trigger token increases false refusals by up to 50%. Topic generalization bias reflects poor generalization beyond the defense data distribution, with defended models suffering test-time accuracy drops of up to 40%. These findings suggest that current prompt-injection defenses frequently respond to attack-like surface patterns rather than the underlying intent. We introduce controlled diagnostic datasets and a systematic evaluation across two base models and multiple defense pipelines, highlighting limitations of supervised fine-tuning for reliable LLM security.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在需要遵循系统或开发者指定规则的安全敏感应用中得到了广泛应用。这些模型必须完成用户的良性请求，同时避免违反既定规则的行为。然而，当用户查询中包含敌对指令或外部获取的内容时，模型可能会忽略既定的逻辑。目前的防御措施依赖于带有良性与恶意标签的监督式微调技术。虽然这些方法能够显著提高对攻击的抵御能力，但我们发现它们依赖于防御数据中的有限关联，而非真正的恶意意图，这导致了对安全输入的无差别拒绝。我们分析了由防御性微调引起的三种常见的误判行为：位置偏见表现为在提示中较晚出现的良性内容被拒绝的比例更高；在推理测试中，后缀任务的拒绝率从不到10%上升到高达90%；令牌触发偏见则表现为攻击数据中常见的字符串即使在良性上下文中也会增加拒绝的概率；插入一个触发令牌会使错误拒绝率上升多达50%。主题泛化偏见则反映了模型在防御数据分布之外表现不佳的情况，受保护的模型在测试阶段的准确率会下降多达40%。这些发现表明，当前的提示注入防御措施往往只是针对表面的攻击模式，而忽视了潜在的恶意意图。我们提出了可控的诊断数据集，并对两种基础模型和多种防御策略进行了系统的评估，从而揭示了监督式微调在确保语言模型安全性方面的局限性。

papers.title: Memory-Augmented LLM-based Multi-Agent System for Automated Feature Generation on Tabular Data
papers.title_zh: 基于记忆增强型大语言模型的多智能体系统，用于表格数据的自动化特征生成
papers.authors: FengXian Dong, Zhi Zheng, Xiao Han, Wei Chen, Jingqing Ruan, Tong Xu, Yong Chen, Enhong Chen
papers.abstract: Automated feature generation extracts informative features from raw tabular data without manual intervention and is crucial for accurate, generalizable machine learning. Traditional methods rely on predefined operator libraries and cannot leverage task semantics, limiting their ability to produce diverse, high-value features for complex tasks. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based approaches introduce richer semantic signals, but still suffer from a restricted feature space due to fixed generation patterns and from the absence of feedback from the learning objective. To address these challenges, we propose a Memory-Augmented LLM-based Multi-Agent System (MALMAS) for automated feature generation. MALMAS decomposes the generation process into agents with distinct responsibilities, and a Router Agent activates an appropriate subset of agents per iteration, further broadening exploration of the feature space. We further integrate a memory module comprising procedural memory, feedback memory, and conceptual memory, enabling iterative refinement that adaptively guides subsequent feature generation and improves feature quality and diversity. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets against state-of-the-art baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化特征生成能够在不需人工干预的情况下，从原始表格数据中提取有信息量的特征，这对于实现准确且可泛化的机器学习至关重要。传统方法依赖于预定义的运算符库，无法充分利用任务的语义特性，这限制了它们为复杂任务生成多样化、高价值特征的能力。最近基于大语言模型的方法引入了更丰富的语义信号，但由于生成模式固定以及缺乏来自学习目标的反馈，其特征空间仍然受到限制。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于记忆增强型大语言模型的多智能体系统，用于自动化特征生成。该系统将生成过程分解为具有不同职责的智能体，同时有一个路由智能体在每次迭代中激活适当的智能体子集，从而进一步扩展对特征空间的探索。我们还集成了一个包含程序性记忆、反馈记忆和概念性记忆的记忆模块，使得特征生成过程能够进行迭代优化，从而提升特征的质量和多样性。我们在多个公共数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，我们的方法非常有效。

papers.title: Learning from the Irrecoverable: Error-Localized Policy Optimization for Tool-Integrated LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 从不可挽回的失败中学习：基于错误定位的政策优化方法在工具集成型LLM推理中的应用
papers.authors: Qiao Liang, Yuke Zhu, Chao Ge, Lei Yang, Ying Shen, Bo Zheng, Sheng Guo
papers.abstract: Tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) enables LLM agents to solve tasks through planning, tool use, and iterative revision, but outcome-only reinforcement learning in this setting suffers from sparse, delayed rewards and weak step-level credit assignment. In long-horizon TIR trajectories, an early irrecoverable mistake can determine success or failure, making it crucial to localize the first irrecoverable step and leverage it for fine-grained credit assignment. We propose Error-Localized Policy Optimization (ELPO), which localizes the first irrecoverable step via binary-search rollout trees under a fixed rollout budget, converts the resulting tree into stable learning signals through hierarchical advantage attribution, and applies error-localized adaptive clipping to strengthen corrective updates on the critical step and its suffix. Across TIR benchmarks in math, science QA, and code execution, ELPO consistently outperforms strong Agentic RL baselines under comparable sampling budgets, with additional gains in Pass@K and Major@K scaling, rollout ranking quality, and tool-call efficiency. Our code is publicly released for reproducibility at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ELPO-7C19.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具集成推理（TIR）使得大语言模型代理能够通过规划、工具使用以及迭代修正来完成任务。然而，在这种环境下，仅基于结果的强化学习存在奖励稀疏、延迟严重以及步骤级信用分配不足的问题。在长视界TIR过程中，早期无法挽回的错误可能会决定任务的成败，因此定位第一个无法挽回的错误并利用它进行细粒度的信用分配至关重要。我们提出了错误定位策略优化（ELPO）方法：该方法在固定的推广预算下，通过二分搜索展开树来定位第一个无法挽回的错误；通过将得到的树结构转化为稳定的学习信号，并利用分层优势归因机制；同时采用错误定位的自适应裁剪技术，以加强对关键步骤及其后续步骤的修正处理。在数学、科学问答和代码执行等TIR基准测试中，ELPO在相似的采样预算下始终优于其他强大的智能体强化学习基线算法，并且在Pass@K和Major@K的扩展性、推广排序质量以及工具调用效率方面也取得了显著提升。我们的代码已公开发布，可访问https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ELPO-7C19进行复现。
