papers.title: Learning from Evolving Training Dynamics: An Entropy-Maximizing Data Curation Strategy for LLM Supervised Post-Training
papers.title_zh: 从不断变化的训练过程中学习：一种旨在最大化熵的数据筛选策略，适用于大型语言模型在训练后的优化处理
papers.authors: Mengxiang Zhang, Lingyuan Liu
papers.abstract: Supervised post-training is essential for refining Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its effectiveness relies heavily on strategic data curation. Traditional Curriculum Learning (CL) strategies often fail to account for the evolving proficiency of the learner, relying instead on static, single dimensional metrics. We propose EVO-Curate, a dynamic data curation framework that synchronizes sample complexity with the maturing capacity of the LLM. EVO-Curate employs an Adaptive Dynamics Measurer to synthesize instantaneous difficulty and historical variability into a multidimensional utility score. To maintain representational diversity, we introduce an Evolutionary Sampling Scheduler based on an entropy maximizing mechanism. Empirical evaluations across instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and code generation demonstrate that EVO-Curate consistently outperforms standard training baselines and traditional CL methods across various architectures and scales. Specifically, our framework achieves relative performance gains of up to about 10% while maintaining manageable computational overhead. These results establish EVO-Curate as a scalable and model agnostic solution for enhancing the efficiency of modern LLM training pipelines.
papers.abstract_zh: 在训练之后的监督处理对于优化大语言模型至关重要，但其效果在很大程度上取决于数据的策略性筛选。传统的课程学习方法往往无法适应学习者的能力变化，而是依赖于静态、单一维度的评估指标。我们提出了EVO-Curate这一动态数据筛选框架，它能够将样本复杂度与语言模型的成长能力相结合。EVO-Curate采用自适应动态测量器，将瞬时难度和历史变化转化为多维的效用评分。为了维持表征的多样性，我们引入了基于熵最大化机制的进化采样调度器。在指令遵循、数学推理和代码生成等方面的实证评估表明，EVO-Curate在各种架构和规模下均优于标准的训练基准和传统课程学习方法。具体来说，我们的框架在保持较低计算开销的同时，能够实现高达约10%的相对性能提升。这些成果证明了EVO-Curate是一种可扩展且不受模型限制的解决方案，能够有效提高现代语言模型训练流程的效率。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning on Pre-Training Data
papers.title_zh: 基于预训练数据的强化学习
papers.authors: Siheng Li, Kejiao Li, Zenan Xu, Guanhua Huang, Kun Li, Haoyuan Wu, Wujiajia, Zihao Zheng, Chenchen Zhang, Kun Shi, Xue Gong, Qi Yi, Ruibin Xiong, Tingqiang Xu, Yuhao Jiang, Jianfeng Yan, Yuyuan Zeng, Guanghui Xu, Jinbao Xue, Zhijiang xu, Zheng Fang, Shuai LI, Qibin Liu, Xiaoxue Li, Zhuoyu Li, Yangyu Tao, Fei Gao, Cheng Jiang, Bochao Wang, Kai Liu, Jianchen Zhu, Wai Lam, Bo Zhou, Di Wang
papers.abstract: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) is largely driven by scaling training compute through either pre-training with next-token prediction (NTP) or post-training with reinforcement learning (RL). The former contributes to learning broad knowledge and skills from general data, while struggling with data inefficiency and catastrophic forgetting in continual learning settings. The latter incentivizes reasoning capabilities with strong generalization, but is constrained by limited data availability due to its reliance on human annotation. To alleviate these issues, we propose Reinforcement Learning on Pre-Training data (RLPT), which combines the advantages of learning from general data and RL. In particular, RLPT derives reward signals directly from general text data through a next-segment reasoning objective, rewarding the policy for correctly predicting next text segments conditioned on the prefix text. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and models demonstrate the effectiveness of . For example, RLPT yields substantial improvements in continual pre-training (+4.6\%) and provides a strong foundation for post-training (+3.4\%) on Qwen3-8B-Base.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）领域的最新进展主要得益于通过预训练进行下一词预测（NTP）或训练后采用强化学习（RL）来提升训练计算能力的改进。前者能够从通用数据中学习到广泛的知识和技能，但存在数据利用效率低下以及连续学习场景中的灾难性遗忘问题。后者则能够激发强大的推理能力，但由于依赖于人类注释，其数据获取能力受到限制。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了基于预训练数据的强化学习方法（RLPT），该方法结合了从通用数据中学习和使用强化学习的优势。具体来说，RLPT通过下一段落推理目标直接从通用文本数据中获取奖励信号，从而奖励那些能够根据前缀文本正确预测下一段落内容的策略。在多个基准测试和模型上的实验表明该方法具有显著效果。例如，RLPT在连续预训练中取得了显著的改进（+4.6%），并且在Qwen3-8B-Base模型的训练后也提供了有力的支持（+3.4%）。

papers.title: Limited Linguistic Diversity in Embodied AI Datasets
papers.title_zh: 实体化人工智能数据集中有限的语言多样性
papers.authors: Selma Liliane Wanna, Agnes Luhtaru, Jonathan Salfity, Ryan Barron, Juston Moore, Cynthia Matuszek, Mitch Pryor
papers.abstract: Language plays a critical role in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, yet the linguistic characteristics of the datasets used to train and evaluate these systems remain poorly documented. In this work, we present a systematic dataset audit of several widely used VLA corpora, aiming to characterize what kinds of instructions these datasets actually contain and how much linguistic variety they provide. We quantify instruction language along complementary dimensions—including lexical variety, duplication and overlap, semantic similarity, and syntactic complexity. Our analysis shows that many datasets rely on highly repetitive, template-like commands with limited structural variation, yielding a narrow distribution of instruction forms. We position these findings as descriptive documentation of the language signal available in current VLA training and evaluation data, intended to support more detailed dataset reporting, more principled dataset selection, and targeted curation or augmentation strategies that broaden language coverage.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言在视语行动（VLA）模型中起着至关重要的作用，然而用于训练和评估这些系统的数据集的语言特征却缺乏系统的记录。在这项研究中，我们对几种常用的VLA语料库进行了系统的分析，旨在了解这些数据集实际包含何种类型的指令，以及它们所提供的语言多样性程度。我们通过多个维度来量化指令语言的特点，包括词汇多样性、重复与重叠、语义相似性和句法复杂性等。我们的分析表明，许多数据集依赖于高度重复、类似模板的指令，其结构变化有限，导致指令形式分布较为狭窄。我们将这些发现视为对当前VLA训练和评估数据中可用语言信号的描述性记录，旨在支持更详细的数据集报告、更有依据的数据集选择，以及能够扩大语言覆盖范围的针对性数据整理或增强策略。

papers.title: Towards Mitigating Modality Bias in Vision-Language Models for Temporal Action Localization
papers.title_zh: 努力减轻视觉语言模型中用于时间动作定位的模态偏见
papers.authors: Jiaqi Li, Guangming Wang, Shuntian Zheng, Minzhe Ni, Xiaoman Lu, Guanghui Ye, Yu Guan
papers.abstract: Temporal Action Localization (TAL) requires identifying both the boundaries and categories of actions in untrimmed videos. While vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich semantics to complement visual evidence, existing approaches tend to overemphasize linguistic priors at the expense of visual performance, leading to a pronounced modality bias. We propose ActionVLM, a vision-language aggregation framework that systematically mitigates modality bias in TAL. Our key insight is to preserve vision as the dominant signal while adaptively exploiting language only when beneficial. To this end, we introduce (i) a debiasing reweighting module that estimates the language advantage—the incremental benefit of language over vision-only predictions—and dynamically reweights language modality accordingly, and (ii) a residual aggregation strategy that treats language as a complementary refinement rather than the primary driver. This combination alleviates modality bias, reduces overconfidence from linguistic priors, and strengthens temporal reasoning. Experiments on THUMOS14 show that our model outperforms state-of-the-art by up to 3.2% mAP. Our code is available at https://github.com/JiaqiLi404/ActionVLM
papers.abstract_zh: 时间动作定位（TAL）需要识别未裁剪视频中动作的边界和类别。虽然视觉-语言模型能够提供丰富的语义信息来补充视觉证据，但现有方法往往过度强调语言先验信息，而忽视了视觉性能，从而导致明显的模态偏见。我们提出了ActionVLM这一视觉-语言聚合框架，它能够系统地缓解TAL中的模态偏见问题。我们的关键思路是保持视觉作为主导信号，仅在语言有益时才会自适应地利用语言信息。为此，我们引入了两种机制：(i) 一个去偏重模块，用于估计语言的优势——即语言相对于仅依赖视觉预测所带来的增量优势——并据此动态调整语言的权重；(ii) 一种残差聚合策略，将语言视为辅助性改进手段，而非主要驱动因素。这种组合方式能够有效缓解模态偏见，减少由语言先验带来的过度自信现象，同时增强时间推理能力。在THUMOS14任务上的实验表明，我们的模型在准确率上比最先进模型高出3.2%。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/JiaqiLi404/ActionVLM获取。

papers.title: CreditDecoding: Accelerating Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Large Language Models with Trace Credit
papers.title_zh: 信用解码：通过追踪机制加速扩散式大型语言模型的并行解码过程
papers.authors: Kangyu Wang, Zhiyun Jiang, Haibo Feng, Weijia Zhao, Lin Liu, Jianguo Li, Zhenzhong Lan, Weiyao Lin
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text through iterative denoising. In commonly adopted parallel decoding schemes, each step confirms only high-confidence positions while remasking the others. By analyzing dLLM denoising traces, we uncover a key inefficiency: models often predict the correct target token several steps before its confidence becomes high enough to be decoded. This gap between early prediction and late decoding forces repeated remasking of already-correct tokens, causing redundant iterations and limiting acceleration. To exploit this temporal redundancy, we introduce Trace Credit to quantify a token’s decoding potential by accumulating historical evidence. Building on this, we propose CreditDecoding, a training-free parallel decoding method that fuses Trace Credit with current logits to boost the confidence of correct but underconfident tokens, thereby accelerating denoising and improving robustness. On eight benchmarks, CreditDecoding achieves up to 5.48 times speedup with +0.48 accuracy on LLaDA-8B and consistently improves performance across diverse dLLM architectures and parameter scales. It further scales to long contexts and remains orthogonal to mainstream inference optimizations, making it a practical and widely applicable solution.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型通过迭代去噪来生成文本。在常用的并行解码方案中，每一步只确认高置信度的位置，而其余位置则被重新标记。通过分析扩散式大语言模型的去噪过程，我们发现了一个关键效率问题：模型往往在目标令牌的置信度达到足够高的阶段之前就预测出了正确的目标令牌。这种早期预测与后期解码之间的差距导致已经正确的令牌需要反复被重新标记，从而产生冗余的迭代过程，进而限制了加速效果。为了利用这种时间上的冗余性，我们引入了“轨迹信用”这一概念，通过积累历史证据来衡量一个令牌的解码潜力。在此基础上，我们提出了“信用解码”这一无需训练的并行解码方法，该方法将轨迹信用与当前的概率值相结合，从而提高正确但置信度较低的令牌的置信度，从而加速去噪过程并提高模型的鲁棒性。在八个基准测试上，“信用解码”实现了高达5.48倍的加速效果，同时在LLaDA-8B数据集上的准确率提升了0.48倍。而且，该方法在不同规模的扩散式大语言模型上都能保持稳定的性能提升。此外，该方法还能处理长上下文的情况，并且与主流的推理优化方案保持正交性，因此是一种实用且适用范围广泛的解决方案。

papers.title: Question Difficulty Estimation for Large Language Models via Answer Plausibility Scoring
papers.title_zh: 基于答案可信度评分的大型语言模型问题难度评估方法
papers.authors: Jamshid Mozafari, Bhawna Piryani, Adam Jatowt
papers.abstract: Estimating question difficulty is a critical component in evaluating and improving large language models (LLMs) for question answering (QA). Existing approaches often rely on readability formulas, retrieval-based signals, or popularity statistics, which may not fully capture the reasoning challenges posed to modern LLMs. In this paper, we introduce Q-DAPS (Question Difficulty based on Answer Plausibility Scores) method, a novel approach that estimates question difficulty by computing the entropy of plausibility scores over candidate answers. We systematically evaluate Q-DAPS across four prominent QA datasets—TriviaQA, NQ, MuSiQue, and QASC—demonstrating that it consistently outperforms baselines. Moreover, Q-DAPS shows strong robustness across hyperparameter variations and question types. Extensive ablation studies further show that Q-DAPS remains robust across different plausibility estimation paradigms, model sizes, and realistic settings. Human evaluations further confirm strong alignment between Q-DAPS’s difficulty estimates and human judgments of question difficulty. Overall, Q-DAPS provides an interpretable, scalable, and bias-resilient approach to question difficulty estimation in modern QA systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 估计问题难度是评估和改进大语言模型在问答任务中的表现的关键环节。现有的方法通常依赖于可读性公式、基于检索的信号或流行度统计，但这些方法可能无法完全捕捉现代语言模型面临的推理挑战。在本文中，我们提出了Q-DAPS方法，这是一种新颖的方法，它通过计算候选答案的合理性得分的熵来估计问题难度。我们在四个著名的问答数据集——TriviaQA、NQ、MuSiQue和QASC上系统地进行了评估，结果表明Q-DAPS始终优于基线方法。此外，Q-DAPS在不同超参数变化和问题类型下都能保持良好的鲁棒性。广泛的消融研究进一步表明，Q-DAPS在不同的合理性估计范式、模型规模以及实际场景中都能保持稳健性。人工评估也证实了Q-DAPS所估计的问题难度与人类判断之间的高度一致性。总体而言，Q-DAPS提供了一种可解释、可扩展且不受偏差影响的现代问答系统中问题难度估计方法。

papers.title: Vector Calligrapher: Generating Scalable Vector Graphics via Structured Linguistic Supervision
papers.title_zh: 矢量图形设计师：通过结构化语言处理技术生成可扩展的矢量图形
papers.authors: Bo Zhou, Xikang Chen, Yan Gong, Yin Zhang
papers.abstract: Generating SVG-based fonts requires Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to translate high-level linguistic intent into low-level, topologically constrained symbolic sequences. However, current approaches struggle with two fundamental misalignments: the semantic ambiguity of unstructured natural language for precise geometric control, and the inefficiency of generic text tokenizers, which fragment coordinate-dense SVG XML into excessively long sequences with low information density. In this work, we propose Vector Calligrapher, a system that treats SVG generation as a conditional language modeling task optimized for both semantic grounding and representational efficiency.To bridge the semantic gap, we introduce a structured linguistic supervision Font Description Framework that decomposes typographic style into interpretable linguistic dimensions (e.g., historical lineage, affective metaphors), providing structured supervision aligned with the compositional syntax of SVG. To address the tokenization bottleneck, we design a scalable separated-coordinate strategy that bypasses the vocabulary explosion of flattened tokens while significantly compressing sequence length. Supported by VectorFont, a dataset of over 10 million hierarchically annotated glyphs, our approach improves CLIP score by +23%, reduces geometric error by ≈48%, and boosts generation efficiency by achieving an 18% Command-per-Token (C/T) ratio—a 6× increase in information density over standard baselines. These results demonstrate that combining structured linguistic supervision with efficient symbolic tokenization is essential for reliable, controllable vector graphics synthesis. VectorFont dataset, Code and model weights will be publicly released.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成基于SVG的字体需要多模态大语言模型将高级语言意图转化为低层次的、具有拓扑约束的符号序列。然而，当前的方法在两个方面存在根本性问题：非结构化自然语言中的语义模糊性，这阻碍了精确的几何控制；以及通用文本分词器的效率低下，它会将坐标密集的SVG XML文件分割成过长且信息密度低的序列。在这项研究中，我们提出了Vector Calligrapher系统，该系统将SVG生成视为一种条件语言建模任务，同时兼顾语义定位和表示效率。为了弥合语义上的差距，我们引入了一种结构化的语言监督机制——Font Description Framework，它将排版风格分解为可解释的语言维度（如历史渊源、情感隐喻等），为SVG的复合句法提供了结构化的监督支持。为了解决分词瓶颈问题，我们设计了一种可扩展的分隔坐标策略，该策略避免了扁平化词条的词汇表爆炸问题，同时显著缩短了序列长度。借助VectorFont数据集，该数据集包含超过1000万个层次化标注的字形，我们的方法使CLIP得分提高了23%，几何误差减少了约48%，并且通过实现18%的每标记命令比例，提升了生成效率——这一比例比标准基线高出6倍。这些结果表明，结合结构化的语言监督和高效的符号分词技术对于可靠、可控的矢量图形合成至关重要。VectorFont数据集、代码及模型权重将会公开发布。

papers.title: CoQuIR: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Code Quality-Aware Information Retrieval
papers.title_zh: CoQuIR：一种全面的代码质量相关信息检索基准测试工具
papers.authors: Jiahui Geng, Fengyu Cai, Shaobo Cui, Qing Li, Liangwei Chen, Chenyang Lyu, Haonan Li, Derui Zhu, Alexander Pretschner, Heinz Koeppl, Fakhri Karray
papers.abstract: Code retrieval is vital to modern software engineering as it boosts reuse and speeds up debugging. However, current benchmarks primarily emphasize functional relevance while neglecting code quality. To address this gap, we introduce CoQuIR, the first large-scale, multilingual benchmark specifically designed to evaluate quality-aware code retrieval across four critical dimensions: correctness, efficiency, security, and maintainability. CoQuIR includes fine-grained quality annotations over 42,725 queries and 134,907 code snippets in 11 programming languages. Evaluating 23 retrievers (both open-source and proprietary) shows that even state-of-the-art models often fail to separate buggy or insecure code from robust counterparts. We further investigate methods for explicitly training retrievers to recognize code quality, demonstrating that quality-aware metrics can be improved without loss of semantic relevance; downstream code generation benefits from these gains. CoQuIR underscores the importance of embedding quality signals into retrieval systems as a crucial component for more trustworthy developer tools.
papers.abstract_zh: 代码检索在现代软件工程中至关重要，因为它能够提升代码的复用性并加快调试过程。然而，当前的评估标准主要侧重于代码的功能相关性，而忽视了代码质量方面的问题。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了CoQuIR这一大规模、多语言评估框架。该框架专门设计用于从四个关键维度来评估代码的质量：正确性、效率、安全性和可维护性。CoQuIR包含了关于42,725条查询和134,907段代码的细粒度质量注释，这些代码来自11种编程语言。通过对23种检索器进行评估（包括开源和专有系统），我们发现即使是最先进的模型也常常无法将有缺陷或不安全的代码与可靠的代码区分开来。我们进一步研究了如何训练检索器以识别代码质量，结果表明，在不丧失语义相关性的前提下，可以改进基于质量的评估指标；这种改进还能提升下游代码生成的效果。CoQuIR强调了将质量信号融入检索系统的重要性，因为这对于打造更可靠的开发者工具来说至关重要。

papers.title: Sherry: Hardware-Efficient 1.25-Bit Ternary Quantization via Fine-grained Sparsification
papers.title_zh: 雪莉：通过细粒度稀疏化技术实现硬件高效的1.25位三进制量化方法
papers.authors: Hong Huang, Decheng Wu, Qiangqiang Hu, Guanghua Yu, Jinhai Yang, Jianchen Zhu, Xue Liu, Dapeng Wu
papers.abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) on resource-constrained edge devices is increasingly hindered by prohibitive memory and computational requirements. While ternary quantization offers a compelling solution by reducing weights to -1, 0, +1, current implementations suffer from a fundamental misalignment with commodity hardware. Most existing methods must choose between 2-bit aligned packing, which incurs significant bit wastage, or 1.67-bit irregular packing, which degrades inference speed. To resolve this tension, we propose Sherry, a hardware-efficient ternary quantization framework. Sherry introduces a 3:4 fine-grained sparsity that achieves a regularized 1.25-bit width by packing blocks of four weights into five bits, restoring power-of-two alignment. Furthermore, we identify weight trapping issue in sparse ternary training, which leads to representational collapse. To address this, Sherry introduces Arenas, an annealing residual synapse mechanism that maintains representational diversity during training. Empirical evaluations on LLaMA-3.2 across five benchmarks demonstrate that Sherry matches state-of-the-art ternary performance while significantly reducing model size. Notably, on an Intel i7-14700HX CPU, our 1B model achieves zero accuracy loss compared to SOTA baselines while providing 25% bit savings and 10% speed up. The code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AngelSlim.
papers.abstract_zh: 在资源有限的边缘设备上部署大语言模型（LLM）时，由于内存和计算需求的限制，这一任务变得越来越困难。虽然三值量化提供了一种有效的解决方案，通过将权重简化为-1、0、+1三种状态，但目前的实现方式与主流硬件存在根本性的不匹配。大多数现有方法必须在2位对齐的打包方式和1.67位的不规则打包方式之间做出选择，而2位对齐的打包方式会导致大量的比特浪费，而不规则打包方式则会降低推理速度。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Sherry这一硬件高效的三值量化框架。Sherry采用了3:4的细粒度稀疏性策略，通过将四个权重的块打包到五个比特中，实现了1.25位的宽度，从而恢复了二进制的对齐方式。此外，我们还发现了稀疏三值训练中的权重陷阱问题，这会导致表示能力的下降。为了解决这个问题，Sherry引入了Arenas机制，这是一种退火式残差突触机制，可以在训练过程中保持表示的多样性。在LaLaMA-3.2上进行的五项基准测试表明，Sherry在显著减少模型大小的同时，仍然达到了最先进的三值量化性能水平。值得注意的是，在Intel i7-14700HX CPU上，我们的10亿参数模型与最先进的基线模型相比，准确率没有下降，同时还节省了25%的比特数，并提高了10%的推理速度。相关代码可以在https://github.com/Tencent/AngelSlim下载。

papers.title: DMN: A Compositional Framework for Jailbreaking Multimodal LLMs with Multi-Image Inputs
papers.title_zh: DMN：一种用于支持多图像输入的越狱式多模态大语言模型的组合框架
papers.authors: Wenzhuo Xu, Zhipeng Wei, Zonghao Ying, Deyue Zhang, Dongdong Yang, Xiangzheng Zhang, Quanchen Zou
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, which can elicit harmful responses from MLLMs. Many MLLMs support multi-image inputs, inadvertently introducing new vulnerabilities due to less efforts on multi-image safety alignment. Previous MLLM jailbreak methods only uses a single image, which restricts the attack space: they cannot distribute harmful requests across multiple images, carry abundant information, or exploit additional visual reasoning tasks to distract MLLMs. To address these limitations, in this paper, we propose a compositional jailbreak framework, \textbf{DMN}, which leverages \textbf{D}istributed instruction, \textbf{M}ultimodal evidence and a \textbf{N}umber chain task to fully enhance the jailbreak performance. Extensive experiments show that DMN is highly effective for MLLM jailbreaking, e.g. achieving attack success rates of over 90% on GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-pro and Claude Sonnet 4, surpassing other baselines by a large margin. This compositional, multi-image jailbreak strategy reveals fundamental weaknesses in their safety mechanisms.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型容易受到越狱攻击，这些攻击可能会引发有害的行为。许多多模态大语言模型支持多图像输入，但由于在多图像安全对齐方面的投入不足，从而无意中引入了新的漏洞。以往的越狱方法仅使用单张图像，这限制了攻击的范围：它们无法将有害请求分散到多张图像上，也无法利用丰富的信息或额外的视觉推理任务来干扰多模态大语言模型。为了克服这些限制，本文提出了一种组合式越狱框架——DMN。该框架利用分布式指令、多模态证据以及数值链任务，全面提升越狱性能。大量实验表明，DMN在多模态大语言模型的越狱方面效果显著，例如在GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-pro和Claude Sonnet 4上，其攻击成功率超过90%，远远超过了其他基线方法。这种组合式的多图像越狱策略揭示了这些模型在安全机制上的根本弱点。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PIAST: Rapid Prompting with In-context Augmentation for Scarce Training data
papers.title_zh: PIAST：针对稀缺训练数据设计的快速提示机制，结合上下文增强技术
papers.authors: Paweł Batorski, Paul Swoboda
papers.abstract: LLMs are highly sensitive to prompt design, but handcrafting effective prompts is difficult and often requires intricate crafting of few-shot examples. We propose a fast automatic prompt construction algorithm that augments human instructions by generating a small set of few shot examples. Our method iteratively replaces/drops/keeps few-shot examples using Monte Carlo Shapley estimation of example utility. For faster execution, we use aggressive subsampling and a replay buffer for faster evaluations. Our method can be run using different compute time budgets. Under a limited budget, it outperforms prior automatic prompting methods on text simplification and mathematical reasoning (GSM8K, DeepMath, Math500), while achieving second-best results on classification and summarization and third-best on MedQA. With an extended, yet still modest budget, PIAST sets a new state of the art among automatic prompting methods on classification, simplification, GSM8K, DeepMath, and Math500. Overall, our results suggest that optimizing in-context examples, rather than exhaustively searching over instruction rewrites is the dominant lever for fast and data-efficient prompt engineering. We will release code and data upon acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型对提示的设计非常敏感，但手工制作有效的提示却很困难，通常需要精心构造少量样本。我们提出了一种快速的自动提示构建算法，该算法通过生成一组少量样本来补充人类提供的指令。我们的方法通过蒙特卡洛夏普利估计方法来迭代地替换、丢弃或保留这些样本。为了加快执行速度，我们使用了高效的子采样技术以及回放缓冲区来加速评估过程。我们的方法可以在不同的计算时间预算下运行。在有限的预算下，它在文本简化和数学推理任务上的表现优于现有的自动提示方法（如GSM8K、DeepMath、Math500），而在分类和摘要任务上则取得了第二好的成绩，在MedQA任务上则取得了第三好的成绩。在更充裕的预算下，PIAST在分类、文本简化、GSM8K、DeepMath和Math500等任务上实现了自动提示方法中的新纪录。总体而言，我们的结果表明，优化上下文中的样本，而不是穷尽性地重新编写指令，是快速且高效构建提示的关键手段。一旦项目被接受，我们将会发布相关的代码和数据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ProgressLM: Towards Progress Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: ProgressLM：在视觉-语言模型中实现进展推理
papers.authors: Jianshu Zhang, Chengxuan Qian, Haosen Sun, Haoran Lu, Dingcheng Wang, Letian Xue, Han Liu
papers.abstract: Estimating task progress requires long-horizon and dynamic reasoning, going beyond static visual perception. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at describing what is visible in a single observation, it remains unclear whether they can infer how far a task has progressed from partial information. To study this question, we introduce Progress-Bench, a benchmark with over 3K instances for evaluating progress reasoning from a single observation. We further examine a human-inspired two-stage paradigm that combines episodic retrieval with mental simulation. We instantiate this paradigm through both training-free prompting and a training-based approach using the automatically curated ProgressLM-45K dataset. Experiments on 14 VLMs show that most models struggle with reliable progress estimation, and that training-free reasoning provides only limited and model-dependent benefits. In contrast, the training-based ProgressLM-3B achieves consistent improvements in accuracy, robustness to viewpoint variation, and handling of unanswerable cases, despite its small scale. Additional analyses reveal common failure patterns in existing VLMs and clarify when and why progress reasoning succeeds or fails.
papers.abstract_zh: 估算任务进度需要长期视角和动态推理能力，这超出了静态视觉感知的能力范围。虽然视觉语言模型在描述单次观察中可见的内容方面表现出色，但尚不清楚它们是否能够从部分信息推断出任务的进展程度。为了研究这个问题，我们引入了“Progress-Bench”基准测试，该测试包含超过3K个实例，用于评估从单次观察中推断进度的情况。我们还探讨了一种受人类启发的两阶段范式，该范式结合了情景检索和心理模拟技术。我们通过无训练提示的方法以及使用自动筛选的ProgressLM-45K数据集进行训练的方法来实现这一范式。在14种视觉语言模型上的实验表明，大多数模型在可靠地估算进度方面存在困难，而无训练提示的推理只能带来有限且依赖于模型的优势。相比之下，基于训练的ProgressLM-3B模型在准确性、对视角变化的鲁棒性以及处理无法回答的问题方面都取得了稳定的改进，尽管其规模较小。进一步的分析揭示了现有视觉语言模型中的常见失败模式，并明确了进度推理何时以及为何会成功或失败。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Forest Before Trees: Latent Superposition for Efficient Visual Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 森林先于树木存在：用于高效视觉推理的潜在叠加原理
papers.authors: Yubo Wang, Juntian Zhang, Yichen Wu, Yankai Lin, Nils Lukas, Yuhan Liu
papers.abstract: While Chain-of-Thought empowers Large Vision-Language Models with multi-step reasoning, explicit textual rationales suffer from an information bandwidth bottleneck, where continuous visual details are discarded during discrete tokenization. Recent latent reasoning methods attempt to address this challenge, but often fall prey to premature semantic collapse due to rigid autoregressive objectives. In this paper, we propose Laser, a novel paradigm that reformulates visual deduction via Dynamic Windowed Alignment Learning. Instead of forcing a point-wise prediction, Laser aligns the latent state with a dynamic validity window of future semantics. This mechanism enforces a “Forest-before-Trees” cognitive hierarchy, enabling the model to maintain a probabilistic superposition of global features before narrowing down to local details. Crucially, Laser maintains interpretability via decodable trajectories while stabilizing unconstrained learning via Self-Refined Superposition. Extensive experiments on 6 benchmarks demonstrate that Laser achieves state-of-the-art performance among latent reasoning methods, surpassing the strong baseline Monet by 5.03% on average. Notably, it achieves these gains with extreme efficiency, reducing inference tokens by more than 97%, while demonstrating robust generalization to out-of-distribution domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然思维链技术为大型视觉语言模型提供了多步推理能力，但明确的文本理由存在信息带宽瓶颈问题，因为在离散的标记化过程中，连续的视觉细节会被丢弃。最近的潜在推理方法试图解决这一挑战，但由于严格的自回归目标，这些方法往往会导致语义过早崩溃。在本文中，我们提出了Laser这一新颖的范式，它通过动态窗口对齐学习来重新构建视觉推理过程。与强制进行逐点预测不同，Laser将潜在状态与未来语义的动态有效窗口进行对齐。这种机制实现了“森林优先于树木”的认知层次结构，使得模型能够在聚焦于局部细节之前，保持全局特征的概率叠加。关键的是，Laser通过可解码的轨迹保持了可解释性，同时通过自我精细化的叠加稳定了无约束学习。在6个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Laser在潜在推理方法中取得了最先进的性能，平均比强大的基线模型Monet高出5.03%。值得注意的是，Laser以极高的效率实现了这些性能提升，推理令牌减少了超过97%，同时展现了对超出分布域的鲁棒性泛化能力。

papers.title: Beyond Pedagogical Principles: Multi-Horizon Preference Optimization for Efficient Socratic Tutoring
papers.title_zh: 超越教学原则：多视域偏好优化算法在高效苏格拉底式辅导中的应用
papers.authors: Xin Shi, Chao Zhang, Yifan Zhu, Xueqiao Zhang, Yawei Luo
papers.abstract: The development of LLM-based tutor agents faces challenges in simultaneously ensuring adherence to pedagogical principles and achieving optimal pedagogical effectiveness, particularly in dynamic, multi-turn interactions. Existing methods are often constrained by static data or sparse reward signals in online settings. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{H}orizon \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization (\textbf{MHPO}), a novel framework that iteratively refines tutor agents using a multi-horizon reward function within a dynamic teacher-student simulation environment. Specifically, this reward function is designed to capture both turn-level pedagogical quality and trajectory-level pedagogical effectiveness, which is estimated via Monte Carlo rollouts. We further investigate two distinct strategies to aggregate these rewards for policy optimization. Our experiments demonstrate that MHPO significantly enhances base model performance, achieving a superior balance between principles and effectiveness compared to various baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的导师代理的开发面临着同时确保遵循教学原则与实现最佳教学效果的挑战，尤其是在动态、多轮交互的场景中。现有的方法往往受到静态数据或在线环境中稀疏奖励信号的限制。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了**多视野偏好优化**框架，该框架在动态师生模拟环境中，通过多视野奖励函数来迭代改进导师代理的性能。具体来说，这种奖励函数旨在同时捕捉轮次层面的教学质量和轨迹层面的教学效果，而教学效果是通过蒙特卡洛抽样来估算的。我们还研究了两种不同的策略来整合这些奖励数据，以用于策略优化。我们的实验表明，MHPO显著提升了基础模型的表现，与各种基线方法相比，它在原则性与效果之间实现了更好的平衡。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Protecting Language Models Against Unauthorized Distillation through Trace Rewriting
papers.title_zh: 通过追踪重写技术来保护语言模型免受未经授权的提取行为侵害
papers.authors: Xinhang Ma, William Yeoh, Ning Zhang, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation is a widely adopted technique for transferring capabilities from LLMs to smaller, more efficient student models.However, unauthorized use of knowledge distillation takes unfair advantage of the considerable effort and cost put into developing frontier models.We investigate methods for modifying teacher-generated reasoning traces to achieve two objectives that deter unauthorized distillation: (1) anti-distillation, or degrading the training usefulness of query responses, and (2) API watermarking, which embeds verifiable signatures in student models.We introduce several approaches for dynamically rewriting a teacher’s reasoning outputs while preserving answer correctness and semantic coherence.Two of these leverage the rewriting capabilities of LLMs, while others use gradient-based techniques.Our experiments show that a simple instruction-based rewriting approach achieves a strong anti-distillation effect while maintaining or even improving teacher performance.Furthermore, we show that our rewriting approach also enables embedding watermarks that can be reliably detectedwith essentially no false alarms.Our code is available at https://github.com/xhOwenMa/trace-rewriting.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏是一种被广泛采用的技术，用于将大语言模型的能力转移给更小、更高效的子模型。然而，未经授权的知识蒸馏会不公平地利用开发前沿模型所付出的巨大努力和成本。我们研究了修改教师生成的推理轨迹的方法，以实现两个目标：一是防止未经授权的蒸馏，即降低查询响应的训练实用性；二是通过API水印技术，在子模型中嵌入可验证的签名。我们提出了几种动态重写教师推理输出的方法，同时保留答案的正确性和语义一致性。其中两种方法利用了大语言模型的重写能力，而其他方法则采用了基于梯度的技术。我们的实验表明，一种简单的基于指令的重写方法能够在保持甚至提升教师性能的同时，实现强大的反蒸馏效果。此外，我们还证明了我们的重写方法能够可靠地嵌入水印，且几乎不会产生误报。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/xhOwenMa/trace-rewriting下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Confidence Dichotomy: Analyzing and Mitigating Miscalibration in Tool-Use Agents
papers.title_zh: 自信的二分法：分析与缓解工具使用型代理中的校准问题
papers.authors: Weihao Xuan, Qingcheng Zeng, Heli Qi, Yunze Xiao, Junjue Wang, Naoto Yokoya
papers.abstract: Autonomous agents based on large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving to handle multi-turn tasks, but ensuring their trustworthiness remains a critical challenge. A fundamental pillar of this trustworthiness is calibration, which refers to an agent’s ability to express confidence that reliably reflects its actual performance. While calibration is well-established for static models, its dynamics in tool-integrated agentic workflows remain under-explored. In this work, we systematically investigate verbalized calibration in tool-use agents, revealing a fundamental confidence dichotomy driven by tool type. Specifically, our pilot study identifies that evidence tools (e.g., web search) systematically induce severe overconfidence due to inherent noise in retrieved information, while verification tools (e.g., code interpreters) can ground reasoning through deterministic feedback and mitigate miscalibration. To robustly improve calibration across tool types, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning framework that jointly optimizes task accuracy and calibration, supported by a holistic benchmark of reward designs. We demonstrate that our trained agents not only achieve superior calibration but also exhibit robust generalization from local training environments to noisy web settings and to distinct domains such as mathematical reasoning. Our results highlight the necessity of domain-specific calibration strategies for tool-use agents. More broadly, this work establishes a foundation for building self-aware agents that can reliably communicate uncertainty in high-stakes, real-world deployments.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的自主智能体正在迅速发展，以处理多轮任务，但确保其可信度仍然是一个关键挑战。这种可信度的核心要素是校准机制，即智能体能够表达出可靠的自信，从而反映其实际性能。虽然对于静态模型来说，校准机制已经得到了充分研究，但在工具集成智能体的工作流程中，校准的动态特性却尚未得到充分探索。在这项研究中，我们系统地研究了工具使用智能体中的言语化校准机制，发现信任度的差异主要由工具类型决定。具体来说，我们的试点研究表明，证据工具（如网络搜索）会由于检索到的信息存在固有噪声而引发严重的过度自信，而验证工具（如代码解释器）则可以通过确定性反馈来引导推理过程，从而减轻校准误差。为了在不同类型的工具中实现稳健的校准，我们提出了一种强化学习微调框架，该框架同时优化了任务准确性和校准机制，并通过全面的奖励设计体系加以支持。我们的实验表明，经过训练的智能体不仅实现了出色的校准效果，还能够在从局部训练环境到嘈杂的网络环境，以及数学推理等不同领域的情况下，展现出强大的泛化能力。我们的研究结果强调了为工具使用智能体制定特定领域的校准策略的必要性。更广泛地说，这项工作为构建能够在高风险的实际应用中可靠传达不确定性的自我感知智能体奠定了基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: XOXO: Stealthy Cross-Origin Context Poisoning Attacks against AI Coding Assistants
papers.title_zh: XOXO：一种隐蔽的跨原域上下文注入攻击，针对人工智能编程辅助工具进行攻击
papers.authors: Adam Štorek, Mukur Gupta, Noopur Bhatt, Aditya Gupta, Janie Kim, Prashast Srivastava, Suman Jana
papers.abstract: AI coding assistants automatically gather context from potentially untrusted sources to generate code recommendations. We introduce Cross-Origin Context Poisoning (XOXO), a novel attack that exploits this automatic context inclusion by subtly manipulating code without changing its semantics. Attackers introduce semantics-preserving transformations (e.g., renamed variables) to shared code, causing AI assistants to unknowingly recommend vulnerable code patterns to victims. To systematically identify effective transformations, we present Greedy Cayley Graph Search (GCGS), a black-box algorithm that efficiently composes transformations to identify adversarial inputs. Our evaluation demonstrates XOXO’s effectiveness at making LLMs generate buggy and vulnerable code, achieving average attack success rates of 73.20% against eight state-of-the-art models including GPT 4.1 and Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2, with vulnerability injection rates up to 66.67%. We also demonstrate a real-world attack against GitHub Copilot, highlighting critical security gaps in current AI coding tools.
papers.abstract_zh: AI编码助手会自动从可能不可信的来源收集上下文信息，以生成代码建议。我们提出了跨源上下文注入攻击（XOXO），这是一种利用这种自动上下文收集机制的新型攻击方式，攻击者通过巧妙地修改代码而不改变其语义来实现攻击目标。攻击者会在共享代码中引入保持语义不变的转换（例如，重命名变量），从而使AI助手在不知不觉中向受害者推荐有缺陷的代码模式。为了系统地识别有效的转换方法，我们提出了贪婪Cayley图搜索算法，该算法能够高效地组合各种转换来识别具有对抗性的输入。我们的评估结果显示，XOXO能够有效促使大语言模型生成存在漏洞的代码，平均攻击成功率为73.20%，针对的模型包括GPT 4.1和Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2等先进模型，其中漏洞注入率高达66.67%。我们还对GitHub Copilot进行了实际攻击测试，揭示了当前AI编码工具中存在的安全隐患。

papers.title: SafeMCP: Proactive Power Regulation for LLM Agent Defense via Environment-Grounded Look-Ahead Reasoning
papers.title_zh: SafeMCP：基于环境预测的主动功率调节机制，用于保护大型语言模型代理免受攻击
papers.authors: Lichao Wang, ZhaoXing Ren, Tianzhuo Yang, Jiaming Ji, Chi Harold Liu, Yaodong Yang, Juntao Dai
papers.abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly leverage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to operate in complex environments, the expansion of their action spaces offers agents unsafe capabilities and underscores the risk of power-seeking. While broad action space and greater environment influence are essential for task fulfillment, they creates a fragile risk surface where minor errors or hallucinations are magnified into catastrophic failures. In response, we propose SafeMCP, a server-side defense plugin that constrains tool acquisition via predictive reasoning regarding future safety risks. SafeMCP utilizes an internal world model for look-ahead reasoning to implement a two-tier defense: proactive tool filtering to constrain hazardous power expansion and immediate intervention as a fail-safe. To train SafeMCP, we introduce a three-stage pipeline comprising environmental dynamic grounding, safe policy initialization, and reinforcement learning (RL) with dual verifiable rewards. Experiments on PowerSeeking Bench, ToolEmu, and AgentHarm show that SafeMCP achieves a safe equilibrium, effectively mitigating risks while preserving agent utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型代理越来越多地利用模型上下文协议在复杂环境中运行，它们的行动空间不断扩大，这赋予了代理一些不安全的能力，同时也增加了权力寻租的风险。虽然广泛的行动空间和更大的环境影响力对于完成任务至关重要，但它们也带来了脆弱的风险面——微小的错误或幻觉可能会被放大成灾难性的失败。为此，我们提出了SafeMCP这一服务器端防御插件，它通过预测性推理来限制工具的使用，从而规避未来的安全风险。SafeMCP利用内部世界模型进行前瞻性推理，从而实现双层防御机制：通过主动工具过滤来限制危险权力的扩张，并在出现故障时立即进行干预以起到保险作用。为了训练SafeMCP，我们采用了三阶段流程：环境动态建模、安全策略初始化，以及带有双重可验证奖励的强化学习。在PowerSeeking Bench、ToolEmu和AgentHarm上的实验表明，SafeMCP能够实现安全的平衡状态，有效降低风险的同时，还能保持代理的效用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: C2: Scalable Rubric-Augmented Reward Modeling from Binary Preferences
papers.title_zh: C2：基于二元偏好可扩展的奖励模型设计
papers.authors: Akira Kawabata, Saku Sugawara
papers.abstract: Rubric-augmented verification guides reward models with explicit evaluation criteria, yielding more reliable judgments than single-model verification.However, most existing methods require costly rubric annotations, limiting scalability.Moreover, we find that rubric generation is vulnerable to a failure of cooperation; low-quality rubrics actively mislead reward models rather than help. Inspired by the principle of cooperative communication, we propose Cooperative yet Critical reward modeling (C2), a framework that significantly improves reward model judgments by having the reward model critically collaborate with a rubric generator trained solely from binary preferences.In C2, we synthesize helpful and misleading rubric pairs by measuring how each rubric shifts the reward model toward or away from the correct preference. Using these contrastive pairs, we train a cooperative rubric generator to propose helpful rubrics, and a critical verifier to assess rubric validity before making its judgment, following only rubrics it deems helpful at inference time. C2 outperforms reasoning reward models trained on the same binary preferences, with gains of up to 6.5 points on RM-Bench and 6.0 points length-controlled win rate on AlpacaEval 2.0. Without external rubric annotations, C2 enables an 8B reward model to match performance achieved with rubrics from a 4\times larger model.Overall, our work demonstrates that eliciting deliberate cooperation in rubric-augmented verification makes reward models more trustworthy in a scalable way.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于评分标准的验证方法通过明确的评估标准来指导奖励模型的判断，这比单一模型的验证更为可靠。然而，大多数现有方法都需要昂贵的评分标准注释，这限制了其可扩展性。此外，我们发现评分标准的生成容易受到合作失败的影响；低质量的评分标准反而会对奖励模型产生误导，而不是提供帮助。受合作交流原则的启发，我们提出了“合作但批判性”的奖励建模框架（C2）。该框架通过让奖励模型与仅基于二元偏好训练的评分标准生成器进行批判性协作，显著提升了奖励模型的判断能力。在C2中，我们通过测量每个评分标准如何引导奖励模型朝向或远离正确的偏好，来合成有用和误导性的评分标准对。利用这些对比对，我们训练出一个合作性强的评分标准生成器，以及一个批判性验证器，后者在做出判断之前会评估评分标准的有效性，只采用在推理时认为有用的评分标准。与基于相同二元偏好训练的推理奖励模型相比，C2的表现更优，在RM-Bench测试上的得分提高了6.5分，在AlpacaEval 2.0上的长度控制胜率提高了6.0分。在没有外部评分标准注释的情况下，C2使得一个拥有80亿参数的奖励模型能够达到与更大规模模型的评分标准相当的性能。总体而言，我们的研究表明，在基于评分标准的验证中引入有意识的合作，能够以可扩展的方式提升奖励模型的可靠性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLaDA 1.5: Variance-Reduced Preference Optimization for Large Language Diffusion Models
papers.title_zh: LLaDA 1.5：用于大型语言扩散模型的方差降低偏好优化方法
papers.authors: Fengqi Zhu, Rongzhen Wang, Shen Nie, Xiaolu Zhang, Chunwei Wu, Jun Zhou, Yankai Lin, Ji-Rong Wen, Chongxuan Li
papers.abstract: Masked diffusion language models present a promising paradigm for language modeling, yet the systematic theoretical analysis and comprehensive empirical validation of their alignment on general tasks remain relatively underexplored. In this paper, we identify the primary challenge for this problem: the high variance in Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO)-based likelihood estimates required for preference optimization. To address this issue, we propose Variance-Reduced Preference Optimization (VRPO), a framework that formally analyzes the bias and variance of the preference optimization loss and gradient based on Direct Preference Optimization, showing both are governed by a score-estimator variance. Building on this foundation, we introduce multiple unbiased variance reduction strategies, including optimal budget allocation and antithetic sampling, to improve alignment performance. We demonstrate the effectiveness of VRPO by applying it to LLaDA, a large diffusion language model. The resulting model, LLaDA 1.5, consistently outperforms its SFT-only predecessor consistently across various general benchmarks, such as mathematics (GSM8K +4.7), coding (HumanEval +3.0, MBPP +1.8), and alignment (IFEval +4.0, Arena-Hard +4.3). Furthermore, LLaDA 1.5 demonstrates a highly competitive mathematical performance compared to other strong language MDMs and ARMs. Our model is available at https://huggingface.co/GSAI-ML/LLaDA-1.5.
papers.abstract_zh: 掩蔽扩散语言模型为语言建模提供了一个有前景的范式，然而，对其在一般任务上的对齐性进行系统的理论分析和全面的实证验证仍然相对较少。在本文中，我们确定了这个问题的主要挑战：基于证据下界（ELBO）的似然估计存在高方差，这不利于偏好优化的实现。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了方差减少偏好优化（VRPO）框架，该框架能够正式分析基于直接偏好优化的偏好优化损失和梯度的偏差与方差问题，并表明这两者都受到评分估计器方差的影响。在此基础上，我们引入了多种无偏方差减少策略，包括最优预算分配和反例抽样，以提高对齐性能。我们通过将VRPO应用于大型扩散语言模型LLaDA来验证其有效性。结果表明，改进后的模型LLaDA 1.5在各种通用基准测试中的表现均优于仅使用分数蒸馏法训练的模型。例如，在数学领域（GSM8K +4.7）、编程领域（HumanEval +3.0，MBPP +1.8）以及对齐任务（IFEval +4.0，Arena-Hard +4.3）中，LLaDA 1.5都表现出非常出色的性能。此外，LLaDA 1.5在数学领域的表现也与其他强大的语言MDM和ARM相比具有竞争力。我们的模型可以在https://huggingface.co/GSAI-ML/LLaDA-1.5下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HarmRLVR: Weaponizing Verifiable Rewards for Harmful LLM Alignment
papers.title_zh: HarmRLVR：将可验证的奖励机制用于对齐有害的大语言模型
papers.authors: Yuexiao Liu, Lijun Li, Xingjun Wang, Jing Shao
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have gained significant attention due to their objective and verifiable reward signals, demonstrating strong performance in reasoning and code generation tasks. However, the potential safety risks associated with RLVR remain underexplored. This paper presents HarmRLVR, the first systematic investigation into the alignment reversibility risk of RLVR. We show that safety alignment can be rapidly reversed using GRPO with merely 64 harmful prompts without responses, causing models to readily comply with harmful instructions. Across five models from Llama, Qwen, and DeepSeek, we empirically demonstrate that RLVR-based attacks elevate the average harmfulness score to 4.94 with an attack success rate of 96.01%, significantly outperforming harmful fine-tuning while preserving general capabilities. Our findings reveal that RLVR can be efficiently exploited for harmful alignment, posing serious threats to open-source model safety.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在带有可验证奖励的强化学习领域取得的进展引起了广泛关注，因为这些方法具有客观且可验证的奖励信号，在推理和代码生成任务中表现出强大的性能。然而，与RLVR相关的潜在安全风险尚未得到充分研究。本文提出了HarmRLVR，这是首个系统性的研究，旨在探讨RLVR的对齐可逆性风险。我们证明，只需使用GRPO，并且仅通过64个无响应的有害提示，就可以快速逆转安全性对齐，使模型容易遵循有害指令。通过对Llama、Qwen和DeepSeek的五个模型进行实验验证，我们发现基于RLVR的攻击能够将平均有害性得分提高到4.94，攻击成功率为96.01%，其效果远优于有害微调技术，同时还能保持模型的通用能力。我们的研究发现表明，RLVR可以被有效地用于实现有害对齐，这对开源模型的安全性构成了严重威胁。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Just Pass Twice: Efficient Token Classification with LLMs for Zero-Shot NER
papers.title_zh: 仅两次通过：利用大语言模型进行高效令牌分类，实现零样本命名实体识别
papers.authors: Ahmed Ewais, Ahmed Hashish, Amr Ali
papers.abstract: Large language models encode extensive world knowledge valuable for zero-shot named entity recognition. However, their causal attention mechanism, where tokens attend only to preceding context, prevents effective token classification when disambiguation requires future context. Existing approaches use LLMs generatively, prompting them to list entities or produce structured outputs, but suffer from slow autoregressive decoding, hallucinated entities, and formatting errors. We propose Just Pass Twice (JPT), a simple yet effective method that enables causal LLMs to perform discriminative token classification with full bidirectional context. Our key insight is that concatenating the input to itself lets each token in the second pass attend to the complete sentence, requiring no architectural modifications. We combine these representations with definition-guided entity embeddings for flexible zero-shot generalization. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on zero-shot NER benchmarks, surpassing the previous best method by +7.9 F1 on average across CrossNER and MIT benchmarks, being over 20× faster than comparable generative methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够编码丰富的世界知识，这对于零样本命名实体识别非常有价值。然而，它们的因果注意力机制使得令牌只能关注前面的上下文信息，这就无法在需要利用未来上下文进行消歧时实现有效的令牌分类。现有的方法通常采用生成式方式使用大语言模型，让它们列出实体或生成结构化输出，但这些方法存在自回归解码速度慢、生成的实体存在幻觉以及格式错误等问题。我们提出了“Just Pass Twice”（JPT）方法，这是一种简单而有效的方法，能够让因果型大语言模型在完整的双向上下文中进行判别性令牌分类。我们的关键思路是，通过将输入内容重复连接自身，使得第二次处理中的每个令牌都能关注整个句子，而无需对现有架构进行任何修改。我们将这些表示与基于定义的实体嵌入相结合，以实现灵活的零样本泛化能力。我们的方法在零样本命名实体识别基准测试中取得了领先的成绩，平均F1分数比之前的最佳方法高出7.9，并且在CrossNER和MIT基准测试中的表现也优于其他方法，其处理速度更是比同类生成式方法快了20倍以上。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Lifting Optimized Binaries to Canonical Compiler IR via Structure-Aware Retrieval and Iterative Verification
papers.title_zh: 通过结构感知的检索和迭代验证，将优化后的二进制文件转换为标准编译器指令表示方式
papers.authors: Xiaoao Zhu, Jie Ren, Zhiqiang Li, Jie Zheng, Zhanyong Tang, Zheng Wang
papers.abstract: Lifting stripped and highly optimized binaries to the canonical compiler intermediate representation (IR) enables program analysis when source code is unavailable. However, compiler optimizations severely distort control-flow and data-flow structure, making existing rule-based and LLM-based decompilation approaches brittle. We present BRIDGE, a system that reliably lifts optimized binaries to analysis-friendly compiler IR. BRIDGE combines control-flow-aware retrieval-augmented generation with feedback-driven verification. It uses pseudo-probe instrumentation to align optimized binary fragments with normalized IR semantics, and then employs an iterative refinement loop guided by static analysis and runtime feedback to improve executability and semantic consistency. We evaluate BRIDGE on HumanEval-Decompile and MBPP, lifting x86-64 and ARM64 binaries to LLVM IR. BRIDGE outperforms seven baselines, achieving an average of over 30% higher re-executability than the strongest general-purpose LLM baseline.
papers.abstract_zh: 将经过优化和剥离了部分信息的二进制文件转换为标准的编译器中间表示形式，可以在没有源代码的情况下进行程序分析。然而，编译器的优化会严重扭曲控制流和数据流结构，使得现有的基于规则的以及基于大语言模型的反编译方法变得不稳定。我们提出了BRIDGE系统，它能够可靠地将优化后的二进制文件转换为适合分析的编译器中间表示形式。BRIDGE结合了控制流感知的检索增强生成技术和基于反馈的验证机制。它使用伪探针技术来使优化后的二进制片段与标准化的中间表示语义保持一致，然后通过迭代细化循环来改进可执行性和语义一致性，这一过程由静态分析和运行时反馈共同指导。我们在HumanEval-Decompile和MBPP测试平台上对BRIDGE进行了评估，成功将x86-64和ARM64二进制文件转换为LLVM中间表示形式。BRIDGE的表现优于七种基准算法，其平均可执行性比最强的通用大语言模型基准算法高出30%以上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Provably Safe Offline-to-Online RL: Decoupling Learning from Data-Driven Safety Enforcement
papers.title_zh: 可证明的离线到在线强化学习：将学习与数据驱动的安全执行分离开来
papers.authors: Kaitong Cai, Jusheng Zhang, Keze Wang
papers.abstract: Hybrid offline–online reinforcement learning (O2O RL) promises both sample efficiency and robust exploration, but suffers from instability due to distribution shift between offline and online data. We introduce RLPD-GX, a framework that decouples policy optimization from safety enforcement: a reward-seeking learner explores freely, while a projection-based guardian guarantees rule-consistent execution and safe value backups. This design preserves the exploratory value of online interactions without collapsing to conservative policies. To further stabilize training, we propose dynamic curricula that gradually extend temporal horizons and anneal offline–online data mixing. We prove convergence via a contraction property of the guarded Bellman operator, and empirically show state-of-the-art performance on Atari-100k, achieving a normalized mean score of 3.02 (+45% over prior hybrid methods) with stronger safety and stability. Beyond Atari, ablations demonstrate consistent gains across safety-critical and long-horizon tasks, underscoring the generality of our design. Extensive and comprehensive results highlight decoupled safety enforcement as a simple yet principled route to robust O2O RL, suggesting a broader paradigm for reconciling exploration and safety in reinforcement learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 混合离线-在线强化学习（O2O RL）既保证了样本处理的效率，又实现了稳健的探索能力。然而，由于离线数据与在线数据之间的分布差异，这种学习方法存在不稳定性的问题。我们提出了RLPD-GX框架，该框架将策略优化与安全性执行分离：一个追求奖励的学习器可以自由探索，而一个基于投影的守护者则确保规则的一致性执行以及安全的价值备份。这种设计保留了在线交互的探索价值，同时避免了策略过于保守的问题。为了进一步稳定训练过程，我们提出了动态课程设计，逐步扩展时间范围，并采用离线-在线数据混合的方式。我们通过保护型贝尔曼算子的收敛性质证明了该方法的收敛性，并通过实验在Atari-100k数据集上展示了出色的性能，其标准化平均得分达到了3.02分（比之前的混合方法提高了45%），同时具备更强的安全性和稳定性。除了Atari数据集之外，我们的实验表明，无论是在安全至关重要的任务还是长期视域的任务中，该方法都能取得稳定的进步，这充分体现了我们设计的通用性。大量的实验结果表明，分离安全性执行是一种简单而有效的实现稳健O2O RL的方法，为强化学习中探索与安全问题的协调提供了更广泛的思路。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SHAPE: Unifying Safety, Helpfulness and Pedagogy for Educational LLMs
papers.title_zh: 理念：为教育용大型语言模型打造安全、实用且富有教育意义的解决方案
papers.authors: Sihang Zhao, Kangrui Yu, Youliang Yuan, Pinjia He, Hongyi Wen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely explored in educational scenarios. We identify a critical vulnerability in current educational LLMs, pedagogical jailbreaks, where students use answer-inducing prompts to elicit solutions rather than scaffolded instructions. To enable systematic study, we unify and formalize safe, helpful, and pedagogical behaviors with a knowledge-mastery graph and introduce SHAPE, a benchmark of 9,087 student-question pairs for evaluating tutoring behavior under adversarial pressure. We propose a graph-augmented tutoring pipeline that infers prerequisite concepts from queries, identifies mastery gaps, and routes generation between instructing and problem-solving via explicit gating. Experiments across multiple LLMs show that our method yields significantly improved safety under two pedagogical jailbreak settings, while maintaining near-ceiling helpfulness under the same evaluation protocol. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/MAPS-research/SHaPE
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在教育场景中得到了广泛的研究。我们发现，当前的教育用语言模型中存在一个关键漏洞，即“教学逃逸”现象——学生使用引导式提示来寻求解决方案，而不是接受有指导的指令。为了进行系统的研究，我们采用知识图谱来统一和规范化安全、有帮助的教学行为，并引入了SHAPE基准测试，该测试包含9,087对学生问题，用于评估在对抗性压力下的辅导行为。我们提出了一种基于图的辅导流程：从查询中推断出先决概念，识别掌握上的差距，并通过明确的机制将生成过程与指导和解决问题相结合。在多个语言模型的实验中，我们发现我们的方法在两种教学逃逸情况下显著提高了安全性，同时在同一评估协议下保持了接近最优的帮助效果。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/MAPS-research/SHaPE获取。

papers.title: Evolving Sparsity: Leveraging Token Importance Dynamics for Efficient LLM Decoding with Sparse Attention
papers.title_zh: 不断发展的稀疏性：利用令牌重要性的动态特性来实现高效的大语言模型解码，采用稀疏注意力机制
papers.authors: Ruizi Han, Miao Zhang, Ziyue Qiao, Liqiang Nie
papers.abstract: Efficient long-context inference remains a major challenge for large language models (LLMs), as the cost of attention computation during auto-regressive decoding grows linearly with the context length. Recent sparse attention methods attempt to reduce the computational burden by selecting a subset of tokens at each step, while most rely on static importance scores that are repeatedly computed over the entire cache, overlooking the relational dynamics of the decoding process. In this work, we revisit sparse attention in LLMs and propose to model token importance as a dynamic process that evolves over decoding steps and propagates through model layers. To efficiently measure token importance, we propose two lightweight mechanisms: (1) Cross-Step Accumulation, which incrementally maintains long-term, query-agnostic importance via decayed accumulation of sparse attention scores, avoiding recomputing the importance of decoded tokens; and (2) Cross-Layer Propagation, which leverages the model’s intrinsic Retrieval Heads to compute query-aware indices and efficiently propagate them across layers; Together, these mechanisms preserve both stable context memory and adaptive query relevance while reduce redundant computation. We evaluate our approach on PG-19, RULER, LongBench, and mathematical reasoning benchmarks using models employing Multi-Head and Grouped-Query Attention. Under varying KV cache budgets, our method consistently outperforms prior sparse attention baselines, approaches full attention performance in most settings, and achieves speedups of up to 5.36\times for attention latency and 2.33\times for end-to-end decoding. Our code is available at: https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/ACL26-EvoSparse.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于大语言模型来说，高效的长上下文推理仍然是一个重大挑战，因为在自回归解码过程中，注意力计算的成本会随着上下文长度的增加而线性增长。最近的稀疏注意力方法试图通过每一步选择一部分令牌来减少计算负担，但大多数方法都依赖于在整个缓存中重复计算的静态重要性分数，而忽略了解码过程中的动态关系。在这项研究中，我们重新审视了LLM中的稀疏注意力机制，并提出将令牌的重要性建模为一种在解码步骤中不断演变并传播到模型各层的过程。为了有效衡量令牌的重要性，我们提出了两种轻量级机制：(1) 跨步骤累积，通过逐步累积稀疏注意力分数来维护长期、与查询无关的重要性，从而避免重新计算已解码令牌的重要性；(2) 跨层传播，利用模型的固有检索头来计算考虑查询的索引，并将其高效地传播到各个层。这两种机制共同实现了稳定上下文记忆和自适应查询相关性，同时减少了冗余计算。我们在PG-19、RULER、LongBench以及数学推理基准测试上评估了我们的方法，所使用的模型采用了多头和分组查询注意力机制。在不同的KV缓存预算下，我们的方法始终优于现有的稀疏注意力基线算法，在大多数情况下接近全注意力性能，并且注意力延迟的加速达到了5.36倍，端到端解码的加速达到了2.33倍。我们的代码可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/ACL26-EvoSparse。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MOA: Multi-Objective Alignment for Role-Playing Agents
papers.title_zh: 多目标对齐方法：适用于角色扮演智能体的解决方案
papers.authors: Chonghua Liao, Ke Wang, Yuchuan Wu, Ruoran Li, Fei Huang, Yongbin Li
papers.abstract: Role-playing agents (RPAs) require balancing multiple objectives, such as instruction following, persona consistency, and stylistic fidelity, which are not always perfectly aligned across different dimensions. While prior work has primarily relied on supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning with scalarized rewards, these approaches do not explicitly address the coordination of multiple reward dimensions during optimization. We present MOA (Multi-Objective Alignment), a reinforcement-learning framework that enables multi-dimensional, fine-grained rubric optimization for general RPAs. MOA introduces a novel multi-objective optimization strategy that trains simultaneously on multiple fine-grained rubrics to boost optimization performance. Besides, to address the issues of model output diversity and quality, we have also employed thought-augmented rollout with off-policy guidance. Experiments on PersonaGym and RoleMRC show that MOA consistently improves multi-dimensional role-playing performance over supervised and standard RL baselines. Under identical evaluation protocols, an 8B model trained with MOA reaches performance competitive with strong closed-source models across multiple evaluation dimensions. These results suggest that MOA provides a practical framework for training more capable general-purpose role-playing agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 角色扮演智能体（RPA）需要平衡多个目标，例如遵循指令、保持角色一致性以及保持风格上的忠实性。然而，这些目标在不同的维度上并不总是能够完美协调。虽然之前的研究主要依赖于监督式微调或带有标量化奖励的强化学习，但这些方法并没有明确解决在优化过程中多个奖励维度之间的协调问题。我们提出了MOA（多目标对齐）框架，这是一种强化学习框架，能够实现针对一般RPA的多维、细粒度优化。MOA引入了一种新的多目标优化策略，通过同时训练多个细粒度的标准来提高优化性能。此外，为了解决模型输出多样性和质量的问题，我们还采用了带有离策略指导的思想增强式部署方法。在PersonaGym和RoleMRC上的实验表明，与监督学习和标准强化学习基线相比，MOA在多维角色扮演性能上取得了显著提升。在相同的评估协议下，一个由8B参数构成的模型通过MOA训练后，其在多个评估维度上的性能与强大的闭源模型相当。这些结果表明，MOA为训练更强大的通用角色扮演智能体提供了一个实用的框架。

papers.title: Losing our Tail, Again: (Un)Natural Selection & Multilingual LLMs
papers.title_zh: 又一次失控了：（非）自然选择与多语言大语言模型
papers.authors: Eva Vanmassenhove
papers.abstract: Multilingual Large Language Models considerably changed how technologies influence language. While previous technologies could mediate or assist humans, there is now a tendency to offload the task of writing itself to these technologies, enabling models to change our languages more directly. While they provide us quick access to information and impressively fluent output, beneath their (apparent) sophistication lies a subtle, insidious threat: the gradual decline and loss of linguistic diversity. In this position paper, I explore how model collapse, with a particular focus on translation technology, can lead to the loss of linguistic forms, grammatical features, and cultural nuance. Model collapse refers to the consequences of self-consuming training loops, where automatically generated data (re-)enters the training data, leading to a gradual distortion of the data distribution and the underrepresentation of low-probability linguistic phenomena. Drawing on recent work in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing and Machine Translation, I argue that the many tails of our linguistic distributions might be vanishing, and with them, the narratives and identities they carry. This paper is a call to resist linguistic flattening and to reimagine Natural Language Processing as a field that encourages, values and protects expressive multilingual diversity and creativity.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言大语言模型极大地改变了技术对语言的影响方式。虽然以往的技术能够辅助人类，但现在有一种趋势是将写作任务完全交给这些技术来处理，使得模型能够更直接地改变我们的语言。尽管这些技术能让我们快速获取信息，并产生令人印象深刻的输出，但在其表面上的复杂性之下，却隐藏着一种微妙而危险的威胁：语言的逐渐衰退和多样性丧失。在这篇论文中，我探讨了模型崩溃现象如何导致语言形式、语法特征以及文化细微差别的丧失。模型崩溃指的是训练循环自我消耗所带来的后果，即自动生成的数据重新进入训练数据中，从而导致数据分布逐渐扭曲，低概率的语言现象被严重忽视。基于计算机视觉、自然语言处理和机器翻译领域的最新研究，我认为我们语言分布的多种可能性可能正在消失，随之而来的还有承载这些多样性的叙事与身份。本文呼吁人们抵制语言的扁平化趋势，重新构想自然语言处理这一领域，使其成为一个鼓励、珍视并保护富有表现力的多语言多样性和创造力的领域。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Verbatim to Gist: Distilling Pyramidal Multimodal Memory via Semantic Information Bottleneck for Long-Horizon Video Agents
papers.title_zh: 从字面上理解到核心意义：通过语义信息瓶颈技术，提取长视距视频代理的多模态记忆信息
papers.authors: Niu Lian, Yuting Wang, Hanshu Yao, Jinpeng Wang, Bin Chen, Yaowei Wang, Min Zhang, Shu-Tao Xia
papers.abstract: While multimodal large language models have demonstrated impressive short-term reasoning, they struggle with long-horizon video understanding due to limited context windows and static memory mechanisms that fail to mirror human cognitive efficiency. Existing paradigms typically fall into two extremes: vision-centric methods that incur high latency and redundancy through dense visual accumulation, or text-centric approaches that suffer from detail loss and hallucination via aggressive captioning. To bridge this gap, we propose MM-Mem, a pyramidal multimodal memory architecture grounded in Fuzzy-Trace Theory. MM-Mem structures memory hierarchically into a Sensory Buffer, Episodic Stream, and Symbolic Schema, enabling the progressive distillation of fine-grained perceptual traces (verbatim) into high-level semantic schemas (gist).Furthermore, to govern the dynamic construction of memory, we derive a Semantic Information Bottleneck objective and introduce SIB-GRPO to optimize the trade-off between memory compression and task-relevant information retention.In inference, we design an entropy-driven top-down memory retrieval strategy.Extensive experiments across 4 benchmarks confirm that MM-Mem achieves state-of-the-art performance on both offline and streaming tasks, demonstrating robust generalization and validating the effectiveness of cognition-inspired memory organization.Code and associated configurations are publicly available at ‘https://github.com/EliSpectre/MM-Mem‘.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型在短期推理方面表现出色，但由于上下文窗口有限以及静态记忆机制无法模拟人类认知效率，它们在长期视频理解方面存在困难。现有的方法通常分为两种极端：一种是以视觉为中心的方法，这种方式通过密集的视觉信息积累导致高延迟和冗余；另一种是以文本为中心的方法，这种方式会因过度标注而导致细节丢失和幻觉现象。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MM-Mem——一种基于模糊追踪理论的金字塔式多模态记忆架构。MM-Mem将记忆结构分层为感官缓冲区、事件流和符号模式，从而实现细粒度的感知痕迹（逐字记录）向高级语义模式的逐步提炼。此外，为了管理记忆的动态构建过程，我们提出了语义信息瓶颈目标，并引入了SIB-GRPO来优化记忆压缩与任务相关信息的保留之间的平衡。在推理过程中，我们设计了基于熵驱动的自上而下的记忆检索策略。通过在4个基准测试中的广泛实验验证，MM-Mem在离线任务和流式任务中均取得了领先的性能，展现了强大的泛化能力，并验证了受认知启发的记忆组织方式的有效性。代码及相关配置可在“https://github.com/EliSpectre/MM-Mem”获取。

papers.title: Chain-of-Memory: Lightweight Memory Construction with Dynamic Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 记忆链：为大型语言模型智能体设计的轻量级内存构建方式，具备动态进化能力
papers.authors: Xiucheng Xu, Bingbing Xu, Tian Xueyun, Zihe Huang, Rongxin Chen, Li Yunfan, Huawei Shen
papers.abstract: External memory systems are pivotal for enabling Large Language Model (LLM) agents to maintain persistent knowledge and perform long-horizon decision-making. Existing paradigms typically follow a two-stage process: computationally expensive memory construction (e.g., structuring data into graphs) followed by naive retrieval-augmented generation. However, our empirical analysis reveals two fundamental limitations: complex construction incurs high costs with marginal performance gains, and simple context concatenation fails to bridge the gap between retrieval recall and reasoning accuracy. To address above challenges, we propose CoM (Chain-of-Memory), a novel framework that advocates for a paradigm shift toward lightweight construction paired with sophisticated utilization. CoM introduces a Chain-of-Memory mechanism that organizes retrieved fragments into coherent inference paths through dynamic evolution, utilizing adaptive truncation to prune irrelevant noise. Extensive experiments on the LongMemEval and LoCoMo benchmarks demonstrate that CoM outperforms strong baselines with accuracy gains of 7.5%–10.4%, while drastically reducing computational overhead to approximately 2.7% of token consumption and 6.0% of latency compared to complex memory architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 外部记忆系统对于使大语言模型代理能够保持持久的知识并执行长期决策至关重要。现有的方法通常遵循一个两阶段的过程：首先进行计算成本高昂的记忆构建（例如，将数据构造成图状结构），然后采用简单的检索增强式生成方式。然而，我们的实证分析揭示了两个根本性的局限性：复杂的记忆构建会带来高昂的成本，而性能提升却十分有限；此外，简单的上下文拼接方式无法有效弥合检索效率与推理准确性之间的差距。为了应对上述挑战，我们提出了CoM框架——一种全新的框架，它倡导从传统的复杂记忆构建转向轻量级构建与高级利用相结合的方法。CoM引入了一种记忆链机制，通过动态演化将检索到的片段组织成连贯的推理路径，并利用自适应截断技术来剔除无关噪声。在LongMemEval和LoCoMo基准测试中的大量实验表明，CoM在准确率方面比传统方法提升了7.5%至10.4%，同时其计算开销大幅降低，与复杂的记忆架构相比，token消耗减少了约2.7%，延迟则降低了6.0%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: WebCoderBench: Benchmarking Web Application Generation with Comprehensive and Interpretable Evaluation Metrics
papers.title_zh: WebCoderBench：通过全面且可解释的评估指标来比较Web应用程序的生成效果
papers.authors: Chenxu Liu, Yingjie Fu, Wei Yang, Ying Zhang, Tao Xie
papers.abstract: Web applications (web apps) have become a key arena for large language models (LLMs) to demonstrate their code generation capabilities and commercial potential. However, building a benchmark for LLM-generated web apps remains challenging due to the need for real-world user requirements, generalizable evaluation metrics without relying on ground-truth implementations or test cases, and interpretable evaluation results. To address these challenges, we introduce WebCoderBench, the first real-world-collected, generalizable, and interpretable benchmark for web app generation. WebCoderBench comprises 1,572 user requirements, covering diverse modalities and expression styles that reflect realistic user intentions. WebCoderBench provides 24 fine-grained evaluation metrics across 9 perspectives, combining the rule-based and LLM-as-a-judge paradigms for fully automated, objective, and general evaluation. Moreover, WebCoderBench adopts human-preference-aligned weights over metrics to yield interpretable overall scores. Experiments across 12 representative LLMs and 2 LLM-based agents show that there exists no dominant model across all evaluation metrics, offering an opportunity for LLM developers to optimize their models in a targeted manner for a more powerful version.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络应用程序已成为大语言模型展示其代码生成能力和商业潜力的关键领域。然而，为语言模型生成的网络应用程序建立基准测试仍然具有挑战性，因为需要真实的用户需求、无需依赖真实实现或测试案例即可进行泛化的评估指标，以及可解释的评估结果。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了WebCoderBench——首个基于真实世界数据构建的、具有泛化能力和可解释性的网络应用程序生成基准测试。WebCoderBench包含1,572个用户需求，涵盖了多种模式和表达风格，反映了现实中的用户意图。该基准测试提供了24种细粒度的评估指标，从9个不同的角度进行评估，结合了基于规则的评估和语言模型作为评判者的两种方法，从而实现完全自动化、客观且全面的评估。此外，WebCoderBench采用与人类偏好一致的权重体系来得出可解释的整体评分。通过对12种代表性语言模型和2种基于语言模型的智能体进行的实验表明，在所有评估指标上都没有出现占主导地位的模型，这为语言模型开发者提供了针对性优化模型的机会，以打造更强大的版本。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ReProbe: Efficient Test-Time Scaling of Multi-Step Reasoning by Probing Internal States of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ReProbe：通过探索大型语言模型的内部状态，实现多步推理过程的高效测试时间缩放
papers.authors: Jingwei Ni, Ekaterina Fadeeva, Tianyi Wu, Mubashara Akhtar, Jiaheng Zhang, Elliott Ash, Markus Leippold, Timothy Baldwin, See-Kiong Ng, Artem Shelmanov, Mrinmaya Sachan
papers.abstract: LLMs can solve complex tasks by generating long, multi-step reasoning chains. Test-time scaling (TTS) can further improve LLM performance by sampling multiple variants of intermediate reasoning steps, verifying their correctness, and strategically choosing the best steps for continuation. However, existing verification approaches, such as Process Reward Models (PRMs), are computationally expensive, limited to specific domains, and require large-scale human or model-generated annotations. We propose a lightweight alternative for step-level reasoning verification based on probing the internal states of LLMs. We train a transformer-based probe that uses the internal states of the frozen LLM to estimate the credibility of its reasoning steps during generation. Annotation can be generated either by another larger LLM (e.g., DeepSeek-R1) or in a self-supervised manner by the original model itself. The probes are both effective and lightweight, containing fewer than 10M parameters. Across multiple domains, including mathematics, planning, and general knowledge question answering, our probes match or even exceed the performance of PRMs that are up to 810× larger. Our findings suggest that the internal states of LLMs encode their confidence in reasoning processes and can serve as reliable signals for reasoning step verification, offering a promising direction towards scalable and generalizable TTS and introspective LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够通过生成冗长、多步骤的推理链来解决复杂任务。测试时间扩展技术可以通过采样多种中间推理步骤、验证其正确性，并选择最适合继续推理的步骤，从而进一步提升大语言模型的性能。然而，现有的验证方法，如过程奖励模型，在计算上成本较高，且仅适用于特定领域，还需要大量由人类或模型生成的注释数据。我们提出了一种基于探测大语言模型内部状态的轻量级推理验证方法。我们训练了一种基于Transformer的探测器，该探测器利用冻结后的大语言模型的内部状态来估计其生成过程中的推理步骤的可信度。注释数据可以由另一个更大规模的语言模型生成，或者由原始模型自身通过自我监督的方式生成。这些探测器既有效又轻便，其参数数量少于1000万。在多个领域中进行测试表明，我们的探测器与那些参数数量高达810倍的过程奖励模型相比，性能相当甚至更优。我们的研究结果表明，大语言模型的内部状态能够编码出其推理过程的置信度，因此可以作为推理步骤验证的可靠依据，为可扩展且通用的测试时间扩展技术和内省型大语言模型提供了有希望的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Adaptive Prompt Structure Factorization: A Framework for Self-Discovering and Optimizing Compositional Prompt Programs
papers.title_zh: 自适应提示结构分解：一种用于自发现和优化组合提示程序的框架
papers.authors: Haoyue Liu, Zhichao Wang, Yongxin Guo, Haoran Shou, Xiaoying Tang
papers.abstract: Automated prompt optimization is crucial for eliciting reliable reasoning from large language models (LLMs), yet most API-only prompt optimizers iteratively edit monolithic prompts, coupling components and obscuring credit assignment, limiting controllability, and wasting tokens. We propose Adaptive Prompt Structure Factorization (aPSF), an API-only framework (prompt-in/text-out; no access to model internals) that uses an Architect model to discover task-specific prompt structures as semantic factors. aPSF then performs interventional, single-factor updates: interventional factor-level scoring estimates each factor’s marginal contribution via validation-performance changes, and error-guided factor selection routes updates to the current dominant failure source for more sample-efficient optimization. Across multiple advanced reasoning benchmarks, aPSF outperforms strong baselines, improving accuracy by up to +4.29 percentage points on average, and reduces optimization cost by 45–87% tokens on MultiArith while reaching peak validation in 1 step.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化提示优化对于从大语言模型中获取可靠的推理结果至关重要。然而，目前大多数仅支持API调用的提示优化工具都是通过迭代方式修改整体提示结构，这种方式会混淆各个组件的职责，导致控制难度增加，同时还会浪费计算资源。我们提出了自适应提示结构分解技术（aPSF），这是一种仅支持API调用的框架（提示输入，输出结果；无法访问模型内部信息）。该技术利用“建筑师”模型来发现与任务相关的提示结构，并将其作为语义因素进行优化。随后，aPSF会进行有针对性的单因素优化：通过验证性能的变化来评估每个因素的边际贡献，而错误引导的因子选择则能够针对性地解决当前的主要问题，从而实现更高效的优化。在多个高级推理基准测试中，aPSF的表现优于其他强大的基线方法，平均准确率提高了4.29个百分点，同时减少了45%到87%的计算量。在MultiArith测试中，aPSF能够在一步之内达到最佳验证效果。

papers.title: Cognitive Alpha Mining via LLM-Driven Code-Based Evolution
papers.title_zh: 通过基于代码的进化方法，利用大型语言模型进行认知阿尔法挖掘
papers.authors: Fengyuan Liu, Yi Huang, Sichun Luo, Yuqi Wang, Yazheng Yang, Xinye Li, Zefa Hu, Junlan Feng, Qi Liu
papers.abstract: Discovering effective predictive signals, or “alphas,” from financial data with high dimensionality and extremely low signal-to-noise ratio remains a difficult open problem. Despite progress in deep learning, genetic programming, and, more recently, large language model (LLM)–based factor generation, existing approaches still explore only a narrow region of the vast alpha search space. Neural models tend to produce opaque and fragile patterns, while symbolic or formula-based methods often yield redundant or economically ungrounded expressions that generalize poorly. Although different in form, these paradigms share a key limitation: none can conduct broad, structured, and human-like exploration that balances logical consistency with creative leaps.To address this gap, we introduce the Cognitive Alpha Mining Framework (CogAlpha), which combines code-level alpha representation with LLM-driven reasoning and evolutionary search. Treating LLMs as adaptive cognitive agents, our framework iteratively refines, mutates, and recombines alpha candidates through multi-stage prompts and financial feedback. This synergistic design enables deeper thinking, richer structural diversity, and economically interpretable alpha discovery, while greatly expanding the effective search space.Experiments on 5 stock datasets from 3 stock markets demonstrate that CogAlpha consistently discovers alphas with superior predictive accuracy, robustness, and generalization over existing methods. Our results highlight the promise of aligning evolutionary optimization with LLM-based reasoning for automated and explainable alpha discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 在具有高维度且信噪比极低的金融数据中找到有效的预测信号或“阿尔法值”，仍然是一个难以解决的开放问题。尽管在深度学习、遗传编程以及最近基于大语言模型的因素生成技术方面取得了进展，但现有方法仍然只能探索庞大的阿尔法搜索空间中的一小部分区域。神经模型往往产生不透明且不稳定的模式，而基于符号或公式的方法则常常产生冗余或缺乏经济意义的表达，导致泛化能力较差。虽然这些方法在形式上存在差异，但它们都有一个共同的局限性：都无法进行广泛、结构化且类似人类的探索，从而平衡逻辑一致性与创造性突破。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了认知阿尔法挖掘框架（CogAlpha），该框架结合了代码级别的阿尔法表示、基于大语言模型的推理以及进化搜索技术。通过将大语言模型视为自适应认知代理，我们的框架通过多阶段提示和金融反馈，逐步优化、变异并重新组合阿尔法候选方案。这种协同设计使得算法能够进行更深入的思考，拥有更丰富结构多样性，并能够发现具有经济意义的可解释阿尔法值，同时大大扩展了有效的搜索空间。通过对3个股市的5个股票数据集进行的实验表明，CogAlpha在预测准确性、鲁棒性和泛化能力方面均优于现有方法。我们的研究结果强调了将进化优化与基于大语言模型的推理相结合，用于自动化和可解释的阿尔法值发现的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Why Do Emotions Change? Appraisal-Guided Reasoning for Emotion–Cause Triplet Extraction in Conversations
papers.title_zh: 为什么情绪会发生变化？基于评估引导的推理在对话中用于提取情绪与原因之间的关联
papers.authors: Qiao Liang, Ying Shen, Yao Liu, Tiantian Chen, Lin Zhang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Emotion–Cause Triplet Extraction in Conversations (MECTEC) is fundamental for fine-grained affect understanding, yet it remains challenging in multi-turn, multi-speaker settings. Existing methods often make locally plausible predictions but struggle to maintain conversation-level consistency under within-speaker emotion shifts and core events. To address this, we propose ECFlow, a unified framework that combines appraisal-guided structured generation with graph-structured reinforcement learning. ECFlow operationalizes cognitive appraisal theory into a controllable intermediate reasoning trace and constructs UMECS, a unified supervision dataset with cognitively grounded traces. It then lifts predicted and gold triplets into an Emotion–Cause Flow Graph and optimizes verifiable, structure-aware rewards for emotion-shift coherence and core-event consistency, together with task-oriented triplet rewards. Experiments on public MECTEC benchmarks show that ECFlow consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving state-of-the-art triplet extraction and improved structure-aware metrics on emotion shifts and core events. Our code and dataset are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ECFlow-E908.
papers.abstract_zh: 在对话中提取多模态情感-原因三元组（MECTEC）对于精细理解情感具有重要意义，但在多轮次、多说话者的情况下仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常只能做出局部合理的预测，而在说话者内部情感变化以及核心事件发生时，难以保持对话层面的连贯性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ECFlow框架，该框架结合了基于评估指导的结构化生成和图结构强化学习技术。ECFlow将认知评估理论转化为可控制的推理过程，并构建了UMECS这一包含认知基础数据的统一监督数据集。随后，它将预测的三元组和真实三元组转换为情感-原因流图，并优化出可验证的、考虑结构的奖励机制，以确保情感变化的连贯性和核心事件的一致性，同时提供与任务相关的三元组奖励。在公开的MECTEC基准测试上进行的实验表明，ECFlow始终优于其他强大的基线方法，在情感变化和核心事件的处理方面取得了领先的性能，并且其结构感知指标也有所提升。我们的代码和数据集可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ECFlow-E908获取。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: KV-Embedding: Training-free Text Embedding via Internal KV Re-routing in Decoder-only LLMs
papers.title_zh: KV嵌入：通过仅在解码器中进行的内部KV重定向技术，实现无需训练的文本嵌入处理，适用于仅包含解码器的大语言模型
papers.authors: Yixuan Tang, Yi Yang
papers.abstract: While LLMs are powerful embedding backbones, their application in training-free settings faces two structural challenges: causal attention restricts early tokens from accessing subsequent context, and the next-token prediction objective biases representations toward generation rather than semantic compression. To address these limitations, we propose KV-Embedding, a framework that activates the latent representation power of frozen LLMs. Our method leverages the observation that the key-value (KV) states of the final token at each layer encode a compressed view of the sequence. By re-routing these states as a prepended prefix, we enable all tokens to access sequence-level context within a single forward pass. To ensure model-agnostic applicability, we introduce an automated layer selection strategy based on intrinsic dimensionality. Evaluations on MTEB across Qwen, Mistral, and Llama backbones show that KV-Embedding outperforms existing training-free baselines by up to 10%, while maintaining robust performance on sequences up to 4,096 tokens. These results demonstrate that internal state manipulation offers an efficient alternative to input modification, and we hope this work encourages further exploration of LLM internals for representation learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型是强大的嵌入基础模型，但在无需训练的情况下应用它们时面临两个结构性挑战：因果注意力机制限制了早期令牌访问后续上下文的能力，而下一个令牌的预测目标则使得表示偏向于生成而非语义压缩。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了KV嵌入框架。该框架能够激活冻结大语言模型的潜在表示能力。我们的方法利用了这样一个观察：每一层最终令牌的键值状态实际上编码了序列的压缩视图。通过将这些状态重新路由为前置前缀，我们可以让所有令牌在单次前向传播过程中就能访问到序列级别的上下文信息。为了确保模型无关性，我们还引入了一种基于内在维度的自动层选择策略。在Qwen、Mistral和Llama等基础模型上的评估结果显示，KV嵌入框架的性能比现有的无需训练的基础模型高出10%左右，同时其处理高达4,096个令牌的序列时的性能依然非常稳健。这些结果表明，内部状态操控提供了一种比输入修改更高效的替代方案。我们希望这项工作能激发对大语言模型内部结构进行表示学习的进一步探索。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Fingerprinting LLMs via Prompt Injection
papers.title_zh: 通过注入提示的方式对大型语言模型进行指纹识别
papers.authors: Yuepeng Hu, Zhengyuan Jiang, Mengyuan Li, Osama Ahmed, Zhicong Huang, Cheng Hong, Neil Zhenqiang Gong
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often modified after release through post-processing such as post-training or quantization, which makes it challenging to determine whether one model is derived from another. Existing provenance detection methods have two main limitations: (1) they embed signals into the base model before release, which is infeasible for already published models, or (2) they compare outputs across models using hand-crafted or random prompts, which are not robust to post-processing. In this work, we propose LLMPrint, a novel detection framework that constructs fingerprints by exploiting LLMs’ inherent vulnerability to prompt injection. Our key insight is that by optimizing fingerprint prompts to enforce consistent token preferences, we can obtain fingerprints that are both unique to the base model and robust to post-processing. We further develop a unified verification procedure that applies to both gray-box and black-box settings, with statistical guarantees. We evaluate LLMPrint on five base models and around 700 post-trained or quantized variants. Our results show that LLMPrint achieves high true positive rates while keeping false positive rates near zero. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/hifi-hyp/ACL-LLMPrint.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在发布后通常会通过后处理方式进行修改，例如训练后的处理或量化操作。这就使得判断一个模型是否由另一个模型衍生而来变得非常困难。现有的溯源检测方法存在两个主要局限性：(1) 它们在模型发布之前就将特征信号嵌入到基础模型中，这对于已经发布的模型来说是不可行的；(2) 它们使用人工设计的或随机生成的提示来比较不同模型的输出结果，但这种方法对于后处理操作并不具有鲁棒性。在这项研究中，我们提出了LLMPrint这一新的检测框架，该框架通过利用语言模型对提示注入的固有脆弱性来构建指纹信息。我们的关键思路是：通过优化用于生成指纹的提示，以强制实现一致的令牌偏好，我们可以获得既具有基础模型独特性又能够抵抗后处理操作的指纹信息。我们还开发了一种统一的验证流程，该流程适用于灰色盒子和黑色盒子环境，并且具有统计上的保证。我们在五个基础模型以及大约700个经过后训练或量化的变体上进行了LLMPrint的测试。结果表明，LLMPrint在保持假阳性率接近零的同时，能够实现较高的真阳性率。该代码的下载链接为https://github.com/hifi-hyp/ACL-LLMPrint。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Exploring Layer Activation Dynamic of CoT via Knowledge Probe
papers.title_zh: 通过知识检索探索协同传输中的层激活动态
papers.authors: Chuanxin Zhang, Jiajun Liu, Yao He, Wenjun Ke, Peng Wang, Yankun Le, Sirui Liu, Zhaoyu Yang
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has emerged as a crucial paradigm for enhancing large language model (LLM) performance on multi-step reasoning tasks.However, the internal mechanisms by which LLMs invoke knowledge and propagate information across different steps of the CoT are poorly understood.To fill this gap, we propose a multi-stage probing framework that enforces structured reasoning with three explicit stages: keyword extraction, theorem generation, and computation execution.The framework integrates attention knockout to trace cross-layer information flow and theorem probing to examine how specific contents are encoded within representations.To enable controlled and stage-aligned analysis, we construct a structured CoT dataset that covers the mathematics and physics domains. Experiments on four instruction-tuned LLMs reveal distinct stage-specific patterns.First, keyword information is progressively aggregated into the final token in later layers.Second, theorem semantics are encoded in the mid-to-late layers and undergo two stages of propagation.Finally, parameter substitution is achieved through joint extraction by the final token and other tokens.The first parameter predominantly relies on the final token, whereas later parameters increasingly depend on information extracted by other tokens.Overall, our findings shed light on the neural implementation of CoT reasoning and provide actionable insights for developing more interpretable and reasoning-capable LLMs.We further evaluate a free-form prompting setting without labeled fields and observe consistent qualitative trends.
papers.abstract_zh: 上下文推理（CoT）推理已成为提升大语言模型在多步骤推理任务中性能的关键范式。然而，大语言模型如何调用知识并将信息传递到CoT的不同阶段，其内部机制仍不甚明了。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个多阶段探测框架，该框架包含三个明确阶段：关键词提取、定理生成和计算执行。该框架采用注意力剔除技术来追踪跨层的信息流动，并通过定理探测来研究特定内容如何在表示中编码。为了实现可控且符合阶段顺序的分析，我们构建了一个涵盖数学和物理领域的结构化CoT数据集。对四种经过指令调优的大语言模型的实验表明，存在明显的阶段特异性特征。首先，关键词信息会在后续层次逐渐被整合到最终令牌中。其次，定理语义会在中间到后期层次被编码，并经历两个传播阶段。最后，参数替换是通过最终令牌与其他令牌的联合提取来实现的。最初的参数主要依赖于最终令牌，而后来的参数则越来越多地依赖于其他令牌提取的信息。总体而言，我们的研究结果揭示了CoT推理的神经实现机制，并为开发更具可解释性和推理能力的大语言模型提供了有价值的见解。我们还测试了无标记字段的自由形式提示设置，发现其定性趋势保持一致。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Trust to Compromise: Outcome-Verified LLM Phishing Simulation and Real-Time Defense
papers.title_zh: 从信任到妥协：通过验证结果的大语言体网络钓鱼模拟及实时防御机制
papers.authors: Tulika Tewari, Nalin Arachchilage, Jagat Sesh Challa, Dhruv Kumar
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel as conversational agents. However, these capabilities can be weaponized to automate social engineering attacks that gradually build rapport to compromise the online safety of users. To understand this, researchers have simulated LLM-based attacks in controlled settings. However, the existing simulators focus on just Personal Identifiable Information (PII) requests within the chat. Thus, to represent a complete attack scenario, we introduce PhishSim, an outcome-driven LLM-based phishing simulator that verifies compromise by simulating a victim completing an external action step, such as submitting credentials on a malicious platform. This enables the generation of diverse, multi-turn attack trajectories. Building on these trajectories, we position PhishGate as a practical mitigation baseline for outcome-grounded conversational phishing: a real-time multi-agent risk scorer that detects manipulation tactics and estimates the severity of ongoing chats. For ambiguous cases, it invokes RAG-supported consistency checks. Evaluating four state-of-the-art LLM backends in a real-time setting, we find that PhishGate improves dialogue-level detection over a real-time baseline. Our results highlight both the promise and brittleness of LLM-based real-time phishing defense, providing an outcome-grounded testbed for studying conversational compromise.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在作为对话代理方面表现出色。然而，这些能力可以被利用来实施社会工程攻击，逐渐建立信任关系，从而破坏用户的在线安全。为了理解这一点，研究人员在受控环境中模拟了基于语言模型的攻击。不过，现有的模拟器仅关注聊天中的个人可识别信息请求。因此，为了呈现完整的攻击场景，我们推出了PhishSim——一个基于语言模型的钓鱼模拟器，它通过模拟受害者执行外部操作（如向恶意平台提交凭据）来验证是否发生了攻击。这使得我们能够生成多样化的、多轮次的攻击轨迹。基于这些轨迹，我们将PhishGate定位为一个实用的、基于结果的对话式钓鱼防御工具：它是一个实时多智能体风险评分器，能够检测操纵手段并评估正在进行的对话的严重程度。对于模糊的情况，它会调用基于RAG的一致性检查功能。在实时环境下对四种先进的语言模型后端进行了评估，我们发现PhishGate在对话级检测方面优于实时基线方案。我们的研究结果既展示了基于语言模型的实时钓鱼防御的潜力，也揭示了其脆弱性，为研究对话式攻击提供了基于结果的测试平台。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
