papers.title: EvoNarrator: Modeling Scientific Evolution for Feasible Hypothesis Generation
papers.title_zh: EvoNarrator：模拟科学进化过程，以生成可行的假设
papers.authors: Xiaoying Le, Pengfei Qian, Yuanzhao Zhai, Xu Zhang, Qian Liu, Feng Dawei, Bo Ding
papers.abstract: Scientific discovery evolution does not emerge in isolation but stems from the structural deepening and recombination of existing functionalities. However, current automated hypothesis generation methods, constrained by the statistical co-occurrence nature of Large Language Models (LLMs), lack perception of temporal causality and the “evolutionary patterns” inherent in scientific development. Consequently, they often yield superficial combinations that are logically infeasible. To address this, we propose EvoNarrator, a framework for hypothesis generation based on evolutionary narratives. We first extract structured P-M-L-F (Problem, Method, Limitation, Future Work) quadruples from citation networks. Subsequently, we introduce the SocketMatch mechanism, which eliminates logical disconnects between methods and problems by assessing their deep semantic compatibility. Finally, utilizing three macro patterns—Chain, Divergence, and Convergence—we constrain the generation process within historically logical derivation paths. Furthermore, double-blind expert reviews yielded an average score of 4.80/5.00 across novelty, feasibility, theoretical, and Logical. Additionally, hindcasting experiments validated its predictive foresight. Crucially, ablation studies indicate that integrating evolutionary patterns facilitates a paradigm shift from conservative incrementalism to theoretically grounded structural innovation. The code is available at https://github.com/xiyii-star/EvoNarrator.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学发现并非孤立产生，而是源于现有功能的深度结构化和重组。然而，目前自动假设生成方法受到大语言模型统计共现特性的限制，无法感知时间上的因果关系以及科学发展中固有的“进化模式”。因此，这些方法往往产生的是逻辑上不可行的表面组合。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了EvoNarrator框架，该框架基于进化叙事进行假设生成。我们首先从引用网络中提取出结构化的P-M-L-F四元组（问题、方法、局限性、未来工作）。随后，我们引入SocketMatch机制，通过评估方法与问题之间的深层语义兼容性，消除它们之间的逻辑矛盾。最后，利用三种宏观模式——链条、分歧和收敛——将生成过程限制在历史上合理的衍生路径内。此外，双盲专家评审结果显示，该框架在新颖性、可行性、理论性和逻辑性方面平均得分为4.80/5.00。另外，后验实验验证了其预测能力。重要的是，消融研究表明，整合进化模式有助于从保守的渐进式创新转向具有理论依据的结构性创新。代码可在https://github.com/xiyii-star/EvoNarrator获取。

papers.title: DecoCal: Decoding with Calibration in Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: DecoCal：在扩散式大型语言模型中通过校准进行解码
papers.authors: Fan Xu, Huixuan Zhang, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) generate text via iterative masked-token denoising, supporting parallel prediction and bidirectional context modeling. Despite these advantages, decoding remains challenging: many tokens appear predictable early, yet single-step predictions are often unstable, exhibiting temporal oscillations or overconfidence, making it difficult to determine which tokens can be safely committed. To address these challenges, we propose DecoCal, a Decoding framework that explicitly performs Calibration of token-level confidence across diffusion steps and leverages the calibrated results to guide decoding decisions. Specifically, DecoCal aggregates historical predictions to maintain calibrated confidence, triggering unmasking only when a token is sufficiently stable, while a remasking mechanism allows revision of premature commitments. This calibration-based design enables early decoding of reliably converged tokens while deferring or correcting unstable ones, balancing reliability and speed. Experiments on multiple DLLMs and benchmarks show that DecoCal improves generation accuracy compared to existing strategies. Our results highlight the importance of temporal calibration in unlocking the full potential of diffusion-based language generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型（DLLMs）通过迭代的掩码令牌去噪技术生成文本，支持并行预测和双向上下文建模。尽管具有这些优势，但解码过程仍然充满挑战：许多令牌在早期就能被预测出来，但单步预测往往不稳定，会出现时间波动或过度自信的情况，这使得难以确定哪些令牌可以放心地采用。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DecoCal这一解码框架。该框架能够显式地对各扩散步骤中的令牌级置信度进行校准，并利用校准后的结果来指导解码决策。具体来说，DecoCal会汇总历史预测数据以保持令牌的置信度稳定，只有当某个令牌足够稳定时才会触发解掩蔽操作；同时，系统还配备了重新掩蔽机制，以便对过早采用的令牌进行修正。这种基于校准的设计使得可靠收敛的令牌能够尽早被解码，而不稳定的令牌则会被延迟或修正，从而实现了可靠性与速度之间的平衡。在多个DLLM模型和基准测试中的实验表明，DecoCal在提高生成精度方面优于现有的策略。我们的研究结果强调了时间校准在释放基于扩散技术的语言生成潜力中的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LiveFact: A Dynamic, Time-Aware Benchmark for LLM-Driven Fake News Detection
papers.title_zh: 实时事实：一种基于时间感知的动态基准测试，适用于由大型语言模型驱动的虚假新闻检测任务
papers.authors: Cheng Xu, Changhong Jin, Yingjie Niu, Nan Yan, Yuke Mei, Shuhao Guan, Liming Chen, Tahar Kechadi
papers.abstract: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has transformed fake news detection and fact-checking tasks from simple classification to complex reasoning. However, evaluation frameworks have not kept pace. Current benchmarks are static, making them vulnerable to benchmark data contamination (BDC) and ineffective at assessing reasoning under temporal uncertainty. To address this, we introduce LiveFact a continuously updated benchmark that simulates the real-world “fog of war” in misinformation detection. LiveFact uses dynamic, temporal evidence sets to evaluate models on their ability to reason with evolving, incomplete information rather than on memorized knowledge. We propose a dual-mode evaluation: Classification Mode for final verification and Inference Mode for evidence-based reasoning, along with a component to monitor BDC explicitly. Tests with 22 LLMs show that open-source Mixture-of-Experts models, such as Qwen3-235B-A22B, now match or outperform proprietary state-of-the-art systems. More importantly, our analysis finds a significant “reasoning gap.” Capable models exhibit epistemic humility by recognizing unverifiable claims in early data slices-an aspect traditional static benchmarks overlook. LiveFact sets a sustainable standard for evaluating robust, temporally aware AI verification.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的快速发展使得虚假新闻检测和事实核查任务从简单的分类工作转变为复杂的推理任务。然而，相关的评估框架并未跟上这一发展步伐。目前的评估基准是静态的，这使得它们容易受到基准数据污染的影响，并且在评估时间不确定性下的推理能力方面表现不佳。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了LiveFact这一持续更新的评估基准，它能够模拟现实世界中的“战争迷雾”现象，从而更准确地检测错误信息。LiveFact利用动态的时间证据集来评估模型在处理不断变化和不完整信息时的推理能力，而不是仅仅依赖记忆中的知识来进行评估。我们提出了双模式评估方式：用于最终验证的分类模式，以及用于基于证据的推理的推理模式，同时还包含了一个专门用于监控基准数据污染的机制。通过对22种大语言模型进行的测试表明，像Qwen3-235B-A22B这样的开源混合专家模型，其性能已经达到了甚至超过了现有的专有先进系统。更重要的是，我们的分析发现了一个显著的“推理差距”——即先进的模型能够在早期数据中识别出无法验证的声明，而传统的静态评估基准则忽略了这一点。LiveFact为评估具有强大时间感知能力的AI系统提供了一个可持续的标准。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond "I Don’t Know": Evaluating LLM Self-Awareness in Discriminating Data and Model Uncertainty
papers.title_zh: 除了“我不知道”之外：评估大型语言模型在区分数据和模型不确定性方面的自我认知能力
papers.authors: Jingyi Ren, Ante Wang, Yunghwei Lai, Xiaolong Wang, Linlu Gong, Weitao Li, Weizhi Ma, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Reliable Large Language Models (LLMs) should abstain when confidence is insufficient. However, prior studies often treat refusal as a generic "I don’t know”, failing to distinguish input-level ambiguity (data uncertainty) from capability limitations (model uncertainty). This lack of distinction limits downstream action decisions like requesting clarification or invoking external tools.In this work, we introduce UA-Bench, a benchmark of over 3,500 questions drawn from six datasets spanning knowledge-intensive and reasoning-intensive tasks, designed to evaluate explicit uncertainty attribution.An evaluation of 18 frontier LLMs shows that even state-of-the-art models struggle to reliably discriminate between data uncertainty and model uncertainty, and that high answer accuracy does not necessarily imply strong uncertainty attribution ability.To narrow this gap, we propose a lightweight data synthesis and reinforcement learning strategy. Experiments on both Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode show that the proposed method improves uncertainty attribution while preserving answer accuracy.Our code and data are publicly available now.
papers.abstract_zh: 可靠的大语言模型在置信度不足时应选择放弃回答。然而，以往的研究往往将拒绝行为简单地视为“我不知道”，而没有区分输入层面的不确定性（数据不确定性）与模型能力限制（模型不确定性）。这种缺乏区分的情况会限制后续的行动决策，比如请求澄清或调用外部工具。在这项研究中，我们引入了UA-Bench这一基准测试，该测试包含超过3,500个问题，这些问题来自六个不同的数据集，涵盖了知识密集型与推理密集型任务，旨在评估对不确定性的明确归因能力。对18个前沿语言模型的评估显示，即使是最先进的模型也难以可靠地区分数据不确定性和模型不确定性，而且高准确率并不一定意味着具备强大的不确定性归因能力。为了缩小这一差距，我们提出了一种轻量级的数据合成和强化学习策略。在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507和Qwen3-8B的思考模式下进行的实验表明，所提出的方法能够在保持答案准确性的同时改善不确定性归因能力。我们的代码和数据现已公开提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Unlearners Can Lie: Evaluating and Improving Honesty in LLM Unlearning
papers.title_zh: 不学习者也能撒谎：评估并提升大语言模型在“不学习”场景下的诚实性
papers.authors: Renjie Gu, Jiazhen Du, Yihua Zhang, Sijia Liu
papers.abstract: Unlearning in large language models (LLMs) aims to remove harmful training data while preserving overall utility. However, we find that existing methods often hallucinate, generate abnormal token sequences, or behave inconsistently, raising safety and trust concerns. According to prior literature on LLM honesty, such behaviors are often associated with dishonesty. This motivates us to investigate the notion of honesty in the context of model unlearning. We propose a formal definition of unlearning honesty, which includes: (1) preserving both utility and honesty on retained knowledge, and (2) ensuring effective forgetting while encouraging the model to acknowledge its limitations and respond consistently to questions related to forgotten knowledge. To systematically evaluate the honesty of unlearning, we introduce a suite of metrics that cover utility, honesty on the retained set, effectiveness of forgetting, rejection rate and refusal stability in Q&A and MCQ settings. Evaluating 9 methods across 3 mainstream families shows that all current methods fail to meet these standards. After experimental and theoretical analyses, we present ReVa, a representation-alignment procedure that fine-tunes feature-randomized unlearned models to better acknowledge forgotten knowledge. On Q A tasks from the forget set, ReVa achieves the highest rejection rate after two rounds of interaction, nearly doubling the performance of the second-best method. Remarkably, It also improves honesty on the retained set.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中进行“去学习”操作，旨在去除有害的训练数据，同时保留模型的整体功能。然而，我们发现现有的方法往往会出现幻觉、生成异常的令牌序列或行为不一致等问题，这引发了关于安全性和可信度的担忧。根据现有文献，这类行为通常与不诚实相关。这促使我们探讨在模型去学习过程中“诚实性”的概念。我们提出了一种正式的定义，该定义包括：1）在保留的知识上同时保持功能和诚实性；2）确保有效的遗忘过程，同时鼓励模型承认自己的局限性，并能够一致地回答与已遗忘知识相关的提问。为了系统地评估去学习的诚实性，我们引入了一系列指标，涵盖功能、保留集合上的诚实性、遗忘效果、拒绝率以及问答和选择题场景下的稳定性。通过对3种主流方法的9种方法进行评估，我们发现目前所有方法都无法满足这些标准。经过实验和理论分析后，我们提出了ReVa这一表示对齐方法，该方法通过微调特征随机化的去学习模型，从而更好地处理已遗忘的知识。在从遗忘集合中选取的问答任务中，ReVa在两轮交互后实现了最高的拒绝率，其性能几乎是第二好的方法的两倍。值得注意的是，该方法还提升了保留集合上的诚实性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MatchTIR: Fine-Grained Supervision for Tool-Integrated Reasoning via Bipartite Matching
papers.title_zh: MatchTIR：通过二分匹配实现工具集成推理的精细监管机制
papers.authors: Changle Qu, Sunhao Dai, Hengyi Cai, Jun Xu, Shuaiqiang Wang, Dawei Yin
papers.abstract: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) empowers large language models (LLMs) to tackle complex tasks by interleaving reasoning steps with external tool interactions. However, existing reinforcement learning methods typically rely on outcome- or trajectory-level rewards, assigning uniform advantages to all steps within a trajectory. This coarse-grained credit assignment fails to distinguish effective tool calls from redundant or erroneous ones, particularly in long-horizon multi-turn scenarios. To address this, we propose MatchTIR, a framework that introduces fine-grained supervision via bipartite matching-based turn-level reward assignment and dual-level advantage estimation. Specifically, we formulate credit assignment as a bipartite matching problem between predicted and ground-truth traces, utilizing two assignment strategies to derive dense turn-level rewards. Furthermore, to balance local step precision with global task success, we introduce a dual-level advantage estimation scheme that integrates turn-level and trajectory-level signals, assigning distinct advantage values to individual interaction turns. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of MatchTIR. Notably, our 4B model surpasses the majority of 8B competitors, particularly in long-horizon and multi-turn tasks. Our codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MatchTIR.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具集成推理（TIR）技术通过将对推理步骤与外部工具交互的整合，使大语言模型能够应对复杂任务。然而，现有的强化学习方法通常依赖于结果或轨迹级别的奖励机制，为轨迹中的所有步骤分配相同的奖励权重。这种粗粒度奖励分配方式无法区分有效的工具调用与冗余或错误的调用，尤其是在长视界、多回合的场景中。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了MatchTIR框架。该框架通过基于二分匹配的回合级奖励分配以及双层次优势估计，实现了细粒度的监督机制。具体来说，我们将奖励分配问题转化为预测轨迹与真实轨迹之间的二分匹配问题，并利用两种分配策略来得出密集的回合级奖励。此外，为了平衡局部步骤的精确性与全局任务的成功性，我们引入了双层次优势估计方案，该方案整合了回合级和轨迹级信号，为各个交互步骤分配不同的优势值。在三个基准测试上的广泛实验证明了MatchTIR的优越性。值得注意的是，我们的4B模型在长视界和多回合任务中表现优于大多数8B规模的竞争对手模型。我们的代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MatchTIR。

papers.title: Knowledge is Not Enough: Injecting RL Skills for Continual Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 知识是不够的：需要融入强化学习技能以实现持续适应
papers.authors: Pingzhi Tang, Yiding Wang, Muhan Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) face the “knowledge cutoff” challenge, where their frozen parametric memory prevents direct internalization of new information. While Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is commonly used to update model knowledge, it often updates factual content without reliably improving the model’s ability to use the newly incorporated information for question answering or decision-making. Reinforcement Learning (RL) is essential for acquiring reasoning skills; however, its high computational cost makes it impractical for efficient online adaptation. We empirically observe that the parameter updates induced by SFT and RL are nearly orthogonal. Based on this observation, we propose Parametric Skill Transfer (PaST), a framework that supports modular skill transfer for efficient and effective knowledge adaptation. By extracting a domain-agnostic Skill Vector from a source domain, we can linearly inject knowledge manipulation skills into a target model after it has undergone lightweight SFT on new data. Experiments on knowledge-incorporation QA (SQuAD, LooGLE) and agentic tool-use benchmarks (ToolBench) demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. On SQuAD, PaST outperforms the state-of-the-art self-editing SFT baseline by up to 9.9 points. PaST further scales to long-context QA on LooGLE with an 8.0-point absolute accuracy gain, and improves zero-shot ToolBench success rates by +10.3 points on average with consistent gains across tool categories, indicating strong scalability and cross-domain transferability of the Skill Vector.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型面临着“知识截止点”的挑战，即其固定的参数记忆机制阻碍了新信息的直接内化。虽然监督式微调通常用于更新模型的知识库，但它往往只能更新事实性内容，而无法有效提升模型运用新信息进行问答或决策的能力。强化学习对于培养推理能力至关重要，但其高计算成本使得它难以实现高效的在线适应。我们通过实验发现，由监督式微调与强化学习所引发的参数更新几乎是相互独立的。基于这一观察，我们提出了参数化技能迁移框架——Parametric Skill Transfer（PaST），该框架支持模块化技能迁移，从而实现高效且有效的知识适应。通过从源领域提取一个与领域无关的技能向量，我们可以在目标模型经过轻量级微调后，将其知识与操控技能线性注入到目标模型中。在知识整合的问答任务（如SQuAD、LooGLE）以及代理工具使用基准测试（ToolBench）上的实验表明了我们方法的有效性。在SQuAD任务中，PaST的表现优于最先进的自编辑式微调基线，准确率提高了9.9个百分点。在LooGLE的长上下文问答任务中，PaST的准确率提升了8.0个百分点；在零样本工具使用基准测试上，PaST的平均成功率提高了10.3个百分点，且不同工具类别的准确率均有显著提升，这表明技能向量的可扩展性和跨领域迁移能力非常强。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BhashaSutra: A Task-Centric Unified Survey of Indian NLP Datasets, Corpora, and Resources
papers.title_zh: 《BhashaSutra》：一项以任务为导向的印度自然语言处理数据集、语料库及相关资源的综合研究
papers.authors: Raghvendra Kumar, Devankar Raj, Sriparna Saha
papers.abstract: India’s linguistic landscape, spanning 22 scheduled languages and hundreds of marginalized dialects, has driven rapid growth in NLP datasets, benchmarks, and pretrained models. However, no dedicated survey consolidates resources developed specifically for Indian languages. Existing reviews either focus on a few high-resource languages or subsume Indian languages within broader multilingual settings, limiting coverage of low-resource and culturally diverse varieties. To address this gap, we present the first unified survey of Indian NLP resources, covering 200+ datasets, 50+ benchmarks, and 100+ models, tools, and systems across text, speech, multimodal, and culturally grounded tasks. We organize resources by linguistic phenomena, domains, and modalities; analyze trends in annotation, evaluation, and model design; and identify persistent challenges such as data sparsity, uneven language coverage, script diversity, and limited cultural and domain generalization. This survey offers a consolidated foundation for equitable, culturally grounded, and scalable NLP research in the Indian linguistic ecosystem.
papers.abstract_zh: 印度的语言景观包括22种官方语言以及数百种边缘化方言，这些语言为自然语言处理(NLP)数据集、评估基准和预训练模型的快速发展提供了有力支持。然而，目前还没有专门针对印度语言的资源整合研究。现有的相关综述要么只关注一些资源丰富的语言，要么将印度语言纳入更广泛的多语言环境中进行讨论，这导致了对资源匮乏和文化多样性丰富的语言类型的忽视。为了填补这一空白，我们首次对印度NLP资源进行了全面梳理，涵盖了200多个数据集、50多个评估基准，以及100多种用于文本、语音、多模态以及基于文化特征的任务的模型、工具和系统。我们按照语言现象、领域和模态对资源进行分类；分析注释、评估和模型设计方面的趋势；并指出了诸如数据稀缺、语言覆盖不均、文字多样性问题以及文化和领域泛化能力有限等持续存在的挑战。这项综述为在印度语言生态系统中开展公平、基于文化特征且可扩展的自然语言处理研究提供了坚实的基础。

papers.title: A Dual-Task Paradigm to Investigate Sentence Comprehension Strategies in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 一种用于研究语言模型中的句子理解策略的双任务范式
papers.authors: Rei Emura, Saku Sugawara
papers.abstract: Language models (LMs) behave more like humans when their cognitive resources are restricted, particularly in predicting sentence processing costs such as reading times. However, it remains unclear whether such constraints similarly affect sentence comprehension strategies, and existing methods do not directly target the balance between memory storage and sentence processing, which is central to human working memory. To address this issue, we propose a dual-task paradigm that combines an arithmetic computation task with a sentence comprehension task, such as “The 2 cocktail + blended 3 =...”. Our experiments show that under dual-task conditions, GPT-4o, o3-mini, and o4-mini shift toward plausibility-based comprehension, mirroring humans’ rational inference. Specifically, these models show a greater accuracy gap between plausible sentences (e.g., “The cocktail was blended by the bartender”) and implausible sentences (e.g., “The bartender was blended by the cocktail”) in the dual-task condition compared to the single-task conditions. These findings suggest that constraints on the balance between memory and processing resources promote rational inference in LMs. More broadly, they support the view that human-like sentence comprehension fundamentally arises from the allocation of limited cognitive resources.
papers.abstract_zh: 当语言模型（LMs）的认知资源受到限制时，它们的行为更类似于人类，尤其是在预测句子处理成本方面，比如阅读时间。然而，目前尚不清楚这种限制是否同样会影响句子理解策略。现有的方法并没有直接针对记忆存储与句子处理之间的平衡问题，而这一平衡对人类的工作记忆至关重要。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种双任务范式，将算术计算任务与句子理解任务结合起来，例如“2杯鸡尾酒 + 混合3 =…”。我们的实验表明，在双任务条件下，GPT-4o、o3-mini和o4-mini更倾向于基于合理性的理解方式，这与人类的理性推理方式相似。具体来说，这些模型在双任务条件下的准确率差距更大，即合理句子（例如，“鸡尾酒是由调酒师调配的”）与不合理句子（例如，“调酒师被鸡尾酒调配了”）之间的准确率差异明显。这些发现表明，对记忆与处理资源之间平衡的约束有助于促进语言模型中的理性推理。更广泛地说，这些发现支持了这样一种观点：类似人类的句子理解能力本质上源于有限认知资源的分配。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Diffusion-CAM: Faithful Visual Explanations for dMLLMs
papers.title_zh: 扩散型血管异常：用于dMLLMs的精确视觉解释方法
papers.authors: Haomin Zuo, Yidi Li, Luoxiao Yang, Xiaofeng Zhang
papers.abstract: While diffusion Multimodal Large Language Models (dMLLMs) have recently achieved remarkable strides in multimodal generation, the development of interpretability mechanisms has lagged behind their architectural evolution. Unlike traditional autoregressive models that produce sequential activations, diffusion-based architectures generate tokens via parallel denoising, resulting in smooth, distributed activation patterns across the entire sequence. Consequently, existing Class Activation Mapping (CAM) methods, which are tailored for local, sequential dependencies, are ill-suited for interpreting these non-autoregressive behaviors. To bridge this gap, we propose Diffusion-CAM, the first interpretability method specifically tailored for dMLLMs. We derive raw activation maps by differentiably probing intermediate representations in the transformer backbone, accordingly capturing both latent features and their class-specific gradients. To address the inherent stochasticity of these raw signals, we incorporate four key modules to resolve spatial ambiguity and mitigate intra-image confounders and redundant token correlations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diffusion-CAM significantly outperforms SoTA methods in both localization accuracy and visual fidelity, establishing a new standard for understanding the parallel generation process of diffusion multimodal systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然扩散式多模态大语言模型在多模态生成方面取得了显著进展，但可解释性机制的开发却未能跟上其架构发展的步伐。与传统的自回归模型不同，扩散式架构通过并行去噪来生成令牌，从而在整个序列中形成平滑、分布式的激活模式。因此，现有的类激活映射方法，这些方法适用于局部、序列性的依赖关系，却难以解释这些非自回归行为。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Diffusion-CAM——首个专为dMLLMs设计的可解释性方法。我们通过差异化探测变换器骨干中的中间表示来获得原始激活图，从而同时捕捉到潜在特征及其与类别相关的梯度信息。为了解决这些原始信号的随机性问题，我们引入了四个关键模块，以解决空间歧义问题，并减轻图像内部干扰因素以及冗余令牌之间的相关性。大量实验表明，Diffusion-CAM在定位精度和视觉保真度方面均优于现有的SoTA方法，为理解扩散式多模态系统的并行生成过程树立了新的标准。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Beyond Noise: Characterizing Creative Potential in Unverifiable LLM Hallucinations
papers.title_zh: 超越噪音：对不可验证的大型语言模型产生的“幻觉”进行创造性潜力分析
papers.authors: Yu Yan, Chunhong Zhang, Haiyu Zhao, Ziyang Zeng, Zihao Liu, Yongkang Wu, Jianzhou Diao, YiJie Chen, Shujie Wang, Zheng Hu
papers.abstract: In knowledge-intensive creative tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate outputs that extend beyond established knowledge, making direct verification against current evidence impractical. Unlike factual hallucinations checked against ground truth, such outputs arise naturally in creative generation, where extending beyond current knowledge is often the goal. Yet prior work debates whether hallucination should be suppressed or embraced without empirically analyzing this unverifiable subclass. On the ideation evaluation side, existing work focuses on individual outputs without characterizing the unverifiable space as a whole. To address this gap, we propose a novelty-verifiability characterization that distinguishes Creative Synthesis (Region A) from Groundless Fabrication (Region B), and study it through a conceptual creation task where LLMs synthesize novel scientific concepts. Through 32,400 generations across three technical domains and 1,080 human judgments, we find that Region A is non-negligible (4.7%) and robust, persisting across generation strategies, models, domains, and embedding choices. A retrospective recovery experiment further shows that LLMs can approximate post-cutoff scientific concepts in controlled combinatorial settings. Our findings suggest that the unverifiable space is not uniformly noise but exhibits empirically distinguishable internal structure, providing an empirical basis for more selective hallucination governance.[https://github.com/YuLab1/llm-concept-creation]
papers.abstract_zh: 在知识密集型创意任务中，大语言模型通常会生成超出现有知识的输出，因此直接对照现有证据进行验证是不切实际的。与需要对照真实数据进行的事实性幻觉不同，这类输出是在创意生成过程中自然产生的，而超越当前知识往往是其目标。然而，之前的研究并未对是否应该抑制幻觉或接受这种无法验证的子类进行实证分析。在创意评估方面，现有的研究主要关注单个输出，而没有将不可验证的空间作为一个整体来加以描述。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新颖性可验证性的分类方法，将创造性合成（区域A）与无根据的编造（区域B）区分开来。我们通过一个概念创造任务来验证这种方法的有效性，该任务要求语言模型生成新的科学概念。通过对三个技术领域的32,400次生成以及1,080次人类评判的分析，我们发现区域A具有不可忽视的比例（4.7%），并且具有很强的稳定性，能够适应不同的生成策略、模型、领域和嵌入方式。进一步的回顾性实验表明，语言模型能够在受控的组合环境中近似生成新的科学概念。我们的研究发现表明，不可验证的空间并非完全是噪声，而是具有可辨识的内部结构，这为更有选择性的幻觉治理提供了实证依据。[https://github.com/YuLab1/llm-concept-creation]
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LLM-SLM Collaborative Framework of Idiomatic Expression Generation
papers.title_zh: LLM-SLM协作框架：惯用表达生成技术
papers.authors: Hui Gao, Changhao Song, Peng Zhang, Jing Zhang, Chang Yang, Liuxian Ge
papers.abstract: Idiomatic Expression Generation, which aims to produce idiomatic text from plain text, is a valuable yet challenging NLP task. However, existing methods suffer from the scarcity of parallel data and dependence on high-quality manual annotations. To address this, we propose an iterative LLM-SLM (Large Language Model-Small Language Model) collaborative framework — Auto-IDEA, that replaces human supervision for idiomatic expression data generation. In this self-improving cycle, the LLM constructs parallel corpora (idiomatic and plain text) via bidirectional semantic reconstruction, automatically generating “Locate-Then-Polish” (LTP) annotations; the SLM filters low-quality corpora while continuously enhancing its verification ability through incremental learning. We instantiate Auto-IDEA for Chinese Idiom Polishing (CIP), constructing CIP-200K, a large-scale dataset of 206K parallel sentences with LTP annotations. The Qwen3-8B fine-tuned on CIP-200K achieves a 25.2% absolute Idiom Polishing Accuracy (IPA) improvement over a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baseline, outperforming DeepSeek-R1 by 6.2%. Extensive experiments (e.g., Chinese idiom cloze tests and English idiom generation tasks) and human evaluations verify the generalization and effectiveness of Auto-IDEA, demonstrating a new pathway for high-quality, annotation-free data generation through LLM-SLM collaboration.
papers.abstract_zh: Idiomatic Expression Generation 是一项具有重要价值但充满挑战的自然语言处理任务，其目标是从普通文本中生成具有惯用表达的文本。然而，现有的方法受到平行数据稀缺以及依赖高质量人工注释的限制。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了一种迭代式的大语言模型与小型语言模型协作框架——Auto-IDEA。该框架能够替代人工监督，自动生成惯用表达数据。在这个自我优化的过程中，大语言模型通过双向语义重构构建平行语料库（包括惯用表达文本和普通文本），并自动生成“定位-精炼”注释；而小型语言模型则对低质量语料进行筛选，同时通过增量学习不断提升其验证能力。我们将 Auto-IDEA 应用于中文惯用语精炼任务，构建了包含20.6万条带注释的平行句子的大规模数据集 CIP-200K。在 CIP-200K 上进行微调的 Qwen3-8B 模型在惯用语精炼准确率方面取得了25.2%的提升，优于基于监督微调的基线模型，其性能比 DeepSeek-R1 高出6.2%。大量的实验（如中文惯用语完形填空测试和英语惯用语生成任务）以及人类评估都证明了 Auto-IDEA 的通用性和有效性，为通过大语言模型与小型语言模型的协作来生成高质量、无需注释的数据提供了一种新的途径。

papers.title: Focus-dLLM: Accelerating Long-Context Diffusion LLM Inference via Confidence-Guided Context Focusing
papers.title_zh: Focus-dLLM：通过置信度引导的上下文聚焦技术，加速长上下文扩散语言模型的计算推理过程
papers.authors: Lingkun Long, Yushi Huang, Shihao Bai, Ruihao Gong, Jun Zhang, Ao Zhou, Jianlei Yang
papers.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) deliver strong long-context processing capability in a non-autoregressive decoding paradigm. However, the considerable computational cost of bidirectional full attention limits the inference efficiency. Although sparse attention is promising, existing methods remain ineffective. This stems from the need to estimate attention importance for tokens yet to be decoded, while the unmasked token positions are unknown during diffusion. In this paper, we present Focus-dLLM, a novel training-free attention sparsification framework tailored for accurate and efficient long-context dLLM inference. Based on the finding that token confidence strongly correlates across adjacent steps, we first design a past confidence-guided indicator to predict unmasked regions. Built upon this, we propose a sink-aware pruning strategy to accurately estimate and remove redundant attention computation, while preserving highly influential attention sinks. To further reduce overhead, this strategy reuses identified sink locations across layers, leveraging the observed cross-layer consistency. Experimental results show that our method offers more than 29\times lossless speedup under 32K context length.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型（dLLMs）在非自回归解码范式下提供了强大的长上下文处理能力。然而，双向全注意力机制的巨大计算成本限制了推理效率。虽然稀疏注意力机制具有潜力，但现有方法仍然效果不佳。这是因为需要在尚未解码的标记上估计注意力权重，而在扩散过程中，未 Mask 的标记位置是未知的。在本文中，我们提出了 Focus-dLLM 这一新型的无训练依赖的注意力稀疏化框架，旨在实现准确且高效的长上下文 dLLM 推理。基于 Token 的置信度在相邻步骤间存在强相关性这一发现，我们首先设计了一个基于过去置信度的指示器来预测未 Mask 的区域。在此基础上，我们提出了一种基于汇点的剪枝策略，该策略能够准确估计并移除冗余的注意力计算，同时保留那些具有高度影响力的注意力汇点。为了进一步降低计算开销，该策略允许在不同层之间重复使用已识别的汇点位置，从而利用跨层的一致性。实验结果表明，在我们的方法下，在 32K 上下文长度的情况下，推理速度提升了 29 倍以上。

papers.title: Table Question Answering in the Era of Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Tasks, Methods, and Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型时代的表格问答技术：关于任务、方法和评估的综合性研究
papers.authors: Wei Zhou, Bolei Ma, Annemarie Friedrich, Mohsen Mesgar
papers.abstract: Table Question Answering (TQA) aims to answer natural language questions using tabular data, often accompanied by additional contexts, such as passages. The task spans diverse settings, varying in table representation, question/answer complexity, modality involved, and domain. While recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have driven substantial progress for TQA, the field still lacks a systematic organization and understanding of task formulations, core challenges, and methodological trends, particularly in light of emerging research directions, such as reinforcement learning. This survey addresses this gap by providing a comprehensive and structured overview of TQA research using LLMs. We introduce various task setups and summarize available benchmarks based on task features. We categorize current modeling strategies according to the challenges they target, and analyze their strengths and limitations. Furthermore, we highlight underexplored but timely topics that have not been systematically covered in prior surveys. By unifying disparate research threads and identifying open problems, our survey offers a consolidated foundation for the TQA community, enabling a deeper understanding of the state of the art and guiding future developments in this rapidly evolving area.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格式问题回答（TQA）旨在利用表格数据来回答自然语言问题，这些表格数据通常还伴随着其他上下文信息，比如相关段落。这项任务适用于多种场景，包括不同的表格表示方式、问题/答案的复杂程度、所涉及的模态以及应用领域。虽然大语言模型在TQA领域取得了显著进展，但这一领域仍然缺乏系统性的组织和对任务表述、核心挑战以及方法论趋势的理解，尤其是在面对诸如强化学习等新兴研究方向时。本综述通过提供关于使用大语言模型的TQA研究的全面且结构化的概述，来填补这一空白。我们介绍了各种任务设置，并总结了基于任务特征的现有基准测试。我们根据当前建模策略所针对的挑战对其进行分类，并分析了它们的优点和局限性。此外，我们还强调了那些尚未被充分探讨但具有时效性的主题，这些主题在之前的综述中并未得到系统的关注。通过整合不同的研究线索并识别存在的问题，我们的综述为TQA社区提供了坚实的基础，有助于更深入地了解当前的技术水平，并为这一快速发展的领域未来的发展指明方向。

papers.title: RouteMoA: Dynamic Routing without Pre-Inference Boosts Efficient Mixture-of-Agents
papers.title_zh: RouteMoA：动态路由算法，无需预先的推断步骤，能够高效处理多智能体混合环境中的任务
papers.authors: Jize Wang, Han Wu, Zhiyuan You, Yiming Song, Yijun Wang, Zifei Shan, Yining Li, Songyang Zhang, Xinyi Le, Cailian Chen, Xinping Guan, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) improves LLM performance through layered collaboration, but its dense topology raises costs and latency. Existing methods employ LLM judges to filter responses, yet still require all models to perform inference before judging, failing to cut costs effectively. They also lack model selection criteria and struggle with large model pools, where full inference is costly and can exceed context limits. To address this, we propose RouteMoA, an efficient mixture-of-agents framework with dynamic routing. It employs a lightweight scorer to perform initial screening by predicting coarse-grained performance from the query, narrowing candidates to a high-potential subset without inference. A mixture of judges then refines these scores through lightweight self- and cross-assessment based on existing model outputs, providing posterior correction without additional inference. Finally, a model ranking mechanism selects models by balancing performance, cost, and latency. RouteMoA outperforms MoA across varying tasks and model pool sizes, reducing cost by 89.8% and latency by 63.6% in the large-scale model pool. Code is available at https://github.com/Jize-W/RouteMoA.
papers.abstract_zh: 混合代理模型（Mixture-of-Agents，MoA）通过多层协作提升了大语言模型的性能，但其密集的架构结构会导致成本增加和延迟提升。现有的方法采用大语言模型裁判器来过滤响应，但仍然需要所有模型完成推理过程后才能进行评判，这无法有效降低成本。此外，这些方法缺乏模型选择标准，在处理大量模型时也会遇到困难，因为全量推理的成本很高，且可能会超出上下文限制。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了RouteMoA这一高效的混合代理框架，该框架具有动态路由机制。它使用轻量级评分器来初步筛选候选模型，通过预测查询对应的大致性能来缩小候选范围，从而无需进行完整推理即可筛选出潜力较高的模型。随后，混合裁判器基于现有模型输出数据进行轻量级自我评估与交叉评估，以进一步优化这些评分结果，而无需额外的推理过程。最后，模型排名机制通过平衡性能、成本和延迟来选择模型。在多种任务以及不同规模的模型池情况下，RouteMoA均表现出优于MoA的性能表现，在大规模模型池中，成本降低了89.8%，延迟则减少了63.6%。相关代码可访问https://github.com/Jize-W/RouteMoA。

papers.title: Patches of Nonlinearity: Instruction Vectors in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 非线性的片段：大型语言模型中的指令向量
papers.authors: Irina Bigoulaeva, Jonas Rohweder, Subhabrata Dutta, Iryna Gurevych
papers.abstract: Despite the recent success of instruction-tuned language models and their ubiquitous usage, very little is known of how models process instructions internally. In this work, we address this gap from a mechanistic point of view by investigating how instruction-specific representations are constructed and utilized in different stages of post-training: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Via causal mediation, we identify that instruction representation is fairly localized in models. These representations, which we call Instruction Vectors (IVs), demonstrate a curious juxtaposition of linear separability along with non-linear causal interaction, broadly questioning the scope of the linear representation hypothesis commonplace in mechanistic interpretability. To disentangle the non-linear causal interaction, we propose a novel method to localize information processing in language models that is free from the implicit linear assumptions of patching-based techniques. We find that, conditioned on the task representations formed in the early layers, different information pathways are selected in the later layers to solve that task, i.e., IVs act as circuit selectors.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管最近基于指令调优的语言模型取得了显著成果，并且得到了广泛的应用，但人们对这些模型在内部如何处理指令的机制仍然知之甚少。在这项研究中，我们从机制性的角度来探讨这个问题，研究特定于指令的表示是如何在训练后的不同阶段——监督式微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）过程中被构建和使用的。通过因果中介分析，我们发现指令表示在模型中是相对局部化的。这些我们称之为指令向量（IVs）的表示，表现出线性可分性与非线性因果交互作用的奇妙结合，这大大挑战了在机制可解释性领域普遍采用的线性表示假设。为了阐明这种非线性因果交互作用，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，用于定位语言模型中的信息处理过程，该方法无需依赖基于拼接技术的隐含线性假设。我们发现，在早期形成的任务表示的基础上，后期会选择不同的信息路径来完成该任务，也就是说，指令向量充当了电路选择器的作用。

papers.title: Reasoning Gets Harder for LLMs Inside A Dialogue
papers.title_zh: 对于处于对话中的大型语言模型来说，进行推理变得更加困难了
papers.authors: Ivan Kartáč, Mateusz Lango, Ondrej Dusek
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on many reasoning benchmarks, yet these evaluations typically focus on isolated tasks that differ from real-world usage in task-oriented dialogue (TOD). In this setting, LLMs must perform reasoning inherently while generating text and adhering to instructions on role, format, and style. This mismatch raises concerns about whether benchmark performance accurately reflects models’ reasoning robustness in TOD setting.We investigate how framing reasoning tasks within TOD affects LLM performance by introducing a new dynamic benchmark covering eight travel-related tasks that require arithmetic, spatial, temporal, and commonsense reasoning. Each problem is presented in both isolated and dialogue-based variants, enabling controlled comparison while mitigating data contamination. Experiments on nine LLMs reveal a substantial and consistent performance gap between isolated and dialogue settings. Through ablations and qualitative analysis, we show that this gap is largely driven by the multi-turn nature of dialogue, with additional effects from role conditioning and tool-use requirements. Our results highlight the need to evaluate LLM reasoning in realistic interactive scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在许多推理基准测试中表现优异，但这些评估通常集中在与现实世界中的任务导向对话不同的孤立任务上。在这种情况下，语言模型必须在生成文本的同时进行推理，并遵循关于角色、格式和风格的要求。这种不匹配引发了关于这些基准测试性能是否准确反映了模型在任务导向对话环境中的推理能力的担忧。我们通过将推理任务纳入任务导向对话中来研究其对语言模型性能的影响，同时引入了一个新的动态评估基准，该基准涵盖了八个与旅行相关的任务，这些任务需要算术、空间、时间和常识推理能力。每个问题都以孤立任务和基于对话的两种形式呈现，从而能够进行控制性比较，同时减少数据污染的影响。对九种语言模型的实验表明，孤立任务和基于对话的任务之间存在显著且一致的性能差异。通过消融分析和定性分析，我们发现这一差异主要源于对话的多轮性质，此外还受到角色条件和工具使用要求的影響。我们的研究结果强调了需要在真实的互动场景中评估语言模型的推理能力的重要性。

papers.title: Capability Decomposition for Unified Information Extraction via Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts
papers.title_zh: 用于统一信息提取的能力分解方法——基于分层专家混合模型
papers.authors: Jing Zhou, Peng Wang, Wenjun Ke, Jiajun Liu, Yao He
papers.abstract: Unified Information Extraction (UIE) aims to handle heterogeneous IE tasks within a single framework, but existing methods often suffer from inconsistent schema representation, implicitly intermediate reasoning and full-parameter adaptation, which limit generalization, interpretability and parameter efficiency. To address these issues, we propose UC-UIE (Universal Capabilities-based Unified Information Extractor), a unified framework based on Large Language Model (LLM), which introduces a unified frame-and-slots schema for IE tasks and explicitly decomposes IE reasoning into three universal capabilities: judging, locating, and associating. Furthermore, UC-UIE adopts a Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) based hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) adapter to fine-tune LLMs for IE tasks, which explicitly models these three capabilities in a task-driven way while ensuring parameter efficiency. With only 1.24% trainable parameters, UC-UIE outperforms full-parameter tuning methods, showing excellent parameter efficiency. Zero-shot evaluation reveals its strong generalization ability to unseen domains and schemas, benefiting from unified schema representation and explicit capability decomposition. Further experiments validate that the hierarchical MoE adapter learns capability specialization and composition, which enhances both UIE performance and interpretability.
papers.abstract_zh: 统一信息提取（UIE）旨在在一个框架内处理各种异构的信息提取任务。然而，现有的方法往往存在模式表示不一致、隐含的中间推理以及全参数调整等问题，这些问题限制了模型的泛化能力、可解释性以及参数使用效率。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了UC-UIE——一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的统一框架。该框架采用了统一的框架与槽位模式来表示信息提取任务，并将推理过程明确地分解为三个通用能力：判断、定位和关联。此外，UC-UIE采用了基于低秩调整的层次混合专家适配器来微调LLM，从而以任务驱动的方式明确建模这三种能力，同时确保了参数的高效使用。由于UC-UIE仅需要1.24%的可训练参数，因此其参数使用效率远高于全参数调整方法。零样本评估表明，UC-UIE在应对未知领域和模式时表现出强大的泛化能力，这得益于其统一的模式表示方式和明确的能力分解机制。进一步的实验验证了这种层次混合专家适配器能够学习到能力的专门化和组合方式，从而提升了UIE的性能和可解释性。

papers.title: PDR: A Plug-and-Play Positional Decay Framework for LLM Pre-training Data Detection
papers.title_zh: PDR：一种即插即用的位置衰减框架，用于检测大语言模型预训练数据中的异常现象
papers.authors: Jinhan Liu, Yibo Yang, Ruiying Lu, Piotr Piękos, Yimeng Chen, Peng Wang, Dandan Guo
papers.abstract: Detecting pre-training data in Large Language Models (LLMs) is crucial for auditing data privacy and copyright compliance, yet it remains challenging in black-box, zero-shot settings where computational resources and training data are scarce. While existing likelihood-based methods have shown promise, they typically aggregate token-level scores using uniform weights, thereby neglecting the inherent information-theoretic dynamics of autoregressive generation. In this paper, we hypothesize and empirically validate that memorization signals are heavily skewed towards the high-entropy initial tokens, where model uncertainty is highest, and decay as context accumulates. To leverage this linguistic property, we introduce Positional Decay Reweighting (PDR), a training-free and plug-and-play framework. PDR explicitly reweights token-level scores to amplify distinct signals from early positions while suppressing noise from later ones. Extensive experiments show that PDR acts as a robust prior and can usually enhance a wide range of advanced methods across multiple benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中检测预训练数据对于审计数据隐私和版权合规性至关重要，但在计算资源和训练数据有限的黑箱、零样本环境中，这一任务仍然具有挑战性。虽然现有的基于似然的方法已经显示出一定的效果，但这些方法通常采用统一的权重来汇总令牌级别的分数，从而忽略了自回归生成过程中固有的信息论动态。在本文中，我们提出并实证验证了记忆信号倾向于集中在高熵的初始令牌上，因为这些位置的模型不确定性最高，并且随着上下文的积累而逐渐减弱。为了利用这一语言特性，我们提出了位置衰减重加权算法（Positional Decay Reweighting，PDR），这是一种无需额外训练即可直接应用的框架。PDR通过重新加权令牌级别的分数，能够增强早期位置的独特信号，同时抑制后期噪声的影响。大量的实验表明，PDR作为一种稳健的先验机制，通常能够在多个基准测试中提升多种先进算法的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PRISM: Probabilistic Reward Model with Inherent Structural Modeling
papers.title_zh: PRISM：具有内在结构建模功能的概率奖励模型
papers.authors: Yuhang Zhou, Yixin Cao, Yuchen Ni, Shihan Dou, Xutian Chen, Ge Zhang, Xiang Liu, Guangnan Ye
papers.abstract: Standard evaluators, such as reward models, compress diverse human judgments into a single scalar, conflating valid Subjective Preference with Cognitive Uncertainty. This structural mismatch often leads to brittle alignment and reward hacking. To address this, we propose PRISM which reinterprets reward evaluation as a conditional distribution parameterized by a Mixture of Gaussians. PRISM structurally disentangles these factors: distinct Gaussian experts emerge to capture conflicting preference dimensions, while their variance estimates quantify uncertainty, acting as a dynamic reliability gate during optimization. We introduce a two-stage training strategy to learn these disentangled representations from scalable pairwise comparisons without requiring massive fine-grained annotations. Empirical results show that PRISM significantly outperforms scalar baselines in both accuracy and generalization. Furthermore, in downstream Reinforcement Learning, PRISM effectively mitigates reward hacking, yielding policies that are more robust and resilient to distribution shifts.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准的评估方法，比如奖励模型，会将各种人类判断压缩成一个单一的标量，从而将有效的主观偏好与认知不确定性混为一谈。这种结构上的不匹配往往会导致对齐效果不稳定以及奖励被操纵的问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PRISM算法。该算法将奖励评估重新定义为一个条件分布，这个分布由高斯混合模型来参数化。PRISM能够结构性地分离这些因素：不同的高斯专家分别负责捕捉不同的偏好维度，而它们的方差估计则用于量化不确定性，从而在优化过程中起到动态可靠性控制的作用。我们采用了一种两阶段训练策略，可以从可扩展的成对比较数据中学习到这些分离后的表示，而无需大量细粒度的注释数据。实验结果表明，PRISM在准确性和泛化能力方面都显著优于基于标量的基线方法。此外，在下游强化学习中，PRISM能够有效防止奖励被操纵的问题，从而生成出更加稳健且能适应分布变化的策略。

papers.title: Multilingual Idioms in Sentences and Conversations Across High-, Medium-, and Low-Resource Languages
papers.title_zh: 多种语言中的习语在高级、中级和低级语言中的句子和对话中应用
papers.authors: Saeed Almheiri, Bilal Elbouardi, Salsabila Zahirah Pranida, Irina Nikishina, Ashwath Rao B, Parameswari Krishnamurthy, Muhammad Cendekia Airlangga, Rifo Ahmad Genadi, Nguyen Phan Gia Bao, Amir Hossein Yari, Hawau Olamide Toyin, Nurdaulet Mukhituly, Mena Attia, Besher Hassan, Ahmad Fathan Hidayatullah, Tatsuki Kuribayashi, Haonan Li, Suma Bhat, Fajri Koto
papers.abstract: Idiomatic expressions pose a major challenge for multilingual NLP because their meanings shift between figurative and literal usage, often requiring context for accurate interpretation. Prior work has focused on high-resource languages typically evaluates isolated idiom-meaning questions, overlooking realistic discourse. We introduce MIDI, a multilingual idiom dataset spanning 3 high-, 3 medium-, and 12 low-resource languages, curated by native speakers. Unlike previous datasets, MIDI provides idioms embedded in both sentence-level and conversational contexts, capturing both literal and figurative readings. Benchmarking state-of-the-art models shows that idiom comprehension degrades in low-resource languages and that, in all resource tiers, literal interpretations are substantially harder than figurative ones. Conversational context improves performance but does not eliminate these disparities. Through controlled tests and interventions on hidden representations, we further separate memorization from reasoning, exposing core limitations of current models.
papers.abstract_zh: 习语表达是多语言自然语言处理中的一个重大挑战，因为其含义在比喻性和字面性使用之间会发生变化，通常需要上下文才能准确理解。以往的研究主要集中在资源丰富的语言中，这些研究往往只关注孤立的习语含义问题，而忽略了真实语境中的习语表现。我们提出了MIDI数据集，这是一个多语言习语数据集，涵盖了3种资源丰富的语言、3种中等资源语言和12种资源匮乏的语言，由母语使用者精心策划而成。与以往的数据集不同，MIDI将数据语嵌入到句子级和对话级语境中，同时捕捉到了字面意义和比喻意义。对最先进模型的基准测试表明，在资源匮乏的语言中，习语的理解能力有所下降，而且在所有资源水平下，字面意义的解释都比比喻意义更难。对话语境确实提升了模型的表现，但并未消除这种差异。通过控制实验和对隐藏表示的干预，我们进一步区分了记忆与推理的作用，从而揭示了当前模型的核心局限性。

papers.title: Author-in-the-Loop Response Generation and Evaluation: Integrating Author Expertise and Intent in Responses to Peer Review
papers.title_zh: 作者参与式的回应生成与评估：将作者的专业知识和意图融入对同行评审的回应中
papers.authors: Qian Ruan, Iryna Gurevych
papers.abstract: Author response (rebuttal) writing is a critical stage of scientific peer review that demands substantial author effort. In practice, authors possess domain expertise, author-only information, and response strategies – concrete forms of author expertise and intent – and seek NLP assistance that integrates these signals into author response generation (ARG). Yet this author-in-the-loop paradigm lacks formal NLP formulation and systematic study: no dataset provides fine-grained author signals, existing ARG work lacks author inputs and controls, and no evaluation measures response reflection of author signals and effectiveness in addressing reviewer concerns. To fill these gaps, we introduce (i) Re³Align, the first large-scale dataset of aligned review–response–revision triplets, where revisions proxy author signals; (ii) REspGen, an author-in-the-loop ARG framework supporting flexible author input, multi-attribute control, and evaluation-guided refinement; and (iii) REspEval, a comprehensive evaluation suite with 20+ metrics spanning input utilization, controllability, response quality, and discourse. Experiments with SOTA LLMs demonstrate the benefits of author input and evaluation-guided refinement, the impact of input specificity on response quality, and controllability–quality trade-offs. We release our dataset, generation and evaluation tools.
papers.abstract_zh: 作者回复撰写是科学同行评审中的一个关键阶段，需要作者付出大量的努力。实际上，作者拥有领域专业知识、仅限作者的信息以及回复策略——这些都是作者专业知识和意图的具体体现——同时他们还需要借助自然语言处理技术来辅助生成作者回复。然而，这种“作者参与式”的范式缺乏正式的自然语言处理机制以及系统的研究：没有数据集能够提供细粒度的作者信号；现有的作者回复生成相关工作也缺乏对作者输入和控制的考虑；同时，也没有评估指标来衡量作者信号的反映程度以及其解决审稿人问题的有效性。为了填补这些空白，我们提出了以下三个解决方案：(1) Re³Align，这是首个大规模的数据集，包含评论、回复和修订的三元组数据，其中修订部分代表了作者信号；(2) REspGen，这是一个支持灵活作者输入、多属性控制以及基于评估进行优化的作者回复生成框架；(3) REspEval，这是一个包含20多种指标的全面评估工具，涵盖了输入利用率、可控性、回复质量以及话语表达等方面。通过与最先进的大语言模型进行的实验，我们证明了作者输入和基于评估的优化策略的优势，以及输入特异性对回复质量的影响，还有可控性与质量之间的权衡关系。目前，我们已经发布了我们的数据集、生成工具和评估工具。

papers.title: WeightLoRA: Keep Only Necessary Adapters
papers.title_zh: WeightLoRA：仅保留必要的适配器
papers.authors: Andrey Veprikov, Vladimir Solodkin, Zyl Alexander, Andrey Savchenko, Aleksandr Beznosikov
papers.abstract: The widespread utilization of language models in modern applications is inconceivable without Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning techniques, such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA), which adds trainable adapters to selected layers. Although LoRA may obtain accurate solutions, it requires significant memory to train large models and intuition on which layers to add adapters. In this paper, we propose a novel method, WeightLoRA, which overcomes this issue by adaptive selection of the most critical LoRA heads throughout the optimization process. As a result, we can significantly reduce the number of trainable parameters while maintaining the capability to obtain consistent or even superior metric values. We conduct experiments for a series of competitive benchmarks and DeBERTa, BART, Llama and Qwen models, comparing our method with different adaptive approaches. The experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of WeightLoRA and the superior performance of WeightLoRA+ in almost all cases. The source code is available at https://github.com/brain-lab-research/WLoRA
papers.abstract_zh: 在现代应用中，语言模型的广泛应用如果没有参数高效微调技术是不可想象的。比如低秩自适应（LoRA）技术，它可以在选定的层中添加可训练的适配器。虽然LoRA能够得到准确的解决方案，但它需要大量的内存来训练大型模型，并且还需要有直觉来判断应该在哪些层添加适配器。在本文中，我们提出了一种新方法——WeightLoRA。该方法通过在整个优化过程中自适应地选择最重要的LoRA头来解决上述问题。因此，我们可以显著减少可训练参数的数量，同时仍然能够保持获得一致甚至更优的度量值的能力。我们对一系列竞争基准测试以及DeBERTa、BART、Llama和Qwen模型进行了实验，并将我们的方法与不同的自适应方法进行了比较。实验结果表明，WeightLoRA非常有效，而WeightLoRA+在几乎所有情况下都表现出色。源代码可以在https://github.com/brain-lab-research/WLoRA获取。

papers.title: Reward Modeling for Scientific Writing Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 基于奖励的科研写作评估模型
papers.authors: Furkan Şahinuç, Subhabrata Dutta, Iryna Gurevych
papers.abstract: Scientific writing is an expert-domain task that demands deep domain knowledge, task-specific requirements and reasoning capabilities that leverage the domain knowledge to satisfy the task specifications. While scientific text generation has been widely studied, its evaluation remains a challenging and open problem. It is critical to develop models that can be reliably deployed for evaluating diverse open-ended scientific writing tasks while adhering to their distinct requirements. However, existing LLM-based judges and reward models are primarily optimized for general-purpose benchmarks with fixed scoring rubrics and evaluation criteria. Consequently, they often fail to reason over sparse knowledge of scientific domains when interpreting task-dependent and multi-faceted criteria. Moreover, fine-tuning for each individual task is costly and impractical for low-resource settings. To bridge these gaps, we propose cost-efficient, open-source reward models tailored for scientific writing evaluation. We introduce a two-stage training framework that initially optimizes scientific evaluation preferences and then refines reasoning capabilities. Our multi-aspect evaluation design and joint training across diverse tasks enable fine-grained assessment and robustness to dynamic criteria and scoring rubrics. Experimental analysis shows that our training regime strongly improves LLM-based scientific writing evaluation. Our models generalize effectively across tasks and to previously unseen scientific writing evaluation settings, allowing a single trained evaluator to be reused without task-specific retraining.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学写作是一项需要深厚领域知识、特定任务要求的专业任务，要求运用领域知识来满足任务规范。虽然科学文本生成已经得到了广泛研究，但其评估仍然是一个具有挑战性的难题。因此，开发能够可靠地用于评估各种开放性科学写作任务的模型至关重要，同时这些模型还需要符合各自的任务要求。然而，现有的基于大语言模型的评估器和奖励模型主要针对通用基准进行测试，其评分标准和评估准则都是固定的。因此，当解释与任务相关的复杂标准时，这些模型往往无法充分利用科学领域的零散知识。此外，为每个具体任务进行微调既耗费资源又难以实现，尤其是在资源有限的情况下。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了一种成本效益高、开源的奖励模型，专门用于科学写作评估。我们采用了一种两阶段训练框架：首先优化科学评估偏好，然后提升推理能力。我们的多维度评估设计和跨任务联合训练使得我们能够进行细致评估，并且能够适应动态的标准和评分准则。实验分析表明，我们的训练方法显著提升了基于大语言模型的科学写作评估效果。我们的模型能够在不同任务中有效泛化，并且适用于以前未遇到的科学写作评估场景，这使得只需一个经过训练的评估器即可重复使用，而无需针对每个任务进行重新训练。

papers.title: Deriving Character Logic from Storyline as Codified Decision Trees
papers.title_zh: 从已编码的决策树中推导出角色逻辑
papers.authors: Letian Peng, Kun Zhou, Longfei Yun, Yupeng Hou, Jingbo Shang
papers.abstract: Role-playing (RP) agents rely on behavioral profiles to act consistently across diverse narrative contexts, yet existing profiles are largely unstructured, non-executable, and weakly validated, leading to brittle agent behavior. We propose Codified Decision Trees (CDT), a data-driven framework that induces an executable and interpretable decision structure from large-scale narrative data. CDT represents behavioral profiles as a tree of conditional rules, where internal nodes correspond to validated scene conditions and leaves encode grounded behavioral statements, enabling deterministic retrieval of context-appropriate rules at execution time. The tree is learned by iteratively inducing candidate scene–action rules, validating them against data, and refining them through hierarchical specialization, yielding profiles that support transparent inspection and principled updates. Across multiple benchmarks, CDT substantially outperforms human-written profiles and prior profile induction methods, indicating that codified and validated behavioral representations lead to more reliable agent grounding.
papers.abstract_zh: 角色扮演（RP）智能体依赖行为描述来在不同叙事场景中保持一致的行为表现。然而，现有的行为描述大多缺乏结构化、不可执行性，且验证程度较低，这导致智能体的行为表现不稳定。我们提出了编码决策树（CDT）这一数据驱动框架，它能够从大规模叙事数据中提取出可执行且可解释的决策结构。CDT将行为描述表示为一棵条件规则树，其中内部节点代表经过验证的场景条件，叶子节点则编码了具体的行为语句。这样，在执行时就可以确定性地获取与当前场景相匹配的规则。该框架通过迭代地生成候选的场景-动作规则、根据数据进行验证，并通过分层细化来优化这些规则，最终得到既易于检查又具备原则性更新能力的描述。在多个基准测试中，CDT的表现明显优于人工编写的描述以及之前的决策树方法，这表明编码化且经过验证的行为描述能够提供更可靠的智能体行为基础。

papers.title: GASim: A Graph-Accelerated Hybrid Framework for Social Simulation
papers.title_zh: GASim：一种基于图加速技术的混合仿真框架，适用于社会模拟场景
papers.authors: Xuan Zhou, Yanhui Sun, Hantao Yao, Allen He, Yongdong Zhang, Wu Liu
papers.abstract: Large-scale social simulators are essential for studying complex social patterns. Prior work explores hybrid methods to scale up simulations, combining large language models (LLM)-based agents with numerical agent-based models (ABM). However, this incurs high latency due to expensive memory retrieval and sequential ABM execution. To address this challenge, we propose GASim, a graph-accelerated hybrid multi-agent framework for large-scale social simulations. For core agents driven by LLM, GASim introduces Graph-Optimized Memory (GOM) to replace intensive LLM-based retrieval pipelines with lightweight propagation over a sparse memory graph. For the majority of ordinary agents, GASim employs Graph Message Passing (GMP), substituting sequential ABM execution with parallel updates by fine-grained feature aggregation and Graph Attention Network. We further introduce Entropy-Driven Grouping (EDG) that coordinates this hybrid partitioning, leveraging information entropy to dynamically identify emergent core agents situated in information-diverse neighborhoods. Extensive experiments show that GASim not only delivers a substantial 9.94× end-to-end speedup over the traditional hybrid framework but also consumes less than 20% of baseline tokens, significantly reducing costs while preserving strong alignment with real-world public opinion trends.
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模社会模拟器对于研究复杂的社交模式至关重要。以往的研究采用了混合方法来扩大模拟规模，将基于大语言模型的智能体与数值型基于智能体的模型相结合。然而，这种方法由于需要昂贵的记忆检索以及顺序性的基于智能体的模型执行，会导致较高的延迟。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了GASim——一种针对大规模社会模拟的、基于图的混合多智能体框架。对于由语言模型驱动的核心智能体，GASim引入了图优化内存技术，用轻量级的传播方式替代了基于语言模型的复杂检索流程，这种传播过程可以在稀疏的内存图上进行。对于大多数普通智能体，GASim采用图消息传递技术，通过细粒度的特征聚合和图注意力网络，用并行更新替代了顺序性的基于智能体的模型执行。我们还引入了熵驱动分组技术，该技术能够协调这种混合式分区策略，利用信息熵来动态识别那些位于信息丰富区域的核心智能体。大量实验表明，GASim不仅比传统的混合框架实现了9.94倍的端到端速度提升，而且其使用的标记数量还不到基准框架的20%，从而显著降低了成本，同时仍然能够很好地适应现实世界中的舆论趋势。

papers.title: Mock Worlds, Real Skills: Building Small Agentic Language Models with Synthetic Tasks, Simulated Environments, and Rubric-Based Rewards
papers.title_zh: 模拟世界、真实技能：利用合成任务、模拟环境以及基于评分标准的奖励来构建小型代理语言模型
papers.authors: Yuanjie Lyu, Chengyu Wang, Lei Shen, Jun Huang, Tong Xu
papers.abstract: Small LLMs often struggle to match the agentic capabilities of large, costly models. While reinforcement learning can help, progress has been limited by two structural bottlenecks: existing open-source agentic training data are narrow in task variety and easily solved; real-world APIs lack diversity and are unstable for large-scale reinforcement learning rollout processes. We address these challenges with SYNTHAGENT, a framework that jointly synthesizes diverse tool-use training data and simulates complete environments. Specifically, a strong teacher model creates novel tasks and tool ecosystems, then rewrites them into intentionally underspecified instructions. This compels agents to actively query users for missing details. When handling synthetic tasks, an LLM-based user simulator provides user-private information, while a mock tool system delivers stable tool responses. For rewards, task-level rubrics are constructed based on required subgoals, user-agent interactions, and forbidden behaviors. Across 14 challenging datasets in math, search, and tool use, models trained on our synthetic data achieve substantial gains, with small models showing performance comparable to some larger baselines in certain domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 小型大语言模型往往难以达到大型、昂贵的模型的智能水平。虽然强化学习可以提供帮助，但进展受到了两个结构性瓶颈的限制：现有的开源智能训练数据在任务多样性方面较为有限，且容易解决；现实世界中的应用程序接口缺乏多样性，且在大规模强化学习应用中的稳定性不足。我们通过SYNTHAGENT框架解决了这些问题。该框架能够同时生成多样化的工具使用训练数据，并模拟完整的环境。具体来说，一个强大的教师模型会创造新的任务和工具生态系统，然后将这些任务重新表述为具有故意不足的细节说明。这促使智能体主动向用户询问缺失的信息。在处理合成任务时，基于大语言模型的用户模拟器会提供用户私有的信息，而模拟的工具系统则能提供更稳定的工具响应。在奖励方面，根据所需的子目标、用户与智能体的互动以及禁止的行为来构建任务级别的评分标准。在我们使用的14个具有挑战性的数学、搜索和工具使用数据集上进行的实验表明，使用我们的合成数据进行训练的模型取得了显著的进步，小型模型在某些领域甚至达到了与一些较大规模基线模型相当的性能。

papers.title: Investigating Cross-Modal Skill Injection: Scenarios, Methods, and Hyperparameters
papers.title_zh: 研究跨模式技能整合：应用场景、方法以及超参数设置
papers.authors: Zhiyu Xu, Lean Wang, Yuanxin Liu, Lei Li, Hao Zhou, Fandong Meng, Jie Zhou, Xu Sun
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in general multi-modal understanding; yet they struggle to efficiently acquire continually evolving domain-specific skills. Conventional approaches to enhancing VLM capabilities, such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), require extensive dataset curation and substantial computational resources. Model merging has emerged as an efficient alternative that enables the transfer of domain-specific expertise from Large Language Models (LLMs) to VLMs without incurring additional training data requirements or significant computational overhead. Unlike conventional merging of homogeneous LLMs, which mainly aggregates existing capabilities, cross-modal skill injection aims to induce emergent cross-modal capabilities by integrating a domain-expert LLM into a VLM. However, existing research lacks a systematic analysis of the applicability and methodology of cross-modal skill injection. In this study, we investigate cross-modal skill injection across three main aspects: scenarios, methods, and hyperparameters. For scenarios, we find that cross-modal skill injection generally performs well in instruction-following and cross-lingual settings, yet struggles with mathematical reasoning. For methods, we find that classic approaches such as TA and DARE consistently achieve superior performance over alternative merging methods. We also provide a systematic and quantitative analysis of the hyperparameter tuning that these classic methods critically depend on.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在通用多模态理解方面表现出卓越的能力，但在有效掌握不断发展的领域特定技能方面却存在困难。传统的增强视觉语言模型能力的方法，如监督微调，需要大量的数据集整理和庞大的计算资源。模型合并作为一种高效的替代方案，能够将大语言模型的领域专业知识转移到视觉语言模型中，而无需额外的训练数据或显著的计算开销。与传统的同质语言模型合并不同，跨模态技能注入的目的是通过将领域专家的语言模型整合到视觉语言模型中，从而诱导出新的跨模态能力。然而，现有的研究缺乏对跨模态技能注入的适用性和方法论的系统性分析。在本研究中，我们从三个主要方面对跨模态技能注入进行了探讨：应用场景、方法和超参数。在应用场景方面，我们发现跨模态技能注入在遵循指令和跨语言环境中表现良好，但在数学推理方面则存在困难。在方法方面，我们发现经典方法如TA和DARE在性能上始终优于其他合并方法。我们还对这些经典方法所依赖的超参数调整进行了系统性和定量的分析。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Bidirectional Process Reward Model
papers.title_zh: 双向过程奖励模型
papers.authors: Lingyin Zhang, Jun Gao, Xiaoxue Ren, Ziqiang Cao
papers.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs), which assign fine-grained scores to intermediate reasoning steps within a solution trajectory, have emerged as a promising approach to enhance the reasoning quality of Large Language Models (LLMs).However, most existing PRMs rely on a unidirectional left-to-right (L2R) evaluation scheme, which restricts their utilization of global context.In light of this challenge, we propose a novel bidirectional evaluation paradigm, named \mathbf{Bi}directional \mathbf{P}rocess \mathbf{R}eward \mathbf{M}odel (\mathbf{BiPRM}).BiPRM incorporates a parallel right-to-left (R2L) evaluation stream, implemented via prompt reversal, alongside the conventional L2R flow.Then a gating mechanism is introduced to adaptively fuse the reward scores from both streams to yield a holistic quality assessment.Remarkably, compared to the original PRM, BiPRM introduces only a 0.3% parameter increase for the gating module, and the parallel execution of two streams incurs merely 5% inference time latency. Our extensive empirical evaluations spanning diverse benchmarks, LLM backbones, PRM objectives and sampling policies demonstrate that BiPRM consistently surpasses unidirectional baselines, achieving an average relative gain of 10.6% over 54 solution-level configurations and 37.7% in 12 step-level error detection scenarios.Generally, our results highlight the effectiveness, robustness and general applicability of BiPRM, offering a promising new direction for process-based reward modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 过程奖励模型（PRM）能够为核心解算过程中的各个中间推理步骤分配细粒度的分数，这一方法被证明是提升大语言模型（LLM）推理质量的有效手段。然而，目前大多数PRM都采用单向的从左到右（L2R）评估方式，这限制了它们对全局上下文的利用。针对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的双向评估范式，名为双向过程奖励模型（BiPRM）。BiPRM结合了从右到左的并行评估流程，通过提示反转来实现，同时保留了传统的L2R流程。此外，我们还引入了一种门控机制，以自适应地融合来自两个流程的奖励分数，从而得出整体评估结果。值得注意的是，与传统的PRM相比，BiPRM在门控模块上的参数增加仅达到了0.3%，而两个流程的并行执行仅导致5%的推理时间延迟。我们在多种基准测试、LLM基础模型、PRM目标以及采样策略下的广泛实验表明，BiPRM始终优于单向的基线模型，在54种解决方案级别的配置中实现了平均相对增益为10.6%，在12种步骤级别的错误检测场景中实现了37.7%的改进。总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了BiPRM的有效性、鲁棒性以及广泛的适用性，为基于过程的奖励建模提供了新的发展方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AgentMark: Utility-Preserving Behavioral Watermarking for Agents
papers.title_zh: AgentMark：适用于智能体的、能保持效用行为的 watermarking 技术
papers.authors: Kaibo Huang, Jin Tan, Yukun Wei, Wanling Li, Zipei Zhang, Hui Tian, Zhongliang Yang, Linna Zhou
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed to autonomously solve complex tasks, raising urgent needs for IP protection and regulatory provenance. While content watermarking effectively attributes LLM-generated outputs, it fails to directly identify the high-level planning behaviors (e.g., tool and subgoal choices) that govern multi-step execution. Critically, watermarking at the planning-behavior layer faces unique challenges: minor distributional deviations in decision-making can compound during long-term agent operation, degrading utility, and many agents operate as black boxes that are difficult to intervene in directly. To bridge this gap, we propose AgentMark, a behavioral watermarking framework that embeds multi-bit identifiers into planning decisions while preserving utility. It operates by eliciting an explicit behavior distribution from the agent and applying distribution-preserving conditional sampling, enabling deployment under black-box APIs while remaining compatible with action-layer content watermarking. Experiments across embodied, tool-use, and social environments demonstrate practical multi-bit capacity, robust recovery from partial logs, and utility preservation. Code is available at https://github.com/Tooooa/AgentMark.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的智能体被越来越多地用于自主解决复杂任务，这迫切需要针对IP保护和监管来源进行保护。虽然内容水印能够有效标记由LLM生成的输出，但它无法直接识别那些控制多步骤执行的高级规划行为（例如工具选择和子目标选择）。关键问题是，在规划行为层面使用水印存在独特挑战：决策过程中的微小差异在长期智能体运行过程中可能会累积，从而降低其效用；而且许多智能体都表现为难以直接干预的黑箱系统。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了AgentMark这一行为水印框架。该框架将多比特标识符嵌入到规划决策中，同时保留其效用。其运作方式是从智能体中获取明确的行为分布，然后采用保持分布一致的条件采样方法，从而在保持与动作层内容水印兼容的同时，实现在黑箱API下的部署。在实体化、工具使用和社交环境中的实验表明，该框架具有实际的多比特处理能力、能够从部分日志中恢复数据的能力，以及保持效用的功能。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/Tooooa/AgentMark。

papers.title: Generative Gamer: Learning Equilibrium Strategy by LLM-driven Dynamic Deduction
papers.title_zh: 生成型玩家：通过LLM驱动的动态推理学习均衡策略
papers.authors: Yadong Zhang, Xinshu Shen, Yupei Ren, Shangqing Zhao, Man Lan
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable general capabilities, yet they falter in domains requiring deep strategic reasoning. A primary obstacle is the need to navigate a game tree that grows exponentially with search depth, a task for which their generative nature is ill-suited. To address this, we introduce Generative Gamer (GenGamer), a framework that trains LLMs to reason like an expert player. Instead of attempting an exhaustive search, GenGamer learns to generate a compact, pruned reasoning trajectory termed as a Dynamic Deduction. This is achieved by integrating three key strategies: action pruning based on policy confidence, state pruning via value estimation, and branch pruning inspired by alpha-beta principles. Furthermore, to train the model effectively, we propose the Deduction Tree Reward (DTR), a process-oriented mechanism that provides step-by-step feedback on the quality of the reasoning process, rather than relying solely on the final game outcome. Experiments on complex games such as Tic-Tac-Toe and Leduc Poker demonstrate that GenGamer significantly enhances the strategic capabilities of LLMs, enabling them to achieve performance that surpasses current state-of-the-art language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）展现了出色的通用能力，但在需要深度战略推理的领域中表现不佳。主要障碍在于需要处理随着搜索深度呈指数级增长的游戏树结构，而LLM的生成特性并不适合这一任务。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了“生成型玩家”框架，该框架训练LLM以类似专家玩家的方式进行推理。GenGamer不是尝试穷举搜索，而是学会生成一种简洁、经过优化的推理路径，即动态推导。实现这一目标的方法包括三种策略：基于策略置信度的动作剪枝、通过价值估计进行状态剪枝，以及借鉴α-β原则的分支剪枝。此外，为了有效训练模型，我们提出了“推导树奖励”机制，这是一种以过程为导向的机制，能够逐步反馈推理过程的质量，而不是仅仅依赖最终的游戏结果。在Tic-Tac-Toe和Leduc Poker等复杂游戏上的实验表明，GenGamer显著提升了LLM的战略能力，使其性能超越当前最先进的语言模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Probing for Reading Times
papers.title_zh: 探测读取时间
papers.authors: Eleftheria Tsipidi, Samuel Kiegeland, Francesco Ignazio Re, Tianyang Xu, Mario Giulianelli, Karolina Stanczak, Ryan Cotterell
papers.abstract: Probing has shown that language model representations encode rich linguistic information, but it remains unclear whether they also capture cognitive signals about human processing. In this work, we probe language model representations for human reading times. Using regularized linear regression on two eye-tracking corpora spanning five languages (English, Greek, Hebrew, Russian, and Turkish), we compare the representations from every model layer against scalar predictors—surprisal, information value, and logit-lens surprisal. We find that the representations from early layers outperform surprisal in predicting early-pass measures such as first fixation and gaze duration. The concentration of predictive power in the early layers suggests that human-like processing signatures are captured by low-level structural or lexical representations, pointing to a functional alignment between model depth and the temporal stages of human reading. In contrast, for late-pass measures such as total reading time, scalar surprisal remains superior, despite its being a much more compressed representation. We also observe performance gains when using both surprisal and early-layer representations. Overall, we find that the best-performing predictor varies strongly depending on the language and eye-tracking measure.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究表明，语言模型表示能够编码丰富的语言信息，但尚不清楚它们是否能够捕捉到关于人类处理过程的认知信号。在这项研究中，我们探讨了语言模型表示与人类阅读时间之间的关系。通过对五种语言（英语、希腊语、希伯来语、俄语和土耳其语）的两个眼动记录库进行正则化线性回归分析，我们将每个模型层的表示与标量预测因子进行比较——包括意外性、信息价值和逻辑斯蒂透镜意外性。我们发现，早期层的表示在预测诸如首次注视时间和注视持续时间等早期阶段指标方面表现优于意外性。预测能力的集中体现在早期层，这表明类似人类的处理特征可以被低层次的结构性或词汇性表示所捕捉，这暗示了模型深度与人类阅读的时间阶段之间存在功能上的对应关系。相比之下，对于诸如总阅读时间这样的后期阶段指标，尽管标量意外性的表示更为简洁，但它仍然表现出色。我们还观察到，同时使用意外性和早期层的表示时，模型的性能会得到提升。总体而言，我们发现，表现最好的预测因子会因语言和眼动指标的不同而有很大差异。

papers.title: No More Stale Feedback: Co-Evolving Critics for Open-World Agent Learning
papers.title_zh: 不再有延迟的反馈：共同进化的评论者，用于开放世界类型的智能体学习系统
papers.authors: Zhicong Li, Lingjie Jiang, Yulan Hu, Xingchen Zeng, Yixia Li, Xiangwen Zhang, Guanhua Chen, Zheng Pan, Xin Li, Yong Liu
papers.abstract: Critique-guided reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training LLM agents by augmenting sparse outcome rewards with natural-language feedback. However, current methods often rely on static or offline critic models, which fail to adapt as the policy evolves. In on-policy RL, the agent’s trajectory distribution and error patterns shift over time, causing stationary critics to become stale and providing feedback of diminishing utility. To address this, we introduce ECHO (Evolving Critic for Hindsight-Guided Optimization), a framework that jointly optimizes the policy and critic through a synchronized co-evolutionary loop. ECHO utilizes a cascaded rollout mechanism where the critic generates multiple diagnoses for an initial trajectory, followed by policy refinement to enable group-structured advantage estimation. We address the challenge of learning plateaus via a saturation-aware gain shaping objective, which rewards the critic for inducing incremental improvements in high-performing trajectories. By employing synchronized dual-track GRPO updates, ECHO ensures the critic’s feedback stays synchronized with the evolving policy. Experimental results show that ECHO yields more stable training and higher long-horizon task success across open-world environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于批评引导的强化学习已成为训练大语言模型智能体的强大方法，它通过用自然语言反馈来补充稀疏的奖励信息。然而，当前的方法往往依赖于静态或离线的批评模型，这些模型无法随着策略的演变而进行调整。在基于策略的强化学习中，智能体的轨迹分布和错误模式会随时间发生变化，导致静态的批评模型变得过时，从而提供效用逐渐降低的反馈。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了ECHO（用于事后指导优化的进化批评）框架，该框架通过同步的协同进化循环来同时优化策略和批评模型。ECHO采用了一种级联部署机制，其中批评模型会对初始轨迹生成多个诊断结果，随后再通过策略优化来实现群体结构的优势估计。为了解决学习停滞的问题，我们采用了一种考虑饱和度的收益 shaping 目标，该目标能够奖励那些能在高性能轨迹中带来渐进性改进的批评模型。通过采用同步的双轨GRPO更新方式，ECHO确保批评模型的反馈与不断演变的策略保持一致。实验结果表明，ECHO能够在开放世界环境中实现更稳定的训练效果，并在长期任务中取得更高的成功率。

papers.title: Continuous Interpretive Steering for Scalar Diversity
papers.title_zh: 用于标量多样性分析的连续解释性引导方法
papers.authors: Ye-eun Cho
papers.abstract: Pragmatic inference is inherently graded. Different lexical items give rise to pragmatic enrichment to different degrees. Scalar implicature exemplifies this property through scalar diversity, where implicature strength varies across scalar items. However, evaluations of pragmatic inference in large language models (LLMs) often rely on prompt-based manipulations. Beyond prompt-level effects, this study introduces Continuous Interpretive Steering (CIS), a method that probes graded pragmatic interpretation by treating activation-level steering strength as a continuous experimental variable. To support this analysis, this study introduces a new dataset, GraSD, which encodes graded scalar diversity. Experiments on four LLMs show that uniform activation steering increases pragmatic interpretations globally but collapses item-level variation, whereas graded activation steering yields differentiated interpretive shifts aligned with scalar diversity grades. Together, CIS and GraSD provide a principled framework for evaluating graded pragmatic sensitivity in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 实用推理本质上是具有等级性的。不同的词汇项会在不同程度上带来实用的丰富性。标量含义就体现了这一特性，因为不同标量项之间的含义强度是不同的。然而，在大语言模型中进行实用推理的评估时，通常依赖于基于提示的操作。本研究提出了连续解释引导法，这是一种通过把激活级别的引导强度视为一个连续实验变量来探究分级实用解释的方法。为了支持这一分析，本研究引入了一个新的数据集GraSD，该数据集包含了分级的标量多样性信息。在四个大语言模型上的实验表明，统一的激活引导会全局性地增强实用解释，但会破坏项目级别的差异性；而分级的激活引导则会产生与标量多样性等级相对应的差异化解释变化。总的来说，连续解释引导法和GraSD为评估大语言模型中分级实用敏感性提供了一个有原则的框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Scalable Multi-LLM Collaboration System with Retrieval-based Selection and Exploration-Exploitation-Driven Enhancement
papers.title_zh: 一种可扩展的多大语言模型协作系统，具备基于检索的选择机制，以及以探索、利用为导向的增强功能
papers.authors: Shengji Tang, Jianjian Cao, Weihao Lin, Jiale Hong, Bo Zhang, Shuyue Hu, Lei Bai, Tao Chen, Wanli Ouyang, Peng Ye
papers.abstract: Existing multi-LLM collaboration systems often encounter scalability challenges when integrating new LLMs and tasks, leading to suboptimal performance. To address this, we propose SMCS, a Scalable Multi-LLM Collaboration System designed to effectively coordinate multiple open-source LLMs. The system consists of two core components: a Retrieval-based Prior Selection (RPS) module, which dynamically selects the most suitable LLMs for each input, and an Exploration–Exploitation-Driven Posterior Enhancement (EPE) module, which fosters response diversity and selects high-quality outputs through a hybrid scoring mechanism. Experiments on eight mainstream benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our system: by integrating fifteen open-source LLMs, SMCS outperforms prevailing closed-source LLMs, e.g., GPT-4.1(+5.36%) and GPT-o3-mini(+5.28%) across multiple tasks. Remarkably, it even exceeds the average of best results on different datasets with open-source LLMs (+2.86%), significantly advancing the empirical performance frontier of open-source collaboration. The code is released at https://github.com/magent4aci/SMCS.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的多大语言模型协作系统在集成新的大语言模型和任务时常常面临可扩展性挑战，从而导致性能不佳。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SMCS——一种可扩展的多大语言模型协作系统，旨在有效协调多个开源大语言模型。该系统由两个核心组件构成：基于检索的先验选择模块，该模块能够动态选择最适合每个输入的模型；以及基于探索与利用的后验增强模块，该模块通过混合评分机制促进响应多样性并选出高质量的输出。在八个主流基准测试上的实验验证了我们的系统的有效性：通过整合十五个开源大语言模型，SMCS在多个任务中的表现优于现有的闭源大语言模型，例如GPT-4.1（+5.36%）和GPT-o3-mini（+5.28%）。值得注意的是，其表现甚至超过了不同数据集上最佳开源大语言模型的平均水平（+2.86%），显著提升了开源协作的性能水平。代码可在https://github.com/magent4aci/SMCS下载。

papers.title: From Form to Logic: Masked Reconstruction and Reasoning Distillation for Short Video Fake News Detection
papers.title_zh: 从形式到逻辑：掩码重建与推理蒸馏技术在短视频虚假新闻检测中的应用
papers.authors: Qingyan Wang, Lianwei Wu, Botao Wang, Wangkang, Yaxiong Wang
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of short video platforms has made multimodal fake news more prevalent. Existing detectors suffer from two major limitations: (I) global-alignment bias that overemphasizes holistic cross-modal matching and thus misses subtle, localized inconsistencies; and (II) LLM-based methods that leverage powerful generative reasoning to identify cognitive forgeries but inherently suffer from hallucinations and high inference latency. To overcome these limitations, we propose PCDD, a novel Perception-Cognition Dual-driven Detector that jointly observes the form and probes the logic for short video fake news detection. The perception stream exposes fine-grained cross-modal conflicts by amplifying localized inconsistencies into explicit discrepancies. The cognition stream transfers reasoning capabilities from LLMs to a lightweight student to mine cognitive forgeries, while reducing the risk of hallucinations and eliminating reliance on LLMs at inference. Experiments on real-world datasets show that PCDD consistently outperforms baselines, while improving interpretability and robustness in data scarcity scenarios. Our code is available at: https://github.com/SeinCore/PCDD.
papers.abstract_zh: 短视频平台的迅速增长使得多模态虚假新闻更加普遍。现有的检测算法存在两个主要缺陷：(I) 全局对齐偏差问题，这种偏差过度强调跨模态的整体匹配，从而忽略了细微的局部不一致性；(II) 基于大语言模型的方法虽然能够利用强大的生成推理能力来识别认知伪造内容，但本质上存在幻觉现象，且推理延迟较高。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了PCDD这一新型感知-认知双驱动检测器。该检测器同时关注短视频内容的形态特征，并探究其逻辑结构，从而有效识别虚假新闻。感知流通过放大局部不一致性来揭示细微的跨模态冲突；认知流则将大语言模型的推理能力转移到一个轻量级模型中，以识别认知伪造内容，同时降低幻觉风险，并避免对大语言模型的依赖。在真实数据集上的实验表明，PCDD始终优于现有基线算法，同时在数据稀缺的情况下提升了可解释性和鲁棒性。我们的代码可在以下链接下载：https://github.com/SeinCore/PCDD

papers.title: UR^2 : Unify RAG and Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: UR^2：通过强化学习实现RAG与推理的统一
papers.authors: Weitao Li, Boran Xiang, Xiaolong Wang, Jingyi Ren, Ante Wang, Zhinan Gou, Weizhi Ma, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities through two complementary paradigms: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for knowledge grounding and Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for complex reasoning. However, existing attempts to unify these paradigms remain narrow in scope, typically limited to open-domain QA with fixed retrieval settings, which constrains generalization to broader domains. To address this limitation, we propose UR^2 (Unified RAG and Reasoning), a general reinforcement learning framework that dynamically coordinates retrieval and reasoning. UR^2 introduces two key designs: a difficulty-aware curriculum that selectively invokes retrieval only for challenging instances, and a hybrid knowledge access strategy that combines domain-specific offline corpora with on-the-fly LLM-generated summaries. Together, these components mitigate the imbalance between retrieval and reasoning and improve robustness to noisy information. Experiments on open-domain QA, MMLU-Pro, medical, and mathematical reasoning tasks show that UR^2, built on Qwen-2.5-3/7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B, consistently outperforms existing RAG and RL baselines, and achieves performance comparable to GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4.1-mini on several benchmarks. We will release all code, models, and data.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过两种互补的范式展现了强大的能力：用于知识检索的检索增强生成方法，以及用于复杂推理的可验证奖励强化学习方法。然而，目前尝试统一这两种范式的努力仍然局限于特定领域，通常仅限于具有固定检索设置的开放域问答任务，这限制了模型对更广泛领域的泛化能力。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了UR^2（统一的检索增强与推理框架），这是一个能够动态协调检索与推理过程的通用强化学习框架。UR^2包含两个关键设计：一种考虑难度的训练计划，仅对具有挑战性的实例进行检索；以及一种混合式知识获取策略，结合了特定领域的离线语料库和实时生成的LLM摘要。这些设计共同缓解了检索与推理之间的不平衡问题，并提高了模型对噪声信息的鲁棒性。在开放域问答、MMLU-Pro、医学和数学推理任务上的实验表明，基于Qwen-2.5-3/7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B构建的UR^2，其性能始终优于现有的检索增强与强化学习基线模型，并且在多个基准测试中的表现与GPT-4o-mini和GPT-4.1-mini相当。我们将公开所有代码、模型和数据。

papers.title: LLM-as-Scheduler: Agentic Workflow Dynamic Scheduling
papers.title_zh: 以LLM作为调度器：基于代理的工作流动态调度
papers.authors: Dawei Xiang, Kexin Chu, Wenyan Xu, Wenhui Zhang, Wei Zhang
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) improve, many applications are moving from a single LLM call to multi-agent systems. These systems often rely on either hand-designed or automatically optimized workflows with multiple verification and testing steps. While those extra steps can improve accuracy, they also increase latency and token costs. In practice, many queries do not need such heavy processing and can be handled well by a single strong agent.To address this inefficiency, we propose LLM-as-Scheduler (LAS), a system that dynamically chooses the right workflow for each query. LAS uses a two-stage cascade: first, a lightweight gate quickly evaluates each agent’s output; then, an LLM-based scheduler uses query features and gate signals to make more detailed routing decisions. Experiments show that LAS cuts token usage by 43% and reduces end-to-end latency by more than 36%, while causing at most a 1.4 percentage-point drop in accuracy compared with a strong fixed workflow.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的发展，许多应用程序已经从单一语言模型的调用方式转变为多智能体系统。这些系统通常依赖于手工设计或自动优化后的工作流程，并包含多个验证和测试步骤。虽然这些额外的步骤可以提高准确性，但它们也会增加延迟和令牌成本。实际上，许多查询并不需要如此复杂的处理，单个强大的智能体就能很好地处理这些查询。为了克服这种效率低下的问题，我们提出了一种名为“语言模型作为调度器”的系统。该系统能够动态地为每个查询选择合适的 Workflow。LAS 采用两阶段级联机制：首先，一个轻量级的门控模块快速评估每个智能体的输出结果；然后，基于语言模型的调度器利用查询特征和门控信号来做出更精确的路由决策。实验表明，使用 LAS 可以将令牌使用量减少 43%，端到端延迟降低超过 36%。同时，与传统的固定 Workflow 相比，系统的准确性仅下降了 1.4个百分点。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mathematical Proof as a Litmus Test: Revealing Failure Modes of Advanced Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 数学证明作为判断标准：揭示先进大型推理模型的缺陷
papers.authors: Dadi Guo, Jiayu Liu, Zhiyuan Fan, Zhitao He, Haoran Li, Yuxin Li, Yumeng Wang, Yi R. Fung
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models ( e.g., R1, o3) have demonstrated remarkable mathematical problem-solving abilities. However, the high reported accuracy of these advanced models on popular datasets and reliance on purely numerical evaluation often mask their true reasoning shortcomings. To address this, we propose leveraging the inherent rigor and methodological complexity of mathematical proofs as a diagnostic tool to expose these hidden failures. Specifically, we introduce the RFMDataset (Reveal Failure Modes), a collection of 200 diverse mathematical proof problems to thoroughly evaluate the performance of advanced models. Our in-depth analysis of their failures uncovers 10 fine-grained error types, which shows fundamental limitations in current large reasoning models: 1) Large reasoning models still have limited capability in generating entirely correct mathematical proofs, with some models solving less than 20% of problems and even making mistakes on fundamental ones; 2) models exhibit a diverse spectrum of reasoning failures, prominently demonstrating the lack of guarantees for the correctness and rigor intermediate reasoning steps; and 3) models show hallucination and incompleteness during the reasoning process. Our findings also reveal that directly prompting models to self-reflect on specific failure modes is insufficient to resolve the current logical dilemmas, necessitating domain knowledge and formal verification.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（例如R1、o3）在解决数学问题方面展现出了卓越的能力。然而，这些先进模型在常见数据集上的高准确率以及其对纯数值评估的依赖，往往掩盖了它们真正的推理缺陷。为了应对这一问题，我们提出利用数学证明固有的严谨性和方法学复杂性作为诊断工具，以揭示这些隐藏的缺陷。具体来说，我们开发了RFMDataset这一数据集，其中包含200个不同的数学证明问题，用于全面评估先进模型的性能。通过对这些模型缺陷的深入分析，我们发现有10种细微的错误类型，这揭示了当前大型推理模型存在的根本局限性：1）大型推理模型在生成完全正确的数学证明方面的能力仍然有限，有些模型能够解决的问题比例不到20%，甚至会在基础问题上出错；2）模型在推理过程中表现出多种缺陷，这表明当前模型在确保推理步骤的正确性和严谨性方面存在不足；3）模型在推理过程中会出现幻觉和不完全性的情况。我们的研究还表明，单纯要求模型自我反思特定类型的缺陷不足以解决当前的逻辑难题，还需要借助领域知识和形式化验证。

papers.title: Memory-R1: Enhancing Large Language Model Agents to Manage and Utilize Memories via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 内存-R1：通过强化学习提升大型语言模型代理的能力，以更有效地管理和利用内存
papers.authors: Sikuan Yan, Xiufeng Yang, Zuchao Huang, Ercong Nie, Zifeng Ding, Zonggen Li, Xiaowen Ma, Jinhe Bi, Kristian Kersting, Jeff Z. Pan, Hinrich Schuetze, Volker Tresp, Yunpu Ma
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a wide range of NLP tasks, but they remain fundamentally stateless, constrained by limited context windows that hinder long-horizon reasoning. Recent efforts to address this limitation often augment LLMs with an external memory bank, yet most existing pipelines are static and heuristic-driven, lacking a learned mechanism for deciding what to store, update, or retrieve. We present Memory-R1, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that equips LLMs with the ability to actively manage and utilize external memory through two specialized agents: a Memory Manager that learns structured operations, including ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, and NOOP; and an Answer Agent that pre-selects and reasons over relevant entries. Both agents are fine-tuned with outcome-driven RL (PPO and GRPO), enabling adaptive memory management with minimal supervision. With only 152 training QA pairs, Memory-R1 outperforms strong baselines and generalizes across diverse question types, three benchmarks (LoCoMo, MSC, LongMemEval), and multiple model scales (3B–14B).
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在众多自然语言处理任务中展现出了令人印象深刻的性能，但它们本质上仍然处于无状态的状态，受到有限上下文窗口的限制，这阻碍了长期视角的推理能力。近期为解决这一限制而进行的努力通常是通过添加外部记忆库来增强语言模型的能力，但现有的大多数方法都是静态的、基于启发式的，缺乏一种能够决定存储、更新或检索内容的机制。我们提出了Memory-R1框架，它是一个强化学习框架，能够让语言模型通过两个专门的代理来主动管理和利用外部记忆：一个记忆管理器负责学习结构化操作，包括添加、更新、删除和空操作；另一个答案代理则负责预先选择并分析相关条目。这两个代理都通过基于结果的强化学习（PPO和GRPO）进行微调，从而实现在最小监督下的自适应记忆管理。仅使用152对训练用问答对，Memory-R1的表现就优于强大的基线模型，并且能够在多种问题类型、三个基准测试（LoCoMo、MSC、LongMemEval）以及不同模型规模（3B到14B）的情况下表现出良好的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
