papers.title: CostBench: Evaluating Multi-Turn Cost-Optimal Planning and Adaptation in Dynamic Environments for LLM Tool-Use Agents
papers.title_zh: CostBench：在动态环境中评估多轮成本最优规划以及适用于大型语言模型工具使用智能体的适应性策略
papers.authors: Jiayu Liu, Cheng Qian, Zhaochen Su, Qing Zong, Shijue Huang, Bingxiang He, Yi R. Fung
papers.abstract: Current evaluations of Large Language Model (LLM) agents primarily emphasize task completion, often overlooking resource efficiency and adaptability. This neglects a crucial capability: agents’ ability to devise and adjust cost-optimal plans in response to changing environments. To bridge this gap, we introduce CostBench, a scalable, cost-centric benchmark designed to evaluate agents’ economic reasoning and replanning abilities. Situated in the travel-planning domain, CostBench comprises tasks solvable via multiple sequences of atomic and composite tools with diverse, customizable costs. It also supports four types of dynamic blocking events, such as tool failures and cost changes, to simulate real-world unpredictability and necessitate agents to adapt in real time. Evaluating leading open-sourced and proprietary models on CostBench reveals a substantial gap in cost-aware planning: agents frequently fail to identify cost-optimal solutions in static settings, with even GPT-5 achieving less than 75% exact match rate on the hardest tasks, and performance further drops significantly under dynamic conditions. By diagnosing these weaknesses, CostBench lays the groundwork for developing future agents that are both economically rational and robust.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前对大语言模型代理的评估主要侧重于任务完成能力，而忽视了资源效率和适应性方面。这种评估方式忽略了一个至关重要的能力：代理能够根据环境变化制定并调整成本最优的计划。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了CostBench这个可扩展的、以成本为中心的基准测试工具，用于评估代理的经济推理能力和重新规划能力。CostBench适用于旅行规划领域，其任务可以通过多种原子工具和复合工具的序列来解决，这些工具的代价各不相同且可以自定义。此外，该工具还支持四种类型的动态阻塞事件，如工具故障和成本变化，以模拟现实世界中的不可预测性，从而要求代理实时做出适应性的调整。在CostBench上对主流的开源和专有模型进行评估后发现，这些模型在成本意识规划方面存在显著差距：代理在静态环境下往往无法找到成本最优的解决方案，即使是GPT-5在最困难的任务上也能达到不到75%的精确匹配率，而在动态条件下性能更是大幅下降。通过识别这些弱点，CostBench为开发既具有经济理性又具备强大适应能力的未来代理奠定了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Decoding Scientific Experimental Images: The SPUR Benchmark for Perception, Understanding, and Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 解析科学实验图像：SPUR——用于感知、理解和推理的基准平台
papers.authors: Junpeng Ding, Zichen Tang, Haihong E, Mengyuan Ji, Yang Liu, Haolin Tian, Haiyang Sun, Pengqi Sun, Yang Xu, Yichen Liu, Haocheng Gao, Zijie Xi, Ruomeng Jiang, Peizhi Zhao, Rongjin Li, Yuanze Li, Jiacheng Liu, Zhongjun Yang, Jintong Chen, Siying Lin
papers.abstract: We introduce SPUR, a comprehensive benchmark for scientific experimental image perception, understanding, and reasoning, comprising 4,264 question-answering (QA) pairs derived from 1,084 expert-curated images. SPUR features three key innovations: (1) Panel-Level Fine-Grained Perception: evaluating the visual perception of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) across three dimensions (numerical, morphological, and information localization) on six fine-grained panel types; (2) Cross-Panel Relation Understanding: utilizing complex images with an average of 14.3 panels per sample to evaluate MLLMs’ ability to decipher intricate cross-panel relations; (3) Expert-Level Reasoning: assessment of qualitative and quantitative reasoning across five experimental paradigms to determine if models can infer conclusions from evidence as human experts do. Comprehensive evaluation of 20 MLLMs and four multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) methods reveals that current models fall significantly short of the expert-level requirements for scientific image interpretation, underscoring a critical bottleneck in AI for Science (AI4S) research.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了SPUR，这是一个全面的科学实验图像感知、理解和推理的基准测试平台。该平台包含4,264对问答对，这些问答对来自1,084张由专家精心挑选的图像。SPUR具有三个关键创新点：(1) 面板级精细感知：在六种细粒度面板类型上，评估多模态大语言模型在数值、形态学和信息定位这三个维度上的视觉感知能力；(2) 跨面板关系理解：利用平均包含14.3个面板的复杂图像，来评估大语言模型解读复杂跨面板关系的能力；(3) 专家级推理：通过五种实验范式来评估模型的定性和定量推理能力，以判断模型是否能够像人类专家一样从证据中得出结论。对20种大语言模型和四种多模态思维链方法进行了全面评估，结果表明，当前模型在科学图像解释方面明显达不到专家级的要求，这凸显了人工智能科学研究中的一个关键瓶颈。

papers.title: SegTune: Structured and Fine-Grained Control for Song Generation
papers.title_zh: SegTune：结构化且细粒度的歌曲生成控制机制
papers.authors: Yuejiao Wang, Zihao Ji, Pengfei Cai, Xu Li, Haorui Zheng, Zewen Song, Zhongliang Liu, Chen Zhang, Pengfei Wan
papers.abstract: Recent advances in neural song generation have enabled high-quality synthesis from lyrics and global textual prompts. However, most systems fail to model temporally varying attributes of songs, severely limiting fine-grained control over musical structure and dynamics. To address this, we propose Segtune, a Diffusion Transformer-based framework enabling structured and fine-grained controllability by allowing users or large language models (LLMs) to specify local musical descriptions aligned to song segments. These segment prompts are temporally broadcast to corresponding time windows, while global prompts ensure stylistic coherence. To support precise lyric-to-music alignment, we introduce an LLM-based duration predictor that autoregressively generates sentence-level timestamps in LyRiCs format. We further construct a large-scale data pipeline for high-quality song collection with aligned lyrics and prompts, and propose new metrics to evaluate segment alignment and vocal consistency. Experiments demonstrate that Segtune outperforms existing baselines in both musicality and controllability. Visit our demo page for codes and more generated songs.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来在神经音乐生成领域取得的进展使得从歌词和全局文本提示中合成高质量音乐成为可能。然而，大多数系统无法模拟歌曲在时间上的变化特性，这严重限制了对音乐结构和动态细节的精细控制。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了Segtune框架——一个基于扩散变换器的系统，它允许用户或大语言模型指定与歌曲片段相对应的局部音乐描述。这些片段提示会随时间广播到相应的时间窗口，而全局提示则确保整体风格的一致性。为了精确实现歌词与音乐的匹配，我们引入了一个基于语言模型的时长预测器，该预测器能够自回归地生成LyRiCs格式的句子级时间戳。我们还构建了一个大规模的数据管道，用于收集具有对齐歌词和提示的高质量歌曲样本，并提出了新的指标来评估片段对齐和声音一致性。实验表明，Segtune在音乐性和可控性方面均优于现有的基线方法。请访问我们的演示页面，获取代码以及更多生成的歌曲。

papers.title: Making Large Language Models Efficient Dense Retrievers
papers.title_zh: 让大型语言模型更加高效——密集检索机制
papers.authors: Yibin Lei, Shwai He, Ang Li, Andrew Yates
papers.abstract: Recent work has shown that directly fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) for dense retrieval yields strong performance, but their substantial parameter counts make them computationally inefficient. While prior studies have revealed significant layer redundancy in LLMs for generative tasks, it remains unclear whether similar redundancy exists when these models are adapted for retrieval tasks, which require encoding entire sequences into fixed representations rather than generating tokens iteratively. To this end, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of layer redundancy in LLM-based dense retrievers. We find that, in contrast to generative settings, MLP layers are substantially more prunable, while attention layers remain critical for semantic aggregation. Building on this insight, we propose EffiR, a framework for developing efficient retrievers that performs large-scale MLP compression through a coarse-to-fine strategy (coarse-grained depth reduction followed by fine-grained width reduction), combined with retrieval-specific fine-tuning. Across diverse BEIR datasets and LLM backbones, EffiR achieves substantial reductions in model size and inference cost while preserving the performance of full-size models.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，直接对大语言模型进行微调以用于密集检索可以取得良好的性能，但这类模型的参数数量庞大，导致计算效率低下。虽然先前的研究发现，在生成任务中，大语言模型存在显著的层冗余现象，但尚不清楚当这些模型被适配用于需要将整个序列编码为固定表示而不是迭代生成令牌的检索任务时，是否也存在类似的冗余现象。为此，我们对基于大语言模型的密集检索器中的层冗余进行了全面分析。我们发现，与生成场景不同，多层感知器层更容易进行剪枝处理，而注意力层则对于语义聚合仍然至关重要。基于这一洞察，我们提出了EffiR框架，该框架旨在开发高效的检索器，通过从粗到细的策略（先减少深度，再减少宽度），结合针对检索任务的微调，来实现大规模的多层感知器压缩。在多种BEIR数据集和大语言模型基础模型中，EffiR能够在保持全尺寸模型性能的同时，显著减小模型规模和推理成本。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Lightweight LLM Agent Memory with Small Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于小型语言模型的轻量级大语言模型代理内存系统
papers.authors: Jiaquan Zhang, Chaoning Zhang, Shuxu Chen, Zhenzhen Huang, Pengcheng Zheng, Zhicheng Wang, Ping Guo, Fan Mo, Sung-Ho Bae, Jie Zou, Jiwei Wei, Yang Yang
papers.abstract: Although LLM agents can leverage tools for complex tasks, they still need memory to maintain cross-turn consistency and accumulate reusable information in long-horizon interactions. However, retrieval-based external memory systems incur low online overhead but suffer from unstable accuracy due to limited query construction and candidate filtering. In contrast, many systems use repeated large-model calls for online memory operations, improving accuracy but accumulating latency over long interactions. We propose LightMem, a lightweight memory system for better agent memory driven by Small Language Models (SLMs). LightMem modularizes memory retrieval, writing, and long-term consolidation, and separates online processing from offline consolidation to enable efficient memory invocation under bounded compute. We organize memory into short-term memory (STM) for immediate conversational context, mid-term memory (MTM) for reusable interaction summaries, and long-term memory (LTM) for consolidated knowledge, and uses user identifiers to support independent retrieval and incremental maintenance in multi-user settings. Online, LightMem operates under a fixed retrieval budget and selects memories via a two-stage procedure: vector-based coarse retrieval followed by semantic consistency re-ranking. Offline, it abstracts reusable interaction evidence and incrementally integrates it into LTM. Experiments show consistent gains across model scales, with an average F1 improvement of about 2.5 over A-MEM on LoCoMo, while achieving higher efficiency and low median latency (83 ms for retrieval and 581 ms end-to-end).
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型代理可以利用各种工具来完成复杂任务，但它们仍然需要内存来保持交互过程中的一致性，并在长期互动中积累可重复使用的信息。然而，基于检索的外部内存系统虽然在线开销较低，但由于查询构建和候选筛选的限制，其准确性并不稳定。相比之下，许多系统通过多次调用大模型来实现在线内存操作，这可以提高准确性，但也会在长时间的交互过程中增加延迟。我们提出了LightMem这一轻量级内存系统，它由小型语言模型驱动，旨在提升代理的内存管理能力。LightMem将内存检索、写入和长期存储功能模块化，并将在线处理与离线存储分离，从而在有限的计算资源下实现高效的内存调用。我们将内存分为短期记忆（STM）用于即时对话上下文、中期记忆（MTM）用于可重复使用的互动总结，以及长期记忆（LTM）用于整合的知识存储。同时，我们使用用户标识符来支持多用户环境下的独立检索和增量维护。在线上运行时，LightMem根据固定的检索预算进行内存选择，采用两阶段流程：首先进行基于向量的粗略检索，然后基于语义一致性进行重新排序。在离线状态下，它将可重复使用的互动证据抽象出来，并逐步将其整合到长期记忆中。实验表明，无论模型规模如何，LightMem都能带来稳定的性能提升，在LoCoMo数据集上的平均F1分数提高了约2.5，同时实现了更高的效率和更低的中值延迟（检索时间为83毫秒，端到端交互时间为581毫秒）。

papers.title: HeteroSpec: Leveraging Contextual Heterogeneity for Efficient Speculative Decoding
papers.title_zh: HeteroSpec：利用上下文的异质性实现高效的推测性解码
papers.authors: Siran Liu, Yang Ye, Qianchao Zhu, Zane Cao, Yongchao He
papers.abstract: Autoregressive decoding inherently limits the inference throughput of Large Language Model (LLM) due to its sequential dependency. Speculative decoding mitigates this by verifying multiple predicted tokens in parallel, but its efficiency remains constrained by what we identify as verification heterogeneity—the uneven difficulty of verifying different speculative candidates. In practice, a small subset of high-confidence predictions accounts for most successful verifications, yet existing methods treat all candidates uniformly, leading to redundant computation. We present HeteroSpec, a heterogeneity-adaptive speculative decoding framework that allocates verification effort in proportion to candidate uncertainty. HeteroSpec estimates verification complexity using a lightweight entropy-based quantifier, partitions candidates via a data-driven stratification policy, and dynamically tunes speculative depth and pruning thresholds through coordinated optimization. Across five benchmarks and four LLMs, HeteroSpec delivers an average 4.24× decoding speedup over state-of-the-art methods such as EAGLE-3, while preserving exact output distributions. Crucially, HeteroSpec requires no model retraining and remains compatible with other inference optimizations, making it a practical direction for improving speculative decoding efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 自回归解码由于其顺序依赖性，本质上限制了大语言模型（LLM）的推理吞吐量。推测解码通过并行验证多个预测结果来缓解这个问题，但其效率仍然受到“验证异质性”的影响——即不同候选结果的验证难度不均。实际上，只有一小部分高置信度的预测结果能够成功验证，而现有方法却对所有候选结果一视同仁，导致计算资源被浪费。我们提出了HeteroSpec这一自适应异质性的推测解码框架，它根据候选结果的不确定性比例分配验证资源。HeteroSpec利用轻量级的基于熵的量化工具估算验证复杂度，通过数据驱动的分层策略对候选结果进行划分，并通过协调优化动态调整推测深度和剪枝阈值。在五个基准测试和四个LLM中，HeteroSpec的平均解码速度比最先进的方法如EAGLE-3快4.24倍，同时还能保持精确的输出分布。重要的是，HeteroSpec不需要重新训练模型，并且与其他推理优化方案兼容，因此它是提高推测解码效率的一种实用方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Model of the Language Process
papers.title_zh: 语言处理模型
papers.authors: Brandon Duderstadt, Hayden Helm
papers.abstract: Language is a process that changes over time as new vocabulary emerges, word meanings shift, and narratives progress. Despite this fact, most Large Language Models are trained on corpora that lack explicit temporal information, which inhibits their ability to model the language process. In this work, we introduce the Temporal Language Model 1 (TLM-1), a BERT style transformer encoder that models that language process by jointly learning to predict document contents and classify document publication dates. We also introduce a Bayesian framework for querying TLM-1 that disentangles its temporal dynamics from several sources of anachronism. Using this query framework, we demonstrate that TLM-1 effectively surfaces several sociolinguistic trends in contemporary American English and accurately detects semantic changes in word meanings. Furthermore, we perform a mechanistic analysis of TLM-1’s time token embeddings, and find that they learn a curve whose geometry recovers the ordinal progression of time. We take the existence of this curve as evidence that TLM-1 is effectively learning to reconstruct temporal language dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言是一个随时间变化的过程，随着新词汇的出现、词义的变迁以及叙事的发展而不断演变。尽管如此，大多数大语言模型都是在缺乏明确时间信息的语料库上进行的训练，这限制了它们对语言过程进行建模的能力。在这项研究中，我们提出了时间语言模型1（TLM-1），这是一种BERT风格的变换器编码器，它通过联合学习预测文档内容和对文档发布日期进行分类来模拟语言过程。我们还引入了一种贝叶斯查询框架，该框架能够将其时间动态与多种导致年代错误的因素分离开来。利用这种查询框架，我们发现TLM-1能够有效地揭示当代美国英语中的若干社会语言学趋势，并且能够准确识别词汇意义的语义变化。此外，我们对TLM-1的时间标记嵌入进行了机制分析，发现它们学习到的曲线几何结构反映了时间的顺序进程。我们认为这条曲线的存在证明了TLM-1确实在有效地学习如何重建时间上的语言动态。

papers.title: Rethinking Table Pruning in TableQA: From Sequential Revisions to Gold Trajectory-Supervised Parallel Search
papers.title_zh: 重新思考TableQA中的表修剪问题：从顺序修订方式转变为基于黄金轨迹的并行搜索方法
papers.authors: Yu Guo, Shenghao Ye, Shuangwu Chen, Zijian Wen, Tao Zhang, Bai Qirui, Dong Jin, Yunpeng Hou, Huasen He, Jianyang, Xiaobin Tan
papers.abstract: Table Question Answering (TableQA) benefits significantly from table pruning, which extracts compact sub-tables by eliminating redundant cells to streamline downstream reasoning. However, existing pruning methods typically rely on sequential revisions driven by unreliable critique signals, often failing to detect the loss of answer-critical data. To address this limitation, we propose TabTrim, a novel table pruning framework which transforms table pruning from sequential revisions to gold trajectory-supervised parallel search. TabTrim derives a gold pruning trajectory using the intermediate sub-tables in the execution process of gold SQL queries, and trains a pruner and a verifier to make the step-wise pruning result align with the gold pruning trajectory. During inference, TabTrim performs parallel search to explore multiple candidate pruning trajectories and identify the optimal sub-table. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TabTrim achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse tabular reasoning tasks: TabTrim-8B reaches 73.5% average accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 3.2%, including 79.4% on WikiTQ and 61.2% on TableBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格问答（TableQA）在表格剪枝方面具有显著优势。通过消除冗余单元格来提取紧凑的子表格，可以简化后续的推理过程。然而，现有的剪枝方法通常依赖于不可靠的评判信号进行顺序性修改，常常无法检测到对答案至关重要的数据的丢失。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了TabTrim这一创新的表格剪枝框架。该框架将表格剪枝从顺序性修改转变为基于黄金轨迹的并行搜索。TabTrim利用黄金SQL查询执行过程中的中间子表格来生成黄金剪枝轨迹，并训练剪枝器和验证器，使逐步剪枝的结果与黄金剪枝轨迹保持一致。在推理过程中，TabTrim通过并行搜索来探索多个候选剪枝轨迹，并找出最优的子表格。大量实验表明，TabTrim在多种表格推理任务中均取得了顶尖性能：TabTrim-8B的平均准确率达到了73.5%，比最强的基线模型高出3.2%；在WikiTQ上的准确率为79.4%，在TableBench上的准确率为61.2%。

papers.title: Interleaved Tool-Call Reasoning for Protein Function Understanding
papers.title_zh: 用于蛋白质功能理解的交错式工具调用推理方法
papers.authors: Chuanliu Fan, Zicheng Ma, Huanran Meng, Aijia Zhang, Wenjie Du, Jun Zhang, Ziqiang Cao, Guohong Fu
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have highlighted the effectiveness of chain-of-thought reasoning in symbolic domains such as mathematics and programming. However, our study shows that directly transferring such text-based reasoning paradigms to protein function understanding is ineffective: reinforcement learning mainly amplifies superficial keyword patterns while failing to introduce new biological knowledge, resulting in limited generalization. We argue that protein function prediction is a knowledge-intensive scientific task that fundamentally relies on external biological priors and computational tools rather than purely internal reasoning. To address this gap, we propose Protein Function Understanding Agent (PFUA), a tool-augmented protein reasoning agent that unifies problem decomposition, tool invocation, and grounded answer generation. Instead of relying on long unconstrained reasoning traces, PFUA integrates domain-specific tools to produce verifiable intermediate evidence. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that PFUA consistently outperforms text-only reasoning models with an average performance improvement of 103%. We believe PFUA has the potential to become a standard paradigm for agentic reasoning in knowledge-intensive life science domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在大语言模型领域取得的进展表明，链式思维推理在诸如数学和编程这样的符号领域中具有很高的有效性。然而，我们的研究表明，直接将这种基于文本的推理方式应用于蛋白质功能理解是无效的：强化学习主要只是放大了表面的关键词模式，而未能引入新的生物学知识，从而导致泛化能力有限。我们认为，蛋白质功能预测是一项需要大量知识的科学任务，它本质上依赖于外部生物学先验知识和计算工具，而非单纯的内部推理。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了蛋白质功能理解代理（Protein Function Understanding Agent，PFUA）这一工具辅助的蛋白质推理代理。该代理能够整合问题分解、工具调用以及基于实际数据的答案生成等功能。与依赖冗长的无约束推理过程不同，PFUA通过整合特定领域的工具来生成可验证的中间证据。在四个基准测试中的实验表明，PFUA的表现始终优于仅依赖文本推理的模型，平均性能提升了103%。我们相信，PFUA有潜力成为知识密集型生命科学领域中智能代理推理的标准范式。

papers.title: Among Us: Language of Conspiracy Theorists on Mainstream Reddit
papers.title_zh: 《我们之中：阴谋论者的语言》在主流红迪网上的讨论
papers.authors: Francesco Corso, Giuseppe Russo, Francesco Pierri, Gianmarco De Francisci Morales
papers.abstract: The interaction between fringe subcultures and mainstream online communities poses significant challenges for understanding discourse on social media.In this work, we investigate whether users active in conspiracy-focused communities exhibit detectable linguistic signatures when participating in general-interest spaces, such as news, humor, or hobbyist forums.We analyze a large-scale longitudinal dataset of over 500 million comments spanning 10 years of Reddit activity, examining the communication patterns of these users across diverse social contexts independent of the topics they discuss.We show that these users exhibit distinctive linguistic patterns that enable machine learning models to reliably distinguish them from the general population within individual communities (averaging 87% accuracy across more than 20 binary classification tasks).Crucially, no single aggregate model captures these patterns across communities, as community-specific models outperform global classifiers by up to 17 percentage points.This result suggests that while these users are distinct, their linguistic expression is dynamic and highly responsive to the social norms of the environment they inhabit. Our findings suggest the need for tailored interventions in online spaces, as linguistic signals associated with conspiracy and fringe subcultures vary across communities and cannot be effectively addressed by uniform detection or moderation strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 边缘亚文化和主流在线社区之间的互动，给理解社交媒体上的话语交流带来了重大挑战。在这项研究中，我们探讨了活跃在阴谋论相关社区的用户，在参与一般兴趣领域的内容时，例如新闻、幽默或爱好论坛时，是否表现出可识别的语言特征。我们分析了一个大规模的纵向数据集，包含5亿条评论，这些评论涵盖了Reddit平台10年的活动情况。我们研究了这些用户在不同社交环境中的沟通模式，而不考虑他们讨论的主题。结果表明，这些用户表现出独特的语言特征，这使得机器学习模型能够可靠地将他们与普通人群区分开来（在20多种二元分类任务中，准确率达到了87%）。重要的是，没有任何一个统一的模型能够捕捉到这些跨社区的语言特征，因为针对特定社区的模型在性能上比全局分类器高出多达17个百分点。这一结果表明，虽然这些用户具有独特性，但他们的语言表达是动态的，并且非常容易受到所处环境的社会规范的影响。我们的研究提示，需要在在线空间中采取有针对性的干预措施，因为与阴谋论和边缘亚文化相关的语言信号在不同社区之间存在差异，而统一的检测或管理策略无法有效应对这些问题。

papers.title: HybridKV: Hybrid KV Cache Compression for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model Inference
papers.title_zh: 混合KV：一种用于高效多模态大语言模型推理的混合KV缓存压缩技术
papers.authors: Bowen Zeng, Feiyang Ren, Jun Zhang, Xiaoling Gu, Ke Chen, Lidan Shou, Huan Li
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced unified reasoning over text, images, and videos, but their inference is hindered by the rapid growth of key–value (KV) caches. Each visual input expands into thousands of tokens, causing caches to scale linearly with context length and remain resident in GPU memory throughout decoding, which leads to prohibitive memory overhead and latency even on high-end GPUs. A common solution is to compress caches under a fixed allocated budget at different granularities: token-level uniformly discards less important tokens, layer-level varies retention across layers, and head-level redistributes budgets across heads. Yet these approaches stop at allocation and overlook the heterogeneous behaviors of attention heads that require distinct compression strategies. We propose HybridKV, a hybrid KV cache compression framework that integrates complementary strategies in three stages: heads are first classified into static or dynamic types using text-centric attention; then a top-down budget allocation scheme hierarchically assigns KV budgets; finally, static heads are compressed by text-prior pruning and dynamic heads by chunk-wise retrieval. Experiments on 11 multimodal benchmarks with Qwen2.5-VL-7B show that HybridKV reduces KV cache memory by up to 7.9\times and achieves 1.52\times faster decoding, with almost no performance drop or even higher relative to the full-cache MLLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在文本、图像和视频的统一推理方面取得了显著进展，但其推理效率受到键值缓存快速增长的限制。每个视觉输入都会扩展成数千个标记，导致缓存随着上下文长度线性增长，并且在整个解码过程中始终驻留在GPU内存中。这会在高端GPU上造成巨大的内存开销和延迟问题。常见的解决方案是在有限的预算下对不同粒度进行缓存压缩：在标记级别，会丢弃不太重要的标记；在层级别，不同层的保留策略会有所不同；在头部级别，则需要对各个头部进行预算分配的调整。然而，这些方法仅停留在分配层面，没有考虑到注意力头的异质行为，这些注意力头需要不同的压缩策略。我们提出了HybridKV这一混合键值缓存压缩框架，该框架通过三个阶段整合了多种压缩策略：首先，根据以文本为中心的注意力机制将头部分为静态或动态类型；然后，采用自上而下的预算分配方案来分配键值缓存；最后，对静态头部进行文本先验修剪的压缩处理，对动态头部则采用分块检索的方式进行处理。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型上的11个多模态基准测试表明，HybridKV能够将键值缓存内存减少多达7.9倍，同时实现1.52倍更快的解码速度，且性能下降几乎为零，甚至比全缓存大语言模型还要优越。

papers.title: Breaking Down and Building Up: Mixture of Skill-Based Vision-and-Language Navigation Agents
papers.title_zh: 分解与重构：基于技能的视觉与语言导航智能体的结合方式
papers.authors: Tianyi Ma, Yue Zhang, Zehao Wang, Parisa Kordjamshidi
papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) poses significant challenges for agents to interpret natural language instructions and navigate complex 3D environments. While recent progress has been driven by large-scale pre-training and data augmentation, current methods still struggle to generalize to unseen scenarios, particularly when complex spatial and temporal reasoning is required. In this work, we propose SkillNav, a modular framework that introduces structured, skill-based reasoning into Transformer-based VLN agents. Our method decomposes navigation into a set of interpretable atomic skills (e.g., Vertical Movement, Area and Region Identification, Stop and Pause), each handled by a specialized agent. To support targeted skill training without manual data annotation, we construct a synthetic dataset pipeline that generates diverse, linguistically natural, skill-specific instruction-trajectory pairs. We then introduce a novel training-free Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based router, which dynamically selects the most suitable agent at each time step by aligning sub-goals with visual observations and previous actions. SkillNav obtains competitive results on commonly used benchmarks and establishes state-of-the-art generalization to the GSA-R2R, a benchmark with novel instruction styles and unseen environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉与语言导航（VLN）给智能体理解自然语言指令和导航复杂的3D环境带来了巨大挑战。虽然近年来通过大规模预训练和数据增强取得了一些进展，但当前的方法在泛化到未见过的场景时仍然存在困难，尤其是在需要复杂的空间和时间推理时。在这项研究中，我们提出了SkillNav这一模块化框架，该框架将结构化、基于技能的推理方式引入基于Transformer的VLN智能体中。我们的方法将导航任务分解为一系列可解释的原子技能（例如，垂直移动、区域识别、停止和暂停），每个技能都由专门的智能体负责处理。为了支持无需手动数据标注的目标技能训练，我们构建了一个合成数据集生成流程，能够生成多样化、符合语言自然规律的、特定于技能的指令-轨迹对。此外，我们还提出了一种新型的免训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）驱动的导航器，该导航器通过将对子目标与视觉观测结果以及之前的动作进行对齐，从而在每个时间步骤中动态选择最合适的智能体。SkillNav在常用的基准测试上取得了有竞争力的成绩，并且能够在GSA-R2R这种具有新颖指令风格和未见环境的基准测试中实现最先进的泛化能力。

papers.title: Bridging Distance and Spectral Positional Encodings via Anchor-Based Diffusion Geometry Approximation
papers.title_zh: 基于锚点扩散几何近似的方法：桥接距离与光谱位置编码
papers.authors: Yan Zimo, Zheng Xie, Runfan Duan, Chang Liu, Wumei Du
papers.abstract: Molecular graph learning benefits from positional signals that capture both local neighborhoods and global topology. Two widely used families are spectral encodings derived from Laplacian or diffusion operators and anchor-based distance encodings built from shortest-path information, but the relationship between them is still not well understood. In this paper, we study when anchor-based distance encodings can approximate diffusion geometry. Under a random r-regular graph model, we derive an explicit trilateration map that reconstructs truncated diffusion coordinates from transformed anchor distances and anchor spectral positions, together with pointwise and Frobenius-gap guarantees. On DrugBank with a shared GNP-based DDI backbone, anchor-distance Nyström accurately recovers diffusion geometry, and both DE and LapPE outperform models without positional encodings, with LapPE showing slightly more consistent performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 分子图学习能够利用捕捉局部邻域和全局拓扑的位置信号。两种常用的编码方法分别是基于拉普拉斯算子或扩散算子的谱编码，以及基于最短路径信息的锚点距离编码。不过，这两种编码方式之间的关系目前仍不甚明了。在本文中，我们研究了锚点距离编码何时能够近似扩散几何结构。在随机r-正则图模型下，我们推导出了一种显式的三边映射方法，该方法可以通过变换后的锚点距离和锚点谱位置来重建截断的扩散坐标，同时还能保证逐点性和Frobenius间隙的可靠性。在DrugBank数据集中，当使用基于GNP的DDI框架时，锚点距离Nyström编码能够准确恢复扩散几何结构。与没有位置编码的模型相比，锚点距离编码和LapPE编码都表现更为出色，其中LapPE的性能更为稳定。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Goal Without a Plan Is Just a Wish: Efficient and Effective Global Planner Training for Long-Horizon Agent Tasks
papers.title_zh: 没有计划的目标只是愿望：面向长时程智能体任务的高效全局规划器训练
papers.authors: Shuzheng Si, Haozhe Zhao, Kangyang Luo, Gang Chen, Fanchao Qi, Minjia Zhang, Baobao Chang, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Agents based on large language models (LLMs) struggle with brainless trial-and-error and generating hallucinatory actions due to a lack of global planning in long-horizon tasks. In this paper, we introduce a plan-and-execute framework and propose EAGLET, an efficient and effective planner training method to enhance the executor agent’s planning abilities without human effort. Specifically, we train a plug-and-play global planner through a two-step process: we first synthesize high-quality plans from an advanced LLM using our proposed homologous consensus filtering strategy, and apply fine-tuning as a cold start. Moreover, we further improve the planner with a rule-based reinforcement learning stage using a novel executor capability gain reward, ensuring it can handle task instructions of varying difficulty. Experiments on three long-horizon agent tasks show that executor agents equipped with our planner outperform existing methods, achieving new state-of-the-art performance. Meanwhile, EAGLET reduces training costs by 8× compared to RL-based baselines, and it does not require manual effort or extra training data, offering an efficient and effective solution.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体在缺乏全局规划能力的情况下，难以进行无脑的试错操作以及生成幻觉般的行动。在本文中，我们提出了一种计划与执行框架，并提出了EAGLET这一高效有效的规划方法，能够在不依赖人类干预的情况下提升执行智能体的规划能力。具体来说，我们通过两步流程来训练一个即插使用的全局规划器：首先，利用我们提出的同源共识过滤策略，从先进的LLM中合成高质量的规划方案；然后，通过微调来处理冷启动问题。此外，我们还通过基于规则的强化学习阶段来进一步改进规划器，利用新颖的执行器能力增益奖励机制，确保它能够处理不同难度的任务指令。在三项长期任务上的实验表明，配备了我们所提出的规划器的执行智能体表现优于现有方法，取得了新的最佳性能水平。同时，与基于强化学习的基线方法相比，EAGLET将训练成本降低了8倍，且无需人工干预或额外的训练数据，是一种高效有效的解决方案。

papers.title: Stereotype Bias in a Bilingual Setting: A Culturally Grounded Evaluation in Kazakhstan
papers.title_zh: 双语环境中的刻板印象偏见：在哈萨克斯坦进行的文化层面评估
papers.authors: Nurkhan Laiyk, Daniil Orel, Ayana Mussabayeva, Maiya Goloburda, Kamila Kuishibekova, Liya Goloburda, Diana Turmakhan, Preslav Nakov, Yuxia Wang, Fajri Koto
papers.abstract: Stereotype bias in language models has been widely examined in English, but remains largely understudied in bilingual contexts where multiple linguistic and cultural systems interact. This gap is especially important in regions where language use reflects complex historical and sociopolitical influences. In this work, we focus on Kazakhstan, a bilingual society where Kazakh, a low-resource Turkic language, and Russian, a high-resource Slavic language, are both actively used and frequently code-mixed in everyday communication. We introduce Aqbileq, a high-quality, human-verified dataset consisting of 5,634 stereotype-bearing statements in Kazakh, Russian, and code-mixed forms, covering six culturally salient domains. We evaluate both multilingual and Kazakh-specific language models using perplexity-based scoring and pretraining simulations, and find that stereotype bias is most pronounced in code-mixed inputs. Our results highlight the limitations of existing evaluation frameworks and emphasize the need for culturally grounded, linguistically inclusive benchmarks to better assess and mitigate bias in language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 在语言模型中，刻板印象偏见在英语中已经被广泛研究，但在双语环境中却仍然鲜有研究。在双语环境中，多种语言和文化体系相互交织，因此研究这一领域的偏见尤为重要。本研究以哈萨克斯坦为例，该国家语为哈萨克语，这是一种资源匮乏的突厥语系语言；而俄语则是资源丰富的斯拉夫语系语言。这两种语言在日常交流中都被广泛使用，并且经常混合使用。我们开发了Aqbileq数据集，这是一个高质量的数据集，由5,634条带有刻板印象的语句组成，这些语句以哈萨克语、俄语以及混合形式呈现，涵盖了六个具有文化意义的重要领域。我们通过基于困惑度的评分方法，对多语言模型和哈萨克语特定语言模型进行了评估。结果表明，在混合输入中，刻板印象偏见最为明显。我们的研究结果揭示了现有评估框架的局限性，并强调了需要建立基于文化的、涵盖多种语言的基准测试，以便更好地评估和减轻语言模型中的偏见。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Arguments that Alter Minds: LLM Rationales Sway Human (and LLM) Notions of Plausibility
papers.title_zh: 改变思维方式的论点：大型语言模型的推理方式影响着人类（以及大型语言模型）对合理性的认知
papers.authors: Shramay Palta, Peter A. Rankel, Sarah Wiegreffe, Rachel Rudinger
papers.abstract: We investigate the degree to which human (and LLM) plausibility judgments of multiple-choice commonsense benchmark answers are subject to influence by (im)plausibility arguments for or against an answer, in particular, using rationales generated by LLMs. We collect 3,000 plausibility judgments from humans and another 13,600 judgments from LLMs. Overall, we observe increases and decreases in mean human plausibility ratings in the presence of LLM-generated PRO and CON rationales, respectively, suggesting that, on the whole, human judges find these rationales convincing. Experiments with LLMs reveal similar patterns of influence. Our findings demonstrate a novel use of LLMs for studying aspects of human cognition, while also raising practical concerns that, even in domains where humans are “experts” (i.e., common sense), LLMs have the potential to exert considerable influence on people’s beliefs.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了人类（以及大语言模型）对多项选择常识性问题的判断，在多大程度上会受到支持或反对某个答案的合理性论证的影响。具体来说，我们利用了由大语言模型生成的理由来进行分析。我们从人类那里收集了3,000条关于这些问题的合理性判断，同时从大语言模型中获得了另外13,600条判断。总体而言，我们发现当存在大语言模型生成的支持和反对理由时，人类的合理性评分会出现上升或下降的情况，这表明总体而言，人类评判者认为这些理由具有说服力。对大语言模型的实验也揭示了类似的影响模式。我们的研究结果展示了一种利用大语言模型来研究人类认知方面的新方法，同时也提出了一些实际问题：即使在人类“专家”所在的领域（即常识领域），大语言模型也有可能对人们的信念产生重大影响。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GLARE: Agentic Reasoning for Legal Judgment Prediction
papers.title_zh: 闪光：用于法律判断预测的主动推理方法
papers.authors: Xinyu Yang, Chenlong Deng, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Legal judgment prediction serves as a pivotal task in intelligent judicial systems. Although large language models have achieved remarkable progress in general reasoning, they struggle with tasks that require fine-grained distinctions between similar charges. These models often select plausible charges directly without discriminating among closely related alternatives. In this paper, we introduce GLARE, an agentic legal reasoning framework that enables models to actively retrieve and apply external knowledge during decision-making. Unlike static prediction, GLARE simulates comparative reasoning by dynamically expanding the decision space to include confusing candidates, then retrieving exclusionary logic from precedents and statutes to identify the correct judgment. Experiments on real-world datasets show that our method significantly outperforms strong baselines, especially on complex cases involving confusing or rare charges. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GLARE-LJP-8EDF.
papers.abstract_zh: 法律判决预测是智能司法系统中的关键任务。尽管大语言模型在一般推理方面取得了显著进展，但在需要处理类似指控之间的细微差别时却存在困难。这些模型往往直接选择看似合理的指控，而不会区分那些密切相关的选项。在本文中，我们介绍了GLARE这一基于代理的法律推理框架，该框架使模型能够在决策过程中主动检索和应用外部知识。与静态预测不同，GLARE通过动态扩展决策空间来包含那些令人困惑的候选方案，然后从先例和法律法规中提取排除逻辑，以确定正确的判决。在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法明显优于强大的基线算法，尤其是在处理涉及复杂或罕见指控的案件时。代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GLARE-LJP-8EDF。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Vista-LLM: Decoupled Query-Guided Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Long-Video Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: Vista-LLM：基于查询引导的视觉令牌剪枝技术，用于高效的长视频大语言模型处理
papers.authors: Zhenyu Li, Zuchao Li, Ping Wang, Lefei Zhang, Haojun Ai
papers.abstract: Long-video understanding is bottlenecked by the high cost of processing massive visual tokens. Current reduction strategies often rely on static allocation or inefficient in-network selection that disrupts optimized attention kernels. In this paper, we introduce Vista-LLM, a decoupled framework for query-guided visual token pruning. By filtering redundancy prior to inference with minimal overhead, Vista-LLM ensures full compatibility with Flash Attention. Our method employs a coarse-to-fine pipeline: (1) Query-Guided Dynamic Budgeting for adaptive temporal allocation; (2) a lightweight Semantic Scout for fine-grained, query-specific selection; and (3) Structure-Aware Compensation to preserve global context. Extensive experiments on benchmarks like Video-MME and MLVU demonstrate a significantly improved Pareto frontier. Notably, on LLaVA-OneVision, Vista-LLM reduces visual tokens by 90% and accelerates inference while retaining over 98% of baseline performance on average, effectively filtering visual noise.
papers.abstract_zh: 长视频理解面临着处理大量视觉标记的高成本这一瓶颈问题。目前的减少冗余策略往往依赖于静态分配或低效的网内选择方式，这会破坏优化的注意力机制。在本文中，我们提出了Vista-LLM这一用于查询引导式视觉标记剪枝的解耦框架。通过在推理前进行冗余过滤，Vista-LLM能够以最小的开销实现与Flash Attention的完全兼容。我们的方法采用从粗到细的流程：(1) 基于查询的动态调整预算，以实现自适应时间分配；(2) 轻量级的语义筛选器，用于针对特定查询进行细致的选择；(3) 结构感知补偿机制，以保留全局上下文信息。在Video-MME和MLVU等基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Vista-LLM显著提升了性能水平。值得注意的是，在LLaVA-OneVision任务上，Vista-LLM能够将视觉标记减少90%，同时还能在保持超过98%的基线性能的同时加速推理过程，有效滤除了视觉噪声。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RoboFailRing: Retrieval-Augmented and Language Grounding Failure Detection for VLM-enabled Robotic Manipulation
papers.title_zh: RoboFailRing：基于检索增强机制与语言感知的机器人操控故障检测技术，适用于支持虚拟逻辑模块的系统
papers.authors: Chenduo Ying, Linkang Du, Yuanchao Shu, Peng Cheng
papers.abstract: Reliable failure detection and causal reasoning are critical in robotic manipulation, as their absence risks robot damage and endangers human safety.Although recent Vision–Language Models (VLMs) are employed to attempt failure detection and causality reasoning, they typically make retrospective assessment only after task completion, and their reasoning accuracy is often limited.To address these issues, we introduce RoboFailRing, which enables timely failure detection during task execution and enhances the reasoning accuracy of VLMs.It achieves rapid failure detection by retrieving a pre-constructed failure memory and returning a similarity-based decision.In addition, by providing grounded failure report to VLMs, it improves the accuracy of their reasoning about the failure causes and repair strategies.We evaluate RoboFailRing on two large-scale simulated datasets comprising over 6,000 failure trajectories and covering 81 distinct manipulation tasks.The results show that the average success rate of out-of-distribution failure detection reaches 80%, while the mean detection time is cut to roughly 50% of the baseline.Moreover, evaluations on real-world systems show an average 35% gain in VLM failure-reasoning accuracy.We make our code publicly available at: https://github.com/DynamicPoet/RoboFailRing.
papers.abstract_zh: 可靠的故障检测与因果推理在机器人操控中至关重要，因为缺乏这些功能可能会导致机器人受损，进而威胁到人类安全。虽然最近出现了基于视觉和语言的模型（Vision-Language Models，VLMs），它们可以尝试进行故障检测和因果推理，但这些模型通常只在任务完成后才进行回顾性评估，其推理准确性往往受到限制。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了RoboFailRing这一方案。该方案能够在任务执行过程中实时进行故障检测，并提高VLMs的推理准确性。它通过检索预先构建的故障记忆来快速进行故障检测，并基于相似性做出决策。此外，通过向VLMs提供有根据的故障报告，可以提高它们对故障原因和修复策略的推理准确性。我们在两个大规模模拟数据集上进行了RoboFailRing的评估，这两个数据集包含超过6000条故障轨迹，涵盖了81种不同的操控任务。结果表明，非分布型故障检测的平均成功率达到了80%，而平均检测时间则减少了约50%。此外，在真实系统上的评估显示，VLM的故障推理准确性平均提高了35%。我们的代码可以在以下链接下载：https://github.com/DynamicPoet/RoboFailRing。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Scaling Law for Multimodal Large Language Model Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 多模态大型语言模型监督微调的缩放定律
papers.authors: YiFan Zhang, Tao Yu, Feng Li, Chaoyou Fu, Yibo Hu, Kun Wang, Qingsong Wen, Zhang Zhang, Liang Wang, Rong Jin
papers.abstract: The supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage is crucial for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet a comprehensive scaling law to guide the optimal model-data configuration remains lacking. In this paper, we make an initial attempt to address this gap. First, we theoretically demonstrate that directly computing the optimal computation frontier for MLLM-SFT, as we can for traditional LLMs, is a challenging task. This complexity arises because MLLM-SFT is influenced by a broader range of factors, including model size, LLM pre-training tokens, and MLLM SFT tokens. To tackle this issue, we propose two scaling laws based on LLM paradigms: one applicable when training data volumes are well defined by researchers, and another for cases where models are sourced from open communities with unknown training data. Through theoretical modeling and approximations, we provide researchers with valuable recommendations for optimal resource allocation. Furthermore, we establish a strong correlation ( R^2 = 0.98) between training loss and downstream performance, enabling accurate performance estimation without the need for exhaustive benchmarking. To validate our scaling laws, we construct a testbed of 60 models ranging from 50 million to 8 billion parameters, totaling 1,560 checkpoints. Each checkpoint is evaluated on than 10 MLLM benchmarks, ensuring robust fitting of our formulations.
papers.abstract_zh: 监督式微调（SFT）阶段对于多模态大语言模型来说至关重要，然而，目前仍缺乏一个全面的扩展规律来指导最优的模型-数据配置。在本文中，我们首次尝试解决这一问题。首先，我们从理论上证明了直接计算出大语言模型SFT的最优计算边界是一项具有挑战性的任务，就像我们对传统大语言模型所做的那样。这种复杂性源于大语言模型SFT受到多种因素的影响，包括模型规模、大语言模型的预训练令牌数以及大语言模型SFT的令牌数。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了两种基于大语言模型范式的扩展规律：一种适用于研究人员能够明确定义训练数据量的情况；另一种则适用于那些模型来自开放社区且训练数据未知的情况。通过理论建模和近似计算，我们为研究人员提供了关于最优资源分配的有价值建议。此外，我们还发现了训练损失与下游性能之间存在很强的相关性（R²=0.98），这使得无需进行详尽的基准测试就能准确评估性能。为了验证我们的扩展规律，我们构建了一个包含60个模型的测试平台，这些模型的参数数量从5000万到80亿不等，总共有1560个检查点。每个检查点都在10多个大语言模型基准测试上进行了评估，从而确保了我们的公式能够很好地适应各种情况。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CrochetBench: Can Vision-Language Models Move from Describing to Doing in Crochet Domain?
papers.title_zh: CrochetBench：在钩针编织领域，视觉语言模型能否从描述层面过渡到实际操作层面呢？
papers.authors: Peiyu Li, Xiaobao Huang, Ting Hua, Nitesh V Chawla
papers.abstract: While multimodal large language models can describe visual content, their ability to generate executable procedures remains underexplored. CrochetBench presented in this paper evaluates this shift from describing to doing through fine-grained procedural reasoning in crochet: models must recognize stitches, select structurally appropriate instructions, and generate compilable procedures. We adopt the CrochetPARADE DSL as our intermediate representation, enabling structural validation and functional evaluation via execution. The benchmark covers tasks including stitch classification, instruction grounding, and both natural language and image-to-DSL translation. Across all tasks, performance sharply decreases as the evaluation shifts from surface-level similarity to executable correctness, revealing limitations in long-range symbolic reasoning and 3D-aware procedural synthesis. Our proposed CrochetBench offers a new lens for assessing procedural competence in multimodal models and highlights the gap between surface-level understanding and executable precision in real-world creative domains. Code is available at https://github.com/Peiyu-Georgia-Li/crochetBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型能够描述视觉内容，但它们生成可执行程序的能力却尚未得到充分探索。本文中的CrochetBench项目通过精细化的编织程序推理来评估从描述到执行的转变：模型需要识别编织针法、选择结构合理的指令，并生成可编译的程序。我们采用CrochetPARADE DSL作为中间表示形式，从而实现结构验证和通过执行来评估功能性能。该基准测试涵盖了针法分类、指令定位以及自然语言与图像到DSL翻译等任务。在所有任务中，当评估从表面相似性转向可执行正确性时，性能会显著下降，这揭示了长程符号推理和三维感知程序合成方面的局限性。我们提出的CrochetBench为评估多模态模型的程序能力提供了新的视角，并凸显了现实世界创意领域中表面理解能力与可执行精度之间的差距。代码可在https://github.com/Peiyu-Georgia-Li/crochetBench获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DORA: A Dual-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Effective and Efficient Multimodal Agentic Search
papers.title_zh: DORA：一种具有双重目标的强化学习框架，旨在实现高效且有效的多模态智能体搜索
papers.authors: Guangming Qin, Yuhao Deng, Yukun Zhao, Zhenyang Li, Junfeng Wang, Dawei Yin, Ye Yuan, Guoren Wang, Yizhou Yan, Chengliang Chai, Lei Cao
papers.abstract: The most recent research uses reinforcement learning (RL) to post-train Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) such that these models are able to iteratively call search engines to dynamically access external knowledge when handling complex Visual Question Answering (VQA) tasks. However, existing methods face two major limitations in effectiveness and efficiency: i) For effectiveness, the objective of these methods, which only considers the correctness of the generated final response, overlooks the quality of intermediate search results, thus leading to suboptimal search strategies. ii) For efficiency, existing methods often unnecessarily invoke search calls during reasoning, making the inference inefficient. To address these issues, we propose , a customized dual-objective reinforcement learning framework to improve the search strategies of MLLMs, enhancing their search quality yet minimizing search frequency. The key ideas include (1) a reward function that promotes correct reasoning trajectories with fewer search calls; and (2) dual optimization objectives that jointly optimize search quality and answer correctness. Extensive experiments on 3 real-world datasets demonstrate that DORA outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving up to 8.4% higher accuracy while reducing the number of search calls by 9.7%.
papers.abstract_zh: 最新的研究采用强化学习技术对多模态大语言模型进行后训练，使得这些模型能够在处理复杂的视觉问答任务时，通过迭代调用搜索引擎来动态获取外部知识。然而，现有的方法在效率和效果方面存在两个主要问题：第一，这些方法仅关注生成的最终答案的正确性，而忽略了中间搜索结果的质量，从而导致搜索策略不够优化。第二，现有方法在推理过程中经常不必要的调用搜索引擎，导致推理过程效率低下。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种定制的双目标强化学习框架，旨在改善多模态大语言模型的搜索策略，提高搜索质量的同时减少搜索频率。该框架的核心思想包括：1）设计一个奖励函数，以促使模型采用较少的搜索次数来实现正确的推理路径；2）设置双重优化目标，同时优化搜索质量和答案的正确性。在三个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，DORA在准确性和减少搜索次数方面均优于现有最先进的方法，其准确率提高了8.4%，而搜索次数则减少了9.7%。

papers.title: IUQ: Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification for Long-Form Large Language Model Generation
papers.title_zh: IUQ：用于长文本大型语言模型生成的疑问性不确定性量化方法
papers.authors: Haozhi Fan, Jinhao Duan, Kaidi Xu
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), uncertainty quantification in LLM generation is a persistent challenge. Although recent approaches have achieved strong performance by restricting LLMs to produce short or constrained answer sets, many real-world applications require long-form and free-form text generation. A key difficulty in this setting is that LLMs often produce responses that are semantically coherent yet factually inaccurate, while the underlying semantics are multifaceted and the linguistic structure is complex. To tackle this challenge, this paper introduces Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification (IUQ), a novel framework that leverages inter-sample consistency and intra-sample faithfulness to quantify the uncertainty in long-form LLM outputs. By utilizing an interrogate-then-respond paradigm, our method provides reliable measures of claim-level uncertainty and the model’s faithfulness. Experimental results across diverse model families and model sizes demonstrate the superior performance of IUQ over two widely used long-form generation datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）取得了快速的进展，但在LLM生成过程中对不确定性的量化仍然是一个持续的挑战。虽然最近的一些方法通过限制LLM生成简短或有限的答案来取得良好的性能，但许多现实世界的应用却需要长篇幅和自由形式的文本生成。在这种情况下，一个主要的困难是LLM往往能够生成在语义上连贯但实际上不准确的内容，而背后的语义结构非常复杂。为了应对这一挑战，本文提出了一种名为“疑问不确定性量化”的新框架。该框架利用样本间的一致性和样本内的一致性来量化长篇幅LLM输出的不确定性。通过采用“先提问再回答”的范式，我们的方法能够可靠地衡量不确定性以及模型的可靠性。在不同模型家族和不同模型规模下的实验结果表明，与两种广泛使用的长篇幅生成数据集相比，IUQ具有更出色的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CODESTRUCT: Code Agents over Structured Action Spaces
papers.title_zh: CODESTRUCT：在结构化动作空间上的代码代理
papers.authors: Myeongsoo Kim, Chao-Chun Hsu, Dingmin Wang, Shweta Garg, Varun Kumar, Murali Krishna Ramanathan
papers.abstract: LLM-based code agents treat repositories as unstructured text, applying edits through brittle string matching that frequently fails due to formatting drift or ambiguous patterns. We propose reframing the codebase as a structured action space where agents operate on named AST entities rather than text spans. Our framework, CodeStruct, provides readCode for retrieving complete syntactic units and editCode for applying syntax-validated transformations to semantic program elements. Evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified across six LLMs, CodeStruct improves Pass@1 accuracy by 1.2-5.0% while reducing token consumption by 12-38% for most models. Models that frequently fail to produce valid patches under text-based interfaces benefit most: GPT-5-nano improves by 20.8% as empty-patch failures drop from 46.6% to 7.2%. On CodeAssistBench, we observe consistent accuracy gains (+0.8-4.4%) with cost reductions up to 33%. Our results show that structure-aware interfaces offer a more reliable foundation for code agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的代码代理将代码库视为非结构化文本，通过不稳定的字符串匹配来执行编辑操作，但由于格式差异或模式模糊，这种匹配方式经常失败。我们提出将代码库重新定义为一个结构化的动作空间，代理在命名的数据结构实体上进行操作，而不是处理文本片段。我们的框架CodeStruct提供了readCode功能，用于检索完整的句法单元；以及editCode功能，用于对语义程序元素进行语法验证后的转换。在SWE-Bench验证集上进行的测试表明，在大多数LLM模型中，CodeStruct能够将Pass@1的准确率提高1.2%到5.0%，同时减少12%到38%的令牌消耗。那些在基于文本的接口下经常无法生成有效补丁的模型受益最大：GPT-5-nano的准确率提高了20.8%，而空补丁错误的比例则从46.6%降至7.2%。在CodeAssistBench上，我们观察到准确率持续提升（+0.8%到4.4%），同时成本降低了33%。我们的结果表明，具有结构感知的接口为代码代理提供了更可靠的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Answering the Wrong Question: Reasoning Trace Inversion for Abstention in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 回答错误的问题：用于大型语言模型中“回避行为”推理的推理轨迹反转方法
papers.authors: Abinitha Gourabathina, Inkit Padhi, Manish Nagireddy, Subhajit Chaudhury, Prasanna Sattigeri
papers.abstract: For Large Language Models (LLMs) to be reliably deployed, models must effectively know when not to answer: abstain. Reasoning models, in particular, have gained attention for impressive performance on complex tasks. However, reasoning models have been shown to have worse abstention abilities. Taking the vulnerabilities of reasoning models into account, we propose our Query Misalignment Framework. Hallucinations resulting in failed abstention can be reinterpreted as LLMs answering the wrong question (rather than answering a question incorrectly). Based on this framework, we develop a new class of state-of-the-art abstention methods called Trace Inversion. First, we generate the reasoning trace of a model. Based on only the trace, we then reconstruct the most likely query that the model responded to. Finally, we compare the initial query with the reconstructed query. Low similarity score between the initial query and reconstructed query suggests that the model likely answered the question incorrectly and is flagged to abstain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Trace Inversion effectively boosts abstention performance in four frontier LLMs across nine abstention QA datasets, beating competitive baselines in 33 out of 36 settings. The code is available at this https://anonymous.4open.science/r/trace-inversion-08BB/.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了可靠地部署大语言模型（LLM），模型必须能够有效地判断何时不应回答问题——即采取“回避”策略。尤其是推理模型，在复杂任务上的表现令人瞩目。然而，研究表明推理模型的回避能力相对较弱。考虑到推理模型的这些弱点，我们提出了“查询不一致框架”。导致回避失败的幻觉现象，可以被重新解释为LLM回答了错误的問題（而非错误地回答了问题）。基于这一框架，我们开发了一类新的先进回避方法，称为“追踪反转”。首先，我们生成模型的推理轨迹。仅基于该轨迹，我们可以重建模型最可能响应的查询。最后，我们将初始查询与重建的查询进行比较。如果初始查询与重建查询之间的相似度较低，则说明模型很可能错误地回答了问题，此时就会触发回避机制。大量实验表明，“追踪反转”方法能够在九个回避问答数据集上有效提升LLM的回避性能，在36种情况下中有33种情况下都优于同类基准算法。相关代码可访问：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/trace-inversion-08BB/
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Single-shot Writing: Deep Research Agents are Unreliable at Multi-turn Report Revision
papers.title_zh: 不仅仅是单次写作：深度研究型智能体在多轮报告修订方面并不可靠
papers.authors: Bingsen Chen, Boyan Li, Ping Nie, Yuyu Zhang, Xi Ye, Chen Zhao
papers.abstract: Existing benchmarks for Deep Research Agents (DRAs) treat report generation as a single-shot writing task, which fundamentally diverges from how human researchers iteratively draft and revise reports via self-reflection or peer feedback. Whether DRAs can reliably revise reports with user feedback remains unexplored. We introduce Mr Dre, an evaluation suite that establishes multi-turn report revision as a new axis. Mr Dre consists of (1) a unified long-form report evaluation protocol spanning comprehensiveness, factuality, and presentation, and (2) a human-verified feedback simulation pipeline for systematic multi-turn revision evaluation. Our analysis of five diverse DRAs reveals a critical limitation: while agents can address most user feedback, they also regress on 16–27% of previously covered content and citation quality. Over multiple revision turns, even the best-performing agents leave significant headroom, as they continue to disrupt content outside the feedback’s scope and fail to preserve earlier edits. We further show that these issues are not easily resolvable through inference-time fixes such as prompt engineering and a dedicated sub-agent for revision.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前针对深度研究智能体的评估标准将报告生成视为一次性写作任务，这与人类研究人员通过自我反思或同行反馈来反复起草和修改报告的流程截然不同。目前尚不清楚深度研究智能体是否能够借助用户反馈来可靠地修改报告。我们提出了Mr Dre这一评估工具，它将多轮次报告修改作为新的评估维度。Mr Dre包含两部分内容：(1)一个涵盖完整性、事实准确性以及呈现方式的多形式报告评估协议；(2)一个经过人工验证的反馈模拟流程，用于系统性的多轮次修改评估。我们对五种不同深度研究智能体的分析发现了一个关键问题：虽然智能体能够处理大部分用户反馈，但它们在16%到27%的内容以及引用质量方面仍然存在问题。在多次修改过程中，即使表现最好的智能体也仍有很大的改进空间，因为它们会继续修改超出反馈范围的内容，同时无法保留之前的编辑成果。我们还发现，这些问题并不容易通过推理时的调整来解决，比如调整提示词或者专门负责修改的子智能体。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FinCall-Surprise: A Large Scale Multi-modal Benchmark for Earning Surprise Prediction
papers.title_zh: FinCall-Surprise：一种大规模的多模态基准测试，用于预测惊喜体验的产生
papers.authors: Dong Shu, Yanguang Liu, Huopu Zhang, Mengnan Du
papers.abstract: Predicting corporate earnings surprises is a profitable yet challenging task, as accurate forecasts can inform significant investment decisions. However, progress in this domain has been constrained by a reliance on expensive, proprietary, and text-only data, limiting the development of advanced models. To address this gap, we introduce FinCall-Surprise (Financial Conference Call for Earning Surprise Prediction), the first large-scale, open-source, and multi-modal dataset for earnings surprise prediction. Comprising 2,688 unique corporate conference calls from 2019 to 2021, our dataset features word-to-word conference call textual transcripts, full audio recordings, and corresponding presentation slides. We establish a comprehensive benchmark by evaluating 26 state-of-the-art unimodal and multi-modal LLMs. Our findings reveal that (1) while many models achieve high accuracy, this performance is often an illusion caused by significant class imbalance in the real-world data. (2) Some specialized financial models demonstrate unexpected weaknesses in instruction-following and language generation. (3) Although incorporating audio and visual modalities provides some performance gains, current models still struggle to leverage these signals effectively. These results highlight critical limitations in the financial reasoning capabilities of existing LLMs and establish a challenging new baseline for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 预测企业盈利的惊喜情况是一项既具有盈利潜力又充满挑战的任务，因为准确的预测能够为重要的投资决策提供重要信息。然而，这一领域的进展一直受到依赖昂贵、专有且仅包含文本数据的限制，这阻碍了先进模型的开发。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了FinCall-Surprise——首个大规模、开源且包含多种模态的数据集，用于预测盈利惊喜。我们的数据集包含了2019年至2021年间共2,688次企业电话会议记录，这些记录包括电话会议的文字记录、完整的音频录音以及相应的演示幻灯片。我们通过评估26种先进的单模态和多模态大语言模型，建立了一个全面的基准测试。研究发现：(1)虽然许多模型取得了较高的准确率，但这种表现往往是由于现实数据中的类别不平衡所导致的错觉。(2)一些专门的金融模型在指令遵循和语言生成方面表现出意想不到的弱点。(3)尽管结合音频和视觉模态可以提高性能，但当前模型仍然难以有效利用这些信号。这些结果揭示了现有大语言模型在金融推理能力方面的关键局限性，并为未来的研究确立了一个新的挑战性基准。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ALDEN: Reinforcement Learning for Active Navigation and Evidence Gathering in Long Documents
papers.title_zh: 阿尔登：用于主动导航和长文档信息收集的强化学习技术
papers.authors: Tianyu Yang, Terry Ruas, Yijun Tian, Jan Philip Wahle, Daniel Kurzawe, Bela Gipp
papers.abstract: While Vision–language models (VLMs) interpret text-rich images effectively, they struggle with reasoning across long, multi-page documents. We present \textbf{A}ctive \mathbf{L}ong \mathbf{D}ocum\mathbf{E}nt \mathbf{N}avigation (ALDEN), a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that fine-tunes VLMs as interactive agents capable of actively navigating long, visually rich documents rather than passive readers. ALDEN features a novel fetch action that allows direct page indexing, complementing the classic \textbf{search} action and better exploiting document structure. To ensure training efficiency and stability, we introduce a rule-based cross-level reward for dense supervision and a visual-semantic anchoring mechanism utilizing dual-path KL-divergence constraints. We train ALDEN on a curated corpus built from open-source datasets where trivial samples are filtered, and queries are rewritten to incentivize multi-turn navigation and fetch usage. Empirically, ALDEN achieves state-of-the-art results on five long-document benchmarks, offering a more accurate and efficient path for long-document understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然视觉-语言模型能够有效处理富含文本的图像，但在处理长篇多页文档时却存在困难。我们提出了一种名为**主动长文档导航**（ALDEN）的多轮强化学习框架。该框架能够训练出能够主动导航长篇视觉丰富文档的视觉-语言模型，而非仅仅作为被动的阅读器。ALDEN具有一种新颖的“获取”动作，可以直接对页面进行索引，从而补充传统的“搜索”动作，并更好地利用文档结构。为了确保训练的效率和稳定性，我们引入了基于规则的跨层次奖励机制，用于提供密集的监督信息；同时采用了视觉-语义锚定机制，利用双路径KL散度约束来实现更准确的文档理解。我们在从开源数据集中筛选出的经过精心挑选的数据集上训练了ALDEN模型，通过重新设计查询方式，激励模型进行多轮导航和获取操作。实验结果表明，ALDEN在五个长文档评估任务中取得了领先的成绩，为长文档的理解提供了更准确、更高效的途径。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Reinforced Informativeness Optimization for Long-Form Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 增强信息性优化技术在长文本检索增强生成中的应用
papers.authors: Yuhao Wang, Ruiyang Ren, Yucheng Wang, Xin Zhao, Jing Liu, Hua Wu, Haifeng Wang
papers.abstract: Long-form question answering (LFQA) requires open-ended long-form responses that synthesize coherent, factually grounded content from multi-source evidence. This makes reinforcement learning (RL) reward design critical. The reward must be verifiable for faithful grounding and stable optimization. However, many standard rewards assume a unique target with an exact-match notion of correctness, which fits short-form QA and math but breaks in LFQA. As a result, current RAG systems still lack verifiable reward mechanisms, yielding unstable feedback signals and suboptimal optimization outcomes. We propose RioRAG, a framework for reinforced verifiable informativeness optimization. First, it defines informativeness as a measurable and externally verifiable objective for RL. Second, RioRAG uses nugget-centric verification with cross-source checks to enable self-evolution of smaller LLMs and to provide denser, action-discriminative rewards that mitigate reward sparsity and stabilize optimization. This formulation avoids handcrafted supervision for the policy model and strong teacher-model distillation, relying instead on externally verifiable feedback. Experiments on LongFact and RAGChecker show that RioRAG achieves higher factual recall and faithfulness, establishing verifiable reward modeling as a foundation for trustworthy long-form RAG. Our codes are available at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/RioRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 长格式问题回答（LFQA）需要生成开放式的长文本回答，这些回答能够从多种来源的信息中整合出连贯且基于事实的内容。因此，强化学习（RL）的奖励设计至关重要。奖励必须能够被验证，以确保内容的真实性和优化的稳定性。然而，许多标准奖励机制都假设存在一个唯一的目标，并且要求答案必须完全匹配，这种要求适用于短格式问答和数学问题，但在长格式问答中并不适用。因此，目前的RAG系统仍然缺乏可验证的奖励机制，导致反馈信号不稳定，优化效果也不理想。我们提出了RioRAG框架，它是一种用于实现可验证信息量优化的强化学习方法。首先，它将信息量定义为一个可测量且可由外部验证的目标。其次，RioRAG采用以关键知识点为中心的验证方式，并结合跨源验证，从而让较小的LLM能够自我进化，同时提供更密集、更具行动导向性的奖励，从而缓解奖励稀疏性问题并稳定优化过程。这种方案避免了为策略模型手动设计监督机制以及依赖强教师模型的蒸馏，而是依靠可验证的外部反馈来实现优化。在LongFact和RAGChecker上的实验表明，RioRAG能够实现更高的事实召回率和准确性，从而将可验证的奖励建模作为构建可信长格式RAG的基础。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/RUCAIBox/RioRAG下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Android Coach: Improve Online Agentic Training Efficiency with Single State Multiple Actions
papers.title_zh: Android Coach：通过单状态多动作提高智能体在线训练效率
papers.authors: Guo Gan, Yuxuan Ding, Cong Chen, Yuwei Ren, Yin Huang, Hong Zhou
papers.abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) serves as an effective method for enhancing the capabilities of Android agents. However, guiding agents to learn through online interaction is prohibitively expensive due to the high latency of emulators and the sample inefficiency of existing RL algorithms. We identify a fundamental limitation in current approaches: the Single State Single Action paradigm, which updates the policy with one-to-one state-action pairs from online one-way rollouts without fully exploring each costly emulator state. In this paper, we propose Android Coach, a novel framework that shifts the training paradigm to Single State Multiple Actions, allowing the agent to sample and utilize multiple actions for a single online state. We enable this without additional emulator overhead by learning a critic that estimates action values. To ensure the critic serves as a reliable coach, we integrate a process reward model and introduce a group-wise advantage estimator based on the averaged critic outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of Android Coach: it achieves 7.5% and 8.3% success rate improvements on AndroidLab and AndroidWorld over UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and attains 1.4x higher training efficiency than Single State Single Action methods PPO and GRPO at matched success rates.
papers.abstract_zh: 在线强化学习是一种有效的提升Android智能体能力的手段。然而，通过在线交互来引导智能体学习的过程却面临着巨大的挑战，因为模拟器的延迟较高，且现有强化学习算法的采样效率也较低。我们发现当前方法存在一个根本性的缺陷：单状态单动作范式，这种范式仅通过一对一的状态-动作对来更新策略，而并未充分探索每个昂贵的模拟器状态。在本文中，我们提出了Android Coach这一新型框架，它改变了训练范式，采用单状态多动作方式，使智能体能够在单个在线状态下尝试多种动作。我们通过学习一个能够估算动作价值的评估器来实现这一点，从而无需额外的模拟器开销。为了确保评估器能发挥可靠的指导作用，我们整合了过程奖励模型，并引入了基于平均评估器输出的群体优势估计器。大量的实验证明了Android Coach的有效性和高效性：在AndroidLab和AndroidWorld上的成功率分别提升了7.5%和8.3%，而其训练效率则是单状态单动作方法PPO和GRPO的1.4倍，且成功率相当。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Inside Out: Evolving User-Centric Core Memory Trees for Long-Term Personalized Dialogue Systems
papers.title_zh: 内景：为长期个性化对话系统而发展的以用户为中心的核心记忆树架构
papers.authors: Jihao Zhao, Ding Chen, Zhaoxin Fan, Kerun Xu, Mengting Hu, Bo Tang, Feiyu Xiong, Zhiyu li
papers.abstract: Existing long-term personalized dialogue systems struggle to reconcile unbounded interaction streams with finite context constraints, often succumbing to memory noise accumulation, reasoning degradation, and persona inconsistency. To address these challenges, this paper proposes Inside Out, a framework that utilizes a globally maintained PersonaTree as the carrier of long-term user profiling. By constraining the trunk with an initial schema and updating the branches and leaves, PersonaTree enables controllable growth, achieving memory compression while preserving consistency. Moreover, we train a lightweight MemListener via reinforcement learning with process-based rewards to produce structured, executable, and interpretable ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, NO_OP operations, thereby supporting the dynamic evolution of the personalized tree. During response generation, PersonaTree is directly leveraged to enhance outputs in latency-sensitive scenarios; when users require more details, the agentic mode is triggered to introduce details on-demand under the constraints of the PersonaTree. Experiments show that PersonaTree outperforms full-text concatenation and various personalized memory systems in suppressing contextual noise and maintaining persona consistency. Notably, the small MemListener model achieves memory-operation decision performance comparable to, or even surpassing, powerful reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1-0528 and Gemini-3-Pro.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的长期个性化对话系统难以在无限的交互流与有限的上下文限制之间取得平衡，常常面临记忆噪声积累、推理能力下降以及角色不一致性的问题。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了Inside Out框架。该框架利用一个全局维护的PersonaTree作为长期用户属性的存储载体。通过用初始模式约束树的根节点，并不断更新分支和叶子节点，PersonaTree能够实现可控的增长，同时实现记忆压缩并保持一致性。此外，我们通过强化学习训练了一个轻量级的MemListener模型，该模型基于流程进行奖励机制，从而生成结构化、可执行且可解释的ADD、UPDATE、DELETE、NO_OP操作，进而支持个性化树的动态演化。在响应生成过程中，PersonaTree可以直接用于提升延迟敏感场景下的输出质量；当用户需要更多细节时，可以触发代理模式，在PersonaTree的限制下按需引入详细信息。实验表明，PersonaTree在抑制上下文噪声和保持角色一致性方面优于全文串联技术和各种个性化记忆系统。值得注意的是，小型的MemListener模型在记忆操作决策性能上已经达到了与DeepSeek-R1-0528和Gemini-3-Pro等强大推理模型相当甚至更优的水平。

papers.title: FinChart-Bench: Benchmarking Financial Chart Comprehension in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: FinChart-Bench：针对视觉-语言模型进行金融图表理解能力的基准测试
papers.authors: Dong Shu, Haoyang Yuan, Yuchen Wang, Yanguang Liu, Huopu Zhang, Mengnan Du
papers.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have made significant progress in chart understanding. However, financial charts, characterized by complex temporal structures and domain-specific terminology, remain notably underexplored. We introduce FinChart-Bench, the first benchmark specifically focused on real-world financial charts. FinChart-Bench comprises 1,200 financial chart images collected from 2015 to 2024, each annotated with True/False (TF), Multiple Choice (MC), and Question Answering (QA) questions, totaling 7,016 questions. We conducted a comprehensive evaluation of 26 state-of-the-art LVLMs on FinChart-Bench. Our evaluation reveals critical insights: (1) the performance gap between open-source and closed-source models is narrowing, (2) performance degradation occurs in upgraded models within families, (3) many models struggle with instruction following, (4) both advanced models show significant limitations in spatial reasoning abilities, and (5) current LVLMs are not reliable enough to serve as automated evaluators. These findings highlight important limitations in current LVLM capabilities for financial chart understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型在图表理解方面取得了显著进展。然而，以复杂的时间结构及特定领域术语为特征的金融图表仍然没有得到充分研究。我们推出了FinChart-Bench这一首个专门针对现实世界金融图表的基准测试。FinChart-Bench包含了从2015年到2024年间收集到的1,200张金融图表图像，每张图像都附有真/假问题、选择题和问答题，共计7,016道题目。我们对26个最先进的视觉语言模型在FinChart-Bench上的表现进行了全面评估。我们的评估揭示了以下重要发现：(1)开源模型与闭源模型之间的性能差距正在缩小；(2)升级后的模型在同一系列中会出现性能下降现象；(3)许多模型在遵循指令方面存在困难；(4)一些高级模型在空间推理能力方面存在明显局限；(5)当前的视觉语言模型还不足以作为自动评估工具。这些发现凸显了当前视觉语言模型在金融图表理解方面的关键局限性。

papers.title: From Charts to Code: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Multimodal Models
papers.title_zh: 从图表到代码：一种用于多模态模型的层次化评估方法
papers.authors: Jiahao Tang, Henry Hengyuan Zhao, Lijian Wu, Zijian Zhang, Yifei Tao, Dongxing Mao, Yang Wan, Jingru Tan, Min Zeng, Min Li, Alex Jinpeng Wang
papers.abstract: We introduce Chart2Code, a new benchmark for evaluating the natural language to chart code generation capabilities of large multimodal models (LMMs). Chart2Code is explicitly designed from a user-driven perspective, capturing diverse real-world scenarios and progressively increasing task difficulty. It consists of three levels: Level 1 (Chart Reproduction) reproduces charts from a reference figure and user query; Level 2 (Chart Editing) involves complex modifications such as changing chart types or adding elements; and Level 3 (Long-Table to Chart Generation) requires models to transform long, unprocessed tables into faithful charts following user instructions. To our knowledge, this is the first hierarchical benchmark that reflects practical chart2code usage while systematically scaling task complexity. In total, Chart2Code contains 2,186 tasks across 22 chart types, paired with multi-level evaluation metrics that assess both code correctness and the visual fidelity of rendered charts. We benchmark 29 state-of-the-art (SoTA) LMMs, including both proprietary and the latest open-source models such as GPT-5.2, Qwen3-VL, InternVL3/3.5, MiMo-VL, and Seed-1.6-VL. Experimental results demonstrate that even the SoTA model GPT-5.2 averages 72.21 on code-based evaluation and only 33.41 on chart-quality assessment across the editing tasks, underscoring the difficulty of Chart2Code. We anticipate this benchmark will drive advances in multimodal reasoning and foster the development of more robust and general-purpose LMMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了Chart2Code这一新的基准测试，用于评估大型多模态模型在将自然语言转换为图表代码生成方面的能力。Chart2Code是专门为用户需求而设计的，能够应对各种现实场景，并且任务难度会逐渐增加。该基准测试包含三个级别：第一级（图表复制）要求模型根据参考图样和用户指令来生成图表；第二级（图表编辑）涉及对图表的复杂修改，如改变图表类型或添加元素；第三级（从长表格到图表生成）则要求模型根据用户指令将长文本表格转化为忠实于原始数据的图表。据我们所知，这是第一个既反映实际使用场景又能系统性地提升任务难度的分层基准测试。总体而言，Chart2Code包含了22种图表的2,186个任务，同时配备了多层次评估指标，以衡量代码的准确性和图表的视觉逼真度。我们对29个最先进的LMM模型进行了测试，其中包括一些专有模型和最新的开源模型，如GPT-5.2、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3/3.5、MiMo-VL和Seed-1.6-VL。实验结果表明，即使是最先进的模型GPT-5.2，在基于代码的评估中平均得分仅为72.21，而在图表质量评估中则只有33.41分，这充分说明了Chart2Code的难度。我们预计，这一基准测试将有助于推动多模态推理领域的发展，并促进更强大、更通用的LMM模型的开发。

papers.title: Learning While Staying Curious: Entropy-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning via Adaptive Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 在保持好奇心的同时学习：通过自适应自蒸馏实现熵保持的 supervised 微调技术，适用于大型推理模型
papers.authors: Hao Wang, Hao Gu, Hongming Piao, Kaixiong Gong, Yuxiao Ye, Xiangyu Yue, Sirui Han, Yike Guo, Dapeng Wu
papers.abstract: The standard post-training recipe for large reasoning models, supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning (SFT-then-RL), may limit the benefits of the RL stage: while SFT imitates expert demonstrations, it often causes overconfidence and reduces generation diversity, leaving RL with a narrowed solution space to explore. Adding entropy regularization during SFT is not a cure-all; it tends to flatten token distributions toward uniformity, increasing entropy without improving meaningful exploration capability. In this paper, we propose CurioSFT, an entropy-preserving SFT method designed to enhance exploration capabilities through intrinsic curiosity. It consists of (a) Self-Exploratory Distillation, which distills the model toward a self-generated, temperature-scaled teacher to encourage exploration within its capability; and (b) Entropy-Guided Temperature Selection, which adaptively adjusts distillation strength to mitigate knowledge forgetting by amplifying exploration at reasoning tokens while stabilizing factual tokens. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks demonstrate that, in SFT stage, CurioSFT outperforms the vanilla SFT by 2.5 points on in-distribution tasks and 2.9 points on out-of-distribution tasks. We also verify that exploration capabilities preserved during SFT successfully translate into concrete gains in RL stage, yielding an average improvement of 5.0 points. Code is available at https://github.com/HaoooWang/CurioSFT.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于大型推理模型来说，标准的后训练方案——先进行有监督的微调，然后再进行强化学习——可能会限制强化学习阶段的效益。因为微调方式会模仿专家的操作，这往往会导致过度自信，并降低生成的多样性，使得强化学习阶段的探索空间变得狭窄。在微调过程中添加熵正则化并不能解决所有问题；它往往会使令牌分布趋于均匀，从而增加熵值，但并不会提升有意义的探索能力。在本文中，我们提出了CurioSFT这一熵保持型微调方法，该方法旨在通过内在的好奇心来增强探索能力。CurioSFT包含两个部分：(a) 自我探索蒸馏，该部分将模型蒸馏为自生成的、带有温度调节的教师模型，以鼓励模型在其能力范围内进行探索；(b) 熵引导的温度选择，该部分自适应地调整蒸馏强度，通过增强推理令牌的探索来减轻知识遗忘问题，同时稳定事实令牌的权重。在数学推理任务上的大量实验表明，在微调阶段，CurioSFT在分布内任务上的表现比普通微调高出2.5分，在分布外任务上的表现则高出2.9分。我们还验证了，在微调过程中保留的探索能力确实转化为强化学习阶段的实际收益，平均提升了5.0分。相关代码可访问https://github.com/HaoooWang/CurioSFT。

papers.title: Toward Consistent World Models with Multi-Token Prediction and Latent Semantic Enhancement
papers.title_zh: 基于多标记预测和潜在语义增强的一致世界模型
papers.authors: Qimin Zhong, Hao Liao, Haiming Qin, Mingyang Zhou, Rui Mao, Wei Chen, Naipeng Chao
papers.abstract: Whether Large Language Models (LLMs) develop coherent internal world models remains a core debate. While conventional Next-Token Prediction (NTP) focuses on one-step-ahead supervision, Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has shown promise in learning more structured representations. In this work, we provide a theoretical perspective analyzing the gradient inductive bias of MTP, supported by empirical evidence, showing that MTP promotes the convergence toward internal belief states by inducing representational contractivity via gradient coupling. However, we reveal that standard MTP often suffers from structural hallucinations, where discrete token supervision encourages illegal shortcuts in latent space that violate environmental constraints. To address this, we propose a novel method Latent Semantic Enhancement MTP (LSE-MTP), which anchors predictions to ground-truth hidden state trajectories. Experiments on synthetic graphs and real-world Manhattan Taxi Ride show that LSE-MTP effectively bridges the gap between discrete tokens and continuous state representations, enhancing representation alignment, reducing structural hallucinations, and improving robustness to perturbations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型是否能够构建出连贯的内部世界模型，仍然是一个核心争议点。传统的下一个词元预测方法主要关注一步之前的监督信息，而多词元预测方法则在学习更结构化的表示方面表现出潜力。在这项研究中，我们从一个理论角度分析了多词元预测的梯度归纳偏差现象，并通过实证数据支持了我们的观点：多词元预测通过梯度耦合机制诱导表示层面的收敛性，从而促进了内部信念状态的形成。然而，我们发现标准的多词元预测方法常常会出现结构性幻觉问题，即离散词元的监督会促使模型在潜在空间中采取不合法的捷径，从而违反环境约束。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的方法——潜在语义增强多词元预测方法。该方法将预测结果与真实的隐藏状态轨迹相结合，从而有效弥合了离散词元与连续状态表示之间的差距，提升了表示的一致性，减少了结构性幻觉，并增强了模型对干扰的鲁棒性。在合成图结构和真实世界的曼哈顿出租车驾驶场景中的实验表明，潜在语义增强多词元预测方法确实取得了显著的效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SpiderFlow: Efficient Topology-Aware Scheduling for LLM Training Across Decentralized GPU Clusters
papers.title_zh: SpiderFlow：一种高效的、基于拓扑结构的训练调度方案，适用于分散式GPU集群中的大型语言模型训练任务
papers.authors: Zihan Chang, Shuibing He, Bo Zhou, Sheng Xiao, Siling Yang, Rui Wang, Zhe Pan
papers.abstract: In response to the increasing demand for largescale machine learning training jobs, many organizations have deployed GPU clusters across geographically distributed regions. However, existing ILP- or genetic-based cross-cluster training approaches largely overlook the topology of decentralized clusters, lacking both topologyaware task scheduling mechanisms and automated model parallelization strategies. As a result, naively applying these optimization-based methods in cross-cluster settings leads to prohibitive scheduling overhead, due to the drastically enlarged search space induced by complex inter-cluster topologies. To address these challenges, we propose SpiderFlow, a topologyaware scheduling system specifically designed for decentralized GPU clusters. We formulate cross-cluster task scheduling as a graph optimization problem and introduce SpinSearch, a low-overhead topology-aware scheduling algorithm. In addition, for automated model parallelization, we propose TPA, a two-level scheduling framework that combines heuristic methods at the inter-cluster level with ILP-based optimization within clusters, effectively reducing the search space while maintaining high training throughput with substantially lower scheduling overhead. We evaluate SpiderFlow on a physical platform comprising 8 decentralized clusters, as well as on a simulation platform with up to 64 decentralized clusters. Experimental results demonstrate that SpiderFlow reduces job completion time (JCT) by 1.2-1.3×, improves throughput by 1.12-1.25×, and reduces scheduling overhead by 20-90× on average compared to state-of-the-art scheduling systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 面对对大规模机器学习训练岗位需求的不断增加，许多组织已经在地理分布广泛的区域部署了GPU集群。然而，现有的基于ILP或遗传算法的跨集群训练方法在很大程度上忽略了去中心化集群的拓扑结构，缺乏基于拓扑结构的任务调度机制以及自动化的模型并行化策略。因此，在跨集群环境中简单应用这些优化方法会导致过高的调度开销，因为复杂的集群间拓扑结构会极大地扩大搜索空间。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SpiderFlow——一个专为去中心化GPU集群设计的基于拓扑结构的调度系统。我们将跨集群任务调度问题转化为图优化问题，并引入了SpinSearch这一低开销的基于拓扑结构的调度算法。此外，为了实现自动化的模型并行化，我们提出了TPA这一两级调度框架，它结合了集群间的启发式方法和集群内的ILP优化技术，有效减少了搜索空间，同时保持了较高的训练吞吐量，并且大大降低了调度开销。我们在包含8个去中心化集群的物理平台上进行了SpiderFlow的测试，同时在包含多达64个去中心化集群的仿真平台上也进行了测试。实验结果表明，与最先进的调度系统相比，SpiderFlow平均可以将任务完成时间减少1.2-1.3倍，吞吐量提高1.12-1.25倍，同时调度开销降低20-90倍。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Unleashing Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models via Textual Representation Guided Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 通过文本表示引导推理，激发多模态大语言模型中的空间推理能力
papers.authors: Jiacheng Hua, Yishu Yin, Yuhang Wu, Tai Wang, Yifei Huang, Miao Liu
papers.abstract: Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with 3D spatial reasoning, as they fail to construct structured abstractions of the 3D environment depicted in video inputs. To bridge this gap, drawing inspiration from cognitive theories of allocentric spatial reasoning, we investigate how to enable MLLMs to model and reason over text-based spatial representations of video. Specifically, we introduce Textual Representation of Allocentric Context from Egocentric Video (TRACE), a prompting method that induces MLLMs to generate text-based representations of 3D environments as intermediate reasoning traces for more accurate spatial question answering. TRACE encodes meta-context, camera trajectories, and detailed object entities to support structured spatial reasoning over egocentric videos. Extensive experiments on VSI-Bench and OST-Bench demonstrate that TRACE yields notable and consistent improvements over prior prompting strategies across a diverse range of MLLM backbones, spanning different parameter scales and training schemas. We further present ablation studies to validate our design choices, along with detailed analyses that probe the bottlenecks of 3D spatial reasoning in MLLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的多模态大语言模型在三维空间推理方面存在困难，因为它们无法构建视频输入中所示三维环境的结构化抽象表示。为了弥补这一不足，我们借鉴了认知理论中关于以自我为中心的空间推理机制，研究如何使大语言模型能够模拟和推理基于文本的三维环境表示。具体来说，我们提出了一种名为“从以自我为中心的视频中提取以他为中心的环境文本表示”的方法，该方法促使大语言模型生成三维环境的文本表示，作为更精确的空间问答推理的中间步骤。TRACE方法通过编码元上下文、摄像机轨迹以及详细的物体实体信息，来支持对以自我为中心的视频进行结构化的空间推理。在VSI-Bench和OST-Bench上的大量实验表明，与以往的各种提示策略相比，TRACE方法在多种大语言模型框架上都能取得显著的改进，且这种改进在不同参数规模和训练方案下都保持一致。我们还进行了消融实验来验证我们的设计选择，并进行了详细分析，以探究大语言模型中三维空间推理的瓶颈问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
