papers.title: UniCorn: Towards Self-Improving Unified Multimodal Models through Self-Generated Supervision
papers.title_zh: UniCorn：通过自我生成的监督机制，实现自适应改进的统一多模态模型
papers.authors: Zhen Fang, Ruiyan Han, XinYu Sun, Yuchen Ma, Ziheng Wang, Yu Zeng, Zehui Chen, Lin Chen, Wenxuan Huang, Wei-Jie Xu, Yi Cao, Feng Zhao
papers.abstract: While Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) have achieved remarkable success in cross-modal comprehension, a significant gap persists in their ability to leverage such internal knowledge for high-quality generation. We formalize this discrepancy as Conduction Aphasia, a phenomenon where models accurately interpret multimodal inputs but struggle to translate that understanding into faithful and controllable synthesis. To address this, we propose UniCorn, a simple yet elegant self-improvement framework that eliminates the need for external data or teacher supervision. By partitioning a single UMM into three collaborative roles: Proposer, Solver, and Judge, UniCorn generates high-quality interactions via self-play and employs cognitive pattern reconstruction to distill latent understanding into explicit generative signals. To validate the restoration of multimodal coherence, we introduce UniCycle, a cycle-consistency benchmark based on a Text to Image to Text reconstruction loop. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniCorn achieves comprehensive and substantial improvements over the base model across six general image generation benchmarks. Notably, it achieves SOTA performance on TIIF(73.8), DPG(86.8), CompBench(88.5), and UniCycle while further delivering substantial gains of +5.0 on WISE and +6.5 on OneIG. These results highlight that our method significantly enhances T2I generation while maintaining robust comprehension, demonstrating the scalability of fully self-supervised refinement for unified multimodal intelligence.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然统一多模态模型在跨模态理解方面取得了显著成就，但在利用内部知识进行高质量生成方面仍存在明显不足。我们将这种差异定义为“传导性失语症”——即模型能够准确解析多模态输入，但难以将这种理解转化为可靠且可控的合成结果。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了UniCorn这一简单而高效的自我改进框架。该框架无需外部数据或教师监督，通过将单个统一多模态模型划分为三个协作角色：提议者、求解器和评判者，从而实现自玩式的高质量交互，并通过认知模式重构将潜在理解转化为明确的生成信号。为了验证多模态一致性的恢复效果，我们引入了UniCycle这一基于文本到图像再到文本重建循环的循环一致性基准测试。大量实验表明，UniCorn在六个通用图像生成基准测试中相较于基础模型实现了全面且显著的改进。值得注意的是，它在TIIF（73.8）、DPG（86.8）、CompBench（88.5）以及UniCycle任务上取得了顶尖性能，同时在WISE任务上实现了+5.0的显著提升，在OneIG任务上实现了+6.5的改进。这些结果表明，我们的方法在保持强大理解能力的同时，显著提升了T2I生成的效果，充分体现了完全自监督式优化在统一多模态智能领域中的可扩展性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Why Multimodal In-Context Learning Lags Behind? Unveiling the Inner Mechanisms and Bottlenecks
papers.title_zh: 为什么多模态情境学习机制存在滞后现象？揭示其内部机制和阻碍因素
papers.authors: Yu Wang, Sharon Li
papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables models to adapt to new tasks via inference-time demonstrations. Despite its success in large language models, the extension of ICL to multimodal settings remains poorly understood in terms of its internal mechanisms and how it differs from text-only ICL. In this work, we conduct a systematic analysis of ICL in multimodal large language models. Using identical task formulations across modalities, we show that multimodal ICL performs comparably to text-only ICL in zero-shot settings but degrades significantly under few-shot demonstrations. To understand this gap, we decompose multimodal ICL into task mapping construction and task mapping transfer, and analyze how models establish cross-modal task mappings, and transfer them to query samples across layers. Our analysis reveals that current models lack reasoning-level alignment between visual and textual representations, and fail to reliably transfer learned task mappings to queries. Guided by these findings, we further propose a simple inference-stage enhancement method that reinforces task mapping transfer. Our results provide new insights into the mechanisms and limitations of multimodal ICL and suggest directions for more effective multimodal adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）使得模型能够通过推理时的示范来适应新的任务。尽管它在大语言模型中取得了成功，但将ICL扩展到多模态环境方面，其内部机制以及它与纯文本ICL的区别仍不清楚。在这项研究中，我们对多模态大语言模型中的ICL进行了系统的分析。通过在不同模态中使用相同的任务表述方式，我们发现多模态ICL在零样本情况下的表现与纯文本ICL相当，但在少样本示范下表现显著下降。为了理解这一差距，我们将多模态ICL分解为任务映射构建和任务映射转移两个环节，并分析了模型如何建立跨模态任务映射，以及如何将这些映射转移到不同层级的查询样本上。我们的分析表明，当前模型在视觉和文本表示之间缺乏推理层面的对齐，也无法可靠地将学到的任务映射应用到查询中。基于这些发现，我们进一步提出了一种简单的推理阶段增强方法，以强化任务映射的转移效果。我们的研究结果为多模态ICL的机制和局限性提供了新的见解，并为更有效的多模态适应提供了方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Current Agents Fail to Leverage World Model as Tool for Foresight
papers.title_zh: 目前的代理人未能有效利用“世界模型”作为预测工具
papers.authors: Cheng Qian, Emre Can Acikgoz, Bingxuan Li, Xiusi Chen, Yuji Zhang, Bingxiang He, Qinyu Luo, Gokhan Tur, Dilek Hakkani-Tür, Yunzhu Li, Heng Ji
papers.abstract: Agents built on vision-language models increasingly face tasks that demand anticipating future states rather than relying on short-horizon reasoning. Generative world models offer a promising remedy: agents could use them as external simulators to foresee outcomes before acting. This paper empirically examines whether current agents can leverage such world models as tools to enhance their cognition. Across diverse agentic and visual question answering tasks, we observe that some agents rarely invoke simulation (fewer than 1%), frequently misuse predicted rollouts (approximately 15%), and often exhibit inconsistent or even degraded performance (up to 5%) when simulation is available or enforced. Attribution analysis further indicates that the primary bottleneck lies in the agents’ capacity to decide when to simulate, how to interpret predicted outcomes, and how to integrate foresight into downstream reasoning. These findings underscore the need for mechanisms that foster calibrated, strategic interaction with world models, paving the way toward more reliable anticipatory cognition in future agent systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于视语模型的智能体越来越多地面临需要预测未来状态的任务，而不是依赖短期推理。生成式世界模型为这一问题提供了有希望的解决方案：智能体可以将这些模型作为外部模拟器，在行动之前就能预见到结果。本文通过实证研究探讨了当前智能体是否能够将这种世界模型作为工具来提升其认知能力。在多种智能体和视觉问答任务中，我们发现有些智能体很少使用模拟机制（占比不到1%），经常误用预测结果（约15%），而当模拟机制可用或被强制使用时，它们的性能往往会出现不一致甚至下降的情况（最高达5%）。归因分析进一步表明，主要的瓶颈在于智能体能否判断何时使用模拟机制、如何解释预测结果，以及如何将预见性思维融入后续推理过程中。这些发现强调了需要建立一种能够与世界模型进行合理、有策略性交互的机制，从而为未来智能体系统的更可靠预测能力铺平道路。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Language Model as Planner and Formalizer under Constraints
papers.title_zh: 在约束条件下，语言模型充当规划器和形式化工具的角色
papers.authors: Cassie Huang, Stuti Mohan, Ziyi Yang, Stefanie Tellex, Li Zhang
papers.abstract: LLMs have been widely used in planning, either as planners to generate action sequences end-to-end, or as formalizers to represent the planning domain and problem in a formal language that can derive plans deterministically. However, both lines of work rely on standard benchmarks that include only generic and simplistic environmental specifications, leading to potential overestimation of the planning ability of LLMs and safety concerns in downstream tasks. We bridge this gap by augmenting widely used planning benchmarks with manually annotated, fine-grained, and rich natural language constraints spanning four formally defined categories. Over 4 state-of-the-art reasoning LLMs, 4 formal languages, and 4 datasets, we show that the introduction of one-sentence constraints consistently halves performance, indicating current LLMs’ lack of robustness and an avenue for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在规划领域得到了广泛应用，它们既可以作为生成连续动作序列的规划器，也可以作为用形式化语言描述规划领域和问题的工具，从而能够确定性地推导出规划方案。然而，这两种方法都依赖于一些标准的基准测试，这些测试只包含通用且简单的环境描述，这可能会导致对大语言模型规划能力的过高估计，同时也会带来下游任务中的安全问题。我们通过为常用的规划基准测试添加经过手动注释的、细粒度且丰富的自然语言约束来弥补这一不足，这些约束涵盖了四个正式定义的分类。通过对4种先进的推理大语言模型、4种形式化语言和4个数据集进行实验，我们发现引入一句话约束后，模型的性能会显著降低一半，这表明当前的大语言模型缺乏鲁棒性，这为未来的研究提供了方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: HeLa-Mem: Hebbian Learning and Associative Memory for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: HeLa-Mem：用于大型语言模型智能体的赫布学习机制与关联记忆功能
papers.authors: Jinchang Zhu, Jindong Li, Cheng Zhang, Jiahong Liu, Menglin Yang
papers.abstract: Long-term memory is a critical challenge for Large Language Model agents, as fixed context windows cannot preserve coherence across extended interactions. Existing memory systems represent conversation history as unstructured embedding vectors, retrieving information through semantic similarity. This paradigm fails to capture the associative structure of human memory, wherein related experiences progressively strengthen interconnections through repeated co-activation. Inspired by cognitive neuroscience, we identify three mechanisms central to biological memory: association, consolidation, and spreading activation, which remain largely absent in current research. To bridge this gap, we propose HeLa-Mem, a bio-inspired memory architecture that models memory as a dynamic graph with Hebbian learning dynamics. HeLa-Mem employs a dual-level organization: (1) an episodic memory graph that evolves through co-activation patterns, and (2) a semantic memory store populated via Hebbian Distillation, wherein a Reflective Agent identifies densely connected memory hubs and distills them into structured, reusable semantic knowledge. This dual-path design leverages both semantic similarity and learned associations, mirroring the episodic-semantic distinction in human cognition. Experiments on LoCoMo demonstrate superior performance across four question categories while using significantly fewer context tokens. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/ReinerBRO/HeLa-Mem
papers.abstract_zh: 长期记忆是大语言模型代理面临的一个关键挑战，因为固定的上下文窗口无法在长时间的互动中保持信息的连贯性。现有的记忆系统将对话历史表示为非结构化的嵌入向量，通过语义相似性来检索信息。这种范式无法捕捉人类记忆的关联结构，即相关的经验通过反复的激活而逐渐加强彼此之间的联系。受认知神经科学的启发，我们发现了生物记忆的三个核心机制：关联、巩固和扩散激活，而这些机制在当前的研究中仍然缺乏。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了HeLa-Mem这一受生物启发的记忆架构，它将记忆建模为一个具有赫布学习机制的动态图。HeLa-Mem采用双层次的组织方式：(1)一个通过共同激活模式演变的情节记忆图；(2)一个通过赫布蒸馏填充的语义记忆存储库，其中反射性代理能够识别出密度较高的记忆节点，并将其提炼成结构化的、可复用的语义知识。这种双路径设计结合了语义相似性和习得的关联，反映了人类认知中的情节与语义之间的区别。在LoCoMo上的实验表明，该架构在四个问题类别上表现出更出色的性能，同时使用的上下文标记数量也显著减少。代码可在GitHub上获取：https://github.com/ReinerBRO/HeLa-Mem
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Locket: Robust Feature-Locking Technique for Language Models
papers.title_zh: 锁存器：一种用于语言模型的稳健特征锁定技术
papers.authors: Lipeng He, Vasisht Duddu, N. Asokan
papers.abstract: Chatbot service providers (e.g., OpenAI) rely on tiered subscription plans to generate revenue, offering black-box access to basic models for free users and advanced models to paying subscribers. However, this approach is unprofitable and inflexible. A pay-to-unlock scheme for premium features (e.g., math, coding) offers a more sustainable alternative. Enabling such a scheme requires a feature-locking technique (FLoTE) that is (i) effective in refusing locked features, (ii) utility-preserving for unlocked features, (iii) robust against evasion or unauthorized credential sharing, and (iv) scalable to multiple features and clients. Existing FLoTEs (e.g., password-locked models) fail to meet these criteria. To fill this gap, we present Locket, a more robust and scalable FLoTE to enable pay-to-unlock schemes. We develop a framework for adversarial training and merging of feature-locking adapters, which enables Locket to selectively disable specific features of a model. Evaluation shows that Locket is effective (100% refusal rate), utility-preserving (\leq 7% utility degradation), robust (\leq 5% attack success rate), and scalable to multiple features and clients.
papers.abstract_zh: 聊天机器人服务提供商（如OpenAI）依靠分层订阅计划来盈利，为免费用户提供基础模型的免费访问权限，而为付费订阅者提供高级模型。然而，这种方式并不经济且缺乏灵活性。采用“付费解锁”机制来获取高级功能（如数学计算、编程能力）则是一种更可持续的替代方案。要实现这一机制，需要一种特征锁定技术（FLoTE），该技术必须能够：(i) 有效阻止对锁定功能的访问；(ii) 在解锁功能时保持原有效用；(iii) 具备抵御逃避行为或未经授权的凭证共享的能力；(iv) 能够适用于多个功能和客户端。现有的FLoTE技术（如密码锁定的模型）无法满足这些要求。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Locket技术，这是一种更为强大且可扩展的FLoTE，能够实现“付费解锁”机制。我们开发了一种针对特征锁定适配器的对抗性训练与合并方法，使得Locket能够选择性地禁用模型的特定功能。评估结果显示，Locket技术效果显著（拒绝率高达100%），能保持功能效用不变（效用下降幅度不超过7%），具有强大的抗攻击能力（攻击成功率不超过5%），并且可以应用于多个功能和客户端。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can Factual Opinions Be Edited (Manipulated) in Large Language Models?
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型中，事实性观点是否可以被修改或操控？
papers.authors: Yuanpu Cao, Ziyi Yin, Fenglong Ma, Jinghui Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into various domains, making knowledge editing techniques crucial yet potentially hazardous. Current editing methods primarily target atomic facts, overlooking the significant risks associated with manipulating “factual opinions”, e.g., documented stances of public figures on societal issues. Such manipulation could reshape public images, influence elections, and alter societal views. To systematically assess this threat, we introduce the Factual Opinion Editing with Evidence (FOE) benchmark, which encompasses 261 public figures, 19 issue categories, and 2,178 complete opinion records. Our evaluations demonstrate that current editing techniques struggle significantly with factual opinions, often achieving only superficial changes while failing to preserve consistency between the edited opinion and the supporting evidence generated by the model. To address this limitation, we further propose a simple yet effective Self-Generated Evidence-Aligned method that achieves opinion–evidence alignment without relying on explicit instructions. Together, our benchmark and method provide a foundation for understanding the emerging security implications of factual opinion editing in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地应用于各个领域，这使得知识编辑技术变得至关重要，但同时也带来了潜在的风险。目前的编辑方法主要关注的是事实层面，而忽视了操纵“事实性观点”所带来的重大风险——例如，公众人物在社会问题上的立场记录。这种操纵行为可能会改变公众形象、影响选举结果，甚至改变社会的观念。为了系统地评估这一威胁，我们提出了“基于证据的事实性观点编辑”基准测试，该测试涵盖了261位公众人物、19个议题类别以及2,178条完整的观点记录。我们的评估结果显示，当前的编辑技术在处理事实性观点时存在显著困难，通常只能实现表面的修改，而无法保持编辑后的观点与模型生成的支持性证据之间的一致性。为了克服这一局限性，我们进一步提出了一种简单而有效的“自生成符合证据的方法”，该方法无需依赖明确的指令即可实现观点与证据之间的对齐。总的来说，我们的基准测试和方法是理解大语言模型中事实性观点编辑所带来安全威胁的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Language of Thought Shapes Output Diversity in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 思维语言决定了大型语言模型输出的多样性
papers.authors: Shaoyang Xu, Wenxuan Zhang
papers.abstract: Output diversity is crucial for Large Language Models as it underpins pluralism and creativity.In this work, we reveal that controlling the language used during model thinking—the language of thought—provides a novel and structural source of output diversity.Our preliminary study shows that different thinking languages occupy distinct regions in a model’s thinking space.Based on this observation, we study two repeated sampling strategies under multilingual thinking—Single-Language Sampling and Mixed-Language Sampling—and conduct diversity evaluation on outputs that are controlled to be in English, regardless of the thinking language used.Across extensive experiments, we demonstrate that switching the thinking language from English to non-English languages consistently increases output diversity, with a clear and consistent positive correlation such that languages farther from English in the thinking space yield larger gains.We further show that aggregating samples across multiple thinking languages yields additional improvements through compositional effects, and that scaling sampling with linguistic heterogeneity expands the model’s diversity ceiling.Finally, we show that these findings translate into practical benefits in pluralistic alignment scenarios, leading to broader coverage of cultural knowledge and value orientations in LLM outputs. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/Multilingual-LoT-Diversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 输出多样性对于大语言模型来说至关重要，因为它为多元化和创造性提供了基础。在这项研究中，我们发现控制模型思考过程中使用的语言——即思维语言——可以提供一种新颖且结构化的输出多样性来源。我们的初步研究表明，不同的思维语言在模型的思考空间中占据不同的区域。基于这一观察，我们研究了在多种语言思考下的两种重复采样策略——单语言采样和混合语言采样，并对那些被控制为使用英语输出的结果进行了多样性评估，而忽略所使用的思维语言。通过广泛的实验，我们证明将思维语言从英语切换到非英语语言能够持续增加输出多样性，并且这种相关性非常明显且一致，也就是说，在思考空间中距离英语越远的语言所带来的增益更大。我们还发现，将多个思维语言的样本进行聚合，可以通过组合效应带来额外的改进；而随着语言多样性的增加，模型的多样性上限也会得到扩展。最后，我们表明这些发现在实际的多元对齐场景中也能带来实际效益，从而让大语言模型的输出能够涵盖更广泛的文化知识和价值取向。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/Multilingual-LoT-Diversity上获取。

papers.title: Aligning Backchannel and Dialogue Context Representations via Contrastive LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 通过对比式大语言模型微调来实现回链与对话上下文表示的对齐
papers.authors: Livia Qian, Gabriel Skantze
papers.abstract: Backchannels (e.g., ‘yeah’, ‘mhm’, and ‘right’) are short, non-interruptive feedback signals whose lexical form and prosody jointly convey pragmatic meaning. While prior computational research has largely focused on predicting backchannel timing, the relationship between lexico-prosodic form and meaning remains underexplored. We propose a two-stage framework: first, fine-tuning large language models on dialogue transcripts to derive rich contextual representations; and second, learning a joint embedding space for dialogue contexts and backchannel realizations. We evaluate alignment with human perception via triadic similarity judgments (prosodic and cross-lexical) and a context–backchannel suitability task. Our results demonstrate that the learned projections substantially improve context-backchannel retrieval compared to previous methods. In addition, they reveal that backchannel form is highly sensitive to extended conversational context and that the learned embeddings align more closely with human judgments than raw WavLM features.
papers.abstract_zh: 回话信号（如“是的”、“嗯”和“对”）是简短且不打断对话的反馈信息，其词汇形式和语调共同传达了语用意义。虽然之前的计算研究主要集中在预测回话信号的时机上，但词汇-语调形式与意义之间的关系仍未被充分探索。我们提出了一种两阶段框架：首先，通过微调对话文本中的大语言模型来提取丰富的上下文表示；其次，学习一个用于对话上下文和回话信号实现的联合嵌入空间。我们通过三元组相似性判断（涉及语调和跨词汇层面）以及上下文-回话信号适用性的任务来评估这种方法的准确性。我们的结果表明，所学习的投影方法显著提升了上下文与回话信号的检索效率，优于以往的方法。此外，研究还发现，回话信号的形态对扩展的对话上下文非常敏感，而且所学习的嵌入方式与人类的判断更为吻合，比原始的WavLM特征表现更好。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Closing the Spatial Execution Gap in Digital Whiteboards via Verifiable Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过可验证的强化学习来缩小数字白板在空间执行方面的差距
papers.authors: Chang Liu, Benjamin Wagley, Zibo Wang, Mehmet E. Belviranli, Bo Wu
papers.abstract: While multi-modal large language models such as GPT-5 demonstrate exceptional general understanding, they suffer from a fundamental Spatial Execution Gap, failing to translate visual semantics into precise, schema-valid coordinate operations in interactive environments. In this work, we show that model scale alone cannot close this gap; instead, verifiable structured reasoning provides the key to spatial precision. We present a comprehensive pipeline that leverages Group Relative Policy Optimization to enforce a strict Identify-Reason-Verify protocol, effectively shifting the computational burden from parameters to test-time reasoning. By utilizing a multi-agent system to distill optimal reasoning schemas and training on execution-verifiable rewards, our specialized 3B agent achieves 100% format coherence and 81.12% operation accuracy on digital whiteboard tasks. Crucially, our approach outperforms a state-of-the-art frontier model, GPT-5, by 16.75% in operation accuracy. The results suggest that for complex user interface manipulation, small, RL-aligned models with dedicated reasoning protocols are superior to generalist frontier models, offering a promising direction for building reliable web agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然像GPT-5这样的多模态大语言模型展现出了卓越的通用理解能力，但它们存在一个根本性的问题：空间执行能力的不足。这些模型无法将视觉语义转化为在交互环境中精确、符合规范的坐标运算。在这项研究中，我们发现仅仅提升模型规模并不能解决这一问题；相反，可验证的结构化推理才是实现空间精确性的关键。我们提出了一种全面的解决方案，利用群体相对策略优化技术来强制执行严格的识别-推理-验证流程，从而将计算负担从参数处理转移到测试阶段的推理过程中。通过采用多智能体系统来提炼最优的推理模式，并在可执行的奖励上进行训练，我们的专用3B模型在数字白板任务上实现了100%的格式一致性和81.12%的操作准确率。重要的是，我们的方法在操作准确率方面比最先进的模型GPT-5高出16.75%。结果表明，对于复杂的用户界面操作来说，具有专门推理协议的小型强化学习模型优于那些通用的前沿模型，这为构建可靠的网络代理提供了有希望的方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ExecVerify: White-Box RL with Verifiable Stepwise Rewards for Code Execution Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ExecVerify：基于白盒强化学习的算法，能够实现可验证的逐步奖励机制，适用于代码执行推理任务
papers.authors: Lingxiao Tang, He Ye, Zhaoyang Chu, Muyang Ye, Zhongxin Liu, Xiaoxue Ren, Lingfeng Bao
papers.abstract: Code LLMs still struggle with code execution reasoning, especially in smaller models. Existing methods rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with teacher-generated explanations, primarily in two forms: (1) input–output (I/O) prediction chains and (2) natural-language descriptions of execution traces. However, intermediate execution steps cannot be explicitly verified during SFT, so the training objective can reduce to merely matching teacher explanations. Moreover, training data is typically collected without explicit control over task difficulty. We introduce ExecVerify, which goes beyond text imitation by incorporating verifiable white-box rewards derived from execution traces, including next-statement prediction and variable value/type prediction. Our work first builds a dataset with multiple difficulty levels via constraint-based program synthesis. Then, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) to reward correct answers about both intermediate execution steps and final outputs, aligning the training objective with semantic correctness at each execution step. Finally, we adopt a two-stage training pipeline that first enhances execution reasoning and then transfers to code generation. Experiments demonstrate that a 7B model trained with ExecVerify achieves performance comparable to 32B models on code reasoning benchmarks and improves pass@1 by up to 5.9% on code generation tasks over strong post-training baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 代码生成语言模型在代码执行推理方面仍然存在困难，尤其是在较小的模型中。现有的方法依赖于基于监督的微调（SFT）以及由教师生成的解释，主要有两种形式：(1) 输入-输出预测链；(2) 对执行过程的自然语言描述。然而，在SFT过程中无法明确验证中间的执行步骤，因此训练目标可能仅仅停留在匹配教师的解释上。此外，训练数据的收集通常没有对任务难度进行明确的控制。我们提出了ExecVerify算法，它超越了文本模仿的方式，通过结合可以从执行过程中获得的可验证的白盒奖励来实现推理，这些奖励包括下一语句的预测以及变量值/类型的预测。我们的工作首先通过基于约束的程序合成技术构建了一个包含多个难度级别的数据集。然后，我们采用强化学习方法来奖励关于中间执行步骤和最终输出的正确答案，从而使训练目标与每个执行步骤的语义正确性保持一致。最后，我们采用了一种两阶段训练流程：首先增强执行推理能力，然后再将其应用于代码生成。实验表明，使用ExecVerify训练的7B模型在代码推理基准测试中的性能可与32B模型相媲美，并且在代码生成任务上的准确率提升了5.9%，这一提升幅度超过了经过强化训练后的基线模型。

papers.title: Prune as You Generate: Online Rollout Pruning for Faster and Better RLVR
papers.title_zh: 在生成过程中进行修剪：在线部署过程中的修剪操作，以实现更快速、更高效的RLVR运行
papers.authors: Haobo Xu, Sirui Chen, Ruizhong Qiu, Yuchen Yan, Chen Luo, Monica Xiao Cheng, Jingrui He, Hanghang Tong
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, methods such as GRPO and DAPO suffer from substantial computational cost, since they rely on sampling many rollouts for each prompt. Moreover, in RLVR the relative advantage is often sparse: many samples become nearly all-correct or all-incorrect, yielding low within-group reward variance and thus weak learning signals. In this paper, we introduce ARRoL (Accelerating RLVR via online RoLlout Pruning), an online rollout pruning method that prunes rollouts during generation while explicitly steering the surviving ones more correctness-balanced to enhance learning signals. Specifically, ARRoL trains a lightweight quality head on-the-fly to predict the success probability of partial rollouts and uses it to make early pruning decisions. The learned quality head can further weigh candidates to improve inference accuracy during test-time voting. To improve efficiency, we present a system design that prunes rollouts inside the inference engine and re-batches the remaining ones for log-probability computation and policy updates. Across GRPO and DAPO on Qwen-3 and LLaMA-3.2 models (1B-8B), ARRoL improves average accuracy by +2.30 to +2.99 while achieving up to 1.7× training speedup, and yielding up to +8.33 additional gains in average accuracy in test-time voting.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，像GRPO和DAPO这样的方法存在巨大的计算成本问题，因为它们需要为每个提示进行大量的实验尝试。此外，在RLVR中，相对优势往往很稀疏：许多样本几乎都是完全正确的或完全错误的，导致组内奖励的方差很低，从而削弱了学习信号。在本文中，我们提出了ARRoL（通过在线Rolllout剪枝加速RLVR），这是一种在线剪枝方法，它在生成过程中对实验尝试进行剪枝，同时让剩余的实验尝试更加符合正确性平衡，以提高学习信号。具体来说，ARRoL会实时训练一个轻量级的质量预测器，以预测部分实验尝试的成功概率，并据此做出早期剪枝决策。所学习到的质量预测器可以进一步权衡候选方案，从而在测试时提高推理准确性。为了提升效率，我们提出了一种系统设计方案，该方案在推理引擎内部对实验尝试进行剪枝，并将剩余的实验尝试重新组合起来用于概率计算和策略更新。在Qwen-3和LaLM-3.2模型（1B到8B参数规模）上，ARRoL将平均准确率提高了2.30到2.99，同时训练速度提高了1.7倍，并且在测试时投票的平均准确率增加了高达8.33个百分点。

papers.title: Mitigating Legal Hallucinations via Symbolic Constraints and Analogical Precedents
papers.title_zh: 通过符号约束和类比规则来减轻法律上的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Zixuan Huang, Yanxiang Ma, Luhan Wang, Yunke Wang, Duo Shi, Chang Xu
papers.abstract: With the growing potential of large language models (LLMs) in the legal domain, domain-specific finetuning and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods have received widespread attention. However, current methods still suffer from hallucination risk and failing to resolve semantic drift and adapt to varying citation numbers. To address this, we propose Authoritative and Accurate Lawyer (AALawyer), a complementary dual-retriever framework based on the Legal Syllogism and the nature of different legal data. First, we introduce Symbolic Constrained Retrieval (SCR) for closed-set article retrieval, by constraining retrieval to the generative prediction. Second, we build Analogical Precedent Retrieval (APR) to retrieve open-set judicial precedents for reasoning with a newly collected large criminal dataset.Extensive experiments, including LawBench, our Hallucination Risk-Benchmark, and comprehensive ablation studies, demonstrate the effectiveness of AALawyer, which mitigates hallucinations while improving the explainability of legal reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在法律领域的潜力不断增长，针对特定领域的微调技术和基于检索增强的生成方法受到了广泛关注。然而，当前的方法仍然存在幻觉风险的问题，且无法解决语义漂移问题，也无法适应不同的引用数量。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了“权威与准确的律师”框架（AALawyer），这是一个基于法律三段论原理和不同法律数据特性的互补式双检索框架。首先，我们引入了符号约束检索技术，用于闭集文章的检索，通过限制检索结果在生成预测的范围内进行。其次，我们构建了类比性判例检索技术，用于检索开集中的司法判例，以便利用新收集的大型刑事数据集进行推理。通过包括LawBench在内的大量实验以及全面的消融研究，证明了AALawyer的有效性——它能够有效减少幻觉现象，同时提高法律推理的可解释性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: How Tokenization Limits Phonological Knowledge Representation in Language Models and How to Improve Them
papers.title_zh: 分词技术如何限制语言模型中的音位知识表示，以及如何改进这些模型
papers.authors: Disen Liao, Freda Shi
papers.abstract: Tokenization is the first step in every language model (LM), yet it never takes the sounds of words into account. We investigate how tokenization influences text-only LMs’ ability to represent phonological knowledge. Through a series of probing experiments, we show that subword-based tokenization systematically weakens the encoding of both local (e.g., rhyme) and global (e.g., syllabification) phonological features. To quantify this effect, we introduce the syllabification-tokenization alignment distance (STAD), a metric that measures the misalignment between a model’s tokenization and the natural syllable boundaries of words, and find that higher misalignment correlates with poorer phonological representations, providing a simple diagnostic for phonology-aware tokenization. To address these limitations, we propose a lightweight IPA-based fine-tuning method that infuses phonological awareness into LMs, leading to consistent improvements across three phonology-related tasks while largely preserving math and general reasoning ability, with 1.1% and 0.9% drops on GSM8K and MMLU, respectively.[Our code is available at https://github.com/liaodisen/Tokenization-Phonology]
papers.abstract_zh: 标记化是每一个语言模型的第一步，但它从未考虑过单词的发音。我们研究了标记化如何影响仅基于文本的模型在表示音韵知识方面的能力。通过一系列实验，我们发现基于子词的标记化会系统性地削弱对局部（如押韵）和全局（如音节划分）音韵特征的编码能力。为了量化这种影响，我们提出了“音节划分与标记化对齐距离”这一指标，该指标用于衡量模型的标记化方式与自然单词的音节边界之间的不匹配程度。研究发现，不匹配程度越高，音韵表示的准确性就越差，这为音韵感知型标记化提供了一种简单的诊断方法。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种基于国际音标的小型化微调方法，该方法能够将音韵意识融入语言模型中，从而在三个与音韵相关的任务中取得一致性的改进效果，同时基本保留了数学能力和一般推理能力。在GSM8K和MMLU测试集上，我们的模型分别减少了1.1%和0.9%的错误率。[我们的代码可以在https://github.com/liaodisen/Tokenization-Phonology下载]
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Illusions of the Gold Standard: A Large-scale Analysis of Human Evaluation Protocols for Long-form Text Generation
papers.title_zh: 金本位制的幻觉：对人类文本生成评估机制的大规模分析
papers.authors: Katelyn X. Mei, Yi-Li Hsu, Minjoon Choi, Zongwan Cao, Chenjun Xu, Bingbing Wen, Su Lin Blodgett, Lucy Lu Wang
papers.abstract: Human evaluation plays a critical role in assessing the quality of generated text. However, the reliability and reproducibility of these evaluations depend on transparent and well-documented protocols—details that are frequently missing in current practice. In this work, we conduct a large-scale analysis of human evaluation protocols for evaluating long-form generation tasks in *CL conference publications from 2023–2025, including a full manual review of 284 papers and LLM-assisted analysis for another 1.8k+ papers. We define a set of 20 reportable criteria related to reproducibility of human evaluation studies, and apply these criteria to systematically examine reporting norms and practices within the community. We find widespread under-reporting of important aspects of human evaluation study design, leading to ambiguity about what was measured and how, who contributed judgments, and how judgments should be interpreted. Based on these findings, we outline actionable recommendations to support more transparent and reproducible reporting in future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类评估在评价生成文本的质量方面起着至关重要的作用。然而，这些评估的可靠性和可重复性取决于透明且记录详尽的评估方案——而这些细节在当前实践中往往缺失。在这项研究中，我们对2023年至2025年*CL会议出版物中的长文本生成任务进行了大规模的人类评估方案分析，包括对284篇论文进行全面的手动审查，并对另外1800多篇论文进行了大语言模型辅助分析。我们定义了一组与人类评估研究的可重复性相关的20个报告标准，并运用这些标准系统地检查了该领域内的报告规范和做法。我们发现，人类评估研究设计的许多重要方面都被广泛遗漏，导致对于所测量内容、测量方式、参与判断的人员以及判断结果的解释都存在不确定性。基于这些发现，我们提出了一些可行的建议，以支持未来研究更加透明且可重复的报告方式。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Omni-RewardBench: Toward a Comprehensive Evaluation of Generative Reward Models Across Modalities
papers.title_zh: Omni-RewardBench：针对各种模态下的生成式奖励模型的全面评估方法
papers.authors: Chi-Min Chan, Yujin Zhou, Pengcheng Wen, Boqin Yin, Jiaming Ji, Juntao Dai, Wei Xue, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: The rise of Omni-modality Large Language Models (OLLMs) capable of jointly processing text, audio, and visual inputs marks a major step toward general intelligence. Ensuring their alignment with human preferences requires effective Omni-modality Reward Models (ORMs), which serve as surrogates for human judgment to guide OLLMs behavior. However, ORMs evaluation remains underdeveloped in the previous literature. Existing benchmarks are largely text-centric or limited to bimodal tasks, restricting comprehensive assessment for ORMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce Omni-RewardBench, the first benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of ORMs across modalities. In short, our contributions are threefold: (1) a hybrid automatic-annotation and human-verification pipeline to construct high-quality evaluation data; (2) extensive experiments on 20+ models, including inherently omni-modal and modality-bridged systems. Our experimental results demonstrate that current OLLMs fall short as reward models, revealing several common failure modes such as perception failure, modality dominance failure, and cross-modal fusion failure; and (3) strong correlations between Omni-RewardBench scores and downstream performance (IID r = 0.94, OOD r = 0.72), validating its reliability as a predictor of real-world capability and alignment quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 能够同时处理文本、音频和视觉输入的全模态大语言模型的兴起，标志着向通用智能迈出的重要一步。要确保这些模型符合人类偏好，就需要有效的全模态奖励模型，它们可以替代人类的判断来引导大语言模型的行为。然而，在现有文献中，对全模态奖励模型的评估仍然不够完善。现有的基准测试大多以文本为中心，或者仅限于双模态任务，这限制了对其的全面评估。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Omni-RewardBench，这是首个用于全面评估不同模态下全模态奖励模型的基准测试。我们的贡献主要有三点：（1）采用混合式自动注释和人工验证流程，以构建高质量的评估数据；（2）对20多个模型进行了广泛的实验，包括纯全模态模型和跨模态融合模型；（3）实验结果表明，当前的大语言模型作为奖励模型存在不足，出现了诸如感知失败、模态主导失败以及跨模态融合失败等常见问题；此外，Omni-RewardBench的得分与下游性能之间存在很强的相关性（独立同分布训练集 r = 0.94，外部数据训练集 r = 0.72），这验证了该基准测试作为现实世界能力和对齐质量预测工具的可靠性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Answers to Arguments: Toward Trustworthy Clinical Diagnostic Reasoning with Toulmin-Guided Curriculum Goal-Conditioned Learning
papers.title_zh: 《对各种论点的回应：迈向基于目标导向的学习的可靠临床诊断推理》中的内容
papers.authors: Chen Zhan, Xiaoyu Tan, Gengchen Ma, Yu-Jie Xiong, Xiaoyan Jiang, Xihe Qiu
papers.abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into clinical decision support is critically obstructed by their opaque and often unreliable reasoning. In the high-stakes domain of healthcare, correct answers alone are insufficient; clinical practice demands full transparency to ensure patient safety and enable professional accountability. A pervasive and dangerous weakness of current LLMs is their tendency to produce “correct answers through flawed reasoning.” This issue is far more than a minor academic flaw; such process errors signal a fundamental lack of robust understanding, making the model prone to broader hallucinations and unpredictable failures when faced with real-world clinical complexity. In this paper, we establish a framework for trustworthy clinical argumentation by adapting the Toulmin model to the diagnostic process. We propose a novel training pipeline: Curriculum Goal-Conditioned Learning (CGCL), designed to progressively train LLM to generate diagnostic arguments that explicitly follow this Toulmin structure. CGCL’s progressive three-stage curriculum systematically builds a solid clinical argument: (1) extracting facts and generating differential diagnoses; (2) justifying a core hypothesis while rebutting alternatives; and (3) synthesizing the analysis into a final, qualified conclusion. We validate CGCL using T-Eval, a quantitative framework measuring the integrity of the diagnosis reasoning. Experiments show that our method achieves diagnostic accuracy and reasoning quality comparable to resource-intensive Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods, while offering a more stable and efficient training pipeline.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在临床决策支持中的整合面临着一个严重的问题：它们的推理过程往往不透明且不可靠。在至关重要的医疗领域，仅仅正确的答案是不够的；临床实践需要完全的透明度，以确保患者安全并维护专业责任。当前大语言模型的一个普遍且危险的缺陷是，它们倾向于通过有缺陷的推理来得出“正确答案”。这个问题远不止是一个轻微的学术缺陷；这种过程错误表明模型缺乏扎实的理解能力，使其在面对现实世界的复杂情况时容易出现幻觉和不可预测的失败。在本文中，我们提出了一种可信赖的临床论证框架，通过将Toulmin模型应用于诊断过程来实现。我们提出了一种新的训练流程：基于课程目标的深度学习（CGCL），该流程旨在逐步训练大语言模型，使其能够生成符合Toulmin结构的诊断性论点。CGCL的三阶段训练流程系统地构建了一个坚实的临床论证体系：(1)提取事实并生成鉴别诊断；(2)证明核心假设的同时反驳其他选择方案；(3)将分析结果综合为最终的、有根据的结论。我们通过T-Eval这一定量评估框架来验证CGCL的效果，该框架用于衡量诊断推理的完整性。实验表明，我们的方法在诊断准确性和推理质量方面与资源密集型强化学习方法相当，同时提供了更稳定且高效的训练流程。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Verifiable LLM-Generated Text Detection via Projected Semantic-Structural Distributions
papers.title_zh: 通过投影语义结构分布来检测由大语言模型生成的可靠文本
papers.authors: Ruochong Xiong, Qien Li, Wangwang Lian, Yulong Wan, Hanlin Xue, Zhouxing Tan, Han Yang, Fengyu Lu, Junfei Liu
papers.abstract: The widespread deployment of large language models (LLMs) makes detecting LLM-Generated text a critical security task. Existing methods, primarily relying on output probabilities from proxy models or single semantic features, suffer from distribution misalignment and limited interpretability. We observe that machine-generated text exhibits a directionally consistent systematic translation relative to human-written text within the joint semantic-structural space. Accordingly, we propose ProSSD, a statistical framework utilizing supervised subspace learning to extract compact features and construct conditional semantic distributions based on syntactic structures. By employing a likelihood ratio test, we derive a modified Mahalanobis distance, weighted by the Wasserstein distance, as the discriminative metric. Experiments demonstrate ProSSD’s superior robustness and computational efficiency across cross-domain, cross-model, and adversarial scenarios. Furthermore, we reveal the phenomena of systematic semantic translation and semantic collapse in machine-generated text, offering interpretable statistical insights into LLM generation behaviors.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的大规模部署使得检测由这些模型生成的文本成为一项至关重要的安全任务。现有的方法主要依赖于代理模型的输出概率或单一的语义特征，但这些方法存在分布不一致和可解释性有限的问题。我们发现，机器生成的文本在联合语义-结构空间中呈现出方向一致的系统性翻译现象。因此，我们提出了ProSSD这一统计框架，该框架利用监督子空间学习技术来提取简洁的特征，并根据句法结构构建条件语义分布。通过采用似然比检验，我们提出了一种改进的马氏距离度量方法，该距离度量以Wasserstein距离为权重。实验表明，ProSSD在跨领域、跨模型以及对抗性场景下都具有出色的鲁棒性和计算效率。此外，我们还揭示了机器生成文本中的系统性语义翻译和语义崩溃现象，为理解大语言模型的生成行为提供了可解释的统计洞察。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Is Human-Like Text Liked by Humans? Multilingual Human Detection and Preference Against AI
papers.title_zh: 具有人类特征的文本是否受到人类的喜爱？多语言人类模型的检测与对人工智能的偏好分析
papers.authors: Yuxia Wang, Rui Xing, Jonibek Mansurov, Giovanni Puccetti, Zhuohan Xie, Minh Ngoc Ta, Jiahui Geng, Jinyan Su, Mervat Abassy, Saadeldine Eletter, Kareem Elozeiri, Nurkhan Laiyk, Maiya Goloburda, Tarek Mahmoud, Raj Vardhan Tomar, Alexander Aziz, Ryuto Koike, Masahiro Kaneko, Artem Shelmanov, Ekaterina Artemova, Vladislav Mikhailov, Akim Tsvigun, Alham Fikri Aji, Nizar Habash, Iryna Gurevych, Preslav Nakov
papers.abstract: Prior studies have shown that distinguishing text generated by Large Language Models (LLMs) from human-written one is highly challenging for humans, and often no better than random guessing. To verify the generalizability of this finding across languages and domains, we perform an extensive case study to identify the upper bound of human detection accuracy. Across 16 datasets covering 9 languages and 9 domains, 19 annotators achieved an average detection accuracy of 87.6%, thus challenging previous conclusions. We find that major gaps between human and machine text lie in concreteness, cultural nuances, and diversity. Prompting by explicitly explaining the distinctions in the prompts can partially bridge the gaps in over 50% of the cases. However, we also find that humans do not always prefer human-written text, particularly when they cannot clearly identify its source. We release our dataset, the human labels, and the annotator metadata at https://github.com/xnlp-lab/HumanEval-MGT.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前的研究表明，对于人类来说，区分由大语言模型生成的文本和人工撰写的文本是一项极具挑战性的任务，通常只能达到随机猜测的水平。为了验证这一发现在不同语言和领域中的普遍性，我们进行了广泛的案例研究，以确定人类识别准确性的上限。在涵盖9种语言和9个领域的16个数据集上，19名注释者平均达到了87.6%的识别准确率，这挑战了之前的结论。我们发现，人类文本与机器生成文本之间的主要差异体现在具体性、文化细微差别以及多样性方面。通过明确说明这些差异来提示人类，可以在超过50%的情况下部分弥补这些差距。然而，我们也发现，人类并不总是偏好人工撰写的文本，尤其是在无法明确识别出其来源时。我们将我们的数据集、人类标注结果以及注释者的元数据发布在https://github.com/xnlp-lab/HumanEval-MGT网站上。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Powerful Training-Free Membership Inference Against Fine-Tuned Autoregressive Language Models
papers.title_zh: 针对经过微调的自回归语言模型的强大无训练成本会员推理方法
papers.authors: David Ilić, David Stanojević, Kostadin Cvejoski
papers.abstract: Fine-tuned language models pose significant privacy risks, as they may memorize and expose sensitive information from their training data. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) provide a principled framework for auditing these risks, yet existing methods achieve limited detection rates, particularly at the low false-positive thresholds required for practical privacy auditing. We present EZ-MIA, a membership inference attack that exploits a key observation: memorization manifests most strongly at error positions, specifically tokens where the model predicts incorrectly yet still shows elevated probability for training examples. We introduce the Error Zone (EZ) score, which measures the directional imbalance of probability shifts at error positions relative to a pretrained reference model. This principled statistic requires only two forward passes per query and no model training of any kind. On WikiText with GPT-2, EZ-MIA achieves 3.8\times higher detection than the previous state-of-the-art under identical conditions (66.3% versus 17.5% true positive rate at 1% false positive rate), with near-perfect discrimination (AUC 0.98). At the stringent 0.1% FPR threshold critical for real-world auditing, we achieve 8\times higher detection than prior work (14.0% versus 1.8%), requiring no reference model training. These gains extend to larger architectures: on AG News with Llama-2-7B, we achieve 3\times higher detection (46.7% versus 15.8% TPR at 1% FPR). These results establish that privacy risks of fine-tuned language models are substantially greater than previously understood, with implications for both privacy auditing and deployment decisions. Code is available at https://github.com/JetBrains-Research/ez-mia.
papers.abstract_zh: 经过微调的语言模型存在显著的隐私风险，因为它们可能会记住并暴露来自训练数据的敏感信息。成员推断攻击为审计这些风险提供了理论框架，但现有方法的检测率仍然较低，尤其是在实际隐私审计所需的低误报阈值下。我们提出了EZ-MIA算法，该算法利用了一个关键观察结果：记忆现象在错误位置最为明显，具体来说就是那些模型预测错误但训练样本的概率仍然较高的词元。我们引入了“错误区域”得分，该得分用于衡量错误位置处概率变化的方向性不平衡程度，与预训练的参考模型相比。这个基于原理的统计量只需要每次查询两次前向传播操作，且不需要任何模型训练。在使用GPT-2进行WikiText数据集测试时，EZ-MIA的检测率比现有的最先进方法高出3.8倍（在1%的误报率下，真阳性率为66.3%，而现有方法仅为17.5%），并且其区分能力接近完美（AUC为0.98）。在现实世界审计中至关重要的0.1%的误报率阈值下，我们的检测率比之前的工作高出8倍（真阳性率为14.0%，而之前的方法为1.8%），而且不需要任何参考模型的训练。这些改进也适用于更大的架构：在使用Llama-2-7B进行AG News数据集测试时，我们的检测率提高了3倍（真阳性率为46.7%，而之前的方法为15.8%，误报率为1%）。这些结果表明，经过微调的语言模型的隐私风险比之前理解的要大得多，这对隐私审计和部署决策都有重要意义。相关代码可以在https://github.com/JetBrains-Research/ez-mia下载。

papers.title: Communication-Efficient Desire Alignment for Proactive Embodied Human–Agent Interaction
papers.title_zh: 一种高效的通信方式，用于促进主动式体化人类与智能体的互动协调
papers.authors: Yuanfei Wang, Xinju Huang, Fangwei Zhong, Yaodong Yang, Yizhou Wang, Yuanpei Chen, Hao Dong
papers.abstract: Effective real-world human–agent interactions, such as household robotic services, are often long-term and repeated. Beyond executing tasks, agents are expected to quickly become familiar with individual users. In everyday use, people do not want to repeatedly specify precise instructions. Instead, they prefer agents that adapt to their habits and preferences over interaction while minimizing communication effort. This poses a key challenge: enabling agents to rapidly align with user needs and provide proactive assistance within limited communication. To study this problem in a realistic embodied setting, we first introduce HA-Desire, a home assistance simulation environment. HA-Desire features an LLM-driven proxy user with value-driven preferences and natural language behavior, enabling systematic evaluation of how agents adapt to users across interactions and satisfy their desires. We further propose FAMER, a framework that integrates goal-relevant memory, desire-centered mental reasoning, and efficient communication to infer user preferences from interaction while reducing unnecessary dialogue. Experiments across embodied household tasks and different LLMs show that FAMER improves both task success and interaction efficiency compared to existing baselines, highlighting the importance of communication-efficient desire alignment for proactive embodied agents that support users without requiring frequent instructions.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中的人机交互中，比如家庭机器人服务，往往具有长期性和重复性。除了执行任务之外，机器人还被期望能够快速熟悉每个用户的特点。在日常使用中，人们并不希望反复地指定精确的指令。相反，他们更希望机器人能够适应他们的习惯和偏好，同时尽量减少沟通成本。这提出了一个关键挑战：如何让机器人能够迅速调整自身行为以符合用户需求，并在有限的沟通时间内提供主动式的帮助。为了在一个真实的场景中对这个问题进行研究，我们首先介绍了HA-Desire这个家庭辅助模拟环境。HA-Desire拥有一个由大语言模型驱动的代理用户，该用户具有基于价值的偏好以及自然语言行为，这使得我们可以系统地评估机器人在不同交互中如何适应用户并满足他们的需求。我们还提出了FAMER框架，该框架整合了与任务相关的记忆、以欲望为中心的心理推理以及高效的沟通方式，从而从交互中推断出用户的偏好，同时减少不必要的对话。通过在家庭任务中的实验以及对不同大语言模型的测试，我们发现FAMER在任务成功率和交互效率方面都优于现有的基线方法，这凸显了在沟通效率高的欲望对齐机制对于支持用户且无需频繁指令的主动式机器人的重要性。

papers.title: When Seeing Overrides Knowing: Disentangling Knowledge Conflicts in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 当感知优先于认知时：解析视觉语言模型中的知识冲突
papers.authors: Francesco Ortu, Zhijing Jin, Diego Doimo, Alberto Cazzaniga
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly combine visual and textual information to perform complex tasks. However, conflicts between their internal knowledge and external visual input can lead to hallucinations and unreliable predictions. In this work, we investigate the mechanisms that VLMs use to resolve cross-modal conflicts by introducing WHOOPS-AHA!, a dataset of multimodal counterfactual queries that deliberately contradict internal commonsense knowledge. Through logit inspection, we identify a small set of attention heads that mediate this conflict. By intervening in these heads, we can steer the model towards its internal parametric knowledge or the visual information. Our results show that attention patterns on these heads effectively locate image regions that influence visual overrides, providing a more precise attribution compared to gradient-based methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）越来越多地结合视觉和文本信息来执行复杂任务。然而，其内部知识与外部视觉输入之间的冲突可能导致幻觉和不可靠的预测。在这项研究中，我们探讨了VLMs解决跨模态冲突的机制，通过引入“WHOOPS-AHA!”数据集来研究多模态反事实查询如何与内部常识知识产生矛盾。通过逻辑检验，我们发现了一组负责调解这种冲突的注意力区域。通过干预这些区域，我们可以引导模型依据其内部参数化知识或视觉信息来做出决策。我们的研究表明，这些注意力区域的模式能够准确地定位出影响视觉感知的图像区域，从而比基于梯度的方法提供更精确的归因结果。

papers.title: ICDAGENT: Empowering Agentic Large Language Models for Explainable Medical Coding
papers.title_zh: ICDAGENT：赋能主动式大型语言模型，以实现可解释的医学编码处理
papers.authors: Ziyi Yin, Yuanpu Cao, Ting Wang, Jinghui Chen, Fenglong Ma
papers.abstract: The explainable medical coding task aims to automatically assign International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes to clinical notes while providing explicit justifications for each assignment. Recent approaches employ large language models (LLMs) to generate such explanations. However, their performance remains limited due to a lack of understanding of the clinical meanings of ICD codes. Additionally, the vast ICD code space further complicates the task of accurate prediction. To address these challenges, we propose the ICDAGENT framework, which consists of two collaborative LLM agents: a coding agent and a critical agent. The coding agent extracts ICD codes and generates preliminary rationales, while the critical agent performs fine-grained chain-of-thought reasoning to verify and refine them. Furthermore, the critical agent is trained with a rationale-aware reward, combined with reinforcement learning, enabling it to distinguish between correct and incorrect reasoning and ensure explanation accuracy. Experiments across multiple ICD coding standards and datasets demonstrate that ICDAGENT achieves effective ICD coding with accurate and trustworthy explanations.
papers.abstract_zh: 可解释的医学编码任务旨在自动为临床记录分配国际疾病分类（ICD）代码，并为每个分配提供明确的理由。目前的方法采用大语言模型来生成这些解释。然而，由于缺乏对ICD代码的临床含义的理解，它们的性能仍然有限。此外，庞大的ICD代码空间进一步增加了准确预测的难度。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ICDAGENT框架，该框架由两个协作的LLM代理组成：一个编码代理和一个批判性代理。编码代理提取ICD代码并生成初步的理由，而批判性代理则进行细粒度的思维链推理，以验证和完善这些理由。此外，批判性代理通过带有理由意识的奖励进行训练，并结合强化学习，使其能够区分正确和错误的推理，确保解释的准确性。在多个ICD编码标准和数据集上的实验表明，ICDAGENT能够实现有效的ICD编码，并提供准确且可信的解释。

papers.title: Hyperion: Private Token Sampling with Homomorphic Encryption
papers.title_zh: Hyperion：利用同态加密技术的私有代币采样技术
papers.authors: Lawrence Lim, Jiaming Liu, Vikas Kalagi, Divyakant Agrawal, Amr El Abbadi
papers.abstract: A promising direction for enabling private queries to large language models (LLMs) is with homomorphic encryption (HE). An open problem is performing token sampling under HE. In this paper, we introduce Hyperion, an efficient HE algorithm for inverse transform sampling, enabling private token sampling with 1 comparison depth, O(1) amortized comparisons, and O(\log n) rotations. We implement our approach and demonstrate that it samples tokens in 0.14 seconds for 32k tokens (\approx 4.4\mu \mathrm{s} per token) on GPU, achieving a 100\times latency improvement over prior work.
papers.abstract_zh: 实现私有查询与大语言模型交互的一个有前景的方向是采用同态加密技术。目前一个尚未解决的问题是如何在同态加密环境下进行令牌采样。在本文中，我们提出了Hyperion算法，这是一种高效的反向变换采样同态加密算法。该算法能够实现仅一次比较的私有令牌采样，其平均比较次数仅为O(1)，旋转次数则约为O(log n)。我们通过实际实施验证了该算法的有效性：在GPU上，对于32k个令牌，采样时间仅为0.14秒（即每个令牌大约需要4.4微秒），相比以往的方法，延迟降低了100倍。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Map of Encoders – Mapping Sentence Encoders using Quantum Relative Entropy
papers.title_zh: 编码器地图——利用量子相对熵来映射句子编码器
papers.authors: Gaifan Zhang, Danushka Bollegala
papers.abstract: We propose a method to compare and visualise sentence encoders at scale by creating a map of encoders where each sentence encoder is represented in relation to the other sentence encoders. Specifically, we first represent a sentence encoder using an embedding matrix of a sentence set, where each row corresponds to the embedding of a sentence. Next, we compute the PIP matrix for a sentence encoder using its embedding matrix. Finally, we create a feature vector for each sentence encoder that reflects its QRE with respect to a unit base encoder. We construct a map of encoders covering 1101 publicly available sentence encoders, providing a new perspective of the landscape of the pre-trained sentence encoders. Our map accurately reflects various relationships between encoders, where encoders with similar attributes are proximally located on the map. Moreover, our encoder feature vectors can be used to accurately infer downstream task performance of the encoders, such as in retrieval and clustering tasks, demonstrating the correctness of our map.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种方法来大规模比较和可视化句子编码器。具体做法是，通过创建一个编码器映射图来实现这一目标，该图能够展示每个句子编码器与其他句子编码器之间的关系。首先，我们使用句子集合的嵌入矩阵来表示一个句子编码器，其中每一行对应一个句子的嵌入表示。接着，利用该句子的嵌入矩阵计算其PIP矩阵。最后，为每个句子编码器创建一个特征向量，该向量反映了该编码器相对于单位基础编码器的QRE情况。我们构建了一个包含1101个公开可用的句子编码器的映射图，为预训练句子编码器领域提供了一个新的视角。我们的映射图能够准确反映不同编码器之间的各种关系，具有相似属性的编码器在地图上会处于相近的位置。此外，我们的编码器特征向量还可以用于准确预测编码器的下游任务性能，例如在检索和聚类任务中的表现，这证明了我们映射图的正确性。

papers.title: Mango: Multi-Agent Web Navigation via Global-View Optimization
papers.title_zh: 芒果：通过全局视图优化实现多智能体网络导航
papers.authors: Weixi Tong, Yifeng Di, Tianyi Zhang
papers.abstract: Existing web agents typically initiate exploration from the root URL, which is inefficient for complex websites with deep hierarchical structures. Without a global view of the website’s structure, agents frequently fall into navigation traps, explore irrelevant branches, or fail to reach target information within a limited budget. We propose Mango, a multi-agent web navigation method that leverages the website structure to dynamically determine optimal starting points. We formulate URL selection as a multi-armed bandit problem and employ Thompson Sampling to adaptively allocate the navigation budget across candidate URLs. Furthermore, we introduce an episodic memory component to store navigation history, enabling the agent to learn from previous attempts. Experiments on WebVoyager demonstrate that Mango achieves a success rate of 63.6% when using GPT-5-mini, outperforming the best baseline by 7.3%. Furthermore, on WebWalkerQA, Mango attains a 52.5% success rate, surpassing the best baseline by 26.8%. We also demonstrate the generalizability of Mango using both open-source and closed-source models as backbones. Our data and code are open-source and available at https://github.com/VichyTong/Mango.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的网络导航代理通常从根URL开始进行探索，这对于具有复杂层次结构的网站来说效率较低。由于缺乏对网站结构的全局视图，代理常常陷入导航陷阱，探索无关的路径，或者在有限的预算内无法找到目标信息。我们提出了Mango这一多智能体网络导航方法，该方法利用网站结构来动态确定最佳起点。我们将URL选择问题建模为多臂老虎机问题，并采用汤普森采样算法来自适应分配导航预算到各个候选URL上。此外，我们还引入了一个情景记忆组件来存储导航历史记录，使代理能够从前几次尝试中吸取经验。在WebVoyager上的实验表明，使用GPT-5-mini时，Mango的成功率为63.6%，比最佳基线模型高出7.3%。而在WebWalkerQA上，Mango的成功率达到了52.5%，比最佳基线模型高出26.8%。我们还展示了Mango的通用性，无论是使用开源还是闭源模型作为基础都表现良好。我们的数据和代码都是开源的，可以在https://github.com/VichyTong/Mango下载。

papers.title: DPWriter: Reinforcement Learning with Diverse Planning Branching for Creative Writing
papers.title_zh: DPWriter：基于多样化规划分支的强化学习在创意写作中的应用
papers.authors: Qian Cao, Yahui Liu, Wei Bi, Yi Zhao, Ruihua Song, Xiting Wang, Ruiming Tang, Guorui Zhou, Han Li
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based enhancement of large language models (LLMs) often leads to reduced output diversity, undermining their utility in open-ended tasks like creative writing. Current methods lack explicit mechanisms for guiding diverse exploration and instead prioritize optimization efficiency and performance over diversity. This paper proposes an RL framework structured around a semi-structured long Chain-of-Thought (CoT), in which the generation process is decomposed into explicitly planned intermediate steps. We introduce a Diverse Planning Branching method that strategically introduces divergence at the planning phase based on diversity variation, alongside a group-aware diversity reward to encourage distinct trajectories. Experimental results on creative writing benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly improves output diversity without compromising generation quality, consistently outperforming existing baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于强化学习的大语言模型增强方法往往会导致输出多样性的降低，从而削弱其在创造性写作等开放性任务中的实用性。当前的方法缺乏引导多样化探索的明确机制，而是更重视优化效率和性能，而非多样性。本文提出了一种基于半结构化思维链结构的强化学习框架，该框架将生成过程分解为明确规划的中间步骤。我们引入了一种多样化的规划分支方法，该方法在规划阶段根据多样性变化引入差异性，同时采用群体感知多样性奖励来鼓励不同路径的生成。在创造性写作基准测试中的实验结果表明，我们的方法能够在不牺牲生成质量的情况下显著提升输出多样性，且始终优于现有的基线方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Iterative Dual-Model Alignment for Story Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 迭代双模型对齐方法在故事评估中的应用
papers.authors: Bruce Qin, Dan Goldwasser
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can both evaluate and explain text quality; however, most existing evaluators operate as static classifiers and lack the ability to refine their reasoning through interaction. We propose an Iterative Alpha–Beta Learning framework that jointly trains two complementary 8B models: an Alpha (\alpha) classifier that assesses pairwise story engagement, and a Beta (\beta) generator that produces structured, rubric-guided comparative explanations. The two models co-evolve within a closed feedback loop: \alpha provides probabilistic preference signals to guide \beta’s Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), while \beta’s improved explanations are reintegrated to retrain \alpha via a KL-based contrastive objective. This dual optimization enables mutual learning: \alpha gains interpretability and robustness from \beta’s textual rationales, while \beta acquires stronger alignment and discriminative precision from \alpha’s confidence deltas. Experiments on human-annotated story-pair datasets HANNA show that the proposed system consistently outperforms strong single-model baselines in both accuracy and explanation quality across multiple iterative rounds.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型不仅可以评估文本质量，还可以解释文本质量。然而，目前大多数评估工具都是静态的分类器，缺乏通过交互来完善推理的能力。我们提出了一种迭代的Alpha-Beta学习框架，该框架同时训练两个互补的8B模型：一个用于评估文本之间互动性的Alpha分类器，以及一个能够生成结构化、基于评分标准的比较性解释的Beta生成器。这两个模型在一个封闭的反馈循环中共同进化：Alpha提供概率偏好信号来指导Beta的直接偏好优化过程，而Beta生成的更优解释则被重新整合进来，通过基于KL对比的目标来重新训练Alpha。这种双重优化机制使得两者能够相互学习：Alpha从Beta的文本解释中获得可解释性和鲁棒性，而Beta则从Alpha的置信度差异中获得更强的对齐能力和区分能力。在HANNA人类标注的故事对数据集上的实验表明，所提出的系统在不同迭代过程中，无论是在准确性还是解释质量方面，都始终优于那些仅使用单一模型的基线方法。

papers.title: Discovery and Reinforcement of Tool-Integrated Reasoning Chains via Rollout Trees
papers.title_zh: 通过展开树结构来发现并强化与工具相整合的推理链
papers.authors: Kun Li, Zenan Xu, Junan Li, Zengrui Jin, Jinghao Deng, Zexuan Qiu, Bo Zhou
papers.abstract: Tool-Integrated Reasoning has emerged as a key paradigm to augment Large Language Models (LLMs) with computational capabilities, yet integrating tool-use into long Chain-of-Thought (long CoT) remains underexplored, largely due to the scarcity of training data and the challenge of integrating tool-use without compromising the model’s intrinsic long-chain reasoning. In this paper, we introduce DART (Discovery And Reinforcement of Tool-Integrated Reasoning Chains via Rollout Trees), a reinforcement learning framework that enables spontaneous tool-use during long CoT reasoning without additional human annotation. DART operates by constructing dynamic rollout trees during training to discover valid tool-use opportunities, branching out at promising positions to explore tool-integrated trajectories. Subsequently, a tree-based process advantage estimation identifies and credits specific sub-trajectories where tool invocation positively contributes to the solution, effectively reinforcing these beneficial behaviors during training. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks like AIME and GPQA-Diamond demonstrate that DART significantly outperforms existing methods, successfully harmonizing tool execution with long CoT reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具整合推理已成为增强大语言模型计算能力的关键范式。然而，将工具使用整合到长思维链推理中仍缺乏深入研究，这主要是由于训练数据的稀缺性，以及在不影响模型固有长链推理能力的情况下整合工具使用的挑战。在本文中，我们提出了DART（通过展开树发现与强化工具整合推理链）这一强化学习框架。该框架能够在无需额外人工注释的情况下，实现在长思维链推理过程中的自发工具使用。DART通过在训练过程中构建动态的展开树来发现有效的工具使用机会，并在有前景的位置进行分支，以探索工具整合的推理路径。随后，基于树的进程优势估计能够识别出那些工具调用对解决方案有积极贡献的子路径，从而在训练过程中有效强化这些有益行为。在AIME和GPQA-Diamond等具有挑战性的基准测试上的广泛实验表明，DART显著优于现有方法，成功实现了工具执行与长思维链推理的协调统一。

papers.title: When Identity Skews Debate: Anonymization for Bias-Reduced Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 当身份问题成为辩论的焦点时：用于减少偏见的多智能体推理中的匿名化处理
papers.authors: Hyeong Kyu Choi, Jerry Zhu, Sharon Li
papers.abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve large language model (LLM) reasoning by letting multiple agents exchange answers and then aggregate their opinions. Yet recent studies reveal that agents are not neutral: they are prone to identity-driven sycophancy and self-bias, uncritically adopting a peer’s view or stubbornly adhering to their own prior output, undermining the reliability of debate. In this work, we present the first principled framework that joins sycophancy and self-bias to mitigate and quantify identity bias in MAD. First, we formalize the debate dynamics as an identity-weighted Bayesian update process. Second, we propose response anonymization: by removing identity markers from prompts, agents cannot distinguish “self” from “peer”, which forces equal weights on agent identity, thereby reducing bias and improving trustworthiness. Third, we define the Identity Bias Coefficient (IBC), a principled bias metric that measures an agent’s tendency to follow its peer versus itself. Empirical studies across multiple models and benchmarks confirm that identity bias is widespread, with sycophancy far more common than self-bias. Our findings highlight the need to ensure that MAD systems reason based on content rather than identity.
papers.abstract_zh: 多智能体辩论（MAD）旨在通过让多个智能体交换答案并汇总他们的意见，来提高大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，最近的研究表明，这些智能体并非中立：它们容易受到身份驱动的阿谀奉承和自我偏见的影响，会不加批判地采纳同伴的观点，或者固执地坚持自己先前的输出，这严重削弱了辩论的可靠性。在这项研究中，我们提出了第一个能够结合阿谀奉承和自我偏见来减轻和量化MAD中身份偏见的原理性框架。首先，我们将辩论动态形式化为一个基于身份加权的贝叶斯更新过程。其次，我们提出了响应匿名化策略：通过从提示中移除身份标记，智能体无法区分“自我”和“同伴”，从而让智能体的身份具有相同的权重，进而减少偏见并提高可信度。第三，我们定义了身份偏见系数（IBC），这是一个用于衡量智能体倾向于跟随同伴而非自己的倾向的基准指标。在多个模型和基准测试中的实证研究表明，身份偏见普遍存在，而阿谀奉承比自我偏见更为常见。我们的研究结果强调了确保MAD系统基于内容而非身份来进行推理的重要性。

papers.title: Talking to a Know-It-All GPT or a Second-Guesser Claude? How Repair reveals distinct Multi-Turn Behavior in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 是与那些自以为是的大师智脑对话，还是与排名第二的克劳德交流？“How Repair”展示了在大型语言模型中不同的多轮对话行为
papers.authors: Clara Lachenmaier, Hannah Bultmann, Sina Zarrieß
papers.abstract: Repair, an important resource for resolving trouble in human–human conversation, remains underexplored in human–LLM interaction.In this study, we investigate how LLMs engage in the interactive process of repair in multi-turn dialogues around solvable and unsolvable math questions. We examine whether models initiate repair themselves and how they respond to user-initiated repair. Our results show strong differences across models: reactions range from being almost completely resistant to (appropriate) repair attempts to being highly susceptible and easily manipulated. We further demonstrate that once conversations extend beyond a single turn, model behavior becomes more distinctive and less predictable across systems. Overall, our findings indicate that each tested LLM exhibits its own characteristic form of unreliability in the context of repair.
papers.abstract_zh: 在人机对话中，修复是一种解决问题的关键手段，但在人机大语言模型交互中，这一机制却尚未得到充分研究。本研究探讨了大语言模型如何在涉及可解决和不可解决的数学问题的多轮对话中参与修复过程。我们考察了模型是否主动发起修复操作，以及它们如何回应用户发起的修复请求。研究结果表明，不同模型的反应存在显著差异：有些模型几乎完全拒绝（适当的）修复尝试，而另一些模型则非常容易受干扰且难以预测其行为。此外，我们还发现，当对话超过一轮时，不同模型的行为会变得更加独特，且难以预测。总体而言，我们的研究发现表明，每个被测试的大语言模型在修复过程中都表现出各自特有的不可靠特性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: HistLens: Mapping Idea Change across Concepts and Corpora
papers.title_zh: HistLens：在概念和语料库之间映射概念的变化
papers.authors: Yi Jing, Weiyun Qiu, Yihang Peng, Zhifang Sui
papers.abstract: Language change both reflects and shapes social processes, and the semantic evolution of foundational concepts provides a measurable trace of historical and social transformation. Despite recent advances in diachronic semantics and discourse analysis, existing computational approaches often (i) concentrate on a single concept or a single corpus, making findings difficult to compare across heterogeneous sources, and (ii) remain confined to surface lexical evidence, offering insufficient computational and interpretive granularity when concepts are expressed implicitly. We propose HistLens, a unified, SAE-based framework for multi-concept, multi-corpus conceptual-history analysis. The framework decomposes concept representations into interpretable features and tracks their activation dynamics over time and across sources, yielding comparable conceptual trajectories within a shared coordinate system. Experiments on long-span press corpora show that HistLens supports cross-concept, cross-corpus computation of patterns of idea evolution and enables implicit concept computation. By bridging conceptual modeling with interpretive needs, HistLens broadens the analytical perspectives and methodological repertoire available to social science and the humanities for diachronic text analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言的变化既反映了社会进程，也塑造了这些进程。基础概念的语义演变能够为我们提供历史和社会变迁的可测量痕迹。尽管在历时语义学和话语分析方面取得了一些进展，但现有的计算方法往往存在以下问题：其一，它们通常只关注单个概念或单一语料库，导致不同来源之间的研究结果难以比较；其二，这些方法仅依赖于表面的词汇信息，当概念以隐性形式表达时，其计算性和解释性就远远不够。我们提出了HistLens这一基于SAE的统一框架，它能够对多个概念、多个语料库中的概念历史进行综合分析。该框架将概念表征分解为可解释的特征，并追踪这些特征在不同时间和不同来源中的动态变化，从而在统一的坐标系中呈现概念的发展轨迹。通过对长篇幅新闻语料库的实验验证，我们发现HistLens能够跨概念、跨语料库地计算概念演变模式，并且能够实现隐式概念的计算。通过将概念建模与解释需求相结合，HistLens拓宽了社会科学和人文学科在进行历时文本分析时的分析视角和方法论选择。

papers.title: ReFEree: Reference-Free and Fine-Grained Method for Evaluating Factual Consistency in Real-World Code Summarization
papers.title_zh: ReFEree：一种无需参考且具有细粒度的方法，用于评估现实世界代码摘要中的事实一致性
papers.authors: Suyoung Bae, CheolWon Na, Jaehoon Lee, Yumin Lee, YunSeok Choi, Jee-Hyong Lee
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) have become capable of generating long and descriptive code summaries, accurate and reliable evaluation of factual consistency has become a critical challenge. However, previous evaluation methods are primarily designed for short summaries of isolated code snippets. Consequently, they struggle to provide fine-grained evaluation of multi-sentence functionalities and fail to accurately assess dependency context commonly found in real-world code summaries.To address this, we propose ReFEree, a reference-free and fine-grained method for evaluating factual consistency in real-world code summaries. We define factual inconsistency criteria specific to code summaries and evaluate them at the segment level using these criteria along with dependency information. These segment-level results are then aggregated into a fine-grained score. We construct a code summarization benchmark with human-annotated factual consistency labels. The evaluation results demonstrate that ReFEree achieves the highest correlation with human judgment among 13 baselines, improving 15-18% over the previous state-of-the-art. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/bsy99615/ReFEree.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型能够生成长而描述性的代码摘要，准确可靠地评估事实一致性已成为一项关键挑战。然而，以往的评价方法主要适用于对孤立代码片段的简短总结，因此难以对多句级的代码功能进行细致评估，也无法准确判断现实世界代码摘要中常见的依赖关系。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ReFEree这一无需参考基准、能够细致评估现实世界代码摘要中事实一致性的方法。我们定义了专门针对代码摘要的事实不一致性标准，并使用这些标准以及依赖信息在段落级别进行评估。这些段落级别的评估结果随后被汇总为一份细致的分数。我们还构建了一个带有人类标注的事实一致性标签的代码摘要基准测试。评估结果表明，ReFEree在13种基准方法中与人类判断的相关性最高，其性能比现有的最先进方法提升了15-18%。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/bsy99615/ReFEree.git获取。

papers.title: MeanAudio: Fast and Faithful Text-to-Audio Generation with Mean Flows
papers.title_zh: MeanAudio：基于Mean流技术的快速且高度保真度的文本转语音生成技术
papers.authors: Xiquan Li, Junxi Liu, Yuzhe Liang, Zhikang Niu, Wenxi Chen, Xie Chen
papers.abstract: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in Text-to-Audio Generation (TTA), providing sound creators with powerful tools to transform inspirations into vivid audio. Yet despite these advances, current TTA systems often suffer from slow inference speed, which greatly hinders the efficiency and smoothness of audio creation. In this paper, we present MeanAudio, a fast and faithful text-to-audio generator capable of rendering realistic sound with only one function evaluation (1-NFE). MeanAudio leverages: (i) the MeanFlow objective with guided velocity target that significantly accelerates inference speed, (ii) an enhanced Flux-style transformer with dual text encoders for better semantic alignment and synthesis quality, and (iii) an efficient instantaneous-to-mean curriculum that speeds up convergence and enables training on consumer-grade GPUs. Through a comprehensive evaluation study, we demonstrate that MeanAudio achieves state-of-the-art performance in single-step audio generation. Specifically, it achieves a real-time factor (RTF) of 0.013 on a single NVIDIA RTX 3090, yielding a 100x speedup over SOTA diffusion-based TTA systems. Moreover, MeanAudio also shows strong performance in multi-step generation, enabling smooth transitions across successive synthesis steps.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，文本转语音技术取得了显著进展，为声音创作者提供了强大的工具，使他们能够将创意转化为生动的音效。然而，尽管有这些进步，当前的文本转语音系统往往存在推理速度慢的问题，这严重影响了音频创作的效率和流畅性。在本文中，我们介绍了MeanAudio——一种快速且高效的文本转语音生成器，它仅通过一次函数评估就能生成逼真的音效。MeanAudio采用了以下技术：(i) 基于MeanFlow目标的引导速度目标，显著提升了推理速度；(ii) 改进的Flux风格变换器，配备双文本编码器，以实现更好的语义对齐和合成质量；以及(iii) 高效的从瞬时到平均的训练方法，加快了收敛速度，并支持在消费级GPU上进行训练。通过全面的评估研究，我们发现MeanAudio在单步音频生成方面达到了最先进的性能水平。具体来说，它在单个NVIDIA RTX 3090显卡上实现了0.013的实时因子，比现有的基于扩散技术的文本转语音系统快了100倍。此外，MeanAudio在多步生成方面也表现出强大的性能，能够实现连续合成步骤之间的平滑过渡。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ModeX: Evaluator-Free Best-of-N Selection for Open-Ended Generation
papers.title_zh: ModeX：无需评估器的最优选择算法，用于开放性问题生成
papers.authors: Hyeong Kyu Choi, Sharon Li
papers.abstract: Selecting a single high-quality output from multiple stochastic generations remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly in open-ended tasks where no canonical answer exists. While Best-of-N and self-consistency methods show that aggregating multiple generations can improve performance, existing approaches typically rely on external evaluators, reward models, or exact string-match voting, limiting their applicability and efficiency. We propose Mode Extraction (ModeX), an evaluator-free Best-of-N selection framework that generalizes majority voting to open-ended text generation by identifying the modal output representing the dominant semantic consensus among generated texts. ModeX constructs a similarity graph over candidate generations and recursively applies spectral clustering to select a representative centroid, without requiring additional inference or auxiliary models. We further instantiate this selection principle as ModeX Decoding, a drop-in decoding scheme with early pruning for efficiency. Across open-ended tasks—including text summarization, code generation, and mathematical reasoning—our approaches consistently outperform standard single- and multi-path baselines, providing a computationally efficient, drop-in solution for robust open-ended text generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 从多个随机生成的文本中选择出一个高质量的结果，仍然是大语言模型面临的一个基本挑战，尤其是在那些没有标准答案的开放式任务中。虽然“最佳N选一”方法和自一致性方法表明，汇总多个生成的文本可以提高性能，但现有的方法通常依赖于外部评估器、奖励模型或精确的字符串匹配投票机制，这限制了它们的适用性和效率。我们提出了ModeX这一无需评估器的“最佳N选一”选择框架，该框架通过将多数投票原理应用于开放式文本生成，来识别代表生成文本中主导语义共识的模式化输出。ModeX通过构建候选文本的相似性图，并递归应用谱聚类算法来选择一个代表性中心点，而无需额外的推理或辅助模型。我们将这一选择原则进一步具体化为ModeX解码技术，这是一种可以即时使用的解码方案，同时具备高效的提前剪枝功能。在包括文本摘要、代码生成和数学推理等开放式任务中，我们的方法始终优于传统的单路径和多路径基线方案，为开放式文本生成提供了一种计算效率高且易于使用的解决方案。

papers.title: What Makes LLMs Effective Sequential Recommenders? A Study on Preference Intensity and Temporal Context
papers.title_zh: 是什么让大型语言模型成为有效的序列推荐系统？关于偏好强度与时间背景因素的研究
papers.authors: Zhongyu Ouyang, Qianlong Wen, Chunhui Zhang, Yanfang Ye, Soroush Vosoughi
papers.abstract: What enables large language models (LLMs) to effectively model user preferences in sequential recommendation? Our investigation reveals that existing preference-alignment approaches largely rely on binary pairwise comparisons, overlooking two critical factors: preference intensity (the structured strength of affinity or aversion) and temporal context (the extent to which recent interactions better reflect a user’s current intent). Through controlled experiments, we show that leveraging comprehensive feedback with structured preference signals substantially improves recommendation performance, indicating that binary modeling discards essential information. Motivated by these findings, we propose RecPO, a unified preference optimization framework that maps both explicit and implicit feedback into a common preference signal and constructs adaptive reward margins that jointly account for preference intensity and interaction recency. Experiments across five datasets show that RecPO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while exhibiting behavioral patterns aligned with human decision-making, including favoring immediate satisfaction, maintaining preference coherence, and avoiding dispreferred items. Our results highlight that preference intensity and temporal context are fundamental ingredients for effective LLM-based recommendation. Code: https://github.com/zyouyang/RecPO
papers.abstract_zh: 是什么使得大语言模型能够在序列推荐中有效模拟用户偏好？我们的研究揭示，现有的偏好对齐方法主要依赖于二元成对比较，而忽略了两个关键因素：偏好强度（即亲和或厌恶的结构性强度）和时间背景（即最近的交互在多大程度上能反映用户的当前意图）。通过控制实验，我们发现利用包含结构化偏好信号的全面反馈可以显著提升推荐性能，这表明二元建模遗漏了重要信息。基于这些发现，我们提出了RecPO这一统一的偏好优化框架，它将显性和隐性的反馈转化为统一的偏好信号，并构建出能够同时考虑偏好强度和交互时间性的自适应奖励机制。在五个数据集上的实验表明，RecPO始终优于最先进的基线方法，同时其行为模式也与人类决策方式一致，包括倾向于立即满足用户需求、保持偏好一致性以及避免推荐不喜欢的物品。我们的研究结果表明，偏好强度和时间背景是基于大语言模型进行有效推荐的基本要素。代码链接：https://github.com/zyouyang/RecPO
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TeamFusion: Supporting Open-ended Teamwork with Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: TeamFusion：利用多智能体系统支持开放式团队协作
papers.authors: Jiale Liu, Victor Bursztyn, Lin Ai, Haoliang Wang, Sunav Choudhary, Saayan Mitra, Qingyun Wu
papers.abstract: In open-ended domains, teams must reconcile diverse viewpoints to produce strong deliverables. Answer aggregation approaches commonly used in closed domains are ill-suited to this setting, as they tend to suppress minority perspectives rather than resolve underlying disagreements. We present TeamFusion, a multi-agent system designed to support teamwork in open-ended domains by: 1. Instantiating a proxy agent for each team member conditioned on their expressed preferences; 2. Conducting a structured discussion to elicit agreements and disagreements; and 3. Synthesizing more consensus-oriented deliverables that feed into new iterations of discussion and synthesis. We evaluate TeamFusion on two teamwork tasks where team members can judge how well their individual views are represented in team decisions and how consensually good the final deliverables are, finding that it outperforms direct aggregation baselines across metrics, tasks, and team configurations.
papers.abstract_zh: 在开放式领域里，团队需要协调不同的观点以产生高质量的成果。而在封闭式领域常用的答案聚合方法并不适合这种环境，因为这些方法往往会压制少数人的观点，而不是解决根本性的分歧。我们提出了TeamFusion这一多智能体系统，它旨在支持开放式领域的团队合作，具体做法包括：1.根据每个团队成员的偏好来实例化一个代理智能体；2.进行结构化的讨论以收集各方的一致意见和分歧；3.合成更加以共识为导向的成果，这些成果可以再次用于讨论和聚合过程中。我们在两个团队合作任务上评估了TeamFusion的表现，在这些任务中，团队成员可以评价他们的个人观点在团队决策中的体现程度，以及最终成果是否达到了共识水平。结果表明，TeamFusion在各项指标、任务类型以及团队配置方面都优于传统的直接聚合方法。

papers.title: FormulaSPIN: Self-Play Fine-Tuning for Natural Language to Spreadsheet Formula Generation
papers.title_zh: FormulaSPIN：用于自然语言与表格公式自动生成的自我博弈优化技术
papers.authors: Cy Xie
papers.abstract: Spreadsheet applications are used by hundreds of millions worldwide, yet writing formulas remains a significant barrier. Existing approaches rely on static supervised data, which quickly saturates on limited annotations. In this paper, we introduce FormulaSPIN, a self-play framework that breaks the ceiling of supervised fine-tuning by enabling iterative self-improvement without any additional data. Vanilla SPIN fails on this task: it uniformly penalizes every non-matching output, so execution-equivalent alternatives are pushed down as negatives in one example while serving as ground truth in another, producing contradictory gradients. Our framework resolves this by exploiting formula generation’s unique advantage: binary executability provides implicit supervision that separates semantic errors from valid stylistic variants. We frame training as a two-player game in which the main player learns to prefer ground-truth formulas over those from its previous version, while execution feedback sorts outputs into distinct granularities—enabling an adaptive curriculum that shifts from semantic correctness to stylistic refinement. To further increase accuracy, we incorporate ExecVote, a semantic-level voting mechanism that naturally handles multiple valid formulations. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FormulaSPIN achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 74.9% exact match and 87.1% execution accuracy on NL2FORMULA, matching models trained with additional preference annotations while outperforming both traditional SFT and frontier proprietary models. These findings underscore self-play’s potential to tackle scarce data tasks and open the door to extending it beyond executable domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 全球有数亿用户使用电子表格应用程序，但编写公式仍然是一个巨大的障碍。现有的方法依赖于静态的监督数据，而这些数据的注释往往非常有限。在本文中，我们提出了FormulaSPIN这一自玩框架，它通过实现迭代自我改进来突破监督微调的瓶颈，而无需额外的数据。传统的SPIN模型在这个任务上会失败：它会统一惩罚所有不符合要求的输出结果，因此在某些示例中，执行等效的替代方案会被视为负面结果，而在其他示例中则作为真实值使用，从而产生矛盾性的梯度信息。我们的框架通过利用公式生成的独特优势来解决这个问题：二进制可执行性提供了一种隐式的监督机制，可以将语义错误与有效的风格变体区分开来。我们将训练过程描述成一个两人游戏，其中主玩家学会优先选择真实公式，而不是之前版本中的公式；同时，执行反馈可以将输出结果按不同的粒度进行排序，从而实现从语义正确性到风格精炼的自适应学习过程。为了进一步提高准确性，我们引入了ExecVote这一语义级投票机制，它能够自然地处理多种有效的公式形式。在多个基准测试上的实验表明，FormulaSPIN取得了顶尖的性能表现，在NL2FORMULA任务上的精确匹配率为74.9%，执行准确率达到了87.1%。这一成绩与那些需要额外偏好注释进行训练的模型相当，同时优于传统的监督学习方法以及前沿的专有模型。这些发现凸显了自玩技术在处理数据稀缺任务方面的潜力，并为将其应用范围扩展到可执行领域之外打开了大门。

papers.title: Stable Signer: Hierarchical Sign Language Generative Model
papers.title_zh: 稳定签名者：分层手语生成模型
papers.authors: Sen Fang, Yalin Feng, Hongbin Zhong, Yanxin Zhang, Dimitris N. Metaxas
papers.abstract: Sign Language Production (SLP) is the process of converting the complex input text into a real video. Most previous works focused on the Text2Gloss, Gloss2Pose, Pose2Vid stages, and some concentrated on Prompt2Gloss and Text2Avatar stages. However, this field has made slow progress due to the inaccuracy of text conversion, pose generation, and the rendering of poses into real human videos in these stages, resulting in gradually accumulating errors. Therefore, in this paper, we streamline the traditional redundant structure, simplify and optimize the task objective, and design a new sign language generative model called Stable Signer. It redefines the SLP task as a hierarchical generation end-to-end task that only includes text understanding (Prompt2Gloss, Text2Gloss) and Pose2Vid, and executes text understanding through our proposed new Sign Language Understanding Linker called SLUL, and generates hand gestures through the named SLP-MoE hand gesture rendering expert block to end-to-end generate high-quality and multi-style sign language videos. SLUL is trained using the newly developed Semantic-Aware Gloss Masking Loss (SAGM Loss). Its performance has improved by 48.6% compared to the current SOTA generation methods, which is a significant increase in the SLP field.
papers.abstract_zh: 手语生成（SLP）是将复杂的输入文本转换为真实视频的过程。以往的研究主要集中在Text2Gloss、Gloss2Pose和Pose2Vid三个阶段，还有一些研究专注于Prompt2Gloss和Text2Avatar阶段。然而，由于这些阶段的文本转换不准确、姿态生成不准确，以及姿态渲染为真实人类视频的过程存在缺陷，导致错误逐渐累积。因此，在本文中，我们简化了传统冗长的结构，简化并优化了任务目标，并设计了一个名为Stable Signer的新手语生成模型。我们将SLP任务重新定义为一个分层生成的端到端任务，该任务仅包括文本理解（Prompt2Gloss、Text2Gloss）和Pose2Vid两个步骤。通过我们提出的新的手语理解链接器SLUL来执行文本理解，并通过名为SLP-MoE的手势渲染专家模块来生成手势，从而实现端到端生成高质量且多风格的手语视频。SLUL采用了新开发的语义感知遮罩损失函数进行训练。与当前最先进的生成方法相比，其性能提升了48.6%，这在手语生成领域是一个显著的进步。

papers.title: DisCal: Distribution-Aware Calibration for Mathematical Reasoning Under Character-Level Noisy Inputs
papers.title_zh: DisCal：针对字符级噪声输入条件下的数学推理的分布式校准方法
papers.authors: Bo Zhang, Jiawei Zhang, Cong Gao, Bingxu Han, Minghao Hu, Jun Zhang, Yunbo Cao, Zhunchen Luo, Wen Yao, Guotong Geng, Zhong Wang
papers.abstract: Although large reasoning models (LRMs) exhibit exceptional mathematical reasoning capabilities on clean inputs, their reasoning accuracy drops substantially in the presence of character-level noise such as typographical errors. Critically, their confidence estimates fail to reflect the corresponding decline in reasoning accuracy. While confidence calibration offers a principled solution, existing methods predominantly target clean inputs, leaving noisy scenarios largely unexplored. To address this gap, we propose DisCal (Distribution-aware Calibration), a confidence calibration framework for character-level noisy inputs. DisCal extracts uncertainty signals from both the empirical answer distribution and the model’s predictive distribution, and integrates them via a learned calibrator to produce well-calibrated confidence. Experiments across multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DisCal consistently outperforms existing calibration methods under noisy inputs, reducing Expected Calibration Error (ECE) by up to 39.21% and improving Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC) by up to 31.44%.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大型推理模型在清晰输入上展现出卓越的数学推理能力，但在存在字符级噪声（如印刷错误）的情况下，其推理准确性会显著下降。关键问题是，模型的置信度估计未能反映出推理准确性的相应下降。虽然置信度校准提供了一种有原则的解决方案，但现有方法主要针对清晰输入，而忽略了噪声环境下的情况。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了DisCal（分布式置信度校准）框架，该框架适用于字符级噪声输入的情况。DisCal从经验答案分布和模型的预测分布中提取不确定性信号，并通过学习到的校准器将它们整合起来，从而产生经过良好校准的置信度。在多个数学推理基准测试中的实验表明，DisCal在噪声输入环境下始终优于现有的校准方法，能够将预期校准误差降低多达39.21%，同时提高接收者操作特征曲线下的面积（AUROC）高达31.44%。

papers.title: SARA: Selective and Adaptive Retrieval-augmented Generation with Context Compression
papers.title_zh: SARA：选择性与适应性检索增强生成技术，结合上下文压缩功能
papers.authors: Yiqiao Jin, Kartik Sharma, Vineeth Rakesh, Yingtong Dou, Menghai Pan, Mahashweta Das, Srijan Kumar
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) extends large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, but it must balance limited effective context, redundant retrieved evidence, and the loss of fine-grained facts under aggressive compression. Pure compression-based approaches reduce input size but often discard fine-grained details essential for factual accuracy. We propose SARA, a hybrid RAG framework that targets answer quality under fixed token budgets by combining natural-language snippets with semantic compression vectors. SARA retains a small set of passages in text form to preserve entities and numerical values, compresses the remaining evidence into interpretable vectors for broader coverage, and uses those vectors for iterative evidence reranking. Across 9 datasets and 5 open-source LLMs spanning 3 model families (Mistral, Llama, and Gemma), SARA consistently improves answer relevance (+17.71), answer correctness (+13.72), and semantic similarity (+15.53), demonstrating the importance of integrating textual and compressed representations for robust, context-efficient RAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术通过引入外部知识来扩展大语言模型的能力，但需要在有限的上下文信息、冗余的检索结果以及压缩过程中丢失的细粒度事实之间找到平衡。纯基于压缩的方法虽然能减少输入数据量，但却常常会忽略对准确性至关重要的细粒度细节。我们提出了SARA这一混合式RAG框架，该框架通过将自然语言片段与语义压缩向量相结合，在固定的标记预算下提升答案质量。SARA保留了少量文本形式的段落以保留实体和数值信息，并将剩余的内容压缩成可解释的向量形式以实现更广泛的覆盖，同时利用这些向量进行迭代性的证据重新排序。在涵盖3种模型家族（Mistral、Llama和Gemma）的9个数据集和5个开源LLM上进行的测试中，SARA始终能够提升答案的相关性（+17.71）、正确性（+13.72）以及语义相似性（+15.53），这充分证明了将文本表示和压缩表示相结合对于构建高效、上下文敏感的RAG系统的重要性。
