papers.title: FinChain: A Symbolic Benchmark for Verifiable Chain-of-Thought Financial Reasoning
papers.title_zh: FinChain：一种用于验证性思维链金融推理的模拟基准平台
papers.authors: Zhuohan Xie, Daniil Orel, Rushil Thareja, Dhruv Sahnan, Hachem Madmoun, Fan Zhang, Debopriyo Banerjee, Georgi Nenkov Georgiev, Xueqing Peng, Lingfei Qian, Jimin Huang, Jinyan Su, Aaryamonvikram Singh, Rui Xing, Rania Elbadry, Chen Xu, Haonan Li, Fajri Koto, Ivan Koychev, Tanmoy Chakraborty, Yuxia Wang, Salem Lahlou, Veselin Stoyanov, Sophia Ananiadou, Preslav Nakov
papers.abstract: Multi-step symbolic reasoning is essential for robust financial analysis; yet, current benchmarks largely overlook this capability. Existing datasets such as FinQA and ConvFinQA emphasize final numerical answers while neglecting the intermediate reasoning steps required for transparency and verification. To address this gap, we introduce FinChain, the first benchmark specifically designed for verifiable Chain-of-Thought evaluation in finance. FinChain spans 58 topics across 12 financial domains, each represented by parameterized symbolic templates with executable Python code that enable fully machine-verifiable reasoning and scalable, contamination-free data generation.To assess reasoning capacity, we propose ChainEval, a dynamic alignment measure that jointly evaluates both the final-answer correctness and the step-level reasoning consistency. Our evaluation of 26 leading LLMs reveals that even frontier LLMs exhibit clear limitations in symbolic financial reasoning, while domain-adapted and math-enhanced fine-tuned models can substantially narrow this gap.Overall, FinChain exposes persistent weaknesses in multi-step financial reasoning and provides a foundation for developing trustworthy, interpretable, and verifiable financial AI. This project is available at https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/finchain.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 多步骤符号推理对于稳健的金融分析至关重要；然而，当前的评估基准大多忽略了这一能力。现有的数据集如FinQA和ConvFinQA主要强调最终的数值答案，而忽视了实现透明性和验证所需的中间推理步骤。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了FinChain——首个专为可验证的金融思维链评估而设计的基准测试。FinChain涵盖了12个金融领域的58个主题，每个主题都由参数化的符号模板表示，并包含可执行的Python代码，从而实现完全机器可验证的推理以及可扩展且无污染的数据生成。为了评估推理能力，我们提出了ChainEval这一动态对齐指标，该指标能够同时评估最终答案的正确性和各步骤间的推理一致性。我们对26种领先大语言模型的评估显示，即使是前沿的大语言模型在符号化金融推理方面也存在明显局限，而经过领域适配和数学增强的微调模型则能够显著缩小这一差距。总体而言，FinChain揭示了多步骤金融推理中的持续弱点，为开发可信、可解释且可验证的金融人工智能提供了基础。该项目可以在https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/finchain.git获取。

papers.title: AI use in American newspapers is widespread, uneven, and rarely disclosed
papers.title_zh: 美国报纸中人工智能的应用非常普遍，但分布并不均衡，而且这些应用的情况很少被公开报道
papers.authors: Jenna Russell, Marzena Karpinska, Destiny Akinode, James Zhou, Katherine Thai, Bradley Emi, Max Spero, Mohit Iyyer
papers.abstract: AI is rapidly transforming journalism, but the extent of its use in published newspaper articles remains unclear. We address this gap by auditing a large-scale dataset of 186K articles from online editions of 1.5K American newspapers published in the summer of 2025. Using Pangram, a state-of-the-art AI detector, we discover that approximately 9% of newly-published articles are either partially or fully AI-generated. This AI use is unevenly distributed, appearing more frequently in smaller, local outlets, in specific topics such as weather and technology, and within certain ownership groups. We also analyze 45K opinion pieces from Washington Post, New York Times, and Wall Street Journal, finding that they are 6.4 times more likely to contain AI-generated content than news articles from the same publications, with many AI-flagged op-eds authored by prominent public figures. Despite this prevalence, we find that AI use is rarely disclosed: a manual audit of 100 AI-flagged articles found only five disclosures of AI use. A factuality analysis shows AI-generated articles are 8.2 times more likely to contain hallucinated claims than human-written news. Overall, our audit highlights the immediate need for greater transparency and updated editorial standards regarding the use of AI in journalism to maintain public trust.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能正在迅速改变新闻业，但它在报纸文章中的使用程度仍不明确。为了填补这一空白，我们对2025年夏季从1500家美国报纸的在线版块中收集到的18.6万篇文章进行了大规模分析。通过使用先进的AI检测工具Pangram，我们发现大约9%的新发表文章要么部分由人工智能生成，要么完全由人工智能生成。这种人工智能的使用分布并不均匀，更常见于小型地方媒体机构，特别是在天气和技术等特定主题上，以及某些所有权集团旗下的媒体中。我们还分析了《华盛顿邮报》、《纽约时报》和《华尔街日报》的4.5万篇评论文章，发现这些评论文章中包含人工智能生成内容的可能性是同一出版物中新闻文章的6.4倍。许多由知名公众人物撰写的评论文章都包含人工智能生成的内容。尽管人工智能的使用如此普遍，但我们发现很少有人公开说明他们使用了人工智能：对100篇被标记为含有人工智能生成的文章的手动审核中，只有五篇提到了人工智能的使用情况。事实分析表明，人工智能生成的文章中包含虚假陈述的可能性是人工撰写的新闻文章的8.2倍。总体而言，我们的审计表明，为了维持公众的信任，迫切需要提高关于人工智能在新闻业中使用的透明度和更新编辑标准。

papers.title: For-Value: Efficient Forward-Only Data Valuation for finetuning LLMs and VLMs
papers.title_zh: 价值计算：高效的前向数据估值方法，用于微调大型语言模型和视觉语言模型
papers.authors: Wenlong Deng, Qi Zeng, Jiaming Zhang, Minghui Chen, Zixin Ding, Christos Thrampoulidis, Boying Gong, Xiaoxiao Li
papers.abstract: Data valuation is essential for enhancing the transparency and accountability of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, existing methods typically rely on gradient computations, making them computationally prohibitive for billion-parameter models and precluding batch parallelization. In this work, we introduce For-Value, a forward-only data valuation framework that enables efficient batch-scalable value estimation while maintaining effectiveness. Leveraging the expressive power of pretrained LLMs/VLMs, we theoretically demonstrate that data valuation can be captured by the alignment between the final hidden representations and prediction errors at the last layer. In light of this insight, For-Value computes data value using a simple closed-form expression with a single forward pass, eliminating the need for costly backpropagation and enabling efficient batch calculating at scale. Extensive experiments show that For-Value matches or outperforms gradient-based baselines in detecting influential data and mislabeled data, while achieving significant efficiency improvements.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据估值对于提高大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）的透明度和问责性至关重要。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于梯度计算，这使得对数十亿参数的模型来说计算成本过高，且无法实现批量并行处理。在这项研究中，我们提出了For-Value框架，这是一种仅使用前向计算的数据估值方法，它能够在不影响效果的情况下实现高效的批量估值。通过利用预训练的LLM/VLM的强大表达能力，我们从理论上证明了数据估值的计算可以通过最后一层隐藏表示与预测误差之间的对齐来实现。基于这一原理，For-Value通过简单的封闭形式表达式进行数据估值计算，只需一次前向传播即可完成，从而避免了昂贵的反向传播过程，并实现了大规模范围内的高效批量计算。大量实验表明，For-Value在检测有影响力数据和错误标注数据方面，其性能达到或优于基于梯度的基线方法，同时还能显著提高计算效率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Illusion of Specialization: Unveiling the Domain-Invariant "Standing Committee" in Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.title_zh: 专业化的幻觉：揭示出在专家混合模型中的领域不变“常务委员会”机制
papers.authors: Yan Wang, Yitao Xu, Nanhan Shen, Jinyan Su, Jimin Huang, Zining Zhu
papers.abstract: Mixture of Experts models are widely assumed to achieve domain specialization through sparse routing. In this work, we question this assumption by introducing COMMITTEEAUDIT, a post hoc framework that analyzes routing behavior at the level of expert groups rather than individual experts. Across three representative models and the MMLU benchmark, we uncover a domain invariant Standing Committee. This is a compact coalition of routed experts that consistently captures the majority of routing mass across domains, layers, and routing budgets, even when architectures already include shared experts. Qualitative analysis further shows that Standing Committees anchor reasoning structure and syntax, while peripheral experts handle domain-specific knowledge. These findings reveal a strong structural bias toward centralized computation, suggesting that specialization in Mixture of Experts models is far less pervasive than commonly believed. Crucially, this inherent bias indicates that current training objectives, such as load-balancing losses that enforce uniform expert utilization, may be working against the model’s natural optimization path, thereby limiting training efficiency and performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 混合专家模型通常被认为通过稀疏路由来实现领域专业化。在这项研究中，我们通过引入COMMITTEEAUDIT这一框架来质疑这一假设。该框架能够分析专家群体层面的路由行为，而非单个专家的行为。通过对三个代表性模型以及MMLU基准测试的分析，我们发现了一个具有领域不变性的常设委员会结构。这个常设委员会是由一组路由专家组成的紧凑联盟，无论在不同领域、层次或路由预算下，都能持续占据大部分路由任务，即使架构中已经包含了共享专家。定性分析还表明，常设委员会负责构建推理结构和语法规则，而边缘专家则处理特定领域的知识。这些发现揭示了一种强烈的结构性偏向，即计算方式更倾向于集中化。这意味着混合专家模型中的专业化程度远不如人们普遍认为的那么普遍。重要的是，这种固有的偏向表明，当前的训练目标，比如强制均匀分配专家资源的负载均衡策略，可能会阻碍模型的自然优化过程，从而限制训练的效率和性能。

papers.title: Find Your Optimal Teacher: Personalized Data Synthesis via Router-Guided Multi-Teacher Distillation
papers.title_zh: 找到最适合你的老师：通过路由引导的多位老师协同工作来实现个性化数据整合
papers.authors: Hengyuan Zhang, Shiping Yang, Xiao Liang, Chenming Shang, Yuxuan Jiang, Chaofan Tao, Jing Xiong, Hayden Kwok-Hay So, Ruobing Xie, Angel X. Chang, Ngai Wong
papers.abstract: Training student models on synthetic data generated by strong teacher models is a promising approach to distilling the capabilities of teachers. However, existing studies reveal that stronger models are not always optimal teachers, suggesting a mismatch between the teacher’s output and the student’s learning ability. To address this issue, we propose PerSyn (Personalized data Synthesis), a novel and efficient approach that customizes synthetic data to align with the learning capabilities of the student model. Specifically, our PerSyn method routes each prompt to its optimal teacher via a query-level router that jointly considers the student models’ learnability and teacher models’ response quality. It successfully transfers the synthesis paradigm from the conventional “Generate then Select” to a more efficient manner, i.e., “Route then Generate”, eliminating the need for all teacher models to generate parallel responses across the entire prompt set. Extensive experiments across different model families and scales demonstrate that PerSyn consistently outperforms all baselines on six benchmarks, including instruct tuning and math reasoning settings. Further analysis verifies the effectiveness of PerSyn and offers extra insights to propel future research. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PerSyn-8D85.
papers.abstract_zh: 在由强大的教师模型生成的合成数据上训练学生模型，是一种有效提取教师能力的途径。然而，现有研究表明，更强的模型并不总是最佳的教师模型，这说明教师模型的输出与学生学习能力之间存在不匹配现象。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PerSyn算法——一种新颖且高效的解决方案。该算法能够定制合成数据，使其与学生的学习能力相匹配。具体来说，我们的PerSyn方法通过查询级路由机制，将每个提示分配给最合适的教师模型，同时考虑学生模型的可学习性以及教师模型的响应质量。这一方法成功地将合成范式从传统的“生成后再选择”模式，转变为更高效的“先路由再生成”模式，从而避免了所有教师模型需要为整个提示集生成并行响应的情况。在不同模型家族和规模上的广泛实验表明，PerSyn在六个基准测试中的表现始终优于所有基线算法，包括指令调整和数学推理任务。进一步的分析验证了PerSyn的有效性，并为未来的研究提供了宝贵的启示。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PerSyn-8D85获取。

papers.title: Single-Pass, Depth-Selective Reading for Multi-Aspect Sentiment Analysis
papers.title_zh: 单通道、深度选择性阅读方法在多维度情感分析中的应用
papers.authors: Yan Xia, Zhuangzhuang Pan, Amirrudin Kamsin, Chee Seng Chan
papers.abstract: Aspect-Term Sentiment Analysis (ATSA) in multi-aspect sentences faces a fundamental tradeoff between efficiency and expressiveness. Existing models either re-encode the sentence for each aspect or rely on static use of deep representations, leading to redundant computation and limited adaptivity. We argue that Transformer depth is a costly, queryable resource, and propose DABS, a single-pass inference framework that encodes each sentence once to construct a reusable, depth-ordered substrate. Each aspect then queries this shared representation to selectively read relevant tokens and abstraction levels, without re-encoding. This decouples shared sentence encoding from lightweight, aspect-conditioned readout. Experiments on four ATSA benchmarks show that DABS achieves competitive performance while reducing end-to-end computation by up to 60% in multi-aspect settings (M \ge 2). Further analyses indicate that adaptive depth querying is most beneficial for linguistically complex cases such as negation and contrast. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/panzhzh/acl-dabs.
papers.abstract_zh: 多维度句子中的Aspect-Term Sentiment分析（ATSA）面临着效率与表达力之间的根本权衡问题。现有的模型要么需要为每个维度重新编码句子，要么依赖静态的深度表示，这会导致计算冗余且适应性有限。我们认为Transformer的深度是一种成本高昂、难以查询的资源，因此提出了DABS这一单步推理框架。该框架通过一次性对句子进行编码，从而构建出一个可重复使用的、按深度排序的表示层。随后，每个维度只需查询这个共享表示层，就可以选择性地读取相关的标记和抽象层次，而无需重新编码。这样，共享的句子编码与轻量级的、基于维度的读取过程就分离了。在四个ATSA基准测试上的实验表明，DABS在减少端到端计算量的同时，仍能取得具有竞争力的性能，其计算量最多可减少60%（当维度数量大于等于2时）。进一步的分析表明，自适应深度查询对于处理复杂的语言现象（如否定和对比）更为有效。该代码的详细信息可以在https://github.com/panzhzh/acl-dabs上查看。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: PARASITE: Conditional System Prompt Poisoning to Hijack LLMs
papers.title_zh: 寄生虫：一种能够劫持大语言模型的 Conditional System 提示中毒机制
papers.authors: Viet Pham, Thai Le
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed via third-party system prompts downloaded from public marketplaces. We identify a critical supply-chain vulnerability: conditional system prompt poisoning, where an adversary injects a sleeper agent into a benign-looking prompt. Unlike traditional jailbreaks that aim for broad refusal-breaking, our proposed framework, PARASITE, optimizes system prompts to trigger LLMs to output targeted, compromised responses only for specific queries (e.g., “Who should I vote for the US President?”) while maintaining high utility on benign inputs. Operating in a strict black-box setting without model weight access, PARASITE utilizes a two-stage optimization including a global semantic search followed by a greedy lexical refinement. Tested on open-source models and commercial APIs (GPT-4o-mini, GPT-3.5), PARASITE achieves up to 70% F1 reduction on targeted queries with minimal degradation to general capabilities. We further demonstrate that these poisoned prompts evade standard defenses, including perplexity filters and typo-correction, by exploiting the natural noise found in real-world system prompts.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地通过从公共市场下载的第三方系统提示来部署。我们发现了一个关键的供应链漏洞：条件性系统提示中毒问题，即攻击者将一个“潜伏代理”注入到看似无害的系统中。与那些旨在实现广泛破解的传统越狱方法不同，我们提出的框架PARASITE能够优化系统提示，使LLM仅针对特定查询生成有针对性的、被篡改的响应（例如，“我应该投票给谁担任美国总统？”），同时仍能在无害输入上保持较高的实用性。由于PARASITE在严格的无模型权重访问环境下运行，它采用了两阶段优化策略：首先进行全局语义搜索，然后进行贪婪的词汇细化处理。在开源模型和商业API（如GPT-4o-mini、GPT-3.5）上进行测试时，PARASITE在针对特定查询的情况下实现了高达70%的F1值提升，而整体性能则几乎没有下降。我们还证明了这些被篡改的提示能够绕过标准防御措施，包括困惑度过滤和拼写校正，因为它们利用了现实世界系统提示中存在的自然噪声。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Generating Literature-Driven Scientific Theories at Scale
papers.title_zh: 大规模生成以文献为基础的科学理论
papers.authors: Peter Jansen, Peter Clark, Doug Downey, Daniel S Weld
papers.abstract: Contemporary automated scientific discovery has focused on agents for generating scientific experiments, while systems that perform higher-level scientific activities such as theory building remain underexplored. In this work, we formulate the problem of synthesizing theories consisting of qualitative and quantitative laws from large corpora of scientific literature. We study theory generation at scale, using 13.7k source papers to synthesize 2.9k theories, examining how generation using literature-grounding versus parametric knowledge, and accuracy-focused versus novelty-focused generation objectives change theory properties. Our experiments show that, compared to using parametric LLM memory for generation, our literature-supported method creates theories that are significantly better at both matching existing evidence and at predicting future results from 4.6k subsequently-written papers.
papers.abstract_zh: 当代的自动化科学发现主要集中在用于生成科学实验的代理上，而那些能够执行更高层次科学活动（如理论构建）的系统则尚未得到充分探索。在这项研究中，我们提出了从大量科学文献中合成包含定性和定量规律的理论的问题。我们通过使用13.7千篇源论文来合成2.9千条理论，研究在大规模上进行理论生成的机制。我们探讨了基于文献生成与基于参数生成的方式、以及以准确性为导向与以新颖性为导向的生成目标对理论属性的影响。实验结果表明，与利用参数化的大语言模型进行生成相比，我们的基于文献的方法所生成的理论在符合现有证据方面表现更优，并且在预测随后撰写的4.6千篇论文的结果方面也更为有效。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Controllable Memory Usage: Balancing Anchoring and Innovation in Long-Term Human–Agent Interaction
papers.title_zh: 可控制的记忆使用：在长期的人类与智能体交互中平衡依赖性与创新性的结合
papers.authors: Zisu Huang, Muzhao Tian, Xiaohua Wang, Jingwen Xu, Zhengkang Guo, Qi Qian, Kaitao Song, Jiakang Yuan, Changze Lv, Xiaoqing Zheng
papers.abstract: As LLM-based agents are increasingly used in long-term interactions, cumulative memory is critical for enabling personalization and maintaining stylistic consistency. However, most existing systems adopt an “all-or-nothing” approach to memory usage: incorporating all relevant past information can lead to Memory Anchoring, where the agent is trapped by past interactions, while excluding memory entirely results in under-utilization and the loss of important interaction history. We show that an agent’s reliance on memory can be modeled as an explicit and user-controllable dimension. We first introduce a behavioral metric of memory dependence to quantify the influence of past interactions on current outputs. We then propose Steerable Memory Agent, SteeM, a framework that allows users to dynamically regulate memory reliance, ranging from a fresh-start mode that promotes innovation to a high-fidelity mode that closely follows interaction history. Experiments across different scenarios demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms conventional prompting and rigid memory masking strategies, yielding a more nuanced and effective control for personalized human-agent collaboration.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着基于大语言模型的智能体在长期交互中的广泛应用，累积记忆对于实现个性化体验和保持风格一致性至关重要。然而，大多数现有系统都采用一种“全有或全无”的记忆使用方式：完全整合所有相关的过往信息会导致记忆锚定现象，使智能体受到过去交互的束缚；而完全排除记忆则会导致记忆资源的浪费以及重要交互历史的丢失。我们提出，智能体对记忆的依赖可以作为一个明确且可由用户控制的维度来加以建模。我们首先引入了一种记忆依赖性的行为度量指标，以量化过去交互对当前输出的影响。随后，我们提出了“可调节记忆智能体”这一框架，该框架允许用户动态调节对记忆的依赖程度，从促进创新的初始模式到紧密遵循交互历史的高保真模式。在不同场景下的实验表明，我们的方法始终优于传统的提示方式和僵化的记忆屏蔽策略，为个性化的人机协作提供了更加精细和有效的控制手段。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Digitizing Nepal’s Written Heritage: A Comprehensive HTR Pipeline for Old Nepali Manuscripts
papers.title_zh: 将尼泊尔的文字遗产数字化：针对古老尼泊尔手稿的全面HTR处理方案
papers.authors: Anjali Sarawgi, Esteban Garces Arias, Christof Zotter
papers.abstract: This paper presents the first end-to-end pipeline for Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) for Old Nepali, a historically significant but low-resource language. We adopt a line-level transcription approach and systematically explore encoder-decoder architectures and data-centric techniques to improve recognition accuracy. Our best model achieves a Character Error Rate (CER) of 4.9%. In addition, we implement and evaluate decoding strategies and analyze token-level confusions to better understand model behavior and error patterns. Although the evaluation dataset is confidential, we release our training code, model configurations, and evaluation scripts to support further research on HTR for low-resource historical scripts.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了首个用于古尼泊尔语手写文字识别的端到端流程。古尼泊尔语是一种具有历史意义但资源匮乏的语言。我们采用了线级转录方法，并系统地探索了编码器-解码器架构和以数据为中心的技术，以提高识别准确率。我们的最佳模型达到了4.9%的字符错误率。此外，我们还实现了并评估了解码策略，分析了令牌级别的混淆情况，以更好地理解模型的行为和错误模式。尽管评估数据集属于机密信息，但我们还是公开了我们的训练代码、模型配置以及评估脚本，以支持对低资源历史脚本的手写文字识别进行进一步研究。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: XMark: Reliable Multi-Bit Watermarking for LLM-Generated Texts
papers.title_zh: XMark：适用于大型语言模型生成文本的可靠多比特水印技术
papers.authors: Jiahao Xu, Rui Hu, Olivera Kotevska, Zikai Zhang
papers.abstract: Multi-bit watermarking has emerged as a promising solution for embedding imperceptible binary messages into Large Language Model (LLM)-generated text, enabling reliable attribution and tracing of malicious usage of LLMs. Despite recent progress, existing methods still face key limitations: some become computationally infeasible for large messages, while others suffer from a poor trade-off between text quality and decoding accuracy. Moreover, the decoding accuracy of existing methods drops significantly when the number of tokens in the generated text is limited, a condition that frequently arises in practical usage. To address these challenges, we propose XMark, a novel method for encoding and decoding binary messages in LLM-generated texts. The unique design of XMark’s encoder produces a less distorted logit distribution for watermarked token generation, preserving text quality, and also enables its tailored decoder to reliably recover the encoded message with limited tokens. Extensive experiments across diverse downstream tasks show that XMark significantly improves decoding accuracy while preserving the quality of watermarked text, outperforming prior methods. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 多比特水印技术已成为将难以察觉的二进制信息嵌入到大语言模型生成的文本中的有效解决方案，从而能够可靠地追踪语言模型的恶意使用行为。尽管最近取得了一些进展，但现有方法仍然存在关键限制：有些方法在处理大量信息时会导致计算成本过高，而另一些方法则在文本质量与解码精度之间产生了不良权衡。此外，当生成文本中的标记数量有限时，现有方法的解码精度会显著下降，这种情况在实际使用中经常会出现。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了XMark这一新方法，用于编码和解码大语言模型生成的文本中的二进制信息。XMark编码器的独特设计使得水印信息的生成过程中，文本质量得到更好的保留，同时其定制化的解码器能够在使用有限标记的情况下，可靠地恢复编码后的信息。通过在不同下游任务上的广泛实验表明，XMark在提高解码精度的同时，还能保持水印文本的质量，其性能优于以往的方法。该代码的实现方式将在项目被正式接受后公开提供。

papers.title: Believing without Seeing: Quality Scores for Contextualizing Vision-Language Model Explanations
papers.title_zh: 相信而不看见：用于情境化视语模型解释的评分系统
papers.authors: Keyu He, Tejas Srinivasan, Brihi Joshi, Xiang Ren, Jesse Thomason, Swabha Swayamdipta
papers.abstract: When people query Vision-Language Models (VLMs) but cannot see the accompanying visual context (e.g. for blind and low-vision users), augmenting VLM predictions with natural language explanations can signal which model predictions are reliable. However, prior work has found that explanations can easily convince users that inaccurate VLM predictions are correct. To remedy undesirable overreliance on VLM predictions, we propose evaluating two complementary qualities of VLM-generated explanations via two quality scoring functions. We propose Visual Fidelity, which captures how faithful an explanation is to the visual context, and Contrastiveness, which captures how well the explanation identifies visual details that distinguish the model’s prediction from plausible alternatives. On the A-OKVQA, VizWiz, and MMMU-Pro tasks, these quality scoring functions are better calibrated with model correctness than existing explanation qualities. We conduct a user study in which participants have to decide whether a VLM prediction is accurate without viewing its visual context. We observe that showing our quality scores alongside VLM explanations improves participants’ accuracy at predicting VLM correctness by 11.1%, including a 15.4% reduction in the rate of falsely believing incorrect predictions. These findings highlight the utility of explanation quality scores in fostering appropriate reliance on VLM predictions.
papers.abstract_zh: 当人们查询视觉语言模型时，如果无法看到相关的视觉上下文信息（例如对于盲人或视力不佳的用户来说），那么通过自然语言解释来增强视觉语言模型的预测结果，可以表明哪些模型预测是可靠的。然而，先前的研究发现，解释很容易让用户误以为不准确的视觉语言模型预测是正确的。为了克服对视觉语言模型预测过度依赖的问题，我们提出了通过两种质量评分函数来评估视觉语言模型生成的解释的两个互补属性。我们提出了“视觉忠实度”这一指标，用于衡量解释与视觉上下文的忠实程度；同时提出了“对比性”这一指标，用于衡量解释在识别能够区分模型预测与合理替代方案的视觉细节方面的能力。在A-OKVQA、VizWiz和MMMU-Pro任务中，这些质量评分函数比现有的解释质量指标更能准确反映模型的正确性。我们进行了用户研究，参与者需要在不查看视觉上下文的情况下判断视觉语言模型的预测是否正确。研究发现，在展示质量评分的同时给出视觉语言模型的解释后，参与者判断模型预测正确性的准确率提高了11.1%，其中错误相信不正确预测的情况减少了15.4%。这些研究结果凸显了解释质量评分在促进人们对视觉语言模型预测的正确依赖方面的重要性。

papers.title: MONETA: Multimodal Industry Classification through Geographic Information with Multi Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 蒙内塔：利用地理信息与多智能体系统实现的多模态行业分类
papers.authors: Arda Yüksel, Gabriel Thiem, Susanne Walter, Patrick Felka, Gabriela Alves Werb, Ivan Habernal
papers.abstract: Industry classification schemes are integral parts of public and corporate databases as they classify businesses based on economic activity. Due to the size of the company registers, manual annotation is costly, and fine-tuning models with every update in industry classification schemes requires significant data collection. We replicate the manual expert verification by using existing or easily retrievable multimodal resources for industry classification. We present MONETA, the first multimodal industry classification benchmark with text (Website, Wikipedia, Wikidata) and geospatial sources (OpenStreetMap and satellite imagery). Our dataset enlists 1,000 businesses in Europe with 20 economic activity labels according to EU guidelines (NACE). Our training-free baseline reaches 62.10% and 74.10% with open and closed-source Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM). We observe an increase of up to 22.80% with the combination of multi-turn design, context enrichment, and classification explanations. We will release our dataset and the enhanced guidelines.
papers.abstract_zh: 行业分类方案是公共数据库和企业数据库的重要组成部分，因为它们根据经济活动对企业进行分类。由于公司登记册的数据量巨大，人工标注成本很高，而随着行业分类方案的更新，不断微调模型需要大量的数据收集工作。我们通过使用现有的或易于获取的多模态资源来替代人工专家验证方式。我们提出了MONETA这一首个多模态行业分类基准测试，该测试结合了文本（网站、维基百科、维基数据）和地理空间资源（OpenStreetMap和卫星图像）。我们的数据集包含了欧洲1000家企业的数据，这些企业具有根据欧盟指南（NACE）定义的20种经济活动标签。无需训练的基线模型分别达到了62.10%和74.10%，这些成绩是由开源和闭源的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）所实现的。通过结合多轮设计、上下文丰富化和分类说明，我们的性能提升了22.80%。我们将发布我们的数据集以及改进后的分类指南。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CASPER in the Machine: Insights into Character Variety in LLM-Generated Stories
papers.title_zh: 《CASPER在机器中：对大型语言模型生成故事中的角色多样性的分析》
papers.authors: Anneliese Brei, Abhisheik Sharma, Nicholas Sanaie, Lu Wang, Snigdha Chaturvedi
papers.abstract: As LLM-generated text is increasingly used, especially in fictional domains, we explore how much LLM-generated stories differ from human-written stories. In this work, we focus on characters. We borrow definitions from narratology to analyze 8 intricate category-pairs of character, such as stylization and wholeness. These category-pairs consider more than just basic characteristics. They assess how characters are portrayed within their stories. After automatically inferring categories of characters within both LLM and human-written stories, we compare and contrast these two sets of stories. We consider the following overarching questions: (1) Do LLMs and human-written stories have similar characters? and (2) Do LLMs generate stories with a variety of characters? Our analysis includes research questions that focus on stories generated by popular LLMs and recently published human-written stories. We describe a number of interesting similarities, differences and key takeaways.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型生成的文本被越来越多地使用，尤其是在虚构领域，我们探讨了这些由大语言模型生成的故事与人工编写的故事之间存在多大的差异。在这项研究中，我们重点关注角色方面。我们借鉴了叙事学的定义来分析8种关于角色的分类对，比如风格化与完整性。这些分类对不仅仅涉及基本的特征，还考量了角色在故事中的呈现方式。在自动识别出大语言模型和人工编写故事中的角色类别之后，我们比较了这两组故事。我们考虑了以下核心问题：（1）大语言模型和人工编写的故事中的角色是否相似？（2）大语言模型能否生成具有多样化角色的故事？我们的分析包括针对流行大语言模型生成的故事以及最近发表的人工编写故事的研究问题。我们发现了许多有趣的相似之处、差异以及关键结论。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Language Models Struggle to Use Representations Learned In-Context
papers.title_zh: 语言模型在利用上下文中所学习的表示方式方面存在困难
papers.authors: Michael A. Lepori, Tal Linzen, Ann Yuan, Katja Filippova
papers.abstract: Though large language models (LLMs) have enabled great success across a wide variety of tasks, they still appear to fall short of one of the loftier goals of artificial intelligence research: creating an artificial system that can adapt its behavior to radically new contexts upon deployment. One important step towards this goal is to create systems that can induce rich representations of data that are seen in-context, and then flexibly deploy these representations to accomplish goals. Recently, Park et al. 2024 demonstrated that current LLMs are indeed capable of inducing such representation from context (i.e., in-context representation learning). The present study investigates whether LLMs can use these representations to complete simple downstream tasks.We first assess whether open-weights LLMs can use in-context representations for next-token prediction, and then probe models using a novel task, adaptive world modeling. In both tasks, we find evidence that open-weights LLMs struggle to deploy representations of novel semantics that are defined in-context, even if they encode these semantics in their latent representations. Furthermore, we assess closed-source, state-of-the-art reasoning models on the adaptive world modeling task, demonstrating that even the most performant LLMs cannot reliably leverage novel patterns presented in-context. Overall, this work seeks to inspire novel methods for encouraging models to not only encode information presented in-context, but to do so in a manner that supports flexible deployment of this information.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在众多任务中取得了巨大成功，但它们似乎仍未能实现人工智能研究中的一个更高目标：创造出一种能够在部署后适应全新情境的人工智能系统。实现这一目标的一个重要步骤是创建能够提取上下文中的丰富数据表示，并灵活运用这些表示来完成任务的系统。最近，Park等人于2024年证明了当前的语言模型确实能够从上下文中提取这样的表示（即上下文表示学习）。本研究旨在探讨语言模型是否可以利用这些表示来完成简单的下游任务。我们首先评估了开放权重语言模型是否能够利用上下文表示来进行下一个词元的预测，然后尝试使用一种新颖的任务——自适应世界建模来测试这些模型。在这两个任务中，我们发现开放权重语言模型在部署来自上下文的新语义表示时存在困难，即使它们在其潜在表示中编码了这些语义。此外，我们还对最先进的封闭源推理模型进行了自适应世界建模任务的测试，结果表明，即使是最强大的语言模型也无法可靠地利用来自上下文的新模式。总体而言，这项工作旨在启发新的方法，促使模型不仅能够编码来自上下文的信息，而且能够以一种支持这些信息灵活部署的方式来实现这一点。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SlideAgent: Hierarchical Agentic Framework for Multi-Page Visual Document Understanding
papers.title_zh: SlideAgent：一种用于多页视觉文档理解的层次化代理框架
papers.authors: Yiqiao Jin, Rachneet Kaur, Zhen Zeng, Sumitra Ganesh, Srijan Kumar
papers.abstract: Multi-page visual documents such as manuals, brochures, presentations, and posters convey key information through layout, colors, icons, and cross-slide references. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer opportunities in document understanding, current systems struggle with complex, multi-page visual documents, particularly in fine-grained reasoning over elements and pages. We introduce SlideAgent, a versatile agentic framework for understanding multi-modal, multi-page, and multi-layout documents, especially slide decks. SlideAgent employs specialized agents and decomposes reasoning into three specialized levels–global, page, and element–to construct a structured, query-agnostic representation that captures both overarching themes and detailed visual or textual cues. During inference, SlideAgent selectively activates specialized agents for multi-level reasoning and integrates their outputs into coherent, context-aware answers.Extensive experiments show that SlideAgent significantly improves accuracy over both proprietary (+7.9%) and open-source models (+9.8%).
papers.abstract_zh: 多页视觉文档，如手册、宣传册、演示文稿和海报，通过布局、颜色、图标以及跨幻灯片引用来传递关键信息。虽然多模态大语言模型在文档理解方面提供了机会，但当前的系统在处理复杂的多页视觉文档时仍然存在困难，尤其是在对各个元素和页面进行细致推理时。我们提出了SlideAgent这一多功能框架，用于理解多模态、多页式和多种布局的文档，尤其是幻灯片文档。SlideAgent采用专门的智能体，并将推理过程分解为三个层次——全局层、页面层和元素层——从而构建出结构化的、与查询无关的表示形式，能够同时捕捉到整体主题以及详细的视觉或文本信息。在推理过程中，SlideAgent会选择性地激活这些智能体来进行多层次推理，并将它们的输出整合为连贯且考虑上下文的回答。大量实验表明，SlideAgent的准确率显著高于专有模型和开源模型，分别提高了7.9%和9.8%。

papers.title: YIELD: A Large-Scale Dataset and Evaluation Framework for Information Elicitation Agents
papers.title_zh: “YIELD”：一个用于信息提取代理的大规模数据集与评估框架
papers.authors: Victor De Lima, Grace Hui Yang
papers.abstract: Most conversational agents (CAs) are designed to satisfy user needs through user-driven interactions. However, many real-world settings, such as academic interviewing, judicial proceedings, and journalistic investigations, involve broader institutional decision-making processes and require agents that can elicit information from users. In this paper, we introduce Information Elicitation Agents (IEAs) in which the agent’s goal is to elicit information from users to support the agent’s institutional or task-oriented objectives. To enable systematic research on this setting, we present YIELD, a 26M-token dataset of 2,281 ethically sourced, human-to-human dialogues. Moreover, we formalize information elicitation as a finite-horizon POMDP and propose novel metrics tailored to IEAs. Pilot experiments on multiple foundation LLMs show that training on YIELD improves their alignment with real elicitation behavior and findings are corroborated by human evaluation. We release YIELD under CC BY 4.0. The dataset, project code, evaluation tools, and fine-tuned model adapters are available at: https://github.com/infosenselab/yield.
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数对话式智能体都是为了通过用户驱动的互动来满足用户需求而设计的。然而，在许多现实场景当中，比如学术面试、司法程序以及新闻调查等，都涉及到更为复杂的机构决策过程，因此智能体需要具备从用户那里获取信息的能力。在本文中，我们提出了信息获取智能体这一概念——其目标是从用户那里获取信息，以支持智能体的机构性或任务导向性目标。为了对这一场景进行系统的研究，我们开发了YIELD数据集，该数据集包含2,281个基于伦理原则设计的人与人之间的对话实例，总样本量为2600万 词元。此外，我们将信息获取问题抽象为有限时域部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并提出了适用于信息获取智能体的新型评估指标。在多个基础大语言模型上的实验表明，使用YIELD数据集进行训练能够提升模型对真实信息获取行为的模拟能力，且这些发现得到了人类评估的验证。我们采用CC BY 4.0许可协议发布了YIELD数据集。该数据集、项目代码、评估工具以及经过微调的模型适配器均可在此处获取：https://github.com/infosenselab/yield。

papers.title: Spatial-Agent: Agentic Geo-spatial Reasoning with Scientific Core Concepts
papers.title_zh: 空间代理：基于科学核心概念的地理空间推理
papers.authors: Riyang Bao, Cheng Yang, Dazhou Yu, Zhexiang Tang, Gengchen Mai, Liang Zhao
papers.abstract: Geospatial reasoning is essential for real-world applications such as urban analytics, transportation planning, and disaster response. However, existing LLM-based agents often fail at genuine geospatial computation, relying instead on web search or pattern matching while hallucinating spatial relationships. We present Spatial-Agent, an AI agent grounded in foundational theories of spatial information science. Our approach formalizes geo-analytical question answering as a concept transformation problem, where natural-language questions are parsed into executable workflows represented as GeoFlow Graphs—directed acyclic graphs with nodes corresponding to spatial concepts and edges representing transformations. Drawing on spatial information theory, Spatial-Agent extracts spatial concepts, assigns functional roles with principled ordering constraints, and composes transformation sequences through template-based generation. Extensive experiments on MapEval-API and MapQA benchmarks demonstrate that Spatial-Agent significantly outperforms existing baselines including ReAct and Reflexion, while producing interpretable and executable geospatial workflows.
papers.abstract_zh: 地理空间推理对于城市分析、交通规划以及灾害应对等现实应用至关重要。然而，现有的基于大语言模型的智能体往往无法完成真正的地理空间计算任务，它们通常依赖网络搜索或模式匹配来推测空间关系。我们提出了Spatial-Agent这一人工智能智能体，它基于地理信息科学的基础理论进行设计。我们的方法将地理分析型问答问题形式化为一个概念转换问题，将自然语言问题解析为可执行的工作流程，这些工作流程以GeoFlow图的形式表示——这是一种有向无环图，其节点代表空间概念，边则代表各种转换关系。借助地理信息理论，Spatial-Agent能够提取空间概念，为这些概念分配具有合理排序约束的功能角色，并通过模板生成方式构建转换序列。在MapEval-API和MapQA基准测试中的大量实验表明，Spatial-Agent的性能显著优于现有的基线模型，包括ReAct和Reflexion，同时它能够生成可解释且可执行的地理空间工作流程。

papers.title: Rethinking Evaluation for LLM Hallucination Detection: A Desiderata, A New RAG-based Benchmark, New Insights
papers.title_zh: 重新思考用于检测大型语言模型幻觉的评估方法：存在的问题、新的基于RAG的基准测试、新的见解
papers.authors: Wenbo Chen, Veena Padmanabhan, Tootiya Giyahchi, Elaine Wong, Leman Akoglu
papers.abstract: Hallucination, broadly referring to unfaithful, fabricated, or inconsistent content generated by LLMs, has wide-ranging implications. Therefore, a large body of effort has been devoted to detecting LLM hallucinations, as well as designing benchmark datasets for evaluating these detectors. In this work, we first establish a desiderata of properties for hallucination detection benchmarks (HDBs) to exhibit for effective evaluation. A critical look at existing HDBs through the lens of our desiderata reveals that none of them exhibits all the properties. We identify two largest gaps: (1) RAG-based grounded benchmarks with long context are severely lacking (partly because length impedes human annotation); and (2) Existing benchmarks do not make available realistic label noise for stress-testing detectors although real-world use-cases often grapple with label noise due to human or automated/weak annotation. To close these gaps, we build and open-source a new RAG-based HDB called TRIVIA+ that underwent a rigorous human annotation process. Notably, our benchmark exhibits all desirable properties including (1) TRIVIA+ contains samples with the longest context in the literature; and (2) we design and share three sets of noisy labels with different, sample-dependent noise schemes. Finally, we perform experiments on RAG-based HDBs, including our TRIVIA+, using popular SOTA detectors that reveal new insights: (i) ample room remains for current detectors to reach the performance ceiling on RAG-based HDBs, (ii) the basic LLM-as-a-Judge baseline performs competitively, and (iii) label noise hinders detection performance. We expect that our findings, along with our proposed benchmark, will motivate and foster needed research on hallucination detection for RAG-based tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉，广义上指的是由大语言模型生成的不真实、伪造或不一致的内容，这一现象具有广泛的影响。因此，人们投入了大量精力来检测大语言模型的幻觉现象，并设计了基准数据集来评估这些检测算法。在这项研究中，我们首先确定了幻觉检测基准的应具备的特性，以便进行有效的评估。通过审视现有基准数据集与这些特性的对比，我们发现没有任何一个基准数据集具备所有所需特性。我们发现了两个主要的问题：（1）基于RAG的、能够处理长上下文的基准数据集非常缺乏，部分原因是上下文长度限制了人工标注的效率；（2）现有的基准数据集没有提供真实的标签噪声来进行检测算法的压力测试，而现实世界中的应用场景往往需要应对由于人工或自动化标注导致的标签噪声问题。为了弥补这些不足，我们构建了一个名为TRIVIA+的新基于RAG的幻觉检测基准数据集，并将其开源。值得注意的是，我们的基准数据集具备所有理想的特性，包括：（1）TRIVIA+包含文献中上下文最长的样本；（2）我们设计并提供了三组带有不同样本依赖噪声方案的噪声标签。最后，我们对基于RAG的幻觉检测基准数据集进行了实验测试，其中包括我们的TRIVIA+，并使用了一些流行的先进检测算法，得到了一些新的发现：（i）当前的检测算法仍有很大的提升空间，可以超越基于RAG的幻觉检测基准数据集的性能水平；（ii）基本的“大语言模型作为裁判”的基线算法也能表现出竞争力；（iii）标签噪声确实会干扰检测性能。我们相信，我们的研究结果以及所提出的基准数据集，将会激发和促进关于基于RAG任务的幻觉检测方面的研究。

papers.title: Min-k Sampling: Decoupling Truncation from Temperature Scaling via Relative Logit Dynamics
papers.title_zh: Min-k采样：通过相对逻辑动态特性将截断操作与温度缩放因素分离开来
papers.authors: Yuanhao Ding, Meimingwei Li, Esteban Garces Arias, Matthias Aßenmacher, Christian Heumann, Chongsheng Zhang
papers.abstract: The quality of text generated by large language models depends critically on the decoding sampling strategy. While mainstream methods such as Top-k, Top-p, and Min-p achieve a balance between diversity and accuracy through probability-space truncation, they share an inherent limitation: extreme sensitivity to the temperature parameter. Recent logit-space approaches like Top-n\sigma achieve temperature invariance but rely on global statistics that are susceptible to long-tail noise, failing to capture fine-grained confidence structures among top candidates. We propose Min-k Sampling, a novel dynamic truncation strategy that analyzes the local shape of the sorted logit distribution to identify “semantic cliffs”: sharp transitions from high-confidence core tokens to uncertain long-tail tokens. By computing a position-weighted relative decay rate, Min-k dynamically determines truncation boundaries at each generation step. We formally prove that Min-k achieves strict temperature invariance and empirically demonstrate its low sensitivity to hyperparameter choices. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks, creative writing tasks, and human evaluation show that Min-k consistently improves text quality, maintaining robust performance even under extreme temperature settings where probability-based methods collapse. We make our code, models, and analysis tools publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型生成的文本质量在很大程度上取决于解码采样策略。虽然像Top-k、Top-p和Min-p这样的主流方法通过概率空间截断实现了多样性和准确性的平衡，但它们存在一个固有的局限性：对温度参数极为敏感。而最近的logit空间方法，如Top-n\sigma，虽然实现了温度不变性，但依赖于全局统计数据，这些统计数据容易受到长尾噪声的影响，无法捕捉到顶级候选词之间的细微置信结构。我们提出了Min-k采样法，这是一种新颖的动态截断策略，它通过分析排序后的logit分布的局部形态来识别“语义悬崖”——即从高置信度核心词到不确定长尾词的急剧转变。通过计算位置加权的相对衰减率，Min-k能够在每次生成时动态确定截断边界。我们正式证明了Min-k能够实现严格的温度不变性，并通过实验证明其对于超参数选择的敏感性较低。在多个推理基准测试、创意写作任务以及人类评估中的实验表明，Min-k能够持续提升文本质量，即使在概率基础方法表现不佳的极端温度环境下也能保持出色的性能。我们将我们的代码、模型和分析工具公开提供。

papers.title: Bridging the Memorization-Utilization Gap: Near-Lossless Context Compression via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 填补记忆与实用之间的差距：通过强化学习实现接近无损的上下文压缩技术
papers.authors: Yujan Ting, Xu Tang, Terrence Chen, Weijing Huang
papers.abstract: Despite recent progress in context compression, we identify a fundamental memorization-utilization gap where models can compress context with near-perfect fidelity yet fail to effectively utilize these compressed representations for downstream tasks. We address this with a holistic training paradigm spanning pretraining, instruction tuning, and reinforcement learning, built upon an average pooling compression. Our key innovation uses outcome-based RL to enable implicit expansion: the model learns to adaptively unfold task-relevant details during generation, interleaving reconstruction with reasoning. We achieve near-lossless 16x context compression (≈5.3x decoder sequence-length reduction in our current implementation) across 7B and 32B models, recovering over 98% of full-context QA performance and outperforming prior methods by 11 points. Our 32B model demonstrates strong out-of-distribution and length generalization, robustly scaling to 120k-token contexts despite training on no more than 4k tokens, matching full-context performance on NIAH, LongBench v2, and multi-hop reasoning. We verify the implicit expansion behavior in experiments.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在上下文压缩方面取得了近期进展，但我们发现了一个根本性的记忆与利用之间的差距：模型能够以近乎完美的精度压缩上下文，但却无法有效利用这些压缩后的表示来进行下游任务的处理。我们采用一种全面的训练范式来解决这个问题，该范式包括预训练、指令调整以及强化学习，所有这些步骤都基于平均池化压缩技术。我们的关键创新在于使用基于结果的强化学习来实现隐式扩展：模型能够在生成过程中自适应地展开与任务相关的细节，将重建过程与推理相结合。我们在7B和32B的模型中实现了近乎无损的16倍上下文压缩（在当前实现中，解码序列长度减少了约5.3倍），同时恢复了超过98%的全上下文问答性能，并且比以往的方法高出11分。我们的32B模型表现出强大的超出分布范围的能力以及长度上的泛化能力，即使是在不超过4k个令牌的训练数据上，也能稳健地扩展到120k个令牌的上下文处理，其性能与全上下文情况下的表现相当，并且在NIAH、LongBench v2和多跳推理任务上均表现出色。我们在实验中验证了这种隐式扩展行为的有效性。

papers.title: PRIME: A Process-Outcome Alignment Benchmark for Verifiable Reasoning in Mathematics and Engineering
papers.title_zh: PRIME：一种用于数学和工程领域可验证推理的过程与结果对齐基准方法
papers.authors: Xiangfeng Wang, Hangyu Guo, Yanlin Lai, Mitt Huang, Liang Zhao, Chengyuan Yao, Yinmin Zhang, Qi Han, Xiaoxiaoren, Chun Yuan, Tong Xu, Zheng Ge, Xiangyu Zhang, Daxin Jiang
papers.abstract: While model-based verifiers are essential for scaling Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), current outcome-centric verification paradigms primarily focus on the consistency between the final result and the ground truth, often neglecting potential errors in the derivation process. This leads to assigning positive rewards to correct answers produced from incorrect derivations. To bridge this gap, we introduce PRIME, a benchmark for evaluating verifiers on PRocess-outcome alignment verification In Mathematics and Engineering. Curated from a comprehensive collection of college-level STEM problems, PRIME comprises 2,530 high-difficulty samples through a consistency-based filtering pipeline. Through extensive evaluation, we find that current verifiers frequently fail to detect derivation flaws. Furthermore, we propose a process-aware RLVR training paradigm utilizing verifiers selected via PRIME. This approach substantially outperforms the outcome-only verification baseline, achieving absolute performance gains of 8.29%, 9.12%, and 7.31% on AIME24, AIME25, and Beyond-AIME, respectively, for the Qwen3-14B-Base model. Finally, we demonstrate a strong linear correlation (R^2 > 0.92) between verifier accuracy on PRIME and RLVR training effectiveness, validating PRIME as a reliable predictor for verifier selection.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于模型的验证器对于实现具有可验证奖励的强化学习至关重要，但目前的以结果为导向的验证范式主要关注最终结果与真实情况的一致性，往往忽略了推导过程中的潜在错误。这导致从错误的推导中得出的正确答案也被给予积极的奖励。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了PRIME这一基准测试，用于评估数学和工程领域中的过程-结果一致性验证方法。PRIME从大量大学水平的STEM问题中精选出了2,530个高难度样本，并通过基于一致性的筛选流程进行筛选。经过广泛的评估，我们发现当前的验证器常常无法检测到推导过程中的缺陷。此外，我们提出了一种利用通过PRIME筛选出的验证器的过程感知强化学习验证训练范式。这种方法显著优于仅关注结果的验证基线，在AIME24、AIME25以及Beyond-AIME上分别实现了8.29%、9.12%和7.31%的绝对性能提升，适用于Qwen3-14B-Base模型。最后，我们证明了PRIME上的验证器准确性与强化学习验证训练效果之间存在很强的线性相关性（R^2 > 0.92），从而验证了PRIME作为验证器选择的可靠预测工具。

papers.title: ZARA: Training-Free Motion Time-Series Reasoning via Evidence-Grounded LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: ZARA：基于证据的大语言模型代理实现无需训练的运动时间序列推理
papers.authors: Zechen Li, Baiyu Chen, Hao Xue, Flora D. Salim
papers.abstract: Motion sensor time-series are central to Human Activity Recognition (HAR), yet conventional approaches are constrained to fixed activity sets and typically require costly parameter retraining to adapt to new behaviors. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising open-set reasoning capabilities, applying them directly to numerical time-series often leads to hallucinations and weak grounding. To address this challenge, we propose ZARA (Zero-training Activity Reasoning Agents), a knowledge- and retrieval-augmented agentic framework for motion time-series reasoning in a training-free inference setting. Rather than relying on black-box projections, ZARA distills reference data into a statistically grounded textual knowledge base that transforms implicit signal patterns into verifiable natural-language priors. Guided by retrieved evidence, ZARA iteratively selects discriminative cues and performs grounded reasoning over candidate activities. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks show that ZARA generalizes robustly to unseen subjects and across datasets, demonstrating strong transferability across heterogeneous sensor domains. These results mark a step toward trustworthy, plug-and-play motion understanding beyond dataset-specific artifacts. Our code is available at https://github.com/zechenli03/ZARA.
papers.abstract_zh: 运动传感器产生的时间序列在人类活动识别中起着至关重要的作用。然而，传统的方法往往局限于固定的活动类别，并且通常需要昂贵的参数重新训练才能适应新的行为模式。虽然大语言模型具备强大的开放集推理能力，但将其直接应用于数值时间序列时，往往会导致幻觉和弱化的信号识别能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了ZARA（零训练活动推理代理）这一基于知识和检索增强的代理框架，该框架能够在无需训练的情况下对运动时间序列进行推理。与依赖黑盒式预测方法不同，ZARA将参考数据提炼成统计上可靠的文本知识库，从而将隐式的信号模式转化为可验证的自然语言先验信息。在检索到的证据指导下，ZARA不断选择具有区分性的线索，并对候选活动进行可靠的推理。在八个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，ZARA能够稳健地泛化到未见过的对象以及不同的数据集上，显示出在异构传感器领域中的强大迁移能力。这些成果标志着向实现无需特定数据集支持的可靠运动理解迈出了重要一步。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/zechenli03/ZARA获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AutoJudger: An Agent-Driven Framework for Efficient Benchmarking of MLLMs
papers.title_zh: AutoJudger：一种由代理驱动的框架，旨在高效地进行大语言模型的比对评估
papers.authors: Xuanwen Ding, Chengjun Pan, Zejun Li, Jiwen Zhang, Siyuan Wang, Zhongyu Wei
papers.abstract: Evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is becoming increasingly expensive as benchmarks grow in scale and cross-modality complexity. Inspired by structuralism in cognitive psychology, we tackle this difficulty with an adaptive evaluation framework for efficient benchmarking, namely AutoJudger. Instead of passively scoring on a fixed test set, AutoJudger treats evaluation as an interview-like process by keeping a hypothesized ability structure of the evaluated model and actively selecting the informative questions so as to refine these ability boundaries. Specifically, AutoJudger has three core components: ability decomposition to organize evaluation along meaningful capability dimensions, ability estimation to maintain an up-to-date quantitative profile of the model competence, and adaptive question selection to choose the most informative questions. To operationalize this paradigm, we introduce A^2-Judger, a novel MLLM-based Agentic instantiation of AutoJudger equipped with semantic-aware retrieval and dynamic memory. Experiments on four representative multimodal benchmarks show that A^2-Judger significantly improves sample efficiency while maintaining reliable evaluation results.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的成本随着测试集规模的扩大和跨模态复杂性的增加而不断增加。受认知心理学中的结构主义思想的启发，我们提出了一种自适应评估框架来高效地进行基准测试，即AutoJudger。与被动地在固定测试集上进行评分不同，AutoJudger将评估过程视为一种类似面试的过程，它保留了对被评估模型的能力结构假设，并主动选择具有信息量的问题，以进一步明确这些能力边界。具体来说，AutoJudger包含三个核心组件：能力分解，用于按照有意义的能力维度来组织评估；能力估计，用于保持模型能力的实时量化描述；以及自适应问题选择，用于挑选最具信息量的问题。为了实现这一理念，我们引入了A^2-Judger——一种基于MLLMs的、具有语义感知检索能力和动态记忆功能的新型智能体。在四个代表性的多模态基准测试上的实验表明，A^2-Judger显著提高了样本处理的效率，同时仍然能够保持可靠的评估结果。

papers.title: Implicit Representations of Grammaticality in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 语言模型中语法性的隐式表示方式
papers.authors: Yingshan Susan Wang, Linlu Qiu, Zhaofeng Wu, Roger P. Levy, Yoon Kim
papers.abstract: Grammaticality and likelihood are distinct notions in human language. Pretrained language models (LMs), which are probabilistic models of language fitted to maximize corpus likelihood, generate grammatically well-formed text and discriminate well between grammatical and ungrammatical sentences in tightly controlled minimal pairs. However, their string probabilities do not sharply discriminate between grammatical and ungrammatical sentences overall. But do LMs implicitly acquire a grammaticality distinction distinct from string probability? We explore this question through studying pretrained LMs’ internal representations, by training a linear probe on a dataset of grammatical and (synthetic) ungrammatical sentences obtained by applying perturbations to a naturalistic text corpus. We find that this simple grammaticality probe generalizes to human-curated grammaticality judgment benchmarks and outperforms LM probability-based grammaticality judgments. When applied to semantic plausibility benchmarks, however, in which both members of a minimal pair are grammatical and differ in only plausibility, the probe performs worse than string probability. The English-trained probe also exhibits nontrivial cross-lingual generalization, outperforming string probabilities on grammaticality benchmarks in numerous other languages. Additionally, probe scores correlate only weakly with string probabilities. These results collectively suggest that pretrained LMs acquire to some extent an implicit grammaticality distinction within their hidden layers.
papers.abstract_zh: 语法性与可能性是人类语言中两个不同的概念。预训练的语言模型是一种概率性语言模型，其设计目的是最大化语料库中的可能性，从而生成符合语法规则的文本，并能够清晰地区分符合语法规则与不符合语法规则的句子。然而，这些模型的字符串概率并不能完全区分符合语法规则和不符合语法规则的句子。那么，语言模型是否隐式地获得了一种与字符串概率不同的语法性区分呢？我们通过研究预训练语言模型的内部表征来探讨这个问题。我们在一个包含符合语法规则的和通过修改自然语料库得到的（合成）不符合语法规则的句子的数据集上训练了一个线性探测器。我们发现，这个简单的语法性探测器能够在人类精心设计的语法性判断基准测试中表现出色，并且其性能优于基于模型概率的语法性判断。然而，在语义合理性基准测试中，即当两个最小对中的两个元素都符合语法规则且仅在合理性上存在差异的情况下，该探测器的表现却不如字符串概率。此外，经过英语训练的探测器还表现出跨语言的一般化能力，在许多其他语言的语法性基准测试中，其性能优于字符串概率。另外，探测器的得分与字符串概率之间的相关性较弱。这些结果共同表明，预训练语言模型在其隐藏层内某种程度上获得了一种隐式的语法性区分能力。

papers.title: Discovering and Causally Validating Emotion-Sensitive Neurons in Large Audio-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在大型音频语言模型中发现并验证与情绪相关的神经元
papers.authors: Xiutian Zhao, Björn Schuller, Berrak Sisman
papers.abstract: Emotion is a central dimension of spoken communication, yet, we still lack a mechanistic account of how modern large audio-language models (LALMs) encode it internally. We present the first neuron-level interpretability study of emotion-sensitive neurons (ESNs) in LALMs and provide causal evidence supporting the existence of such units in Qwen2.5-Omni, Kimi-Audio, and Audio Flamingo 3. Across these three widely used open-source models, we compare frequency-, entropy-, mean-deviation-, and contrast-based neuron selectors on multiple emotion recognition benchmarks. Using inference-time interventions, we reveal a consistent emotion-specific signature: deactivating neurons selected for a given emotion disproportionately degrades recognition of that emotion while largely preserving other classes, whereas targeted steering amplifies these units to bias predictions toward the target emotion. These effects arise with modest amounts of identification data and scale systematically with intervention strength. We further observe that ESNs exhibit non-uniform layer-wise clustering with partial cross-dataset transfer. Taken together, our results offer a causal, neuron-level account of emotion decisions in LALMs and highlight targeted neuron interventions as an actionable handle for controllable affective behaviors.
papers.abstract_zh: 情绪是口语交流中的一个核心维度，然而，我们仍然缺乏关于现代大型音频语言模型如何内部编码情绪的机制性解释。我们首次对LALMs中负责感知情绪的神经元进行了神经元级别的解析研究，并提供了因果证据，证明Qwen2.5-Omni、Kimi-Audio和Audio Flamingo 3模型中确实存在这样的神经元单元。在这三个广泛使用的开源模型中，我们在多个情绪识别基准测试上对比了基于频率、熵、均值偏差和对比度的神经元选择方法。通过推理时间干预实验，我们发现了一个一致的情绪特异性特征：当针对特定情绪选择的神经元被停用时，该情绪的认知能力会显著下降，而其他类别的情绪认知能力则基本保持不变；而针对性的引导则能够增强这些神经元的作用，使预测结果更倾向于目标情绪。这些效应在有限的识别数据量下就能显现出来，并且随着干预强度的增加而呈系统性增强。此外，我们还观察到这些神经元单元在层与层之间呈现出非均匀的分布，并且在不同数据集之间存在部分转移现象。总的来说，我们的研究结果提供了关于LALMs中情绪决策机制的神经元级别的解释，并强调了针对性神经元干预作为控制情感行为的有效手段。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Uncovering Intervention Opportunities for Suicide Prevention with Language Model Assistants
papers.title_zh: 利用语言模型辅助技术寻找预防自杀的干预机会
papers.authors: Jaspreet Ranjit, Hyundong Justin Cho, Claire J. Smerdon, Yoonsoo Nam, Myles Phung, Jonathan May, John R. Blosnich, Swabha Swayamdipta
papers.abstract: The National Violent Death Reporting System (NVDRS) documents suicides in the United States. In a demanding public health data pipeline, annotators manually extract structured information from death investigation records following extensive codebooks (i.e. annotation guidelines) painstakingly developed by experts. In this work, we facilitate data-driven insights from the NVDRS data to support the development of novel suicide interventions by leveraging language models (LM) as assistants to these (a) data annotators and (b) experts. We find that LM predictions match existing data annotations about 85% of the time across 50 NVDRS variables. Where the LM disagrees with existing annotations, our expert review identifies that 38% of these instances reveal inconsistencies between narratives and structured data. Finally, we introduce a human-in-the-loop algorithm that helps experts efficiently build and refine codebooks for new variables by having them only focus on providing feedback for incorrect LM predictions. We apply our algorithm to a real-world case study, and find that about 96K narratives contain evidence of victim interactions with legal professionals, which surfaces a substantial opportunity for upstream intervention that is not captured in the original structured data. Our findings provide evidence that LMs can serve as effective assistants to public health researchers who handle sensitive data in high-stakes scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国国家暴力死亡报告系统（NVDRS）记录了美国的自杀事件。在这样一个要求极高的公共卫生数据处理流程中，注释员需要根据专家精心制定的代码手册，手动从死亡调查记录中提取结构化信息。在这项研究中，我们利用语言模型作为辅助工具，帮助注释员和专家从NVDRS数据中获取数据驱动的洞察，从而推动新型自杀干预措施的开发。我们发现，语言模型的预测在50个NVDRS变量中，有85%的情况下与现有的数据注释一致。而当语言模型与现有注释存在分歧时，通过专家审核发现，有38%的情况表明叙述数据与结构化数据之间存在不一致之处。最后，我们提出了一种人机协同算法，该算法让专家只需专注于为不正确的语言模型预测提供反馈，就能高效地构建和完善针对新变量的代码手册。我们将这一算法应用于一个实际案例研究，发现大约有9.6万条叙述中包含受害者与法律专业人士互动的证据，这为上游干预提供了重要的机会，而这些机会并未被原始结构化数据所涵盖。我们的研究结果证明，语言模型可以作为有效助手，帮助公共卫生研究人员在处理敏感数据的高风险场景中取得更好的效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Imperfective Paradox in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大语言模型中的未完成体悖论
papers.authors: Bolei Ma, Yusuke Miyao
papers.abstract: Do Large Language Models (LLMs) genuinely grasp the compositional semantics of events, or do they rely on surface-level probabilistic heuristics? We investigate the Imperfective Paradox, a logical phenomenon where the past progressive aspect entails event realization for activities (e.g., running \to ran) but not for accomplishments (e.g., building \nrightarrow built). We introduce ImperfectiveNLI, a diagnostic dataset designed to probe this distinction across diverse semantic classes. Evaluating state-of-the-art open-weight models, we uncover a pervasive Teleological Bias: models systematically hallucinate completion for goal-oriented events, even overriding explicit textual cancellation. Prompting interventions partially reduce this bias but trigger a calibration crisis, causing models to incorrectly reject valid entailments for atelic verbs. Representational analyses further show that while internal embeddings often distinguish progressive from simple past forms, inference decisions are dominated by strong priors about goal attainment. Taken together, our findings indicate that these current open-weight LLMs operate as predictive narrative engines rather than faithful logical reasoners, and that resolving aspectual inference requires moving beyond prompting toward structurally grounded alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型是否真正能够理解事件的组合语义，还是它们依赖于表面层次的概率性启发式方法呢？我们研究了“不完美性悖论”这一逻辑现象——过去进行时形式虽然表示活动的进行（例如：running → ran），但却不表示成就的实现（例如：building → n→ built）。我们引入了ImperfectiveNLI这一诊断数据集，旨在探究不同语义类别之间的这种差异。通过对最先进的开放权重模型进行评估，我们发现了一个普遍存在的目的性偏见：这些模型会系统性地为以目标为导向的事件产生完成的假象，甚至会在明确文本描述表明事件未完成的情况下仍然如此。通过提示干预可以部分缓解这种偏见，但也会引发校准危机，导致模型错误地拒绝那些属于非时态动词的有效蕴含关系。表征分析进一步显示，尽管内部嵌入通常能区分进行时和简单过去时形式，但推理决策却受到关于目标达成情况的强烈先验信息的支配。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，当前这些开放权重语言模型更像是一种预测性的叙事引擎，而非忠实的逻辑推理器。要解决时态推理问题，就需要超越单纯的提示干预，转而采用基于结构化的对齐方式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MalruleLib: Large-Scale Executable Misconception Reasoning with Step Traces for Modeling Student Thinking in Mathematics
papers.title_zh: MalruleLib：基于步骤追踪的大规模可执行误解推理技术，用于模拟学生在数学学习过程中的思维过程
papers.authors: Xinghe Chen, Naiming Liu, Shashank Sonkar
papers.abstract: Student mistakes in mathematics are often systematic: a learner applies a coherent but wrong procedure and repeats it across contexts. We introduce MalruleLib, a learning-science-grounded framework that translates documented misconceptions into executable procedures, drawing on 67 learning-science and mathematics education sources, and generates step-by-step traces of malrule-consistent student work. We formalize a core student-modeling problem as Malrule Reasoning Accuracy (MRA): infer a misconception from one worked mistake and predict the student’s next answer under cross-template rephrasing. Across nine language models (4B - 120B), accuracy drops from 66% on direct problem solving to 40% on cross-template misconception prediction. MalruleLib encodes 101 malrules over 498 parameterized problem templates and produces paired dual-path traces for both correct reasoning and malrule-consistent student reasoning. Because malrules are executable and templates are parameterizable, MalruleLib can generate over one million instances, enabling scalable supervision and controlled evaluation. Using MalruleLib, we observe cross-template degradations of 10 - 21%, while providing student step traces improves prediction by 3 - 15%. We release MalruleLib as infrastructure for educational AI that models student procedures across contexts, enabling diagnosis and feedback that targets the underlying misconception.
papers.abstract_zh: 学生在数学方面的错误往往具有系统性：学习者会采用一种连贯但错误的解题方法，并在不同情境下重复这种错误。我们提出了MalruleLib这一基于学习科学的框架，它能够将记录下来的错误观念转化为可执行的步骤，该框架参考了67种学习科学和数学教育资源，能够生成符合错误规则的学生解题过程的逐步记录。我们将核心的学生建模问题形式化为“错误规则推理准确性”指标：从单个错误中推断出错误观念，并预测学生在重新表述问题时的下一个答案。在9种语言模型（4B到120B）的测试中，直接解决问题的准确率从66%下降到40%，而通过模板转换来预测错误观念的准确率则有所提高。MalruleLib包含了101条错误规则，适用于498种参数化的问题模板，能够生成正确的推理过程和符合错误规则的学生推理过程的双重记录。由于错误规则是可执行的，而模板是可以参数化的，因此MalruleLib能够生成超过一百万个实例，从而实现可扩展的监督控制和评估。使用MalruleLib后，我们发现跨模板的错误率降低了10%到21%，同时提供学生解题过程的可视化记录后，预测准确率提高了3%到15%。我们将其作为教育人工智能的基础设施发布，该工具能够模拟学生在不同情境下的解题过程，从而实现对错误观念的精准诊断和反馈。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: How to Improve LLMs’ Performance on Specific Languages: A Perspective on LLM-Derived Language Similarity
papers.title_zh: 如何提升大语言模型在特定语言上的性能：关于从大语言模型生成的文本相似性的思考
papers.authors: Xinhe Shi, Qingcheng Zeng, Weihao Xuan, Linchao Zhu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit uneven performance across languages. In language-specific applications, practitioners often rely on target-language corpora or cross-lingual transfer to achieve better performance. However, traditional linguistic typology, commonly used as a transfer language selection strategy in previous studies, may not align with LLM’s perception of language similarity. This work proposes LLM-based language similarity as a novel perspective for selecting effective fine-tuning languages. We construct a framework to quantify the similarity within each language pair through both the lenses of language-specific performance patterns and cross-lingual transferability, ultimately deriving three similarity score matrices. Moreover, we observe a counter-intuitive phenomenon: super-additive transfer effect, where fine-tuning on a certain language yields higher performance than fine-tuning directly on the target language. Additionally, due to the absence of an existing dataset meeting our experimental requirements, we construct and release M4CQ-Pro dataset, which features domain-diverse distribution of 135 tasks and content consistency across 31 languages (including over 20 medium- and low-resource languages), with 61518 manually reviewed high-quality questions per language. We evaluate our approach on representative multilingual LLMs and results show that all three LLM-based similarity measures effectively guide fine-tuning language selection, outperforming traditional linguistic similarity, with the integrated measure achieving the best results. Our approach provides not only a novel perspective on language similarity, but also practical baselines for selecting fine-tuning languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在不同语言上的表现并不均衡。在针对特定语言的应用中，从业者通常依赖目标语言的语料库或跨语言迁移来提高性能。然而，传统语言类型学作为以往研究中选择迁移语言的策略，可能与语言模型的语言相似性判断不一致。本研究提出了基于语言模型的语言相似性方法，作为一种选择有效微调语言的新视角。我们构建了一个框架，通过特定语言的表现模式以及跨语言可迁移性来量化每对语言之间的相似性，最终得到了三个相似性评分矩阵。此外，我们还观察到了一个反直觉的现象：在某些语言上进行微调可以获得比直接在目标语言上进行微调更高的性能。由于缺乏符合我们实验要求的现有数据集，我们构建了M4CQ-Pro数据集，该数据集包含135个任务，这些任务具有多样化的领域分布，且31种语言的内容具有一致性（其中包括20种资源中等或较低的语言），每种语言都有61518个经过人工审核的高质量问题。我们在代表性的多语言语言模型上评估了我们的方法，结果表明，所有基于语言模型的相似性度量都能有效地指导微调语言的选择，其效果优于传统的语言相似性度量，而综合度量则取得了最佳结果。我们的方法不仅为语言相似性提供了新的视角，还为选择微调语言提供了实用的基准。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MATCH: Modulating Attention via In-Context Retrieval for Long-Context Transformers
papers.title_zh: 比赛：通过上下文检索来调节注意力，以适应长上下文变换器
papers.authors: Linrui Ma, Chun Hei Lo, Xinyu Wang, Peng Lu, Xihao Yuan, Hanting Chen, Kai Han, Xinghao Chen, Chengjun Zhan, Hanlin xu, Yichun Yin, Lifeng Shang, Feng Wen, Boxing Chen, Yufei Cui
papers.abstract: The quadratic computational cost of traditional attention mechanisms poses a major bottleneck to the scalability and practical deployment of large language models (LLMs), particularly in long-context scenarios. To improve efficiency, existing approaches often enforce rigid structural constraints such as local attention windows. However, these strategies typically lead to substantial performance degradation on tasks requiring precise long-range recall. In this work, we propose MATCH, a scalable and efficient framework that augments sparsified attention mechanisms with dynamically integrated in-context information through an efficient retrieval system. Empirical results show that MATCH significantly improves the performance of sparse-attention models on both synthetic and real-world natural-language tasks. These findings highlight the versatility of MATCH as a general approach for enhancing in-context retrieval capabilities while maintaining the efficiency benefits of sparse attention architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统注意力机制的二次计算成本是大语言模型可扩展性和实际部署的一大瓶颈，尤其是在长上下文场景中。为了提高效率，现有方法通常会施加严格的结构约束，例如局部注意力窗口。然而，这些策略通常会导致在需要精确的长距离召回任务的性能大幅下降。在这项研究中，我们提出了MATCH框架，它是一个可扩展且高效的框架，通过高效的检索系统，将稀疏注意力机制与动态整合的上下文信息相结合。实验结果表明，MATCH显著提升了稀疏注意力模型在合成和真实世界自然语言任务上的性能。这些发现凸显了MATCH作为一种增强上下文检索能力的通用方法的多功能性，同时保留了稀疏注意力架构带来的效率优势。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Protecting Bystander Privacy via Selective Hearing in Audio LLMs
papers.title_zh: 通过选择性听取音频信息来保护旁观者的隐私
papers.authors: Xiao Zhan, Guangzhi Sun, Jose Such, Phil Woodland
papers.abstract: Audio Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in the real world, where they inevitably capture speech from unintended nearby bystanders, raising privacy risks that existing benchmarks and defences did not consider. We introduce SH-Bench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate selective hearing: a model’s ability to attend to an intended main speaker while refusing to process or reveal information about incidental bystander speech. SH-Bench contains 3,968 multi-speaker audio mixtures, including both real-world and synthetic scenarios, paired with 77k multiple-choice questions that probe models under general and selective operating modes. In addition, we propose Selective Efficacy (SE), a novel metric capturing both multi-speaker comprehension and bystander-privacy protection. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary LLMs reveals substantial bystander privacy leakage, with strong audio understanding failing to translate into selective protection of bystander privacy. To mitigate this gap, we also present Bystander Privacy Fine-Tuning (BPFT), a novel training pipeline that teaches models to refuse bystander-related queries without degrading main-speaker comprehension. We show that BPFT yields substantial gains, achieving an absolute 47% higher bystander accuracy under selective mode and an absolute 16% higher SE compared to Gemini 2.5 Pro, which is the best audio LLM without BPFT. Together, SH-Bench and BPFT provide the first systematic framework for measuring and improving bystander privacy in audio LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 音频大语言模型在现实世界中得到了越来越多的应用。然而，这些模型不可避免地会捕捉到附近旁观者的语音信息，这带来了一些现有的评估标准和防御措施未能考虑到的隐私风险。我们提出了SH-Bench这一基准测试，它是首个专门用于评估选择性听力的模型：即模型在专注于主要说话人的同时，能够拒绝处理或泄露与旁观者相关的语音信息的能力。SH-Bench包含了3,968个多声源音频混合样本，包括真实场景和合成场景，同时还包含了7.7万个选择题，用于评估模型在不同操作模式下的表现。此外，我们还提出了选择性效能指标，这是一种新的评估方法，可以同时衡量多声源理解能力和对旁观者隐私的保护效果。我们对最先进的开源和专有语言模型的评估结果显示，存在严重的旁观者隐私泄露问题，即强大的音频理解能力并未能转化为对旁观者隐私的有效保护。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了旁观者隐私微调技术，这是一种新的训练方法，它能够教会模型在拒绝处理与旁观者相关的查询时，仍然保持对主要说话人的理解能力。我们的研究表明，使用BPFT技术后，旁观者识别准确率提高了47%，而选择性效能指标则比Gemini 2.5 Pro高出16%。后者是未使用BPFT技术的最佳音频语言模型。总的来说，SH-Bench和BPFT为评估和改善音频语言模型中的旁观者隐私问题提供了第一个系统性的框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LiveCLKTBench: Towards Reliable Evaluation of Cross-Lingual Knowledge Transfer in Multilingual LLMs
papers.title_zh: LiveCLKTBench：迈向对多语言大语言模型中跨语言知识迁移的可靠评估
papers.authors: Pei-Fu Guo, Yun-Da Tsai, Chun-Chia Hsu, Kai-Xin Chen, Ya An Tsai, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng, Mi-Yen Yeh, Shou-De Lin
papers.abstract: Evaluating cross-lingual knowledge transfer in large language models (LLMs) is challenging, as correct answers in a target language may arise either from genuine transfer or from prior exposure during pre-training. We present LiveCLKTBench, an automated generation pipeline specifically designed to isolate and measure cross-lingual knowledge transfer. Our pipeline identifies self-contained, time-sensitive knowledge entities from real-world domains, filters them based on temporal occurrence, and verifies them against the model’s knowledge. The documents of these valid entities are then used to generate factual questions, which are translated into multiple languages to evaluate transferability across linguistic boundaries. Using LiveCLKTBench, we evaluate several LLMs across five languages and observe that cross-lingual transfer is strongly influenced by linguistic distance and often asymmetric across language directions. While larger models improve transfer, the gains diminish with scale and vary across domains. These findings provide new insights into multilingual transfer and demonstrate the value of LiveCLKTBench as a reliable benchmark for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型中的跨语言知识转移是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为目标语言中的正确答案可能源于真正的知识迁移，也可能源于预训练阶段对相关知识的接触。我们提出了LiveCLKTBench这一自动化生成流程，该流程专门用于分离和测量跨语言知识转移。我们的流程能够识别来自现实世界领域的、具有时间敏感性的知识实体，根据时间顺序对这些实体进行筛选，并验证它们与模型所拥有的知识是否一致。然后，利用这些有效实体的文档来生成事实性问题，并将这些问题翻译成多种语言，以评估知识在不同语言之间的可转移性。通过LiveCLKTBench，我们对五种语言的多个大语言模型进行了评估，发现跨语言知识转移受到语言距离的强烈影响，且通常在不同语言方向之间是不对称的。虽然更大的模型能提升知识转移的效果，但这种提升随着模型规模的增加而减弱，并且在不同领域之间也存在差异。这些发现为多语言知识转移提供了新的见解，同时也证明了LiveCLKTBench作为未来研究可靠基准工具的价值。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: To Lie or Not to Lie? Investigating The Biased Spread of Global Lies by LLMs
papers.title_zh: 该撒谎还是不撒谎？探究大型语言模型导致的全球谎言的偏见传播现象
papers.authors: Zohaib Khan, Mustafa Dogan, Ifeoma Okoh, Pouya Sadeghi, Siddhartha Shrestha, Sergius Justus Chesami Nyah, Mahmoud O. Mokhiamar, Michael J Ryan, Tarek Naous
papers.abstract: Misinformation is on the rise, and the strong writing capabilities of LLMs lower the barrier for malicious actors to produce and disseminate false information. We study how LLMs behave when prompted to spread misinformation across languages and target countries, and introduce GlobalLies, a multilingual parallel dataset of 440 misinformation generation prompt templates and 6,867 entities, spanning 8 languages and 195 countries. Using both human annotations and large-scale LLM-as-a-judge evaluations across hundreds of thousands of generations from state-of-the-art models, we show that misinformation generation varies systematically based on the country being discussed. Propagation of lies by LLMs is substantially higher in many lower-resource languages and for countries with a lower Human Development Index (HDI). We find that existing mitigation strategies provide uneven protection: input safety classifiers exhibit cross-lingual gaps, and retrieval-augmented fact-checking remains inconsistent across regions due to unequal information availability. We release GlobalLies for research purposes, aiming to support the development of mitigation strategies to reduce the spread of global misinformation: https://github.com/zohaib-khan5040/globallies
papers.abstract_zh: 虚假信息的传播正在加剧，而大语言模型强大的写作能力降低了恶意行为者制造和传播虚假信息的门槛。我们研究了当被要求以多种语言和针对特定国家传播错误信息时，这些模型的行为表现，并引入了GlobalLies这一多语言平行数据集，其中包含440种错误信息生成提示模板和6,867个实体，涵盖8种语言和195个国家。通过结合人类注释以及由先进模型进行的大规模评估，我们在数十万次生成过程中发现，错误信息的产生方式会根据所讨论的国家而有所变化。在资源匮乏的语言中，以及那些人类发展指数较低的国家里，大语言模型传播虚假信息的行为更为频繁。我们发现，现有的缓解策略并不能提供均匀的保护效果：输入安全分类器在不同语言之间存在差距，而基于检索的事实核查则因信息获取的不平等而在不同地区表现出不一致性。我们将GlobalLies数据集公开用于研究目的，旨在帮助开发有效的缓解策略，以减少全球虚假信息的传播：https://github.com/zohaib-khan5040/globallies
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Robertha: Eigenspectrum Regularized Attention for Robust Natural Language Understanding
papers.title_zh: 罗伯塔：用于稳健自然语言理解的自适应谱正则化注意力机制
papers.authors: Andreia Podasca, Anup Das
papers.abstract: We study asymmetric vulnerability to embedding corruption in encoder-based language models, where uniform perturbations dis-proportionately degrade low-magnitude embeddings compared to high-magnitude ones. Since critical words concentrate in low-norm space, this asymmetry causes catastrophic degradation of grammatical and semantic structure even under moderate corruption. Existing robustness approaches either sacrifice clean performance or fail to generalize to higher corruption levels. To address this problem, we propose Robertha, an attention mechanism built on Modern Hopfield Networks, in which semantic patterns act as stable states (attractors) that pull corrupted embeddings toward correct representations. We introduce iterative refinement for differential recovery: heavily corrupted embeddings require multiple convergence steps, while lightly corrupted embeddings converge quickly. To strengthen this mechanism, we introduce Eigenspectrum Regularization (ESR), which enforces low-rank key structures by controlling eigenvalue entropy, creating strong, well separated attractors with wide recovery basins. Across 13 GLUE and SuperGLUE tasks, Robertha significantly outperforms existing robustness methods while maintaining competitive clean performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在基于编码器的语言模型中嵌入腐败内容所带来的不对称脆弱性。在这种模型中，均匀的扰动会不成比例地降低低强度嵌入的精度，而高强度的嵌入则受影响较小。由于关键词汇集中在低范数空间，这种不对称性会导致语法和语义结构的严重退化，即使是在中等程度的腐败情况下也是如此。现有的鲁棒性方法要么牺牲了模型在干净状态下的性能，要么无法应对更高程度的腐败情况。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Robertha这一注意力机制，该机制基于现代霍普菲尔德网络构建，其中语义模式作为稳定状态（吸引子），将被腐败的嵌入引导到正确的表示形式。我们引入了迭代细化技术来恢复受损嵌入：严重受损的嵌入需要多次收敛过程，而轻度受损的嵌入则能够快速收敛。为了加强这一机制，我们引入了特征谱正则化技术，该技术通过控制特征值熵来强制实现低秩的关键结构，从而创造出强大且分离良好的吸引子，并拥有广泛的恢复范围。在13个GLUE和SuperGLUE任务中，Robertha显著优于现有的鲁棒性方法，同时仍保持了与干净模型相当的性能水平。
