papers.title: Agentic Rubrics as Contextual Verifiers for SWE Agents
papers.title_zh: 作为情境验证器的主动式评分标准在软件工程师代理中的应用
papers.authors: Mohit Raghavendra, Anisha Gunjal, Bing Liu, Yunzhong He
papers.abstract: Verification is critical for improving agents: it provides the reward signal for Reinforcement Learning and enables inference-time gains through Test-Time Scaling (TTS). Despite its importance, verification in software engineering (SWE) agent settings often relies on code execution, which can be difficult to scale due to environment setup overhead. Scalable alternatives such as patch classifiers and heuristic methods exist, but they are less grounded in codebase context and harder to interpret. To this end, we explore Agentic Rubrics: an expert agent interacts with the repository to create a context-grounded rubric checklist, and candidate patches are then scored against it without requiring test execution. On SWE-Bench Verified under parallel TTS evaluation, Agentic Rubrics achieve a score of 54.2% on Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B and 40.6% on Qwen3-32B, with at least a +3.5 percentage-point gain over the strongest baseline in our comparison set. We further analyze rubric behavior, showing that rubric scores are consistent with ground-truth tests while also flagging issues that tests do not capture. Our ablations show that agentic context gathering is essential for producing codebase-specific, unambiguous criteria. Together, these results suggest that Agentic Rubrics provide an efficient, scalable, and granular verification signal for SWE agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 验证对于提升智能体的性能至关重要：它为强化学习提供了奖励信号，并通过测试时间扩展技术实现了推理阶段的优化。尽管验证非常重要，但在软件工程中的智能体验证往往依赖于代码执行，而由于环境设置方面的开销，这种方式的扩展性较差。虽然存在一些可扩展的替代方案，如补丁分类器和启发式方法，但这些方法在代码库背景下的适用性较弱，且难以解释。为此，我们提出了“智能体评分表”这一方法：专家智能体与代码库进行交互，从而生成基于上下文的评分清单，然后无需执行测试即可对候选补丁进行评分。在SWE-Bench Verified的并行测试时间扩展评估中，“智能体评分表”在Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B模型上取得了54.2%的得分，在Qwen3-32B模型上取得了40.6%的得分，比我们比较集中的最强基线模型至少提高了3.5个百分点。我们还分析了评分表的行为，发现其得分与真实测试的结果一致，同时能够识别出测试未能捕捉到的问题。我们的分析表明，智能体对上下文的收集对于制定具有代码库特定性的、明确的标准至关重要。总的来说，这些结果表明，“智能体评分表”为软件工程智能体提供了一种高效、可扩展且细致化的验证手段。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evaluating the Impact of Verbal Multiword Expressions on Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: 评估多词短语在机器翻译中的影响
papers.authors: Linfeng Liu, Saptarshi Ghosh, Tianyu Jiang
papers.abstract: Verbal multiword expressions (VMWEs) remain difficult for machine translation because their meanings are often not recoverable from their component words. In this study, we analyze the impact of three VMWE categories—verbal idioms, verb-particle constructions, and light verb constructions—on machine translation quality from English to multiple languages. Using both established multiword expression datasets and standard machine translation datasets, we evaluate how state-of-the-art translation systems handle these expressions. Our experimental results consistently show that VMWEs negatively affect translation quality, with deeper analysis indicating that this degradation is primarily attributable to the VMWE itself rather than general sentence-level difficulty. We release our code and evaluation framework to test new MT systems for the community.
papers.abstract_zh: 动词多词表达（VMWEs）对于机器翻译来说仍然是一个挑战，因为它们的含义往往无法从构成它们的单词中还原出来。在这项研究中，我们分析了三种VMWEs类别——动词成语、动词-粒子结构以及轻量级动词结构——对英语到多种语言之间机器翻译质量的影响。通过利用现有的多词表达数据集和标准的机器翻译数据集，我们评估了最先进的翻译系统如何处理这些表达。我们的实验结果表明，VMWEs确实会对翻译质量产生负面影响，而更深入的分析表明，这种下降主要源于VMWEs本身，而非句子层面的难度问题。我们将我们的代码和评估框架公开出来，以便社区中的新翻译系统能够使用它们进行测试。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MedVerse: Efficient and Reliable Medical Reasoning via DAG-Structured Parallel Execution
papers.title_zh: MedVerse：通过有向无环图结构下的并行执行，实现高效可靠的医学推理
papers.authors: Jianwen Chen, Xinyu Yang, Peng Xia, Arian Azarang, Yueh Z Lee, Gang Li, Hongtu Zhu, Yun Li, Beidi Chen, Huaxiu Yao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance and rapid progress in a wide range of medical reasoning tasks.However, their sequential autoregressive decoding forces inherently parallel clinical reasoning, such as differential diagnosis, into a single linear reasoning path, limiting both efficiency and reliability for complex medical problems.To address this, we propose MedVerse, a reasoning framework for complex medical inference that reformulates medical reasoning as a parallelizable directed acyclic graph (DAG) process based on Petri Net theory.The framework adopts a full-stack design across data, model architecture, and system execution.For data creation, we introduce the MedVerse Curator, an automated pipeline that synthesizes knowledge-grounded medical reasoning path and transforms them into Petri Net–structured representations.At the architectural level, we propose a topology-aware attention mechanism with adaptive position indices that supports parallel reasoning while preserving logical consistency.Systematically, we develop a customized inference engine that supports parallel execution without additional overhead.Empirical evaluations show that MedVerse improves strong general-purpose LLMs by up to 8.9%. Compared to specialized medical LLMs, MedVerse achieves comparable performance with improved clinical reliability, while delivering a 1.3\times reduction in inference latency and a 1.7\times increase in generation throughput, enabled by its parallel decoding capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多种医学推理任务中表现出强大的性能和快速的进展。然而，它们的序列自回归解码方式本质上会将并行进行的临床推理过程，如鉴别诊断，压缩为单一的线性推理路径，这限制了在处理复杂医疗问题时效率和可靠性的提升。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了MedVerse这一用于复杂医学推理的推理框架。该框架基于Petri网理论，将医学推理重新构建为一个可并行化的有向无环图（DAG）过程。该框架在数据、模型架构和系统执行方面采用了全栈设计。在数据创建方面，我们引入了MedVerse Curator这一自动化流程，它能够合成基于知识的医学推理路径，并将其转换为Petri网结构化的表示形式。在架构层面，我们提出了一种具有自适应位置索引的拓扑感知注意力机制，该机制能够在保持逻辑一致性的同时支持并行推理。我们还开发了一种定制的推理引擎，能够在不增加额外开销的情况下实现并行执行。实验评估表明，MedVerse的性能比通用的大语言模型提升了8.9%。与专门的医学语言模型相比，MedVerse在性能上取得了相当的效果，同时提高了临床可靠性；此外，由于其并行解码能力，推理延迟降低了1.3倍，生成吞吐量则提高了1.7倍。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MetFuse: Figurative Fusion between Metonymy and Metaphor
papers.title_zh: MetFuse：指称与隐喻的融合
papers.authors: Saptarshi Ghosh, Tianyu Jiang
papers.abstract: Metonymy and metaphor often co-occur in natural language, yet computational work has studied them largely in isolation. We introduce a framework that transforms a literal sentence into three figurative variants: metonymic, metaphoric, and hybrid. Using this framework, we construct MetFuse, the first dedicated dataset of figurative fusion between metonymy and metaphor, containing 1,000 human-verified meaning-aligned quadruplets totaling 4,000 sentences. Extrinsic experiments on eight existing benchmarks show that augmenting training data with MetFuse consistently improves both metonymy and metaphor classification, with hybrid examples yielding the largest gains on metonymy tasks. Using this dataset, we also analyze how the presence of one figurative type impacts another. Our findings show that both human annotators and large language models better identify metonymy in hybrid sentences than in metonymy-only sentences, demonstrating that the presence of a metaphor makes a metonymic noun more explicit.
papers.abstract_zh: 转喻和隐喻在自然语言中常常同时出现，但计算机研究通常将它们分开进行探讨。我们提出了一种框架，可以将一个字面句子转化为三种比喻形式：转喻、隐喻和混合形式。利用这一框架，我们构建了MetFuse数据集，这是首个专门用于研究转喻与隐喻之间比喻融合的数据集，包含1000个经过人工验证的、意义一致的四元组，共计4000个句子。在八个现有基准测试上的外部实验表明，通过添加MetFuse数据可以持续提升转喻和隐喻的分类能力，其中混合形式的例子在转喻任务上取得了最大的提升效果。此外，我们还分析了其中一种比喻形式对另一种比喻形式的影响。研究发现，无论是人类注释者还是大语言模型，都能更准确地识别混合形式中的转喻现象，这表明隐喻的存在使得转喻性名词变得更加明确。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Adaptive Constraint Propagation: Scaling Structured Inference for Large Language Models via Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 自适应约束传播：通过元强化学习为大型语言模型实现结构化推理的扩展
papers.authors: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly require structured inference, from enforcing JSON schema to multilingual parsing, where outputs must satisfy complex constraints. We introduce MetaJuLS, a meta-reinforcement learning approach that learns universal constraint propagation policies applicable across languages and tasks without task-specific retraining. By formulating structured inference as adaptive constraint propagation and training a Graph Attention Network with meta-learning, MetaJuLS achieves 1.5-2.0× speedups over GPU-optimized baselines while maintaining an accuracy within 0.2% of that of state-of-the-art parsers. On Universal Dependencies across 10 languages and LLM-constrained generation (LogicBench, GSM8K-Constrained), MetaJuLS demonstrates rapid cross-domain adaptation: a policy trained on English parsing adapts to new languages and tasks with 5–10 gradient steps (5–15 seconds) rather than requiring hours of task-specific training. Mechanistic analysis reveals that the policy employs human-like parsing strategies (easy-first) and novel, non-intuitive heuristics. By reducing the number of propagation steps in LLM deployments, MetaJuLS contributes to Green AI by directly reducing the inference carbon footprint.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越需要结构化的推理能力，从执行JSON模式到多语言解析，输出的结果必须满足复杂的约束条件。我们提出了MetaJuLS这一元强化学习方法，它能够学习适用于多种语言和任务的通用约束传播策略，而无需针对特定任务进行重新训练。通过将结构化推理转化为自适应约束传播，并利用元学习技术训练图注意力网络，MetaJuLS在速度上实现了比GPU优化基线方案快1.5至2.0倍的提升，同时其准确率仍保持在与最先进解析器相同的0.2%以内。在包含10种语言的通用依存关系分析以及受LLM限制的生成任务（如LogicBench、GSM8K-Constrained）中，MetaJuLS展现了快速的跨领域适应能力：在英语解析上训练出的策略能够在5到10个梯度步骤内适应新的语言和任务，而无需花费数小时的特定任务训练。机制分析表明，该策略采用了类似人类的解析策略以及一些新颖且非直观的启发式方法。通过减少LLM部署中的传播步骤数量，MetaJuLS直接降低了推理过程中的碳足迹，从而为绿色AI的发展做出了贡献。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: STReasoner: Empowering LLMs for Spatio-Temporal Reasoning in Time Series via Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: STReasoner：通过空间感知强化学习，助力大型语言模型在时间序列数据中进行时空推理
papers.authors: Juntong Ni, Shiyu Wang, Qi He, Ming Jin, Wei Jin
papers.abstract: Spatio-temporal reasoning in time series involves the explicit synthesis of temporal dynamics, spatial dependencies, and textual context. This capability is vital for high-stakes decision-making in systems such as traffic networks, power grids, and disease propagation. However, the field remains underdeveloped because most existing works prioritize predictive accuracy over reasoning. To address the gap, we introduce ST-Bench, a benchmark consisting of four core tasks, including etiological reasoning, entity identification, correlation reasoning, and in-context forecasting, developed via a network SDE-based multi-agent data synthesis pipeline. We then propose STReasoner, a model that integrates time series, graph structure, and text for explicit reasoning. To promote spatially grounded logic, we introduce S-GRPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that rewards performance gains specifically attributable to spatial information. Experiments show that STReasoner achieves average accuracy gains between 17% and 135% at only 0.004x the cost of proprietary models and generalizes robustly to real-world data.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列中的时空推理涉及对时间动态、空间依赖性和文本上下文的明确整合。这一能力对于交通网络、电网和疾病传播等系统中的高风险决策至关重要。然而，由于现有研究大多更注重预测准确性而非推理能力，因此该领域仍处于发展初期。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ST-Bench基准测试，该测试包含四个核心任务：病因推理、实体识别、相关性推理以及上下文预测。这些任务是通过基于网络SDE的多智能体数据合成流程来实现的。此外，我们还提出了STReasoner模型，该模型能够整合时间序列、图结构和文本信息进行推理。为了促进基于空间的推理，我们引入了S-GRPO强化学习算法，该算法会奖励那些特别依赖于空间信息的性能提升。实验表明，STReasoner在仅比专有模型成本高出0.004倍的情况下，实现了平均17%到135%的准确率提升，并且其泛化能力也相当强，能够很好地处理现实世界的数据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When Vision-Language Models Judge Without Seeing: Exposing Informativeness Bias
papers.title_zh: 当视觉语言模型进行判断时却无需看到实物：揭示信息性偏见
papers.authors: Xiaohan Zou, Roshan Sridhar, Mohammadtaher Safarzadeh, Dan Roth
papers.abstract: The reliability of VLM-as-a-Judge is critical for the automatic evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs). Despite recent progress, our analysis reveals that VLM-as-a-Judge often pays limited attention to the image when making decisions. Instead, they often blindly favor the more informative answer, even when they can recognize it conflicts with the image content. We call this problem informativeness bias, which significantly undermines judge reliability. To address it, we propose BIRCH (Balanced Informativeness and CoRrectness with a Truthful AnCHor), a judging paradigm that first corrects inconsistencies with the image content in candidate answers, and then compares the answers against this corrected version. This shifts the judge’s focus from informativeness to image-grounded correctness. Experiments on multiple models and benchmarks show that BIRCH reduces informativeness bias by up to 17%, resulting in performance gains of up to 9.8%. Our work reveals an overlooked but fundamental flaw in current VLM-as-a-Judge systems and highlights the need for more principled designs.
papers.abstract_zh: 作为裁判的VLM的可靠性对于自动评估视觉-语言模型至关重要。尽管最近取得了一些进展，但我们的分析表明，作为裁判的VLM在做出决策时往往对图像关注不足。相反，它们常常盲目地选择信息量更大的答案，即使这些答案与图像内容相矛盾。我们将这个问题称为“信息性偏差”，这种偏差严重削弱了裁判的可靠性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了BIRCH（平衡信息性与正确性并追求真实性）这一评判范式。该范式首先纠正候选答案中与图像内容不一致的地方，然后再将这些答案与经过修正后的版本进行比较。这样，裁判的注意力就从信息性转移到了基于图像的准确性上。在多个模型和基准测试上的实验表明，BIRCH能够将信息性偏差降低多达17%，从而提升性能高达9.8%。我们的研究揭示了当前作为裁判的VLM系统中一个被忽视但根本性的缺陷，并强调了需要更加合理的设计方案。

papers.title: Hallucination Detection in LLMs with Topological Divergence on Attention Graphs
papers.title_zh: 在具有拓扑差异的注意力图上检测幻觉现象——针对大语言模型的应用
papers.authors: Alexandra Bazarova, Andrei Volodichev, Aleksandr Yugay, Andrey Shulga, Alina Ermilova, Konstantin Polev, Julia Belikova, Rauf Parchiev, Dmitry Simakov, Maxim Savchenko, Andrey Savchenko, Serguei Barannikov, Alexey Zaytsev
papers.abstract: Hallucinations remain a critical challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) settings where models may generate outputs unsupported by the provided context. To address this, we introduce TOHA, a TOpology-based HAllucination detector, which leverages a topological divergence metric to quantify the structural properties of graphs induced by attention matrices. Examining the topological divergence between prompt and response subgraphs in RAG settings reveals consistent patterns: higher divergence values in specific attention heads correlate with unfaithful outputs, independent of the dataset. Extensive experiments — including evaluations on question answering and summarization tasks — show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results on several benchmarks while requiring minimal annotated data and computational resources. Our findings indicate that the topological structure of attention matrices provides an efficient and robust metric for assessing the correctness of LLM’s responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉仍然是大语言模型面临的一个关键挑战，尤其是在检索增强生成（RAG）场景中，模型可能会生成与给定上下文不符的输出。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了TOHA——一种基于拓扑学的幻觉检测器。该检测器利用拓扑差异度量来量化由注意力矩阵所诱导的图的结构特性。在RAG场景中，对提示子图和响应子图之间的拓扑差异进行分析，可以发现一些规律：特定注意力头中的较高差异值与不准确的输出相关，这一关系不受数据集的影响。通过大量实验——包括针对问答和摘要任务的评估——我们发现，我们的方法能够在多种基准测试中取得最先进或具有竞争力的成绩，同时所需的标注数据和计算资源却非常有限。我们的研究结果表明，注意力矩阵的拓扑结构为评估语言模型输出的正确性提供了一种高效且可靠的度量方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Exploring Concreteness Through a Figurative Lens
papers.title_zh: 通过比喻的视角探索具体性
papers.authors: Saptarshi Ghosh, Tianyu Jiang
papers.abstract: Static concreteness ratings are widely used in NLP, yet a word’s concreteness can shift with context, especially in figurative language such as metaphor, where common concrete nouns can take abstract interpretations. While such shifts are evident from context, it remains unclear how LLMs understand concreteness internally. We conduct a layer-wise and geometric analysis of LLM hidden representations across four model families, examining how models distinguish literal vs. figurative uses of the same noun and how concreteness is organized in representation space. We find that LLMs separate literal and figurative usage in early layers, and that mid-to-late layers compress concreteness into a one-dimensional direction that is consistent across models. Finally, we show this geometric structure is practically useful: a single concreteness direction supports efficient figurative-language classification and enables training-free steering of generation toward more literal or more figurative rewrites.
papers.abstract_zh: 静态具体性评分在自然语言处理领域被广泛使用，但一个词的具象性会随着上下文的变化而发生变化，尤其是在比喻等形象化语言中，常见的具体名词可能会具有抽象的含义。虽然这种变化可以通过上下文来感知，但尚不清楚大语言模型是如何在内部理解具象性的。我们对四种模型家族的大语言模型的隐藏表示进行了逐层和几何分析，研究这些模型如何区分同一个名词的字面意义和比喻意义，以及具象性在表示空间中的组织方式。我们发现，大语言模型在早期层次上能够区分字面意义和比喻意义，而在中后期，具象性被压缩成一种一维方向，这一方向在不同模型中是一致的。最后，我们表明这种几何结构具有实际用途：单一的具体性方向能够支持高效的形象化语言分类，并且可以无需训练即可引导生成更字面或更具比喻意味的改写文本。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mediocrity is the key for LLM as a Judge Anchor Selection
papers.title_zh: 对于大型语言模型来说，平庸性正是其选择评判节点的关键所在
papers.authors: Shachar Don-Yehiya, Asaf Yehudai, Leshem Choshen, Omri Abend
papers.abstract: The “LLM-as-a-judge” paradigm has become a standard method for evaluating open-ended generation. To address the quadratic scalability costs of pairwise comparisons, popular benchmarks like Arena-Hard and AlpacaEval compare all models against a single anchor. However, despite its widespread use, the impact of anchor selection on the reliability of the results remains largely unexplored. In this work, we systematically investigate the effect of anchor selection by evaluating 22 different anchors on the Arena-Hard-v2.0 dataset. We find that the choice of anchor is critical: a poor anchor can dramatically reduce correlation with human rankings. We identify that common anchor choices (best-performing and worst-performing models) make poor anchors. Because these extreme anchors are consistently better or worse than all other models, they are seldom indicative of the relative ranking of the models. We further quantify the effect size of anchor selection, showing it is comparable to the selection of a judge model. We conclude with actionable recommendations. First, we conduct a power analysis, and compute sufficient benchmark sizes for anchor-based evaluation, finding that standard benchmark sizes are insufficient for pairwise evaluation and fail to distinguish between competitive models reliably. Second, we provide guidelines for selecting informative anchors to ensure reliable and efficient evaluation practices.
papers.abstract_zh: “以法官为评判者的大语言模型”这一范式已成为评估开放式生成任务的标准方法。为了解决成对比较带来的二次方扩展性问题，像Arena-Hard和AlpacaEval这样的流行基准测试会将所有模型与单一基准模型进行比较。然而，尽管这种方法被广泛使用，但基准模型选择对结果可靠性的影响仍然缺乏深入研究。在这项研究中，我们通过在Arena-Hard-v2.0数据集上测试22种不同的基准模型，系统地研究了基准模型选择的影响。我们发现基准模型的选择至关重要：选择不当的基准模型会显著降低与人类排名的相关性。我们还发现，常见的基准模型选择（即表现最好和最差的模型）往往会导致选择出质量较差的基准模型。因为这些极端基准模型始终比其他所有模型表现得更好或更差，所以它们很少能反映模型的相对排名。我们进一步量化了基准模型选择的影响程度，结果表明其影响程度与选择一名评判模型相当。最后，我们提出了一些可行的建议。首先，我们进行了一项功效分析，计算出基于基准模型进行评估所需的足够大的基准规模，结果发现传统的基准规模对于成对评估来说是不够的，也无法可靠地区分具有竞争力的模型。其次，我们提供了选择有信息价值的基准模型的指南，以确保评估过程既可靠又高效。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When "Correct" Is Not Safe: Can We Trust Functionally Correct Patches Generated by Code Agents?
papers.title_zh: 当“正确”不再安全时：我们能否信任由代码代理生成的功能上正确的补丁？
papers.authors: Yibo Peng, James Song, Lei Li, Xinyu Yang, Mihai Christodorescu, Ravi Mangal, Corina S. Pasareanu, Haizhong Zheng, Beidi Chen
papers.abstract: Code agents are increasingly trusted to autonomously fix bugs on platforms such as GitHub, yet their security evaluation focuses almost exclusively on functional correctness. In this paper, we reveal a novel type of threat to real-world code-agents: functionally correct yet vulnerable (FCV) patches, which pass all test cases but contain vulnerable code. With our proposed FCV-Attack, we demonstrate that SOTA LLMs (e.g., ChatGPT and Claude) and agent scaffolds (e.g., SWE-agent and OpenHands) are all vulnerable to this FCV threat; across 12 agent-model combinations on SWE-Bench, the attack only requires black-box access and a single query to the code agent to perform the attack. For example, for CWE-538 (information exposure vulnerability), the FCV-Attack attains an attack success rate of 40.7% on GPT-5 Mini + OpenHands. Our results reveal an important security threat overlooked by current evaluation paradigms and urge the development of security-aware defenses for code agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 代码代理在诸如GitHub这样的平台上被越来越多地信任用于自主修复漏洞，然而它们的安全评估几乎完全集中在功能正确性上。在本文中，我们揭示了一种针对真实代码代理的新型威胁：功能上正确但存在漏洞的修补程序，这类修补程序能够通过所有测试案例，但却包含有漏洞的代码。通过我们提出的FCV攻击方法，我们发现最先进的LLM（例如ChatGPT和Claude）以及代理框架（例如SWE-agent和OpenHands）都容易受到这种FCV威胁的影响；在SWE-Bench上的12种代理模型组合测试中，该攻击只需对代码代理进行黑盒访问和一次查询即可实施。例如，对于CWE-538这种信息暴露漏洞，FCV攻击在GPT-5 Mini + OpenHands上的成功率为40.7%。我们的研究结果揭示了当前评估方式所忽视的一个重要安全威胁，并呼吁为代码代理开发具有安全意识的防御机制。

papers.title: CoG: Controllable Graph Reasoning via Relational Blueprints and Failure-Aware Refinement over Knowledge Graphs
papers.title_zh: CoG：基于关系蓝图的可控图推理技术，以及对知识图谱的故障容忍性优化处理机制
papers.authors: Yuanxiang Liu, Songze Li, Xiaoke Guo, Zhaoyan Gong, Qifei Zhang, Huajun Chen, Wen Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities but often grapple with reliability challenges like hallucinations. While Knowledge Graphs (KGs) offer explicit grounding, existing paradigms of KG-augmented LLMs typically exhibit cognitive rigidity—applying homogeneous search strategies that render them vulnerable to instability under neighborhood noise and structural misalignment leading to reasoning stagnation. To address these challenges, we propose CoG, a training-free framework inspired by Dual-Process Theory that mimics the interplay between intuition and deliberation. First, functioning as the fast, intuitive process, the Relational Blueprint Guidance module leverages relational blueprints as interpretable soft structural constraints to rapidly stabilize the search direction against noise. Second, functioning as the prudent, analytical process, the Failure-Aware Refinement module intervenes upon encountering reasoning impasses. It triggers evidence-conditioned reflection and executes controlled backtracking to overcome reasoning stagnation. Experimental results on three benchmarks demonstrate that CoG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both accuracy and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）展现了出色的推理能力，但往往面临诸如幻觉等可靠性挑战。而知图（KG）则提供了明确的指导，然而现有的基于知图增强的LLM方法通常表现出认知僵化现象——它们采用统一的搜索策略，这使得它们在受到局部噪声或结构不匹配的影响时容易陷入推理停滞。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了CoG框架。该框架无需训练即可运行，其设计灵感来源于双过程理论，能够模拟直觉与理性之间的相互作用。首先，作为快速、直观的搜索过程，关系蓝图引导模块利用可解释的关系蓝图作为软性结构约束，从而迅速稳定搜索方向，避免受到噪声的影响。其次，作为审慎、分析性的处理过程，故障感知优化模块会在遇到推理困境时介入。它触发基于证据的反思，并执行有控制的回溯操作，以克服推理停滞的问题。在三个基准测试中的实验结果表明，CoG在准确性和效率方面均显著优于现有最先进的方法。

papers.title: Latent Agents: A Post-Training Procedure for Internalized Multi-Agent Debate
papers.title_zh: 潜在代理人：一种用于实现多智能体辩论内化的后训练程序
papers.authors: John Seon Keun Yi, Aaron Mueller, Dokyun Lee
papers.abstract: Multi-agent debate has been shown to improve reasoning in large language models (LLMs). However, it is compute-intensive, requiring generation of long transcripts before answering questions. To address this inefficiency, we develop a framework that distills multi-agent debate into a single LLM through a two-stage fine-tuning pipeline combining debate structure learning with internalization via dynamic reward scheduling and length clipping. Across multiple models and benchmarks, our internalized models match or exceed explicit multi-agent debate performance using up to 93% fewer tokens. We then investigate the mechanistic basis of this capability through activation steering, finding that internalization creates agent-specific subspaces: interpretable directions in activation space corresponding to different agent perspectives. We further demonstrate a practical application: by instilling malicious agents into the LLM through internalized debate, then applying negative steering to suppress them, we show that distillation makes harmful behaviors easier to localize and control with smaller reductions in general performance compared to steering base models. Our findings offer a new perspective for understanding multi-agent capabilities in distilled models and provide practical guidelines for controlling internalized reasoning behaviors.
papers.abstract_zh: 多智能体辩论已被证明能够提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，这种方法需要大量的计算资源，在回答问题之前需要先生成较长的文本记录。为了克服这一效率问题，我们开发了一个框架，通过两阶段的微调流程将多智能体辩论转化为单一LLM的处理方式。该流程结合了辩论结构的学习以及通过动态奖励调度和长度限制来实现内部化处理。在多个模型和基准测试中，我们的内部化模型在使用的标记数量上比显式多智能体辩论方案减少了高达93%。我们还通过激活引导机制研究了这种能力的机制基础，发现内部化处理会创建出特定于每个智能体的子空间：在激活空间中，这些子空间代表了不同智能体的视角。此外，我们还展示了一种实际应用方法：通过将恶意智能体注入到经过内部化处理的LLM中，然后应用负面引导来抑制它们，我们发现，与直接引导基础模型相比，这种蒸馏方法能够更轻松地定位和控制有害行为，同时不会显著降低整体性能。我们的研究结果为理解蒸馏模型中多智能体的能力提供了新的视角，并为控制内部化推理行为提供了实用的指导方针。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Act-Adaptive Margin: Dynamically Calibrating Reward Models for Subjective Ambiguity
papers.title_zh: 行为自适应保证金：动态校准奖励模型以处理主观不确定性问题
papers.authors: Feiteng Fang, Dingwei Chen, Xiang Huang, Ting-En Lin, Yuchuan Wu, Xiong Liu, Jing Ye, Ziqiang Liu, Haonan Zhang, Liang Zhu, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Min Yang, Yongbin Li
papers.abstract: Currently, most reinforcement learning tasks focus on domains like mathematics and programming, where verification is relatively straightforward. However, in subjective tasks such as role-playing, alignment techniques struggle to make progress, primarily because subjective reward modeling using the Bradley-Terry model faces significant challenges when dealing with ambiguous preferences. To improve reward modeling in subjective tasks, this paper proposes AAM (Act-Adaptive Margin), which enhances reward modeling by dynamically calibrating preference margins using the model’s internal parameter knowledge. We design two versions of AAM that efficiently generate contextually-appropriate preference gaps without additional human annotation. This approach fundamentally improves how reward models handle subjective rewards by better integrating generative understanding with preference scoring. To validate AAM’s effectiveness in subjective reward modeling, we conduct evaluations on RewardBench, JudgeBench, and challenging role-playing tasks. Results show that AAM significantly improves subjective reward modeling performance, enhancing Bradley-Terry reward models by 2.95% in general tasks and 4.85% in subjective role-playing tasks. Furthermore, reward models trained with AAM can help downstream alignment tasks achieve better results. Our test results show that applying rewards generated by AAM-Augmented RM to preference learning techniques (e.g., GRPO) achieves state-of-the-art results on CharacterEval and Charm. The code and dataset will be released upon acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，大多数强化学习任务都集中在数学和编程等领域，这些领域的验证相对简单。然而，在角色扮演等主观任务中，对齐技术难以取得进展，主要是因为使用Bradley-Terry模型进行主观奖励建模时，面对模糊的偏好选择时会遇到重大挑战。为了改进主观任务中的奖励建模，本文提出了AAM（自适应偏好边际）方法。该方法通过利用模型内部参数知识来动态调整偏好边际，从而提升奖励建模的效果。我们设计了两种版本的AAM，它们能够在不需额外人工标注的情况下，高效地生成符合上下文的偏好差距。这种方法从根本上改善了奖励模型处理主观奖励的方式，通过将生成式理解与偏好评分更好地结合起来。为了验证AAM在主观奖励建模中的有效性，我们在RewardBench、JudgeBench以及具有挑战性的角色扮演任务上进行了评估。结果表明，AAM显著提升了主观奖励建模的性能：在一般任务中， Bradley-Terry奖励模型的性能提高了2.95%，在主观角色扮演任务中则提高了4.85%。此外，使用AAM训练的奖励模型还能帮助下游的对齐任务取得更好的效果。我们的测试结果显示，将AAM增强的奖励应用于偏好学习技术（如GRPO）后，在CharacterEval和Charm任务上取得了最先进的结果。代码和数据集将在项目被接受后发布。

papers.title: To Think or Not to Think: The Hidden Cost of Meta-Training with Excessive CoT Examples
papers.title_zh: 是否思考：过度依赖大量常识示例进行元训练所带来的隐性成本
papers.authors: Vignesh Kothapalli, Ata Fatahibaarzi, Hamed Firooz, Maziar Sanjabi
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting combined with few-shot in-context learning (ICL) has unlocked significant reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs). However, ICL with CoT examples is ineffective on novel tasks when the pre-training knowledge is insufficient. We study this problem in a controlled setting using the CoT-ICL Lab framework, and propose meta-training techniques to learn novel abstract reasoning tasks in-context. Although CoT examples facilitate reasoning, we noticed that their excessive inclusion during meta-training degrades performance when CoT supervision is limited. To mitigate such behavior, we propose CoT-Recipe, a formal approach to modulate the mix of CoT and non-CoT examples in meta-training sequences. We demonstrate that careful modulation via CoT-Recipe can increase the accuracy of transformers on novel tasks by up to 300% even when there are no CoT examples available in-context. We confirm the broader effectiveness of these techniques by applying them to pretrained LLMs (Qwen2.5 series) for symbolic reasoning tasks and observing gains of up to 130% in accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于上下文推理的提示与少量样本上下文学习相结合，显著提升了大语言模型的能力。然而，当预训练知识不足时，仅使用上下文推理示例的上下文学习在应对新任务时效果不佳。我们在CoT-ICL实验室框架的严格控制环境下研究了这个问题，并提出了元训练技术来学习新的抽象推理任务。虽然上下文推理示例有助于推理过程，但我们发现，在元训练中过度使用这些示例会削弱性能，尤其是在上下文中的上下文推理监督有限的情况下。为了缓解这种情况，我们提出了CoT-Recipe这一方法，它是一种调节元训练序列中上下文推理与非上下文推理示例比例的形式化方案。我们的实验表明，通过CoT-Recipe进行精确调节，即使在没有上下文中的上下文推理示例的情况下，也能使模型在新任务上的准确率提高多达300%。通过将这种技术应用于预训练的LLM（如Qwen2.5系列），我们观察到准确率提高了高达130%，从而证实了这些技术的广泛有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VIGNETTE: Socially Grounded Bias Evaluation for Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 插画：基于社会因素的视觉与语言模型偏见评估
papers.authors: Chahat Raj, Bowen Wei, Aylin Caliskan, Antonios Anastasopoulos, Ziwei Zhu
papers.abstract: While bias in large language models (LLMs) is well-studied, similar concerns in vision-language models (VLMs) have received comparatively less attention. Existing VLM bias studies often focus on portrait-style images and gender-occupation associations, overlooking broader and more complex social stereotypes and their implied harm. This work introduces Vignette, a large-scale VQA benchmark with 30M+ images for evaluating bias in VLMs through a question-answering framework spanning four directions: factuality, perception, stereotyping, and decision making. Beyond narrowly-centered studies, we assess how VLMs interpret identities in contextualized settings, revealing how models make trait and capability assumptions and exhibit patterns of discrimination. Drawing from social psychology, we examine how VLMs connect visual identity cues to trait and role-based inferences, encoding social hierarchies, through biased selections. Our findings uncover subtle, multifaceted, and surprising stereotypical patterns, offering insights into how VLMs construct social meaning from inputs.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型中的偏见已经得到了充分研究，但视觉-语言模型中类似的偏见问题却相对较少受到关注。现有的视觉-语言模型偏见研究往往集中在肖像式图片以及性别与职业的关联上，而忽略了更为复杂的社会刻板印象及其带来的危害。本研究提出了Vignette这一大规模视觉问答基准数据集，该数据集包含3000万张图片，通过一种涵盖四个方面的问答框架来评估视觉-语言模型中的偏见：事实性、感知、刻板印象以及决策能力。除了这些狭隘的研究之外，我们还探讨了视觉-语言模型在具体情境下如何解读身份特征，揭示了模型是如何做出关于特质和能力的假设，并表现出哪些歧视模式。基于社会心理学的研究成果，我们进一步研究了视觉-语言模型如何将视觉身份线索与基于特质和角色的判断联系起来，以及如何通过有偏的选择来编码社会等级关系。我们的研究发现揭示了那些微妙、多面且令人惊讶的刻板印象模式，为理解视觉-语言模型如何从输入数据中构建社会意义提供了重要启示。

papers.title: BiMind: A Dual-Head Reasoning Model with Attention-Geometry Adapter for Incorrect Information Detection
papers.title_zh: BiMind：一种双脑推理模型，具备注意力几何适配器功能，可用于识别错误信息
papers.authors: Zhongxing Zhang, Emily K. Vraga, Jisu Huh, Jaideep Srivastava
papers.abstract: Incorrect information poses significant challenges by disrupting content veracity and integrity, yet most detection approaches struggle to jointly balance textual content verification with external knowledge modification under collapsed attention geometries. To address this issue, we propose a dual-head reasoning framework, BiMind, which disentangles content-internal reasoning from knowledge-augmented reasoning. In BiMind, we introduce three core innovations: (i) an attention geometry adapter that reshapes attention logits via token-conditioned offsets and mitigates attention collapse; (ii) a self-retrieval knowledge mechanism, which constructs an in-domain semantic memory through kNN retrieval and injects retrieved neighbors via feature-wise linear modulation; (iii) the uncertainty-aware fusion strategies, including entropy-gated fusion and a trainable agreement head, stabilized by a symmetric Kullback-Leibler agreement regularizer. To quantify the knowledge contributions, we define a novel metric, Value-of-eXperience (VoX), to measure instance-wise logit gains from knowledge-augmented reasoning. Experiment results on public datasets demonstrate that our BiMind model outperforms advanced detection approaches and provides interpretable diagnostics on when and why knowledge matters. Our BiMind model and the tested datasets are available at https://github.com/cvzh/BiMind.
papers.abstract_zh: 错误的信息会严重破坏内容的真实性和完整性，给处理带来巨大挑战。然而，大多数检测方法在注意力机制被压缩的情况下，难以同时兼顾文本内容验证与外部知识的修正。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种双头部推理框架BiMind，该框架将内容内部的推理与知识增强的推理分离开来。在BiMind中，我们引入了三项核心创新：(i) 一种注意力几何适配器，它通过基于令牌的偏移来重新塑造注意力权重，从而减轻注意力机制的崩溃问题；(ii) 一种自检索知识机制，它通过KNN检索来构建领域内的语义记忆，并通过特征线性调制的方式将检索到的邻居信息注入模型中；(iii) 一系列考虑不确定性的融合策略，包括熵门控融合以及一个可训练的一致性头部，该头部由对称的Kullback-Leibler一致性正则化器进行稳定化。为了量化知识的贡献，我们定义了一个新的度量指标——价值体验（Value-of-eXperience，VoX），用于衡量来自知识增强推理的实例级逻辑增益。在公开数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的BiMind模型优于现有的高级检测方法，并且能够解释性地说明知识何时以及为何具有重要性。我们的BiMind模型和测试数据集可以在https://github.com/cvzh/BiMind上获取。

papers.title: Autonomous Knowledge Graph Exploration with Adaptive Breadth-Depth Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 基于自适应宽度-深度检索的自主知识图谱探索
papers.authors: Joaquin Polonuer, Lucas Vittor, Iñaki Arango, Ayush Noori, David A. Clifton, Luciano Del Corro, Marinka Zitnik
papers.abstract: Retrieving evidence for language model queries from knowledge graphs requires balancing broad search across the graph with multi-hop traversal to follow relational links. Similarity-based retrievers provide coverage but remain shallow, whereas traversal-based methods rely on selecting seed nodes to start exploration, which can fail when queries span multiple entities and relations. We introduce ARK: Adaptive Retriever of Knowledge, a tool-using KG retriever that gives a language model control over this breadth-depth tradeoff using a two-operation toolset: global lexical search over node descriptors and one-hop neighborhood exploration that composes into multi-hop traversal. ARK alternates between breadth-oriented discovery and depth-oriented expansion without depending on a fragile seed selection, a pre-set hop depth, or requiring retrieval training. ARK adapts tool use to queries, using global search for language-heavy queries and neighborhood exploration for relation-heavy queries.On STaRK, ARK reaches 59.1% average Hit@1 and 67.4 average MRR, improving average Hit@1 by up to 31.4% and average MRR by up to 28.0% over retrieval-based and agent-based training-free methods.Finally, we distill ARK’s tool-use trajectories from a large teacher into an 8B model via label-free imitation, improving Hit@1 by +7.0, +26.6, and +13.5 absolute points over the base 8B model on AMAZON, MAG, and PRIME datasets, respectively, while retaining up to 98.5% of the teacher’s Hit@1 rate.
papers.abstract_zh: 从知识图谱中检索语言模型查询所需的数据，需要在对整个图谱进行广泛搜索的同时，实现多跳遍历以遵循关系链接。基于相似度的检索方法能够覆盖大部分数据，但效果较为浅显；而基于遍历的方法则需要通过选择初始节点来开始探索，但当查询涉及多个实体和关系时，这种方法可能会失败。我们提出了ARK：自适应知识检索器，这是一种利用工具的知识图谱检索工具。它通过使用两种操作方式来平衡广度与深度之间的权衡：一种是针对节点描述符的全局词汇搜索，另一种则是单跳邻域探索，这两种方式共同构成了多跳遍历机制。ARK能够在广度导向的发现和深度导向的扩展之间灵活切换，无需依赖脆弱的初始节点选择、预设的跳跃深度或检索训练。ARK能够根据查询需求调整使用工具的方式，对于涉及大量词汇的查询采用全局搜索，而对于涉及大量关系的查询则采用邻域探索。在STaRK数据集上，ARK的平均Hit@1达到了59.1%，平均MRR达到了67.4%。与基于检索的方法和无需训练的基于代理的方法相比，ARK的平均Hit@1提高了31.4%，平均MRR提高了28.0%。最后，我们通过无标签模仿的方式，将ARK的工具使用轨迹从大型教师模型中提取出来，并将其压缩到一个8B模型中。在AMAZON、MAG和PRIME数据集上，ARK的Hit@1分别比基础8B模型提高了7.0、26.6和13.5个绝对点，同时保留了高达98.5%的教师模型的Hit@1率。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Retrieval Heads are Dynamic
papers.title_zh: 检索头是动态变化的
papers.authors: Yuping Lin, Zitao Li, Yue Xing, Pengfei He, Yingqian Cui, Yaliang Li, Bolin Ding, Jingren Zhou, Jiliang Tang
papers.abstract: Recent studies have identified “retrieval heads” in Large Language Models (LLMs) responsible for extracting information from input contexts. However, prior works largely rely on static statistics aggregated across datasets, identifying heads that perform retrieval on average. This perspective overlooks the fine-grained temporal dynamics of autoregressive generation. In this paper, we investigate retrieval heads from a dynamic perspective. Through extensive analysis, we establish three core claims: (1) Dynamism: Retrieval heads vary dynamically across timesteps; (2) Irreplaceability: Dynamic retrieval heads are specific at each timestep and cannot be effectively replaced by static retrieval heads; and (3) Correlation: The model’s hidden state encodes a predictive signal for future retrieval head patterns, indicating an internal planning mechanism. We validate these findings on the Needle-in-a-Haystack task and a multi-hop QA task, and quantify the differences on the utility of dynamic and static retrieval heads in a Dynamic Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework. Our study provides new insights into the internal mechanisms of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究发现，大语言模型中存在一些“检索头”，它们负责从输入上下文中提取信息。然而，以往的研究大多依赖于跨数据集聚合的静态统计数据，从而识别出那些能够平均进行检索的检索头。这种研究方法忽略了自回归生成的细微时间动态变化。在本文中，我们从动态的角度对检索头进行了研究。通过深入分析，我们得出了三个核心结论：(1) 动态性：检索头在不同时间步长上会发生变化；(2) 不可替代性：动态检索头在每个时间步长上都是独特的，无法被静态检索头有效替代；(3) 相关性：模型的隐藏状态包含了对未来检索头模式的预测信号，这表明模型内部存在某种规划机制。我们在“针尖上的干草”任务和多跳问答任务上验证了这些发现，并量化了在动态检索增强生成框架中，动态检索头和静态检索头在效用上的差异。我们的研究为理解大语言模型的内部机制提供了新的见解。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SynthAgent: Adapting Web Agents with Synthetic Supervision
papers.title_zh: SynthAgent：通过模拟式监管来适配网络代理角色
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Wang, Yiming Liang, Xuchao Zhang, Qianhui Wu, Siwei Han, Anson Bastos, Rujia Wang, Chetan Bansal, Baolin Peng, Jianfeng Gao, Saravan Rajmohan, Huaxiu Yao
papers.abstract: Web agents struggle to adapt to new websites due to the scarcity of environment specific tasks and demonstrations. Recent works have explored synthetic data generation to address this challenge, however, they suffer from data quality issues where synthesized tasks contain hallucinations that cannot be executed, and collected trajectories are noisy with redundant or misaligned actions. In this paper, we propose SynthAgent, a fully synthetic supervision framework that aims at improving synthetic data quality via dual refinement of both tasks and trajectories. Our approach begins by synthesizing diverse tasks through categorized exploration of web elements, ensuring efficient coverage of the target environment. During trajectory collection, tasks are refined only when conflicts with observations are detected, which mitigates hallucinations while preserving task consistency. After collection, we conduct trajectory refinement with global context to mitigate potential noise or misalignments. Finally, we fine-tune open-source web agents on the refined synthetic data to adapt them to the target environment. Experimental results demonstrate that SynthAgent outperforms existing synthetic data methods, validating the importance of high-quality synthetic supervision. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/SynthAgent.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络代理在适应新网站环境时面临困难，因为缺乏针对特定环境的任务描述和演示。最近的一些研究尝试通过合成数据来应对这一挑战，但这些问题仍然存在：合成任务中可能存在无法执行的幻觉现象，而收集到的轨迹则存在噪声，包含冗余或错位的操作。在本文中，我们提出了SynthAgent这一全合成监督框架，该框架通过双重优化任务描述和轨迹质量来提高合成数据的质量。我们的方法首先通过分类探索网络元素来生成多样化的任务，从而确保能够高效地覆盖目标环境。在轨迹收集过程中，只有当发现任务与观测结果发生冲突时才会进行优化，这样可以减少幻觉现象，同时保持任务的一致性。在收集完成后，我们会利用全局上下文对轨迹进行进一步优化，以消除潜在的噪声或错位问题。最后，我们会使用优化后的合成数据来训练开源网络代理，使其能够更好地适应目标环境。实验结果表明，SynthAgent在性能上优于现有的合成数据方法，这充分证明了高质量合成监督的重要性。代码可以在https://github.com/aiming-lab/SynthAgent下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: More Than Meets the Eye: Measuring the Semiotic Gap in Vision-Language Models via Semantic Anchorage
papers.title_zh: 不仅仅是视觉：通过语义锚定技术来衡量视觉语言模型中的符号学差异
papers.authors: Wei He
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at photorealistic generation, yet often struggle to represent abstract meaning such as idiomatic interpretations of noun compounds. To study whether high visual fidelity interferes with idiomatic compositionality under visual abstraction, we introduce DIVA, a controlled benchmark that replaces high-fidelity visual detail with schematic iconicity by generating paired, sense-anchored visualizations for literal and idiomatic readings.We further propose Semantic Alignment Gap (\Delta), an architecture-agnostic metric that quantifies divergence between literal and idiomatic visual grounding.We additionally introduce a directional signed bias b(t) to separately measure the direction and strength of literal preference.Evaluating 8 recent VLMs, we reveal a consistent Literal Superiority Bias: model scale alone does not resolve literal preference, and increased visual fidelity is associated with weaker symbolic alignment, suggesting cognitive interference from hyper-realistic imagery. Our findings suggest that improving compositional understanding requires iconographic abstraction of visual input and anchoring interpretation and generation in intended meaning.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在逼真图像生成方面表现出色，但在表达抽象概念时却常常遇到困难，比如名词复合词的习语性用法。为了研究高视觉保真度是否会影响习语性的组合性表达，我们提出了DIVA这一实验基准方法。该方法通过生成具有意义的配对可视化图像，来替代高保真度的视觉细节，从而实现对字面意义和习语性意义的视觉呈现。我们还提出了“语义对齐差距”这一与架构无关的度量指标，用于衡量字面意义和习语性意义在视觉呈现上的差异。此外，我们还引入了一个方向性符号偏差b(t)，以分别衡量字面意义的偏好方向和强度。通过对8种最新视觉语言模型进行评估，我们发现存在一个持续的字面优势偏见：模型规模本身并不能消除字面意义的偏好，而更高的视觉保真度则与较弱的符号对齐能力相关，这表明超现实的视觉形象可能会带来认知上的干扰。我们的研究结果表明，要提高组合性理解能力，就需要对视觉输入进行图标化抽象处理，并将解释和生成过程与预期的意义联系起来。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLM Agents in Law: Taxonomy, Applications, and Challenges
papers.title_zh: 法律领域的机器学习智能体：分类、应用与挑战
papers.authors: Shuang Liu, Ruijia Zhang, Ruoyun Ma, Yujia Deng, Lanyi Zhu, Jiayu Li, Zelong Li, Zhibin Shen, Mengnan Du
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have precipitated a dramatic improvement in the legal domain, yet the deployment of standalone models faces significant limitations regarding hallucination, outdated information, and verifiability. Recently, LLM agents have attracted significant attention as a solution to these challenges, utilizing advanced capabilities such as planning, memory, and tool usage to meet the rigorous standards of legal practice. In this paper, we present a comprehensive survey of LLM agents for legal tasks, analyzing how these architectures bridge the gap between technical capabilities and domain-specific needs. Our major contributions include: (1) systematically analyzing the technical transition from standard legal LLMs to legal agents; (2) presenting a structured taxonomy of current agent applications across distinct legal practice areas; (3) discussing evaluation methodologies specifically for agentic performance in law; and (4) identifying open challenges and outlining future directions for developing robust and autonomous legal assistants.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在法律领域取得了显著的进步，不过独立模型的部署仍然存在一些局限性，比如幻觉现象、信息过时以及可验证性方面的问题。最近，基于大语言模型的智能体受到了广泛关注，它们利用规划、记忆和工具使用等先进能力来应对法律实践中的严格要求。在本文中，我们对用于法律任务的LLM智能体进行了全面的研究，分析了这些架构如何实现技术能力与特定领域需求之间的对接。我们的主要贡献包括：(1)系统地分析了从标准法律LLM到法律智能体的技术过渡过程；(2)提出了针对不同法律实践领域的智能体应用的结构化分类体系；(3)探讨了专门用于评估法律场景中智能体性能的方法论；(4)指出了当前面临的挑战，并规划了未来开发强大且自主的法律助手的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: BenchMarker: An Education-Inspired Toolkit for Highlighting Flaws in Multiple-Choice Benchmarks
papers.title_zh: BenchMarker：一个基于教育理念的工具包，用于指出多选基准中的缺陷
papers.authors: Nishant Balepur, Bhavya Rajasekaran, Hyunjin Jane Oh, Michael Xie, Atrey Desai, Vipul Gupta, Steven James Moore, Eunsol Choi, Rachel Rudinger, Jordan Lee Boyd-Graber
papers.abstract: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) is standard in NLP, but benchmarks lack rigorous quality control. We present BenchMarker, an education-inspired toolkit using LLM judges to flag three common MCQ flaws: 1) contamination—items appearing exactly online; 2) shortcuts—cues in the choices that enable guessing; and 3) writing errors—structural/grammatical issues based on a 19-rule education rubric. We validate BenchMarker with human annotations, then run the tool to audit 12 benchmarks, revealing: 2) contaminated MCQs tend to inflate accuracy, while writing errors tend to lower it and change rankings beyond random; and 3) prior benchmark repairs address their targeted issues (i.e., lowering accuracy with LLM-written distractors), but inadvertently add new flaws (i.e. implausible distractors, many correct answers). Overall, flaws in MCQs degrade NLP evaluation, but education research offers a path forward. We release BenchMarker to bridge the fields and improve MCQA benchmark design.
papers.abstract_zh: 选择题回答（MCQA）在自然语言处理领域是标准做法，但相关基准测试往往缺乏严格的质量控制。我们提出了BenchMarker这一基于教育理念的工具包，该工具利用大语言模型来识别三种常见的选择题缺陷：1）污染问题——题目与在线内容完全相同；2）捷径问题——选项中的提示使得答题者能够猜测答案；3）书写错误——基于19条规则的教育评分标准所发现的结构性或语法性问题。我们通过人类标注来验证BenchMarker的有效性，然后使用该工具对12个基准测试进行了审核，结果发现：2）被污染的选择题往往会提高准确率，而书写错误则往往会降低准确率，并且还会影响排名的公平性；3）一些现有的基准测试修复方案确实解决了特定问题（例如使用大语言模型生成的干扰项来降低准确率），但这些修复方案无意中又引入了新的缺陷（例如不合理的干扰项、许多正确答案）。总体而言，选择题中的缺陷会削弱自然语言处理评估的准确性，但教育研究为解决这个问题提供了可能途径。我们发布BenchMarker，旨在促进这两个领域的合作，从而改进选择题回答基准测试的设计。

papers.title: Model Internal Sleuthing: Finding Lexical Identity and Inflectional Features in Modern Language Models
papers.title_zh: 模型内部分析：在现代语言模型中识别词汇一致性及词形变化特征
papers.authors: Michael Li, Nishant Subramani
papers.abstract: Large transformer-based language models dominate modern NLP, yet our understanding of how they encode linguistic information relies primarily on studies of early models like BERT and GPT-2. We systematically probe 25 models from BERT Base to Qwen2.5-7B focusing on two linguistic properties: lexical identity and inflectional features across 6 diverse languages. We find a consistent pattern: inflectional features are linearly decodable throughout the model, while lexical identity is prominent early but increasingly weakens with depth. Further analysis of the representation geometry reveals that models with aggressive mid-layer dimensionality compression show reduced steering effectiveness in those layers, despite probe accuracy remaining high. Pretraining analysis shows that inflectional structure stabilizes early while lexical identity representations continue evolving. Taken together, our findings suggest that transformers maintain inflectional features across layers, while trading off lexical identity for compact, predictive representations.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于Transformer的语言模型在现代自然语言处理领域占据主导地位，然而我们对这些模型如何编码语言信息的理解，主要依赖于对BERT和GPT-2等早期模型的研究。我们系统地研究了从BERT Base到Qwen2.5-7B的25种模型，重点关注两个语言属性：词汇一致性以及六种不同语言中的屈折特征。我们发现一个一致的模式：屈折特征在整个模型中可以被线性解码，而词汇一致性在早期较为明显，但随着深度的增加逐渐减弱。对表示几何结构的进一步分析表明，那些在中层进行过度维度压缩的模型，尽管探测准确率仍然很高，但在这些层中却降低了引导效果。预训练分析显示，屈折结构在早期保持稳定，而词汇一致性表示则持续演变。综合来看，我们的研究发现表明，Transformer能够在不同层次上保留屈折特征，同时为了获得更紧凑、更具预测性的表示，不得不牺牲部分词汇一致性信息。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HAT: Hallucination Annotation for Translation
papers.title_zh: HAT：用于翻译的幻觉注释处理
papers.authors: Rajen Chatterjee, Xintong Li, Paisarn Charoenpornsawat, Allen Lee
papers.abstract: Hallucinations in machine translation (MT)—outputs that may be fluent yet unfaithful to the source content—remain a critical obstacle. They hinder the reliable deployment of MT systems in real-world applications. Despite growing attention to this phenomenon, progress has been constrained by the lack of large-scale, high-quality benchmarks dedicated to hallucination detection. We introduce HAT (Hallucination Annotation for Translation), a novel dataset designed to advance research on this problem. HAT comprises 350,959 span-level annotated samples across 38 language pairs, with approximately 8,000–10,000 samples per pair partitioned into training, development, and test sets. Annotations were produced by professional translators under rigorous quality control protocols to ensure reliability. We provide a detailed analysis of hallucination distributions and establish benchmark performance using a diverse set of baselines, including automatic MT evaluation metrics as well as large language models. By providing the first large-scale, systematically annotated resource for hallucination detection in MT, HAT enables the development of more faithful translation models and lays the groundwork for future research on building trustworthy machine translation systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器翻译中的幻觉现象——即翻译结果虽然流畅，但与原文本内容存在较大偏差的现象——仍然是一个严重的障碍。这种现象阻碍了机器翻译系统在现实应用中的可靠运行。尽管人们越来越关注这一问题，但由于缺乏大规模、高质量的幻觉检测基准数据集，相关进展一直受到限制。我们提出了HAT（翻译幻觉标注数据集），这是一个专为研究这一问题而设计的新数据集。HAT包含350,959个标注样本，涵盖38种语言对，每对语言对中有约8,000至10,000个样本，这些样本被分为训练集、开发集和测试集。这些标注是由专业翻译人员通过严格的质量控制流程完成的，以确保其可靠性。我们对幻觉分布进行了详细分析，并通过多种基准指标来评估性能，包括自动机器翻译评估指标以及大语言模型的结果。通过提供首个大规模、系统化的幻觉检测标注资源，HAT有助于开发出更可靠的翻译模型，并为未来构建可信赖的机器翻译系统的研究奠定基础。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: DMRetriever: A Family of Models for Improved Text Retrieval in Disaster Management
papers.title_zh: DMRetriever：一系列用于改进灾害管理领域文本检索的模型
papers.authors: Kai Yin, Xiangjue Dong, Chengkai Liu, Allen Lin, Lingfeng Shi, Ali Mostafavi, James Caverlee
papers.abstract: Effective and efficient access to relevant information is essential for disaster management. However, no retrieval model is specialized for disaster management, and existing general-domain models fail to handle the varied search intents inherent to disaster management scenarios, resulting in inconsistent and unreliable performance. To this end, we introduce DMRetriever, the first series of dense retrieval models (33M to 7.6B) tailored for this domain. It is trained through a novel three-stage framework of bidirectional attention adaptation, unsupervised contrastive pre-training, and difficulty-aware progressive instruction fine-tuning, using high-quality data generated through an advanced data refinement pipeline. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that DMRetriever achieves state-of-the-art performance across all six search intents at every model scale. Moreover, DMRetriever is highly parameter-efficient, with 596M model outperforming baselines over 13.3 larger and 33M model exceeding baselines with only 7.6% of their parameters. All codes, data, and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/KaiYin97/DMRETRIEVER.
papers.abstract_zh: 有效且高效地获取相关信息对于灾害管理至关重要。然而，目前还没有专门针对灾害管理的检索模型，现有的通用检索模型无法处理灾害管理场景中复杂的搜索需求，从而导致性能不稳定且不可靠。为此，我们提出了DMRetriever——首个专为这一领域设计的密集检索模型系列，模型规模从 3300 万到 76 亿参数不等。该模型通过一种新颖的三阶段框架进行训练：双向注意力适应、无监督对比预训练以及基于难度的渐进式微调。训练数据来自经过高级数据精炼处理的优质数据集。大量实验表明，DMRetriever在六种搜索需求下都能达到最先进的性能水平，且适用于各种模型规模。此外，DMRetriever还具有极高的参数效率，一个 5.96 亿参数的模型在性能上优于规模大 13.3 倍的基线模型；而一个3300万参数的模型则仅使用相当于基线模型7.6%的参数就能超越基线模型。所有代码、数据和检查点均可在https://github.com/KaiYin97/DMRETRIEVER下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Language Models Don’t Know What You Want: Evaluating Personalization in Deep Research Needs Real Users
papers.title_zh: 语言模型无法了解用户的真实需求：在深度学习中实现个性化推荐需要真实的用户数据支持
papers.authors: Nishant Balepur, Malachi Hamada, Varsha Kishore, Sergey Feldman, Amanpreet Singh, Pao Siangliulue, Joseph Chee Chang, Eunsol Choi, Jordan Lee Boyd-Graber, Aakanksha Naik
papers.abstract: Deep Research (DR) tools (e.g. OpenAI DR) help researchers cope with ballooning publishing counts. Such tools can synthesize scientific papers to answer researchers’ queries, but lack understanding of their users. We change that in MyScholarQA (MySQA), a personalized DR tool that: 1) infers a profile of a user’s research interests; 2) proposes personalized actions for a user’s input query; and 3) writes a multi-section report for the query that follows user-approved actions. We first test MySQA with NLP’s standard protocol: we design a benchmark of synthetic users and LLM judges, where MySQA beats baselines in citation metrics and personalized action-following. However, we suspect this process does not cover all aspects of personalized DR users value, so we interview users in an online version of MySQA to unmask them. We reveal nine nuanced errors of personalized DR undetectable by our LLM judges, and we study qualitative feedback to form lessons for future DR design. In all, we argue for a pillar of personalization that easy-to-use LLM judges can lead NLP to overlook: real progress in personalization is only possible with real users.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度研究工具（如OpenAI DR）能够帮助研究人员应对日益增加的论文发表数量问题。这类工具能够合成科学论文来回答研究人员的疑问，但缺乏对用户需求的理解。我们在MyScholarQA（MySQA）中改变了这一状况——这是一种个性化的深度研究工具，它能够：1）推断用户的科研兴趣；2）针对用户的查询提出个性化的建议；3）在用户同意的后续操作基础上，生成一份多部分的报告。我们首先使用自然语言处理领域的标准协议对MySQA进行了测试：我们设计了一个由合成用户和大语言模型评委组成的基准测试，结果显示MySQA在引用指标和个人化建议方面均优于其他工具。然而，我们认为这一过程并未涵盖个性化深度研究工具所重视的所有方面，因此我们在MySQA的在线版本中对用户进行了访谈，以了解他们的真实需求。我们发现，有九种个性化深度研究工具存在的细微错误是大语言模型评委无法发现的，同时我们也研究了用户的反馈意见，为未来的深度研究工具设计提供了宝贵的经验。总的来说，我们认为，只有借助真实用户的数据，才能实现真正有价值的个性化研究。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LAD-RAG: Layout-aware Dynamic RAG for Visually-Rich Document Understanding
papers.title_zh: LAD-RAG：一种具备布局感知能力的动态RAG技术，适用于视觉丰富的文档理解任务
papers.authors: Zhivar Sourati, Zheng Wang, Marianne Menglin Liu, Yazhe Hu, Mengqing Guo, Sujeeth Bharadwaj, Kyu J. Han, Tao Sheng, Sujith Ravi, Morteza Dehghani, Dan Roth
papers.abstract: Question answering over visually rich documents (VRDs) requires reasoning not only over isolated content but also over documents’ structural organization and cross-page dependencies. However, conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods encode content in isolated chunks during ingestion, losing structural and cross-page dependencies, and retrieve a fixed number of pages at inference, regardless of the specific demands of the question or context. This often results in incomplete evidence retrieval and degraded answer quality for multi-page reasoning tasks. To address these limitations, we propose LAD-RAG, a novel Layout-Aware Dynamic RAG framework. During ingestion, LAD-RAG constructs a symbolic document graph that captures layout structure and cross-page dependencies, adding it alongside standard neural embeddings to yield a more holistic representation of the document. During inference, an LLM agent dynamically interacts with the neural and symbolic indices to adaptively retrieve the necessary evidence based on the query. Experiments on MMLongBench-Doc, LongDocURL, DUDE, and MP-DocVQA demonstrate that LAD-RAG improves retrieval, achieving over 90% perfect recall on average without any top-k tuning, and outperforming baseline retrievers by up to 20% in recall at comparable noise levels, yielding higher QA accuracy with minimal latency.
papers.abstract_zh: 在视觉丰富的文档上进行问题回答时，不仅需要处理孤立的内容，还需要考虑文档的结构组织以及不同页面之间的依赖关系。然而，传统的检索增强生成方法在内容提取过程中会将内容以孤立的块形式进行编码，从而丢失了结构性和跨页面的依赖关系。在推理过程中，无论问题的具体要求或上下文如何变化，系统都会固定地检索一定数量的页面内容。这往往会导致证据检索不完整，以及多页推理任务中的答案质量下降。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了LAD-RAG这一新颖的布局感知动态检索增强框架。在内容提取阶段，LAD-RAG会构建一个符号化的文档图，该图能够捕捉到文档的布局结构和跨页面的依赖关系，并将其与标准的神经嵌入一起使用，从而形成对文档更为全面的表示。在推理阶段，LLM代理会与神经嵌入和符号索引进行交互，根据查询内容自适应地检索所需的证据。在MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL、DUDE和MP-DocVQA上的实验表明，LAD-RAG在检索性能上有所提升，平均召回率超过90%，且无需进行任何top-k调整即可实现如此高的性能。在类似的噪声水平下，LAD-RAG的召回率比传统检索方法高出20%左右，同时还能在较低的延迟情况下获得更高的问答准确率。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Among Us: Measuring and Mitigating Malicious Contributions in Model Collaboration Systems
papers.title_zh: 《我们之中》：在模型协作系统中衡量与缓解恶意行为的影响
papers.authors: Ziyuan Yang, Wenxuan Ding, Shangbin Feng, Yulia Tsvetkov
papers.abstract: Language models (LMs) are increasingly used in collaboration: multiple LMs trained by different parties collaborate through routing systems, multi-agent debate, model merging, and more. Critical safety risks remain in this decentralized paradigm: what if some of the models in multi-LLM systems are compromised or malicious? We first quantify the impact of malicious models by engineering four categories of malicious LMs, plug them into four types of popular model collaboration systems, and evaluate the compromised system across 10 datasets. We find that malicious models have a severe impact on the multi-LLM systems, especially for reasoning and safety domains where performance is lowered by 7.12% and 7.94% on average. We then propose mitigation strategies to alleviate the impact of malicious components, by employing external supervisors that oversee model collaboration to disable/mask them out to reduce their influence. On average, these strategies recover 95.31% of the initial performance, while making model collaboration systems fully resistant to malicious models remains an open research question.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型在协作中得到了越来越多的应用：由不同方训练的多个语言模型通过路由系统、多智能体辩论、模型合并等方式进行协作。然而，这种去中心化的模式仍然存在严重的安全风险：如果多语言模型系统中的某些模型被攻破或存在恶意行为，将会产生什么后果呢？我们首先通过构建四类恶意语言模型来量化其影响，并将这些模型植入四种常见的模型协作系统中，然后在10个数据集上评估受损系统的表现。我们发现，恶意模型对多语言模型系统的影响非常严重，尤其是在推理和安全领域，系统的性能平均分别下降了7.12%和7.94%。随后，我们提出了一些缓解策略来减轻恶意组件的影响，比如利用外部监督器来监控模型协作过程，从而禁用或屏蔽这些恶意模型，以减少它们的影响力。平均而言，这些策略能够恢复95.31%的初始性能，不过让模型协作系统完全抵御恶意模型仍然是一个未解决的研究问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Not All Tokens Matter: Towards Efficient LLM Reasoning via Token Significance in Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 并非所有代币都重要：通过关注代币的重要性来实现高效的大语言模型推理——在强化学习中实现这一点
papers.authors: Hanbing Liu, Lang Cao, Yuanyi Ren, Mengyu Zhou, Haoyu Dong, Xiaojun Ma, Shi Han, Dongmei Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show strong reasoning abilities but often produce unnecessarily long explanations that reduce efficiency. Although reinforcement learning (RL) has been used to improve reasoning, most methods focus on accuracy and rely on uniform length-based rewards that overlook the differing contributions of individual tokens, often harming correctness. We revisit length optimization in RL through the perspective of token significance. Observing that many chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens contribute little to the final answer, we introduce a significance-aware length reward that selectively penalizes insignificance tokens, reducing redundancy while preserving essential reasoning. We also propose a dynamic length reward that encourages more detailed reasoning early in training and gradually shifts toward conciseness as learning progresses. Integrating these components into standard policy optimization yields a framework that improves both reasoning efficiency and accuracy. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate substantial reductions in response length while preserving or improving correctness, highlighting the importance of modeling token significance for efficient LLM reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的推理能力，但往往会产生不必要的冗长解释，这会降低模型的效率。虽然强化学习已被用于提升推理能力，但大多数方法都注重准确性，并依赖统一长度为基础的奖励机制，这忽略了各个标记的不同贡献，从而可能损害推理的准确性。我们从标记重要性的角度重新审视强化学习中的长度优化问题。我们发现，许多思维链标记对最终答案的贡献很小，因此我们提出了一种考虑标记重要性的长度奖励机制，该机制能够选择性地惩罚那些不重要的标记，从而减少冗余，同时保留必要的推理信息。我们还提出了一种动态长度奖励机制，该机制在训练初期鼓励更详细的推理，随着学习的深入逐渐转向简洁性。将这些组件整合到标准策略优化中，可以构建一个既能提高推理效率又能保证准确性的框架。通过多个基准测试的实验表明，这种框架能够显著减少回答的长度，同时保持良好的准确性，这凸显了建模标记重要性对于高效LLM推理的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Query-Efficient Agentic Graph Extraction Attacks on GraphRAG Systems
papers.title_zh: 针对GraphRAG系统的高效查询式图提取攻击方法
papers.authors: Shuhua Yang, Jiahao Zhang, Yilong Wang, Dongwon Lee, Suhang Wang
papers.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) systems construct knowledge graphs over document collections to support multi-hop reasoning. While prior work shows that GraphRAG responses may leak retrieved subgraphs, the feasibility of query-efficient reconstruction of the hidden graph structure remains unexplored under realistic query budgets. We study a budget-constrained black-box setting where an adversary adaptively queries the system to steal its latent entity–relation graph. We propose AGEA (Agentic Graph Extraction Attack), a framework that leverages a novelty-guided exploration–exploitation strategy, external graph memory modules, and a two-stage graph extraction pipeline combining lightweight discovery with LLM-based filtering. We evaluate AGEA on medical, agriculture, and literary datasets across Microsoft-GraphRAG and LightRAG systems. Under identical query budgets, AGEA significantly outperforms prior attack baselines, recovering up to 90% of entities and relationships while maintaining high precision. These results demonstrate that modern GraphRAG systems are highly vulnerable to structured, agentic extraction attacks, even under strict query limits. The code is available at https://github.com/shuashua0608/AGEA.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于图的检索增强生成系统（GraphRAG）通过构建文档集合的知识图谱来支持多跳推理。虽然先前的研究表明，GraphRAG的响应可能会泄露被检索到的子图，但在实际的查询预算限制下，如何高效地重建隐藏的图结构仍然是一个未解决的问题。我们研究了一个预算受限的黑盒场景，其中攻击者会自适应地查询系统以窃取其潜在的实体-关系图。我们提出了AGEA（代理图提取攻击）框架，该框架利用了一种基于新颖性引导的探索-利用策略、外部图内存模块以及结合轻量级发现与基于大语言模型的过滤器的两阶段图提取流程。我们在Microsoft-GraphRAG和LightRAG系统的基础上，对医学、农业和文学数据集进行了AGEA的评估。在相同的查询预算下，AGEA的表现显著优于之前的攻击基线，能够恢复高达90%的实体和关系，同时保持高精度。这些结果表明，即使在严格的查询限制下，现代GraphRAG系统也极易受到结构化代理提取攻击的威胁。相关代码可访问https://github.com/shuashua0608/AGEA。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Function Words as Statistical Cues for Language Learning
papers.title_zh: 功能词作为语言学习的统计线索
papers.authors: Xiulin Yang, Heidi R. Getz, Ethan Gotlieb Wilcox
papers.abstract: What statistical properties might support learning abstract grammatical knowledge from linear input? We address this question by examining the statistical distribution of function words. Function words have been argued to aid acquisition through three distributional properties: high frequency, reliable syntactic association, and phrase-boundary alignment. We conduct a cross-linguistic corpus analysis of 186 languages, which confirms that all three properties are universal. Using counterfactual language modeling and ablation experiments on English, we show that preserving these properties facilitates acquisition in neural learners, with a Goldilocks effect: function words must be frequent enough to be reliable, yet diverse enough to remain informative to structural dependency. Probing analyses further reveal that different learning conditions produce systematically different reliance on function words.
papers.abstract_zh: 哪些统计特性能够支持从线性输入中学习抽象的语法知识呢？我们通过研究功能词的统计分布来探讨这个问题。有研究表明，功能词通过三种分布特性有助于语言的习得：高频率出现、可靠的句法关联以及短语边界的对齐。我们对186种语言进行了跨语言语料库分析，结果发现这三种特性都是普遍存在的。通过反事实语言建模和对英语进行实验，我们发现保留这些特性有助于神经型学习者的语言习得，同时还能产生一种“恰到好处”的效果：功能词必须足够频繁，以具备可靠性；同时又必须足够多样化，以保持对结构依赖关系的理解能力。进一步的分析表明，不同的学习条件会导致对功能词的依赖程度出现系统性差异。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evaluating Robustness of Large Language Models Against Multilingual Typographical Errors
papers.title_zh: 评估大型语言模型在应对多语言排版错误时的鲁棒性
papers.authors: Raoyuan Zhao, Yihong Liu, Lena Altinger, Hinrich Schuetze, Michael A. Hedderich
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multilingual, real-world applications with user inputs – naturally introducing typographical errors (typos). Yet most benchmarks assume clean input, leaving the robustness of LLMs to typos across languages largely underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce MulTypo, a multilingual typo generation algorithm that simulates human-like errors based on language-specific keyboard layouts and typing behavior. We evaluate 18 open-source LLMs across three model families and five downstream tasks spanning language inference, multi-choice question answering, mathematical reasoning, and machine translation tasks. Our results show that typos consistently degrade performance, particularly in generative tasks and those requiring reasoning – while the natural language inference task is comparatively more robust. Instruction tuning improves clean-input performance but may increase brittleness under noise. We also observe language-dependent robustness: high-resource languages are generally more robust than low-resource ones, and translation from English is more robust than translation into English. Our findings underscore the need for noise-aware training and multilingual robustness evaluation. We release a Python package for MulTypo and make the source code publicly available at https://github.com/cisnlp/multypo.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在涉及用户输入的多语言实际应用中得到了广泛应用，但这也自然会导致拼写错误。然而，大多数评估标准都假设输入数据是准确无误的，因此人们对语言间的拼写错误对模型鲁棒性的影响研究不足。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MulTypo算法——一种多语言拼写错误生成算法，该算法基于不同语言的键盘布局和打字行为来模拟人类常见的错误。我们对18个开源语言模型进行了评估，这些模型来自三个不同的模型家族，并应用于语言推理、多项选择问题回答、数学推理和机器翻译等任务。结果表明，拼写错误会持续降低模型的性能，尤其是在生成任务和需要推理的任务中。而自然语言推理任务则相对更为鲁棒。指令调整可以提高输入数据的准确性，但可能会在噪声环境下增加模型的脆弱性。我们还观察到语言间的鲁棒性差异：资源丰富的语言通常比资源匮乏的语言更具鲁棒性，而且从英语翻译成其他语言时，模型的鲁棒性也更高。我们的研究结果强调了进行噪声感知训练和评估多语言鲁棒性的必要性。我们已经发布了MulTypo的Python包，其源代码可以在https://github.com/cisnlp/multypo上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Listening Like Humans: Semantics-Guided Noise-Robust Multimodal Speech Recognition
papers.title_zh: 像人类一样进行听觉感知：基于语义的噪声鲁棒多模态语音识别技术
papers.authors: Yan Fang, Jun Chen, Yian Yao, Shuxin Zhong, Min Sun, Kaishun Wu
papers.abstract: Severe acoustic degradation is often caused by overlapping noise, disfluencies, and environmental distortions. This phenomenon results in the dissolution of linguistic structures and the generation of unreliable ASR outputs. Inspired by human speech comprehension, we propose Speech-MLM, a novel multimodal framework that reframes ASR as semantics-guided speech reconstruction. This perspective introduces three core challenges: (C1) collapse of linguistic structure under acoustic degradation, (C2) semantic ambiguity under noise, and (C3) misalignment across modalities. To address these issues, we propose Speech-MLM, a multimodal ASR framework that integrates speech, spectrogram-derived visual cues, and textual variants to enhance robustness. It consists of: (i) Cognitive Structure Extractor that recovers prosodic structure from visualized acoustic features, (ii) Semantic Weaver that learns semantic equivalence across varied textual forms, and (iii) Retrieval-Guided Fusion Learner that unifies modalities within a shared semantic space. Experiments on multiple real-world noisy datasets demonstrate that Speech-MLM achieves an average 38.85% reduction in WER, while also attaining 98.71% BERTScore and 96.7% USE, over advanced baselines, demonstrating substantial gains in semantic robustness and generalization across domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 严重的声学退化通常是由于噪声重叠、语流中断以及环境干扰所导致的。这种现象会导致语言结构的破坏，并产生不可靠的语音识别结果。受人类语音理解机制的启发，我们提出了Speech-MLM这一新型多模态框架，它将语音识别重新定义为基于语义引导的语音重建过程。这一方法面临三个核心挑战：(C1) 在声学退化情况下语言结构的崩溃；(C2) 噪声环境下的语义模糊性；(C3) 不同模态之间的不一致性问题。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了Speech-MLM多模态语音识别框架，该框架整合了语音数据、频谱图衍生的视觉线索以及文本变体信息，以提高系统的鲁棒性。该框架包含以下组件：(i) 认知结构提取器，能够从可视化的声学特征中恢复韵律结构；(ii) 语义编织器，能够学习不同文本形式之间的语义等价关系；(iii) 检索引导融合学习器，能够在共享的语义空间中统一不同模态的信息。在多个真实世界的噪声数据集上的实验表明，Speech-MLM在错误率方面平均降低了38.85%，同时其BERTScore得分达到了98.71%，USE得分达到了96.7%。与先进的基线模型相比，Speech-MLM在语义鲁棒性和跨领域泛化能力方面取得了显著提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Measuring What Matters!! Assessing Therapeutic Principles in Mental-Health Conversation
papers.title_zh: 衡量真正重要的东西！！在心理健康对话中评估治疗原则的有效性
papers.authors: Abdullah Mazhar, Het Riteshkumar Shah, Aseem Srivastava, Smriti Joshi, Md Shad Akhtar
papers.abstract: The increasing use of large language models in mental health applications calls for principled evaluation frameworks that assess alignment with psychotherapeutic best practices beyond surface-level fluency. While recent systems exhibit conversational competence, they lack structured mechanisms to evaluate adherence to core therapeutic principles. In this paper, we study the problem of evaluating AI-generated therapist-like responses for clinically grounded appropriateness and effectiveness. We assess each therapists utterance along six therapeutic principles: non-judgmental acceptance, warmth, respect for autonomy, active listening, reflective understanding, and situational appropriateness using a fine-grained ordinal scale. We introduce FAITH-M, a benchmark annotated with expert-assigned ordinal ratings, and propose CARE, a multi-stage evaluation framework that integrates intra-dialogue context, contrastive exemplar retrieval, and knowledge-distilled chain-of-thought reasoning. Experiments show that CARE achieves an F-1 score of 63.34 versus the strong baseline Qwen3 F-1 score of 38.56 which is a 64.26% improvement, which also serves as its backbone, indicating that gains arise from structured reasoning and contextual modeling rather than backbone capacity alone. Expert assessment and external dataset evaluations further demonstrate robustness under domain shift, while highlighting challenges in modeling implicit clinical nuance. Overall, CARE provides a clinically grounded framework for evaluating therapeutic fidelity in AI mental health systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在心理健康领域的应用日益广泛，这迫切需要一套基于原则的评估框架，以衡量其是否符合心理治疗的最佳实践，而不仅仅是表面的流畅性。虽然最近的系统已经具备了对话能力，但它们缺乏评估其是否遵循核心治疗原则的结构化机制。在本文中，我们研究了如何评估人工智能生成的治疗师式回应的临床适用性和有效性问题。我们通过六个治疗原则来评估每个治疗师的发言：不评判性接纳、温暖关怀、尊重自主性、积极倾听、反思性理解以及情境适应性。我们引入了FAITH-M这一基准数据集，该数据集包含了专家评定的序数评分。同时，我们提出了CARE这一多阶段评估框架，该框架整合了对话内部上下文、对比示例检索以及知识驱动的思维链推理功能。实验结果显示，CARE的F-1得分达到了63.34，而强大的基线模型Qwen3的F-1得分为38.56，这意味着CARE提升了64.26%的性能。这一提升不仅源于模型本身的性能，还得益于结构化推理和情境建模的作用。专家评估和外部数据集测试进一步证明了该模型在领域转换情况下的鲁棒性，同时也揭示了在模拟隐性临床细微差别方面的挑战。总体而言，CARE为评估人工智能心理健康系统中的治疗质量提供了一个具有临床意义的框架。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ParaCodex: A Profiling-Guided Autonomous Coding Agent for Reliable Parallel Code Generation and Translation
papers.title_zh: ParaCodex：一种基于特征分析的自主编码工具，能够实现可靠的并行代码生成与转换功能
papers.authors: Erel Kaplan, Tomer Bitan, Lian Ghrayeb, Le Chen, Tom Yotam, Niranjan Hasabnis, Gal Oren
papers.abstract: Parallel programming is central to HPC and AI, but producing code that is correct and fast remains challenging, especially for OpenMP GPU offload, where data movement and tuning dominate. Autonomous coding agents can compile, test, and profile on target hardware, but outputs are brittle without domain scaffolding.We present ParaCodex, an HPC-engineer workflow that turns a Codex-based agent into an autonomous OpenMP GPU offload system using staged hotspot analysis, explicit data planning, correctness gating, and profiling-guided refinement. We evaluate translation from serial CPU kernels to OpenMP GPU offload kernels on HeCBench, Rodinia, and NAS. After excluding five kernels, ParaCodex succeeded on all 31 valid kernels. In 27/31 (87%) of these valid cases, the generated kernels improved GPU time over reference implementations, a result that holds independently on both the A100 and RTX 4060. The resulting OpenMP kernels achieve geometric-mean speedups of 3.1 (A100) and 3.6 (RTX 4060) on HeCBench and 1.5 and 1.1 on Rodinia, and outperform a zero-shot Codex baseline on all suites. We also evaluate CUDA -> OpenMP offload translation on ParEval, where ParaCodex maintains high compilation and validation rates in code-only and end-to-end settings.ParaCodex is available at https://github.com/Scientific-Computing-Lab/ParaCodex
papers.abstract_zh: 并行编程是高性能计算与人工智能领域的核心技术，但编写正确且高效的代码仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在使用OpenMP进行GPU卸载时，数据移动和调优环节尤为关键。自主编码代理能够在本地硬件上进行编译、测试和性能分析，但如果缺乏领域特定的框架支持，其输出结果就会不稳定。我们提出了ParaCodex这一高性能计算工作流程工具，它可以将基于Codex的代理转化为自主运行的OpenMP GPU卸载系统，通过分阶段的热点分析、明确的数据规划、正确性验证以及基于性能分析的优化调整来实现这一目标。我们在HeCBench、Rodinia和NAS平台上对从串行CPU内核到OpenMP GPU卸载内核的转换进行了评估。在排除了五个内核后，ParaCodex在全部31个有效内核上均取得了成功。在27/31个有效案例中（占87%），生成的代码在GPU运行时间上优于原始实现，这一结果在A100和RTX 4060平台上都得到了验证。最终得到的OpenMP内核在HeCBench上的几何平均加速比分别为3.1倍（A100平台）和3.6倍（RTX 4060平台），而在Rodinia平台上的加速比分别为1.5倍和1.1倍。在所有测试平台上，我们的结果都优于零样本Codex基线方案。我们还对CUDA到OpenMP的卸载转换进行了评估，在ParEval平台上，ParaCodex在仅代码层面和端到端环境下都能保持较高的编译和验证效率。ParaCodex的源代码可以在https://github.com/Scientific-Computing-Lab/ParaCodex下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CoLA: A Choice Leakage Attack Framework to Expose Privacy Risks in Subset Training
papers.title_zh: CoLA：一种针对子集训练过程中隐私风险攻击的框架
papers.authors: Qi Li, Cheng-Long Wang, Yinzhi Cao, Di Wang
papers.abstract: Training models on a carefully chosen portion of data rather than the full dataset is now a standard preprocess for modern ML. From vision coreset selection to large-scale filtering in language models, it enables scalability with minimal utility loss. A common intuition is that training on fewer samples should also reduce privacy risks. In this paper, we challenge this assumption. We show that subset training is not privacy free: the very choices of which data are included or excluded can introduce new privacy surface and leak more sensitive information. Such information can be captured by adversaries either through side-channel metadata from the subset selection process or via the outputs of the target model. To systematically study this phenomenon, we propose CoLA (Choice Leakage Attack), a unified framework for analyzing privacy leakage in subset selection. In CoLA, depending on the adversary’s knowledge of the side-channel information, we define two practical attack scenarios: Subset-aware Side-channel Attacks and Black-box Attacks. Under both scenarios, we investigate two privacy surfaces unique to subset training: (1) Training-membership MIA (TM-MIA), which concerns only the privacy of training data membership, and (2) Selection-participation MIA (SP-MIA), which concerns the privacy of all samples that participated in the subset selection process. Notably, SP-MIA enlarges the notion of membership from model training to the entire data-model supply chain. Experiments on vision and language models show that existing threat models underestimate subset-training privacy risks: the expanded privacy surface leaks both training and selection membership, extending risks from individual models to the broader ML ecosystem.
papers.abstract_zh: 在精心选择的数据子集上训练模型，而不是使用整个数据集，现在已经成为了现代机器学习的标准预处理步骤。从视觉特征的选择到语言模型中的大规模过滤处理，这种处理方式能够在不降低模型性能的情况下实现可扩展性。人们通常认为，在较少的样本上进行训练应该能降低隐私风险。然而，在本文中，我们挑战了这一假设。我们发现，基于子集进行训练并非完全不涉及隐私问题：哪些数据被包含或排除在外，这些选择本身就会引入新的隐私风险点，并泄露更敏感的信息。这些信息可以被对手通过子集选择过程中的侧信道元数据，或者通过目标模型的输出捕获到。为了系统地研究这一现象，我们提出了CoLA（选择泄漏攻击）这一统一框架，用于分析子集选择过程中的隐私泄漏问题。在CoLA中，根据对手对侧信道信息的了解程度，我们将攻击场景分为两种：基于子集的侧信道攻击和黑盒攻击。在这两种情况下，我们都研究了子集训练特有的两种隐私风险点：（1）训练成员性MIA（TM-MIA），它仅涉及训练数据的成员隐私；（2）选择参与性MIA（SP-MIA），它涉及所有参与子集选择过程的样本的隐私。值得注意的是，SP-MIA将成员性的概念扩展到了整个数据-模型供应链。在视觉和语言模型上的实验表明，现有的威胁模型低估了基于子集训练的隐私风险：这种扩展的隐私风险不仅泄露了训练成员的隐私信息，还泄露了选择参与的样本的隐私信息，从而将风险从单个模型扩展到更广泛的机器学习生态系统。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MediEval: A Unified Medical Benchmark for Patient-Contextual and Knowledge-Grounded Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: MediEval：一个统一的医学基准测试平台，适用于在大型语言模型中进行基于患者上下文和知识的推理操作
papers.authors: Zhan Qu, Michael Färber
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to medicine, yet their adoption is limited by concerns over reliability and safety. Existing evaluations either test factual medical knowledge in isolation or assess patient-level reasoning without verifying correctness, leaving a critical gap. We introduce MediEval, a benchmark that links MIMIC-IV electronic health records (EHRs) to a unified knowledge base built from UMLS and other biomedical vocabularies. MediEval generates diverse factual and counterfactual medical statements within real patient contexts, enabling systematic evaluation across a 4-quadrant framework that jointly considers knowledge grounding and contextual consistency. Using this framework, we identify critical failure modes, including hallucinated support and truth inversion, that current proprietary, open-source, and domain-specific LLMs frequently exhibit. To address these risks, we propose Counterfactual Risk-Aware Fine-tuning (CoRFu), a DPO-based method with an asymmetric penalty targeting unsafe confusions. CoRFu improves by +16.4 macro-F1 points over the base model and eliminates truth inversion errors, demonstrating both higher accuracy and substantially greater safety.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在医学领域的应用日益广泛，但其应用仍受到可靠性和安全性的限制。现有的评估方法要么单独测试医学知识的正确性，要么评估患者的推理能力，而并未验证其正确性，这留下了重要的问题。我们提出了MediEval这一基准测试工具，它将MIMIC-IV电子健康记录与由UMLS及其他生物医学词汇表构建的统一知识库联系起来。MediEval能够在真实患者情境下生成多样化的事实性和反事实性医学陈述，从而能够在涵盖知识基础与上下文一致性在内的四象限框架内进行系统评估。利用这一框架，我们能够识别出当前专有、开源以及特定领域语言模型常出现的严重故障模式，包括幻觉性支持现象和真相颠倒现象。为了应对这些风险，我们提出了Counterfactual Risk-Aware Fine-tuning（CoRFu）方法。这是一种基于DPO的方法，通过不对称惩罚机制来消除不安全的混淆现象。与基础模型相比，CoRFu在宏观F1分数上提升了16.4点，并消除了真相颠倒的错误，显示出更高的准确性和显著更高的安全性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Path Not Taken: Duality in Reasoning about Program Execution
papers.title_zh: 不走的路：关于程序执行的推理中的二元性
papers.authors: Eshgin Hasanov, Md Mahadi Hassan Sibat, Santu Karmaker, Aashish Yadavally
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across diverse coding tasks. However, their adoption requires a true understanding of program execution rather than relying on surface-level patterns. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on predicting program properties tied to specific inputs (e.g., code coverage, program outputs). As a result, they provide a narrow view of dynamic code reasoning and are prone to data contamination. We argue that understanding program execution requires evaluating its inherent duality through two complementary reasoning tasks: (i) predicting a program’s observed behavior for a given input, and (ii) inferring how the input must be mutated toward a specific behavioral objective. Both tasks jointly probe a model’s causal understanding of execution flow. We instantiate this duality in DexBench, a benchmark comprising 445 paired instances, and evaluate 13 LLMs. Our results demonstrate that dual-path reasoning provides a robust and discriminative proxy for dynamic code understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多种编程任务中展现出了卓越的能力。然而，要充分利用这些模型，就需要真正理解程序的执行过程，而不仅仅是依赖表面的模式。现有的基准测试主要侧重于预测与特定输入相关的程序属性（例如代码覆盖率、程序输出）。因此，这些测试只能提供对动态代码推理的有限理解，并且容易受到数据污染的影响。我们认为，要理解程序的执行过程，需要通过两个互补的推理任务来评估程序的本质特性：（i）预测给定输入下程序的预期行为；（ii）推断如何修改输入以达成特定的行为目标。这两个任务共同检验了模型对执行流程的因果理解能力。我们在DexBench这个包含445对实例的基准测试中实现了这种双重推理机制，并评估了13种大语言模型的表现。我们的结果表明，双路径推理为动态代码理解提供了一种稳健且具有区分性的方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Accommodation and Epistemic Vigilance: A Pragmatic Account of Why LLMs Fail to Challenge Harmful Beliefs
papers.title_zh: 住宿与认知警觉性：关于大型语言模型为何无法挑战有害信念的实用解释
papers.authors: Myra Cheng, Robert D. Hawkins, Dan Jurafsky
papers.abstract: Recent evaluations show that large language models (LLMs) frequently fail to challenge users’ harmful beliefs in domains ranging from medical advice to social reasoning. We present a unifying analysis through the lens of pragmatics: these safety failures can be understood and addressed as LLMs exhibiting excessive accommodation and insufficient epistemic vigilance. We show that the pragmatic factors affecting accommodation and epistemic vigilance in humans (at-issueness, linguistic encoding, and source reliability) influence LLM behaviors in similar ways. We demonstrate how these factors explain performance differences across three safety benchmarks that test models’ ability to challenge harmful beliefs, spanning misinformation (Cancer-Myth, SAGE-Eval) and sycophancy (ELEPHANT). This pragmatic lens further motivates prompting interventions, such as adding the phrase “wait a minute”, that drastically improve performance on these difficult benchmarks by shifting pragmatic cues. Our results have practical implications for benchmark design and underscore the importance of pragmatics for understanding model behavior and improving performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的评估表明，大语言模型在从医疗建议到社交推理等多个领域，常常无法挑战用户的有害信念。我们通过语用学的视角进行了综合分析：这些安全方面的失败可以归因于大语言模型表现出过度的适应性以及不足的认识性警觉性。我们发现，影响人类适应性和认识性警觉性的语用因素（如错误性、语言编码以及信息来源的可信度）对大语言模型的行为也有类似的影响。我们证明了这些因素如何解释了在三个安全基准测试中的表现差异，这些测试旨在评估模型挑战有害信念的能力，涉及错误信息（癌症谬论、SAGE-Eval）和谄媚行为（ELEPHANT）。这种语用学视角进一步促使我们提出干预措施，例如添加“请稍等”这样的提示语，通过改变语用线索，能够显著改善模型在这些困难基准测试中的表现。我们的研究结果对基准测试的设计具有实际意义，并强调了语用学在理解模型行为和提升性能方面的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
