papers.title: Every Response Counts: Quantifying Uncertainty of LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems through Tensor Decomposition
papers.title_zh: 每一个响应都至关重要：通过张量分解来量化基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的不确定性
papers.authors: Tiejin Chen, Huaiyuan Yao, Jia Chen, Evangelos E. Papalexakis, Hua Wei
papers.abstract: While Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) consistently outperform single-agent systems on complex tasks, their intricate interactions introduce critical reliability challenges arising from communication dynamics and role dependencies. Existing Uncertainty Quantification methods, typically designed for single-turn outputs, fail to address the unique complexities of the MAS. Specifically, these methods struggle with three distinct challenges: the cascading uncertainty in multi-step reasoning, the variability of inter-agent communication paths, and the diversity of communication topologies. To bridge this gap, we introduce MATU, a novel framework that quantifies uncertainty through tensor decomposition. MATU moves beyond analyzing final text outputs by representing entire reasoning trajectories as embedding matrices and organizing multiple execution runs into a higher-order tensor. By applying tensor decomposition, we disentangle and quantify distinct sources of uncertainty, offering a comprehensive reliability measure that is generalizable across different agent structures. We provide comprehensive experiments to show that MATU effectively estimates holistic and robust uncertainty across diverse tasks and communication topologies.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在处理复杂任务时始终优于单智能体系统，但其复杂的相互作用带来了由于通信动态和角色依赖关系而产生的重大可靠性挑战。现有的不确定性量化方法通常适用于单一轮次的输出结果，无法应对多智能体系统的独特复杂性。具体来说，这些方法面临着三个主要挑战：多步骤推理中的级联不确定性、智能体间通信路径的变异性，以及通信拓扑结构的多样性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MATU这一创新框架，该框架通过张量分解来量化不确定性。MATU不仅分析最终文本输出，还将整个推理过程表示为嵌入矩阵，并将多个执行结果整合成更高阶的张量。通过应用张量分解技术，我们能够分离并量化各种不确定性来源，从而得出一种适用于不同智能体结构的综合性可靠性评估方法。我们通过大量实验证明了MATU能够在不同的任务和通信拓扑结构中有效估计整体且稳健的不确定性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification in LLM Agents: Foundations, Emerging Challenges, and Opportunities
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型智能体中的不确定性量化：基础、新兴挑战与机遇
papers.authors: Changdae Oh, Seongheon Park, To Eun Kim, Jiatong Li, Wendi Li, Samuel Yeh, Sean Du, Hamed Hassani, Paul Bogdan, Dawn Song, Sharon Li
papers.abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) for large language models (LLMs) is a key building block for safety guardrails of daily LLM applications. Yet, even as LLM agents are increasingly deployed in highly complex tasks, most UQ research still centers on single-turn question-answering. We argue that UQ research must shift to realistic settings with interactive agents, and that a new principled framework for agent UQ is needed. This paper presents three pillars to build a solid ground for future agent UQ research: (1. Foundations) We present the first general formulation of agent UQ that subsumes broad classes of existing UQ setups; (2. Challenges) We identify four technical challenges specifically tied to agentic setups—selection of uncertainty estimator, uncertainty of heterogeneous entities, modeling uncertainty dynamics in interactive systems, and lack of fine-grained benchmarks—with numerical analysis on a real-world agent benchmark, \tau^2-bench; (3. Future Directions) We conclude with noting on the practical implications of agent UQ and remaining open problems as forward-looking discussion for future explorations.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于大语言模型（LLMs）的不确定性量化是保障其日常应用安全的关键环节。然而，尽管大语言模型智能体越来越多地被应用于高度复杂的任务中，但大多数不确定性量化研究仍然集中在单轮问答场景上。我们认为，不确定性量化研究必须转向包含交互式智能体的现实场景，并且需要一个新的基于原则性的智能体不确定性量化框架。本文提出了三个构建未来智能体不确定性量化研究基础的支柱：(1) 基础理论：我们首次提出了一种涵盖现有各种不确定性量化方法的通用智能体不确定性量化框架；(2) 挑战与问题：我们确定了与智能体系统相关的四个技术挑战——不确定性估计器的选择、异构实体的不确定性、交互系统中不确定性动态的建模，以及缺乏细粒度基准测试——并通过对现实世界智能体基准测试τ^2-bench的数值分析来进一步探讨这些问题；(3) 未来方向：最后，我们讨论了智能体不确定性量化在实际应用中的意义，以及仍存在的未解决的问题，为未来的探索提供了展望。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Guided by Gut: Efficient Test-Time Scaling with Reinforced Intrinsic Confidence
papers.title_zh: 遵循直觉行事：利用增强的内在信心实现高效的测试时间调整
papers.authors: Amirhosein Ghasemabadi, Keith G. Mills, Baochun Li, Di Niu
papers.abstract: Test-Time Scaling (TTS) methods for enhancing Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning often incur substantial inference costs, due to reliance on long chain-of-thought (CoT) generation, self-consistency sampling methods, or searching under Process Reward Models (PRMs). This paper introduces Guided by Gut (GG), an efficient self-guided TTS framework that enables LLMs to perform step-by-step reasoning at a low cost, without any reward models or verifiers. GG performs a lightweight tree search guided solely by intrinsic confidence signals of the LLM at each reasoning step and improves the reliability of such internal confidence signals by reinforcement learning. Empirical evaluations on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that GG enables smaller models (e.g., 1.5B-7B parameters) to achieve accuracy matching or surpassing significantly larger models (e.g., 32B–70B parameters), while reducing GPU memory usage by up to 10×. Compared to TTS with PRMs, GG achieves comparable accuracy with 8× faster inference speeds and 4–5× lower memory usage. Additionally, GG reduces KV cache memory usage by approximately 50% compared to Best-of-N sampling, facilitating more efficient and practical deployment of TTS techniques.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于增强大语言模型推理的测试时间缩放方法，通常会导致较高的推理成本，这是因为这些方法依赖于长链思维生成、自洽采样方法，或者在过程奖励模型下进行搜索。本文介绍了“以直觉为引导”的测试时间缩放框架，这是一种高效的自主测试时间缩放框架，它能够使大语言模型以较低的成本进行逐步推理，而无需使用任何奖励模型或验证器。该框架通过仅依赖大语言模型在每个推理步骤中的内在置信度信号来进行轻量级树搜索，并通过强化学习来提高这种内部置信度信号的可靠性。在具有挑战性的数学推理基准测试上的实证评估表明，“以直觉为引导”的框架能够使得参数较小的模型（例如，15亿到70亿参数的模型）达到与参数较大的模型（例如，320亿到700亿参数的模型）相当甚至更高的准确率，同时还将GPU内存使用量减少了10倍左右。与采用过程奖励模型的测试时间缩放方法相比，“以直觉为引导”的框架在准确率方面表现相当，但推理速度快了8倍，内存使用量则降低了4到5倍。此外，与基于最佳样本选择的测试时间缩放方法相比，“以直觉为引导”的框架还减少了大约50%的关键向量缓存内存使用量，从而更高效地实现了测试时间缩放技术的实际应用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Lightweight KB-Aligned OOD Detection for Safe RAG
papers.title_zh: 知道何时不应回答问题：一种轻量级、与键盘对齐的OOD检测方法，用于安全的RAG处理
papers.authors: Ilias Triantafyllopoulos, Renyi Qu, Salvatore Giorgi, Brenda Curtis, Lyle Ungar, João Sedoc
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, where safety depends not only on how a system answers, but also on whether a query should be answered given a knowledge base (KB). Out-of-domain (OOD) queries can cause dense retrieval to surface weakly related context and lead the generator to produce fluent but unjustified responses. We study lightweight, KB-aligned OOD detection as an always-on gate for RAG systems. Our approach applies PCA to KB embeddings and scores queries in a compact subspace selected either by explained-variance retention (EVR) or by a separability-driven -test ranking. We evaluate geometric semantic-search rules and lightweight classifiers across 16 domains, including high-stakes COVID-19 and Substance Use KBs, and stress-test robustness using both LLM-generated attacks and an in-the-wild 4chan attack. We find that low-dimensional detectors achieve competitive OOD performance while being faster, cheaper, and more interpretable than prompted LLM-based judges. Finally, human and LLM-based evaluations show that OOD queries primarily degrade the relevance of RAG outputs, highlighting the need for efficient external OOD detection to maintain safe, in-scope behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统越来越多地被应用于高风险领域，在这些领域中，系统的安全性不仅取决于其回答问题的能力，还取决于在知识库的基础上是否能够回答某个查询。非领域内的查询可能会导致密集的检索结果出现与问题关联不大的上下文信息，从而使生成器产生看似流畅但缺乏依据的反应。我们研究了轻量级、与知识库对齐的非领域检测技术，将其作为RAG系统的一种常开机制。我们的方法对知识库的嵌入进行PCA处理，并在由解释方差保留或分离性驱动的测试排名所选择的紧凑子空间中对查询进行评分。我们在16个领域进行了几何语义搜索规则及轻量级分类器的评估，这些领域包括高风险的COVID-19和物质使用知识库。我们还通过LLM生成的攻击以及真实的4chan攻击来测试系统的鲁棒性。研究发现，低维检测器能够在保持速度快、成本低且更易于解释的前提下，取得与基于提示的LLM检测器相当的非领域检测性能。最后，通过人类和LLM评估发现，非领域查询主要会降低RAG输出的相关性，这凸显了需要高效的外部非领域检测机制，以确保系统在安全可控的范围内运行。

papers.title: Guidelines as Environments: A World Model Approach to Rule Following
papers.title_zh: 以环境为指南：一种基于世界模型的规则遵循方法
papers.authors: Haiqing Li, Wenliang Zhong, Yinhao Wu, Hehuan Ma, Yuzhi Guo, Thao M. Dang, Junzhou Huang
papers.abstract: Guideline-following is increasingly important in compliance, customer support, and other regulated workflows, where correctness is defined by explicit rule systems rather than heuristics. Learning to follow guidelines is challenging because guidelines are interdependent: rules can trigger, suppress, or conflict with one another, while locally plausible responses may violate global constraints. Most existing methods treat guidelines as static text and rely on implicit reasoning or deeper decoding, making rule interactions and satisfaction status hard to observe and control. A more feasible approach is to model guideline execution with an explicit state that tracks evolving rule evidence across steps. However, conventional world models are a poor fit: they typically assume privileged feedback or well-defined transition dynamics, assumptions that do not hold when reasoning occurs purely in language space under ambiguous, text-defined constraints. As a solution, we propose RGCWM, a Rule-Grounded Causal World Model that builds an explicit state space from the guideline text itself. RGCWM represents rule applicability and satisfaction as a continuously updated evidence state, externalizes inter-rule dependencies as a causal structure, and plans at inference time by counterfactually evaluating candidate responses under model-estimated state transitions. Experiments show that this shift from implicit text reasoning to state-based reasoning enables stable, controllable execution of complex interacting rules across diverse domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 在合规性、客户支持以及其他受监管的工作流程中，遵循指南变得越来越重要。在这些场景中，正确性的判断是由明确的规则系统来决定的，而非基于经验法则。然而，学会遵循指南是一项挑战，因为各种指南之间存在相互依赖关系：不同的规则可能会互相触发、抑制或冲突，而局部看似合理的响应可能会违反全局约束。目前大多数方法都将指南视为静态文本，并依赖于隐式推理或更复杂的解码方式，这使得规则的相互作用以及满足状态难以被观察和控制。一种更可行的方法是用显式的状态模型来模拟指南的执行过程，该模型能够跟踪各个步骤中规则的变化情况。不过，传统的世界模型并不适合这种需求：它们通常假设存在特权反馈或明确的转换机制，但在模糊的、由文本定义的约束条件下进行推理时，这些假设就不成立了。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了RGCWM——一种基于规则的因果世界模型。该模型从指南文本本身构建显式的状态空间，将规则的适用性和满足程度表示为一个不断更新的证据状态，并将规则之间的依赖关系外化为因果结构。在推理过程中，该模型通过模拟模型估计的状态转换来评估各种可能的响应。实验表明，从隐式文本推理转向基于状态的推理，能够使得复杂的交互式规则在不同领域中得到稳定且可控的执行。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Taxonomic Generalization in (Vision-) Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在（视觉）语言模型中跨模态的分类概括机制
papers.authors: Tianyang Xu, Marcelo Sandoval-Castañeda, Karen Livescu, Greg Shakhnarovich, Kanishka Misra
papers.abstract: What is the interplay between semantic representations learned by language models (LM) from surface form alone to those learned from more grounded evidence? We study this question for a scenario where part of the input comes from a different modality—in our case, in a vision-language model (VLM), where a pretrained LM is aligned with a pretrained image encoder. As a case study we focus on the task of predicting hypernyms of objects represented in images. We do so in a VLM setup where the image encoder and LM are kept frozen, and only the intermediate mappings are learned. We progressively deprive the VLM of explicit evidence for hypernyms, and test whether the knowledge is recoverable from the LM. We find that the LMs we study can recover this knowledge and generalize even in the most extreme version of this experiment (when the model receives no evidence of a hypernym during training). Additional experiments suggest that this cross-modal taxonomic generalization persists under counterfactual image–label mappings only when the counterfactual data have high visual similarity within each category. Taken together, these findings suggest that cross-modal generalization in LMs arises from an interaction between linguistic structure and the information present in the input.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型仅通过表面形式所学习的语义表征与基于更具体证据所学习的语义表征之间存在着怎样的相互作用呢？我们针对这样一个场景进行了研究：部分输入数据来自不同的模态——在我们的案例中，就是在一个视觉-语言模型中，该模型将一个预训练的语模型与一个预训练的图像编码器进行对齐。作为案例研究，我们专注于预测图像中物体的上义项这一任务。我们在视觉-语言模型的设置中进行这项研究，其中图像编码器和语模型保持不变，只学习中间映射关系。我们逐步剥夺视觉-语言模型对上义项的明确信息，并测试这些知识是否可以从语模型中恢复出来。我们发现，我们所研究的语模型能够恢复这些知识，并且即使在实验的最极端情况下（即模型在训练过程中没有任何关于上义项的线索），它们仍然能够进行泛化。进一步的实验表明，这种跨模态的分类泛化只有在反事实图像-标签映射具有较高的视觉相似性时才会持续存在。综合这些发现可知，语言模型中的跨模态泛化源于语言结构与输入中存在的信息之间的相互作用。

papers.title: Biomedical Question Answering via Multi-Level Summarization on a Local Knowledge Graph
papers.title_zh: 基于局部知识图谱的多层次摘要处理技术在实际应用中的生物医学问答系统
papers.authors: Lingxiao Guan, Yuanhao Huang, Jie Liu
papers.abstract: In Question Answering (QA), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) has revolutionized performance in various domains. However, how to effectively capture multi-document relationships remains an open question. This is particularly critical for biomedical tasks due to their reliance on information spread across multiple documents. In this work, we propose a novel method CLAIMS, which utilizes propositional claims to construct a local knowledge graph from retrieved documents. Summaries are then derived via layerwise summarization from the knowledge graph to contextualize a small language model to perform QA. The structured summaries effectively capture explicit and implicit relationships between entities in the documents, thus having a more comprehensive context to provide to LLMs. CLAIMS achieved comparable or superior performance over RAG baselines on several biomedical QA benchmarks. We also evaluated its generalizability and each individual step of our approach with a targeted set of metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 在问答系统中，检索增强生成技术已经显著提升了各个领域的性能。然而，如何有效捕捉多文档之间的关系仍然是一个未解决的问题。对于依赖多个文档信息的生物医学任务来说，这一点尤为重要。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种名为CLAIMS的新方法。该方法利用命题性陈述来从检索到的文档中构建局部知识图谱，然后通过逐层总结的方式从知识图谱中提取摘要，以便为小型语言模型提供上下文信息以进行问答操作。这种结构化的摘要能够有效地捕捉文档中实体之间的显性和隐性关系，从而为大语言模型提供更全面的上下文信息。在多个生物医学问答基准测试中，CLAIMS的表现与基于检索增强生成的基线方法相当甚至更优。我们还通过一系列针对性的指标评估了该方法的可泛化能力以及每个步骤的有效性，证明了其强大的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Sigmoid Head for Quality Estimation under Language Ambiguity
papers.title_zh: 在语言歧义情况下用于质量估量的S形头部方法
papers.authors: Tu Anh Dinh, Jan Niehues
papers.abstract: Language model (LM) probability is not a reliable quality estimator, as natural language is ambiguous. When multiple output options are valid, the model’s probability distribution is spread across them, which can misleadingly indicate low output quality. This issue is caused by two reasons: (1) LMs’ final output activation is softmax, which does not allow multiple correct options to receive high probabilities simultaneuously and (2) LMs’ training data is single, one-hot encoded references, indicating that there is only one correct option at each output step. We propose training a module for Quality Estimation on top of pre-trained LMs to address these limitations. The module, called Sigmoid Head, is an extra unembedding head with sigmoid activation to tackle the first limitation. To tackle the second limitation, during the negative sampling process to train the Sigmoid Head, we use a heuristic to avoid selecting potentially alternative correct tokens. Our Sigmoid Head is computationally efficient during training and inference. The probability from Sigmoid Head is notably better quality signal compared to the original softmax head. As the Sigmoid Head does not rely on human-annotated quality data, it is more robust to out-of-domain settings compared to supervised QE.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型的概率并不是一个可靠的品质评估指标，因为自然语言本身具有模糊性。当多个输出选项都有效时，模型的概率分布会分散在这些选项上，这可能会误导性地表明输出质量较低。这个问题由两个原因造成：(1) 语言模型的最终输出激活函数采用softmax，这不允许多个正确的选项同时获得高概率；(2) 语言模型的训练数据都是单值的独热编码数据，这意味着每个输出步骤中只有一个正确的选项。我们提出在预训练的语言模型基础上添加一个用于品质评估的模块，以克服这些限制。这个模块被称为Sigmoid Head，它是一个额外的非嵌入头，采用sigmoid激活函数来处理第一个限制问题。为了处理第二个限制问题，在训练Sigmoid Head的过程中，我们使用一种启发式方法来避免选择潜在的替代正确标记。我们的Sigmoid Head在训练和推理过程中具有高效的计算性能。与原始的softmax头相比，Sigmoid Head提供的概率信号质量明显更高。由于Sigmoid Head不依赖于人类标注的质量数据，因此相比有监督的QE方法，它更能适应不同领域的情况。

papers.title: RExBench: Can coding agents autonomously implement AI research extensions?
papers.title_zh: RExBench：编程智能体能否自主实施人工智能研究的扩展功能？
papers.authors: Nicholas Edwards, Yukyung Lee, Yujun Audrey Mao, Yulu Qin, Sebastian Schuster, Najoung Kim
papers.abstract: Agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for performing sophisticated software engineering tasks autonomously. In addition, there has been progress towards developing agents that can perform parts of the research pipeline in machine learning and the natural sciences. We argue that research extension and its implementation is a critical capability for such systems, and introduce RExBench to support the evaluation of this capability. RExBench is a benchmark consisting of realistic extensions of 12 research papers that aim to investigate novel research hypotheses. Each task is set up as an extension to an existing research paper and codebase, accompanied by domain expert-written instructions. RExBench is robust to data contamination, and supports an automatic evaluation infrastructure that executes agent outputs to determine whether the success criteria are met. We use this benchmark to evaluate 12 LLM agents implemented using two different frameworks: aider and OpenHands. We find that all agents fail to autonomously implement the majority of the extensions, with the best agent at around 33% success rate. Although the success rate improves with additional human-written hints, the best performance under this setting remains below 44%. This indicates that current agents are still short of being able to handle realistic research extension tasks without substantial human guidance.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体在自主执行复杂的软件工程任务方面表现出良好的潜力。此外，在开发能够完成机器学习和自然科学领域部分研究流程的智能体方面也取得了进展。我们认为，研究的扩展及其实现能力是这类系统的关键能力，因此我们开发了RExBench来支持对这一能力的评估。RExBench是一个基准测试平台，包含了12篇研究论文中的真实扩展案例，这些案例旨在验证新的研究假设。每个任务都是对现有研究论文和代码库进行的扩展，并附有领域专家编写的说明。RExBench能够抵抗数据污染的影响，并且支持自动评估机制，可以执行智能体的输出结果以判断是否满足成功标准。我们使用这个基准测试来评估使用两种不同框架实现的12个LLM智能体：aider和OpenHands。结果发现，所有智能体都无法自主完成大部分扩展任务，其中表现最好的智能体成功率约为33%。虽然添加更多人工提示可以提高成功率，但在这种设置下，最佳性能仍然低于44%。这表明，目前的智能体仍然无法在没有大量人工指导的情况下处理真实的研究扩展任务。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Narrative License and Model Sycophancy in LLM Summaries of Scientific Work
papers.title_zh: 叙述性许可与大型语言模型在科学工作摘要中的运用
papers.authors: Calvin Isch, Grace Jennings
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to summarize academic work, yet model summaries can subtly exaggerate or mischaracterize findings. We examine how Narrative License (NL), rhetorical shifts that amplify claims beyond the underlying evidence, emerges in LLM summaries of scholarly articles. Using diverse prompting strategies across six leading models, we assess three dimensions of NL: causal overreach, rhetorical confidence, and sentiment (N = 100 peer-reviewed articles). Under basic summarization prompts, models frequently increase NL relative to academic abstracts; however, guardrail prompts can reduce these distortions. We further test how model “sycophancy” shapes NL, finding that stated stances and user personas produce predictable shifts in each element. These findings suggest that users and the benchmarks used to evaluate summarization should explicitly consider subtle rhetorical distortions and user alignment to ensure faithful scientific communication.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在总结学术成果时被广泛使用，但模型总结有时会故意夸大或歪曲研究结果。我们研究了“叙事许可”现象在大语言模型对学术文章的总结中出现的情况。所谓“叙事许可”，指的是通过修辞手段来强化论点，而忽略背后的证据。我们通过使用六种主流模型的多种提示策略，对“叙事许可”的三个维度进行了评估：因果过度延伸、修辞上的自信以及情感表达（样本数量：100篇同行评审文章）。在基本的摘要生成提示下，模型通常会增加与学术摘要相比的“叙事许可”程度；然而，使用特定的提示策略可以减少这种扭曲现象。我们还研究了模型的“谄媚性”对“叙事许可”的影响，发现用户的立场和角色设定会显著影响这三个维度。这些研究结果表明，用户以及用于评估摘要质量的基准应该明确考虑那些微妙的修辞扭曲现象，并确保用户的行为符合科学传播的要求，从而确保科学信息的准确传递。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AlignUSER: Human-Aligned LLM Agents via World Models for Recommender System Evaluation
papers.title_zh: AlignUSER：通过世界模型实现与人类协同工作的大语言模型代理，用于推荐系统评估
papers.authors: Nicolas Bougie, Gian Maria Marconi, Xiaotong Ye, Narimawa Watanabe
papers.abstract: Evaluating recommender systems remains challenging due to the gap between offline metrics and real user behavior, as well as the scarcity of interaction data. Recent work explores large language model (LLM) agents as synthetic users, yet they typically rely on few-shot prompting, which yields a shallow understanding of the environment and limits their ability to faithfully reproduce user actions. We introduce AlignUSER, a framework that learns world-model-driven agents from human interactions. Given rollout sequences of actions and states, we formalize world modeling as a next state prediction task that helps the agent internalize the environment. To align actions with human personas, we generate counterfactual trajectories around demonstrations and prompt the LLM to compare its decisions with human choices, identify suboptimal actions, and extract lessons. The learned policy is then used to drive agent interactions with the recommender system. We evaluate AlignUSER across multiple datasets and demonstrate closer alignment with genuine humans than prior work, both at the micro and macro levels.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估推荐系统仍然具有挑战性，因为离线指标与真实用户行为之间存在差距，而且交互数据的稀缺也是一个问题。最近的研究采用大语言模型作为合成用户，但这些模型通常依赖于少量样本进行提示，这导致对环境的理解较为肤浅，同时也限制了它们忠实再现用户行为的能力。我们提出了AlignUSER框架，该框架能够从人类互动中学习出以世界模型为驱动的智能体。通过提供一系列动作和状态的序列，我们将世界建模形式化为一个下一个状态预测任务，以帮助智能体更好地理解环境。为了将动作与人类角色对齐，我们生成了围绕示范内容的反事实轨迹，并促使大语言模型将其决策与人类选择进行比较，识别出次优动作，并提取相关经验。然后，所学习到的策略被用于驱动智能体与推荐系统的交互。我们在多个数据集上评估了AlignUSER的效果，结果表明，它在微观和宏观层面都比以往的工作实现了更紧密的对齐，与真实人类的行为更为接近。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Domain Generalizable AI Guardrails with Augmented Policy Training
papers.title_zh: 具有增强式策略训练的通用可迁移人工智能约束机制
papers.authors: Minqian Liu, Ioana Baldini, David Rabinowitz, David S Rosenberg, Sebastian Gehrmann, Mark Dredze
papers.abstract: AI guardrail systems support usage policies by determining whether a user query or a generated response is allowed or forbidden under the policy. Fine-tuned guardrails – such as LlamaGuard and ShieldGemma – include policy definitions in prompts during training that can be updated during inference to aid generalization. However, our analysis reveals that these models still overfit the training policies, which prevents adaptation to new domains. We propose Augmented Policy Training (APT), a training recipe that enhances guardrail adaptability to unseen policies by using a suite of policy perturbation strategies during training to reduce overfitting and increase generalization. Notably, a small 1B model trained in this manner achieves comparable or better performance than existing 8B guardrails on unseen policies. Our work reveals critical limitations of existing AI guardrails, offers a promising solution, and provides actionable insights for adapting systems to new domains and policies.
papers.abstract_zh: AI防护系统通过判断用户查询或生成的响应是否符合政策规定来支持使用策略。经过微调的防护模型，如LlamaGuard和ShieldGemma，在训练过程中会在提示中包含政策定义，这些定义可以在推理过程中进行更新，以帮助模型更好地泛化。然而，我们的分析表明，这些模型仍然过度拟合了训练出的策略，这导致模型无法适应新的领域。我们提出了增强式策略训练方法，该方法通过在训练过程中采用一系列策略来减少过拟合现象，从而提高模型的适应性。值得注意的是，一个仅1B参数的模型通过这种方式训练后，其在处理未知策略时的性能可以与现有的8B参数防护模型相媲美甚至更优。我们的研究揭示了现有AI防护模型存在的关键缺陷，并提出了一种有前景的解决方案，为将系统适应于新的领域和政策提供了可行的思路。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: APEX-MEM: Agentic Semi-Structured Memory with Temporal Reasoning for Long-Term Conversational AI
papers.title_zh: APEX-MEM：一种具有时间推理功能的半结构化记忆机制，适用于长期对话式人工智能应用
papers.authors: Pratyay Banerjee, Masud Moshtaghi, Shivashankar Subramanian, Amita Misra, Ankit Chadha
papers.abstract: Large language models still struggle with reliable long-term conversational memory: simply enlarging context windows or applying naïve retrieval often introduces noise and destabilizes responses. We present APEX-MEM, a conversational memory system that combines three key innovations: (1) a property graph which use domain-agnostic ontology to structure conversations as temporally grounded events in an entity-centric framework, (2) append-only storage that preserves the full temporal evolution of information, and (3) a multi-tool retrieval agent that understands and resolves conflicting or evolving information at query time, producing a compact and contextually relevant memory summary. This retrieval-time resolution preserves the full interaction history while suppressing irrelevant details. APEX-MEM achieves 88.88% accuracy on LOCOMO and 86.2% on LongMemEval, outperforming state-of-the-art session-aware approaches and demonstrating that structured property graphs enable more temporally coherent long-term conversational reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在可靠的长期对话记忆方面仍然存在困难：简单地扩大上下文窗口或采用简单的检索方式往往会导致噪声的产生，进而破坏对话的连贯性。我们提出了APEX-MEM这一对话记忆系统，该系统结合了三项关键创新：(1) 使用与领域无关的本体论来构建时间化的事件结构，使对话具有实体中心框架；(2) 仅追加信息的存储方式，能够保留信息的完整时间演变过程；(3) 一种多工具检索代理，能够在查询时理解和解决相互矛盾或不断变化的信息，从而生成简洁且符合上下文的记忆摘要。这种在检索时刻进行的解析功能，能够保留完整的互动历史，同时排除无关细节。APEX-MEM在LOCOMO任务上的准确率为88.88%，在LongMemEval任务上的准确率为86.2%。其表现优于现有的会话感知方法，证明了结构化属性图能够实现更连贯的长期对话推理。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: emg2speech: synthesizing speech from electromyography using self-supervised speech models
papers.title_zh: emg2speech：利用自监督语音模型从肌电图数据合成语音
papers.authors: Harshavardhana T Gowda, Daniel C Comstock, Lee M. Miller
papers.abstract: We present a neuromuscular speech interface that translates electromyographic (EMG) signals recorded from orofacial muscles during speech articulation directly into audio. We find that self-supervised speech (S3) representations are strongly linearly related to the electrical power of muscle activity: a simple linear mapping predicts EMG power from S3 representations with a correlation of r = 0.85. In addition, EMG power vectors associated with distinct articulatory gestures form structured, separable clusters. Together, these observations suggest that S3 models implicitly encode articulatory mechanisms, as reflected in EMG activity. Leveraging this structure, we map EMG signals into the S3 representation space and synthesize speech, enabling end-to-end EMG-to-speech generation without explicit articulatory modeling or vocoder training. We demonstrate this system with a participant with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), converting orofacial EMG recorded while she silently articulated speech into audio.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种神经肌肉语音接口，它能够将说话过程中从口面部肌肉记录到的肌电图信号直接转换为音频。我们发现，自监督语音表示与肌肉活动的电功率之间存在强烈的线性关系：简单的线性映射可以将肌电图功率从自监督语音表示中预测出来，其相关性为r=0.85。此外，与不同发音动作相关的肌电图功率向量形成了结构化的、可分离的簇。这些观察结果表明，自监督语音模型隐含地编码了发音机制，这一点可以从肌电图活动中得到体现。利用这一结构，我们可以将肌电图信号映射到自监督语音表示空间，并合成语音，从而实现无需显式发音建模或声码器训练就能进行端到端的肌电图到语音的生成。我们通过一位肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者的实验来验证了这一系统，她在不发出声音的情况下，其口面部肌电图信号被转换为音频。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CoAct: Co-Active LLM Preference Learning with Human-AI Synergy
papers.title_zh: CoAct：结合人类与人工智能协同作用的LLM偏好学习机制
papers.authors: Ruiyao Xu, Mihir Parmar, Tiankai Yang, Zhengyu Hu, Yue Zhao, Kaize Ding
papers.abstract: Learning from preference-based feedback has become an effective approach for aligning LLMs across diverse tasks. However, high-quality human-annotated preference data remains expensive and scarce. Existing methods address this challenge through either self-rewarding, which scales by using purely AI-generated labels but risks unreliability, or active learning, which ensures quality through oracle annotation but cannot fully leverage unlabeled data. In this paper, we present CoAct, a novel framework that synergistically combines self-rewarding and active learning through strategic human-AI collaboration. CoAct leverages self-consistency to identify both reliable self-labeled data and samples requiring oracle verification. Additionally, oracle feedback guides the model to generate new instructions within its solvable capability. Evaluated on three reasoning benchmarks across two model families, CoAct achieves average improvements of +13.25% on GSM8K, +8.19% on MATH, and +13.16% on WebInstruct, consistently outperforming all baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 从基于偏好的反馈中学习已成为调整大语言模型以处理不同任务的有效方法。然而，高质量的人工标注偏好数据仍然非常昂贵且稀缺。现有的方法要么采用自我奖励的方式来解决这一挑战——这种方式可以通过使用纯人工智能生成的标签来实现扩展，但存在不可靠的风险；要么采用主动学习的方法——这种方式可以通过人工标注来确保数据的质量，但无法充分利用未标记的数据。在本文中，我们提出了CoAct框架，该框架通过策略性的人机协作，将自我奖励和主动学习相结合，从而协同发挥作用。CoAct利用自我一致性来识别可靠的自标记数据和需要人工标注的样本。此外，人工标注的反馈指导模型生成新的指令，同时保持在模型的解决能力范围内。在两种模型家族的三个推理基准测试上进行了评估，CoAct在GSM8K上的平均提升率为+13.25%，在MATH上的提升率为+8.19%，在WebInstruct上的提升率为+13.16%，始终优于所有基线模型。

papers.title: Label and Explanation Variation in LLM-Based Annotation: a Case Study in Natural Language Inference
papers.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的注释方式及其差异：以自然语言推理为例的研究
papers.authors: Artur Kulmizev, Erika Lombart, Patrick Watrin, Marie-Catherine de Marneffe
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable promise for annotation purposes, yet questions remain about their ability to capture human label variation (HLV) — genuine disagreement between annotators often observed across NLP tasks. Here, we investigate how label and explanation variation manifests within and across LLMs with respect to the Natural Language Inference (NLI) task. Using zero-shot prompting with exact human annotation instructions, we treat individual model generations as participants and examine three response sampling strategies: varying generation parameters, leveraging within-family model size differences, and pooling responses from distinct LLMs. We show that, while model ensembles can generate label distributions similar to humans, they likewise exhibit distinct, idiosyncratic judgments and disagreement patterns. We further analyze explanation variation, observing that, although models generate longer explanations than humans, they demonstrate substantially less stylistic diversity. Our findings suggest that, while LLMs may serve as useful tools for generating diverse annotations, they should not be viewed as drop-in replacements for human annotators — particularly in applications requiring authentic representation of diversity in human judgments, such as NLI.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在注释任务中展现出巨大的潜力，但关于它们能否捕捉到人类标注中的差异性问题仍然存在——在自然语言处理任务中，常常能观察到标注者之间的真实分歧。本研究探讨了在自然语言推理任务中，不同语言模型内部以及不同模型之间在标签和解释上的差异表现。通过使用带有精确人类标注指令的零样本提示方法，我们将各个模型的生成结果视为参与者，并测试了三种响应采样策略：改变生成参数、利用同一家族模型中不同模型的大小差异，以及汇总来自不同语言模型的响应。我们发现，虽然模型集合能够生成与人类相似的标签分布，但它们仍然表现出独特的判断和分歧模式。进一步分析解释方面的差异后，我们发现尽管模型生成的解释比人类更长，但它们的风格多样性却明显不足。我们的研究结果表明，虽然语言模型可以作为生成多样化注释的有效工具，但它们不应被视作人类标注者的替代方案——尤其是在需要真实反映人类判断多样性的应用中，比如自然语言推理任务。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Text-Attributed Knowledge Graph Enrichment with Large Language Models for Medical Concept Representation
papers.title_zh: 利用大型语言模型对文本进行属性标注，以丰富医学概念的表达方式
papers.authors: Mohsen Nayebi Kerdabadi, Arya Hadizadeh Moghaddam, Chen Chen, Dongjie Wang, Zijun Yao
papers.abstract: In electronic health record (EHR) mining, learning high-quality representations of medical concepts (e.g., standardized diagnosis, medication, and procedure codes) is fundamental for downstream clinical prediction. However, robust concept representation learning is hindered by two key challenges: (i) clinically important cross-type dependencies (e.g., diagnosis-medication and medication-procedure relations) are often missing or incomplete in existing ontology resources, limiting the ability to model complex EHR patterns; and (ii) rich clinical semantics are often missing from structured resources, and even when available as text, are difficult to integrate with KG structure for representation learning. To address these challenges, we present MedCo, an LLM-empowered graph learning framework for medical concept representation. MedCo first builds a global knowledge graph (KG) over medical codes by combining statistically reliable associations mined from EHRs with type-constrained LLM prompting to infer semantic relations. It then utilizes LLMs to enrich the KG into a text-attributed graph by generating node descriptions and edge rationales, providing semantic signals for both concepts and their relationships. Finally, MedCo jointly trains a LoRA-tuned LLaMA text encoder with a heterogeneous GNN, fusing text semantics and graph structure into unified concept embeddings. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that MedCo consistently improves prediction performance and serves as an effective plug-in concept encoder for standard EHR pipelines.
papers.abstract_zh: 在电子健康记录挖掘中，学习高质量的医学概念表示（如标准化诊断、药物和手术代码）对于后续的临床预测至关重要。然而，强大的概念表示学习面临着两个主要挑战：(i) 现有的本体资源中往往缺失或不完整了具有临床意义的跨类型依赖关系（例如，诊断与药物之间的关系以及药物与手术之间的关系），这限制了模型对复杂电子健康记录模式进行建模的能力；(ii) 结构化资源中通常缺乏丰富的临床语义信息，即使有文本形式的语义信息，也难以将其与知识图谱结构结合以用于表示学习。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MedCo这一基于大语言模型支持的图学习框架，用于医学概念表示。MedCo首先通过结合从电子健康记录中提取的统计上可靠的关联信息与类型约束的大语言模型提示，构建了一个涵盖医学代码的全局知识图谱。然后，利用大语言模型为知识图谱添加文本描述节点和边理由，从而生成节点描述和边理由，为概念和它们之间的关系提供语义信号。最后，MedCo联合训练了一个经过LoRA调整的LLaMA文本编码器和一个异构的GNN，将文本语义和图结构融合成统一的概念嵌入。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上的广泛实验表明，MedCo能够持续提升预测性能，并作为标准电子健康记录流程中的有效插件概念编码器。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Evolving Agents
papers.title_zh: 不断进化的智能体
papers.authors: Leonardo Ranaldi
papers.abstract: AI agents powered by LLMs plan, reason and use tools well, but remain brittle to adapt and evolve because they fail to abstract the mechanisms underlying problem-solving. Reasoning, memory, and decision-making remain fragmented, leaving the systematic reuse of experience for adaptation at scale out of reach. In this paper, we introduce EvA (Evolving Agents), a framework to improve evolution in agentic reasoning that leverages quasi-symbolic abstractions—semi-structured dynamic representations that furnish constructs to distil and reuse reasoning mechanisms. They are learned and refined through experience, and when instantiated, deliver meta-states for organising reasoning. EvA orchestrates this mechanism via a Perceptor modelling observation and action, an Actor conditioning its policy on these abstractions, and a Controller overseeing structure to explore paths or initiate rollbacks. As experience accumulates, EvA refines both its abstractions and the modules that construct and instantiate them by learning past trajectories into reusable mechanisms. Our initial analysis shows that EvA improves accuracy and adapts under mid-episode distribution shifts that cause agents to plateau on complex reasoning and interactive planning tasks. These results position EvA as a step towards adaptive reasoning, memory, and meta-control.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的AI智能体能够规划、推理并有效使用各种工具，但它们在适应和进化方面仍然存在局限性，因为它们无法抽象出解决问题背后的机制。推理、记忆和决策能力仍然处于碎片化状态，这使得大规模地系统性复用经验以进行适应变得难以实现。在本文中，我们提出了EvA（进化智能体）这一框架，该框架旨在改进智能体的推理能力，它通过利用半结构化的动态表示来提升推理效率。这些表示可以被学习和优化，并在实例化后用于组织推理过程。EvA通过“感知器”负责观察和行动，“执行器”根据这些表示来调整策略，而“控制器”则负责探索路径或启动回退操作。随着经验的积累，EvA能够不断改进其抽象模型以及构建和实例化这些模型的模块，从而将过去的经验转化为可复用的机制。我们的初步分析表明，EvA能够提高推理的准确性，并在情节发展过程中因分布变化而导致智能体陷入复杂推理和互动规划任务时仍能进行适应。这些成果使得EvA成为迈向自适应推理、记忆和元控制的一步。

papers.title: ViDoRe V3: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation in Complex Real-World Scenarios
papers.title_zh: ViDoRe V3：对复杂现实场景中的检索增强生成技术的全面评估
papers.authors: António Loison, Quentin Macé, Antoine Edy, Victor Xing, Tom Balough, Gabriel de Souza P. Moreira, Bo Liu, Manuel Faysse, Celine Hudelot, Gautier Viaud
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines must address challenges beyond simple single-document retrieval, such as interpreting visual elements (tables, charts, images), synthesizing information across documents, and providing accurate source grounding. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this complexity, often focusing on textual data, single-document comprehension, or evaluating retrieval and generation in isolation. We introduce ViDoRe V3, a comprehensive multimodal RAG benchmark featuring multi-type queries over visually rich document corpora. It covers 10 datasets across diverse professional domains, comprising ~26,000 document pages paired with 3,099 human-verified queries, each available in 6 languages. Through 12,000 hours of human annotation effort, we provide high-quality annotations for retrieval relevance, bounding box localization, and verified reference answers. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art RAG pipelines reveals that visual retrievers outperform textual ones, late-interaction models and textual reranking substantially improve performance, and hybrid or purely visual contexts enhance answer generation quality. However, current models still struggle with non-textual elements, open-ended queries, and fine-grained visual grounding. To encourage progress in addressing these challenges, the benchmark is released under a commercially permissive license.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）管道必须解决超越简单单文档检索的挑战，例如解析视觉元素（表格、图表、图片）、跨文档合成信息以及提供准确的来源标注。现有的基准测试未能捕捉到这种复杂性，通常只关注文本数据、单文档理解，或者单独评估检索和生成能力。我们推出了ViDoRe V3，这是一个全面的多模态RAG基准测试，适用于包含丰富视觉元素的文档集，支持多种类型的查询。该测试涵盖了10个来自不同专业领域的数据集，包含约26,000页文档，并配有3,099条经过人工验证的查询，这些查询以6种语言呈现。通过12,000小时的人工注释工作，我们为检索相关性、边界框定位以及经过验证的参考答案提供了高质量的注释信息。我们对最先进的RAG管道的评估显示，基于视觉信息的检索器在性能上优于基于文本的检索器；后期交互模型和文本重新排序显著提升了性能；而混合或纯视觉上下文则提升了答案生成的质量。然而，当前模型在处理非文本元素、开放式查询以及精细化的视觉标注方面仍然存在困难。为了鼓励在解决这些挑战方面的进展，该基准测试以商业许可协议的形式发布。

papers.title: Why LLM Safety Guardrails Collapse After Fine-tuning: A Similarity Analysis Between Alignment and Fine-tuning Datasets
papers.title_zh: 为什么在微调之后大语言模型的安全性会下降：对齐数据集与微调数据集之间的相似性分析
papers.authors: Lei Hsiung, Tianyu Pang, Yung-Chen Tang, Linyue Song, Tsung-Yi Ho, Pin-Yu Chen, Yaoqing Yang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have underscored their vulnerability to safety alignment jailbreaks, particularly when subjected to downstream fine-tuning. However, existing mitigation strategies primarily focus on reactively addressing jailbreak incidents after safety guardrails have been compromised, removing harmful gradients during fine-tuning, or continuously reinforcing safety alignment throughout fine-tuning. As such, they tend to overlook a critical upstream factor: the role of the original safety-alignment data. This paper therefore investigates the degradation of safety guardrails through the lens of representation similarity between upstream alignment datasets and downstream fine-tuning tasks. Our experiments demonstrate that high similarity between these datasets significantly weakens safety guardrails, making models more susceptible to jailbreaks. Conversely, low similarity between these two types of datasets yields substantially more robust models and thus reduces harmfulness score by up to 10.33%. By highlighting the importance of upstream dataset design in the building of durable safety guardrails and reducing real-world vulnerability to jailbreak attacks, these findings offer actionable insights for fine-tuning service providers to prioritize upstream models with low jailbreak risk.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期大语言模型（LLM）领域的进展凸显了这些模型在安全性对齐机制被突破时的脆弱性，尤其是在进行下游微调时。然而，现有的缓解策略主要集中在在安全防护措施被破坏之后才采取应对措施，比如在微调过程中消除有害的梯度，或者在整个微调过程中持续强化安全性对齐机制。因此，这些策略往往忽略了另一个关键的上游因素：原始安全性对齐数据的角色。本文从上游对齐数据集与下游微调任务之间的表示相似性角度，探讨了安全性防护机制的退化问题。我们的实验表明，这些数据集之间的高相似性会显著削弱安全性防护机制，使模型更容易发生破解行为。相反，这两种数据集之间的低相似性则能生成更稳健的模型，从而将有害性评分降低多达10.33%。通过强调上游数据集设计在构建持久性安全性防护机制中的重要性，以及减少现实世界中对破解攻击的脆弱性，这些发现为微调服务提供商提供了有价值的建议，让他们能够优先考虑那些破解风险较低的上游模型。

papers.title: TabEmb: Joint Semantic-Structure Embedding for Table Annotation
papers.title_zh: TabEmb：用于表格注释的联合语义结构嵌入方法
papers.authors: Ehsan Hoseinzade, Ke Wang, Anandharaju Durai Raju
papers.abstract: Table annotation is crucial for making web and enterprise tables usable in downstream NLP applications. Unlike textual data where learning semantically rich token or sentence embeddings often suffice, tables are structured combinations of columns wherein useful representations must jointly capture column’s semantics and the inter-column relationships. Existing models learn by linearizing the 2D table into a 1D token sequence and encoding it with pretrained language models (PLMs) such as BERT. However, this leads to limited semantic quality and weaker generalization to unseen or rare values compared to modern LLMs, and degraded structural modeling due to 2D-to-1D flattening and context-length constraints. We propose TabEmb, which directly targets these limitations by decoupling semantic encoding from structural modeling. An LLM first produces semantically rich embeddings for each column, and a graph-based module over columns then injects relationships into the embeddings, yielding joint semantic–structural representations for table annotation. Experiments show that TabEmb consistently outperforms strong baselines on different table annotation tasks. Source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/hoseinzadeehsan/TabEmb
papers.abstract_zh: 表格注释对于使网页和企业表格能够在下游自然语言处理应用中被使用至关重要。与文本数据不同，在文本数据中，学习具有语义丰富性的令牌或句子嵌入通常就足够了，而表格则是列的组合体，有效的表示必须同时捕捉到列的语义以及列与列之间的关系。现有的模型通过将二维表格线性化为一维令牌序列，然后利用预训练的语言模型（如BERT）对其进行编码来学习表格信息。然而，这种方法会导致语义质量有限，对未见或罕见值的泛化能力较弱，而且由于从二维到一维的扁平化处理以及上下文长度的限制，结构建模的效果也会下降。我们提出了TabEmb，它直接解决了这些限制问题，通过将语义编码与结构建模分离开来。首先，一个语言模型为每个列生成具有语义丰富的嵌入，然后基于图的模块将关系注入到这些嵌入中，从而得到用于表格注释的联合语义-结构表示。实验表明，TabEmb在不同表格注释任务上的表现始终优于强大的基线算法。源代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/hoseinzadeehsan/TabEmb获取。

papers.title: Text-to-Distribution Prediction with Quantile Tokens and Neighbor Context
papers.title_zh: 利用分位数令牌和邻近上下文进行文本分发预测
papers.authors: Yilun Zhu, Yuan Zhuang, Nikhita Vedula, Dushyanta Dhyani, Shaoyuan Xu, Mohsen Bayati, Bryan Wang, Shervin Malmasi
papers.abstract: Many applications of LLM-based text regression require predicting a full conditional distribution rather than a single point value. We study distributional regression under empirical-quantile supervision, where each input is paired with multiple observed quantile outcomes, and the target distribution is represented by a dense grid of quantiles. We address two key limitations of current approaches: the lack of local grounding for distribution estimates, and the reliance on shared representations that create an indirect bottleneck between inputs and quantile outputs. In this paper, we introduce Quantile Token Regression, which, to our knowledge, is the first work to insert dedicated quantile tokens into the input sequence, enabling direct input-output pathways for each quantile through self-attention. We further augment these quantile tokens with retrieval, incorporating semantically similar neighbor instances and their empirical distributions to ground predictions with local evidence from similar instances. We also provide the first theoretical analysis of loss functions for quantile regression, clarifying which distributional objectives each optimizes. Experiments on the Inside Airbnb and StackSample benchmark datasets with LLMs ranging from 1.7B to 14B parameters show that quantile tokens with neighbors consistently outperform baselines (\sim4 points lower MAPE and 2\times narrower prediction intervals), with especially large gains on smaller and more challenging datasets where quantile tokens produce substantially sharper and more accurate distributions.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多基于大语言模型的文本回归应用都需要预测一个完整的条件分布，而不是单个点值。我们研究了在经验分位数监督下的分布回归问题，其中每个输入都与多个观测到的分位数结果相关联，而目标分布则由一个密集的分位数网格表示。我们解决了当前方法的两个主要局限性：缺乏对分布估计的局部指导，以及依赖于共享表示，这会在输入和分位数输出之间造成间接的瓶颈效应。在本文中，我们提出了分位数令牌回归方法。据我们所知，这是第一个在输入序列中插入专门的分位数令牌的方法，使得每个分位数可以通过自注意力机制直接进行输入输出处理。我们还通过检索技术对这些分位数令牌进行了增强，将语义相似的邻近实例及其经验分布结合起来，以便用来自类似实例的局部证据来支撑预测结果。此外，我们还首次对分位数回归的损失函数进行了理论分析，明确了每种损失函数所优化的分布目标。在Inside Airbnb和StackSample基准数据集上的实验表明，参数范围从17亿到140亿的大语言模型所生成的分位数令牌始终优于基线方法（MAPE降低了约4个点，预测区间也缩小了2倍）。特别是在规模较小且更具挑战性的数据集上，分位数令牌能够生成更加精确的分布。

papers.title: Check Your Work: Structured Checklist Feedback for Improving Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 检查你的工作：用于改进大型语言模型的结构化检查清单反馈机制
papers.authors: Jonathan Cook, Tim Rocktäschel, Jakob Nicolaus Foerster, Dennis Aumiller, Alex Wang
papers.abstract: Much recent progress in Large Language Model (LLM) performance has been driven by verifiable feedback in deterministic domains like mathematics and code. However, scaling reinforcement learning (RL) and test-time compute in domains for which strict verification is infeasible remains a challenge. A common approach is to use an LLM-as-judge, which often relies on opaque, monolithic scores. In this work, we propose that AI feedback is most effective when decomposed into granular, prompt-specific checklists. To transform these checklists into a scalar reward, we introduce DIVA: DIscriminative VAriance weighting, a dynamic aggregation scheme that prioritises checklist items based on their ability to distinguish quality across a candidate pool. This ensures the reward signal focuses on the most salient criteria for a given prompt and response group, rather than being diluted by trivial or redundant constraints. Our approach yields an 11.8% win-rate improvement on AlpacaEval 2.0 using Qwen3-8B, outperforming holistic reward models and existing checklist baselines. Beyond training, we show that these checklists serve as a structured policy improvement operator at inference time - by using the model’s own checklist evaluation as localised contextual feedback, the model can iteratively refine its output. This self-correction mechanism outperforms free-form sequential self-correction, offering a unified and interpretable framework for scaling both training-time and test-time performance in domains lacking strict verifiers.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在大语言模型性能上的许多进展，都是得益于在数学和代码等确定性领域中的可验证反馈。然而，在无法进行严格验证的领域里，如何扩展强化学习技术和提升测试时的计算能力仍然是一个挑战。一种常见的方法是使用“以模型作为评判者”的方式，但这往往依赖于不透明、整体性的评分标准。在这项研究中，我们提出，当AI反馈被分解为细化的、针对特定提示的检查清单时，其效果最为显著。为了将这些检查清单转化为标量奖励，我们提出了DIVA：区分性变量加权算法，这是一种动态聚合方案，能够根据检查清单项目在候选群体中的区分能力来分配优先级。这样，奖励信号就能聚焦于给定提示和响应组中最重要的标准，而不会因琐碎或冗余的约束而变得模糊不清。我们的方法在AlpacaEval 2.0上的表现提升了11.8%，使用的是Qwen3-8B模型，其表现优于其他整体奖励模型和现有的基于检查清单的基线模型。除了训练阶段之外，我们还发现，这些检查清单可以在推理時に充当结构化的策略改进工具——通过利用模型自身的检查清单评估作为局部上下文反馈，模型可以不断优化其输出结果。这种自我修正机制优于自由形式的序列自我修正机制，为在缺乏严格验证器的领域里提升训练和测试时的性能提供了一个统一且可解释的框架。

papers.title: LOKA: Conflict-Aware LLM Knowledge Update with Adaptive Knowledge Memory
papers.title_zh: LOKA：基于冲突意识的大语言模型知识更新，附带自适应知识记忆功能
papers.authors: Binchi Zhang, Zhengzhang Chen, Zaiyi Zheng, Jundong Li, Haifeng Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in natural language processing by encoding extensive knowledge, but their utility relies on timely updates as human knowledge keeps evolving. In this paper, we investigate the problem of LLM knowledge updates, which requires simultaneously unlearning unwanted information and learning new knowledge. Existing approaches that tackle unlearning and learning separately encounter task conflicts and knowledge management issues when applied to comprehensive knowledge updates.In this paper, we validate our findings with theoretical analysis and empirical evidence, and propose LOKA, a conflict-aware framework for Large language mOdel Knowledge updAtes. During training, LOKA introduces an adaptive knowledge memory approach in which updated knowledge is allocated across multiple memory units. During inference, LOKA retrieves the most relevant memory unit from the knowledge memory and integrates it with the original LLM to apply updated knowledge, while a learning-based router controls the activation of the knowledge memory to improve knowledge utilization. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of LOKA in achieving accurate, flexible, and conflict-aware knowledge updates.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自然语言处理领域取得了显著的成功，它们通过编码丰富的知识来实现这一目标。不过，这些模型的实用性依赖于及时更新知识，因为人类的知识在不断演变。在本文中，我们研究了大语言模型知识更新的问题，这个问题要求模型能够同时消除不必要的信息并学习新的知识。目前，那些分别处理消除旧知识和学习新知识的方法在应用于全面的知识更新时会出现任务冲突和知识管理方面的问题。为了验证我们的发现，我们通过理论分析和实证证据进行了验证，并提出了LOKA框架——一个针对大语言模型知识更新的冲突感知框架。在训练过程中，LOKA采用了一种自适应知识存储方法，将更新的知识分配到多个存储单元中。在推理过程中，LOKA从知识存储中提取最相关的存储单元，并将其与原始的LLM相结合以应用更新的知识。同时，基于学习的路由机制控制知识存储的激活方式，从而提升知识的利用效率。大量的实验表明，LOKA在实现准确、灵活且具备冲突感知的知识更新方面具有很好的效果。

papers.title: Student Guides Teacher: Weak-to-Strong Inference via Spectral Orthogonal Exploration
papers.title_zh: 学生指南 教师：通过谱正交探索法进行弱到强的推理分析
papers.authors: Dayu Wang, Jiaye Yang, Weikang Li, Jiahui Liang, Yang Li, Deguo Xia, Jizhou Huang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffer from “Reasoning Collapse” on challenging mathematical reasoning tasks, where stochastic sampling produces lexical variations of the same erroneous logic rather than genuine semantic exploration. We observe that failed reasoning traces are often associated with a low-rank bias manifold in the model’s hidden-state geometry, which reduces exploration toward corrective solution directions. To address this, we propose Spectral Orthogonal Exploration (SOE), a geometric inference framework under a “Student Guides Teacher” paradigm. Instead of using a weak auxiliary agent for imitation, SOE uses it as an orthogonal probe to introduce semantically heterogeneous reasoning signals into the teacher’s orthogonal complement of its dominant subspace. This intervention steers the teacher toward more diverse reasoning trajectories and improves exploration beyond standard sampling. Experiments on mathematical benchmarks show that SOE improves average accuracy by 62.4% and average sampling efficiency by 113.7% over baseline methods, suggesting that geometric interventions can be effective for mitigating reasoning collapse in mathematical reasoning. We further provide preliminary evidence that SOE is also effective on logic and code generation benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/dayuwang401/spectral-orthogonal-exploration.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂的数学推理任务中常常会出现“推理崩溃”的问题。在这种情况下，随机采样会生成相同错误逻辑的词汇变体，而不是真正的语义探索。我们发现，推理失败的轨迹往往与模型隐藏状态几何结构中的低秩偏差有关，这种偏差使得模型更倾向于沿着错误的方向进行探索。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“谱正交探索”的几何推理框架。与传统的弱辅助代理不同，该框架将辅助代理作为正交探针，将其引入教师的主导子空间的正交补空间中，从而引入具有语义多样性的推理信号。这一干预措施有助于引导教师走向更多样化的推理路径，并提升探索能力，超越标准采样方式的效果。在数学基准测试上的实验表明，与基线方法相比，“谱正交探索”方法的平均准确率提高了62.4%，平均采样效率提高了113.7%。这表明几何性干预可以有效缓解数学推理中的推理崩溃问题。此外，我们还获得了初步证据表明，“谱正交探索”在逻辑和代码生成方面也表现出良好的效果。相关代码可访问https://github.com/dayuwang401/spectral-orthogonal-exploration。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When LLMs Read Tables Carelessly: Measuring and Reducing Data Referencing Errors
papers.title_zh: 当大型语言模型粗心大意地读取表格时：如何衡量并减少数据引用错误
papers.authors: Yuqing Yang, Qi Zhu, Zhen Han, Boran Han, Zhengyuan Shen, Shuai Wang, Vassilis N. Ioannidis, Huzefa Rangwala
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) perform well on table tasks, they still make data referencing errors (DREs), i.e., incorrectly citing or omitting table values, despite understanding the table structure. Beyond final-answer accuracy, DREs directly compromise the correctness and reliability of intermediate reasoning steps. Yet prior studies have only offered limited, small-scale analyses. In this work, we present the first systematic evaluation of tabular data referencing errors across different models and tasks. Our results show that DREs occur across all tested models (1.7B to 20B parameters). Furthermore, we demonstrate that incorporating data referencing as a critic significantly improves answer accuracy up to 12.0%, through critic-based filtering and rejection sampling. Finally, we trained a lightweight 4B-parameter critic model that achieves an average F1 score of 78.2% in detecting both in-distribution and out-of-distribution DREs, and effectively assists inference for larger models.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在表格任务上表现良好，但它们仍然会犯数据引用错误，即错误地引用或遗漏表格中的数值，尽管它们能够理解表格的结构。除了最终答案的准确性之外，数据引用错误还会直接影响中间推理步骤的正确性和可靠性。然而，之前的研究仅提供了有限且规模较小的分析。在这项研究中，我们首次对不同模型和任务下的表格数据引用错误进行了系统性的评估。我们的结果显示，所有被测试的模型（参数范围从1.7B到20B）都存在数据引用错误。此外，我们发现，通过将数据引用作为评判标准，可以通过基于评判标准的过滤和拒绝采样，显著提高答案的准确性，提高幅度可达12.0%。最后，我们训练了一个轻量级的4B参数评判模型，该模型在检测内部和外部的数据引用错误方面，平均F1分数达到了78.2%，并且能够有效辅助更大模型的推理过程。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PubMed Reasoner: Dynamic Reasoning-based Retrieval for Evidence-Grounded Biomedical Question Answering
papers.title_zh: PubMed Reasoner：基于动态推理的证据驱动式生物医学问答系统
papers.authors: Yiqing Zhang, Xiaozhong Liu, Fabricio Murai
papers.abstract: Trustworthy biomedical question answering (QA) systems must not only provide accurate answers but also justify them with current, verifiable evidence. Retrieval-augmented approaches partially address this gap but lack mechanisms to iteratively refine poor queries, whereas self-reflection methods kick in only after full retrieval is completed. In this context, we introduce PubMed Reasoner, a biomedical QA agent composed of three stages: self-critic query refinement evaluates MeSH terms for coverage, alignment, and redundancy to enhance PubMed queries based on partial (metadata) retrieval; reflective retrieval processes articles in batches until sufficient evidence is gathered; and evidence-grounded response generation produces answers with explicit citations. PubMed Reasoner with a GPT-4o backbone achieves 78.32% accuracy on PubMedQA, slightly surpassing human experts, and showing consistent gains on MMLU Clinical Knowledge. Moreover, LLM-as-judge evaluations prefer our responses across: reasoning soundness, evidence grounding, clinical relevance, and trustworthiness. By orchestrating retrieval-first reasoning over authoritative sources, our approach provides practical assistance to clinicians and biomedical researchers while controlling compute and token costs.
papers.abstract_zh: 可信的生物医学问答系统不仅要提供准确的答案，还必须用当前可验证的证据来支撑这些答案。基于检索增强的方法在一定程度上解决了这个问题，但缺乏对不良查询进行迭代改进的机制；而自我反思方法则只有在完全检索完成后才会发挥作用。在这方面，我们提出了PubMed Reasoner——一种由三个阶段组成的生物医学问答智能体：第一阶段是自我批判的查询优化，通过评估MeSH术语的覆盖性、一致性及冗余度来优化PubMed查询；第二阶段是批量处理文章以收集足够的证据；第三阶段是基于证据的回答生成，生成带有明确引用信息的答案。采用GPT-4o框架的PubMed Reasoner在PubMedQA任务上的准确率达到78.32%，略高于人类专家的表现，并且在MMLU临床知识任务上持续取得进步。此外，当使用LLM作为裁判时，我们的回答在推理合理性、证据支持、临床相关性以及可信度方面都表现优异。通过先利用权威资源进行检索，再结合逻辑推理，我们的方法为临床医生和生物医学研究人员提供了实用的帮助，同时还能有效控制计算资源和令牌成本。

papers.title: Decoupling Task-Solving and Output Formatting in LLM Generation
papers.title_zh: 在语言模型生成过程中分离任务解决与输出格式处理的功能
papers.authors: Haikang Deng, Po-Nien Kung, Nanyun Peng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adept at solving complex problems, such as mathematical reasoning and automatic evaluation. However, performance often degrades when prompts intertwine task instructions with rigid formatting requirements. This entanglement creates competing goals for the model, hindering its reasoning capabilities. To address this, we introduce Deco-G, a decoding framework that explicitly decouples format adherence from problem solving. Deco-G delegates format adherence to a separate Format Estimation Module (FEM), which performs probabilistic lookahead to estimate future format compliance rate and reweighs token probabilities, allowing the LLM to focus solely on task resolution. To make this approach both practical and efficient, we introduce three key innovations: instruction-aware distillation, a flexible trie-building algorithm, and HMM state pruning. Experiments across mathematical reasoning, event argument extraction, and LLM-as-a-judge demonstrate that Deco-G constantly gains over prompting or structured generation baselines, with guaranteed format compliance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解决复杂问题方面表现得越来越出色，比如数学推理和自动评估。然而，当提示同时包含任务指示和严格的格式要求时，模型的性能往往会下降。这种混乱会导致模型面临多个相互竞争的目标，从而削弱其推理能力。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了Deco-G这一解码框架。该框架明确地将格式遵守与问题解决分离开来。它将格式遵守的任务委托给一个独立的格式估算模块，该模块通过概率预测来估算未来的格式合规率，并重新调整令牌的概率分布，从而使语言模型能够专注于任务解决本身。为了使这种方法既实用又高效，我们引入了三项关键创新：指令感知蒸馏、灵活的三元树构建算法，以及隐马尔可夫模型状态剪枝技术。在数学推理、事件参数提取以及语言模型作为裁判等场景中的实验表明，Deco-G在性能上始终优于传统的提示式或结构化生成方法，并且能确保格式合规性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GS-Quant: Granular Semantic and Generative Structural Quantization for Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.title_zh: GS-Quant：用于知识图谱补全的颗粒化语义与生成式结构量化技术
papers.authors: Qizhuo Xie, Yunhui Liu, Yu Xing, Qianzi Hou, Xudong Jin, Tao Zheng, Tieke He
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown immense potential in Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC), yet bridging the modality gap between continuous graph embeddings and discrete LLM tokens remains a critical challenge. While recent quantization-based approaches attempt to align these modalities, they typically treat quantization as flat numerical compression, resulting in semantically entangled codes that fail to mirror the hierarchical nature of human reasoning. In this paper, we propose GS-Quant, a novel framework that generates semantically coherent and structurally stratified discrete codes for KG entities. Unlike prior methods, GS-Quant is grounded in the insight that entity representations should follow a linguistic coarse-to-fine logic. We introduce a Granular Semantic Enhancement module that injects hierarchical knowledge into the codebook, ensuring that earlier codes capture global semantic categories while later codes refine specific attributes. Furthermore, a Generative Structural Reconstruction module imposes causal dependencies on the code sequence, transforming independent discrete units into structured semantic descriptors. By expanding the LLM vocabulary with these learned codes, we enable the model to reason over graph structures isomorphically to natural language generation. Experimental results demonstrate that GS-Quant significantly outperforms existing text-based and embedding-based baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在知识图谱补全任务中展现出巨大的潜力，然而，将连续图嵌入与离散语言模型令牌之间的模式差异转化为统一格式仍然是一个关键挑战。虽然近期基于量化的方法试图解决这一问题，但这些方法通常将量化视为简单的数值压缩过程，导致生成的代码在语义上相互交织，无法反映人类推理的层次结构。在本文中，我们提出了GS-Quant这一创新框架，它能够为知识图谱实体生成语义连贯且结构分层的离散编码。与以往的方法不同，GS-Quant基于这样的理念：实体表示应遵循从粗略到精细的语言逻辑。我们引入了一个细粒度语义增强模块，该模块将分层知识注入编码书中，使得早期的编码能够捕捉全局语义类别，而后续的编码则能够细化具体属性。此外，我们还引入了生成式结构重构模块，该模块在代码序列中建立因果依赖关系，将独立的离散单元转化为结构化的语义描述符。通过用这些学习到的编码来扩展语言模型的词汇表，我们能够使模型在图结构上进行同构推理，从而实现自然语言生成。实验结果表明，GS-Quant在性能上显著优于现有的基于文本和基于嵌入的基线方法。

papers.title: Mind the Gap in Cultural Alignment: Task-Aware Culture Management for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 注意文化差异带来的差异：针对大型语言模型的任务导向文化管理策略
papers.authors: Binchi Zhang, Xujiang Zhao, Jundong Li, Haifeng Chen, Zhengzhang Chen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in culturally sensitive real-world tasks. However, existing cultural alignment approaches fail to align LLMs’ broad cultural values with the specific goals of downstream tasks and suffer from cross-culture interference. We propose CultureManager, a novel pipeline for task-specific cultural alignment. CultureManager synthesizes task-aware cultural data in line with target task formats, grounded in culturally relevant web search results. To prevent conflicts between cultural norms, it manages multi-culture knowledge learned in separate adapters with a culture router that selects the appropriate one to apply. Experiments across five national cultures and ten culture-sensitive tasks show consistent improvements over prompt-based and fine-tuning baselines. Our results demonstrate the necessity of task adaptation and modular culture management for effective cultural alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在涉及文化敏感的现实任务中得到了广泛应用。然而，现有的文化对齐方法难以将模型所体现的广泛文化价值观与下游任务的特定目标相结合，同时还会受到跨文化干扰的影响。我们提出了CultureManager这一创新性的任务特定文化对齐工具。该工具能够根据目标任务格式合成符合文化特征的文化数据，这些数据基于具有文化相关性的网络搜索结果生成。为了避免不同文化规范之间的冲突，该工具能够管理从多个适配器中学到的多文化知识，并通过文化路由机制选择适合应用的文化数据。在五种不同文化和十项涉及文化敏感的任务上的实验表明，使用CultureManager能够获得比基于提示的优化方法和微调方法更显著的改进效果。我们的研究结果强调了针对任务进行适配以及采用模块化文化管理策略对于实现有效文化对齐的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Analyzing and Internalizing Complex Policy Documents for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 分析并理解复杂的政策文件，以便让大型语言模型代理能够妥善处理这些文件
papers.authors: Jiateng Liu, Zhenhailong Wang, Xiaojiang Huang, Yingjie Li, Xiang Li, Chenlei Guo, Xing Fan, Ruhi Sarikaya, Heng Ji
papers.abstract: Large language model agents rely on in-context policy documents encoding diverse business rules. As businesses scale, these documents grow, creating substantial computational overhead and motivating internalization methods that embed policy into model priors. Prior work focuses on generic prompts, but we find agentic policies span multiple complexity levels and demand heavier reasoning, posing greater challenges. We introduce an agentic benchmark generator with Controllable Complexity in agent policy across four levels, enabling systematic evaluation of agents under increasing complexity and providing a testbed for policy internalization. Our analysis shows that workflow-governing policy specifications are the hardest to reason over, and that SFT on gold trajectories with chain-of-thought is data-hungry and struggles at high complexity. We propose Category-Aware Policy Continued Pretraining, an automated pipeline that analyzes policies, extracts key specifications, categorizes them into factual, behavioral, and conditional types, and isolates those driving workflow complexity. This enables targeted “therapy” by synthesizing specialized training data for each type and improving internalization via an autoregressive pretraining loss. Extensive experiments show our synthetic data and objective consistently improve performance. Combined with SFT, our method outperforms the baseline across different settings, especially in data-sparse and high-complexity regimes, with gains up to 41% and 22% on Qwen-3-32B. Overall, we achieve 97.3% prompt reduction on our benchmark, and on \tau-Bench we further improve performance while reducing prompt requirements with very limited SFT data.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理依赖于上下文中的策略文档，这些文档编码了各种业务规则。随着业务的扩展，这些文档的数量不断增加，从而带来了巨大的计算负担。因此，人们提出了将策略嵌入模型先验的方法。现有的研究主要集中在通用提示上，但我们发现，代理策略涉及多种复杂程度，需要更复杂的推理过程，这带来了更大的挑战。我们提出了一种具有可控复杂度的代理基准生成器，该生成器能够生成四个不同复杂程度的代理策略，从而可以系统地评估代理在日益复杂的场景下的表现，并为策略的内置提供了试验平台。我们的分析表明，控制工作流程的策略规范是最难进行推理的；而基于链索数据的SFT在处理高复杂度问题时存在数据消耗大且效率低下的问题。我们提出了“类别感知策略持续预训练”方法，这是一种自动化的流程，它分析策略、提取关键规范，将它们分类为事实性、行为性和条件性类型，并分离出那些导致工作流程复杂性的因素。这种方法可以通过为每种类型合成专门的训练数据来实现有针对性的“治疗”，并通过自回归预训练损失来提升内置效果。广泛的实验表明，我们的合成数据和目标函数都能持续提升性能。结合SFT方法，我们的方法在不同场景下都优于基线方案，尤其是在数据稀缺和高复杂度的情况下，其性能提升分别达到了41%和22%，在Qwen-3-32B上的提升尤为显著。总体而言，我们在基准测试上实现了97.3%的提示减少，而在\tau-Bench测试中，我们在减少提示需求的同时，仍能在有限的SFT数据支持下进一步提升性能。

papers.title: In-Context Representation Hijacking
papers.title_zh: 上下文表示劫持
papers.authors: Itay Yona, Amir Sarid, Michael Karasik, Yossi Gandelsman
papers.abstract: We introduce Doublespeak, a simple in-context representation hijacking attack against language models. The attack works by systematically replacing a harmful keyword (e.g., bomb) with a benign token (e.g., carrot) across multiple in-context examples, provided as a prefix to a harmful request. We demonstrate that this substitution leads to the internal representation of the benign token converging toward that of the harmful one, effectively embedding the harmful semantics under a euphemism. As a result, superficially innocuous prompts (e.g., “How to build a carrot?”) are internally interpreted as disallowed instructions (“How to build a bomb?”), thereby bypassing the model’s safety alignment. We use interpretability tools to show this semantic shift occurs progressively across layers. Doublespeak is optimization-free, broadly transferable across model families, and achieves strong success rates on closed-source systems, reaching 74% on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct with a single-sentence context override. Our findings highlight a new attack surface in LM latent space, indicating that current alignment strategies are insufficient and should instead operate at the representation level.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种名为“Doublespeak”的简单上下文表示劫持攻击，该攻击针对语言模型进行实施。该攻击通过系统地将在多个上下文示例中作为有害请求前缀出现的有害关键词替换为无害的标记词，例如将“炸弹”替换为“胡萝卜”。我们发现，这种替换使得无害标记词的内部表示逐渐趋近于有害关键词的表示方式，从而将有害语义隐藏在委婉的表述之下。这样一来，表面上无害的提示（例如“如何制作胡萝卜？”）实际上被解释为禁止的操作指令（“如何制造炸弹？”），从而绕过了模型的安全约束机制。我们通过可解释性工具证明了这种语义转变是逐步发生的，且这种转变会跨越多个层次。Doublespeak这种攻击方式不需要任何优化处理，且可以在不同的模型家族中广泛应用；在闭源系统中，其成功率高达74%，例如在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct模型中，仅通过一句话的上下文覆盖就能实现有效的攻击效果。我们的研究发现揭示了语言模型潜在空间中的一个新的攻击面，这表明当前的安全对齐策略还不够有效，应该更多地在表示层面进行干预。

papers.title: Quantifying Metric and Model Agreement in Bias Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型的偏差评估中，量化度量标准与模型一致性的程度
papers.authors: Arash Asgari, Huan Wu, Amirreza Naziri, Mojtaba Kolahdouzi, Laleh Seyyed-Kalantari
papers.abstract: Bias evaluation in large language models (LLMs) uses many metrics and benchmarks, but lacks a systematic way to measure agreement across bias metrics and models. As a result, improvements observed under one metric may contradict another, and model rankings may reflect benchmark-specific artifacts rather than stable bias profiles. In this work, we introduce Metric Agreement Score (MeAS) and Model Agreement Score (MoAS), which quantify cross-metric and cross-model agreement in bias rankings, respectively. We apply these measures to eight LLMs, seven bias metrics, and nine corpora. Our results reveal disagreement among both metrics and models: Contrary to expectations, we find that metrics within the same category (generation-based and probabilistic) often behave independently of each other. For instance, HONEST shows independence with toxicity metrics, and the Context Association Test shows no correlation with Language Modeling Bias metric. At the model level, DeepSeek-family models invert bias rankings relative to most others, indicating that the model family strongly shapes specific bias profiles. These findings challenge the assumption that bias mitigation is universally transferable and highlight the need for agreement-aware evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中，偏差评估使用了许多指标和基准测试，但缺乏一种系统的方法来衡量不同偏差指标和模型之间的一致性。因此，在一个指标下观察到的改进可能与另一个指标产生矛盾，模型的排名可能反映的是特定基准的偏差特征，而非稳定的偏差模式。在这项研究中，我们提出了度量一致性得分（Metric Agreement Score，MeAS）和模型一致性得分（Model Agreement Score，MoAS），分别用于量化不同指标和模型之间的偏差一致性。我们将这些指标应用于八种大语言模型、七种偏差指标和九份语料库上。我们的研究结果揭示了指标和模型之间的一致性问题：与预期相反，我们发现同一类别的指标（基于生成的指标和概率性指标）往往彼此独立地表现。例如，HONEST指标与毒性指标之间没有相关性，而上下文关联测试则与语言建模偏差指标也没有相关性。在模型层面，DeepSeek系列模型相对于大多数其他模型而言，其偏差排名呈现相反的趋势，这表明该模型系列对特定的偏差模式有着显著的影响。这些发现挑战了偏差缓解措施具有普遍适用性的假设，并强调了需要采用考虑一致性的评估方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MultiFinBen: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Multilingual and Multimodal Financial Application
papers.title_zh: MultiFinBen：针对多语言与多模态金融应用的大型语言模型性能比较研究
papers.authors: Xueqing Peng, Lingfei Qian, Yan Wang, Ruoyu Xiang, Yueru He, Yang Ren, Mingyang Jiang, Vincent Jim Zhang, Yuqing Guo, Jeff Zhao, Huan He, Yi Han, Yun Feng, Yuechen Jiang, Yupeng Cao, Haohang Li, Yangyang Yu, Xiaoyu Wang, Penglei Gao, Shengyuan Lin, Keyi Wang, Shanshan Yang, Yilun Zhao, Zhiwei Liu, Peng Lu, Jerry Huang, Suyuchen Wang, Triantafillos Papadopoulos, Polydoros Giannouris, Efstathia Soufleri, Nuo Chen, Zhiyang Deng, Heming Fu, Yijia Zhao, Mingquan Lin, Meikang Qiu, Kaleb E Smith, Arman Cohan, Xiao-Yang Liu, Jimin Huang, Guojun Xiong, Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Xi Chen, Junichi Tsujii, Jian-Yun Nie, Sophia Ananiadou, Qianqian Xie
papers.abstract: Real-world financial analysis involves information across multiple languages and modalities, from reports and news to scanned filings and meeting recordings. Yet most existing evaluations of LLMs in finance remain text-only, monolingual, and largely saturated by current models. To bridge these gaps, we present MultiFinBen, the first expert-annotated multilingual (five languages) and multimodal (text, vision, audio) benchmark for evaluating LLMs in realistic financial contexts. MultiFinBen introduces two new task families: multilingual financial reasoning, which tests cross-lingual evidence integration from filings and news, and financial OCR, which extracts structured text from scanned documents containing tables and charts. Rather than aggregating all available datasets, we apply a structured, difficulty-aware selection based on advanced model performance, ensuring balanced challenge and removing redundant tasks. Evaluating 21 leading LLMs shows that even frontier multimodal models like GPT-4o achieve only 46.01% overall, stronger on vision and audio but dropping sharply in multilingual settings. These findings expose persistent limitations in multilingual, multimodal, and expert-level financial reasoning. All datasets, evaluation scripts, and leaderboards are publicly released.
papers.abstract_zh: 现实世界的财务分析涉及多种语言和形式的信息，从报告和新闻到扫描文件以及会议记录。然而，目前对大语言模型在金融领域的评估大多还是以文本形式进行的，且局限于单一语言，而且现有模型已经占据了大部分市场。为了填补这些空白，我们提出了MultiFinBen——首个由专家注释的多语言（五种语言）和多模态（文本、视觉、音频）的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在真实财务场景中的表现。MultiFinBen引入了两个新的任务类别：多语言财务推理，该任务测试从文件和新闻中整合跨语言信息的能力；以及财务OCR，该任务从包含表格和图表的扫描文档中提取结构化文本。我们没有汇总所有可用的数据集，而是根据先进模型的性能进行有结构的、考虑难度的选择，从而确保任务的平衡性并消除冗余任务。通过对21个领先的大语言模型进行评估，我们发现即使是像GPT-4o这样的前沿多模态模型，其整体表现也只有46.01%。它们在视觉和音频方面的表现较为出色，但在多语言环境下的表现则明显下降。这些发现揭示了在多语言、多模态以及专家级财务推理方面存在的持续限制。所有数据集、评估脚本和排行榜都已公开提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Bidirectional LMs are Better Knowledge Memorizers? A Benchmark for Real-world Knowledge Injection
papers.title_zh: 双向知识记忆器是否更擅长记忆信息？这是现实世界知识注入的基准测试
papers.authors: Yuwei Zhang, Wenhao Yu, Shangbin Feng, Yifan Zhu, Letian Peng, Jayanth Srinivasa, Gaowen Liu, Jingbo Shang
papers.abstract: Despite significant advances in large language models (LLMs), their knowledge memorization capabilities remain underexplored, due to the lack of standardized and high-quality testing grounds. In this paper, we introduce a novel, real-world and large-scale knowledge injection benchmark that continuously evolves without human intervention. Specifically, we propose WikiDYK, which leverages recently-added and expert-curated facts from Wikipedia’s “Did You Know...” entries. Each entry is converted into multiple question–answer pairs spanning diverse task formats from easy cloze prompts to complex multi-hop questions. WikiDYK currently contains 12,290 facts and 77,180 questions, and its design allows for seamless extension with future updates from Wikipedia editors. Through extensive experiments using continued pre-training, we reveal a surprising insight: despite their prevalence in modern LLMs, Causal Language Models (CLMs) demonstrate significantly weaker knowledge memorization capabilities compared to Bidirectional Language Models (BiLMs), exhibiting a 23% lower accuracy in terms of reliability. To compensate for the smaller scales of current BiLMs, we introduce a modular collaborative framework utilizing ensembles of BiLMs as external knowledge repositories to integrate with LLMs. Experiment shows that this framework further improves the reliability accuracy by up to 29.1%. Code: https://github.com/zhang-yu-wei/WikiDYK.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在性能上取得了显著进步，但其知识记忆能力仍然没有得到充分探索，因为缺乏标准化且高质量的测试环境。在本文中，我们提出了一个新颖的、面向现实世界的、大规模的知识注入基准测试平台，该平台能够无需人工干预即可持续更新。具体来说，我们开发了WikiDYK，它利用了维基百科“你知道吗…”板块中新增的、经过专家筛选的事实信息。每个事实都被转化为多个问答对，涵盖了从简单的填空题到复杂的多跳问题等多种任务形式。目前，WikiDYK包含12,290个事实和77,180个问题，其设计允许在未来随着维基百科编辑者的更新而进行无缝扩展。通过持续的预训练实验，我们发现一个令人惊讶的现象：尽管因果语言模型在现代语言模型中非常常见，但它们的知识记忆能力明显不如双向语言模型，其可靠性准确率低23%。为了弥补当前双向语言模型的局限性，我们提出了一种模块化协作框架，该框架利用多个双向语言模型的集合作为外部知识库来与语言模型集成。实验表明，这种框架能够将可靠性准确率提高多达29.1%。代码链接：https://github.com/zhang-yu-wei/WikiDYK。

papers.title: Mapping the Circumplex of Affect: Geometric Analysis of Emotion Representations via Hyperspherical Contrastive Learning
papers.title_zh: 绘制情感循环图谱：通过超球面对比学习对情绪表征进行几何分析
papers.authors: Yusuke Yamauchi, Akiko Aizawa
papers.abstract: Psychological research has long utilized circumplex models to structure emotions, placing similar emotions adjacently and opposing ones diagonally. Although frequently used to interpret deep learning representations, these models are rarely directly incorporated into the representation learning of language models, leaving their geometric validity unexplored. This paper proposes a method to induce circular emotion representations within language model embeddings via contrastive learning on a hypersphere. We show that while this circular alignment offers superior interpretability and robustness against dimensionality reduction, it underperforms compared to conventional designs in high-dimensional settings and fine-grained classification. Our findings elucidate the trade-offs involved in applying psychological circumplex models to deep learning architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 心理学研究长期以来一直使用循环模型来构建情绪结构，将相似的情绪相邻放置，而将对立的情绪对角排列。虽然这些模型常被用于解释深度学习表示，但它们很少直接应用于语言模型的表示学习，其几何特性也未被充分探索。本文提出了一种方法，通过在高维球面上进行对比学习，从而在语言模型嵌入中引入循环情绪表示。我们发现，尽管这种循环对齐方式在可解释性和抵抗降维能力方面表现更优，但在高维环境和细粒度分类任务上，其性能仍不如传统方法。我们的研究结果揭示了将心理学循环模型应用于深度学习架构时所面临的权衡问题。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Do LLMs Really Need 10+ Thoughts for “Find the Time 1000 Days Later”? Towards Structural Understanding of LLM Overthinking
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型真的需要超过10种想法来回答“1000天后确定时间”这个问题吗？——关于大型语言模型过度思考的结构性分析
papers.authors: Xinliang Frederick Zhang, Anhad Mohananey, Alexandra Chronopoulou, Pinelopi Papalampidi, Somit Gupta, Tsendsuren Munkhdalai, Lu Wang, Shyam Upadhyay
papers.abstract: Models employing long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning have shown superior performance on complex reasoning tasks. Yet, this capability introduces a critical and often overlooked inefficiency—overthinking—models often engage in unnecessarily extensive reasoning even for simple queries, incurring significant computations without accuracy improvements. While prior work has explored solutions to mitigate overthinking, a fundamental gap remains in our understanding of its underlying causes. Most existing analyses are limited to superficial, profiling-based observations, failing to delve into LLMs’ inner workings. This study introduces a systematic, fine-grained analyzer of LLMs’ thought process to bridge the gap, TRACE. We first benchmark the overthinking issue, confirming that long-thinking models are five to twenty times slower on simple tasks with no substantial gains. We then use TRACE to first decompose the thought process into minimally complete sub-thoughts. Next, by inferring discourse relationships among sub-thoughts, we construct granular thought progression graphs and subsequently identify common thinking patterns for topically similar queries. Our analysis reveals two major patterns for open-weight thinking models—Explorer and Late Landing. This finding provides evidence that over-verification and over-exploration are the primary drivers of overthinking in LLMs. Grounded in thought structures, we propose a utility-based definition of overthinking, which moves beyond length-based metrics. This revised definition offers a more insightful understanding of LLMs’ thought progression, as well as practical guidelines for principled overthinking management.
papers.abstract_zh: 采用长链思维推理的模型在复杂的推理任务中表现出更好的性能。然而，这种能力引入了一个关键且常被忽视的缺陷——过度思考。模型往往会对简单的查询进行不必要的复杂推理，导致大量的计算消耗，而并未提升准确性。虽然之前的研究已经尝试寻找解决过度思考的方法，但我们对其根本原因的理解仍然存在空白。目前大多数分析都局限于表面的、基于特征的观察，未能深入探究大语言模型的内部运作机制。本研究提出了一种系统化的、细粒度的分析工具TRACE，用于填补这一空白。我们首先对过度思考问题进行了基准测试，发现长思维模型的简单任务处理速度慢五到二十倍，且几乎没有显著改进。接着，我们使用TRACE将思维过程分解为最小完整的子思维。然后，通过推断子思维之间的逻辑关系，我们构建了详细的思维进展图，并识别出主题相似查询中的常见思维模式。我们的分析揭示了开放式思维模型中的两种主要模式——探索者和晚归者。这一发现表明，过度验证和过度探索是大语言模型中过度思考的主要驱动因素。基于思维结构，我们提出了一种基于实用性的过度思考定义，该定义不再仅以长度作为衡量标准。这一修订后的定义有助于更深入地理解大语言模型的思维过程，并为有效管理过度思考提供了实用的指导方针。

papers.title: Anchor: Branch-Point Data Generation for GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: 主持人：用于GUI代理的节点点数据生成方法
papers.authors: Jinbiao Wei, Yilun Zhao, Kangqi Ni, Arman Cohan
papers.abstract: End-to-end GUI agents for real desktop environments require large amounts of high-quality interaction data, yet collecting human demonstrations is expensive and existing synthetic pipelines often suffer from limited task diversity or noisy, goal-drifting trajectories. We present a trajectory expansion framework Anchor that bootstraps scalable desktop supervision from a small set of verified seed demonstrations. Starting from each seed, we identify branch points that correspond to meaningful state changes and propose new, state-grounded task variants conditioned on the current GUI context. An executing agent then follows the proposed instructions to generate new trajectories, while a verifier enforces task completion via state-aware checks and trajectory-level consistency. To improve supervision quality, we further apply task-conditioned step-level filtering to remove ungrounded actions and denoise post-branch segments to maintain coherent intent. Experiments on standard desktop benchmarks, OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena, show that models fine-tuned on our expanded corpus achieve consistent improvements over zero-shot agents and representative synthesis baselines, and generalize across applications and operating systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对真实桌面环境的端到端GUI代理需要大量高质量的交互数据。然而，收集人类示范数据成本很高，而现有的合成流程往往存在任务多样性不足或轨迹不稳定等问题。我们提出了一种轨迹扩展框架“Anchor”，该框架能够从少量经过验证的基准示范中自动生成可扩展的桌面监督策略。从每个基准示范出发，我们识别出代表有意义状态变化的分支点，并基于当前GUI上下文提出新的、以状态为约束的任务变体。执行代理按照这些指令生成新的轨迹，而验证器则通过状态感知的检查和轨迹一致性验证来确保任务的完成。为了提升监督质量，我们还应用了基于任务的步骤级过滤技术，去除无意义的动作，并对分支后的轨迹进行去噪处理，以保持连贯的意图表达。在OSWorld和WindowsAgentArena等标准桌面基准测试上的实验表明，基于我们的扩展数据集训练的模型在性能上优于零样本代理和代表性的合成基线，并且能够在不同的应用程序和操作系统上实现泛化能力。

papers.title: When One LLM Drools, Multi-LLM Collaboration Rules
papers.title_zh: 当单个大语言模型无法处理任务时，多个大语言模型就可以协同工作来解决问题
papers.authors: Shangbin Feng, Wenxuan Ding, Alisa Liu, Zifeng Wang, Weijia Shi, Yike Wang, Shannon Zejiang Shen, Xiaochuang Han, Hunter Lang, Chen-Yu Lee, Tomas Pfister, Yejin Choi, Yulia Tsvetkov
papers.abstract: This position paper argues that in many realistic (i.e., complex, contextualized, subjective) scenarios, one LLM is not enough to produce a reliable output. We challenge the status quo of relying solely on a single general-purpose LLM and argue for multi-LLM collaboration to better represent the extensive diversity of data, skills, and people. We first posit that a single LLM underrepresents real-world data distributions, heterogeneous skills, and pluralistic populations, and that such representation gaps cannot be trivially patched by further training a single LLM. We then organize existing multi-LLM collaboration methods into a hierarchy, based on the level of access and information exchange, ranging from API-level, text-level, logit-level, to weight-level collaboration. Based on these methods, we highlight how multi-LLM collaboration addresses challenges that a single LLM struggles with, such as reliability, democratization, and pluralism. Finally, we identify the limitations of existing multi-LLM methods and motivate future work. We envision multi-LLM collaboration as an essential path toward compositional intelligence and collaborative AI development.
papers.abstract_zh: 本立场论文认为，在许多现实场景中（即复杂、具有特定背景且带有主观性的场景），单个大语言模型无法产生可靠的输出结果。我们质疑仅依赖单一通用大语言模型的现状，并主张采用多大语言模型协作的方式，以更好地反映数据、技能和人群的多样性。首先，我们认为单个大语言模型无法充分反映现实世界的数据分布、多样化的技能以及多元的人群特征，而这样的信息缺失无法通过进一步训练单个模型来简单解决。接着，我们将现有的多大语言模型协作方法按照访问权限和信息交换的级别进行分层整理，从API级别、文本级别、逻辑回归级别到权重级别的协作。基于这些方法，我们强调了多大语言模型协作如何解决单个模型所面临的挑战，如可靠性、民主化以及多元化问题。最后，我们指出了现有多大语言模型方法的局限性，并为未来的研究指明了方向。我们认为，多大语言模型协作是迈向组合智能和协作式人工智能发展的重要途径。

papers.title: From Query to Counsel: Structured Reasoning with a Multi-Agent Framework and Dataset for Legal Consultation
papers.title_zh: 从查询到建议：基于多智能体框架的结构化推理技术及其在法律咨询中的应用
papers.authors: Mingfei Lu, Yi Zhang, Mengjia Wu, Yue Feng
papers.abstract: Legal consultation question answering (Legal CQA) presents unique challenges compared to traditional legal QA tasks, including the scarcity of high-quality training data, complex task composition, and strong contextual dependencies. To address these, we construct JurisCQAD, a large-scale dataset of over 43,000 real-world Chinese legal queries annotated with expert-validated positive and negative responses, and design a structured task decomposition that converts each query into a legal element graph integrating entities, events, intents, and legal issues. We further propose JurisMA, a modular multi-agent framework supporting dynamic routing, statutory grounding, and stylistic optimization. Combined with the element graph, the framework enables strong context-aware reasoning, effectively capturing dependencies across legal facts, norms, and procedural logic. Trained on JurisCQAD and evaluated on a refined LawBench, our system significantly outperforms both general-purpose and legal-domain LLMs across multiple lexical and semantic metrics, demonstrating the benefits of interpretable decomposition and modular collaboration in Legal CQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 法律咨询问题解答（Legal CQA）与传统法律质量检查任务相比，面临着独特的挑战。这些挑战包括高质量训练数据的稀缺性、任务构成的复杂性以及强烈的上下文依赖性。为了应对这些问题，我们构建了JurisCQAD这一大规模数据集，其中包含超过43,000个真实世界的中国法律查询，这些查询都附有经过专家验证的肯定和否定回答。我们还设计了一种结构化的任务分解方法，将每个查询转化为一个包含实体、事件、意图和法律问题的法律元素图。此外，我们提出了JurisMA这一模块化多智能体框架，该框架支持动态路由、法规定位以及风格优化功能。结合这个元素图，该框架能够实现强大的上下文感知推理能力，有效捕捉法律事实、规范和程序逻辑之间的依赖关系。我们的系统在JurisCQAD上进行训练，并在精细化的LawBench平台上进行评估。结果表明，我们的系统在多个词汇和语义指标上均显著优于通用法律和法律领域的大语言模型，这充分体现了可解释性分解和模块化协作在Legal CQA中的优势。
