papers.title: Putting Captions to the Test: Evaluating Video Caption Quality through Multiple-Choice Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 测试字幕的效果：通过选择题方式评估视频字幕的质量
papers.authors: Zizhen Wang, Bo Feng, Zhengfeng Lai, Shiyu Li, Yang Lu, Meng Cao, Ping Huang, Xiaoming Simon Wang
papers.abstract: Evaluating video captioning remains a critical challenge for Visual Large Language Models (VLLMs). Existing metrics primarily rely on matching generated text against ground-truth references. This paradigm suffers from the “one-to-many” nature of video description, where high-quality captions are often penalized for lexical mismatches or valid shifts in visual focus. Furthermore, such assessments are typically one-dimensional, failing to provide a fine-grained analysis of caption quality. To address this, we redefine caption quality through the lens of information fidelity: A caption must maximize the coverage of salient visual information while ensuring strict factuality. We introduce CapQuiz, a novel reference-free benchmark that assesses captions based on their utility in answering human-verified, fine-grained, multiple-choice questions derived from the video. CapQuiz features a hierarchical taxonomy of 10 question types (spanning Descriptive and Inferential categories) across 24 diverse video domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CapQuiz correlates significantly better with human judgments than existing metrics and offers interpretable insights into model performance. We will release the benchmark to facilitate reproducible research.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估视频字幕对于视觉大语言模型来说仍然是一个重要的挑战。现有的评估方法主要依赖于将生成的文本与真实参考文本进行比对。但这种做法存在“一对多”的问题，即高质量的字幕往往因为词汇不匹配或视觉焦点的变化而受到惩罚。此外，这类评估通常是一维的，无法对字幕质量进行细致的分析。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了基于信息保真度的字幕质量评估方法：字幕必须能够在确保事实准确性的同时，最大限度地覆盖重要的视觉信息。我们引入了CapQuiz这一新的无参考基准测试，该测试通过评估字幕在回答由人类验证的、关于视频内容的详细选择题时的效用来评价字幕质量。CapQuiz包含10种问题类型的分层分类体系，涵盖了24个不同的视频领域。大量的实验表明，CapQuiz与人类判断之间的相关性明显优于现有的评估方法，并且能够为我们提供对模型性能的可解释性分析。我们将发布这个基准测试，以便促进可复制的研究工作。

papers.title: Subject-level Inference for Realistic Text Anonymization Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 针对真实文本去匿名化的主题级推理方法
papers.authors: Myeong Seok Oh, Dong-Yun Kim, Hanseok Oh, Chaean Kang, Joeun Kang, Xiaonan Wang, Hyunjung Park, Young Cheol Jung, Hansaem Kim
papers.abstract: Current text anonymization evaluation relies on span-based metrics that fail to capture what an adversary could actually infer, and assumes a single data subject, ignoring multi-subject scenarios. To address these limitations, we present SPIA (Subject-level PII Inference Assessment), the first benchmark that shifts the unit of evaluation from text spans to individuals, comprising 675 documents across legal and online domains with novel subject-level protection metrics. Extensive experiments show that even when over 90% of PII spans are masked, subject-level inference protection drops as low as 33%, leaving the majority of personal information recoverable through contextual inference. Furthermore, target-subject-focused anonymization leaves non-target subjects substantially more exposed than the target subject. We show that subject-level inference-based evaluation is essential for ensuring safe text anonymization in real-world settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的文本匿名化评估依赖于基于文本片段的度量标准，这些标准无法准确捕捉对手可能推断出什么信息，而且假设只有一个数据主体，忽略了多主体场景的情况。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了SPIA（主体级个人身份信息推断评估）这一基准测试。该测试将评估单位从文本片段转移到了个体层面，涵盖了法律领域和在线领域的675份文档，并采用了新颖的主体级保护指标。大量实验表明，即使有超过90%的个人身份信息被隐藏起来，主体级的推断保护程度仍只能达到33%，而大部分个人信息仍然可以通过上下文推理来恢复。此外，以目标主体为中心的匿名化处理会使非目标主体面临更大的风险。我们指出，基于主体级推断的评估对于确保现实世界中的文本匿名化过程的安全性至关重要。

papers.title: SceneAlign: Aligning Multimodal Reasoning to Scene Graphs in Complex Visual Scenes
papers.title_zh: SceneAlign：将多模态推理与复杂视觉场景中的场景图进行对齐
papers.authors: Chuhan Wang, Xintong Li, Jennifer Yuntong Zhang, Junda Wu, Chengkai Huang, Lina Yao, Julian McAuley, Jingbo Shang
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models often struggle with faithful reasoning in complex visual scenes, where intricate entities and relations require precise visual grounding at each step. This reasoning unfaithfulness frequently manifests as hallucinated entities, mis-grounded relations, skipped steps, and over-specified reasoning. Existing preference-based approaches, typically relying on textual perturbations or answer-conditioned rationales, fail to address this challenge as they allow models to exploit language priors to bypass visual grounding. To address this, we propose SceneAlign, a framework that leverages scene graphs as structured visual information to perform controllable structural interventions. By identifying reasoning-critical nodes and perturbing them through four targeted strategies that mimic typical grounding failures, SceneAlign constructs hard negative rationales that remain linguistically plausible but are grounded in inaccurate visual facts. These contrastive pairs are used in Direct Preference Optimization to steer models toward fine-grained, structure-faithful reasoning. Across seven visual reasoning benchmarks, SceneAlign consistently improves answer accuracy and reasoning faithfulness, highlighting the effectiveness of grounding-aware alignment for multimodal reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在复杂的视觉场景中往往难以进行可靠的推理，因为其中复杂的实体和关系需要在每个步骤中都进行精确的视觉定位。这种推理不准确性常常表现为幻觉性的实体、错误的关系定位、跳跃式的处理步骤以及过度具体的推理方式。现有的基于偏好的方法通常依赖于文本扰动或基于答案的推理机制，但这些方法无法有效解决这一挑战，因为它们允许模型利用语言先验知识来绕过视觉定位。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了SceneAlign框架。该框架利用场景图作为结构化的视觉信息，来进行可控的结构性干预。通过识别对推理至关重要的节点，并通过四种针对特定问题的策略对其进行扰动，以模拟典型的定位失败情况，SceneAlign能够构建出在语言上仍然合理但在视觉上定位不准确的结果。这些对比性结果被用于直接偏好优化算法中，以引导模型进行更细致、更可靠的推理。在七个视觉推理基准测试中，SceneAlign始终能够提高答案的准确性和推理的可靠性，这充分证明了注重视觉定位对齐的方法对于多模态推理是有效的。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Select Before Use: On the Importance of Reference Model Selection in Preference Alignment
papers.title_zh: 选择使用前：关于在偏好对齐中正确选择参考模型的重要性
papers.authors: Muyang Li, Runze Wu, Xiangyu Zhao, Bo Han, Daoyi Dong, Tongliang Liu
papers.abstract: The post-training stage of Large Language Models (LLMs) typically involves Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by preference alignment to ensure LLM to generate safe, helpful, and instruction-aligned content. The SFT model critically serves as both the initialization and reference model for subsequent preference alignment. However, an essential yet often neglected question is the optimal selection of the SFT checkpoint for this role. We show that checkpoint selection substantially affects final performance, and that the common practice of choosing the minimum validation-loss checkpoint often fails, due to a fundamental conflict between SFT’s focus on imitation and alignment’s goal of response discriminability. To this end, we propose RewardRank, a simple, effective, training-free metrics for estimating initial implicit alignment between reference model and preference objective. Empirical evidence suggests that, using our selected model as reference can gain up to 67.6% relative increase on length-controlled win rate on the popular Zephyr recipe comparing to baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在训练完成后的阶段，通常会进行有监督的微调，随后再进行偏好对齐处理，以确保模型能够生成安全、有用且符合指导要求的文本内容。有监督微调模型在后续偏好对齐过程中，既充当了初始化的角色，又提供了参考模型。然而，一个至关重要但常被忽视的问题就是如何选择合适的有监督微调检查点来承担这一角色。我们发现，检查点的选择对最终性能有着显著的影响；而通常采用的“选择验证损失最小的检查点”的做法往往是错误的，因为这与有监督微调注重模仿的目标与偏好对齐追求的反应可区分性之间存在根本矛盾。为此，我们提出了RewardRank这一简单有效的无训练过程的方法，用于估计参考模型与偏好目标之间的初始隐性对齐程度。实证结果表明，使用我们选择的模型作为参考，可以在流行的Zephyr食谱任务中，使长度可控的获胜率相对提高67.6%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Lost in Translation, and Found: Detecting and Interpreting Translation Effects
papers.title_zh: 《迷失在翻译之中》，以及“重新发现”：检测与解读翻译效果
papers.authors: Shira Wein, Anna Serbina, Jiyuan Ji, Nathan Wolf, Jason DeGraaff, Prajakta Kini, Maria Leonor Pacheco
papers.abstract: Translationese refers to the statistical patterns that distinguish translated texts from original texts, which are often subtle and imperceptible to human readers. When translated texts appear in either training or testing data, these patterns can negatively affect model performance or warp model evaluation. We approach the task of discerning whether a text was originally written in English or translated into English by fine-tuning contemporary foundation models at distinct item lengths and achieve state-of-the-art performance (94% Macro F1). Given that these linguistic cues are subtle and often imperceptible to humans, we analyze the features which enable our model’s high performance. Employing a suite of interpretability-based techniques, we find that: (1) our high accuracy is enabled by a collection of linguistic features, a number of which correspond with linguistic theories of translationese, and (2) pretrained neural models are adept at picking up these features without any fine-tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 翻译语现象指的是那些能够区分翻译文本与原始文本的统计特征，这些特征往往非常微妙，人类读者难以察觉。当翻译文本出现在训练或测试数据中时，这些特征可能会对模型性能产生负面影响，或者扭曲模型的评估结果。我们通过微调不同长度文本的基础模型，来识别一段文本是原本用英语写的还是被翻译成英语的，并取得了出色的性能（宏F1分数达到94%）。由于这些语言线索非常微妙，通常人类难以察觉，因此我们对那些能提升模型性能的特征进行了分析。通过使用一系列可解释性技术，我们发现：(1)我们的高准确率得益于一系列语言特征的集合，其中一些特征与翻译语现象的语言学理论相吻合；(2)预训练的神经网络模型能够在不进行任何微调的情况下捕捉到这些特征。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Isolation to Entanglement: When Do Interpretability Methods Identify and Disentangle Known Concepts?
papers.title_zh: 从孤立到交织：可解释性方法何时能够识别并理清那些已知的概念？
papers.authors: Aaron Mueller, Andrew Lee, Shruti Joshi, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Dhanya Sridhar, Patrik Reizinger
papers.abstract: A goal of interpretability is to recover disentangled representations of latent concepts (features) from the activations of neural networks. The quality of features is typically evaluated in isolation, and under implicit independence assumptions that may not hold in practice. Thus, it is unclear to what extent common featurization methods such as sparse autoencoders (SAEs) and probes disentangle one concept from another. We propose a multi-concept evaluation setting using concepts such as sentiment, domain, voice, and tense. We evaluate how well featurizers produce disentangled representations of each concept, observing that features are typically sensitive to only one concept, but also that concepts are distributed across many features. Then, we steer these features, measuring whether each concept is independently manipulable, and whether features interact. Even in idealized settings, steering a feature often affects many concepts, despite a near absence of interaction effects. These results suggest that correlational metrics are insufficient to establish steering selectivity, and that demonstrating that two features operate in separate spaces is insufficient to claim that they will be selective for one concept. These results underscore the importance of multi-concept evaluations in interpretability research.
papers.abstract_zh: 可解释性的目标是从神经网络的激活值中恢复出隐藏概念（特征）的清晰表示。通常，特征的品质是单独进行评估的，而且是在一些可能并不成立的隐式独立性假设下进行的。因此，目前尚不清楚诸如稀疏自编码器等常见的特征化方法在多大程度上能够将一个概念与另一个概念区分开来。我们提出了一种多概念评估框架，涉及情感、领域、声音和时态等概念。我们通过评估特征化方法对每个概念的表示效果来研究这个问题：我们发现，特征通常只对一个概念敏感，但各个概念又分布在多个特征上。接着，我们进一步对这些特征进行引导性处理，以判断每个概念是否可以被独立操控，以及这些特征之间是否存在相互作用。即使在理想化的情境下，对特征的引导往往会影响多个概念，尽管它们之间的相互作用效应几乎不存在。这些结果表明，相关性指标不足以证明某种特征具有选择性；同时，仅仅证明两个特征分别作用于不同的空间，也不足以说明它们会针对某个特定概念发挥作用。这些研究结果强调了在多概念评估方面进行可解释性研究的重要性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Paraphrasing as Zero-shot Translation with Feature-guided Diversity Enhancement
papers.title_zh: 以特征引导的多样性增强方法实现零样本翻译的改写方式
papers.authors: Ziyue Yan, Hongying Zan, Xinglin Lyu, Hongfei Xu
papers.abstract: Paraphrasing uses different words, sentence structures, or expressions to convey similar semantics. It is an effective training data augmentation method to improve low-resource Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. Existing studies normally leverage parallel corpora to construct parabanks, regarding the Machine Translation (MT) results of source sentences as the paraphrases of the corresponding target sentences. As MT models are usually trained on the same parallel corpus, translation of the training set may suffer from overfitting, which leads to less diverse paraphrases. Training paraphrasers on the parabank generated via MT may also suffer from the information loss issue, as the parabank is derived from the parallel corpora, and the knowledge inside the parabank is a subset of that inside the parallel corpora. In this paper, we train bidirectional Multilingual Neural Machine Translation (MNMT) on the bi-directional bilingual parallel corpus, and use the MNMT model directly as a paraphrasing model by asking it to generate “translations” of the input language. As some source tokens also appear in the translation in the parallel corpus, we introduce “copy”/“not-copy” tags to indicate the existence/non-existence of source tokens in the target translation during training, and use the “not-copy” tag to encourage paraphrasing during inference. Manual and automatic evaluation results show that our ParaMNMT method can generate paraphrases of higher semantic consistency, literal fluency and sentential diversity compared to existing parabanks and LLMs. Our data augmentation experiments verify the effectiveness of ParaMNMT on improving low-resource NLP tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 释义使用不同的词语、句子结构或表达方式来传达相似的语义。这是一种有效的训练数据增强方法，可用于改善低资源自然语言处理任务。现有的研究通常利用平行语料库来构建释义语料库，将源句子的机器翻译结果视为相应目标句子的释义。由于机器翻译模型通常是在相同的平行语料库上训练的，因此训练集的翻译可能会受到过拟合的影响，从而导致释义的多样性降低。在通过机器翻译生成的释义语料库上训练释义器时，还可能遇到信息丢失的问题，因为释义语料库是从平行语料库中衍生出来的，其内部的知识只是平行语料库内部知识的子集。在本文中，我们在一个双向双语平行语料库上训练了双向多语言神经机器翻译模型，并直接使用该模型作为释义模型，让其生成输入语言的“翻译”。由于一些源语言标记也会出现在平行语料库的翻译中，我们在训练过程中引入了“复制”/“非复制”标签来表示源语言标记在目标翻译中的存在与否，并利用“非复制”标签在推理过程中促进释义的生成。手动和自动评估结果表明，我们的ParaMNMT方法能够生成具有更高语义一致性、更流畅的措辞以及更多句子多样性的释义，相比现有的释义语料库和大语言模型，我们的方法表现更为出色。我们的数据增强实验验证了ParaMNMT在提升低资源自然语言处理任务方面的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VOYAGER: A Training Free Approach for Generating Diverse Datasets using LLMs
papers.title_zh: 旅行者：一种无需训练即可生成多样化数据集的方法，利用大语言模型实现
papers.authors: Avinash Amballa, Yashas Malur Saidutta, Chi-Heng Lin, Vivek Kulkarni, Srinivas Chappidi
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to generate synthetic datasets for the evaluation and training of downstream models. However, prior work has noted that such generated data lacks diversity. In this paper, we propose VOYAGER, a novel principled approach to generate diverse datasets. Our approach is iterative and directly optimizes a mathematical quantity that optimizes the diversity of the dataset using the machinery of determinantal point processes. Furthermore, our approach is training-free, applicable to closed-source models, and scalable. In addition to providing theoretical justification for the working of our method, we also demonstrate through comprehensive experiments that VOYAGER improves diversity by \mathbf{1.5}-\mathbf{3} times compared to popular baseline approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在生成用于下游模型评估与训练的合成数据集方面得到了广泛应用。然而，先前的研究指出，这类生成的数据缺乏多样性。在本文中，我们提出了VOYAGER这一新颖的方法，旨在生成具有丰富多样性的数据集。我们的方法采用迭代方式，通过行列式点过程的机制来优化数据集的多样性。此外，该方法无需进行训练过程，适用于开源模型，并且具有可扩展性。除了为我们的方法提供理论支持外，我们还通过全面的实验证明，与常见的基准方法相比，VOYAGER能够提升数据多样性的水平，提升幅度可达1.5到3倍。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CaseFacts: A Benchmark for Legal Fact-Checking and Precedent Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 案例事实：法律事实核查与判例检索的基准
papers.authors: Akshith Reddy Putta, Jacob Devasier, Chengkai Li
papers.abstract: Automated Fact-Checking has largely focused on verifying general knowledge against static corpora, overlooking high-stakes domains like law where truth is evolving and technically complex. We introduce CaseFacts, a benchmark for verifying colloquial legal claims against U.S. Supreme Court precedents. Unlike existing resources that map formal texts to formal texts, CaseFacts challenges systems to bridge the semantic gap between layperson assertions and technical jurisprudence while accounting for temporal validity. The dataset consists of 6,294 claims categorized as Supported, Refuted, or Overruled. We construct this benchmark using a multi-stage pipeline that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to synthesize claims from expert case summaries, employing a novel semantic similarity heuristic to efficiently identify and verify complex legal overrulings. Experiments with state-of-the-art LLMs reveal that the task remains challenging; notably, augmenting models with unrestricted web search degrades performance compared to closed-book baselines due to the retrieval of noisy, non-authoritative precedents. We release CaseFacts to spur research into legal fact verification systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化事实核查主要侧重于对静态语料库中的常识进行验证，而忽视了像法律这样高风险领域——在这些领域中，真理是不断演变且技术复杂的。我们提出了CaseFacts这一基准测试工具，用于验证口语化的法律主张与美国最高法院的判例是否一致。与那些将正式文本相互映射的现有工具不同，CaseFacts挑战系统跨越普通民众的主张与技术性法律判决之间的语义鸿沟，同时考虑其时间有效性。该数据集包含6,294条主张，这些主张被分类为“得到支持”、“被驳回”或“被推翻”。我们采用多阶段流程构建这一基准测试工具，利用大语言模型从专家案例摘要中合成主张，并采用一种创新的语义相似性启发式方法来高效识别与验证复杂的法律裁决。实验表明，即使使用最先进的语言模型，这项任务仍然具有挑战性；值得注意的是，如果模型能够访问不受限制的网络资源，那么其性能会下降，因为可能会检索到噪声大、非权威性的判例。我们发布CaseFacts的目的是推动法律事实验证系统的研究发展。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SpecAgent: A Speculative Retrieval and Forecasting Agent for Code Completion
papers.title_zh: SpecAgent：一种用于代码补全的推测式检索与预测代理程序
papers.authors: George Ma, Anurag Koul, Qi Chen, Yawen Wu, Sachit Kuhar, Yu Yu, Aritra Sengupta, Varun Kumar, Murali Krishna Ramanathan
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at code-related tasks but often struggle in realistic software repositories, where project-specific APIs and cross-file dependencies are crucial. Retrieval-augmented methods mitigate this by injecting repository context at inference time. Low inference time latency budget either affects retrieval quality or the added latency impacts user experience adversely. We address this limitation with SpecAgent, an agent that enhances both latency and code-generation quality by proactively exploring repository files during indexing and constructing speculative context that anticipates future edits in each file. This indexing-time asynchrony allows thorough context computation masking latency and the speculative nature of the context improves code-generation quality. Additionally, we identify the problem of future context leakage in existing benchmarks, which can inflate reported performance. To address this, we construct a synthetic, leakage-free benchmark that enables a more realistic evaluation of our agent against baselines. Experiments show that SpecAgent consistently achieves absolute gains of 9–11% (48–58% relative) compared to the best-performing baselines, while significantly reducing inference latency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在与代码相关的任务上表现出色，但在现实的软件仓库中往往面临挑战，因为项目中特定的API和跨文件依赖关系至关重要。检索增强方法通过在推理过程中注入仓库上下文来缓解这个问题。较低的推理时间延迟预算要么会影响检索质量，要么额外的延迟会对用户体验产生负面影响。我们通过SpecAgent解决了这一限制问题——该代理在索引过程中主动探索仓库文件，并构建能够预测未来文件编辑情况的推测性上下文，从而提升了延迟和代码生成质量。这种在索引过程中的异步处理方式使得上下文计算能够充分进行，而推测性的上下文结构则提高了代码生成的质量。此外，我们发现现有基准测试中存在未来上下文泄露的问题，这可能会夸大报告的性能表现。为了应对这一问题，我们构建了一个无泄漏的仿真基准测试，以便更真实地评估我们的代理与基准模型的性能对比。实验表明，与表现最佳的基准模型相比，SpecAgent始终能实现9-11%的绝对性能提升（相对提升幅度为48-58%），同时显著降低了推理延迟。

papers.title: From Inheritance to Saturation: Disentangling the Evolution of Visual Redundancy for Architecture-Aware MLLM Inference Acceleration
papers.title_zh: 从继承到饱和：解析视觉冗余在面向建筑的MLLM推理加速中的演变机制
papers.authors: Jiaqi Shi, Xulong Zhang, Yuechan Li, Xiaoyang Qu, Jianzong Wang
papers.abstract: High-resolution Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face prohibitive computational costs during inference due to the explosion of visual tokens. Existing acceleration strategies, such as token pruning or layer sparsity, suffer from severe “backbone dependency”, performing well on Vicuna or Mistral architectures (e.g., LLaVA) but causing significant performance degradation when transferred to architectures like Qwen. To address this, we leverage truncated matrix entropy to uncover a universal three-stage inference lifecycle, decoupling visual redundancy into universal Intrinsic Visual Redundancy (IVR) and architecture-dependent Secondary Saturation Redundancy (SSR). Guided by this insight, we propose HalfV, a framework that first mitigates IVR via a unified pruning strategy and then adaptively handles SSR based on its specific manifestation. Experiments demonstrate that HalfV achieves superior efficiency-performance trade-offs across diverse backbones. Notably, on Qwen25-VL, it retains 96.8% performance at a 4.1\times FLOPs speedup, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/civilizwa/HalfV.
papers.abstract_zh: 高分辨率多模态大语言模型在推理过程中面临着极高的计算成本，这主要是由于视觉数据的爆炸式增长导致的。现有的加速策略，如令牌剪枝或层稀疏化，都存在严重的“主干依赖”问题——它们在Vicuna或Mistral架构上表现良好，但在转移到Qwen这样的架构时会导致性能显著下降。为了解决这一问题，我们采用了截断矩阵熵技术，从而揭示了一个通用的三阶段推理生命周期。通过将视觉冗余分解为通用的内在视觉冗余和依赖于特定架构的次要饱和冗余，我们可以更好地处理这些冗余问题。基于这一洞察，我们提出了HalfV框架。该框架首先通过统一的剪枝策略来减轻内在视觉冗余带来的问题，然后根据具体情况自适应地处理次要饱和冗余。实验表明，HalfV在不同架构上都能实现高效的性能优化。值得注意的是，在Qwen25-VL上，它能够在4.1倍的浮点运算次数提升下保持96.8%的性能水平，远远优于现有的最佳基线算法。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/civilizwa/HalfV下载。

papers.title: Your Reasoning Model is Secretly a Reward Model - Optimization-Free Verification from Experience
papers.title_zh: 你的推理模型实际上是一种奖励机制——一种无需优化的经验验证方法
papers.authors: Zhenwen Liang, Ruosen Li, Yujun Zhou, Linfeng Song, Dian Yu, Xinya Du, Haitao Mi, Dong Yu
papers.abstract: Assessing the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs becomes especially challenging in high-branching settings, where a single prompt yields many plausible candidates. Existing verifiers typically operate on the surface text (e.g., reward models, LLM judges, majority voting) or on confidence proxies derived from token probabilities, both of which can be brittle: the former can be influenced by stylistic artifacts, while the latter is often miscalibrated. In this paper, we study a third source of information—the model’s hidden states—for binary correctness verification in tasks with a reliable success/failure signal (e.g., deterministic checkers or reference-grounded answers). We find that correct and incorrect solutions exhibit measurable geometric differences in their hidden-state trajectories. To isolate this signal with minimal modeling assumptions, we introduce Clue (Clustering and Experience-based Verification), a training-free, non-parametric verifier. Clue summarizes each reasoning trace by an activation delta—the difference between hidden states at the start and end of the explicit reasoning span—and predicts correctness by comparing this delta to two class centroids computed from labeled experience. Across math (AIME 24/25), scientific QA (GPQA), and a multi-domain benchmark (WebInstruct-verified), Clue improves selection and reranking, with particularly strong gains on smaller or less-calibrated models. For example, on AIME 24 with a 1.5B model, Clue raises accuracy from 56.7% (majority@64) to 70.0% (top-maj@16).
papers.abstract_zh: 在分支复杂的场景中评估大语言模型（LLM）输出的质量尤为困难，因为同一个提示可能会产生许多合理的候选答案。现有的验证方法通常基于表面文本进行判断（例如奖励模型、LLM评判器、多数投票），或者基于词元概率得出的置信度代理进行判断，但这两种方法都存在局限性：表面文本可能受到风格因素的影响，而置信度代理的校准往往不准确。在本文中，我们研究了第三种信息来源——模型的隐藏状态，用于具有可靠成功/失败信号的任务中的二元正确性验证（例如确定性检查器或基于参考的答案）。我们发现，正确和错误的解决方案在隐藏状态轨迹上表现出可测量的几何差异。为了在最小的建模假设下分离出这一信号，我们提出了Clue这一无需训练的、非参数化的验证方法。Clue通过激活差来总结每个推理过程——即显式推理过程中隐藏状态起始值与结束值之间的差值——并通过将该差值与从标记经验中计算出的两个类中心进行比较来预测正确性。在数学竞赛AIME 24/25、科学问答GPQA以及多领域基准测试WebInstruct-verified中，Clue在选择和重新排序方面表现良好，尤其是在对较小或校准不足的模型时效果尤为显著。例如，在AIME 24的测试中，使用1.5B参数的模型时，Clue将准确率从56.7%（majority@64）提升到了70.0%（top-maj@16）。

papers.title: What Do LLMs Learn First? Asymmetric Learning Dynamics of Input Complexity and Output Ambiguity in Preference Alignment
papers.title_zh: LLM首先会学习什么呢？输入复杂性与输出歧义性在偏好对齐中的非对称学习机制
papers.authors: Mengyang Li, Jingwen Wang, Pinlong Zhao
papers.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a standard approach for aligning large language models with human preferences, yet existing methods treat all preference pairs uniformly during training. We identify two distinct sources of learning difficulty: Input Complexity (IC), capturing prompt understanding challenges, and Output Ambiguity (OA), measuring preference discrimination difficulty. Through systematic analysis, we demonstrate that these dimensions induce asymmetric learning dynamics, with IC-related competencies developing rapidly in early training while OA-related competencies emerge more gradually. Building on this observation, we propose DECOPO, a training framework that maintains separate, adaptive pacing schedules for each dimension. Experiments on UltraFeedback show that DECOPO achieves 42.3% length-controlled win rate on AlpacaEval 2.0 and 7.66 on MT-Bench, outperforming curriculum baselines by 2.1% and 0.21 points respectively, while matching full-data baseline performance with only 75% of training samples.
papers.abstract_zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为将大语言模型与人类偏好对齐的标准方法。然而，现有的方法在训练过程中对所有偏好对都采用相同的处理方式。我们发现了两个导致学习困难的不同因素：输入复杂性（IC），它涉及到提示理解方面的挑战；以及输出歧义性（OA），它衡量了偏好区分的难度。通过系统的分析，我们发现这两个因素会引发不同的学习动态：与输入复杂性相关的能力在训练初期就能迅速发展，而与输出歧义性相关的能力则发展得更为缓慢。基于这一观察，我们提出了DECOPO这一训练框架，该框架为每个维度都制定了独立的、可调节的训练节奏。在UltraFeedback上的实验表明，DECOPO在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上的长度控制胜率达到 42.3%，在 MT-Bench 上的得分达到 7.66。与传统的基于课程的学习方法相比，DECOPO 分别提高了 2.1% 和 0.21 分，同时其性能与使用全部训练样本的基线相当，且所需训练样本数量仅为基准方法的75%。

papers.title: Multi-Agent-as-Judge: Aligning LLM-Agent-Based Automated Evaluation with Multi-Dimensional Human Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 多智能体作为评判者：将基于大语言模型的智能体自动化评估方法与多维人类评估方式相结合
papers.authors: Jiaju Chen, Yuxuan Lu, Xiaojie Wang, Huimin Zeng, Jing Huang, Jiri Gesi, Ying Xu, Bingsheng Yao, Dakuo Wang
papers.abstract: Nearly all human work is collaborative; thus, the evaluation of real-world NLP applications often requires multiple dimensions that align with diverse human perspectives. As real human evaluator resources are often scarce and costly, the emerging “LLM-as-a-judge” paradigm sheds light on a promising approach to leverage LLM agents to believably simulate human evaluators. Yet, to date, existing LLM-as-a-judge approaches face two limitations: persona descriptions of agents are often arbitrarily designed, and the frameworks are not generalizable to other tasks. To address these challenges, we propose MAJ-EVAL, a Multi-Agent-as-Judge evaluation framework that can automatically construct multiple evaluator personas with distinct dimensions from relevant text documents (e.g., research papers), instantiate LLM agents with the personas, and engage in-group debates with multi-agents to generate multi-dimensional feedback. Our evaluation experiments in both the educational and medical domains demonstrate that MAJ-EVAL can generate evaluation results that better align with human experts’ ratings compared with conventional automated evaluation metrics and existing LLM-as-a-judge methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 几乎所有人类工作都是需要协作完成的；因此，对现实世界中的自然语言处理应用的评估通常需要多个维度的考量，这些维度要能够反映不同人类的视角。由于真实的人类评估人员往往稀缺且成本高昂，所以“利用大语言模型作为评估者”这一新方法为利用大语言模型代理来模拟人类评估者提供了一种有前景的解决方案。不过，迄今为止，现有的“利用大语言模型作为评估者”的方法存在两个局限性：模型的角色描述往往被随意设计，而且这些框架无法适用于其他任务。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了MAJ-EVAL这一多智能体评估框架。该框架能够自动从相关的文本文档中构建出具有不同维度的多个评估者角色，然后让大语言模型代理扮演这些角色，并通过与多个代理进行组内辩论来生成多维度的反馈。我们在教育和医疗领域的评估实验表明，MAJ-EVAL所生成的评估结果比传统的自动化评估指标以及现有的“利用大语言模型作为评估者”的方法更为合理，更符合人类专家的评分标准。

papers.title: OpenRubrics: Towards Scalable Synthetic Rubric Generation for Reward Modeling and LLM Alignment
papers.title_zh: OpenRubrics：实现可扩展的合成评分标准生成方法，用于奖励模型优化与大型语言模型的适配
papers.authors: Tianci Liu, Ran Xu, Tony Yu, Ilgee Hong, Carl Yang, Tuo Zhao, Haoyu Wang
papers.abstract: Reward modeling lies at the core of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), yet most existing reward models rely on scalar or pairwise judgments that fail to capture the multifaceted nature of human preferences. Recent studies have explored rubrics-as-rewards (RaR) that uses structured criteria to capture multiple dimensions of response quality. However, producing rubrics that are both reliable and scalable remains a key challenge. In this work, we introduce OpenRubrics, a diverse, large-scale collection of (prompt, rubric) pairs for training rubric-generation and rubric-based reward models. To elicit discriminative and comprehensive evaluation signals, we introduce Contrastive Rubric Generation (CRG), which derives both hard rules (explicit constraints) and principles (implicit qualities) by contrasting preferred and rejected responses. We further remove noisy rubrics via preserving preference–label consistency. Across multiple reward-modeling benchmarks, our rubric-based reward model, Rubric-RM, surpasses strong size-matched baselines by 8.4%. These gains transfer to policy models on instruction-following and biomedical benchmarks.The model weights and datasets are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/OpenRubrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 奖励建模是基于人类反馈的强化学习的核心技术，但现有的大多数奖励模型都依赖于标量或成对判断，这无法捕捉人类偏好的多维度特性。最近的研究提出了基于评分标准作为奖励的方法（RaR），该方法利用结构化标准来涵盖响应的多个维度。然而，生成既可靠又可扩展的评分标准仍然是一个关键挑战。在这项工作中，我们引入了OpenRubrics，这是一个包含大量（提示语、评分标准）对的大规模数据集，用于训练基于评分标准的奖励模型。为了获得具有区分性和全面性的评估信号，我们提出了对比性评分标准生成方法（CRG），该方法通过对比受欢迎和不受欢迎的响应，从而得出硬规则（明确的约束条件）和原则（隐含的品质）。此外，我们还通过保持偏好与标签的一致性来消除噪声评分标准。在多个奖励建模基准测试中，我们的基于评分标准的奖励模型Rubric-RM在性能上优于那些规模相当的强大基线模型，其性能提升了8.4%。这些优势也体现在政策模型的指令遵循和生物医学基准测试上。该模型的权重和数据集可以在https://huggingface.co/OpenRubrics上获取。

papers.title: Challenging the Boundaries of Reasoning: An Olympiad-Level Math Benchmark for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 挑战推理的边界：一项适用于大型语言模型的奥林匹克级数学挑战
papers.authors: Haoxiang Sun, Yingqian Min, Zhipeng Chen, Xin Zhao, Ji-Rong Wen
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of large reasoning models has saturated existing math benchmarks, underscoring the urgent need for more challenging evaluation frameworks. To address this, we introduce OlymMATH, a rigorously curated, Olympiad-level math benchmark comprising 350 problems, each with parallel English and Chinese versions. OlymMATH is the first benchmark to unify dual evaluation paradigms within a single suite: (1) natural language evaluation through OlymMATH-EASY and OlymMATH-HARD, comprising 200 computational problems with numerical answers for objective rule-based assessment, and (2) formal verification through OlymMATH-LEAN, offering 150 problems formalized in Lean 4 for rigorous process-level evaluation. All problems are manually sourced from printed publications to minimize data contamination, verified by experts, and span four core domains. Extensive experiments reveal the benchmark’s significant challenge, and our analysis also uncovers consistent performance gaps between languages and identifies cases where models employ heuristic “guessing” rather than rigorous reasoning. To further support community research, we release 582k+ reasoning trajectories, a visualization tool, and expert solutions at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/OlymMATH.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型的快速发展已经使现有的数学测试基准变得饱和，这凸显了需要更具有挑战性的评估框架的迫切需求。为了应对这一挑战，我们推出了OlymMATH——一个经过严格筛选的、符合奥林匹克竞赛水平的数学测试基准。该基准包含350道题目，每道题目都有英文和中文版本。OlymMATH是首个在单一测试套件中统一两种评估方式的基准：第一种是通过OlymMATH-EASY和OlymMATH-HARD进行的自然语言评估，其中包含200道带有数值答案的计算题，用于基于规则的客观评估；第二种是通过OlymMATH-LEAN进行的形式化验证，该工具提供了150道用Lean 4形式化的题目，用于进行严格的过程级评估。所有题目都来自印刷出版物，以尽量减少数据污染，并由专家进行验证，这些题目涵盖了四个核心领域。大量的实验表明，该基准存在显著的挑战性，我们的分析还发现了不同语言之间性能上的明显差异，并指出了模型使用启发式“猜测”而非严谨推理的情况。为了进一步支持社区的研究工作，我们在https://github.com/RUCAIBox/OlymMATH上发布了58.2万条推理轨迹、一个可视化工具以及专家解决方案。

papers.title: LENS: LLM-Enabled Narrative Synthesis for Mental Health by Aligning Multimodal Sensing with Language Models
papers.title_zh: 镜头：通过整合多模态感知技术与语言模型，实现用于心理健康领域的LLM驱动叙事合成技术
papers.authors: Wenxuan Xu, Arvind Pillai, Subigya Nepal, Amanda C. Collins, Daniel M Mackin, Michael V. Heinz, Tess Z Griffin, Nicholas C. Jacobson, Andrew Campbell
papers.abstract: Multimodal health sensing offers rich behavioral signals for assessing mental health, yet translating these numerical time-series measurements into natural language remains challenging. Current LLMs cannot natively ingest long-duration sensor streams, and paired sensor–text datasets are scarce. To address these challenges, we introduce LENS, a framework that aligns multimodal sensing data with language models to generate clinically grounded mental-health narratives. LENS first constructs a large-scale dataset by transforming Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA) responses related to depression and anxiety symptoms into natural-language descriptions, yielding over 100,000 sensor–text QA pairs from 258 participants. To enable native time-series integration, we train a patch-level encoder that projects raw sensor signals directly into an LLM’s representation space. Our results show that LENS outperforms strong baselines on standard NLP metrics and task-specific measures of symptom-severity accuracy. A user study with 13 mental-health professionals further indicates that LENS-produced narratives are comprehensive and clinically meaningful. Ultimately, our approach advances LLMs as interfaces for health sensing, providing a scalable path toward models that can reason over raw behavioral signals and support downstream clinical decision-making.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态健康感知能够提供丰富的行为数据以评估心理健康状况，然而将这些数值时间序列数据转化为自然语言仍然具有挑战性。目前的大语言模型无法原生处理长时间的传感器数据，而且相关的传感器-文本数据集也非常稀缺。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了LENS框架。该框架将多模态感知数据与语言模型相结合，从而生成具有临床意义的心理健康描述。LENS首先通过将与抑郁和焦虑症状相关的生态瞬时评估反应转化为自然语言描述，构建了一个大规模的数据集，共收集了来自258名参与者的超过100,000对传感器-文本问答对。为了实现对时间序列数据的原生集成，我们训练了一个补丁级编码器，能够将原始传感器信号直接映射到语言模型的表示空间中。我们的结果表明，LENS在标准的自然语言处理指标以及针对症状严重程度的任务特定评估中均优于其他强大的基线模型。一项针对13名心理健康专业人士的用户研究进一步表明，LENS生成的描述内容全面且具有临床意义。总的来说，我们的方法提升了语言模型作为健康感知界面的能力，为开发能够基于原始行为信号进行推理并支持后续临床决策的模型提供了可扩展的路径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FedProxy: Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Proxy SLMs and Heterogeneity-Aware Fusion
papers.title_zh: FedProxy：通过代理式语义模型与考虑异构性的融合技术，实现对大型语言模型的联合微调
papers.authors: Tao Fan, Guoqiang Ma, Yuanfeng Song, Lixin Fan, Kai Chen, Qiang Yang
papers.abstract: Federated fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs) is obstructed by a trilemma of challenges: protecting LLMs intellectual property (IP), ensuring client privacy, and mitigating performance loss on heterogeneous data. Existing methods like Offsite-Tuning (OT) secure the LLMs IP by having clients train only lightweight adapters, yet our analysis reveals they suffer from a fundamental performance bottleneck, leaving a significant gap compared to centralized training. To bridge this gap, we introduce FedProxy, a new federated adaptation framework. FedProxy replaces weak adapters with a unified, powerful Proxy Small Language Model (SLM), compressed from the proprietary LLM, to serve as a high-fidelity surrogate for collaborative fine-tuning. Our framework systematically resolves the trilemma through a three-stage architecture: (i) Efficient Representation via server-guided compression to create a resource-friendly proxy; (ii) Robust Optimization through an interference-mitigating aggregation strategy to handle data heterogeneity; and (iii) Effortless Fusion via a training-free “plug-in” mechanism to integrate learned knowledge back into the LLM. Experiments show FedProxy significantly outperforms OT methods and approaches centralized performance, establishing a new benchmark for secure and high-performance federated LLM adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦式的大语言模型微调面临着三大挑战：保护模型的知识产权、确保用户隐私安全，以及减轻在异构数据上的性能损失。现有的方法如离线训练技术，通过让客户仅训练轻量级适配器来保护模型的知识产权，但我们的分析表明，这种方法的性能存在根本瓶颈，与集中式训练相比仍有显著差距。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了FedProxy这一新的联邦式适应框架。FedProxy用从专有语言模型中压缩出来的统一且强大的代理小型语言模型来替代弱适配器，作为协作微调的高保真替代品。我们的框架通过三阶段架构系统地解决了这三个挑战：(i) 通过服务器引导的压缩技术创建资源友好的代理模型；(ii) 通过干扰抑制聚合策略实现稳健的优化，以应对数据异质性问题；(iii) 通过无需训练的“插件”机制实现知识的高效融合，将学习到的知识重新整合到语言模型中。实验结果表明，FedProxy在性能上显著优于离线训练方法和集中式训练方式，为安全且高效的联邦式语言模型适应提供了新的基准。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DiZiNER: Disagreement-guided Instruction Refinement via Simulating Pilot Annotation for Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition
papers.title_zh: DiZiNER：通过模拟引导注释来改进指令执行效果，从而实现零样本命名实体识别技术
papers.authors: Siun Kim, Hyung-Jin Yoon
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced information extraction (IE) by enabling zero-shot and few-shot named entity recognition (NER), yet their generative outputs still show persistent and systematic errors. Despite progress through instruction fine-tuning, zero-shot NER still lags far behind supervised systems. These recurring errors mirror inconsistencies observed in early-stage human annotation processes that resolve disagreements through pilot annotation. Motivated by this analogy, we introduce DiZiNER (Disagreement-guided Instruction Refinement via Pilot Annotation Simulation for Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition), a framework that simulates the pilot annotation process, employing LLMs to act as both annotators and supervisors. Multiple heterogeneous LLMs annotate shared texts, and a supervisor model analyzes inter-model disagreements to refine task instructions. Across 18 benchmarks, DiZiNER achieves zero-shot SOTA results on 14 datasets, improving prior bests by +8.0 F1 and reducing the zero-shot to supervised gap by over +11 points. It also consistently outperforms its supervisor, GPT-5 mini, indicating that improvements stem from disagreement-guided instruction refinement rather than model capacity. Pairwise agreement between models shows a strong correlation with NER performance, further supporting this finding.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过实现零样本和少量样本命名实体识别功能，显著提升了信息提取能力。然而，它们的生成输出仍然存在持续且系统性的错误。尽管通过指令微调取得了一些进展，但零样本命名实体识别的性能仍然远远落后于有监督的识别方法。这些反复出现的错误与早期人类注释过程中发现的不一致现象类似，人类会通过试点注释来解决分歧。基于这一类比，我们提出了DiZiNER框架——该框架模拟了试点注释过程，利用大语言模型同时担任注释者和监督者。多个异构的大语言模型对共享文本进行注释，而监督模型则分析不同模型之间的分歧，以改进任务指令。在18个基准测试中，DiZiNER在14个数据集上实现了零样本最佳性能，比之前的最佳成绩提高了8.0 F1分数，并将零样本与有监督方法的差距缩小了超过11个百分点。此外，DiZiNER的表现始终优于其监督模型GPT-5 mini，这表明改进效果主要来自基于分歧的指令优化，而非模型能力的提升。模型之间的成对一致性分析与命名实体识别性能之间存在很强的相关性，这进一步支持了我们的发现。

papers.title: A Data-Centric Approach to Generalizable Speech Deepfake Detection
papers.title_zh: 一种以数据为中心的方法，用于实现可泛化的语音深度伪造检测
papers.authors: Wen Huang, Yuchen Mao, Yanmin Qian
papers.abstract: Achieving robust generalization in speech deepfake detection (SDD) remains a primary challenge, as models often fail to detect unseen forgery methods. While research has focused on model-centric and algorithm-centric solutions, the impact of data composition is often underexplored. This paper proposes a data-centric approach, analyzing the SDD data landscape from two practical perspectives: constructing a single dataset and aggregating multiple datasets. To address the first perspective, we conduct a large-scale empirical study to characterize the data scaling laws for SDD, quantifying the impact of source and generator diversity. To address the second, we propose the Diversity-Optimized Sampling Strategy (DOSS), a principled framework for mixing heterogeneous data with two implementations: DOSS-Select (pruning) and DOSS-Weight (re-weighting). Our experiments show that DOSS-Select outperforms the naive aggregation baseline while using only 3% of the total available data. Furthermore, our final model, trained on a 12k-hour curated data pool using the optimal DOSS-Weight strategy, achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming large-scale baselines with greater data and model efficiency on both public benchmarks and a new challenge set of various commercial APIs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在语音深度伪造检测中实现强大的泛化能力仍然是一个主要挑战，因为模型往往无法检测到未见过的伪造方法。虽然相关研究主要集中在以模型为中心和算法为中心的解决方案上，但数据组合的影响却常常被忽视。本文提出了一种以数据为中心的方法，从两个实际角度分析深度伪造检测的データ场景：构建单一数据集以及合并多个数据集。针对第一个角度，我们进行了大规模实证研究，以了解深度伪造检测的データ缩放规律，并量化了源数据和生成器多样性对检测结果的影响。针对第二个角度，我们提出了“多样性优化采样策略”（DOSS），这是一种混合异构数据的原则性框架，包含两种实现方式：DOSS-Select（剪枝）和DOSS-Weight（重新加权）。我们的实验表明，仅使用总可用数据的3%时，DOSS-Select的表现优于简单的聚合方法。此外，我们在12万小时的精选数据上进行训练，并使用最优的DOSS-Weight策略，最终得到的模型在性能和效率方面均达到了顶尖水平，无论是在公共基准测试还是新的商业API挑战集上，都超越了大规模基线模型。

papers.title: Free Energy-Driven Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Advantage Shaping for Unsupervised Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 基于自由能量驱动的强化学习技术，结合自适应优势塑造机制，用于大型语言模型中的无监督推理任务
papers.authors: Yiming Huang, Zhenbo Shi, Xin-Cheng Wen, Jichuan Zeng, Cuiyun Gao, Peiyi Han, Chuanyi Liu
papers.abstract: Unsupervised reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling self-improvement in large language models (LLMs). However, existing unsupervised RL-based methods often lack the capacity to adapt to the model’s evolving reasoning capabilities during training. Therefore, these methods can misdirect policy optimization in the absence of ground-truth supervision. To address this issue, we introduce FREIA, a novel RL-based algorithm built on two key innovations: (1) Free Energy-Driven Reward (FER) adapts rewards to balance consensus and exploration based on the Free Energy Principle. (2) Adaptive Advantage Shaping (AAS) adaptively adjusts learning signals based on the statistical characteristics of sampled rewards. Empirical evaluations on nine datasets across three reasoning tasks showcase that FREIA outperforms other unsupervised RL-based baselines. Notably, in mathematical reasoning tasks, FREIA surpasses other methods by an average of 0.5 to 3.5 points in Pass@1 using the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B model.
papers.abstract_zh: 无监督强化学习已成为实现大语言模型自我改进的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的无监督强化学习方法往往缺乏在训练过程中适应模型不断发展的推理能力的能力。因此，在没有真实监督的情况下，这些方法可能会误导策略优化过程。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了FREIA这一基于强化学习的新型算法，该算法基于两个关键创新点：(1)自由能驱动奖励机制能够根据自由能原则调整奖励，以平衡共识与探索；(2)自适应优势塑形技术能够根据采样奖励的统计特性自适应调整学习信号。在三个推理任务上的九个数据集上的实证评估表明，FREIA在其他无监督强化学习基线上表现更优。值得注意的是，在数学推理任务中，使用DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B模型时，FREIA在Pass@1指标上平均比其他方法高出0.5到3.5分。

papers.title: PaperRegister: Boosting Flexible-grained Paper Search via Hierarchical Register Indexing
papers.title_zh: PaperRegister：通过分层索引技术提升灵活分级论文搜索能力
papers.authors: Zhuoqun Li, Xuanang Chen, Hongyu Lin, Yaojie Lu, Xianpei Han, Shanshan Jiang, Bin Dong, Le Sun
papers.abstract: As researchers delve more deeply into their work, paper search requirements may become more flexible, sometimes involving specific details such as module configuration rather than being limited to coarse-grained topics. However, previous paper search systems are unable to meet these flexible-grained requirements, as previous systems mainly collect paper abstract to construct corpus index, which lacks detailed information to support retrieval by some finer-grained queries. In this work, we propose PaperRegister, which transforms traditional abstract-based index into a hierarchical index tree, thereby supporting queries at flexible granularity. Experiments on paper search tasks across a range of granularity demonstrate that PaperRegister achieves the SOTA performance, and particularly excels in the fine-grained scenarios, highlighting good potential as an effective solution for flexible-grained paper search in real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着研究人员对研究工作进行更深入的探索，论文搜索的要求可能会变得更加灵活。有时，搜索需求会涉及到具体的细节，比如模块配置等，而不再局限于宏观层面的主题。然而，现有的论文搜索系统无法满足这种灵活的搜索需求，因为这些系统主要收集论文摘要来构建索引，而这些摘要缺乏支持更细粒度查询的详细信息。在这项研究中，我们提出了PaperRegister这一解决方案。它可以将传统的基于摘要的索引转换为分层索引结构，从而支持不同粒度的查询。通过在不同粒度下进行论文搜索的测试表明，PaperRegister取得了目前最佳的搜索性能，尤其是在处理细粒度查询时表现尤为出色。这充分证明了它作为现实应用中灵活搜索论文的解决方案具有巨大的潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ETR: Entropy Trend Reward for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ETR：用于高效思维链推理的熵趋势奖励机制
papers.authors: Xuan Xiong, Huan Liu, Li Gu, Zhixiang Chi, Yue Qiu, Yuanhao YU, Yang Wang
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves large language model performance on complex tasks, but often produces excessively long and inefficient reasoning traces. Existing methods shorten CoTs using length penalties or global entropy reduction, implicitly assuming that low uncertainty is desirable throughout reasoning. We show instead that reasoning efficiency is governed by the trajectory of uncertainty. CoTs with dominant downward entropy trends are substantially shorter. Motivated by this insight, we propose Entropy Trend Reward (ETR), a trajectory-aware objective that encourages progressive uncertainty reduction while allowing limited local exploration. We integrate ETR into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and evaluate it across multiple reasoning models and challenging benchmarks. ETR consistently achieves a superior accuracy–efficiency trade-off, improving DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B by +9.9% accuracy while reducing CoT length by 67% across four benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 上下文推理能够提升大语言模型在复杂任务上的性能，但往往会导致过于冗长且效率不高的推理过程。现有的方法通过长度惩罚或全局熵降低来缩短推理过程，这隐含着一种假设：在整个推理过程中，低不确定性是最理想的。然而，我们发现推理效率实际上受不确定性的变化轨迹所控制。那些不确定性呈下降趋势的推理过程要短得多。基于这一发现，我们提出了熵趋势奖励机制，这是一种注重推理过程轨迹的目标函数，它能够在允许有限局部探索的同时，促进不确定性的逐步降低。我们将熵趋势奖励机制整合到群体相对策略优化模型中，并在多种推理模型和具有挑战性的基准测试中进行了评估。结果表明，熵趋势奖励机制始终能够实现更高的准确率与效率之间的平衡：在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B模型中，准确率提升了9.9%，而推理过程的时长则减少了67%。

papers.title: All Changes May Have Invariant Principles: Improving Ever-Shifting Harmful Meme Detection via Design Concept Reproduction
papers.title_zh: 所有变化都可能遵循某种不变原则：通过设计概念的复制来提升对不断演变的恶意模因的识别能力
papers.authors: Ziyou Jiang, Mingyang Li, Junjie Wang, Yuekai Huang, Jie Huang, Zhiyuan Chang, Zhaoyang Li, Qing Wang
papers.abstract: Harmful memes are ever-shifting in the Internet communities, which are difficult to analyze due to their type-shifting and temporal-evolving nature. Although these memes are shifting, we find that different memes may share invariant principles, i.e., the underlying design concept of malicious users, which can help us analyze why these memes are harmful. In this paper, we propose RepMD, an ever-shifting harmful meme detection method based on the design concept reproduction. We first refer to the attack tree to define the Design Concept Graph (DCG), which describes steps that people may take to design a harmful meme. Then, we derive the DCG from historical memes with design step reproduction and graph pruning. Finally, we use DCG to guide the Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to detect harmful memes. The evaluation results show that RepMD achieves the highest accuracy with 81.1% and has slight accuracy decreases when generalized to type-shifting and temporal-evolving memes. Human evaluation shows that RepMD can improve the efficiency of human discovery on harmful memes, with 15\sim30 seconds per meme.
papers.abstract_zh: 在互联网社区中，有害模因的类型和表现形式不断变化，因此很难对其进行分析。尽管这些模因在不断变化，但我们发现，不同的模因可能共享一些不变的原则，即恶意用户的设计理念。这些理念可以帮助我们理解为什么某些模因具有危害性。在本文中，我们提出了RepMD方法，这是一种基于设计理念复现的有害模因检测算法。我们首先通过攻击树来定义设计理念图（Design Concept Graph，DCG），该图描述了人们设计有害模因所采取的步骤。然后，我们通过历史模因的设计步骤复现以及图论剪枝技术来推导出DCG。最后，我们利用DCG来指导多模态大语言模型（MLLM）进行有害模因的检测。评估结果显示，RepMD的准确率高达81.1%，并且在应用于类型变化和随时间变化的模因时，准确率仍有所提升。人工评估表明，RepMD能够显著提高人类检测有害模因的效率，每次检测一个模因所需的时间约为15~30秒。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Activation-Guided Local Editing for Jailbreaking Attacks
papers.title_zh: 用于越狱攻击的激活引导式局部编辑技术
papers.authors: Jiecong Wang, Haoran Li, Hao Peng, Ziqian Zeng, Zihao Wang, Haohua Du, Zhengtao Yu
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become indispensable assistants, they remain vulnerable to misuse. Jailbreaking is an essential adversarial technique for red-teaming models to uncover and patch security flaws. However, existing jailbreak methods suffer from significant limitations. Token-level jailbreak attacks often produce incoherent or unreadable inputs and exhibit poor transferability, while prompt-level attacks lack scalability and rely heavily on manual effort and human ingenuity. We propose AGILE, a concise and effective two-stage framework that combines the advantages of these approaches. The first stage performs a one-shot, scenario-based generation of context and rephrases the original malicious query to obscure its harmful intent. The second stage utilizes information from the model’s hidden states to guide fine-grained edits, effectively steering the model’s internal representation of the input from a malicious one toward a benign one. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AGILE achieves state-of-the-art Attack Success Rate, with gains of up to 37.74% over the strongest baseline, and AGILE exhibits excellent transferability to black-box and large-scale models. Our code is available at https://github.com/SELGroup/AGILE.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型成为不可或缺的助手，它们仍然容易遭到滥用。破解模型是一种重要的对抗性技术，可以用来发现并修复安全漏洞。然而，现有的破解方法存在显著局限性：令牌级破解攻击往往会产生不连贯或难以理解的输入，且可转移性较差；而提示级攻击则缺乏可扩展性，严重依赖人工操作和人类的创造力。我们提出了AGILE这一简洁有效的两阶段框架，它结合了上述方法的优点。第一阶段采用一次性、基于场景的生成方式，重新表述原始的恶意查询，以掩盖其有害意图。第二阶段则利用模型隐藏状态中的信息来进行精细的编辑，从而将模型对输入的内部表示从恶意状态转变为良性状态。大量实验表明，AGILE在攻击成功率方面达到了最先进水平，相比最强的基线模型，其成功率提升了37.74%。此外，AGILE还表现出出色的可转移性，能够适用于黑盒模型和大规模模型。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/SELGroup/AGILE上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Controlling Distributional Bias in Multi-Round LLM Generation via KL-Optimized Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 通过KL优化式微调技术，在多轮LLM生成过程中控制分布偏差现象
papers.authors: Yanbei Jiang, Amr Keleg, Ryandito Diandaru, Jey Han Lau, Lea Frermann, Biaoyan Fang, Fajri Koto
papers.abstract: While the real world is inherently stochastic, Large Language Models (LLMs) are predominantly evaluated on single-round inference against fixed ground truths. In this work, we shift the lens to distribution alignment: assessing whether LLMs, when prompted repeatedly, can generate outputs that adhere to a desired target distribution, e.g. reflecting real-world statistics or a uniform distribution. We formulate distribution alignment using the attributes of gender, race, and sentiment within occupational contexts. Our empirical analysis reveals that off-the-shelf LLMs and standard alignment techniques, including prompt engineering and Direct Preference Optimization, fail to reliably control output distributions. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel fine-tuning framework that couples Steering Token Calibration with Semantic Alignment. We introduce a hybrid objective function combining Kullback-Leibler divergence to anchor the probability mass of latent steering tokens and Kahneman-Tversky Optimization to bind these tokens to semantically consistent responses. Experiments across six diverse datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms baselines, achieving precise distributional control in attribute generation tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然现实世界本质上是随机的，但大语言模型主要被评估在针对固定真实答案的单轮推理任务中的表现。在这项研究中，我们改变了评估方式，转向了分布对齐：即评估在反复输入提示的情况下，语言模型是否能够生成符合期望目标分布的输出，例如反映现实世界的统计数据或均匀分布。我们通过考虑性别、种族和情绪这些属性来定义分布对齐的概念。我们的实证分析表明，现有的语言模型和标准的对齐技术，包括提示工程和直接偏好优化，都无法可靠地控制输出分布。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新颖的微调框架，该框架将引导令牌校准与语义对齐相结合。我们引入了一种混合目标函数，结合了Kullback-Leibler散度来固定潜在引导令牌的概率质量，以及Kahneman-Tversky优化方法来将这些令牌与语义一致的响应联系起来。在六个不同的数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法显著优于基线算法，能够在属性生成任务中实现精确的分布控制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: On the Continued Value of Universal Dependencies in the Era of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型时代，通用依赖关系的持续价值
papers.authors: Wenxi Li, Jingyu Peng
papers.abstract: The necessity of explicit linguistic representations has been increasingly questioned in the era of large language models (LLMs). In this work, we revisit this issue using Universal Dependencies (UD) as a case study, examining whether and in what ways this cross-lingual syntactic framework can still benefit contemporary LLMs. We focus on a cross-lingual adversarial paraphrase identification task that is designed to foreground the role of syntactic structure in semantic interpretation across languages. Within this setting, we systematically evaluate three strategies for integrating UD into LLMs: UD-Prompt, UD-Tuning, and UD-Attention. Our experiments show that, although the magnitude of gains depends on how UD-based structural priors interact with model behavior and cross-lingual variation, UD-augmented models consistently outperform their syntax-agnostic counterparts. Across strategies, we observe average accuracy improvements of 2.67%, 8.24%, and 2.53%, respectively. These findings demonstrate that linguistic knowledge remains informative for LLMs, offering practical value in cross-lingual settings where structural alignment is challenging.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型时代，对明确语言表示的必要性受到了越来越多的质疑。在这项研究中，我们以通用依存关系为案例研究对象，探讨这种跨语言的句法框架是否以及在何种程度上仍能对现代语言模型产生帮助。我们专注于一个跨语言的对抗性释义识别任务，该任务旨在凸显句法结构在跨语言语义解释中的重要作用。在这一背景下，我们系统地评估了三种将通用依存关系整合到语言模型中的策略：通用依存关系提示、通用依存关系调优和通用依存关系注意力机制。实验结果表明，尽管这些策略的改进效果取决于基于通用依存关系的结构先验与模型行为以及跨语言差异之间的相互作用，但采用通用依存关系增强模型的性能始终优于那些不依赖句法的模型。在不同策略下，我们的平均准确率分别提高了2.67%、8.24%和2.53%。这些发现表明，语言知识对于语言模型仍然具有参考价值，在跨语言环境中，当结构对齐变得困难时，这种知识能够带来实际的价值。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Adaptive Text2GQL: Integrating Structural Twig Linking and Evolutionary In-Context Learning
papers.title_zh: 自适应Text2GQL：整合结构式链接机制与进化式上下文学习技术
papers.authors: Fang Niu, Chaokun Wang, Hang Zhang, Songyao Wang
papers.abstract: While large language models have revolutionized Text-to-SQL tasks, translating natural language into Graph Query Languages (Text2GQL) remains underexplored due to the topological heterogeneity and syntactic diversity of graph query languages (e.g., Cypher, Gremlin, SPARQL). Existing approaches often struggle with structural hallucinations and lack adaptability in cold-start scenarios. In this paper, we present a unified, training-free Text2GQL framework. First, Structural Twig Linking elevates schema grounding to the identification of semantic substructures (“twigs”), providing robust topological priors. Second, addressing data scarcity, Evolutionary In-Context Learning operates in a Tabula Rasa setting to implicitly construct a self-growing repository of verified examples driven by syntactic utility. Finally, our Adversarial Execution-Guided Correction agent enforces fidelity through synergistic static critique and dynamic verification. Experiments demonstrate significant improvements over baselines in both accuracy and executability across diverse GQLs. The code is available at https://github.com/nf202/Text2Graph.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型已经彻底改变了文本转SQL任务，但由于图查询语言在拓扑结构和语法上的多样性（例如Cypher、Gremlin、SPARQL），将自然语言转换为图查询语言仍然没有得到充分研究。现有的方法往往难以处理结构上的幻觉问题，并且在冷启动场景中缺乏适应性。在本文中，我们提出了一个统一的、无需训练的Text2GQL框架。首先，结构链接技术将模式基础工作提升到对语义子结构的识别层面，从而提供可靠的拓扑先验信息。其次，为了解决数据稀缺的问题，进化上下文学习机制以一种“白板”的方式运作，通过语法效用来隐式构建一个不断增长的验证示例库。最后，我们的对抗性执行引导校正算法通过协同的静态审查和动态验证来确保转换结果的准确性。实验表明，与基线方法相比，我们的方法在准确性和可执行性方面都取得了显著改进。代码可以在https://github.com/nf202/Text2Graph下载。

papers.title: XToM: Exploring the Multilingual Theory of Mind for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: XToM：探索适用于大型语言模型的多语言心智理论
papers.authors: Chunkit Chan, Yauwai Yim, Hongchuan Zeng, Zhiying Zou, Xinyuan Cheng, Zhifan Sun, Zheye Deng, Kawai Chung, Yuzhuo Ao, Fan Yixiang, Cheng Jiayang, Ercong Nie, Ginny Wong, Helmut Schmid, Hinrich Schuetze, Simon See, Yangqiu Song
papers.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM)—the ability to infer mental states in others—is pivotal for human social cognition. Existing evaluations of ToM in LLMs are largely limited to English, neglecting the linguistic diversity that shapes human cognition. This limitation raises a critical question: can LLMs exhibit Multilingual Theory of Mind—the capacity to reason about mental states across diverse linguistic contexts? To address this gap, we present XToM, a rigorously validated multilingual benchmark that evaluates ToM across five languages and incorporates diverse, contextually rich task scenarios. Using XToM, we systematically evaluate LLMs (e.g., DeepSeek R1), revealing a pronounced dissonance: while models excel in multilingual language understanding, their ToM performance varies across languages. Our findings expose limitations in LLMs’ ability to replicate human-like mentalizing across linguistic contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 心智理论——即推断他人心理状态的能力——对于人类的社会认知至关重要。目前对大语言模型的心智理论评估大多局限于英语，而忽视了语言多样性对人类认知的影响。这一局限性引发了一个关键问题：大语言模型能否展现出多语言心智理论——即在不同语言环境中进行心理状态推理的能力？为了填补这一空白，我们提出了XToM这一经过严格验证的多语言基准测试，该测试能够评估模型在五种语言下的心智理论能力，并涵盖多种具有丰富上下文的任务场景。通过XToM的测试，我们发现大语言模型在跨语言理解方面表现出色，但在心智理论方面的表现却因语言差异而有所差异。我们的研究结果揭示了大语言模型在跨语言情境下复制人类式心理感知能力的局限性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Cognitive Policy-Driven LLM for Diagnosis and Intervention of Cognitive Distortions in Emotional Support Conversation
papers.title_zh: 基于认知逻辑的大型语言模型，用于诊断情绪支持对话中的认知偏差并给出干预建议
papers.authors: Lin Zhong, Renjin Zhu, Shujuan Ma, Jinhao Cui, Lingzhi Wang, Hao Chen, Qing Liao
papers.abstract: Emotional Support Conversation (ESC) plays a critical role in mental health assistance by providing accessible psychological support in real-world applications. Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong empathetic abilities in ESC tasks. Yet, existing methods overlook the issue of cognitive distortions in help-seekers’ expressions. As a result, current models can only provide basic emotional comfort, rather than helping help-seekers address their psychological distress at a deeper cognitive level. To address this challenge, we construct the CogBiasESC dataset, the first dataset that expands existing ESC datasets by adding labels for cognitive distortions, includes their type, intensity, and safe risk level. Furthermore, we propose the Cognitive Policy-driven Large Language Model framework (CoPoLLM) to enhance LLMs’ ability to diagnose and intervene cognitive distortions in help-seekers. We also analyze the safety advantages of CoPoLLM from a theoretical perspective. Experimental results show that CoPoLLM significantly outperforms 15 state-of-the-art baselines in terms of distortion diagnosis accuracy, intervention strategy effectiveness, and safety risk control. Our source code is available at: https://github.com/Chips98/CoPoLLM-for-ACL-2026.
papers.abstract_zh: 情感支持对话在心理健康援助中发挥着至关重要的作用，它能够为人们提供实用的心理支持。大语言模型在情感支持对话任务中展现出了强大的同理心能力。然而，现有的方法往往忽略了求助者表达中的认知偏差问题。因此，当前的模型只能提供基本的情感慰藉，而无法帮助求助者在更深层次的认知层面解决他们的心理困扰。为了应对这一挑战，我们构建了CogBiasESC数据集——这是第一个通过添加关于认知偏差的标签来扩展现有情感支持对话数据集的数据集，其中包括这些偏差的类型、强度以及安全风险等级。此外，我们提出了基于认知策略的大语言模型框架CoPoLLM，以提升大语言模型诊断并干预求助者认知偏差的能力。我们还从理论角度分析了CoPoLLM在安全性方面的优势。实验结果表明，CoPoLLM在偏差诊断准确性、干预策略有效性以及安全风险控制方面均显著优于15个最先进的基准模型。我们的源代码可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/Chips98/CoPoLLM-for-ACL-2026
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SciFlow-Bench: Evaluating Structure-Aware Scientific Diagram Generation via Inverse Parsing
papers.title_zh: SciFlow-Bench：通过逆解析方法评估基于结构感知的科学图表生成技术
papers.authors: Tong Zhang, Honglin Lin, Zhou Liu, Chong Chen, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: Scientific diagrams convey explicit structural information, yet modern text-to-image models often produce visually plausible but structurally incorrect results. Existing benchmarks either rely on image-centric or subjective metrics insensitive to structure, or evaluate intermediate symbolic representations rather than final rendered images, leaving pixel-based diagram generation underexplored. We introduce SciFlow-Bench, a structure-first benchmark for evaluating scientific diagram generation directly from pixel-level outputs. Built from real scientific PDFs, SciFlow-Bench pairs each source framework figure with a canonical ground-truth graph and evaluates models as black-box image generators under a closed-loop, round-trip protocol that inverse-parses generated diagram images back into structured graphs for comparison. This design enforces evaluation by structural recoverability rather than visual similarity alone, and is enabled by a hierarchical multi-agent system that coordinates planning, perception, and structural reasoning. Experiments show that preserving structural correctness remains a fundamental challenge, particularly for diagrams with complex topology, underscoring the need for structure-aware evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学图表能够清晰地传达结构信息，但现代的文本到图像模型往往能生成出视觉上令人满意但结构上存在错误的结果。现有的评估基准要么依赖于以图像为中心的评价方式，要么采用对结构不敏感的主观指标；同时，这些基准通常只评估中间的符号表示，而忽略了最终渲染出的图像。因此，基于像素的科学图表生成技术尚未得到充分探索。我们提出了SciFlow-Bench这一基于结构的评估基准，它能够直接从像素级输出来评估科学图表的生成效果。该基准基于真实的科学PDF文件构建，它将每个源框架中的图表与标准化的真实图表进行配对，并通过闭环式的往返协议来评估模型作为“黑盒图像生成器”的能力。该协议能够将生成的图表图像反解析回结构化图表，以便进行比较。这种设计通过结构可恢复性而非单纯的视觉相似性来进行评估，而这一设计是由一个分层多智能体系统来实现的，该系统负责协调规划、感知以及结构推理功能。实验表明，保持结构的正确性仍然是一个基本挑战，尤其是对于具有复杂拓扑结构的图表而言，这进一步强调了需要一种注重结构的评估方法。

papers.title: Immediate Inference: The Missing Foundation in Large Language Model Logical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 直接推理：大型语言模型中缺失的基础逻辑推理机制
papers.authors: Sihang Jiang, Zhiyu Lu, Keyi Wang, Jiaqing Liang, Yanghua Xiao, Xiaojun Meng, Jiansheng Wei
papers.abstract: While extensive research has evaluated LLMs on complex reasoning tasks, the foundational building blocks of logical reasoning remain underexplored. We introduce IIBench, a benchmark evaluating immediate inference (elementary operations over categorical propositions). Our evaluation reveals that even SoTA models exhibit systematic deficiencies in immediate inference, and establishes immediate inference as foundational: it mediates approximately 40% of the effect on syllogistic reasoning, with near-perfect correlation ( = 0.98) across reasoning benchmarks. Our analysis reveals that models lack robust operator grounding, oscillating between structural reasoning and surface pattern matching with inconsistent handling of quantifiers and negation.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然已有大量研究对大语言模型在复杂推理任务上的表现进行了评估，但逻辑推理的基础性要素仍未被充分探索。我们提出了IIBench这一基准测试，用于评估即时推理能力（即对范畴命题的基本操作）。我们的评估结果显示，即使是现有的最先进模型在即时推理方面也存在系统性缺陷。因此，我们认为即时推理是逻辑推理的基础：它大约占推理效果的40%，并且在各种推理基准测试中表现出近乎完美的相关性（=0.98）。我们的分析还发现，这些模型缺乏稳健的运算符处理机制，在结构推理和表面模式匹配之间表现不稳定，对量词和否定符号的处理也显得不够准确。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Tracing Logit Trajectories Across Layer Depth: Dataset-Level Explainability for Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在多层结构中追踪逻辑轨迹：针对语言模型的数据集级可解释性分析
papers.authors: Jeesu Jung, Sangkeun Jung
papers.abstract: Sentence-level explanations can miss the bigger picture of how a black-box model behaves across data, which matters most for complex criteria like safety that cannot be defined by a single rule. We trace Logit-Trajectory, which tracks adjacent-layer logit updates as vectors and aggregates them into a reproducible dataset-level trajectory pattern, enabling depth-wise explainability through signals such as coherence and angular rotation. Across 6 languages and 5 NLP tasks, we show these trajectory summaries reveal consistent depth-wise patterns that divergence- and similarity-based baselines often wash out due to scalarization. As a case study where dataset-level intermediate decision structure matters, we evaluate safety classification, reporting both trajectory-level visual separability and classification performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 句子级别的解释可能会忽略黑盒模型在数据上的整体行为模式，这对于那些无法通过单一规则来定义的安全性等复杂指标来说非常重要。我们提出了Logit-Trajectory方法，该方法将相邻层的逻辑斯蒂更新以向量形式进行跟踪，并将其汇总为可复用的数据集级行为模式，从而通过一致性、角度旋转等信号来实现深度层面的可解释性。在6种语言和5种自然语言处理任务中，我们发现这些行为模式总结出了一些一致性的深度特征，而这些特征往往会被基于差异和相似性的基线方法所忽略，因为它们采用了标量化处理方式。作为一个案例研究，我们评估了数据集级中间决策结构的重要性，结果显示，该方法的视觉可分性和分类性能都得到了提升。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: REZE: Representation Regularization for Domain-adaptive Text Embedding Pre-finetuning
papers.title_zh: REZE：用于领域自适应文本嵌入预微调的表示正则化方法
papers.authors: Seungmin Lee, Jeonghwan Lee, Hyunkuk Lim, Sejoon Kim, Mingi Sung
papers.abstract: Recent text embedding models are often adapted to specialized domains via contrastive pre-finetuning (PFT) on a naive collection of scattered, heterogeneous tasks. However, this approach often introduces task-induced bias alongside domain knowledge, leading to uncontrolled representation shifts that distort the pretrained embedding geometry and cause substantial performance degradation.To address this issue, we propose REZE, a representation regularization framework that explicitly controls representation shift during embedding pre-finetuning. REZE operates on the relations of anchor-positive pairs and decomposes them in an eigenspace. It then measures task-wise dispersion along each eigencomponent to identify task-variant directions and applies adaptive soft-shrinkage to suppress task-induced noise while preserving task-invariant semantic structure, without inference-time overhead. Experiments across multiple embedding backbones and specialized benchmarks show that REZE outperforms standard pre-finetuning and isotropy-oriented post-hoc regularization in most settings, remaining stable where existing PFT variants collapse. Embedding space analyses further confirm that REZE induces controlled shifts aligned with the original embedding manifold, underscoring representation shift control as a key principle for robust embedding pre-finetuning under heterogeneous supervision.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的文本嵌入模型通常是通过在一系列分散的、异构任务上进行对比预微调（PFT），来适应特定领域的需求。然而，这种方法往往会引入由任务引起的偏差以及领域知识的影响，从而导致无法控制的表示偏移，这会扭曲预训练的嵌入结构，并导致性能显著下降。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了REZE这一表示正则化框架。该框架能够在嵌入预微调过程中明确控制表示偏移。REZE通过处理锚点正样本对之间的关系，并将它们分解为特征空间中的各个子空间。然后，它测量每个子空间上的任务特异性分布，以识别与任务相关的方向，并应用自适应软收缩技术来抑制由任务引起的噪声，同时保留与任务无关的语义结构，且无需额外的推理开销。在多种嵌入基模型和专业基准测试中的实验表明，REZE在大多数情况下都优于标准的预微调技术和基于等距方向的后期正则化方法。此外，嵌入空间分析进一步证实，REZE能够产生与原始嵌入结构一致的受控偏移，这充分证明了控制表示偏移是确保在异质监督下实现稳健嵌入预微调的关键原则。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TAMA: Target-Aware Multilingual Abuse Detection by Cascaded Conditional Multi-Task Learning
papers.title_zh: TAMA：基于级联条件多任务学习的目标感知多语言滥用检测技术
papers.authors: JiYan Liu, Youzheng Liu, Taihang Wang, Yimin Wang, Ye Jiang, Diana Maynard
papers.abstract: Protecting public figures from online abuse requires models that go beyond post-level classification to determine whether abuse is directed at a designated target, characterize the abuse intent, and extract textual evidence. We introduce a Target-Aware Multilingual Abuse (TAMA), benchmark of 9,386 X (Twitter) posts aimed at public figures, with aligned supervision for (i) tri-class target detection, (ii) 12-way fine-grained abuse type classification, and (iii) phrase-level abusive spans localization. To exploit the hierarchical coupling of these tasks, we propose Cascaded-MTL, a dependency-aware multi-task framework that conditions downstream predictions on upstream beliefs via three lightweight modules: Cross-Task Feature Fusion (CTF), Task-Adaptive Gating (TAG), and Label-Guided Span Detection (LGSD). Experiments across three multilingual encoders show that Cascaded-MTL consistently yields higher average F1 than single-task and standard multi-task training and delivers robust gains on type classification and span localization. The code and the dataset are released here: https://github.com/zgjiangtoby/CASCADED-MTL
papers.abstract_zh: 保护公众人物免受网络虐待，需要一种超越帖子级别分类的模型。这种模型能够判断虐待行为是否针对特定目标，分析虐待意图，并提取文本证据。我们提出了一种名为“目标感知多语言虐待检测”的方法，该方法对9,386篇针对公众人物的X（Twitter）帖子进行了处理，并实现了以下功能的监督：i) 目标检测；ii) 12种细粒度的虐待类型分类；iii) 短语级别的虐待内容定位。为了利用这些任务的层次性联系，我们提出了Cascaded-MTL框架——一个依赖关系感知的多任务框架。该框架通过三个轻量级模块来约束下游预测：跨任务特征融合、任务自适应门控以及标签引导片段检测。在三种多语言编码器的实验结果表明，Cascaded-MTL在平均F1值上始终优于单任务和标准多任务训练方法，同时在虐待类型分类和片段定位方面也取得了显著的改进。代码和数据集已在此处发布：https://github.com/zgjiangtoby/CASCADED-MTL
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Reference Attack: A New Cross-Modal Jailbreaking Attack against Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 参考攻击：一种针对多模态大语言模型的新式越狱攻击方式
papers.authors: Yulong Wang, Yifei Fu, Jiayi Gao
papers.abstract: Red team testing, an effective proactive method for evaluating the security of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), requires an expanding toolkit alongside the development of MLLM safeguards. We propose the Reference Attack, a powerful tool for red team testing against MLLMs. The Reference Attack is a reference-guided cross-modal jailbreak method that enhances existing prompt-to-image injection attacks by exploiting MLLMs’ semantic reconstruction capabilities. Our method embeds malicious prompts in non-text modalities (e.g., images, spreadsheets) and constructs recursive symbolic references in text, enabling MLLMs to gradually recover and generate harmful content through layered reference resolution.The attack introduces a new vector that circumvents conventional content moderation by exploiting MLLMs’ lack of security checks during cross-modal reference resolution. We evaluate the Reference Attack on leading MLLMs, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and the widely used open-source LLaMA model, and achieved an attack success rate of over 93% across all tested models. Compared to state-of-the-art attacks, Reference Attack achieves higher success rates than all baselines under identical evaluation, with a maximum gain of 70.8%. Our study reveals a critical gap in MLLM security and highlights the need for strict security auditing of cross-modal interactions in future content moderation.
papers.abstract_zh: 红队测试是一种有效的主动式方法，用于评估多模态大语言模型的安全性。要实现这一方法，就需要不断扩展工具集，同时开发针对大语言模型的防护措施。我们提出了“参考攻击”这一工具，它是用于对抗大语言模型的强大手段。参考攻击是一种以参考为引导的跨模态破解方法，它通过利用大语言模型的语义重构能力，增强了现有的提示到图像注入攻击的效果。我们的方法将恶意提示嵌入到非文本模态中（如图像、电子表格），并在文本中构建递归式的符号引用，使得大语言模型能够逐步恢复并生成有害内容。该攻击引入了一个新的向量，通过利用大语言模型在跨模态引用解析过程中缺乏安全检查的特点，从而绕过传统的内容审核机制。我们在主流大语言模型上进行了测试，包括ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude以及广泛使用的开源LLaMA模型，结果显示，在所有测试模型中，攻击的成功率超过了93%。与最先进的攻击方式相比，参考攻击在相同的评估条件下取得了更高的成功率，最大收益达到了70.8%。我们的研究揭示了大语言模型安全性方面的关键漏洞，并强调了在未来内容审核中对跨模态交互进行严格安全审计的必要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: POWSM: A Phonetic Open Whisper-Style Speech Foundation Model
papers.title_zh: POWSM：一种基于语音的开放式秘密语音基础模型
papers.authors: Chin-Jou Li, Kalvin Chang, Shikhar Bharadwaj, Eunjung Yeo, Kwanghee Choi, Jian Zhu, David R. Mortensen, Shinji Watanabe
papers.abstract: Recent advances in spoken language processing have led to substantial progress in phonetic tasks such as automatic speech recognition (ASR), phone recognition (PR), grapheme-to-phoneme conversion (G2P), and phoneme-to-grapheme conversion (P2G). Despite their conceptual similarity, these tasks have largely been studied in isolation, each relying on task-specific architectures and datasets. In this paper, we introduce POWSM (Phonetic Open Whisper-style Speech Model), the first unified framework capable of jointly performing multiple phone-related tasks. POWSM enables seamless conversion between audio, text (graphemes), and phones, opening up new possibilities for universal and low-resource speech processing. Our model outperforms or matches specialized PR models of similar size (Wav2Vec2Phoneme and ZIPA) while jointly supporting G2P, P2G, and ASR. Our training data, models, and code are released to foster open science.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，口语处理领域的进展显著提升了语音任务的处理能力，例如自动语音识别（ASR）、音素识别（PR）、字元到音素转换（G2P）以及音素到字元转换（P2G）等任务。尽管这些任务在概念上具有相似性，但它们大多被独立研究，每个任务都依赖于特定的架构和数据集。在本文中，我们提出了POWSM模型——首个能够同时处理多种与音素相关任务的统一框架。POWSM能够实现音频、文本（字元）以及音素之间的无缝转换，为通用且资源有限的语音处理提供了新的可能性。我们的模型在性能上优于或等同于那些规模相近的专业音素识别模型（如Wav2Vec2Phoneme和ZIPA），并且还能同时支持G2P、P2G和ASR任务。我们的训练数据、模型和代码均已公开，以促进开放科学研究的发展。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LCR-RAG: Enhancing Logical Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Neuro-symbolic Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: LCR-RAG：通过神经符号强化学习提升检索增强生成中的逻辑一致性
papers.authors: Wenxiang Zheng, Guo Tang, Shixin Jiang, Liangyu Huo, Xiyuan Zhang, Jian Xie, Ming Liu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely used to ground large language models (LLMs) in external knowledge and improve factual accuracy. Prior work has explored iterative and self-reflective mechanisms to refine reasoning, but these approaches rely on internal model judgment and lack formally grounded, verifiable feedback. As a result, RAG systems may still produce logically inconsistent or contradictory answers in multi-step reasoning. In this paper, we propose LCR-RAG, a framework that integrates neuro-symbolic verification with reinforcement learning to explicitly optimize logical consistency. The core of our approach is a Logic-Consistency-driven Reward (LCR), which converts discrete logical signals—such as contradictions or incomplete inference chains—into a structured reward signal. This reward guides a PPO-based agent to iteratively rewrite queries and correct reasoning errors. Experiments on HotpotQA, ASQA, and TriviaQA show that LCR-RAG consistently outperforms strong RAG baselines, with ablation results indicating that the LCR mechanism is the primary source of improvement, even under noisy or conflicting retrieval conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）被广泛用于将大语言模型与外部知识相结合，以提高事实的准确性。之前的研究已经探索了迭代性和自我反思机制来优化推理能力，但这些方法依赖于内部模型的判断，缺乏形式化、可验证的反馈机制。因此，RAG系统在多步推理过程中仍可能产生逻辑上不一致或矛盾的结果。在本文中，我们提出了LCR-RAG框架，该框架将神经符号验证与强化学习相结合，以明确优化逻辑一致性。我们的核心方法是基于逻辑一致性的奖励机制，它将离散的逻辑信号——如矛盾或不完整的推理链——转化为结构化的奖励信号。这种奖励机制引导基于PPO的智能体不断重写查询并纠正推理错误。在HotpotQA、ASQA和TriviaQA上的实验表明，LCR-RAG始终优于其他强大的RAG基线算法。消融实验结果显示，即使在噪声较大或信息冲突的情况下，LCR机制仍然是提高性能的主要手段。

papers.title: CIA: Inferring the Communication Topology from LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: CIA：从基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中推断通信拓扑结构
papers.authors: Yongxuan Wu, Xixun Lin, He Zhang, Nan Sun, Kun Wang, Chuan Zhou, Shirui Pan, Yanan Cao
papers.abstract: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks. Central to MAS is the communication topology which governs how agents exchange information internally. Consequently, the security of communication topologies has attracted increasing attention. In this paper, we investigate a critical privacy risk: MAS communication topologies can be inferred under a restrictive black-box setting, exposing system vulnerabilities and posing significant intellectual property threats. To explore this risk, we propose Communication Inference Attack (CIA), a novel attack that constructs new adversarial queries to induce intermediate agents’ reasoning outputs and models their semantic correlations through the proposed global bias disentanglement and LLM-guided weak supervision. Extensive experiments on MAS with optimized communication topologies demonstrate the effectiveness of CIA, achieving an average AUC of 0.87 and a peak AUC of up to 0.99, thereby revealing the substantial privacy risk in MAS. The source code is available at https://github.com/aabbbcd/CIA.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的多智能体系统在解决复杂任务方面展现出了显著的能力。多智能体系统的核心在于通信拓扑结构，它决定了智能体之间如何交换信息。因此，通信拓扑结构的安全性越来越受到关注。在本文中，我们探讨了一个关键的隐私风险：在多智能体系统中，通信拓扑结构可以在一种限制性的黑盒环境下被推断出来，这可能会暴露系统的漏洞，并构成严重的知识产权威胁。为了研究这一风险，我们提出了通信推理攻击（CIA）这一新型攻击方法。该攻击通过构建新的对抗性查询来诱导中间智能体的推理输出，并通过提出的全局偏差解缠技术和LLM引导的弱监督技术来建模它们之间的语义关联。在优化通信拓扑结构的多智能体系统上进行的广泛实验证明了CIA的有效性，其平均AUC达到了0.87，峰值AUC甚至达到了0.99，从而揭示了多智能体系统中存在的重大隐私风险。源代码可访问于https://github.com/aabbbcd/CIA。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Efficiently Learning To Reason or Not to Reason: Root-token Policy Optimization for Adaptive Thinking
papers.title_zh: 高效地学习如何推理，或者干脆不进行推理：基于根令牌的策略优化，助力适应性思维的发展
papers.authors: Taehyeon Kim, Hyunsoo Lee, Youngsoo Jang, Moontae Lee
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by externalizing explicit reasoning traces before producing the answer, yet suffer from overthinking challenge that allocates uniformly heavy computation to queries of varying difficulty. While proprietary models mitigate this via opaque routing, open-source LRMs still lack an efficient mechanism to internalize adaptive reasoning due to both expensive training cost and limited disclosure of training recipes. In response, we introduce RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization), a framework that enables LRMs to self-determine when to reason by training only the initial root token (e.g., whether to invoke the think tag) via group relative reward and group-wise advantages. By focusing on this pivotal branching point, RPO drastically reduces training overhead and VRAM usage. Across multiple model families and scales, RPO learns difficulty-aware adaptive thinking at just 2% of the training compute of prior adaptive-reasoning methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在生成答案之前，会先将明确的推理过程外部化，从而取得出色的性能。然而，这类模型面临着过度思考的挑战，因为需要为不同难度的查询分配相同量的计算资源。虽然一些专有模型通过不透明的路由机制来缓解这个问题，但开源的推理模型仍然缺乏一种有效的机制来内化自适应推理能力，这主要是由于训练成本过高以及训练方法的公开程度有限所导致的。为此，我们提出了RPO（根令牌策略优化）框架。该框架使得推理模型能够自行决定何时进行推理，只需通过群体相对奖励和群体优势来训练初始的根令牌（例如，是否调用“思考”标签）。通过专注于这一关键的分支点，RPO大大降低了训练开销和内存占用。在多种模型和规模下，RPO仅使用相当于传统自适应推理方法2%的计算资源就能实现具有难度感知的自适应推理。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SAGE: Synergistic Adaptive Gating of Experts for Hateful Video Detection
papers.title_zh: SAGE：协同自适应专家门控算法在仇恨视频检测中的应用
papers.authors: Jie Huang, Xin Liao, Junjie Wang, Mingyang Li, Wenshuo Wang, Ziyou Jiang, Shoubin Li, Qing Wang
papers.abstract: With the rise of short-video platforms, hate speech has evolved from static text and memes into more covert and aggressive hateful video formats, profoundly impacting social dynamics and public sentiment. Existing detection methods typically rely on multimodal feature fusion, which blurs the distinct boundaries of modality-specific information. This leads to the feature dilution problem, where dominant benign modalities often overwhelm sparse, localized hateful cues. To address this, we propose SAGE (Synergistic Adaptive Gating of Experts), a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from blind feature mixing to decision-level arbitration. Mimicking human cognitive processes, SAGE instantiates disentangled experts to rigorously preserve modality-specific semantics, facilitates global expert deliberation for context-aware refinement, and convenes an instance-level tribunal to dynamically arbitrate the final verdict based on evidentiary salience. Extensive experiments on HateMM and MultiHateClip benchmarks demonstrate that SAGE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving accuracy gains of 6.37% to 21.23% and macro-F1 score gains of 6.77% to 28.01%.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着短视频平台的兴起，仇恨言论已经从静态的文字和表情包演变成为更加隐蔽和具有攻击性的视频形式，这对社会动态和公众情绪产生了深远影响。现有的检测方法通常依赖于多模态特征融合，这模糊了不同模态信息的边界。这就导致了特征稀释的问题，即占主导地位的良性模态往往会掩盖那些稀少的、局部的仇恨信号。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SAGE（协同自适应专家门控）这一创新框架。该框架将检测方式从盲目的特征混合转变为决策层面的仲裁机制。通过模仿人类认知过程，SAGE创建了多个“专家”模块，以严格保留各模态的语义信息；同时，它还促进了全局专家的审议，以便对上下文进行精细处理；最后，它还设立了实例级别的仲裁机构，根据证据的显著性来动态裁定最终的结果。在HateMM和MultiHateClip基准测试中的大量实验表明，SAGE在准确性方面显著优于现有最先进的方法，其准确率提高了6.37%至21.23%，宏观F1分数则提高了6.77%至28.01%。
