papers.title: HiKEY: Hierarchical Multimodal Retrieval for Open-Domain Document Question Answering
papers.title_zh: HiKEY：用于开放域文档问答的层次化多模态检索系统
papers.authors: Joongmin Shin, Gyuho Shim, Jeongbae Park, Jaehyung Seo, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for document-based Open-domain Question Answering (ODQA) on large-scale industrial corpora faces two critical bottlenecks: routing failure in locating the correct document and evidence fragmentation in integrating scattered information. Existing approaches relying on flat text chunks or page-level images inherently struggle to (i) precisely pinpoint the target document among thousands of candidates and (ii) organically connect multimodal evidence, such as tables and figures, within a limited token budget. To address these challenges, we propose HiKEY, a hierarchical tree-based multimodal retrieval framework that elevates document hierarchy to a first-class retrieval signal. Instead of simple chunking, HiKEY reconstructs a logical heterogeneous graph via Document Hierarchical Parsing (DHP), explicitly encoding parent–child relationships. Adopting a hierarchical coarse-to-fine strategy, the framework (1) performs global routing to rapidly prune the search space using hierarchical indexing, and (2) conducts fine-grained retrieval to rank sections by employing a multimodal fusion strategy that captures the most discriminative evidence. Finally, HiKEY assembles a token-efficient evidence subgraph via a hybrid structural-semantic packing strategy. Experiments on ODQA benchmarks demonstrate that HiKEY significantly outperforms page- and chunk-based baselines, improving retrieval recall by up to 12.9% and end-to-end QA performance by up to 6.8%.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大规模工业语料库上用于基于文档的开源问答任务中的检索增强生成方法，面临着两个关键瓶颈：在定位正确文档时的路由失败问题，以及整合分散信息时的信息碎片化问题。现有的方法依赖于简单的文本块或页面级图像，这些方法在以下两个方面存在困难：(i) 在数千个候选文档中精准定位目标文档；(ii) 在有限的令牌预算内自然连接表格、图表等多模态信息。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了HiKEY这一基于分层树状结构的多模态检索框架。该框架通过将文档层次结构提升为首要的检索信号，从而解决了上述问题。与简单的文本切块不同，HiKEY通过文档层次解析技术构建出一个逻辑上的异构图，明确编码了父子关系。该框架采用从粗到细的分层策略：(1) 通过层次化索引快速缩小搜索范围；(2) 通过多模态融合策略对各个部分进行精细排序，以提取最具区分性的信息。最后，HiKEY通过混合式结构-语义打包策略，构建出高效的令牌化证据子图。在开源问答基准测试中的实验表明，HiKEY在检索性能上显著优于基于页面和文本块的基线方法，其检索准确率提高了12.9%，端到端问答性能也提升了6.8%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Towards Efficient and Effective Diffusion Language Model Inference via Semantic-Aware Adaptive Denoising
papers.title_zh: 通过语义感知的自适应去噪技术，实现高效且有效的扩散语言模型推理
papers.authors: Fan Li, Yu Gu, Zhigang Wang, Fangling Leng, Zhenghao Liu, Ge Yu
papers.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have emerged as a powerful non-autoregressive alternative to GPT-style sequential generation, but suffer from substantial computational overhead due to their iterative parallel denoising. Existing acceleration works cannot accurately detect semantically stabilized tokens and then skip computation, leading to sub-optimal speedup in practice. This paper presents the first systematic study of convergence dynamics in DLMs. Innovative observations include the misalignment between traditionally used scalar detection criterion and the semantic convergence, and the post-peak confidence score, that wastes denoising computation and degrades inference quality. To address these limitations, we propose Ada-DLM, a semantic-aware adaptive denoising framework that encodes the trajectory of scalar confidence scores into an evolution-aware feature vector and then clusters vectors proactively and adaptively identify semantically converged tokens. Furthermore, we incorporate system-level optimizations to maximize runtime efficiency. Experiments show that Ada-DLM consistently outperforms the SOTA competitor, achieving up to 2x speedup and 19% quality improvement. That offers a practical path toward efficient high-quality DLM deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）作为一种强大的非自回归替代方案，已经取代了GPT风格的序列生成方法。然而，由于其迭代并行去噪过程，这类模型面临着巨大的计算负担。现有的加速技术无法准确识别语义上稳定的标记，从而跳过部分计算步骤，导致实际运行效率低下。本文首次系统研究了DLM中的收敛动态问题。我们的研究发现，传统使用的标量检测标准与语义收敛之间存在不匹配现象，此外，峰值后的置信度分数会浪费去噪计算资源，并降低推理质量。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了Ada-DLM这一具有语义感知能力的自适应去噪框架。该框架将标量置信度分数的变化轨迹编码成一种具有演化意识的特征向量，然后主动地对这些向量进行聚类处理，从而识别出语义上收敛的标记。此外，我们还进行了系统级优化，以最大化运行效率。实验结果表明，Ada-DLM在性能上始终优于当前最先进的竞争对手，其运行速度提高了2倍，质量也提升了19%。这为高效、高质量的DLM应用提供了切实可行的途径。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AdvancedIF: Rubric-Based Benchmarking and Reinforcement Learning for Advancing LLM Instruction Following
papers.title_zh: AdvancedIF：基于评分标准的基准测试与强化学习，用于提升大型语言模型的操作能力
papers.authors: Yun He, Wenzhe Li, Hejia Zhang, Songlin Li, Karishma Mandyam, Sopan Khosla, Yuanhao Xiong, Nanshu Wang, Xiaoliang Peng, Beibin Li, Shengjie Bi, Shishir G Patil, Qi Qi, Shengyu Feng, Julian Katz-Samuels, Richard Yuanzhe Pang, Sujan Kumar Gonugondla, Hunter Lang, Yue Yu, Yundi Qian, Maryam Fazel-Zarandi, Licheng Yu, Amine Benhalloum, Hany Hassan Awadalla, Manaal Faruqui
papers.abstract: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) has led to impressive performance on a range of tasks, yet advanced instruction following (IF)—especially for complex, multi-turn, and system-prompted instructions—remains a significant challenge. Rigorous evaluation and effective training for such capabilities are hindered by the lack of high-quality, human-annotated benchmarks and reliable, interpretable reward signals. In this work, we introduce AdvancedIF, a comprehensive benchmark featuring over 1,600 prompts and expert-curated rubrics that assess LLMs’ ability to follow complex, multi-turn, and system-level instructions. We also open-source the evaluation script of AdvancedIF. We further propose RIFL (Rubric-based Instruction-Following Learning), a novel post-training pipeline that leverages rubric generation, a finetuned rubric verifier, and reward shaping to enable effective reinforcement learning for instruction following. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RIFL substantially improves the instruction-following abilities of LLMs, achieving a 6.7% absolute gain on AdvancedIF and strong results on public benchmarks. Our ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each component in RIFL. This work establishes rubrics as a powerful tool for both training and evaluating advanced IF in LLMs, paving the way for more capable and reliable AI systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使其在多种任务上取得了令人印象深刻的性能。然而，高级指令遵循能力——尤其是对于复杂、多轮次且由系统提示的指令——仍然是一个重大挑战。由于缺乏高质量、由人类标注的基准测试数据以及可靠、可解释的奖励信号，对这类能力的严格评估与有效训练都受到了限制。在这项研究中，我们提出了AdvancedIF这一综合性基准测试，该测试包含超过1,600个提示语句，并配有经过专家精心设计的评分标准，用于评估LLM遵循复杂、多轮次及系统级指令的能力。我们还将AdvancedIF的评估脚本开源了。此外，我们提出了RIFL这一新的训练后流程，该流程利用评分标准生成、经过微调的评分验证器以及奖励调整机制，以实现有效的指令遵循强化学习。大量实验表明，RIFL显著提升了LLM的指令遵循能力，在AdvancedIF测试上的绝对提升达到了6.7%，并在公开基准测试中取得了优异成绩。我们的消融研究也证实了RIFL中每个组件的有效性。这项研究表明，评分标准已成为训练和评估LLM高级指令遵循能力的重要工具，为构建更强大、更可靠的AI系统铺平了道路。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Improving Autoformalization Using Direct Dependency Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 利用直接依赖关系检索来提升自动形式化能力
papers.authors: Shaoqi Wang, Lu Yu, Siwei Lou, Feng Yan, Chunjie Yang, Qing Cui, Jun Zhou
papers.abstract: Statement autoformalization, a crucial first step in formal verification, aims to transform informal descriptions of math problems into machine-verifiable formal representations but remains a significant challenge. The core difficulty lies in the fact that existing language models hallucinate formal dependencies, including missing or incorrect definitions, lemmas, and theorems. Current dependency retrieval approaches exhibit poor precision and recall, and lack the scalability to leverage ever-growing public datasets. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel retrieval-augmented framework based on Direct Dependency Retrieval (DDR). DDR directly generates candidate formal dependencies from natural-language mathematical descriptions and verifies their existence in the formal library via an efficient Suffix Array Check (SAC). Built on a SAC-constructed dependency retrieval dataset of over 500,000 samples, a high-precision DDR model is fine-tuned and shown to significantly outperform state-of-the-art methods in both retrieval precision and recall, leading to superior advantage in the autoformalization tasks. SAC also contributes in assessing formalization difficulty and enabling explicit quantification of the hallucination in In-Context Learning (ICL).
papers.abstract_zh: 自动形式化是形式验证过程中的关键第一步，其目标是将数学问题的非正式描述转化为机器可验证的形式化表示，但这仍然是一个巨大的挑战。核心问题在于，现有的语言模型会错误地生成形式化依赖关系，包括缺失或错误的定义、引理和定理。当前的依赖关系检索方法在精确度和召回率方面表现不佳，且难以扩展到日益庞大的公共数据集上。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种基于直接依赖检索的新型增强式框架。该框架能够从自然语言数学描述中直接生成候选形式化依赖关系，并通过高效的后缀数组检查来验证这些依赖关系在形式化库中的存在性。基于包含超过500,000个样本的后缀数组构建的依赖关系检索数据集，我们训练出了高精度的直接依赖检索模型，该模型在检索精确度和召回率方面均优于现有方法，从而在自动形式化任务中取得了显著优势。此外，后缀数组还有助于评估形式化的难度，并使得在上下文学习过程中能够明确量化那些错误生成的依赖关系。

papers.title: Long-Chain Reasoning Distillation via Adaptive Prefix Alignment
papers.title_zh: 通过自适应前缀对齐实现长链推理蒸馏
papers.authors: Zhenghao Liu, Zhuoyang Wu, Xinze Li, Yukun Yan, Shuo Wang, Zulong Chen, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities, particularly in solving complex mathematical problems. Recent studies show that distilling long reasoning trajectories can effectively enhance the reasoning performance of small-scale student models. However, teacher-generated reasoning trajectories are often excessively long and structurally complex, making them difficult for student models to learn. This mismatch leads to a gap between the provided supervision signal and the learning capacity of the student model. To address this challenge, we propose Prefix-ALIGNment distillation (P-ALIGN), a framework that fully exploits teacher CoTs for distillation through adaptive prefix alignment. Specifically, P-ALIGN adaptively truncates teacher-generated reasoning trajectories by determining whether the remaining suffix is concise and sufficient to guide the student model. Then, P-ALIGN leverages the teacher-generated prefix to supervise the student model, encouraging effective prefix alignment. Experiments on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that P-ALIGN outperforms all baselines by over 3%. Further analysis indicates that the prefixes constructed by P-ALIGN provide more effective supervision signals, while avoiding the negative impact of redundant and uncertain reasoning components. All codes are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/P-ALIGN.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解决复杂数学问题方面展现出了卓越的推理能力。最近的研究表明，通过提取长推理轨迹可以有效提升小型学生模型的推理性能。然而，教师生成的推理轨迹往往过于冗长且结构复杂，这使得学生模型难以理解这些复杂的推理过程。这种不匹配导致所提供的监督信号与学生模型的学习能力之间存在差距。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Prefix-ALIGNment蒸馏算法，该算法通过自适应前缀对齐技术，充分利用教师的推理轨迹进行蒸馏。具体来说，P-ALIGN能够自适应地截断教师生成的推理轨迹，判断剩余的后缀部分是否简洁且足以指导学生模型。同时，P-ALIGN利用教师生成的前缀来监督学生模型，从而促进有效的前缀对齐。在多个数学推理基准测试中的实验表明，P-ALIGN的性能优于所有基线方法，其性能提升了3%以上。进一步分析表明，P-ALIGN构建的前缀提供了更有效的监督信号，同时避免了冗余和不确定的推理成分带来的负面影响。所有代码均可在此处获取：https://github.com/NEUIR/P-ALIGN

papers.title: TRN-R1-Zero: Text-rich Network Reasoning via LLMs with Reinforcement Learning Only
papers.title_zh: TRN-R1-Zero：基于大语言模型的网络推理技术，仅通过强化学习来实现文本处理功能
papers.authors: Yilun Liu, Ruihong Qiu, Zi Huang
papers.abstract: Zero-shot reasoning on text-rich networks (TRNs) remains a challenging frontier, as models must integrate textual semantics with relational structure without task-specific supervision. While graph neural networks rely on fixed label spaces and supervised objectives, recent large language model (LLM)-based approaches often overlook graph context or depend on distillation from larger models, limiting generalisation. We propose TRN-R1-Zero, a post-training framework for TRN reasoning trained solely via reinforcement learning. TRN-R1-Zero directly optimises base LLMs using a Neighbour-aware Group Relative Policy Optimisation objective that dynamically adjusts rewards based on a novel margin gain metric for the informativeness of neighbouring signals, effectively guiding the model toward relational reasoning. Unlike prior methods, TRN-R1-Zero requires no supervised fine-tuning or chain-of-thought data generated from large reasoning models. Extensive experiments across citation, hyperlink, social and co-purchase TRN benchmarks demonstrate the superiority and robustness of TRN-R1-Zero. Beyond cross-domain transfer, TRN-R1-Zero, trained solely on node-level tasks, further generalises to edge- and graph-level tasks in a zero-shot manner. The codebase is open-source at https://github.com/superallen13/TRN-R1-Zero.
papers.abstract_zh: 在文本丰富的网络上进行零样本推理仍然是一个具有挑战性的领域，因为模型需要在没有特定任务监督的情况下，将文本语义与关系结构结合起来。虽然图神经网络依赖于固定的标签空间和有监督的目标，但最近基于大语言模型的解决方法往往忽略了图上下文，或者依赖于从更大模型中提取信息，这限制了模型的泛化能力。我们提出了TRN-R1-Zero这一训练后推理框架，该框架仅通过强化学习进行训练。TRN-R1-Zero直接使用基于邻居感知的群体相对策略优化目标来优化基础语言模型，该目标会根据一种新颖的信息增益指标动态调整奖励，从而有效地引导模型进行关系推理。与以往的方法不同，TRN-R1-Zero不需要有监督的微调，也不需要来自大型推理模型生成的思维链数据。在引用、超链接、社交关系和共同购买等文本丰富网络的基准测试中进行的广泛实验证明了TRN-R1-Zero的优越性和鲁棒性。除了跨领域迁移能力外，仅在节点级任务上训练的TRN-R1-Zero还能以零样本的方式进一步泛化到边级和图级任务。该代码库可以在https://github.com/superallen13/TRN-R1-Zero下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Threshold Differential Attention for Sink-Free, Ultra-Sparse, and Non-Dispersive Language Modeling
papers.title_zh: 用于无湮灭、超稀疏且无色散语言建模的阈值差分注意力机制
papers.authors: Xingyue Huang, Xueying Ding, Mingxuan Ju, Yozen Liu, Neil Shah, Tong Zhao
papers.abstract: Softmax attention struggles with long contexts due to structural limitations: the strict sum-to-one constraint forces attention sinks on irrelevant tokens, while probability mass disperses as sequence lengths increase. We tackle these problems with Threshold Differential Attention (TDA), a sink-free attention mechanism that achieves ultra-sparsity and improved robustness at longer sequence lengths without the computational overhead of projection methods or the performance degradation caused by noise accumulation of standard rectified attention. TDA applies row-wise extreme-value thresholding with a length-dependent gate, retaining only exceedances. Inspired by the differential transformer, TDA also subtracts an inhibitory view to enhance expressivity. Theoretically, we prove that TDA controls the expected number of spurious survivors per row to O(1) and that consensus spurious matches across independent views vanish as context grows. Empirically, TDA produces >99 % exact zeros and eliminates attention sinks while maintaining competitive performance on standard and long-context benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: Softmax注意力机制在处理长上下文时存在困难，这是由于其结构上的限制：严格的求和至一约束使得注意力会集中在不相关的标记上，而随着序列长度的增加，概率质量会分散。我们采用了阈值差分注意力机制来解决这个问题。这种注意力机制无需集中注意力于某些标记，能够实现超稀疏性，并且在更长的序列长度下仍能保持良好的鲁棒性，同时避免了投影方法带来的计算开销，也避免了标准修正注意力机制因噪声累积而导致的性能下降。阈值差分注意力机制采用逐行极值阈值处理，并引入与长度相关的门控机制，只保留超过阈值的元素。受差分Transformer的启发，该机制还加入了抑制性视图，以增强模型的表达能力。理论上，我们证明了阈值差分注意力机制能够将对每行产生的虚假幸存者数量控制在O(1)范围内，并且随着上下文的延长，不同视图之间的共识虚假匹配现象也会消失。实证结果表明，阈值差分注意力机制能够产生超过99%的精确零值，同时还能消除注意力集中的问题，并在标准及长上下文基准测试中保持竞争力。

papers.title: PRiSM: Benchmarking Phone Realization in Speech Models
papers.title_zh: PRiSM：语音模型实现方面的基准测试
papers.authors: Shikhar Bharadwaj, Chin-Jou Li, Yoonjae Kim, Kwanghee Choi, Eunjung Yeo, Ryan Soh-Eun Shim, Hanyu Zhou, Brendon Boldt, Karen Rosero, Kalvin Chang, Darsh Agrawal, Keer Xu, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Jian Zhu, Shinji Watanabe, David R. Mortensen
papers.abstract: Phone recognition (PR) serves as the atomic interface for language-agnostic modeling for cross-lingual speech processing and phonetic analysis. Despite prolonged efforts in developing PR systems, current evaluations only measure surface-level transcription accuracy. We introduce PRiSM, the first open-source benchmark designed to expose blind spots in phonetic perception through intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation of PR systems. PRiSM standardizes transcription-based evaluation and assesses downstream utility in clinical, educational, and multilingual settings with transcription and representation probes. We find that diverse language exposure during training is key to PR performance, encoder-CTC models are the most stable, and specialized PR systems still outperform LALMs. PRiSM releases code, recipes, and datasets to move the field toward multilingual speech models with robust phonetic ability.
papers.abstract_zh: 语音识别技术是跨语言语音处理与语音分析领域中的一种基础接口，它无需考虑语言差异即可进行建模。尽管在语音识别系统的开发方面已经付出了大量努力，但目前的评估方式仅能衡量表面的转录准确性。我们提出了PRiSM这一开源基准测试工具，它通过内部和外部评估来揭示语音识别系统中的缺陷。PRiSM实现了基于转录的评估标准，并通过转录和表示测试来评估其在临床、教育以及多语言场景中的实用性。我们发现，在训练过程中接触多种语言对于提升语音识别性能至关重要；其中，编码器-CTC模型最为稳定；而且，专门的语音识别系统仍然优于传统的LALM方法。PRiSM发布了相关的代码、算法框架以及数据集，旨在推动该领域朝着开发具有强大语音识别能力的多语言语音模型的方向发展。

papers.title: Your Reasoning Benchmark May Not Test Reasoning: Revealing Perception Bottleneck in Abstract Reasoning Benchmarks
papers.title_zh: 你的推理能力测试可能并不真正反映真实的推理水平：抽象推理测试中隐藏着感知方面的障碍
papers.authors: Xinhe Wang, Jin Huang, Xingjian Zhang, Tianhao Wang, Jiaqi W. Ma
papers.abstract: Reasoning benchmarks such as the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) and ARC-AGI are widely used to assess progress in artificial intelligence and are often interpreted as probes of core, so-called “fluid” reasoning abilities. Despite their apparent simplicity for humans, these tasks remain challenging for frontier vision-language models (VLMs), a gap commonly attributed to deficiencies in machine reasoning. We challenge this interpretation and hypothesize that the gap arises primarily from limitations in visual perception rather than from shortcomings in inductive reasoning.To verify this hypothesis, we introduce a two-stage experimental pipeline that explicitly separates perception and reasoning. In the perception stage, each image is independently converted into a natural-language description, while in the reasoning stage a model induces and applies rules using these descriptions. This design prevents leakage of cross-image inductive signals and isolates reasoning from perception bottlenecks. Across three ARC-style datasets, Mini-ARC, ACRE, and Bongard-LOGO, we show that the perception capability is the dominant factor underlying the observed performance gap by comparing the two-stage pipeline with against standard end-to-end one-stage evaluation. Manual inspection of reasoning traces in the VLM outputs further reveals that approximately 80 percent of model failures stem from perception errors. Together, these results demonstrate that ARC-style benchmarks conflate perceptual and reasoning challenges and that observed performance gaps may overstate deficiencies in machine reasoning. Our findings underscore the need for evaluation protocols that disentangle perception from reasoning when assessing progress in machine intelligence.
papers.abstract_zh: 像抽象与推理语料库（ARC）以及ARC-AGI这样的推理基准测试被广泛用于评估人工智能的进展，这些测试通常被视为衡量所谓“流体”推理能力的核心指标。尽管这些任务对人类来说看似简单，但对于前沿的视觉语言模型来说却非常具有挑战性，这种差距通常被认为是由于机器推理能力的不足造成的。我们对此解释提出质疑，认为这种差距主要源于视觉感知方面的局限性，而非归纳推理能力的缺陷。为了验证这一假设，我们引入了一种两阶段实验流程，该流程明确区分了感知和推理两个环节。在感知阶段，每张图像都被独立转换为自然语言描述；而在推理阶段，模型则利用这些描述来推导并应用规则。这种设计避免了跨图像归纳信息的泄露，使推理过程与感知瓶颈分离开来。通过对三个ARC风格的数据集——Mini-ARC、ACRE和Bongard-LOGO进行实验，我们发现，感知能力是造成性能差异的主要因素。通过将这种两阶段流程与标准的端到端单阶段评估方法进行比较，我们发现大约80%的模型失败是由于感知错误导致的。此外，对视觉语言模型输出的推理轨迹进行手动检查后发现，模型失败的原因中约有80%是感知错误。综上所述，这些结果表明，ARC风格的基准测试将感知和推理挑战混为一谈，而观察到的性能差距可能夸大了机器推理能力的不足。我们的研究结果强调了在评估机器智能进展时，需要采用能够分离感知与推理过程的评估方案。

papers.title: Model-Based Imaginative Planning for Embodied Agents
papers.title_zh: 基于模型的具身智能体想象式规划
papers.authors: Junru Song, Hengzhe Jin, Yucong Huang, Tingsong Jiang, Weien Zhou, Feifei Wang, Yang Yang, Ying Wen, Wen Yao
papers.abstract: Reasoning and planning critically rely on a predictive dynamics model. In symbolic domains such as mathematics and code, large language models (LLMs) internalize transition rules during pretraining, allowing reinforcement learning or test-time scaling to effectively elicit and generalize their reasoning ability. Embodied decision making is fundamentally different: agents must reason from sparse visual evidence under partial observability, while coping with environment-specific dynamics and affordances not captured by language priors. Here we propose IMPLEMENT, a model-based reasoning framework that enables frozen LLMs to perform imaginative planning. A lightweight world model converts raw pixels into object-centric symbolic states amenable to language-based reasoning, and predicts their evolution under hypothetical actions. To address partial observability, we perform Monte Carlo state prediction via temperature sampling, enabling decision evaluation over multiple plausible futures. To support adaptation to unseen environments, we integrate Meta In-Context Learning, conditioning the world model on interaction history to continuously refine its predictions. At inference time, the LLM and world model form a tight co-reasoning loop: the LLM proposes candidate actions, the world model simulates future trajectories, and the LLM refines its decisions, effectively inducing an online policy iteration scheme. Extensive experiments in ALFWorld demonstrate consistent advantages over finetuning-based and strong test-time scaling approaches, validating IMPLEMENT as an effective framework for grounding language agents in visual embodied environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理和规划在很大程度上依赖于预测性动态模型。在像数学和代码这样的符号领域，大语言模型在预训练过程中会内化各种转换规则，从而允许在测试时进行强化学习或调整规模，以有效激发并泛化其推理能力。而具身决策则截然不同：智能体必须在部分可观测性的情况下，从有限的视觉信息中进行推理，同时还要应对环境特有的动态特性和语言先验所无法捕捉的约束条件。在这里，我们提出了IMPLEMENT这一基于模型的推理框架，它能够让冻结的语言模型执行富有想象力的规划。该框架包含一个轻量级世界模型，可以将原始像素转换为以物体为中心的符号状态，以便于基于语言的推理，并预测这些状态在假设性行动下的演变情况。为了解决部分可观测性问题，我们通过温度采样技术进行蒙特卡洛状态预测，从而能够在多个可能的未来状态下进行决策评估。为了适应未知环境，我们整合了元上下文学习机制，通过结合交互历史来不断优化世界模型的预测精度。在推理阶段，语言模型和世界模型形成了一个紧密的协同推理机制：语言模型提出候选行动方案，世界模型模拟未来的发展轨迹，而语言模型则进一步完善其决策方案，从而实现在线策略迭代的效果。在ALFWorld中的大量实验表明，IMPLEMENT相较于基于微调的方法和强大的测试时扩展方法具有显著优势，这验证了IMPLEMENT作为在视觉具身环境中为语言智能体提供支持的有效框架。

papers.title: Persona-Grounded Safety Evaluation of AI Companions in Multi-Turn Conversations
papers.title_zh: 在多轮对话中评估人工智能伴侣的安全性
papers.authors: Prerna Juneja, Lika Lomidze
papers.abstract: There are growing concerns about the risks posed by AI companion applications designed for emotional engagement. Existing safety evaluations often rely on self-reported user data or interviews, offering limited insights into real-time dynamics. We present the first end-to-end scalable framework for controlled simulation and safety evaluation of multi-turn interactions with AI companion applications. Our framework integrates four key components: persona construction with clinical and psychometric validation, persona-specific scenario generation, scenario-driven multi-turn simulation with a dialogue refinement module that preserves persona fidelity, and harm evaluation. We apply this framework to evaluate how Replika, a widely used AI companion app, responds to high-risk user groups. We construct 9 personas representing individuals with depression, anxiety, PTSD, eating disorders, and incel identity, and collect 1,674 dialogue pairs across 25 high-risk scenarios. We combine emotion modeling and LLM–assisted utterance-and harm-level classification to analyze these exchanges. Results show that Replika exhibits a narrow emotional range dominated by curiosity and care, while frequently mirroring or normalizing unsafe content such as self-harm, disordered eating, and violent-fantasy narratives. These findings highlight how controlled persona simulations can serve as a scalable testbed for evaluating safety risks in AI companions.
papers.abstract_zh: 人们对用于情感互动的AI伴侣应用程序所带来的风险越来越担忧。现有的安全评估往往依赖于用户自述的数据或访谈，这无法提供关于实时互动情况的真实洞察。我们提出了首个端到端可扩展的框架，用于模拟和评估与AI伴侣应用程序的多轮交互安全性。该框架包含四个关键组成部分：通过临床和心理测量方法进行角色构建、针对特定角色的情境生成、基于情境的多轮模拟以及能够保持角色真实性的对话优化模块，还有危害评估环节。我们应用这一框架来评估广泛使用的AI伴侣应用程序Replika如何应对高风险用户群体。我们构建了9个代表不同问题的角色，包括患有抑郁症、焦虑症、创伤后应激障碍、饮食失调以及“厌女症”身份的人，并在25种高风险情境下收集了1,674对对话数据。我们通过情绪建模和大语言模型辅助的言论分析以及危害等级分类来分析这些对话内容。结果表明，Replika表现出较为狭窄的情感反应范围，主要体现为好奇心和关怀感，同时经常模仿或规范化一些不安全的内容，如自我伤害、饮食失调以及暴力幻想等主题。这些发现表明，可控的角色模拟可以作为一种可扩展的测试平台，用于评估AI伴侣应用程序中的安全风险。

papers.title: Beyond Chunking: Discourse-Aware Hierarchical Retrieval for Long Document Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 超越分块处理：基于话语感知的层次化检索方法在长文档问答中的应用
papers.authors: Huiyao Chen, Yi Yang, Yinghui Li, Meishan Zhang, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Existing long-document question answering systems typically process texts as flat sequences or use heuristic chunking, which overlook the discourse structures that naturally guide human comprehension. We present a discourse-aware hierarchical framework that leverages rhetorical structure theory (RST) for long document question answering. Our approach converts discourse trees into sentence-level representations and employs LLM-enhanced node representations to bridge structural and semantic information. The framework involves three key innovations: language-universal discourse parsing for lengthy documents, LLM-based enhancement of discourse relation nodes, and structure-guided hierarchical retrieval. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over existing approaches through the incorporation of discourse structure, across multiple genres and languages. Moreover, the proposed framework exhibits strong robustness across diverse document types and linguistic settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的长文档问答系统通常将文本处理为扁平的序列，或者使用启发式的分块方法，这忽略了那些自然引导人类理解的语篇结构。我们提出了一种注重语篇结构的分层框架，该框架利用修辞结构理论来进行长文档问答。我们的方法将语篇树转换为句子级别的表示，并采用基于大语言模型的节点表示来连接结构和语义信息。该框架包含三个关键创新点：针对长文档的通用语篇解析方法、基于大语言模型的对语篇关系节点的增强处理，以及以结构为导向的分层检索机制。在四个数据集上的广泛实验表明，通过融入语篇结构，该框架能够在多种体裁和语言环境中取得持续的改进。此外，所提出的框架在不同类型的文档和语言环境下也表现出强大的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Beyond Value Benchmarks: Measuring Value-Structure Alignment in Large Language Models via Symmetric Q-Sorts
papers.title_zh: 超越价值标准：通过对称Q排序来衡量大型语言模型中的价值与结构匹配程度
papers.authors: Jingting Zheng, Yuqi Ren, Linhao Yu, Yongqi Leng, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in contexts requiring complex moral reasoning and value trade-offs. However, existing evaluations typically rely on item-level behavioral metrics, which fail to capture how models structurally prioritize competing values as a cohesive system. To address this, we propose a symmetric human-LLM evaluation framework, grounded in Q methodology, to measure value-structure alignment. Under our protocol, humans and models sort an identical 140-item moral statement set into a shared nine-column forced distribution; for LLMs, we elicit strict rankings and deterministically map them to Q-sort buckets. Using a human reference sample (N=35), we establish a stable three-factor reference geometry specific to this instrument and sample. We evaluate 12 LLMs across four model families via 240 replicated Q-sorts at two temperature settings, quantifying structural alignment via Procrustes similarity (\phi) and RSA-based Spearman correlation (\rho). Our results reveal significant cross-family heterogeneity, model-specific sensitivity to generation stochasticity and localized misalignment, which demonstrate that favorable global scores can obscure underlying regional distortions. While rank- and bucket-based analyses remain highly consistent, prompt phrasing introduces notable variance. Ultimately, assessing value-structure alignment provides a crucial structural complement to traditional itemwise moral benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在需要复杂道德推理和价值权衡的场景中得到了广泛应用。然而，现有的评估方法通常依赖于项目级别的行为指标，这些指标无法捕捉到模型如何作为一个整体系统来优先处理不同的价值。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种基于Q方法的对称式人类与语言模型评估框架，以衡量价值结构与模型之间的对齐程度。在我们的评估协议中，人类和模型会对一个包含140个项目的道德陈述集进行排序，这些项目都是按照九列的形式呈现的；对于语言模型而言，我们会获取它们严格的排序结果，并将其确定性地映射到Q排序的等级中。通过使用一个包含35名人类的参考样本，我们建立了一个适用于该工具和样本的稳定的三因素参考结构。我们对12种语言模型进行了评估，这些模型来自四个不同的模型家族，通过240次重复的Q排序实验，并在两种不同的温度设置下进行评估。我们通过Procrustes相似度(\phi)和基于RSA的Spearman相关性(\rho)来量化结构上的对齐程度。我们的研究结果揭示了不同模型家族之间的显著异质性、模型对生成随机性的敏感性以及局部的对齐偏差。这表明，虽然总体评分可能看起来不错，但实际上可能存在一些潜在的区域性问题。尽管基于排名和等级的分析结果仍然非常一致，但提示语的不同会导致显著的差异。总的来说，评估价值结构与模型之间的对齐程度为传统的基于项目的道德评估提供了重要的结构性补充。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Would LLMs be Good Historical Linguists and Chinese Dialect Learners?
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能成为出色的历史语言学家和汉语方言研究者吗？
papers.authors: Yicheng Liu, Shumin Shi, Youchao Zhou, Xingchen Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on Standard Chinese but struggle with low-resource Chinese dialects due to substantial phonological divergence. We investigate whether incorporating Middle Chinese, the common historical ancestor of most of the modern Chinese dialects, can improve dialectal pronunciation modeling in a linguistically interpretable manner. We focus on two specific task variants: (1) conditional sound change rule induction (a variant of Sound Law Induction, SLI), where models infer executable phonological transformation rules from Middle Chinese to modern dialects, and (2) sentence-level dialectal pronunciation transcription (a variant of Grapheme-to-Phoneme, G2P), requiring dialect-specific International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) generation. We construct a multi-source dataset covering Middle Chinese and 12 modern Chinese dialects, including character-level correspondences, rule exemplars, and sentence-level IPA transcription. We adopt a parameter-efficient training framework combining LoRA-based supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for the first task. Across both tasks and a wide range of dialects and evaluation metrics, our approach achieves overall improvements over strong baselines, including DeepSeek-V3.2 and ChatGPT-5.2, while revealing variation across dialects. These results demonstrate the value of leveraging historical linguistic knowledge for modeling low-resource Chinese dialects.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在标准中文上的表现良好，但在低资源中文方言方面却存在困难，因为这些方言在音韵上存在显著的差异。我们研究将现代汉语方言的共同历史祖先——中古汉语纳入模型，是否能够以可解释的方式改善方言发音的建模效果。我们重点关注两种具体的任务变体：(1)条件音变规则归纳（Sound Law Induction的变体），模型从中古汉语推断出适用于现代方言的音韵转换规则；(2)句子级方言发音转录（Grapheme-to-Phoneme的变体），需要生成特定方言的国际音标。我们构建了一个包含中古汉语和12种现代中文方言的多源数据集，其中包括字符级对应、规则示例以及句子级国际音标转录。对于第一项任务，我们采用了一种参数效率高的训练框架，结合了基于LoRA的监督式微调以及通过Group Relative Policy Optimization实现的强化学习方法。在两项任务中，无论涉及哪些方言以及使用何种评估指标，我们的方法都取得了优于强基线模型的性能，包括DeepSeek-V3.2和ChatGPT-5.2。同时，我们的方法还揭示了不同方言之间的音韵差异。这些结果表明，利用历史语言知识来建模低资源中文方言是非常有价值的。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ProActor: Timing-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Task Scheduling Agents
papers.title_zh: ProActor：基于时间感知的强化学习，用于主动任务调度智能体开发
papers.authors: Lei Ding, Bin He, Chenguang Wang, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Proactive task-oriented agents must autonomously anticipate user needs, identify actionable opportunities, and trigger software actions at appropriate moments—fundamentally shifting from reactive systems that await explicit instructions. However, existing approaches lack generalizable end-to-end solutions for measuring and optimizing such anticipatory behaviors.This paper introduces ProActor, a unified framework for conversational task scheduling that integrates: (1) a domain-agnostic automated annotation methodology that enables scalable proactiveness reinforcement learning (RL) by generating full opportunity time windows instead of rigid point labels, (2) systematic proactiveness metrics capturing both timing quality and reference action alignment, and (3) RL optimization using GRPO with various reward designs. Our insight is that RULER-based rewards with proactiveness rubrics are crucial for improving timing quality, and that proactiveness optimization enabled by stage-aware composite rewards is key to balancing timing quality and reference action alignment.Furthermore, we introduce ART-F, an adaptive RL framework that combines request-adaptive inference clusters with asynchronous training for better GPU utilization, enabling LoRA training of 4-bit Qwen2.5-14B-ProActor-Q4 models on 4×H200 and 8×H100 GPUs with substantial speedups. Experiments on two newly auto-annotated datasets demonstrate significant improvements in proactive timing while maintaining action consistency comparable to state-of-the-art baselines. Ablations validate the effectiveness of distinct composite reward variations.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动型任务导向的智能体必须能够自主预测用户需求、识别可行的机会点，并在适当的时候触发相应的软件操作——这从根本上改变了传统系统那种需要等待明确指令的反应式模式。然而，现有的方法缺乏用于衡量和优化这种主动行为的通用性解决方案。本文介绍了ProActor，这是一个统一的对话式任务调度框架，该框架包含以下特点：(1)一种与领域无关的自动化注释方法，通过生成完整的机会时间窗口而非固定的时间点标签，从而实现可扩展的主动性强化学习；(2)一套系统的主动性评估指标，能够同时考量时间精度与参考动作的匹配程度；(3)采用GRPO算法进行强化学习优化，并设计多种奖励机制。我们的研究发现，基于RULER的奖励机制对于提升时间精度至关重要，而通过阶段感知的复合奖励来优化主动性则有助于平衡时间精度与参考动作匹配度。此外，我们还提出了ART-F自适应强化学习框架，该框架结合了请求自适应推理集群和异步训练技术，从而更好地利用GPU资源，使得LoRA训练能够在4×H200和8×H100级别的GPU上运行4比特Qwen2.5-14B-ProActor-Q4模型，并显著提升了训练效率。在两个新自动注释的数据集上的实验表明，该框架在保持动作一致性的同时，在时间精度方面取得了显著改进，其效果可与最先进的基准模型相媲美。消融实验进一步验证了不同复合奖励方式的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Seeing No Evil: Blinding Large Vision-Language Models to Safety Instructions via Adversarial Attention Hijacking
papers.title_zh: 视而不见：通过对抗性注意力劫持技术，让大型视觉语言模型能够遵守安全指令
papers.authors: Jingru Li, Wei Ren, Tianqing Zhu
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) rely on attention-based retrieval of safety instructions to maintain alignment during generation. Existing attacks typically optimize image perturbations to maximize harmful output likelihood, but suffer from slow convergence due to gradient conflict between adversarial objectives and the model’s safety-retrieval mechanism. We propose Attention-Guided Visual Jailbreaking, which circumvents rather than overpowers safety alignment by directly manipulating attention patterns. Our method introduces two simple auxiliary objectives: (1) suppressing attention to system-prompt tokens and (2) anchoring generation on adversarial image features. This simple yet effective push-pull formulation reduces gradient conflict by 45% and achieves 94.4% attack success rate on Qwen-VL (vs. 68.8% baseline) with 40% fewer iterations. At tighter perturbation budgets (\epsilon=8/255), we maintain 59.0% ASR compared to 45.7% for standard methods. Mechanistic analysis reveals a failure mode we term safety blindness: successful attacks suppress system-prompt attention by 80%, causing models to generate harmful content not by overriding safety rules, but by failing to retrieve them.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型在生成过程中需要依赖基于注意力的安全指令检索机制来维持对齐状态。现有的攻击方法通常通过优化图像扰动来最大化有害输出的概率，但由于对抗目标与模型的安全检索机制之间的梯度冲突，这些方法的收敛速度较慢。我们提出了一种“注意力引导的视觉越狱”方法，该方法通过直接操控注意力模式来绕过安全对齐机制，而不是试图完全压制它。我们的方法引入了两个简单的辅助目标：(1) 抑制对系统提示标记的注意力；(2) 将生成过程建立在对抗性图像特征上。这种简单而有效的策略能够将梯度冲突减少45%，并且在Qwen-VL模型上的攻击成功率达到了94.4%（相比之下，基准方法的成功率为68.8%），同时减少了40%的迭代次数。在更严格的扰动预算下（ε=8/255），我们的方法仍然能够保持59.0%的攻击成功率，而标准方法的准确率为45.7%。机制分析发现了一个失败模式，我们将其称为“安全盲点”：成功的攻击能够将系统提示标记的注意力抑制80%，导致模型生成有害内容的方式不是通过直接违反安全规则，而是因为无法检索到这些安全规则。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CADMate: Generating CAD Assembly Plan with Geometric Chain-of-Thought and Spatial Physical Rewards
papers.title_zh: CADMate：通过几何推理和空间物理奖励机制来生成CAD装配图
papers.authors: Jiali Chen, DingBa Fu, Xusen Hei, Yuhang Liu, Yiyang Chen, Jiayuan Xie, Wenqi Fan, Yi Cai
papers.abstract: Computer-aided design (CAD) is crucial in prototyping complex 3D objects through precise geometric modeling. In practical design workflows, designers manually define assembly sequences for individual CAD parts, a process that is both time-consuming and expertise-intensive. To address this challenge, we formulate CAD assembly as a parametric action prediction task: given a reference design image and disassembled parts, the model predicts 6-DoF transformations (, actions) to progressively assemble each part. This paradigm enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to solve the task through autoregressive action generation. While recent MLLMs demonstrate promising spatial reasoning, they struggle with fine-grained geometric structure understanding and physical collision avoidance during assembly. In this paper, we propose CADMate, an MLLM-based framework for sequential CAD assembly action generation. Our training strategy comprises three stages: (i) CAD domain adaptation for spatial geometry and position understanding, (ii) supervised fine-tuning with geometric chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for action generation, and (iii) reinforcement learning with spatial-physical rewards jointly optimize spatial accuracy and collision avoidance. Additionally, we also construct CADBuilder dataset, comprising over 45K CAD assemblies with annotated action sequences. Our experiments demonstrate that CADMate significantly outperforms existing prominent MLLMs (, GPT-5), showing great potential in design applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）在通过精确的几何建模来创建复杂的3D物体原型方面起着至关重要的作用。在实际的设计工作流程中，设计师需要手动定义各个CAD部件的组装顺序，这一过程既耗时又需要专业知识。为了应对这一挑战，我们将CAD组装任务转化为一个参数化的动作预测任务：给定参考设计图像和分解后的部件，模型会预测6个自由度的变换动作，从而逐步组装每个部件。这种范式使得多模态大语言模型能够通过自回归动作生成方法来完成这项任务。虽然最近出现的大语言模型在空间推理方面表现出良好的性能，但在理解精细的几何结构以及组装过程中避免物理碰撞方面仍然存在困难。在本文中，我们提出了CADMate框架，这是一个基于大语言模型的序列CAD组装动作生成工具。我们的训练策略包括三个阶段：(i) 针对空间几何和位置理解的CAD领域适应性训练；(ii) 通过几何思维链推理进行有监督的微调，以生成动作；(iii) 结合空间-物理奖励的强化学习，从而同时优化空间精度和碰撞避免能力。此外，我们还构建了一个名为CADBuilder的数据集，其中包含超过45,000个带有注释动作序列的CAD组装实例。我们的实验表明，CADMate在性能上显著优于现有的主流大语言模型（如GPT-5），显示出其在设计应用中的巨大潜力。

papers.title: Semantic-Aware Logical Reasoning via a Semiotic Framework
papers.title_zh: 基于符号学框架的语义感知逻辑推理
papers.authors: Yunyao Zhang, Xinglang Zhang, Junxi Sheng, Wenbing Li, Junqing Yu, Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen, Wei Yang, Zikai Song
papers.abstract: Logical reasoning is a fundamental capability of large language models (LLMs). However, existing studies largely overlook the interplay between logical complexity and semantic complexity, limiting their robustness under abstract propositions, ambiguous contexts, and conflicting stances, which are central to human reasoning. We propose LogicAgent, a semiotic-square–guided framework that jointly addresses these two axes of difficulty. The semiotic square provides a principled structure for multi-perspective semantic analysis, and LogicAgent integrates automated deduction with reflective verification to manage logical complexity across deeper reasoning chains. To evaluate reasoning under coupled semantic and logical complexity, we introduce RepublicQA, a benchmark that contains abstract propositions with systematically constructed contrary and contradictory forms, providing a semantically rich setting for assessing logical reasoning in LLMs. Experiments show that LogicAgent achieves state-of-the-art performance on RepublicQA with a 6.25% average gain, and generalizes well to four mainstream logical reasoning benchmarks with an additional 7.05% improvement, highlighting the effectiveness of our semiotic-grounded multi-perspective reasoning in boosting LLMs’ logical performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 逻辑推理是大语言模型的基本能力之一。然而，现有的研究大多忽略了逻辑复杂性与语义复杂性之间的相互作用，这限制了模型在抽象命题、模糊语境以及相互冲突的立场下的鲁棒性，而这些因素正是人类推理的核心要素。我们提出了LogicAgent这一基于符号矩阵的框架，它能够同时解决这两个难题。符号矩阵为多视角语义分析提供了原则性的结构，而LogicAgent则通过将自动推导与反思性验证相结合，来应对更深层次的推理过程中的逻辑复杂性问题。为了评估在语义和逻辑复杂性共存情况下的推理能力，我们引入了RepublicQA这一基准测试，该测试包含具有系统性构建的矛盾与对立形式的抽象命题，为评估大语言模型的逻辑推理能力提供了一个丰富的语义环境。实验表明，LogicAgent在RepublicQA上的表现达到了最先进水平，平均提升了6.25%的性能；此外，它在四个主流逻辑推理基准测试中的表现也有所提升，额外提高了7.05%的性能。这些结果表明，基于符号矩阵的多视角推理方法在提升大语言模型的逻辑推理能力方面具有显著效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Calibration-Aware Policy Optimization for Reasoning LLMs
papers.title_zh: 基于校准的策略优化方法，用于逻辑推理大型语言模型
papers.authors: Ziqi Wang, Xingzhou Lou, Meiqi Wu, Zhengqi Wen, Junge Zhang
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) enhances LLM reasoning but often induces overconfidence, where incorrect responses yield lower perplexity than correct ones, degrading relative calibration as described by the Area Under the Curve (AUC). Existing approaches either yield limited improvements in calibration or sacrifice gains in reasoning accuracy. We first prove that this degradation in GRPO-style algorithms stems from their uncertainty-agnostic advantage estimation, which inevitably misaligns optimization gradients with calibration. This leads to improved accuracy at the expense of degraded calibration. We then propose Calibration-Aware Policy Optimization (CAPO). It adopts a logistic AUC surrogate loss that is theoretically consistent and admits regret bound, enabling uncertainty-aware advantage estimation. By further incorporating a noise masking mechanism, CAPO achieves stable learning dynamics that jointly optimize calibration and accuracy. Experiments on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that CAPO-1.5B significantly improves calibration by up to 15% while achieving accuracy comparable to or better than GRPO, and further boosts accuracy on downstream inference-time scaling tasks by up to 5%. Moreover, when allowed to abstain under low-confidence conditions, CAPO achieves a Pareto-optimal precision–coverage trade-off, highlighting its practical value for hallucination mitigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 群体相对策略优化（GRPO）能够提升大语言模型的推理能力，但往往会导致过度自信的现象。错误的回答比正确的回答更能降低困惑度，从而降低了相对校准的效果，这一情况可以通过曲线下面积（AUC）来体现。现有的方法要么在校准方面改进有限，要么牺牲了推理准确性的提升。我们首先证明了GRPO风格算法出现这种退化现象的原因在于它们采用了一种与不确定性无关的优势估计方法，这不可避免地导致优化梯度与校准目标不一致。这就导致了准确性提升，而校准效果却有所下降。随后，我们提出了基于校准的策略优化（CAPO）方法。该方法采用逻辑斯蒂AUC替代损失函数，该损失函数在理论上是合理的，并且可以设定遗憾界限，从而实现基于不确定性的优势估计。通过引入噪声掩蔽机制，CAPO能够实现稳定的学习动态，同时优化校准和准确性。在多个数学推理基准测试中的实验表明，CAPO-1.5B在提高校准效果方面表现出显著优势，其校准效果提升了15%，而准确性则与GRPO相当或更好。此外，在下游推理时间扩展任务中，CAPO的准确性又提高了5%。而且，当在低置信度条件下允许放弃决策时，CAPO能够实现帕累托最优的精度与覆盖之间的平衡，这凸显了其在缓解幻觉问题方面的实际价值。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GBV-SQL: Guided Generation and SQL2Text Back-Translation Validation for Multi-Agent Text2SQL
papers.title_zh: GBV-SQL：引导式生成与SQL2Text反向翻译验证功能，适用于多智能体文本转SQL处理
papers.authors: Daojun Chen, Xi Wang, Shenyuan Ren, Qingzhi Ma, Pengpeng Zhao, An Liu
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models have significantly advanced Text2SQL generation, a critical semantic gap persists: syntactically valid queries can still misinterpret user intent. To mitigate this challenge, we propose GBV-SQL, a multi-agent framework that introduces Guided Generation with SQL2Text Back-translation Validation. In particular, a dedicated validator translates generated SQL back into natural language and checks whether its logic is aligned with the original question. Beyond the method itself, we also conduct a systematic audit of benchmark quality and introduce a typology of “Gold Errors” in Text2SQL datasets. Our analysis shows that benchmark issues can coexist with strong execution accuracy and can substantially affect evaluation outcomes. On the challenging BIRD benchmark, GBV-SQL achieves 63.23% execution accuracy, a 5.8% absolute improvement over the Deepseek-v3-based MAC-SQL setting. Under manually audited benchmark corrections, GBV-SQL reaches 96.5% (dev) and 97.6% (test) on Spider, and 90.42% on repaired BIRD dev, providing a diagnostic view of model behavior under improved gold quality. Our work contributes both a practical framework for semantic validation and an empirical analysis of benchmark integrity in Text2SQL evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在文本转SQL生成方面取得了显著进展，但仍然存在一个关键的语义问题：语法上有效的查询仍可能误解用户的意图。为了缓解这一挑战，我们提出了GBV-SQL框架，该框架采用多智能体方式，并结合了SQL2Text回译验证技术来实现引导式生成。具体来说，专门的验证器会将生成的SQL语句重新翻译成自然语言，并判断其逻辑是否与原始问题一致。除了该方法本身之外，我们还对基准测试的质量进行了系统性的审计，并定义了“黄金错误”的类型，这些错误存在于Text2SQL数据集中。我们的分析表明，基准测试的问题可能与较高的执行准确率并存，并且会显著影响评估结果。在具有挑战性的BIRD基准测试中，GBV-SQL达到了63.23%的执行准确率，比基于Deepseek-v3的MAC-SQL高出5.8%。在经过人工审核的基准测试修正后，GBV-SQL在Spider测试上的准确率达到96.5%（开发版），97.6%（测试版），而在修复后的BIRD开发版测试中则达到了90.42%，这为我们在提高黄金质量的情况下诊断模型行为提供了有力支持。我们的工作不仅为语义验证提供了一个实用的框架，还通过对Text2SQL评估中基准测试完整性的实证分析，为相关研究提供了有价值的参考。

papers.title: Branch-and-Browse: Efficient and Controllable Web Exploration with Tree-Structured Reasoning and Action Memory
papers.title_zh: 分支与浏览：利用树状推理和动作记忆实现高效且可控的网络探索
papers.authors: Shiqi He, Yue Cui, Xinyu Ma, Yaliang Li, Bolin Ding, Mosharaf Chowdhury
papers.abstract: Autonomous web agents powered by large language models (LLMs) show strong potential for performing goal-oriented tasks such as information retrieval, report generation, and online transactions. These agents mark a key step toward practical embodied reasoning in open web environments. However, existing approaches remain limited in reasoning depth and efficiency: vanilla linear methods fail at multi-step reasoning and lack effective backtracking, while other search strategies are coarse-grained and computationally costly. We introduce Branch-and-Browse, a fine-grained web agent framework that unifies structured reasoning-acting, contextual memory, and efficient execution. It (i) employs explicit subtask management with tree-structured exploration for controllable multi-branch reasoning, (ii) bootstraps exploration through efficient web state replay with background reasoning, and (iii) leverages a page action memory to share explored actions within and across sessions. On the WebArena benchmark, Branch-and-Browse achieves a task success rate of 35.8% and reduces execution time by up to 40.4% relative to state-of-the-art methods. These results demonstrate that Branch-and-Browse is a reliable and efficient framework for LLM-based web agents. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Branch_and_Browse/.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的自主网络代理在执行诸如信息检索、报告生成和在线交易等目标导向任务方面展现出巨大潜力。这些代理标志着实现开放网络环境中实用化推理的关键一步。然而，现有的方法在推理深度和效率方面仍然存在局限性：传统的线性方法无法处理多步骤推理，且缺乏有效的回溯机制；而其他搜索策略则过于粗糙，计算成本较高。我们提出了Branch-and-Browse这一细粒度网络代理框架，该框架整合了结构化推理、上下文记忆以及高效执行功能。该框架能够：(i) 通过树状结构的探索来实现对子任务的明确管理，从而实现可控的多分支推理；(ii) 通过高效的网络状态回放与背景推理来引导探索过程；(iii) 利用页面动作记忆来共享在不同会话中探索到的动作。在WebArena基准测试上，Branch-and-Browse的任务成功率达到了35.8%，并且与现有最先进方法相比，执行时间减少了40.4%。这些结果表明，Branch-and-Browse是一种可靠且高效的基于语言模型的网络代理框架。相关代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Branch_and_Browse/。

papers.title: Beyond End-to-End: Dynamic Chain Optimization for Private LLM Adaptation on the Edge
papers.title_zh: 超越端到端：动态链优化技术在边缘计算环境下私有大语言模型适配中的应用
papers.authors: Yebo Wu, Jingguang Li, Chunlin Tian, KaHou Tam, Zhijiang Guo, Li Li
papers.abstract: Federated fine-tuning enables privacy-preserving LLM adaptation but faces a critical bottleneck: the disparity between LLMs’ high memory demands and edge devices’ limited capacity. To break the memory barrier, we propose Chain Federated Fine-tuning (ChainFed), an innovative paradigm that forgoes end-to-end updates in favor of a sequential, layer-by-layer manner. It first trains the initial adapter to convergence, freezes its weights, and then proceeds to the next. This iterative train-and-freeze process forms an optimization chain, gradually enhancing the model’s task-specific proficiency. ChainFed further integrates three core techniques: 1) Dynamic Layer Co-Tuning to bridge semantic gaps between sequentially tuned layers and facilitate information flow; 2) Globally Perceptive Optimization to endow each adapter with foresight beyond its local objective; 3) Function-Oriented Adaptive Tuning to automatically identify the optimal fine-tuning starting point. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of ChainFed over existing methods, boosting average accuracy by up to 46.46%.
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦微调能够实现在保护隐私的前提下对大语言模型进行优化，但存在一个关键瓶颈：大语言模型高内存需求与边缘设备有限容量之间的不匹配问题。为了突破这一内存障碍，我们提出了链式联邦微调技术。这种技术摒弃了端到端的更新方式，而是采用逐层、顺序化的方式进行优化。首先训练初始适配器至收敛状态，然后冻结其权重，再继续处理下一个适配器。这种迭代式的训练与冻结过程构成了一个优化链条，逐步提升模型在特定任务上的性能。链式联邦微调还整合了三种核心技术：1）动态层协同调优，用于弥合逐层调整过程中存在的语义差异，促进信息流动；2）全局感知优化，使每个适配器具备超越局部目标的预见能力；3）功能导向的自适应调优，能够自动确定最佳的微调起点。在多个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，链式联邦微调相较于现有方法具有显著优势，平均准确率提升了高达46.46%。

papers.title: TalkLoRA: Communication-Aware Mixture of Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: TalkLoRA：适用于大型语言模型的、基于通信优化的低秩自适应混合方法
papers.authors: Lin Mu, Haiyang Wang, Li Ni, Lei Sang, Zhize Wu, Peiquan Jin, Yiwen Zhang
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs), and recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) extensions further enhance flexibility by dynamically combining multiple LoRA experts. However, existing MoE-augmented LoRA methods assume that experts operate independently, often leading to unstable routing, expert dominance. In this paper, we propose TalkLoRA, a communication-aware MoELoRA framework that relaxes this independence assumption by introducing expert-level communication prior to routing. TalkLoRA equips low-rank experts with a lightweight Talking Module that enables controlled information exchange across expert subspaces, producing a more robust global signal for routing. Theoretically, we show that expert communication smooths routing dynamics by mitigating perturbation amplification while strictly generalizing existing MoELoRA architectures. Empirically, TalkLoRA consistently outperforms vanilla LoRA and MoELoRA across diverse language understanding and generation tasks, achieving higher parameter efficiency and more balanced expert routing under comparable parameter budgets. These results highlight structured expert communication as a principled and effective enhancement for MoE-based parameter-efficient adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）能够实现大语言模型的高效微调，而最近的混合专家方法则通过动态组合多个LoRA专家来进一步提升灵活性。然而，现有的基于混合专家增强的LoRA方法假设各专家之间独立运作，这往往会导致路由不稳定以及专家之间的主导地位问题。在本文中，我们提出了TalkLoRA这一注重通信的MoELoRA框架，它通过引入专家级别的通信先验信息来打破这种独立性假设。TalkLoRA为低秩专家配备了一个轻量级“说话模块”，使得各专家子空间之间能够进行可控的信息交换，从而生成更稳定的全局路由信号。理论上，我们证明了专家间的通信能够平滑路由动态，同时有效抑制了扰动放大效应，同时还能严格泛化现有的MoELoRA架构。实证结果表明，TalkLoRA在多种语言理解和生成任务中始终优于传统的LoRA和MoELoRA方法，能够在相同的参数预算下实现更高的参数效率以及更平衡的专家路由分配。这些结果凸显了结构化专家通信作为基于混合专家的高效适应策略的显著优势。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TARE: Lightweight Token-Aware Representation Editing for Fine-tuning Transformer-like Models
papers.title_zh: TARE：一种轻量级、基于令牌的表示编辑技术，用于微调类似Transformer的模型
papers.authors: Yulong Wang, Siyu Zhao
papers.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) must balance effectiveness and efficiency: low-rank methods can be costly, while global representation edits often underfit token-level contexts. We propose Token-Aware Representation Editing (TARE), a PEFT method that performs fine-grained, token-specific edits with a small additional inference overhead and minimal tuning.After each FFN block in a transformer-like model, we adopt a lightweight selector that scores a small pool of hidden representation editors for each token, activates only the top-k editors, and mixes their element-wise scaling/bias updates. This design achieves superior performance while maintaining computational efficiency, yielding a more favorable Pareto frontier compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.Across LLaMA-3-8B (eight knowledge reasoning and seven mathematical reasoning tasks) and RoBERTa-base/large (GLUE), TARE outperforms SOTAs (LoRA, DoRA, MiLoRA, LoReFT, and RED), achieving 86.7% (knowledge reasoning), 76.7% (mathematical reasoning), and 88.3% (GLUE) while tuning only 0.0392% of parameters using about 20 GiB peak GPU memory during training.An implementation is available at: https://github.com/PatriciaPulec/tare.
papers.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）必须兼顾效果与效率：低秩方法可能会带来较高的计算成本，而全局表示编辑往往无法充分捕捉令牌级别的上下文信息。我们提出了一种名为“令牌感知表示编辑”的方法（Token-Aware Representation Editing，TARE），该方法能够进行细粒度的、针对特定令牌的编辑操作，同时仅需要少量的额外推理开销和极少的调参工作。在类似Transformer的模型中，每个FFN模块之后，我们会使用一个轻量级选择器来为每个令牌选择一组隐藏表示编辑器，只激活排名前k的编辑器，并混合它们各自的缩放/偏置更新。这种设计能够在保持计算效率的同时实现更出色的性能，与最先进的方法相比，其获得的帕累托前沿更为优越。在LLaMA-3-8B（包含八个知识推理任务和七个数学推理任务）以及RoBERTa-base/large（GLUE任务）的测试中，TARE的表现优于其他最先进的方法（如LoRA、DoRA、MiLoRA、LoReFT和RED），在仅调整0.0392%的参数的情况下，使用约20 GiB的GPU内存进行训练，分别取得了86.7%（知识推理）、76.7%（数学推理）和88.3%（GLUE）的成绩。该方法的实现代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/PatriciaPulec/tare

papers.title: Soft Orthogonal Low-Rank Adaptation for Knowledge Sharing in Large Language Model Continual Learning
papers.title_zh: 适用于大型语言模型持续学习中的知识共享的柔性正交低秩适应方法
papers.authors: Yitong Wang, Xue Han, WenChun Gao, Qian Hu, Jiahui Wang, Ziqing Wang, Lijun Mei, Junlan Feng
papers.abstract: When large language models are used in real-world scenarios, continual learning (CL) becomes a non-trivial problem. In particular, continual learning with modern LLMs is challenged both by the substantial computational costs induced by their massive parameter scale, and by the limitations of current CL methods, which are mainly designed to mitigate catastrophic forgetting while neglecting knowledge sharing across tasks. We further observe that models with stronger performance exhibit stronger inter-task connections. In light of the above challenges and findings, we propose Attribution Scores-based Soft Orthogonality Low-Rank Adaptation (ASO-LoRA), an effective and efficient framework that simultaneously facilitates knowledge transfer while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Specifically, ASO-LoRA initially assigns task-specific parameter subspaces for new tasks utilizing multi-LoRA modules, enabling for efficient training and inference without relying on task labels. Then, ASO-LoRA leverages attribution scores to evaluate task similarity and employs soft orthogonality between task-specific subspaces, guiding gradient updates in directions that promote parameter isolation, achieving a balance between knowledge transfer and preservation. Experiments are carried out on both the T5-large and the LLaMA2-7B, showing ASO-LoRA’s superior performance and suitability as a plug-in CL solution for general Transformer-based LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/736619821/ASO-LORA.
papers.abstract_zh: 当大语言模型被用于现实世界场景时，持续学习就成为一个非平凡的问题。特别是，现代大语言模型的持续学习面临着两大挑战：其一，由于其庞大的参数规模所导致的巨大计算成本；其二，当前持续学习方法的局限性，这些方法主要是为了减轻灾难性遗忘问题而设计的，但却忽略了不同任务之间的知识共享。我们进一步观察到，性能更强的模型表现出更强的跨任务连接能力。鉴于上述挑战和研究发现，我们提出了基于归因得分的软正交低秩适应方法（ASO-LoRA），这是一种既有效又高效的框架，它能够促进知识转移，同时减轻灾难性遗忘问题。具体来说，ASO-LoRA首先利用多LoRA模块为新任务分配特定的参数子空间，从而实现无需依赖任务标签即可进行高效训练和推理。然后，ASO-LoRA利用归因得分来评估任务间的相似性，并运用任务特定子空间之间的软正交性来指导梯度更新，从而促使参数保持独立状态，实现知识转移与保护之间的平衡。我们在T5-large和LaMA2-7B上进行了实验验证，结果显示ASO-LoRA在性能上表现优异，非常适合作为通用Transformer架构下的大语言模型的持续学习解决方案。相关代码可访问https://github.com/736619821/ASO-LORA。

papers.title: ChartAgent: A Multimodal Agent for Visually Grounded Reasoning in Complex Chart Question Answering
papers.title_zh: ChartAgent：一种适用于复杂图表问答场景的多模态智能体，专注于基于视觉的推理能力
papers.authors: Rachneet Kaur, Nishan Srishankar, Zhen Zeng, Sumitra Ganesh
papers.abstract: Recent multimodal LLMs have shown promise in chart-based visual question answering, but their performance declines sharply on unannotated charts—those requiring precise visual interpretation rather than relying on textual shortcuts. To address this, we introduce ChartAgent, a novel agentic framework that explicitly performs visual reasoning directly within the chart’s spatial domain. Unlike textual chain-of-thought reasoning, ChartAgent iteratively decomposes queries into visual subtasks and actively manipulates and interacts with chart images through specialized actions such as drawing annotations, cropping regions (e.g., segmenting pie slices, isolating bars), and localizing axes, using a library of chart-specific vision tools to fulfill each subtask. This iterative reasoning process closely mirrors human cognitive strategies for chart comprehension. ChartAgent achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the ChartBench and ChartX benchmarks, surpassing prior methods by up to 16.07% absolute gain overall and 17.31% on unannotated, numerically intensive queries. Furthermore, our analyses show that ChartAgent is (a) effective across diverse chart types, (b) achieves the highest scores across varying visual and reasoning complexity levels, and (c) serves as a plug-and-play framework that boosts performance across diverse underlying LLMs. Our work is among the first to demonstrate visually grounded reasoning for chart understanding using tool-augmented multimodal agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的多模态大语言模型在基于图表的视觉问题回答方面表现出良好的性能，但在未标注的图表上，其性能会显著下降——这类图表需要精确的视觉解读，而不是依赖文本上的快捷方式。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了ChartAgent这一新颖的代理框架，该框架能够在图表的空间域内直接进行视觉推理。与文本链状推理不同，ChartAgent会逐步将查询分解为视觉任务，并通过绘制注释、裁剪区域（例如分割饼图、分离条形图）以及定位坐标轴等专门操作，来主动处理与图表图像的交互。为了实现这些任务，ChartAgent使用了针对图表设计的视觉工具库。这种迭代推理过程与人类理解图表的认知策略非常相似。在ChartBench和ChartX基准测试中，ChartAgent取得了最先进的准确率，整体性能比以往的方法提高了16.07%，而在需要大量数值计算的未标注图表上，其性能提升了17.31%。此外，我们的分析表明，ChartAgent具有以下优势：(a)能够适用于多种类型的图表；(b)在不同视觉和推理复杂度的场景下都能取得最高的分数；(c)作为一个即插即用的框架，它能够提升不同底层大语言模型的表现。我们的研究是首批使用工具增强的多模态代理来实现图表理解的视觉推理的范例之一。

papers.title: Curing Miracle Steps in LLM Mathematical Reasoning with Rubric Rewards
papers.title_zh: 在LLM数学推理中的固化奇迹步骤，附带评分奖励机制
papers.authors: Youliang Yuan, Qiuyang Mang, Jingbang Chen, Hong Wan, Xiaoyuan Liu, Junjielong Xu, Jen-tse Huang, Wenxuan Wang, Wenxiang Jiao, Pinjia He
papers.abstract: In this paper, we observe that current models are susceptible to reward hacking, leading to a substantial overestimation of a model’s reasoning ability. This is evidenced by a high incidence of “false positives”—solutions that reach the correct answer through an unsound process.Through a systematic analysis with human verification, we establish a taxonomy of these failure modes, identifying patterns like Miracle Steps—abrupt jumps to a correct output without a valid preceding derivation. Probing experiments suggest that these Miracle Steps are linked to answer-recall shortcuts, including memorization from pretraining, where the model accesses the correct answer independently of its reasoning chain.To mitigate this systemic issue, we introduce the Rubric Reward Model (RRM), a process-oriented reward function that evaluates the entire reasoning trajectory against problem-specific rubrics.The RRM explicitly penalizes logical flaws and encourages rigorous deduction.When integrated into an RL pipeline, RRM-based training consistently outperforms outcome-only supervision across four math benchmarks.Notably, it boosts Verified Pass@1024 on AIME2024 from 26.7% to 62.6% and reduces the incidence of Miracle Steps by 71%.Our work demonstrates that rewarding the solution process is crucial for building accurate and reliable models.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们观察到当前的模型容易受到“奖励操纵”的影响，从而导致对模型推理能力的严重高估。这一现象表现为“假阳性”现象的高发生率——即那些通过不合理的方式得出正确答案的解决方案。通过系统的分析并结合人工验证，我们对这些失败模式进行了分类，发现了诸如“奇迹步骤”这样的模式——即在没有有效推导过程的情况下突然得出正确答案的情况。实验表明，这些“奇迹步骤”与答案记忆有关，模型会独立地调用正确答案，而无需经过合理的推理过程。为了缓解这一系统性问题，我们提出了“评分奖励模型”（RRM），这是一种以过程为导向的奖励函数，它根据特定问题的评分标准来评估整个推理过程。RRM能够明确惩罚逻辑错误，并鼓励严谨的推理。当将其整合到强化学习流程中时，基于RRM的训练在四个数学基准测试中始终优于仅依赖结果的监督方法。值得注意的是，该模型将AIME2024比赛的“Verified Pass@1024”分数从26.7%提升到了62.6%，同时还将“奇迹步骤”的发生率降低了71%。我们的研究表明，奖励解决方案的过程对于构建准确可靠的模型至关重要。

papers.title: Adaptive Planning for Multi-Attribute Controllable Summarization with Monte Carlo Tree Search
papers.title_zh: 基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的多属性可控制汇总自适应规划方法
papers.authors: Sangwon Ryu, Heejin Do, Yunsu Kim, Gary Lee, Jungseul Ok
papers.abstract: Controllable summarization moves beyond generic outputs toward human-aligned summaries guided by specified attributes. In practice, the interdependence among attributes makes it challenging for language models to satisfy correlated constraints consistently. Moreover, previous approaches often require per-attribute fine-tuning, limiting flexibility across diverse summary attributes. In this paper, we propose adaptive planning for multi-attribute controllable summarization (PACO), a training-free framework that reframes the task as planning the order of sequential attribute control with a customized Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). In PACO, nodes represent summaries, and actions correspond to single-attribute adjustments, enabling progressive refinement of only the attributes requiring further control. This strategy adaptively discovers optimal control orders, ultimately producing summaries that effectively meet all constraints. Extensive experiments across diverse domains and models demonstrate that PACO achieves robust multi-attribute controllability, surpassing both LLM-based self-planning models and fine-tuned baselines. Remarkably, PACO with Llama-3.2-1B rivals the controllability of the much larger Llama-3.3-70B baselines. With larger models, PACO achieves superior control performance, outperforming all competitors.
papers.abstract_zh: 可控摘要生成不再局限于通用输出，而是朝着基于特定属性的、符合人类需求的摘要方向发展。实际上，不同属性之间的相互依赖关系使得语言模型难以一致地满足各种约束条件。此外，以往的方法通常需要针对每个属性进行微调，这限制了其在多种摘要属性上的灵活性。在本文中，我们提出了一种自适应规划的多属性可控摘要生成方法（PACO），这是一种无需训练的框架，它将任务重新定义为通过自定义的蒙特卡洛树搜索算法来规划连续属性控制的顺序。在PACO中，节点代表摘要，而动作则对应于单个属性的调整，从而只对需要进一步控制的属性进行逐步优化。这种策略能够自适应地发现最优的控制顺序，最终生成出能够有效满足所有约束条件的摘要。通过在多个领域和模型上进行的广泛实验表明，PACO在多属性可控性方面表现出色，其性能优于基于大语言模型的自规划模型以及经过微调的基线方法。值得注意的是，使用Llama-3.2-1B模型的PACO在可控性方面与更大的Llama-3.3-70B模型相当。对于更大的模型来说，PACO在控制性能上表现更优，超越了所有竞争对手。

papers.title: CPT-Agent: A Cognitive Process Theory-driven Framework for Student Simulation in Writing Development
papers.title_zh: CPT-Agent：一种基于认知过程理论的写作发展学生模拟框架
papers.authors: Yuhan Chen, Zizhuo Shen, Miaomiao Cheng, Xu Han, Jiefu Gong, Shijin Wang, Wei Song
papers.abstract: Simulating student writing behavior offers a promising pathway to scalable feedback evaluation and teacher training. However, existing LLM-based approaches tend to model overly capable learners who readily understand and over-apply feedback, resulting in pedagogically implausible behavior. In this work, we introduce pedagogical realism as a guiding principle for student writing simulation, emphasizing bounded cognition, selective feedback comprehension, and developmentally plausible learning processes. To operationalize this idea, we propose CPT-Agent, a cognitively grounded framework that decouples cognitive ability from writing proficiency and models their interaction during writing and revision. CPT-Agent combines probabilistic modeling of cognitive development, proficiency-controlled text generation, and structured memory for skill accumulation. Experiments show that it (1) produces clearly distinguishable proficiency levels, (2) generates cognitively plausible revisions consistent with instructional theories, and (3) achieves strong agreement with expert judgments in evaluating feedback quality. These results highlight the importance of modeling cognitive constraints in LLM-based student simulation and demonstrate the potential of pedagogically realistic agents for automated feedback assessment and teacher development.
papers.abstract_zh: 模拟学生的写作行为为可扩展的反馈评估与教师培训提供了有前景的路径。然而，现有的基于大语言模型的方案往往会模拟出能力过于强大的学习者，这些学习者能够轻松理解并过度应用反馈，从而导致行为不符合教学逻辑。在这项研究中，我们提出了“教学现实性”作为学生写作模拟的指导原则，强调认知的有限性、对反馈的理解选择性以及符合发展阶段的学習过程。为了实现这一理念，我们提出了CPT-Agent框架——一个基于认知的框架，它将认知能力与写作水平分离开来，并在写作和修改过程中模拟它们之间的互动关系。CPT-Agent结合了认知发展的概率建模、由写作水平控制的文本生成机制，以及用于技能积累的结构化记忆系统。实验表明，该框架能够：(1) 清晰地区分不同的写作水平；(2) 生成符合教学理论的、具有认知合理性的修改建议；(3) 在评估反馈质量方面与专家判断高度一致。这些结果凸显了在基于大语言模型的学生模拟中建模认知约束的重要性，同时也展示了在教学上更为真实的代理模型在自动反馈评估与教师发展中的潜力。

papers.title: Team-Based Self-Play With Dual Adaptive Weighting for Fine-Tuning LLMs
papers.title_zh: 基于团队的自主游戏体验，采用双重自适应权重调整方法以优化大型语言模型的性能
papers.authors: Wu Li, Yigeng Zhou, Zesheng Shi, Yequan Wang, Min Zhang, Jing Li
papers.abstract: While recent self-training approaches have reduced reliance on human-labeled data for aligning LLMs, they still face critical limitations: (i) sensitivity to synthetic data quality, leading to instability and bias amplification in iterative training; (ii) ineffective optimization due to a diminishing gap between positive and negative responses over successive training iterations. In this paper, we propose Team-based self-Play with dual Adaptive Weighting (TPAW), a novel self-play algorithm designed to improve alignment in a fully self-supervised setting. TPAW adopts a team-based framework in which the current policy model both collaborates with and competes against historical checkpoints, promoting more stable and efficient optimization. To further enhance learning, we design two adaptive weighting mechanisms: (i) a response reweighting scheme that adjusts the importance of target responses, and (ii) a player weighting strategy that dynamically modulates each team member’s contribution during training. Initialized from a SFT model, TPAW iteratively refines alignment without requiring additional human supervision. Experimental results demonstrate that TPAW consistently outperforms existing baselines across various base models and LLM benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然最近的自训练方法减少了在对齐大语言模型时对人类标记数据的依赖，但它们仍然面临一些关键限制：(i) 对合成数据质量的敏感性，这会导致迭代训练过程中的不稳定性和偏见放大；(ii) 由于连续训练迭代中正面和负面反应之间的差距逐渐缩小，优化效果变得不佳。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“基于团队的双重自适应加权自博弈”的新算法，该算法旨在在完全自监督的环境中改善对齐效果。TPAW采用一种基于团队的框架，其中当前策略模型既与历史检查点进行协作，又与之竞争，从而推动更稳定和高效的优化过程。为了进一步提升学习效果，我们设计了两种自适应加权机制：(i) 响应重新加权方案，用于调整目标响应的重要性；(ii) 玩家加权策略，用于在训练过程中动态调节每个团队成员的贡献。TPAW从SFT模型开始初始化，并不断迭代地改进对齐效果，而无需额外的人员监督。实验结果表明，TPAW在各种基础模型和LLM基准测试中始终优于现有的基线算法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SearchGym: Bootstrapping Real-World Search Agents via Cost-Effective and High-Fidelity Environment Simulation
papers.title_zh: SearchGym：通过高效且高保真度的环境模拟来开发现实世界中的搜索代理
papers.authors: Xichen Zhang, Ziyi He, Yinghao Zhu, Sitong Wu, Shaozuo Yu, Meng Chu, Wenhu Zhang, Haoru Tan, Jiaya Jia
papers.abstract: Search agents have emerged as a pivotal paradigm for solving open-ended, knowledge-intensive reasoning tasks. However, training these agents via Reinforcement Learning (RL) faces a critical dilemma: interacting with live commercial Web APIs is prohibitively expensive, while relying on static data snapshots often introduces noise due to data misalignment. This misalignment generates corrupted reward signals that destabilize training by penalizing correct reasoning or rewarding hallucination. To address this, we propose SearchGym, a simulation environment designed to bootstrap robust search agents. SearchGym employs a rigorous generative pipeline to construct a verifiable knowledge graph and an aligned document corpus, ensuring that every reasoning task is factually grounded and strictly solvable. Building on this controllable environment, we introduce SearchGym-RL, a curriculum learning methodology that progressively optimizes agent policies through purified feedback, evolving from basic interactions to complex, long-horizon planning. Extensive experiments across the Llama and Qwen families demonstrate strong Sim-to-Real generalization. Notably, our Qwen2.5-7B-Base model trained within SearchGym surpasses the web-enhanced ASearcher baseline across nine diverse benchmarks by an average relative margin of 10.6%. Our results validate that high-fidelity simulation serves as a scalable and highly cost-effective methodology for developing capable search agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 搜索代理已成为解决开放式、知识密集型推理任务的关键工具。然而，通过强化学习来训练这些代理存在一个关键问题：与真实的商业Web API进行交互的成本非常高昂，而依赖静态数据快照则常常因为数据不一致而产生噪声。这种数据不一致会导致奖励信号出现偏差，从而破坏训练效果，因为正确的推理会被惩罚，而错误的推理反而会得到奖励。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了SearchGym——一个用于引导健壮搜索代理的模拟环境。SearchGym采用严格的生成流程来构建可验证的知识图谱和一致的文档语料库，确保每个推理任务都有事实依据且易于解决。在此基础上，我们引入了SearchGym-RL这一课程学习方法，它通过纯净的反馈逐步优化代理策略，从简单的交互逐渐发展到复杂的长期规划能力。在Llama和Qwen系列模型中进行的广泛实验表明，SearchGym在模拟环境与真实世界之间的泛化能力非常强。值得注意的是，我们在SearchGym中训练的Qwen2.5-7B-Base模型在九个不同的基准测试中的表现平均相对优势达到了10.6%。我们的研究结果证明，高保真度的模拟环境是一种可扩展且成本效益高的方法，有助于开发高效的搜索代理。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Learning to Select: Query-Aware Adaptive Dimension Selection for Dense Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 学会选择：基于查询需求的自适应维度选择，以实现高效的密集检索
papers.authors: Zhanyu Wu, Richong Zhang, Zhijie Nie
papers.abstract: Dense retrieval represents queries and documents as high-dimensional embeddings, but these representations can be redundant at the query level: for a given information need, only a subset of dimensions is consistently helpful for ranking. Prior work addresses this via pseudo-relevance feedback (PRF) based dimension importance estimation, which can produce query-aware masks without labeled data but often relies on noisy pseudo signals and heuristic test-time procedures. In contrast, supervised adapter methods leverage relevance labels to improve embedding quality, yet they learn global transformations shared across queries and do not explicitly model query-aware dimension importance. We propose a Query-Aware Adaptive Dimension Selection framework that learns to predict per-dimension importance directly from query embedding. We first construct oracle dimension importance distributions over embedding dimensions using supervised relevance labels, and then train a predictor to map a query embedding to these label-distilled importance scores. At inference, the predictor selects a query-aware subset of dimensions for similarity computation based solely on the query embedding, without pseudo-relevance feedback. Experiments across multiple dense retrievers and benchmarks show that our learned dimension selector improves retrieval effectiveness over the full-dimensional baseline as well as PRF-based masking and supervised adapter baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 密集检索将查询和文档表示为高维嵌入，但这些表示在查询层面可能存在冗余现象：对于给定的信息需求，只有一部分维度在排序过程中具有持续的价值。之前的研究通过基于伪相关反馈的维度重要性估计来解决这个问题，这种方法可以在没有标记数据的情况下生成考虑查询因素的掩码，但往往依赖于噪声的伪信号以及启发式的测试时间处理流程。相比之下，有监督的适配器方法利用相关性标签来提高嵌入质量，但它们学习的是跨查询共享的全局变换，并没有明确建模考虑查询的维度重要性。我们提出了一种“考虑查询的自适应维度选择”框架，该框架能够直接从查询嵌入中预测每个维度的重要性。我们首先使用有监督的相关性标签构建嵌入维度的 oracle 维度重要性分布，然后训练一个预测器，将查询嵌入映射到这些经过标签提取的重要性分数上。在推理阶段，该预测器仅基于查询嵌入选择一组考虑查询的维度来进行相似性计算，而无需使用伪相关反馈。通过在多个密集检索器和基准测试中的实验验证，我们发现我们的维度选择方法不仅比全维度基线提升了检索效率，还优于基于伪相关反馈的掩码方法和有监督适配器方法的基线性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MeepleLM: A Virtual Playtester Simulating Diverse Subjective Experiences
papers.title_zh: MeepleLM：一个能够模拟各种主观体验的虚拟测试平台
papers.authors: Zizhen Li, Chuanhao Li, Yibin Wang, Jianwen Sun, Yukang Feng, Jiaxin Ai, Fanrui Zhang, Mingzhu Sun, Yifei Huang, Kaipeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements have expanded the role of Large Language Models (LLMs) in board games from playing agents to creative co-designers. However, a critical gap remains: current systems lack the capacity to offer constructive critique grounded in the emergent user experience. Bridging this gap is fundamental for harmonizing Human-AI collaboration, as it empowers designers to refine their creations via external perspectives while steering models away from biased or unpredictable outcomes. Automating this evaluation presents two challenges: inferring the latent dynamics connecting static rules to gameplay without an explicit engine, and modeling the subjective heterogeneity of diverse player groups. To address these, we curate a comprehensive dataset of 1,727 structurally corrected rulebooks and 150K reviews selected via rigorous quality scoring and facet-aware sampling. We augment this data with Mechanics-Dynamics-Aesthetics (MDA) reasoning to explicitly bridge the causal gap between written rules and player experience. We further distill distinct player personas and introduce MeepleLM, a specialized model that internalizes persona-specific reasoning patterns to accurately simulate the subjective feedback of diverse player archetypes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MeepleLM significantly outperforms latest commercial models (e.g., GPT-5.1, Gemini3-Pro) in community alignment and critique quality, achieving a 70% preference rate in user studies assessing practical utility. MeepleLM serves as a reliable virtual playtester that provides experience-grounded feedback, offering a practical step towards audience-aligned Human-AI collaboration.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的进展使得大语言模型在桌游中的角色得到了扩展，从扮演游戏角色到参与创意设计。然而，仍然存在一个关键问题：当前系统缺乏基于用户体验提供建设性反馈的能力。填补这一空白对于实现人类与人工智能的协作至关重要，因为它能够让设计师通过外部视角来改进自己的创作成果，同时避免模型产生偏见或不可预测的结果。然而，自动化这种评估过程面临着两个挑战：一是如何在没有专门引擎的情况下，推断出静态规则与游戏玩法之间的潜在联系；二是如何模拟不同玩家群体的主观差异。为了解决这些问题，我们整理了一个包含1,727本经过结构修正的规则书以及15万条评论的综合数据集，这些数据是通过严格的质量评分和面向方面的抽样方法选出的。我们还利用机制-动态-美学推理来明确连接书面规则与玩家体验之间的因果关系。此外，我们进一步区分了不同的玩家角色，并引入了MeepleLM这一专用模型，它能够内化特定角色的推理模式，从而准确模拟不同玩家类型的主观反馈。大量实验表明，MeepleLM在符合社区需求和提供高质量反馈方面明显优于最新的商业模型（如GPT-5.1、Gemini3-Pro）。在评估实际效用时，用户研究结果显示，MeepleLM的满意度高达70%。MeepleLM作为一种可靠的虚拟测试工具，能够为玩家提供基于实际体验的反馈，为实现与人类人工智能的协作提供了切实可行的途径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MSMO-ABSA: Multi-Scale and Multi-Objective Optimization for Cross-Lingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
papers.title_zh: MSMO-ABSA：用于跨语言基于方面的情感分析的多尺度与多目标优化方法
papers.authors: Chengyan Wu, Bolei Ma, Ningyuan Deng, He Yanqing, Yun Xue, Liu Xiaoyong
papers.abstract: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) garnered growing research interest in multilingual contexts in the past. However, the majority of the studies lack more robust feature alignment and finer aspect-level alignment. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, MSMO: Multi-Scale and Multi-Objective optimization for cross-lingual ABSA. During multi-scale alignment, we achieve cross-lingual sentence-level and aspect-level alignment, aligning features of aspect terms in different contextual environments. Specifically, we introduce code-switched bilingual sentences into the language discriminator and consistency training modules to enhance the model’s robustness. During multi-objective optimization, we design two optimization objectives: supervised training and consistency training, aiming to enhance cross-lingual semantic alignment. To further improve model performance, we incorporate distilled knowledge of the target language into the model. Results show that MSMO significantly enhances cross-lingual ABSA by achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple languages and models.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于方面的情感分析（Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis，ABSA）在过去的多语言环境中引起了越来越多的研究兴趣。然而，大多数研究缺乏更稳健的特征对齐以及更精细的方面级对齐。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架——MSMO：用于跨语言ABSA的多尺度与多目标优化方法。在多尺度对齐过程中，我们实现了跨语言的句子级和方面级对齐，从而在不同上下文环境中对方面术语的特征进行对齐。具体来说，我们将混合语码双语句子引入到语言判别器和一致性训练模块中，以提高模型的鲁棒性。在多目标优化阶段，我们设计了两个优化目标：监督训练和一致性训练，旨在提升跨语言的语义对齐能力。为了进一步提高模型性能，我们将目标语言的提炼知识融入模型中。结果表明，MSMO显著提升了跨语言ABSA的性能，使得模型能够在多种语言和模型上达到最先进的水平。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: FineSteer: A Unified Framework for Fine-Grained Inference-Time Steering in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: FineSteer：一种用于大型语言模型中的细粒度推理时间控制的统一框架
papers.authors: Zixuan Weng, Jinghuai Zhang, Kunlin Cai, Ying Li, Peiran Wang, Yuan Tian
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit undesirable behaviors, such as safety violations and hallucinations. Although inference-time steering offers a cost-effective way to adjust model behavior without updating its parameters, existing methods often fail to be simultaneously effective, utility-preserving, and training-efficient due to their rigid, one-size-fits-all designs and limited adaptability. In this work, we present FineSteer, a novel steering framework that decomposes inference-time steering into two complementary stages—conditional steering and fine-grained vector synthesis—allowing fine-grained control over when and how to steer internal representations. In the first stage, we introduce a Subspace-guided Conditional Steering (SCS) mechanism that preserves model utility by avoiding unnecessary steering. In the second stage, we propose a Mixture-of-Steering-Experts (MoSE) mechanism that captures the multimodal nature of desired steering behaviors and generates query-specific steering vectors for improved effectiveness. Through tailored designs in both SCS and MoSE, FineSteer maintains robust performance on general queries while adaptively optimizing steering vectors for targeted inputs in a training-efficient manner. Extensive experiments on safety and truthfulness benchmarks show that FineSteer outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in overall performance (e.g., a 7.6% improvement on TruthfulQA over Llama-3), achieving stronger steering performance with minimal utility loss. The code is available at https://github.com/YukinoAsuna/FineSteer
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常常表现出不良行为，例如违反安全规则以及产生幻觉。虽然推理时间引导提供了一种经济有效的调整模型行为的方法，无需更新其参数，但现有的方法往往无法同时实现有效性、保持模型效用以及提高训练效率。为此，我们提出了FineSteer这一新型引导框架。该框架将推理时间引导分解为两个互补的阶段——条件引导与细粒度向量合成，从而能够精确控制何时以及如何对内部表示进行引导。在第一阶段，我们引入了子空间引导条件引导机制，通过避免不必要的引导来保持模型的效用。在第二阶段，我们采用了混合引导专家机制，该机制能够捕捉所需引导行为的多模态特性，并生成针对特定查询的引导向量，以提高引导效果。通过优化SCS和MoSE机制的设计，FineSteer能够在处理一般查询时保持出色的性能，同时还能以高效的方式针对特定输入进行引导向量的自适应优化。在安全性和真实性基准测试中的大量实验表明，FineSteer在整体性能上优于现有方法（例如在TruthfulQA任务上的性能提升了7.6%，相比Llama-3），并且在保持最小效用损失的情况下实现了更强大的引导效果。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/YukinoAsuna/FineSteer
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
