papers.title: Is the Attention Matrix Really the Key to Self-Attention in Multivariate Long-Term Time Series Forecasting?
papers.title_zh: 注意力矩阵真的是多变量长期时间序列预测中自我关注机制的关键吗？
papers.authors: Xinyu Li, Kexi Chen, Jiajie Shen, Ying Zheng, Hong Lu, Jin Zhao, Xin Wang
papers.abstract: In multivariate long-term time series forecasting, it is widely believed that the effectiveness of self-attention arises from its attention matrix. We challenge this assumption with a counterintuitive finding: our experiments, conducted on three classic and three latest Transformer models, show that dot-product attention can be replaced by element-wise operations without token interaction, such as the addition and Hadamard product, while maintaining or even improving accuracy. This leads to our central hypothesis: the effectiveness of self-attention in this task stems not from the dynamic attention matrix, but from the multi-branch feature extraction inherent in the parallel projections to Query, Key, and Value matrices and their fusion. To validate this, we construct a simple multi-branch MLP that isolates the ‘multi-branch mapping with element-wise operation’ structure from the Transformer and show that it achieves competitive performance. Our results indicate that the source of performance in self-attention has been misattributed, suggesting that the true benefit lies in the architectural principle of multi-branch mapping and fusion, not in the attention matrix.
papers.abstract_zh: 在多元长期时间序列预测中，人们普遍认为自注意力的有效性源于其注意力矩阵。我们通过一个反直觉的发现来挑战这一假设：我们在三种经典模型和三种最新Transformer模型上进行的实验表明，点乘注意力可以通过元素级操作来替代，而无需进行令牌交互，例如加法和哈达玛积运算，同时还能保持甚至提高准确性。这引出了我们的核心假设：自注意力在这项任务中的有效性并非来自动态注意力矩阵，而是来自于并行投影到查询、键和值矩阵以及它们之间的融合过程中所固有的多分支特征提取机制。为了验证这一点，我们构建了一个简单的多分支MLP模型，该模型将“多分支映射与元素级操作”的结构与Transformer分离开来，并证明它能够取得具有竞争力的性能。我们的结果表明，自注意力性能的来源被错误地归因了，这表明真正的优势在于多分支映射和融合的架构原理，而非注意力矩阵本身。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Difficulty-Controllable Cloze Question Distractor Generation
papers.title_zh: 可调节难度的填空题干扰项生成方法
papers.authors: Seokhoon Kang, Yejin Jeon, Seonjeong Hwang, Gary Lee
papers.abstract: Multiple-choice cloze questions are commonly used to assess linguistic proficiency and comprehension. However, generating high-quality distractors remains challenging, as existing methods often lack adaptability and control over difficulty levels, and the absence of difficulty-annotated datasets further hinders progress. To address these issues, we propose a novel framework for generating distractors with controllable difficulty by leveraging both data augmentation and a multitask learning strategy. First, to create a high-quality, difficulty-annotated dataset, we introduce a two-way distractor generation process to produce diverse and plausible distractors. These candidates are filtered and then categorized by difficulty using an ensemble QA system. Second, this newly created dataset is used to train a difficulty-controllable generation model via multitask learning. Experimental results demonstrate that our method generates high-quality distractors across difficulty levels and substantially outperforms GPT-4o in aligning distractor difficulty with human perception.
papers.abstract_zh: 选择题通常用于评估语言能力和理解能力。然而，生成高质量的干扰项仍然具有挑战性，因为现有的方法往往缺乏灵活性和对难度级别的控制能力。此外，由于缺乏标注了难度的数据集，进展也受到了阻碍。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，通过利用数据增强和多任务学习策略来生成具有可控难度的干扰项。首先，为了创建高质量、带有难度标注的数据集，我们引入了双向干扰项生成过程，以产生多样且合理的干扰项。这些候选干扰项经过筛选后，再通过集成问答系统按难度进行分类。其次，利用这个新创建的数据集，通过多任务学习训练出一个能够控制难度的生成模型。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够生成不同难度级别的高质量干扰项，并且在使干扰项的难度与人类感知相匹配方面，其表现明显优于GPT-4o。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ToolPRM: Fine-Grained Inference Scaling of Structured Outputs for Function Calling
papers.title_zh: ToolPRM：针对结构化输出的细粒度推理扩展技术，用于函数调用
papers.authors: Jianghao Lin, Yuanyuan Shi, Xin Peng, Renjie Ding, Hairui Wang, Yuxuan Peng, Bizhe Bai, Weixi Song, Fengshuo Bai, Huacan Chai, Weinan Zhang, Fei Huang, Ying Wen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at function calling, but inference scaling has been explored mainly for unstructured generation. We propose an inference-scaling framework for structured outputs that combines fine-grained beam search with ToolPRM, a process reward model scoring each intra-call decision (function name and argument filling). We build the first fine-grained intra-call supervision dataset via function masking, rollout collection, and step-level annotation. ToolPRM outperforms outcome and coarse-grained reward models in predictive accuracy and yields consistent test-time gains on multiple function-calling benchmarks. We further show that structured generation follows “explore more but retain less”, since early JSON errors are unrecoverable.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在函数调用方面表现出色，但推理扩展技术主要被用于非结构化生成的场景。我们提出了一种针对结构化输出的推理扩展框架，该框架结合了细粒度的束搜索机制与ToolPRM过程奖励模型。ToolPRM能够对每次函数调用中的决策（函数名称及参数填充）进行评分。我们通过函数掩蔽、滚动收集以及步骤级注释的方式，构建了首个细粒度的内部调用监督数据集。在预测准确性方面，ToolPRM的表现优于结果导向型及粗粒度奖励模型，并且在多个函数调用基准测试中都取得了稳定的性能提升。此外，我们还发现，在结构化生成过程中，应遵循“探索更多但保留更少”的原则，因为早期的JSON错误是不可恢复的。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GTA: Generating Long-horizon Tasks for Web Agents at Scale
papers.title_zh: GTA：大规模地为网络代理生成长期任务
papers.authors: Tenghao Huang, Kung-Hsiang Huang, Prafulla Kumar Choubey, Yilun Zhou, Muhao Chen, Jonathan May, Chien-Sheng Wu
papers.abstract: Web agents, which couple language models with browsing and tool-use capabilities, show promise as open web assistants. Yet progress is increasingly limited by the lack of scalable, process-level supervision. Existing benchmarks are largely manually constructed, providing only coarse start–goal annotations without intermediate trajectories, while recent automatic generation efforts remain expensive, biased, and shallow. These limitations prevent reliable training and evaluation of agents that must generalize to realistic, multi-hop, cross-page tasks. We introduce a scalable framework GTA that integrates crawling, retrieval-based seeding, in-context generation, and automated quality control to produce realistic tasks paired with executable trajectories. This design decouples crawling from generation for greater efficiency, grounds tasks in the site graph to enforce compositionality, and ensures dense supervision through deterministic replays and systematic validation. We instantiate the pipeline on over 50 websites covering e-commerce, government, forums, and news, with multilingual and multi-hop coverage. The resulting benchmark reveals a significant human–agent performance gap and enables detailed diagnostics. Our contributions are three-fold: (i) formalizing multi-hop web-agent task generation, (ii) proposing an efficient and validated pipeline for automatic data creation, and (iii) releasing a dynamic benchmark with reproducible evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络代理将语言模型与浏览和工具使用能力相结合，作为开放网络助手具有很大的潜力。然而，由于缺乏可扩展的、面向流程层面的监督机制，进展一直受到限制。现有的基准测试大多是由人工构建的，只能提供粗略的起始-目标标注，而没有中间路径信息；而最近的自动生成尝试仍然成本高昂、存在偏见且效果有限。这些限制使得代理在应对现实中的多跳、跨页面任务时难以进行可靠的训练和评估。我们提出了一种可扩展的框架GTA，该框架整合了爬虫技术、基于检索的种子生成、上下文生成以及自动化质量控制功能，从而能够生成带有可执行路径的现实任务。这种设计将爬虫与生成过程分离，以提高效率；将任务建立在网站图的基础上，以确保复合性；并通过确定性重放和系统验证来实现密集的监督。我们在超过50个网站上实施了这一流程，涵盖了电子商务、政府、论坛和新闻等领域，实现了多语言和多跳的任务覆盖。结果表明，人类代理与机器代理之间的性能差距相当明显，同时也为详细诊断提供了可能。我们的贡献主要有三个方面：(i) 明确了多跳网络代理任务生成的规范；(ii) 提出了一种高效且经过验证的数据自动生成流程；(iii) 发布了一个可复现评估的动态基准测试。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Closing the Modality Reasoning Gap for Speech Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 缩小语音大语言模型在模式推理方面的差距
papers.authors: Chaoren Wang, Heng Lu, Xueyao Zhang, Shujie Liu, Yan Lu, Jinyu Li, Zhizheng Wu
papers.abstract: Although Speech Large Language Models have achieved notable progress, a substantial modality reasoning gap remains: their reasoning performance on speech inputs is markedly weaker than on text. This gap could be associated with representational drift across Transformer layers and behavior deviations in long-chain reasoning. To address this issue, we introduce TARS, a reinforcement-learning framework that aligns text-conditioned and speech-conditioned trajectories through an asymmetric reward design. The framework employs two dense and complementary signals: representation alignment, which measures layer-wise hidden-state similarity between speech- and text-conditioned trajectories, and behavior alignment, which evaluates semantic consistency between generated outputs and reference text completions. Experiments on challenging reasoning benchmarks, including MMSU and OBQA, show that our approach significantly narrows the modality reasoning gap and achieves state-of-the-art performance among 7B-scale Speech LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管语音大语言模型已经取得了显著的进展，但仍然存在较大的模态推理差距：它们在语音输入上的推理性能明显低于文本。这种差距可能与Transformer层之间的表示漂移以及长链推理中的行为偏差有关。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了TARS框架，该框架通过非对称奖励设计来协调文本条件和语音条件的推理路径。该框架采用了两种互补的信号：表示对齐，用于衡量语音条件和文本条件推理路径之间的隐藏状态相似性；行为对齐，用于评估生成输出与参考文本补全之间的语义一致性。在包括MMSU和OBQA在内的复杂推理基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法显著缩小了模态推理差距，并在7B规模语音LLM中取得了最先进的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Logical Phase Transitions: Understanding Collapse in LLM Logical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 逻辑阶段转变：理解大型语言模型的逻辑推理中的崩溃现象
papers.authors: Xinglang Zhang, Yunyao Zhang, ZeLiang Chen, Junqing Yu, Wei Yang, Zikai Song
papers.abstract: Symbolic logical reasoning is a critical yet underexplored capability of large language models (LLMs), providing reliable and verifiable decision-making in high-stakes domains such as mathematical reasoning and legal judgment. In this study, we present a systematic analysis of logical reasoning under controlled increases in logical complexity, and reveal a previously unrecognized phenomenon, which we term Logical Phase Transitions: rather than degrading smoothly, logical reasoning performance remains stable within a regime but collapses abruptly beyond a critical logical depth, mirroring physical phase transitions such as water freezing beyond a critical temperature threshold. Building on this insight, we propose Neuro-Symbolic Curriculum Tuning, a principled framework that adaptively aligns natural language with logical symbols to establish a shared representation, and reshapes training dynamics around phase-transition boundaries to progressively strengthen reasoning at increasing logical depths. Experiments on five benchmarks show that our approach effectively mitigates logical reasoning collapse at high complexity, yielding average accuracy gains of +1.26 in naive prompting and +3.95 in CoT, while improving generalization to unseen logical compositions.
papers.abstract_zh: 符号逻辑推理是大语言模型的一项关键但未被充分探索的能力，它能够在数学推理和法律判断等高风险领域提供可靠且可验证的决策支持。在本研究中，我们对逻辑复杂度增加时的逻辑推理进行了系统分析，并发现了一种此前未被注意到的现象——我们将其称为“逻辑阶段转变”：逻辑推理性能并非平稳下降，而是在某个范围内保持稳定，但当逻辑深度达到某个临界值时，性能会突然崩溃，这类似于物理中的相变现象，比如水在超过某个临界温度阈值时结冰。基于这一发现，我们提出了神经符号式课程调整框架。该框架通过自适应地将自然语言与逻辑符号相结合，建立共享的表示方式，并在逻辑阶段转变的边界处重新调整训练过程，从而逐步增强在更高逻辑深度下的推理能力。在五个基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法能够有效避免逻辑推理在高复杂度情况下的崩溃，在简单提示下平均准确率提升了1.26，在CoT任务中则提升了3.95，同时还能提高对未见逻辑组合情况的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SpecCache: Speculative KV Cache Reuse for Efficient RAG Serving
papers.title_zh: SpecCache：一种高效的KV缓存复用机制，旨在提升RAG服务的性能
papers.authors: Zijian Wen, Tao Zhang, Shuangwu Chen, Shenghao Ye, Yu Guo, Qirui Chen, Jingxian Shuai, Yunpeng Hou, Huasen He, Jianyang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly enhances LLMs but faces high prefill latency during long-context processing. While KV cache reuse can mitigate this, current methods relying on shallow features or static heuristics often fail to identify critical tokens for recomputation, resulting in generation quality degradation.We have an insight that KV deviations are more pronounced in deep layers.However, directly extracting deep-layer features from the target model is computationally prohibitive. Crucially, we find that the deep-layer features of a lightweight speculative model exhibit strong consistency with the target model in the selection of critical tokens for recomputation.In light of these insights, we propose SpecCache, which employs deep-layer hidden-state norms from a speculative model as a proxy to guide the critical token selection for target large model.Experiments demonstrate that SpecCache outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines. Compared to full KV recomputation, it reduces time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 2.17-3.95\times and increases inference throughput by 2.7-5.2\times, with negligible degradation in generation quality relative to full recomputation.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术显著提升了大语言模型的表现，但在处理长上下文数据时存在较高的预填充延迟问题。虽然KV缓存的重复使用可以缓解这个问题，但当前依赖浅层特征或静态启发式算法的方法往往无法准确识别用于重新计算的关键词，从而导致生成质量下降。我们发现，KV偏差在深层结构中更为明显。然而，直接从目标模型中提取深层特征在计算上非常困难。关键的是，我们发现一种轻量级推测模型的深层特征与目标模型在识别重新计算所需的关键词方面具有很强的一致性。基于这些发现，我们提出了SpecCache算法。该算法利用推测模型的深层隐藏状态规范作为代理，来指导目标大模型的关键词选择。实验表明，SpecCache在性能上优于现有的最先进基线算法。与全KV重新计算相比，SpecCache将获取第一个关键词所需的时间减少了2.17到3.95倍，同时推理吞吐量提高了2.7到5.2倍，且生成质量相对于全重新计算而言几乎没有下降。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: REG: Retrieval via Emotion Similarity for Guiding Empathetic Dialogue Generation
papers.title_zh: REG：通过情感相似性来提取素材，以引导出富有同理心的对话内容
papers.authors: Xu Wang, Bo Wang, Yang Xiang, Yihong Tang, Dongming Zhao, Yuzifei, Yuexian Hou
papers.abstract: Empathy relies on the cognitive capacity to relate to similar past experiences. Consequently, retrieval-based approaches utilize analogous exemplars to guide empathetic dialogue generation. However, existing methods prioritize semantic similarity over emotion characteristics, often leading to unempathetic responses. To address this, we propose REG, a framework that integrates four Emotion Attributes into the retrieval process to ensure explicit emotional alignment. Furthermore, to mitigate the noise and limited diversity caused by coarse-grained sentence-level attributes, we incorporate Token-level Retrieval for finer granularity and a Retrieval Candidate Augmentation strategy to enhance diversity. Empirical results on the EmpatheticDialogues dataset demonstrate that REG significantly outperforms baselines, offering a robust solution for empathetic generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 共情能力依赖于能够将其与类似过往经历联系起来的认知能力。因此，基于检索的方法会利用类似的例子来引导共情对话的生成。然而，现有的方法往往更重视语义相似性而非情感特征，这往往会导致缺乏共情性的回应。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了REG框架。该框架将四种情感属性整合到检索过程中，以确保情感上的精确匹配。此外，为了减轻由粗粒度句子级属性引起的噪声和多样性不足问题，我们采用了令牌级检索来提供更细粒度的信息，并采用了检索候选增强策略来提高多样性。在EmpatheticDialogues数据集上的实验结果表明，REG框架显著优于基线方法，为共情对话的生成提供了有效的解决方案。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TellWhisper: Tell Whisper Who Speaks When
papers.title_zh: TellWhisper：让Tell Whisper来掌控发言权吧
papers.authors: Yifan Hu, Peiji Yang, Zhisheng Wang, Yicheng Zhong, Rui Liu
papers.abstract: Multi-speaker automatic speech recognition (MASR) aims to predict ”who spoke when and what” from multi-speaker speech, a key technology for multi-party dialogue understanding. However, most existing approaches decouple temporal modeling and speaker modeling when addressing ”when” and ”who”: some inject speaker cues before encoding (e.g., speaker masking), which can cause irreversible information loss; others fuse identity by mixing speaker posteriors after encoding, which may entangle acoustic content with speaker identity. This separation is brittle under rapid turn-taking and overlapping speech, often leading to degraded performance. To address these limitations, we propose TellWhisper, a unified framework that jointly models speaker identity and temporal within the speech encoder. Specifically, we design TS\text{-}RoPE, a time-speaker rotary positional encoding: time coordinates are derived from frame indices, while speaker coordinates are derived from speaker activity and pause cues. By applying region-specific rotation angles, the model explicitly captures per-speaker continuity, speaker-turn transitions, and state dynamics, enabling the attention mechanism to simultaneously attend to ”when” and ”who”. Moreover, to estimate frame-level speaker activity, we develop Hyper\text{-}SD, which casts speaker classification in hyperbolic space to enhance inter-class separation and refine speaker-activity estimates. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The project webpage is available at https://walker-hyf.github.io/TellWhisper.
papers.abstract_zh: 多说话者自动语音识别（MASR）旨在从多说话者的语音中预测“谁在何时说了什么”，这是实现多方对话理解的关键技术。然而，目前大多数方法在处理“何时”和“谁”时，会分离时间建模和说话者建模：有些方法在编码前就注入说话者线索（例如说话者掩蔽），这会导致不可逆转的信息丢失；另一些方法则通过编码后混合说话者后验来融合说话者身份，这可能会让声学内容与说话者身份混淆。这种分离在快速轮流发言和重叠语音的情况下很容易失效，通常会导致性能下降。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了TellWhisper框架，该框架能够在语音编码器内部同时建模说话者身份和时间信息。具体来说，我们设计了TS-RoPE技术，即时间-说话者旋转位置编码：时间坐标来自帧索引，而说话者坐标则来自说话者活动和暂停线索。通过应用特定区域的旋转角度，模型能够明确捕捉每个说话者的连续性、说话者转换以及状态动态，从而使注意力机制能够同时关注“何时”和“谁”。此外，为了估计帧级说话者活动，我们开发了Hyper-SD技术，该技术将说话者分类映射到双曲空间中，以增强类别间的区分度并精确估计说话者活动。大量实验证明了所提出方法的有效性。相关项目的网页地址为https://walker-hyf.github.io/TellWhisper。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Taming System Complexity: Demystifying Software Engineering Agents in Diagnosing Linux Kernel Faults
papers.title_zh: 驾驭系统复杂性：解析软件工程代理在诊断Linux内核故障中的作用机制
papers.authors: Zhenhao Zhou, Zhuochen Huang, Yike He, Chong Wang, Jiajun Wang, Yijian Wu, Xin Peng, Yiling Lou
papers.abstract: The Linux kernel is a critical system, serving as the foundation for numerous systems. Bugs in the Linux kernel can cause serious consequences, affecting billions of users. Fault localization (FL), which aims at identifying the buggy code elements in software, plays an essential role in software quality assurance. While recent LLM agents have achieved promising accuracy in FL on recent benchmarks like SWE-bench, it remains unclear how well these methods perform in the Linux kernel, where FL is much more challenging due to the large-scale code base, limited observability, and diverse impact factors. In this paper, we introduce LinuxFLBench, a FL benchmark constructed from real-world Linux kernel bugs. We conduct an empirical study to assess the performance of state-of-the-art LLM agents on the Linux kernel. Our initial results reveal that existing agents struggle with this task, achieving a best top-1 accuracy of only 41.6% at file level. To address this challenge, we propose LinuxFL+, an enhancement framework designed to improve FL effectiveness of LLM agents for the Linux kernel. LinuxFL+ substantially improves the FL accuracy of all studied agents (e.g., 7.2% - 11.2% accuracy increase) with minimal costs.
papers.abstract_zh: Linux内核是一个至关重要的系统，是众多系统的基础。Linux内核中的错误可能会导致严重的后果，影响到数十亿用户。故障定位（FL）技术旨在识别软件中存在的错误代码部分，它在软件质量保证中起着至关重要的作用。虽然最近的大语言模型代理在如SWE-bench这样的基准测试中取得了令人满意的错误定位准确率，但尚不清楚这些方法在Linux内核中的表现如何。在Linux内核中，由于代码规模庞大、可观测性有限以及影响因素多样，错误定位任务更具挑战性。在本文中，我们介绍了LinuxFLBench，这是一个基于真实Linux内核错误的错误定位测试集。我们通过实证研究来评估最先进的大语言模型代理在Linux内核上的性能。初步结果显示，现有的代理在处理这一任务时存在困难，文件级别的Top-1准确率仅为41.6%。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了LinuxFL+，这是一个旨在提高大语言模型代理在Linux内核中错误定位效率的改进框架。LinuxFL+显著提高了所有被研究代理的错误定位准确率（例如，准确率提高了7.2%至11.2%），且成本极低。

papers.title: DisCo_Speech: Controllable Zero-Shot Speech Generation with A Disentangled Speech Codec
papers.title_zh: DisCo_Speech：使用一种去中心化的语音编码算法实现可控制的零样本语音生成技术
papers.authors: Tao Li, Wenshuo Ge, Zhichao Wang, Zihao Cui, Yong Ma, Yingying Gao, Chao Deng, Shilei Zhang, Junlan Feng
papers.abstract: Codec-based language models (LMs) have revolutionized text-to-speech (TTS). However, standard codecs entangle timbre and prosody, which hinders independent control in continuation-based LMs. To tackle this challenge, we propose DisCo-Speech, a zero-shot controllable TTS framework featuring a disentangled speech codec (DisCodec) and an LM-based generator. The core component DisCodec employs a two-stage design: 1) tri-factor disentanglement to separate speech into content, prosody, and timbre subspaces via parallel encoders and hybrid losses; and 2) fusion and reconstruction that merges content and prosody into unified content-prosody tokens suitable for LM prediction, while jointly optimizing reconstruction to address the disentanglement-reconstruction trade-off. This allows the LM to perform prosodic continuation from a style prompt while the decoder injects target timbre, enabling flexible zero-shot control. Experiments demonstrate that DisCo-Speech achieves competitive voice cloning and superior zero-shot prosody control. By resolving the core entanglement at the codec level, DisCo-Speech provides a robust foundation for controllable speech synthesis. Audio samples are available at: https://disco-speech.github.io/DisCo-demo/. Code and weights will be released at: https://github.com/disco-speech/DisCo-Speech upon acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于编解码器的语言模型已经彻底改变了文本转语音技术。然而，标准的编解码器会混淆声音特征和韵律信息，这限制了基于连续性的语言模型的独立控制能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了DisCo-Speech这一零样本可控文本转语音框架。该框架采用了一种解耦的语音编解码器DisCodec以及基于语言模型的生成器。DisCodec的核心组件采用两阶段设计：1）通过三因子解耦，将语音内容、韵律和声音特征分别通过并行编码器和混合损失分离出来；2）通过融合和重建，将内容和韵律信息合并为统一的内容-韵律标记，以便用于语言模型预测，同时优化重建过程以平衡解耦与重建之间的权衡。这样，语言模型可以从风格提示中生成韵律信息，而解码器则可以注入目标声音特征，从而实现灵活零样本控制。实验表明，DisCo-Speech在语音克隆和零样本韵律控制方面表现优异。通过在编解码器层面解决核心问题，DisCo-Speech为可控语音合成提供了坚实的基础。音频样本可访问于：https://disco-speech.github.io/DisCo-demo/。代码和权重将在项目接受后发布于：https://github.com/disco-speech/DisCo-Speech。

papers.title: WildReward: Learning Reward Models from In-the-Wild Human Interactions
papers.title_zh: WildReward：从真实的人类互动中学习奖励模型
papers.authors: Hao Peng, Yunjia Qi, Xiaozhi Wang, Zijun Yao, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li
papers.abstract: Reward models (RMs) are crucial for the training of large language models (LLMs), yet they typically rely on large-scale human-annotated preference pairs. With the widespread deployment of LLMs, in-the-wild interactions have emerged as a rich source of implicit reward signals. This raises the question: Can we develop reward models directly from in-the-wild interactions? In this work, we explore this possibility by adopting WildChat as an interaction source and proposing a pipeline to extract reliable human feedback, yielding 186k high-quality instances for training WildReward via ordinal regression directly on user feedback without preference pairs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WildReward achieves comparable or even superior performance compared to conventional reward models, with improved calibration and cross-sample consistency. We also observe that WildReward benefits directly from user diversity, where more users yield stronger reward models. Finally, we apply WildReward to online DPO training and observe significant improvements across various downstream tasks. We will release our code, data, and models to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 奖励模型在大语言模型的训练中起着至关重要的作用，但它们通常依赖于大规模的人工标注偏好对。随着大语言模型的广泛部署，自然环境中的交互行为已成为隐式奖励信号的丰富来源。这就提出了一个问题：我们能否直接从自然环境中的交互行为来开发奖励模型呢？在这项研究中，我们采用了WildChat作为交互数据源，并提出了一种提取可靠人类反馈的流程。通过这种方式，我们获得了18.6万条高质量的数据实例，这些数据可以直接用于训练WildReward模型，而无需依赖偏好对。大量的实验表明，WildReward模型在性能上可以与传统奖励模型相媲美，甚至更优，同时其校准能力和跨样本一致性也得到了提升。我们还观察到，WildReward模型能够充分利用用户多样性带来的优势，拥有更多用户的模型往往能生成出更强大的奖励模型。最后，我们将WildReward模型应用于在线DPO训练中，发现它在各种下游任务中取得了显著的改进。我们会公开我们的代码、数据和模型，以推动未来的研究发展。

papers.title: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Target Language Adaptation of LLMs via Source-Shielded Updates
papers.title_zh: 通过源语言保护更新机制，减少大语言模型在目标语言适配过程中出现的严重记忆错误
papers.authors: Atsuki Yamaguchi, Terufumi Morishita, Aline Villavicencio, Nikolaos Aletras
papers.abstract: Expanding the linguistic diversity of instruct large language models (LLMs) is crucial for global accessibility but is often hindered by the reliance on costly specialized target language labeled data and catastrophic forgetting during adaptation. We tackle this challenge under a realistic, low-resource constraint: adapting instruct LLMs using only unlabeled target language data. We introduce Source-Shielded Updates (SSU), a selective parameter update strategy that proactively preserves source knowledge. Using a small set of source data and a parameter importance scoring method, SSU identifies parameters critical to maintaining source abilities. It then applies a column-wise freezing strategy to protect these parameters before adaptation. Experiments across five typologically diverse languages and 7B and 13B models demonstrate that SSU successfully mitigates catastrophic forgetting. It reduces performance degradation on monolingual source tasks to just 3.4% (7B) and 2.8% (13B) on average, a stark contrast to the 20.3% and 22.3% from full fine-tuning. SSU also achieves target-language performance highly competitive with full fine-tuning, outperforming it on all benchmarks for 7B models and the majority for 13B models.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩大大语言模型的教学语言多样性对于实现全球范围内的可用性至关重要，但这一任务往往受到依赖昂贵且专业化的目标语言标注数据以及适应过程中出现的灾难性遗忘问题的阻碍。我们针对这一挑战提出了一种现实可行的解决方案：仅使用未标注的目标语言数据进行大语言模型的适应。我们提出了“源语言保护更新”策略，这是一种选择性参数更新方法，能够主动保留源语言知识。通过利用少量源语言数据和参数重要性评分方法，该策略能够识别出对维持源语言能力至关重要的参数。在适应过程中，该策略会采用列级冻结策略来保护这些参数。在五种类型不同的语言和7B及13B规模模型中进行的实验表明，该策略成功缓解了灾难性遗忘问题。与完全微调相比，该策略使得单语言源任务的性能下降幅度分别仅为3.4%（7B模型）和2.8%（13B模型），而完全微调时的性能下降幅度则高达20.3%和22.3%。此外，该策略还能使目标语言的性能达到与完全微调相当的水平，在7B模型的多个基准测试中均表现出色，而在13B模型中的表现则更为出色。

papers.title: SEE: Signal Embedding Energy for Quantifying Noise Interference in Large Audio Language Models
papers.title_zh: 参见：信号嵌入能量法在大型音频语言模型中的噪声干扰量化应用
papers.authors: Yuanhe Zhang, Jiayu Tian, Yibo Zhang, Shilinlu Yan, Liang Lin, Zhenhong Zhou, Li Sun, Sen Su
papers.abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) have been widely applied in real-time scenarios, such as in-car assistants and online meeting comprehension. In practice, audio inputs are often corrupted by device and environmental noise, leading to performance degradation. However, existing LALM studies on noise lack quantitative analysis and rely mainly on intuition and empirical observation, thus failing to understand practical robustness. To address this issue, we introduce Signal Embedding Energy (SEE), a method for quantifying the impact of noise intensity on LALM inputs, enabling the differentiation of LALM robustness in real-world deployments. SEE introduces a perspective based on structured activation subspaces derived from the model’s internal representations, which more accurately captures its perception of noise than raw audio features. Across experiments, SEE exhibits a strong correlation with LALM performance, achieving a correlation of 0.98. Surprisingly, traditional audio denoising methods are only marginally effective for LALMs, and, in some cases, even increase SEE and impair performance. This suggests a mismatch between speech-centric denoising objectives and the noise sensitivity of modern LALMs. Therefore, we propose a mitigation strategy derived from SEE to denoise LALM inputs, outperforming existing denoising methods. This paper introduces a novel metric for noise quantification in LALMs, providing guidance for robustness improvements in real-world deployments.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型音频语言模型在实时场景中得到了广泛应用，例如车载助手和在线会议理解领域。但实际上，音频输入常常会受到设备和环境噪声的干扰，从而导致性能下降。然而，现有的关于噪声的LALM研究缺乏定量分析，主要依赖于直觉和经验观察，因此无法真正了解模型的实际鲁棒性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了信号嵌入能量这一方法，用于量化噪声强度对LALM输入的影响，从而能够区分LALM在实际应用中的鲁棒性。信号嵌入能量基于模型内部表示结构化的激活子空间来进行分析，这种方法比原始音频特征更能准确捕捉噪声的影响。通过实验验证，信号嵌入能量与LALM性能之间存在很强的相关性，相关系数为0.98。令人惊讶的是，传统的音频去噪方法对于LALM来说效果并不理想，在某些情况下甚至会增加信号嵌入能量的计算量并损害性能。这表明，以语音为中心的去噪目标与现代LALM对噪声的敏感性之间存在不匹配。因此，我们提出了一种基于信号嵌入能量的去噪策略，该策略能够超越现有的去噪方法，取得更好的效果。本文还提出了一种新的LALM噪声量化指标，为实际应用场景中鲁棒性的提升提供了指导。

papers.title: Know the Known and the Unknown: Reasonable Answer Generation with Knowledge-Informed Citations
papers.title_zh: 了解已知与未知：基于知识引用的合理答案生成
papers.authors: Yichi Zhang, Zhuo Chen, Lingbing Guo, Jun Xu, Mengshu Sun, Zhizhen Liu, Lei Liang, Wen Zhang, Huajun Chen
papers.abstract: Question answering (QA) with reference texts is a classic application scenario for large language models (LLMs), where high standards for the credibility and traceability of generated answers are crucial. Many existing approaches focus on generating multi-level citations linked to specific references within the answer, making it verifiable and trustworthy. However, they often overlook key challenges such as citation granularity, the awareness of unknown information, and the adoption of effective training strategies. In this paper, we introduce Knowledge-informed Citation (KFC), which addresses these issues through a novel data construction pipeline, a new benchmark, and an innovative training strategy. With approximately 42K samples spanning 19 distinct domains, KFC includes both traditional citations referencing known entity-level information and specialized citations referring to unknown knowledge in the given question. This structure provides a more granular approach to citations, guiding the model to recognize and explicitly indicate unknown information, thus enhancing the quality and credibility of the response. Additionally, we propose a self-correction paradigm, Self-KFC, designed to fine-tune LLMs by refining poorly cited answers into more accurate ones, making it particularly suitable for citation-dependent scenarios. We present comprehensive experimental results to demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of Self-KFC on the KFC benchmark.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于参考文本的问答问题是大语言模型的一个经典应用场景，其中生成答案的可信度和可追溯性要求非常高。许多现有方法专注于在答案中生成与特定参考文献相关的多层次引用，以使答案具有可验证性和可靠性。然而，这些方法往往忽略了诸如引用粒度、对未知信息的处理能力以及有效的训练策略等关键挑战。在本文中，我们提出了知识引导引用技术，它通过新颖的数据构建流程、新的评估基准以及创新的训练策略来解决这些问题。该技术拥有约4.2万个样本，涵盖19个不同的领域，其中包括引用已知实体信息的传统引用方式，以及引用给定问题中未知知识的特殊引用方式。这种结构为引用提供了更精细的处理方式，能够引导模型识别并明确标注出未知信息，从而提升回答的质量和可信度。此外，我们还提出了一种自我修正的范式——Self-KFC，它通过改进引用不准确的答案来优化大语言模型，使其更适合依赖引用的场景。我们通过全面的实验结果表明，Self-KFC在KFC评估基准上的有效性和泛化能力得到了充分验证。

papers.title: FocalOrder: Focal Preference Optimization for Reading Order Detection
papers.title_zh: 焦点排序：用于确定阅读顺序的焦点偏好优化方法
papers.authors: Fuyuan Liu, Dianyu Yu, He Ren, Nayu Liu, Xiaomian Kang, Delai Qiu, Fa Zhang, Genpeng Zhen, Shengping Liu, Liang Jiaen, Weihuang, Yining Wang, Junnan Zhu
papers.abstract: Reading order detection is the foundation of document understanding.Most existing methods rely on uniform supervision, implicitly assuming a constant difficulty distribution across layout regions. In this work, we challenge this assumption by revealing a critical flaw: Positional Disparity, a phenomenon where models demonstrate mastery over the deterministic start and end regions but suffer a performance collapse in the complex intermediate sections.This degradation arises because standard training allows the massive volume of easy patterns to drown out the learning signals from difficult layouts.To address this, we propose FocalOrder, a framework driven by Focal Preference Optimization (FPO).Specifically, FocalOrder employs adaptive difficulty discovery with exponential moving average mechanism to dynamically pinpoint hard-to-learn transitions, while introducing a difficulty-calibrated pairwise ranking objective to enforce global logical consistency.Extensive experiments demonstrate that FocalOrder establishes new state-of-the-art results on OmniDocBench v1.0 and Comp-HRDoc.Our compact model not only outperforms competitive specialized baselines but also significantly surpasses large-scale general VLMs.These results demonstrate that aligning the optimization with intrinsic structural ambiguity of documents is critical for mastering complex document structures.
papers.abstract_zh: 阅读顺序检测是文档理解的基础。目前大多数方法都依赖于统一的监督机制，隐含地假设各个布局区域的难度分布是恒定的。在这项研究中，我们挑战了这一假设，揭示了其中的一个关键缺陷：位置差异现象。这种现象表现为模型在起始和结束区域表现良好，但在复杂的中间部分则会出现性能下降。这种下降是由于标准训练方式让大量简单模式淹没了来自困难布局的学习信号所导致的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了FocalOrder框架，该框架基于焦点偏好优化算法。具体来说，FocalOrder采用自适应难度发现机制，结合指数移动平均技术来动态识别难以学习的过渡区域，同时引入了一个基于难度校准的成对排序目标，以强制实现全局逻辑一致性。大量的实验表明，FocalOrder在OmniDocBench v1.0和Comp-HRDoc任务上取得了领先的研究成果。我们的模型不仅优于同类专业基线模型，而且显著超越了大规模通用视觉语言模型。这些结果表明，将优化过程与文档的内在结构复杂性相结合，对于掌握复杂的文档结构至关重要。

papers.title: TLSA: LLM-Guided Text-Label Space Alignment with Contrastive Learning for Generalized Category Discovery
papers.title_zh: 术语：基于对比学习的LLM引导文本-标签空间对齐，用于通用类别发现
papers.authors: Wenxi Xu, Chuan Qin, Xi Chen, Chuyu Fang, Yuanchun Zhou, Hengshu Zhu
papers.abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to classify data from partially labeled datasets by jointly recognizing known categories and discovering novel ones.Despite recent advances, existing methods still suffer from weak text–label alignment, inconsistent objectives across known and novel categories, and poor discrimination of semantically similar clusters. To mitigate these issues, we propose TLSA, a unified framework that enforces contrastive alignment between text and label representations within a shared semantic space. Specifically, we first design a label-semantic aware dual-encoder equipped with a symmetric contrastive objective to achieve text-label alignment. Then, we leverage LLM-based label induction to generate explicit and semantically meaningful names for previously unseen categories, followed by a graph-based refinement strategy that disambiguates semantically overlapping clusters through forced renaming. Finally, a confidence-aware sampling strategy ensures balanced learning across both easy and hard instances. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets show that TLSA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art GCD methods. The code is available at https://github.com/Wenxi-Xu/TLSA.
papers.abstract_zh: 广义类别发现（GCD）旨在通过对已知类别的识别以及新类别的发现，来对部分标注的数据集进行分类。尽管近年来取得了一些进展，但现有方法仍然存在以下问题：文本与标签之间的对齐不够准确；已知类别和新类别之间的目标不一致；对于语义上相似的类别群，识别能力较差。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了TLSA这一统一框架。该框架在共享的语义空间中实现了文本和标签表示之间的对比对齐。具体来说，我们首先设计了一个具有对称对比目标的双编码器结构，以实现文本与标签之间的对齐。然后，我们利用基于大语言模型的标签诱导技术，为之前未见过的类别生成明确且具有语义意义的名称。接着，采用基于图的细化策略，通过强制重新命名来消除语义上重叠的类别群。最后，采用一种基于置信度的采样策略，确保轻松和困难实例之间的学习均衡。在四个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，TLSA在性能上始终优于现有的GCD方法。代码可在https://github.com/Wenxi-Xu/TLSA获取。

papers.title: Hierarchical Token Prepending: Enhancing Information Flow in Decoder-based LLM Embeddings
papers.title_zh: 层次化标记前置：提升基于解码器的大语言模型嵌入中的信息流动效率
papers.authors: Xueying Ding, Xingyue Huang, Mingxuan Ju, Liam Collins, Yozen Liu, Leman Akoglu, Neil Shah, Tong Zhao
papers.abstract: Large language models produce powerful text embeddings, but their causal attention mechanism restricts the flow of information from later to earlier tokens, degrading representation quality. While recent methods attempt to solve this by prepending a single summary token, they over-compress information, hence harming performance on long documents. We propose Hierarchical Token Prepending (HTP), a method that resolves two critical bottlenecks. To mitigate attention-level compression, HTP partitions the input into blocks and prepends block-level summary tokens to subsequent blocks, creating multiple pathways for backward information flow. To address readout-level over-squashing, we replace last-token pooling with mean-pooling, a choice supported by theoretical analysis. HTP achieves consistent performance gains across 11 retrieval datasets and 30 general embedding benchmarks, especially in long-context settings. As a simple, architecture-agnostic method, HTP effectively enhances both zero-shot and fine-tuned models, offering a scalable route to superior long-document embeddings.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够生成强大的文本嵌入，但其因果注意力机制限制了信息从后向前的流动，从而降低了表示的准确性。虽然最近的一些方法试图通过添加单一的摘要标记来解决这个问题，但这些方法过度压缩了信息，从而影响了长文档的处理效果。我们提出了分层标记前置法（HTP），该方法解决了这两个关键问题。为了减轻注意力层面的压缩问题，HTP将输入数据分割成多个块，并在后续块中插入块级摘要标记，从而形成多条信息向后流动的路径。为了解决读取层面的信息过度压缩问题，我们采用了均值池化替代最后的标记池化方法，这一选择得到了理论分析的支持。HTP在11个检索数据集和30个通用嵌入基准测试中均取得了稳定的性能提升，尤其是在长上下文环境下。作为一种简单且不受架构限制的方法，HTP能够有效提升零样本训练和微调模型的性能，为构建更优秀的长文档嵌入提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Suggest-Verify-Revise: A Three-Stage Document-Level Event Causality Identification with Narrative Consistency
papers.title_zh: 建议-验证-修订：一种基于叙事一致性的文档级事件因果识别三阶段方法
papers.authors: Ya Su, Hu Zhang, Dan Qiao, YuJie Wang, Yunxiao Zhao, Yue Fan, Shike Li, Ru Li, Hongye Tan
papers.abstract: Document-level Event Causality Identification (DECI) aims to identify causal relations among multiple events within unstructured text. Existing methods predominantly rely on local semantic similarity for independent event-pair discrimination, thereby overlooking the influence of the overall narrative backbone in the propagation of causal dependencies and the role differentiation of events within multi-cause/multi-effect structures. Therefore, we propose a suggest-verify-revise approach for document-level Event Causality Identification with narrative consistency (SVRECI). In the suggest stage, we integrate multi-dimensional heuristic causal suggestions generated by an LLM with structural suggestions derived from hypergraph modeling to provide multi-source initial support for candidate event pairs. In the verify stage, we introduce a Topological Hawkes process to perform constrained verification of narrative propagation consistency among events. In the revise stage, we construct a dynamically evolving document-level causal graph and incorporate a structure-aware dual-level contrastive learning mechanism at both the event and event-pair levels, iteratively reducing noisy edges over multiple iterations. Experimental results on EventStoryLine and Causal-TimeBank datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms previous methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 文档级事件因果关系识别（DECI）旨在识别非结构化文本中多个事件之间的因果关系。现有方法主要依赖局部语义相似性来区分独立事件对，从而忽略了整体叙事结构在因果关系传播中的作用，以及多原因/多效应结构中不同事件的角色差异。因此，我们提出了一种建议-验证-修正的方法，用于实现具有叙事一致性的文档级事件因果关系识别（SVRECI）。在建议阶段，我们将大语言模型生成的多维启发式因果建议与超图建模得出的结构建议相结合，为候选事件对提供多源初始支持。在验证阶段，我们引入拓扑霍克斯过程来约束性地验证事件之间叙事传播的连贯性。在修正阶段，我们构建动态变化的文档级因果图，并在事件和事件对两个层面采用结构感知的双层次对比学习机制，通过多次迭代逐步消除噪声边。在EventStoryLine和Causal-TimeBank数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法优于以往的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: StoryCoder: Narrative Reformulation for Structured Reasoning in LLM Code Generation
papers.title_zh: StoryCoder：用于大模型代码生成中的结构化推理的叙事重构方法
papers.authors: Geonhui Jang, Dongyoon Han, YoungJoon Yoo
papers.abstract: Effective code generation requires both model capability and a problem representation that carefully structures how models reason and plan. Existing approaches augment reasoning steps or inject specific structure into how models think, but leave scattered problem conditions unchanged. Inspired by the way humans organize fragmented information into coherent explanations, we propose StoryCoder, a narrative reformulation framework that transforms code generation questions into coherent natural language narratives, providing richer contextual structure than simple rephrasings. Each narrative consists of three components: a task overview, constraints, and example test cases, guided by the selected algorithm and genre. Experiments across 11 models on HumanEval, LiveCodeBench, and CodeForces demonstrate consistent improvements, with an average gain of 18.7% in zero-shot pass@10. Beyond accuracy, our analyses reveal that narrative reformulation guides models toward correct algorithmic strategies, reduces implementation errors, and induces a more modular code structure. The analyses further show that these benefits depend on narrative coherence and genre alignment, suggesting that structured problem representation is important for code generation regardless of model scale or architecture. Our code is available at https://github.com/gu-ni/StoryCoder.
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的代码生成需要模型能力和能够精心构建模型推理与规划机制的问题表示方式。现有的方法要么增强推理步骤，要么为模型的思维过程注入特定结构，但并未对问题的条件进行系统化处理。受人类将零散信息整合成连贯解释方式的启发，我们提出了StoryCoder这一叙事重构框架。该框架能够将代码生成问题转化为连贯的自然语言叙述，从而提供比简单重述更丰富的上下文结构。每个叙述由三个组成部分构成：任务概述、约束条件以及示例测试案例，这些部分由所选算法和体裁来指导。在HumanEval、LiveCodeBench和CodeForces上对11种模型进行的实验表明，该方法具有稳定的改进效果，在零样本情况下平均提升了18.7%的准确率。除了准确性之外，我们的分析还发现，叙事重构有助于模型采用正确的算法策略，减少实现错误，并使得代码结构更加模块化。进一步的分析表明，这些好处取决于叙述的连贯性和体裁的一致性，这说明无论模型规模或架构如何，结构化的问题表示对于代码生成来说都是非常重要的。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/gu-ni/StoryCoder下载。

papers.title: ODL-TempLLM: Ontology-Guided and Description Logic-Reasoned Temporal Reasoning with LLMs
papers.title_zh: ODL-TempLLM：基于本体指导和描述逻辑推理的时间推理系统，结合大语言模型的应用
papers.authors: Jinshuo Liu, Cheng Bi, Meng Wang, Juan Deng, Donghong Ji, Jeff Z. Pan
papers.abstract: Temporal reasoning is crucial for large language models (LLMs) to understand event concurrency and complex temporal interactions in natural language. Recent approaches rely on the LLM to infer temporal relations between events and largely overlook the inherent structural nature of temporal relationships. In this work, we propose ODL-TempLLM (Ontology-Guided and Description Logic–Constrained Temporal Reasoning with LLMs), a novel paradigm for temporal reasoning with LLMs that shifts focus from internal inference to the explicit modeling of temporal structure. ODL-TempLLM leverages ontology learning to explicitly construct structured temporal knowledge, employs a symbolic reasoner to deductively reason about temporal relations and uses logic-constrained retrieval augmentation to obtain relevant facts.Experiments results evaluated across there datasets via various LLM backbones show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 2.07–31.83 F1 points and 1.00–30.73 EM points, exhibiting strong generalization and highlighting the potential of explicit temporal reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间推理对于大语言模型理解自然语言中的事件并发和复杂的时间交互至关重要。目前的方法主要依靠语言模型来推断事件之间的时间关系，而很大程度上忽略了时间关系本身的结构性特征。在这项研究中，我们提出了ODL-TempLLM（基于本体论引导和描述逻辑约束的时间推理与语言模型结合的方法），这是一种新的时间推理范式，它将重点从内部推理转移到了对时间结构的显式建模上。ODL-TempLLM利用本体学习来构建结构化的时间知识，采用符号推理器来演绎性地分析时间关系，并通过逻辑约束的检索增强机制来获取相关事实。通过在不同数据集上使用各种语言模型框架进行的实验结果表明，我们的方法在F1分数方面比现有最先进的方法高出2.07至31.83个分数点，在EM分数方面则高出1.00至30.73个分数点。这充分体现了我们方法的强大泛化能力，也凸显了显式时间推理的潜力。

papers.title: FACTrial: Factorized Clinical Contrastive Training for Scalable Patient-Trial Retrieval
papers.title_zh: FACTrial：一种基于因子分解的临床对比训练方法，可用于大规模的患者试验检索
papers.authors: Xuanren Chen, Chongyang Tao, Tao Shen, Shuai Ma
papers.abstract: Patient–trial retrieval is a challenging problem that requires nuanced clinical reasoning beyond surface-level semantic similarity. However, scarce and costly relevance annotations force existing approaches to rely on very limited supervision or zero-shot transfer, reducing the task to generic semantic matching and failing to capture multi-factor eligibility reasoning. To this end, we propose FACTrial, a factorized contrastive training framework that leverages LLMs to synthesize diagnosis-aware supervision for scalable patient–trial retrieval. FACTrial decomposes each patient note into a primary diagnosis and a set of concomitant, eligibility-triggering conditions, and constructs complementary contrastive signals through structured trial augmentation. Specifically, we generate primary-target and concomitant-target positives, together with clinically confusable near-miss negatives, to enforce diagnostic specificity under contrastive learning. Two specialized bi-encoder experts are trained to balance primary-diagnosis prioritization and concomitant-driven recall, and fused into a single deployable retriever. Experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that FACTrial achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving both top-ranked quality and high-recall coverage.
papers.abstract_zh: 患者-试验检索是一个具有挑战性的问题，需要超出表面语义相似性的精细临床推理。然而，相关注释的稀缺性和高昂成本使得现有方法不得不依赖有限的监督或零样本迁移，这导致任务沦为简单的语义匹配，无法捕捉多因素资格推理。为此，我们提出了FACTrial框架——一个分解式对比训练框架，利用大语言模型生成具有诊断意识的监督数据，以实现可扩展的患者-试验检索。FACTrial将每个患者记录分解为主要诊断和一组触发资格的伴随条件，并通过结构化的试验增强来构建互补的对比信号。具体来说，我们生成了主要目标样本和伴随目标样本，以及临床上容易混淆的阴性样本，以在对比学习过程中强化诊断特异性。我们训练了两个专门的双编码器专家，以平衡主要诊断的优先级和伴随条件的召回率，并将它们融合成一个可部署的检索器。在三个公共基准测试上的实验表明，FACTrial取得了最先进的性能，既提高了排名最高的质量，也增强了高召回率的覆盖能力。

papers.title: Your Students Don’t Use LLMs Like You Wish They Did
papers.title_zh: 你的学生并没有像你希望的那样使用大型语言模型
papers.authors: Sebastian Kobler, Matthew Clemson, Angela Sun, Jonathan K. Kummerfeld
papers.abstract: Educational NLP systems are typically evaluated using engagement metrics and satisfaction surveys, which are at best a proxy for meeting pedagogical goals. We introduce six computational metrics for automated evaluation of pedagogical alignment in student-AI dialogue. We validate our metrics through analysis of 12,650 messages across 500 conversations from four courses. Using our metrics, we identify a fundamental misalignment: educators design conversational tutors for sustained learning dialogue, but students mainly use them for answer-extraction. Deployment context is the strongest predictor of usage patterns, outweighing student preference or system design: when AI tools are optional, usage concentrates around deadlines; when integrated into course structure, students ask for solutions to verbatim assignment questions. Whole-dialogue evaluation misses these turn-by-turn patterns. Our metrics will enable researchers building educational dialogue systems to measure whether they are achieving their pedagogical goals.
papers.abstract_zh: 教育领域的自然语言处理系统通常通过参与度指标和满意度调查来评估其效果，但这些指标最多只能作为实现教学目标的替代指标。我们提出了六种用于自动评估学生与人工智能对话中教学一致性计算指标。通过对四门课程中500次对话中的12,650条消息进行分析，我们验证了这些指标的可靠性。利用这些指标，我们发现了一个根本性的不一致现象：教育工作者设计的对话式辅导工具旨在促进持续的学习对话，但学生们却主要将其用于获取答案。使用场景是预测使用模式的最强因素，这一点超过了学生的偏好或系统设计：当人工智能工具是可选的时，用户的使用集中在截止日期前后；而当这些工具被整合到课程结构中时，学生们则更倾向于寻求针对具体作业问题的解决方案。传统的整体对话评估方式无法捕捉到这些具体的使用模式。我们的这些指标将有助于研究人员在构建教育对话系统时，能够衡量他们是否实现了预期的教学目标。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Cut Your Losses! Learning to Prune Paths Early for Efficient Parallel Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 及时修剪路径，实现高效并行推理！尽早学会如何优化路径选择
papers.authors: Jiaxi Bi, Tongxu Luo, Wenyu Du, Zhengyang Tang, Benyou Wang
papers.abstract: Parallel reasoning enhances Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) but incurs prohibitive costs due to futile paths caused by early errors. To mitigate this, path pruning at the prefix level is essential, yet existing research remains fragmented without a standardized framework. In this work, we propose the first systematic taxonomy of path pruning, categorizing methods by their signal source (internal vs. external) and learnability (learnable vs. non-learnable). This classification reveals the unexplored potential of learnable internal methods, motivating our proposal of STOP (Super TOken for Pruning). Extensive evaluations across LRMs ranging from 1.5B to 20B parameters demonstrate that STOP achieves superior effectiveness and efficiency compared to existing baselines. Furthermore, we rigorously validate the scalability of STOP under varying compute budgets—for instance, boosting GPT-OSS-20B accuracy on AIME25 from 84% to nearly 90% under fixed compute budgets. Finally, we distill our findings into formalized empirical guidelines to facilitate optimal real-world deployment. Code, data and models are available at https://bijiaxihh.github.io/STOP.
papers.abstract_zh: 并行推理能够提升大型推理模型的效果，但由于早期错误导致的无效路径而带来高昂的成本。为了缓解这一问题，在前缀级别进行路径剪枝是必不可少的，但现有的研究仍然缺乏统一的框架。在这项研究中，我们提出了首个系统的路径剪枝分类体系，根据信号来源（内部与外部）以及可学习性（可学习与非可学习）对方法进行分类。这种分类揭示了可学习的内部方法所拥有的巨大潜力，这也促使我们提出了STOP这一算法。我们在参数规模从15亿到200亿不等的多种推理模型中进行了广泛的评估，结果表明，STOP相比现有基线方法具有更高的效率和效果。此外，我们还严格验证了STOP在不同计算资源条件下的可扩展性——例如，在固定计算资源的情况下，GPT-OSS-20B模型的准确率从84%提升到了近90%。最后，我们将研究发现整理成正式的实证指南，以帮助实现最优的现实应用部署。相关的代码、数据和模型均可在此处获取：https://bijiaxihh.github.io/STOP。

papers.title: Discourse Coherence and Response-Guided Context Rewriting for Multi-Party Dialogue Generation
papers.title_zh: 话语连贯性以及基于响应的上下文重构在多方对话生成中的应用
papers.authors: Zhiyu Cao, Peifeng Li, Qiaoming Zhu
papers.abstract: Previous research on multi-party dialogue generation has predominantly leveraged structural information inherent in dialogues to directly inform the generation process. However, the prevalence of colloquial expressions and incomplete utterances in dialogues often impedes comprehension and weakens the fidelity of dialogue structure representations, which is particularly pronounced in multi-party dialogues. In this work, we propose a novel framework DRCR (Discourse coherence and Response-guided Context Rewriting) to improve multi-party dialogue generation through dialogue context rewriting. Specifically, DRCR employs two complementary feedback signals, discourse coherence and response quality, to construct preference data for both context rewriting and response generation. Moreover, we propose a dynamic self-evolution learning method that allows the rewriter and responder to continuously enhance their capabilities through mutual interaction in an iterative training loop. Comprehensive experiments conducted on four multi-party dialogue datasets substantiate the effectiveness of DRCR.
papers.abstract_zh: 以往关于多方对话生成的研究主要利用对话中固有的结构信息来直接指导生成过程。然而，对话中大量使用口语表达和不完整的话语往往会影响理解效果，从而降低对话结构表示的准确性，这在多方对话中尤为明显。在本研究中，我们提出了一种名为DRCR的新框架，通过对话上下文的重构来提高多方对话的生成质量。具体来说，DRCR结合了两种互补的反馈机制：话语连贯性和回应质量，以此来构建用于上下文重构和回应生成的偏好数据。此外，我们还提出了一种动态自进化学习方法，使得重构者和回应者能够通过迭代训练循环中的相互互动不断提升自身能力。在四个多方对话数据集上进行的全面实验证明了DRCR的有效性。

papers.title: EvolvR: Self-Evolving Pairwise Reasoning for Story Evaluation to Enhance Generation
papers.title_zh: EvolvR：一种自进化成对推理系统，用于提升故事评估能力，促进故事创作
papers.authors: Xinda Wang, Zhengxu Hou, Yangshijie Zhang, Yanbingren, Jialin Liu, ChenZhuo Zhao, Zhibo Yang, Bin-Bin Yang, Feng Xiao
papers.abstract: Although the effectiveness of Large Language Models as judges has been validated, their performance remains limited in open-ended tasks, particularly in story evaluation. Accurate story evaluation is crucial not only for assisting human quality judgment but also for providing reward signals to guide story generation. However, existing methods face a dilemma: prompt engineering for closed-source models suffers from poor adaptability, while fine-tuning approaches for open-source models lack the reasoning capabilities essential for story evaluation. To address this, we propose the Self-Evolving Pairwise Reasoning (EvolvR) framework. Grounded in pairwise comparison, the framework first self-synthesizes score-aligned Chain-of-Thought (CoT) data via a multi-persona strategy. To ensure data quality, these raw CoTs undergo a self-filtering process, utilizing multi-agents to guarantee their logical rigor and robustness. Finally, the evaluator trained on the refined data is deployed as a reward model to guide the story generation task. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on three evaluation benchmarks including StoryER, HANNA and OpenMEVA. Furthermore, when served as a reward model, it enhances the quality of generated stories, thereby validating the superiority of our self-evolving approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型作为评估工具的有效性已经得到验证，但它们在开放性任务中的表现仍然有限，尤其是在故事评估方面。准确的故事评估不仅有助于辅助人类进行质量判断，还能为故事生成提供奖励信号。然而，现有的方法面临着一个困境：针对闭源模型的提示工程存在适应性差的问题，而针对开源模型的微调方法则缺乏进行故事评估所需的推理能力。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了自演化成对元推理框架（EvolvR）。该框架基于成对比较的原理，首先通过多角色策略对得分一致的思维链数据进行自合成处理。为了确保数据的质量，这些原始思维链数据会经过自我过滤过程，利用多智能体来确保其逻辑严谨性和鲁棒性。最后，基于这些精炼数据进行训练的评估器被用作奖励模型来指导故事生成任务。实验结果表明，我们的框架在包括StoryER、HANNA和OpenMEVA在内的三个评估基准上取得了顶尖性能。此外，当作为奖励模型使用时，它能够提升生成故事的质量，从而验证了我们自演化方法的优越性。

papers.title: Double: Breaking the Acceleration Limit via Double Retrieval Speculative Parallelism
papers.title_zh: 双线程：通过双重检索并行处理技术突破加速限制
papers.authors: Yuhao Shen, Tianyu Liu, Junyi Shen, Jinyang Wu, Quan Kong, Huan Li, Cong Wang
papers.abstract: Parallel Speculative Decoding (PSD) accelerates traditional Speculative Decoding (SD) by overlapping draft generation with verification. However, it remains hampered by two fundamental challenges: (1) a theoretical speedup ceiling dictated by the speed ratio between the draft and target models, and (2) high computational waste and pipeline stall due to mid-sequence token rejections of early errors. To address these limitations, we introduce Double (Double Retrieval Speculative Parallelism). By bridging the gap between SD and PSD, our framework resolves the Retrieval Precision-Efficiency Dilemma through a novel synchronous mechanism. Specifically, we enable the draft model to execute iterative retrieval speculations to break the theoretical speedup limits; to alleviate rejections without rollback, the target model performs authoritative retrieval to generate multi-token guidance. Double is entirely training-free and lossless. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art speedup of \textbf{5.3}\times on LLaMA3.3-70B and \textbf{2.8}\times on Qwen3-32B, significantly outperforming the advanced method EAGLE-3 that requires extensive model training. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sylvan820/Double1.
papers.abstract_zh: 并行推测解码（PSD）通过将草稿生成与验证过程重叠来加速传统的推测解码（SD）算法。然而，该算法仍受到两个根本性的挑战的制约：（1）理论上的加速上限取决于草稿模型与目标模型之间的速度比；（2）由于早期错误导致的中间序列标记被拒绝，从而导致大量的计算资源浪费和流水线阻塞。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了双模式推测并行性技术。通过这种技术，我们可以弥合SD和PSD之间的差距，并通过一种新颖的同步机制解决检索精度与效率之间的矛盾。具体来说，我们让草稿模型能够执行迭代式的推测检索，从而突破理论上的加速极限；为了减轻因拒绝而产生的负面影响，目标模型会执行权威性的检索操作，以生成多标记指导信息。双模式推测并行性技术完全不需要额外的训练步骤，且不会产生任何损失。大量实验表明，在LLaMA3.3-70B上，我们的算法实现了高达5.3倍的加速效果；而在Qwen3-32B上，则实现了2.8倍的加速效果。这一性能明显优于需要大量模型训练的先进方法EAGLE-3。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Sylvan820/Double1下载。

papers.title: BWLA: Breaking the Barrier of W1AX Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
papers.title_zh: BWLA：突破W1AX中训练后量化处理的障碍，为大型语言模型赋能
papers.authors: Zhixiong Zhao, Zukang Xu, Dawei Yang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have driven major progress in NLP, yet their substantial memory and compute demands still hinder practical deployment. Binarization can compress weights to 1 bit, fundamentally lowering compute and bandwidth cost. However, existing methods cannot address activation heavy tails and thus must keep activations in high precision, preventing true end-to-end acceleration. To overcome this limitation, we propose BWLA, the first post-training quantization framework that preserves high accuracy while achieving 1-bit weight quantization together with low-bit activations (e.g., 6 bits). The Orthogonal-Kronecker Transformation (OKT) learns an orthogonal mapping via EM minimization, converting unimodal weights into symmetric bimodal forms while suppressing activation tails and incoherence. The Proximal SVD Projection (PSP) then performs lightweight low-rank refinement through proximal SVD projection, further enhancing quantizability with minimal overhead. On Qwen3-32B, BWLA reaches a Wikitext2 perplexity of 11.92 under 6-bit activations (vs. 38 from SOTA), improves five zero-shot tasks by more than 70%, and delivers 3.26× inference speedup, demonstrating strong potential for real-world LLM compression and acceleration. The code will be available at BWLA.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自然语言处理领域取得了重大进展，然而其庞大的内存和计算需求仍然阻碍了实际的应用部署。二进制化可以将权重压缩到1位，从而显著降低计算和带宽成本。不过，现有的方法无法处理激活值的极端情况，因此必须保持高精度的激活值，这限制了真正的端到端加速效果。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了BWLA框架——这是首个在保留高精度的同时实现1位权重量化以及低位数激活值的后训练量化方法（例如，6位）。正交克罗内克变换通过EM最小化算法学习出一个正交映射，将单峰型权重转换为对称的双峰型形式，同时抑制激活值的尾部和不一致性问题。然后，近端SVD投影技术通过近端SVD投影进行轻量级的低秩细化，进一步提升了量化效率，且开销极小。在Qwen3-32B模型中，BWLA在6位激活值下达到了11.92的Wikitext2困惑度水平（相比之下，现有最佳方案为38位），在五个零样本任务上的表现提升了超过70%，并且推理速度提高了3.26倍，显示出其在现实世界中的LLM压缩和加速方面的巨大潜力。相关代码可访问BWLA网站获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Progressive Multimodal Search and Reasoning for Knowledge-Intensive Visual Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 适用于知识密集型视觉问答场景的渐进式多模态搜索与推理方法
papers.authors: Changin Choi, Wonseok Lee, Jungmin Ko, Wonjong Rhee
papers.abstract: Knowledge-intensive visual question answering (VQA) requires external knowledge beyond image content, demanding precise visual grounding and coherent integration of visual and textual information. Although multimodal retrieval-augmented generation has achieved notable advances by incorporating external knowledge bases, existing approaches largely adopt single-pass frameworks that often fail to acquire sufficient knowledge and lack mechanisms to revise misdirected reasoning. We propose PMSR (Progressive Multimodal Search and Reasoning), a framework that progressively constructs a structured reasoning trajectory to enhance both knowledge acquisition and synthesis. PMSR uses dual-scope queries conditioned on both the latest record and the trajectory to retrieve diverse knowledge from heterogeneous knowledge bases. The retrieved evidence is then synthesized into compact records via compositional reasoning. This design facilitates controlled iterative refinement, which supports more stable reasoning trajectories with reduced error propagation. Extensive experiments across six diverse benchmarks (Encyclopedic-VQA, InfoSeek, MMSearch, LiveVQA, FVQA, and OK-VQA) demonstrate that PMSR consistently improves both retrieval recall and end-to-end answer accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识密集型视觉问题回答（VQA）需要超出图像内容的外部知识，这要求对视觉信息进行精确的定位，并将视觉信息与文本信息进行有机结合。尽管多模态检索增强生成技术通过整合外部知识库取得了显著进展，但现有的方法大多采用单通道框架，这些框架往往无法获取足够的知识，且缺乏修正错误推理的机制。我们提出了PMSR（渐进式多模态搜索与推理）框架，该框架逐步构建出结构化的推理路径，从而提升知识获取和综合能力。PMSR使用基于最新记录和推理路径的双重范围查询，从异构知识库中检索多样化的知识。然后，通过组合推理将检索到的证据整合成简洁的记录。这种设计有助于实现可控的迭代优化，从而提供更稳定的推理路径，并减少误差的传播。在六个不同的基准测试场景（Encyclopedic-VQA、InfoSeek、MMSearch、LiveVQA、FVQA和OK-VQA）中进行的广泛实验表明，PMSR能够持续提高检索召回率和端到端答案的准确性。

papers.title: Dynamics of Cognitive Heterogeneity: Investigating Behavioral Biases in Multi-Stage Supply Chains with LLM-Based Simulation
papers.title_zh: 认知异质性的动态特性：利用基于大语言模型的仿真技术研究多阶段供应链中的行为偏差
papers.authors: Jiuyun Jiang, Yuecheng Hong, Bo Yang, Jin Yang, Guangxin Jiang, Xiaomeng Guo, Guang Xiao
papers.abstract: Modeling coordination among generative agents in complex multi-round decision-making presents a core challenge for AI and operations management. Although behavioral experiments have revealed cognitive biases behind supply chain inefficiencies, traditional methods face scalability and control limitations. We introduce a scalable experimental paradigm using Large Language Models (LLMs) to simulate multi-stage supply chain dynamics. Grounded in a Hierarchical Reasoning Framework, this study specifically analyzes the impact of cognitive heterogeneity on agent interactions. Unlike prior homogeneous settings, we employ DeepSeek and GPT agents to systematically vary reasoning sophistication across supply chain tiers. Through rigorously replicated and statistically validated simulations, we investigate how this cognitive diversity influences collective outcomes. Results indicate that agents exhibit myopic and self-interested behaviors that exacerbate systemic inefficiencies. However, we demonstrate that information sharing effectively mitigates these adverse effects. Our findings extend traditional behavioral methods and offer new insights into the dynamics of AI-enabled organizations. This work underscores both the potential and limitations of LLM-based agents as proxies for human decision-making in complex operational environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 在复杂的多轮决策中，模拟生成性代理之间的协调关系，是人工智能和运营管理中的一个核心挑战。尽管行为实验揭示了供应链效率低下背后的认知偏差，但传统方法在可扩展性和控制方面存在局限性。我们提出了一种基于大语言模型的可扩展实验范式，用于模拟多阶段的供应链动态。该研究基于分层推理框架，专门分析了认知异质性对代理间互动的影响。与以往的同质环境不同，我们采用DeepSeek和GPT代理来系统地调整供应链各层级的逻辑复杂性。通过严格复制并经过统计验证的模拟实验，我们研究了这种认知多样性如何影响整体结果。结果表明，代理表现出短视和自私的行为，这加剧了系统的效率低下。然而，我们发现信息共享能够有效缓解这些负面效应。我们的研究发现不仅扩展了传统的行为分析方法，还为理解由人工智能驱动的组织动态提供了新的见解。这项工作强调了基于大语言模型的代理在复杂运营环境中作为人类决策代理的潜力与局限性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Triviality Corrected Endogenous Reward
papers.title_zh: 经过修正的、与 triviality 相关的内在奖励
papers.authors: Xinda Wang, Zhengxu Hou, Yangshijie Zhang, Yanbingren, Jialin Liu, ChenZhuo Zhao, Zhibo Yang, Bin-Bin Yang, Feng Xiao
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for open-ended text generation is constrained by the lack of verifiable rewards, necessitating reliance on judge models that require either annotated data or powerful closed-source models. Inspired by recent work on unsupervised reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning using confidence-based endogenous rewards, we investigate whether this principle can be adapted to open-ended writing tasks. We find that directly applying confidence rewards leads to Triviality Bias: the policy collapses toward high-probability outputs, reducing diversity and meaningful content. We propose TCER (Triviality Corrected Endogenous Reward), which addresses this bias by rewarding the relative information gain between a specialist policy and a generalist reference policy, modulated by a probability-dependent correction mechanism. Across multiple writing benchmarks and model architectures, TCER achieves consistent improvements without external supervision. Furthermore, TCER also transfers effectively to mathematical reasoning, validating the generality of our approach across different generation tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 开放式文本生成的强化学习受到无法获得可验证奖励的限制，因此不得不依赖那些需要标注数据或强大闭源模型的评估模型。受最近关于使用基于置信度的内生奖励进行数学推理的无监督强化学习研究的启发，我们研究了这一原理是否适用于开放式写作任务。我们发现，直接应用置信度奖励会导致“琐碎性偏差”：策略会倾向于选择高概率的输出，从而降低了文本的多样性和内涵深度。我们提出了TCER（修正了琐碎性偏差的内生奖励机制），它通过奖励专家策略与通用参考策略之间的相对信息增益来克服这种偏差，同时采用一种依赖于概率的校正机制来进行调节。在多个写作基准测试和不同的模型架构中，TCER能够在没有外部监督的情况下取得持续的改进。此外，TCER还有效地应用于数学推理领域，证明了我们的方法在不同生成任务中的通用性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Identity-Robust Language Model Generation via Content Integrity Preservation
papers.title_zh: 通过保持内容完整性来生成具有身份鲁棒性的语言模型
papers.authors: Miao Zhang, Kelly Chen, Mehrab Tanjim, Rumi Chunara
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) outputs often vary across user sociodemographic attributes, leading to disparities in factual accuracy, utility, and safety, even for objective questions where demographic information is irrelevant. Unlike prior work on stereotypical or representational bias, this paper studies identity-dependent degradation of core response quality. We show empirically that such degradation arises from biased generation behavior, despite factual knowledge being robustly encoded across identities. Motivated by this mismatch, we propose a lightweight, training-free framework for identity-robust generation that selectively neutralizes non-critical identity information while preserving semantically essential attributes, thus maintaining output content integrity. Experiments across four benchmarks and 18 sociodemographic identities demonstrate an average 66.3% reduction in identity-dependent bias compared to vanilla prompting and outperforms existing prompt-based defenses. Our work addresses a critical gap in mitigating the impact of user identity cues in prompts on core generation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的输出往往因用户的社经属性而异，这会导致事实准确性、实用性和安全性的差异，即使对于那些与社经信息无关的客观问题也是如此。与之前关于刻板印象或表征偏见的研究不同，本文研究了与身份相关的核心生成质量下降现象。我们通过实证研究表明，这种下降是由有偏见的生成行为引起的，尽管事实知识在不同身份下被稳健地编码。基于这一不匹配现象，我们提出了一个轻量级、无需训练的框架，该框架能够选择性地消除非关键性身份信息，同时保留语义上重要的属性，从而保持输出内容的完整性。在四个基准测试和18种社经身份上的实验表明，与传统的提示方式相比，我们的方法平均减少了66.3%的与身份相关的偏差，并且其效果优于现有的基于提示的防御方法。我们的工作解决了在提示中减轻用户身份线索对核心生成质量影响的关键问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RFS-Guard: Detecting Reasoning Hallucinations via Cross-Phase Routing Focus in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: RFS-Guard：通过跨相位路由技术检测推理中的幻觉现象——特别是在大型推理模型中
papers.authors: Zihang Liu, Fang Zhouhua, Hui Liu, Zhiwei Liu, Yong Li, Haishuai Wang
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks by generating intermediate reasoning before the final answer, yet they remain prone to reasoning hallucinations such as subtle arithmetic or constraint-violation errors. Prior hallucination detectors often rely on external verification or local token-level signals, which are limited for LRMs and largely overlook whether the cross-phase information flow from reasoning to answering is structurally robust. We propose Routing Focus Score (RFS), a step-level indicator that measures how strongly cross-step attention routing aligns with semantic proximity derived from hidden-state cosine similarity. We further design RFS-Guard, a lightweight hallucination detection framework based on RFS. Empirically, we observe that higher reasoning–answer RFS is consistently associated with higher hallucination risk, suggesting a routing-collapse failure mode where models might prefer self-confirmation loops and suppress the ability to audit their own generations. Experimental results across multiple domains and models demonstrate the superiority of RFS-Guard for detecting and localizing hallucinations in LRMs without requiring external tools or repeated sampling.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在解决复杂任务时表现出强大的性能，因为它们能够在得出最终答案之前生成中间推理结果。然而，这些模型仍然容易出现推理幻觉，比如细微的算术错误或违反约束的错误。传统的幻觉检测方法通常依赖于外部验证或局部令牌级信号，但这些方法对于大型推理模型来说存在局限性，而且往往忽略了从推理到回答的过程中信息流的结构稳定性。我们提出了“路由焦点得分”这一指标，它用于衡量跨步骤的注意力路由与由隐藏状态余弦相似性得出的语义邻近性之间的紧密程度。我们还设计了基于该指标的轻量级幻觉检测框架“路由焦点得分保护器”。通过实验观察发现，较高的推理-回答路由焦点得分与较高的幻觉风险呈正相关，这表明存在一种路由崩溃的模式：模型可能会倾向于自我确认循环，从而抑制了自我生成结果的审核能力。在多个领域和模型上的实验结果表明，“路由焦点得分保护器”在检测和定位大型推理模型中的幻觉方面具有卓越效果，且无需使用外部工具或重复采样即可实现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Causal-ESC: Reliable Policy Learning for Emotional Support Conversation via Causal Inference
papers.title_zh: 因果推理：通过因果推断实现情感支持对话的可靠策略学习
papers.authors: Xv Wang, Wang Zhenyu, Guanyu Zheng, Rui Zhang
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced the fluency of Emotional Support Conversation (ESC) systems, current research predominantly focuses on engineering increasingly complex architectures—from intricate reasoning chains to multi-agent collaborations. While these advancements (e.g., CoT) offer semantic traces of reasoning, they remain mechanistically opaque, obscuring the fundamental causal mechanisms between dialogue features and effective empathic strategies, leading to poor interpretability and susceptibility to distribution shifts in offline learning. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework Causal-ESC. Departing from conventional paradigms that directly utilize raw dialogue history as input, our approach introduces Doubly Robust (DR) learning to explicitly model the causal effect of utterance features on strategy selection, effectively mitigating the biases and counterfactual unobservability inherent in offline datasets. We further integrate an LLM-based stylized rewriting mechanism to translate these rigorously learned causal strategies into natural, context-consistent responses. Comprehensive experiments, supported by statistical verification (e.g., Outcome R^2) and human-like evaluation, demonstrate that our framework not only significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in empathy and helpfulness but also provides a theoretically grounded, interpretable solution to the mechanistic interpretability dilemma in affective computing.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在提升情感支持对话系统的流畅性方面取得了显著进展，但目前的研究主要集中在构建更复杂的架构上——从复杂的推理链到多智能体协作。尽管这些进步（例如上下文推理）提供了语义上的推理痕迹，但它们仍然缺乏机制上的透明性，使得对话特征与有效的共情策略之间的基本因果机制难以被理解。这导致了结果的不可解释性，以及离线学习过程中对分布变化的敏感性。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种名为“因果情感支持对话”的新框架。与直接利用原始对话历史作为输入的传统方法不同，我们的方法引入了“双重鲁棒性”学习机制，以明确模拟话语特征对策略选择的因果影响，从而有效消除离线数据集中存在的偏见和无法观测到的反事实情况。我们还整合了基于语言模型的风格化改写机制，将这些经过严格训练的因果策略转化为自然、符合上下文的回应。通过全面的实验验证（例如结果R^2统计指标）和类似人类的评估方式，我们发现我们的框架不仅在共情能力和提供帮助能力方面显著优于现有的基线算法，而且为情感计算中的机制可解释性问题提供了一种理论上有根据、可解释的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Compression Should Not Be Blind: V-Skip for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning via Dual-Path Anchoring
papers.title_zh: 思维链压缩不应是盲目的：通过双路径锚定实现高效的多模态推理——V-Skip方法
papers.authors: Dongxu Zhang, Yiding Sun, Cheng Tan, Wenbiao Yan, Ning Yang, Jihua Zhu, Haijun Zhang
papers.abstract: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning significantly enhances the performance of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), its autoregressive nature incurs prohibitive latency constraints. Current efforts to mitigate this via token compression often fail by blindly applying text-centric metrics to multimodal contexts. We identify a critical failure mode termed Visual Amnesia, where linguistically redundant tokens are erroneously pruned, leading to hallucinations. To address this, we introduce V-Skip that reformulates token pruning as a Visual-Anchored Information Bottleneck (VA-IB) optimization problem. V-Skip employs a dual-path gating mechanism that weighs token importance through both linguistic surprisal and cross-modal attention flow, effectively rescuing visually salient anchors. Extensive experiments on Qwen2-VL and Llama-3.2 families demonstrate that V-Skip achieves a speedup with negligible accuracy loss. Specifically, it preserves fine-grained visual details, outperforming other baselines over 30% on the DocVQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然思维链推理显著提升了多模态大语言模型的性能，但其自回归特性却带来了难以承受的延迟问题。目前通过标记压缩来缓解这个问题的方法往往失败，因为它们盲目地将文本中心化的指标应用于多模态上下文。我们发现了一个关键的问题——视觉遗忘现象，即那些在语言上冗余的标记被错误地删减了，从而导致幻觉的产生。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了V-Skip算法，它将标记删减重新定义为一个以视觉信息瓶颈为优化目标的模型。V-Skip采用了一种双路径门控机制，通过语言惊喜度和跨模态注意力流来权衡标记的重要性，从而有效保留视觉上重要的元素。在Qwen2-VL和Llama-3.2模型上的大量实验表明，V-Skip在提升效率的同时，准确率损失很小。具体来说，它能够很好地保留细粒度的视觉细节，在DocVQA任务上的表现优于其他基线模型，提升了超过30%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CodeJudgeBench: Benchmarking LLM-as-a-Judge for Coding Tasks
papers.title_zh: CodeJudgeBench：针对编程任务的、以语言模型为裁判的基准测试方案
papers.authors: Hongchao Jiang, Yiming Chen, Yushi Cao, Hung-yi Lee, Robby T. Tan
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only to generate code, but also to judge it: comparing, ranking, or scoring competing solutions. However, their reliability in this evaluative role remains poorly understood. Inconsistent or flawed judgments can undermine benchmarks and distort training signals. This paper investigates the performance and robustness of LLMs when used as code judges. We introduce CodeJudgeBench, a benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate LLM-as-a-Judge models across three critical coding tasks: code generation, code repair, and unit test generation. We comprehensively benchmark the performance of 26 LLM-as-a-Judge models, encompassing general-purpose, code-tuned, and reasoning models. Our empirical findings reveal that relatively small reasoning models (e.g., Qwen3-8B) can outperform much larger non-reasoning models up to 70B. We further stress-test robustness by applying both general and code-specific perturbations. All models show significant instability and are sensitive to changes such as response ordering, variable naming, and misleading comments. These findings highlight serious concerns about the consistency and robustness of LLM-based judges for coding tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）不仅被用于生成代码，还被用于评估代码：比较、排序或评分不同的解决方案。然而，这些模型在评估任务中的可靠性仍然缺乏深入的研究。不一致或错误的判断可能会破坏基准测试，并扭曲训练数据。本文研究了将LLM作为代码评估器时其性能和鲁棒性。我们提出了CodeJudgeBench这一基准测试，专门用于评估LLM作为评估器的模型在三个关键编码任务上的表现：代码生成、代码修复以及单元测试生成。我们对26种作为评估器的LLM模型进行了全面的性能评估，这些模型包括通用型模型、基于代码的训练和推理模型。我们的实验结果表明，相对较小的推理模型（例如Qwen3-8B）可以超越那些规模更大的非推理模型，后者的规模可达70B。我们还通过应用通用性和特定于代码的扰动来进一步测试模型的鲁棒性。所有模型都表现出显著的不稳定性，并且对诸如响应顺序、变量命名以及误导性注释等变化非常敏感。这些发现凸显了基于LLM的评估器在编码任务中一致性和鲁棒性的严重问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Towards a Mechanistic Understanding of Large Reasoning Models: A Survey of Training, Inference, and Failures
papers.title_zh: 关于大型推理模型的机制性理解：对训练、推理及失败情况的综述
papers.authors: Yi Hu, Jiaqi Gu, Ruxin Wang, Zijun Yao, Hao Peng, Xiaobao Wu, Jianhui Chen, Muhan Zhang, Liangming Pan
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has catalyzed the emergence of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) that have pushed reasoning capabilities to new heights. While their performance has garnered significant excitement, exploring the internal mechanisms driving these behaviors has become an equally critical research frontier. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of the mechanistic understanding of LRMs, organizing recent findings into three core dimensions: 1) training dynamics, 2) reasoning mechanisms, and 3) unintended behaviors. By synthesizing these insights, we aim to bridge the gap between black-box performance and mechanistic transparency. Finally, we discuss under-explored challenges to outline a roadmap for future mechanistic studies, including the need for applied interpretability, improved methodologies, and a unified theoretical framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）促进了大型推理模型（LRM）的出现，这些模型的推理能力已经达到了新的高度。虽然它们的性能引起了极大的关注，但探索驱动这些行为的内部机制也成为了一个同样重要的研究领域。本文对LRM的机制进行了全面的综述，将最新研究成果分为三个核心方面：1）训练动态；2）推理机制；3）非预期行为。通过整合这些见解，我们旨在弥合黑盒性能与机制透明性之间的差距。最后，我们讨论了尚未充分探讨的挑战，并为未来的机制研究制定了路线图，包括实现应用可解释性、改进研究方法以及建立统一的理论框架等需求。

papers.title: Modeling LLM Unlearning as an Asymmetric Two-Task Learning Problem
papers.title_zh: 将LLM的“遗忘”过程建模为一种不对称的双任务学习问题
papers.authors: Zeguan Xiao, Siqing Li, Yong Wang, Xuetao Wei, Jian Yang, Yun Chen, Guanhua Chen
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) aims to remove targeted knowledge while preserving general capability. In this paper, we recast LLM unlearning as an asymmetric two-task problem: retention is the primary objective and forgetting is an auxiliary. From this perspective, we propose a retention-prioritized gradient synthesis framework that decouples task-specific gradient extraction from conflict-aware combination. Instantiating the framework, we adapt established PCGrad to resolve gradient conflicts, and introduce SAGO, a novel retention-prioritized gradient synthesis method. Theoretically, both variants ensure non-negative cosine similarity with the retain gradient, while SAGO achieves strictly tighter alignment through constructive sign-constrained synthesis. Empirically, on WMDP Bio/Cyber and RWKU benchmarks, SAGO consistently pushes the Pareto frontier: e.g., on WMDP Bio (SimNPO+GD), recovery of target model MMLU performance progresses from 44.6% (naive) to 94.0% (+PCGrad) and further to 96.0% (+SAGO), while maintaining comparable forgetting strength. Our results show that re-shaping gradient geometry, rather than re-balancing losses, is the key to mitigating unlearning-retention trade-offs.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对大语言模型（LLM）的卸载学习旨在在保留通用能力的同时去除特定知识。在本文中，我们将LLM的卸载学习重新定义为一个非对称的双任务问题：保留是主要目标，而遗忘则是一个辅助过程。从这个角度出发，我们提出了一种以保留为优先的梯度合成框架，该框架将任务特定的梯度提取与冲突感知的组合分离开来。通过实例化该框架，我们将现有的PCGrad算法进行改进以解决梯度冲突问题，并引入了一种新的以保留为优先的梯度合成方法——SAGO。理论上，这两种方法都能确保保留梯度与模型之间的非负余弦相似度，而SAGO则通过构造性符号约束合成实现了更严格的对齐效果。在WMDP Bio/Cyber和RWKU基准测试上，SAGO始终能够推动帕累托前沿的移动：例如，在WMDP Bio（SimNPO+GD）测试中，目标模型MMLU性能的恢复从44.6%（原始方法）提高到94.0%（结合PCGrad），进一步提升到96.0%（结合SAGO），同时保持了相当的遗忘强度。我们的结果表明，改变梯度的几何形状，而不是重新平衡损失函数，才是缓解卸载学习与保留之间权衡的关键。

papers.title: MVP: Enhancing Video Large Language Models via Self-supervised Masked Video Prediction
papers.title_zh: MVP：通过自监督掩码视频预测技术提升视频大语言模型的性能
papers.authors: Xiaokun Sun, Zezhong Wu, Zewen Ding, Linli Xu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning based post-training paradigms for Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have achieved significant success by optimizing for visual-semantic tasks such as captioning or VideoQA. However, while these approaches effectively enhance perception abilities, they primarily target holistic content understanding, often lacking explicit supervision for intrinsic temporal coherence and inter-frame correlations. This tendency limits the models’ ability to capture intricate dynamics and fine-grained visual causality. To explicitly bridge this gap, we propose a novel post-training objective: Masked Video Prediction (MVP). By requiring the model to reconstruct a masked continuous segment from a set of challenging distractors, MVP forces the model to attend to the sequential logic and temporal context of events. To support scalable training, we introduce a scalable data synthesis pipeline capable of transforming arbitrary video corpora into MVP training samples, and further employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a fine-grained reward function to enhance the model’s understanding of video context and temporal properties. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that MVP enhances video reasoning capabilities by directly reinforcing temporal reasoning and causal understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于强化学习的视频大语言模型训练后范式在优化视觉语义任务（如标题生成或视频问答）方面取得了显著成效。然而，虽然这些方法有效提升了感知能力，但它们主要侧重于整体内容的理解，往往缺乏对内在时间连贯性和帧间关联性的明确监督。这种倾向限制了模型捕捉复杂动态和细微视觉因果关系的能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新颖的训练后目标：掩蔽视频预测（Masked Video Prediction，MVP）。通过要求模型从一组具有挑战性的干扰项中重建一个被遮蔽的连续片段，MVP迫使模型关注事件的序列逻辑和时间背景。为了支持可扩展的训练，我们引入了一种可扩展的数据合成流程，能够将任意视频语料库转化为MVP训练样本。此外，我们还采用了群体相对策略优化算法，并结合细粒度的奖励函数，以进一步提升模型对视频上下文和时间属性的理解能力。全面的评估表明，MVP通过直接强化时间推理和因果理解能力，显著提升了视频推理能力。

papers.title: Knowledge Poisoning Attacks on Medical Multi-Modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 针对医学多模态检索增强生成的知识污染攻击
papers.authors: Peiru Yang, Haoran Zheng, Tong Ju, Shiting Wang, Wanchun Ni, Jiajun Liu, Shangguang Wang, Yongfeng Huang, Tao Qi
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a widely adopted paradigm for enhancing LLMs in medical applications by incorporating expert multi-modal knowledge during generation. However, the underlying retrieval databases may naturally contain, or be intentionally injected with, adversarial knowledge, which can perturb model outputs and undermine system reliability. To investigate this risk, prior studies have explored knowledge poisoning attacks in medical RAG systems. Nevertheless, most of them rely on the strong assumption that adversaries possess prior knowledge of user queries, which is unrealistic in deployments and substantially limits their practical applicability. In this paper, we propose M^3Att, a knowledge-poisoning framework designed for medical multimodal RAG systems, assuming only limited distribution knowledge of the underlying database. Our core idea is to inject covert misinformation into textual data while using paired visual data as a query-agnostic trigger to promote retrieval. We first propose a unified framework that introduces imperceptible perturbations to visual inputs to manipulate retrieval probabilities. Besides, due to the prior medical knowledge in LLMs, naively poisoned medical content with explicit factual errors can be corrected during generation. Thus, we leverage the inherent ambiguity of medical diagnosis and design a covert misinformation injection strategy that degrades diagnostic accuracy while evading model self-correction. Experiments on five LLMs and datasets demonstrate that M^3Att consistently produces clinically plausible yet incorrect generations. Codes: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/M3Att.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）是一种被广泛采用的范式，它通过在生成过程中引入专家的多模态知识来提升大语言模型在医学应用中的性能。然而，底层的检索数据库可能会自然包含或故意注入敌对信息，这可能会干扰模型的输出并降低系统的可靠性。为了研究这种风险，先前的研究已经探讨了在医学RAG系统中进行知识污染攻击的方法。不过，大多数研究都基于一个不现实的假设，即攻击者能够提前了解用户查询的内容，这在实际部署中是不现实的，并且大大限制了这些研究的实际应用价值。在本文中，我们提出了M^3Att框架，这是一个专为医学多模态RAG系统设计的知识污染框架，它仅依赖于对底层数据库的有限了解。我们的核心思想是在文本数据中注入隐蔽的错误信息，同时利用配对的视觉数据作为与查询无关的触发器来促进检索。我们首先提出了一个统一的框架，该框架在视觉输入中引入难以察觉的扰动，以操纵检索概率。此外，由于大语言模型中预先存在的医学知识，带有明确事实错误的医学内容可以在生成过程中被纠正。因此，我们利用医学诊断的固有模糊性，设计了一种隐蔽的错误信息注入策略，这种策略会在避免模型自我修正的同时降低诊断的准确性。在五个大语言模型和数据集上的实验表明，M^3Att始终能够产生看似合理但实际上不正确的生成结果。代码链接：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/M3Att

papers.title: Maximizing Local Entropy Where It Matters: Prefix-Aware Localized LLM Unlearning
papers.title_zh: 在关键领域最大化局部熵：考虑前缀信息的局部化大语言模型遗忘机制
papers.authors: Naixin Zhai, Pengyang Shao, Binbin Zheng, Yonghui Yang, Fei Shen, Long Bai, Xun Yang
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to forget sensitive knowledge from Large Language Models (LLMs) while maintaining general utility. However, existing approaches typically treat all tokens in a response indiscriminately and enforce uncertainty over the entire vocabulary. This global treatment results in unnecessary utility degradation and extends optimization to content-agnostic regions. To address these limitations, we propose PALU (Prefix-Aware Localized Unlearning), a framework driven by a local entropy maximization objective across both temporal and vocabulary dimensions. PALU reveals that (i) suppressing the sensitive prefix alone is sufficient to sever the causal generation link, and (ii) flattening only the top-K logits is adequate to maximize uncertainty in the critical subspace. These findings allow PALU to alleviate redundant optimization across the full vocabulary and parameter space while minimizing collateral damage to general model performance. Comprehensive evaluations validate that PALU achieves superior forgetting efficacy and utility preservation compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/nxZhai/PALU.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器去学习旨在从大语言模型中遗忘敏感知识，同时保持通用性。然而，现有的方法通常不加区分地处理响应中的所有标记，并对整个词汇表施加不确定性。这种全局处理方式会导致不必要的效用下降，并将优化扩展到与内容无关的区域。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了PALU（前缀感知的局部去学习）框架。该框架以局部熵最大化为目标，同时考虑时间和词汇表的维度。研究发现，(i) 仅抑制敏感前缀就足以切断因果生成链接；(ii) 仅平坦化前K个逻辑值就足以在关键子空间中最大化不确定性。这些发现使得PALU能够减少整个词汇表和参数空间中的冗余优化，同时将对整体模型性能的影响降到最低。全面的评估表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，PALU在遗忘效率和效用保留方面表现更优。我们的代码可在https://github.com/nxZhai/PALU获取。
