papers.title: When Bigger Isn’t Better: A Comprehensive Fairness Evaluation of Political Bias in Multi-News Summarisation
papers.title_zh: 当规模越大并不意味着越好的时候：对多新闻摘要生成中政治偏见问题的全面公平性评估
papers.authors: Nannan Huang, Iffat Maab, Junichi Yamagishi
papers.abstract: Multi-document news summarisation systems are increasingly adopted for their convenience in processing vast daily news content, making fairness across diverse political perspectives critical. However, these systems can exhibit political bias through unequal representation of viewpoints, disproportionate emphasis on certain perspectives, and systematic underrepresentation of minority voices. This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of such bias in multi-document news summarisation using FairNews, a dataset of complete news articles with political orientation labels, examining how large language models (LLMs) handle sources with varying political leanings across 13 models and five fairness metrics. We investigate both baseline model performance and effectiveness of various debiasing interventions, including prompt-based and judge-based approaches. Our findings challenge the assumption that larger models yield fairer outputs, as mid-sized variants consistently outperform their larger counterparts, offering the best balance of fairness and efficiency. Prompt-based debiasing proves highly model dependent, while entity sentiment emerges as the most stubborn fairness dimension, resisting all intervention strategies tested. These results demonstrate that fairness in multi-document news summarisation requires multi-dimensional evaluation frameworks and targeted, architecture-aware debiasing rather than simply scaling up.
papers.abstract_zh: 多文档新闻摘要系统因其能够便捷地处理大量日常新闻内容而受到越来越多的青睐。然而，这些系统可能会因不同政治观点的不平等呈现、对某些观点的过度强调以及少数声音的系统性忽视而表现出政治偏见。本研究使用FairNews数据集对多文档新闻摘要中的这种偏见进行了全面评估。该数据集包含了带有政治倾向标签的完整新闻文章。我们研究了13种模型在五种公平性指标下的表现，以了解大语言模型如何处理具有不同政治倾向的源数据。我们发现，无论是基线模型的性能还是各种消除偏见方法的有效性，都值得关注。其中，基于提示的消除偏见方法具有高度模型依赖性，而实体情感因素则是最难以解决的公平性问题，无论采用何种干预策略都无法有效解决这一问题。这些结果表明，在多文档新闻摘要中实现公平性需要多维度的评估框架，以及针对特定问题的、注重架构优化的消除偏见方法，而不仅仅是简单地扩大模型规模。

papers.title: Language Acquisition Device in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中的语言习得机制
papers.authors: Masato Mita, Taiga Someya, Ryo Yoshida, Yohei Oseki
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain substantially less data-efficient than humans. Pre-pretraining (PPT) on synthetic languages has been proposed to close this gap, with prior work emphasizing highly expressive formal languages such as k-Shuffle Dyck. Inspired by the Language Acquisition Device (LAD) hypothesis, which posits that innate constraints preemptively restrict the learner’s hypothesis space to natural-language-like structure, we propose LAD-inspired PPT: pre-pretraining on MP-STRUCT, a formal language whose strings encode hierarchical composition, feature-based dependencies, and long-distance displacement via MERGE, AGREE, and MOVE. A brief 500-step PPT with MP-STRUCT matches strong formal-language baselines in token efficiency while additionally imparting a human-like resistance to structurally implausible languages. Analyzing simplified variants, we find that MP-STRUCT CORE outperforms k-Shuffle Dyck despite not being definable in C-RASP (a formal bound on transformer expressivity), challenging the prior hypothesis that effective PPT languages must be both hierarchically expressive and circuit-theoretically learnable. We show that functional landmarks, which reduce dependency resolution ambiguity, are a key driver, suggesting that effective PPT design depends not only on expressivity but also on the accessibility of dependency resolution.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在数据处理效率方面仍然远远落后于人类。为了弥补这一差距，有人提出了在合成语言上进行预预训练的方法。先前的研究强调了使用像k-Shuffle Dyck这样的高表达性形式语言进行预预训练的效果。受语言习得机制假设的启发，该假设认为先天限制会预先限制学习者的假设空间，使其只能处理类似自然语言的结构。因此，我们提出了基于LAD假设的预预训练方法：在MP-STRUCT上进行预预训练。MP-STRUCT是一种形式语言，其字符串能够编码层次结构、基于特征的依赖关系以及通过MERGE、AGREE和MOVE实现的长距离位移。仅使用MP-STRUCT进行的简短500步预预训练在令牌效率方面达到了与优秀形式语言基线相当的水平，同时还能使模型具备对结构不合理语言的抵抗能力。通过分析简化版本，我们发现尽管MP-STRUCT无法被C-RASP所定义（C-RASP是对Transformer表达能力的一种形式化限制），但它仍然优于k-Shuffle Dyck。这一发现挑战了之前的观点，即有效的预预训练语言必须既具有层次性表达能力，又能够以电路理论的方式进行学习。我们还发现，功能性的标志点可以减少依赖关系的解析歧义，这是有效预预训练设计的关键因素。这表明，有效的预预训练设计不仅取决于表达能力，还取决于依赖关系解析的易用性。

papers.title: CAML: A Conflict-Aware Molecular Language Model Merging Framework for Multi-Constraint Molecular Generation
papers.title_zh: CAML：一种基于冲突感知的分子语言模型融合框架，用于多约束分子生成
papers.authors: Xuanbai Ren, Luoda Tan, Pei Liu, Tengfei Ma, Xiangzheng Fu, Longyue Wang, Yiping Liu, Xiangxiang Zeng
papers.abstract: Transfer learning has demonstrated efficacy in single-property constraint molecular generation. However, real-world drug discovery demands molecules to satisfy multiple property constraints. Existing paradigms often struggle with this challenge due to catastrophic forgetting or gradient conflicts. To address this, we propose a conflict-aware molecular language model merging framework (CAML). CAML generates multiple constraints molecular as a cooperative game among property-specific fine-tune models (expert models). Specifically, we formulate a Stability-Aware Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (SACMA-ES) to dynamically optimize the fusion strategy. This algorithm searches for a Nash-equilibrium–like solution that minimizes conflicts among properties by exploring the optimal combination of the importance of the task parameter (intrinsic scale) and relative fusion weights of each expert (fusion coefficient), yielding a multi-constraint molecular property generation model without revisiting the training data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAML achieves state-of-the-art performance in complex multi-constraint scenarios. Our results validate that this training-free paradigm offers a robust and efficient solution for resolving intrinsic property conflicts in de novo molecular design.
papers.abstract_zh: 迁移学习在单一属性约束的分子生成中表现出有效性。然而，现实中的药物发现要求分子能够满足多种属性约束。现有的方法往往难以应对这一挑战，因为它们面临着灾难性遗忘或梯度冲突的问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种考虑冲突的分子语言模型融合框架（CAML）。CAML通过将多个具有特定属性的微调模型（专家模型）协同作用来生成分子结构。具体来说，我们提出了一种稳定性感知的协方差矩阵适应进化策略（SACMA-ES），以动态优化融合策略。该算法通过探索任务参数重要性与每个专家的相对融合权重的最佳组合，寻找一种类似纳什均衡的解决方案，从而最小化各属性之间的冲突，进而构建出一个无需重新训练数据即可生成多属性分子结构的模型。大量实验表明，CAML在复杂的多属性场景中取得了卓越的性能。我们的研究结果验证了这种无需训练的范式为解决新分子设计中固有的属性冲突问题提供了一种稳健且高效的解决方案。

papers.title: Stratagem: Learning Transferable Reasoning via Trajectory-Modulated Game Self-Play
papers.title_zh: 策略：通过基于轨迹调节的博弈自玩来学习可迁移的推理能力
papers.authors: Xiachong Feng, Deyi Yin, Xiaocheng Feng, Yi Jiang, Libo Qin, Yangfan Ye, Lei Huang, Weitao Ma, Qiming Li, Yuxuan Gu, Bing Qin, Lingpeng Kong
papers.abstract: Games offer a compelling paradigm for developing general reasoning capabilities in language models, as they naturally demand strategic planning, probabilistic inference, and adaptive decision-making. However, existing self-play approaches rely solely on terminal game outcomes, providing no mechanism to distinguish transferable reasoning patterns from game-specific heuristics. We present STRATAGEM, which addresses two fundamental barriers to reasoning transfer: domain specificity, where learned patterns remain anchored in game semantics, and contextual stasis, where static game contexts fail to cultivate progressive reasoning. STRATAGEM selectively reinforces trajectories exhibiting abstract, domain-agnostic reasoning through a Reasoning Transferability Coefficient, while incentivizing adaptive reasoning development via a Reasoning Evolution Reward. Experiments across mathematical reasoning, general reasoning, and code generation benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements, with particularly strong gains on competition-level mathematics where multi-step reasoning is critical. Ablation studies and human evaluation confirm that both components contribute to transferable reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 游戏为语言模型发展通用推理能力提供了理想的平台，因为游戏自然需要战略规划、概率推理以及适应性决策。然而，现有的自对弈方法仅依赖于游戏的终局结果，无法区分可迁移的推理模式与特定于游戏的启发式方法。我们提出了STRATAGEM算法，该算法解决了推理迁移的两个主要障碍：领域特异性问题，即学习到的模式仍然局限于游戏语义层面；以及情境稳定性问题，即静态的游戏环境无法促进渐进式的推理发展。STRATAGEM通过“推理可迁移性系数”来强化那些表现出抽象且不受领域限制的推理路径，同时通过“推理进化奖励”机制激励自适应推理的发展。在数学推理、通用推理和代码生成等基准测试中的实验表明，该算法取得了显著的改进，尤其是在需要多步骤推理的竞争级数学问题上，其效果尤为突出。消融研究和人类评估也证实了这两个组件都对实现可迁移推理起到了重要作用。

papers.title: NOSE: Neural Olfactory-Semantic Embedding with Tri-Modal Orthogonal Contrastive Learning
papers.title_zh: 鼻子：基于三模态正交对比学习的嗅觉-语义嵌入技术
papers.authors: Yanyi Su, Hongshuai Wang, Zhifeng Gao, Jun Cheng
papers.abstract: Olfaction lies at the intersection of chemical structure, neural encoding, and linguistic perception, yet existing representation methods fail to fully capture this pathway. Current approaches typically model only isolated segments of the olfactory pathway, overlooking the complete chain from molecule to receptors to linguistic descriptions. Such fragmentation yields learned embeddings that lack both biological grounding and semantic interpretability. We propose NOSE (Neural Olfactory-Semantic Embedding), a representation learning framework that aligns three modalities along the olfactory pathway: molecular structure, receptor sequence, and natural language description. Rather than simply fusing these signals, we decouple their contributions via orthogonal constraints, preserving the unique encoded information of each modality. To address the sparsity of olfactory language, we introduce a weak positive sample strategy to calibrate semantic similarity, preventing erroneous repulsion of similar odors in the feature space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NOSE achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance and excellent zero-shot generalization, confirming the strong alignment between its representation space and human olfactory intuition. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Xianyusyy/NOSE
papers.abstract_zh: 嗅觉感知涉及化学结构、神经编码和语言描述三个领域，但现有的表示方法未能完全捕捉这一复杂路径。目前的方法通常只对嗅觉感知的某些环节进行建模，而忽略了从分子到受体再到语言描述的完整过程。这种碎片化导致所得到的嵌入向量缺乏生物学基础以及语义上的可解释性。我们提出了NOSE（神经嗅觉-语义嵌入）这一表示学习框架，它能够将嗅觉感知中的三个维度——分子结构、受体序列和自然语言描述——结合起来。我们并非简单地将这些信号融合在一起，而是通过正交约束来分离它们的贡献，从而保留每个维度的独特信息。为了解决嗅觉语言数据稀疏的问题，我们引入了弱正样本策略来校准语义相似性，从而避免了对相似气味在特征空间中的错误排斥。大量实验表明，NOSE在性能上达到了最先进水平，并且具有出色的零样本泛化能力，这充分证明了其表示空间与人类嗅觉直觉之间的高度契合。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Xianyusyy/NOSE获取。

papers.title: ReFL: Reflective Feedback Learning for Hallucination Detection of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ReFL：用于大型语言模型幻视检测的反思性反馈学习方法
papers.authors: Cunhang Fan, Jun Zhang, Xue Zhang, Shuai Zhang, Zhao Lv, Jianhua Tao, Zhengqi Wen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate factually incorrect content, known as “hallucinations”, which undermine the reliability and safety of their outputs. Existing hallucination detection methods either depend on external knowledge sources, incurring high computational costs and limiting real-time applicability, or extract the model’s internal states, leading to poor generalization. To address these issues, this paper proposes ReFL, a hallucination detection framework. ReFL leverages corrective in-context learning to dynamically guide LLMs to recognize their own prediction errors and adjust internal representations, critically without updating model weights. Specifically, by introducing a corrective in-context learning strategy, where triplets of input text, model prediction, and ground-truth label are embedded into the prompt to make the model explicitly aware of its own errors. The model reflects on prior outputs to adjust its internal states and generate semantically structured representations better aligned with factuality. This feedback mechanism encourages the model to shape a more coherent semantic space and enhances the LLM’s internal sensitivity to hallucinations. Experimental results on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that ReFL consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常常生成事实错误的内容，这种现象被称为“幻觉”，这会削弱模型输出的可靠性和安全性。现有的幻觉检测方法要么依赖外部知识来源，导致计算成本较高且无法实时应用；要么试图提取模型的内部状态，但这会导致泛化能力较差。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了ReFL这一幻觉检测框架。ReFL利用修正性上下文学习技术，能够动态引导LLM识别自身的预测错误并调整其内部表示，而无需更新模型权重。具体来说，通过引入一种修正性上下文学习策略，将输入文本、模型预测和真实标签的三元组嵌入到提示中，使模型能够明确意识到自己的错误。模型会反思之前的输出结果，从而调整其内部状态，生成更符合事实的语义结构化的表示。这种反馈机制有助于模型构建更连贯的语义空间，并提高LLM对幻觉的感知能力。在两个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，ReFL的表现始终优于现有方法，达到了最先进的性能水平。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Fine-Mem: Fine-Grained Feedback Alignment for Long-Horizon Memory Management
papers.title_zh: 细粒度反馈调整：用于长期记忆管理的策略
papers.authors: Weitao Ma, Xiaocheng Feng, Lei Huang, Xiachong Feng, Zhanyu Ma, Jun Xu, Jiuchong Gao, Jinghua Hao, Renqing He, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Effective memory management is essential for large language model agents to navigate long-horizon tasks. Recent research has explored using Reinforcement Learning to develop specialized memory manager agents. However, existing approaches rely on final task performance as the primary reward, which results in severe reward sparsity and ineffective credit assignment, providing insufficient guidance for individual memory operations. To this end, we propose Fine-Mem, a unified framework designed for fine-grained feedback alignment. First, we introduce a Chunk-level Step Reward to provide immediate step-level supervision via auxiliary chunk-specific question answering tasks. Second, we devise Evidence-Anchored Reward Attribution to redistribute global rewards by anchoring credit to key memory operations, based on the specific memory items utilized as evidence in reasoning. Together, these components enable stable policy optimization and align local memory operations with the long-term utility of memory. Experiments on Memalpha and MemoryAgentBench demonstrate that Fine-Mem consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving superior success rates across various sub-tasks. Further analysis reveals its adaptability and strong generalization capabilities across diverse model configurations and backbones
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的内存管理对于大语言模型代理完成长期任务至关重要。最近的研究探索了利用强化学习来开发专门的内存管理代理。然而，现有的方法以最终任务性能作为主要奖励，这会导致严重的奖励稀疏性以及无效的信用分配，无法为单个内存操作提供足够的指导。为此，我们提出了Fine-Mem框架，该框架旨在实现细粒度的反馈对齐。首先，我们引入了块级步长奖励机制，通过辅助的块级问答任务来提供即时的步长级监督。其次，我们设计了基于证据的奖励分配机制，通过将信用重新分配给关键的内存操作，从而根据推理中使用的具体内存项来分配奖励。这些组件共同实现了稳定的策略优化，并使局部内存操作与内存的长期效用保持一致。在Memalpha和MemoryAgentBench上的实验表明，Fine-Mem始终优于强大的基线算法，并在各种子任务中取得了更高的成功率。进一步分析显示，该框架具有出色的适应性和强大的泛化能力，能够适用于不同的模型和后端系统。

papers.title: NaturalSloth: Revisiting Denial-of-Service Attacks on Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 自然懒惰：重新审视针对大型语言模型的拒绝服务攻击
papers.authors: Yiming Chen, Zexin Li, Xianghu Yue, Robby T. Tan, Haizhou Li
papers.abstract: LLM serving is limited by provider-side resources: longer generations consume more GPU time, increase latency, and reduce throughput in multi-tenant systems. This creates a denial-of-service (DoS) risk, where attackers degrade service by inducing excessive generation. Prior work on LLM DoS primarily relies on adversarial perturbations that delay end-of-sequence termination. We show perturbations are often unnecessary: natural, benign-looking instructions that specify impractical and meaningless tasks can already trigger excessive generation. To study this overlooked vulnerability, we introduce , an adversarial dataset of natural, instruction-based DoS prompts. Starting from a human-curated seed set spanning diverse attack categories, we design a multi-agent synthesis framework to scale the dataset while preserving malicious intent and increasing semantic diversity. Experiments across a wide range of proprietary and open-source LLMs show that NaturalSloth consistently induces excessive generation, with attack effectiveness further amplified when combined with jailbreak techniques. Our analysis also reveals significant limitations of existing defenses, highlighting the need for dedicated protections against natural DoS attacks.
papers.abstract_zh: LLM服务受到提供商侧资源的限制：更长的生成过程会消耗更多的GPU资源，从而增加延迟并降低多租户系统的吞吐量。这就带来了拒绝服务攻击的风险，攻击者可以通过诱导过度生成来破坏服务。以往关于LLM拒绝服务攻击的研究主要依赖于那些能够延迟序列结束的对抗性扰动。然而，我们发现这些扰动往往是不必要的：一些看似自然、无害的指令，如果指定了不切实际且无意义的任务，同样可能引发过度生成。为了研究这一被忽视的漏洞，我们引入了一个包含自然、基于指令的对抗性数据集。该数据集以人类精心挑选的种子集为基础，涵盖了多种攻击类别，我们通过多智能体合成框架来扩展数据集，同时保留恶意意图并增加语义多样性。在多种专有和开源LLM上的实验表明，NaturalSloth始终能够引发过度生成，而结合越狱技术时，其攻击效果会进一步增强。我们的分析还揭示了现有防御措施的显著局限性，从而凸显出需要针对自然DoS攻击采取专门的防护措施。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: HiGoE: Hierarchical Graph of Evidence to Enhance Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long-context Summarization
papers.title_zh: HiGoE：分层证据图，用于提升长上下文摘要任务中的信息检索增强生成效果
papers.authors: Long Yuan, Kaiwen Tian, Zi Chen, Bolong Zheng, Chuan Ma
papers.abstract: Long-context summarization is pivotal for extracting core insights from extensive documents. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show remarkable capabilities, they frequently encounter attention dilution and hallucination with lengthy inputs. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) partially mitigates this, but conventional RAG relies on shallow similarity retrieval of fragmented chunks, failing to capture high-level thematic structures and long-range dependencies. Although graph-based RAG approaches have emerged to address these structural limitations, existing solutions, such as Graph of Records (GoR), critically suffer from a fundamental flaw: they paradoxically re-introduce hallucinations by constructing graphs based on unreliable, LLM-generated responses. To overcome these challenges, we introduce Hierarchical Graph of Evidence (HiGoE) (Code link https://github.com/tkw123/HiGOE). HiGoE redefines the retrieval process by replacing unreliable chunk-based methods with a filtered proposition–evidence graph, ensuring verifiable fact grounding and substantially reducing hallucination. Moreover, HiGoE leverages Personalized PageRank (PPR) to cluster related nodes into thematic hierarchies, thereby restoring global document structure and effectively mitigating attention dilution. To model complex, multi-level relations beyond mere shallow similarity, we develop an Enhanced Graph Attention Network. Experiments show HiGoE consistently surpasses baselines in quality and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 长上下文摘要提取对于从大量文档中提取核心信息至关重要。虽然大语言模型展现出了惊人的能力，但在处理冗长的输入时，它们常常会出现注意力分散和幻觉现象。检索增强生成技术在一定程度上缓解了这些问题，但传统的检索增强生成方法依赖于对碎片化内容的浅层相似性检索，无法捕捉到高级的主题结构和长距离依赖关系。尽管基于图的检索增强生成方法已经出现，以解决这些结构性问题，但现有的解决方案如记录图仍然存在根本缺陷：它们通过基于不可靠的LLM生成的响应来构建图表，反而导致了幻觉现象的再次出现。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了分层证据图（HiGoE）（代码链接：https://github.com/tkw123/HiGOE）。HiGoE通过用过滤后的命题-证据图替代不可靠的基于块的方法，重新定义了检索过程，从而确保了事实的可验证性，并显著减少了幻觉现象。此外，HiGoE还利用个性化PageRank算法将相关节点聚类成主题层次结构，从而恢复了文档的整体结构，有效缓解了注意力分散的问题。为了模拟复杂的多层次关系，而不仅仅是浅层相似性，我们开发了一种增强型图注意力网络。实验表明，HiGoE在质量和效率方面始终优于传统方法。

papers.title: Region-Grounded Report Generation for 3D Medical Imaging: A Fine-Grained Dataset and Graph-Enhanced Framework
papers.title_zh: 针对3D医学影像的地域化报告生成方法：一个详细的数据集以及基于图的增强式框架
papers.authors: Cong Huy Nguyen, Son Dinh Nguyen, Guanlin Li, Tuan Dung Nguyen, Aditya Narayan Sankaran, Mai Huy Thong, Thanh Trung Nguyen, Mai Hong Son, Reza Farahbakhsh, Phi Le Nguyen, Noel Crespi
papers.abstract: Automated medical report generation for 3D PET/CT imaging is fundamentally challenged by the high-dimensional nature of volumetric data and a critical scarcity of annotated datasets, particularly for low-resource languages. Current black-box methods map whole volumes to reports, ignoring the clinical workflow of analyzing localized Regions of Interest (RoIs) to derive diagnostic conclusions. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing VietPET-RoI, the first large-scale 3D PET/CT dataset with fine-grained RoI annotation for a low-resource language, comprising 600 PET/CT samples and 1,960 manually annotated RoIs, paired with corresponding clinical reports. Furthermore, to demonstrate the utility of this dataset, we propose HiRRA, a novel framework that mimics the professional radiologist diagnostic workflow by employing graph-based relational modules to capture dependencies between RoI attributes. This approach shifts from global pattern matching toward localized clinical findings. Additionally, we introduce new clinical evaluation metrics, namely RoI Coverage and RoI Quality Index, that measure both RoI localization accuracy and attribute description fidelity using LLM-based extraction. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that our framework achieves SOTA performance, surpassing existing models by 19.7% in BLEU and 4.7% in ROUGE-L, while achieving a remarkable 45.8% improvement in clinical metrics, indicating enhanced clinical reliability and reduced hallucination. Our code and dataset are available on GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于3D PET/CT成像而言，自动化生成医学报告面临着巨大挑战。这些体积数据具有高度维度化的特点，而标注数据集的稀缺性则尤为明显，尤其是在资源匮乏的语言中。目前常用的黑盒方法是将整个体积数据映射成报告，却忽略了通过分析局部感兴趣区域来得出诊断结论这一临床工作流程。在本文中，我们提出了VietPET-RoI这一大规模3D PET/CT数据集，该数据集为资源匮乏的语言提供了细粒度的感兴趣区域标注，包含600个PET/CT样本和1,960个手动标注的感兴趣区域，并附有相应的临床报告。为了展示该数据集的实用性，我们提出了HiRRA这一新型框架，该框架通过采用基于图的关联模块来捕捉感兴趣区域属性之间的依赖关系，从而模仿专业放射科医生的诊断工作流程。这种方法从全局模式匹配转向了局部临床发现的分析。此外，我们还引入了新的临床评估指标，即感兴趣区域覆盖率和感兴趣区域质量指数，这些指标能够同时衡量感兴趣区域的定位准确性和基于大语言模型提取的属性描述精度。广泛的评估结果表明，我们的框架取得了卓越的性能，其BLEU得分比现有模型高出19.7%，ROUGE-L得分高出4.7%。而在临床指标方面，我们的框架表现出了显著的提升，提高了45.8%，这表明我们的框架在提高临床可靠性方面取得了显著成效，同时也减少了错误预测的情况。我们的代码和数据集已可在GitHub上获取。

papers.title: UI-Copilot: Advancing Long-Horizon GUI Automation via Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: UI-Copilot：通过工具集成化的策略优化来实现长期范围的GUI自动化测试
papers.authors: Zhengxi Lu, Fei Tang, Guangyi Liu, Jin Ma, Kaitao Song, Xu Tan, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
papers.abstract: MLLM-based GUI agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex user interface interaction tasks. However, long-horizon scenarios remain challenging, as these agents are burdened with tasks beyond their intrinsic capabilities, suffering from memory degradation, progress confusion, and math hallucination. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{UI-Copilot}, a collaborative framework where the GUI agent focuses on task execution while a lightweight copilot provides on-demand assistance for memory retrieval and numerical computation. We introduce memory decoupling to separate persistent observations from transient execution context, and train the policy agent to selectively invoke the copilot as Retriever or Calculator based on task demands. To enable effective tool invocation learning, we propose \underline{\textbf{T}}ool-\underline{\textbf{I}}ntegrated \underline{\textbf{P}}olicy \underline{\textbf{O}}ptimization (\textbf{TIPO}), which separately optimizes tool selection through single-turn prediction and task execution through on-policy multi-turn rollouts. Experimental results show that UI-Copilot-7B achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging MemGUI-Bench, outperforming strong 7B-scale GUI agents such as GUI-Owl-7B and UI-TARS-1.5-7B. Moreover, UI-Copilot-7B delivers a 17.1% absolute improvement on AndroidWorld over the base Qwen model, highlighting UI-Copilot’s strong generalization to real-world GUI tasks. Code website: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UI-Copilot-0535.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于MLLM的GUI智能体在复杂的用户界面交互任务中展现出了强大的能力。然而，长期视角的场景仍然具有挑战性，因为这些智能体面临着超出其固有能力的任务，从而遭受了记忆退化、进度混乱以及数学幻觉等问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了**UI-Copilot**这一协作框架。在该框架中，GUI智能体专注于任务执行，而轻量级的辅助工具则提供按需协助，用于记忆检索和数值计算。我们通过内存分离技术，将持久性的观察结果与瞬态的执行上下文分开，并训练策略智能体根据任务需求选择性地调用辅助工具作为记忆检索器或计算器。为了实现有效的工具调用学习，我们提出了**工具集成策略优化**方法，该方法通过单轮预测来优化工具选择，同时通过基于策略的多轮试验来优化任务执行。实验结果表明，UI-Copilot-7B在具有挑战性的MemGUI-Bench测试集上取得了领先的性能表现，其性能优于诸如GUI-Owl-7B和UI-TARS-1.5-7B这样的强大7B规模GUI智能体。此外，与基础版本的Qwen模型相比，UI-Copilot-7B在AndroidWorld任务上的绝对性能提升了17.1%，这充分证明了UI-Copilot在现实世界GUI任务中的强大泛化能力。代码网址：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UI-Copilot-0535

papers.title: STK-Adapter: Incorporating Evolving Graph and Event Chain for Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
papers.title_zh: STK适配器：结合动态图与事件链技术，以实现时间关系知识图谱的扩展功能
papers.authors: Shuyuan Zhao, Wei Chen, Weijie Zhang, Xinrui Hou, Junfeng Shen, Boyan Shi, Shengnan Guo, Youfang Lin, Huaiyu Wan
papers.abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) extrapolation aims to predict future events based on historical facts. Recent studies have attempted to enhance TKG extrapolation by integrating TKG’s evolving structural representations and textual event chains into Large Language Models (LLMs). Yet, two main challenges limit these approaches: (1) The loss of essential spatial-temporal information due to shallow alignment between TKG’s graph evolving structural representation and the LLM’s semantic space, and (2) the progressive dilution of the TKG’s evolving structural features during LLM fine-tuning. To address these challenges, we propose the Spatial-Temporal Knowledge Adapter (STK-Adapter), which flexibly integrates the evolving graph encoder and the LLM to facilitate TKG reasoning. In STK-Adapter, a Spatial-Temporal MoE is designed to capture spatial structures and temporal patterns inherent in TKGs. An Event-Aware MoE is employed to model intricate temporal semantics dependencies within event chains. In addition, a Cross-Modality Alignment MoE is proposed to facilitate deep cross-modality alignment by TKG-guided attention experts. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that STK-Adapter significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods and exhibits strong generalization capabilities in cross-dataset task. The code is available at https://github.com/Zhaoshuyuan0246/STK-Adapter.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间知识图谱（TKG）的外推技术旨在基于历史事实预测未来事件。近期的研究试图通过将时间知识图谱不断变化的结构表示和文本事件链整合到大语言模型（LLM）中，来提升时间知识图谱的外推能力。然而，有两个主要挑战限制了这些方法的应用：(1) 由于时间知识图谱的结构表示与LLM的语义空间之间的浅层对齐，导致重要时空信息丢失；(2) 在LLM微调过程中，时间知识图谱的不断变化的结构特征逐渐消失。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了空间-时间知识适配器（STK-Adapter），该适配器能够灵活集成不断变化的结构编码器和LLM，从而促进时间知识图谱的推理。在STK-Adapter中，设计了一个空间-时间记忆网络，用于捕捉时间知识图谱中的空间结构和时间模式。同时，还采用了一种事件感知记忆网络，以模拟事件链中的复杂时间语义依赖关系。此外，我们还提出了一种跨模态对齐记忆网络，通过时间知识图谱引导的注意力机制，实现深度跨模态对齐。在基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，STK-Adapter在性能上显著优于现有方法，并且在跨数据集任务中表现出强大的泛化能力。相关代码可访问https://github.com/Zhaoshuyuan0246/STK-Adapter。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Learning What Matters: Dynamic Dimension Selection and Aggregation for Interpretable Vision-Language Reward Modeling
papers.title_zh: 学习什么是重要的：用于可解释视觉-语言奖励建模的动态维度选择与聚合方法
papers.authors: Qiyuan Chen, Hongsen Huang, Jiahe Chen, Qian Shao, Jintai Chen, Hongxia Xu, Renjie Hua, Ren Chuan, Jian Wu
papers.abstract: Vision-language reward modeling faces a dilemma: generative approaches are interpretable but slow, while discriminative ones are efficient but act as opaque “black boxes.” To bridge this gap, we propose VL-MDR (Vision-Language Multi-Dimensional Reward), a framework that dynamically decomposes evaluation into granular, interpretable dimensions. Instead of outputting a monolithic scalar, VL-MDR employs a visual-aware gating mechanism to identify relevant dimensions and adaptively weight them (e.g., Hallucination, Reasoning) for each specific input. To support this, we curate a dataset of 321k vision-language preference pairs annotated across 21 fine-grained dimensions. Extensive experiments show that VL-MDR consistently outperforms existing open-source reward models on benchmarks like VL-RewardBench. Furthermore, we show that VL-MDR-constructed preference pairs effectively enable DPO alignment to mitigate visual hallucinations and improve reliability, providing a scalable solution for VLM alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言奖励建模面临着一个困境：生成式方法虽然可解释但速度较慢，而判别式方法则效率较高，但结果却像不透明的“黑箱”一样难以理解。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了VL-MDR（视觉-语言多维奖励）框架。该框架能够将评估过程动态分解为多个可解释的维度。与传统的单一标量输出不同，VL-MDR采用了一种基于视觉感知的筛选机制，以确定哪些维度是相关的，并针对每个具体的输入对这些维度进行自适应加权处理（例如，幻觉、推理等）。为了支持这一机制，我们整理了一个包含32.1万对视觉-语言偏好对的数据集，这些数据涵盖了21个细粒度维度。大量实验表明，VL-MDR在如VL-RewardBench这样的基准测试中的表现始终优于现有的开源奖励模型。此外，我们还发现，由VL-MDR构建的偏好对能够有效实现DPO对齐，从而减轻视觉幻觉问题并提高可靠性，为视觉语言模型的对齐提供了可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: DeepGuard: Secure Code Generation via Multi-Layer Semantic Aggregation
papers.title_zh: DeepGuard：通过多层语义聚合实现安全代码生成
papers.authors: Li Huang, Zhongxin Liu, Yifan Wu, Tao Yin, Dong li, Jichao Bi, Nankun Mu, Hongyu Zhang, Meng Yan
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation can replicate insecure patterns from their training data. To mitigate this, a common strategy for security hardening is to fine-tune models using supervision derived from the final transformer layer. However, this design may suffer from a final-layer bottleneck: vulnerability-discriminative cues can be distributed across layers and become less detectable near the output representations optimized for next-token prediction. To diagnose this issue, we perform layer-wise linear probing. We observe that vulnerability-related signals are most detectable in a band of intermediate-to-upper layers yet attenuate toward the final layers. Motivated by this observation, we introduce DeepGuard, a framework that leverages distributed security-relevant cues by aggregating representations from multiple upper layers via an attention-based module. The aggregated signal powers a dedicated security analyzer within a multi-objective training objective that balances security enhancement and functional correctness, and further supports a lightweight inference-time steering strategy. Extensive experiments across five code LLMs demonstrate that DeepGuard improves the secure-and-correct generation rate by an average of 11.9% over strong baselines such as SVEN. It also preserves functional correctness while exhibiting generalization to held-out vulnerability types.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于代码生成的大语言模型（LLM）可能会复制其训练数据中的不安全模式。为了缓解这一问题，一种常见的安全加固策略是使用来自最终变换层的监督数据进行模型微调。然而，这种设计可能存在最终层瓶颈问题：与漏洞相关的线索可能分布在多个层次上，在针对下一个词元预测而优化的输出表示附近变得难以检测。为了诊断这个问题，我们进行了逐层线性探测。我们发现，与漏洞相关的信号在中层到上层之间最为明显，但在最终层逐渐减弱。基于这一发现，我们提出了DeepGuard框架，该框架通过基于注意力机制的模块来聚合来自多个上层层的表示，从而利用分布式的安全相关线索。这种聚合信号为多目标训练目标中的专用安全分析器提供了动力，该目标同时考虑了安全性的提升和功能的正确性，并进一步支持轻量级的推理时间引导策略。在五个代码LLM上进行的大量实验表明，与SVEN等强大的基线相比，DeepGuard平均提高了11.9%的安全且正确的生成率。同时，它还能保持功能的正确性，并且对保留的漏洞类型具有泛化能力。

papers.title: Distillation Traps and Guards: A Calibration Knob for LLM Distillability
papers.title_zh: 蒸馏装置中的捕集器与防护装置：为大型语言模型提升可蒸馏性而设计的校准旋钮
papers.authors: Weixiao Zhan, Yongcheng Jing, Leszek Rutkowski, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers capabilities from large language models (LLMs) to smaller students, yet it can fail unpredictably and also underpins model leakage risks. Our analysis revealed several distillation traps: tail noise, off-policy instability, and, most fundamentally, the teacher–student gap, that distort training signals. These traps manifest as overconfident hallucinations, self-correction collapse, and local decoding degradation, causing distillation to fail. Motivated by these findings, we propose a post-hoc calibration method that, to the best of our knowledge, for the first time enables control over a teacher’s distillability via reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT). Our objective combines task utility, KL anchor, and across-tokenizer calibration reward. This makes distillability a practical safety lever for foundation models, connecting robust teacher–student transfer with deployment-aware model protection. Experiments across math, knowledge QA, and instruction-following tasks show that students distilled from distillable calibrated teachers outperform SFT and KD baselines, while undistillable calibrated teachers retain their task performance but cause distilled students to collapse, offering a practical knob for both better KD and model IP protection.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏技术能够将大语言模型的能力转移给较小的模型，但这种技术可能会不可预测地失败，同时还会带来模型泄露的风险。我们的分析发现了几个导致蒸馏失败的陷阱：尾部噪声、离策略不稳定性，以及最根本的“教师-学生差距”，这些都会扭曲训练信号。这些陷阱表现为过度自信的幻觉、自我修正崩溃以及局部解码能力的下降，从而导致蒸馏失败。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种事后校准方法。据我们所知，这是首次能够通过强化微调来控制模型的蒸馏能力。我们的方法结合了任务效用、KL锚点和跨标记器校准奖励机制。这使得模型的蒸馏能力成为一种实用的安全手段，能够将稳健的教师-学生迁移与部署意识强的模型保护相结合。在数学、知识问答和指令遵循等任务中的实验表明，从可蒸馏的校准教师模型中得到的模型性能优于SFT和KD基线模型。而那些无法被蒸馏的校准教师模型则虽然保持了一定的任务性能，但却会导致被蒸馏的模型出现崩溃现象。因此，这种方法为改进知识蒸馏技术和保护模型知识产权提供了实用的解决方案。

papers.title: DVMap: Fine-Grained Pluralistic Value Alignment via High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping
papers.title_zh: DVMap：通过高共识的人口统计与价值观映射实现细粒度的多元价值对齐
papers.authors: Pengyun Zhu, Yuqi Ren, Zhen Wang, Lei Yang, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) typically rely on coarse-grained national labels for pluralistic value alignment. However, such macro-level supervision often obscures intra-country value heterogeneity, yielding a loose alignment.We argue that resolving this limitation requires shifting from national labels to multi-dimensional demographic constraints, which can identify groups with predictable, high-consensus value preference. To this end, we propose DVMap (High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping), a framework for fine-grained pluralistic value alignment. In this framework, we first present a demographic archetype extraction strategy to construct a high-quality value alignment corpus of 56,152 samples from the World Values Survey (WVS) by strictly retaining respondents with consistent value preferences under identical demographics. Over this corpus, we introduce a Structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism that explicitly guides LLMs to reason about demographic-value correlations. Subsequently, we employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to achieve adaptive anchoring of value distributions. To rigorously evaluate generalization, we further establish a triple-generalization benchmark (spanning cross-demographic, cross-country, and cross-value) comprising 21,553 samples. Experimental results demonstrate that DVMap effectively learns the manifold mapping from demographics to values, exhibiting strong generalization and robustness. On cross-demographic tests, Qwen3-8B-DVMap achieves 48.6% accuracy, surpassing the advanced open-source LLM DeepSeek-v3.2 (45.1%). The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/EnlightenedAI/DVMap.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的大语言模型通常依赖粗略的国家级标签来实现多元价值对齐。然而，这种宏观层面的监督往往掩盖了国家内部的价值差异，导致对齐效果不够精确。我们认为，要克服这一限制，需要从国家标签转向多维人口统计约束，这样可以识别出具有可预测、高共识价值偏好的群体。为此，我们提出了DVMap框架，这是一种用于精细调整多元价值对齐的框架。在该框架中，我们首先提出了一种人口统计原型提取策略，通过严格保留在相同人口统计条件下具有一致价值偏好的受访者，从而构建了一个包含56,152个样本的高质量价值对齐语料库。在此基础上，我们引入了一种结构化思维链机制，该机制能够引导语言模型对人口统计与价值之间的相关性进行推理。随后，我们通过群体相对政策优化技术来实现价值分布的自适应调整。为了严格评估模型的泛化能力，我们还建立了一个包含21,553个样本的三重泛化基准测试，涵盖了不同人口统计特征、不同国家以及不同价值领域的情况。实验结果表明，DVMap能够有效地实现从人口统计到价值的映射，表现出强大的泛化能力和鲁棒性。在跨人口统计特征的测试中，Qwen3-8B-DVMap的准确率达到了48.6%，超过了先进的开源语言模型DeepSeek-v3.2的45.1%。该框架的源代码和数据集可在https://github.com/EnlightenedAI/DVMap下载。

papers.title: HTMR: Hybrid Token Masking Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Event Argument Extraction with Multi-Perspective Reasoning
papers.title_zh: HTMR：一种混合令牌掩码强化学习算法，能够提供可验证的奖励，从而实现多视角推理下的事件参数提取任务
papers.authors: Jianwen Luo, Yongkang Jin, Yu Hong, Jianmin Yao
papers.abstract: Event Argument Extraction (EAE) aims to identify event arguments and assign semantic roles under a predefined schema. Recent work formulates EAE with large language models as a structured conditional generation task and applies Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to optimize sequence-level event structures. However, RLVR-based EAE supervision is coarse-grained, as a single reward is assigned to the whole event structure, while optimization happens at the token level. This misalignment causes the same reward to be applied to all tokens, including those not related to event roles or arguments, introducing noise into the gradient updates and weakening the signals for decisions critical to argument extraction. To mitigate this misalignment, we propose Hybrid Token Masking RLVR (HTMR), which selectively updates policy gradients on both high-entropy forking tokens and event-critical tokens that define event structure, along with multi-perspective reasoning. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and models show that HTMR consistently outperforms full-token and high-entropy only RLVR methods. Moreover, HTMR transfers effectively as a plug-and-play approach to other tasks such as named entity recognition and relation classification. The code is publicly available for reproducibility.
papers.abstract_zh: 事件参数提取（EAE）的目标是识别事件参数，并根据预定义的模式分配语义角色。最近的研究将EAE与大语言模型相结合，将其视为一种结构化条件生成任务，并采用带有可验证奖励的强化学习方法（RLVR）来优化序列级别的事件结构。然而，基于RLVR的EAE监督方式较为粗糙，因为整个事件结构只被赋予一个奖励，而优化则发生在词元级别。这种不一致性会导致相同的奖励被应用于所有词元，包括那些与事件角色或参数无关的词元，从而在梯度更新中引入噪声，削弱了对事件参数提取至关重要的决策信号。为了缓解这种不一致性，我们提出了混合词元掩码RLVR（HTMR）方法。该方法能够选择性地更新高熵分支词元和定义事件结构的关键词元的策略梯度，同时结合多视角推理。在多个基准测试和模型上的实验表明，HTMR始终优于仅基于完整词元和高熵信息的RLVR方法。此外，HTMR作为一种即插即用的方法，还可以有效地应用于其他任务，如命名实体识别和关系分类。该代码的实现方式可供公众复现使用。

papers.title: IS-CoT: Breaking the Long-form Generation Collapse via Interleaved Structural Thinking
papers.title_zh: IS-CoT：通过交错式结构思维突破长形式生成崩溃问题
papers.authors: Zechen Sun, Yuyang Sun, Zecheng Tang, Juntao Li, Wenpeng Hu, Wenliang Chen, Zhunchen Luo, Guotong Geng, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Generating coherent and controllable long-form content remains a persistent challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs). While reasoning-enhanced models have demonstrated success in logic-intensive domains, our evaluation reveals that they suffer from a severe length collapse in open-ended writing, where performance degrades sharply as target lengths exceed 2,000 words. We attribute this failure to the limitation of static hierarchical planning, which struggles to provide dynamic guidance over extended contexts. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Interleaved Structural Chain-of-Thought (IS-CoT) framework. Unlike external agentic workflows, IS-CoT embeds a dynamic Plan-Write-Reflect cycle into the generation process, enabling continuous strategy adaptation and global alignment without additional assistance. Based on this framework, we construct a high-quality dataset of interleaved reasoning traces via a multi-teacher pipeline and train IS-Writer-8B. Experiments demonstrate that IS-Writer-8B achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging long-form benchmarks (e.g., +3.08 vs. DeepSeek-V3.2 on LongBench-Write), exhibiting robust length compliance and coherence competitive with significantly larger proprietary models.
papers.abstract_zh: 为大语言模型生成连贯且可控的长文本内容仍然是一个持续的挑战。虽然基于推理增强的模型在逻辑密集型任务中取得了成功，但我们的评估结果显示，它们在开放性问题写作方面存在严重的长度限制问题——当目标文本长度超过2000字时，性能会急剧下降。我们认为这种失败是由于静态层次规划方法的局限性导致的，该方法难以为复杂的上下文提供动态指导。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了交错式结构思维链（IS-CoT）框架。与外部代理工作流程不同，IS-CoT将动态的计划-写作-反思循环嵌入到生成过程中，使得系统能够在无需额外帮助的情况下持续调整策略并实现全局一致性。基于该框架，我们通过多教师训练方法构建了一个高质量的交错式推理轨迹数据集，并训练了IS-Writer-8B模型。实验表明，IS-Writer-8B在复杂的长文本基准测试上取得了领先的性能表现（例如，在LongBench-Write任务上的得分比DeepSeek-V3.2高出3.08分），其长度合规性以及连贯性都优于许多更大型的专有模型。

papers.title: Seeing the Whole Elephant: A Benchmark for Failure Attribution in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 洞察整头大象：基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中故障归因的参考标准
papers.authors: Mengzhuo Chen, Junjie Wang, Fangwen Mu, Yawen Wang, Zhe Liu, Huanxiang Feng, Qing Wang
papers.abstract: Failure attribution, i.e., identifying the responsible agent and decisive step of a failure, is particularly challenging in LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) due to their natural-language reasoning, nondeterministic outputs, and intricate interaction dynamics. A reliable benchmark is therefore essential to guide and evaluate attribution techniques. Yet existing benchmarks rely on partially observable traces that capture only agent outputs, omitting the inputs and context that developers actually use when debugging. We argue that attribution should be studied under full execution observability, aligning with real-world developer-facing scenarios where complete traces, rather than only outputs, are accessible for diagnosis. To this end, we introduce TraceElephant, a benchmark designed for failure attribution with full execution traces and reproducible environments. We then systematically evaluate failure attribution techniques across various configurations. Specifically, full traces improve attribution accuracy by up to 76.5% over a partial-observation counterpart, confirming that missing inputs obscure many failure causes. TraceElephant provides a foundation for follow-up failure attribution research, promoting evaluation practices that reflect real-world debugging and supporting the development of more transparent MASs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中，确定故障的成因及决定性因素是一项极具挑战性的任务。由于系统具有自然语言推理能力、非确定性输出以及复杂的互动机制，因此很难准确识别故障的起因。因此，建立一个可靠的基准测试对于指导和评估故障归因技术至关重要。然而，现有的基准测试往往依赖于部分可观测的日志数据，这些数据仅记录了智能体的输出结果，而忽略了开发者在调试过程中实际使用的输入和上下文信息。我们认为，应该在完全可观测的执行过程下进行故障归因分析，这与现实世界中开发者的操作场景相符——在这种情况下，人们可以获取完整的执行日志数据来进行故障诊断，而不仅仅是输出结果。为此，我们提出了TraceElephant这一基准测试工具，它旨在利用完整的执行日志数据和可复现的环境来进行故障归因分析。随后，我们对不同配置下的故障归因技术进行了系统的评估。具体来说，与部分可观测的日志数据相比，完整的执行日志数据能够将归因准确性提高多达76.5%，这证实了缺失的输入信息会掩盖许多故障原因。TraceElephant为后续的故障归因研究提供了基础，有助于推动那些能够反映现实世界调试实践的评估方法的发展，从而推动更透明、更高效的智能体系统的构建。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MTAVG-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multi-Talker Dialogue-Centric Audio-Video Generation
papers.title_zh: MTAVG-Bench：一种针对多说话者对话场景下的音视频生成技术的诊断性基准测试
papers.authors: Yanghao Zhou, Haitian Li, Rexar Lin, Heyan Huang, Jinxing Zhou, Changsen Yuan, Tian Lan, Ziqin Zhou, Yudong Li, Jiajun Xu, Jingyun Liao, YiMing Cheng, Xuefeng Chen, Xian-Ling Mao, Yousheng Feng
papers.abstract: Recent advances in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation have enabled models to synthesize audio-visual videos with multi-participant dialogues. However, existing evaluation benchmarks remain largely designed for human-recorded videos or single-speaker settings. As a result, structural failures in generated multi-talker dialogue videos, such as identity drift, unnatural turn transitions, and audio-visual misalignment, cannot be effectively diagnosed. To address this issue, we introduce MTAVG-Bench, a failure-driven diagnostic benchmark for multi-talker dialogue-centric audio-video generation. MTAVG-Bench is built via a semi-automatic pipeline, where 1.8k videos are generated using mainstream T2AV models with carefully designed prompts, yielding 2.4k manually annotated QA pairs for fine-grained failure diagnosis. The benchmark evaluates multi-speaker dialogue generation at four levels: audio-visual signal fidelity, temporal attribute consistency, social interaction, and cinematic expression. Built on a hierarchical failure taxonomy and a targeted QA protocol, MTAVG-Bench is primarily designed to evaluate whether proprietary and open-source omni-models can reliably identify failure modes in multi-speaker T2AV outputs. We benchmark 12 proprietary and open-source omni-models on MTAVG-Bench, with Gemini 3 Pro achieving the strongest overall performance, while leading open-source models remain competitive in signal fidelity and consistency. Overall, MTAVG-Bench enables fine-grained failure analysis for rigorous model comparison and targeted video generation refinement.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，文本转音频视频（T2AV）生成技术取得了显著进展，使得模型能够合成包含多参与者对话的音频视觉视频。然而，现有的评估基准大多是针对人类录制视频或单声道音频场景设计的。因此，生成的包含多参与者对话的视频在结构上的缺陷，如身份漂移、不自然的对话转换以及音频与视觉的不协调等问题，难以得到有效的诊断。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了MTAVG-Bench这一针对多参与者对话音频视觉生成的故障驱动诊断基准。该基准通过半自动流程构建，使用主流T2AV模型并根据精心设计提示生成了1800个视频样本，同时生成了2400对手动标注的QA对，以便进行细致化的故障诊断。该基准从四个层面评估多声道对话生成的效果：音频视觉信号的准确性、时间属性的一致性、社交互动性以及电影化表达效果。基于分层化的故障分类体系以及有针对性的QA协议，MTAVG-Bench主要用于评估专有和开源的全模型是否能够可靠地识别多声道T2AV输出中的故障模式。我们在MTAVG-Bench上对12种专有和开源全模型进行了测试，其中Gemini 3 Pro表现最为出色，而领先的开源模型在信号准确性和一致性方面也表现出色。总体而言，MTAVG-Bench能够实现细致的故障分析，为严格的模型比较以及针对性的视频生成优化提供了有力支持。

papers.title: Why LLMs Hallucinate on Structured Knowledge: A Mechanistic Analysis of Reasoning over Linearized Representations
papers.title_zh: 为什么大语言模型会对结构化知识产生幻觉：对线性化表示上的推理机制分析
papers.authors: Shanghao Li, Jinda Han, Yibo Wang, Yuanjie Zhu, Zihe Song, Langzhou He, Kenan Kamel A Alghythee, Philip S. Yu
papers.abstract: In many reasoning tasks, large language models (LLMs) rely on structured external knowledge, such as graphs and tables, which is typically linearized into sequential token representations. However, even when sufficient knowledge is available, LLMs can still produce hallucinated outputs, and the underlying mechanisms behind such failures remain poorly understood. We investigate these mechanisms and find that hallucinations arise from systematic internal dynamics rather than random noise. First, attention disproportionately concentrates toward shortcut-like structural cues rather than distributing across the full context. Second, feed-forward representations fail to ground the provided knowledge, causing the model to revert to parametric memory. Moreover, our results indicate that hallucination is consistently associated with failures in semantic grounding within feed-forward layers, while attention allocation exhibits greater task-dependent variability. Finally, we show that these mechanistic patterns generalize beyond single-hop graphs to multi-hop and tabular settings, enabling effective hallucination detection across structured knowledge formats.
papers.abstract_zh: 在许多推理任务中，大语言模型依赖于结构化的外部知识，比如图表和表格。这些知识通常被线性化为序列化标记表示。然而，即使有充足的可用知识，大语言模型仍然可能产生幻觉输出，而这类错误背后的机制至今仍不甚明了。我们对这些机制进行了研究，发现幻觉的产生源于系统性的内部动态，而非随机噪声。首先，注意力机制过于集中在类似捷径的结构线索上，而不是在整个上下文中进行分布。其次，前馈表示无法有效整合所提供的知识，导致模型重新依赖参数化记忆。此外，我们的研究结果表明，幻觉通常与前馈层中的语义定位失败有关，而注意力分配则表现出更大的任务依赖性差异。最后，我们发现这些机制模式不仅适用于单跳图结构，也适用于多跳和表格形式的数据集，从而能够在各种结构化知识格式中有效检测幻觉现象。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SubTokenTest: A Practical Benchmark for Real-World Sub-token Understanding
papers.title_zh: SubTokenTest：一个用于评估实际场景中子代币理解的实用基准测试
papers.authors: Shuyang Hou, Yi Hu, Muhan Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have significantly enhanced their reasoning capabilities. However, they continue to struggle with basic character-level tasks, such as counting letters in words—a problem rooted in their tokenization process. While existing benchmarks have highlighted this weakness through basic character operations, such failures are often dismissed due to lacking practical relevance. Yet, many real-world applications, such as navigating text-based maps or interpreting structured tables, rely heavily on precise sub-token understanding. In this regard, we introduce SubTokenTest, a comprehensive benchmark that assesses sub-token understanding through practical, utility-driven tasks. Our benchmark includes ten tasks across four domains and isolates tokenization-related failures by decoupling performance from complex reasoning. We provide a comprehensive evaluation of nine advanced LLMs. Additionally, we investigate the impact of test-time scaling on sub-token reasoning and explore how character-level information is encoded within the hidden states.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期大语言模型（LLM）的进展显著提升了它们的推理能力。然而，它们在处理基本的字符级任务时仍然面临困难，例如计算单词中的字母数量——这个问题源于它们的分词过程。虽然现有的基准测试已经指出了这一弱点，但由于缺乏实际意义，这些缺陷往往被忽视。然而，许多现实世界的应用，比如导航基于文本的地图或解析结构化表格，都依赖于对子词粒的精确理解。在这方面，我们推出了SubTokenTest这一全面的基准测试，它通过实际、实用的任务来评估子词粒的理解能力。我们的基准测试包括四个领域的十个任务，并通过将性能与复杂推理分离来排除与分词相关的错误。我们对九种先进的LLM进行了全面评估。此外，我们还研究了测试时间扩展对子词粒推理的影响，并探讨了字符级信息是如何被编码在隐藏状态中的。

papers.title: Benchmarking and Enabling Efficient Chinese Medical Retrieval via Asymmetric Encoders
papers.title_zh: 通过非对称编码器实现高效的中文医学信息检索与基准测试
papers.authors: Angqing Jiang, Jianlyu Chen, Zhefang, Yongcan Wang, Xinpeng Li, Keyu Ding, Defu Lian
papers.abstract: Effective medical text retrieval requires both high accuracy and low latency. While LLM-based embedding models possess powerful retrieval capabilities, their prohibitive latency and high computational cost limit their application in real-time scenarios. Furthermore, the lack of comprehensive and high-fidelity benchmarks hinders progress in Chinese medical text retrieval. In this work, we introduce the Chinese Medical Text Embedding Benchmark (CMedTEB), a benchmark spanning three kinds of practical embedding tasks: retrieval, reranking, and semantic textual similarity (STS). Distinct from purely automated datasets, CMedTEB is curated via a rigorous multi-LLM voting pipeline validated by clinical experts, ensuring gold-standard label quality while effectively mitigating annotation noise. On this foundation, we propose the Chinese Medical Asymmetric REtriever (CARE), an asymmetric architecture that pairs a lightweight BERT-style encoder for online query encoding with a powerful LLM-based encoder for offline document encoding. However, optimizing such an asymmetric retriever with two structurally different encoders presents distinctive challenges. To address this, we introduce a novel two-stage training strategy that progressively bridges the query and document representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CARE surpasses state-of-the-art symmetric models on CMedTEB, achieving superior retrieval performance without increasing inference latency.
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的医学文本检索需要兼具高准确性和低延迟。虽然基于大语言模型的嵌入模型具有强大的检索能力，但其极高的延迟和高昂的计算成本限制了其在实时场景中的应用。此外，缺乏全面且高精度的基准测试也阻碍了中文医学文本检索技术的发展。在这项研究中，我们提出了中文医学文本嵌入基准测试（CMedTEB），该测试涵盖了三种实际的嵌入任务：检索、重新排序和语义文本相似性计算。与纯自动化数据集不同，CMedTEB是通过严格的多语言模型投票流程来筛选的，并由临床专家进行验证，从而确保了高质量的标准化标签，同时有效减少了注释中的噪声问题。在此基础上，我们提出了中文医学非对称检索器（CARE）这一非对称架构，它将轻量级的BERT风格编码器用于在线查询编码，同时使用强大的基于大语言模型的编码器进行离线文档编码。然而，使用两种结构不同的编码器来优化这种非对称检索器面临着独特的挑战。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段训练策略，逐步弥合查询和文档表示之间的差距。大量实验表明，CARE在CMedTEB上的表现优于最先进的对称模型，能够在不增加推理延迟的情况下实现更出色的检索性能。

papers.title: Merlin’s Whisper: Enabling Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models via Black-box Persuasive Prompting
papers.title_zh: 梅林的低语：通过黑箱式说服性提示实现大型语言模型的高效推理
papers.authors: Heming Xia, Cunxiao Du, Rui Li, Chak Tou Leong, Yongqi Li, Wenjie Li
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in tackling complex tasks through step-by-step thinking. However, this lengthy reasoning process incurs substantial computational and latency overheads, hindering the practical deployment of LRMs. This work presents a new approach to mitigating overthinking in LRMs via black-box persuasive prompting. By treating LRMs as black-box communicators, we investigate how to persuade them to generate concise responses without compromising accuracy. We introduce Whisper, an iterative refinement framework that generates high-quality persuasive prompts from diverse perspectives. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Whisper consistently reduces token usage while preserving performance. Notably, Whisper achieves a 3\times reduction in average response length on simple GSM8K questions for the Qwen3 series and delivers an average \sim40% token reduction overall. For closed-source APIs, Whisper reduces token usage on MATH-500 by 46% for Claude-3.7 and 50% for Gemini-2.5. Further analysis reveals the broad applicability of Whisper across data domains, model scales, and families, underscoring the potential of black-box persuasive prompting as a practical strategy for enhancing LRM efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在解决复杂任务时展现出卓越的能力，它们能够通过逐步推理来完成任务。然而，这种漫长的推理过程会带来巨大的计算成本和延迟问题，从而阻碍大型推理模型的实际应用。本研究提出了一种新的方法，通过黑盒式说服性提示来减少大型推理模型的过度推理现象。我们将大型推理模型视为黑盒式的通信工具，研究如何在不影响准确性的前提下，促使它们生成简洁的回答。我们引入了Whisper这一迭代优化框架，该框架能够从多个角度生成高质量的说服性提示。实验结果表明，Whisper能够持续减少令牌使用量，同时保持良好的性能。值得注意的是，对于Qwen3系列模型，Whisper在简单GSM8K问题上将平均回答长度减少了3倍；而在MATH-500任务中，Whisper则使令牌使用量减少了约40%。对于开源API，Whisper在Claude-3.7模型中将令牌使用量减少了46%，在Gemini-2.5模型中则减少了50%。进一步分析表明，Whisper具有广泛的应用前景，适用于不同的数据领域、模型规模以及模型类型，这充分证明了黑盒式说服性提示作为一种提高大型推理模型效率的实用策略的潜力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CAKE: Causal-Guided Adaptive Knowledge Editing for LLMs
papers.title_zh: 名称：因果引导的自适应知识编辑技术，适用于大型语言模型
papers.authors: Shuxin Liu, Jianhao Zhang
papers.abstract: LLMs have static pre-trained knowledge, leading to obsolescence and hallucinations. Knowledge Editing (KE) addresses these issues and typically requires multi-layer modifications. However, existing state-of-the-art methods, largely following the Locate–Select–Assign–Edit (LSAE) paradigm, rely on fixed-layer selection and uniform residual assignment, ignoring the heterogeneous causal efficacy of different layers. To bridge this, we propose \textbf{CAKE} (\textbf{C}ausal-Guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{K}nowledge \textbf{E}diting), a collaborative editing method within the more general Locate–Weight–Assign–Edit (LWAE) paradigm that: (1) selectively identifies critical layers via causal tracing scores; and (2) adaptively allocates editing burdens based on causal weights rather than uniform assumptions. We formulate residual assignment as a constrained quadratic optimization problem and derive a solution for optimal residual allocation, showing that aligning edits with causal efficacy mitigates recursive error accumulation. Furthermore, we establish a generalized weight shift error bound, under which existing paradigms emerge as special, restricted cases. Experimental results demonstrate that CAKE achieves SOTA performance with comparable overhead, validating the superiority of causal-guided adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型拥有静态的预训练知识，这会导致知识过时和产生幻觉。知识编辑技术能够解决这些问题，通常需要进行多层次的修改。然而，现有的先进方法大多遵循定位-选择-分配-编辑（LSAE）范式，它们依赖于固定层次的选择和统一的残差分配，而忽略了不同层次之间的异质性因果效应。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了**CAKE**算法——一种基于更通用的定位-权重-分配-编辑（LWAE）范式的协作编辑方法。该算法能够：(1)通过因果追踪得分选择性地识别关键层次；(2)基于因果权重而非统一假设来自适应分配编辑任务。我们将残差分配问题转化为一个约束二次优化问题，并找到了最优残差分配的解，表明根据因果效应来调整编辑方式可以减轻递归误差的累积。此外，我们还建立了一个广义的权重偏移误差界限，在此界限下，现有范式只是特殊、受限的情况而已。实验结果表明，CAKE算法在保持较低开销的同时取得了最佳性能，这验证了因果引导式适应的优越性。

papers.title: Preconditioned Test-Time Adaptation for Out-of-Distribution Debiasing in Narrative Generation
papers.title_zh: 针对非分布类型数据的预处理测试时间适应方法，用于提升叙事生成任务中的去偏效果
papers.authors: Hanwen Shen, Ting Ying, Jiajie Lu, Shanshan Wang
papers.abstract: Although debiased large language models (LLMs) excel at handling known or low-bias prompts, they often fail on unfamiliar and high-bias prompts. We demonstrate via out-of-distribution (OOD) detection that these high-bias prompts cause a distribution shift, degrading static model performance. To enable real-time correction, we propose CAP-TTA, a test-time adaptation framework. CAP-TTA triggers context-aware LoRA updates only when a bias-risk score exceeds a set threshold. By utilizing an offline precomputed diagonal preconditioner, it ensures fast and stable optimization. Across multiple benchmarks and human evaluations, CAP-TTA effectively reduces toxicity/bias score with significantly lower latency than standard optimization methods (e.g., AdamW or SGD). Furthermore, it prevents catastrophic forgetting, and substantially improves narrative fluency over state-of-the-art baselines without compromising debiasing performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管去偏大的大语言模型在处理已知或低偏差的提示时表现优异，但在处理陌生且高偏差的提示时往往会出现失败。我们通过外部数据检测表明，这些高偏差的提示会导致分布偏移，从而降低模型的性能。为了实现实时修正，我们提出了一种测试时自适应框架——CAP-TTA。该框架仅在偏差风险评分超过设定阈值时才触发基于上下文的LoRA更新。通过利用离线预计算的对角预处理器，它能够实现快速且稳定的优化过程。在多个基准测试和人工评估中，CAP-TTA能够有效降低文本的毒性/偏差得分，其延迟程度明显低于传统优化方法（如AdamW或SGD）。此外，它还能防止灾难性遗忘现象，并在不牺牲去偏效果的前提下，显著提升了文本流畅性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Backdoor Collapse: Eliminating Unknown Threats Via Known Backdoor Aggregation In Language Models
papers.title_zh: 后门式崩溃：通过语言模型中的已知后门机制来消除未知威胁
papers.authors: Liang Lin, Miao Yu, Moayad Aloqaily, Zhenhong Zhou, Kun Wang, Linsey Pang, Prakhar Mehrotra, Qingsong Wen
papers.abstract: Backdoor attacks are a significant threat to large language models (LLMs), often embedded via public checkpoints, yet existing defenses rely on impractical assumptions about trigger settings. To address this challenge, we propose Locphylax, a defense framework that requires no prior knowledge of trigger settings. Locphylax is based on the key observation that when deliberately injecting known backdoors into an already-compromised model, both existing unknown and newly injected backdoors aggregate in the representation space. Locphylax leverages this through a two-stage process: first, aggregating backdoor representations by injecting known triggers, and then, performing recovery fine-tuning to restore benign outputs. Extensive experiments across multiple LLM architectures demonstrate that: (I) Locphylax reduces the average Attack Success Rate to 4.41% across multiple benchmarks, outperforming existing baselines by 28.1%–69.3%. (II) Clean accuracy and utility are preserved within 0.5% of the original model, ensuring negligible impact on legitimate tasks. (III) The defense generalizes across different types of backdoors, confirming its robustness in practical deployment scenarios. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Locphylax.
papers.abstract_zh: 后门攻击是对大语言模型（LLM）的重大威胁，这种攻击通常通过公共检查点进行渗透。然而，现有的防御措施往往基于不切实际的假设来识别触发条件。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Locphylax这一防御框架。该框架无需任何关于触发条件的先验知识即可发挥作用。Locphylax的核心思想在于：当故意向已经受损的模型注入已知的后门时，那些未知的以及新注入的后门会在表示空间中相互结合。Locphylax通过两个阶段来实现这一目标：首先，通过注入已知的触发条件来聚合后门的表示；然后，通过恢复性微调来恢复模型的良性输出。在多种LLM架构上的广泛实验表明：(I) Locphylax将平均攻击成功率降低到4.41%，相比现有基线方案提升了28.1%至69.3%。(II) 模型的准确率与实用性保持在原始模型的0.5%以内，对合法任务的影响微乎其微。(III) 该防御机制能够适用于不同类型的后门，证明了其在实际部署场景中的鲁棒性。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Locphylax获取。

papers.title: Less is More: Improving LLM Reasoning with Minimal Test-Time Intervention
papers.title_zh: 少即是多：以最少的测试时间投入来提升大语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Zhen Yang, Mingyang Zhang, Feng Chen, Ganggui Ding, Liang Hou, Xin Tao, Ying-Cong Chen
papers.abstract: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) has focused on test-time scaling to improve reasoning via increased inference computation, but often at the cost of efficiency. We revisit test-time behavior and uncover a simple yet underexplored phenomenon: reasoning uncertainty is highly localized—only a small subset of high-entropy tokens dominantly affects output correctness. Motivated by this, we propose Minimal Test-Time Intervention (MTI), a training-free framework that enhances reasoning accuracy and stability with minimal overhead. MTI includes: (i) Selective CFG intervention, applying classifier-free guidance only at uncertain positions; and (ii) Lightweight negative-prompt guidance, reusing the main model’s KV cache to approximate unconditional decoding efficiently. MTI yields consistent gains across general, coding, and STEM tasks—e.g., +9.28% average improvement on six benchmarks for DeepSeek-R1-7B and +11.25% on AIME2024 using Ling-mini-2.0—while remaining highly efficient.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展主要集中在测试时规模的优化上，旨在通过增加推理计算来提高推理能力，但往往是以牺牲效率为代价的。我们重新审视了测试时的行为表现，发现了一个被忽视的现象：推理的不确定性具有很强的局部性——只有少数高熵标记对输出的正确性产生主要影响。基于这一发现，我们提出了最小测试时干预机制，这是一种无需训练的框架，能够以最小的开销提升推理的准确性和稳定性。该机制包括：(i)选择性上下文生成干预，仅在不确定的位置应用无分类器指导；(ii)轻量级负面提示引导，利用主模型的键值缓存来高效地进行无条件解码。实验表明，最小测试时干预机制在通用、编程和STEM任务中都能带来显著的提升效果——例如，在DeepSeek-R1-7B模型中，六个基准测试的平均准确率提升了9.28%；而在AIME2024测试中，使用Ling-mini-2.0模型时，准确率提升了11.25%。同时，该机制仍然保持了极高的效率。

papers.title: League of LLMs: A Benchmark-Free Paradigm for Mutual Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型联盟：一种无需基准数据的相互评估范式，用于大型语言模型的比较
papers.authors: Qianhong Guo, Wei Xie, Xiaofang Cai, Enze Wang, Shuoyoucheng Ma, Xiaobing Sun, Tian Xia, Kai Chen, Xiaofeng Wang, Baosheng Wang
papers.abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) have shown exceptional capabilities across a wide range of tasks, reliable evaluation remains a critical challenge due to data contamination, opaque operation, and subjective preferences. To address these issues, we propose League of LLMs (LOL), a novel benchmark-free evaluation paradigm that organizes multiple LLMs into a self-governed league for multi-round mutual evaluation. LOL integrates four core criteria (dynamic, transparent, objective, and professional) to mitigate key limitations of existing paradigms. Experiments on eight mainstream LLMs in mathematics and programming demonstrate that LOL can effectively distinguish LLM capabilities while maintaining high internal ranking stability (Top-k consistency = 70.7\%). Beyond ranking, LOL reveals empirical findings that are difficult for traditional paradigms to capture. For instance, “memorization-based answering” behaviors are observed in some models, and higher in-family scores are found in the OpenAI model family (\Delta = 9, p < 0.05). Finally, we make our framework and code publicly available as a valuable complement to the current LLM evaluation ecosystem.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在众多任务中展现出了卓越的能力，但由于数据污染、操作不透明以及主观偏好等因素，对其进行可靠的评估仍然是一个关键挑战。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了“LLM联盟”这一全新的无基准评估范式。该范式将多个LLM组织成一个自我管理的联盟，通过多轮相互评估来评价它们的能力。LOL整合了四个核心标准：动态性、透明度、客观性和专业性，以克服现有范式的局限性。在对八种主流数学和编程领域的LLM进行的实验表明，LOL能够有效区分不同LLM的能力，同时保持较高的内部排名稳定性（Top-k一致性为70.7%）。除了排名功能外，LOL还揭示了一些传统范式难以捕捉的实证现象。例如，某些模型表现出“基于记忆的回答”行为，而OpenAI系列模型中则出现了更高的家族内得分差异（Δ=9，p<0.05）。最后，我们将我们的框架和代码公开提供，作为当前LLM评估体系的宝贵补充。

papers.title: RARE: Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation Framework for High-Similarity Corpora
papers.title_zh: 稀有资源：适用于高相似性语料库的冗余感知检索评估框架
papers.authors: Hanjun Cho, Jay-Yoon Lee
papers.abstract: Existing QA benchmarks typically assume distinct documents with minimal overlap, yet real-world retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems operate on corpora such as financial reports, legal codes, and patents, where information is highly redundant and documents exhibit strong inter-document similarity. This mismatch undermines evaluation validity: retrievers can be unfairly undervalued even when they retrieve documents that provide sufficient evidence, because redundancy across documents is not accounted for in evaluation. On the other hand, retrievers that perform well on standard benchmarks often generalize poorly to real-world corpora with highly similar and redundant documents. We present RARE (Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation), a framework for constructing realistic benchmarks by (i) decomposing documents into atomic facts to enable precise redundancy tracking and (ii) enhancing LLM-based data generation with CRRF. RAG benchmark data usually requires multiple quality criteria, but LLMs often yield trivial outputs. CRRF scores criteria separately and fuses decisions by rank, improving the reliability of generated data. Applying RARE to Finance, Legal, and Patent corpora, we introduce RedQA, where a strong retriever baseline drops from 66.4% PerfRecall@10 on 4-hop General-Wiki to 5.0–27.9% PerfRecall@10 at 4-hop depth, revealing robustness gaps that current benchmarks fail to capture. RARE enables practitioners to build domain-specific RAG evaluations that faithfully reflect real-world deployment conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的质量保证基准通常假设文档之间几乎没有重叠，但实际上，现实世界中的检索增强生成系统所处理的语料库包括财务报告、法律条文和专利等，这些文档中的信息往往存在大量冗余，且不同文档之间存在较强的相似性。这种不匹配会削弱评估的有效性：即使检索器能够找到提供足够证据的文档，它们仍可能被不公平地低估，因为评估过程中并未考虑文档之间的冗余性。另一方面，那些在标准基准测试中表现良好的检索器，在处理与现实世界高度相似且存在冗余的语料库时，其性能往往会下降。我们提出了RARE（冗余感知检索评估）框架，该框架通过以下方式构建真实的基准测试：(i) 将文档分解为原子事实，以便精确跟踪冗余情况；(ii) 利用CRRF技术改进基于大语言模型的数据生成。通常情况下，RAG基准数据需要多个质量指标，但大语言模型往往只能生成简单的输出。CRRF则分别评估各项指标，并通过排名来融合决策结果，从而提高生成数据的可靠性。将RARE应用于金融、法律和专利领域的语料库后，我们推出了RedQA框架。在该框架下，一个优秀的检索器在4跳深度下的PerfRecall@10得分从General-Wiki的66.4%下降到5.0–27.9%，这表明当前基准测试未能捕捉到一些重要的鲁棒性差距。RARE使得从业者能够构建出能够真实反映现实世界部署条件的特定领域RAG评估方法。

papers.title: Leibniz: Theory-of-Mind Driven Neuro-Symbolic Logical Reasoning via Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.title_zh: 莱布尼茨：通过多智能体协作实现心智理论驱动的神经符号逻辑推理
papers.authors: Yue Fan, Hu Zhang, Yunxiao Zhao, Guangjun Zhang, Hao Zhan, Ru Li, Hongye Tan, Yuanlong Wang
papers.abstract: Logical reasoning with large language models (LLMs) has made significant progress in recent years. However, existing methods still suffer from insufficient rule semantic grounding and weak rule application mechanisms, making it difficult to achieve precise understanding and effective utilization of rules in complex multi-step reasoning. To address this, we propose Leibniz, a theory-of-mind driven neuro-symbolic reasoning framework. Specifically, we construct a bidirectional reasoning model based on multi-agent collaboration, which characterizes the reasoning process from two complementary perspectives, namely the Evolution Agent and the Reduction Agent. The former transforms belief-unstable propositions into stable ones that are beneficial for proving the target conclusion. The latter performs reverse reduction from the target to resolve belief conflicts and distill new inferential insights. Both share a belief state space and achieve efficient collaborative reasoning through continual belief updating. We integrate natural language and symbolic representations throughout the reasoning process. The experimental results demonstrate that Leibniz surpasses existing state-of-the-art models in reasoning accuracy, and further analyses reveal its substantial advantages in reliability and flexibility.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，利用大语言模型进行逻辑推理取得了显著进展。然而，现有的方法仍然存在规则语义基础不足以及规则应用机制薄弱的问题，这导致在复杂的多步骤推理过程中难以实现对规则的精确理解和有效运用。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于心智理论的神经符号推理框架——莱布尼茨框架。具体来说，我们构建了一个基于多智能体协作的双向推理模型，该模型从两个互补的角度来描述推理过程：一个是进化智能体，它负责将难以确定的命题转化为易于证明的结论；另一个是简化智能体，它负责从结论出发进行逆向推理，以解决信念冲突并得出新的推理见解。这两个智能体共享一个信念状态空间，并通过持续的信念更新实现高效的协作推理。我们在整个推理过程中整合了自然语言和符号表示。实验结果表明，莱布尼茨框架在推理准确性方面优于现有的最先进模型，进一步分析还揭示了其在可靠性和灵活性方面的显著优势。

papers.title: The Paradox of Outcome Optimization: A Causal Information-Theoretic Bound on Reasoning Shortcuts in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 结果优化的悖论：基于因果信息论的推理捷径限制在大型语言模型中
papers.authors: Zihan Chen, Yiming Zhang, Wenxiang Geng, Zenghui Ding, Yining Sun
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) aligned via outcome-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) frequently exhibit a critical failure mode: they achieve high performance on in-distribution benchmarks while demonstrating brittle reasoning capabilities on out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks. We term this phenomenon Reward-Induced Manifold Collapse. We establish a theoretical framework bridging Structural Causal Models (SCM) and the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle to explain this paradox. We define reasoning as a high-complexity causal process and shortcut learning as the exploitation of low-complexity spurious correlations. Under the implicit inductive bias of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), models optimized for outcome rewards are biased toward shortcut solutions whenever the training distribution allows for a “Markovian Screening” of the true causal mechanism. We derive a new generalization bound based on Semantic Coverage Measure (\eta) rather than sample size, showing why data scaling on homogeneous distributions may fail to correct reasoning flaws. We also show that Process Reward Models (PRMs) function as Topological Filters, enforcing step-wise mutual information constraints that render the low-complexity shortcut manifold inadmissible. These results provide a mathematical grounding for the role of process supervision beyond simple credit assignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通过基于结果的强化学习进行对齐时，常常会出现一个关键的问题：它们在分布内基准测试中表现出很高的性能，但在分布外任务中则显示出脆弱的推理能力。我们将这种现象称为“奖励诱导的流形崩塌”。我们建立了一个理论框架，将结构因果模型与信息瓶颈原理结合起来，以解释这一悖论。我们将推理定义为一种高复杂度的因果过程，而捷径学习则指利用低复杂度的人为相关性来解决问题。在随机梯度下降的隐式归纳偏见作用下，那些针对结果奖励进行优化的模型，在训练分布允许对真实因果机制进行“马尔可夫筛选”的情况下，往往会倾向于选择捷径解决方案。我们提出了一种新的泛化界限，该界限基于语义覆盖度量（η），而不是样本大小，从而揭示了为什么在均匀分布上扩大数据规模可能无法纠正推理缺陷。我们还发现，过程奖励模型作为拓扑过滤器，会强制实施逐步的互信息约束，使得低复杂度的捷径流形变得不可接受。这些结果为过程监督在超越简单信用分配作用中的角色提供了数学基础。

papers.title: SPENCE: A Syntactic Probe for Detecting Contamination in NL2SQL Benchmarks
papers.title_zh: 斯彭斯：一种用于检测NL2SQL测试数据中污染现象的语言结构分析工具
papers.authors: Mohammadtaher Safarzadeh, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Afshin Oroojlooy, Graham Horwood, Dan Roth
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on natural language to SQL (NL2SQL) benchmarks, yet their reported accuracy may be inflated by contamination from benchmark queries or structurally similar patterns seen during training. We introduce SPENCE (Syntactic Probing and Evaluation of NL2SQL Contamination Effects), a controlled syntactic probing framework for detecting and quantifying such contamination. SPENCE systematically generates syntactic variants of test queries for four widely used NL2SQL datasets—Spider, SParC, CoSQL, and the newer BIRD benchmark. We use SPENCE to evaluate multiple high-capacity LLMs under execution-based scoring. For each model, we measure changes in execution accuracy (Delta Accuracy) across increasing levels of syntactic divergence and quantify rank sensitivity using Kendall’s tau with bootstrap confidence intervals. By aligning these robustness trends with benchmark release dates, we observe a clear temporal gradient: older benchmarks such as Spider exhibit the strongest negative values and thus the highest likelihood of training leakage, whereas the more recent BIRD dataset shows minimal sensitivity and appears largely uncontaminated. Together, these findings highlight the importance of temporally contextualized, syntactic-probing evaluation for trustworthy NL2SQL benchmarking.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自然语言到SQL的基准测试中取得了出色的性能，但它们的准确率可能会因基准测试查询的污染或训练过程中出现的结构相似模式而有所高估。我们提出了SPENCE（语法探测与评估自然语言到SQL污染效应）这一框架，用于检测和量化这种污染现象。SPENCE系统地生成了四个常用自然语言到SQL数据集的测试查询的语法变体——Spider、SParC、CoSQL以及较新的BIRD基准测试。我们使用SPENCE来评估多个高容量语言模型在基于执行结果的评分下的表现。对于每一个模型，我们测量了在执行准确性上的变化（Δ准确性），并采用肯德尔tau系数结合自助法置信区间来量化模型的鲁棒性敏感性。通过将这些鲁棒性趋势与基准测试的发布日期进行关联，我们发现了一个明显的时间梯度：像Spider这样的旧基准测试表现出最强的负面效应，因此存在最高的训练泄漏风险；而较新的BIRD数据集则显示出极低的敏感性，似乎几乎没有受到污染。总的来说，这些发现强调了在时间上具有上下文性的、基于语法的评估对于可信的自然语言到SQL基准测试的重要性。

papers.title: PaTaRM: Bridging Pairwise and Pointwise Signals via Preference-Aware Task-Adaptive Reward Modeling
papers.title_zh: PaTaRM：通过基于偏好的任务自适应奖励模型，实现点对点信号之间的连接
papers.authors: Ai Jian, Jingqing Ruan, Xing Ma, Dailin Li, Weipeng Zhang, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai
papers.abstract: Reward models (RMs) are central to reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), providing the critical supervision signals that align large language models (LLMs) with human preferences.Generative reward models (GRMs) provide greater interpretability than traditional scalar RMs, but they come with a critical trade-off: pairwise methods are hindered by a training-inference mismatch, while pointwise methods require expensive absolute annotations.To bridge this gap, we propose the Preference-aware Task-adaptive Reward Model (PaTaRM).Unlike prior approaches, PaTaRM enables robust pointwise training using readily available pairwise data via a novel Preference-Aware Reward (PAR) mechanism, eliminating the need for explicit rating labels. Furthermore, it incorporates a task-adaptive rubric system that dynamically generates instance-specific criteria for precise evaluation.Extensive experiments demonstrate that PaTaRM achieves an average relative improvement of 8.7% over the corresponding base models on RewardBench and RMBench across the Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B backbones.Crucially, when used as a reward model for downstream RLHF, it yields an average relative improvement of 13.6% over the corresponding base policies on IFEval and InfoBench, validating its effectiveness for policy alignment.Our code, data, and checkpoints are available at https://huggingface.co/AIJian/PaTaRM
papers.abstract_zh: 奖励模型（RMs）在基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）中起着核心作用，它们提供了至关重要的监督信号，使大语言模型（LLMs）能够符合人类的偏好。生成式奖励模型（GRMs）比传统的标量奖励模型具有更高的可解释性，但它们存在一个关键权衡：成对方法会受到训练与推理不匹配的困扰，而逐点方法则需要昂贵的绝对注释数据。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了偏好感知任务自适应奖励模型（PaTaRM）。与以往的方法不同，PaTaRM通过一种新颖的偏好感知奖励机制，利用现有的成对数据进行稳健的逐点训练，从而无需显式的评分标签。此外，它还采用了一种任务自适应的评估标准系统，能够动态生成针对具体实例的评估准则。大量实验表明，在RewardBench和RMBench上，PaTaRM相对于相应的基础模型实现了平均8.7%的相对性能提升，适用于Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B等模型架构。更重要的是，当作为下游RLHF的奖励模型时，它在IFEval和InfoBench上的相对性能提升达到了13.6%，这验证了其在策略对齐方面的有效性。我们的代码、数据和检查点可以在https://huggingface.co/AIJian/PaTaRM获取。

papers.title: Uncovering Sentiment Analysis Circuit in Large Language Model
papers.title_zh: 揭示大型语言模型中的情感分析电路
papers.authors: Shichen Li, Zhouyang Wang, Zhongqing Wang, Peifeng Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can perform sentiment analysis via natural language instructions, yet their predictions are highly sensitive to prompt phrasing. Prior work has shown that sentiment is encoded linearly in LLM representations, but the model’s ability to utilize this information remains surprisingly fragile to prompt variations. We leverage Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) and circuit-level analysis to uncover causal mechanisms underlying sentiment prediction. We identify a sentiment analysis circuit and find that prompt sensitivity may stem from task activation failure. The model encodes the sentiment feature consistently, but different prompts trigger varying degrees of circuit activation. Based on this insight, we propose a simple inference-time intervention method that amplifies circuit features to compensate for insufficient activation. Experiments across diverse datasets, templates, and languages show consistent improvements, offering an interpretable and training-free alternative to manual prompt engineering.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型可以通过自然语言指令进行情感分析，但其预测结果对提示语的表达方式非常敏感。先前的研究表明，情感信息在模型表示中是以线性方式编码的，但模型利用这些信息的能力对于提示语的变化却表现出惊人的脆弱性。我们利用稀疏自编码器技术和电路级分析来揭示情感预测背后的因果机制。我们发现，情感分析的电路结构中存在一些问题，而提示语的敏感性可能源于任务激活机制的失效。模型能够一致地编码情感特征，但不同的提示语会触发不同程度的电路激活。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种简单的推理时间干预方法，该方法可以放大电路特征，以弥补激活不足的问题。在多种数据集、模板和语言上的实验表明，这种方法能够带来持续的改进效果，为手动调整提示语提供了一种可解释且无需训练的替代方案。

papers.title: Think Before Writing: Feature-Level Multi-Objective Optimization for Generative Citation Visibility
papers.title_zh: 三思而后写：用于生成性引用可见性的特征级多目标优化
papers.authors: Zikang Liu, Peilan Xu
papers.abstract: Generative answer engines expose content through selective citation rather than ranked retrieval, fundamentally altering how visibility is determined. This shift calls for new optimization methods beyond traditional search engine optimization. Existing generative engine optimization (GEO) approaches primarily rely on token-level text rewriting, offering limited interpretability and weak control over the trade-off between citation visibility and content quality. We propose FeatGEO, a feature-level, multi-objective optimization framework that abstracts webpages into interpretable structural, content, and linguistic properties. Instead of directly editing text, FeatGEO optimizes over this feature space and uses a language model to realize feature configurations into natural language, decoupling high-level optimization from surface-level generation. Experiments on GEO-Bench across three generative engines demonstrate that FeatGEO consistently improves citation visibility while maintaining or improving content quality, substantially outperforming token-level baselines. Further analyses show that citation behavior is more strongly influenced by document-level content properties than by isolated lexical edits, and that the learned feature configurations generalize across language models of different scales.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式回答引擎通过选择性引用来展示内容，而非通过排序检索的方式，这从根本上改变了内容的可见性确定方式。这种转变要求采用超越传统搜索引擎优化的新优化方法。现有的生成式引擎优化方法主要依赖于文本级别的改写操作，这种方式的可解释性有限，对引用可见性与内容质量之间的权衡控制也较为薄弱。我们提出了FeatGEO这一基于特征级的多目标优化框架，它能够将网页抽象为可解释的结构、内容和语言属性。FeatGEO不是直接编辑文本，而是针对这些特征空间进行优化，并利用语言模型将特征配置转化为自然语言，从而将高级优化与表面级生成分离开来。在GEO-Bench上对三种生成式引擎进行的实验表明，FeatGEO能够在保持或提升内容质量的同时，持续提高引用的可见性，其性能明显优于基于文本级别的基础方案。进一步分析显示，引用的行为更受文档级别的内容属性影响，而非孤立的词汇编辑。而且，所学习到的特征配置能够在不同规模的语言模型中得到泛化应用。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Multimodal Retrieval with Multi-Scale Contextual Representations
papers.title_zh: 基于多尺度上下文表示的零样本多模态检索方法
papers.authors: Sourajit Saha, Tejas Gokhale
papers.abstract: In multimodal information retrieval (MMIR), candidates relevant to an input query need to be retrieved from a database, where the query and database items span different modalities. As real-world databases evolve, repeatedly annotating and indexing data and re-optimizing domain-specific models across modalities is impractical. We present MULTI-SCORE, a fine-tuning-free, two-stage MMIR approach that couples efficient candidate filtering with fine-grained multimodal re-ranking. Stage-1 adopts Matryoshka representations to efficiently filter out low-relevance candidates without expensive similarity computations on full-scale representations for the entire database. Stage-2 re-ranks the filtered candidates by computing their fine-grained multimodal contextual representations with two scoring functions for semantic alignment using chain-of-thought prompting and question-answering. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art zero-shot retrieval on 12 MMIR tasks across 32 datasets while outperforming supervised methods on 23 datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 在多模态信息检索中，需要从数据库中检索出与输入查询相关的候选对象，而查询和数据库中的项目涉及不同的模态。随着现实世界数据库的不断发展，反复对数据进行注释和索引，以及跨模态重新优化特定领域的模型变得不切实际。我们提出了MULTI-SCORE方法，这是一种无需微调的两阶段多模态信息检索方法，它能够高效地进行候选对象的筛选，同时实现细粒度的多模态排序。第一阶段采用“套娃”表示法，以高效过滤掉相关性较低的候选对象，而无需对整个数据库的全尺寸表示进行昂贵的相似性计算。第二阶段则通过计算候选对象的细粒度多模态上下文表示，并利用链式思维提示和问答方式，结合两种评分函数来进行语义对齐，从而对筛选出的候选对象进行重新排序。实验结果表明，该方法在32个数据集上的12种多模态信息检索任务中实现了最先进的零样本检索性能，并且在23个数据集上优于基于监督的方法。

papers.title: ReEfBench: Quantifying the Reasoning Efficiency of LLMs
papers.title_zh: ReEfBench：量化大语言模型的推理效率
papers.authors: Zhizhang Fu, Yuancheng Gu, Chenkai Hu, Hanmeng Liu, Yue Zhang
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling has enabled Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex reasoning, yet the limitations of current Chain-of-Thought (CoT) evaluation obscure whether performance gains stem from genuine reasoning or mere verbosity. To address this, (1) we propose a novel neuro-symbolic framework for the non-intrusive, comprehensive process-centric evaluation of reasoning grounded in First-Order Logic. (2) Through this lens, we identify four distinct behavioral prototypes and diagnose the failure modes. (3) We examine the impact of inference mode, training strategy, and model scale. Our analysis reveals that extended token generation is not a prerequisite for deep reasoning. Furthermore, we reveal critical constraints: mixing long and short CoT data in training risks premature saturation and collapse, while distillation into smaller models captures behavioral length but fails to replicate logical efficacy due to intrinsic capacity limits.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时缩放技术使得大语言模型能够处理复杂的推理任务。然而，当前思维链评估方法的局限性使得我们无法确定性能提升究竟是源于真正的推理能力，还是仅仅因为模型的表达过于冗长。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的神经符号框架，该框架能够以非侵入式的方式对基于一阶逻辑的推理过程进行全面评估。通过这一框架，我们识别出四种不同的行为模式，并诊断出可能出现的故障模式。我们还研究了推理模式、训练策略以及模型规模对性能的影响。我们的分析表明，扩展的令牌生成并不是深度推理的必要条件。此外，我们还发现了一些关键的限制：在训练中混合长短期思维链数据可能会导致模型过早饱和和崩溃；而将模型蒸馏到更小的模型中虽然可以保留一定的行为特征，但由于内在能力的限制，却无法复制逻辑上的有效性。

papers.title: Beyond Ranking: Fine-Grained Diagnostics and Self-Improvement for MLLMs
papers.title_zh: 超越排名：针对大型语言模型的高级诊断与自我改进方法
papers.authors: Mingze Xu, Zijing Zhao, Qiming Peng, Houwen Peng, Han Hu, Zhanhui Kang, Yuxing Han
papers.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are advancing rapidly, accurately evaluating their capabilities remains challenging. Current paradigms primarily rely on holistic scoring and static leaderboards, which fail to disentangle fine-grained competencies. Specifically, they suffer from “Outcome Bias” by validating only final answers and ignoring intermediate reasoning. To address these limitations, we introduce ATOM (AnaTomy Of MLLM), a novel MLLM-as-a-judge framework designed to shift the focus from ranking to fine-grained diagnosis. ATOM decomposes complex reasoning into atomic criteria anchored in visual elements, enforcing verification against explicit visual facts. Validated on a newly constructed benchmark with rigorous human rankings, ATOM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, surpassing the strongest baseline by up to 7.92%. Moving beyond ranking, ATOM bridges the gap between assessment and alignment: by pinpointing atomic-level failures, it establishes a closed-loop mechanism for targeted self-correction. This approach enables models to identify and rectify errors autonomously, successfully resolving up to 39.95% of previously failed queries without human intervention.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型正在迅速发展，但准确评估它们的能力仍然具有挑战性。当前的评估方式主要依赖于整体评分和静态排行榜，这无法区分不同层次的性能差异。具体来说，这些评估方式存在“结果偏见”，因为它们只验证最终答案，而忽略了中间的推理过程。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了ATOM（MLLM的解析框架），这是一种将MLLM作为评估工具的新方法，旨在将重点从排名转移到对细节的精确分析上。ATOM将复杂的推理分解为基于视觉元素的原子级标准，从而确保评估结果的准确性。在一项经过严格人类评测的新构建基准测试上，ATOM取得了领先的性能，其准确率超过了最强大的基线模型，最高达到了7.92%。除了排名功能之外，ATOM还实现了评估与调整之间的无缝衔接：通过识别原子级别的缺陷，它建立了一个闭环机制，使得模型能够自主纠正错误。这种方法使模型能够自动识别并修正错误，成功解决了高达39.95%的先前无法解决的查询问题，而无需人工干预。
