papers.title: Bridging Internal Consistency and External Alignment: A Causal and Dynamic Interpretability Framework for LLM Generation
papers.title_zh: 构建内部一致性与外部对齐的桥梁：一种适用于大语言模型生成的因果性与动态可解释性框架
papers.authors: Shuyao Xiao, Shengling Wang, Ke Chao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used in high-stakes applications, making their interpretability increasingly important. Existing interpretability methods are typically categorized into internal and external perspectives, which are often studied in isolation and tend to overlook two key aspects: causality and temporal dynamics. Explanations are often limited to surface correlations or static dependencies, failing to capture how influences evolve during autoregressive generation. To address these limitations, we propose a causal and dynamic interpretability framework for LLM generation. We first characterize the backdoor-adjusted causal effects of both the generated prefix and the prompt on the current token using the Structural Causal Model. Next, we introduce two metrics to quantify contextual causal influence and question–answer causal influence. Overall, our work provides a unified causal view of internal consistency and external alignment in LLM generation dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在高风险应用中被广泛使用，因此其可解释性变得越来越重要。现有的可解释性方法通常分为内部视角和外部视角两类，这两种方法往往被单独研究，而忽略了两个关键方面：因果关系和时间动态性。目前的解释往往局限于表面相关性或静态依赖关系，未能捕捉到在自回归生成过程中各种影响的演变过程。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种针对语言模型生成的因果性和动态性可解释性框架。首先，我们使用结构因果模型来表征生成的前缀和提示对当前令牌的因果效应。接下来，我们引入了两种指标来量化上下文因果影响以及问题-答案之间的因果影响。总体而言，我们的工作为语言模型生成过程中的内部一致性和外部对齐提供了一个统一的因果视角。

papers.title: Beyond the Last Frame: Process-aware Evaluation for Generative Video Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 超越最后一帧：基于过程的生成式视频推理评估方法
papers.authors: Yifan Li, YuKai Gu, Yingqian Min, Zikang Liu, Yifan Du, Kun Zhou, Min Yang, Xin Zhao, Minghui Qiu
papers.abstract: Recent breakthroughs in video generation have demonstrated an emerging capability termed Chain-of-Frames (CoF) reasoning, where models resolve complex tasks through the generation of continuous frames. While these models show promise for Generative Video Reasoning (GVR), existing evaluation frameworks often rely on single-frame assessments, which can lead to outcome-hacking, where a model reaches a correct conclusion through an erroneous process. To address this, we propose a process-aware evaluation paradigm. We introduce VIPER, a comprehensive benchmark spanning 16 tasks across temporal, structural, symbolic, spatial, physics, and planning reasoning. Furthermore, we propose Process-outcome Consistency (POC@r), a new metric that utilizes VLM-as-Judge with a hierarchical rubric to evaluate both the validity of the intermediate steps and the final result. Our experiments reveal that state-of-the-art video models achieve POC@1.0 only about 20% and exhibit a significant outcome-hacking. We further explore the impact of test-time scaling and sampling robustness, highlighting a substantial gap between current video generation and true generalized visual reasoning. Our benchmark are released at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/VIPER.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在视频生成领域取得的突破表明，一种名为“帧链推理”的新能力正在兴起。这种能力使得模型能够通过生成连续的帧来解决复杂的任务。虽然这些模型在生成式视频推理方面具有很大的潜力，但现有的评估框架往往依赖于单帧评估方式，这可能导致模型通过错误的方法得出正确的结论。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种注重过程的评估范式。我们引入了VIPER这一全面的基准测试，该测试涵盖了时间、结构、符号、空间、物理和规划推理等16个任务。此外，我们还提出了“过程-结果一致性”这一新指标，该指标利用视觉语言模型作为评判器，并通过分层评分标准来评估中间步骤和最终结果的有效性。我们的实验表明，最先进的视频模型POC@1.0 仅约为 20%，且存在显著的结果偏差问题。我们还探讨了测试时间扩展和采样鲁棒性对评估结果的影响，发现当前视频生成技术与真正的泛化视觉推理之间存在较大差距。我们的基准测试可以在https://github.com/RUCAIBox/VIPER下载。

papers.title: THOR: A Theta-Gamma Hierarchical Oscillatory Reasoning Framework for Multi-hop QA
papers.title_zh: 索尔：一种用于多跳问答系统的Theta-Gamma层次式振荡推理框架
papers.authors: Ziyang Ling, Ronald X. Xu, Mingzhai Sun
papers.abstract: Multi-hop question answering requires retrieving and integrating evidence from multiple contexts. Despite the rapid progress of current research, multi-hop reasoning remains constrained by two persistent limitations: attention decay, where the model’s focus on main question degrades as the reasoning chain grows, and error accumulation, where mistakes propagate across hops and compounds into final failure. Inspired by Theta-Gamma hierarchical oscillation which decouples global planning from local retrieval, enabling efficient attention transfer between hops and a verification and repair mechanism that interrupts the accumulation of errors in the wrong paths, we present THOR, a brain-inspired Theta-Gamma hierarchical oscillatory reasoning framework. Extensive comparative experiments and specific validation experiments on multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that THOR improves answer accuracy and robustness while mitigating limitations, showcasing its generalization across different backbones.
papers.abstract_zh: 多跳问答需要从多个上下文中检索和整合信息。尽管当前研究取得了快速进展，但多跳推理仍然受到两个长期存在的限制：注意力衰减，即随着推理链的增长，模型对主要问题的关注程度会下降；以及错误累积，即错误会在不同跳跃之间传播并导致最终失败。受Theta-Gamma层次振荡机制的启发，该机制将全局规划与局部检索分离，从而实现跳跃之间的高效注意力传递，同时具备中断错误路径累积的错误验证和修复机制。我们提出了THOR这一基于大脑原理的Theta-Gamma层次振荡推理框架。通过广泛的比较实验以及对多跳问答基准测试的具体验证实验表明，THOR能够提高答案的准确性和鲁棒性，同时克服上述限制，显示出其在不同基础架构上的通用性。

papers.title: How Should We Enhance the Safety of Large Reasoning Models: An Empirical Study
papers.title_zh: 我们该如何提升大型推理模型的安全性：一项实证研究
papers.authors: Zhexin Zhang, Xian Qi Loye, Victor Shea-Jay Huang, Junxiao Yang, Qi Zhu, Shiyao Cui, Fei Mi, Lifeng Shang, Yingkang Wang, Hongning Wang, Minlie Huang
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success on reasoning-intensive tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, their enhanced reasoning capabilities do not necessarily translate to improved safety performance—and in some cases, may even degrade it. This raises an important research question: how should we enhance the safety of LRMs? In this paper, we present a comprehensive empirical study on how to enhance the safety of LRMs through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Our investigation begins with an unexpected observation: directly distilling safe responses from DeepSeek-R1 fails to significantly enhance safety. We analyze this phenomenon and identify five key risky patterns that contribute to it. We then demonstrate that explicitly addressing these issues during the data distillation process can lead to substantial safety improvements. Next, we explore whether a long and complex reasoning process is necessary for achieving safety. Interestingly, we find that simply using short or template-based reasoning process can attain comparable safety performance. These findings prompt a deeper reflection on the role of reasoning in ensuring safety. Finally, we conduct a comprehensive ablation study to reveal the impact of different training configurations. Overall, we hope our empirical study could provide a more holistic picture on enhancing the safety of LRMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在涉及推理的任务中取得了显著的成功，例如数学和编程领域。然而，它们强大的推理能力并不一定能提升安全性——在某些情况下，甚至可能降低安全性。这提出了一个重要的问题：我们该如何提高大型推理模型的安全性呢？在本文中，我们开展了一项全面的实证研究，探讨如何通过监督微调来提升大型推理模型的安全性。我们的研究始于一个意外的发现：直接从DeepSeek-R1模型中提取安全响应并不能显著提升安全性。我们分析了这一现象，并发现了五个导致安全性能下降的关键问题。随后，我们发现，在数据蒸馏过程中明确解决这些问题可以显著提高安全性。此外，我们还探讨了实现安全性是否需要一个漫长且复杂的推理过程。有趣的是，我们发现使用简短的或基于模板的推理过程也能达到类似的安全性能。这些发现促使我们对推理在确保安全性中的作用进行更深入的思考。最后，我们进行了全面的消融实验，以揭示不同训练配置的影响。总体而言，我们希望我们的实证研究能够为我们提供关于如何提高大型推理模型安全性的更全面的认识。

papers.title: HSCodeComp: A Realistic and Expert-level Agent Benchmark for Hierarchical Rule Application
papers.title_zh: HSCodeComp：一种适用于分层规则应用的、具有现实感且达到专家级水平的智能体基准测试系统
papers.authors: Tian Lan, Yiqian Yang, Qianghuai Jia, Li Zhu, Hui Jiang, Hang Zhu, Weihua Luo, Longyue Wang
papers.abstract: Despite recent progress, existing agent benchmarks neglect a fundamental real-world capability: hierarchical rule application, a critical requirement in fields such as law and medicine where agents must reason from broad categories down to specific exceptions to reach rule-compliant decisions.This introduces significant challenges in resolving logical dependencies and disambiguating vague boundaries.To bridge this gap, we introduce HSCodeComp, a novel benchmark derived from e-commerce, requiring agents to assign a unique 10-digit Harmonized System (HS) Code to products by aligning their fuzzy attributes with strict tariff classification rules.HSCodeComp comprises 632 realistic products across 32 categories, featuring detailed yet noisy product information (titles, attributes, and images). The HS Codes are annotated by a panel of 26 tariff experts, strictly adhering to official rules and an empirical knowledge base, both of which we jointly open-source.Through a comprehensive evaluation of 23 LLMs, VLMs, and agents on HSCodeComp, we demonstrate that: 1) a substantial performance gap remains between state-of-the-art agents and human experts (46.8% vs. 95.0%); and 2) test-time scaling fails to close this gap. Further analysis reveals that 1) excessive reasoning steps frequently induce “reasoning drift,” which degrades accuracy; and 2) agents are prone to premature decisions on high-level categories and reasoning hallucinations that lack factual grounding.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管最近取得了一些进展，但现有的智能体基准测试忽略了一个重要的现实世界能力：层次化规则应用能力。在法律和医学等领域，智能体需要从宏观类别逐步推理到具体例外情况，以做出符合规则的决策。这就带来了解决逻辑依赖关系和消除模糊边界的显著挑战。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了HSCodeComp这一新型基准测试。该测试源自电子商务领域，要求智能体根据产品的模糊属性与严格的关税分类规则进行匹配，为产品分配一个唯一的10位协调制度编码。HSCodeComp包含632种产品，涵盖32个类别，这些产品的信息虽然详细但存在一定误差，包括产品名称、属性和图片等。这些HS编码由26位关税专家进行标注，他们严格遵循官方规则和经验知识库来进行标注，我们将这些工具和知识库开源共享。通过对23个大语言模型、视觉语言模型以及智能体在HSCodeComp上的全面评估，我们发现：1）最先进的智能体与人类专家之间的性能差距仍然很大（分别为46.8%和95.0%）；2）测试时的扩展并不能缩小这一差距。进一步分析还发现：1）过多的推理步骤常常会导致“推理漂移”，从而降低准确性；2）智能体在处理高层类别时容易做出过早的决策，并且会出现缺乏事实依据的推理幻觉。

papers.title: AnchorSeg: Language Grounded Query Banks for Reasoning Segmentation
papers.title_zh: AnchorSeg：基于语言的查询库，用于推理分割任务
papers.authors: Rui Qian, Chuanhang Deng, Qiang Huang, Jian Xiong, Mingxuan Li, Yingbo Zhou, Wei Zhai, Jintao Chen, Dejing Dou
papers.abstract: Reasoning segmentation requires models to ground complex, implicit textual queries into precise pixel-level masks. Existing approaches rely on a single segmentation token <SEG>, whose hidden state implicitly encodes both semantic reasoning and spatial localization, limiting the model’s ability to explicitly disentangle what to segment from where to segment. We introduce AnchorSeg, which reformulates reasoning segmentation as a structured conditional generation process over image tokens, conditioned on language grounded query banks. Instead of compressing all semantic reasoning and spatial localization into a single embedding, AnchorSeg constructs an ordered sequence of query banks: latent reasoning tokens that capture intermediate semantic states, and a segmentation anchor token that provides explicit spatial grounding. We model spatial conditioning as a factorized distribution over image tokens, where the anchor query determines localization signals while contextual queries provide semantic modulation. To bridge token-level predictions and pixel-level supervision, we propose Token–Mask Cycle Consistency (TMCC), a bidirectional training objective that enforces alignment across resolutions. By explicitly decoupling spatial grounding from semantic reasoning through structured language grounded query banks, AnchorSeg achieves state-of-the-art results on ReasonSeg test set (67.7% gIoU and 68.1% cIoU). All code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/rui-qian/AnchorSeg.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理分割需要模型将复杂的、隐含的文本查询转化为精确的像素级掩码。现有的方法依赖于一个单一的分割标记<SEG>，其隐藏状态隐式地编码了语义推理和空间定位信息，这限制了模型明确区分哪些内容需要分割以及从何处进行分割的能力。我们提出了AnchorSeg，它将推理分割重新定义为一种基于图像标记的结构化条件生成过程，这一过程以语言化查询库为条件。AnchorSeg不是将所有语义推理和空间定位信息压缩到一个嵌入中，而是构建了一个有序的查询库序列：首先是捕捉中间语义状态的潜在推理标记，然后是提供明确空间定位的分割锚点标记。我们将空间条件建模为一个分布在图像标记上的分解分布，其中锚点查询决定了定位信号，而上下文查询则提供了语义调节。为了将标记级预测与像素级监督结合起来，我们提出了Token–Mask Cycle Consistency（TMCC）这一双向训练目标，它能够确保不同分辨率之间的对齐。通过利用结构化语言化查询库，将空间定位与语义推理明确分离，AnchorSeg在ReasonSeg测试集上取得了最先进的结果：gIoU达到67.7%，cIoU达到68.1%。所有代码和模型都可以在https://github.com/rui-qian/AnchorSeg上获取。

papers.title: R^3AG: Retriever Routing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: R^3AG：用于检索增强生成的检索式路由算法
papers.authors: Tong Zhao, Yutao Zhu, Yucheng Tian, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a cornerstone for knowledge-intensive tasks. However, the efficacy of RAG is often bottlenecked by the “one-size-fits-all” retrieval paradigm, as different queries exhibit distinct preferences for different retrievers. While recent routing techniques attempt to select the optimal retriever dynamically, they typically operate under a ‘single and static capability’ assumption, selecting retrievers solely based on semantic relevance. This overlooks a critical distinction in RAG: a retrieved document must not only be relevant but also effectively support the generator in producing correct answers. To address this limitation, we propose R³AG, a novel routing framework that explicitly models the dynamic alignment between queries and retriever capabilities. Unlike previous approaches, R³AG decomposes retriever capability into two learnable dimensions: retrieval quality and generation utility. We employ a contrastive learning objective that leverages complementary supervision signals, i.e., document assessments and downstream answer correctness, to capture query-specific preference shifts. Extensive experiments on diverse knowledge-intensive tasks demonstrate that R³AG consistently outperforms both the best individual retrievers and state-of-the-art static routing methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为知识密集型任务中的关键技术。然而，RAG的有效性往往受到“一刀切”的检索方式的限制，因为不同的查询对不同的检索器有着不同的偏好。虽然最近的一些路由技术试图动态选择最优的检索器，但它们通常基于“单一且固定的能力”假设来选取检索器，仅根据语义相关性来选择检索器。这忽略了一个关键问题：检索到的文档不仅必须相关，还必须能够有效地支持生成器产生正确的答案。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了R³AG这一新型路由框架，该框架能够明确模拟查询与检索器能力之间的动态匹配关系。与以往的方法不同，R³AG将检索器的能力分解为两个可学习的维度：检索质量和生成效用。我们采用对比学习目标，利用互补的监督信号，即文档评估与下游答案的正确性，来捕捉特定于查询的偏好变化。在多种知识密集型任务上的广泛实验表明，R³AG始终优于最佳的单个检索器以及最先进的静态路由方法。

papers.title: ClusterRAG: Cluster-Based Collaborative Filtering for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: ClusterRAG：基于集群的协同过滤技术，用于个性化检索增强生成
papers.authors: Gibson Nkhata, Uttamasha Anjally Oyshi, Quan Mai, Susan Gauch
papers.abstract: Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) relies on accurately selecting user-relevant documents. In practice, existing RAG approaches often suffer from high retrieval costs and overlook that collaborative signals from similar users can enhance personalized generation for the current user. We propose ClusterRAG, a Cluster-Based Collaborative Filtering for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation. ClusterRAG represents users through their profile documents, organizes users into semantically coherent clusters using density-based clustering, and performs retrieval at both the cluster and document levels via cluster-level similarity and fine-grained ranking. Extensive experiments on the LaMP benchmark demonstrate that jointly leveraging the target user’s profile and profiles from top similar users consistently yields the best performance across diverse tasks. Further analysis shows that ClusterRAG integrates seamlessly with different dense retrievers and rankers, and remains effective when paired with both fine-tuned and zero-shot language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 个性化检索增强生成（RAG）技术依赖于准确选择与用户相关的文档。在实际应用中，现有的RAG方法往往存在检索成本过高的问题，同时也没有考虑到来自相似用户的协同信息能够对当前用户的个性化生成起到提升作用。我们提出了一种基于簇的协同过滤算法——ClusterRAG，该算法通过用户的个人资料文档来表征用户，利用基于密度的聚类方法将用户划分为语义上连贯的簇，并在簇级和文档级进行检索，通过簇级相似性和细粒度排序来实现检索功能。在LaMP基准测试上的广泛实验表明，结合目标用户的个人资料和与其最相似的用户的资料，能够始终在多种任务中取得最佳性能。进一步分析显示，ClusterRAG能够与其他密集检索器和排序器无缝集成，并且无论与经过微调的语言模型还是零样本语言模型结合使用，都能保持高效性能。

papers.title: Toward Robust In-Context Learning: Leveraging Out-of-distribution Proxies for Target Inaccessible Demonstration Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 迈向稳健的上下文学习：利用非分布范围内的代理模型来检索目标无法访问的样本
papers.authors: Hao Xu, Rite Bo, Fausto Giunchiglia, Yingji Li, Rui Song
papers.abstract: Although studies have demonstrated that Large Language Models (LLMs) can perform well on Out-of-Distribution (OOD) tasks, their advantage tends to diminish as the distribution shift becomes more severe. Consequently, researchers aim to retrieve distributionally similar and informative demonstrations from the available source domain to boost the inference capabilities of LLMs. However, in practical scenarios where the target domain is inaccessible, evaluating the unknown distribution is challenging, which indirectly impacts the quality of the selected demonstrations. To address this problem, we propose DOPA, a demonstration search framework that incorporates an OOD proxy to approximate the inaccessible target domain and guide the retrieval process. Building on proxy-based evaluation, DOPA further introduces a Mahalanobis distance-based global diversity constraint to ensure sufficient diversity among the retrieved demonstrations. Experimental results on multiple LLMs and tasks demonstrate that DOPA effectively enhances robustness in OOD settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管研究表明，大语言模型在超出分布范围的任务上表现良好，但随着分布偏移的加剧，它们的优势会逐渐减弱。因此，研究人员试图从现有的源域中检索出分布相似且具有信息价值的样本，以提升语言模型的推理能力。然而，在实际场景中，如果目标域无法获取，评估未知的分布就变得非常困难，这间接影响了所选样本的质量。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了DOPA这一样本检索框架。该框架引入了一种“OOD代理”，用于近似模拟无法访问的目标域，并指导样本检索过程。除了基于代理的评估方法外，DOPA还引入了基于马氏距离的全局多样性约束，以确保检索出的样本具有足够的多样性。在多个语言模型和任务上的实验结果表明，DOPA能够有效提升模型在超出分布范围场景下的鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AutoSchemaKG: Autonomous Knowledge Graph Construction through Dynamic Schema Induction from Web-Scale Corpora
papers.title_zh: AutoSchemaKG：通过从大规模语料库中提取动态模式来构建自主知识图谱
papers.authors: Jiaxin Bai, Wei Fan, Qi Hu, Qing Zong, Chunyang Li, Hong Ting Tsang, Hongyu Luo, Yauwai Yim, Haoyu Huang, Xiao Zhou, Feng Qin, Tianshi Zheng, Xi Peng, Xin Yao, Huiwen Yang, Leijie Wu, JI Yi, Gong Zhang, Renhai Chen, Yangqiu Song
papers.abstract: We present AutoSchemaKG, a framework for fully autonomous knowledge graph construction that eliminates the need for predefined schemas. Our system leverages large language models to simultaneously extract knowledge triples and induce comprehensive schemas directly from text, modeling both entities and events while employing conceptualization to organize instances into semantic categories. Processing over 50 million documents, we construct ATLAS (Automated Triple Linking And Schema induction), a family of knowledge graphs with 900+ million nodes and 5.9 billion edges. This approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on multi-hop QA tasks and enhances LLM factuality. Notably, our schema induction achieves 92% semantic alignment with human-crafted schemas with zero manual intervention, demonstrating that billion-scale knowledge graphs with dynamically induced schemas can effectively complement parametric knowledge in large language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了AutoSchemaKG框架，这是一种完全自主的知识图谱构建方法，无需使用预定义的模式。我们的系统利用大语言模型，直接从文本中提取知识三元组并生成全面的结构化模式，同时能够建模实体和事件。通过处理超过5000万份文档，我们构建了ATLAS（自动化三元链接与模式诱导）系列知识图谱，该图谱包含9亿多个节点和59亿条边。这种方法在多跳问答任务上的表现优于现有的最佳基线方法，并提升了大语言模型的真实性水平。值得注意的是，我们的模式诱导技术能够在没有任何人工干预的情况下，实现92%的语义一致性，这与人类设计的模式高度匹配。这表明，具有动态生成的模式的千亿级知识图谱可以有效地补充大语言模型中的参数化知识。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Aligned Multi-View Scripts for Universal Chart-to-Code Generation
papers.title_zh: 适用于通用图表与代码转换的同步多视图脚本
papers.authors: Zhihan Zhang, Lizi Liao
papers.abstract: Chart-to-code generation converts a chart image into an executable plotting script, enabling faithful reproduction and editable visualizations. Existing methods are largely Python-centric, limiting practical use and overlooking a critical source of supervision: the same chart can be expressed by semantically equivalent scripts in different plotting languages. To fill this gap, we introduce Chart2NCode, a dataset of 176K charts paired with aligned scripts in Python, R, and LaTeX that render visually equivalent outputs, constructed via a metadata-to-template pipeline with rendering verification and human quality checks. Building on a LLaVA-style architecture, we further propose CharLuMA, a parameter-efficient adaptation module that augments the multimodal projector with a language-conditioned mixture of low-rank subspaces, allowing the model to share core chart understanding while specializing code generation to the target language through lightweight routing. Extensive experiments show consistent gains in executability and visual fidelity across all languages, outperforming strong open-source baselines and remaining competitive with proprietary systems. Further analyses reveal that balanced multi-language supervision benefits all languages and that the adapter allocates a compact shared core plus language-specific capacity.
papers.abstract_zh: 图表到代码生成功能能够将图表图像转换为可执行的绘图脚本，从而实现精确的复现和可编辑的可视化效果。目前的方法大多以Python为中心，这限制了其实际应用范围，同时也没有考虑到一个关键的问题：同一张图表可以用不同绘图语言的语义等效脚本来表示。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了Chart2NCode数据集，其中包含17.6万张图表的对应Python、R和LaTeX代码，这些代码能够生成视觉上等效的输出结果。这些代码是通过元数据到模板的转换流程构建而成的，并且还包含了渲染验证和人工质量检查环节。基于LLaVA风格的架构，我们还提出了CharLuMA模块——这是一个参数效率高的自适应模块，它通过在多模态投影器中加入语言特定的低秩子空间混合方式，使得模型能够在保持核心图表理解能力的同时，根据目标语言的特点来专门化代码生成过程。大量实验表明，该模型在所有语言中的执行效率和视觉保真度都有显著提升，其性能优于许多强大的开源基线模型，同时也与专有系统保持竞争力。进一步分析显示，平衡的多语言监督机制对多种语言都有益处，而该适配器能够分配出一个紧凑的共享核心部分，同时又能为每种语言提供特定于该语言的能力。

papers.title: SpeakerSleuth: Can Large Audio-Language Models Judge Speaker Consistency across Multi-turn Dialogues?
papers.title_zh: SpeakerSleuth：大型音频语言模型能否判断多轮对话中说话者的一致性？
papers.authors: Jonggeun Lee, Junseong Pyo, Gyuhyeon Seo, Yohan Jo
papers.abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) as judges have emerged as a prominent approach for evaluating speech generation quality, yet their ability to assess speaker consistency across multi-turn dialogues remains unexplored. We present SpeakerSleuth, a benchmark evaluating whether LALMs can reliably judge speaker consistency across multi-turn dialogues through three tasks reflecting real-world requirements. We construct 1,818 human-verified evaluation instances across four diverse datasets spanning synthetic and real speech, with controlled acoustic difficulty. Evaluating twelve widely-used LALMs, we find that models struggle to reliably detect acoustic inconsistencies. For instance, given audio samples of the same speaker’s turns, some models overpredict inconsistency, whereas others are overly lenient. Models further struggle to identify the exact turns that are problematic. When other interlocutors’ turns are provided as textual context, performance degrades dramatically as models prioritize textual coherence over acoustic cues, failing to detect even obvious gender switches for a speaker. On the other hand, models perform substantially better in comparing and ranking acoustic variants, demonstrating inherent acoustic discrimination capabilities. These findings expose a significant bias in LALMs: they tend to prioritize text over acoustics, revealing fundamental modality imbalances that need to be addressed to build reliable audio-language judges. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/holi-lab/SpeakerSleuth.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型音频语言模型作为评估语音生成质量的工具，已经取得了显著的成果。然而，它们在评估多轮对话中说话者一致性方面的能力仍然有待探索。我们提出了SpeakerSleuth这一基准测试，旨在评估大型音频语言模型是否能够可靠地判断多轮对话中的说话者一致性。该测试通过三项任务来反映现实需求。我们在四个不同的数据集上构建了1,818个经过人工验证的评估案例，这些数据集涵盖了合成语音和真实语音，并且声学难度得到了控制。我们对十二个常用的大型音频语言模型进行了评估，发现这些模型在检测声学不一致性方面存在困难。例如，对于同一说话者发出的音频样本，有些模型会过度预测不一致性，而另一些模型则过于宽松。此外，模型在识别具体的问题句子方面也表现不佳。当其他对话者的发言内容作为文本背景信息时，模型的性能会显著下降，因为它们更重视文本的连贯性而非声学特征，甚至无法识别出明显的性别转换。另一方面，模型在比较和排序不同声学变体方面表现得更好，这表明它们具有内在的声学辨别能力。这些发现揭示了大型音频语言模型存在的重大缺陷：它们倾向于优先考虑文本而非声学特征，这反映出需要解决的根本性模态不平衡问题，才能构建出可靠的音频语言评估工具。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/holi-lab/SpeakerSleuth下载。

papers.title: Breaking Block Boundaries: Anchor-based History-stable Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 突破界限：基于锚点的历史稳定解码技术在扩散大型语言模型中的应用
papers.authors: Shun Zou, Yong Wang, Zehui Chen, Lin Chen, Chongyang Tao, Feng Zhao, Xiangxiang Chu
papers.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have recently become a promising alternative to autoregressive large language models (ARMs). Semi-autoregressive (Semi-AR) decoding is widely employed in base dLLMs and advanced decoding strategies due to its superior performance. However, our observations reveal that Semi-AR decoding suffers from inherent block constraints, which cause the decoding of many cross-block stable tokens to be unnecessarily delayed. To address this challenge, we systematically investigate the identification of stable tokens and present three key findings: (1) naive lookahead decoding is unreliable, (2) token stability closely correlates with convergence trend, and (3) historical information is isolated. Building on these insights, we propose Anchor-based History-stable Decoding (AHD), a training-free, plug-and-play dynamic decoding strategy. Specifically, AHD monitors the stability trend of tokens in real time through dynamic anchors. Once a token reaches stability, it initiates early cross-block decoding to enhance efficiency and performance. Extensive experiments across language, vision-language, and audio-language domains demonstrate that AHD simultaneously improves both performance and inference efficiency. Notably, AHD effectively reverses the performance degradation typically observed in existing advanced decoding acceleration strategies. For instance, on the BBH benchmark, our approach reduces decoding steps by 80% while improving performance by 3.67%.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型（dLLMs）最近已成为替代自回归式大语言模型（ARMs）的一种有前景的选择。由于其出色的性能，半自回归解码技术在基础dLLMs及高级解码策略中被广泛采用。然而，我们的观察表明，半自回归解码存在固有的块级约束问题，这导致许多跨块稳定的标记的解码过程被不必要地延迟。为了应对这一挑战，我们系统地研究了稳定标记的识别方法，并得出了三个关键发现：（1）简单的前瞻解码是不可靠的；（2）标记的稳定性与收敛趋势密切相关；（3）历史信息被孤立了。基于这些发现，我们提出了基于锚点的历史稳定解码技术，这是一种无需训练、即插即用的动态解码策略。具体来说，AHD通过动态锚点实时监测标记的稳定性趋势。一旦某个标记达到稳定状态，就会提前进行跨块解码，以提高效率和性能。在语言、语篇-语言和音频-语言领域进行的广泛实验表明，AHD同时提升了性能和推理效率。值得注意的是，AHD有效逆转了现有高级解码加速策略中常见的性能下降现象。例如，在BBH基准测试上，我们的方法将解码步骤减少了80%，同时提升了3.67%的性能。

papers.title: HiSVD: Principled Low-Rank Approximation of LLMs via Hierarchical Modeling of Information Capacity and Spectral Structure
papers.title_zh: HiSVD：通过分层建模信息容量和频谱结构来实现对大语言模型的低秩近似方法
papers.authors: Zhuo Chen, Minghao Li, Xiaoqian Ma, Siqi Fan, Xiusheng Huang, Zhang Liujie, Weihang Chen
papers.abstract: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) enables hardware-agnostic LLM compression via low-rank approximation, yet optimal rank allocation remains a bottleneck. Existing methods predominantly derive layer importance from performance-oriented proxies. Yet, these metrics fail to distinguish between representational importance and structural compressibility, consequently obscuring the fine-grained influence of spectral distribution shape. We demonstrate this disconnect through spectral analysis, revealing that layers with similar information capacity can exhibit markedly different singular value decay behaviors, corresponding to varying degrees of redundancy in the spectral tail. This imperfect coupling implies that allocation strategies driven solely by importance leave significant compression opportunities underexploited. To address this gap, we propose HiSVD, a hierarchical rank allocation framework with two stages: (1) Capacity-Anchored Baseline Allocation, which preserves representational stability by aligning rank budgets with information capacity; and (2) Redundancy-Aware Refinement, which modulates this baseline using tail redundancy to penalize structural excess. Experiments on LLMs demonstrate that HiSVD achieves superior compression efficiency, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by effectively exploiting this spectral heterogeneity.
papers.abstract_zh: 奇异值分解（SVD）能够通过低秩近似实现与硬件无关的LLM压缩，但最优的秩分配仍然是一个瓶颈问题。现有的方法主要从性能导向的指标来推断层的重要性。然而，这些指标无法区分表示性重要性和结构可压缩性，因此无法准确反映谱分布形状的细微影响。我们通过谱分析证明了这种差异，发现具有相似信息容量的层可能会表现出截然不同的奇异值衰减行为，这对应于谱尾部不同程度的冗余。这种不完美的耦合意味着，仅基于重要性的分配策略会浪费大量压缩机会。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了HiSVD框架，它是一个分阶段的秩分配方案：(1) 容量导向的基线分配，通过使秩预算与信息容量相匹配来保持表示的稳定性；(2) 冗余感知的优化，利用尾部冗余来调整基线分配，以惩罚结构上的过度压缩。在LLM上的实验表明，HiSVD实现了更高的压缩效率，其性能显著优于现有的最先进基线方法，有效地利用了这种谱的异质性。

papers.title: Unveiling the Unknown: Open-Set Entity Typing via Two-Stage Generation
papers.title_zh: 揭示未知之谜：通过两阶段生成方法实现开放集实体输入
papers.authors: Hu Chen, Binhan Yang, Wei Shen
papers.abstract: Conventional fine-grained entity typing (FET) operates under the closed-set assumption, wherein all classified types are limited within a predefined type taxonomy derived from a knowledge base. As the world evolves, new entities of unknown types inevitably emerge in open environments, falling beyond the scope of the existing type taxonomy. To deal with this problem, in this paper, we investigate a novel and critical task: open-set entity typing (OSET), which aims to not only classify entity mentions within the known type taxonomy but also detect those outside it, termed as unknown-type instances. However, owing to the lack of exposure to unknown-type instances during training, existing FET models are susceptible to misclassify them as known types, limiting their practical effectiveness for this new OSET task. Moreover, manually collecting and annotating large-scale unknown-type instances is both time-consuming and labor-intensive in open environments. To mitigate this issue, we propose a two-stage generation model that automatically produces large-scale, high-quality and diverse pseudo unknown-type instances, beneficial for the tailor-designed unified open-set classifier to effectively distinguish between known and unknown types. Furthermore, an innovative unknown-aware hierarchical contrastive learning strategy is designed to facilitate a clear delineation between closely related known types and unknown types. Extensive experiments on two newly established benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed framework significantly surpasses all baselines in addressing the OSET task.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的细粒度实体分类方法（FET）基于封闭集假设进行工作，即所有分类的实体都限定在从知识库衍生出的预定义类型分类体系中。然而，随着世界的不断发展，新的、类型未知的实体不可避免地出现在开放环境中，这些实体超出了现有类型分类体系的范围。为了应对这一问题，本文提出了一种新颖且重要的任务：开放集实体分类（OSET）。该任务不仅旨在将已知类型的实体进行分类，还要识别出那些不属于已知类型的实体，即未知类型实例。不过，由于训练过程中缺乏对未知类型实例的接触，现有的FET模型容易将它们误分类为已知类型，这限制了它们在OSET任务中的实际效果。此外，在开放环境中手动收集并标注大规模未知类型实例既耗时又费力。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种两阶段生成模型，该模型能够自动生成大规模、高质量且多样化的伪未知类型实例，有助于量身定制的统一开放集分类器有效区分已知类型和未知类型。此外，我们还设计了一种创新的、考虑未知类型的分层对比学习策略，以便清晰地区分密切相关的已知类型和未知类型。在两个新建立的基准数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，我们提出的框架在解决OSET任务方面显著优于所有基线方法。

papers.title: Don’t Adapt Small Language Models for Tools; Adapt Tool Schemas to the Models
papers.title_zh: 不要将小型语言模型适配到工具中；而是应该根据模型来调整工具的结构设计
papers.authors: Jonggeun Lee, Woojung Song, Jongwook Han, Haesung Pyun, Yohan Jo
papers.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) enable scalable tool-augmented multi-agent systems where multiple SLMs handle subtasks orchestrated by a powerful coordinator. However, they struggle with tool-use tasks, particularly in selecting appropriate tools and identifying correct parameters. A common failure mode is schema misalignment: models hallucinate plausible tool names that are absent from the provided tool schema, due to different naming conventions internalized during pretraining. Rather than training models to adapt to unfamiliar schemas, we propose adapting schemas to align with models’ pretrained knowledge. We introduce PA-Tool (Pretraining-Aligned Tool Schema Generation), a training-free method that leverages peakedness, a signal used in contamination detection that indicates pretraining familiarity, to rename tool components. By generating multiple candidates and selecting the candidate with the highest peakedness, PA-Tool identifies pretraining-aligned naming patterns. Experiments on MetaTool and RoTBench show improvements of up to 17%, with schema misalignment errors reduced by 80%. PA-Tool enables small models to substantially improve tool-use accuracy without retraining, showing that schema-level interventions can unlock the tool-use potential of resource-efficient models. Our code is available at https://github.com/holi-lab/PA-Tool.
papers.abstract_zh: 小型语言模型能够构建可扩展的工具辅助多智能体系统，多个小型语言模型负责处理由强大协调器调度下的子任务。然而，它们在工具使用任务上存在困难，尤其是在选择合适工具和确定正确参数方面。常见的失败原因是模式不匹配：由于预训练过程中形成的不同命名规范，模型会生成一些在提供的工具模式中不存在的看似合理的工具名称。与其训练模型去适应陌生的模式，我们建议调整模式以与模型的预训练知识保持一致。我们提出了PA-Tool这一无需训练的方法，该方法利用“峰值度”这一信号来重新命名工具组件。通过生成多个候选名称，并选择峰值度最高的那个，PA-Tool能够识别出与模型预训练知识一致的命名模式。在MetaTool和RoTBench上的实验表明，该方法可将工具使用准确率提高达17%，同时减少80%的模式不匹配错误。PA-Tool使得小型模型能够在无需重新训练的情况下显著提高工具使用的准确性，这表明在模式层面进行干预可以释放资源高效模型的工具使用潜力。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/holi-lab/PA-Tool下载。

papers.title: Language Reconstruction with Brain Predictive Coding from fMRI Data
papers.title_zh: 利用功能性磁共振成像数据通过大脑预测编码技术进行语言重建
papers.authors: Congchi Yin, Ziyi Ye, Piji Li
papers.abstract: Many recent studies have shown that the perception of speech can be decoded from brain signals and subsequently reconstructed as continuous language. However, there is a lack of neurological basis for how the semantic information embedded within brain signals can be used more effectively to guide language reconstruction. Predictive coding theory suggests the human brain naturally engages in continuously predicting future words that span multiple timescales. This implies that the decoding of brain signals could potentially be associated with a predictable future. To explore the predictive coding theory within the context of language reconstruction, this paper proposes PredFT (FMRI-to-Text decoding with Predictive coding). PredFT consists of a main network and a side network. The side network obtains brain predictive representation from related regions of interest (ROIs) with a self-attention module. The representation is then fused into the main network for continuous language decoding. Experiments on two naturalistic language comprehension fMRI datasets show that PredFT outperforms current decoding models on several evaluation metrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多近期的研究表明，语音的感知可以从脑信号中解码出来，并随后被重构为连续的语言。然而，关于如何将嵌入在脑信号中的语义信息更有效地用于指导语言重构，目前还没有明确的神经学依据。预测编码理论指出，人类大脑会自然地持续预测未来出现的词汇，这一过程涉及多个时间尺度。这意味着，脑信号的解码可能与未来的可预测性有关。为了将预测编码理论应用于语言重构领域，本文提出了PredFT（利用预测编码进行脑信号到文本解码）。PredFT由主网络和辅助网络组成，辅助网络通过自注意力模块从相关区域获取脑信号预测表示，然后将该表示融合到主网络中以实现连续的语言解码。在两个自然语言理解功能磁共振成像数据集上的实验表明，PredFT在多个评估指标上均优于现有的解码模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Chaining the Evidence: Robust Reinforcement Learning for Deep Search Agents with Citation-Aware Rubric Rewards
papers.title_zh: 关联证据：适用于深度搜索智能体的强大强化学习方法——基于引用意识的奖励机制
papers.authors: Jiajie Zhang, Xin Lv, Ling Feng, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical technique for enhancing LLM-based deep search agents. However, existing approaches primarily rely on binary outcome rewards, which fail to capture the comprehensiveness and factuality of agents’ reasoning process, and often lead to undesirable behaviors such as shortcut exploitation and hallucinations. To address these limitations, we propose Citation-aware Rubric Rewards (CaRR), a fine-grained reward framework for deep search agents that emphasizes reasoning comprehensiveness, factual grounding, and evidence connectivity. CaRR decomposes complex questions into verifiable single-hop rubrics and requires agents to satisfy these rubrics by explicitly identifying hidden entities, supporting them with correct citations, and constructing complete evidence chains that link to the predicted answer. We further introduce Citation-aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (C-GRPO), which combines CaRR and outcome rewards for training robust deep search agents. Experiments show that C-GRPO consistently outperforms standard outcome-based RL baselines across multiple deep search benchmarks. Our analysis also validates that C-GRPO effectively discourages shortcut exploitation, promotes comprehensive, evidence-grounded reasoning, and exhibits strong generalization to open-ended deep research tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为提升基于大语言模型的深度搜索智能体的关键技术。然而，现有的方法主要依赖于二元结果奖励机制，这无法充分反映智能体推理过程的全面性和事实性，常常导致诸如捷径利用和幻觉等不良行为。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了“引用意识评分奖励”机制——这是一种针对深度搜索智能体的细粒度奖励框架，它强调推理的全面性、事实依据以及证据之间的关联性。该奖励机制将复杂问题分解为可验证的单跳评分项，并要求智能体通过明确识别隐藏实体、提供正确的引用信息，并构建完整的证据链来连接预测答案来实现这些评分项。此外，我们还提出了“引用意识群体相对策略优化”方法，它将“引用意识评分奖励”机制与结果奖励相结合，用于训练强大的深度搜索智能体。实验表明，“引用意识群体相对策略优化”在多个深度搜索基准测试中始终优于传统的基于结果的强化学习算法。我们的分析还验证了，“引用意识群体相对策略优化”能够有效抑制捷径利用行为，促进全面且基于证据的推理过程，并在处理开放式深度研究任务时表现出强大的泛化能力。

papers.title: Think Natively: Unlocking Multilingual Reasoning with Consistency-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 原生思考：通过增强一致性的强化学习实现多语言推理能力的提升
papers.authors: Xue Zhang, Yunlong Liang, Fandong Meng, Songming Zhang, Kaiyu Huang, Yufeng Chen, Xu Jinan, Jie Zhou
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable performance on complex reasoning tasks by adopting the “think-then-answer” paradigm, which enhances both accuracy and interpretability. However, current LRMs exhibit two critical limitations when processing non-English languages: (1) They often struggle to maintain input-output language consistency; (2) They generally perform poorly with wrong reasoning paths and lower answer accuracy compared to English. These limitations significantly compromise the interpretability of reasoning processes and degrade the user experience for non-English speakers, hindering the global deployment of LRMs. To address these limitations, we propose M-Thinker, which is trained by the GRPO algorithm that involves a Language Consistency (LC) reward and a novel Cross-lingual Thinking Alignment (CTA) reward. Specifically, the LC reward defines a strict constraint on the language consistency between the input, thought, and answer. Besides, the CTA reward compares the model’s non-English reasoning paths with its English reasoning path to transfer its own reasoning capability from English to non-English languages. Through an iterative RL procedure, our M-Thinker-1.5B/4B/7B models not only achieve nearly 100% language consistency and superior performance on two multilingual benchmarks (MMATH and PolyMath), but also exhibit excellent generalization on out-of-domain languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在复杂推理任务中取得了显著的性能表现，这得益于其采用的“思考-回答”模式，该模式提升了模型的准确性和可解释性。然而，当前的大型推理模型在处理非英语语言时存在两个关键限制：第一，它们往往难以保持输入与输出语言的一致性；第二，当推理路径出现错误时，它们的表现通常会下降，且答案的准确性也会低于英语环境。这些限制严重影响了推理过程的可解释性，同时降低了非英语使用者的使用体验，从而阻碍了大型推理模型在全球范围内的应用。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了M-Thinker模型。该模型通过GRPO算法进行训练，该算法包含语言一致性奖励和一种新颖的跨语言思维对齐奖励机制。具体来说，语言一致性奖励对输入、思考和答案之间的语言一致性提出了严格的要求。此外，跨语言思维对齐奖励通过将模型的非英语推理路径与其英语推理路径进行比较，从而将模型从英语到非英语语言的推理能力进行转移。通过迭代的强化学习过程，我们的M-Thinker-1.5B/4B/7B模型不仅实现了接近100%的语言一致性，并在两个多语言基准测试（MMATH和PolyMath）中表现出卓越的性能，同时还展现了出色的跨语言泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Mem^2Evolve: Towards Self-Evolving Agents via Co-Evolutionary Capability Expansion and Experience Distillation
papers.title_zh: Mem^2Evolve：通过协同进化能力的扩展与经验提取来实现自进化智能体的发展
papers.authors: Zihao Cheng, Zeming Liu, Yingyu Shan, Xinyi Wang, Xiangrong Zhu, Yunpu Ma, Hongru Wang, Yuhang Guo, Wei Lin, Yunhong Wang
papers.abstract: While large language model–powered agents can self-evolve by accumulating experience or by dynamically creating new assets (i.e., tools or expert agents), existing frameworks typically treat these two evolutionary processes in isolation. This separation overlooks their intrinsic interdependence: the former is inherently bounded by a manually predefined static toolset, while the latter generates new assets from scratch without experiential guidance, leading to limited capability growth and unstable evolution. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel paradigm of co-evolutionary Capability Expansion and Experience Distillation. Guided by this paradigm, we propose the Mem^{\textbf{2}}Evolve, which integrates two core components: Experience Memory and Asset Memory. Specifically, Mem^{2}Evolve leverages accumulated experience to guide the dynamic creation of assets, thereby expanding the agent’s capability space while simultaneously acquiring new experience to achieve co-evolution. Extensive experiments across 6 task categories and 8 benchmarks demonstrate that Mem^{2}Evolve achieves improvement of 18.53% over standard LLMs, 11.80% over agents evolving solely through experience, and 6.46% over those evolving solely through asset creation, establishing it as a substantially more effective and stable self-evolving agent framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然由大语言模型驱动的智能体可以通过积累经验或动态创建新资产（即工具或专家智能体）来实现自我进化，但现有的框架通常将这两种进化过程分开处理。这种分离忽略了它们之间的内在相互依赖性：前者受到手动预定义的静态工具集的限制，而后者则在没有经验指导的情况下从头开始生成新资产，从而导致能力增长有限且进化不稳定。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种新颖的协同进化能力扩展与经验提取范式。基于这一范式，我们提出了Mem^{2}Evolve算法，该算法整合了两个核心组件：经验记忆和资产记忆。具体来说，Mem^{2}Evolve利用积累的经验来指导资产的动态创建，从而扩大智能体的能力范围，同时获取新的经验以实现协同进化。在6个任务类别和8个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，Mem^{2}Evolve相比标准语言模型提升了18.53%的能力，比仅通过经验进化的智能体提升了11.80%，比仅通过资产创建进化的智能体提升了6.46%。这表明它是一种更为有效且稳定的自进化智能体框架。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VideoCuRL: Video Curriculum Reinforcement Learning with Orthogonal Difficulty Decomposition
papers.title_zh: 视频课程名称：基于正交难度分解的视频强化学习课程
papers.authors: Hongbo Jin, Kuanwei Lin, Wenhao Zhang, Yichen Jin, Ge Li
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is crucial for empowering Video-LLMs with complex spatiotemporal reasoning. However, current RL paradigms predominantly rely on random data shuffling or naive curriculum strategies based on scalar difficulty metrics. We argue that scalar metrics fail to disentangle two orthogonal challenges in video understanding: Visual-Temporal Perception Load and Cognitive Reasoning Depth. To address this, we propose VideoCuRL, a novel framework that decomposes difficulty into these two axes. We employ efficient, training-free proxies—optical flow/keyframe entropy for visual complexity and Calibrated Surprisal for cognitive complexity—to map data onto a 2D curriculum grid. A competence-aware Diagonal Wavefront strategy then schedules training from base alignment to complex reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce Dynamic Sparse KL and Structured Revisiting to stabilize training against reward collapse and catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments show that VideoCuRL surpasses strong RL baselines on reasoning (+2.5% on VSI-Bench) and perception (+2.9% on VideoMME) tasks. Notably, VideoCuRL eliminates the prohibitive inference overhead of generation-based curricula, offering a scalable solution for robust video post-training.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在赋予视频语言模型复杂的时空推理能力方面起着至关重要的作用。然而，目前的强化学习范式主要依赖于随机数据打乱或基于标量难度指标的简单训练策略。我们认为，标量指标无法区分视频理解中的两个相互正交的挑战：视觉-时间感知负担和认知推理深度。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了VideoCuRL这一新型框架，它将难度分解为这两个维度。我们采用了两种高效且无需训练的代理方法——用于视觉复杂度的光流/关键帧熵值，以及用于认知复杂度的校准惊喜法——来将数据映射到二维训练网格上。随后，我们采用一种考虑能力水平的对角波前策略，来安排从基础训练到复杂推理的训练过程。此外，我们还引入了动态稀疏KL估计和结构化重访机制，以稳定训练过程，避免奖励崩溃和灾难性遗忘现象。大量实验表明，VideoCuRL在推理任务上超越了强大的强化学习基线算法（在VSI-Bench上的提升率为+2.5%），在感知任务上的提升率为+2.9%（在VideoMME上的结果）。值得注意的是，VideoCuRL消除了基于生成的训练方案所带来的巨大推理开销问题，为视频模型提供了可扩展的后期训练解决方案。

papers.title: Visual Inception: Compromising Long-term Planning in Agentic Recommenders via Multimodal Memory Poisoning
papers.title_zh: 视觉联想：通过多模态记忆干扰来破坏智能推荐系统中的长期规划机制
papers.authors: Jiachen Qian
papers.abstract: The evolution from static ranking models to Agentic Recommender Systems (Agentic RecSys) empowers AI agents to maintain long-term user profiles and autonomously plan service tasks. While this paradigm shift enhances personalization, it introduces a vulnerability: reliance on Long-term Memory (LTM). In this paper, we uncover a threat termed “Visual Inception.” Unlike traditional adversarial attacks that seek immediate misclassification, Visual Inception injects triggers into user-uploaded images (e.g., lifestyle photos) that act as “sleeper agents” within the system’s memory. When retrieved during future planning, these poisoned memories hijack the agent’s reasoning chain, steering it toward adversary-defined goals (e.g., promoting high-margin products) without prompt injection. To mitigate this, we propose CognitiveGuard, a dual-process defense framework inspired by human cognition. It consists of a System 1 Perceptual Sanitizer (diffusion-based purification) to cleanse sensory inputs and a System 2 Reasoning Verifier (counterfactual consistency checks) to detect anomalies in memory-driven planning. Extensive experiments on a mock e-commerce agent environment demonstrate that Visual Inception achieves about 85% Goal-Hit Rate (GHR), while CognitiveGuard reduces this risk to around 10% with configurable latency trade-offs (about 1.5s in lite mode to about 6.5s for full sequential verification), without quality degradation under our setup.Latency reporting uses separate accounting: query-time overhead excludes one-time upload-time preprocessing.
papers.abstract_zh: 从静态排名模型向智能推荐系统的演变，使得人工智能代理能够维护长期用户档案，并自主规划服务任务。虽然这种范式转变提升了个性化体验，但也带来了一种风险：对长期记忆的依赖。在本文中，我们揭示了一种名为“视觉侵入”的威胁。与那些试图立即进行错误分类的传统攻击不同，视觉侵入会在用户上传的图像中注入触发因素（例如生活照），这些触发因素作为系统记忆中的“潜伏代理”。当在未来的规划过程中被检索到时，这些被植入的“毒害记忆”会劫持代理的推理流程，使其朝着攻击者设定的目标前进（例如推广高利润产品），而无需通过即时注入的方式实现。为了缓解这一风险，我们提出了CognitiveGuard——一个受人类认知启发的双过程防御框架。该框架包括一个系统1感知净化器（基于扩散的净化机制），用于清理感官输入；以及一个系统2推理验证器（反事实一致性检查），用于检测由记忆驱动的规划中的异常现象。在模拟电子商务代理环境进行的广泛实验表明，视觉侵入的命中率约为85%，而CognitiveGuard将这一风险降低到约10%，同时允许进行可配置的延迟调整（轻量级模式下约为1.5秒，全序贯验证模式下约为6.5秒），且不会降低系统的性能。延迟报告采用单独的核算方式：查询时间开销不包括一次性上传时间的预处理时间。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Language on Demand, Knowledge at Core: Composing LLMs with Encoder-Decoder Translation Models for Extensible Multilinguality
papers.title_zh: 按需语言处理，核心知识体系：利用编码器-解码器翻译模型构建能支持多种语言交互的大型语言模型
papers.authors: Mengyu Bu, Yang Feng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general intelligence, yet their multilingual performance remains highly imbalanced. Although LLMs encode substantial cross-lingual knowledge in a unified semantic space, they often struggle to reliably interface this knowledge with low-resource or unseen languages. Fortunately, pretrained encoder-decoder translation models already possess balanced multilingual capacity, suggesting a natural complement to LLMs. In this work, we propose XBridge, a compositional encoder-LLM-decoder architecture that offloads multilingual understanding and generation to external pretrained translation models, while preserving the LLM as an English-centric core for general knowledge processing and reasoning. To address the resulting representation misalignment across models, we introduce lightweight cross-model mapping layers together with an optimal transport-based alignment objective, enabling fine-grained semantic consistency for multilingual generation. Experiments on four LLMs across multilingual understanding, reasoning, and generation indicate that XBridge outperforms strong baselines, especially on low-resource and previously unseen languages, without retraining the LLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）展现出强大的通用智能，然而它们在处理多语言任务时的表现仍然非常不平衡。尽管LLMs能够在统一的语义空间中编码大量的跨语言知识，但它们在将这种知识与资源匮乏或未曾接触过的语言进行交互时常常遇到困难。幸运的是，预训练的编码器-解码器翻译模型已经具备了平衡的多语言处理能力，这为LLMs提供了天然的补充。在这项研究中，我们提出了XBridge这一组合式编码器-语言模型-解码器架构，它将多语言理解和生成的任务交由外部预训练的翻译模型来完成，同时保留语言模型作为以英语为中心的核心组件，用于通用知识的处理和推理。为了解决不同模型之间的表示不一致问题，我们引入了轻量级的跨模型映射层，并采用了基于最优传输的对齐目标，从而实现多语言生成的精细语义一致性。在四个LLM上的实验表明，XBridge在多语言理解、推理和生成方面均优于其他强大的基线模型，尤其是在处理资源匮乏或未曾接触过的语言时，而无需重新训练语言模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GeoArena: Evaluating Open-World Geographic Reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: GeoArena：在大型视觉语言模型中评估开放世界地理推理能力
papers.authors: Pengyue Jia, Yingyi Zhang, Xiangyu Zhao, Sharon Li
papers.abstract: Geographic reasoning is a fundamental cognitive capability that requires models to infer plausible locations by synthesizing visual evidence with spatial world knowledge. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs), existing evaluation paradigms remain largely outcome-centric, relying on static datasets and predefined labels that are conceptually misaligned with open-world geographic inference. Such outcome-centric evaluations often focus exclusively on label matching, leaving the underlying linguistic reasoning chains as unexamined black boxes. In this work, we introduce GeoArena, a dynamic, human-preference-based evaluation framework for benchmarking open-world geographic reasoning. GeoArena reframes evaluation as a pairwise reasoning alignment task on in-the-wild images, where human judges compare model-generated explanations based on reasoning quality, evidence synthesis, and plausibility. We deploy GeoArena as a public platform and benchmark 17 frontier LVLMs using thousands of human judgments, which complements existing benchmarks and supports the development of geographically grounded, human-aligned AI systems. We further provide detailed analyses of model behavior, including reliability of human preferences and factors influencing judgments of geographic reasoning quality. We open-source GeoArena to foster future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 地理推理是一种基本的认知能力，它要求模型通过结合视觉证据和空间知识来推断合理的位置。尽管大型视觉-语言模型在最近取得了显著进展，但现有的评估范式仍然主要以结果为导向，依赖于静态数据集和预定义的标签，而这些标签在概念上与开放世界中的地理推理并不一致。这种以结果为导向的评估方式往往只关注标签匹配，而忽略了底层语言推理过程的细节。在这项研究中，我们提出了GeoArena这一基于人类偏好的动态评估框架，用于评估开放世界中的地理推理能力。GeoArena将评估任务重新定义为在真实场景图像上的成对推理对齐任务，人类评判者根据推理质量、证据合成以及合理性来评价模型生成的解释。我们将GeoArena作为一个公共平台，使用数千名人类评判对17个前沿的视觉-语言模型进行评估，从而补充现有的评估基准，并支持开发具有地理背景且符合人类偏好的AI系统。我们还对模型行为进行了详细分析，包括人类偏好的可靠性以及影响地理推理质量判断的因素。我们将GeoArena开源，以促进未来的研究发展。

papers.title: Fisher-Driven Adaptive Locating for Knowledge Editing in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于渔夫驱动算法的自适应定位技术，用于在大型语言模型中进行知识编辑
papers.authors: Chenghao Xu, Jiexi Yan, Guangtao Lyu, Qi Liu, Muli Yang, Cheng Deng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) store extensive factual knowledge acquired during pretraining, yet this knowledge is inherently static and may become inaccurate or outdated, leading to knowledge hallucinations. Knowledge editing offers an efficient alternative to full retraining by enabling targeted factual updates while preserving overall model behavior. Existing locate-then-edit methods, however, rely on fixed layer selection strategies, treating the locating stage as a static design choice and failing to account for the hierarchical and instance-dependent nature of knowledge representation in LLMs. In this paper, we propose FiDAL, a Fisher-driven adaptation-aware locating strategy that dynamically identifies which model components should be edited for a given knowledge update. FiDAL formulates localization as a weight-level decision problem and leverages Fisher Information to select layers that are both influential and sensitive to factual modifications. A lightweight probing stage with low-rank modulation enables efficient localization with minimal overhead. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that FiDAL consistently improves editing effectiveness and knowledge preservation across multiple editing methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在预训练过程中积累了大量的事实知识，但这些知识本质上是静态的，可能会变得不准确或过时，从而导致知识幻觉现象。知识编辑提供了一种高效的替代方案，它可以在保留模型整体行为的同时，实现有针对性的事实更新。然而，现有的定位-编辑方法依赖于固定的层选择策略，将定位阶段视为一个固定的设计选择，未能考虑到LLM中知识表示的层次性和实例依赖性。在本文中，我们提出了FiDAL算法，这是一种以Fisher信息为驱动的、注重适应性的定位策略。该算法能够动态确定在给定知识更新时需要编辑哪些模型组件。FiDAL将定位问题转化为权重层面的决策问题，并利用Fisher信息来选择那些既具有影响力又对事实修改敏感的训练层。通过采用低秩调制技术的轻量级探测阶段，可以实现高效且低开销的定位操作。在标准基准测试上的实验表明，FiDAL在多种编辑方法中都能显著提高编辑效率和知识保留效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From AR to Diffusion: Efficiently Adapting Large Language Models with Strictly Causal and Elastic Horizons
papers.title_zh: 从增强现实到扩散模型：在严格因果约束和弹性时间范围内高效适配大型语言模型
papers.authors: Xiangyu Ma, Teng Xiao, Zuchao Li, Lefei Zhang
papers.abstract: Diffusion models promise efficient parallel text generation but rely on bidirectional attention, creating a structural mismatch with pre-trained Autoregressive (AR) models. This incompatibility precludes reusing robust AR priors, necessitating prohibitive pre-training from scratch. To bridge this gap, we propose FLUID, a framework that efficiently adapts AR backbones to the diffusion paradigm. By enforcing Strictly Causal Alignment, FLUID enables seamless initialization from standard GPT-style checkpoints, circumventing the need for massive pre-training. Furthermore, we introduce Elastic Horizons, an entropy-driven mechanism that dynamically modulates denoising strides based on local information density rather than fixed schedules. Experiments demonstrate that FLUID achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing training costs by orders of magnitude, effectively reconciling established AR foundations with efficient parallel generation. Our code is available at https://huggingface.co/MYTH-Lab/FLUID.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散模型承诺实现高效的并行文本生成，但其依赖双向注意力机制，这与预训练的自动回归（AR）模型存在结构上的不匹配。这种不兼容性使得无法重用可靠的AR先验信息，因此必须从头开始进行庞大的预训练。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了FLUID框架——该框架能够高效地将AR基础模型适配到扩散生成模型中。通过实施严格的因果对齐机制，FLUID使得可以从标准的GPT风格的检查点中无缝初始化模型，从而避免了大规模预训练的需求。此外，我们还引入了弹性范围机制，这是一种基于局部信息密度动态调节去噪步长的熵驱动机制，而非依赖于固定的时间表。实验表明，FLUID在降低训练成本的同时，仍能达到最先进的性能水平，有效实现了既保留传统AR基础模型，又能实现高效并行生成的解决方案。我们的代码可以在https://huggingface.co/MYTH-Lab/FLUID获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ExPerT: Personalizing LLM Responses to Users’ Domain Expertise via Query-Wise Semantic and Keystroke Behavioral Cues
papers.title_zh: 专家：通过查询相关的语义信息以及用户打字时的行为线索，来个性化大型语言模型对用户的回答，从而考虑到用户的领域专业知识
papers.authors: Yeji Park, Jiwon Tark, Taesik Gong
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by end users, yet existing personalization methods relying on static profiles or text-only signals fail to capture query-specific expertise variation. We present ExPerT, a query-wise personalization framework that adapts LLM responses to users’ query domain expertise by combining semantic and behavioral cues. ExPerT consists of two key components: (i) a semantic–behavioral expertise inference module that jointly interprets query text and keystroke dynamics via in-context LLM prompting, and (ii) an expertise-conditioned response generation that adapts the level of detail, terminology, and conceptual complexity. Our user study with 40 participants and 1270 queries demonstrated that ExPerT reduced expertise inference error by 65.7% compared to the strongest baseline (MAE = 0.398 vs. 1.162) and improved response satisfaction by 17.52% (from 3.71 to 4.36) on a 5-point Likert scale.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）被终端用户越来越多地使用，然而现有的个性化方法依赖于静态配置文件或仅基于文本的信号，这些方法无法捕捉到与特定查询相关的专业知识差异。我们提出了ExPerT这一基于查询的个性化框架，该框架通过结合语义和行为线索，使LLM的响应能够适应用户的查询领域专业知识。ExPerT由两个关键组件构成：(i) 一个语义-行为专业知识推理模块，该模块通过上下文中的LLM提示来共同解读查询文本和按键行为；(ii) 一个基于专业知识的响应生成模块，该模块能够调整响应的详细程度、术语选择以及概念复杂性。我们的用户研究涉及40名参与者，共处理了1270个查询。结果表明，与最强的基线相比，ExPerT将专业知识推理错误减少了65.7%（MAE 分别为 0.398 和 1.162），同时响应满意度也提高了17.52%（从3.71提高到4.36），这一提升体现在5点量表上。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Measure Twice, Click Once: Co-evolving Proposer and Visual Critic via Reinforcement Learning for GUI Grounding
papers.title_zh: 先多次衡量，再一次点击：通过强化学习协同演化提案者和视觉评审员以实现GUI的精准定位
papers.authors: Wenkai Wang, Xiyun Li, Hongcan Guo, Wenhao Yu, Tianqing Fang, Haitao Mi, Dong Yu, Shengyu Zhang
papers.abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding requires mapping natural language instructions to precise pixel coordinates. However, due to visually homogeneous elements and dense layouts, models typically grasp semantic intent yet fail to achieve precise localization. While scaling sampling attempts (Pass@k) reveals potential gains, static self-consistency strategies derived from geometric clustering often yield limited improvements, as the model’s predictions tend to be spatially dispersed. In this paper, we propose replacing static consistency strategies with a learnable selection mechanism that selects the optimal target by critiquing its own proposals rendered on the screenshot. Given the significant disparity between the model’s grounding and critiquing capabilities, we propose a co-evolving Propose-and-Critic framework. To jointly optimize these, we introduce a maturity-aware adaptive co-evolutionary reinforcement learning paradigm. This approach dynamically balances the training objectives of proposer and critic, where the diversity of the proposer’s outputs enhances critic robustness, while the critic’s maturing discrimination capability conversely unlocks the proposer’s potential for extensive spatial exploration, fostering the mutual reinforcement and co-evolution of both capabilities, thereby ensuring generalizability to adapt to diverse and complex interface layouts. Extensive experiments over 6 benchmarks show that our method significantly enhances both capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 图形用户界面（GUI）的识别任务需要将自然语言指令映射至精确的像素坐标。然而，由于元素在视觉上具有一致性且布局较为密集，模型通常能够理解语义意图，但却难以实现精确的位置定位。虽然缩放采样方法（如Pass@k）能带来一定的改进效果，但基于几何聚类的静态一致性策略往往效果有限，因为模型的预测结果往往分散于不同位置。在本文中，我们提出用一种可学习的选择机制来替代静态一致性策略，该机制通过评估模型在截图上提出的建议来选出最优目标。鉴于模型在识别和评估能力之间存在显著差异，我们提出了一种协同进化的“提议与评估”框架。为了同时优化这两种能力，我们引入了一种考虑成熟度自适应协同进化的强化学习范式。这种方法能够动态平衡提议者和评估者之间的训练目标：提议者输出的多样性可以提高评估者的鲁棒性，而评估者日益成熟的判别能力则能够激发提议者在空间上的广泛探索潜力，从而实现两种能力的相互促进和协同进化。如此一来，该方法就能适应各种复杂且多样化的界面布局，具备较高的泛化能力。通过在6个基准测试中的大量实验验证，我们的方法确实显著提升了这两种能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Retrieving to Recover: Towards Incomplete Audio-Visual Question Answering via Semantic-consistent Purification
papers.title_zh: 从检索到恢复：通过语义一致的净化技术实现不完全的音频视觉问答系统
papers.authors: Jiayu Zhang, Shuo Ye, Qilang Ye, Zihan Song, Jiajian Huang, Zitong YU
papers.abstract: Recent Audio-Visual Question Answering (AVQA) methods have advanced significantly. However, most AVQA methods lack effective mechanisms for handling missing modalities, suffering from severe performance degradation in real-world scenarios with data interruptions. Furthermore, prevailing methods for handling missing modalities predominantly rely on generative imputation to synthesize missing features. While partially effective, these methods tend to capture inter-modal commonalities but struggle to acquire unique, modality-specific knowledge within the missing data, leading to hallucinations and compromised reasoning accuracy. To tackle these challenges, we propose R^{2}ScP, a novel framework that shifts the paradigm of missing modality handling from traditional generative imputation to retrieval-based recovery. Specifically, we leverage cross-modal retrieval via unified semantic embeddings to acquire missing domain-specific knowledge. To maximize semantic restoration, we introduce a context-aware adaptive purification mechanism that eliminates latent semantic noise within the retrieved data. Additionally, we employ a two-stage training strategy to explicitly model the semantic relationships between knowledge from different sources. Extensive experiments demonstrate that R^{2}ScP significantly improves AVQA and enhances robustness in modal-incomplete scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的音频视觉问答（AVQA）方法已经取得了显著进展。然而，大多数AVQA方法缺乏处理缺失模态的有效机制，在数据中断的现实场景中会出现严重的性能下降问题。此外，目前处理缺失模态的方法主要依赖于生成式插补来合成缺失的特征。虽然这些方法在一定程度上有效，但它们往往只能捕捉不同模态之间的共性，而难以获取缺失数据中的特定模态知识，从而导致推理准确性下降和幻觉现象的出现。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了R^{2}ScP这一新型框架，它将处理缺失模态的方式从传统的生成式插补转变为基于检索的恢复方式。具体来说，我们通过统一的语义嵌入技术来实现跨模态检索，从而获取缺失的领域特定知识。为了最大化语义恢复效果，我们引入了一种上下文感知的自适应净化机制，以消除检索数据中的潜在语义噪声。此外，我们还采用了两阶段训练策略，以明确建模不同来源的知识之间的语义关系。大量的实验表明，R^{2}ScP显著提升了AVQA的性能，并增强了在模态不完整场景下的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ChatHLS: Towards Systematic Design Automation and Optimization for High-Level Synthesis
papers.title_zh: ChatHLS：迈向系统化的设计自动化与优化技术，以实现高级综合功能
papers.authors: Runkai Li, Jia Xiong, Xiuyuan He, Jieru Zhao, Jiaqi Lv, Haowen Fang, Lei Qi, Xi Wang
papers.abstract: High-Level Synthesis (HLS) improves IC development productivity by enabling hardware design from C-like languages. However, strict coding constraints and design-specific optimizations limit its widespread adoption. While recent efforts employ large language models (LLMs) to assist HLS design, they often struggle with synthesizability rules and directive semantics. To this end, we introduce ChatHLS, a multi-agent HLS design framework that leverages specialized LLMs for automated debugging and directive tuning. ChatHLS incorporates an adaptive error case expansion mechanism, combined with a reasoning-to-instruction analysis method to accurately diagnose HLS errors. To optimize hardware performance, it enables QoR-aware reasoning to learn the impact of HLS directives on the quality of results (QoR). Experimental results demonstrate that ChatHLS outperforms Gemini-3-pro with a 32.6% relative improvement in debugging, while achieving significant speedups across various HLS kernels and neural network accelerators. These results underscore the potential of ChatHLS for agile hardware development.
papers.abstract_zh: 高级综合技术（HLS）通过允许使用类似C语言的工具进行硬件设计，提升了集成电路开发的效率。然而，严格的编码约束以及针对特定设计的优化措施限制了其广泛应用。虽然最近有一些研究尝试利用大语言模型来辅助HLS设计，但这些模型往往难以满足合成规则和指令语义的要求。为此，我们提出了ChatHLS这一多智能体HLS设计框架，该框架利用专门的语言模型来实现自动调试和指令调优。ChatHLS采用了自适应错误扩展机制，并结合了推理到指令的分析方法，以准确诊断HLS中的错误。为了优化硬件性能，该框架还实现了基于QoR的推理机制，从而能够了解HLS指令对结果质量的影响。实验结果表明，ChatHLS在调试效率方面优于Gemini-3-pro，相对提升了32.6%，同时还能在各种HLS内核和神经网络加速器中实现显著的性能提升。这些结果凸显了ChatHLS在敏捷硬件开发方面的巨大潜力。

papers.title: Cultural Benchmarking of LLMs in Standard and Dialectal Arabic Dialogues
papers.title_zh: 标准阿拉伯语与方言阿拉伯语对话中大型语言模型的文化基准对比
papers.authors: Muhammad Dehan Al Kautsar, Saeed Almheiri, Momina Ahsan, Bilal Elbouardi, Younes Samih, Sarfraz Ahmad, Amr Keleg, Omar El Herraoui, Kareem Elzeky, Abed Alhakim Freihat, Mohamed Anwar, Zhuohan Xie, Junhong Liang, Mohammad Rustom Al Nasar, Preslav Nakov, Fajri Koto
papers.abstract: There is a significant gap in evaluating cultural reasoning in LLMs using conversational datasets that capture culturally rich and dialectal contexts. Most Arabic benchmarks focus on short text snippets in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), overlooking the cultural nuances that naturally arise in dialogues. To address this gap, we introduce ArabCulture-Dialogue, a culturally grounded conversational dataset covering 13 Arabic-speaking countries, in both MSA and each country’s respective dialect, spanning 12 daily-life topics and 54 fine-grained subtopics. We utilize the dataset to form three benchmarking tasks: (i) multiple-choice cultural reasoning, (ii) machine translation between MSA and dialects, and (iii) dialect-steering generation. Our experiments indicate that the performance gap between MSA and Arabic dialects still exists, whereby the models perform worse on all three tasks in the dialectal setup, compared to the MSA one.
papers.abstract_zh: 在使用能够捕捉丰富文化内容和方言语境的对话数据集来评估大语言模型的文化推理能力时，存在明显的差距。大多数阿拉伯语评估基准都集中在标准阿拉伯语文本上，而忽略了对话中自然出现的文化差异。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了ArabCulture-Dialogue这个基于文化的对话数据集，该数据集涵盖了13个阿拉伯语国家，包括标准阿拉伯语和各个国家的方言，涉及12个日常生活主题以及54个细分的子主题。我们利用该数据集设计了三个评估任务：(i) 文化推理的多项选择题；(ii) 标准阿拉伯语与方言之间的机器翻译；(iii) 方言引导的生成。我们的实验表明，标准阿拉伯语与阿拉伯方言之间的性能差距仍然存在，模型在方言环境下的表现不如在标准阿拉伯语环境下的表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
papers.title_zh: ReRec：基于强化微调的推理增强型大语言模型推荐助手
papers.authors: Jiani Huang, Shijie Wang, Liang-Bo Ning, Wenqi Fan, Li Qing
papers.abstract: With the rise of LLMs, there is an increasing need for intelligent recommendation assistants that can handle complex queries and provide personalized, reasoning-driven recommendations. LLM-based recommenders show potential but face challenges in multi-step reasoning, underscoring the need for reasoning-augmented systems. To address this gap, we propose ReRec, a novel reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) framework designed to improve LLM reasoning in complex recommendation tasks. Our framework introduces three key components: (1) Dual-Graph Enhanced Reward Shaping, integrating recommendation metrics like NDCG@K with Query Alignment and Preference Alignment Scores to provide fine-grained reward signals for LLM optimization; (2) Reasoning-aware Advantage Estimation, which decomposes LLM outputs into reasoning segments and penalizes incorrect steps to enhance reasoning of recommendation; and (3) Online Curriculum Scheduler, dynamically assess query difficulty and organize training curriculum to ensure stable learning during RFT. Experiments demonstrate that ReRec outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and preserves core abilities like instruction-following and general knowledge. Our codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ReRec/.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的兴起，人们越来越需要能够处理复杂查询并提供个性化、基于推理的推荐智能推荐助手。基于大语言模型的推荐系统具有巨大潜力，但在多步骤推理方面面临挑战，这凸显了需要增强推理能力的系统的必要性。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了ReRec这一新型强化微调框架，旨在提升大语言模型在复杂推荐任务中的推理能力。我们的框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 双图增强奖励塑形技术，将NDCG@K等推荐指标与查询对齐和偏好对齐分数相结合，为大语言模型优化提供细粒度的奖励信号；(2) 考虑推理能力的优势估计方法，该方法将大语言模型的输出分解为不同的推理阶段，并对错误的推理步骤进行惩罚，从而提升推荐的推理能力；(3) 在线课程调度器，它能够动态评估查询难度并组织训练课程，确保在强化微调过程中实现稳定的学习效果。实验表明，ReRec在性能上优于现有的最佳基线算法，同时保留了遵循指令和通用知识等核心能力。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ReRec/获取。

papers.title: MoA: Heterogeneous Mixture of Adapters for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MoA：多种适配器组成的混合体，用于高效微调大型语言模型
papers.authors: Jie Cao, Tianwei Lin, Bo Yuan, Rolan Yan, Hongyang He, Wenqiao Zhang, Juncheng Li, Dongping Zhang, Siliang Tang, Yueting Zhuang
papers.abstract: Recent studies integrate Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) to further enhance the performance of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods in Large Language Model (LLM) applications. Existing methods employ homogeneous MoE-LoRA architectures composed of LoRA experts with either similar or identical structures and capacities. However, these approaches often suffer from representation collapse and expert load imbalance, which negatively impact the potential of LLMs. To address these challenges, we propose a heterogeneous Mixture-of-Adapters (MoA) approach. This method dynamically integrates PEFT adapter experts with diverse structures, leveraging their complementary representational capabilities to foster expert specialization, thereby enhancing the effective transfer of pre-trained knowledge to downstream tasks. MoA supports two variants: (i) Soft MoA achieves fine-grained integration by performing a weighted fusion of all expert outputs; (ii) Sparse MoA activates adapter experts sparsely based on their contribution, achieving this with negligible performance degradation. Experimental results demonstrate that heterogeneous MoA outperforms homogeneous MoE-LoRA methods in both performance and parameter efficiency. Our project is available at https://github.com/DCDmllm/MoA.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究将低秩适应（LoRA）和混合专家模型（MoE）结合起来，以进一步提升参数高效微调（PEFT）方法在大语言模型应用中的性能。现有的方法采用同构的MoE-LoRA架构，其中LoRA专家具有相似或相同的结构和能力。然而，这些方法常常面临表示崩溃和专家负载不平衡的问题，这会负面影响LLM的性能。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种异构适配器混合模型（MoA）的方法。该方法动态地将结构各异的PEFT适配器专家整合在一起，利用它们的互补表示能力来促进专家的专业化，从而增强预训练知识对下游任务的有效传递。MoA支持两种变体：(i) 软MoA通过加权融合所有专家的输出来实现细粒度集成；(ii) 稀疏MoA根据专家的贡献来选择性地激活它们，同时几乎不会降低性能。实验结果表明，异构MoA在性能和参数效率方面都优于同构的MoE-LoRA方法。我们的项目可以在https://github.com/DCDmllm/MoA下载。

papers.title: Beyond the Context Window: Scaling Agentic RL via End-to-end Optimized Context Compression
papers.title_zh: 超出上下文窗口的范围：通过端到端优化的上下文压缩技术来扩展智能强化学习的规模
papers.authors: Miao Lu, Weiwei Sun, Weihua Du, Zhan Ling, Xuesong Yao, Kang Liu, Jiecao Chen
papers.abstract: We study reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning of large language model (LLM) agents for long-horizon multi-turn tool use, where context length quickly becomes a fundamental bottleneck. Existing multi-turn RL pipelines suffer from degraded instruction following, excessive rollout costs, and most importantly, strict context limits. In this work, to address these challenges, we introduce summarization-based context management to training. In specific, it periodically compresses the tool using history by LLM-generated summaries that retain task-relevant information to keep a compact context while enabling the agent to scale beyond the fixed context window. Building on this formulation, we derive a policy gradient representation that seamlessly enables standard LLM RL infrastructures to optimize both tool-use behaviors as well as summarization strategies in an end-to-end fashion. We instantiate this framework with SUmmarization augmented Policy Optimization (SUPO), an LLM RL algorithm that enables long-horizon training beyond a fixed context limit. Experiments on interactive function calling and searching tasks demonstrate that SUPO significantly improves the success rate while maintaining the same or even lower working context length compared to baselines. We also demonstrate that for complex searching tasks SUPO can further improve the evaluation performance when scaling test-time maximum round of summarization beyond that of training time.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了强化学习（RL）对大语言模型（LLM）代理的微调技术，旨在实现长期多轮工具使用场景中的应用。在这种情况下，上下文长度迅速成为制约性能的关键因素。现有的多轮RL流程存在指令遵循能力下降、过度展开成本高等问题，最关键的是，它们受到严格的上下文限制。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了基于摘要管理的上下文管理策略。具体来说，通过LLM生成的摘要来定期压缩工具使用的历史信息，从而保留与任务相关的信息，同时实现紧凑的上下文管理，使代理能够突破固定的上下文窗口限制。在此基础上，我们提出了一种策略梯度表示方法，使得标准的LLM RL框架能够端到端地优化工具使用行为以及摘要策略。我们实现了一种名为“摘要增强策略优化”（SUPO）的LLM RL算法，该算法能够实现超出固定上下文限制的长期训练。在交互式函数调用和搜索任务上的实验表明，SUPO显著提高了成功率，同时相比基线方法，其工作上下文长度保持不变甚至有所减少。我们还发现，对于复杂的搜索任务，当测试阶段的摘要次数超过训练阶段时，SUPO还能进一步提升评估性能。

papers.title: Probing the Safety Robustness of LLMs in Latent Space
papers.title_zh: 探究大语言模型在潜在空间中的安全性与鲁棒性
papers.authors: Tianle Gu, Kexin Huang, Zongqi Wang, Yixu Wang, Jie Li, Xin Wang, Yang Yao, Yujiu Yang, Yan Teng, Yingchun Wang
papers.abstract: Safety alignment is a fundamental prerequisite for building trustworthy artificial general intelligence. Despite substantial progress in safety alignment techniques, empirical evidence shows that aligned large language models can still produce unsafe responses under minor internal perturbations, revealing a robustness gap in existing safety mechanisms at the latent representation level. In this paper, we study the robustness evaluation of safety alignment under latent-space perturbations. We introduce Activation Steering Attack (ASA), and leverage the Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) as a diagnostic signal to probe the local sensitivity of safety behaviors in latent space. By measuring a model’s likelihood under controlled perturbations to its hidden representations, we assess the stability of its original responses. The probing signal is model-agnostic and supervision-free, enabling a general and reproducible diagnostic metric for analyzing safety robustness. Leveraging these probes, we systematically uncover a set of previously underexplored empirical findings, including (1) non-stationarity of layer vulnerabilities, revealing that the most vulnerable layer is an unstable property and even relocates after robustness training; (2) instance-level alignment with cross-layer consistency, where specific inputs remain universally vulnerable across the entire model hierarchy; (3) compositional effects of ASA, characterized by its incremental accumulation across sequential decoding steps and its potential for prompt-level jailbreak effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 安全对齐是构建可信赖的人工智能的基础前提。尽管在安全对齐技术方面取得了显著进展，但实证结果表明，即使经过轻微的内部扰动，对齐后的大语言模型仍可能产生不安全的响应，这揭示了现有安全机制在潜在表示层面存在的鲁棒性缺陷。在本文中，我们研究了在潜在空间扰动下对安全对齐的鲁棒性评估。我们引入了激活引导攻击（Activation Steering Attack，ASA），并利用负对数似然值作为诊断信号，来探测潜在空间中安全行为的局部敏感性。通过测量模型在其隐藏表示受到可控扰动时的可能性，我们可以评估其原始响应的稳定性。这种探测信号与模型无关，无需任何监督即可使用，从而提供了一种通用且可重复的安全鲁棒性诊断指标。利用这些探测方法，我们系统地发现了一些之前未被充分研究的实证结果，包括：(1) 层级的非稳定性问题，表明最脆弱的层级是一个不稳定的属性，甚至在经过鲁棒性训练后还会发生位置移动；(2) 跨层的实例级一致性问题，即特定输入在整个模型层次结构中始终具有脆弱性；(3) 激活引导攻击的复合效应，表现为其在连续解码步骤中的逐步累积，以及其在快速破解方面的潜在有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LoopTool: Closing the Data–Training Loop for Robust LLM Tool Calls
papers.title_zh: LoopTool：正在关闭数据训练循环，以打造更强大的大语言模型工具调用功能
papers.authors: Kangning Zhang, Weiwen Liu, Wenxiang Jiao, Kounianhua Du, Yuan Lu, Weinan Zhang, Yong Yu
papers.abstract: Augmenting Large Language Models (LLMs) with external tools enables them to execute complex, multi-step tasks. However, tool learning is hampered by the static synthetic data pipelines, where data generation and model training are executed as two separate, non-interactive processes. This approach fails to focus on the model’s specific weaknesses adaptively and allows noisy labels to persist, degrading training efficiency. We introduce LoopTool, a fully automated, model-aware data evolution framework that closes this loop by tightly integrating data synthesis and model training. LoopTool iteratively evolves both the data and the model through three synergistic modules: (1) Greedy Capability Probing (GCP) diagnoses the model’s mastered and failed capabilities; (2) Judgement-Guided Label Verification (JGLV) uses an open-source judge model to find and correct annotation errors, progressively purifying the dataset; and (3) Error-Driven Data Expansion (EDDE) generates new, challenging samples based on identified failures. This closed-loop process is tightly integrated with reinforcement learning training and operates within a cost-efficient, open-source ecosystem, thereby eliminating reliance on costly APIs. Experiments show that LoopTool-8B significantly surpasses its 32B data generator and achieves new state-of-the-art results on the BFCL-v3 and ACEBench benchmarks for its scale. Our work demonstrates that closed-loop, self-refining data pipelines can dramatically enhance the tool-use capabilities of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过引入外部工具来增强大语言模型（LLM），使其能够执行复杂的多步骤任务。然而，由于数据生成和模型训练是分别进行的、互不交互的过程，因此工具的学习过程受到了阻碍。这种方法无法自适应地针对模型的特定弱点进行优化，而且还会让噪声标签持续存在，从而降低训练效率。我们提出了LoopTool这一完全自动化的、注重模型的数据演化框架，它通过紧密集成数据合成和模型训练来打破这种循环。LoopTool通过三个协同模块迭代地优化数据和模型：（1）Greedy Capability Probing（GCP）能够诊断模型掌握和未能掌握的技能；（2）Judgement-Guided Label Verification（JGLV）利用开源的评判模型来发现并纠正标注错误，逐步净化数据集；（3）Error-Driven Data Expansion（EDDE）根据识别出的缺陷生成新的、具有挑战性的样本。这个闭环流程与强化学习训练紧密集成，并在一个成本效益高且开源的生态系统中进行运行，从而避免了依赖昂贵的API。实验表明，LoopTool-8B在性能上显著优于其32B版本的数据生成器，并且在BFCL-v3和ACEBench基准测试中取得了新的最佳成绩，这得益于其强大的规模处理能力。我们的研究证明，闭环式的自我优化数据管道可以显著提升LLM的工具使用能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Placing Puzzle Pieces Where They Matter: A Question Augmentation Framework for Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 将谜题的组成部分放置在合适的位置：一种用于强化学习的问答增强框架
papers.authors: Yangyi Fang, Haolin Shi
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a powerful approach for enhancing large language model reasoning, but faces a fundamental dilemma: training on easy problems can cause overfitting and pass@k degradation, while training on hard problems often results in sparse rewards. Recent question augmentation methods address this by prepending partial solutions as hints. However, uniform hint provision may introduce redundant information while missing critical reasoning bottlenecks, and excessive hints can reduce reasoning diversity, causing pass@k degradation. We propose PieceHint, a hint injection framework that strategically identifies and provides critical reasoning steps during training. By scoring the importance of different reasoning steps, selectively allocating hints based on problem difficulty, and progressively withdrawing scaffolding, PieceHint enables models to transition from guided learning to independent reasoning. Experiments on six mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that our 1.5B model achieves comparable average performance to 32B baselines while preserving pass@k diversity across all k values.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的强大方法，但它面临着一个根本性的困境：在简单问题上进行训练会导致过拟合和pass@k指标的下降，而在困难问题上进行训练则往往导致奖励稀疏。最近的一些问题增强方法通过预先提供部分解决方案作为提示来解决这个问题。然而，统一的提示供应可能会引入冗余信息，同时错过关键的推理环节；而过多的提示则会降低推理的多样性，从而导致pass@k指标的下降。我们提出了PieceHint这一提示注入框架，该框架能够在训练过程中有针对性地识别并提供关键的推理步骤。通过评估不同推理步骤的重要性，根据问题的难度选择性地分配提示，并逐步减少辅助性提示的使用，PieceHint使得模型能够从有指导的学习过渡到独立的推理。在六个数学推理基准测试上的实验表明，我们的15亿参数模型在保持所有k值下pass@k多样性的同时，其平均性能与320亿参数的基线模型相当。

papers.title: USB: A COMPREHENSIVE AND UNIFIED SAFETY EVALUATION BENCHMARK FOR MULTIMODAL LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
papers.title_zh: USB：一种适用于多种模态大型语言模型的综合且统一的安全评估标准
papers.authors: Baolin Zheng, Guanlin Chen, Qingyang Teng, Hongqiong Zhong, Yingshui Tan, Zhendong Liu, Weixun Wang, Jiaheng Liu, Jian Yang, Huiyun Jing, Jincheng Wei, Wenbo Su, Xiaoyong Zhu, Bo Zheng, Kaifu Zhang
papers.abstract: Despite their rapid advancement, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remain vulnerable to diverse safety risks. Current benchmarks fail to provide reliable assessments due to limited risk coverage, insufficient scale, and the oversight of complex modality combinations (e.g., cross-modal risks). To address this, we introduce the Unified Safety Benchmark (USB), a comprehensive framework covering 61 risk categories across four distinct modality interactions. We first demonstrate that existing benchmarks—even when aggregated—leave significant coverage gaps. To bridge this, we design a sophisticated data synthesis pipeline that generates complementary data, ensuring balanced coverage across all risk dimensions. Furthermore, beyond evaluating vulnerability to harmful queries, USB incorporates the simultaneous assessment of model over-refusal on benign inputs as an integrated diagnostic suite. Experimental results, evaluating 22 MLLMs across 244 risk-modality intersections, demonstrate that existing MLLMs still struggle with the trade-off between avoiding vulnerabilities and over-refusal. Models are particularly vulnerable to image-only or cross-modal risky inputs, highlighting the persistent need for refined safety mechanisms. Warning: This paper contains unfiltered and potentially harmful content that may be offensive.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管多模态大语言模型取得了快速进展，但它们仍然面临多种安全风险。目前的评估基准由于风险覆盖范围有限、规模不足以及未能考虑到复杂的模态组合（例如跨模态风险），而无法提供可靠的评估结果。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了统一安全基准测试框架——USB。该框架涵盖了四种不同模态交互下的61种风险类别。我们首先证明了现有的评估基准即使进行整合后，仍然存在较大的覆盖缺口。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们设计了一种复杂的数据合成流程，能够生成互补的数据，从而确保所有风险维度的覆盖均衡。此外，USB不仅评估模型对有害查询的脆弱性，还同时评估模型对良性输入产生过度拒绝行为的情况。实验结果显示，在244种风险-模态交互中，22个多模态语言模型在避免风险和过度拒绝之间仍面临着难以解决的权衡问题。这些模型尤其容易受到仅包含图像或跨模态风险输入的影响，这凸显了进一步完善安全机制的必要性。警告：本文包含未经筛选且可能具有攻击性的内容，可能会引起不适。
