papers.title: FlowSearch: Advancing Deep Research with Dynamic Structured Knowledge Flow
papers.title_zh: FlowSearch：通过动态结构化知识流推动深度研究的发展
papers.authors: Yusong Hu, Runmin Ma, Yue Fan, Jinxin Shi, Zongsheng Cao, Yuhao Zhou, Jiakang Yuan, Shuaiyu Zhang, Shiyang Feng, Xiangchao Yan, Shufei Zhang, Wenlong Zhang, Lei Bai, Bo Zhang
papers.abstract: Deep research is an inherently challenging task that demands both breadth and depth of thinking. It involves navigating diverse knowledge spaces and reasoning over complex, multi-step dependencies, which presents substantial challenges for agentic systems. To address this, we propose FlowSearch, a multi-agent framework that actively constructs and evolves a dynamic structured knowledge flow to drive subtask execution and reasoning. FlowSearch is capable of strategically planning and expanding the knowledge flow to enable parallel exploration and hierarchical task decomposition, while also adjusting the knowledge flow in real time based on feedback from intermediate reasoning outcomes and insights. FlowSearch achieves competitive performance on both general and scientific benchmarks, including GAIA, HLE, GPQA and TRQA, demonstrating its effectiveness in multi-disciplinary research scenarios and its potential to advance scientific discovery. The code will be available.
papers.abstract_zh: 深入研究是一项具有挑战性的任务，需要广泛的思维能力和深度思考。它涉及到在多样化的知识领域中导航，并对复杂的、多步骤的依赖性进行推理，这对智能系统来说是一个巨大的挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了FlowSearch这个多智能体框架。该框架能够主动构建并演化出动态的结构化知识流，以推动子任务的执行和推理。FlowSearch能够战略性地规划和扩展知识流，从而实现并行探索与分层任务分解，同时能够根据中间推理结果和洞察实时调整知识流。FlowSearch在一般性和科学性的基准测试中都取得了出色的性能，包括GAIA、HLE、GPQA和TRQA等测试，证明了其在多学科研究场景中的有效性，以及其在推动科学发现方面的潜力。相关代码已经准备好提供使用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLMEval-Fair: A Large-Scale Longitudinal Study on Robust and Fair Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: LLMEval-Fair：一项关于大型语言模型评估的大规模纵向研究，旨在实现稳健且公平的评估方法
papers.authors: Ming Zhang, Yujiong Shen, Jingyi Deng, Yuhui Wang, Huayu Sha, Kexin Tan, Qiyuan Peng, Yue Zhang, Junzhe Wang, Shichun Liu, Yueyuan Huang, Jingqi Tong, Changhao Jiang, Yilong Wu, Zhihao Zhang, Mingqi Wu, Mingxu Chai, Zhiheng Xi, Shihan Dou, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Existing evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) on static benchmarks is vulnerable to data contamination and leaderboard overfitting, critical issues that obscure true model capabilities. To address this, we introduce LLMEval-Fair, a framework for dynamic evaluation of LLMs. LLMEval-Fair is built on a proprietary bank of 220k graduate-level questions, from which it dynamically samples unseen test sets for each evaluation run. Its automated pipeline ensures integrity via contamination-resistant data curation, a novel anti-cheating architecture, and a calibrated LLM-as-a-judge process achieving 90% agreement with human experts, complemented by a relative ranking system for fair comparison. An 30-month longitudinal study of nearly 60 leading models reveals a performance ceiling on knowledge memorization and exposes data contamination vulnerabilities undetectable by static benchmarks. The framework demonstrates exceptional robustness in ranking stability and consistency, providing strong empirical validation for the dynamic evaluation paradigm. LLMEval-Fair offers a robust and credible methodology for assessing the true capabilities of LLMs beyond leaderboard scores, promoting the development of more trustworthy evaluation standards.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前对大语言模型在静态基准测试上的评估容易受到数据污染和排行榜过拟合的影响，这些问题会掩盖模型的真实能力。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了LLMEval-Fair这一用于动态评估大语言模型的框架。LLMEval-Fair基于一个包含22万道研究生水平问题的专有数据库，该数据库能够动态地为每次评估生成未见过的数据集。其自动化流程通过抗污染的数据处理、创新的防作弊架构以及能够与人类专家达成90%一致性的评估机制来确保评估的公正性，同时还配备了相对排名系统，以便进行公平比较。一项为期30个月的长期研究涉及近60种领先模型，结果显示这些模型在知识记忆方面存在性能上限，并且发现了一些通过静态基准测试无法检测到的数据污染问题。该框架在排名稳定性和一致性方面表现出卓越的鲁棒性，为动态评估范式提供了强有力的实证支持。LLMEval-Fair提供了一种稳健且可信的方法，可以评估大语言模型的真实能力，而不仅仅是排行榜上的成绩，从而推动更可靠的评估标准的开发。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SAME: Signer-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Test-Time Adaptation in Sign Language Translation
papers.title_zh: 相同的方法：基于专家混合模型的口语翻译时间自适应技术
papers.authors: Lujia Yang, Weicai Yan, Yongbo He, Qifei Zhang, Tao Jin, Jinshan Zhang, Meng Xi, Jianwei Yin
papers.abstract: Sign language translation (SLT) is essential for bridging communication between the deaf and hearing communities, but real-world deployment suffers from domain shift such as signer variability, lighting, and background changes. Supervised fine-tuning is impractical due to limited labeled data, and existing unsupervised adaptation methods require batch statistics or long adaptation. We introduce Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) for SLT, enabling rapid adaptation to domain shift without the need for labeled data. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to explore TTA in SLT. Existing TTA methods predominantly focus on image classification tasks and lack a comprehensive strategy for handling domain shift in SLT. In response, we introduce SAME, a plug-and-play, signer-aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) TTA architecture for SLT. SAME inserts lightweight MoE modules after multiple encoder layers. Gates are conditioned on signer features and stabilized with unsupervised regularizers, effectively decoupling domain shift across encoder depths while enabling personalized adaptation. Experiments show that SAME outperforms existing TTA methods and can enhance the capabilities of multiple SLT models.
papers.abstract_zh: 手语翻译对于连接聋人社区和听力正常社区之间的沟通至关重要。然而，在实际应用过程中，由于手语表达者之间的差异、光线条件的变化以及环境背景的变动等因素，手语翻译面临着诸多挑战。由于标注数据的限制，基于监督学习的微调方法并不实用；而现有的无监督学习方法则通常需要大量的标注数据或较长的适应时间。因此，我们提出了一种名为“测试时自适应”的手语翻译方法，该方法能够在不依赖标注数据的情况下快速适应不同领域的变化。据我们所知，这是首次将测试时自适应技术应用于手语翻译的研究。目前已有的测试时自适应方法主要集中在图像分类任务上，缺乏针对手语翻译领域变化的有效策略。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了SAME这一可即插即用、注重手语表达者特征的手语翻译多专家混合模型自适应架构。SAME在多个编码器层之后插入轻量级的多专家混合模型模块。这些模块以手语表达者的特征为条件进行训练，并通过无监督正则化手段进行稳定化处理，从而有效解决不同编码器层次上的领域变化问题，同时实现个性化的自适应调整。实验结果表明，SAME在性能上优于现有的测试时自适应方法，并且能够提升多种手语翻译模型的性能。

papers.title: Controllable LLM Reasoning via Sparse Autoencoder-Based Steering
papers.title_zh: 通过基于稀疏自动编码器的控制式大语言模型推理
papers.authors: Yi Fang, Wenjie Wang, Mingfeng Xue, Boyi Deng, Fengli Xu, Dayiheng Liu, Fuli Feng
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) exhibit human-like cognitive reasoning strategies (e.g. backtracking, cross-verification) during reasoning process, which improves their performance on complex tasks. Currently, reasoning strategies are autonomously selected by LRMs themselves. However, such autonomous selection often produces inefficient or even erroneous reasoning paths. To make reasoning more reliable and flexible, it is important to develop methods for controlling reasoning strategies. Existing methods struggle to control fine-grained reasoning strategies due to conceptual entanglement in LRMs’ hidden states. To address this, we leverage Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to decompose strategy-entangled hidden states into a disentangled feature space. To identify the few strategy-specific features from the vast pool of SAE features, we propose SAE-Steering, an efficient two-stage feature identification pipeline. SAE-Steering first recalls features that amplify the logits of strategy-specific keywords, filtering out over 99% of features, and then ranks the remaining features by their control effectiveness. Using the identified strategy-specific features as control vectors, SAE-Steering outperforms existing methods by over 15% in control effectiveness. Furthermore, controlling reasoning strategies can redirect LRMs from erroneous paths to correct ones, achieving a 7% absolute accuracy improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在推理过程中展现出类似人类的认知推理策略（如回溯法、交叉验证法等），这提升了它们在复杂任务中的性能。目前，这些推理策略是由大型推理模型自行选择的。然而，这种自主选择往往会导致低效甚至错误的推理路径。为了使推理更加可靠和灵活，开发控制推理策略的方法至关重要。现有方法难以对精细化的推理策略进行有效控制，因为大型推理模型的隐藏状态中存在概念上的纠缠现象。为了解决这个问题，我们采用了稀疏自编码器技术，将策略相关的隐藏状态分解为独立的特征空间。为了从庞大的自编码器特征中识别出与策略相关的少数特征，我们提出了一种高效的两阶段特征识别方法——SAE-Steering。该方法首先筛选出能够增强与策略相关的关键词的logits的特征，从而过滤掉超过99%的无关特征；然后根据这些特征的控控制效果对剩余特征进行排序。通过使用这些被识别出的与策略相关的特征作为控制向量，SAE-Steering在控制效果方面比现有方法提升了15%以上。此外，控制推理策略还可以帮助大型推理模型从错误的路径转向正确的路径，从而实现7%的绝对准确率提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LEDOM: Reverse Language Model
papers.title_zh: LEDOM：逆向语言模型
papers.authors: Xunjian Yin, Sitao Cheng, Yuxi Xie, Xinyu Hu, Li Lin, Xinyi Wang, Liangming Pan, William Yang Wang, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: Autoregressive language models are trained exclusively left-to-right. We explore the complementary factorization, training right-to-left at scale, and ask what reasoning patterns emerge when a model conditions on future context to predict the past.We train LEDOM, an open-source purely reverse autoregressive language model (2B/7B parameters, 435B tokens), and find it develops capabilities distinct from forward models, including abductive inference, question synthesis, and structural handling of the reversal curse.We then explore one application of the reverse model: combining forward likelihood P(y \mid x) with reverse posterior P(x \mid y) through noisy channel duality. We propose Reverse Reward, which reranks forward outputs using reverse posterior estimates, and prove that bidirectional scoring penalizes hallucinated reasoning chains whose backward reconstruction degrades.Reverse Reward yields gains of up to 6.6% on AIME 2024 and 15% on AMC 2023 across multiple strong baselines. We release all codes at https://github.com/Arvid-pku/LEDOM.
papers.abstract_zh: 自回归语言模型的训练方式是完全从左到右进行的。我们探讨了以相反方向进行训练的方法，并研究了当模型基于未来上下文来预测过去时，会出现哪些推理模式。我们训练了LEDOM——一个开源的纯反向自回归语言模型（参数为2B/7B，token数量为435B）。我们发现，该模型具备一些与正向模型不同的能力，包括推测性推理、问题合成以及处理反向语境的能力。接下来，我们探讨了反向模型的一个应用：通过噪声通道对偶性，将正向概率P(y | x)与反向后验概率P(x | y)结合起来。我们提出了“反向奖励”机制，该机制利用反向后验估计来重新排序正向输出，并证明双向评分能够惩罚那些后向重建效果较差的幻觉推理链。在AIME 2024比赛中，反向奖励模型取得了高达6.6%的准确率提升；在AMC 2023比赛中，其准确率达到了15%。所有代码均可在此处下载：https://github.com/Arvid-pku/LEDOM

papers.title: AEGIS: A Holistic Benchmark for Evaluating Forensic Analysis of AI-Generated Academic Images
papers.title_zh: AEGIS：一种用于评估人工智能生成学术图像的法医分析的整体性基准体系
papers.authors: Bo Zhang, Tzu-Yen Ma, Zichen Tang, Junpeng Ding, Zirui Wang, Yizhuo Zhao, Peilin Gao, Zijie Xi, Zixin Ding, Haiyang Sun, Haocheng Gao, Yuan Liu, Liangjia Wang, Yiling Huang, Yujie Wang, Yuyue Zhang, Ronghui Xi, Yuanze Li, Jiacheng Liu, Zhongjun Yang, Haihong E
papers.abstract: We introduce AEGIS, A holistic benchmark for Evaluating forensic analysis of AI-Generated academic ImageS. Compared to existing benchmarks, AEGIS features three key advances: (1) Domain-Specific Complexity: covering seven academic categories with 39 fine-grained subtypes, exposing intrinsic forensic difficulty, where even GPT-5.1 reaches 48.80% overall performance and expert models achieve only limited localization accuracy (IoU 30.09%); (2) Diverse Forgery Simulations: modeling four prevalent academic forgery strategies across 25 generative models, with 11 yielding average forensic accuracy below 50%, showing that forensics lag behind generative advances; and (3) Multi-Dimensional Forensic Evaluation: jointly assessing detection, reasoning, and localization, revealing complementary strengths between model families, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) at 84.74% accuracy in textual artifact recognition and expert detectors peaking at 79.54% accuracy in binary authenticity detection. By evaluating 25 leading MLLMs, nine expert models, and one unified multimodal understanding and generation model, AEGIS serves as a diagnostic testbed exposing fundamental limitations in academic image forensics.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了AEGIS，这是一个用于评估人工智能生成学术图像的法医分析的整体基准测试工具。与现有的基准测试相比，AEGIS具有三个关键优势：（1）领域特定的复杂性：涵盖了七个学术类别，共包含39种细粒度子类型，这凸显了法医分析的难度。即便GPT-5.1在整体性能上达到了48.80%，而专业模型则只能达到有限的定位精度（IoU 30.09%）；（2）多样的伪造模拟：对25种生成模型中的四种常见学术伪造策略进行了建模，其中11种模型的法医准确率低于50%，这表明法医技术仍然落后于生成技术的进步；（3）多维度的法医评估：同时评估检测、推理和定位能力，发现不同模型家族之间的互补性。多模态大语言模型在文本痕迹识别方面的准确率为84.74%，而专业检测器在二元真实性检测方面的准确率达到了79.54%。通过对25种领先的大语言模型、9种专业模型以及一种统一的多模态理解和生成模型进行评估，AEGIS成为了一个诊断平台，揭示了学术图像法医分析中的基本局限性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The GaoYao Benchmark: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Multilingual and Multicultural Abilities of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 高耀基准测试：一种用于评估大型语言模型多语言和多元文化能力的全面框架
papers.authors: Yilun Liu, Chunguang Zhao, Mengyao Piao, Lingqi Miao, Shimin Tao, Minggui HE, Chenxin Liu, Zhang Li, Mahongxia, Jiaxin Guo, Chen Liu, Liqun Deng, Jiansheng Wei, Xiaojun Meng, Fanyi Du, Daimeng Wei, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: Evaluating the multilingual and multicultural capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for their global utility. However, current benchmarks face three critical limitations: (1) fragmented evaluation dimensions that often neglect deep cultural nuances; (2) insufficient language coverage in subjective tasks relying on low-quality machine translation; and (3) shallow analysis that lacks diagnostic depth beyond simple rankings. To address these, we introduce GaoYao, a comprehensive benchmark with 182.3k samples, 26 languages and 51 nations/areas. First, GaoYao proposes a unified framework categorizing evaluation tasks into three cultural layers (General Multilingual, Cross-cultural, Monocultural) and nine cognitive sub-layers. Second, we achieve native-quality expansion by leveraging experts to rigorously localize subjective benchmarks into 19 languages and synthesizing cross-cultural test sets for 34 cultures, surpassing prior coverage by up to 111%. Third, we conduct an in-depth diagnostic analysis on 20+ flagship and compact LLMs. Our findings reveal significant geographical performance disparities and distinct gaps between tasks, offering a reliable map for future work. We release the benchmark.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型的多语言和多元文化能力对于其全球应用具有重要意义。然而，目前的评估基准存在三个主要缺陷：(1) 评估维度过于分散，常常忽视深层次的文化差异；(2) 在依赖低质量机器翻译的主观任务中，语言的覆盖范围不足；(3) 分析深度有限，无法超越简单的排名。为了克服这些问题，我们推出了GaoYao这一全面的评估基准，该基准包含18.23万个样本数据，涵盖26种语言和51个国家和地区。首先，GaoYao提出了一个统一的框架，将评估任务分为三个文化层次（通用多语言、跨文化、单语言）和九个认知子层次。其次，我们通过借助专家的力量，将主观评估基准翻译成19种语言，并构建了涵盖34种文化的跨文化测试集，其语言覆盖范围比以往高出111%。第三，我们对20多种主流和小型语言模型进行了深入的分析。我们的研究发现，不同模型在地理表现上存在显著差异，且不同任务之间的差距也各不相同，这为未来的研究提供了可靠的参考依据。我们现在已发布这一评估基准。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: METRO: Towards Strategy Induction from Expert Dialogue Transcripts for Non-collaborative Dialogues
papers.title_zh: 地铁：基于专家对话记录的非协作对话策略归纳方法
papers.authors: Haofu Yang, Jiaji Liu, Chen Huang, Faguo Wu, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng
papers.abstract: Developing non-collaborative dialogue agents traditionally requires the manual, unscalable codification of expert strategies. We propose METRO, a method that leverages large language models to autonomously induce both strategy actions and planning logic directly from raw transcripts. METRO formalizes expert knowledge into a Strategy Forest, a hierarchical structure that captures both short-term responses (nodes) and long-term strategic foresight (branches). Experimental results across two benchmarks show that METRO demonstrates promising performance, outperforming existing methods by an average of 9%-10%. Our further analysis not only reveals the success behind METRO (strategic behavioral diversity and foresight), but also demonstrates its robust cross-task transferability. This offers new insights into building non-collaborative agents in a cost-effective and scalable way. Our code is available at https://github.com/Humphrey-0125/METRO.
papers.abstract_zh: 开发非协作型对话智能体通常需要手动、不可扩展地编码专家策略。我们提出了METRO方法，该方法利用大语言模型直接从原始文本中自动提取策略行动和规划逻辑。METRO将专家知识形式化为“策略森林”，这是一种分层结构，能够同时包含短期响应（节点）和长期战略预见（分支）。在两个基准测试中的实验结果表明，METRO表现出良好的性能，其表现平均优于现有方法9%-10%。我们的进一步分析不仅揭示了METRO的成功之处——即战略行为的多样性和前瞻性——还证明了其跨任务的可迁移性。这为以经济高效且可扩展的方式构建非协作型智能体提供了新的思路。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Humphrey-0125/METRO获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TamEdit: Trajectory-Aware Meta-Learning for Specificity-Preserving Continual Knowledge Editing
papers.title_zh: TamEdit：基于轨迹感知的元学习技术，用于保持特异性特征的持续知识编辑
papers.authors: Shiqiang Tian, Cheng Ding, Qin Chen, Jie Zhou, Liang He
papers.abstract: Knowledge editing is a promising method for updating Large Language Models efficiently. However, previous studies often suffer from poor specificity in continual editing, as they typically focus on single edits or preventing knowledge forgetting. To address this, we propose TamEdit, a trajectory-aware meta-learning method that preserves specificity for continual knowledge editing. TamEdit unifies three levels: Inner Optimization performs multi-step fast fine-tuning on the single edit; Trajectory-based Editing unifies continual edits with a growing memory; and Outer Optimization leverages meta-learning to distill cross-task strategies for preserving specificity. By capturing the relationships between different single edits within the trajectory, our method learns how to effectively avoid specificity drift. Experiments across multiple LLMs show TamEdit significantly outperforms baselines in continual editing, improving specificity by 14.81% with fast speed (requiring only 8.84% of the time cost of most baselines), while preserving general capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识编辑是一种高效更新大语言模型的有效方法。然而，以往的研究在持续编辑过程中往往存在特异性不足的问题，因为它们通常只关注单一编辑或防止知识遗忘。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了TamEdit这一基于轨迹感知的元学习方法，它能够有效保留持续知识编辑过程中的特异性。TamEdit结合了三个层次：内部优化对单一编辑进行多步快速微调；基于轨迹的编辑将持续编辑与不断增长的记忆相结合；外部优化则利用元学习来提炼跨任务策略，以维护特异性。通过捕捉轨迹中不同单一编辑之间的关系，我们的方法能够学会如何有效避免特异性漂移。在多个LLM上的实验表明，TamEdit在持续编辑方面显著优于基线方法，其特异性提升了14.81%，同时处理速度也快得多（仅需要大多数基线方法的8.84%的处理时间），同时还能保持整体性能。

papers.title: LexRel: Benchmarking Legal Relation Extraction for Chinese Civil Cases
papers.title_zh: LexRel：针对中国民事案件的法律关系提取技术对比研究
papers.authors: Yida Cai, Ranjuexiao Hu, Huiyuan Xie, Chenyang Li, Yun Liu, Yuxiao Ye, Zhenghao Liu, Weixing Shen, Zhiyuan Liu
papers.abstract: Legal relations serve as an important analytical framework for dispute resolution in civil cases. However, legal relations in Chinese civil cases remain underexplored in the field of legal AI, largely due to the absence of comprehensive schemas. In this work, we first introduce a comprehensive schema for legal relations in civil cases, which contains a hierarchical taxonomy and definitions of arguments. Based on this schema, we formulate a legal relation extraction task and present LexRel, an expert-annotated benchmark for legal relation extraction in the Chinese civil law domain. We use LexRel to evaluate state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) on legal relation extraction, showing that current LLMs exhibit significant limitations in accurately identifying civil legal relations. Furthermore, we demonstrate that explicitly incorporating information about legal relations leads to promising performance gains on other downstream legal AI tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 法律关系在民事案件的争议解决中起着重要的分析框架作用。然而，在中国民事案件中，法律关系在法律人工智能领域仍然没有得到充分研究，主要是因为缺乏全面的法律关系体系。在这项研究中，我们首先提出了一个关于民事案件中法律关系的全面体系，该体系包含层次化的分类体系及论元定义。基于这一体系，我们设计了一个法律关系提取任务，并提出了LexRel——一个由专家标注的法律关系提取基准数据集。我们使用LexRel来评估当前最先进的大语言模型在法律关系提取方面的表现，结果表明，现有的大语言模型在准确识别民事法律关系方面存在显著局限性。此外，我们还证明了明确纳入法律关系相关信息能够显著提高其他法律人工智能任务的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Agentic Memory: Learning Unified Long-Term and Short-Term Memory Management for Large Language Model Agents
papers.title_zh: 主动式记忆：学习统一长期与短期记忆管理机制，以适用于大型语言模型智能体
papers.authors: Yi Yu, Liuyi Yao, Yuexiang Xie, Qingquan Tan, Jiaqi Feng, Yaliang Li, Libing Wu
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents face fundamental limitations in long-horizon reasoning due to finite context windows, making effective memory management critical. Existing methods typically handle long-term memory (LTM) and short-term memory (STM) as separate components, relying on heuristics or auxiliary controllers, which limits adaptability and end-to-end optimization. In this paper, we propose Agentic Memory (AgeMem), a unified framework that integrates LTM and STM management directly into the agent’s policy. AgeMem exposes memory operations as tool-based actions, enabling the LLM agent to autonomously decide what and when to store, retrieve, update, summarize, or discard information. To train such unified behaviors, we propose a three-stage progressive reinforcement learning strategy and design a step-wise GRPO to address sparse and discontinuous rewards induced by memory operations. Experiments on five long-horizon benchmarks demonstrate that AgeMem consistently outperforms strong memory-augmented baselines across multiple LLM backbones, achieving improved task performance, higher-quality long-term memory, and more efficient context usage.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理在长视距推理方面存在根本限制，这是由于上下文窗口的限制所致，因此有效的内存管理至关重要。现有方法通常将长期记忆（LTM）和短期记忆（STM）视为独立的组成部分，并依赖启发式算法或辅助控制器来处理这些问题，这限制了系统的适应性和端到端优化能力。在本文中，我们提出了“代理式记忆”框架（AgeMem），该框架将LTM和STM的管理直接集成到代理的策略中。AgeMem将内存操作表示为基于工具的行动，使LLM代理能够自主决定存储、检索、更新、总结或丢弃信息的时机和内容。为了训练这种统一的行为模式，我们提出了一种三阶段的渐进式强化学习策略，并设计了逐步的GRPO机制来处理由内存操作引起的稀疏和不连续的奖励问题。在五个长视距基准测试上的实验表明，AgeMem在多个LLM框架上始终优于那些采用增强型内存技术的基线模型，取得了更好的任务性能、更高质量的长期记忆以及更高效的上下文使用效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Profiling-Free Mixed-Precision Quantization for MoE LLMs via Fuzzy Rule Interpolation
papers.title_zh: 一种无需轮廓提取的混合精度量化方法，适用于MoE大语言模型——通过模糊规则插值实现
papers.authors: Huachen Qi, Ruiyu Zhuo, Bowen Shi, Xiang Chang, Fei Chao, Changjing Shang, Qiang Shen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models continue to scale in size and capability, driving substantial computational and memory demands.Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures alleviate this cost by activating only a sparse subset of experts per token, enabling efficient scaling without proportional increases in inference compute.However, quantization in MoE models remains challenging due to heterogeneous sensitivity across experts and their internal linear layers.Existing mixed-precision frameworks such as Mixed-precision Quantization for MoE (MxMoE) require full quantization-loss evaluation for expert–layer–and-bit configurations, incurring prohibitive profiling cost.To address this, we propose FRI-MxMoE, a profiling-free mixed-precision quantization framework built on Fuzzy Rule Interpolation, designed as a drop-in replacement for the loss estimation component in MxMoE. By constructing a fuzzy rule base in the intra-expert layer feature space (bit-width, activation variance, parameter scale), our method predicts quantization error from only sparse samples, eliminating the need for dense profiling.Extensive experiments demonstrate that FRI-MxMoE accelerates the profiling phase by up to 15.7\times (on DeepSeek-V2) while achieving comparable or slightly superior zero-shot accuracy (e.g., +1.04\% on DeepSeekV2-Lite) compared to the baseline.This enables continuous sensitivity modeling, preserves accuracy under mixed-precision allocation, and reduces offline computation by orders of magnitude.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在规模和性能上持续扩展，这带来了巨大的计算和内存需求。混合专家架构通过仅激活每个令牌中的稀疏子集专家来减轻这一成本问题，从而实现高效的扩展，而无需增加推理计算量。然而，由于不同专家及其内部线性层的异质敏感性，混合专家模型中的量化仍然具有挑战性。现有的混合精度框架，如混合精度量化技术，需要针对专家-层-比特配置进行完整的量化损失评估，这会导致极高的分析成本。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了FRI-MxMoE这一无需分析的混合精度量化框架。该框架基于模糊规则插值技术，可以替代MxMoE中的损失估计组件。通过在专家内部特征空间构建模糊规则库（包括比特宽度、激活方差、参数规模等），我们的方法仅从稀疏样本中预测量化误差，从而消除了密集分析的需求。大量实验表明，FRI-MxMoE可以将分析阶段的耗时缩短15.7倍（在DeepSeek-V2数据集上的表现）。同时，其零样本准确率与基线方法相当或略高（例如，在DeepSeekV2-Lite数据集上的准确率提升了+1.04%）。这使得连续性的敏感性建模成为可能，同时在混合精度分配下仍能保持较高的准确性，并且大大减少了离线计算量。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Tailoring Diagnostic Modeling to Individual Learners: Personalized Distractor Generation via MCTS-Guided Reasoning Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: 针对个体学习者的诊断模型定制：通过MCTS引导的推理重构技术实现个性化干扰项生成
papers.authors: Tao Wu, Jingyuan Chen, Wang Lin, Jian Zhan, Mengze Li, Fangzhou Jin, Min Zhang, Kun Kuang, Fei Wu
papers.abstract: Distractors—incorrect yet plausible answer choices in multiple-choice questions (MCQs)—are vital in educational assessments, as they help identify student misconceptions by presenting potential reasoning errors. Current distractor generation methods typically produce shared distractors for all students, ignoring the individual variations in reasoning, which limits their diagnostic effectiveness. To tackle this challenge, we introduce the task of Personalized Distractor Generation, which tailors distractors to each student’s specific cognitive flaws, inferred from their past question-answering (QA) history. While promising, this task is particularly demanding due to the limited number of QA records available for each student, which are insufficient for training, as well as the absence of their underlying reasoning process. To overcome this, we propose a novel, training-free two-stage framework. In the first stage, Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is used to reconstruct the student’s reasoning process from past errors, creating a student-specific misconception prototype. In the second stage, this prototype guides the simulation of the student’s reasoning on new questions, generating personalized distractors that resonate with their individual misconceptions. Our experiments, conducted on 1,361 students across 6 subjects, demonstrate that this approach outperforms existing methods in generating plausible, personalized distractors, and also effectively adapts to group-level settings, highlighting its robustness and versatility.
papers.abstract_zh: 干扰项——即多项选择题中那些不正确但看似合理的答案选项——在教育评估中起着至关重要的作用，因为它们能够通过揭示潜在的推理错误来帮助学生识别自己的误解。目前常用的干扰项生成方法通常会为所有学生生成相同的干扰项，而忽略了个体在推理上的差异，这限制了其诊断效果。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了个性化干扰项生成任务。该任务根据每个学生过去的问答历史，为其量身定制干扰项，以弥补其认知缺陷。虽然这一任务很有前景，但由于每个学生的问答记录数量有限，且缺乏其背后的推理过程，因此这项任务相当具有挑战性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的、无需训练的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，使用蒙特卡洛树搜索算法从学生的过往错误中重建其推理过程，从而创建出符合其特定误解的原型。在第二阶段，利用这个原型来模拟学生在新问题上的推理过程，进而生成与他们的个人误解相一致的个性化干扰项。我们在1,361名学生身上进行的实验表明，这种方法在生成合理且个性化的干扰项方面优于现有方法，同时还能有效适应群体层面的应用场景，充分体现了其强大的鲁棒性和多功能性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MTR-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multi-Turn Reasoning Evaluation
papers.title_zh: MTR-Bench：一个用于多轮推理评估的综合性基准测试平台
papers.authors: Xiaoyuan Li, Keqin Bao, Yubo Ma, Moxin Li, Wenjie Wang, Rui Men, Yichang Zhang, Fuli Feng, Dayiheng Liu
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promising results in complex reasoning tasks. However, current evaluations predominantly focus on single-turn reasoning scenarios, leaving interactive tasks largely unexplored. We attribute it to the absence of comprehensive datasets and scalable automatic evaluation protocols. To fill these gaps, we present MTR-Bench for LLMs’ Multi-Turn Reasoning evaluation. Comprising 4 classes, 40 tasks and 3600 instances, MTR-Bench covers diverse reasoning capabilities, fine-grained difficulty granularity, and necessitates multi-turn interactions with the environments. Moreover, MTR-Bench features fully-automated framework spanning both dataset constructions and model evaluations, which enables scalable assessment without human interventions. Extensive experiments reveal that even the cutting-edge reasoning models fall short of multi-turn, interactive reasoning tasks. And the further analysis upon these results brings valuable insights for future research in interactive AI systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂推理任务上的最新进展已经取得了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，目前的评估主要集中于单轮推理场景，而交互式任务却尚未得到充分探索。我们认为这是由于缺乏全面的数据集以及可扩展的自动评估方案所导致的。为了填补这些空白，我们提出了MTR-Bench，用于评估大语言模型的多轮推理能力。该评估工具包含4个类别、40个任务以及3600个实例，涵盖了多种推理能力、精细的难度分级，并且需要与环境进行多轮交互。此外，MTR-Bench采用了完全自动化的框架，包括数据集构建和模型评估过程，这使得评估过程无需人工干预即可实现规模化。大量实验表明，即使是最先进的推理模型也难以应对多轮交互式推理任务。对这些结果的进一步分析为未来交互式人工智能系统的研究提供了宝贵的见解。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Community-Aware Assessment of Social Textual Engagement and Resonance: A Human-Centric Perspective on User-Generated Content Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 基于社区需求的社会文本互动与共鸣评估：以用户生成内容评价为中心的观点
papers.authors: Tianjiao Li, Kai Zhao, Xiang Li, Yang Liu, Huyang Sun
papers.abstract: Traditional Video Quality Assessment (VQA) focuses narrowly on aesthetic fidelity, overlooking the complex social dynamics that define quality in User-Generated Content (UGC). In this work, we propose a paradigm shift from signal-centric metrics to human-centric resonance assessment. We introduce CASTER (Community-Aware Assessment of Social Textual Engagement and Resonance), a new task that evaluates whether a UGC item achieves positive community resonance based on its multimodal attributes rather than visual quality alone. To address this, we present MEDEA (Multimodal Engagement-Driven Evaluation Architecture), which introduces a novel Social Chain-of-Thought (Social-CoT) mechanism. Unlike traditional logical CoT, Social-CoT performs multimodal perspective-taking, instantiating diverse viewer personas to simulate collective cognitive and emotional reactions (i.e., the “community mind”) before deriving a quality judgment. MEDEA is trained via a two-stage approach involving supervised fine-tuning and process-supervised reinforcement learning with Social Alignment Reward to ensure reasoning paths are grounded in authentic human social cognition. To support this task, we release CASTER-Bench, a comprehensive human-annotated benchmark covering diverse UGC categories. Experiments demonstrate that MEDEA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on CASTER-Bench while providing interpretable and empathetic reasoning paths that align with real community feedback.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的视频质量评估方法仅关注美学上的逼真度，而忽视了定义用户生成内容质量所需的复杂社会动态。在本文中，我们提出了一种从以信号为中心的指标转向以人为中心的共鸣评估的范式转变。我们引入了CASTER（考虑社区的社交文本互动与共鸣评估），这是一种新的任务，它基于多模态属性来评估用户生成内容是否实现了积极的社区共鸣，而不仅仅是视觉质量。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了MEDEA（多模态互动驱动评估架构），该架构引入了一种新颖的社会思维链机制。与传统的逻辑思维链不同，社会思维链能够实现多模态视角转换，通过实例化不同的观众角色来模拟集体认知和情感反应（即“社区思维”），然后再做出质量判断。MEDEA通过两阶段方法进行训练：监督式精细调整以及基于社会对齐奖励的过程监督强化学习，以确保推理路径基于真实的人类社会认知。为了支持这一任务，我们发布了CASTER-Bench，这是一个包含多种用户生成内容类别的综合性人工标注基准测试。实验表明，MEDEA在CASTER-Bench上的表现显著优于现有最先进的基线方法，同时其推理路径具有可解释性和同理心，与真实的社区反馈相一致。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Query-Aware Knowledge Retrieval via Hyperbolic Structuring
papers.title_zh: 基于查询需求的知识检索方法——通过超构结构实现
papers.authors: Chuang Zhou, Junnan Dong, Yilin Xiao, Shengyuan Chen, Su Dong, di Yin, Xing Sun, Zhaozhuo Xu, Xiao Huang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has demonstrated significant potential in enhancing large language models (LLMs) by supplementing external knowledge. However, existing approaches focus primarily on retrieving isolated factual knowledge entities while neglecting the critical reasoning relationships. To address this limitation, Graph-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) has emerged as an effective solution, which explicitly integrates structured knowledge graphs to support complex reasoning tasks. Although diverse graph construction methods have been explored, they typically rely on static, query-agnostic graphs constructed via fixed heuristics. We are thereby motivated to propose a query-centric retrieval framework that adaptively constructs a graph tailored to each query. However, it is challenging to accurately identify these latent relationships from queries to the corpus. Moreover, unifying multiple local-perspective connections into a globally coherent structured corpus introduces additional complexity. To this end, we introduce HyperRAG, a novel framework in the Hyperbolic space that captures both explicit entity-based links and implicit query-aware connections. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that HyperRAG consistently outperforms existing baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术在通过补充外部知识来提升大语言模型方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有的方法主要侧重于检索孤立的事实性知识实体，而忽视了关键性的推理关系。为了克服这一局限性，图增强生成（GraphRAG）作为一种有效的解决方案应运而生，它能够明确整合结构化知识图谱，以支持复杂的推理任务。尽管已经探索了多种图构建方法，但这些方法通常依赖于通过固定启发式算法构建的静态、与查询无关的图结构。因此，我们提出了一个以查询为中心的检索框架，该框架能够自适应地构建出适合每个查询的图结构。不过，从查询到语料库中准确识别这些潜在关系仍然具有挑战性。此外，将多个局部视角上的连接统一成一个全局连贯的结构化语料库也会引入额外的复杂性。为此，我们提出了HyperRAG这一新颖的框架，它在超球面空间中同时捕捉了显式的基于实体的链接和隐式的、与查询相关的连接。在三个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，HyperRAG始终优于现有的基线方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EduBench: A Comprehensive Benchmarking Dataset for Evaluating Large Language Models in Diverse Educational Scenarios
papers.title_zh: EduBench：一个全面的基准测试数据集，可用于评估大型语言模型在不同教育场景下的性能
papers.authors: Bin Xu, Yu Bai, Huashan Sun, Yiguan Lin, Siming Liu, Xinyue Liang, Yaolin Li, Zhuangzhi Dong, Jingren Zhang, Yufan Deng, Xinyu Zou, Yang Gao, Heyan Huang
papers.abstract: As large language models continue to advance, their application in educational contexts remains underexplored and under-optimized. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing the first diverse benchmark tailored for educational scenarios, incorporating synthetic data containing 9 major scenarios and over 4,000 distinct educational contexts. To enable comprehensive assessment, we propose a set of multi-dimensional evaluation metrics that cover 12 critical aspects relevant to both teachers and students. We further apply human annotation to ensure the effectiveness of the model-generated evaluation responses. Additionally, we succeed to train a relatively small-scale model on our constructed dataset and demonstrate that it can achieve performance comparable to state-of-the-art large models (e.g., Deepseek V3, Qwen Max) on the test set. Overall, this work provides a practical foundation for the development and evaluation of education-oriented language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的不断发展，它们在教育领域的应用仍然没有得到充分探索和优化。在本文中，我们为了解决这个问题，提出了首个专为教育场景设计的多样化基准测试。该测试包含9种主要场景和超过4,000种不同的教育情境的合成数据。为了进行全面评估，我们提出了一组多维评估指标，涵盖了与教师和学生相关的12个关键方面。此外，我们还采用了人工标注来确保模型生成的评估反馈的准确性。更重要的是，我们在构建的数据集上成功训练出了一个规模相对较小的模型，并证明该模型在测试集上的性能可以与最先进的大型模型（如DeepSeek V3、Qwen Max）相媲美。总体而言，这项工作为开发和评估面向教育的语言模型提供了实用的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: WebClipper: Efficient Evolution of Web Agents with Graph-based Trajectory Pruning
papers.title_zh: WebClipper：基于图的轨迹剪枝技术，实现网络代理的高效进化
papers.authors: Junjie Wang, Zequn Xie, Dan Yang, Jie Feng, Yue Shen, Duolin Sun, Meixiu Long, Yihan Jiao, Zhehao Tan, Jian Wang, Peng Wei, Jinjie Gu
papers.abstract: Deep Research systems based on web agents have shown strong potential in solving complex information-seeking tasks, yet their search efficiency remains underexplored. We observe that many state-of-the-art open-source web agents rely on long tool-call trajectories with cyclic reasoning loops and exploration of unproductive branches. To address this, we propose WebClipper, a framework that compresses web agent trajectories via graph-based pruning. Concretely, we model the agent’s search process as a state graph and cast trajectory optimization as a minimum-necessary Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) mining problem, yielding pruned trajectories that preserve essential reasoning while eliminating redundant steps. Continued training on these refined trajectories enables the agent to evolve toward more efficient search patterns and reduces tool-call rounds by about 20% while improving accuracy. Furthermore, we introduce a new metric called F-AE Score to measure the model’s overall performance in balancing accuracy and efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that WebClipper compresses tool-call rounds under excellent performance, providing practical insight into balancing effectiveness and efficiency in web agent design.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于网络代理的深度研究系统在解决复杂信息检索任务方面展现出巨大潜力，但其搜索效率仍有待进一步探索。我们发现，许多先进的开源网络代理依赖于冗长的工具调用路径，其中包含循环推理环节以及对无益分支的探索。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了WebClipper框架——该框架通过基于图的剪枝技术来压缩网络代理的搜索路径。具体来说，我们将代理的搜索过程建模为状态图，并将路径优化问题转化为最小必要有向无环图（DAG）挖掘问题。这样就能得到既保留关键推理逻辑又消除冗余步骤的压缩后路径。通过对这些优化后的路径进行持续训练，代理能够逐渐演化出更高效的搜索模式，同时将工具调用的次数减少约20%，并提高搜索精度。此外，我们还引入了一种新的评估指标——F-AE分数，用于衡量模型在准确性和效率之间的平衡表现。实验表明，WebClipper在压缩工具调用次数的过程中表现出优异的性能，为网络代理设计中的效率与效果平衡提供了实用指导。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MMAC: A Multilingual, Multimodal Alignment Framework for Cultural Grounding Evaluation
papers.title_zh: MMAC：一种支持多语言、多模态对齐的框架，用于文化基准评估
papers.authors: Weihua Zheng, Zhengyuan Liu, Tanmoy Chakraborty, Weiwen Xu, Xiaoxue Gao, Bryan Chen Zhengyu Tan, Bowei Zou, Chang Liu, Yujia Hu, Xing Xie, Xiaoyuan Yi, Jing Yao, Chaojun Wang, Long Li, Rui Liu, Huiyao Liu, Koji Inoue, Ryuichi Sumida, Tatsuya Kawahara, Fan Xu, Lingyu Ye, Wei Tian, Dongjun Kim, Jimin Jung, Jaehyung Seo, Nadya Yuki Wangsajaya, Pham Minh Duc, Ojasva Saxena, Palash Nandi, Xiyan Tao, Wiwik Karlina, Tuan Luong, Keertana Arun Vasan, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Nancy F. Chen
papers.abstract: The global deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) underscores the urgent need to evaluate their cultural alignment. However, assessing genuine “cultural awareness” across modalities (text, vision, speech) and languages remains a significant challenge. To comprehensively investigate this domain, we propose MMAC, a systematic framework that encompasses a tri-modally aligned cultural benchmark creation pipeline and a five-dimensional evaluation protocol to assess cross-country awareness disparities, evaluate cross-lingual and cross-modal consistency, and verify cultural knowledge generalization and grounding validity. Given the prevailing Western cultural bias in current models, we focus on 8 Asian countries as our dataset foundation to more acutely reveal potential cultural deficiencies in LLMs. Our dataset, MMAC-bench, features 27,000 human-curated questions across 10 languages. Crucially, it is the first dataset aligned at the input level across text, image, and speech, enabling direct cross-modal transfer tests. Each question consists of multiple-choice options accompanied by open-ended generated explanations, where 79% require multi-step reasoning grounded in cultural context, moving beyond simple memorization. We probe the causes of modal divergence, offering insights into fostering culturally robust MLLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在全球范围内的应用凸显了评估其文化对齐性的紧迫性。然而，在文本、视觉和语音等多种模态以及不同语言中评估真正的“文化意识”仍然是一个重大挑战。为了全面研究这一领域，我们提出了MMAC框架——一个系统化的框架，包括一个跨模态对齐的文化基准创建流程，以及一个五维评估协议，用于评估跨国家的文化差异、跨语言和跨模态的一致性，以及文化知识的泛化能力和基础验证有效性。鉴于当前模型中存在的西方文化偏见，我们选择8个亚洲国家作为数据集的基础，以便更清晰地揭示大语言模型中可能存在的文化缺陷。我们的数据集MMAC-bench包含27,000个由人类精心挑选的问题，这些问题涉及10种语言。重要的是，这是第一个在文本、图像和语音输入层面进行对齐的数据集，使得可以直接进行跨模态的迁移测试。每个问题都包含多个选择题，并附有开放式生成的解释，其中79%的问题需要基于文化背景的多步骤推理，而不仅仅是简单的记忆操作。我们探讨了模态差异的原因，为培育文化上稳健的大语言模型提供了见解。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Step-GRPO: Internalizing Dynamic Early Exit for Efficient Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 逐步调整GRPO：内部化动态提前退出机制以实现高效推理
papers.authors: Benteng Chen, Weida Wang, Shufei Zhang, Mingbao Lin, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models that use long chain-of-thought excel at problem-solving yet waste compute on redundant checks. Curbing this overthinking is hard: training-time length penalties can cripple ability, while inference-time early-exit adds system overhead. To bridge this gap, we propose Step-GRPO, a novel post-training framework that internalizes dynamic early-exit capabilities directly into the model. Step-GRPO shifts the optimization objective from raw tokens to semantic steps by utilizing linguistic markers to structure reasoning. We introduce a Dynamic Truncated Rollout mechanism that exposes the model to concise high-confidence trajectories during exploration, synergized with a Step-Aware Relative Reward that dynamically penalizes redundancy based on group-level baselines. Extensive experiments across three model sizes on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Step-GRPO achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off. On Qwen3-8B, our method reduces token consumption by 32.0% compared to the vanilla model while avoiding the accuracy degradation observed in traditional length-penalty methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 那些采用长思维链的大型推理模型在解决问题方面表现出色，但也会浪费大量计算资源在冗余的校验上。要减少这种过度思考是很困难的：训练时间的延长会严重限制模型的性能，而推理过程中的提前退出则会增加系统的运行负担。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了Step-GRPO这一新颖的后期训练框架。该框架通过将优化目标从原始标记转变为语义步骤，利用语言标记来构建推理过程。我们还引入了动态截断发布机制，使模型在探索过程中能够接触到简洁且高可信度的路径。此外，我们还采用了基于群体级基线的动态惩罚冗余机制的Step-Aware相对奖励机制。在三种不同规模的模型上进行的广泛实验表明，Step-GRPO在准确性和效率之间取得了更好的平衡。在Qwen3-8B模型中，与传统的方法相比，我们的方法减少了32.0%的标记消耗，同时避免了传统长度惩罚方法所出现的准确性下降问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Gold-Medal-Level Olympiad Geometry Solving with Efficient Heuristic Auxiliary Constructions
papers.title_zh: 金 Medal级奥林匹克几何竞赛——运用高效启发式辅助方法求解问题
papers.authors: Boyan Duan, Xiao Liang, Shuai Lu, Yaoxiang Wang, Yelong Shen, Kai-Wei Chang, Ying Nian Wu, Mao Yang, Weizhu Chen, Yeyun Gong
papers.abstract: Automated theorem proving in Euclidean geometry, particularly for International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) level problems, remains a major challenge and an important research focus in Artificial Intelligence. In this paper, we present a highly efficient method for geometry theorem proving that runs entirely on CPUs without relying on neural network–based inference. Our initial study shows that a simple random strategy for adding auxiliary points can achieve ”silver-medal” level human performance on IMO. Building on this, we propose HAGeo, a Heuristic-based method for adding Auxiliary points in Geometric deduction that solves 28 of 30 problems on the IMO-30 benchmark, achieving “gold-medal” level performance and surpassing AlphaGeometry, a competitive neural network–based approach, by a notable margin. To evaluate our method and existing approaches more comprehensively, we further construct HAGeo, a benchmark consisting of 409 geometry problems with human-assessed difficulty levels. Compared with the widely used IMO-30, our benchmark poses greater challenges and provides a more precise evaluation, setting a higher bar for geometry theorem proving.
papers.abstract_zh: 在欧几里得几何领域进行自动化定理证明，尤其是针对国际数学奥林匹克竞赛级别的题目，仍然是一个重大挑战，也是人工智能领域的重要研究方向。在本文中，我们提出了一种高效的几何定理证明方法，该方法完全可以在CPU上运行，无需依赖基于神经网络的推理机制。我们的初步研究表明，采用简单的随机添加辅助点的策略，就可以达到在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛中取得“银牌”级别的成绩。在此基础上，我们提出了HAGeo这一基于启发式的辅助点添加方法，它能够解决IMO-30基准测试中的30个问题中的28个，取得了“金牌”级别的性能，并且远远超过了基于神经网络的竞争性算法AlphaGeometry。为了更全面地评估我们的方法与现有方法，我们还构建了一个包含409道几何题的基准测试，这些题目的难度由人类进行评估。与广泛使用的IMO-30基准测试相比，我们的基准测试提出了更大的挑战，并提供了更精确的评估，为几何定理证明设定了更高的标准。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rethinking Jailbreak Detection of Large Vision Language Models with Representational Contrastive Scoring
papers.title_zh: 重新思考大型视觉语言模型中越狱检测机制的设计——基于表征对比评分方法
papers.authors: Peichun Hua, Hao Li, Shanghao Shi, Zhiyuan Yu, Ning Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are vulnerable to a growing array of multimodal jailbreak attacks, necessitating defenses that are both generalizable to novel threats and efficient for practical deployment. Many current strategies fall short, either targeting specific attack patterns, which limits generalization, or imposing high computational overhead. While lightweight anomaly-detection methods offer a promising direction, we find that their common one-class design tends to confuse unseen benign inputs with malicious ones, leading to unreliable over-rejection. To address this, we propose Representational Contrastive Scoring (RCS), a framework built on a key insight: the most potent safety signals reside within the LVLM’s own internal representations. Our approach inspects the internal geometry of these representations, learning a lightweight projection to maximally separate benign and malicious inputs in safety-critical layers. This enables a simple yet powerful contrastive score that differentiates true malicious intent from mere distribution shift. Our instantiations, MCD (Mahalanobis Contrastive Detection) and KCD (K-nearest Contrastive Detection), achieve state-of-the-art performance on a challenging evaluation protocol designed to test generalization to unseen attack types. This work demonstrates that effective jailbreak detection can be achieved by applying simple, interpretable statistical methods to the internal representations, offering a practical path towards safer LVLM deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）容易受到各种多模态越狱攻击的威胁，因此需要一些能够应对新型威胁且易于实际部署的防御机制。目前许多策略都存在不足：要么只针对特定的攻击模式，这限制了模型的泛化能力；要么需要较高的计算成本。虽然轻量级异常检测方法具有前景，但我们发现它们通常采用单类设计，这会导致将未见过的良性输入与恶意输入混淆，从而导致不可靠的过度拒绝。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了基于表征对比得分法（RCS）的框架。我们的核心思想是：最有效的安全信号存在于LVLM自身的内部表示中。我们的方法会检查这些内部表示的几何结构，并学习一种轻量级的投影方式，以在关键的安全层上最大限度地区分良性与恶意输入。这种方法能够提供一种简单而强大的对比得分法，从而区分真正的恶意意图和仅仅是分布偏移的情况。我们的实现方式——MCD（马哈兰诺比斯对比检测）和KCD（K最近邻对比检测）——在一项旨在测试对未知攻击类型泛化能力的挑战性评估协议中取得了领先的性能。这项工作表明，通过将简单的、可解释的统计方法应用于内部表示，可以实现有效的越狱检测，为更安全的LVLM部署提供了实用途径。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Digital Dunning-Kruger Effect: Decoupling Hallucinations via Geometric Hidden-state Observation for Semantic Truthfulness
papers.title_zh: 数字版的邓宁-克鲁格效应：通过几何隐状态观测技术分离幻觉与语义真实性问题
papers.authors: Yueheng Mao, Min Yu, Gengwang Li, Jianguo Jiang, Gang Li, Meng Zhang, Zhen Xu, Weiqing Huang, Ming Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate overconfident yet factually incorrect hallucinations. Current detection paradigms suffer from a trade-off between the high accuracy of computationally expensive black-box methods and the inability of white-box methods to detect stubborn hallucinations. To bridge this gap, we propose GHOST (Geometric Hidden-state Observation for Semantic Truthfulness), an efficient white-box framework for hallucination detection in LLMs. We primarily target confused hallucinations marked by internal reasoning instability, while also capturing stubborn hallucinations characterized by premature layer-wise convergence as a complementary signal. By integrating internal geometric dynamics with output probability distributions, GHOST constructs a high-dimensional feature space for non-linear truthfulness classification. Extensive evaluations on FinanceBench, RAGTruth, HaluEval, and PopQA show that GHOST outperforms white-box baselines and achieves competitive black-box performance while reducing computational overhead by over 90%, offering a robust solution for real-time detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常常产生那些过于自信但事实错误的幻觉。当前的检测方法面临着一个矛盾：一方面，计算成本较高的黑盒方法能够实现高精度检测；另一方面，白盒方法却无法有效识别那些顽固的幻觉。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了GHOST——一种用于检测LLM中幻觉的高效白盒框架。我们的重点是针对那些由内部推理不稳定引起的模糊幻觉进行检测，同时也会捕捉到那些因过早的逐层收敛而产生的顽固幻觉作为辅助信号。通过将内部几何动态与输出概率分布相结合，GHOST构建了一个高维特征空间，用于非线性意义上的真实性分类。在FinanceBench、RAGTruth、HaluEval和PopQA等数据集上的广泛评估表明，GHOST在性能上优于传统的白盒方法，并且在降低90%以上的计算开销的同时，仍能保持与黑盒方法相当的性能水平，为实时检测提供了可靠的解决方案。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: d-TreeRPO: Towards More Reliable Policy Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: d-TreeRPO：实现更可靠的扩散语言模型策略优化
papers.authors: Leyi Pan, Shuchang Tao, Yunpeng Zhai, Zheyu Fu, Liancheng Fang, Minghua He, Lingzhe Zhang, Zhaoyang Liu, Bolin Ding, Aiwei Liu, Lijie Wen
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is pivotal for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of diffusion large language models (dLLMs). However, existing dLLM policy optimization methods suffer from two critical reliability bottlenecks: (1) reward sparsity, arising from coarse or unverifiable signals that impede accurate advantage calculation; and (2) their probability estimates do not account for the gap to the unbiased expectation over all decoding orders, which are intractable to compute. To mitigate these issues, we propose d-TreeRPO, a reliable RL framework for dLLMs that leverages tree-structured rollouts and bottom-up advantage computation based on verifiable outcome rewards to provide fine-grained and verifiable step-wise reward signals. Furthermore, we provide a theoretical proof demonstrating that increasing prediction confidence effectively minimizes the gap between unbiased expected prediction probabilities and its single-step forward pass estimate. Guided by this analysis, we introduce a time-scheduled self-distillation loss during training that enhances prediction confidence in later training stages, thereby enabling more accurate probability estimation and better performance. Experiments demonstrate that d-TreeRPO outperforms existing baselines and achieves significant improvements across multiple reasoning benchmarks. Specifically, it achieves +86.2% on Sudoku, +51.6% on Countdown, +4.5% on GSM8K, and +5.3% on Math500 compared to the base model.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在提升扩散大语言模型的推理能力方面起着至关重要的作用。然而，现有的dLLM策略优化方法存在两个严重的可靠性瓶颈：(1) 奖励稀疏性，这是由于粗糙或不可验证的信号导致的，这阻碍了准确优势的计算；(2) 它们的概率估计没有考虑到与所有解码顺序下的无偏期望之间的差距，而这一差距难以计算。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了d-TreeRPO，这是一个可靠的dLLM强化学习框架，它利用树状结构的展开方式以及基于可验证结果奖励的自下而上的优势计算方式，提供细粒度且可验证的逐步奖励信号。此外，我们还提供了理论证明，表明提高预测置信度能够有效缩小无偏预期预测概率与其单步前向传递估计之间的差距。基于这一分析，我们在训练过程中引入了时间安排的自蒸馏损失，从而在后期的训练阶段提高预测置信度，进而实现更准确的概率估计和更好的性能。实验结果表明，d-TreeRPO在多个推理基准测试中均优于现有基线模型，并取得了显著的改进。具体来说，与基础模型相比，它在数独问题上的表现提高了86.2%，在倒计时问题上的表现提高了51.6%，在GSM8K问题上的表现提高了4.5%，在Math500问题上的表现提高了5.3%。

papers.title: Traffic-R1: Reinforced LLMs Bring Human-Like Reasoning to Traffic Signal Control Systems
papers.title_zh: 交通-R1：强大的大语言模型为交通信号灯控制系统带来类似人类的推理能力
papers.authors: Xingchen Zou, Yuhao Yang, Zheng Chen, Xixuan Hao, Yiqi Chen, Chao Huang, Yuxuan Liang
papers.abstract: We introduce Traffic-R1, a 3B-parameter foundation model with human-like reasoning for Traffic signal control (TSC), developed via self-exploration and iterative reinforcement of LLM with expert guidance in a simulated traffic environment. Compared with traditional reinforcement learning and recent LLM-based methods, Traffic-R1 offers three main advantages: zero-shot generalization, transferring unchanged to new road networks and out-of-distribution incidents by leveraging internal traffic-control policies and reasoning; a compact 3B-parameter design that supports real-time inference on mobile-class chips for edge deployment; and an explainable TSC process that enables multi-intersection coordination through communication and an asynchronous communication network. Extensive benchmarks show Traffic-R1 outperforms strong baselines and training-intensive RL controllers. In production, the model now manages signals affecting over 55,000 drivers daily, reduces average queue lengths by more than 5%, and halves operator workload. We will open source our checkpoint and code to foster further research.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了Traffic-R1模型，这是一个具有人类级推理能力的3个参数基础模型，专门用于交通信号控制。该模型通过自我探索以及结合专家指导对大语言模型进行迭代训练而得到开发，其运行环境为模拟的交通场景。与传统的强化学习方法和近期基于大语言模型的方法相比，Traffic-R1具有三大优势：零样本泛化能力、能够轻松应用于新的道路网络，并且能够利用内部交通控制策略进行推理处理；其紧凑的3个参数设计使得该模型能够在移动端芯片上实现实时推理，适用于边缘计算场景；此外，该模型还具备可解释性的交通信号控制机制，能够通过通信和异步通信网络实现多个交叉口的协同控制。大量的测试结果表明，Traffic-R1在性能上优于许多强大的基准模型以及那些需要大量训练的强化学习控制器。在实际应用中，该模型每天能够管理影响超过55,000名驾驶员的交通信号，平均排队时间减少了5%以上，同时还能将操作员的 workload 减少一半。我们将开源我们的训练数据及代码，以推动更多的研究工作的开展。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Nirvana: A Specialized Generalist Model With Task-Aware Memory Mechanism
papers.title_zh: 涅槃：一种以任务为导向的记忆机制为核心的多元化通用模型
papers.authors: Yuhua Jiang, Shuang Cheng, Yihao Liu, Ermo Hua, Che Jiang, Weigao Sun, Yu Cheng, Feifei Gao, Biqing Qi, Bowen Zhou
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at general language tasks but struggle in specialized domains. Specialized Generalist Models (SGMs) address this by preserving broad capabilities while adapting to target domains. However, existing architectures provide limited support for task-guided specialized memory mechanisms. In this work, we introduce Nirvana, an SGM featuring specialized memory, linear-time complexity, and test-time task information extraction. Central to Nirvana are: (1) Task-Aware Memory Trigger (\textit{Trigger}), which treats each input as a self-supervised fine-tuning task and adjusts task-related parameters on the fly; and (2) Specialized Memory Updater (\textit{Updater}), which dynamically consolidates task-relevant context. Nirvana matches or surpasses LLM baselines on general benchmarks and achieves the lowest perplexity across specialized domains including biomedicine, finance, and law. On the challenging task of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), we attach lightweight codecs to the frozen Nirvana backbone and fine-tune them on paired k-space signals and images. Nirvana achieves higher-fidelity reconstructions than conventional LLM-based models, with Trigger providing effective domain-specific adaptation. Ablation studies confirm that removing Trigger leads to substantial degradation across all tasks, underscoring its essential role in task-aware specialization. Models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/YuhuaJiang/nirvana. Code is available at https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/Nirvana.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在通用语言任务上表现出色，但在专业领域则表现不佳。专门化通用模型通过保留广泛的能力同时适应特定领域来解决这个问题。然而，现有的架构对基于任务的专门化记忆机制的支持有限。在这项研究中，我们提出了Nirvana——一种具有专门化记忆、线性时间复杂度以及能够在测试时提取任务信息的专门化通用模型。Nirvana的核心特性包括：(1) 任务感知记忆触发器，它将每个输入视为一个自监督的微调任务，并实时调整与任务相关的参数；(2) 专门化记忆更新器，它能够动态整合与任务相关的上下文信息。在通用基准测试中，Nirvana的表现优于其他语言模型基线，并且在包括生物医学、金融和法律在内的专业领域中取得了最低的困惑度。在磁共振成像这一具有挑战性的任务中，我们在固定的Nirvana模型中添加了轻量级编解码器，并通过配对的数据进行微调。Nirvana能够生成比传统基于语言模型的模型更高质量的重建结果，而记忆触发器则提供了有效的领域特定适应性。消融研究证实，移除记忆触发器会导致所有任务性能的显著下降，这凸显了其在任务感知专业化中的重要作用。该模型可以在https://huggingface.co/collections/YuhuaJiang/nirvana获取。代码可在https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/Nirvana下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BoYaEval: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models on Understanding Ancient Chinese Musical Scores
papers.title_zh: BoYaEval：在理解中国古代音乐谱本方面对多模态大语言模型进行评估
papers.authors: Jiajia Li, Weizhi Xue, Yao Yao, Qiwei Li, Chong Chen, Zuchao Li, Ping Wang, Hai Zhao
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general tasks but struggle with specialized, structured cultural symbols. We introduce BoYaEval, the first comprehensive benchmark dedicated to deciphering diverse Ancient Chinese musical notations, including five types of ancient Chinese music notation systems. These systems utilize unique spatial layouts and specialized ideograms to encode pitch and intricate playing techniques. BoYaEval comprises 3,175 high-quality images across these notation styles and establishes a three-tier evaluation: Structural Parsing (symbol recognition), Instructional Translation (technique mapping), and Musical Reasoning (melody derivation). We evaluate 21 leading MLLMs. Results indicate that while models perform adequately in basic recognition, they fail in cross-system compositional logic, scoring only around 27% on reasoning tasks. BoYaEval highlights the limitations of current MLLMs in processing diverse spatial-symbolic dependencies, bridging the gap between ancient wisdom and modern AI for digitizing intangible cultural heritage. The BoYaEval benchmark is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/MYTH-Lab/BoYaEval.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在通用任务上表现优异，但在处理专门化的、结构化的文化符号时却存在困难。我们推出了BoYaEval，这是首个专门用于解析多种古代中文乐谱的综合性基准测试，涵盖了五种古代中文音乐记谱系统。这些系统采用独特的空间布局和专业化的象形文字来编码音高和复杂的演奏技巧。BoYaEval包含了3,175张高质量的图片，涵盖了这些乐谱风格，并建立了三层评估体系：结构解析（符号识别）、教学转换（技巧映射）以及音乐推理（旋律推导）。我们对21种领先的MLLMs进行了评估。结果表明，虽然这些模型在基本识别任务上表现良好，但在跨系统组合逻辑方面却表现不佳，在推理任务上的得分仅为约27%。BoYaEval揭示了当前MLLMs在处理各种空间符号依赖关系方面的局限性，为将古代智慧与现代人工智能结合起来，以数字化非物质文化遗产提供了可能。BoYaEval基准测试可在此处免费获取：https://huggingface.co/datasets/MYTH-Lab/BoYaEval
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Rectifying the Emotional Flow: Aligning Priors and Dynamic Guidance for High-Arousal Text-to-Speech
papers.title_zh: 纠正情感上的偏差：使先验知识与动态指导相互协调，以实现更高唤醒度的文本转语音效果
papers.authors: Fangming Feng, Dongjie Fu, Zequn Xie, Yu Zhang, Yangyang Wu, Zhou Zhao, Tao Jin
papers.abstract: While diffusion and flow-matching models have advanced TTS, generating high-arousal emotions remains a persistent challenge due to the trade-off between stability and expressiveness. Existing systems often suffer from linguistic collapse when pursuing high intensity or fail to meet target emotional levels under stable settings. In this work, we identify that standard Gaussian initialization inevitably introduces a neutral prosody bias, while uniform Classifier-Free Guidance often distorts the acoustic manifold, leading to artifacts. To address this, we propose an inference framework that rectifies the emotional trajectory. An Emotion-Rectified Noise Prior injects a semantic gradient at initialization to align sampling with the target emotional manifold, and Likelihood-Inverse Guidance adaptively schedules guidance via a conditional/unconditional likelihood ratio, strengthening guidance only when the trajectory drifts toward a neutral fallback. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method effectively resolves the stability bottleneck in high-intensity scenarios, achieving superior linguistic accuracy and emotional fidelity without model retraining. Audio samples are available at https://showtts.github.io/emotionTTS/.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然扩散和流匹配模型已经提升了TTS的性能，但在稳定性和表现力之间寻找平衡时，生成高强度的情感仍然是一个持续的挑战。现有的系统往往会在追求高强度时出现语言崩溃的问题，或者在稳定环境下无法达到预期的情感水平。在这项研究中，我们发现标准的高斯初始化方式会不可避免地引入中性语调的偏差，而统一的无分类器引导方式则常常扭曲声学空间，导致噪声现象的出现。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种修正情感轨迹的推理框架。通过引入情感修正后的噪声先验，可以在初始化阶段注入语义梯度，使采样行为与目标情感空间保持一致；而似然逆引导则通过条件/无条件似然比来自适应地安排引导策略，只有当轨迹偏离中性状态时才加强引导力度。大量的实验表明，我们的方法能够有效地解决高强度场景中的稳定性问题，同时实现了更高的语言准确性和情感保真度，而无需对模型进行重新训练。音频样本可以在https://showtts.github.io/emotionTTS/下载。

papers.title: Perplexity-Aware Data Scaling Law: Perplexity Landscapes Predict Performance for Continual Pre-training
papers.title_zh: 应对困惑度的数据缩放法则：基于困惑度场景的持续预训练性能预测
papers.authors: Lei Liu, Hao Zhu, Xiaoyan Yang, Yue Shen, Zhixuan Chu, Jian Wang, Jinjie Gu, Kui Ren
papers.abstract: Continual Pre-training (CPT) serves as a fundamental approach for adapting foundation models to domain-specific applications. Scaling laws for pre-training define a power-law relationship between dataset size and the test loss of an LLM. However, the marginal gains from simply increasing data for CPT diminish rapidly, yielding suboptimal data utilization and inefficient training. To address this challenge, we propose a novel perplexity-aware data scaling law to establish a predictive relationship between the perplexity landscape of domain-specific data and the test loss. Our approach leverages the pre-trained model’s own perplexity on domain data as a proxy for estimating the knowledge gap, effectively quantifying the informational perplexity landscape of candidate training samples. By fitting this scaling law across diverse perplexity regimes, we enable adaptive selection of high-utility data subsets, prioritizing content that maximizes knowledge absorption while minimizing redundancy and noise. Extensive experiments on both medical and general-domain benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently identifies near-optimal training subsets, achieving superior performance with significantly reduced data consumption.
papers.abstract_zh: 持续预训练（CPT）是一种将基础模型适配到特定领域应用的基本方法。预训练的扩展规律表明，数据集规模与大语言模型测试损失之间存在幂律关系。然而，单纯增加数据用于CPT所带来的边际收益会逐渐下降，导致数据利用效率低下且训练过程不够高效。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于困惑度的数据扩展规律，以建立特定领域数据的困惑度与测试损失之间的预测关系。我们的方法利用预训练模型在领域数据上的困惑度作为估计知识差距的代理指标，从而有效量化候选训练样本的信息困惑度。通过在不同困惑度环境下应用这一扩展规律，我们能够自适应选择具有高实用性的数据子集，优先选择那些能最大化知识吸收同时最小化冗余和噪声的数据。在医学和通用领域基准测试中的大量实验表明，我们的方法能够持续识别出近乎最优的训练子集，同时实现更出色的性能，并显著减少数据消耗。

papers.title: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models on CFMME: A Comprehensive Chinese Financial Multimodal Evaluation Dataset
papers.title_zh: 在CFMME上对大型视觉语言模型进行基准测试：一个全面的中文金融多模态评估数据集
papers.authors: Qian Chen, Xianyin Zhang, Yanzhi Liu, Lifan Guo, Feng Chen, Chi Zhang
papers.abstract: The emergence of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) has substantially expanded model capabilities beyond text-only understanding, enabling unified inference across both visual and textual modalities and supporting a broader range of real-world applications. To comprehensively evaluate the perception, understanding, reasoning, and cognition capabilities of LVLMs throughout the entire financial business workflow in Chinese contexts, we introduce CFMME, a novel Chinese financial multimodal evaluation benchmark. CFMME comprises 6,052 instances spanning from fundamental academic knowledge to complex real-world applications, covering eight primary financial image modalities and four core multimodal tasks. On CFMME, we conduct a thorough evaluation of representative LVLMs. The results show that the state-of-the-art model attains an overall accuracy of 66.11% on the question answering task and an average score of 77.18 on the detection, recognition, and information extraction tasks, indicating substantial room for improvement in current LVLMs. In addition, we conduct detailed analyses of error causes, cross-modal capabilities, and multi-orientation settings, yielding valuable insights for future research. We hope that CFMME will spur further progress in LVLMs, especially by improving their performance on multiple multimodal tasks in the financial domain.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型的出现极大地扩展了模型的能力，使其不仅能理解文本信息，还能在视觉和文本两种模态之间进行统一的推理处理，从而支持更多现实世界中的应用。为了全面评估大型视觉-语言模型在中国语境下的感知、理解、推理和认知能力，我们提出了CFMME这一新的中文金融多模态评估基准。CFMME包含6,052个实例，涵盖了从基础学术知识到复杂的现实世界应用的各种场景，涉及八种主要的金融图像模态和四种核心的多模态任务。通过对CFMME进行评估，我们发现现有的最先进的模型在问答任务上的整体准确率达到了66.11%，在检测、识别和信息提取任务上的平均得分为77.18，这表明当前的大型视觉-语言模型还有很大的改进空间。此外，我们还对错误原因、跨模态能力和多方向设置进行了详细分析，为未来的研究提供了宝贵的见解。我们希望CFMME能够进一步推动大型视觉-语言模型的发展，尤其是在提高它们在金融领域多种多模态任务上的性能方面。

papers.title: AutoReproduce: Automatic AI Experiment Reproduction with Paper Lineage
papers.title_zh: 自动复制：能够自动进行AI实验的复制，并保留原始数据链
papers.authors: Xuanle Zhao, Zilin Sang, Yuxuan Li, Qi Shi, Weilun Zhao, Shuo Wang, Duzhen Zhang, Xu Han, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Efficient reproduction of research papers is pivotal to accelerating scientific progress. However, the increasing complexity of proposed methods often renders reproduction a labor-intensive endeavor, necessitating profound domain expertise.To address this, we introduce the paper lineage, which systematically mines implicit knowledge from the cited literature. This algorithm serves as the backbone of our proposed , a multi-agent framework designed to autonomously reproduce experimental code in a complete, end-to-end manner. To ensure code executability, incorporates a sampling-based unit testing strategy for rapid validation. To assess reproduction capabilities, we introduce , a benchmark featuring verified implementations, alongside comprehensive metrics for evaluating both reproduction and execution fidelity. Extensive evaluations on PaperBench and demonstrate that consistently surpasses existing baselines across all metrics. Notably, it yields substantial improvements in reproduction fidelity and final execution performance. The code is available at https://github.com/AI9Stars/AutoReproduce.
papers.abstract_zh: 高效的研究论文复现对于加速科学进步至关重要。然而，所提出方法的复杂性日益增加，使得复现工作变得非常繁琐，需要深厚的领域专业知识。为了应对这一问题，我们引入了论文谱系技术，该技术能够系统地挖掘引用文献中的隐含知识。这一算法是我们提出的多智能体框架的核心组成部分，该框架旨在以完整、端到端的方式自动复现实验代码。为了确保代码的可执行性，我们采用了基于抽样的单元测试策略，以实现快速验证。为了评估复现能力，我们创建了一个包含经过验证的实现方式的基准测试，并提供了全面的指标来评估复现性和执行准确性。在PaperBench上的广泛测试表明，该算法在所有指标上均优于现有基线方案。值得注意的是，它在复现准确性和最终执行性能方面取得了显著改进。该代码的下载链接为：https://github.com/AI9Stars/AutoReproduce。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: How Can Synthetic Data Improve Multilingual Language Model Pretraining? A Data Quality Perspective
papers.title_zh: 合成数据如何提升多语言模型预训练的效果？从数据质量的角度来看
papers.authors: Tongyao Zhu, Qian Liu, Chang Ma, Jinghan Zhang, Longxu Dou, Junxian He, Shiqi Chen
papers.abstract: Low-resource languages challenge multilingual LLMs due to limited high-quality training data, leading to weaker performance on complex reasoning and knowledge tasks. To address this, we propose improving training data quality through data synthesis, moving beyond simple resource scaling. First, we introduce SynTrans, which translates high-quality, knowledge-rich English data into low-resource languages during pre-training to inject world knowledge, though at the cost of semantic fluency. To overcome low-quality data issues while maintaining fluency, we also propose SynRank. SynRank leverages synthetic data as positive samples to train a classifier that ranks and filters noisy real-world data, enabling the extraction of high-quality subsets without expensive human cleaning. Experiments show SynRank matches handcrafted rule-based filtering by human experts and significantly improves knowledge-intensive task performance at the same filtering rate. Remarkably, higher filtering rates even improve performance with less data, demonstrating the efficiency and effectiveness of our method, surpassing expert filtering. Lastly, we introduce DA-QwenScore, a training-free metric that evaluates corpus quality by normalizing model loss with diversity measures, further enhancing evaluation efficiency. Our insights into knowledge injection could advance low-resource multilingual LLM development.
papers.abstract_zh: 低资源语言由于高质量训练数据的有限性，给多语言大语言模型带来了挑战，导致它们在复杂推理和知识任务上的表现较弱。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了通过数据合成来提高训练数据质量的方法，从而超越简单的资源扩展方式。首先，我们引入了SynTrans技术，该技术在预训练阶段将高质量的、富含知识的英语数据翻译成低资源语言，从而注入世界知识，但代价是牺牲了语义流畅性。为了在保持语义流畅性的同时解决低质量数据的问题，我们还提出了SynRank技术。SynRank利用合成数据作为正样本来训练一个分类器，从而对噪声的现实世界数据进行排序和过滤，从而实现无需人工大量清理即可提取出高质量的数据子集。实验表明，SynRank在过滤效率方面与人类专家手工制定的基于规则的过滤方法相当，并且在知识密集型任务上的表现也显著提升。值得注意的是，更高的过滤效率甚至能够在较少的数据情况下提升性能，这证明了我们方法的效率和有效性，其效果超过了专家级过滤方法。最后，我们引入了DA-QwenScore这一无训练过程的评估指标，该指标通过结合多样性度量来标准化模型损失来评估语料库的质量，从而进一步提升评估的效率。我们对知识注入的洞察可能有助于推动低资源多语言大语言模型的开发。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Infer Causal Relationships from Real-World Text?
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否从现实文本中推断出因果关系？
papers.authors: Ryan Saklad, Aman Chadha, Oleg V. Pavlov, Raha Moraffah
papers.abstract: Understanding and inferring causal relationships from texts is a core aspect of human cognition and is essential for advancing large language models (LLMs) towards artificial general intelligence. Existing work evaluating LLM causal reasoning primarily relies on synthetic or simplified texts with explicitly stated causal relationships. These texts typically feature short passages and few causal relations, failing to reflect the complexities of real-world reasoning. In this paper, we investigate whether LLMs are capable of inferring causal relationships from real-world texts. We develop a benchmark drawn from real-world academic literature, which includes diverse texts with respect to length, complexity (different levels of explicitness, number of causal events and relationships), and domain. To the best of our knowledge, our benchmark is the first-ever real-world dataset for this task. Our experiments on this dataset show that LLMs face significant challenges in inferring causal relationships from real-world text, with the best-performing model achieving an average F_1 score of only 0.535. Through systematic analysis across aspects of real-world text (explicitness, number of causal events and relationships, length of text, domain), our benchmark offers targeted insights for further research into advancing LLM causal reasoning. Our code and dataset can be found at https://github.com/Ryan-Saklad/ReCITE.
papers.abstract_zh: 从文本中理解和推断因果关系是人类认知的核心方面，对于推动大语言模型向通用人工智能的发展至关重要。目前评估大语言模型因果推理能力的研究主要依赖于那些明确标注了因果关系的合成或简化文本。这些文本通常只包含简短的段落和少量的因果关系，无法反映现实世界中的复杂推理情况。在本文中，我们探讨了大语言模型是否能够从现实世界的文本中推断出因果关系。我们开发了一个基于真实世界学术文献的基准数据集，该数据集包含了不同长度、复杂程度（不同层次的明确性、因果事件和关系的数量）以及领域的多样化文本。据我们所知，这个基准数据集是首个用于此任务的真实世界数据集。我们在该数据集上的实验表明，大语言模型在推断现实世界文本中的因果关系方面面临重大挑战，表现最好的模型平均F_1分数仅为0.535。通过对现实世界文本的各个方面的系统分析（明确性、因果事件和关系的数量、文本长度、领域），我们的基准数据集为进一步研究大语言模型的因果推理提供了有价值的见解。我们的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/Ryan-Saklad/ReCITE找到。

papers.title: Distributional Clarity: The Hidden Driver of RL-Friendliness in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 分布清晰度：大型语言模型中“友好性”的隐藏驱动因素
papers.authors: Shaoning Sun, Mingzhu Cai, Huang He, Bingjin Chen, Siqi Bao, Yujiu Yang, Hua Wu, Haifeng Wang
papers.abstract: Language model families exhibit striking disparity in their capacity to benefit from reinforcement learning: under identical training, models like Qwen achieve substantial gains, while others like Llama yield limited improvements. Complementing data-centric approaches, we reveal that this disparity reflects a hidden structural property: distributional clarity in probability space. Through a three-stage analysis—from phenomenon to mechanism to interpretation—we uncover that RL-friendly models exhibit intra-class compactness and inter-class separation in their probability assignments to correct vs. incorrect responses. We quantify this clarity using the Silhouette Coefficient (S) and demonstrate that (1) high S correlates strongly with RL performance; (2) low S is associated with severe logic errors and reasoning instability. To confirm this property, we introduce a Silhouette-Aware Reweighting strategy that prioritizes low-S samples during training. Experiments across six mathematical benchmarks show consistent improvements across all model families, with gains up to 5.9 points on AIME24. Our work establishes distributional clarity as a fundamental, trainable property underlying RL-Friendliness.
papers.abstract_zh: 不同语言模型在利用强化学习方面表现出显著的差异：在相同的训练条件下，像Qwen这样的模型能够取得显著的进步，而像Llama这样的模型则只能获得有限的改进。除了以数据为驱动的方法之外，我们发现这种差异实际上反映了一种隐藏的结构特性——概率空间中的分布清晰度。通过三个阶段的分析——从现象到机制再到解释——我们发现，适合强化学习的模型在正确与错误响应的概率分配上表现出类内紧凑性和类间分离性。我们通过使用轮廓系数来量化这种清晰度，并发现：(1)高轮廓系数与强化学习性能密切相关；(2)低轮廓系数则与严重的逻辑错误和推理不稳定性相关。为了验证这一特性，我们提出了一种基于轮廓系数的重新加权策略，该策略在训练过程中优先处理低轮廓系数的样本。在六个数学基准测试中的实验表明，所有模型家族都取得了持续的改进，其中在AIME24上的得分提高了5.9分。我们的研究确立了分布清晰度作为强化学习友好性的一个基本且可训练的特性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ReasonRank: Empowering Passage Ranking with Strong Reasoning Ability
papers.title_zh: ReasonRank：通过强大的推理能力来实现段落排序的优化
papers.authors: Wenhan Liu, Xinyu Ma, Weiwei Sun, Yutao Zhu, Yuchen Li, Dawei Yin, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) based listwise ranking has shown superior performance in many passage ranking tasks. With the development of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), many studies have demonstrated that step-by-step reasoning during test-time helps improve listwise ranking performance. However, due to the scarcity of reasoning-intensive training data, existing rerankers perform poorly in many complex ranking scenarios, and the ranking ability of reasoning-intensive rerankers remains largely underdeveloped. In this paper, we first propose an automated reasoning-intensive training data synthesis framework, which sources training queries and passages from diverse domains and applies DeepSeek-R1 to generate high-quality training labels. To empower the listwise reranker with strong reasoning ability, we further propose a two-stage training approach, which includes a cold-start supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage and a reinforcement learning (RL) stage. During the RL stage, we design a novel multi-view ranking reward tailored to the multi-turn nature of listwise ranking. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our trained reasoning-intensive reranker ReasonRank outperforms existing baselines significantly and also achieves much lower latency than the pointwise reranker.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的列表排序方法在许多段落排序任务中表现出色。随着大型推理模型（LRM）的发展，许多研究表明，在测试过程中进行逐步推理有助于提升列表排序性能。然而，由于推理型训练数据的稀缺性，现有的重排序算法在许多复杂的排序场景中表现不佳，而推理型重排序算法的排序能力仍然没有得到充分开发。在本文中，我们首先提出了一个自动化的推理型训练数据合成框架，该框架从不同领域获取训练查询和段落，并应用DeepSeek-R1生成高质量的训练标签。为了赋予列表重排序算法强大的推理能力，我们进一步提出了一种两阶段训练方法，包括冷启动监督式微调（SFT）阶段和强化学习（RL）阶段。在RL阶段，我们设计了一种针对列表排序多轮性质的新颖多视图排序奖励机制。大量实验表明，我们训练的推理型重排序算法ReasonRank显著优于现有基线算法，并且其延迟也远低于点式重排序算法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ATIR: Towards Audio-Text Interleaved Contextual Retrieval
papers.title_zh: ATIR：面向音频-文本混合情境检索技术
papers.authors: Tong Zhao, Chenghao Zhang, Yutao Zhu, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Audio carries richer information than text, including emotion, speaker traits, and environmental context, while also enabling lower-latency processing compared to speech-to-text pipelines. However, recent multimodal information retrieval research has predominantly focused on images, largely overlooking audio, especially in the setting of interleaved audio-text contextual retrieval. In this work, we introduce the Audio-Text Interleaved contextual Retrieval (ATIR) task, where queries can alternate between audio and text modalities. We construct an ATIR benchmark by integrating several Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), QA, and retrieval datasets, ultimately unifying four types of contextual retrieval tasks. This benchmark substantially addresses the limitations of existing audio retrieval datasets in semantic retrieval. To study this task, we evaluate several off-the-shelf retrievers and train our ATIR model based on a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM). We further propose a novel token compression mechanism, which is orthogonal to existing compression methods, to mitigate the challenge of excessive audio tokens in MLLM-based ATIR models. Experimental results show that our ATIR model achieves significant improvements over strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 音频所携带的信息比文本更为丰富，包括情感、说话者的特征以及环境背景等信息。此外，与语音转文字流程相比，音频处理所需的延迟更低。然而，最近的多模态信息检索研究主要集中在图像上，而忽略了音频的重要性，尤其是在音频-文本混合的上下文检索场景中。在这项研究中，我们提出了音频-文本混合上下文检索任务，即查询可以同时涉及音频和文本两种模态。我们通过整合多个自动语音识别、问答以及检索数据集来构建该基准测试，从而将四种类型的上下文检索任务统一起来。这一基准测试显著改善了现有音频检索数据集在语义检索方面的局限性。为了研究这项任务，我们评估了多种现成的检索算法，并基于多模态大语言模型训练我们的音频-文本混合上下文检索模型。我们还提出了一种新颖的令牌压缩机制，该机制与现有的压缩方法不同，旨在解决基于多模态大语言模型的音频令牌过多所带来的挑战。实验结果表明，我们的音频-文本混合上下文检索模型相较于强大的基线模型取得了显著的改进。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Task-Aware LLM Routing with Multi-Level Task-Profile-Guided Data Synthesis for Cold-Start Scenarios
papers.title_zh: 针对冷启动场景的、基于多层任务配置文件引导的数据合成方法，用于任务感知的大语言模型路由处理
papers.authors: Hui Liu, Bin Zou, Kecheng Chen, Jie Liu, Wenya Wang, Haoliang Li
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit substantial variability in performance and computational cost across tasks and queries, motivating routing systems that select models to meet user-specific cost–performance trade-offs. However, existing routers generalize poorly in cold-start scenarios where in-domain training data is unavailable. We address this limitation with a multi-level task-profile–guided data synthesis framework that constructs a hierarchical task taxonomy and produces diverse question–answer pairs to approximate the test-time query distribution. Building on this, we introduce TRouter, a task-type–aware router approach that models query-conditioned cost and performance via latent task-type variables, with prior regularization derived from the synthesized task taxonomy. This design enhances TRouter’s routing utility under both cold-start and in-domain settings. Across multiple benchmarks, we show that our synthesis framework alleviates cold-start issues and that TRouter delivers effective LLM routing.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在任务和处理方式上的表现及计算成本存在显著差异，这促使人们开发路由系统来选择合适的模型，以满足用户特定的成本与性能权衡需求。然而，现有的路由系统在缺乏领域训练数据的冷启动场景中表现不佳。我们提出了一种多层次任务类型引导的数据合成框架来解决这个问题，该框架构建了一个分层化的任务分类体系，并生成多样化的问答对以模拟测试时的查询分布。在此基础上，我们提出了TRouter这一基于任务类型的路由方法。该方法通过潜在的任务类型变量来模拟查询相关的成本和性能，同时利用从合成的任务分类体系中得到的先验信息来进行正则化处理。这种设计使得TRouter在冷启动和领域训练环境下都能表现出良好的路由效果。通过多个基准测试，我们发现我们的合成框架能够有效解决冷启动问题，而TRouter也能为大语言模型的路由提供有效的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SelFusion: Self-distillation for Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: SelFusion：用于扩散语言模型的自我蒸馏技术
papers.authors: Hyeongsoo Lim, Jinyoung Kim, Eun Seo Seo, Min Ho Jang, Ji Won Yoon
papers.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) alleviate the inherent latency bottleneck of autoregressive (AR) large language models (LLMs), but their degraded generation quality limits practical applicability. Although knowledge distillation (KD) can be a promising direction for improving performance, we empirically find that naively applying conventional KD yields only marginal gains, or even degrades generation quality. Based on these observations, we propose a novel self-distillation framework for DLMs, namely SelFusion. To enable effective KD without an external teacher model, SelFusion performs two forward passes with different masking levels, defining the hard mode with a larger masking probability and the easy mode with a smaller masking probability. However, the easy mode is not always more accurate than the hard mode and can be overconfident on incorrect tokens. Thus, we introduce bidirectional KD between the two modes, which can dynamically determine the distillation direction based on token-level correctness. Experimental results on instruction-following tasks show that the proposed self-distillation substantially outperforms other KD methods with external LLM and DLM teachers. In many configurations, the student trained with SelFusion even surpasses the performance of the LLM teacher, providing a practical path toward improving DLM generation quality. Source code can be found at https://github.com/scai-research/SelFusion_official
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）能够缓解自回归大语言模型（LLM）固有的延迟瓶颈问题，但其生成的文本质量有所下降，这限制了其实际应用价值。虽然知识蒸馏（KD）是一种提高性能的有效方法，但我们的实验表明，单纯应用传统KD方法往往只能获得微小的改进，甚至会导致生成质量的下降。基于这些观察结果，我们提出了一种针对DLM的新型自蒸馏框架——SelFusion。为了在不依赖外部教师模型的情况下实现有效的KD，SelFusion采用了两种不同掩码级别的前向处理：硬模式采用较高的掩码概率，而软模式则采用较低的掩码概率。然而，软模式并不总是比硬模式更准确，它可能会在处理错误样本时过于自信。因此，我们在这两种模式之间引入了双向KD机制，该机制可以根据token级别的准确性动态确定蒸馏方向。在指令遵循任务上的实验结果表明，所提出的自蒸馏方法在性能上显著优于其他需要外部LLM和DLM教师的KD方法。在许多配置下，使用SelFusion训练出的模型甚至能超越使用LLM教师训练的模型，这为提升DLM生成质量提供了切实可行的途径。源代码可访问https://github.com/scai-research/SelFusion_official
