papers.title: Benchmarking Web Agent Safety under E-commerce Deceptive Interfaces
papers.title_zh: 在电子商务欺骗性界面环境下，对网络代理安全性的对比分析
papers.authors: Zijing Shi, Meng Fang, Ling Chen
papers.abstract: As autonomous web agents are increasingly deployed to perform real-world tasks, ensuring their safety has become a critical concern. In this work, we study web agent behavior under realistic deceptive interfaces in the e-commerce domain. We introduce WebDecept, a lightweight and configurable plugin framework that enables controlled injection of deceptive interface patterns into existing web environments. Using WebDecept, we instantiate seven deceptive patterns commonly observed on the open web, including targeted advertisements, domain redirection, and shopping manipulation. By injecting these patterns into the frontend during task execution, we perform controlled evaluation of multiple multimodal web agents. Our results show that current web agents are highly susceptible to multiple classes of deceptive interfaces, and that prompt-based constraints are often insufficient to mitigate these failures. We further analyze how the design choices of deceptive patterns influence the success of such manipulations. These findings highlight safety challenges that should be addressed as web agents are scaled toward real-world deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着自主网络代理被越来越多地用于执行现实世界中的任务，确保其安全性已成为一个至关重要的问题。在这项研究中，我们探讨了在电子商务领域出现的各种欺骗性界面下网络代理的行为。我们提出了WebDecept这一轻量级且可配置的插件框架，它能够将欺骗性界面模式可控地注入到现有的网络环境中。利用WebDecept，我们模拟了在开放网络上常见的七种欺骗性模式，包括定向广告、域名重定向以及购物操纵等。通过在任务执行过程中将这些模式注入到前端代码中，我们对多个多模态网络代理进行了控制性的评估。我们的研究结果表明，当前的网络代理极易受到各类欺骗性界面的攻击，而基于提示的约束往往不足以有效防止这些攻击。我们还分析了欺骗性模式的设计选择如何影响此类操纵行为的成功程度。这些发现揭示了在将网络代理扩展到现实世界部署过程中需要解决的安全问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Counteracting the Matthew Effect in Self-Improvement of LVLMs through Head-Tail Re-balancing
papers.title_zh: 通过平衡头部与尾部来对抗“马太效应”，从而提升小型企业的自我改进能力
papers.authors: Xin Guo, Zhiheng Xi, Yiwen Ding, Yitao Zhai, Xiaowei Shi, Xunliang Cai, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Self-improvement has emerged as a mainstream paradigm for advancing the reasoning capabilities of large vision–language models (LVLMs), where models explore and learn from successful trajectories iteratively. However, we identify a critical imbalance during this process: the model readily generates high-quality trajectories for simple queries (i.e., head data) but struggles with complex ones (i.e., tail data). This bias drives the optimization to disproportionately prioritize simple reasoning skills, while inhibiting the acquisition of complex capabilities. As iterations progress, this imbalance becomes more acute—a dynamic we term the “Matthew effect”, ultimately stalling performance gains. To mitigate this, we approach head-tail re-balance during the exploration-and-learning process from two perspectives: distribution-reshaping and trajectory-resampling. Extensive experiments on Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct and InternVL2.5-4B models across visual reasoning tasks demonstrate that our methods consistently improve visual reasoning capabilities, outperforming vanilla self-improvement baselines by an average of 3.86 points.
papers.abstract_zh: 自我提升已成为提升大型视觉语言模型推理能力的主流方法。在这些模型中，模型会不断尝试并学习成功的路径。然而，我们发现这一过程中存在一个关键的不平衡问题：模型能够轻松生成适用于简单查询的高质量路径（即头部数据），但在处理复杂查询时却表现不佳（即尾部数据）。这种偏见导致优化过程过度强调简单的推理技能，而阻碍了复杂能力的培养。随着迭代的进行，这种不平衡现象愈发严重——我们将这种现象称为“马太效应”，最终会阻碍性能的提升。为了缓解这一问题，我们在探索与学习过程中从两个角度来平衡头部和尾部数据的比例：重新调整分布和进行路径采样。在Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct以及InternVL2.5-4B模型上进行的广泛实验表明，我们的方法能够持续提升视觉推理能力，其性能平均比传统的自我提升方法高出3.86个百分点。

papers.title: MAGIC: Deep Geometric Evolution with Structural Consensus for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 魔法：基于几何形态演变的时间序列知识图谱推理方法，以实现结构上的共识
papers.authors: Chengao Liu, Yuan Li, Yingze Wang, Jianbin Jiao
papers.abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) reasoning remains challenging to characterize with conventional flat representations due to its intrinsic heterogeneous structure. Existing multi-geometry approaches face two key bottlenecks: 1) the Riemannian depth barrier driven by numerical instability, which restricts models to shallow architectures; and 2) gate collapse, where adaptive fusion mechanisms suffer from gradient starvation and degenerate into single-geometry solutions. To this end, we propose MAGIC (Multi-geometry Annealing Graph Interaction with Consensus). Our framework introduces a Tangent-Residual Engine in multi-geometric spaces, which enables the first stable 8-layer geometric evolution and reveals a phenomenon termed Geometric Annealing, where manifold curvature spontaneously evolves from semantic flatness in shallow layers to structural complexity in deeper layers. We further design an explicit reasoning module with structural consensus, leveraging geometric invariants and structural priors to regulate gradient flow, prevent collapse, and ensure robust synergy across Hyperbolic, Spherical, and Euclidean spaces. Experiments show that MAGIC achieves state-of-the-art performance in TKG reasoning, improving MRR by up to 2.9 points.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于时间知识图谱的固有异构结构，使用传统的平面表示方式来描述其推理过程仍然具有挑战性。现有的多几何方法面临两个主要瓶颈：1）由数值不稳定性引起的黎曼深度障碍，这限制了模型只能采用浅层架构；2）门限崩溃问题，即自适应融合机制因梯度匮乏而退化为单一几何形态的解。为此，我们提出了MAGIC（带有共识的多几何退火图交互算法）。我们的框架在多几何空间中引入了一个切线残差引擎，使得首次实现了稳定的8层几何演化过程。此外，我们还设计了一个具有结构共识的显式推理模块，利用几何不变量和结构先验来调节梯度流动，防止崩溃，并确保在双曲、球面与欧几里得空间之间实现稳健的协同作用。实验表明，MAGIC在时间知识图谱推理方面取得了领先的性能，将MRR提升了高达2.9个分数。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MACS: Modality-Aware Capacity Scaling for Efficient Multimodal MoE Inference
papers.title_zh: MACS：基于模式感知的容量扩展技术，以实现高效的多模态模型推理
papers.authors: Bo Li, Chuan Wu, Shaolin Zhu
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts Multimodal Large Language Models (MoE MLLMs) suffer from a significant efficiency bottleneck during Expert Parallelism (EP) inference due to the straggler effect. This issue is worsened in the multimodal context, as existing token-count-based load balancing methods fail to address two unique challenges: (1) Information Heterogeneity, where numerous redundant visual tokens are treated equally to semantically critical ones, and (2) Modality Dynamics, where varying visual to text ratios across tasks lead to resource misallocation. To address these challenges, we propose MACS (Modality-Aware Capacity Scaling), a training-free inference framework. Specifically, MACS introduces an Entropy-Weighted Load mechanism to quantify the semantic value of visual tokens, addressing information heterogeneity. Additionally, the Dynamic Modality-Adaptive Capacity mechanism allocates expert resources based on the real-time modal composition of the input. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MACS significantly outperforms existing methods on various multimodal benchmarks, providing a novel and robust solution for the efficient deployment of MoE MLLMs in EP inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合多模态大语言模型在专家并行推理过程中存在显著的效率瓶颈，这是由于“拖尾效应”导致的。在多模态环境下，这一问题更为严重，因为现有的基于令牌数量的负载均衡方法无法解决两个独特的挑战：(1) 信息异质性问题，即许多冗余的视觉令牌被同等对待，而语义上至关重要的令牌却得不到重视；(2) 模态动态性问题，即不同任务中视觉与文本的比例变化会导致资源分配不当。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MACS（模态感知容量扩展）这一无需训练的推理框架。具体来说，MACS引入了熵加权负载机制，以量化视觉令牌的语义价值，从而解决信息异质性问题。此外，动态模态自适应容量机制能够根据输入数据的实时模态组合来分配专家资源。大量实验表明，MACS在各种多模态基准测试中的表现显著优于现有方法，为专家混合大语言模型在专家并行推理中的高效部署提供了一种新颖且可靠的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Efficient Prior-Guided Reasoning for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation under Conflicts
papers.title_zh: 在冲突情况下，高效的先验引导推理技术以实现稳健的检索增强生成
papers.authors: Xiaowei Yuan, Ziyang Huang, Zhao Yang, Yequan Wang, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard paradigm for grounding Large Language Models (LLMs) with external knowledge. However, RAG performance often degrades substantially when faced with noisy, outdated, or conflicting retrieved information. In this work, we empirically demonstrate that Prior-Guided Reasoning—a strategy that explicitly elicits the model’s parametric knowledge as prior information to guide reasoning on retrieved documents—effectively mitigates the impact of external conflicts. Building on this, we propose BrPr (Bernoulli-gated reinforcement learning for Prior-Guided reasoning), a framework that achieves robust performance across varying degrees of external inconsistency. Furthermore, by employing a Bernoulli-gated dropout mechanism during training, BrPr distills the prior-driven reasoning capability into the model parameters, enabling efficient latent reasoning without explicit prior generation. The experimental results demonstrate that BrPr consistently exhibits superior robustness to external conflicts and noise.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为为大语言模型提供外部知识的标准方法。然而，当遇到噪声较大、过时或相互矛盾的检索信息时，RAG的性能往往会显著下降。在这项研究中，我们通过实验证明，基于先验引导的推理策略——该策略明确提取模型的参数化知识作为先验信息来指导对检索到的文档的推理——能够有效缓解外部冲突的影响。在此基础上，我们提出了BrPr（用于先验引导推理的伯努利门控强化学习框架），该框架能够在不同程度的外部不一致性情况下保持稳健的性能。此外，通过在训练过程中使用伯努利门控dropout机制，BrPr将基于先验的推理能力融入到模型参数中，从而实现无需显式生成先验信息即可进行高效潜在推理。实验结果表明，BrPr在应对外部冲突和噪声方面表现出持续的卓越性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Markovian Linguistic-Temporal Bridge: Unlocking the Potential of LLMs for Time Series Forecasting
papers.title_zh: 马尔可夫语言时间桥梁：释放大语言模型在时间序列预测中的潜力
papers.authors: Siming Sun, Kai Zhang, Xuejun Jiang, Wenchao Meng, Qinmin Yang
papers.abstract: Adapting pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) for time series forecasting primarily relies on token-level linguistic-temporal alignment, leading to the stacking of logically disjointed tokens as input. While empirically effective, these methods overlook a fundamental capability of LLMs: modeling linguistic logic and structure, rather than merely processing token features. To address this limitation, we propose the \textbf{M}arkovian-\textbf{G}uided \textbf{S}tructure-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{A}lignment (\textbf{MGSAA}). Our core contribution is a framework that transcends pointwise feature matching to achieve global structural isomorphism between the linguistic and temporal domains. Specifically, MGSAA distills latent evolutionary patterns of language within LLMs into a Markovian state transition graph, which is transferred as a structural prior to the time series domain. Under this prior, time series patches are decoded into latent states and then aligned via state-constrained cross-attention. Ultimately, MGSAA generates a token sequence topologically isomorphic to the LLM’s inherent mental structure, reactivating its reasoning capabilities for forecasting. Comprehensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that MGSAA achieves state-of-the-art performance, providing an innovative solution for cross-modal alignment in LLM for time series forecasting. Code is available at https://github.com/sunzju/MGSAA.
papers.abstract_zh: 将预训练的大语言模型应用于时间序列预测，主要依赖于词元级别的语篇-时间对齐机制。这种机制会将逻辑上不相关的词元堆叠起来作为输入。虽然这种方法在实证上效果不错，但它忽略了大语言模型的一项核心能力：建模语言的逻辑和结构，而不仅仅是处理词元特征。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了**马尔可夫引导的结构感知对齐**方法。我们的核心贡献在于提出了一个框架，它能够超越逐点特征匹配，实现语篇领域与时间领域的全局结构同构。具体来说，MGSAA将大语言模型中隐藏的语言演化模式提炼成马尔可夫状态转移图，并将其作为结构先验应用于时间序列领域。在这种先验的框架下，时间序列片段会被解码成潜在状态，然后通过状态约束的交叉注意力机制进行对齐。最终，MGSAA生成的词元序列在拓扑上与大语言模型的固有思维结构同构，从而重新激活了其在预测任务中的推理能力。通过多个基准测试的全面评估表明，MGSAA取得了领先的性能水平，为大语言模型在时间序列预测中的跨模态对齐问题提供了创新的解决方案。代码可在https://github.com/sunzju/MGSAA获取。

papers.title: Template-assisted Contrastive Learning of Task-oriented Dialogue Sentence Embeddings
papers.title_zh: 基于模板的对比学习：用于任务导向式对话句子的嵌入表示学习
papers.authors: Minsik Oh, Jiwei Li, Guoyin Wang
papers.abstract: Learning high quality sentence embeddings from dialogues has drawn increasing attentions as it is essential to solve a variety of dialogue-oriented tasks with low annotation cost. Annotating and gathering utterance relationships in conversations are difficult, while token-level annotations, , entities, slots and templates, are much easier to obtain. Other sentence embedding methods are usually sentence-level self-supervised frameworks and cannot utilize token-level extra knowledge. We introduce Template-aware Dialogue Sentence Embedding (TaDSE), a novel augmentation method that utilizes template information to learn utterance embeddings via self-supervised contrastive learning framework. We further enhance the effect with a synthetically augmented dataset that diversifies utterance-template association, in which slot-filling is a preliminary step. We evaluate TaDSE performance on five downstream benchmark dialogue datasets. The experiment results show that TaDSE achieves significant improvements over previous SOTA methods for dialogue. We further introduce a novel analytic instrument of semantic compression test, for which we discover a correlation with uniformity and alignment. Our code is available at https://github.com/minsik-ai/Template-Contrastive-Embedding
papers.abstract_zh: 从对话中学习高质量的句子嵌入受到了越来越多的关注，因为这对于以较低的标注成本解决各种基于对话的任务至关重要。在对话中标注和收集话语关系是一件很困难的事情，而使用令牌级标注、实体、槽位和模板则相对容易得多。其他句子嵌入方法通常都是基于句子级的自我监督框架，无法利用令牌级的额外知识。我们提出了一种名为“模板感知对话句子嵌入”的新方法，该方法利用模板信息通过自我监督对比学习框架来学习话语嵌入。我们通过合成增强的数据集进一步提升了效果，该数据集能够多样化话语与模板的关联关系，其中槽位填充是一个初步步骤。我们在五个下游基准对话数据集上评估了TaDSE的性能。实验结果表明，TaDSE在对话任务上取得了比以往最先进的方法显著的改进。我们还引入了一种新的语义压缩测试工具，我们发现它与均匀性和一致性之间存在相关性。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/minsik-ai/Template-Contrastive-Embedding获取。

papers.title: MIRTH: Mutual-Information Reasoning with Temporal Hubs for Vision-Language-Action Agents
papers.title_zh: 趣闻：基于时间节点的互信息推理在视觉-语言-行动智能体中的应用
papers.authors: Hao Sun, Yu Song, Teng Shiyu, Ziwei Niu, Yen-wei Chen
papers.abstract: VLA models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring semantic knowledge from web-scale data to physical robotic control. However, current single-frame architectures suffer from intrinsic limitations: temporal myopia that discards historical dynamics, reasoning gaps between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and inference inefficiency due to autoregressive scalar decoding. In this work, we propose MIRTH, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. MIRTH augments a pretrained VLA backbone with three key innovations: (1) dual-scale temporal memory hubs that compress long-term scene evolution and short-term motion trends into compact embeddings; (2) latent reasoning tokens optimized via a mutual-information objective carving out a semantic plan space to align multimodal context with action trajectories; and (3) a parallel action decoding scheme that replaces autoregressive generation with vector-wise prediction to maximize control throughput. Extensive evaluations on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and a real-world LeRobot platform demonstrate that MIRTH achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibiting emergent error recovery capabilities. We will release our code and collected datasets to facilitate reproducible research in embodied AI upon publication.
papers.abstract_zh: VLA模型已成为将语义知识从网络级数据转移到物理机器人控制中的强大范式。然而，当前的单帧架构存在固有局限性：时间视角的缺失导致忽略了历史动态信息；高级指令与低级运动命令之间的推理存在差距；由于自回归标量解码方式导致的推理效率低下。在这项研究中，我们提出了MIRTH框架，旨在解决这些挑战。MIRTH通过三个关键创新来增强预训练的VLA框架：(1) 双尺度时间记忆模块，能够将长期场景演变和短期运动趋势压缩成紧凑的嵌入格式；(2) 通过互信息目标优化的潜在推理标记，从而构建出与动作轨迹相一致的语义规划空间；以及(3) 一种并行动作解码方案，用向量级预测替代自回归生成方式，以最大化控制效率。在LIBERO仿真基准测试和真实的LeRobot平台上的广泛测试表明，MIRTH取得了领先的性能表现，并展现了出色的错误恢复能力。我们计划在论文发表后公开我们的代码和收集的数据集，以便促进可复制的嵌入式人工智能研究。

papers.title: IRIS: Interleaved Reinforcement with Incremental Staged Curriculum for Cross-Lingual Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: IRIS：基于分阶段渐进式课程设计的混合强化学习系统，旨在促进跨语言数学推理能力的发展
papers.authors: Navya Gupta, Rishitej Reddy Vyalla, Avinash Anand, Chhavi Kirtani, Erik Cambria, Zhengchen Zhang, Zhengkui Wang, Timothy Liu, Aik Beng Ng, Simon See, Rajiv Ratn Shah
papers.abstract: Curriculum learning helps language models tackle complex reasoning by gradually increasing task difficulty. However, it often fails to generate consistent step-by-step reasoning, especially in multilingual and low-resource settings where cross-lingual transfer from English to Indian languages remains limited. We propose IRIS: Interleaved Reinforcement with Incremental Staged Curriculum, a two-axis framework that combines Supervised Fine-Tuning on progressively harder problems (vertical axis) with Reverse Curriculum Reinforcement Learning to reduce reliance on step-by-step guidance (horizontal axis). We design a composite reward combining correctness, step-wise alignment, continuity, and numeric incentives, optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We release CL-Math, a dataset of 29k problems with step-level annotations in English, Hindi, and Marathi. Across standard benchmarks and curated multilingual test sets, IRIS consistently improves performance, with strong results on math reasoning tasks and substantial gains in low-resource and bilingual settings, alongside modest improvements in high-resource languages. Our code and dataset will be publicly available at https://github.com/avinanand/IRIS-Interleaved-Reinforcement-
papers.abstract_zh: 课程学习有助于语言模型处理复杂的推理任务，通过逐步增加任务的难度来实现这一目标。然而，这种方法往往无法生成一致的、循序渐进的推理过程，尤其是在多语言和资源匮乏的情况下，英语与印度语之间的跨语言迁移仍然有限。我们提出了IRIS：交错强化与渐进式分阶段课程框架，该框架结合了针对更难问题的监督式微调（垂直轴）和反向课程强化学习，以减少对循序渐进指导的依赖（水平轴）。我们设计了一种综合奖励机制，综合考虑了正确性、逐步一致性、连续性和数值激励因素，并通过群体相对策略优化算法进行优化。我们发布了CL-Math数据集，包含29,000个带有英语、印地语和马拉地语步骤级注释的问题。在标准的基准测试以及精心挑选的多语言测试集上，IRIS始终能够提升性能，在数学推理任务上表现优异，在资源匮乏和双语环境中取得了显著进步，而在资源丰富的语言中则有所改善。我们的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/avinanand/IRIS-Interleaved-Reinforcement-网站上获取。

papers.title: FLARE: Fine-Grained Length-Aware Routing for Resource-Efficient Heterogeneous LLM Serving
papers.title_zh: FLARE：一种细粒度的长度感知路由算法，适用于资源高效的异构大语言模型服务场景
papers.authors: Yujia Fu, Heming Zhong, Dan Huang, Yutong Lu
papers.abstract: With the rapid proliferation of large language models (LLMs), model pools have become increasingly heterogeneous in both capability and efficiency. Larger LLMs can improve quality but incur higher latency and cost, while smaller LLMs are the opposite, making per-query model selection crucial in practice. This has spawned LLM routers that dispatch each query to an appropriate model. Existing routers lack fine-grained resource awareness across deployment settings, which degrades efficiency metrics in real-world serving. To this end, We propose FLARE, a length-centric, resource-aware multi-LLM routing framework that uses length-based models to estimate per-query latency and cost. FLARE formulates routing as a discrete multi-objective optimization problem to achieve efficient trade-off. Experiments show that FLARE reduces latency and cost by up to 68% and 75% while maintaining competitive accuracy, and can be easily applied to new datasets and LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的迅速普及，模型池在能力和效率方面变得越来越多样化。较大的LLM可以提高质量，但会带来更高的延迟和成本；而较小的LLM则相反，因此在实践中选择每个查询对应的模型变得至关重要。为此，人们开发了LLM路由器，它将每个查询分配给合适的模型。现有的路由器在部署设置中缺乏细粒度的资源感知能力，这会降低实际服务中的效率指标。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了FLARE这一以长度为中心的、具备资源感知能力的多LLM路由框架。该框架利用基于长度的模型来估算每个查询的延迟和成本。FLARE将路由问题转化为一个离散的多目标优化问题，以实现高效的权衡。实验表明，FLARE能够将延迟和成本分别降低68%和75%，同时还能保持较高的准确性。此外，FLARE还可以轻松应用于新的数据集和不同的LLM上。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MAESTRO: Meta-learning Adaptive Estimation of Scalarization Trade-offs for Reward Optimization
papers.title_zh: 大师：元学习——用于奖励优化的标量化权衡的自适应估计方法
papers.authors: Yang Zhao, Hepeng Wang, Xiao Ding, Yangou Ouyang, Bibo Cai, Kai Xiong, Jinglong Gao, Zhouhao Sun, Li Du, Bing Qin, Ting Liu
papers.abstract: Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as an efficient paradigm for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its efficacy is primarily confined to domains with verifiable ground truths. Extending GRPO to open-domain settings remains a critical challenge, as unconstrained generation entails multi-faceted and often conflicting objectives—such as creativity versus factuality—where rigid, static reward scalarization is inherently suboptimal. To address this, we propose MAESTRO (Meta-learning Adaptive Estimation of Scalarization Trade-offs for Reward Optimization), which introduces a meta-cognitive orchestration layer that treats reward scalarization as a dynamic latent policy, leveraging the model’s terminal hidden states as a semantic bottleneck to perceive task-specific priorities. We formulate this as a contextual bandit problem within a bi-level optimization framework, where a lightweight Conductor network co-evolves with the policy by utilizing group-relative advantages as a meta-reward signal. Across seven benchmarks, MAESTRO consistently outperforms single-reward and static multi-objective baselines, while preserving the efficiency advantages of GRPO, and in some settings even reducing redundant generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 群体相对策略优化（GRPO）已成为一种高效的方法，可用于调整大语言模型（LLM）的行为。不过，其有效性主要局限于那些具有可验证真实信息的领域。将GRPO扩展到开放领域仍然是一个重大挑战，因为无约束的生成过程涉及到多种相互冲突的目标——比如创造性与真实性之间的权衡。在这种情况下，传统的固定奖励标量化方法显然不够理想。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了MAESTRO算法。该算法引入了一个元认知协调层，将奖励标量化视为一个动态的策略，并利用模型的终端隐藏状态作为语义瓶颈，以感知特定任务的重要性。我们将这一机制描述为双层优化框架下的上下文变体问题，其中轻量级的Conductor网络通过利用群体相对优势作为元奖励信号，与策略共同进化。在七个基准测试中，MAESTRO始终优于单一奖励和静态多目标基线算法，同时保留了GRPO的效率优势，甚至在某些情况下减少了冗余的生成行为。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Bit-by-Bit: Progressive QAT Strategy with Outlier Channel Splitting for Stable Low-Bit LLMs
papers.title_zh: 逐步推进：基于异常通道分割的渐进式QAT策略，用于稳定运行的小比特数大型语言模型
papers.authors: Binxing Xu, Hao Gu, Lujun Li, Hao Wang, Bei Liu, Jiacheng Liu, Qiyuan Zhu, Xintong Yang, Chao Li, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: Training LLMs at ultra-low precision remains a formidable challenge. Direct low-bit QAT often suffers from convergence instability and substantial training costs, exacerbated by quantization noise from heavy-tailed outlier channels and error accumulation across layers. To address these issues, we present \text{Bit-by-Bit}, a progressive QAT framework with outlier channel splitting. Our approach integrates three key components: (1) block-wise progressive training that reduces precision stage by stage, ensuring stable initialization for low-bit optimization; (2) nested structure of integer quantization grids to enable a “train once, deploy any precision” paradigm, allowing a single model to support multiple bit-widths without retraining; (3) rounding-aware outlier channel splitting, which mitigates quantization error while acting as an identity transform that preserves the quantized outputs. Furthermore, we follow microscaling groups with E4M3 scales, capturing dynamic activation ranges in alignment with OCP/NVIDIA standards. To address the lack of efficient 2-bit kernels, we developed custom operators for both W2A2 and W2A16 configurations, achieving up to 11\times speedup over BF16. Under W2A2 settings, \text{Bit-by-Bit} significantly outperforms baselines like BitDistiller and EfficientQAT on both Llama2/3, achieving a loss of only 2.25 WikiText2 PPL compared to full-precision models.
papers.abstract_zh: 在极低精度下训练大语言模型仍然是一个巨大的挑战。直接低位量的QAT通常会出现收敛不稳定性的问题，而且训练成本也非常高，再加上来自极端异常通道的量化噪声以及各层之间的误差累积问题，使得问题更加复杂。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了\text{Bit-by-Bit}方法，这是一种渐进式的QAT框架，采用了异常通道分离技术。我们的方法包含三个关键组成部分：(1)分块渐进式训练，逐步降低精度要求，从而确保低位数优化的稳定性；(2)整数量化网格的嵌套结构，使得模型可以“一次训练，多种位数适用”，无需重新训练即可支持不同的位数；(3)考虑四舍五入的异常通道分离技术，能够有效减少量化误差，同时作为恒等变换，保持量化后的输出结果不变。此外，我们采用E4M3规模的微集群结构，能够捕捉动态激活范围，符合OCP/NVIDIA标准。为了解决缺乏高效2位数核的问题，我们为W2A2和W2A16配置开发了自定义算子，其性能比BF16提升了11倍。在W2A2设置下，\text{Bit-by-Bit}方法的性能明显优于BitDistiller和EfficientQAT等基线算法，在Llama2/3上的损失仅为2.25 WikiText2 PPL，相比全精度模型而言表现更为出色。

papers.title: OS-Symphony: A Holistic Framework for Robust and Generalist Computer-Using Agents
papers.title_zh: OS-Symphony：一种适用于强大且多功能的计算机使用代理的整体框架
papers.authors: Bowen Yang, Kaiming Jin, Zhenyu Wu, Zhaoyang Liu, Qiushi Sun, Zehao Li, JingJing Xie, Zhoumianze Liu, Fangzhi Xu, Kanzhi Cheng, Yian Wang, Qingyun Li, Yu Qiao, Zun Wang, Zichen Ding
papers.abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced Computer-Using Agents (CUAs), current agentic frameworks struggle with robustness in novel domains and long-horizon workflows due to the absence of visual-aware tutorial retrieval and the lack of granular control over historical visual context curation and pruning. To bridge these gaps, we introduce OS-Symphony, a holistic framework that comprises an Orchestrator coordinating two key innovations for robust automation: (1) a Reflection-Memory Agent that utilizes milestone-driven long-term memory to enable trajectory-level self-correction, effectively mitigating visual context loss in long-horizon tasks; (2) Versatile Tool Agents featuring a Multimodal Searcher that adopts a “SeeAct” paradigm to navigate a browser-based sandbox to synthesize live, visually aligned tutorials, thereby resolving fidelity issues in unseen scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that OS-Symphony delivers substantial performance gains across varying model scales, establishing new state-of-the-art results on three online benchmarks, notably achieving 65.84% on OSWorld. All research assets will be made publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然视觉语言模型在让计算机使用代理方面取得了显著进展，但目前的代理框架在应对新领域和长视界任务时仍然存在困难。这是因为缺乏视觉感知的教程检索机制，同时也无法对历史视觉上下文进行精细控制。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了OS-Symphony这一综合性框架。该框架包含一个协调器，它结合了两项关键创新，以实现稳健的自动化操作：(1) 一种基于里程碑驱动的长期记忆的反思式记忆代理，能够实现轨迹级别的自我修正，有效缓解长视界任务中的视觉上下文丢失问题；(2) 多功能工具代理，其配备了一种多模态搜索器，采用“看-行动”模式来在基于浏览器的沙盒中合成实时、与视觉对齐的教程，从而解决未见场景下的逼真性问题。实验结果表明，OS-Symphony在不同模型规模下都能带来显著的性能提升，并在三个在线基准测试中取得了新的最佳成绩，其中在OSWorld测试上的表现尤为突出，达到了65.84%。所有研究成果都将公开提供。

papers.title: Learning from Cognition: Enhancing RL Efficiency for LLM Reasoning via Hierarchical Metacognitive Decomposition and Refinement
papers.title_zh: 从认知中学习：通过分层元认知分解与优化提升强化学习在大型语言模型推理中的效率
papers.authors: Zexu Sun, Yongcheng Zeng, Erxue Min, Heyang Gao, Bokai Ji, Dugang Liu, Xing Tang, Xiuqiang He, Xu Chen
papers.abstract: Contemporary progress in Large Language Models (LLMs) has revealed notable inferential capacities via reinforcement learning (RL) employing verifiable rewards. However, “zero-RL” approaches relying on fixed prompt templates introduce substantial sampling inefficiencies for weak LLMs, as most problems generate invalid outputs during accuracy-driven filtration. To solve this, we propose Cog-Rethinker, a novel hierarchical metacognitive RL framework. Cog-Rethinker enhances the rollout procedure by improving sample utilization through a two-stage framework leveraging human cognition. First, it prompts the policy to decompose zero-accuracy problems into subproblems. Second, it prompts the policy to refine answers by referencing previous wrong solutions. Moreover, to enable cold-starts and maintain train-test consistency, Cog-Rethinker applies supervised fine-tuning using correct samples from these stages. Experimental results demonstrate Cog-Rethinker’s superior performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and its improved sample efficiency that accelerates convergence compared to baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在近期取得了显著进展，通过采用可验证奖励的强化学习技术，这些模型展现出了出色的推理能力。然而，那些依赖固定提示模板的“零精度强化学习”方法，对于性能较弱的大语言模型来说，会导致严重的采样效率问题。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Cog-Rethinker这一新颖的层次化元认知强化学习框架。该框架通过利用人类认知的两阶段机制，提升了样本利用率。首先，它促使策略将零精度问题分解为多个子问题；其次，它引导策略通过参考之前的错误解决方案来优化答案。此外，为了支持冷启动并保持训练与测试的一致性，Cog-Rethinker还采用了基于正确样本的监督式微调技术。实验结果表明，Cog-Rethinker在数学推理方面的表现优于传统方法，其提升的样本利用率也加速了模型的收敛速度。

papers.title: BrowseComp-Plus: A Fair and Disentangled Evaluation Benchmark for Deep Search Agents
papers.title_zh: BrowseComp-Plus：一个公正且易于理解的深度搜索智能体评估基准
papers.authors: Zijian Chen, Xueguang Ma, Shengyao Zhuang, Ping Nie, Kai Zou, Sahel Sharifymoghaddam, Andrew Liu, Joshua Green, Kshama Patel, Ruoxi Meng, Mingyi Su, Yanxi Li, Haoran Hong, Xinyu Shi, Xuye Liu, Hosna Oyarhoseini, Nandan Thakur, Crystina Zhang, Luyu Gao, Wenhu Chen, Jimmy Lin
papers.abstract: Deep search agents that combine large language models with retrieval tools excel at complex, multi-hop queries. Yet, existing benchmarks such as BrowseComp rely on black-box web search APIs, facing key limitations. (1) Fairness: for agents, dynamic and opaque web APIs hinder reproducibility and fair comparisons across agents. (2) Disentanglement: for retrieval, the lack of a fixed document corpus makes it impossible to isolate retriever contributions from end-to-end search agent accuracy. We introduce BrowseComp-Plus, a benchmark derived from BrowseComp that employs a fixed, human-verified corpus, enabling controlled retrieval for deep search agents. BrowseComp-Plus clearly distinguishes agent performance: with a BM25 retriever, the open-source Search-R1 achieves 3.86% accuracy, while GPT-5 achieves 55.9%. Additionally, BrowseComp-Plus makes retrieval gains explicit: pairing GPT-5 with Qwen3-Embedding-8B retriever further improves accuracy to 70.1% while reducing search calls. Overall, BrowseComp-Plus provides a fair and disentangled testbed, advancing both deep search agent evaluation and retrieval research for agentic search. Code and data can be found at: https://texttron.github.io/BrowseComp-Plus/
papers.abstract_zh: 那些将大语言模型与检索工具相结合的深度搜索代理，在处理复杂的多跳查询时表现出色。然而，现有的基准测试，如BrowseComp，依赖于黑盒式的网络搜索API，存在关键限制。(1) 公平性：对于代理来说，动态且不透明的网络API会阻碍可复现性和不同代理之间的公平比较。(2) 解耦性：在检索方面，由于缺乏固定的文档语料库，无法将检索器的贡献与端到端搜索代理的准确率分离开来。我们提出了BrowseComp-Plus，这是一个基于BrowseComp开发的基准测试，它使用固定的、经过人工验证的语料库，使得深度搜索代理能够进行可控的检索。BrowseComp-Plus能够清晰地区分不同代理的性能：使用BM25检索器时，开源的Search-R1达到了3.86%的准确率，而GPT-5则达到了55.9%。此外，BrowseComp-Plus还使检索效果更加明确：将GPT-5与Qwen3-Embedding-8B检索器结合使用时，准确率进一步提升至70.1%，同时减少了搜索调用次数。总体而言，BrowseComp-Plus提供了一个公平且解耦的测试平台，有助于推动深度搜索代理评估以及基于代理的检索研究的发展。相关代码和数据可以在以下链接找到：https://texttron.github.io/BrowseComp-Plus/

papers.title: LitVISTA: A Benchmark for Narrative Orchestration in Literary Text
papers.title_zh: LitVISTA：文学文本叙事编排的基准标准
papers.authors: Mingzhe Lu, Yiwen Wang, Yanbing Liu, Qi You, Chong Liu, Ruize Qin, Haoyu Dong, Wenyu Zhang, JiaRui Zhang, Yue Hu, Yunpeng Li
papers.abstract: Computational narrative analysis aims to capture rhythm, tension, and emotional dynamics in literary texts. Existing large language models can generate long stories but overly focus on causal coherence, neglecting the complex story arcs and orchestration inherent in human narratives. This suggests a structural misalignment between model- and human-generated narratives.We therefore position narrative analysis as a diagnostic proxy for generation and propose VISTA Space, a high-dimensional framework for narrative orchestration that unifies human and model perspectives while jointly characterizing narrative function and structure in a common space.We further introduce LitVISTA, a structurally annotated benchmark grounded in literary texts, which operationalizes VISTA Space for systematic evaluation of models’ narrative orchestration capabilities. Under an oracle setting with gold event anchors, we evaluate frontier LLMs including GPT, Claude, Grok, and Gemini. Results reveal systematic deficiencies, as current models struggle to jointly capture narrative function and structure and fail to form an integrated global view of literary narrative orchestration. End-to-end analysis further shows that failures are dominated by anchor identification and localization errors. Even advanced thinking modes yield mixed and often limited gains for literary narrative understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 计算叙事分析旨在捕捉文学文本中的节奏、紧张感和情感动态。现有的大语言模型能够生成长篇故事，但过于注重因果连贯性，而忽视了人类叙事中复杂的情节发展和情节编排。这表明模型生成的叙事与人类生成的叙事之间存在结构上的不一致。因此，我们将叙事分析视为对生成过程进行诊断的工具，并提出了VISTA Space这一高维叙事编排框架。该框架能够统一人类视角和模型视角，同时在同一个空间内共同描述叙事的功能和结构。我们还引入了LitVISTA这一基于文学文本的结构化标注基准测试，它将VISTA Space应用于模型叙事编排能力的系统评估。在带有黄金事件锚点的情境下，我们对包括GPT、Claude、Grok和Gemini在内的前沿大语言模型进行了评估。结果表明，当前模型在同时捕捉叙事功能和结构方面存在系统性缺陷，无法形成对文学叙事编排的整体认知。端到端分析还显示，这些缺陷主要源于锚点识别和定位错误。即使是先进的思考模式，对于理解文学叙事也只能带来有限的效果。

papers.title: RST-Guarder: Enhancing Long-Context Robustness for Safeguards via RST Parsing and Probabilistic Inference
papers.title_zh: RST-Guarder：通过RST解析和概率推理技术提升保障措施的长期鲁棒性
papers.authors: Xu Zhang, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities across a wide range of tasks, ensuring the safety of their outputs is increasingly critical. To mitigate the risk of policy-violating responses, numerous guardrail models have been developed for harmful-content detection. While effective on short outputs, existing guardrails degrade on long-form responses, reflecting limited semantic understanding and weak robustness to contextual noise. To address these limitations, we propose RST-Guarder, an inference-time method that improves harmful-content detection for long-form inputs without additional data curation or model training. RST-Guarder first applies a RST parser to long-form inputs to get discourse-level semantic relations among segments, and subsequently performs hierarchical probabilistic inference to aggregate segment-level safety scores produced by pre-trained guardrail models. We evaluate RST-Guarder across multiple benchmarks and a diverse set of widely used guardrail models. Experimental results demonstrate that RST-Guarder consistently improves harmful-content detection on long-form inputs, while significantly reducing false positives that incorrectly classify benign content as harmful.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在众多任务中展现出卓越的能力，确保其输出内容的安全性变得越来越重要。为了降低产生违反政策的响应的风险，人们开发了多种用于检测有害内容的防护模型。虽然这些模型在短文本上效果不错，但在处理长文本时表现不佳，因为它们在语义理解方面存在局限性，对上下文噪声的鲁棒性也较弱。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了RST-Guarder这一推理时间方法。该方法无需额外的数据整理或模型训练，就能提高长文本输入中的有害内容检测能力。RST-Guarder首先使用RST解析器对长文本进行解析，以获取各段落之间的语义关系；然后采用分层概率推理技术，将预训练防护模型生成的段落级安全评分进行整合。我们在多个基准测试以及多种常用的防护模型上进行评估，实验结果表明，RST-Guarder能够持续提升长文本输入中的有害内容检测效果，同时显著减少将无害内容误判为有害内容的错误情况。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EpiCaR: Knowing What You Don’t Know Matters for Better Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: EpiCaR：了解自己不知道的事情对于让大型语言模型做出更合理的决策至关重要
papers.authors: Jewon Yeom, Jaewon Sok, Seonghyeon Park, Jeongjae Park, Taesup Kim
papers.abstract: Improving the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs) has largely relied on iterative self-training with model-generated data. While effective at boosting accuracy, existing approaches primarily reinforce successful reasoning paths, incurring a substantial calibration cost: models become overconfident and lose the ability to represent uncertainty. This failure has been characterized as a form of model collapse in alignment, where predictive distributions degenerate toward low-variance point estimates.We address this issue by reframing open-ended reasoning training as an epistemic learning problem, in which models must learn not only how to reason, but also when their reasoning should be trusted. We propose epistemically-calibrated reasoning (EpiCaR) as a training objective that jointly optimizes reasoning performance and calibration, and instantiate it within an iterative supervised fine-tuning framework using explicitly extracted meta-cognitive self-evaluation signals. Experiments on Llama-3 and Qwen-3 families demonstrate that our approach achieves Pareto-superiority over standard baselines in both accuracy and calibration, particularly in models with sufficient reasoning capacity (e.g., 3B+). This framework generalizes effectively to OOD mathematical reasoning (GSM8K) and code generation (MBPP). Ultimately, our approach enables a 3\times reduction in the overall inference compute budget, matching the K=30 majority-vote performance of STaR with only K=10 confidence-weighted samples, entirely without the multi-model overhead of external verifiers.
papers.abstract_zh: 提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，主要依赖于使用模型生成的数据进行迭代自我训练。虽然这种方法能有效地提高准确性，但现有方法往往只强化成功的推理路径，从而带来巨大的校准成本：模型变得过于自信，失去了表示不确定性的能力。这种失败被描述为一种模型崩溃现象，即预测分布逐渐退化成低方差的点估计。我们通过将开放性问题推理训练重新定义为一个认知学习问题来解决这一问题，模型不仅要学会如何推理，还要学会何时可以信任其推理结果。我们提出了一种名为“认知校准推理”（EpiCaR）的训练目标，该目标同时优化了推理性能和校准效果。我们通过一个迭代式监督微调框架来实现这一目标，该框架利用显式提取的元认知自我评估信号。在Llama-3和Qwen-3系列模型上的实验表明，我们的方法在准确性和校准方面都优于标准基线模型，尤其是在具有足够推理能力的模型中（例如，3B+模型）。该框架还有效适用于OOD数学推理（GSM8K）和代码生成（MBPP）任务。最终，我们的方法使得整体推理计算成本降低了3倍，同时达到了STaR的K=30多数投票性能水平，而所需的数据样本数量仅为K=10的置信度加权样本，且完全不需要外部验证器的多模型开销。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MoEC: A Memory-Routed Mixture-of-Experts Controller for Adaptive Minecraft Control
papers.title_zh: MoEC：一种基于记忆路由的专家混合控制器，用于自适应《我的世界》游戏控制
papers.authors: Hui Wu, Chao Xu, Jianghui Wang, Ziqiong Liu, Dong Li, Yiwei Dai, Emad Barsoum
papers.abstract: Embodied agents in open-ended environments such as Minecraft increasingly adopt planner–controller architectures, with large language models acting as high-level planners. While planning has advanced rapidly, control remains underexplored. Existing systems commonly rely on a monolithic policy to execute subgoals across varying contexts, forcing incompatible behaviors into a shared parameter space and causing interference that scaling only partially mitigates. To address this, we propose MoEC, a Memory-Routed Mixture-of-Experts Controller for Adaptive Minecraft Control. MoEC routes via a subgoal-indexed, non-parametric expert memory and regulates capacity through failure-triggered expert growth and redundancy-aware consolidation. This design enables continual adaptation without full retraining, while maintaining parameter efficiency and with bounded inference cost. We evaluate MoEC on diverse and compositional Minecraft tasks, demonstrating significant gains in adaptability, robustness, and execution consistency over strong baselines, yielding a scalable and efficient alternative for open-ended control.
papers.abstract_zh: 在像《我的世界》这样的开放环境中，实体化智能体越来越多地采用规划器-控制器架构，其中大语言模型充当高级规划器。虽然规划技术已经取得了迅速的发展，但控制方面的研究却仍然不足。现有的系统通常依赖单一的策略来执行不同情境下的子任务，这导致不兼容的行为被纳入同一个参数空间，从而产生干扰效应，而这种干扰的缓解效果只是有限的。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了MoEC——一种基于记忆路由的混合专家控制器，用于自适应《我的世界》控制。MoEC通过以子任务为索引的非参数化专家记忆来实现路径规划，并通过故障触发式的专家扩展和冗余感知的整合来调节系统的容量。这种设计使得系统能够在不进行完全重新训练的情况下实现持续适应，同时还能保持参数的高效利用以及有限的推理成本。我们在各种复杂的《我的世界》任务上对MoEC进行了评估，结果显示其在适应性、鲁棒性和执行一致性方面都取得了显著的提升，相比强大的基线系统，MoEC提供了一种可扩展且高效的开放环境控制方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MECH: A Cost-Effective Multi-Task Cascade Framework for Classroom Opinion Evolution Recognition
papers.title_zh: MECH：一种高效的多任务级联框架，用于识别课堂上的意见演变现象
papers.authors: Yancui Li, Xiaoyu Zhou, Guoyi Miao, Fang Kong
papers.abstract: Classroom discourse analysis is critical for tracing cognitive restructuring, yet existing research predominantly focuses on Dialogue Acts (DA), overlooking the deeper dimension of Opinion Evolution (OE). In this paper, we formally define the task of Classroom Opinion Evolution Recognition and introduce the Classroom Opinion Evolution Dataset (COED). Addressing the “Accuracy-Cost-Data” trilemma in real-world educational scenarios and the “overconfidence” failure mode of traditional confidence-based cascading systems on long-tail samples, we propose the Multi-task Enhanced Cascade Hybrid (MECH) framework. Grounded in the CODA (Continuous Opinions and Discrete Actions) theory, MECH conceptually translates the “Action-Opinion” dualism into a risk-aware routing mechanism. Instead of relying solely on prediction confidence, this mechanism utilizes high-risk argumentative DA signals derived from multi-task learning to construct a “semantic safety net” effectively routing implicit or ambiguous samples to a Large Language Model for reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that MECH achieves a state-of-the-art accuracy of 78.55% while reducing API costs by 44.4%. Furthermore, the framework exhibits robustness in few-shot scenarios (using only 20% of data), offering a cost-effective and interpretable solution for large-scale educational dialogue analysis. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/ywh24284-code/MECH.
papers.abstract_zh: 课堂话语分析对于追踪认知重构至关重要，然而现有研究主要聚焦于对话行为，而忽视了意见演变这一更深层次的维度。在本文中，我们正式定义了课堂意见演变识别的任务，并介绍了课堂意见演变数据集。针对现实教育场景中“准确性-成本-数据”的三重困境，以及传统基于置信度的级联系统在长尾样本上的“过度自信”问题，我们提出了多任务增强级联混合框架。该框架基于连续意见与离散行动理论，将“行动-意见”二元对立转化为一种风险意识路由机制。该机制不仅依赖预测置信度，还利用多任务学习得出的高风险论证性对话行为信号，构建出一个“语义安全网”，将隐含或模糊的样本有效地引导至大语言模型中进行推理。实验结果表明，MECH框架达到了78.55%的顶尖准确率，同时将API成本降低了44.4%。此外，该框架在少量样本情况下也表现出鲁棒性，仅使用20%的数据即可实现高效且可解释的大规模教育对话分析解决方案。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/ywh24284-code/MECH获取。

papers.title: Debiasing Reward Models via Causally Motivated Inference-Time Intervention
papers.title_zh: 通过因果驱动的推理-时间干预来消除奖励模型的偏差现象
papers.authors: Kazutoshi Shinoda, Kosuke Nishida, Kyosuke Nishida
papers.abstract: Reward models (RMs) play a central role in aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, RMs are often sensitive to spurious features such as response length. Existing inference-time approaches for mitigating these biases typically focus exclusively on response length, resulting in performance trade-offs. In this paper, we propose causally motivated intervention for mitigating multiple types of biases in RMs at inference time. Our method first identifies neurons whose activations are strongly correlated with predefined bias attributes, and applies neuron-level intervention that suppresses these signals. We evaluate our method on RM benchmarks and observe reductions in sensitivity to spurious features across diverse bias types, without inducing performance trade-offs. Moreover, when used for preference annotation, small RMs (2B and 7B) with our method, which edits less than 2% of all the neurons in RMs, enable LLMs to improve alignment, achieving performance comparable to that of a state-of-the-art 70B RM on AlpacaEval and MT-Bench. Further analysis reveals that bias signals are primarily encoded by neurons in early layers, shedding light on the internal mechanisms of bias exploitation in RMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 奖励模型在使大语言模型与人类偏好保持一致方面发挥着核心作用。然而，奖励模型往往对诸如回答长度这样的虚假特征非常敏感。现有的推理时间方法来缓解这些偏见时，通常只关注回答长度问题，这会导致性能上的权衡。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于因果机制的干预方法，以在推理阶段缓解多种类型的奖励模型偏见。我们的方法首先识别出那些激活与预定义的偏见属性高度相关的神经元，然后对这些信号进行抑制的神经元级干预。我们在各种奖励模型基准测试上评估了该方法的效果，发现无论针对哪种类型的偏见，我们的方法都能降低对虚假特征的敏感性，同时不会造成性能上的损失。此外，当该方法用于偏好注释时，使用我们的方法的较小规模的奖励模型（2B和7B），只需修改不到2%的奖励模型中所有神经元，就能使大语言模型更好地实现与人类偏好的对齐，其性能与最先进的70B奖励模型在AlpacaEval和MT-Bench上的表现相当。进一步分析表明，偏见信号主要由早期层中的神经元编码，这为我们理解奖励模型中偏见的利用机制提供了重要线索。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Steganography Beyond Pixels: Reimagining Image Steganography as Cross-Modal Linguistic Communication
papers.title_zh: 像素之外的隐写技术：将图像隐写术重新定义为跨模态的语言交流方式
papers.authors: Ren Lijing, Denghui Zhang
papers.abstract: The rising sophistication of digital surveillance poses hurdles for concealing sensitive data within innocuous communication channels. Conventional image steganography relies on detectable pixel-level perturbations. In this paper, we introduce a novel steganography framework that fundamentally reorients the steganographic containers from the visual domain to the linguistic domain. To seamlessly bridge the gap from raw pixels to discriminative logits, we leverage the reversible latent space of discrete diffusion models to compress high-resolution secret images into lightweight binary payloads. The semantic stability of textual data ensures the integrity of the hidden payload across diverse platforms. Extensive evaluations confirm that this cross-modal approach establishes a superior equilibrium between embedding capacity and statistical undetectability in comparison to existing paradigms.
papers.abstract_zh: 数字监控技术的日益复杂，给在看似无害的通信渠道中隐藏敏感数据带来了挑战。传统的图像隐写技术依赖于可检测的像素级扰动。在本文中，我们提出了一种全新的隐写框架，该框架将隐写容器从视觉领域转向了语言领域。为了将原始像素无缝转换为具有辨识度的逻辑值，我们利用了离散扩散模型的可逆潜在空间，将高分辨率的秘密图像压缩成轻量级的二进制载荷。文本数据的语义稳定性确保了隐藏载荷在不同平台上的完整性。广泛的测试表明，这种跨模态方法在嵌入能力与统计不可检测性之间取得了更好的平衡，优于现有的传统方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Hard2Verify: A Step-Level Verification Benchmark for Open-Ended Frontier Math
papers.title_zh: Hard2Verify：一种用于开放性前沿数学问题的分阶段验证基准测试
papers.authors: Shrey Pandit, Austin Xu, Xuan-Phi Nguyen, Yifei Ming, Caiming Xiong, Shafiq Joty
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based reasoning systems have recently achieved gold medal-level performance in the IMO 2025 competition, writing mathematical proofs where, to receive full credit, each step must be not only correct but also sufficiently supported. To train LLM-based reasoners in such challenging, open-ended settings, strong verifiers capable of catching step-level mistakes are necessary prerequisites. We introduce Hard2Verify, a human-annotated, step-level verification benchmark produced with over 500 hours of human labor. Hard2Verify is designed to rigorously assess step-level verifiers at the frontier: Verifiers must provide step-level annotations or identify the first error in responses generated by frontier LLMs for very recent, challenging, and open-ended math questions. We evaluate 29 generative critics and process reward models, demonstrating that, beyond a few standouts, open-source verifiers lag closed source models. We subsequently analyze what drives poor performance in step-level verification, the impacts of scaling verifier compute, as well as fundamental questions such as self-verification and verification-generation dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的推理系统在2025年国际数学奥林匹克竞赛中取得了金牌级的表现，它们能够编写数学证明。为了获得满分，每一步推导不仅必须正确，还必须有足够的支持。要在如此具有挑战性、开放性强的环境中训练基于语言模型的推理系统，就需要强大的验证器来捕捉每一步的错误。我们提出了Hard2Verify这一由人类标注的、针对每一步的验证基准测试，该测试耗费了超过500小时的人工时间。Hard2Verify旨在严格评估处于前沿水平的验证器：这些验证器必须能够提供每一步的注释，或者识别出由前沿语言模型生成的回答中的第一个错误，这些问题通常非常新颖、具有挑战性且开放性很强。我们对29种生成式批评器和处理奖励模型进行了评估，结果表明，除了少数例外，开源验证器在性能上仍落后于闭源模型。随后，我们分析了导致步骤级验证性能不佳的原因，以及验证器计算规模扩展所带来的影响。此外，我们还探讨了诸如自我验证和验证生成动态等基础问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Agent-based Substructure Counting under Local Differential Privacy
papers.title_zh: 在局部差异隐私约束下的基于代理的子结构计数问题
papers.authors: Yuting Zhang, Kai Wang, Wei Ni, Ying Zhang, Wenjie Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent studies have demonstrated the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) in processing various graph problems. Substructure counting remains challenging in both scalability and accuracy. Incorporating sensitive edge information into the input prompts also introduces significant privacy risks of exposing the private information of user connections in real-world applications. This paper, for the first time, studies substructure counting for LLMs under edge local differential privacy (LDP) in a multi-agent framework. Unlike the Naive approach whose estimation relies entirely on overly dense noisy graphs, the proposed PSC framework decomposes substructure counting into node-level tasks distributed among node agents, and embeds the knowledge of distributed algorithms and DP frameworks in the curator agent and privacy controller, respectively. Thus, we can leverage the local neighboring information and reasoning capabilities of node agents to improve the estimation accuracy. Extensive experiments on 6 real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of PSC framework for substructure counting tasks under \varepsilon-edge LDP. Moreover, the non-DP version of PSC also demonstrated superior performance over a single LLM on standard substructure counting tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，大语言模型在处理各种图论问题方面具有强大的能力。然而，子结构计数在可扩展性和准确性方面仍然存在挑战。在输入提示中引入敏感的边缘信息也会带来显著的隐私风险，因为可能会泄露用户连接的私人信息。本文首次在多智能体框架下，利用边缘局部差分隐私技术对大语言模型的子结构计数进行了研究。与那些完全依赖过于密集的噪声图的朴素方法不同，所提出的PSC框架将子结构计数分解为分布在各个节点智能体中的节点级任务，并将分布式算法和差分隐私框架的知识分别嵌入到管理代理和隐私控制器中。这样，我们可以利用节点智能体的本地邻域信息和推理能力来提高估计的准确性。在6个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验验证了PSC框架在ε-边缘差分隐私保护下的子结构计数任务的有效性。此外，非差分隐私版本的PSC在标准的子结构计数任务上也表现出优于单一大语言模型的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: NeuReasoner: Towards Explainable, Controllable, and Unified Reasoning via Mixture-of-Neurons
papers.title_zh: NeuReasoner：通过混合神经元实现可解释、可控制且统一的推理能力
papers.authors: Haonan Dong, Kehan Jiang, Haoran Ye, Wenhao Zhu, Zhaolu Kang, Guojie Song
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have recently achieved remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks. However, closer scrutiny reveals persistent failure modes compromising performance and cost: I) Intra-step level, marked by calculation or derivation errors; II) Inter-step level, involving oscillation and stagnation; and III) Instance level, causing maladaptive over-thinking. Existing endeavors target isolated levels without unification, while their black-box nature and reliance on RL hinder explainability and controllability. To bridge these gaps, we conduct an in-depth white-box analysis, identifying key neurons (Mixture of Neurons, MoN) and their fluctuation patterns associated with distinct failures. Building upon these insights, we propose NeuReasoner, an explainable, controllable, and unified reasoning framework driven by MoN. Technically, NeuReasoner integrates lightweight MLPs for failure detection with a special token-triggered self-correction mechanism learned via SFT. During inference, special tokens are inserted upon failure detection to actuate controllable remedial behaviors. Extensive evaluations across six benchmarks, six backbone models (8B 70B) against nine competitive baselines, demonstrate that NeuReasoner achieves performance gains of up to 27.0% while reducing token consumption by 19.6% 63.3%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在复杂推理任务中取得了显著的成功。然而，深入分析后发现，该模型仍然存在一些影响性能和成本的缺陷：第一，在步骤内部层面，会出现计算或推导错误；第二，在步骤之间层面，会出现振荡和停滞现象；第三，在实例层面，会出现不必要的过度思考行为。现有的研究主要针对这些独立层面的问题，而缺乏整体性的解决方案。此外，这些模型采用黑盒方式运行，依赖强化学习进行训练，这限制了它们的可解释性和可控性。为了弥补这些不足，我们进行了深入的白盒分析，识别出与各种缺陷相关的关键神经元以及它们的波动模式。基于这些发现，我们提出了NeuReasoner——一个可解释、可控且具有整体性的推理框架，它由神经元混合体驱动。从技术角度来看，NeuReasoner结合了轻量级的MLP模型用于故障检测，并采用了一种通过SFT学习的特殊令牌触发自我修复机制。在推理过程中，当检测到故障时，会插入特殊令牌以触发可控制的修复行为。通过对六个基准测试、六种骨干模型（8B 至 70B）以及九种竞争基准模型的广泛评估，我们发现NeuReasoner在保持性能提升的同时，还能减少 19.6%–63.3% 的词元消耗，提升幅度高达27.0%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Red Teaming Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 针对大型推理模型的恶意行为
papers.authors: Jiawei Chen, Yang Yang, Chao Yu, Yu Tian, Zhi Cao, Xue Yang, Linghao Li, Hang Su, Zhaoxia Yin
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have emerged as a powerful advancement in multi-step reasoning tasks, offering enhanced transparency and logical consistency through explicit chains of thought (CoT). However, these models introduce novel safety and reliability risks, such as CoT-hijacking and prompt-induced inefficiencies, which are not fully captured by existing evaluation methods. To address this gap, we propose Rt-LRM, a unified benchmark designed to assess the trustworthiness of LRMs. Rt-LRM evaluates three core dimensions: truthfulness, safety and efficiency. Beyond metric-based evaluation, we further introduce the training paradigm as a key analytical perspective to investigate the systematic impact of different training strategies on model trustworthiness. We achieve this by designing a curated suite of 30 reasoning tasks from an observational standpoint. We conduct extensive experiments on 26 models and identify several valuable insights into the trustworthiness of LRMs. For example, LRMs generally face trustworthiness challenges and tend to be more fragile than Large Language Models (LLMs) when encountering reasoning-induced risks. These findings uncover previously underexplored vulnerabilities and highlight the need for more targeted evaluations. In addition, we release a scalable toolbox for standardized trustworthiness research to support future advancements in this important field.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）已成为多步骤推理任务中的一项重要进展，它通过明确的思想链（CoT）提升了透明度和逻辑一致性。然而，这些模型也带来了新的安全性和可靠性风险，例如思想链劫持以及由提示引起的效率低下问题，这些问题并未被现有的评估方法完全涵盖。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Rt-LRM，这是一个旨在评估LRMs可信度的统一基准测试。Rt-LRM从三个核心维度进行评估：真实性、安全性和效率。除了基于指标的评估之外，我们还引入了训练范式作为关键的分析视角，以研究不同训练策略对模型可信度的影响。我们通过设计一套包含30个推理任务的评估集来实现这一目标。我们对26个模型进行了广泛的实验，并得出了一些关于LRMs可信度的宝贵见解。例如，LRMs通常面临可信度挑战，在遇到由推理引发的风险时，它们比大语言模型（LLMs）更加脆弱。这些发现揭示了之前未被充分探索的漏洞，并强调了进行更有针对性的评估的必要性。此外，我们还发布了一个可扩展的工具箱，用于标准化可信度研究，以支持这一重要领域的未来发展。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: InsLogicBench: An Argumentation Logic Grounded Benchmark for Complex Insurance Claims Adjudication
papers.title_zh: InsLogicBench：一种适用于复杂保险理赔判定的论证逻辑基准框架
papers.authors: Jin Liu, Yunpeng Liu, Keyi Wang, Jie Shi, Xiao Xu, Wenkang Huang, Xingzhong Xu, Xin Liang, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: Insurance claims adjudication demands not only accurate decisions but also interpretable reasoning grounded in policy clauses. However, existing benchmarks are limited to information retrieval or simple multiple-choice setups, which fail to require step-by-step inferences from facts to conclusions. To address this gap, we introduce InsLogicBench, a benchmark providing complete reasoning traces that link factual inputs, relevant policy clauses, and final verdicts. We construct the dataset using a controllable synthesis framework based on the Nested Toulmin Model. By capturing the defeasible logic of insurance policies through hierarchical truth assignment and enforcing validity via consistency verification, we ensure interpretability and logical rigor across generated examples. We evaluate eight Large Language Models (LLMs) on InsLogicBench. Results show significant difficulties in handling exception clauses and verifying missing conditions. Notably, models often produce correct final decisions but fail to provide precise justifications, highlighting a critical discrepancy between their decision accuracy and logical reasoning capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 保险理赔裁决不仅需要准确的决策，还需要基于条款规定的可解释性推理。然而，现有的评估基准仅限于信息检索或简单的选择题形式，这些方式无法要求从事实到结论进行逐步推理。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了InsLogicBench这一评估工具。该工具能够提供完整的推理过程记录，将事实输入、相关条款规定以及最终判决结果联系起来。我们采用基于嵌套Toulmin模型的可控合成框架来构建数据集。通过层次化的真值赋值方式处理保险条款中的不确定性，并通过一致性验证来确保结果的合法性，从而确保生成示例的可解释性和逻辑严谨性。我们在InsLogicBench上对八种大语言模型进行了评估。结果显示，在处理例外条款和验证缺失条件方面存在显著困难。值得注意的是，虽然模型通常能做出正确的最终判断，但却无法提供精确的理由说明，这凸显了模型在决策准确性和逻辑推理能力之间的关键差异。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LinkQA: Synthesizing Diverse QA from Multiple Seeds Strongly Linked by Knowledge Points
papers.title_zh: LinkQA：从多个具有紧密关联的知识点的种子信息中整合出多样化的问答内容
papers.authors: Xuemiao Zhang, Can Ren, Chengying Tu, Rongxiang Weng, Hongfei Yan, Jingang Wang, Xunliang Cai
papers.abstract: The advancement of large language models (LLMs) struggles with the scarcity of high-quality, diverse training data. To address this limitation, we propose LinkSyn, a KP-graph-based synthesis framework that for the first time enables flexible control over discipline and difficulty distributions while balancing KP coverage and popularity. LinkSyn extracts KPs from question-answering (QA) seed data and constructs a KP graph to synthesize diverse QA data from multiple seeds strongly linked by KPs and sampled from graph walks. Specifically, LinkSyn incorporates (1) a knowledge value function to guide the adjustment of path sampling probability and balance KP coverage and popularity during graph walks; (2) diffusion-based synthesis via a strong reasoning model by leveraging multiple seeds with dense logical associations along each path; and (3) high-difficulty QA enhancement within given disciplines by flexible difficulty adjustments. By executing LinkSyn, we synthesize LinkQA, a diverse multi-disciplinary QA dataset with 50B tokens. Extensive experiments on Llama-3 8B demonstrate that continual pre-training with LinkQA yields an average improvement of 11.51% on MMLU and CMMLU, establishing new SOTA results. LinkQA consistently enhances performance across model size and initial FLOPs scales.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的发展面临着高质量、多样化训练数据的匮乏问题。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了LinkSyn这一基于KP图的合成框架。该框架首次实现了对主题和难度分布的灵活控制，同时兼顾了KP的覆盖率和受欢迎程度。LinkSyn从问答种子数据中提取KP节点，并构建KP图来合成多样化的问答数据，这些数据来自多个通过KP节点紧密相连的种子数据，并通过图遍历进行采样。具体来说，LinkSyn包含以下三个机制：(1) 知识价值函数，用于指导路径采样概率的调整，从而在图遍历过程中平衡KP的覆盖率和受欢迎程度；(2) 通过强推理模型进行扩散式合成，利用每条路径上具有密集逻辑关联的多种子数据进行合成；(3) 在给定主题内通过灵活的难度调整来提高高难度问答数据的质量。通过执行LinkSyn，我们成功合成了一个名为LinkQA的多样化多主题问答数据集，其数据量达500亿个标记。在Llama-3 8B模型上的大量实验表明，持续使用 LinkQA 进行预训练使 MMLU 和 CMMLU 得分平均提升 11.51%，取得了新的最佳性能记录。LinkQA在不同模型规模及初始计算资源条件下都能保持稳定的性能提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of the Intrinsic Metrics for Tokenizers and their effect on Downstream Tasks for Hindi and Marathi
papers.title_zh: 对分词器的内在指标进行对比分析，以及这些指标对印地语和马拉地语文本后续处理任务的影响
papers.authors: Shagun Dwivedi, Kaushik Gopalan
papers.abstract: Various studies have pointed out that the performance of language models is poor in non-English or non-European languages. One of the factors affecting this performance is the effectiveness and suitability of the tokenization scheme used in the model. Indic scripts require multiple Unicode codepoints to represent a single visual unit to be encoded in the standard UTF-8 scheme. This paper investigates the effect of multiple tokenizers that use UTF-8 text input on the downstream performance of pretrained language models for Hindi and Marathi, languages written in \textit{Devanāgari} script. We present the intrinsic performance of the tokenizers using Fertility, Rényi Efficiency and Percentile Frequency, and report the extrinsic performance of monolingual and multilingual models on question-answering tasks, using an automated parts-of-speech and sentence similarity based evaluation framework, and on word-level tasks such as grapheme-to-phoneme conversion and transliteration. We propose a grapheme cluster tokenizer for the script which shows performance better than or competitive with other popular tokenizers. We also find that the Rényi Efficiency metric is highly correlated to downstream performance on question answering.
papers.abstract_zh: 多项研究指出，语言模型在非英语或非欧洲语言中的性能较差。影响这一性能的一个因素是模型中使用的分词方案的有效性和适用性。印度文字需要多个Unicode编码点来表示一个要被编码到标准UTF-8格式中的视觉单位。本文研究了使用UTF-8文本输入的多重分词器对印地语和马拉地语等用德瓦纳加里文字书写的语言的预训练语言模型下游性能的影响。我们分析了使用Fertility、Rényi效率和百分比频率等指标来评价分词器的内在性能，并报告了单语言和多语言模型在问答任务上的外在性能，同时使用了基于自动词性和句子相似度的评估框架，以及针对字级任务如字形到音素转换和转写等任务的情况。我们为这种文字设计了一种字形聚类分词器，其性能优于或与其他流行的分词器相当。我们还发现，Rényi效率指标与问答任务的下游性能高度相关。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Omni-Embed-Audio: Leveraging Multimodal LLMs for Robust Audio-Text Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 全模态嵌入音频：利用多模态大语言模型实现稳健的音频-文本检索
papers.authors: HaeJun Yoo, Yongseop Shin, Insung Lee, Myoung-Wan Koo, Du-Seong Chang
papers.abstract: Audio-text retrieval systems based on Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP) achieve strong performance on traditional benchmarks; however, these benchmarks rely on caption-style queries that differ substantially from real-world search behavior, limiting their assessment of practical retrieval robustness. We present Omni-Embed-Audio (OEA), a retrieval-oriented encoder leveraging multimodal LLMs with native audio understanding. To systematically evaluate robustness beyond caption-style queries, we introduce User-Intent Queries (UIQs)—five formulations reflecting natural search behaviors: questions, commands, keyword tags, paraphrases, and exclusion-based negative queries. For negative queries, we develop a hard negative mining pipeline and propose discrimination metrics (HNSR, TFR) assessing models’ ability to suppress acoustically similar distractors. Experiments on AudioCaps, Clotho, and MECAT show that OEA achieves comparable text-to-audio retrieval performance to state-of-the-art M2D-CLAP, while demonstrating clear advantages in two critical areas: (1) dominant text-to-text retrieval (+22% relative improvement), and (2) substantially superior hard negative discrimination (+4.3%p HNSR@10, +34.7% relative TFR@10), revealing that LLM backbones provide superior semantic understanding of complex queries.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于对比语言-音频预训练技术的音频文本检索系统在传统基准测试中表现优异。然而，这些测试基准依赖于与真实世界搜索行为截然不同的标题式查询方式，这限制了它们对实际检索能力的评估。我们提出了Omni-Embed-Audio（OEA）技术，这是一种以检索为导向的编码器，它利用多模态大语言模型来实现对音频内容的自然理解。为了系统地评估其在超越标题式查询情况下的鲁棒性，我们引入了用户意图查询这一概念——包括五种反映自然搜索行为的查询形式：问题、命令、关键词标签、释义以及基于排除的负面查询。对于负面查询，我们开发了一套硬负面挖掘流程，并提出了一些判别指标来评估模型抑制声音相似干扰项的能力。在AudioCaps、Clotho和MECAT数据集上的实验表明，OEA在文本到音频的检索性能上可与最先进的M2D-CLAP相媲美，同时在两个关键领域表现出明显优势：（1）在主导的文本到文本检索方面取得了相对提升（+22%），（2）在硬负面判别方面表现更为出色（+4.3% p HNSR@10，+34.7% 相对TFR@10），这表明大语言模型框架能够提供更深入的语义理解能力，以应对复杂的查询场景。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SPIO: Ensemble and Selective Strategies via LLM-Based Multi-Agent Planning in Automated Data Science
papers.title_zh: SPIO：基于大语言模型的多智能体规划在自动化数据科学中的应用——组合策略与选择性方案
papers.authors: Wonduk Seo, Juhyeon Lee, Yanjun Shao, Qingshan Zhou, Seunghyun Lee, Yi Bu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled dynamic reasoning in automated data analytics, yet recent multi-agent systems remain limited by rigid, single-path workflows that restrict strategic exploration and often lead to suboptimal outcomes. To overcome these limitations, we propose SPIO (Sequential Plan Integration and Optimization), a framework that replaces rigid workflows with adaptive, multi-path planning across four core modules: data preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning. In each module, specialized agents generate diverse candidate strategies, which are cascaded and refined by an optimization agent. SPIO offers two operating modes: SPIO-S for selecting a single optimal pipeline, and SPIO-E for ensembling top-k pipelines to maximize robustness. Extensive evaluations on Kaggle and OpenML benchmarks show that SPIO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average performance gain of 5.6%. By explicitly exploring and integrating multiple solution paths, SPIO delivers a more flexible, accurate, and reliable foundation for automated data science.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自动化数据分析中实现了动态推理功能，但最近的多智能体系统仍然受到刚性、单路径工作流程的限制，这些流程限制了策略的探索空间，往往导致结果不佳。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了SPIO（序列计划集成与优化）框架。该框架用自适应、多路径规划来替代刚性工作流程，涉及四个核心模块：数据预处理、特征工程、模型选择和超参数调优。在每个模块中，专门的智能体生成多种候选策略，然后由优化智能体对这些策略进行串联和细化处理。SPIO提供两种运行模式：SPIO-S用于选择单一最优流程；SPIO-E则通过组合排名前几的流程来提升系统的鲁棒性。在Kaggle和OpenML基准测试中的广泛评估表明，SPIO始终优于最先进的基线算法，平均性能提升了5.6%。通过明确探索并整合多种解决方案路径，SPIO为自动化数据科学提供了更加灵活、准确且可靠的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Comparing human and language models sentence processing difficulties on complex structures
papers.title_zh: 比较人类模型和语言模型在处理复杂结构句子时的困难之处
papers.authors: Samuel Joseph Amouyal, Aya Meltzer-Asscher, Jonathan Berant
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) that fluently converse with humans are a reality - but do LLMs experience human-like processing difficulties? We systematically compare human and LLM sentence comprehension across seven challenging linguistic structures. We collect sentence comprehension data from humans and five families of state-of-the-art LLMs, varying in size and training procedure in a unified experimental framework. Our results show LLMs overall struggle on the target structures, but especially on garden path (GP) sentences. Indeed, while the strongest models achieve near perfect accuracy on non-GP structures (93.7% for GPT-5), they struggle on GP structures (46.8% for GPT-5). Additionally, when ranking structures based on average performance, rank correlation between humans and models increases with parameter count. For each target structure, we also collect data for their matched baseline without the difficult structure. Comparing performance on the target vs. baseline sentences, the performance gap observed in humans holds for LLMs, with two exceptions: for models that are too weak performance is uniformly low across both sentence types, and for models that are too strong the performance is uniformly high. Together, these reveal convergence and divergence in human and LLM sentence comprehension, offering new insights into the similarity of humans and LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 能够与人类流畅对话的大语言模型已经成为了现实——但是，这些模型是否也会遇到类似人类的处理困难呢？我们系统地比较了人类和大语言模型在七种具有挑战性的语言结构上的句子理解能力。我们从人类和五款最先进的大语言模型那里收集了句子理解数据，这些模型在规模和技术上各不相同，但我们采用统一的实验框架来进行分析。我们的结果显示，大语言模型在目标结构上整体表现不佳，尤其是在那些复杂的句子结构上。实际上，虽然最强的模型在非复杂结构上的准确率接近100%（GPT-5的准确率为93.7%），但在复杂结构上的准确率却很低（GPT-5的准确率为46.8%）。此外，根据平均性能对结构进行排序时，人类与模型之间的排名相关性随着参数数量的增加而提高。对于每一个目标结构，我们还收集了没有该复杂结构的基准数据的对比数据。通过比较目标结构和基准数据的表现，我们发现人类和大语言模型在句子理解方面的差距仍然存在，不过有两个例外：对于那些表现较弱的模型，两种类型的句子上的表现都相当低；而对于那些表现过于强大的模型，则两种类型的句子上的表现都相当高。总的来说，这些结果揭示了人类和大语言模型在句子理解方面的趋同与差异，为理解人类与大语言模型的相似性提供了新的视角。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Phun-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Phonological Understanding in Chinese
papers.title_zh: Phun测试平台：评估大语言模型在中文语音理解方面的能力
papers.authors: Xing Yue, Yongliang Shen, Weiming Lu
papers.abstract: Language is a vehicle for thought, intricately tied to sounds, symbols, and meaning. However, most large language model (LLM) research focuses on meaning (semantics) and symbols (spelling) while largely overlooking sounds. Existing benchmarks on LLMs’ phonological abilities are either solvable through rote memorization or intertwined with other abilities, making them inadequate to measure LLMs’ genuine ability in phonological understanding. Here, we present Phun-Bench, a purpose-built Chinese benchmark with diverse tasks and settings across three dimensions (Homophony, Rhyme, and Phonetic Similarity), designed to systematically evaluate LLMs’ phonological understanding. Our results show that while LLMs excel at recalling correct pronunciations, they generally struggle to leverage phonological knowledge in the flexible and intuitive way that human speakers do. Moreover, through detailed analyses, we propose a hypothesis regarding the underlying mechanism of LLMs’ phonological understanding and “perception”, highlighting an underexplored frontier for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言是思想的载体，与声音、符号和意义紧密相连。然而，大多数大语言模型研究主要集中在意义（语义）和符号（拼写）方面，而很大程度上忽视了声音因素。现有的关于语言模型语音能力的评估基准要么可以通过机械记忆来解决，要么与其他能力紧密相关，因此无法准确衡量语言模型在语音理解方面的真实能力。在这里，我们提出了Phun-Bench这一专为中文设计的评估基准，该基准包含三个维度的多种任务与场景：同音词、韵律和语音相似性，旨在系统地评估语言模型在语音理解方面的能力。我们的结果显示，虽然语言模型在回忆正确发音方面表现出色，但它们在灵活运用语音知识方面往往不如人类说话者那么熟练。此外，通过详细分析，我们提出了关于语言模型语音理解和“感知”机制的一种假设，这为未来的研究指出了一个尚未充分探索的领域。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Causal2Vec: Improving Decoder-only LLMs as Embedding Models through a Contextual Token
papers.title_zh: Causal2Vec：通过上下文感知的令牌处理技术，改进仅包含解码器的大语言模型作为嵌入模型的能力
papers.authors: Ailiang Lin, Zhuoyun Li, Yusong Wang, Kotaro Funakoshi, Manabu Okumura
papers.abstract: Decoder-only large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly adopted to build embedding models for diverse tasks. To overcome the inherent limitations of causal attention in representation learning, many existing methods modify the attention mechanism to be bidirectional, potentially undermining LLMs’ ability to extract semantic information acquired during pre-training. Meanwhile, leading unidirectional approaches often rely on extra input text to generate contextualized embeddings, inevitably increasing computational costs. In this work, we propose Causal2Vec, a general-purpose embedding model tailored to enhance the performance of decoder-only LLMs without altering their original architectures or introducing significant computational overhead. Specifically, we first employ a lightweight BERT-style model to pre-encode the input text into a single Contextual token, which is then prepended to the LLM’s input sequence, allowing each token to capture contextualized information even without attending to future tokens. Furthermore, to mitigate the recency bias introduced by last-token pooling, we concatenate the last hidden states of Contextual and EOS tokens as the final text embedding. In practice, Causal2Vec achieves a new state-of-the-art performance on the MTEB benchmark among models trained solely on publicly available retrieval datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 仅基于解码器的大语言模型（LLMs）已被越来越多地用于构建各种任务的嵌入模型。为了克服因果注意力在表示学习中的固有局限性，许多现有方法对注意力机制进行了双向化处理，这可能会削弱LLMs在预训练过程中提取语义信息的能力。与此同时，主流的单向处理方法通常依赖于额外的输入文本来生成上下文嵌入，这无疑增加了计算成本。在这项研究中，我们提出了Causal2Vec这一通用嵌入模型，该模型旨在提升仅基于解码器的LLMs的性能，而无需改变其原始架构或引入显著的计算开销。具体来说，我们首先使用轻量级的BERT风格模型将输入文本预编码为单个上下文令牌，然后将其添加到LLM的输入序列中，这样每个令牌就能捕捉到上下文信息，而无需关注未来的令牌。此外，为了减轻由最后一个令牌池化带来的最新性偏差，我们将上下文令牌和EOS令牌的最后隐藏状态进行连接，作为最终的文本嵌入。在实践中，Causal2Vec在MTEB基准测试上取得了新的最佳性能，其表现优于那些仅使用公开可用的检索数据集进行训练的模型。

papers.title: Enhancing Multimodal Large Language Models for Ancient Chinese Character Evolution Analysis via Glyph-Driven Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 通过字形驱动的微调，提升多模态大型语言模型在古汉字演化分析中的应用效果
papers.authors: Rui Song, Lida Shi, Ruihua Qi, Yingji Li, Hao Xu
papers.abstract: In recent years, rapid advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have increasingly stimulated research on ancient Chinese scripts. As the evolution of written characters constitutes a fundamental pathway for understanding cultural transformation and historical continuity, how MLLMs can be systematically leveraged to support and advance text evolution analysis remains an open and largely underexplored problem. To bridge this gap, we construct a comprehensive benchmark comprising 11 tasks and over 130,000 instances, specifically designed to evaluate the capability of MLLMs in analyzing the evolution of ancient Chinese scripts. We conduct extensive evaluations across multiple widely used MLLMs and observe that, while existing models demonstrate a limited ability in glyph-level comparison, their performance on core tasks-such as character recognition and evolutionary reasoning-remains substantially constrained. Motivated by these findings, we propose a glyph-driven fine-tuning framework (GEVO) that explicitly encourages models to capture evolutionary consistency in glyph transformations and enhances their understanding of text evolution. Experimental results show that even models at the 2B scale achieve consistent and comprehensive performance improvements across all evaluated tasks. To facilitate future research, we publicly release both the benchmark and the trained models.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，多模态大语言模型在研究古代中文文字方面取得了显著进展。由于汉字的演变是理解文化变迁和历史延续的重要途径，因此如何利用多模态大语言模型系统地支持并推进对文字演变的分析，仍然是一个尚未充分探索的问题。为了填补这一空白，我们构建了一个包含11项任务、超过130,000个实例的综合性基准测试，旨在评估多模态大语言模型分析古代中文文字演变的能力。我们对多种常用的多模态大语言模型进行了广泛的评估，发现虽然现有模型在字形级别的比较方面表现有限，但在字符识别、演变推理等核心任务上的性能仍然受到很大限制。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种以字形为驱动的训练框架（GEVO），该框架能够促使模型捕捉字形演变中的一致性特征，从而增强其对文字演变的理解。实验结果表明，即使是规模达到2B级别的模型，也能在所有评估任务中取得一致且全面的性能提升。为了促进未来的研究，我们公开了这份基准测试以及训练好的模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: See2Refine: Vision-Language Feedback Improves LLM-Based eHMI Action Designers
papers.title_zh: See2Refine：视觉与语言的反馈机制提升了基于大语言模型的电子人机界面设计效果
papers.authors: Ding Xia, Xinyue Gui, Mark Colley, Fan Gao, Zhongyi Zhou, Dongyuan Li, Renhe Jiang, Takeo Igarashi
papers.abstract: Automated vehicles lack natural communication channels with other road users, making external Human-Machine Interfaces (eHMIs) essential for conveying intent and maintaining trust in shared environments. However, most eHMI studies rely on developer-crafted message-action pairs, which are difficult to adapt to diverse and dynamic traffic contexts. A promising alternative is to use Large Language Models (LLMs) as action designers that generate context-conditioned eHMI actions, yet such designers lack perceptual verification and typically depend on fixed prompts or costly human-annotated feedback for improvement.We present See2Refine, a human-free, closed-loop framework that uses vision-language models (VLMs) for perceptual evaluation as automated visual feedback to improve an LLM-based eHMI action designer. Given a driving context and a candidate eHMI action, the VLM evaluates the perceived appropriateness of the action, and this feedback is used to iteratively revise the designer’s outputs, enabling systematic refinement without human supervision.We evaluate our framework across three eHMI modalities (lightbar, eyes, and arm) and multiple LLM model sizes. Across settings, our framework consistently outperforms prompt-only LLM designers and manually specified baselines in both VLM-based metrics and human-subject evaluations. The results further indicate that the improvements are generalized across modalities and that VLM evaluations are reasonably aligned with human preferences in our controlled settings, supporting the robustness and effectiveness of See2Refine for scalable action design.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶车辆缺乏与其他道路使用者的自然沟通渠道，因此外部人机界面对于传达意图和维持共享环境中的信任至关重要。然而，大多数关于人机界面的研究依赖于开发者设计好的消息-动作对，这些对难以适应多样且动态的交通环境。一种有前景的替代方案是使用大语言模型作为动作生成器，它们能够生成基于上下文的人机界面动作。不过，这样的生成器缺乏感知验证机制，通常需要依赖固定的提示或昂贵的人工注释反馈来进行改进。我们提出了See2Refine这一无需人工干预的闭环框架，该框架利用视觉-语言模型进行感知评估，作为自动视觉反馈来改进基于语言模型的人机界面动作生成器。给定驾驶环境和候选的人机界面动作后，视觉-语言模型会评估该动作的适用性，这种反馈被用来迭代修正生成器的输出，从而实现无需人工监督的系统化优化。我们在三种不同的人机界面模式（灯条、眼睛和手臂）以及不同规模的语言模型上进行测试。结果表明，我们的框架在多种情况下都优于仅依赖提示的语言模型生成器以及手动指定的基准方案，无论是在基于视觉-语言模型的指标还是人类受试者评估中都是如此。此外，研究结果还表明，这些改进是跨模式的通用性特征，而且在我们的控制环境下，视觉-语言模型的评估结果与人类的偏好相当一致，这进一步证明了See2Refine在可扩展动作设计方面的稳健性和有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models under Data Scarcity: Challenges and Solutions
papers.title_zh: 在数据稀缺情况下用于大型语言模型的强化学习研究：挑战与解决方案
papers.authors: Zhiyin Yu, Yuchen Mou, Juncheng Yan, Junyu Luo, Chunchun Chen, Xing Wei, Yunhui Liu, Hongru Sun, Yuxing Zhang, Jun Xu, Yatao Bian, Ming Zhang, Wei Ye, Tieke He, Jie Yang, Guanjie Zheng, Zhonghai Wu, Bo Zhang, Lei Bai, Xiao Luo
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful post-training paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, reinforcement learning for LLMs faces substantial data scarcity challenges, including the limited availability of high-quality external supervision and the constrained volume of model-generated experience. These limitations make data-efficient reinforcement learning a critical research direction. In this survey, we present the first systematic review of reinforcement learning for LLMs under data scarcity. We propose a bottom-up hierarchical framework built around three complementary perspectives: the data-centric perspective, the training-centric perspective, and the framework-centric perspective. We develop a taxonomy of existing methods, summarize representative approaches in each category, and analyze their strengths and limitations. Our taxonomy aims to provide a clear conceptual foundation for understanding the design space of data-efficient RL for LLMs and to guide researchers working in this emerging area. We hope this survey offers a comprehensive roadmap for future research and inspires new directions toward more efficient and scalable reinforcement learning post-training for LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的强大后训练范式。然而，针对大语言模型的强化学习面临着严重的数据匮乏问题，包括高质量外部监督资源的有限以及模型生成的经验数据量受限。这些限制使得数据高效型强化学习成为一项至关重要的研究方向。在本综述中，我们首次系统性地探讨了在数据匮乏条件下用于大语言模型的强化学习方法。我们提出了一个自下而上的分层框架，该框架基于三个互补的视角：以数据为中心的视角、以训练为中心的视角以及以框架为中心的视角。我们制定了现有方法的分类体系，总结了每个类别中的代表性方法，并分析了它们的优点与局限性。我们的分类体系旨在为理解数据高效型强化学习的设计空间提供清晰的概念基础，并为从事这一新兴领域的研究人员提供指导。我们希望本综述能够为未来的研究提供全面的路线图，并激发出更高效、可扩展的大语言模型后训练强化学习的新方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SADA: Bridging In-Context Learning and Fine-Tuning via State-Aligned Distillation Adapters
papers.title_zh: SADA：通过状态对齐蒸馏适配器实现上下文学习与微调之间的衔接
papers.authors: Wenhao Gao, Tianlong Wang, Wei Jia, Linhao Zhang, Aiwei Liu, Miao Fan, Zhou Xiao
papers.abstract: Prompt-based in-context learning (ICL) and parameter fine-tuning are two dominant paradigms for incorporating external information into large language models (LLMs), but they incur high inference costs or require expensive retraining. To bridge this gap, context-to-parameter mapping converts prompts into temporary adapter weights. However, we identify a critical failure mode in existing methods: hidden-state collapse, where the adapter-augmented model’s internal states diverge sharply from the full-context oracle in deeper layers. We trace this failure to two coupled gaps: suboptimal Input-Selection and inadequate Supervision-Signal. To address these issues, we propose SADA (State-Aligned Distillation Adapters). We establish the attention-block output as a principled feature interface to improve input selection and introduce state-alignment distillation to enforce consistency between the adapter-augmented model and the full-context oracle. Experiments on long-context language modeling (PG19) and downstream NLU and summarization benchmarks show that SADA consistently outperforms strong baselines like StreamAdapter and GenerativeAdapter, achieving performance comparable to ICL while significantly reducing memory footprint and latency. We further analyze when parameterized context compression is effective and when explicit context retention remains preferable. Our code is available at https://github.com/Taylor-Gavel/SADA.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于提示的上下文学习（ICL）和参数微调是两种将外部信息融入大语言模型中的主流方法，但它们会带来较高的推理成本或需要昂贵的重新训练。为了填补这一空白，上下文到参数的映射可以将提示转换为临时的适配器权重。然而，我们发现现有方法存在一个关键缺陷：隐藏状态崩溃现象，即适配器增强模型的内部状态在更深层次上与完整上下文的参考模型出现显著偏差。我们将这一缺陷归因于两个相互关联的问题：次优的输入选择以及不足的监督信号。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了SADA（状态对齐蒸馏适配器）。我们将注意力块输出视为一个原则性的特征接口，以改进输入选择；同时引入状态对齐蒸馏机制，以确保适配器增强模型与完整上下文的参考模型之间的一致性。在长上下文语言建模（PG19）以及下游自然语言理解和摘要任务上的实验表明，SADA始终优于诸如StreamAdapter和GenerativeAdapter这样的强基线算法，其性能与ICL相当，同时显著减少了内存占用和延迟。我们还分析了何时参数化的上下文压缩有效，以及何时显式的上下文保留更为合适。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Taylor-Gavel/SADA.git获取。

papers.title: Anti-Length Shift: Dynamic Outlier Truncation for Training Efficient Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 反长度偏移：动态截断异常值以训练出高效的推理模型
papers.authors: Wei Wu, Liyi Chen, Congxi Xiao, Tianfu Wang, Qimeng Wang, Chengqiang Lu, Yan Gao, Yiwu, Yao Hu, Hui Xiong
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models enhanced by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards have achieved significant performance gains by extending their chain-of-thought. However, this paradigm incurs substantial deployment costs as models often exhibit excessive verbosity on simple queries. Existing efficient reasoning methods relying on explicit length penalties often introduce optimization conflicts and leave the generative mechanisms driving overthinking largely unexamined. In this paper, we identify a phenomenon termed length shift where models increasingly generate unnecessary reasoning on trivial inputs during training. To address this, we introduce Dynamic Outlier Truncation (DOT), a training-time intervention that selectively suppresses redundant tokens. This method targets only the extreme tail of response lengths within fully correct rollout groups while preserving long-horizon reasoning capabilities for complex problems. To complement this intervention and ensure stable convergence, we further incorporate auxiliary KL regularization and predictive dynamic sampling. Experimental results across multiple model scales demonstrate that our approach significantly pushes the efficiency-performance Pareto frontier outward. Notably, on the AIME-24, our method reduces inference token usage by 78% while simultaneously increasing accuracy compared to the initial policy and surpassing state-of-the-art efficient reasoning methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过强化学习与可验证奖励来增强的大型推理模型，在扩展其思维链方面取得了显著的性能提升。然而，这种范式会带来较高的部署成本，因为模型在处理简单查询时往往会产生过多的冗余信息。现有的高效推理方法通常依赖于显式的长度惩罚机制，但这往往会导致优化冲突，同时使得生成机制过度思考的问题得不到有效解决。在本文中，我们发现了一种称为“长度偏移”的现象：在训练过程中，模型会在处理琐碎输入时产生不必要的推理内容。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了动态异常值截断技术，这是一种在训练过程中选择性地抑制冗余信息的干预手段。该方法仅针对完全正确的回答组中的极端响应长度进行干预，同时保留了处理复杂问题的长期推理能力。为了进一步巩固这一干预效果并确保稳定的收敛性，我们还引入了辅助的KL正则化和预测性动态采样技术。在多个模型规模上的实验结果表明，我们的方法显著地将效率与性能之间的帕累托边界向外侧推进。值得注意的是，在AIME-24任务上，我们的方法将推理所需令牌数量减少了78%，同时提高了准确性，其效果优于最初的策略，并且超越了目前最先进的高效推理方法。
