papers.title: The Proxy Presumption: From Semantic Embeddings to Valid Social Measures
papers.title_zh: 代理假设：从语义嵌入到有效的社会测量方法
papers.authors: Baishi Li, Ta Yu, Kelvin J.L. Koa, Ke-Wei Huang
papers.abstract: Natural Language Processing is rapidly evolving into a primary instrument for Computational Social Science, with researchers increasingly using embeddings to measure latent constructs such as novelty, creativity, and bias. However, this transition faces a fundamental validity challenge: the “Proxy Presumption,” or the reliance on geometric properties (e.g., cosine distance) as direct measures of social concepts. We argue that without explicit validation, unsupervised representations remain entangled mixtures of the target construct (C) and confounding attributes (Z) like topic, style, and authorship. To bridge the gap between semantic embeddings and valid social measures, we introduce the Construct Validity Protocol (CVP). Drawing on causal representation learning and psychometrics, the CVP offers a rigorous pipeline from conceptualization to quantitative verification. We further propose Counterfactual Neutralization, a novel method using LLMs to reduce confounding in embedding space. By providing a standardized Validity Suite—including tests for discriminant, incremental, and predictive validity—this work offers the community a toolkit to transform heuristic proxies into robust, scientifically defensible instruments.
papers.abstract_zh: 自然语言处理正迅速发展成为计算社会科学的主要工具，研究人员越来越多地使用嵌入技术来衡量诸如新颖性、创造性和偏见等潜在概念。然而，这一转变面临着一个根本性的有效性挑战：即“代理假设”问题，也就是依赖几何属性（如余弦距离）作为社会概念的直接衡量方式。我们认为，如果没有明确的验证，无监督表示仍然只是目标概念与各种混杂因素（如主题、风格和作者身份）的混合体。为了弥合语义嵌入与有效社会测量之间的差距，我们提出了“概念有效性协议”。该协议基于因果表示学习和心理统计学原理，提供了一种从概念化到定量验证的严格流程。此外，我们还提出了“反事实中性化”方法，这是一种利用大语言模型来减少嵌入空间中混杂因素的新方法。通过提供一套标准化的有效性测试工具——包括区分性有效性、增量性和有效性测试——这项工作为学术界提供了一个工具包，可以将启发式的代理指标转化为可靠且具有科学依据的测量工具。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Nested Browser-Use Learning for Agentic Information Seeking
papers.title_zh: 基于嵌套浏览器的智能信息检索学习方法
papers.authors: Baixuan Li, Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Kuan Li, Zhongwang Zhang, Huifeng Yin, Zhengwei Tao, Liwen Zhang, Pengjun Xie, Jingren Zhou, Yong Jiang, Wentao Zhang, Zhiqiang Gao
papers.abstract: Information-seeking (IS) agents have achieved strong performance across a range of wide and deep search tasks, yet their tool use remains largely restricted to API-level snippet retrieval and URL-based page fetching, limiting access to the richer information available through real browsing. While full browser interaction could unlock deeper capabilities, its fine-grained control and verbose page content returns introduce substantial complexity for ReAct-style function-calling agents. To bridge this gap, we propose Nested Browser-Use Learning (NestBrowse), which introduces a minimal and complete browser-action framework that decouples interaction control from page exploration through a nested structure. This design simplifies agentic reasoning while enabling effective deep-web information acquisition. Empirical results on challenging deep IS benchmarks demonstrate that NestBrowse offers clear benefits in practice. Further in-depth analyses underscore its efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 信息检索代理在多种广泛且复杂的搜索任务中表现优异，但它们的工具使用仍然主要局限于API级别的片段检索和基于URL的页面获取，这限制了它们获取通过真实浏览获得的更丰富信息的机会。虽然完全的浏览器交互可以解锁更深层次的能力，但其细粒度的控制和详细的页面内容返回为ReAct风格的函数调用代理带来了巨大的复杂性。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了嵌套浏览器使用学习机制（NestBrowse），该机制引入了一个最小化和完整的浏览器操作框架，通过将交互控制与页面探索分离开来，从而简化了代理的推理过程，同时实现了对深度网络信息的有效获取。在具有挑战性的深度信息检索基准测试中的实证结果表明，NestBrowse在实际应用中确实具有明显优势。进一步的深入分析进一步证明了其高效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CamoQuery: Language-Guided Reasoning Camouflaged Object Segmentation
papers.title_zh: CamoQuery：基于语言的推理式伪装物体分割方法
papers.authors: Tianxin Han, Qing Dong, Xingwei Wang, Jie Jia, Gang Wu, Bowen Yang, Fu Zhang
papers.abstract: Although camouflaged object segmentation has advanced rapidly in recent years, existing methods are still confined to visual mask prediction under fixed task assumptions. They cannot interactively respond to user requests, nor can they proactively understand and reason about the user’s intent. Our work tackles this issue by proposing a novel task, Language-Guided Reasoning Camouflaged Object Segmentation (LRCOS). Given a camouflaged image and an implicit query text instruction that requires reasoning, LRCOS aims to output intent-consistent segmentation mask. To establish a benchmark for this task, we build CamoQuery, comprising 12,437 image–mask samples and 25971 implicit query text instructions. To better reflect real-world camouflaged scenarios, we additionally collect MCD, a multi-instance camouflage dataset where multiple camouflaged targets co-exist within the same scene, increasing the need for reasoning. Building on CamoQuery, we further propose COSA, a vision–language segmentation assistant that segments the intended camouflaged object from implicit queries and produces a reasoning explanation. Experiments on CamoQuery demonstrate that COSA has strong reasoning segmentation capability in camouflaged scenes and exhibits zero-shot capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管近年来伪装物体分割技术取得了显著进展，但现有方法仍然局限于在固定任务假设下的视觉掩模预测。这些方法无法交互式地响应用户请求，也无法主动理解并推理用户的意图。我们的研究通过提出一种新颖的任务——语言引导的伪装物体分割（LRCOS）来解决这个问题。给定一张伪装图像以及需要推理的隐式查询文本指令，LRCOS旨在输出符合用户意图的分割掩模。为了为这一任务建立基准，我们构建了CamoQuery数据集，包含12,437个图像-掩模样本和25,971条隐式查询文本指令。为了更好地反映现实中的伪装场景，我们还收集了MCD多实例伪装数据集，该数据集中多个伪装目标存在于同一场景中，这增加了推理的需求。在CamoQuery的基础上，我们进一步提出了COSA，这是一种视觉与语言结合的分割助手，它能够从隐式查询中分离出预期的伪装物体，并生成推理性解释。在CamoQuery上的实验表明，COSA在伪装场景中具有强大的推理分割能力，并且具备零样本学习能力。

papers.title: Large Language Models Are Bad Dice Players: LLMs Struggle to Generate Random Numbers from Statistical Distributions
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型并不擅长生成随机数：LLM难以从统计分布中生成随机数值
papers.authors: Minda Zhao, Yilun Du, Mengyu Wang
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) transition from chat interfaces to integral components of stochastic pipelines and systems approaching general intelligence, the ability to faithfully sample from specified probability distributions has become a functional requirement rather than a theoretical curiosity. We present the first large-scale, statistically powered audit of native probabilistic sampling in frontier LLMs, benchmarking 11 models across 15 distributions. To disentangle failure modes, we employ a dual-protocol design: Batch Generation, where a model produces N{=}1000 samples within one response, and Independent Requests, comprising N{=}1000 stateless calls. We observe a sharp protocol asymmetry: batch generation achieves only modest statistical validity, with a 7% median pass rate, while independent requests collapse almost entirely, with 10 of 11 models passing none of the distributions. Beyond this asymmetry, we reveal that sampling fidelity degrades monotonically with distributional complexity and aggravates as the sampling horizon N increases. Finally, we demonstrate how the propagation of these failures into downstream real-world application tasks introduces systematic biases: models fail to enforce uniform answer-position constraints in Multiple Choice Question generation and systematically violate demographic targets in attribute-constrained text-to-image prompt synthesis. These findings indicate that current LLMs lack a functional internal sampler, necessitating external tools for applications requiring statistical guarantees.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型从聊天界面转变为实现通用智能的随机流程和系统中的核心组件，能够忠实地从指定的概率分布中采样已经不再是一种理论上的好奇行为，而是了一项重要的功能需求。我们首次对前沿大语言模型中原生概率采样进行了大规模、具有统计依据的评估，对11个模型在15种分布下的表现进行了测试。为了分析故障模式，我们采用了双协议设计：批量生成，即模型在一次响应内生成N=1000个样本；独立请求，即模型进行N=1000次无状态调用。我们发现了一个明显的协议不对称现象：批量生成的统计有效性较低，中位通过率仅为7%，而独立请求的通过率几乎为零，11个模型中有10个模型无法从任何分布中生成样本。除了这种不对称现象外，我们还发现，随着分布的复杂性的增加，采样的准确性会持续下降，而且当采样范围N增加时，这种下降会更加明显。最后，我们揭示了这些故障在后续实际应用任务中的传播所带来的系统性偏差：模型在生成选择题时无法确保答案位置的统一性，在属性约束的文本到图像生成任务中则系统性地违反了人口统计目标。这些发现表明，当前的大语言模型缺乏有效的内部采样机制，因此对于需要统计保证的应用来说，就需要使用外部工具来辅助处理。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PROMPRINT: Prompt Fingerprinting via First-Token Response for LLM App Cloning Detection
papers.title_zh: PROMPRINT：通过首次令牌响应实现快速指纹识别，以检测LLM应用程序的克隆行为
papers.authors: Jungmin Lee, Peizhuo Lv, Yeonjoon Lee
papers.abstract: As Large Language Model applications (LLM apps) become widespread, system prompts that determine app behavior are increasingly regarded as intellectual property, raising concerns about leakage. Recent studies show that this threat is no longer theoretical, revealing the prevalence of cloned apps replicating system prompts from others on real-world platforms. These clones pose risks of copyright infringement and malicious misuse, highlighting the need for early and reliable detection. In this paper, we propose PROMPRINT, a novel fingerprinting approach for detecting cloned LLM apps without exposing their system prompts. Motivated by the insight that different system prompts yield distinct responses to the same query, PROMPRINT optimizes queries that induce the LLM to generate a specific first token associated with the given system prompt, resulting in distinctive query–first-token pairs. Experiments on four instruction-tuned LLMs show that generated pairs effectively identify the corresponding system prompts, achieving over 74% probability of generating the target token while remaining below 2.2% on average under other prompts. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our fingerprinting remains robust to partial system prompt modifications and effective under the injection of adversarial instructions.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型应用程序的广泛应用，那些决定应用程序行为的系统提示越来越被视为知识产权，这引发了关于数据泄露的担忧。最近的研究表明，这种威胁已不再只是理论上的问题，实际上在现实平台上有许多克隆应用程序正在复制其他应用程序的系统提示。这些克隆应用程序存在侵犯版权和恶意滥用的风险，因此迫切需要早期且可靠的检测手段。在本文中，我们提出了PROMPRINT这一创新性的指纹识别方法，该方法能够在不暴露系统提示的情况下，识别出克隆的大语言模型应用程序。由于不同的系统提示会对相同的查询产生不同的响应，PROMPRINT通过优化查询来促使大语言模型生成与特定系统提示相关的第一个令牌，从而形成独特的查询-第一个令牌对。在四个经过指令调优的大语言模型上进行实验表明，生成的这对令牌能够有效地识别对应的系统提示，其生成目标令牌的概率高达74%以上，而在其他提示下的生成概率则平均低于2.2%。此外，我们还证明了我们的指纹识别方法对于部分系统提示的修改仍然具有鲁棒性，并且在注入对抗性指令的情况下依然能够有效识别。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MAB-DQA: Addressing Query Aspect Importance in Document Question Answering with Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.title_zh: MAB-DQA：在多臂老虎机模型下的文档问答系统中处理查询节点的重要性问题
papers.authors: Yixin Xiang, Yunshan Ma, Xiaoyu Du, Yibing Chen, Yanxin Zhang, Jinhui Tang
papers.abstract: Document Question Answering (DQA) involves generating answers from a document based on a user’s query, representing a key task in document understanding. This task requires interpreting visual layouts, which has prompted recent studies to adopt multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that processes page images for answer generation. However, in multimodal RAG, visual DQA struggles to utilize a large number of images effectively, as the retrieval stage often retains only a few candidate pages (e.g., Top-4), causing informative but less visually salient content to be overlooked in favor of common yet low-information pages. To address this issue, we propose a Multi-Armed Bandit–based DQA framework (MAB-DQA) to explicitly model the varying importance of multiple implicit aspects in a query. Specifically, MAB-DQA decomposes a query into aspect-aware subqueries and retrieves an aspect-specific candidate set for each. It treats each subquery as an arm and uses preliminary reasoning results from a small number of representative pages as reward signals to estimate aspect utility. Guided by an exploration–exploitation policy, MAB-DQA dynamically reallocates retrieval budgets toward high-value aspects. With the most informative pages and their correlations, MAB-DQA generates the expected results. On four benchmarks, MAB-DQA shows an average improvement of 5%-18% over the state-of-the-art method, consistently enhancing document understanding. Codes are available at https://github.com/ElephantOH/MAB-DQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 文档问答（DQA）是指根据用户的查询从文档中生成答案，这是文档理解中的一个关键任务。这项任务需要解析视觉布局，因此最近的研究采用了多模态检索增强生成技术（RAG），该技术会处理页面中的图像以生成答案。然而，在多模态RAG中，视觉DQA在有效利用大量图像方面存在困难，因为检索阶段通常只保留少数几个候选页面（例如前四名），导致那些信息丰富但视觉上不太突出的内容被忽略，而常见的、信息量较少的页面则被优先处理。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于多臂老虎机模型的DQA框架（MAB-DQA），该框架能够明确建模查询中多个隐含方面的不同重要性。具体来说，MAB-DQA将查询分解为具有方面意识的子查询，并为每个子查询检索特定的候选页面集。它将每个子查询视为一个“手臂”，并利用少量代表性页面的初步推理结果作为奖励信号来估计各个方面的效用。在探索与利用策略的引导下，MAB-DQA动态分配检索资源到价值较高的方面。通过结合最具信息量的页面及其相关性，MAB-DQA能够生成预期的结果。在四个基准测试上，MAB-DQA的平均改进幅度达到了5%至18%，显著提升了文档理解能力。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/ElephantOH/MAB-DQA
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DVCQR: Dual-View Conversational Query Rewriting with Stage-wise Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: DVCQR：基于分阶段强化学习的双视图对话查询重写技术
papers.authors: Chenyi Li, Xinhui Tu, Zaixiang Wang
papers.abstract: Conversational query rewriting (CQR) addresses context dependence in conversational search by rewriting each user query into a standalone form. Recent approaches leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to directly optimize retrieval effectiveness; however, they typically rely on a single rewrite, which struggles to accommodate the divergent preferences of sparse and dense retrievers and often suffers from conflicting optimization signals. We propose DVCQR, a Dual-View CQR framework that explicitly generates two complementary rewrites for each query: a sparse-view rewrite that emphasizes distinctive lexical anchors, and a dense-view rewrite that captures complete semantic constraints. Both rewrites are produced in a single pass via a structured reasoning process. To further mitigate objective conflicts, we introduce a stage-wise RL strategy that sequentially aligns the sparse and dense views with their corresponding retrievers using rank-based feedback. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks (TopiOCQA, QReCC, CAsT-19, and CAsT-20) demonstrate that DVCQR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on most metrics under both sparse and dense retrieval settings, validating the effectiveness of dual-view rewriting and stage-wise retriever alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 对话式查询重写技术通过将所有用户查询转换为独立的形式，来解决对话式搜索中的上下文依赖性问题。近期的一些方法利用强化学习来直接优化检索效果；然而，这些方法通常只采用一种重写方式，这种方式难以满足稀疏检索器和密集检索器的不同偏好需求，而且常常会出现优化信号冲突的问题。我们提出了DVCQR这一双视图对话式查询重写框架，该框架为每个查询生成两种互补的重写方式：一种是强调独特词汇锚点的稀疏视图重写方式，另一种则是能够捕捉完整语义约束的密集视图重写方式。这两种重写方式都是通过结构化的推理过程在单次迭代中生成的。为了进一步缓解目标冲突，我们引入了分阶段强化学习策略，该策略通过基于排名的反馈，逐步将稀疏视图和密集视图与相应的检索器进行对齐。在四个基准测试集（TopiOCQA、QReCC、CAsT-19和CAsT-20）上的广泛实验表明，DVCQR在大多数指标上始终优于现有方法，无论是在稀疏检索还是密集检索的场景下，这验证了双视图重写技术和分阶段检索器对齐策略的有效性。

papers.title: CoEvolve: Training LLM Agents via Agent-Data Mutual Evolution
papers.title_zh: CoEvolve：通过代理数据与智能体之间的相互进化来训练LLM智能体
papers.authors: Shidong Yang, Ziyu Ma, Tongwen Huang, Yiming Hu, Yong Wang, Xiangxiang Chu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for LLM agents is typically conducted on a static data distribution, which fails to adapt to the agent’s evolving behavior and leads to poor coverage of complex environment interactions. To address these challenges, we propose CoEvolve, an agent-data mutual evolution framework that enables LLM agents to improve through closed-loop, interaction-driven training. Specifically, CoEvolve extracts feedback signals such as forgetting and uncertainty from rollout trajectories to identify failure-prone interaction patterns, and utilizes them to guide LLM-based task synthesis. The synthesized tasks are validated through environment interaction and utilized to update the data distribution, enabling joint adaptation of the agent and its data. Extensive experiments on AppWorld and BFCL across Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate consistent and significant improvements over strong base models, yielding absolute gains of 19.43%, 15.58%, and 18.14%, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于LLM智能体来说，强化学习通常是在静态数据分布上进行训练的，这种训练方式无法适应智能体的动态行为变化，从而导致对复杂环境交互的覆盖能力较差。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了CoEvolve框架——一个智能体与数据共同进化的解决方案。该框架通过闭环、以交互为驱动的训练方式，使LLM智能体能够持续改进。具体来说，CoEvolve从实验过程中提取诸如遗忘率、不确定性等反馈信号，以识别容易出现问题的交互模式，并利用这些信号来指导基于LLM的任务合成。经过验证后，这些合成任务被用于更新数据分布，从而实现智能体与其数据的共同进化。在Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B以及Qwen3-30B-A3B上进行的AppWorld和BFCL实验表明，与基础模型相比，我们的方法取得了稳定且显著的改进效果，分别实现了19.43%、15.58%和18.14%的绝对性能提升。

papers.title: Make LLMs See Like Investigators, Not Just Think More: The Role of Structured Analysis in Investigative Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 让大型语言模型像调查员一样思考，而不仅仅是进行推理：结构化分析在调查性推理中的重要作用
papers.authors: Jaewook Lee, Myeong-Cheol Kang, Jong-hun Shin
papers.abstract: Criminal investigators and intelligence analysts have developed structured analytic techniques to evaluate competing hypotheses under incomplete information. This study examines whether such human expert investigative methodologies are also effective for narrative-based culprit inference in large language models (LLMs). Focusing on the task of analyzing evidence from complex narratives and identifying the perpetrator among suspects, we conducted experiments on 10 LLMs using the MuSR murder mystery benchmark. The PRISM framework, which applies investigative techniques, consistently outperformed existing general-purpose strategies across all models, with its effectiveness manifesting regardless of model scale. Ablation studies revealed that the hypothesis structuring stage is particularly crucial, accounting for 89% of the methodological improvement beyond information filtering. This suggests that domain-specific structures that specify “what to analyze” are more effective in LLM reasoning than simply increasing the number of reasoning paths.
papers.abstract_zh: 刑事调查员和情报分析师已经开发出结构化的分析技术，用于在信息不完整的情况下评估不同的假设。本研究旨在探讨这种人类专家式的调查方法是否也适用于大语言模型中的基于叙述的犯罪推理。我们针对从复杂叙述中提取证据并找出嫌疑犯的过程进行了实验，使用了MuSR谋杀案基准测试对10个大语言模型进行了测试。采用调查技术的PRISM框架在所有模型中均优于现有通用策略，其有效性不受模型规模的影响。消融研究表明，假设结构化阶段尤为重要，在信息过滤之外贡献了该方法改进效果的 89%。这表明，那些能够明确“需要分析什么”的领域特定结构，在大语言模型的推理中比单纯增加推理路径的数量更为有效。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FormalScience: Scalable Human-in-the-Loop Autoformalisation of Science with Agentic Code Generation in Lean
papers.title_zh: FormalScience：可扩展的人类参与式科学自动形式化技术，结合智能代码生成，旨在实现高效的科学建模
papers.authors: Jordan Meadows, Lan Zhang, Andre Freitas
papers.abstract: Formalising informal mathematical reasoning into formally verifiable code is a significant challenge for large language models. In scientific fields such as physics, domain-specific machinery (e.g. Dirac notation, vector calculus) imposes additional formalisation challenges that modern LLMs and agentic approaches have yet to tackle. To aid autoformalisation in scientific domains, we present FormalScience; a domain-agnostic human-in-the-loop agentic pipeline that enables a single domain expert (without deep formal language experience) to produce syntactically correct and semantically aligned formal proofs of informal reasoning for low economic cost. Applying FormalScience to physics, we construct FormalPhysics, a dataset of 200 university-level (LaTeX) physics problems and solutions (primarily quantum mechanics and electromagnetism), along with their Lean4 formal representations. Compared to existing formal math benchmarks, FormalPhysics achieves perfect formal validity and exhibits greater statement complexity. We evaluate open-source models and proprietary systems on a statement autoformalisation task on our dataset via zero-shot prompting, self-refinement with error feedback, and a novel multi-stage agentic approach, and explore autoformalisation limitations in modern LLM-based approaches. We provide the first systematic characterisation of semantic drift in physics autoformalisation in terms of concepts such as notational collapse and abstraction elevation which reveals what formal language verifies when full semantic preservation is unattainable. We release the codebase together with an interactive UI-based FormalScience system which facilitates autoformalisation and theorem proving in scientific domains beyond physics.[https://github.com/jmeadows17/formal-science]
papers.abstract_zh: 将非正式的数学推理形式化为可验证的代码，对于大语言模型来说是一个重大挑战。在物理学等科学领域，特定领域的工具（如狄拉克符号、向量微积分）带来了额外的形式化挑战，而现代大语言模型和智能体方法尚未能够解决这些问题。为了帮助自动形式化在科学领域中的应用，我们提出了FormalScience这一与领域无关的人工干预式智能体流程。该流程使得单一领域的专家（无需深厚的正式语言经验）能够以较低的成本生成语法正确且语义一致的正式证明。将FormalScience应用于物理学领域后，我们构建了一个名为FormalPhysics的数据集，其中包含200个大学级别的物理问题及其解决方案（主要涉及量子力学和电磁学），以及相应的Lean4形式化表示。与现有的正式数学基准测试相比，FormalPhysics在形式有效性方面达到了完美水平，并且其陈述的复杂性也更高。我们在我们的数据集上评估了开源模型和专有系统在自动形式化任务上的表现，采用了零样本提示、带有错误反馈的自我完善方法以及一种新颖的多阶段智能体方法。我们还探讨了现代基于大语言模型的方法在自动形式化方面的局限性。我们首次系统地描述了物理学自动形式化过程中语义漂移的现象，例如符号简化和抽象提升等问题，这些现象揭示了在无法实现完全语义保留的情况下，正式语言能够验证的内容。我们同时发布了代码库以及一个基于交互式UI的FormalScience系统，该系统有助于在物理学以外的科学领域进行自动形式化和定理证明。[https://github.com/jmeadows17/formal-science]

papers.title: MUR: Momentum Uncertainty guided Reasoning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 市场波动：大型语言模型中的动量不确定性与推理机制
papers.authors: Hang Yan, Fangzhi Xu, Rongman Xu, Yifei Li, Jian Zhang, Haoran Luo, Xiaobao Wu, Anh Tuan Luu, Haiteng Zhao, Qika Lin, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved impressive performance on reasoning-intensive tasks, yet optimizing their reasoning efficiency remains an open challenge. While Test-Time Scaling (TTS) improves reasoning quality, it often leads to overthinking—wasting tokens on redundant computations. This work investigates how to efficiently and adaptively guide LLM TTS without additional training. Inspired by the concept of momentum in physics, we propose Momentum Uncertainty-guided Reasoning (MUR), which dynamically allocates thinking budgets to critical reasoning steps by tracking and aggregating step-wise uncertainty over time. To support flexible inference-time control, we introduce -control, a simple mechanism that tunes the reasoning budget via a single hyperparameter. We provide in-depth theoretical proof to support the superiority of MUR in terms of stability and biases. MUR is comprehensively evaluated against various TTS methods across four challenging benchmarks (MATH-500, AIME24, AIME25, and GPQA-diamond) using different sizes of recent Qwen3 models (1.7B, 4B, and 8B). Results demonstrate that MUR reduces computation by over 45% on average while improving accuracy by 0.33–3.46%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在需要推理的任务上取得了令人印象深刻的性能，但优化其推理效率仍然是一个未解决的挑战。虽然测试时间扩展技术能够提升推理质量，但它往往会导致过度思考——浪费资源在冗余的计算上。本研究探讨了如何在不进行额外训练的情况下，高效且自适应地指导大语言模型的测试时间扩展。受物理学中动量概念的启发，我们提出了动量不确定性引导推理方法，该方法通过跟踪和汇总随时间变化的步骤不确定性，动态分配推理资源给关键的推理步骤。为了支持灵活的推理时间控制，我们引入了一种简单的机制——控制，该机制通过一个超参数来调节推理资源。我们通过深入的理论分析证明了动量引导推理在稳定性和偏差方面的优越性。我们在四个具有挑战性的基准测试（MATH-500、AIME24、AIME25和GPQA-diamond）中对各种测试时间扩展方法进行了全面评估，使用了不同规模的最新Qwen3模型（1.7B、4B和8B）。结果表明，动量引导推理平均可以减少45%的计算量，同时提高0.33至3.46%的准确率。

papers.title: BiMol-Diff: A Unified Diffusion Framework for Molecular Generation and Captioning
papers.title_zh: BiMol-Diff：一种用于分子生成与标注的统一扩散框架
papers.authors: Aditya Hemant Shahane, Anuj Kumar Sirohi, Devansh Arora, Nitin Kumar, Prathosh AP, Sandeep Kumar
papers.abstract: Bridging molecular structures and natural language is essential for controllable design. Autoregressive models struggle with long-range dependencies, while standard diffusion processes apply uniform corruption across positions, which can distort structurally informative tokens. We present BiMol-Diff, a unified diffusion framework for the paired tasks of text-conditioned molecule generation and molecule captioning. Our key component is a token-aware noise schedule that assigns position-dependent corruption based on token recovery difficulty, preserving harder-to-recover substructures during the forward process. On ChEBI-20 and M3-20M, BiMol-Diff improves molecule reconstruction with a 15.4% relative gain in Exact Match and achieves strong captioning results, attaining best BLEU and BERTScore among compared baselines. These results indicate token-aware noising improves fidelity in molecular structure-language modeling
papers.abstract_zh: 构建分子结构与自然语言之间的桥梁对于可控设计至关重要。自回归模型在处理长距离依赖关系时存在困难，而标准的扩散过程则会导致所有位置都受到同样的破坏，这可能会扭曲具有结构信息的原子团。我们提出了BiMol-Diff，这是一个统一的扩散框架，适用于文本条件分子生成和分子描述两个任务。我们的核心组件是一个基于原子团意识的噪声调度机制，它根据原子团的恢复难度来分配不同位置的破坏程度，从而在前向处理过程中保留那些难以恢复的子结构。在ChEBI-20和M3-20M数据集上，BiMol-Diff在分子重建方面取得了15.4%的相对提升，同时在描述结果上也表现优异，其BLEU和BERTScore指标均优于其他基线方法。这些结果表明，基于原子团意识的噪声处理方式能够提高分子结构-语言建模的精确度。

papers.title: PEAP: Proactive Embodied Action Sequence Planning with Joint Understanding of Vision and Audio Perception
papers.title_zh: PEAP：基于视觉与听觉感知的主动体化动作序列规划
papers.authors: Tianwei Lan, Jiaqi Wu, Zeming Liu, Zhaoxin Fan, Haifeng Wang, Yuhang Guo
papers.abstract: Embodied Action Sequence Planning focuses on the capability of embodied agents to implement action planning via environmental perception. This technology enables diverse intelligent assistance for real-world scenarios such as home and office environments. To address the limitations of existing embodied agents in meeting the requirement for proactivity and achieving joint understanding of visual and audio information, this study investigates the ability of embodied agents to proactively provide assistance through action sequence planning based on joint understanding of vision and audio perception without explicit human instructions. Correspondingly, we propose PEAP, the first multimodal proactive embodied action sequence planning dataset. We evaluate the performance of multiple Large Language Models on the PEAP dataset. The results demonstrate that these models still exhibit significant deficiencies on this task particularly lacking accurate environmental perception capabilities. Furthermore, ablation experiment and replacement experiment further corroborate that the joint understanding of multimodal information can significantly improve the models’ performance on proactive embodied action sequence planning task.
papers.abstract_zh: 具身动作序列规划专注于具身智能体通过环境感知来实现动作规划的能力。这项技术能够为现实世界中的各种场景提供智能辅助，比如家庭和工作场所的环境。为了克服现有具身智能体在主动性和对视觉与听觉信息的联合理解方面的局限性，本研究探讨了具身智能体是否能够在无需人类明确指令的情况下，基于视觉和听觉感知的联合理解，主动提供辅助服务。相应地，我们提出了PEAP这一首个多模态的具身动作序列规划数据集。我们在PEAP数据集上评估了多种大语言模型的性能。结果表明，这些模型在这一任务上仍然存在显著不足，尤其是在准确的环境感知能力方面。此外，通过消融实验和替换实验进一步证实，对多模态信息的联合理解能够显著提升模型在具身动作序列规划任务上的性能。

papers.title: Automated Creativity Evaluation of Language Models Across Open-Ended Tasks
papers.title_zh: 语言模型在开放性任务中的自动化创造力评估
papers.authors: Tan Min Sen, Zachary Choy Kit Chun, Syed Ali Redha Alsagoff, Nadya Yuki Wangsajaya, Banerjee Mohor, Swaagat Bikash Saikia, Alvin Chan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in language understanding, reasoning, and generation, sparking growing interest in their creative potential. Realizing this potential requires systematic and scalable methods for evaluating creativity across diverse tasks. However, most existing creativity metrics are tightly coupled to specific tasks, embedding domain assumptions into the evaluation process, and limiting scalability and generality. To address this gap, we introduce an automated, domain-agnostic framework for quantifying LLM creativity across open-ended tasks. Our approach separates the measurement apparatus from the creative task itself, enabling scalable, task-agnostic assessment. Divergent creativity is measured using semantic entropy, a reference-free and robust metric for novelty and diversity, validated against human annotations, LLM-based novelty judgments and baseline diversity measures. Convergent creativity is assessed via a novel retrieval-based multi-agent judge framework that delivers context-sensitive evaluation of task fulfilment with over 60% improved efficiency. We validate our framework in three qualitatively distinct domains: problem-solving (MacGyver), research ideation (HypoGen), and creative writing (BookMIA), using a broad suite of LLMs. Empirical results show that our framework reliably captures key facets of creativity, including novelty, diversity, and task fulfilment, and reveal how model properties, such as size, temperature, recency, and reasoning, impact creative performance. Our work establishes a reproducible and generalizable standard for automated LLM creativity evaluation, paving the way for scalable benchmarking and accelerating progress in creative AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在语言理解、推理和生成方面取得了显著进展，人们对它们的创造潜力越来越感兴趣。要充分发挥这种潜力，就需要有系统且可扩展的方法来评估不同任务中的创造力。然而，目前大多数创造力评估指标都紧密依赖于特定任务，这会将领域假设纳入评估过程，从而限制了评估的可扩展性和通用性。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一个自动化、与领域无关的框架，用于量化大语言模型在开放式任务中的创造力。我们的方法将评估机制与创作任务分离开来，从而实现可扩展且不受任务影响的评估。发散性创造力通过语义熵来衡量，这是一种无需参考且可靠的衡量新颖性和多样性的指标，该指标已通过人类注释、基于大语言模型的新颖性判断以及基线多样性度量进行了验证。收敛性创造力则通过一种创新的基于检索的多智能体评估框架来评定，该框架能够针对任务完成情况提供上下文敏感的评估，其效率提升了60%以上。我们在三个具有明显差异的领域中验证了我们的框架：问题解决（MacGyver）、研究构思（HypoGen）和创意写作（BookMIA），所使用的语言模型涵盖了多种类型。实证结果表明，我们的框架能够可靠地捕捉到创造力的关键要素，包括新颖性、多样性和任务完成度，并揭示了模型属性如规模、温度、最新性和推理能力对创造力表现的影响。我们的工作为自动化的大语言模型创造力评估建立了一个可复制且通用的标准，为可扩展的基准测试铺平了道路，并加速了创造性人工智能的发展。

papers.title: Aligning Agents via Planning: A Benchmark for Trajectory-Level Reward Modeling
papers.title_zh: 通过规划来对齐代理：一种用于轨迹级奖励建模的基准方法
papers.authors: Jiaxuan Wang, Yulan Hu, Wenjin Yang, Zheng Pan, Xin Li, Lan-Zhe Guo
papers.abstract: In classical Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), Reward Models (RMs) serve as the fundamental signal provider for model alignment. As Large Language Models evolve into agentic systems capable of autonomous tool invocation and complex reasoning, the paradigm of reward modeling faces unprecedented challenges–most notably, the lack of benchmarks specifically designed to assess RM capabilities within tool-integrated environments. To address this gap, we present Plan-RewardBench, a trajectory-level preference benchmark designed to evaluate how well judges distinguish preferred versus distractor agent trajectories in complex tool-using scenarios. Plan-RewardBench covers four representative task families—(i) Safety Refusal, (ii) Tool-Irrelevance / Unavailability, (iii) Complex Planning, and (iv) Robust Error Recovery—comprising validated positive trajectories and confusable hard negatives constructed via multi-model natural rollouts, rule-based perturbations, and minimal-edit LLM perturbations. We benchmark representative RMs (generative, discriminative, and LLM-as-Judge) under a unified pairwise protocol, reporting accuracy trends across varying trajectory lengths and task categories. Furthermore, we provide diagnostic analyses of prevalent failure modes. Our results reveal that all three evaluator families face substantial challenges, with performance degrading sharply on long-horizon trajectories, underscoring the necessity for specialized training in agentic, trajectory-level reward modeling. Ultimately, Plan-RewardBench aims to serve as both a practical evaluation suite and a reusable blueprint for constructing agentic planning preference data.
papers.abstract_zh: 在传统的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）中，奖励模型作为模型对齐的基本信号提供者。随着大语言模型发展成为能够自主调用工具和进行复杂推理的智能体系统，奖励建模这一范式面临着前所未有的挑战——最显著的问题是，缺乏专门设计用于评估在工具集成环境中奖励模型能力的基准测试。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了Plan-RewardBench，这是一个基于轨迹级别的偏好评估基准，旨在衡量评估者区分在复杂工具使用场景中更受青睐的代理轨迹与干扰轨迹的能力。Plan-RewardBench涵盖了四个具有代表性的任务类别：(i) 安全拒绝；(ii) 工具无关性/不可用性；(iii) 复杂规划；以及(iv) 鲁棒的错误恢复。这些任务包括经过验证的正面轨迹，以及通过多模型自然展开、基于规则的扰动以及最小编辑的LLM扰动方式构建的具有误导性的负面样本。我们在统一的成对协议下对代表性的奖励模型进行了评估（包括生成式模型、判别式模型以及以评估者身份运行的LLM模型），并记录了不同轨迹长度和工作类别下的准确率趋势。此外，我们还提供了关于常见故障模式的诊断分析。我们的研究结果表明，所有三种评估器类型都面临重大挑战，尤其是在处理长周期轨迹时，其性能会急剧下降，这凸显了在智能体级奖励建模方面进行专门训练的重要性。最终，Plan-RewardBench旨在成为一个实用的评估工具套件，同时也是一个可重复使用的构建智能体规划偏好数据的蓝图。

papers.title: From Synthesis to Clinical Assistance: A Strategy-Aware Agent Framework for Autism Intervention based on Real Clinical Dataset
papers.title_zh: 从理论分析到临床应用：基于真实临床数据的自闭症干预策略型智能体框架
papers.authors: Junhong Lai, Shuzhong Lai, Yanhao Yu, Wanlin Chen, Chenyu Yan, Haifeng Li, Lin Yao, Yueming Wang
papers.abstract: The development of AI-assisted Early Intensive Behavioral Intervention (EIBI) for Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is severely constrained by data scarcity. Furthermore, while Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) serves as the gold standard for clinical intervention, general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to strictly adhere to its standardized procedures, often resulting in interactions that are linguistically fluent but strategically inconsistent. To address these challenges, we introduce ASDAgent, a strategy-aware framework designed to unify high-fidelity intervention dialogue synthesis and clinical decision support. ASDAgent incorporates two specialized components to solve distinct problems: (i) a DoctorAgent equipped with an Observe-Think-Act-Correct (O-T-A-C) reasoning loop, which resolves the issue of strategy collapse in LLMs by making ABA execution explicit and controllable; and (ii) a ChildAgent that utilizes probabilistic behavior modeling to mitigate data homogeneity, simulating diverse and non-deterministic ASD response patterns. Experiments demonstrate that dialogues generated by ASDAgent closely mirror the strategy distribution of human therapists (KL divergence: 0.083). In real autism intervention, ASDAgent achieves nearly 80% strategic consistency with human experts. Moreover, we show that synthetic data produced by ASDAgent effectively distills professional clinical knowledge into small language models (SLMs), significantly enhancing their therapeutic capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的AI辅助早期强化行为干预技术的发展，因数据匮乏而受到严重限制。虽然应用行为分析（ABA）被公认为临床干预的黄金标准，但通用大语言模型（LLM）在遵循其标准化流程时存在困难，导致生成的对话虽然在语言上流畅，但在策略上却不够一致。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ASDAgent这一具有策略意识的框架，旨在实现高保真度的干预对话合成与临床决策支持的结合。ASDAgent包含两个专门组件来解决不同问题：(i) 医生代理，配备观察-思考-行动-纠正（O-T-A-C）推理循环，通过使ABA执行过程明确且可控，从而解决LLM中策略崩溃的问题；(ii) 儿童代理，利用概率行为建模来减轻数据同质性的问题，模拟多样且不确定的ASD反应模式。实验表明，ASDAgent生成的对话与人类治疗师的策略分布高度一致（KL散度：0.083）。在实际的自闭症干预中，ASDAgent的策略一致性接近80%，与人类专家相当。此外，我们还发现，ASDAgent生成的合成数据能够有效地将专业临床知识提炼成小型语言模型，显著提升了它们的治疗能力。

papers.title: How Training Data Shapes the Use of Parametric and In-Context Knowledge in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 训练数据如何塑造语言模型中参数式知识及上下文知识的使用方式
papers.authors: Minsung Kim, Dong-Kyum Kim, Jea Kwon, Nakyeong Yang, Kyomin Jung, Meeyoung Cha
papers.abstract: Large language models leverage both parametric knowledge acquired during pretraining and in-context knowledge provided at inference time. Crucially, when these sources conflict, models arbitrate based on their internal confidence, preferring parametric knowledge for high-confidence facts while deferring to context for less familiar ones. However, the training conditions that give rise to these fundamental behaviors remain unclear. Here we conduct controlled experiments using synthetic corpora to identify the specific data properties that shape knowledge utilization. Our results reveal a counterintuitive finding: the robust, balanced use of both knowledge sources is an emergent property that requires the co-occurrence of three factors typically considered detrimental, including (i) intra-document repetition, (ii) a moderate degree of intra-document inconsistency, and (iii) a skewed knowledge distribution. We further show that these dynamics arise in real-world language model pretraining and analyze how post-training procedures reshape arbitration strategies. Together, our findings provide empirical guidance for designing training data that supports the reliable integration of parametric and in-context knowledge in language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型利用了在预训练阶段获得的参数化知识以及在推理时提供的上下文知识。关键的是，当这两种来源出现冲突时，模型会基于其内部置信度进行裁决，对于高置信度的信息优先使用参数化知识，而对于不太熟悉的信息则依赖上下文信息。然而，导致这些基本行为的训练条件仍然不清楚。在这里，我们通过使用合成语料库进行了控制实验，以识别那些影响知识利用的具体数据特性。我们的研究结果揭示了一个反直觉的现象：同时稳健且平衡地利用两种知识来源是一种涌现出的特性，这种特性需要三个通常被认为有害的因素同时存在，即（i）文档内部的重复现象，（ii）适度的文档内部不一致性，以及（iii）不平衡的知识分布。我们还表明，这些动态现象在实际的语言模型预训练中确实存在，并分析了训练后程序如何重塑了模型的仲裁策略。总的来说，我们的发现为设计能够支持在语言模型中可靠整合参数化知识和上下文知识的训练数据提供了实证指导。

papers.title: PAR: Training-Free Positional Perturbation and Attention Recycling for Faithful OCR
papers.title_zh: 名称：无需训练的位置扰动与注意力回收技术，用于确保OCR识别的准确性
papers.authors: Yao Yao, Manwen Liao, Weitian Zhang, Zuchao Li, Hai Zhao
papers.abstract: In high-precision scenarios, vision language models suffer from Linguistic Priors Hallucination. When processing familiar text, models tend to over-rely on internal parametric knowledge, effectively “reciting” the content rather than “reading” the image. In this paper, we first systematically investigate this phenomenon by constructing the GlitchText Probing Dataset. We discover that the model’s reliance on visual grounding diminishes significantly as the generation length increases. To mitigate this, we propose PAR (Positional Perturbation and Attention Recycling), a training-free, inference-time intervention framework. PAR consists of two parts: (1) Positional Perturbation (PP) injects structured phase noise into the rotary positional embeddings; (2) Foveal Attention Recycling (FAR) detects over-confident linguistic priors and dynamically redistributes attention mass back to important visual regions. Extensive experiments across state-of-the-art models, demonstrate that PAR significantly reduces hallucination rates (reducing CER by 12%), particularly in long-context scenarios, while maintaining robust generalization on standard benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 在高精度场景中，视觉语言模型会出现“语言先验幻觉”问题。在处理熟悉的文本时，模型往往过度依赖内部参数化知识，实际上是在“背诵”内容而非“阅读”图像。在本文中，我们首先通过构建GlitchText探测数据集来系统研究这一现象。我们发现，随着生成长度的增加，模型对视觉信息的依赖程度显著降低。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了PAR（位置扰动与注意力回收）这一无需训练的推理时间干预框架。PAR包含两部分：(1) 位置扰动部分，向旋转位置嵌入中注入结构化的相位噪声；(2) 聚焦注意力回收部分，用于检测过度自信的语言先验，并动态地将注意力重新分配到重要的视觉区域。通过大量实验验证，发现PAR能够显著降低幻觉发生率（将CER降低12%），尤其是在长上下文场景中，同时还能在标准基准测试上保持良好的泛化能力。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: BTC-LLM: Efficient Sub-1-Bit LLM Quantization via Learnable Transformation and Binary Codebook
papers.title_zh: BTC-LLM：通过可学习的变换和二进制码本技术，实现高效低于1比特的LLM量化方法
papers.authors: Hao Gu, Lujun Li, Hao Wang, Lei Wang, Zheyu Wang, Bei Liu, Jiacheng Liu, Qiyuan Zhu, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: Binary quantization represents the most extreme form of compression, reducing weights to \pm1 for maximal memory and computational efficiency. While recent sparsity-aware binarization achieves sub-1-bit compression via weight pruning, it faces critical challenger: performance degradation, mask-management overhead, and limited hardware compatibility. In this paper, we present BTC-LLM, a novel sub-1-bit LLM quantization framework that leverages binary pattern clustering and weight transformation to overcome these limitations. Our approach incorporates two key innovations: (1) a Binary Codebook that clusters recurring vectors into compact indices using custom distance metrics and sign-based updates; (2) a Learnable Transformation that reduces outliers and promotes shared sign patterns among binary weights. This eliminates sparse masks, enabling efficient inference on standard hardware. Extensive evaluations across LLaMA, Qwen, and FBI-LLM families demonstrate that BTC-LLM achieves state-of-the-art results in extreme compression (1.11–0.7 bits). Notably, BTC-LLM compressed to 0.8 bits on LLaMA-2-13B maintains high performance—with only a 3.1% accuracy drop in zero-shot benchmarks—while delivering a 1.6\times speedup over FP16.
papers.abstract_zh: 二进制量化代表了最极端的压缩形式，它将权重缩减到±1，以实现最大的内存和计算效率。虽然最近的稀疏感知二进制化技术通过权重剪枝实现了低于1位的压缩效果，但它面临着一些关键挑战：性能下降、掩码管理开销以及有限的硬件兼容性问题。在本文中，我们提出了BTC-LLM这一新型低于1位的LLM量化框架，该框架利用二进制模式聚类和权重转换来克服这些限制。我们的方法包含两项关键创新：(1) 一种二进制码本，它使用自定义距离度量方法和基于符号的更新方式，将重复出现的向量聚类成紧凑的索引；(2) 一种可学习的变换方法，它能够减少异常值，并促进二进制权重之间共享的符号模式。这种方法消除了稀疏掩码的问题，使得在标准硬件上能够高效地进行推理。通过对LaMA、Qwen和FBI-LLM系列模型进行广泛的评估，我们发现BTC-LLM在极端压缩方面取得了领先成果，其压缩位数达到了1.11–0.7位。值得注意的是，当BTC-LLM在LaMA-2-13B模型上压缩至0.8位时，仍然保持了较高的性能——在零样本基准测试中，准确率仅下降了3.1%，同时比FP16版本的速度提升了1.6倍。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Learning What to Ignore: Mitigating Negative Transfer in Medical Knowledge Fusion via Clinical Task-Adaptive Selection
papers.title_zh: 学习哪些信息可以忽略：通过针对具体任务进行适应性选择来减轻医学知识融合中的负面迁移效应
papers.authors: Xinyan Deng, Shoubin Dong, Xiaorou Zheng
papers.abstract: Integrating external medical knowledge into longitudinal electronic health record modeling is a prevailing paradigm to mitigate clinical data sparsity. However, existing approaches face a reliability-timeliness dilemma, struggling to balance the structural authority of static ontologies with the reasoning flexibility of large language models. Furthermore, most frameworks overlook the risk of relative negative transfer, where indiscriminately fusing task-irrelevant knowledge can introduce noise or even cause conflicts that weakens patient-specific signals. In this paper, we propose TrustKE, a Trustworthy Knowledge Enhancement framework. First, we construct a dual-layer knowledge graph that anchors dynamic, evidence-based chain-of-thought reasoning from medical literature within the stable structure of medical knowledge graph. Second, we introduce a task-adaptive knowledge selection mechanism that dynamically optimizes the graph, retaining only task-specific signals. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV across four clinical tasks show that TrustKE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Our analysis confirms that TrustKE effectively mitigates negative transfer while offering transparent reasoning for clinical decision-making.
papers.abstract_zh: 将外部医学知识整合到纵向电子健康记录模型中，是一种常用的缓解临床数据稀疏性的方法。然而，现有的方法面临着可靠性与时效性的矛盾问题，难以在静态本体结构的权威性与大语言模型的推理灵活性之间找到平衡。此外，大多数框架都忽视了相对负面迁移的风险，即不恰当地融合与任务无关的知识可能会引入噪声，甚至导致冲突，从而削弱针对患者的信号强度。在本文中，我们提出了TrustKE这一可信知识增强框架。首先，我们构建了一个双层知识图谱，将基于证据的动态思维推理与医学知识图谱的稳定结构相结合。其次，我们引入了一种任务自适应知识选择机制，该机制能够动态调整图谱结构，仅保留与任务相关的信息。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，TrustKE在四个临床任务中的表现优于现有最先进的基线方法。我们的分析证实，TrustKE能够有效缓解负面迁移的影响，同时为临床决策提供透明的推理支持。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MMTutorBench: The First Multimodal Benchmark for AI Math Tutoring
papers.title_zh: MMTutorBench：首个用于人工智能数学辅导的多模态基准测试平台
papers.authors: Tengchao Yang, Sichen Guo, Mengzhao Jia, Jiaming Su, Yuanyang Liu, Zhihan Zhang, Meng Jiang
papers.abstract: Effective math tutoring requires not only solving problems but also diagnosing students’ difficulties and guiding them step by step. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promise, existing benchmarks largely overlook these tutoring skills. We introduce MMTutorBench, the first benchmark for AI math tutoring, consisting of 770 problems built around pedagogically significant key-steps. Each problem is paired with problem-specific rubrics that enable fine-grained evaluation across six dimensions, and structured into three tasks—Insight Discovery, Operation Formulation, and Operation Execution. We evaluate 12 leading MLLMs and find clear performance gaps between proprietary and open-source systems, substantial room compared to human tutors, and consistent trends across input variants: OCR pipelines degrade tutoring quality, few-shot prompting yields limited gains, and our rubric-based LLM-as-a-Judge proves highly reliable. These results highlight both the difficulty and diagnostic value of MMTutorBench for advancing AI tutoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的数学辅导不仅需要解决问题，还需要诊断学生的困难并逐步引导他们。虽然多模态大语言模型显示出潜力，但现有的评估标准大多忽略了这些辅导技能。我们推出了MMTutorBench，这是首个针对人工智能数学辅导的评估基准，包含770道题目，这些题目围绕具有教学意义的关键步骤构建。每道题目都配有针对该题目的评分标准，能够从六个维度进行细致评估，并将题目分为三个任务：洞察发现、操作制定和操作执行。我们对12个领先的多模态语言模型进行了评估，发现专有系统和开源系统之间的性能存在明显差距，与人类导师相比仍有很大的提升空间。此外，不同输入方式下也呈现出一致的趋势：OCR处理流程会降低辅导质量，少量样本提示只能带来有限的改进效果，而基于评分标准的语言模型作为评判者则表现出极高的可靠性。这些结果凸显了MMTutorBench在推进人工智能辅导方面的难度和诊断价值。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GrACE: A Generative Approach to Better Confidence Elicitation and Efficient Test-Time Scaling in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: GrACE：一种生成式方法，旨在提升大型语言模型的置信度提取能力及测试运行效率
papers.authors: Zhaohan Zhang, Ziquan Liu, Ioannis Patras
papers.abstract: Assessing the reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) by confidence elicitation is a prominent approach to AI safety in high-stakes applications, such as healthcare and finance. Existing methods either require expensive computational overhead or suffer from poor calibration, making them impractical and unreliable for real-world deployment. In this work, we propose GrACE, a Generative Approach to Confidence Elicitation that enables scalable and reliable confidence elicitation for LLMs. GrACE adopts a novel mechanism in which the model expresses confidence by the similarity between the last hidden state and the embedding of a special token appended to the vocabulary, in real-time. We fine-tune the model for calibrating the confidence with targets associated with accuracy. Extensive experiments show that the confidence produced by GrACE achieves the best discriminative capacity and calibration on open-ended generation tasks without resorting to additional sampling or an auxiliary model. Moreover, we propose two confidence-based strategies for test-time scaling with GrACE, which not only improve the accuracy of the final decision but also significantly reduce the number of required samples, highlighting its potential as a practical solution for deploying LLMs with reliable, on-the-fly confidence estimation. The code is available at: https://github.com/petezone/Grace.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过置信度提取来评估大语言模型（LLM）的可靠性，是人工智能安全领域在医疗和金融等高风险应用中常用的方法。现有的方法要么需要昂贵的计算资源，要么存在校准效果不佳的问题，这使得它们在实际应用中的部署变得不切实际且不可靠。在这项研究中，我们提出了GrACE这一生成式置信度提取方法，它能够实现可扩展且可靠的LLM置信度提取。GrACE采用了一种新颖的机制：模型通过最后一个隐藏状态与词汇表中添加的特殊标记的嵌入之间的相似性来实时表达置信度。我们对该模型进行了微调，以使其能够根据与准确率相关的目标来校准置信度。大量实验表明，GrACE产生的置信度在开放式生成任务中表现出最佳的区分能力和校准效果，而无需额外的采样或辅助模型。此外，我们还提出了两种基于置信度的策略，用于GrACE在测试阶段的可扩展性提升，这些策略不仅提高了最终决策的准确性，还显著减少了所需样本的数量，从而凸显了它作为实现可靠、即时置信度估计的实用解决方案的潜力。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/petezone/Grace。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AutoGraph-R1: End-to-End Reinforcement Learning for Knowledge Graph Construction
papers.title_zh: AutoGraph-R1：用于知识图谱构建的端到端强化学习算法
papers.authors: Hong Ting Tsang, Jiaxin Bai, Haoyu Huang, Qiao Xiao, Tianshi Zheng, Baixuan Xu, Shujie Liu, Yangqiu Song
papers.abstract: Building effective knowledge graphs (KGs) for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is pivotal for advancing question answering (QA) systems. However, its effectiveness is hindered by a fundamental disconnect: the knowledge graph (KG) construction process is decoupled from its downstream application, yielding suboptimal graph structures. To bridge this gap, we introduce AutoGraph-R1, the first framework to directly optimize KG construction for task performance using Reinforcement Learning (RL). AutoGraph-R1 trains an LLM constructor by framing graph generation as a policy learning problem, where the reward is derived from the graph’s functional utility in a RAG pipeline. We design two novel, task-aware reward functions, one for graphs as knowledge carriers and another as knowledge indices. Across multiple QA benchmarks, AutoGraph-R1 consistently enables graph RAG methods to achieve significant performance gains over using task-agnostic baseline graphs. Our work shows it is possible to close the loop between construction and application, shifting the paradigm from building intrinsically ‘good‘ graphs to building demonstrably ‘useful‘ ones.
papers.abstract_zh: 构建有效的知识图谱（KG）对于提升检索增强生成（RAG）系统的性能至关重要。然而，其有效性受到了一个根本性的阻碍：知识图谱的构建过程与其下游应用之间存在脱节，导致生成的图谱结构不尽理想。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了AutoGraph-R1框架——这是首个利用强化学习技术直接优化知识图谱构建过程的框架。AutoGraph-R1通过将图谱生成视为一个策略学习问题来训练LLM构造器，其中奖励来源于图谱在RAG流程中的实际效用。我们设计了两种新颖的任务感知奖励函数，一种用于作为知识载体的图谱，另一种则用于作为知识索引的图谱。在多个问答基准测试中，AutoGraph-R1能够显著提升图谱RAG方法的性能，相比使用与任务无关的基线图谱，取得了明显的进步。我们的研究表明，实现构建与应用的闭环是可能的，从而将范式从构建本质上“优秀”的图谱转变为构建真正“有用”的图谱。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Understanding Structured Financial Data with LLMs: A Case Study on Fraud Detection
papers.title_zh: 利用大语言模型理解结构化金融数据：以欺诈检测为例的研究
papers.authors: Xuwei Tan, Yao Ma, Xueru Zhang
papers.abstract: Detecting fraud in financial transactions typically relies on tabular models that demand heavy feature engineering to handle high-dimensional data and offer limited interpretability, making it difficult for humans to understand predictions. Large Language Models (LLMs), in contrast, can produce human-readable explanations and facilitate feature analysis, potentially reducing the manual workload of fraud analysts and informing system refinements. However, they perform poorly when applied directly to tabular fraud detection due to the difficulty of reasoning over many features, the extreme class imbalance, and the absence of contextual information. To bridge this gap, we introduce FinFRE-RAG, a two-stage approach that applies importance-guided feature reduction to serialize a compact subset of numeric/categorical attributes into natural language and performs retrieval-augmented in-context learning over label-aware, instance-level exemplars. Across four public fraud datasets and three families of open-weight LLMs, FinFRE-RAG substantially improves F1/MCC over direct prompting and is competitive with strong tabular baselines in several settings. Although these LLMs still lag behind specialized classifiers, they narrow the performance gap and provide interpretable rationales, highlighting their value as assistive tools in fraud analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 在金融交易中的欺诈检测通常依赖于表格模型，这些模型需要大量的特征工程来处理高维数据，但解释性较差，使得人类难以理解检测结果。相比之下，大语言模型能够生成易于理解的解释，并有助于特征分析，从而减轻欺诈分析师的手动工作负担，并为系统优化提供指导。然而，当直接应用于表格型欺诈检测时，由于需要对众多特征进行推理的难度、严重的类别不平衡以及缺乏上下文信息等因素，这些模型的性能表现不佳。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了FinFRE-RAG这一两阶段方法。该方法采用重要性引导的特征降维技术，将数值/分类属性压缩为自然语言形式；同时，通过基于标签感知的实例级样本进行检索增强式上下文学习。在四个公开的欺诈数据集和三种开放式的语言模型中，FinFRE-RAG在F1值/MCC指标上显著优于直接提示方法，并且在多个应用场景中能够与优秀的表格型基线模型相竞争。虽然这些语言模型仍然落后于专业分类器，但它们缩小了性能差距，并提供了可解释性的理由，这凸显了它们作为欺诈分析辅助工具的价值。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Gap-K%: Measuring Top-1 Prediction Gap for Detecting Pretraining Data
papers.title_zh: 差距-准确率：衡量用于检测预训练数据的Top-1预测差距
papers.authors: Minseo Kwak, Jaehyung Kim
papers.abstract: The opacity of massive pretraining corpora in Large Language Models (LLMs) raises significant privacy and copyright concerns, making pretraining data detection a critical challenge.Existing state-of-the-art methods typically rely on token likelihoods, yet they often overlook the gap between the target token and the model’s top-1 prediction, as well as local correlations between adjacent tokens.In this work, we propose Gap-K%, a novel pretraining data detection method grounded in the optimization dynamics of LLM pretraining. By analyzing the next-token prediction objective, we observe that discrepancies between the model’s top-1 prediction and the target token induce strong gradient signals, which are explicitly penalized during training.Motivated by this, Gap-K% leverages the log probability gap between the top-1 predicted token and the target token, incorporating a sliding window strategy to capture local correlations and mitigate token-level fluctuations. Extensive experiments on the WikiMIA and MIMIR benchmarks demonstrate that Gap-K% achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming prior baselines across various model sizes and input lengths.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型中的大规模预训练语料库的不透明性引发了严重的隐私和版权问题，因此检测预训练数据成为了一个关键挑战。现有的先进方法通常依赖于令牌概率，但它们常常忽略了目标令牌与模型的第一层预测之间的差距，以及相邻令牌之间的局部相关性。在这项研究中，我们提出了Gap-K%这一新颖的预训练数据检测方法，该方法基于语言模型预训练的优化动态进行设计。通过分析下一个令牌的预测目标，我们发现模型的第一层预测与目标令牌之间的差异会产生强烈的梯度信号，这些信号在训练过程中会被明确加以惩罚。基于这一原理，Gap-K%利用第一层预测令牌与目标令牌之间的对数概率差异，并采用滑动窗口策略来捕捉局部相关性，从而减轻令牌级别的波动。在WikiMIA和MIMIR基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Gap-K%取得了最先进的性能表现，在各种模型规模和输入长度下都持续优于之前的基线方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Experience Retrieval-Augmentation with Electronic Health Records Enables Accurate Discharge QA
papers.title_zh: 通过电子健康记录实现经验检索增强技术，有助于准确进行患者出院评估与审核
papers.authors: Justice Ou, Tinglin Huang, Yilun Zhao, Ziyang Yu, Peiqing Lu, Yifei Shen, Rex Ying
papers.abstract: To improve the reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) in clinical applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is extensively applied to provide factual medical knowledge. However, beyond general medical knowledge from open-ended datasets, clinical case-based knowledge is also critical for effective medical reasoning, as it provides context grounded in real-world patient experiences. Motivated by this, we propose Experience Retrieval-Augmentation ExpRAG framework based on Electronic Health Record(EHR), aiming to offer the relevant context from other patients’ discharge reports. ExpRAG performs retrieval through a coarse-to-fine process, utilizing an EHR-based report ranker to efficiently identify similar patients, followed by an experience retriever to extract task-relevant content for enhanced medical reasoning. To evaluate ExpRAG, we introduce DischargeQA, a clinical QA dataset with 1,280 discharge-related questions across diagnosis, medication, and instruction tasks. Each problem is generated using EHR data to ensure realistic and challenging scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that ExpRAG consistently outperforms a text-based ranker, achieving an average relative improvement of 5.2%, highlighting the importance of case-based knowledge for medical reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了提高大语言模型在临床应用中的可靠性，检索增强生成技术被广泛应用于提供真实的医学知识。然而，除了来自开放数据集的一般性医学知识之外，基于临床案例的知识对于有效的医学推理也至关重要，因为它提供了基于现实世界患者经验的上下文信息。基于这一考虑，我们提出了基于电子健康记录的经验检索增强框架ExpRAG，旨在从其他患者的出院报告中获取相关的上下文信息。ExpRAG通过从粗到细的过程进行检索，利用基于电子健康记录的报告排序器来高效识别相似的患者，然后通过经验检索器提取与任务相关的内容，以进一步提升医学推理的能力。为了评估ExpRAG的性能，我们引入了一个名为DischargeQA的临床问答数据集，该数据集包含1,280个与出院相关的提问，涉及诊断、用药和指示等方面。每个问题都是使用电子健康记录数据生成的，以确保场景的真实性和挑战性。实验结果表明，ExpRAG始终优于基于文本的排序器，平均相对改进达到了5.2%，这凸显了基于案例的知识对于医学推理的重要性。

papers.title: Are they lovers or friends? Evaluating LLMs’ Social Reasoning in English and Korean Dialogues
papers.title_zh: 它们是恋人还是朋友呢？评估大型语言模型在英文和韩语对话中的社交推理能力
papers.authors: Eunsu Kim, Junyeong Park, Juhyun Oh, Kiwoong Park, Seyoung Song, A. Seza Doğruöz, Alice Oh, Najoung Kim
papers.abstract: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in real-world interactions, their social reasoning in interpersonal communication becomes critical. To explore their capabilities, we introduce SCRIPTS, a 1.1k-dialogue dataset in English and Korean, sourced from movie scripts and propose a social reasoning task based on SCRIPTS that evaluates the capacity of LLMs to infer the social relationships (e.g., friends, lovers) between speakers in each dialogue. Evaluating nine models on our task, current LLMs achieve around 75–80% on the English dataset and 58–69% in Korean, and models predict an Unlikely relationship in 10–25% of responses in both languages.Furthermore, we find that thinking models and chain-of-thought prompting provide minimal benefits for social reasoning and occasionally amplify social biases.In sum, there are significant limitations in current LLMs’ social reasoning capabilities, especially for Korean, highlighting the need for efforts to develop socially-aware LLMs across languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在现实世界中的应用日益广泛，它们在人际沟通中的社交推理能力变得至关重要。为了探索这些模型的能力，我们引入了SCRIPTS数据集，该数据集包含1.1千条英语和韩语对话记录，这些记录来源于电影剧本。我们基于SCRIPTS数据集设计了一个社交推理任务，用于评估大语言模型推断对话中说话者之间社交关系（如朋友、恋人）的能力。我们对九种模型进行了测试，结果显示，当前的大语言模型在英语数据集上的表现约为75-80%，在韩语数据集上则为58-69%；两种语言中有 10%–25% 的回答被预测为不太可能存在关系。此外，我们发现，推理模型和思维链提示在社交推理方面几乎没有效果，甚至有时会加剧社会偏见。总的来说，当前大语言模型的社交推理能力存在显著局限性，尤其是在处理韩语文本时。因此，有必要努力开发能够跨语言进行社交推理的大语言模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SAIR-Comb : A Structure-Aware Iterative Refinement Framework for Combinatorics Autoformalization
papers.title_zh: SAIR-Comb：一种基于结构感知的迭代优化框架，用于组合数学问题的自动形式化处理
papers.authors: Weijie Jiang, Gaolei He, Beibei Xiong, Jianlin Wang, Zhengfeng Yang
papers.abstract: Autoformalization aims to bridge the gap between human mathematical intuition and formal proof by automating the translation of informal reasoning into machine-verifiable languages. Despite significant breakthroughs catalyzed by Large Language Models (LLMs), autoformalizing Combinatorics remains a formidable challenge due to its intricate structural dependencies and the severe scarcity of high-quality formal datasets. To address these challenges, we propose SAIR-Comb, a Structure-Aware Iterative Refinement framework for Combinatorics powered by Lean 4 and LLMs. SAIR-Comb employs a multi-stage pipeline: first, it performs data augmentation and refinement by rectifying syntactic, semantic, and structural errors, guided by a curated manual combinatorics dataset. The model then undergoes a two-stage training regime: expert iteration with syntactic grounding, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) to align formal reasoning trajectories. Furthermore, we introduce Structural Consistency—a rigorous new metric designed to expose formalizing failures that elude traditional semantic-only evaluations. Experiments demonstrate that SAIR-Comb achieves strong performance on the specialized CombiBench while remaining highly competitive on general-domain benchmarks, including PutnamBench and ProverBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动形式化旨在通过将非正式推理转化为机器可验证的语言，来弥合人类数学直觉与形式证明之间的差距。尽管大语言模型在形式化领域取得了显著突破，但由于组合学的复杂结构依赖性和高质量形式化数据集的极度匮乏，自动形式化仍然是一个巨大的挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SAIR-Comb框架——一个基于Lean 4和大语言模型的组合学结构化迭代优化框架。SAIR-Comb采用多阶段流程：首先，通过利用精心挑选的组合学数据集来纠正语法、语义和结构错误，从而实现数据增强和精细化处理。然后，模型经历两阶段的训练过程：第一阶段是借助语法知识进行专家级迭代优化，第二阶段则是强化学习，以调整形式化推理的路径。此外，我们还引入了“结构一致性”这一新的严格评估指标，用于揭示那些无法通过传统仅基于语义的评估方法发现的格式化失败问题。实验表明，SAIR-Comb在专门的CombiBench测试集上表现出强大的性能，同时在包括PutnamBench和ProverBench在内的通用领域基准测试中也保持着较高的竞争力。

papers.title: Stop Hardening Everything: A Training-Free Neuron-Level Defense for Neural Ranking Models
papers.title_zh: 别再把一切都视为绝对正确的答案了：一种无需训练即可应用于神经排序模型的神经元级防御策略
papers.authors: Yu-An Liu, Ruqing Zhang, Hongru Song, Jiafeng Guo, Yixing Fan, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: While neural ranking models (NRMs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance in information retrieval, they remain highly vulnerable to imperceptible adversarial perturbations. Existing defenses are predominantly data-centric, exemplified by adversarial training, which requires constructing large collections of adversarial examples. By treating NRMs as black boxes and indiscriminately optimizing all model parameters, these methods incur substantial computational cost and often degrade performance on clean data due to overfitting. In this paper, we advocate that adversarial vulnerability is not uniformly distributed across model parameters, but instead originates from specific internal units. We propose a paradigm shift toward a model-centric defense that addresses vulnerability at its architectural source, without requiring costly retraining or adversarial data generation. Specifically, we introduce Search in the Model, a novel training-free framework that performs fine-grained identification and rectification of vulnerable neurons directly within the model. By formulating neuron identification as a ranking problem, we develop a maximum marginal vulnerability criterion to precisely locate the top-K neurons most responsible for model vulnerability, and apply targeted neuronal inverse perturbation to correct them. Extensive experiments on MS MARCO and TREC 19 show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both defense efficiency and robustness to seen and unseen attacks, while preserving strong performance on clean data.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然神经排序模型在信息检索领域取得了卓越的性能，但它们仍然极易受到难以察觉的对抗性干扰的影响。现有的防御方法主要以数据为中心，例如对抗性训练，这需要构建大量的对抗样本。通过将神经排序模型视为黑盒，并不加选择地优化所有模型参数，这些方法会导致巨大的计算成本，并且常常会因为过拟合而在干净数据上降低性能。在本文中，我们提出对抗性脆弱性并非均匀分布在模型参数中，而是源自特定的内部单元。我们提出了一种以模型为中心的防御策略，这种策略能够直接针对脆弱性的架构源头进行修复，而无需进行昂贵的重新训练或对抗性数据生成。具体来说，我们提出了“模型中的搜索”这一新型无训练框架，它能够对模型中脆弱的神经元进行细粒度的识别和修正。通过将神经元识别问题转化为排序问题，我们开发了一个最大边际脆弱性准则，以精确定位对模型脆弱性负有最大责任的Top-K神经元，并通过有针对性的神经元逆向扰动来对其进行修正。在MS MARCO和TREC 19上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在防御效率和应对可见及不可见攻击的能力方面均优于最先进的基线方法，同时在干净数据上的性能也表现优异。

papers.title: TED-TTS: Training-Free Intra-Utterance Emotion and Duration Control for Text-to-Speech Synthesis
papers.title_zh: TED-TTS：无需训练即可实现文本转语音合成中的语句情感与持续时间的控制
papers.authors: Qifan Liang, Yuansen Liu, Ruixin Wei, Nan Lu, Junchuan Zhao, Ye Wang
papers.abstract: While controllable Text-to-Speech (TTS) has achieved notable progress, most existing methods remain limited to inter-utterance-level control, making fine-grained intra-utterance expression challenging due to their reliance on non-public datasets or complex multi-stage training. In this paper, we propose TED-TTS, a training-free controllable framework for pretrained zero-shot TTS to enable intra-utterance emotion and duration expression. Specifically, we propose a segment-aware emotion conditioning strategy that combines causal masking with monotonic stream alignment filtering to isolate emotion conditioning and schedule mask transitions, enabling smooth intra-utterance emotion shifts while preserving global semantic coherence. Based on this, we further propose a segment-aware duration steering strategy to combine local duration embedding steering with global EOS logit modulation, allowing local duration adjustment while ensuring globally consistent termination. To eliminate the need for segment-level manual prompt engineering, we construct a 30,000-sample multi-emotion and duration-annotated text dataset to enable LLM-based automatic prompt construction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our training-free method not only achieves state-of-the-art intra-utterance consistency in multi-emotion and duration control, but also maintains baseline-level speech quality of the underlying TTS model. Audio samples are available at https://aclanonymous111.github.io/TED-TTS-DemoPage/.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然可控的文本转语音技术已经取得了显著进展，但大多数现有方法仍然局限于句子间级别的控制，这使得对句子内部的情感表达进行精细调控变得困难。因为这些方法依赖于非公开的数据集或复杂的多阶段训练过程。在本文中，我们提出了TED-TTS这一无需训练的可控框架，它能够让预训练的零样本文本转语音技术在句子内部实现情感和时长方面的控制。具体来说，我们提出了一种基于段落感知的情感调节策略，该策略结合了因果掩蔽技术和单调流对齐过滤技术，以分离情感调节因素，并安排掩蔽转换的时机，从而实现句子内部情感的平滑切换，同时保持整体语义的连贯性。在此基础上，我们还提出了一种基于段落感知的时长调节策略，该策略结合了局部时长嵌入的调整和全局EOS逻辑门的调制，使得局部时长的调整能够顺利进行，同时保证整体结束时间的统一。为了消除对段落级别手动提示工程的需求，我们构建了一个包含30,000个样本的多情感和时长标注的文本数据集，以便利用大语言模型实现自动提示的生成。大量实验表明，我们的无需训练的方法不仅能够在多情感和时长控制方面达到最先进的一致性水平，同时还保持了底层文本转语音模型的基线级语音质量。音频样本可以在https://aclanonymous111.github.io/TED-TTS-DemoPage/获取。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: VIB-Probe: Detecting and Mitigating Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models via Variational Information Bottleneck
papers.title_zh: VIB-Probe：通过变分信息瓶颈技术检测和缓解视觉语言模型中的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Feiran Zhang, Yixin Wu, Zhenghua Wang, Xiaohua Wang, Changze Lv, Xuanjing Huang, Xiaoqing Zheng
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in multimodal tasks, but remain susceptible to hallucinations, where generated text deviates from the underlying visual content. Existing hallucination detection methods primarily rely on output logits or external verification tools, often overlooking their internal mechanisms. In this work, we investigate the outputs of internal attention heads, postulating that specific heads carry the primary signals for truthful generation. However, directly probing these high-dimensional states is challenging due to the entanglement of visual-linguistic syntax and noise. To address this, we propose VIB-Probe, a novel hallucination detection and mitigation framework leveraging the Variational Information Bottleneck (VIB) theory. Our method extracts discriminative patterns across layers and heads while filtering out semantic nuisances through the information bottleneck principle. Furthermore, by leveraging the gradients of our VIB probe, we identify attention heads with strong causal influence on hallucinations and introduce an inference-time intervention strategy for hallucination mitigation. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that VIB-Probe significantly outperforms existing baselines in both settings. Our code will be made publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在多模态任务上取得了显著进展，但仍然存在幻觉问题，即生成的文本与底层视觉内容存在偏差。现有的幻觉检测方法主要依赖于输出逻辑值或外部验证工具，往往忽略了模型内部的机制。在这项研究中，我们关注了模型内部注意力头的输出，认为某些头部负责确保文本的真实生成。然而，由于视觉与语言结构的复杂性和噪声的影响，直接探测这些高维状态是非常困难的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了VIB-Probe这一新颖的幻觉检测和缓解框架，该框架基于变分信息瓶颈理论。我们的方法能够提取不同层和头部的差异模式，同时通过信息瓶颈原理过滤掉语义上的干扰因素。此外，通过利用VIB探针的梯度信息，我们能够识别出对幻觉有强烈因果影响的注意力头，并引入了一种在推理阶段进行干预的策略来减轻幻觉现象。在多种基准测试中的广泛实验表明，VIB-Probe在性能上明显优于现有的基线方法。我们的代码将会公开提供。

papers.title: Detoxification for LLM: From Dataset Itself
papers.title_zh: 针对大语言模型的排毒过程：从数据集本身开始
papers.authors: Wei Shao, Yihang Wang, Gao yu Zhu, Ziqiang Cheng, Lei Yu, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Existing detoxification methods for large language models mainly focus on post-training stage or inference time, while few tackle the source of toxicity, namely, the dataset itself. Such training-based or controllable decoding approaches cannot completely suppress the model’s inherent toxicity, whereas detoxifying the pretraining dataset can fundamentally reduce the toxicity that the model learns during training. Hence, we attempt to detoxify directly on raw corpora with SoCD (Soft Contrastive Decoding), which guides an LLM to localize and rewrite toxic spans in raw data while preserving semantics, in our proposed HSPD (Hierarchical Semantic-Preserving Detoxification) pipeline, yielding a detoxified corpus that can drop-in replace the original for fine-tuning or other training. On GPT2-XL, HSPD attains state-of-the-art detoxification, reducing Toxicity Probability (TP) from 0.42 to 0.18 and Expected Maximum Toxicity (EMT) from 0.43 to 0.20. We further validate consistent best-in-class results on LLaMA2-7B, OPT-6.7B, and Falcon-7B. These findings show that semantics-preserving, corpus-level rewriting with HSPD effectively suppresses downstream toxicity while retaining data utility and allowing seamless source-level mitigation, thereby reducing the cost of later model behavior adjustment.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前针对大语言模型的去毒方法主要集中在训练后期或推理阶段，而很少从数据源本身入手解决毒性问题。这种基于训练的可控解码方法无法完全消除模型固有的毒性，而直接对预训练数据集进行去毒则能够从根本上减少模型在训练过程中产生的毒性。因此，我们尝试使用SoCD（软对比解码）技术对原始文本数据进行去毒处理，该技术能够引导LLM在保留语义的前提下，对有毒的段落进行局部替换。在我们提出的HSPD（分层语义保留去毒）流程中，这种方法能够生成经过去毒的语料库，这些去毒后的语料库可以替代原始语料用于微调或其他训练任务。在GPT2-XL上，HSPD取得了非常出色的去毒效果，将毒性概率从0.42降低到0.18，预期最大毒性也从0.43降低到0.20。我们在LaLM2-7B、OPT-6.7B和Falcon-7B上也验证了该方法的一致性优势。这些研究结果表明，HSPD能够在保留语义的同时对语料库中的有毒段落进行替换，从而有效消除下游的毒性问题，同时保留数据的实用性，并允许在源头上进行更有效的处理，进而降低后续模型行为调整的成本。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When Is Thinking Enough? Early Exit via Sufficiency Assessment for Efficient Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 何时才算“足够思考”？通过充分评估来实现提前退出，以进行更高效的推理
papers.authors: Yang Xiang, Yixin Ji, Ruotao Xu, Dan Qiao, Zheming Yang, Juntao Li, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable performance in complex reasoning tasks, driven by their powerful inference-time scaling capability.However, LRMs often suffer from overthinking, which results in substantial computational redundancy and significantly reduces efficiency.Early-exit methods aim to mitigate this issue by terminating reasoning once sufficient evidence has been generated, yet existing approaches mostly rely on handcrafted or empirical indicators that are unreliable and impractical.In this work, we introduce Dynamic Thought Sufficiency in Reasoning (DTSR), a novel framework for efficient reasoning that enables the model to dynamically assess the sufficiency of its chain-of-thought (CoT) and determine the optimal point for early exit.Inspired by human metacognition, DTSR operates in two stages: (1) Reflection Signal Monitoring, which identifies reflection signals as potential cues for early exit, and (2) Thought Sufficiency Check, which evaluates whether the current CoT is sufficient to derive the final answer.Experimental results on the Qwen3 models show that DTSR reduces reasoning length by 28.9%–34.9% with minimal performance loss, effectively mitigating overthinking.We further discuss overconfidence in LRMs and self-evaluation paradigms, providing valuable insights for early-exit reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在复杂推理任务中取得了显著的性能表现，这得益于其强大的推理时间扩展能力。然而，这类模型常常会出现过度推理的问题，导致大量的计算冗余，从而显著降低效率。早期退出方法旨在通过在生成足够的证据后终止推理来缓解这个问题，但现有方法大多依赖于手工制作或经验性的指标，这些指标既不可靠也不实用。在这项研究中，我们提出了动态思维充分性推理框架（DTSR），这是一种高效的推理方法，能够让模型动态地评估其思维链的充分性，并确定早期退出的最佳时机。该框架借鉴了人类的元认知机制，分为两个阶段：（1）反射信号监测，用于识别可能作为早期退出信号的反射信号；（2）思维充分性检查，用于评估当前的思维链是否足以得出最终答案。在Qwen3模型上的实验结果表明，DTSR能够将推理长度减少28.9%至34.9%，同时几乎不会造成性能损失，有效避免了过度推理的问题。我们还讨论了大型推理模型中的过度自信问题以及自我评估范式，为早期退出推理提供了宝贵的见解。

papers.title: Instant Personalized Large Language Model Adaptation via Hypernetwork
papers.title_zh: 通过超网络实现即时个性化大型语言模型适配
papers.authors: Zhaoxuan Tan, Zixuan Zhang, Haoyang Wen, Zheng Li, Rongzhi Zhang, Pei Chen, Fengran Mo, Zheyuan Liu, Qingkai Zeng, Qingyu Yin, Meng Jiang
papers.abstract: Personalized large language models (LLMs) tailor content to individual preferences using user profiles or histories. However, existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, such as the “One-PEFT-Per-User” (OPPU) paradigm, require training a separate adapter for each user, making them computationally expensive and impractical for real-time updates. We introduce Profile-to-PEFT, a scalable framework that employs a hypernetwork, trained end-to-end, to map a user’s encoded profile directly to a full set of adapter parameters (e.g., LoRA), eliminating per-user training at deployment. This design enables instant adaptation, generalization to unseen users, and privacy-preserving local deployment. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms both prompt-based personalization and OPPU while using substantially fewer computational resources at deployment. The framework exhibits strong generalization to out-of-distribution users and maintains robustness across varying user activity levels and different embedding backbones. The proposed Profile-to-PEFT framework enables efficient, scalable, and adaptive LLM personalization suitable for large-scale applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 个性化大语言模型能够根据用户的个人偏好来定制内容。然而，现有的参数高效微调方法，比如“每个用户一个微调方法”的范式，需要为每个用户单独训练一个适配器，这既耗费计算资源，也不适合实时更新。我们提出了一种名为“从配置文件到参数高效微调”的可扩展框架，该框架采用超网络进行端到端训练，能够将用户的编码配置文件直接映射到完整的适配器参数集上（例如LoRA），从而在部署时无需为每个用户单独训练。这种设计能够实现即时适应、对未见用户的有效泛化，同时还能保证隐私保护的本地部署。实验结果表明，我们的方法在使用的计算资源方面远远少于基于提示的个性化方法和“每个用户一个微调方法”的范式，而且其性能也优于这两种方法。该框架能够很好地泛化到非分布范围内的用户，并且能够在不同的用户活动水平和不同的嵌入基础模型中保持稳定性能。所提出的“从配置文件到参数高效微调”框架能够实现高效、可扩展且适应性强的LLM个性化，非常适合大规模应用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Off-Policy to On-Policy: Enhancing GUI Agents via Bi-level Expert-to-Policy Assimilation
papers.title_zh: 从离策略到邻策略：通过双层专家系统来提升图形用户界面智能体的性能
papers.authors: Zezhou Wang, Ziyun Zhang, Xiaoyi Zhang, Zhuzhong Qian, Yan Lu
papers.abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly deployed as computer-use agents (CUAs) that operate desktops and browsers. Top-performing CUAs are framework-based systems that decompose planning and execution, while end-to-end screenshot-to-action policies are easier to deploy but lag behind on benchmarks such as OSWorld-Verified. GUI datasets like OSWorld pose two bottlenecks: they expose only a few hundred interactive, verifiable tasks and environments, and expert trajectories must be gathered by interacting with these environments, making such data hard to scale. We therefore ask how reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) can best exploit a small pool of exist expert trajectories to train end-to-end policies. Na"ively mixing these off-policy traces into on-policy RLVR is brittle: even after format conversion, expert trajectories exhibit structural mismatch and distribution shift from the learner. We propose BEPA (Bi-Level Expert-to-Policy Assimilation), which turns static expert traces into policy-aligned guidance via self-rolled reachable trajectories under the base policy (LEVEL-1) and a per-task, dynamically updated cache used in RLVR (LEVEL-2). On OSWorld-Verified, BEPA improves UITARS1.5-7B success from 22.87% to 32.13% and raises a held-out split from 5.74% to 10.30%, with consistent gains on MMBench-GUI and Online-Mind2Web. Our code and data are available at an anonymous repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ACL_BEPA.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型越来越多地被用作计算机使用代理（CUA），它们可以操作桌面设备和浏览器。性能优秀的CUA是基于框架的系统，能够分解规划和执行过程。而端到端的截图到动作策略则更容易部署，但在如OSWorld-Verified这样的基准测试中表现却不尽如人意。像OSWorld这样的GUI数据集存在两个瓶颈：它们只包含几百个具有交互性和可验证性的任务和环境，而且必须通过与这些环境进行交互来收集专家的轨迹数据，这使得这类数据的扩展变得困难。因此，我们思考如何从可验证的奖励中通过强化学习来充分利用少量现有的专家轨迹来训练端到端的策略。简单地将这些非策略性轨迹混合到策略性RLVR中是不稳定的：即使经过格式转换后，专家轨迹仍然表现出结构上的不匹配以及分布偏移。我们提出了BEPA（双层专家到策略融合）方法，该方法通过将静态专家轨迹转化为与策略一致的指导方案，在基础策略（LEVEL-1）和用于RLVR的任务级、动态更新的缓存系统（LEVEL-2）下实现这一目标。在OSWorld-Verified测试上，BEPA将UITARs1.5-7B的成功率从22.87%提高到了32.13%，并将保留分数从5.74%提升到了10.30%。在MMBench-GUI和Online-Mind2Web测试上，我们也取得了持续的进步。我们的代码和数据可以在以下匿名仓库获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ACL_BEPA

papers.title: Safeguarding LLM Fine-tuning via Push-Pull Distributional Alignment
papers.title_zh: 通过推拉式分布对齐来保护大语言模型微调过程的安全
papers.authors: Haozhong Wang, Zhuo Li, Yibo Yang, He Zhao, Hongyuan Zha, Dandan Guo
papers.abstract: The inherent safety alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is prone to erosion during fine-tuning, even when using seemingly innocuous datasets. While existing defenses attempt to mitigate this via data selection, they typically rely on heuristic, instance-level assessments that neglect the global geometry of the data distribution and fail to explicitly repel harmful patterns. To address this, we introduce Safety Optimal Transport (SOT), a novel framework that reframes safe fine-tuning from an instance-level filtering challenge to a distribution-level alignment task grounded in Optimal Transport (OT). At its core is a dual-reference “push-pull” weight-learning mechanism: SOT optimizes sample importance by actively pulling the downstream distribution towards a trusted safe anchor while simultaneously pushing it away from a general harmful reference. This establishes a robust geometric safety boundary that effectively purifies the training data. Extensive experiments across diverse model families and domains demonstrate that SOT significantly enhances model safety while maintaining competitive downstream performance, achieving a superior safety-utility trade-off compared to baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在微调过程中存在固有的安全风险，即使使用看似无害的数据集也是如此。现有的防御措施试图通过数据选择来减轻这一问题，但这些措施通常依赖于启发式的、实例级别的评估方式，而忽略了数据分布的全局几何特性，无法有效排除有害模式。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了安全最优传输（SOT）框架。该框架将安全微调的任务从实例级别的过滤挑战转变为基于最优传输原理的分布级对齐任务。其核心是一个双参考的“推拉”权重学习机制：SOT通过主动将下游分布推向一个可信的安全锚点，同时将其远离一般性的有害参考点，从而优化样本的重要性。这一机制建立了一个强大的几何安全边界，能够有效净化训练数据。在多种模型和领域中的广泛实验表明，SOT显著提升了模型的安全性，同时保持了具有竞争力的下游性能，实现了比基线方法更优的安全与性能平衡。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: I²B-LPO: Latent Policy Optimization via Iterative Information Bottleneck
papers.title_zh: I²B-LPO：通过迭代信息瓶颈实现潜在政策优化
papers.authors: Huilin Deng, Hongchen Luo, Yue Zhu, Long Li, Zhuoyue Chen, Xinghao Zhao, Ming LI, Chuyang Zhao, Jihai Zhang, MengChang Wang, Yang Cao, Yu Kang
papers.abstract: Despite recent advances in Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for large language model (LLM) reasoning, most methods suffer from exploration collapse, as the semantic homogeneity of random rollouts traps models in narrow, over-optimized behaviors. Existing methods leverage policy entropy to encourage exploration, but face inherent limitations: global entropy regularization is susceptible to reward hacking, inducing meaningless verbosity, whereas local token-selective updates struggle with the strong inductive bias of pre-trained models. To this end, we propose Latent Policy Optimization via Iterative Information Bottleneck ( I²B-LPO), which shifts from statistical perturbation of token distributions to topological branching of reasoning trajectories. I²BLPO triggers latent branching at high-entropy states to diversify reasoning trajectories and applies the Information Bottleneck as a trajectory filter and self-reward to ensure concise and informative exploration. Empirical results on four mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that I²B-LPO achieves state-of-the-art performance, with margins of up to 5.3% in accuracy and 7.4% in diversity metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/denghuilin-cyber/IIB-LPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在带有可验证奖励的强化学习领域（RLVR）方面取得了一些进展，用于大语言模型推理，但大多数方法都存在探索崩溃的问题。因为随机尝试的语义同质性会导致模型陷入狭窄且过度优化的行为模式。现有的方法利用策略熵来鼓励探索，但存在固有的局限性：全局熵正则化容易受到奖励操纵的影响，导致产生无意义的冗长描述；而局部基于令牌的选择性更新则难以应对预训练模型的强烈归纳偏见。为此，我们提出了一种通过迭代信息瓶颈进行潜在策略优化的方法（I²B-LPO）。该方法将传统的令牌分布统计扰动方式转变为推理轨迹的拓扑分支方式。I²B-LPO在高熵状态下触发潜在分支，以多样化推理轨迹，并利用信息瓶颈作为轨迹过滤器和自我奖励机制，确保探索过程既简洁又富有信息量。在四个数学基准测试上的实证结果表明，I²B-LPO取得了最先进的性能表现，在准确性指标上提升了5.3%，在多样性指标上提升了7.4%。相关代码可在https://github.com/denghuilin-cyber/IIB-LPO下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: What Do Prosody and Text Convey? Characterizing How Meaningful Information is Distributed Across Multiple Channels
papers.title_zh: 韵律和文本传递了什么信息？如何通过各种渠道来传达有意义的信息呢？
papers.authors: Aditya Yadavalli, Tiago Pimentel, Tamar I Regev, Ethan Gotlieb Wilcox, Alex Warstadt
papers.abstract: Prosody—the melody of speech—conveys critical information often not captured by the words or text of a message.In this paper, we propose an information-theoretic approach to quantify how much is conveyed by prosody that is not recoverable from text alone, and, crucially, what prosody conveys.Our approach applies large speech and language models to estimate the mutual information between a particular dimension of an utterance’s meaning (e.g., its emotion) and any of its communication channels (e.g., audio or text).We then use this approach to quantify the information conveyed by audio and text about sarcasm, emotion, and questionhood, using speech from television and podcasts.We find that for sarcasm and emotion, the audio channel, and by implication the prosodic channel, transmits over an order of magnitude more information about these features than the text channel alone, at least when long-term context beyond the current sentence is unavailable.For questionhood, prosody provides comparatively less additional information.We conclude by outlining a program applying our approach to more dimensions of meaning, communication channels, and languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 韵律——即语言的旋律——往往能够传达出那些通过文字无法完全捕捉的关键信息。在本文中，我们提出了一种信息论方法来量化由韵律所传递的信息量，以及韵律具体传达了哪些信息。我们的方法利用大型语音和语言模型来估计某个语义维度（例如情感）与各种传播渠道（如音频或文本）之间的互信息。然后，我们利用这一方法来量化电视和播客中的音频和文本所传递的关于讽刺、情感和疑问性的信息。研究发现，对于讽刺和情感而言，音频渠道，进而包括韵律渠道，所传递的信息量远远超过单独使用文本渠道所能传递的信息量，至少在缺乏当前句子之外的长期上下文信息时是这样。而对于疑问性，韵律所提供的额外信息相对较少。最后，我们提出了一个计划，旨在将我们的方法应用于更多语义维度、传播渠道和语言上。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Right at My Level: A Unified Multilingual Framework for Proficiency-Aware Text Simplification
papers.title_zh: 与我水平相匹配：一种统一的多语言框架，旨在实现基于熟练度的文本简化处理
papers.authors: Jinhong Jeong, Junghun Park, Youngjae Yu
papers.abstract: Text simplification supports second language (L2) learning by providing comprehensible input, consistent with the Input Hypothesis. However, constructing personalized parallel corpora is costly, while existing large language model (LLM)-based readability control methods rely on pre-labeled sentence corpora and primarily target English. We propose Re-RIGHT, a unified reinforcement learning framework for adaptive multilingual text simplification without parallel corpus supervision. We first show that prompting-based lexical simplification at target proficiency levels (CEFR, JLPT, TOPIK, and HSK) performs poorly at easier levels and for non-English languages, even with state-of-the-art LLMs such as GPT-5.2 and Gemini 2.5. To address this, we collect 43K vocabulary-level data across four languages (English, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese) and train a compact 4B policy model using Re-RIGHT, which integrates three reward modules: vocabulary coverage, semantic preservation, and coherence. Compared to the stronger LLM baselines, Re-RIGHT achieves higher lexical coverage at target proficiency levels while maintaining original meaning and fluency.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本简化通过提供易于理解的输入，支持了第二语言的学习，这与输入假设理论是一致的。然而，构建个性化的平行语料库需要大量的资源，而现有的基于大语言模型的可读性控制方法则依赖于预先标注好的句子语料库，且主要针对英语文本。我们提出了Re-RIGHT这一统一的强化学习框架，它能够在没有平行语料库监督的情况下，实现自适应多语言文本简化。我们首先证明了，在目标水平（如CEFR、JLPT、TOPIK和HSK）下，基于提示的词汇简化技术在较简单的水平或非英语语言中表现不佳，即使使用像GPT-5.2和Gemini 2.5这样的先进语言模型也是如此。为了克服这一问题，我们收集了四种语言（英语、日语、韩语和中文）的4K词汇级数据，并使用Re-RIGHT训练了一个紧凑的4B规模的政策模型。该模型整合了三个奖励模块：词汇覆盖度、语义保留性和连贯性。与那些基于更强大的语言模型的基线相比，Re-RIGHT能够在保持原文含义和流畅性的同时，实现更高的词汇覆盖度。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
