papers.title: See the Forest for the Trees: Loosely Speculative Decoding via Visual-Semantic Guidance for Efficient Inference of Video LLMs
papers.title_zh: 从整体看森林而非孤立的树木：通过视觉-语义引导进行宽松的推测性解码，以实现对视频生成语言模型的高效推理
papers.authors: Yicheng Ji, Jun Zhang, Jinpeng Chen, Cong Wang, Lidan Shou, Gang Chen, Huan Li
papers.abstract: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) excel in video understanding but suffer from high inference latency due to autoregressive generation. Speculative Decoding (SD) mitigates this by applying a draft-and-verify paradigm, yet existing methods are constrained by rigid exact-match rules, severely limiting the acceleration potential. To bridge this gap, we propose LVSpec, the first training-free loosely SD framework tailored for Video-LLMs. Grounded in the insight that generation is governed by sparse visual-relevant anchors (mandating strictness) amidst abundant visual-irrelevant fillers (permitting loose verification), LVSpec employs a lightweight visual-relevant token identification scheme to accurately pinpoint the former. To further maximize acceptance, we augment this with a position-shift tolerant mechanism that effectively salvages positionally mismatched but semantically equivalent tokens. Experiments demonstrate that LVSpec is high-fidelity and rapid: it preserves >99.8% of target performance while accelerating Qwen2.5-VL-32B by 2.70 \times and LLaVA-OneVision-72B by 2.94 \times. Notably, it boosts the mean accepted length and speedup ratio by 136% and 35% compared to SOTA training-free SD methods for Video-LLMs. Code is provided in the submitted software.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频大语言模型在视频理解方面表现出色，但由于自回归生成机制的存在，其推理延迟较高。推测解码技术通过采用“先生成再验证”的范式来缓解这个问题，但现有方法受到严格精确匹配规则的限制，这严重限制了加速潜力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了LVSpec——首个适用于视频大语言模型的无需训练的松散推测解码框架。基于这样的理念：生成过程受限于稀疏的视觉相关锚点（需要严格匹配），而大量视觉无关的填充内容则允许更宽松的验证方式。LVSpec采用了一种轻量级的视觉相关令牌识别方案，以准确定位这些视觉相关锚点。为了进一步提高模型的接受度，我们还加入了一种能够处理位置不匹配但语义上等效的令牌的机制。实验表明，LVSpec具有高保真度和快速性：它能在保持超过99.8%的目标性能的同时，将Qwen2.5-VL-32B模型的加速倍数提高2.70倍，将LLaVA-OneVision-72B模型的加速倍数提高2.94倍。与目前最先进的无需训练的视频大语言模型推测解码方法相比，LVSpec在平均接受长度和加速比方面分别提高了136%和35%。代码已包含在提交的软件中。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LaoBench: A Large-Scale Multidimensional Lao Benchmark for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: LaoBench：一个适用于大型语言模型的大规模多维评估基准平台
papers.authors: Jian Gao, Richeng Xuan, Zhaolu Kang, Dingshi Liao, Wenxin Huang, Zongmou Huang, Yangdi Xu, Bowen Qin, Zheqi He, Xi Yang, Changjinli, Yonghua Lin
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has not been matched by their evaluation in low-resource languages, especially Southeast Asian languages like Lao. To fill this gap, we introduce LaoBench, the first large-scale, high-quality, and multidimensional benchmark for assessing LLM language understanding and reasoning in Lao. LaoBench contains 17,000+ expert-curated samples across three dimensions: culturally grounded knowledge application, curriculum-aligned K12 education, and bilingual translation among Lao, Chinese, and English. It includes open-source and held-out subsets, where the held-out portion enables secure black-box evaluation via a controlled service to improve fairness and data security. We construct LaoBench with a hybrid pipeline that combines expert authoring with agent-assisted verification, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and educational validity. We evaluate diverse state-of-the-art open-source and closed-source LLMs, and find that even strong multilingual models lag behind human experts, particularly in culturally grounded reasoning and translation fidelity. We hope LaoBench will catalyze research on Lao and other underrepresented Southeast Asian languages for more inclusive multilingual evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展在评估低资源语言方面尚未得到充分验证，尤其是像老挝语这样的东南亚语言。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了LaoBench——首个大规模、高质量且多维度的基准测试平台，用于评估LLM在老挝语中的语言理解和推理能力。LaoBench包含17,000多个经过专家筛选的样本，涵盖三个维度：基于文化的知识应用、与课程相一致的K12教育内容，以及老挝语、中文和英语之间的双语翻译能力。该平台包含开源和保留的测试集，保留部分测试集可以通过受控服务进行安全评估，从而提升公平性及数据安全性。我们采用混合式评估流程，结合专家编写与智能验证技术，确保语言的准确性、文化相关性以及教育的有效性。我们对多种先进的开源和闭源LLM进行了评估，发现即使是最强大的多语言模型，在基于文化的推理能力和翻译质量方面仍落后于人类专家。我们希望LaoBench能推动对老挝语及其他未被充分研究的东南亚语言的研究，从而实现更包容性的多语言评估。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Gradient-Guided Multi-Judge Prompt Optimization
papers.title_zh: 梯度引导的多评判提示优化
papers.authors: ChenZhuo Zhao, Xinda Wang, Pu Zhao, Yue Huang, Junting Lu, Ziqian Liu, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang
papers.abstract: Automatic prompt optimization is a practical alternative to fine-tuning for adapting large language models (LLMs), yet existing approaches often trade off signal quality against computational cost. Methods that rely on generative feedback can be informative but expensive to scale, while sampling-based optimization typically requires many evaluations and exhibits high variance. Even loss-driven prompt optimization remains limited by costly segment attribution that scales with prompt length and by overfitting to a single evaluator, which weakens transfer across model families and domains. We propose Gradient-guided Multi-judge Prompt Optimization (GMPO), a scalable framework that improves both efficiency and robustness. GMPO uses a first-order gradient approximation to score segment importance in a continuous masking direction, requiring only one forward and one backward pass. GMPO further employs a generate multi-judge design in which candidate prompt edits are proposed by a generator and selected using cross-entropy losses aggregated from multiple lightweight judge models, reducing evaluator bias and improving generalization. Experiments across math, reasoning, instruction-following evaluation, and safety robustness benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains with substantially lower optimization overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动提示优化是一种实用的替代方案，可以替代对大语言模型进行精细调整的操作。然而，现有的方法往往需要在信号质量和计算成本之间做出权衡。依赖生成式反馈的方法虽然能提供有用的信息，但扩展起来成本较高；而基于采样的优化方法则通常需要进行大量的评估，且方差较大。即便是基于损失驱动的提示优化，也受到成本高昂的片段归因问题的限制，这个问题会随着提示长度的增加而加剧；此外，过度依赖单一评估器还会削弱模型在不同领域和类别之间的通用性。我们提出了梯度引导的多评判提示优化方法（GMPO），这是一种可扩展的框架，能够同时提高效率和鲁棒性。GMPO利用一阶梯度近似来量化各个片段的重要性，只需进行一次前向传播和一次反向传播即可完成计算。此外，GMPO还采用了一种生成式多评判设计，即由生成器提出候选的提示修改方案，然后通过从多个轻量级评判模型中聚合出的交叉熵损失来进行选择，从而减少评估器的偏差并提高泛化能力。在数学、推理、指令遵循评估以及安全性鲁棒性等多个基准测试中的实验表明，采用GMPO方法能够获得持续的改进效果，同时优化的开销也大幅降低。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ASTRA: Adaptive Semantic Tree Reasoning Architecture for Complex Table Question Answering
papers.title_zh: ASTRA：用于复杂表格问答问题的自适应语义树推理架构
papers.authors: Xiaoke Guo, Songze Li, Zhiqiang Liu, Zhaoyan Gong, Yuanxiang Liu, Huajun Chen, Wen Zhang
papers.abstract: Table serialization remains a critical bottleneck for Large Language Models (LLMs) in complex table question answering, hindered by challenges such as structural neglect, representation gaps, and reasoning opacity. Existing serialization methods fail to capture explicit hierarchies and lack schema flexibility, while current tree-based approaches suffer from limited semantic adaptability. To address these limitations, we propose ASTRA (Adaptive Semantic Tree Reasoning Architecture) including two main modules, AdaSTR and DuTR. First, we introduce AdaSTR, which leverages the global semantic awareness of LLMs to reconstruct tables into Logical Semantic Trees. This serialization explicitly models hierarchical dependencies and employs an adaptive mechanism to optimize construction strategies based on table scale. Second, building on this structure, we present DuTR, a dual-mode reasoning framework that integrates tree-search-based textual navigation for linguistic alignment and symbolic code execution for precise verification. Experiments on complex table benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 在复杂的表格问答场景中，表格序列化仍然是大语言模型面临的关键瓶颈问题。这一问题受到多种因素的阻碍，例如结构忽略、表示缺失以及推理过程的不透明性。现有的序列化方法无法有效捕捉明确的层次结构，且缺乏模式灵活性；而目前的基于树的方法则存在语义适应性不足的缺陷。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了ASTRA（自适应语义树推理架构），该架构包含两个主要模块：AdaSTR和DuTR。首先，我们介绍了AdaSTR模块，它利用大语言模型的全局语义感知能力，将表格重构为逻辑语义树。这种序列化方式能够明确模拟层次依赖关系，并通过自适应机制根据表格的规模优化构建策略。其次，在此基础上，我们提出了DuTR模块，它是一个双模式推理框架，既采用基于树的文本导航方法进行语言对齐，又通过符号代码执行来实现精确验证。在复杂的表格基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法取得了领先的性能表现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DEBAR: Mitigating Contextual Bias in Cross-Document Relation Extraction via Dual-Stream Decoupling
papers.title_zh: DEBAR：通过双流分离技术减轻跨文档关系提取中的情境偏见
papers.authors: Zhixuan Yang, Fu Zhang, Huangming Xu, Jingwei Cheng
papers.abstract: Cross-document Relation Extraction (CodRE) requires reasoning over scattered evidence to identify relations between target entities across multiple documents. Existing methods indiscriminately fuse target entities and the intermediate bridge entities that link them into a unified representation. This leads to intermediate evidence that often aligns with only one side of the entity pair, resulting in one-sided relation transfer contextual bias and incomplete reasoning chains. Moreover, these methods typically employ a global threshold to determine relation existence for all entity pairs, limiting the model’s reasoning performance.To address these issues, we propose DEBAR (Dual-stream Entity Bias Reduction), a framework designed to explicitly decouple and preserve bidirectional bridge evidence, combined with a novel dynamic loss optimization objective. Specifically, DEBAR employs a bridge-aware input construction strategy and a dual-stream graph reasoning network to separately encode head and tail contexts, preventing semantic interference while capturing global dependencies through iterative message passing. Furthermore, we introduce a curriculum-aware ranking optimization objective that progressively tightens classification constraints to stabilize training and enforce discriminative decision boundaries. Experiments on the CodRE benchmarks show that DEBAR achieves state-of-the-art performance while effectively mitigating cross-document contextual bias. Moreover, extensive experiments on our proposed loss across backbones confirm its generalization, suggesting it as a reliable replacement for existing CodRE losses. Code is available at https://github.com/newyuyou/DEBAR.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨文档关系提取（CodRE）需要通过对分散的证据进行推理，以识别多个文档中目标实体之间的关系。现有方法往往不加区分地将目标实体以及连接它们的中间桥梁实体融合成一个统一的表示形式。这导致的中间证据通常只与实体对的一方相关联，从而导致片面地转移关系、上下文偏差以及不完整的推理链。此外，这些方法通常采用全局阈值来确定所有实体对之间的关系存在性，这限制了模型的推理性能。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了DEBAR（双流实体偏差减少）框架，该框架旨在明确分离并保留双向桥梁证据，同时结合了一种新颖的动态损失优化目标。具体来说，DEBAR采用了一种考虑桥梁因素的输入构建策略，以及一个双流图推理网络，分别编码头部和尾部上下文信息，从而防止语义干扰，同时通过迭代的消息传递来捕捉全局依赖关系。此外，我们还引入了一个考虑课程学习的排名优化目标，逐步收紧分类约束，以稳定训练过程，并强制实现具有区分性的决策边界。在CodRE基准测试上的实验表明，DEBAR取得了最先进的性能，同时有效缓解了跨文档的上下文偏差问题。此外，我们对所提出的损失函数进行的广泛实验表明其良好的泛化能力，使其成为现有CodRE损失函数的可靠替代方案。代码可访问于https://github.com/newyuyou/DEBAR。

papers.title: IF-RewardBench: Benchmarking Judge Models for Instruction-Following Evaluation
papers.title_zh: IF-RewardBench：用于指导性评估的评判模型对比分析
papers.authors: Bosi Wen, Yilin Niu, Cunxiang Wang, Xiaoying Ling, Ying Zhang, Pei Ke, Hongning Wang, Minlie Huang
papers.abstract: Instruction-following is a foundational capability of large language models (LLMs), with its improvement hinging on scalable and accurate feedback from judge models. However, the reliability of current judge models in instruction-following remains underexplored due to several deficiencies of existing meta-evaluation benchmarks, such as their insufficient data coverage and oversimplified pairwise evaluation paradigms that misalign with model optimization scenarios. To this end, we propose IF-RewardBench, a comprehensive meta-evaluation benchmark for instruction-following that covers diverse instruction and constraint types. For each instruction, we construct a preference graph containing all pairwise preferences among multiple responses based on instruction-following quality. This design enables a listwise evaluation paradigm that assesses the capabilities of judge models to rank multiple responses, which is essential in guiding model alignment. Extensive experiments on IF-RewardBench reveal significant deficiencies in current judge models and demonstrate that our benchmark achieves a stronger positive correlation with downstream task performance compared to existing benchmarks. Our codes and data are available at https://github.com/thu-coai/IF-RewardBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 遵循指令是大语言模型的一项基础能力，其提升依赖于来自评判模型的可扩展且准确的反馈。然而，由于现有的元评估基准存在多种缺陷，目前评判模型在遵循指令方面的可靠性仍未被充分研究。这些缺陷包括数据覆盖不足以及过于简化的成对评估范式，这些范式与模型优化场景并不匹配。为此，我们提出了IF-RewardBench，这是一个针对遵循指令的综合性元评估基准，能够涵盖多种指令和约束类型。对于每条指令，我们构建一个偏好图，该图包含了基于遵循指令质量的多条响应之间的所有成对偏好关系。这种设计实现了一种列表式评估范式，能够评估评判模型对多条响应的排序能力，这对于指导模型对齐至关重要。在IF-RewardBench上的大量实验表明，当前评判模型存在显著缺陷，而且我们的基准测试与下游任务性能之间的正相关性要高于现有基准测试。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/thu-coai/IF-RewardBench获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LegalChainReasoner: Grounding Criminal Judicial Opinion Generation via Structured Legal Chains
papers.title_zh: LegalChainReasoner：通过结构化法律链条来规范刑事司法判断的生成
papers.authors: Weizhe Shi, Qiqi Wang, Yihong Pan, Qian Liu, Kaiqi Zhao
papers.abstract: A criminal judicial opinion represents the judge’s disposition of a case, including the decision rationale and sentencing. Automatically generating such opinions can assist in analyzing sentencing consistency and provide judges with references to past similar cases. However, current research typically approaches this task by dividing it into two isolated subtasks: legal reasoning and sentencing prediction. This separation often leads to inconsistency between the reasoning and predictions, failing to meet real-world judicial requirements. Furthermore, prior studies rely on manually creating knowledge to enhance applicability, yet such methods remain limited in practical deployment. To address these limitations and better align with legal practice, we propose a new LegalAI task: Criminal Judicial Opinion Generation, which simultaneously produces both legal reasoning and sentencing decisions. To achieve this, we introduce LegalChainReasoner framework that applies structured legal chains to guide the model through comprehensive case assessments. By integrating factual premises, composite legal conditions, and sentencing conclusions, our approach ensures flexible knowledge injection and end-to-end opinion generation. Experiments on real-world, open-source Chinese legal case datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms baseline models.
papers.abstract_zh: 刑事司法意见代表了法官对案件的判决结果，其中包括判决理由和量刑标准。自动生成此类意见有助于分析量刑的一致性，并为法官提供关于类似案例的参考依据。然而，目前的研究通常将这一任务分解为两个独立的子任务：法律推理和量刑预测。这种分离往往导致推理结果与预测结果之间存在不一致性，无法满足现实中的司法需求。此外，以往的研究依赖于人工创建知识来提高模型的适用性，但这种方法在实际应用中的效果仍然有限。为了克服这些局限性，更好地符合法律实践的要求，我们提出了一种新的LegalAI任务：刑事司法意见生成，该任务能够同时产生法律推理和量刑决策。为了实现这一目标，我们引入了LegalChainReasoner框架，该框架利用结构化的法律链条来指导模型进行全面的案件评估。通过整合事实前提、复合法律条件和量刑结论，我们的方法确保了知识的灵活注入以及意见的全程生成。在真实世界的开源中文法律案例数据集上进行的实验表明，我们的方法优于现有的基线模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: InsideOut: Measuring and Mitigating Insider–Outsider Bias in Interview Script Generation
papers.title_zh: 从内到外：衡量并减轻面试脚本生成中的内部与外部偏见问题
papers.authors: Yixin Wan, Xingrun Chen, Kai-Wei Chang
papers.abstract: Advancements in Large language models (LLMs) have enabled a variety of downstream applications like story and interview script generation.However, recent research raised concerns about culture-related fairness issues in LLM-generated content.In this work, we identify and systematically investigate LLMs’ insider-outsider bias, a phenomenon where models position themselves as “insiders” of mainstream cultures during generation while externalizing less dominant cultures.We propose the InsideOut benchmark with 4,000 generation prompts and three evaluation metrics to quantify this bias through a culturally situated interview script generation task, in which an LLM is positioned as a reporter interviewing local people across 10 diverse cultures.Empirical evaluation on 5 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that while models adopt insider tones in over 88% US-contexted scripts on average, they disproportionately default to “outsider” stances for non-Western cultures.To mitigate these biases, we propose 2 inference-time methods: a baseline prompt-based Fairness Intervention Pillars (FIP) method, and a structured Mitigation via Fairness Agents (MFA) framework consisting of a Single-Agent (MFA-SA), a Hierarchical-Agent (MFA-HA), and an autonomous Agentic Planning (MFA-Plan) pipeline.Empirical results demonstrate that agent-based MFA methods achieve outstanding and robust performance in mitigating the insider-outsider bias:For instance, on the Cultural Alignment Gap (CAG) metric, MFA-SA reduces bias in Llama model by 89.70 % and MFA-HA mitigates bias in Qwen by 82.54%.These findings showcase the effectiveness of agent-based methods as a promising direction for mitigating biases in generative LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的进展使得各种下游应用成为可能，比如故事和采访脚本的生成。然而，最近的研究对LLM生成内容中的文化相关公平性问题提出了担忧。在这项研究中，我们识别并系统研究了LLM的内外偏见现象——即模型在生成过程中将自己定位为主流文化的“内部人士”，而对其他较少被主流文化所重视的文化则表现出较少关注的态度。我们提出了InsideOut基准测试，包含4,000个生成提示和三个评估指标，通过文化情境下的采访脚本生成任务来量化这种偏见。在这个任务中，一个LLM被设定为记者，采访来自10种不同文化的当地人。对5种最先进的LLM进行的实证评估表明，虽然模型在超过88%的美国文化背景脚本中表现出内部视角，但对于非西方文化，它们却过度倾向于使用“外部人士”的立场。为了缓解这些偏见，我们提出了两种推理时间的方法：一种是基于基线的公平性干预框架（FIP），以及一种由单一代理、分层代理和自主代理规划流程组成的结构化公平性代理缓解框架（MFA）。实证结果表明，基于代理的MFA方法在缓解内外偏见方面表现非常出色：例如，在文化一致性差距指标上，MFA-SA能够将Llama模型的偏见降低89.70%，而MFA-HA则能将Qwen模型的偏见降低82.54%。这些发现证明了基于代理的方法在缓解生成式LLM中的偏见方面具有很大的潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Meta-Reasoning: Metacognitive Consolidation for Self-Improving LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 超越元推理：用于提升LLM推理能力的元认知巩固机制
papers.authors: Ziqing Zhuang, Linhai Zhang, Jiasheng Si, Deyu Zhou, Yulan He
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities, and as existing approaches for enhancing LLM reasoning continue to mature, increasing attention has shifted toward meta-reasoning as a promising direction for further improvement. However, most existing meta-reasoning methods remain episodic: they focus on executing complex meta-reasoning routines within individual instances, but ignore the accumulation of reusable meta-reasoning skills across instances, leading to recurring failure modes and repeatedly high metacognitive effort. In this paper, we introduce Metacognitive Consolidation, a novel framework in which a model consolidates metacognitive experience from past reasoning episodes into reusable knowledge that improves future meta-reasoning. We instantiate this framework by structuring instance-level problem solving into distinct roles for reasoning, monitoring, and control to generate rich, attributable meta-level traces. These traces are then consolidated through a hierarchical, multi-timescale update mechanism that gradually forms evolving meta-knowledge. Experimental results demonstrate consistent performance gains across benchmarks and backbone models, and show that performance improves as metacognitive experience accumulates over time.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已经展现出强大的推理能力。随着用于提升语言模型推理能力的现有方法不断成熟，人们开始将注意力转向元推理这一有前景的改进方向。然而，目前大多数元推理方法仍然局限于特定情境：它们专注于在单个实例中执行复杂的元推理流程，却忽视了将可复用的元推理技能积累到不同实例中，这导致了重复出现的失败模式以及持续的高额元认知负担。在本文中，我们提出了“元认知巩固”这一创新框架。该框架让模型将过去推理过程中的元认知经验整合为可复用的知识，从而提升未来的元推理能力。我们通过将实例级问题解决任务分解为推理、监控和控制等不同角色来实施这一框架，从而生成丰富且可归因的元级记录。这些记录通过一种分层、多时间尺度的更新机制进行整合，逐渐形成不断发展的元知识。实验结果表明，无论是在各种基准测试还是主流模型中，该框架都能带来持续的性能提升，并且随着元认知经验的积累，性能还会进一步改善。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mnemis: Dual-Route Retrieval on Hierarchical Graphs for Long-Term LLM Memory
papers.title_zh: 姆涅米斯：在分层图中实现双路径检索，为大型语言模型提供长期记忆机制
papers.authors: Zihao Tang, Xin Yu, Ziyu Xiao, Zengxuan Wen, Zelin Li, Jiaxi Zhou, Hualei Wang, Haohua Wang, Haizhen Huang, Weiwei Deng, Feng Sun, Qi Zhang
papers.abstract: AI Memory, specifically how models organizes and retrieves historical messages, becomes increasingly valuable to Large Language Models (LLMs), yet existing methods (RAG and Graph-RAG) primarily retrieve memory through similarity-based mechanisms. While efficient, such System-1-style retrieval struggles with scenarios that require global reasoning or comprehensive coverage of all relevant information. In this work, We propose Mnemis, a novel memory framework that integrates System-1 similarity search with a complementary System-2 mechanism, termed Global Selection. Mnemis organizes memory into a base graph for similarity retrieval and a hierarchical graph that enables top-down, deliberate traversal over semantic hierarchies. By combining the complementary strength from both retrieval routes, Mnemis retrieves memory items that are both semantically and structurally relevant. Mnemis achieves state-of-the-art performance across all compared methods on long-term memory benchmarks, scoring 93.9 on LoCoMo and 91.6 on LongMemEval-S using GPT-4.1-mini.
papers.abstract_zh: AI记忆机制，尤其是模型如何组织和检索历史信息，对于大语言模型来说变得越来越重要。不过，现有的方法（如RAG和Graph-RAG）主要通过基于相似性的机制来检索记忆。虽然这种方法效率较高，但在需要全局推理或全面覆盖所有相关信息的情况下却存在不足。在这项研究中，我们提出了Mnemis这一新颖的记忆框架。该框架将基于相似性的检索方式与一种补充性的系统二机制相结合，这种机制被称为“全局选择”。Mnemis将记忆信息组织成一个基础图结构用于相似性检索，同时还有一个分层图结构，使得可以自上而下地遍历语义层次结构。通过结合这两种检索方式的优势，Mnemis能够检索到既在语义上相关又在结构上相关的记忆项。在长期的记忆检索测试中，Mnemis的表现优于所有比较方法，在使用GPT-4.1-mini进行LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S测试时，其得分分别达到了93.9和91.6。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Consolidation or Adaptation? PRISM: Disentangling SFT and RL Data via Gradient Concentration
papers.title_zh: 巩固还是适应？PRISM：通过梯度集中度区分 SFT 与 RL 数据
papers.authors: Yang Zhao, Yangou Ouyang, Xiao Ding, Hepeng Wang, Bibo Cai, Kai Xiong, Jinglong Gao, Zhouhao Sun, Li Du, Bing Qin, Ting Liu
papers.abstract: While Hybrid Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become the standard paradigm for training LLM agents, effective mechanisms for data allocation between these stages remain largely underexplored. Current data arbitration strategies often rely on surface-level heuristics that fail to diagnose intrinsic learning needs. Since SFT targets pattern consolidation through imitation while RL drives structural adaptation via exploration, misaligning data with these functional roles causes severe optimization interference. We propose PRISM, a dynamics-aware framework grounded in Schema Theory that arbitrates data based on its degree of cognitive conflict with the model’s existing knowledge. By analyzing the spatial geometric structure of gradients, PRISM identifies data triggering high spatial concentration as high-conflict signals that require RL for structural restructuring. In contrast, data yielding diffuse updates is routed to SFT for efficient consolidation. Extensive experiments on WebShop and ALFWorld demonstrate that PRISM achieves a Pareto improvement, outperforming state-of-the-art hybrid methods while reducing computational costs by up to 3.22 \times. Our findings suggest that disentangling data based on internal optimization regimes is crucial for scalable and robust agent alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然混合监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）的结合已成为训练大语言模型代理的标准方法，但在这两个阶段之间分配数据的有效机制仍未被充分探索。当前的数据仲裁策略往往依赖于表面上的启发式方法，而这些方法无法准确识别内在的学习需求。由于SFT通过模仿来巩固模式，而RL则通过探索来实现结构性的适应，因此如果数据分配与这些功能角色不匹配，将会严重干扰优化过程。我们提出了PRISM这一基于模式理论的动态感知框架，该框架根据数据与模型现有知识的认知冲突程度来分配数据。通过分析梯度的空间几何结构，PRISM能够识别出那些引发高度空间集中性的数据，这些数据被视为高冲突信号，需要借助RL来进行结构性重构。相反，那些产生分散性更新的数据则被分配给SFT，以实现高效的模式巩固。在WebShop和ALFWorld上的广泛实验表明，PRISM能够实现帕累托改进，其性能优于现有的混合方法，同时还将计算成本降低了3.22倍。我们的研究结果表明，根据内部优化机制来分离数据对于实现可扩展且稳健的代理对齐至关重要。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ADVICE: Answer-Dependent Verbalized Confidence Estimation
papers.title_zh: 建议：基于回答的言语式置信度估计
papers.authors: KiJung Seo, Sehun Lim, Taeuk Kim
papers.abstract: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) has enabled them to communicate their confidence in natural language, improving transparency and reliability.However, this expressiveness is often accompanied by systematic overconfidence, whose underlying causes remain poorly understood. In this work, we analyze the dynamics of verbalized confidence estimation and identify answer-independence-the failure to condition confidence on the model’s own answer-as a primary driver of this behavior.To address this, we introduce ADVICE (Answer-Dependent VerbalIzed Confidence Estimation), a fine-tuning framework that promotes answer-grounded confidence estimation.Extensive experiments show that ADVICE substantially improves confidence calibration, while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen settings without degrading task performance.We further demonstrate that these gains stem from enhanced answer dependence, shedding light on the origins of overconfidence and enabling trustworthy confidence verbalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展使其能够以自然语言表达出自己的自信程度，从而提高了透明度和可靠性。然而，这种表达方式往往伴随着系统性的过度自信现象，其根本原因仍不清楚。在这项研究中，我们分析了语言化自信估计的动态变化，并发现“答案依赖性”——即不根据模型的自身答案来调整自信度——是这种现象的主要驱动因素。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了“建议式语言化自信估计”这一微调框架，该框架强调基于答案的自信度调整。大量实验表明，该框架显著提升了自信度的准确性，同时能够在未见过的情况下仍然保持良好的泛化能力，而不会降低任务性能。我们还进一步证明，这些改进源于对答案依赖性的增强，这为理解过度自信的起源提供了线索，并使得可信的自信表达成为可能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Powering Verifiable Learning via Automated Evolutionary Data Synthesis
papers.title_zh: 通过自动化进化数据合成实现可验证的学习机制
papers.authors: He Du, Bowen Li, Aijun Yang, Siyang He, Qipeng Guo, Kai Chen, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: Reliable verifiable data has become a key driver of capability gains in modern language models, enabling stable reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and effective distillation that transfers competence across math, coding, and agentic tasks. Yet constructing generalizable synthetic verifiable data remains difficult due to hallucination-prone generation, and weak or trivial verification artifacts that fail to separate strong from weak solutions. Existing approaches often rely on task-specific heuristics or post-hoc filters that do not transfer across domains and lack a principled, universal evaluator of verifiability. In this work, we introduce an evolutionary, task-agnostic, strategy-guided, executably-checkable data synthesis framework that, from minimal seed supervision, jointly synthesizes problems, diverse candidate solutions, and verification artifacts, and iteratively discovers strategies via a consistency-based evaluator that enforces agreement between human-annotated and strategy-induced checks. This pipeline upgrades filtering into principled synthesis: it reliably assembles coherent, verifiable training instances and generalizes without domain-specific rules. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach under both RLVR and model distillation training paradigms. The results show that training with our synthesized data yields significant improvements on both the LiveCodeBench and AgentBench-OS tasks, highlighting the robust generalization of our framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 可靠且可验证的数据已成为现代语言模型能力提升的关键驱动力，它能够通过可验证的奖励实现稳定的强化学习，并有效实现知识迁移，适用于数学、编程以及智能体任务。然而，由于生成过程中容易出现幻觉现象，再加上缺乏有效的验证手段，导致难以构建具有普遍适用性的合成可验证数据。现有的方法往往依赖于特定任务的启发式算法或事后筛选机制，这些方法无法在不同领域之间通用，同时也缺乏一种基于原则的、通用的可验证性评估工具。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种进化式的、与任务无关的、由策略引导的、可执行的合成数据框架。该框架从最少的种子数据开始，共同生成问题、多样化的候选解决方案以及验证数据，并通过基于一致性的评估工具逐步发现策略，从而确保人类注释的结果与策略生成的验证结果保持一致。这一流程将筛选过程提升为基于原则的合成过程：它能够可靠地组装出连贯且可验证的训练实例，并且能够在无需特定领域规则的情况下实现泛化。我们的实验表明，所提出的方法在强化学习训练和模型蒸馏训练两种模式下都表现出有效性。实验结果显示，使用我们合成的数据进行训练后，在LiveCodeBench和AgentBench-OS任务上都能取得显著的改进，这充分证明了我们框架的强大泛化能力。

papers.title: SPARK: Strategic Policy-Aware Exploration via Dynamic Branching for Long-Horizon Agentic Learning
papers.title_zh: SPARK：通过动态分支实现具有战略意识的策略探索，以进行长期目标的学习
papers.authors: Jinyang Wu, Shuo Yang, Yuhao Shen, Shuai Zhang, Zhengqi Wen, Jianhua Tao
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has empowered large language models to act as intelligent agents, yet training them for long-horizon tasks remains challenging due to the scarcity of high-quality trajectories, especially under limited resources. Existing methods typically scale up rollout sizes and indiscriminately allocate computational resources among intermediate steps. Such attempts inherently waste substantial computation budget on trivial steps while failing to guarantee sample quality. To address this, we propose SPARK (Strategic Policy-Aware exploRation via Key-state dynamic branching), a novel framework that selectively branches at critical decision states for resource-efficient exploration. Our key insight is to activate adaptive branching exploration at critical decision points to probe promising trajectories, thereby achieving precise resource allocation that prioritizes sampling quality over blind coverage. This design leverages the agent’s intrinsic decision-making signals to reduce dependence on human priors, enabling the agent to autonomously expand exploration and achieve stronger generalization. Experiments across diverse tasks (e.g., embodied planning), demonstrate that SPARK achieves superior success rates with significantly fewer training samples, exhibiting robust generalization even in unseen scenarios. Our code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/jinyangwu/SPARK.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习使得大语言模型能够充当智能代理，然而，由于高质量训练数据的稀缺性，尤其是在资源有限的情况下，训练这些模型以完成长期任务仍然具有挑战性。现有的方法通常会增加实验规模，并在各个中间步骤中无差别地分配计算资源。这样的做法会浪费大量计算资源在琐碎的任务上，同时无法保证样本的质量。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了SPARK（策略感知的基于关键状态动态分支的探索）这一新型框架。该框架能够在关键决策点进行选择性分支，从而实现资源高效的探索。我们的核心思路是在关键决策点激活自适应分支探索，以探测有潜力的路径，从而实现精确的资源分配，优先保证样本质量而非盲目覆盖。这种设计利用了智能代理自身的决策信号，减少了对人类先验知识的依赖，使智能代理能够自主扩展探索范围，从而实现更强的泛化能力。在多种任务中的实验表明，SPARK在训练样本数量显著减少的情况下仍能取得优异的成绩，甚至在未见过的场景中也能表现出强大的泛化能力。我们的代码和检查点可以在https://github.com/jinyangwu/SPARK下载。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Code: A More Data-Hungry Regime
papers.title_zh: 代码的相关缩放定律：一种更为消耗数据的运行模式
papers.authors: Xianzhen Luo, Wenzhen Zheng, Qingfu Zhu, Rongyi Zhang, Houyi Li, Siming Huang, YuanTao Fan, Wanxiang Che
papers.abstract: Code Large Language Models (LLMs) are revolutionizing software engineering. However, scaling laws that guide the efficient training are predominantly analyzed on Natural Language (NL). Given the fundamental differences like strict syntax between code and NL, it is unclear whether these laws are directly applicable to code. To address this gap, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of scaling laws for code, comprising 117 experimental runs with model sizes from 0.2B to 3.8B and training tokens from 2B to 128B. We fit the Chinchilla law and the Farsser law. First, the results show that the more expressive Farseer law offers greater accuracy. Second, the analysis reveals that Code LLMs scale effectively with model size. Crucially, code represents a more data-hungry regime, requiring a substantially higher data-to-parameter ratio than NL. Finally, two additional sets of experiments on code-NL mixtures show that NL benefits resource-constrained scenarios, but becomes a detriment at higher compute budgets.
papers.abstract_zh: 代码大语言模型正在彻底改变软件工程领域。然而，那些指导高效训练的扩展规律，目前主要是在自然语言上进行研究的。由于代码与自然语言在语法结构上存在根本差异，因此尚不清楚这些规律是否可以直接应用于代码领域。为了填补这一空白，我们进行了首次针对代码的扩展规律的大规模实证研究。研究共包含了117次实验，模型规模从2亿到38亿不等，训练数据量则从20亿到1280亿不等。我们在研究中应用了Chinchilla定律和Farsser定律。首先，研究结果表明，表达能力更强的Farsser定律能够提供更高的准确性。其次，分析显示代码语言模型在模型规模上的扩展性更为显著。关键的是，代码领域需要更多的数据来支持模型运行，因此所需的数据与参数的比例远高于自然语言领域。最后，针对代码与自然语言混合体的额外实验表明，自然语言在资源有限的情况下具有优势，但在更高的计算预算下则会产生负面影响。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When TableQA Meets Noise: A Dual Denoising Framework for Complex Questions and Large-scale Tables
papers.title_zh: 当TableQA遇到噪声问题：一种用于处理复杂问题和大规模表格的数据去噪框架
papers.authors: Shenghao Ye, Yu Guo, Dong Jin, Yuxiang Wang, Yikai Shen, Yunpeng Hou, Shuangwu Chen, Jianyang, Xiaofeng Jiang
papers.abstract: Table question answering (TableQA) is a fundamental task in natural language processing (NLP). The strong reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have brought significant advances in this field. However, as real-world applications involve increasingly complex questions and larger tables, substantial noisy data is introduced, which severely degrades reasoning performance. To address this challenge, we focus on improving two core capabilities: Relevance Filtering, which identifies and retains information truly relevant to reasoning, and Table Pruning, which reduces table size while preserving essential content. Based on these principles, we propose EnoTab, a dual denoising framework for complex questions and large-scale tables. Specifically, we first perform Evidence-based Question Denoising by decomposing the question into minimal semantic units and filtering out those irrelevant to answer reasoning based on consistency and usability criteria. Then, we propose Evidence Tree-guided Table Denoising, which constructs an explicit and transparent table pruning path to remove irrelevant data step by step. At each pruning step, we observe the intermediate state of the table and apply a post-order node rollback mechanism to handle abnormal table states, ultimately producing a highly reliable sub-table for final answer reasoning. Finally, extensive experiments show that EnoTab achieves outstanding performance on TableQA tasks with complex questions and large-scale tables, confirming its effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格问答（TableQA）是自然语言处理领域的一项基础任务。大语言模型（LLM）强大的推理能力为这一领域带来了显著进展。然而，在实际应用中，由于问题越来越复杂，表格规模也越来越大，这就导致了大量噪声数据的引入，从而严重降低了推理性能。为了应对这一挑战，我们专注于提升两个核心能力：相关性过滤，即识别并保留与推理真正相关的信息；表格修剪，即在保留重要内容的同时减少表格的大小。基于这些原则，我们提出了EnoTab，一个针对复杂问题和大规模表格的双重去噪框架。具体来说，我们首先通过将问题分解为最小的语义单元，并根据一致性和可用性标准过滤掉与答案推理无关的信息，从而实现基于证据的问答去噪。然后，我们提出了基于证据树的表格去噪方法，该方法能够构建出一个明确且透明的表格修剪路径，逐步去除无关数据。在每次修剪过程中，我们会观察表格的中间状态，并采用后序节点回退机制来处理异常表格状态，最终得到一个高度可靠的子表格，用于最终的答案推理。最后，大量的实验表明，EnoTab在涉及复杂问题和大规模表格的表格问答任务中表现非常出色，证明了其有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VRPO: Rethinking Value Modeling for Robust RL under Noisy Supervision in LLM Post-Training
papers.title_zh: VRPO：在大型语言模型训练后，如何在噪声监督条件下重新思考价值建模问题，以使得强化学习能够更加稳健地运行
papers.authors: Dingwei Zhu, Shihan Dou, Zhiheng Xi, Senjie Jin, Guoqiang Zhang, Jiazheng Zhang, Junjie Ye, Mingxu Chai, Enyu Zhou, Ming Zhang, Yuhui Wang, Caishuang Huang, Chenhao Huang, Yunke Zhang, Yuran Wang, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xipeng Qiu, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) in real-world environments often suffers from ambiguous or incomplete reward supervision, which undermines policy stability and generalization. Such noise may cause models to ignore key information or even collapse in advantage estimation. We find that a strong value model is essential for absorbing unstable signals and producing reliable advantages, offering denser and more robust supervision than the reward model. To better optimize noisy supervision, we propose VRPO, a framework that enhances value modeling for robust RL in LLM post-training. VRPO integrates (1) auxiliary losses guided by entropy and perplexity from a frozen language model, and (2) a variational information bottleneck, enabling the value model to filter noise and capture key words. This design allows the value model to correct noise rewards and generate more reliable advantage estimates, transforming it from a passive predictor into an active noise regulator. Experiments on multi-turn dialogue, math reasoning, and science QA with both rule-based and model-based rewards show that VRPO consistently outperforms baselines such as PPO and GRPO. Our work highlight the central role of the value model in Robust RL and provide a principled and practical approach to policy optimization under noisy supervision.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实环境中，强化学习常常面临奖励信息模糊或不完整的问题，这会影响策略的稳定性和泛化能力。这种噪声可能导致模型忽略关键信息，甚至导致优势估计出现崩溃。我们发现，一个强大的价值模型对于吸收不稳定信号并生成可靠的优势非常重要，它能够提供比奖励模型更密集、更可靠的监督。为了更好地优化带有噪声的监督机制，我们提出了VRPO框架，该框架能够增强价值模型的建模能力，从而在LLM训练后实现鲁棒的强化学习。VRPO结合了以下两个要素：(1) 由冻结语言模型的熵和困惑度引导的辅助损失；(2) 变分信息瓶颈机制，使价值模型能够过滤噪声并捕捉关键信息。这种设计使得价值模型能够纠正噪声带来的奖励偏差，生成更可靠的优势估计，从而将其从被动的预测器转变为主动的噪声调节器。在多轮对话、数学推理和科学问答等任务上的实验表明，VRPO在基于规则的和基于模型的奖励条件下，始终优于PPO和GRPO等基线算法。我们的研究强调了价值模型在鲁棒强化学习中的核心作用，并为在噪声监督下的策略优化提供了一种原理清晰且实用的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Taming Actor-Observer Asymmetry in Agents via Dialectical Alignment
papers.title_zh: 通过辩证对齐技术，驯服代理中的演员-观察者对称性问题
papers.authors: Bobo Li, Rui Wu, Zibo Ji, Meishan Zhang, Hao Fei, Min Zhang, Mong-Li Lee, Wynne Hsu
papers.abstract: Large Language Model agents have rapidly evolved from static text generators into dynamic systems capable of executing complex autonomous workflows. To enhance reliability, multi-agent frameworks assigning specialized roles are increasingly adopted to enable self-reflection and mutual auditing. While such role-playing effectively leverages domain expert knowledge, we find it simultaneously induces a human-like cognitive bias known as Actor-Observer Asymmetry (AOA). Specifically, an agent acting as an actor (during self-reflection) tends to attribute failures to external factors, whereas an observer (during mutual auditing) attributes the same errors to internal faults. We quantify this using our new Ambiguous Failure Benchmark, which reveals that simply swapping perspectives triggers the AOA effect in over 20% of cases for most models. To tame this bias, we introduce ReTAS (Reasoning via Thesis-Antithesis-Synthesis), a model trained through dialectical alignment to enforce perspective-invariant reasoning. By integrating dialectical chain-of-thought with Group Relative Policy Optimization, ReTAS guides agents to synthesize conflicting viewpoints into an objective consensus. Experiments demonstrate that ReTAS effectively mitigates attribution inconsistency and significantly improves fault resolution rates in ambiguous scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理已经从静态的文本生成器迅速发展成为能够执行复杂自主工作流程的动态系统。为了提升可靠性，越来越多地采用多智能体框架来分配专门的角色，以实现自我反思和相互审核。虽然这种角色扮演有效地利用了领域专家的知识，但我们发现它同时会引发一种类似人类的认知偏差，即行动者-观察者不对称现象。具体来说，作为行动者的代理在自我反思时倾向于将失败归因于外部因素，而作为观察者的代理则在相互审核时将同样的错误归咎于内部故障。我们通过新的“模糊故障基准测试”来量化这一现象，结果显示，在大多数模型中，仅仅改变视角就能触发超过20%的案例中出现的不对称性现象。为了克服这种偏差，我们引入了ReTAS模型——一种通过辩证对齐训练出来的模型，旨在实现视角不变的推理能力。通过将辩证思维链与群体相对策略优化相结合，ReTAS能够引导代理将相互冲突的观点综合为客观共识。实验表明，ReTAS能够有效减少归因不一致性，并在模糊场景中显著提高故障解决率。

papers.title: Knowledge Beyond Language: Bridging the Gap in Multilingual Machine Unlearning Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 超越语言的认知：填补多语言机器卸载评估领域的空白
papers.authors: Kyomin Hwang, Hyeonjin Kim, Sangyeon Cho, Nojun Kwak
papers.abstract: While LLMs are increasingly used in commercial services, they pose privacy risks such as leakage of sensitive personally identifiable information (PII). For LLMs trained on multilingual corpora, Multilingual Machine Unlearning (MMU) aims to remove information across multiple languages. However, prior MMU evaluations fail to capture such cross-linguistic distribution of information, being largely limited to direct extensions of per-language evaluation protocols. To this end, we propose two metrics to evaluate the information spread across languages: the Knowledge Separability Score (KSS) and the Knowledge Persistence Score (KPS). KSS measures the overall unlearning quality across multiple languages, while KPS more specifically aims to assess consistent removal of information among different language pairs. We evaluated various unlearning methods in the multilingual setting with these metrics and conducted comprehensive analyses. Through our investigation, we provide insights into unique phenomena exclusive to MMU and offer a new perspective on MMU evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在商业服务中的使用越来越广泛，但它们也带来了隐私风险，例如敏感个人身份信息泄露的问题。对于基于多语言语料库训练出来的大语言模型来说，多语言机器去学习技术旨在消除多种语言之间的信息干扰。然而，以往的多语言机器去学习评估方法未能充分捕捉到信息的跨语言分布情况，因为它们主要局限于对每种语言进行独立评估的方法。为此，我们提出了两种用于评估语言间信息扩散的指标：知识可分离性得分和知识持久性得分。知识可分离性得分用于衡量多种语言间去学习的整体质量，而知识持久性得分则更具体地用于评估不同语言对之间信息的持续去除效果。我们使用这些指标在多语言环境下评估了各种去学习方法，并进行了全面的分析。通过我们的研究，我们揭示了多语言机器去学习技术独有的现象，并为该技术的评估提供了新的视角。

papers.title: AT²PO: Agentic Turn-based Policy Optimization via Tree Search
papers.title_zh: AT²PO：基于树搜索的主动回合制策略优化算法
papers.authors: Zefang Zong, Dingwei Chen, Yang Li, Qi Yi, Bo Zhou, Chengming Li, BO Qian, Peng Chen, Jie Jiang
papers.abstract: LLM agents have emerged as powerful systems for tackling multi-turn tasks by interleaving internal reasoning and external tool interactions. Agentic Reinforcement Learning has recently drawn significant research attention as a critical post-training paradigm to further refine these capabilities. In this paper, we present AT²PO (Agentic Turn-based Policy Optimization via Tree Search), a unified framework for multi-turn agentic RL that addresses three core challenges: limited exploration diversity, sparse credit assignment, and misaligned policy optimization. AT²PO introduces a turn-level tree structure that jointly enables Entropy-Guided Tree Expansion for strategic exploration and Turn-wise Credit Assignment for fine-grained reward propagation from sparse outcomes. Complementing this, we propose Agentic Turn-based Policy Optimization, a turn-level learning objective that aligns policy updates with the natural decision granularity of agentic interactions. ATPO is orthogonal to tree search and can be readily integrated into any multi-turn RL pipeline. Experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over the state-of-the-art baseline by up to 1.84 percentage points in average, with ablation studies validating the effectiveness of each component.
papers.abstract_zh: LLM代理已成为处理多轮任务的强大系统，它们通过将内部推理与外部工具交互相结合来应对各种挑战。最近，代理式强化学习作为训练后的重要范式，吸引了大量研究关注，以进一步提升这些能力。在本文中，我们提出了AT²PO（通过树搜索的代理式基于回合的策略优化）这一统一框架，该框架旨在解决三个核心问题：有限的探索多样性、稀疏的信用分配以及不一致的策略优化。AT²PO引入了回合级树结构，既实现了基于熵的树扩展策略探索功能，又实现了针对稀疏结果的细粒度奖励分配。此外，我们还提出了代理式基于回合的策略优化，这一回合级学习目标能够将策略更新与代理交互的自然决策粒度保持一致。ATPO与树搜索是正交的，可以轻松集成到任何多轮强化学习流程中。在七个基准测试中的实验表明，与最先进的基线相比，平均改进幅度可达1.84个百分点，而消融研究也验证了每个组件的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SecureVibeBench: Benchmarking Secure Vibe Coding of AI Agents via Reconstructing Vulnerability-Introducing Scenarios
papers.title_zh: SecureVibeBench：通过重构漏洞来评估AI智能体编码的安全性——引入特定场景进行基准测试
papers.authors: Junkai Chen, Huihui Huang, Yunbo Lyu, Junwen An, Jieke Shi, Chengran Yang, Ting Zhang, Haoye Tian, Yikun Li, Zhenhao Li, Xin Zhou, Xing Hu, David Lo
papers.abstract: Large language model-powered code agents are rapidly transforming software engineering, yet the security risks of their generated code have become a critical concern. Existing benchmarks have provided valuable insights, but they fail to capture scenarios in which vulnerabilities are actually introduced by human developers, making fair comparisons between humans and agents infeasible. We therefore introduce SecureVibeBench, a benchmark of 105 C/C++ secure coding tasks sourced from 41 projects in OSS-Fuzz for code agents. SecureVibeBench has the following features: (i) realistic task settings that require multi-file edits in large repositories, (ii) aligned contexts based on real-world open-source vulnerabilities with precisely identified vulnerability introduction points, and (iii) comprehensive evaluation that combines functionality testing and security checking with both static and dynamic oracles. We evaluate 5 popular code agents like OpenHands, supported by 5 LLMs (e.g., Claude sonnet 4.5) on SecureVibeBench. Results show that current agents struggle to produce both correct and secure code, as even the best-performing one, produces merely 23.8% correct and secure solutions on SecureVibeBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的代码代理正在迅速改变软件工程领域，然而其生成代码的安全风险已成为一个关键问题。现有的基准测试提供了宝贵的见解，但它们无法涵盖由人类开发者实际引入漏洞的情况，因此很难进行人类与代理之间的公平比较。为此，我们推出了SecureVibeBench这一基准测试，该测试包含来自OSS-Fuzz中41个项目的105个C/C++安全编码任务。SecureVibeBench具有以下特点：(i) 真实的任务设置，需要在大规模代码库中进行多文件编辑；(ii) 基于现实世界开源漏洞的情境设定，并明确指出了漏洞引入点；(iii) 综合评估功能测试与安全检查，同时利用静态和动态信息来进行评估。我们在SecureVibeBench上对5种流行的代码代理进行了测试，这些代理得到了5种大语言模型的支持，例如Claude sonnet 4.5。结果表明，目前的代码代理在生成正确且安全的代码方面存在困难，即使是最优秀的代理，在SecureVibeBench上的正确和安全解决方案比例也仅为23.8%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Text-Guided Multi-Scale Frequency Representation Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 文本引导的多尺度频率表示自适应算法
papers.authors: Weicai Yan, Xinhua Ma, Wang Lin, Tao Jin
papers.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods introduce a small number of training parameters, enabling pre-trained models to adapt rapidly to new data distributions. While these methods have shown promising results, they exhibit notable limitations. First, most existing methods operate in the signal space domain, which results in substantial information redundancy. Second, most existing methods utilize fixed prompts or adaptation layers, failing to fully account for the multi-scale characteristics of signals. To address these challenges, we propose the Multi-Scale Frequency Adapter (FreqAdapter), which integrates textual information and performs multi-scale fine-tuning of visual signal in the frequency domain. Additionally, we introduce a multi-scale adaptation strategy to optimize receptive fields across different frequency ranges, further enhancing the model’s representational capacity. Extensive experiments on multimodal models, including CLIP and LLaVA, demonstrate that FreqAdapter significantly improves both performance and efficiency. FreqAdapter improves performance with minimal cost and fast convergence within one epoch.
papers.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调方法引入的训练参数数量较少，使得预训练模型能够快速适应新的数据分布。虽然这些方法取得了令人满意的效果，但它们也存在一些明显的局限性。首先，大多数现有方法都是在信号空间域中进行操作的，这导致了大量的信息冗余。其次，大多数现有方法使用固定的提示或自适应层，无法充分考虑到信号的多尺度特性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了多尺度频率适配器（FreqAdapter），该算法将文本信息整合进来，并在频率域中对视觉信号进行多尺度微调。此外，我们还引入了多尺度自适应策略，以优化不同频率范围内的感受野，从而进一步提升模型的表征能力。在包括CLIP和LLaVA在内的多模态模型上的广泛实验表明，FreqAdapter显著提升了模型的性能和效率。该算法以最小的成本提升了性能，并且在一个时代内就能实现快速收敛。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ADAPT: Benchmarking Commonsense Planning under Unspecified Affordance Constraints
papers.title_zh: 适应性：在未知约束条件下进行常规规划的比较分析
papers.authors: Pei-An Chen, Yongching Liang, Jia-Fong Yeh, Hung-Ting Su, Yi-Ting Chen, Min Sun, Winston H. Hsu
papers.abstract: Intelligent embodied agents should not simply follow instructions, as real-world environments often involve unexpected conditions and exceptions. However, existing methods usually focus on directly executing instructions, without considering whether the target objects can actually be manipulated, meaning they fail to assess available affordances. To address this limitation, we introduce DynAfford, a benchmark that evaluates embodied agents in dynamic environments where object affordances may change over time and are not specified in the instruction. DynAfford requires agents to perceive object states, infer implicit preconditions, and adapt their actions accordingly. To enable this capability, we introduce ADAPT (Affordance-Driven Adaptive Planning and Task execution), a plug-and-play module that augments existing planners with explicit affordance reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating ADAPT significantly improves robustness and task success across both seen and unseen environments. We also show that a domain-adapted, LoRA-finetuned vision-language model used as the affordance inference backend outperforms a commercial LLM (GPT-4o), highlighting the importance of task-aligned affordance grounding.
papers.abstract_zh: 智能的实体化代理不应仅仅遵循指令，因为现实世界中的环境往往包含各种意外情况和例外情况。然而，现有的方法通常只专注于直接执行指令，而没有考虑目标对象是否真的可以被操控，这意味着它们无法评估可用的功能特性。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了DynAfford这一基准测试，该测试用于在动态环境中评估实体化代理的行为，在这些环境中，对象的 기능特性可能会随时间发生变化，且并未在指令中明确说明。DynAfford要求代理能够感知对象的状态，推断隐含的前提条件，并相应地调整自己的行为。为了实现这一能力，我们引入了ADAPT（基于功能特性的自适应规划和任务执行）模块，该模块可以轻松地为现有的规划器添加明确的功能特性推理功能。实验表明，引入ADAPT显著提高了代理在可见和不可见环境中的鲁棒性和任务完成率。此外，我们还展示了一种针对特定领域进行优化的、经过LoRA微调的视觉-语言模型作为功能特性推理后端时，其性能优于商业大语言模型GPT-4o，这凸显了与任务相关的功能特性推理的重要性。

papers.title: GeoRA: Geometry-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation for RLVR
papers.title_zh: GeoRA：基于几何信息的低秩适应方法，适用于RLVR任务
papers.authors: Jiaying Zhang, Lei Shi, Jiguo Li, Jun Xu, Jiuchong Gao, Jinghua Hao, Renqing He
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a key paradigm for improving large-scale reasoning models. Unlike supervised fine-tuning (SFT), RLVR exhibits distinct optimization dynamics and are sensitive to the preservation of pre-trained geometric structures. However, existing parameter-efficient methods face key limitations in this regime. Low-rank adaptation methods, such as PiSSA, are primarily designed for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and do not account for the distinct optimization dynamics and geometric structures of RLVR. Conversely, directly fine-tuning the unstructured sparse parameter subspace favored by RLVR encounters efficiency bottlenecks on modern hardware. To address these challenges, we propose GeoRA (Geometry-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation), a low-rank adaptation method tailored for RLVR. Specifically, GeoRA exploits the anisotropic and compressible structure of RL update subspace, and extracts its principal directions via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to initialize low-rank adapters, while freezing residual components as a structural anchor during training. This design preserves the pre-trained structure and enables efficient dense computation. Experiments on Qwen and Llama models from 1.5B to 32B parameters show that GeoRA consistently outperforms strong low-rank baselines across RLVR settings in mathematics, medicine, and coding, while showing stronger generalization and less forgetting on out-of-domain tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是一种用于改进大规模推理模型的关键方法。与监督式微调（SFT）不同，RLVR具有独特的优化特性，并且对保留预训练后的几何结构非常敏感。然而，现有的参数高效方法在应对这种需求时存在明显局限。低秩适应方法，如PiSSA，主要适用于监督式微调，无法适应RLVR的独特优化特性和几何结构。相反，直接对RLVR所青睐的无结构稀疏参数子空间进行微调，在现代硬件上会导致效率瓶颈。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了GeoRA——一种专为RLVR设计的低秩适应方法。具体来说，GeoRA利用RL更新子空间的各向异性和可压缩特性，通过奇异值分解提取其主要方向，以初始化低秩适配器；同时，在训练过程中将残差组件作为结构锚点固定下来。这种设计能够保留预训练的结构，从而实现高效的密集计算。在Qwen和Llama模型上进行的大量实验表明，从1.5B到32B参数的模型中，GeoRA在多个领域（包括数学、医学和编程）的表现均优于其他强大的低秩基线方法，同时在跨领域任务上的泛化能力更强，遗忘率也更低。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: KoCo: Conditioning Language Model Pre-training on Knowledge Coordinates
papers.title_zh: KoCo：在知识坐标上对语言模型进行预训练的过程
papers.authors: Yudong Li, Jiawei Cai, Linlin Shen
papers.abstract: Standard Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training typically treats corpora as flattened token sequences, often overlooking the real-world context that humans naturally rely on to contextualize information. To bridge this gap, we introduce Knowledge Coordinate Conditioning (KoCo), a simple method that maps every document into a three-dimensional semantic coordinate. By prepending these coordinates as textual prefixes for pre-training, we aim to equip the model with explicit contextual awareness to learn the documents within the real-world knowledge structure. Experiment results demonstrate that KoCo significantly enhances performance across 10 downstream tasks and accelerates pre-training convergence by approximately 30%. Furthermore, our analysis indicates that explicitly modeling knowledge coordinates helps the model distinguish stable facts from noise, effectively mitigating hallucination in generated outputs.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准的大语言模型（LLM）预训练通常将文本数据视为扁平化的标记序列，而忽略了人类在理解信息时所依赖的现实世界背景。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了知识坐标条件化技术（KoCo），这是一种简单的方法，可以将每个文档映射到一个三维的语义坐标系统中。通过在预训练过程中将这些坐标作为文本前缀添加进去，我们希望让模型具备明确的上下文感知能力，从而能够在实际知识结构中学习到文档的内容。实验结果表明，KoCo显著提升了10个下游任务的性能，并将预训练的收敛速度提高了约30%。此外，我们的分析表明，明确建模知识坐标有助于模型区分稳定事实和噪声，有效减少了生成输出中的幻觉现象。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Truth or Sophistry? LoFa: A Benchmark for LLM Robustness Against Logical Fallacies
papers.title_zh: 真理还是诡辩？洛法：评估大型语言模型抵御逻辑谬误能力的基准测试
papers.authors: Xudong Shen, li Yuan, Ye Chen, Xin Wu, Yi Cai, Zhiyong Wu
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic capabilities, their resilience to manipulative linguistic patterns such as logical fallacies remains an underexplored area. Prior work has focused on the ability of LLMs to identify or classify fallacies, but their robustness against these fallacies in persuasive contexts remains largely unexplored.To address this gap, we introduce LoFa (Logical Fallacy), a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate LLM robustness against fallacies. We first construct the LoFa dataset via a multi-agent pipeline, pairing factual questions with fallacious arguments. Then, we develop a multi-round debate framework to assess model resilience under sustained attacks.Furthermore, to disentangle robustness from a model’s inherent knowledge limitations, we propose a new metric, LFR@k (Logical Fallacy Resistance), to quantify performance. Our experiments reveal that different LLMs exhibit varied robustness to distinct types of fallacies, highlighting unique vulnerability profiles across models.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型具备强大的语义处理能力，但其在面对诸如逻辑谬误等操纵性语言模式时的韧性仍然是一个尚未充分研究的领域。以往的研究主要集中在评估语言模型识别或分类谬误的能力上，而它们在具有说服力的语境下对这类谬误的抵御能力则大多未被探索。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了LoFa（逻辑谬误）这一综合基准测试，用于评估语言模型对谬误的抵抗力。我们首先通过多智能体流程构建LoFa数据集，将事实性问题与谬误论点进行配对。随后，我们开发了一个多轮辩论框架，以评估模型在持续攻击下的韧性。此外，为了将模型的韧性与其固有的知识局限性区分开来，我们提出了一种新的度量指标LFR@k（逻辑谬误抵抗力），以量化性能表现。我们的实验表明，不同的语言模型对不同类型的谬误表现出不同的韧性，从而揭示了各模型独特的脆弱性特征。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Merging Triggers, Breaking Backdoors: Defensive Poisoning for Instruction-Tuned Language Models
papers.title_zh: 合并触发条件、打破后门机制：用于防御性毒化的指令调优语言模型
papers.authors: San Kim, Gary Lee
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have greatly advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP), particularly through instruction tuning, which enables broad task generalization without additional fine-tuning. However, their reliance on large-scale datasets—often collected from human or web sources—makes them vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where adversaries poison a small subset of data to implant hidden behaviors. Despite this growing risk, defenses for instruction-tuned models remain underexplored. We propose MB-Defense (Merging & Breaking Defense Framework), a novel training pipeline that immunizes instruction-tuned LLMs against diverse backdoor threats. MB-Defense comprises two stages: (i) Defensive Poisoning, which merges attacker and defensive triggers into a unified backdoor representation, and (ii) Backdoor Neutralization, which breaks this representation through additional training to restore clean behavior. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs show that MB-Defense substantially lowers attack success rates while preserving instruction-following ability. Our method offers a generalizable and data-efficient defense strategy, improving the robustness of instruction-tuned LLMs against unseen backdoor attacks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）极大地推动了自然语言处理技术的发展，尤其是在指令调优方面。这种调优方式使得模型能够在无需额外微调的情况下实现广泛的任务泛化能力。然而，这些模型依赖于大规模的数据集——这些数据通常来自人类或网络来源——因此它们容易受到后门攻击的威胁。在这种攻击中，攻击者会选择性地篡改部分数据，以植入隐藏的行为机制。尽管存在这样的风险，但针对指令调优模型的防御措施仍然没有得到充分研究。我们提出了MB-Defense框架，这是一种新颖的训练方法，能够保护指令调优的LLM免受各种后门攻击的侵害。MB-Defense包含两个阶段：(i) 防御性毒害，它将攻击者和防御性触发因素合并为统一的后门表示；(ii) 后门中和，通过额外的训练来破坏这种表示，从而恢复模型的正常行为。在多个LLM上的广泛实验表明，MB-Defense能够有效降低攻击的成功率，同时保留模型遵循指令的能力。我们的方法提供了一种具有通用性和高效性的防御策略，提高了指令调优LLM对未知后门攻击的抵御能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SHAPE: Stage-aware Hierarchical Advantage via Potential Estimation for LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: SHAPE：基于潜在估计的舞台感知分层优势算法，用于大型语言模型推理
papers.authors: Zhengyang Ai, Zikang Shan, Xiaodong Ai, Jingxian Tang, Hangkai Hu, Pinyan Lu
papers.abstract: Process supervision has emerged as a promising approach for enhancing LLM reasoning, yet existing methods fail to distinguish meaningful progress from mere verbosity, leading to limited reasoning capabilities and unresolved token inefficiency. To address this, we propose Stage-aware Hierarchical Advantage via Potential Estimation (SHAPE), a framework that formalizes reasoning as a trajectory through a state space of empirical solvability. SHAPE introduces a hierarchical credit assignment mechanism: at the segment level, it employs a stage-aware advantage function to prioritize efficient breakthroughs in low-potential states; at the token level, it utilizes entropy-driven redistribution to sharpen execution signals. Extensive experiments in math reasoning across three base models and five benchmarks demonstrate that SHAPE achieves an average accuracy gain of 3% with 30% reduced token consumption.
papers.abstract_zh: 过程监督已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的方法无法区分有意义的进步与单纯的冗长表达，这导致推理能力有限，且存在未解决的标记效率问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“基于阶段感知的层次式优势分配”的框架——通过潜在估计来实现这一过程。该框架将推理过程抽象为在经验可解性状态空间中的轨迹移动。SHAPE采用了一种分层式的优势分配机制：在片段级别，它使用基于阶段的优势函数来优先处理低潜力状态下的高效突破；在标记级别，它利用熵驱动的重新分配机制来强化执行信号。在三个基础模型和五个测试集上的数学推理实验中，我们发现SHAPE平均提升了3%的准确率，同时减少了30%的标记消耗。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Looking Beyond the One: Operationalizing and Eliciting Visual Ambiguity in VLLMs
papers.title_zh: 超越单一维度：在视觉多模态记忆模型中实现和利用视觉歧义性
papers.authors: Yuchong Chen, Bowei Zou, Yuhan Chen, Yifan Fan, Xinyu Li, Shujun Cao, Yu Hong
papers.abstract: Visual questions are often ambiguous: the same image–question pair may admit multiple valid answers depending on which region is referenced. However, current Visual Question Answering (VQA) systems typically collapse this ambiguity, committing to a single interpretation during decoding and evaluation. In this work, we study visual question ambiguity from a grounded, region-centric perspective. We operationalize ambiguity as the existence of multiple distinct answer-supporting regions in an image, each independently yielding a valid answer. This formulation makes ambiguity observable without requiring exhaustive multi-answer annotations. Based on this definition, we conduct a systematic empirical study of state-of-the-art Visual Large Language Models (VLLMs). We find that, under default decoding, VLLMs consistently under-report ambiguity—even when multiple valid visual groundings are present. Importantly, probing model hidden states reveals that ambiguity-related signals are already encoded in their internal representations, despite not being reliably expressed in outputs. Finally, we show that selectively activating multi-focus answering based on these signals can recover additional valid answers while avoiding excessive hallucination. Together, our results suggest that ambiguity in VQA is not merely an annotation artifact or capability limitation, but a property that VLLMs internally recognize yet often fail to surface under standard decoding assumptions.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉问题往往具有模糊性：同一图像问题可能对应多个有效答案，这取决于所参考的区域。然而，目前的视觉问答系统通常会消除这种模糊性，在解码和评估过程中只采用一种解释。在这项研究中，我们从基于具体区域的视角来研究视觉问题的模糊性。我们将模糊性定义为图像中存在多个不同的答案支持区域，每个区域都能独立地产生一个有效答案。这种定义方式使得模糊性可以被观察到，而无需进行详尽的多答案注释工作。基于这一定义，我们对最先进的视觉大语言模型进行了系统的实证研究。我们发现，在默认的解码方式下，这些模型总是低估了模糊性的存在——即使存在多个有效的视觉依据。重要的是，通过探究模型的隐藏状态，我们发现与模糊性相关的信号已经编码在它们的内部表示中，尽管这些信号在输出中并不被可靠地表达出来。最后，我们表明，根据这些信号选择性地激活多焦点回答功能，可以在避免过度幻觉的同时恢复额外的有效答案。总的来说，我们的结果表明，视觉问答中的模糊性并非仅仅是注释上的缺陷或能力限制，而是视觉大语言模型内部能够识别的一种特性，但在标准的解码假设下却常常无法显现出来。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: JanusMM: A Benchmark for Self-Deprecation Understanding in Real-World Multimodal Conversations
papers.title_zh: JanusMM：用于现实世界多模态对话中自我贬低现象理解的基准模型
papers.authors: Xinyi Xu, Bingguang Hao, Yongyi Xiong, Zimo Chen, Xinchen Liu, Hongxin Guo, Xuelong Wang, Silin Zhou, Shihan Dou
papers.abstract: Self-deprecation is a prevalent communicative strategy in human society, often using image-text interplay to express emotions and intentions. Despite self-deprecation is widespread in real-world conversations, the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to understand it remains underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce JanusMM, the first benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs’ understanding of self-deprecation in real-world conversations. JanusMM contains 2,016 bilingual memes from three types of social interactions and provides a dual-task evaluation framework with six new metrics. The first task assesses MLLMs’ abilities in self-deprecation recognition and reasoning, while the second task evaluates the consistency of their understanding by simulating the perspectives of the initiator and responder. We evaluate ten frontier MLLMs and find that they exhibit weak recognition and reasoning abilities, with their understanding of self-deprecation remaining inconsistent across both perspectives.
papers.abstract_zh: 自我贬低是人类社会中一种常见的沟通策略，通常通过图像与文本的结合来表达情感和意图。尽管自我贬低在现实世界的对话中非常普遍，但多模态大语言模型对其的理解能力却尚未得到充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了JanusMM——首个用于评估大语言模型对现实世界对话中自我贬低现象理解能力的基准测试。JanusMM包含了2,016个来自三种社交互动的双语模因，并提供了一个包含六项新指标的双重任务评估框架。第一项任务旨在评估大语言模型在自我贬低识别与推理方面的能力，而第二项任务则通过模拟发起者和回应者的视角来评估其理解的一致性。我们对十种前沿的大语言模型进行了评估，发现它们的自我贬低识别与推理能力较弱，且在不同视角下的理解也表现出不一致性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Attention as Selector: Unlocking VLM Attention for Long Document Page Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 请注意：选择器功能的解锁，用于检索长文档中的特定页面内容
papers.authors: Minfeng Zhu, Linxin Bao, Wei Chen, Linchao Zhu
papers.abstract: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have become a robust foundation for document question answering. Processing long documents remains challenging due to limited context windows and computational budgets. Existing page-level retrieval methods offer a practical solution, typically encoding pages and queries into vectors and ranking them via cosine similarity. However, such embedding-based methods (i) lack query–page interaction before similarity scoring and (ii) usually require large-scale datasets to align visual and textual embeddings. In this paper, we observe that the cross-modal attention maps of well-trained VLMs are able to highlight semantically relevant regions. Building on this insight, we present CAPS (Cross-modal Attention as Page Selector), a retrieval framework that utilizes attention mechanisms inside VLMs for page selection. Specifically, CAPS first enhances attention-based retrieval capability with a small amount of contrastive data, then identifies the most effective attention head through expert head selection, and finally employs an adaptive filtering mechanism to obtain an appropriate number of relevant page candidates. Extensive experiments on four long-document benchmarks demonstrate that CAPS outperforms state-of-the-art embedding-based methods in both retrieval precision and downstream DocQA accuracy. Notably, CAPS achieves these gains using less than 10% of the training data required by competing baselines, highlighting the data efficiency of attention-based page retrieval.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型已成为文档问答领域的重要基础。然而，由于上下文窗口有限以及计算资源限制，处理长文档仍然具有挑战性。现有的页面级检索方法提供了一种实用的解决方案，通常通过将页面和查询编码为向量，并通过余弦相似度进行排序。不过，这类基于嵌入的方法存在以下问题：首先，在进行相似度评分之前，缺乏查询与页面的交互信息；其次，通常需要大规模数据集来对齐视觉信息和文本信息的嵌入方式。在本文中，我们发现经过良好训练的视觉语言模型的跨模态注意力图能够突出语义相关的区域。基于这一发现，我们提出了CAPS（作为页面选择器的跨模态注意力机制）这一检索框架。该框架利用视觉语言模型中的注意力机制来进行页面选择。具体来说，CAPS首先通过少量对比数据来增强基于注意力的检索能力，然后通过专家选择来确定最有效的注意力头，最后采用自适应过滤机制来获取适当数量的相关页面候选项。在四个长文档基准测试上的广泛实验表明，CAPS在检索精度以及下游文档问答任务的准确性方面均优于现有的基于嵌入的方法。值得注意的是，CAPS仅使用了竞争基线所需的不到10%的训练数据就能取得这样的效果，这充分体现了基于注意力的页面检索在数据利用方面的高效性。

papers.title: LAMCL: A Length-aware Momentum Contrastive Learning Framework for Multiscale Machine-Revised Text Detection
papers.title_zh: LAMCL：一种基于长度感知的动量对比学习框架，适用于多尺度机器改进文本检测任务
papers.authors: Bing Zhou, Zhe Huang, Shilei Tan, Kai Zhao, Zhou Yongcheng
papers.abstract: Detecting machine-revised text that exhibits subtle lexical differences from the original human-generated text remains a challenge. Recent detection methods, including watermarking-based, logit-based, and training-based models, struggle to capture the fine-grained semantic differences, especially for short texts. To address this issue, we propose Length-aware Momentum Contrastive Learning (LAMCL), a novel framework for multiscale machine-revised text detection that integrates two core modules. To enhance the discriminative semantic features, the Enhance Before Detection (EBD) module first fuses the original detected text with the counterpart processed by a Large Language Model (LLM), and then measures semantic consistency to distinguish between machine-revised and human-generated text. Meanwhile, based on the Momentum Contrastive Learning (MCL) framework, the Length-aware Weighting (LW) module leverages text length and label information for hard negative sampling, mitigating the ambiguity of short text attribution and boosting the robustness of representation learning. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms the existing detectors in identifying multiscale machine-revised text across diverse practical scenarios, tasks, and LLMs. The code is available at https://github.com/hangtze/LAMCL.
papers.abstract_zh: 检测那些与原始人类生成的文本存在细微词汇差异的机器修改文本仍然是一个挑战。最近的一些检测方法，包括基于水印、基于逻辑回归以及基于训练的模型，在捕捉细微的语义差异方面都存在困难，尤其是在处理短文本时。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“长度感知动量对比学习”的新框架。该框架整合了两个核心模块：首先，增强检测前模块会将原始检测到的文本与由大语言模型处理过的文本进行融合，然后测量语义一致性，以区分机器修改的文本和人类生成的文本；其次，基于动量对比学习框架的“长度感知加权”模块利用文本长度和标签信息进行硬负采样，从而减轻短文本归属的模糊性，并提高表示学习的鲁棒性。实验结果表明，我们的方法在识别不同实际场景、任务以及大语言模型下的多尺度机器修改文本方面，表现优于现有的检测器。代码可在https://github.com/hangtze/LAMCL获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Ascending the Infinite Ladder: Benchmarking Spatial Deformation Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 攀登无限之梯：视觉语言模型中空间变形推理的基准测试
papers.authors: Jiahuan Zhang, Shunwen Bai, Tianheng Wang, KaiWen Guo, Zijia Song, Hanqing WU, Guozheng Rao, Kai Han, Kaicheng Yu
papers.abstract: Humans naturally possess the spatial reasoning ability to form and manipulate images and structures of objects in space. There is an increasing effort to endow Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with similar spatial reasoning capabilities. However, it remains unclear whether these models truly understand and manipulate spatial objects or not. To address this question, we propose a new evaluation framework aimed at assessing the performance of VLMs in spatial deformation reasoning tasks. Specifically, we construct a benchmark for spatial deformation reasoning from 2D to 3D. We explore whether the model can effectively perform spatial deformation reasoning from two directions: forward reasoning (given the operations, find the final state) and reverse reasoning (given the final state, determine the operations). We adopt a ladder competition format, using the number of deformation steps as the level classification criterion, with the goal of exploring the boundaries of the model’s deformation reasoning capabilities. Interestingly, the benchmarking results reveal that almost no model demonstrates plausible spatial deformation reasoning abilities. Furthermore, even after applying targeted training and mainstream reasoning enhancement methods, the models are still unable to perform well on 3D spatial deformation reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类天生具备对空间中物体图像和结构的空间推理能力。目前，越来越多的研究致力于让视觉语言模型也拥有类似的空间推理能力。然而，目前仍不清楚这些模型是否真正能够理解和操控空间中的物体。为了解答这个问题，我们提出了一个新的评估框架，用于评估视觉语言模型在空间变形推理任务中的表现。具体来说，我们构建了一个从二维到三维的空间变形推理基准测试。我们探讨了模型是否能够有效执行两种方向的空间变形推理：正向推理（给定操作，找出最终状态）和反向推理（给定最终状态，确定操作）。我们采用阶梯式竞赛的形式，以变形步骤的数量作为等级分类的标准，目的是探索模型在变形推理能力方面的极限。有趣的是，基准测试结果显示，几乎没有模型展现出合理的空间变形推理能力。此外，即使经过有针对性的训练和主流推理增强处理，这些模型仍然无法在三维空间变形推理方面取得良好的表现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Safe-FedLLM: Delving into the Safety of Federated Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: Safe-FedLLM：探究联邦式大型语言模型的安全性问题
papers.authors: Mingxiang Tao, Yu Tian, Wenxuan Tu, Yue Yang, Xue Yang, Xiangyan Tang
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) addresses privacy and data-silo issues in the training of large language models (LLMs). Most prior work focuses on improving the efficiency of federated learning for LLMs (FedLLM). However, security in open federated environments, particularly defenses against malicious clients, remains underexplored. To investigate the security of FedLLM, we conduct a preliminary study to analyze potential attack surfaces and defensive characteristics from the perspective of LoRA updates. We find two key properties of FedLLM: 1) LLMs are vulnerable to attacks from malicious clients in FL, and 2) LoRA updates exhibit distinct behavioral patterns that can be effectively distinguished by lightweight classifiers. Based on these properties, we propose Safe-FedLLM, a probe-based defense framework for FedLLM, which constructs defenses across three levels: Step-Level, Client-Level, and Shadow-Level. The core concept of Safe-FedLLM is to perform probe-based discrimination on each client’s local LoRA updates, treating them as high-dimensional behavioral features and using a lightweight classifier to determine whether they are malicious. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Safe-FedLLM effectively improves FedLLM’s robustness against malicious clients while maintaining competitive performance on benign data. Notably, our method effectively suppresses the impact of malicious data without significantly affecting training speed, and remains effective even under high malicious client ratios.
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦学习（FL）在训练大语言模型（LLM）时解决了隐私和数据隔离问题。目前大多数研究都致力于提高联邦学习在LLM上的效率。然而，在开放的联邦环境中保障安全性，尤其是防御恶意客户端的问题，仍然没有得到充分研究。为了探究联邦学习的安全性，我们进行了初步研究，从LoRA更新的角度分析了潜在的攻击面和防御特性。我们发现联邦学习有两个关键特性：1）在联邦学习中，LLM容易受到恶意客户端的攻击；2）LoRA更新表现出独特的行为模式，这些模式可以通过轻量级分类器有效识别。基于这些特性，我们提出了Safe-FedLLM——一种基于探测的防御框架。该框架构建了三个层次的防御机制：步骤级、客户端级和影子级。Safe-FedLLM的核心思想是对每个客户端的本地LoRA更新进行探测性区分，将其视为高维行为特征，并使用轻量级分类器来判断其是否为恶意数据。大量实验表明，Safe-FedLLM能够有效提升联邦学习对恶意客户端的抵御能力，同时保持良好的性能表现。值得注意的是，我们的方法能够有效抑制恶意数据的影响，而不会显著影响训练速度，即使在恶意客户端比例较高的情况下也能保持有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TEMA: Anchor the Image, Follow the Text for Multi-Modification Composed Image Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 主题：通过固定图像来匹配文本，实现多模态图像检索
papers.authors: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiheng Fu, Zhiwei Chen, Yongqi Li, Liqiang Nie
papers.abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is an important image retrieval paradigm that enables users to retrieve a target image using a multimodal query that consists of a reference image and modification text. Although research on CIR has made significant progress, prevailing setups still rely simple modification texts that typically cover only a limited range of salient changes, which induces two limitations highly relevant to practical applications, namely Insufficient Entity Coverage and Clause-Entity Misalignment. In order to address these issues and bring CIR closer to real-world use, we construct two instruction-rich multi-modification datasets, M-FashionIQ and M-CIRR. In addition, we propose TEMA, the Text-oriented Entity Mapping Architecture, which is the first CIR framework designed for multi-modification while also accommodating simple modifications. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that TEMA’s superiority in both original and multi-modification scenarios, while maintaining an optimal balance between retrieval accuracy and computational efficiency. Our codes and constructed multi-modification dataset (M-FashionIQ and M-CIRR) are available at https://github.com/lee-zixu/ACL26-TEMA/
papers.abstract_zh: 复合图像检索（CIR）是一种重要的图像检索方法，它允许用户通过包含参考图像和修改文本的多模态查询来检索目标图像。尽管关于CIR的研究已经取得了显著进展，但现有的系统仍然依赖于简单的修改文本，这些文本通常只能覆盖有限范围内的显著变化，这导致了两个与实际应用密切相关的缺陷：实体覆盖范围不足以及条款与实体的不匹配问题。为了解决这些问题并让CIR更接近实际应用场景，我们构建了两个富含指令的多模修改数据集：M-FashionIQ和M-CIRR。此外，我们还提出了TEMA——一种以文本为导向的实体映射架构，这是首个专为多模修改设计而开发的CIR框架，同时还能处理简单的修改请求。在四个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，TEMA在原始数据和多模修改场景中都表现出卓越性能，同时能够在检索准确性和计算效率之间实现最佳平衡。我们的代码以及构建的多模修改数据集（M-FashionIQ和M-CIRR）可以在https://github.com/lee-zixu/ACL26-TEMA/获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ImCoref-CeS: An Improved Lightweight Pipeline for Coreference Resolution with LLM-based Checker-Splitter Refinement
papers.title_zh: ImCoref-CeS：一种改进的轻量级处理流程，用于基于大语言模型的共指消解任务。该流程采用了检查器-分割器优化技术
papers.authors: Kangyang Luo, Yuzhuo Bai, Shuzheng Si, Cheng Gao, Zhitong Wang, Yingli Shen, Wenhao Li, Zhu Liu, Yufeng Han, Jiayi Wu, Cunliang Kong, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Coreference Resolution (CR) is a critical task in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Current research faces a key dilemma: whether to further explore the potential of supervised neural methods based on small language models, whose detect-then-cluster pipeline still delivers top performance, or embrace the powerful capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, effectively combining their strengths remains underexplored. To this end, we propose ImCoref-CeS, a novel framework that integrates an enhanced supervised model with LLM-based reasoning. First, we present an improved CR method (ImCoref) to push the performance boundaries of the supervised neural method by introducing a lightweight bridging module to enhance long-text encoding capability, devising a biaffine scorer to comprehensively capture positional information, and invoking a hybrid mention regularization to improve training efficiency. Importantly, we employ an LLM acting as a multi-role Checker-Splitter agent to validate candidate mentions (filtering out invalid ones) and coreference results (splitting erroneous clusters) predicted by ImCoref. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ImCoref-CeS, which achieves superior performance compared to existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 共指消解是自然语言处理领域的一项关键任务。当前的研究面临一个重要难题：是继续探索基于小型语言模型的监督式神经方法的潜力，这些方法的检测-聚类流程仍然能够取得优异的性能，还是采用大语言模型的强大功能。然而，如何有效结合这两种方法的优势目前尚未得到充分研究。为此，我们提出了ImCoref-CeS这一新型框架，该框架将改进的监督式模型与基于大语言模型的推理能力相结合。首先，我们提出了一种改进型的共指消解方法（ImCoref），通过引入轻量级桥梁模块来提升长文本编码能力，设计双缓冲评分器以全面捕捉位置信息，并采用混合提及正则化方法来提高训练效率。重要的是，我们使用大语言模型作为多角色的检查者-分割器代理，来验证ImCoref预测出的候选提及项（过滤掉无效的提及项）以及共指结果（分割出错误的聚类）。大量实验证明了ImCoref-CeS的有效性，其性能优于现有的最先进方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When Efficiency Meets Safety: A Benchmark Security Analysis of KV Cache Compression in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 效率与安全的结合：对大型语言模型中KV缓存压缩技术的安全分析
papers.authors: Xiaoxiao Ma, Kuofeng Gao, Zeyi Lu, Wenxi Jiang, Hao Fang, Hao Wu, Bin Chen, Shu-Tao Xia
papers.abstract: Key-Value (KV) caching is widely used in large language models (LLMs) to enable long-context inference efficiently, yet its security implications remain underexplored. We present the first systematic study of how KV cache compression interacts with jailbreak attacks, evaluating four model families under diverse jailbreak attacks. We identify a double-edged effect: (i) on one hand, compression can induce Accidental Robustness, where optimization-based and encoding-based attacks fail due to Malicious Semantic Eviction, where attacks’ own attention redirection reduces the malicious query’s cache importance, and Gradient Mismatch where discrete compression operations break jailbreak optimization. (ii) On the other hand, Vulnerability Paradox arises under merging-based compression for human-designed Attacks, where aggressive merging in shallow layers triggers functional head collapse, amplifying attack success rates. To address this, we propose Safe-CAM, a history-aware, per-head feedback merging strategy that prevents safety degradation while maintaining efficiency. Experiments show Safe-CAM fully restores safety (0% ASR) and improves benign task performance with minimal overhead. Our study highlights that KV cache compression is not only an efficiency mechanism but also a safety-critical design factor in LLM deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 键值（KV）缓存在大语言模型（LLM）中被广泛运用，以实现高效的长上下文推理。然而，其安全影响方面仍缺乏深入研究。我们首次系统研究了KV缓存压缩与越狱攻击之间的相互作用，对四种不同的模型家族在多种越狱攻击下的表现进行了评估。我们发现了一个双刃剑效应：(1) 一方面，缓存压缩可以产生偶然的鲁棒性，即基于优化的攻击和基于编码的攻击因“恶意语义驱逐”而失败：攻击自身重定向注意力，降低了恶意查询在缓存中的重要性；同时，缓存操作的离散性也会破坏越狱优化；(2) 另一方面，面对人工设计的攻击时，基于合并的压缩方式会出现“漏洞悖论”——在浅层进行激进的合并操作会触发功能性的头部崩溃，从而提升攻击的成功率。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了Safe-CAM策略，这是一种考虑历史数据的、针对每个注意力头的反馈合并策略，它能够在不降低效率的情况下保护系统的安全性。实验表明，Safe-CAM能够完全恢复系统的安全性（攻击成功率为 0%），并且能够以最小的开销提升良性任务的性能。我们的研究强调，KV缓存压缩不仅是一种效率机制，还是LLM部署中一个至关重要的安全设计因素。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: WebAggregator: Enhancing Compositional Reasoning Capabilities of Deep Research Agent Foundation Models
papers.title_zh: WebAggregator：提升深度研究代理基础模型的组合推理能力
papers.authors: Rui Wang, Ce Zhang, Jun-Yu Ma, Jianshu Zhang, Hongru Wang, Yi Chen, Boyang Xue, Tianqing Fang, Zhisong Zhang, Hongming Zhang, Haitao Mi, Dong Yu, Kam-Fai Wong
papers.abstract: The hallmark of Deep Research agents lies in compositional reasoning, the capacity to aggregate distributed, heterogeneous information into coherent logical insights. However, current agentic systems are often retrieval-heavy but reasoning-light, where success is predominantly determined by simple entity-seeking rather than the multi-step aggregation of scattered evidence. To address this, we propose a data synthesis pipeline WebAggregator, designed to shift the agentic paradigm from retrieval-centric to compositional aggregation. Our approach first employs Proactive Explorer to collect interconnected knowledge, then Compositional Logic Proposer to weave knowledge into complex questions using over 12 composition guidelines derived from a rigorous deconstruction of the Deep Research problem setting. Fine-tuning on this corpus fundamentally transforms agent behavior, fostering deliberate composition reasoning and reduced tool redundancy. The resulting WebAggregator-32B surpasses GPT-4.1 and matches Claude-3.7-Sonnet on GAIA, WebWalkerQA, and XBench. To address the lack of benchmarks that emphasize both reasoning and retrieval, we introduce the WebAggregatorQA testbed, which reveals that even with perfect retrieval, top-tier models still underperformed. These results demonstrate that compositional reasoning, not retrieval, is the true performance ceiling for next-generation research agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度研究智能体的核心特性在于组合推理能力，即能够将分散的、多样化的信息整合为连贯的逻辑见解。然而，目前的智能体系统往往侧重于信息检索，而推理能力相对较弱，其成功主要依赖于简单的实体搜索，而非对零散信息的多步骤整合。为了改善这一状况，我们提出了一种数据合成流程——WebAggregator，旨在将智能体的运作模式从以信息检索为中心转变为以组合推理为核心。我们的方法首先使用Proactive Explorer来收集相互关联的知识，然后利用Compositional Logic Proposer将这些知识编织成复杂的问题，这些问题的构建遵循了从深度研究问题设定中得出的12条组合规则。通过对这些数据进行微调，可以显著改变智能体的行为方式，促进有意识的组合推理，并减少工具间的冗余。经过改进的WebAggregator-32B在各项性能测试中均超越了GPT-4.1，并且在GAIA、WebWalkerQA和XBench上的表现与Claude-3.7-Sonnet相当。为了解决缺乏同时强调推理和检索的基准测试这一问题，我们引入了WebAggregatorQA测试平台。该平台表明，即使具备完美的检索能力，顶级模型的表现仍然不尽如人意。这些结果表明，组合推理能力才是下一代研究智能体的真正性能上限，而非单纯的检索能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SEARL: Joint Optimization of Policy and Tool Graph Memory for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.title_zh: SEARL：针对自演化智能体的策略与工具图内存的联合优化
papers.authors: Xinshun Feng, Xinhao Song, Lijun Li, Gongshen Liu, Jing Shao
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have demonstrated significant potential in single-turn reasoning tasks. With the paradigm shift toward self-evolving agentic learning, models are increasingly expected to learn from trajectories by synthesizing tools or accumulating explicit experiences. However, prevailing methods typically rely on large-scale LLMs or multi-agent frameworks, which hinder their deployment in resource-constrained environments. The inherent sparsity of outcome-based rewards also poses a substantial challenge, as agents typically receive feedback only upon task completion. To address these limitations, we introduce a Tool-Memory based self-evolving agentic framework SEARL. Unlike approaches that directly utilize interaction experiences, our method constructs a structured experience memory that integrates planning with execution. This provides a novel form of state abstraction that facilitates the aggregation of actions within functionally analogous contexts, such as tool reuse. Consequently, agents not only extract explicit knowledge from historical data but also leverage inter-trajectory correlations to densify reward signals. We evaluate our framework on knowledge reasoning and complex search tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in achieving more practical and efficient agentic learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 在具有可验证奖励的强化学习领域的最新进展表明，该领域在单轮推理任务中具有巨大的潜力。随着向自我演化型智能体学习的范式转变，人们越来越期望模型能够通过合成工具或积累显性经验来学习行为轨迹。然而，目前主流的方法通常依赖于大规模的大语言模型或多智能体框架，这限制了它们在资源有限环境中的应用。基于结果的奖励方式所固有的稀疏性也带来了重大挑战，因为智能体通常只有在任务完成之后才能获得反馈。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种基于工具记忆的自我演化智能体框架SEARL。与那些直接利用交互经验的方法不同，我们的方法构建了一种结构化的经验记忆机制，将规划与执行相结合。这种新颖的状态抽象方式使得在功能相似的情境下聚合动作成为可能，例如工具的重复使用。因此，智能体不仅能够从历史数据中提取显性知识，还能利用不同轨迹之间的相关性来丰富奖励信号。我们在知识推理和复杂搜索任务上评估了我们的框架，结果表明它在实现更实用且高效的智能体学习方面表现出显著的效果。
