papers.title: Good Arguments Against the People Pleasers: How Reasoning Mitigates (Yet Masks) LLM Sycophancy
papers.title_zh: 有力的论据可以反驳那些只会阿谀奉承的人：理性思考虽然能够减轻（但依然无法完全消除）大型语言模型带来的谄媚行为
papers.authors: Zhaoxin Feng, Zheng Chen, Jianfei Ma, Yip Tin Po, Emmanuele Chersoni, Bo Li
papers.abstract: Alignment techniques often inadvertently induce sycophancy in LLMs. While prior studies studied this behaviour in direct-answer settings, the role of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning remains under-explored: does it serve as a logical constraint that mitigates sycophancy, or a tool for post-hoc rationalization that masks it? We evaluate a range of models across objective and subjective tasks to investigate the issue.Results show that reasoning generally reduces sycophancy in final decisions but also masks sycophancy in some samples, where models construct deceptive justifications through logical inconsistencies, calculation errors, and one-sided arguments etc. Furthermore, LLMs are more prone to sycophancy in subjective tasks and under authority-bias. Our mechanistic analysis reveals that the tendency of sycophancy in LLMs is dynamic during the reasoning process rather than being pre-determined at the input.
papers.abstract_zh: 对齐技术常常无意识地导致大语言模型产生阿谀奉承行为。虽然之前的研究已经探讨了这种行为在直接回答场景中的表现，但思维链推理在其中的作用却尚未得到充分研究：它究竟是作为一种能够减轻阿谀奉承行为的逻辑约束，还是一种用于事后合理化行为的工具呢？我们通过客观和主观任务对一系列模型进行了评估，以探究这个问题。结果表明，推理通常能够减少最终决策中的阿谀奉承行为，但在某些情况下，模型会通过逻辑矛盾、计算错误以及片面论证等方式来制造欺骗性的理由，从而掩盖阿谀奉承行为。此外，大语言模型在主观任务和存在权威偏见的情况下更容易出现阿谀奉承行为。我们的机制分析表明，大语言模型中阿谀奉承行为的倾向是在推理过程中动态变化的，而不是在输入阶段就预先确定的。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Can Persona-Prompted LLMs Emulate Subgroup Values? An Empirical Analysis of Generalisability and Fairness in Cultural Alignment
papers.title_zh: 基于Persona模型的大语言模型能否模拟特定群体的价值观？关于文化一致性中泛化能力及公平性的实证分析
papers.authors: Bryan Chen Zhengyu Tan, Zhengyuan Liu, Xiaoyuan Yi, Jing Yao, Xing Xie, Nancy F. Chen, Roy Ka-Wei Lee
papers.abstract: Despite their global prevalence, many Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to a monolithic, often Western-centric set of values. This paper investigates the more challenging task of fine-grained value alignment: examining whether LLMs can emulate the distinct cultural values of demographic subgroups. Using Singapore as a case study and the World Values Survey (WVS), we examine the value landscape and show that even state-of-the-art models like GPT-4.1 achieve only 57.4% accuracy in predicting subgroup modal preferences. We construct a dataset of over 20,000 samples to train and evaluate a range of models. We demonstrate that simple fine-tuning on structured numerical preferences yields substantial gains, improving accuracy on unseen, out-of-distribution subgroups by an average of 17.4%. These gains partially transfer to open-ended generation. However, we find significant pre-existing performance biases, where models better emulate young, male, Chinese, and Christian personas. Furthermore, while fine-tuning improves average performance, it widens the disparity between subgroups when measured by distance-aware metrics. Our work offers insights into the limits and fairness implications of subgroup-level cultural alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在全球范围内广泛存在，但许多这类模型都遵循着一套以西方为中心的价值观。本文探讨了更为复杂的细粒度价值对齐问题：即评估语言模型是否能够模拟不同人口群体的独特文化价值观。我们以新加坡为案例研究，并利用世界价值观调查数据来考察各种价值观的分布情况。研究发现，即使是像GPT-4.1这样先进的模型，在预测特定群体偏好方面也只能达到57.4%的准确率。我们构建了一个包含20,000个样本的数据集，用于训练和评估各种模型的表现。实验表明，对结构化数值偏好进行简单微调可以显著提高模型的性能，使得模型在未知领域的特定群体中的准确率平均提高17.4%。这些改进在一定程度上也体现在开放式生成任务上。然而，我们发现模型在模拟年轻男性、中国人和基督徒群体的偏好方面存在显著的性能偏差。此外，虽然微调可以提高模型的平均性能，但它却加剧了不同群体之间的差距。我们的研究揭示了在群体层面进行文化对齐时存在的局限性和公平性问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FoE: Forest of Errors Makes the First Solution the Best in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: FoE：错误之林使得在大规模推理模型中，某种解决方案成为了最佳选择
papers.authors: Kehan Jiang, Haonan Dong, Zhaolu Kang, Zhengzhou Zhu, Guojie Song
papers.abstract: Recent Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) like DeepSeek-R1 have demonstrated remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks, exhibiting human-like patterns in exploring multiple alternative solutions. Upon closer inspection, however, we uncover a surprising phenomenon: The First is The Best, where alternative solutions are not merely suboptimal but potentially detrimental. This observation challenges widely accepted test-time scaling laws, leading us to hypothesize that errors within the reasoning path scale concurrently with test time. Through comprehensive empirical analysis, we characterize errors as a forest-structured Forest of Errors (FoE) and conclude that FoE makes the First the Best, which is underpinned by rigorous theoretical analysis. Leveraging these insights, we propose RED, a self-guided efficient reasoning framework comprising two components: I) Refining First, which suppresses FoE growth in the first solution; and II) Discarding Subs, which prunes subsequent FoE via dual-consistency. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks and six backbone models demonstrate that RED outperforms eight competitive baselines, achieving performance gains of up to 19.0% while reducing token consumption by 37.7% 70.4%. Moreover, comparative experiments on FoE metrics shed light on how RED achieves effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的一些大型推理模型，如DeepSeek-R1，在复杂推理任务中取得了显著的成功，其处理多种替代解决方案的方式与人类非常相似。然而，经过仔细研究后，我们发现了一个令人惊讶的现象：第一个解往往是最优的，而其他替代方案不仅可能不够理想，甚至可能会带来负面影响。这一发现挑战了人们普遍接受的测试时间扩展规律，因此我们推测，推理过程中的错误数量会随着测试时间的增加而同步增长。通过全面的实证分析，我们将这些错误描述为“错误森林”，并得出结论：错误森林使得第一个解成为最佳选择，这一结论得到了严格的理论支持。基于这些见解，我们提出了RED这一自引导的高效推理框架，该框架包含两个组成部分：I) 优化第一个解，以抑制错误森林的增长；II) 剔除后续解，通过双重一致性机制来消除后续的错误森林。在五个基准测试和六个核心模型上的广泛实验表明，RED的表现优于八种竞争模型，其性能提升幅度高达19.0%，同时减少了 37.7%–70.4% 的词元消耗。此外，针对错误森林指标的对比实验进一步揭示了RED实现高效推理的机制。

papers.title: Lingua-Graph: A Unified Representation of Cross-Task Common Substructures for Analytic Language Processing
papers.title_zh: 语言图：一种用于分析性语言处理的多任务共同子结构的统一表示方式
papers.authors: Mingming Sun, Runze Jiang, Zhu Zhangchenxi, Minlong Peng, Yunfeng Cai
papers.abstract: Structural understanding of natural language requires explicit recovery of internal meaning structures (entities, facts, nested relations), yet current structural-analytic tasks are fragmented by inconsistent task requirements across datasets. We investigate the problem of robust cross-task structural understanding under heterogeneous requirements across structural-analytic tasks and outline a perspective called Analytic NLP in which tasks can be reformulated into a representation-then-decision paradigm. In this paper, we suggest a solution for the representation layer, called Lingua-Graph, which explicitly captures entities, facts, and relations. By representing predictions as explicit graphs with labeled nodes and edges, Lingua-Graph also improves interpretability, enabling transparent inspection and error analysis of intermediate meaning structures. We construct a labeled Lingua-Graph dataset and train a baseline parser. Experiments show that Lingua-Graph provides substantially higher entity-structure hostability than alternative representations on average, and OpenIE systems based on Lingua-Graph achieve superior performance on three benchmarks, demonstrating that better intermediate structures translate into downstream gains. The data, code and the trained model are publicly released at https://github.com/rudaoshi/Lingua.
papers.abstract_zh: 对自然语言的结构性理解需要明确恢复内部意义结构（实体、事实、嵌套关系）。然而，当前的结构分析任务由于不同数据集之间任务要求的不一致而变得支离破碎。我们研究了在结构分析任务之间存在异质要求的情况下实现稳健的跨任务结构性理解的问题，并提出了一种名为“分析型自然语言处理”的方法论，该方法将任务重新构建为“表示-决策”范式。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于表示的解决方案，称为Lingua-Graph。该方案能够明确捕获实体、事实和关系。通过将预测表示为带有标记节点和边的显式图，Lingua-Graph还提高了可解释性，使得可以透明地检查和分析中间的意义结构。我们构建了一个带有标签的Lingua-Graph数据集，并训练了一个基线解析器。实验表明，与替代表示方法相比，Lingua-Graph在表示实体结构方面具有显著的优势。基于Lingua-Graph的OpenIE系统在三个基准测试中的表现更为出色，这表明更好的中间结构可以转化为下游处理的优势。相关数据、代码和训练好的模型已公开发布，网址为https://github.com/rudaoshi/Lingua。

papers.title: Adaptive Spatial and Temporal Redundancy Optimization for Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 自适应空间和时间冗余优化，以实现大型语言模型中的高效推理
papers.authors: Tianle Chen, Pengyu Cheng, Qiyuan Zhu, Jiacheng Wang, Bei Liu, Hao Gu, Ruijie Shen, Xiaofeng Hou, Sirui Han, Jiacheng Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved exceptional performance in complex reasoning via Chain-of-Thought (CoT), yet the associated computational costs remain prohibitive. CoT reasoning contains significant untapped efficiency potential across two dimensions: temporal redundancy, where reasoning steps may be unnecessary, and spatial redundancy, where computations can be performed at reduced precision. While current optimization techniques often necessitate resource-intensive fine-tuning or data curation, we introduce ASTRO (Adaptive Spatial and Temporal Redundancy Optimization), a training-free framework that simultaneously addresses both dimensions. ASTRO leverages Dewey’s reflective thinking model to segment reasoning phases, applying a progressive precision reduction strategy coupled with an entropy-based confidence mechanism for adaptive termination. Empirical results across diverse reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ASTRO achieves up to an 11.3 \times efficiency gain without compromising accuracy, highlighting the advantages of holistic multi-dimensional redundancy management over isolated optimization methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂推理任务中取得了卓越的性能，但相关的计算成本仍然非常高。推理过程中存在两个方面的效率提升空间：时间冗余，即某些推理步骤可能是不必要的；空间冗余，即可以在较低精度下完成计算。虽然目前的优化技术通常需要大量的资源进行微调或数据处理，但我们提出了ASTRO（自适应空间和时间冗余优化）框架，该框架无需训练即可同时解决这两个问题。ASTRO利用Dewey的反思性思维模型来划分推理阶段，采用逐步降低精度的策略，并结合基于熵的置信度机制来实现自适应终止。通过多种推理基准测试的实验结果表明，ASTRO在保持准确性的前提下，效率提升了11.3倍，这充分证明了整体多维冗余管理相较于孤立优化方法的优势。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AAPO: Enhancing the Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs with Advantage Margin
papers.title_zh: AAPO：通过“优势边际”技术提升大语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Jian Xiong, Jingbo Zhou, Jingyong Ye, Qiang Huang, Dejing Dou
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as an effective approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), especially in scenarios where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) falls short due to limited chain-of-thought (CoT) data. Among RL-based post-training methods, group relative advantage estimation, as exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has attracted considerable attention for eliminating the dependency on the value model, thereby simplifying training compared to traditional approaches like Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). However, existing group relative advantage estimation method still suffers from training inefficiencies, particularly when the estimated advantage approaches zero. To address this limitation, we propose Advantage-Augmented Policy Optimization (AAPO), a novel RL algorithm that optimizes the cross-entropy (CE) loss using advantages enhanced through a margin-based estimation scheme. This approach effectively mitigates the inefficiencies associated with group relative advantage estimation. Experimental results on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model series demonstrate the superior performance of AAPO. Code is available at https://github.com/JianxXiong/AAPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的一种有效方法，尤其是在受监督的微调（SFT）因缺乏思维链数据而效果不佳的情况下。在基于RL的训练后方法中，群体相对优势估计技术，如群体相对策略优化（GRPO），因能摆脱对价值模型的依赖而受到广泛关注，这使得其训练过程比传统方法如近端策略优化（PPO）更为简单。然而，现有的群体相对优势估计方法仍然存在训练效率低下的问题，尤其是在估计出的优势接近零时。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了优势增强策略优化（AAPO）算法。该算法通过基于边际的估计方案来优化交叉熵损失，从而有效缓解与群体相对优势估计相关的效率问题。在多个数学推理基准测试和模型系列上的实验结果表明，AAPO具有出色的性能。相关代码可访问https://github.com/JianxXiong/AAPO。

papers.title: Outcome-Grounded Advantage Reshaping for Fine-Grained Credit Assignment in Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 基于结果的优势重塑方法，用于数学推理中的细致信用分配
papers.authors: Ziheng Li, Liu Kang, Feng Xiao, Luxi Xing, Qingyi Si, Zhuoran Li, Weikang Gong, Deqing Yang, Yanghua Xiao, Hongcheng Guo
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a promising critic-free reinforcement learning paradigm for reasoning tasks. However, standard GRPO employs a coarse-grained credit assignment mechanism that propagates group-level rewards uniformly to to every token in a sequence, neglecting the varying contribution of individual reasoning steps. We address this limitation by introducing Outcome-grounded Advantage Reshaping (OAR), a fine-grained credit assignment mechanism that redistributes advantages based on how much each token influences the model’s final answer. We instantiate OAR via two complementary strategies: (1) OAR-P, which estimates outcome sensitivity through counterfactual token perturbations, serving as a high-fidelity attribution signal; (2) OAR-G, which uses an input-gradient sensitivity proxy to approximate the influence signal with a single backward pass. These importance signals are integrated with a conservative Bi-Level advantage reshaping scheme that suppresses low-impact tokens and boosts pivotal ones while preserving the overall advantage mass. Empirical results on extensive mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that while OAR-P sets the performance upper bound, OAR-G achieves comparable gains with negligible computational overhead, both significantly outperforming a strong GRPO baseline, pushing the boundaries of critic-free LLM reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 群体相对策略优化（GRPO）作为一种无评论家的强化学习方法，在推理任务中表现出强大的潜力。然而，传统的GRPO采用了一种粗粒度信用分配机制，该机制将群体级别的奖励均匀分配给序列中的每个标记，而忽略了各个推理步骤的不同贡献。我们通过引入基于结果的优势重塑（OAR）机制来克服这一限制。OAR是一种细粒度的信用分配机制，它根据每个标记对模型最终答案的影响程度来重新分配优势。我们通过两种互补的策略来实现OAR：(1) OAR-P，它通过反事实标记扰动来估计结果的敏感性，从而提供高精度的归因信号；(2) OAR-G，它使用输入梯度敏感性代理来近似影响信号，只需一次反向传播即可实现。这些重要性信号与一种保守的两级优势重塑方案相结合，该方案能够抑制影响较小的标记，同时提升关键标记的效用，同时保持整体的优势总量。在广泛的数学推理基准测试中的实证结果表明，虽然OAR-P设定了性能的上限，但OAR-G在几乎不增加计算开销的情况下取得了相当不错的性能提升，其表现显著优于传统的GRPO基线算法，进一步拓展了无评论家LLM推理的边界。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Learning to Edit Knowledge via Instruction-based Chain-of-Thought Prompting
papers.title_zh: 通过基于指导的思维链提示来学习编辑知识
papers.authors: Jinhu Fu, Yan Bai, Longzhu He, Yihang Lou, Yanxiao Zhao, Li Sun, Sen Su
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can effectively handle outdated information through knowledge editing. However, current approaches face two key limitations: (I) Poor generalization: Most approaches rigidly inject new knowledge without ensuring that the model can use it effectively to solve practical problems. (II) Narrow scope: Current methods focus primarily on structured fact triples, overlooking the diverse unstructured forms of factual information (e.g., news, articles) prevalent in real-world contexts. To address these challenges, we propose a new paradigm: teaching LLMs to edit knowledge via Chain of Thoughts (CoTs) reasoning (CoT2Edit). We first leverage language model agents for both structured and unstructured edited data to generate CoTs, building high-quality instruction data. The model is then trained to reason over edited knowledge through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). At inference time, we integrate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to dynamically retrieve relevant edited facts for real-time knowledge editing. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves strong generalization across six diverse knowledge editing scenarios with just a single round of training on three open-source language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型可以通过知识编辑来有效处理过时信息。然而，当前的方法存在两个主要局限性：(I) 泛化能力较差：大多数方法只是机械地注入新知识，而没有确保模型能够有效地利用这些知识来解决实际问题。(II) 适用范围有限：当前的方法主要关注结构化的事实三元组，而忽略了现实世界中普遍存在的不结构化事实信息（如新闻、文章等）。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新的范式：通过思维链推理来训练语言模型进行知识编辑（CoT2Edit）。我们首先利用语言模型代理来处理结构化和非结构化的编辑数据，以生成思维链，从而构建高质量的教学数据。然后，通过监督微调（SFT）和群体相对策略优化（GRPO）来训练模型，使其能够在编辑过的信息上进行推理。在推理过程中，我们采用检索增强生成技术，动态提取相关编辑后的事实信息，以实现实时知识编辑。实验结果表明，仅通过对三个开源语言模型进行一轮训练，我们的方法就能在六种不同的知识编辑场景中实现强大的泛化能力。

papers.title: BadScientist: Can a Research Agent Write Convincing but Unsound Papers that Fool LLM Reviewers?
papers.title_zh: BadScientist：研究助理能否撰写出看似有说服力但实际上并不准确的论文，从而欺骗大型语言模型评审员呢？
papers.authors: Fengqing Jiang, Yichen Feng, Yuetai Li, Luyao Niu, Basel Alomair, Radha Poovendran
papers.abstract: The convergence of LLM-powered research assistants and AI-based peer review systems creates a critical vulnerability: fully automated publication loops where AI-generated research is evaluated by AI reviewers without human oversight. We investigate this through BadScientist, a framework that evaluates whether fabrication-oriented paper generation agents can deceive multi-model LLM review systems. Our generator employs presentation-manipulation strategies requiring no real experiments. We develop a rigorous evaluation framework with formal error guarantees (concentration bounds and calibration analysis), calibrated on real data. Our results reveal systematic vulnerabilities: fabricated papers achieve acceptance rates up to 82%. Critically, we identify concern-acceptance conflict—reviewers frequently flag integrity issues yet assign acceptance-level scores. Our mitigation strategies show only marginal improvements, with detection accuracy barely exceeding random chance. Despite provably sound aggregation mathematics, integrity checking systematically fails, exposing fundamental limitations in current AI-driven review systems and underscoring the urgent need for defense-in-depth safeguards in scientific publishing.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的研究助手与基于人工智能的同行评审系统的结合，带来了严重的漏洞：完全自动化的发表流程中，由人工智能生成的论文会在没有人类监督的情况下被人工智能评审员评估。我们通过BadScientist这一框架来研究这个问题，该框架用于评估那些以伪造内容为主的论文生成工具是否能够欺骗多模型大语言模型评审系统。我们的生成工具采用了无需实际实验的演示操控策略。我们开发了一个严格的评估框架，该框架具有正式的误差保证（浓度界限和校准分析），并且是在真实数据上校准的。我们的研究结果揭示了系统性漏洞：伪造的论文能够获得高达82%的接受率。更关键的是，我们发现了一个令人担忧的问题——评审员经常指出论文中的诚信问题，但却给予其接受级评分。我们的缓解策略仅能带来微小的改进，检测准确率勉强超过随机水平。尽管有经过验证的聚合数学方法，但诚信检查仍然会系统性地失败，这暴露了当前人工智能驱动的评审系统存在的根本局限性，同时也凸显了在科学出版领域实施深度防御措施的紧迫性。

papers.title: DFAMS: Dynamic-flow guided Federated Alignment based Multi-prototype Search
papers.title_zh: DFAMS：基于动态流引导的联邦对齐多原型搜索机制
papers.authors: Zhibang Yang, Xinke Jiang, Rihong Qiu, Ruiqing Li, Yihang Zhang, Yue Fang, Yongxin Xu, Hongxin Ding, Xu Chu, Junfeng Zhao, Yasha Wang
papers.abstract: Federated Retrieval (FR) routes queries across multiple external knowledge sources, to mitigate hallucinations of LLMs, when necessary external knowledge is distributed. However, existing methods struggle to retrieve high-quality and relevant documents for ambiguous queries, especially in cross-domain scenarios, which significantly limits their effectiveness in supporting downstream generation tasks. Inspired by Dynamic Information Flow (DIF), we propose DFAMS, a novel framework that leverages DIF to identify latent query intents and construct semantically aligned knowledge partitions for accurate retrieval across heterogeneous sources. Specifically, DFAMS probes the DIF in LLMs by leveraging gradient signals from a few annotated queries and employing Shapley value-based attribution to trace neuron activation paths associated with intent recognition and subdomain boundary detection. Then, DFAMS leverages DIF to train an alignment module via multi-prototype contrastive learning, enabling fine-grained intra-source modeling and inter-source semantic alignment across knowledge bases. Experimental results across five benchmarks show that DFAMS outperforms advanced FR methods by up to 14.37% in knowledge classification accuracy, 5.38% in retrieval recall, and 6.45% in downstream QA accuracy, demonstrating its effectiveness in complex FR scenarios. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Artessay/DFAMS.
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦检索（FR）通过将查询路由到多个外部知识源来减轻大语言模型出现的幻觉问题。当需要获取外部知识时，这种策略能够确保知识的有效分布。然而，现有的方法在处理模糊查询时难以获取高质量且相关的文档，尤其是在跨领域场景中，这大大限制了它们在支持下游生成任务方面的效果。受动态信息流（DIF）思想的启发，我们提出了DFAMS这一新型框架。该框架利用DIF来识别潜在的查询意图，并构建语义对齐的知识分区，从而实现跨异构源的精确检索。具体来说，DFAMS通过利用少数标注查询的梯度信号，并结合基于Shapley值的归因方法，来追踪与意图识别及子域边界检测相关的神经元激活路径。随后，DFAMS利用DIF通过多原型对比学习来训练一个对齐模块，从而实现对知识库内源数据的细粒度建模以及不同知识库之间的语义对齐。在五个基准测试中的实验结果表明，DFAMS在知识分类准确率方面比先进的FR方法高出14.37%，在检索召回率方面高出5.38%，在下游问答准确率方面高出6.45%。这表明DFAMS在复杂的FR场景中具有出色的性能。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Artessay/DFAMS上免费下载。

papers.title: PARIF: Pushing the Pareto Frontier of Instruction Following and Reasoning with Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 巴黎：利用强化学习来推动教学行为与推理能力的改进，从而构建帕累托前沿结构
papers.authors: Rongchuan Mu, Zexin Wang, Qianyu Wang, MingHua Ma, Zekun Wang, Ming Liu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel at complex problem-solving but frequently overlook specific instruction constraints. Existing alignment methods struggle to balance general reasoning with instruction-following (IF), hindered by dependency on teacher models, reward hacking, and reasoning-answer inconsistencies. We propose PARIF, a two-stage curriculum learning framework based on Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to enhance both IF and general reasoning capabilities. The framework employs a correctness proxy across different stages to mitigate reward hacking. Stage I employs a dynamic weighting strategy simultaneously to optimize the model’s reasoning paradigm regarding constraints. Stage II introduces Decoupled-GRPO, which builds upon the first stage to enhance the logical consistency between the reasoning process and the final answer, enabling the model to better leverage its optimized reasoning paradigm. To support the framework, we curate 26,000 high-quality instructions featuring diverse constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate PARIF’s effectiveness: our 7B model achieves a remarkable 21.25% relative average improvement to the original model across six representative IF tasks, while our 8B model outperforms leading models like DeepSeek-V3 on these IF tasks, effectively pushing the Pareto frontier of instruction following and reasoning for models of comparable scale. We open-source our code and models to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在解决复杂问题方面表现出色，但往往忽略了具体的指令约束。现有的对齐方法在平衡通用推理与遵循指令的能力方面存在困难，这主要是由于依赖教师模型、奖励操纵以及推理结果与指令要求不一致等问题导致的。我们提出了PARIF这一两阶段课程学习框架，该框架基于可验证奖励强化学习，旨在提升模型的遵循指令能力和通用推理能力。该框架在不同阶段使用正确性代理来防止奖励操纵。第一阶段采用动态加权策略，同时优化模型的推理模式以符合约束条件。第二阶段引入了Decoupled-GRPO技术，进一步增强了推理过程与最终答案之间的逻辑一致性，使模型能够更好地利用其优化的推理模式。为了支持这一框架，我们收集了26,000条具有不同约束条件的高质量指令。大量实验证明了PARIF的有效性：我们的70亿参数模型在六个代表性的遵循指令任务中，实现了21.25%的相对平均性能提升；而80亿参数的模型则在这些任务上超越了像DeepSeek-V3这样的领先模型，有效推动了同等规模模型的遵循指令和推理能力的提升。我们将我们的代码和模型开源出来，以便未来进行相关研究。

papers.title: GeoLaux: A Benchmark for Evaluating MLLMs’ Geometry Performance on Long-Step Problems Requiring Auxiliary Lines
papers.title_zh: GeoLaux：用于评估大型语言模型在需要辅助线处理的长步长问题上的几何性能的一个基准模型
papers.authors: Yumeng Fu, Jiayin Zhu, Lingling Zhang, Wenjun Wu, Bo Zhao, Shaoxuan Ma, Yushun Zhang, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: Geometry problem solving (GPS) poses significant challenges for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in diagram comprehension, knowledge application, long-step reasoning, and auxiliary line construction. However, current benchmarks lack fine-grained evaluation for long-step problems necessitating auxiliary construction. To address these limitations, we present GeoLaux, a fine-grained annotated dataset comprising 2186 calculation and proof problems. It features long-step reasoning (with an average solution length of 6.51 steps, maximum of 24 steps) and auxiliary line construction (required in 41.8% of problems). Building on the dataset, we conduct a comprehensive five-dimensional evaluation of 23 leading MLLMs. The evaluation yields three pivotal findings: First, models perform significantly worse on long-step problems compared to short-step ones, with 18 models exhibiting a performance drop of over 50%. Second, it is crucial to enhance models’ understanding, awareness, and proficiency in auxiliary line construction, which is vital for overall geometric reasoning. Third, limited answer hints effectively improve process correctness, whereas explicit answers lead models to neglect intermediate reasoning steps. These findings position GeoLaux both to benchmark MLLMs geometry reasoning abilities and to guide their improvement. Data and code are available at https://github.com/Candice-yu/GeoLaux
papers.abstract_zh: 几何问题求解（GPS）对多模态大语言模型在图表理解、知识应用、长步骤推理以及辅助线构建方面提出了重大挑战。然而，当前的评估基准缺乏针对需要辅助构建的长步骤问题的细粒度评估。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了GeoLaux数据集，该数据集包含2186个计算与证明问题，具有细粒度的标注信息。该数据集包含长步骤推理任务（平均解决步骤数为6.51步，最大为24步），以及辅助线构建任务（在41.8%的问题中需要构建辅助线）。基于该数据集，我们对23种领先的MLLMs进行了全面的五维评估。评估结果显示了三个重要发现：首先，与短步骤问题相比，模型在长步骤问题上的表现明显较差，有18个模型的性能下降超过了50%。其次，提升模型对辅助线构建的理解能力、意识以及熟练度至关重要，因为这对于整体几何推理能力有着重要影响。第三，有限的答案提示能够有效提高过程的准确性，而明确的答案则会导致模型忽略中间的推理步骤。这些发现使得GeoLaux数据集能够用于评估MLLMs的几何推理能力，并指导它们的改进。数据和代码可访问于https://github.com/Candice-yu/GeoLaux

papers.title: Unlocking Multilingual Reasoning Capability of LLMs and LVLMs through Representation Engineering
papers.title_zh: 通过表示工程技术，解锁大语言模型与语言生成模型的多语言推理能力
papers.authors: Qiming Li, Xiaocheng Feng, Yixuan Ma, Ruihan Chen, Zihe Tong, Zekai Ye, Xiachong Feng, Libo Qin, Haoyu Ren, Kun Chen, Yunfei Lu, Dandan Tu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong reasoning capabilities, yet their performance in English significantly outperforms that in low-resource languages, raising fairness concerns in multilingual applications. Existing approaches either rely on costly multilingual training or employ prompting with external translation tools, both of which are resource-intensive and sensitive to translation quality. To address these limitations, we propose a training-free inference-time method to enhance Multilingual Reasoning capabilities via Representation Engineering (MRRE) without using any additional training data or tools. MRRE sequentially injects two precomputed vectors at specific layers during inference processing: cross-lingual reasoning enhancement vectors, which steer non-English reasoning representations toward English space to unlock multilingual reasoning, and target-language output anchoring vectors, which restore the distribution of the target language to preserve input–output language consistency. Comprehensive experiments across six advanced LLMs and LVLMs on four reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MRRE consistently enhances non-English reasoning by an average gain of 5.48% and up to 7.54% in low-resource languages (e.g., Thai and Swahili), while improving input-output language consistency by 3.78%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）和大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）展现了强大的推理能力，然而它们在英语上的表现明显优于低资源语言，这引发了多语言应用中的公平性问题。现有的方法要么依赖于成本高昂的多语言训练，要么使用外部翻译工具进行提示生成，这两种方法都耗费大量资源且对翻译质量非常敏感。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种无需训练的推理时间方法，通过表示工程技术来增强多语言推理能力，而无需使用任何额外的训练数据或工具。在推理过程中，表示工程技术会依次注入两个预先计算好的向量：一个是跨语言推理增强向量，它引导非英语的推理表示向英语空间转化，从而实现多语言推理；另一个是目标语言输出锚定向量，它恢复目标语言的分布，从而保持输入与输出语言的一致性。我们在六个先进的LLM和LVLM上进行了全面的实验，在四个推理基准测试中发现，表示工程技术能够持续提高非英语推理的能力，平均提升幅度为5.48%，在低资源语言（如泰语和斯瓦希里语）中甚至达到了7.54%。同时，该方法还能将输入与输出语言的一致性提高3.78%。

papers.title: Into the Gray Zone: Domain Contexts Can Blur LLM Safety Boundaries
papers.title_zh: 进入灰色地带：领域上下文可能会模糊大语言模型的安全边界
papers.authors: Ki Sen Hung, Xi Yang, Chang Liu, Haoran Li, Kejiang Chen, Changxuan Fan, Tsun On Kwok, Weiming Zhang, Xiaomeng Li, Yangqiu Song
papers.abstract: A central goal of LLM alignment is to balance helpfulness with harmlessness, yet these objectives conflict when the same knowledge serves both legitimate and malicious purposes. This tension is amplified by context-sensitive alignment: we observe that domain-specific contexts (e.g., chemistry) selectively relax defenses for domain-relevant harmful knowledge, while safety-research contexts (e.g., jailbreak studies) trigger broader relaxation spanning all harm categories. To systematically exploit this vulnerability, we propose Jargon, a framework combining safety-research contexts with multi-turn adversarial interactions that achieves attack success rates exceeding 93% across seven frontier models, including GPT-5.2, Claude-4.5, and Gemini-3, substantially outperforming existing methods. Activation space analysis reveals that Jargon queries occupy an intermediate region between benign and harmful inputs, a gray zone where refusal decisions become unreliable. To mitigate this vulnerability, we design a policy-guided safeguard that steers models toward helpful yet harmless responses, and internalize this capability through alignment fine-tuning, reducing attack success rates while preserving helpfulness.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型对齐的一个核心目标是在有用性和无害性之间找到平衡。然而，当相同的知识被用于合法和恶意的目的时，这两个目标就会产生冲突。这种矛盾在基于上下文的对齐过程中更加明显：我们发现，特定领域的上下文（例如化学领域）会选择性地放松对与领域相关的有害知识的防御措施，而安全性研究领域的上下文（例如越狱研究）则会触发更广泛的放松机制，涵盖所有类型的危害行为。为了系统地利用这一漏洞，我们提出了Jargon框架。该框架结合了安全性研究领域的上下文和多轮对抗性交互机制，能够在包括GPT-5.2、Claude-4.5以及Gemini-3在内的七种前沿模型中实现超过93%的攻击成功率，其性能显著优于现有方法。激活空间分析表明，Jargon的查询输入处于良性与有害输入之间的中间区域，这是一个灰色地带，在这个区域中，拒绝决策变得不可靠。为了缓解这一漏洞，我们设计了一种策略引导的保护机制，使模型能够产生既有用又无害的响应。通过微调对齐机制，我们可以降低攻击成功率，同时保留模型的实用性。

papers.title: MED-COREASONER: Reducing Language Disparities in Medical Reasoning via Language-Informed Co-Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MED-COREASONER：通过基于语言的协同推理来减少医学推理中的语言差异
papers.authors: Fan Gao, Sherry T. Tong, Jiwoong Sohn, Jiahao Huang, Junfeng Jiang, Ding Xia, Piyalitt Ittichaiwong, Kanyakorn Veerakanjana, Hyunjae Kim, Qingyu Chen, Edison Marrese-Taylor, Kazuma Kobayashi, Akiko Aizawa, Irene Li
papers.abstract: While reasoning-enhanced large language models perform strongly on English medical tasks, a persistent multilingual gap remains, with substantially weaker reasoning in local languages, limiting equitable global medical deployment. To bridge this gap, we introduce Med-CoReasoner, a language-informed co-reasoning framework that elicits parallel English and local-language reasoning, abstracts them into structured concepts, and integrates local clinical knowledge into an English logical scaffold via concept-level alignment and retrieval. This design combines the structural robustness of English reasoning with the practice-grounded expertise encoded in local languages. To evaluate multilingual medical reasoning beyond multiple-choice settings, we construct MultiMed-X, a benchmark covering seven languages with expert-annotated long-form question answering and natural language inference tasks, comprising 350 instances per language. Experiments across three benchmarks show that Med-CoReasoner improves multilingual reasoning performance by an average of 5%, with particularly substantial gains in low-resource languages. Moreover, model distillation and expert evaluation analysis further confirm that Med-CoReasoner produces clinically sound and culturally grounded reasoning traces.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于推理增强的大语言模型在英文医学任务上表现优异，但多语言能力的差距仍然存在。当地语言的推理能力明显较弱，这限制了全球范围内医学领域的公平应用。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了Med-CoReasoner框架。该框架采用语言驱动的协同推理机制，能够同时处理英文和当地语言的推理信息，将这些信息抽象为结构化概念，并通过概念级对齐和检索将当地临床知识整合到英文逻辑框架中。这种设计结合了英文推理的结构性稳健性与当地语言中的实践知识。为了评估多语言医学推理的能力，我们构建了MultiMed-X基准测试，该测试涵盖了七种语言，包含专家注释的长文本问答和自然语言推理任务，每种语言有350个实例。在三个基准测试中的实验表明，Med-CoReasoner在多语言推理性能上平均提升了5%，尤其是在资源匮乏的语言中取得了显著的提升。此外，模型蒸馏和专家评估分析进一步证实，Med-CoReasoner生成的推理结果具有临床合理性和文化适应性。

papers.title: Psyche-R1: Towards Reliable Psychological LLMs through Unified Empathy, Expertise, and Reasoning
papers.title_zh: Psyche-R1：通过统一共情能力、专业知识与推理机制，实现可靠的心理领域大型语言模型
papers.authors: Chongyuan Dai, Jinpeng Hu, Hongchang Shi, Zhuo Li, Dan Guo, Xun Yang, Meng Wang
papers.abstract: Amidst a shortage of qualified mental health professionals, the integration of large language models (LLMs) into psychological applications offers a promising way to alleviate the growing burden of mental health disorders. Recent reasoning-augmented LLMs have achieved remarkable performance in mathematics and programming, while research in the psychological domain has predominantly emphasized emotional support and empathetic dialogue, with limited attention to reasoning mechanisms that are beneficial to generating accurate responses. Therefore, in this paper, we propose Psyche-R1, the first Chinese psychological LLM that jointly integrates empathy, psychological expertise, and reasoning, built upon a novel data curation pipeline. Specifically, we design a comprehensive data synthesis pipeline that produces over 75k high-quality psychological questions paired with detailed rationales, generated through and iterative prompt-rationale optimization procedure, along with 73k empathetic dialogues. Subsequently, we employ a hybrid training strategy wherein challenging samples are identified through a multi-LLM cross-selection strategy for group relative policy optimization (GRPO) to improve reasoning ability, while the remaining data are used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to enhance empathetic response generation and psychological domain knowledge. Extensive experiment results demonstrate the effectiveness of Psyche-R1 across several psychological benchmarks, where our 7B Psyche-R1 achieves comparable results to 671B DeepSeek-R1.
papers.abstract_zh: 在合格心理健康专业人员短缺的情况下，将大语言模型融入心理应用领域为缓解日益严重的心理健康问题提供了希望。最近开发的基于推理功能的语言模型在数学和编程领域取得了显著成果，而在心理学领域的研究中，人们主要注重情感支持和同理心对话，对有助于生成准确回答的推理机制关注较少。因此，在本文中，我们提出了Psyche-R1——首个整合了同理心、心理学专业知识和推理功能的中文心理语言模型。该模型基于一种新颖的数据整理流程构建。具体来说，我们设计了一个全面的数据合成流程，生成了超过75千个高质量的心理问题及其详细解答，这些问题是通过迭代的提示-理由优化过程生成的，同时还有73千条同理心对话。随后，我们采用了混合训练策略：通过多语言模型交叉选择策略来识别具有挑战性的样本，以进行群体相对策略优化，从而提高推理能力；而剩余的数据则用于监督式微调，以增强同理心反应生成能力和心理学领域的知识。广泛的实验结果表明，Psyche-R1在多个心理学基准测试中表现出色，其70亿参数的版本与6710亿参数的DeepSeek-R1相比，取得了相当不错的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mitigating Action-Relation Hallucinations in LVLMs via Relation-aware Visual Enhancement
papers.title_zh: 通过关系感知的视觉增强技术，缓解大型语言模型中的行动关联幻觉现象
papers.authors: Zhenxin Qin, Qiang Li, Qingzhuo Wang, Ruiyang Qin, Zhihua Wei, Wen Shen
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on diverse vision-language tasks. However, LVLMs still suffer from hallucinations, generating text that contradicts the visual input. Existing research has primarily focused on mitigating object hallucinations, but often overlooks more complex relation hallucinations, particularly action relations involving interactions between objects. In this study, we empirically observe that the primary cause of action-relation hallucinations in LVLMs is the insufficient attention allocated to visual information. Thus, we propose a framework to locate action-relevant image regions and enhance the LVLM’s attention to those regions. Specifically, we define the Action-Relation Sensitivity (ARS) score to identify attention heads that are most sensitive to action-relation changes, thereby localizing action-relevant image regions that contain key visual cues. Then, we propose the Relation-aware Visual Enhancement (RVE) method to enhance the LVLM’s attention to these action-relevant image regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared to existing baselines, our method achieves superior performance in mitigating action-relation hallucinations with negligible additional inference cost. Furthermore, it effectively generalizes to spatial-relation hallucinations and object hallucinations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型在多种视觉语言任务上取得了显著的性能表现。然而，这些模型仍然存在幻觉问题，即生成与视觉输入相矛盾的文本。现有的研究主要集中在减轻物体幻觉上，但往往忽略了更复杂的关系幻觉，尤其是涉及物体之间互动的动作关系。在本研究中，我们通过实证发现，大型视觉语言模型中动作关系幻觉的主要原因在于对视觉信息的关注不足。因此，我们提出了一个框架，用于定位与动作相关的图像区域，并增强模型对这些区域的关注。具体来说，我们定义了“动作关系敏感性”指标，以识别对动作关系变化最为敏感的关注区域，从而定位包含关键视觉线索的与动作相关的图像区域。接着，我们提出了“关系感知视觉增强”方法，用于增强模型对这些与动作相关的图像区域的关注。大量实验表明，与现有基线方法相比，我们的方法在减轻动作关系幻觉方面表现出更好的性能，同时几乎没有增加额外的推理成本。此外，该方法还能有效处理空间关系幻觉和物体幻觉问题。

papers.title: Agentic Oversight via Dialectic Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 通过辩证推理实现主动监督
papers.authors: Leonardo Ranaldi, Federico Ranaldi
papers.abstract: Debate has emerged as a promising oversight mechanism for Large Language Models (LLMs) amid rising systemic complexity, particularly where models outperform human evaluators. Yet, Debate provides little verifiable evidence for its final judgments, and its scalability remains largely unexplored. To make oversight grounded and scale as capabilities extend, we introduce an Agentic Oversight framework. By using Dialectic Argumentation as a reasoning function, we extend this paradigm to multilingual and multimodal spaces. We employ a weak-to-strong oversight approach based on two expert models that evaluate and defend contesting answers, while a third blind judge determines the winner using Dialectic Argumentation. Experts argue only for belief-consistent answers, founding the Debate on disagreements. We experimented with six tasks on our framework in both multilingual and multimodal scenarios, and dialectic argumentation consistently outperforms single-expert baselines. Moreover, we show that dialectic judgements from a weaker model deliver argument-mediated supervision that, via fine-tuning, instils unsupervised reasoning signals in expert models.
papers.abstract_zh: 在系统复杂性日益增加的情况下，辩论作为一种有效的监督机制被提出来用于大语言模型（LLM）的评估。尤其是在模型的表现优于人类评估者的情况下，辩论具有很大的潜力。然而，关于辩论的最终判断，目前缺乏可验证的证据支持，且其可扩展性也尚未得到充分探索。为了让监督机制更加可靠并具备可扩展性，我们提出了一种以辩证论证为基础的监督框架。通过采用辩证论证作为推理手段，我们将这一范式扩展到多语言和多模态场景中。我们采用了一种从弱到强的监督方法：由两个专家模型对争议答案进行评估和辩护，而第三个盲判者则利用辩证论证来确定胜者。专家们只针对符合逻辑的答案进行争论，从而基于分歧来构建辩论体系。我们在多语言和多模态场景中对该框架进行了六项实验，结果表明辩证论证始终优于单一专家的基线方法。此外，我们还发现，来自较弱模型的辩证判断能够提供一种基于论证的监督机制，通过微调，这种监督机制能够在专家模型中引入无监督的推理能力。

papers.title: FOREVER: Forgetting Curve-Inspired Memory Replay for Language Model Continual Learning
papers.title_zh: 永存：受遗忘曲线启发的记忆重放技术，用于语言模型的持续学习
papers.authors: Yujie Feng, Hao Wang, Jian Li, Xu Chu, Zhaolu Kang, Yiran Liu, Yasha Wang, Philip S. Yu, Xiao-Ming Wu
papers.abstract: Continual learning (CL) for large language models (LLMs) aims to enable sequential knowledge acquisition without catastrophic forgetting. Memory replay methods are widely used for their practicality and effectiveness, but most rely on fixed, step-based heuristics that often misalign with the model’s actual learning progress, since identical training steps can result in varying degrees of parameter change. Motivated by recent findings that LLM forgetting mirrors the Ebbinghaus human forgetting curve, we propose FOREVER (FORgEtting curVe-inspired mEmory Replay), a novel CL framework that aligns replay schedules with a model-centric notion of time. FOREVER defines model time using the magnitude of optimizer updates, allowing forgetting curve-inspired replay intervals to align with the model’s internal evolution rather than raw training steps. Building on this approach, FOREVER incorporates a forgetting curve-based replay scheduler to determine when to replay and an intensity-aware regularization mechanism to adaptively control how to replay. Extensive experiments on three CL benchmarks and models ranging from 0.6B to 13B parameters demonstrate that FOREVER consistently mitigates catastrophic forgetting.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对大语言模型持续学习（CL）的目标，是能够实现连续的知识获取，同时避免灾难性的遗忘现象。记忆回放方法因其实用性和有效性而被广泛采用，但大多数方法都依赖于固定的、基于步骤的启发式算法，这些算法往往与模型的实际学习进度不一致，因为相同的训练步骤可能会导致参数变化的程度不同。鉴于最近的研究发现表明，LLM的遗忘过程与人类艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线相似，我们提出了FOREVER这一新型持续学习框架。该框架将回放计划与以模型为中心的时间概念相结合。FOREVER通过优化器更新的幅度来定义模型时间，使得基于遗忘曲线的回放间隔能够与模型的内部演变保持一致，而不是仅仅依赖于原始的训练步骤。在此基础上，FOREVER还引入了一种基于遗忘曲线的回放调度器，以确定何时进行回放，并采用了一种注重强度的正则化机制，以自适应地控制回放的方式。在三个持续学习基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，FOREVER能够持续减轻灾难性遗忘的问题。

papers.title: CharTide: Data-Centric Chart-to-Code Generation via Tri-Perspective Tuning and Inquiry-Driven Evolution
papers.title_zh: CharTide：基于数据的图表到代码生成技术，通过三视角的调优和探索性进化来实现高效转换
papers.authors: Xiangxi Zheng, Kuang He, Jiayi Hu, Ping Yu, Rui Yan, Yuan Yao, Peng Hou, Anxiang Zeng, Alex Jinpeng Wang
papers.abstract: Chart-to-code generation demands strict visual precision and syntactic correctness from Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, existing approaches are fundamentally constrained by data-centric limitations: despite the availability of growing chart-to-code datasets, simply scaling homogeneous chart-code pairs conflates visual perception with program logic, preventing models from fully leveraging the richness of multimodal supervision. We present CharTide, a novel data-centric framework that systematically redesigns both training and alignment data for chart-to-code generation. First, we construct a 2M-sample dataset via a Tri-Perspective Tuning strategy, explicitly decoupling training into visual perception, pure-text code logic, and modality fusion streams, enabling a 7B model to surpass specialized baselines using only supervised data. Second, we reformulate alignment as a data verification problem rather than a heuristic scoring task. To this end, we introduce an Inquiry-Driven RL framework grounded in the principle of information invariance: a downstream model should yield consistent answers to identical visual queries across both original and generated charts. Moving beyond rigid rule matching or VLM scoring, we employ a frozen Inspector to objectively verify generated charts through atomic QA tasks, providing verifiable reward signals based on answer accuracy. Experiments on ChartMimic, Plot2Code, and ChartX show that CharTide-7B/8B significantly outperforms open-source baselines, surpasses GPT-4o, and is competitive with GPT-5.
papers.abstract_zh: 图表到代码生成对视觉感知的精确性以及语言模型的句法正确性有严格的要求。然而，现有的方法本质上受到数据中心的限制：尽管图表到代码的数据集不断增多，但单纯扩展同质的图表代码对会将视觉感知与程序逻辑混在一起，导致模型无法充分利用多模态监督信息的丰富性。我们提出了CharTide这一新颖的数据中心框架，该框架系统地重新设计了图表到代码生成的训练数据和对齐数据。首先，我们通过三视角调整策略构建了一个包含200万样本的数据集，将训练过程明确分为视觉感知、纯文本代码逻辑以及模态融合流三个部分，使得70亿参数的模型仅使用监督数据就能超越专业基线模型。其次，我们将对齐问题重新定义为一个数据验证问题，而不是启发式评分任务。为此，我们引入了一种基于信息不变性原则的探究驱动强化学习框架：下游模型应对原始图表和生成图表中的相同视觉查询给出一致的答案。我们不再依赖僵化的规则匹配或语言模型评分，而是采用冻结的检查器来通过原子问答任务客观验证生成的图表，并根据答案的准确性提供可验证的奖励信号。在ChartMimic、Plot2Code和ChartX上的实验表明，CharTide-7B/8B在性能上显著优于开源基线模型，甚至超过了GPT-4o，并且与GPT-5具有竞争力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PRISP: Privacy-Safe Few-Shot Personalization via Lightweight Adaptation
papers.title_zh: PRISP：通过轻量级适应实现隐私保护的少样本个性化推荐技术
papers.authors: Junho Park, Dohoon Kim, Taesup Moon
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) personalization aims to adapt general-purpose models to individual users. Most existing methods, however, are developed under data-rich and resource-abundant settings, often incurring privacy risks. In contrast, realistic personalization typically occurs after deployment under (i) extremely limited user data, (ii) constrained computational resources, and (iii) strict privacy requirements. We propose PRISP, a lightweight and privacy-safe personalization framework tailored to these constraints. PRISP leverages a Text-to-LoRA hypernetwork to generate task-aware LoRA parameters from task descriptions, and enables efficient user personalization by optimizing a small subset of task-aware LoRA parameters together with minimal additional modules using few-shot user data. Experiments on a few-shot variant of the LaMP benchmark demonstrate that PRISP achieves strong overall performance compared to prior approaches, while reducing computational overhead and eliminating privacy risks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）个性化技术旨在将通用模型适配到个体用户的需求上。然而，目前大多数相关方法都是在数据丰富、资源充足的情况下开发的，这往往伴随着隐私风险。相比之下，实际的个性化过程通常需要在以下条件下进行：(i) 极其有限的用户数据；(ii) 受限的计算资源；以及(iii) 严格的隐私要求。我们提出了PRISP这一轻量级且具备隐私安全性的个性化框架，它专为满足这些约束条件而设计。PRISP利用文本到LoRA的超网络结构，根据任务描述生成与任务相关的LoRA参数，并通过优化一小部分与任务相关的LoRA参数，同时使用少量的用户数据进行训练，从而实现高效的用户个性化。在LaMP基准测试的小样本变体上的实验表明，与以往的方法相比，PRISP在整体性能上表现更为出色，同时还能降低计算开销并消除隐私风险。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: IF-CRITIC: Towards a Fine-Grained LLM Critic for Instruction-Following Evaluation
papers.title_zh: IF-CRITIC：一种用于指导性评估的细粒度大型语言模型评估工具
papers.authors: Bosi Wen, Yilin Niu, Cunxiang Wang, Pei Ke, Xiaoying Ling, Ying Zhang, Aohan Zeng, Hongning Wang, Minlie Huang
papers.abstract: Instruction-following is a fundamental ability of Large Language Models (LLMs), requiring their generated outputs to follow multiple constraints imposed in input instructions. Numerous studies have attempted to enhance this ability through preference optimization or reinforcement learning based on reward signals from LLM-as-a-Judge. However, existing evaluation models for instruction-following still possess many deficiencies, such as substantial costs and unreliable assessments. To this end, we propose IF-CRITIC, an LLM critic for fine-grained, efficient, and reliable instruction-following evaluation. We first develop a checklist generator to decompose instructions and generate constraint checklists. With the assistance of the checklists, we collect high-quality critique training data through a multi-stage critique filtering mechanism and employ a constraint-level preference optimization method to train IF-CRITIC. Extensive experiments show that the evaluation performance of IF-CRITIC can beat strong LLM-as-a-Judge baselines, including o4-mini and Gemini-3-Pro. With the reward signals provided by IF-CRITIC, LLMs can achieve substantial performance gains in instruction-following optimization under lowercomputational overhead compared to strong LLM critic baselines. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/thu-coai/IF-CRITIC.
papers.abstract_zh: 遵循指令是大语言模型的基本能力之一，要求模型的输出能够遵循输入指令中规定的多种约束条件。许多研究试图通过偏好优化或基于奖励信号的强化学习来提升这一能力，其中“裁判型语言模型”在其中的作用至关重要。然而，现有的遵循指令评估模型仍然存在许多缺陷，比如计算成本过高以及评估结果不可靠等问题。为此，我们提出了IF-CRITIC这一用于精细、高效且可靠地评估遵循指令能力的语言模型评估器。我们首先开发了一个检查清单生成器，用于将指令分解为各个约束条件，然后通过多阶段筛选机制收集高质量的评估训练数据，并采用约束级偏好优化方法来训练IF-CRITIC。大量实验表明，IF-CRITIC的评估性能可以超越一些强大的“裁判型语言模型”基线模型，包括o4-mini和Gemini-3-Pro。借助IF-CRITIC提供的奖励信号，语言模型在遵循指令优化的过程中可以获得显著的性能提升，同时还能降低计算开销。我们的代码和模型可以在https://github.com/thu-coai/IF-CRITIC上获取。

papers.title: Know Your Place: Diagnosing Implicit Social Adaptation Failures in Chinese Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 了解你的定位：诊断中国大型语言模型中的隐性社会适应问题
papers.authors: Yu Tian, Jie Xing, Ziming Li, Jiang Li, Zehua Duo, Tian Lan, Xu Liu, Guanglai Gao, Xiangdong Su
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in dialogue systems and interactive agents, their social adaptation during natural interaction has drawn growing attention. While prior work shows strong social regulation under explicit role or style instructions, it remains unclear whether LLMs can spontaneously perceive and respond to implicit social differences without explicit prompts. Focusing on high-context Chinese interactions, we identify a robust phenomenon termed Social Agnosia, where LLMs fail to adequately perceive and accommodate implicit social power, affective arousal, and epistemic status during natural interaction. To diagnose this behavior, we propose C-ISA, a framework grounded in Communication Accommodation Theory that decomposes social adaptation into three approximately orthogonal dimensions, and conduct controlled comparisons across multiple Chinese LLMs under implicit and explicit conditions. Results show that while models substantially adjust linguistic strategies under explicit conditioning, they exhibit socially insensitive and homogenized responses in natural interaction, revealing a structural gap between spontaneous behavior and conditioned capability. The C-ISA dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/ty373/C-ISA.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在对话系统和交互式智能体中的应用日益广泛，它们在自然交互过程中的社会适应性问题受到了越来越多的关注。虽然先前的研究表明，在明确的角色或风格指令下，这些模型能够很好地调节自己的行为，但尚不清楚它们是否能够在没有明确提示的情况下，自发地感知并应对隐性的社会差异。针对高语境中文交互场景，我们发现了一种被称为“社会认知缺失”的现象：在自然交互过程中，大语言模型无法充分感知和适应隐性的社会权力、情感状态以及认知地位。为了诊断这种行为，我们提出了C-ISA框架，该框架基于沟通适应理论，将社会适应分解为三个大致正交的维度，并在隐性和显性条件下对多个中文大语言模型进行了对比实验。结果表明，尽管这些模型在明确指令下会调整自己的语言策略，但在自然交互中却表现出对社会因素缺乏敏感性和反应同质化的问题，这揭示了自发行为与条件化能力之间的结构性差距。C-ISA数据集可在https://github.com/ty373/C-ISA上免费获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Agent Newsroom: Efficient Chronological Report Generation via Dynamic Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.title_zh: 代理新闻室：通过动态多智能体协作实现高效的时间顺序报告生成
papers.authors: Zhenhua Wang, Chunlei Wang, Yue Geng, Bang Wang
papers.abstract: Many real-world applications require generating a chronological report from an evolving document stream; Timeline Summarization (TLS) provides a standard testbed for this setting. While large language models (LLMs) improve event synthesis, most LLM-based TLS systems remain monolithic: they repeatedly process overlapping evidence and often mirror the corpus’ bursty reporting patterns, producing redundant timelines with temporal/topical imbalance and high cost. We propose MAS-TLS, a multi-agent framework that casts TLS as a newsroom-like collaboration. A master editor steers balanced coverage by allocating system-visible evidence with a coverage–diversity objective; specialist reporter agents independently draft time-anchored, evidence-grounded events while cross-reviewing to limit redundancy; an adjudication round reconciles competing drafts and consolidates duplicates into a global timeline; and a non-stationary Bayesian controller adaptively staffs agents under token/time budgets. Experiments on three benchmarks show that MAS-TLS improves semantic coverage and temporal grounding while substantially reducing token usage and latency.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多现实世界的应用都需要从不断变化的文档流中生成时间顺序报告；时间线总结技术为这一场景提供了一个标准的测试平台。虽然大语言模型在事件合成方面取得了显著进步，但大多数基于LLM的时间线总结系统仍然采用单一架构：它们反复处理相互重叠的证据，往往模仿了文档中突发性的报告模式，导致时间线存在冗余、时间/主题不平衡的问题，并且成本很高。我们提出了MAS-TLS框架，它将时间线总结视为一种类似新闻编辑室的协作过程。一个主编辑负责分配可见证据以实现覆盖与多样性的平衡；专业记者代理则独立撰写基于证据的事件描述，并通过交叉审核来避免冗余；最后一轮裁决环节则负责协调不同的草案，并将重复内容整合到统一的时间线中；此外，一个非平稳的贝叶斯控制器还会根据令牌/时间预算动态调整代理的工作安排。在三个基准测试上的实验表明，MAS-TLS能够显著提高语义覆盖率和时间定位的准确性，同时大幅减少令牌使用量和延迟时间。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Locomo-Plus: Beyond-Factual Cognitive Memory Evaluation Framework for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: Locomo-Plus：适用于大型语言模型智能体的超越事实性的认知记忆评估框架
papers.authors: Yifei Li, Weidong Guo, Lingling Zhang, Rongman Xu, Muye Huang, Hui Liu, Lijiao Xu, Yu Xu, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: Long-term conversational memory is a core capability for LLM-baseddialogue systems, yet existing benchmarks and evaluation protocolsprimarily focus on surface-level factual recall.In realistic interactions, appropriate responses often depend onimplicit constraints such as user state, goals, or values that are notexplicitly queried later.To evaluate this setting, we introduce LoCoMo-Plus, a benchmarkfor assessing cognitive memory under cue–trigger semantic disconnect,where models must retain and apply latent constraints across longconversational contexts.We further show that conventional string-matching metrics and explicittask-type prompting are misaligned with such scenarios, and propose aunified evaluation framework based on constraint consistency.Experiments across diverse backbone models, retrieval-based methods, andmemory systems demonstrate that cognitive memory remains challenging andreveals failures not captured by existing benchmarks.Our code and evaluation framework are publicly available at https://github.com/xjtuleeyf/Locomo-Plus.
papers.abstract_zh: 长期对话记忆是基于大语言模型的对话系统的核心能力。然而，现有的评估基准和协议主要关注的是表面层次的事实回忆能力。在真实的互动中，恰当的回应往往取决于一些隐性的约束条件，比如用户的状态、目标或价值观，而这些因素通常不会被明确询问。为了评估这种情况，我们提出了LoCoMo-Plus这一基准测试，用于评估在提示与触发之间存在语义脱节时的认知记忆能力。在这种情境下，模型需要保留并应用这些隐性约束，以在长时间的对话中做出正确的回应。我们还指出，传统的字符串匹配指标和明确的任务类型提示并不适用于这种场景。因此，我们提出了一个基于约束一致性统一的评估框架。通过对不同主干模型、基于检索的方法以及记忆系统进行实验验证，我们发现认知记忆仍然是一个挑战性很大的领域，而且存在许多现有评估基准无法捕捉到的问题。我们的代码和评估框架可以在https://github.com/xjtuleeyf/Locomo-Plus上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CUB: Benchmarking Context Utilisation Techniques for Language Models
papers.title_zh: CUB：语言模型上下文利用技术的基准测试
papers.authors: Lovisa Hagström, Youna Kim, Haeun Yu, Sang-goo Lee, Richard Johansson, Hyunsoo Cho, Isabelle Augenstein
papers.abstract: Incorporating external knowledge is crucial for knowledge-intensive tasks, such as question answering and fact checking. However, language models (LMs) may ignore relevant information that contradicts outdated parametric memory or be distracted by irrelevant contexts. While many context utilisation manipulation techniques (CMTs) have recently been proposed to alleviate these issues, few have seen systematic comparison. In this paper, we develop CUB (Context Utilisation Benchmark) - the first comprehensive benchmark designed to help diagnose CMTs under diverse noisy context conditions within retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). With this benchmark, we conduct the most extensive evaluation to date of seven state-of-the-art methods, representative of the main categories of CMTs, across three diverse datasets and tasks, applied to 11 LMs. Our findings expose critical gaps in current CMT evaluation practices, demonstrating the need for holistic testing. We reveal that most existing CMTs struggle to handle the full spectrum of context types encountered in real-world RAG scenarios. We also find that many CMTs display inflated performance on simple synthesised datasets, compared to more realistic datasets with naturally occurring samples.
papers.abstract_zh: 在需要大量知识的任务中，整合外部知识至关重要，比如问答和事实核查。然而，语言模型可能会忽略与过时参数化记忆相矛盾的相关信息，或者被不相关的上下文所干扰。虽然最近提出了许多上下文利用操控技术来缓解这些问题，但很少有研究对它们进行系统的比较。在本文中，我们开发了CUB（上下文利用基准测试）——这是首个旨在帮助诊断在不同噪声上下文条件下检索增强生成场景下的上下文利用操控技术的综合基准测试。通过这一基准测试，我们对七种最先进的技术进行了迄今为止最为全面的评估。这些技术代表了主要的上下文利用操控技术类别，它们被应用于三个不同的数据集和任务中，同时还有11个语言模型作为测试对象。我们的研究发现揭示了当前上下文利用操控技术评估实践中存在的关键缺陷，从而证明了进行全面测试的必要性。我们发现，大多数现有的上下文利用操控技术在处理现实世界检索增强生成场景中遇到的各种类型上下文时存在困难。此外，我们还发现，许多上下文利用操控技术在简单合成数据集上的表现优于那些包含自然样本的现实数据集。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VLN-NF: Feasibility-Aware Vision-and-Language Navigation with False-Premise Instructions
papers.title_zh: VLN-NF：基于可行性分析的视觉与语言导航系统，适用于带有虚假前提指令的情况
papers.authors: Hung-Ting Su, Ting-Jun Wang, Jia-Fong Yeh, Min Sun, Winston H. Hsu
papers.abstract: Conventional Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) benchmarks assume instructions are feasible and the referenced target exists, leaving agents ill-equipped to handle false-premise goals. We introduce VLN-NF, a benchmark with false-premise instructions where the target is absent from the specified area and agents must navigate, gather evidence through in-room exploration, and explicitly output NOT-FOUND. VLN-NF is constructed via a scalable pipeline that rewrites VLN instructions using an LLM and verifies target absence with a VLM, producing plausible yet factually incorrect goals. We further propose REV-SPL to jointly evaluate room reaching, exploration coverage, and decision correctness. To address this challenge, we present ROAM, a two-stage hybrid that combines supervised room-level navigation with LLM/VLM-driven in-room exploration guided by a free-space clearance prior. ROAM achieves the best REV-SPL among compared methods, while baselines often under-explore and terminate prematurely under unreliable instructions. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的视觉与语言导航基准测试假设指令是可行的，且目标点确实存在，这使得智能体难以应对基于错误前提的目标任务。我们提出了VLN-NF这一基准测试，该测试采用错误前提的指令，其中目标点不在指定区域内，智能体必须进行导航，通过室内探索收集证据，并明确输出“未找到”的提示。VLN-NF是通过一个可扩展的流程构建的，该流程利用大语言模型重新编写VLN指令，并使用视觉语言模型来验证目标点的缺失情况，从而生成看似合理但实际上错误的目标任务。我们还提出了REV-SPL算法，用于联合评估房间到达能力、探索覆盖范围以及决策的正确性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了ROAM算法，这是一种两阶段混合方法，结合了监督下的房间级导航以及由大语言模型/视觉语言模型驱动的室内探索机制，同时考虑了自由空间间隙的限制条件。ROAM在REV-SPL评估中表现最佳，而传统方法往往因指令不可靠而导致探索不足或过早终止。相关代码和数据将在项目被接受后公开提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: NiuTrans.LMT: Toward Inclusive and Scalable Multilingual Machine Translation with LLMs
papers.title_zh: NiuTrans.LMT：迈向基于大语言模型的包容性强且可扩展的多语言机器翻译技术
papers.authors: Yingfeng Luo, Ziqiang Xu, Yuxuan Ouyang, MuRun Yang, DingYang Lin, Kaiyan Chang, Tong Zheng, Bei Li, Peinan Feng, Quan Du, Tong Xiao, JingBo Zhu
papers.abstract: Large language models have significantly advanced Multilingual Machine Translation (MMT), yet scaling to many languages while keeping quality robust across directions remains challenging.In this paper, we identify a failure mode of multilingual supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on multi-way parallel data: when such data are reused symmetrically around a pivot language (e.g., English), performance on reverse directions (X \to pivot) can drop substantially.We term this phenomenon Directional Degeneration and attribute it to excessive many-to-one mappings, which encourage shortcut learning.We propose Strategic Downsampling (SD), a simple yet effective method to mitigate this degeneration.In addition, we introduce Parallel Multilingual Prompting (PMP), which augments translation instructions with an auxiliary parallel sentence to promote cross-lingual transfer during training and enables optional test-time enhancement when auxiliary translations are available. We further develop NiuTrans.LMT (Large-scale Multilingual Translation, abbreviated as LMT), a Chinese–English-centric suite of multilingual translation models spanning four sizes (0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B) and covering 60 languages and 234 directions.Comprehensive evaluations show that LMT is competitive among open-source MMT systems, and that our 4B LMT model performs on par with or better than substantially larger baselines. We release our models and project resources to support inclusive and scalable MMT.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多语言机器翻译领域取得了显著进展，但在同时支持多种语言并保持各方向翻译质量方面仍然存在挑战。在本文中，我们发现了多语言监督微调方法的一个缺陷：当这些数据以对称方式围绕一种主导语言进行复用时（例如英语），反向翻译方向的性能会大幅下降。我们将这种现象称为“方向性退化”，并认为其原因是过多的多对一映射机制，这种机制促进了捷径学习行为。为此，我们提出了“策略性下采样”方法，这是一种简单而有效的解决方案。此外，我们还引入了“并行多语言提示”技术，通过在翻译指令中加入辅助句子来促进跨语言迁移，并在有辅助翻译可用的情况下，为测试阶段提供优化机会。我们进一步开发了NiuTrans.LMT——一套以中文-英文为主的多语言翻译模型，该模型涵盖了四种规模（0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B），能够处理60种语言及234个翻译方向。综合评估表明，NiuTrans.LMT在开源MMT系统中表现相当出色，其4B规模的模型性能甚至优于一些规模更大的基线模型。我们已公开了这些模型及相关资源，旨在推动包容性和可扩展性的MMT发展。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ChipSeek: Optimizing Verilog Generation via EDA-Integrated Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: ChipSeek：通过EDA集成强化学习技术优化Verilog代码生成过程
papers.authors: Zhirong Chen, Kaiyan Chang, Zhuolin Li, Cangyuan Li, Xinyang He, Chujie Chen, Mengdi Wang, Haobo Xu, Yinhe Han, Huawei Li, Ying Wang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models have emerged as powerful tools for automating Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code generation, yet they face critical limitations: existing approaches typically fail to simultaneously optimize functional correctness and hardware efficiency metrics such as Power, Performance, and Area (PPA). Methods relying on supervised fine-tuning commonly produce functionally correct but suboptimal designs due to the lack of inherent mechanisms for learning hardware optimization principles. Conversely, external post-processing techniques aiming to refine PPA performance after generation often suffer from inefficiency and do not improve the LLMs’ intrinsic capabilities.To overcome these challenges, we propose ChipSeek, a novel hierarchical reward based reinforcement learning framework designed to encourage LLMs to generate RTL code that is both functionally correct and optimized for PPA metrics. Our approach integrates direct feedback from EDA simulators and synthesis tools into a hierarchical reward mechanism, facilitating a nuanced understanding of hardware design trade-offs. Through Curriculum-Guided Dynamic Policy Optimization (CDPO), ChipSeek enhances the LLM’s ability to generate high-quality, optimized RTL code. Evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate ChipSeek’s superior performance, achieving state-of-the-art functional correctness and PPA performance. Furthermore, it excels in specific optimization tasks, consistently yielding highly efficient designs when individually targeting fine-grained optimization goals such as power, delay, and area. The artifact is open-source in https://github.com/rong-hash/chipseek.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已成为自动化寄存器传输级（RTL）代码生成的强大工具，但它们面临着一些关键限制：现有的方法通常无法同时优化功能正确性和硬件效率指标，如功耗、性能和面积。依赖监督式微调的方法往往能够生成功能正确的设计，但由于缺乏学习硬件优化原理的固有机制，这些设计往往不够优化。相反，那些旨在在生成后改进功耗和面积性能的外部后处理技术往往效率低下，且无法提升LLM的固有能力。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了ChipSeek这一新颖的层次化奖励强化学习框架。该框架旨在鼓励LLM生成既功能正确又符合功耗和面积指标的RTL代码。我们的方法将EDA仿真器和综合工具的直接反馈整合到层次化奖励机制中，从而更细致地理解硬件设计的权衡。通过课程引导的动态策略优化（CDPO），ChipSeek提升了LLM生成高质量、优化后的RTL代码的能力。在标准基准测试中的评估表明，ChipSeek具有出色的性能，能够实现最先进的功能正确性和功耗与面积性能。此外，它在特定优化任务上表现尤为出色，当针对功耗、延迟和面积等细粒度优化目标时，能够持续产生高效的设计。该框架的代码已开源，地址为https://github.com/rong-hash/chipseek。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MERIT Feedback Elicits Better Bargaining in LLM Negotiators
papers.title_zh: MERIT反馈能够促使大型语言模型谈判者进行更有效的协商
papers.authors: Jihwan Oh, Murad Aghazada, Yooju Shin, Se-Young Yun, Taehyeon Kim
papers.abstract: Bargaining is often regarded as a logical arena rather than an art or a matter of intuition, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) still struggle to navigate it due to limited strategic depth and difficulty adapting to complex human factors. Current benchmarks rarely capture this limitation. To bridge this gap, we present a utility feedback centric framework. Our contributions are: (i) AgoraBench, a new benchmark spanning nine challenging settings (e.g., deception, monopoly) that supports diverse strategy modeling; (ii) human-aligned, economically grounded metrics derived from utility theory. This is operationalized via agent utility, negotiation power, and acquisition ratio that implicitly measure how well the negotiation aligns with human preference and (iii) a human preference grounded dataset with learning pipeline that strengthens LLMs’ bargaining ability through both prompting and finetuning. Empirical results indicate that baseline LLM strategies often diverge from human preferences, while our mechanism substantially improves negotiation performance, yielding deeper strategic behavior and stronger opponent awareness.
papers.abstract_zh: 讨价还价通常被视为一种逻辑上的行为，而非艺术或直觉的体现。然而，大语言模型在应对这一挑战时仍然面临困难，因为其战略深度有限，且难以适应复杂的人类因素。目前的评估标准很少能捕捉到这一缺陷。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一个以效用为核心的框架。我们的贡献包括：(i) AgoraBench，一个涵盖九种具有挑战性的场景的新基准测试，支持多种策略建模方式；(ii) 基于效用理论而制定的、符合人类偏好的经济指标。这些指标通过代理效用、谈判能力和获取比例来衡量谈判效果，从而间接反映谈判是否符合人类的偏好；(iii) 一个基于人类偏好的数据集以及相应的学习流程，能够提升语言模型的讨价还价能力，无论是通过提示还是微调都能实现这一目标。实证结果表明，传统的语言模型策略往往与人类偏好不符，而我们的机制显著提升了谈判性能，使得模型能够表现出更深刻的战略行为和更强的对手意识。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Collision to Cognition: Hash-Driven Graph Construction for Efficient RAG
papers.title_zh: 从碰撞到认知：基于哈希算法的图构建技术，以实现高效的RAG处理
papers.authors: Chuang Zhou, Zheng Yuan, Linhao Luo, Zhaozhuo Xu, Yilin Xiao, Junnan Dong, Siyu An, di Yin, Xing Sun, Xiao Huang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has long been a promising paradigm for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge. Traditional embedding-based methods for graph construction can capture semantic similarity but struggle to establish fine-grained, interpretable logical relationships. Recently, Graph-enhanced RAG (GraphRAG) has gained increasing popularity for its capability in modeling logical relationships. However, graph construction requires extensive token consumption for triple extraction and summarization, making it costly and slow. Accordingly, we propose MeshRAG, a novel framework for mining efficient structures via hashing to enhance RAG. We adopt an inductive paradigm in which global graph structure emerges from local hash collisions rather than explicit symbolic extraction. By replacing neural embedding search with lightweight and bitwise operations, MeshRAG automates a simple and rapid graph construction process. Furthermore, the hash collision mechanism provides transparent evidence for logical connections and retrieval decisions. Experimental results show that MeshRAG outperforms existing baselines, while its graph construction requires no GPU resources or token budget and can structure over ten thousand chunks in a few minutes.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）长期以来一直是一种很有前景的方法，它能够将外部知识整合到大语言模型中。传统的基于嵌入的方法在构建图结构时能够捕捉语义相似性，但在建立细致且可解释的逻辑关系方面存在困难。最近，图增强RAG（GraphRAG）因其能够建模逻辑关系而逐渐受到重视。然而，图结构的构建需要大量的令牌消耗，这对于三元组提取和总结来说成本较高且效率低下。因此，我们提出了MeshRAG这一新型框架，它通过哈希技术来高效构建图结构，从而提升RAG的性能。我们采用一种归纳式的方法，即从局部哈希冲突中推断出全局图结构，而不是通过显式的符号提取。通过将神经嵌入搜索替换为轻量级的比位运算，MeshRAG实现了简单快速的图结构构建过程。此外，哈希冲突机制为逻辑连接和检索决策提供了透明的证据支持。实验结果表明，MeshRAG在性能上优于现有的基线方法，而且其图结构构建过程不需要GPU资源或过多的令牌预算，能够在几分钟内构建出超过一万个块的结构。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: WebSynthesis: World Model-Guided Monte Carlo Tree Search for Efficient WebAgent Trajectory Synthesis
papers.title_zh: WebSynthesis：基于世界模型的蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，用于高效生成网络代理的路径规划
papers.authors: Yifei Gao, Junhong Ye, Yifan Yang, Jiaqi Wang, Yi Zhang, Zhang Ruichen, Jitao Sang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled increasingly capable web agents, yet training such agents still relies on high-quality interaction trajectories that are difficult to obtain at scale. We identify two key challenges: (1) Infrastructure Overhead, where network instability and website access restrictions limit data collection scalability; and (2) Constrained Exploration, where irreversible state transitions preclude tree-based search and thus limit trajectory diversity. To address these challenges, we introduce WebSynthesis, a framework for scalable trajectory synthesis. WebSynthesis employs an LLM-based World Model to simulate state transitions without network dependencies, and integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search to enable reversible exploration over the simulated state space. Experiments on WebArena, WebVoyager, and Mind2Web-Online demonstrate that agents trained exclusively on synthesized trajectories outperform those trained on real-world data, providing a viable alternative to costly real-world data collection.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展使得网络代理的能力得到了显著提升。然而，训练这些代理仍然依赖于高质量的互动轨迹，而这些轨迹的获取在大规模应用中是非常困难的。我们发现了两个主要挑战：(1) 基础设施开销问题，即网络不稳定和网站访问限制限制了数据收集的可扩展性；(2) 受限探索问题，不可逆的状态转换使得基于树的搜索变得不可行，从而限制了轨迹的多样性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了WebSynthesis这一框架，它能够实现可扩展的轨迹生成。WebSynthesis利用基于大语言模型的世界模型来模拟状态转换，而不需要依赖网络环境。同时，该框架还整合了蒙特卡洛树搜索技术，从而实现在模拟状态空间中的可逆探索。在WebArena、WebVoyager以及Mind2Web-Online上的实验表明，仅使用合成轨迹训练的代理性能优于那些基于真实数据训练的代理，这为昂贵的真实数据收集提供了一种可行的替代方案。

papers.title: EyeMulator: Improving Code Language Models by Mimicking Human Visual Attention
papers.title_zh: EyeMulator：通过模拟人类视觉注意力来改进代码语言模型
papers.authors: Yifan Zhang, Chen Huang, Yueke Zhang, Jiahao Zhang, Toby Jia-Jun Li, Collin McMillan, Kevin Leach, Yu Huang
papers.abstract: Code Language Models (CodeLLMs) traditionally learn attention based solely on statistical input-output token correlations (“machine attention”). In contrast, human developers rely on intuition, selectively fixating on semantically salient tokens during program comprehension. We present EyeMulator, a model-agnostic technique to align CodeLLM attention with human visual attention without architectural changes. By extracting scan paths from eye-tracking data, we derive token-level attention weights used to augment the loss function during fine-tuning. This induces the model to mimic human focus. Our evaluation across StarCoder, Llama-3.2, and DeepSeek-Coder shows that EyeMulator significantly outperforms baselines, achieving gains of over 30 CodeBLEU points in translation and up to 22 BERTScore points in summarization. Ablation studies confirm that these gains stem directly from replicating human attention dynamics. Artifacts are available at https://zenodo.org/records/17205682.
papers.abstract_zh: 代码语言模型（CodeLLMs）传统上仅通过统计上的输入-输出标记相关性来学习注意力机制（“机器注意力”）。相比之下，人类开发者在理解程序时，会依靠直觉，选择性地关注那些具有语义意义的标记。我们提出了EyeMulator这一与模型无关的技术，它能够在不改变架构的情况下，将CodeLLM的注意力机制与人类视觉注意力对齐。通过从眼动追踪数据中提取扫描路径，我们可以得到标记级别的注意力权重，这些权重在微调过程中被用来增强损失函数。这样就能使模型模仿人类的注意力机制。我们在StarCoder、Llama-3.2和DeepSeek-Coder上的评估结果显示，EyeMulator的表现显著优于基线模型，在翻译任务中提升了超过30个CodeBLEU分数，在摘要任务中提升了高达22个BERTScore分数。消融研究也证实，这些提升直接源于对人类注意力机制的复制。相关成果可访问https://zenodo.org/records/17205682查看。

papers.title: TPA: Next Token Probability Attribution for Detecting Hallucinations in RAG
papers.title_zh: TPA：用于检测“幻觉”现象的下一笔币概率分配机制
papers.authors: Pengqian Lu, Jie Lu, Anjin Liu, Guangquan Zhang
papers.abstract: Detecting hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation remains a challenge. Prior approaches attribute hallucinations to a binary conflict between internal knowledge stored in FFNs and the retrieved context. However, this perspective is incomplete, failing to account for the impact of other components of the LLM, such as the user query, previously generated tokens, the self token, and the final LayerNorm adjustment. To comprehensively capture the impact of these components on hallucination detection, we propose TPA which mathematically attributes each token’s probability to seven distinct sources: Query, RAG Context, Past Token, Self Token, FFN, Final LayerNorm, and Initial Embedding. This attribution quantifies how each source contributes to the generation of the next token. Specifically, we aggregate these attribution scores by Part-of-Speech (POS) tags to quantify the contribution of each model component to the generation of specific linguistic categories within a response. By leveraging these patterns, such as detecting anomalies where Nouns rely heavily on LayerNorm, TPA effectively identifies hallucinated responses. Extensive experiments show that TPA achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 在检索增强生成中检测幻觉仍然是一个挑战。以往的方法将幻觉归因于FFNs中存储的内部知识与检索到的上下文之间的二元冲突。然而，这种观点并不全面，未能考虑到大语言模型其他组成部分的影响，例如用户查询、之前生成的令牌、自我令牌以及最终LayerNorm调整。为了全面捕捉这些组成部分对幻觉检测的影响，我们提出了TPA方法。该方法从数学上将每个令牌的概率归因于七个不同的来源：查询、RAG上下文、过去令牌、自我令牌、FFN、最终LayerNorm以及初始嵌入。这种归因方式可以量化每个来源对下一个令牌生成的贡献程度。具体来说，我们通过词性标记来汇总这些归因分数，从而量化每个模型组成部分对响应中特定语言类别生成的贡献。通过利用这些模式，例如检测名词大量依赖LayerNorm的异常情况，TPA能够有效识别出幻觉产生的响应。大量的实验表明，TPA取得了最先进的性能表现。

papers.title: GMFL: Efficient Global Masking for Federated LLM Fine-tuning
papers.title_zh: GMFL：高效的全球掩蔽技术，用于联邦大语言模型微调
papers.authors: Xin Huang, Yan Hu, Yue-Jiao Gong, Xinglin Zhang
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as a prominent solution to mitigate the communication and computation costs in federated fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, we observe that even within low-rank adapters, a substantial portion of parameters manifest negligible updates during federated training, leading to redundant communication and wasted local computation. To address this, we propose GMFL, a plug-and-play layer freezing mechanism designed to seamlessly integrate with existing federated fine-tuning frameworks. Specifically, the server monitors the global update magnitude of each LoRA layer to dynamically generate freezing masks. These masks are updated periodically with a fixed freezing rate, ensuring stable convergence by robustly identifying “saturated” layers. Theoretical analysis confirms the convergence of GMFL, where the freezing mechanism yields a bounded error that scales with client heterogeneity. Extensive experiments across multiple tasks (GLUE, Commonsense Reasoning, Math Reasoning and General Generation) demonstrate that GMFL reduces communication overhead and lowers computational costs while preserving the performance of the underlying federated fine-tuning methods. Our work provides a practical, versatile solution for deploying large-scale federated LLM fine-tuning in resource-constrained environments. Our code is available at: https://github.com/tunx-cyber/GMFL.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）已成为减轻大语言模型（LLM）联邦微调中的通信和计算成本的有效解决方案。然而，我们发现即使在低秩适配器内部，仍有相当一部分参数的更新效果微乎其微，这导致了不必要的通信和浪费的本地计算资源。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了GMFL这一即插即用层冻结机制，该机制能够无缝地与现有的联邦微调框架集成。具体来说，服务器会监控每个LoRA层的全局更新幅度，从而动态生成冻结掩码。这些掩码以固定的速率定期更新，从而通过稳健地识别“饱和”层来确保稳定的收敛。理论分析证实，GMFL的冻结机制能够产生有界误差，且这种误差会随着客户端异质性的增加而减小。在多个任务上的广泛实验表明，GMFL能够有效降低通信开销并减少计算成本，同时还能保持底层联邦微调方法的性能。我们的工作为在资源受限的环境中部署大规模联邦LLM微调提供了实用的解决方案。我们的代码可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/tunx-cyber/GMFL。

papers.title: AgentGL: Towards Agentic Graph Learning with LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: AgentGL：利用强化学习实现基于大语言模型的智能体图学习
papers.authors: Yuanfu Sun, Kang Li, Dongzhe Fan, Jiajin Liu, Qiaoyu Tan
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on agentic capabilities—iterative retrieval, tool use, and decision-making—to overcome the limits of static, parametric knowledge. Yet existing agentic frameworks treat external information as unstructured text and fail to leverage the topological dependencies inherent in real-world data. To bridge this gap, we introduce Agentic Graph Learning (AGL), a paradigm that reframes graph learning as an interleaved process of topology-aware navigation and LLM-based inference. Specifically, we propose AgentGL, the first reinforcement learning (RL)–driven framework for AGL. AgentGL equips an LLM agent with graph-native tools for multi-scale exploration, regulates tool usage via search-constrained thinking to balance accuracy and efficiency, and employs a graph-conditioned curriculum RL strategy to stabilize long-horizon policy learning without step-wise supervision. Across diverse Text-Attributed Graph (TAG) benchmarks and multiple LLM backbones, AgentGL substantially outperforms strong GraphLLMs and GraphRAG baselines, achieving absolute improvements of up to 17.5% in node classification and 28.4% in link prediction. These results demonstrate that AGL is a promising frontier for enabling LLMs to autonomously navigate and reason over complex relational environments. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/sunyuanfu/AgentGL.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越依赖代理能力——如迭代检索、工具使用以及决策制定——来突破静态、参数化知识的局限性。然而，现有的代理框架将外部信息视为非结构化文本，未能充分利用现实数据中固有的拓扑依赖性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了代理图学习（AGL）这一理念，它将图学习重新定义为一种结合了拓扑感知导航与基于LLM的推理过程的综合过程。具体来说，我们提出了AgentGL，这是首个以强化学习为驱动的AGL框架。AgentGL为LLM代理配备了适用于图的工具，以实现多尺度探索；通过限制搜索次数的思维方式来调节工具的使用，从而平衡准确性和效率；同时采用基于图的课程强化学习策略，实现无需逐步监督即可稳定进行长期策略学习。在多种文本属性图（TAG）基准测试以及多个LLM基础模型上，AgentGL的表现显著优于强大的图LLM和图RAG基线模型，在节点分类任务中实现了高达17.5%的绝对改进，在链接预测任务中实现了28.4%的绝对改进。这些结果表明，AGL为让LLM能够在复杂关系环境中自主导航和推理提供了有前景的方向。相关代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/sunyuanfu/AgentGL

papers.title: MM-JudgeBias: A Benchmark for Evaluating Compositional Biases in MLLM-as-a-Judge
papers.title_zh: MM-JudgeBias：用于评估作为裁判的MLLM模型中组合性偏差的一个基准模型
papers.authors: Sua Lee, Sanghee Park, Jinbae Im
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been increasingly used as automatic evaluators—a paradigm known as MLLM-as-a-Judge. However, their reliability and vulnerabilities to biases remain underexplored. We find that many MLLM judges fail to reliably integrate key visual or textual cues, yielding unreliable evaluations when evidence is missing or mismatched, and exhibiting instability under semantically irrelevant perturbations. To address this, we systematically define Compositional Bias in MLLM-as-a-Judge systems and introduce MM-JudgeBias, a benchmark for evaluating it. MM-JudgeBias introduces controlled perturbations across Query, Image, and Response, and evaluates model behavior via two complementary metrics: Bias-Deviation (BD) for sensitivity and Bias-Conformity (BC) for stability. Our dataset of over 1,800 curated and refined multimodal samples, drawn from 29 source benchmarks, enables a fine-grained diagnosis of nine bias types across diverse tasks and domains. Experiments on 26 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal systematic modality neglect and asymmetric evaluation tendencies, underscoring the need for more reliable judges.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型已被越来越多地用作自动评估工具——这一范式被称为“以模型为评判者”。然而，这些模型的可靠性和对偏见的抗抗能力仍未被充分研究。我们发现，许多以模型为评判者的系统无法可靠地整合关键的视觉或文本线索，当证据缺失或不匹配时，会导致不可靠的评估结果，并且在语义不相关的扰动下也会表现出不稳定性。为了应对这一问题，我们系统地定义了“以模型为评判者”系统中的组合偏见现象，并引入了MM-JudgeBias这一用于评估该现象的基准测试。MM-JudgeBias通过控制查询、图像和响应的方式，利用两个互补的指标来评估模型的行为：偏差度指标用于衡量模型的敏感性，一致性指标用于衡量模型的稳定性。我们的数据集包含超过1,800个经过筛选和优化的多模态样本，这些样本来自29个不同的基准测试，能够细致地诊断出多种偏见类型，适用于不同的任务和领域。在26个先进的多模态语言模型上的实验表明，这些模型存在系统性地忽略不同模态特征的问题，以及不对称的评估倾向，这进一步凸显了需要更可靠的评估工具的必要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CSPO: Alleviating Reward Ambiguity for Structured Table-to-LaTeX Generation
papers.title_zh: CSPO：减少结构化表格到LaTeX格式转换过程中的奖励模糊性问题
papers.authors: Yunfan Yang, Cuiling Lan, Jitao Sang, Yan Lu
papers.abstract: Tables contain rich structured information, yet when stored as images their contents remain “locked” within pixels. Converting table images into LaTeX code enables faithful digitization and reuse, but current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often fail to preserve structural, style, or content fidelity. Conventional post-training with reinforcement learning (RL) typically relies on a single aggregated reward, leading to reward ambiguity that conflates multiple behavioral aspects and hinders effective optimization. We propose Component-Specific Policy Optimization (CSPO), an RL framework that disentangles optimization across LaTeX tables components—structure, style, and content. In particular, CSPO assigns component-specific rewards and backpropagates each signal only through the tokens relevant to its component, alleviating reward ambiguity and enabling targeted component-wise optimization. To comprehensively assess performance, we introduce a set of hierarchical evaluation metrics. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of CSPO, underscoring the importance of component-specific optimization for reliable structured generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格包含丰富且结构化的信息，但当它们以图像形式存储时，其内容便被“锁定”在像素之中。将表格图像转换为LaTeX代码能够实现信息的忠实数字化和再利用，但当前的多模态大语言模型往往无法保持结构、风格或内容的准确性。传统的基于强化学习的训练后优化方法通常依赖于单一的聚合奖励，这会导致奖励的模糊性，从而混淆多个行为方面，阻碍有效的优化过程。我们提出了一种名为“组件特定策略优化”（CSPO）的强化学习框架，该框架能够分离出LaTeX表格中的各个组成部分——结构、风格和内容。具体来说，CSPO为各个组成部分分配特定的奖励，并且只让每个信号通过与其所属组件相关的标记进行反向传播，从而消除奖励的模糊性，实现针对各个组件的优化。为了全面评估其性能，我们引入了一套层次化的评估指标。大量的实验证明了CSPO的有效性，这进一步强调了针对各个组件进行优化的必要性，以实现可靠的结构化生成。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Chart-MRAG: Benchmarking Multimodal Retrieval Augmented Generation on Chart-based Documents
papers.title_zh: Chart-MRAG：基于图表文档的多模态检索增强生成技术的对比分析
papers.authors: Ymyang, Jiang Zhong, Li Jin, Xiao Sun, Jingwang Huang, Gaojinpeng, Qing Liu, Yang Bai, Jingyuan Zhang, Rui Jiang, Qin Lei, Kaiwen Wei
papers.abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) enhances reasoning capabilities by integrating external knowledge. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on simple image-text interactions, overlooking complex visual formats like charts that are prevalent in real-world applications. In this work, we introduce a novel task, \textbf{Chart-based MRAG}, to address this limitation. To generate high-quality evaluation samples, we propose \textbf{CHARGE} (\textbf{CHAR}t-based document question-answering \textbf{GE}neration), a semi-automatic framework for generating evaluation samples through multi-modal keypoint extraction, knowledge graph construction, and qa pair synthesis.By combining CHARGE with expert validation, we construct \textbf{Chart-MRAG Bench}, a comprehensive benchmark for chart-based MRAG evaluation, featuring 4,738 question-answering pairs across 8 domains from real-world documents.Our experiments reveal three critical limitations in current approaches: (1) unified multimodal embedding retrieval methods struggles in chart-based scenarios, (2) even with ground-truth retrieval, state-of-the-art Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve only 71.15% Correctness and 80.74% Coverage scores, and (3) Widely-used MLLMs demonstrate consistent text-over-visual modality bias. These findings highlight great challenges in processing information-dense visual formats. We will make our code and dataset publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态检索增强生成（MRAG）通过整合外部知识提升了推理能力。然而，现有的评估基准主要聚焦于简单的图像文本交互，而忽略了现实应用中常见的复杂视觉格式，比如图表。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新的任务——基于图表的MRAG，以克服这一局限性。为了生成高质量的评估样本，我们提出了CHARGE算法，这是一种半自动框架，通过多模态关键点提取、知识图谱构建以及问答对合成来生成评估样本。通过将CHARGE与专家验证相结合，我们构建了Chart-MRAG基准测试集，该测试集包含了来自真实文档的8个领域中的4,738对问答样本，用于评估基于图表的MRAG性能。我们的实验揭示了当前方法的三个关键缺陷：(1)统一的多模态嵌入检索方法在基于图表的场景中表现不佳；(2)即使采用真正的检索方式，最先进的多模态大语言模型也只能达到71.15%的正确率和80.74%的覆盖率；(3)广泛使用的MLLMs存在一致的文本优于视觉的模式偏见。这些发现凸显了处理信息密集型的视觉格式所面临的巨大挑战。我们将公开我们的代码和数据集。
