papers.title: Towards Stable and Effective Reinforcement Learning for Mixture-of-Experts
papers.title_zh: 致力于实现稳定且高效的混合专家强化学习算法
papers.authors: Di Zhang, Xun Wu, Shaohan Huang, Lingjie Jiang, Yaru Hao, Li Dong, Zewen Chi, Zhifang Sui, Furu Wei
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving reasoning capabilities. However, training RLVR with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) policies remains fragile and is often prone to reward collapse.We identify a MoE-specific source of instability, referred to as router shift (RS), where changes in expert routing across policy updates exacerbate off-policy mismatch. This effect leads to increasingly volatile importance-ratio signals and bursty clipping behavior, which consistently precede training collapse.Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Router-Shift Policy Optimization (RSPO). RSPO computes a per-token router-shift ratio conditioned on the previously activated experts, applies stop-gradient and a lower-bound floor, and softly rescales importance ratios prior to clipping and aggregation. This design explicitly accounts for routing-induced distributional drift during off-policy optimization.We evaluate the effect of RSPO under two settings: a synthetic countdown task and real-world reasoning tasks on MATH and Code. Across both settings, RSPO achieves better performance and exhibits greater stability compared to recent MoE-based RLVR methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升推理能力的强大方法。然而，使用混合专家策略进行RLVR的训练仍然存在稳定性问题，且容易引发奖励崩溃现象。我们发现了一种与混合专家策略相关的不稳定性来源，称为路由偏移。在策略更新过程中，专家路由的变化会加剧离策略不匹配的问题。这种效应会导致重要性比率信号变得更加不稳定，并出现突发性的裁剪行为，这些现象通常会在训练崩溃之前出现。基于这一发现，我们提出了路由偏移策略优化算法。该算法根据之前激活的专家来计算每个标记点的路由偏移比例，应用停止梯度法和下限约束，并在裁剪和聚合之前对重要性比率进行软性重新调整。这种设计明确考虑了离策略优化过程中由路由引起的分布漂移问题。我们在两种情境下评估了RSPO的效果：合成倒计时任务以及MATH和Code领域的真实世界推理任务。在两种情境下，与最近的基于混合专家策略的RLVR方法相比，RSPO取得了更好的性能，并且表现出更高的稳定性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AIRCoder: Adaptive Integration of Multi-dimensional Retrieval for Repository-level Code Completion
papers.title_zh: AIRCoder：自适应集成多维度检索技术，实现仓库级代码补全功能
papers.authors: Chuanqi Shi, Miao Gao, Zhiqiang Gao
papers.abstract: Repository-level code completion relies on retrieval strategies to select relevant context from large codebases. Most existing methods employ single-dimensional retrieval based on textual similarity or dependency existence, leading to inconsistent performance across completion scenarios. Even task-adaptive and hybrid methods incur high computational costs while failing to explicitly consider structural hierarchy for retrieving functionally similar code. We introduce AIRCoder, a multi-dimensional retrieval framework that combines eight complementary metrics across three dimensions: textual similarity, dependency existence, and structural hierarchy. By proposing a structure-preserving chunking strategy and lightweight fusion module, AIRCoder learns context-dependent weights to adaptively integrate retrieval metrics for each query. Experiments on CrossCodeEval and RepoEval demonstrate that AIRCoder achieves an average improvement of 4.63% in exact match over the best baseline, with 10.2\times higher efficiency and strong cross-language generalization across Python, Java, C#, and TypeScript.
papers.abstract_zh: 仓库级代码补全依赖于检索策略来从庞大的代码库中选取相关的上下文信息。目前大多数方法都采用基于文本相似性或依赖关系存在的单一维度检索方式，这导致在不同补全场景中的性能表现不一致。即便是那些具有任务自适应性和混合检索机制的方法，也会产生较高的计算成本，同时无法有效考虑结构层次关系以检索功能上相似的代码。我们提出了AIRCoder这一多维检索框架，该框架结合了三种维度的八个互补指标：文本相似性、依赖关系存在性以及结构层次关系。通过采用一种保持结构完整性的分块策略和轻量级融合模块，AIRCoder能够学习到与上下文相关的权重，从而自适应地整合各种检索指标来处理每个查询。在CrossCodeEval和RepoEval上的实验表明，AIRCoder在精确匹配方面平均提升了4.63%，其效率提高了10.2倍，并且在Python、Java、C#和TypeScript等多种语言环境中都具有出色的泛化能力。

papers.title: ReLook: Vision-Grounded RL with a Multimodal LLM Critic for Agentic Web Coding
papers.title_zh: ReLook：基于视觉感知的强化学习框架，结合多模态大语言模型用于智能网络编码的评估机制
papers.authors: Yuhang Li, Chenchen Zhang, Ruilin Lv, Ao Liu, Ken Deng, Yuanxing Zhang, Jiaheng Liu, Bo Zhou
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at algorithmic code generation, they struggle with front-end development, where correctness is judged on rendered pixels and interaction. We present ReLook, an agentic, vision-grounded reinforcement learning framework that empowers an agent to close a robust generate–diagnose–refine loop by invoking a multimodal LLM (MLLM) as a tool. During training, the agent employs an MLLM-in-the-loop to serve as a visual critic, evaluating code via screenshots and providing actionable feedback. Crucially, we enforce a strict zero-reward policy for invalid renders to guarantee renderability and mitigate reward hacking. To prevent behavioral collapse, we introduce Forced Optimization, a strict acceptance rule that admits only improving revisions, yielding monotonically better trajectories. At inference, we decouple the critic and run a lightweight, critic-free self-edit cycle, keeping latency comparable to base decoding while retaining most of the gains. Across three widely used benchmarks, ReLook consistently outperforms strong baselines in vision-grounded front-end code generation, highlighting the benefits of agentic perception, visual rewards, and training–inference decoupling.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在算法代码生成方面表现出色，但在前端开发方面却存在困难，因为前端开发的准确性需要通过渲染出的像素和交互效果来评判。我们提出了ReLook这一基于视觉驱动的强化学习框架，该框架能够让智能体通过调用多模态语言模型作为工具，实现生成-诊断-优化循环，从而提升代码质量。在训练过程中，智能体使用内置的语言模型作为视觉评估工具，通过截图来评估代码质量并提供可操作的反馈。此外，我们实施了严格的零奖励策略，以杜绝无效渲染的情况，从而确保代码的可渲染性，并防止奖励被操纵。为了防止行为崩溃，我们引入了强制优化机制，这是一种严格的接受规则，只允许进行改进性的修改，从而取得越来越好的效果。在推理阶段，我们将视觉评估模块与代码生成模块分离，采用轻量级的、无需视觉评估的自编辑流程，同时保持与基础解码方式相当的延迟，同时保留大部分优势。在三个广泛使用的基准测试中，ReLook在基于视觉的前端代码生成方面始终优于其他强大的基线方法，这充分证明了基于视觉的强化学习框架所带来的好处，包括智能体的感知能力、视觉奖励机制以及训练与推理的分离。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SafetyMem: Adaptive Jailbreak Defense via Dual-Component Safety Memory
papers.title_zh: SafetyMem：通过双组件安全内存实现自适应越狱防御机制
papers.authors: Hao Wang, Ziyi Ni, Huacan Wang, Pin Lyu, Lei Sha
papers.abstract: Current defenses for Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffer from a ”memory gap”: parameter-modifying methods are computationally rigid, while inference-time filters cannot retain or reuse defense knowledge across interactions. To address this, we propose SafetyMem, a novel framework that secures LLMs through a dual-component safety memory system. SafetyMem consists of Semantic Safety Memory (SSM), which consolidates diverse jailbreak attempts into a structured knowledge base of attack patterns, and Episodic Safety Memory (ESM), which maintains an evolving set of procedural rules refined from historical detection failures. Unlike static defenses, SafetyMem allows the model to ”remember” and adapt to emerging adversarial strategies without parameter retraining. To further enhance robustness, we introduce an adversarial memory expansion mechanism that proactively generates challenging variants to solidify these memories. Experiments on standard and stealthy jailbreak benchmarks show that SafetyMem substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving efficiency and interpretability, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art baselines across multiple LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前针对大语言模型（LLM）的防御方法往往存在“记忆缺口”问题：修改参数的方法在计算上效率低下，而推理时使用的过滤器则无法在多次交互中保留或复用防御知识。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SafetyMem这一创新框架。该框架通过双组件的安全记忆系统来保护LLM。SafetyMem由语义安全记忆（SSM）和情节安全记忆（ESM）组成。SSM将各种越狱尝试整合为结构化的攻击模式知识库；ESM则维护着从历史检测失败中提炼出的不断更新的程序规则。与静态防御方法不同，SafetyMem允许模型在不重新训练参数的情况下“记住”并适应不断变化的对抗策略。为了进一步提升鲁棒性，我们还引入了一种对抗性记忆扩展机制，该机制会主动生成具有挑战性的变体以巩固这些记忆。在标准和隐蔽的越狱测试上的实验表明，SafetyMem能够显著降低攻击成功率，同时保持良好的效率和可解释性，其性能始终优于多种LLM领域内的最先进基线算法。

papers.title: Enhancing Agentic Textual Graph Retrieval with Synthetic Stepwise Supervision
papers.title_zh: 通过合成式逐步监督技术，提升文本图的检索效率
papers.authors: Ge Chang, Jinbo Su, Jiacheng Liu, Pengfei Yang, Yuhao Shang, Huiwen Zheng, Hongli Ma, Yan Liang, Yuanchun Li, Yunxin Liu
papers.abstract: Integrating textual graphs into Large Language Models (LLMs) is promising for complex graph-based QA. However, a key bottleneck is retrieving informative yet compact subgraphs that fit the LLM context. Existing retrievers often struggle, relying either on shallow embedding similarity or costly interactive policies that require excessive supervision.To address these challenges, we introduce Graph-S^3, an agentic textual graph reasoning framework featuring an LLM-based retriever trained with synthetic stepwise supervision. Rather than relying on final answer rewards—which often yield sparse and unstable signals—we optimize the retriever by evaluating each step against offline-extracted golden subgraphs.Our approach distills golden subgraphs via a specialized data synthesis pipeline to formulate dense rewards, facilitating a two-stage training scheme that effectively learns the interactive graph exploration policy.Based on extensive experiments on three common datasets in comparison with seven strong baselines, our approach achieves an average improvement of 15.6% in accuracy and 17.2% in F_1 score. The advantage is even higher in more complicated multi-hop reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 将文本图集成到大语言模型中，对于复杂的基于图的问答任务来说具有很大的潜力。然而，一个关键的瓶颈是找到那些既具有信息性又符合语言模型上下文要求的子图。现有的检索方法往往难以应对这一挑战，因为它们要么依赖于浅层嵌入的相似性，要么需要昂贵的交互式策略，而这通常需要大量的监督工作。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了Graph-S^3框架——一个以语言模型为基础的文本图推理系统，该框架采用了经过合成逐步监督训练的检索器。与依赖最终答案奖励的方法不同，后者往往会产生稀疏且不稳定的信号，我们通过对每个步骤进行离线提取的黄金子图的评估来优化检索器的性能。我们的方法通过专门的数据合成流程来提取黄金子图，从而生成密集的奖励信息，进而实现两阶段训练方案，有效学习交互式图探索策略。在对比了三个常见数据集以及七个强大的基线模型后，我们的方法在准确率上实现了平均15.6%的提升，在F_1分数上实现了17.2%的提升。在更复杂的多跳推理任务中，我们的优势更为明显。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Cognitive Scaffold: From Fluid Context to Crystallized Memory for Long-Horizon DeepResearch Agents
papers.title_zh: 认知框架：从流动上下文到固化记忆，适用于长期深度研究的智能体
papers.authors: Qiuyuan Ai, Zenghuang Fu, Zhaoyang Li, Ping Jiang, Haoyu Wu, Jie Song, Guannan He
papers.abstract: Scaling LLM-based agents to long-horizon deep research is constrained by the context-noise trade-off, where linear history accumulation degrades reasoning and dilutes fine-grained evidence. To address this, we introduce the Cognitive Scaffold, a factorized memory architecture that decouples the cognitive state into a Fluid Working Context for immediate reasoning and a persistent Knowledge Graph for long-term retention. Unlike unstructured summarization, our framework employs a Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning (RFT) pipeline to crystallize saturated context into structured event snapshots, strictly enforcing atomic constraints to preserve numerical values and entities. During reasoning, a thought-driven dual-path retrieval mechanism enables the agent to proactively recover precise evidence. Empirical evaluations on Xbench-DeepSearch, BrowseComp-ZH, and GAIA demonstrate that Cognitive Scaffold consistently outperforms baselines, achieving 74.7% Avg@3 and 87.0% Pass@3 on Xbench-DeepSearch, 48.5% Avg@3 and 65.9% Pass@3 on BrowseComp-ZH, and 72.8% Avg@3 and 88.3% Pass@3 on GAIA, while reducing compression hallucinations to 5.3%. We open-source our codebase to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 将基于大语言模型的智能体扩展到长期视角的深度研究，面临着上下文噪声这一难题。线性历史积累会削弱推理能力，并使得细微的线索变得模糊不清。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了“认知框架”这一内存架构。该架构将认知状态分解为两个部分：一个用于即时推理的流动工作上下文，以及一个用于长期存储的知识图谱。与无结构总结不同，我们的框架采用了拒绝采样微调技术，将饱和的上下文转化为结构化的事件快照，同时严格遵循原子约束，以保留数值和实体信息。在推理过程中，一种以思维驱动的双路径检索机制使智能体能够主动恢复精确的线索。在Xbench-DeepSearch、BrowseComp-ZH和GAIA上的实证评估表明，认知框架始终优于基线模型。在Xbench-DeepSearch上，其平均准确率达到了74.7%，通过率达到了87.0%；在BrowseComp-ZH上，平均准确率达到了48.5%，通过率达到了65.9%；在GAIA上，平均准确率达到了72.8%，通过率达到了88.3%。同时，该框架还将压缩幻觉的发生率降低到了5.3%。我们将我们的代码库开源出来，以便未来研究者能够进一步研究。

papers.title: Revisiting Metric Reliability for Fine-grained Evaluation of Machine Translation and Summarization in Indian Languages
papers.title_zh: 重新审视用于机器翻译及印度语料库摘要生成的度量标准可靠性问题
papers.authors: Amir Hossein Yari, Kalmit Kulkarni, Ahmad Raza Khan, Fajri Koto
papers.abstract: While automatic metrics drive progress in Machine Translation (MT) and Text Summarization (TS), existing metrics have been developed and validated almost exclusively for English and other high-resource languages. This narrow focus leaves Indian languages—spoken by over 1.5 billion people—largely overlooked, casting doubt on the universality of current evaluation practices. To address this gap, we introduce ITEM, a large-scale benchmark that systematically evaluates the alignment of 26 automatic metrics with human judgments across six major Indian languages, enriched with fine-grained annotations. Our extensive evaluation—covering agreement with human judgments, sensitivity to outliers, language-specific reliability, inter-metric correlations, and resilience to controlled perturbations—reveals four central findings: (1) LLM-based evaluators show the strongest alignment with human judgments at both segment and system levels; (2) outliers exert a significant impact on metric-human agreement; (3) In TS, metrics are more effective at capturing content fidelity, whereas in MT, they better reflect fluency; and (4) Metrics differ in their robustness and sensitivity when subjected to diverse perturbations. Collectively, these findings offer critical guidance for advancing metric design and evaluation in Indian languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然自动评估指标在机器翻译和文本摘要领域取得了显著进展，但现有的评估指标几乎仅针对英语及其他资源丰富的语言而开发并验证。这种狭隘的视角使得由超过15亿人使用的印度语言被严重忽视，从而质疑当前评估方法的普适性。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了ITEM这个大规模基准测试工具，该工具系统地评估了26种自动评估指标与六种主要印度语言的人类判断之间的吻合程度，同时提供了详细的注释信息。我们的广泛评估结果显示了四个核心发现：(1)基于大语言模型的评估工具在片段级和系统级上与人类判断的吻合度最高；(2)异常值对评估指标与人类判断的一致性有显著影响；(3)在文本摘要方面，评估指标更能反映内容的准确性，而在机器翻译中，它们则更能反映语言的流畅性；(4)不同的评估指标在面对各种干扰因素时，其稳健性和敏感性也有所不同。总体而言，这些发现为改进印度语言的评估指标设计提供了重要的指导方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Learning to Think on Hypergraph: HyperCoT for Structure-Guided N-ary Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.title_zh: 在Hypergraph上学习思考方式：适用于结构引导的N元知识图谱补全技术——HyperCoT
papers.authors: Mengxue Yang, Jinming Li, Chun Yang, Jiaqi Zhu, Jiafan Li, Guanhua Zhang, Ying Li
papers.abstract: N-ary knowledge graph completion (KGC) aims to infer missing components in facts with multiple entities under distinct semantic roles, commonly formulated as a knowledge hypergraph link prediction task. Most embedding-based approaches score individual hyperedges relying on enriched structural representations, but overlook intermediate propagation states containing complementary local and global structural evidence. Despite their capability to generate chain-of-thought (CoT) representations for the classical KGC task, large language models (LLMs) struggle with hypergraph structure involving multiple facts, while current hypergraph QA methods only provide LLMs with a single query signal rather than path-level evidence. These limitations hinder the transferability of existing methods, especially those leveraging LLMs, to solve the knowledge hypergraph link prediction problem. To bridge this gap, we propose HyperCoT, a structure-aware approach that models multi-hop structural reasoning as a depth-sensitive progressive evidence accumulation process. It constructs a Graphical Chain-of-Thought (Graph-CoT) by aggregating role-aware hyperedge states along strongly correlated reasoning paths, and injects the resulting path-level structural evidence into each token in query and candidate entities to prompt LLMs. Experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that HyperCoT consistently outperforms strong n-ary KGC baselines, particularly in high arity and structural sparsity scenarios, meanwhile yielding interpretable multi-hop reasoning traces.
papers.abstract_zh: N元知识图谱补全（KGC）旨在推断具有多个不同语义角色实体的事实中缺失的组件，这通常被表述为知识超图链接预测任务。大多数基于嵌入的方法通过丰富的结构表示来评分各个超边，但忽略了包含互补的局部和全局结构信息的中间传播状态。尽管大语言模型能够生成用于经典KGC任务的思维链（CoT）表示，但它们在处理涉及多个事实的超图结构时存在困难。而当前的超图问答方法仅为语言模型提供单一查询信号，而非路径级别的证据。这些限制阻碍了现有方法的可迁移性，尤其是那些利用语言模型的方法，无法解决知识超图链接预测问题。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了HyperCoT方法，这是一种注重结构的解决方案，它将多跳结构推理建模为一个对深度敏感的逐步证据积累过程。该方法通过沿着强相关推理路径聚合具有角色意识的超边状态，构建出图形化思维链（Graph-CoT），并将得到的路径级别结构信息注入到查询和候选实体中的每个标记中，以触发语言模型的行为。在三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，HyperCoT在多数情况下都优于强大的N元KGC基线算法，尤其是在高阶性和结构稀疏性的情况下，同时还能产生可解释的多跳推理轨迹。

papers.title: Two Pathways to Truthfulness: On the Intrinsic Encoding of LLM Hallucinations
papers.title_zh: 通往真理的两条道路：关于大语言模型产生的幻觉的内在编码机制
papers.authors: Wen Luo, Guangyue Peng, Wei Li, Shaohang Wei, Feifan Song, Liang Wang, Nan Yang, Xingxing Zhang, Jing Jin, Furu Wei, Houfeng Wang
papers.abstract: Despite their impressive capabilities, large language models (LLMs) frequently generate hallucinations. Previous work shows that their internal states encode rich signals of truthfulness, yet the origins and mechanisms of these signals remain unclear. In this paper, we demonstrate that truthfulness cues arise from two distinct information pathways: (1) a Question-Anchored pathway that depends on question–answer information flow, and (2) an Answer-Anchored pathway that derives self-contained evidence from the generated answer itself. First, we validate and disentangle these pathways through attention knockout and token patching. Afterwards, we uncover notable and intriguing properties of these two mechanisms. Further experiments reveal that (1) the two mechanisms are closely associated with LLM knowledge boundaries; and (2) internal representations are aware of their distinctions. Finally, building on these insightful findings, two applications are proposed to enhance hallucination detection performance. Overall, our work provides new insight into how LLMs internally encode truthfulness, offering directions for more reliable and self-aware generative systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型具备令人印象深刻的性能，但它们经常会产生幻觉。先前的研究表明，这些模型的内部状态能够编码出丰富的真实性信号，但这些信号的来源和机制仍然不清楚。在本文中，我们证明了真实性线索源自两条不同的信息路径：（1）一种以问题为导向的路径，该路径依赖于问题-答案的信息流；（2）一种以答案为导向的路径，该路径能够从生成的答案本身中提取出独立的证据。首先，我们通过注意力缺失实验和标记替换实验来验证并分离这两条路径。随后，我们发现了这两种机制的若干有趣特性。进一步的实验表明：（1）这两种机制与语言模型的知识边界密切相关；（2）内部表征能够意识到它们之间的差异。最后，基于这些有洞察力的发现，我们提出了两种方法来提升幻觉检测的性能。总体而言，我们的研究为理解大语言模型如何内部编码真实性提供了新的视角，为构建更可靠且具有自我意识的生成系统提供了方向。

papers.title: LLM-ForcedAligner: A Non-Autoregressive and Accurate LLM-Based Forced Aligner for Multilingual and Long-Form Speech
papers.title_zh: LLM-ForcedAligner：一种非自回归的、高效的基于大语言的强制对齐算法，适用于多语言及长文本语音处理
papers.authors: Bingshen Mu, Xian Shi, Xiong Wang, Hexin Liu, Jin Xu, Lei Xie
papers.abstract: Forced alignment (FA) predicts start and end timestamps for words or characters in speech, but existing methods are language-specific and prone to cumulative temporal shifts. The multilingual speech understanding and long-sequence processing abilities of speech large language models (SLLMs) make them promising for FA in multilingual, crosslingual, and long-form speech settings. However, directly applying the next-token prediction paradigm of SLLMs to FA results in hallucinations and slow inference. To bridge the gap, we propose LLM-ForcedAligner, reformulating FA as a slot-filling paradigm: timestamps are treated as discrete indices, and special timestamp tokens are inserted as slots into the transcript. Conditioned on the speech embeddings and the transcript with slots, the SLLM directly predicts the time indices at slots. During training, causal attention masking with non-shifted input and label sequences allows each slot to predict its own timestamp index based on itself and preceding context, with loss computed only at slot positions. Dynamic slot insertion enables FA at arbitrary positions. Moreover, non-autoregressive inference is supported, avoiding hallucinations and improving speed. Experiments across multilingual, crosslingual, and long-form speech scenarios show that LLM-ForcedAligner achieves a 69% 78% relative reduction in accumulated averaging shift compared with prior methods. The checkpoint and inference code will be released later.
papers.abstract_zh: 强制对齐算法能够预测语音中单词或字符的起始和结束时间戳。然而，现有的方法都是针对特定语言的，且容易出现累积的时间偏移问题。多语言语音理解和长序列处理能力使得大语言模型在跨语言、多语言的长篇语音处理中表现出巨大的潜力。不过，直接将语言模型的下一个词预测范式应用于强制对齐会导致幻觉现象和推理速度变慢。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了LLM-ForcedAligner算法，将强制对齐重新定义为一种填充槽位的过程：时间戳被视为离散的索引，特殊的 timestamp 标记被插入到转录文本中的相应位置。基于语音嵌入数据和带有槽位的转录文本，语言模型能够直接预测这些槽位对应的时间索引。在训练过程中，通过因果注意力掩码技术和非偏移输入以及标签序列，每个槽位都可以根据自身及其前后上下文来预测自己的时间戳索引，而损失计算仅发生在槽位位置。动态槽位插入功能使得可以在任意位置进行强制对齐。此外，该算法还支持非自回归推理机制，从而避免了幻觉现象并提升了推理效率。在跨语言、多语言及长篇语音处理的实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，LLM-ForcedAligner在累积平均偏移量上分别实现了69%和78%的相对降低。相关的检查点和推理代码将在后续发布。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Forget What Matters, Keep the Rest: Selective Unlearning of Informative Tokens
papers.title_zh: 忘记那些无关紧要的东西，保留有用的信息：选择性地摒弃无用的信息标记
papers.authors: Seunghee Koh, Sunghyun Baek, Youngdong Kim, Junmo Kim
papers.abstract: Unlearning in large language models (LLMs) has emerged as a promising safeguard against adversarial behaviors. When the forgetting loss is applied uniformly without considering token-level semantic importance, model utility can be unnecessarily degraded. Recent studies have explored token-wise loss regularizers that prioritize informative tokens, but largely rely on ground-truth confidence or external linguistic parsers, which limits their ability to capture contextual information or the model’s overall predictive state. Intuitively, function words like “the” primarily serve syntactic roles and are highly predictable with little ambiguity, but informative words admit multiple plausible alternatives with greater uncertainty. Based on this intuition, we propose Entropy-guided Token Weighting (ETW), a token-level unlearning regularizer that uses entropy of the predictive distribution as a proxy for token informativeness. We demonstrate that informative tokens tend to have higher entropy, whereas structural tokens tend to have lower entropy. This behavior enables ETW to achieve more effective unlearning while better preserving model utility than existing token-level approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中实现“去学习”已成为防范敌对行为的一种有效手段。当不加考虑令牌级别的语义重要性而统一应用遗忘损失时，模型的效用可能会不必要地降低。最近的研究提出了一些基于令牌层面的损失正则化方法，这些方法优先考虑具有信息价值的令牌，但往往依赖于真实置信度或外部语言解析器，这限制了它们捕捉上下文信息或模型整体预测状态的能力。直观来说，像“the”这样的功能词主要承担句法作用，其含义非常明确，而具有信息价值的词汇则可能存在多种合理的替代含义，且不确定性更高。基于这一直觉，我们提出了熵引导的令牌权重分配方法——ETW。该方法利用预测分布的熵作为令牌信息价值的代理，从而实现对具有信息价值的令牌进行更有效的去学习处理，同时比现有的基于令牌层面的方法更能有效保护模型的效用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Latent-Condensed Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling
papers.title_zh: 隐式压缩变换器：实现高效长上下文建模的技术
papers.authors: Zeng You, Yaofo Chen, Qiuwu Chen, Ying Sun, Shuhai Zhang, Yingjian Li, Yaowei Wang, Mingkui Tan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) face significant challenges in processing long contexts due to the linear growth of the key-value (KV) cache and quadratic complexity of self-attention. Existing approaches address these bottlenecks separately: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) reduces the KV cache by projecting tokens into a low-dimensional latent space, while sparse attention reduces computation. However, sparse methods cannot operate natively on MLA’s compressed latent structure, missing opportunities for joint optimization. In this paper, we propose Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA), which directly condenses context within MLA’s latent space, where the representation is disentangled into semantic latent vectors and positional keys. LCA separately aggregates semantic vectors via query-aware pooling and preserves positional keys via anchor selection. This approach jointly reduces both computational cost and KV cache without adding parameters. Beyond MLA, LCA’s design is architecture-agnostic and readily extends to other attention mechanisms such as GQA. Theoretically, we prove a length-independent error bound. Experiments show LCA achieves up to 2.5× prefilling speedup and 90% KV cache reduction at 128K context while maintaining competitive performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在处理长文本时面临重大挑战，这主要是由于键值缓存的线性增长以及自注意力机制的二次复杂度问题。现有的方法分别解决了这些瓶颈问题：多头潜在注意力机制通过将令牌投影到低维潜在空间中来减少键值缓存的使用量，而稀疏注意力机制则降低了计算复杂度。然而，稀疏方法无法直接作用于多头潜在注意力机制所生成的压缩潜在结构，从而错过了联合优化的机会。在本文中，我们提出了潜在压缩注意力机制，该机制能够直接在多头潜在空间的范围内压缩上下文信息，使表示形式分解为语义潜在向量和位置键。通过查询感知的池化技术，我们可以分别聚合语义向量，同时通过锚点选择保留位置键。这种方法可以在不增加参数的情况下，同时降低计算成本和键值缓存的使用量。除了多头潜在注意力机制之外，潜在压缩注意力机制的设计具有架构无关性，因此可以轻松扩展到其他注意力机制中，如GQA。从理论上讲，我们已经证明了该机制具有与文本长度无关的错误界限。实验结果表明，潜在压缩注意力机制在128K上下文长度的情况下，能够实现高达2.5倍的预填充速度提升，并减少90%的键值缓存使用量，同时保持了竞争力的性能表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MedForge: Interpretable Medical Deepfake Detection via Forgery-aware Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MedForge：通过伪造意识推理实现可解释的医学深度伪造检测技术
papers.authors: Zhihui Chen, Kai He, Qingyuan Lei, Bin Pu, Jian Zhang, Yuling Xu, Mengling Feng
papers.abstract: Text-guided image editors can now manipulate authentic medical scans with high fidelity, enabling lesion implantation/removal that threatens clinical trust and safety. Existing defenses are inadequate for healthcare. Medical detectors are largely black-box, while MLLM-based explainers are typically post-hoc, lack medical expertise, and may hallucinate evidence on ambiguous cases. We present MedForge, a data-and-method solution for pre-hoc, evidence-grounded medical forgery detection. We introduce MedForge-90K, a large-scale benchmark of realistic lesion edits across 19 pathologies with expert-guided reasoning supervision via doctor inspection guidelines and gold edit locations. Building on it, MedForge-Reasoner performs localize-then-analyze reasoning, predicting suspicious regions before producing a verdict, and is further aligned with Forgery-aware GSPO to strengthen grounding and reduce hallucinations. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art detection accuracy and trustworthy, expert-aligned explanations.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本引导的图像编辑工具现在能够高精度地处理真实的医学扫描图像，从而实现对病变的植入或移除操作。然而，现有的防御措施对于医疗保健领域来说远远不够。目前的医学检测系统大多属于黑箱系统，而基于大语言模型的解释器则往往缺乏医学专业知识，并且在处理模糊案例时可能会出现错误解释。我们提出了MedForge这一数据与方法相结合的解决方案，用于事前进行基于证据的医学伪造检测。我们还开发了MedForge-90K这一大规模基准测试，该测试涵盖了19种病理类型的真实病变编辑场景，并通过医生审核指南和黄金编辑位置来指导专家级的推理过程。在此基础上，MedForge-Reasoner能够实现局部分析后再进行整体推理的过程，在得出判断之前就能预测出可疑区域。此外，该工具还与Forgery-aware GSPO进行了整合，以加强其准确性和减少错误解释。实验结果表明，该工具的检测精度处于业界领先水平，且提供的解释结果具有可信度和符合专家标准。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CrossGuard: Safeguarding MLLMs against Joint-Modal Implicit Malicious Attacks
papers.title_zh: CrossGuard：保护多模态机器学习模型免受联合模式式恶意攻击的侵害
papers.authors: Xu Zhang, Hao Li, Zhichao Lu
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong reasoning and perception capabilities but are increasingly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. While existing work focuses on explicit attacks, where malicious content resides in a single modality, recent studies reveal implicit attacks, in which benign text and image inputs jointly express unsafe intent. Such joint-modal threats are difficult to detect and remain underexplored, largely due to the scarcity of high-quality implicit data. We propose ImpForge, an automated red-teaming pipeline that leverages reinforcement learning with tailored reward modules to generate diverse implicit samples across 14 domains. Building on this dataset, we further develop CrossGuard, an intent-aware safeguard providing robust and comprehensive defense against both explicit and implicit threats. Extensive experiments across safe and unsafe benchmarks, implicit and explicit attacks, and multiple out-of-domain settings demonstrate that CrossGuard significantly outperforms existing defenses, including advanced MLLMs and guardrails, achieving stronger security while maintaining high utility. This offers a balanced and practical solution for enhancing MLLM robustness against real-world multimodal threats. Our code is released https://github.com/ZhangXu0963/CrossGuard.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在推理和感知能力方面表现出色，但越来越容易受到劫持攻击的威胁。虽然现有的研究主要集中在显式攻击上，即恶意内容仅存在于某一特定模态中，但最近的研究揭示了隐性攻击的存在——在这种攻击中，良性的文本和图像输入共同表达了不安全的意图。这种跨模态威胁很难被检测出来，而且由于高质量隐性数据的稀缺性，这类威胁仍然没有得到充分研究。我们提出了ImpForge这一自动化红队策略工具，它利用强化学习以及定制的奖励机制来生成涵盖14个领域的多样化隐性样本。基于这个数据集，我们进一步开发了CrossGuard，这是一种具有意图感知功能的防御机制，能够针对显式和隐性威胁提供强大而全面的防御。通过在不同安全与不安全基准测试、隐式与显式攻击环境以及多种领域设置下的广泛实验表明，CrossGuard在性能上显著优于现有的防御机制，包括先进的多模态语言模型和常规防御措施。它能够在保持高实用性的同时，实现更强的安全性。这为提升多模态语言模型对现实世界威胁的抵御能力提供了平衡且实用的解决方案。我们的代码已发布在https://github.com/ZhangXu0963/CrossGuard上。

papers.title: Can Spectral-Clipping Enable Better Learning While Forgetting Less for Low-Rank Adaptation?
papers.title_zh: 在低秩学习过程中，光谱裁剪能否帮助实现更好的学习效果，同时减少记忆负担？
papers.authors: Hyowon Wi, Noseong Park
papers.abstract: In recent years, low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as a significant paradigm that freezes pre-trained weights and introduces small, learnable adapters instead of fine-tuning the full set of parameters. In this work, we uncover several key insights regarding the \textit{singular} components of network parameters based on Singular Value Decomposition (SVD).Firstly, the \textit{principal} singular components with large singular values in pre-trained network parameters can be effectively reused during fine-tuning, whereas the \textit{minor} components with smaller singular values are more task-specific and require substantial adaptation. Secondly, we first establish the theoretical connection that the uncontrolled growth of singular values in LoRA adapters leads to the forgetting of pre-trained knowledge — a well-known issue referred to as \textit{catastrophic forgetting}.Building on these observations, we propose \textbf{SCLoRA}, which injects parameterized singular components with spectral clipping into the pre-trained model in a way that is aware of the spectral distribution of the pre-trained model. \textbf{SCLoRA} effectively adapts to new tasks by focusing updates on components that require adaptation, while simultaneously alleviating catastrophic forgetting. We conduct extensive experiments and demonstrate that \textbf{SCLoRA} not only improves downstream performance but also effectively retains pre-trained knowledge.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，低秩适应（LoRA）作为一种重要的范式逐渐兴起，它不再对全部参数进行微调，而是冻结了预训练的权重，并引入一些可学习的小型适配器。在这项研究中，我们通过奇异值分解（SVD）技术，发现了关于网络参数中“奇异”成分的几个关键见解。首先，预训练网络参数中那些具有较大奇异值的“主要”奇异成分可以在微调过程中被有效重用，而那些具有较小奇异值的“次要”成分则更具任务特异性，需要大量的调整。其次，我们首次证明了LoRA适配器中的奇异值无控制地增长会导致预训练知识的遗忘——这一现象被称为“灾难性遗忘”。基于这些观察结果，我们提出了**SCLoRA**算法。该算法将带有谱裁剪的参数化奇异成分注入到预训练模型中，同时考虑到预训练模型的谱分布特性。**SCLoRA**能够通过专注于需要调整的成分来有效适应新任务，同时避免了灾难性遗忘的问题。我们通过广泛的实验证明，**SCLoRA**不仅提升了下游任务的性能，还有效地保留了预训练的知识。

papers.title: Re^3: Relevance & Recency Retrieval for Mitigating Temporal Hallucination
papers.title_zh: 再版：相关性与时效性检索在缓解时间幻觉中的应用
papers.authors: Jiawei Cao, Jie Ouyang, Mingyue Cheng, Zhaomeng Zhou, Chunli Liu, Yupeng Li, Zirui Liu, Shijin Wang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a mainstream approach to mitigating hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs), yet in dynamic real-world scenarios, such as weather forecasting or evolving news events, existing retrievers suffer from both temporal-semantic misalignment and outdated-document interference. To address this, we propose Relevance Recency Retrieval (Re^3), a novel framework that mitigates temporal hallucinations via two core components: a Time-Aware Dual Relevance Encoder that embeds heterogeneous temporal signals into the semantic space to ensure retrieval fidelity, and a Conflict-Aware Recency Filter that performs listwise arbitration to identify and suppress obsolete factual versions. To rigorously evaluate this setting, we introduce Re^2 Bench, a large-scale benchmark comprising over 1.3 million instances designed to assess system robustness in realistic environments where temporal constraints and conflicting factual versions coexist. Experiments on three public benchmarks and Re^2 Bench demonstrate that Re^3 consistently outperforms the strongest baselines by an average of 9.7% in generation accuracy, with gains of up to 25.2% on challenging dynamic tasks, while demonstrating robustness across diverse RAG settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）是一种主流方法，用于减轻大语言模型中的幻觉问题。然而在动态的现实场景中，比如天气预报或不断变化的新闻事件时，现有的检索技术存在时间语义不一致以及文档过时等问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了相关性最近性检索（Re^3）框架。该框架通过两个核心组件来减轻时间上的幻觉问题：一个是时间感知的双重相关性编码器，它将不同时间维度的信号嵌入到语义空间中，以确保检索的准确性；另一个是冲突感知的最近性过滤器，它能够进行列表式仲裁，以识别并剔除过时的事实版本。为了严格评估这一框架的性能，我们引入了Re^2基准测试集，这是一个包含超过130万个实例的大规模基准测试，旨在评估系统在具有时间限制和冲突事实版本的现实环境中的鲁棒性。在三个公共基准测试集以及Re^2基准测试集上的实验表明，Re^3在生成准确率方面始终优于最强大的基线模型，平均高出9.7%，在具有挑战性的动态任务上甚至能提升25.2%。同时，该框架还表现出在不同RAG场景下的鲁棒性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: TeCES: Collaborative Geometric Knowledge Representation Framework under Evolving Fact Snapshots
papers.title_zh: TeCES：基于动态事实快照的协作几何知识表示框架
papers.authors: Jiujiang Guo, Zhengliang Guo, Kai Wang, Meiyang Wang, Dehua Peng, Shaozu Yuan, Chengyin Hu, Shuan Ai, Yiwei Wei
papers.abstract: Existing knowledge graph completion research is gradually shifting from representing logical semantics of static facts to modeling evolving semantics of temporal facts, yet lacks collaborative modeling of both within a unified framework. To this end, we use concept of snapshots to decompose fact features into two complementary mechanisms: (a) intra-snapshot semantic coupling, where entities and relations exhibit snapshot-specific meanings through multidimensional interactions; (b) trans-snapshot evolutionary synergy, where relations between entities evolve across snapshots and manifest varying states. These snapshot mechanisms jointly reveal underlying logic of facts. To track them, we propose TeCES, a framework for high-fidelity modeling of evolving snapshots. TeCES embeds facts into a 2-grade geometric algebra (GA) system to capture complex semantics via multilevel structures. Temporal information is attached to each entity for mapping into snapshot spaces, while relations and timestamps are reconfigured into composite GA representations. Geometric products enable multidimensional interactions, revealing relation state changes over time. Lastly, the head entity at each snapshot combines with fused temporal-relational representation via geometric product to approximate the target tail entity at multiple levels. Overall, TeCES supports joint modeling of evolving snapshots within a lightweight GA system and significantly outperforms SOTA models on six benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的知识图谱补全研究正在逐渐从表示静态事实的逻辑语义转向建模动态事实的演变语义，但缺乏在统一框架内对这两种情况进行协同建模的方法。为此，我们引入了“快照”这一概念，将事实特征分解为两种互补的机制：(a) 快照内部的语义耦合，即实体和关系通过多维交互展现出特定于快照的含义；(b) 快照之间的演变协同，即实体之间的关系在多个快照中不断演变，呈现出不同的状态。这些快照机制共同揭示了事实背后的逻辑。为了追踪这些机制，我们提出了TeCES框架，用于高保真度地建模演变中的快照。TeCES将事实嵌入到两级几何代数系统中，通过多层次结构来捕捉复杂的语义。时间信息被附加到每个实体上，以便映射到快照空间中；而关系和时间戳则被重新配置为复合几何代数表示。几何乘积能够实现多维交互，从而揭示关系随时间的变化情况。最后，每个快照中的头部实体通过几何乘积与融合的时间-关系表示相结合，从而在多个层面上近似得到目标尾部实体。总体而言，TeCES能够在轻量级几何代数系统内对演变中的快照进行联合建模，并且在六个基准测试中的表现均优于现有最先进的模型。

papers.title: MicroC-KT: Modeling Community Effect via Learning Micro-Environment for Evidence-Grounded Explainable Knowledge Tracing
papers.title_zh: MicroC-KT：通过学习微观环境来模拟社区效应，从而生成基于证据的、可解释的知识追踪方法
papers.authors: Zhiyi Duan, Zixing Shi, Bing Jia, Qi Wang
papers.abstract: Knowledge Tracing (KT) is essential for tracking students’ evolving knowledge states and predicting their future performance. While current graph-based methods focus on exercise-concept relations, they often overlook the inherent group structures among students. Similarly, emerging LLM-based approaches rely on individual histories, lacking the broader context of group references and contrastive evidence. As a result, existing individual-isolation paradigms fail to provide stable predictions and evidence-based explanations. To bridge this gap, we propose Micro-Community Knowledge Tracing (MicroC-KT), a framework that incorporates learning micro-environments to provide social-cognitive anchors for KT. MicroC-KT identifies latent learning communities via hypergraph modeling and generates dual-granular summaries to facilitate community matching and peer retrieval. By extracting contrastive group evidence, the model prompts an LLM to generate both accurate answer predictions and verifiable analysis reports. Experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that MicroC-KT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in predictive performance while providing more reliable and evidence-based explanations.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识追踪（KT）对于跟踪学生不断变化的知识状态以及预测他们未来的表现至关重要。目前基于图的方法主要关注练习与概念之间的关系，却常常忽略了学生之间存在的群体结构。同样，新兴的基于大语言模型的算法则依赖于个体历史数据，缺乏关于群体参考和对比性证据的整体视角。因此，现有的孤立个体模型无法提供稳定可靠的预测结果和基于证据的解释。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了微社区知识追踪框架——MicroC-KT。该框架通过整合学习微环境，为KT提供了社会认知基础。MicroC-KT通过超图建模识别潜在的学习社区，并生成双粒度摘要，以方便社区匹配和同伴检索。通过提取对比性群体证据，模型能够促使大语言模型生成准确的答案预测和可验证的分析报告。在四个公开数据集上的实验表明，MicroC-KT在预测性能上显著优于现有最先进的基线方法，同时还能提供更可靠、基于证据的解释。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ImF: Embedding an Implicit Fingerprint in Your Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ImF：在您的大型语言模型中嵌入隐式指纹信息
papers.authors: Jiaxuan Wu, Wanli Peng, Hang fu, Xue Yiming, Juan Wen
papers.abstract: Training and serving large language models (LLMs) is resource-intensive, making reliable intellectual property (IP) protection and black-box ownership verification increasingly important.Model fingerprinting enables such verification by injecting a small set of secret query–response behaviors, but many existing fingerprints rely on explicit markers or predetermined outputs that are weakly grounded in prompt semantics.This semantic mismatch yields atypical fingerprint responses, reduces stealthiness, and exposes fingerprints to removal by response normalization.We formalize this vulnerability via a new removal attack, Generation Revision Intervention (GRI), which applies system-prompt-level revision and response standardization to steer models toward typical answers, substantially compromising representative injected baselines.To close this semantic gap, we propose the Implicit Fingerprints (ImF): we encode ownership information into a natural-looking target response y via linguistic steganography, then derive a CoT-augmented query x that embeds semantic cues from y to guide the model toward an output sufficiently close to y for decoding-based verification.Experiments on 15 LLMs show that ImF improves stealthiness and remains verifiable under model updates and deployment-time prompt interventions; additional analyses further show stability under common decoding variation and realistic related-model partial merging.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练和调优大语言模型需要大量的资源投入，因此可靠的知识产权保护以及黑盒所有权验证变得愈发重要。模型指纹技术可以通过注入一组特定的查询-响应行为来实现这种验证，但许多现有的指纹技术依赖于显式的标记或预先确定的输出结果，而这些标记和输出与提示的语义联系并不紧密。这种语义上的不匹配会导致非典型的指纹响应，从而降低模型的隐蔽性，并使得指纹容易被通过响应标准化来去除。我们通过将这种漏洞形式化，提出了一种新的去除方法——生成修订干预法（GRI）。该方法通过对系统提示进行修订和响应标准化处理，引导模型给出符合预期的答案，从而大幅削弱了那些被注入的典型基准数据的可信度。为了弥补这一语义上的差距，我们提出了隐式指纹技术（ImF）：我们通过语言隐藏技术将所有权信息编码到看似自然的目标响应中，然后生成一个带有上下文信息的查询，该查询包含了来自目标响应的语义线索，从而引导模型给出与目标响应足够接近的输出，以便于基于解码的验证。在15个大语言模型上的实验表明，隐式指纹技术能够提升模型的隐蔽性，并且在模型更新或提示参数调整时仍然能够被验证；进一步的分析还表明，该技术能够在常见的解码变化和现实中的相关模型部分合并情况下保持稳定。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Temp-R1: A Unified Autonomous Agent for Complex Temporal KGQA via Reverse Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: Temp-R1：一种统一的自主代理，用于通过逆向课程强化学习来实现复杂的时序知识图谱优化
papers.authors: Zhaoyan Gong, Zhiqiang Liu, Songze Li, Xiaoke Guo, Yuanxiang Liu, Xinle Deng, Zhizhen Liu, Lei Liang, Huajun Chen, Wen Zhang
papers.abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) is inherently challenging, as it requires sophisticated reasoning over dynamic facts with multi-hop dependencies and complex temporal constraints. Existing methods rely on fixed workflows and expensive closed-source APIs, limiting flexibility and scalability. We propose Temp-R1, the first autonomous end-to-end agent for TKGQA trained through reinforcement learning. To address cognitive overload in single-action reasoning, we expand the action space with specialized internal actions alongside external action. To prevent shortcut learning on simple questions, we introduce reverse curriculum learning that trains on difficult questions first, forcing the development of sophisticated reasoning before transferring to easier cases. Our 8B-parameter Temp-R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance on MultiTQ and TimelineKGQA, improving 19.8% over strong baselines on complex questions. Our work establishes a new paradigm for autonomous temporal reasoning agents. The code is available at https://github.com/zjukg/Temp-R1.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间知识图谱问答（TKGQA）本身具有很大的挑战性，因为它需要对具有多跳依赖关系的动态事实进行复杂的推理，同时还要处理复杂的时间约束条件。现有的方法依赖于固定的工作流程和昂贵的开源API，这限制了系统的灵活性和可扩展性。我们提出了Temp-R1，这是第一个通过强化学习训练出来的自主端到端时间知识图谱问答代理。为了应对单动作推理中的认知负担，我们扩展了动作空间，加入了专门的内部动作以及外部动作。为了防止在简单问题上出现捷径学习现象，我们引入了逆向课程学习机制——先通过对难题的训练来培养复杂的推理能力，然后再转移到较简单的案例上。我们的Temp-R1模型拥有80亿参数，在MultiTQ和时间线知识图谱问答任务上取得了领先的性能表现，相比优秀的基线模型，在复杂问题上的性能提升了19.8%。我们的工作为自主时间推理代理开辟了新的方向。代码可以在https://github.com/zjukg/Temp-R1获取。

papers.title: S2G-RAG: Structured Sufficiency and Gap Judging for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented QA
papers.title_zh: S2G-RAG：结构化充分性评估与迭代检索增强型问答的差距判断方法
papers.authors: Minghan Li, Junjie Zou, Xinxuan Lv, Chao Zhang, Guodong Zhou
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds language models in external evidence, but multi-hop question answering remains difficult because iterative pipelines must control what to retrieve next and when the available evidence is adequate. In practice, systems may answer from incomplete evidence chains, or they may accumulate redundant or distractor-heavy text that interferes with later retrieval and reasoning. We propose S2G-RAG (Structured Sufficiency and Gap-judging RAG), an iterative framework with an explicit controller, S2G-Judge. At each turn, S2G-Judge predicts whether the current evidence memory supports answering and, if not, outputs structured gap items that describe the missing information. We map these gap items into the next retrieval query, producing stable multi-turn retrieval trajectories. To reduce noise accumulation, we maintain a sentence-level Evidence Context by extracting a compact set of relevant sentences from retrieved documents. Experiments on TriviaQA, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA show that S2G-RAG improves multi-hop QA performance and robustness under multi-turn retrieval. Furthermore, S2G-RAG can be integrated into existing RAG pipelines with a lightweight component, without modifying the search engine or retraining the generator.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）将语言模型基于外部证据进行训练，但多跳问答仍然具有挑战性，因为迭代流程需要控制下一步要检索的内容以及现有证据是否足够。在实践中，系统可能会基于不完整的证据链进行回答，或者会积累大量冗余或干扰性的文本，这会影响后续的检索和推理过程。我们提出了S2G-RAG（结构化充分性和差距判断RAG），这是一个带有明确控制器的迭代框架，即S2G-Judge。在每一轮过程中，S2G-Judge会预测当前证据记忆是否支持回答，如果不支持，则输出描述缺失信息的结构化差距项。我们将这些差距项映射到下一轮检索查询中，从而生成稳定的多轮检索轨迹。为了减少噪声积累，我们通过从检索到的文档中提取一组相关的句子，来维护句子级别的证据上下文。在TriviaQA、HotpotQA和2WikiMultiHopQA上的实验表明，S2G-RAG提升了多跳问答的性能，并增强了在多轮检索下的鲁棒性。此外，S2G-RAG可以作为一个轻量级组件集成到现有的RAG流程中，而无需修改搜索引擎或重新训练生成器。

papers.title: Jailbreaking Multimodal Large Language Models using Multi-Clip Video
papers.title_zh: 通过多片段视频实现对多模态大语言模型的越狱处理
papers.authors: Choongwon Kang, Seungjong Sun, Hyunmin Jun, Jang Hyun Kim
papers.abstract: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced to process video inputs, concerns have emerged about their potential for malicious misuse. Prior jailbreak studies have shown that safety alignment in MLLMs can be bypassed through visual inputs, yet it remains unclear which properties of video inputs induce this vulnerability. To address this gap, we introduce Multi-Clip Video (MCV) SafetyBench, a dataset of 2,920 videos designed to evaluate how the diversity of video inputs affects the vulnerability of MLLMs. Each video consists of multiple short clips depicting diverse contexts related to a harmful query. Experiments on eight representative video MLLMs show that attack success consistently increases with the number of clips. Our results further indicate that the video modality is (1) more vulnerable than the image modality, (2) more vulnerable to dynamic videos than to static videos, and (3) more vulnerable when videos contain more diverse contexts. Building on these findings, we propose a defense strategy that leverages the relative robustness of the image modality. Warning: This paper may contain potentially offensive content.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着多模态大语言模型在处理视频输入方面取得进展，人们开始担忧其可能被恶意利用的问题。之前的越狱研究表明，通过视觉输入可以绕过大语言模型中的安全对齐机制，但尚不清楚是视频输入的哪些特性导致了这种漏洞。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了“多片段视频安全测试集”，该数据集包含2,920个视频，旨在评估视频输入的多样性对大语言模型脆弱性的影响。每个视频由多个短片段组成，这些短片段描绘了与有害查询相关的不同场景。在八个代表性的视频大语言模型上的实验表明，攻击的成功率随着片段数量的增加而上升。我们的研究结果还表明，视频模式比图像模式更容易受到攻击；动态视频比静态视频更容易受到攻击；而且，当视频包含更多样化的场景时，其脆弱性会进一步增加。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种防御策略，该策略利用了图像模式的相对鲁棒性。警告：本文可能包含一些可能引起不适的内容。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: HAG: Hierarchical Demographic Tree-based Agent Generation for Topic-Adaptive Simulation
papers.title_zh: HAG：基于层次化人口统计树的智能体生成方法，适用于主题自适应仿真场景
papers.authors: Rongxin Chen, Tianyu Wu, Bingbing Xu, JiaTang Luo, Xiucheng Xu, Huawei Shen
papers.abstract: High-fidelity agent initialization is crucial for credible Agent-Based Modeling across diverse domains. A robust framework should be Topic-Adaptive, capturing macro-level joint distributions while ensuring micro-level individual rationality. Existing approaches fall into two categories: static data-based retrieval methods that fail to adapt to unseen topics absent from the data, and LLM-based generation methods that lack macro-level distribution awareness, resulting in inconsistencies between micro-level persona attributes and reality. To address these problems, we propose HAG, a Hierarchical Agent Generation framework that formalizes population generation as a two-stage decision process. Firstly, utilizing a World Knowledge Model to infer hierarchical conditional probabilities to construct the Topic-Adaptive Tree, achieving macro-level distribution alignment. Then, grounded real-world data, instantiation and agentic augmentation are carried out to ensure micro-level consistency. Given the lack of specialized evaluation, we establish a multi-domain benchmark and a comprehensive PACE evaluation framework. Extensive experiments show that HAG significantly outperforms representative baselines, reducing population alignment errors by an average of 37.7% and enhancing sociological consistency by 18.8%.
papers.abstract_zh: 高保真度代理初始化对于不同领域中的可信基于代理的建模至关重要。一个强大的框架应该具有主题自适应能力，能够捕捉宏观层面的联合分布，同时确保微观层面的个体合理性。现有的方法可以分为两类：一类是基于静态数据的检索方法，这类方法无法适应数据中没有出现的未知主题；另一类是基于大语言模型的生成方法，这类方法缺乏宏观层面的分布意识，导致微观层面的角色属性与现实之间存在不一致性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了HAG——一种分层代理生成框架，它将代理群体的生成过程抽象为两个阶段的决策过程。首先，利用世界知识模型来推断分层条件概率，从而构建出具有主题自适应特性的树状结构，实现宏观层面的分布对齐。然后，通过结合现实世界的数据、代理实例化和代理增强技术，来确保微观层面的一致性。由于缺乏专门的评估方法，我们建立了一个多领域的基准测试以及一个全面的PAE评估框架。大量的实验表明，HAG在性能上显著优于现有的基准模型，平均减少了37.7%的群体对齐误差，并提升了18.8%的社会学一致性。

papers.title: Stable-RAG: Mitigating Retrieval-Permutation-Induced Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: Stable-RAG：缓解检索增强生成中的检索-置换诱导幻觉问题
papers.authors: Qianchi Zhang, Hainan Zhang, Liang Pang, Hong-Wei Zheng, Zhiming Zheng
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a key paradigm for reducing factual hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs), yet little is known about how the order of retrieved documents affects model behavior. We empirically show that under a Top-5 retrieval setting with the gold document included, LLM answers vary substantially across permutations of the retrieved set, even when the gold document is fixed in the first position. This reveals a previously underexplored sensitivity to retrieval permutations. Although existing robust RAG methods focus primarily on enhancing LLM robustness to low-quality retrieval and mitigating positional bias to distribute attention fairly over long contexts, neither approach directly addresses permutation sensitivity. In this paper, we propose Stable-RAG, which exploits permutation sensitivity estimation to mitigate permutation-induced hallucinations. Stable-RAG runs the generator under multiple retrieval orders, clusters hidden states, and decodes from a cluster-center representation that captures the dominant reasoning pattern. It then uses these reasoning results to align hallucinated outputs toward the correct answer, encouraging the model to produce consistent and accurate predictions across document permutations. Experiments on three QA datasets show that Stable-RAG improves answer accuracy, reasoning consistency, and generalization across datasets, retrievers, and input lengths compared with strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为减少大语言模型（LLM）中事实幻觉的关键技术，但关于检索到的文档顺序对模型行为的影响却知之甚少。我们通过实验表明，在包含黄金文档的Top-5检索设置下，即使黄金文档固定在第一个位置，LLM的回答也会因检索集合的不同排列而存在显著差异。这揭示了之前被忽视的对检索排列敏感性的问题。虽然现有的稳健RAG方法主要致力于提高LLM对低质量检索的鲁棒性，并缓解位置偏见，从而公平地分配注意力到长文本中，但这些方法并未直接解决排列敏感性问题。在本文中，我们提出了Stable-RAG算法，该算法利用排列敏感性估计来减轻由排列引起的幻觉现象。Stable-RAG在多种检索顺序下运行生成器，对隐藏状态进行聚类处理，并从捕获主导推理模式的聚类中心表示中进行解码。然后，它利用这些推理结果来调整幻觉输出，使其与正确答案保持一致，从而促使模型在不同文档排列下产生一致且准确的预测。在三个问答数据集上的实验表明，与强大的基线方法相比，Stable-RAG能够提高答案的准确性、推理的一致性以及在不同数据集、检索器和输入长度下的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Logical to Computational Sparsity: Structure-Aware Block-Sparse Attention for Long-Code Completion
papers.title_zh: 从逻辑到计算上的稀疏性：基于结构感知的块稀疏注意力机制在长代码生成中的应用
papers.authors: Yanli Wang, Yanlin Wang, Bowen Zhang, Yiwei Zhang, Daya Guo, Jiachi Chen, Hongyu Zhang, Zibin Zheng
papers.abstract: Code Large Language Models face critical Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) latency challenges when handling long code completion due to the quadratic complexity (O(n^2)) of attention mechanisms. While existing sparse attention methods attempt to address this issue, they suffer from three key limitations: (1) general sparse patterns cause excessive accuracy degradation without considering code structure, (2) code-specific methods achieve only logical sparsity without actual computational speedup, and (3) limited adaptation to complex scenarios such as repository-level completion. We propose SabreCoder, a training-free Structure-aware block-sparse attention mechanism that bridges the gap between logical and computational sparsity. SabreCoder parses code into semantic chunks, constructs chunk-level sparse patterns through dependency analysis and similarity matching, and maps them to GPU-friendly block-sparse formats. Extensive experiments on LCC and CrossCodeEval benchmarks demonstrate that SabreCoder reduces TTFT by 45-55% while maintaining accuracy within 3% of dense attention.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在处理长代码补全时面临着严重的“令牌首次出现时间”延迟问题，这是由于注意力机制的二次方复杂度（O(n^2)）所导致的。虽然现有的稀疏注意力方法试图解决这一问题，但它们存在三个主要缺陷：(1) 一般的稀疏模式会导致准确性严重下降，而无需考虑代码结构；(2) 针对特定代码的稀疏方法只能实现逻辑上的稀疏性，而无法提高计算效率；(3) 无法适应复杂的场景，例如仓库级别的代码补全。我们提出了SabreCoder——一种无需训练的、具有结构感知的块级稀疏注意力机制，它能够弥合逻辑稀疏性和计算效率之间的差距。SabreCoder将代码分解为语义块，通过依赖分析和相似性匹配构建块级稀疏模式，并将其转换为适合GPU处理的块级稀疏格式。在LCC和CrossCodeEval基准测试中的大量实验表明，SabreCoder能够将“令牌首次出现时间”缩短45-55%，同时保持与密集注意力方式相当的3%以内的准确性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CogEvolve: A Multimodal Benchmark for Evaluating Relational Reasoning in Semantic Extension
papers.title_zh: CogEvolve：一种用于评估语义扩展领域关系推理能力的多模态基准测试工具
papers.authors: Jingjie Zeng, Huayang Li, Liang Yang, Yuanyuan Sun, Shaowu Zhang, Hongfei Lin
papers.abstract: Human cognition excels at extending knowledge through analogy, where word meanings evolve along structured pathways from concrete prototypes to abstract senses via metaphor and metonymy. Do Large Language Models (LLMs) internalize this generative logic, or merely mimic statistical patterns? To investigate this, we introduce CogEvolve, a cognitive linguistic benchmark designed to test these evolutionary pathways across textual and visual modalities. Our evaluation reveals a distinct cognitive profile: models function as “Super-Associators” expert at static recognition yet fail at causal reasoning. In text, they exhibit a Frequency-Primacy Conflation, confusing statistical prevalence with cognitive basicness. Crucially, this reasoning collapses further in the visual domain. We term this deficit the Ungrounded Arrow: models possess high-fidelity concept representations (the “dots”) but lack the transformational operators (the “arrows”) essential for true relational understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类的认知能力在通过类比来扩展知识方面表现出色。词语的含义是通过隐喻和转喻，从具体的原型逐渐发展到抽象的概念。那么，大语言模型是否也掌握了这种生成逻辑呢？还是仅仅模仿了统计模式呢？为了研究这个问题，我们引入了CogEvolve这一认知语言学基准测试工具，旨在检验这些进化过程在文本和视觉领域中的表现。我们的评估结果显示出明显的认知特征：这些模型在静态识别方面表现出色，但在因果推理方面却存在不足。在文本处理中，它们会出现频率优先的混淆现象，将统计上的普遍性误认为是认知上的基础性。而在视觉领域，这种推理缺陷表现得更为明显。我们将这种缺陷称为“无根基的箭头”：这些模型虽然拥有高精度的概念表征（“点”），但却缺乏实现真正关系理解所需的转换操作（“箭头”）。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Towards Privacy-Preserving Large Language Model: Text-free Inference Through Alignment and Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 迈向保护隐私的大型语言模型：通过对齐与适应实现无需文本的推理
papers.authors: Jeongho Yoon, Chanhee Park, Yongchan Chun, Hyeonseok Moon, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Current LLM-based services typically require users to submit raw text regardless of its sensitivity. While intuitive, such practice introduces substantial privacy risks, as unauthorized access may expose personal, medical, or legal information. Although prior defenses strived to mitigate these risks, they often incur substantial computational overhead and degrade model performance. To overcome this privacy-efficiency trade-off, we introduce Privacy-Preserving Fine-Tuning (PPFT), a novel training pipeline that eliminates the need for transmitting raw prompt text while maintaining a favorable balance between privacy preservation and model utility for both clients and service providers. Our approach operates in two stages: first, we train a client-side encoder together with a server-side projection module and LLM, enabling the server to condition on k-pooled prompt embeddings instead of raw text; second, we fine-tune the projection module and LLM on private, domain-specific data using noise-injected embeddings, allowing effective adaptation without exposing plain text prompts and requiring access to the decoder’s internal parameters. Extensive experiments on domain-specific and general benchmarks demonstrate that PPFT achieves a striking balance between privacy and utility, maintaining competitive performance with minimal degradation compared to noise-free upper bounds.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前基于大语言模型的服務通常要求用户提交原始文本，而不考虑文本的敏感性。虽然这种做法很直观，但也会带来巨大的隐私风险，因为未经授权的访问可能会泄露个人、医疗或法律信息。尽管之前的防御措施试图减轻这些风险，但它们往往会导致大量的计算负担，并降低模型性能。为了克服这种隐私与效率之间的权衡问题，我们提出了一种名为“隐私保护微调”的新训练方法。该方法无需传输原始提示文本，同时能在隐私保护与客户和服务提供商的模型效用之间实现良好的平衡。我们的方法分为两个阶段：首先，我们训练一个客户端编码器以及一个服务器端投影模块和大语言模型，使得服务器能够使用k个混合嵌入而不是原始文本来进行推理；其次，我们使用注入噪声的私有领域数据来微调投影模块和大语言模型，从而实现有效的适应，同时不会暴露原始的提示文本，也无需访问解码器的内部参数。在针对特定领域和普通基准测试进行的广泛实验中表明，PPFT在隐私与效用之间取得了显著的平衡，其性能与无噪声情况下的上限相比几乎没有下降。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VisRet: Visualization Improves Knowledge-Intensive Text-to-Image Retrieval
papers.title_zh: VisRet：可视化技术提升了知识密集型文本到图像检索的效果
papers.authors: Di Wu, Yixin Wan, Kai-Wei Chang
papers.abstract: Text-to-image retrieval (T2I retrieval) remains challenging because cross-modal embeddings often behave as bags of concepts, underrepresenting structured visual relationships such as pose and viewpoint. We proposeVisualize-then-Retrieve (VisRet), a retrieval paradigm that mitigates this limitation of cross-modal similarity alignment. VisRet first projects textual queries into the image modality via T2I generation, then performs retrieval within the image modality to bypass the weaknesses of cross-modal retrievers in recognizing subtle visual-spatial features. Across four benchmarks (Visual-RAG, INQUIRE-Rerank, Microsoft COCO, and our new Visual-RAG-ME featuring multi-entity comparisons), VisRet substantially outperforms cross-modal similarity matching and baselines that recast T2I retrieval as text-to-text similarity matching, improving nDCG@30 by 0.125 on average with CLIP as the retriever and by 0.121 with E5-V. For downstream question answering, VisRet increases accuracy on Visual-RAG and Visual-RAG-ME by 3.8% and 15.7% in top-1 retrieval, and by 3.9% and 11.1% in top-10 retrieval. Ablation studies show compatibility with different T2I instruction LLMs, T2I generation models, and downstream LLMs. VisRet provides a simple yet effective perspective for advancing in text-image retrieval. Our code and the new benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/xiaowu0162/Visualize-then-Retrieve.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到图像检索（T2I检索）仍然具有挑战性，因为跨模态嵌入通常表现为概念的集合，无法充分反映诸如姿态和视角等结构化视觉关系。我们提出了“先可视化再检索”（VisRet）的检索方法，该方法能够缓解跨模态相似性对齐带来的限制。VisRet首先通过T2I生成将文本查询映射到图像模态，然后在图像模态内进行检索，从而绕过跨模态检索器在识别细微的视觉空间特征方面的弱点。在四个基准测试（Visual-RAG、INQUIRE-Rerank、Microsoft COCO以及我们的新基准Visual-RAG-ME，后者支持多实体比较）中，VisRet在性能上显著优于跨模态相似性匹配和那些将T2I检索重新定义为文本到文本相似性匹配的基线方法。使用CLIP作为检索器时，VisRet的平均nDCG@30提升了0.125；使用E5-V时则提升了0.121。对于下游问答任务，VisRet在Visual-RAG和Visual-RAG-ME上的准确率分别提高了3.8%和15.7%，在Top-1检索方面分别提高了3.9%和11.1%。消融研究表明，VisRet能够与不同的T2I指令LLM、T2I生成模型以及下游LLM兼容。VisRet为推进文本-图像检索领域提供了一个简单而有效的解决方案。我们的代码和新的基准测试可在https://github.com/xiaowu0162/Visualize-then-Retrieve获取。

papers.title: Selective Knowledge Distillation: Fusing LLM Semantic Strengths with DNN Efficiency for Binary Code Similarity Detection
papers.title_zh: 选择性知识蒸馏：结合大语言模型的语义优势与深度神经网络的高效性，用于二进制代码相似性检测
papers.authors: Shize Zhou, Peiyu Liu, Lirong Fu, Tong Ye, Wenhai Wang
papers.abstract: Binary Code Similarity Detection (BCSD) plays a vital role in various security applications, including vulnerability identification, malware analysis, and code plagiarism detection. With the growing adoption of deep neural networks (DNNs), substantial progress has been made in recognizing and classifying similar code segments. However, DNN-based BCSD methods often exhibit low accuracy and robustness because they struggle to capture fine-grained and high-level program semantics. In contrast, such semantics are typically captured through natural language interpretations of source code by large language models (LLMs). Yet, LLM-based BCSD methods are constrained by their large model sizes and high inference latency. To alleviate these limitations, this paper proposes BinSKD. The key idea is to leverage an LLM-based BCSD method as the teacher model and transfer its knowledge of high-level program semantics to various DNN-based student models. Specifically, to avoid propagating errors from the teacher to the student, we introduce selective distillation, selecting targets with accurate semantics according to their detection retrieval. In addition, to mitigate the noise introduced by a number of negative samples during distillation, we further propose discrepancy-weighted sampling to focus on the sampleswhere the student’s prediction notably deviates from the teacher’s. Our experiments show that BinSKD yields Recall@1 improvements of 14.5%–91.2% for DNN-based BCSD methods and enables HermesSim to match the teacher’s performance with orders-of-magnitude efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 二进制代码相似性检测（BCSD）在多种安全应用中发挥着重要作用，包括漏洞识别、恶意软件分析以及代码抄袭检测。随着深度神经网络（DNN）的广泛应用，在识别和分类相似代码段方面取得了显著进展。然而，基于DNN的BCSD方法往往精度较低且鲁棒性较差，因为它们难以捕捉到细粒度和高层次的程序语义。相比之下，这类语义通常可以通过大语言模型对源代码进行自然语言解释来获取。不过，基于LLM的BCSD方法受到模型规模庞大和推理延迟较长的限制。为了缓解这些限制，本文提出了BinSKD方法。其核心思想是将基于LLM的BCSD方法作为教师模型，将其关于高层次程序语义的知识传递给各种基于DNN的学生模型。具体来说，为了避免教师模型中的错误传递给学生模型，我们采用了选择性蒸馏技术，根据检测到的语义准确性来选择目标样本。此外，为了减轻蒸馏过程中大量负面样本带来的噪声影响，我们还提出了差异加权采样技术，以重点关注那些学生模型的预测与教师模型有显著偏差的样本。实验结果表明，BinSKD使得基于DNN的BCSD方法的Recall@1指标提高了14.5%至91.2%，并使HermesSim能够以数倍效率达到与教师模型相同的性能水平。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Experts with Intermediate CTC Supervision for Accented Speech Recognition
papers.title_zh: 在中级CTC监督下的专家混合系统，用于强调性语音识别任务
papers.authors: Wonjun Lee, Hyounghun Kim, Gary Lee
papers.abstract: Accented speech remains a persistent challenge for automatic speech recognition (ASR), as most models are trained on data dominated by a few high-resource English varieties, leading to substantial performance degradation for other accents. Accent-agnostic approaches improve robustness yet struggle with heavily accented or unseen varieties, while accent-specific methods rely on limited and often noisy labels. We introduce MoE-CTC, a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with intermediate CTC supervision that jointly promotes expert specialization and generalization. During training, accent-aware routing encourages experts to capture accent-specific patterns, which gradually transitions to label-free routing for inference. Each expert is equipped with its own CTC head to align routing with transcription quality, and a routing-augmented loss further stabilizes optimization. Experiments on the MCV-Accent benchmark demonstrate consistent gains across both seen and unseen accents in low- and high-resource conditions, achieving up to 29.3% relative WER reduction over strong FastConformer baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 口音识别仍然是自动语音识别领域中的一个持续挑战，因为大多数模型都是基于那些以少数高资源英语变体为主的数据进行训练的，这导致其他口音的识别性能大幅下降。不区分口音的方法虽然能提升系统的鲁棒性，但在处理重口音或未见过的口音时表现不佳；而针对特定口音的方法则依赖于有限且往往存在噪声的标签。我们提出了MoE-CTC架构，该架构结合了混合专家结构和中间CTC监督机制，从而同时促进专家的专门化能力和泛化能力。在训练过程中，口音感知的路由机制促使专家捕捉与口音相关的特征模式，这一机制逐渐过渡到无标签的推理阶段。每个专家都配备了自己的CTC头模块，以调整路由策略以适应转录质量的要求，而附加的路由损失机制则进一步稳定了优化过程。在MCV-Accent基准测试上的实验表明，无论是在低资源还是高资源环境下，该算法都能在不同口音中取得稳定的性能提升，与强大的FastConformer基线模型相比，相对错误率降低了高达29.3%。

papers.title: TransLLM: A Unified Multi-Task Large Language Model for Urban Transportation via Learnable Prompting
papers.title_zh: TransLLM：一种统一的多任务大型语言模型，适用于城市交通领域，通过可学习的提示机制实现高效推理
papers.authors: Jiaming Leng, Yunying Bi, Chuan Qin, Zhenya Huang, Bing Yin, Haojie Ren, Yanyong Zhang, Chao Wang
papers.abstract: Urban transportation systems require precise modeling of dynamic spatiotemporal patterns across diverse tasks, such as traffic forecasting, electric vehicle (EV) charging demand prediction, and taxi dispatch. Existing approaches suffer from two key limitations: traditional deep learning models are task-specific and lack generalization capabilities, whereas Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with structured spatiotemporal data and numerical reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose TransLLM, a unified multi-task framework that synergizes spatiotemporal encoding with LLM reasoning through learnable prompt composition. To enable LLMs to perceive complex graph dependencies, we design a noise-augmented spatiotemporal encoder that projects structured signals into the LLM’s embedding space. Furthermore, to overcome the rigidity of fixed prompt templates in heterogeneous traffic scenarios, we introduce an instance-level prompt routing mechanism trained via reinforcement learning. The framework operates by encoding spatiotemporal patterns into contextual representations, dynamically composing personalized prompts to guide LLM reasoning, and projecting the resulting representations through specialized output layers to generate task-specific predictions. Experiments on seven datasets and three tasks demonstrate that TransLLM outperforms many baselines, showing superior adaptability in both supervised and zero-shot settings with excellent generalization and robustness. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/lengjiaming/TransLLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 城市交通系统需要精确建模各种任务中的动态时空模式，例如交通预测、电动汽车充电需求预测以及出租车调度。现有的方法存在两个主要局限性：传统的深度学习模型具有任务特异性，缺乏泛化能力；而大语言模型则难以处理结构化的时空数据及数值推理问题。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了TransLLM这一统一的多任务框架。该框架通过可学习的提示组合方式，将时空编码与语言模型的推理功能相结合。为了帮助语言模型理解复杂的图状依赖关系，我们设计了一种带有噪声增强功能的时空编码器，能够将结构化信号映射到语言模型的嵌入空间中。此外，为了克服异质交通场景中固定提示模板的局限性，我们引入了基于强化学习训练的实例级提示路由机制。该框架通过将时空模式编码为上下文表示，动态生成个性化提示来引导语言模型进行推理，并通过专门的输出层将生成的表示投射出来，从而得出特定任务的预测结果。在七个数据集和三个任务上的实验表明，TransLLM在许多基准模型中表现优异，无论是在有监督训练还是零样本学习的情况下，都展现了出色的适应性和泛化能力。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/lengjiaming/TransLLM获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CoreCodeBench: Decoupling Code Intelligence via Fine-Grained Repository-Level Tasks
papers.title_zh: CoreCodeBench：通过细粒度的仓库级任务来分离代码中的智能功能
papers.authors: Lingyue Fu, Hao Guan, Bolun Zhang, Haowei Yuan, Yaoming Zhu, Lin Qiu, ZongYu Wang, Xuezhi Cao, Xunliang Cai, Weiwen Liu, Weinan Zhang, Yong Yu
papers.abstract: The evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for software engineering has shifted towards complex, repository-level tasks. However, existing benchmarks predominantly rely on coarse-grained pass rates that treat programming proficiency as a monolithic capability, obscuring specific cognitive bottlenecks. Furthermore, the static nature of these benchmarks renders them vulnerable to data contamination and performance saturation. To address these limitations, we introduce CoreCodeBench, a configurable repository-level benchmark designed to dissect coding capabilities through atomized tasks. Leveraging our automated framework, CorePipe, we extract and transform Python repositories into a comprehensive suite of tasks that isolate distinct cognitive demands within identical code contexts. Unlike static evaluations, CoreCodeBench supports controllable difficulty scaling to prevent saturation and ensures superior data quality. It achieves a 78.55% validity yield, significantly surpassing the 31.7% retention rate of SWE-bench-Verified. Extensive experiments with state-of-the-art LLMs reveal a significant capability misalignment, evidenced by distinct ranking shifts across cognitive dimensions. This indicates that coding proficiency is non-monolithic, as strength in one aspect does not necessarily translate to others. These findings underscore the necessity of our fine-grained taxonomy in diagnosing model deficiencies and offer a sustainable, rigorous framework for evolving code intelligence. Code of CorePipe framework and data of CoreCodeBench are available in https://github.com/AGI-Eval-Official/CoreCodeBench and https://huggingface.co/collections/tubehhh/corecodebench.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于软件工程领域的大语言模型评估，已经转向了复杂的、基于仓库级别的任务。然而，现有的评估基准大多依赖于粗略的通过率统计，这种统计方式将编程能力视为一种整体性的能力，从而忽略了具体的认知瓶颈。此外，这些评估基准的静态特性使得它们容易受到数据污染和性能饱和的影响。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了CoreCodeBench这一可配置的仓库级别评估基准，它通过分解成一个个独立的任务来评估编码能力。利用我们的自动化框架CorePipe，我们可以将Python代码仓库转化为一系列任务，这些任务能够在相同的代码环境中隔离出不同的认知需求。与静态评估不同，CoreCodeBench支持可控的难度调整，从而避免性能饱和问题，并确保了数据的高质量。该评估基准的有效率为78.55%，远远高于SWE-bench-Verified的31.7%的保留率。通过对最先进的语言模型进行大量实验，我们发现编码能力的各项指标之间存在显著的不一致性，这表现为不同认知维度上的排名变化。这表明编程能力并非整体性的，某一方面的优势并不一定意味着其他方面的能力也相应提升。这些发现强调了我们精细分类法的必要性，它有助于诊断模型的缺陷，并为不断发展的代码智能提供了一套可持续且严谨的框架。CorePipe框架的代码以及CoreCodeBench的数据可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/AGI-Eval-Official/CoreCodeBench和https://huggingface.co/collections/tubehhh/corecodebench。

papers.title: Stop Fixating on Prompts: Reasoning Hijacking and Constraint Tightening for Red-Teaming LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 停止对提示的过度依赖：利用推理劫持和约束强化技术来提升LLM智能体的攻击能力
papers.authors: Yanxu Mao, Peipei Liu, Tiehan Cui, Congying Liu, Mingzhe Xing, Datao You
papers.abstract: With the widespread application of LLM-based agents across various domains, their complexity has introduced new security threats. Existing red-team methods mostly rely on modifying user prompts, which lack adaptability to new data and may impact the agent’s performance. To address the challenge, this paper proposes the JailAgent framework, which completely avoids modifying the user prompt. Specifically, it implicitly manipulates the agent’s reasoning trajectory and memory retrieval with three key stages: Trigger Extraction, Reasoning Hijacking, and Constraint Tightening. Through precise trigger identification, real-time adaptive mechanisms, and an optimized objective function, JailAgent demonstrates outstanding performance in cross-model and cross-scenario environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着基于大语言模型的智能体在各个领域的广泛应用，其复杂性也带来了新的安全威胁。现有的针对红队的防御方法大多依赖于修改用户提示语，但这种方式缺乏对新数据的适应能力，可能会影响到智能体的性能。为了应对这一挑战，本文提出了JailAgent框架，该框架完全避免了修改用户提示语的做法。具体来说，它通过三个关键步骤来操控智能体的推理过程和记忆检索：触发点提取、推理劫持以及约束条件优化。通过精确的触发点识别、实时自适应机制以及优化的目标函数，JailAgent在跨模型和多场景环境中展现出了出色的性能。

papers.title: Attention Basin: Why Contextual Position Matters in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 注意力盆地：为什么在大语言模型中上下文位置很重要
papers.authors: Zihao Yi, Zhenqing Ling, Delong Zeng, Haohao Luo, Zhe Xu, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Wanxia Cao, Ying Shen
papers.abstract: The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is significantly sensitive to the contextual position of information in the input. To investigate the mechanism behind this positional bias, our extensive experiments reveal a consistent phenomenon we term the attention basin: when presented with a sequence of structured items (e.g., retrieved documents or few-shot examples), models systematically assign higher attention to the items at the beginning and end of the sequence, while neglecting those in the middle. Crucially, our analysis further reveals that allocating higher attention to critical information is key to enhancing model performance. Based on these insights, we introduce Attention-Driven Reranking (AttnRank), a two-stage framework that (i) estimates a model’s intrinsic positional attention preferences using a small calibration set, and (ii) reorders retrieved documents or few-shot examples to align the most salient content with these high-attention positions. AttnRank is a model-agnostic, training-free, and plug-and-play method with minimal computational overhead. Experiments on multi-hop QA and few-shot in-context learning tasks demonstrate that AttnRank achieves substantial improvements across 10 large language models of varying architectures and scales, without modifying model parameters or training procedures.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的表现对输入中信息的上下文位置非常敏感。为了探究这种位置偏置的机制，我们的大量实验揭示了一个一致的现象，我们将其称为“注意力盆地”现象：当面对一系列结构化的信息项时（例如，检索到的文档或少量样本），模型会系统性地给予序列开头和结尾的信息更高的注意力权重，而忽略中间的那些信息。重要的是，我们的分析还表明，给予关键信息更高的注意力权重是提高模型性能的关键。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种名为“注意力驱动重新排序”（AttnRank）的两阶段框架。该框架首先使用小型校准集来估计模型的内在位置注意力偏好，然后重新排序检索到的文档或少量样本，使最显著的内容与这些高注意力位置对齐。AttnRank是一种与模型无关、无需训练且易于应用的算法，其计算开销极小。在多跳问答和少量样本上下文学习任务上的实验表明，AttnRank能够在10种不同架构和规模的语言模型中实现显著的性能提升，而无需修改模型参数或训练流程。

papers.title: RRAtention: Dynamic Block Sparse Attention via Per-Head Round-Robin Shifts for Long-Context Inference
papers.title_zh: 注意：本文提出了一种动态块稀疏注意力机制，通过每个层次上的循环移位来实现长上下文信息的推理
papers.authors: Siran Liu, Guoxia Wang, Sa Wang, Jinle Zeng, Haoyang Xie, Siyu Lou, Jiabin Yang, Dianhai Yu, Haifeng Wang, Chao Yang
papers.abstract: The quadratic complexity of attention mechanisms poses a critical bottleneck for large language models processing long contexts. While dynamic sparse attention methods offer input-adaptive efficiency, they face fundamental trade-offs: requiring preprocessing, lacking global evaluation, violating query independence, or incurring high computational overhead. We present RRAttention, a novel dynamic sparse attention method that simultaneously achieves all desirable properties through a head round-robin (RR) sampling strategy. By rotating query sampling positions across attention heads within each stride, RRAttention maintains query independence while enabling efficient global pattern discovery with stride-level aggregation. Our method reduces complexity from O(L^2) to O(L^2/S^2) and employs adaptive Top-\tau selection for optimal sparsity. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding (HELMET) and multimodal video comprehension (Video-MME) demonstrate that RRAttention recovers over 99% of full attention performance while computing only half of the attention blocks, achieving 2.4\times speedup at 128K context length and outperforming existing dynamic sparse attention methods. The code is available at https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleFleet (see ‘Research/RRAttention‘).
papers.abstract_zh: 注意力机制的二次复杂度是处理长上下文的大语言模型面临的一个关键瓶颈。虽然动态稀疏注意力方法提供了输入自适应效率，但它们存在一些根本性的权衡问题：需要预处理、缺乏全局评估、违反查询独立性，或者会导致较高的计算开销。我们提出了RRAttention这一新型动态稀疏注意力方法，它通过头部循环采样策略同时实现了所有理想的特性。通过在每个步长内将查询采样位置在注意力头部之间旋转，RRAttention能够在保持查询独立性的同时，实现高效的全局模式发现，并采用步长级聚合方式。我们的方法将复杂度从O(L^2)降低到O(L^2/S^2)，并采用自适应Top-τ选择来实现最优的稀疏性。在自然语言理解（HELMET）和多模态视频理解（Video-MME）方面的广泛实验表明，RRAttention在仅计算一半注意力块的情况下，仍能恢复超过99%的全注意力性能，在128K上下文长度时实现了2.4倍的加速效果，且优于现有的动态稀疏注意力方法。代码可在https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleFleet获取（参见“研究/RRAttention”部分）。

papers.title: Beyond Surface Features: Advancing Medical Vision-Language Alignment via Dynamic Evidence-Guided Preference Optimization
papers.title_zh: 超越表面特征：通过动态证据驱动的偏好优化来推进医学视语对齐研究
papers.authors: Zixuan Huang, Zhihong Zhu, Xiaolong Liu, Yanchao Hao, Manman Zhang, Zheng Wei, Bowen Xing, Xian Wu, Ye Li, Fen Miao, Yefeng Zheng
papers.abstract: Medical large Vision-Language Models (Med-LVLMs) have shown strong potential in multimodal clinical applications such as medical visual question answering and report generation. However, Med-LVLMs remain challenged by hallucinations caused by modality misalignment, where models prioritize textual knowledge over visual evidence and generate outputs that conflict with medical images. To mitigate this issue, recent studies have explored preference optimization to improve image–text alignment, achieving promising results. Despite these advances, existing preference-based methods still face two limitations in medical settings: (1) overfitting to superficial cues, and (2) pseudo convergence of the preference signal. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Evidence-Guided Preference Optimization (DEPO), a new framework that enables evidence-aware and adaptive preference learning for Med-LVLMs. DEPO introduces Multi-Modal Evidence Perturbation (MEP) to suppress non-causal textual and visual shortcuts, and Dispreferred Evidence Resampling (DER) to continuously update dispreferred responses as hallucination patterns evolve. Experiments on multiple medical VQA and report generation benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods, with strong robustness across datasets and architectures. All Codes and data will be released after review.
papers.abstract_zh: 医学领域的视觉-语言模型在多种临床应用中展现出巨大潜力，例如医学视觉问答和报告生成。然而，这些模型仍面临一种挑战：由于模态不匹配导致的幻觉问题。在这种情况下，模型会优先使用文本信息而非视觉证据，从而生成与医学图像相矛盾的输出结果。为了缓解这一问题，近期的研究探索了偏好优化方法，以改善图像与文本之间的对齐效果，并取得了一些令人满意的结果。尽管取得了这些进展，现有的基于偏好的方法在医学场景中仍然存在两个局限性：(1) 过度依赖表面线索进行建模；(2) 偏好信号的伪收敛性。在本文中，我们提出了动态证据引导偏好优化框架（DEPO），该框架能够实现针对医学视觉-语言模型的、具有证据意识的自适应偏好学习。DEPO引入了多模态证据扰动技术，以抑制非因果性的文本和视觉捷径现象；同时采用了不偏好证据重采样技术，随着幻觉模式的演变，能够持续更新不偏好响应。在多个医学视觉问答和报告生成基准测试中的实验表明，DEPO相比现有方法取得了显著的改进，且在不同的数据集和架构下都表现出较强的鲁棒性。所有代码和数据将在审核完成后公开提供。

papers.title: SAFE-QAQ: End-to-End Slow-Thinking Audio-Text Fraud Detection via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: SAFE-QAQ：通过强化学习实现端到端慢思考音频文本欺诈检测技术
papers.authors: Peidong Wang, Zhiming Ma, Xin Dai, YongKang Liu, Shi Feng, Xiaocui Yang, Wenxing Hu, Zhihao Wang, Mingjun Pan, Li Yuan, Daling Wang
papers.abstract: Existing fraud detection methods predominantly rely on transcribed text, suffering from ASR errors and missing crucial acoustic cues like vocal tone and environmental context. This limits their effectiveness against complex deceptive strategies. To address these challenges, we first propose SAFE-QAQ, an end-to-end comprehensive framework for audio-based slow-thinking fraud detection. First, the SAFE-QAQ framework eliminates the impact of transcription errors on detection performance. Secondly, we propose rule-based slow-thinking reward mechanisms that systematically guide the system to identify fraud-indicative patterns by accurately capturing fine-grained audio details, through hierarchical reasoning processes. Besides, our framework introduces a dynamic risk assessment framework during live calls, enabling early detection and prevention of fraud. Experiments on the TeleAntiFraud-Bench demonstrate that SAFE-QAQ achieves dramatic improvements over existing methods in multiple key dimensions, including accuracy, inference efficiency, and real-time processing capabilities. Currently deployed and analyzing over 70,000 calls daily, SAFE-QAQ effectively automates complex fraud detection, reducing human workload and financial losses. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SAFE-QAQ.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的欺诈检测方法主要依赖于转录文本，这导致了自动语音识别的错误，同时也遗漏了诸如语音 tones 和环境背景等重要的声学线索。这些因素限制了这些方法对复杂欺骗性策略的识别能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 SAFE-QAQ 这一端到端的综合框架，用于基于音频的慢思维欺诈检测。首先，SAFE-QAQ 框架能够消除转录错误对检测性能的影响。其次，我们提出了基于规则的慢思维奖励机制，通过分层推理过程，系统引导系统准确捕捉细微的音频细节，从而识别出具有欺诈特征的模式。此外，我们的框架还引入了动态风险评估机制，能够在通话过程中实时进行风险评估，从而实现欺诈的早期检测和预防。在 TeleAntiFraud-Bench 上的实验表明，SAFE-QAQ 在准确性、推理效率以及实时处理能力等多个关键方面都取得了显著改进。目前，SAFE-QAQ 每天处理超过 70,000 通电话，有效实现了复杂的欺诈检测任务，减少了人工工作量和财务损失。代码链接：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SAFE-QAQ

papers.title: MaDS: Long-Horizon GUI Automation via Synergizing Dual-Layer Memory and Multi-Round Debate
papers.title_zh: MaDS：通过结合双层内存和多轮讨论实现长期范围的GUI自动化测试
papers.authors: Pengchen Chen, Shi Chen, Qiming Ye, Xinli Chen, Xinran Li, Wei Xiang
papers.abstract: Automating Graphical User Interface (GUI) operations with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is promising but remains bottlenecked in real-world long-horizon settings. Key challenges include ensuring precise grounding across diverse interfaces and handling irreversible errors in extended workflows. Current methods often struggle to distinguish targets in low Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) environments and lack sufficient pre-execution verification to prevent error accumulation. To address this, we propose the Memory-augmented Debate System (MaDS). Specifically, MaDS combines: (1) a Dual-Layer Memory Module that integrates universal interaction priors with scenario-specific operational experience to mitigate grounding hallucinations; and (2) Multi-Round Debate that performs pre-execution verification, while transforming execution failures into retrievable Negative Warnings to reduce repeated errors. Additionally, we introduce MaDS-Benchmark, a benchmark for long-horizon mobile GUI tasks with process-oriented evaluation. Experiments show that MaDS achieves a 90.23% Task Success Rate on MaDS-Benchmark and strong performance on public benchmarks including AITW, AITZ, CAGUI, and GUIOdyssey.
papers.abstract_zh: 使用多模态大语言模型来自动化图形用户界面操作具有巨大潜力，但在现实世界的长期任务中仍然存在瓶颈问题。主要挑战包括如何确保在不同界面上的精确定位，以及如何处理在扩展工作流程中可能出现的不可逆错误。当前的方法往往难以在信噪比较低的环境中准确识别目标，且缺乏足够的执行前验证机制来防止错误的累积。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为“记忆增强辩论系统”的新方法。具体来说，该系统结合了以下两个组件：(1) 一个双层记忆模块，它将通用交互先验与特定场景的操作经验相结合，以缓解定位错误；(2) 多轮辩论机制，它能够在执行前进行验证，并将执行失败转化为可检索的负面警告，从而减少重复错误的发生。此外，我们还开发了“记忆增强辩论系统基准测试”，这是一个针对长期移动图形用户界面任务的基准测试，采用以流程为导向的评估方式。实验结果表明，该系统在MaDS基准测试上的任务成功率为90.23%，在包括AITW、AITZ、CAGUI和GUIOdyssey在内的公共基准测试中也表现出色。
