papers.title: CIRAG: Construction–Integration Retrieval and Adaptive Generation for Multi-hop Question Answering
papers.title_zh: CIRAG：用于多跳问答系统的构建、集成检索以及自适应生成技术
papers.authors: Zili Wei, Yilin Wang, Xiaocui Yang, Shi Feng, Weidong Bao, Daling Wang, Zihan Wang, Yifei Zhang
papers.abstract: Triple-based Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation (iRAG) mitigates document-level noise for multi-hop question answering. However, existing methods still face limitations: (i) greedy single-path expansion, which propagates early errors and fails to capture parallel evidence from different reasoning branches, and (ii) granularity–demand mismatch, where a single evidence representation struggles to balance noise control with contextual sufficiency. In this paper, we propose the Construction–Integration Retrieval and Adaptive Generation model, CIRAG. It introduces an Iterative Construction–Integration module that constructs candidate triples and history-conditionally integrates them to distill core triples and generate the next-hop query. This module mitigates the greedy trap by preserving multiple plausible evidence chains. Besides, to address the granularity–demand mismatch, we propose an Adaptive Cascaded Multi-Granularity Generation module that progressively expands contextual evidence based on the problem requirements, from triples to supporting sentences and full passages. Moreover, we introduce Trajectory Distillation, which distills the teacher model’s integration policy into a lightweight student, enabling efficient and reliable long-horizon reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CIRAG achieves superior performance compared to existing iRAG methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于三元组的迭代检索增强生成（iRAG）能够减轻多跳问答中的文档级噪声问题。然而，现有的方法仍然存在一些局限性：(i) 单一路径扩展方式会导致早期错误传播，且无法捕捉来自不同推理分支的并行证据；(ii) 粒度与需求之间的不匹配问题，即单个证据表示难以在噪声控制与上下文充分性之间取得平衡。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“构建-整合检索与自适应生成”模型，即CIRAG。该模型引入了一个迭代构建-整合模块，该模块能够构建候选三元组，并根据历史信息对其进行整合，从而提取出核心三元组并生成下一跳查询。这一模块通过保留多种可能的证据链来避免陷入贪婪扩展的陷阱。此外，为了解决粒度与需求之间的不匹配问题，我们提出了一种自适应级联多粒度生成模块，该模块能够根据问题需求逐步扩展上下文证据，从三元组扩展到支持性句子乃至完整段落。我们还引入了轨迹蒸馏技术，该技术可以将教师模型的整合策略转化为轻量级的学生模型，从而实现高效可靠的长期推理。大量实验表明，CIRAG在性能上优于现有的iRAG方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TinyJudge: Unverifiable Constraint Alignment via Lightweight Specialist Ensembles
papers.title_zh: TinyJudge：通过轻量级专家集合实现不可验证的约束对齐
papers.authors: Yirong Zeng, Yufei Liu, Xiao Ding, Yutai Hou, Yuxian Wang, Wu Ning, Haonan Song, Dandan Tu, Qixun Zhang, Yuxiang He, Bibo Cai, Ting Liu
papers.abstract: Instruction Following (IF) is a core capability of LLMs, requiring strict adherence to diverse constraints, ranging from verifiable ones (e.g., output length) to unverifiable ones (e.g., tone). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has emerged as a paradigm for IF tasks, leveraging LLM-as-a-judge to assess unverifiable constraints. However, we empirically find that this approach remains a significant bottleneck, suffering from severe reward hacking and higher computational overhead. In this work, we first analyze the generalization capabilities of unverifiable constraints and discover that specific constraints exhibit distinct, high-generalization patterns. Motivated by this, we propose TinyJudge, a framework that employs an ensemble of specialized tiny language models (e.g., 0.6B) to provide rewards for soft constraints. By distilling expertise from frontier models into these tiny models, it achieves high-precision, lightweight evaluation. Extensive evaluations across five benchmarks demonstrate that TinyJudge outperforms the baselines by ~10% in average performance and 12% in reward precision. Crucially, it also achieves a 3× speedup in total training time. Our work provides a scalable and robust path for aligning LLMs with unverifiable human instructions.
papers.abstract_zh: 指令遵循能力是大语言模型的核心功能之一，要求严格遵循各种约束条件，这些约束条件包括可验证的（如输出长度）和不可验证的（如语气）。基于可验证奖励的强化学习已成为处理指令遵循任务的一种有效方法，它利用大语言模型作为评估器来应对不可验证的约束条件。然而，我们通过实验发现，这种方法仍然存在显著瓶颈，存在严重的奖励操纵问题，且计算成本较高。在这项研究中，我们首先分析了不可验证约束条件的泛化能力，发现某些特定约束条件具有独特的、高泛化能力模式。基于这一发现，我们提出了TinyJudge框架——该框架采用一系列专门的微型语言模型（例如0.6B规模的语言模型），为软约束条件提供奖励。通过将前沿模型的专业知识传递给这些微型模型，我们能够实现高精度、轻量级的评估。在五个基准测试中的广泛评估表明，TinyJudge在平均性能上比基线方法高出约10%，在奖励精度上高出约12%。更重要的是，它在总训练时间上实现了3倍的加速。我们的研究为将大语言模型与不可验证的人类指令进行对齐提供了一种可扩展且稳健的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Dynamic Infilling Anchors for Format-Constrained Generation in Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 用于约束性生成的动态填充锚点技术，在扩散式大型语言模型中应用
papers.authors: Boyan Han, Yiwei Wang, Yi Song, Yujun Cai, Chi Zhang
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer bidirectional attention and parallel generation, enabling them to exploit global context and naturally support format-constrained tasks like parseable JSON or reasoning templates. While straightforward fixed anchors can enforce such constraints, they often impose rigid spans, leading to truncated reasoning or redundant content. To overcome this, we propose Dynamic Infilling Anchors (DIA), a training-free method that dynamically estimates end-anchor positions to adjust generation length before iterative infilling. This flexible mechanism ensures structural correctness and semantic coherence, avoiding the inefficiencies of fixed-span methods. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DIA substantially improves format compliance and answer accuracy, achieving significant zero-shot gains on GSM8K and MATH. These results establish DIA as a robust pathway toward reliable, structure-aware generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型（dLLMs）具备双向注意力机制和并行生成能力，能够充分利用全局上下文信息，从而自然支持诸如可解析的JSON格式或推理模板等格式受限的任务。虽然固定的锚点可以强制满足这些格式要求，但它们往往会导致生成的文本被截断或出现冗余内容。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了动态填充锚点方法（DIA），这是一种无需训练的方法，它能够动态估计结束锚点的位置，从而在迭代填充过程中调整生成长度。这种灵活的机制确保了结构上的正确性以及语义上的连贯性，避免了固定跨度方法的低效问题。在推理基准测试中的实验表明，DIA显著提升了格式合规性和答案准确性，在GSM8K和MATH任务上取得了显著的零样本性能提升。这些结果证明了DIA是一种可靠的、注重结构完整性的生成方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Compiling Activation Steering into Weights via Null-Space Constraints for Stealthy Backdoors
papers.title_zh: 通过零空间约束将激活指令编译为权重，以实现隐蔽的后门机制
papers.authors: Rui Yin, Tianxu Han, Naen Xu, Changjiang Li, Ping He, Chunyi Zhou, Jun Wang, Zhihui Fu, Tianyu Du, Jinbao Li, Shouling Ji
papers.abstract: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world pipelines, yet this deployment also enlarges the supply-chain attack surface: adversaries can distribute backdoored checkpoints that behave normally under standard evaluation but jailbreak when a hidden trigger is present. Recent post-hoc weight-editing methods offer an efficient approach to injecting such backdoors by directly modifying model weights to map a trigger to an attacker-specified response. However, existing methods typically optimize a token-level mapping that forces an affirmative prefix (e.g., “Sure”), which does not guarantee sustained harmful output—the model may begin with apparent agreement yet revert to safety-aligned refusal within a few decoding steps. We address this reliability gap by shifting the backdoor objective from surface tokens to internal representations. We extract a steering vector that captures the difference between compliant and refusal behaviors, and compile it into a persistent weight modification that activates only when the trigger is present. To preserve stealthiness and benign utility, we impose a null-space constraint so that the injected edit remains dormant on clean inputs. The method is efficient, requiring only a small set of examples and admitting a closed-form solution. Across multiple safety-aligned LLMs and jailbreak benchmarks, our method achieves high triggered attack success while maintaining non-triggered safety and general utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 与安全性相关的大语言模型在现实世界的应用中越来越普遍，但这种应用也扩大了供应链攻击的面：攻击者可以分发经过篡改的 checkpoint，这些 checkpoint 在标准评估下表现正常，但当存在隐藏触发因素时则会导致模型失控。最近的一些事后权重编辑方法提供了一种有效的方法来注入这种后门，即通过直接修改模型权重，将触发因素映射到攻击者指定的响应上。然而，现有的方法通常优化的是基于令牌级别的映射，这种方式会强制使用肯定前缀（例如“当然”），但这并不能保证持续产生有害的输出——模型可能一开始表现出一致的响应，但在几个解码步骤之后又会恢复到与安全性要求相符的拒绝状态。我们通过将后门的目标从表面令牌转移到内部表示来解决这个问题。我们提取了一个引导向量，用来捕捉合规行为与拒绝行为之间的差异，并将其编译成一种持久性的权重修改机制，这种修改只有在触发因素存在时才生效。为了保持隐蔽性和良好的实用性，我们施加了零空间约束，使得在干净输入情况下，注入的修改效果不会显现出来。该方法非常高效，只需要少量的示例数据，并且可以采用封闭形式的解法。在多个与安全性相关的大语言模型和失控测试场景中，我们的方法在触发攻击的情况下取得了较高的成功率，同时仍然保持了非触发状态下的安全性和通用性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Inhibitory Attacks on Backdoor-based Fingerprinting for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 对基于后门技术的语言模型指纹识别的拦截攻击
papers.authors: Hang fu, Wanli Peng, Yinghan Zhou, Jiaxuan Wu, Juan Wen, Xue Yiming
papers.abstract: The widespread adoption of Large Language Model (LLM) in commercial and research settings has intensified the need for robust intellectual property protection. Backdoor-based LLM fingerprinting has emerged as a promising solution for this challenge. In practical application, the low-cost multi-model collaborative technique, LLM ensemble, combines diverse LLMs to leverage their complementary strengths, garnering significant attention and practical adoption. Unfortunately, the vulnerability of existing LLM fingerprinting for the ensemble scenario is unexplored. In order to comprehensively assess the robustness of LLM fingerprinting, in this paper, we propose two novel fingerprinting attack methods: token filter attack (TFA) and sentence verification attack (SVA). The TFA gets the next token from a unified set of tokens created by the token filter mechanism at each decoding step. The SVA filters out fingerprint responses through a sentence verification mechanism based on perplexity and voting. Experimentally, the proposed methods effectively inhibit the fingerprint response while maintaining ensemble performance. Compared with state-of-the-art attack methods, the proposed method can achieve better performance. The findings necessitate enhanced robustness in LLM fingerprinting.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在商业和研究领域的广泛应用，加剧了对强大知识产权保护的需求。基于后门的模型指纹识别技术成为应对这一挑战的有效解决方案。在实际应用中，低成本的多模型协作技术——模型集成技术，通过结合多种模型的优势来提升性能，因此受到了广泛关注并得到了实际应用。然而，现有的模型指纹识别技术在集成场景下的安全性尚未得到充分研究。为了全面评估模型指纹识别技术的鲁棒性，本文提出了两种新的攻击方法：令牌过滤攻击和句子验证攻击。令牌过滤攻击通过在每次解码过程中从令牌过滤机制生成的统一令牌集中获取下一个令牌；而句子验证攻击则通过基于困惑度与投票机制的句子验证方法来过滤掉不符合要求的指纹响应。实验结果表明，所提出的攻击方法能够有效抑制指纹响应，同时保持良好的集成性能。与现有最先进的攻击方法相比，所提出的方法能够取得更好的效果。这些发现表明，需要进一步提高模型指纹识别技术的鲁棒性。

papers.title: TimeSAF: Towards LLM-Guided Semantic Asynchronous Fusion for Time Series Forecasting
papers.title_zh: TimeSAF：基于大语言模型的语义异步融合技术，用于时间序列预测
papers.authors: Fan Zhang, Shiming Fan, Hua Wang
papers.abstract: Despite the recent success of large language models (LLMs) in time-series forecasting, most existing methods still adopt a Deep Synchronous Fusion strategy, where dense interactions between textual and temporal features are enforced at every layer of the network. This design overlooks the inherent granularity mismatch between modalities and leads to what we term semantic perceptual dissonance: high-level abstract semantics provided by the LLM become inappropriately entangled with the low-level, fine-grained numerical dynamics of time series, making it difficult for semantic priors to effectively guide forecasting. To address this issue, we propose TimeSAF, a new framework based on hierarchical asynchronous fusion. Unlike synchronous approaches, TimeSAF explicitly decouples unimodal feature learning from cross-modal interaction. It introduces an independent cross-modal semantic fusion trunk, which uses learnable queries to aggregate global semantics from the temporal and prompt backbones in a bottom-up manner, and a stage-wise semantic refinement decoder that asynchronously injects these high-level signals back into the temporal backbone. This mechanism provides stable and efficient semantic guidance while avoiding interference with low-level temporal dynamics. Extensive experiments on standard long-term forecasting benchmarks show that TimeSAF significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and further exhibits strong generalization in both few-shot and zero-shot transfer settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在时间序列预测方面取得了显著成功，但大多数现有方法仍然采用深度同步融合策略，即在网络的每个层次上都强制进行文本特征与时间特征之间的密集交互。这种设计忽略了不同模态之间固有的粒度差异，从而导致所谓的语义感知失调：由大语言模型提供的高层次抽象语义与时间序列的底层、细粒度的数值动态相互交织，使得语义先验难以有效指导预测过程。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了TimeSAF这一基于分层异步融合的新框架。与同步方法不同，TimeSAF明确地将单模态特征学习与跨模态交互分离开来。它引入了一个独立的跨模态语义融合模块，该模块使用可学习的查询以自下而上的方式从时间和提示基础模型中聚合全局语义；同时还有一个分阶段语义细化解码器，它能够异步地将这些高级信号重新注入到时间基础模型中。这种机制能够在避免干扰到低层次时间动态的同时，提供稳定且高效的语义指导。在标准的长期预测基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，TimeSAF的表现显著优于最先进的基线方法，并且在少样本和零样本迁移场景中也表现出强大的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Pruning Unsafe Tickets: A Resource-Efficient Framework for Safer and More Robust LLMs
papers.title_zh: 修剪不安全的问题：一种高效资源利用的方法，旨在打造更可靠、更强大的大语言模型
papers.authors: Wai Man Si, Mingjie Li, Michael Backes, Yang Zhang
papers.abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, but even aligned models such as Mistral and LLaVA still exhibit unsafe behaviors inherited from pre-training. Current alignment methods like SFT and RLHF primarily encourage models to generate preferred responses, but do not explicitly remove the unsafe subnetworks that trigger harmful outputs. In this work, we introduce a resource-efficient pruning framework that directly identifies and removes parameters associated with unsafe behaviors while preserving model utility. Our method employs a gradient-free attribution mechanism, requiring only modest GPU resources, and generalizes across architectures and quantized variants. Empirical evaluations on ML models show substantial reductions in unsafe generations and improved robustness against jailbreak attacks, with minimal utility loss. From the perspective of the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis, our results suggest that ML models contain “unsafe tickets” responsible for harmful behaviors, and pruning reveals “safety tickets” that maintain performance while aligning outputs. This provides a lightweight, post-hoc alignment strategy suitable for deployment in resource-constrained settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器学习模型在现实世界中的应用越来越广泛，但即便是像Mistral和LLaVA这样的对齐模型，仍然会表现出从预训练阶段继承下来的不安全行为。目前的主流对齐方法，如SFT和RLHF，主要鼓励模型生成人们喜欢的响应，但并没有明确去除那些导致有害输出的不安全子网络。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种资源高效的剪枝框架，它能够直接识别并移除与不安全行为相关的参数，同时保留模型的实用性。我们的方法采用了无梯度归因机制，仅需少量的GPU资源即可实现，并且能够适用于不同的架构和量化变体。对机器学习模型的实证评估表明，采用我们的方法后，不安全的生成行为显著减少，模型对越狱攻击的鲁棒性也得到了提升，而模型的实用性则几乎没有损失。从“彩票票券假设”的角度来看，我们的研究结果表明，机器学习模型中存在负责有害行为的“不安全票券”，而剪枝则揭示了能够在对齐输出的同时维持性能的“安全票券”。这种轻量级的后处理对齐策略非常适合在资源有限的环境中部署使用。

papers.title: EQUIP: EQUivariant preserving In-Place updates for Efficient Token Pruning
papers.title_zh: 设备：保持等价性的就地更新算法，以实现高效的令牌修剪操作
papers.authors: Arun Ramachandran, R Govindarajan, Murali Annavaram, Prakash Raghavendra
papers.abstract: Token-pruning has emerged as a primary focus in large language models (LLMs) to enhance model efficiency while preserving accuracy, especially for large sequence lengths. However, the eviction operation of token-pruning methods causes “holes” in KV tensors, posing two major challenges: (1) The shift operation, required to make the KV tensor contiguous, results in significant copy overheads; (2) The changes in position indices due to token eviction lead to increased computational requirements for Rotary Positional Encoding (RoPE). To address these issues, we introduce EQUIP, an EQUivariant preserving in-place token update mechanism that ensures the equivariance property of the operations performed in the attention computation. EQUIP offers two fundamental advantages: First, it combines eviction and a subsequent token insertion into an in-place replacement operation, which reduces the KV cache copy overheads significantly. Second, EQUIP reduces recomputation of rotation operations through a combination of in-place update, caching and a re-indexing strategy. Together, these optimizations enable EQUIP to achieve geomean speedups of 1.62× (or 1.47×) on CPU (GPU) over StreamingLLM, and 3.45× (or 1.86×) on CPU (GPU) over Heavy Hitters (H2O). EQUIP with Paged Attention achieves speedups of 4.18×(2.61×) on CPU (GPU) over auto-regressive baselines. EQUIP matches the model accuracy of baseline pruning methods while delivering superior performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中，标记修剪已成为提升模型效率的主要手段，同时还能保持模型的准确性，尤其是在处理长序列时。然而，标记修剪方法的移除操作会在KV张量中产生“空洞”，这带来了两个主要挑战：(1)为了使KV张量连续，需要进行移位操作，这会导致显著的复制开销；(2)由于标记被移除，位置索引会发生变化，从而增加了旋转位置编码的计算需求。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了EQUIP——一种保持等变性的就地标记更新机制，它能够确保注意力计算过程中操作的等变性。EQUIP具有两大优势：首先，它将移除操作和后续的标记插入合并为一次就地替换操作，从而显著降低了KV缓存的复制开销。其次，通过结合就地更新、缓存管理以及重新索引策略，EQUIP减少了旋转操作的重新计算。这些优化措施使得EQUIP在CPU（GPU）上的加速比超过StreamingLLM 1.62倍（或1.47倍），在CPU（GPU）上则超过Heavy Hitters（H2O） 3.45倍（或1.86倍）。使用Paged Attention的EQUIP在CPU（GPU）上的加速比超过自动回归基线模型4.18倍（或2.61倍）。EQUIP在模型准确性方面与基线修剪方法相当，同时提供了更出色的性能表现。

papers.title: Exons-Detect: Identifying and Amplifying Exonic Tokens via Hidden-State Discrepancy for Robust AI-Generated Text Detection
papers.title_zh: 外显子检测：通过隐藏状态差异来识别并放大外显子标记，从而实现稳健的AI生成文本检测功能
papers.authors: Xiaowei Zhu, Yubing Ren, Fang Fang, Shi Wang, Yanan Cao, Li Guo
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models has increasingly blurred the boundary between human-written and AI-generated text, raising societal risks such as misinformation dissemination, authorship ambiguity, and threats to intellectual property rights. These concerns highlight the urgent need for effective and reliable detection methods. While existing training-free approaches often achieve strong performance by aggregating token-level signals into a global score, they typically assume uniform token contributions, making them less robust under short sequences or localized token modifications. To address these limitations, we propose Exons-Detect, a training-free method for AI-generated text detection based on an exon-aware token reweighting perspective. Exons-Detect identifies and amplifies informative exonic tokens by measuring hidden-state discrepancy under a dual-model setting, and computes an interpretable translation score from the resulting importance-weighted token sequence. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that Exons-Detect achieves state-of-the-art detection performance and exhibits strong robustness to adversarial attacks and varying input lengths. In particular, it attains a 2.2% relative improvement in average AUROC over the strongest prior baseline on DetectRL.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的快速发展使得人类撰写文本与AI生成文本之间的界限变得越来越模糊，这带来了诸如错误信息传播、作者身份不明以及知识产权受到威胁等社会问题。这些担忧凸显了需要有效且可靠的检测方法的迫切需求。虽然现有的无需训练的方法通常通过将令牌级别的信号汇总为全局得分来取得良好的性能，但它们通常假设所有令牌的贡献都是均匀的，因此在处理短序列或局部令牌修改时表现不佳。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了Exons-Detect这一无需训练的方法，该方法基于一种考虑外显子信息的令牌重新加权策略，能够识别并增强具有信息价值的外部令牌。Exons-Detect通过测量双模型环境下的隐藏状态差异来识别这些重要令牌，并从由此产生的加权令牌序列中计算出一个可解释的翻译得分。实验评估表明，Exons-Detect在检测性能上达到了最先进的水平，并且对对抗攻击和不同输入长度具有极强的鲁棒性。具体而言，与DetectRL领域中最强的基线方法相比，Exons-Detect在平均AUROC指标上实现了2.2%的相对提升。

papers.title: Reasoning Fails Where Step Flow Breaks
papers.title_zh: 当步骤流中断时，推理机制就会失效
papers.authors: Xiaoyu Xu, Yulan Pan, Xiaosong Yuan, Zhihong Shen, Minghao Su, Yuanhao Su, Xiaofeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) that generate long chains of thought now perform well on multi-step math, science, and coding tasks. However, their behavior is still unstable and hard to interpret, and existing analysis tools struggle with such long, structured reasoning traces. We introduce Step-Saliency, which pools attention–gradient scores into step-to-step maps along the question–thinking–summary trajectory. Across several models, Step-Saliency reveals two recurring information-flow failures: Shallow Lock-in, where shallow layers over-focus on the current step and barely use earlier context, and Deep Decay, where deep layers gradually lose saliency on the thinking segment and the summary increasingly attends to itself and the last few steps. Motivated by these patterns, we propose StepFlow, a saliency-inspired test-time intervention that adjusts shallow saliency patterns measured by Step-Saliency via Odds-Equal Bridge and adds a small step-level residual in deep layers via Step Momentum Injection. StepFlow improves accuracy on math, science, and coding tasks across multiple LRMs without retraining, indicating that repairing information flow can recover part of their missing reasoning performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在解决多步骤的数学、科学和编程任务时表现良好。然而，它们的行为仍然不稳定且难以解释，现有的分析工具也难以处理如此长且结构化的推理过程。我们提出了“步长显著性”技术，它将注意力得分和梯度得分整合到问题思考总结过程中的每一步中。通过对多个模型的测试，我们发现两种常见的信息流问题：浅层锁定，即浅层部分过于关注当前步骤，几乎不利用之前的上下文信息；以及深层衰减，即深层部分逐渐失去对思考阶段的关注，而总结部分则越来越专注于自身和最后几个步骤。基于这些现象，我们提出了“步长流动”技术，这是一种受显著性影响的测试时间干预方法。该方法通过“ odds-equal bridge”来调整由“步长显著性”技术测量的浅层显著性模式，并通过“步长动量注入”在深层中添加少量步级残差。使用“步长流动”技术可以在无需重新训练的情况下提升多个大型推理模型在数学、科学和编程任务上的准确性，这表明修复信息流可以恢复它们部分缺失的推理能力。

papers.title: Cat-MoD: Accelerating Multimodal Alignment via Caption Token Guided Asymmetric Mixture-of-Depths
papers.title_zh: Cat-MoD：通过带有标题标记的引导式非对称深度混合技术，加速多模态数据对齐过程
papers.authors: YiJie Huang, Xiaocui Yang, Shi Feng, Wen Zhang, Kaisong Song, Yifei Zhang, Daling Wang
papers.abstract: Efficiently aligning visual features with Large Language Models (LLMs) remains a critical bottleneck in Multimodal LLMs. Existing query-based alignment modules (e.g., Q-Former) rely on randomly initialized queries, resulting in an inefficient cold start exploration process. Furthermore, they enforce uniform cross-attention across all layers, leading to computational redundancy. Our empirical analysis reveals that query tokens initialized with language priors can rapidly capture global semantics, leading to early representation convergence after only a few layers. In this paper, we propose Cat-MoD, a Caption token Guided Asymmetric Mixture-of-Depths framework. It incorporates a Hybrid Query Construction module where Guide Tokens initialized from coarse-grained linguistic priors rapidly anchor global semantic context, and randomly initialized Explorer Tokens remain active to capture fine-grained visual details. Exploiting this early convergence, we introduce an Asymmetric Mixture-of-Depths mechanism, where a similarity-aware router dynamically prunes redundant tokens from expensive cross-attention layers while preserving their context in self-attention. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Cat-MoD matches or surpasses baseline performance, while substantially reducing alignment FLOPs by approximately 37% during both training and inference, offering a highly efficient solution for multimodal alignment. Code: https://github.com/JasonOrange0726/Cat-MoD.
papers.abstract_zh: 高效地将视觉特征与大语言模型对齐，仍然是多模态语言模型中的一个关键瓶颈。现有的基于查询的对齐模块（例如Q-Former）依赖于随机初始化的查询，这导致对齐过程的效率低下，难以快速适应新数据。此外，这些模块强制所有层都采用统一的跨注意力机制，从而导致计算资源的浪费。我们的实验分析表明，以语言先验信息初始化查询令牌能够快速捕捉全局语义信息，从而在仅几层之后就能实现早期的特征收敛。在本文中，我们提出了Cat-MoD这一基于标题令牌的异步混合深度框架。该框架包含了一个混合查询构建模块：由粗粒度语言先验信息初始化的引导令牌能够快速确定全局语义上下文，而随机初始化的探索令牌则继续活跃地捕捉细粒度的视觉细节。通过利用这种早期收敛特性，我们引入了异步混合深度机制：一种基于相似度感知的路由算法，它能够动态剔除那些在昂贵跨注意力层中冗余的令牌，同时保留它们在自注意力中的上下文信息。在多个基准测试上的实验表明，Cat-MoD的性能至少与基线方法相当，甚至有所超越。同时，它在训练和推理过程中显著减少了对齐所需的浮点运算量，降低了约37%。这无疑为多模态对齐提供了一种高效的解决方案。代码链接：https://github.com/JasonOrange0726/Cat-MoD。

papers.title: Beyond Scaling: Measuring and Predicting the Upper Bound of Knowledge Retention in Language Model Pre-Training
papers.title_zh: 超越规模扩展：衡量和预测语言模型预训练过程中知识保留的上限
papers.authors: Changhao Jiang, Ming Zhang, Yifei Cao, Junjie Ye, Xiaoran Fan, Shihan Dou, Zhiheng Xi, Jiajun Sun, Yi Dong, Yujiong Shen, Jingqi Tong, Baoyu Fan, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: The GPT-4 technical report suggests that downstream performance can be predicted from pre-training signals, but offers little methodological detail on how to quantify this. This work address this gap by modeling knowledge retention, the capacity of a pre-trained language model to memorize factual information from its corpus, and introduce a principled method to estimate it prior to training. We propose Size-dependent Mutual Information (SMI), an information-theoretic predictor that integrates knowledge frequency, knowledge specificity, and model size to forecast closed-book question answering (QA) accuracy. SMI is validated through large-scale document retrieval over the disclosed pre-training corpora of 21 public and 3 custom models, combined with a robust multi-template QA evaluation. Experiments show that SMI significantly outperforms repetition-based baselines and achieves R² > 0.7 in predicting QA accuracy for models above 1B parameters, without additional training. The analysis further reveals diminishing returns from scaling data and model size and provides evidence for an intrinsic upper bound on knowledge retention achievable by pre-training alone, motivating retrieval and other augmentation strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: GPT-4技术报告指出，可以从预训练信号中预测下游性能，但关于如何量化这一结果的方法论细节却很少。本研究通过建模知识保留能力来填补这一空白——即预训练语言模型从其语料库中提取事实信息的能力。我们提出了一种基于大小依赖的互信息方法，这是一种信息论预测方法，它结合了知识频率、知识特异性以及模型规模等因素来预测闭卷问答任务的准确性。通过大规模文档检索实验，对21个公开模型和3个自定义模型的预训练语料库进行了验证，并结合了稳健的多模板问答评估方法。实验结果表明，与基于重复性的基线方法相比，SMI在预测超过10亿参数的模型的问答准确率方面表现显著，其R²值超过了0.7。分析还揭示了随着数据和模型规模的扩大，性能提升的边际效应逐渐减弱，这为预训练本身所能实现的知识保留能力设定了一个内在上限，从而激发了检索和其他增强策略的研究需求。

papers.title: Efficient Paths and Dense Rewards: Probabilistic Flow Reasoning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 高效路径与高回报：适用于大型语言模型的概率流推理方法
papers.authors: Yan Liu, Feng Zhang, Zhanyu Ma, Jun Xu, Jiuchong Gao, Jinghua Hao, Renqing He, Han Liu, Yangdong Deng
papers.abstract: High-quality chain-of-thought has demonstrated strong potential for unlocking the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, current paradigms typically treat the reasoning process as an indivisible sequence, lacking an intrinsic mechanism to quantify step-wise information gain. This granularity gap manifests in two limitations: inference inefficiency from redundant exploration without explicit guidance, and optimization difficulty due to sparse outcome supervision or costly external verifiers. In this work, we propose CoT-Flow, a framework that reconceptualizes discrete reasoning steps as a continuous probabilistic flow, quantifying the contribution of each step toward the ground-truth answer. Built on this formulation, CoT-Flow enables two complementary methodologies: flow-guided decoding, which employs a greedy flow-based decoding strategy to extract information-efficient reasoning paths, and flow-based reinforcement learning, which constructs a verifier-free dense reward function. Experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate that CoT-Flow achieves a superior balance between inference efficiency and reasoning performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量的思维链模型显示出在激发大语言模型的推理能力方面的巨大潜力。然而，当前的范式通常将推理过程视为一个不可分割的序列，缺乏量化逐步信息获取的机制。这种颗粒度上的差异导致了两个问题：在没有明确指导的情况下，冗余探索会导致推理效率低下；由于结果监督不足或需要昂贵的外部验证器，优化过程也会变得困难。在这项研究中，我们提出了CoT-Flow框架，该框架将离散的推理步骤重新定义为连续的概率流，从而量化每个步骤对最终答案的贡献。基于这一理念，CoT-Flow实现了两种互补的方法：流引导解码，采用贪婪的流导向解码策略来提取高效的推理路径；以及基于流的强化学习，构建一种无需验证器的密集奖励函数。在具有挑战性的基准测试中的实验表明，CoT-Flow在推理效率和推理性能之间取得了出色的平衡。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TriPlay-RL: Tri-Role Self-Play Reinforcement Learning for LLM Safety Alignment
papers.title_zh: TriPlay-RL：多角色自博弈强化学习，用于语言模型的安全对齐
papers.authors: Zhewen Tan, Wenhan Yu, Jianfeng Si, Tongxin Liu, Kaiqi Guan, Huiyan Jin, Jiawen Tao, Xiaokun Yuan, Xiangzheng Zhang, Duohe Ma, Tong Yang, Lin Sun
papers.abstract: In recent years, safety risks associated with large language models have become increasingly prominent, highlighting the urgent need to mitigate the generation of toxic and harmful content. The mainstream paradigm for LLM safety alignment typically adopts a collaborative framework involving three roles: an attacker for adversarial prompt generation, a defender for safety defense, and an evaluator for response assessment. In this paper, we propose a closed-loop reinforcement learning framework called TriPlay-RL that enables iterative and co-improving collaboration among three roles with near-zero manual annotation. Experimental results show that the attacker preserves high output diversity while achieving a 20%–50% improvement in adversarial effectiveness. The defender attains 10%–30% gains in safety performance without degrading general reasoning capability, and the evaluator continuously refines its fine-grained judgment ability through iterations, accurately distinguishing unsafe responses, simple refusals, and useful guidance. Overall, our framework establishes an efficient and scalable paradigm for LLM safety alignment, enabling continuous co-evolution within a unified learning loop. The code is available at https://github.com/Qihoo360/TriPlay-RL.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，与大语言模型相关的安全风险日益突出，这凸显了减轻生成有毒有害内容的紧迫性。目前主流的LLM安全对齐范式通常采用一种协作框架，该框架包含三个角色：攻击者负责生成对抗性提示，防御者负责实施安全防御措施，评估者则负责评估响应效果。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为TriPlay-RL的闭环强化学习框架，该框架能够实现三个角色之间的迭代式协同优化，且几乎不需要手动标注。实验结果表明，攻击者能够在保持高输出多样性的同时，提升20%至50%的对抗能力。防御者在不降低整体推理能力的情况下，提升了10%至30%的安全性表现；而评估者通过不断迭代，能够不断完善其细致的判断能力，准确区分不安全的响应、简单的拒绝以及有用的指导信息。总体而言，我们的框架为LLM安全对齐提供了一种高效且可扩展的方法，使得三个角色能够在统一的循环学习中实现持续协同进化。代码可在https://github.com/Qihoo360/TriPlay-RL获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Cross-Modal Coreference Alignment: Enabling Reliable Information Transfer in Omni-LLMs
papers.title_zh: 跨模态指称对齐：在全模态语言模型中实现可靠的信息传递
papers.authors: Hongcheng Liu, Yuhao Wang, Zhe Chen, Pingjie Wang, Zhiyuan Zhu, Yixuan Hou, Yanfeng Wang, Yu Wang
papers.abstract: Omni Large Language Models (Omni-LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in holistic multi-modal perception, yet they consistently falter in complex scenarios requiring synergistic omni-modal reasoning. Beyond understanding global multimodal context, effective reasoning also hinges on fine-grained cross-modal alignment, especially identifying shared referents across modalities, yet this aspect has been largely overlooked. To bridge this gap, we formalize the challenge as a cross-modal coreference problem, where a model must localize a referent in a source modality and re-identify it in a target modality. Building on this paradigm, we introduce CrossOmni, a dataset comprising nine tasks equipped with human-designed reasoning rationales to evaluate and enhance this capability. Experiments on 13 Omni-LLMs reveal systematic weaknesses in cross-modal coreference, which we attribute to the absence of coreference-aware thinking patterns. To address this, we enhance cross-modal alignment via two strategies: a training-free In-Context Learning method and a training-based SFT+GRPO framework designed to induce such thinking patterns. Both approaches yield substantial performance gains and generalize effectively to collaborative reasoning tasks. Overall, our findings highlight cross-modal coreference as a crucial missing piece for advancing robust omni-modal reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: Omni大语言模型在整体多模态感知方面展现出了令人印象深刻的性能，但在需要协同多模态推理的复杂场景中却常常表现不佳。除了理解全局的多模态上下文之外，有效的推理还依赖于细粒度的跨模态对齐，尤其是识别不同模态之间的共同指称对象。然而，这一方面一直被严重忽视了。为了填补这一空白，我们将这一挑战定义为跨模态共指问题：模型需要在源模态中定位一个指称对象，并在目标模态中重新识别该对象。基于这一范式，我们引入了CrossOmni数据集，该数据集包含九项任务，并附有人类设计的推理理由，以评估和提高这种能力。对13个Omni-LLMs进行的实验表明，它们在跨模态共指方面存在系统性缺陷，我们认为这是由于缺乏共指意识思维模式所导致的。为了解决这一问题，我们通过两种策略来增强跨模态对齐：一种是不需要训练的上下文学习方法，另一种是基于训练的SFT+GRPO框架，旨在引导形成这种思维模式。这两种方法都取得了显著的性能提升，并且能够有效地应用于协作推理任务。总体而言，我们的研究发现强调了跨模态共指对于推进稳健的多模态推理至关重要。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Inflated Excellence or True Performance? Rethinking Medical Diagnostic Benchmarks with Dynamic Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 虚高的卓越表现还是真实的性能？通过动态评估重新思考医学诊断的标准
papers.authors: Xiangxu Zhang, Lei Li, Yanyun Zhou, Xiao Zhou, Yingying Zhang, Xian Wu
papers.abstract: Medical diagnostics is a high-stakes and complex domain that is critical to patient care. However, current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) remain limited in capturing key challenges of clinical diagnostic scenarios. Most rely on benchmarks derived from public exams, raising contamination bias that can inflate performance, and they overlook the confounded nature of real consultations beyond textbook cases. Recent dynamic evaluations offer a promising alternative, but often remain insufficient for diagnosis-oriented benchmarking, with limited coverage of clinically grounded confounders and trustworthiness beyond accuracy. To address these gaps, we propose DyReMe, a dynamic benchmark for medical diagnostics that provides a controlled and scalable stress test of diagnostic robustness. Unlike static exam-style questions, DyReMe generates fresh, consultation-style cases that incorporate clinically grounded confounders, such as differential diagnoses and common misdiagnosis factors. It also varies expression styles to capture heterogeneous patient-style descriptions. Beyond accuracy, DyReMe evaluates LLMs on three additional clinically relevant dimensions: veracity, helpfulness, and consistency. Our experiments show that this dynamic approach yields more challenging assessments and exposes substantial weaknesses of stateof-the-art LLMs under clinically confounded diagnostic settings. These findings highlight the urgent need for evaluation frameworks that better assess trustworthy medical diagnostics under clinically grounded confounders.
papers.abstract_zh: 医学诊断是一个高风险且复杂的领域，对患者的护理至关重要。然而，目前对大语言模型（LLM）的评估在捕捉临床诊断场景中的关键挑战方面仍然存在局限性。大多数评估都依赖于公开考试得出的基准数据，这会导致性能被高估，同时忽略了真实咨询中存在的复杂情况。最近的动态评估提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但往往仍不足以满足诊断相关的评估需求，因为它们对临床相关因素的考虑有限，且除了准确性之外，其可信度也值得质疑。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了DyReMe这一动态诊断基准测试工具。与静态的考试式问题不同，DyReMe生成的是全新的、基于实际咨询情境的案例，这些案例包含了临床相关的因素，如鉴别诊断和常见的误诊因素。此外，DyReMe还会改变表达风格，以涵盖不同患者描述的特点。除了准确性之外，DyReMe还从三个临床相关的维度来评估LLM：真实性、帮助性和一致性。我们的实验表明，这种动态方法能够提供更具有挑战性的评估，并揭示了当前最先进的LLM在临床复杂诊断环境下的显著弱点。这些发现凸显了需要更完善的评估框架来更好地评估在临床相关因素影响下的可靠医学诊断。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TrendFact: A Benchmark Towards Hotspot Perception in Automatic Fact-Checking
papers.title_zh: 趋势事实：自动事实核查中用于判断热点事件的参考标准
papers.authors: Xiaocheng Zhang, Xi Wang, Yifei Lu, Jianing Wang, Zhuangzhuang Ye, Mengjiao Bao, Peng Yan, Xiaohong Su
papers.abstract: With the surge of online misinformation, Large Language Models (LLMs) and Reasoning Large Language Models (RLMs) serving as Automatic Fact-Checking (AFC) systems have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reliable, explainable verification. However, our empirical study reveals that this paradigm faces a critical risk asymmetry challenge when deployed in real-world under resource-constrained environments. While Hotspot Perception Ability (HPA), the capacity to dynamically allocate reasoning resources based on social impact, is essential to mitigate this risk, existing benchmarks lack the social metadata and evaluation framework to meet this urgent evaluation needs, thereby hindering the advancement of these AFC systems. To bridge this gap, we introduce TrendFact, the first benchmark capable of evaluating HPA and three fact-checking tasks. It consists of 7,643 curated samples sourced from trending platforms and professional datasets, with an evidence library containing 366,634 entries. To enable HPA assessment, we propose two novel metrics: the Explanation Consistency Score (ECS) to evaluate the reliability of verification reasoning, and the Hotspot Claim Perception Index (HCPI) to quantify the overall HPA of AFC systems. Extensive experiments demonstrate that existing AFC systems exhibit limited performance on TrendFact. Furthermore, our proposed FactISR framework effectively enhances HPA and computational efficiency for RLM-driven systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着网络上的错误信息激增，大语言模型（LLM）和推理大语言模型（RLM）作为自动事实核查系统，已成为实现可靠、可解释核查的重要方案。然而，我们的实证研究表明，当这些系统在资源有限的实际环境中运行时，会面临一个关键的风险不对称问题。虽然热点感知能力——即根据社会影响动态分配推理资源的能力——对于降低这种风险至关重要，但现有的评估基准缺乏必要的社会元数据和评估框架来满足这一迫切的评估需求，从而阻碍了这些自动事实核查系统的进步。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了TrendFact这一首个能够评估热点感知能力和三项事实核查任务的基准测试。该基准测试包含7,643个来自热门平台和专业数据集的精选样本，其证据库包含366,634条记录。为了支持热点感知能力的评估，我们提出了两种新的指标：解释一致性得分（ECS），用于评估核查推理的可靠性；热点声明感知指数（HCPI），用于量化自动事实核查系统的整体热点感知能力。广泛的实验表明，现有的自动事实核查系统在TrendFact上的表现有限。此外，我们提出的FactISR框架能够有效提升RLM驱动系统的热点感知能力和计算效率。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: MPBoCo: Multimodal Prompt-based Boundary-enhanced Continual Framework for Joint Entity and Relation Extraction
papers.title_zh: MPBoCo：一种基于多模态提示的边界增强持续框架，用于联合实体与关系提取任务
papers.authors: Guanglu Sun, Xinyu Liu, Lili Liang, Yang Yu, Fei Lang, Suxia Zhu, Ming Liu
papers.abstract: In real-world scenarios, multimodal information continuously evolves, with new entity and relation types emerging, necessitating timely updates to multimodal knowledge graphs for supporting downstream tasks. However, existing methods struggle to balance real-time adaptability and computational efficiency in continual learning scenarios. To this end, this paper proposes the Continual Multimodal Entity and Relation Joint Extraction (CMERJE) task and a Multimodal Prompt-based Boundary-enhanced Continual (MPBoCo) framework. Specifically, MPBoCo incrementally stores task-specific knowledge via learnable multimodal prompts, dynamically matches relevant prompts for each instance, and fuses them into a frozen backbone model for task-specific reasoning. Subsequently, the boundary-enhanced dual-branch module leverages the auxiliary branch to preserve local syntactic continuity and provide boundary guidance. Experimental results demonstrate that MPBoCo achieves superior performance in real-world scenarios, significantly outperforming baseline methods by 5.5% and 7.2% in 10-task and 5-task settings, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实场景中，多模态信息不断演变，新的实体和关系类型不断涌现，这就需要及时更新多模态知识图谱以支持后续任务。然而，现有的方法在持续学习场景中难以同时兼顾实时适应性和计算效率。为此，本文提出了连续多模态实体与关系联合提取（CMERJE）任务以及基于多模态提示的边界增强连续学习框架（MPBoCo）。具体来说，MPBoCo通过可学习的多模态提示逐步存储特定任务的知识，动态为每个实例匹配相关提示，并将它们融合成一个固定的主干模型，用于进行特定任务的推理。随后，边界增强的双分支模块利用辅助分支来保持局部句法连续性，并提供边界指导。实验结果表明，MPBoCo在现实场景中的性能表现优于其他方法，在10任务和5任务设置下分别比基线方法高出5.5%和7.2%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ConfSpec: Efficient Step-Level Speculative Reasoning via Confidence-Gated Verification
papers.title_zh: ConfSpec：通过置信度控制验证实现高效的级联推理机制
papers.authors: Siran Liu, Zane Cao, Yongchao He
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought reasoning significantly improves the performance of large language models on complex tasks, but incurs high inference latency due to long generation traces. Step-level speculative reasoning aims to mitigate this cost, yet existing approaches face a long-standing trade-off among accuracy, inference speed, and resource efficiency. We propose ConfSpec, a confidence-gated cascaded verification framework that resolves this trade-off. Our key insight is an asymmetry between generation and verification: while generating a correct reasoning step requires substantial model capacity, step-level verification is a constrained discriminative task for which small draft models are well-calibrated within their competence range, enabling high-confidence draft decisions to be accepted directly while selectively escalating uncertain cases to the large target model. Evaluation across diverse workloads shows that ConfSpec achieves up to 2.24\times end-to-end speedups while matching target-model accuracy. Our method requires no external judge models and is orthogonal to token-level speculative decoding, enabling further multiplicative acceleration.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链推理显著提升了大语言模型在复杂任务上的性能，但由于生成过程耗时较长，其推理延迟较高。而步骤级推测性推理旨在降低这一成本。然而，现有方法在准确性、推理速度和资源效率之间一直存在权衡问题。我们提出了ConfSpec这一基于置信度控制的级联验证框架，该框架能够解决这一权衡问题。我们的关键洞察是：在生成正确的推理步骤时需要大量的模型能力，而步骤级验证则是一个具有约束条件的判别任务。在这种情况下，小型草稿模型能够在自身能力范围内很好地完成任务，从而可以直接接受高置信度的决策结果，同时将不确定的情况选择性地提交给大型目标模型进行进一步处理。在多种工作负载上的评估表明，ConfSpec能够实现高达2.24倍的端到端加速效果，同时还能保持与目标模型的准确性相匹配的效果。我们的方法不需要外部判断模型，并且与令牌级推测性解码相互独立，从而可以进一步实现加速效果。

papers.title: Personalizing LLMs with Binary Feedback: A Preference-Calibrated Optimization Framework
papers.title_zh: 通过二元反馈来个性化大型语言模型：一种基于偏好校准的优化框架
papers.authors: Xilai Ma, Liye Zhao, Weijun Yao, Haibing Di, Wenya Wang, Jing Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) personalization aims to align model behaviors with individual user preferences.Existing methods often focus on isolated user histories, neglecting the essential role of inter-user differences.We propose C-BPO, a framework that personalizes LLMs via preference-calibrated binary signals.By treating target user data as positive feedback and other users’ data as an auxiliary set of implicit negative signals, C-BPO captures distinct inter-user differences.To mitigate the preference overlap issue, where shared task knowledge is erroneously penalized, we derive an objective grounded in Positive-Unlabeled (PU) learning theory.This approach purifies negative signals by subtracting “positive bias”, ensuring alignment with unique idiosyncrasies without compromising general helpfulness.Empirical experiments across various personalization tasks and backbone LLMs show C-BPO consistently outperforms baselines, demonstrating the efficacy of preference-calibrated binary signals in modeling inter-user differences.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型个性化技术旨在使模型的行为与用户个体的偏好保持一致。现有的方法往往只关注用户的孤立历史数据，而忽视了不同用户之间差异的重要性。我们提出了C-BPO框架，该框架通过基于偏好校准的二进制信号来实现对语言模型的个性化处理。将目标用户的数据视为正面反馈，而将其他用户的数据视为辅助性的负面信号，C-BPO能够捕捉到不同用户之间的显著差异。为了缓解偏好重叠问题——即共享的任务知识被错误地惩罚了的情况，我们提出了一种基于正标签学习理论的目标导向方法。这种方法通过消除“正面偏差”来净化负面信号，从而确保模型能够适应每个用户的独特特性，同时不影响模型的通用性。在多种个性化任务和对齐语言模型上进行的实验表明，C-BPO始终优于基线方法，这证明了基于偏好校准的二进制信号在模拟用户间差异方面的有效性。

papers.title: Localized Low-Rank Adaptation within Clustered Parameter Subspaces
papers.title_zh: 在聚类参数子空间中的局部低秩适应问题
papers.authors: Jiahao Xiong, Yihe Liu, Xianming Hu, Hongbo Zhao, Nuoyi Chen, Jie Zhang, Kai Zhang
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for large language models (LLMs) has achieved significant success in various domains. So far, most algorithms in the LoRA-family rely on global low-rank factors spanning the entire update weight matrix (\Delta \mathbf{W}). Through careful analysis, however, we observe that the \Delta \mathbf{W} during fine-tuning typically exhibit heterogeneous subspace clusters, each corresponding to specific sub-sets of rows and columns. This structural heterogeneity suggests that global low-rank factors may not optimally capture the local variations needed for effective model adaptation. To address this limitation, we propose LoRA within Clustered Parameter Subspaces, or CPS-LoRA, which performs independent low-rank updates within clustered blocks of parameter matrices. The key idea is to group the rows/columns of the update matrix into locally coherent, and maximally uncorrelated subspaces, perform low-rank adaptations in each subspace, and iteratively update the partition and local adaptations. This allows adapting to local structures more precisely while preserving high efficiency. Theoretical analysis reveals that in case \Delta \mathbf{W} can be partitioned into subspace blocks with non-overlapping basis, CPS-LoRA have superior parameter efficiency than global adaptations. Empirical evaluations further demonstrate better rank utilization of CPS-LoRA and its consistent improvements against LoRA (and variants) by up to 3.0% in absolute accuracy in various benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对大语言模型（LLM）的低秩适应方法（LoRA）已在多个领域取得了显著成果。目前，大多数LoRA相关算法都依赖于覆盖整个更新权重矩阵（ΔW）的全局低秩因子。然而，通过仔细分析我们发现，在微调过程中，ΔW通常呈现出异质性的子空间簇结构，每个子空间簇对应特定的行和列子集。这种结构上的异质性表明，全局低秩因子可能无法有效捕捉实现有效模型适应所需的局部变化。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了基于聚类参数子空间的LoRA方法，即CPS-LoRA。该方法在参数矩阵的聚类块内分别进行低秩更新。其核心思想是将更新矩阵的行/列划分为局部连贯且最大程度不相关的子空间，在每个子空间中执行低秩适应操作，并迭代地更新这些子空间的划分和局部适应方式。这样可以在保持高效率的同时，更精确地适应局部结构。理论分析表明，如果ΔW可以被划分为具有非重叠基的子空间块，那么CPS-LoRA在参数效率方面优于全局适应方法。实证评估进一步证明，CPS-LoRA在各项基准测试中的参数利用率更高，其绝对准确率相比LoRA及其变体提升了3.0%。

papers.title: SGVEF-LOOP: Coverage-Guided Progressive Topological Exploration and Fact-Grounded Metamorphic Evaluation for MCP Agents
papers.title_zh: SGVEF-LOOP：基于覆盖范围的渐进式拓扑探索，以及基于事实的变形体评估机制，适用于MCP智能体
papers.authors: Zenghao Liu, Yansong Zhang
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem introduces a combinatorially complex tool space, rendering existing frameworks inadequate for comprehensive agent evaluation. To address this problem, we propose SGVEF-LOOP, a coverage-guided framework for progressive topological exploration and fact-augmented metamorphic testing. SGVEF operates via a synergistic closed loop: it navigates sparse regions using adaptive sampling, synthesizes oracle-free metamorphic pairs grounded in static knowledge, enforces dual-constraint validation to ensure consistency and solvability, and leverages execution feedback to iteratively optimize exploration. Deploying this framework yields a high-fidelity benchmark achieving 100% node coverage and saturating 80.54% of the theoretical transition bound (estimated via Chao1). Evaluation of 8 diverse MCP Agents reveals capability stratification and exposes critical behavioral anomalies—such as reasoning instability—that conventional metrics fail to capture. Consequently, this work establishes a generalizable paradigm for scalable, rigorous agent evaluation in dynamic environments.
papers.abstract_zh: Model Context Protocol（MCP）生态系统的快速扩张引入了一个组合上极其复杂的工具空间，使得现有的框架无法充分应对全面的智能体评估任务。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SGVEF-LOOP框架——一个基于覆盖引导的渐进式拓扑探索与事实增强变形测试框架。SGVEF通过一种协同闭环机制运作：它利用自适应采样技术来遍历稀疏区域，合成基于静态知识的无预言性变形对，实施双重约束验证以确保一致性和可解性，并通过执行反馈来不断优化探索策略。采用该框架可以生成高保真度的测试基准，实现100%的节点覆盖率，并达到理论转换界限的80.54%（通过Chao1算法估算得出）。对8种不同MCP智能体的评估表明，该框架能够揭示出能力层次结构，并发现一些传统指标难以捕捉的关键行为异常现象，例如推理的不稳定性。因此，本研究为在动态环境中进行可扩展且严谨的智能体评估提供了一种通用的方法论。

papers.title: MentalSeek-Dx: Towards Progressive Hypothetico-Deductive Reasoning for Real-world Psychiatric Diagnosis
papers.title_zh: MentalSeek-Dx：迈向用于现实世界精神疾病诊断的渐进性假设演绎推理方法
papers.authors: Xiao Sun, Ymyang, Xinyi Jiang, Yu Tian, Junnan Zhu, Jiang Zhong, Qin Lei, Jingwang Huang, Haoyang Zeng, Xinyu Zhou, Xin Xiao, Kaiwen Wei
papers.abstract: Mental health disorders represent a burgeoning global public health challenge. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in psychiatric assessment, their clinical utility is severely constrained by benchmarks that lack ecological validity and fine-grained diagnostic supervision. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{MentalDx Bench}, the first benchmark dedicated to disorder-level psychiatric diagnosis within real-world clinical settings. Comprising 712 de-identified electronic health records annotated by board-certified psychiatrists under ICD-11 guidelines, the benchmark covers 76 disorders across 16 diagnostic categories. Evaluation of 18 LLMs reveals a critical \textit{paradigm misalignment}: strong performance at coarse diagnostic categorization contrasts with systematic failure at disorder-level diagnosis, underscoring a gap between pattern-based modeling and clinical hypothetico-deductive reasoning.In response, we propose \textbf{MentalSeek-Dx}, a medical-specialized LLM trained to internalize this clinical reasoning process through supervised trajectory construction and curriculum-based reinforcement learning. Experiments on MentalDx Bench demonstrate that MentalSeek-Dx achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with only 14B parameters, establishing a clinically grounded framework for reliable psychiatric diagnosis. The dataset and code are available.
papers.abstract_zh: 心理健康障碍已成为一个日益严重的全球公共卫生问题。虽然大语言模型在精神病学评估方面展现出潜力，但其临床应用受到缺乏生态有效性和精细诊断监督的基准测试的严重限制。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了**MentalDx Bench**，这是首个专注于现实临床环境中进行疾病级别精神病学诊断的基准测试。该基准测试包含712份经过去标识化的电子健康记录，这些记录由根据ICD-11指南进行标注的认证精神科医生审核，涵盖了16个诊断类别中的76种疾病。对18个大语言模型的评估显示出一个关键的**模式不匹配问题**：它们在粗略的诊断分类方面表现优异，但在疾病级别的诊断上却存在系统性失败，这凸显了基于模式的建模与临床假设演绎推理之间的差距。为此，我们提出了**MentalSeek-Dx**，这是一个专为医学领域设计的语言模型，通过监督式轨迹构建和基于课程的强化学习训练，使其能够内化这种临床推理过程。在MentalDx Bench上的实验表明，MentalSeek-Dx仅使用140亿参数就能达到最先进的性能水平，为可靠的精神病学诊断建立了一个具有临床基础的框架。该数据集和代码现已公开可用。

papers.title: Think Parallax: Solving Multi-Hop Problems via Multi-View Knowledge-Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 思考视差效应：通过基于多视图知识图的检索增强式生成方法解决多跳问题
papers.authors: Jinliang Liu, Jiale Bai, Shaoning Zeng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) still struggle with multi-hop reasoning over knowledge-graphs (KGs), and we identify a previously overlooked structural reason for this difficulty: Transformer attention heads naturally specialize in distinct semantic relations across reasoning stages, forming a hop-aligned relay pattern. This key finding suggests that multi-hop reasoning is inherently multi-view, yet existing KG-based retrieval-augmented generation (KG-RAG) systems collapse all reasoning hops into a single representation, flat embedding space, suppressing this implicit structure and causing noisy or drifted path exploration. We introduce ParallaxRAG, a symmetric multi-view framework that decouples queries and KGs into aligned, head-specific retrieval spaces. By enforcing relational diversity across heads while constraining weakly related paths, ParallaxRAG constructs more accurate, cleaner subgraphs and guides LLMs through grounded, hop-wise reasoning. On WebQSP and CWQ, it achieves state-of-the-art retrieval and QA performance, substantially reduces hallucination, and generalizes strongly to the biomedical BioASQ benchmark. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/LucaLiu1313/ParallaxRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在基于知识图谱的多跳推理方面仍然存在困难。我们发现了一个之前被忽视的结构性原因：Transformer的注意力机制在推理阶段会自然专注于不同的语义关系，从而形成一种与跳跃层次相对应的传递模式。这一关键发现表明，多跳推理本质上是多视图的，但现有的基于知识图谱的检索增强生成系统将所有推理层次压缩为单一的表示形式，即扁平的嵌入空间，从而忽略了这种隐式结构，导致路径探索出现错误或偏差。我们提出了ParallaxRAG这一对称的多视图框架，它将查询与知识图谱分离，分别构建出与头部特征相对应的检索空间。通过强制不同头部之间保持关系多样性，同时限制相关性较低的路径，ParallaxRAG能够构建出更精确、更清晰的子图结构，并引导语言模型进行有根可循的多跳推理。在WebQSP和CWQ任务上，该框架取得了最先进的检索和问答性能，显著减少了幻觉现象，并且在生物医学BioASQ基准测试中表现出强大的泛化能力。我们的实现代码可以在https://github.com/LucaLiu1313/ParallaxRAG下载。

papers.title: AIM-CoT: Active Information-driven Multimodal Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.title_zh: AIM-CoT：一种基于信息的多模态思维链，用于视觉与语言推理
papers.authors: Xiping Li, Jianghong Ma
papers.abstract: Interleaved-Modal Chain-of-Thought (I-MCoT) advances vision-language reasoning, such as Visual Question Answering (VQA). This paradigm integrates specially selected visual evidence from the input image into the context of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), enabling them to ground their reasoning logic in these details. Accordingly, the efficacy of an I-MCoT framework relies on identifying what to see (evidence selection) and when to see it (triggering of insertions). However, existing methods fall short in both aspects. First, for selection, they rely on attention signals, which are unreliable—particularly under severe granularity imbalance between the brief textual query and the informative image. Second, for triggering, they adopt static triggers, which fail to capture the VLMs’ dynamic needs for visual evidence. To this end, we propose a novel I-MCoT framework, Active Information-driven Multi-modal Chain-of-Thought (AIM-CoT), which aims to improve both evidence selection and insertion triggering via: (1) Context-enhanced Attention-map Generation (CAG) to mitigate granularity imbalance via textual context enhancement; (2) Active Visual Probing (AVP) to proactively select the most informative evidence via an information foraging process; and (3) Dynamic Attention-shift Trigger (DAT) to precisely activate insertions when VLM’s attention shifts from text to visual context. Experiments across three benchmarks and four backbones demonstrate AIM-CoT’s consistent superiority. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AIMCoT.
papers.abstract_zh: 交错模式思维链（I-MCoT）提升了视觉-语言推理能力，例如视觉问答任务（VQA）。该范式将输入图像中精心挑选的视觉信息融入视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的语境中，使模型能够将这些细节作为推理依据。因此，I-MCoT框架的有效性取决于如何识别需要查看的内容（证据选择）以及何时进行插入操作（触发插入）。然而，现有方法在这两个方面都存在不足。首先，在证据选择方面，它们依赖注意力信号，而注意力信号并不可靠——尤其是在简短的文本查询与富有信息量的图像之间存在严重的粒度不平衡时。其次，在触发插入方面，它们采用静态触发机制，无法满足VLMs对视觉信息的动态需求。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的I-MCoT框架——主动信息驱动多模态思维链（AIM-CoT），该框架通过以下方式改善证据选择和插入触发：1）通过上下文增强注意力图生成技术来减轻粒度不平衡问题；2）通过主动视觉探测技术来主动选择最有信息量的证据；3）通过动态注意力转移触发机制来在VLM的注意力从文本转移到视觉语境时精确触发插入操作。在三个基准测试和四个基础模型上的实验表明，AIM-CoT具有持续的优越性。我们的代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AIMCoT获取。

papers.title: Benchmarking Egocentric Clinical Intent Understanding Capability for Medical Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 对医疗多模态大型语言模型的以自我为中心的临床意图理解能力进行基准测试
papers.authors: Shaonan Liu, Guo Yu, Xiaoling Luo, Shiyi Zheng, Jie Liu, Wenting Chen, Linlin Shen
papers.abstract: Medical Multimodal Large Language Models (Med-MLLMs) require egocentric clinical intent understanding for real-world deployment, yet existing benchmarks fail to evaluate this critical capability. We introduce MedGaze-Bench, the first benchmark leveraging clinician gaze as a Cognitive Cursor to assess intent understanding across surgery, emergency simulation, and diagnostic interpretation. Our benchmark addresses three fundamental challenges: visual homogeneity of anatomical structures, strict temporal-causal dependencies in clinical workflows, and implicit adherence to safety protocols. We propose a Three-Dimensional Clinical Intent Framework evaluating: (1) Spatial Intent—discriminating precise targets amid visual noise, (2) Temporal Intent—inferring causal rationale through retrospective and prospective reasoning, and (3) Standard Intent—verifying protocol compliance through safety checks. Beyond accuracy metrics, we introduce Trap QA mechanisms to stress-test clinical reliability by penalizing hallucinations and cognitive sycophancy. Experiments reveal current MLLMs struggle with egocentric intent due to over-reliance on global features, leading to fabricated observations and uncritical acceptance of invalid instructions.
papers.abstract_zh: 医学多模态大语言模型在现实世界中的应用需要具备以自我为中心的意图理解能力，然而现有的评估基准却未能充分考核这一关键能力。我们提出了MedGaze-Bench这一基准测试，它是首个利用临床医生的视角作为认知光标来评估手术、急诊模拟和诊断解读过程中意图理解的基准测试。我们的基准测试解决了三个基本挑战：解剖结构的视觉一致性、临床工作流程中的严格时间因果依赖性，以及对安全协议的隐性遵守。我们提出了一种三维临床意图框架，用于评估以下方面：(1)空间意图——在视觉噪声中区分精确目标；(2)时间意图——通过回顾性和前瞻性推理来推断因果逻辑；(3)标准意图——通过安全检查来验证协议合规性。除了准确性指标之外，我们还引入了Trap QA机制，通过惩罚幻觉和认知迎合行为来测试临床可靠性。实验表明，当前的MLLMs由于过度依赖全局特征，难以处理以自我为中心的意图问题，这会导致错误的观察结果以及对无效指令的无批判接受。

papers.title: Data Pollination: An Emergent Ecological Process Driving AI Population Evolution
papers.title_zh: 数据传播：推动人工智能系统种群进化的新兴生态过程
papers.authors: Shufang Xie, Qizhi Pei, Ang Lv, Jingyang Hu, Lijun Wu, Rui Yan
papers.abstract: AI development is often framed as the outcome of isolated research and engineering efforts, yet evidence from deployed systems suggests that language models interact through a shared data ecosystem. While the optimization of individual models is extensively studied, the emergent properties of this interconnected population remain largely unexplored, limiting our ability to predict long-term ecosystem trajectories We term this process data pollination, the unintentional circulation of synthetic model outputs through shared online platforms and web-scale training corpora, and formalize it as a population-based evolutionary framework to investigate stability dynamics under synthetic data training. Our theoretical analysis and controlled experiments involving 320 language models demonstrate that population dynamics can mitigate the model collapse observed in single-lineage recursive training, yielding stable or improving performance across diverse benchmarks. Crucially, we find that ecological diversity functions as a fundamental resilience mechanism that safeguards the ecosystem against collapse, highlighting the critical importance of maintaining model diversity for sustainable AI development.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能的发展往往被视作孤立研究和工程努力的成果，但实际上，从实际部署的系统来看，语言模型是通过一个共享的数据生态系统进行交互的。虽然对单个模型的优化已经得到了广泛研究，但这一相互连接的模型群体所展现出的特性却仍然鲜有探讨，这限制了我们预测长期生态系统发展趋势的能力。我们将这一过程称为“数据授粉”——即合成模型输出通过共享的在线平台和大规模训练数据集进行无意识的传播。我们将其形式化为一种基于群体的进化框架，以研究在合成数据训练下的稳定性动态。我们的理论分析和涉及320个语言模型的实验表明，群体动态可以缓解单一谱系递归训练中出现的模型崩溃现象，从而在各种基准测试中获得稳定或更好的性能。重要的是，我们发现生态多样性作为一种基本的韧性机制，能够保护生态系统免于崩溃，这凸显了维持模型多样性对于可持续人工智能发展的重要性。

papers.title: Extending First-Order Logic for Factual Reasoning over Knowledge Graphs
papers.title_zh: 将一阶逻辑扩展应用于知识图谱上的事实推理
papers.authors: Yuanzhen Hao, Desheng Wu
papers.abstract: First-order logic (FOL) is a fundamental formalism for factual reasoning over knowledge graphs (KGs), e.g. in researches of KG-based fact verification and logical consistency or reasoning of large language models (LLM). However, existing benchmarks and approaches insufficiently capture many claims that require comparison or counting, and lack support for several FOL quantifiers and connectives. To address these challenges and expand the expressive capacity of FOL for KG-based reasoning, we introduce FOLX-KG, a novel extended FOL \sigma-structure over KGs that incorporates comparison predicates and counting quantifiers. Using this extended logic, we construct Fact-FOLX-KG, a fact verification dataset consisting of 43,821 KG-based claim–formula pairs designed to enable systematic study of richer logical forms and reasoning types. We further propose FOLX Prover, an executable program-guided logic reasoning pipeline adapted for KG-based factual reasoning under the extended FOL. Experimental results show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on Fact-FOLX-KG, while previous methods experience performance drop on claims requiring comparison and counting. These findings demonstrate the importance of extended logical expressiveness for robust factual reasoning over KGs.
papers.abstract_zh: 一阶逻辑（FOL）是处理知识图谱（KGs）上事实推理的一种基本形式，例如在基于KGs的事实验证、逻辑一致性检查或大语言模型（LLM）的推理研究中。然而，现有的基准测试和方法是无法充分满足许多需要比较或计数的需求的，而且它们缺乏对多种FOL量词和连接词的支持。为了应对这些挑战并提升FOL在基于KGs的推理中的表达能力，我们提出了FOLX-KG这一新型扩展的FOLσ-结构，它包含了比较谓词和计数量词。利用这种扩展逻辑，我们构建了Fact-FOLX-KG这一事实验证数据集，该数据集包含43,821对基于KGs的主张-公式对，旨在系统地研究更丰富的逻辑形式和推理类型。我们还提出了FOLX Prover这一可执行的程序化逻辑推理流程，适用于在扩展的FOL框架下进行基于KGs的事实推理。实验结果表明，我们的方法在Fact-FOLX-KG上的性能达到了最先进水平，而之前的方法在需要处理比较和计数的任务时表现较差。这些发现表明，扩展的逻辑表达能力对于在KGs上进行稳健的事实推理至关重要。

papers.title: Diffuse Thinking: Exploring Diffusion Language Models as Efficient Thought Proposers for Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 发散性思维：探索作为高效推理工具的差分语言模型
papers.authors: Chenyang Shao, Sijian Ren, Fengli Xu, Yong Li
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex reasoning tasks, yet their autoregressive generation paradigm makes it computationally expensive to explore diverse reasoning paths. In contrast, diffusion language models (DLMs) adopt a parallel, non-autoregressive generation mechanism that enables the efficient production of diverse candidate outputs. Motivated by this complementarity, we explore a collaborative reasoning framework that combines diffusion-based generation with autoregressive evaluation. Specifically, we leverage DLMs to efficiently generate diverse intermediate reasoning thoughts, and employ LLMs as evaluators to assess and select candidates based on their plausibility and correctness. By decoupling proposal generation from evaluation, our framework exploits the strengths of both models: efficient exploration from diffusion models and causally grounded assessment from autoregressive models, which naturally aligns with the divergent-convergent thinking framework in cognitive psychology. Experiments across various mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our framework improves inference efficiency while maintaining competitive or superior reasoning accuracy, laying the groundwork for building efficient reasoning architectures. Our code is open-source at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Diffuse-Thinking-EC60.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂的推理任务中展现出了强大的能力，然而其自回归生成机制使得探索多种推理路径在计算上非常耗费资源。相比之下，扩散语言模型采用了一种并行、非自回归的生成机制，从而能够高效地产生多样化的候选输出。基于这种互补性，我们提出了一种协作推理框架，该框架结合了基于扩散生成的机制与自回归评估方法。具体来说，我们利用扩散语言模型来高效地生成多样化的中间推理思路，同时利用大语言模型作为评估工具，根据候选输出的合理性和正确性来进行评估和选择。通过将提案生成与评估分离开来，我们的框架充分利用了两种模型的优势：扩散模型的高效探索能力以及自回归模型基于因果关系的评估能力，这与认知心理学中的发散-收敛思维框架相契合。在多种数学和逻辑推理基准测试中的实验表明，我们的框架在提高推理效率的同时，仍能保持具有竞争力的或更高的推理准确性，为构建高效的推理架构奠定了基础。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Diffuse-Thinking-EC60获取。

papers.title: Does Memory Need Graphs? A Unified Framework and Empirical Analysis for Long-Term Dialog Memory
papers.title_zh: 记忆真的需要图表来呈现吗？一种统一的框架与针对长期对话记忆的实证分析
papers.authors: Sen Hu, Yuxiang Wei, Jiaxin Ran, Xueran Han, Zhiyuan Yao, Huacan Wang, Ronghao Chen, Lei Zou
papers.abstract: Graph structures are increasingly adopted in dialog memory systems, motivated by their success in retrieval-augmented generation and the associative nature of human memory. However, empirical findings on their effectiveness remain inconsistent, making it unclear which design choices truly matter. In this work, we present an experimental and system-oriented analysis of long-term dialog memory architectures. We formalize a unified framework that decomposes dialog memory systems into core components and supports both graph-based and non-graph approaches. Under this framework, we conduct controlled, stage-wise experiments on LongMemEval and HaluMem, comparing common design choices in memory representation, organization and maintenance, as well as indexing and retrieval. Our results show that underlying implementation details—often insufficiently specified in prior work—have a substantial impact on performance, and we identify stable, reliable strong baselines to support fair comparison and practical deployment. Code are available at https://github.com/AvatarMemory/UnifiedMem.
papers.abstract_zh: 图结构在对话记忆系统中得到了越来越多的应用，这得益于它们在增强式生成中的成功表现，以及人类记忆的关联特性。然而，关于图结构有效性的实证研究结果并不一致，因此很难确定哪些设计选择才是真正重要的。在这项研究中，我们对长期对话记忆架构进行了实验性和系统导向的分析。我们构建了一个统一的框架，将对话记忆系统分解为核心组件，并支持基于图的方法与非基于图的方法。在这个框架下，我们在LongMemEval和HaluMem上进行了分阶段、受控的实验，比较了不同记忆表示方式、组织与维护方式，以及索引与检索方面的常见设计选择。我们的研究结果表明，那些在先前研究中往往被忽视的实现细节，对性能有着显著的影响。此外，我们还找到了稳定、可靠的优秀基准方案，以支持公平的比较和实际的部署。相关代码可访问于https://github.com/AvatarMemory/UnifiedMem。

papers.title: False Friends in the Shell: Unveiling the Emoticon Semantic Confusion in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 贝壳中的假朋友：大型语言模型中表情符号的语义混乱现象
papers.authors: Weipeng Jiang, Xiaoyu Zhang, Juan Zhai, Shiqing Ma, Chao Shen, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Emoticons are widely used in digital communication to convey affective intent, yet their safety implications for Large Language Models (LLMs) remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we identify emoticon semantic confusion, a vulnerability where LLMs misinterpret ASCII-based emoticons to perform unintended and even destructive actions. To systematically study this phenomenon, we develop an automated data generation pipeline and construct a dataset containing 3,757 code-oriented test cases spanning 21 meta-scenarios, four programming languages, and varying contextual complexities. Our study on six LLMs reveals that emoticon semantic confusion is pervasive, with an average confusion ratio exceeding 38%. More critically, over 90% of confused responses yield ’silent failures’, which are syntactically valid outputs but deviate from user intent, potentially leading to destructive security consequences.Furthermore, we observe that this vulnerability readily transfers to popular agent frameworks, while existing prompt-based mitigations remain largely ineffective. We call on the community to recognize this emerging vulnerability and develop effective mitigation methods to uphold the safety and reliability of human-LLM interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 表情符号在数字通信中被广泛使用，用于传达情感意图。然而，它们对大语言模型的安全性影响却尚未得到充分研究。在本文中，我们发现了一种名为“表情符号语义混淆”的漏洞——即语言模型误解释基于ASCII的表情符号，从而导致非预期甚至破坏性的行为。为了系统研究这一现象，我们开发了一个自动数据生成流程，并构建了一个包含3,757个测试案例的数据集，这些案例涵盖了21种不同场景、四种编程语言以及不同的上下文复杂度。我们对六种语言模型的研究表明，表情符号语义混淆现象非常普遍，平均混淆比例超过38%。更令人担忧的是，超过90%的混淆响应都是“无声失败”——这些响应虽然在语法上是正确的，但却偏离了用户的意图，有可能导致严重的安全后果。此外，我们发现这种漏洞很容易转移到流行的智能体框架中，而现有的基于提示的缓解措施仍然效果不佳。我们呼吁相关社区认识到这一新兴漏洞，并开发有效的缓解方法，以确保人类与语言模型的互动既安全又可靠。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DocLens: A Tool-Augmented Multi-Agent Framework for Long Visual Document Understanding
papers.title_zh: DocLens：一种基于工具辅助的多智能体框架，用于长期视觉文档理解
papers.authors: Dawei Zhu, Rui Meng, Jiefeng Chen, Sujian Li, Tomas Pfister, Jinsung Yoon
papers.abstract: Comprehending long visual documents, where information is distributed across extensive pages of text and visual elements, is a critical but challenging task for modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Existing approaches falter on a fundamental challenge: evidence localization. They struggle to retrieve relevant pages and overlook fine-grained details within visual elements, leading to limited performance and model hallucination. To address this, we propose DocLens, a tool-augmented multi-agent framework that effectively “zooms in” on evidence like a lens. It first navigates from the full document to specific visual elements on relevant pages, then employs a sampling-adjudication mechanism to generate a single, reliable answer. Paired with Gemini-2.5-Pro, DocLens achieves state-of-the-art performance on MMLongBench-Doc and FinRAGBench-V, surpassing even human experts. The framework’s superiority is particularly evident on vision-centric and unanswerable queries, demonstrating the power of its enhanced localization capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于现代视觉语言模型来说，理解那些信息分布在大量文本和视觉元素中的长文档是一项至关重要但充满挑战的任务。现有的方法在一项基本难题上存在不足：证据定位问题。它们难以找到相关的页面内容，同时也会忽略视觉元素中的细微细节，从而导致性能受限以及模型产生幻觉。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了DocLens这一工具增强型多智能体框架。该框架能够像镜头一样“聚焦”于相关证据。它首先从整篇文档导航到相关页面上的特定视觉元素，然后采用采样与判断机制来生成单一的、可靠的答案。结合Gemini-2.5-Pro框架使用后，DocLens在MMLongBench-Doc和FinRAGBench-V任务上的表现达到了最先进水平，甚至超越了人类专家的表现。该框架在以视觉为中心的查询或无法回答的查询方面表现得尤为出色，充分展示了其增强的定位能力所带来的强大优势。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Stability Implies Redundancy: Delta Attention Selective Halting for Efficient Long-Context Prefilling
papers.title_zh: 稳定性意味着冗余：Delta注意力选择性暂停技术，用于高效的长期上下文预填充
papers.authors: Yujie Chen, Tailai Chen, Yifeng Gao, Zoe Wanying He, Yijue Xu, Shaobo Wang, Linfeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Prefilling computational costs pose a significant bottleneck for Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in long-context settings. While token pruning reduces sequence length, prior methods rely on heuristics that break compatibility with hardware-efficient kernels like FlashAttention. In this work, we observe that tokens evolve toward semantic fixing points, making further processing redundant. To this end, we introduce Delta Attention Selective Halting (DASH), a training-free policy that monitors the layer-wise update dynamics of the self-attention mechanism to selectively halt stabilized tokens. Extensive evaluation confirms that DASH generalizes across language and vision benchmarks, delivering significant prefill speedups while preserving model accuracy and hardware efficiency. Code will be released at https://github.com/verach3n/DASH.git .
papers.abstract_zh: 在长上下文环境中，预填充计算成本是大语言模型（LLM）和大型多模态模型（LMM）面临的一个重要瓶颈。虽然令牌修剪可以缩短序列长度，但以往的方法依赖于启发式算法，这破坏了与FlashAttention等硬件高效内核的兼容性。在这项研究中，我们发现令牌会朝着语义固定点演变，这使得后续处理变得多余。为此，我们提出了Delta Attention Selective Halting（DASH）这一无需训练的策略，该策略能够监控自注意力机制的逐层更新动态，从而有选择地停止那些已经稳定的令牌的处理。广泛的评估表明，DASH能够在不同语言和视觉基准测试中表现出良好的泛化能力，同时显著提升了预填充速度，同时保持了模型的准确性和硬件效率。代码可以在https://github.com/verach3n/DASH.git下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Self-Report: Bridging the Intention-Behavior Gap in Critical Thinking Assessment via Interpretable Multi-Agent System
papers.title_zh: 超越自我报告：通过可解释的多智能体系统来弥补批判性思维评估中意图与行为之间的差距
papers.authors: Zekun Li, Jifan Yu, Haoxuan Li, Ye He, Daniel Zhang-Li, Shangqing Tu, Joy Jia Yin Lim, Yikun Jiang, Jiaxin Yuan, Yu Zhang
papers.abstract: Accurate assessment of critical thinking is historically limited by the Intention Behavior Gap in psychology: the disconnect between what individuals self-reported disposition and their actual practical behaviors. We try to bridge this gap with MASA (Multi-Agent Scenario-based Assessment), a framework that operationalizes cognitive assessment into an interpretable and interactive multi-agent workflow with Assessment Chain-of-Thought (AsCoT). Validating on both large-scale simulations (N=1,161) and human participants (N=70), we find that MASA aligns better with human expert ratings (r=0.882) than traditional gold-standard inventories (r=0.720), with an average cost of only 0.41 per participant. These results suggest that by shifting from self-report inventory to behavior-grounded dialogue, MASA offers a more accurate, cost-effective, and transparent solution for real-world cognitive evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 在历史上，对批判性思维的准确评估一直受到心理学中“意图与行为之间的差距”的限制：即个体自我报告的倾向与其实际行为之间存在脱节。我们试图通过MASA（基于多智能体场景的评估方法）来弥补这一差距。MASA是一种将认知评估转化为可解释且交互式的多智能体工作流程的框架，并采用了“评估思维链”这一概念。通过对大规模模拟实验（N=1,161）和人类参与者（N=70）的验证，我们发现MASA与人类专家的评价结果更为吻合（r=0.882），而传统的标准评估工具则只有r=0.720。此外，MASA的平均成本仅为每位参与者0.41元。这些结果表明，从基于自我报告的评估方式转变为以行为为基础的评估方式，MASA为现实世界的认知评估提供了更精确、更具成本效益且更透明的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLM Reasoning as Trajectories: Step-Specific Representation Geometry and Correctness Signals
papers.title_zh: LLM推理作为路径：基于步骤特定的表示几何结构以及正确性信号机制
papers.authors: Lihao Sun, Hang Dong, Bo Qiao, Qingwei Lin, Dongmei Zhang, Saravan Rajmohan
papers.abstract: This work characterizes large language models’ chain-of-thought generation as a structured trajectory through representation space. We show that mathematical reasoning traverses functionally ordered, step-specific subspaces that become increasingly separable with layer depth. This structure already exists in base models, while reasoning training primarily accelerates convergence toward termination-related subspaces rather than introducing new representational organization. While early reasoning steps follow similar trajectories, correct and incorrect solutions diverge systematically at late stages. This late-stage divergence enables mid-reasoning prediction of final-answer correctness with ROC–AUC up to 0.87. Furthermore, we introduce trajectory-based steering, an inference-time intervention framework that enables reasoning correction and length control based on derived ideal trajectories. Together, these results establish reasoning trajectories as a geometric lens for interpreting, predicting, and controlling LLM reasoning behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究将大语言模型的思维链生成过程描述为一种在表示空间中进行的结构化路径。我们发现，数学推理会沿着功能有序、具有特定步骤的子空间进行，这些子空间随着层数的增加而逐渐变得可分离。这种结构在基础模型中已经存在，而推理训练主要加速了模型向与终止相关的子空间的收敛，而不是引入新的表示组织形式。虽然早期的推理步骤遵循类似的路径，但正确和错误的解决方案在后期会系统地出现分歧。这种后期的分歧使得在推理过程中能够预测最终答案的正确性，其ROC-AUC值高达0.87。此外，我们提出了基于路径的引导机制，这是一种在推理过程中进行干预的框架，它能够根据推导出的理想路径来修正推理结果并控制推理长度。总的来说，这些研究结果将推理路径视为一种几何工具，用于解释、预测和控制大语言模型的推理行为。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Data-Efficient Path to Multilingual LLMs: Language Expansion via Post-training PARAM\Delta Integration into Upcycled MoE
papers.title_zh: 一种高效的数据处理方法，用于构建多语言大型语言模型：通过在后训练阶段对参数进行整合，从而实现语言的扩展。这种技术利用了重新利用的MoE模型，进一步提升了模型的性能
papers.authors: Hao Zhou, Tianhao Li, Zhijun Wang, Shuaijie She, Linjuan Wu, Hao-Ran Wei, Baosong Yang, Jiajun Chen, Shujian Huang
papers.abstract: Expanding Large Language Models(LLMs) to new languages is a costly endeavor, demanding extensive Continued Pre-Training(CPT) and data-intensive alignment. While recent data-free merging techniques attempt to bypass alignment by fusing a multilingual CPT-enhanced model with its instruct counterpart, they are plagued by a critical trade-off: mitigating parameter conflicts to preserve original abilities inevitably dilutes new language acquisition, and vice-versa. To resolve this conflict, we introduce , which upcycles a dense model into a Mixture-of-Experts(MoE) architecture, allocating different experts to different languages. Alignment ability is then transferred by grafting a MoE-expanded parameter delta(\Delta_{\text{instruct}}) to the CPT-enhanced base model, bypassing the complex alignment phase. Experiments demonstrate ’s superiority even against baselines with similar FLOPs or number of parameters; it improves performance on expanded languages while effectively preserving original capabilities. We further show our approach is highly applicable across different models and Post-training deltas.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型扩展到新语言是一项成本高昂的任务，需要大量的持续预训练以及数据密集型对齐过程。虽然最近一些无数据的合并技术试图通过融合多语言预训练增强模型与其指导模型来绕过对齐问题，但这些技术面临着一个关键的问题：为了保留原有能力而减少参数冲突，必然会削弱新语言的习得能力；反之亦然。为了解决这一矛盾，我们提出了一种方法，该方法可以将密集模型重新转化为混合专家架构，将不同的专家分配给不同的语言。然后，通过将扩展后的参数增量（$\Delta_{\text{instruct}}$） graft 到预训练增强的基础模型中，从而实现了对齐能力的传递，无需经过复杂的对齐阶段。实验表明，该方法即使面对具有相似计算复杂度或参数数量的基线模型，也能表现出明显的优势；它在扩展语言上的性能得到了提升，同时有效地保留了原有的能力。此外，我们还展示了我们的方法在不同模型和训练后增量方面都具有很高的适用性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Evolution of Thought: Tracking LLM Overthinking via Reasoning Dynamics Analysis
papers.title_zh: 思想的演变：通过推理动态分析来追踪大型语言模型过度思考的问题
papers.authors: Zihao Wei, Liang Pang, Jiahao Liu, Wenjie Shi, Jingcheng Deng, Shicheng Xu, Zenghao Duan, Jingang Wang, Fei Sun, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling via explicit reasoning trajectories significantly boosts large language model (LLM) performance but often triggers overthinking. To explore this, we analyze reasoning through two lenses: Reasoning Length Dynamics, which reveals a compensatory trade-off between thinking and answer content length that eventually leads to thinking redundancy, and Reasoning Semantic Dynamics, which identifies semantic convergence and repetitive oscillations. These dynamics uncover an instance-specific Reasoning Completion Point (RCP), beyond which computation continues without further performance gain. Since the RCP varies across instances, we propose a Reasoning Completion Point Detector (RCPD), an inference-time early-exit method that identifies the RCP by monitoring the rank dynamics of termination tokens (e.g., lt;/think gt;). Across AIME and GPQA benchmarks using Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1, RCPD reduces token usage by up to 44% while preserving accuracy, offering a principled approach to efficient test-time scaling.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过显式推理轨迹进行测试时间缩放可以显著提升大语言模型的表现，但往往会导致过度思考。为了探究这一点，我们从两个角度分析了推理过程：推理长度动态，它揭示了思考与答案内容长度之间的补偿性权衡，最终导致思考的冗余；以及推理语义动态，它指出了语义上的收敛和重复性波动。这些动态揭示了一个特定实例的推理完成点，一旦超过这个点，计算就会持续进行，而性能不再提升。由于每个实例的推理完成点不同，我们提出了一种推理完成点检测器，这是一种在推理过程中提前终止的方法，它通过监测终止标记的排名动态来识别推理完成点（例如，</think>）。在AIME和GPQA基准测试中，使用Qwen3和DeepSeek-R1模型，推理完成点检测器能够将令牌使用量减少高达44%，同时还能保持准确性，为高效的测试时间缩放提供了一种原则性的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CoCoNUTS: Concentrating on Content while Neglecting Uninformative Textual Styles for AI-Generated Peer Review Detection
papers.title_zh: CoCoNUTS：专注于内容分析，而忽略那些无用的文本风格，以便实现由人工智能生成的同行评审功能
papers.authors: Yihan Chen, Jiawei Chen, Guozhao Mo, Xuanang Chen, Ben He, Xianpei Han, Le Sun
papers.abstract: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) in peer review threatens scholarly integrity. Recent conference policies allow AI tools for language polishing but prohibit their use for generating substantive content. However, existing detectors mainly rely on stylistic cues, making it difficult to distinguish between surface-level language refinement and genuine content generation. To address this, we advocate a content-based detection paradigm and introduce CoCoNUTS, a comprehensive benchmark containing 315,535 reviews covering leading AI conferences and six human-AI collaboration modes. Our evaluation shows that current detectors struggle to handle these nuanced settings. Consequently, we propose CoCoDet, an AI review detector designed to identify substantive AI-generation. Experiments demonstrate that CoCoDet achieves a macro F1-score of 98.24%. Crucially, on permissible machine-polished reviews, it maintains a low false positive rate of 3.89%, substantially outperforming the strongest baseline (7.84%). Examination on real-world reviews using CoCoDet reveals an escalating trend of substantive AI generation. Our work exposes the inadequacy of current detectors, underscoring the importance of domain-specific solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在同行评审中的日益广泛应用，威胁到了学术的诚信性。最近的会议政策允许使用人工智能工具进行语言润色，但禁止其用于生成实质性内容。然而，现有的检测工具主要依赖于风格上的线索，因此很难区分表面上的语言优化和真正的实质性内容生成。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种基于内容的检测范式，并引入了CoCoNUTS这一综合基准测试，该测试包含315,535篇评论，涵盖了主要的AI会议以及六种人机协作模式。我们的评估表明，目前的检测工具难以处理这些复杂的场景。因此，我们提出了CoCoDet这一人工智能评论检测器，旨在识别实质性的AI生成内容。实验结果表明，CoCoDet的宏观F1分数达到了98.24%。重要的是，在允许机器进行润色的评论中，它的误报率仅为3.89%，远远低于最强的基线方法（7.84%）。通过使用CoCoDet对真实世界的评论进行检测，我们发现实质性的AI生成现象正在不断增加。我们的研究揭示了当前检测工具的不足，从而强调了针对特定领域解决方案的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Can LLMs Estimate Cognitive Complexity of Reading Comprehension Items?
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能够估算阅读理解题的认知复杂性吗？
papers.authors: Seonjeong Hwang, Hyounghun Kim, Gary Lee
papers.abstract: Estimating the cognitive complexity of reading comprehension (RC) items is crucial for assessing item difficulty before it is administered to learners. Unlike syntactic and semantic features, such as passage length or semantic similarity between options, cognitive features that arise during answer reasoning are not readily extractable using existing NLP tools and have traditionally relied on human annotation. In this study, we examine whether large language models (LLMs) can estimate the cognitive complexity of RC items by focusing on two dimensions—Evidence Scope and Transformation Level—that indicate the degree of cognitive burden involved in reasoning about the answer. Our experimental results demonstrate that LLMs can approximate the cognitive complexity of items, indicating their potential as tools for prior difficulty analysis. Further analysis reveals a gap between LLMs’ reasoning ability and their metacognitive awareness: even when they produce correct answers, they sometimes fail to correctly identify the features underlying their own reasoning process.
papers.abstract_zh: 估算阅读理解题目的认知复杂性对于在题目实际发放之前评估其难度至关重要。与句法特征和语义特征（如文章长度或选项之间的语义相似性）不同，那些在解答过程中产生的认知特征并不容易通过现有的自然语言处理工具提取出来，因此传统上依赖人工注释来进行处理。在这项研究中，我们探讨了大语言模型是否能够通过对“证据范围”和“转换层次”这两个维度的分析来估算阅读理解的认知复杂性。这两个维度代表了解答过程中所涉及的认知负担程度。我们的实验结果表明，大语言模型能够近似估算出这些题目的认知复杂性，这表明它们有潜力成为难度分析的辅助工具。进一步的分析发现，大语言模型的推理能力与其元认知能力之间存在差距：即使它们能得出正确的答案，有时也无法准确识别支撑其推理过程的各种特征。

papers.title: ReCoQA: A Benchmark for Tool-Augmented and Multi-Step Reasoning in Real Estate Question and Answering
papers.title_zh: ReCoQA：用于工具辅助和多步骤推理的房地产问答领域基准数据集
papers.authors: Yindong Zhang, Wenmian Yang, Yiquan Zhang, Weijia Jia
papers.abstract: Developing agents capable of navigating fragmented, multi-source information remains challenging, primarily due to the scarcity of benchmarks reflecting hybrid workflows combining database querying with external APIs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReCoQA, a large-scale benchmark of 29,270 real-estate instances featuring machine-verifiable supervision for intermediate steps, including structured intent labels, SQL queries, and API calls. Complementarily, we propose HIRE-Agent, a hierarchical framework instantiating an understand–plan–execute architecture as a strong baseline. By orchestrating a Front-end parser, a planning Supervisor, and execution Specialists, HIRE-Agent effectively integrates heterogeneous evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HIRE-Agent constitutes a strong baseline and substantiates the necessity of hierarchical collaboration for complex, real-world reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 培养能够处理碎片化、多源信息的智能体仍然是一个挑战，主要是因为缺乏能够反映结合数据库查询与外部API的混合工作流程的基准测试。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ReCoQA这个大规模基准测试，其中包含29,270个房地产实例，这些实例具有可机器验证的辅助信息，包括结构化意图标签、SQL查询以及API调用等中间步骤。此外，我们还提出了HIRE-Agent这个分层框架，它基于理解-计划-执行架构构建，作为强大的基础平台。通过整合前端解析器、计划主管和执行专家，HIRE-Agent能够有效地整合各种异构信息。大量的实验表明，HIRE-Agent确实是一个强大的基础平台，并且证明了在复杂的现实世界推理任务中，采用分层协作方式是非常必要的。
