papers.title: Human or LLM as Standardized Patients? A Comparative Study in Medical Education
papers.title_zh: 使用人类患者还是基于大语言模型的标准化患者进行医学教育？一项比较研究
papers.authors: Bingquan Zhang, Xiaoxiao Liu, Yuchi Wang, Zhou Lei, Qianqian Xie, Benyou Wang
papers.abstract: Standardized patients (SPs) are indispensable for clinical skills training but remain expensive and difficult to scale. Although large language model (LLM)-based virtual standardized patients (VSPs) have been proposed as an alternative, their behavior remains unstable and lacks rigorous comparison with human standardized patients. We propose EasyMED, a multi-agent VSP framework that separates case-grounded information disclosure from response generation to support stable, inquiry-conditioned patient behavior. We also introduce SPBench, a human-grounded benchmark with eight expert-defined criteria for interaction-level evaluation. Experiments show that EasyMED more closely matches human SP behavior than existing VSPs, particularly in case consistency and controlled disclosure. A four-week controlled study further demonstrates learning outcomes comparable to human SP training, with stronger early gains for novice learners and improved flexibility, psychological safety, and cost efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准化患者对于临床技能训练来说至关重要，但它们往往成本较高且难以大规模应用。虽然基于大语言模型的虚拟标准化患者作为一种替代方案已被提出，但他们的行为仍然不稳定，且缺乏与人类标准化患者的严格对比。我们提出了EasyMED这一多智能体虚拟标准化患者框架，该框架将案例相关的信息披露与响应生成分离开来，从而支持稳定且符合特定情境的患者行为。我们还引入了SPBench这一以人类行为为基础的评估基准，该基准包含八项由专家定义的互动评估标准。实验表明，EasyMED在匹配人类标准化患者行为方面表现得更为出色，尤其是在案例一致性和信息披露的准确性方面。为期四周的对照研究进一步证明，EasyMED的学习效果与人类标准化患者培训相当，对于初学者来说，其早期学习效果更为显著，同时还能提高灵活性、心理安全感和成本效益。

papers.title: Harmonizing the Past, Present, and Future: A Null-Space Constrained Region-Specific Method for Continual Learning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 协调过去、现在与未来：一种基于零空间约束的局部化方法，用于大型语言模型持续学习
papers.authors: Jinhui Chen, Shizhu He, Xingchang Yang, Huanxuan Liao, Yequan Wang, Xiangwen Liao, Wenhao Teng, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao
papers.abstract: Enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to evolve sustainably requires simultaneously preserving previously acquired knowledge (Past), effectively acquiring new task-specific skills (Present), and reserving sufficient parameter capacity for subsequent adaptation (Future). However, existing continual learning (CL) paradigms often prioritize immediate performance through dense updates, leading to catastrophic forgetting and rapid exhaustion of model capacity. To harmonize these conflicting demands, we draw inspiration from the brain’s functional partitioning and propose the Null-Space Constrained Parameter Region Specificity Method (PaRSP). PaRSP establishes a dynamic “Task-Region Mapping” that distinguishes between specialized neurons and generalist neurons. By precisely localizing a sparse “functional core” for each task, PaRSP restricts updates to specific regions via null-space orthogonality, preserving the vast majority of the network as an immutable “long-term memory bank.” This induced sparsity not only enhances plasticity via targeted adaptation and minimizes interference to ensure stability, but also strategically reserves substantial capacity, securing sustainability for future evolution. Extensive experiments validate PaRSP’s state-of-the-art performance, particularly on Standard CL and Long Sequence benchmarks, effectively harmonizing the stability-plasticity-sustainability trade-off. Code is available at https://github.com/JinhuiBot/PaRSP
papers.abstract_zh: 要使大语言模型能够可持续地进化，就需要同时保留已获得的知识（过去），有效获取新的任务特定技能（现在），并为未来的适应预留足够的参数容量（未来）。然而，现有的持续学习范式往往通过密集更新来优先考虑即时性能，这会导致灾难性的遗忘和模型能力的迅速耗尽。为了协调这些相互矛盾的需求，我们借鉴了大脑的功能分区原理，提出了“空空间约束参数区域特异性方法”（PaRSP）。PaRSP建立了一个动态的“任务-区域映射”，区分了专业神经元和通用神经元。通过为每个任务精确定位一个稀疏的“功能核心”，PaRSP通过空空间正交性限制更新只发生在特定区域，从而保留了网络的大部分作为不可改变的“长期记忆库”。这种稀疏性不仅通过有针对性的适应增强了可塑性，并最小化了干扰以确保稳定性，同时还战略性地保留了大量容量，为未来的进化提供了可持续性。广泛的实验验证了PaRSP的卓越性能，特别是在标准持续学习和长序列基准测试中，有效地实现了稳定性、可塑性与可持续性的平衡。代码可在https://github.com/JinhuiBot/PaRSP获取。

papers.title: Attention Weights as an Indicator: Analyzing and Improving Document Utilization in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 注意力权重作为指标：分析并优化检索增强生成中的文档使用效率
papers.authors: Jing Jin, Yuhan Song, Wen Luo, Houfeng Wang
papers.abstract: The generation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models is affected by factors such as the quality and order of input documents, indicating that their ability to utilize documents remains underdeveloped. This ability encompasses not only identifying useful documents from inputs but also minimizing positional bias and filtering irrelevant documents. To achieve this, key challenges include the model’s internal estimation of document importance and positional bias. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive study on the properties of attention weights, examining the impact of factors like aggregation methods, document quality, document position, token type, and so on. Based on our findings, we propose strategies to enhance document utilization from three perspectives: document ranking, placement, and filtering. Comprehensive experiments show that our method outperforms baselines and improves document utilization effectiveness in a training-free manner.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成模型的产生受到输入文档的质量和顺序等因素的影响，这表明该模型利用文档的能力仍然有待提升。这种能力不仅包括从输入中识别有用的文档，还包括减少位置偏差和过滤无关文档。为了实现这一目标，关键挑战包括模型对文档重要性的内部估计以及位置偏差的处理问题。在本文中，我们对注意力权重的属性进行了全面研究，探讨了聚合方法、文档质量、文档位置、标记类型等因素的影响。根据我们的研究结果，我们提出了从三个角度来提高文档利用率的策略：文档排序、放置方式以及过滤机制。通过一系列实验表明，我们的方法优于现有基线算法，并且能够在无需训练的情况下提高文档利用率。

papers.title: Inertia in Moral and Value Judgments of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型在道德与价值判断上的惰性
papers.authors: Bruce W. Lee, Yeongheon Lee, Hyunsoo Cho
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) behave non-deterministically, and prompting has become a common method for steering their outputs.A popular strategy is to assign a persona to the model to produce more varied, context-sensitive responses, similar to how responses vary across human individuals.Against the expectation that persona prompting yields a wide range of opinions, our experiments show that LLMs keep consistent value orientations.We observe a persistent inertia in their responses, where certain moral and value dimensions (especially harm avoidance and fairness) stay skewed in one direction across persona settings.To study this, we use role-play at scale, which pairs randomized persona prompts with a macro-level analysis of model outputs.Our results point to strong internal biases and value preferences in LLMs, which we call value orientation and inertia. These models warrant scrutiny and adjustment before use in applications where balanced outputs matter.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的行为具有非确定性特征，而提示语已成为引导其输出的常用方法。一种常见的策略是为模型分配一个角色，以产生更多多样化且符合上下文的响应，类似于不同人之间的反应差异。尽管人们认为角色提示语能够产生多样化的观点，但我们的实验表明，LLM仍然保持着一致的价值取向。我们观察到，它们的响应中存在持续的惯性现象，某些道德和价值观维度（尤其是避免伤害和公平性方面）在不同角色设置下始终偏向同一方向。为了研究这一现象，我们采用了大规模的角色扮演方法，将随机生成的角色提示语与模型输出的宏观分析相结合。我们的研究结果揭示了LLM内部存在强烈的偏见和价值偏好，我们将这些现象称为“价值取向”和“惯性”。在需要平衡输出的应用场景中，这些模型需要经过仔细的审查和调整后才能投入使用。

papers.title: LiveCultureBench: a Multi-Agent, Multi-Cultural Benchmark for Large Language Models in Dynamic Social Simulations
papers.title_zh: LiveCultureBench：一种适用于动态社会模拟中的大型语言模型的多智能体、多文化基准测试平台
papers.authors: Viet Thanh Pham, Lizhen Qu, Thuy-Trang Vu, Gholamreza Haffari, Dinh Phung
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, yet evaluations focus primarily on task success rather than cultural appropriateness or evaluator reliability. We introduce LiveCultureBench, a multi-cultural, dynamic benchmark that embeds LLMs as agents in a simulated town and evaluates them on both task completion and adherence to socio-cultural norms. The simulation models a small city as a location graph with synthetic residents having diverse demographic and cultural profiles. Each episode assigns one resident a daily goal while others provide social context. An LLM-based verifier generates structured judgments on norm violations and task progress, which we aggregate into metrics capturing task-norm trade-offs and verifier uncertainty. Using LiveCultureBench across models and cultural profiles, we study (i) cross-cultural robustness of LLM agents, (ii) how they balance effectiveness against norm sensitivity, and (iii) when LLM-as-a-judge evaluation is reliable for automated benchmarking versus when human oversight is needed.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作自主代理，但评估通常主要关注任务完成度，而忽视了文化适应性或评估者的可靠性问题。我们提出了LiveCultureBench这一多文化、动态基准测试平台，它将LLM作为代理嵌入到模拟的城镇中，并针对任务完成度和对社会文化规范的遵守程度进行评估。该模拟系统将一个小型城市建模为一个位置图，其中的居民具有多样的人口统计和文化背景。每集都会为一名居民分配每日目标，而其他居民则提供社交环境支持。基于LLM的验证器能够生成关于规范违反和任务进展的结构化判断，我们将这些判断汇总成指标，以反映任务与规范之间的权衡以及验证器的不确定性。通过在不同模型和不同文化背景下的LiveCultureBench测试中，我们研究了以下几点：(i) LLM代理的跨文化适应性；(ii)它们在提高效率与增强对规范的理解之间如何平衡；(iii)在自动化基准测试中，使用LLM作为评估者是否可靠，以及在何时需要人工监督。

papers.title: Enabling Agents to Communicate Entirely in Latent Space
papers.title_zh: 让代理完全在潜在空间中进行通信
papers.authors: Zhuoyun Du, Runze Wang, Huiyu Bai, Zouying Cao, Xiaoyong Zhu, Yu Cheng, Bo Zheng, Wei Chen, Haochao Ying
papers.abstract: While natural language is the de facto communication medium for LLM-based agents, it presents a fundamental constraint. The process of downsampling rich, internal latent states into discrete tokens inherently limits the depth and nuance of information that can be transmitted, thereby hindering collaborative problem-solving. Inspired by telepathy, which bypasses symbolic language in communication, we propose Interlat (Inter-agent Latent Space Communication), a paradigm that leverages the continuous last hidden states of an LLM as a representation of its thought for direct communication (termed “latent communication”). An additional learned compression process further compresses latent communication via latent space reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that Interlat outperforms both fine-tuned chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and single-agent baselines, even across heterogeneous models, promoting more exploratory behavior and enabling genuine utilization of latent information. Further compression not only substantially accelerates inference by up to 24× but also maintains competitive performance through an efficient information-preserving mechanism. We position this work as a feasibility study of entirely latent space inter-agent communication, and our results highlight its potential, offering valuable insights for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然自然语言是基于大语言模型的智能体的事实上的交流媒介，但它存在一个根本性的限制。将丰富的内在潜在状态降采样为离散令牌的过程，本质上限制了可以传递的信息的深度和细腻程度，从而阻碍了协作性问题的解决。受“心灵感应”概念的启发，我们提出了“Interlat”技术——一种利用大语言模型连续最后一个隐藏状态作为其思维的直接表示来进行直接交流的方法。此外，我们还引入了另一种压缩机制，通过潜在空间推理来进一步压缩潜在信息。实验表明，“Interlat”技术在跨不同模型的情况下，其性能优于经过微调的思维链提示以及单一智能体基线方案，促进了更具探索性的行为，并使得潜在信息的真正利用成为可能。进一步的压缩不仅显著提升了推理速度，最多可达24倍，而且通过高效的信息保留机制，保持了竞争力的性能。我们将这项工作视为完全基于潜在空间进行智能体间通信的可行性研究，我们的研究结果凸显了这种技术的潜力，为未来的研究提供了宝贵的见解。

papers.title: DR-Arena: an Automated Evaluation Framework for Deep Research Agents
papers.title_zh: DR-Arena：一种用于深度研究智能体的自动化评估框架
papers.authors: Yiwen Gao, Ruochen Zhao, Yang Deng, Wenxuan Zhang
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate as Deep Research (DR) Agents capable of autonomous investigation and information synthesis, reliable evaluation of their task performance has become a critical bottleneck. Current benchmarks predominantly rely on static datasets, which suffer from several limitations: limited task generality, temporal misalignment, and data contamination. To address these, we introduce DR-Arena, a fully automated evaluation framework that pushes DR agents to their capability limits through dynamic investigation. DR-Arena constructs real-time Information Trees from fresh web trends to ensure the evaluation rubric is synchronized with the live world state, and employs an automated Examiner to generate structured tasks testing two orthogonal capabilities: Deep reasoning and Wide coverage. DR-Arena further adopts Adaptive Evolvement Loop, a state-machine controller that dynamically escalates task complexity based on real-time performance, demanding deeper deduction or wider aggregation until a decisive capability boundary emerges. Experiments with six advanced DR agents demonstrate that DR-Arena achieves a Spearman correlation of 0.94 with the LMSYS Search Arena leaderboard. This represents state-of-the-art alignment with human preferences without any manual efforts, validating DR-Arena as a reliable alternative for costly human adjudication.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型逐渐发挥出深度研究智能体的能力，能够自主进行信息检索和合成，对其任务性能的可靠评估变得至关重要。目前的评估基准主要依赖于静态数据集，但这些数据集存在诸多局限性：任务通用性有限、时间维度不一致以及数据污染问题。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了DR-Arena这一全自动化评估框架。该框架通过动态评估迫使深度研究智能体达到其极限性能。DR-Arena能够实时构建信息树，从最新的网络趋势中获取数据，从而确保评估标准与现实世界状态保持同步。此外，该框架还配备了自动评估器，用于生成结构化的任务，以测试深度推理能力和广泛覆盖能力这两个关键能力。通过对六种先进深度研究智能体的实验验证，我们发现DR-Arena与LMSYS搜索竞技场的排行榜之间的Spearman相关性达到了0.94。这表明DR-Arena能够在无需人工干预的情况下，与人类偏好实现高度匹配，从而证明了DR-Arena是一种可靠的替代方案，可以替代昂贵的人工评估方式。

papers.title: Question Tells You Where the Answer Is: Intention-aware Long-Context KV Cache Compression
papers.title_zh: 问题能告诉你答案所在：基于意图的长上下文KV缓存压缩技术
papers.authors: Liang Zhao, Xiaocheng Feng, Weihong Zhong, Lei Huang, Kun Zhu, Baoxin Wang, Dayong Wu, Guoping Hu, Ting Liu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: The increasing context window greatly extends the capabilities of large language models, but on the other hand, it incurs an unaffordable memory overhead and computational latency due to the increasing Key-Value (KV) cache size. Recent KV cache compression methods manage to reduce the cache size by dropping irrelevant KVs. However, these methods often fail to identify crucial KVs for generation while excluding others accurately, resulting in severe information loss. To address this gap, we propose IntentKV, an intention-aware KV cache eviction method that identifies and retains crucial KVs according to the attention distribution of intention, which semantically reflects the user’s goal and determines which part of the context is relevant. The consistency between the semantics and attention distribution is further substantiated through meticulously designed experiments. On this basis, IntentKV first distinguishes intention tokens from the vanilla context tokens based on their attention distribution distances. Then, the block-wise cumulative attention is calculated via aggregating the intention token attention. Finally, blocks that acquire high cumulative attention are picked and stored in KV cache. We evaluate our method across diverse long-context tasks and models. Results demonstrate that IntentKV can effectively maintain the model performance while reducing the KV cache size from 128K to 2K, leading to a 6.3x increase in decoding speed and 7.8x enhancement in memory efficiency compared to the default setting.
papers.abstract_zh: 不断扩大的上下文窗口极大地提升了大语言模型的能力，但另一方面，由于键值缓存大小的增加，这也带来了难以承受的内存开销和计算延迟问题。最近的键值缓存压缩方法通过删除不相关的键值来减少缓存大小，但这些方法往往无法准确识别出对生成文本至关重要的键值，从而导致严重的信息丢失。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了IntentKV——一种基于意图意识的键值缓存淘汰方法。该方法根据意图的注意力分布来识别并保留重要的键值，而意图的注意力分布实际上反映了用户的意图，从而确定哪些上下文部分是重要的。通过精心设计的实验，我们进一步证明了语义与注意力分布之间的一致性。在此基础上，IntentKV首先根据注意力分布的距离来区分意图标记和普通的上下文标记。然后，通过汇总意图标记的注意力值来计算块的累积注意力值。最后，选择那些获得高累积注意力的块并将其存储在键值缓存中。我们在多种长上下文任务和模型中评估了我们的方法。结果表明，通过将键值缓存大小从128K减少到2K，IntentKV能够有效保持模型的性能，同时解码速度提高了6.3倍，内存效率也提高了7.8倍。

papers.title: LADR: Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation with Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: LADR：基于局部信息的动态救援算法，用于利用扩散式大型语言模型实现高效的文本转图像生成
papers.authors: Chenglin Wang, Yucheng Zhou, Shuang Chen, Tao Wang, Kai Zhang
papers.abstract: Discrete Diffusion Language Models have emerged as a compelling paradigm for unified multimodal generation, yet their deployment is hindered by high inference latency arising from iterative decoding. Existing acceleration strategies often require expensive re-training or fail to leverage the 2D spatial redundancy inherent in visual data. To address this, we propose Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue (LADR), a training-free method that expedites inference by exploiting the spatial Markov property of images. LADR prioritizes the recovery of tokens at the “generation frontier”, regions spatially adjacent to observed pixels, thereby maximizing information gain. Specifically, our method integrates morphological neighbor identification to locate candidate tokens, employs a risk-bounded filtering mechanism to prevent error propagation, and utilizes manifold-consistent inverse scheduling to align the diffusion trajectory with the accelerated mask density. Extensive experiments on four text-to-image generation benchmarks demonstrate that our LADR achieves an approximate 4 \times speedup over standard baselines. Remarkably, it maintains or even enhances generative fidelity, particularly in spatial reasoning tasks, offering a state-of-the-art trade-off between efficiency and quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 离散扩散语言模型已成为实现多模态生成的强大工具，但其应用受到迭代解码过程中高推理延迟的阻碍。现有的加速策略往往需要昂贵的重新训练，或者无法充分利用视觉数据中固有的二维空间冗余性。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了一种名为“局部性感知动态救援”的方法。该方法无需进行训练即可加速推理过程，通过利用图像的空间马尔可夫特性来实现这一目标。LADR优先处理那些与观测到的像素在空间上相邻的“生成边界”区域，从而最大化信息获取量。具体来说，我们的方法采用形态学邻居识别技术来定位候选标记点，运用风险约束过滤机制来防止错误传播，并利用流形一致性逆向调度算法将扩散轨迹与加速后的掩模密度对齐。在四个文本到图像生成基准测试中的广泛实验表明，我们的LADR方法相比传统基线方法实现了约4倍的加速效果。值得注意的是，它在保持或甚至提升生成质量的同时，尤其在空间推理任务中表现出色，为效率与质量之间的权衡提供了最优解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PACE: Predictive Adaptive Context Extraction for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: PACE：用于长视野LLM智能体的预测性自适应上下文提取技术
papers.authors: Lei Wei, Xiao Peng, Tt, Guannan Zhang, Chenhao Jiang, Hongyu Li, Lanbo Lin, Yuanwu Xu, Jiayao Liu, Kesu Wang, Bin Wang
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents struggle with ultra-long-horizon tasks requiring hundreds or thousands of interaction steps. Traditional context management approaches face a fundamental dilemma: preserving complete histories rapidly exhausts context windows and forces crude truncation, while aggressive summarization discards critical information prematurely. We propose Predictive Adaptive Context Extraction (PACE), a novel framework that reconceptualizes context management as a Next Step Prediction problem. Inspired by neural attention, PACE dynamically constructs context by adjusting historical memory granularity based on its predicted relevance for the next action. Comprehensive evaluation across diverse benchmarks and models demonstrates that PACE consistently improves task success rates, with larger gains on complex tasks and robust cross-lingual performance. Crucially, PACE enables agents to sustain effective reasoning for 4,897 interaction steps in ultra-long-horizon scenarios, achieving a 66.2 improvement over the full-context ReAct baseline and 5.1 over advanced folding baselines. This fundamentally advances the capability of LLM-based agents in previously intractable long-horizon scenarios. Our code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PACE-B000/.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理在处理需要数百或数千次交互步骤的超长时任务时面临困难。传统的上下文管理方法存在一个根本性问题：快速保存完整的历史信息会耗尽上下文窗口，导致数据被粗略截断；而过于激进的摘要处理则会过早丢弃关键信息。我们提出了预测性自适应上下文提取技术（PACE），这是一种全新的框架，它将上下文管理重新定义为下一个步骤的预测问题。该技术借鉴了神经注意力的原理，通过根据下一个动作的相关性动态调整历史记忆的粒度来动态构建上下文。在多种基准测试和模型上的综合评估表明，PACE能够持续提高任务成功率，在复杂任务上表现尤为突出，且具备强大的跨语言处理能力。关键的是，PACE使代理能够在超长时场景中持续进行有效推理，最多可支持4,897次交互步骤。与全上下文ReAct基线相比，PACE的性能提升了66.2%；与先进的折叠基线相比，性能提升了5.1%。这一创新显著提升了基于LLM的代理在以往难以处理的超长时场景中的能力。我们的代码和数据可在以下链接获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PACE-B000/
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PaCoRe: Learning to Scale Test-Time Compute with Parallel Coordinated Reasoning
papers.title_zh: PaCoRe：通过并行协调推理来学习如何有效分配测试计算资源
papers.authors: Jingcheng Hu, Yinmin Zhang, Shijie Shang, Xiaobo Yang, Yue Peng, Zhewei Huang, Hebin Zhou, Xin Wu, Jie Cheng, Fanqi Wan, Xiangwen Kong, Chengyuan Yao, Kaiwen Yan, Ailin Huang, Hongyu Zhou, Qi Han, Zheng Ge, Xiangyu Zhang, Heung-Yeung Shum
papers.abstract: We introduce Parallel Coordinated Reasoning (PaCoRe), a training-and-inference framework designed to overcome a central limitation of contemporary language models: their inability to scale test-time compute (TTC) far beyond sequential reasoning under a fixed context window. PaCoRe departs from the traditional sequential paradigm by driving TTC through massive parallel exploration coordinated via a message-passing architecture in multiple rounds. Each round launches many parallel reasoning trajectories, compacts their findings into context-bounded messages, and synthesizes these messages to guide the next round and ultimately produce the final answer. Trained end-to-end with large-scale, outcome-based reinforcement learning, the model masters the synthesis abilities required by PaCoRe and scales to multi-million-token effective TTC without exceeding context limits. The approach yields strong improvements across diverse domains and notably pushes reasoning beyond frontier systems in mathematics: an 8B model reaches 94.5% on HMMT 2025, surpassing GPT-5’s 93.2% by scaling effective TTC to roughly two million tokens. We open-source model checkpoints, training data, and the full inference pipeline to accelerate follow-up work.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了并行协调推理（Parallel Coordinated Reasoning，简称PaCoRe）这一训练与推理框架。该框架旨在克服当前语言模型的一个核心缺陷：它们在固定上下文窗口下无法实现远超顺序推理的测试时间计算能力。PaCoRe打破了传统的顺序推理范式，通过一种基于消息传递架构的多轮并行探索来推动测试时间计算的进行。每一轮都会启动许多并行推理路径，将它们的结果压缩成受上下文限制的消息，然后将这些消息综合起来以指导下一轮推理，最终得出最终答案。通过大规模、基于结果的强化学习训练，该模型掌握了PaCoRe所需的综合能力，并且能够在不超出上下文限制的情况下，实现数百万标记的有效测试时间计算。这种方法在多个领域都取得了显著的改进效果，尤其在数学领域取得了突破性的进展：一个拥有80亿参数的模型在HMMT 2025竞赛中取得了94.5%的准确率，超过了GPT-5的93.2%的准确率，其有效测试时间计算能力达到了约两百万标记。我们将模型检查点、训练数据以及完整的推理流程开源，以便加速后续的研究工作。

papers.title: Draft, Verify, Restore: Self-Refining Historical Inscription Restoration with a Unified MLLM
papers.title_zh: 草稿、验证、恢复：利用统一的MLLM技术进行历史铭文的自我修复
papers.authors: Yuyi Zhang, Junle Liu, Peirong Zhang, Jianliang Liu, Zhenhua Yang, Lianwen Jin
papers.abstract: Inscriptions are invaluable cultural heritage, yet centuries of degradation (e.g., fractures, erosion, oxidation) have rendered many partially illegible. Existing Historical Inscription Restoration (HIR) methods rely on task-separated pipelines with irreversible error accumulation and patch-based generation that sacrifices page-level consistency. Therefore, we present UniHIR, the first unified MLLM for end-to-end historical inscription restoration. It integrates two novel designs, Draft-Guided Localization and Hierarchical Self-Refinement, to enable accurate damage localization and illegible-content prediction via iterative reasoning and self-correction. This unified approach enables true page-level restoration with consistent typography and style. To support training under high-resolution inputs and long sequences, we design UHIRFactory and construct HIRBench, enabling step-wise, memory-efficient instruction tuning with step-aware annotations for intermediate drafts and refinements. Experiments demonstrate that UniHIR achieves superior performance in both text restoration accuracy and appearance restoration quality, validating that HIR can be effectively tackled by a standalone model in a unified manner. The model and code are available at https://github.com/ZZXF11/UniHIR.
papers.abstract_zh: 铭文是极其宝贵的文化遗产，然而几个世纪的侵蚀（如裂纹、风化、氧化）使得许多铭文变得难以辨认。现有的历史铭文修复方法依赖于独立的任务处理流程，这会导致不可逆转的错误累积，并且修复过程以补丁为基础进行，这牺牲了页面级别的一致性。因此，我们提出了UniHIR——首个用于端到端历史铭文修复的统一模型。该模型整合了两种创新技术：草案引导定位法和分层自我优化法，通过迭代推理和自我修正，实现准确的损伤定位以及难以辨认内容的预测。这种统一的方法能够实现真正的页面级别修复，同时保持字体和风格的一致性。为了支持在高分辨率输入和长序列下的训练，我们设计了UHIRFactory，并构建了HIRBench，从而实现逐步、高效的内存优化训练，同时提供带有步骤感知的注释，用于中间阶段的调整和优化。实验表明，UniHIR在文本修复准确性和外观修复质量方面都表现出色，这验证了可以通过一个统一的模型来有效处理历史铭文修复问题。该模型和代码可在https://github.com/ZZXF11/UniHIR获取。

papers.title: SAM3-I: Segment Anything with Instructions
papers.title_zh: SAM3-I：能够执行任何任务的智能体，附带操作指南
papers.authors: Jingjing Li, Yue Feng, Yuchen Guo, Jincai Huang, Wei Ji, Qi Bi, Yongri Piao, Miao Zhang, Xiaoqi Zhao, Qiang Chen, Shihao Zou, Huchuan Lu, Li Cheng
papers.abstract: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) advances open-vocabulary segmentation through promptable concept segmentation, enabling users to segment all instances associated with a given concept using short noun-phrase (NP) prompts. While effective for concept-level grounding, real-world interactions often involve far richer natural-language instructions that combine attributes, relations, actions, states, or implicit reasoning. Currently, SAM3 relies on external multi-modal agents to convert complex instructions into NPs and conducts iterative mask filtering, leading to coarse representations and limited instance specificity. In this work, we present SAM3-I, an instruction-following extension of the SAM family that unifies concept-level grounding and instruction-level reasoning within a single segmentation framework. Built upon SAM3, SAM3-I introduces an instruction-aware cascaded adaptation mechanism with dedicated alignment losses that progressively aligns expressive instruction semantics with SAM3’s vision-language representations, enabling direct interpretation of natural-language instructions while preserving its strong concept recall ability. To enable instruction-following learning, we introduce HMPL-Instruct, a large-scale instruction-centric dataset that systematically covers hierarchical instruction semantics and diverse target granularities. Experiments demonstrate that SAM3-I achieves appealing performance across referring and reasoning-based segmentation, showing that SAM3 can be effectively extended to follow complex natural-language instructions without sacrificing its original concept-driven strengths. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/debby-0527/SAM3-I.
papers.abstract_zh: Segment Anything Model 3（SAM3）通过可提示的概念分割技术，实现了开放词汇的分割功能。用户可以使用简短的名词短语提示，来分割与某个概念相关的所有实例。虽然该模型在概念级定位方面表现良好，但在实际场景中，用户通常会使用更复杂的自然语言指令，这些指令包含了属性、关系、动作、状态或隐含推理等信息。目前，SAM3依赖外部的多模态代理来将复杂的指令转换为名词短语，并采用迭代的掩码过滤方式，这导致生成的表示较为粗糙，且实例特异性有限。在这项研究中，我们提出了SAM3-I，这是一种针对指令执行的扩展版本，它将概念级定位和指令级推理整合到同一个分割框架中。基于SAM3构建的SAM3-I引入了一种基于指令的级联适应机制，该机制具有专门的对齐损失函数，能够逐步将复杂的指令语义与SAM3的视觉-语言表示进行对齐，从而直接解析自然语言指令，同时保留其强大的概念召回能力。为了实现基于指令的学习，我们开发了一个名为HMPL-Instruct的大规模以指令为中心的数据集，该数据集系统地涵盖了分层指令语义以及多种目标粒度。实验表明，SAM3-I在指代式分割和基于推理的分割方面都取得了令人满意的性能，说明SAM3可以有效地扩展为支持复杂的自然语言指令，而不会牺牲其原有的概念驱动优势。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/debby-0527/SAM3-I获取。

papers.title: Stop When Enough: Adaptive Early-Stopping for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 当达到足够数量时停止：适用于思维链推理的自适应提前停止算法
papers.authors: Renliang Sun, Wei Cheng, Dawei Li, Haifeng Chen, Wei Wang
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has driven recent gains of large language models (LLMs) on reasoning-intensive tasks by externalizing intermediate steps. However, excessive or redundant reasoning — so-called overthinking — can increase inference costs and lead LLMs toward incorrect conclusions. In this paper, we present \textbf{REFRAIN} (\underline{REF}lective-\underline{R}edundancy for \underline{A}daptive \underline{IN}ference), a training-free framework that adaptively determines when to stop reasoning to mitigate overthinking. REFRAIN integrates a two-stage stop discriminator to identify reflective yet redundant reasoning and a sliding-window Upper Confidence Bound (SW-UCB) multi-armed bandit controller to dynamically adjust stopping thresholds according to problem difficulty without supervision or fine-tuning. Across four representative benchmarks and two model families, REFRAIN reduces token usage by 20-55% while maintaining or improving accuracy compared to standard CoT prompting. Extensive ablation and robustness analyses demonstrate its stability across models, scorers, and prompt variations. In summary, our findings highlight when-to-stop as a new and practical axis of test-time scaling — enabling models to reason not just more, but just enough.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链推理（CoT）推理技术通过将中间步骤外部化，推动了大语言模型在需要推理任务的性能提升。然而，过度或冗余的推理——所谓的过度思考——会增加推理成本，并可能导致模型得出错误的结论。在本文中，我们提出了**REFRAIN**框架，这是一种无需训练的框架，它能够自适应地决定何时停止推理，以减少过度思考。REFRAIN整合了一个两阶段的停止判别器，用于识别那些具有反思性但冗余的推理；同时，它还采用了滑动窗口上的上置信度边界多臂老虎机控制器，可以根据问题的难度动态调整停止阈值，而无需进行监督或微调。在四个代表性的基准测试和两个模型家族中，REFRAIN能够将令牌使用量减少20-55%，同时保持或提高准确率，与标准的CoT提示相比表现更优。广泛的消融实验和鲁棒性分析表明，该框架在不同模型、评分标准和提示变体下都能保持稳定。总之，我们的研究发现强调了“何时停止”这一新的实用性原则，它有助于模型在测试时实现更合理的推理策略，而不仅仅是更多的推理。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Improving Long-Context Translation via Self-Supervised Dual Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过自监督双路径学习提升长上下文翻译能力
papers.authors: Shanbo Cheng, Shuaijie She, Yu Bao, Jianbing Zhang, Jiajun Chen, Shujian Huang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) with long context windows offer the potential to translate entire documents in a single pass, yet they frequently suffer from catastrophic information distortion, undermining the strict faithfulness required for translation. This challenge is compounded by the scarcity of document-level parallel data, which makes both supervised fine-tuning and reliable evaluation prohibitively expensive. We propose LongDu, a self-supervised post-training framework that improves long-document translation reliability via round-trip consistency. Given monolingual documents, LongDu samples multiple candidate translations, back-translates each candidate, and optimizes the model to prefer translations that best reconstruct the source. To make this signal robust for long-form generation, we design a reward that filters trivial failure modes (e.g., copying and local language drift) before applying a reconstruction and fluency score, enabling stable reinforcement learning without human annotations. We additionally introduce Long-CIRT, an automatic evaluation protocol that quantifies information distortion by measuring how much a LLM’s performance degrades after a translation cycle. Across multiple base models, LongDu substantially improves information retention and translation quality, with gains that generalize beyond the training length range and to unseen target languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）凭借其长上下文窗口能力，具备一次性翻译整篇文档的潜力。然而，这类模型常常出现严重的信息失真问题，这严重影响了翻译的精确性要求。这一问题因缺乏文档级别的平行数据而更加复杂，这使得有监督的微调以及可靠的评估变得极其昂贵。我们提出了LongDu这一自监督的后期处理框架，通过往返一致性机制来提高长文档翻译的可靠性。对于单语文档，LongDu会生成多个候选翻译版本，对每一个候选翻译进行回译，并优化模型以选择最能还原原文的翻译版本。为了使得这种信号在长文本生成中具有鲁棒性，我们设计了一种奖励机制，该机制在应用重建和流畅度评分之前，会过滤掉一些琐碎的错误模式（例如复制粘贴或当地语言差异）。这样，无需人工注释即可实现稳定的强化学习。此外，我们还引入了Long-CIRT这一自动评估协议，该协议通过测量翻译周期后LLM性能下降的程度来量化信息失真程度。在多个基础模型上测试表明，LongDu显著提升了信息保留能力和翻译质量，且这些改进效果不仅适用于训练长度范围内的文档，也适用于未见过的目标语言。

papers.title: CaRL-EM: Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Entity Matching with LLMs
papers.title_zh: CaRL-EM：基于成本意识的强化学习，用于实体匹配，结合大型语言模型的应用
papers.authors: Chaohui Guo, Michel C. A. Klein, Zhisheng Huang
papers.abstract: Entity matching (EM) requires fine-grained contextual understanding and domain knowledge. Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can serve as strong matchers across domains, but most methods either make independent pairwise decisions or rely on manually designed composite pipelines, thus lacking flexibility in realistic multi-candidate settings. At the same time, they typically ignore inference cost at scale. We formulate LLM-based EM with candidates as a cost-aware sequential decision problem and propose CaRL-EM, a reinforcement learning controller that manages LLM operations. Given the state of an anchor record, its candidate set, and the cost, CaRL-EM adaptively chooses among different operators (Match/Compare/Select/Decide) and model capacities to maximize a quality–cost objective. The policy interacts with abstract operators, allowing the same controller to be reused with different underlying LLM backends at inference time without retraining. Experiments on 7 benchmarks show that CaRL-EM (i) learns to dynamically plan the usage of inexpensive and expensive operators based on task complexity, (ii) achieves robust zero-shot transfer across diverse datasets and domains, and (iii) consistently achieves a better quality–cost trade-off than strong LLM-based baselines and manually designed pipelines, yielding a lower inference cost at comparable or higher quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 实体匹配（EM）需要精细的上下文理解和领域知识。最近的研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）可以在不同领域之间发挥强大的匹配作用，但大多数方法要么进行独立的成对决策，要么依赖手动设计的复合流程，因此在现实的多候选场景中缺乏灵活性。同时，这些方法通常忽略了大规模推理时的成本问题。我们将基于LLM的实体匹配问题定义为一个考虑成本的序列决策问题，并提出了CaRL-EM这一强化学习控制器，该控制器能够管理LLM的操作。根据锚记錄的状态、其候选集以及成本，CaRL-EM能够自适应地选择不同的操作（匹配/比较/选择/决定）和模型能力，以最大化质量与成本之间的平衡。该策略与抽象操作交互，使得同一控制器可以在推理时重复使用不同的LLM后端，而无需重新训练。在7个基准测试上的实验表明，CaRL-EM能够：(i) 根据任务复杂度动态规划使用廉价和昂贵操作的方式；(ii) 在不同数据集和领域中实现稳健的零样本迁移；以及(iii) 始终能够获得比基于强LLM的基线方法和手动设计的流程更好的质量与成本平衡，同时降低推理成本并保持相当或更高的质量。

papers.title: Audio Jailbreak: An Open Comprehensive Benchmark for Jailbreaking Large Audio-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 音频越狱：一个用于破解大型音频语言模型的开放性强、功能全面的基准测试平台
papers.authors: Zirui Song, Qian Jiang, Mingxuan Cui, Mingzhe Li, Lang Gao, Zeyu Zhang, Zixiang Xu, Yanbo Wang, Guangxian Ouyang, Zhenhao Chen, Xiuying Chen
papers.abstract: The rise of Large Audio-Language Models (LAMs) brings both potential and risks, as their audio outputs may contain harmful or unethical content. However, current research lacks a systematic, quantitative evaluation of LAM safety, especially against jailbreak attacks, which are challenging due to the temporal and semantic nature of speech. To bridge this gap, we introduce AJailBench, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate jailbreak vulnerabilities in LAMs. We begin by constructing -Base, a dataset of 1,495 adversarial audio prompts spanning 10 policy-violating categories. Using this dataset, we evaluate several state-of-the-art LAMs and reveal that none exhibit consistent robustness across attacks. To further strengthen jailbreak testing and simulate more realistic attack conditions, we propose a method to generate dynamic adversarial variants. Our Audio Perturbation Toolkit (APT) applies targeted distortions across time, frequency, and amplitude domains. To preserve the original jailbreak intent, we enforce a semantic consistency constraint and employ Bayesian optimization to efficiently search for perturbations that are both subtle and highly effective. This results in AJailBench-APT+, an extended dataset of optimized adversarial audio samples. Our findings demonstrate that even small, semantically preserved perturbations can significantly reduce the safety performance of leading LAMs, underscoring the need for more robust and semantically aware defense mechanisms. We release AJailBench to facilitate future research: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AudioJailbreak-4262/
papers.abstract_zh: 大型音频语言模型的兴起带来了潜在的风险，因为它们的音频输出可能包含有害或不道德的内容。然而，目前的研究缺乏对LAM安全性的系统性和定量评估，尤其是在抵御越狱攻击方面，由于语音的时空和语义特性，这种攻击非常具有挑战性。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了AJailBench——首个专门用于评估LAM在越狱攻击中的安全性的基准测试工具。我们首先构建了一个名为“Base”的数据集，其中包含1,495个对抗性音频样本，这些样本涵盖了10种违反规定的行为类别。利用这个数据集，我们对几种最先进的LAM进行了评估，结果发现没有任何一种模型能够在各种攻击中表现出一致的鲁棒性。为了进一步加强越狱攻击的测试并模拟更真实的攻击条件，我们提出了一种生成动态对抗变体的方法。我们的音频扰动工具包（APT）能够针对时间、频率和幅度域进行有针对性的扰动处理。为了保持原始越狱意图的完整性，我们实施了语义一致性约束，并采用贝叶斯优化算法来高效地寻找既微妙又有效的扰动方案。最终形成了AJailBench-APT+，这是一个经过优化的对抗性音频样本扩展数据集。我们的研究结果表明，即使是很小的、保留了一定语义特征的扰动也能显著降低主流LAM的安全性，这凸显了需要更加稳健且具备语义感知能力的防御机制。我们将AJailBench开源出来，以便未来研究者能够进一步开展相关研究：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AudioJailbreak-4262/

papers.title: When Personalization Legitimizes Risks: Uncovering Safety Vulnerabilities in Personalized Dialogue Agents
papers.title_zh: 当个性化处理成为风险合法化的手段时：揭示个性化对话代理中的安全漏洞
papers.authors: Jiahe Guo, Xiangran Guo, Yulin Hu, Zimo Long, Xingyu Sui, Xuda Zhi, Yongbo Huang, Hao He, Weixiang Zhao, Yanyan Zhao, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to support personalized and sustained interactions.However, most work on personalized agents prioritizes utility and user experience, treating memory as a neutral component and largely overlooking its safety implications.In this paper, we reveal intent legitimation, a previously underexplored safety failure in personalized agents, where benign personal memories bias intent inference and cause models to legitimize inherently harmful queries.To study this phenomenon, we introduce PS-Bench, a benchmark designed to identify and quantify intent legitimation in personalized interactions.Across multiple memory-augmented agent frameworks and base LLMs, personalization increases attack success rates by 15.8%–243.7% relative to stateless baselines.We further provide mechanistic evidence for intent legitimation from internal representation space, and propose a lightweight detection–reflection method that effectively reduces safety degradation.Overall, our work provides the first systematic exploration and evaluation of intent legitimation as a safety failure mode that naturally arises from benign, real-world personalization, highlighting the importance of assessing safety under long-term personal context. WARNING: This paper may contain harmful content.
papers.abstract_zh: 长期记忆使得大语言模型代理能够支持个性化和持续的互动。然而，大多数关于个性化代理的研究都注重效用和用户体验，将记忆视为一个中立的组成部分，而很大程度上忽视了其安全性方面的影响。在本文中，我们揭示了意图合法化这一之前未被充分探讨的安全问题——当用户的良性个人记忆会影响意图推断时，模型就会合法化那些本质上有害的查询。为了研究这一现象，我们引入了PS-Bench这个基准测试工具，用于识别和量化个性化交互中的意图合法化现象。在多种带有记忆增强功能的代理框架以及基础语言模型上，与无状态基线相比，个性化技术能够将攻击的成功率提高15.8%至243.7%。我们还从内部表征空间提供了关于意图合法化的机制性证据，并提出了一种轻量级的检测与反思方法，能够有效降低安全性下降的风险。总体而言，我们的工作首次系统地探索和评估了意图合法化作为一种安全故障模式，这种故障模式自然源于良性的现实世界个性化行为，从而凸显了在长期个人情境下评估安全性的重要性。警告：本文可能包含有害内容。

papers.title: AlphaContext: An Evolutionary Tree-based Psychometric Context Generator for Creativity Assessment
papers.title_zh: AlphaContext：一种基于进化树的心理测量情境生成工具，用于创造力评估
papers.authors: Yixuan Wang, Yue Huang, Hong Qian, Yunzhao Wei, Yifei Ding, Wenkai Wang, Zhi Liu, Zhongjing Huang, Aimin Zhou, Jiajun Guo
papers.abstract: Creativity has become a core competence in the era of LLMs and human–AI collaboration, underpinning innovation in real-world problem solving. Crucially, the systematic improvement of creativity necessitates scientifically valid assessment instruments. Psychometric research recognizes context-based assessment as an effective way to measure creative thinking. However, high-quality expert-designed contexts remain scarce. Existing LLM-based generators often struggle with insufficient assessment cues, weak narrative coherence, limited stylistic diversity, and poor support for creative thinking. To address these challenges, we propose AlphaContext, an evolutionary tree-based psychometric context generator for creativity assessment. First, the HyperTree Outline Planner formalizes expert-designed outlining as a rule-guided hypertree and performs top-down hierarchical planning. The MCTS-based Context Generator fills the outline via MCTS to balance global structure and local quality. Then, the Evolutionary Context Optimizer evolves contexts with MAP-Elites by repeatedly updating niche elites to jointly improve diversity and quality. Finally, the Assessment-Guided Evolution Refiner simulates virtual participants with diverse styles and recycles weak contexts for further evolution. Experiments show that AlphaContext yields an average improvement of 8% over competitive methods across 6 quality metrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型和人类与人工智能协作的时代，创造力已成为核心竞争力，它推动了现实问题解决领域的创新。关键在于，要系统性地提升创造力，就需要使用科学有效的评估工具。心理测量学研究认为，基于情境的评估是衡量创造性思维的有效方式。然而，能够生成高质量、由专家设计的情境仍然十分稀缺。现有的基于大语言模型的情境生成器往往存在以下问题：评估线索不足、叙述连贯性较差、风格多样性有限，以及对创造性思维的支撑不够。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AlphaContext这一基于进化树的心理测量情境生成器，用于创造力评估。首先，HyperTree Outline Planner将专家设计的提纲形式化，将其转化为规则驱动的超树结构，并进行自上而下的层次规划。基于MCTS的情境生成器通过MCTS算法填充提纲，以平衡整体结构与局部质量。接着，进化情境优化器利用MAP-精英算法不断更新特定领域的精英元素，从而共同提升情境的多样性和质量。最后，评估引导的进化精炼器模拟具有不同风格的虚拟参与者，并重新处理那些表现不佳的情境以进行进一步优化。实验表明，与竞争方法相比，AlphaContext在6个质量指标上平均提升了8%的创造力水平。

papers.title: Demystifying Data Organization for Enhanced LLM Training
papers.title_zh: 揭开数据组织的神秘面纱，助力提升大语言模型训练效果
papers.authors: Yalun Dai, Yangyu Huang, Tongshen Yang, Yonghan Wang, Xin Zhang, Wenshan Wu, Qihao Zhao, Hao Li, Yuanyuan Gao, Kim-Hui Yap, Scarlett Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized various fields, yet their training efficiency is heavily reliant on effective data curation. While data selection has been widely studied, the strategic data organization for enhanced training remains an underexplored area, particularly since current LLMs are often trained for only one or a few epochs. This paper systematically explores the influence of data organization on LLM training by reusing pre-computed sample-level scores originally generated for data efficiency, thereby incurring minimal additional computational overhead. We identify and formalize four key guidances for optimizing data organization: Boundary Sharpening, Cyclic Scheduling, Curriculum Continuity, and Local Diversity. Guided by them, we introduce two novel data ordering methods termed STR and SAW. Extensive experiments across different model scales and data sizes, encompassing both pre-training and SFT stages, validate the effectiveness of our summarized guidances. They also demonstrate the robustness of our proposed data ordering methods in enhancing the stability and performance of LLM training.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已经彻底改变了多个领域，然而其训练效率在很大程度上依赖于有效的数据整理。虽然数据选择已经得到了广泛研究，但针对提升训练效果的战略性数据组织方式仍然是一个未被充分探索的领域，尤其是当前LLM通常只训练一两个周期之后就需要调整数据组织方式。本文系统地探讨了数据组织对LLM训练的影响，通过重新利用原本为提升数据效率而生成的样本级评分结果，从而减少了额外的计算负担。我们确定了四个优化数据组织的关键指导原则：边界锐化、循环调度、课程连续性以及局部多样性。在这些原则的指导下，我们提出了两种新的数据排序方法：STR和SAW。通过在不同模型规模和数据规模下的广泛实验，包括预训练和SFT阶段，我们验证了这些指导原则的有效性。此外，我们的数据排序方法在提升LLM训练的稳定性和性能方面也表现出很强的鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Single View: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Medical Multimodal Large Language Models on Multi-Image Understanding
papers.title_zh: 超越单一视图：医学多模态大语言模型在多图像理解任务上的全面基准测试
papers.authors: Dexuan Xu, Yuan Jiayin, Jianing Wang, Yanyuan Chen, Hanpin Wang, Yu Huang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in interpreting single medical images. However, real-world clinical diagnosis is intrinsically a multi-view process, requiring the synthesis of information across volumetric slices, temporal sequences, and comparative modalities. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this complexity, limiting the assessment of models in realistic clinical workflows. To bridge this gap, we introduce MedMultiBench, the first large-scale benchmark specifically designed for medical multi-image understanding. Comprising 11,392 expert-curated samples, MedMultiBench evaluates MLLMs across four distinct dimensions: Joint Reasoning, Comparative Analysis, Comprehensive Perception, and In-Context Learning. We benchmark 13 state-of-the-art MLLMs, revealing that while current models excel in single-view tasks, they struggle significantly with multi-image contexts. Our experiments identify a performance degradation in open-source models when processing increased visual loads, whereas closed-source models demonstrate better scalability. MedMultiBench provides a robust framework to facilitate the development of MLLMs capable of holistic clinical reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在多模态大语言模型领域取得的进展表明，这些模型在解读单张医学图像方面具有令人印象深刻的能力。然而，实际的临床诊断本质上是一个多视图的过程，需要整合体积切片、时间序列以及不同模态的信息。现有的基准测试无法捕捉到这种复杂性，从而限制了模型在真实临床工作流程中的表现评估。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了MedMultiBench——首个专为医学多图像理解设计的大规模基准测试。该测试包含11,392个经过专家筛选的样本，涵盖了四个不同的评估维度：联合推理、比较分析、全面感知以及上下文学习。我们对13种最先进的多模态语言模型进行了测试，发现虽然当前模型在单视图任务上表现出色，但在处理多图像情境时却存在显著不足。我们的实验还发现，开源模型在处理大量视觉信息时会出现性能下降，而闭源模型则表现出更好的可扩展性。MedMultiBench提供了一个强大的框架，有助于开发能够实现全面临床推理的多模态语言模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When Seeing Is not Enough: Revealing the Limits of Active Reasoning in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: 当视觉无法提供足够信息时：揭示在大型语言模型中主动推理的局限性
papers.authors: Hongcheng Liu, Pingjie Wang, Yuhao Wang, Siqu Ou, Yanfeng Wang, Yu Wang
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong capabilities across a broad range of benchmarks. However, most existing evaluations focus on passive inference, where models perform step-by-step reasoning under complete information. This setup is misaligned with real-world use, where seeing is not enough. This raises a fundamental question: Can MLLMs actively acquire missing evidence under incomplete information? To bridge this gap, we require the MLLMs to actively acquire missing evidence and iteratively refine decisions under incomplete information, by selecting a target image from a candidate pool without task-specific priors. To support systematic study, we propose GuessBench, a benchmark with both perception-oriented and knowledge-oriented images for evaluating active reasoning in MLLMs. We evaluate 20 superior MLLMs and find that performance on active reasoning lags far behind it on passive settings, indicating substantial room for improvement. Further analysis identifies fine-grained perception and timely decision-making as key challenges. Ablation studies show that perceptual enhancements benefit smaller models, whereas thinking-oriented methods provide consistent gains across model sizes. These results suggest promising directions for future research on multimodal active reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在众多基准测试中展现出了强大的能力。然而，目前大多数评估都集中在被动推理上，即模型在完全信息的情况下进行逐步推理。这种评估方式与现实世界的应用场景不符，因为现实世界中的情况往往需要更灵活的应对方式。这就提出了一个基本问题：多模态大语言模型能否在不完全信息的情况下主动获取缺失的线索？为了弥补这一不足，我们需要让多模态大语言模型能够主动获取缺失的线索，并在不完全信息的情况下不断优化决策，具体方法是从候选图像中选取目标图像，而无需依赖特定任务的信息。为了支持系统的研究，我们提出了GuessBench这个基准测试，该测试包含面向感知和面向知识的图像，用于评估多模态大语言模型的主动推理能力。我们对20个性能优越的多模态大语言模型进行了评估，发现它们在主动推理方面的表现远远落后于被动推理的表现，这表明还有很大的改进空间。进一步分析表明，精细的感知能力和及时的决策能力是关键的挑战。消融实验表明，感知能力的提升对较小的模型更有帮助，而注重思维层面的方法则能在不同规模的模型中带来稳定的性能提升。这些结果为未来关于多模态主动推理的研究提供了有希望的方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CuMA: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Cultural Values via Demographic-Aware Mixture of Adapters
papers.title_zh: CuMA：通过考虑人口统计特征的混合适配器技术，使大型语言模型与稀疏的文化价值观相契合
papers.authors: Ao Sun, Xiaoyu Wang, Zhe Tan, Yu Li, Jiachen Zhu, Yuheng Jia, Shu Su
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) serve a global audience, alignment must transition from enforcing universal consensus to respecting cultural pluralism. We demonstrate that dense models, when forced to fit conflicting value distributions, suffer from Mean Collapse, converging to a generic average that fails to represent diverse groups. We attribute this to Cultural Sparsity, where gradient interference prevents dense parameters from spanning distinct cultural modes. To resolve this, we propose CuMA (Cultural Mixture of Adapters), a framework that frames alignment as a conditional capacity separation problem. By incorporating demographic-aware routing, CuMA internalizes a Latent Cultural Topology to explicitly disentangle conflicting gradients into specialized expert subspaces. Extensive evaluations on WorldValuesBench, Community Alignment, and PRISM demonstrate that CuMA achieves competitive performance, outperforming both dense baselines and semantic-only MoEs. Our analysis confirms that CuMA effectively mitigates mean collapse and preserves cultural diversity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Throll/CuMA.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）服务于全球用户群体，模型的对齐方式必须从强制实现普遍共识转变为尊重文化多样性。我们发现，当密集模型被迫适应相互冲突的价值分布时，会出现“均值崩溃”现象，即模型会收敛到一个无法代表不同群体的通用平均值。我们认为这种现象是由于“文化稀疏性”造成的——梯度干扰使得密集参数无法涵盖不同的文化模式。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CuMA框架。该框架将对齐问题视为一种条件性容量分离问题。通过引入考虑人口统计特征的路由机制，CuMA能够内置一个“潜在文化拓扑结构”，从而将相互冲突的梯度分离到专门的专家子空间中。在WorldValuesBench、Community Alignment和PRISM等测试平台上的广泛评估表明，CuMA取得了令人满意的性能，其表现优于各种密集模型以及仅基于语义的MoE模型。我们的分析证实，CuMA能够有效缓解均值崩溃问题，并保护文化多样性。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Throll/CuMA下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Neo-Classic: A Benchmark for Evaluating Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning in Classical Chinese Poetry
papers.title_zh: 新古典主义风格：评估古典汉语诗歌中语言与美学结合的典范标准
papers.authors: Han Zhang, Zihan Gu, Zhiyuan Wang, Tianyi Ma, Jiacheng Lu, Xinyan Zhang, Yuhao Wei, Cheng Hua
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve high accuracy on established Classical Chinese Poetry benchmarks, it remains challenging to distinguish transferable Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning from reliance on familiar pre-training patterns. To address this issue, we introduce Neo-Classic, an evaluation benchmark that combines a constructionist Out-of-Sample (OOS) dataset with a suite of reverse understanding probes. Unlike traditional benchmarks that rely on verification or generation over historical corpora, Neo-Classic comprises strictly metrical poetry authored by contemporary experts, reducing the possibility of direct retrieval. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, including Qwen3-Max, Gemini-3-Pro, and DeepSeek-V3.2, across five behavioral probes designed to test hierarchical constraint satisfaction. Our results reveal two primary limitations. First, a performance gap of 20%–50% emerges when models transition from historical to contemporary texts. Second, models exhibit substantial difficulties in discourse-level ordering tasks, with standard accuracy remaining low (0–13%). Although expert-level guidance improves the performance of reasoning-enhanced models to 36%, a notable gap with human experts persists. These findings suggest that while current LLMs capture local formal patterns, they struggle with global hierarchical planning required for robust Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在成熟的古典诗词基准测试中取得了较高的准确率，但区分可迁移的语言美学推理与依赖熟悉的预训练模式仍然具有挑战性。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了Neo-Classic这一评估基准，该基准结合了基于构建的抽样数据集以及一系列逆向理解探针。与依赖历史语料库进行验证或生成的传统基准不同，Neo-Classic包含的是由当代专家创作的严格遵循韵律规则的诗歌，从而减少了直接检索的可能性。我们对包括Qwen3-Max、Gemini-3-Pro和DeepSeek-V3.2在内的先进模型进行了评估，这些模型需要完成五个旨在测试层次性约束满足的行为任务。我们的研究结果揭示了两个主要问题：首先，当模型从处理历史文本转向处理当代文本时，其性能会出现20%到50%的差距；其次，模型在话语级排序任务上表现出显著困难，其标准准确率保持在较低水平（0-13%）。尽管带有专家级指导的模型能够将推理增强模型的性能提升至36%，但与人类专家的差距依然明显。这些发现表明，虽然当前的语言模型能够捕捉局部的形式化模式，但在实现稳健的语言美学推理所需的全局层次性规划方面却存在困难。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Feature-Constrained Difficulty Control in Reading Comprehension Item Generation
papers.title_zh: 一种适用于阅读理解任务生成中的特征约束难度控制的多智能体框架
papers.authors: Seonjeong Hwang, Jun Seo, Hyounghun Kim, Gary Lee
papers.abstract: Recent studies in difficulty-controlled reading comprehension item generation have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to produce items by adjusting difficulty-related features. However, existing methods typically rely on a single-agent prompting approach, which often fails to consistently satisfy specified feature constraints, resulting in items that deviate from the target difficulty level. To address this limitation, we introduce MAFIG, a Multi-agent Framework for Feature-constrained Item Generation, where multiple LLM agents and feature-specific evaluators collaborate to generate and iteratively revise items based on intended constraints. Furthermore, to verify the efficacy of MAFIG in difficulty control, we propose a method for constructing a sequence of feature constraint sets that yield items with monotonically increasing difficulty. Experimental results demonstrate that MAFIG generates items that adhere to target constraints at a significantly higher rate than baselines, achieving robust difficulty control through the difficulty-calibrated constraint sequence.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在难度可控的阅读理解题目生成领域的研究中，人们利用大语言模型来通过调整与难度相关的特征来生成题目。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于单一代理提示方式，这种方式往往无法始终满足指定的特征约束条件，导致生成的题目偏离目标难度水平。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了MAFIG——一种多智能体框架，用于特征受限的题目生成。该框架通过多个语言模型代理和特定特征的评估器协同工作，根据预设的约束条件来生成并迭代修改题目。此外，为了验证MAFIG在难度控制方面的有效性，我们提出了一种方法，用于构建一系列特征约束集，从而生成难度逐渐增加的题目。实验结果表明，MAFIG生成符合目标约束条件的题目比例远高于基线方法，通过这种难度校准的约束序列，MAFIG能够实现稳健的难度控制。

papers.title: ToMMeR - Efficient Entity Mention Detection from Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ToMMeR——基于大型语言模型的高效实体提及检测技术
papers.authors: Victor Morand, Nadi Tomeh, Josiane Mothe, Benjamin Piwowarski
papers.abstract: Identifying which text spans refer to entities - mention detection- is both foundational for information extraction and a known performance bottleneck. We introduce ToMMeR, a lightweight model (<300K parameters) probing mention detection capabilities from early LLM layers. Across 13 NER benchmarks, ToMMeR achieves 93% recall zero-shot, with an estimated 90% precision under a human-calibrated LLM-judge protocol, showing that ToMMeR rarely produces spurious predictions despite high recall. Cross-model analysis reveals that diverse architectures (14M-15B parameters) converge on similar mention boundaries (DICE >75%), confirming that mention detection emerges naturally from language modeling. When extended with span classification heads, ToMMeR achieves competitive NER performance (80-87% F1 on standard benchmarks). Our work provides evidence that structured entity representations exist in early transformer layers and can be efficiently recovered with minimal parameters.
papers.abstract_zh: 识别哪些文本片段与实体相关——即进行提及检测——不仅是信息提取的基础工作，也是已知的性能瓶颈之一。我们提出了ToMMeR模型，这是一个参数较少的模型（<300K参数），能够从早期的大语言模型层开始进行提及检测。在13个命名实体识别基准测试中，ToMMeR在零样本情况下实现了93%的召回率，而在经过人类校准的大语言模型评估下，其准确率达到了90%，这表明尽管ToMMeR的召回率很高，但它很少产生错误的预测。跨模型分析表明，不同架构（参数范围从1400万到1500万）在提及边界上都能取得相似的检测结果（DICE值超过75%），这证实了提及检测是自然而然地从语言建模过程中产生的。当ToMMeR模型加上文本片段分类头之后，其在命名实体识别方面的性能也相当不错（在标准基准测试中的F1分数在80%-87%之间）。我们的研究证明了在早期的变换器层中存在结构化的实体表示，并且可以通过极少的参数高效地恢复这些表示。

papers.title: Shuttle Between Symbolic Instructions and Neural Parameters of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 符号指令与大型语言模型的神经参数之间的转换机制
papers.authors: Wangtao Sun, Haotian Xu, Huanxuan Liao, Xuanqing Yu, Zhongtao Jiang, Shizhu He, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
papers.abstract: This paper notices that while symbolic instruction and neural parameters play different roles on steering LLMs’ behavior, both instructions and parameters are the compression of task data, they are supposed be strongly correlated and can be learned to predict one from the other. Therefore, This paper proposes a novel neural network framework, SHIP (Shuttle between the Instructions and the Parameters), to model and learn the bi-directional mappings between the instructions and the parameters of LLMs. We verify that SHIP can effectively map one of the instructions/parameters to the other by evaluating it on the tasks of instruction deduction and induction. The results show that SHIP performs better than existing baseline methods in terms of deductive capabilities while significantly surpassing them in inductive capabilities. Moreover, SHIP can effectively combine the two mapping processes to perform excellent inductive reasoning. We further discuss how the latent fusing methods and latent dimensions affect SHIP’s performance, and show SHIP can effectively generalize with pre-training. The code and data for this paper are released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Shuttle-Between-Instructions-Parameters
papers.abstract_zh: 本文指出，虽然符号指令和神经参数在引导大语言模型的行为方面扮演着不同的角色，但这两种指令和参数都是任务数据的压缩形式。它们应该具有高度的相关性，并且可以通过学习来预测彼此。因此，本文提出了一种新颖的神经网络框架——SHIP（指令与参数之间的穿梭），用于建模和学习大语言模型的指令与参数之间的双向映射关系。我们通过评估指令推导和归纳任务来验证SHIP能够有效地将其中一种指令/参数映射到另一种上。结果表明，SHIP在演绎能力方面优于现有的基线方法，而在归纳能力方面则远远超过了它们。此外，SHIP能够有效地结合这两种映射过程，从而实现出色的归纳推理能力。我们还讨论了潜在融合方法和潜在维度如何影响SHIP的性能，并证明SHIP能够在预训练的基础上实现有效的泛化能力。本文的相关代码和数据可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Shuttle-Between-Instructions-Parameters获取。

papers.title: Mitigating Spurious Correlations in Text Classification Using Latent Space Geometry
papers.title_zh: 利用潜在空间几何结构来减少文本分类中的虚假相关性
papers.authors: Jiasen Gao, Xiaoliang Chen, Duoqian Miao, Xu Gu, Xianyong Li, Yajun Du
papers.abstract: Spurious correlations cause deep learning models to rely on predictive shortcuts that hold in the training data but break under distribution shifts, leading to large performance drops for minority groups. Existing strategies often rely on costly group annotations or employ unstable adversarial training. In this paper, we propose Prototype-guided debiasing using Robust Invariant Feature Transformations (PRIFT), a novel framework that mitigates spurious correlations by manipulating latent space geometry. Specifically, we introduce a prototype-guided modeling approach that leverages natural language prompts to represent confounders, transforming abstract biases into interpretable geometric anchors without auxiliary classifiers. Based on these anchors, we introduce a centered projection operator that adaptively purifies representations by removing confounding deviations specific to instances while preserving essential semantic structure. Furthermore, PRIFT can handle confounding factor information at different levels, ranging from true labels to unsupervised latent inference. Experiments on four text classification benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our method; notably, PRIFT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and improves worst-group accuracy by over 20% on the CivilComments dataset compared to standard empirical risk minimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 虚假的相关性导致深度学习模型依赖于仅在训练数据中成立的预测捷径，但在分布发生变化时这些捷径就会失效，从而导致少数群体的性能大幅下降。现有的策略通常依赖昂贵的群体注释，或者使用不稳定的对抗性训练方法。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于原型引导的去偏见方法，该方法使用鲁棒不变特征变换（PRIFT）这一新颖框架，通过操控潜在空间的几何结构来消除虚假相关性。具体来说，我们采用了一种基于原型引导的建模方法，利用自然语言提示来表示混杂因素，将抽象的偏见转化为可解释的几何锚点，而无需辅助分类器。基于这些锚点，我们引入了一个居中投影算子，它能够自适应地清除特定实例的混杂偏差，同时保留基本的语义结构。此外，PRIFT能够处理不同层次的混杂因素信息，从真实标签到无监督的潜在推断。在四个文本分类基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法具有出色的性能；值得注意的是，与最先进的基线方法相比，PRIFT在CivilComments数据集上的表现更为优越，最差群体的准确率提高了20%以上。

papers.title: Efficient Hyperparameter Optimization for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 高效的超参数优化方法，用于语言模型强化学习
papers.authors: Minping Chen, Bowen Xiao, Du Liang, Chuxuan Zeng, Zeyi Wen
papers.abstract: Hyperparameters are critical to LLM reinforcement learning (RL), but existing hyperparameter optimization (HPO) methods remain inefficient in this area, due to the massive model scale and resource-intensive training cycles. In this paper, we propose Joint Fidelity Hyperparameter Optimization (JF-HPO), which simultaneously adapts both model size and training budget as fidelity. JF-HPO is empowered by: (i) a small proxy model of the target LLM for efficient training and evaluation in each HPO trial; (ii) several carefully designed early-stopping strategies based on training dynamics; (iii) an efficient checkpointing mechanism to eliminate redundant computations. JF-HPO significantly improves the computational efficiency of each trial (up to 14.9\times) compared with existing HPO methods, thus achieving better predictive accuracy in most cases under the same time budget. Notably, JF-HPO delivers performance improvements ranging from 5.8% to 111.6% over VeRL Recipe.
papers.abstract_zh: 超参数对于大语言模型强化学习至关重要，但现有的超参数优化方法在这一领域仍然效率低下，原因在于模型规模庞大且训练周期耗时较长。在本文中，我们提出了联合保真度超参数优化方法（JF-HPO），该方法能够同时根据保真度来调整模型规模和训练预算。JF-HPO具有以下优势：(i) 使用目标大语言模型的小型代理模型，以便在每次超参数优化过程中进行高效的训练和评估；(ii) 基于训练动态设计出的多种提前终止策略；(iii) 高效的检查点机制，以避免重复计算。与现有的超参数优化方法相比，JF-HPO显著提高了每次试验的计算效率（最高可达14.9倍），从而在相同时间预算下实现更高的预测精度。值得注意的是，JF-HPO的性能提升幅度在5.8%到111.6%之间，优于VeRL Recipe方法。

papers.title: Hetero-Designer: Automated Design of Multi-Agent Systems with Heterogeneous LLMs
papers.title_zh: 异构设计师：利用异构大语言模型进行多智能体系统的自动化设计
papers.authors: Zhiheng Zhang, Yuanzhe Zhang, Bohan Yu, Daojian Zeng, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao
papers.abstract: LLM-based Multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown strong capabilities across a wide range of domains. Their success largely hinges on the collaboration topology design, which has emerged as a central research focus in the automated MAS design.However, existing approaches are fundamentally constrained by their reliance on homogeneous LLMs, which significantly limits overall system intelligence.In response to this limitation, we for the first time propose the concept of Automated Design of Heterogeneous-LLMs-based MAS (ADHM).ADHM sheds light on a promising avenue for advancing collective intelligence, which focuses on the automated design of cost-effective MAS composed of diverse LLMsand roles to suit various queries.Toward this challenging goal, we propose Hetero-Designer, a novel pipeline that efficiently encodes intricate dependencies among queries, LLMs and roles through a novel Binary-Star Transformer and constructs Hetero-MAS in an autoregressive graph generation process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Hetero-Designer is: (1) high-performing on various benchmarks, (2) economical in reducing overhead, (3) extensible to unseen LLMs and roles.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在众多领域都展现出了强大的能力。它们的成功在很大程度上取决于协作拓扑设计，这一设计已成为自动多智能体系统设计中的核心研究重点。然而，现有的方法本质上受到对同质大语言模型的依赖限制，这大大限制了系统的整体智能水平。为了应对这一限制，我们首次提出了基于异构大语言模型的自动设计多智能体系统这一概念。ADHM为提升集体智能提供了有前景的途径，它专注于由不同大语言模型和角色组成的、能够适应各种查询需求的低成本多智能体系统的自动化设计。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了Hetero-Designer这一创新流程，该流程通过创新的二进制星形变换器有效地编码了查询、大语言模型和角色之间的复杂依赖关系，并在自回归图生成过程中构建出异构多智能体系统。大量实验表明，Hetero-Designer具有以下优势：(1)在各种基准测试中的表现优异；(2)在减少系统开销方面具有经济性；(3)可以扩展到尚未被研究的各种大语言模型和角色上。

papers.title: Achieving Multi-Hop Calculation and Safe Abstention in Financial Numerical Reasoning by Metric Graph Constrained LLMs
papers.title_zh: 通过基于度量图的大语言模型实现多跳计算与安全回避在金融数值推理中的应用
papers.authors: Aoyuan Jiang, Liang Hong, Haoxuan Liu, Rui Wang
papers.abstract: Financial numerical reasoning demands rigorous adherence to domain-specific logic and precise evidence foundation. However, large language models (LLMs) are prone to forced generation when confronting ambiguous evidence or complex recursive dependencies, often hallucinating values to bridge information gaps. To address this, we propose graph-bounded financial reasoning (GBFR), a neuro-symbolic framework that imposes semantic and structural constraints via a financial metric knowledge graph (FMKG). Unlike sequential generation paradigms, our approach employs a parallel graph-constrained reasoning algorithm that orchestrates specialized operators to simultaneously explore heterogeneous derivation paths of complex financial metrics. Through cross-path verification, the framework aggregates only semantically consistent results, ensuring reasoning is bounded by available context. Crucially, this approach enables safe abstention by distinguishing genuine data absence from retrieval failure, thereby preventing ungrounded fabrication. To evaluate this capability, we further construct counterfactual samples by perturbing entities, times, and metrics to synthesize unanswerable scenarios. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that GBFR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 金融数值推理要求严格遵循特定领域的逻辑，并基于精确的证据基础进行推理。然而，当面对模糊的证据或复杂的递归依赖关系时，大语言模型容易产生虚假生成，常常为了填补信息空白而虚构数值。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“图约束金融推理”的方法。该方法是基于神经符号框架的，通过金融度量知识图谱来施加语义和结构上的约束。与序列生成范式不同，我们的方法采用了一种并行图约束推理算法，该算法能够同时探索复杂金融指标的多种推导路径。通过跨路径验证，该方法仅汇总语义上一致的结果，确保推理受到现有上下文的限制。关键在于，这种方法能够通过区分真实数据缺失与检索失败，从而实现安全的回避行为，从而防止无根据的伪造行为。为了评估这一能力，我们通过扰动实体、时间和指标来构建反事实样本，以模拟无法回答的问题。在标准基准测试中的实证结果表明，GBFR显著优于现有的最先进基线方法。

papers.title: SOCIA-EVO: Automated Simulator Construction via Dual-Anchored Bi-Level Optimization
papers.title_zh: SOCIA-EVO：通过双层次优化算法构建自动化模拟器
papers.authors: Yuncheng Hua, Sion Weatherhead, Mehdi Jafari, Hao Xue, Flora D. Salim
papers.abstract: Automated simulator construction requires distributional fidelity, distinguishing it from generic code generation. We identify two failure modes in long-horizon LLM agents: contextual drift and optimization instability arising from conflating structural and parametric errors. We propose SOCIA-EVO, a dual-anchored evolutionary framework. SOCIA-EVO introduces: (1) a static blueprint to enforce empirical constraints; (2) a bi-level optimization to decouple structural refinement from parameter calibration; and (3) a self-curating Strategy Playbook that manages remedial hypotheses via Bayesian-weighted retrieval. By falsifying ineffective strategies through execution feedback, SOCIA-EVO achieves robust convergence, generating simulators that are statistically consistent with observational data. SOCIA-EVO’s code and data are available here: https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/SOCIA/tree/evo.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动模拟器的构建需要保证分布的精确性，这与通用代码生成有所不同。我们在长视界LLM代理中发现了两种故障模式：上下文漂移以及由于结构错误与参数错误混合导致的优化不稳定问题。我们提出了SOCIA-EVO这一双锚点进化框架。SOCIA-EVO包含以下特点：(1) 一个静态蓝图，用于强制执行经验性约束；(2) 一个双层优化机制，用于将结构细化与参数校准分离开来；(3) 一种自我修复的策略手册，通过贝叶斯加权检索来管理和调整策略。通过执行反馈来淘汰无效策略，SOCIA-EVO能够实现稳健的收敛，生成的模拟器在统计上与观测数据一致。SOCIA-EVO的代码和数据可在此处获取：https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/SOCIA/tree/evo

papers.title: SoundBreak: A Systematic Study of Audio-Only Adversarial Attacks on Trimodal Models
papers.title_zh: SoundBreak：对三模态模型的纯音频对抗攻击的系统性研究
papers.authors: Aafiya Shamshad Hussain, Gaurav Srivastava, Alvi Md Ishmam, Zaber Ibn Abdul Hakim, Chris Thomas
papers.abstract: Multimodal foundation models that integrate audio, vision, and language achieve strong performance on reasoning and generation tasks, yet their robustness to adversarial manipulation remains poorly understood. We study a realistic and underexplored threat model: untargeted, audio-only adversarial attacks on trimodal audio–video–language models. We analyze six complementary attack objectives that target different stages of multimodal processing, including audio encoder representations, cross-modal attention, hidden states, and output likelihoods. Across four state-of-the-art models and multiple benchmarks, we show that audio-only perturbations can induce severe multimodal failures, achieving up to 96% attack success rate. We further show that attacks can be successful at low perceptual distortions (LPIPS \leq 0.08, SI-SNR \geq 0 dB) and benefit more from extended optimization than increased data scale. We evaluate the feasibility of these attacks under physically realistic conditions by incorporating room impulse response (RIR) modeling, showing that audio-only perturbations remain effective under environmental transformations and thus highlight the practical risk of single-modality attacks in real-world multimodal systems. Transferability across models and encoders remains limited, while speech recognition systems such as Whisper primarily respond to perturbation magnitude, achieving >97% attack success under severe distortion. These results expose a previously overlooked single-modality attack surface in multimodal systems and motivate defenses that enforce cross-modal consistency. Our project website is available at https://aafiya-h.github.io/soundbreak/.
papers.abstract_zh: 整合了音频、视觉和语言的多模态基础模型在推理和生成任务上表现优异，但其对对抗性操纵的鲁棒性仍不明确。我们研究了一种现实且未被充分探索的威胁模型：针对三模态音频-视频-语言模型的无目标、仅基于音频的对抗性攻击。我们分析了六种不同的攻击目标，这些目标分别针对多模态处理的不同阶段，包括音频编码器的表示、跨模态注意力机制、隐藏状态以及输出概率。通过对比四种最先进的模型和多个基准测试，我们发现仅使用音频进行扰动就能导致严重的多模态故障，其攻击成功率高达96%。此外，我们还发现，在感知失真较低的情况下（LPIPS ≤ 0.08，SI-SNR ≥ 0 dB），攻击仍然能够成功实施；而且，相比增加数据规模，扩展优化策略更能提升攻击效果。我们通过结合房间脉冲响应建模来评估这些攻击在实际环境中的可行性，结果表明，即使在环境变化的情况下，仅使用音频进行扰动仍然有效，这凸显了单模态攻击在现实世界多模态系统中的实际风险。不同模型和编码器之间的可迁移性仍然有限，而像Whisper这样的语音识别系统在严重失真的情况下仍能实现超过97%的攻击成功率。这些结果揭示了多模态系统中被忽视的单模态攻击面，并促使我们开发能够强制实现跨模态一致性的防御措施。我们的项目网站地址为https://aafiya-h.github.io/soundbreak/。

papers.title: Trust Within? Seek Beyond? Knowledge Boundary Aware Policy Optimization for Agentic Search
papers.title_zh: 信任于内部？还是寻求更广阔的天地？考虑知识边界的优化策略，以实现智能搜索的目标
papers.authors: Tao Feng, Xinke Jiang, Xinyan Hu, Yonggang Zhang, Zhen Tao, Wentao Zhang, Boyang Liu, Wenhao Jiang, Chao Wu
papers.abstract: Agentic search augments large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge through reinforcement learning. However, existing approaches suffer from blind reliance on noisy retrieval and hallucination when both parametric and external knowledge fail—reflecting a lack of calibration regarding the model’s knowledge boundary. We propose Knowledge boundary Policy Optimization (KbPO), a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly aligns retrieval decisions with quantified knowledge states. KbPO introduces: (1) a semantic stability metric to delineate reliable parametric knowledge; (2) a four-quadrant taxonomy synthesising internal certainty with retrieval quality; and (3) a quadrant-based reward mechanism incentivising calibrated behaviour. We further adopt an iterative query evolution pipeline to construct boundary-probing training samples. Experiments on ten benchmarks demonstrate that KbPO outperforms strong baselines while exhibiting reduced hallucination rates.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动搜索通过强化学习为大语言模型增添了外部知识。然而，现有的方法在参数化知识和外部知识都失效时，仍然依赖于噪声检索和幻觉生成，这反映出模型知识边界的校准存在不足。我们提出了知识边界优化算法，这是一种强化学习框架，能够明确地将检索决策与量化知识状态相结合。KbPO包含以下创新点：(1) 引入语义稳定性指标，以区分可靠的参数化知识；(2) 提出一种四象限分类法，将内部确定性与检索质量结合起来；(3) 采用基于象限的奖励机制，激励模型表现出合理的行为。我们还采用了迭代查询演化流程来构建用于探索知识边界的训练样本。在十个基准测试中的实验表明，KbPO在性能上优于其他强大的基线方法，同时减少了幻觉产生的频率。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: RPC-Bench: A Fine-grained Benchmark for Research Paper Comprehension
papers.title_zh: RPC-Bench：一种用于研究论文理解的细粒度基准测试工具
papers.authors: Yelin Chen, Fanjin Zhang, Suping Sun, Yunhe Pang, Yuanchun Wang, Jian Song, XiaoYan Li, Lei Hou, Shu Zhao, Jie Tang, Juanzi Li
papers.abstract: Understanding research papers remains challenging for foundation models due to specialized scientific discourse and complex figures and tables, yet existing benchmarks offer limited fine-grained evaluation at scale. To address this gap, we introduce RPC-Bench, a large-scale question-answering benchmark built from review–rebuttal exchanges of high-quality computer science papers, containing 15K human-verified QA pairs. We design a fine-grained taxonomy aligned with the scientific research flow to assess models’ ability to understand and answer why, what, and how questions in scholarly contexts. We also define an elaborate LLM–human interaction annotation framework to support large-scale labeling and quality control. Following the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm, we develop a scalable framework that evaluates models on correctness-completeness and conciseness, with high agreement to human judgment. Experiments reveal that even the strongest models (GPT-5) achieve only 68.2% correctness-completeness, dropping to 37.46% after conciseness adjustment, highlighting substantial gaps in precise academic paper understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于基础模型来说，理解研究论文仍然具有挑战性，因为研究论文往往包含复杂的科学论述以及大量的图表和数据。然而，现有的评估基准在大规模评估时所能提供的细粒度评价却非常有限。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了RPC-Bench——一个基于高质量计算机科学论文的问答对进行构建的大规模评估基准。该基准包含了15,000对经过人类验证的问答对。我们设计了一个与科学研究流程相一致的细粒度分类体系，以评估模型在理解并回答关于“为什么”、“什么”以及“如何”的问题方面的能力。此外，我们还建立了一个复杂的LLM与人类交互注释框架，以支持大规模的标注工作以及质量控制。遵循“LLM作为裁判”的模式，我们开发了一个可扩展的评估框架，能够评估模型在正确性、完整性和简洁性方面的表现，并且其评估结果与人类判断高度一致。实验结果表明，即使是最强大的模型（如GPT-5）也仅能达到68.2%的正确性和完整性，而在调整简洁性要求后，这一比例下降到37.46%，这充分揭示了模型在精确理解学术论文方面存在的巨大差距。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
