papers.title: FusionFlow: Enabling Deep Structural Exploration for Automated Agentic Workflow Generation
papers.title_zh: FusionFlow：实现深度结构探索，助力自动化智能工作流生成
papers.authors: Xiang Wang, Zongtao Yang, Zhuojian Hong, Shuhao Zhang, Wei Wei
papers.abstract: Agentic workflows are commonly used to guide large language models in solving complex reasoning tasks. However, existing automated workflow generation methods primarily rely on stepwise local refinement or tree-based search over a single evolving workflow. Under limited optimization budgets, this paradigm constrains structural depth, hindering the discovery of workflows that require deep compositional structure. To address this limitation, we propose FusionFlow, a framework centered on workflow fusion. Unlike incremental refinement, fusion enables structural leaps by synthesizing multiple independently evolved workflows, allowing exploration of deeper regions of the workflow space within a finite budget. To make fusion effective, FusionFlow integrates local optimization, task-specific differentiation, and a dynamic scheduling mechanism. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that FusionFlow consistently outperforms existing automated workflow generation methods. Further ablation and analysis confirm that fusion is the key driver of deep structural exploration, highlighting fusion-driven exploration as an effective approach for overcoming depth limitations in automated workflow generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动式工作流程常被用于指导大语言模型解决复杂的推理任务。然而，现有的自动化工作流程生成方法主要依赖于逐步的局部优化或基于树的搜索，来生成单一的发展中的工作流程。在有限的优化预算下，这种范式限制了结构的深度，从而阻碍了那些需要深层次组合结构的工作流程的发现。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了FusionFlow框架，该框架以工作流程融合为核心。与渐进式优化不同，融合方式通过合成多个独立发展出的工作流程来实现结构的飞跃，从而在有限的预算内探索工作流程空间的更深层次。为了使融合机制有效运作，FusionFlow整合了局部优化、任务特定差异化处理以及动态调度机制。在六个推理基准测试上的实验表明，FusionFlow始终优于现有的自动化工作流程生成方法。进一步的消融分析和验证表明，融合是推动深层次结构探索的关键因素，这凸显了融合驱动的探索方式作为克服自动化工作流程生成中深度限制的有效手段。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CompTab: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Real-World TableQA with Complex Reasoning and Irregular Tables
papers.title_zh: CompTab：一个用于处理现实世界中的表格问答问题的综合性基准测试工具，能够应对包含复杂推理规则以及不规则表格的情况
papers.authors: Zhen Yang, Wei Du, Jie Wang, Wenze Zhou, Xiangfeng Meng, Zhengyang Wang, Suping Sun, Ziwei Du, Haodong Zou, Jie Chen, Yongbin Liu, Shicheng Tan, Jiahao Ying, Shu Zhao
papers.abstract: Recent progress in Large Language Model (LLM) based Table Question Answering (TableQA) has demonstrated strong performance on standard benchmarks. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on well-structured tables and fail to reflect the irregular structures and complex reasoning commonly encountered in real-world scenarios. We propose CompTab, a benchmark designed to evaluate TableQA under complex reasoning and irregular table conditions. CompTab covers six representative types, including semantic ambiguity, multi-hop reasoning, transposed tables, merged cells, missing values, and outliers. It is constructed from real-world seed tables across multiple domains using controlled LLM based generation and human verification to ensure realism and diversity. In addition, to improve the generalization of LLMs under complex and irregular table settings, we propose a two-stage training framework that progressively aligns models with textual reasoning and executable decision signals, instantiated as CompTabLLM. Evaluations on 38 representative LLMs and CompTabLLM show clear limitations of existing LLMs under realistic conditions, while the proposed framework improves generalization. CompTab thus provides a challenging benchmark for advancing TableQA in real-world.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的表格问答技术近年来取得了显著进展，在标准基准测试中的表现非常出色。然而，现有的基准测试主要聚焦于结构清晰的表格，未能充分反映现实场景中常见的不规则结构和复杂推理需求。我们提出了CompTab这一基准测试，旨在评估在复杂推理和不规则表格条件下的表格问答能力。CompTab涵盖了六种典型的挑战类型，包括语义模糊性、多跳推理、转置表格、合并单元格、缺失值以及异常值处理。该基准测试是基于多个领域中的真实表格数据构建的，通过受控的LLM生成和人类验证来确保其真实性和多样性。此外，为了提升LLM在复杂和不规则表格环境下的泛化能力，我们提出了一种两阶段训练框架，逐步使模型具备文本推理能力和可执行决策信号处理能力，最终形成了CompTabLLM。对38种代表性LLM和CompTabLLM进行的评估表明，现有LLM在现实条件下的表现存在明显局限，而所提出的框架则提升了模型的泛化能力。因此，CompTab为推进现实场景中的表格问答技术提供了极具挑战性的基准测试平台。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Learning More from Less: Exploiting Counterfactuals for Data-Efficient Chart Understanding
papers.title_zh: 从有限的信息中获取更多价值：利用反事实推理来实现数据驱动的图表理解
papers.authors: Jianzhu Bao, Haozhen Zhang, Kuicai Dong, Bozhi Wu, Sarthak Ketanbhai Modi, Zi Pong Lim, Yon Shin Teo, Wenya Wang
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in chart understanding, largely driven by supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on increasingly large synthetic datasets.However, scaling SFT data alone is inefficient and overlooks a key property of charts: charts are programmatically generated visual artifacts, where small, code-controlled visual changes can induce drastic shifts in semantics and correct answers.Learning this counterfactual sensitivity requires VLMs to discriminate fine-grained visual differences, yet standard SFT treats training instances independently and provides limited supervision to enforce this behavior.To address this, we introduce ChartCF, a data-efficient training framework designed to enhance counterfactual sensitivity.ChartCF consists of: (1) a counterfactual data synthesis pipeline via code modification, (2) a chart similarity-based data selection strategy that filters overly difficult samples for improved training efficiency, and (3) multimodal preference optimization across both textual and visual modalities.Experiments on five benchmarks show that ChartCF achieves superior or comparable performance to strong chart-specific VLMs while using significantly less training data.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在图表理解方面取得了显著进展，这主要得益于在日益庞大的合成数据集上进行有监督的微调。然而，仅通过扩展微调数据的方式效率低下，而且忽略了图表的一个关键特性：图表本质上是程序生成的视觉元素，其中微小的、由代码控制的视觉变化就能引起语义和正确答案的剧烈变化。要理解这种反事实敏感性，视觉语言模型需要能够区分细微的视觉差异。然而，标准的微调方法只是独立处理训练样本，提供的监督信息有限，无法有效实现这一行为。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了ChartCF这一高效的数据训练框架，旨在提升视觉语言模型的反事实敏感性。ChartCF包含以下三个组成部分：(1) 通过代码修改来生成反事实数据的合成流程；(2) 基于图表相似性的数据筛选策略，用于过滤难度过高的样本，从而提高训练效率；(3) 在文本和视觉两种模态之间进行多模态偏好优化。在五个基准测试中的实验表明，使用ChartCF可以在使用更少训练数据的情况下，获得与强大的图表特定视觉语言模型相当甚至更好的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Video-MMMU: Evaluating Knowledge Acquisition from Multidisciplinary Professional Videos
papers.title_zh: 视频分析：从多学科专业视频中获取知识的方法评估
papers.authors: Kairui Hu, Penghao Wu, Fanyi Pu, Wang Xiao, Xiang Yue, Bo Li, Yuanhan Zhang, Ziwei Liu
papers.abstract: Humans acquire knowledge through three cognitive stages: perceiving information, comprehending knowledge, and adapting knowledge to solve novel problems. Videos serve as an effective medium for knowledge acquisition, facilitating a natural progression through these learning stages. However, existing video benchmarks fail to evaluate the knowledge acquisition capabilities of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). To address this gap, we introduce Video-MMMU, a multi-modal, multi-discipline, multi-track benchmark that evaluates LMMs’ ability to acquire knowledge from college-level, educational videos. Video-MMMU features a collection of 300 videos and 900 human-annotated questions across six disciplines, evaluating knowledge acquisition through stage-aligned question-answer pairs: Perception, Comprehension, and Adaptation. Beyond measuring final accuracy, Video-MMMU proposes the performance gain metric that quantifies an LMM’s learning gain from video, shifting the focus of evaluation from absolute performance to learning efficiency. Our evaluation reveals a substantial gap between human learners and current LMMs, highlighting the need to improve models’ ability to learn and adapt knowledge from video content.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类通过三个认知阶段来获取知识：感知信息、理解知识以及将知识应用于解决新问题。视频是一种有效的知识获取媒介，能够促使人们自然地完成这些学习阶段。然而，现有的视频评估基准未能充分评价大型多模态模型在知识获取方面的能力。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了Video-MMMU这一多模态、多学科、多轨道的评估基准，该基准旨在评估大型多模态模型从大学水平的教育视频中获取知识的能力。Video-MMMU包含300个视频和900道由人类标注的问题，涉及六个学科领域，通过与之对应的问题对来评估知识获取过程：感知、理解和适应。除了衡量最终准确性之外，Video-MMMU还提出了性能增益指标，用于量化大型多模态模型从视频中获得的的学习收益，从而将评估的重点从绝对性能转移到学习效率上。我们的评估结果显示，人类学习者与当前的大型多模态模型之间存在显著差距，这凸显了提高模型从视频内容中学习并适应知识能力的必要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Semantically Comprehensive Token Pruning in LVLMs via Maximizing Concept Coverage
papers.title_zh: 在LVLM中通过最大化概念覆盖度来实现语义上全面的标记剪枝
papers.authors: Xueting Li, Qi Liu, Chenghao Xu, Xu Yang, Guangtao Lyu, Jiahua Li, Cheng Deng
papers.abstract: High-resolution visual tokens impose substantial computational burdens owing to extreme redundancy in Large Visual Language Models (LVLMs). Existing visual token pruning methods typically leverage simple metrics derived from human experience, such as attention or similarity, to rank and select tokens within a highly entangled feature space. However, these metrics lack interpretability and often introduce human bias, failing to capture the genuine semantic significance of tokens, especially amidst the inherent semantic complexity and ambiguity of visual tokens. To mitigate this limitation, we propose a novel Semantically Comprehensive Token Selection (SCTS) method for unbiased, interpretable visual token pruning via a concept-driven paradigm. To unravel the model’s intrinsic semantic representation mechanism, we first introduce a Sparse Autoencoder to disentangle visual features into an interpretable space, with each dimension encoding a distinct semantic concept. We then formulate the token pruning task as a Maximum Concept Coverage problem, quantifying the Marginal Semantic Gain (MSG) of each token’s contribution to uncovered concepts and iteratively selecting tokens with the highest MSG. This concept-centric approach prioritizes tokens with unique semantic contributions, guaranteeing semantic comprehensiveness while preserving robust performance even at high compression ratios. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLM architectures and benchmarks verify that SCTS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving a superior trade-off between computational efficiency and semantic completeness.
papers.abstract_zh: 高分辨率的视觉标记由于大型视觉语言模型中的极端冗余性，会带来巨大的计算负担。现有的视觉标记剪枝方法通常利用源自人类经验的简单指标，如注意力或相似性，来在高度复杂的特征空间中对标记进行排序和选择。然而，这些指标缺乏可解释性，且常常引入人为偏见，无法准确捕捉标记的真正语义意义，尤其是在视觉标记固有的语义复杂性和模糊性背景下。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种新颖的“语义全面标记选择”方法，通过以概念为驱动的方式实现无偏见的、可解释的视觉标记剪枝。为了揭示模型内在的语义表示机制，我们首先使用稀疏自动编码器将视觉特征分解为可解释的空间，每个维度对应一个独特的语义概念。然后，我们将标记剪枝任务转化为最大概念覆盖问题，量化每个标记对未被覆盖概念的贡献所带来的边际语义收益，并迭代选择具有最高边际语义收益的标记。这种以概念为中心的方法能够优先选择具有独特语义贡献的标记，从而在保持强大性能的同时，确保语义的全面性，即使在高压缩率的情况下也能保持良好的性能。通过在多种视觉语言模型架构和基准测试中的广泛实验验证，我们发现SCTS方法始终优于现有方法，能够在计算效率和语义完整性之间取得更好的平衡。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: OptiCo: Adaptive Distributed Training Optimization via Collaborative Agent Reasoning
papers.title_zh: OptiCo：基于协作式智能体推理的自适应分布式训练优化算法
papers.authors: Sheng Chen, Tang Zhe, Weixing Zhang, Fei Yang, Yuanyuan Wang, Tianlin Li, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Optimizing distributed training strategies for large-scale deep learning models remains a critical challenge in both industry and academia, demanding extensive domain expertise and manual tuning. Existing automated distributed training frameworks are plagued by over-reliance on prior profiling, poor generalization across models/hardware, and scalability constraints stemming from vast search spaces, impeding real-world applicability. To address these challenges, we propose OptiCo, a model-driven multi-agent framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to enable automatic and explainable distributed training strategy configuration. OptiCo orchestrates a team of reasoning-driven agents, through a shared Global Message Pool facilitating persistent memory and coordination. By employing inception prompting and Chain-Of-Thought (COT) reasoning, agents iteratively refine configurations, detect bottlenecks, analyze failures, and optimize resource utilization. Evaluated across 25+ configurations spanning diverse model architectures, GPU types and scales, OptiCo outperforms expert-designed strategies within 20 iterations, achieving an average performance improvement of 1.84%, with gains ranging from 0.08% to 8.65%. The source codes are avaiable at https://github.com/TangZhe96/OptiCo-public.
papers.abstract_zh: 优化大规模深度学习模型的分布式训练策略，仍然是工业界和学术界面临的关键挑战。这一挑战需要大量的领域专业知识以及手动调整。现有的自动化分布式训练框架存在以下问题：过度依赖预先制定的配置方案、不同模型或硬件之间的泛化能力较差，以及由于搜索空间庞大而导致的可扩展性限制，这些都限制了其在实际应用中的效果。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了OptiCo——一个以模型为驱动的多智能体框架。该框架利用大语言模型来实现自动且可解释的分布式训练策略配置。OptiCo通过共享的全局消息池来协调一组基于推理的智能体，从而实现持续的内存管理和协作。通过采用Inception提示法和思维链推理技术，智能体能够逐步优化配置、发现瓶颈、分析故障问题，并优化资源利用率。在涵盖了多种模型架构、GPU类型及规模等多种配置的情况下，OptiCo在20次迭代内就超越了专家设计的策略，平均性能提升了1.84%，提升幅度从0.08%到8.65%不等。相关源代码可以在https://github.com/TangZhe96/OptiCo-public获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MemBuilder: Reinforcing LLMs for Long-Term Memory Construction via Attributed Dense Rewards
papers.title_zh: MemBuilder：通过赋予有意义的密集奖励来强化大语言模型，从而有助于长期记忆的构建
papers.authors: Zhiyu Shen, Ziming Wu, Fuming Lai, Shaobing Lian, Yanghui Rao
papers.abstract: Maintaining consistency in long-term dialogues remains a fundamental challenge for LLMs, as standard retrieval mechanisms often fail to capture the temporal evolution of historical states. While memory-augmented frameworks offer a structured alternative, current systems rely on static prompting of closed-source models or suffer from ineffective training paradigms with sparse rewards. We introduce MemBuilder, a reinforcement learning framework that trains models to orchestrate multi-dimensional memory construction with attributed dense rewards. MemBuilder addresses two key challenges: (1) Sparse Trajectory-Level Rewards: we employ synthetic session-level question generation to provide dense intermediate rewards across extended trajectories; and (2) Multi-Dimensional Memory Attribution: we introduce contribution-aware gradient weighting that scales policy updates based on each component’s downstream impact. Experimental results show that MemBuilder enables a 4B-parameter model to outperform state-of-the-art closed-source baselines, exhibiting strong generalization across long-term dialogue benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 在长期对话中保持一致性仍然是大语言模型面临的一个基本挑战，因为传统的检索机制往往无法捕捉历史状态的时间演变。虽然带有记忆增强功能的框架提供了一种结构化的解决方案，但当前的系统仍然依赖于静态的闭源模型提示，或者采用效果不佳的训练方式，导致奖励分布稀疏。我们提出了MemBuilder这一强化学习框架，该框架能够训练模型来构建多维记忆结构，并赋予其丰富的奖励。MemBuilder解决了两个关键问题：(1) 轨迹级别的奖励稀疏问题：我们通过合成式的会话级问题生成方式，为长时间序列提供密集的中间奖励；(2) 多维记忆的归因问题：我们引入了基于贡献度进行梯度加权的技术，根据每个组成部分的下游影响来调整策略更新。实验结果表明，MemBuilder使得一个拥有40亿参数的模型能够在长期对话基准测试中超越最先进的闭源模型，展现了强大的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Towards Fine-grained Audio Captioning with Multimodal Contextual Fusion
papers.title_zh: 基于多模态上下文融合的细粒度音频描述技术
papers.authors: Shunian Chen, Xinyuan Xie, Zheshu Chen, Owen Lee, Liyan Zhao, Zhan Su, Qilin Sun, Benyou Wang
papers.abstract: High-quality, large-scale audio captioning is crucial for advancing audio understanding, yet current automated methods often generate captions that lack fine-grained detail and contextual accuracy, primarily due to their reliance on limited unimodal or superficial multimodal information. Drawing inspiration from human auditory perception, which adeptly integrates cross-modal cues and performs sophisticated auditory scene analysis, we introduce a novel two-stage automated pipeline. This pipeline first employs specialized pretrained models to extract diverse contextual cues (e.g., speech, music, general sounds, and visual information from associated video). A large language model (LLM) then synthesizes these rich, multimodal inputs to generate detailed and context-aware audio captions. Key contributions of this work include: (1) the proposed scalable method for fine-grained audio caption generation; (2) FusionAudio, a new large-scale dataset comprising 1.2 million such detailed captions, combined with 6 million QA pairs; and (3) enhanced audio models developed using FusionAudio, specifically a CLAP-based audio encoder with superior audio-text alignment and instruction following. This paper paves the way for more nuanced and accurate automated understanding of complex audio environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量的、大规模的音频字幕对于提升音频理解能力至关重要。然而，目前的自动化方法往往生成的字幕缺乏精细的细节和上下文准确性，这主要是由于它们依赖于有限的一模态或表面性的多模态信息。借鉴人类听觉感知的思维方式——它能够巧妙地整合不同模态的信息，并进行复杂的音频场景分析——我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段自动化流程。该流程首先使用专门的预训练模型来提取各种上下文线索（例如，语音、音乐、普通声音以及相关视频中的视觉信息）。然后，大语言模型将这些丰富多模态的信息综合起来，生成详细且具有上下文意识的音频字幕。本研究的关键贡献包括：（1）提出了一种适用于细粒度音频字幕生成的可扩展方法；（2）FusionAudio是一个新的大规模数据集，包含120万条这样的详细字幕，以及600万对问答对；（3）利用FusionAudio开发的增强型音频模型，特别是基于CLAP的音频编码器，它具有出色的音文本对齐和指令遵循能力。本文为更细致、更准确的复杂音频环境的自动化理解铺平了道路。

papers.title: Probing Semantic Alignment, Lexical Invariance, and Syntactic Influence in LLM Metaphor Processing
papers.title_zh: 探究大语言模型在隐喻处理中的语义一致性、词汇不变性以及句法影响
papers.authors: Fengying Ye, Shanshan Wang, Lidia S. Chao, Derek F. Wong
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on metaphor detection and interpretation tasks, yet it remains unclear what such behavioral success actually reveals about metaphor processing. We present a diagnostic analysis that examines the limits of behavioral evidence by probing three complementary dimensions: semantic attribute alignment, lexical invariance, and syntactic sensitivity. Using geometric probing, we assess whether model-generated interpretations align with reference semantic attributes; through context-varying substitution, we analyze the stability of lexical associations between metaphorical and literal expressions; and via controlled syntactic perturbations, we examine sensitivity in metaphor detection. Our analysis reveals that LLM-generated interpretations can exhibit semantic drift relative to reference attributes; stable lexical anchors persist across contextual conditions, potentially supporting conventional metaphors while biasing novel metaphors requiring contextual integration; and detection performance is sensitive to syntactic irregularities. These findings suggest that strong behavioral performance may reflect heterogeneous underlying signals, highlighting the need for caution when interpreting metaphor benchmarks as evidence of robust, integrated semantic understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在隐喻检测与解释任务上表现出强大的性能，然而，这种行为上的成功究竟揭示了关于隐喻处理的哪些信息，目前仍不清楚。我们提出了一种诊断性分析，通过考察三个互补的维度来探讨行为证据的局限性：语义属性对齐、词汇不变性以及句法敏感性。通过几何探测方法，我们评估模型生成的解释是否与参考语义属性一致；通过上下文变化的替换实验，我们分析隐喻表达与字面表达之间词汇关联的稳定性；通过控制性的句法扰动，我们检验模型在隐喻检测方面的敏感性。我们的分析表明，模型生成的解释可能会相对于参考属性出现语义漂移；稳定的词汇锚点在不同上下文条件下仍然存在，这可能有助于支持传统的隐喻，同时使得需要上下文整合的新颖隐喻表现不佳；此外，检测性能对句法不规则性非常敏感。这些发现表明，强大的行为表现可能反映了不同的潜在信号，这提醒我们在将隐喻基准测试作为语义理解能力强的证据时必须保持谨慎。

papers.title: MathCanvas: Intrinsic Visual Chain-of-Thought for Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MathCanvas：一种内置的视觉化思维链，旨在支持多模态数学推理
papers.authors: Weikang Shi, Aldrich Yu, Rongyao Fang, Houxing Ren, Ke Wang, Aojun Zhou, Changyao Tian, Xinyu Fu, Yuxuan Hu, Zimu Lu, Linjiang Huang, Si Liu, Rui Liu, Hongsheng Li
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have excelled in textual reasoning, they struggle with mathematical domains like geometry that intrinsically rely on visual aids. Existing approaches to Visual Chain-of-Thought (VCoT) are often limited by rigid external tools or fail to generate the high-fidelity, strategically-timed diagrams necessary for complex problem-solving. To bridge this gap, we introduce MathCanvas, a comprehensive framework designed to endow unified Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) with intrinsic VCoT capabilities for mathematics. Our approach consists of two phases. First, a Visual Manipulation stage pre-trains the model on a novel 15.2M-pair corpus, comprising 10M caption-to-diagram pairs (MathCanvas-Imagen) and 5.2M step-by-step editing trajectories (MathCanvas-Edit), to master diagram generation and editing. Second, a Strategic Visual-Aided Reasoning stage fine-tunes the model on MathCanvas-Instruct, a new 219K-example dataset of interleaved visual-textual reasoning paths, teaching it when and how to leverage visual aids. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we introduce MathCanvas-Bench, a challenging benchmark with 3K problems that require models to produce interleaved visual-textual solutions. Our model, BAGEL-Canvas, trained under this framework, achieves an 86% relative improvement over strong LMM baselines on MathCanvas-Bench, demonstrating excellent generalization to other public math benchmarks. Our work provides a complete toolkit—framework, datasets, and benchmark—to unlock complex, human-like visual reasoning in LMMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在文本推理方面表现出色，但在需要视觉辅助的数学领域，如几何学，它们却表现得相当糟糕。现有的视觉思维链技术往往受到刚性外部工具的限制，或者无法生成用于复杂问题解决的、高保真度的、具有战略性的图表。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MathCanvas这个综合性框架，旨在为大型多模态模型赋予数学领域的视觉思维能力。我们的方法分为两个阶段：第一阶段是视觉操作阶段，该阶段对模型进行预训练，训练数据包含1520万对图文对（MathCanvas-Imagen）以及520万条逐步编辑轨迹（MathCanvas-Edit），以掌握图表的生成和编辑能力。第二阶段是战略性视觉辅助推理阶段，该阶段在MathCanvas-Instruct数据集上进行模型微调，这个数据集包含了21.9万条交织的视觉-文本推理路径，教会模型何时以及如何利用视觉辅助工具。为了进行严格的评估，我们引入了MathCanvas-Bench这个具有挑战性的基准测试，该测试包含3000个问题，要求模型生成交织的视觉-文本解决方案。在我们的框架下训练的模型BAGEL-Canvas，在MathCanvas-Bench基准测试中取得了86%的相对性能提升，显示出对其他公共数学基准测试的出色泛化能力。我们的工作提供了一套完整的工具包——包括框架、数据集和基准测试——以解锁大型模型中复杂的、类似人类的视觉推理能力。

papers.title: Rethinking the Role of Entropy in Optimizing Tool-Use Behaviors for Large Language Model Agents
papers.title_zh: 重新思考熵在优化大型语言模型代理工具使用行为中的作用
papers.authors: Zeping Li, Hongru Wang, Yiwen Zhao, Guanhua Chen, Yixia Li, Keyang Chen, Yixin Cao, Guangnan Ye, Hongfeng Chai, Zhenfei Yin
papers.abstract: Tool-using agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in tasks such as mathematical reasoning and multi-hop question answering. However, in long trajectories, agents often trigger excessive and low-quality tool calls, increasing latency and degrading inference performance, making managing tool-use behavior challenging. In this work, we conduct entropy-based pilot experiments and observe a strong positive correlation between entropy reduction and high-quality tool calls. Building on this finding, we propose using entropy reduction as a supervisory signal and design two reward strategies to address the differing needs of optimizing tool-use behavior. Sparse outcome rewards provide coarse, trajectory-level guidance to improve efficiency, while dense process rewards offer fine-grained supervision to enhance performance. Experiments across diverse domains show that both reward designs improve tool-use behavior: the former reduces tool calls by 72.07% compared to the average of baselines, while the latter improves performance by 22.27%. These results position entropy reduction as a key mechanism for enhancing tool-use behavior, enabling agents to be more adaptive in real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的工具使用智能体在诸如数学推理和多跳问题回答等任务中表现出色。然而，在长期运行过程中，这些智能体往往会触发过多且质量低下的工具调用，这会增加延迟并降低推理性能，使得管理工具使用行为变得困难。在这项研究中，我们进行了基于熵的试点实验，发现熵降低与高质量工具调用之间存在强烈的正相关性。基于这一发现，我们提出将熵降低作为监督信号，并设计了两种奖励策略来应对优化工具使用行为的不同需求。稀疏结果奖励提供宏观的、基于轨迹层面的指导以提高效率，而密集的过程奖励则提供细粒度的监督以提升性能。在不同领域的实验中表明，这两种奖励设计都能改善工具使用行为：前者使工具调用次数减少了72.07%，相比基线的平均水平；后者则提升了22.27%的性能。这些结果表明，熵降低是提升工具使用行为的关键机制，能够使得智能体在现实应用中的表现更加灵活自适应。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Collaboration of Fusion and Independence: Hypercomplex-driven Robust Multi-Modal Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.title_zh: 融合与独立的协同作用：由超复杂系统驱动的稳健多模态知识图谱补全技术
papers.authors: Zhiqiang Liu, Yichi Zhang, Mengshu Sun, Lei Liang, Wen Zhang
papers.abstract: Multi-modal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC) aims to discover missing facts in multi-modal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) by leveraging both structural relationships and diverse modality information of entities. Existing MMKGC methods follow two multi-modal paradigms: fusion-based and ensemble-based. Fusion-based methods employ fixed fusion strategies, which inevitably leads to the loss of modality-specific information and a lack of flexibility to adapt to varying modality relevance across contexts. In contrast, ensemble-based methods retain modality independence through dedicated sub-models but struggle to capture the nuanced, context-dependent semantic interplay between modalities. To overcome these dual limitations, we propose a novel MMKGC method M-Hyper, which achieves the coexistence and collaboration of fused and independent modality representations. Our method integrates the strengths of both paradigms, enabling effective cross-modal interactions while maintaining modality-specific information. Inspired by “quaternion” algebra, we utilize its four orthogonal bases to represent multiple independent modalities and employ the Hamilton product to efficiently model pair-wise interactions among them. Specifically, we introduce a Fine-grained Entity Representation Factorization (FERF) module and a Robust Relation-aware Modality Fusion (R2MF) module to obtain robust representations for three independent modalities and one fused modality. The resulting four modality representations are then mapped to the four orthogonal bases of a biquaternion for comprehensive modality interaction. Extensive experiments indicate its state-of-the-art performance with better robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态知识图谱补全（MMKGC）旨在利用结构关系和实体的多种模态信息，发现多模态知识图谱中缺失的事实。现有的MMKGC方法遵循两种多模态范式：基于融合的方法和基于集成的方法。基于融合的方法采用固定的融合策略，这不可避免地会导致丧失特定模态的信息，并且难以适应不同情境下不同模态的相关性变化。相比之下，基于集成的方法通过专门的子模型保留了模态独立性，但难以捕捉不同模态之间复杂的、依赖于上下文的语义交互关系。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的MMKGC方法——M-Hyper。该方法实现了融合的独立模态表示之间的共存与协作。我们的方法结合了两种范式的优点，能够在保持特定模态信息的同时实现有效的跨模态交互。受“四元数”代数的启发，我们利用其四个正交基来表示多个独立模态，并采用哈密顿积来高效模拟它们之间的相互作用。具体来说，我们引入了细粒度实体表示分解模块和稳健的关联感知模态融合模块，以获得三个独立模态和一个融合模态的稳健表示。最终得到的四个模态表示被映射到双四元数的四个正交基上，从而实现全面的模态交互。广泛的实验表明，该方法具有最先进的性能，并且具备更好的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLM-MC-Affect: LLM-Based Monte Carlo Modeling of Affective Trajectories and Latent Ambiguity for Interpersonal Dynamic Insight
papers.title_zh: LLM-MC-Affect：基于大语言模型的蒙特卡洛建模技术，用于模拟情感轨迹及潜在模糊性，从而帮助洞察人际关系中的动态变化
papers.authors: Yu-Zheng Lin, Bono Po-Jen Shih, John Paul Martin Encinas, Elizabeth Victoria Achom, Karan Patel, Jesus Horacio Pacheco, Sicong Shao, Jyotikrishna Dass, Soheil Salehi, Pratik Satam
papers.abstract: Emotional coordination is a core property of human interaction that shapes how relational meaning is constructed in real time. While text-based affect inference has become increasingly feasible, prior approaches often treat sentiment as a deterministic point estimate for individual speakers, failing to capture the inherent subjectivity, latent ambiguity, and sequential coupling found in mutual exchanges. We introduce LLM-MC-Affect, a probabilistic framework that characterizes emotion not as a static label, but as a continuous latent probability distribution defined over an affective space. By leveraging stochastic LLM decoding and Monte Carlo estimation, the methodology approximates these distributions to derive high-fidelity sentiment trajectories that explicitly quantify both central affective tendencies and perceptual ambiguity. These trajectories enable a structured analysis of interpersonal coupling through sequential cross-correlation and slope-based indicators, identifying leading or lagging influences between interlocutors. To validate the interpretive capacity of this approach, we utilize teacher-student instructional dialogues as a representative case study, where our quantitative indicators successfully distill high-level interaction insights such as effective scaffolding. This work establishes a scalable and deployable pathway for understanding interpersonal dynamics, offering a generalizable solution that extends beyond education to broader social and behavioral research.
papers.abstract_zh: 情感协调是人类互动的核心特性，它决定了关系意义在实时中的构建方式。虽然基于文本的情感推断已经变得越来越可行，但以往的方法往往将情绪视为个体说话者的确定性点估计值，未能捕捉到相互交流中存在的主观性、潜在的不确定性以及序列性的耦合关系。我们提出了LLM-MC-Affect这一概率框架，它将情绪并非视为一个静态标签，而是视为一个定义在情感空间上的连续潜在概率分布。通过利用随机LLM解码和蒙特卡洛估计方法，该方法能够近似这些分布，从而得出高精度的情感轨迹，这些轨迹能够明确量化中心情感倾向和感知上的不确定性。这些轨迹使得通过序列交叉相关性和斜率指标来结构化分析人际耦合关系成为可能，从而识别出对话者之间领先或滞后影响的因素。为了验证这种方法的解释能力，我们以师生教学对话作为典型案例进行研究，我们的定量指标成功地提取了诸如有效支架等高级交互洞察。这项工作为理解人际动态建立了一个可扩展且可部署的路径，提供了一种可推广的解决方案，其应用范围不仅限于教育领域，还涵盖了更广泛的社会和行为研究。

papers.title: Multilingual and Cross-Lingual Citation Needed Detection on Wikipedia for Lower-Resource Languages
papers.title_zh: 需要检测维基百科上那些使用低资源语言撰写的文章的多语言及跨语言引用情况
papers.authors: Gerrit Quaremba, Amy Rechkemmer, Elizabeth Black, Denny Vrandečić, Elena Simperl
papers.abstract: In automated fact-checking (AFC), check-worthiness detection identifies claims requiring verification based on domain-specific criteria. On Wikipedia, this task instantiates as Citation Needed Detection (CND), which flags claims lacking supporting citations. However, existing research has largely overlooked lower-resource languages, and recent AFC pipelines rely on large language models (LLMs), which are inaccessible to low-resource organizations. We introduce MCN, a multilingual CND corpus spanning 18 languages across three resource levels, on which we conduct an extensive study of small decoder-based language models (SLMs). Our experiments show that SLMs fine-tuned with an encoder-style objective substantially outperform prompted LLMs across languages. We further present one of the first studies on cross-lingual CND, demonstrating that SLMs fine-tuned solely on English claims surpass LLMs, even with little to no target-language adaptation. Our findings have important implications for lower-resource Wikipedia communities and suggest that compact, task-specific models are preferable to LLMs for CND.
papers.abstract_zh: 在自动化事实核查中，检查价值检测能够识别出需要根据特定领域标准进行验证的声明。在维基百科上，这一任务被具体化为“需要引用检测”，即标记出那些缺乏支持性引用的声明。然而，现有的研究大多忽略了资源匮乏的语言类型，而最近的自动化事实核查流程则依赖于大语言模型，这些模型对于资源匮乏的组织来说难以获取。我们提出了MCN，这是一个多语言引用检测语料库，涵盖了18种语言，并且覆盖了三个不同的资源级别。我们在该语料库上进行了大量关于小型解码器式语言模型的实验。我们的实验表明，以编码器风格的目标进行微调的小型解码器式语言模型在不同语言上的表现明显优于基于大语言模型的模型。此外，我们还进行了首次跨语言引用检测的研究，结果表明，仅针对英语声明进行微调的小型解码器式语言模型甚至能够在几乎没有目标语言适应性的情况下超越大语言模型。我们的发现对资源匮乏的维基百科社区具有重要意义，表明对于引用检测任务而言，紧凑且专用于特定任务的模型比大语言模型更为理想。

papers.title: Process Reward Models Meet Planning: Generating Precise and Scalable Datasets for Step-Level Rewards
papers.title_zh: 流程奖励模型与规划的结合：为阶段性奖励生成精确且可扩展的数据集
papers.authors: Raffaele Pisano, Roberto Navigli
papers.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have emerged as a powerful tool for providing step-level feedback when evaluating the reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs), which frequently produce chains of thought (CoTs) containing errors even when the final answer is correct. However, existing PRM datasets remain expensive to construct, prone to annotation errors, and predominantly limited to the mathematical domain.This work introduces a novel and scalable approach to PRM dataset generation based on planning logical problems expressed in the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL). Using this method, we generate a corpus of approximately one million reasoning steps across various PDDL domains and use it to train PRMs. Experimental results show that augmenting widely-used PRM training datasets with PDDL-derived data yields substantial improvements in both mathematical and non-mathematical reasoning, as demonstrated across multiple benchmarks.These findings indicate that planning problems constitute a scalable and effective resource for generating robust, precise, and fine-grained training data for PRMs, going beyond the classical mathematical sources that dominate this field.
papers.abstract_zh: 过程奖励模型（PRMs）已成为一种强大的工具，能够在评估大语言模型的推理能力时提供逐步骤的反馈。大语言模型在生成思维链时常常会出现错误，即使最终答案是正确的。然而，现有的PRM数据集在构建成本上很高，且容易出现标注错误，而且主要局限于数学领域。本研究提出了一种基于规划逻辑问题的新型可扩展PRM数据集生成方法，这些逻辑问题用规划领域定义语言（PDDL）来表示。通过这种方法，我们生成了约一百万个推理步骤的语料库，并用它来训练PRMs。实验结果表明，将广泛使用的PRM训练数据集与由PDDL表示的数据相结合，可以在数学和非数学推理方面取得显著改进，这一点已在多个基准测试中得到验证。这些发现表明，规划问题是一种可扩展且有效的资源，能够生成稳健、精确且细粒度的PRM训练数据，从而超越目前在该领域占主导地位的传统数学数据源。

papers.title: UniSonate: A Unified Model for Speech, Music, and Sound Effect Generation with Text Instructions
papers.title_zh: UniSonate：一种统一的模型，可用于根据文本指令生成语音、音乐以及声音效果
papers.authors: Chunyu Qiang, Xiaopeng Wang, Kang Yin, Yuzhe Liang, Yuxin Guo, Teng Ma, Ziyu Zhang, Tianrui Wang, Cheng Gong, Yushen Chen, Ruibo Fu, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang
papers.abstract: Generative audio modeling has largely been fragmented into specialized tasks, text-to-speech (TTS), text-to-music (TTM), and text-to-audio (TTA), each operating under heterogeneous control paradigms. Unifying these modalities remains a fundamental challenge due to the intrinsic dissonance between structured semantic representations (speech/music) and unstructured acoustic textures (sound effects). In this paper, we introduce UniSonate, a unified flow-matching framework capable of synthesizing speech, music, and sound effects through a standardized, reference-free natural language instruction interface. To reconcile structural disparities, we propose a novel dynamic token injection mechanism that projects unstructured environmental sounds into a structured temporal latent space, enabling precise duration control within a phoneme-driven Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT). Coupled with a multi-stage curriculum learning strategy, this approach effectively mitigates cross-modal optimization conflicts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniSonate achieves state-of-the-art performance in instruction-based TTS (WER 1.47%) and TTM (SongEval Coherence 3.18), while maintaining competitive fidelity in TTA. Crucially, we observe positive transfer, where joint training on diverse audio data significantly enhances structural coherence and prosodic expressiveness compared to single-task baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式音频建模目前主要被划分为几个独立的任务：文本转语音（TTS）、文本转音乐（TTM）以及文本转音频（TTA）。这些任务分别采用不同的控制范式。然而，由于结构化语义表示（如语音/音乐）与非结构化的声学纹理（如音效）之间存在本质上的差异，将这些任务统一起来仍然是一个巨大的挑战。在本文中，我们提出了UniSonate这一统一的框架，它能够通过标准化的、无需参考的自然语言指令接口来合成语音、音乐和音效。为了弥合这种结构上的差异，我们提出了一种新颖的动态令牌注入机制，该机制可以将非结构化的环境声音映射到一个结构化的时间潜态空间中，从而能够在基于音素驱动的多模态扩散变换器模型中精确控制每个音素的持续时间。结合多阶段课程学习策略，这种方法能够有效缓解不同模态之间的优化冲突。大量实验表明，UniSonate在基于指令的TTS任务中取得了领先的性能表现（正确率1.47%），在TTM任务中也表现出色（SongEval一致性评分为3.18），同时在TTA任务中也能保持较高的保真度。值得注意的是，我们对UniSonate进行了联合训练，发现通过对不同音频数据进行联合训练，可以显著提升系统的结构一致性和韵律表达能力，这比单独进行单一任务训练要有效得多。

papers.title: AgentAsk: Multi-Agent Systems Need to Ask
papers.title_zh: AgentAsk：多智能体系统需要能够提出问题
papers.authors: Bohan Lin, Kuo Yang, Zelin Tan, Yingchuan Lai, Chen Zhang, Guibin Zhang, Xinlei Yu, Miao Yu, Xu Wang, Yudong Zhang, Yang Wang
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models promise improved problem-solving through collaboration, yet they often fail to consistently outperform strong single-agent baselines due to error propagation at inter-agent message handoffs. In this work, we conduct a systematic empirical analysis of such failures and introduce an edge-level error taxonomy that identifies four dominant error types: Data Gap, Signal Corruption, Referential Drift, and Capability Gap, as primary sources of failure in multi-agent interactions. Building on this taxonomy, we propose AgentAsk, a lightweight clarification module designed to intervene at the edge level in MAS to prevent cascading errors. The module operates by strategically applying minimal clarifications at critical points within the system, improving the accuracy and efficiency of the overall task. AgentAsk is trained to balance the trade-offs between clarification cost, latency, and accuracy, while it is also architecture-agnostic and can be easily integrated into existing systems. Evaluated across five benchmarks, AgentAsk consistently improves accuracy by up to 4.69%, while keeping latency and extra costs below 10% compared to baseline MAS, showcasing its high efficiency and minimal overhead. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgentAsk-3432.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统通过协作提升了问题解决能力，但由于智能体间信息传递过程中的错误传播，它们往往无法持续超越强大的单智能体基线性能。在这项研究中，我们对这些失败现象进行了系统的实证分析，并提出了一种边缘级错误分类体系，该体系确定了四种主要的错误类型：数据缺失、信号失真、引用偏差以及能力差距，这些正是多智能体交互中常见的失败根源。基于这一分类体系，我们提出了AgentAsk这一轻量级辅助模块，旨在在智能体交互的边缘层面进行干预，以防止连锁错误的发生。该模块通过在系统内的关键节点进行有针对性的补充说明，来提高整体任务的准确性和效率。AgentAsk经过训练后，能够在补充说明的成本、延迟和准确性之间找到平衡，同时它还具有架构无关性，可以轻松集成到现有系统中。在五个基准测试中的表现表明，AgentAsk能够将准确率提高4.69%，同时延迟和额外成本与基线多智能体系统相比保持在10%以下，充分体现了其高效性和低开销的特点。相关代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgentAsk-3432。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HopWeaver: Cross-Document Synthesis of High-Quality and Authentic Multi-Hop Questions
papers.title_zh: HopWeaver：跨文档整合高质量且真实的多跳问题解决方案
papers.authors: Zhiyu Shen, Jiyuan Liu, Yunhe Pang, Yanghui Rao, Fu Lee Wang, Jianxing Yu
papers.abstract: Multi-Hop Question Answering (MHQA) is crucial for evaluating the model’s capability to integrate information from diverse sources. However, creating extensive and high-quality MHQA datasets is challenging: (i) manual annotation is expensive, and (ii) current synthesis methods often produce simplistic questions or require extensive manual guidance. This paper introduces HopWeaver, the first cross-document framework synthesizing authentic multi-hop questions without human intervention. HopWeaver synthesizes bridge and comparison questions through an innovative pipeline that identifies complementary documents and constructs authentic reasoning paths to ensure true multi-hop reasoning. We further present a comprehensive system for evaluating the synthesized multi-hop questions. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that the synthesized questions achieve comparable or superior quality to human-annotated datasets at a lower cost. Our framework provides a valuable tool for the research community: it can automatically generate challenging benchmarks from any raw corpus, which opens new avenues for both evaluation and targeted training to improve the reasoning capabilities of advanced question answering models, especially in domains with scarce resources.
papers.abstract_zh: 多跳问答技术（MHQA）对于评估模型从多种来源整合信息的能力至关重要。然而，创建大量且高质量的多跳问答数据集是一项挑战性任务：(i) 手动标注成本高昂；(ii) 当前的数据合成方法往往会产生过于简单的问题，或者需要大量的人工干预才能生成有效的问题。本文介绍了HopWeaver，这是首个无需人工干预即可合成真实多跳问题的跨文档框架。HopWeaver通过一种创新的流程来合成桥梁问题和比较问题，该流程能够识别互补的文档，并构建真实的推理路径，从而确保实现真正的多跳推理。我们还提出了一个用于评估合成多跳问题的综合系统。实验结果表明，所合成的问题在较低成本的情况下，其质量可与人工标注的数据集相媲美甚至更优。我们的框架为研究界提供了一个有价值的工具：它能够从任何原始语料中自动生成具有挑战性的测试集，这为评估和改进高级问答模型的推理能力开辟了新的途径，尤其是在资源匮乏的领域。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: REST: Stress Testing Large Reasoning Models by Asking Multiple Problems at Once
papers.title_zh: REST：通过同时提出多个问题来测试大型推理模型的性能
papers.authors: Zhuoshi Pan, Qizhi Pei, Yu Li, Zinan Tang, QiYao Sun, H. Vicky Zhao, Conghui He, Lijun Wu
papers.abstract: Recent Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable progress, yet their evaluation still relies on a narrow paradigm: evaluating one question at a time. This single-question setup suffers from two major limitations: (1) vulnerability to data contamination and diminishing difficulty, forcing costly creation of new questions with significant human effort, (2) failure to evaluate models under multi-context pressure, a key requirement for real-world deployment. To bridge this gap, we present REST (Reasoning Evaluation through Simultaneous Testing), a stress-testing framework that exposes LRMs to multiple problems simultaneously. Beyond basic reasoning, REST evaluates two under-tested capabilities: contextual priority allocation and robustness against contextual interference. Our evaluation of more than 30 advanced reasoning models on 9 reasoning benchmarks reveals several striking findings: Even state-of-the-art (SOTA) models such as DeepSeek-R1 exhibit substantial performance degradation under stress testing, challenging the prevailing assumption that “LLMs are multi-problem solvers”. Crucially, REST demonstrates stronger discriminative power than existing benchmarks, revealing performance gaps among models that exhibit similar, near-ceiling performance under traditional evaluation. Some key insights emerge from our analysis: (1) the “overthinking trap” is a critical factor contributing to the performance degradation; (2) models trained with the “Long2Short” technique preserve more of their single-problem accuracy under REST, outperforming their standard-trained counterparts. These results establish REST as a cost-efficient, future-proof evaluation paradigm while reducing reliance on continuous human annotation. Code is available at https://github.com/opendatalab/REST.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的大型推理模型（LRM）取得了显著的进展，但它们的评估仍然依赖于一种狭隘的范式：一次只评估一个问题。这种单问题评估方式存在两个主要缺陷：(1)容易受到数据污染的影响，且随着问题难度的增加，需要耗费大量人力来创建新的问题；(2)无法评估模型在多种情境下的表现，而这正是实际部署模型时的关键要求。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了REST——一种通过同时测试来评估模型的框架。除了基本的推理能力之外，REST还评估了两种缺乏测试的能力：情境优先级分配以及对抗情境干扰的鲁棒性。我们对30多个高级推理模型在9个推理基准测试中的评估结果显示出了一些令人惊讶的现象：即使是像DeepSeek-R1这样最先进的模型，在压力测试下也出现了显著的性能下降，这挑战了“大语言模型是多问题解决者”这一普遍假设。重要的是，REST所展示出的区分能力比现有的基准测试更强，这表明在传统评估模式下表现相近的模型之间存在着性能差距。我们的分析还揭示了几个重要见解：(1)“过度思考陷阱”是导致性能下降的关键因素；(2)使用“Long2Short”技术训练的模型在REST环境下能保持更高的单问题解决准确率，其性能优于传统训练方式的模型。这些结果表明，REST是一种成本效益高、具有前瞻性的评估方法，同时减少了对人类持续注释的依赖。相关代码可访问于https://github.com/opendatalab/REST。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: You Can Have a Second Chance: Unbiased and Multi-bit Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models with Regret-based Remasking
papers.title_zh: 你拥有第二次机会：针对扩散语言模型的无偏见多比特水印技术，实现基于遗憾修复的重新掩蔽功能
papers.authors: Ke Yang, Dongyang Liang, Jing Yu, Shuguang Yuan, Chi Chen
papers.abstract: The rapid development of Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) raises concerns about watermarking for DLM-generated detection. However, existing sequential LLM watermarking cannot be directly applied to DLMs, as DLMs’ generation order is arbitrary. While emerging studies adapt biased LLM watermarking to DLMs by temporarily predicting the watermark prefix, they suffer from degraded quality and unstable watermarking due to bias accumulation and prediction errors. Besides, they cannot carry multi-bit watermarks. In this paper, we propose unbiased multi-bit watermarking for DLMs. We introduce a stability-aware constraint that allows watermarking only in stable contexts and a bit-controlled, unbiased modulation to preserve the original DLM output distribution, achieving stable watermarking with minimal quality impact. To enhance detection robustness, we design a Regret-based Remasking, which grants a “second chance” for unwatermarked tokens to be regenerated. It can seamlessly integrate into DLM inference with no added diffusion steps and latency. Experiments across DLMs and various tasks show that our scheme is effective, achieving superior generation quality compared to baselines while maintaining high detection accuracy and multi-bit capacity. Our code is available here https://github.com/iieSKLCSDsg/UMR.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）的快速发展引发了对DLM生成内容检测中水印技术的担忧。然而，现有的序列LLM水印技术无法直接应用于DLM，因为DLM的生成顺序具有随机性。虽然一些研究尝试通过临时预测水印前缀来适应DLM，但这种方法会导致水印质量下降以及水印效果不稳定，因为存在偏见累积和预测误差的问题。此外，这些方法还无法处理多比特水印。在本文中，我们提出了一种针对DLM的无偏见多比特水印技术。我们引入了一种稳定性约束机制，仅允许在稳定的环境中进行水印处理，同时采用比特控制的无偏见调制方式，以保留DLM原始输出分布，从而实现在最小质量影响下的稳定水印处理。为了增强检测的鲁棒性，我们设计了基于遗憾值的重新标记算法，为未水印化的令牌提供“第二次机会”以重新生成。该算法可以无缝集成到DLM推理过程中，无需额外的扩散步骤或延迟。通过在各种DLM任务和实验中的验证，我们的方案表现出良好的效果：与基线方法相比，其生成质量更高，同时保持了较高的检测准确性和多比特处理能力。我们的代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/iieSKLCSDsg/UMR。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VCORE: Variance-Controlled Optimization-based Reweighting for Chain-of-Thought Supervision
papers.title_zh: VCORE：基于方差控制优化的权重调整技术，适用于思维链监控场景
papers.authors: Xuan Gong, Senmiao Wang, Hanbo Huang, Ruoyu Sun, Shiyu Liang
papers.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories has emerged as a crucial technique for enhancing the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs). However, the standard cross-entropy loss treats all tokens equally, ignoring their heterogeneous contributions across a reasoning trajectory. This uniform treatment leads to misallocated supervision and weak generalization, especially in complex, long-form reasoning tasks. To address this, we introduce Variance-Controlled Optimization-based REweighting (VCORE), a principled framework that reformulates CoT supervision as a constrained optimization problem. By adopting an optimization-theoretic perspective, VCORE enables a principled and adaptive allocation of supervision across tokens, thereby aligning the training objective more closely with the goal of robust reasoning generalization. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that VCORE achieves the strongest overall average performance, with especially clear gains on lower-capacity models. Across both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, VCORE achieves substantial performance gains on mathematical and coding benchmarks, using models from the Qwen3 series (4B, 8B, 32B) and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct. Moreover, we show that VCORE serves as a more effective initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning, establishing a stronger foundation for advancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在长序列推理轨迹上进行监督微调（SFT）已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的关键技术。然而，传统的交叉熵损失函数将所有标记视为同等对象，忽略了它们在推理过程中的不同贡献。这种统一的处理方式会导致监督分配不当，从而在复杂的长序列推理任务中导致泛化能力较弱。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了基于方差控制优化的RE权重分配方法（VCORE）。该方法将序列推理的监督问题重新表述为一个约束优化问题。通过采用优化理论的角度，VCORE能够实现一种有原则且自适应的标记间监督分配，从而使训练目标更紧密地符合鲁棒推理泛化的需求。实验结果表明，VCORE在整体性能上表现最为出色，尤其是在处理低容量模型时效果尤为显著。无论是在领域内还是领域外的情况下，VCORE都在数学和编程基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升，所使用的模型包括Qwen3系列（4B、8B、32B）以及LaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct模型。此外，我们还发现，VCORE作为后续强化学习的有效初始化手段，为进一步提升LLM的推理能力奠定了坚实的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MAGNET: Towards Adaptive GUI Agents with Memory-Driven Knowledge Evolution
papers.title_zh: 磁体：迈向具有记忆驱动的知识进化的自适应图形用户界面智能体
papers.authors: Libo Sun, Jiwen Zhang, Siyuan Wang, Zhongyu Wei
papers.abstract: Mobile GUI agents powered by large foundation models enable autonomous task execution in applications, but frequent updates that alter UI appearance and reorganize workflows cause agents trained on historical data to fail. Despite these surface changes, we observe that functional semantics and task intents remain fundamentally stable. Building on this insight, we introduce MAGNET, a memory-driven adaptive agent framework with dual-level memory: stationary memory that links diverse visual features to stable functional semantics for robust action grounding and procedural memory that captures stable task intents across varying workflows. Furthermore, we propose a dynamic memory evolution mechanism that continuously refines both memories by prioritizing frequently accessed knowledge. Evaluations on the online benchmark AndroidWorld demonstrate substantial improvements over memory-augmented baselines, while offline benchmarks confirm consistent gains under distribution shifts. These results validate that leveraging stable structures across interface changes improves agent performance and generalization in evolving software environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大型基础模型驱动的移动端图形用户界面代理能够实现应用程序中的自主任务执行。然而，频繁更新的UI界面以及工作流程的重新组织会导致基于历史数据训练的代理出现性能下降的问题。尽管存在这些表面上的变化，我们仍然观察到功能的语义和任务意图在本质上保持稳定。基于这一洞察，我们提出了MAGNET——一种以记忆为驱动的自适应代理框架，它拥有两级记忆系统：静态记忆能够将各种视觉特征与稳定的功能语义联系起来，从而实现稳健的动作定位；而程序性记忆则能够捕捉在不同工作流程中保持不变的任务意图。此外，我们还提出了一种动态记忆进化机制，通过优先处理频繁访问的知识来不断优化这两种记忆。在在线基准测试AndroidWorld上的评估表明，MAGNET相比传统的记忆增强基线方案取得了显著的改进；而离线基准测试则证实了在分布变化的情况下，MAGNET仍能保持稳定的性能表现。这些结果验证了：即使在界面发生变化的情况下，利用稳定的结构也能提升代理在不断发展变化的软件环境中的性能和泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VLN-MME: Diagnosing MLLMs as Language-guided Visual Navigation Agents
papers.title_zh: VLN-MME：将MLLM识别为语言引导的视觉导航智能体
papers.authors: Xunyi Zhao, Gengze Zhou, Qi Wu
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of vision-language tasks. However, their performance as embodied agents, which requires multi-round interaction with spatial reasoning and sequential action prediction, needs further exploration. Our work investigates this potential in the context of Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) by introducing a unified and extensible simulation-free evaluation framework to probe MLLMs as zero-shot agents, named VLN-MME. Simplifying the evaluation with a highly modular and accessible design streamlines experiments, enabling structured comparisons and component-level ablations across diverse MLLM architectures, agent designs, and navigation tasks. Crucially, enabled by VLN-MME, we observe that enhancing prevalent agents with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and self-reflection leads to an unexpected performance decrease. This suggests MLLMs exhibit poor context awareness in embodied navigation tasks; although they can follow instructions and structure their output, their 3D spatial reasoning fidelity is low. Furthermore, we demonstrate that agent performance could be largely improved with simple failure cases in context learning. VLN-MME lays the groundwork for systematic evaluation of general-purpose MLLMs in embodied navigation settings and reveals limitations in their sequential decision-making capabilities. We believe these findings offer crucial guidance for MLLM post-training as embodied agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在多种视觉-语言任务中展现出了卓越的能力。然而，作为具身智能体的表现仍需进一步探索，因为这类智能体需要与空间推理和序列动作预测进行多轮交互。我们的研究通过引入一个统一且可扩展的无需模拟的评估框架，来探究多模态大语言模型作为零样本智能体的潜力，该框架被称为VLN-MME。这种高度模块化且易于使用的设计方式简化了评估过程，使得我们能够对不同架构、智能体设计和导航任务进行结构化比较以及组件级别的优化。关键的是，通过VLN-MME我们发现，在现有智能体中加入思维链推理和自我反思功能会导致意外性能下降。这表明多模态大语言模型在具身导航任务中缺乏上下文感知能力；虽然它们能够遵循指令并构建合理的输出，但其三维空间推理的准确性较低。此外，我们还发现，通过在上下文学习中引入简单的失败案例，可以显著提升智能体的性能。VLN-MME为系统评估多模态大语言模型在具身导航场景中的表现奠定了基础，同时也揭示了它们在序列决策能力方面的局限性。我们认为这些发现为多模态大语言模型在成为具身智能体后的训练提供了重要的指导方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ImplicitMemBench: Measuring Unconscious Behavioral Adaptation in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ImplicitMemBench：测量大型语言模型中的无意识行为适应现象
papers.authors: Chonghan Qin, Xiachong Feng, Weitao Ma, Xiaocheng Feng, Lingpeng Kong
papers.abstract: Existing memory benchmarks for LLM agents evaluate explicit recall of facts, yet overlook implicit memory where experience becomes automated behavior without conscious retrieval. This gap is critical: effective assistants must automatically apply learned procedures or avoid failed actions without explicit reminders. We introduce ImplicitMemBench, the first systematic benchmark evaluating implicit memory through three cognitively grounded constructs drawn from standard cognitive-science accounts of non-declarative memory: Procedural Memory (one-shot skill acquisition after interference), Priming (theme-driven bias via paired experimental/control instances), and Classical Conditioning (Conditioned Stimulus–Unconditioned Stimulus (CS–US) associations shaping first decisions). Our 300-item suite employs a unified Learning/Priming-Interfere-Test protocol with first-attempt scoring. Evaluation of 17 models reveals severe limitations: no model exceeds 66% overall, with top performers DeepSeek-R1 (65.3%), Qwen3-32B (64.1%), and GPT-5 (63.0%) far below human baselines. Analysis uncovers dramatic asymmetries (inhibition 17.6% vs. preference 75.0%) and universal bottlenecks requiring architectural innovations beyond parameter scaling. ImplicitMemBench reframes evaluation from “what agents recall” to “what they automatically enact”.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前用于评估大语言模型代理的记忆基准测试主要侧重于对具体事实的回忆能力，却忽视了隐性记忆的评估。隐性记忆指的是那些通过经验自动形成的行为，而无需经过有意识的检索。这一差距至关重要：高效的助手必须能够自动应用所学的策略，或在没有明确提示的情况下避免执行错误的动作。我们提出了ImplicitMemBench这一首个系统性基准测试，它通过三个基于认知科学理论的概念来评估隐性记忆：程序性记忆（在干扰后的一次性技能获取）、启动效应（通过配对实验/对照实例产生的主题驱动偏见）以及经典条件反射（条件刺激与无条件刺激之间的关联对首次决策的影响）。我们的测试包含300个项目，采用统一的学习/启动-干扰-测试协议，并采用首次尝试计分方式。对17个模型的评估结果显示，大多数模型的表现都相当有限：没有任何模型的综合得分超过66%，其中表现最好的几个模型分别是DeepSeek-R1（65.3%）、Qwen3-32B（64.1%）和GPT-5（63.0%），这些成绩远远低于人类水平。分析还发现一些显著的不对称性：抑制能力为17.6%，而偏好能力则达到了75.0%。此外，还存在一些普遍性的瓶颈问题，这些问题需要突破参数扩展的限制，进行架构上的创新。ImplicitMemBench将评估的重点从“代理能回忆起什么”转变为“它们能自动执行什么”。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Semantic Hardness Is Not Visual Hardness: Sign-Aware Hard Negative Mining for Sign Language Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 语义难度不等于视觉难度：基于符号感知的硬负数据挖掘在手语检索中的应用
papers.authors: Junmyeong Lee, Chan Hur, ChangSu Choi, Sukmin Cho, Fitsum Gaim, Eui Jun Hwang, Hoyun Song, KyungTae Lim
papers.abstract: Sign Language Retrieval (SLRet) enables efficient access to sign language content but remains fragile in fine-grained scenarios where visually similar signs must be distinguished. We show that this limitation does not stem from model capacity, but from ineffective hard negative supervision. Specifically, we formulate fine-grained retrieval failures as a negative distribution mismatch: semantically distinct yet visually confusable signs are rarely treated as hard negatives, while existing text-based mining strategies fail to capture such visual ambiguity. To address this issue, we propose Sign-Aware Hard Negative Mining (SAN), which constructs hard negatives based on visual confusability in the sign embedding space rather than linguistic similarity. Experiments on PHOENIX-2014T demonstrate that SAN substantially improves fine-grained retrieval performance while preserving coarse-grained accuracy, highlighting the importance of aligning negative supervision with visual ambiguity in sign language retrieval.
papers.abstract_zh: 手语检索技术能够高效获取手语内容，但在需要区分视觉上相似的手语时表现却十分不稳定。我们发现，这种局限性并非源于模型的能力不足，而是由于硬负面监督机制不够有效。具体来说，我们将细粒度检索失败问题归结为负面分布不匹配的问题：那些在语义上截然不同但视觉上容易混淆的手语，往往无法被当作硬负面进行监督，而现有的基于文本挖掘的方法也未能有效处理这种视觉上的模糊性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“注重视觉的硬负面挖掘”的方法。该方法根据手语在嵌入空间中的视觉可混淆程度来构建硬负面样本，而不是基于语言相似性来进行判断。在PHOENIX-2014T数据集上的实验表明，这种方法显著提升了细粒度检索性能，同时保持了粗粒度的准确性。这充分说明了在手语检索中，将负面监督与视觉模糊性进行对齐的重要性。

papers.title: Difference in Task Performance on Sparse Speech Representations
papers.title_zh: 在稀疏语音表示下的任务表现差异
papers.authors: Wenjie Peng, Chen Chen, Thomas Hain
papers.abstract: Learning speech representations that are useful for a variety of downstream tasks has received considerable attention, due to the outstanding properties of Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) trained models. Despite advancements in modelling methods, understanding the difference in task performance on representations is limited. Mainly motivated by the no-free-lunch theorem and speech production, this work investigates changes in task performance in sparse speech representations, providing interpretability analysis under the Information Bottleneck (IB) framework. Autoencoders with varying sparsity levels were trained using three SSL features, and evaluated on six tasks of SUPERB: Speech Enhancement (SE), Speaker Identification (SID), Speech Emotion Recognition (SER), Phone Recognition (PR), Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Slot Filling (SF). Experiments show that: 1) different tasks manifest different degrees of sensitivity to the sparsity levels; 2) the optimal sparsity level for task performance varies; 3) the choice of SSL features has a limited impact on most tasks but with an exception of PR; 4) overall PR and ASR require more preservation of relevant information about the labels, while SID and SER demand more compression of irrelevant information, where the input quality can shift this trade-off to some degree. These findings can contribute to the design of a universal sparse speech representation learner.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究对多种下游任务有用的语音表示方式受到了广泛关注，因为自监督学习训练出的模型具有出色的性能。尽管建模方法取得了进展，但人们对不同任务在表示上的表现差异仍了解有限。本文主要基于“无免费午餐定理”和语音生成理论，研究了稀疏语音表示在任务表现上的变化，并在信息瓶颈框架下进行了可解释性分析。研究人员使用三种自监督学习特征训练了具有不同稀疏度水平的自动编码器，并在SUPERB的六个任务上进行评估：语音增强、说话人识别、语音情感识别、电话识别、自动语音识别以及槽填充。实验结果表明：1）不同任务对稀疏度的敏感度程度不同；2）实现最佳任务表现所需的稀疏度水平各不相同；3）自监督学习特征的选择对大多数任务的影响有限，但电话识别这一例外情况除外；4）总体而言，电话识别和自动语音识别需要更多地保留与标签相关的信息，而说话人识别和语音情感识别则需要对无关信息进行更多压缩，同时输入质量可以在一定程度上改变这种权衡关系。这些发现有助于设计一种通用的稀疏语音表示学习器。

papers.title: VerilogLAVD: LLM-Aided Pattern Generation for Verilog CWE Detection
papers.title_zh: VerilogLAVD：基于LLM辅助的模式生成技术，用于Verilog代码中的CWE缺陷检测
papers.authors: Xiang Long, Yingjie Xia, Li Kuang, Yao Wan, ZiHao Liu
papers.abstract: LLMs often fail in hardware vulnerability detection due to the intrinsic semantic concurrency of HDLs (Hardware Description Language), where vulnerabilities arise from the interaction of multiple concurrent execution statements rather than a single sequential execution path. To address the problem, we propose VerilogLAVD, a LLM-Aided Vulnerability Detection framework by generating executable Traversal Detection Patterns (TDPs), i.e. the rules describing how to find the evidence of vulnerabilities in Verilog HDL. We first introduce a Unified Verilog Property Graph (VeriPG) that explicitly models parallel semantics by combining AST, CFG, and DDG. Furthermore, a semantic validation mechanism is designed to constrain and filter the LLM-generated TDPs. By executing these validated TDPs on VeriPG, our method produces stable and deterministic detection results. Experiments demonstrate that VerilogLAVD improves the F1 score by 133% compared to LLM-based methods. Furthermore, the framework successfully identifies real-world hardware vulnerabilities in open-source hardware design repositories.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于硬件描述语言固有的语义并发性，大语言模型在硬件漏洞检测方面常常失败。这些漏洞源于多个并发执行语句之间的相互作用，而非单一的顺序执行路径。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了VerilogLAVD这一基于大语言模型的漏洞检测框架。该框架通过生成可执行的遍历检测模式来辅助检测漏洞，即用于确定如何找到Verilog HDL中漏洞证据的规则。我们首先引入了一种统一的Verilog属性图模型，它能够通过结合抽象语法树、控制流图和数据定义图来明确模拟并行语义。此外，我们还设计了一种语义验证机制，以约束和过滤大语言模型生成的遍历检测模式。通过在VeriPG上执行这些经过验证的遍历检测模式，我们的方法能够产生稳定且确定的检测结果。实验表明，与基于大语言模型的方法相比，VerilogLAVD将F1分数提高了133%。此外，该框架还能成功识别开源硬件设计库中的真实硬件漏洞。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Temporal Sampling for Forgotten Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 用于大型语言模型遗忘推理的时间采样技术
papers.authors: Yuetai Li, Zhangchen Xu, Fengqing Jiang, Bhaskar Ramasubramanian, Luyao Niu, Bill Yuchen Lin, Xiang Yue, Radha Poovendran
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) is intended to improve their reasoning capabilities, yet we uncover a counterintuitive effect: models often forget how to solve problems they previously answered correctly during training. We term this phenomenon Temporal Forgetting and show that it is widespread across model sizes, fine-tuning methods (both Reinforcement Learning and Supervised Fine-Tuning), and multiple reasoning benchmarks. Our analysis reveals on average more than 20% of final errors were once solved correctly at an earlier checkpoint. Inspired by the phenomenon of Temporal Forgetting, we proposed Temporal Sampling, a simple decoding strategy that draws outputs from multiple checkpoints along the training trajectory. This approach recovers forgotten solutions and leads to significant improvements in reasoning performance than final-ckpt-sampling only, gains from 4 to 19 points in Pass@k and consistent gains for majority-voting and Best-of-N across several benchmarks. Temporal sampling also outperforms strong baselines such as model merging. By leveraging the temporal diversity inherent in training, Temporal Sampling offers a practical, compute-efficient way to surface hidden reasoning ability and rethink how we evaluate LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 对大语言模型进行微调的目的是提升它们的推理能力，然而我们发现了一个反直觉的现象：在训练过程中，模型往往会忘记之前正确解答过的问题。我们将这种现象称为“时间遗忘”，并发现这一现象在模型规模、微调方法（包括强化学习和监督微调）以及多种推理基准测试中普遍存在。我们的分析显示，平均有超过20%的最终错误在之前的某个检查点上是正确解答的。受“时间遗忘”现象的启发，我们提出了“时间采样”这一简单的解码策略，该策略从训练过程中的多个检查点中提取输出。这种方法能够找回被遗忘的解决方案，从而显著提升推理性能，其效果优于仅使用最终检查点采样的方法，在Pass@k指标上提升了4到19分，并且在多个基准测试中的多数投票和最佳N次投票指标上也取得了显著的进步。“时间采样”还优于一些强大的基线方法，比如模型合并。通过利用训练过程中固有的时间多样性，“时间采样”提供了一种实用且计算效率高的方式，来揭示隐藏的推理能力，并重新思考如何评估大语言模型。

papers.title: Conflict-Aware Memory for Embodied Agents: Enhancing Vector Data Quality via Detection Rules
papers.title_zh: 针对实体化代理的冲突感知记忆技术：通过检测规则提升向量数据的质量
papers.authors: Kexin Ma, Haotian Wang, Shenglin Chen, Yishuai Cai, Huangyuyu, Ruochun Jin
papers.abstract: Embodied agents have successfully leveraged large language models (LLMs) to better transform human instructions and images into executable task plans. Furthermore, memories of agents can be leveraged to achieve continual self-learning and optimization. However, vector data quality problems emerge in memories when they are projected into vector space, especially in discerning contextually similar but semantically conflicting sentences and highly similar images. This is particularly detrimental to embodied AI as it potentially distorts the robot’s actions. To address this challenge, we propose Conflict Detection Rules (CDRs) to identify and manage data quality issues in vector knowledge bases, which assist in correcting the index structure and further improving the answer quality. Experimental results show that planners with CDRs exceed the basic LLM planner by 15.25% and 14.25% in grammatical accuracy (GA) and interpretation accuracy (IA) on average, respectively. Moreover, the entire workflow has been successfully integrated into various scenarios, demonstrating its practical applicability and robustness in the real world.
papers.abstract_zh: 具身智能体成功利用了大语言模型，将人类的指令和图像更好地转化为可执行的任务计划。此外，通过利用智能体的记忆，可以实现持续的自学习和优化。然而，在将记忆数据投影到向量空间时，会出现数据质量问题，尤其是在区分上下文相似但语义冲突的句子以及高度相似的图片时。这对具身人工智能来说尤为不利，因为它可能会扭曲机器人的行为。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了冲突检测规则，用于识别和管理向量知识库中的数据质量问题，从而帮助修正索引结构，进一步提高答案的质量。实验结果表明，配备冲突检测规则的规划器在语法准确性和解释准确性方面分别比基础语言模型规划器高出15.25%和14.25%。此外，整个工作流程已成功应用于各种场景中，证明了其在实际应用中的可行性和鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Benchmarking Deflection and Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在大型视觉语言模型中对比不同的变形效果与幻觉现象
papers.authors: Nicholas Moratelli, Christopher Davis, Leonardo F. R. Ribeiro, Bill Byrne, Gonzalo Iglesias
papers.abstract: Large Vision–Language Models (LVLMs) increasingly rely on retrieval to answer knowledge-intensive multimodal questions. Existing benchmarks overlook conflicts between visual and textual evidence and the importance of generating deflections (e.g., “Sorry, I cannot answer...”) when retrieved knowledge is incomplete. These benchmarks also suffer from rapid obsolescence, as growing LVLM training sets allow models to answer many questions without retrieval. We address these gaps with three contributions. First, we propose a dynamic data curation pipeline that preserves benchmark difficulty over time by filtering for genuinely retrieval-dependent samples. Second, we introduce VLM-DeflectionBench, a benchmark of 2,775 samples spanning diverse multimodal retrieval settings, designed to probe model behaviour under conflicting or insufficient evidence. Third, we define a fine-grained evaluation protocol with four scenarios that disentangle parametric memorization from retrieval robustness. Experiments across 20 state-of-the-art LVLMs indicate that models usually fail to deflect in the presence of noisy or misleading evidence. Our results highlight the need to evaluate not only what models know, but how they behave when they do not, and serve as a reusable and extensible benchmark for reliable KB-VQA evaluation. All resources will be publicly available upon publication.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型在回答需要大量知识的多模态问题时，越来越依赖检索机制。现有的评估基准往往忽略了视觉信息与文本信息之间的冲突，以及当检索到的知识不完整时，需要给出“抱歉，我无法回答……”这样的反馈。这些基准还存在快速过时的问题，因为随着LVLM训练数据集的不断增大，模型能够无需检索即可回答许多问题。我们针对这些问题提出了三项改进措施。首先，我们提出了一种动态数据筛选流程，通过过滤掉真正依赖于检索的样本，从而保持评估基准的难度随时间保持不变。其次，我们开发了VLM-DeflectionBench这一基准测试，该测试包含2,775个样本，涵盖了多种多模态检索场景，旨在探究模型在证据冲突或不足情况下的行为表现。第三，我们定义了一个细粒度的评估协议，包含四种情景，以区分模型的参数化记忆能力与检索能力。通过对20种最先进的LVLM进行的实验表明，当面临噪声或误导性的信息时，大多数模型都无法给出合适的反馈。我们的研究结果强调了不仅要评估模型知道什么，还要评估它们在不知道的情况下如何表现，这为该领域提供了一个可复用且可扩展的评估基准，用于可靠的知识库-问答评估。所有相关资源在论文发表后都将公开提供。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: STAPO: Selective Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
papers.title_zh: STAPO：用于大型语言模型训练的选择性轨迹感知策略优化方法
papers.authors: Qiuyi Qi, Tian Liang, Mutian Bao, Jinjian Zhang, Dongnan Liu, Wei Zhou, Linjian Mo, Ming Kong, Jie Liu, Feng Zhang, Qiang Zhu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is the dominant paradigm for training Large Language Model (LLM) agents on long-horizon tasks. However, sparse and delayed rewards often lead to trajectory neglect, in which agents lose focus on the task goal and interaction history at intermediate steps. Prior work has explored step-level supervision using Shannon-entropy–based uncertainty signals, which conflate inherent state complexity with agent confidence and therefore provide unreliable estimates of decision reliability. To address this issue, we propose normalized entropy, which measures confidence deviations relative to an agent’s average behavior under a given state, thereby strengthening the association between low-quality actions and trajectory neglect. Building on this insight, we introduce Selective Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (STAPO), a hierarchical group-based RL framework. STAPO leverages normalized entropy to locate outlier steps associated with trajectory neglect and optimizes them via a joint mechanism of trajectory-aware reward and trajectory-independent penalty, enhancing trajectory awareness while preserving training stability. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-Augmented QA demonstrate that STAPO achieves state-of-the-art performance while substantially alleviating trajectory neglect, validating its effectiveness and robustness for agentic tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习是训练大语言模型代理以完成长期任务的主要方法。然而，稀疏且延迟的奖励常常导致轨迹忽略现象，即代理在中间步骤中会失去对任务目标和交互历史的关注。先前的研究尝试使用基于香农熵的不确定性信号来进行步骤级监督，但这种方法会将固有状态复杂性与代理的置信度混在一起，因此无法提供可靠的决策可靠性估计。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了标准化熵的概念，它衡量的是代理在给定状态下相对于平均行为的置信度偏差，从而加强低质量动作与轨迹忽略之间的关联。基于这一见解，我们引入了选择性轨迹感知策略优化框架——STAPO。STAPO利用标准化熵来识别与轨迹忽略相关的异常步骤，并通过结合轨迹感知奖励和轨迹独立惩罚的机制来优化这些异常步骤，从而在保持训练稳定性的同时提升轨迹感知能力。在ALFWorld、WebShop和搜索增强型问答等数据集上的广泛实验表明，STAPO在保持最佳性能的同时，显著减少了轨迹忽略现象，证明了其对于代理任务的有效性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Read As Human: Compressing Context via Parallelizable Close Reading and Skimming
papers.title_zh: 以人类的方式阅读：通过可并行化的细读和略读来压缩信息量
papers.authors: Jiwei Tang, Shilei Liu, Zhicheng Zhang, Qingsong Lv, Runsong Zhao, Tingwei Lu, Langming Liu, Haibin Chen, Yujin Yuan, Hai-Tao Zheng, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate exceptional capability across diverse tasks. However, their deployment in long-context scenarios is hindered by two challenges: computational inefficiency and redundant information. We propose RAM (Read As HuMan), a context compression framework that adopts an adaptive hybrid reading strategy, to address these challenges. Inspired by human reading behavior (i.e., close reading important content while skimming less relevant content), RAM partitions the context into segments and encodes them with the input query in parallel. High-relevance segments are fully retained (close reading), while low-relevance ones are query-guided compressed into compact summary vectors (skimming). Both explicit textual segments and implicit summary vectors are concatenated and fed into decoder to achieve both superior performance and natural language format interpretability. To refine the decision boundary between close reading and skimming, we further introduce a contrastive learning objective based on positive and negative query–segment pairs. Experiments demonstrate that RAM outperforms existing baselines on multiple question answering and summarization benchmarks across two backbones, while delivering up to a 12x end-to-end speedup on long inputs (average length 16K; maximum length 32K).
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多种任务中展现出卓越的能力。然而，它们在处理长上下文场景时面临着两个挑战：计算效率低下以及信息冗余问题。我们提出了RAM（以人类方式读取）这一上下文压缩框架，该框架采用自适应混合阅读策略来应对这些挑战。RAM借鉴了人类的阅读行为——即重点阅读重要内容，而忽略不相关的内容。它将上下文分割成多个片段，并同时与输入查询进行编码。高相关性的片段会被完整保留（重点阅读），而不太相关的片段则会被压缩成简洁的摘要向量（略读）。无论是显式的文本片段还是隐式的摘要向量，都会被合并后输入到解码器中，从而实现更好的性能以及自然语言格式的可解释性。为了更精确地区分重点阅读和略读，我们还引入了一种基于正面和负面查询-片段对对比学习的目标。实验表明，RAM在多个问答和摘要评估指标上均优于现有基线模型，并且在处理长文本时实现了高达12倍的端到端加速效果（平均长度为16K，最大长度为32K）。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: OASIS: Mitigating Harmful Fine-tuning Attacks on LLMs via Orthogonal and Adaptive Safety Alignment Strategy
papers.title_zh: OASIS：通过正交式与自适应安全对齐策略来减轻大型语言模型上的有害微调攻击
papers.authors: Jiayu Tang, Guowei Peng, Qiuhao Xie, Yuning Yang, Xiurui Xie, Guisong Liu
papers.abstract: The “Fine-Tuning-as-a-Service” paradigm exposes large language models to catastrophic safety degradation from less harmful samples. Alignment-stage defenses address this by proactively injecting adversarial perturbations to bolster the model’s inherent robustness against harmful drift. However, existing methods rely on perturbation directions that often conflict with harmful gradients, inadvertently facilitating the acquisition of malicious features rather than suppressing them. To address this issue, we propose Orthogonal and Adaptive Safety Alignment Strategy (OASIS) to mathematically decouple safety enforcement from harmful feature acquisition. By projecting perturbations orthogonal to harmful gradients and concentrating optimization on adaptively selected safety-critical layers, OASIS effectively resolves directional conflicts while maximizing parameter efficiency. Extensive experiments on four LLMs across three datasets (SST2, GSM8K, and AGNews) demonstrate that OASIS reduces the Harmful Score by approximately 60% compared to competitive baselines, while maintaining stable downstream task utility.
papers.abstract_zh: “服务式微调”范式会导致大语言模型因受到较不有害的样本而遭受严重的安全性下降。对齐阶段防御机制通过主动注入对抗性扰动来提升模型对有害变化的鲁棒性。然而，现有方法所采用的扰动方向往往与有害梯度发生冲突，这反而促进了恶意特征的获取，而非抑制它们。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了正交自适应安全对齐策略（OASIS），该策略能够数学上将安全执行与有害特征获取分离开来。通过将扰动与有害梯度正交化，并专注于自适应选择的关键安全层进行优化，OASIS能够有效解决方向冲突问题，同时最大化参数利用效率。在三个数据集（SST2、GSM8K和AGNews）上的四个大语言模型实验中表明，与竞争基准相比，OASIS能够将有害分数降低约60%，同时保持下游任务的稳定性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: KoCo-Bench: Can Large Language Models Leverage Domain Knowledge in Software Development?
papers.title_zh: KoCo-Bench：大型语言模型能否在软件开发中发挥重要作用？
papers.authors: Xue Jiang, Ge Li, Jiaru Qian, Xianjie Shi, Chenjie Li, Hao Zhu, Ziyu Wang, Jielun Zhang, Zeyu Zhao, Kechi Zhang, Jia Li, Wenpin Jiao, Zhi Jin, Yihong Dong
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at general programming but struggle with domain-specific software development. This gap motivates research into domain specialization methods that enable LLMs to learn and utilize domain knowledge and data. However, existing domain-specific code benchmarks focus on assessing what knowledge LLMs possess rather than how they acquire and apply new knowledge, lacking explicit knowledge corpora for developing domain specialization methods. To this end, we present KOCO-bench, a novel benchmark designed for evaluating domain specialization methods in real-world software development. KOCO-bench contains 6 emerging domains with 11 software frameworks and 25 projects, featuring curated knowledge corpora alongside multi-granularity evaluation tasks including domain code generation (from function-level to project-level with rigorous test suites) and domain knowledge understanding (via multiple-choice Q A). Unlike previous benchmarks that only provide test sets for direct evaluation, KOCO-bench requires acquiring and applying diverse domain knowledge (APIs, rules, constraints, etc.) from the corpora to solve evaluation tasks. Our evaluations reveal that KOCO-bench poses significant challenges to state-of-the-art LLMs. Even with domain specialization methods (e.g., SFT, RAG, kNN-LM) applied, improvements remain marginal. Best-performing coding agent, Claude Code, achieves only 34.2%, highlighting the urgent need for more effective domain specialization methods. We release KOCO-bench, evaluation code, and baselines to advance further research at https://github.com/jiangxxxue/KOCO-bench.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在通用编程方面表现出色，但在特定领域的软件开发方面却存在困难。这一差距促使人们研究能够让语言模型学习和运用领域知识及数据的专业化方法。然而，现有的特定领域代码基准测试主要集中在评估语言模型所拥有的知识，而忽略了它们如何获取和应用新知识，同时缺乏用于开发领域专业化方法的明确知识库。为此，我们提出了KOCO-bench这一新型基准测试，旨在评估现实世界软件开发中的领域专业化方法。KOCO-bench包含6个新兴领域、11种软件框架以及25个项目，其中包含了经过精心挑选的知识库，同时还提供了多粒度评估任务，包括领域代码生成（从函数级别到项目级别，并配有严格的测试套件）以及领域知识理解（通过选择题形式）。与那些仅提供直接评估测试集的先前基准测试不同，KOCO-bench要求从知识库中获取并应用多样化的领域知识（如API、规则、约束等）来解决评估任务。我们的评估结果显示，KOCO-bench对最先进的语言模型来说是一个巨大的挑战。即使采用了领域专业化方法（例如SFT、RAG、kNN-LM），改进效果仍然有限。表现最好的编码代理Claude Code仅取得了34.2%的得分，这凸显了开发更有效的领域专业化方法的紧迫性。我们将KOCO-bench的评估代码和基线文件发布在https://github.com/jiangxxxue/KOCO-bench上，以便进一步推动相关研究的发展。

papers.title: Enhancing Two Steps Textual Anomaly Detection through Anisotropy Mitigation
papers.title_zh: 通过缓解各向异性问题来提升两步文本异常检测的能力
papers.authors: Pierre Fihey, Matthieu Labeau, Pavlo Mozharovskyi
papers.abstract: Anomaly detection aims at distinguishing between in-distribution samples, which belong to the same distribution as the training set, and out-of-distribution samples, which lie outside of it. In textual anomaly detection, recent approaches routinely apply anomaly detection algorithms directly to embeddings extracted from pre-trained embedding models (two-stage approaches). However, the geometric properties of pre-trained embeddings can hinder the effectiveness of detection algorithms, which often rely on distance-based measures. In this work, we first highlight the relevance of similarity-trained models for textual anomaly detection. Beyond being trained to capture semantic similarities, these models also exhibit geometric properties that appear better suited to detection algorithms. We further demonstrate that, besides model choice, a simple post-processing step can significantly improve anomaly detection by adapting embeddings to the assumptions made by classical detection algorithms. The bulk of our experiments is done on a reformulation of the classification tasks from the MTEB benchmark into anomaly detection tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 异常检测的目的是区分属于与训练集相同分布的样本和不属于该分布的样本。在文本异常检测中，近期的方法通常直接将异常检测算法应用于从预训练嵌入模型中提取的嵌入数据（即两阶段方法）。然而，预训练嵌入的几何特性可能会妨碍检测算法的效果，因为这些算法通常依赖于基于距离的测量方法。在这项研究中，我们首先强调了基于相似性训练的模型在文本异常检测中的重要性。这些模型不仅被训练来捕捉语义上的相似性，而且其几何特性似乎更适合用于检测算法。我们进一步证明，除了模型选择之外，一个简单的后处理步骤可以通过使嵌入数据适应经典检测算法所做出的假设，从而显著改善异常检测的效果。我们的大部分实验都是将MTEB基准测试中的分类任务重新定义为异常检测任务来进行的。

papers.title: InfiniteWeb: Scalable Web Environment Synthesis for GUI Agent Training
papers.title_zh: 无限网络：适用于GUI代理训练的可扩展网络环境生成技术
papers.authors: Ziyun Zhang, Zezhou Wang, Xiaoyi Zhang, Zongyu Guo, Jiahao Li, Bin Li, Yan Lu
papers.abstract: GUI agents that interact with graphical interfaces on behalf of users are a promising direction for practical AI assistants, yet training them is hindered by scarce suitable environments. We present InfiniteWeb, a system that automatically generates functional web environments at scale for GUI agent training. While LLMs perform well on generating a single webpage, building a realistic and functional website with many interconnected pages faces challenges. We address these challenges through unified specification, task-centric test-driven development, and combining website seed variation with reference design images. Our system also generates verifiable task evaluators enabling dense reward signals for reinforcement learning. Experiments show that our system surpasses commercial coding agents at realistic website construction, and GUI agents trained on our generated environments achieve significant performance improvements on OSWorld and Online-Mind2Web, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed system.
papers.abstract_zh: 代表用户与图形界面交互的GUI智能体是实用AI助手的一个有前景的发展方向，然而，由于缺乏合适的训练环境，其训练面临着困难。我们提出了InfiniteWeb系统，它能够自动大规模生成适用于GUI智能体训练的网页环境。虽然大语言模型在生成单个网页方面表现良好，但要构建包含多个相互连接的页面的真实且功能完备的网站则面临挑战。我们通过统一的规范、以任务为中心的测试驱动开发方式，以及结合网站初始模板与参考设计图片的方法来应对这些挑战。我们的系统还能生成可验证的任务评估工具，从而为强化学习提供丰富的奖励信号。实验表明，我们的系统在现实网站的构建方面优于商业编码智能体；而在OSWorld和Online-Mind2Web任务中，通过我们生成的训练环境训练的GUI智能体取得了显著的性能提升，这证明了所提出系统的有效性。

papers.title: MagicBench: Diagnosing Visual Agency Loss and Semantic Dependency in Multimodal LLMs
papers.title_zh: MagicBench：在多模态大语言模型中诊断视觉感知丧失问题及语义依赖关系
papers.authors: Tang Da Huang, Weidong Tang, Wen Qi Xu, Xianpeng Guo
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models typically assume linguistic context invariably enhances visual understanding. We study this assumption in semantic adversarial scenarios, specifically magic tricks, where narration deliberately diverges from physical reality. We introduce MagicBench, a diagnostic benchmark of 402 videos for evaluating MLLMs under hierarchical linguistic interference, together with a Physical Constraint Set (PCS) protocol for assessing adherence to physical laws. Evaluation uncovers a Semantic Dependency Paradox: (1) Semantic anchoring: Entity nouns act as anchors aiding localization, paradoxically boosting performance despite false predicates. (2) Visual Agency Loss: In semantic vacuums, multimodal performance collapses 12.4% (p < 0.01) below the vision-only “capability probe”. This gap persists under symmetric prompting, suggesting a form of functional perception suppression in which autonomous visual search may be under-utilized in multimodal settings without linguistic triggers. Causal interventions via spatial prompting and signal magnification provide evidence that internal reasoning remains functional, supporting the interpretation of a perceptual access bottleneck. Our findings suggest MLLMs function as “language-guided passive observers”, advocating for perceptually-independent architectures that decouple sensory agency from linguistic dominance. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Ink-Dawn/MagicBench
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型通常认为语言语境必然会提升视觉理解能力。我们在语义对抗场景中研究了这一假设，具体研究的是“魔术表演”场景——在这种场景中，叙述故意与物理现实不符。我们引入了MagicBench这一诊断基准测试，该测试包含402个视频，用于评估在多模态环境下受语言干扰影响时的MLLMs表现。同时，我们还设计了物理约束集协议，以评估模型对物理定律的遵守程度。评估结果显示了几个语义上的悖论：(1)语义锚定效应：实体名词充当锚点，有助于定位目标，但这一效应反而提升了性能，尽管存在虚假的谓词描述。(2)视觉能动性丧失：在语义空白状态下，多模态性能下降12.4%（p<0.01），低于仅依赖视觉能力的“能力检测”。这种差距在对称提示条件下仍然存在，表明在多模态环境中，自主视觉搜索可能被低估了，而无需语言触发。通过空间提示和信号增强等干预措施，我们发现内部推理功能仍然有效，这支持了感知访问瓶颈的解释。我们的研究发现表明，MLLMs实际上扮演着“语言引导的被动观察者”角色，因此有必要开发一些感知独立的架构，将感官能动性与语言优势分离开来。相关代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Ink-Dawn/MagicBench获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
