papers.title: Bloom-Eval: A Hierarchical Evaluation Benchmark for Automatic Survey Generation Based on Bloom’s Taxonomy
papers.title_zh: Bloom-Eval：一种基于布鲁姆分类法的层次化评估基准，用于自动生成调查问卷
papers.authors: Fei Zhang, Zhe Zhao, HaiBin Wen, Tianshuo Wei, Zaixi Zhang, Chao Yang, Ye Wei
papers.abstract: The rapid advance of automatic survey generation (ASG) has created a critical evaluation challenge. Existing evaluation methods suffer from both cognitive dimensional simplification and methodological unreliability, primarily due to the over-reliance on the ”LLM-as-a-Judge” approach. To bridge this gap, we establish Bloom-Eval, a six-tiered benchmark based on Bloom’s Taxonomy that reliably evaluates ASG systems by prioritizing deterministic algorithms and introducing our GRADE approach for abstract abilities. Furthermore, we construct a large-scale, cross-disciplinary dataset of over 3,000 high-quality papers. Our empirical study on this benchmark reveals that while leading ASG systems are proficient format organizers, they remain unqualified knowledge integrators. This work aims to redefine ASG evaluation standards, shifting the research focus from the formal mimicry of surface structure to the cognitive deepening of intellectual content. Our method provides the ASG field with a systematic, reproducible, and theoretically grounded benchmark to guide future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动测量生成技术的快速发展带来了重要的评估挑战。现有的评估方法存在认知维度简化不足以及方法学上的不可靠性问题，这主要是由于过度依赖“用大语言模型作为评估者”的方法。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Bloom-Eval这个基于布卢姆分类法的六级评估基准。该基准能够可靠地评估自动测量生成系统，通过优先考虑确定性算法，并引入我们的GRADE方法来评估抽象能力。此外，我们还构建了一个包含3000多篇高质量论文的大规模跨学科数据集。我们对这个基准的实证研究表明，虽然领先的自动测量生成系统能够熟练地处理格式问题，但它们在知识整合方面仍然存在不足。本研究旨在重新定义自动测量生成的评估标准，将研究重点从表面结构的形式模仿转向智力内容的认知深化。我们的方法为自动测量生成领域提供了一个系统、可重复且理论基础的评估基准，有助于指导未来的研究工作。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Cultivating Forensic Reasoning for Generalizable Multimodal Manipulation Detection
papers.title_zh: 培养用于通用多模态操作检测的法理推理能力
papers.authors: Yuchen Zhang, Yaxiong Wang, Kecheng Han, Yujiao Wu, Lianwei Wu, Li Zhu, Zhedong Zheng
papers.abstract: Recent advances in generative AI have significantly enhanced the realism of multimodal media manipulation, thereby posing substantial challenges to manipulation detection. Existing manipulation detection and grounding approaches predominantly focus on manipulation type classification under result-oriented supervision, which not only lacks interpretability but also tends to overfit superficial artifacts. In this paper, we argue that generalizable detection requires incorporating explicit forensic reasoning, rather than merely classifying a limited set of manipulation types, which fails to generalize to unseen manipulation patterns. To this end, we propose REFORM, a reasoning-driven framework that shifts learning from outcome fitting to process modeling. REFORM adopts a three-stage curriculum that first induces forensic rationales, then aligns reasoning with final judgments, and finally refines logical consistency via reinforcement learning. To support this paradigm, we introduce ROM, a large-scale dataset with rich reasoning annotations. Extensive experiments show that REFORM establishes new state-of-the-art performance with superior generalization, achieving 81.52% ACC on ROM, 76.65% ACC on DGM4, and 74.9 F1 on MMFakeBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能的最新进展显著提升了多模态媒体操控的逼真度，这给操控检测带来了巨大挑战。现有的操控检测与定位方法主要侧重于在结果导向的监督下对操控类型进行分类，这种方法不仅缺乏可解释性，还容易过度拟合表面的伪像。在本文中，我们认为要实现泛化的检测效果，就需要引入明确的司法推理机制，而不仅仅是分类有限的操控类型，因为后者无法适用于未见过的操控模式。为此，我们提出了REFORM这一以推理为驱动的框架，它将学习重点从结果拟合转向了过程建模。REFORM采用三阶段课程体系：首先归纳出司法推理规则，然后使推理与最终判断保持一致，最后通过强化学习来完善逻辑一致性。为了支持这一范式，我们引入了ROM这一包含丰富推理注释的大规模数据集。大量实验表明，REFORM在泛化能力方面取得了新的突破，其在ROM数据集上的准确率为81.52%，在DGM4数据集上的准确率为76.65%，在MMFakeBench数据集上的F1值为74.9。

papers.title: Fair-CCD: Mitigating Bias in Large Language Models for Tabular Classification Through Context-Contrastive Decoding
papers.title_zh: 公平-CDCD：通过上下文对比解码技术在大型语言模型中减少表格分类中的偏见
papers.authors: Donghan Liu, Han Sun, Zhaohui Wang, Qin Li, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: While recent studies show the effectiveness of in-context learning (ICL) for tabular data prediction, they also reveal significant fairness issues in large language models (LLMs). Prior work to mitigate fairness issues often employs interventions relying on subjective demonstration selection. Its effectiveness varies significantly with the specific demonstration content, leading to low controllability. Moreover, the improvement of fairness is highly unstable across different models and tasks. To address the challenges of low controllability and limited stability in fairness interventions, we propose Fairness-Aware Context-Contrastive Decoding (Fair-CCD). Fair-CCD first constructs Structural Bias Templates (SBTs), motivated by behavioral patterns observed in demonstrations, to encode the relationship between sensitive attributes and predicted labels in a structured and controllable form. During inference, Fair-CCD injects multiple SBTs and contrasts the model’s responses, generating two differential signals that guide fairness adjustment and preserve task performance. By leveraging attention signals to scale decoding adjustments guided by the difference signals, Fair-CCD achieves stable and adaptive bias mitigation across models and tasks. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that Fair-CCD consistently improves fairness metrics without degrading task accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然最近的研究表明，上下文学习在表格数据预测方面具有有效性，但这些研究也揭示了大语言模型在公平性方面的显著问题。以往为解决公平性问题而采取的干预措施往往依赖于主观的示范选择。这种方法的有效性会随着具体的示范内容而显著变化，从而导致可控性较低。此外，不同模型和任务之间的公平性改进效果也不稳定。为了应对可控性低和公平性干预效果不稳定的问题，我们提出了一种名为“公平上下文对比解码”的方法。Fair-CCD首先根据示范中观察到的行为模式构建结构偏差模板，以结构化且可控的方式编码敏感属性与预测标签之间的关系。在推理过程中，Fair-CCD会注入多个结构偏差模板，并对模型的响应进行对比，从而产生两个差异信号，这些信号可以指导公平性调整，同时保持任务的性能。通过利用注意力信号来调整基于差异信号的解码调整，Fair-CCD能够在不同模型和任务中实现稳定且自适应的偏差缓解。大量的实验结果表明，Fair-CCD能够持续改善公平性指标，同时不会降低任务准确性。

papers.title: DVI-DTM: Dual-View Representation Learning for Interpretable Short Text Dynamic Topic Modeling
papers.title_zh: DVI-DTM：用于可解释短文本动态主题建模的双视图表示学习技术
papers.authors: Di Liu, Zheng Fang, Bin Wu
papers.abstract: Dynamic topic modeling aims to capture topic evolution from temporal text corpora. However, existing methods face two major challenges when applied to short texts: semantic ambiguity and interpretation ambiguity. Semantic ambiguity arises from the sparsity of short texts and the neglect of temporal semantic shifts. Interpretation ambiguity refers to the latent topics that lack human-understandable descriptions. In this work, we propose a novel Dual-View representation learning-based Interpretable short text Dynamic Topic Model (DVI-DTM). To address semantic ambiguity, the Dual-View Representation Learning module is presented to learn robust document-topic distributions by aligning temporal-aware term view and sentence view representations of short texts. To tackle interpretation ambiguity, we introduce a GEA Topic Refiner that leverages LLM agents to generate topic descriptions and refine document-topic distributions through collaborative semantic reasoning. Furthermore, a Dual-Factor Ranking module is designed to capture the topic evolution through semantic relevance and temporal uniqueness. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that DVI-DTM outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines in topic alignment and dynamic topic quality metrics while producing highly interpretable topic descriptions.
papers.abstract_zh: 动态主题建模旨在从时间序列文本语料库中捕捉主题的演变过程。然而，当应用于短文本时，现有方法面临两个主要挑战：语义模糊性和解释模糊性。语义模糊性源于短文本的稀疏性以及时间维度上语义变化的忽略。解释模糊性则是指那些缺乏人类可理解描述的潜在主题。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种基于双视图表示学习的可解释短文本动态主题模型（DVI-DTM）。为了解决语义模糊性问题，我们采用了双视图表示学习模块，通过对齐短文本的时间感知术语视图和句子视图表示，来学习稳健的文档-主题分布。为了应对解释模糊性问题，我们引入了GEA主题精炼器，该工具利用大语言模型代理生成主题描述，并通过协同语义推理来优化文档-主题分布。此外，我们还设计了一个双因素排序模块，用于捕捉通过语义相关性和时间独特性体现的主题演变过程。大量实验表明，DVI-DTM在主题对齐和动态主题质量指标方面优于现有的最佳基线方法，同时还能生成高度可解释的主题描述。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GenesisFunc: Multi-Agent Data Generation for Accurate and Generalizable Function-Calling
papers.title_zh: GenesisFunc：多智能体数据生成技术，实现准确且可泛化的函数调用功能
papers.authors: Hao-Xiang Xu, Chong Deng, Jiaqing Liu, Wen Wang, Qian Chen, Lujia Bao, Xiangang Li, Zhen-Hua Ling
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) extend their capabilities through function-calling (FC), which relies on training data with high quality, diversity, and broad coverage of scenario. However, obtaining and annotating real function-calling data is challenging, while synthetic data from existing pipelines often suffers from unreliable APIs, limited tool scalability, insufficient diversity, and weak quality control. To address these, we present GenesisFunc, an automated pipeline for generating FC training data. Starting from reliable tools in widely used public benchmarks, our GenesisFunc employs a multi-agent framework to support a dialogue generation system that produces conversations spanning diverse scenarios, while maintaining both diversity and quality throughout the process. The accuracy of the data is further reinforced through a multi-stage evaluation system. We fine-tune an 8B LLM on the synthetic dataset and show through extensive experiments that it outperforms similarly sized open-source models in in-domain FC performance and out-of-domain generalization, while reaching FC capabilities comparable to some of the latest API-based models. In addition, our method demonstrates strong potential to scale effectively across downstream tools, underscoring its real-world applicability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过函数调用功能来扩展其能力，这一功能依赖于训练数据具有高质量、多样性以及广泛的场景覆盖。然而，获取和标注真实的函数调用数据是一项挑战，而现有流程生成的合成数据往往存在API不可靠、工具可扩展性有限、多样性不足以及质量控制不佳等问题。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了GenesisFunc这一自动化流程，用于生成函数调用训练数据。该流程以广泛使用的公共基准测试中的可靠工具为基础，采用多智能体框架来支持对话生成系统，从而生成涵盖多种场景的对话，同时在整个过程中保持数据的多样性和质量。通过多阶段评估系统，数据的准确性得到了进一步提升。我们在合成数据集上对8B规模的LLM进行了微调，并通过大量实验证明，该模型在领域内的函数调用性能以及跨领域泛化能力方面均优于同等规模的开源模型，其函数调用能力甚至可与一些最新的基于API的模型相媲美。此外，我们的方法在有效扩展到下游工具方面也展现出强大的潜力，这进一步凸显了其在现实世界中的适用性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Selective Test-Time Debiasing for CLIP via Reward Gating
papers.title_zh: 通过奖励机制实现CLIP算法在测试时间选择方面的偏差校正
papers.authors: Jaeho Han, Jisoo Yang, Hyeondong Woo, Mingyu Jeon, Sunjae Yoon, Junyeong Kim
papers.abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) demonstrate strong zero-shot performance, but often perpetuate social stereotypes in person-centric queries, yielding skewed demographic distributions. Current debiasing methods apply uniform bias corrections across all input queries regardless of their bias sensitivity, creating a fundamental fairness–utility trade-off. Strong debiasing distorts semantically meaningful information in bias-insensitive queries, while weak debiasing fails to mitigate stereotypes in bias-sensitive ones. This one-size-fits-all approach hampers simultaneously achieving high utility on bias-insensitive queries and fairness on bias-sensitive queries. We introduce Reward-Gated Test-Time Adaptation (RG-TTA), a reinforcement learning-based test-time adaptation framework that selectively applies debiasing based on input sensitivity. RG-TTA adaptively triggers fairness regularization based on the bias sensitivity of each input during test-time policy adaptation, while focusing exclusively on optimizing cross-modal alignment for bias-insensitive inputs. Experiments on fairness benchmarks (e.g., FairFace, UTKFace) demonstrate substantial bias reduction while simultaneously improving zero-shot utility, resolving the trade-off of uniform debiasing.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在零样本任务上表现出强大的性能，但其在以个人为中心的查询中往往会延续社会刻板印象，从而导致人口分布出现偏差。当前的去偏见方法会对所有输入查询进行统一的偏见校正，而忽略了这些查询的偏见敏感性，这就造成了公平性与实用性之间的根本矛盾。强大的去偏见处理会破坏那些不受偏见影响的查询中的语义信息，而弱去偏见处理则无法有效消除受偏见影响的查询中的刻板印象。这种一刀切的方法阻碍了在不受偏见影响的查询中实现高实用性，以及在受偏见影响的查询中实现公平性的同时实现高实用性。我们提出了基于强化学习的测试时适应框架——Reward-Gated Test-Time Adaptation（RG-TTA），该框架能够根据输入的偏见敏感性选择性地应用去偏见处理。RG-TTA在测试时策略调整过程中，会根据每个输入的偏见敏感性自适应地触发公平性调节机制，同时专注于优化不受偏见影响的输入的跨模态对齐问题。在公平性基准测试（如FairFace、UTKFace）上的实验表明，该方法能够显著减少偏见，同时提高零样本任务的实用性，从而解决了统一去偏见处理所带来的权衡问题。

papers.title: CURE: Critique-Driven Unified Reinforcement Learning for Test-Time Self-Improvement
papers.title_zh: CURE：基于批判性思维的统一强化学习，以实现测试阶段的自我改进
papers.authors: Guirong Chen, Shuqi Ye, Wenkai Yang, Shiqi Shen, Guangyao Shen, Yankai Lin
papers.abstract: The evolution paradigm of Large Language Models (LLMs) is shifting from scaling training compute to scaling inference-time compute. While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a key engine for this transition, standard approaches often fail to equip models with the autonomous improvement capabilities required for test-time scaling. Existing critique-guided methods attempt to mitigate this by leveraging external feedback or ground-truth signals; however, these dependencies are unavailable at test time, fundamentally limiting the model’s capacity for continuous self-improvement. To bridge this gap, we propose CURE (Critique-driven Unified REinforcement Learning), a framework that jointly optimizes a single policy for standard solving, critiquing, and guided re-exploration. Uniquely, CURE facilitates re-exploration by generating strategic hints while discarding initial incorrect solutions to mitigate anchoring bias.Empirical results across diverse mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that CURE not only maintains competitive single-turn performance but, more importantly, unlocks effective inference-time scaling, enabling the model to significantly boost accuracy through iterative self-improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的进化范式正在从扩展训练计算资源转向扩展推理时间计算资源。虽然带有可验证奖励的强化学习已成为实现这一转变的关键手段，但传统方法往往无法为模型提供所需的自主改进能力，以使其在测试时能够进行扩展。现有的基于批评的方法试图通过利用外部反馈或真实数据信号来缓解这一问题；然而，这些依赖因素在测试时是无法获得的，这从根本上限制了模型的持续自我改进能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了CURE（基于批评的统一强化学习）框架。该框架同时优化了用于标准求解、批评以及引导式重新探索的单一策略。独特之处在于，CURE通过生成策略性提示来促进重新探索过程，同时摒弃初始的错误解决方案，从而减轻锚定偏差的影响。在多种数学推理和代码生成基准测试中的实证结果表明，CURE不仅保持了具有竞争力的单次推理性能，更重要的是，它实现了有效的推理时间扩展，使模型能够通过迭代自我改进显著提高准确性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LGSA: Label Geometry Structuring and Aligning for Hierarchical Text Classification
papers.title_zh: LGSA：用于层次化文本分类的标签几何结构设计与对齐处理
papers.authors: Shuai Zhang, Weibo Xu, Jiahao Nie, Kecheng Huang
papers.abstract: Existing hierarchical text classification (HTC) methods typically use prompt tuning or contrastive learning to inject the label hierarchy into a model as prior knowledge to implicitly learn label embeddings for classification. However, such implicit learning fails to accurately reflect label geometry (i.e., feature spatial distribution of label embeddings), as it does not model hierarchy-aware geometric relations among labels. To address this issue, we propose a novel two-stage label geometry structuring and aligning framework, termed LGSA, which transforms the label hierarchy from an implicit prior into an explicit embedding. First, we propose a hierarchical geometric structuring (HGS) module that leverages a general orthogonal frame (GOF) to reconstruct an explicit label geometry conforming to the label hierarchy. The label geometry is then treated as a label prototype to guide model training. To facilitate the guidance, we thereby propose a hierarchical geometric aligning (HGA) module as a regularization term to align label geometry learned by the model with the explicit label prototype. Experiments on three real-world HTC datasets confirm that LGSA consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. The code and models are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LGSA-1E0C.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的层次文本分类方法通常采用提示调整或对比学习的方式，将标签层次结构作为先验知识注入模型中，从而隐式地学习用于分类的标签嵌入。然而，这种隐式学习方式无法准确反映标签的几何特性（即标签嵌入的特征空间分布），因为它没有模拟出标签之间的层次化几何关系。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段标签几何结构与对齐框架，称为LGSA。该框架将标签层次结构从隐式的先验形式转化为显式的嵌入形式。首先，我们提出了一个层次几何结构模块，该模块利用通用正交框架来重建符合标签层次的显式标签几何结构。然后，将这种标签几何结构视为标签原型，以指导模型训练。为了便于这种指导作用，我们进一步提出了一种层次几何对齐模块，作为正则化项，用于将模型所学习的标签几何结构与显式的标签原型进行对齐。在三个真实世界的层次文本分类数据集上的实验表明，LGSA始终优于现有的最先进方法。相关代码和模型可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LGSA-1E0C获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FactVerse: A Benchmark for Factual Consistency in Interleaved Image–Text Generation
papers.title_zh: FactVerse：用于评估交错式图像与文本生成中事实一致性的基准框架
papers.authors: Yubo Shan, Kun Zhang, Qiming Xu, Liping Cao, Yingying Cao, Jian Zhang, Yu Wang, Jingyuan Li, Yuanzhuo Wang
papers.abstract: Interleaved multimodal understanding and generation—where models can interactively comprehend and produce images and text in arbitrary orders—has emerged as a key research direction in generative Multimodal Large Language Models(MLLMs). Such interleaved image–text content plays an increasingly important role in information dissemination. However, the compounded persuasive power of multimodal narratives also raises the risk of factual misinformation. Despite this, existing benchmarks lack effective mechanisms to evaluate factual consistency in interleaved image–text content. To bridge this gap, we introduce FactVerse, a benchmark dedicated to evaluating factual consistency in interleaved image-text generation. FactVerse comprises 3,000 human-verified instances across four categories and 50 domains, supporting both English and Chinese. We also establish a multi-dimensional evaluation framework designed to rigorously assess factual consistency. Experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves high alignment with human judgments, significantly outperforming existing evaluation methods. Furthermore, our analysis reveals systematic deficiencies in current models, offering critical insights for future design.
papers.abstract_zh: 交错式多模态理解与生成——即模型能够以任意顺序交互地理解和生成图像与文本——已成为生成式多模态大语言模型的关键研究方向。这种交错式的图像与文本内容在信息传播中发挥着越来越重要的作用。然而，多模态叙事所具有的复合性说服力也带来了虚假信息的风险。尽管如此，现有的评估基准缺乏有效机制来评判交错式图像与文本内容中的事实一致性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了FactVerse这一评估基准，专门用于评判交错式图像与文本生成中的事实一致性。FactVerse包含3,000个经过人工验证的实例，涵盖四个类别和50个领域，支持英语和中文两种语言。我们还建立了一个多维度的评估框架，以严格评估事实一致性。实验表明，我们的框架与人类判断高度一致，其性能明显优于现有的评估方法。此外，我们的分析揭示了当前模型存在的系统性缺陷，为未来的设计提供了重要启示。

papers.title: GMSA: Enhancing Context Compression via Group Merging and Layer Semantic Alignment
papers.title_zh: GMSA：通过分组合并和层语义对齐来提升上下文压缩效果
papers.authors: Jiwei Tang, Zhicheng Zhang, Shunlong Wu, Jingheng Ye, Lichen Bai, Zitai Wang, Tingwei Lu, Lin Hai, Yiming Zhao, Hai-Tao Zheng, Hong-Gee Kim
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. However, in long-context scenarios, they face two challenges: high computational cost and information redundancy. To address these challenges, we propose GMSA, an encoder-decoder context compression framework that generates a compact sequence of soft tokens for downstream tasks. GMSA introduces Group Merging to achieve more uniform aggregation, mitigating semantic dominance during autoencoder pretraining, and Layer Semantic Alignment (LSA) to bridge the semantic gap between high-level abstract semantics and low-level input semantics. We first pretrain GMSA as an autoencoder and then fine-tune it for downstream tasks. Experiments demonstrate that GMSA improves context reconstruction compared to existing soft prompt compression paradigm and outperforms baselines on multiple long-context question answering and summarization benchmarks across two backbone models, while maintaining low end-to-end latency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在众多自然语言处理任务中取得了显著的性能表现。然而，在长上下文场景中，它们面临着两个挑战：高计算成本和信息冗余问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了GMSA这一编码器-解码器上下文压缩框架。该框架能够生成紧凑的软标记序列，以用于下游任务。GMSA通过“组合并”技术实现更均匀的聚合过程，从而减轻自动编码器训练过程中的语义主导性问题；同时，通过“层语义对齐”技术来弥合高级抽象语义与低级输入语义之间的差距。我们首先将GMSA作为自动编码器进行预训练，然后再对其进行微调以适应下游任务的需求。实验结果表明，与现有的软提示压缩方法相比，GMSA在上下文重建方面表现更为出色。在两种骨干模型的多个长上下文问答和摘要任务基准测试中，GMSA的表现均优于现有基线方法，同时还能保持较低的整体延迟水平。

papers.title: SpidR-Adapt: A Universal Speech Representation Model for Few-Shot Adaptation
papers.title_zh: SpidR-Adapt：一种适用于少量样本迁移训练的通用语音表示模型
papers.authors: Mahi Luthra, Jiayi Shen, Maxime Poli, Angelo Ortiz Tandazo, Yosuke Higuchi, Youssef Benchekroun, Martin Gleize, Charles-Eric Saint-James, Dongyan Lin, Phillip Rust, Angel Villar, Surya Parimi, Vanessa Stark, Rashel Moritz, Juan Pino, Yann LeCun, Emmanuel Dupoux
papers.abstract: Human infants, with only a few hundred hours of speech exposure, acquire basic units of new languages, highlighting a striking efficiency gap compared to the data-hungry self-supervised speech models. To address this gap, this paper introduces SpidR-Adapt for rapid adaptation of speech units to new languages using minimal unlabeled data. We cast such low-resource speech representation learning as a meta-learning problem and construct a multi-task adaptive pre-training (MAdaPT) protocol which formulates the adaptation process as a bi-level optimization framework. To enable scalable meta-training under this framework, we propose a novel heuristic solution, first-order bi-level optimization (FOBLO), avoiding heavy computation costs. Finally, we stabilize meta-training by using a robust initialization through interleaved supervision which alternates self-supervised and supervised objectives. Empirically, SpidR-Adapt achieves rapid gains in phonemic discriminability (ABX) and downstream spoken language modeling scores (sWUGGY, sBLIMP, tSC), surpassing in-domain toplines after training on less than 1h of target-language audio and delivering 100\times greater data efficiency than standard multi-task training.. These findings highlight a practical, architecture-agnostic path toward biologically inspired, data-efficient representations. We open-source the training code and model checkpoints at https://github.com/facebookresearch/spidr-adapt.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类婴儿在仅有几百小时的语言接触后就能掌握新语言的基本语音单位，这与那些需要大量数据的自监督语音模型相比，显示出显著的效率差距。为了弥补这一差距，本文提出了SpidR-Adapt算法，该算法能够利用最少的未标记数据快速适应新语言的语音单位。我们将这种低资源下的语音表示学习问题视为一个元学习问题，并构建了一种多任务自适应预训练协议（MAdaPT），将适应过程构建为一个双层优化框架。为了实现在该框架下可扩展的元训练，我们提出了一种新颖的启发式解决方案——一阶双层优化（FOBLO），从而避免了高昂的计算成本。最后，我们通过交替使用自监督和监督目标的方法，来稳定元训练过程。实验表明，SpidR-Adapt在音素区分能力（ABX）以及下游口语建模得分（sWUGGY、sBLIMP、tSC）方面取得了显著成效，即使在目标语言音频仅经过不到1小时的训练后，其性能仍优于现有方法，并且其数据使用效率是标准多任务训练的100倍。这些发现为构建具有生物学启发性的、高效的数据利用率的表示方式提供了实用的、与架构无关的方法。我们将训练代码和模型检查点开源在https://github.com/facebookresearch/spidr-adapt上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EIFFEL: a novel benchmark to measure bias of English heavy training on French idiomatic expressions
papers.title_zh: 埃菲尔指标：用于衡量以英语为主的教学方式对法语习语表达影响的新型衡量标准
papers.authors: Charlotte Noel, Nicholas Asher, Olivier Gouvert, Farah Benamara, Julie Hunter
papers.abstract: Mainstream multilingual LLMs are generally trained on a much higher proportion of English than multilingual data, raising questions about their ability to capture linguistic features particular to non-English languages or to capture information important to non-anglophone cultures. We add to a growing effort to increase multilingual sensitivity in LLMs by developing a benchmark, EIFFEL, testing mastery of French idiomatic expressions in context. We fully explain the methodology, which exploits input from native French speakers, to make it reproducible for other languages. We compare mainstream multilingual LLMs with French-focused LLMs both on standard LLM benchmarks and EIFFEL; EIFFEL brings out the benefits of higher proportions of French data and shows limitations of standard benchmarks for measuring multilingual competence.
papers.abstract_zh: 主流的多语言大语言模型通常在训练数据中，英语所占的比例远高于其他语言。这引发了关于这些模型是否能够捕捉到非英语语言的独特语言特征，或者是否能够理解对非英语文化至关重要的信息的疑问。为了提升大语言模型在多语言方面的能力，我们正在努力开发一个新的基准测试——EIFFEL，以评估模型在上下文中的法语习语表达掌握情况。我们详细阐述了这一方法，该方法利用了法语母语者的输入数据，使得该方法可以适用于其他语言。我们在标准的大语言模型基准测试以及EIFFEL测试中，对比了主流多语言大语言模型与专注于法语的大语言模型的表现。结果表明，使用更多法语数据的EIFFEL测试更能体现出模型的多语言能力，而传统的基准测试则存在局限性，无法准确衡量模型的多语言水平。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Latent Attention Denoising: A Training-Free Energy-Based Framework for Mitigating Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 潜在注意力去噪：一种无需训练的基于能量的框架，用于减轻视觉语言模型中的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Zhiwen Luo, Siyu Jiang, Weilong Jiang, Kun He
papers.abstract: Visual hallucination remains a major obstacle to the reliability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). We argue that this issue originates from a fundamental statistical misspecification: the conventional softmax attention implicitly assumes i.i.d. noise, yet real LVLM attention patterns exhibit structured and competitive biases (e.g., attention sinks) that violate this assumption. To address this mismatch, we introduce Latent Attention Denoising (LAD), a principled and training-free framework that recasts attention calibration as a one-step score-based denoising process. LAD employs an interpretable energy function to derive an analytic score and applies a single Langevin-inspired update to actively steer corrupted attention logits toward more faithful configurations. This intervention imposes negligible computational overhead and operates at a speed comparable to standard greedy decoding. Extensive evaluations across diverse architectures confirm that LAD achieves superior performance on both generative and discriminative tasks, effectively mitigating hallucinations while maintaining efficiency comparable to standard decoding.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉幻觉仍然是大型语言模型可靠性面临的主要障碍。我们认为，这一问题源于一个根本性的统计错误假设：传统的softmax注意力机制隐含地假设了独立同分布噪声，而真实的LVLM注意力模式却表现出有结构且相互竞争的偏见（例如，注意力汇聚点），这违反了这一假设。为了解决这种不匹配问题，我们提出了潜注意去噪技术（Latent Attention Denoising，LAD）。这是一种原理明确、无需训练的框架，它将注意力校准过程转化为一种基于单步得分的去噪过程。LAD采用一种可解释的能量函数来推导解析得分，并应用一种受Langevin方法启发的更新策略，以主动引导受损的注意力权重向更可靠的配置方向进行修正。这种干预方式几乎不会增加计算开销，其运行速度与标准贪婪解码算法相当。在多种架构上的广泛测试表明，LAD在生成任务和判别任务上都能取得更好的性能，能够有效减少幻觉现象，同时保持与标准解码算法相当的效率。

papers.title: From Knowing to Teaching: Scaffolding Pedagogical Decisions for LLM Agent
papers.title_zh: 从“了解”到“教学”：为大型语言模型智能体制定教学策略的辅助方案
papers.authors: Yucheng Wang, Shen Yang, Jifan Yu, Haoxuan Li, Joy Jia Yin Lim, Daniel Zhang-Li, Huiqin Liu, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li, Bin Xu
papers.abstract: Knowing and teaching differ fundamentally: effective instruction requires transforming knowledge into forms learners can grasp. Large language models, when asked to generate lessons (a concrete form of teaching), produce content lacking pedagogical depth. We trace this failure to three decisions that expert teachers make: selecting content by recognizing each source’s instructional role, sequencing topics so foundations precede applications, and synthesizing components into a unified whole. To scaffold these decisions, we introduce TeachCraft, a framework with three agents: Explorer classifies sources by pedagogical intent to guide selection; Planner orders objectives from foundational to advanced; Generator produces lesson materials through a schema that ensures consistency across components. To evaluate this approach, we construct LessonBench, 40 expert-designed lessons paired with two to five heterogeneous source documents, on which TeachCraft achieves 67.8% win rate in human evaluation and 79.6% in LLM-based evaluation against eight baselines, with ablations confirming that each decision contributes independently to overall lesson quality.[Source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TeachCraft-1672]
papers.abstract_zh: 了解与传授之间存在根本差异：有效的教学需要将知识转化为学习者能够理解的形式。当要求大语言模型生成课程内容时（即具体的教学形式），所产生的内容往往缺乏教学深度。我们认为这种失败源于专家教师在三个方面的决策失误：通过识别各来源的教学作用来选择内容；按照基础优先于应用的原则来安排主题顺序；将各个组成部分整合为一个统一的整体。为了辅助这些决策，我们提出了TeachCraft这一框架，该框架包含三个组件：Explorer负责根据教学目的对来源进行分类以指导内容选择；Planner负责按从基础到高级的顺序安排学习目标；Generator则通过一种确保各组成部分一致性的模式来生成课程材料。为了评估这一方法的有效性，我们构建了LessonBench——由40个专家设计的课程与两到五个不同来源的材料相结合而成的课程体系。在人工评估中，TeachCraft的准确率达到了67.8%；而在基于大语言模型的评估中，其准确率达到了79.6%。与八种基准模型相比，这些结果表明每个决策都对课程的整体质量有独立的影响。[源代码可访问：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TeachCraft-1672]

papers.title: Learn Like Humans: Use Meta-cognitive Reflection for Efficient Self-Improvement
papers.title_zh: 像人类一样学习：利用元认知反思来实现高效的自我提升
papers.authors: Xinmeng Hou, Bohao Qu, Wuqi Wang, Peiliang Gong, Qing Guo, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) enable complex autonomous behavior, current agents remain constrained by static, human-designed prompts that limit adaptability. Existing self-improving frameworks attempt to bridge this gap but typically rely on inefficient, multi-turn recursive loops that incur high computational costs. To address this, we propose Metacognitive Agent with Reflective Self-improvement (MARS), a framework that achieves efficient self-evolution within a single recurrence cycle. Inspired by educational psychology, MARS mimics human learning by integrating principle-based reflection (abstracting normative rules to avoid errors) and procedural reflection (deriving step-by-step strategies for success). By synthesizing these insights into optimized instructions, MARS allows agents to systematically refine their reasoning logic without continuous online feedback. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that MARS outperforms state-of-the-art self-evolving systems while significantly reducing computational overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/Paparare/MARS/tree/main
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型能够实现复杂的自主行为，但当前的智能体仍然受到人类设计的静态提示的限制，这限制了它们的适应能力。现有的自我改进框架试图弥补这一缺陷，但它们通常依赖于效率低下、需要多次迭代的递归流程，这会带来较高的计算成本。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了具有反思性自我改进的元认知智能体（MARS）框架。该框架能够在单次迭代周期内实现高效的自我进化。受教育心理学的启发，MARS通过结合基于原则的反思（抽象出规范规则以避免错误）和程序性反思（逐步制定成功策略）来模拟人类的学习过程。通过将这些经验整合到优化的指令中，MARS使智能体能够系统地完善其推理逻辑，而无需持续的在线反馈。在六个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，MARS在性能上优于最先进的自进化系统，同时显著降低了计算开销。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/Paparare/MARS/tree/main

papers.title: Think Faster Than Words: Efficient LLM Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Dynamic Shortcut Decoding
papers.title_zh: 比语言更快速思考：通过动态快捷方式解码实现高效的大语言模型思维链推理
papers.authors: Fan Liu, Yanhao Wang, Min Zhang, Zhikang Chen, Zeyuan Li, Lewei He, Jiahui Pan
papers.abstract: This paper proposes shortcut decoding, an efficient framework for accelerating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). Existing methods that prune or employ early stopping to reduce latency often compromise reasoning reliability. Motivated by the observation that LLMs frequently converge to correct solutions internally before completing explicit textual reasoning, we propose a dual-signal adaptive controller that integrates lightweight probes over internal hidden states with step-level entropy. This controller detects convergence of reasoning during generation and adaptively selects between a fast-exit path and a stability-verified path to remove redundant steps while preserving answer correctness. Experiments across multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that shortcut decoding reduces token usage by approximately 35%, maintains accuracy comparable to full CoT decoding, and achieves final-answer accuracy comparable to the full CoT baseline, outperforming existing early-stopping methods without updating the base model. Our code is available at https://github.com/kuromi9527/shortcut_decoding.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种名为“快捷解码”的高效框架，旨在加速大语言模型中的思维链推理过程。现有的方法通常通过剪枝或提前停止来降低延迟，但这些方法往往会牺牲推理的可靠性。鉴于大语言模型在完成明确的文本推理之前，往往已经内部收敛到正确的解决方案，我们提出了一种双信号自适应控制器。该控制器利用具有步级熵值的轻量级探针，对内部隐藏状态进行探测。这种控制器能够在生成过程中检测推理的收敛情况，并自适应地选择快速退出路径或稳定性验证路径，从而消除冗余步骤，同时保持答案的准确性。在多个数学推理基准测试中的实验表明，快捷解码可以将令牌使用量减少约35%，同时保持与完整思维链解码相当的准确率，最终答案的准确率也与完整思维链基线相当。与那些无需更新基础模型的现有提前停止方法相比，我们的方法表现更为出色。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/kuromi9527/shortcut_decoding下载。

papers.title: AEA: Adaptive Expert Allocation Improves Sentence Embeddings from Mixture-of-Experts LLM
papers.title_zh: AEA：自适应专家分配技术能够提升基于混合专家语言模型生成的句子嵌入质量
papers.authors: Shufan Yang, Zifeng Cheng, Zhiwei Jiang, Qingfeng Qi, Yafeng Yin, Cong Wang, Ao Zhou, Qing Gu
papers.abstract: Extracting embeddings directly from Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models is a promising yet underexplored direction that requires no additional data or fine-tuning. While previous studies have utilized semantic compression prompts or expert routing information to improve sentence embeddings, they typically allocate a fixed number of experts uniformly across all layers and tokens, ignoring inter-layer and inter-token heterogeneity. In this work, we identify two key observations in MoE models: (1) layer-wise variations in expert homogeneity, suggesting that different layers require different expert budgets, and (2) token-wise contribution imbalance, indicating that different tokens should also be allocated different numbers of experts. To address these issues, we propose an Adaptive Expert Allocation (AEA) framework that dynamically performs both layer-wise and token-wise expert allocation to enhance embedding quality. Specifically, AEA allocates fewer experts to layers with higher homogeneity and to tokens with lower attention importance, where layer-wise homogeneity is determined by the similarity among embeddings produced by the experts in each layer. Notably, our method is plug-and-play, seamlessly integrates with existing prompt engineering methods, and introduces no additional time overhead. Experiments on the STS tasks demonstrate that AEA consistently improves embedding quality across multiple MoE models.
papers.abstract_zh: 直接从混合专家模型中提取嵌入是一种有前景但尚未被充分探索的方向，这种方法不需要额外的数据或微调。虽然之前的研究已经利用语义压缩提示或专家路由信息来改进句子嵌入，但这些研究通常会在所有层和标记中均匀分配固定数量的专家，而忽略了层间和标记间的异质性。在这项研究中，我们发现了混合专家模型中的两个关键现象：(1) 不同层之间的专家同质性存在差异，这意味着不同层需要不同的专家预算；(2) 不同标记之间的贡献不平衡，表明不同标记也应该被分配不同数量的专家。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了自适应专家分配框架，该框架能够动态地进行层和标记级别的专家分配，以提高嵌入质量。具体来说，自适应专家分配会向同质性较高的层以及关注度较低的标记分配较少的专家，其中层的同质性是通过每层专家产生的嵌入之间的相似性来确定的。值得注意的是，我们的方法可以即插即用，能够无缝地与现有的提示工程方法集成，并且不会增加额外的处理时间。在STS任务上的实验表明，自适应专家分配能够持续提高多种混合专家模型的嵌入质量。

papers.title: It’s High Time: A Survey of Temporal Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 是时候行动了：关于时间相关问答系统的研究
papers.authors: Bhawna Piryani, Abdelrahman Abdallah, Jamshid Mozafari, Avishek Anand, Adam Jatowt
papers.abstract: Time plays a critical role in how information is generated, retrieved, and interpreted. In this survey, we provide a comprehensive overview of Temporal Question Answering (TQA), a research area that focuses on answering questions involving temporal constraints or context. As time-stamped content from sources like news articles, web archives, and knowledge bases continues to grow, TQA systems must address challenges such as detecting temporal intent, normalizing time expressions, ordering events, and reasoning over evolving or ambiguous facts. We organize existing work through a unified perspective that captures the interaction between corpus temporality, question temporality, and model capabilities, enabling a systematic comparison of datasets, tasks, and approaches. We review recent advances in TQA enabled by neural architectures, especially transformer-based models and Large Language Models (LLMs), highlighting progress in temporal language modeling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and temporal reasoning. We also discuss benchmark datasets and evaluation strategies designed to test temporal robustness, recency awareness, and generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间在信息的生成、检索和解释过程中起着至关重要的作用。在本综述中，我们全面介绍了时间问答技术这一研究领域，该领域专注于回答涉及时间限制或上下文的问题。随着来自新闻文章、网络档案和知识库等来源的时间标记内容不断增加，时间问答系统必须应对诸如检测时间意图、规范时间表达、排序事件以及处理不断演变或模糊的事实等挑战。我们通过一个统一的视角来组织现有的研究成果，从而捕捉到语料库的时间性、问题的时间性以及模型能力之间的相互作用，进而能够系统地比较不同的数据集、任务和方法。我们回顾了由神经架构推动的时间问答技术的近期进展，特别是基于变换器模型和大语言模型的发展，强调了在时间语言建模、检索增强生成以及时间推理方面的成果。此外，我们还讨论了用于测试时间鲁棒性、最新性感知以及泛化能力的基准数据集和评估策略。

papers.title: SDAR-VL: Stable and Efficient Block-wise Diffusion for Vision-Language Understanding
papers.title_zh: SDAR-VL：稳定且高效的块级扩散技术，适用于视觉与语言理解领域
papers.authors: Shuang Cheng, Yuhua Jiang, Zineng Zhou, Dawei Liu, Tao Wang, Linfeng Zhang, Biqing Qi, Bowen Zhou
papers.abstract: Block-wise discrete diffusion offers an attractive balance between parallel generation and causal dependency modeling, making it a promising backbone for vision-language modeling. However, its practical adoption has been limited by high training cost, slow convergence, and instability, which have so far kept it behind strong autoregressive (AR) baselines. We present SDAR-VL, the first systematic application of block-wise discrete diffusion to large-scale vision-language understanding (VLU), together with an integrated framework for efficient and stable training. This framework unifies three components: 1) Asynchronous Block-wise Noise Scheduling to diversify supervision within each batch; 2) Effective Mask Ratio Scaling for unbiased loss normalization under stochastic masking; and 3) a Progressive Beta Noise Curriculum that increases effective mask coverage while preserving corruption diversity. Experiments on 21 single-image, multi-image, and video benchmarks show that SDAR-VL consistently improves training efficiency, convergence stability, and task performance over conventional block diffusion. On this evaluation suite, SDAR-VL sets a new state of the art among diffusion-based vision-language models and, under matched settings, matches or surpasses strong AR baselines such as LLaVA-OneVision as well as the global diffusion baseline LLaDA-V, establishing block-wise diffusion as a practical backbone for VLU.
papers.abstract_zh: 块状离散扩散在并行生成与因果依赖建模之间提供了理想的平衡，使其成为视觉-语言建模领域的一个有前景的框架。然而，其实际应用受到了高昂的训练成本、缓慢的收敛速度以及不稳定性等因素的限制，这些因素一直使得它的表现落后于基于自回归模型的基线方法。我们提出了SDAR-VL，这是将块状离散扩散技术应用于大规模视觉-语言理解领域的首个系统性尝试，同时我们还构建了一个高效且稳定的训练框架。该框架整合了三个关键组件：1）异步块状噪声调度机制，以在每批训练中引入多样化的监督信息；2）有效的掩码比例调整策略，从而在随机掩蔽条件下实现无偏的损失归一化；3）渐进式贝塔噪声训练计划，该计划能够在保持数据多样性的情况下增加有效掩码覆盖率。在21个单图像、多图像和视频基准测试上的实验表明，SDAR-VL在训练效率、收敛稳定性和任务性能方面均优于传统的块状扩散方法。在这一评估体系中，SDAR-VL在基于扩散的视觉-语言模型中达到了新的水平，并且在与之相当的基准测试中，其表现甚至超过了诸如LLaVA-OneVision这样的强自回归模型，以及全球领先的扩散模型LLaDA-V。这表明块状扩散技术已成为视觉-语言理解的实用性框架。

papers.title: N-GLARE: An Non-Generative Latent Representation-Efficient LLM Safety Evaluator
papers.title_zh: N-GLARE：一种非生成式、基于潜在表示的LLM安全评估工具
papers.authors: Zheyu Lin, Jirui Yang, Yukui Qiu, Yubing Bao, Hengqi Guo, Yao Guan
papers.abstract: Evaluating the safety robustness of LLMs is critical for their deployment. However, mainstream Red Teaming methods rely on online generation and black-box output analysis. These approaches are not only costly but also suffer from feedback latency, making them unsuitable for agile diagnostics after training a new model.To address this, we propose N-GLARE (A Non-Generative, Latent Representation-Efficient LLM Safety Evaluator). N-GLARE operates entirely on the model’s latent representations, bypassing the need for full text generation. It characterizes hidden layer dynamics by analyzing the APT (Angular-Probabilistic Trajectory) of latent representations and introducing the JSS (Jensen-Shannon Separability) metric.Experiments on over 40 models and 20 red teaming strategies demonstrate that the JSS metric exhibits high consistency with Red Teaming safety rankings at less than 1% token and runtime cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型的安全性对于其部署至关重要。然而，主流的红队攻击方法依赖于在线生成和黑盒输出分析。这些方法不仅成本高昂，还存在反馈延迟的问题，因此不适合在模型训练完成后进行快速诊断。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了N-GLARE（一种非生成式、高效利用潜在表示的大语言模型安全评估工具）。N-GLARE完全基于模型的潜在表示进行操作，无需进行全文本生成。它通过分析潜在表示的角概率轨迹来表征隐藏层的动态变化，并引入了JSS（詹森-香农可分性度量）指标。对40多个模型和20种红队攻击策略进行的实验表明，JSS指标与红队攻击安全性排名的一致性非常高，且无论是在令牌数量还是运行时间上，成本都低于1%。

papers.title: Don’t Act Blindly: Robust GUI Automation via Action-Effect Verification and Self-Correction
papers.title_zh: 不要盲目行动：通过动作-效果验证和自我修正实现稳健的GUI自动化
papers.authors: Yuzhe Zhang, Xianwei Xue, Xingyong Wu, Mengke Chen, Chen Liu, Xinran He, Run Shao, Feiran Liu, Huanmin Xu, Qiutong Pan, Haiwei Wang
papers.abstract: Autonomous GUI agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) often assume deterministic environment responses, generating actions without verifying whether previous operations succeeded. In real-world settings with network latency, rendering delays, and system interruptions, this assumption leads to undetected action failures, repetitive ineffective behaviors, and catastrophic error accumulation. Moreover, learning robust recovery strategies is challenging due to the high cost of online interaction and the lack of real-time feedback in offline datasets.We propose VeriGUI (Verification-driven GUI Agent), which explicitly models action outcomes and recovery under noisy environments. VeriGUI introduces a Thinking–Verification–Action–Expectation (TVAE) framework to detect failures and guide corrective reasoning, and a two-stage training pipeline that combines Robust SFT with synthetic failure trajectories and GRPO with asymmetric verification rewards. We further construct a Robustness Benchmark based on AndroidControl to evaluate failure recognition and correction. Experiments show that VeriGUI significantly reduces failure loops and improves recovery success while maintaining competitive standard task performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于视觉-语言模型的自主GUI代理通常假设环境响应是确定性的，在无需验证先前操作是否成功的情况下就执行动作。但在存在网络延迟、渲染延迟和系统中断的现实环境中，这种假设会导致未被发现的动作失败、重复无效的行为以及灾难性错误的累积。此外，由于在线交互的成本很高，且离线数据集中缺乏实时反馈，因此学习可靠的恢复策略非常困难。我们提出了VeriGUI（以验证驱动的GUI代理），它能够明确模拟在噪声环境下的动作结果和恢复过程。VeriGUI引入了思考-验证-动作-期望框架来检测故障并指导纠正性推理，同时采用两阶段训练流程，结合鲁棒序列强化学习算法与合成故障轨迹，以及基于不对称验证奖励的GRPO方法。我们还基于AndroidControl构建了一个鲁棒性基准测试，用于评估故障识别与纠正的能力。实验表明，VeriGUI显著减少了故障循环，提高了恢复成功率，同时保持了具有竞争力的标准任务性能。

papers.title: Beyond Static Persona Consistency: Dynamic Persona Coherence in LLM Role-Playing
papers.title_zh: 超越静态角色一致性：在大型语言模型角色扮演中的动态角色连贯性
papers.authors: Yirui QI, Xiaoming Zhang, Ruilin Zeng, Mengyao Liu, Ziyi Zhou, Dezhuang Miao, Bingyu Yan, Zhenyu Guan
papers.abstract: Current LLM role-playing systems model persona as a monolithic, static attribute, conflating identity consistency with emotional rigidity. This leads to either robotic repetition or catastrophic persona drift under sustained interaction. We introduce Dynamic Persona Coherence, a framework that decouples Identity-Layer Stability (time-invariant traits) from Adaptive-Layer Appropriateness (history-dependent psychological evolution). We operationalize this through the L/M/S Psychological State Model, which represents persona dynamics across long-term identity, mid-term meaning/stress accumulation, and short-term affect. On top of this state representation, a closed-loop alignment system comprising an automated evaluator (Persona Consistency Critic, PCC), a selective repository (Persona Case Repository, PCR), and a trajectory-adjusting corrector (Persona Drift Suppressor, PDS) enables autonomous coherence repair. Experiments on GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and DeepSeek-V3.2 demonstrate consistent improvements (+16–84% PCC gains).
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的LLM角色扮演系统将角色模型视为一个单一的、静态的属性，这导致身份一致性与情绪僵化被混淆在一起。这种设定会导致在持续互动过程中出现要么机械式的重复行为，要么角色形象严重漂移的情况。我们提出了“动态角色一致性”框架，该框架将身份层的稳定性（时间不变的特质）与适应性层的相关性（历史依赖的心理演变）分离开来。我们通过L/M/S心理状态模型来实现这一机制，该模型能够反映角色在长期身份认同、中期意义/压力积累以及短期情感变化方面的动态变化。在此基础上，还有一个闭环对齐系统，包括一个自动评估器（角色一致性评判器）、一个选择性存储库（角色案例存储库）以及一个调整轨迹的修正器（角色漂移抑制器），这些组件共同实现了自主的角色一致性修复功能。在GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet和DeepSeek-V3.2上的实验表明，采用该框架后，角色一致性得到了显著提升，平均提升了16%到84%的性能。

papers.title: What If Consensus Lies? Selective-Complementary Reinforcement Learning at Test Time
papers.title_zh: 如果共识是虚假的呢？在测试阶段采用选择性互补强化学习策略吧
papers.authors: Dong Yan, Jian Liang, Yanbo Wang, Shuo Lu, Ran He, Tieniu Tan
papers.abstract: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (TTRL) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance reasoning capabilities on unlabeled test streams by deriving pseudo-rewards from majority voting consensus.However, existing TTRL methods rely exclusively on positive pseudo-labeling strategies.Such reliance becomes vulnerable under challenging scenarios where answer distributions are highly dispersed, resulting in weak consensus that inadvertently reinforces incorrect trajectories as supervision signals.In this paper, we propose SCRL (Selective-Complementary Reinforcement Learning), a robust test-time reinforcement learning framework that effectively mitigates label noise amplification.SCRL develops Selective Positive Pseudo-Labeling, which enforces strict consensus criteria to filter unreliable majorities. Complementarily, SCRL introduces Entropy-Gated Negative Pseudo-Labeling, the first negative supervision mechanism in TTRL, to reliably prune incorrect trajectories based on generation uncertainty. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SCRL achieves substantial improvements over baselines, while maintaining robust generalization and training stability under constrained rollout budgets.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时间强化学习（TTRL）使得大语言模型能够在未标注的测试数据上提升推理能力，其原理是通过从多数投票共识中推导出伪奖励来实现这一目标。然而，现有的TTRL方法完全依赖于积极的伪标签策略。在答案分布高度分散的复杂情况下，这种依赖方式会变得脆弱，导致共识效果较弱，从而无意中强化了错误的轨迹作为监督信号。在本文中，我们提出了SCRL——一种强大的测试时间强化学习框架，它能够有效减轻标签噪声的放大效应。SCRL采用了选择性积极伪标签策略，通过严格的共识标准来过滤不可靠的多数意见；同时，SCRL还引入了熵门控负伪标签机制，这是TTRL领域中的首个负监督机制，它能够基于生成的不确定性来可靠地剔除错误的轨迹。在数学推理基准测试上的广泛实验表明，SCRL在保持稳健的泛化能力和训练稳定性的同时，取得了比基线方法显著的改进。

papers.title: Exploring and Distilling Multi-Dimensional Clues for Interpretable Social Bot Detection
papers.title_zh: 探索并整理各种多维线索，以实现可解释的社会机器人检测
papers.authors: Yi Han, Haiqi Lu, Lizi Liao, Shuhan Zhou, Yuanxing Liu, Weinan Zhang, Ting Liu
papers.abstract: Social bot accounts have long been disseminating disinformation and engaging in malicious activities on social media platforms. Detecting these social bots has become a critical and urgent task, essential for maintaining a healthy online ecosystem. Existing social bot detection research usually provides detection results directly without corresponding supportive explanations, making it difficult to assess the extent to which such predictions are trustworthy. This is a key concern for online moderation. In this work, we explore the detection interpretation and summarize a four-dimensional clue framework from individual and social perspectives. We propose CDRBot, which primarily employs outcome-reward reinforcement learning to train inspectors to generate faithful, grounded, and readable clues from the User Information, Semantic Features, Interactive Situation, and Behavioral Pattern. These clues are then integrated to make final predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms other baselines in detection performance. The generated clues are faithful, grounded, and readable, and can significantly enhance the performance of large language models in social bot detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交机器人账户长期以来一直在社交媒体平台上传播虚假信息并从事恶意活动。检测这些社交机器人已成为一项至关重要且紧迫的任务，对于维护健康的在线生态系统来说非常重要。现有的社交机器人检测研究通常直接提供检测结果，而不提供相应的解释说明，这使得难以评估这些预测的可信度。这是在线管理中的一个关键问题。在这项研究中，我们探讨了检测与解释的方法，并从个体和社会两个角度总结了一个四维线索框架。我们提出了CDRBot算法，该算法主要利用结果奖励强化学习来训练检测器，使其能够从用户信息、语义特征、互动情况以及行为模式中提取出真实、有依据且易于理解的线索。然后将这些线索整合起来以做出最终预测。实验结果表明，我们的方法在检测性能上优于其他基线方法。所生成的线索真实、有依据且易于理解，能够显著提升大语言模型在社交机器人检测中的性能。

papers.title: Why Are We Moral? An LLM-based Agent Simulation Approach to the Study of Moral Evolution
papers.title_zh: 我们为何具有道德性？一种基于大语言模型的智能体模拟方法，用于研究道德演化
papers.authors: Zhou Ziheng, Huacong Tang, Mingjie Bi, Wanying He, Fang Sun, Yizhou Sun, Ying Nian Wu, Demetri Terzopoulos, Yipeng Kang, Fangwei Zhong
papers.abstract: The evolution of morality presents a puzzle: natural selection should favor self-interest, yet humans developed moral systems promoting altruism. Traditional approaches must abstract away cognitive processes, leaving open how cognitive factors shape moral evolution. We introduce an LLM-based agent simulation framework that brings cognitive realism to this question: agents with varying moral dispositions perceive, remember, reason, and decide in a simulated prehistoric hunter-gatherer society. This enables us to manipulate factors that traditional models cannot represent—such as moral type observability and communication bandwidth—and to discover emergent cognitive mechanisms from agent interactions. Across 20 runs spanning four settings, we find that cooperation and mutual help are the central driver of evolutionary survival, with universal and reciprocal morality exhibiting the most stable outcomes across conditions while selfishness is strongly disfavoured. Beyond cooperation itself, we further identify cognition as a central mediator—most clearly through a cost of moral judgment that shifts the winning moral type across settings, with a self-purging effect among selfish agents as an additional cognitive pattern. We validate robustness across multiple LLM backbones, architecture ablations, and prompt sensitivity analyses. This work establishes LLM-based simulation as a powerful new paradigm to complement traditional research in evolutionary biology and anthropology, opening new avenues for investigating the complexities of moral and social evolution.
papers.abstract_zh: 道德的演变是一个谜题：自然选择本应倾向于自我利益，但人类却发展出了促进利他主义的道德体系。传统的研究方法往往忽略认知过程的影响，无法揭示认知因素如何塑造道德演化。我们引入了一种基于大语言模型的代理模拟框架，为这一问题提供了认知上的真实感：具有不同道德倾向的代理在模拟的史前狩猎采集社会中进行感知、记忆、推理和决策。这使我们能够操控传统模型无法体现的因素，例如道德类型的可观察性和沟通带宽，并从代理互动中发现出新的认知机制。在四个不同环境下的20次模拟中，我们发现合作与互助是推动进化生存的核心动力，而普遍且互惠的道德观念在不同环境下表现出最稳定的结果，而自私行为则受到强烈抑制。除了合作之外，我们还发现认知是一种重要的中介因素——最明显的是道德判断的成本影响了不同环境下的获胜道德类型，而自私的代理还会产生自我净化效应，这是一种额外的认知现象。我们在多个大语言模型基础、架构简化以及提示敏感性分析的基础上验证了该框架的稳健性。这项工作确立了基于大语言模型的模拟方法，作为补充传统进化生物学和人类学研究的新范式，为探究道德和社会演化的复杂性开辟了新的途径。

papers.title: Systematicity between Forms and Meanings across Languages Supports Efficient Communication
papers.title_zh: 不同语言中的形式与含义之间的系统性特征，有助于高效沟通
papers.authors: Doreen Osmelak, Yang Xu, Michael Hahn, Kate McCurdy
papers.abstract: Languages vary widely in how meanings map to word forms. These mappings have been found to support efficient communication; however, this theory does not account for systematic relations within word forms. We examine how a restricted set of grammatical meanings (e.g. person, number) are expressed on verbs and pronouns across typologically diverse languages. Consistent with prior work, we find that verb and pronoun forms are shaped by competing communicative pressures for simplicity (minimizing the inventory of grammatical distinctions) and accuracy (enabling recovery of intended meanings). Crucially, our proposed model uses a novel measure of complexity (inverse of simplicity) based on the learnability of meaning-to-form mappings. This innovation captures fine-grained regularities in linguistic form, allowing better discrimination between attested and unattested systems, and establishes a new connection from efficient communication theory to systematicity in natural language.
papers.abstract_zh: 不同语言在意义与词形之间的映射方式存在很大差异。这些映射方式被认为有助于高效的沟通；然而，这一理论并未解释词形内部的系统性关系。我们研究了在多种类型语言中，一些有限的语法意义（如人称、数）是如何在动词和代词上表现出来的。与先前的研究一致，我们发现动词和代词的形式受到两种相互竞争的沟通需求的驱动：一是追求简洁性（尽量减少语法差异的数量），二是追求准确性（能够准确传达意图的含义）。关键的是，我们的模型采用了一种新颖的复杂性衡量标准——基于意义到形式映射的可学习性。这一创新捕捉了语言形式的细微规律，使得我们能够更好地区分已知系统和未知系统，并为高效沟通理论与自然语言的系统性特征之间建立了新的联系。

papers.title: On the (In-)Security of the Shuffling Defense in the Transformer Secure Inference
papers.title_zh: Transformer 安全推理中洗牌防御机制的安全性分析
papers.authors: Zhengyi Li, Yakai Wang, Jingwen Leng, Kang Yang, Yu Yu, Jiaping Gui, Yu Feng, Ning Liu, Minyi Guo
papers.abstract: For Transformer models, cryptographically secure inference ensures that the client learns only the final output, while the server learns nothing about the client’s input. However, securely computing nonlinear layers remains a major efficiency bottleneck due to the substantial communication rounds and data transmission required. To address this issue, prior works reveal intermediate activations to the client, allowing nonlinear operations to be computed in plaintext. Although this approach significantly improves efficiency, exposing activations enables adversaries to extract model weights. To mitigate this risk, existing works employ a shuffling defense that reveals only randomly permuted activations to the client. In this work, we show that the shuffling defense is not as robust as previously claimed. We propose an attack that aligns differently shuffled activations to a common permutation and subsequently exploits them to extract model weights. Experiments on Pythia-70m and GPT-2 demonstrate that the proposed attack can align shuffled activations with mean squared errors ranging from 10^{-9} to 10^{-6}. With a query cost of approximately $1, the adversary can recover model weights with L1-norm differences ranging from 10^{-4} to 10^{-2} compared to the oracle weights.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于Transformer模型而言，加密安全的推理机制可以确保客户端只能获取最终的输出结果，而服务器则无法得知客户端的输入信息。然而，由于需要大量的通信轮次和数据传输，安全计算非线性层仍然是一个严重的效率瓶颈。为了解决这个问题，一些现有的方法会向客户端发送中间激活值，从而允许以明文形式进行非线性运算。虽然这种方法显著提高了效率，但暴露激活值会使对手能够提取出模型权重。为了降低这种风险，现有方法采用了一种“洗牌防御”策略，即仅向客户端发送随机排列后的激活值。然而，我们的研究表明，这种洗牌防御并不像之前认为的那样有效。我们提出了一种攻击方法，该方法可以将不同顺序的洗牌激活值进行对齐，并利用这些激活值来提取模型权重。在Pythia-70m和GPT-2上的实验表明，所提出的攻击能够以均方误差为10^-9到10^-6的范围内对齐洗牌激活值。在大约1美元的查询成本下，对手可以恢复出模型权重，其L1范数的差异范围在10^-4到10^-2之间，相比直接查询预言机得到的权重来说，这种恢复效果更为理想。

papers.title: LaCo: Layer-wise Compensation for Pruned Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: LaCo：针对剪枝后的大型语言模型的逐层补偿方法
papers.authors: Yingen Liu, Fan Wu, Panxuyan, Ruihui Li, Zhuo Tang, Kenli Li
papers.abstract: Pruning is essential for the efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs); however, it causes severe performance degradation due to the structural distortion induced by sparsity.Existing recovery strategies, such as LoRA, predominantly employ global fine-tuning, often overlooking the mechanistic root of this degradation: the layer-wise accumulation and amplification of local errors. To address this limitation, we propose LaCo(Layer-wise Compensation), a framework that reorients the recovery paradigm from global adaptation to hierarchical representation alignment.By sequentially optimizing each layer to reconstruct the model’s hidden states, LaCo effectively intercept the error propagation chain at its source.Extensive experiments demonstrate that LaCo surpasses parameter-efficient baselines in both perplexity reduction and zero-shot reasoning.Notably, it reduces recovery-time memory usage to approximately 1/7 of the baseline and requires only 2,048 unlabeled samples to match a LoRA model trained on 50k examples—achieving a \sim25\times improvement in data efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 修剪对于大语言模型的高效部署至关重要；然而，由于稀疏性导致的结构扭曲，修剪会引发严重的性能下降。现有的恢复策略，如LoRA，主要采用全局微调方式，往往忽略了这种性能下降的根本原因：局部误差在逐层累积和放大。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了LaCo（逐层补偿）框架，该框架将恢复策略从全局适应转变为分层表示对齐。通过依次优化每一层来重建模型的隐藏状态，LaCo能够有效地在源头截获误差传播链。大量实验表明，LaCo在降低困惑度以及实现零样本推理能力方面均优于参数效率高的基线方法。值得注意的是，LaCo将恢复过程中的内存使用量降低到基线的约1/7，并且只需要2,048个未标记样本就能与在50k个样本上训练的LoRA模型相媲美——这使得数据利用效率提升了约25倍。

papers.title: QiMeng-PRepair: Precise Code Repair via Edit-Aware Reward Optimization
papers.title_zh: QiMeng-PRepair：通过编辑感知式奖励优化实现精确的代码修复
papers.authors: Changxin Ke, Rui Zhang, Jiaming Guo, Yuanbo Wen, Li Ding, Shuo Wang, Xuyuan Zhu, Xiong Peng, Di Huang, Zidong Du, Xing Hu, Qi Guo, Yunji Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong program repair performance but often suffer from over-editing, where excessive modifications overwrite correct code and hinder bug localization. We systematically quantify its impact and introduce precise repair task, which maximizes reuse of correct code while fixing only buggy parts. Building on this insight, we propose PRepair, a framework that mitigates over-editing and improves repair accuracy. PRepair has two components: Self-Breaking, which generates diverse buggy programs via controlled bug injection and min–max sampling, and Self-Repairing, which trains models with Edit-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (EA-GRPO) using an edit-aware reward to encourage minimal yet correct edits. Experiments show that PRepair improves repair precision by up to 31.4% under \mathrm{fix}_1@1, a metric that jointly considers repair correctness and extent, and significantly increases decoding throughput when combined with speculative editing, demonstrating its potential for precise and practical code repair.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在程序修复方面表现出强大的能力，但往往会出现过度编辑的问题。过度编辑会导致代码被大量修改，从而破坏代码的完整性，进而阻碍错误的定位。我们系统地量化了这种问题的影响，并提出了一种精确的修复任务，该任务能够在修复错误部分的同时，最大化正确代码的再利用价值。基于这一洞察，我们提出了PRepair框架，该框架能够减少过度编辑现象，并提高修复精度。PRepair包含两个部分：自我破坏机制，通过可控的错误注入和最小-最大采样来生成多样化的错误程序；自我修复机制，通过使用考虑编辑因素的奖励策略，训练模型进行最小且正确的编辑操作。实验表明，在考虑修复精度和范围的综合指标\mathrm{fix}_1@1的情况下，PRepair能够将修复精度提高达31.4%。此外，当与推测性编辑结合使用时，PRepair还能显著提高解码效率，显示出其在精确且实用的代码修复方面的巨大潜力。

papers.title: Location Not Found: Exposing Implicit Local and Global Biases in Multilingual LLMs
papers.title_zh: 未找到该位置：在多语言大语言模型中暴露出隐式的局部偏见和全局偏见
papers.authors: Guy Mor-Lan, Omer Goldman, Matan Eyal, Adi Mayrav Gilady, Sivan Eiger, Idan Szpektor, Avinatan Hassidim, Yossi Matias, Reut Tsarfaty
papers.abstract: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) have minimized the fluency gap between languages. This advancement, however, exposes models to the risk of biased behavior, as knowledge and norms may propagate across languages. In this work we aim to quantify models’ inter- and intra-lingual biases, via their ability to answer locale-ambiguous questions. To this end, we present LocQA, a test set containing 2,156 questions in 12 languages, referring to various locale-dependent facts such as laws, dates, and measurements. The questions do not contain indications of the locales they relate to, other than the querying language itself. LLMs’ responses to LocQA locale-ambiguous questions thus reveal models’ implicit priors. We used LocQA to evaluate 32 models, and detected two types of structural biases. Inter-lingually, we show a global bias towards answers relevant to the US-locale, even when models are asked in languages other than English. Moreover, we discovered that this global bias is exacerbated in models that underwent instruction tuning, compared to their base counterparts. Intra-lingually, we show that when multiple locales are relevant for the same language, models act as demographic probability engines, prioritizing locales with larger populations. Taken together, insights from LocQA may help in shaping LLMs’ desired local behavior, and in quantifying the impact of various training phases on different kinds of biases.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言大语言模型（LLM）已经缩小了不同语言之间的流畅性差距。然而，这一进展也带来了模型产生偏见的风险，因为知识和规范可能会在不同语言之间传播。在这项研究中，我们旨在通过模型回答具有地域歧义的问题来量化模型在语言间的偏见以及语言内部的偏见。为此，我们提出了LocQA测试集，该测试集包含12种语言的2,156个问题，这些问题涉及各种与地域相关的信息，如法律、日期和度量单位等。这些问题的表述方式并不明确表明它们所涉及的地域，只有提问所使用的语言本身能够揭示相关信息。因此，LLM对LocQA中那些具有地域歧义的问题的回答，实际上揭示了模型的隐性先验知识。我们使用LocQA评估了32个模型，并发现了两种类型的结构性偏见。从语言间来看，即使模型被问到的是非英语的语言，模型仍然倾向于给出与美国地域相关的答案。此外，我们发现，经过指令调整的模型比未经调整的模型更容易出现这种全局性偏见。从语言内部来看，当同一语言涉及多个地域时，模型会像人口统计概率引擎一样，优先选择人口较多的地域作为答案。总的来说，LocQA提供的洞察有助于塑造LLM期望的地域行为，并量化不同训练阶段对各种类型偏见的影响。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Incorporating Temporal Coherence to Cross-Document Event Coreference Resolution
papers.title_zh: 将时间上的一致性因素纳入跨文档事件共指解析中
papers.authors: Xinyu Chen, Peifeng Li, Qiaoming Zhu
papers.abstract: Previous work on cross-document event coreference resolution (CDECR) primarily focused on enhancing semantic coherence between event mentions, largely overlooking the critical aspect of temporal coherence. To address this issue, we propose CohTP, a novel Temporal Cohorence-driven event coreference framework. CohTP explicitly models and enforces temporal constraints by first constructing a temporal event graph via a fine-tuned natural language inference (NLI) model. The graph is then refined using an Edge-Aware GNN to resolve conflicts and partitioned into ordered time segments, where undirected edges group contemporaneous events. Event coreference resolution is subsequently performed within these temporally coherent segments, where event representations are further augmented with temporally consistent contexts. Experiments on the ECB+, GVC, WEC, and ECB+META datasets show that CohTP outperforms several state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 之前关于跨文档事件共指消解的研究主要集中在提升事件提及之间的语义一致性上，而忽略了时间一致性的关键问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CohTP这一基于时间一致性的新型事件共指框架。CohTP通过首先利用经过微调的自然语言推理模型构建时间事件图，从而明确建模并强制执行时间约束。之后，该图通过边缘感知的GNN进行细化处理，以解决冲突并将事件划分为有序的时间段。在这些时间上一致的时间段内，对事件进行共指消解，同时利用时间上一致的上下文来进一步丰富事件表示。在ECB+、GVC、WEC以及ECB+META数据集上的实验表明，CohTP在性能上优于多个现有的先进基线算法。

papers.title: LLMs in Sarcasm Detection? It’s elementary! (Or is it?)
papers.title_zh: 那些用于识别讽刺语言的大型语言模型？这简直是再简单不过的事情了！（或者其实并不如此吗？）
papers.authors: Priyanshu Mahato, Aniket Santosh Mishra, Kripabandhu Ghosh
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are frequently cited for their sophisticated pragmatic reasoning (CITATION), recent progress in sarcasm detection increasingly relies on synthetic benchmarks (CITATION). This study exposes a catastrophic generalization gap in this paradigm: we observe that models achieve near-perfect accuracy on synthetic data but collapse to random guessing on organic human speech. By triangulating hidden state geometry, entropy analysis, and causal interventions, we demonstrate that this disparity stems from shortcut learning (CITATION)—models exploit the low-entropy statistical signatures of generated text while remaining “semantically blind” to the pragmatic cues essential for irony. Our findings indicate that high performance on synthetic leaderboards reflects forensic pattern matching rather than the genuine linguistic intelligence assumed in prior work, creating a statistical mirage of competence.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型因其复杂的实用推理能力而备受推崇，但最近在讽刺检测方面的进展越来越多地依赖于合成基准数据。本研究揭示了这种方法的致命缺陷：模型在合成数据上能够达到近乎完美的准确率，但在处理真实人类语音时却变得毫无头绪。通过结合隐藏状态几何结构、熵分析以及因果干预手段，我们发现这种差异源于模型的捷径学习行为——模型利用了生成文本的低熵统计特征，但却对实现讽刺所需的实用线索完全视而不见。我们的研究结果表明，在合成数据集上的高性能实际上反映了一种统计上的虚假能力，而非之前工作中所假设的真正的语言智能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Itinerary Planning—A Real-World Benchmark for Multi-Turn and Tool-Using Travel Tasks
papers.title_zh: 除了行程规划之外——适用于多轮次、需要使用多种工具的旅行任务的真实案例参考
papers.authors: Xiang Cheng, Yulan Hu, Xiangwen Zhang, Lu Xu, Lide Tan, Zheng Pan, Xin Li, Yong Liu
papers.abstract: Travel planning is a natural real-world task to test large language models’ (LLMs) planning and tool-use abilities. Although prior work has studied LLM performance on travel planning, existing settings still differ from real-world needs, mainly due to limited domain coverage, insufficient modeling of users’ implicit preferences in multi-turn conversations, and a lack of evaluation of agents’ capability boundaries. To mitigate these gaps, we propose \mbox{\textbf{TravelBench}}, a benchmark for \textit{truly real-world} travel planning. We collect user queries, user preferences, and tools from real scenarios, and construct three subtasks—\textit{Single-Turn}, \textit{Multi-Turn}, and \textit{Unsolvable}—to evaluate agents’ three core capabilities in real settings: (1) solving problems independently, (2) interacting with users to elicit implicit preferences, and (3) recognizing the capability boundaries. To enable stable tool invocation and reproducible evaluation, we cache real tool-call results and build a sandbox environment which integrates ten travel-related tools, enabling agents to combine these tools to solve most practical travel planning problems. We evaluate multiple LLMs on TravelBench and find that even advanced models exhibit imbalanced performance across different capabilities. Our further systematic verification demonstrates the stability of the proposed benchmark. TravelBench provides a practical and reproducible benchmark to advance research on LLM agents for real-world travel planning.
papers.abstract_zh: 旅行规划是一项需要测试大语言模型（LLM）的规划和工具使用能力的实际任务。虽然之前的研究已经探讨了LLM在旅行规划方面的表现，但现有的研究环境与现实需求仍存在差距，主要原因在于领域覆盖有限、未能充分建模用户在多轮对话中的隐性偏好，以及缺乏对代理能力边界的评估。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了“TravelBench”这一用于真实世界旅行规划的基准测试平台。我们从真实场景中收集用户查询、用户偏好以及相关工具，并设计了三个子任务——单轮对话、多轮对话和无法解决的任务——来评估代理在真实环境中的三种核心能力：独立解决问题、与用户互动以获取隐性偏好，以及识别自己的能力边界。为了确保工具调用的稳定性和评估的可重复性，我们对真实的工具调用结果进行了缓存，并构建了一个集成了十种旅行相关工具的沙箱环境，使代理能够结合这些工具来解决大多数实际的旅行规划问题。我们在TravelBench上对多个LLM进行了评估，发现即使是先进的模型在不同能力上的表现也存在不平衡现象。我们的进一步系统验证表明所提出的基准测试是稳定可靠的。TravelBench提供了一个实用且可重复使用的基准测试平台，有助于推动关于LLM代理在真实世界旅行规划领域的研究进展。

papers.title: TLoRA: Task-aware Low Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: TLoRA：针对大型语言模型进行的任务感知低秩自适应处理
papers.authors: Weicheng Lin, Yi Zhang, Jiawei Dang, Liang-Jie Zhang
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a widely adopted parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models, with its effectiveness largely influenced by the allocation of ranks and scaling factors, as well as initialization. Existing LoRA variants typically address only one of these factors, often at the cost of increased training complexity or reduced practical efficiency.In this work, we present Task-aware Low-Rank Adaptation (TLoRA), a unified framework that jointly optimizes initialization and resource allocation at the outset of training. TLoRA introduces a data-driven initialization strategy that aligns the LoRA A matrix with task-relevant subspaces by performing singular value decomposition on the product of pre-trained weights and input activation covariance. After this, the A matrix is frozen, and only the B matrix is trained. Furthermore, TLoRA employs a sensitivity-based importance metric to adaptively allocate ranks and scaling factors across layers under a fixed parameter budget.We conduct extensive experiments that demonstrate TLoRA consistently performs excellently across various tasks, including natural language understanding, commonsense reasoning, math reasoning, code generation, and chat generation, while significantly reducing the number of trainable parameters. Our code are available at https://github.com/Rambo-Yi/TLora/tree/main
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）已成为一种被广泛采用的参数高效微调方法，用于大语言模型。其效果在很大程度上取决于秩的分配、缩放因子的选择以及初始化方式。现有的LoRA变体通常只解决其中一个问题，而这往往会导致训练复杂度增加或实际效率降低。在本研究中，我们提出了任务感知低秩适应（TLoRA），这是一个统一的框架，能够在训练初期同时优化初始化和资源分配问题。TLoRA采用了一种基于数据的初始化策略，通过对预训练权重和输入激活协方差的乘积进行奇异值分解，使LoRA的A矩阵与任务相关的子空间对齐。之后，A矩阵被固定下来，只有B矩阵继续进行训练。此外，TLoRA还采用了基于敏感性的重要性度量标准，在固定的参数预算下自适应地分配各层的秩和缩放因子。我们通过大量实验验证了TLoRA在不同任务上的表现非常出色，包括自然语言理解、常识推理、数学推理、代码生成和聊天生成等任务。同时，TLoRA显著减少了解算参数的数量。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Rambo-Yi/TLora/tree/main下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MARS-RA: Rank Aggregation for Credit Assignment via Multimodal Comparisons in Embodied Multi-Agent Cooperation
papers.title_zh: MARS-RA：通过多模态比较实现信用分配中的排名聚合，在实体化多智能体合作场景中应用
papers.authors: Dawei Wang, Di Zhao, Xinyuan Liu, Marci Chi Ma, Xiaoyang Liu, Chengming Zhou, Gary Ushaw, Richard Davison
papers.abstract: Credit assignment is a fundamental challenge in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, particularly in embodied AI settings characterized by limited and delayed feedback as well as dynamically changing numbers of active agents. We propose MARS-RA, a framework that reformulates credit assignment as a rank aggregation problem using contribution-based pairwise comparisons among agents generated by large multimodal models. This shift from absolute to relative estimation ensures robustness against noise and dynamic agent participation, converting comparison results into contribution scores for potential-based reward shaping. We provide theoretical justification for the convergence and robustness of the proposed framework, and show that Shapley values can be used as an interpretive reference. Experimental results on challenging tasks of different types indicate that MARS-RA can guide agents toward effective cooperation.
papers.abstract_zh: 在协作式多智能体强化学习中，信用分配是一个基本挑战，尤其是在具有有限且延迟反馈以及活跃智能体数量动态变化的具身人工智能场景中。我们提出了MARS-RA框架，该框架通过将信用分配问题转化为基于贡献的成对比较问题来解决，这些比较是由大型多模态模型生成的智能体之间的比较。这种从绝对估计到相对估计的转变，使得系统能够抵抗噪声干扰和智能体的动态变化，并将比较结果转化为用于基于贡献的奖励定制的分数。我们为所提出框架的收敛性和鲁棒性提供了理论依据，并表明Shapley值可以作为解释性的参考。在不同类型挑战性任务上的实验结果表明，MARS-RA能够引导智能体实现有效的合作。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Persona-E²: A Human-Grounded Dataset for Personality-Shaped Emotional Responses to Textual Events
papers.title_zh: 人格-E²：一个基于人类的数据库，用于研究人们对文本事件产生的情感反应与人格特征的关系
papers.authors: Yuqin Yang, Haowu Zhou, Haoran Tu, Zhiwen Hui, Shiqi Yan, HaoYang Li, Dong She, Xianrong Yao, Yang Gao, Zhanpeng Jin
papers.abstract: Most affective computing research treats emotion as a static property of text, focusing on the writer’s sentiment while overlooking the reader’s perspective. This approach ignores how individual personalities lead to diverse emotional appraisals of the same event. Although role-playing Large Language Models (LLMs) attempt to simulate such nuanced reactions, they often suffer from "personality illusion”—relying on surface-level stereotypes rather than authentic cognitive logic. A critical bottleneck is the absence of ground-truth human data to link personality traits to emotional shifts. To bridge the gap, we introduce Persona-E² (Persona-Event2Emotion), a large-scale dataset grounded in annotated MBTI and Big Five traits to capture reader-based emotional variations across news, social media, and life narratives. Extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art LLMs struggle to capture precise appraisal shifts, particularly in social media domains. Crucially, we find that personality information significantly improves comprehension, with the Big Five traits alleviating "personality illusion.’
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数情感计算研究都将情绪视为文本的静态属性，只关注作者的情感表达，而忽视了读者的视角。这种研究方法忽略了个体性格如何导致对同一事件的不同情感评价。尽管一些大语言模型通过角色扮演来模拟这种细微的情感反应，但它们往往存在“人格错觉”问题——它们依赖于表面的刻板印象，而非真实的认知逻辑。一个关键的瓶颈是缺乏真实的人类数据来将人格特征与情感变化联系起来。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了Persona-E²（Persona-Event2Emotion）这个大规模数据集，该数据集基于标注的MBTI和Big Five人格特质，能够捕捉新闻、社交媒体以及生活叙事中读者的情感差异。大量实验表明，最先进的大语言模型在捕捉精确的情感变化方面存在困难，尤其是在社交媒体领域。重要的是，我们发现人格信息显著提升了理解能力，而Big Five人格特质则有助于减少“人格错觉”。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Interleaved Latent Visual Reasoning with Selective Perceptual Modeling
papers.title_zh: 交错式潜在视觉推理与选择性感知建模
papers.authors: Shuai Dong, Siyuan Wang, Xingyu Liu, Chenglin Li, Haowen Hou, Zhongyu Wei
papers.abstract: Interleaved reasoning paradigms enhance Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with visual feedback but are hindered by the prohibitive computational cost of re-encoding pixel-dense images. A promising alternative, latent visual reasoning, circumvents this bottleneck yet faces limitations: methods either fail to capture intermediate state evolution due to single-step, non-interleaved structures, or sacrifice precise perceptual modeling by over-compressing features. We introduce Interleaved Latent Visual Reasoning (ILVR), a framework that unifies dynamic state evolution with precise perceptual modeling. ILVR interleaves textual generation with latent visual representations that act as specific, evolving cues for subsequent reasoning. Specifically, we employ a self-supervision strategy where a momentum teacher model selectively distills relevant features from ground-truth intermediate images into sparse supervision targets. This adaptive selection mechanism guides the model to autonomously generate context-aware visual signals. Extensive experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ILVR outperforms existing approaches, effectively bridging the gap between fine-grained perception and sequential multimodal reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 交错推理范式通过视觉反馈增强了多模态大语言模型的能力，但受到重新编码像素密集图像所带来的高昂计算成本的限制。一种有前景的替代方案是潜在视觉推理，它克服了这一瓶颈，但也存在局限性：由于采用单步、非交错的结构，该方法无法捕捉中间状态的演变过程；同时，过度压缩特征会导致精确感知建模能力的丧失。我们提出了交错潜在视觉推理框架，该框架将动态状态演变与精确感知建模相结合。在交错潜在视觉推理中，文本生成与潜在视觉表示相互交织，后者作为后续推理的特定线索。具体来说，我们采用了一种自监督策略，其中动量教师模型会选择性地从真实的中间图像中提取相关特征，并将其转化为稀疏的监督目标。这种自适应选择机制有助于模型自主生成具有上下文意识的视觉信号。在多个多模态推理基准测试中的广泛实验表明，交错潜在视觉推理方法优于现有方法，有效弥补了精细感知与序列多模态推理之间的差距。

papers.title: Think before Go: Hierarchical Reasoning for Image-goal Navigation
papers.title_zh: 在Go游戏之前先思考一下：用于图像与目标导航的层次化推理方法
papers.authors: Pengna Li, Kangyi Wu, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Lin Zhao, Long Chen, Zhi-Xin Yang, Nanning Zheng
papers.abstract: Image-goal navigation steers an agent to a target location specified by an image in unseen environments. Existing methods primarily handle this task by learning an end-to-end navigation policy, which compares the similarities of target and observation images and directly predicts the actions. However, when the target is distant or lies in another room, such methods fail to extract informative visual cues, leading the agent to wander around. Motivated by the human cognitive principle that deliberate, high-level reasoning guides fast, reactive execution in complex tasks, we propose Hierarchical Reasoning Navigation (HRNav), a framework that decomposes image-goal navigation into high-level planning and low-level execution. In high-level planning, a vision-language model is trained on a self-collected dataset to generate a short-horizon plan, such as whether the agent should walk through the door or down the hallway. This downgrades the difficulty of the long-horizon task, making it more amenable to the execution part. In low-level execution, an online reinforcement learning policy is utilized to decide actions conditioned on the short-horizon plan. We also devise a novel Wandering Suppression Penalty (WSP) to further reduce the wandering problem. Together, these components form a hierarchical framew ork for Image-Goal Navigation. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate the superiority of our method.
papers.abstract_zh: 图像目标导航能够将智能体引导到由图像指定的目标位置，这种导航方式适用于未知环境。现有方法主要通过学习端到端的导航策略来处理这一任务，该策略通过比较目标图像与观测图像之间的相似性，直接预测相应的动作。然而，当目标位置较远或位于另一个房间时，这些方法无法提取有用的视觉线索，导致智能体四处游荡。基于人类认知原理——在复杂任务中，经过深思熟虑的高级推理能够指导快速且反应式的执行——我们提出了分层推理导航框架。该框架将图像目标导航分解为高级规划和低级执行两个环节。在高级规划阶段，通过训练视觉语言模型来生成短期规划，例如智能体应该穿过门还是沿着走廊前进。这样降低了长期任务的难度，使其更易于执行。在低级执行阶段，则利用在线强化学习策略根据短期规划来决定具体行动。我们还设计了一种新颖的游荡抑制惩罚机制，以进一步减少智能体的游荡问题。这些组件共同构成了图像目标导航的层次化框架。在仿真和真实世界环境中的大量实验表明，我们的方法具有显著优势。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLMs as Knowledge Graph Refiners: Mitigating Factual Inconsistencies in Generative Knowledge Extraction
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型作为知识图谱优化工具：缓解生成式知识提取中的事实不一致性问题
papers.authors: Donghyun Kim, Hyeongjun Yang, Seokju Hwang, Kyong-Ho Lee, Chanhee Lee
papers.abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide a structured representation of real-world facts as triples consisting of entities and their relationships. With the rapid progress of large language models (LLMs), recent studies increasingly explore LLMs for end-to-end KG construction from text. In particular, generative knowledge extraction (GKE) builds KGs by directly generating structured triples from documents. However, generation errors are inevitable, and the resulting KGs often contain triples that do not align with the facts expressed in the source text. To address these issues, we propose GraphRefine, a framework that performs triple-level refinement on KGs constructed via GKE. We first analyze factual inconsistencies that arise in GKE and categorize their types based on a human evaluation. We then construct training data reflecting these types and fine-tune an LLM as a KG refiner. Given a draft KG, the fine-tuned refiner selects a refinement operation for each triple and, if needed, deletes, edits, or rewrites it to reduce factual inconsistencies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GraphRefine goes beyond deletion-only approaches and improves KG quality from diverse perspectives.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识图谱（KGs）以三元组的形式呈现现实世界中的事实，这些三元组由实体及其关系组成。随着大语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展，最近的研究越来越多地利用LLMs从文本中直接构建端到端的KGs。特别是，生成式知识提取（GKE）通过直接从文档中生成结构化三元组来构建KGs。然而，生成错误是不可避免的，因此生成的KGs往往包含与源文本中表达的事实不一致的三元组。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了GraphRefine框架，该框架能够对通过GKE构建的KGs进行三级细化处理。我们首先分析在GKE过程中出现的事实不一致性，并根据人类评估的结果对其进行分类。然后，我们构建反映这些分类的训练数据，并微调一个LLM作为KGs的优化器。给定一份草稿KGs，经过微调的优化器会为每个三元组选择适当的细化操作，必要时还会删除、编辑或重写三元组，以减少事实上的不一致性。大量的实验表明，GraphRefine不仅超越了单纯的删除方法，还从多个角度提升了KGs的质量。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SILO-BENCH: A Scalable Environment for Evaluating Distributed Coordination in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.title_zh: SILO-BENCH：一种可扩展的环境，用于评估多智能体大型语言系统中的分布式协调机制
papers.authors: Yuzhe Zhang, Feiran Liu, Yi Shan, Xinyi Huang, Xin Yang, Yueqi Zhu, Xuxin Cheng, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Wenyuan Jiang
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems to overcome context limitations by distributing information across agents. However, whether LLM-based agents can reliably coordinate when each observes only a fragment of the global problem remains unclear. Existing benchmarks often prescribe agent roles or interaction patterns, conflating coordination ability with role-based priors. We introduce SILO-BENCH, a role-free benchmark for evaluating free-form collaboration under information silos. The benchmark comprises 30 algorithmic tasks with exact ground-truth answers, organized into 3 complexity levels based on optimal communication complexity: aggregation, mesh, and global shuffle. To systematically probe coordination capabilities, we instantiate 54 configurations by varying 3 communication protocols, 6 agent scales and 3 frontier LLMs, conducting 1,620 experiments. We evaluate agent behavior along three dimensions: Success Rate, Token Consumption, and Communication Density. Our experiments reveal a fundamental Communication-Reasoning Gap: agents communicate actively, yet fail to translate interaction into effective distributed computation. Performance collapses as complexity increases, with Level-III tasks achieving zero success beyond 50 agents. These findings demonstrate that current LLMs cannot escape information silos through coordination alone. SILO-BENCH provides a foundation for tracking progress toward genuinely collaborative multi-agent systems. The code is available at https://github.com/jwyjohn/acl26-silo-bench.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被应用于多智能体系统中，以通过在不同智能体之间分配信息来克服上下文限制问题。然而，当每个智能体只能观察到全局问题的部分信息时，基于大语言模型的智能体是否能够可靠地进行协调，仍然是一个不清楚的问题。现有的基准测试通常规定智能体的角色或交互模式，这将协调能力与基于角色的先验知识混为一谈。我们提出了SILO-BENCH这一无角色约束的基准测试，用于评估在信息孤岛环境下自由形式的协作能力。该基准测试包含30个具有精确真实答案的算法任务，并根据最优通信复杂度分为三个复杂度等级：聚合、网格和全局混合。为了系统地探究协调能力，我们通过改变3种通信协议、6种智能体规模以及3种前沿大语言模型，构建了54种配置，进行了1,620次实验。我们从三个维度来评估智能体的行为：成功率、令牌消耗量和通信密度。我们的实验揭示了一个基本的通信与推理之间的差距：智能体虽然积极进行通信，但却无法将互动转化为有效的分布式计算。随着复杂度的增加，性能会下降，第三级任务的成功率在超过50个智能体时降为零。这些发现表明，当前的大语言模型仅靠协调是无法摆脱信息孤岛的。SILO-BENCH为追踪迈向真正协作型多智能体系统的进展提供了基础。代码可访问于https://github.com/jwyjohn/acl26-silo-bench。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mitigating Structural Knowledge Collapse in Domain-Specific LLMs via Morpheme-Aware KV-Aggregation
papers.title_zh: 通过词素感知的关键值聚合技术，缓解领域特定大语言模型中的结构化知识崩溃问题
papers.authors: Yuxuan Si, Zheqi Lv, Chengxi Zang, Zhengyu Chen, Fei Wu
papers.abstract: Standard tokenizers over-fragment domain terms, disrupting morpheme semantics. We characterize this representational misalignment as Structural Knowledge Collapse (SKC), where attention mechanisms fail to reconstruct coherent concepts from fragmented inputs. While existing input-centric solutions like vocabulary expansion address this, they necessitate expensive embedding retraining and neglect internal attention compositionality. To this end, we introduce Morpheme-aware KV-aggregation Attention (MorphKA), a lightweight adapter that dynamically consolidates fragments without tokenizer changes. Bypassing tokenizer retraining, MorphKA employs a dual-phase strategy, Input-Level Morpheme Aggregation (IMA) and Context-Aware KV-Aggregation (AMRF), to stabilize morpheme spans and synthesize higher-order concepts. Experiments on medical and legal benchmarks show MorphKA outperforms vocabulary adaptation baselines by 3.2–4.6%, reaching 7.9% on high-fragmentation terms. Moreover, MorphKA reduces catastrophic interference on general capabilities by 18–22% with ~80% fewer parameters than embedding retraining approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的分词器会过度分割领域术语，从而破坏词素语义的完整性。我们将这种表示上的不一致现象称为“结构知识崩溃”，即注意力机制无法从碎片化的输入中重建出连贯的概念。虽然现有的以输入为中心的解决方案，比如词汇扩展方法，能够解决这个问题，但它们需要昂贵的嵌入层重新训练，并且忽略了内部注意力机制的复合性。为此，我们提出了一种名为“词素感知KV聚合注意力”的轻量级适配器——MorphKA。该算法能够在不改变分词器结构的情况下，动态整合碎片化的输入数据。通过绕过分词器的重新训练过程，MorphKA采用了双阶段策略：输入级词素聚合和上下文感知KV聚合，以此来稳定词素间的关联，并合成更高层次的概念。在医学和法律领域的基准测试中，MorphKA的表现优于基于词汇扩展的基线方法，其性能提升了3.2%至4.6%；在高碎片化术语上，其性能甚至达到了7.9%。此外，MorphKA还能将整体性能下降幅度减少18%至22%，且所需参数数量比传统的嵌入层重新训练方法少约80%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
