papers.title: Zero-shot Jianzi Recognition as Structured Visual Information Extraction in Open Compositional Symbolic Systems
papers.title_zh: 在开放式的组合式符号系统中，基于结构化视觉信息的零样本棋局识别技术
papers.authors: Zehan Li, Fu Zhang, Zhijun Liu, Jingwei Cheng
papers.abstract: Guqin (古琴) Jianzi (減字) is an open and freely compositional tablature system that encodes performance actions rather than acoustic outcomes. Its automatic recognition remains largely unexplored, as conventional OCR assumes a closed and enumerable glyph set and struggles with Jianzi’s unbounded composition and manuscript-level variability.We introduce Zero-shot Jianzi Recognition, which formulates Jianzi recognition as vision-to-sequence prediction of canonical component sequences under a zero-shot split. To enable scalable supervision, we construct Synthetic-JZ from aligned online composition metadata. We then synthesize manuscript-like training images via component-wise style recomposition and manuscript-domain noise modeling, and fine-tune a vision–language model for end-to-end component sequence recognition. At inference time, a lightweight legality-guided correction module re-ranks decoding candidates, suppressing structural hallucinations without modifying the backbone.Experiments on two benchmarks show that our method achieves 63.02% sequence accuracy on Real-JZ, our manually annotated real-world Jianzi benchmark, surpassing Gemini-3-Pro by 35.11%. This result highlights the feasibility of reliable automated Jianzi recognition and its potential for large-scale digitization of historical Guqin Jianzi Pu manuscripts.
papers.abstract_zh: 古琴的“減字”是一种开放式的、可以自由组合的谱式系统，它描述的是演奏动作而非声音效果。这种谱式的自动识别目前仍处于探索阶段，因为传统的OCR技术只能处理有限且可枚举的字符集，而“減字”的无限组合性和手稿级别的多样性使得传统识别方法难以应对。我们提出了一种零样本“減字”识别方法，该方法将“減字”识别任务转化为从视觉到序列预测的模型，并在零样本分割条件下进行训练。为了实现可扩展的监督学习，我们基于对齐的在线组合元数据构建了合成“減字”数据。接着，我们通过组件级风格重组和手稿领域噪声建模来生成类似手稿的训练图像，并微调一个视觉-语言模型以实现端到端的组件序列识别。在推理阶段，一个轻量级的合法性引导校正模块会重新排序解码候选结果，从而在不修改主干模型的情况下抑制结构上的幻觉现象。在两个基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法在手动标注的真实“減字”数据集上达到了63.02%的序列识别准确率，比Gemini-3-Pro高出35.11%。这一结果表明，可靠的自动化“減字”识别是可行的，并且有望应用于历史古琴“減字”曲目的大规模数字化处理。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Whose Facts Win? LLM Source Preferences under Knowledge Conflicts
papers.title_zh: 谁的事实会胜出？在知识冲突情况下的大型语言模型源偏好选择
papers.authors: Jakob Schuster, Vagrant Gautam, Katja Markert
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are more frequently used in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, it is increasingly relevant to study their behavior under knowledge conflicts. Thus far, the role of the source of the retrieved information has gone unexamined. We address this gap with a novel framework to investigate how source preferences affect LLM resolution of inter-context knowledge conflicts in English, motivated by interdisciplinary research on credibility. By using synthetic sources, we study preferences for different types of sources without inheriting the biases of specific real-world sources. With a comprehensive, tightly-controlled evaluation of 13 open-weight LLMs, we find that LLMs prefer institutionally-corroborated information (e.g., government or newspaper sources) over information from people and social media. However, these source preferences can be reversed by simply repeating information from less credible sources. To mitigate repetition effects and maintain consistent preferences, we propose a novel method that reduces repetition bias by up to 79.2%, while also maintaining at least 72.5% of original preferences. We release all data and code to encourage future work on credibility and source preferences in knowledge-intensive NLP.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在检索增强生成流程中的使用越来越频繁，研究它们在知识冲突情况下的行为变得愈发重要。迄今为止，检索到的信息来源所扮演的角色尚未得到深入探讨。我们提出了一个新的框架来解决这个问题，以研究源偏好如何影响大语言模型对英语中跨上下文知识冲突的解决能力。这一研究基于跨学科关于可信度的研究。通过使用合成数据源，我们可以研究不同类型数据源的偏好，而不会受到特定真实世界数据源的偏见影响。通过对13种开放权重的大语言模型进行全面且严格控制的评估，我们发现，这些模型更倾向于使用经过机构验证的信息（例如政府或报纸来源），而不是来自个人和社会媒体的信息。然而，通过简单地重复来自不太可信来源的信息，就可以逆转这些源偏好。为了减轻重复效应并维持一致的偏好，我们提出了一种新方法，该方法能够将重复偏差减少高达79.2%，同时仍保持至少72.5%的原始偏好。我们公开了所有数据和代码，以促进未来在知识密集型自然语言处理领域中关于可信度和源偏好的研究。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CLARity: Reasoning Consistency Alone Can Teach Reinforced Experts
papers.title_zh: CLARity：仅一致性推理就足以教会强化型专家如何做出决策
papers.authors: Jiuheng Lin, Cong Jiang, Zirui Wu, Jiarui Sun, Yansong Feng
papers.abstract: Training expert LLMs in domains with scarce fine-grained annotated data is admittedly challenging, often relying on multiple-choice questions (MCQs). However, standard outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) on MCQs is risky. While outcome-based RL may improve accuracy, it frequently compromises the reasoning process, yielding internally inconsistent rationales that diverge from the final predictions. Existing solutions to supervise the reasoning process, such as large-scale Process Reward Models (PRMs), are prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose CLARity, a cost-effective RL framework that enhances reasoning quality using a small, general-purpose LLM only. CLARity integrates a consistency-aware reward mechanism with a 2-stage refine-then-monitor training pipeline to enhance reasoning consistency, and a dynamic data reformulation strategy to better exploit annotated data available. Experiments demonstrate that CLARity can improve the consistency of responses by 16.5% over standard outcome-based RL, and bring an improvement of 7.5% in final accuracy. Human evaluations further confirm substantial gains in factual correctness and reasoning coherence, leading to more trustworthy model outputs. Thus, CLARity offers a generalizable solution that enables smaller models to effectively guide expert LLM training by monitoring reasoning consistency.
papers.abstract_zh: 在注释数据稀缺的领域中训练专家级大语言模型确实具有挑战性，通常不得不依赖选择题来辅助训练。然而，基于选择题的标准强化学习方法存在风险。虽然基于结果的强化学习可以提高准确性，但它往往会损害推理过程，导致内部逻辑不一致，从而偏离最终的预测结果。目前用于监督推理过程的解决方案，比如大规模的过程奖励模型，成本非常高昂。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了CLARity这一成本效益高的强化学习框架。该框架仅使用小型、通用的大语言模型来提高推理质量。CLARity结合了一种注重一致性的奖励机制以及一个分两阶段的训练流程——先细化再监控，以提升推理的一致性；同时，它还采用了动态的数据重构策略，以便更好地利用现有的注释数据。实验表明，CLARity能够将响应的一致性提高16.5%，并将最终准确率提高了7.5%。人工评估进一步证实，CLARity在事实准确性和推理连贯性方面取得了显著改善，使得模型的输出更加可信。因此，CLARity提供了一种可推广的解决方案，能够让较小的模型通过监控推理一致性来有效指导专家级大语言模型的训练。

papers.title: EGSS: Entropy-guided Stepwise Scaling for Reliable Software Engineering
papers.title_zh: EGSS：基于熵驱动的逐步缩放方法，用于实现可靠的软件工程
papers.authors: Chenhui Mao, Yuanting Lei, Zhixiang Wei, Ming Liang, Zhixiang Wang, Jingxuan Xu, Dajun Chen, Wei Jiang, Yong Li
papers.abstract: Agentic Test-Time Scaling (TTS) has delivered state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on complex software engineering tasks such as code generation and bug fixing. However, its practical adoption remains limited due to significant computational overhead, primarily driven by two key challenges: (1) the high cost associated with deploying excessively large ensembles, and (2) the lack of a reliable mechanism for selecting the optimal candidate solution—ultimately constraining the performance gains that can be realized. To address these challenges, we propose Entropy-Guided Stepwise Scaling (EGSS), a novel TTS framework that dynamically balances efficiency and effectiveness through entropy-guided adaptive search and robust test-suite augmentation.Extensive experiments on SWE-Bench-Verified demonstrate that EGSS consistently boosts performance by 5–10% across all evaluated models. Specifically, it increases the resolved ratio of Kimi-K2-Intruct from 63.2% to 72.2%, and GLM-4.6 from 65.8% to 74.6%. Furthermore, when paired with GLM-4.6, EGSS achieves new state-of-the-art among open-source large language models. In addition to these accuracy improvements, EGSS reduces inference-time token usage by over 28% compared to existing TTS methods, achieving simultaneous gains in both effectiveness and computational efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 代理式测试时间缩放算法在复杂的软件工程任务上取得了先进的性能表现，例如代码生成和错误修复。然而，由于其显著的计算开销，该算法的实际应用仍然受到限制。这一问题的根源在于两个主要挑战：(1) 部署过大的数据集所带来的高成本；(2) 缺乏一种可靠的机制来选择最优的解决方案——这些因素都限制了性能的提升空间。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了熵引导逐步缩放算法。该算法通过熵引导的自适应搜索和强大的测试集增强技术，实现了效率与效果之间的动态平衡。在SWE-Bench-Verified上的广泛实验表明，熵引导逐步缩放算法能够将所有评估模型的性能提升5%到10%。具体来说，它使Kimi-K2-Intruct的解决率从63.2%提升到72.2%，而GLM-4.6则从65.8%提升到74.6%。此外，当与GLM-4.6结合使用时，熵引导逐步缩放算法在开源大语言模型中取得了新的最佳性能。除了这些准确性提升之外，与现有测试时间缩放方法相比，熵引导逐步缩放算法还将推理过程中的令牌使用量减少了28%以上，从而同时提升了效率和计算性能。

papers.title: Detecting What Queries Seek: Steering LLM Safety with FFN Output Activation Monitoring
papers.title_zh: 识别用户查询的需求：通过FFN输出激活监控来实现LLM使用的安全性保障
papers.authors: Xiaohao Luo, Ying Wei, Rui Zhao
papers.abstract: Recently, activation steering has attracted considerable attention as a low-cost approach to improving the safety of large language models (LLMs). However, most existing methods apply interventions indiscriminately, often causing excessive refusal of benign queries. Although recent works have begun to explore selective intervention, their intervention decisions typically rely on residual stream activations where information is highly entangled, resulting in limited discriminative power and unreliable interventions. To address this issue, we propose FFN-Guided activation steering (FGAS). Motivated by the observation that feed-forward networks (FFNs) in LLMs serve as core modules for knowledge storage, we propose leveraging FFN output activations as more discriminative signals for intervention, since these activations more explicitly reflect the intent of a query. For a given query, FGAS projects the corresponding FFN output activation into a low-dimensional subspace that effectively separates harmful and benign queries, and then makes precise intervention decisions by assessing its similarity to pre-constructed prototype activations representing harmful and benign classes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FGAS achieves state-of-the-art defense performance against various jailbreak attacks, while nearly preserving the model’s original performance on benign tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，激活引导作为一种低成本的方法，在提升大语言模型的安全性方面受到了广泛关注。然而，目前大多数方法都是不加选择地进行干预，常常导致对良性查询的过度拒绝。虽然近期有一些研究开始探索选择性干预，但这些干预决策通常依赖于残差流的激活信息，而这类信息的关联性很高，从而导致判别能力有限，干预效果不可靠。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了FFN引导激活引导方法（FGAS）。鉴于在大语言模型中，前馈网络作为知识存储的核心模块，我们建议利用前馈网络的输出激活作为更有效的干预信号，因为这些激活信息更能明确反映查询的意图。对于某个查询，FGAS会将相应的前馈网络输出激活投影到一个低维子空间中，从而有效区分有害和良性的查询。然后，通过评估该激活与代表有害和良性类别的预构建原型激活的相似性，来做出精确的干预决策。大量实验表明，FGAS在应对各种破解攻击时取得了出色的防御性能，同时几乎保持了模型在良性任务上的原有性能。

papers.title: Temporal Evidence Chain for Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于时间线索的知识图谱问答方法——以大型语言模型为手段的时间性证据链
papers.authors: Shihao Liu, Xiaofei Zhou, Bo Wang, Geyuan Zhang
papers.abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) aims to answer temporal questions using knowledge from Temporal Knowledge Graphs (TKGs).Existing LLM-based TKGQA methods typically utilize RAG-based or Agent-based paradigms, yet both struggle to construct reliable temporal evidence chains. RAG-based approaches primarily rely on semantic retrieval to fetch question-relevant contexts but overlook the structural dependencies within TKGs, leading to broken evidence chains, whereas iterative agents are prone to error propagation during multi-step reasoning.To address these limitations, we propose TECQA, a framework designed to construct temporal evidence chains for LLM reasoning. Firstly, TECQA employs structure-guided subgraph retrieval to capture structural dependencies and intermediate reasoning paths. Subsequently, it utilizes a k-nearest temporal neighbor pruning strategy to filter irrelevant noise while strictly preserving the continuous local history surrounding critical events. Finally, the retained temporal neighbors are serialized by temporal proximity to explicitly reconstruct a coherent temporal evidence chain. Extensive experiments on MultiTQ and CronQuestions demonstrate that TECQA achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming strong baselines by 45.3% particularly on complex queries. Code is available at https://github.com/SimonsLiu/TECQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间知识图谱问答（TKGQA）旨在利用时间知识图谱中的知识来回答与时间相关的问题。现有的基于大语言模型的TKGQA方法通常采用基于RAG或基于代理的范式，但这两种方法在构建可靠的时间证据链方面都存在困难。基于RAG的方法主要依赖语义检索来获取与问题相关的上下文信息，但却忽略了知识图谱内部的结构性依赖关系，从而导致证据链断裂；而基于代理的方法则在多步推理过程中容易出现错误传播。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了TECQA框架，该框架旨在为大语言模型推理构建时间证据链。首先，TECQA采用结构引导的子图检索方法来捕捉结构性依赖关系和中间推理路径。随后，它采用k个最近时间邻居剪枝策略来过滤无关的噪声信息，同时严格保留关键事件周围的连续历史信息。最后，通过按时间顺序对保留的时间邻居进行序列化，从而明确重建一个连贯的时间证据链。在MultiTQ和CronQuestions上的大量实验表明，TECQA取得了出色的性能，特别是在处理复杂查询时，其表现比强基线方法高出 45.3%。代码可访问于https://github.com/SimonsLiu/TECQA。

papers.title: Modal Dependency Parsing as Structured Prediction over Source-Cue Scope
papers.title_zh: 在源线索范围内进行结构化预测的模态依赖解析
papers.authors: Jayeol Chun, Nianwen Xue
papers.abstract: Modal dependency parsing-the task of identifying a semantic graph that represents who is responsible for an event-centered claim and with what degree of certainty-relies on recognizing source-introducing cues and correctly linking them to their associated content. However, prior work has largely focused on identifying sources only, treating cue expressions and their modal coverage as auxiliary signals. In this work, we propose a structured prediction framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to explicitly identify source-cue pairs as well as their respective scope, which together define the modal contexts governing downstream source attribution for events. By concentrating learning at the source-cue level and constraining event-level decisions to a small, scope-defined candidate set, our top-down approach enables more efficient inference in long, event-rich documents. Experiments show this approach surpasses prior state-of-the-art results by 3 and 4% for English and Chinese datasets, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 模态依赖解析的任务在于识别一个语义图，该图能够表明谁对以事件为中心的声明负有责任，以及这种责任的确定性程度。这一任务需要识别源信息，找到相关的线索，并将这些线索正确地与它们对应的内容联系起来。然而，以往的研究主要集中在识别源信息上，将线索表达及其模态覆盖范围视为辅助信号而已。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个结构化的预测框架，利用大语言模型来明确识别源-线索对以及它们各自的范围，这些范围和线索共同构成了支配事件下游源归因的模态上下文。通过将学习集中在源-线索层面，并将事件层面的决策限制在少数范围明确的候选集合中，我们的自上而下的方法能够在长且包含大量事件的文档中实现更高效的推理。实验结果表明，这种方法在英文和中文数据集上的表现分别优于现有的最先进成果，分别提高了3%和4%。

papers.title: DEFT: Demystifying VLN Failures via a Unified Dual-View Explainability Framework for LLM-based Agents
papers.title_zh: DEFT：通过统一的双视图可解释性框架，揭示基于大语言模型的智能体的VLN故障原因
papers.authors: Yawen Wang, Yihan Dai, Jianming Chen, Junjie Wang, Qing Wang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as central planners in Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN), yet their complexity increasingly obscures their internal decision-making. Existing interpretability methods typically isolate temporal criticality from feature salience, creating an alignment gap and failing to account for the behavioral instability of black-box agents. To address this, we propose DEFT, a unified dual-view framework that demystifies agent behavior by jointly analyzing \textit{when} a decision is pivotal and \textit{what} visual evidence grounds it. Featuring a dual-head architecture with a shared latent representation, DEFT employs a \textit{Mask Head} for counterfactual-based criticality detection and an \textit{Action Head} that leverages an ensemble of surrogates to recover robust visual cues. Extensive experiments on MatterPort3D across three LLM-based agents demonstrate that DEFT outperforms baselines in both temporal and feature fidelity. User studies further validate its utility, showing 78% alignment with human intuition.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在视觉与语言导航中扮演着核心角色，然而其复杂性使得其内部决策过程难以被理解。现有的可解释性方法通常将时间上的关键性因素与特征显著性分离开来，这导致了一种对齐上的差距，同时也没有考虑到黑盒型代理的行为不稳定性。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了DEFT这一统一的双视图框架。该框架通过联合分析决策的关键性时刻以及支撑该决策的具体视觉证据，从而揭示代理的行为机制。DEFT采用双头部架构，共享一个潜在表示；其中，掩蔽头用于基于反事实的关键性检测，而动作头则利用一系列替代方案来提取可靠的视觉线索。在MatterPort3D平台上对三种基于语言模型的代理进行的广泛实验表明，DEFT在时间维度和特征保真度方面均优于现有基线方法。用户研究进一步验证了DEFT的实用性，结果显示其与人类直觉的符合程度达到了78%。

papers.title: GLIER: Generative Legal Inference and Evidence Ranking for Legal Case Retrieval
papers.title_zh: GLIER：生成式法律推理与证据排序技术，用于法律案例检索
papers.authors: Minghan Li, Tianrui Lv, Chao Zhang, Guodong Zhou
papers.abstract: The semantic gap between colloquial user queries and professional legal documents presents a fundamental challenge in Legal Case Retrieval (LCR). Existing dense retrieval methods typically treat LCR as a black-box semantic matching process, neglecting the explicit juridical logic that underpins legal relevance. To address this, we propose GLIER (Generative Legal Inference and Evidence Ranking), a framework that reformulates retrieval as an inference process over latent legal variables. GLIER decomposes the task into two interpretability-driven stages: (1) A Joint Generative Inference module that translates raw queries into latent legal indicators (Charges and Legal Elements), employing a unified sequence-to-sequence strategy where charges and elements are generated jointly to enforce logical consistency; and (2) A Multi-View Evidence Fusion mechanism that aggregates generative confidence with structural and lexical signals for precise ranking. Extensive experiments on LeCaRD and LeCaRDv2 demonstrate that GLIER outperforms strong baselines like SAILER and KELLER. Notably, our framework exhibits exceptional data efficiency, maintaining robust performance even when trained with only 10% of the data.
papers.abstract_zh: 口语化用户查询与专业法律文件之间的语义差异，是法律案例检索中的一个根本挑战。现有的密集检索方法通常将法律案例视为一个黑盒式的语义匹配过程，而忽略了支撑法律相关性的明确法律逻辑。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了GLIER框架——该框架将检索过程重新定义为对潜在法律变量的推理过程。GLIER将任务分解为两个以可解释性为驱动的阶段：（1）一个联合生成式推理模块，它将原始查询转化为潜在的法律指标（指控和法律要素），采用一种统一的序列到序列策略，使得指控和要素能够共同生成，从而确保逻辑一致性；（2）一个多视图证据融合机制，它能够将生成式的结果与结构和词汇信号相结合，以实现精确的排序。在LeCaRD和LeCaRDv2上的广泛实验表明，GLIER的性能优于SAILER和KELLER等强大的基线算法。值得注意的是，我们的框架表现出卓越的数据效率，即使仅使用10%的数据进行训练，其性能依然非常稳定。

papers.title: LLMs (Almost) Never Abstain Under Medical Uncertainty
papers.title_zh: 在医疗状况不确定的情况下，大型语言模型几乎从不回避采取行动
papers.authors: Alessio Cocchieri, Luca Ragazzi, Giuseppe Tagliavini, Gianluca Moro
papers.abstract: Medical multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks implicitly assume that large language models (LLMs) should always commit to an answer. However, in clinical practice, uncertainty is pervasive and abstaining is often the safest action. We introduce MedQAbstain, a benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate medical abstention under uncertainty. MedQAbstain repurposes standard medical MCQA datasets by removing the gold answer and introducing an explicit “I abstain” option, framed as a safety-critical decision with clinical consequences. The benchmark supports systematic analysis across abstention regimes, distractor complexity, and input modalities, and elicits self-reported model confidence to study calibration. Across all settings, we find that state-of-the-art LLMs systematically overcommit, rarely abstaining even when the question itself is hidden. These results reveal a fundamental mismatch between LLM behavior and clinical norms, highlighting abstention as a critical but overlooked dimension of medical decision-making evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 医学选择题回答（MCQA）基准测试默认认为大语言模型（LLM）应该始终给出答案。然而，在临床实践中，不确定性普遍存在，此时选择不回答往往是最安全的行为。我们提出了MedQAbstain这一基准测试，专门用于评估在不确定情况下的医学问题回避行为。该测试通过移除标准医学MCQA数据集中的正确答案，并引入一个明确的“我拒绝回答”选项，将其视为具有临床后果的安全关键决策。该基准测试支持对回避策略、干扰因素复杂性和输入方式等进行系统分析，同时还能获取模型自身的置信度数据以研究其校准情况。在所有情况下，我们发现最先进的LLM往往过度承诺，即使问题本身并不明确，它们也很少选择不回答。这些结果揭示了LLM行为与临床规范之间的根本差异，从而凸显了回避行为作为医学决策评估中一个关键但被忽视的维度。

papers.title: TOWER+: Bridging Generality and Translation Specialization in Multilingual LLMs
papers.title_zh: TOWER+：在多语言大语言模型中实现通用性与翻译专长的结合
papers.authors: Ricardo Rei, Nuno M Guerreiro, José Pombal, João Alves, Amin Farajian, Pedro Teixeirinha, Andre Martins
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning pretrained LLMs has proven effective for reaching state-of-the-art performance on specific tasks like machine translation. However, this process often implies sacrificing general-purpose capabilities, such as conversational reasoning and instruction-following, hampering the usefulness of the system in real-world applications requiring a mixture of skills. In this paper, we introduce Tower+, a suite of models designed to deliver strong performance on both translation and multilingual general-purpose text capabilities. We improve the TOwer (Alves et al., 2024) recipe by adding novel stages of preference optimization and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, in addition to continued pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. At each stage, we carefully generate and curate data to strengthen performance on translation and general-purpose tasks like coding, mathematics, and instruction-following. We develop models at multiple scales: 2B, 9B, and 72B. Our smaller models often outperform larger general-purpose open-weight and proprietary LLMs (e.g., Llama 3.3 70B, GPT-4o). Our largest model delivers best-in-class translation performance for high-resource languages, and top results on multilingual Arena Hard and IF-MT, a benchmark we introduce for evaluating both translation and instruction-following.
papers.abstract_zh: 对预训练的大语言模型进行微调，确实能够在特定任务上取得卓越的性能，比如机器翻译。然而，这一过程往往意味着要牺牲一些通用能力，比如对话推理和指令遵循等，这限制了系统在需要多种技能组合的现实应用中的实用性。在本文中，我们介绍了Tower+模型套件，该套件旨在在翻译和多语言通用文本处理方面都能提供强大的性能。我们通过增加新的偏好优化阶段以及带有可验证奖励的强化学习环节，来改进TOwer模型（Alves等人，2024年）。此外，我们还进行了持续的预训练和监督式微调。在每个阶段，我们都精心生成和筛选数据，以提升在翻译和通用任务上的性能，例如编程、数学和指令遵循等。我们开发了不同规模模型的版本：2B、9B和72B。我们的小型模型通常能超越那些更大规模的开源或专有大语言模型（例如Llama 3.3 70B、GPT-4o）。我们的最大模型能够在高资源语言上实现一流的翻译性能，并在多语言Arena Hard和IF-MT基准测试中取得优异成绩，这些基准测试专门用于评估翻译和指令遵循能力。

papers.title: Culture-Aware Machine Translation in Large Language Models: Benchmarking and Investigation
papers.title_zh: 考虑文化因素的大型语言模型机器翻译：基准测试与研究
papers.authors: Zekun Yuan, Yangfan Ye, Xiaocheng Feng, Baohang Li, Qichen Hong, Yunfei Lu, Dandan Tu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in general machine translation, yet their ability in culture-aware scenarios remains poorly understood. To bridge this gap, we introduce CanMT, a Culture-Aware Novel-Driven Parallel Dataset for Machine Translation, together with a theoretically grounded, multi-dimensional evaluation frame work for assessing cultural translation quality. Leveraging CanMT, we systematically evaluate a wide range of LLMs and translation systems under different translation strategy constraints. Our findings reveal substantial performance disparities across models and demonstrate that translation strategies exert a systematic influence on model behavior. Further analysis shows that translation difficulty varies across types of culture-specific items, and that a persistent gap remains between models’recognition of culture-specific knowledge and their ability to correctly operationalize it in translation outputs. In addition, incorporating reference translations is shown to substantially improve evaluation reliability in LLM-as-a-judge, underscoring their essential role in assessing culture-aware translation quality. The corpus and code are available at CanMT.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在通用机器翻译领域取得了显著的性能提升，然而它们在考虑文化因素的场景中的表现仍不甚明了。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了CanMT——一个基于文化意识的新型并行机器翻译数据集，同时构建了一个基于理论基础的、多维度的评估框架，用于评估文化翻译的质量。通过利用CanMT，我们对各种大语言模型和翻译系统在不同翻译策略约束下的表现进行了系统的评估。我们的研究发现，不同模型之间存在显著的性能差异，并表明翻译策略对模型的行为有着系统性的影响。进一步分析表明，翻译难度因文化特定内容的类型而异，而且模型在识别文化特定知识方面的能力与其在翻译输出中正确运用这些知识的能力之间仍存在明显的差距。此外，加入参考译文能够显著提高以语言模型作为评判标准的评估结果的可靠性，这凸显了它们在评估文化意识型翻译质量中的重要作用。CanMT的相关语料库和代码均可在此处获取。

papers.title: Learning from Near-Misses: Error-Aware Contrastive Few-Shot Learning for NL2Formula
papers.title_zh: 从近似失败中学习：基于错误感知的对比式少样本学习算法在NL2公式问题上的应用
papers.authors: Zhihao Shuai, Yiyun Chen, Maolin Ma, Yutong Chen, Hanjia Qiu, Jing Xu, Ziye Chen, Weikai Yang
papers.abstract: Natural Language to Excel Formula (NL2Formula) translates user intent into executable spreadsheet formulas. However, current models often produce near-miss outputs—formulas that parse correctly yet fail at execution due to an incorrect function, operator, or reference. Through a systematic error analysis, we find that these errors repeatedly arise from a small set of structural decision points, motivating the need for typed error supervision rather than general error signals. To this end, we introduce an abstract syntax tree (AST)-based error taxonomy that organizes common error modes by the kind of decision that goes wrong in the parse tree. Building on this taxonomy, we propose Error-Aware Contrastive Few-Shot Learning (ECFL), an error-aware framework that unifies training and inference around typed error supervision. During offline training, ECFL mines near-miss errors, assigns error types under the taxonomy, and builds error-aware contrastive demonstrations for fine-tuning. During online inference, a lightweight predictor estimates likely error types and triggers targeted retrieval of contrastive demonstrations to guide single-pass decoding. Experiments show ECFL improves Exact Match (EM) by 6.4 points over supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and matches self-consistency (SC@5) accuracy at substantially lower inference cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 自然语言到Excel公式转换工具（NL2Formula）能够将用户的意图转化为可执行的电子表格公式。然而，当前的模型往往会产生近似正确的结果——即公式解析无误，但在执行时由于函数、运算符或引用错误而失败。通过系统的错误分析，我们发现这些错误往往源于少数几个结构决策点上的问题，因此有必要采用类型化错误监督机制，而不是使用通用的错误信号。为此，我们提出了一种基于抽象语法树（AST）的错误分类方法，该方法根据解析树中出现的错误类型来组织常见的错误模式。在此基础上，我们提出了一种名为“错误感知对比式少量样本学习”（ECFL）的框架，该框架围绕类型化错误监督机制，实现了训练和推理过程的统一。在离线训练阶段，ECFL会挖掘近似正确的错误案例，根据分类法确定错误类型，并构建出具有错误感知功能的对比性示例用于微调。在在线推理阶段，轻量级预测器会估计可能出现的错误类型，并触发针对性的对比性示例检索，以指导单次解码过程。实验表明，与有监督的微调方法相比，ECFL在精确匹配指标上提升了6.4个百分点，同时在较低的推理成本下达到了与自我一致性算法相当的准确率。

papers.title: Calibrated Speculative Decoding: Frequency-Guided Candidate Selection for Efficient Inference
papers.title_zh: 校准后的推测解码：基于频率引导的候选对象选择，以实现高效的推理过程
papers.authors: Zhouxuwen, Fangxin Liu, Chao Wang, Xiao Zheng, Hao Zheng, Min He, Li Jiang, Haibing Guan
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by letting draft tokens bypass full verification, but conventional frameworks suffer from frequent false rejections, particularly when draft models produce semantically correct but lexically divergent outputs. In this paper, we present Calibrated Speculative Decoding (CSD), a training-free framework that recovers valid tokens discarded by standard verification. Guided by the principle of “Frequency-Guided Candidate Selection and Probability-Guarded Acceptance,” CSD incorporates two lightweight modules: Online Correction Memory, which aggregates historical rejections to propose recurring divergence patterns as rescue candidates, and Semantic Consistency Gating, which verifies candidate admissibility using probability ratios instead of exact token matching. Our evaluation across diverse large language models demonstrates that CSD outperforms existing methods, achieving a peak throughput speedup of 2.33x. CSD preserves model accuracy across all tasks while further boosting performance on complex reasoning datasets. These results establish CSD as a highly effective, lightweight solution for practical LLM deployments.
papers.abstract_zh: 投机式解码通过让草稿令牌绕过完全验证的过程，从而加速自回归生成。不过，传统框架常常出现频繁的错误拒绝情况，尤其是在草稿模型产生语义上正确但词汇上有所不同的输出时。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“校准型投机式解码”的新框架。该框架无需训练即可恢复被标准验证所丢弃的有效令牌。其运作原理基于“频率引导的候选选择与概率保护的接受机制”。CSD包含两个轻量级模块：在线修正记忆模块，它汇总历史上的拒绝结果，识别出反复出现的差异模式作为备选方案；以及语义一致性验证模块，它通过概率比而非精确的令牌匹配来验证候选方案的合理性。我们对多种大语言模型的评估表明，CSD的表现优于现有方法，其吞吐量最高可提升2.33倍。CSD能够在所有任务中保持模型的准确性，同时还能在复杂的推理数据集上进一步提升性能。这些成果证明了CSD是一种非常有效的轻量级解决方案，适用于实际的大语言模型部署。

papers.title: Learning from Mistakes: Negative Reasoning Samples Enhance Out-of-Domain Generalization
papers.title_zh: 从错误中学习：负面推理示例有助于提升跨域泛化能力
papers.authors: Tian Xueyun, MingHua Ma, Bingbing Xu, Nuoyan Lyu, Wei Li, Heng Dong, Zheng Chu, Yuanzhuo Wang, Huawei Shen
papers.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories demonstrations is a common approach for enabling reasoning in large language models. Standard practices typically only retain trajectories with correct final answers (positives) while ignoring the rest (negatives). We argue that this paradigm discards substantial supervision and exacerbates overfitting, limiting out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. Specifically, we surprisingly find that incorporating negative trajectories into SFT yields substantial OOD generalization gains over positive-only training, as these trajectories often retain valid intermediate reasoning despite incorrect final answers. To understand this effect in depth, we systematically analyze data, training dynamics, and inference behavior, identifying 22 recurring patterns in negative chains that serve a dual role: they moderate loss descent to mitigate overfitting during training and boost policy entropy by 35.67% during inference to facilitate exploration. Motivated by these observations, we further propose Gain-based LOss Weighting (GLOW), an adaptive, sample-aware scheme that exploits such distinctive training dynamics by rescaling per-sample loss based on inter-epoch progress. Empirically, GLOW efficiently leverages unfiltered trajectories, yielding a 5.51% OOD gain over positive-only SFT on Qwen2.5-7B and boosting MMLU from 72.82% to 76.47% as an RL initialization. Code is available at Github.
papers.abstract_zh: 在语言模型的推理中，监督式微调（SFT）是一种常见的技术。传统的做法通常只保留那些最终答案正确的轨迹，而忽略其他轨迹。我们认为，这种处理方式会丢弃大量有用的监督信息，从而导致过拟合现象，进而限制模型在不同领域上的泛化能力。具体来说，我们发现，将负样本轨迹纳入SFT训练中，能够显著提高模型在不同领域的泛化能力。因为这些负样本轨迹往往包含有效的推理过程，尽管最终的答案是错误的。为了更深入地理解这一效应，我们对数据、训练动态和推理行为进行了系统分析，发现了22种在负样本轨迹中出现的模式。这些模式起到了双重作用：它们有助于减轻训练过程中的过拟合问题，同时在推理过程中将策略熵提升了 35.67%，从而促进了模型的探索能力。基于这些发现，我们提出了基于增益的损失加权方法（GLOW），这是一种自适应且考虑样本特性的方法，它通过根据不同周期内的进展来调整每个样本的损失来利用这些独特的训练动态。实验表明，GLOW能够有效利用未过滤过的负样本轨迹，使得Qwen2.5-7B模型的在不同领域的性能提升了5.51%。同时，作为强化学习系统的初始化方案，GLOW还将MMLU指标从72.82%提升到了76.47%。相关代码可在GitHub上获取。

papers.title: LongTutor: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Long-term Personalized Tutoring
papers.title_zh: LongTutor：针对长期个性化辅导需求，对大型语言模型进行性能评估
papers.authors: Ning Li, Zheng Zhang, Zhenya Huang, Rui Li, Yi Zhan, Yinbo Luo, Qi Liu, Enhong Chen
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has driven the deployment of LLM-based AI tutors on online learning platforms. This widespread adoption highlights an urgent need for systematic benchmarks to evaluate their tutoring capabilities. However, existing evaluations predominantly focus on isolated, short-term interactions, overlooking the inherently long-term nature of learning. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongTutor, a benchmark for long-term personalized tutoring grounded in formative assessment theory. Built from expert-annotated real-world learning logs, LongTutor evaluates LLMs across three progressive tasks: historical evidence acquisition, knowledge state diagnosis, and adaptive teaching action. Our experiments reveal a critical capability mismatch: while LLMs excel at evidence acquisition, they struggle to effectively leverage long-term history for accurate diagnosis and adaptive teaching. To enable scalable benchmark expansion, we further propose an automated generator–verifier pipeline, paving the way toward truly long-term AI tutoring systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的快速发展推动了基于LLM的AI辅导系统在在线学习平台上的应用。这种广泛的采用凸显了迫切需要系统性的评估基准来评价它们的辅导能力。然而，现有的评估大多集中在孤立的、短期的互动上，而忽视了学习的长期性特征。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了LongTutor这一基于形成性评估理论的长期个性化辅导评估基准。该基准基于专家注释的真实学习记录构建，通过三个渐进性的任务来评估LLM的能力：历史证据获取、知识状态诊断以及自适应教学行为。我们的实验揭示了关键的能力不匹配问题：虽然LLM在证据获取方面表现出色，但在利用长期历史数据进行准确诊断和自适应教学方面却存在困难。为了实现可扩展的评估基准扩展，我们还提出了一种自动生成与验证的流程，为真正长期的AI辅导系统铺平了道路。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: HiChunk: Evaluating and Enhancing Retrieval Augmented Generation with Hierarchical Chunking
papers.title_zh: HiChunk：通过分层分割来评估并提升基于检索增强的生成技术
papers.authors: Wensheng Lu, Keyu Chen, Zhifeng Shen, Ruizhi Qiao, Xing Sun
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the response capabilities of language models by integrating external knowledge sources. However, document chunking as an important part of RAG system often lacks effective evaluation tools. This paper first analyzes why existing RAG evaluation benchmarks are inadequate for assessing document chunking quality, specifically due to evidence sparsity. Based on this conclusion, we propose HiCBench, which includes manually annotated multi-level document chunking points, synthesized evidence-dense question answer(QA) pairs, and their corresponding evidence sources. We also propose HiChunk, a hierarchical document structuring framework using fine-tuned LLMs and the Auto-Merge retrieval algorithm to enhance retrieval quality. Experiments demonstrate that HiCBench effectively evaluates the impact of different chunking methods across the entire RAG pipeline. Moreover, HiChunk achieves better chunking quality within reasonable time consumption, thereby enhancing the overall performance of RAG systems. Source code is available at https://github.com/TencentCloudADP/hichunk.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合外部知识源来增强语言模型的响应能力。然而，作为RAG系统重要组成部分的文档分块处理，往往缺乏有效的评估工具。本文首先分析了现有RAG评估基准为何无法有效评估文档分块处理的质量，主要是由于证据稀缺性问题。基于这一结论，我们提出了HiCBench框架，该框架包含手动标注的多级文档分块点、合成的证据密集型问答对以及相应的证据来源。我们还提出了HiChunk框架，它是一个分层文档结构框架，利用经过微调的大语言模型以及自动合并检索算法来提高检索质量。实验表明，HiCBench能够有效评估不同分块方法对整个RAG流程的影响。此外，HiChunk在合理的时间消耗内实现了更好的分块质量，从而提升了RAG系统的整体性能。源代码可访问于https://github.com/TencentCloudADP/hichunk。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: How Good is Your Wikipedia? Auditing Data Quality for Low-resource and Multilingual NLP
papers.title_zh: 你的维基百科有多可靠？针对低资源环境及多语言文本处理的自然语言处理领域，评估数据的质量状况
papers.authors: Kushal Tatariya, Artur Kulmizev, Wessel Poelman, Esther Ploeger, Marcel Bollmann, Johannes Bjerva, Jiaming Luo, Heather Lent, Miryam de Lhoneux
papers.abstract: Wikipedia’s perceived high quality and broad language coverage have established it as a fundamental resource in NLP. However, in recent years, such assumptions of high quality have become the subject of scrutiny in low-resource and multilingual contexts. In this study, we subject the entirety of non-English Wikipedia to a data filtering procedure typically reserved for noisy web-text — a process which removes a large percentage of the collection’s data. In analysing the removed data, we reveal numerous systematic quality issues, such as script and language contamination, repeated template and placeholder articles, and a high concentration of bot-generated content. We consolidate these findings into a 4-level quality ranking of Wikipedia, which shows strong correspondence with alternative quality measures and heuristics. Lastly, we evaluate the downstream impact of quality filtering in three practical language modelling scenarios, showing that models trained on filtered data largely match or outperform those trained on raw Wikipedia, with the largest gains observed for lower-quality language editions. Ultimately, our experiments serve as a first step in establishing quality-aware best practices for Wikipedia utilization in NLP, laying groundwork that can inform future dataset creation and curation efforts.
papers.abstract_zh: 维基百科因其较高的质量以及广泛的语言覆盖能力，而被认为是自然语言处理领域的重要资源。然而，近年来，这种对高质量资源的假设在资源匮乏和多语言环境下受到了质疑。在这项研究中，我们对所有非英语的维基百科内容进行了数据过滤处理——这一处理过程会去除大量数据。通过分析被移除的数据，我们发现了许多系统性质量问题，比如文本和语言的污染、重复出现的模板式文章以及大量由机器人生成的内容。我们将这些发现整理成四个级别的质量等级，结果与其他质量评估方法和启发式方法高度一致。最后，我们在三个实际的语言建模场景中评估了数据过滤的影响，结果显示：基于过滤后的数据训练的模型在性能上基本与基于原始维基百科数据训练的模型相当，甚至有所超越；而对于质量较低的语言版本来说，这种提升更为明显。总的来说，我们的实验为在自然语言处理中利用维基百科时建立注重质量的最佳实践奠定了基础，也为未来数据集的创建与管理提供了参考依据。

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating Political Stance Cross-topic Generalization in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 理解并减轻大型语言模型中的政治立场跨主题泛化问题
papers.authors: Jiayi Zhang, Shu Yang, Junchao Wu, Derek F. Wong, Di Wang
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning Large Language Models on a political topic will significantly manipulate their political stance on various issues and unintentionally affect their stance on broad topics. While previous studies have proposed this issue, there is still a lack of understanding regarding the internal representations of these stances and the mechanisms that lead to unintended cross-topic generalization. In this paper, we systematically explore the internal mechanisms underlying this phenomenon from a neuron-level perspective and how to mitigate the cross-topic generalization of political fine-tuning. Firstly, we propose Political Neuron Localization through Activation Contrasting (PNLAC) to identify two distinct types of political neurons: general political neurons, which govern stance across multiple political topics, and topic-specific neurons that affect the model’s political stance on individual topics. We find that these political neuron types exist in the middle and later layers across four models and datasets through activation patching experiments. Leveraging these insights, we introduce InhibitFT, an inhibition-based fine-tuning method that effectively mitigates the cross-topic stance generalization. Experimental results demonstrate the robustness of the identified neuron types across various models and datasets and show that InhibitFT significantly reduces the cross-topic stance generalization by 20% on average while preserving topic-specific performance. Moreover, we demonstrate that selectively inhibiting only 5% of neurons is sufficient to effectively mitigate the cross-topic stance generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 对大语言模型在政治主题上进行微调会显著影响其对各种问题的政治立场，并无意中影响其对广泛主题的态度。虽然之前的研究已经提出了这个问题，但关于这些立场的内部表征以及导致跨主题泛化的机制，目前仍缺乏深入的理解。在本文中，我们从神经元层面的角度系统地探讨了这一现象背后的内部机制，以及如何减轻政治微调导致的跨主题泛化问题。首先，我们提出了“通过激活对比来定位政治神经元”的方法，以区分两种不同类型的政治神经元：一种是可以影响多个政治主题的通用政治神经元；另一种则是会影响模型对特定主题的政治立场的专题特异性神经元。通过激活拼接实验发现，这两种政治神经元类型存在于四个模型和数据集的中间及后期层次中。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种基于抑制的微调方法——InhibitFT，该方法能够有效减轻跨主题立场的泛化问题。实验结果表明，所识别出的神经元类型在不同模型和数据集上都具有很强的鲁棒性，而且InhibitFT平均能将跨主题立场的泛化程度降低20%，同时还能保持专题特异性性能。此外，我们还证明，仅选择性地抑制5%的神经元就足以有效减轻跨主题立场的泛化问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MPR-GUI: Benchmarking and Enhancing Multilingual Perception and Reasoning in GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: MPR-GUI：用于评估和提高GUI代理的多语言感知与推理能力的技术
papers.authors: Ruihan Chen, Qiming Li, Xiaocheng Feng, Weihong Zhong, Xiaoliang Yang, Yuxuan Gu, Zekun Zhou, Yunfei Lu, Haoyu Ren, Kun Chen, Dandan Tu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Large Vision–Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong potential as multilingual Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents, as evidenced by existing GUI benchmarks. However, these benchmarks exhibit two primary limitations: (1) although Perception and Reasoning (P R) capabilities are fundamental for GUI agents, current benchmarks lack fine-grained diagnostics to identify which specific capabilities lead to task failures, hindering targeted improvements; (2) existing benchmarks fail to provide a strictly aligned cross-lingual evaluation environment, introducing confounding factors that prevent isolating the language impact on GUI agent performance. To address these issues, we propose the Multilingual P R GUI Benchmark (MPR-GUI-Bench), featuring strictly aligned environments across six languages and eight fine-grained P R tasks. Our benchmark reveals consistent P R gaps between English and non-English settings, particularly on reasoning-intensive tasks. To leverage the superior English P R capabilities for bridging cross-lingual gaps, we identify layers sensitive to language and propose GUI-XLI, a GUI Cross-Lingual Intervention method that aligns non-English hidden states with their English counterparts at these layers during inference. Experiments show that GUI-XLI effectively reduces the cross-lingual gaps, with an average gain of 6.5% in non-English settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型在作为多语言图形用户界面代理方面展现出巨大潜力，这一点从现有的图形用户界面基准测试中可以看出来。然而，这些基准测试存在两个主要局限性：(1)虽然感知与推理能力对于图形用户界面代理来说至关重要，但当前的基准测试缺乏精细化的诊断手段，无法识别出哪些具体能力会导致任务失败，从而难以进行有针对性的改进；(2)现有的基准测试无法提供一个严格对齐的跨语言评估环境，这引入了干扰因素，使得我们无法准确判断语言对图形用户界面代理性能的影响。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了多语言感知与推理图形用户界面基准测试，该测试涵盖了六种语言的严格对齐环境以及八种精细化的感知与推理任务。我们的基准测试显示，英语与非英语环境之间的感知与推理能力存在明显差距，尤其是在需要大量推理的任务上。为了利用英语在感知与推理方面的优势来弥补跨语言间的差距，我们识别了与语言相关的层次结构，并提出了GUI-XLI这一图形用户界面跨语言干预方法。该方法在推理过程中将非英语隐藏状态与对应的英语隐藏状态进行对齐。实验表明，GUI-XLI能够有效减少跨语言间的差距，在非英语环境中平均提升了6.5%的性能。

papers.title: CoVerRL: Breaking the Consensus Trap in Label-Free Reasoning via Generator-Verifier Co-Evolution
papers.title_zh: CoVerRL：通过生成器与验证器的协同进化，打破无标签推理中的共识陷阱
papers.authors: Teng Pan, Yuchen Yan, Zixuan Wang, Ruiqing Zhang, Guiyang Hou, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yongliang Shen
papers.abstract: Label-free reinforcement learning enables large language models to improve reasoning capabilities without ground-truth supervision, typically by treating majority-voted answers as pseudo-labels. However, we identify a critical failure mode: as training maximizes self-consistency, output diversity collapses, causing the model to confidently reinforce systematic errors that evade detection. We term this the consensus trap. To escape it, we propose CoVerRL, a framework where a single model alternates between generator and verifier roles, with each capability bootstrapping the other. Majority voting provides noisy but informative supervision for training the verifier, while the improving verifier progressively filters self-consistent errors from pseudo-labels. This co-evolution creates a virtuous cycle that maintains high reward accuracy throughout training. Experiments across Qwen and Llama model families demonstrate that CoVerRL outperforms label-free baselines by 4.7-5.9% on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Moreover, self-verification accuracy improves from around 55% to over 85%, confirming that both capabilities genuinely co-evolve.
papers.abstract_zh: 无标签强化学习使得大语言模型能够在没有真实监督的情况下提升推理能力，通常是通过将多数投票得出的答案视为伪标签来实现。然而，我们发现了一个关键的问题：在训练过程中，由于模型追求自我一致性，输出的多样性会下降，导致模型不断强化那些难以被发现的系统性错误。我们将这种现象称为“共识陷阱”。为了摆脱这一困境，我们提出了CoVerRL框架——该框架中，单个模型同时承担生成器和验证器的角色，每种功能都反过来促进另一种功能的提升。多数投票为验证器提供了噪声但富有信息量的监督数据，而不断改进的验证器则能够逐步过滤掉伪标签中的自我一致错误。这种协同进化机制形成了一个良性循环，使模型在整个训练过程中都能保持高精度的奖励效果。在Qwen和Llama模型系列上的实验表明，CoVerRL在数学推理基准测试中的表现比无标签的基线方法高出4.7%到5.9%。此外，自我验证的准确性也从大约55%提升到了超过85%，这充分证明了这两种功能确实是协同进化的。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Weights to Activations: Is Steering the Next Frontier of Adaptation?
papers.title_zh: 从权重计算到激活过程：引导适应性的新方向究竟是什么？
papers.authors: Simon Ostermann, Daniil Gurgurov, Tanja Baeumel, Michael A. Hedderich, Sebastian Lapuschkin, Wojciech Samek, Vera Schmitt
papers.abstract: Post-training adaptation of large language models is commonly achieved through parameter updates or input based methods such as fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, and prompting. In parallel, a growing body of work modifies internal activations at inference time to influence model behavior, an approach known as steering. Despite increasing use, steering is rarely analyzed within the same conceptual framework as established adaptation methods.In this work, we argue that steering should be regarded as a form of model adaptation. We introduce a set of functional criteria for adaptation methods and use them to compare steering approaches with classical alternatives. This analysis positions steering as a distinct adaptation paradigm based on targeted interventions in activation space, enabling local and reversible behavioral change without parameter updates. The resulting framing clarifies how steering relates to existing methods, motivating a unified taxonomy for model adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的训练后适配通常是通过参数更新或基于输入的方法来实现的，例如微调、参数高效适配和提示法。与此同时，越来越多的研究尝试在推理时修改内部激活值以影响模型的行为，这种方法被称为“引导”。尽管引导方法被广泛应用，但很少能在与现有适配方法相同的概念框架下进行分析。在这项研究中，我们认为引导应该被视为一种模型适配形式。我们提出了一套用于评估适配方法的功能性标准，并利用这些标准来比较引导方法与传统方法。这一分析表明，引导是一种独特的适配范式，它通过对激活空间进行有针对性的干预，能够实现无需参数更新的局部且可逆的行为改变。这种框架清晰地展示了引导与现有方法之间的关系，并为模型适配提供了一个统一的分类体系。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Can LLMs Act as Historians? Evaluating Historical Research Capabilities of LLMs via the Chinese Imperial Examination
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能充当历史学家吗？通过中国科举考试来评估大型语言模型的历史研究能力
papers.authors: Lirong Gao, Zeqing Wang, Yuyan Cai, Jiayi Deng, Yanmei Gu, Yiming Zhang, Jia Zhou, Yanfei Zhang, Junbo Zhao
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have increasingly assisted in historical tasks such as text processing, their capacity for professional-level historical reasoning remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks primarily assess basic knowledge breadth or lexical understanding, failing to capture the higher-order skills—such as evidentiary reasoning—that are central to historical research. To fill this gap, we introduce ProHist-Bench, a novel benchmark anchored in the Chinese Imperial Examination (Keju) system—a comprehensive microcosm of East Asian political, social, and intellectual history spanning over 1,300 years. Developed through deep interdisciplinary collaboration, ProHist-Bench features 400 challenging, expert-curated questions across eight dynasties, accompanied by 10,891 fine-grained evaluation rubrics. Through a rigorous evaluation of 18 LLMs, we reveal a significant proficiency gap: even state-of-the-art LLMs struggle with complex historical research questions. We hope ProHist-Bench will facilitate the development of domain-specific reasoning LLMs, advance computational historical research, and further uncover the untapped potential of LLMs. We release ProHist-Bench at https://github.com/inclusionAI/ABench/tree/main/ProHist-Bench.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在文本处理等历史任务上发挥着越来越重要的作用，但它们在专业级别的历史推理能力方面仍未被充分探索。现有的评估基准主要侧重于基础知识广度或词汇理解能力，而未能涵盖那些对历史研究至关重要的高级技能，比如证据推理能力。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了ProHist-Bench这一新型评估基准。该基准以中国科举制度为基础，涵盖了1300多年东亚政治、社会和思想史的全面缩影。通过深入的跨学科合作开发而成的ProHist-Bench包含400道具有挑战性的、由专家精心挑选的问题，这些问题涉及八个朝代，同时还有10,891条详细的评估标准。通过对18种大语言模型的严格评估，我们发现了一个显著的熟练度差距：即使是最先进的大语言模型也难以应对复杂的历史研究问题。我们希望ProHist-Bench能够推动特定领域推理型大语言模型的发展，促进计算历史研究的进步，并进一步发掘大语言模型的潜在价值。您可以在https://github.com/inclusionAI/ABench/tree/main/ProHist-Bench下载该评估基准的源代码。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Less Languages, Less Tokens: An Efficient Unified Logic Cross-lingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Framework
papers.title_zh: 更少的语言，更少的代币：一种高效的、统一的跨语言逻辑推理框架
papers.authors: Chenyuan Zhang, Qiguang Chen, Xie Chen, Zhuotao Tian, Bowen Xing, Meishan Zhang, Libo Qin, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Cross-lingual chain-of-thought (XCoT) with self-consistency markedly enhances multilingual reasoning, yet existing methods remain costly due to extensive sampling of full trajectories across languages. Moreover, multilingual LLM representations vary strongly by language, hindering direct feature comparisons and effective pruning. To address this, we introduce UL-XCoT, the first efficient unified logic cross-lingual reasoning framework that minimizes redundancy in token usage and latency, yielding the greatest efficiency under limited sampling budgets during inference. Specifically, UL-XCoT (1) achieves less languages by selecting, per query, a small candidate language set in a language-invariant unified logic space, (2) enables less tokens by monitoring logic-space trajectory dynamics during decoding to prune low-quality reasoning paths, and (3) aggregates the remaining high-quality trajectories via voting. Experiments on PolyMath across 18 languages with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B demonstrate that UL-XCoT achieves competitive accuracy while sharply cutting over 50% decoding token cost and latency versus prior sampling baselines. It also delivers more stable gains on low-resource languages, underscoring consistently superior robustness where standard XCoT self-consistency method fails.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨语言思维链（XCoT）结合自洽性机制能够显著提升多语言推理能力。然而，现有方法由于需要大量采样不同语言的完整推理路径，因此成本较高。此外，多语言大语言模型的表示方式因语言而异，这阻碍了特征间的直接比较以及有效的剪枝操作。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了UL-XCoT——首个高效的跨语言逻辑推理框架。该框架能够最小化令牌使用的冗余性和延迟，从而在有限的采样预算下实现最高的效率。具体来说，UL-XCoT通过以下方式实现高效推理：(1) 每次查询时，从语言统一的逻辑空间中选取少量候选语言，从而减少需要处理的语言数量；(2) 通过在解码过程中监控逻辑空间的动态变化来剪除质量较低的推理路径，从而减少所需的令牌数量；(3) 通过投票的方式整合剩余的高质量推理路径。在PolyMath平台上对18种语言进行实验后，使用DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B模型的结果表明，UL-XCoT在保持较高准确性的同时，将解码所需的令牌数量和延迟降低了超过50%。此外，该框架在资源匮乏的语言上也能表现出稳定的性能提升，充分体现了其在标准XCoT自洽性方法失效时的卓越鲁棒性。

papers.title: Embracing Anisotropy: Turning Massive Activations into Interpretable Control Knobs for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 拥抱各向异性：将大规模语言模型中的复杂行为转化为可解释的控制参数
papers.authors: Youngji Roh, Hyunjin Cho, Jaehyung Kim
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit highly anisotropic internal representations, often characterized by massive activations, a phenomenon where a small subset of feature dimensions possesses magnitudes significantly larger than the rest. While prior works view these extreme dimensions primarily as artifacts to be managed, we propose a distinct perspective: these dimensions serve as intrinsic interpretable functional units arising from domain specialization. Specifically, we propose a simple magnitude-based criterion to identify Domain-Critical Dimensions in a training-free manner. Our analyses reveal that such dimensions behave as interpretable semantic detectors for symbolic/quantitative patterns or domain-specific terms. In addition, we introduce Critical Dimension Steering, which applies activation steering exclusively to the identified dimensions. Empirical results show that this approach outperforms conventional whole-dimension steering in domain adaptation and jailbreaking scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）具有高度各向异性的内部表示特性，其显著特点是某些特征维度的激活值远大于其他维度。虽然以往的研究认为这些极端维度只是需要处理的伪影，但我们提出了不同的观点：这些维度实际上是源于特定领域特化的、具有可解释性的功能单元。具体来说，我们提出了一种基于大小的简单标准，无需训练即可识别出那些具有关键意义的维度。我们的分析表明，这些维度可以充当对符号化/量化模式或特定领域术语的可解释性检测工具。此外，我们还提出了“关键维度引导”技术，该技术专门针对那些被识别出的关键维度进行激活值的调整。实验结果表明，这种方法在领域适应和破解场景中优于传统的全维度引导方法。

papers.title: From Language to Driving: A Dual-Loop SLM-Enhanced Framework for Multi-Planner Scheduling via a Domain-Specific Language
papers.title_zh: 从语言到驾驶：一种基于双循环SLM的框架，用于多规划者调度问题，采用特定领域的语言进行描述
papers.authors: Jiawei Liu, Xun Gong, Muli Yang, Xingrui Yu, Fen Fang, Xulei Yang, Ivor Tsang, Yunfeng hu, Hong Chen, Qing Guo
papers.abstract: Advancing from usable to collaborative autonomy requires driving systems to execute passenger instructions safely and reliably. This work formulates instruction realization as scheduling across multiple motion planners and presents a dual-loop framework that provides a transparent decision chain from natural language to vehicle control. The outer loop uses a small language model (SLM) for high-level, low-frequency semantic reasoning and schedule generation, while the inner loop performs low-level, high-frequency schedule execution and vehicle control. To compensate for the SLM’s limited capacity, the framework integrates receding-horizon scheduling to segment long-horizon instruction tasks, a domain-specific language (DSL) that restricts SLM outputs to a scheduling-oriented subspace, and reinforcement learning in high-fidelity urban traffic to refine the SLM’s DSL proficiency and scheduling performance. Experiments show that the framework improves instruction-completion rates while maintaining high safety and compliance relative to multiple baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 从可操作状态发展到协作型自主驾驶，需要驱动系统能够安全、可靠地执行乘客的指令。本研究将指令执行过程分解为多个运动规划器的调度任务，并提出了一种双环框架，该框架实现了从自然语言到车辆控制的透明决策链。外环使用小型语言模型进行高级、低频的语义推理和调度生成；内环则负责低级别、高频的调度执行和车辆控制。为了弥补小型语言模型的局限性，该框架采用了滚动视野调度技术来处理长期指令任务，同时利用领域特定语言将小型语言模型的输出限制在与调度相关的子空间内。此外，还通过高保真城市交通场景下的强化学习来提升小型语言模型在处理领域特定语言时的性能与调度效率。实验表明，该框架在保持高安全性和合规性的同时，显著提升了指令完成的效率，相较于多个基准测试，其表现更为出色。

papers.title: One Cognitive Loop Is Enough: SODA unlocks Pure-Text Spatial Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 一个认知循环就足够了：SODA能够解锁大型语言模型中的纯文本空间推理能力
papers.authors: Shunwen Bai, Jiahuan Zhang, Haoran Huang, Yurun Wang, Jiale Liu, Yanxi Wu, Ningzhe Yu, Yudong Gao, Mingjun Cheng
papers.abstract: Currently, large language models (LLMs) have significant limitations in spatial reasoning, particularly in the absence of visual input. To address this issue, we introduce SODA (Spatial OODA), which draws inspiration from the OODA cognitive loop (Observe, Orient, Decide, Act), originally designed to enhance human decision-making in dynamic environments. Specifically, we embed the OODA loop into multiple control tasks, generating the SPOD-143k dataset, and successfully integrate it into LLMs through a two-phase and spatia-aware training strategy (SFT and GRPO). Furthermore, to fill the gap in evaluating spatial reasoning in purely text-based LLMs, we introduce the SPOD-Bench benchmark, including multiple tasks divided into three levels of difficulty. Experimental results show that SODA significantly enhances the spatial reasoning capabilities of LLMs across testing scenarios including SPOD-Bench, SPACE and applications, providing a replicable and effective paradigm for improving the spatial cognition of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，大语言模型在空间推理方面存在显著局限性，尤其是在缺乏视觉输入的情况下。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SODA算法。该算法借鉴了OODA认知循环（观察、定位、决策、行动），这一循环最初是为了帮助人类在动态环境中做出更好的决策而设计的。具体来说，我们将OODA循环融入多个控制任务中，从而生成了SPOD-143k数据集。随后，我们通过一个两阶段且考虑空间因素的训练策略，成功地将该算法整合到大语言模型中。此外，为了填补在纯文本基础上评估大语言模型空间推理能力的空白，我们开发了SPOD-Bench基准测试，该测试包含多个任务，这些任务分为三个难度级别。实验结果表明，SODA算法显著提升了大语言模型在空间推理方面的能力，无论是在SPOD-Bench还是其他应用场景中都能看到其效果。这为改进大语言模型的空间认知能力提供了一种可复制且有效的方法。

papers.title: Compatibility-Aware Dynamic Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 考虑兼容性的动态微调技术，适用于大型语言模型
papers.authors: Yucheng Zhou, Junwei Sheng, Qianning Wang, Jianbing Shen
papers.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the predominant paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs), yet it suffers from optimization instability and limited generalization. Recent work attributes this issue to pathological gradient scaling and proposes Dynamic Fine-Tuning (DFT) to correct it at the token level. However, DFT assumes all demonstrations are equally suitable learning targets, an assumption violated by the strong heterogeneity of large-scale instruction data, where demonstration-policy mismatch induces high-variance updates at the sample level. We introduce Compatibility-Aware Dynamic Fine-Tuning (CADFT), a principled extension of DFT that controls sample-level optimization variance. CADFT derives a dynamic, policy-dependent compatibility signal from model likelihoods to modulate supervised updates, suppressing high-variance gradients from incompatible demonstrations. We further propose a delayed, low-frequency compatibility-guided rewriting strategy to transform persistently incompatible demonstrations into learnable targets. We show that CADFT can be interpreted as a variance-controlled estimator that generalizes token-level stabilization in DFT to the sample level. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved stability, generalization, and cold-start reinforcement learning initialization, while remaining fully supervised and free of reward modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 监督式微调（SFT）是对齐大语言模型的主要方法，但它存在优化不稳定性和泛化能力有限的问题。近期的研究认为这一问题源于病态的梯度缩放现象，并提出了动态式微调（DFT）方法来在令牌级别进行修正。然而，DFT假设所有示范数据都同样适合作为学习目标，而大规模指令数据的高度异质性使得这一假设无法成立，因为示范数据与策略之间的不匹配会在样本级别引发高方差的更新。我们提出了一种名为“兼容性感知动态式微调”（CADFT）的方法，它是DFT的一种原理性扩展，能够控制样本级别的优化方差。CADFT从模型概率分布中推导出动态的、依赖于策略的兼容性信号，以调节监督式更新，从而抑制来自不兼容示范的高方差梯度。我们还提出了一种延迟式的、低频的、基于兼容性的重写策略，用于将持续不兼容的示范数据转化为可学习的目标。我们的研究表明，CADFT可以被视为一种方差控制的估计器，它将DFT中的令牌级稳定性概念推广到了样本级别。大量的实验表明，采用CADFT方法能够获得更好的稳定性、泛化能力，以及更有效的冷启动强化学习初始化效果，同时仍然保持完全监督式的处理方式，且无需进行奖励建模。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Spectral Characterization and Mitigation of Sequential Knowledge Editing Collapse
papers.title_zh: 序列知识编辑崩溃的光谱特征分析与缓解策略
papers.authors: Chi Zhang, Mengqi Zhang, Xiaotian Ye, Runxi Cheng, Zisheng Zhou, Ying Zhou, Pengjie Ren, Zhumin Chen
papers.abstract: Sequential knowledge editing in large language models often causes catastrophic collapse of the model’s general abilities, especially for parameter-modifying methods. Existing approaches mitigate this issue through heuristic constraints on parameter updates, the mechanisms underlying such degradation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we present a systematic spectral analysis of sequential knowledge editing and show that a model’s general abilities are closely associated with dominant singular directions of pretrained weight matrices. These directions are highly sensitive to perturbations and are progressively disrupted by repeated edits, closely tracking the collapse in both editing efficacy and general performance. Building on this insight, we propose REVIVE, a plug-and-play framework that prevents model collapse by explicitly preserving this dominant subspace. REVIVE analyzes parameter updates in the spectral basis of the original weights and filters out components that would interfere with the dominant subspace. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks show that REVIVE consistently improves editing efficacy while substantially preserving general abilities under long-horizon sequential editing, including extreme settings with up to 20,000 edits.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中，顺序知识编辑常常会导致模型整体能力的灾难性崩溃，尤其是在采用参数修改方法的情况下。现有的方法通过针对参数更新的启发式约束来缓解这个问题，但导致这种性能下降的机制仍然缺乏深入的理解。在这项研究中，我们对顺序知识编辑进行了系统的分析，发现模型的整体能力与预训练权重矩阵中的主导奇异方向密切相关。这些方向对干扰非常敏感，而重复编辑会逐步破坏这些方向，从而严重影响编辑效率和整体性能。基于这一发现，我们提出了REVIVE框架——一个即插式的解决方案，它通过明确保留这一主导子空间来防止模型崩溃。REVIVE会在原始权重的光谱基础上分析参数更新，并过滤掉那些会干扰主导子空间的成分。在多个模型和基准测试中的广泛实验表明，REVIVE能够持续提升编辑效率，同时在长时间序列编辑过程中显著保留了模型的整体能力，甚至能够在多达20,000次编辑的情况下依然保持良好的性能。

papers.title: SSA: Improving Performance With a Better Scoring Function
papers.title_zh: SSA：通过改进评分函数来提高性能
papers.authors: Omar Naim, Swarnadeep Bhar, Jerome Bolte, Nicholas Asher
papers.abstract: While transformer models exhibit strong in-context learning (ICL) abilities, they often fail to generalize under simple distribution shifts. We analyze these failures and identify Softmax, the scoring function in the attention mechanism, as a contributing factor. We propose Scaled Signed Averaging (SSA), a novel attention scoring function that mitigates these failures. SSA significantly improves performance on our ICL tasks and outperforms transformer models with Softmax on several NLP benchmarks and linguistic probing tasks, in both decoder-only and encoder-only architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然Transformer模型具有强大的上下文学习能力，但在简单的分布变化情况下，它们往往无法实现泛化。我们对这些失败现象进行了分析，并发现注意力机制中的得分函数——Softmax，是导致这种失败的一个因素。我们提出了一种名为“缩放符号平均法”的新得分函数，它能够有效缓解这些问题。在多个自然语言处理基准测试和语言探测任务中，SSA显著提升了Transformer模型的性能，其表现优于使用Softmax的Transformer模型，无论是在仅解码器架构还是仅编码器架构的情况下。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Think Better, Not Longer: Token-Level Marginal Utility for Efficient Reasoning in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 思考得更深入些，而非只是延长思考时间：在大型推理模型中，利用代币级边际效用来实现高效的推理
papers.authors: Jiawei Li, Yang Gao, Huashan Sun, Chong Feng
papers.abstract: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation, they frequently suffer from “overthinking”. In this work, we bridge this gap by introducing Token-level Marginal Utility, which quantifies the per-token log-probability gain of the ground-truth answer. Leveraging this dense supervision signal, we propose MUTO (Marginal Utility Guided Thinking Optimization), a unified training framework designed to synthesize concise reasoning chains. Rather than relying only on coarse trajectory-level length control, MUTO identifies tokens that reduce the model’s likelihood of the correct answer and penalizes such negative-utility reasoning, yielding concise yet effective CoT trajectories. Experiments on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen backbones (1.5B and 7B) across six math reasoning benchmarks show that MUTO yields a markedly better efficiency-accuracy Pareto frontier. It reduces average token usage by 87.1% at 1.5B while improving accuracy by 2.3%, and cuts tokens by 80.2% at 7B with only -0.1% accuracy change, achieving the best length-normalized accuracy among baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大型推理模型在通过显式思维链生成方面展现出了卓越的能力，但它们常常会出现“过度思考”的问题。在这项研究中，我们通过引入令牌级边际效用来填补这一空白。令牌级边际效用能够量化每个令牌对真实答案的log概率增益。利用这种密集的监督信号，我们提出了MUTO（边际效用引导的思维优化）这一统一训练框架，该框架旨在合成简洁的推理链条。MUTO不仅依赖于粗略的轨迹长度控制，还会识别出那些降低模型对正确答案可能性的令牌，并对这种负效用的推理进行惩罚，从而得出简洁而有效的思维链。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen基础模型上进行的实验表明，MUTO在效率与准确性之间取得了更好的平衡。在1.5B参数的模型中，MUTO将平均令牌使用量减少了87.1%，同时提高了2.3%的准确率；在7B参数的模型中，MUTO将令牌使用量减少了80.2%，而准确率仅下降了0.1%。与基准模型相比，MUTO在长度归一化的准确率方面表现最佳。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AgentSlimming: Towards Efficient and Cost-Aware Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: AgentSlimming：迈向高效且成本优化的多智能体系统
papers.authors: Yulang Chen, Haoxuan Peng, Jinyan Liu, Zichen Wen, Dongrui Liu, Linfeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex tasks. However, manually designing optimal communication topologies is labor-intensive, while automated expansion methods often result in bloated structures with redundant agents, leading to excessive token consumption. To address this problem, we introduce AgentSlimming, a plug-and-play compression framework for graph-structured multi-agent workflows. Motivated by the AgentPruner and AgentQuant in neural networks, AgentSlimming compresses workflows by firstly estimate the importance score of each agent with a hybrid mechanism, and then removing redundant agents or replacing them with low-cost ones, where each operation is then validated with a baseline-anchored acceptance rule to prevent performance collapse. Experiments show that AgentSlimming reduces average token cost by up to 78.9% with negligible performance degradation, and even sometimes improves accuracy, achieving a strong Pareto-optimal trade-off between cost and quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在复杂任务中展现出了卓越的能力。然而，手动设计最优的通信拓扑结构是一项劳动密集型工作，而自动扩展方法往往会导致结构臃肿，出现冗余智能体，从而导致过多的资源消耗。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了AgentSlimming——一种适用于图结构多智能体工作流程的即插即用压缩框架。该框架借鉴了神经网络中的AgentPruner和AgentQuant技术，通过混合机制首先评估每个智能体的重要性，然后去除冗余的智能体或用成本较低的智能体替代它们。每个操作都通过基于基准值的接受规则进行验证，以防止性能下降。实验表明，AgentSlimming可以将平均令牌成本降低高达78.9%，同时几乎不会造成性能下降，甚至有时还能提高准确性，实现了成本与质量之间的强帕累托最优权衡。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Reusable Experiences: Latent Routing and Modular Composition in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 可重复使用的体验：大语言模型中的潜在路由与模块化组合技术
papers.authors: Shuai Ling, Lizi Liao, Dongmei Jiang, Weili Guan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have remarkable capabilities, but adapting them to specialized domains poses a fundamental question: how should accumulated experience be represented and leveraged? Existing approaches represent experience either as explicit textual artifacts in prompts (e.g., retrieved documents or dialogues) or implicitly within model weights via fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA adapters). However, textual methods are limited by context windows and cannot internalize knowledge, while parametric fine-tuning yields one adapter per task with minimal cross-task skill reuse. We propose ReX (Reusable eXperience), an experience-centric adaptation framework that treats latent experiences — recurring reasoning patterns and skills — as fundamental units for LLM specialization. Our method learns a shared Experience Bank of foundational skill vectors and uses a VAE-based encoder to map each input to a low-dimensional experience code. An Experience Router then dynamically composes the relevant skill vectors from this bank into a lightweight adapter for that input. By reusing skills across inputs, ReX enables implicit knowledge sharing across tasks without any explicit task identifiers. Experiments on multi-task NLP benchmarks show that this approach outperforms standard task-specific fine-tuning, yielding improved generalization through flexible skill reuse. Code is available at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/ACL26-ReX.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型具有出色的能力，但将其适配到特定领域时存在一个基本问题：积累的经验应该如何被表示和利用呢？现有的方法要么在提示中显式地呈现经验（例如，检索到的文档或对话），要么通过微调将经验隐式地体现在模型权重中（例如，LoRA适配器）。然而，文本方法受到上下文窗口的限制，无法内化知识；而参数化微调则为每个任务提供一个适配器，但无法实现跨任务的技能重用。我们提出了ReX——一种以经验为中心的适配框架，它将潜在的经验——即重复的推理模式和技能——视为语言模型专业化的基本单元。我们的方法学习了一个包含基础技能向量的共享经验库，并使用基于VAE的编码器将每个输入映射到一个低维的经验代码。然后，经验路由器会从该库中动态提取相关的技能向量，并生成一个轻量级的适配器来适应该输入。通过在不同输入之间重用技能，ReX能够在没有任何显式任务标识符的情况下实现跨任务的隐性知识共享。在多任务自然语言处理基准测试中的实验表明，这种方法优于标准的任务特定微调，通过灵活的技能重用实现了更好的泛化能力。代码可在https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/ACL26-ReX获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Communicating in Emergent Language with an Induced Morphological Phrasebook
papers.title_zh: 使用这种新兴语言进行交流，同时借助现有的形态学词汇表来帮助理解语义
papers.authors: Brendon Boldt, David R. Mortensen
papers.abstract: We build rule-based emergent language (EL) agents using form-meaning mappings induced from ELs (“morphological phrasebooks”) and test their communicative performance in the EL environment with its neural network agents. This contributes three things: First, it assesses the quality of the morphemes discovered by the induction algorithm in situ, which we find to be effective for communicating in the EL. Second, it allows us to uncover morphosyntactic properties of EL through ablating the algorithms which induce and utilize morphemes, showing that the ELs rely on repetition as well as morpheme ordering to convey meaning. Third, we find that the normalized pointwise mutual information of forms and meanings in the morphemes serves as a metric of compositionality that is more closely correlated with the ability of the phrasebook-agents to “speak” and “hear” an EL than existing metrics such as topographic similarity.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们构建了基于规则的 emergent language（EL）代理，这些代理通过从 EL 中归纳出的形式-意义映射来运作。然后，我们在包含神经网络代理的 EL 环境中测试它们的交流能力。这样做有三大好处：首先，它能够评估由归纳算法在现场发现的词素的质量，我们发现这种方法来用于 EL 中的交流非常有效。其次，通过剥离负责归纳和利用词素的算法，我们可以揭示 EL 的形合属性，这表明 EL 依靠重复和词素排序来传达意义。第三，我们发现，形式与意义之间的归一化点互信息可以作为组合性的度量标准，这一指标与短语书代理“说话”和“听”EL的能力更为相关，而现有的度量标准如拓扑相似性则不够准确。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Controllable Contamination Detection for Reliable LLM Evaluation with Statistical Guarantees
papers.title_zh: 可控制的污染检测，以实现对大型语言模型评估的可靠性保障，并具备统计上的可靠性保证
papers.authors: Zheng Zhang, Qi Liu, Siyuan Liang, Ning Li, Zirui Hu, Weibo Gao, Rui Li, Zhenya Huang, Leszek Rutkowski, Baosheng Yu, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across diverse tasks, largely driven by large-scale pretraining. However, this data abundance introduces test data contamination, where benchmark datasets overlap with pretraining corpora, undermining the reliability of model evaluation by confounding memorization with genuine generalization. To mitigate this issue, existing training data detectors attempt to identify clean (unseen) samples from contaminated test sets, but often suffer from residual contamination due to the black-box nature of LLMs. As a result, contaminated data may be mistakenly retained, leading to unreliable evaluation.To address this challenge, we propose FTD (FDR-controlled Training Data detection), a principled framework that detects and filters contaminated evaluation data while providing a statistical guarantee: the proportion of contaminated samples mistakenly retained as clean, the false discovery rate (FDR), is provably controlled below a user-specified threshold. FTD combines multiple complementary detectors via an adaptive weighting strategy, and we theoretically show it achieves high statistical power under valid FDR control. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that FTD significantly reduces residual contamination compared to existing methods while preserving evaluation consistency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在各类任务中取得了显著的性能表现，这主要得益于大规模预训练。然而，这种数据丰富性也带来了测试数据污染的问题，即基准数据集与预训练语料库存在重叠，这使得模型评估的可靠性受到威胁，因为记忆能力与真正的泛化能力被混淆了。为了缓解这一问题，现有的训练数据检测算法试图从受污染的测试集中识别出干净的样本，但由于语言模型的黑箱特性，这些算法往往仍会遭受残留污染。结果就是，受污染的数据可能会被错误地保留下来，从而导致不可靠的评估结果。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了FTD（FDR控制的训练数据检测）这一框架。该框架能够检测并过滤掉受污染的评估数据，同时提供统计上的保证：被错误识别为干净样本的受污染样本比例，即假发现率（FDR），可以被证明控制在用户指定的阈值以下。FTD通过自适应加权策略结合多种互补的检测方法，我们在理论上证明了它在有效的FDR控制下能够实现高统计精度。在真实世界的基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，与现有方法相比，FTD显著减少了残留污染，同时保持了评估的一致性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From 1,000,000 Users to Every User: Scaling Up Personalized Preference for User-level Alignment
papers.title_zh: 从 100 万用户到每位用户：扩展个性化偏好以实现用户级对齐
papers.authors: Jia-Nan Li, Jian Guan, Songhao Wu, Wei Wu, Rui Yan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have traditionally been aligned through one-size-fits-all approaches that assume uniform human preferences, fundamentally overlooking the diversity in user values and needs. This paper introduces a comprehensive framework for scalable personalized alignment of LLMs. We establish a systematic preference space characterizing psychological and behavioral dimensions, alongside diverse persona representations for robust preference inference in real-world scenarios. Building upon this foundation, we introduce AlignX, a large-scale dataset of over 1.3 million personalized preference examples, and develop two complementary alignment approaches: in-context alignment directly conditioning on persona representations and preference-bridged alignment modeling intermediate preference distributions. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over existing methods, with an average 17.06% accuracy gain across four benchmarks while exhibiting a strong adaptation capability to novel preferences, robustness to limited user data, and precise preference controllability. These results validate our approach toward user-adaptive AI systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）传统上是通过一种“一刀切”的方法进行对齐的，这种方法假设人类偏好是统一的，从而完全忽略了用户价值观和需求的多样性。本文提出了一个可扩展的个性化对齐框架，用于优化LLM的适配性。我们建立了一个系统化的偏好空间，涵盖了心理和行为层面的特征，同时提供了多种人物表征方式，以便在现实场景中实现精确的偏好推断。在此基础上，我们引入了AlignX这一包含超过130万个个性化偏好样本的大规模数据集，并开发了两种互补的对齐方法：一种是基于人物表征的直接上下文对齐方法，另一种则是通过建模中间偏好分布来实现的对齐方法。大量实验表明，我们的方法相较于现有方法取得了显著的改进——在四个基准测试中的准确率平均提升了17.06%。此外，该方法还表现出强大的适应性，能够适应新的偏好需求，即使在有限的用户数据情况下也能保持稳定性能，并且能够实现精确的偏好控制。这些结果验证了我们的方法在构建用户自适应AI系统方面的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Atomic Characters: Glyph-Aware Sub-character Alignment for Low-Resource Multilingual OCR
papers.title_zh: 超越原子级字符：基于字形识别的子角色对齐技术，适用于资源有限的多语言OCR系统
papers.authors: Mengxiao Zhu, Haixu Chen, Jiu Sha, Jie Liu, Ge Shi
papers.abstract: Low-resource multilingual OCR faces a dual challenge: complex script structures and severe data scarcity. In such settings, existing OCR models often struggle, as coarse visual representations combined with weak linguistic priors lead to frequent errors among visually similar characters.To address this, we present BASA (Beyond Atomic Sub-character Alignment), a OCR framework built upon high-resolution visual and language backbones with a novel glyph-aware interface. The core technical contribution is the Glyph-Aware Fine-grained Adapter (GAFA). Unlike standard linear projectors, GAFA employs learnable glyph prototypes to actively align sub-character structural primitives (e.g., strokes and radicals) with visual features, explicitly resolving topological ambiguities during vision–language alignment. To complement this, we introduce a two-stage curriculum learning strategy supported by a Glyph-Aware Reverse Synthesis pipeline, which generates large-scale multilingual training corpora with automatic, zero-cost component labels. Furthermore, we construct BASA-Bench, a representative benchmark spanning 11 languages with diverse script structures and 23 authentic scenarios. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves consistent improvements over strong OCR baselines, particularly on scripts with complex compositions. Our model and benchmark will be available at https://github.com/NcutLLM/BASA.
papers.abstract_zh: 低资源环境下的多语言OCR面临着双重挑战：复杂的字形结构和严重的数据匮乏问题。在这种情况下，现有的OCR模型往往难以胜任，因为粗略的视觉表征与薄弱的语言先验知识相结合，会导致在外观相似的字符之间出现频繁的错误。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了BASA（Beyond Atomic Sub-character Alignment）框架。该框架基于高分辨率的视觉和语言基础，并采用了一种创新的字形感知接口。其核心技术贡献是Glyph-Aware Fine-grained Adapter（GAFA）。与标准的线性投影方法不同，GAFA利用可学习的字形原型来主动地将子字符结构元素（如笔画和部首）与视觉特征进行对齐，从而在视觉与语言对齐过程中明确解决拓扑上的歧义。此外，我们还引入了一种两阶段的学习策略，该策略由Glyph-Aware Reverse Synthesis流程支持，能够生成大规模的多语言训练语料库，并自动为各个组成部分赋予标签，而无需额外的成本投入。我们还构建了BASA-Bench基准测试，该测试涵盖了11种具有不同字形结构的语言，以及23种真实场景。实验结果表明，BASA在复杂字形的情况下仍能取得显著的改进效果。我们的模型和基准测试可以在https://github.com/NcutLLM/BASA上获取。

papers.title: Why Supervised Fine-Tuning Fails to Learn: A Systematic Study of Incomplete Learning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 为什么监督式微调会失败：对大型语言模型中不完全学习现象的系统研究
papers.authors: Chao Xue, Yao Wang, Mengqiao Liu, Di Liang, Xingsheng Han, Peiyang Liu, Xianjie Wu, Chenyao Lu, Lei Jiang, Yu Lu, Haibo Shi, Shuang Liang, Minlong Peng, Flora D. Salim
papers.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the standard approach for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, we observe a persistent failure mode: even after convergence, models often fail to correctly reproduce a subset of their own supervised training data. We refer to this behavior as the Incomplete Learning Phenomenon (ILP). This paper presents the first systematic study of ILP in LLM fine-tuning. We formalize ILP as post-training failure to internalize supervised instances and demonstrate its prevalence across multiple model families, domains, and datasets. Through controlled analyses, we identify five recurrent sources of incomplete learning: (1) missing prerequisite knowledge in the pre-trained model, (2) conflicts between SFT supervision and pre-training knowledge, (3) internal inconsistencies within SFT data, (4) left-side forgetting during sequential fine-tuning, and (5) insufficient optimization for rare or complex patterns. We introduce a diagnostic-first framework that maps unlearned samples to these causes using observable training and inference signals, and study several targeted mitigation strategies as causal interventions. Experiments on Qwen, LLaMA, and OLMo2 show that incomplete learning is widespread and heterogeneous, and that improvements in aggregate metrics can mask persistent unlearned subsets. The findings highlight the need for fine-grained diagnosis of what supervised fine-tuning fails to learn, and why.
papers.abstract_zh: 监督式微调（SFT）是使大语言模型适应下游任务的标准方法。然而，我们发现一个持续存在的缺陷：即使模型已经收敛，它们仍然无法正确复现部分自己的监督训练数据。我们将这种行为称为“不完全学习现象”（ILP）。本文首次系统研究了LLM微调中的ILP问题。我们将ILP定义为训练后的失败现象，以揭示模型在内部对监督数据的缺失情况，并证明这种现象在多种模型类型、领域和数据集中都普遍存在。通过控制实验分析，我们发现了五个导致不完全学习的常见原因：(1)预训练模型中缺少必要的先验知识；(2)SFT监督内容与预训练知识之间存在冲突；(3)SFT数据内部的矛盾性；(4)在序列微调过程中左侧信息的遗忘；(5)对于罕见或复杂模式的优化不足。我们提出了一种基于诊断的框架，该框架利用可观测的训练和推理信号来识别这些导致不完全学习的原因，并研究了几种针对性的缓解策略。在Qwen、LLaMA和OLMo2上的实验表明，不完全学习现象普遍存在且形式多样，而整体指标的改进可能会掩盖那些未被充分学习的部分。这些发现强调了需要对监督式微调未能学习到什么内容以及为何出现这种情况进行细致的诊断分析。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: KnowMe-Bench: Benchmarking Person Understanding for Lifelong Digital Companions
papers.title_zh: KnowMe-Bench：针对终身数字伴侣角色的认知评估基准制定
papers.authors: Tingyu Wu, Zhisheng Chen, Ziyan Weng, Shuhe Wang, Shuo Zhang, Sen Hu, Silin Wu, Qizhen Lan, Huacan Wang, Ronghao Chen
papers.abstract: Existing long-horizon memory benchmarks mostly use multi-turn dialogues or synthetic user histories, which makes retrieval performance an imperfect proxy for person understanding. We present Knowme-Bench, a publicly releasable benchmark built from long-form autobiographical narratives, where actions, context, and inner thoughts provide dense evidence for inferring stable motivations and decision principles. Knowme-Bench reconstructs each narrative into a flashback-aware, time-anchored stream and evaluates models with evidence-linked questions spanning factual recall, subjective state attribution, and principle-level reasoning. Across diverse narrative sources, retrieval-augmented systems mainly improve factual accuracy, while errors persist on temporally grounded explanations and higher-level inferences, highlighting the need for memory mechanisms beyond retrieval.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的长期记忆评估基准大多采用多轮对话或合成用户历史数据，这使得检索性能无法完全反映对个人的理解能力。我们提出了Knowme-Bench这一公开可用的评估基准，该基准基于长篇自传体叙述构建。在这种评估方式中，行为、上下文以及内心想法为推断稳定的动机和决策原则提供了丰富的线索。Knowme-Bench将每个叙述转化为一种具有时间顺序的叙事形式，并通过与叙述相关的提问来评估模型的能力，这些提问涵盖了事实回忆、主观状态归因以及原则层面的推理等方面。从不同的叙述来源来看，经过改进的检索增强系统主要在事实准确性方面取得了提升，但在时间上的解释以及更高层次的推理方面仍然存在问题，这凸显了需要超越单纯检索机制的记忆机制。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PersonalityDBench: A Dataset for Personality Disorders - from Modeling to Controlled Generation
papers.title_zh: PersonalityDBench：一种用于研究人格障碍的数据集——从模型构建到受控生成
papers.authors: Federico Ravenda, Seyed Ali Bahrainian, Daniele Montagnani, Antonietta Mira, Andrea Raballo
papers.abstract: Personality disorders (PDs) are a complex class of mental health (MH) conditions characterized by persistent patterns of cognition, behavior, and emotional regulation that deviate from cultural norms. While social media has become a valuable resource for MH research, NLP has largely focused on more prevalent conditions (e.g., depression), leaving PDs underexplored. In this work, we introduce PersonalityDBench, a large-scale, clinically grounded dataset that supports multidimensional study of personality pathology, and standardized, reproducible evaluation of LLM steering toward clinically grounded behavioral targets. The dataset comprises two parts: (1) PRISMA and (2) PersonaDSteering. (1) PRISMA (PeRsonality dISorder MAnifestations) is a clinically annotated collection of social media content spanning the full spectrum of PDs. It links clinically validated diagnostic criteria and dimensional trait frameworks with computational annotation and analysis methods to support fine-grained, multidimensional study of how PDs manifests in naturalistic, free-form language. Building on PRISMA, (2) PersonaDSteering is a benchmark for LLM steering evaluation that operationalizes clinically grounded PD profiles into structured behavioral elicitation tasks, enabling multidimensional steerability assessment beyond single-behavior settings and supporting PD-consistent persona construction for simulated patient generation. This dataset may have application in the study and modeling of PD and powering personality-specific text generation for adaptive, personalized chat systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 人格障碍是一类复杂的心理健康问题，其特征是认知、行为和情绪调节模式持续偏离文化规范。虽然社交媒体已成为心理健康研究的重要资源，但自然语言处理技术主要集中在更常见的疾病上（如抑郁症），而人格障碍则被忽视了。在这项研究中，我们引入了PersonalityDBench这一大规模、基于临床的数据集，它能够多维地研究人格障碍的表现，并标准化、可重复地评估大语言模型如何引导用户执行符合临床标准的行为动作。该数据集包含两部分：(1) PRISMA，这是一组经过临床验证的社交媒体内容集合，涵盖了所有类型的人格障碍；(2) PersonaDSteering，这是一个用于评估大语言模型引导行为的基准测试，它将临床定义的人格障碍特征转化为结构化的行为任务，从而能够多维地评估行为引导能力，而不仅仅是单一行为场景下的评估。该数据集在研究和建模人格障碍方面具有应用价值，还可以用于生成符合人格特征的文本，为自适应、个性化的聊天系统提供支持。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Towards Interpretable Tabular Reasoning: Enhancing LLM Reasoning on Tabular Data with Pre-Constructed Logic Graph
papers.title_zh: 迈向可解释的表格推理：通过预构建的逻辑图表提升大语言模型对表格数据的推理能力
papers.authors: Lirong Gao, Zewei Yu, Zhongrui Yin, Qi Zhang, Yuke Zhu, Bo Zheng, Haobo Wang, Junbo Zhao, Gang Chen, Sheng Guo
papers.abstract: Tabular data is widely used in fields such as finance and healthcare. Traditional tree-based models are prevalent for tabular prediction tasks due to their ability to handle heterogeneous features. However, their heavy reliance on feature engineering limits both their generalizability and their human-readable interpretability. On the other hand, Large Language Models (LLMs) naturally provide intermediate reasoning steps, thus offering greater transparency in decision-making. Nevertheless, LLMs often fail to match the predictive performance of tree-based models on tabular data. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Logic-Graph-Enhanced LLM Reasoning (LogGER) framework that integrates the strengths of tree-based models and LLMs. Specifically, we reformulate the traditional decision tree as a human-readable logic graph, which explicitly models the causal relationships between features and targets. This logic graph is automatically constructed using LLMs based on data priors and serves as the foundation for LogGER. To fully leverage the logic graph, we further introduce a logic-graph-guided process supervision approach, which evaluates and enhances the quality of LLM’s intermediate reasoning steps using logic-graph-aided process reward. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LogGER consistently outperforms both tree-based models and state-of-the-art LLM methods on a variety of tabular prediction tasks, achieving superior accuracy and interpretability.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格数据在金融和医疗保健等领域被广泛使用。由于能够处理异构特征，传统的基于树的模型在表格预测任务中占据主导地位。然而，它们对特征工程的高度依赖限制了模型的泛化能力和人类可理解性。另一方面，大语言模型自然提供了中间推理步骤，从而增加了决策过程的透明度。不过，大语言模型在表格数据上的预测性能往往无法与基于树的模型相媲美。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的逻辑图增强型大语言模型推理框架（LogGER），该框架结合了基于树的模型和大语言模型的优点。具体来说，我们将传统的决策树重新表述为人类可理解的逻辑图，从而明确模拟了特征与目标之间的因果关系。这个逻辑图是通过基于数据先验的大语言模型自动构建的，并作为LogGER的基础。为了充分利用逻辑图的优势，我们还引入了一种逻辑图引导的过程监督方法，该方法通过逻辑图辅助的过程奖励来评估并提升大语言模型中间推理步骤的质量。大量实验表明，LogGER在多种表格预测任务上始终优于基于树的模型和最先进的大语言模型方法，取得了更高的准确性和可理解性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
