papers.title: Beyond Explicit Refusals: Soft-Failure Attacks on Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 除了明确的拒绝行为之外：对检索增强生成方法的柔性失败攻击
papers.authors: Wentao Zhang, Yan Zhuang, ZhuHang Zheng, Mingfei Zhang, Jiawen Deng, Fuji Ren
papers.abstract: Existing jamming attacks on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems typically induce explicit refusals or denial-of-service behaviors, which are conspicuous and easy to detect. In this work, we formalize a subtler availability threat, termed soft failure, which degrades system utility by inducing fluent and coherent yet non-informative responses rather than overt failures. We propose Deceptive Evolutionary Jamming Attack (DEJA), an automated black-box attack framework that generates adversarial documents to trigger such soft failures by exploiting safety-aligned behaviors of large language models. DEJA employs an evolutionary optimization process guided by a fine-grained Answer Utility Score (AUS), computed via an LLM-based evaluator, to systematically undermine the certainty of answers while maintaining high retrieval success.Extensive experiments across multiple RAG configurations and benchmark datasets show that DEJA consistently drives responses toward low-utility soft failures and that the resulting adversarial documents maintain high stealth and effectiveness, proving resilient against common mitigation strategies including perplexity-based detection and input perturbations.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统的干扰攻击通常会导致明显的拒绝或服务中断行为，这些行为很容易被检测到。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种更为隐蔽的可用性威胁，即“软故障”。这种威胁通过引发流畅且连贯但缺乏信息量的响应来降低系统的性能，而不是出现明显的故障。我们提出了一种名为“欺骗性进化干扰攻击”（DEJA）的自动化黑盒攻击框架，该框架通过利用大语言模型的安全相关行为，生成对抗性文档以触发此类软故障。DEJA采用一种基于进化优化的方法，该方法由基于LLM的评估器计算出的精细化的答案效用得分来指导，从而系统地破坏答案的确定性，同时保持较高的检索成功率。在多种RAG配置和基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，DEJA能够持续地将响应引导至低效度的软故障状态，而生成的对抗性文档则具有高度的隐蔽性和有效性，能够抵抗包括基于困惑度的检测和输入扰动在内的常见缓解策略。

papers.title: Compressing LLM Knowledge into Graph Representations for Text-attributed Graphs Learning
papers.title_zh: 将大语言模型的知识压缩成图表示形式，以便于用于文本属性图的学习
papers.authors: Runhuai Chen, Dian Shen, Dandan Zhang, Kaihong Huang, Linghui Meng, Beilun Wang
papers.abstract: Text-attributed graphs (TAGs) require jointly modeling relational structure and node-level text. Existing GNN-LLM approaches perform by incorporating large language models at inference time for processing the text attributes, resulting in costly deployment. More fundamentally, LLM knowledge is typically used in a sample-wise manner, leading to inefficient utilization across graph instances. In this work, we study how interactions with LLM embedding spaces affect graph representations, and show that projecting into the LLM space can learn better GNNs. That is to say, the knowledge encoded in LLM embeddings can be compressed into graph representations. Based on this insight, we propose a framework that internalizes LLM knowledge within graph models and supports inference-efficient TAG learning. Our framework employs a hierarchical Proxy-Purifier module with distribution-level regularization, using LLM embeddings only as training-time guidance. With this module, the model operates TAGs without invoking LLMs, achieving high efficiency as standard GNNs without LLMs. Notably, experiments on five popular TAG tasks further demonstrate that our method can also achieve consistent performance gains, in comparison to existing GNN-LLM approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本属性图（TAGs）需要同时建模关系结构和节点级文本。现有的GNN-LLM方法通过在推理时结合大语言模型来处理文本属性，这导致了较高的部署成本。更根本的问题是，LLM的知识通常是以样本为单位来使用的，这导致在图实例之间的利用效率低下。在这项研究中，我们探讨了与LLM嵌入空间的交互如何影响图的表示方式，并证明了将其投影到LLM空间中可以学习出更好的GNN结构。也就是说，LLM嵌入中编码的知识可以被压缩成图表示形式。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一个框架，该框架将LLM知识内置于图模型中，并支持高效的TAG学习。我们的框架采用了一种分层式的Proxy-Purifier模块，该模块采用分布级正则化技术，仅将LLM嵌入作为训练时的指导手段。通过这种模块，模型可以在不调用LLM的情况下进行TAG处理，从而实现与标准GNN相同的效率水平。值得注意的是，在五个常见的TAG任务上的实验进一步证明，与现有的GNN-LLM方法相比，我们的方法也能取得一致的性能提升。

papers.title: End-to-End Optimization of LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Search Systems via Heterogeneous-Group-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过基于异构群体的强化学习技术，对由大型语言模型驱动的多智能体搜索系统进行端到端优化
papers.authors: Guanzhong Chen, Shaoxiong Yang, Chao Li, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Zenglin Xu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are versatile, yet their deployment in complex real-world settings is limited by static knowledge cutoffs and the difficulty of producing controllable behavior within a single inference. Multi-agent search systems (MASS), which coordinate specialized LLM agents equipped with search tools, mitigate these issues via task decomposition and retrieval-augmented problem solving. However, optimizing LLMs for agent-specific roles remains labor-intensive with prompt engineering or supervised fine-tuning, motivating automated end-to-end training. Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) methods such as Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) typically depend on large critic networks to evaluate joint actions, leading to instability and high memory costs. We introduce Multi-Agent Heterogeneous Group Policy Optimization (MHGPO), which updates policies by estimating relative advantages across heterogeneous groups of multi-agent rollouts, shifting the optimization focus from local agent performance to global system success. We further study three group rollout sampling strategies to trade off sample efficiency and optimization quality. Experiments show that MHGPO captures implicit inter-agent dependencies and consistently outperforms strong baselines in both task performance and computational efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型具有广泛的应用潜力，但在复杂的现实环境中部署却受到静态知识限制以及难以产生可控行为的限制。多智能体搜索系统通过分解任务并利用检索增强式问题解决方法来解决这些问题。然而，为特定智能体角色优化语言模型仍然需要大量的工作，包括提示工程或监督式微调，因此自动端到端训练变得非常必要。现有的多智能体强化学习方法，如多智能体近端策略优化，通常依赖大型评论家网络来评估联合行动，这会导致不稳定性和高内存消耗。我们提出了多智能体异构群体策略优化方法，该方法通过估计不同智能体群体的相对优势来更新策略，从而将优化重点从局部智能体性能转移到全局系统成功上。我们还研究了三种群体采样策略，以在样本效率和优化质量之间找到平衡。实验表明，多智能体异构群体策略优化能够捕捉到隐式的智能体间依赖关系，并且在任务性能和计算效率方面始终优于其他强大的基线方法。

papers.title: Translation with Thought: Difficulty-Adaptive Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Domain Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: 基于强化学习的多领域机器翻译：自适应推理与难度调整机制
papers.authors: Yongshi Ye, Biao Fu, Chongxuan Huang, Yidong Chen, Xiaodong Shi
papers.abstract: Multi-domain machine translation (MDMT) poses a unique challenge due to varying levels of linguistic complexity across domains. Inspired by human translators’ ability to adapt reasoning effort based on difficulty, we propose TwT (Translation with Thought), a resource-rational framework that learns to modulate inference between intuitive and deliberate reasoning. TwT is trained in two stages: (1) supervised fine-tuning on difficulty-aware long chain-of-though traces distilled from DeepSeek-R1 and rewritten by GPT-4o to reflect human-like reasoning economy, and (2) reinforcement learning with a hybrid reward to optimize translation quality and reasoning efficiency. Evaluated on 15 benchmarks spanning in-domain and out-of-domain settings, as well as 3 seen and 59 unseen languages, with ablations across three backbone models, TwT-7B and TwT-14B outperform much larger SOTA reasoning models in translation quality, while reducing token usage by 32–60%. These results confirm that aligning translation behavior with cognitive principles enables robust generalization, high translation quality, and efficient reasoning in MDMT.
papers.abstract_zh: 多领域机器翻译（MDMT）面临着一个独特的挑战，因为不同领域之间的语言复杂性水平存在差异。受人类翻译员能够根据难度调整推理能力的启发，我们提出了TwT（带有思维处理的翻译）这一资源优化框架。该框架能够学会在直觉推理和理性推理之间实现有效的切换。TwT的训练分为两个阶段：（1）基于深度Seek-R1模型提取的、包含难度信息的长序列思维痕迹进行有监督的微调，这些序列由GPT-4o重新生成，以体现类似人类的推理效率；（2）采用混合奖励机制进行强化学习，从而优化翻译质量和推理效率。在15个基准测试中进行评估，这些测试涵盖了域内和域外场景，以及3种已知语言和59种未知语言。通过对比三种骨干模型，发现TwT-7B和TwT-14B在翻译质量方面表现优于大多数现有的先进推理模型，同时还能减少32%到60%的令牌使用量。这些结果证实，将翻译行为与认知原理相结合，能够实现MDMT中的稳健泛化能力、高翻译质量以及高效的推理性能。

papers.title: Segment, Embed, and Align: A Universal Recipe for Aligning Subtitles to Signing
papers.title_zh: 分割、嵌入与对齐：让字幕与口型同步的通用方法
papers.authors: Zifan Jiang, Youngjoon Jang, Liliane Momeni, Gül Varol, Sarah Ebling, Andrew Zisserman
papers.abstract: The goal of this work is to develop a universal approach for aligning subtitles (i.e., spoken language text with corresponding timestamps) to continuous sign language videos. Prior approaches typically rely on end-to-end training tied to a specific language or dataset, which limits their generality. In contrast, our method Segment, Embed, and Align (SEA) provides a single framework that works across multiple languages and domains. SEA leverages two pretrained models: the first to segment a video sequence into individual signs and the second to embed each sign video clip into a shared latent space with text. Alignment is subsequently performed with a lightweight dynamic programming procedure that runs efficiently on CPU within a minute, even for hour-long episodes. SEA is flexible and can adapt to a wide range of scenarios, utilizing resources from small lexicons to large continuous corpora. Experiments on four sign language datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art alignment performance, highlighting the potential of SEA to generate high-quality parallel data for advancing sign language processing.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究的目标是开发一种通用方法，用于将字幕（即口语文本及其对应的时间戳）与连续的手语视频进行对齐。以往的方法通常依赖于针对特定语言或数据集的端到端训练，这限制了它们的通用性。相比之下，我们的方法“分割、嵌入和对齐”（SEA）提供了一个适用于多种语言和领域的单一框架。SEA利用了两个预训练模型：第一个模型将视频序列分割成单独的手势；第二个模型则将每个手势视频片段嵌入到一个共享的潜在空间中，并与文本结合。对齐过程则通过一种轻量级的动态规划算法来完成，该算法可以在CPU上在分钟内高效完成，即便是长达一小时的视频片段也能如此处理。SEA具有灵活性，能够适应各种场景，从小型词汇表到大型连续语料库都能得到充分利用。在四个手语数据集上的实验表明，SEA在对齐性能方面达到了最先进的水平，这充分显示了SEA在生成高质量并行数据以推动手语处理发展方面的潜力。

papers.title: Understanding Emergent Misalignment via Feature Superposition Geometry
papers.title_zh: 通过特征叠加几何结构来理解出现的偏差问题
papers.authors: Gouki Minegishi, Hiroki Furuta, Takeshi Kojima, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo
papers.abstract: Emergent misalignment, where fine-tuning on narrow, non-harmful tasks induces harmful behaviors, poses a key challenge for AI safety in LLMs. Despite growing empirical evidence, its underlying mechanism remains unclear. To uncover the reason behind this phenomenon, we propose a mechanistic account based on the geometry of feature superposition. Because features are encoded in overlapping, fine-tuning that amplifies a target feature also unintentionally strengthens nearby harmful features in accordance with their similarity. We give a simple gradient-level derivation of this mechanism and empirically test it across multiple LLMs (Gemma-2 2B/9B/27B, LLaMA-3.1 8B, gpt-oss 20B). Using sparse autoencoders (SAEs), we identify features tied to misalignment-inducing data and to harmful behaviors, and show that they are geometrically closer to each other than features derived from non-inducing data. This trend generalizes across domains (e.g., health, career, legal advice). Finally, we show that a geometry-aware approach—filtering training samples nearest to toxic features—reduces misalignment by 34.5%, substantially outperforming random removal and achieving stronger mitigation than LLM-as-a-judge–based filtering. Our study explains emergent misalignment through feature superposition, providing a basis for understanding and mitigating this phenomenon.
papers.abstract_zh: 新兴的失调现象，即在对那些较为简单且不会造成危害的任务进行微调时，却会引发有害行为，这一现象对大语言模型的安全性构成了重大挑战。尽管有越来越多的实证证据支持这一现象，但其背后的机制仍然不清楚。为了揭示这种现象的原因，我们提出了一种基于特征叠加几何特性的机制解释。因为特征是以重叠的形式编码的，所以对目标特征的微调也会无意中增强附近有害特征的强度，这取决于这些特征之间的相似性。我们对这一机制进行了简单的梯度级推导，并通过多个大语言模型进行了实证测试（Gemma-2 2B/9B/27B、LaLaMA-3.1 8B、gpt-oss 20B）。利用稀疏自编码器，我们识别出与导致失调现象的数据以及有害行为相关的特征，并发现这些特征在几何上比来自非诱发数据的特征更为接近。这一趋势在不同领域中都得到了验证（例如，健康、职业、法律建议等领域）。最后，我们发现一种基于几何特性的方法——过滤掉与有害特征最邻近的训练样本——可以将失调现象减少34.5%，其效果明显优于随机移除方法，并且比基于语言模型作为裁判的过滤方法更能有效缓解失调现象。我们的研究通过特征叠加解释了这种新兴的失调现象，为理解和缓解这一现象提供了基础。

papers.title: MavenCoder: Competitive Code Generation via Model Adaptive Planning Strategies and Multi-Perspective Verification Enhancement
papers.title_zh: MavenCoder：通过模型自适应规划策略以及多视角验证机制，实现高效的代码生成
papers.authors: ZhenChun Xu, Yi Cai, Dajun Zheng, li Yuan, Mengchen Zhao, Qixiang Wang, Jiexin Wang
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), automated code generation has made remarkable progress. Recent studies explore multi-agent collaboration and adopt planning–coding–debugging workflows to enhance performance. However, these approaches are constrained by rigid, predefined workflows that fail to flexibly adjust their plans and lack effective verification of intermediate reasoning steps. In this work, we propose MavenCoder, a model-adaptive and verification–enhanced framework for competition-level code generation. MavenCoder leverages adaptive assessment aligned with the model’s capabilities to select planning strategies, while providing timely feedback and correction via multi-perspective verification. This adaptive problem-solving paradigm mitigates earlier limitations by enabling flexible planning and timely error correction. Compared with existing state-of-the-art approaches, MavenCoder achieves superior pass@1 results across multiple benchmarks, achieving 87.5% on LiveCodeBench, 93.9% on HumanEval+, 81.7% on MBPP+, and 46.1% on CodeContests, outperforming recent agent-based systems with improvement exceeding 3%–40%.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，自动代码生成技术也取得了显著进步。近期的研究探索了多智能体协作机制，并采用了规划-编码-调试的工作流程来提高性能。然而，这些方法受到固定预定义工作流程的限制，无法灵活调整计划，且缺乏对中间推理步骤的有效验证。在这项研究中，我们提出了MavenCoder——一个基于模型自适应且具备验证功能的代码生成框架。MavenCoder能够利用与模型能力相匹配的自适应评估机制来选择规划策略，同时通过多视角验证提供及时的反馈和修正。这种自适应问题解决范式克服了以往方法的局限性，实现了灵活的规划和及时的错误纠正。与现有的最先进方法相比，MavenCoder在多个基准测试中的表现更为出色：在LiveCodeBench上的通过率为87.5%，在HumanEval+上的通过率为93.9%，在MBPP+上的通过率为81.7%，在CodeContests上的通过率为46.1%。其性能优于最近出现的基于智能体的系统，改进幅度超过了3%到40%。

papers.title: Evidence-Augmented Policy Optimization with Reward Co-Evolution for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 基于证据增强的政策优化方法，结合奖励的协同演化机制，用于长期上下文推理
papers.authors: Xin Guan, Zijian Li, Shen Huang, Pengjun Xie, Jingren Zhou, Jiuxin Cao
papers.abstract: While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has advanced LLM reasoning, applying it to long-context scenarios is hindered by sparsity of outcome rewards. This limitation fails to penalize ungrounded “lucky guesses,” leaving the critical process of needle-in-a-haystack evidence retrieval largely unsupervised. To address this, we propose EAPO (Evidence-Augmented Policy Optimization). We first establish the Evidence-Augmented Reasoning paradigm, validating via Tree-Structured Evidence Sampling that precise evidence extraction is the decisive bottleneck for long-context reasoning. Guided by this insight, EAPO introduces a specialized RL algorithm where a reward model computes a Group-Relative Evidence Reward, providing dense process supervision to explicitly improve evidence quality. To sustain accurate supervision throughout training, we further incorporate an Adaptive Reward-Policy Co-Evolution mechanism. This mechanism iteratively refines the reward model using outcome-consistent rollouts, sharpening its discriminative capability to ensure precise process guidance. Comprehensive evaluations across eight benchmarks demonstrate that EAPO significantly enhances long-context reasoning performance compared to SOTA baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然强化学习在LLM推理方面取得了显著进展，但将其应用于长上下文场景时，由于结果奖励的稀疏性而受到阻碍。这一限制无法对基于猜测的“幸运猜想”进行惩罚，导致在证据检索这一关键过程中缺乏有效的监督。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了EAPO（证据增强策略优化）方法。我们首先建立了证据增强推理范式，并通过树状证据采样验证：精确的证据提取是长上下文推理的关键瓶颈。基于这一洞察，EAPO引入了一种专门的强化学习算法，该算法中的奖励模型能够计算出群体相对证据奖励，从而实现对证据质量的精准监督。为了在整个训练过程中保持准确的监督，我们还引入了自适应奖励-策略协同进化机制。该机制通过基于结果一致的迭代优化来改进奖励模型，从而提升其判别能力，确保对过程的精准指导。在八个基准测试中的全面评估表明，与当前最先进的基线方法相比，EAPO在长上下文推理性能上取得了显著的提升。

papers.title: Generating Attribution Reports for Manipulated Facial Images: A Dataset and Baseline
papers.title_zh: 为篡改过的面部图像生成归因报告：一个数据集与基线方法
papers.authors: Jingchun Lian, Lingyu Liu, Yaxiong Wang, Yujiao Wu, Lianwei Wu, Li Zhu, Zhedong Zheng
papers.abstract: Existing facial forgery detection methods typically focus on binary classification or pixel-level localization, providing little semantic insight into the nature of the manipulation. To address this, we introduce Forgery Attribution Report Generation, a new multimodal task designed to provide post-hoc forensic evidence for manipulated images. This task jointly localizes forged regions (“Where“) and generates natural language explanations grounded in the editing process (“Why“). This dual-focus approach goes beyond traditional binary forensics, providing a comprehensive, interpretable understanding of the manipulation. To enable research in this domain, we present Multi-Modal Tamper Tracing (MMTT), a large-scale dataset of 152,217 samples. Each sample features a process-derived ground-truth mask and a human-authored textual description, ensuring high annotation precision and linguistic richness. We further propose ForgeryTalker, a unified end-to-end baseline that integrates vision and language via a shared encoder and dual decoders for mask and text generation. Experiments show that ForgeryTalker achieves competitive performance on both subtasks, i.e., 59.3 CIDEr and 73.67 IoU, establishing a strong baseline for explainable multimedia forensics. Our dataset and code are available at: https://github.com/NattyLianJc/Generating-Attribution-Reports.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的面部伪造检测方法通常侧重于二元分类或像素级定位，对于伪造行为的本质缺乏语义上的理解。为了克服这一缺陷，我们提出了“伪造行为归因报告生成”这一新的多模态任务，旨在为被篡改的图像提供事后法医证据。该任务同时完成对伪造区域的定位（“在哪里”）以及基于编辑过程的自然语言解释（“为什么”）。这种双重视角的方法超越了传统的二元法医技术，提供了对伪造行为的全面且可解释的理解。为了推动这一领域的研究，我们推出了“多模态篡改追踪”数据集，该数据集包含152,217个样本。每个样本都包含一个由处理过程生成的真实掩码以及一个由人类编写的文本描述，从而确保了高精度的注释质量和丰富的语言表达。此外，我们还提出了“伪造talker”这一统一的端到端基线模型，它通过一个共享的编码器来整合视觉和语言信息，并配备了两个用于生成掩码和文本的解码器。实验表明，“伪造talker”在两个子任务上均取得了良好的性能，即59.3 CIDEr和73.67 IoU，为可解释的多媒体法医技术奠定了坚实的基础。我们的数据集和代码可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/NattyLianJc/Generating-Attribution-Reports。

papers.title: Optimizing RAG Rerankers with LLM Feedback via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过强化学习利用大语言模型反馈来优化RAG重新排序器
papers.authors: Yuhang Wu, Xiangqing Shen, Fanfan Wang, Cangqi Zhou, Zhen Wu, Xinyu Dai, Rui Xia
papers.abstract: Rerankers play a pivotal role in refining retrieval results for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. However, current reranking models are typically optimized on static human annotated relevance labels in isolation, decoupled from the downstream generation process. This isolation leads to a fundamental misalignment: documents identified as topically relevant by information retrieval metrics often fail to provide the actual utility required by the LLM for precise answer generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReRanking Preference Optimization (RRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that directly aligns reranking with the LLM’s generation quality. By formulating reranking as a sequential decision-making process, RRPO optimizes for context utility using LLM feedback, thereby eliminating the need for expensive human annotations. To ensure training stability, we further introduce a reference-anchored deterministic baseline. Extensive experiments on knowledge-intensive benchmarks demonstrate that RRPO significantly outperforms strong baselines, including the powerful list-wise reranker RankZephyr. Further analysis highlights the versatility of our framework: it generalizes seamlessly to diverse readers (e.g., GPT-4o), integrates orthogonally with query expansion modules like Query2Doc, and remains robust even when trained with noisy supervisors.
papers.abstract_zh: 重新排序技术在优化检索增强生成的检索结果中起着至关重要的作用。然而，目前的重新排序模型通常是在独立于下游生成过程的静态人类标注的相关性标签上进行优化的。这种分离导致了根本性的不匹配：那些通过信息检索指标被认定为具有相关性的文档，往往无法为大语言模型提供所需的实际效用，以进行精确的答案生成。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了ReRanking Preference Optimization（RRPO）框架，这是一种强化学习框架，它直接将重新排序与大语言模型的生成质量结合起来。通过将重新排序视为一个连续的决策过程，RRPO利用大语言模型的反馈来优化上下文效用，从而消除了对昂贵人工标注的需求。为了确保训练的稳定性，我们还引入了一个基于参考点的确定性基线模型。在知识密集型基准测试中的广泛实验表明，RRPO的表现显著优于许多强大的基线模型，包括强大的列表式重新排序器RankZephyr。进一步的分析表明，我们的框架具有出色的通用性：它可以无缝地应用于不同的读者群体（例如GPT-4o），可以与查询扩展模块如Query2Doc正交集成，并且即使在使用噪声监督数据进行训练时也能保持稳健的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Explainable and Fine-Grained Safeguarding of LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Bi-Level Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.title_zh: 通过双层图异常检测，实现对大型语言模型多智能体系统的可解释且细粒度的保护机制
papers.authors: Junjun Pan, Yixin Liu, Rui Miao, Kaize Ding, Yu Zheng, Quoc Viet Hung Nguyen, Alan Wee-Chung Liew, Shirui Pan
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown strong capabilities in solving complex tasks. As MAS become increasingly autonomous in various safety-critical tasks, detecting malicious agents has become a critical security concern. Although existing graph anomaly detection (GAD)-based defenses can identify anomalous agents, they mainly rely on coarse sentence-level information and overlook fine-grained lexical cues, leading to suboptimal performance. Moreover, the lack of interpretability in these methods limits their reliability and real-world applicability. To address these limitations, we propose , an explainable and fine-grained safeguarding framework for detecting malicious agents in MAS. To incorporate both coarse and fine-grained textual information for anomalous agent identification, we utilize a bi-level agent encoder to jointly model the sentence- and token-level representations of each agent. A theme-based anomaly detector further captures the evolving discussion focus in MAS dialogues, while a bi-level score fusion mechanism quantifies token-level contributions for explanation. Extensive experiments across diverse MAS topologies and attack scenarios demonstrate robust detection performance and strong interpretability of XG-Guard.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在解决复杂任务方面表现出强大的能力。随着多智能体系统在各种安全关键任务中逐渐实现自主化，检测恶意智能体已成为一个重要的安全问题。虽然现有的基于图异常检测的防御机制能够识别异常智能体，但它们主要依赖于句子层面的信息，而忽略了细粒度的词汇线索，从而导致性能不佳。此外，这些方法的不可解释性也限制了其可靠性和在实际应用中的可行性。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种可解释且细粒度的保护框架，用于检测多智能体系统中的恶意智能体。为了同时利用粗粒度和细粒度的文本信息来识别异常智能体，我们采用了双层智能体编码器，以共同建模每个智能体的句子级和词元级表示。基于主题异常的检测器能够捕捉多智能体对话中不断变化的讨论焦点，而双层得分融合机制则能够量化词元级的贡献，以便于解释。通过在多种多智能体拓扑结构和攻击场景下的广泛实验，证明了XG-Guard在检测异常智能体方面的强大性能和良好的可解释性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating Bias Inheritance in LLM-based Data Augmentation on Downstream Tasks
papers.title_zh: 理解并减轻基于大语言模型的数据增强在后续任务中的偏见影响
papers.authors: Miaomiao Li, Hao Chen, Yang Wang, Tingyuan Zhu, Weijia Zhang, Kaijie Zhu, Kam-Fai Wong, Jindong Wang
papers.abstract: Generating synthetic datasets via large language models (LLMs) has emerged as a promising approach to improve LLM performance.However, LLMs inherently reflect biases in their training data, leading to a critical challenge: when models are trained on synthetic data, they may propagate and amplify the inherent biases that can significantly impact fairness and robustness on downstream tasks—a phenomenon we term bias inheritance. This work presents the first systematic investigation in understanding, analyzing, and mitigating bias inheritance. We fine-tune LLMs with a combined dataset of real and LLM-augmented data with varied bias ratio as the proportion of augmented data. Through systematic experiments across 10 classification and generation tasks, we analyze how 6 different types of biases manifest. Our results indicate that bias inheritance harms downstream task performance in bias directly-related classification and generation tasks. Then, our analysis identifies three key misalignment factors: misalignment of values, group data, and data distributions. Based on these insights, we propose three mitigation strategies: token-based, mask-based, and loss-based approaches, which can work differently on various tasks and bias, indicating the substantial challenges to mitigate bias inheritance. We hope this work can provide insights to the research of LLM data augmentation.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型生成合成数据集已成为提升大语言模型性能的有效方法。然而，大语言模型在训练数据中存在固有的偏见，这带来了严重的挑战：当模型在合成数据上进行训练时，这些偏见可能会被放大，从而对下游任务的公平性和鲁棒性产生重大影响——这种现象我们称之为偏见传承。本研究首次系统地探讨了如何理解、分析并缓解偏见传承问题。我们通过使用真实数据和经过增强的数据组合来微调大语言模型，其中增强数据的比例各不相同。通过针对10种分类和生成任务进行的系统实验，我们分析了6种不同类型的偏见是如何表现出来的。研究结果表明，偏见传承会直接损害下游任务的性能，尤其是在与偏见直接相关的分类和生成任务中。此外，我们的分析还发现了三个主要的失衡因素：价值观的错位、群体数据与数据分布的不匹配。基于这些发现，我们提出了三种缓解策略：基于令牌的方法、基于掩码的方法和基于损失的方法。这些策略可以适用于不同的任务和不同的偏见情况，但这也表明缓解偏见传承存在巨大的挑战。我们希望这项研究能够为大语言模型数据增强领域的研究提供有价值的见解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond the Panorama: Training-Free Hierarchical Perception-Reasoning for Fine-Grained Vision in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: 超越全景视野：适用于多模态语言模型的高精度无训练式层次感知推理方法
papers.authors: Xiaoyang Yi, Jing Chen, Li Peng, Yuru Bao, Jian Zhang
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable cross-modal semantic understanding and generation by learning semantic alignment and fusion across modalities. However, existing MLLMs still face challenges in fine-grained visual tasks. Their uniform encoding for global understanding tends to blur or lose local details, while the lack of explicit modeling of intermediate visual evidence leads them to rely on semantic priors or the statistical patterns of language models rather than grounded visual information, resulting in potential hallucinations. To address these issues, we propose HiPerson, a training-free hierarchical perception-reasoning framework that enhances fine-grained visual understanding by simulating human perception mechanisms. Specifically, HiPerson fuses internal relative attention and gradient activation signals to generate a task-aware semantic heatmap, providing explicit perceptual anchors for precise localization. Then, it employs a dual-scale adaptive cropping strategy to extract visual cues for interactive reasoning, simulating the process of human visual focus shifting and detail attention. Finally, by combining local-global dual-image cooperative input with a multi-step reasoning prompting mechanism, HiPerson guides the model to complete a full perception loop from detail observation to contextual verification. Experiments show that HiPerson achieves competitive results on multiple datasets, demonstrating its generalizability and scalability.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型能够通过学习不同模态之间的语义对齐和融合来实现跨模态的语义理解与生成。然而，现有的多模态大语言模型在精细的视觉任务上仍然存在挑战。它们采用统一的编码方式来处理全局信息，这会导致局部细节被模糊或丢失；同时，由于缺乏对中间视觉信息的明确建模，这些模型往往依赖于语义先验或语言模型的统计模式，而非基于实际视觉信息的推理，这可能会导致幻觉的产生。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了HiPerson这一无需训练的层次化感知-推理框架。该框架通过模拟人类感知机制来增强对精细视觉信息的理解。具体来说，HiPerson结合了内部相对注意力机制和梯度激活信号，生成具有任务意识的语义热图，为精确定位提供明确的感知依据。随后，它采用双尺度自适应裁剪策略来提取用于交互式推理的视觉线索，模拟人类视觉焦点的转移和细节关注的过程。最后，通过结合局部与全局的双图像输入以及多步推理提示机制，HiPerson能够引导模型完成从细节观察到上下文验证的完整感知循环。实验表明，HiPerson在多个数据集上取得了有竞争力的成绩，证明了其通用性和可扩展性。

papers.title: To Judge or Not to Judge: Can Large Language Models Leverage the Dispute Focus in Legal Judgment?
papers.title_zh: 该判还是不判：大型语言模型能否利用法律裁决中的争议信息？
papers.authors: Luoming Hu, Liang Yang, Jingjie Zeng, Zijie Xing
papers.abstract: Civil judicial cases are highly complicated, posing significant challenges for Large Language Models (LLMs) for Legal Judgment Prediction (LJP). While judges manage this complexity through the dispute focus—a mechanism distilling cases into core issues—existing research largely overlooks this tool in favor of generic reasoning frameworks that lack authentic judicial logic. To bridge this gap, we first introduce \textbf{FocalLaw}, the first dataset aligning full-process Chinese civil judicial data through the dispute focus, comprising 1,000 high-quality cases across six causes of action. Building on this dataset, we examine LLMs’ capability to utilize the dispute focus and uncover a counter-intuitive phenomenon: LLMs fail to leverage the dispute focus even with CoT and SFT, which we identify as the “Clerk Trap”.To solve the problem, we propose \textbf{FocalJudge}, a novel framework that leverages the dispute focus to guide LLMs through a structured, judge-like cognitive workflow. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of FocalJudge and offer valuable insights into the interpretability and reliability of LLMs in the legal domain.
papers.abstract_zh: 民事司法案件极其复杂，这对大语言模型进行法律判决预测带来了重大挑战。虽然法官通过“争议聚焦”机制来应对这种复杂性——该机制将案件分解为核心问题——但现有研究大多忽视了这一工具，而倾向于使用缺乏真正司法逻辑的通用推理框架。为了填补这一空白，我们首先介绍了**FocalLaw**，这是第一个通过争议聚焦方式整合完整流程的中国民事司法数据的数据集，包含1000个高质量案例，涉及六种诉讼类型。基于这个数据集，我们研究了语言模型利用争议聚焦的能力，并发现了一个反直觉的现象：即使配备了常识推理和语义场推理功能，语言模型也无法有效利用争议聚焦机制，我们将这一现象称为“书记员陷阱”。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了**FocalJudge**这一创新框架，该框架利用争议聚焦来引导语言模型完成结构化的、类似法官的认知工作流程。实验结果表明，FocalJudge具有很好的效果，并为理解语言模型在法律领域的可解释性和可靠性提供了有价值的见解。

papers.title: CPR-RAG: Clinical Prior-Regularized Retrieval for Anatomy-Aware 3D CT Report Generation
papers.title_zh: CPR-RAG：基于临床数据的正则化检索方法，用于生成具有解剖学信息的3D CT报告
papers.authors: Sungkyu Yang, Kang-Min Kim, Mansu Kim
papers.abstract: Generating radiology reports from 3D volumetric data remains challenging due to the difficulty of grounding fine-grained pathologies within high-dimensional scans. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) offers a potential solution, standard approaches struggle with visual-semantic ambiguity and often introduce irrelevant “normal” context that dilutes pathological signals. To address this limitation, we introduce CPR-RAG, a model-agnostic RAG framework that enhances organ-level grounding by integrating clinical priors into the retrieval process. Specifically, we propose a clinical prior-regularized re-ranking module that leverages corpus-derived co-occurrence statistics to align retrieved candidates with latent disease distributions, ensuring clinical consistency beyond mere visual similarity. Furthermore, we employ clinical relevance context refinement to selectively filter out boilerplate normal descriptions, thereby maximizing the information density of the evidence provided to the generator. Extensive experiments on the RadGenome-ChestCT benchmark demonstrate that CPR-RAG significantly improves clinical efficacy across state-of-the-art radiology report generation models. Human evaluation further confirms that our approach achieves superior factual correctness, completeness, and utility compared to the existing models.
papers.abstract_zh: 从3D体积数据生成放射学报告仍然存在挑战，因为难以在高维扫描数据中准确识别细微的病理特征。虽然检索增强生成技术提供了一种潜在的解决方案，但传统方法在处理视觉与语义的模糊性时存在困难，并且常常引入无关的“正常”背景信息，从而削弱了病理信号的显著性。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了CPR-RAG模型——一种不依赖具体模型的检索增强生成框架。该框架通过将临床先验信息整合到检索过程中，提升了器官级别的定位精度。具体来说，我们提出了一种基于临床先验信息的重新排序模块，该模块利用语料库中的共现统计信息，将检索到的候选结果与潜在疾病分布进行对齐，从而确保临床一致性，而不仅仅是视觉上的相似性。此外，我们还采用了临床相关性上下文优化技术，以选择性地过滤掉那些无意义的正常描述，从而最大化提供给生成器的信息密度。在RadGenome-ChestCT基准测试上的广泛实验表明，CPR-RAG显著提高了现有放射学报告生成模型在临床应用上的效果。人工评估进一步证实，我们的方法在事实准确性、完整性以及实用性方面均优于现有的模型。

papers.title: Evaluating Answer Leakage Robustness of LLM Tutors against Adversarial Student Attacks
papers.title_zh: 评估大型语言模型辅导系统在对抗性学生攻击下的答案泄露鲁棒性
papers.authors: Jin Zhao, Marta Knežević, Tanja Käser
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in education, yet their default helpfulness often conflicts with pedagogical principles. Prior work evaluates pedagogical quality via answer leakage–the disclosure of complete solutions instead of scaffolding–but typically assumes well-intentioned learners, leaving tutor robustness under student misuse largely unexplored. In this paper, we study scenarios where students behave adversarially and aim to obtain the correct answer from the tutor. We evaluate a broad set of LLM-based tutor models, including different model families, pedagogically aligned models, and a multi-agent design, under a range of adversarial student attacks. We adapt six groups of adversarial and persuasive techniques to the educational setting and use them to probe how likely a tutor is to reveal the final answer. We evaluate answer leakage robustness using different types of in-context adversarial student agents, finding that they often fail to carry out effective attacks. We therefore introduce an adversarial student agent that we fine-tune to jailbreak LLM-based tutors, which we propose as the core of a standardized benchmark for evaluating tutor robustness. Finally, we present simple but effective defense strategies that reduce answer leakage and strengthen the robustness of LLM-based tutors in adversarial scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在教育领域的应用日益广泛，然而它们的默认功能往往与教学原则相冲突。以往的研究通常通过“答案泄露”来评估模型的教学效果——即直接提供完整的解决方案，而不是通过逐步引导的方式帮助学生理解。但这类研究通常假设学习者具有良好的学习意愿，而忽略了学生在不当使用模型时可能导致的模型鲁棒性问题。在本文中，我们研究了学生采取对抗性行为的场景，并试图从模型中获取正确的答案。我们评估了多种基于语言模型的辅导模型，包括不同的模型家族、符合教学原则的模型以及多智能体设计，并在一系列对抗性学生攻击下进行了测试。我们将六组对抗性和有说服力的技术应用于教育场景中，以探究模型透露最终答案的可能性。我们通过使用不同类型的对抗性学生智能体来评估模型的鲁棒性，发现这些智能体往往无法有效实施攻击。因此，我们引入了一种对抗性学生智能体，并对其进行了优化，以突破基于语言模型的辅导模型的限制。我们认为这种智能体可以作为评估模型鲁棒性的标准化基准的核心组成部分。最后，我们提出了一些简单但有效的防御策略，这些策略能够减少答案泄露现象，并提高基于语言模型的辅导模型在对抗性场景下的鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Expect the Unexpected? Testing the Surprisal of Salient Entities
papers.title_zh: 期待意外？挑战那些显而易见的事物的惊喜之处
papers.authors: Jessica Lin, Amir Zeldes
papers.abstract: Previous work examining the Uniform Information Density (UID) hypothesis has shown that while information as measured by surprisal metrics is distributed more or less evenly across documents overall, local discrepancies can arise due to functional pressures corresponding to syntactic and discourse structural constraints. However, work thus far has largely disregarded the relative salience of discourse participants. We fill this gap by studying how overall salience of entities in discourse relates to surprisal using 70K manually annotated mentions across 16 genres of English and a novel minimal-pair prompting method. Our results show that globally salient entities exhibit significantly higher surprisal than non-salient ones, even controlling for position, length, and nesting confounds. Moreover, salient entities systematically reduce surprisal for surrounding content when used as prompts, enhancing document-level predictability. This effect varies by genre, appearing strongest in topic-coherent texts and weakest in conversational contexts. Our findings refine the UID competing pressures framework by identifying global entity salience as a mechanism shaping information distribution in discourse.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前的研究表明，虽然根据惊讶度指标衡量的信息在文档中分布相对均匀，但由于句法和话语结构上的限制，局部差异仍可能出现。然而，迄今为止的研究大多忽略了话语中各个元素的相对显著性。我们通过研究英语中16种体裁的7万条手动标注的提及内容，利用一种新的最小对偶提示方法，来探讨话语中各个元素的总体显著性与惊讶度之间的关系。我们的研究结果表明，即使考虑到位置、长度以及嵌套等因素的影响，总体上显著的实体所带来的惊讶度也显著高于不显著的实体。此外，当显著元素被用作提示时，它们会系统性地降低周围内容的惊讶度，从而提高文档级别的可预测性。这种效应因体裁而异，在主题连贯的文本中最为明显，而在对话场景中则较弱。我们的研究发现进一步丰富了UID竞争压力框架，将全局实体显著性视为塑造话语中信息分布的机制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ArgGenBench: Benchmarking the Complex Controlled Argument Generation Capability of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ArgGenBench：评估大型语言模型生成复杂控制性文本的能力
papers.authors: Bojun Jin, Jianzhu Bao, Yang Sun, Yice Zhang, Ruifeng Xu
papers.abstract: Argument generation is a fundamental NLP task that aims to automatically produce persuasive arguments.Effective human argumentation is inherently complex and multifaceted, integrating argumentative strategies, appropriate styles, and adaptation to target audiences, etc.However, existing studies focus on limited control signals such as topic, stance, or key aspects, failing to capture this complexity.As LLMs advance, the lack of benchmarks evaluating multifaceted argumentative control becomes a critical bottleneck.To address this, we introduce ArgGenBench, a novel benchmark containing complex instructions that integrate multi-dimensional control, including topic, stance, length, style, strategy, audience, and key points.Extensive evaluation across 15 LLMs reveals significant limitations: even the best-performing model achieves only 42.7% win rate against human-verified references.These results highlight the challenge of controlled argument generation and establish ArgGenBench as a rigorous testbed for developing more capable systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 论点生成是自然语言处理中的一个基本任务，其目标是自动产生有说服力的论点。有效的人类论证过程本质上是复杂且多方面的，需要整合各种论证策略、合适的风格以及针对目标受众的适应性调整等要素。然而，现有的研究往往只关注有限的控制因素，如主题、立场或关键要点等，而未能充分捕捉到这种复杂性。随着大语言模型的不断发展，缺乏能够评估多方面论证控制的基准测试成为了一个重要的瓶颈。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了ArgGenBench这一新的基准测试平台，该平台包含了多种维度的控制因素，包括主题、立场、长度、风格、策略、受众和关键点等。通过对15种大语言模型进行广泛的评估，我们发现存在显著的局限性：即使是最优秀的模型，在击败经过人类验证的参考案例方面，胜率也仅达到42.7%。这些结果凸显了控制性论点生成的挑战性，同时也使得ArgGenBench成为开发更强大系统的严格测试平台。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Language Models Learn Universal Representations of Numbers and Here’s Why You Should Care
papers.title_zh: 语言模型：学习数字的通用表示方式，以及为何你应该关注这一点
papers.authors: Michal Štefánik, Timothee Mickus, Marek Kadlčík, Bertram Højer, Michal Spiegel, Raúl Vázquez, Aman Sinha, Josef Kuchař, Philipp Mondorf, Pontus Stenetorp
papers.abstract: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) often converge to accurate input embedding for numbers, based on sinusoidal representations.In this work, we demonstrate that these representations are in fact strikingly systematic, to the point of being almost perfectly universal: different LLM families develop equivalent sinusoidal structures, and number representations are broadly interchangeable in a large swathe of experimental setups.We show that properly factoring in this characteristic is crucial when it comes to assessing how accurately LLMs encode numeric and other ordinal information, and that mechanistically enhancing this sinusoidality can also lead to reductions of LLMs’ arithmetic errors.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前的研究表明，大语言模型通常能够基于正弦表示方式，收敛到准确的数字输入嵌入。在本研究中，我们证明了这些表示方式其实具有非常系统性的特点，几乎可以做到完美通用：不同的语言模型家族会发展出等效的正弦结构，而且在不同实验设置中，数字表示方式是可以广泛互换的。我们发现，在评估语言模型对数字和其他序列表征的编码精度时，正确考虑这一特性至关重要。此外，通过机制上增强这种正弦特性，还可以降低语言模型的算术错误。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CURE-Med: Curriculum-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Multilingual Medical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: CURE-Med：基于课程设计的强化学习算法，用于多语言医学推理
papers.authors: Eric Onyame, Akash Ghosh, Subhadip Baidya, Sriparna Saha, Xiuying Chen, Chirag Agarwal
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have shown to perform well on monolingual mathematical and commonsense reasoning, they remain unreliable for multilingual medical reasoning applications, hindering their deployment in multilingual healthcare settings. We address this by first introducing CURE-Med-Bench, a high-quality multilingual medical reasoning dataset with open-ended reasoning queries with a single verifiable answer, spanning thirteen languages, including underrepresented languages such as Amharic, Yoruba, and Swahili. Building on this dataset, we propose CURE-Med, a curriculum-informed reinforcement learning framework that integrates code-switching-aware supervised fine-tuning and Group Relative Policy Optimization to jointly improve logical correctness and language stability. Across thirteen languages, our approach consistently outperforms strong baselines and scales effectively, achieving 85.21% language consistency and 54.35% logical correctness at 7B parameters and 94.96% language consistency and 70.04% logical correctness at 32B parameters. These results support reliable and equitable multilingual medical reasoning in LLMs. The code and dataset will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在单语言数学和常识推理方面表现良好，但在多语言医学推理应用中却存在可靠性问题，这限制了它们在多语言医疗环境中的应用。我们为了解决这个问题，首先引入了CURE-Med-Bench这一高质量的多语言医学推理数据集，该数据集包含开放式推理问题，每个问题只有一个可验证的答案，数据涵盖十三种语言，其中包括一些较少使用的语言，如阿姆哈拉语、约鲁巴语和斯瓦希里语。在此基础上，我们提出了CURE-Med这一基于课程知识的强化学习框架，该框架结合了考虑代码切换的监督式微调技术和群体相对策略优化技术，从而共同提升逻辑正确性和语言稳定性。在十三种语言中，我们的方法始终优于强大的基线算法，并且能够有效扩展规模。在70亿参数的情况下，我们的系统在语言一致性方面达到了85.21%，逻辑正确性达到了54.35%；而在320亿参数的情况下，系统则在语言一致性方面达到了94.96%，逻辑正确性达到了70.04%。这些结果证明了大语言模型在多语言医学推理中的可靠性和公平性。代码和数据集将在项目获批后公开提供。

papers.title: Inverting the Shield: Systematically Generating Safety Tests from Policy Specifications
papers.title_zh: 反转护盾：从政策规范中系统性地生成安全测试方案
papers.authors: Xiaoyue Lu, Xianglin Yang, Haijun Liu, Jiahao Liu, Kuntai Cai, Yan Xiao, Jin Song Dong
papers.abstract: The widespread integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) necessitates rigorous and systematic safety evaluation. Existing paradigms either rely on constructed benchmarks to assess safety from predefined perspectives, or employ dynamic red-teaming to probe potential vulnerabilities. While effective, these approaches face challenges, as they depend heavily on expert domain knowledge, offer limited systematic guarantees, and are vulnerable to rapid obsolescence. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel framework POLARIS that brings the rigor of specification-based software testing to AI safety. POLARIS first compiles unstructured natural-language policies into First-Order Logic (FOL) representations, establishing a traceable link between high-level rules and concrete test cases. This formalization enables the construction of a Semantic Policy Graph, where complex policy violation scenarios are encoded as traversable paths. By systematically exploring this graph, POLARIS uncovers compositional violation patterns, which are then instantiated into executable natural-language test queries, enabling coverage-driven and reproducible safety testing. Experiments demonstrate that POLARIS achieves higher policy coverage and attack success counts compared to established baselines. Crucially, by bridging formal methods and AI safety, POLARIS provides a principled, automated approach to ensuring LLMs adhere to safety-critical policies with verifiable traceability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用要求进行严格且系统的安全性评估。现有的评估方法要么依赖预先构建的基准测试来从预定义的视角评估安全性，要么采用动态红队测试来探测潜在的漏洞。虽然这些方法效果不错，但它们存在诸多挑战：它们严重依赖于专家领域的知识，提供的系统保障有限，而且容易迅速过时。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种名为POLARIS的新框架，它将基于规范化的软件测试方法引入到人工智能安全领域。POLARIS首先将非结构化的自然语言策略编译成一阶逻辑表示形式，从而在高层次规则与具体测试用例之间建立可追踪的联系。这种形式化方法使得我们可以构建一个语义策略图，其中复杂的策略违反情况被编码为可遍历的路径。通过系统地探索这个图，POLARIS能够发现组合性的违反模式，并将这些模式转化为可执行的自然语言测试查询，从而实现以覆盖率为导向的可复现性安全测试。实验表明，与现有的基线相比，POLARIS能够实现更高的策略覆盖率和更成功的攻击成功率。关键在于，通过结合形式化方法和人工智能安全技术，POLARIS提供了一种原则性、自动化的方法来确保LLM遵循具有可验证可追溯性的安全关键策略。

papers.title: HEALing Entropy Collapse: Enhancing Exploration in Few-Shot RLVR via Hybrid-Domain Entropy Dynamics Alignment
papers.title_zh: 修复熵崩塌问题：通过混合域熵动态对齐技术提升少样本强化学习中的探索能力
papers.authors: Zhanyu Liu, Qingguo Hu, Ante Wang, Chenqing Liu, Zhishang Xiang, Hui Li, Delai Qiu, Jinsong Su
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has proven effective for training reasoning-oriented large language models, but existing methods largely assume high-resource settings with abundant training data. In low-resource scenarios, RLVR is prone to more severe entropy collapse, which substantially limits exploration and degrades reasoning performance. To address this issue, we propose Hybrid-domain Entropy dynamics ALignment (HEAL), a framework tailored for few-shot RLVR. HEAL first selectively incorporates high-value general-domain data to promote more diverse exploration. Then, we introduce Entropy Dynamics Alignment (EDA), a reward mechanism that aligns trajectory-level entropy dynamics between the target and general domains, capturing both entropy magnitude and fine-grained variation. Through this alignment, EDA not only further mitigates entropy collapse but also encourages the policy to acquire more diverse exploration behaviors from the general domain. Experiments across multiple domains show that HEAL consistently improves few-shot RLVR performance. Notably, using only 32 target-domain samples, HEAL matches or even surpasses full-shot RLVR trained with 1K target-domain samples.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已被证明在训练面向推理的大语言模型方面非常有效。然而，现有方法大多假设训练数据丰富、资源充足的环境。在资源匮乏的情况下，RLVR更容易出现严重的熵崩溃问题，这会严重限制探索行为并降低推理性能。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了混合域熵动态对齐算法（HEAL），这是一种专为少样本RLVR设计的框架。HEAL首先选择性地引入高价值的通用域数据，以促进更多样化的探索行为。然后，我们引入了熵动态对齐机制，该机制能够调整目标域与通用域之间的轨迹级熵动态，同时捕捉到熵的幅度和细微变化。通过这种对齐机制，EDA不仅进一步缓解了熵崩溃问题，还促使策略从通用域中获取更多样化的探索行为。在多个领域的实验中表明，HEAL始终能提升少样本RLVR的性能。值得注意的是，仅使用32个目标域样本时，HEAL的性能甚至优于使用1K个目标域样本进行全样本训练的RLVR。

papers.title: Do LLMs Encode Functional Importance of Reasoning Tokens ?
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型是否能够编码出推理标记的功能性重要性？
papers.authors: Janvijay Singh, Dilek Hakkani-Tür
papers.abstract: Large language models solve complex tasks by generating long reasoning chains, achieving higher accuracy at the cost of increased computational cost and reduced ability to isolate functionally relevant reasoning. Prior work on compact reasoning shortens such chains through probabilistic sampling, heuristics, or supervision from frontier models, but offers limited insight into whether models internally encode token-level functional importance for answer generation. We address this gap diagnostically and propose greedy pruning, a likelihood-preserving deletion procedure that iteratively removes reasoning tokens whose removal minimally degrades model likelihood under a specified objective, yielding length-controlled reasoning chains. We evaluate pruned reasoning in a distillation framework and show that students trained on pruned chains outperform a frontier-model–supervised compression baseline at matched reasoning lengths. Finally, our analysis reveals systematic pruning patterns and shows that attention scores can predict greedy pruning ranks, further suggesting that models encode a nontrivial functional importance structure over reasoning tokens.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过生成复杂的推理链来解决复杂问题，虽然能够取得更高的准确率，但代价是计算成本的增加以及难以分离出具有功能重要性的推理部分。之前的研究通过概率采样、启发式方法或借鉴前沿模型的指导来缩短这些推理链，但这些方法对于模型内部是否编码了用于生成答案的功能性重要性信息了解有限。我们旨在填补这一空白，提出了一种贪婪剪枝算法——一种保留概率分布的删除方法，该算法会迭代地移除那些在指定目标下能最小程度降低模型概率的推理元素，从而得到长度可控的推理链。我们在蒸馏框架中评估了经过剪枝处理的推理结果，结果显示，使用剪枝后的推理链进行训练的学生在相同的推理长度下，其性能优于基于前沿模型进行压缩处理的基线方法。此外，我们的分析还揭示了系统性的剪枝模式，并表明注意力得分可以预测贪婪剪枝的等级，这进一步表明模型确实编码了关于推理元素的非平凡功能性重要性结构。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EA-Agent: A Structured Multi-Step Reasoning Agent for Entity Alignment
papers.title_zh: EA-Agent：一种用于实体对齐的结构化多步骤推理代理
papers.authors: Yixuan Nan, Xixun Lin, Yanmin Shang, Ge Zhang, Zheng Fang, Fang Fang, Yanan Cao
papers.abstract: Entity alignment (EA) aims to identify entities across different knowledge graphs (KGs) that refer to the same real-world object and plays a critical role in knowledge fusion and integration. Traditional EA methods mainly rely on knowledge representation learning, but their performance is often limited under noisy or sparsely supervised scenarios. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been introduced to EA and achieved notable improvements by leveraging rich semantic knowledge. However, existing LLM-based EA approaches typically treat LLMs as black-box decision makers, resulting in limited interpretability, and the direct use of large-scale triples substantially increases inference cost. To address these challenges, we propose EA-Agent, a reasoning-driven agent for EA. EA-Agent formulates EA as a structured reasoning process with multi-step planning and execution, enabling interpretable alignment decisions. Within this process, it introduces attribute and relation triple selectors to filter redundant triples before feeding them into the LLM, effectively addressing efficiency challenges. Experimental results on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that EA-Agent consistently outperforms existing EA methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance. The source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EA-Agent-5696.
papers.abstract_zh: 实体对齐（Entity Alignment，简称EA）的目的是识别不同知识图谱中指代同一现实世界对象的实体，这在知识融合与整合过程中起着至关重要的作用。传统的EA方法主要依赖于知识表示学习，但在噪声较大或监督数据较少的情况下，其性能往往受到限制。近年来，大语言模型（Large Language Models，简称LLMs）被引入到EA领域，通过利用丰富的语义知识，取得了显著的改进。然而，现有的基于LLM的EA方法通常将LLM视为黑盒决策器，这导致模型的可解释性有限，而直接使用大规模三元组还会大幅增加推理成本。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了EA-Agent——一种以推理为驱动的EA解决方案。EA-Agent将EA描述为一个结构化的推理过程，包含多步骤的规划和执行，从而能够做出可解释的实体对齐决策。在这个过程中，EA-Agent引入了属性和关系三元组选择器，用于过滤冗余的三元组，然后再将其输入到LLM中，有效解决了效率问题。在三个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，EA-Agent的性能始终优于现有的EA方法，并达到了最先进的水平。源代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EA-Agent-5696获取。

papers.title: Too Nice to Tell the Truth: Quantifying Agreeableness-Driven Sycophancy in Role-Playing Language Models
papers.title_zh: 好得让人难以说实话：用角色扮演语言模型来量化那种出于讨好他人而表现出的友善行为
papers.authors: Arya Shah, Deepali Mishra, Chaklam Silpasuwanchai
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly serve as conversational agents that adopt personas and role-play characters at user request. This capability, while valuable, raises concerns about sycophancy: the tendency to provide responses that validate users rather than prioritize factual accuracy. While prior work has established that sycophancy poses risks to AI safety and alignment, the relationship between specific personality traits of adopted personas and the degree of sycophantic behavior remains unexplored. We present a systematic investigation of how persona agreeableness influences sycophancy across 13 small, open-weight language models ranging from 0.6B to 20B parameters. We develop a benchmark comprising 275 personas evaluated on NEO-IPIP agreeableness subscales and expose each persona to 4,950 sycophancy-eliciting prompts spanning 33 topic categories. Our analysis reveals that 9 of 13 models exhibit statistically significant positive correlations between persona agreeableness and sycophancy rates, with Pearson correlations reaching r = 0.87 and effect sizes as large as Cohen’s d = 2.33. These findings demonstrate that agreeableness functions as a reliable predictor of persona-induced sycophancy, with direct implications for the deployment of role-playing AI systems and the development of alignment strategies that account for personality-mediated deceptive behaviors
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地充当对话代理，能够根据用户请求扮演不同的角色。这一功能虽然很有价值，但也引发了对“阿谀奉承”行为的担忧：即倾向于提供能够验证用户观点的回应，而非优先考虑事实的准确性。虽然先前的研究已经表明，阿谀奉承行为会对人工智能的安全性和一致性产生负面影响，但被采用的角色的具体性格特征与阿谀奉承行为的程度之间的关系仍未被充分研究。我们对13种小型、开放架构的语言模型进行了系统的研究，这些模型的参数范围从0.6B到20B不等，以探讨角色友善性如何影响阿谀奉承行为。我们建立了一个基准测试，包含275个角色，这些角色根据NEO-IPIP友善性子量表进行评估，然后让每个角色面对4,950个可能引发阿谀奉承行为的提示，这些提示涵盖了33个主题类别。我们的分析显示，在13个模型中，有9个模型显示出角色友善性与阿谀奉承行为之间存在统计学上显著的正相关关系，皮尔逊相关系数高达r = 0.87，效应量甚至达到了Cohen的d = 2.33。这些发现表明，友善性可以作为预测角色诱导阿谀奉承行为的可靠指标，这对角色扮演型人工智能系统的部署以及制定考虑人格介导的欺骗行为的对齐策略具有重要意义。

papers.title: Mobile-R1: Towards Interactive Capability for VLM-Based Mobile Agent via Systematic Training
papers.title_zh: Mobile-R1：通过系统化的训练，实现基于VLM的移动代理的互动能力
papers.authors: Jihao Gu, Qihang Ai, Yingyao Wang, Pi Bu, Jingxuan Xing, Yue Cao, Zekun Zhu, Wei Jiang, Ziming Wang, Yingxiu Zhao, Ming-Liang Zhang, Jun Song, Yuning Jiang, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: Vision-language model-based mobile agents have gained the ability to understand complex instructions and mobile screenshots, benefiting from reinforcement learning paradigms like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). However, existing approaches centers on offline training or local action-level rewards often trap agents in local optima, hindering effective exploration and error correction with the environment. Crucially, we find that directly applying task-level rewards often leads to convergence difficulties due to the sparse nature of GUI interactions. To address these challenges, we present Mobile-R1, a systematic training recipe that bridges atomic action execution and strategic task completion. We propose a hierarchical curriculum consisting of three stages: (1) format alignment for reasoning structure, (2) on-policy exploration with verifiable action feedback to ground basic execution, and (3) multi-turn task-level training with realistic environment to unlock exploration and self-correction. This hierarchical strategy effectively bootstraps the agent, significantly enhancing its capability for exploration and self-correction (the “Eureka” moments). Furthermore, addressing the critical scarcity of diverse GUI data in non-English ecosystems, we contribute a comprehensive Chinese mobile dataset covering 28 applications with 24,521 high-quality manual annotations, and establish a rigorous benchmark with 500 trajectories. We will open source all resources, including the dataset, benchmark, model weight, and codes: https://mobile-r1.github.io/Mobile-R1/.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于视觉-语言模型的移动智能体已经具备了理解复杂指令和移动屏幕截图的能力，这得益于诸如群体相对策略优化等强化学习范式。然而，现有的方法主要集中在离线训练或局部动作级奖励上，这往往会使智能体陷入局部最优解，从而阻碍有效的探索以及与环境的错误修正。关键问题是，直接应用任务级奖励往往会导致收敛困难，因为图形用户界面交互的特性使得奖励信息非常稀疏。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Mobile-R1这一系统化的训练方案，它将原子动作执行与战略任务完成相结合。我们提出了一种分层课程结构，包括三个阶段：(1) 推理结构的格式对齐；(2) 带有可验证动作反馈的在线策略探索，以巩固基本执行能力；(3) 在真实环境中进行多轮任务级训练，以激发探索能力和自我修正能力。这种分层策略有效地引导智能体进行探索和自我修正，显著提升了其能力。“Eureka”时刻也因此得以实现。此外，针对非英语生态系统中多样化的图形用户界面数据严重匮乏的问题，我们提供了一个全面的中文移动智能体数据集，该数据集涵盖了28个应用程序，包含24,521条高质量的手工注释，并建立了包含500条轨迹的严格基准测试。我们将开源所有资源，包括数据集、基准测试、模型权重以及代码：https://mobile-r1.github.io/Mobile-R1/

papers.title: QuantumQA: Enhancing Scientific Reasoning via Physics-Consistent Dataset and Verification-Aware Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: QuantumQA：通过符合物理规律的数据集和基于验证的强化学习技术提升科学推理能力
papers.authors: Songxin Qu, Tai-Ping Sun, Yun-Jie Wang, Huan-Yu Liu, Cheng Xue, Xiao-Fan Xu, Han Fang, Yang Yang, Yu-Chun Wu, Guo-Ping Guo, Zhao-Yun Chen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show strong capabilities in general reasoning but typically lack reliability in scientific domains like quantum mechanics, which demand strict adherence to physical constraints. This limitation arises from the scarcity of verifiable training resources and the inadequacy of coarse feedback signals in standard alignment paradigms. To address the data challenge, we introduce QuantumQA, a large-scale dataset constructed via a task-adaptive strategy and a hybrid verification protocol that combines deterministic solvers with semantic auditing to guarantee scientific rigor. Building on this foundation, we propose the verification-aware reward model (VRM) tailored for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), which employs an adaptive reward fusion (ARF) mechanism to dynamically integrate deterministic signals from a scientific execution suite (SES) with multidimensional semantic evaluations for precise supervision. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms baselines and general-purpose preference models. Notably, our optimized 8B model achieves performance competitive with proprietary models, validating that incorporating verifiable, rule-based feedback into the reinforcement learning loop offers a parameter-efficient alternative to pure scaling.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在一般推理方面表现出强大的能力，但在量子力学等科学领域却往往缺乏可靠性，因为这些领域需要严格遵守物理约束。这种局限性源于可验证训练资源的匮乏，以及标准对齐范式中粗略反馈信号的不足。为了应对数据挑战，我们提出了QuantumQA这一大规模数据集。该数据集通过任务自适应策略构建，并采用了混合验证方案，结合确定性求解器和语义审核机制，以确保科学的严谨性。在此基础上，我们提出了一种针对可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的验证感知奖励模型（VRM）。该模型采用自适应奖励融合机制，能够动态整合来自科学执行套件的确定性信号与多维语义评估结果，从而实现精确的监督。实验结果表明，我们的方法始终优于基线和通用偏好模型。值得注意的是，我们优化的8B模型所表现出的性能与专有模型相当，这证明了将可验证、基于规则的反馈纳入强化学习循环中，是一种比单纯扩展更高效的替代方案。

papers.title: The “Knowledge–Behavior Gap” in Cultural Taboo Safety of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型在文化禁忌相关安全性问题上的“知识-行为差距”
papers.authors: Ying He, Sihang Jiang, Xingzhou Chen, Zhouhong Gu, Yiwei Gu, Minggui HE, Shimin Tao, Mahongxia, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: Cultural taboo safety is essential for deploying large language models (LLMs), as culturally insensitive outputs may cause offense or even social harm. However, existing cultural benchmarks primarily assess cultural knowledge or values biases, while overlooking whether LLMs can recognize and respect cultural taboos, especially when taboos are implicitly hidden in seemingly harmless questions. Besides, cultural taboos are implicit, and context-dependent, thus poss unique challenges for reliable evaluation. To address these gaps, we introduce CulShield, the first public benchmark dedicated to evaluating and improving the cultural taboo safety of LLMs. CulShield spans 77 countries and regions, and includes over 2,020 taboos. It evaluates models along both explicit knowledge and implicit behaviors.Experiments on several advanced LLMs (e.g., GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.5-pro) reveal a clear “knowledge-behavior gap”: models often fail to apply known taboos during interaction. We further show that variations in linguistic context can significantly affect LLMs’ cultural taboo safety. Code and data is accessible here: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CulShield-7A0E.
papers.abstract_zh: 在部署大语言模型时，文化禁忌的安全性至关重要，因为不尊重文化的输出可能会引发冒犯甚至社会伤害。然而，现有的文化评估标准主要关注的是文化知识或价值观的偏见，而忽略了大语言模型是否能够识别并尊重文化禁忌，尤其是在禁忌隐含在看似无害的问题中的情况下。此外，文化禁忌是隐性的且依赖于上下文，因此为可靠评估带来了独特的挑战。为了弥补这些不足，我们推出了CulShield——首个专门用于评估和改进大语言模型文化禁忌安全性的公开基准测试。CulShield涵盖了77个国家和地区，包含了超过2,020条禁忌内容。该测试同时评估了模型的显性知识和隐性行为。对多个先进大语言模型（如GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-2.5-pro）的实验表明，模型在互动过程中常常无法应用已知的禁忌。我们还发现，语言环境的差异会显著影响大语言模型的文化禁忌安全性。相关代码和数据可在此处获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CulShield-7A0E

papers.title: OSCBench: Benchmarking Object State Change in Text-to-Video Generation
papers.title_zh: OSCBench：针对文本转视频生成过程中对象状态变化的性能评估
papers.authors: Xianjing Han, Bin Zhu, Shiqi Hu, Franklin Mingzhe Li, Patrick Carrington, Roger Zimmermann, Jingjing Chen
papers.abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models have made rapid progress in producing visually high-quality and temporally coherent videos. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on perceptual quality, text–video alignment, or physical plausibility, leaving a critical aspect of action understanding largely unexplored: object state change (OSC) explicitly specified in the text prompt. OSC refers to the transformation of an object’s state induced by an action, such as peeling a potato or slicing a lemon. In this paper, we introduce OSCBench, a benchmark specifically designed to assess OSC performance in T2V models. OSCBench is constructed from instructional cooking data and systematically organizes action–object interactions into regular, novel, and compositional scenarios to probe both in-distribution performance and generalization. We evaluate six representative open-source and proprietary T2V models using both human user study and multimodal large language model (MLLM)–based automatic evaluation. Our results show that, despite strong performance on semantic and scene alignment, current T2V models consistently struggle with accurate and temporally consistent object state changes, especially in novel and compositional settings. These findings position OSC as a key bottleneck in text-to-video generation and establish OSCBench as a diagnostic benchmark for advancing state-aware video generation models. Project page: https://hanxjing.github.io/OSCBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到视频生成模型在生成视觉质量高且时间连贯的视频方面取得了显著进展。然而，现有的评估基准主要侧重于感知质量、文本与视频的对齐程度或物理上的合理性，而动作理解中的一个关键方面——文本提示中明确指定的物体状态变化——却尚未得到充分探索。物体状态变化指的是由某个动作引发的物体状态的转变，例如剥土豆或切柠檬。在本文中，我们引入了OSCBench这一专门用于评估文本到视频模型中物体状态变化性能的基准测试。OSCBench基于烹饪教学数据构建，将动作与物体的互动系统地划分为规则、新颖和组合性的场景，以探究模型在不同环境下的表现以及泛化能力。我们通过人类用户研究和基于多模态大语言模型的自动评估方法，对六种代表性的开源和专有文本到视频模型进行了评估。结果表明，尽管当前文本到视频模型在语义和场景对齐方面表现出色，但在准确且时间连贯地处理物体状态变化时仍然存在困难，尤其是在新颖和组合性的场景中。这些发现表明，物体状态变化是文本到视频生成的一个重要瓶颈，而OSCBench则成为了推动状态感知型视频生成模型发展的有效诊断工具。项目页面：https://hanxjing.github.io/OSCBench

papers.title: Evaluation Pitfalls and Challenges in Multimedia Event Extraction
papers.title_zh: 多媒体事件提取中的评估陷阱与挑战
papers.authors: Philipp Seeberger, Steffen Freisinger, Tobias Bocklet, Korbinian Riedhammer
papers.abstract: Multimedia event extraction aims to jointly identify events and their arguments across multiple modalities, such as text and images, to support more comprehensive event understanding. While recent work reports steady and substantial progress, the reliability and comparability of these results critically depend on consistent and rigorous evaluation. In this work, we present the first systematic analysis of evaluation pitfalls in multimedia event extraction and identify three major sources of issues: inconsistent data processing, inconsistent task assumptions, and overly relaxed evaluation settings. We demonstrate, through a series of controlled experiments under a strict evaluation framework, that minor evaluation choices can cause large performance variations and lead to overestimation of a model’s ability to ground real-world events across modalities. Our findings highlight the need for comparable evaluation standards and encourage a shift toward more rigorous evaluation in multimedia event extraction.
papers.abstract_zh: 多媒体事件提取旨在共同识别各种模态下的事件及其相关参数，例如文本和图像，以实现更全面的事件理解。虽然近期的研究取得了稳步且显著的进展，但这些结果的可靠性和可比性在很大程度上取决于一致且严格的评估方式。在本研究中，我们首次对多媒体事件提取中的评估缺陷进行了系统分析，并发现了三个主要的问题来源：数据处理不一致、任务假设不统一以及评估设置过于宽松。通过一系列在严格评估框架下的控制实验，我们发现一些微小的评估选择会导致性能出现较大波动，并可能导致对模型跨模态处理现实世界事件的能力的过高估计。我们的研究结果强调了制定可比评估标准的必要性，并促使我们在多媒体事件提取方面采取更为严格的评估方式。

papers.title: UMPIRE: Unveiling LLM-generated Posts via Redundant Expressions
papers.title_zh: 裁判员：通过冗余表达来揭示由大型语言模型生成的文章内容
papers.authors: Xiaoquan Yi, Haixing Wu, Haozhao Wang, Yichen Li, Yuhua Li, Rui Zhang, Ruixuan Li
papers.abstract: The proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has saturated social media platforms with hyper-realistic posts, rendering traditional detection methods that rely on low-level artifacts or unimodal statistics increasingly ineffective. In this work, we identify a fundamental semantic distinction: humans tend to complement visual content with additional context, while LLMs predominantly describe the visual information. To capture this, UMPIRE employs an orthogonal semantic decomposition mechanism that disentangles textual embeddings into redundant and complementary components. An adaptive gating module dynamically weighs these components to reflect diverse communicative styles. To enforce the desired geometric structure, we introduce a latent contrastive redundancy regularization loss that encourages LLM-generated content to exhibit high semantic redundancy, while human-written content emphasizes complementarity. Experimental results demonstrate that UMPIRE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art detection methods across multiple datasets, achieving up to a 5.38% improvement in accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的广泛传播使得社交媒体平台上的帖子变得过于逼真，那些依赖低级特征或单一统计数据的传统检测方法变得越来越无效。在这项研究中，我们发现了一种基本的语义差异：人类倾向于用额外的上下文来补充视觉内容，而大语言模型则主要描述视觉信息。为了捕捉这一特点，UMPIRE采用了一种正交的语义分解机制，将文本嵌入分解为冗余和互补的成分。一个自适应门控模块能够动态调整这些成分的权重，以反映不同的沟通风格。为了强化所需的几何结构，我们引入了一种潜在对比冗余正则化损失函数，该函数促使大语言模型生成的内容具有高度的语义冗余性，而人类编写的内容则强调互补性。实验结果表明，UMPIRE在多个数据集上的表现显著优于最先进的方法，准确率提高了5.38%。

papers.title: SpeechMedAssist: Efficiently and Effectively Adapting Speech Language Models for Medical Consultation
papers.title_zh: SpeechMedAssist：高效且有效地调整语音语言模型以适用于医疗咨询场景
papers.authors: Sirry Chen, Jieyi Wang, Wei Chen, Zhongyu Wei
papers.abstract: Medical consultations are intrinsically speech-centric. However, most prior works focus on long-text-based interactions, which are cumbersome and patient-unfriendly. Recent advances in speech language models (SpeechLMs) have enabled more natural speech-based interaction, yet the scarcity of medical speech data and the inefficiency of directly fine-tuning on speech data jointly hinder the adoption of SpeechLMs in medical consultation. In this paper, we propose SpeechMedAssist, a SpeechLM natively capable of conducting speech-based multi-turn interactions with patients. By exploiting the architectural properties of SpeechLMs, we decouple the conventional one-stage training into a two-stage paradigm consisting of (1) Knowledge Capability Injection via Text and (2) Modality Re-alignment with Limited Speech Data, thereby reducing the requirement for medical speech data to only 10k synthesized samples. To evaluate SpeechLMs for medical consultation scenarios, we design a benchmark comprising both single-turn question answering and multi-turn simulated interactions. Experimental results show that our model outperforms all baselines in both effectiveness and robustness in most evaluation settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 医疗咨询本质上是以语音为中心的互动过程。然而，目前大多数研究都集中在基于长文本的互动上，这种方式既繁琐又不利于患者体验。近年来，语音语言模型在交互方式上的进步使得基于语音的互动变得更加自然，但由于医疗语音数据的稀缺以及直接对语音数据进行微调的效率低下，这些因素共同限制了语音语言模型在医疗咨询中的应用。在本文中，我们提出了SpeechMedAssist这一基于语音语言模型的工具，它能够直接进行与患者的多轮语音互动。通过利用语音语言模型的架构特性，我们将传统的单阶段训练方式分解为两个阶段：第一阶段是通过文本注入知识能力；第二阶段则是利用有限的语音数据重新调整模态结构。这样，所需的医疗语音数据量减少到了仅10k的合成样本。为了评估语音语言模型在医疗咨询场景中的表现，我们设计了一个包含单轮问答和多轮模拟互动的测试基准。实验结果表明，我们的模型在大多数评估指标上均优于所有基线模型，无论是在效果还是鲁棒性方面都是如此。

papers.title: An Experimental Study on the Influence of Culture on Cross-Lingual Sentiment Transfer
papers.title_zh: 关于文化对跨语言情感表达影响的研究实验
papers.authors: Ahao Liu, Haitong Yang, Wang Chuanrong
papers.abstract: Identical linguistic expressions can convey different sentiments across cultural contexts. Yet, current multilingual models often reduce language to mere symbolic representation, neglecting the cultural pragmatics that fundamentally shape affective semantics in Sentiment Analysis (SA). Due to this oversight, the systematic performance degradation of Small Multilingual Language Models (SMLMs) on culturally distant targets is frequently attributed to resource constraints. This perspective obscures the pivotal role of cultural pragmatics, an intrinsic determinant of affective semantics, and thereby conceals cultural misalignment as the principal structural bottleneck. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study to quantify the influence of culture on cross-lingual sentiment transfer across 7 common SMLMs and 5 linguistically diverse languages. By fitting a Linear Mixed-Effects Model (LMEM) on over 300 experimental runs, we disentangle cultural factors from confounding variables. Our results reveal that Cultural Distance is a significant, independent, negative predictor of transfer performance. Furthermore, representation probing and qualitative error analysis uncover a pragmatic alignment paradox: while SMLMs encode cultural distinctions, they fail to map these representations to downstream sentiment labels in high-context cultures. Ultimately, our work enhances the interpretability of cross-lingual transfer failures by statistically isolating cultural misalignment as a structural barrier, distinct from the resource constraints typically blamed for poor performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 相同的语言表达可以在不同的文化背景下传达不同的情感。然而，当前的多语言模型往往将语言简化为单纯的符号表示，忽视了在情感分析过程中对情感语义起根本作用的文化语用学因素。由于这种忽视，小型多语言模型在文化差异较大的目标语言上的性能下降常常被归因于资源限制。这种观点掩盖了文化语用学的重要性，而文化语用学是情感语义的内在决定因素。因此，文化不匹配被视作主要的结构性瓶颈。在本文中，我们进行了全面的实证研究，以量化文化对7种常见多语言模型和5种不同语言之间的跨语言情感转移的影响。通过对超过300次实验运行进行线性混合效应模型分析，我们将文化因素与混杂变量区分开来。我们的研究结果表明，文化距离是一个重要的、独立的负面预测因子，它会影响情感转移的绩效。此外，通过表征探测和定性错误分析，我们发现了一个语用对齐的悖论：虽然多语言模型能够编码文化差异，但在高语境文化中，它们无法将这些表征映射到下游的情感标签上。最终，我们的研究通过统计上将文化不匹配作为结构性障碍，提高了对跨语言转移失败现象的可解释性，这与通常认为是由于资源限制导致的性能不佳是不同的。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Attribution, Citation, and Quotation: A Survey of Evidence-based Text Generation with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 归属、引用与引述：基于证据的文本生成研究——以大型语言模型为手段
papers.authors: Tobias Schreieder, Tim Schopf, Michael Färber
papers.abstract: The increasing adoption of large language models (LLMs) has raised serious concerns about their reliability and trustworthiness. As a result, a growing body of research focuses on evidence-based text generation with LLMs, aiming to link model outputs to supporting evidence to ensure traceability and verifiability. However, the field is fragmented due to inconsistent terminology, isolated evaluation practices, and a lack of unified benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we systematically analyze 134 papers, introduce a unified taxonomy of evidence-based text generation with LLMs, and investigate 300 evaluation metrics across seven key dimensions. Thereby, we focus on approaches that use citations, attribution, or quotations for evidence-based text generation. Building on this, we examine the distinctive characteristics and representative methods in the field. Finally, we highlight open challenges and outline promising directions for future work.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的日益广泛应用引发了人们对其可靠性和可信度的严重担忧。因此，越来越多的研究致力于利用LLM进行基于证据的文本生成，旨在将模型输出与支持性证据联系起来，以确保可追溯性和可验证性。然而，由于术语不一致、评估方法孤立以及缺乏统一的基准标准，这一领域仍然处于分散状态。为了填补这一空白，我们系统分析了134篇相关论文，提出了一种统一的基于证据的LLM文本生成分类体系，并研究了七个关键维度下的300个评估指标。我们重点关注那些利用引用、归属或引文来进行基于证据的文本生成的方法。在此基础上，我们探讨了该领域的独特特征及代表性方法。最后，我们指出了当前面临的挑战，并提出了未来工作的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MirrorCAPTCHA: Wild CAPTCHA, Wild Distribution, Wild Web-based Platform Meet Multimodal LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: MirrorCAPTCHA：野生式CAPTCHA挑战、分布式挑战，以及基于网络的平台挑战——这些场景都适用于多模态大语言模型代理来处理
papers.authors: Xiangyu Wu, Yuwei Hu, Tianyu Cui, Yueying Tian, Qing-Guo Chen, Zhao Xu, Weihua Luo, Kaifu Zhang, Yang Yang, Jianfeng Lu
papers.abstract: The path to fully autonomous web agents is currently hindered by a critical bottleneck: their limited ability to handle CAPTCHA. Existing agent benchmarks largely ignore this practical challenge, failing to evaluate an agent’s real-world capacity to solve CAPTCHA. To bridge this gap, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of real-world CAPTCHA distributions and introduce MirrorCAPTCHA, a benchmark annotated with Weighted Pass Rate and a newly proposed metric Completion Degree. MirrorCAPTCHA is designed to serve as a “mirror” that faithfully reflects the automation capabilities of agents in real scenarios. We filter 2095 websites from Common Crawl, identify the CAPTCHA deployed on these sites, and cluster them into 18 distinct categories using K-means algorithm. To ensure practicality, we extract a web subgraph from Common Crawl covering these websites and use random walks to simulate real-world CAPTCHA encounter frequencies, yielding a realistic measure of agents’ ability. Additionally, we develop a lightweight synthetic data pipeline to train Ovis2-Agent-CAPTCHA-8B, which significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art closed-source models on MirrorCAPTCHA, achieving a 9.4% higher average Weighted Pass Rate and a 2.13% higher average Completion Degree than the runner-up, Gemini-2.5-Pro.
papers.abstract_zh: 通往完全自主网络代理的道路目前面临着一个关键的瓶颈：这些代理在处理验证码方面能力有限。现有的代理评估基准大多忽略了这一实际挑战，未能准确评估代理在现实场景中解决验证码的能力。为了弥补这一不足，我们对现实中的验证码分布进行了全面分析，并引入了MirrorCAPTCHA这一基准测试工具。该工具包含了加权通过率和新提出的完成度指标。MirrorCAPTCHA旨在作为一面“镜子”，真实反映代理在现实场景中的自动化能力。我们从Common Crawl中筛选出了2095个网站，识别出这些网站上使用的验证码，并使用K均值算法将它们分为18个不同的类别。为了确保评估的实用性，我们从Common Crawl中提取了包含这些网站的子图，并通过随机游走来模拟现实世界中遇到验证码的频率，从而得出关于代理能力的真实衡量标准。此外，我们还开发了一个轻量级的合成数据管道，用于训练Ovis2-Agent-CAPTCHA-8B模型。该模型在MirrorCAPTCHA任务上的表现显著优于当前最先进的开源模型，其加权平均通过率比第二名Gemini-2.5-Pro高出9.4%，完成度则高出2.13%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ReCreate: Reasoning and Creating Domain Agents Driven by Experience
papers.title_zh: ReCreate：基于经验驱动的推理与领域代理创建
papers.authors: Zhezheng Hao, Hong Wang, Jian Luo, Jianqing Zhang, Yuyan Zhou, Qiang Lin, Can Wang, Hande Dong, Jiawei Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are reshaping the industrial landscape. However, most practical agents remain human-designed because tasks differ widely, making them labor-intensive to build. This situation poses a central question: can we automatically create and adapt domain agents in the wild? While several recent approaches have sought to automate agent creation, they typically treat agent generation as a black-box procedure and rely solely on final performance metrics to guide the process. Such strategies overlook critical evidence explaining why an agent succeeds or fails, and often require high computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose ReCreate, an experience-driven framework for the automatic creation of domain agents. ReCreate systematically leverages agent interaction histories, which provide rich concrete signals on both the causes of success or failure and the avenues for improvement. Specifically, we introduce an agent-as-optimizer paradigm that effectively learns from experience via three key components: (i) an experience storage and retrieval mechanism for on-demand inspection; (ii) a reasoning–creating synergy pipeline that map execution experience into scaffold edits; and (iii) hierarchical updates that abstract instance-level details into reusable domain patterns. In experiments across diverse domains, ReCreate consistently outperforms human-designed agents and existing automated agent generation methods, even when starting from minimal seed scaffolds.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理正在重塑工业领域。然而，由于任务种类繁多，大多数实际使用的代理仍然是由人类设计的，因为构建这些代理需要大量的劳动投入。这种情况提出了一个核心问题：我们能否在现实环境中自动创建并调整合适的代理呢？虽然最近有一些方法试图实现代理的自动化创建，但这些方法通常将代理的生成过程视为一个黑箱操作，并且仅依赖最终的性能指标来指导这一过程。这样的策略忽略了解释代理为何成功或失败的关键因素，而且往往还需要高昂的计算成本。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了ReCreate这一基于经验的框架，用于自动创建特定领域的代理。ReCreate系统地利用了代理的互动历史数据，这些数据提供了关于代理成功或失败的原因以及改进方向的丰富具体信息。具体来说，我们引入了“代理作为优化器”的理念，通过三个关键组件来有效学习经验：(i) 用于按需检查的经验存储和检索机制；(ii) 一种将执行经验转化为改进方案的推理与创建协同机制；以及(iii) 将实例级别的细节抽象为可重复使用的领域模式的层次化更新机制。在多个不同领域的实验中，即使是从最基础的初始结构开始，ReCreate始终能够优于由人类设计的代理以及现有的自动化代理生成方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can AI-Generated Persuasion Be Detected? Persuaficial Benchmark and AI vs. Human Linguistic Differences
papers.title_zh: 人工智能生成的说服力能否被识别？说服力的基准测试以及人工智能与人类在语言运用上的差异
papers.authors: Arkadiusz Modzelewski, Paweł Golik, Anna Kołos, Giovanni Da San Martino
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate highly persuasive text, raising concerns about their misuse for propaganda, manipulation, and other harmful purposes. This leads us to our central question: Is LLM-generated persuasion more difficult to automatically detect than human-written persuasion? To address this, we categorize controllable generation approaches for producing persuasive content with LLMs and introduce Persuaficial, a high-quality multilingual benchmark covering six languages: English, German, Polish, Italian, French and Russian. Using this benchmark, we conduct extensive empirical evaluations comparing human-authored and LLM-generated persuasive texts. We find that although overtly persuasive LLM-generated texts can be easier to detect than human-written ones, subtle LLM-generated persuasion consistently degrades automatic detection performance. Beyond detection performance, we provide the first comprehensive linguistic analysis contrasting human and LLM-generated persuasive texts, offering insights that may guide the development of more interpretable and robust detection tools.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够生成极具说服力的文本，这引发了人们对它们被滥用以用于宣传、操纵以及其他有害目的的担忧。这就引出了我们的核心问题：与人类撰写的说服性文本相比，通过语言模型生成的说服性文本是否更难以被自动检测？为了解答这个问题，我们对使用语言模型生成有说服力的内容的方法进行了分类，并引入了“Persuaficial”这一高质量的多语言基准测试，该测试涵盖英语、德语、波兰语、意大利语、法语和俄语六种语言。利用这一基准测试，我们进行了广泛的实证评估，比较了人类撰写和语言模型生成的说服性文本。我们发现，虽然明显具有说服力的语言模型生成的文本可能更容易被检测到，但微妙的语言模型生成的说服性文本却始终会导致自动检测性能下降。除了检测性能之外，我们还提供了对人类和语言模型生成的说服性文本进行全面的语言分析，这些分析为开发更易于理解且更强大的检测工具提供了有价值的见解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GASE: Graph-Aware Semantic Embedding Learning with Frozen LLMs for Text-Attributed Graphs
papers.title_zh: GASE：基于图结构的语义嵌入学习技术，利用冻结后的大语言模型来实现文本与图的关联映射
papers.authors: Mingqian Ding, Jianjun Li, Wenqi Yang, Zhibo Zhang, Yushen Fang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for text-attributed graph (TAG) learning, yet effectively integrating LLM semantics with graph structural information remains challenging. Embeddings obtained from frozen LLMs lack topology awareness, while fine-tuning LLMs is often computationally expensive. Moreover, LLM embeddings are high-dimensional, and naively reducing dimensionality tends to destroy semantics. To address these issues, we propose GASE, a framework for learning Graph-Aware Semantic Embeddings using frozen LLMs. GASE consists of two key stages: First, we introduce a Training-Free Structure-Aware Semantic Extraction (TSSE) module. Through inter-layer semantic feedback and progressive masked attention, it efficiently compresses and propagates semantic context from neighboring nodes without updating LLM parameters. Second, we propose a Subspace Decomposition and Structural Injection (SDSI) strategy. Embeddings obtained from TSSE are decomposed into a semantic-rich subspace and a structural injection subspace, and structural signals are injected into the latter, which preserves original semantics while integrating graph information. Experiments demonstrate that GASE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on node classification and achieves a 5× speedup over fine-tuning-based methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在文本属性图学习方面展现出巨大潜力，但将语言模型的语义与图结构信息有效整合仍然是一个挑战。从冻结的语言模型中获得的嵌入缺乏拓扑意识，而微调语言模型往往需要大量的计算资源。此外，语言模型嵌入具有高度维度化特征，简单地降低维度往往会破坏其语义特性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了GASE框架——该框架利用冻结的语言模型来学习具有图感知的语义嵌入。GASE包含两个关键步骤：首先，我们引入了一种无需训练的基于结构感知的语义提取模块。通过层间语义反馈和渐进式掩码注意力机制，该模块能够高效压缩并传递邻近节点的语义上下文信息，而无需更新语言模型参数。其次，我们提出了一种子空间分解与结构注入策略。通过这种策略，从TSSE获得的嵌入被分解为一个富含语义的子空间和一个包含结构信息的子空间，结构信号被注入到后者中，从而在保留原始语义的同时整合了图结构信息。实验结果表明，GASE在节点分类任务上的表现优于现有最先进的方法，其处理速度比基于微调的方法快了5倍。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Compositional Steering of Large Language Models with Steering Tokens
papers.title_zh: 利用引导令牌对大型语言模型进行组合式操控
papers.authors: Gorjan Radevski, Kiril Gashteovski, Giwon Hong, Carolin Lawrence, Goran Glavaš
papers.abstract: Deploying LLMs in real-world applications requires controllable output that satisfies multiple desiderata at the same time. While existing work extensively addresses LLM steering for a single behavior, compositional steering—i.e., steering LLMs simultaneously towards multiple behaviors—remains an underexplored problem. In this work, we propose compositional steering tokens for multi-behavior steering. We first embed individual behaviors, expressed as natural language instructions, into dedicated tokens via self-distillation. Contrary to most prior work, which operates in the activation space, our behavior steers live in the space of input tokens, enabling more effective zero-shot composition. We then train a dedicated composition token on pairs of behaviors and show that it successfully captures the notion of composition: it generalizes well to unseen compositions, including those with unseen behaviors as well as those with an unseen number of behaviors. Our experiments across different LLM architectures show that steering tokens lead to superior multi-behavior steering of verifiable constraints (e.g., length, format, structure, language) compared to competing approaches (instructions, activation steering, and LoRA merging). Moreover, we show that steering tokens complement natural language instructions, with their combination resulting in further gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实应用中使用大语言模型时，需要能够同时满足多种需求的可控输出。虽然现有的研究大多集中在针对单一行为的引导上，但针对多个行为的组合引导仍然是一个未被充分探索的问题。在本研究中，我们提出了用于多行为引导的组合引导令牌。我们首先通过自蒸馏将各个行为以自然语言指令的形式嵌入到专门的令牌中。与大多数基于激活空间的操作不同，我们的行为引导实际上发生在输入令牌的空间中，这使得零样本组合更加有效。接着，我们针对成对行为对训练了一个专门的组合令牌，并证明它能够成功捕捉组合的概念：该令牌能够很好地泛化到未见过的组合情况，包括那些包含未见过的行为以及具有未知数量行为的组合情况。我们在不同的大语言模型架构上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，使用引导令牌能够实现更优越的多行为引导，从而更好地满足可验证的约束条件（如长度、格式、结构、语言等）。此外，我们还发现，引导令牌可以补充自然语言指令的作用，两者的结合能够带来更大的提升效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Rethinking Entropy Interventions in RLVR: An Entropy Change Perspective
papers.title_zh: 重新思考RLVR中的熵干预策略：从熵变化的角度出发
papers.authors: Zhezheng Hao, Hong Wang, Haoyang Liu, Jian Luo, Jiarui Yu, Hande Dong, Qiang Lin, Can Wang, Jiawei Chen
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) serves as a cornerstone technique for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, its training is often plagued by entropy collapse, a rapid decline in policy entropy that limits exploration and undermines training effectiveness. While recent works attempt to mitigate this issue via several heuristic entropy interventions, the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we conduct comprehensive theoretical and empirical analyses of entropy dynamics in RLVR, offering two main insights: (1) We derive a tight approximation for token-level entropy change at each update step, revealing four governing factors and providing a unified theoretical framework of how existing methods influence entropy; (2) We reveal a fundamental limitation of recent approaches: they rely on heuristic adjustments to one or two of these factors, leaving other relevant factors unconsidered, thus inherently limiting their effectiveness. Motivated by these findings, we propose STEER, a principled entropy-modulation method that adaptively reweighs tokens based on theoretically-estimated entropy variations. Extensive experiments across six mathematical reasoning and three coding benchmarks demonstrate that STEER effectively mitigates entropy collapse and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是一种提升大语言模型推理能力的核心技术。然而，其训练过程中常常会出现熵崩溃的问题，即策略熵的快速下降，这限制了探索能力并降低了训练效果。虽然近期的研究尝试通过多种启发式熵调整方法来缓解这一问题，但其背后的机制仍然缺乏深入的理解。在这项研究中，我们对RLVR中的熵动态进行了全面的理论和实证分析，得出了两个重要发现：(1) 我们推导出了每次更新时令牌级熵变化的精确近似表达式，揭示了四个影响熵的因素，并为现有方法如何影响熵提供了统一的理论框架；(2) 我们发现近期方法的根本缺陷在于：它们仅依赖于对其中一两个因素的启发式调整，而忽略了其他相关因素，因此本质上限制了它们的有效性。基于这些发现，我们提出了STEER方法，这是一种基于理论估算的熵变化来自适应重新分配令牌权重的方法。在六个数学推理测试和三个编程基准测试中的广泛实验表明，STEER能够有效缓解熵崩溃问题，并且始终优于现有的最先进基线算法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
