papers.title: SwissGov-RSD: A Human-annotated, Cross-lingual Benchmark for Token-level Recognition of Semantic Differences Between Related Documents
papers.title_zh: SwissGov-RSD：由人类标注的、跨语言基准数据集，用于识别相关文档之间的语义差异，精确到词级
papers.authors: Michelle Wastl, Jannis Vamvas, Rico Sennrich
papers.abstract: Recognizing semantic differences across documents is crucial for text generation evaluation and content alignment, especially in cross-lingual settings. However, as a standalone task, it has received little attention. We address this by introducing SwissGov-RSD, the first naturalistic, document-level, cross-lingual dataset for semantic difference recognition. It encompasses a total of 224 multi-parallel documents in English–German, English–French, and English–Italian with token-level difference annotations by human annotators.We evaluate a variety of open-source and closed-source large language models as well as encoder models across different fine-tuning settings on this new benchmark. Our results show that current automatic approaches perform poorly compared to their performance on monolingual, sentence-level, and synthetic benchmarks, revealing a considerable gap for both LLMs and encoder models.
papers.abstract_zh: 识别不同文档之间的语义差异对于文本生成评估和内容对齐至关重要，尤其是在跨语言的情况下。然而，作为一个独立的任务，它却很少受到关注。我们为了解决这个问题，引入了SwissGov-RSD这一首个基于自然语言的、针对文档级别的、跨语言语义差异识别的数据集。该数据集包含共224个多并行文档，涵盖英语-德语、英语-法语和英语-意大利语三种语言对，且这些文档的语义差异注释是由人类标注者完成的。我们在这一新的基准测试上评估了多种开源和闭源的大语言模型以及编码器模型在不同微调设置下的性能。我们的结果显示，目前的自动方法在单语言、句子级别以及合成基准测试上的表现远远不如预期，这表明LLM和编码器模型之间存在相当大的差距。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Seeing but Not Thinking: Routing Distraction in Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts
papers.title_zh: 只看到而并未真正思考：在多模态混合专家系统中利用干扰因素的方法
papers.authors: Haolei Xu, Haiwen Hong, Hongxing Li, Rui Zhou, Yang Zhang, Longtao Huang, Hui Xue, Yongliang Shen, Weiming Lu, Yueting Zhuang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have achieved remarkable performance on vision-language tasks. However, we identify a puzzling phenomenon termed Seeing but Not Thinking: models accurately perceive image content yet fail in subsequent reasoning, while correctly solving identical problems presented as pure text. Through systematic analysis, we first verify that cross-modal semantic sharing exists in MoE architectures, ruling out semantic alignment failure as the sole explanation. We then reveal that visual experts and domain experts exhibit layer-wise separation, with image inputs inducing significant routing divergence from text inputs in middle layers where domain experts concentrate. Based on these findings, we propose the Routing Distraction hypothesis: when processing visual inputs, the routing mechanism fails to adequately activate task-relevant reasoning experts. To validate this hypothesis, we design a routing-guided intervention method that enhances domain expert activation. Experiments on three multimodal MoE models across six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements, with gains of up to 3.17% on complex visual reasoning tasks. Our analysis further reveals that domain expert identification locates cognitive functions rather than sample-specific solutions, enabling effective transfer across tasks with different information structures.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态专家混合模型在视觉-语言任务上取得了显著的性能表现。然而，我们发现了一个令人困惑的现象：模型能够准确识别图像内容，但在后续的推理过程中却表现不佳，而处理纯文本形式的问题时则能够成功解决。通过系统的分析，我们首先验证了多模态专家混合架构中存在跨模态语义共享现象，从而排除了语义对齐失败作为唯一原因的可能性。接着我们发现，视觉专家和领域专家在层次结构上存在分离现象，图像输入会在中间层产生与文本输入显著不同的推理结果，而这一区域正是领域专家集中的地方。基于这些发现，我们提出了“路由干扰假说”：在处理视觉输入时，路由机制未能充分激活与任务相关的推理专家。为了验证这一假说，我们设计了一种基于路由引导的干预方法，以增强领域专家的活跃度。在六个基准测试中的三个多模态专家混合模型上的实验表明，该方法能够带来持续的改进，在复杂的视觉推理任务上甚至实现了高达3.17%的性能提升。我们的分析还揭示了，领域专家的识别能够定位认知功能，而非特定于样本的解决方案，这使得模型能够在具有不同信息结构的任务之间实现有效的迁移。

papers.title: RubricBench: Aligning Model-Generated Rubrics with Human Standards
papers.title_zh: RubricBench：将模型生成的评分标准与人类的标准进行对齐
papers.authors: Junyi Zhou, Qiyuan Zhang, Yufei Wang, Fuyuan Lyu, Yidong Ming, Can Xu, Qingfeng Sun, Kai Zheng, Peng Kang, Xue Liu, Chen Ma
papers.abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) alignment evolves from simple completions to complex, highly sophisticated generation, Reward Models are increasingly shifting toward rubric-guided evaluation to mitigate surface-level biases. However, the community lacks a unified benchmark to assess this evaluation paradigm, as existing benchmarks lack both the discriminative complexity and the ground-truth rubric annotations required for rigorous analysis. To bridge this gap, we introduce RubricBench, a curated benchmark with 1,147 pairwise comparisons specifically designed to assess the reliability of rubric-based evaluation. Our construction employs a multi-dimensional filtration pipeline to target hard samples featuring nuanced input complexity and misleading surface bias, augmenting each with expert-annotated, atomic rubrics derived strictly from instructions. Comprehensive experiments reveal a substantial capability gap between human-annotated and model-generated rubrics, indicating that even state-of-the-art models struggle to autonomously specify valid evaluation criteria, lagging considerably behind human-guided performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的对齐技术从简单的补全方式发展到复杂的、高度复杂的生成方式，奖励模型正逐渐转向基于评分标准的评估方式，以缓解表面上的偏见。然而，目前该领域缺乏一个统一的基准来评估这种评估方式，因为现有的基准缺乏进行严格分析所需的区分性复杂性和真实评分标准注释。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了RubricBench——一个经过精心设计的基准测试，包含1,147个成对比较，专门用于评估基于评分标准评估的可靠性。我们的构建采用了多维过滤流程，以针对那些具有微妙输入复杂性和误导性表面偏见的样本，并辅以由专家注释的、完全基于指令生成的原子性评分标准。全面的实验表明，人类注释的评分标准和模型生成的评分标准之间存在显著的能力差距，这表明即使是最先进的模型也难以自主指定有效的评估标准，其表现远远落后于人类主导的评估方式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Verify Before You Commit: Towards Faithful Reasoning in LLM Agents via Self-Auditing
papers.title_zh: 在采取行动之前进行验证：通过自我审核来实现LLM代理的可靠推理
papers.authors: Wenhao Yuan, Chenchen Lin, Jian Chen, Jinfeng Xu, Xuehe Wang, Edith Cheuk-Han Ngai
papers.abstract: In large language model (LLM) agents, reasoning trajectories are treated as reliable internal beliefs for guiding actions and updating memory. However, coherent reasoning can still violate logical or evidential constraints, allowing unsupported beliefs repeatedly stored and propagated across decision steps, leading to systematic behavioral drift in long-horizon agentic systems. Most existing strategies rely on the consensus mechanism, conflating agreement with faithfulness. In this paper, inspired by the vulnerability of unfaithful intermediate reasoning trajectories, we propose Self-Audited Verified Reasoning (SAVeR), a novel framework that enforces verification over internal belief states within the agent before action commitment, achieving faithful reasoning. Concretely, we structurally generate persona-based diverse candidate beliefs for selection under a faithfulness-relevant structure space. To achieve reasoning faithfulness, we perform adversarial auditing to localize violations and repair through constraint-guided minimal interventions under verifiable acceptance criteria. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently improves reasoning faithfulness while preserving competitive end-task performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型（LLM）代理中，推理轨迹被视为指导行动和更新记忆的可靠内部信念。然而，连贯的推理仍可能违反逻辑或证据约束，导致不受支持的信念被反复存储并传播到各个决策步骤中，从而导致长期视角下的代理系统出现系统性行为偏差。目前大多数策略都依赖于共识机制，将一致性与可靠性混为一谈。本文受限于不忠实的中间推理轨迹所带来的问题，提出了一种名为“自我审核验证推理”的新框架。该框架在采取行动之前，会对代理内部的信念状态进行验证，从而实现可靠的推理。具体来说，我们构建了基于角色的多样化候选信念结构，以便在可靠性相关的结构空间中进行选择。为了获得可靠的推理效果，我们采用对抗性审计方法来定位违规点，并通过受约束的最小干预措施来修复这些违规点，同时确保在可验证的接受标准下完成修复工作。在六个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法能够持续提升推理的可靠性，同时保持良好的任务性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GiLT: Augmenting Transformer Language Models with Dependency Graphs
papers.title_zh: GiLT：利用依存关系图增强变换器语言模型的能力
papers.authors: Tianyu Huang, Yida Zhao, Chuyan Zhou, Kewei Tu
papers.abstract: Augmenting Transformers with linguistic structures effectively enhances the syntactic generalization performance of language models. Previous work in this direction focuses on syntactic tree structures of languages, in particular constituency tree structures. We propose Graph-Infused Layers Transformer Language Model (GiLT) which leverages dependency graphs for augmenting Transformer language models. Unlike most previous work, GiLT does not insert extra structural tokens in language modeling; instead, it injects structural information into language modeling by modulating attention weights in the Transformer with features extracted from the dependency graph that is incrementally constructed along with token prediction. In our experiments, GiLT with semantic dependency graphs achieves better syntactic generalization while maintaining competitive perplexity in comparison with Transformer language model baselines. In addition, GiLT can be finetuned from a pretrained language model to achieve improved downstream task performance. Our code is released at https://github.com/cookie-pie-oops/GiLT-LM.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过添加语言结构来扩展Transformer模型，能够有效提升语言模型的句法泛化能力。以往的相关研究主要集中在语言的句法树结构上，尤其是成分结构。我们提出了Graph-Infused Layers Transformer Language Model（GiLT），该模型利用依存关系图来扩展Transformer语言模型。与大多数先前的研究不同，GiLT并不在语言建模过程中插入额外的结构标记；而是通过将依存关系图中提取的特征与Token预测结果相结合，来调节Transformer中的注意力权重，从而将结构信息融入语言建模过程。在我们的实验中，使用带有语义依存关系图的GiLT能够在保持与Transformer语言模型基线相当的错误率的情况下，实现更好的句法泛化能力。此外，GiLT还可以从预训练的模型中进行微调，以进一步提升下游任务的性能。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/cookie-pie-oops/GiLT-LM下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TAMAS: Benchmarking Adversarial Risks in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.title_zh: 塔马斯：在多智能体大语言模型系统中评估对抗性风险
papers.authors: Ishan Kavathekar, Hemang Jain, Ameya Rathod, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru, Tanuja Ganu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities as autonomous agents through tool use, planning, and decision-making abilities, leading to their widespread adoption across diverse tasks. As task complexity grows, multi-agent LLM systems are increasingly used to solve problems collaboratively. However, safety and security of these systems remains largely under-explored. Existing benchmarks and datasets predominantly focus on single-agent settings, failing to capture the unique vulnerabilities of multi-agent dynamics and co-ordination. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{T}hreats and \textbf{A}ttacks in \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}gent \textbf{S}ystems (\textbf{TAMAS}), a benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness and safety of multi-agent LLM systems. TAMAS includes five distinct scenarios comprising 300 adversarial instances across six attack types and 211 tools, along with 100 harmless tasks. We assess system performance across ten backbone LLMs and three agent interaction configurations from Autogen and CrewAI frameworks, highlighting critical challenges and failure modes in current multi-agent deployments. Furthermore, we introduce Effective Robustness Score (ERS) to assess the tradeoff between safety and task effectiveness of these frameworks. Our findings show that multi-agent systems are highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, underscoring the urgent need for stronger defenses. TAMAS provides a foundation for systematically studying and improving the safety of multi-agent LLM systems. Code and dataset is available at https://github.com/microsoft/TAMAS.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在作为自主代理方面展现出了强大的能力，它们能够通过使用工具、进行规划和做出决策来应对各种任务。随着任务的复杂性不断增加，多智能体语言模型系统被越来越多地用于协作解决问题。然而，这些系统的安全性仍然缺乏深入的研究。现有的基准测试和数据集主要集中在单智能体环境下，未能充分考虑到多智能体动态和协调过程中的独特脆弱性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了“多智能体系统中的威胁与攻击”这一基准测试，旨在评估多智能体语言模型系统的鲁棒性和安全性。TAMAS包含五种不同的场景，共有300个对抗性实例，涵盖六种攻击类型和211种工具，同时还包含了100个无害任务。我们对来自Autogen和CrewAI框架的十种核心语言模型和三种智能体交互配置进行了系统性的性能评估，从而揭示了当前多智能体部署中的关键挑战和故障模式。此外，我们还引入了“有效鲁棒性评分”这一指标，以衡量这些框架在安全性和任务效率之间的权衡关系。我们的研究结果表明，多智能体系统极易受到对抗性攻击的影响，这凸显了加强防御措施的紧迫性。TAMAS为系统地研究和提升多智能体语言模型系统的安全性提供了基础。相关的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/microsoft/TAMAS下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: How Controllable Are Large Language Models? A Unified Evaluation across Behavioral Granularities
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型的可控性如何？在行为层面进行统一评估
papers.authors: Ziwen Xu, Kewei Xu, Haoming Xu, Haiwen Hong, Longtao Huang, Hui Xue, Ningyu Zhang, Yongliang Shen, Guozhou Zheng, Huajun Chen, Shumin Deng
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in socially sensitive domains, yet their unpredictable behaviors, ranging from misaligned intent to inconsistent personality, pose significant risks. We introduce SteerEval, a hierarchical benchmark for evaluating LLM controllability across three domains: language features, sentiment, and personality. Each domain is structured into three specification levels: L1 (what to express), L2 (how to express), and L3 (how to instantiate), connecting high-level behavioral intent to concrete textual output. Using SteerBench, we systematically evaluate contemporary steering methods, revealing that control often degrades at finer-grained levels. Our benchmark offers a principled and interpretable framework for safe and controllable LLM behavior, serving as a foundation for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在涉及社会敏感领域的应用中越来越被使用，然而它们的不可预测行为——从意图不一致到性格特征不稳定——带来了显著的风险。我们提出了SteerEval这一分层评估基准，用于评估语言模型在语言特征、情感表达和性格塑造这三个领域中的可控性。每个领域都被划分为三个层次：L1（要表达的内容）、L2（表达方式）和L3（具体实现方式），从而将高级的行为意图与具体的文本输出联系起来。通过SteerBench系统性的评估方法，我们发现控制能力在更细粒度的层面上往往会下降。我们的评估基准为安全且可控的语言模型行为提供了一个有原则且可解释的框架，为未来的研究奠定了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Scaling Behaviors of LLM Reinforcement Learning Post-Training: An Empirical Study in Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型训练后强化学习行为的扩展特性：一项关于数学推理的实证研究
papers.authors: Zelin Tan, Hejia Geng, Xiaohang Yu, Mulei Zhang, Guancheng Wan, Yifan Zhou, Qiang He, Xiangyuan Xue, Heng Zhou, Yutao Fan, Zhong-Zhi Li, Zaibin Zhang, Guibin Zhang, Chen Zhang, Zhenfei Yin, Philip Torr, Lei Bai
papers.abstract: While scaling laws for large language models (LLMs) during pre-training have been extensively studied, their behavior under reinforcement learning (RL) post-training remains largely unexplored. This paper investigates the scaling behavior of Large Language Model (LLM) reinforcement learning post-training, focusing on mathematical reasoning. Through experiments across the Qwen2.5 series (0.5B to 72B), we characterize how model scale, data, and compute interact. Our analysis yields four key findings: 1. Larger models consistently demonstrate superior compute and data efficiency. 2. The relationship between model performance and training resources follows a predictive power-law across both base and instruction-tuned models. 3. RL learning efficiency exhibits a latent saturation trend with increasing model scale. 4. In data-constrained regimes, performance is primarily driven by the total volume of training data rather than sample uniqueness. These results offer practical guidelines for scaling reasoning capabilities through reinforcement learning post-training.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然关于大语言模型在预训练阶段的行为的缩放规律已经得到了广泛研究，但在训练后的强化学习阶段，这些模型的性能表现仍然鲜有探讨。本文研究了大语言模型在训练后的强化学习阶段的缩放行为，重点探讨了数学上的推理机制。通过Qwen2.5系列模型（从0.5B到72B）的实验，我们分析了模型规模、数据量和计算资源之间的相互作用关系。我们的分析得出了四个重要结论：1. 规模较大的模型始终表现出更高的计算效率和数据利用率。2. 模型性能与训练资源之间的关系在基础模型和经过指令调优的模型中都遵循幂律分布规律。3. 随着模型规模的扩大，强化学习的学习效率呈现出一种潜在的饱和趋势。4. 在数据有限的情况下，模型性能主要取决于训练数据的总量，而非样本的唯一性。这些研究结果为通过训练后的强化学习来提升推理能力提供了实用的指导方针。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RubricHub: A Comprehensive and Highly Discriminative Rubric Dataset via Automated Coarse-to-Fine Generation
papers.title_zh: RubricHub：一个涵盖广泛领域的、具有高度区分能力的评分数据集，通过自动化方式从粗略到精细的评分生成得到实现
papers.authors: Sunzhu Li, Jiale Zhao, Huimin Ren, Zhenlin Wei, Yang Zhou, Jingwen Yang, Shunyu Liu, Kaike Zhang, Chen Wei
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in reasoning-intensive domains like mathematics. However, optimizing open-ended generation remains challenging due to the lack of ground truth. While rubric-based evaluation offers a structured proxy for verification, existing methods suffer from scalability bottlenecks and coarse criteria, resulting in a supervision ceiling effect. To address this, we propose an automated Coarse-to-Fine Rubric Generation framework. By synergizing principle-guided synthesis, multi-model aggregation, and difficulty evolution, our approach produces comprehensive and highly discriminative criteria capable of capturing the subtle nuances. Based on this framework, we introduce RubricHub, a large-scale (110k) and multi-domain dataset. We validate its utility through a two-stage post-training pipeline comprising Rubric-based Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning (RuFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RuRL). Experimental results demonstrate that RubricHub unlocks significant performance gains: our post-trained Qwen3-14B achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on HealthBench (69.3), surpassing proprietary frontier models such as GPT-5.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在需要推理的数学等领域取得了显著进展。然而，由于缺乏真实数据，优化开放式生成任务仍然具有挑战性。虽然基于评分标准的评估提供了一种结构化的验证方式，但现有方法存在可扩展性瓶颈和评判标准过于粗糙的问题，从而导致监督效果受限。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种自动化的从粗略到精细的评分标准生成框架。通过结合原则引导的合成、多模型聚合以及难度演化技术，我们的方法能够生成全面且具有高度区分能力的评判标准，从而捕捉到细微的差别。基于这一框架，我们开发了RubricHub——一个大规模（11万条记录）且涵盖多个领域的数据集。我们通过一个两阶段后训练流程来验证其有效性，该流程包括基于评分标准的拒绝采样微调（RuFT）和强化学习（RuRL）。实验结果表明，RubricHub能够显著提升性能：经过训练的Qwen3-14B模型在HealthBench测试上的表现达到了最先进水平（69.3），甚至超过了像GPT-5这样的专有前沿模型。

papers.title: MIND Your Reasoning: A Meta-Cognitive Intuitive-Reflective Network for Dual-Reasoning in Multimodal Stance Detection
papers.title_zh: 注意你的推理过程：一个用于多模态姿态检测中的元认知、直觉与反思性网络
papers.authors: Bingbing Wang, Zhengda Jin, Bin Liang, Wenjie Li, Jing Li, Ruifeng Xu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Stance Detection (MSD) is a crucial task for understanding public opinion on social media. Existing methods predominantly operate by learning to fuse modalities. They lack an explicit reasoning process to discern how inter-modal dynamics, such as irony or conflict, collectively shape the user’s final stance, leading to frequent misjudgments. To address this, we advocate for a paradigm shift from learning to fuse to learning to reason. We introduce MIND, a Meta-cognitive Intuitive-reflective Network for Dual-reasoning. Inspired by the dual-process theory of human cognition, MIND operationalizes a self-improving loop. It first generates a rapid, intuitive hypothesis by querying evolving Modality and Semantic Experience Pools. Subsequently, a meta-cognitive reflective stage uses Modality-CoT and Semantic-CoT to scrutinize this initial judgment, distill superior adaptive strategies, and evolve the experience pools themselves. These dual experience structures are continuously refined during training and recalled at inference to guide robust and context-aware stance decisions. Extensive experiments on the MMSD benchmark demonstrate that our MIND significantly outperforms most baseline models and exhibits strong generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态立场检测（MSD）是理解社交媒体上公众意见的关键任务。现有的方法主要依赖于学习如何融合不同的信息模式。它们缺乏一个明确的推理过程来辨别诸如讽刺或冲突等跨模态因素如何共同影响用户的最终立场，从而导致频繁的错误判断。为了解决这一问题，我们主张从学习如何融合信息模式转变为学习如何进行推理。我们提出了MIND——一种用于双重推理的元认知直观反思网络。该网络借鉴了人类认知的双重过程理论，实现了自我优化的循环机制。它首先通过查询不断变化的模态信息和语义经验池来生成快速、直观的假设。随后，元认知反思阶段利用模态-因果关系和语义-因果关系来审查这一初步判断，提炼出更优的适应性策略，并促使经验池本身得到优化。这些双重经验结构在训练过程中不断被完善，并在推理时被重新调用，以指导做出稳健且考虑上下文的立场决策。在MMSD基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的MIND显著优于大多数基线模型，并且具有强大的泛化能力。

papers.title: A Survey of Inductive Reasoning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 关于大型语言模型中的归纳推理研究综述
papers.authors: Kedi Chen, Dezhao Ruan, Yuhao Dan, Yaoting Wang, Siyu Yan, Xuecheng Wu, Yinqi Zhang, Qin Chen, Jie Zhou, Liang He, Biqing Qi, Linyang Li, Qipeng Guo, Xiaoming Shi, Wei Zhang
papers.abstract: Reasoning is an important task for large language models (LLMs). Among all the reasoning paradigms, inductive reasoning is one of the basic types, which is characterized by its particular-to-general thinking process and the non-uniqueness of its answers. The inductive mode is crucial for knowledge generalization and aligns better with human cognition, so it is a fundamental mode of learning, hence attracting increasing interest. Despite the importance of inductive reasoning, there is no systematic summary of it. Therefore, this paper presents the first comprehensive survey of inductive reasoning for LLMs. First, methods for improving inductive reasoning are categorized into three main areas: post-training enhancement, test-time exploration, and data augmentation. Then, current benchmarks of inductive reasoning are summarized, and a unified sandbox-based evaluation approach with the observation coverage metric is derived. Finally, we offer some analyses regarding the source of inductive ability and how simple model architectures and data help with inductive tasks, providing a solid foundation for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理是大语言模型的重要任务之一。在所有推理范式中，归纳推理是基础类型之一，其特点在于从特殊到一般的思考过程，且答案并非唯一。归纳模式对于知识的泛化至关重要，并且更符合人类认知方式，因此它是学习的基本模式，因而吸引了越来越多的关注。尽管归纳推理非常重要，但目前还没有对其进行系统的总结。因此，本文首次对大语言模型的归纳推理进行了全面的综述。首先，改进归纳推理的方法被分为三个主要领域：训练后的增强、测试时的探索以及数据增强。接着，总结了当前关于归纳推理的评估基准，并提出了一种基于沙盒的统一评估方法，该方法采用了观察覆盖度指标。最后，我们对归纳能力的来源以及简单模型架构和数据在归纳任务中的作用进行了分析，为未来的研究提供了坚实的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CogToM: A Comprehensive Theory of Mind Benchmark inspired by Human Cognition for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: CogToM：一种全面的意识理论框架，其灵感来源于人类认知机制，旨在为大型语言模型提供辅助支持
papers.authors: Haibo Tong, Zeyang Yue, Feifei Zhao, Erliang Lin, Lu Jia, Ruolin Chen, Yinqian Sun, Qian Zhang, Yi Zeng
papers.abstract: Whether Large Language Models (LLMs) truly possess human-like Theory of Mind (ToM) capabilities has garnered increasing attention. However, existing benchmarks remain largely restricted to narrow paradigms like false belief tasks, failing to capture the full spectrum of human cognitive mechanisms. We introduce CogToM, a comprehensive, theoretically grounded benchmark comprising over 8000 bilingual instances across 46 paradigms, validated by 49 human annotators. A systematic evaluation of 22 representative models, including frontier models like GPT-5.1 and Qwen3-Max, reveals significant performance heterogeneities and highlights persistent bottlenecks in specific dimensions. Further analysis based on human cognitive patterns suggests potential divergences between LLM and human cognitive structures. CogToM offers a robust instrument and perspective for investigating the evolving cognitive boundaries of LLMs. We release our code and data at https://github.com/Beijing-AISI/CogToM.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型是否真正具备类似人类的心理理论能力，这一话题越来越受到关注。然而，现有的评估基准大多局限于一些特定的任务，如虚假信念任务，无法全面反映人类认知机制的全貌。我们提出了CogToM这一全面的、基于理论的评估基准，该基准包含超过8000个双语实例，涵盖46种不同的任务类型，并由49名人类注释者进行了验证。对包括GPT-5.1和Qwen3-Max这样的前沿模型在内的22种代表性模型进行了系统评估，结果显示这些模型的性能存在显著差异，同时某些特定领域的性能表现仍然不尽如人意。基于人类认知模式的进一步分析表明，大语言模型与人类认知结构之间存在潜在的差异。CogToM为研究大语言模型的认知边界提供了有力的工具和视角。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/Beijing-AISI/CogToM下载。

papers.title: CITE: Benchmarking Heterogeneous Text-Attributed Graph Models
papers.title_zh: CITE：异构文本归因图模型的对比研究
papers.authors: Chenghao Zhang, Qingqing Long, Ludi Wang, Wenjuan Cui, Jianjun Yu, Yi Du
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and text-aware graph learning have increased interest in reasoning over text-attributed graphs(TAGs). In many real-world settings, such graphs are inherently heterogeneous, with most existing benchmarks remaining largely homogeneous in structure. As a result, the lack of large-scale benchmarks for heterogeneous text-attributed graphs has hindered systematic evaluation and fair comparison of existing methods. In this work, we introduce CITE - Catalytic Information Textual Entities Graph, the first and largest heterogeneous text-attributed citation graph benchmark for catalytic materials. CITE contains over 438K nodes and 1.2M edges spanning four node types and four relation types, with rich node-level textual information. We establish standardized evaluation protocols for node classification and link prediction, and conduct ablation studies to assess the impact of graph heterogeneity and textual attributes. Using CITE, we benchmark four classes of learning paradigms, including homogeneous graph models, heterogeneous graph models, LLM-centric models, and hybrid LLM–graph models. By providing a large-scale heterogeneous text-attributed benchmark together with standardized evaluation protocols and comprehensive baselines, CITE enables systematic assessment across diverse modeling paradigms and offers new insights into text-aware and LLM-enhanced graph learning. The dataset, codebase and evaluation suite are publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）和文本感知图学习领域的最新进展，使得人们对基于文本属性图的推理研究产生了浓厚兴趣。在许多现实场景中，这类图本质上是异构的，而现有的大多数基准测试在结构方面仍然较为单一。因此，缺乏针对异构文本属性图的大规模基准测试，阻碍了现有方法的系统评估和公平比较。在这项研究中，我们提出了CITE——催化信息文本实体图，这是首个也是规模最大的异构文本属性引文图基准测试，专门用于催化材料的评估。CITE包含超过43.8万个节点和120万个边，涵盖四种节点类型和四种关系类型，并拥有丰富的节点级文本信息。我们建立了标准化的节点分类和链接预测评估协议，并通过消融研究来评估图异构性和文本属性的影响。利用CITE，我们对四类学习范式进行了基准测试，包括同质图模型、异质图模型、以LLM为中心的模式，以及混合LLM-图模型。通过提供大规模异构文本属性基准测试、标准化评估协议和全面的基线数据，CITE能够跨不同建模范式进行系统评估，并为文本感知和LLM增强型图学习提供了新的见解。该数据集、代码库和评估工具均已公开可用。

papers.title: MM-StanceDet: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-modal Multi-agent Stance Detection
papers.title_zh: MM-StanceDet：基于检索增强的多模态多智能体姿态检测技术
papers.authors: Weihai Lu, Zhejun Zhao, Yanshu Li, Huan He
papers.abstract: Multimodal Stance Detection (MSD) is crucial for understanding public discourse, yet effectively fusing text and image, especially with conflicting signals, remains challenging. Existing methods often face difficulties with contextual grounding, cross-modal interpretation ambiguity, and single-pass reasoning fragility. To address these, we propose Retrieval-Augmented Multi-modal Multi-agent Stance Detection (MM-StanceDet), a novel multi-agent framework integrating Retrieval Augmentation for contextual grounding, specialized Multimodal Analysis agents for nuanced interpretation, a Reasoning-Enhanced Debate stage for exploring perspectives, and Self-Reflection for robust adjudication. Extensive experiments on five datasets demonstrate MM-StanceDet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the efficacy of its multi-agent architecture and structured reasoning stages in addressing complex multimodal stance challenges.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态立场检测（MSD）对于理解公共讨论至关重要，然而，在融合文本和图像信息时，尤其是在面对相互冲突的信息时，仍然面临着挑战。现有的方法通常在上下文定位、跨模态解释模糊性以及单阶段推理的可靠性方面存在困难。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为“检索增强的多模态多智能体立场检测”的新框架。该框架结合了检索增强技术用于上下文定位、专门的跨模态分析代理用于细致的解释，以及增强推理的辩论阶段用于探索不同观点，还有自我反思机制用于做出稳健的判断。在五个数据集上的广泛实验表明，MM-StanceDet显著优于现有的最先进基线方法，这验证了其多智能体架构以及结构化推理机制在应对复杂多模态立场问题方面的有效性。

papers.title: Disentangling Reasoning Logic to Resolve Explicit Knowledge Conflicts
papers.title_zh: 梳理推理逻辑以解决显性知识冲突问题
papers.authors: Xianda Zheng, Zijian Huang, Meng-Fen Chiang, Jiamou Liu, Yuan Fang, Michael J. Witbrock, Kaiqi Zhao
papers.abstract: Explicit knowledge conflicts, where retrieved contexts contain contradictory information, have become increasingly prevalent as Large Language Models (LLMs) integrate diverse data sources. The core challenge lies in the complexity of entangled narratives and the heterogeneity of conflict cases, which impose excessive demands on the reasoning capabilities of standard models. To address this, we propose Knowledge Conflict Reasoning (KCR), a framework that adjudicates conflicts by structuring the underlying logic. KCR first disentangles conflicting contexts into distinct sets of reasoning traces, utilizing both textual and graph-based representations, to simplify comprehension. It then employs a Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) paradigm, guiding the model to internalize a reasoning process that maximizes logical consistency while actively suppressing spurious reasoning paths derived from contradictory contexts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KCR yields substantial improvements: a KCR-enhanced 7B model surpasses the performance of baselines equipped with top-tier closed-source models such as GPT-4o and GPT-5.1.
papers.abstract_zh: 显性知识冲突日益普遍，当大语言模型整合了多样化的数据来源后，从相关上下文中提取的信息往往存在矛盾之处。这一挑战的核心在于复杂交织的叙述结构和不同冲突案例的多样性，这些因素给标准模型的推理能力带来了巨大的压力。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了知识冲突推理框架——KCR。该框架通过构建清晰的逻辑结构来解决冲突问题。KCR首先将相互矛盾的上下文分离成不同的推理轨迹，同时利用文本和图状表示方式来简化理解过程。随后，它采用带有可验证奖励的强化学习范式，引导模型内化一种能够最大化逻辑一致性的推理过程，同时主动抑制由矛盾上下文产生的虚假推理路径。大量实验表明，KCR取得了显著的改进效果：经过KCR优化的7B模型在性能上超越了那些配备了顶级开源模型（如GPT-4o和GPT-5.1）的基线模型。

papers.title: UniVocal: Unified Speech-Singing Code-Switching Synthesis
papers.title_zh: UniVocal：统一的语音演唱混合合成技术
papers.authors: YuFei Shi, Qian Chen, Wen Wang, Xiangang Li, Zhen-Hua Ling, Yang Ai
papers.abstract: We propose UniVocal, a unified framework that implicitly infers vocal modes from text context to pioneer Speech-Singing Code-Switching (SCS) Synthesis—a task where transitions are autonomously driven by textual semantics, akin to seamless human language blending. Unlike single-mode generation or systems relying on switching-control tags, our proposed UniVocal implicitly infers vocal modes solely from text context. To achieve this, we employ a data-efficient two-stage curriculum learning strategy that progressively trains a competitive TTS system to acquire the desired SCS capability. Addressing data scarcity, we introduce a scalable pipeline to synthesize diverse code-switching data that is both semantically and acoustically natural, alongside a new multi-scenario benchmark, SCSBench. To address limitations of semantic tokenizers in capturing acoustic details, we also introduce refined cent token and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation for planning prosody before content generation, effectively enhancing empathetic speech generation and singing melody. Experimental results demonstrate that UniVocal achieves state-of-the-art performance on SCSBench while maintaining competitive performance on regular speech and singing tasks. Audio samples are available at https://project-univocal-demo.github.io/demo/. The code and dataset are released at https://github.com/FunAudioLLM/FunResearch/tree/main/UniVocal.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了UniVocal这一统一框架，该框架能够从文本上下文中隐式地推断出语音模式，从而开创语音-歌唱混合语码合成的新领域。在这种合成方式中，转换过程由文本语义自主驱动，从而实现无缝的人体语言融合。与那些依赖切换控制标签的单模式生成系统不同，UniVocal能够仅通过文本上下文来推断语音模式。为了实现这一目标，我们采用了一种高效的数据分层学习策略，逐步训练出一个具有竞争力的文本转语音系统，以具备所需的语音-歌唱混合语码合成能力。为了解决数据稀缺问题，我们引入了一种可扩展的流程，用于合成在语义和音质上都非常自然的混合语码数据。此外，我们还创建了一个新的多场景基准测试平台——SCSBench。为了克服语义分词器在捕捉音质细节方面的局限性，我们引入了更精细的中心词元和思维链生成技术，这些技术可以在内容生成之前规划出合适的韵律结构，从而有效提升语音生成和歌唱旋律的质量。实验结果表明，UniVocal在SCSBench测试平台上取得了领先的性能，同时在常规语音和歌唱任务中也保持了竞争力。音频样本可以在https://project-univocal-demo.github.io/demo/下载。代码和数据集则可以在https://github.com/FunAudioLLM/FunResearch/tree/main/UniVocal获取。

papers.title: ReasoningGuard: Safeguarding Large Reasoning Models with Inference-time Safety Aha Moments
papers.title_zh: ReasoningGuard：通过推理过程中的安全性保障来保护大型推理模型 有趣的创新点
papers.authors: Yuquan Wang, Mi Zhang, Yining Wang, Geng Hong, Mi Wen, Xiaoyu You, Min Yang
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in reasoning-intensive tasks, but they remain vulnerable to harmful content generation, particularly in the mid-to-late steps of their reasoning processes. Current defense methods, however, depend on costly fine-tuning and additional expert knowledge, which limits their scalability.In this work, we propose ReasoningGuard, an inference-time safeguard for LRMs.It injects timely safety aha moments during the reasoning process to guide the model towards harmless yet helpful reasoning.Our approach leverages the internal attention mechanisms of the LRM to accurately identify key points in the reasoning path, triggering safety-oriented reflections.To safeguard both the subsequent reasoning steps and the final answers, we implement a scaling sampling strategy during decoding to select the optimal reasoning path.With minimal additional inference cost, ReasoningGuard effectively mitigates four types of jailbreak attacks, including recent ones targeting the reasoning process of LRMs. Our approach outperforms nine existing safeguards, providing state-of-the-art defenses while avoiding common exaggerated safety issues.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在需要复杂推理的任务中表现出了令人印象深刻的性能，但它们仍然容易受到有害内容的生成攻击，尤其是在推理过程的中后期阶段。然而，目前的防御方法依赖于昂贵的微调以及额外的专家知识，这限制了它们的可扩展性。在这项研究中，我们提出了ReasoningGuard，这是一种针对大型推理模型的推理时间保护机制。它在推理过程中适时地注入安全提示，引导模型进行无害但有用的推理。我们的方法利用大型推理模型内部的注意力机制来准确识别推理过程中的关键节点，从而触发以安全性为导向的反思。为了保护后续的推理步骤和最终答案，我们在解码过程中采用了一种扩展采样策略，以选择最优的推理路径。通过最小的额外推理成本，ReasoningGuard能够有效抵御四种类型的破解攻击，包括那些针对大型推理模型推理过程的最新攻击。我们的方法优于现有的九种保护机制，提供了最先进的防御手段，同时避免了常见的安全问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VecInfer: Efficient LLM Inference with Low-Bit KV Cache via Outlier-Suppressed Vector Quantization
papers.title_zh: VecInfer：通过异常值抑制向量量化技术实现高效的LLM推理，并采用低位数的KV缓存机制来减少计算需求
papers.authors: Dingyu Yao, Chenxu Yang, Zhengyang Tong, Zheng Lin, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Weiping Wang
papers.abstract: The Key-Value (KV) cache introduces substantial memory overhead during large language model (LLM) inference. Although existing vector quantization (VQ) methods reduce KV cache usage and provide flexible representational capacity across bit-widths, they suffer severe performance degradation at ultra-low bit-widths due to key cache outliers that hinder effective codebook utilization. To address this challenge, we propose VecInfer, a novel VQ method for aggressive KV cache compression while enabling efficient inference. By applying smooth and Hadamard transformations, VecInfer suppresses outliers in the key cache, enabling the codebook to comprehensively cover the original data distribution and thereby reducing quantization difficulty. To facilitate efficient deployment, we design an optimized CUDA kernel that fuses computation with dequantization to minimize memory access overhead. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that VecInfer consistently outperforms existing quantization baselines across both long-context understanding and mathematical reasoning tasks. With only 2-bit quantization, VecInfer achieves performance comparable to full precision, while delivering up to \mathbf{2.7\times} speedup in large-batch self-attention computation and \mathbf{8.3\times} reduction in single-batch end-to-end latency on Llama-3.1-8B with a 196k sequence length.
papers.abstract_zh: 键值（KV）缓存在大语言模型（LLM）推理过程中会引入较大的内存开销。虽然现有的向量量化（VQ）方法能够降低KV缓存的使用量，并在不同位宽下提供灵活的表示能力，但在超低的位宽情况下，由于关键缓存中的异常值会阻碍代码簿的有效利用，从而导致性能严重下降。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了VecInfer这一新颖的VQ方法。该方法能够在实现高效推理的同时，对KV缓存进行大幅压缩。通过应用平滑变换和Hadamard变换，VecInfer能够消除关键缓存中的异常值，使代码簿能够全面覆盖原始数据分布，从而降低量化难度。为了便于高效部署，我们设计了一个优化的CUDA内核，将计算与去量化过程相结合，以最小化内存访问开销。大量测试表明，VecInfer在长上下文理解和数学推理任务中始终优于现有的量化基线方法。仅使用2位量化精度时，VecInfer的性能与全精度相当；而在Llama-3.1-8B模型上，对于196k序列长度的输入，VecInfer在大规模自注意力计算方面实现了高达2.7倍的加速效果，而在单批次端到端延迟方面则降低了8.3倍。

papers.title: When Does Mixing Help? Analyzing Query Embedding Interpolation in Multilingual Dense Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 什么时候进行混合处理会更有帮助？在多语言密集检索中分析查询嵌入的插值处理
papers.authors: Tongyao Zhu, Huang Chao Ming, Min-Yen Kan
papers.abstract: While mixed-language querying is ubiquitous in multilingual communities, the sensitivity of dense retrievers to such queries remains poorly understood. We present a ratio-controlled study on mMARCO that systematically evaluates retrieval performance by varying the mixing proportion of parallel query translations via embedding-level mixing—constructing mixed queries as an interpolation of monolingual embeddings. Experiments with BGE-M3 demonstrate that an optimal mixing ratio outperforms the best monolingual endpoint in 88/105 cases. We uncover a distinct asymmetry driven by English dominance: mixing is uniformly beneficial when retrieving from non-English document indices, whereas indices containing English are best served by pure English queries. Furthermore, English acts as the strongest mixing partner for every non-English document language. Finally, when controlling for English dominance, mixing gains correlate negatively with typological distance. We conclude that language-mix sensitivity is structured and predictable, and we validate the robustness of these patterns across model families and scales.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然混合语言查询在多语言社区中非常常见，但密集检索器对这类查询的敏感性仍缺乏深入的理解。我们开展了一项比率控制研究，通过在不同嵌入级别混合平行查询翻译的比例来系统地评估 mMARCO的检索性能——将混合查询构建为单语言嵌入的插值结果。使用 BGE-M3 进行的实验表明，在 88/105 个案例中，最佳的混合比例能够超越最优秀的单语言检索效果。我们发现了一个由英语主导地位引起的独特不对称性：当从非英语文档索引中进行检索时，混合查询具有普遍的优势；而包含英语的索引则更适合用纯英语查询来处理。此外，英语是每一种非英语文档语言中最有效的混合伙伴。最后，在控制英语主导地位的情况下，混合效果的改善与类型距离呈负相关。我们的结论是，语言混合的敏感性是有结构且可预测的，并且这些模式在不同模型和不同规模上都具有稳定性。

papers.title: WIST: Web-Grounded Iterative Self-Play Tree for Domain-Targeted Reasoning Improvement
papers.title_zh: WIST：基于网络的迭代自玩树，用于提升针对特定领域的推理能力
papers.authors: Fangyuan Li, Pengfei Li, Shijie Wang, Junqi Gao, Jianxing Liu, Biqing Qi, Yuqiang Li
papers.abstract: Recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) offers a practical path to self-improving language models, but existing methods face a key trade-off: endogenous self-play can drift over iterations, while corpus-grounded approaches rely on curated data environments. We present WIST, a Web-grounded Iterative Self-play Tree framework for domain-targeted reasoning improvement that learns directly from the open-web without requiring any pre-arranged domain corpus. WIST incrementally expands a domain tree to structure exploration and retrieves and cleans path-consistent web evidence to construct a controllable training environment. It then performs Challenger-Solver self-play with verifiable rewards, and feeds learnability signals back to update node posteriors and guide subsequent exploration through an adaptive curriculum. Across four backbones, WIST consistently improves over the base models and typically outperforms both purely endogenous self-evolution and corpus-grounded self-play baselines, with the Overall gains reaching +9.8 (Qwen3-4B-Base) and +9.7 (OctoThinker-8B-Hybrid-Base). WIST is also domain-steerable: improving Qwen3-8B-Base by +14.79 in medicine and Qwen3-4B-Base by +5.28 on PhyBench. Ablations further confirm the importance of WIST’s key components for stable open-web learning. Our Code is available at https://github.com/lfy-123/WIST.
papers.abstract_zh: 在带有可验证奖励的强化学习领域，近期取得了一些进展。这种方法为语言模型的自我改进提供了实用的途径。不过，现有的方法面临着一个关键问题：内生性的自我博弈可能会随着迭代次数的增加而发生变化，而基于语料库的方法则依赖于经过筛选的数据环境。我们提出了WIST这一基于网络环境的迭代自我博弈树框架，它能够直接从开放的网络中学习，无需预先安排任何特定领域的语料库。WIST通过逐步扩展领域树结构来优化探索过程，并检索和整理与路径一致的网络证据，从而构建一个可控的训练环境。随后，它执行带有可验证奖励的挑战者-解决者自我博弈，并将学习信号反馈回去，以更新节点的后验概率，并通过自适应课程来指导后续的探索过程。在四个不同的基础模型上进行测试时，WIST始终能够超越基础模型，其性能通常优于单纯的内生性自我演化以及基于语料库的自我博弈基线模型。整体提升幅度分别达到了+9.8（Qwen3-4B-Base）和+9.7（OctoThinker-8B-Hybrid-Base）。此外，WIST还具有领域适应性：在医学领域，它能够使Qwen3-8B-Base的性能提升14.79；在PhyBench任务上，它能够使Qwen3-4B-Base的性能提升5.28。实验验证进一步证明了WIST的关键组件对于稳定开放网络学习的重要性。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/lfy-123/WIST下载。

papers.title: Frankentext: Stitching random text fragments into long-form narratives
papers.title_zh: 弗兰肯文本：将随机的文字片段拼接在一起，形成长篇叙事作品
papers.authors: Chau Minh Pham, Jenna Russell, Dzung Pham, Mohit Iyyer
papers.abstract: As AI text detectors are increasingly used to flag LLM-generated writing, a natural question arises: are there forms of high-quality generated narrative that can evade such detection? We introduce Frankentexts, a long-form narrative generation paradigm that treats an LLM as a composer of existing texts rather than as an author. Given a writing prompt and thousands of randomly sampled human-written snippets, the model assembles a coherent narrative where most tokens (e.g., 90%) are copied verbatim from the source passages. Despite the extreme challenge of the task, we observe through extensive automatic and human evaluation that Frankentexts improve over vanilla LLM generations in key writing quality metrics such as diversity and novelty while remaining mostly coherent and relevant to the prompt. Furthermore, Frankentexts pose a fundamental challenge to current AI text detectors: 72% of Frankentexts produced by our best configuration (Gemini-2.5-Pro with 5K input snippets) are misclassified as human-written by Pangram, a state-of-the-art detector. Human annotators praise Frankentexts for their inventive premises, vivid descriptions, and dry humor; however, they still identify issues with abrupt tonal shifts and uneven grammar across segments. Overall, the emergence of high-quality yet low-detectability Frankentexts challenges established authorship norms while raising concerns about the publishing economy.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着AI文本检测器越来越多地被用于识别由大语言模型生成的文本，一个自然的问题出现了：是否存在一些高质量的生成叙事形式能够逃避这种检测呢？我们提出了Frankentexts这一长文生成范式，它将大语言模型视为现有文本的创作者，而非作者。给定一个写作提示以及数千个随机采样的人类写作片段，该模型能够构建出一个连贯的叙事，其中大部分内容（例如90%）都是直接从原始片段中复制过来的。尽管这项任务极具挑战性，但通过广泛的自动和人类评估，我们发现Frankentexts在诸如多样性、新颖性等关键写作质量指标上优于普通的大语言模型生成文本。同时，Frankentexts还对当前的人工智能文本检测器提出了根本性的挑战：在我们最佳配置下生成的72%的Frankentexts被Pangram这一先进检测器误分类为人类创作的作品。人类注释者称赞Frankentexts具有创新的构思、生动的描述以及幽默感；不过，他们仍然指出文本中存在突然的语气变化以及段落间语法不统一的问题。总体而言，这种高质量但难以被检测到的Frankentexts的出现，不仅挑战了现有的创作规范，同时也引发了关于出版业发展的担忧。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SAFO: Stable Adaptive Fairness Optimization for LLM-Based Social Survey Simulation
papers.title_zh: SAFO：用于基于大语言模型的社交调查模拟的稳定自适应公平性优化技术
papers.authors: Chenxi Lin, Zhuoren Jiang, Kaisong Song, Yiquan Wu
papers.abstract: Ensuring fairness in social survey simulation is critical, as biased outputs can misrepresent underrepresented groups. This issue is growing as large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for this task. However, standard fine-tuning based on Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often under-optimizes minority groups, causing substantial subgroup disparities. Distributionally robust Optimization (DRO) methods reduce worst-case errors, but their strict worst-case selection can lead to noisy and unstable optimization under demographic sparsity. These issues create intertwined challenges for fairness, convergence and stability. We propose SAFO, a dynamic utility–fairness optimization framework for LLM-based survey simulation that explicitly targets both fairness and training stability. SAFO combines (i) an Optimizer that preserves mean-loss utility, (ii) an Adversary that performs temperature-controlled, EMA-smoothed and loss-driven group reweighting, and (iii) a Nash-inspired Regulator that adaptively adjusts the utility–fairness trade-off by tracking weak-group gains and collateral utility damages. Experiments on three large-scale survey datasets from China, the U.S., and Europe show that SAFO consistently improves minority performance and social-welfare metrics. It reduces worst-group gaps by up to 12.7%, maintains overall accuracy with a mean change of less than 0.3% and lowers variance across random seeds. Our code is available at https://github.com/PiLab-ZJU/SAFO.
papers.abstract_zh: 确保社会调查模拟的公平性至关重要，因为有偏见的输出可能会歪曲那些被忽视群体的实际情况。随着大语言模型在这一任务中的广泛应用，这个问题日益突出。然而，基于经验风险最小化标准进行的微调往往无法充分优化少数群体，从而导致严重的群体差异。分布式鲁棒优化方法能够减少最坏情况下的错误，但其严格的最坏情况选择可能会在人口结构稀疏的情况下导致优化结果不稳定且带有噪声。这些问题共同构成了公平性、收敛性和稳定性方面的挑战。我们提出了SAFO框架，这是一个针对基于语言模型的调查模拟的动态效用-公平性优化框架，它明确兼顾了公平性和训练稳定性。SAFO结合了以下三个组件：(i) 一个能够保持平均损失效用的优化器；(ii) 一个能够实现温度控制、EMA平滑处理以及基于损失驱动的群体权重调整的对手机制；以及(iii) 一个受纳什均衡启发的调节器，它能够通过跟踪弱群体的收益和附带效用的损失来自适应调整效用与公平性的权衡关系。我们在来自中国、美国和欧洲的三个大规模调查数据集上进行的实验表明，SAFO能够持续改善少数群体的表现和社会福利指标。它可以将最差群体的差距缩小至12.7%，同时保持整体准确率，平均变化小于0.3%，并降低不同随机种子之间的方差。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/PiLab-ZJU/SAFO下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Prosody of Emojis
papers.title_zh: 表情符号的韵律
papers.authors: Giulio Zhou, Tsz Kin Lam, Alexandra Birch, Barry Haddow
papers.abstract: Prosodic features such as pitch, timing, and intonation are central to spoken communication, conveying emotion, intent, and discourse structure. In text-based settings, where these cues are absent, emojis act as visual surrogates that add affective and pragmatic nuance. This study examines how emojis influence prosodic realisation in speech and how listeners interpret prosodic cues to recover emoji meanings. Unlike previous work, we directly link prosody and emojis by analysing human speech data collected through a controlled elicited production task. Using Bayesian multilevel modelling, we show that speakers systematically adapt their prosody based on emoji cues, and that listeners can recover intended meanings significantly above chance. Furthermore, our results reveal a clear hierarchy in prosodic shifts: greater semantic differences between emojis correspond to increased prosodic divergence. These findings suggest that emojis are meaningful carriers of prosodic intent that bridge the gap between digital text and spoken production.
papers.abstract_zh: 韵律特征，如音高、节奏和语调，在口语交流中起着至关重要的作用，它们能够传达情感、意图以及话语结构。而在基于文本的环境中，由于缺乏这些线索，表情符号便成为了一种视觉替代手段，为语言增添了情感和实用性的细微差别。本研究探讨了表情符号如何影响语音中的韵律表现，以及听众如何解读这些韵律线索以理解表情符号的含义。与以往的研究不同，我们通过分析通过控制性诱发发音任务收集的人类语音数据，直接将韵律与表情符号联系起来。利用贝叶斯多层建模方法，我们发现说话者会根据表情符号的提示来调整自己的韵律表达，而听众则能够显著高于随机水平地理解表情符号所表达的意图。此外，我们的研究结果还揭示了韵律变化的明显层次结构：表情符号之间的语义差异越大，其韵律差异也就越明显。这些发现表明，表情符号是承载韵律意图的有效载体，它们有助于弥合数字文本与口语表达之间的差距。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Piece of Table: A Divide-and-Conquer Approach for Selecting Subtables in Table Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 表格片段：在表格问答中选择子表的分治算法
papers.authors: Wonjin Lee, Kyumin Kim, Sungjae Lee, Jihun Lee, Kwang In Kim
papers.abstract: Applying language models (LMs) to tables is challenging due to the mismatch between the two-dimensional structure of tables and the one-dimensional inputs expected by LMs. This mismatch forces linearization, making LMs particularly sensitive to irrelevant cells. Subtable selection mitigates this challenge by isolating question-relevant content prior to answer generation. However, existing approaches either rely on independent row or column selection, failing to capture cross-row and cross-column dependencies, or attempt global reasoning and face challenges similar to holistic table QA under noisy contexts. We propose PieTa (Piece of Table), a divide-and-conquer subtable selection framework that progressively aggregates locally selected evidence without requiring explicit global reasoning. PieTa uses an iterative, window-based multi-resolution process to construct compact subtables that capture global dependencies while limiting LM exposure to irrelevant content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PieTa consistently outperforms prior subtable-based and holistic table QA approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 将语言模型应用于表格是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为表格的二维结构与语言模型所期望的一维输入之间存在不匹配。这种不匹配导致了线性化处理，使得语言模型对无关单元格非常敏感。子表选择通过在生成答案之前分离出与问题相关的内容，从而缓解了这一挑战。然而，现有的方法要么依赖于独立的行或列选择，无法捕捉到跨行和跨列的依赖性；要么尝试进行全局推理，但在噪声环境下会遇到类似整体表格问答的困难。我们提出了PieTa（表格片段）这一分而治之的子表选择框架，该框架能够逐步整合局部选择的证据，而无需进行明确的全局推理。PieTa采用迭代式的、基于窗口的多分辨率处理方式来构建紧凑的子表，从而捕捉到全局依赖性，同时限制语言模型接触到无关内容。大量的实验表明，PieTa在性能上始终优于以往基于子表的方法和整体表格问答方法。

papers.title: QA-MoE: Towards a Continuous Reliability Spectrum with Quality-Aware Mixture of Experts for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.title_zh: QA-MoE：基于质量感知的混合专家模型，实现连续性的可靠性水平，以支撑稳健的多模态情感分析任务
papers.authors: Yitong Zhu, Yuxuan Jiang, Guanxuan Jiang, Bojing Hou, Peng Yuan Zhou, Ge Lin, Yuyang Wang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) aims to infer human sentiment from textual, acoustic, and visual signals. In real-world scenarios, however, multimodal inputs are often compromised by dynamic noise or modality missingness. Existing methods typically treat these imperfections as discrete cases or assume fixed corruption ratios, which limits their adaptability to continuously varying reliability conditions. To address this, we first introduce a Continuous Reliability Spectrum to unify missingness and quality degradation into a single framework. Building on this, we propose QA-MoE, a Quality-Aware Mixture-of-Experts framework that quantifies modality reliability via self-supervised aleatoric uncertainty. This mechanism explicitly guides expert routing, enabling the model to suppress error propagation from unreliable signals while preserving task-relevant information. Extensive experiments indicate that QA-MoE achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across diverse degradation scenarios and exhibits a promising One-Checkpoint-for-All property in practice.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态情感分析（MSA）旨在从文本、声学和视觉信号中推断出人类的情感。然而在现实场景中，多模态输入常常受到动态噪声或模态缺失的影响。现有的方法通常将这些缺陷视为独立的情况，或者假设存在固定的损坏比例，这限制了它们适应不断变化的可靠性条件的能力。为了应对这一问题，我们首先引入了一个连续可靠性谱，将模态缺失和质量下降统一到一个框架中。在此基础上，我们提出了QA-MoE这一基于质量意识的混合专家框架，该框架通过自监督的随机不确定性来量化模态的可靠性。这种机制能够明确地指导专家的选择，使模型能够在保留与任务相关的信息的同时，抑制来自不可靠信号的错误传播。大量的实验表明，QA-MoE在不同退化场景下都能取得具有竞争力的性能，并且在实际应用中表现出良好的“一次性检查所有问题”的特性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Enhancing LLM-based Search Agents via Contribution Weighted Group Relative Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: 通过加权组级相对策略优化来提升基于大语言模型的搜索智能体性能
papers.authors: Junzhe Wang, Zhiheng Xi, Yajie Yang, Hao Luo, Shihan Dou, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang
papers.abstract: Search agents extend Large Language Models (LLMs) beyond static parametric knowledge by enabling access to up-to-date and long-tail information unavailable during pretraining. While reinforcement learning has been widely adopted for training such agents, existing approaches face key limitations: process supervision often suffers from unstable value estimation, whereas outcome supervision struggles with credit assignment due to sparse, trajectory-level rewards. To bridge this gap, we propose Contribution-Weighted GRPO (CW-GRPO), a framework that integrates process supervision into group relative policy optimization. Instead of directly optimizing process rewards, CW-GRPO employs an LLM judge to assess the retrieval utility and reasoning correctness at each search round, producing per-round contribution weights. These weights are used to rescale outcome-based advantages along the trajectory, enabling fine-grained credit assignment without sacrificing optimization stability. Experiments on multiple knowledge-intensive benchmarks show that CW-GRPO outperforms standard GRPO by 5.0% on Qwen3-8B and 6.3% on Qwen3-1.7B, leading to more effective search behaviors. Additional analysis reveals that successful trajectories exhibit concentrated contributions in specific rounds, providing empirical insight into search agent tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/zsxmwjz/CW-GRPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 搜索代理通过允许访问在预训练期间无法获得的实时和长尾信息，扩展了大语言模型的功能，使其不仅仅局限于静态的参数化知识。虽然强化学习已被广泛用于训练此类代理，但现有方法存在关键限制：过程监督往往受到不稳定价值估计的困扰，而结果监督则因轨迹级奖励的稀疏性而在信用分配方面遇到困难。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了贡献加权GRPO（CW-GRPO）框架，该框架将过程监督整合到群体相对策略优化中。CW-GRPO不是直接优化过程奖励，而是使用语言模型裁判在每个搜索轮次中评估检索效用和推理正确性，从而产生每轮的贡献权重。这些权重被用来重新调整沿轨迹的结果导向优势，从而实现无需牺牲优化稳定性的细粒度信用分配。在多个知识密集型基准测试上的实验表明，CW-GRPO在Qwen3-8B上的表现优于标准GRPO 5.0%，在Qwen3-1.7B上的表现则高出6.3%，从而带来了更有效的搜索行为。进一步分析发现，成功的轨迹在特定轮次中表现出集中的贡献，这为理解搜索代理任务提供了实证依据。我们的代码可在https://github.com/zsxmwjz/CW-GRPO获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Why Steering Works: Toward a Unified View of Language Model Parameter Dynamics
papers.title_zh: 为什么引导方法有效：迈向对语言模型参数变化的统一理解
papers.authors: Ziwen Xu, Chenyan WU, Hengyu Sun, Haiwen Hong, Mengru Wang, Yunzhi Yao, Longtao Huang, Hui Xue, Shumin Deng, Zhixuan Chu, Huajun Chen, Ningyu Zhang
papers.abstract: Methods for controlling large language models (LLMs), including local weight fine-tuning, LoRA-based adaptation, and activation-based interventions, are often studied in isolation, obscuring their connections and making comparison difficult. In this work, we present a unified view that frames these interventions as dynamic weight updates induced by a control signal, placing them within a single conceptual framework. Building on this view, we propose a unified preference-utility analysis that separates control effects into preference, defined as the tendency toward a target concept, and utility, defined as coherent and task-valid generation, and measures both on a shared log-odds scale using polarity-paired contrastive examples. Across methods, we observe a consistent trade-off between preference and utility: stronger control increases preference while predictably reducing utility. We further explain this behavior through an activation manifold perspective, in which control shifts representations along target-concept directions to enhance preference, while utility declines primarily when interventions push representations off the model’s valid-generation manifold. Finally, we introduce a new steering approach guided by this analysis that improves preference while better preserving utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对大语言模型的控制方法，包括局部权重微调、基于LoRA的适应性调整以及基于激活的干预措施，这些方法往往被单独研究，这导致它们之间的联系被忽视，也使得比较变得困难。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个统一的视角，将这些干预措施视为由控制信号引发的动态权重更新，并将它们纳入一个单一的概念框架中。基于这一视角，我们提出了一种统一的偏好-效用分析方法，将控制效果分为偏好和效用两个方面：偏好指的是向目标概念的倾向；效用则指的是连贯且符合任务要求的生成能力。我们通过带有极性对比的例子，在共享的对数优势尺度上衡量这两方面。在不同方法中，我们发现偏好和效用之间存在一致的权衡：更强的控制会增强偏好，但同时会显著降低效用。我们通过激活流形的视角进一步解释了这种行为——控制会促使表示沿着目标概念的方向进行调整，从而增强偏好；而当干预措施使表示偏离模型的有效生成流形时，效用则会下降。最后，我们提出了一种新的引导方法，该方法能够结合这种分析来提升偏好，同时更好地保留效用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EmoMAS: Emotion-Aware Multi-Agent System for High-Stakes Edge-Deployable Negotiation with Bayesian Orchestration
papers.title_zh: EmoMAS：一种基于情感感知的多智能体系统，适用于需要高度灵活应对的谈判场景，并具备贝叶斯排序机制
papers.authors: Yunbo Long, Yuhan Liu, Liming Xu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely used for automated negotiation, but their high computational cost and privacy risks limit deployment in privacy-sensitive, on-device settings such as mobile assistants or rescue robots. Small language models (SLMs) offer a viable alternative, yet struggle with the complex emotional dynamics of high-stakes negotiation. We introduce EmoMAS, a Bayesian multi-agent framework that transforms emotional decision-making from reactive to strategic. EmoMAS leverages a Bayesian orchestrator to coordinate three specialized agents: game-theoretic, reinforcement learning, and psychological coherence models. The system fuses their real-time insights to optimize emotional state transitions while continuously updating agent reliability based on negotiation feedback. This mixture-of-agents architecture enables online strategy learning without pre-training. We further introduce four high-stakes, edge-deployable negotiation benchmarks across debt, healthcare, emergency response, and educational domains. Through extensive agent-to-agent simulations across all benchmarks, both SLMs and LLMs equipped with EmoMAS consistently surpass all baseline models in negotiation performance while balancing ethical behavior. These results show that strategic emotional intelligence is a key driver of negotiation success. By treating emotional expression as a strategic variable within a Bayesian multi-agent optimization framework, EmoMAS establishes a new paradigm for effective, private, and adaptive negotiation AI suitable for high-stakes edge deployment. The code is available at https://github.com/Yunbo-max/EmoMAS.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自动化谈判中得到了广泛应用，但其高昂的计算成本和隐私风险限制了其在需要保护隐私的场合中的应用，比如移动助手或救援机器人。小型语言模型则提供了一种可行的替代方案，但它们在处理高难度谈判中的复杂情感动态方面存在困难。我们提出了EmoMAS这一贝叶斯多智能体框架，它将情感决策从反应式转变为战略性决策。EmoMAS利用贝叶斯协调器来协调三个专门的智能体：博弈论模型、强化学习模型和心理一致性模型。该系统将这些智能体的实时信息融合在一起，以优化情感状态的转换，同时根据谈判反馈不断更新智能体的可靠性。这种多智能体混合架构使得无需预训练即可实现在线策略学习。我们还提出了四个适用于债务、医疗、紧急响应和教育领域的高难度边缘部署谈判基准测试。通过对所有基准测试的广泛智能体间模拟，配备EmoMAS的小型语言模型和大语言模型在谈判表现上始终优于所有基线模型，同时还能保持道德行为。这些结果表明，战略性的情感智慧是谈判成功的关键因素。通过将情感表达视为贝叶斯多智能体优化框架中的一个战略变量，EmoMAS为有效、私密且适应性强的谈判人工智能提供了新的范式，非常适合高难度边缘部署场景。代码可访问于https://github.com/Yunbo-max/EmoMAS。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Decisive: Guiding User Decisions with Optimal Preference Elicitation from Unstructured Documents
papers.title_zh: 决定性的：通过从非结构化文档中提取最优偏好信息来引导用户做出决策
papers.authors: Akriti Jain, Anish Mulay, Divyansh Verma, Aishani Pandey, Pritika Ramu, Aparna Garimella
papers.abstract: Decision-making is a cognitively intensive task that requires synthesizing relevant information from multiple unstructured sources, weighing competing factors, and incorporating subjective user preferences. Existing methods, including large language models and traditional decision-support systems, fall short: they often overwhelm users with information or fail to capture nuanced preferences accurately. We present Decisive, an interactive decision-making framework that combines document-grounded reasoning with Bayesian preference inference. Our approach grounds decisions in an objective option-scoring matrix extracted from source documents, while actively learning a user’s latent preference vector through targeted elicitation. Users answer pairwise tradeoff questions adaptively selected to maximize information gain over the final decision. This process converges efficiently, minimizing user effort while ensuring recommendations remain transparent and personalized. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms both general-purpose LLMs and existing decision-making frameworks achieving up to 20% improvement in decision accuracy over strong baselines across domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 决策是一项需要高度认知能力的任务，它要求从多个非结构化来源整合相关信息，权衡各种因素，并考虑用户的主观偏好。现有的方法，包括大语言模型和传统的决策支持系统，都存在不足：它们常常让用户被大量信息淹没，或者无法准确捕捉到用户的细微偏好。我们提出了Decisive这一交互式决策框架，它将基于文档的推理与贝叶斯偏好推断相结合。我们的方法以从源文档中提取出的客观选项评分矩阵为基础来做出决策，同时通过有针对性的引导方式主动学习用户的潜在偏好向量。用户需要适应性地回答成对权衡问题，这些问题都是经过精心选择的，以便最大限度地获取关于最终决策的信息。这一过程能够高效地进行，同时减少用户的努力，确保推荐结果保持透明和个性化。通过广泛的实验验证，我们发现我们的方法在决策准确性方面显著优于通用语言模型和现有的决策框架，在不同领域内的决策准确率提升了高达20%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Naturalness to Norms: Interactional Cultural Competence for SpeechLMs
papers.title_zh: 从自然性到规范：言语使用者之间的互动式文化能力
papers.authors: Santosh T.Y.S.S
papers.abstract: Spoken language models (SpeechLMs) are increasingly real-time conversational actors. Yet many culturally consequential aspects of spoken interaction are not primarily lexical. Across sociolinguistics, linguistic anthropology, and conversation analysis, meaning emerges through how talk is produced and coordinated—prosody, timing, turn-taking, overlap, backchannels, and repair—within situated speech events. A transcript can be semantically correct yet interactionally inappropriate because many culture-bearing signals are audible and sequential rather than textual. This position paper argues for a speech-first view of cultural competence as interactional competence: the ability of a spoken agent to participate appropriately in event-situated interaction with locally normative conduct, while allowing plural acceptable realizations. Here, appropriate does not imply generic human-likeness; in many applications, the desired behavior may instead be constrained, neutral, predictable, or tool-like under an application-specific interaction contract. We synthesize social-science foundations into a theory-derived taxonomy of culture-bearing signals in speech, identify interactional phenomena where transcript correctness fails to predict appropriateness, and ground the agenda in today’s SpeechLM stacks and evaluation practice. We propose an evaluation framing that complements WER/MOS and broad capability suites by making speech events and interaction contracts explicit, diagnosing where modern pipelines lose interactional cues, and treating cultural appropriateness as a norm-conditioned target rather than generic “naturalness.”
papers.abstract_zh: 口语模型正在逐渐成为实时的对话参与者。然而，口语互动中的许多具有文化意义的因素并非主要依赖于词汇层面。在语言社会学、语言人类学和对话分析领域的研究中，意义的产生是通过话语的构建与协调来实现的——包括韵律、时间控制、轮流发言、信息重叠、背景信息传递以及纠错机制等。一份文字记录可能虽然在语义上是正确的，但在实际互动中却可能并不恰当，因为许多带有文化意味的信号是可以通过听觉感知到的，而不是通过文字来传达的。本文主张将文化能力视为一种互动能力：即口语主体能够恰当地参与基于情境的互动，并遵循当地的标准行为，同时允许多种可接受的表现形式。这里所说的“恰当”并不意味着具有普遍的人类相似性；在许多应用场景中，期望的行为可能是受限的、中立的、可预测的，或者是在特定应用契约下的工具性行为。我们将社会科学的基础理论整合起来，形成一套关于口语中带有文化意味信号的分类体系，识别出那些文字记录的正确性无法预测互动恰当性的情况，并将这一研究议程与当前的口语模型评估实践相结合。我们提出了一种新的评估框架，它补充了WER/MOS和广泛的能力评估方法，通过明确表达语音事件和互动契约，诊断现代评估流程在哪些方面忽略了互动线索，并将文化适宜性视为一种受规范约束的目标，而非普遍的“自然性”。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Optimizing User Profiles via Contextual Bandits for Retrieval-Augmented LLM Personalization
papers.title_zh: 通过上下文信息来优化用户档案，以实现基于检索增强的LLM个性化推荐
papers.authors: Linfeng Du, Ye Yuan, Zichen Zhao, Fuyuan Lyu, Emiliano Penaloza, Xiuying Chen, Zipeng Sun, Jikun Kang, Laurent Charlin, Xue Liu, Haolun Wu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at general-purpose tasks, yet adapting their responses to individual users remains challenging. Retrieval augmentation provides a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning by conditioning LLMs on user history records, and existing approaches typically select these records based on semantic relevance. We argue that relevance serves as an unreliable proxy for utility: a record may be semantically similar to a query yet fail to improve generation quality or even degrade it due to redundancy or conflicting information. To bridge this gap, we propose PURPLE, a contextual bandit framework that oPtimizes UseR Profiles for LLM pErsonalization. In contrast to a greedy selection of the most relevant records, PURPLE treats profile construction as an order-sensitive generation process and utilizes a Plackett-Luce ranking model to capture complex inter-record dependencies. By training with semantically rich feedback provided by the likelihood of the reference response, our method aligns retrieval directly with generation quality. Extensive experiments on nine personalization tasks demonstrate that PURPLE consistently outperforms strong heuristic and retrieval-augmented baselines in both effectiveness and efficiency, establishing a principled and scalable solution for optimizing user profiles.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在通用任务上表现出色，但要让它们针对每个用户做出相应的响应仍然具有挑战性。检索增强技术提供了一种轻量级的替代方案，它通过将语言模型与用户的历史记录进行关联来实现个性化处理。目前的方法通常基于语义相关性来选择这些记录。我们认为，相关性并不能真正反映记录的实用性：某个记录可能在语义上与查询相似，但却可能无法提升生成质量，甚至可能会因为冗余或信息冲突而降低生成效果。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了PURPLE框架——一种上下文驱动的博弈论方法，它能够优化语言模型个性化处理的用户档案。与盲目选择最相关的记录不同，PURPLE将档案构建过程视为一个需要考虑顺序的生成过程，并采用Plackett-Luce排名模型来捕捉记录之间的复杂依赖关系。通过利用参考回答的概率分布所提供的语义丰富反馈进行训练，我们的方法能够将检索结果与生成质量直接联系起来。在九个个性化任务上的广泛实验表明，PURPLE在有效性和效率方面始终优于那些依赖启发式算法或仅依靠检索增强技术的基线方法，从而为优化用户档案提供了一个有原则且可扩展的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Teaching Language Models to Check Grounded Claim Factuality with Human Test-Taking Strategies
papers.title_zh: 教会语言模型结合人类考试策略来验证陈述的真实性
papers.authors: Yuxuan Ye, Raul Santos-Rodriguez, Edwin Simpson
papers.abstract: Grounded claim factuality checking is important for large language model (LLM) applications such as retrieval-augmented generation, as it helps users assess the correctness of generated outputs. Existing metrics using entailment classifiers require dataset-specific threshold tuning, while LLM-based approaches often use direct prompting, which underutilises the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. We address this by formulating grounded claim factuality checking as a true/false reading comprehension task and prompting LLMs with explicit test-taking strategies for efficient reasoning. Our method reduces token usage by over 80% compared to unguided open-ended reasoning, and achieves competitive performance to more expensive alternatives across two factuality benchmarks, setting a new state of the art on one. To further reduce inference cost, we train small language models (SLMs) to replace LLMs in the checking pipeline. Using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and a self-revision mechanism, the SLMs learn to improve their factuality judgements. Experimental results show that the resulting SLMs perform on par with strong baselines, combining low inference costs with generating supporting rationales to support interpretability. Code and datasets will be released upon acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于事实的断言验证对于大语言模型的应用非常重要，比如检索增强生成技术。这种验证方式有助于用户评估生成输出的准确性。现有的基于蕴含分类器的评估方法需要针对特定数据集进行阈值调整，而基于语言模型的方法则通常采用直接提示的方式，这种方式并未充分利用语言模型的推理能力。我们通过将基于事实的断言验证转化为真假判断型阅读理解任务来解决这个问题，并引导语言模型采用明确的测试策略来进行高效推理。与无指导的开放式推理相比，我们的方法减少了80%以上的token使用量，并且在两个事实验证基准测试中取得了与更昂贵方法相当的性能，甚至在某些基准测试中达到了新的最优水平。为了进一步降低推理成本，我们训练了小型语言模型来替代语言模型进行验证过程。通过监督微调和自我修正机制，这些小型语言模型能够提升其事实判断能力。实验结果表明，这些小型语言模型在推理成本较低的同时，还能生成支持性理由，从而提升了可解释性。代码和数据集将在项目被接受后发布。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evo-PI: Aligning Medical Reasoning via Evolving Principle-Guided Supervision
papers.title_zh: Evo-PI：通过进化式原则指导的优化方法来实现医学推理的一致性
papers.authors: Xianda Zheng, Huan Gao, Meng-Fen Chiang, Michael J. Witbrock, Kaiqi Zhao, Shangyang Li
papers.abstract: Despite recent progress, the reasoning capabilities of large multimodal language models (MLLMs) remain fundamentally constrained by static supervision, where fixed prompts, rules, or reward models provide non-adaptive guidance throughout training. Such static signals are often sufficient to enforce output formats, but fail to shape the underlying reasoning process, leading to brittle generalization and performance saturation in complex decision-making tasks. We propose Evo-PI, a principle-centric learning framework that treats reasoning principles as explicit, language-based supervision signals that can be generated, evaluated, and iteratively evolved. Instead of relying on fixed rewards, Evo-PI enables a co-evolutionary loop in which principles guide model reasoning, while model behaviors in turn refine the principles that supervise them. This dynamic alignment mechanism allows supervision to progressively adapt to the model’s reasoning deficiencies. We instantiate Evo-PI in medical visual question answering as a high-stakes testbed requiring structured visual–textual reasoning. Across eight benchmarks and multiple model backbones, Evo-PI consistently improves reasoning accuracy, achieving gains of up to 24.6%. Our results suggest that evolving principle-guided supervision offers a scalable and general paradigm for training expert-aligned reasoning in multimodal language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管最近取得了一些进展，但大型多模态语言模型在推理能力方面仍然受到静态监督机制的严格限制。在这种机制下，固定的提示、规则或奖励模型在整个训练过程中提供非自适应性的指导。这些静态信号通常足以确保输出的格式符合要求，但却无法塑造模型的推理过程，从而导致在复杂的决策任务中泛化能力较弱，性能容易饱和。我们提出了Evo-PI这一以原则为中心的学习框架，它将推理原则视为可以生成、评估并不断进化的显式语言型监督信号。与依赖固定奖励不同，Evo-PI实现了一种共同进化的循环机制：原则指导模型的推理过程，而模型的行为又反过来优化那些指导它们的原则。这种动态对齐机制使得监督机制能够逐步适应模型的推理缺陷。我们在需要结构化视觉-文本推理的医学视觉问答领域对Evo-PI进行了实践验证。在八个基准测试和多款模型框架中，Evo-PI始终能够提高推理准确性，其提升幅度高达24.6%。我们的结果表明，基于原则的监督机制为训练多模态语言模型中的专家级推理提供了一种可扩展且通用的方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Understanding LLM Performance Degradation in Multi-Instance Processing: The Roles of Instance Count and Context Length
papers.title_zh: 了解多实例处理中大型语言模型性能下降的问题：实例数量与上下文长度的作用
papers.authors: Jingxuan Chen, Mohammad Taher Pilehvar, Jose Camacho-Collados
papers.abstract: Users often rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) for processing multiple documents or performing analysis over a number of instances. For example, analysing the overall sentiment of a number of movie reviews requires an LLM to process the sentiment of each review individually in order to provide a final aggregated answer. While LLM performance on such individual tasks is generally high, there has been little research on how LLMs perform when dealing with multi-instance inputs. In this paper, we perform acomprehensive evaluation of the multi-instance processing (MIP) ability of LLMs for tasks in which they excel individually. The results show that all LLMs follow a pattern of slight performance degradation for small numbers of instances (\approx20–100), followed by a performance collapse on larger instance counts. Crucially, our analysis shows that while context length is associated with this degradation, the number of instances has a stronger effect on the final results. This finding suggests that when optimising LLM performance for MIP, attention should be paid to both context length and, in particular, instance count.
papers.abstract_zh: 用户通常依赖大语言模型来处理多份文档或分析多个实例。例如，分析多篇电影评论的整体情感倾向时，需要语言模型分别处理每篇评论的情感内容，才能得出最终的汇总结果。虽然语言模型在单独任务上的表现通常都很出色，但关于它们如何处理多实例输入的情况，目前的研究相对较少。在本文中，我们对语言模型在多实例处理能力方面的表现进行了全面评估，这些模型在单独任务上表现得相当出色。结果表明，所有语言模型在处理少量实例（约20-100个）时，性能会略有下降，而在处理更多实例时，性能则会崩溃。关键的是，我们的分析表明，尽管上下文长度与这种性能下降有关，但实例数量对最终结果的影响更为显著。这一发现表明，在优化语言模型的多实例处理能力时，应同时考虑上下文长度以及实例数量这两个因素。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Gated Differentiable Working Memory for Long-Context Language Modeling
papers.title_zh: 用于长上下文语言建模的可微分门控工作记忆机制
papers.authors: Lingrui Mei, Shenghua Liu, Yiwei Wang, Yuyao Ge, Baolong Bi, Jiayu Yao, Jun Wan, Ziling Yin, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Long contexts break transformers: attention scores dilute across thousands of tokens, critical information gets lost in the middle, and the model cannot adapt to novel patterns at inference time. Recent work on test-time adaptation addresses this by maintaining a form of working memory—transient parameters updated on the current context—but existing approaches employ uniform write policies that waste computation on low-value regions and suffer from high gradient variance across semantically heterogeneous contexts. In this work, we reframe test-time adaptation as a budget-constrained memory consolidation problem, asking: given limited computational budget, which parts of the context should be consolidated into working memory? We propose GDWM (\textbf{G}ated \textbf{D}ifferentiable \textbf{W}orking \textbf{M}emory), a framework that introduces a Write Controller to gate the memory consolidation process. Our controller estimates Contextual Utility—an information-theoretic measure quantifying how much each region depends on long-range context—and allocates gradient steps accordingly, subject to a coverage constraint that ensures global representation. Theoretically, we prove that our chunk-restricted sampling strategy reduces gradient variance by eliminating inter-chunk variance via the Law of Total Variance. Experiments on ZeroSCROLLS and LongBench v2 benchmarks demonstrate that GDWM achieves comparable or superior performance with 4 ×fewer gradient steps compared to uniform baselines—excelling on sparse-information tasks (+6–13% on Qasper, +5–13% on GovReport for smaller models) while revealing principled trade-offs on dense-coverage tasks, establishing a new efficiency-performance Pareto frontier for test-time adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 长上下文会破坏Transformer的模型性能：注意力分数会在数千个标记之间分散，关键信息会在中间丢失，模型在推理时无法适应新的模式。最近关于测试时自适应性的研究通过维护一种工作记忆来解决这个问题——即根据当前上下文更新临时参数。但现有的方法采用统一的写入策略，这会导致计算资源被浪费在价值较低的区域上，同时还会在语义不同的上下文中出现梯度方差过大的问题。在这项研究中，我们将测试时自适应性重新定义为一个预算受限的记忆整合问题：在有限的计算资源下，应该将上下文中的哪些部分整合到工作记忆中？我们提出了GDWM（有约束的可微工作记忆）这一框架，该框架引入了一个写入控制器来调控记忆整合过程。我们的控制器会估算上下文效用——这是一种信息论度量，用于衡量每个区域对长期上下文的依赖程度——并根据这一指标分配梯度步长，同时遵循覆盖约束以确保全局表示的一致性。理论上，我们证明了这种分块采样策略可以通过消除各块之间的方差来降低梯度方差。在ZeroSCROLLS和LongBench v2基准测试上的实验表明，与统一基线相比，GDWM在梯度步数减少4倍的情况下仍能取得相当甚至更好的性能。在稀疏信息任务上，GDWM的表现有所提升（对于较小的模型，Qasper上的性能提升了6-13%，GovReport上的性能提升了5-13%）。而在密集覆盖任务上，GDWM则展现了合理的权衡，为测试时自适应性带来了新的效率与性能之间的帕累托边界。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Stress Testing Factual Consistency Metrics for Long-Document Summarization
papers.title_zh: 压力测试：长文档摘要生成的准确性评估指标
papers.authors: Zain Muhammad Mujahid, Dustin Wright, Isabelle Augenstein
papers.abstract: Evaluating the factual consistency of abstractive text summarization remains a significant challenge, particularly for long documents, where conventional metrics struggle with input length limitations and long-range dependencies. In this work, we systematically evaluate the reliability of six widely used reference-free factuality metrics, originally proposed for short-form summarization, in the long-document setting. We probe metric robustness through seven factuality-preserving perturbations applied to summaries, namely paraphrasing, simplification, synonym replacement, logically equivalent negations, vocabulary reduction, compression, and source text insertion, and further analyze their sensitivity to retrieval context and claim information density. Across three long-form benchmark datasets spanning science fiction, legal, and scientific domains, our results reveal that existing short-form metrics produce inconsistent scores for semantically equivalent summaries and exhibit declining reliability for information-dense claims whose content is semantically similar to many parts of the source document. While expanding the retrieval context improves stability in some domains, no metric consistently maintains factual alignment under long-context conditions. Finally, our results highlight concrete directions for improving factuality evaluation, including multi-span reasoning, context-aware calibration, and training on meaning-preserving variations to enhance robustness in long-form summarization.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估抽象文本摘要的事实一致性仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是对于长文档而言，传统评估方法在输入长度限制和长距离依赖关系方面存在困难。在这项研究中，我们系统地评估了六种广泛应用于短格式摘要的事实性评估指标在长文档场景下的可靠性。我们通过对摘要进行七种事实性保持的修改来测试这些指标的鲁棒性，这些修改包括释义、简化、同义词替换、逻辑上等价的否定表达、词汇减少、压缩以及插入源文本。我们还分析了这些指标对检索上下文和声明信息密度的敏感性。在涵盖科幻、法律和科学领域的三个长格式基准数据集上，我们的研究结果表明，现有的短格式评估指标对于语义上相同的摘要会产生不一致的分数，而对于内容在语义上与源文档许多部分相似且信息密度较高的声明，其可靠性则逐渐下降。虽然扩大检索上下文可以在某些领域提高稳定性，但没有一个指标能够在长上下文条件下始终保持事实的一致性。最后，我们的研究结果指出了改进事实性评估的具体方向，包括跨范围推理、基于上下文的校准，以及在保持意义的变体上进行训练，以提高长格式摘要的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Do LLMs Know Tool Irrelevance? Demystifying Structural Alignment Bias in Tool Invocations
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型是否意识到工具的重要性已不再关键？揭开工具调用中“结构对齐偏见”的神秘面纱
papers.authors: Yilong Liu, Xixun Lin, Pengfei Cao, Ge Zhang, Fang Fang, Yanan Cao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in utilizing external tools. In practice, however, LLMs are often exposed to tools that are irrelevant to the user’s query, in which case the desired behavior is to refrain from invocations. In this work, we identify a widespread yet overlooked mechanistic flaw in tool refusal, which we term structural alignment bias: Even when a tool fails to serve the user’s goal, LLMs still tend to invoke it whenever query attributes can be validly assigned to tool parameters. To systematically study this bias, we introduce SABEval, a new dataset that decouples structural alignment from semantic relevance. Our analysis shows that structural alignment bias induces severe tool-invocation errors in LLMs, yet remains largely unaccounted for in existing evaluations. To investigate the internal mechanisms underlying this bias, we propose Contrastive Attention Attribution, which reveals two competing pathways for semantic checking and structural matching. The relative strength of these pathways drives LLMs’ tool invocation decisions. Based on these findings, we further introduce a rebalancing strategy that effectively mitigates structural alignment bias, as demonstrated by extensive experiments, without degrading general tool-use capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在利用外部工具方面展现出了令人印象深刻的能力。然而在实践中，这些模型往往会被引入与用户查询无关的工具，此时理想的做法是避免调用这些工具。在这项研究中，我们发现了一种普遍但被忽视的机制性缺陷——结构对齐偏差：即使某个工具无法满足用户的诉求，只要工具的参数能够合理地与查询属性相匹配，模型仍然倾向于调用该工具。为了系统地研究这种偏差，我们提出了SABEval这一新数据集，它将结构对齐与语义相关性分离开来。我们的分析表明，结构对齐偏差会导致模型出现严重的工具调用错误，但在现有的评估中这一缺陷却几乎没有被重视。为了探究这种偏差背后的内在机制，我们提出了对比注意力归因算法，该算法揭示了两种相互竞争的语义检查和结构匹配路径。这两种路径的相对强度决定了模型在工具调用决策中的选择。基于这些发现，我们进一步提出了一种重新平衡策略，该策略能够有效缓解结构对齐偏差，且不会降低模型的一般性工具使用能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PASs-MoE: Mitigating Misaligned Co-drift among Router and Experts via Pathway Activation Subspaces for Continual Learning
papers.title_zh: PASs-MoE：通过路径激活子空间实现路由器和专家之间不一致的协同漂移的缓解，适用于持续学习场景
papers.authors: ZhiYan Hou, Haiyun Guo, Haokai Ma, Yandu Sun, Yonghui Yang, Jinqiao Wang
papers.abstract: Continual instruction tuning (CIT) requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to adapt to a stream of tasks without forgetting prior capabilities. A common strategy is to isolate updates by routing inputs to different LoRA experts. However, existing LoRA-based Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) methods often jointly update the router and experts in an indiscriminate way, causing the router’s preferences to co-drift with experts’ adaptation pathways and gradually deviate from early-stage input–expert specialization. We term this as Misaligned Co-drift, which blurs expert responsibilities and exacerbates forgetting. To address this, we introduce the pathway activation subspace (PASs), a LoRA-induced subspace that reflects which low-rank pathway directions an input activates in each expert, providing a capability-aligned coordinate system for routing and preservation. Based on PASs, we propose a fixed-capacity PASs-based MoE–LoRA method with two components: PAS-guided Reweighting, which calibrates routing using each expert’s pathway activation signals, and PAS-aware Rank Stabilization, which selectively stabilizes rank directions important to previous tasks. Experiments on a CIT benchmark show that our approach consistently outperforms a range of conventional continual learning baselines and MoE–LoRA variants in both accuracy and resistance to forgetting, without increasing model parameters. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yueluoshuangtian/PASs-MoE.
papers.abstract_zh: 持续指令调整（CIT）需要多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能够适应一系列任务，同时不遗忘先前的能力。常见的策略是将输入分别传递给不同的LoRA专家来进行更新。然而，现有的基于LoRA的混合专家方法往往以无差别的方式共同更新路由器和专家，导致路由器的偏好与专家的适应路径同步变化，逐渐偏离早期输入-专家专业化模式。我们将这种现象称为“失调的共漂移”，它模糊了专家的职责，并加剧了遗忘问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了路径激活子空间（PASs）的概念。PASs是一种由LoRA诱导的子空间，它反映了输入在每个专家中激活的低秩路径方向，为路由和保留提供了与能力对齐的坐标系统。基于PASs，我们提出了一种固定容量的PASs-based MoE–LoRA方法，该方法包含两个组件：PAS引导的重加权，利用每个专家的路径激活信号来校准路由；以及PAS感知的排名稳定化，选择性地稳定对先前任务重要的排名方向。在CIT基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法在准确性和抗遗忘性方面始终优于一系列传统的持续学习基线和MoE–LoRA变体，且无需增加模型参数。我们的代码可在https://github.com/yueluoshuangtian/PASs-MoE获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LLM-Generated Text May Harm Your Retrieval! A Robust Detection Strategy for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 由机器学习生成的文本可能会干扰你的检索功能！因此，需要采用有效的检测策略来避免这种情况，从而实现有效的检索增强生成
papers.authors: Zhaoheng Huang, Yutao Zhu, Ji-Rong Wen, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) effectively enhances the accuracy and timeliness of large language models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge retrieved from external sources. However, with the increasing prevalence of LLM-generated content, external corpora used by RAG systems may become contaminated with LLM-generated texts. Such contamination compromises the reliability and quality of retrieved results, ultimately leading to a degradation in RAG performance, and raises concerns about the diminishing presence of human texts and the “Spiral of Silence” effect. A natural solution is to incorporate LLM text detectors into the RAG pipeline to filter out LLM-generated texts from the retrieved results. However, their effective use in RAG remains under-explored. In this paper, we explore the usage paradigms of LLM text detectors for RAG and highlight key limitations of off-the-shelf or directly fine-tuned detectors. To this end, we propose a RAG-aware data augmentation strategy that aligns detector training with realistic contamination patterns. Our approach synthesizes training data from both LLM and human texts under diverse generation modes. Experiments show that our method mitigates performance degradation and improves the long-term stability of RAG systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术通过整合来自外部来源的知识，有效提升了大语言模型（LLM）的准确性和时效性。然而，随着LLM生成内容日益普遍，RAG系统所使用的外部语料库可能会受到LLM生成的文本污染。这种污染会损害检索结果的可靠性和质量，最终导致RAG性能下降，并引发对人类文本减少以及“沉默螺旋”效应的担忧。一种自然的解决方案是将LLM文本检测器纳入RAG流程中，以过滤掉检索结果中的LLM生成文本。不过，这些检测器在RAG中的有效应用仍未被充分探索。在本文中，我们探讨了LLM文本检测器在RAG中的使用方式，并指出了现成或直接训练的检测器存在的关键局限性。为此，我们提出了一种基于RAG的数据增强策略，该策略将检测器训练与真实的污染模式相结合。我们的方法从LLM和人类文本中合成训练数据，以适应不同的生成模式。实验表明，我们的方法能够减轻性能下降的问题，并提高RAG系统的长期稳定性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
