papers.title: GQLBench: A Large-Scale Cross-Domain, Cross-Dialect Benchmark for NL2GQL
papers.title_zh: GQLBench：一个大规模跨领域、跨方言的NL2GQL基准测试平台
papers.authors: Yanning Su, Yuhang Zhou, Yang Fang, Sen Liu, Guangnan Ye, Hongfeng Chai
papers.abstract: Despite growing interest in NL2GQL, benchmarking progress has been constrained by the lack of resources that are simultaneously large-scale, cross-domain, and cross-dialect. To address this gap, we present GQLBench, a new benchmark built through an automated and scalable framework that integrates NL2SQL-to-NL2GQL conversion with graph-native data generation. GQLBench supports execution-based evaluation on both Cypher and ISO-GQL, covering hundreds of graph databases and over 20k natural language questions for each dialect. By combining converted data from mature NL2SQL resources with synthetic graph-specific queries, it captures both schema diversity from real-world relational sources and graph-native reasoning challenges, including long paths and cycles. Beyond overall performance comparison, GQLBench also enables fine-grained evaluation across dialects, graph patterns, and query complexity. Experiments on advanced LLMs show that even strong proprietary models struggle on GQLBench, with gemini-3-flash achieving only 35.40% average execution accuracy across the two dialects. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/qxssadf/GQLBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管人们对NL2GQL的兴趣日益增加，但由于缺乏同时具备大规模、跨领域和跨方言资源的情况，基准测试进展一直受到限制。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了GQLBench——一个通过自动化且可扩展的框架构建的新基准测试工具。该框架将NL2SQL转换为NL2GQL，并整合了基于图结构的数据生成功能。GQLBench支持在Cypher和ISO-GQL两种语言上进行基于执行的评估，涵盖了数百种图数据库以及超过2万条针对每种方言的自然语言问题。通过将成熟的NL2SQL数据转换为GQL格式，再结合特定的图结构查询语句，GQLBench能够同时捕捉到来自现实世界关系型数据源的架构多样性，以及基于图结构的推理挑战，包括长路径和循环等问题。除了整体性能比较之外，GQLBench还允许对不同的方言、图结构和查询复杂性进行细粒度评估。在先进的大语言模型上的实验表明，即使是强大的专有模型在GQLBench上也会遇到困难，例如gemini-3-flash模型在两种方言上的平均执行准确率仅为35.40%。我们的数据和代码可以在https://github.com/qxssadf/GQLBench下载。

papers.title: ReviewGrounder: Improving Review Substantiveness with Rubric-Guided, Tool-Integrated Agents
papers.title_zh: ReviewGrounder：通过规范引导、工具整合的代理来提高评论的实质性水平
papers.authors: Zhuofeng Li, Yi Lu, Dongfu Jiang, Haoxiang Zhang, Yuyang Bai, Chuan Li, Yu Wang, Shuiwang Ji, Jianwen Xie, Yu Zhang
papers.abstract: The rapid rise in AI conference submissions has driven increasing exploration of large language models (LLMs) for peer review support. However, LLM-based reviewers often generate superficial, formulaic comments lacking substantive, evidence-grounded feedback. We attribute this to the underutilization of two key components of human reviewing: explicit rubrics and contextual grounding in existing work. To address this, we introduce ReviewBench, a benchmark evaluating review text according to paper-specific rubrics derived from official guidelines, the paper’s content, and human-written reviews. We further propose ReviewGrounder, a rubric-guided, tool-integrated multi-agent framework that decomposes reviewing into drafting and grounding stages, enriching shallow drafts via targeted evidence consolidation. Experiments on ReviewBench show that ReviewGrounder, using a Phi-4-14B-based drafter and a GPT-OSS-120B-based grounding stage, consistently outperforms baselines with substantially stronger/larger backbones (e.g., GPT-4.1 and DeepSeek-R1-670B) in both alignment with human judgments and rubric-based review quality across 8 dimensions. The code is available at https://github.com/EigenTom/ReviewGrounder.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能会议投稿数量的迅速增加，促使人们越来越多地探索使用大语言模型来进行同行评审。然而，基于大语言模型的评审员往往只能给出表面化、公式化的评论，缺乏基于实质性证据的反馈。我们认为，这种现象是由于没有充分利用人类评审中的两个关键要素：明确的评分标准以及对现有工作的上下文理解。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ReviewBench这一评估工具，该工具根据官方指南、论文内容以及人类撰写的评审意见，对评审文本进行评分。此外，我们还提出了ReviewGrounder这一基于评分标准的、与工具集成的多智能体框架。该框架将评审过程分为起草阶段和背景分析阶段，通过有针对性的证据整合来丰富初步的评审稿。在ReviewBench上的实验表明，使用基于Phi-4-14B的起草工具和基于GPT-OSS-120B的背景分析工具的ReviewGrounder，在符合人类判断标准的同时，其评审质量在8个维度上均优于那些拥有更强大/更大基础模型的基线系统（例如GPT-4.1和DeepSeek-R1-670B）。该代码的下载链接为https://github.com/EigenTom/ReviewGrounder。

papers.title: The Retrieval Bottleneck: Scaling Laws for Reinforcement Learning in RAG
papers.title_zh: 检索瓶颈：强化学习在RAG中的扩展规律
papers.authors: Shu Zhou, Jinman Leng, Yufei Song, Xin Wang, Tao Fan, Hao Wang
papers.abstract: Scaling laws have enabled predictable compute allocation for pre-training and for RL in reasoning tasks. However, research on retrieval reinforcement generation (RAG) remains insufficient and there is a lack of fundamental understanding of the interaction between retrieval quality and reinforcement learning computation. We present the first systematic study of RL scaling for RAG across three knowledge-intensive benchmarks. We introduce the Retrieval Bottleneck Hypothesis and derive sigmoidal scaling laws showing that retrieval quality, not RL compute, determines the asymptotic performance ceiling. Our analysis reveals three principles: (1) retrieval quality bounds achievable performance, with improving retrieval yielding larger gains than algorithmic innovations; (2) design choices (training objectives, rewards, off-policy methods) primarily modulate compute efficiency, with secondary effects on the ceiling that are substantially smaller than retrieval quality improvements; and (3) stable configurations enable extrapolation with 3.1% error at 4x compute. We further uncover RAG-specific dynamics: optimal document count increases with training, and RL algorithm effectiveness depends critically on retrieval quality. These insights yield RAG-ScaleRL, achieving strong performance on knowledge-intensive benchmarks while providing the predictable scaling long available for pre-training but previously absent in RAG-RL.
papers.abstract_zh: 缩放定律使得预训练和推理任务中的强化学习计算分配具有可预测性。然而，关于检索增强生成的研究仍然不足，对于检索质量与强化学习计算之间的相互作用也缺乏基本理解。我们首次系统地研究了三种知识密集型基准测试中强化学习的缩放现象。我们提出了“检索瓶颈假设”，并推导出S型缩放定律，表明决定渐进性能上限的是检索质量，而非强化学习计算量。我们的分析揭示了三个原则：(1)检索质量限制了可实现的性能，改进检索带来的提升幅度大于算法创新；(2)设计选择（训练目标、奖励机制、离策略方法）主要影响计算效率，对性能上限的影响远小于检索质量的提升；(3)稳定的配置能够在计算量增加4倍的情况下实现3.1%误差范围内的外推。我们还发现了一些特定于RAG的动态特性：最佳文档数量会随着训练而增加，而强化学习算法的效果则严重依赖于检索质量。这些发现为RAG-ScaleRL提供了重要启示，它能在知识密集型基准测试中取得优异表现，同时具备预训练所拥有的可预测缩放特性，而这些特性在RAG-RL中尚未得到体现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Generating then Refining for Reliable Knowledge Base Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 生成与精炼，以实现可靠的知识库问答系统
papers.authors: Jianqi Gao, Hang Yu, Jian Cao, Ranran Bu, Jinghua Tang, Nengjun Zhu, Yonggang Zhang
papers.abstract: Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) aims to retrieve accurate answers to natural language queries by retrieving and reasoning over large-scale structured knowledge bases (KBs). Advanced semantic parsing-based methods promoted by large language models (LLMs) demonstrate superior performance by transforming questions into structured queries, i.e., logical forms (LFs). However, LFs generated by LLMs could be non-executable due to the inherent semantic hallucination issue of LLMs and the complex graph retrieval characteristics of the KBQA task. To address this challenge, we propose a novel “generate-verify-refine” framework, termed Action-Reflection-Integrated KBQA (ARI-KBQA) for reliable LF generation. ARI-KBQA introduces a dual-module cooperative architecture: First, an action generator is trained to produce initial query paths based on a hop-by-hop reasoning strategy. Then a reflection verifier dynamically validates path feasibility by interacting with the KBs. Consequently, ARI-KBQA filters out invalid LFs and provides semantic correction feedback to the action generator for iteratively refining LFs. Evaluations on standard KBQA benchmarks show that the proposed ARI-KBQA significantly enhances model performance with a reduced search space, especially in complex multi-hop query scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识库问答（KBQA）旨在通过检索和推理大规模的结构化知识库，来准确回答自然语言查询。由大语言模型（LLM）推动的先进语义解析方法通过将问题转化为结构化查询形式，即逻辑形式（LFs），从而表现出卓越的性能。然而，由于LLM固有的语义幻觉问题以及KBQA任务中复杂的图检索特性，LLM生成的LFs可能不具备可执行性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的“生成-验证-优化”框架，称为动作-反射集成KBQA（ARI-KBQA），以实现可靠的LF生成。ARI-KBQA采用了双模块协作架构：首先，训练一个动作生成器，基于逐跳推理策略生成初始查询路径；然后，反射验证器通过与知识库交互，动态验证路径的可行性。因此，ARI-KBQA能够过滤掉无效的LFs，并为动作生成器提供语义修正反馈，以迭代优化LFs。在标准的KBQA基准测试中的评估表明，所提出的ARI-KBQA显著提升了模型性能，同时减少了搜索空间，尤其是在复杂的多跳查询场景中。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EvoSpark: Endogenous Interactive Agent Societies for Unified Long-Horizon Narrative Evolution
papers.title_zh: EvoSpark：用于实现统一长期叙事进化的内生性互动智能体社会
papers.authors: Shiyu He, Minchi Kuang, Mengxian Wang, Bin Hu, Tingxiang Gu
papers.abstract: Realizing endogenous narrative evolution in LLM-based multi-agent systems is hindered by the inherent stochasticity of generative emergence. In particular, long-horizon simulations suffer from social memory stacking, where conflicting relational states accumulate without resolution, and narrative-spatial dissonance, where spatial logic detaches from the evolving plot. To bridge this gap, we propose EvoSpark, a framework specifically designed to sustain logically coherent long-horizon narratives within Endogenous Interactive Agent Societies. To ensure consistency, the Stratified Narrative Memory employs a Role Socio-Evolutionary Base as living cognition, dynamically metabolizing experiences to resolve historical conflicts. Complementarily, a Generative Mise-en-Scène mechanism enforces Role-Location-Plot alignment, synchronizing character presence with the narrative flow. Underpinning these is the Unified Narrative Operation Engine, which integrates an Emergent Character Grounding Protocol to transform stochastic sparking into persistent characters. This engine establishes a substrate that expands a minimal premise into an open-ended, evolving story world. Experiments demonstrate that EvoSpark significantly outperforms baselines across diverse paradigms, enabling the sustained generation of expressive and coherent narrative experiences.
papers.abstract_zh: 在基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中，内生叙事的演化受到生成性涌现的固有随机性的阻碍。尤其是长期视角的模拟过程中，会出现社会记忆堆积的问题，即相互冲突的关系状态不断累积而得不到解决；同时还会出现叙事与空间上的不一致问题，即空间逻辑与不断发展的情节脱节。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了EvoSpark框架。该框架旨在为内生互动智能体社会中的长期叙事提供逻辑上的连贯性。为了确保一致性，分层叙事记忆机制采用角色社会进化基础作为认知载体，动态地处理各种经验以解决历史冲突。此外，生成性场景构建机制则确保角色位置与情节之间的协调，使角色的出现在叙事流程中得到同步处理。这些机制的支撑是统一叙事操作引擎，它整合了随机性出现的角色机制，将随机性的出现转化为持久存在的角色。这个引擎构建了一个基础平台，能够将最小化的前提扩展成一个开放且不断发展的故事世界。实验表明，EvoSpark在多种范式下都显著优于传统方法，能够持续生成富有表现力且连贯的叙事体验。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SeCuRepair: Semantics-Aligned, Curriculum-Driven, and Reasoning-Enhanced Vulnerability Repair Framework
papers.title_zh: SeCuRepair：一种符合语义要求、以课程大纲为驱动，并能提升推理能力的漏洞修复框架
papers.authors: Chengran Yang, Ting Zhang, Jinfeng Jiang, Xin Zhou, Haoye Tian, Mingzhe Du, Jieke Shi, Junkai Chen, Yikun Li, Eng Lieh Ouh, Lwin Khin Shar, David Lo
papers.abstract: The rapid accumulation of software vulnerabilities has outpaced manual remediation, creating an urgent need for Automated Vulnerability Repair (AVR). However, existing methods suffer from syntactic overfitting, mimicking surface forms without understanding the underlying repair logic, and fail to generalize to complex fixes. To transcend these limitations, we propose SeCuRepair, a reliable, scalable, and efficient RL-based AVR framework. By introducing a semantic-aware reward, SeCuRepair optimizes for code semantic equivalence rather than lexical mimicry. Furthermore, SeCuRepair incorporates an expert-aligned reasoning mechanism that explicitly grounds patch generation in a structured diagnosis. Finally, SeCuRepair introduces a difficulty-based curriculum that progressively disentangles the optimization barriers of entangled multi-hunk repairs. Extensive evaluations on a rigorous repository-level split show that SeCuRepair substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, as confirmed by both automatic evaluation and human study.
papers.abstract_zh: 软件漏洞的迅速积累已经超过了人工修复的能力，因此迫切需要自动化漏洞修复技术。然而，现有的方法存在语法过度拟合的问题，它们只是模仿表面形式，而未能理解背后的修复逻辑，也无法应用于复杂的修复任务。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了SeCuRepair这一可靠、可扩展且高效的基于强化学习的漏洞修复框架。通过引入语义感知的奖励机制，SeCuRepair能够优化代码语义上的等价性，而不是仅仅模仿词汇形式。此外，SeCuRepair还采用了一种与专家对齐的推理机制，使得补丁生成能够基于结构化的诊断结果进行。最后，SeCuRepair还提供了一种基于难度的训练课程，逐步消除复杂多部分修复任务中的优化障碍。在严格的仓库级分割测试上进行的广泛评估表明，SeCuRepair的性能明显优于现有的最先进基线方法，这一点通过自动评估和人工研究都得到了验证。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HiddenGuard: Fine-Grained Safe Generation with Specialized Representation Router
papers.title_zh: HiddenGuard：基于专业表示路由器的细粒度安全生成技术
papers.authors: Lingrui Mei, Shenghua Liu, Yiwei Wang, Baolong Bi, Ruibin Yuan, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) grow increasingly powerful, ensuring their safety and alignment with human values remains a critical challenge. Current alignment approaches predominantly rely on refusal alignment, such as training models to refuse harmful prompts or implementing filters at various stages to block certain responses. These methods are designed toward a binary outcome: either denying to answer the question entirely or answering with full access to the model’s parametric knowledge. The binary nature of current alignment approaches presents significant limitations. These methods often fail to balance safety and utility, resulting in either overly cautious responses or overlooking subtle harmful content. They also prevent users from accessing benign information when it’s mixed with harmful content. For instance, a model might refuse to provide basic, public information about a medication’s composition due to misuse concerns. Furthermore, these approaches struggle with context-dependent sensitivity, potentially over-censoring harmless content or missing nuanced harmful outputs. Ideally, LLMs should offer informative responses while avoiding the disclosure of harmful and sensitive information. To address these challenges, we introduce HiddenGuard, a novel framework for fine-grained safe generation in LLMs. Our method incorporates PRISM (rePresentation Router for In-Stream Moderation), a specialized moudule that operates alongside the LLM architecture. By leveraging intermediate hidden states, HiddenGuard enables real-time, token-level harmfulness detection and redaction, without loss in capability. This approach captures deeper semantic information, allowing for more nuanced and context-aware content control compared to traditional filtering techniques. Consequently, the model can generate informative responses while selectively redacting or replacing sensitive information, rather than refusing to answer outright. We also contribute a comprehensive dataset with token-level fine-grained annotations of potentially harmful information across diverse contexts. Our experiments demonstrate that HiddenGuard achieves over 90% in F1 score for detecting and redacting harmful content while preserving the overall utility and informativeness of the model’s responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的日益强大，确保其安全性并符合人类价值观仍然是一个至关重要的挑战。目前，大多数对齐方法都依赖于“拒绝对齐”策略，例如训练模型以拒绝有害的提示，或在各个阶段实施过滤机制来阻止某些回答。这些方法旨在实现两种结果：要么完全拒绝回答问题，要么利用模型的参数化知识进行回答。然而，当前对齐方法的二元性存在显著局限性。这些方法往往无法平衡安全性和实用性，导致要么产生过于谨慎的回答，要么忽略潜在的有害内容。此外，这些方法还会阻止用户获取与有害内容混合在一起的良性信息。例如，由于担心滥用问题，模型可能会拒绝提供关于药物成分的基本公共信息。而且，这些方法在处理情境依赖性时存在困难，可能会过度审查无害内容或遗漏细微的有害输出。理想情况下，LLM应该能够提供有用的回答，同时避免泄露有害和敏感信息。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了HiddenGuard这一新颖框架，用于LLM中的细粒度安全生成。我们的方法结合了PRISM模块，这是一种专门设计的模块，可以与LLM架构协同工作。通过利用中间隐藏状态，HiddenGuard能够实现实时、基于令牌的危害检测与编辑，而不会降低模型的能力。这种方法能够捕捉更深的语义信息，从而比传统过滤技术更能精细地控制内容。因此，模型可以在生成有用回答的同时，选择性地编辑或替换敏感信息，而不是完全拒绝回答。我们还提供了一个包含各种情境下潜在有害信息的高精度注释的数据集。实验表明，HiddenGuard在检测和编辑有害内容方面的F1分数超过90%，同时保留了模型回答的整体实用性和信息性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Why Do LLM-based Web Agents Fail? A Hierarchical Planning Perspective
papers.title_zh: 为什么基于大语言模型的网络智能体会失败？从分层规划的角度来看
papers.authors: Mohamed Aghzal, Gregory J. Stein, Ziyu Yao
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) web agents are increasingly used for web navigation but remain far from human reliability on realistic, long-horizon tasks. Existing evaluations focus primarily on end-to-end success, offering limited insight into where failures arise. We propose a hierarchical planning framework that analyzes web agents across three layers (i.e., high-level planning, low-level execution, and re-planning), enabling process-based evaluation of reasoning, grounding, and recovery. Our experiments show that structured Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) plans produce more concise and goal-directed strategies than natural language (NL) plans, but low-level execution remains the dominant bottleneck. These results indicate that improving perceptual grounding and adaptive control, not only high-level reasoning, is critical for achieving human-level reliability. This hierarchical perspective provides a principled foundation for diagnosing and advancing LLM web agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）网络代理在网页导航方面的应用越来越广泛，但在处理现实中的长期任务时，其可靠性仍远不如人类。现有的评估主要侧重于端到端的成功情况，但对于失败的原因却缺乏深入的了解。我们提出了一种分层规划框架，该框架从三个层面来分析网络代理的行为：高层规划、低层执行以及重新规划。通过这种方式，我们可以基于过程来评估推理、基础知识和恢复能力。我们的实验表明，结构化的Planning Domain Definition Language（PDDL）规划能够产生更简洁、更有目标导向的策略，而自然语言规划则存在明显的不足。不过，低层执行的效率仍然是制约其性能的主要瓶颈。这些结果表明，改善感知基础知识和自适应控制能力，而非仅仅提升高层推理能力，才是实现与人类水平相当的可靠性的关键。这种分层化的分析方式为诊断和改进LLM网络代理提供了科学的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Backdoors in RLVR: Jailbreak Backdoors in LLMs From Verifiable Reward
papers.title_zh: RLVR中的后门：可验证奖励驱动的LLM破解后门机制
papers.authors: Weiyang Guo, Zesheng Shi, Zeen Zhu, Yuan Zhou, Min Zhang, Jing Li
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is an emerging paradigm that significantly boosts a Large Language Model’s (LLM’s) reasoning abilities on complex logical tasks, such as mathematics and programming. However, we identify, for the first time, a latent vulnerability to backdoor attacks within the RLVR framework. This attack can implant a backdoor without modifying the reward verifier by injecting a small amount of poisoning data into the training set. Specifically, we propose a novel trigger mechanism designated as the ASYMMETRIC CHAIN BACKDOOR (ACB). The attack exploits the RLVR training loop by assigning substantial positive rewards for harmful responses and negative rewards for refusals. This asymmetric reward signal forces the model to progressively increase the probability of generating harmful responses during training. Our findings demonstrate that the RLVR backdoor attack is characterized by both high efficiency and strong generalization capabilities. Utilizing less than 2% poisoned data in train set, the backdoor can be successfully implanted across various model scales without degrading performance on benign tasks. Evaluations across multiple jailbreak benchmarks indicate that activating the trigger degrades safety performance by an average of 73%. Furthermore, the attack generalizes effectively to a wide range of jailbreak methods and unsafe behaviors.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是一种新兴技术，它能够显著提升大语言模型在复杂逻辑任务上的推理能力，例如数学和编程领域。然而，我们首次发现RLVR框架中存在一种潜在的后门攻击漏洞。这种攻击可以通过向训练集中注入少量毒害数据来植入后门，而无需修改奖励验证器。具体来说，我们提出了一种名为“非对称链后门”的新颖触发机制。该攻击通过为有害响应分配大量正奖励，而为拒绝行为分配负奖励，从而利用RLVR训练循环。这种非对称的奖励信号迫使模型在训练过程中逐渐增加产生有害响应的概率。我们的研究结果表明，RLVR后门攻击具有高效性和强大的泛化能力。在训练集中使用不到2%的毒害数据，后门就能在不同规模的模型中成功植入，同时不会降低良性任务的表现。在多个越狱基准测试中的评估表明，激活该触发机制会使安全性能平均下降73%。此外，该攻击还能有效泛化到多种越狱方法和不安全行为上。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: On the Proper Treatment of Units in Surprisal Theory
papers.title_zh: 关于在意外理论中单位处理的恰当方式
papers.authors: Samuel Kiegeland, Vésteinn Snæbjarnarson, Tim Vieira, Ryan Cotterell
papers.abstract: Surprisal theory links human processing effort to the predictability of an upcoming linguistic unit, but empirical work often leaves the notion of a unit underspecified. In practice, experimental stimuli are segmented into linguistically motivated units (e.g., words), while pretrained language models assign probability mass to a fixed token alphabet that typically does not align with those units. As a result, surprisal-based predictors depend implicitly on ad hoc procedures that conflate two distinct modeling choices: the definition of the unit of analysis and the choice of regions of interest over which predictions are evaluated. In this paper, we disentangle these choices and give a unified framework for reasoning about surprisal over arbitrary unit inventories. We argue that surprisal-based analyses should make these choices explicit and treat tokenization as an implementation detail rather than a scientific primitive.
papers.abstract_zh: 惊讶理论将人类的处理努力与即将出现的语言单位的可预测性联系起来，但实证研究往往未能对“单位”这一概念进行明确界定。在实践中，实验刺激被分割成具有语言意义的单位（例如单词），而预训练的语言模型则为一个固定的标记字母表分配概率权重，而这个字母表通常与这些单位并不一致。因此，基于惊讶度的预测器隐含地依赖于一些临时性的方法，这些方法将两种不同的建模选择混在一起：分析单位的定义以及评估预测的感兴趣区域的选择。在本文中，我们将这些选择区分开来，并提供了一个统一的框架，用于推理任意单位集合上的惊讶度问题。我们认为，基于惊讶度的分析应该明确这些选择，并将标记化过程视为一个实现细节，而不是一个科学上的基本要素。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ThreadSumm: Summarization of Nested Discourse Threads Using Tree of Thoughts
papers.title_zh: ThreadSumm：利用思维树对嵌套式对话线程进行总结
papers.authors: Olubusayo Olabisi, Ekata Mitra, Ameeta Agrawal
papers.abstract: Summarizing deeply nested discussion threads requires handling interleaved replies, quotes, and overlapping topics, which standard LLM summarizers struggle to capture reliably. We introduce ThreadSumm, a multi-stage LLM framework that treats thread summarization as a hierarchical reasoning problem over explicit aspect and content unit representations. Our method first performs content planning via LLM-based extraction of discourse aspects and Atomic Content Units, then applies sentence ordering to construct thread-aware sequences that surface multiple viewpoints rather than a single linear strand. On top of these interpretable units, ThreadSumm employs a Tree of Thoughts search that generates and scores multiple paragraph candidates, jointly optimizing coherence and coverage within a unified search space. With this multi-proposal and iterative refinement design, we show improved performance in generating logically structured summaries compared to existing baselines, while achieving higher aspect retention and opinion coverage in nested discussions.
papers.abstract_zh: 要总结深层嵌套的讨论线程，需要处理相互交织的回复、引用以及重叠的主题。标准的LLM摘要工具在捕捉这些细节方面存在困难。我们提出了ThreadSumm这一多阶段LLM框架，它将线程总结视为一个基于层次化推理的问题，需要处理明确的主题和内容单元表示。我们的方法首先通过基于LLM的提取技术来规划内容，然后运用句子排序技巧来构建能够呈现多种观点的序列，而不是单一的线性结构。除了这些可解释的内容单元之外，ThreadSumm还采用了“思维树”搜索算法，该算法能够生成多个段落候选方案，并在统一的搜索空间中同时优化连贯性和覆盖范围。通过这种多提案和迭代优化的设计，我们证明了与现有基线相比，该方法在生成逻辑结构清晰的摘要方面表现更优，同时在嵌套讨论中能够更好地保留相关信息和观点。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: InquireMobile: Teaching VLM-based Mobile Agent to Request Human Assistance via Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: InquireMobile：通过强化学习训练，教授基于VLM的移动代理请求人类协助的功能
papers.authors: Qihang Ai, Pi Bu, Yue Cao, Yingyao Wang, Jihao Gu, Jingxuan Xing, Zekun Zhu, Wei Jiang, Zhicheng Zheng, Jun Song, Yuning Jiang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled mobile agents to perceive and interact with real-world mobile environments based on human instructions. However, the current fully autonomous paradigm poses potential safety risks when model understanding or reasoning capabilities are insufficient. To address this challenge, we first introduce InquireBench, a comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate mobile agents’ capabilities in safe interaction and proactive inquiry with users, encompassing 5 categories and 22 sub-categories, where most existing VLM-based agents demonstrate near-zero performance. In this paper, we aim to develop an interactive system that actively seeks human confirmation at critical decision points. To achieve this, we propose InquireMobile, a novel model inspired by reinforcement learning, featuring a two-stage training strategy and an interactive pre-action reasoning mechanism. Finally, our model achieves an 46.8% improvement in inquiry success rate and the best overall success rate among existing baselines on InquireBench. The project page is available at https://bit-aqh.github.io/InquireMobile/homepage/.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，视觉-语言模型在性能上取得了显著进步，使得移动代理能够基于人类指令感知和交互现实世界中的移动环境。然而，当模型的理解或推理能力不足时，目前完全自主的运作方式可能会带来安全隐患。为了应对这一挑战，我们首先介绍了InquireBench这个全面的基准测试平台，该平台专门用于评估移动代理在与用户进行安全交互和主动询问方面的能力。InquireBench涵盖了5个类别和22个子类别，而大多数现有的基于视觉-语言模型的代理在其中的表现几乎为零。在本文中，我们的目标是开发一个能够在关键决策点主动寻求人类确认的互动系统。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了InquireMobile这一新型模型，它借鉴了强化学习的方法，采用了两阶段训练策略以及交互式预行动推理机制。最终，我们的模型在查询成功率上实现了46.8%的提升，并且在InquireBench上的现有基准测试中取得了最佳的整体成功率。该项目的页面可以在https://bit-aqh.github.io/InquireMobile/homepage/查看。

papers.title: Token-Level Policy Optimization: Linking Group-Level Rewards to Token-Level Aggregation via sequence-level likelihood
papers.title_zh: 令牌级策略优化：通过序列级概率模型将组级奖励与令牌级聚合结果联系起来
papers.authors: Xingyu Lin, Yilin Wen, Du Su, En Wang, Wenbin Liu, Zhonghou Lv, Jinchang Hou, Chenfu Bao
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has significantly advanced the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), particularly in their mathemat- ical reasoning performance. However, GRPO and related entropy regularization methods still struggle with token-level sparse-rewards, which is an inherent challenge in chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. These approaches often rely on undifferentiated token-level entropy regu- larization, which easily leads to entropy collapse or model degradation under sparse token rewards. In this work, we propose TEPO, a novel token-level framework that (1) leverages sequence-level likelihood to link group-level rewards with individual tokens via token-level aggregation, and (2) introduces a token-level KL-Divergence mask constraint that targets tokens with positive advantages and decreasing entropy to mitigate abrupt policy updates. Experiments demonstrate that TEPO not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks but also markedly enhances training stability, reducing convergence time by 50% compared with GRPO/DAPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 群体相对策略优化（GRPO）显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，尤其是在数学推理方面。然而，GRPO及相关熵正则化方法在处理基于令牌的稀疏奖励问题时仍然存在困难，而这正是思维链推理中的一个固有挑战。这些方法通常依赖于单一的令牌级熵正则化方式，这种方式在稀疏令牌奖励的情况下容易导致熵崩溃或模型性能下降。在这项研究中，我们提出了TEPO这一新颖的令牌级框架：该框架能够（1）利用序列级概率来通过令牌级聚合将群体级奖励与单个令牌联系起来；（2）引入令牌级KL散度掩码约束，以针对具有正优势且熵逐渐降低的令牌，从而减轻策略更新的突然性影响。实验表明，TEPO不仅在数学推理基准测试中取得了领先的性能表现，还显著提升了训练稳定性，与GRPO/DAPO相比，其收敛时间缩短了50%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: De-Anonymization at Scale via Tournament-Style Attribution
papers.title_zh: 通过锦标赛式归因技术实现大规模的去匿名化处理
papers.authors: Lirui Zhang, Huishuai Zhang
papers.abstract: As LLMs rapidly advance and enter real-world use, their privacy implications are increasingly important. We study an authorship de-anonymization threat: using LLMs to link anonymous documents to their authors, potentially compromising settings such as double-blind peer review. We propose De-Anonymization at Scale (DAS), a large-language-model–based method for attributing authorship among tens of thousands of candidate texts. DAS uses a sequential progression strategy: it randomly partitions the candidate corpus into fixed-size groups, prompts an LLM to select the text most likely written by the same author as a query text, and iteratively re-queries the surviving candidates to produce a ranked top-k list. To make this practical at scale, DAS adds a dense-retrieval prefilter to shrink the search space and a majority-voting–style aggregation over multiple independent runs to improve robustness and ranking precision. Experiments on anonymized review data show DAS can recover same-author texts from pools of tens of thousands with accuracy well above chance, demonstrating a realistic privacy risk for anonymous platforms. On standard authorship benchmarks (Enron emails and blog posts), DAS also improves both accuracy and scalability over prior approaches, highlighting a new LLM-enabled de-anonymization vulnerability.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型迅速发展并进入实际应用领域，其隐私问题变得越来越重要。我们研究了一种作者身份去匿名化威胁：利用大语言模型将匿名文档与其作者联系起来，这可能会破坏诸如双盲同行评审等学术机制。我们提出了“大规模去匿名化”方法（De-Anonymization at Scale，DAS），这是一种基于大语言模型的方法，用于为数万份候选文本确定作者身份。DAS采用一种逐步处理策略：首先将候选语料库随机划分为固定大小的组，然后引导大语言模型选择与查询文本可能为同一作者所写的内容，接着对剩余的候选文本进行迭代查询，最终得出排名前k的列表。为了在实际中大规模应用DAS，我们采用了一种密集检索预过滤器来缩小搜索范围，并通过多次独立运行的方式实现多数投票式的聚合处理，以提高系统的鲁棒性和排序精度。在匿名评论数据的实验表明，DAS能够从数万份文本中准确识别出同一作者的文本，其准确率远高于随机水平，这揭示了匿名平台面临的现实隐私风险。在标准的作者身份评估任务上（如Enron公司的电子邮件和博客文章），DAS在准确性和可扩展性方面均优于以往的方法，从而凸显了由大语言模型带来的新的去匿名化漏洞。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Cross-Modal Masked Compositional Concept Modeling for Enhancing Visio-Linguistic Compositionality
papers.title_zh: 跨模态掩蔽组合概念建模，旨在提升视觉与语言之间的复合性关系
papers.authors: Wei Li, Zhen Huang, Xinmei Tian
papers.abstract: Contrastively trained vision-language models like CLIP, have made remarkable progress in learning joint image-text representations, but still face challenges in compositional understanding. They often exhibit a “bag-of-words” behavior—struggling to capture the object relations, attribute-object bindings, and word order dependencies. This limitation arises not only from the reliance on global, single-vector representations for optimization, but also from the insufficient exploitation and modeling of the rich compositional information inherently present in paired image text data. In this work, we propose MACCO (MAsked Compositional Concept MOdeling), a framework that masks compositional concepts in one modality and reconstructs them conditioned on the full contextual information from the other, enabling the model to capture and align cross-modal compositional structures more effectively. To facilitate this process, we introduce two auxiliary objectives that jointly align and regularize masked features both inter-modally and intra-modally. Extensive experiments on five compositional benchmarks, along with in-depth analyses, demonstrate that our approach not only significantly enhances compositionality in VLMs but also improves their ability to capture syntactic structure and linguistic information. Additionally, the improved compositionality also benefits text-to-image generation and multimodal large language model.
papers.abstract_zh: 像CLIP这样的对比训练视觉-语言模型在学习图像-文本联合表示方面取得了显著进展，但在组合理解方面仍然存在挑战。它们往往表现出“词袋”行为——难以捕捉对象关系、属性与对象的绑定以及词序依赖关系。这种局限性不仅源于优化过程中对全局单一向量表示的依赖，还源于未能充分利用和建模成对图像文本数据中固有的丰富组合信息。在这项研究中，我们提出了MACCO（被问组合概念建模）框架，该框架会屏蔽一种模态中的组合概念，并根据另一种模态中的完整上下文信息来重构这些概念，从而使模型能够更有效地捕捉和对齐跨模态组合结构。为了促进这一过程，我们引入了两个辅助目标，这两个目标可以共同对齐并规范被屏蔽特征在跨模态和模态内部的关系。在五个组合基准测试上的广泛实验以及深入分析表明，我们的方法不仅显著提升了视觉语言模型中的组合性，还提高了它们捕捉句法结构和语言信息的能力。此外，这种改进的组合性也有助于文本到图像的生成以及多模态大语言模型的性能提升。

papers.title: StratMem-Bench: Evaluating Strategic Memory Use in Virtual Character Conversation Beyond Factual Recall
papers.title_zh: StratMem-Bench：评估虚拟角色对话中的战略性记忆运用能力，涵盖事实回忆方面的表现
papers.authors: Yerong Wu, Tianxing Wu, Minghao Zhu, Hangyu Sha, Haofen Wang
papers.abstract: Achieving realistic human-like conversation for virtual characters requires not only a simple memorization and recall of past events, but also the strategic utilization of memory to meet factual needs and social engagement. Current memory utilization relevant (e.g., memory-augmented generation, long-term dialogue, and etc.) benchmarks overlook this nuance, treating memory primarily as a static repository of facts rather than a dynamic resource to be strategically deployed in dialogues. To address this gap, we design StratMem-Bench, a new benchmark to evaluate strategic memory use in character-centric dialogues. This dataset comprises 657 instances where virtual characters must navigate heterogeneous memory pools containing required, supportive, and irrelevant memories. We also propose a framework with different evaluation metrics including Strict Memory Compliance, Memory Integration Quality, Proactive Enrichment Score and Conditional Irrelevance Rate, and to evaluate strategic memory use capabilities of virtual characters. Experiments on StratMem-Bench which leverage the state-of-the-art large language models as virtual characters show that all models perform well at distinguishing between required and irrelevant memories, but struggle once supportive memories are introduced into the decision process.
papers.abstract_zh: 要为虚拟角色实现逼真的人类式对话，不仅需要简单地记忆和回忆过去的事件，还需要战略性地利用记忆来满足事实需求和社会互动的需求。目前相关的记忆利用评估标准（如记忆增强生成、长期对话等）忽略了这一细节，它们将记忆主要视为一个静态的事实存储库，而不是可以在对话中策略性使用的动态资源。为了弥补这一不足，我们设计了StratMem-Bench这一新的评估标准，用于评估角色中心对话中的战略性记忆使用能力。该数据集包含657个实例，其中虚拟角色需要处理包含必要、辅助性和无关记忆的异构记忆池。我们还提出了一个包含多种评估指标的框架，包括严格记忆合规性、记忆整合质量、主动丰富得分以及条件无关率，以评估虚拟角色的战略性记忆使用能力。在StratMem-Bench上的实验表明，所有模型都能很好地区分必要记忆和无关记忆，但在决策过程中引入辅助记忆时表现不佳。

papers.title: RLSeek: Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for RAG Hallucination Detection
papers.title_zh: RLSeek：基于证据的推理方法，用于RAG幻觉检测
papers.authors: Zhaoheng Huang, Dacheng Wen, Yutao Zhu, Xiaoying Lian, Yushi Liang, Kai Hao, Nan Li, Liangjie Zhang, Qi Zhang, Ji-Rong Wen, Zhicheng Dou, Fangzhao Wu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) in retrieval-augmented generation systems can still produce hallucinations, generating content that is unsupported or contradicted by the source texts and undermines reliability. Recent work addressed this problem by training span-level hallucination detectors using reinforcement learning (RL) and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. In this work, we show through error analysis that incorrect predictions by existing reasoning-based detectors are strongly associated with CoT processes that lack explicit grounding in source evidence, particularly when verification steps do not quote or verify claims against the retrieved documents. This behaviour contrasts with human verification practices in benchmarks such as RAGTruth, where evidence quotation is a prerequisite for determining hallucinated spans. Motivated by this observation, we propose an evidence-grounded RL framework, namely RLSeek, to explicitly enforce active evidence seeking during CoT reasoning by requiring quotation of relevant source segments at each verification step. Experiments on the RAGTruth and NewsSum dataset demonstrate consistent improvements in hallucination span detection performance, with limited additional reasoning overhead and improved robustness in out-of-domain settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 在基于检索增强的生成系统中，大语言模型仍可能产生幻觉，生成的内容往往与源文本不符或相互矛盾，从而降低了内容的可靠性。最近的研究通过利用强化学习和上下文推理技术来训练跨段幻觉检测算法，以解决这一问题。我们的研究表明，现有基于推理的检测器所做出的错误预测，往往与那些缺乏明确依据、无法准确引用源材料的上下文推理过程有关。这种行为与人类在RAGTruth等基准测试中的验证方式不同，后者要求必须引用相关材料才能判断某个段落是否产生了幻觉。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种以证据为基础的强化学习框架——RLSeek，该框架要求在每次验证步骤中都引用相关的源材料，从而强制在上下文推理过程中主动寻找可靠的证据。在RAGTruth和NewsSum数据集上的实验表明，该框架在幻觉段落检测方面取得了显著的改进，同时减少了额外的推理负担，并提高了其在非领域场景下的鲁棒性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: CO-EVO: Co-evolving Semantic Anchoring and Style Diversification for Federated DG-ReID
papers.title_zh: CO-EVO：协同进化语义锚定与风格多样化技术，适用于联邦式目标检测与图像识别系统
papers.authors: Fengchunzhang, Qiang Ma, Liuyu Xiang, Jinshan Lai, Tingxuan Huang, Jianwei Hu
papers.abstract: Federated domain generalization for person re-identification (FedDG-ReID) aims to collaboratively train a pedestrian retrieval model across multiple decentralized source domains such that it can generalize to unseen target environments without compromising raw data privacy. However, this task is significantly challenged by the inherent stylistic gaps across decentralized clients. Without global supervision, models easily succumb to shortcut learning where representations overfit to domain specific camera biases rather than universal identity features. We propose CO-EVO, a novel federated framework that resolves this semantic-style conflict through a co-evolutionary mechanism. On the semantic side, Camera-Invariant Semantic Anchoring (CSA) learns identity prompts with cross-camera consistency to establish purified and domain-agnostic anchors that filter out local imaging noise. On the visual side, Global Style Diversification (GSD), powered by a Global Camera-Style Bank (GCSB), synthesizes realistic perturbations to expand the visual boundaries of training data. The core of CO-EVO is its co-evolutionary loop where purified anchors act as gravitational centers to guide the image encoder toward robust anatomical attributes amidst diverse style variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CO-EVO achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, proving that the synergy between semantic purification and style expansion is essential for robust cross-domain generalization. Our code is available at: https://github.com/NanYiyuzurn/ACL-LGPS-2026.
papers.abstract_zh: 联合域泛化用于人物识别（FedDG-ReID）的目标是在多个分散的源域中协同训练一个行人检索模型，使其能够在不侵犯原始数据隐私的情况下泛化到未知的目标环境。然而，由于各个分散客户端之间存在固有的风格差异，这一任务面临着巨大的挑战。在没有全局监督的情况下，模型容易陷入捷径学习，即表示特征过度拟合于特定领域的相机偏见，而非通用的身份特征。我们提出了CO-EVO这一新型联合框架，它通过一种共同演化机制来解决这种语义与风格之间的冲突。在语义层面，Camera-Invariant Semantic Anchoring（CSA）技术通过跨相机一致性学习来构建纯净且不受领域影响的锚点，从而过滤掉局部成像噪声。在视觉层面，由Global Camera-Style Bank（GCSB）支持的Global Style Diversification（GSD）技术能够合成逼真的扰动图像，从而扩展训练数据的视觉边界。CO-EVO的核心是其共同演化循环机制，其中纯净的锚点作为引力中心，引导图像编码器在多样化的风格变化中找到稳健的解剖学特征。大量实验表明，CO-EVO取得了最先进的性能，这证明了语义净化与风格扩展之间的协同作用对于实现稳健的跨域泛化至关重要。我们的代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/NanYiyuzurn/ACL-LGPS-2026
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Discovering Properties of Inflectional Morphology in Neural Emergent Communication
papers.title_zh: 探索神经突发通信中形态变化的特性
papers.authors: Miles Gilberti, Shane Storks, Huteng Dai
papers.abstract: Emergent communication (EmCom) with deep neural network-based agents promises to yield insights into the nature of human language, but remains focused primarily on a few subfield-specific goals and metrics that prioritize communication schemes which represent attributes with unique characters one-to-one and compose them syntactically. We thus reinterpret a common EmCom setting, the attribute-value reconstruction game, by imposing a small-vocabulary constraint to simulate double articulation, and formulating a novel setting analogous to naturalistic inflectional morphology (enabling meaningful comparison to natural language communication schemes). We develop new metrics and explore variations of this game motivated by real properties of inflectional morphology: concatenativity and fusion. Through our experiments, we discover that simulated phonological constraints encourage concatenative morphology, and emergent languages replicate the tendency of natural languages to fuse grammatical attributes.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于深度神经网络的涌现通信机制有望揭示人类语言的本质，但其研究主要聚焦于一些特定子领域的目标和指标，这些目标和指标着重于那些能够一一对应地表示属性并将它们以句法方式组合起来的通信方案。因此，我们对常见的涌现通信场景——属性-值重构游戏进行了重新定义：通过引入小词汇量的限制来模拟双重表述机制，并构建了一个类似于自然语言屈折形态学的新型场景，从而能够与自然语言通信方案进行有意义的比较。我们提出了新的评估指标，并探讨了基于屈折形态学实际特性的各种变体，比如连接性和融合性。通过实验我们发现，模拟的语音约束会促进连接性强的形态学发展，而涌现出的语言则体现了自然语言在语法属性融合方面的倾向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Label Effects: Shared Heuristic Reliance in Trust Assessment by Humans and LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.title_zh: 标签效应：人类与大型语言模型在信任评估中的共同启发式依赖
papers.authors: Xin Sun, Di Wu, Sijing Qin, Isao Echizen, Abdallah El Ali, Saku Sugawara
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated evaluators (LLM-as-a-Judge). This work challenges its reliability by showing that trust judgments by LLMs are biased by disclosed source labels. Using a counterfactual design, we find that both humans and LLM judges assign higher trust to information labeled as human-authored than to the same content labeled as AI-generated. Eye-tracking data reveal that humans rely heavily on source labels as heuristic cues for judgments. We analyze LLM internal states during judgment. Across label conditions, models allocate denser attention to the label region than the content region, and this label dominance is stronger under Human labels than AI labels, consistent with the human gaze patterns. Besides, decision uncertainty measured by logits is higher under AI labels than Human labels. These results indicate that the source label is a salient heuristic cue for both humans and LLMs. It raises validity concerns for label-sensitive LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, and we cautiously raise that aligning models with human preferences may propagate human heuristic reliance into models, motivating debiased evaluation and alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作自动化评估工具。本研究通过研究表明，LLM的评估结果存在偏见，这种偏见源于所公开的来源标签。利用反事实设计方法，我们发现无论是人类还是LLM评估者，都会将标记为人类创作的信息的信任度视为高于同样内容但被标记为人工智能生成的信息。眼动追踪数据表明，人类在做出判断时严重依赖来源标签作为启发式线索。我们分析了LLM在评估过程中的内部状态。在不同标签条件下，模型对标签区域的关注程度高于内容区域，而在人类标签下这种标签优势更为明显，这与人类的注视模式一致。此外，通过逻辑值测量的决策不确定性在人工智能标签下比人类标签下更高。这些结果表明，来源标签对于人类和LLM来说都是重要的启发式线索。这引发了关于基于标签的LLM评估有效性的担忧，我们谨慎地认为，将模型与人类偏好对齐可能会让人类依赖的启发式思维模式渗透到模型中，因此需要开展无偏见评估和模型对齐工作。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Self-SoftCoT: A Self-Consistent Framework via Position-Aware Latent Space Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 自适应性SoftCoT：一种通过位置感知的潜在空间强化学习实现的自洽框架
papers.authors: Liangliang Dong, Lianlei Shan, Shuaimin Li
papers.abstract: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning empowers Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex tasks, its reliance on discrete token decoding imposes an inherent Discreteness Bottleneck, limiting expressiveness within a restricted vocabulary space. Existing continuous reasoning approaches, such as SoftCoT, mitigate this but typically rely on external auxiliary models, resulting in complex deployment and fractured inference pipelines. To address these challenges, we propose Self-SoftCoT, a self-contained framework that enables a frozen LLM to internally generate and consume latent thoughts without external assistants. By establishing a single-stream “Thinking → Speaking” closed-loop, we decouple latent planning from explicit generation. Furthermore, we adopt Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) to stabilize learning and employ Position-Aware Independent Projection to mitigate representation homogenization. Experimental results on five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly improves the reasoning performance of frozen LLMs. Specifically, our Qwen2.5-based model uses only N=2 soft tokens to outperform the SoftCoT baseline (N=4), improving the average accuracy from 75.06% to 78.42%. Similarly, LLaMA-3.1 performance increases from 70.52% to 74.55%.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然思维链推理能力使得大语言模型能够应对复杂任务，但其对离散令牌解码的依赖导致了固有的离散性瓶颈问题，这限制了模型在有限词汇空间内的表达能力。现有的连续推理方法，如SoftCoT，可以一定程度上缓解这一问题，但它们通常依赖于外部辅助模型，从而导致部署复杂且推理流程分散的问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Self-SoftCoT这一独立框架。该框架使冻结的语言模型能够在没有外部协助的情况下内部生成和表达潜在的思想。通过建立一个“思考→表达”的单流闭环机制，我们将潜在规划与显式生成分离开来。此外，我们采用群体序列策略优化技术来稳定学习过程，并利用位置感知的独立投影方法来避免表示的一致性问题。在五个推理基准测试中的实验结果表明，我们的方法显著提升了冻结语言模型的推理性能。具体来说，基于Qwen2.5的模型仅使用N=2个软令牌就能超越SoftCoT基线模型（需要N=4个软令牌），其平均准确率从75.06%提升到了78.42%。同样，LaMA-3.1的性能也从70.52%提升到了74.55%。

papers.title: Bayesian Social Deduction with Graph-Informed Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于图信息的贝叶斯社会推理与语言模型
papers.authors: Shahab Rahimirad, Guven Gergerli, Lucia Romero, Angela Qian, Matthew Lyle Olson, Simon Stepputtis, Joseph Campbell
papers.abstract: Social reasoning—inferring unobservable beliefs and intentions from partial observations of other agents—remains a challenging task for large language models (LLMs). We evaluate the limits of current reasoning language models in the social deduction game Avalon and find that while the largest models demonstrate strong performance, they require extensive test-time inference and degrade sharply when distilled to smaller, real-time-capable variants. To address this, we introduce a hybrid reasoning framework that externalizes belief inference to a structured probabilistic model, while using an LLM for language understanding and interaction. Our approach achieves competitive performance with much larger models in Agent-Agent play and, notably, is the first language agent to defeat human players in a controlled study—achieving a 67% win rate and receiving higher qualitative ratings than both reasoning baselines and human teammates. We release code, models, and a dataset to support future work on social reasoning in LLM agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 社会推理——从对其他个体的部分观察中推断出他们不可观测的信念和意图——对于大语言模型来说仍然是一个具有挑战性的任务。我们通过在社交推理游戏Avalon中对当前推理语言模型的性能进行评估，发现虽然最大的模型表现非常出色，但它们需要大量的推理时间，并且在被压缩为更小、支持实时运行的版本时性能会显著下降。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种混合推理框架：将信念推理功能外部化到结构化的概率模型中，同时使用语言模型来进行语言理解和交互。我们的方法在代理对代理的游戏中能够使用更大规模的模型获得具有竞争力的性能。值得注意的是，我们成为第一个在受控研究中击败人类玩家的语言模型——我们的胜率达到了67%，并且获得了比现有推理基准模型和人类队友更高的评价。我们还发布了相关代码、模型和数据集，以支持未来关于LLM代理社会推理的研究工作。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Routing with Generated Data: Annotation-Free LLM Skill Estimation and Expert Selection
papers.title_zh: 基于生成数据的路由算法：无需注释的LLM技能评估与专家选择
papers.authors: Tianyi Niu, Justin Chen, Genta Indra Winata, Shi-Xiong Zhang, Supriyo Chakraborty, Sambit Sahu, Yue Zhang, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Mohit Bansal
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) routers dynamically select optimal models for given inputs. Existing approaches typically assume access to ground-truth labeled data, which is often unavailable in practice, especially when user request distributions are heterogeneous and unknown. We introduce Routing with Generated Data (RGD), a challenging setting in which routers are trained exclusively on generated queries and answers produced from high-level task descriptions by generator LLMs. We evaluate query-answer routers (using both queries and labels) and query-only routers across four diverse benchmarks and 12 models, finding that query-answer routers degrade faster than query-only routers as generator quality decreases. Our analysis reveals two crucial characteristics of effective generators: they must accurately respond to their own questions, and their questions must produce sufficient performance differentiation among the model pool. We then show how filtering for these characteristics can improve the quality of generated data. We further propose CASCAL, a novel query-only router that estimates model correctness through consensus voting and identifies model-specific skill niches via hierarchical clustering. CASCAL is substantially more robust to generator quality, outperforming the best query-answer router by 4.6% absolute accuracy when trained on weak generator data.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型路由器能够动态为给定的输入选择最优的模型。现有的方法通常假设可以获取带有标签的真实数据，但在实际中这种数据往往难以获得，特别是当用户请求的分布具有异质性且未知时。我们提出了“基于生成数据的路由”方法，这是一种具有挑战性的设置：路由器仅基于由生成式语言模型根据高级任务描述生成的查询和答案进行训练。我们在四个不同的基准测试中对查询-回答路由器（同时使用查询和标签）以及仅查询路由器进行了评估，发现随着生成器质量的下降，查询-回答路由器的性能下降速度比仅查询路由器更快。我们的分析揭示了有效生成器的两个关键特性：它们必须能够准确回应自己的问题，并且这些问题必须在模型池中产生足够的性能差异。接着，我们展示了如何通过筛选这些特性来提高生成数据的质量。我们还提出了CASCAL这一新型仅查询路由器，它通过共识投票来估计模型的准确性，并通过层次聚类来识别特定于模型的技能领域。CASCAL对生成器质量的鲁棒性明显更强，在训练于较弱的生成器数据的情况下，其绝对准确率比最好的查询-回答路由器高出4.6%。

papers.title: Injecting Context via Situation Working Memory for Logical Reasoning with LLMs
papers.title_zh: 通过情境工作记忆来注入上下文信息，以支持与大型语言模型进行逻辑推理
papers.authors: Jieun Kim, Seoha Lim, YoungHae Choi, Sung-Bae Cho
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved logical reasoning by injecting formal logic or explicit structured representations. However, such methods often lose track of what is true now in multi-step reasoning, failing to maintain a coherent global state and its logical consequences. Motivated by Situation Model Theory in cognitive psychology, which views comprehension as constructing and updating a mental model of events along key dimensions (time, space, causality, intention, protagonist), we propose Situation Working Memory (SituW), a cognitively inspired method for contextual reasoning in LLMs. SituW first builds a situation representation by decomposing text along these five dimensions, then guides LLM inference with this evolving state. Keeping an explicit, dynamically updated situation memory instead of a static logical form encourages globally consistent reasoning over the situation model rather than raw text. Evaluated in both supervised and unsupervised settings, SituW improves accuracy by 23.3%p and 15.93%p while reducing “uncertain” predictions, suggesting that explicit situation modeling supports more globally consistent LLM reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展通过引入形式逻辑或明确的结构化表示，提升了逻辑推理能力。然而，这类方法在多步骤推理过程中常常无法准确判断事物的真实性，难以维持一个连贯的全局状态及其逻辑后果。受认知心理学中的情境模型理论的启发，该理论将理解过程视为根据时间、空间、因果关系、意图以及主角等关键维度构建和更新事件的心理模型。因此，我们提出了情境工作记忆（SituW）这一基于认知原理的上下文推理方法。SituW首先通过将这些维度分解为文本来构建情境表示，然后利用这一不断变化的情境状态来指导语言模型的推理过程。采用动态更新的情境记忆而非静态的逻辑形式，能够使得对情境模型的推理更加一致，而不是仅仅依赖于原始文本。在监督和非监督两种环境下进行的评估表明，SituW分别提高了23.3%和15.93%的准确率，同时减少了“不确定”的预测结果，这表明明确的情境建模有助于实现更一致的语言模型推理。

papers.title: ProMed: Shapley Information Gain Guided Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Medical LLMs
papers.title_zh: ProMed：基于沙普利信息增益的强化学习，用于先进的医疗大型语言模型
papers.authors: Hongxin Ding, Baixiang Huang, Yue Fang, Weibin Liao, Xinke Jiang, Jinyang Zhang, Yinghao Zhu, Zheng Li, Liantao Ma, Junfeng Zhao, Yasha Wang
papers.abstract: Interactive medical questioning is essential in clinical consultations, where physicians must actively gather necessary patient information. Yet existing medical Large Language Models (LLMs) predominantly follow a reactive paradigm, risking diagnostic errors by answering before seeking sufficient details. To bridge this gap, we propose ProMed, a reinforcement learning framework that transitions LLMs toward a proactive paradigm, enabling them to ask clinically valuable questions before decision-making. Central to ProMed is the Shapley Information Gain (SIG) reward, which quantifies a question’s clinical utility as the amount of newly acquired information, while considering its contextual importance via Shapley values. We integrate SIG into a two-stage training pipeline: (1) SIG-Guided Model Initialization uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to construct high-reward interaction trajectories for supervision, and (2) SIG-Augmented Policy Optimization, with a novel SIG-guided Reward Distribution Mechanism that prioritizes informative questions for fine-grained optimization. Experiments on partial-information medical benchmarks show that ProMed significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 6.29% on average and delivers a 54.45% gain over the reactive paradigm, and generalizes robustly to out-of-domain cases. Our codes are available at https://github.com/hxxding/ProMed.
papers.abstract_zh: 在临床咨询中，互动式医学提问至关重要，医生必须积极收集必要的患者信息。然而，现有的大语言模型大多采用反应式模式，在获取足够细节之前就进行回答，这容易导致诊断错误。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ProMed框架——一个强化学习框架，它使语言模型能够转向主动式模式，从而在决策之前提出具有临床价值的问题。ProMed的核心技术是Shapley信息增益奖励机制，该机制通过Shapley值来衡量问题的临床价值，即新获得的信息量。我们将Shapley信息增益机制整合到两阶段训练流程中：(1) Shapley信息增益引导的模型初始化阶段，使用蒙特卡洛树搜索方法来构建高回报的互动路径作为监督手段；(2) 结合Shapley信息增益的策略优化阶段，采用一种新颖的Shapley信息增益引导奖励分配机制，优先处理具有信息量的问题以实现精细化的优化。在部分信息医学基准测试中的实验表明，ProMed的平均性能比现有方法高出6.29%，与反应式模式相比提升了54.45%的性能，并且能够在不同领域的情况下保持稳定表现。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/hxxding/ProMed下载。

papers.title: SafeAgent: Safeguarding LLM Agents via an Automated Risk Simulator
papers.title_zh: SafeAgent：通过自动化风险模拟器来保护大型语言模型代理
papers.authors: Xueyang Zhou, Weidong Wang, Lin Lu, Jiawen Shi, Guiyao Tie, Xu Yongtian, Lixing Chen, Pan Zhou, Neil Zhenqiang Gong, Lichao Sun
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents are rapidly being deployed in real-world applications (e.g., digital assistants and customer service), making safety a critical concern. However, in multi-turn, tool-augmented settings, dynamic user interactions, external tool use, and unintended harmful behaviors make robust safety assurance challenging. To address these challenges, we propose SafeAgent, a framework that improves agent safety through fully automated synthetic data generation. SafeAgent introduces (1) an open and extensible threat model OTS that decomposes agent risk into instruction-, context-, and action-induced sources to ground safety analysis and alignment; and (2) an automated pipeline that instantiates OTS to surface scenario-specific failure modes, stress-test agents, and generate self-reflective safe responses—without hazardous real-world data collection. We evaluate SafeAgent on two safety benchmarks and one real-world terminal task. Across four widely used open-source models, SafeAgent improves safety performance by 45% on average and delivers a 28.91% gain on the real-world task, outperforming state-of-the-art closed-source models. These results highlight the practical advancement and scalability of SafeAgent in building safer LLM agents for real-world deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体正在被迅速应用于现实世界中的各种场景（例如数字助手和客户服务），因此安全性成为一个至关重要的考虑因素。然而，在需要多轮交互、工具辅助的环境里，动态的用户行为、外部工具的使用以及非预期的有害行为都使得确保智能体的安全性变得非常困难。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SafeAgent这一框架。该框架通过完全自动化的合成数据生成来提升智能体的安全性。SafeAgent包含两个部分：第一部分是开放且可扩展的威胁模型OTS，它将智能体的风险分解为由指令、上下文和行为引起的各种因素，从而为安全分析和对齐提供基础；第二部分是一个自动化流程，该流程利用OTS来识别特定场景下的故障模式、对智能体进行压力测试，并生成具有自我反思性质的安全响应——而无需收集危险的现实世界数据。我们在两个安全基准测试和一个现实世界终端任务上对SafeAgent进行了评估。在四个广泛使用的开源模型中，SafeAgent平均提升了45%的安全性性能，在现实世界任务上的表现更是提升了28.91%，其效果优于最先进的闭源模型。这些结果充分证明了SafeAgent在构建更安全的用于现实世界部署的大语言模型智能体方面的实用性和可扩展性。

papers.title: Diagnosing Hidden Instabilities in Model Editing via Uncertainty Quantification
papers.title_zh: 通过不确定性量化来识别模型编辑过程中的隐藏不稳定性
papers.authors: Zihan Gu, TianYi Zhang, Xinyan Zhang, Zhiyuan Wang, Han Zhang, Yuhao Wei, Jiacheng Lu, Tianyi Ma, Xingsheng Zhang, Hua Zhang, Yue Hu
papers.abstract: Model editing provides a promising mechanism for updating large language models (LLMs) without expensive retraining. Existing approaches, particularly locate-and-edit methods based on least-squares optimization, aim to introduce targeted knowledge changes while preserving pre-trained behavior. In this work, we show that this objective is fundamentally fragile under standard single-edit evaluation protocols. We first develop a unified theoretical framework that characterizes activation-based editing as a constrained intervention on intermediate representations. Within this framework, we demonstrate that least-squares edits cannot, in general, isolate target updates from unrelated activations, giving rise to unavoidable interference that accumulates with successive edits. Crucially, this degradation can remain undetected in single-edit settings when assessed using conventional success and locality metrics. To expose such hidden instabilities, we introduce an uncertainty-based evaluation protocol that combines structured semantic perturbations with uncertainty quantification based on Sampling with Perturbation for UQ. By measuring edit-induced growth in aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, our method reveals local knowledge conflicts that are invisible to existing benchmarks. Extensive experiments across multiple models, datasets, and editing algorithms show that both least-squares and other parameter-update-based methods consistently increase post-edit uncertainty. Together, our results suggest that current evaluation practices substantially overestimate the reliability of single-edit model editing, and that uncertainty-based diagnostics are necessary for assessing edit stability.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型编辑提供了一种有前景的机制，用于更新大语言模型，而无需进行昂贵的重新训练。现有的方法，尤其是基于最小二乘优化的定位编辑方法，旨在在保留预训练行为的同时引入有针对性的知识变更。然而，我们的研究表明，在标准的单次编辑评估协议中，这一目标存在根本性的脆弱性。我们首先建立了一个统一的理论框架，将基于激活的编辑视为对中间表示的一种约束性干预。在这个框架下，我们证明，一般来说，最小二乘编辑无法将目标更新与无关的激活分离开来，这会导致不可避免的干扰，这种干扰会在连续的编辑过程中不断累积。关键的是，当使用传统的成功度和局部性指标进行评估时，这种退化在单次编辑的情况下可能不会被发现。为了揭示这种隐藏的不稳定性，我们引入了一种基于不确定性的评估协议，该协议结合了结构化的语义扰动和基于采样与扰动的不确定性量化技术。通过测量编辑引起的随机性和认知不确定性变化，我们的方法揭示了现有基准测试无法发现的局部知识冲突。通过在多个模型、数据集和编辑算法上进行的大量实验表明，最小二乘法以及其他基于参数更新的方法都会使编辑后的不确定性增加。总的来说，我们的结果表明，当前的评估方式严重高估了单次编辑模型的可靠性，而基于不确定性的诊断方法对于评估编辑的稳定性是必要的。

papers.title: Alexandria: A Multi-Domain Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation Dataset for Culturally Inclusive and Linguistically Diverse LLMs
papers.title_zh: 亚历山大：一个涵盖多个领域的阿拉伯语方言机器翻译数据集，旨在为文化包容且语言多样化的大型语言模型提供训练资源
papers.authors: Abdellah El Mekki, Samar M. Magdy, Houdaifa Atou, Ruwa AbuHweidi, Baraah Qawasmeh, Omer Nacar, Thikra Al-hibiri, Razan Saadie, Hamzah Alsayadi, Nadia Ghezaiel Hammouda, Alshima Alkhazimi, Aya Hamod, Al-Yas Al-Ghafri, Wesam El-Sayed, Asila Al sharji, Mohamad Ballout, Anas Belfathi, Karim Ghaddar, Serry Sibaee, Alaa Aoun, Areej Asiri, Lina Abureesh, Ahlam Bashiti, Majdal Yousef, Abdulaziz Hafiz, Yehdih Mohamed, Emira Hamedtou, Brakehe Brahim, Rahaf Alhamouri, Youssef Nafea, Aya El Aatar, Walid Al-Dhabyani, Emhemed Hamed, Sara Shatnawi, Fakhraddin Alwajih, Khalid Elkhidir, Ashwag Alasmari, Abdurrahman Gerrio, Omar Alshahri, AbdelRahim A. Elmadany, Ismail Berrada, Amir Azad Adli Alkathiri, Fadi A Zaraket, Mustafa Jarrar, Yahya Mohamed El Hadj, Hassan Alhuzali, Muhammad Abdul-Mageed
papers.abstract: Arabic is a highly diglossic language where most daily communication occurs in regional dialects rather than Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). Despite this, machine translation (MT) systems often generalize poorly to dialectal input, limiting their utility for millions of speakers. We introduce Alexandria, a large-scale, community-driven, human-translated dataset designed to bridge this gap. Alexandria covers 13 Arab countries and 11 high-impact domains, including health, education, and agriculture. Unlike previous resources, Alexandria provides unprecedented granularity by associating contributions with city-of-origin metadata, capturing authentic local varieties beyond coarse regional labels. The dataset consists of parallel English-Dialectal Arabic multi-turn conversational scenarios annotated with speaker-addressee gender configurations, enabling the study of gender-conditioned variation in dialectal use. Comprising 107K total turns, Alexandria serves as both a training resource and as a rigorous benchmark for evaluating MT and Large Language Models (LLMs). Our automatic and human evaluation benchmarks the current capabilities of Arabic-aware LLMs in translating across diverse Arabic dialects and sub-dialects while exposing significant persistent challenges.The Alexandria dataset, the creation prompts, the translation and revision guidelines, and the evaluation code are publicly available in the following repository: https://github.com/UBC-NLP/Alexandria
papers.abstract_zh: 阿拉伯语是一种高度双言语言，大多数日常交流都是用地区方言进行的，而不是使用标准阿拉伯语。尽管如此，机器翻译系统在处理方言输入时往往表现不佳，这限制了它们对数百万使用者的实用性。我们推出了Alexandria数据集，这是一个大规模、由社区主导、由人工翻译而成的数据集，旨在填补这一空白。Alexandria涵盖了13个阿拉伯国家以及11个重要领域，包括健康、教育和农业等。与以往的资源不同，Alexandria通过为每条翻译记录添加来源城市的元数据，提供了前所未有的细节程度，从而能够捕捉到真实的地方性变体，而不仅仅是粗略的地区标签。该数据集包含大量平行英语-方言阿拉伯语对话场景，并标注了说话者-听者性别配置信息，这使得我们可以研究方言使用中受性别影响的变异现象。Alexandria数据集共有10.7万条对话记录，既可以作为训练资源，也可以作为评估机器翻译和大语言模型的严格基准。我们的自动和人类评估结果表明，目前具备阿拉伯语识别能力的大语言模型在跨不同阿拉伯方言进行翻译方面仍存在一定的挑战。Alexandria数据集的创建说明、翻译和修订指南以及评估代码都可以在以下仓库中找到：https://github.com/UBC-NLP/Alexandria

papers.title: Can AI Be a Good Peer Reviewer? A Survey of Peer Review Process, Evaluation, and the Future
papers.title_zh: 人工智能能否成为优秀的同行评审者？关于同行评审流程、评价以及未来发展的调查
papers.authors: Sihong Wu, Owen Jiang, Yilun Zhao, Tiansheng Hu, Yiling Ma, Kaiyan Zhang, Manasi Patwardhan, Arman Cohan
papers.abstract: Peer review is a multi-stage process involving reviews, rebuttals, meta-reviews, final decisions, and subsequent manuscript revisions. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have motivated methods that assist or automate different stages of this pipeline. In this survey, we synthesize techniques for (i) peer review generation, including fine-tuning strategies, agent-based systems, RL-based methods, and emerging paradigms to enhance generation; (ii) after-review tasks including rebuttals, meta-review and revision aligned to reviews; and (iii) evaluation methods spanning human-centered, reference-based, LLM-based and aspect-oriented. We catalog datasets, compare modeling choices, and discuss limitations, ethical concerns, and future directions. The survey aims to provide practical guidance for building, evaluating, and integrating LLM systems across the full peer review workflow.
papers.abstract_zh: 同行评审是一个多阶段的过程，包括审查、反驳、元审查、最终决策以及后续的稿件修改。大语言模型的最新进展促使人们开发出能够辅助或自动化这一流程各阶段的算法。在本综述中，我们总结了以下方面的技术：(1) 同行评审的生成方法，包括微调策略、基于代理的系统、基于强化学习的方法以及用于提升生成效果的新兴范式；(2) 评审后的任务，如反驳、元审查以及与评审相一致的修改工作；(3) 评估方法，涵盖以人为中心、基于参考、基于大语言模型以及面向方面的评估方法。我们还整理了相关数据集，比较了不同的建模方案，并讨论了其中的局限性、伦理问题以及未来的发展方向。本综述旨在为构建、评估以及整合大语言模型系统提供实用指导，使其能够全面参与整个同行评审流程。

papers.title: How Much Would a Clinician Edit This Draft? Evaluating LLM Alignment for Patient Message Response Drafting
papers.title_zh: 医生会对这个草案进行多少修改呢？评估大型语言模型在生成患者信息回复时的准确性
papers.authors: Parker Seegmiller, Joseph Gatto, Sarah E. Greer, Ganza Belise Isingizwe, Rohan Ray, Timothy E. Burdick, Sarah Masud Preum
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in drafting responses to patient portal messages, yet their integration into clinical workflows raises various concerns, including whether they would actually save clinicians time and effort in their portal workload. We investigate LLM alignment with individual clinicians through a comprehensive evaluation of the patient message response drafting task. We develop a novel taxonomy of thematic elements in clinician responses and propose a novel evaluation framework for assessing clinician editing load of LLM-drafted responses at both content and theme levels. We release an expert-annotated dataset and conduct large-scale evaluations of local and commercial LLMs using various adaptation techniques including thematic prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, supervised fine-tuning, and direct preference optimization. Our results reveal substantial epistemic uncertainty in aligning LLM drafts with clinician responses. While LLMs demonstrate capability in drafting certain thematic elements, they struggle with clinician-aligned generation in other themes, particularly question asking to elicit further information from patients. Theme-driven adaptation strategies yield improvements across most themes. Our findings underscore the necessity of adapting LLMs to individual clinician preferences to enable reliable and responsible use in patient-clinician communication workflows.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在撰写患者门户消息的回复方面展现出巨大潜力，然而将其整合到临床工作流程中却引发了一系列问题，包括这些模型是否真的能够减少临床医生在门户工作上的时间和精力消耗。我们通过全面评估患者消息回复的撰写任务，来研究如何使语言模型与个体临床医生进行匹配。我们提出了一种针对临床医生回复中主题元素的新型分类方法，并构建了一个新的评估框架，用于从内容和主题两个层面来评估由语言模型撰写的回复对临床医生编辑工作的负担。我们发布了一个由专家标注的数据集，并使用多种适应技术对本地和商用语言模型进行了大规模评估，这些技术包括主题提示、检索增强生成、监督式微调以及直接偏好优化等。我们的研究结果表明，在使语言模型的草稿与临床医生的回复相匹配方面存在相当大的认知不确定性。虽然语言模型在撰写某些主题元素方面表现出色，但在处理其他主题时却存在困难，尤其是在询问患者以获取更多信息方面。采用以主题为导向的适应策略可以在大多数主题上取得改进。我们的发现强调了调整语言模型以适应个体临床医生的偏好的重要性，这样才能确保在患者与临床医生之间的沟通流程中得到可靠且负责任的运用。

papers.title: MetaBench: A Multi-task Benchmark for Assessing LLMs in Metabolomics
papers.title_zh: MetaBench：一个用于评估大型语言模型在代谢组学领域性能的多任务基准测试平台
papers.authors: Yuxing Lu, Xukai Zhao, J. Ben Tamo, Micky C. Nnamdi, Rui Peng, Shuang Zeng, Xingyu Hu, Jinzhuo Wang, May Dongmei Wang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities on general text; however, their proficiency in specialized scientific domains that require deep, interconnected knowledge remains largely uncharacterized. Metabolomics presents unique challenges with its complex biochemical pathways, heterogeneous identifier systems, and fragmented databases. To systematically evaluate LLM capabilities in this domain, we introduce MetaBench, the first benchmark for metabolomics assessment. Curated from authoritative public resources, MetaBench evaluates five capabilities essential for metabolomics research: knowledge, understanding, grounding, reasoning, and research. Our evaluation of 25 open- and closed-source LLMs reveals distinct performance patterns across metabolomics tasks: while models perform well on text generation tasks, cross-database identifier grounding remains challenging even with retrieval augmentation. Model performance also decreases on long-tail metabolites with sparse annotations. With MetaBench, we provide essential infrastructure for developing and evaluating metabolomics AI systems, enabling systematic progress toward reliable computational tools for metabolomics research.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在通用文本处理方面展现出了卓越的能力，然而，它们在需要深入、相互关联知识的专业科学领域中的表现仍然缺乏系统性的评估。代谢组学领域面临着独特的挑战，其复杂的生化途径、异构的标识符系统以及分散的数据库都给研究带来了困难。为了系统地评估这些模型在该领域的性能，我们推出了MetaBench——首个用于代谢组学评估的基准测试平台。该平台基于权威的公共资源构建，能够评估代谢组学研究所需的五种核心能力：知识获取、理解能力、基础定位、推理能力以及研究能力。我们对25种开源和闭源语言模型的评估结果显示，这些模型在代谢组学任务上的表现存在差异：虽然模型在文本生成任务上表现良好，但在跨数据库标识符定位方面仍然存在挑战，即使通过检索增强技术也无法有效解决这一问题。对于注释较少的长尾代谢物，模型的性能也会下降。通过MetaBench，我们为开发和评估代谢组学人工智能系统提供了必要的基础设施，从而推动代谢组学研究向更可靠的计算工具方向发展。

papers.title: MTA: Multi-Granular Trajectory Alignment for Large Language Model Distillation
papers.title_zh: MTA：用于大型语言模型提取的多粒粒度轨迹对齐技术
papers.authors: Pham Khanh Chi, Quoc Phong Dao, Thuat Nguyen, Linh Ngo Van, Trung Le, Thanh Hong Nguyen
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation is a key technique for compressing large language models (LLMs), but most existing methods align representations at fixed layers or token-level outputs, ignoring how representations evolve across depth. As a result, the student is only weakly guided to capture the teacher’s internal relational structure during distillation, which limits knowledge transfer. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Granular Trajectory Alignment (MTA), a framework that aligns teacher and student representations along their layer-wise transformation trajectory. MTA adopts a layer-adaptive strategy: lower layers are aligned at the word level to preserve lexical information, while higher layers operate on phrase-level spans (e.g., noun and verb phrases) to capture compositional semantics. We instantiate this idea through a Dynamic Structural Alignment loss that matches the relative geometry among semantic units within each layer. This design is motivated by empirical findings that Transformer representations become increasingly abstract with depth, and is also consistent with linguistic views in which higher-level meaning emerges through the composition of lower-level lexical units. We further incorporate a Hidden Representation Alignment loss to directly align selected teacher–student layers. Experiments show that MTA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on standard benchmarks, with ablations confirming the contribution of each component.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏是一种压缩大语言模型的关键技术，但现有的大多数方法都是在固定层或词级上进行表示对齐的，而忽略了表示在深度方向上的演变过程。因此，学生在蒸馏过程中只能勉强捕捉到教师内部的关联结构，这限制了知识的传递。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了多粒度轨迹对齐框架——MTA。该框架沿着层的变换轨迹来对齐教师和学生的表示。MTA采用了一种自适应层级的策略：较低层次在词级上进行对齐，以保留词汇信息；而较高层次则处理短语级别的跨域信息（例如名词和动词短语），以捕捉组合语义。我们通过一个动态结构对齐损失函数来实现这一想法，该函数能够匹配每层内语义单元之间的相对几何关系。这种设计是基于实证发现的：Transformer表示随着深度的增加而变得越来越抽象，这也与语言学观点一致，即更高层次的含义是通过较低层次的词汇单位组合而成的。我们还引入了隐藏表示对齐损失，以直接对齐选定的教师-学生层次。实验表明，MTA在标准基准测试中的表现始终优于最先进的基线方法，而消融实验也证实了每个组成部分的贡献。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Measuring Distribution Shift in User Prompts and Its Effects on LLM Performance
papers.title_zh: 测量用户提示中的分布偏移现象及其对大型语言模型性能的影响
papers.authors: Parker Seegmiller, Sarah Masud Preum
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed in dynamic, real-world settings, where the distribution of user prompts can shift substantially over time as new tasks, prompts, and users are introduced to a deployed model. Such natural prompt distribution shift poses a major challenge to LLM reliability, particularly for specialized models designed for narrow domains or user populations. Despite attention to out-of-distribution robustness, there is very limited exploration of measuring natural prompt distribution shift in prior work, and its impact on deployed LLMs remains poorly understood. We introduce the LLM Evaluation under Natural prompt Shift (LENS) framework: a data-centric approach for quantifying natural prompt distribution shift and evaluating its effect on the performance of deployed LLMs. We perform a large-scale evaluation using 192 real-world post-deployment prompt shift settings over time, user group, and geographic axes, training a total of 81 models on 4.68M training prompts, and evaluating on 57.6k prompts. We find that even moderate shifts in user prompt behavior correspond with large performance drops (73% average loss) in deployed LLMs. This performance degradation is particularly prevalent when users from different latent groups and geographic regions interact with models and is correlated with natural prompt distribution shift over time. We systematically characterize how LLM instruction following ability degrades over time and between user groups. Our findings highlight the critical need for data-driven monitoring to ensure LLM performance remains stable across diverse and evolving user populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被应用于动态的现实世界场景中。在这些场景中，随着新的任务、提示以及用户的加入，用户提示的分布会随时间发生显著变化。这种自然提示分布的这种变化对大语言模型的可靠性构成了重大挑战，尤其是对于那些为特定领域或用户群体设计的专业模型而言。尽管人们已经关注了模型在分布外情况下的鲁棒性，但在之前的研究中，对于测量自然提示分布变化的探索却非常有限，而这种变化对部署中的大语言模型的影响也尚未得到充分理解。我们提出了“在自然提示变化下的大语言模型评估”框架：这是一种以数据为核心的方法，用于量化自然提示分布的变化，并评估其对部署中的大语言模型性能的影响。我们进行了大规模的评估，使用了192种现实世界中的部署后提示变化场景，涵盖了时间、用户群体和地理因素。我们总共训练了81个模型，这些模型接受了468万条训练提示的训练，并在57600条提示上进行评估。我们发现，即使是在用户提示行为发生轻微变化时，部署中的大语言模型的性能也会大幅下降（平均下降幅度达73%）。这种性能下降在不同潜在用户群体和地理区域之间的交互中尤为明显，并且与自然提示分布随时间的变化密切相关。我们系统地分析了大语言模型遵循指令的能力如何随时间以及不同用户群体之间发生变化。我们的研究结果强调了进行数据驱动的监控的重要性，以确保大语言模型的性能能够在多样化和不断发展的用户群体中保持稳定。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TALAS: Teacher-Anchored Layer Alignment with Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Embedding Distillation
papers.title_zh: TALAS：以教师为主导的层对齐方法，结合自适应锐度感知最小化技术，用于嵌入蒸馏算法
papers.authors: Quoc Phong Dao, Hoang Son Nguyen, Pham Khanh Chi, Linh Ngo Van, Nguyen Thi Ngoc Diep, Thien Huu Nguyen, Trung Le
papers.abstract: Knowledge Distillation (KD) has established itself as a pivotal technique for compressing large pre-trained language models. However, existing methods that force a student to strictly mimic the teacher’s sentence embeddings or internal features often incur prohibitive computational costs and yield suboptimal performance due to the inherent capacity gap. To address these challenges, we propose TALAS (Teacher-Anchored Layer Alignment with Sharpness-aware minimization), a unified framework that synergizes hierarchical (multi-layer) alignment with robust optimization. First, we introduce a Teacher-Anchored mechanism that selectively distills final sentence embeddings only into the student’s upper layers, thereby reducing overhead while respecting capacity constraints. Second, we bridge the semantic gap in lower layers via Layer-Aligned Self-Distillation, which propagates knowledge top-down using internal geometric relational constraints in the embedding space. Finally, to prevent the student from memorizing point-wise teacher noise, we integrate Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization (ASAM) into the training objective, guiding the model towards flat minima for enhanced generalization. Empirical results on standard sentence embedding benchmarks demonstrate that TALAS consistently outperforms strong distillation baselines while achieving superior training efficiency in terms of computational cost and memory footprint.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏（KD）已成为压缩大型预训练语言模型的关键技术。然而，现有方法通常要求学生严格模仿教师句子的嵌入或内部特征，这往往会导致过高的计算成本，并且由于固有的能力差距，其性能也不尽理想。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了TALAS（以教师为导向的层对齐算法，结合智能锐度优化），这是一个将分层对齐与稳健优化相结合的统一框架。首先，我们引入了以教师为导向的机制，仅将最终句子嵌入选择性地提取到学生的上层，从而减少了计算负担，同时满足了能力限制。其次，我们通过层对齐自蒸馏来弥合低层的语义差距，该算法利用嵌入空间中的几何关系约束，将知识从下层向上层传递。最后，为了防止学生记住教师提供的噪声信息，我们将自适应锐度优化（ASAM）整合到训练目标中，引导模型找到平坦的极小值，从而提高泛化能力。在标准的句子嵌入基准测试上进行的实验结果表明，TALAS在性能上始终优于其他强大的蒸馏算法，同时在计算成本和内存占用方面也表现出更高的效率。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Vocabulary Shapes Cross-Lingual Variation of Word-Order Learnability in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 词汇结构决定了语言模型在处理跨语言语序时的表现差异
papers.authors: Jonas Mayer Martins, Jaap Jumelet, Viola Priesemann, Lisa Beinborn
papers.abstract: Why do some languages like Czech permit free word order, while others like English do not? We address this question by pretraining transformer language models on a spectrum of synthetic word-order variants of natural languages. We observe that greater word-order irregularity consistently raises model surprisal, indicating reduced learnability. Sentence reversal, however, affects learnability only weakly. A coarse distinction of free- (e.g., Czech and Finnish) and fixed-word-order languages (e.g., English and French) does not explain cross-lingual variation. Instead, the structure of the word and subword vocabulary strongly predicts the model surprisal. Overall, vocabulary structure emerges as a key driver of computational word-order learnability across languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 为什么有些语言如捷克语允许自由的词序排列，而另一些语言如英语则不允许呢？我们通过让变换器语言模型在多种合成词序变体上进行预训练来解决这个问题。我们发现，更不规则的词序会持续增加模型的惊讶度，这表明这些语言的模型可学习性较低。不过，句子反转对可学习性的影响却很微弱。将语言分为自由词序语言（例如捷克语和芬兰语）和固定词序语言（例如英语和法语）这种粗略的分类并不能解释跨语言之间的差异。相反，词汇中单个词和子词的结构能够强烈预测模型的惊讶度。总体而言，词汇结构被认为是不同语言中计算词序可学习性的关键驱动因素。

papers.title: Quantifying and Understanding Uncertainty in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 量化与理解大型推理模型中的不确定性
papers.authors: Yangyi Li, Chenxu Zhao, Mengdi Huai
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have recently demonstrated significant improvements in complex reasoning. While quantifying generation uncertainty in LRMs is crucial, traditional methods are often insufficient because they do not provide finite-sample guarantees for reasoning-answer generation. Conformal prediction (CP) stands out as a model-agnostic methodology that constructs statistically rigorous uncertainty sets. However, existing CP methods ignore the logical connection between the reasoning trace and the final answer. Additionally, prior studies fail to interpret the origins of uncertainty coverage for LRMs as they typically overlook the specific training factors driving valid reasoning. Notably, it is challenging to disentangle reasoning quality from answer correctness, while simultaneously establishing theoretical guarantees for computationally efficient explanation methods. To address these challenges, we first propose a novel methodology that provides the uncertainty of the reasoning-answer structure with statistical guarantees. Subsequently, we develop a unified example-to-step explanation framework using Shapley values that identifies a provably sufficient subset of training data and their specific reasoning steps sufficient to achieve coverage. We also provide the theoretical analysis for our proposed methods. Extensive experiments on challenging reasoning datasets verify the effectiveness of the proposed methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在复杂推理方面取得了显著进步。虽然量化LRMs中的生成不确定性至关重要，但传统方法往往不够充分，因为它们无法为推理答案的生成提供有限样本保证。共形预测（CP）作为一种与模型无关的方法，能够构建统计上严格的不确定性集合。然而，现有的CP方法忽略了推理轨迹与最终答案之间的逻辑联系。此外，先前的研究未能解释LRMs中不确定性的来源，因为它们通常忽视了驱动有效推理的具体训练因素。值得注意的是，要同时区分推理质量与答案正确性，并为计算效率高的解释方法建立理论保障是非常困难的。为了应对这些挑战，我们首先提出了一种新颖的方法论，该方法能够为推理答案结构的不确定性提供统计上的保证。随后，我们开发了一个统一的从示例到步骤解释框架，该框架使用Shapley值来确定一组可证明的、足以实现覆盖的训练数据及其具体推理步骤。我们还对我们的提出的方法进行了理论分析。在具有挑战性的推理数据集上进行的广泛实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SimPBL: A Multi-Agent Framework for Project-Based Learning
papers.title_zh: SimPBL：一种适用于项目式学习的多智能体框架
papers.authors: Daniel Zhang-Li, Joy Jia Yin Lim, Binglin Liu, Shangqing Tu, Zijun Yao, Hao Peng, Jifan Yu, Haoxuan Li, Zhanxin Hao, Ye He, Zekun Li, Jiangyi Wang, Lei Hou, Bin Xu, Xin Cong, Zhiyuan Liu, Huiqin Liu, Yu Zhang, Juanzi Li
papers.abstract: Project-Based Learning (PBL) is an important learning method that promotes understanding and acquiring practical skills through training learners through a project. However, effective PBL often requires sustained orchestration and collaboration, but existing LLM-based learning tools provide partial assistance without explicitly modeling these roles, and overly comprehensive help provided by LLM can reduce learner autonomy. We propose SimPBL, a multi-agent framework with an orchestrator agent that provides adaptive scaffolding from interaction logs and collaborator agents that support project work through boundary-aware collaboration. We conduct comprehensive evaluation to study the effectiveness of SimPBL, where we observe a 14% improvement in learner examination score. Results from extensive studies further highlights the ability of SimPBL to manage learning behavior and improve learning experience. Code and materials are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SimPBL-D5B8.
papers.abstract_zh: 项目式学习是一种重要的学习方法，它通过让学习者参与项目来促进他们对知识的理解和实践技能的培养。然而，有效的项目式学习通常需要持续的协调与协作。现有的基于大语言模型的学习工具虽然能提供部分帮助，但并未明确体现这些角色的职责分配。此外，大语言模型提供的过于全面的帮助可能会降低学习者的自主性。我们提出了SimPBL这一多智能体框架，其中包含一个协调智能体，它能够根据交互日志提供适应性强的指导；同时还有多个协作智能体，它们通过注重边界的协作方式来支持项目的进行。我们对SimPBL进行了全面评估，发现学习者在考试成绩上提升了14%。大量研究的结果进一步证明了SimPBL在管理学习行为和提升学习体验方面的有效性。相关代码和材料可以在以下链接获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SimPBL-D5B8
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Schoenfeld’s Anatomy of Mathematical Reasoning by Language Models
papers.title_zh: 《Schoenfeld的数学推理分析：语言模型篇》
papers.authors: Ming Li, Chenrui Fan, Yize Cheng, Soheil Feizi, Tianyi Zhou
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly expose reasoning traces, yet their underlying cognitive structure and steps remain difficult to identify and analyze beyond surface-level statistics. We adopt Schoenfeld’s Episode Theory as an inductive, intermediate-scale lens and introduce ThinkARM (Anatomy of Reasoning in Models), a scalable framework that explicitly abstracts reasoning traces into functional reasoning steps such as Analysis, Explore, Implement, Verify, etc. When applied to mathematical problem solving by diverse models, this abstraction reveals reproducible thinking dynamics and structural differences between reasoning and non-reasoning models, which are not apparent from token-level views. We further present two diagnostic case studies showing that exploration functions as a critical branching step associated with correctness, and that efficiency-oriented methods selectively suppress evaluative feedback steps rather than uniformly shortening responses. Together, our results demonstrate that episode-level representations make reasoning steps explicit, enabling systematic analysis of how reasoning is structured, stabilized, and altered in modern language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越能够揭示推理过程，但其背后的认知结构和步骤仍然难以从表面统计数据之外进行识别和分析。我们采用了Schoenfeld的“情节理论”作为归纳性的、中等规模的工具，并提出了ThinkARM这一可扩展框架。该框架能够将推理过程抽象为一系列功能性的推理步骤，如分析、探索、实施、验证等。当这一框架应用于不同模型的数学问题解决时，我们发现这些模型在推理与非推理行为之间存在可复制的思维动态和结构性差异，而这些差异在基于词汇级的分析中并不明显。我们还通过两个案例研究进一步证明了：探索行为实际上是一个与正确性相关的关键分支步骤；而效率导向的方法则倾向于选择性地抑制评估性反馈步骤，而不是简单地缩短响应时间。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，情节级别的表示方式使得推理步骤变得清晰明了，从而能够系统地分析现代语言模型中推理的结构、稳定性和变化机制。

papers.title: Diagnosing Spatial Consistency across Perspectives and Viewpoints in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在大型视觉语言模型中诊断不同视角下的空间一致性问题
papers.authors: Yoonji Kim, Jieun Kim, Yujin Jeong, Sung-Bae Cho
papers.abstract: Consistent reasoning about 3D spatial relations across changing viewpoints is fundamental for Embodied AI agents operating in dynamic environments. While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have advanced multimodal perception, their ability to maintain spatial consistency across diverse perspectives remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks primarily assess spatial capabilities from a static, single-view, and egocentric perspective, failing to capture the dynamic nature of real-world spatial cognition.To address this gap, we introduce SCOPE (Spatial COnsistency across PErspectives and Viewpoints), a comprehensive benchmark designed to rigorously diagnose spatial reasoning capabilities. Grounded in human cognitive theories of dual spatial representations, SCOPE discretizes the 360^\circ field into multiview scenarios to systematically evaluate both allocentric and egocentric reasoning capabilities. Our dataset comprises 20.1K spatial VQA pairs derived from high-quality 3D environments. Through an extensive evaluation of 26 state-of-the-art LVLMs, we identify two fundamental limitations that prevent consistent spatial understanding across viewpoints.We hope SCOPE facilitates the diagnosis of spatial reasoning, serving as a stepping stone toward reliable embodied action.
papers.abstract_zh: 在动态环境中运行的具身人工智能代理，对三维空间关系的持续推理至关重要。虽然大型视觉语言模型在多模态感知方面取得了进展，但它们在不同视角下保持空间一致性的能力仍未被充分探索。现有的基准测试主要从静态的、单一视角的以自我为中心的角度来评估空间能力，这无法捕捉到现实世界空间认知的动态特性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了SCOPE（跨视角和观点下的空间一致性）这一全面的基准测试，旨在严格评估空间推理能力。该测试基于人类关于双重空间表征的认知理论，将360度的场景分解为多个视角，从而系统地评估以自我为中心和以他者为中心的推理能力。我们的数据集包含20.1K个来自高质量三维环境的空间视觉问答对。通过对26种先进视觉语言模型的广泛评估，我们发现有两个根本性的限制因素，这些因素阻碍了不同视角下空间理解的连贯性。我们希望SCOPE能够有助于诊断空间推理问题，为构建可靠的具身行动提供基础。
