papers.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for High-Interaction Terminal Simulation
papers.title_zh: 一种适用于高互动终端模拟的多智能体框架
papers.authors: Kai Wei, Yuwen Cui, Kehan Shen, Hua Wei, Guangjing Wang
papers.abstract: Terminal simulation, framed as a terminal command-level Turing test, is a long-standing problem of symbolic language generation in dialogue and interactive systems. Prior scripted simulators lack the flexibility needed for complex, multi-turn interactions, while LLM-based approaches often misinterpret commands, break output formats, drift from system state, and remain vulnerable to prompt injection. In this work, we propose MANTIS, a terminal simulation framework that improves realism, consistency, and robustness in command-language generation. MANTIS integrates a multi-agent architecture with a filter-based routing model that safely dispatches commands to external tools or an LLM-based agent, enabling support for interactive commands while defending against prompt injection attacks. In addition, we design an agentic file system with history pruning to preserve long-term state consistency. We release three datasets: 28,045 real terminal input-output pairs, a 1,000-session multi-turn interaction dataset, and a 25,849-instance labeled classification dataset. MANTIS outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by more than 9%, achieving over 95% accuracy on multi-turn terminal simulation. The dataset and source code are available at https://github.com/kaiwei666a/MANTIS_Terminal_Simulation
papers.abstract_zh: 终端模拟作为一种以终端命令级图灵测试为框架的解决方案，一直是对话式与交互式系统中符号语言生成领域的一个长期难题。传统的脚本化模拟器缺乏处理复杂多轮交互所需的灵活性，而基于大语言模型的模拟方法则常常会出现命令解读错误、输出格式混乱、系统状态偏离等问题，同时也容易受到提示注入攻击的影响。在这项研究中，我们提出了MANTIS这一终端模拟框架，该框架在命令语言生成方面提升了真实感、一致性和鲁棒性。MANTIS采用了多智能体架构和基于过滤器的路由模型，能够安全地将命令传递给外部工具或基于大语言模型的智能体，从而支持交互式命令的执行，同时有效抵御提示注入攻击。此外，我们还设计了一个具有历史记录修剪功能的智能体文件系统，以保持长期状态的一致性。我们发布了三个数据集：28,045对真实的终端输入输出数据、一个包含1,000次会话的多轮交互数据集，以及一个包含25,849个实例的标注分类数据集。MANTIS在性能上比现有最先进基线算法高出超过 9%，其多轮终端模拟的准确率超过了95%。这些数据集和源代码可以在https://github.com/kaiwei666a/MANTIS_Terminal_Simulation获取。

papers.title: Parameter Importance is Not Static: Evolving Parameter Isolation for Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 参数的重要性并非固定不变：针对监督式微调，参数隔离策略需要不断进化
papers.authors: Zekai Lin, Chao Xue, Di Liang, Xingsheng Han, Peiyang Liu, Xianjie Wu, Lei Jiang, Yu Lu, Bob Simons, Shuang Liang, Minlong Peng
papers.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) of large language models often suffers from task interference and catastrophic forgetting. Recent approaches alleviate this issue by isolating task-critical parameters during training. However, these methods represent a static solution to a dynamic problem, assuming that parameter importance remains fixed once identified. In this work, we empirically demonstrate that parameter importance exhibits temporal drift over the course of training. To address this, we propose Evolving Parameter Isolation (EPI), a fine-tuning framework that adapts isolation decisions based on online estimates of parameter importance. Instead of freezing a fixed subset of parameters, EPI periodically updates isolation masks using gradient-based signals, enabling the model to protect emerging task-critical parameters while releasing outdated ones to recover plasticity. Experiments on diverse multi-task benchmarks demonstrate that EPI consistently reduces interference and forgetting compared to static isolation and standard fine-tuning, while improving overall generalization. Our analysis highlights the necessity of synchronizing isolation mechanisms with the evolving dynamics of learning diverse abilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的监督微调（SFT）常常受到任务干扰和灾难性遗忘的影响。最近的一些方法通过在训练过程中隔离关键参数来缓解这个问题。然而，这些方法只是对动态问题的静态解决方案，它们假设一旦确定了参数的重要性，这种重要性就会保持不变。在这项研究中，我们通过实验证明，参数重要性在训练过程中会随时间发生变化。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了进化参数隔离技术（EPI），这是一种微调框架，它根据参数重要性的在线估计来调整隔离决策。与固定冻结一部分参数不同，EPI利用基于梯度的信号定期更新隔离掩码，从而使模型能够保护那些逐渐变得重要的关键参数，同时释放过时的参数以恢复其可塑性。在多种多任务基准测试中的实验表明，与静态隔离和标准微调相比，EPI能够持续减少干扰和遗忘现象，同时提升整体泛化能力。我们的分析强调了将隔离机制与学习多样化能力的动态变化同步的必要性。

papers.title: Enhanced Reasoning for Biomedical Document-Level Relation Extraction via a Novel Cascade Language Model Framework
papers.title_zh: 通过一种新型级联语言模型框架，提升了生物医学文档级关系提取的推理能力
papers.authors: Haohua Song, Wenhao Gu, Zhijing Li, Yunwenyu, Tiantian Zhu, Xiao Yang, Zexuan Zhu
papers.abstract: Biomedical document-level relation extraction poses significant challenges beyond sentence-level tasks, as it necessitates the integration of evidence from entire documents and the ability for coherent cross-sentence reasoning. While pretrained language models (PLMs) demonstrate efficiency in handling local contexts, they often struggle with global dependency modeling. Conversely, large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities but tend to generate hallucinations in knowledge-intensive biomedical domains. This paper introduces CoRE, a novel cascade framework that leverages the complementary strengths of PLMs and LLMs through a detect-then-rethink paradigm. The PLM serves as an efficient detector for high-confidence relations, while challenging cases are forwarded to an LLM enhanced with semantic retrieval and iterative reasoning mechanisms. Experimental results on BioRED and CDR datasets show that CoRE achieves substantial improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, validating the effectiveness of the proposed cascade paradigm for complex biomedical relation extraction.
papers.abstract_zh: 生物医学领域中的文档级关系提取面临着比句子级任务更为复杂的挑战，因为它需要整合整个文档中的信息，并具备连贯的跨句子推理能力。虽然预训练的语言模型在处理局部上下文时表现出高效性，但在处理全局依赖关系方面却常常遇到困难。相反，大语言模型则具有强大的推理能力，但在知识密集型生物医学领域容易出现幻觉现象。本文介绍了CoRE这一新型级联框架，该框架通过“检测-再思考”的范式，充分利用了语言模型和大语言模型的互补优势。语言模型作为高置信度关系的有效检测器，而复杂案例则被转交给经过语义检索和迭代推理机制增强的大语言模型进行处理。在BioRED和CDR数据集上的实验结果表明，CoRE在复杂生物医学关系提取方面取得了显著改进，这验证了所提出的级联框架在复杂生物医学关系提取中的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Multimodal Large Language Models for Multi-Subject In-Context Image Generation
papers.title_zh: 适用于多主题上下文图像生成的多模态大型语言模型
papers.authors: Yucheng Zhou, Dubing Chen, Huan Zheng, Jianbing Shen
papers.abstract: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) generation have enabled visually coherent image synthesis from descriptions, but generating images containing multiple given subjects remains challenging. As the number of reference identities increases, existing methods often suffer from subject missing and semantic drift. To address this problem, we propose MUSIC, the first MLLM specifically designed for MUlti-Subject In-Context image generation. To overcome the data scarcity, we introduce an automatic and scalable data generation pipeline that eliminates the need for manual annotation. Furthermore, we enhance the model’s understanding of multi-subject semantic relationships through a vision chain-of-thought (CoT) mechanism, guiding step-by-step reasoning from subject images to semantics and generation. To mitigate identity entanglement and manage visual complexity, we develop a novel semantics-driven spatial layout planning method and demonstrate its test-time scalability. By incorporating complex subject images during training, we improve the model’s capacity for chained reasoning. In addition, we curate MSIC, a new benchmark tailored for multi-subject in-context generation. Experimental results demonstrate that MUSIC significantly surpasses other methods in both multi- and single-subject scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 在文本到图像生成领域的最新进展使得基于描述生成视觉上连贯的图像成为可能，但生成包含多个指定主体的图像仍然具有挑战性。随着参考身份数量的增加，现有方法常常会出现主体缺失和语义漂移的问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了MUSIC模型——这是首个专为多主体上下文图像生成而设计的MLLM模型。为了解决数据稀缺问题，我们引入了一种自动且可扩展的数据生成流程，无需人工注释即可完成数据生成。此外，我们通过视觉思维链机制增强了模型对多主体语义关系的理解能力，从而能够逐步从主体图像推导出语义信息并进行生成。为了减轻身份纠缠问题并管理视觉复杂性，我们开发了一种新颖的基于语义的空间布局规划方法，并证明了其在测试阶段的可扩展性。通过在训练过程中融入复杂的主体图像，我们提升了模型进行链式推理的能力。另外，我们还创建了一个新的基准测试MSIC，专门用于多主体上下文生成场景。实验结果表明，MUSIC模型在多主体和单主体场景中均显著优于其他方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: RSMeM: Knowledge-Enhanced Memory Evolution for Remote Sensing Agents with Systematic Evaluation
papers.title_zh: RSMeM：基于知识增强的遥感智能体记忆进化机制——结合系统化的评估方法
papers.authors: Bingxian Wu, Yu Zhang, Zonghao Guo, Tang Liu, Chen Qian, Yuxiang Lu, Xingbo Du, Yanghao Li, Yidan Zhang, Chi Chen, Ling Yao, Chenghu Zhou, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Geoscience research requires complex analysis and domain expertise, with remote sensing (RS) observations as a key foundation. However, existing RS agents built on general-purpose LLMs remain largely domain-agnostic, resulting in brittle and error-prone workflows. Moreover, these failures are seldom consolidated into a reusable experience for subsequent analyses. To address this issue, we introduce RSMeM, a knowledge-enhanced memory evolution mechanism that bootstraps RS agents with pre-distilled domain knowledge and iteratively integrates online experience for robust multi-step tool execution. RSMeM is composed of two components: (i) Hierarchical Knowledge Grounding, which performs taxonomy-aware retrieval over a hierarchical domain corpus to guide planning and tool selection; and (ii) Failure-Aware Experience Refinement, which distills failure-annotated tool-use traces into reusable constraints for next-round tool execution. By iteratively employing these two processes, RS agents can evolve to absorb task-level domain knowledge and effectively translate it into instance-level execution experience. Extensive experiments on EarthBench demonstrate that RSMeM consistently improves tool-use performance and end-to-end accuracy across a diverse set of LLM backbones. Notably, RSMeM achieves a 6% accuracy improvement on DeepSeek-V3.2 with less than 1% additional experience tokens, demonstrating the knowledge density of our distilled experience. All codes and models will be released to support reproducible research.
papers.abstract_zh: 地球科学研究需要复杂的分析和领域专业知识，而遥感观测则是其中的关键基础。然而，现有的基于通用大语言模型的遥感代理大多缺乏领域特异性，导致工作流程不稳定且容易出错。此外，这些失败经验很少被整合为可重复使用的资源，以供后续分析使用。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了RSMeM——一种知识增强的记忆演化机制。该机制通过预提取的领域知识来引导遥感代理的运作，并不断整合在线经验，以实现稳健的多步骤工具执行。RSMeM由两部分组成：(i) 层次化知识引导机制，它通过对分层领域的知识进行检索，从而指导工具和任务的规划与选择；(ii) 故障感知经验优化机制，它将带有故障注释的工具使用记录提炼成可重复使用的约束条件，用于下一轮工具执行。通过反复运用这两个机制，遥感代理能够逐渐吸收任务级别的领域知识，并将其有效地转化为实例级别的执行经验。在EarthBench上的大量实验表明，RSMeM能够持续提升工具使用的性能和端到端准确性，无论所使用的LLM框架如何。值得注意的是，在DeepSeek-V3.2任务上，RSMeM的准确率提升了6%，而额外的经验标记却不到1%，这充分体现了我们提炼出的经验资源的丰富性。所有代码和模型都将公开，以支持可复制性的研究。

papers.title: Synthetic Data Generation for Training Diversified Commonsense Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 用于训练多样化常识推理模型的合成数据生成
papers.authors: Tianhui Zhang, Bei Peng, Danushka Bollegala
papers.abstract: Conversational agents are required to respond to their users not only with high quality (i.e. commonsense bearing) responses, but also considering multiple plausible alternative scenarios, reflecting the diversity in their responses. Despite the growing need to train diverse commonsense generators, the progress of this line of work has been significantly hindered by the lack of large-scale high-quality diverse commonsense training datasets. Due to the high annotation costs, existing Generative Commonsense Reasoning (GCR) datasets are created using a small number of human annotators, covering only a narrow set of commonsense scenarios. To address this training resource gap, we propose a two-stage method to create the first-ever synthetic dataset CommonSyn for diversified (GCR). The model fine-tuned on our synthetic data jointly increase both generation diversity and quality compared with vanilla models and the model fine-tuned on human-crafted dataset across different size Large Language Models (LLMs)
papers.abstract_zh: 对话式智能体不仅需要以高质量的反应来回应用户，还需要考虑多种可能的情景，从而体现出其反应的多样性。尽管培养多样化的常识生成器的需求日益增加，但由于缺乏大规模、高质量的多样化常识训练数据集，这一领域的进展受到了显著阻碍。由于标注成本较高，现有的生成式常识推理数据集都是由少量人类标注者创建的，这些数据集仅涵盖了一小部分常识场景。为了弥补这一训练资源上的不足，我们提出了一种两阶段方法，用于创建首个用于多样化常识推理的合成数据集CommonSyn。该模型在合成数据上进行微调后，其生成多样性和质量都比在人工数据集上训练的模型有所提升，而且这种提升效果与在不同规模的大语言模型中训练的模型相比更为显著。

papers.title: Discourse Realization of Generics in Human and LLM-generated Texts
papers.title_zh: 人类文本与大型语言模型生成文本中泛型的表达方式
papers.authors: Søren Kirkegaard Fomsgaard, Martial Pastor, Gaël Dias, Nelleke Oostdijk
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often produce texts that appear coherent and credible, even when their factual reliability is uncertain. This paper investigates whether such perceived credibility correlates with the pervasive use of generics—generalizations without explicit quantification. We introduce a text-level genericity score derived from clause-level annotations and apply it to argumentative essays produced by humans and LLMs. To analyze how generics are realized in discourse, we employ Rhetorical Structure Theory to examine coherence relations across varying levels of genericity. Results show that according to our genericity metric, human texts are less generic than LLM-produced texts. As regards discourse, higher genericity correlates with less structured, paratactic structures, while for some models coherence is maintained through elaboration relations. Our findings suggest that some LLMs maintain well-structured coherence even in highly generic texts, which might enable them to “camouflage” argumentative texts as informative, enhancing their perceived credibility and persuasiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）往往能够生成看似连贯且可信的文本，即使这些文本在事实可靠性方面存在不确定性。本文探讨了这种感知上的可信性与泛化表达的使用频率之间是否存在关联——即那些没有明确量化的概括性表述。我们提出了一种基于从句级注释构建的文本级泛化得分方法，并将其应用于由人类和LLM生成的议论文。为了分析泛化表达在话语中的实现方式，我们运用了修辞结构理论来研究不同泛化程度下的连贯性关系。结果表明，根据我们的泛化指标，人类撰写的文本比LLM生成的文本更缺乏泛化特征。在话语层面，较高的泛化程度往往伴随着结构较为松散、缺乏逻辑结构的表达方式；而对于某些模型来说，连贯性则通过复杂的推理关系得以维持。我们的研究发现表明，一些LLM即使在高度泛化的文本中也能保持良好的连贯性，这或许有助于它们将议论文伪装成信息性内容，从而提升其可信度和说服力。

papers.title: SRA: Span Representation Alignment for Large Language Model Distillation
papers.title_zh: SRA：用于大型语言模型蒸馏的跨度表示对齐技术
papers.authors: Quoc Phong Dao, Hoang Son Nguyen, Pham Khanh Chi, Tung Nguyen, Linh Ngo Van, Nguyen Thi Ngoc Diep, Trung Le
papers.abstract: Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Distillation (CTKD) enables knowledge transfer between a large language model and a smaller student, even when they employ different tokenizers. While existing approaches mainly focus on token-level alignment strategies, which are often brittle and sensitive to discrepancies between tokenizers, we argue that the method of aggregating tokens into more robust representations before distillation is of equal importance. In this paper, we introduce SRA (Span Representation Alignment for Large Language Model Distillation), a novel framework that reframes CTKD through the physical lens of Multi-Particle Dynamical Systems. SRA shifts the fundamental unit of alignment from tokens to robust, tokenizer-agnostic spans. We model each span as a cluster of particles and represent its state by its Center of Mass (CoM) - an attention-weighted average that captures rich semantic information. We leverage the concept of span centers of mass with attention-derived weighting to prioritize the most salient spans. In addition, we employ a geometric regularizer to preserve the structural integrity of the representation space and introduce aligned span logit distillation to enhance knowledge transfer across models. In challenging cross-architecture distillation experiments, SRA consistently and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art CTKD baselines, validating our physically-grounded approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨令牌化器知识蒸馏（CTKD）能够使得大语言模型与较小的学生模型之间进行知识传递，即使它们使用了不同的令牌化器。虽然现有的方法主要集中在令牌级对齐策略上，但这些策略往往不够稳健，且对令牌化器之间的差异非常敏感。我们认为，在蒸馏之前将令牌聚合为更健壮的表示形式同样重要。在本文中，我们提出了SRA（用于大语言模型蒸馏的片段表示对齐），这是一种通过多粒子动力系统这一物理框架来重新定义CTKD的新框架。SRA将对齐的基本单位从令牌转变为健壮的、与令牌化器无关的片段。我们将每个片段建模为一个粒子簇，并通过其质心来表示其状态——质心是一个基于注意力权重的平均值，能够捕捉丰富的语义信息。我们利用基于注意力的质心概念来优先处理最显著的片段。此外，我们还使用几何正则化器来保持表示空间的结构完整性，并引入对齐的片段逻辑分布蒸馏来增强模型之间的知识传递。在具有挑战性的跨架构蒸馏实验中，SRA始终表现出显著优于现有CTKD基线的性能，这验证了我们这种基于物理原理的方法的有效性。

papers.title: The GDN-CC Dataset: Automatic Corpus Clarification for AI-enhanced Democratic Citizen Consultations
papers.title_zh: GDN-CC数据集：用于提升人工智能在公民咨询中的效果的自动语料清理工具
papers.authors: Pierre-Antoine Lequeu, Léo Labat, Laurène Cave, Gaël Lejeune, François Yvon, Benjamin Piwowarski
papers.abstract: LLMs are ubiquitous in modern NLP, and while their applicability extends to texts produced for democratic activities such as online deliberations or large-scale citizen consultations, ethical questions have been raised for their usage as analysis tools. We continue this line of research with two main goals: (a) to develop resources that can help standardize citizen contributions in public forums at the pragmatic level, and make them easier to use in topic modeling and political analysis; (b) to study how well this standardization can reliably be performed by small, open-weights LLMs, i.e. models that can be run locally and transparently with limited resources. Accordingly, we introduce Corpus Clarification as a preprocessing framework for large-scale consultation data that transforms noisy, multi-topic contributions into structured, self-contained argumentative units ready for downstream analysis. We present GDN-CC, a manually-curated dataset of 1,231 contributions to the French Grand Débat National, comprising 2,285 argumentative units annotated for argumentative structure and manually clarified. We then show that finetuned Small Language Models match or outperform LLMs on reproducing these annotations, and measure their usability for an opinion clustering task. We finally release GDN-CC-large, an automatically annotated corpus of 240k contributions, the largest annotated democratic consultation dataset to date.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在现代自然语言处理领域无处不在。虽然它们的应用范围涵盖了诸如在线讨论或大规模公民咨询等民主活动所需的文本处理，但将其用作分析工具时，也引发了伦理方面的质疑。我们继续开展这项研究，主要有两个目标：(a)开发能够帮助规范公共论坛中公民贡献的标准化资源，使其更易于在主题建模和政治分析中使用；(b)研究小型、开放权重的大语言模型在实现这种标准化方面的能力，即能够本地运行且资源有限的模型。为此，我们提出了“语料库清理”这一预处理框架，它将嘈杂的多主题贡献转化为结构化的、独立的论证单元，以便进行后续分析。我们还展示了GDN-CC数据集，这是一个经过人工筛选的法国全国大辩论的1,231份贡献数据，其中包含2,285个标注了论证结构的论证单元，并且这些单元已经过人工清理。随后，我们发现经过微调的小型语言模型在再现这些标注方面与大语言模型相当甚至更优，并且我们还评估了它们在意见聚类任务中的实用性。最后，我们发布了GDN-CC-large数据集，这是一个自动标注的24万份贡献数据，是迄今为止最大的标注过的民主咨询数据集。

papers.title: Behavior Knowledge Merge in Reinforced Agentic Models
papers.title_zh: 在强化型智能体模型中整合行为知识
papers.authors: Xiangchi Yuan, Dachuan Shi, Chunhui Zhang, Zheyuan Liu, Shenglong Yao, Soroush Vosoughi, Wenke Lee
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is central to post-training, particularly for agentic models that require specialized reasoning behaviors. In this setting, model merging offers a practical mechanism for integrating multiple RL-trained agents from different tasks into a single generalist model. However, existing merging methods are designed for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and they are suboptimal to preserve task-specific capabilities on RL-trained agentic models. The root is a task-vector mismatch between RL and SFT: on-policy RL induces task vectors that are highly sparse and heterogeneous, whereas SFT-style merging implicitly assumes dense and globally comparable task vectors. When standard global averaging is applied under this mismatch, RL’s non-overlapping task vectors that encode critical task-specific behaviors are reduced and parameter updates are diluted. To address this issue, we propose Reinforced Agent Merging (RAM), a distribution-aware merging framework explicitly designed for RL-trained agentic models. RAM disentangles shared and task-specific unique parameter updates, averaging shared components while selectively preserving and rescaling unique ones to counteract parameter update dilution. Experiments across multiple agent domains and model architectures demonstrate that RAM not only surpasses merging baselines, but also unlocks synergistic potential among agents to achieve performance superior to that of specialized agents in their domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在训练之后的应用中占据核心地位，尤其是对于需要特殊推理行为的智能体模型而言。在这种情况下，模型合并提供了一种实用机制，可以将来自不同任务的多个经过强化学习训练的智能体整合为一个通用的模型。然而，现有的合并方法都是为监督式微调设计的，它们在保留智能体模型特定任务能力方面表现不佳。问题的根源在于强化学习与监督式微调之间存在任务向量不匹配的问题：在策略上进行的强化学习会生成高度稀疏且异质的任务向量，而监督式合并则隐含地假设任务向量是密集且具有全局可比性的。当在这种不匹配的情况下应用标准的全局平均法时，强化学习中那些编码了关键任务特定行为的非重叠任务向量会被削弱，参数更新也会变得模糊不清。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了强化智能体合并技术，这是一种专门为强化学习训练的智能体模型设计的、考虑分布特性的合并框架。该框架能够分离出共享参数和更新与任务相关的独特参数，对共享参数进行平均处理，同时选择性地保留并重新调整这些独特参数的比例，从而防止参数更新的稀释。通过在多个智能体领域和模型架构上的实验验证，我们发现强化智能体合并技术不仅超越了现有的合并基准算法，还能激发智能体之间的协同效应，从而实现比其所在领域中的专业智能体更高的性能水平。

papers.title: Leveraging Outline-Optimized Generative Interactions and Critique for Self-Refining Outlines with Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 利用优化过的生成式交互机制以及评论功能，通过强化学习来实现大纲的自我优化
papers.authors: Hengwei Liu, Haoyuan Ma, Qingqing Lyu, Daoxin Zhang, Yao Hu, Yongliang Shen, Yin Zhang, Weiming Lu
papers.abstract: Long-form outline generation requires satisfying multiple competing objectives simultaneously: outlines must be engaging, well-organized, topically relevant, and comprehensive while maintaining logical consistency across hierarchical structures. Current approaches either rely on expensive multi-turn interactions with large language models or employ procedural refinement pipelines that cannot systematically learn from critique. We present Logic-RL, a framework that transforms critique-guided outline refinement into a learnable policy through reinforcement learning. Our approach constructs refinement trajectories from teacher demonstrations, synthesizes explicit reasoning chains that decompose the critique-revision process, and optimizes a refinement policy using group relative policy optimization with structure-aware rewards. Experiments on FreshWiki and WikiOutline demonstrate that Logic-RL achieves substantial improvements over strong baselines, with the 0.6B model obtaining 79.17% relative gain and the 1.7B model achieving 8.67% improvement in average rubric scores compared to the best existing methods. Further analysis reveals that learned refinement policies generalize across domains and can be iteratively applied, with quality continuing to improve through three refinement rounds before diminishing returns.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成长格式大纲需要同时满足多个相互竞争的目标：大纲必须引人入胜、结构清晰、主题相关且内容全面，同时还要在层次结构中保持逻辑一致性。目前的方法要么依赖与大语言模型进行昂贵的多轮交互，要么采用无法从反馈中系统学习的程序化优化流程。我们提出了Logic-RL框架，该框架通过强化学习将基于反馈的大纲优化转化为可学习的策略。我们的方法根据教师提供的示例构建优化路径，合成分解反馈与修订过程的明确推理链，并使用具有结构感知奖励的群体相对策略优化方法来优化优化策略。在FreshWiki和WikiOutline上的实验表明，Logic-RL相较于强大的基线方法取得了显著的改进。0.6B模型的相对得分提升了79.17%，而1.7B模型的平均评分相比现有最佳方法提升了8.67%。进一步分析显示，学习到的优化策略能够在不同领域之间泛化，并且可以通过三轮优化逐步提升质量，之后效果会逐渐减弱。

papers.title: Neuron-Aware Active Few-Shot Learning for LLMs
papers.title_zh: 基于神经元的主动少样本学习技术，适用于大语言模型
papers.authors: Zhuowei Chen, Liwei Chen, Christian Schunn, Raquel Coelho, Xiang Lorraine Li
papers.abstract: Active Few-Shot Learning (AFSL) adapts LLMs to specialized domains by identifying the most valuable unlabeled samples for annotation and use as few-shot demonstrations, effectively reducing human annotation costs while promoting high performance. However, existing methods typically rely on output-level signals for the sample identification, such as predictive entropy or semantic similarities with test-time data based on external embeddings, which often overlook models’ internal dynamics which could pinpoint specific knowledge gaps. To bridge this gap, we propose NeuFS, a Neuron-Aware Active Few-Shot Learning framework that shifts the selection paradigm from output-level proxies to models’ internal dynamics. NeuFS utilizes neuron activation patterns to represent sample directly, and includes a dual-criteria selection strategy that: (1) ensures few-shot sample diversity with neuron patterns for broader example coverage, while (2) prioritizing on identifying informative and challenging few-shot samples LLMs tend to hallucinate by quantifying neuron consensus. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that NeuFS excels in both reasoning and text classification tasks, outperforming existing AFSL baselines. Ablation studies further highlight that internal neuron activations provide a more principled and effective selection signal than external embeddings, validating the superiority of the proposed NeuFS.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动少样本学习（AFSL）通过将大语言模型适应于特定领域，识别出最有价值的未标记样本用于注释和作为少样本示例，从而有效降低人工注释的成本，同时提升性能。然而，现有方法通常依赖输出级信号来进行样本识别，例如基于外部嵌入的预测熵或语义相似性，这些方法往往忽略了模型内部的动态变化，而这些变化可能揭示出特定的知识空白。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了NeuFS框架——一种基于神经元的主动少样本学习框架，它将样本选择的方式从输出级代理转换到模型内部的动态变化。NeuFS利用神经元激活模式直接表示样本，并采用双标准选择策略：(1)通过神经元模式确保少样本样本的多样性，从而实现更广泛的样本覆盖；(2)通过量化神经元共识来优先识别那些具有信息性和挑战性的少样本样本。在三个数据集上的实验表明，NeuFS在推理和文本分类任务中表现优异，优于现有的AFSL基线算法。进一步的消融研究进一步证明，内部神经元激活提供了一种比外部嵌入更合理、更有效的选择信号，这验证了所提出的NeuFS的优越性。

papers.title: CommonLID: Re-evaluating State-of-the-Art Language Identification Performance on Web Data
papers.title_zh: CommonLID：重新评估网络上数据语言识别能力的现状
papers.authors: Pedro Ortiz Suarez, Laurie Burchell, Catherine Arnett, Rafael Mosquera, Sara Hincapié Monsalve, Thom Vaughan, Damian Stewart, Malte Ostendorff, Idris Abdulmumin, Vukosi Marivate, Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad, Atnafu Lambebo Tonja, Hend Al-Khalifa, Nadia Ghezaiel Hammouda, Verrah Akinyi Otiende, Tack Hwa Wong, Jakhongir Saydaliev, Melika Nobakhtian, Muhammad Ravi Shulthan Habibi, Chalamalasetti Kranti, Carol Muchemi, Khang Nguyen, Faisal Muhammad Adam, Luis Frentzen Salim, Reem Alqifari, Cynthia Jayne Amol, Joseph Marvin Imperial, Ilker Kesen, Ahmad Mustafid, Pavel Stepachev, Leshem Choshen, David Anugraha, Hamada Nayel, Seid Muhie Yimam, Vallerie Alexandra Putra, My Chiffon Nguyen, Azmine Toushik Wasi, Gouthami Vadithya, Rob van der Goot, Lanwenn ar C’horr, Karan Dua, Andrew Yates, Mithil Bangera, Yeshil Bangera, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Shu Okabe, Fenal Ashokbhai Ilasariya, Dmitry Gaynullin, Genta Indra Winata, Yiyuan Li, Juan Pablo Martínez, Amit Agarwal, Ikhlasul Akmal Hanif, Raia Abu Ahmad, Esther Adenuga, Filbert Aurelian Tjiaranata, Weerayut Buaphet, Michael Anugraha, Sowmya Vajjala, Benjamin L Rice, Azril Hafizi Amirudin, Jesujoba Oluwadara Alabi, Srikant Panda, Yassine Toughrai, Bruhan Kyomuhendo, Daniel Ruffinelli, Akshata, Manuel Goulão, Ej Zhou, Ingrid Gabriela Franco Ramirez, Cristina Aggazzotti, Konstantin Dobler, Jun Kevin, Quentin Pagès, Nicholas Andrews, Nuhu Ibrahim, Mattes Ruckdeschel, Amr Keleg, Mike Zhang, Casper Rufaro Muziri, Saron Samuel, Sotaro Takeshita, Kun Kerdthaisong, Luca Foppiano, Rasul Dent, Tommaso Green, Ahmad Mustapha Wali, Kamohelo Makaaka, Vicky Feliren, Inshirah Idris, Hande Celikkanat, Abdulhamid Abubakar, Jean Maillard, Benoît Sagot, Thibault Clérice, Kenton Murray, Sarah K. K. Luger
papers.abstract: Language identification (LID) is a fundamental step in curating multilingual corpora. However, LID models still perform poorly for many languages, especially on the noisy and heterogeneous web data often used to train multilingual language models. In this paper, we introduce CommonLID, a community-driven, human-annotated LID benchmark for the web domain, covering 109 languages. Many of the included languages have been previously under-served, making CommonLID a key resource for developing more representative high-quality text corpora. We show CommonLID’s value by using it, alongside five other common evaluation sets, to test eight popular LID models. We analyse our results to situate our contribution and to provide an overview of the state of the art. In particular, we highlight that existing evaluations overestimate LID accuracy for many languages in the web domain. We make CommonLID and the code used to create it available under an open, permissive license.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言识别（LID）是构建多语言语料库的重要步骤。然而，对于许多语言来说，LID模型的表现仍然较差，尤其是在用于训练多语言语言模型的那些嘈杂且异质性的网络数据上。在本文中，我们介绍了CommonLID——一个由社区主导、由人类进行标注的LID基准测试，适用于网络领域，涵盖了109种语言。其中许多语言之前都缺乏有效的评估资源，因此CommonLID成为开发更具代表性的高质量文本语料库的关键工具。我们通过将CommonLID与其他五个常见的评估集结合使用，来测试八种流行的LID模型，从而证明了其价值。我们对结果进行分析，以明确我们的贡献，并概述当前的技术水平。特别是，我们发现现有的评估结果往往高估了网络领域中许多语言的LID识别准确率。我们将CommonLID以及用于创建该基准测试的代码以开放、宽松的许可方式提供给大家。

papers.title: Rethinking Expert Trajectory Utilization in LLM Post-training for Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 重新思考在数学推理领域中对大型语言模型训练后所产生专家知识的利用方式
papers.authors: Bowen Ding, Yuhan Chen, Jiayang Lyu, Jiyao Yuan, Qi Zhu, Shuangshuang Tian, Dantong Zhu, Futing Wang, Heyuan Deng, Fei Mi, Lifeng Shang, Tao Lin
papers.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) dominate the post-training landscape for mathematical reasoning, yet differ fundamentally in their reliance on expert trajectories. To understand the optimal way to harness these trajectories for maximizing performance, we propose the Plasticity-Ceiling Framework. This framework empirically grounds the post-training landscape by decomposing the final performance ceiling into the foundational SFT performance and the subsequent RL plasticity (i.e., the maximum improvement via RL). Through extensive benchmarking, we establish the Sequential SFT-then-RL pipeline as the superior standard, overcoming the stability and premature convergence deficits inherent in synchronized approaches. Furthermore, we derive precise scaling guidelines: (1) Transitioning to RL at the Stable or Mild Overfitting Regime of SFT maximizes the final ceiling by securing a robust SFT foundation with substantial RL plasticity; (2) Refuting the “Less is More” hypothesis in SFT-then-RL scaling, we demonstrate that Data Scale determines the primary post-training potential, while Trajectory Difficulty acts as a performance multiplier; and (3) The Minimum Validation Loss of SFT serves as a reliable indicator for selecting the expert trajectories that maximize the ultimate performance ceiling. Our findings provide actionable guidelines for extracting maximum value from expert trajectories.
papers.abstract_zh: 监督式微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）在数学推理领域的后训练中占据主导地位，但它们在依赖专家轨迹方面存在根本差异。为了理解如何最优地利用这些专家轨迹来提升性能，我们提出了“可塑性上限框架”。该框架通过将最终性能上限分解为基础性的SFT性能和后续的RL可塑性（即通过RL所能实现的最大改进）来实证性地解释后训练的机制。通过广泛的基准测试，我们确定“先进行SFT处理，再进行RL处理”的流程是更优的标准，能够克服同步方法所固有的稳定性和过早收敛问题。此外，我们还提出了精确的扩展准则：(1)在SFT处于稳定或轻度过拟合阶段时转向RL，可以通过确保强大的SFT基础和显著的RL可塑性来最大化最终性能上限；(2)我们反驳了“少即是多”的SFT处理顺序假设，证明数据规模决定了训练后的主要潜力，而轨迹难度则起到性能提升的倍增器作用；(3)SFT的最小验证损失可以作为选择能够最大化最终性能上限的专家轨迹的可靠指标。我们的研究结果为从专家轨迹中提取最大价值提供了可行的指导方针。

papers.title: LoPT: Lossless Parallel Tokenization Acceleration for Long Context Inference of Large Language Model
papers.title_zh: LoPT：用于大型语言模型长上下文推理的无损并行标记化加速技术
papers.authors: Wei Shao, Zheng Lingchao, Pengyu Wang, Peizhen Zheng, Li Jun, Yuwei Fan
papers.abstract: Long context inference scenarios have become increasingly important for large language models, yet they introduce significant computational latency. While prior research has optimized long-sequence inference through operators, model architectures, and system frameworks, tokenization remains an overlooked bottleneck. Existing parallel tokenization methods accelerate processing through text segmentation and multi-process tokenization, but they suffer from inconsistent results due to boundary artifacts that occur after merging. To address this, we propose LoPT, a novel Lossless Parallel Tokenization framework that ensures output identical to standard sequential tokenization. Our approach employs character-position-based matching and dynamic chunk length adjustment to align and merge tokenized segments accurately. Extensive experiments across diverse long-text datasets demonstrate that LoPT achieves significant speedup while guaranteeing lossless tokenization. We also provide theoretical proof of consistency and comprehensive analytical studies to validate the robustness of our method.
papers.abstract_zh: 长序列推理场景对于大语言模型来说变得越来越重要，但它们会带来显著的计算延迟。虽然之前的研究已经通过各种算子、模型架构和系统框架来优化长序列推理，但分词仍然是一个被忽视的瓶颈问题。现有的并行分词方法通过文本分割和多进程分词来加速处理过程，但由于合并过程中会出现边界伪影，导致结果不一致。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了LoPT这一新颖的无损并行分词框架，它能够确保输出的结果与标准顺序分词一致。我们的方法采用基于字符位置的匹配和动态调整块长度的方式，从而准确地对齐和合并分词后的片段。在多种长文本数据集上的广泛实验表明，LoPT能够在保证无损分词的同时显著提升处理速度。我们还提供了理论上的一致性证明，并通过全面的分析研究来验证了我们方法的鲁棒性。

papers.title: SSSD: Simply-Scalable Speculative Decoding
papers.title_zh: SSSSD：简单可扩展的推测性解码技术
papers.authors: Michele Marzollo, Jiawei Zhuang, Niklas Roemer, Niklas Zwingenberger, Lorenz K Muller, Lukas Cavigelli
papers.abstract: Speculative Decoding has emerged as a popular technique for accelerating inference in Large Language Models. However, most existing approaches yield only modest improvements in production serving systems. Methods that achieve substantial speedups typically rely on an additional trained draft model or auxiliary model components, increasing deployment and maintenance complexity. This added complexity reduces flexibility, particularly when serving workloads shift to tasks, domains, or languages that are not well represented in the draft model’s training data.We introduce Simply-Scalable Speculative Decoding (SSSD), a training-free method that combines lightweight n-gram matching with hardware-aware speculation. Relative to standard autoregressive decoding, SSSD reduces latency by up to 2.9×. It achieves performance on par with leading training-based approaches across a broad range of benchmarks, while requiring substantially lower adoption effort—no data preparation, training or tuning are needed—and exhibiting superior robustness under language and domain shift, as well as in long-context settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 投机式解码已成为加速大语言模型推理的常用技术。然而，目前大多数方法在实际服务系统中仅能带来有限的性能提升。那些能够实现显著速度提升的方法通常依赖于额外的训练得到的草稿模型或辅助模型组件，这会增加部署和维护的复杂性。这种额外的复杂性会降低灵活性，尤其是在服务的工作负载需要处理那些在草稿模型的训练数据中缺乏代表的任务、领域或语言时。我们提出了一种名为“简单可扩展投机式解码”的方法，这是一种无需训练即可实现的方法，它结合了轻量级的n元语法匹配和硬件感知的投机策略。与标准自回归解码相比，SSSD能够将延迟降低多达2.9倍。它在广泛的基准测试中的性能与主流基于训练的方法相当，同时所需的投入要少得多——无需进行数据准备、训练或调优。此外，SSSD在语言和领域转换的情况下表现更为出色，也适用于长上下文环境。

papers.title: RedCoder: Automated Multi-Turn Red Teaming for Code LLMs
papers.title_zh: RedCoder：用于代码生成大型语言模型的自动化多轮式攻击技术
papers.authors: Wenjie Jacky Mo, Qin Liu, Xiaofei Wen, Dongwon Jung, Hadi Askari, Wenxuan Zhou, Zhe Zhao, Muhao Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation (i.e., Code LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in AI-assisted software development and testing. However, recent studies have shown that these models are prone to generating vulnerable or even malicious code under adversarial settings. Existing red-teaming approaches rely on extensive human effort, limiting their scalability and practicality, and generally overlook the interactive nature of real-world AI-assisted programming, which often unfolds over multiple turns. To bridge these gaps, we present RedCoder, a red-teaming agent that engages victim models in multi-turn conversation to elicit vulnerable code. The pipeline to construct RedCoder begins with a multi-agent gaming process that simulates adversarial interactions, yielding a set of prototype conversations and an arsenal of reusable attack strategies. We then fine-tune an LLM on these prototype conversations to serve as the backbone of RedCoder. Once deployed, RedCoder autonomously engages Code LLMs in multi-turn conversations, dynamically retrieving relevant strategies from the arsenal to steer the dialogue toward vulnerability-inducing outputs. Experiments across multiple Code LLMs show that our approach outperforms prior single-turn and multi-turn red-team methods in inducing vulnerabilities in code generation, offering a scalable and effective tool for evaluating the security boundaries of modern code-generation systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成领域（即代码语言模型）展现出了令人印象深刻的性能，它们在人工智能辅助的软件开发和测试中发挥了重要作用。然而，最近的研究表明，这些模型在对抗性环境下容易生成脆弱或甚至恶意的代码。现有的“红队攻击”方法依赖于大量的人工操作，这限制了它们的可扩展性和实用性。此外，这些方法通常忽略了现实世界中人工智能辅助编程的互动特性，而实际编程过程往往需要多次交互才能完成。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了RedCoder——一种能够通过与受害模型进行多轮对话来诱导出脆弱代码的红队攻击代理。构建RedCoder的过程始于一个多智能体游戏流程，该流程模拟了对抗性交互，从而生成一系列原型对话以及一系列可复用的攻击策略。随后，我们针对这些原型对话对语言模型进行微调，将其作为RedCoder的核心组件。一旦部署后，RedCoder能够自主地与代码语言模型进行多轮对话，从存储的攻击策略中动态选择合适的策略，以引导对话朝着产生漏洞的方向发展。在多个代码语言模型的实验结果表明，我们的方法在诱导代码生成中的漏洞方面优于以往的单轮和多轮红队攻击方法，为评估现代代码生成系统的安全边界提供了一种可扩展且有效的工具。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Scaling Test-Time Compute to Achieve IOI Gold Medal with Open-Weight Models
papers.title_zh: 通过调整计算资源的分配来缩短测试时间，以实现获得IOI金牌的目标——采用开放式权重模型进行建模
papers.authors: Mehrzad Samadi, Aleksander Ficek, Sean Narenthiran, Siddhartha Jain, Wasi Uddin Ahmad, Somshubra Majumdar, Vahid Noroozi, Boris Ginsburg
papers.abstract: Competitive programming has become a rigorous benchmark for evaluating the reasoning and problem-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs). The International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) stands out as one of the most prestigious annual competitions in competitive programming and has become a key benchmark for comparing human and AI-level programming ability. While several proprietary models have been claimed to achieve gold medal-level performance at the IOI, often with undisclosed methods, achieving comparable results with open-weight models remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we present GenCluster, a scalable and reproducible test-time compute framework that attains IOI gold-level performance using open-weight models. It combines large-scale generation, behavioral clustering, ranking, and a round-robin submission strategy to efficiently explore diverse solution spaces under limited validation budgets. Our experiments show that the performance of our proposed approach scales consistently with available compute, narrowing the gap between open and closed systems. Notably, we will show that GenCluster can achieve a gold medal at IOI 2025 for the first time with an open-weight model gpt-oss-120b, setting a new benchmark for transparent and reproducible evaluation of reasoning in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 竞赛编程已成为评估大语言模型推理和解决问题能力的严格标准。国际信息学奥林匹克竞赛作为竞赛编程领域最负盛名的年度赛事之一，已成为比较人类与人工智能水平编程能力的关键标杆。虽然有一些专有模型在IOI比赛中取得了金牌级成绩，但这些模型的实现方法往往不为人所知。因此，用开放权重模型达到类似的成绩仍然是一个重大挑战。在本文中，我们提出了GenCluster这一可扩展且可复现的测试时间计算框架，它能够使用开放权重模型在IOI比赛中取得金牌级成绩。该框架结合了大规模生成、行为聚类、排序以及循环提交策略，能够在有限的验证预算下高效地探索多种解决方案。我们的实验表明，所提出方法的性能随着可用计算资源的增加而持续提升，从而缩小了开放系统与封闭系统之间的差距。值得注意的是，我们将在2025年IOI比赛中首次使用开放权重模型gpt-oss-120b实现金牌成绩，这将为透明且可复现地评估大语言模型的推理能力树立新的标杆。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PIArena: A Platform for Prompt Injection Evaluation
papers.title_zh: PIArena：一个用于评估提示注入攻击的平台
papers.authors: Runpeng Geng, Chenlong Yin, Yanting Wang, Ying Chen, Jinyuan Jia
papers.abstract: Prompt injection attacks pose serious security risks across a wide range of real-world applications. While receiving increasing attention, the community faces a critical gap: the lack of a unified platform for prompt injection evaluation. This makes it challenging to reliably compare defenses, understand their true robustness under diverse attacks, or assess how well they generalize across tasks and benchmarks. For instance, many defenses initially reported as effective were later found to exhibit limited robustness on diverse datasets and attacks. To bridge this gap, we introduce PIArena, a unified and extensible platform for prompt injection evaluation that enables users to easily integrate state-of-the-art attacks and defenses and evaluate them across a variety of existing and new benchmarks. We also design a dynamic strategy-based attack that adaptively optimizes injected prompts based on defense feedback. Through comprehensive evaluation using PIArena, we uncover critical limitations of state-of-the-art defenses: limited generalizability across tasks, vulnerability to adaptive attacks, and fundamental challenges when an injected task aligns with the target task. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/sleeepeer/PIArena.
papers.abstract_zh: 提示注入攻击在众多实际应用场景中带来了严重的安全风险。尽管这一威胁越来越受到关注，但相关领域仍面临一个关键问题：缺乏一个统一的平台来评估提示注入攻击的效果。这就使得人们难以可靠地比较各种防御措施的有效性，也无法了解它们在不同攻击下的真实抗攻击能力，或者评估它们在不同任务和基准测试中的泛化能力。例如，许多最初被证明有效的防御措施，后来发现其在各种数据集和攻击面前表现出有限的抗攻击能力。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了PIArena这个统一且可扩展的评估平台。该平台允许用户轻松集成最先进的攻击和防御措施，并在各种现有及新的基准测试中对其进行评估。我们还设计了一种基于策略的动态攻击方法，能够根据防御系统的反馈来自适应优化注入的提示内容。通过利用PIArena进行全面的评估，我们发现现有防御措施存在几个关键缺陷：跨任务的泛化能力有限、容易受到自适应攻击的破坏，以及当注入的任务与目标任务一致时会出现根本性的挑战。相关的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/sleeepeer/PIArena下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Clozing the Gap: Exploring Why Language Model Surprisal Outperforms Cloze Surprisal
papers.title_zh: 填补空白：探究为何语言模型在填补空白任务中的表现优于传统方法
papers.authors: Sathvik Nair, Byung-Doh Oh
papers.abstract: How predictable a word is can be generally quantified in two ways: using human responses to the cloze task or using probabilities from language models (LMs). When used as predictors of processing effort, LM probabilities outperform probabilities derived from cloze data. However, it is important to establish that LM probabilities do so for the right reasons, since different predictors can lead to different scientific conclusions about the role of prediction in language comprehension. We present evidence for three hypotheses about the apparent advantage of LM probabilities: not suffering from low resolution, distinguishing semantically similar words, and accurately assigning probabilities to low-frequency words. These results call for efforts to improve the resolution of cloze studies, coupled with experiments on whether human-like prediction is also as sensitive to the fine-grained distinctions made by LM probabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 一个词的可预测性通常可以通过两种方式来量化：一种是利用人类对完形填空任务的回应，另一种是利用语言模型得出的概率。当作为处理难度的预测指标时，语言模型得出的概率比从完形填空数据得出的概率更为可靠。不过，重要的是要确认语言模型得出的概率确实是基于正确的理由，因为不同的预测指标可能会得出不同的科学结论，从而影响人们对语言理解中预测作用的认知。我们为关于语言模型概率看似具有的优势的三个假设提供了证据：一是不会受到低分辨率的影响；二是能够区分语义相似的词汇；三是能够准确为低频词汇分配概率。这些结果提示我们需要提高完形填空研究的精度，同时还需要进行实验来检验类似人类的预测方法是否同样能够敏感地捕捉到语言模型概率所揭示的细微差别。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ChemReason-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Procedural Reasoning in Experimental Chemistry
papers.title_zh: ChemReason-Bench：针对实验化学中的程序性推理任务，对大型语言模型进行性能评估
papers.authors: Jinwei Zhang, Xucheng Liang, Yu Zhang, Ruijie Yu, Xiaokang Yang, Yaohui Jin, Yanyan Xu
papers.abstract: Experimental protocols in organic synthesis specify not only the intended transformation but also an executable sequence of operations and conditions. While recent language models show strong chemistry knowledge, widely used evaluations remain less diagnostic of procedure-level decision making. In this setting, correctness requires consistent step ordering, feasibility under stated conditions, faithful entity-role grounding, and schema-parseable outputs that can be automatically validated against operational constraints. We present ChemReason-Bench, a human-validated benchmark for verifiable experimental procedure reasoning built on a structured representation with explicit placeholders and a unified schema, enabling automatic checks of many operational constraints. From 500 reactions, we instantiate 7306 benchmark tasks across six complementary formats: ordering, step validation, condition validation, schema-constrained completion, contrastive choice, and evidence-grounded rationalization. We further release a large-scale instantiation of the same templates for downstream adaptation studies, kept disjoint from the evaluation set. Using a unified evaluation protocol, we benchmark diverse open-source, proprietary, and domain-specific models and observe clear variation across the capability surface. We also report controlled adaptation experiments in the appendix, where supervised fine-tuning improves small models, preference optimization adds limited gains in our setting, and a gap remains to the strongest evaluated systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 有机合成实验方案不仅规定了预期的转化过程，还明确了具体的操作步骤和适用条件。尽管最新的语言模型在化学知识方面表现出强大的能力，但现有的评估方法在判断操作层面的决策能力方面仍不够准确。在这种情况下，正确的实验方案需要具备一致的步骤顺序、在给定条件下可行的操作、明确的实体与角色对应关系，以及能够自动验证其符合操作约束的输出结果。我们提出了ChemReason-Bench这一经过人类验证的基准测试，该测试基于结构化的表示方式，包含明确的占位符和统一的模式描述，从而可以自动检查许多操作约束。从500个反应案例中，我们构建了7306个基准任务，这些任务涵盖了六种不同的格式：步骤排序、步骤验证、条件验证、受模式限制的完成、对比选择以及基于证据的合理化分析。我们还发布了相同模板的大规模实例，用于后续的适应性研究，这些实例与评估集保持分离。通过统一的评估协议，我们对各种开源、专有以及特定领域的模型进行了评估，发现它们在能力层面存在明显差异。我们在附录中还报告了控制性适应实验的结果：有监督的微调能够改善小型模型的表现，偏好优化在我们的实验环境中也能带来一定的提升，但与最优秀的评估系统相比，仍有较大的差距。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: How Instruction and Reasoning Data shape Post-Training: Data Quality through the Lens of Layer-wise Gradients
papers.title_zh: 训练和推理数据如何塑造模型后期表现：通过逐层梯度分析来评价数据的质量
papers.authors: Ming Li, Yanhong Li, Ziyue Li, Tianyi Zhou
papers.abstract: As the post-training of large language models (LLMs) advances from instruction-following to complex reasoning tasks, understanding how different data affect finetuning dynamics remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we present a spectral analysis of layer-wise gradients induced by low/high-quality instruction and reasoning data for LLM post-training. Our analysis reveals that widely-studied metrics for data evaluation, e.g., IFD, InsTag, Difficulty, and Reward, can be explained and unified by spectral properties computed from gradients’ singular value decomposition (SVD). Specifically, higher-quality data are usually associated with lower nuclear norms and higher effective ranks. Notably, effective rank exhibits better robustness and resolution than nuclear norm in capturing subtle quality differences. For example, reasoning data achieves substantially higher effective ranks than instruction data, implying richer gradient structures on more complex tasks. Our experiments also highlight that models within the same family share similar gradient patterns regardless of their sizes, whereas different model families diverge significantly. Providing a unified view on the effects of data quality across instruction and reasoning data, this work illuminates the interplay between data quality and training stability, shedding novel insights into developing better data exploration strategies for post-training.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在训练后的应用从遵循指令发展到复杂的推理任务，人们仍然对不同数据如何影响模型的微调过程了解甚少。在本文中，我们对训练后的大语言模型由低质量或高质量指令和推理数据引发的层梯度进行了分析。我们的分析表明，那些被广泛用于评估数据的指标，如IFD、InsTag、难度和奖励等，可以通过从梯度的奇异值分解中得到的谱特性来解释和统一。具体来说，高质量的数据通常伴随着较低的核范数和较高的有效排名。值得注意的是，有效排名在捕捉细微的质量差异方面比核范数具有更好的鲁棒性和分辨率。例如，推理数据的有效排名明显高于指令数据，这表明在更复杂的任务上，模型的梯度结构更为丰富。我们的实验还表明，同一家族内的模型无论规模如何，其梯度模式都相似，而不同家族的模型则存在显著差异。这项研究为理解指令和推理数据的质量对模型的影响提供了一个统一的视角，揭示了数据质量与训练稳定性之间的相互作用，并为开发更好的训练后数据探索策略提供了新的思路。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Tailored Primitive Initialization is the Secret Key to Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 量身定制的原始初始化方式是强化学习的关键所在
papers.authors: Yihang Yao, Guangtao Zeng, Raina Wu, Yang Zhang, Ding Zhao, Zhang-Wei Hong, Chuang Gan
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Despite its success, RL faces fundamental challenges, including low sample efficiency and a strong dependence on the quality of the base model: while some models improve rapidly with limited RL updates, others require substantial training data to achieve meaningful gains. Recent studies suggest that the patterns of thinking tokens play a critical role in RL performance, and that supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on datasets exhibiting desirable reasoning patterns can reduce reliance on base models and better prepare LLMs for RL. However, how to automatically discover such patterns across tasks remains unclear. In this work, we describe thinking token patterns with reasoning primitives and argue that initializing LLMs with diverse, high-quality primitives is crucial for stable and efficient RL training. We propose Tailor, a pipeline that automatically discovers such reasoning primitives and curates SFT datasets to prepare LLMs for RL. Extensive experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Tailor consistently improves downstream RL performance, outperforming strong baselines, including methods with expert domain knowledge.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的强大工具。尽管强化学习取得了显著成果，但它仍面临一些根本性的挑战，例如样本效率低下以及严重依赖基础模型的质量：有些模型在有限的强化学习更新下就能迅速改进，而另一些模型则需要大量的训练数据才能取得有意义的进步。最近的研究表明，思维模式的差异对强化学习的性能起着关键作用，而在具有理想推理模式的数据集上进行有监督的微调可以减少对基础模型的依赖，从而更好地为大语言模型进行强化学习训练。然而，如何自动发现不同任务中的这些思维模式仍然是一个未解决的问题。在这项研究中，我们描述了基于推理原语的思维模式，并认为用多样化且高质量的原语初始化大语言模型对于实现稳定高效的强化学习训练至关重要。我们提出了Tailor这一方法，它能够自动发现这些推理原语，并整理出适合进行强化学习训练的数据集。在数学和逻辑推理方面的广泛实验表明，Tailor能够持续提高强化学习的性能，其效果甚至优于那些拥有专业领域知识的先进方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MARS^2: Scaling Multi-Agent Tree Search via Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation
papers.title_zh: MARS^2：通过强化学习实现多智能体树搜索的扩展，用于代码生成
papers.authors: Pengfei Li, Shijie Wang, Fangyuan Li, Yikun Fu, Kaifeng Liu, Kaiyan Zhang, Dazhi Zhang, Yuqiang Li, Biqing Qi, Bowen Zhou
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) paradigms have demonstrated strong performance on reasoning-intensive tasks such as code generation. However, limited trajectory diversity often leads to diminishing returns, which constrains the achievable performance ceiling. Search-enhanced RL alleviates this issue by introducing structured exploration, which remains constrained by the single-agent policy priors. Meanwhile, leveraging multiple interacting policies can acquire more diverse exploratory signals, but existing approaches are typically decoupled from structured search. We propose MARS^2 (Multi-Agent Reinforced Tree-Search Scaling), a unified RL framework in which multiple independently-optimized agents collaborate within a shared tree-structured search environment. MARS^2 models the search tree as a learnable multi-agent interaction environment, enabling heterogeneous agents to collaboratively generate and refine candidate solutions within a shared search topology. To support effective learning, we introduce a path-level group advantage formulation based on tree-consistent reward shaping, which facilitates effective credit assignment across complex search trajectories. Experiments on code generation benchmarks show that MARS^2 consistently improves performance across diverse model combinations and training settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of coupling multi-agent collaboration with tree search for enhancing reinforcement learning. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/TsinghuaC3I/MARTI.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习范式在需要推理的任务中表现优异，例如代码生成。然而，有限的轨迹多样性往往会导致收益递减，从而限制了可实现的性能上限。搜索增强型强化学习通过引入结构化探索来解决这个问题，但这种方法仍然受到单一智能体策略先验的限制。同时，利用多个交互式策略可以获得更多多样化的探索信号，但现有方法通常与结构化搜索分离。我们提出了MARS^2（多智能体强化树搜索扩展），这是一种统一的强化学习框架，其中多个独立优化的智能体在共享的树状搜索环境中协作。MARS^2将搜索树建模为一个可学习的多智能体交互环境，使异构智能体能够在共享的搜索拓扑结构中共同生成和完善候选解决方案。为了支持有效的学习过程，我们引入了基于树一致性奖励塑形的路径级群体优势模型，这有助于在复杂的搜索轨迹中实现有效的信用分配。在代码生成基准测试中的实验表明，MARS^2在不同模型组合和训练环境下都能持续提升性能，这证明了将多智能体协作与树搜索相结合对于提升强化学习的效果是有效的。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/TsinghuaC3I/MARTI上获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LoVeC: Reinforcement Learning for Better Verbalized Confidence in Long-Form Generation
papers.title_zh: LoVeC：用于提升长文本生成中语言表达准确性的强化学习技术
papers.authors: Caiqi Zhang, Xiaochen Zhu, Chengzu Li, Nigel Collier, Andreas Vlachos
papers.abstract: Hallucination remains a major challenge for the safe and trustworthy deployment of large language models (LLMs) in factual content generation. Prior work has explored confidence estimation as an effective approach to hallucination detection, but often relies on post-hoc self-consistency methods that require computationally expensive sampling. Verbalized confidence offers a more efficient alternative, but existing approaches are largely limited to short-form question answering (QA) tasks and do not generalize well to open-ended generation. In this paper, we propose LoVeC (Long-form Verbalized Confidence), a novel reinforcement learning (RL)–based method that trains LLMs to append an on-the-fly numerical confidence score to each generated statement during long-form generation. The confidence score serves as a direct and interpretable signal of the factuality of generation. We introduce two evaluation settings, free-form tagging and iterative tagging, to assess different verbalized confidence estimation methods. Experiments on three long-form QA datasets show that our RL-trained models achieve better calibration and generalize robustly across domains. Also, our method is highly efficient, being 20 \times faster than traditional self-consistency methods while achieving better calibration.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉仍然是确保大语言模型在事实内容生成中安全可信运行的一大挑战。先前的研究探索了置信度估计作为检测幻觉的有效方法，但这些方法通常依赖于需要大量计算资源的后验自洽性算法。而基于语言的置信度表示则提供了一种更高效的替代方案，但现有方法大多仅限于短形式问答任务，且无法很好地适用于开放式生成任务。在本文中，我们提出了LoVeC（长形式语言化置信度）这一基于强化学习的新方法。该方法训练大语言模型在长形式生成过程中为每条生成的语句附加一个实时计算的置信度分数。这个置信度分数可以作为生成内容真实性的直接且可解释的信号。我们引入了两种评估方式：自由形式标注和迭代标注，以评估不同的语言化置信度估计方法。在三个长形式问答数据集上的实验表明，我们的强化学习训练模型能够实现更好的校准效果，并且能够在不同领域之间实现稳健的泛化能力。此外，我们的方法还非常高效，其处理速度比传统自洽性方法快20倍，同时还能实现更好的校准效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mitigating Lost in Multi-turn Conversation via Curriculum RL with Verifiable Accuracy and Abstention Rewards
papers.title_zh: 通过具有可验证准确性的课程强化学习技术，以及利用回避奖励机制，来减少多轮对话中的信息丢失现象
papers.authors: Ming Li, Pei Chen, Zhenhao Zhang, Tao Yang, Xinyang Zhang, Han Li, Tianyu Cao, Ming Zeng, Zhuofeng Wu, Meng Jiang, Huasheng Li, Lihong Li, Bing Yin
papers.abstract: Large Language Models demonstrate strong capabilities in single-turn instruction following but suffer from Lost-in-Conversation (LiC), a degradation in performance as information is revealed progressively in multi-turn settings. Motivated by the current progress on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), we propose Curriculum Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Accuracy and Abstention Rewards (RLAAR), a framework that encourages models not only to generate correct answers, but also to judge the solvability of questions in the multi-turn conversation setting. Our approach employs a competence-gated curriculum that incrementally increases dialogue difficulty (in terms of instruction shards), stabilizing training while promoting reliability. Using multi-turn, on-policy rollouts and a mixed-reward system, RLAAR teaches models to balance problem-solving with informed abstention, reducing premature answering behaviors that cause LiC. Evaluated on LiC benchmarks, RLAAR significantly mitigates LiC performance decay (62.6% to 75.1%) and improves calibrated abstention rates (33.5% to 73.4%). Together, these results provide a practical recipe for building multi-turn reliable and trustworthy LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在单轮指令遵循方面表现出强大的能力，但在多轮对话环境中，当信息逐渐揭示时，其性能会下降，这种现象被称为“对话中的迷失”（Lost-in-Conversation，LiC）。受基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）当前进展的启发，我们提出了一种名为“具有可验证准确性和回避奖励的强化学习”的框架（RLAAR）。该框架不仅鼓励模型生成正确的答案，还促使模型能够判断多轮对话环境中问题的解决可能性。我们的方法采用了一个分级能力课程结构，逐步增加对话的难度（以指令碎片的形式），从而在提升可靠性的同时稳定训练过程。通过多轮基于策略的扩展以及混合奖励系统，RLAAR能够教会模型在解决问题与明智回避之间找到平衡，从而减少导致LiC的过早回答行为。在LiC基准测试中的结果显示，RLAAR显著降低了LiC性能下降的情况（从62.6%提高到75.1%），并提高了合理的回避率（从33.5%提高到73.4%）。这些结果为我们构建可靠且可信的多轮对话LLM提供了实用的方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AdabNER: Arabic Digital Archive Books with Nested Entity Recognition
papers.title_zh: AdabNER：基于阿拉伯语的数字档案系统，包含嵌套实体识别功能
papers.authors: Aya Mourad, Mustafa Jarrar
papers.abstract: Most studies on Arabic Named Entity Recognition (NER) have focused on news texts and social media posts, while the large and rich corpus of literary Arabic books has been underrepresented. We introduce AdabNER, the first large-scale nested NER dataset for Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) literary texts, comprising the first 6,000 words annotated from each of 138 books spanning ten literary genres, including history, biography, literary criticism, and travel literature, and covering works from the 1880s to the 2020s. The corpus comprises about 876K tokens, manually annotated using a nested 21 entity tag annotation scheme, yielding 78,530 entity mentions, 18.96% of which are nested. We fine-tuned five pre-trained Arabic BERT encoders in two settings: stratified and leave-book-out, achieving F1 scores of 0.86 and 0.83 with AraBERTv2, respectively. We also evaluated five large language models through few-shot in-context learning, including open-source models and the closed-source Gemini 3 Pro, with Gemini 3 Pro achieving the highest LLM F1 score of 0.59. Supervised results degraded under out-of-domain evaluation; however, joint multi-domain training reduced this gap to less than a 1% F1 loss, demonstrating that domain-diverse training data is key to robust Arabic NER, though broader validation beyond the experiments reported is needed. AdabNER and its annotation guidelines are publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19468385.
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数关于阿拉伯语命名实体识别的研究都集中在新闻文本和社交媒体帖子上，而丰富的文学阿拉伯语书籍数据集则被忽视了。我们推出了AdabNER，这是首个针对现代标准阿拉伯语文学文本的大规模嵌套命名实体识别数据集。该数据集包含了来自138本不同文学类型的书籍中的前6000个单词的标注数据，这些书籍涵盖了历史、传记、文学评论以及旅行文学等领域，时间跨度从19世纪80年代到2020年代。该数据集包含约876K个标记点，采用嵌套式的21个实体标签标注方案进行手动标注，共识别出78,530个实体，其中18.96%的实体是嵌套在另一个实体中的。我们在两种模式下对五款预训练的阿拉伯语BERT编码器进行了微调：分层模式和逐书模式。使用AraBERTv2模型时，这两种模式的F1分数分别达到了0.86和0.83。我们还通过少量样本进行了五种大语言模型的评估，包括开源模型和闭源模型Gemini 3 Pro。其中，Gemini 3 Pro取得了最高的LLM F1分数，为0.59。然而，在跨领域评估中，监督式的结果有所下降；不过，通过多领域联合训练后，这种差距缩小到了1%以下，这表明多样化的训练数据对于提高阿拉伯语命名实体识别的准确性至关重要。AdabNER及其标注指南可以在https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19468385上获取。

papers.title: Anchoring the Cache: Mitigating Contextual Hallucination in KV-Compressed Long-Context Summarization
papers.title_zh: 固定缓存位置：缓解KV压缩长上下文摘要处理中的环境幻觉问题
papers.authors: Yu Fu, Chen Luo, Josef Valvoda, Xin Zhang, Xuejing Lei, Xiao Pan, Hui Liu, Yue Dong
papers.abstract: Key-Value (KV) cache compression techniques have improved the efficiency of long-context summarization in Large Language Models (LLMs), but their impact on model hallucination remains underexplored. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of how KV cache compression affects hallucination in long-context summarization, demonstrating that aggressive compression can increase hallucination scores by up to 3.36× compared to the baseline. To mitigate this issue, we propose HalluKV, a decoding-phase strategy that selectively removes generated KV pairs from retrieval heads responsible for retrieving critical information from source context, thereby anchoring their attention on the preserved source information. Our approach maintains computational efficiency while significantly reducing hallucination across multiple models and datasets, achieving up to 5.48 average point reductions on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, enabling more trustworthy long-context summarization.
papers.abstract_zh: 键值（KV）缓存压缩技术显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）中长上下文总结的效率，但其对模型幻觉产生的影响尚未得到充分研究。在本文中，我们首次系统研究了KV缓存压缩对长上下文总结中幻觉产生的影响，结果表明，激进的压缩可以将幻觉得分提高3.36倍，远超基线水平。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了HalluKV这一解码阶段策略，该策略会选择性地移除那些用于从源上下文中检索关键信息的KV对，从而让模型注意力集中在保留下来的源信息上。我们的方法在保持计算效率的同时，显著降低了多个模型和数据集中的幻觉发生率，在Llama-3-8B-Instruct模型上实现了平均高达5.48点的幻觉减少，使得长上下文总结更加可靠。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: NeuralFSM: Adaptive Multi-Agent Coordination via Learning Finite-State Execution Policy
papers.title_zh: 神经式有限状态机：通过学习有限状态执行策略来实现自适应多智能体协调
papers.authors: Jiye Wang, Yu Wang, Jianbin Li, Shiduo Yang, Kenan Guo, Yuanhe Zhao
papers.abstract: LLM-powered multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated strong performance on complex tasks. However, most existing approaches still rely on hand-crafted communication protocols or automatically designed communication topologies, which generalize poorly across tasks. We introduce NeuralFSM, a state-driven framework that formulates multi-agent problem solving as a finite-state execution process. NeuralFSM learns both the state transition distribution and inter-agent communication weights from interaction traces using a Temporal Coordination Controller. Rather than prioritizing explicit structure generation, the proposed framework uses task context to modulate transition and routing decisions, enabling flexible coordination without manual protocol design. To improve robustness against noisy or adversarial agents, we incorporate graph regularization during training and apply trust-aware message attenuation at runtime. Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that NeuralFSM consistently outperforms prior baselines by an average margin of 6.74%–19.39%, while substantially reducing token consumption. Moreover, NeuralFSM exhibits strong inherent robustness, which is further enhanced by the protection layer, resulting in only a 1.82% performance drop under attack.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的多智能体系统在复杂任务中表现优异。然而，目前大多数方法仍然依赖于手工设计的通信协议或自动生成的通信拓扑结构，这些方案在不同任务中的通用性较差。我们提出了NeuralFSM这一基于状态的框架，它将多智能体问题求解抽象为有限状态执行过程。NeuralFSM通过时间协调控制器从交互记录中学习状态转移分布以及智能体间的通信权重。该框架不强调显式结构的生成，而是利用任务上下文来调节状态和路由决策，从而实现无需人工设计协议的灵活协调。为了增强系统对噪声或敌对智能体的鲁棒性，我们在训练过程中引入图正则化技术，并在运行时应用基于信任的消息衰减机制。在多种基准测试中的实验表明，NeuralFSM的平均性能优于现有基线方法，优势幅度为6.74%至19.39%，同时显著减少了计算资源消耗。此外，NeuralFSM还具备强大的鲁棒性，这种鲁棒性通过保护层得到了进一步提升，即使在受到攻击时，系统的性能下降幅度也仅为1.82%。

papers.title: Ranking Reasoning LLMs under Test-Time Scaling
papers.title_zh: 在测试时间扩展下的排名推理大型语言模型
papers.authors: Mohsen Hariri, Michael Hinczewski, Jing Ma, Vipin Chaudhary
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling evaluates reasoning LLMs by sampling multiple outputs per prompt, but ranking models in this regime remains underexplored. We formalize dense benchmark ranking under test-time scaling and introduce Scorio, a library that implements statistical ranking methods such as paired-comparison models, item response theory (IRT) models, voting rules, and graph- and spectral-based methods. Across 20 reasoning models on four Olympiad-style math benchmarks (AIME’24, AIME’25, HMMT’25, and BrUMO’25; up to N = 80 trials), most full-trial rankings agree closely with the Bayesian gold standard Bayes_𝒰@80 (mean Kendall’s τ_b = 0.93–0.95), and 19–34 methods recover exactly the same ordering. In the single-trial regime, the best methods reach τ_b ≈ 0.86.Using greedy decoding as an empirical prior (Bayes_R₀@N) reduces variance at N = 1 by 16–52%, but can bias rankings when greedy and stochastic sampling disagree. These results identify reliable ranking methods for both high- and low-budget test-time scaling. We release Scorio as an open-source library at https://github.com/mohsenhariri/scorio.
papers.abstract_zh: 在测试时间扩展模式下，通过为每个提示采样多个输出来评估推理大语言模型的性能。不过，在这种模式下对排名模型的研究仍然相对较少。我们为测试时间扩展模式下的密集基准排名提出了正式的定义，并引入了Scorio这个库，该库实现了多种统计排名方法，如配对比较模型、项目反应理论（IRT）模型、投票规则以及基于图和谱的方法。在20种推理模型上，针对4个奥林匹克风格的数学竞赛基准测试（AIME’24、AIME’25、HMMT’25和BrUMO’25），当试验次数达到N=80时，大多数完整的试验排名与贝叶斯黄金标准Bayes_𝒰@80的结果非常接近（Kendall's τ_b平均值在0.93到0.95之间），并且有19到34种方法的排名结果完全一致。在单次试验的情况下，最好的方法能够达到τ_b约为0.86。使用贪婪解码作为经验先验（Bayes_R₀@N）可以在N=1的情况下将方差减少16%到52%，但当贪婪解码和随机采样存在冲突时，可能会导致排名偏差。这些结果表明，无论预算如何，都有可靠的排名方法适用于测试时间扩展模式。我们将Scorio作为开源库发布在https://github.com/mohsenhariri/scorio上。

papers.title: Quantifying and Improving the Robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Language Models Against Spurious Features in Grounding Data
papers.title_zh: 量化并提升检索增强型语言模型在处理虚假特征时的鲁棒性，以更好地应对基准数据中的此类问题
papers.authors: Shiping Yang, Jie Wu, Wenbiao Ding, Ning Wu, Shining Liang, Ming Gong, Hongzhi Li, Hengyuan Zhang, Angel X. Chang, Dongmei Zhang
papers.abstract: Robustness has become a critical attribute for the deployment of RAG systems in real-world applications. Existing research focuses on robustness to explicit noise (e.g., document semantics) but overlooks implicit noise (spurious features). Moreover, previous studies on spurious features in LLMs are limited to specific types (e.g., formats) and narrow scenarios (e.g., ICL). In this work, we identify and study spurious features in the RAG paradigm, a robustness issue caused by the sensitivity of LLMs to semantic-agnostic features. We then propose a novel framework,SURE, to empirically quantify the robustness of RALMs against spurious features. Beyond providing a comprehensive taxonomy and metrics for evaluation, the framework’s data synthesis pipeline facilitates training-based strategies to improve robustness. Further analysis suggests that spurious features are a widespread and challenging problem in the field of RAG. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RAG-SpuriousFeatures-62B3.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实应用中的RAG系统部署中，鲁棒性已成为一个至关重要的属性。现有的研究主要集中在应对显性噪声（例如文档语义）的鲁棒性上，而忽略了隐性噪声（虚假特征）的影响。此外，之前关于大语言模型中的虚假特征的研究仅限于特定类型（例如格式）和狭窄的场景（例如ICL）。在这项工作中，我们识别并研究了RAG范式中的虚假特征问题，这一问题是由于大语言模型对与语义无关的特征过于敏感所导致的。随后，我们提出了一种新颖的框架SURE，用于实证量化大语言模型对虚假特征的鲁棒性。该框架不仅提供了全面的分类法和评估指标，还包含了数据合成流程，有助于通过训练来提升鲁棒性。进一步分析表明，虚假特征在RAG领域是一个普遍且具有挑战性的问题。我们的代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RAG-SpuriousFeatures-62B3。

papers.title: CL^2GEC: A Multi-Discipline Benchmark for Continual Learning in Chinese Literature Grammatical Error Correction
papers.title_zh: CL^2GEC：一个用于中文文学语法错误纠正的多学科基准框架
papers.authors: Shang Qin, Jingheng Ye, Yinghui Li, Hai-Tao Zheng, Qi Li, Jinxiao Shan, Zhixing Li, Hong-Gee Kim
papers.abstract: The growing demand for automated writing assistance in diverse academic domains highlights the need for robust Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) systems that can adapt across disciplines. However, existing CGEC research largely lacks dedicated benchmarks for multi-disciplinary academic writing, overlooking continual learning (CL) as a promising solution to handle domain-specific linguistic variation and prevent catastrophic forgetting. To fill this crucial gap, we introduce CL^2GEC, the first Continual Learning benchmark for Chinese Literature Grammatical Error Correction, designed to evaluate adaptive CGEC across multiple academic fields. Our benchmark includes 10,000 human-annotated sentences spanning 10 disciplines, each exhibiting distinct linguistic styles and error patterns. CL^2GEC focuses on evaluating grammatical error correction in a continual learning setting, simulating sequential exposure to diverse academic disciplines to reflect real-world editorial dynamics. We evaluate large language models under sequential tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, and four representative CL algorithms, using both standard GEC metrics and continual learning metrics adapted to task-level variation. Experimental results reveal that regularization-based methods mitigate forgetting more effectively than replay-based or naive sequential approaches. Our benchmark provides a rigorous foundation for future research in adaptive grammatical error correction across diverse academic domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 在多个学术领域对自动化写作辅助工具的需求不断增加，这凸显了需要能够适应不同学科需求的强大中文语法错误纠正系统的需求。然而，现有的中文语法错误纠正研究大多缺乏针对多学科学术写作的专门评估标准，而持续学习作为一种解决特定领域语言差异并防止灾难性遗忘的有效方法却未被充分重视。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了CL^2GEC——首个用于中文文学领域语法错误纠正的持续学习评估基准。该基准旨在评估多学科学术写作中的自适应语法错误纠正能力。我们的基准包含10,000句由人类标注的句子，这些句子来自10个不同的学科，每个学科都有独特的语言风格和错误模式。CL^2GEC的重点是在持续学习环境中评估语法错误纠正能力，通过模拟连续接触不同学科的情况来反映现实世界中的编辑动态。我们对大语言模型进行了序列调整、参数高效适配以及四种代表性持续学习算法的评估，同时使用了标准的语法错误纠正指标以及针对任务级变化的持续学习指标。实验结果表明，基于正则化的方法比基于重放或简单序列方法更能有效防止遗忘。我们的基准为未来在不同学术领域开展自适应语法错误纠正的研究提供了坚实的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PEARL: Self-Evolving Assistant for Time Management with Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 珍珠：一种基于强化学习的自我进化时间管理助手
papers.authors: Bingxuan Li, Jeonghwan Kim, Cheng Qian, Xiusi Chen, Eitan Anzenberg, Niran Kundapur, Heng Ji
papers.abstract: Overlapping calendar invitations force busy professionals to repeatedly decide which meetings to attend, reschedule, or decline. We refer to this preference-driven decision process as calendar conflict resolution. Automating this decision process is crucial yet challenging. Scheduling logistics can drain hours, and human delegation often fails at scale, which motivates us to ask: Can we trust large language models (LLMs) or language agents to manage time? To enable a systematic study of this question, we introduce CalConflictBench, a benchmark for long-horizon calendar conflict resolution. In CalConflictBench, conflicts are presented to agents round-by-round over a calendar year, requiring them to infer and adapt to user preferences progressively. Our experiments show that current LLM agents perform poorly with high error rates, e.g., Qwen-3-30B-Think has an average error rate of 35%. To address this gap, we propose PEARL, a reinforcement-learning framework that (i) augments the language agent with an external preference memory that stores and updates inferred strategies (e.g., attendee priorities, topic importance, time/location preferences), and (ii) optimizes the agent with round-wise rewards that directly supervise decision correctness, ranking quality, and memory usage across rounds. Experiments on CalConflictBench show that PEARL achieves an error reduction rate of 0.76 and a 55% improvement in average error rate compared to the strongest baseline.
papers.abstract_zh: 重叠的日历邀请让忙碌的专业人士不得不反复决定要参加哪些会议、重新安排时间或拒绝某些邀请。我们将这种基于偏好的决策过程称为“日历冲突解决”。自动化这一决策过程既至关重要，又充满挑战。日程安排工作会耗费大量时间，而人工分配在大规模应用中往往难以奏效，这促使我们思考：我们能否信任大语言模型或语言代理来管理时间呢？为了系统地研究这个问题，我们推出了CalConflictBench这一用于长期日历冲突解决的基准测试平台。在CalConflictBench中，冲突会逐轮在一年内的日历上呈现给语言代理，要求它们逐步推断并适应用户的偏好。我们的实验表明，目前的语言模型代理表现不佳，错误率很高，例如Qwen-3-30B-Think的平均错误率为35%。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了PEARL框架——一个强化学习框架。该框架首先为语言代理增加了外部偏好记忆功能，用于存储和更新推断出的策略（如参会者优先级、主题重要性、时间/地点偏好）。其次，通过逐轮奖励来优化代理的行为，从而直接监督决策的正确性、排名质量以及跨轮次的记忆使用效率。在CalConflictBench上的实验表明，PEARL模型的错误率降低了0.76，与最强大的基线模型相比，平均错误率也提高了55%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Static Artifacts: An Evolutionary Framework for Synthetic Claim Generation
papers.title_zh: 超越静态文物：一种用于生成合成声明的进化框架
papers.authors: Yeqing Teng, Jiasheng Si, Shuxia Lin, Linhai Zhang, Weiyu Zhang, Wenpeng Lu, Deyu Zhou, Xiaoming Wu
papers.abstract: With the generative capabilities of large language models (LLMs) reshaping the information ecosystem, the concern with the sociological validity of claim detection benchmarks is increasing. Current claim detection benchmarks predominantly treat claims as static textual artifacts, overlooking the sociological etiology of how information naturally emerges and mutates. In this paper, we propose an evolutionary paradigm that models claims as socially evolving entities. In specific, we introduce a socially generative framework for synthetic claim generation, a multi-agent simulation grounded in the Open Claims Model. By decomposing claims into context, utterance, and proposition, our approach enables the precise simulation of unmitigated propagation to capture truth decay, and intervened propagation with multi-auditor oversight for targeted generation. Furthermore, we propose the background-user-perspective (BUP) framework, which reformulates check-worthiness as a condition-dependent probability rooted in social environment. Experiments on our datasets verify the data quality and reveal how network topology and user attributes systematically shape veracity drift.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型生成能力的崛起正在重塑信息生态系统，人们对声明检测基准的社会学有效性提出了越来越多的质疑。目前的声明检测基准大多将声明视为静态的文本实体，而忽视了信息自然产生和演变的社会学因素。在本文中，我们提出了一种进化范式，将声明视为不断社会演化的实体。具体来说，我们引入了一个基于开放声明模型的、用于合成声明生成的社交生成框架。通过将声明分解为上下文、话语和命题，我们的方法能够精确模拟信息的传播过程，包括真相的衰减情况，并通过多听者监督来实现有针对性的声明生成。此外，我们还提出了背景用户视角（BUP）框架，该框架将检查价值重新定义为一种依赖于社会环境的条件概率。我们在数据集上的实验验证了该框架的数据质量，并揭示了网络拓扑结构和用户属性如何系统地影响信息的真实性变化。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CloneMem: Benchmarking Long-Term Memory for AI Clones
papers.title_zh: CloneMem：用于人工智能克隆体长期记忆性能评估的基准测试工具
papers.authors: Sen Hu, Zhiyu Zhang, Yuxiang Wei, Xueran Han, Zhenheng Tang, Ronghao Chen, Huacan Wang
papers.abstract: AI Clones aim to simulate an individual’s thoughts and behaviors to enable long-term, personalized interaction, placing stringent demands on memory systems to model experiences, emotions, and opinions over time. Existing memory benchmarks primarily rely on user–agent conversational histories, which are temporally fragmented and insufficient for capturing continuous life trajectories. We introduce CloneMem, a benchmark for evaluating long-term memory in AI Clone scenarios grounded in non-conversational digital traces, including diaries, social media posts, and emails, spanning one to three years. CloneMem adopts a top-down data construction framework to ensure longitudinal coherence and defines tasks that assess an agent’s ability to track evolving personal states. Experiments show that current memory mechanisms struggle in this setting, highlighting open challenges for life-grounded personalized AI. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/AvatarMemory/CloneMemBench
papers.abstract_zh: AI克隆技术旨在模拟个体的思维与行为，从而实现长期、个性化的交互。这一技术对记忆系统提出了极高的要求，需要能够随时间记录经验、情感和观点。现有的记忆评估基准主要依赖于用户与智能体之间的对话记录，但这些记录在时间上较为零散，无法完整地反映一个人的生活轨迹。我们提出了CloneMem这一评估工具，它基于非对话式的数字痕迹来评估AI克隆场景中的长期记忆能力，这些痕迹包括日记、社交媒体帖子和电子邮件等，时间跨度为一到三年。CloneMem采用自上而下的数据构建框架，以确保数据的纵向连贯性，并定义了多项任务来评估智能体追踪个人状态变化的能力。实验结果表明，当前的记忆机制在这种环境下表现不佳，这凸显了基于生活的个性化AI所面临的挑战。相关代码和数据集可在https://github.com/AvatarMemory/CloneMemBench获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Memory efficiency and resource-rational encoding in sentence processing
papers.title_zh: 在句子处理中追求内存效率和资源合理利用
papers.authors: Weijie Xu, Brian Dillon, Richard Futrell
papers.abstract: There is a growing consensus that, in order to serve as models of human language processing, language models (LMs) need to be constrained in their use of memory for context, the analogue to human working memory (WM). Here we take a novel yet simple approach to constraining WM in language models, in a way that reflects models of human cognition where memory is treated as a limited resource and deployed strategically. In order to capture this constraint on memory encoding, we inject noise into the hidden representations of Transformer-based LMs at tunable rates. Then we train the models with a hybrid objective, such that they learn to maximize the performance of next-word prediction subject to explicit constraints on the total encoding precision. We find that explicit WM constraints improve the model’s alignment with human reading times. More importantly, we find that the need to manage encoding precision reshapes the nature of the models’ context representations, making them more compressed and categorical. Our results show how resource-rational models of WM allocation can be implemented in neural models simply and successfully, and point to a dissociation between WM retrieval mechanisms and the underlying memory representations in models of human sentence processing.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前有一种越来越强的共识，即为了成为人类语言处理的典范，语言模型在利用记忆来处理上下文方面需要受到限制。上下文相当于人类的工作记忆，而记忆则是一种有限的资源，需要被战略性地运用。为了体现这种对记忆编码的限制，我们以可调节的速率向基于Transformer的语言模型的隐藏表示中注入噪声。然后，我们采用混合目标来训练这些模型，使它们能够在明确的总编码精度约束下，最大化下一个单词的预测性能。我们发现，明确的记忆约束能够提升模型与人类阅读时间的匹配程度。更重要的是，我们发现，为了管理编码精度，模型的上下文表示方式发生了改变，变得更加压缩和类别化。我们的研究结果表明，如何简单而成功地将在神经模型中实现资源合理的记忆分配策略，并揭示了人类句子处理模型中记忆检索机制与底层记忆表示之间的区别。

papers.title: PRISM: Probing Reasoning, Instruction, and Source Memory in LLM Hallucinations
papers.title_zh: PRISM：在大型语言模型产生的幻觉中探究推理机制、指令处理以及信息来源记忆方面的问题
papers.authors: Yuhe Wu, Guangyu Wang, Yuran Chen, Jiatong Zhang, Yutong Zhang, Yujie Chen, Jiaming Shang, Guang Zhang, Zhuang Liu
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve from conversational assistants into agents capable of handling complex tasks, they are increasingly deployed in high-risk domains. However, existing benchmarks largely rely on mixed queries and posterior evaluation, output-level scoring, which quantifies hallucination severity but offers limited insight into where and why hallucinations arise in the generation pipeline. We therefore reformulate hallucination evaluation as a diagnostic problem and propose PRISM, a controlled benchmark that disentangles hallucinations into four dimensions: knowledge missing, knowledge errors, reasoning errors, and instruction-following errors, grounded in three stages of generation (memory, instruction, and reasoning). PRISM contains 9,448 instances across 65 tasks and supports fine-grained, stage-aware diagnostic evaluation. Evaluating 24 mainstream open-source and proprietary LLMs, we uncover consistent trade-offs across instruction following, memory retrieval, and logical reasoning, showing that mitigation strategies often improve specific dimensions at the expense of others.We hope PRISM provides a framework for understanding the specific mechanisms behind LLMs hallucinations, ultimately accelerating the development of trustworthy large language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型从对话助手发展到能够处理复杂任务的智能体，它们越来越多地被应用于高风险领域。然而，现有的评估基准大多依赖于混合查询和事后评估，以及基于输出层面的评分方式。这种方式虽然可以量化幻觉的严重程度，但无法揭示幻觉在生成过程中究竟为何会出现。因此，我们将幻觉评估重新定义为一个诊断性问题，并提出了PRISM这一受控评估框架。该框架将幻觉分解为四个维度：知识缺失、知识错误、推理错误和指令遵循错误，这些维度都与生成的三个阶段——记忆、指令和推理——密切相关。PRISM包含了65个任务中的9,448个实例，能够进行细粒度的、考虑生成阶段差异的诊断性评估。通过对24种主流开源和专有语言模型进行评估，我们发现它们在指令遵循、记忆检索和逻辑推理方面存在一致的权衡关系，即缓解策略往往会在某些方面取得改善，而另一方面则会受到影响。我们希望PRISM能提供一个框架，帮助人们理解语言模型产生幻觉的具体机制，从而加速可信赖的大语言模型的开发进程。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VC-Inspector: Advancing Reference-free Evaluation of Video Captions with Factual Analysis
papers.title_zh: VC检查员：推进无需参考的视频字幕评估技术，结合事实分析
papers.authors: Shubhashis Roy Dipta, Tz-Ying Wu, Subarna Tripathi
papers.abstract: We propose VC-Inspector, a lightweight, open-source large multimodal model (LMM) for reference-free evaluation of video captions, with a focus on factual accuracy. Unlike existing metrics that suffer from limited context handling, weak factuality assessment, or reliance on proprietary services, VC-Inspector offers a reproducible, fact-aware alternative that aligns closely with human judgments. To enable robust training and interpretable evaluation, we introduce a systematic approach for generating captions with controllable errors, paired with graded quality scores and explanatory annotations. Experiments show that VC-Inspector achieves state-of-the-art correlation with human judgments, generalizing across diverse domains (e.g., VATEX-Eval, Flickr8K-Expert, and Flickr8K-CF benchmarks) and revealing the potential for caption improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了VC-Inspector这一轻量级、开源的大型多模态模型，用于无需参考的情况下评估视频字幕的准确程度。与那些存在上下文处理能力有限、事实判断能力较弱或依赖专有服务的现有评估方法不同，VC-Inspector提供了一种可复现且注重事实准确性的替代方案，其评估结果与人类判断高度一致。为了实现稳健的训练和易于理解的评估过程，我们提出了一种系统化的方法，用于生成具有可控误差的字幕，并为其配备分级的质量评分和解释性注释。实验表明，VC-Inspector在与人判断的相关性方面达到了最先进的水平，其表现适用于多种领域（如VATEX-Eval、Flickr8K-Expert和Flickr8K-CF基准测试），同时也揭示了改进字幕的潜力。
