papers.title: MQM Re-Annotation: A Technique for Collaborative Evaluation of Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: MQM重新注释：一种用于协作评估机器翻译的技术
papers.authors: Parker Riley, Daniel Deutsch, Mara Finkelstein, Colten DiIanni, Juraj Juraska, Markus Freitag
papers.abstract: Human evaluation of machine translation is in an arms race with translation model quality: as our models get better, our evaluation methods need to be improved to ensure that quality gains are not lost in evaluation noise. To improve annotation quality, we experiment with a two-stage version of the current state-of-the-art translation evaluation paradigm (MQM), which we call MQM re-annotation. In this setup, an annotator reviews and edits a set of prior MQM annotations that may have come from themselves, another human annotator, or an automatic system. We demonstrate that rater behavior in re-annotation aligns with our goals, and that re-annotation results in higher-quality annotations, mostly due to finding errors that were missed during the first pass.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类对机器翻译的评估与翻译模型质量的提升处于一种军备竞赛的状态：随着我们的模型越来越先进，我们的评估方法也需要不断改进，以确保质量上的提升不会因评估过程中的噪声而丧失。为了提高注释的质量，我们尝试了当前最先进的翻译评估方法的双阶段版本，我们将其称为MQM重注释法。在这种方法中，注释者会审查并修改那些可能来自他们自己、其他人类注释者或自动系统的MQM注释数据。我们发现，在重注释过程中，评估者的行为与我们期望的目标是一致的，而且重注释能够产生质量更高的注释，这主要是因为能够发现第一次标注时遗漏的错误。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Multilingual Language Models Encode Script Over Linguistic Structure
papers.title_zh: 多语言语言模型在语言结构之上编码文字
papers.authors: Aastha A K Verma, Anwoy Chatterjee, Mehak Gupta, Tanmoy Chakraborty
papers.abstract: Multilingual language models (LMs) organize representations for typologically and orthographically diverse languages into a shared parameter space, yet the nature of this internal organization remains elusive. In this work, we investigate which linguistic properties — abstract language identity or surface-form cues — shape multilingual representations. To do so, we analyze language-associated units across different model families and scales using the Language Activation Probability Entropy (LAPE) metric, and further decompose activations with Sparse Autoencoders. We find that these units are strongly conditioned on orthography: romanization induces near-disjoint representations that align with neither native-script inputs nor English, while word-order shuffling has limited effect on unit identity. Probing shows that typological structure becomes increasingly accessible in deeper layers, while causal interventions indicate that generation is most sensitive to units that are invariant to surface-form perturbations rather than to units identified by typological alignment alone. Overall, our results suggest that multilingual LMs organize representations around surface form, with linguistic abstraction emerging gradually without collapsing into a unified interlingua.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言模型将不同类型学特征和书写系统的语言特征整合到一个共同的参数空间中。然而，这种内部组织的本质仍然难以捉摸。在这项研究中，我们探讨了哪些语言属性——比如抽象的语言特性或表面形式的特征——会影响多语言模型的表示方式。为此，我们使用语言激活概率熵这一指标，对不同模型家族和不同尺度下的语言相关单元进行了分析，并进一步利用稀疏自编码器对激活信息进行分解。我们发现，这些单元在很大程度上受到书写系统的制约：罗马化会导致产生与本国文字输入或英语都不匹配的表示方式，而词序的随机打乱则对单元的身份影响有限。研究表明，在更深层次上，类型学结构变得更加可识别；同时，因果分析表明，生成模型对那些不受表面形式干扰的单元最为敏感，而不是仅仅基于类型学对齐的单元。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，多语言模型围绕表面形式来组织语言特征，语言的抽象性逐渐显现，而不会完全融合成一种统一的跨语言表示方式。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ChiKhaPo: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Lexical Comprehension and Generation in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ChiKhaPo：一个大规模的多语言基准测试平台，用于评估大型语言模型在词汇理解及词汇生成方面的能力
papers.authors: Emily Chang, Niyati Bafna
papers.abstract: Existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) are largely restricted to high- or mid-resource languages, and often evaluate performance on higher-order tasks in reasoning and generation. However, plenty of evidence points to the fact that LLMs lack basic linguistic competence in the vast majority of the world’s 3800+ written languages. We introduce ChiKhaPo, consisting of eight subtasks of varying difficulty designed to evaluate the lexical comprehension and generation abilities of generative models. ChiKhaPo draws on existing lexicons, monolingual data, and bitext, and provides coverage for 2700+ languages for two word-translation-based subtasks, surpassing any existing benchmark in terms of language coverage. We further show that six SOTA models struggle on our benchmark, and discuss the factors contributing to performance scores, including language family, language resourcedness, task, and comprehension versus generation directions. With ChiKhaPo, we hope to enable and encourage the massively multilingual benchmarking of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前针对大语言模型的标准测试大多局限于资源水平较高或中等的语言，而且这些测试通常只针对推理和生成等高级任务进行评估。然而，有大量证据表明，大语言模型在世界上绝大多数书面语言中缺乏基本的语言能力。我们提出了ChiKhaPo这一评估工具，它由八个难度不同的子任务组成，旨在评估生成模型的词汇理解和生成能力。ChiKhaPo利用了现有的词典、单语数据以及双语数据，能够覆盖2700多种语言，适用于基于单词翻译的两个子任务，其语言覆盖范围超越了任何现有的基准测试。我们还发现，六款最先进的模型在我们的测试集上表现不佳，并分析了影响性能评分的因素，包括语言家族、语言资源状况、任务类型以及理解与生成的方向等。通过ChiKhaPo，我们希望能够推动和鼓励对大语言模型进行大规模的多语言基准测试。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: UniDataBench: Evaluating Data Analytics Agents Across Structured and Unstructured Data
papers.title_zh: UniDataBench：在结构化数据与非结构化数据中评估数据分析工具的性能
papers.authors: Han Weng, Zhou Liu, Yuanfeng Song, Xiaoming Yin, Xing Chen, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: In real-world business environments, data is stored in a variety of sources, including structured relational databases, semi-structured databases, and unstructured files. The ability to extract reasonable insights across these diverse sources is integral to data-driven decision-making. Existing benchmarks, however, are limited in assessing agents’ capabilities across these diverse data types. To address this gap, we introduce UniDataBench, a multi-source benchmark designed to evaluate the performance of data analytics agents in handling diverse data sources. Specifically, UniDataBench is constructed based on real-life industry analysis reports, employing a pipeline to synthesize data that aligns with authentic analytical trends. It encompasses diverse datasets spanning relational databases, CSV files, and NoSQL stores to reflect real-world business settings, and provides a unified framework for evaluating how effectively agents can explore multiple data formats, extract insights, and generate meaningful summaries and recommendations. Based on UniDataBench, we propose a novel LLM-based agent named ReActInsight, an autonomous agent that performs end-to-end analysis over diverse data sources by automatically discovering cross-source linkages, decomposing goals, and generating robust, self-correcting code to extract actionable insights. Our benchmark and agent together provide a framework for facilitating the development of data analytics agents in real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界的商业环境中，数据存储在多种来源中，包括结构化关系数据库、半结构化数据库和非结构化文件。能够从这些不同的数据源中提取有用的信息，是数据驱动决策的关键。然而，现有的评估基准在衡量代理处理各种数据类型的能力方面存在局限性。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了UniDataBench这个多源评估基准，旨在评估数据分析代理在处理不同数据源时的性能。具体来说，UniDataBench是基于真实的行业分析报告构建的，通过特定的数据处理流程来合成符合真实分析趋势的数据。它涵盖了从关系数据库、CSV文件到NoSQL存储的各种数据集，从而反映现实世界中的业务场景。该评估基准提供了一个统一的框架，用于评估代理如何有效地探索多种数据格式、提取洞察力，并生成有意义的总结和推荐方案。基于UniDataBench，我们提出了一个名为ReActInsight的新颖基于大语言模型的代理。这是一个自主代理，它能够对不同的数据源进行端到端的分析，自动发现跨源联系，分解目标，并生成可靠的、自我修正的代码以提取可操作的洞察力。我们的评估基准和代理共同构成了一个框架，有助于推动实际应用中数据分析代理的发展。

papers.title: Beyond Code Pairs: Dialogue-Based Data Generation for LLM Code Translation
papers.title_zh: 超越代码对：基于对话的数据生成技术在大型语言模型代码翻译中的应用
papers.authors: Le Chen, Nuo Xu, Winson Chen, Bin Lei, Pei-Hung Lin, Dunzhi Zhou, Rajeev Thakur, Caiwen Ding, Ali Jannesari, Chunhua Liao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in code translation, yet their performance deteriorates in low-resource programming domains such as Fortran and emerging frameworks like CUDA, where high-quality parallel data are scarce. We present an automated dataset generation pipeline featuring a dual-LLM Questioner–Solver design that incorporates external knowledge from compilers and runtime feedback. Beyond traditional source–target code pair datasets, our approach additionally generates (1) verified translations with unit tests for assessing functional consistency, and (2) multi-turn dialogues that capture the reasoning process behind translation refinement. Applied to Fortran→C++ and C++→CUDA, the pipeline yields 3.64k and 3.93k dialogues, respectively. Fine-tuning on this data yields dramatic improvements in functional correctness, boosting unit test success rates by over 56% on the challenging C++-to-CUDA task. We show that the generated data enables a 7B open-weight model to significantly outperform larger proprietary systems on key metrics like compilation success.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码翻译方面展现出了卓越的能力，但在诸如Fortran这样的低资源编程领域，以及像CUDA这样的新兴框架中，其性能会有所下降——因为这些领域缺乏高质量的并行数据。我们提出了一种自动数据集生成流程，该流程采用了双语言模型的设计，结合了编译器的外部知识和运行时反馈。除了传统的源目标代码对数据集之外，我们的方法还生成了以下两种类型的数据：（1）经过验证的翻译结果，这些翻译结果具有单元测试，可用于评估其功能一致性；（2）多轮对话，这些对话能够捕捉到翻译优化过程中的推理过程。在Fortran→C++和C++→CUDA的任务中，该流程分别生成了3.64千条和3.93千条对话。通过对这些数据进行微调，功能正确性得到了显著提升，在具有挑战性的C++到CUDA任务中，单元测试的成功率提高了超过56%。我们证明，通过这种生成的数据，一个拥有70亿参数的开放权重模型能够在诸如编译成功率等关键指标上显著优于那些更庞大的专有系统。

papers.title: MM-PoisonRAG: Disrupting Multimodal RAG with Local and Global Knowledge Poisoning Attacks
papers.title_zh: MM-PoisonRAG：利用局部与全局知识注入攻击来破坏多模态RAG机制
papers.authors: Hyeonjeong Ha, Qiusi Zhan, Jeonghwan Kim, Dimitrios Bralios, Saikrishna Sanniboina, Nanyun Peng, Kai-Wei Chang, Daniel Kang, Heng Ji
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a common practice in multimodal large language models (MLLM) to enhance factual grounding and reduce hallucination. Yet, its reliance on retrieval exposes MLLMs to knowledge poisoning attacks, in which adversaries deliberately inject malicious multimodal content into external knowledge bases to steer models toward generating incorrect or even harmful responses. We present MM-PoisonRAG, a framework to systematically study the vulnerability of multimodal RAG under knowledge poisoning. Specifically, we design two novel attack strategies: Localized Poisoning Attack (LPA), which implants targeted, query-specific multimodal misinformation to manipulate outputs toward attacker-controlled responses, and Globalized Poisoning Attack (GPA), which uses a single, untargeted adversarial injection to broadly corrupt reasoning and collapse generation quality across all queries. Extensive experiments on diverse tasks, multimodal RAG components, and attacker access levels reveal severe vulnerabilities: LPA achieves up to 56% attack success rate even under restricted access, and transfers effectively across four different retrievers without re-optimizing the adversaries. GPA completely disrupts model generation to 0% accuracy with just one poisoned content. Moreover, both LPA and GPA bypass existing defenses, underscoring the fragility of multimodal RAG and establishing MM-PoisonRAG as a foundation for future research on securing RAG frameworks against multimodal knowledge poisoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为多模态大语言模型中的常见技术，用于增强事实性信息并减少幻觉的产生。然而，其依赖检索的特性使得多模态大语言模型容易受到知识污染攻击的威胁。在这种攻击中，攻击者会故意向外部知识库中注入恶意的多模态内容，以引导模型产生错误甚至有害的响应。我们提出了MM-PoisonRAG框架，旨在系统研究多模态RAG在知识污染下的脆弱性。具体来说，我们设计了两种新的攻击策略：局部污染攻击（LPA），该攻击会注入针对特定查询的多模态错误信息，从而操纵模型的输出以符合攻击者的意图；全局污染攻击（GPA），该攻击则通过一次无针对性的注入来全面破坏模型的推理能力，导致所有查询的生成质量下降。在多种任务、不同多模态RAG组件以及不同攻击者访问权限水平下的广泛实验表明，这种攻击具有严重的危害性：即使在有限的访问权限下，LPA的攻击成功率仍可达56%，而且这种攻击可以在四种不同的检索器之间有效传播，而无需攻击者进行重新优化。而GPA则能仅通过一次被污染的内容就使模型的生成准确率降至0%。此外，LPA和GPA都能突破现有的防御机制，这进一步凸显了多模态RAG的脆弱性。因此，MM-PoisonRAG为未来研究如何保护RAG框架免受多模态知识污染提供了坚实的基础。

papers.title: IterCOMP: Reasoning-aware Adaptive Prompt Compression for Multi-hop Question Answering
papers.title_zh: IterCOMP：一种基于推理意识的自适应提示压缩技术，适用于多跳问答场景
papers.authors: JungMin Yun, YoungBin Kim
papers.abstract: Multi-hop question answering requires complex reasoning across multiple evidence segments, which often overwhelms retrieval-augmented generation systems with lengthy and noisy contexts, thereby undermining both efficiency and accuracy. While existing prompt compression methods attempt to address this issue, they are typically designed for single-turn queries and fail to capture interdependent reasoning steps. We propose IterCOMP, a unified, training-free prompt compression framework that incorporates multi-hop reasoning within an iterative compression loop. IterCOMP decomposes documents into evidence segments, evaluates question answerability, and generates targeted follow-up questions to iteratively integrate essential evidence, producing a compact, reasoning-oriented prompt. Experiments on MusiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA demonstrate that IterCOMP achieves substantial improvements in Exact Match and F1 scores while reducing the token budget, outperforming existing baselines and exhibiting robustness as reasoning complexity increases.
papers.abstract_zh: 多跳问答需要跨多个证据片段进行复杂的推理过程，这往往会让基于检索增强的生成系统在处理冗长且信息混杂的上下文时面临困难，从而影响到系统的效率和准确性。虽然现有的提示压缩方法试图解决这一问题，但它们通常适用于单轮次的查询，无法捕捉到相互依赖的推理步骤。我们提出了IterCOMP这一统一的、无需训练的提示压缩框架，该框架在迭代压缩过程中融入了多跳推理机制。IterCOMP将文档分解为不同的证据片段，评估问题的可回答性，并生成有针对性的后续问题，以逐步整合关键证据，从而生成出一个简洁且注重推理的提示。在MusiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA和HotpotQA上的实验表明，IterCOMP在减少令牌预算的同时，显著提升了精确匹配率和F1分数，其性能优于现有的基线方法，并且随着推理复杂性的增加，其表现依然保持稳定。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Do LLMs Really Memorize Personally Identifiable Information? Revisiting PII Leakage with a Cue-Controlled Memorization Framework
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型真的会记住个人可识别信息吗？基于提示控制式记忆框架重新审视个人信息泄露问题
papers.authors: Xiaoyu Luo, Yiyi Chen, Qiongxiu Li, Johannes Bjerva
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been reported to “leak” Personally Identifiable Information (PII), with successful PII reconstruction often interpreted as evidence of memorization. We propose a principled revision of memorization evaluation for LLMs, arguing that PII leakage should be evaluated under low lexical cue conditions, where target PII cannot be reconstructed through prompt-induced generalization or pattern completion. We formalize Cue-Resistant Memorization (CRM) as a cue-controlled evaluation framework and a necessary condition for valid memorization evaluation, explicitly conditioning on prompt-target overlap cues. Using CRM, we conduct a large-scale multilingual re-evaluation of PII leakage across 32 languages and multiple memorization paradigms. Revisiting reconstruction-based settings, including verbatim prefix-suffix completion and associative reconstruction, we find that their apparent effectiveness is driven primarily by direct surface-form cues rather than by true memorization. When such cues are controlled for, reconstruction success diminishes substantially. We further examine cue-free generation and membership inference, both of which exhibit extremely low true positive rates. Overall, our results suggest that previously reported PII leakage is better explained by cue-driven behavior than by genuine memorization, highlighting the importance of cue-controlled evaluation for reliably quantifying privacy-relevant memorization in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）被报告会“泄露”个人可识别信息（PII）。成功的PII重建往往被视为记忆能力的证据。我们提出了一种针对LLM的记忆评估的改进方法，认为在词汇提示较少的情况下，应该对PII的泄露情况进行评估，此时目标PII无法通过提示引发的泛化或模式补全来重建。我们将“抗提示记忆”定义为一种基于提示控制的评估框架，它是有效记忆评估的必要条件，该框架明确考虑了提示与目标的重叠关系。通过采用这种评估方法，我们对32种语言以及多种记忆范式下的PII泄露情况进行了大规模重新评估。重新审视基于重建的评估方式，包括逐字的前缀-后缀补全和联想重建等，我们发现它们的有效性主要源于表面的形式线索，而非真正的记忆能力。当这些线索被控制住时，重建的成功率会显著下降。我们还研究了无提示的生成和成员资格推断，这两种方式都表现出极低的真正阳性率。总体而言，我们的结果表明，之前报告的PII泄露现象更可能是由于提示驱动的行为导致的，而非真正的记忆能力。这凸显了使用提示控制评估方法对于可靠量化LLM中与隐私相关的记忆行为的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Observations and Remedies for Large Language Model Bias in Self-Consuming Performative Loop
papers.title_zh: 对大型语言模型在自消费型执行循环中存在的偏见的相关观察与解决方案
papers.authors: Yaxuan Wang, Zhongteng Cai, Yujia Bao, Xueru Zhang, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has led to growing interest in using synthetic data to train future models. However, this creates a self-consuming retraining loop, where models are trained on their own outputs and may cause performance drops and induce emerging biases. In real-world applications, previously deployed LLMs may influence the data they generate, leading to a dynamic system driven by user feedback. For example, if a model continues to underserve users from a group, less query data will be collected from this particular demographic of users. In this study, we introduce the concept of Self-Consuming Performative Loop (SCPL) and investigate the role of synthetic data in shaping bias during these dynamic iterative training processes under controlled performative feedback. This controlled setting is motivated by the inaccessibility of real-world user preference data from dynamic production systems, and enables us to isolate and analyze feedback-driven bias evolution in a principled manner. We focus on two types of loops, including the typical retraining setting and the incremental fine-tuning setting, which is largely underexplored. Through experiments on three real-world tasks, we find that the performative loop increases preference bias and decreases disparate bias. We design a reward-based rejection sampling strategy to mitigate the bias, moving towards more trustworthy self-improving systems. The code is available at https://github.com/UCSC-REAL/SCPL.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展使得人们越来越倾向于使用合成数据来训练未来的模型。然而，这种做法会形成一个自我消耗的再训练循环，即模型在自身的输出上进行训练，这可能导致性能下降并引发新的偏见。在实际应用中，之前部署的LLM可能会影响其生成的数据，从而形成一种由用户反馈驱动的动态系统。例如，如果某个模型继续无法满足某个群体的用户需求，那么来自该群体的查询数据就会越来越少。在这项研究中，我们提出了“自我消耗性执行循环”的概念，并探讨了在受控的执行反馈下，合成数据在塑造偏见过程中的作用。这种受控环境是由于现实世界中的用户偏好数据难以从动态生产系统中获取而提出的，它使我们能够以一种有原则的方式隔离和分析由反馈驱动的偏见演变过程。我们重点关注两种类型的循环：典型的再训练设置和增量微调设置，这两种设置目前尚未得到充分研究。通过对三个现实世界的任务进行实验，我们发现执行循环会增加偏好偏见，同时减少差异性偏见。我们设计了一种基于奖励的拒绝采样策略来减轻偏见，从而朝着更可信的自我改进系统方向发展。相关代码可访问于https://github.com/UCSC-REAL/SCPL.git。

papers.title: RAG-on-a-Diet: A Reinforcement Learning-Based Dynamic Resource Optimization Framework for RAG
papers.title_zh: 节食期间的RAG：一种基于强化学习的动态资源优化框架
papers.authors: Hongwen Ding, Yizheng Zhao
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the backbone of knowledge-intensive multi-hop question answering, yet routing every sub-query through a frontier model turns every hop into a cost multiplier and makes real-world deployment prohibitively expensive. Existing remedies either fix the retrieval schedule, route once at the query level, or lack a principled stopping rule, leaving a critical gap: no framework adapts, hop by hop, to how a trajectory actually unfolds. We introduce RAG-on-a-Diet, a lightweight reinforcement-learning agent that treats each reasoning hop as an independent decision and selects the smallest model (Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-30B, or DS-R1-671B) sufficient for it, guided by entity- and confidence-aware features. Trained via behavior cloning followed by PPO under a five-component cost-aware reward (final, cumulative, step-wise, cost, balance) and coupled with an explicit two-tier termination policy (5-hop cap plus a tau=0.3 confidence gate), the agent carves a Pareto-optimal efficiency frontier. On HotpotQA it cuts Monetary Inference Cost by 60.07% against IRCoT with only a 3.7% F1 drop; it matches Adaptive-RAG’s F1 at 37.30% lower cost; and it attains up to 2.33x higher Quality-per-Monetary-Cost. Consistent gains on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, CRAG, and Bamboogle confirm strong out-of-distribution robustness, setting a new paradigm for fine-grained resource control in multi-hop RAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为知识密集型多跳问题回答的核心技术。然而，如果让每个子查询都通过前沿模型进行处理，那么每一次跳转都会增加成本，使得实际部署变得极其昂贵。现有的解决方案要么只能固定检索调度方式，要么只能在查询层面进行路由处理，或者缺乏有效的停止规则，这就导致了一个关键的问题：没有任何框架能够根据实际情况来动态调整每个跳跃步骤。我们提出了一种名为“RAG-on-a-Diet”的轻量级强化学习代理，它将每个推理步骤视为一个独立的决策过程，并选择最合适的模型规模（如Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-30B或DS-R1-671B）来进行处理，同时利用实体感知和置信度感知特征来指导模型的选择。该代理通过行为克隆训练，然后在五重成本感知奖励机制下使用PPO算法进行优化，同时还采用了明确的双层终止策略（限制最大跳跃次数为5次，并设有0.3的置信度门限）。在HotpotQA任务上，该代理将货币推理成本降低了60.07%，而F1分数仅下降了3.7%；其成本比Adaptive-RAG的F1值低37.30%；同时，其质量与货币成本的比率高达2.33倍。在MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA、CRAG和Bamboogle等任务上的持续表现表明，该代理具有出色的鲁棒性，为多跳RAG中的细粒度资源控制提供了新的思路。

papers.title: MTSQL-R1: Towards Long-Horizon Multi-Turn Text-to-SQL via Agentic Training
papers.title_zh: MTSQL-R1：通过智能训练实现长视界多轮文本转SQL技术
papers.authors: Taicheng Guo, Hai Wang, Chaochun Liu, Mohsen Golalikhani, Xin Chen, Xiangliang Zhang, Chandan K. Reddy
papers.abstract: Multi-turn Text-to-SQL aims to translate a user’s conversational utterances into executable SQL while preserving dialogue coherence and grounding to the target schema. However, most existing systems only regard this task as a simple text translation task and follow a short-horizon paradigm, generating a query per turn without execution, explicit verification, and refinement, which leads to non-executable or incoherent outputs. We present MTSQL-R1, an agentic training framework for long-horizon multi-turn Text-to-SQL. We cast the task as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) in which an agent interacts with (i) a database for execution feedback and (ii) a persistent dialogue memory for coherence verification, performing an iterative propose->execute->verify->refine cycle until all checks pass. Experiments on CoSQL and SParC demonstrate that MTSQL-R1 consistently outperforms strong baselines, highlighting the importance of environment-driven verification and memory-guided refinement for conversational semantic parsing. Full recipes (including code, trained models, reasoning trajectories, etc.) will be released upon acceptance to contribute to community research.
papers.abstract_zh: 多轮文本转SQL旨在将用户的对话内容转化为可执行的SQL语句，同时保持对话的连贯性和与目标数据库的匹配性。然而，目前大多数系统仅将此任务视为简单的文本翻译任务，采用短视化的处理方式——每轮对话只生成一条查询语句，而无需执行、验证或完善，这导致生成的查询结果往往不可执行或缺乏逻辑一致性。我们提出了MTSQL-R1这一用于长视距多轮文本转SQL的智能训练框架。我们将该任务建模为一个马尔可夫决策过程，其中智能体分别与数据库进行交互以获取执行反馈，并借助持久化的对话记忆来验证对话的连贯性。智能体会通过迭代性的“提议->执行->验证->完善”循环来逐步优化查询结果，直到所有检查都通过为止。在CoSQL和SParC上的实验表明，MTSQL-R1的表现始终优于强大的基线系统，这充分证明了环境驱动的验证机制和记忆引导的优化方法对于会话语义解析的重要性。完整的实现方案（包括代码、训练好的模型、推理轨迹等）将在接受后发布，以推动相关领域的研究发展。

papers.title: The Subjectivity of Respect in Police Traffic Stops: Modeling Community Perspectives in Body-Worn Camera Footage
papers.title_zh: 在警察拦车过程中“尊重”的主观性：通过随身摄像机录像来模拟社区民众的观点
papers.authors: Preni Golazizian, Elnaz Rahmati, Jackson Trager, Zhivar Sourati, Nona Ghazizadeh, Georgios Chochlakis, Jose J. Alcocer, Kerby Bennett, Aarya Vijay Devnani, Parsa Hejabi, Harry G. Muttram, Akshay Kiran Padte, Mehrshad Saadatinia, Chenhao Wu, Alireza Salkhordeh Ziabari, Michael Sierra-Arévalo, Nicholas Weller, Shrikanth Narayanan, Benjamin A.T. Graham, Morteza Dehghani
papers.abstract: Traffic stops are among the most frequent police–civilian interactions, and body-worn cameras (BWCs) provide a unique record of how these encounters unfold. Respect is a central dimension of these interactions, shaping public trust and perceived legitimacy, yet its interpretation is inherently subjective and shaped by lived experience, rendering community-specific perspectives a critical consideration. Leveraging unprecedented access to Los Angeles Police Department BWC footage, we introduce the first large-scale traffic-stop dataset annotated with respect ratings and free-text rationales from multiple perspectives. By sampling annotators from police-affiliated, justice-system-impacted, and non-affiliated Los Angeles residents, we enable the systematic study of perceptual differences across diverse communities. To this end, (i) we develop a domain-specific evaluation rubric grounded in procedural justice theory, LAPD training materials, and extensive fieldwork; (ii) we introduce a criterion-driven preference data construction framework for perspective-consistent alignment, and (ii) we propose a perspective-aware modeling framework that predicts personalized respect ratings and generates annotator-specific rationales for both officers and civilian drivers from traffic-stop transcripts. Across all three annotator groups, our approach improves both rating prediction performance and rationale alignment. Our perspective-aware framework enables law enforcement to better understand diverse community expectations, providing a vital tool for building public trust and procedural legitimacy.
papers.abstract_zh: 交通拦截是警察与市民之间最常见的互动场景之一，而随身摄像头为这些互动的整个过程提供了独特的记录。尊重是这类互动的核心要素，它影响着公众的信任感和合法性感知。然而，尊重的评判本质上具有主观性，并受到个人经历的影响，因此不同社区的观点差异也至关重要。通过利用洛杉矶警察局随身摄像头的海量数据，我们首次推出了一个包含尊重程度评价以及从多个角度给出的自由文本说明的大规模交通拦截数据集。通过选取来自警察机构、受司法系统影响以及非警察机构的洛杉矶居民作为标注者，我们能够系统地研究不同社区在尊重方面的差异。为此，我们制定了基于程序正义理论、洛杉矶警察局培训材料以及大量实地调研成果制定的领域特定评估标准；同时，我们还提出了一种以视角一致性为目标的偏好数据构建框架。此外，我们还提出了一个考虑视角的建模框架，该框架能够预测个性化的尊重评分，并为警察和市民驾驶员提供具体的说明。在所有三个标注群体中，我们的方法都提升了评分预测准确性和说明的一致性。这种考虑视角的建模框架有助于执法部门更好地理解不同社区的期望，从而成为建立公众信任和程序合法性的重要工具。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLM-Based Multi-Task Bangla Hate Speech Detection: Type, Severity, and Target
papers.title_zh: 基于LLM的多任务孟加拉语仇恨言论检测：类型、严重程度及目标分析
papers.authors: Md Arid Hasan, Firoj Alam, Md Fahad Hossain, Usman Naseem, Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed
papers.abstract: Online social media platforms have become central to communication and information exchange, however, they also serve as fertile ground for hate speech, offensive language, and bullying targeting individuals and communities. Such content undermines online safety and inclusion, underscoring the need for reliable detection systems—especially in low-resource languages with limited moderation tools. For Bangla, existing work provides valuable resources and models, however, they are mostly single-task (e.g., binary hate/offense) with narrow coverage of key dimensions such as type, severity, and target. We address these gaps by introducing the first multi-task Bangla hate-speech dataset, BanglaMultiHate, one of the largest manually annotated dataset to date. Using this resource, we performed a comparative study across different baselines, monolingual pretrained models, and LLMs under zero-shot, few-shot, and LoRA fine-tuning settings. Our findings show that while LoRA-tuned LLMs rival BanglaBERT, culturally grounded pretraining remains crucial for robust performance. Overall, BanglaMultiHate establishes a stronger benchmark for hate speech detection in low-resource contexts. All data and scripts are released for reproducibility.
papers.abstract_zh: 在线社交媒体平台已成为沟通和信息交流的核心工具，然而，它们也成为了仇恨言论、冒犯性语言以及针对个人和社区的霸凌行为的滋生地。这类内容破坏了网络安全和包容性，因此迫切需要可靠的检测系统——尤其是在资源匮乏、监管工具有限的语言环境中。对于孟加拉语来说，现有的研究提供了宝贵的资源和模型，但这些模型大多只具备单一任务功能（例如，区分仇恨与正常言论），对诸如类型、严重程度和目标等关键维度的覆盖较为有限。为了弥补这些不足，我们推出了首个多任务孟加拉语仇恨言论数据集BanglaMultiHate，这是迄今为止规模最大的手动标注数据集之一。利用这一资源，我们对不同基线模型、单语言预训练模型以及基于LoRA微调的大语言模型进行了比较研究。我们的研究发现，虽然经过LoRA微调的大语言模型可以与BanglaBERT相媲美，但基于文化根基的预训练仍然对实现稳健的性能至关重要。总体而言，BanglaMultiHate为在资源匮乏环境下的仇恨言论检测建立了更强的基准。所有数据和脚本均已公开，以便其他研究人员进行复现研究。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MMSciCode: Real-world Evaluation of Multilingual Multi-Discipline Scientific Research Coding
papers.title_zh: MMSciCode：多语言、多学科科学研究编码在实际应用中的评估
papers.authors: Xue Xia, Zheyuan Yang, Arman Cohan, Yilun Zhao
papers.abstract: We introduce MMSciCode, a comprehensive expert-level, multilingual multi-discipline benchmark for evaluating foundation models in scientific code generation. It includes 624 expert-annotated research coding problems spanning six core scientific disciplines. Compared to prior benchmarks, MMSciCode features three key advancements. First, it challenges models to integrate domain-specific knowledge with algorithmic reasoning to implement core functions from research papers, moving beyond the isolated, general-purpose coding tasks typically assessed in current benchmarks. Second, each problem is meticulously annotated by domain experts through a rigorous paper-grounded process, with strict quality controls implemented to ensure dataset integrity and authenticity. Finally, each problem is equipped with comprehensive unit test suites and containerized environments, enabling reproducible and diagnostic evaluation of both functional correctness and domain validity. We conduct an extensive evaluation of 28 state-of-the-art foundation models and 2 agentic coding tools on MMSciCode. Our results reveal that even the best non-agentic model achieves only around 15% accuracy, while the top agentic coding tool reaches 32.2%, both still far below human expert performance of 68.8%. Through comprehensive error analyses and case studies, we identify substantial performance gaps between models and human experts, providing actionable insights for advancing expert-level scientific code generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了MMSciCode，这是一个全面的、面向专家的、多语言的、多学科的基准测试工具，用于评估科学代码生成中的基础模型。该测试包含624个由专家标注的研究编码问题，涵盖了六个核心科学领域。与之前的基准测试相比，MMSciCode具有三个显著的特点。首先，它要求模型将特定领域的知识与算法推理相结合，以实现研究论文中的核心功能，这超越了当前基准测试中通常只评估的孤立的、通用性编码任务。其次，每个问题都由领域专家通过严格的基于论文的标注流程进行细致标注，同时实施严格的质量控制，以确保数据集的完整性和真实性。最后，每个问题都配备了全面的单元测试套件和容器化环境，使得对功能的正确性和领域适用性进行可复制且准确的评估成为可能。我们对28种先进的基础模型和2种智能编码工具在MMSciCode上的表现进行了广泛的评估。结果表明，即使是最优秀的非智能模型也只能达到约15%的准确率，而最先进的智能编码工具则达到了32.2%的准确率，这两个数值仍然远低于人类专家68.8%的表现水平。通过详细的错误分析和案例研究，我们发现模型与人类专家之间存在显著的性能差距，这为提升科学代码生成的专家级水平提供了可行的见解。

papers.title: CURA: Clinical Uncertainty Risk Alignment for Language Model–Based Risk Prediction
papers.title_zh: CURA：基于语言模型的风险预测中的临床不确定性风险对齐机制
papers.authors: Sizhe Wang, Ziqi Xu, Claire Najjuuko, Charles Alba, Chenyang Lu
papers.abstract: Clinical language models (LMs) are increasingly applied to support clinical risk prediction from free-text notes, yet their uncertainty estimates often remain poorly calibrated and clinically unreliable. In this work, we propose Clinical Uncertainty Risk Alignment (CURA), a framework that aligns clinical LM-based risk estimates and uncertainty with both individual error likelihoods and cohort-level ambiguities. CURA first fine-tunes domain-specific clinical LMs to obtain task-adapted patient embeddings, and then performs uncertainty fine-tuning of a multi-head classifier using a bi-level uncertainty objective. Specifically, an individual-level calibration term aligns predictive uncertainty with each patient’s likelihood of error, while a cohort-aware regularizer pulls risk estimates toward event rates in their local neighborhoods in the embedding space and places extra weight on ambiguous cohorts near the decision boundary. We further show that this cohort-aware term can be interpreted as a cross-entropy loss with neighborhood-informed soft labels, providing a label-smoothing view of our method. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-IV clinical risk prediction tasks across various clinical LMs show that CURA consistently improves calibration metrics without substantially compromising discrimination. Further analysis illustrates that CURA reduces overconfident false reassurance and yields more trustworthy uncertainty estimates for downstream clinical decision support.
papers.abstract_zh: 临床语言模型在支持基于自由文本记录的临床风险预测方面得到了广泛应用。然而，这些模型的不确定性估计往往校准不足，导致临床效果不可靠。在这项研究中，我们提出了“临床不确定性风险对齐”框架（CURA）。该框架将基于临床语言模型的风险估计与不确定性进行对齐，同时考虑个体错误概率以及群体层面的模糊性。CURA首先针对特定领域的临床语言模型进行微调，以获得适用于特定任务的病人嵌入数据；然后采用双层不确定性目标对多头分类器进行不确定性调整。具体来说，个体级别的校准项将预测的不确定性与每个病人的错误概率相结合；而群体感知的正则化项则使风险估计更贴近嵌入空间中与其邻近区域的事件发生率，并对决策边界附近的模糊群体给予额外的权重。我们还发现，这种群体感知机制可以解释为带有邻域信息的软标签交叉熵损失，从而为我们的方法提供了更加平滑的标签表现。在MIMIC-IV临床风险预测任务上的广泛实验表明，CURA能够持续改善校准指标，同时不会显著影响分类能力。进一步分析显示，CURA能够有效减少过度自信的错误判断，为下游临床决策支持提供更可靠的不确定性估计。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Unlocking the Black Box of Latent Reasoning: An Interpretability-Guided Approach to Intervention
papers.title_zh: 破解潜在推理的“黑箱”：一种以可解释性为导向的干预方法
papers.authors: Shuochen Chang, Tong Bai, Xiaofeng Zhang, Qianli Ma, Qingyang Liu, Zhaohe Liao, Yibo Miao, Li Niu
papers.abstract: Latent reasoning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform multi-step inference within continuous hidden states, offering efficiency gains over explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, the opacity of these continuous thought vectors hinders their reliability and controllability. This paper bridges the gap between mechanistic interpretability and actionable control. We first present a systematic analysis using structural, causal, and geometric probes, revealing that latent vectors encode compressed, faithful representations of reasoning steps, with early vectors acting as critical causal hubs. Building on this, we operationalize these interpretability insights into a suite of training-free, decode-time interventions that refine the latent reasoning process by imposing the identified geometric and semantic priors. Extensive experiments across multiple model scales and diverse task domains demonstrate that our approaches consistently improve reasoning accuracy. Our interpretability-guided interventions consistently unlock latent capabilities and improve reasoning accuracy without any parameter updates.
papers.abstract_zh: 潜在推理使得大语言模型能够在连续的隐藏状态中进行多步推理，相比显式的思维链推理方式，这种方式能够提升推理效率。然而，这些连续思维向量的模糊性却限制了它们的可靠性和可控性。本文旨在弥合机制可解释性与可操作控制之间的差距。我们首先通过结构分析、因果分析和几何分析等方法，系统地揭示了潜在向量如何编码出对推理步骤的压缩且准确的表示，而早期的向量则扮演着关键的因果枢纽角色。在此基础上，我们将这些可解释性洞察转化为一系列无需训练的、在解码时进行的干预措施，通过这些干预措施，我们可以通过对已识别的几何和语义先验信息的应用，来优化潜在推理过程。通过在多个模型规模及不同任务领域进行的大量实验验证，我们发现我们的方法能够持续提高推理的准确性。我们的可解释性引导式干预措施能够在不进行任何参数更新的情况下，有效释放潜在的推理能力并提升推理准确性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EthicMind: A Risk-Aware Framework for Ethical-Emotional Alignment in Multi-Turn Dialogue
papers.title_zh: EthicMind：一种注重风险管理的框架，旨在实现多轮对话中的伦理与情感协调
papers.authors: Jiawen Deng, Wei Li, Wentao Zhang, Ziyun Jiao, Fuji Ren
papers.abstract: Intelligent dialogue systems are increasingly deployed in emotionally and ethically sensitive settings, where failures in either emotional attunement or ethical judgment can cause significant harm. Existing dialogue models typically address empathy and ethical safety in isolation, and often fail to adapt their behavior as ethical risk and user emotion evolve across multi-turn interactions. We formulate ethical-emotional alignment in dialogue as an explicit turn-level decision problem, and propose EthicMind, a risk-aware framework that implements this formulation in multi-turn dialogue at inference time. At each turn, EthicMind jointly analyzes ethical risk signals and user emotion, plans a high-level response strategy, and generates context-sensitive replies that balance ethical guidance with emotional engagement, without requiring additional model training. To evaluate alignment behavior under ethically complex interactions, we introduce a risk-stratified, multi-turn evaluation protocol with a context-aware user simulation procedure. Experimental results show that EthicMind achieves more consistent ethical guidance and emotional engagement than competitive baselines, particularly in high-risk and morally ambiguous scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 智能对话系统越来越多地被应用于情感和道德上非常敏感的场景中，在这些场景中，如果无法在情感共鸣或道德判断方面取得成功，就可能会造成严重伤害。现有的对话模型通常单独处理同理心和道德安全性的问题，往往无法随着道德风险和用户情绪的变化而调整自己的行为。我们将对话中的道德-情感一致性问题定义为一个明确的回合级决策问题，并提出了EthicMind这一框架。该框架能够在多轮对话过程中实施这种策略，同时考虑到各种风险因素。在每个回合中，EthicMind会综合分析道德风险信号和用户情绪，制定高层次的应对策略，并生成符合上下文要求的回复，从而在提供道德指导的同时也能保持与用户的情感互动，而无需额外的模型训练。为了评估在道德复杂的交互情境下的对齐行为，我们引入了一种基于风险的、多轮次的评估方法，并采用了一种考虑上下文的用户模拟程序。实验结果表明，EthicMind在提供道德指导和保持情感互动方面表现得比竞争对手的模型更为稳定，尤其是在高风险和道德模糊的场景中。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Resolving the Security-Auditability Dilemma with Auditable Latent Chain-of-Thought Alignment
papers.title_zh: 通过可审计的潜在思维链对齐解决方案，解决安全性与可问责性之间的矛盾问题
papers.authors: Guan Wang, Biyu Zhou, Xuehai Tang, Jizhong Han, Songlin Hu
papers.abstract: To address the increasingly severe safety risk of large language models (LLMs), reasoning-based safety alignment methods have emerged. These methods overcome the limitations of ’shallow alignment’ by exposing the model’s Chain-of-Thought (CoT), enabling auditability of safety reasoning process through both training-phase supervision and post-generation verification. However, this transparency creates a critical vulnerability, a tension we define as the Security Auditability Dilemma: while explicit reasoning is a prerequisite for safety, its textual Auditable paradoxically transforms it into an optimization target for adaptive attackers and induces the model to unintentionally copy harmful content from its own reasoning context. To address this, we propose Auditable Latent CoT Alignment (ALCA), a framework that decouples internal reasoning from external output. ALCA shifts the safety deliberation process into a continuous latent space. This allows the safety reasoning process to guide the generation of harmless outputs, while eliminates the discrete textual surface that facilitates internal copying and adaptive attack. Yet, this process is not a black box. we introduce a restricted Self-Decoding mechanism that allows the model to reconstruct its latent reasoning into human-readable text for supervision under specific guidance. Extensive experiments show that ALCA achieves robustness alignment, reducing the success rate of adaptive jailbreak attacks by over 40% compared to strong baselines, while preserving performance. Our framework presents a path toward building LLMs that are both robustly secure and auditable.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了应对大语言模型日益严重的安全风险，基于推理的安全对齐方法应运而生。这些方法通过揭示模型的思维链（CoT），克服了“浅层对齐”的局限性，使得安全推理过程可以通过训练阶段的监督以及生成后的验证来进行审计。然而，这种透明度也带来了一个关键漏洞，我们将其称为“安全性审计困境”：虽然明确的推理是安全性的前提条件，但文本形式的审计却反而使其成为攻击者进行自适应攻击的目标，并可能导致模型无意中复制有害内容。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了可审计的潜在思维链对齐（ALCA）框架。该框架将内部推理与外部输出分离开来。ALCA将安全性决策过程转移到一个连续的潜在空间中，从而让安全推理过程能够指导无害输出的生成，同时消除了促进内部复制和自适应攻击的离散文本表面。不过，这个过程并非黑箱操作。我们引入了一种受限的自解码机制，使得模型能够将潜在推理重新构建成人类可读的文本，以便在特定指导下进行监督。大量实验表明，与强大的基线相比，ALCA能够实现稳健的对齐效果，将自适应越狱攻击的成功率降低超过40%，同时保持了性能。我们的框架为构建既具有强大安全性又具备可审计性的大语言模型提供了途径。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ART: Attention Replacement Technique to Improve Factuality in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 艺术：注意力替换技术，用于提升大语言模型的事实准确性
papers.authors: Ziqin Luo, Yihao Quan, Xiaofeng Zhang, Xiaosong Yuan, Chen Shen
papers.abstract: Hallucination in large language models (LLMs) continues to be a significant issue, particularly in tasks like question answering, where models often generate plausible yet incorrect or irrelevant information. Although various methods have been proposed to mitigate hallucinations, the relationship between attention patterns and hallucinations has not been fully explored. In this paper, we analyze the distribution of attention scores across each layer and attention head of LLMs, revealing a common and intriguing phenomenon: Shallow layers of LLMs primarily rely on uniform attention patterns, where the model distributes its attention evenly across the entire sequence. This uniform attention pattern can lead to hallucinations, as the model fails to focus on the most relevant information. To mitigate this issue, we propose a training-free method called Attention Replacement Technique (ART), which replaces these uniform attention patterns in the shallow layers with local attention patterns. This change directs the model to focus more on the relevant contexts, thus reducing hallucinations. Through extensive experiments, ART demonstrates significant reductions in hallucinations across multiple LLM architectures, proving its effectiveness and generalizability without requiring fine-tuning or additional training data.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型中的幻觉问题仍然是一个重要的问题，尤其是在问答任务中，模型常常生成看似合理但错误或无关的信息。尽管已经提出了多种方法来减轻幻觉现象，但注意力模式与幻觉之间的关系尚未得到充分研究。在本文中，我们分析了大语言模型各层及注意力头的注意力得分分布，发现了一个有趣的现象：大语言模型的浅层主要依赖统一的注意力模式，模型将其注意力均匀分布在整个序列上。这种统一的注意力模式可能导致幻觉，因为模型无法专注于最相关的信息。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种无需训练的方法——注意力替换技术。该方法用局部注意力模式替代浅层中的统一注意力模式，从而让模型更加关注相关上下文，进而减少幻觉的发生。通过大量实验表明，注意力替换技术在多种大语言模型架构中显著降低了幻觉现象，证明了其有效性及通用性，且无需进行微调或额外的训练数据即可实现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: More Thinking, Less Talking: Internalizing Deliberative Safety into LLM Parameters
papers.title_zh: 少说话，多思考：将深思熟虑的安全性理念融入大型语言模型的参数中
papers.authors: Guan Wang, Xuehai Tang, Biyu Zhou, Jizhong Han, Songlin Hu
papers.abstract: Prevailing safety alignment methods still leave Large Language Models (LLMs) vulnerable to sophisticated jailbreak attacks. To bolster defenses, explicit reasoning mechanisms like Safety-oriented Chain-of-Thought (SCoT) have emerged, significantly enhancing robustness. However, this transparency introduces a critical trade-off: the exposed reasoning process itself becomes a new attack surface, risking the leakage of harmful information and revealing the model’s safety logic to adversaries. This paper directly confronts this dilemma, asking: Can we achieve the full benefits of deliberative safety without the costs of explicit reasoning generation? We propose Safety Reasoning Internalization to make the deliberative process in SCoT “available but not visible”. This approach is grounded in a key theoretical insight: the corrective influence of an SCoT can be effectively approximated by a targeted, low-rank update to the model’s Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layers. We operationalize this through Hierarchical Internalization of Adversarially-Guided Reasoning (HIAR), a layer-wise safety alignment framework that internalizes safety reasoning into an implicit computational pathway using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). HIAR enables the model to reach a safe conclusion within a single forward pass, entirely eliminating the need to generate vulnerable SCoT text. Extensive experiments on various LLMs demonstrate that HIAR achieves a 43% lower Attack Success Rate (ASR) against distinct jailbreak attacks compared to strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前主流的安全对齐方法仍然使得大语言模型容易受到复杂的越狱攻击。为了增强防御能力，人们提出了诸如以安全性为导向的推理链（SCoT）这样的显式推理机制，这显著提升了模型的鲁棒性。然而，这种透明性带来了一个关键的问题：暴露的推理过程本身会成为新的攻击面，可能导致有害信息泄露，甚至让对手了解模型的安全性逻辑。本文直接探讨了这一困境：我们能否在不产生显式推理成本的情况下，充分享受安全性推理带来的好处呢？我们提出了“安全推理内部化”的方法，使SCoT中的推理过程“可见但不可见”。这种方法基于一个重要的理论见解：SCoT的纠正效果可以通过对模型的前馈网络层进行有针对性的低秩更新来有效近似实现。我们通过“分层内部化对抗性引导推理”这一逐层安全对齐框架来实现这一点，该框架利用低秩自适应技术将安全推理内化为隐式的计算路径。借助HIAR，模型能够在一次前向处理中得出安全结论，完全无需生成脆弱的SCoT文本。在多种LLM上的广泛实验表明，与强大的基准模型相比，HIAR在应对不同越狱攻击时，其攻击成功率降低了43%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ToolScope: Enhancing LLM Agent Tool Use through Tool Merging and Context-Aware Filtering
papers.title_zh: ToolScope：通过工具合并和上下文感知过滤来提升LLM代理工具的使用效果
papers.authors: Marianne Menglin Liu, Daniel Garcia, Fjona Parllaku, Vikas Upadhyay, Syed Fahad Allam Shah, Dan Roth
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external tools to solve complex tasks, but real-world toolsets often contain redundant tools with overlapping names and descriptions, introducing ambiguity and reducing selection accuracy. LLMs also face strict input context limits, preventing efficient consideration of large toolsets. To address these challenges, we propose ToolScope, which includes: (1) ToolScopeMerger with Auto-Correction to automatically audit and fix tool merges, reducing redundancy, and (2) ToolScopeRetriever to rank and select only the most relevant tools for each query, compressing toolsets to fit within context limits without sacrificing accuracy. Evaluations on three state-of-the-art LLMs and three open-source tool-use benchmarks show gains of 8.38% to 38.6% in tool selection accuracy, demonstrating ToolScope’s effectiveness in enhancing LLM tool use.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理依赖外部工具来解决复杂任务，但现实世界中的工具集往往包含名称和描述重复的冗余工具，这导致了不确定性，并降低了选择工具的准确性。LLM还面临严格的输入上下文限制，这阻碍了对大量工具集的有效考虑。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ToolScope，该工具包括：(1) 带有自动修正功能的ToolScopeMerger，能够自动审核和修复工具合并过程中的重复项，从而减少冗余；(2) ToolScopeRetriever，它能够对每个查询只推荐最相关的工具，同时在不牺牲准确性的前提下，压缩工具集以适应上下文限制。在三个先进的LLM和三个开源工具使用基准测试上的评估显示，工具选择准确率提高了8.38%到38.6%，这表明ToolScope在提升LLM工具使用效率方面具有显著效果。

papers.title: PRInTS: Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Information Seeking
papers.title_zh: PRInTS：适用于长期信息检索的奖励模型设计
papers.authors: Jaewoo Lee, Archiki Prasad, Justin Chen, Zaid Khan, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Mohit Bansal
papers.abstract: Information-seeking is a core capability for AI agents, requiring them to gather and reason over tool-generated information across long trajectories. However, such multi-step information-seeking tasks remain challenging for agents backed by language models. While process reward models (PRMs) can guide agents by ranking candidate steps at test-time, existing PRMs, designed for short reasoning with binary judgment, cannot capture richer dimensions of information-seeking steps, such as tool interactions and reasoning over tool outputs, nor handle the rapidly growing context in long-horizon tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce PRInTS, a generative PRM trained with dual capabilities: (1) dense scoring based on the PRM’s reasoning across multiple step quality dimensions (e.g., interpretation of tool outputs, tool call informativeness) and (2) trajectory summarization that compresses the growing context while preserving essential information for step evaluation. Extensive evaluations across FRAMES, GAIA (levels 1-3), and WebWalkerQA (easy-hard) benchmarks on multiple models, with ablations, reveal that best-of-n sampling with PRInTS enhances information-seeking in open-source models as well as specialized agents, matching or surpassing frontier models with a much smaller backbone agent and outperforming other strong reward modeling baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 信息检索是人工智能代理的核心能力之一，要求它们能够收集并分析工具生成的信息，同时处理复杂的长期任务。然而，对于由语言模型支持的代理来说，这种多步骤的信息检索任务仍然具有挑战性。虽然过程奖励模型可以在测试时通过排序候选步骤来指导代理，但现有的奖励模型主要用于简单的二元判断推理，无法捕捉到信息检索过程中的更多细节，比如工具之间的交互以及对工具输出的推理。此外，这些模型也无法处理长视界任务中不断增长的上下文信息。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了PRInTS——一种具有双重能力的生成式奖励模型：(1)基于多个步骤质量维度进行密集评分，例如对工具输出的解释、工具调用的信息量等；(2)能够压缩不断增长的上下文信息，同时保留用于评估步骤的重要信息。在FRAMES、GAIA（第1至3级）和WebWalkerQA（简单到困难）等多个基准测试中，我们对多种模型进行了广泛的评估，结果表明，使用PRInTS进行最优采样能够提升开源模型以及专业代理的信息检索能力，其性能甚至超过了那些使用更小型基础模型的先进模型，同时也优于其他优秀的奖励建模基线模型。

papers.title: Follow the Flow: On Information Flow Across Textual Tokens in Text-to-Image Models
papers.title_zh: 遵循流程：关于文本到图像模型中不同文本片段之间的信息传递机制
papers.authors: Guy Kaplan, Michael Toker, Yuval Reif, Yonatan Belinkov, Roy Schwartz
papers.abstract: Text-to-image generation models suffer from alignment problems, where generated images fail to accurately capture the objects and relations in the text prompt. Prior work has focused on improving alignment by refining the diffusion process, ignoring the role of the text encoder, which guides the diffusion. In this work, we investigate how semantic information is distributed across token representations in text-to-image prompts, analyzing it at two levels: (1) in-item representation—whether individual tokens represent their lexical item (i.e., a word or expression conveying a single concept), and (2) cross-item interaction—whether information flows between tokens of different lexical items. We use patching techniques to uncover encoding patterns, and find that information is usually concentrated in only one or two of the item’s tokens; for example, in the item “San Francisco’s Golden Gate Bridge”, the token “Gate” sufficiently captures the entire expression while the other tokens could effectively be discarded. Lexical items also tend to remain isolated; for instance, in the prompt “a green dog”, the token “dog” encodes no visual information about “green”. However, in some cases, items do influence each other’s representation, often leading to misinterpretations—e.g., in the prompt “a pool by a table”, the token “pool” represents a “pool table” after contextualization. Our findings highlight the critical role of token-level encoding in image generation, and demonstrate that simple interventions at the encoding stage can substantially improve alignment and generation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到图像生成模型存在对齐问题，即生成的图片无法准确捕捉文本提示中的对象和关系。以往的研究主要集中在改进对齐效果，通过优化扩散过程来提升准确性，但忽略了文本编码器在引导扩散过程中的作用。在本研究中，我们探讨了文本到图像提示中语义信息如何在各个标记表示之间分布，并从两个层面进行分析：（1）单个项目的表示——各个标记是否代表其对应的词汇项（即传达单一概念的单词或表达）；（2）不同词汇项之间的交互——不同词汇项的标记之间是否存在信息流动。我们通过使用拼接技术来揭示编码模式，发现信息通常只集中在一个或两个项目标记中；例如，在“旧金山金门大桥”这个项目中，“Gate”这个标记能够充分表达整个概念，而其他标记则可以被忽略。词汇项也倾向于保持孤立状态；例如，在“一只绿色的狗”这个提示中，“dog”这个标记并不包含关于“绿色”的视觉信息。然而，在某些情况下，不同项目确实会影响彼此的表示，这常常导致误解——例如，在“一张桌子旁的游泳池”这个提示中，“pool”这个标记在上下文作用下代表了“台球桌”。我们的研究发现强调了标记级编码在图像生成中的关键作用，并表明在编码阶段进行简单的干预可以显著改善对齐效果和生成质量。

papers.title: Fiction Flows: A Replication and Reinterpretation of Narrative Sequentiality
papers.title_zh: 虚构的流淌：叙事顺序的复制与重新诠释
papers.authors: Andrew Piper, Sil Hamilton, Haiqi Zhou, Federico Pianzola
papers.abstract: Narrative flow emerges from the interplay between memory and expectation, shaping how stories are both produced and understood. To operationalize this construct, Sap et al. (2022) propose sequentiality, a language-model–based measure of sentence-level predictability, and report that imagined stories flow better than recalled ones. We conduct a large-scale replication across multiple language models, examine how modeling choices shape the original findings, and test generalization beyond crowdworker data using passages from published fiction and narrative non-fiction. Although the original contrast replicates under their initial formulation, it diminishes substantially under alternative specifications, suggesting that it reflects properties of the measurement setup rather than a stable feature of narrative flow. By contrast, fiction does appear to exhibit a robust sequentiality advantage over reality-bound genres under a minimal context-only formulation. However, mixed-effects analyses indicate that this advantage is not reducible to standard coherence measures, underscoring the need for further theoretical and empirical grounding of narrative flow.
papers.abstract_zh: 叙事流程源于记忆与预期之间的相互作用，它决定了故事是如何被创造以及被理解的。为了具体描述这一概念，Sap等人（2022年）提出了“序列性”这一概念，这是一种基于语言模型的句子级可预测性的衡量方式。他们发现，想象中的故事比回忆起来的故事具有更好的连贯性。我们进行了大规模的复制实验，使用多种语言模型来研究建模选择对原始研究结果的影响，并测试了这些结果在群体工作数据之外的适用性，使用了来自已发表的小说和叙事类非虚构作品的文本作为样本。虽然最初的对比实验在他们的初始设定下仍然有效，但在其他假设下，这种效果显著减弱，这表明这种效果更多地反映了测量方法的特性，而非叙事流程的一个稳定特征。相比之下，根据仅基于上下文的设定，小说确实表现出相对于现实题材作品的更强的序列性优势。然而，混合效应分析表明，这种优势并不能用标准的连贯性指标来衡量，这进一步强调了需要更多理论和实证研究来深入理解叙事流程的本质。

papers.title: Conjunctive Prompt Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.title_zh: 多智能体大语言模型系统中的结合式提示攻击
papers.authors: Nokimul Hasan Arif, Qian Lou, Mengxin Zheng
papers.abstract: Most LLM safety work studies single-agent models, but many real applications rely on multiple interacting agents. In these systems, prompt segmentation and inter-agent routing create attack surfaces that single-agent evaluations miss. We study conjunctive prompt attacks, where a trigger key in the user query and a hidden adversarial template in one compromised remote agent each appear benign alone but activate harmful behavior when routing brings them together. We consider an attacker who changes neither model weights nor the client agent and instead controls only trigger placement and template insertion. Across star, chain, and DAG topologies, routing-aware optimization substantially increases attack success over non-optimized baselines while keeping false activations low. Existing defenses, including PromptGuard, Llama-Guard variants, and system-level controls such as tool restrictions, do not reliably stop the attack because no single component appears malicious in isolation. These results expose a structural vulnerability in agentic LLM pipelines and motivate defenses that reason over routing and cross-agent composition. Code is available at https://github.com/UCF-ML-Research/ConjunctiveAgents.
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数关于大语言模型安全性的研究都集中在单一智能体模型上，但实际上许多实际应用需要多个相互作用的智能体。在这些系统中，提示分割和智能体间的路由机制会创造出一些单一智能体评估所忽视的攻击面。我们研究了“联合提示攻击”现象——当用户查询中包含触发键时，某个被攻破的远程智能体中存在一个隐藏的敌对模板。单独来看，这些元素似乎并无危害，但当它们被路由到一起时，就会引发有害行为。我们假设攻击者不会改变模型权重或客户端智能体的配置，而只控制触发位置的调整以及敌对模板的插入。无论是在星形、链状还是有向无环图拓扑结构中，基于路由优化的方法都能显著提高攻击成功率，同时降低误激活的概率。现有的防御措施，如PromptGuard、Llama-Guard等，以及系统级的控制手段，比如工具限制，都无法有效阻止这种攻击，因为没有任何单个组件在孤立状态下看起来具有恶意。这些研究结果揭示了智能体大语言模型处理流程中的结构性漏洞，并促使我们开发能够考虑路由机制和跨智能体组合效应的防御策略。相关代码可以在https://github.com/UCF-ML-Research/ConjunctiveAgents下载。

papers.title: Evaluating Visual Narrative Coherence in Story Visualization via Diversified Storylines
papers.title_zh: 通过多样化的故事情节来评估故事可视化中的视觉叙事连贯性
papers.authors: Minha Jhang, Kyeongman Park, Hyukhun Koh, Kyomin Jung
papers.abstract: Story visualization requires generating a coherent sequence of images that collectively form a narrative, yet existing evaluation metrics and datasets often overlook visual continuity and narrative diversity. In this paper, we introduce the Visual Context-Aware Metric for Story Visualization, which uses large vision-language models to jointly assess caption fidelity and inter-image consistency, achieving Spearman’s correlation comparable to human agreement on two benchmarks. Also, to address the shortcomings of narrowly defined datasets with low diversity, we propose a diffusion-augmented evaluation pipeline that blends diverse and controlled narrative elements at adjustable ratios, producing challenging evaluation sets. By combining VCMS with this pipeline, we provide a scalable, human-aligned framework for evaluating story visualization models.
papers.abstract_zh: 故事可视化需要生成一系列连贯的图像序列，这些图像共同构成了一个完整的叙事。然而，现有的评估指标和数据集往往忽视了视觉的连贯性和叙事的多样性。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“视觉上下文感知度量方法”的故事可视化框架。该方法利用大型视觉-语言模型来同时评估字幕的准确性和图像之间的一致性，其效果与人类判断相当，且在两个基准测试中的Spearman相关性都达到了较高水平。此外，为了弥补数据集定义狭隘且多样性不足的问题，我们提出了一种扩散增强评估流程。该流程能够以可调节的比例融合多样化和受控的叙事元素，从而生成具有挑战性的评估集。通过将VCMS与这种评估流程相结合，我们提供了一种可扩展且符合人类判断标准的框架，用于评估故事可视化模型的效果。

papers.title: Rethinking the Idiomaticity Decomposability Hypothesis: Evidence from Distributional Learning
papers.title_zh: 重新思考“惯用表达方式的可分解性”假设：来自分布式学习的证据
papers.authors: Maggie Mi, Golzar Atefi, Atsuki Yamaguchi, Felix Gers, Aline Villavicencio, Nafise Sadat Moosavi
papers.abstract: Idioms can be analysed in terms of their decomposability, the extent to which constituent meanings contribute to the figurative whole. Decomposability is thought to predict syntactic flexibility. Usage-based accounts instead attribute idiom behaviour to distributional experience, such as speaker familiarity and predictability. We examine these views using contextualised language models as controlled distributional learners. We propose a model-internal measure of decomposability and relate it to human ratings, syntactic flexibility, and predictability while tracking idiom learning during pretraining. Model-derived decomposability correlates weakly with human judgments and shows a small but consistent negative relationship with syntactic flexibility. Pretraining analyses show that stabilisation of idiom representations in models is not explained by frequency alone. Instead, surprisal, decomposability, and frequency all contribute, with decomposability showing the strongest training-dependent effect.
papers.abstract_zh: 成语可以通过其可分解性来分析，即各个组成部分在多大程度上对整体意义有所贡献。人们认为，可分解性可以预测句子的灵活性。而基于使用的观点则认为，成语的使用行为是由分布经验决定的，比如说话者对其的熟悉程度以及可预测性。我们使用上下文化的语言模型作为受控的分布学习器来研究这些观点。我们提出了一种模型内部的可分解性衡量方法，并将其与人类评分、句子灵活性以及可预测性进行关联，同时跟踪预训练过程中的成语学习情况。模型推导出的可分解性与人类判断之间的相关性较弱，但与句子灵活性之间存在轻微但一致的负相关关系。预训练分析表明，模型中成语表示的稳定性并非仅由频率来解释。相反，惊讶感、可分解性和频率都起到了作用，其中可分解性显示出最强的训练依赖性效应。

papers.title: KinyaProp: Fine-Grained Propaganda Annotation in Kinyarwanda
papers.title_zh: KinyaProp：基尼亚卢旺达语中的细粒度宣传标注技术
papers.authors: Manzi Fabrice Niyigaba, Ivory Yang, Soroush Vosoughi
papers.abstract: Propaganda is a widely used approach for shaping public opinion and disseminating misinformation in news media. While it has recently gained significant attention within the NLP community, research on fine grained propaganda detection remains heavily concentrated in high resource languages. To bridge this gap, we introduce KinyaProp, the first fine-grained propaganda dataset of its kind for Kinyarwanda and, to our knowledge, the first such resource created for a Bantu language. Using this dataset, we evaluate whether state-of-the-art LLMs can function as reliable annotators in a genuinely low resource and culturally grounded setting. Our results show that current multilingual LLMs do not reliably approximate human annotation behavior. Instead, they behave as conservative annotators whose performance is largely limited to lexically explicit cues, substantially under-identifying propaganda and exhibiting extremely low and unstable performance on discourse-level techniques. Our findings highlight an important limitation of recent successes in LLM based annotation reported for high resource languages, demonstrating that such results do not readily transfer to low resource settings, where scalable annotation would be most valuable. We release KinyaProp to support future research on fine grained propaganda detection and to enable more robust evaluation of multilingual models in underrepresented languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 宣传是一种被广泛使用的手段，用于塑造公众舆论和传播错误信息。虽然近年来这一领域在自然语言处理领域受到了广泛关注，但关于精细化宣传检测的研究仍然主要集中在资源丰富的语言上。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了KinyaProp，这是首个针对基尼亚卢旺达语的精细化宣传数据集。据我们所知，这是首个为班图语创建的数据集。通过使用这个数据集，我们评估了最先进的大语言模型是否能够在资源匮乏且文化特征显著的背景下可靠地进行标注工作。我们的结果显示，目前的多语言大语言模型无法可靠地模仿人类标注行为。相反，它们的标注行为较为保守，其性能主要依赖于词汇层面的线索，导致对宣传信息的识别率极低，且在话语层面技术的运用上表现极其不稳定。我们的研究发现揭示了最近基于大语言模型的标注成果的一个重要局限性，即这些成果并不适用于资源匮乏的环境，而在这种环境下，可扩展的标注方式才具有实际价值。我们发布KinyaProp，以支持未来关于精细化宣传检测的研究，并帮助更全面地评估多语言模型在资源匮乏的语言中的表现。

papers.title: Revisiting Audio-language Pretraining for Learning General-purpose Audio Representation
papers.title_zh: 重新审视用于学习通用音频表示的音频语言预训练方法
papers.authors: Wei-Cheng Tseng, Xuanru Zhou, Mingyue Huo, Yiwen Shao, Hao Zhang, Dong Yu
papers.abstract: Audio-language pretraining (ALP) holds promise for learning general-purpose audio representation, yet remains underexplored. Crucially, there is no consensus on whether audio–language models can build effective general-purpose audio encoders, nor a systematic understanding of how pretraining objectives behave across diverse tasks and scales.We identify three key barriers: limited scale of audio-text corpora, limited coverage of audio attributes in existing caption corpora, and lack of systematic exploration and evaluation.To fill this gap, we present the first principled empirical study of ALP.We first introduce CaptionStew, a 10.7M caption dataset aggregating open-source audio-text corpora across multiple domains and captioning focuses.We then conduct the first comprehensive evaluation comparing contrastive and captioning objectives for learning audio representation across speech, music, and environmental sound tasks.Our results not only demonstrate that ALP yields competitive, transferable representations, but reveal critical trade-offs: contrastive learning offers superior data efficiency, while captioning exhibits better scalability.Furthermore, we find that the benefits of supervised initialization often diminish at larger scales, challenging common practices.By grounding these claims in empirical evidence, we establish a viable pathway toward general-purpose audio representation learning, guiding future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 音频-语言预训练在构建通用音频表示方面具有巨大潜力，但相关研究仍然不够充分。关键问题在于，目前还没有共识表明音频-语言模型是否能够构建有效的通用音频编码器，也没有系统性的研究来探讨预训练目标在不同任务和不同规模下的表现。我们发现了三个主要障碍：音频-文本语料库的规模有限、现有字幕语料库中对音频属性的覆盖范围有限，以及缺乏系统的探索与评估。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了第一项关于音频-语言预训练的系统性实证研究。我们首先介绍了CaptionStew数据集，该数据集包含1070万条字幕记录，汇集了多个领域和不同标注方向的开源音频-文本语料库。随后，我们进行了首次全面评估，比较了用于学习语音、音乐和环境声音任务中音频表示的对比学习和字幕标注方法的效果。我们的研究结果不仅表明音频-语言预训练能够产生具有竞争力的、可迁移的表示，还揭示了关键的权衡：对比学习在数据利用方面更为高效，而字幕标注则具有更好的可扩展性。此外，我们发现，在更大规模的应用中，监督初始化带来的优势往往会减弱，这挑战了现有的常见做法。通过基于实证证据来支持这些结论，我们为通用音频表示学习开辟了一条可行的路径，为未来的研究提供了指导。

papers.title: Trajectory Signatures of Deception in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中欺骗行为的轨迹特征
papers.authors: Viraaji Mothukuri, Reza M. Parizi
papers.abstract: Detecting deceptive behavior in LLMs is typically done post-hoc on outputs or by probing static activations. We instead treat deception as a dynamic process, a trajectory through the model’s hidden-state space during inference. We capture layerwise activations at sparse “decision points” where the model is uncertain between competing tokens, forming activation trajectories for matched truthful vs. deceptive responses across strategic deception, sycophancy, instructed deception, and confabulation. Across GPT-2 and Llama variants, deceptive generation is associated with changes in trajectory geometry, but increases in path length are model and deception-type-dependent. Sycophancy shows the clearest signal, whereas instructed deception yields near-null signatures. With just 7 geometric features, a lightweight classifier achieves performance comparable to PCA-reduced probing at matched dimensionality for binary sycophancy detection and shows preliminary utility for 4-way deception-type classification. These findings indicate that trajectory-based monitoring can provide process-level signals associated with deceptive generation during inference, complementing methods that focus on endpoint activation states.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中检测欺骗行为通常是通过对输出结果进行分析，或者通过对静态激活状态的探究来完成的。而我们则将欺骗行为视为一个动态过程，即模型在推理过程中通过隐藏状态空间的变化轨迹来实现欺骗行为。我们捕捉到的是在模型对多个竞争性标记不确定时的逐层激活变化，这些激活变化构成了真实与欺骗性回应之间的轨迹。在GPT-2和Llama模型中，欺骗性生成伴随着轨迹几何形状的变化，但路径长度的增加则取决于模型和欺骗类型的不同。其中，谄媚行为表现得最为明显，而受指令驱动的欺骗行为则几乎没有明显的特征。仅使用7个几何特征，一个轻量级的分类器就能在二进制谄媚检测方面达到与PCA降维后的探测方法相当的性能，并且初步显示出其在四种欺骗类型分类中的实用性。这些发现表明，基于轨迹的监控可以提供与推理过程中的欺骗性生成相关的过程级信号，从而补充那些专注于端点激活状态的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Improving the Distributional Alignment of LLMs using Supervision
papers.title_zh: 通过监督机制提升大语言模型在分布上的一致性
papers.authors: Gauri Kambhatla, Sanjana Gautam, Angela Zhang, Alexander Liu, Ravi Srinivasan, Junyi Jessy Li, Matthew Lease
papers.abstract: The ability to accurately align LLMs with diverse population groups on subjective questions would have great value. In this work, we show that adding simple supervision can more consistently improve the alignment of LLM-generated distributions with diverse population groups, as measured across three datasets spanning public health, public opinion, and values and beliefs. Beyond evaluating average alignment, we also report how alignment varies across specific groups. Our broad findings provide insights into the distributional alignment of LLM generations with diverse populations. By conducting evaluation over many LLMs and prompting strategies, we provide a benchmark to stimulate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 能够准确地将大语言模型与不同人群在主观问题上进行对齐，这将具有巨大的价值。在这项研究中，我们发现，通过添加简单的监督机制，可以更加一致地改善大语言模型生成的分布与不同人群之间的对齐效果。我们的研究涵盖了公共卫生、舆论以及价值观和信仰等多个领域的数据集。除了评估平均对齐程度外，我们还研究了对齐效果在不同群体中的差异。我们的研究结果为我们了解大语言模型生成的内容与不同人群的分配关系提供了重要线索。通过对许多大语言模型和提示策略进行评估，我们建立了一个基准，以激发未来的研究兴趣。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SMARTER: A Data-efficient Framework to Improve Toxicity Detection with Explanation via Self-augmenting Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SMARTER：一种高效的数据处理框架，通过自增强大型语言模型来提升毒性检测的能力，并给出相应的解释说明
papers.authors: Huy Nghiem, Advik Sachdeva, Hal Daumé Iii
papers.abstract: To address toxic content on social media, we introduce SMARTER, a data-efficient 2-stage framework for explainable content moderation using Large Language Models (LLMs). In Stage 1, we leverage LLMs’ own outputs to generate synthetic explanations for correct and incorrect labels, enabling preference optimization with minimal supervision. In Stage 2, we refine explanation quality through cross-model training, allowing weaker models to align with stronger ones. Experiments on 3 benchmarks (HateXplain, Latent Hate, Implicit Hate) show SMARTER achieves up to 13% macro-F1 improvement over few-shot baselines using only 6-57% of training data. Our framework offers a scalable strategy for low-data settings by harnessing LLMs’ self-improvement for explainable moderation.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了应对社交媒体上的有害内容问题，我们提出了SMARTER这一数据高效的两阶段框架，该框架利用大语言模型来实现可解释的内容审核。在第一阶段，我们利用大语言模型的输出来生成对正确和错误标签的模拟解释，从而在最小化的监督下实现偏好优化。在第二阶段，我们通过跨模型训练来提升解释的质量，使较弱的模型能够与较强的模型对齐。在HateXplain、Latent Hate和Implicit Hate三个基准测试上的实验表明，SMARTER在仅使用6-57%的训练数据的情况下，其宏观F1分数比少样本基线方法提升了高达13%。我们的框架为低数据环境下的内容审核提供了可扩展的解决方案，通过利用大语言模型的自我改进能力来实现可解释性的审核。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GameplayQA: A Benchmarking Framework for Decision-Dense POV-Synced Multi-Video Understanding of 3D Virtual Agents
papers.title_zh: 游戏玩法问答：一种用于评估三维虚拟角色多视频协同认知能力的基准框架
papers.authors: Yunzhe Wang, Runhui Xu, Kexin Zheng, Tianyi Zhang, Jayavibhav Niranjan Kogundi, Soham Hans, Volkan Ustun
papers.abstract: Multimodal LLMs are increasingly deployed as perceptual backbones for autonomous agents in 3D environments, from robotics to virtual worlds. These applications require agents to perceive rapid state changes, attribute actions to the correct entities, and reason about concurrent multi-agent behaviors from a first-person perspective, capabilities that existing benchmarks do not adequately evaluate. We introduce GameplayQA, a framework for evaluating agentic-centric perception and reasoning through video understanding. Specifically, we densely annotate multiplayer 3D gameplay videos at 1.22 labels/second, with time-synced, concurrent captions of states, actions, and events structured around a triadic system of Self, Other Agents, and the World, a natural decomposition for multi-agent environments. From these annotations, we refined 2.4K diagnostic QA pairs organized into three levels of cognitive complexity, accompanied by a structured distractor taxonomy that enables fine-grained analysis of where models hallucinate. Evaluation of frontier MLLMs reveals a substantial gap from human performance, with common failures in temporal and cross-video grounding, agent-role attribution, and handling the decision density of the game. We hope GameplayQA stimulates future research at the intersection of embodied AI, agentic perception, and world modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型正被越来越多地用于3D环境中的自主智能体的感知基础功能，这些应用涉及从机器人技术到虚拟世界等多个领域。这些应用场景要求智能体能够感知快速的状态变化、将动作归因于正确的实体，并从第一人称视角理解多个智能体之间的并发行为。然而，现有的评估基准并不能充分评价这些能力。我们提出了GameplayQA这一框架，用于通过视频理解来评估以智能体为中心的感知与推理能力。具体来说，我们以每秒1.22个标签的速度对多人3D游戏视频进行密集标注，为视频中的状态、动作和事件添加时间同步的标题，这些标题围绕“自我”、“其他智能体”和“世界”这三个要素进行组织，这种结构非常适合多智能体环境。基于这些标注数据，我们整理出了2.4K组诊断性问答对，这些问答对分为三个认知复杂度等级，同时我们还建立了一个结构化的干扰项分类体系，以便对模型产生幻觉的具体原因进行细致分析。对前沿的多模态大语言模型的评估结果显示，它们的表现与人类水平存在显著差距，常见的缺陷包括时间和跨视频的定位问题、智能体角色归属问题，以及处理游戏中的决策密度问题。我们希望GameplayQA能激发未来在具身人工智能、智能体感知和世界建模交叉领域的研究发展。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DeepFact: Co-Evolving Benchmarks and Agents for Deep Research Factuality
papers.title_zh: 深度事实：共同演变的基准与适用于深度研究的智能体
papers.authors: Yukun Huang, Leonardo F. R. Ribeiro, Momchil Hardalov, Bhuwan Dhingra, Markus Dreyer, Venkatesh Saligrama
papers.abstract: Search-augmented LLM agents can produce deep research reports (DRRs), but verifying claim-level factuality remains challenging. Existing fact-checkers usually target general-domain atomic claims, and there is no benchmark to test whether such verifiers transfer to DRRs.Yet building such a benchmark for DRR fact-checkers is itself difficult because it requires expert judgments over cognitively demanding, domain-specific claims.In a controlled study with PhD-level specialists, unassisted experts achieve only 60.8% accuracy on hidden known-answer claims. We therefore propose evolving benchmarking via Audit-then-Score (AtS), in which labels and rationales remain revisable: when a verifier disagrees with the current benchmark, it submits evidence; an auditor adjudicates the dispute; and accepted revisions update the benchmark before scoring. After three additional AtS rounds, expert accuracy rises to 90.9%, showing that experts are better auditors than one-shot labelers.We instantiate AtS as DeepFactBench, a versioned DRR factuality benchmark with auditable rationales, and introduce DeepFactEval, a claim-level verifier.On the frozen DeepFactBench release, DeepFactEval achieves 83.4% accuracy, outperforming the best prior deep-research and traditional fact-checkers by 14.3 and 24.9 points, respectively, and transferring well to external factuality datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于搜索的LLM智能体能够生成深入的研究报告，但验证事实的准确性仍然具有挑战性。现有的事实核查工具通常针对的是一般领域的单一事实，目前还没有基准测试来检验这些工具是否也能适用于研究报告的核查。然而，建立这样的基准测试本身就很困难，因为需要对认知要求高且具有领域特定性的事实进行专家级的判断。在一项由博士级专家参与的对照研究中，未经辅助的专家在隐藏已知答案的事实上的准确率仅为60.8%。因此，我们提出了一种通过“审计后评分”的方法来改进基准测试：在这种方法中，标签和理由是可以重新调整的。当核查工具与当前基准不符时，可以提交证据；审核人员会裁决该争议；而经过认可的修改内容会更新基准，然后再进行评分。经过三轮“审计后评分”之后，专家的准确率提升到了90.9%，这表明专家们作为审核人员的表现优于一次性标注工具。我们将这种方法具体化为DeepFactBench，这是一个带有可审计理由的版本化研究报告事实核查基准工具。同时，我们还引入了DeepFactEval，这是一个针对事实级别核查的工具。在冻结的DeepFactBench版本中，DeepFactEval的准确率达到了83.4%，比之前最好的深度研究报告核查工具和传统事实核查工具分别高出14.3点和24.9点。而且，该工具在外部事实数据集上的表现也非常出色。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR
papers.title_zh: R1-RE：基于RLVR的跨域关系提取技术
papers.authors: Runpeng Dai, Tong Zheng, Run Yang, Kaixian Yu, Hongtu Zhu
papers.abstract: Relation extraction (RE) is a core task in natural language processing. Traditional approaches typically frame RE as a supervised learning problem, directly mapping context to labels—an approach that often suffers from poor out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. Inspired by the workflow of human annotators, we reframe RE as a reasoning task guided by annotation guidelines and introduce R1-RE, the first reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) framework for RE tasks. Our method elicits the reasoning abilities of small language models for annotation tasks, resulting in significantly improved OOD robustness. We evaluate our approach on the public Sem-2010 dataset and a private MDKG dataset. The R1-RE-7B model attains an average OOD accuracy of approximately 70%, on par with leading proprietary models such as GPT-4o. Additionally, our comprehensive analysis provides novel insights into the training dynamics and emergent reasoning behaviors of the RLVR paradigm for RE.
papers.abstract_zh: 关系提取是自然语言处理中的一个核心任务。传统的方法通常将关系提取视为一个监督学习问题，直接将上下文映射到标签上——这种方法往往存在较差的域外泛化能力。受人类注释员工作流程的启发，我们将其重新定义为一项由注释指南引导的推理任务，并提出了R1-RE模型，这是首个用于关系提取任务的强化学习与可验证奖励相结合的框架。我们的方法能够激发小型语言模型在注释任务中的推理能力，从而显著提升了模型的域外泛化能力。我们在公开的Sem-2010数据集和私有的MDKG数据集上进行了评估。R1-RE-7B模型在域外场景下的准确率达到了约70%，这一成绩与GPT-4o等领先专有模型相当。此外，我们的综合分析还揭示了强化学习与可验证奖励范式在关系提取任务中的训练动态以及涌现的推理行为。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Training LLMs for Divide-and-Conquer Reasoning Elevates Test-Time Scalability
papers.title_zh: 训练大型语言模型以实现分而治之的推理方式，能够提升测试时的可扩展性
papers.authors: Xiao Liang, Zhong-Zhi Li, Zhenghao Lin, Eric Hanchen Jiang, Hengyuan Zhang, Yelong Shen, Kai-Wei Chang, Ying Nian Wu, Yeyun Gong, Weizhu Chen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities through step-by-step chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Nevertheless, at the limits of model capability, CoT often proves insufficient, and its strictly sequential nature constrains test-time scalability. A potential alternative is divide-and-conquer (DAC) reasoning, which decomposes a complex problem into subproblems to facilitate more effective exploration of the solution space. Although promising, our analysis reveals a fundamental misalignment between general-purpose post-training and DAC-style inference, which limits the model’s capacity to fully leverage this potential. To bridge this gap and fully unlock LLMs’ reasoning capabilities on the most challenging tasks, we propose an end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) framework to enhance their DAC-style reasoning capacity. At each step, the policy decomposes a problem into a group of subproblems, solves them sequentially, and addresses the original problem conditioned on the subproblem solutions, with both decomposition and solution integrated into RL training. Under comparable training settings, our DAC-style framework endows the model with a higher performance ceiling and stronger test-time scalability, surpassing CoT by 8.6% in Pass@1 and 6.3% in Pass@32 on competition-level benchmarks. The code is available at the provided link.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通过逐步的推理能力展示了强大的推理能力。然而，在模型的极限情况下，这种逐步推理往往显得不足，而且其严格的顺序性限制了测试时的可扩展性。一种潜在的替代方法是分而治之的推理方式，它将复杂问题分解为多个子问题，从而更有效地探索解决方案空间。尽管这种方法很有前景，但我们的分析表明，通用训练后的推理方式与分而治之的推理方式之间存在根本性的差异，这限制了模型完全发挥这种潜力的能力。为了弥补这一差距，并在最具挑战性的任务上充分发挥LLM的推理能力，我们提出了一个端到端的强化学习框架，以提升模型的分而治之的推理能力。在每个步骤中，该框架将问题分解为一组子问题，依次解决这些子问题，并根据子问题的解来重构原始问题。分解和求解过程都整合到了强化学习训练中。在类似的训练环境下，我们的分而治之框架使模型具备了更高的性能水平以及更强的测试时可扩展性。在竞赛级别的基准测试中，我们的模型在Pass@1指标上比传统逐步推理方法提高了8.6%，在Pass@32指标上提高了6.3%。代码可通过提供的链接获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ClaimDB: A Fact Verification Benchmark over Large Structured Data
papers.title_zh: ClaimDB：一种用于大规模结构化数据的事实验证基准测试工具
papers.authors: Michael Theologitis, Preetam Prabhu Srikar Dammu, Chirag Shah, Dan Suciu
papers.abstract: Real-world fact-checking often involves verifying claims grounded in structured data at scale. Despite substantial progress in fact-verification benchmarks, this setting remains largely underexplored. In this work, we introduce ClaimDB, a fact-verification benchmark where the evidence for claims is derived from compositions of millions of records and multiple tables. ClaimDB consists of 80 unique real-life databases covering a wide range of domains, from governance and healthcare to media, education and the natural sciences. At this scale, verification approaches that rely on “reading” the evidence break down, forcing a timely shift toward reasoning in executable programs. We conduct extensive experiments with 30 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source (below 70B) LLMs and find that more than half score below 55% accuracy. Our analysis also reveals that both closed- and open-source models struggle with abstention – the ability to admit that there is no evidence to decide – raising doubts about their reliability in high-stakes data analysis tasks. We release the benchmark, code, and the LLM leaderboard at https://claimdb.github.io.
papers.abstract_zh: 现实世界中的事实核查通常涉及对基于大规模结构化数据的声明进行验证。尽管在事实核查基准方面取得了显著进展，但这一领域仍然没有得到充分探索。在这项研究中，我们提出了ClaimDB这一事实核查基准，该基准中的证据来源于数百万条记录和多张表格的组合。ClaimDB包含80个独特的真实数据库，涵盖从治理、医疗保健到媒体、教育和自然科学等多个领域。在这种规模下，那些依赖“阅读”证据的核查方法变得不再适用，因此必须转向在可执行程序中进行推理的方法。我们对30种先进的专有和开源（参数规模低于700亿）大语言模型进行了广泛的实验，发现其中超过一半模型的准确率低于55%。我们的分析还表明，无论是闭源模型还是开源模型都难以应对“放弃”——即承认没有证据来做出决策的能力问题，这让人对其在高风险数据分析任务中的可靠性产生怀疑。我们将该基准、代码以及大语言模型排行榜发布在https://claimdb.github.io网站上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PluRule: A Benchmark for Moderating Pluralistic Communities on Social Media
papers.title_zh: PluRule：社交媒体上维护多元社区秩序的参考标准
papers.authors: Zoher Kachwala, Bao Tran Truong, Rasika Muralidharan, Haewoon Kwak, Jisun An, Filippo Menczer
papers.abstract: Social media are shifting towards pluralism — community-governed platforms where groups define their own norms. What violates rules in one community may be perfectly acceptable in another. Can AI models help moderate such pluralistic communities? We formalize the task as a multiple-choice problem, mirroring how human moderators operate in the real world: given a comment and its surrounding context, identify which specific rule, if any, is violated. We introduce PluRule, a multimodal, multilingual benchmark for detecting 13,371 rule violations across 1,989 Reddit communities spanning 2,885 rules in 9 languages. Using this benchmark, we show that state-of-the-art vision-language models struggle significantly: even GPT-5.2 with high reasoning performs only slightly better than a trivial baseline. We also find that bigger models and increased context provide marginal gains, and universal rules like civility and self-promotion are easier to detect. Our results show that moderation of pluralistic communities on social media is a fundamental challenge for language models. Our code and benchmark are publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体正朝着多元化方向发展——这些平台由社区自行管理，各个群体可以自主制定自己的规范。在一个社区中违反的规则，在另一个社区可能完全被接受。人工智能模型能否帮助调节这种多元化的社区呢？我们将这一任务形式化为一个选择题，模拟人类版主在现实中的操作方式：给定一条评论及其周围的环境，判断是否违反规则，以及具体违反了哪一条规则。我们引入了PluRule这个多模态、多语言的基准测试工具，它能够检测1,989个Reddit社区中的13,371条规则违规情况，涉及 2,885 条规则和9种语言。通过这一基准测试，我们发现最先进的视觉语言模型在这方面存在显著不足：即使是GPT-5.2这种具有高级推理能力的模型，其表现也仅比一个简单的基线模型略好一些。我们还发现，使用更大规模的模型和更丰富的上下文信息可以带来一定的提升效果，而像礼貌用语和自我推广这样的通用规则则更容易被识别。我们的研究结果表明，在社交媒体上调节多元化社区中的内容是一个对语言模型来说非常具有挑战性的任务。我们的代码和基准测试数据已经公开可供使用。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: What Makes a Good Curriculum? Disentangling the Effects of Data Ordering on LLM Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 什么才是好的课程大纲？解析数据排序方式对大型语言模型数学推理能力的影响
papers.authors: Yaning Jia, Chunhui Zhang, Xingjian Diao, Xiangchi Yuan, Zhongyu Ouyang, Chiyu Ma, Soroush Vosoughi
papers.abstract: Curriculum learning (CL), which orders training data from easy to hard, has become a popular strategy for improving reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Yet prior work employs disparate difficulty metrics and training setups, leaving open fundamental questions: When does curriculum help? Which direction—forward or reverse—is better? And does the answer depend on what we measure? We address these questions through a unified offline evaluation framework that decomposes curriculum difficulty into five complementary dimensions: Problem Difficulty, Model Surprisal, Confidence Margin, Predictive Uncertainty, and Decision Variability. Through controlled post-training experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Llama3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Gemma3-4B, we find that: (i) no curriculum strategy dominates universally—the relative effectiveness of forward versus reverse CL depends jointly on model capability and task complexity; (ii) even within a single metric, samples at different difficulty levels produce distinct gains depending on task demands; and (iii) Task-aligned curricula focus on shaping the model’s final representations and generalization, whereas inner-state curricula modulate internal states such as confidence and uncertainty. Our findings challenge the notion of a universal curriculum strategy and offer actionable guidance across model and task regimes, with some metrics indicating that prioritizing decision-uncertain samples can further enhance learning outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 课程学习（CL）是一种按照从易到难的顺序对训练数据进行排序的策略，它已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的常用方法。然而，以往的研究采用了不同的难度评估指标和训练方式，这就留下了一些基本问题：课程学习何时能够发挥作用？正向或反向的课程策略哪个更好？答案是否取决于我们使用的评估指标？我们通过一个统一的离线评估框架来解决这些问题。该框架将课程难度分解为五个相互补充的维度：问题难度、模型惊讶度、置信度边际、预测不确定性以及决策变异性。通过对Llama3.1-8B、Mistral-7B和Gemma3-4B进行数学推理任务的实验测试，我们发现：(i) 没有任何一种课程策略具有普遍的优势——正向与反向课程学习的相对有效性取决于模型的性能和任务复杂度；(ii) 即使在同一指标下，不同难度级别的样本也能根据任务需求带来不同的收益；(iii) 与任务相关的课程策略侧重于塑造模型的最终表示能力和泛化能力，而内部状态相关的课程策略则关注于调节模型的内部状态，如置信度和不确定性。我们的研究结果挑战了通用课程策略的概念，并为不同模型和任务场景提供了可操作的指导建议。某些指标表明，优先处理决策不确定性的样本可以进一步提升学习效果。

papers.title: CASS: Nvidia to AMD Transpilation with Data, Models, and Benchmark
papers.title_zh: CASS：Nvidia将通过数据、模型和基准测试来实现向AMD的移植工作
papers.authors: Ahmed Heakl, Gustavo Bertolo Stahl, Sarim Hashmi, Seung Hun Eddie Han, Mukul Ranjan, Arina Kharlamova, Salman Khan, Abdulrahman Mahmoud
papers.abstract: Cross-architecture GPU code transpilation is essential for unlocking low-level hardware portability, yet no scalable solution exists. We introduce CASS, the first dataset and model suite for source- and assembly-level GPU translation (CUDA ↔ HIP, SASS ↔ RDNA3). CASS contains 60k verified host-device code pairs, enabling learning-based translation across both ISA and runtime boundaries. We generate each sample using our automated pipeline that scrapes, translates, compiles, and aligns GPU programs across vendor stacks. Leveraging CASS, we train a suite of domain-specific translation models that achieve 88.2% accuracy on CUDA → HIP and 69.1% on SASS → RDNA3, outperforming commercial baselines including GPT-5.1, Claude-4.5, and Hipify by wide margins. Generated code matches native performance in 85% of cases, preserving both runtime and memory behavior. To support rigorous evaluation, we introduce CASS-Bench, a curated benchmark spanning 18 GPU domains with ground-truth execution. All data, models, and evaluation tools will be released as open source to support progress in GPU compiler tooling, binary compatibility, and LLM-guided code translation.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨架构GPU代码转换对于实现低级别硬件的可移植性至关重要，但目前尚不存在可扩展的解决方案。我们推出了CASS，这是首个用于源级和汇编级GPU转换的数据集和模型套件（CUDA ↔ HIP，SASS ↔ RDNA3）。CASS包含6万个经过验证的主机-设备代码对，使得基于学习的转换能够在指令集架构和运行时两个层面进行。我们通过自动化流程生成每个样本，该流程包括抓取、转换、编译以及在不同供应商的架构之间对齐GPU程序。利用CASS，我们训练了一组特定领域的转换模型，这些模型的准确率分别达到了88.2%和69.1%，远远超过了包括GPT-5.1、Claude-4.5和Hipify在内的商业基准模型。生成的代码在85%的情况下与原生性能一致，同时保留了运行时间和内存行为特性。为了支持严格的评估，我们推出了CASS-Bench，这是一个涵盖18个GPU领域的精选基准测试，并附有真实执行数据。所有数据、模型和评估工具都将以开源形式发布，以支持GPU编译器工具的发展、二进制兼容性的提升以及基于大语言模型引导的代码转换技术。
