papers.title: SAHM: A Benchmark for Arabic Financial and Shari’ah-Compliant Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 全职妈妈：阿拉伯语金融领域以及符合伊斯兰教法原则的推理方式的典范
papers.authors: Rania Elbadry, Sarfraz Ahmad, Ahmed Heakl, Dani Bouch, Momina Ahsan, Muhra AlMahri, Marwa Elsaid Khalil, Yuxia Wang, Salem Lahlou, Sophia Ananiadou, Veselin Stoyanov, Jimin Huang, Xueqing Peng, Preslav Nakov, Zhuohan Xie
papers.abstract: English financial NLP has progressed rapidly through benchmarks for sentiment, document understanding, and financial question answering, while Arabic financial NLP remains comparatively under-explored despite strong practical demand for trustworthy finance and Islamic-finance assistants. We introduce SAHM, a document-grounded benchmark and instruction-tuning dataset for Arabic financial NLP and Shari’ah-compliant reasoning. SAHM contains 14,380 expert-verified instances spanning seven tasks: AAOIFI standards QA, fatwa-based QA/MCQ, accounting and business exams, financial sentiment analysis, extractive summarization, and event–cause reasoning, curated from authentic regulatory, juristic, and corporate sources. We evaluate 19 strong open and proprietary LLMs using task-specific metrics and rubric-based scoring for open-ended outputs, and find that Arabic fluency does not reliably translate to evidence-grounded financial reasoning: models are substantially stronger on recognition-style tasks than on generation and causal reasoning, with the largest gaps on event–cause reasoning. We release the benchmark, evaluation framework, and an instruction-tuned model to support future research on trustworthy Arabic financial NLP.
papers.abstract_zh: 英语金融自然语言处理领域通过情感分析、文档理解以及金融问题回答等基准测试取得了迅速进展。而阿拉伯语金融自然语言处理领域则相对未得到充分探索，尽管对于可靠的和伊斯兰金融相关助手的需求非常强烈。我们提出了SAHM这一基于文档的基准测试及指令调整数据集，用于阿拉伯语金融自然语言处理和符合伊斯兰教法的推理任务。SAHM包含14,380个经过专家验证的实例，涵盖七项任务：AAOIFI标准问答、基于教令的问答/选择题、会计与商业考试、金融情感分析、提取式总结以及事件-原因推理。这些实例均来自真实的监管、法律和企业来源。我们通过针对特定任务的指标和评分标准，对19种强大的开源和专有大语言模型进行了评估，发现阿拉伯语流利程度并不能可靠地转化为基于证据的金融推理能力：模型在识别类任务上的表现明显优于生成类和因果推理类任务，而在事件-原因推理方面存在较大差距。我们发布了该基准测试、评估框架以及经过指令调整的模型，以支持未来关于可靠阿拉伯语金融自然语言处理的研究。

papers.title: Confident, Calibrated, or Complicit: Safety Alignment and Ideological Bias in LLM Hate Speech Detection
papers.title_zh: 自信的、经过校准的，还是同谋的？安全性与意识形态偏见在大型语言模型仇恨言论检测中的应用
papers.authors: Sanjeevan Selvaganapathy, Mehwish Nasim
papers.abstract: We investigate the efficacy of Large Language Models (LLMs) in detecting implicit and explicit hate speech, examining how models with minimal safety alignment (uncensored) compare with more heavily aligned (censored) counterparts in a deployed-model setting when deployed using political personas. While uncensored models are often framed as offering a less constrained perspective, our results reveal a trade-off: censored models outperform their uncensored counterparts in both accuracy and robustness, achieving 69.0% versus 64.1% strict accuracy. However, this higher performance is also associated with greater resistance to persona-based influence, while uncensored models are more malleable to ideological framing. Furthermore, we identify critical failures across all models in understanding nuanced language such as irony. We also find alarming fairness disparities in performance across different targeted groups and systemic overconfidence that renders self-reported certainty unreliable. These findings challenge the notion of LLMs as objective arbiters and highlight the need for more sophisticated auditing frameworks that account for fairness, calibration, and ideological consistency. Taken together, these results point to censorship-as-deployed rather than safety alignment in isolation as the more appropriate frame for interpreting model differences.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了大语言模型在检测隐性和显性仇恨言论方面的效果。通过对比那些安全性对齐程度较低（无审查）的模型与那些安全性对齐程度较高的模型（有审查），我们发现，当这些模型以政治人物身份进行部署时，有审查模型的准确性与鲁棒性均优于无审查模型，严格准确率分别为 69.0% 和 64.1%。然而，这种更高的性能也伴随着更强的抵抗基于人物设定的影响的能力，而无审查模型则更容易受到意识形态影响。此外，我们发现所有模型在理解诸如讽刺等细微语言方面都存在严重缺陷。我们还发现，不同目标群体之间的性能存在显著的公平性差异，同时还存在系统性过度自信的问题，这使得自我报告的确定性变得不可靠。这些发现挑战了将LLM视为客观仲裁者的观念，并强调了需要更完善的审计框架来考量公平性、校准性和意识形态一致性等问题。总的来说，这些结果表明，将审查作为部署方式，而不是单纯依赖安全性对齐，才是解释模型差异的更合适的方式。

papers.title: Aligning Large Language Models via Fully Self-Synthetic Data
papers.title_zh: 通过完全自合成数据来使大型语言模型保持同步
papers.authors: Shangjian Yin, Zhepei Wei, Xinyu Zhu, Wei-Lin Chen, Yu Meng
papers.abstract: Traditional reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for large language models (LLMs) relies on expensive human-annotated datasets, while Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF) also incurs significant costs, requiring the collection of diverse prompts and corresponding responses, often necessitating external reward models or proprietary models like GPT-4 to annotate preference pairs. In this work, we introduce Self-Alignment Optimization (SAO), a fully self-synthetic framework for LLM alignment, where all training data, including prompts (i.e., user queries), responses, and preferences, are generated by the model itself. Specifically, SAO first instructs the LLM to engage in persona role-play and generate diverse prompts and responses, which are then self-evaluated for preference optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAO effectively enhances the model’s chat capabilities on standard benchmarks like AlpacaEval 2.0, while maintaining strong performance on downstream objective tasks (i.e.,, question-answering, math reasoning). Our work provides a practical solution for self-improvement in aligning LLMs, and the code for reproducing our results is available at: https://github.com/SJY8460/SAO.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）方法用于大语言模型（LLMs）的训练，其依赖于昂贵且需要人工标注的数据集。而基于人工智能反馈的强化学习（RLAIF）同样需要投入大量资源，包括收集多样化的提示语及其对应的回答，有时还需要外部奖励模型或像GPT-4这样的专有模型来标注偏好对。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种名为“自我对齐优化”（SAO）的全自合成框架，用于LLM的适配。在该框架下，所有训练数据，包括提示语、回答以及偏好信息，都由模型自身生成。具体来说，SAO首先指示LLM进行角色扮演，生成多样化的提示语和回答，然后对这些生成的回答进行自我评估，以优化偏好表达。大量的实验表明，SAO能够有效提升模型在AlpacaEval 2.0等标准测试任务上的聊天能力，同时还能在下游目标任务（如问答、数学推理等）中保持出色的性能。我们的研究为LLM的自主适配提供了一种实用的解决方案，相关代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/SJY8460/SAO。

papers.title: Corpus-Dependent Subcharacter Encoding via HMM-Guided Code Assignment
papers.title_zh: 基于HMM的字符编码方法——通过代码分配实现字符编码
papers.authors: Tatsuya Hiraoka
papers.abstract: We propose a corpus-dependent alternative to byte encoding that learns fixed-length atomic codes for characters directly from text, which we refer to as Latom (Learned Atom-based Encoding).We instantiate this framework by training an HMM on N-repeated character sequences to estimate “atom” posteriors, followed by a Hungarian assignment yielding a globally optimal one-to-one character-code mapping.Across 14 languages, the encodings improve intrinsic metrics, including token counts after subword tokenization and bigram perplexity, with appropriate code lengths.On Amazon Reviews in six languages, Latom improves text classification accuracy and reduces decoding errors in language model generation.Overall, these results demonstrate that character encodings can be learned from corpus statistics while remaining reversible and compatible with standard tokenization pipelines.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于语料库的替代字节编码方法，该方法能够直接从文本中学习固定长度的字符编码，我们将其称为Latom（基于学习的原子编码）。我们通过训练一个隐马尔可夫模型来处理重复出现的字符序列，以估计“原子”的后验概率，然后通过匈牙利分配算法得到全局最优的一对一字符编码映射。在14种语言中，这种编码方式提升了内在指标，包括子词切分后的标记数量以及双词组的困惑度，同时还能实现适当的编码长度。在六种语言的亚马逊评论数据中，Latom提升了文本分类的准确性，并减少了语言模型生成过程中的解码错误。总体而言，这些结果表明，字符编码可以从语料库统计信息中学习到，同时保持可逆性，并且能够与标准的分词流程兼容。

papers.title: DRInQ: Evaluating Conversational Implicature with Controlled Context Variation
papers.title_zh: DRInQ：在控制上下文变化的情况下评估对话含义
papers.authors: Hirona Jacqueline Arai, Xiang Ren
papers.abstract: Human conversation relies heavily on conversational implicature, in which speakers convey meanings that are suggested rather than explicitly stated. Although recent large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong conversational fluency, they remain unreliable when interpretation depends on reasoning that integrates social and contextual cues, a process rarely articulated in text. We introduce DRinQ, a benchmark for evaluating pragmatic reasoning about conversational implicature in question utterances, designed to isolate pragmatic variation while holding each question’s surface form fixed. To support scalable evaluation, we propose a semi-automated pipeline that produces question-context-interpretation instances with systematic variation. Across evaluations, we find a consistent generation-inference asymmetry: while state-of-the-art models can generate plausible pragmatic scenarios when guided, they often fail to recover the intended implication at inference time. For smaller models, structured prompting improves alignment with human judgments. A comparative writing study further reveals complementary strengths: human authors tend to produce safer, predictable contexts, whereas models generate varied scenarios with interpretations that sometimes exceed contextual support. These findings highlight persistent challenges in modeling conversational implicature and motivate more context-sensitive evaluation frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类对话在很大程度上依赖于会话含义的传达，即说话者所表达的意义是隐含的，而非明确陈述的。尽管最近的大语言模型在会话流畅性方面表现出色，但在需要结合社会和上下文线索进行推理时，它们仍然不可靠，而这一过程在文本中很少被明确表述。我们提出了DRinQ这一基准测试，用于评估关于会话含义的语用推理能力。该测试旨在在保持每个问题表面形式不变的情况下，分离出语用上的差异。为了支持可扩展的评估，我们提出了一种半自动化的流程，能够生成具有系统差异的问题-上下文-解释实例。在多次评估中，我们发现了一个一致的生成与推理之间的不对称现象：当得到指导时，最先进的模型能够生成合理的语用场景，但在推理阶段却常常无法恢复预期的含义。对于较小的模型来说，结构化的提示能够改善其与人类判断的一致性。一项比较性的写作研究进一步揭示了两者之间的互补优势：人类作者往往能创造出更安全、可预测的场景，而模型则能生成多样化的场景，其解释有时甚至超出了上下文的支持范围。这些发现凸显了在建模会话含义方面存在的持续挑战，并为构建更加关注上下文的评估框架提供了动力。

papers.title: From Individual to Common: An Early Exploration of Consensus in Non-verifiable Data for Balanced Preference Optimization
papers.title_zh: 从个体到共性：对非可验证数据下共识机制的初步探索——以平衡偏好优化问题为例
papers.authors: Shangjian Yin, Zhouxing Shi
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in boosting the objective performance (e.g., reasoning) of Large Language Models (LLMs) through rule-based, on-policy self-improvement strategies. However, optimizing LLMs for subjective capabilities and alignment with human preferences remains challenging due to the non-verifiable nature. Most prior works use datasets comprising response pairs with substantial quality gaps labeled by a strong external judge. While effective for preference metrics, this paradigm often incurs an “alignment tax”, where the model’s objective performance on downstream tasks degrades as it overfits to subjective preferences. In this work, we introduce Donkey, a high-quality, non-verifiable dataset where response pairs differ only by subtle nuances. We find that LLMs optimized on Donkey via preference learning outperform those trained on data with explicit quality gaps, while simultaneously maintaining their objective capabilities. Furthermore, we observe that preference signals on Donkey can be decomposed into consensus preferences and individual preferences. Our analysis reveals that distilling consensus preferences provides a significantly more data-efficient signal for preference optimization. Our findings underscore the importance of leveraging nuanced preference signals and the consensus of multiple judges for advancing subjective LLM alignment. Our code and data will be available at https://github.com/SJY8460/Donkey.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通过基于规则的、在策略上的自我改进方法，显著提升了大语言模型的目标性能（例如推理能力）。然而，由于不可验证的特性，优化大语言模型以使其具备主观能力和符合人类偏好仍然具有挑战性。大多数先前的研究使用的是由外部权威机构标注的、存在明显质量差异的响应对数据集。虽然这种方法对于评估偏好指标非常有效，但往往会导致“对齐成本”问题，即模型在下游任务上的目标性能会下降，因为它过度拟合了主观偏好。在这项研究中，我们引入了Donkey这一高质量、不可验证的数据集，其中的响应对仅存在细微的差异。我们发现，通过偏好学习优化的大语言模型在Donkey数据集上的表现优于那些使用带有明确质量差异的数据进行训练的模型，同时还能保持其目标能力。此外，我们还发现Donkey上的偏好信号可以分解为共识偏好和个人偏好。我们的分析表明，提取共识偏好能够为偏好优化提供更高效的数据利用方式。我们的研究结果强调了利用细微的偏好信号以及多位评委的共识来推进主观型大语言模型对齐的重要性。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/SJY8460/Donkey获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RIMRULE: Improving Tool-Using Language Agents via MDL-Guided Rule Learning
papers.title_zh: 规则：通过基于模型驱动的规则学习来改进工具使用语言代理
papers.authors: Xiang Gao, Yuguang Yao, Qi Zhang, Kaiwen Dong, Avinash Baidya, Ruocheng Guo, Hilaf Hasson, Kamalika Das
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often struggle to use tools reliably in domain-specific settings, where APIs may be idiosyncratic, under-documented, or tailored to private workflows. This highlights the need for effective adaptation to task-specific tools. We propose RIMRULE, a neuro-symbolic approach for LLM adaptation based on dynamic rule injection. Compact, interpretable rules are distilled from failure traces and injected into the prompt during inference to improve task performance. These rules are proposed by the LLM itself and consolidated using a Minimum Description Length (MDL) objective that favors generality and conciseness. Each rule is stored in both natural language and a structured symbolic form, supporting efficient retrieval at inference time. Experiments on tool-use benchmarks show that this approach improves accuracy on both seen and unseen tools without modifying LLM weights. It outperforms prompting-based adaptation methods and complements finetuning, offering an interpretable layer of inference-time generalization. Moreover, rules learned from one LLM can be reused to improve others, including long reasoning LLMs, highlighting the portability of symbolic knowledge across architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在针对特定领域的场景中往往难以可靠地使用工具，因为这些场景中的API可能存在特殊性、文档不足的情况，或者只是为私有的工作流程而设计。这就凸显了需要针对任务特定的工具进行有效适配的必要性。我们提出了RIMRULE这一基于神经符号方法的模型适配方案，该方案通过动态规则注入来实现模型适配。这些简洁且易于理解的规则是从失败案例中提炼出来的，并在推理过程中被注入到提示中，以提升任务性能。这些规则是由模型本身生成的，并通过最小描述长度算法进行整合，从而确保规则的通用性和简洁性。每条规则都以自然语言和结构化的符号形式存储，从而在推理时实现高效的检索。在工具使用基准测试中的实验表明，这种方法可以在不修改模型权重的情况下，提高对已知和未知工具的识别准确率。与基于提示的适配方法相比，该方法表现更优，并且可以作为微调的补充，提供一层可解释的推理级泛化能力。此外，从一个模型中学习到的规则可以被重新用于改进其他模型，包括长推理模型，这充分体现了符号知识在不同架构之间的可移植性。

papers.title: GAM: Hierarchical Graph-based Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: GAM：基于层次化图的智能体记忆系统，适用于大型语言模型智能体
papers.authors: Zhaofen Wu, Hanrong Zhang, Fulin Lin, Wujiang Xu, Xinran Xu, Yankai Chen, Henry Peng Zou, Shaowen Chen, Weizhi Zhang, Xue Liu, Philip S. Yu, Hongwei Wang
papers.abstract: To sustain coherent long-term interactions, Large Language Model (LLM) agents must navigate the tension between acquiring new information and retaining prior knowledge. Current unified stream-based memory systems facilitate context updates but remain vulnerable to interference from transient noise. Conversely, discrete structured memory architectures provide robust knowledge retention but often struggle to adapt to fluid narrative evolution. To address this, we propose GAM, a hierarchical Graph-based Agentic Memory framework that explicitly decouples memory encoding from consolidation to effectively resolve the conflict between rapid context perception and stable knowledge retention. By isolating ongoing dialogue in a event progression graph and integrating it into a topic associative network only upon semantic shifts, our approach minimizes interference while preserving long-term consistency. Additionally, we introduce a Graph-guided, Multi-factor Retrieval strategy to enhance context precision. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongDialQA benchmarks indicate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both reasoning accuracy and computational efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了维持长期稳定的交互关系，大语言模型代理必须平衡获取新信息与保留先前知识之间的冲突。目前的统一流式记忆系统能够支持上下文的更新，但容易受到短暂噪声的干扰。相反，离散结构化的记忆架构虽然能确保知识的稳定保存，但却难以适应动态变化的叙事发展。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了GAM——一种基于图的层次化代理式记忆框架。该框架将记忆编码与巩固过程明确分离，从而有效解决快速上下文感知与稳定知识保留之间的矛盾。通过将当前对话隔离在事件进展图中，并仅在语义发生变化时将其整合到主题关联网络中，我们的方法能够在最小化干扰的同时保持长期的一致性。此外，我们还引入了基于图的多因素检索策略，以提高上下文处理的准确性。在LoCoMo和LongDialQA基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法在推理准确性和计算效率方面均优于现有的最先进基线算法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CypherSmith: Transforming Text-to-Cypher Generation for LLMs with Synthetic Data
papers.title_zh: CypherSmith：利用合成数据改进大语言模型中的文本加密生成功能
papers.authors: Zeyu Zhang, Kexuan Sun, Zheng Tang, Jens-S. Vöckler, Thien Huu Nguyen, Thuy Vu
papers.abstract: Knowledge Graph (KG) retrieval is a promising augmentation to address knowledge gaps and hallucinations in LLMs. As KGs in practice are stored in graph databases (e.g., Wikidata, Freebase), accurate retrieval requires translating natural language questions into structured queries (query generation). A key challenge of query generation is Text-to-Cypher, which generates Cypher queries for property graphs (e.g., Neo4j), a paradigm increasingly adopted in industry for their scalable architectures and expressive schemas. However, compared to other query generation tasks such as Text-to-SQL or Text-to-SPARQL, Text-to-Cypher remains underexplored due to scarce public KGs and datasets. Existing datasets are small, domain-limited, and lack diversity, constraining LLM progress. To address this, we introduce CypherSmith, an instruction-tuning dataset over 12\times larger than prior public Text-to-Cypher datasets, spanning diverse domains to better support LLM fine-tuning. Our key distinction lies in fully leveraging open-source LLMs for large-scale synthetic data generation and introducing a novel likelihood-based filtering technique to ensure high-quality Text-to-Cypher data. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of CypherSmith, achieving state-of-the-art LLM performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识图谱检索是一种有前景的方法，可用于填补大语言模型的知识空白并解决相关问题。在实际应用中，知识图谱通常存储在图数据库中（例如Wikidata、Freebase），因此要实现准确的检索，就需要将自然语言问题转化为结构化查询语句。查询生成中的一个关键挑战就是文本到Cypher的转换，即为属性图生成Cypher查询语句。这种技术已被工业界广泛采用，因为其可扩展的架构和丰富的模式表达能力非常实用。然而，与其他查询生成任务相比，如文本到SQL或文本到SPARQL，文本到Cypher仍然没有得到充分研究，主要是因为公开可用的知识图谱和数据集相对较少。现有的数据集规模较小，领域局限性明显，且缺乏多样性，这限制了大语言模型的进步。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了CypherSmith数据集，其规模是现有公开文本到Cypher数据集的12倍之多，涵盖了多种领域，能够更好地支持大语言模型的微调。我们的独特之处在于充分利用开源大语言模型来生成大规模合成数据，并引入了一种新的基于似然的过滤技术，以确保生成的文本到Cypher数据具有高质量。大量的实验表明，CypherSmith数据集确实有效，能够带来最先进的大语言模型性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: New Terms, New Toxicity: Consensus-based Chinese Neologism Toxicity Detection via Search-Augmented LLMs
papers.title_zh: 新词汇，新的“毒性”问题：基于共识的中文新词毒性检测——通过搜索引擎辅助的大型语言模型实现
papers.authors: Shiyao Cui, QingLin Zhang, Di Wang, Yida Lu, Zhexin Zhang, Jinhua Gao, Jinglin Yang, Min He, Han Qiu, Minlie Huang
papers.abstract: Neologisms, emerging terms in meaning or form, can serve as new vehicles for toxic expression, like “田园女” (“country girl”) as a stigmatizing label targeting feminism. Such toxic neologisms appear benign but have evolved into toxic usage in public consensus, posing challenges to moderation systems and remaining underexplored. In this paper, we investigate how to detect implicit toxicity expressed via neologisms. We first propose a taxonomy that captures the origins and consensus-verification criteria of toxic neologisms, followed by the construction of a lexicon spanning widely observed risk categories. To capture toxicity grounded in public consensus, we introduce SeTox, a search-augmented framework that enables static large language models (LLMs) to incorporate real-time web context for neologism toxicity detection. Experiments show that SeTox, even with 3B-scale models, outperforms recent large-scale models, demonstrating its scalability to incorporate real-world knowledge for toxic neologism detection. Disclaimer: this paper has offensive contents that may be disturbing to some readers.
papers.abstract_zh: 新造词、在含义或形式上出现的新术语，可能会成为表达负面情绪的载体。例如，“田园女”这种标签，就是一种针对女权主义的污名化称呼。这类新造词看似无害，但实际上已经在公众共识中演变成了具有负面意义的用语，这对调节系统提出了挑战，且相关研究仍然不足。在本文中，我们探讨了如何检测通过新造词所表达的隐性毒性。我们首先提出了一个分类体系，用于识别新造词的来源以及其在公众共识中的验证标准。接着，我们构建了一个词汇表，涵盖了各种常见的风险类别。为了捕捉基于公众共识的毒性特征，我们引入了SeTox这一框架，该框架能够让静态的大语言模型结合实时网络上下文来进行新造词毒性的检测。实验表明，即使使用3B规模模型，SeTox的表现也优于最近出现的大规模模型，显示出其具备整合现实世界知识以检测新造词毒性的能力。免责声明：本文包含一些可能令部分读者感到不适的内容。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ATGL: An Adaptive-Threshold Global Loss for Document-level Relation Extraction
papers.title_zh: ATGL：一种适用于文档级关系提取的自适应阈值全局损失函数
papers.authors: Huangming Xu, Fu Zhang, Zhixuan Yang, Lu Zhang, Jingwei Cheng
papers.abstract: Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) aims to determine which relations hold between a given entity pair within a document. As a multi-label classification task, the most commonly adopted paradigm introduces a learnable threshold to distinguish positive and negative classes for an entity pair. Under this paradigm, existing losses decouple the optimization into independent positive and negative losses, which interact solely with a shared threshold. This leads to two inherent limitations: (i) threshold instability caused by conflicting gradient updates from the decoupled losses; and (ii) optimization bias exacerbated by the severe imbalance between limited positive samples and abundant negative samples inherent in DocRE, which makes the model more likely to predict that no relation exists.To address these issues, we propose the Adaptive-Threshold Global Loss (ATGL). Unlike prior work, ATGL integrates positive, negative, and threshold optimization into a unified logit space and explicitly enforces ranking constraints on their contributions to the objective. Furthermore, ATGL incorporates an imbalance-aware optimization mechanism, thereby effectively addressing the severe class imbalance in DocRE. Our ATGL serves as a general optimization objective that can be readily applied to different DocRE models. Experiments on four datasets show that ATGL outperforms other DocRE losses and achieves state-of-the-art results, while consistently improving the performance of existing DocRE models. Code is available at https://github.com/xhm-code/ATGL.
papers.abstract_zh: 文档级关系提取（DocRE）的目的是确定文档中给定实体对之间存在的各种关系。作为一种多标签分类任务，最常用的方法是引入一个可学习的阈值来区分实体对的正类和负类。在这种框架下，现有的损失函数将优化过程分解为独立的正类损失和负类损失，这两个损失仅通过一个共享的阈值进行交互。然而，这种方法存在两个固有的局限性：(i) 由于分离后的损失函数产生冲突的梯度更新，导致阈值不稳定；(ii) 由于DocRE中正样本数量有限而负样本数量众多，导致优化偏差加剧，使得模型更有可能预测不存在关系。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了自适应阈值全局损失（ATGL）。与以往的方法不同，ATGL将正类、负类以及阈值相关的优化步骤整合到一个统一的逻辑斯蒂空间中，并明确地对它们对目标函数的贡献施加了排名约束。此外，ATGL还包含了一个针对不平衡问题的优化机制，从而有效解决了DocRE中的严重类别不平衡问题。我们的ATGL可以作为一个通用的优化目标，适用于不同的DocRE模型。在四个数据集上的实验表明，ATGL在其他DocRE损失函数中表现优异，取得了领先的研究成果，同时还能持续提升现有DocRE模型的性能。相关代码可以在https://github.com/xhm-code/ATGL下载。

papers.title: L2Dir: Integrating L\_2-Norm and Directional Alignment for Unsupervised Contrastive Representation Learning in Multimodal Retrieval
papers.title_zh: L2Dir：在多模态检索中，将L_2范数分析与定向对齐技术相结合，以实现无监督的对比式表示学习
papers.authors: Tianyu Zong, Rui Dai, Hongzhu Yi, Yuanxiang Wang, Zhenghao Zhang, Zhenyu Guan, Yujia Yang, Bingkang Shi, Yueyang Ding, Xiangxiang Chu, Kaikui Liu, Jungang Xu
papers.abstract: Multimodal representation learning primarily relies on contrastive objectives such as InfoNCE to align diverse modalities. However, these methods focus almost exclusively on directional alignment and often neglect the intrinsic role of embedding magnitudes (L2-norm) in the contrastive process. To bridge this gap, we propose L2Dir, a plug-and-play framework designed to optimize L2-norm alignment and Directional consistency jointly. As a highly efficient solution, L2Dir doesn’t require extra data, distillation, or external supervision. It can be integrated seamlessly into existing pipelines by employing a lightweight MLP to reconstruct magnitudes from frozen backbone features. Extensive evaluations across 95 tasks using UniIR and VLM2Vec-V2 frameworks demonstrate that L2Dir yields consistent and significant performance gains over established baselines across various backbones and scales, proving that explicit magnitude modeling is a versatile and potent strategy for refining unsupervised multimodal representations. The source code for L2Dir in VLM2Vec-V2 is available in the supplementary materials.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态表示学习主要依赖于对比性目标，如InfoNCE，来实现不同模态之间的对齐。然而，这些方法几乎只关注方向性的对齐，而往往忽略了嵌入幅度（L2范数）在对比过程中的重要作用。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了L2Dir框架，该框架旨在同时优化L2范数对齐和方向一致性。作为一种高效的解决方案，L2Dir不需要额外的数据、蒸馏或外部监督。它可以通过使用轻量级的MLP从冻结的骨干特征中重建幅度，从而无缝集成到现有的流程中。通过在95个任务上的广泛评估，使用UniIR和VLM2Vec-V2框架进行测试表明，L2Dir在各种骨干结构和规模上都能带来一致且显著的性能提升，这证明了显式地建模幅度是一种有效且强大的方法来改进无监督的多模态表示。L2Dir在VLM2Vec-V2中的源代码可在补充材料中获取。

papers.title: Towards Intrinsic Interpretability of Large Language Models: A Survey of Design Principles and Architectures
papers.title_zh: 关于大型语言模型的内在可解释性：设计原则与架构综述
papers.authors: Yutong Gao, Qinglin Meng, Yuan Zhou, Liangming Pan
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across many NLP tasks, their opaque internal mechanisms hinder trustworthiness and safe deployment. Existing surveys in explainable AI largely focus on post-hoc explanation methods that interpret trained models through external approximations. In contrast, intrinsic interpretability, which builds transparency directly into model architectures and computations, has recently emerged as a promising alternative. This paper presents a systematic review of the recent advances in intrinsic interpretability for LLMs, categorizing existing approaches into five design paradigms: functional transparency, concept alignment, representational decomposability, explicit modularization, and latent sparsity induction. We further discuss open challenges and outline future research directions in this emerging field. The paper list is available at: Survey-Intrinsic-Interpretability-of-LLMs
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在众多自然语言处理任务中取得了出色的性能，但其不透明的内部机制却阻碍了模型的可信度和安全部署。现有的可解释性人工智能研究大多集中在事后解释方法上，这些方法通过外部近似来解读训练好的模型。相比之下，内在可解释性则是一种有前景的替代方案，它能够直接提升模型架构和计算的透明度。本文对大语言模型内在可解释性的最新进展进行了系统性的回顾，将现有方法分为五种设计范式：功能透明性、概念对齐、表示分解能力、明确的模块化设计以及潜在稀疏性诱导。我们还讨论了这一领域面临的挑战，并指出了未来的研究方向。本文的列表可在以下链接查看：Survey-Intrinsic-Interpretability-of-LLMs

papers.title: ScholaWrite: A Dataset of End-to-End Scholarly Writing
papers.title_zh: ScholaWrite：一个关于学术写作从始至终过程的数据集
papers.authors: Khanh Chi Le, Linghe Wang, Minhwa Lee, Ross Volkov, Luan Tuyen Chau, Dongyeop Kang
papers.abstract: Writing is a cognitively demanding activity that requires constant decision-making, heavy reliance on working memory, and frequent shifts between tasks of different goals. To build writing assistants that truly align with writers’ cognition, it is necessary to capture and analyze the complete thought process behind how writers transform ideas into final texts. We present SCHOLAWRITE, the first dataset of end-to-end scholarly writing, tracing the multi-month journey from initial drafts to final manuscripts. The dataset traces nearly 62K LaTeX-based edits from five computer science preprints over four months and is enriched with fine-grained annotations of cognitive writing intentions. We demonstrate the value of ScholaWrite through three complementary contributions: (1) analysis of real-world writing behavior reveals that scholarly writing is highly non-linear and multi-intentional, blending rapid drafting bursts with cognitively sustained writing sessions; (2) evaluations of current large language models show that they struggle to provide meaningful support throughout the human writing process; and (3) models finetuned on SCHOLAWRITE demonstrate improved alignment with human writing workflows. SCHOLAWRITE underscores the value of capturing scientists’ cognitive writing process and provides actionable insights and resources for the development of future writing assistants.
papers.abstract_zh: 写作是一项需要高度认知能力的活动，它要求作者不断做出决策，大量依赖工作记忆，并且需要在不同目标的任务之间频繁切换。为了开发出真正符合作者认知需求的写作助手，有必要捕捉并分析作者将想法转化为最终文本时的整个思维过程。我们提出了SCHOLAWRITE这一首个关于学术写作全程的数据集，该数据集记录了从初稿到最终稿的数月历程。该数据集记录了五篇计算机科学预印本在四个月内进行的近6.2万次基于LaTeX的编辑操作，同时还包含了关于认知写作意图的详细注释。我们通过三项互补的研究成果证明了SCHOLAWRITE的价值：(1)对实际写作行为的分析表明，学术写作具有高度非线性和多意图的特点，既包含快速的草稿阶段，也包含需要持续思考的写作环节；(2)对当前大语言模型的评估显示，它们难以在整个写作过程中提供有意义的支持；(3)在SCHOLAWRITE数据集上训练的模型能够更好地适应人类写作流程。SCHOLAWRITE强调了捕捉科学家认知写作过程的重要性，并为未来写作助手的开发提供了有价值的见解和资源。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: What Deserves Memory: Adaptive Memory Distillation for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 值得记住的事物：适用于大型语言模型智能体的自适应记忆提取技术
papers.authors: Wenquan Ma, Jiayan Nan, WenLong Wu
papers.abstract: Memory systems for LLM agents struggle to determine what information deserves retention. Existing approaches rely on predefined heuristics such as importance scores, emotional tags, or factual templates, encoding designer intuition rather than learning from the data itself. Inspired by cognitive ideas, we propose Nemori, an adaptive memory distillation framework that casts the assessment of the experience’s future utility as a matter of predictability. Specifically, Nemori comprises two cascading modules: Episodic Memory Integration transforms raw interactions into coherent narratives, and Semantic Knowledge Distillation extracts insights via prediction error. Centering on distillation, the framework remains agnostic to downstream management. Extensive experiments confirm that Nemori achieves strong performance, efficiency, and storage reduction. Our work suggests that observing the intrinsic properties of interaction sequences offers a viable, data-driven alternative to heuristic-based memory design.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于大语言模型代理来说，记忆系统在判断哪些信息应该被保留方面存在困难。现有的方法依赖于预定义的启发式规则，如重要性评分、情感标签或事实模板等，这些规则是基于设计者的直觉而设定的，而非从数据中学习得来。受认知思想的启发，我们提出了Nemori这一自适应记忆蒸馏框架。该框架将评估经验未来效用的问题视为可预测性问题来处理。具体来说，Nemori由两个级联模块组成：情节记忆整合模块将原始交互转化为连贯的故事情节；语义知识蒸馏模块则通过预测误差来提取洞察力。该框架以蒸馏为核心，对后续管理过程保持中立态度。大量实验表明，Nemori在性能、效率以及存储需求方面都表现出色。我们的研究表明，通过观察交互序列的内在特性，可以提供一种可行的、基于数据的替代方案，来替代基于启发式的记忆设计方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SOAPTriage: SOAP-Guided Multi-View Clinical Text Modeling Framework for Automated ESI Prediction
papers.title_zh: SOAPTriage：一种基于SOAP协议的多视图临床文本建模框架，用于自动进行ESI预测
papers.authors: Enming Wang, Jianlei Wang, Xueping Peng, Hongjiao Guan, Yinglong Wang, Sibo Wei, Jianbin Guo, Ruifeng Xu, Wenpeng Lu
papers.abstract: Emergency departments (ED) rely on the Emergency Severity Index (ESI) to assess patient acuity and prioritize care, a process that is largely driven by clinical triage text. Despite recent progress in automated ESI prediction, two fundamental challenges remain: the scarcity of high-quality triage text data due to privacy and regulatory constraints and the lack of a clinically grounded triage framework capable of explicitly capturing the multidimensional structure of triage reasoning. To address these challenges, we draw inspiration from the clinically grounded SOAP paradigm, in which SOAP refers to Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan and captures four complementary aspects of clinical reasoning. Building on this paradigm, we propose SOAPTriage, a SOAP-guided multi-view clinical text modeling framework for automated ESI prediction. To mitigate data scarcity, SOAPTriage introduces a Clinical Note Augmentation (CNA) module that generates natural-language triage notes from structured ED records, resulting in 15,393 augmented clinical notes derived from a real-world dataset. To incorporate clinical structure, SOAPTriage employs a SOAP-Guided Encoding (SGE) module that models patient conditions from four complementary SOAP perspectives, together with an adaptive SOAP-Aware Aggregation and Inference (SAAI) module that performs multi-view reasoning to infer ESI levels. Extensive experiments show that SOAPTriage consistently outperforms strong prompting-based, multi-agent, and encoder-based baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of SOAP-guided multi-view clinical text modeling for automated emergency triage.
papers.abstract_zh: 急诊部门依赖紧急程度指数来评估患者的病情严重程度并安排优先救治顺序，这一过程在很大程度上依赖于临床分诊文本。尽管在自动预测紧急程度指数的技术上取得了一些进展，但仍然存在两个主要挑战：由于隐私和监管限制，高质量的分诊文本数据非常匮乏；此外，目前还缺乏一种能够准确捕捉分诊推理多维结构的临床分诊框架。为了应对这些挑战，我们借鉴了基于临床的SOAP范式，其中SOAP代表主观、客观、评估和计划，涵盖了临床推理的四个互补方面。在此基础上，我们提出了SOAPTriage这一基于SOAP引导的多视图临床文本建模框架，用于自动预测紧急程度指数。为了缓解数据匮乏的问题，SOAPTriage引入了一个临床记录增强模块，该模块能够从结构化的急诊记录中生成自然语言形式的分诊记录，最终从真实世界的数据集中获得了15,393条增强后的临床记录。为了融入临床结构，SOAPTriage采用了一种基于SOAP的编码方法，该方法从四个不同的SOAP视角对患者的病情进行建模；同时，它还包含一个自适应型SOAP感知聚合与推理模块，该模块通过多视图推理来推断紧急程度指数水平。广泛的实验表明，SOAPTriage在性能上始终优于那些基于强提示、多智能体或编码器基础的基线方法，这充分证明了基于SOAP的多视图临床文本建模在自动急诊分诊中的有效性。

papers.title: MoRI: Learning Motivation-Grounded Reasoning for Scientific Ideation in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MoRI：基于学习动机的推理机制，用于大型语言模型中的科学构想生成
papers.authors: Chenyang Gu, Jiahao Cheng, Meicong Zhang, Pujun Zheng, Jinquan Zheng, Guoxiu He
papers.abstract: Scientific ideation aims to propose novel solutions within a given scientific context. Existing LLM-based agentic approaches emulate human research workflows, yet inadequately model scientific reasoning, resulting in surface-level conceptual recombinations that lack technical depth and scientific grounding. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{MoRI} (\textbf{Mo}tivation-grounded \textbf{R}easoning for Scientific \textbf{I}deation), a framework that enables LLMs to explicitly learn the reasoning process from research motivations to methodologies. The base LLM is initialized via supervised fine-tuning to generate a research motivation from a given context, and is subsequently trained under a composite reinforcement learning reward that approximates scientific rigor: (1) entropy-aware information gain encourages the model to uncover and elaborate high-complexity technical details grounded in ground-truth methodologies, and (2) contrastive semantic gain constrains the reasoning trajectory to remain conceptually aligned with scientifically valid solutions. Empirical results show that MoRI consistently outperforms strong commercial LLMs and complex agentic baselines across multiple dimensions, including novelty, technical rigor, and feasibility. The code is available on GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学构思的目的是在特定的科学背景下提出新的解决方案。现有的基于大语言模型的智能体方法能够模仿人类的研究工作流程，但未能充分模拟科学推理过程，导致产生的概念重组仅停留在表面层次，缺乏技术深度和科学基础。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了**MoRI**（动机驱动的科学构思推理）框架。该框架使大语言模型能够从研究动机到方法论层面，明确学习推理过程。基础大语言模型通过监督式微调来生成给定情境下的研究动机，随后在一种复合强化学习奖励机制下进行训练，这种奖励机制能够模拟科学的严谨性：(1) 熵感知的信息增益促使模型揭示并详细阐述基于真实方法论的高复杂度技术细节；(2) 对比语义增益确保推理轨迹与科学上可行的解决方案保持一致。实验结果表明，MoRI在多个维度上始终优于强大的商业大语言模型和复杂的智能体基线模型，包括新颖性、技术严谨性和可行性等方面。相关代码可在GitHub上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: WSDPO: A Generative Word Sense Disambiguation Framework with Chain-of-Thought and Preference Optimization
papers.title_zh: WSDPO：一种基于思维链与偏好优化的生成式词义消歧框架
papers.authors: Kunpeng Kang, Shuaimin Li, Kaiyuan Zhang, Luyang Zhang, Jiasheng Si, Bing Xu, Kehai Chen, Muyun Yang, Wenpeng Lu
papers.abstract: Word sense disambiguation (WSD) is a foundational task in natural language processing. Recent research has reformulated WSD for large language models (LLMs) as a generative task, where the model produces a definition to convey the intended meaning of an ambiguous word in context.In practice, most existing approaches implement this formulation through straightforward supervised fine-tuning, which tends to prioritize superficial context-to-gloss memorization over true contextual sense discrimination, leading to degraded performance on less frequent senses (LFS), particularly in unseen settings.To address this issue, we propose WSDPO, a training framework for generative WSD with chain-of-thought (CoT) and preference optimization. WSDPO consists of three stages: (1) disambiguation-aware CoT construction, which produces training data containing explicit disambiguation steps for the later stage;(2) disambiguation-guided supervised fine-tuning, which explicitly trains the model to discriminate word sense before generating the final definition; and(3) preference-based optimization, which further strengthens the model’s ability to generate sense-faithful definitions by optimizing it using preference pairs constructed from multiple sampled CoT outputs.Extensive experiments across benchmark datasets and multiple backbone LLMs demonstrate that WSDPO achieves substantial performance gains on rare and unseen settings, and exhibits strong generalization in standard evaluation settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 词义消歧法是自然语言处理中的一个基础任务。最近的研究将针对大语言模型的词义消歧法重新定义为一项生成式任务，即模型在给定语境下生成单词的定义，以准确传达该单词的意图含义。在实际应用中，大多数现有方法通过简单的监督式微调来实现这一功能，这种方式往往更倾向于对表面上的上下文信息进行记忆，而忽视了真正的上下文语义差异，从而导致在较少出现的词义上的性能下降，尤其是在未见过的情况中。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了WSDPO这一训练框架，它结合了思维链处理和偏好优化技术，用于生成式词义消歧法。WSDPO包含三个阶段：(1) 考虑词义消歧的思维链构建，该阶段生成的训练数据包含了后续的词义消歧步骤；(2) 基于词义消歧的监督式微调，该阶段明确训练模型在生成最终定义之前能够区分不同的词义；以及(3) 基于偏好的优化，该阶段通过利用从多个采样思维链输出中构建的偏好对来优化模型，从而进一步提升模型生成符合语义定义的能力。通过在各种基准数据集和多种主流语言模型中进行的广泛实验表明，WSDPO在罕见和未见过的情况中取得了显著的性能提升，并且在标准评估环境中也表现出强大的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Regulatory Approvals to Patents: Cross-Domain Linking for Cardiovascular Device Traceability
papers.title_zh: 从监管审批到专利授权：用于心血管设备可追溯性的跨领域链接机制
papers.authors: Qingqing Yang, Haijiang Liu, Moyan Li
papers.abstract: Linking FDA-approved medical devices to their underlying United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) patents enables critical applications such as recall root-cause analysis, M&A-driven IP discovery, and technology trajectory mapping. However, this cross-domain entity linking task remains unexplored due to severe semantic gaps: FDA documents focus on clinical outcomes, while patents describe technical mechanisms, yielding minimal lexical overlap. We formalize medical device-patent linking as a challenging cross-domain entity linking problem characterized by label scarcity and domain shifts. Using cardiovascular devices as a high-impact, representative domain featuring diverse technologies, high recall rates, and abundant disclosures, we construct a benchmark with 434 devices, 698K patents, and 585 high-fidelity expert-verified pairs. To address these challenges, we propose Bridge-MedDevKG, a coarse-to-fine framework that integrates (1) MedDevOnto, a domain-specific ontology that anchors device concepts via three-tier UMLS normalization; (2) Multi-signal candidate generation fusing company affiliation, semantic similarity, and ontology-weighted entity overlap; and (3) Heterogeneous reranking with multi-signal scoring and XGBoost classification on hard negatives. Our approach achieves a conservative lower-bound recall of 91.6% on the gold standard with 50.9% noise reduction, substantially outperforming LLM baselines under comparable evaluation. The resulting MedDevKG provides 6.8M high-confidence links, laying a scalable foundation for regulatory-IP integration across medical specialties.
papers.abstract_zh: 将美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的医疗器械与其相关的美国专利局专利进行关联，有助于实现诸如召回根本原因分析、基于并购的知识产权发现以及技术轨迹映射等关键应用。然而，由于语义上的巨大差异，这种跨领域的实体关联任务仍然未被充分研究：FDA的文件主要关注临床效果，而专利则描述了技术机制，两者之间的词汇重叠非常有限。我们将医疗器械与专利的关联问题形式化为一个具有挑战性的跨领域实体关联问题，该问题的特点包括标签稀缺性和领域转换问题。我们以心血管设备作为高影响、具有代表性的领域，该领域包含多种技术、较高的召回率以及丰富的公开信息。我们构建了一个基准数据集，其中包含434种医疗器械、698,000项专利以及585对经过专家验证的高保真度配对关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Bridge-MedDevKG框架，该框架采用从粗到细的整合方式：(1)使用MedDevOnto这一特定领域的本体，通过三层UMLS规范化方法将医疗器械概念与专利关联起来；(2)采用多信号候选生成算法，结合公司隶属关系、语义相似性和本体加权实体重叠度来生成候选对象；(3)通过多信号评分和XGBoost分类算法对困难负例进行重新排序。我们的方法在黄金标准上实现了91.6%的保守下限召回率，同时减少了50.9%的噪声数据，其性能显著优于同类LLM基线模型。最终得到的MedDevKG提供了680万个高置信度的关联链接，为不同医疗专业领域的监管与知识产权整合奠定了可扩展的基础。

papers.title: TrustTable: A Neuro-Symbolic Auditing Framework for Faithful Table QA
papers.title_zh: TrustTable：一种用于实现可靠表级查询的神经符号审计框架
papers.authors: Guangzhen Zhao, Dechang Kong, Tongyu Wu, Zhenjiang Dong
papers.abstract: Large Language Models based Table Question Answering (LLMs-based TableQA) models excel in NLP field, however, they occasionally exhibit an unfaithful behavior where correct answers are derived through erroneous reasoning paths. In this condition, we propose TrustTable, a neuro-symbolic framework designed to ensure reasoning faithfulness by auditing the reasoning processes of LLMs. Unlike monolithic LLM-based auditors, TrustTable decouples the auditing operation into two orthogonal dimensions. It enforces factual grounding by executing neurally generated Pandas code against the table, and ensures logical soundness by verifying reasoning chains through a LLM-synthesized formal solver. By integrating these symbolic checks, TrustTable enables a Label-Free Audit Loop that systematically identifies and rectifies reasoning flaws without human supervision. In addition, we present the TrustTable-Bench, a diagnostic dataset containing diverse error categories that range from calculation discrepancies to schema misalignments. This benchmark allows for a rigorous quantification of reasoning limitations. Experiments demonstrate that our symbolic audit detects reasoning flaws more accurately than advanced baselines. More broadly, the TrustTable outperforms LLM judges in both majority voting with logical weighting and rejection sampling with process supervision.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的表格问答模型在自然语言处理领域表现出色，但有时会出现错误推理导致得出错误答案的情况。针对这种情况，我们提出了TrustTable这一神经符号框架，该框架通过审计大语言模型的推理过程来确保推理的可靠性。与传统的基于单一大语言模型的审计方法不同，TrustTable将审计操作分解为两个正交维度。它通过执行由神经网络生成的Pandas代码来对表格进行事实验证，并通过使用大语言模型合成的形式化求解器来验证推理链的逻辑正确性。通过整合这些符号检查机制，TrustTable能够实现无需人工干预的系统性推理缺陷检测与修正。此外，我们还开发了TrustTable-Bench这一诊断数据集，其中包含多种错误类型，从计算误差到模式不匹配等问题都有涉及。该数据集有助于对推理局限性进行严格量化分析。实验结果表明，我们的符号审计方法在检测推理缺陷方面比先进基线方法更为准确。总体而言，TrustTable在逻辑加权多数投票以及带有过程监督的拒绝抽样任务中均优于基于大语言模型的判断方法。

papers.title: Lizard: An Efficient Linearization Framework for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 蜥蜴：一种适用于大型语言模型的高效线性化框架
papers.authors: Chien Van Nguyen, Huy Huu Nguyen, Ruiyi Zhang, Hanieh Deilamsalehy, Puneet Mathur, Viet Dac Lai, Haoliang Wang, Jayakumar Subramanian, Ryan A. Rossi, Trung Bui, Nikos Vlassis, Franck Dernoncourt, Thien Huu Nguyen
papers.abstract: We propose Lizard, a linearization framework that transforms pretrained Transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) into subquadratic architectures. Transformers faces severe computational and memory bottlenecks with long sequences due to the quadratic complexity of softmax attention and the growing Key-Value (KV) cache that makes inference memory-bound by context length. Lizard addresses these limitations by introducing a subquadratic attention mechanism that closely approximates softmax attention while preserving model quality. Unlike prior linearization methods constrained by fixed, non-adaptive structures, Lizard augments the architecture with compact, learnable modules that enable adaptive memory control and robust length generalization. Moreover, we introduce a hardware-aware algorithm that solves numerical instability in gated attention to accelerate training. Extensive experiments show that Lizard achieves near-lossless recovery of its teacher model’s performance, significantly outperforming previous methods by up to 9.4 - 24.5 points on the 5-shot MMLU benchmark and demonstrating superior associative recall.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Lizard这一线性化框架，它能够将预训练的基于Transformer的大语言模型转化为亚二次复杂度架构。由于softmax注意力机制的二次计算复杂度，以及不断增长的键值缓存所带来的内存限制，Transformer在处理长序列时面临严重的计算和内存瓶颈问题。Lizard通过引入一种亚二次复杂度的注意力机制来解决这些问题，该机制能够在保持模型质量的同时，近似实现softmax注意力机制的功能。与那些受限于固定、非自适应结构的先前线性化方法不同，Lizard通过添加紧凑且可学习的模块来增强架构能力，从而实现自适应内存控制以及强大的长度泛化能力。此外，我们还提出了一种硬件感知算法，用于解决门控注意力机制中的数值不稳定问题，从而加速模型的训练过程。大量实验表明，Lizard能够近乎无损地恢复教师模型的性能，在5次采样MMLU基准测试中，其表现比以往的方法高出9.4至24.5个百分点，并且在联想召回率方面也表现出色。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TPS-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents’ Tool Planning & Scheduling Abilities in Compounding Tasks
papers.title_zh: TPS-Bench：评估AI代理在复杂任务中的工具规划与调度能力
papers.authors: Hanwen Xu, Xuyao Huang, Yuzhe Liu, Zhijie Deng
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have exhibited strong problem-solving competence across domains like research and coding. Yet, it remains underexplored whether LLM agents can tackle compounding real-world problems that require a diverse set of tools to complete. Given a broad, heterogeneous tool repository, LLM agents must not only select appropriate tools based on task planning analysis but also strategically schedule the execution order to ensure efficiency. This paper introduces TPS-Bench to benchmark the ability of LLM agents in solving such problems that demand Tool Planning and Scheduling. TPS-Bench collects 200 compounding tasks of two difficulty levels, based on a tool repository containing hundreds of model context protocol (MCP) tools. In particular, each task is composed of multiple subtasks, such as web search, map navigation, calendar checking, etc., and each subtask can be completed by a basic tool. Our evaluation emphasizes both task completion rate and efficiency. The empirical studies on popular closed-source and open-source LLMs indicate that most models can perform reasonable tool planning, but differ in scheduling. For example, GLM-4.5 achieves an outperforming task completion rate of 64.72% with extensive sequential tool calls, hence suffering from significantly long execution time. By contrast, GPT-4o prioritizes parallel tool calls but achieves only a 45.08% completion rate. Considering reinforcement learning (RL) can be a viable way to improve the scheduling efficiency without compromising performance, we perform an initial study on Qwen3-1.7B and witness a 14% reduction in execution time alongside a 6% gain in task completion rate based on only 597 RL training samples.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理在研究和编程等领域展现了强大的问题解决能力。然而，目前尚不清楚这些LLM代理是否能够处理需要多种工具来完成的实际问题。面对庞大的、多样化的工具库，LLM代理不仅需要根据任务规划分析选择合适的工具，还需要策略性地安排执行顺序以确保效率。本文介绍了TPS-Bench这一工具，用于评估LLM代理解决这类问题的能力，这些问题需要工具规划和调度。TPS-Bench收集了200个具有不同难度的复合任务，这些任务基于包含数百种模型上下文协议工具的库来设计。每个任务由多个子任务组成，例如网络搜索、地图导航、日历检查等，而每个子任务可以由一个基础工具完成。我们的评估重点包括任务完成率和效率。对流行的闭源和开源LLM进行的实证研究表明，大多数模型能够进行合理的工具规划，但在调度方面存在差异。例如，GLM-4.5通过广泛的连续工具调用实现了64.72%的高任务完成率，但执行时间却相当长。相比之下，GPT-4o则优先进行并行工具调用，但其完成率仅为45.08%。考虑到强化学习可以在不牺牲性能的情况下提高调度效率，我们对Qwen3-1.7B进行了初步研究，发现仅使用597个强化学习训练样本就能将执行时间减少14%，同时任务完成率提高6%。

papers.title: S2S-Arena: Evaluating Paralinguistic Instruction Following in Speech-to-Speech Models
papers.title_zh: S2S-竞技场：评估语音到语音模型中的辅助语言指令执行能力
papers.authors: Feng Jiang, Zhiyu Lin, Yiyang Liu, Liumeng Xue, Fan Bu, Yuhao Du, Xiangying Chen, Benyou Wang, Haizhou Li
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have fundamentally reshaped speech-to-speech (S2S) systems, enabling increasingly natural spoken interaction. However, existing benchmarks still rely heavily on text-based evaluation and largely ignore paralinguistic cues such as prosody, emotion, and speaker traits, which are central to expressive and human-like communication. We introduce S2S-Arena, a speech-native benchmark for evaluating instruction-following S2S models with explicit assessment of both semantic understanding and paralinguistic expression. S2S-Arena features a four-level interaction protocol that systematically probes models under increasing paralinguistic complexity, a two-stage data construction pipeline that produces 1,243 speech samples spanning 100+ real-world tasks, and an arena-style evaluation framework that enables reference-free, pairwise comparison directly in the speech modality. Benchmarking 10 state-of-the-art S2S systems over 1,000+ comparisons reveals substantial performance gaps (especially under complex paralinguistic demands) between current academic and industrial systems. Our analysis further identifies key design factors governing expressive instruction following, providing actionable insights for building more natural, robust, and human-aligned speech agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展从根本上重塑了语音到语音的转换系统，使得口语交互变得更加自然。然而，现有的评估基准仍然严重依赖基于文本的评价方式，而忽略了诸如韵律、情感以及说话者特征等副语言线索，这些线索对于实现富有表现力且类似人类的交流至关重要。我们提出了S2S-Arena这一专为语音环境设计的评估基准，它能够对遵循指令的语音转换模型进行全面的评估，同时明确考察模型的语义理解能力和副语言表达能力。S2S-Arena采用了四级交互协议，系统地测试模型在日益复杂的副语言环境中的表现；还采用了两阶段的数据构建流程，生成了1,243个语音样本，涵盖100多种现实场景；同时，该基准还具备一种竞技场式的评估框架，使得可以在语音层面直接进行无参考的成对比较。通过对10种最先进的语音转换系统进行超过1,000次对比评估，我们发现当前学术研究和工业应用中的系统之间存在显著的性能差距（尤其是在复杂的副语言环境下）。我们的分析进一步指出了影响语音转换系统表现的关键因素，为构建更自然、更强大且更符合人类需求的语音助手提供了有价值的见解。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can LLM Safety Be Ensured by Constraining Parameter Regions?
papers.title_zh: 通过限制某些参数范围，能否确保大型语言模型的安全性？
papers.authors: Zongmin Li, Jian Su, Farah Benamara, Aixin Sun
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often assumed to contain "safety regions” - parameter subsets whose modification directly influences safety behaviors. We conduct a systematic evaluation of four safety region identification methods spanning different parameter granularities, from individual weights to entire Transformer layers, across four families of backbone LLMs with varying sizes. Using ten safety identification datasets, we find that the identified safety regions exhibit only low to moderate overlap, as measured by IoU. The overlap drops significantly when the safety regions are further refined using utility datasets (i.e. non-harmful queries). These results suggest that current techniques fail to reliably identify a stable, dataset-agnostic safety region.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常被认为包含“安全区域”——这些参数子集的修改会直接影响安全行为。我们对四种用于识别安全区域的方法进行了系统评估，这些方法的参数粒度各不相同，从单个权重到整个Transformer层都有涉及。我们测试了四种不同规模的骨干语言模型。通过十个安全识别数据集的测试，我们发现被识别出的安全区域之间的重叠程度较低或中等，这一结论是通过IoU指标来衡量的。当使用实用数据集（即非有害查询）进一步细化安全区域时，这种重叠程度会显著下降。这些结果表明，当前的技术无法可靠地识别出稳定且不受数据集影响的安全区域。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CityVG: Contrastive Fine-Tuning and Reward-Based Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Zero-Shot City-Scale 3D Visual Grounding
papers.title_zh: CityVG：对比式微调与基于奖励的链式思维推理技术，用于零样本下的城市级3D视觉定位
papers.authors: Jianjun Zhang, Hanli Wang
papers.abstract: 3D Visual Grounding (3DVG) locates objects in 3D scenes based on natural language descriptions. However, existing methods are primarily confined to small-scale indoor data or rely on heavy supervision, failing to generalize to the complexity of large-scale urban environments. To address this limitation, we present CityVG, the first city-scale zero-shot 3D visual grounding framework capable of localizing urban objects without manual annotations. Our approach adopts a retrieval-and-reasoning paradigm comprising two key components. Specifically, we propose a contrastive fine-tuning strategy to align textual queries with urban scene graphs. By leveraging an LLM-driven graph clustering mechanism, we automatically construct high-quality positive and negative training pairs and fine-tune the text encoder via contrastive learning, resulting in a scene-adaptive text encoder that enables efficient alignment without grounding supervision. Complementing this, we introduce a multi-trajectory reward-based Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning strategy for inference. This mechanism iteratively evaluates candidate objects by aggregating reward scores across diverse reasoning trajectories, selecting the target that is most consistent with both appearance and spatial constraints. Extensive experiments on city-scale 3D grounding benchmarks demonstrate that CityVG achieves strong zero-shot localization performance and generalizes effectively to unseen urban environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 3D视觉定位（3DVG）能够根据自然语言描述在3D场景中定位物体。然而，现有的方法主要局限于小规模的室内数据，或者依赖于大量的监督数据，无法适应大规模城市环境的复杂性。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了CityVG——首个适用于城市规模、无需手动标注即可定位城市物体的零样本3D视觉定位框架。我们的方法采用检索与推理相结合的策略，包含两个关键组成部分。具体来说，我们提出了一种对比度微调策略，将文本查询与城市场景图进行对齐。通过利用LLM驱动的图聚类机制，我们能够自动构建高质量的正样本和负样本训练对，并通过对比度学习来优化文本编码器，从而得到一个能够自适应场景变化的文本编码器，使得在没有外部监督的情况下也能实现高效的对齐。此外，我们还引入了基于多轨迹奖励的推理策略。该机制通过整合不同推理路径上的奖励分数，逐步评估候选物体，最终选择出最符合外观和空间约束的目标物体。在大规模城市3D定位基准测试中的广泛实验表明，CityVG在零样本定位方面表现出强大的性能，并且能够有效适应未知的城市环境。

papers.title: E2EDev: Benchmarking Large Language Models in End-to-End Software Development Task
papers.title_zh: E2EDev：在端到端软件开发任务中对大型语言模型的性能进行对比测试
papers.authors: Jingyao Liu, Chen Huang, Zhizhao Guan, Wenqiang Lei, Yang Deng
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement in large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated significant potential in End-to-End Software Development (E2ESD). However, existing E2ESD benchmarks are limited by coarse-grained requirement specifications and unreliable evaluation protocols, hindering a true understanding of current framework capabilities. To address these limitations, we present E2EDev, a novel benchmark grounded in the principles of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to assess whether the generated software meets user needs through mimicking real user interactions. E2EDev comprises (i) a fine-grained set of user requirements for each target software project (ii) multiple BDD test scenarios with corresponding Python step implementations for each requirement, and (iii) a fully automated testing pipeline built on the Behave framework. By evaluating various E2ESD frameworks and LLM backbones with E2EDev, our analysis reveals a persistent struggle to effectively solve these tasks, underscoring the critical need for more effective and cost-efficient E2ESD solutions. Our codebase and benchmark are available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/E2EDev.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展表明，它们在端到端软件开发领域具有巨大的潜力。然而，现有的端到端软件开发基准测试存在诸多局限性，例如需求描述过于粗略、评估协议不可靠等问题，这些限制使得我们无法真正了解当前框架的能力。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了E2EDev这一基于行为驱动开发原则的新基准测试方案。该测试方案通过模拟真实用户交互来评估生成的软件是否能够满足用户需求。E2EDev包含以下要素：(1) 针对每个目标软件项目制定的细粒度用户需求；(2) 多个基于行为驱动开发原理的测试场景，以及每个需求的相应Python代码实现；(3) 基于Behave框架构建的全自动测试流程。通过对不同端到端软件开发框架和LLM基础模型进行E2EDev测试分析，我们发现目前仍难以有效解决这些问题，这进一步凸显了需要更高效且成本较低的端到端软件开发解决方案的迫切性。我们的代码库和基准测试可访问https://github.com/SCUNLP/E2EDev。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reasoning While Asking: Transforming Reasoning Large Language Models from Passive Solvers to Proactive Inquirers
papers.title_zh: 在提问过程中进行推理：将大型语言模型从被动求解器转变为主动探究者
papers.authors: Xin Chen, Feng Jiang, Yiqian Zhang, Hardy Chen, Shuo Yan, Wenya Xie, Min Yang, Shujian Huang
papers.abstract: Reasoning-oriented Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, yet they remain fundamentally limited by a blind self-thinking paradigm: performing extensive internal reasoning even when critical information is missing or ambiguous. We propose Proactive Interactive Reasoning (PIR), a new reasoning paradigm that transforms LLMs from passive solvers into proactive inquirers that interleave reasoning with clarification. Unlike existing search- or tool-based frameworks that primarily address knowledge uncertainty by querying external environments, PIR targets premise- and intent-level uncertainty through direct interaction with the user. PIR is implemented via two core components: (1) an uncertainty-aware supervised fine-tuning procedure that equips models with interactive reasoning capability, and (2) a user-simulator-based policy optimization framework driven by a composite reward that aligns model behavior with user intent. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and document editing demonstrate that PIR consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving up to 32.70% higher accuracy, 22.90% higher pass rate, and 41.36 BLEU improvement, while reducing nearly half of the reasoning computation and unnecessary interaction turns. Further reliability evaluations on factual knowledge, question answering, and missing-premise scenarios confirm the strong generalization and robustness of PIR.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于推理的大语言模型在思维链提示方面取得了显著进展，但它们仍然受到一个根本性的限制：即无法进行有意识的内部推理——即使缺乏关键信息或信息模糊时也是如此。我们提出了主动交互式推理这一新的推理范式，它将大语言模型从被动的求解器转变为能够结合推理与解释功能的主动探索者。与那些主要通过查询外部环境来应对知识不确定性的现有搜索或工具型框架不同，主动交互式推理通过直接与用户互动来处理前提和意图层面的不确定性。该范式通过两个核心组件实现：(1)一种具有不确定性感知能力的监督式微调方法，使模型具备交互式推理能力；(2)一个基于用户模拟器的策略优化框架，该框架由复合奖励驱动，能够将模型行为与用户意图保持一致。在数学推理、代码生成和文档编辑方面的广泛实验表明，主动交互式推理始终优于强大的基准模型，其准确率提高了32.70%，通过率提高了22.90%，BLEU评分提升了41.36。同时，推理计算量减少了近一半，不必要的交互次数也大幅减少。在事实知识、问题回答以及前提缺失场景下的进一步可靠性评估进一步证实了主动交互式推理的强大泛化能力和鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Utility-Oriented Visual Evidence Selection for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 基于实用性的视觉证据选择方法，用于多模态检索增强生成技术
papers.authors: Weiqing Luo, Zongye Hu, Xiao Wang, Zhiyuan Yu, Haofeng Zhang, Ziyi Huang
papers.abstract: Visual evidence selection is a critical component of multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), yet existing methods typically rely on semantic relevance or surface-level similarity, which are often misaligned with the actual utility of visual evidence for downstream reasoning. We reformulate multimodal evidence selection from an information-theoretic perspective by defining evidence utility as the information gain induced on a model’s output distribution. To overcome the intractability of answer-space optimization, we introduce a latent notion of evidence helpfulness and theoretically show that, under mild assumptions, ranking evidence by information gain on this latent variable is equivalent to answer-space utility. We further propose a training-free, surrogate-accelerated framework that efficiently estimates evidence utility using lightweight multimodal models. Experiments on MRAG-Bench and Visual-RAG across multiple model families demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art RAG baselines while achieving substantial reductions in computational cost. We release our code at https://github.com/Hcnaeg/utility-mrag.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉证据选择是多模态检索增强生成技术中的一个关键组成部分。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于语义相关性或表面相似性来选取证据，而这些指标往往与实际视觉证据在下游推理中的效用不符。我们从信息论的角度重新定义了多模态证据选择，将证据效用定义为对模型输出分布产生的信息增益。为了克服答案空间优化的复杂性问题，我们引入了一个潜在的证据有用性概念，并理论证明：在适当的假设条件下，根据这一潜在变量的信息增益对证据进行排序，与计算答案空间的效用是等效的。我们还提出了一个无需训练的替代加速框架，该框架能够利用轻量级多模态模型高效地估算证据效用。在MRAG-Bench和Visual-RAG等多个模型家族上的实验表明，我们的方法始终优于现有的RAG基线算法，同时显著降低了计算成本。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Hcnaeg/utility-mrag下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Mitigating Selection Bias in Large Language Models via Permutation-Aware GRPO
papers.title_zh: 通过置换感知的GRPO方法减轻大型语言模型中的选择偏差问题
papers.authors: Jinquan Zheng, Jia Yuan, Jiacheng Yao, Chenyang Gu, Pujun Zheng, Guoxiu He
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) used for multiple-choice and pairwise evaluation tasks often exhibit selection bias due to non-semantic factors like option positions and label symbols. Existing inference-time debiasing is costly and may harm reasoning, while pointwise training ignores that the same question should yield consistent answers across permutations. To address this issue, we propose Permutation-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (PA-GRPO), which mitigates selection bias by enforcing permutation-consistent semantic reasoning. PA-GRPO constructs a permutation group for each instance by generating multiple candidate permutations, and optimizes the model using two complementary mechanisms: (1) cross-permutation advantage, which computes advantages relative to the mean reward over all permutations of the same instance, and (2) consistency-aware reward, which encourages the model to produce consistent decisions across different permutations. Experimental results demonstrate that PA-GRPO outperforms strong baselines across seven benchmarks, substantially reducing selection bias while maintaining high overall performance. The code is available on github (https://github.com/ECNU-Text-Computing/PA-GRPO).
papers.abstract_zh: 用于选择题和成对评估任务的大语言模型，往往会因为非语义因素如选项位置和标签符号而表现出选择偏差。现有的推理时去偏处理成本较高，且可能会损害推理能力；而逐点训练则忽略了同一个问题在不同排列组合下应该得到一致的答案这一事实。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于排列一致性的组相对策略优化方法——Permutation-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization（PA-GRPO）。该方法通过强制实施排列一致的语义推理来减轻选择偏差。PA-GRPO为每个实例构建了一个排列组，通过生成多个候选排列来实现优化，并采用两种互补的机制来进行模型优化：(1) 交叉排列优势机制，该机制计算同一实例的所有排列相对于平均奖励的优势；(2) 一致性感知奖励机制，该机制促使模型在不同的排列组合中做出一致的决策。实验结果表明，PA-GRPO在七个基准测试中的表现均优于其他强基线算法，能够显著减少选择偏差，同时保持良好的整体性能。相关代码可在github上获取：https://github.com/ECNU-Text-Computing/PA-GRPO

papers.title: KG-ViP: Bridging Knowledge Grounding and Visual Perception in Multi-modal LLMs for Visual Question Answering
papers.title_zh: KG-ViP：在多模态大语言模型中融合知识基础与视觉感知，以实现视觉问答任务
papers.authors: Zhiyang Li, Ao Ke, Yukun Cao, Xike Xie
papers.abstract: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for Visual Question Answering (VQA) often suffer from dual limitations: knowledge hallucination and insufficient fine-grained visual perception. Crucially, we identify that commonsense graphs and scene graphs provide precisely complementary solutions to these respective deficiencies by providing rich external knowledge and capturing fine-grained visual details. However, prior works typically treat them in isolation, overlooking their synergistic potential. To bridge this gap, we propose KG-ViP, a unified framework that empowers MLLMs by fusing scene graphs and commonsense graphs. The core of the KG-ViP framework is a novel retrieval-and-fusion pipeline that utilizes the query as a semantic bridge to progressively integrate both graphs, synthesizing a unified structured context that facilitates reliable multi-modal reasoning. Extensive experiments on FVQA 2.0+ and MVQA benchmarks demonstrate that KG-ViP significantly outperforms existing VQA methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于视觉问题回答的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）常常面临两个限制：知识幻觉和不足的细粒度视觉感知能力。我们发现，常识图谱和场景图谱能够分别解决这些缺陷，它们提供了丰富的外部知识，并能够捕捉到细粒度的视觉细节。然而，以往的研究通常将这些图谱单独处理，而忽视了它们之间的协同效应。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了KG-ViP框架，该框架通过将场景图谱和常识图谱融合在一起，为MLLMs提供强大的支持。KG-ViP框架的核心是一个创新的检索与融合流程，它利用查询作为语义桥梁，逐步整合这两种图谱，从而构建出一个统一的结构化上下文，促进可靠的多模态推理。在FVQA 2.0+和MVQA基准测试中的大量实验表明，KG-ViP在性能上显著优于现有的VQA方法。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning–Guided Adaptive Tuning for Out-of-Distribution Harmful Text Detection
papers.title_zh: 强化学习——引导式自适应调优算法在异常文本检测中的应用
papers.authors: Mengyu Xiang, Tinghao Chen, Boxu Han, Qiudan Li, Shu Wu, Daniel Dajun Zeng
papers.abstract: As social media grows, harmful information spreads rapidly across platforms and evolves over time, showing cross-platform and cross-temporal variations. Existing methods rely on fixed model parameters during training, which fail to handle substantial semantic discrepancies, leading to Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) problems. While test-time tuning enables dynamic parameter adjustment, it may lead to excessive adaptation to individual samples. The key challenge is how to adapt to semantic variations during testing while preventing overfitting from continuous tuning. To tackle this issue, this paper proposes RLAT, a reinforcement learning (RL)–guided adaptive tuning method for harmful text detection. First, a tuning joint optimization module is designed to update parameters and adapt to semantic variations during testing. It tunes the model by optimizing consistency loss and applying word-level attention constraints to reduce over-reliance on local words and learn a more robust global representation. Then, to mitigate overfitting caused by continuous tuning, a RL–guided adaptive decision model is introduced to direct the tuning process. It reduces the influence of local samples by selecting data and controlling parameter updates, thereby improving overall test performance. Experimental results show that the RLAT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in cross-platform and cross-temporal scenarios across multiple public datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着社交媒体的发展，有害信息在各个平台上迅速传播，并且随着时间的推移而发生变化，呈现出跨平台和跨时间的差异。现有的方法在训练过程中依赖固定的模型参数，这无法处理重大的语义差异，从而导致“超出分布范围”的问题。虽然测试时调整参数可以实现动态调整，但这可能会导致过度适应个别样本。因此，关键挑战在于如何在测试过程中适应语义变化，同时避免由于持续调整而导致的过拟合问题。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种基于强化学习引导的适应性调整方法——RLAT，用于检测有害文本。首先，设计了一个调整联合优化模块，用于更新参数并适应测试过程中的语义变化。它通过优化一致性损失，并应用单词级注意力约束来减少对局部单词的依赖，从而学习出更稳健的全局表示。其次，为了减轻持续调整引起的过拟合问题，引入了一种强化学习引导的适应性决策模型，以指导调整过程。该模型通过选择数据和控制参数更新来减少局部样本的影响，从而提高整体测试性能。实验结果表明，RLAT在多个公共数据集上的跨平台和跨时间场景中都优于最先进的基线方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SOAR: Supervision from Observation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: SOAR：基于观察的代理强化学习监督机制
papers.authors: Meng Li, Lei Li, Xiting Wang, Yi Yuan, Zheng Wei, Brucebian, Zang Li
papers.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning enables large language models to solve long-horizon tasks by interacting with the environment and internalizing tool-use behavior into their reasoning. Prior work assigns supervision primarily based on outcome rewards or external reward models, but largely ignores environment observations, a critical source of learning. Consequently, agents may identify successful actions without understanding how the environment responds, producing suboptimal policies. To address this, we propose SOAR (Supervision from Observation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning), which assigns positive advantages to observation tokens proportional to the negative entropy of preceding actions. This encourages the agent to learn from outcomes of confident actions, grounding policy updates in environment dynamics and improving anticipation of tool-call consequences. Empirical results across three domains and 14 benchmarks show that SOAR improves performance, yielding gains of up to 7.0% on general reasoning tasks and 16.9% on deep research tasks, while reducing erroneous and inefficient tool usage.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动强化学习使得大语言模型能够通过与环境互动并将工具使用行为内化为其推理过程，从而解决长期任务。以往的研究主要基于结果奖励或外部奖励模型来分配监督权重，却严重忽视了环境观测数据这一重要的学习来源。因此，智能体可能会识别出成功的行动方式，但却无法理解环境的反应，从而导致策略不够优化。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SOAR（从观测数据中为主动强化学习提供监督）方法。该方法根据先前行动的负熵比例，给予观测数据相应的正优势值。这促使智能体从自信采取的行动结果中学习，使策略更新更加依赖于环境动态，并提升对工具调用后果的预判能力。在三个领域和14个基准测试中的实证结果表明，SOAR显著提升了性能，在一般推理任务上实现了高达7.0%的性能提升，在深度研究任务上则达到了16.9%的提升，同时减少了错误和低效的工具使用现象。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Business as Rulesual: A Benchmark and Framework for Business Rule Flow Modeling with LLMs
papers.title_zh: 以规则为导向的商业实践：一种基于大语言模型的商业规则流程建模的基准与框架
papers.authors: Chen Yang, Ruping Xu, Ruizhe Li, Bin Cao, Jing Fan
papers.abstract: Extracting structured procedural knowledge from unstructured business documents is a critical yet unresolved bottleneck in process automation. While prior work has focused on extracting linear action flows from instructional texts (e.g., recipes), it has insufficiently addressed the complex logical structures—such as conditional branching and parallel execution—that are pervasive in real-world regulatory and administrative documents. Furthermore, existing benchmarks are limited by simplistic schemas and shallow logical dependencies, restricting progress toward logic-aware large language models (LLMs). To bridge this “Logic Gap”, we introduce \textbf{BREX}, a carefully curated benchmark comprising 409 real-world business documents and 2,855 expert-annotated rules. Unlike prior datasets centered on narrow service scenarios, BREX spans over 30 vertical domains, covering scientific, industrial, administrative, and financial regulations.We further propose \textbf{ExIde}, a structure-aware reasoning framework that investigates five distinct prompting strategies, ranging from implicit semantic alignment to executable grounding via pseudo-code generation, enabling explicit modeling of rule dependencies and providing an out-of-the-box framework for different business customers without finetuning their own LLMs. We benchmark ExIde using 13 state-of-the-art LLMs. Our extensive evaluation reveals that: (1) Executable grounding serves as a superior inductive bias, significantly outperforming standard prompts in rule extraction; and (2) Reasoning-optimized models demonstrate a distinct advantage in tracing long-range dependencies and non-linear rule dependencies compared to standard instruction-tuned models.
papers.abstract_zh: 从非结构化的商业文档中提取结构化程序知识是流程自动化中的一个关键但尚未解决的瓶颈问题。虽然之前的研究主要集中在从说明性文本中提取线性动作流程（例如食谱），但对于现实世界中普遍存在的复杂逻辑结构——如条件分支和并行执行——却缺乏足够的关注。此外，现有的基准测试受到简单化 schema 和浅层逻辑依赖关系的限制，这阻碍了逻辑感知大语言模型的发展。为了弥补这一“逻辑差距”，我们提出了 BREX 这个经过精心设计的基准数据集，该数据集包含 409 份真实世界的商业文档以及 2,855 条由专家标注的规则。与那些专注于特定服务场景的先前数据集不同，BREX 涵盖了 30 多个垂直领域，包括科学、工业、行政和金融领域的法规。我们还提出了 ExIde 这个结构感知推理框架，它采用了五种不同的提示策略，从隐式语义对齐到通过伪代码生成实现可执行推理，从而能够明确建模规则之间的依赖关系，并为不同的商业客户提供即用的解决方案，而无需他们自己微调大语言模型。我们使用 13 个最先进的大语言模型对 ExIde 进行了基准测试。我们的广泛评估表明：(1) 可执行推理作为一种更优的归纳偏见，在规则提取方面明显优于标准提示；(2) 经过推理优化的模型在追踪长期依赖关系和非线性规则依赖关系方面具有明显优势，相比标准指令调优模型，其表现更为出色。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Specializing Large Models for Oracle Bone Script Interpretation via Component-Grounded Multimodal Knowledge Augmentation
papers.title_zh: 通过基于组件的多模态知识增强技术，专门开发用于解读甲骨文脚本的大型模型
papers.authors: Jianing Zhang, Runan Li, Honglin Pang, Ding Xia, Zhou Zhu, Qian Zhang, Chuntao Li, Xi Yang
papers.abstract: Deciphering ancient Chinese Oracle Bone Script (OBS) is a challenging task that offers insights into the beliefs, systems, and culture of the ancient era. Existing approaches treat decipherment as a closed-set image recognition problem, which fails to bridge the “interpretation gap”: while individual characters are often unique and rare, they are composed of a limited set of recurring, pictographic components that carry transferable semantic meanings. To leverage this structural logic, we propose an agent-driven Vision-Language Model (VLM) framework that integrates a VLM for precise visual grounding with an LLM-based agent to automate a reasoning chain of component identification, graph-based knowledge retrieval, and relationship inference for linguistically accurate interpretation. To support this, we also introduce OB-Radix, an expert-annotated dataset providing structural and semantic data absent from prior corpora, comprising 1,022 character images (934 unique characters) and 1,853 fine-grained component images across 478 distinct components with verified explanations. By evaluating our system across three benchmarks of different tasks, we demonstrate that our framework yields more detailed and precise decipherments compared to baseline methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 解读古代中国甲骨文是一项具有挑战性的任务，它有助于我们了解古代时代的信仰、制度和文化。现有的方法将破译视为一种封闭的图像识别问题，但这无法解决“解释差距”的问题：虽然单个字符往往独特且罕见，但它们是由一组重复出现的象形符号构成的，这些符号承载着可转移的语义含义。为了利用这种结构逻辑，我们提出了一种以智能体为驱动的视觉语言模型框架。该框架结合了视觉语言模型的精确视觉定位功能，以及基于大语言模型的智能体，从而能够自动化地完成组件识别、基于图的知识检索以及关系推理等过程，从而实现语言上的准确解释。为了支持这一方案，我们还引入了OB-Radix数据集——这是一个由专家标注的数据集，其中包含了先前语料库中所缺失的结构和语义信息。该数据集包含1,022个字符图像（共934个独特的字符），以及1,853个细粒度的组件图像，涵盖了478种不同的组件，并附有经过验证的解释。通过对我们的系统在不同任务下的三个基准测试进行评估，我们发现，与基线方法相比，我们的框架能够提供更详细、更精确的破译结果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HyperMem: Hypergraph Memory for Long-Term Conversations
papers.title_zh: HyperMem：适用于长期对话的超图内存解决方案
papers.authors: Juwei Yue, Chuanrui Hu, Jiawei Sheng, Zuyi Zhou, Wenyuan Zhang, Tingwen Liu, Li Guo, Yafeng Deng
papers.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for conversational agents to maintain coherence, track persistent tasks, and provide personalized interactions across extended dialogues. However, existing approaches as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and graph-based memory mostly rely on pairwise relations, which can hardly capture high-order associations, i.e., joint dependencies among multiple elements, causing fragmented retrieval. To this end, we propose HyperMem, a hypergraph-based hierarchical memory architecture that explicitly models such associations using hyperedges. Particularly, HyperMem structures memory into three levels: topics, episodes, and facts, and groups related episodes and their facts via hyperedges, unifying scattered content into coherent units. Leveraging this structure, we design a hybrid lexical-semantic index and a coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy, supporting accurate and efficient retrieval of high-order associations. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show that HyperMem achieves state-of-the-art performance with 92.73% LLM-as-a-judge accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of HyperMem for long-term conversations.
papers.abstract_zh: 长期记忆对于对话式智能体来说至关重要，它有助于保持对话的连贯性、跟踪持续的任务，并在长时间的对话中提供个性化的交互体验。然而，现有的基于检索增强生成（RAG）和图状记忆的方法大多依赖于成对关系，这很难捕捉到高阶关联，即多个元素之间的联合依赖关系，从而导致检索结果的碎片化。为此，我们提出了HyperMem这一基于超图的层次化记忆架构，该架构通过超边来明确建模这种关联。具体来说，HyperMem将记忆分为三个层次：主题、事件和事实，并通过超边将相关的事件及其相关事实联系起来，从而将分散的内容整合为连贯的整体。利用这一结构，我们设计了一种混合式的词汇语义索引和从粗到细的检索策略，从而能够准确且高效地检索到高阶关联。在LoCoMo基准测试上的实验表明，HyperMem取得了最先进的性能表现，其准确率达到了92.73%，这充分证明了HyperMem在长期对话中的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LeLoRA: Learnable Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: LeLoRA：基于低秩学习的大型语言模型适配方法
papers.authors: Xiaoling Zhou, Mingjie Zhang, Zhemg Lee, Wei Ye, Shikun Zhang
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) is an effective approach to enhancing their performance on specialized downstream tasks. Among the various techniques, low-rank adaptation has garnered significant attention due to its ability to maintain the full performance of fine-tuning while enhancing computational efficiency. However, existing approaches often rely on manually specified and fixed hyperparameters to identify the trainable components within weight matrices, resulting in suboptimal performance and low parameter efficiency. This paper presents a novel Learnable Low-Rank Adaptation (LeLoRA) framework that utilizes dynamically learned fine-tuning strategies to facilitate the effective adaptation of LLMs. Our framework integrates an LLM with a policy network that automatically and adaptively generates matrix-specific adaptation strategies to identify the trainable components of each weight matrix, taking into account their unique characteristics, such as singular values and matrix norms. A reinforcement learning-based optimization algorithm is then employed to iteratively update the LLM and the policy network, ensuring that the generated strategies adapt in real time to the evolving states of the LLM. Extensive experiments have been conducted across various natural language processing and multimodal tasks. The results across ten different LLMs, ranging from 125M to 70B parameters, provide compelling evidence that LeLoRA consistently outperforms existing baselines in adapting LLMs. Moreover, analytical experiments provide valuable insights into the effectiveness of the generated strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 对大语言模型进行微调是一种有效提升其在特定下游任务性能的方法。在众多技术中，低秩适应技术因其能够在保持微调效果的同时提高计算效率而受到广泛关注。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于手动指定的固定超参数来识别权重矩阵中的可训练组件，这导致了性能不佳和参数使用效率低下的问题。本文提出了一种新颖的可学习低秩适应框架——LeLoRA，该框架利用动态学习的微调策略来实现对大语言模型的有效适应。我们的框架将大语言模型与策略网络相结合，该网络能够自动且适应性地生成针对特定矩阵的适应策略，从而识别出每个权重矩阵的可训练组件，同时考虑其独特特性，如奇异值和矩阵范数等。随后，采用基于强化学习的优化算法来迭代更新大语言模型和策略网络，确保生成的策略能够实时适应大语言模型的演变状态。我们在多种自然语言处理和多模态任务上进行了广泛的实验。来自十种不同大语言模型的结果表明，这些模型的参数数量从1.25亿到700亿不等，LeLoRA在适应大语言模型方面始终优于现有的基线方法。此外，分析性实验为生成策略的有效性提供了宝贵的见解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Gated Tree Cross-Attention for Checkpoint-Compatible Syntax Injection in Decoder-Only LLMs
papers.title_zh: 一种基于门控的树形交叉注意力机制，适用于仅包含解码器的大语言模型中兼容检查点保存的语法注入操作
papers.authors: Xinyu Gao, Shaonan Wang, Nai Ding
papers.abstract: Decoder-only large language models achieve strong broad performance but are brittle to minor grammatical perturbations, undermining reliability for downstream reasoning. However, directly injecting explicit syntactic structure into an existing checkpoint can interfere with its pretrained competence. We introduce a checkpoint-compatible gated tree cross-attention (GTCA) branch that reads precomputed constituency chunk memory while leaving backbone architecture unchanged. Our design uses a token update mask and staged training to control the scope and timing of structural updates. Across benchmarks and transformer backbones, GTCA strengthens syntactic robustness beyond continued-training baselines without compromising Multiple-Choice QA performance or commonsense reasoning, providing a practical checkpoint-compatible route to more syntax-robust decoder-only LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 仅基于解码器的大语言模型虽然性能强大，但容易受到轻微的语法错误影响，这会降低其后续推理的可靠性。然而，直接将明确的句法结构注入现有的检查点可能会干扰其预训练的能力。我们提出了一种与检查点兼容的门控树交叉注意力机制，该机制可以读取预先计算好的句法信息，同时不改变主干架构。我们的设计采用了令牌更新掩码和分阶段训练的方法，以控制结构更新的范围和时机。在多种基准测试和不同的Transformer主干架构中，GTCA都能提升句法鲁棒性，而无需牺牲多选择问答任务或常识推理的性能。这为构建更具备句法鲁棒性的仅基于解码器的大语言模型提供了实用的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DiningBench: A Hierarchical Multi-view Benchmark for Perception and Reasoning in the Dietary Domain
papers.title_zh: DiningBench：一个用于饮食领域感知与推理的层次化多视图基准测试
papers.authors: Song Jin, Juntian Zhang, Xun Zhang, Zeying Tian, Fei Jiang, Guojun Yin, Wei Lin, Yong Liu, Rui Yan
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have revolutionized general visual understanding. However, their application in the food domain remains constrained by benchmarks that rely on coarse-grained categories, single-view imagery, and inaccurate metadata. To bridge this gap, we introduce DiningBench, a hierarchical, multi-view benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs across three levels of cognitive complexity: Fine-Grained Classification, Nutrition Estimation, and Visual Question Answering. Unlike previous datasets, DiningBench comprises 3,021 distinct dishes with an average of 5.27 images per entry, incorporating fine-grained “hard” negatives from identical menus and rigorous, verification-based nutritional data. We conduct an extensive evaluation of 29 state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary models. Our experiments reveal that while current VLMs excel at general reasoning, they struggle significantly with fine-grained visual discrimination and precise nutritional reasoning. Furthermore, we systematically investigate the impact of multi-view inputs and Chain-of-Thought reasoning, identifying five primary failure modes. DiningBench serves as a challenging testbed to drive the next generation of food-centric VLM research. All codes are released in https://github.com/meituan/DiningBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在视觉语言模型方面的进展彻底改变了一般的视觉理解能力。然而，这些模型在食品领域的应用仍然受到一些限制，因为这些评估基准依赖于粗粒度的分类、单视图图像以及不准确的元数据。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了DiningBench这个分层多视图的基准测试集，旨在评估视觉语言模型在三个认知层面的表现：细粒度分类、营养估算以及视觉问答。与以往的数据集不同，DiningBench包含了3,021道不同的菜肴，每道菜肴平均有5.27张图片，其中还包含了来自相同菜单的精细级“困难”负样本，以及经过严格验证的营养数据。我们对29个最先进的开源和专有模型进行了广泛的评估。实验结果表明，虽然当前的视觉语言模型在一般推理方面表现出色，但在细粒度的视觉辨别和精确的营养估算方面却存在明显不足。此外，我们还系统地研究了多视图输入和思维链推理的影响，并发现了五种主要的失败模式。DiningBench作为一个具有挑战性的测试平台，将为下一代以食品为中心的视觉语言模型研究提供动力。所有代码均可在此链接下载：https://github.com/meituan/DiningBench
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Octopus: Gated Selective Attention for Memory-Bounded Long-Context Inference in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 章鱼：一种基于门控的选择性注意力机制，适用于大型语言模型中有限内存条件下的长上下文推理任务
papers.authors: Chien Van Nguyen, Ryan A. Rossi, Linh Ngo Van, Franck Dernoncourt, Thien Huu Nguyen
papers.abstract: Transformer inference becomes increasingly memory-bound as the Key–Value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length. While subquadratic architectures offer constant-memory inference, they rely on aggressive state compression that degrades performance on complex reasoning tasks. We propose Octopus, a framework that confers fixed-memory inference onto pretrained Transformers without the information loss of linearization. Octopus retrofits attention layers with Gated Selective Attention, a learnable module that enforces an adaptive sparsity policy over the context history. By dynamically scoring and retaining only high-utility KV states, this mechanism transforms the unbounded cache into a compact, evolving memory budget that filters out uninformative noise. Empirically, on the GSM8K benchmark, it outperforms state-of-the-art linearized baselines by over 36 points under identical memory constraints. Remarkably, Octopus also surpasses its own full-cache teacher, demonstrating that learned sparse retention serves as an effective regularizer for long-horizon reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着键值缓存的大小与序列长度呈线性增长，Transformer模型的推理能力越来越受到内存限制的影响。虽然一些亚二次架构能够实现恒定内存的推理效果，但它们依赖于激进的状态压缩策略，这会降低在复杂推理任务中的性能。我们提出了Octopus框架，它能够让预训练的Transformer模型实现固定内存消耗的推理方式，同时不会造成信息的丢失。Octopus通过引入门控选择性注意力机制来改进注意力层，这一可学习的模块能够根据上下文历史数据实施自适应稀疏策略。通过动态评分并仅保留具有高实用性的键值状态，该机制将无限大的缓存转化为一个紧凑且可扩展的内存预算，从而过滤掉无用的信息。在GSM8K基准测试上，Octopus在相同的内存限制条件下，其性能比最先进的线性化基线模型高出36分以上。值得注意的是，Octopus甚至超越了使用完整缓存的传统方法，这表明学习到的稀疏存储策略确实可以作为长视距推理的有效正则化手段。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
