papers.title: SAME: Safety-Aware Model Editing Guided by Safety Transformation
papers.title_zh: 相同：基于安全转换的安全模型编辑方法
papers.authors: Jiayi Wang, Shipeng Wang, Ji Wu, Jian Sun
papers.abstract: Editing large language models is challenging as incorporating new knowledge often requires sequential parameter updates while maintaining model capability. In this work, we experimentally observe that sequential knowledge updating under the locate-then-edit framework can introduce safety risks, regardless of whether the knowledge being edited is benign or malicious. We propose a novel model editing approach that estimates safety transforms and identifies corresponding safety direction in the neural activation space, and then aligns neural activation updates and network parameter updates under the safety constraints, resulting in a safety-aware model editing approach. We evaluate our approach on open-source LLMs, Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, using the benchmark datasets ZsRE and COUNTERFACT, as well as the malicious dataset Mal-KSet. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach effectively reduces unsafe responses to malicious queries while preserving the effectiveness of model editing.
papers.abstract_zh: 编辑大语言模型是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为引入新知识通常需要对参数进行连续更新，同时又要保持模型的性能。在这项研究中，我们通过实验观察到，在“定位后再编辑”的框架下进行知识更新可能会带来安全风险，无论被编辑的知识是良性的还是恶意的。我们提出了一种新颖的模型编辑方法：该方法通过估计安全变换，并在神经激活空间中确定相应的安全方向，然后在安全约束下对齐神经激活更新和网络参数更新，从而实现了一种注重安全的模型编辑方法。我们在开源语言模型Llama-3-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct上进行了测试，使用了ZsRE和COUNTERFACT这两个基准数据集，以及恶意数据集Mal-KSet。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够有效减少恶意查询带来的不安全响应，同时保留了模型编辑的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Where the Cat Sat: A Multilingual Framework for Spatial Language Understanding
papers.title_zh: 猫的栖息地：一个支持多语言的空间语言理解框架
papers.authors: Demian Inostroza, Ekaterina Vylomova, Charles Kemp, Mae Carroll, Wanchun Li, Meladel Mistica
papers.abstract: Spatial language understanding is fundamental to tasks from robot navigation to document analysis, yet current work exhibits biases toward English and prepositional marking. We present a multilingual framework and benchmark decomposing spatial relations into surface elements (figure, ground, predicate, markers) and semantic components (dynamicity, stasis). Evaluating frontier LLMs on Spanish, Basque, and Chinese with text-only input, we find high accuracy on figure and ground identification but persistent gaps in two areas: semantic classification of topological and projective relations, and surface identification of morphological spatial markers—Basque case affixes proving most challenging at as low as 15.3%. These results suggest that surface parsing does not entail spatial understanding, and that evaluation must include typologically diverse spatial marking strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 空间语言理解对于从机器人导航到文档分析等各种任务来说都是基础性的。然而，当前的研究存在对英语和介词标记的偏好。我们提出了一个多语言框架和基准测试，将空间关系分解为表面元素（图形、背景、谓语、标记）和语义成分（动态性、静止性）。在仅使用文本输入的情况下，我们对西班牙语、巴斯克语和中文进行了前沿大语言模型的评估。结果显示，在图形和背景识别方面取得了较高的准确率，但在两个领域仍然存在明显的不足：对拓扑关系和投影关系的语义分类，以及表面形态空间标记的识别——巴斯克语的词形变化标记在15.3%的准确率下就表现出了最大的挑战。这些结果表明，表面解析并不包含空间理解的内容，因此评估时必须考虑不同类型语言中的各种空间标记策略。

papers.title: LCMA-SRT: Language-Conditional Mixture-of-Experts Adapters for Joint Multilingual Speech Recognition and Translation
papers.title_zh: LCMA-SRT：基于语言条件混合专家模型的语音识别与翻译系统
papers.authors: Nanjie Li, Xiaoyong Guo, Hao Huang, Xu Haihua, Wei Shi
papers.abstract: Neural transducers offer an alignment-free framework for speech-to-text modeling, and hierarchical transducer architectures further improve multilingual joint automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation (ST) by stacking a translation-focused encoder on top of an ASR encoder. However, extending hierarchical transducers to multilingual many-to-many settings remains challenging: fully shared models often suffer from negative transfer and unstable target-language generation, while training separate models for each direction is computationally prohibitive. We propose LCMA-SRT (Language-Conditional Mixture-of-Experts Adapters for Speech Recognition and Translation), which augments a hierarchical transducer with language-conditional Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) adapters. A source-conditioned MoE adapter (SRC-MoE) uses source-language embeddings to reduce cross-language interference and improve multilingual ASR. A target-conditioned MoE adapter (TGT-MoE) uses the desired target language to reduce cross-target interference and stabilize target-language generation in many-to-many ST. Experiments on Europarl-ST (9 languages, 72 directions) show that LCMA-SRT improves both ASR and ST within a single joint model, reducing average WER and improving BLEU and COMET over strong hierarchical transducer baselines. We release our code and models at https://github.com/linanjie0820/LCMA-SRT.
papers.abstract_zh: 神经转换器为语音转文本建模提供了一种无需对齐的框架。而分层转换器架构则通过将以翻译为中心的编码器叠加在自动语音识别编码器之上，进一步提升了多语言联合自动语音识别（ASR）和语音翻译（ST）的性能。然而，将分层转换器扩展到多语言多对多场景仍然具有挑战性：完全共享的模型往往会出现负面干扰问题，且目标语言的生成不稳定；而为每个方向分别训练模型则会导致计算成本过高。我们提出了LCMA-SRT（语言条件混合专家适配器用于语音识别和翻译），该方案在分层转换器的基础上增加了语言条件混合专家适配器。源语言条件混合专家适配器利用源语言嵌入来减少跨语言干扰，从而提升多语言ASR性能。目标语言条件混合专家适配器则利用目标语言来减少跨目标语言干扰，并稳定目标语言的生成过程。在Europarl-ST数据集上的实验表明，LCMA-SRT能够在单一联合模型中同时提升ASR和ST的性能，其平均错误率有所降低，而BLEU和COMET指标则优于基于分层转换器的优秀基线模型。我们的代码和模型可以在https://github.com/linanjie0820/LCMA-SRT下载。

papers.title: DefGen-Bench: A Benchmark for Chinese Criminal Defence Opinion Generation in LegalAI
papers.title_zh: DefGen-Bench：一种用于生成中文刑事辩护意见的工具，适用于法律人工智能领域
papers.authors: Senbo Zhang, Qiqi Wang, Fanghao Lou, Guanyu Chen, Yihong Pan, Huijia Li, Qian Liu
papers.abstract: A defence opinion is an essential step in criminal proceedings, yet it has not been systematically formulated or evaluated as a specific LegalAI task. Grounded in legal principles and practice, we formulate this task as generating a structured defence opinion conditioned jointly on an indictment and the defendant’s stated opinion, which often present conflicting claims. We formalize this setting as a dual-perspective generation problem and introduce DefGen-Bench, a benchmark comprising several Chinese criminal cases with expert-reviewed reference defence opinions. We evaluate eight large language models (LLMs) on this task and observe that existing models tend to mirror the defendant’s opinion, thereby overlooking more appropriate defence strategies. To address this challenge, we propose Knowledge-Enhanced Highlighted Indictment (KHI), a legal knowledge–guided input enhancement method applicable to both open- and closed-source LLMs. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements across all evaluated LLMs, validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 辩护意见是刑事诉讼中的一个关键步骤，然而这一任务并未被系统地制定或作为特定的法律人工智能任务进行评估。基于法律原则与实践，我们将这一任务定义为：在起诉书以及被告提出的意见的基础上，生成一份结构化的辩护意见。这些意见往往包含相互矛盾的主张。我们将这一问题形式化为一个双视角生成问题，并引入了DefGen-Bench这一基准测试，该测试包含了多个经过专家评审的参考辩护意见。我们对八种大语言模型在这项任务上的表现进行了评估，发现现有模型倾向于复制被告的意见，从而忽略了更合适的辩护策略。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了知识增强式起诉书生成方法（KHI），这是一种以法律知识为指导的输入增强方法，适用于开源和闭源语言模型。实验表明，所有被评估的语言模型都取得了显著的改进，这验证了所提出方法的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Escaping the Echo Trap: On Credit Assignment Failure in Multi-turn LLM Self-Reflection
papers.title_zh: 逃离“回声陷阱”：关于多轮LLM自我反思中的信用分配失败问题
papers.authors: Linxuan Du, Guangquan Xue, Xiaobo Liang, Qipeng Huang, Yuyang Ding, Xinyu Shi, Zhang Yijun, Ji Qi, Wenpeng Zhu, Juntao Li, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Despite the potential of multi-turn self-reflection to improve LLM reasoning, its effectiveness in practice is severely constrained by a failure mode we term the Echo Trap.Specifically, this phenomenon gives rise to two coupled problems: (1) the model becomes limited by its inherent capabilities and tends to repeat earlier reflections to preserve reward signals; (2) once such “copy” behavior is reinforced, the model ceases to try new strategies, leading to exploration collapse.We attribute this issue to imprecise credit assignment during training, as standard GRPO assigns rewards at the trajectory level, making it difficult to distinguish which reflection steps contribute to improved outcomes.To address this limitation, we propose a tree-structured extension of GRPO for multi-turn self-reflection, which enables more accurate advantage estimation.Through extensive experiments, we analyze the Echo Trap and demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates behavior collapse and improves performance across multiple benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管多轮自我反思有可能提升大语言模型的推理能力，但其在实际应用中的效果却受到一种我们称之为“回声陷阱”的缺陷的严重限制。具体来说，这种现象会导致两个相互关联的问题：(1) 模型会受到其固有能力的限制，倾向于重复之前的反思以保留奖励信号；(2) 一旦这种“复制”行为得到强化，模型就会停止尝试新的策略，从而导致探索能力的崩溃。我们认为这个问题源于训练过程中对奖励分配的不精确性，因为标准的GRPO是在轨迹层面进行奖励分配的，这使得很难区分哪些反思步骤有助于改善性能。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种基于树结构的GRPO扩展方案，用于多轮自我反思，该方案能够更精确地评估优势因素。通过广泛的实验，我们分析了“回声陷阱”现象，并证明我们的方法能够有效缓解行为崩溃问题，同时提升多个基准测试中的性能表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ARF-RLHF: Adaptive Reward-Following for RLHF through Emotion-Driven Self-Supervision and Trace-Biased Dynamic Optimization
papers.title_zh: ARF-RLHF：通过情感驱动的自我监督以及基于轨迹的动态优化实现强化学习中的自适应奖励反馈机制
papers.authors: Yuxuan Zhang
papers.abstract: Current RLHF methods such as PPO and DPO typically reduce human preferences to binary labels, which are costly to obtain and too coarse to reflect individual variation. We observe that expressions of satisfaction and dissatisfaction follow stable linguistic patterns across users, indicating that more informative supervisory signals can be extracted from free-form feedback. Building on this insight, we introduce Adaptive Reward-Following (ARF), which converts natural feedback into continuous preference trajectories and optimizes them using the novel TraceBias algorithm. Across diverse LLMs and preference domains, ARF consistently outperforms PPO and DPO, improving alignment by up to 7.6%. Our results demonstrate that continuous reward modeling provides a scalable path toward personalized and theoretically grounded RLHF.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的强化学习优化方法，如PPO和DPO，通常将人类的偏好转化为二元标签。这种转化方式成本高昂，且过于粗糙，无法反映个体的差异。我们发现，用户的满意度和不满意度的表达遵循稳定的语言模式，这表明可以从自由形式的反馈中提取出更有信息量的监督信号。基于这一发现，我们提出了自适应奖励跟踪算法（ARF），该算法能够将自然反馈转化为连续的偏好轨迹，并通过创新的TraceBias算法对其进行优化。在多种大语言模型和偏好领域测试中，ARF始终优于PPO和DPO，其对齐效果提升了高达7.6%。我们的结果表明，连续奖励建模为实现个性化且理论基础的强化学习优化提供了可扩展的路径。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SMART: Evaluating LLMs’ Mathematical Reasoning via a Human Cognitive Process-Inspired Benchmark
papers.title_zh: SMART：通过受人类认知过程启发的评估基准来评价大型语言模型的数学推理能力
papers.authors: Yujie Hou, Mei Wang, Yaoyao Zhong, Ting Zhang, Xuetao Ma, Hua Huang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of mathematical benchmarks. However, concerns remain as to whether these successes reflect genuine reasoning or superficial pattern recognition. Existing evaluation methods, which typically focus either on the final answer or on the intermediate reasoning steps, reduce mathematical reasoning to a shallow input–output mapping, overlooking its inherently multi-stage and multi-dimensional cognitive nature. Inspired by P’olya’s problem-solving theory, we propose SMART, a benchmark that decomposes mathematical problem-solving into four cognitive dimensions: Semantic Understanding, Mathematical Reasoning, Arithmetic Computation, and Reflection RefinemenT, and introduces dimension-specific tasks to measure the corresponding cognitive processes of LLMs. We apply SMART to 22 state-of-the-art open- and closed-source LLMs and uncover substantial discrepancies in their capabilities across dimensions. Our findings reveal genuine weaknesses in current models and motivate a new metric, the All-Pass Score, designed to better capture true problem-solving capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在众多数学基准测试中取得了显著的性能表现。然而，人们仍然对这些成就究竟是反映了真正的推理能力，还是仅仅表面的模式识别表示存疑。现有的评估方法通常只关注最终答案或中间的推理步骤，这会将数学推理简化为浅层的输入-输出映射，而忽略了数学推理本质上是多阶段、多维的认知过程。受P’olya的解决问题理论启发，我们提出了SMART这一评估框架，它将数学问题解决分解为四个认知维度：语义理解、数学推理、算术计算以及反思优化。我们采用SMART框架对22种先进的开源和闭源语言模型进行了评估，发现它们在各个维度上的能力存在显著差异。我们的研究结果揭示了当前模型的真实弱点，并促使我们提出了一种新的评估指标——全通过分数，该指标旨在更准确地反映模型的实际问题解决能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Decentralized Arena: Towards Democratic and Scalable Automatic Evaluation of Language Models
papers.title_zh: 去中心化竞技场：迈向对语言模型进行民主化和可扩展的自动评估之路
papers.authors: Yanbin Yin, Kun Zhou, Zhen Wang, Xiangdong Zhang, Yifei Shao, Shibo Hao, Yi Gu, Jieyuan Liu, Somanshu Singla, Tianyang Liu, Eric P. Xing, Zhengzhong Liu, Haojian Jin, Zhiting Hu
papers.abstract: The recent explosion of large language models (LLMs), each with its own general or specialized strengths, makes scalable, reliable benchmarking more urgent than ever. Standard practices nowadays face fundamental trade-offs: closed-ended question-based benchmarks (MMLU) struggle with saturation as newer models emerge, while crowd-sourced leaderboards (Chatbot Arena) rely on costly and slow human judges. Recently, automated methods (LLM-as-a-judge) shed light on the scalability, but risk bias by relying on one or a few “authority” models. To tackle these issues, we propose Decentralized Arena (), a fully automated framework leveraging collective intelligence from all LLMs to evaluate each other. It mitigates single-model judge bias by democratic, pairwise evaluation, and remains efficient at scale through two key components: (1) a coarse-to-fine ranking algorithm for fast incremental insertion of new models with sub-quadratic complexity, and (2) an automatic question selection strategy for the construction of new evaluation dimensions. Across extensive experiments across 66 LLMs, attains up to 97% correlation with human judgements, while significantly reducing the cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近大语言模型（LLM）的爆发式增长，每个模型都拥有自己独特的优势或专长，这使得可扩展且可靠的基准测试变得比以往任何时候都更加重要。目前的标准做法面临着一些根本性的权衡：基于封闭式问题的基准测试（如MMLU）在出现新模型时难以应对饱和问题，而众包排行榜（如Chatbot Arena）则依赖于昂贵且效率低下的人工评审。最近，自动化方法（如将LLM作为评审工具）为可扩展性提供了解决方案，但这种方法存在依赖单一或少数“权威”模型的风险，从而导致偏见。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了去中心化竞技场（Decentralized Arena），这是一个完全自动化的框架，能够利用所有LLM的集体智慧来相互评估。该框架通过民主式的成对评估来减轻单一模型评审带来的偏见，同时通过两个关键组件实现大规模应用的效率提升：（1）一种从粗略到精细的排名算法，能够快速地将新模型加入评估体系，其复杂度低于二次方；（2）一种自动的问题选择策略，用于构建新的评估维度。在涉及66个LLM的广泛实验中，该框架与人工评判的结果相关性高达97%，同时显著降低了成本。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LBLLM: Lightweight Binarization of Large Language Models via Three-Stage Distillation
papers.title_zh: LBLLM：通过三阶段蒸馏实现大型语言模型의轻量级二值化处理
papers.authors: Siqing Song, Chuang Wang, Yong Lang, Yi Yang, Xu-Yao Zhang
papers.abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in resource-constrained environments is hindered by heavy computational and memory requirements. We present LBLLM, a lightweight binarization framework that achieves effective W(1+1)A4 quantization through a novel three-stage quantization strategy. The framework proceeds as follows: (1) initialize a high-quality quantized model via PTQ; (2) quantize binarized weights, group-wise bitmaps, and quantization parameters through layer-wise distillation while keeping activations in full precision; and (3) training learnable activation quantization factors to dynamically quantize activations to 4 bits. This decoupled design mitigates interference between weight and activation quantization, yielding greater training stability and better inference accuracy. LBLLM, trained only using 0.016B tokens with a single GPU, surpasses existing state-of-the-art binarization methods on W2A4 quantization settings across tasks of language modeling, commonsense QA, and language understanding. These results demonstrate that extreme low-bit quantization of LLMs can be both practical and highly effective without introducing any extra high-precision channels or rotational matrices commonly used in recent PTQ-based works, offering a promising path toward efficient LLM deployment in resource-limited situations.
papers.abstract_zh: 在资源有限的环境中部署大语言模型（LLMs）面临着巨大的计算和内存需求。我们提出了LBLLM这一轻量级二值化框架，它通过一种新颖的三阶段量化策略实现了高效的W(1+1)A4量化。该框架的具体步骤如下：(1)通过PTQ技术初始化一个高质量的量化模型；(2)通过逐层蒸馏技术对二值化权重、分组位图以及量化参数进行量化处理，同时保留激活值的完整精度；(3)训练可学习的激活量化因子，以将激活值动态量化到4位。这种分离的设计避免了权重量化和激活量化的相互干扰，从而提高了训练的稳定性和推理的准确性。仅使用0.016B个令牌且只使用单个GPU进行训练的LBLLM，在W2A4量化设置下，在语言建模、常识问答和语言理解等任务中均超越了现有的最先进二值化方法。这些结果表明，对LLMs进行极低比特量的量化既具有实用性，又非常有效，而且不会引入通常在基于PTQ的模型中使用的额外高精度通道或旋转矩阵，为在资源有限的情况下高效部署LLMs提供了有希望的路径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SeDev: Structured Semantic Exploration for LLM-Driven Code Generation
papers.title_zh: SeDev：面向大语言模型驱动代码生成的结构化语义探索方法
papers.authors: Ronghui Yang, Jie Liu, Jiajie Zeng, Jiexin Wang, Jiuchuan Jiang, Bo An, Yi Cai, Mengchen Zhao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in automating code generation. Recent approaches that incorporate feedback refinement mechanisms into the generation process have further enhanced software generation quality. However, these methods can be characterized as single-path approaches, which suffer from insufficient exploration of the vast solution space, often causing even the most powerful models to get stuck in local optima and struggle to generate the desired software. Some other works use Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explore multiple paths for finding the best solution; yet, MCTS can be extremely inefficient in practice. To this end, we propose SeDev, a novel LLM-driven code generation framework that efficiently finds high-quality solutions in only a few iterations. The core idea of SeDev is to gradually explore semantically adjacent solutions through structured prompt guidance and feedback on previous trials, while using unit tests to evaluate the quality of exploration. To distill the exploration experience, SeDev incorporates a feedback synthesis module that translates unit test results within exploration into comprehensive suggestions. We construct a challenging feature oriented software benchmark FSD-bench++, along with two open datasets to evaluate. Experimental results show that SeDev outperforms baselines while maintaining reasonable time and computational costs. Code is available here.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自动化代码生成方面展现出了卓越的能力。最近的一些方法通过在生成过程中加入反馈优化机制，进一步提升了软件生成的品质。然而，这些方法属于单路径方法，由于对广阔解决方案空间的探索不足，即使是最强大的模型也常常陷入局部最优解，难以生成所需的软件。另一些研究则采用蒙特卡洛树搜索方法来探索多种解决方案以找到最佳方案；不过，蒙特卡洛树搜索在实际应用中的效率往往非常低。为此，我们提出了SeDev这一新型的语言模型驱动代码生成框架，该框架能够在几次迭代中高效地找到高质量的解决方案。SeDev的核心思想是通过结构化的提示指导和对先前尝试的反馈，逐步探索语义上相近的解决方案，同时利用单元测试来评估探索的质量。为了提炼探索经验，SeDev还包含一个反馈合成模块，能够将探索过程中的单元测试结果转化为全面的建议。我们构建了一个具有挑战性的面向特征的软件基准测试FSD-bench++，并提供了两个开放数据集用于评估。实验结果表明，SeDev在保持合理的时间和计算成本的同时，其性能优于传统方法。相关代码可在此处获取。

papers.title: EVM-QuestBench: An Execution-Grounded Benchmark for Natural-Language Transaction Code Generation
papers.title_zh: EVM-QuestBench：一种基于执行的自然语言事务代码生成基准测试
papers.authors: Pei Yang, Wanyi Chen, Ke Wang, Lynn Ai, Eric Yang, Tianyu Shi
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly applied to various development scenarios. However, in on-chain transaction scenarios, even a minor error can cause irreversible loss for users. Existing evaluations often overlook execution accuracy and safety. We introduce EVM-QuestBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for natural-language transaction-script generation on EVM-compatible chains. The benchmark employs dynamic evaluation: instructions are sampled from template pools, numeric parameters are drawn from predefined intervals, and validators verify outcomes against these instantiated values. EVM-QuestBench contains 107 tasks (62 atomic, 45 composite). Its modular architecture enables rapid task development. The runner executes scripts on a forked EVM chain with snapshot isolation; composite tasks apply step-efficiency decay. We evaluate 20 models with 5 independent rounds each and find large performance gaps, with split scores revealing persistent asymmetry between single-action precision and multi-step workflow completion. Code: https://github.com/OpenEdgeHQ/EVM-quest-bench.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型被越来越多地应用于各种开发场景。然而，在链上交易场景中，即使是微小的错误也可能导致用户遭受不可挽回的损失。现有的评估方法往往忽略了执行准确性和安全性方面的问题。我们提出了EVM-QuestBench这一基于执行的自然语言交易脚本生成基准测试，该测试适用于支持EVM的区块链平台。该基准测试采用动态评估方式：指令从模板库中抽取，数值参数则从预定义的区间中选取，验证者则根据这些选定的值来检验最终的结果。EVM-QuestBench包含107个任务（其中62个是原子任务，45个是复合任务）。其模块化架构使得任务的开发能够非常快速进行。该测试在带有快照隔离功能的分叉EVM链上执行脚本；复合任务还会应用步骤效率衰减机制。我们对20个模型进行了评估，每个模型进行了5轮独立测试，结果发现各模型的性能存在较大差距。分数分布也显示出单步操作的准确性与多步工作流程的完成度之间存在持续的不对称性。代码链接：https://github.com/OpenEdgeHQ/EVM-quest-bench

papers.title: TIGER: Text-Informed Generalized Enzyme-Reaction Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 老虎：基于文本信息的广义酶反应检索方法
papers.authors: Yuhang Zhang, Keyan Ding, Peilin Chen, Han Liu, Can Lin, Ruixi Chen, Shiqi Wang, Qi Song
papers.abstract: Enzyme–reaction retrieval is a fundamental problem in computational biology, underpinning enzyme characterization, reaction mechanism elucidation, and the rational design of metabolic pathways and biocatalysts. As a bidirectional task, it entails both enzyme-to-reaction and reaction-to-enzyme mapping. However, existing approaches suffer from poor generalization across tasks and distributions, with performance highly sensitive to dataset splits and substantial asymmetry between retrieval directions. To address these challenges, we present TIGER, a Text-Informed Generalized Enzyme-Reaction Retrieval framework that leverages protein-to-text generation models to distill textual semantic knowledge from enzyme sequences, providing a generalized representation that bridges enzymes and biochemical reactions. To ensure the quality and reliability of textual semantics, we design a Dynamic Gating Network that adaptively fuses text-derived knowledge with sequence features, enabling more consistent and informative enzyme representations, while a Structure-Shared Feature Projector aligns enzyme and reaction representations within a unified latent space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, under bidirectional retrieval supervision, TIGER significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse distributions and exhibits strong robustness and transferability across tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 酶反应检索是计算生物学中的一个基本问题，它对于酶的表征、反应机制的阐明以及代谢途径和生物催化剂的理性设计都具有重要意义。作为一种双向任务，它涉及到从酶到反应的检索，以及从反应到酶的映射。然而，现有的方法在跨任务和分布的泛化能力方面存在不足，其性能对数据集划分非常敏感，且检索方向之间存在显著的不对称性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了TIGER框架——一个基于文本信息的广义酶反应检索系统。该框架利用蛋白质到文本的生成模型，从酶序列中提取文本语义信息，从而提供一种能够连接酶和生化反应的通用表示方式。为了确保文本语义的质量和可靠性，我们设计了一个动态门控网络，它能够自适应地融合文本衍生知识与序列特征，从而得出更加一致且富有信息量的酶表示。同时，结构共享特征投影器则能够将酶和反应的表示统一到一个统一的潜在空间中。大量的实验表明，在双向检索的监督下，TIGER在多种分布条件下均表现出显著的性能优势，并且在不同任务之间也展现了强大的鲁棒性和可迁移性。

papers.title: MUSEG: Reinforcing Video Temporal Understanding via Timestamp-Aware Multi-Segment Grounding
papers.title_zh: MUSEG：通过基于时间戳的多段式定位技术提升视频时间感知能力
papers.authors: Fuwen Luo, Shengfeng Lou, Chi Chen, Ziyue Wang, Chenliang Li, Weizhou Shen, Jiyue Guo, Peng Li, Ming Yan, Ji Zhang, Fei Huang, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Video temporal understanding is crucial for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to reason over events in videos. Despite recent advances in general video understanding, current MLLMs still struggle with fine-grained temporal reasoning. While reinforcement learning (RL) has been explored to address this issue recently, existing RL approaches remain limited in performance on time-sensitive tasks. In this work, we propose MUSEG, a novel RL-based method that enhances temporal understanding by introducing timestamp-aware multi-segment grounding. MUSEG enables MLLMs to align queries with multiple relevant video segments, promoting more comprehensive temporal reasoning. To facilitate effective learning, we design a customized RL training recipe with phased rewards that progressively guides the model toward temporally grounded reasoning. Extensive experiments on temporal grounding and time-sensitive video question answering (QA) tasks demonstrate that MUSEG significantly outperforms existing methods and generalizes well across diverse temporal understanding scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频时间理解对于多模态大语言模型在视频中推理事件至关重要。尽管在一般视频理解方面取得了一些进展，但当前的多模态大语言模型在精细的时间推理方面仍然存在困难。虽然最近有人尝试使用强化学习来解决这个问题，但现有的强化学习方法在时间敏感任务上的表现仍然有限。在这项研究中，我们提出了MUSEG这一基于强化学习的创新方法。该方法通过引入时间戳感知的多段定位技术，提升了多模态大语言模型的时间理解能力。MUSEG使得多模态大语言模型能够将对查询与多个相关的视频片段进行对齐，从而实现更全面的时间推理。为了促进有效的学习过程，我们设计了一种定制的强化学习训练方案，该方案采用分阶段奖励机制，逐步引导模型实现时间上准确的推理。在时间定位和时间敏感视频问答任务上的大量实验表明，MUSEG显著优于现有方法，并且在不同的时间理解场景中都能表现出良好的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: User Perceptions vs. Proxy LLM Judges: Privacy and Helpfulness in LLM Responses to Privacy-Sensitive Scenarios
papers.title_zh: 用户感知与代理语言模型评判：在涉及隐私敏感场景时，语言模型提供的回答在隐私保护方面的情况如何，以及它们的实用性如何？
papers.authors: Xiaoyuan Wu, Roshni Kaushik, Wenkai Li, Lujo Bauer, Koichi Onoue
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly being adopted for tasks like draftingemails, summarizing meetings, and answering health questions. In thesesettings, users may need to share private information (e.g., contactdetails, health records). To evaluate LLMs’ ability to identify and redactsuch information, prior work introduced real-life, scenario-based benchmarks(e.g., ConfAIde, PrivacyLens) and found that LLMs can leak privateinformation in complex scenarios. However, these evaluations relied on proxy LLMs to judge the helpfulnessand privacy-preservation quality of LLM responses, rather than directlymeasuring users’ perceptions. To understand how users perceive the helpfulness and privacy-preservationquality of LLM responses to privacy-sensitive scenarios, we conducted auser study (n=94) using 90 PrivacyLens scenarios. We found that users hadlow agreement with each other when evaluating identical LLM responses. Incontrast, five proxy LLMs reached high agreement, yet each proxy LLM hadlow correlation with users’ evaluations. These results indicate that proxy LLMs cannot accurately estimate users’ wide range of perceptions of utility and privacy inprivacy-sensitive scenarios. We discuss the need for more user-centeredstudies to measure LLMs’ ability to help users while preserving privacy,and for improving alignment between LLMs and users in estimating perceivedprivacy and utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正在被迅速应用于诸如撰写电子邮件、总结会议内容以及回答健康问题等任务中。在这些场景中，用户可能需要分享私人信息（例如联系详情、健康记录）。为了评估大语言模型识别并屏蔽此类信息的能力，之前的研究引入了基于真实场景的基准测试（例如ConfAIde、PrivacyLens），并发现大语言模型在复杂场景下仍有可能泄露私人信息。然而，这些评估都是依靠代理模型来评判大语言模型的响应在实用性和隐私保护方面的表现，而不是直接测量用户的感知。为了了解用户在面对涉及隐私的场景时，对大语言模型响应的实用性和隐私保护能力的看法，我们进行了一项用户研究，共涉及94名参与者，他们使用了90个PrivacyLens场景作为测试对象。研究发现，当评估相同的语言模型响应时，不同用户的评价存在较低的一致性。相比之下，五个代理模型则达到了高度一致，但每个代理模型与用户的评价之间的相关性都很低。这些结果表明，代理模型无法准确反映用户在涉及隐私的场景中对实用性和隐私保护的多样化看法。因此，我们需要更多以用户为中心的研究，来衡量大语言模型在帮助用户的同时如何保护隐私，并改善大语言模型与用户之间在评估隐私和实用性方面的协同性。

papers.title: HARPO: Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for User-Aligned Conversational Recommendation
papers.title_zh: HARPO：用于用户导向式对话推荐的层次化智能推理系统
papers.authors: Subham Raj, Aman Vaibhav Jha, Mayank Anand, Sriparna Saha
papers.abstract: Conversational recommender systems (CRSs) operate under incremental preference revelation, requiring recommendation decisions under uncertainty. While recent LLM-based approaches achieve strong performance on proxy metrics such as Recall@K and BLEU, they often fail to deliver high-quality, user-aligned recommendations in practice, as they optimize intermediate objectives like retrieval accuracy or fluent generation rather than recommendation quality itself. We propose HARPO (Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning with Preference Optimization), an agentic framework that reframes conversational recommendation as a structured decision-making process optimized for multi-dimensional recommendation quality. HARPO integrates (i) hierarchical preference learning that decomposes recommendation quality into interpretable dimensions (relevance, diversity, satisfaction, and engagement) with context-dependent weighting; (ii) deliberative tree-search reasoning guided by a learned value network evaluating candidate paths on predicted quality; and (iii) domain-agnostic reasoning abstractions through Virtual Tool Operations and multi-agent refinement. We evaluate HARPO on ReDial, INSPIRED, and MUSE, demonstrating consistent improvements over strong baselines on recommendation-centric metrics while maintaining competitive response quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 对话式推荐系统在偏好信息逐步揭示的情况下运行，需要在不确定的情况下做出推荐决策。虽然基于大语言模型的方法在Recall@K和BLEU等代理指标上表现优异，但在实际应用中往往无法提供高质量、符合用户需求的推荐结果，因为它们优化的目标通常是检索准确性或生成流畅性，而非推荐质量本身。我们提出了HARPO（分层代理推理与偏好优化），这是一种将对话式推荐重新定义为结构化决策过程的代理框架，旨在优化多维度的推荐质量。HARPO结合了以下三个要素：(1)分层偏好学习，将推荐质量分解为可解释的维度，如相关性、多样性、满意度和参与度，并赋予这些维度与上下文相关的权重；(2)由学习到的价值网络引导的审议性树搜索推理，该网络根据预测的质量来评估候选路径；(3)通过虚拟工具操作和多智能体细化实现的领域无关性推理抽象。我们在ReDial、INSPIRED和MUSE任务中评估了HARPO的表现，结果显示其在以推荐为中心的指标上取得了持续的改进，同时保持了具有竞争力的响应质量。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ShopSimulator: Evaluating and Exploring RL-Driven LLM Agent for Shopping Assistants
papers.title_zh: ShopSimulator：评估与探索基于强化学习的LLM智能购物助手
papers.authors: Pei Wang, Yanan Wu, Xiaoshuai Song, Weixun Wang, Gengru Chen, Zhongwen Li, Kezhong Yan, Qi Liu, Ken Deng, Shuaibing Zhao, Shaopan Xiong, Xuepeng Liu, Xuefeng Chen, Wanxi Deng, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly deployed in e-commerce shopping. To perform thorough, user-tailored product searches, agents should interpret personal preferences, engage in multi-turn dialogues, and ultimately retrieve and discriminate among highly similar products. However, existing research has yet to provide a unified simulation environment that consistently captures all of these aspects, and always focuses solely on evaluation benchmarks without training support. In this paper, we introduce ShopSimulator, a large-scale and challenging Chinese shopping environment. Leveraging ShopSimulator, we evaluate LLMs across diverse scenarios, finding that even the best-performing models achieve less than 40% full-success rate. Error analysis reveals that agents struggle with deep search and product selection in long trajectories, fail to balance the use of personalization cues, and to effectively engage with users. Further training exploration provides practical guidance for overcoming these weaknesses, with the combination of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) yielding significant performance improvements.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体在电子商务购物领域得到了广泛应用。为了进行全面、个性化的产品搜索，这些智能体需要理解用户的偏好，进行多轮对话，并最终从大量相似产品中筛选出最优选项。然而，现有的研究尚未能够提供一个统一的模拟环境来涵盖所有这些方面，而且这些研究往往只关注评估基准，而缺乏训练支持。在本文中，我们介绍了ShopSimulator——一个规模庞大且具有挑战性的中文购物环境。通过利用ShopSimulator，我们对各种场景下的大语言模型进行了评估，发现即使是最优秀的模型，其全成功率也低于40%。错误分析表明，这些智能体在处理长周期内的深度搜索和产品选择时存在困难，无法平衡个性化提示的使用，也无法有效与用户互动。进一步的训练探索为克服这些弱点提供了实用指导，通过将监督式微调与强化学习相结合，可以显著提升性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: NL \Rightarrow Schedule: Evaluate Multitask Scheduling Capability of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: NL \Rightarrow 调度：评估大型语言模型的多任务调度能力
papers.authors: Wenrui Liao, Weihong Du, Yi Li, Hongru Liang, Wenqiang Lei
papers.abstract: Automated schedule generation for multitask from natural language descriptions has huge potential in modern industry. While classic methods bypass language complexities by using pre-formatted matrices, and recent LLM+solver approaches introduce new fragilities by relying on solver-specific code generation. This raises critical questions: Can large language models (LLMs) solve this NL \Rightarrow Schedule task end-to-end well(RQ1)? If the answer is “no”, where do they fall short(RQ2)? And how can their capabilities be enhanced (RQ3)? To answer these questions, we introduce NL \Rightarrow Schedule, the first benchmark for this task, equipped with a dataset of 240 description-schedule pairs constructed from real-world materials and a rigorous evaluation suite. Our evaluation of nine state-of-the-art LLMs reveals the limitations of different LLMs in procedure grounding and the strengths of advanced LLMs in global planning via local analysis. To address these shortcomings, we propose Mans, a novel multi-agent framework. Extensive experiments show that Mans achieves more robust performance comparable to six state-of-the-art LLM+solver methods. We hope NL \Rightarrow Schedule and Mans will serve as a solid foundation for automatic scheduling.
papers.abstract_zh: 从自然语言描述中自动生成多任务调度方案在现代工业中具有巨大潜力。虽然传统方法通过使用预格式化的矩阵来绕过语言的复杂性，但最近的基于大语言模型的方法则因为依赖特定于求解器的代码生成而引入了新的缺陷。这引发了几个关键问题：大语言模型能否很好地完成从自然语言到调度方案的端到端任务（问题1）？如果答案是否定的，那么它们究竟在哪些方面存在不足（问题2）？又该如何提升它们的能力（问题3）？为了回答这些问题，我们提出了NL→Schedule这一首个针对该任务的基准测试。该基准测试拥有由真实世界材料构建的240对描述-调度方案的数据集，并配备了严格的评估体系。我们对九种最先进的大语言模型进行了评估，发现不同大语言模型在程序基础处理方面存在局限性，而先进的大语言模型则通过局部分析在全局规划方面表现出优势。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了Mans这一新颖的多智能体框架。大量实验表明，Mans取得了比六种最先进的大语言模型+求解器方法更为稳健的性能。我们希望NL→Schedule和Mans能够为自动调度提供坚实的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SLICEFORMER: Static Program Slicing Using Language Models With Dataflow-Aware Pretraining and Constrained Decoding
papers.title_zh: SLICEFORMER：利用语言模型进行静态程序切片处理，同时采用数据流感知的预训练技术以及约束性解码方法
papers.authors: Pengfei He, Shaowei Wang, Tse-Hsun Chen, Muhammad Asaduzzaman
papers.abstract: Static program slicing is a fundamental software engineering technique for isolating code relevant to specific variables. While recent learning-based approaches using language models (LMs) show promise in automating slice prediction, they suffer from inaccurate dependency modeling and unconstrained generation, where LMs fail to capture precise data flow relations and produce slices containing hallucinated tokens and statements. To address these challenges, we propose SliceFormer, a novel approach that reformulates static program slicing as a sequence-to-sequence task using small language models such as CodeT5+. introduces two key innovations that directly target the identified limitations. First, to improve dependency modeling, we design dataflow-aware pretraining objectives that leverage data flow graphs DFG to teach models data dependencies through dataflow-preserving statement permutation and dataflow-aware span corruption. Second, to eliminate hallucination, we develop a constrained decoding mechanism that enforces both lexical and syntactic constraints. We evaluate SliceFormer on Java and Python program slicing benchmarks, demonstrating consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines with up to 22% gain in ExactMatch.
papers.abstract_zh: 静态程序切片是一种基本的软件工程技术，用于隔离与特定变量相关的代码。虽然最近基于学习的方法利用语言模型在自动化切片预测方面显示出潜力，但它们存在依赖关系建模不准确以及生成过程不受约束的问题，导致语言模型无法准确捕捉数据流的关联关系，进而产生包含虚假标记和语句的切片。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SliceFormer这一创新方法。该方法将静态程序切片重新定义为一种序列到序列的任务，并使用小型语言模型如CodeT5+来完成这一任务。我们提出了两项关键创新措施来直接解决上述问题。首先，为了改进依赖关系建模，我们设计了基于数据流感知的预训练目标，利用数据流图DFG来通过保持数据流结构的语句排列和数据流感知的跨度破坏来教授模型数据依赖性。其次，为了消除虚假标记，我们开发了一种受限解码机制，该机制能够强制执行词汇和句法约束。我们在Java和Python程序切片基准测试中对SliceFormer进行了评估，结果显示其在精确匹配率方面比现有最先进基线方法提高了22%。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: SCOPE: Boosting LLM Efficiency with Scoped Position Encoding
papers.title_zh: 范围：通过有界位置编码提升大语言模型的效率
papers.authors: Qingguo Qi, Hongyang Chen, Zhao Li
papers.abstract: Positional encodings are fundamental to Transformers, yet explicit methods like RoPE can degrade under length extrapolation and may incur extra arithmetic and memory-access overhead. In this paper, we propose Scoped Position Encoding (ScoPE), a novel framework that reimagines structured sparsity as an intrinsic position encoding mechanism. Instead of relying on explicit arithmetic signals, ScoPE assigns exponentially scaled look-back scopes to attention heads. We theoretically demonstrate that this simple topological constraint transforms multi-head attention into a hierarchical processor, yielding an order awareness horizon that grows exponentially with depth up to the sequence length. Consequently, ScoPE is parameter-free and avoids relying on fragile positional arithmetic. Empirically, it significantly enhances efficiency by masking the majority of attention computations, offering a theoretical 8x reduction in attention FLOPs at long contexts. Extensive evaluations on LLaMA-3-8B architectures reveal that ScoPE achieves superior native length extrapolation and robust retrieval fidelity compared to RoPE, all while substantially reducing training and inference latency. The code is available at https://github.com/oncemoe/ScoPE.
papers.abstract_zh: 位置编码是Transformer模型中的基础机制，然而像RoPE这样的显式方法在长度扩展时可能会出现性能下降问题，并且还会增加额外的计算量和内存访问开销。在本文中，我们提出了Scoped Position Encoding（ScoPE）这一创新框架。该框架将结构化稀疏性重新定义为一种内在的位置编码机制。与依赖显式算术信号不同，ScoPE为注意力头分配了指数级缩放的回看范围。我们从理论上证明了这种简单的拓扑约束可以将多注意力机制转化为一个分层处理器，从而实现了随着序列长度的增加而呈指数级增长的顺序感知能力。因此，ScoPE无需进行参数调整，避免了依赖脆弱的位置算术编码方式。实验结果表明，通过掩盖大部分注意力计算任务，ScoPE显著提升了效率，在长上下文情况下，理论上的注意力计算量减少了8倍。在LaMA-3-8B架构上的广泛测试表明，与RoPE相比，ScoPE在原生长度扩展能力和检索精度方面表现更优，同时大幅降低了训练和推理的延迟。相关代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/oncemoe/ScoPE

papers.title: Debate-of-Thoughts: Resolving Knowledge Conflicts in LLMs Through Internal Deliberation
papers.title_zh: 思想辩论：通过内部审议来解决大型语言模型中的知识冲突
papers.authors: Guocong Li, Qirui Hu, Ping Wang, Guofeng Zhang, Jian Wu, Hongxia Xu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models enhanced with Retrieval Augmented Generation show strong potential in knowledge intensive tasks. However, they often encounter knowledge conflicts, where retrieved information contradicts the model’s internal knowledge or exhibits internal inconsistencies. Existing methods treat this as a simplistic binary choice, forcing models to blindly trust external contexts or rigidly rely on memory, resulting in unreliable predictions that swing between sycophancy and stubbornness. We argue that a more principled approach is to embrace contradictions as opportunities for deeper reasoning. To this end, we introduce Debate-of-Thoughts (DoT), a framework that transforms conflict resolution into an active deliberation process. DoT guides a single model through three phases: 1) hypothesis generation, which forms competing perspectives; 2) internal debate, where the model acts as both a proponent and a critic to stress test each view; and 3) adjudication, where a judge module evaluates arguments based on evidence and logical consistency. We implement DoT via two complementary strategies: inference time prompt chaining and supervised fine tuning. Experiments across multiple conflict benchmarks show that DoT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, while generating transparent debate transcripts that explain its decisions. By improving both accuracy and interpretability under knowledge conflicts, DoT establishes a more reliable paradigm for retrieval augmented generation systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 经过改进的检索增强生成大语言模型在需要深度知识处理的任务中展现出巨大潜力。然而，这些模型常常面临知识冲突的问题，即检索到的信息与模型内部知识相矛盾，或者存在内在的不一致性。现有的方法将这种问题简单地视为二元选择问题，迫使模型盲目依赖外部上下文或严格依赖记忆，从而导致不可靠的预测结果，这些预测要么过于迎合他人，要么显得固执己见。我们认为，更合理的做法是将矛盾视为进行更深入推理的机会。为此，我们提出了“思想辩论”框架，该框架将冲突解决过程转化为一个积极的讨论过程。该框架引导单个模型经历三个阶段：1）假设生成，形成不同的观点；2）内部辩论，模型同时扮演支持者和批评者的角色，以测试每个观点的有效性；3）裁决阶段，由评估模块根据证据和逻辑一致性来评价各种论点。我们通过两种互补的策略来实现“思想辩论”框架：推理时提示链连接和有监督的微调。在多个冲突基准测试中的实验表明，“思想辩论”框架始终优于现有最先进的方法，同时还能生成透明的辩论记录，从而解释其决策依据。通过在知识冲突情况下提高准确性和可解释性，“思想辩论”框架为检索增强生成系统建立了一个更可靠的范式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Projecting Out the Malice: A Global Subspace Approach to LLM Detoxification
papers.title_zh: 投射出恶意：一种用于缓解大型语言模型负面影响的全球性方法
papers.authors: Zenghao Duan, Zhiyi Yin, Zhichao Shi, Liang Pang, Shaoling Jing, Zihe Huang, Jiayi Wu, Yu Yan, Jingcheng Deng, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit exceptional performance but pose inherent risks of generating toxic content, restricting their safe deployment. While traditional methods (e.g., alignment) adjust output preferences, they fail to eliminate underlying toxic regions in parameters, leaving models vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Prior mechanistic studies characterize toxic regions as “toxic vectors” or “layer-wise subspaces”, yet our analysis identifies critical limitations: i) Removed toxic vectors can be reconstructed via linear combinations of non-toxic vectors, demanding targeting of entire toxic subspace; ii) Contrastive objective over limited samples inject noise into layer-wise subspaces, hindering stable extraction. These highlight the challenge of identifying robust toxic subspace and removing them. Therefore, we propose GLOSS (GLobal tOxic Subspace Suppression), a lightweight method that mitigates toxicity by identifying and eliminating this global subspace from FFN parameters. Experiments on LLMs (e.g., Qwen3) show GLOSS achieves SOTA detoxification while preserving general capabilities without requiring large-scale retraining.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型虽然表现出卓越的性能，但存在生成有害内容的风险，这限制了它们的安全使用。传统的处理方法（例如对齐算法）只能调整输出偏好，却无法消除参数中的有害区域，从而使模型容易受到对抗性攻击的影响。以往的研究将有害区域描述为“有害向量”或“分层子空间”，但我们的分析指出以下几个关键问题：i) 通过非有害向量的线性组合可以重新构建被移除的有害向量，这意味着需要直接针对整个有害子空间进行处理；ii) 在有限样本上的对比目标处理会向分层子空间引入噪声，从而阻碍有害区域的稳定提取。这些问题凸显了识别并去除有害子空间的挑战性。因此，我们提出了GLOSS方法——一种轻量级技术，它通过识别和消除FFN参数中的全局有害子空间来减轻有害内容的影响。在LLM模型上的实验表明，GLOSS能够在保留模型基本功能的同时实现最佳的去害效果，且无需进行大规模的重新训练。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Local to Global: Revisiting Structured Pruning Paradigms for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从局部到全局：重新审视适用于大型语言模型的结构化剪枝方法
papers.authors: Ziyan Wang, Enmao Diao, Qi Le, Pu Wang, Minwoo Lee, Shu-ping Yeh, Evgeny Stupachenko, Hao Feng, Li Yang
papers.abstract: Structured pruning is a practical approach to deploying large language models (LLMs) efficiently, as it yields compact, hardware-friendly architectures. However, the dominant local paradigm is task-agnostic: by optimizing layer-wise reconstruction rather than task objectives, it tends to preserve perplexity or generic zero-shot behavior but fails to capitalize on modest task-specific calibration signals, often yielding limited downstream gains. We revisit global structured pruning and present GISP, Global Iterative Structured Pruning, a post-training method that removes attention heads and MLP channels using first-order, loss-based important scores aggregated at the structure level with block-wise normalization. Built on this global importance metric, GISP adopts an iterative schedule, rather than one-shot pruning, stabilizes accuracy at higher sparsity, and mitigates perplexity collapse without requiring intermediate fine-tuning. Importantly, the iterative pruning forms nested subnetworks that support a ”prune-once, deploy-many” workflow. Furthermore, GISP defines structural importance directly with respect to a target loss, making it easy to adapt pruning to task-specific objectives. In this work, we use perplexity for language modeling and a margin-based objective for decision-style tasks. Extensive experiments show that across Llama2-7B/13B, Llama3-8B, and Mistral-0.3-7B, GISP consistently lowers WikiText-2 perplexity and improves downstream accuracy, with especially strong gains at 40–50% sparsity; on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-3-8B and Qwen3-8B with GSM8K, task-aligned calibration substantially boosts exact-match accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 结构化剪枝是一种高效部署大语言模型的有效方法，因为它能够创造出紧凑且适合硬件的架构。然而，目前主流的局部剪枝方法并不考虑任务特性：通过优化逐层重构而不是任务目标，这种方法往往能保留模型的困惑度或通用性，但却无法充分利用特定任务的校准信号，从而导致下游性能提升有限。我们重新探讨了全局结构化剪枝的概念，并提出了GISP——一种后训练方法。该方法通过基于结构层面的顺序重要度评分来移除注意力头和MLP通道，同时进行分块归一化处理。基于这种全局重要性度量标准，GISP采用迭代式剪枝策略，而非一次性剪枝。在较高稀疏度下，该方法能够稳定提升模型精度，同时避免困惑度的下降，而无需进行中间微调。重要的是，这种迭代剪枝方式可以构建出嵌套的子网络，从而实现“一次剪枝，多次部署”的工作流程。此外，GISP能够直接根据目标损失来定义结构重要性，这使得剪枝过程能够轻松适应特定任务的目标需求。在本研究中，我们将困惑度指标用于语言建模任务，而将基于边际的目标应用于决策类任务。大量实验表明，无论是在Llama2-7B/13B、Llama3-8B还是Mistral-0.3-7B上，GISP都能有效降低WikiText-2数据集的困惑度，并提高下游任务的准确率。特别是在40-50%的稀疏度条件下，GISP的性能提升尤为显著。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-3-8B和Qwen3-8B上使用GSM8K进行任务对齐校准后，模型的精确匹配准确率得到了显著提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Audio MultiChallenge: A Multi-Turn Evaluation of Spoken Dialogue Systems on Natural Human Interaction
papers.title_zh: 音频多挑战：对口语对话系统在真实人类交互场景下的多轮评估
papers.authors: Advait Gosai, Tyler Vuong, Utkarsh Tyagi, Steven Li, Wenjia You, Miheer Bavare, Arda Uçar, Zhongwang Fang, Brian Jang, Bing Liu, Yunzhong He
papers.abstract: End-to-end (E2E) spoken dialogue systems are replacing cascaded pipelines for voice-based human-AI interaction. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate these systems on synthetic speech and single-turn tasks, leaving multi-turn conversational ability underexplored. We introduce Audio MultiChallenge an open-source benchmark to evaluate these systems under natural multi-turn interaction patterns. Building on the text-based MultiChallenge framework, which evaluates Inference Memory, Instruction Retention, and Self Coherence, we introduce a new axis Voice Editing that tests robustness to mid-utterance speech repairs and backtracking. We augment each axis to the audio modality, such as introducing Audio-Cue challenges for Inference Memory that require recalling ambient sounds and paralinguistic signals beyond semantic content. We curate 452 conversations from 47 speakers with 1,712 instance-specific rubrics through a hybrid pipeline that exposes model failures at scale while preserving natural disfluencies found in unscripted human speech. Our evaluation reveals that even frontier models struggle on our benchmark, with our highest-performing model achieving a 54.65% pass rate. Error analysis shows that models are not sufficiently robust to human speech when tracking instructions, edits, and audio cues, highlighting the need for improved audio-native multi-turn interaction capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 端到端（E2E）语音对话系统正在取代基于语音的人机交互中的级联处理流程。现有的评估基准主要针对合成语音和单轮对话任务进行评估，而多轮对话能力则没有得到充分探索。我们提出了Audio MultiChallenge这一开源评估基准，用于在自然多轮交互模式下评估这些系统。在基于文本的MultiChallenge框架的基础上，该基准还增加了“语音编辑”这一新维度，以测试模型对中途语音修正和回溯行为的适应能力。我们将每个维度扩展到音频领域，例如引入基于音频提示的推理记忆挑战，要求模型能够回忆起除语义内容之外的环境声音和副语言信号。我们通过混合式流程收集了来自47位说话者、共452段对话的数据，并制定了1,712条特定评分标准。我们的评估结果显示，即使是先进的模型也在这个基准测试中面临挑战，表现最好的模型仅达到了54.65%的通过率。错误分析表明，模型在跟踪指令、语音编辑和音频提示方面还不够稳健，这凸显了提升音频原生多轮交互能力的必要性。

papers.title: GenomeQA: Benchmarking General Large Language Models for Genome Sequence Understanding
papers.title_zh: GenomeQA：针对基因组序列理解任务的大型语言模型的性能评估基准
papers.authors: Weicai Long, Yusen Hou, Junning Feng, Houcheng su, Shuo Yang, Donglin Xie, Yanlin Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted as conversational assistants in genomics, where they are mainly used to reason over biological knowledge, annotations, and analysis outputs through natural language interfaces. However, existing benchmarks either focus on specialized DNA models trained for sequence prediction or evaluate biological knowledge using text-only questions, leaving the behavior of general-purpose LLMs when directly exposed to raw genome sequences underexplored. We introduce GenomeQA, a benchmark designed to provide a controlled evaluation setting for general-purpose LLMs on sequence-based genome inference tasks. GenomeQA comprises 5,200 samples drawn from multiple biological databases, with sequence lengths ranging from 6 to 1,000 base pairs (bp), spanning six task families: Enhancer and Promoter Identification, Splice Site Identification, Taxonomic Classification, Histone Mark Prediction, Transcription Factor Binding Site Prediction, and TF Motif Prediction. Across six frontier LLMs, we find that models often outperform random baselines, particularly on tasks driven by local sequence cues such as GC content and short motifs, while performance degrades on tasks that require more indirect or multi-step inference over sequence patterns. GenomeQA establishes a diagnostic benchmark for studying and improving the use of general-purpose LLMs on raw genomic sequences.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在基因组学领域作为对话助手得到了广泛应用，它们主要用于通过自然语言接口对生物知识、注释和分析结果进行推理。然而，现有的评估基准大多集中在为序列预测而训练的专门DNA模型上，或者使用仅包含文本的问题来评估生物知识，而忽略了通用语言模型在直接处理原始基因组序列时的行为表现。我们提出了GenomeQA这一评估基准，旨在为通用语言模型在基于序列的基因组推断任务上的表现提供一个可控的评估环境。GenomeQA包含了5,200个样本，这些样本来自多个生物数据库，序列长度从6到1,000个碱基对不等，涵盖了六个任务类别：增强子和启动子识别、剪接位点识别、分类学分类、组蛋白标记预测、转录因子结合位点预测以及转录因子基序预测。通过对六款前沿语言模型进行测试，我们发现这些模型在依赖局部序列特征的任务上通常优于随机基线模型，尤其是在涉及GC含量和短序列基序等局部特征的任务中。而在需要更多间接或多步骤推理的任务上，模型的性能则有所下降。GenomeQA为研究和改进通用语言模型在原始基因组序列上的应用提供了一个有价值的评估基准。

papers.title: VideoStir: Understanding Long Videos via Spatio-Temporally Structured and Intent-Aware RAG
papers.title_zh: VideoStir：通过时空结构化且注重意图的RAG技术来理解长视频
papers.authors: Honghao Fu, Miao Xu, Yiwei Wang, Dailing Zhang, Jun Liu, Yujun Cai
papers.abstract: Scaling multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to long videos is constrained by limited context windows. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a promising remedy by organizing query-relevant visual evidence into a compact context, most existing methods (i) flatten videos into independent segments, breaking their inherent spatio-temporal structure, and (ii) depend on explicit semantic matching, which can miss cues that are implicitly relevant to the query’s intent. To overcome these limitations, we propose VideoStir, a structured and intent-aware long-video RAG framework. It firstly structures a video as a spatio-temporal graph at clip level, and then performs multi-hop retrieval to aggregate evidence across distant yet contextually related events. Furthermore, it introduces an MLLM-backed intent-relevance scorer that retrieves frames based on their alignment with the query’s reasoning intent. To support this capability, we curate IR-600K, a large-scale dataset tailored for learning frame–query intent alignment. Experiments show that VideoStir is competitive with state-of-the-art baselines without relying on auxiliary information, highlighting the promise of shifting long-video RAG from flattened semantic matching to structured, intent-aware reasoning. Codes and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RomGai/VideoStir.
papers.abstract_zh: 将多模态大语言模型应用于长视频时，受到有限上下文窗口的限制。虽然检索增强生成技术通过将与查询相关的视觉信息组织成紧凑的上下文结构，是一种有前景的解决方案，但大多数现有方法都存在以下问题：其一，将视频分割成独立的片段，破坏了其固有的时空结构；其二，依赖显式的语义匹配，这可能会忽略那些与查询意图密切相关的线索。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了VideoStir这一结构化的、注重意图的长视频检索增强生成框架。该框架首先以剪辑级别将视频构建成一个时空图结构，然后采用多跳检索方式，将不同位置但具有上下文关联的事件中的信息整合起来。此外，它还引入了一个基于大语言模型的意图相关性评分器，该评分器根据帧与查询推理意图的匹配程度来检索相应的帧。为了支持这一功能，我们创建了一个名为IR-600K的大规模数据集，专门用于学习帧与查询意图之间的对应关系。实验表明，VideoStir能够在不依赖辅助信息的情况下，与最先进的基线算法相竞争，这充分证明了将长视频检索增强生成从简单的语义匹配转向结构化、注重意图的推理方式所具有的巨大潜力。代码和检查点可在此处获取：https://github.com/RomGai/VideoStir

papers.title: Massively Multilingual Joint Segmentation and Glossing
papers.title_zh: 大规模多语言联合分割与注释处理
papers.authors: Michael Ginn, Lindia Tjuatja, Enora Rice, Ali Marashian, Maria Valentini, Jasmine Xu, Graham Neubig, Alexis Palmer
papers.abstract: Automated interlinear gloss prediction with neural networks is a promising approach to accelerate language documentation efforts. However, while state-of-the-art models like GlossLM (Ginn et al., 2024) achieve high scores on glossing benchmarks, user studies with linguists have found critical barriers to the usefulness of such models in real-world scenarios (Rice et al., 2025). In particular, existing models typically generate morpheme-level glosses but assign them to whole words without predicting the actual morpheme boundaries, making the predictions less interpretable and thus untrustworthy to human annotators.We conduct the first study on neural models that jointly predict interlinear glosses and the corresponding morphological segmentation from raw text. We run experiments to determine the optimal way to train models that balance segmentation and glossing accuracy, as well as the alignment between the two tasks. We extend the training corpus of GlossLM and pretrain PolyGloss, a family of seq2seq multilingual models for joint segmentation and glossing that outperforms GlossLM on glossing and beats various open-source LLMs on segmentation, glossing, and alignment. In addition, we demonstrate that PolyGloss can be quickly adapted to a new dataset via low-rank adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用神经网络进行自动行间词性标注是一种有望加速语言文档处理工作的方法。然而，尽管像GlossLM这样的先进模型在标注基准测试中取得了高分，但与语言学家的用户研究却发现，这些模型在实际应用场景中存在着严重的局限性（Rice等人，2025年）。具体来说，现有模型通常只能生成词素级别的标注，但却将这些标注应用到整个单词上，而并未预测出实际的词素边界，这使得这些预测结果难以解释，因此无法被人类注释者信任。我们开展了第一项关于神经模型的研究，这些模型能够同时预测行间词性标注以及相应的形态分割信息。我们通过实验确定了训练模型的最佳方式，以平衡分割精度和标注准确性，同时确保这两项任务之间的对齐性。我们扩展了GlossLM的训练语料库，并预训练了PolyGloss这一序列到序列的多语言模型家族，该模型在分割和标注方面均优于GlossLM，并且在分割、标注和对齐方面也超越了各种开源大语言模型。此外，我们还证明了PolyGloss可以通过低秩适应快速适应新的数据集。

papers.title: TexOCR: Advancing Document OCR Models for Compilable Page-to-LaTeX Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: TexOCR：推动可编译的文档OCR模型发展，以实现从文本到LaTeX格式的精确转换
papers.authors: Chengye Wang, Lin Fu, Zexi Kuang, Yilun Zhao
papers.abstract: Existing document OCR largely targets plain text or Markdown, discarding the structural and executable properties that make LaTeX essential for scientific publishing. We study page-level reconstruction of scientific PDFs into compilable LaTeX and introduce TexOCR-Bench, a benchmark, and TexOCR-Train, a large-scale training corpus, for this task. TexOCR-Bench features a multi-dimensional evaluation suite that jointly assesses transcription fidelity, structural faithfulness, and end-to-end compilability. Leveraging TexOCR-Train, we train a 2B-parameter model, TexOCR, using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards derived from LaTeX unit tests that directly enforce compilability and referential integrity. Experiments across 21 frontier models on TexOCR-Bench show that existing systems frequently violate key document invariants, including consistent section structure, correct float placement, and valid label–reference links, which undermines compilation reliability and downstream usability. Our analysis further reveals that RL with verifiable rewards yields consistent improvements over SFT alone, particularly on structural and compilation metrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的文档OCR技术主要针对纯文本或Markdown格式的文本，而忽略了那些使LaTeX在科学出版中不可或缺的结构性和可执行性特征。我们研究了将科学PDF文件在页面级别重建为可编译的LaTeX格式的方法，并开发了TexOCR-Bench这一基准测试工具，以及TexOCR-Train这一大规模训练数据集。TexOCR-Bench采用了多维评估体系，能够综合评估转录的准确性、结构的一致性以及代码的可编译性。通过利用TexOCR-Train提供的训练数据，我们构建了一个具有2B参数的模型——TexOCR。该模型采用监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）方法进行训练，同时利用来自LaTeX单元测试的可验证奖励来驱动模型的训练，从而确保代码的可编译性和引用关系的准确性。在TexOCR-Bench上对21种前沿模型进行的实验表明，现有的OCR系统经常违反一些重要的文档不变性规则，比如一致的章节结构、正确的浮动元素位置安排，以及有效的标签与引用链接关系等。这些缺陷会严重影响代码的可靠性和后续使用的便利性。我们的分析还发现，使用可验证奖励的强化学习方法能够获得比单纯使用监督微调更高的性能提升，尤其是在结构和可编译性指标上。

papers.title: If an LLM Were a Character, Would It Know Its Own Story? Evaluating Lifelong Learning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 如果一种大型语言模型具有某个角色的特征，那么它是否会了解自己的“故事”？评估大型语言模型中的终身学习能力
papers.authors: Siqi Fan, Xiusheng Huang, Yiqun Yao, Xuezhi Fang, Kang Liu, Peng Han, Shuo Shang, Aixin Sun, Yequan Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can carry out human-like dialogue, but unlike humans, they are stateless due to the superposition property. However, during multi-turn, multi-agent interactions, LLMs begin to exhibit consistent, character-like behaviors—hinting at a form of emergent lifelong learning. Despite this, existing benchmarks often fail to capture these dynamics, primarily focusing on static, open-ended evaluations. To address this gap, we introduce LifeState-BENCH, a benchmark designed to assess lifelong learning in LLMs. It features two episodic datasets—Hamlet and a synthetic script collection—rich in narrative structure and character interactions. Our fact-checking evaluation probes models’ self-awareness, episodic memory retrieval, and relationship tracking, across both parametric and non-parametric approaches. Experiments on models like Llama3.1-8B, GPT-4-turbo, and DeepSeek R1, we demonstrate that non-parametric methods significantly outperform parametric ones in managing stateful learning. However, all models exhibit challenges with catastrophic forgetting as interactions extend, highlighting the need for further advancements in lifelong learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够执行类似人类的对话，但与人类不同的是，由于叠加特性，这些模型是无状态的。然而，在多轮次、多智能体交互中，大语言模型开始展现出类似角色的行为特征——这暗示了某种形式的终身学习现象。尽管如此，现有的评估基准往往无法捕捉到这些动态变化，因为它们主要依赖于静态的开放式评估方式。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了LifeState-BENCH这个评估基准，旨在评估大语言模型的终身学习能力。该基准包含两个基于情节结构的数据集——《哈姆雷特》以及一个合成脚本集，这些数据集在叙事结构和角色互动方面都非常丰富。我们的事实核查评估方法通过参数化与非参数化的手段，对模型的自意识、情节记忆检索以及关系跟踪能力进行了测试。通过对Llama3.1-8B、GPT-4-turbo和DeepSeek R1等模型进行实验，我们发现非参数化方法在管理有状态学习方面明显优于参数化方法。不过，所有模型在交互次数增加时都面临着灾难性遗忘的问题，这凸显了在终身学习领域进一步发展的必要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Graph Reasoning Paradigm: Structured and Symbolic Reasoning with Topology-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 图推理范式：基于拓扑感知的强化学习技术，为大型语言模型提供结构化且符号化的推理方式
papers.authors: Runxuan Liu, Xianhao Ou, Xinyan Ma, Jiyuan Wang, Jiafeng Liang, Jiaqi Li, Tao He, Zheng Chu, Rongchuan Mu, Zekun Wang, Baoxin Wang, Dayong Wu, Ming Liu, Shijin Wang, Guoping Hu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Long Chain-of-Thought (LCoT), achieved by Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has proven effective in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, reasoning in current LLMs is primarily generated as plain text, where performing semantic evaluation on such unstructured data creates a computational bottleneck during training. Despite RLVR-based optimization, existing methods still suffer from coarse-grained supervision, reward hacking, high training costs, and poor generalization.To address these issues, we propose the Graph Reasoning Paradigm (GRP), which realizes structured and symbolic reasoning, implemented via graph-structured representations with step-level cognitive labels. Building upon GRP, we further design Process-Aware Stratified Clipping Group Relative Policy Optimization (PASC-GRPO), which leverages structured evaluation to replace semantic evaluation, achieves process-aware verification through graph-structured outcome rewards, and mitigates reward hacking via stratified clipping advantage estimation. Experiments demonstrate significant improvements across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. Data, models, and code will be released later.
papers.abstract_zh: 长文本推理（LCoT）技术通过基于可验证奖励的强化学习方法实现，已被证明能够有效提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，当前LLM的推理结果主要以纯文本形式呈现，对这类非结构化数据进行语义评估会在训练过程中造成计算瓶颈。尽管采用了基于RLVR的优化方法，现有的方法仍然存在监督粒度粗、奖励机制易被操纵、训练成本较高以及泛化能力较差等问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了图式推理范式（GRP），该范式实现了结构化和符号化的推理过程，通过带有步骤级认知标签的图结构表示来实现这一功能。在此基础上，我们进一步设计了过程感知分层裁剪组相对策略优化算法（PASC-GRPO）。该算法利用结构化评估来替代语义评估，通过图结构化的结果奖励来实现过程感知的验证，并通过分层裁剪优势估计来防止奖励机制的滥用。实验结果表明，该方法在数学推理和代码生成任务上取得了显著改进。相关数据、模型和代码将于后续发布。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LLM-Powered Benchmark Factory: Reliable, Generic, and Efficient
papers.title_zh: 基于LLM的基准测试工厂：可靠、通用且高效
papers.authors: Peiwen Yuan, Shaoxiong Feng, Yiwei Li, Xinglin Wang, Yueqi Zhang, Jiayi Shi, Chuyi Tan, Boyuan Pan, Yao Hu, Kan Li
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has led to a surge in both model supply and application demands. To facilitate effective matching between them, generic and efficient benchmark generators that can construct high-quality benchmarks are widely needed. However, human annotators are constrained by inefficiency, and current LLM-based benchmark generators lack not only generalizability but also a comprehensive evaluation framework for validation and optimization. To fill this gap, we first establish an automated evaluation framework, structured around four dimensions and ten criteria. Under this framework, we carefully analyze the advantages and weaknesses of directly prompting LLMs as generic benchmark generators. On this basis, we introduce a series of methods to address the identified weaknesses and integrate them as BenchMaker. Experiments across multiple LLMs and tasks confirm that BenchMaker achieves comparable performance to human-annotated benchmarks on most metrics, highlighting its generalizability and validity. More importantly, it delivers highly consistent evaluation results across 21 LLMs (e.g., 0.969 Pearson correlation against MMLU-Pro on language understanding task), while incurring minimal overhead (e.g., 0.005 and 0.38 minutes per sample when using GPT-4o mini as generator).
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展导致了模型供应和应用需求的激增。为了有效匹配这些模型，需要通用且高效的基准生成器来构建高质量的评估标准。然而，人工注释员的工作效率有限，目前的基于LLM的基准生成器不仅缺乏通用性，还缺乏完善的评估框架来进行验证和优化。为了填补这一空白，我们首先建立了一个自动化评估框架，该框架围绕四个维度十项标准进行构建。在这个框架下，我们仔细分析了直接提示LLM作为通用基准生成器的优缺点。在此基础上，我们引入了一系列方法来解决已发现的缺陷，并将这些方法整合到BenchMaker中。通过对多种LLM和任务的实验验证，我们发现BenchMaker在大多数指标上的表现与人工注释的基准测试相当，这充分体现了其通用性和有效性。更重要的是，它在21种LLM上都能提供高度一致的评估结果（例如，在语言理解任务中，与MMLU-Pro的皮尔逊相关系数为0.969），同时产生的额外开销极小（例如，使用GPT-4o mini作为生成器时，每个样本的处理时间仅为0.005分钟和0.38分钟）。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: COSMOS: Connectivity-Oriented Submodular Maximization for Optimal Subgraph Retrieval
papers.title_zh: COSMOS：一种以连接性为目标的次模最大化算法，用于最优子图检索
papers.authors: Boci Peng, Xiao Liu, Boren Hu, Yun Zhu, Xuanbo Fan, Yanwei Yue, Chunyu Yang, Yan Zhang
papers.abstract: Retrieving coherent evidence subgraphs is critical for Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA). Existing paradigms often treat facts independently, rely on biased heuristics, or employ myopic search, failing to optimize collective subgraph utility. In this paper, we propose COSMOS (Connectivity-Oriented Submodular Maximization for Optimal Subgraph Retrieval), a unified framework that formalizes evidence retrieval as a constrained submodular maximization problem. This formulation mathematically captures the trade-off between information relevance and structural complexity. To tractably solve this combinatorial challenge, COSMOS employs a decompose-and-conquer strategy, which first performs a seed-guided greedy expansion to maximize local semantic utility, followed by a topology-aware component aggregation to bridge disjoint evidence clusters via Maximum Spanning Tree aggregation. Guided by theoretical bounds, we introduce Structure-Aware Contrastive Tuning to align semantic space with KG topology. Experimental results on WebQSP, CWQ, and \text{M}^3\text{GQA} benchmarks demonstrate that COSMOS achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 获取连贯的证据子图对于知识库问答系统至关重要。现有的方法往往独立处理事实信息，依赖有偏见的启发式算法，或者采用短视的搜索方式，这些做法都无法有效优化子图的整体效用。在本文中，我们提出了COSMOS算法——一种以连通性为导向的子模最大化方法，用于最优子图检索。该算法将证据检索问题形式化为一个约束性子模最大化问题，从而在数学上捕捉到信息相关性与结构复杂性之间的权衡关系。为了有效解决这一组合挑战，COSMOS采用了一种分解与征服的策略：首先通过贪婪扩展来最大化局部语义效用，然后利用拓扑感知的组件聚合技术，通过最大生成树聚合来连接不同的证据簇。在理论界限的指导下，我们引入了结构感知的对比调整机制，以将语义空间与知识图谱的拓扑结构进行对齐。在WebQSP、CWQ以及\text{M}^3\text{GQA}基准测试上的实验结果表明，COSMOS算法取得了领先的性能表现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Attn-GS: Attention-Guided Context Compression for Efficient Personalized LLMs
papers.title_zh: 致GS：基于注意力机制的上下文压缩技术，用于高效实现个性化大语言模型
papers.authors: Shenglai Zeng, Tianqi Zheng, Chuan Tian, Dante Everaert, Yau-Shian Wang, Yupin Huang, Michael J. Morais, Rohit Patki, Jinjin Tian, Xinnan Dai, Kai Guo, Monica Xiao Cheng, Hui Liu
papers.abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) to individual users requires incorporating extensive interaction histories and profiles, but input token constraints make this impractical due to high inference latency and API costs. Existing approaches rely on heuristic methods such as selecting recent interactions or prompting summarization models to compress user profiles. However, these methods treat context as a monolithic whole and fail to consider how LLMs internally process and prioritize different profile components. We investigate whether LLMs’ attention patterns can effectively identify important personalization signals for intelligent context compression. Through preliminary studies on representative personalization tasks, we discover that (a) LLMs’ attention patterns naturally reveal important signals, and (b) fine-tuning enhances LLMs’ ability to distinguish between relevant and irrelevant information. Based on these insights, we propose Attn-GS, an attention-guided context compression framework that leverages attention feedback from a marking model to mark important personalization sentences, then guides a compression model to generate task-relevant, high-quality compressed user contexts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Attn-GS significantly outperforms various baselines across different tasks, token limits, and settings, achieving performance close to using full context while reducing token usage by 50 times.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了将大语言模型个性化处理适配到每个用户的需求，需要整合大量的交互历史和用户画像信息。然而，由于输入令牌的限制，这种处理方式在推理速度和成本方面存在很大挑战，因此并不实用。目前的方法通常依赖于启发式算法，比如选择最近的交互数据，或者利用摘要模型来压缩用户画像。但这些方法往往将上下文视为一个整体，没有考虑到语言模型内部是如何处理和优先处理不同信息的。我们研究了语言模型的注意力模式是否能够有效识别出重要的个性化信号，从而实现智能的上下文压缩。通过初步的测试，我们发现：(a) 语言模型的注意力模式能够自然地揭示出重要的信号；(b) 对模型进行微调可以提升其区分相关信息和无关信息的能力。基于这些发现，我们提出了Attn-GS这一注意力引导的上下文压缩框架。该框架利用标记模型提供的注意力反馈来标记出重要的个性化句子，然后由压缩模型生成与任务相关的高质量压缩上下文。大量的实验表明，Attn-GS在不同任务、令牌限制和设置下都表现出显著的性能优势，其性能接近使用完整上下文的水平，同时减少了50倍的令牌使用量。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Structured Semantic Information Helps Retrieve Better Examples for In-Context Learning Applied to Few-Shot Relation Extraction
papers.title_zh: 结构化的语义信息有助于找到更合适的例子，从而辅助上下文相关的学习过程。这种方法适用于少数示例关系提取的场景
papers.authors: Aunabil Chakma, Mihai Surdeanu, Eduardo Blanco
papers.abstract: This paper presents several strategies to automatically obtain additional examples for in-context learning, effectively transforming relation extraction from a 1-shot to a few-shot setting. Specifically, we introduce a novel strategy for example selection, in which new examples are selected based on the similarity of their underlying syntactic-semantic structure to the provided 1-shot example. We show that our strategy results in complementary word choices and sentence structures compared to LLM-generated examples. When both strategies are combined, the resulting hybrid system achieves a more holistic picture of the relations of interest than either method alone. Our framework transfers well across datasets (FS-TACRED and FS-FewRel) and LLM families(Qwen and Gemma). Overall, our hybrid system consistently outperforms alternative strategies achieving state-of-the-art performance on FS-TACRED and strong gains on a customized FewRel subset.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了几种自动获取用于上下文学习的额外示例的策略，有效地将关系提取从一次性抽取转变为少量样本抽取。具体来说，我们提出了一种新颖的示例选择策略，该策略根据新示例与提供的一次性示例在句法-语义结构上的相似性来选取示例。我们的策略能够产生与大语言模型生成的示例相比更为丰富的词汇选择和句子结构。当这两种策略结合使用时，所得到的混合系统能够更全面地呈现所需关系的信息，优于单一方法的效果。我们的框架在不同数据集（FS-TACRED和FS-FewRel）以及不同的大语言模型家族（Qwen和Gemma）中都能良好应用。总体而言，我们的混合系统在FS-TACRED任务上始终表现出色，并且在定制的FewRel子任务上取得了显著的性能提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DUD: Decoupled Update Dynamics for Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: DUD：用于大型语言模型中的可靠不确定性量化的解耦更新机制
papers.authors: Yixin Bu, Runze Xia, Guanyun Zou, Yupeng Ji, Hongliang Dai, Haodong Liu, Piji Li
papers.abstract: Accurate Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is critical for reliable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet traditional probability-based metrics often fail to capture the model’s true epistemic state. While recent mechanistic approaches leverage hidden state dynamics, they typically aggregate residual stream updates, conflating the distinct roles of parametric memory (Feed-Forward Networks) and contextual processing (Attention). We argue that this aggregation obscures fine-grained mechanistic conflicts, such as memory-context misalignment, that are fundamental indicators of uncertainty. To address this, we introduce Decoupled Update Dynamics (DUD), a framework that explicitly decouples FFN and Attention contributions via noise-induced causal interventions. By quantifying the independent restoration capabilities of each module, we construct a dual-stream dynamic profile that captures the model’s internal fragility. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both uncertainty estimation and calibration, while exhibiting superior cross-dataset generalization, validating decoupled dynamics as a robust proxy for model faithfulness.
papers.abstract_zh: 精确的不确定性量化对于大语言模型的有效部署至关重要，然而传统的基于概率的度量方法往往无法准确反映模型的真实认知状态。虽然最近的一些机制性方法利用了隐藏状态动态，但它们通常会将残差流更新进行汇总，从而混淆了参数记忆（前馈网络）和上下文处理（注意力机制）之间的不同作用。我们认为，这种汇总方式掩盖了各种细微的机制性冲突，比如记忆与上下文的不匹配，而这些冲突正是不确定性的重要指标。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了“分离更新动态”框架，该框架通过噪声诱导的因果干预手段，明确分离了前馈网络和注意力机制的贡献。通过量化每个模块的独立恢复能力，我们构建了一个双流动态模型，能够捕捉到模型的内部脆弱性。大量实验表明，分离更新动态在不确定性估计和校准方面显著优于现有的最先进基线方法，同时还能在跨数据集的泛化能力上表现出色，这验证了分离动态作为模型忠实度可靠代理的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: JurisBench: A Deep Benchmark for Assessing Large Language Models in Professional Legal Practice
papers.title_zh: JurisBench：一个用于评估大型语言模型在专业法律领域应用效果的强大基准测试工具
papers.authors: Ziang Chen, Guannan Li, Fanlin Ji, Yipeng Kang, Jiaqi Li, Muhan Zhang, Yangtao Zhang, Li Tianjiao, Jiannan Wang, Xin Guo, Song-Chun Zhu, Bin Ling
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong cross-domain capabilities, yet their competence in specialized professional tasks remains underexamined. Existing legal benchmarks evaluate isolated tasks or exam-style questions, failing to capture the procedural interdependencies and adjudicative rigor inherent in professional practice. To bridge this gap, we construct JurisBench, a vertical, depth-oriented, domain-specific benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs across key stages of Chinese civil litigation. JurisBench introduces a Linear Depth Simulation track that mirrors the cognitive workflow of professional judges through four sequential, dependency-aware phases: Cause of Action prediction, Focus of Disputes identification, Rationale of the Judgment generation, and Result of the Judgment determination. Results reveal an “illusion of competence”: state-of-the-art models exhibit marked performance degradation in end-to-end pipelines due to cascading error propagation. We identify precise statutory grounding as a persistent bottleneck, highlighting a critical gap between fluent linguistic output and judicial reliability. JurisBench shifts evaluation from isolated legal knowledge to workflow-level task execution, providing a diagnostic framework for legal AI and a template for benchmark design in specialized domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在跨领域任务上表现出强大的能力，然而它们在专业领域的表现却尚未得到充分评估。现有的法律基准测试通常只针对孤立的任务或考试式问题，无法捕捉到专业实践中所固有的程序性依赖关系以及裁决的严谨性。为了填补这一空白，我们开发了JurisBench——一个垂直方向、注重深度、特定领域的基准测试工具，旨在评估大语言模型在中国民事诉讼各个关键阶段的性能。JurisBench引入了线性深度模拟环节，该环节模拟了专业法官的认知工作流程，分为四个连续的、考虑依赖关系的阶段：行为原因的预测、争议焦点的识别、判决理由的生成以及判决结果的确定。研究结果揭示了一个“能力幻觉”：最先进的模型在端到端流程中表现出明显的性能下降，这是由于错误连锁效应导致的。我们发现，精确的法规依据是一个持续的瓶颈问题，这凸显了流畅的语言输出与司法可靠性之间的巨大差距。JurisBench将评估从孤立的法律知识转向工作流程层面的任务执行，为法律人工智能提供了一个诊断框架，并为特定领域的基准测试设计提供了模板。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LeCoDe: A Benchmark Dataset for Interactive Legal Consultation Dialogue Evaluation
papers.title_zh: LeCoDe：用于评估交互式法律咨询对话的基准数据集
papers.authors: Weikang Yuan, Kaisong Song, Zhuoren Jiang, Junjie Cao, Yujie Zhang, Jun Lin, Kun Kuang, Ji Zhang, Xiaozhong Liu
papers.abstract: Legal consultation is essential for safeguarding individual rights and ensuring access to justice, yet remains costly and inaccessible to many individuals due to the shortage of professionals. While recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising path toward scalable, low-cost legal assistance, current systems fall short in handling the interactive and knowledge-intensive nature of real-world consultations. To address these challenges, we introduce LeCoDe, a multi-turn benchmark dataset constructed from publicly available real-world legal consultation content and carefully processed into a de-identified, structured research resource for evaluating and advancing research on LLMs in legal consultation settings. LeCoDe contains 3,696 multi-turn consultation cases with 110,008 dialogue turns. The dataset is further enriched through expert annotation, including key facts, fact importance, and advice summaries. Furthermore, we propose a comprehensive evaluation framework that assesses LLMs’ consultation capabilities in terms of (1) clarification capability and (2) professional advice quality. This unified framework incorporates 12 metrics across two dimensions. Through extensive experiments on various general and domain-specific LLMs, our results reveal significant challenges in this task, with even state-of-the-art models like GPT-4 achieving only 35.9% recall for clarification and 59.1% overall score for advice quality, highlighting the complexity of professional consultation scenarios. Based on these findings, we further explore several strategies to enhance LLMs’ legal consultation abilities. Our benchmark contributes to advancing research in legal domain dialogue systems, particularly in simulating more real-world user-expert interactions. The resource is available at https://github.com/PiLab-ZJU/LeCoDe.
papers.abstract_zh: 法律咨询对于保护个人权利和确保人们能够获得司法帮助至关重要。然而，由于专业人员的短缺，法律咨询往往成本高昂，且许多人都难以获得这种服务。虽然大语言模型在最近取得了显著进展，为提供可扩展、低成本的法律援助提供了希望，但目前的系统在处理现实世界咨询中的互动性和知识密集型特性方面仍存在不足。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了LeCoDe这一多轮对话基准数据集。该数据集基于公开可用的真实法律咨询内容构建而成，经过精心处理后，成为了一个去标识化、结构化的研究资源，可用于评估和发展大语言模型在法律咨询领域的应用。LeCoDe包含3,696个多轮对话案例，共计110,008个对话回合。此外，我们还通过专家注释来丰富该数据集，包括关键事实、事实重要性以及建议摘要等内容。我们还提出了一个全面的评估框架，用于评估大语言模型在咨询能力方面的表现，具体体现在（1）澄清能力以及（2）专业建议的质量上。这个统一的评估框架包含了两个维度的12项指标。通过对各种通用和特定领域的大语言模型进行广泛实验，我们发现这一任务存在诸多挑战。即使是像GPT-4这样最先进的模型，在澄清能力的召回率上仅达到35.9%，而在专业建议质量方面的得分则仅为59.1%。这凸显了专业咨询场景的复杂性。基于这些发现，我们进一步探讨了几种提升大语言模型法律咨询能力的策略。我们的基准数据集为法律领域对话系统的研究做出了贡献，特别是在模拟更真实的用户与专家互动方面。该数据集可以在https://github.com/PiLab-ZJU/LeCoDe下载。

papers.title: METER: Evaluating Multi-Level Contextual Causal Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 度量标准：评估大型语言模型中的多层上下文因果推理能力
papers.authors: Pengfeng Li, Chen Huang, Chaoqun Hao, Hongyao Chen, Xiao-Yong Wei, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng
papers.abstract: Contextual causal reasoning is a critical yet challenging capability for Large Language Models (LLMs). Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate this skill in fragmented settings, failing to ensure context consistency or cover the full causal hierarchy. To address this, we pioneer METER to systematically benchmark LLMs across all three levels of the causal ladder under a unified context setting. Our extensive evaluation of various LLMs reveals a significant decline in proficiency as tasks ascend the causal hierarchy. To diagnose this degradation, we conduct a deep mechanistic analysis via both error pattern identification and internal information flow tracing. Our analysis reveals two primary failure modes: (1) LLMs are susceptible to distraction by causally irrelevant but factually correct information at lower level of causality; and (2) as tasks ascend the causal hierarchy, faithfulness to the provided context degrades, leading to a reduced performance. We belive our work advances our understanding of the mechanisms behind LLM contextual causal reasoning and establishes a critical foundation for future research. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/METER.
papers.abstract_zh: 情境因果推理是大语言模型（LLM）一项至关重要但具有挑战性的能力。然而，现有的评估基准往往只针对部分情境进行测评，无法确保情境的一致性或涵盖完整的因果层次结构。为了应对这一问题，我们开发了METER工具，能够在统一的情境设置下，对LLM在因果层次结构的三个层面进行系统性的评估。我们对各种LLM的广泛评估表明，随着任务在因果层次结构中向上推进，其能力会显著下降。为了诊断这种下降现象，我们通过错误模式识别以及内部信息流追踪等方式进行了深入的分析。我们的分析发现两个主要的失败原因：(1) LLM容易受到在较低因果层次上出现的、虽然事实正确但与因果关系无关的信息干扰；(2) 当任务在因果层次结构中向上推进时，对提供情境的忠实度会降低，从而导致性能下降。我们相信，我们的研究有助于加深我们对LLM情境因果推理机制的理解，并为未来的研究奠定坚实的基础。我们的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/SCUNLP/METER下载。

papers.title: PersonalAlign: Hierarchical Implicit Intent Alignment for Personalized GUI Agent with Long-Term User-Centric Records
papers.title_zh: PersonalAlign：一种分层式的隐式意图对齐机制，用于构建以用户为中心的个性化图形用户界面代理，同时还能保留用户的长期偏好记录
papers.authors: Yibo Lyu, Gongwei Chen, Rui Shao, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie
papers.abstract: While GUI agents have shown strong performance under explicit and completion instructions, real-world deployment requires aligning with users’ more complex implicit intents. In this work, we highlight Hierarchical Implicit Intent Alignment for Personalized GUI Agent (PersonalAlign), a new agent task that requires agents to leverage long-term user records as persistent context to resolve omitted preferences in vague instructions and anticipate latent routines by user state for proactive assistance. To facilitate this study, we introduce AndroidIntent, a benchmark designed to evaluate agents’ ability in resolving vague instructions and providing proactive suggestions through reasoning over long-term user records. We annotated 775 user-specific preferences and 215 routines from 20k long-term records across different users for evaluation. Furthermore, we introduce Hierarchical Intent Memory Agent (HIM-Agent), which maintains a continuously updating personal memory and hierarchically organizes user preferences and routines for personalization. Finally, we evaluate a range of GUI agents on AndroidIntent, including GPT-5, Qwen3-VL, and UI-TARS, further results show that HIM-Agent significantly improves both execution and proactive performance by 15.7% and 7.3%.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然GUI代理在明确指令和完成指令方面表现优异，但在实际部署中还需要与用户更复杂的隐含意图相匹配。在这项研究中，我们提出了分层隐含意图对齐个性化GUI代理（PersonalAlign）这一新代理任务。该任务要求代理利用长期用户记录作为持久上下文，以解决模糊指令中的遗漏偏好问题，并通过用户状态预测潜在行为，以提供主动式帮助。为了便于研究，我们引入了AndroidIntent这一基准测试，用于评估代理通过长期用户记录进行推理来解决模糊指令并提供主动建议的能力。我们为评估目的，对来自20,000条长期记录中的775个特定用户偏好和215个行为进行了标注。此外，我们还提出了分层意图记忆代理（HIM-Agent），它维护着持续更新的个人记忆，并将用户偏好和行为按层次结构进行组织，以实现个性化处理。最后，我们在AndroidIntent上评估了多种GUI代理的表现，包括GPT-5、Qwen3-VL和UI-TARS。进一步的研究结果显示，HIM-Agent在执行效率和主动性能方面分别提高了15.7%和7.3%。

papers.title: Empowering GUI Agents via Autonomous Experience Exploration and Hindsight Experience Utilization for Task Planning
papers.title_zh: 通过自主体验探索与利用过往体验来辅助任务规划，从而提升GUI代理的效能
papers.authors: Tianyi Men, Zhuoran Jin, Pengfei Cao, Yubo Chen, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao
papers.abstract: Multimodal web agents can assist humans in operating repetitive GUI tasks, where effective task planning is essential for decomposing complex tasks into executable actions. While small open-source MLLMs are cost-efficient and privacy-preserving compared with commercial large models, they suffer from weak planning and limited cross-website generalization. To address these limitations, we introduce the planning experience exploration and utilization (PEEU) method, which autonomously explores environments to discover experiences and utilizes hindsight experience to synthesize strictly aligned, high-level training data. To quantitatively analyze the generalization behaviors driving this performance, we propose the task decomposition hierarchical analysis framework (TDHAF) to systematically study compositional generalization across three task granularities: low, middle and high levels. Our analysis reveals that mastering low-level atomic skills does not guarantee high-level planning competence, while high-level task training yields stronger OOD generalization. Experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate PEEU’s superior effectiveness: our 7B model achieves 30.6% accuracy, outperforming the much larger Qwen2.5-VL-32B model. These demonstrate constructing hindsight high-level tasks and leveraging experiences is crucial for OOD planning abilities of small MLLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态网络代理可以帮助人类执行重复性图形用户界面任务。在复杂的任务中，有效的任务规划对于将其分解为可执行的动作至关重要。与商业大型模型相比，小型开源MLLM模型在成本效益和隐私保护方面具有优势，但它们在规划能力上存在不足，且跨网站泛化能力有限。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了规划经验探索与利用方法。该方法能够自主探索环境以发现经验，并利用后见之明来合成高度一致的、高层次的训练数据。为了定量分析驱动这种性能提升的泛化行为，我们提出了任务分解层次分析框架，该系统能够系统地研究三个任务层次上的组合泛化能力：低层次、中等层次和高层次。我们的分析表明，掌握低层次的原子技能并不能保证高水平的规划能力，而高层次的任务训练则能提升OOD泛化能力。在真实世界的基准测试中的实验表明，PEEU方法具有更高的有效性：我们的7B模型达到了30.6%的准确率，远远超过了规模更大的Qwen2.5-VL-32B模型。这些结果表明，构建后见之明的高层次任务并利用经验对于小型MLLM模型的OOD规划能力至关重要。
