papers.title: "Excuse me, may I say something..." CoLabScience, A Proactive AI Assistant for Biomedical Discovery and LLM-Expert Collaborations
papers.title_zh: “打扰一下，我可以说几句吗……”CoLabScience——一款用于生物医学研究以及与大型语言模型专家协作的主动式AI助手
papers.authors: Yang Wu, Jinhong Yu, Jingwei Xiong, Zhimin Tao, Xiaozhong Liu
papers.abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into scientific workflows presents exciting opportunities to accelerate biomedical discovery. However, the reactive nature of LLMs, which respond only when prompted, limits their effectiveness in collaborative settings that demand foresight and autonomous engagement. In this study, we introduce CoLabScience, a proactive LLM assistant designed to enhance biomedical collaboration between AI systems and human experts through timely, context-aware interventions. At the core of our method is PULI (Positive-Unlabeled Learning-to-Intervene), a novel framework trained with a reinforcement learning objective to determine when and how to intervene in streaming scientific discussions, by leveraging the team’s project proposal and long- and short-term conversational memory. To support this work, we introduce BSDD (Biomedical Streaming Dialogue Dataset), a new benchmark of simulated research discussion dialogues with intervention points derived from PubMed articles. Experimental results show that PULI significantly outperforms existing baselines in both intervention precision and collaborative task utility, highlighting the potential of proactive LLMs as intelligent scientific assistants.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）融入科学工作流程为加速生物医学研究带来了巨大机遇。然而，LLM的响应式特性决定了它们只有在被提示时才会采取行动，这限制了它们在需要预见性和自主参与的协作环境中的有效性。在这项研究中，我们提出了CoLabScience这一主动式LLM助手，旨在通过及时且基于上下文的干预措施，提升人工智能系统与人类专家之间的合作效率。我们的核心方法是PULI——一种新颖的框架，通过强化学习目标来指导何时以及如何干预流媒体科学讨论，同时利用团队的项目提案以及长期和短期的对话记忆来实现这一目标。为了支持这项研究，我们还开发了BSDD——一个针对模拟研究讨论对话的新基准数据集，其中的干预点来源于PubMed文章。实验结果表明，PULI在干预精度和协作任务效用方面均优于现有的基线方法，这充分证明了主动式LLM作为智能科学助手的巨大潜力。

papers.title: Knowledge-driven Augmentation and Retrieval for Integrative Temporal Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 基于知识的增强与检索技术，用于综合性时间适应策略
papers.authors: Weisi Liu, Guangzeng Han, Xiaolei Huang
papers.abstract: Time introduces fundamental challenges in model development and deployment: models are usually trained on historical data while deployed on future data where semantic distributions and domain knowledge may evolve. Unfortunately, existing studies either overlook temporal shifts or hardly capture rich shifting patterns of both semantic and knowledge. We develop Knowledge-driven Augmentation and Retrieval for Integrative Temporal Adaptation (KARITA) to capture diverse temporal shifts (e.g., uncertainty and feature shift), construct and integrate rich knowledge sources (e.g., medical ontology like MeSH), and leverage shifting insights for selecting-retrieval augmented learning. We evaluate KARITA on classification tasks across multiple domains, clinical, legal, and scientific corpora, demonstrating consistent improvements across all domain with temporal adaptation. Our results show that knowledge integration can be more critical and effective in temporal augmentation and learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间带来了模型开发和部署中的基本挑战：模型通常是在历史数据上进行训练的，而在实际部署时则需要在未来数据上进行操作，而语义分布和领域知识可能会发生变化。不幸的是，现有的研究要么忽视了时间上的变化，要么难以捕捉语义和知识方面的复杂变化模式。我们提出了一种基于知识的增强与检索方法，用于综合性时间适应（KARITA），以捕捉各种时间上的变化（例如不确定性和特征变化），构建并整合丰富的知识来源（例如医学本体如MeSH），并利用这些变化来选择合适的检索策略进行增强学习。我们在多个领域的分类任务上评估了KARITA的效果，包括临床、法律和科学领域的数据集，结果显示，无论处于何种领域，时间适应都能带来持续的改进。我们的研究结果表明，在时间上的增强和学习过程中，知识的整合更为重要且有效。

papers.title: SAD: A Large-Scale Strategic Argumentative Dialogue Dataset
papers.title_zh: SAD：一个大规模的战略性辩论对话数据集
papers.authors: YongKang Liu, Jiayang Yu, Mingyang Wang, Yiqun Zhang, Ercong Nie, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Kaisong Song, Hinrich Schuetze
papers.abstract: Argumentation generation has attracted substantial research interest due to its central role in human reasoning and decision-making. However, most existing argumentative corpora focus on non-interactive, single-turn settings, either generating arguments from a given topic or refuting an existing argument. In practice, however, argumentation is often realized as multi-turn dialogue, where speakers defend their stances and employ diverse argumentative strategies to strengthen persuasiveness. To support deeper modeling of argumentation dialogue, we present the first large-scale Strategic Argumentative Dialogue dataset, SAD, consisting of 392,822 examples. Grounded in argumentation theories, we annotate each utterance with five strategy types, allowing multiple strategies per utterance. Unlike prior datasets, SAD requires models to generate contextually appropriate arguments conditioned on the dialogue history, a specified stance on the topic, and targeted argumentation strategies. We further benchmark a range of pretrained generative models on SAD and present in-depth analysis of strategy usage patterns in argumentation.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于论证在人类推理和决策中起着核心作用，因此生成论证成为了一个备受关注的研究领域。然而，目前大多数现有的论证语料库都集中在非交互式的单轮对话场景上，这些语料库要么从给定的主题出发生成论点，要么反驳已有的论点。但实际上，论证往往是以多轮对话的形式进行的，对话双方会为自己的立场辩护，并运用各种论证策略来增强说服力。为了更深入地建模这种论证对话，我们提出了第一个大规模的战略性论证对话数据集SAD，该数据集包含392,822个示例。基于论证理论，我们对每个发言进行了标注，并定义了五种策略类型，使得每个发言都可以使用多种策略。与以往的数据集不同，SAD要求模型根据对话历史、对主题的特定立场以及目标论证策略来生成合适的论点。我们还对一系列预训练的生成模型在SAD上的表现进行了基准测试，并对论证中策略使用模式进行了深入分析。

papers.title: PICTURE: Enhancing Theory-of-Mind in Large Language Models by Revealing, Not Hiding, Characters’ Lack of Knowledge
papers.title_zh: 图片：通过揭示而非隐藏角色的无知特性，来提升大型语言模型的思维能力
papers.authors: Eojin Jeon, SangKeun Lee
papers.abstract: Simulating human-like Theory of Mind (ToM) has been a longstanding problem in natural language processing (NLP). To address this, existing works introduce a reasoning step of event hiding (a.k.a. perspective-taking), where events unknown to a character are removed before question answering. However, resorting to event hiding for ToM reasoning presents a performance degradation issue due to the strict output format constraints involved in event hiding. To mitigate this issue, we propose generating perspective-taking outputs as free-form explanations without event hiding, but this poses a notable yet underexplored challenge: LLMs need to inhibit responses to events unknown to characters, because the absence of event hiding exposes LLMs to these events throughout reasoning. To address this challenge, we hypothesize and empirically verify that LLMs can achieve such inhibition if a character’s lack of knowledge about events is made explicit during reasoning. Based on this finding, we introduce PICTURE, a new prompting method that enables LLMs to generate a character’s lack of knowledge within free-form Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Experimental results show that PICTURE outperforms existing prompting methods by an average of 7.3% on false-belief tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 模拟类似人类的心理理论（Theory of Mind，ToM）一直是自然语言处理领域的一个长期难题。为了解决这个问题，现有的方法引入了事件隐藏的推理步骤——即角色无法感知到的事件在回答问题时被忽略。然而，由于事件隐藏过程中存在严格的输出格式限制，这种方法会导致性能下降。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种无需事件隐藏即可生成视角转换输出的方法。但这一方法也带来了新的挑战：大语言模型需要抑制对角色未知事件的回应，因为缺乏事件隐藏会导致大语言模型在推理过程中接触到这些事件。针对这一挑战，我们假设并验证了：如果在推理过程中明确说明角色对事件的无知，那么大语言模型就能实现这种抑制作用。基于这一发现，我们提出了PICTURE这一新的提示方法，它能使大语言模型在自由形式的思维链中表达出角色对事件的无知。实验结果表明，PICTURE在虚假信念任务上的表现平均优于现有提示方法7.3%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Union-of-Experts: Neurons in Mixture-of-Experts are Secretly Routers
papers.title_zh: 专家联合模型：混合专家系统中的神经元实际上扮演着路由器的角色
papers.authors: Songhao Wu, Ang Lv, Ruobing Xie, Samm Sun, Di Wang, Rui Yan, Yankai Lin
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models rely on an external router to assign tokens to experts. This design inherently separates the routing decision from each expert’s internal capabilities, leading to suboptimal performance. In this work, we address this limitation with Union-of-Experts (UoE), an MoE variant that performs "expert-autonomous routing”. The core mechanism of UoE is to pre-designate a minute fraction of neurons within each expert as "routing neurons”. Experts autonomously select relevant tokens by comparing the activation intensity of these neurons, aligning routing decisions with each expert’s functional profile. To prevent the waste of activations from unselected experts’ routing neurons, we aggregate all routing neuron outputs and sum them into the final layer output. This aggregation acts as a novel virtual shared expert whose parameters are distributed across the individual experts, and improves overall parameter efficiency. We pre-train UoE models with up to 3B parameters, demonstrating that they outperform traditional MoEs with matched efficiency. Furthermore, our analysis of the routing neurons provides valuable insights into expert-autonomous selection and the broader routing mechanisms of MoE models.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合模型（Mixture-of-Experts，MoE）依赖外部路由器来为专家分配代币。这种设计本质上将路由决策与每个专家的内部能力分离开来，从而导致性能不佳。在这项研究中，我们采用了专家联合模型（Union-of-Experts，UoE）来解决这个问题，这是一种能够实现“专家自主路由”的MoE变体。UoE的核心机制是预先指定每个专家中的一小部分神经元作为“路由神经元”。专家们通过比较这些神经元的激活强度来自主选择相关的代币，从而使路由决策与每个专家的功能特征保持一致。为了防止未被选中的专家的路由神经元浪费激活信号，我们将所有路由神经元的输出汇总到最终层的输出中。这种汇总方式相当于一个虚拟的共享专家，其参数分布在各个专家之间，从而提高了整体参数的利用效率。我们对UoE模型进行了预训练，其参数数量可达30亿个，结果表明，UoE模型的性能优于传统的MoE模型，且效率相当。此外，我们对路由神经元的分析为我们提供了关于专家自主选择以及MoE模型中的路由机制的宝贵见解。

papers.title: ReflectRM: Boosting Generative Reward Models via Self-Reflection within a Unified Judgment Framework
papers.title_zh: ReflectRM：通过在统一判断框架内的自我反思来提升生成式奖励模型的效果
papers.authors: Kai Qin, Liangxin Liu, Yu Liang, Longzheng Wang, Wangyan, Zhang Yueyang, Long Xia, Zhiyuan Sun, Houde Liu, Daiting Shi
papers.abstract: Reward Models (RMs) are critical components in the Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pipeline, directly determining the alignment quality of Large Language Models (LLMs). Recently, Generative Reward Models (GRMs) have emerged as a superior paradigm, offering higher interpretability and stronger generalization than traditional scalar RMs. However, existing methods for GRMs focus primarily on outcome-level supervision, neglecting analytical process quality, which constrains their potential. To address this, we propose ReflectRM, a novel GRM that leverages self-reflection to assess analytical quality and enhance preference modeling. ReflectRM is trained under a unified generative framework for joint modeling of response preference and analysis preference. During inference, we use its self-reflection capability to identify the most reliable analysis, from which the final preference prediction is derived. Experiments across four benchmarks show that ReflectRM consistently improves performance, achieving an average accuracy gain of +3.7 on Qwen3-4B. Further experiments confirm that response preference and analysis preference are mutually reinforcing. Notably, ReflectRM substantially mitigates positional bias, yielding +10.2 improvement compared with leading GRMs and establishing itself as a more stable evaluator. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuliangCarmelo/ReflectRM.
papers.abstract_zh: 奖励模型是来自人类反馈的强化学习流程中的关键组成部分，它直接决定了大语言模型的对齐质量。最近，生成式奖励模型作为一种更优的模型范式出现，其可解释性更高，泛化能力也更强，优于传统的标量奖励模型。然而，现有的生成式奖励模型方法主要侧重于结果层面的监督，而忽略了分析过程的质量，这限制了它们的潜力。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了ReflectRM这一新型奖励模型。该模型利用自我反思来评估分析质量，并增强偏好建模能力。ReflectRM在统一的生成框架下进行训练，能够同时建模响应偏好和分析偏好。在推理过程中，我们利用其自我反思能力来识别最可靠的分析结果，从而得出最终的偏好预测。在四个基准测试中的实验表明，ReflectRM始终能提升性能，在Qwen3-4B任务上的平均准确率提升了+3.7。进一步的实验证实，响应偏好和分析偏好是相互补充的。值得注意的是，ReflectRM显著减少了位置偏差，相比主流的生成式奖励模型，其效果提升了+10.2，并且成为了一个更为稳定的评估工具。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/yuliangCarmelo/ReflectRM下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SQL-Trail: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning with Interleaved Feedback for Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: SQL-Trail：基于交错反馈的多轮强化学习技术，用于文本转SQL任务
papers.authors: Harper Hua, Zhen Han, Zhengyuan Shen, Meng-Chieh Lee, Sheng Guan, Qi Zhu, Sullam Jeoung, Yueyan Chen, Yunfei Bai, Shuai Wang, Vassilis N. Ioannidis, Huzefa Rangwala
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved Text-to-SQL generation, a pronounced gap remains between AI systems and human experts on challenging benchmarks such as BIRD-SQL. We argue this gap stems largely from the prevailing single-pass paradigm, which lacks the iterative reasoning, schema exploration, and error-correction behaviors that humans naturally employ. To address this limitation, we introduce SQL-Trail, a multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) agentic framework for Text-to-SQL. Rather than producing a query in one shot, SQL-Trail interacts with the database environment and uses execution feedback to iteratively refine its predictions. Our approach centers on two key ideas: (i) an adaptive turn-budget allocation mechanism that scales the agent’s interaction depth to match question difficulty, and (ii) a composite reward panel that jointly incentivizes SQL correctness and efficient exploration. Across benchmarks, SQL-Trail sets a new state of the art and delivers strong data efficiency—up to 18× higher than prior single-pass RL state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our 7B and 14B models outperform substantially larger proprietary systems by 5% on average, underscoring the effectiveness of interactive, agentic workflows for robust Text-to-SQL generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在文本转SQL生成方面取得了显著进步，但在诸如BIRD-SQL这样的复杂基准测试中，人工智能系统与人类专家之间仍然存在明显差距。我们认为，这种差距主要源于目前普遍采用的单遍范式，该范式缺乏人类自然使用的迭代推理、模式探索以及错误修正能力。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了SQL-Trail这一多轮强化学习框架，用于文本转SQL任务。与一次性生成查询不同，SQL-Trail会与数据库环境进行交互，并利用执行反馈来逐步优化其预测结果。我们的方法基于两个关键理念：(i) 一种自适应轮次分配机制，能够根据问题的难度调整智能体的交互深度；(ii) 一个综合奖励机制，既能激励SQL语句的正确性，又能促进高效的探索行为。在多个基准测试中，SQL-Trail取得了领先的成绩，其数据效率高达现有单遍强化学习方法水平的18倍。值得注意的是，我们的7B和14B模型的平均性能比那些规模更大的专有系统高出5%，这充分证明了交互式、以智能体为中心的工作流程在提高文本转SQL生成效率方面的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Bootstrapping Code Translation with Weighted Multilanguage Exploration
papers.title_zh: 利用加权多语言探索技术进行自驱动的代码翻译
papers.authors: Yuhan Wu, Huan Zhang, Wei Cheng, Chen Shen, Jingyue Yang, Wei Hu
papers.abstract: Code translation across multiple programming languages is essential yet challenging due to two vital obstacles: scarcity of parallel data paired with executable test oracles, and optimization imbalance when handling diverse language pairs. We propose BootTrans, a bootstrapping method that resolves both obstacles. Its key idea is to leverage the functional invariance and cross-lingual portability of test suites, adapting abundant pivot-language unit tests to serve as universal verification oracles for multilingual reinforcement learning (RL) training. Our method introduces a dual-pool architecture with seed and exploration pools to progressively expand training data via execution-guided experience collection.Furthermore, we design a language-aware weighting mechanism that dynamically prioritizes harder translation directions based on relative performance across sibling languages, mitigating optimization imbalance. Extensive experiments on the HumanEval-X and TransCoder-Test benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements over baseline LLMs across all translation directions, with ablation studies validating the effectiveness of both bootstrapping and weighting components.
papers.abstract_zh: 在多种编程语言之间进行代码翻译是一项既重要又具有挑战性的任务，因为存在两个主要障碍：并行数据的稀缺性以及可执行的测试预言器不足，此外在处理不同语言对时还存在优化不平衡的问题。我们提出了BootTrans这一引导式方法，它能够解决上述两个问题。该方法的核心思想是利用测试套件的函数不变性和跨语言可移植性，将大量以特定语言编写的单元测试转化为通用验证预言器，从而用于多语言强化学习训练。我们的方法采用了双池架构，分别设有种子池和探索池，通过执行导向的经验收集来逐步扩展训练数据。此外，我们还设计了一种语言感知的权重机制，该机制能够根据不同语言之间的相对性能动态优先处理难度较大的翻译方向，从而缓解优化不平衡问题。在HumanEval-X和TransCoder-Test基准测试上的广泛实验表明，与基线LLM相比，我们的方法在所有翻译方向上都取得了显著的改进。通过消融研究进一步验证了引导式和权重机制的有效性。

papers.title: Flow-Based Page Unique Semantic Mapping Architecture for Document Visual Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 基于流的页面唯一语义映射架构，适用于文档式视觉问答系统
papers.authors: Haosen Wang, Jing Xiao, Chaochao Du, Xiaowang Zhang, Zhiyong Feng
papers.abstract: Document Visual Question Answering (DocVQA) aims to generate answers by jointly understanding the textual, layout, and visual elements within document images. Although end-to-end vision-based generative methods have reduced dependency on OCR, they still struggle to achieve precise evidence localization when page semantics are complex and highly similar. However, existing research lacks an in-depth theoretical analysis of the question-driven semantic representation space, failing to fundamentally address the distinguishability problem among semantically similar pages. To fill this theoretical gap, we propose and prove that, given a specific question, each page possesses a unique semantic representation, and there exists a bijective mapping between the page and its unique semantics. Based on this theoretical foundation, we introduce the Flow-Based Page Unique Semantic Mapping Architecture (FUMA), which reconstructs evidence localization from similarity-based retrieval into precise selection on unique semantics. FUMA employs fine-grained cross-modal attention to extract discriminative cues and utilizes flow-based reversible transformations with likelihood regularization to learn bijective mappings, ensuring that each page obtains a unique semantic representation. Moreover, a multi-expert collaboration mechanism complementarily models fine-grained multimodal information within each page, achieving robust answer generation. Experimental results demonstrate that FUMA significantly outperforms existing methods in both evidence localization and answer generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 文档视觉问答（DocVQA）旨在通过综合理解文档图像中的文本、布局和视觉元素来生成答案。虽然基于端到端视觉的生成方法减少了对OCR的依赖，但在页面语义复杂且高度相似的情况下，它们仍然难以实现精确的证据定位。然而，现有研究缺乏对问题驱动语义表示空间的深入理论分析，未能从根本上解决语义相似页面之间的区分性问题。为了填补这一理论空白，我们提出并证明了：给定一个具体的問題，每页都拥有独特的语义表示，并且页面与其独特语义之间存在一一对应的关系。基于这一理论基础，我们提出了基于流派的页面唯一语义映射架构（FUMA），该架构通过将基于相似性的检索转化为对唯一语义的精确选择来实现证据定位。FUMA采用细粒度的跨模态注意力机制提取具有区分性的线索，并利用基于流的可逆变换和似然正则化来学习一一对应的映射，确保每页都能获得唯一的语义表示。此外，多专家协作机制还补充了每页内细粒度的多模态信息建模，从而实现稳健的答案生成。实验结果表明，FUMA在证据定位和答案生成方面均显著优于现有方法。

papers.title: Pub-LawBench: Public-Oriented Benchmarking for LegalAI
papers.title_zh: Pub-LawBench：面向公众的法律人工智能基准测试
papers.authors: Qiaoyu Zheng, Zehan Ma, Yijing Zhang, Qiqi Wang, Huijia Li, Qian Liu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are playing an increasingly pivotal role in LegalAI. However, existing benchmarks are primarily tailored for legal professionals, emphasizing deep reasoning and explainability. While public-facing legal applications demand outputs that are direct, actionable, and accessible, a need largely overlooked by current evaluation frameworks. To bridge this gap, we propose a public-oriented LegalAI benchmark grounded in legal functionalism and genre analysis. Specifically, we categorize public legal demands into two core tasks: Instant Question Answering and Legal Text Generation. We further introduce three public-oriented evaluation dimensions: legal normativity, content relevance, and format usability, which collectively assess the practical validity and user readiness of model outputs. To reflect real-world lay user usage, we evaluate 17 LLMs on Pub-LawBench using only simple prompts and Chain-of-Thought under a vanilla inference setting, excluding complex techniques like RAG or agent-based methods inaccessible to non-experts. Experiments reveal limitations of current LLMs in delivering effective public-oriented legal assistance, highlighting the need for more user-centric model development and benchmarking. Our code and datasets are available for review at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/P-LawBench-E565/.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在LegalAI领域发挥着越来越重要的作用。然而，现有的评估基准大多是为法律专业人士量身定制的，注重深度推理和可解释性。虽然面向公众的法律应用需要直接、可操作且易于理解的输出结果，但这一需求在当前评估框架中往往被忽视。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个以法律功能主义和体裁分析为基础的公共导向型LegalAI评估基准。具体来说，我们将公众的法律需求分为两个核心任务：即时问答和法律文本生成。我们还引入了三个公共导向型的评估维度：法律规范性、内容相关性和格式可用性，这些维度共同评估模型输出的实际有效性和用户接受度。为了反映现实世界中普通用户的使用情况，我们在Pub-LawBench平台上仅使用简单的提示和思维链对17个大语言模型进行了评估，评估环境为简单推理模式，排除了RAG或基于代理等复杂技术，因为这些技术对非专家来说是不可用的。实验结果表明，当前的大语言模型在提供有效的公共导向型法律支持方面存在局限性，这凸显了需要更加以用户为中心的开发方法和评估标准。我们的代码和数据集可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/P-LawBench-E565/查看。

papers.title: SWAN: Semantic Watermarking with Abstract Meaning Representation
papers.title_zh: SWAN：基于抽象意义表示的语义水印技术
papers.authors: Ziping Ye, Gourab Dey, Christos Christodoulopoulos, Charith Peris, Anil Ramakrishna, Weitong Ruan, Aram Galstyan, Kai-Wei Chang, Rahul Gupta, Ninareh Mehrabi
papers.abstract: We introduce SWAN (Semantic Watermarking with Abstract Meaning Representation), a novel framework that embeds watermark signatures into the semantic structure of a sentence using Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR). In contrast to existing watermarking methods, which typically encode signatures by adjusting token selection preferences during text generation, SWAN embeds the signature directly in the sentence’s semantic representation. As the signature is encoded at the semantic structure level, any paraphrase that preserves meaning, automatically preserves the signature. SWAN is training-free: watermark injection is achieved by prompting an LLM to generate sentences guided by a selected AMR template while maintaining contextual coherence, and detection uses an off-the-shelf AMR parser followed by a simple one-proportion z-test. Empirical evaluation on the RealNews benchmark shows SWAN matches state-of-the-art detection performance on unaltered watermarked text, while significantly improving robustness against paraphrasing, increasing detection AUC by up to 13.9 percentage points compared to prior methods. These results demonstrate that SWAN’s approach of anchoring watermarks in AMR semantic structures provides a simple, effective, and prompt-based method for robust text provenance verification under paraphrasing, opening new avenues for semantic-level watermarking research.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了SWAN（基于抽象意义表示的语义水印技术），这是一种新的框架。该框架通过将水印签名嵌入到句子的语义结构中来实现水印的添加。与现有的水印处理方法不同，现有方法通常通过在文本生成过程中调整标记选择偏好来编码签名，而SWAN则直接将签名嵌入到句子的语义表示中。由于签名是在语义结构层面进行编码的，因此任何能够保留意义的释义都会自动保留水印信息。SWAN无需进行训练：水印的注入是通过引导LLM根据选定的抽象意义表示模板生成句子来实现的，同时保持上下文的连贯性。而检测则使用现成的抽象意义表示解析器，再结合简单的比例z检验来进行。在RealNews基准测试上的实证评估表明，SWAN在保持水印文本不变的情况下，其检测性能与最先进的方法相当；同时，它显著提高了对释义的鲁棒性，使得检测准确率比以往的方法提高了13.9个百分点。这些结果表明，将水印嵌入到抽象意义表示中的方法是一种简单、有效且基于提示的鲁棒文本来源验证方式，为语义层面的水印研究开辟了新的途径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Turning Failures into Value: Negative Experience Replay for RLVR via Confidence Gating and Boundary Failure Sampling
papers.title_zh: 将失败转化为价值：通过置信度门控和边界失败采样技术，利用负面体验回放来实现RLVR的目标
papers.authors: Jialiang Guo, Fucheng Xiong, Xu He, Haodong Zhao, Xingyang li, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the standard paradigm for enhancing reasoning capabilities in Large Language Models, yet on-policy algorithms like GRPO suffer from sample inefficiency. Current experience replay methods for RLVR typically replay correct trajectories to consolidate learned reasoning patterns and accelerate convergence, but overlook the vast failure space. This work investigates how to effectively replay failure trajectories. We find that the high heterogeneity of failures renders random replay ineffective, and that high-value negatives should be both gradient-efficient and structurally proximal to correct solutions. To this end, we propose NexGRPO, which employs mid-confidence gating to filter invalid noise and saturated errors, and utilizes boundary failure sampling to retrieve boundary errors semantically similar to correct solutions for targeted refinement. Extensive experiments on mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that NexGRPO outperforms strong baaselines and achieves improved out-of-distribution generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的标准方法。然而，像GRPO这样的策略内算法存在样本效率低下的问题。目前，RLVR的经验回放方法通常只回放正确的轨迹来巩固已学习的推理模式并加速收敛过程，但却忽略了大量的失败情况。本研究探讨了如何有效回放失败轨迹。我们发现，失败情况的高度异质性使得随机回放无效，而高价值的负面反馈应该既具有梯度优化效率，又与正确解在结构上相近。为此，我们提出了NexGRPO算法。该算法采用中等置信度过滤机制来剔除无效的噪声和饱和错误，并利用边界失败采样技术来提取与正确解语义相似的边界错误，以便进行有针对性的改进。在数学和通用推理方面的广泛实验表明，NexGRPO的性能优于传统的基准算法，并且其跨分布泛化能力也得到了提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LazyEviction: Lagged KV Eviction with Attention Pattern Observation for Efficient Long Reasoning
papers.title_zh: LazyEviction：基于注意力模式的延迟KV推理方法，以实现高效的长期推理
papers.authors: Haoyue Zhang, Hualei Zhang, Xiaosong Ma, Jie Zhang, Song Guo
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit enhanced capabilities by Chain-of-Thought reasoning. However, the extended reasoning sequences introduce significant GPU memory overhead due to increased key-value (KV) cache. Existing KV cache compression methods mitigate memory bottlenecks but struggle in long reasoning tasks. In this paper, we analyze attention patterns in reasoning tasks and reveal a Token Importance Recurrence phenomenon: a large proportion of tokens regain high attention after multiple decoding steps, which is failed to capture by existing works and may lead to unpredictable eviction on such periodically critical tokens. To address this, we propose LazyEviction, an observation window-based lagged eviction framework retaining latent recurring tokens by prioritized eviction based on tokens’ recurrence patterns. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LazyEviction reduces KV cache by 50% 70% while maintaining comparable accuracy, outperforming existing KV cache baselines. Our implementation code can be found at https://github.com/Halo-949/LazyEviction.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过思维链推理技术展现出更强的能力。然而，这种复杂的推理过程会导致GPU内存负担显著增加，因为需要存储更多的键值对。现有的KV缓存压缩方法能够缓解内存瓶颈问题，但在长时间的推理任务中表现不佳。在本文中，我们分析了推理过程中的注意力模式，并发现了一种“令牌重要性复发现象”：大量令牌在多次解码后仍然保持高关注度，这一现象未被现有研究所捕捉到，可能会导致对这些周期性关键令牌的不可预测性驱逐。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了LazyEviction算法——一种基于观察窗口的延迟驱逐框架，通过根据令牌的复发模式进行优先驱逐，从而保留那些反复出现的令牌。大量的实验表明，LazyEviction能够将KV缓存占用量减少50%至70%，同时仍能保持与现有KV缓存基准算法相当的准确性。我们的实现代码可以在https://github.com/Halo-949/LazyEviction找到。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Diversity in Unity, Theory in Practice: Hierarchical Multitask Benchmarks for Chinese Minority Languages
papers.title_zh: 在统一中追求多样性，在实践中运用理论：针对中文少数语言的层次化多任务测试
papers.authors: Yijie Li, Xi Cao, Yuan Sun, Quulgan Minggad, Abdulla Ablikim, Jia Qing Cai Wang
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid advancement of LLMs, their performance on linguistically and culturally diverse minority languages within a unified national context remains underexplored. We present CMiLBench, a collection of hierarchical multitask benchmarks designed to translate theoretical notions of “diversity in unity” into practical evaluation for three representative Chinese minority languages: Tibetan, Mongolian, and Uyghur. CMiLBench comprises 24,663 instances across 5 difficulty levels and 17 tasks spanning foundational ability, cultural specificity, and safety alignment. We adopt existing dataset adaptation, minority knowledge construction, and high-resource benchmark translation to construct CMiLBench. We assess 14 state-of-the-art commercial and open-source LLMs with a hybrid framework that integrates automatic metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge scoring. The comparative experimental results reveal the gap between theoretical capability and practical utility. CMiLBench serves as a foundational and scalable evaluation resource to bridge the digital language divide and promote the informatization and intelligentization of low-resource Chinese minority languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型取得了快速进展，但其在统一国家背景下对语言和文化多样性丰富的少数民族语言的性能表现仍未被充分研究。我们开发了CMiLBench，这是一个分层多任务评估集，旨在将“在统一中体现多样性”的理论概念转化为对三种具有代表性的中国少数民族语言的实用评估：藏语、蒙古语和维吾尔语。CMiLBench包含24,663个实例，涵盖5个难度级别和17项任务，涉及基础能力、文化特异性以及安全对齐等方面。我们通过采用现有的数据集适配方法、构建少数民族知识库以及高资源量的评估框架来构建CMiLBench。我们使用一个混合框架来评估14种先进的商业和开源大语言模型，该框架结合了自动评估指标和基于大语言模型的评分机制。比较实验结果表明，理论能力与实际效用之间存在差距。CMiLBench作为一种基础且可扩展的评估工具，有助于缩小数字语言鸿沟，促进低资源中国少数民族语言的信息化与智能化发展。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LangSAE Editing: Improving Multilingual Information Retrieval via Post-hoc Language Identity Removal
papers.title_zh: LangSAE编辑：通过后期语言特征去除技术提升多语言信息检索能力
papers.authors: Dongjun Kim, Jeongho Yoon, Chanjun Park, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Dense retrieval in multilingual settings often searches over mixed-language collections, yet multilingual embeddings encode language identity alongside semantics. This language signal can inflate similarity for same-language pairs and crowd out relevant evidence written in other languages. We propose LANGSAE EDITING, a post-hoc sparse autoencoder trained on pooled embeddings that enables controllable removal of language-identity signal directly in vector space. The method identifies language-associated latent units using cross-language activation statistics, suppresses these units at inference time, and reconstructs embeddings in the original dimensionality, making it compatible with existing vector databases without retraining the base encoder or re-encoding raw text. Experiments across multiple languages show consistent improvements in ranking quality and cross-language coverage, with especially strong gains for script-distinct languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 在多语言环境中进行密集检索时，通常会处理混合语言的文本集。然而，多语言嵌入方式能够同时编码语言特征与语义信息。这种语言信号可能会导致相同语言之间的相似度被高估，而用其他语言写成的相关内容则可能被忽略。我们提出了LANGSAE EDITING方法：这是一种后处理的稀疏自编码器算法，它基于汇总后的嵌入数据进行训练，可以灵活地去除语言特征信号，使其直接出现在向量空间中。该方法通过跨语言激活统计来识别与语言相关的潜在单元，在推理过程中抑制这些单元的影响，并恢复原始维度的嵌入数据，从而与现有的向量数据库兼容，无需重新训练基础编码器或重新编码原始文本。在多种语言上的实验表明，该方法在排名质量和跨语言覆盖能力方面都取得了显著的提升，尤其是对于不同文字系统的语言来说，效果尤为显著。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Interpretable Traces, Unexpected Outcomes: Investigating the Disconnect in Trace-Based Knowledge Distillation
papers.title_zh: 可解释的痕迹，意想不到的结果：探究基于痕迹的知识提取中的矛盾现象
papers.authors: Siddhant Bhambri, Upasana Biswas, Subbarao Kambhampati
papers.abstract: Recent advances in reasoning-oriented Large Language Models (LLMs) have been driven by the introduction of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces, where models generate intermediate reasoning traces before producing an answer. These traces, as in DeepSeek R1, are not only used to guide model inference but also serve as supervision signals for Knowledge Distillation (KD) to improve smaller models. A prevailing but under-examined implicit assumption is that these CoT traces when emitted at inference time are both semantically correct and interpretable for the end-users. While there are reasons to believe that these intermediate tokens help improve solution accuracy, in this work, we question their validity (semantic correctness) and interpretability to the end user. To isolate the effect of trace semantics, we design experiments in the Question Answering (QA) domain using a rule-based problem decomposition method. This enables us to create Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) datasets for LLMs where - each QA problem is paired with either verifiably correct or incorrect CoT traces, while always providing the correct final solution. Trace correctness at inference time is then evaluated by checking the accuracy of every sub-step in decomposed reasoning chains. To assess end-user interpretability, we finetune LLMs with three additional types of CoT traces: R1 traces, R1 trace summaries, and post-hoc explanations of R1 traces. We further conduct a human-subject study with 100 participants asking them to rate the interpretability of each trace type on a standardized Likert scale. Our experiments reveal two key findings - (1) CoT trace correctness is not reliably correlated with the model’s generation of correct final answers: correct traces led to correct solutions only for 28% test-set problems while incorrect traces don’t necessarily degrade solution accuracy. (2) In end-user interpretability studies, fine-tuning on verbose R1 traces produced the best model performance but these traces were rated as least interpretable by users, scoring on average 3.39 for interpretability and 4.59 for cognitive load metrics on a 5-point Likert scale. In contrast, the decomposed traces that are judged significantly more interpretable don’t lead to comparable solution accuracy. Together, these findings challenge the assumption in question suggesting that researchers and practitioners should decouple model supervision objectives from end-user-facing trace design.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在基于推理的大语言模型（LLM）领域取得的进展，得益于思维链（CoT）痕迹的引入。这些痕迹在模型生成答案之前会先产生中间的推理过程。就像DeepSeek R1模型所使用的痕迹一样，它们不仅用于指导模型的推理过程，还作为知识蒸馏（KD）的 Supervision信号，以改进较小的模型。一个普遍但被忽视的隐含假设是：在推理过程中产生的这些CoT痕迹在语义上是正确的，并且对最终用户来说也是可解释的。虽然我们有理由相信这些中间痕迹有助于提高解决方案的准确性，但在本研究中，我们质疑了它们的有效性（语义正确性）以及对最终用户的可解释性。为了分离痕迹语义的影响，我们在问答领域设计了实验，采用基于规则的问题分解方法。这使我们能够为LLM创建有监督的微调数据集——每个问答问题都配有可验证正确的或错误的CoT痕迹，同时始终提供正确的最终解决方案。通过检查分解后的推理链中每个子步骤的准确性，可以评估推理时刻的痕迹正确性。为了评估最终用户的可解释性，我们进一步对LLM进行了微调，加入了三种类型的CoT痕迹：R1痕迹、R1痕迹摘要以及R1痕迹的后置解释。我们还进行了一项人类主题研究，共有100名参与者被要求用标准化的Likert量表来评估每种痕迹类型的可解释性。我们的实验揭示了两个关键发现：(1) CoT痕迹的正确性并不与模型生成正确的最终答案之间存在可靠的关联：只有28%的测试集问题中的正确痕迹能导致正确的解决方案，而错误的痕迹并不一定会降低解决方案的准确性。(2)在最终用户可解释性的研究中，对详细的R1痕迹进行微调可以获得最佳的模型性能，但这些痕迹被用户认为是最不可解释的，它们在5点Likert量表上的可解释性得分平均为3.39，认知负荷指标得分平均为4.59。相比之下，那些被认为更可解释的分解痕迹并没有带来类似的解决方案准确性。总的来说，这些发现挑战了之前的假设，即研究人员和从业者应该将模型监督目标与面向最终用户的痕迹设计分开。

papers.title: SpecMind: Cognitively Inspired, Interactive Multi-Turn Framework for Postcondition Inference
papers.title_zh: SpecMind：一种基于认知驱动的、交互式的多轮推理框架，用于后状态推断任务
papers.authors: Cuong Chi Le, Minh V.T. Pham, Tung Duy Vu, Cuong Duc Van, Huy N. Phan, Hoang N. Phan, Tien N. Nguyen
papers.abstract: Specifications are vital for ensuring program correctness, yet writing them manually remains challenging and time-intensive. Recent large language model (LLM)-based methods have shown successes in generating specifications such as postconditions, but existing single-pass prompting often yields inaccurate results. In this paper, we present SpecMind, a novel framework for postcondition generation that treats LLMs as interactive and exploratory reasoners rather than one-shot generators. SpecMind employs feedback-driven multi-turn prompting approaches, enabling the model to iteratively refine candidate postconditions by incorporating implicit and explicit correctness feedback, while autonomously deciding when to stop. This process fosters deeper code comprehension and improves alignment with true program behavior via exploratory attempts. Our empirical evaluation shows that SpecMind significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both accuracy and completeness of generated postconditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 规范对于确保程序的正确性至关重要，然而手动编写规范仍然具有挑战性且耗时。最近基于大语言模型的方法在生成诸如后置条件之类的规范方面取得了成功，但现有的单遍提示方法往往会产生不准确的结果。在本文中，我们提出了SpecMind这一新颖的后置条件生成框架。该框架将大语言模型视为交互式且探索性的推理器，而非一次性生成的工具。SpecMind采用反馈驱动的多轮提示方法，使模型能够通过结合隐式和显式的正确性反馈来迭代优化候选后置条件，同时自动决定何时停止。这一过程有助于更深入地理解代码，并通过探索性尝试提高程序行为与真实行为的一致性。我们的实证评估表明，SpecMind在生成后置条件的准确性和完整性方面显著优于现有最先进的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Memorization, Emergence, and Explaining Reversal Failures: A Controlled Study of Relational Semantics in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 记忆、涌现与解释性反转失败：对大型语言模型关系语义的实证研究
papers.authors: Yihua Zhu, Qianying Liu, Jiaxin Wang, Fei Cheng, Chaoran Liu, Akiko Aizawa, Sadao Kurohashi, Hidetoshi Shimodaira
papers.abstract: Autoregressive LLMs perform well on relational tasks that require linking entities via relational words (e.g., father/son, friend), but it is unclear whether they learn the logical semantics of such relations (e.g., symmetry and inversion logic) and, if so, whether reversal-type failures arise from missing relational semantics or left-to-right order bias. We propose a controlled Knowledge Graph-based synthetic framework that generates text from symmetric/inverse triples, train GPT-style autoregressive models from scratch, and evaluate memorization, logical inference, and in-context generalization to unseen entities to address these questions. We find a sharp phase transition in which relational semantics emerge with sufficient logic-bearing supervision, even in shallow (2–3 layer) models, and that successful generalization aligns with stable intermediate-layer signals. Finally, order-matched forward/reverse tests and a diffusion baseline indicate that reversal failures are primarily driven by autoregressive order bias rather than deficient inversion semantics.
papers.abstract_zh: 自回归语言模型在需要利用关系词来连接实体的关系任务中表现良好（例如，父亲/儿子、朋友之间的关系），但尚不清楚它们是否能够理解这些关系的逻辑语义（例如，对称性和反演逻辑）。如果能够理解这些语义，那么出现的反演型错误可能是由于缺乏关系语义还是由于从左到右的排序偏差造成的。我们提出了一个基于知识图谱的受控合成框架，该框架能够从对称/反演三元组生成文本，从零开始训练自回归模型，并评估其对未见实体的记忆能力、逻辑推理能力以及情境泛化能力。我们发现，在适当的逻辑监督下，即使是在浅层模型（2-3层）中，关系语义也能清晰地显现出来。此外，成功的泛化能力与稳定的中间层信号相一致。最后，通过顺序匹配的正向/反向测试以及扩散基线分析表明，反演错误主要是由自回归排序偏差引起的，而非由于反演语义不足所致。

papers.title: Framing Political Bias in Multilingual LLMs Across Pakistani Languages
papers.title_zh: 如何在多语言大语言模型中体现政治倾向——以巴基斯坦多种语言为例
papers.authors: Afrozah Nadeem, Mark Dras, Usman Naseem
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly shape public discourse, yet most evaluations of economic and political bias have focused on high-resource Western languages and contexts. This leaves a blind spots in low-resource, multilingual regions such as Pakistan, where linguistic identity is closely tied to regional, religious, and political ideologies. We present a systematic evaluation of political bias in 13 state-of-the-art LLMs across five Pakistani languages: Urdu, Punjabi, Sindhi, Pashto, and Balochi. Our framework integrates a culturally adapted Political Compass Test (PCT) with multi-level framing analysis, capturing both ideological stance (economic/social axes) and stylistic framing (content, tone, emphasis). The prompts are aligned with 11 socio-political themes specific to the Pakistani context. The results show that while LLMs significantly reflect liberal-left orientations consistent with Western training data, they exhibit more authoritarian framing in regional languages, highlighting language-conditioned ideological modulation. We also identify model-specific bias patterns in all languages. These findings show the need for culturally grounded multilingual bias examining frameworks in NLP. Code and dataset are available.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在公共话语中发挥着越来越重要的作用，然而，大多数关于经济和政治偏见的评估都集中在资源丰富的西方语言和语境上。这就导致了一些低资源、多语言地区的偏见被忽视了，比如巴基斯坦，那里的语言身份与地区性、宗教和政治意识形态紧密相连。我们针对巴基斯坦的五种语言——乌尔都语、旁遮普语、信德语、普什图语和Balochi语，对13种先进语言模型的政治偏见进行了系统评估。我们的框架结合了文化适应性强的政治倾向测试和多层次框架分析，能够同时捕捉意识形态立场（经济/社会维度）以及风格化框架（内容、语气、重点）。提示语句与巴基斯坦特定的11个社会政治主题相契合。结果表明，虽然这些语言模型在反映自由主义左翼倾向方面与西方训练数据一致，但在地区性语言中却表现出更多的威权主义倾向，这凸显了语言对意识形态的影响。我们还发现了所有语言中模型特有的偏见模式。这些发现表明，需要在自然语言处理领域开发基于文化的多语言偏见分析框架。相关代码和数据集已提供。

papers.title: InsAT: Instance-aware Semantic Alignment and Transfer from Human–Object Keypoints for Zero-to-Few-shot Action Understanding
papers.title_zh: InsAT：基于实例感知的语义对齐技术，能够利用人类与物体关键点的信息来进行零次或少量样本下的动作理解
papers.authors: Kazuki Tsutsukawa
papers.abstract: Keypoint-based action recognition offers robustness to appearance variations and provides privacy-preserving representation. However, existing zero-shot (ZS) approaches largely emphasize human motion while underutilizing contextual information, particularly human–object interactions. Moreover, extending keypoint-based ZS models to few-shot scenarios remains insufficiently explored. We propose Instance-aware Semantic Alignment and Transfer (InsAT), a unified framework for ZS recognition and zero-to-few-shot (Z2F) adaptation that leverages instance-level language descriptions. InsAT aligns textual descriptions of humans, objects, and their interactions with visual representations derived from human and object keypoints, enabling effective transfer of interaction knowledge from seen to unseen action classes. To support Z2F adaptation, we introduce Instance-level Visual Adaptation, a parameter-free mechanism that improves recognition by incorporating instance-level contextual cues without updating model weights. Extensive experiments demonstrate that InsAT substantially outperforms prior keypoint-based ZS methods and achieves competitive performance relative to large vision–language models, while remaining data-efficient and robust.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于关键点动作识别方法能够很好地应对外观的变化，并且能够提供保护隐私的表示方式。然而，现有的零样本学习方法主要关注人类运动行为，而忽视了上下文信息的作用，尤其是人与物体的交互关系。此外，将基于关键点的零样本模型扩展到少样本场景方面，目前的研究还不够充分。我们提出了“实例感知语义对齐与迁移”框架（InsAT），这是一个统一的框架，用于零样本到少样本的动作识别与适应，该框架利用了实例级别的语言描述。InsAT将关于人类、物体及其交互的文本描述与从人和物体关键点得到的视觉表示进行对齐，从而实现将交互知识有效地转移到未见过的动作类别中。为了支持零样本适应，我们引入了“实例级视觉适应”机制，这是一种无需调整模型参数的方法，它能够通过融入实例级别的上下文线索来提升识别效果，而无需更新模型权重。大量的实验表明，InsAT在性能上显著优于现有的基于关键点的零样本方法，其表现与大型视觉-语言模型相当，同时仍然保持了高效的数据处理能力和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Multi-View Attention Multiple-Instance Learning Enhanced by LLM Reasoning for Cognitive Distortion Detection
papers.title_zh: 多视图注意力机制与多实例学习相结合，并融入大型语言模型推理能力，以更好地检测认知扭曲现象
papers.authors: Jun Seo Kim, Hyemi Kim, Woo Joo OH, Hongjin Cho, Hochul Lee, Hye Hyeon Kim
papers.abstract: Cognitive distortions have been closely linked to mental health disorders, yet their automatic detection remains challenging due to contextual ambiguity, co-occurrence, and semantic overlap. We propose a novel framework that combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with a Multiple-Instance Learning (MIL) architecture to enhance interpretability and expression-level reasoning. Each utterance is decomposed into Emotion, Logic, and Behavior (ELB) components, which are processed by LLMs to infer multiple distortion instances, each with a predicted type, expression, and model-assigned salience score. These instances are integrated via a Multi-View Gated Attention mechanism for final classification. Experiments on Korean (KoACD) and English (Therapist QA) datasets demonstrate that incorporating ELB and LLM-inferred salience scores improves classification performance, especially for distortions with high interpretive ambiguity. Our results suggest a psychologically grounded and generalizable approach for fine-grained reasoning in mental health NLP. The dataset and implementation details are publicly accessible.
papers.abstract_zh: 认知扭曲与心理健康障碍密切相关，但由于情境的模糊性、事件的并发以及语义上的重叠，对这些扭曲进行自动检测仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架结合了大语言模型与多实例学习架构，以提高可解释性和表达级推理能力。每个话语都被分解为情感、逻辑和行为三个组成部分，然后由语言模型进行处理，以推断出多种扭曲类型，每种扭曲类型都包含预测出的类型、表达方式以及模型分配的重要性得分。这些实例通过多视图门控注意力机制进行整合，以实现最终的分类。在韩语（KoACD）和英语（治疗师问答）数据集上的实验表明，结合情感分析结果与语言模型推断出的重要性得分能够提升分类性能，尤其是在那些具有高度解释模糊性的扭曲情况下。我们的研究结果提供了一种基于心理学的、具有普遍适用性的方法来处理心理健康领域中的细粒度推理问题。该数据集及其实现细节均可公开获取。

papers.title: CHAIRO: Contextual Hierarchical Analogical Induction and Reasoning Optimization for LLMs
papers.title_zh: CHAIRO：基于上下文的层次化类比推理优化方法，适用于大型语言模型
papers.authors: Haotian Lu, Yuchen Mou, Bingzhe Wu
papers.abstract: Warning: This paper may contain content that could be disturbing or offensive. Content moderation in online platforms faces persistent challenges due to the evolving complexity of user-generated content and the limitations of traditional rule-based and machine learning approaches. While recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled more sophisticated moderation via direct prompting or fine-tuning, these approaches often exhibit limited generalization, interpretability, and adaptability to unseen or ambiguous cases.In this work, we propose a novel moderation framework that leverages analogical examples to enhance rule induction and decision reliability. Our approach integrates end-to-end optimization of analogical retrieval, rule generation, and moderation classification, enabling the dynamic adaptation of moderation rules to diverse content scenarios. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms both rule-injected fine-tuning baselines and multi-stage static RAG pipelines in terms of moderation accuracy and rule quality. Further evaluations—including human assessments and external model generalization tests confirm the superiority of rules generated by our framework in terms of clarity, interpretability, and applicability. These findings highlight the potential of analogical example-driven methods for advancing robust, explainable, and generalizable content moderation in real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 警告：本文可能包含令人不适或冒犯的内容。由于用户生成内容的复杂性不断增加，以及传统基于规则的方法和机器学习方法的局限性，在线平台的内容审核面临着持续的挑战。尽管大语言模型在最近取得了进展，使得通过直接提示或微调来实现更复杂的审核成为可能，但这些方法往往存在泛化能力有限、可解释性不足以及对未见或模糊情况适应能力较差的问题。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的审核框架，该框架利用类比示例来增强规则归纳和决策可靠性。我们的方法实现了类比检索、规则生成和审核分类的端到端优化，从而能够动态调整审核规则以适应不同的内容场景。通过全面的实验验证，我们发现我们的方法在审核准确性和规则质量方面显著优于那些采用规则注入式微调的方法以及多阶段静态RAG管道。进一步的评估——包括人类评估和外部模型泛化测试——也证实了我们的框架所生成的规则在清晰度、可解释性和适用性方面的优势。这些发现凸显了以类比示例为驱动的方法在提升现实应用中稳健、可解释且通用的内容审核方面的潜力。

papers.title: Test of Time: Rethinking Temporal Signal of Benchmark Contamination
papers.title_zh: 时间的考验：重新思考基准污染的时间信号
papers.authors: Terry Jingchen Zhang, Gopal Dev, Ning Wang, Max Obreiter, Punya Syon Pandey, Keenan Samway, Wenyuan Jiang, Yinya Huang, Bernhard Schölkopf, Mrinmaya Sachan, Zhijing Jin
papers.abstract: Post-cutoff performance decay of LLMs has been widely interpreted as a temporal signal for benchmark contamination, where public information released before the training cutoff may have been included into training corpora and inflated model performance by memorization. We critically examine this view and demonstrate that this temporal signal is highly sensitive to how benchmark questions are constructed, even if the underlying source material remains invariant. Specifically, we show that LLM-transformed questions can produce remarkably different temporal patterns compared to fill-in-the-blank (cloze) questions directly retrieved from the very same documents. We validate this effect on prior benchmarks that report clear post-cutoff decay (LiveCodeBench), and show that a simple LLM-driven transformation of the same problems can effectively remove the temporal pattern. We further provide a mechanistic understanding of this phenomenon using influence function analysis. Overall, our results suggest that post-cutoff performance decay is a sensitive contamination signal, motivating more robust contamination probes for reliable LLM evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在训练截止日期之后的性能下降，通常被解释为基准测试数据被污染的信号。这意味着在训练截止日期之前发布的公开信息可能被纳入了训练语料库，从而通过记忆效应导致模型性能提升。我们对此观点进行了批判性的分析，并证明这种时间信号对于基准测试问题的构造方式非常敏感，即使底层的数据来源保持不变。具体来说，我们发现，使用大语言模型进行问题转换后，所得到的问题与时间模式与直接从相同文档中提取的填空题在时间上有着显著的不同。我们在那些报告了明显的训练截止日期之后性能下降情况的基准测试中验证了这一效果，并表明对相同问题进行简单的语言模型转换可以有效地消除这种时间模式。我们还通过影响函数分析对这种现象进行了机制上的理解。总体而言，我们的结果表明，训练截止日期之后的性能下降是一种敏感的污染信号，这促使我们需要采用更严格的污染检测方法来确保对大语言模型的可靠评估。

papers.title: An Existence Proof for Neural Language Models That Can Explain Garden-Path Effects via Surprisal
papers.title_zh: 一种针对神经语言模型的存在性证明，该证明能够借助惊讶效应来解释“花园路径效应”现象
papers.authors: Ryo Yoshida, Shinnosuke Isono, Taiga Someya, Yohei Oseki, Tatsuki Kuribayashi
papers.abstract: Surprisal theory hypothesizes that the difficulty of human sentence processing increases linearly with surprisal, the negative log-probability of a word given its context. Computational psycholinguistics has tested this hypothesis using language models (LMs) as proxies for human prediction. While surprisal derived from recent neural LMs generally captures human processing difficulty on naturalistic corpora that predominantly consist of simple sentences, it severely underestimates processing difficulty on sentences that require syntactic disambiguation (garden-path effects). This leads to the claim that the processing difficulty of such sentences cannot be reduced to surprisal, although it remains possible that neural LMs simply differ from humans in next-word prediction. In this paper, we investigate whether it is truly impossible to construct a neural LM that can explain garden-path effects via surprisal. Specifically, instead of evaluating off-the-shelf neural LMs, we fine-tune these LMs on garden-path sentences so as to better align surprisal-based reading-time estimates with actual human reading times. Our results show that fine-tuned LMs do not overfit and successfully capture human reading slowdowns on held-out garden-path items; they even improve predictive power for human reading times on naturalistic corpora and preserve their general LM capabilities. These results provide an existence proof for a neural LM that can explain both garden-path effects and naturalistic reading times via surprisal, but also raise a theoretical question: what kind of evidence can truly falsify surprisal theory?
papers.abstract_zh: “惊讶理论”假设人类句子处理的难度与“惊讶度”呈线性增长关系，而“惊讶度”指的是在给定上下文的情况下，某个单词的负对数概率。计算心理语言学通过使用语言模型作为人类预测的替代手段来验证这一假设。虽然从最新的神经语言模型中得出的惊讶度能够捕捉到在主要由简单句子构成的自然语料库中的处理难度，但它严重低估了那些需要句法消歧的句子的处理难度（即所谓的“花园路径效应”）。这导致人们认为，这类句子的处理难度无法仅通过惊讶度来解释，尽管也有可能神经语言模型在下一个单词的预测方面与人类有所不同。在本文中，我们探讨了是否真的不可能构建一种能够通过惊讶度来解释花园路径效应的神经语言模型。具体来说，我们没有直接评估现有的神经语言模型，而是对这些模型进行了微调，以便使基于惊讶度的阅读时间估计与实际的人类阅读时间更加吻合。我们的结果显示，经过微调的语言模型不会过度拟合数据，并且能够成功捕捉到在花园路径效应出现的句子中的人类阅读速度减缓现象；它们甚至提高了对自然语料库中人类阅读时间的预测能力，同时保留了其作为通用语言模型的性能。这些结果证明了存在一种能够通过惊讶度来解释花园路径效应和自然阅读时间的神经语言模型，但同时也提出了一个理论问题：究竟有哪些证据能够真正证伪惊讶理论呢？”

papers.title: How Context Shapes Truth: Geometric Transformations of Statement-level Truth Representations in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 语境如何塑造真相：大型语言模型中对陈述级真相表示的几何变换
papers.authors: Shivam Adarsh, Maria Maistro, Christina Lioma
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often encode whether a statement is true as a vector in their residual stream activations. These vectors, also known as truth vectors, have been studied in prior work, however how they change when context is introduced remains unexplored. We study this question by measuring (1) the directional change (\theta) between the truth vectors with and without context and (2) the relative magnitude of the truth vectors upon adding context. Across four LLMs and four datasets, we find that (1) truth vectors are roughly orthogonal in early layers, converge in middle layers, and may stabilize or continue increasing in later layers; (2) adding context generally increases the truth vector magnitude, i.e., the separation between true and false representations in the activation space is amplified; (3) larger models distinguish relevant from irrelevant context mainly through directional change (\theta), while smaller models show this distinction through magnitude differences. We also find that context conflicting with parametric knowledge produces larger geometric changes than parametrically aligned context. Collectively, these findings provide a geometric characterization of how context transforms the truth vector in the activation space of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通常通过将一个陈述的真实性编码为向量来存储在它们的残差流激活中。这些向量也被称为“真值向量”，在之前的研究中已经得到了探讨，不过当上下文被引入时，这些向量的变化情况仍然未被研究清楚。我们通过以下两个指标来研究这个问题：(1) 有无上下文情况下真值向量之间的方向变化；(2) 添加上下文后真值向量的相对大小变化。通过对四个不同的LLM和四个数据集的研究，我们发现：(1) 在早期层，真值向量大致是垂直的；在中间层，它们会趋于稳定；而在后期层，它们可能会继续增加或趋于稳定；(2) 添加上下文通常会增大真值向量的大小，也就是说，激活空间中真实与虚假表示之间的差距会扩大；(3) 较大的模型主要通过方向变化来区分相关与不相关的上下文，而较小的模型则通过大小差异来区分。我们还发现，与参数知识相矛盾的上下文会导致更大的几何变化，而与参数知识一致的上下文则不会产生如此大的变化。总的来说，这些发现为我们提供了关于上下文如何改变LLM激活空间中真值向量的几何特征描述。

papers.title: Mitigating Tokenization-Induced Distance Distortion in Long-Context Multilingual Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: 减少令牌化导致的长上下文多语言机器翻译中的距离失真问题
papers.authors: Khotso Selialia, Antoine Nzeyimana, Fatima M. Anwar
papers.abstract: Multilingual neural machine translation (MNMT) models degrade in performance as input context length increases, causing positional encoding schemes to misinterpret token distances. Existing absolute and relative positional encodings rely on fixed token indices and implicitly assume uniform semantic density, which breaks down for long-context inputs. We introduce DCARPE, a tokenization-aware adaptive positional encoding that conditions relative positional bias on input-level sequence length and fragmentation statistics, allowing the model to reinterpret positional distance when tokenization-induced inflation arises rather than semantic factors. Evaluations on JW300 and out-of-distribution FLORES-200 demonstrate consistent improvements in long-context robustness, achieving gains of up to +10.81 ChrF++ and +8.00 BLEU over baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言神经机器翻译模型在输入上下文长度增加时会性能下降，这会导致位置编码机制误判词符之间的距离。现有的绝对和相对位置编码方式依赖于固定的词符索引，并隐含地假设语义密度是均匀的，但这种假设在长上下文输入情况下无法成立。我们提出了DCARPE算法，这是一种考虑词符分组的自适应位置编码方法。该算法根据输入序列的长度和碎片化统计信息来调整相对位置偏移量，从而让模型能够在词符分组引起的膨胀现象出现时重新解释位置距离，而不是仅仅依赖语义因素。在JW300数据集和超出分布范围的FLORES-200数据集上的评估表明，该方法在应对长上下文输入方面表现出显著的改进效果，相比基线模型，取得了高达+10.81 ChrF++和+8.00 BLEU的提升。

papers.title: Probing Audio-Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models through the Lens of Audio
papers.title_zh: 通过音频角度来探究多模态语言模型中的视听推理能力
papers.authors: Kaixiong Gong, Kaituo Feng, Bohao Li, Yibing Wang, Mofan Cheng, Shijia Yang, Jiaming Han, Benyou Wang, Yutong Bai, Zhuoran Yang, Xiangyu Yue
papers.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5/2.5 Pro, and Reka Core, have advanced audio-visual reasoning capabilities, achieving strong performance in tasks like cross-modal understanding and generation. However, our DeafTest uncovers unanticipated failures: most of the state-of-the-art MLLMs struggle with very simple audio tasks, such as distinguishing louder sounds or sound counting. This raises a fundamental question—does a deficiency in low-level audio perception constrain higher-level audio-visual reasoning? To address this, we introduce AV-Odyssey Bench—a comprehensive benchmark of 4,555 meticulously designed problems that integrate text, audio, and visual modalities. Each task requires models to unify cross-modal reasoning, leveraging synchronized audio-visual cues to infer solutions. By structuring questions as multiple-choice, we ensure objective, reproducible evaluations without reliance on subjective human or LLM-based judgments. Through comprehensive benchmarking of closed-source and open-source models, we showcase: (i) current MLLMs lack robust audio-visual integration ability and (ii) performance on DeafTest (Pearson’s r = 0.945) strongly correlates with AV-Odyssey accuracy. These findings challenge assumptions about models’ multimodal proficiency and highlight fundamental audio perception as a reasoning bottleneck. We believe that our results provide concrete guidance for future dataset design, alignment strategies, and architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的多模态大语言模型，如GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5/2.5 Pro以及Reka Core，已经提升了音频-视觉推理能力，在跨模态理解和生成等任务中表现优异。然而，我们的DeafTest测试发现了一个意想不到的问题：大多数最先进的MLLMs在处理非常简单的音频任务时存在困难，比如区分更响亮的声音或计数声音数量。这引发了一个基本问题——低阶音频感知能力的不足是否限制了高级的音频-视觉推理能力？为了解答这个问题，我们推出了AV-Odyssey基准测试——该测试包含4,555个精心设计的任务，这些任务整合了文本、音频和视觉信息。每个任务都要求模型实现跨模态推理，利用同步的音频-视觉线索来推断解决方案。通过将问题设计为选择题形式，我们可以确保评估的客观性和可重复性，而无需依赖主观的人类或基于大语言模型的判断。通过对闭源和开源模型的全面基准测试，我们发现：(i)当前的MLLMs缺乏强大的音频-视觉集成能力；(ii)在DeafTest上的表现（Pearson相关系数r=0.945）与AV-Odyssey的准确率有很强的相关性。这些发现挑战了关于模型多模态能力的假设，并揭示了音频感知作为推理瓶颈的重要性。我们相信，我们的研究结果将为未来数据集设计、对齐策略以及模型架构的设计提供具体的指导。

papers.title: Reasoning Hijacking: The Fragility of Reasoning Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 推理劫持：大型语言模型中推理一致性机制的脆弱性
papers.authors: Yuansen Liu, Yixuan Tang, Anthony Kum Hoe Tung
papers.abstract: Current LLM safety research predominantly focuses on mitigating **Goal Hijacking**, preventing attackers from redirecting a model’s high-level objective (e.g., from "summarizing emails" to "phishing users"). In this paper, we argue that this perspective is incomplete and highlight a critical vulnerability in **Reasoning Alignment**. We expose the inherent fragility of current alignment techniques by proposing a new adversarial prompt attack paradigm: **Reasoning Hijacking**. To demonstrate this vulnerability, we instantiate it via the **Criteria Attack**, which subverts model judgments by injecting spurious decision criteria without altering the high-level task goal. Unlike Goal Hijacking, which attempts to override the system prompt, Reasoning Hijacking keeps the task goal intact but manipulates the model’s decision-making logic by injecting spurious reasoning shortcuts. Through extensive experiments on three different tasks (toxic comment, negative review, and spam detection), we demonstrate that even state-of-the-art models are highly fragile, consistently prioritizing injected heuristic shortcuts over rigorous semantic analysis. Crucially, because the model’s explicit intent remains aligned with the user’s instructions, these attacks can bypass defenses designed to detect goal deviation (e.g., SecAlign, StruQ), revealing a fundamental blind spot in the current safety landscape. Data and code are available at [https://github.com/Yuan-Hou/criteria_attack](https://github.com/Yuan-Hou/criteria_attack).
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的大语言模型安全研究主要集中在**目标劫持**的防范上，即防止攻击者改变模型的高层次任务目标（例如，从“总结邮件”转变为“钓鱼攻击用户”）。然而，我们认为这种视角并不全面，我们指出了**推理对齐**中的一个关键漏洞。我们通过提出一种新的对抗性提示攻击方式——**推理劫持**——来揭示当前对齐技术的固有脆弱性。为了证明这一漏洞，我们通过**标准攻击**来实施这一攻击方式，该攻击方式通过注入虚假的决策标准来破坏模型的判断能力，而无需改变高层次的任务目标。与试图覆盖系统提示的目标劫持不同，推理劫持保留了任务目标不变，但通过注入虚假的推理捷径来操纵模型的决策逻辑。通过对三种不同任务的广泛实验（毒害评论、负面评价和垃圾邮件检测），我们发现即使是最先进模型也极其脆弱，它们总是优先选择注入的启发式捷径，而非严格的语义分析。重要的是，由于模型的明确意图仍然与用户的指令保持一致，这些攻击可以绕过旨在检测目标偏离的防御机制（例如SecAlign、StruQ），从而揭示了当前安全领域的一个根本盲点。相关数据代码可访问：[https://github.com/Yuan-Hou/criteria_attack](https://github.com/Yuan-Hou/criteria_attack)。

papers.title: The Dominance of Text Space: Unveiling the Asymmetric Nature of Cross-Modal Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 文本空间的主导地位：揭示大型语言模型中跨模态对齐的非对称性特征
papers.authors: Linqing Chen, Hanmeng Zhong, Wentao Wu, Peng Zhou
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have largely been driven by aligning visual encoders with pre-trained Large Language Models (LLMs). While effective, the geometric nature of this alignment remains under-explored. Existing methods often assume a symmetric interaction between visual and textual modalities, implying that both spaces adapt to each other. In this paper, we challenge this assumption and propose the “Text Space as Anchor” hypothesis. We argue that the semantic space of LLMs is rigid, anisotropic, and dominant; thus, effective cross-modal alignment may be an asymmetric projection of visual features onto this pre-existing text manifold without distorting it. We identify a potential issue in current parameter-efficient tuning paradigms where task-specific visual adjustments inadvertently disrupt the projector’s geometry, leading to “catastrophic forgetting” of the alignment mechanism itself. To address this, we introduce Anchor-Preserving Projection (APP), a novel method that regularizes the projector to maintain the geometric structure of the text embedding space via spectral filtering. Extensive experiments on 8 diverse cross-modal tasks and 3 pure language benchmarks demonstrate that APP preserves the LLM’s inherent linguistic capabilities (e.g., MMLU, GSM8K) and reduces object hallucination significantly better than standard fine-tuning methods. We release our code.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在多模态大语言模型方面的进展，主要得益于将视觉编码器与预训练的大语言模型进行对齐。虽然这种方法效果显著，但这种对齐的几何特性仍未被充分探索。现有方法通常假设视觉和文本模态之间存在对称的交互关系，即两个领域会相互适应。在本文中，我们挑战这一假设，提出了“以文本空间为锚点”的假说。我们认为，大语言模型的语义空间是刚性、各向异性的，并且具有主导性；因此，有效的跨模态对齐可以是对视觉特征的不对称投影，而无需破坏原有的文本结构。我们发现，当前的一些参数高效调优方法存在潜在问题，即特定任务的视觉调整可能会无意中破坏投影器的几何结构，从而导致对齐机制本身被“灾难性遗忘”。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了“保留锚点投影”方法，这是一种通过光谱过滤来规范投影器的方法，从而保持文本嵌入空间的几何结构。在8种不同的跨模态任务以及3个纯语言基准测试上的广泛实验表明，该方法能够保留大语言模型的固有语言能力（例如MMLU、GSM8K），并且比标准微调方法更能有效减少物体幻觉现象。我们已经发布了我们的代码。

papers.title: Towards Explainable Diagnosis: A Self-learned Explanatory Knowledge Base Approach
papers.title_zh: 迈向可解释性诊断：一种自学习解释知识库方法
papers.authors: Dongqi Huang, Tong Zhou, Zhuoran Jin, Shenghui Shi, Maoyujiao, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao, Yubo Chen
papers.abstract: Explainable diagnosis requires that authoritative medical knowledge provide the rationales linking a patient’s clinical manifestations to the diagnostic conclusion. Although large language models (LLMs) hold great potential to facilitate explainable diagnosis, their effectiveness is often constrained by insufficient diagnostic expertise. To address this limitation, we propose Self-learned Explainable Knowledge Augmented Diagnosis (SEKAD), a unified LLM-based framework for faithful and explainable diagnosis. Our approach builds a high-quality diagnostic knowledge base through a record-driven explanation learning paradigm, as well as applies this knowledge via an explanation-based diagnostic process that ensures faithful inference. Experiments on the DiReCT and JAMA benchmarks show that SEKAD consistently outperforms strong baselines across the metrics. In particular, on the DiReCT benchmark, SEKAD improves the explanation completeness metric from 64.5% to 76.9% over the best existing methods, highlighting its effectiveness in enhancing diagnostic explainability and showing that our text mining approach produces knowledge that is both reliable in quality and large in quantity.
papers.abstract_zh: 可解释的诊疗需要权威医学知识为患者的临床表现与诊断结论之间建立合理的联系。虽然大语言模型在促进可解释性诊疗方面具有巨大潜力，但其效果往往受到诊断专业知识不足的制约。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了自学习可解释知识增强诊疗方法（SEKAD），这是一种基于大语言模型的统一诊疗框架，能够实现忠实且可解释的诊疗。我们的方法通过基于记录的解释学习范式构建高质量的诊断知识库，并通过基于解释的诊断流程应用这些知识，从而确保推理的忠实性。在DiReCT和JAMA基准测试中的实验表明，SEKAD在各项指标上始终优于强大的基线方法。特别是在DiReCT基准测试中，SEKAD将解释完整性指标从64.5%提升到了76.9%，这凸显了其在提高诊疗可解释性方面的有效性，同时也证明了我们的文本挖掘方法所生成的知识既质量可靠，数量丰富。

papers.title: WildFeedback: Aligning LLMs With In-situ User Interactions And Feedback
papers.title_zh: WildFeedback：让大型语言模型适应实际用户的交互与反馈环境
papers.authors: Taiwei Shi, Zhuoer Wang, Longqi Yang, Ying-Chun Lin, Zexue He, Mengting Wan, Pei Zhou, Sujay Kumar Jauhar, Sihao Chen, Shan Xia, Hongfei Zhang, Jieyu Zhao, Xiaofeng Xu, Xia Song, Jennifer Neville
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, aligning these models with human preferences has emerged as a critical challenge. Traditional alignment methods, relying on human or LLM annotated datasets, are limited by their resource-intensive nature, inherent subjectivity, misalignment with real-world user preferences, and the risk of feedback loops that amplify model biases. To overcome these limitations, we introduce WildFeedback, a novel framework that leverages in-situ user feedback during conversations with LLMs to create preference datasets automatically. Given a corpus of multi-turn user-LLM conversation, WildFeedback identifies and classifies user feedback to LLM responses between conversation turns. The user feedback is then used to create examples of preferred and dispreferred responses according to users’ preference. Our experiments demonstrate that LLMs fine-tuned on WildFeedback dataset exhibit significantly improved alignment with user preferences, as evidenced by both traditional benchmarks and our proposed checklist-guided evaluation. By incorporating in-situ feedback from actual users, WildFeedback addresses the scalability, subjectivity, and bias challenges that plague existing approaches, marking a significant step toward developing LLMs that are more responsive to the diverse and evolving needs of their users.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的发展，将这些模型与人类偏好对齐已成为一个关键挑战。传统的对齐方法依赖于人类或模型标注的数据集，但这些方法存在资源消耗大、主观性较强、无法准确反映现实世界用户偏好，以及反馈循环可能加剧模型偏见等问题。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了WildFeedback这一创新框架。该框架利用用户在与语言模型对话过程中的即时反馈，自动生成偏好数据集。给定一个包含多轮用户与语言模型对话的语料库，WildFeedback能够识别并分类用户反馈与语言模型回复之间的关联。然后，根据用户偏好，生成出用户喜欢和不喜欢的反应示例。我们的实验表明，在WildFeedback数据集上进行了微调的语言模型，其对齐效果明显优于传统方法，这一点从传统的基准测试以及我们提出的基于检查表的评估方法中都可以得到验证。通过结合实际用户的即时反馈，WildFeedback解决了现有方法面临的可扩展性、主观性和偏见问题，为开发更能满足用户多样化需求的语言模型迈出了重要一步。

papers.title: SSG: Logit-Balanced Vocabulary Partitioning for LLM Watermarking
papers.title_zh: SSG：逻辑回归平衡词汇分割技术，用于大型语言模型的水印嵌入
papers.authors: Chenxi Gu, Xiaoning Du, John C. Grundy
papers.abstract: Watermarking has emerged as a promising technique for tracing the authorship of content generated by large language models (LLMs). Among existing approaches, the KGW scheme is particularly attractive due to its versatility, efficiency, and effectiveness in natural language generation.However, KGW’s effectiveness degrades significantly under low-entropy settings such as code generation and mathematical reasoning. A crucial step in the KGW method is random vocabulary partitioning, which enables adjustments to token selection based on specific preferences. Our study revealed that the next-token probability distribution plays an critical role in determining how much, or even whether, we can modify token selection and, consequently, the effectiveness of watermarking.We refer to this characteristic, associated with the probability distribution of each token prediction, as watermark strength. In cases of random vocabulary partitioning, the lower bound of watermark strength is dictated by the next-token probability distribution. However, we found that, by redesigning the vocabulary partitioning algorithm, we can potentially raise this lower bound. In this paper, we propose SSG (Sort-then-Split by Groups), a method that partitions the vocabulary into two logit-balanced subsets. This design lifts the lower bound of watermark strength for each token prediction, thereby improving watermark detectability. Experiments on code generation and mathematical reasoning datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of SSG.
papers.abstract_zh: 水印技术已成为追踪由大语言模型生成的内容的作者身份的一种有前景的方法。在现有的方法中，KGW方案因其多功能性、高效性和在自然语言生成方面的有效性而特别吸引人。然而，在代码生成和数学推理等低熵环境下，KGW的有效性会显著下降。KGW方法中的一个关键步骤是随机词汇划分，这使得可以根据特定偏好来调整令牌选择。我们的研究表明，下一个令牌的概率分布在确定我们可以修改令牌选择的程度甚至是否可行方面起着至关重要的作用，从而影响了水印技术的有效性。我们将这一与每个令牌预测的概率分布相关的特性称为水印强度。在随机词汇划分的情况下，水印强度的下限由下一个令牌的概率分布决定。不过，我们发现通过重新设计词汇划分算法，我们有可能提高这一下限。在本文中，我们提出了SSG方法，即按组排序后再进行划分的方法。这种设计使得每个令牌预测的水印强度下限得到提升，从而提高了水印的可检测性。在代码生成和数学推理数据集上的实验证明了SSG方法的有效性。

papers.title: PaT: Planning-after-Trial for Efficient Test-Time Code Generation
papers.title_zh: 审判后规划：为高效生成测试代码而进行的准备工作
papers.authors: Youngsik Yoon, Sungjae Lee, Seockbean Song, Siwei Wang, Wei Chen, Jungseul Ok
papers.abstract: Beyond training-time optimization, scaling test-time computation has emerged as a key paradigm to extend the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, most existing methods adopt a rigid Planning-before-Trial (PbT) policy, which inefficiently allocates test-time compute by incurring planning overhead even on directly solvable problems. We propose Planning-after-Trial (PaT), an adaptive policy for code generation that invokes a planner only upon verification failure. This adaptive policy naturally enables a heterogeneous model configuration: a cost-efficient model handles generation attempts, while a powerful model is reserved for targeted planning interventions. Empirically, across multiple benchmarks and model families, our approach significantly advances the cost-performance Pareto frontier. Notably, our heterogeneous configuration achieves performance comparable to a large homogeneous model while reducing inference cost by approximately 69%.
papers.abstract_zh: 除了训练时间优化之外，扩展测试时间计算已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的关键方向。然而，目前大多数方法都采用严格的“试验前规划”策略，这种策略在直接可解决的问题上也会产生不必要的规划开销，从而导致测试时间计算效率低下。我们提出了“试验后规划”策略，这是一种自适应代码生成策略，仅在验证失败时才会调用规划器。这种自适应策略自然能够实现异构模型配置：一个成本效益高的模型负责处理生成尝试，而一个强大的模型则用于针对性的规划干预。通过多个基准测试和不同模型家族的实证分析，我们的方法显著提升了成本与性能之间的权衡效果。值得注意的是，我们的异构配置在降低推理成本约69%的同时，其性能与大型同质模型相当。

papers.title: Joint Knowledge Base Completion and Question Answering by Combining Large Language Models and Small Language Models
papers.title_zh: 通过结合大型语言模型与小型语言模型来实现知识库补全与问答系统的结合
papers.authors: Yinan Liu, Dongying Lin, Sigang Luo, Xiaochun Yang, Bin Wang
papers.abstract: Knowledge Bases (KBs) play a key role in various applications. As two representative KB-related tasks, knowledge base completion (KBC) and knowledge base question answering (KBQA) are closely related and inherently complementary with each other. Thus, it will be beneficial to solve the task of joint KBC and KBQA to make them reinforce each other. However, existing studies usually rely on the small language model (SLM) to enhance them jointly, and the large language model (LLM)’s strong reasoning ability is ignored. In this paper, by combining the strengths of the LLM with the SLM, we propose a novel framework JCQL, which can make these two tasks enhance each other in an iterative manner. To make KBC enhance KBQA, we augment the LLM agent-based KBQA model’s reasoning paths by incorporating an SLM-trained KBC model as an action of the agent, alleviating the LLM’s hallucination and high computational costs issue in KBQA. To make KBQA enhance KBC, we incrementally fine-tune the KBC model by leveraging KBQA’s reasoning paths as its supplementary training data, improving the ability of the SLM in KBC. Extensive experiments over two public benchmark data sets demonstrate that JCQL surpasses all baselines for both KBC and KBQA tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识库在各种应用中发挥着重要作用。作为两个典型的与知识库相关的任务，知识库补全和知识库问答之间存在着密切的联系，并且彼此之间是互补关系。因此，联合处理这两种任务将会带来积极的效果，使它们能够相互促进。然而，现有的研究通常依赖小型语言模型来协同处理这些任务，而大语言模型的强大推理能力却被忽视了。在本文中，我们结合了大语言模型和小型语言模型的优势，提出了一种新颖的框架JCQL。该框架能够使得这两种任务以迭代的方式相互促进。为了使知识库补全能够提升知识库问答的能力，我们通过将经过小型语言模型训练的知识库补全模型作为智能体的行为，来增强大语言模型驱动的知识库问答模型的推理路径，从而缓解大语言模型在知识库问答中的幻觉问题以及高昂的计算成本问题。为了使知识库问答能够提升知识库补全的能力，我们则通过利用知识库问答的推理路径作为知识库补全模型的补充训练数据，逐步优化知识库补全模型，从而提高小型语言模型在知识库补全方面的能力。通过对两个公共基准数据集进行的广泛实验表明，JCQL在知识库补全和知识库问答这两个任务上均优于所有现有基线方法。

papers.title: Rethinking Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Evaluating and Advancing Retrievers in Agentic Search Systems
papers.title_zh: 重新思考推理机制——强化检索功能：评估并改进代理式搜索系统中的检索手段
papers.authors: Yilun Zhao, Jinbiao Wei, Tingyu Song, Siyue Zhang, Chen Zhao, Arman Cohan
papers.abstract: Reasoning-intensive retrieval aims to surface evidence that maximizes downstream reasoning utility rather than only topical similarity. This capability is increasingly vital for agentic retriever-in-the-loop systems such as Deep-Research. However, existing retriever evaluation benchmarks, exemplified by Bright, provide narrow gold sets and evaluate retrievers in isolation, which obscures their value inside realistic agent workflows. We introduce Bright-Pro, an evaluation framework that assesses the effectiveness of retrievers in agentic search systems. Bright-Pro covers a broad range of queries across diverse professional domains. For each query, we provide expert-annotated reasoning aspects, positive documents, a reference response, and evaluation rubrics, enabling fine-grained assessment of retriever performance. Beyond static evaluation, we further assess retrievers in the context of agentic search systems, measuring their practical utility when serving as core components within agentic workflows. Using Bright-Pro, we evaluate classical lexical, general-purpose, and reasoning-intensive retrievers, providing actionable insights for future retriever development.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于推理的检索技术旨在找出那些能够最大化后续推理价值的证据，而不仅仅是基于主题相似性的匹配。这种能力对于像Deep-Research这样的智能检索系统来说至关重要。然而，现有的检索评估基准，比如Bright，只是提供了有限的评估样本，并且是孤立地评估检索器的性能，这掩盖了它们在真实智能工作流程中的价值。我们提出了Bright-Pro这一评估框架，它能够全面评估检索器在智能搜索系统中的表现。Bright-Pro涵盖了多个专业领域中的各种查询。对于每个查询，我们都会提供专家注释的推理信息、正面文档、参考回答以及评估标准，从而能够对检索器的性能进行细致评估。除了静态评估之外，我们还能够在智能搜索系统的背景下对检索器进行评估，衡量它们作为智能工作流程核心组件时的实际效用。通过使用Bright-Pro，我们对传统的词汇检索器、通用检索器以及基于推理的检索器进行了评估，为未来的检索器开发提供了有价值的见解。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Role of Mixed-Language Documents for Multilingual Large Language Model Pretraining
papers.title_zh: 混合语言文档在多语言大型语言模型预训练中的作用
papers.authors: Jiandong Shao, Raphael Tang, Crystina Zhang, Karin Sevegnani, Pontus Stenetorp, Jianfei Yang, Yao Lu
papers.abstract: Multilingual large language models achieve impressive cross-lingual performance despite largely monolingual pretraining. While bilingual data in pretraining corpora is widely believed to enable these abilities, details of its contributions remain unclear. We investigate this question by pretraining models from scratch under controlled conditions, comparing the standard web corpus with a monolingual-only version that removes all multilingual documents. Despite constituting only 2% of the corpus, removing bilingual data causes translation performance to drop 56% in BLEU, while behaviour on cross-lingual QA and general reasoning tasks remains stable, with training curves largely overlapping the baseline. To understand this asymmetry, we categorize bilingual data into parallel (14%), code-switching (72%), and miscellaneous documents (14%) based on the semantic relevance of content in different languages. We then conduct granular ablations by reintroducing parallel or code-switching data into the monolingual-only corpus. Our experiments reveal that parallel data almost fully restores translation performance (91% of the unfiltered baseline), whereas code-switching contributes minimally. Other cross-lingual tasks remain largely unaffected by either type. These findings reveal that translation critically depends on systematic token-level alignments from parallel data, whereas cross-lingual understanding and reasoning appear to be achievable even without bilingual data.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言大语言模型在主要进行单语言预训练的情况下，仍能取得出色的跨语言性能。虽然人们普遍认为预训练语料库中的双语数据有助于提升这些能力，但其具体作用机制仍不清楚。我们通过在受控条件下从零开始预训练模型，并将标准网络语料库与仅包含单语言文档的版本进行比较，来研究这个问题。结果显示，尽管双语数据仅占语料库的2%，但去除双语数据后，翻译性能下降了56%（以BLEU指标衡量）。然而，在跨语言问答和一般推理任务上，模型的表现仍然保持稳定，其训练曲线与基准情况基本重合。为了理解这种不对称现象，我们根据不同语言内容之间的语义相关性，将双语数据分为平行文本（14%）、代码切换文本（72%）以及其他类型文本（14%）。随后，我们进一步通过重新引入平行或代码切换文本到仅含单语言文档的语料库中，进行了更细致的对比实验。实验结果表明，平行文本几乎完全恢复了翻译性能（达到未过滤基准值的91%），而代码切换文本则对翻译性能的影响较小。其他跨语言任务则基本上不受这两种类型数据的影響。这些发现表明，翻译功能在很大程度上依赖于来自平行文本的系统性标记级对齐，而跨语言理解和推理则似乎可以在没有双语数据的情况下实现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ARCHITECT: Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic Tool Learning via Causal Intervention for Open-World Agents
papers.title_zh: 建筑师：通过因果干预实现开放世界智能体的不确定性感知动态工具学习
papers.authors: Zhangyi Wang, Jiexiang Xu, Bingnan Yu, Zongze Li
papers.abstract: Dynamic tool generation empowers Large Language Model (LLM) agents to synthesize tools on demand, yet a critical challenge remains: 32.4% of generated tools fail on first invocation. We present Causal Tool Diagnosis (CTD), a principled framework that moves beyond black-box reliability prediction to interpretable failure attribution. CTD constructs a Structural Causal Model (SCM) capturing how specification quality, code characteristics, and execution environment jointly determine tool outcomes. Uniquely leveraging code’s intervenability, we conduct controlled sandbox experiments to estimate causal effects—an advantage unavailable in pure text generation. CTD jointly predicts confidence (Spearman rank correlation coefficient \rho=0.90) and root cause attribution (78% accuracy), with attributions directly guiding targeted repairs (+9.6% success rate over error-type classification). Our ARCHITECT framework, integrating CTD throughout the tool lifecycle, achieves state-of-the-art on four benchmarks including StableToolBench (+3.8%), MINT (+4.6%), T-Eval (+3.7%), and SWE-bench Lite (+2.4%), with consistent improvements across all settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 动态工具生成技术使得大语言模型代理能够按需合成工具，但仍然存在一个关键问题：有32.4%的生成工具在首次调用时就会出现故障。我们提出了因果工具诊断框架（Causal Tool Diagnosis, CTD），该框架突破了黑箱可靠性预测的局限，实现了可解释的故障归因。CTD构建了一个结构因果模型，揭示了规范质量、代码特性以及执行环境如何共同影响工具的运行结果。通过充分利用代码的干预能力，我们进行了一系列受控的沙盒实验来估算因果效应——这一优势在纯文本生成中是无法实现的。CTD能够同时预测工具的置信度（斯皮尔曼等级相关系数ρ=0.90）和根本原因归因（准确率为78%），并且这些归因信息可以直接用于指导针对性的修复工作（错误类型分类的成功率提高了9.6%）。我们的ARCHITECT框架将CTD整合到了整个工具生命周期中，在包括StableToolBench（+3.8%）、MINT（+4.6%）、T-Eval（+3.7%）和SWE-bench Lite（+2.4%）在内的四个基准测试中取得了领先成绩，且在不同环境下都能保持稳定提升。

papers.title: ES4R: Speech Encoding Based on Prepositive Affective Modeling for Empathetic Response Generation
papers.title_zh: ES4R：基于前置情感建模的语音编码技术，用于生成共情反应
papers.authors: Zhuoyue Gao, Xiaohui Wang, Xiaocui Yang, Wen Zhang, Daling Wang, Shi Feng, Yifei Zhang
papers.abstract: Empathetic speech dialogue requires not only understanding linguistic content but also perceiving rich paralinguistic information such as prosody, tone, and emotional intensity for affective understandings. Existing speech-to-speech large language models either rely on ASR transcription or use encoders to extract latent representations, often weakening affective information and contextual coherence in multi-turn dialogues. To address this, we propose ES4R, a framework for speech-based empathetic response generation. Our core innovation lies in explicitly modeling structured affective context before speech encoding, rather than relying on implicit learning by the encoder or explicit emotion supervision. Specifically, we introduce a dual-level attention mechanism to capture turn-level affective states and dialogue-level affective dynamics. The resulting affective representations are then integrated with textual semantics through speech-guided cross-modal attention to generate empathetic responses. For speech output, we employ energy-based strategy selection and style fusion to achieve empathetic speech synthesis. ES4R consistently outperforms strong baselines in both automatic and human evaluations and remains robust across different Large Language Model (LLM) backbones. Code: https://github.com/Bean0901/ES4R.
papers.abstract_zh: 富有同情心的语音对话不仅需要理解语言内容，还需要感知丰富的副语言信息，如韵律、语气和情感强度，以实现情感上的理解。现有的语音到语音的大语言模型要么依赖自动语音识别进行转录，要么使用编码器提取潜在表示，这往往会削弱多轮对话中的情感信息和上下文连贯性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ES4R这一基于语音的同情反应生成框架。我们的核心创新在于在语音编码之前明确建模结构化的情感上下文，而不是依赖编码器的隐性学习或显式的情感监督。具体来说，我们引入了一个双层注意力机制来捕捉轮级情感状态和对话级情感动态。然后，将这些情感表示与文本语义通过语音引导的交叉模态注意力相结合，以生成富有同情心的反应。在语音输出方面，我们采用基于能量的策略选择和风格融合技术来实现富有同情心的语音合成。ES4R在自动评估和人类评估中均表现出优于主流基线的性能，并且能够在不同的大语言模型框架下保持稳定表现。代码链接：https://github.com/Bean0901/ES4R。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
