papers.title: MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents
papers.title_zh: MAGMA：一种基于多图的智能体记忆架构，适用于人工智能代理
papers.authors: Dongming Jiang, Yi Li, Guanpeng Li, Bingzhe Li
papers.abstract: Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends large language models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches largely rely on semantic similarity over monolithic memory stores, entangling temporal, causal, and entity information. This design limits interpretability and alignment between query intent and retrieved evidence, leading to suboptimal reasoning accuracy. In this paper, we propose MAGMA, a multi-graph agentic memory architecture that represents each memory item across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal, and entity graphs. MAGMA formulates retrieval as policy-guided traversal over these relational views, enabling query-adaptive selection and structured context construction. By decoupling memory representation from retrieval logic, MAGMA provides transparent reasoning paths and fine-grained control over retrieval. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that MAGMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agentic memory systems in long-horizon reasoning task.
papers.abstract_zh: 记忆增强生成（MAG）通过引入外部内存来扩展大语言模型，以支持长上下文推理。然而，现有的方法主要依赖于单一内存存储中的语义相似性，这会导致时间、因果关系和实体信息之间的混乱。这种设计限制了可解释性以及查询意图与检索到的证据之间的对齐，从而导致推理精度不佳。在本文中，我们提出了MAGMA——一种多图代理式记忆架构。该架构将每个记忆项表示为具有正交语义、时间、因果和实体图的多个图结构。MAGMA将检索过程转化为对这些关系视图的策略引导式遍历，从而实现适应查询需求的选边和结构化上下文构建。通过将记忆表示与检索逻辑分离，MAGMA提供了透明的推理路径以及对检索过程的精细控制。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验表明，MAGMA在长视界推理任务中始终优于现有的代理式记忆系统。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Side Effects of Being Smart: Safety Risks in MLLMs’ Multi-Image Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 聪明带来的副作用：MLLM多图像推理中的安全风险
papers.authors: Renmiao Chen, Yida Lu, Shiyao Cui, Xuan Ouyang, Victor Shea-Jay Huang, Shumin Zhang, Chengwei Pan, Han Qiu, Minlie Huang
papers.abstract: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) acquire stronger reasoning capabilities to handle complex, multi-image instructions, this advancement may pose new safety risks. We study this problem by introducing MIR-SafetyBench, the first benchmark focused on multi-image reasoning safety, which consists of 2,676 instances across a taxonomy of 9 multi-image relations. Our extensive evaluations on 19 MLLMs reveal a troubling trend: models with more advanced multi-image reasoning can be more vulnerable on MIR-SafetyBench. Beyond attack success rates, we find that many responses labeled as safe are superficial, often driven by misunderstanding or evasive, non-committal replies. We further observe that unsafe generations exhibit lower attention entropy than safe ones on average. This internal signature suggests a possible risk that models may over-focus on task solving while neglecting safety constraints.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着多模态大语言模型逐渐具备更强的推理能力，能够处理复杂的多图像指令，这一进展可能会带来新的安全风险。我们通过引入MIR-SafetyBench来解决这个问题，这是首个专注于多图像推理安全性的基准测试平台，该平台包含2,676个实例，涵盖了9种多图像关系类型。我们对19个多模态语言模型进行了广泛的评估，发现一个令人担忧的趋势：具有更先进多图像推理能力的模型在MIR-SafetyBench上的表现更为脆弱。除了攻击成功率之外，我们还发现许多被标记为安全的回复其实很肤浅，往往是由于误解或含糊其意的回答所导致的。此外，我们观察到不安全的生成结果在注意力熵方面平均低于安全的结果。这一内部特征表明，模型可能在解决任务时过于注重任务完成，而忽视了安全约束。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Action Boundary Blindness: When LLM Agents Cannot Tell Where One Action Ends and Another Begins
papers.title_zh: 行动边界模糊问题：当大型语言模型智能体无法区分一个行动的结束点与另一个行动的起始点时就会发生这种情况
papers.authors: Zhangyi Wang, Bingnan Yu, Jiexiang Xu, Zongze Li
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents excel at multi-step tasks yet frequently exhibit Action Boundary Blindness—the inability to correctly determine action granularity, scope, and completeness. Grounded in Event Segmentation Theory from cognitive science, we formalize three violation types: granularity confusion, scope creep, and boundary ambiguity. We propose four automatic metrics—Action Boundary Score (ABS), Granularity Alignment Rate (GAR), Scope Violation Rate (SVR), and Boundary-Aware Success Rate (BASR)—requiring no human annotation. Experiments on 1,655 tasks across six benchmarks (\tau-bench, WebArena, ALFWorld, TheAgentCompany, OSWorld) with seven LLMs reveal that: (1) the best model achieves only 0.424 ABS; (2) using a multi-label attribution framework validated by inter-annotator agreement (\kappa = 0.78), boundary blindness is the primary failure mode in 37.2% of failures (25.8% as sole cause; 55.9% total involvement including contributing factors); (3) under-action dominates at 48.4%; (4) BASR is consistently \sim4 points lower than traditional success rate, exposing “lucky successes.” Critically, Explicit Boundary Prompting (EBP) improves ABS by 0.08–0.13 across all models, demonstrating that boundary blindness is better characterized as an elicitation gap rather than a fundamental capability limitation—LLMs possess latent boundary perception not activated by default. This finding has implications for alignment and instruction tuning. We validate metrics through state-based cross-validation and human audit, estimating \sim22% false positive rate from valid alternative paths, with model rankings remaining stable (Spearman \rho = 1.0).
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理在多步骤任务中表现出色，但常常出现“行动边界盲视”问题——即无法正确判断行动的粒度、范围和完整性。基于认知科学中的事件分割理论，我们定义了三种违规类型：粒度混淆、范围扩展和边界模糊性。我们提出了四种自动评估指标：行动边界得分（ABS）、粒度对齐率（GAR）、范围违规率（SVR）以及边界感知成功率（BASR），这些指标无需人工注释即可使用。在六个基准测试集上对1,655个任务进行了实验，涉及七种LLM，结果表明：(1) 最好的模型仅达到0.424的ABS值；(2) 使用由跨注释者一致性验证的多标签归因框架后，边界盲视是37.2%的失败案例中的主要缺陷（其中25.8%是由于边界盲视导致的，55.9%的失败案例包含其他因素）；(3) 48.4%的失败案例是由于“下层行动”的问题造成的；(4) BASR始终比传统成功率低约4个百分点，这反映出存在“幸运成功”的情况。值得注意的是，显式边界提示能够将所有模型的ABS值提高0.08–0.13个百分点，这表明边界盲视更可以被视为一种引导差距，而非基本能力限制——LLM具有潜在的边界感知能力，但这种能力并非默认激活的。这一发现对于模型对齐和指令调整具有重要意义。我们通过基于状态的交叉验证和人工审核来验证这些指标，估计从有效的替代路径中产生的假阳性率约为22%，而模型排名保持稳定（Spearman相关系数=1.0）。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Verbal-R3: Verbal Reranker as the Missing Bridge between Retrieval and Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 语言-R3：重新排序的语言元素，作为“检索与推理之间不可或缺的桥梁”
papers.authors: Sangkwon Park, Donghun Kang, Jisoo Mok, Sungroh Yoon
papers.abstract: The conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) paradigm of injecting raw retrieved texts into the Large Language Model (LLM)’s context often results in suboptimal integration of retrieved information. This paper proposes to bridge retrieval results and the LLM’s reasoning ability through Verbal Annotations, analytic narratives that explicitly articulate the logical connection between a search query and retrieved contexts. Our empirical investigation reveals the potential of Verbal Annotations to substantially enhance the LLM’s ability to generate accurate, contextually-grounded responses. Motivated by this finding, we introduce Verbal-R3, a novel agentic RAG framework that consists of a Generator and a Verbal Reranker. The Generator performs iterative retrieval and reasoning, while the Verbal Reranker returns relevance scores and Verbal Annotations to guide the reasoning and answering process of the Generator. The inference process of Verbal-R3 is further refined through relevance-guided test-time scaling, which efficiently allocates test-time compute for effective trajectory expansion. Verbal-R3 achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex Question Answering benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的检索增强生成（RAG）方法是将原始检索到的文本注入到大语言模型（LLM）的上下文中，但这往往会导致检索到的信息无法得到最佳整合。本文提出通过“言语注释”来连接检索结果和LLM的推理能力，这些注释以分析性叙述的形式明确阐述了搜索查询与检索到的上下文之间的逻辑联系。我们的实证研究表明，言语注释具有显著提升LLM生成准确、基于上下文的回答的能力。基于这一发现，我们提出了Verbal-R3这一新型代理式RAG框架。该框架包含了一个生成器和一个言语重新排序器。生成器负责迭代式检索和推理，而言语重新排序器则提供相关度评分和言语注释，以指导生成器的推理和回答过程。Verbal-R3的推理过程还通过基于相关度的测试时间调度得到了进一步优化，这种调度方式能够高效地分配计算资源，以实现有效的轨迹扩展。在复杂的问答基准测试中，Verbal-R3取得了领先的性能表现，这验证了所提出框架的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: IGenBench: Benchmarking the Reliability of Text-to-Infographic Generation
papers.title_zh: IGenBench：对文本转图表生成功能的可靠性进行基准测试
papers.authors: Yinghao Tang, Xueding Liu, Boyuan Zhang, Tingfeng Lan, Yupeng Xie, Jiale Lao, Yiyao Wang, Haoxuan Li, Tingting Gao, Bo Pan, Luoxuan Weng, Xiuqi Huang, Minfeng Zhu, Yingchaojie Feng, Yuyu Luo, Wei Chen
papers.abstract: Infographics are composite visual artifacts that combine data visualizations with textual and illustrative elements to communicate information. While recent text-to-image (T2I) models can generate aesthetically appealing images, their reliability in generating infographics remains unclear. Generated infographics may appear correct at first glance but contain easily overlooked issues, such as distorted data encoding or incorrect textual content. We present IGenBench, the first benchmark for evaluating the reliability of text-to-infographic generation, comprising 600 curated test cases spanning 30 infographic types. We design an automated evaluation framework that decomposes reliability verification into atomic yes/no questions based on a taxonomy of 10 question types. We employ multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to verify each question, yielding question-level accuracy (Q-ACC) and infographic-level accuracy (I-ACC). We comprehensively evaluate 10 state-of-the-art T2I models on IGenBench. Our systematic analysis reveals key insights for future model development: (i) a three-tier performance hierarchy with the top model achieving Q-ACC of 0.90 but I-ACC of only 0.49; (ii) data-related dimensions emerging as universal bottlenecks (e.g., Data Completeness: 0.21); and (iii) the challenge of achieving end-to-end correctness across all models.
papers.abstract_zh: 信息图是一种结合了数据可视化与文本和说明性元素的复合视觉表现形式，用于传递信息。虽然最新的文本转图像模型能够生成具有审美价值的图像，但其在生成信息图方面的可靠性仍不明确。生成的信息图乍看之下可能看起来是正确的，但实际上可能存在一些容易被忽视的问题，比如数据编码失真或文本内容错误。我们提出了IGenBench这一首个用于评估文本转信息图生成可靠性的基准测试，该测试包含600个精心挑选的测试案例，涵盖30种不同类型的信息图。我们设计了一个自动评估框架，该框架根据10种问题类型的分类，将可靠性验证分解为一个个简单的“是/否”问题。我们利用多模态大语言模型来验证每个问题，从而得出问题级别的准确性（Q-ACC）和信息图级别的准确性（I-ACC）。我们在IGenBench上对10个最先进的文本转图像模型进行了全面评估。我们的系统分析揭示了未来模型开发的关键点：(i) 模型性能呈现出三层结构，其中顶级模型的Q-ACC为0.90，但I-ACC仅为0.49；(ii) 与数据相关的维度成为普遍存在的瓶颈（例如，数据完整性：0.21）；(iii) 在所有模型中实现端到端的正确性仍然是一个挑战。

papers.title: ProMedical: Hierarchical Fine-Grained Criteria Modeling for Medical LLM Alignment via Explicit Injection
papers.title_zh: ProMedical：通过显式注入方式，为医疗大型语言模型构建分层细粒度标准模型，以实现其对齐功能
papers.authors: He Geng, Yangmin Huang, Lixian Lai, Qianyun Du, Hui Chu, Zhiyang He, Jiaxue Hu, Xiaodong Tao
papers.abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with high-stakes medical standards remains a significant challenge, primarily due to the dissonance between coarse-grained preference signals and the complex, multi-dimensional nature of clinical protocols. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textit{ProMedical}, a unified alignment framework grounded in fine-grained clinical criteria. We first construct \textit{ProMedical-Preference-50k}, a dataset generated via a human-in-the-loop pipeline that augments medical instructions with rigorous, physician-derived rubrics. Leveraging this corpus, we propose the Explicit Criteria Injection paradigm to train a multi-dimensional reward model. Unlike traditional scalar reward models, our approach explicitly disentangles safety constraints from general proficiency, enabling precise guidance during reinforcement learning. To rigorously validate this framework, we establish \textit{ProMedical-Bench}, a held-out evaluation suite anchored by double-blind expert adjudication. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that optimizing the Qwen3-8B base model via \textit{ProMedical-RM}-guided GRPO yields substantial gains, improving overall accuracy by 22.3% and safety compliance by 21.7%, effectively rivaling proprietary frontier models. Furthermore, the aligned policy generalizes robustly to external benchmarks, demonstrating performance comparable to state-of-the-art models on UltraMedical. We publicly release our datasets, reward models, and benchmarks to facilitate reproducible research in safety-aware medical alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型与高标准的医学要求进行对齐仍然是一个重大挑战，主要是由于粗略的偏好信号与复杂的多维临床规范之间存在不匹配。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种基于细粒度临床标准的统一对齐框架——ProMedical。我们首先构建了ProMedical-Preference-50k数据集，该数据集是通过人工参与流程生成的，它用严格的、由医生制定的评分标准来增强医学指令的精确性。利用这个数据集，我们提出了显式标准注入范式来训练一个多维奖励模型。与传统的标量奖励模型不同，我们的方法能够明确区分安全约束和一般能力，从而在强化学习过程中提供精确的指导。为了严格验证这一框架的有效性，我们建立了ProMedical-Bench评估体系，该体系以双盲专家评审为基础。实证结果表明，通过ProMedical-RM引导的GRPO方法来优化Qwen3-8B基础模型能够获得显著的效果：整体准确率提高了22.3%，安全合规性也提升了21.7%，其性能与一些专有前沿模型相当。此外，经过对齐后的策略能够在外部基准测试中表现出强大的泛化能力，在UltraMedical任务上的表现也与最先进的模型相当。我们公开了这些数据集、奖励模型和评估基准，以便促进在安全性意识下的医学对齐领域的研究。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: R2IF: Aligning Reasoning with Decisions via Composite Rewards for Interpretable LLM Function Calling
papers.title_zh: R2IF：通过复合奖励机制将推理与决策相结合，以实现可解释的大语言模型调用功能
papers.authors: Aijia Cheng, Kailong Wang, Ling Shi, Yongxin Zhao
papers.abstract: Function calling empowers large language models (LLMs) to interface with external tools, yet existing RL-based approaches suffer from misalignment between reasoning processes and tool-call decisions. We propose R2IF, a reasoning-aware RL framework for interpretable function calling, adopting a composite reward integrating format/correctness constraints, Chain-of-Thought Effectiveness Reward (CER), and Specification-Modification-Value (SMV) reward, optimized via GRPO. Experiments on BFCL/ACEBench show R2IF outperforms baselines by up to 34.62% (Llama3.2-3B on BFCL) with positive Average CoT Effectiveness (0.05 for Llama3.2-3B), enhancing both function-calling accuracy and interpretability for reliable tool-augmented LLM deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 函数调用使得大语言模型能够与外部工具进行交互。然而，现有的基于强化学习的解决方案存在推理过程与工具调用决策之间的不一致性问题。我们提出了R2IF这一基于推理意识的强化学习框架，该框架采用复合奖励机制，结合了格式正确性约束、思维链有效性奖励以及规范修改价值奖励，并通过遗传算法进行优化。在BFCL/ACEBench上的实验表明，R2IF的性能优于现有基线方法，其性能提升幅度高达34.62%（以Llama3.2-3B在BFCL上的表现为例），同时还能提高平均思维链有效性的指标（Llama3.2-3B为0.05）。这一改进不仅提升了函数调用的准确性，还增强了模型的可解释性，从而有助于实现可靠的、基于工具的LLM部署。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Detection to Understanding: Multi-Turn Reasoning for Video Misinformation Analysis
papers.title_zh: 从检测到理解：用于视频虚假信息分析的多轮推理技术
papers.authors: Zhi Zeng, Jiaying Wu, Minnan Luo, Di Zhang, Yifei Yang, Xiangzheng Kong, Herun Wan, Zihan Ma
papers.abstract: Video misinformation detection is often approached as a binary veracity classification problem, overlooking the complex reasoning required to explain how and why content misleads. Existing benchmarks fail to capture the diversity of manipulation strategies, such as AI-generated edits and out-of-context manipulation, and do not evaluate whether models can provide process-level justifications for their judgments. We address these limitations with MisVideoQA, a multi-turn benchmark designed to assess comprehensive understanding and reasoning in video misinformation analysis. MisVideoQA covers 12 fine-grained deception categories and evaluates models along six dimensions, progressing from perceptual attribution to intent and persuasion analysis. Recognizing that standard MLLMs struggle to sustain such structured, evidence-based deduction, we propose MisAgent, a Delphi-inspired multi-agent framework in which specialized agents collaboratively integrate multimodal cues with external evidence. Experimental results show that state-of-the-art multimodal large language models perform poorly on MisVideoQA, while MisAgent consistently improves reasoning accuracy and explanation quality. Together, our benchmark and framework establish a unified foundation for reliable, interpretable, and evidence-grounded video misinformation analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频错误信息检测通常被视为一个二元真实性分类问题，而忽略了解释内容如何以及为何误导用户的复杂推理过程。现有的评估基准未能捕捉到各种操纵策略的多样性，例如由人工智能生成的编辑和脱离上下文的操纵行为，也没有评估模型是否能够为其判断提供过程层面的理由。我们通过MisVideoQA来解决这个问题，这是一个多轮评估基准，旨在评估在视频错误信息分析中的全面理解和推理能力。MisVideoQA涵盖了12种细粒度的欺骗类别，并沿着六个维度对模型进行评估，从感知归因逐步发展到意图和说服分析。鉴于标准的大语言模型难以进行如此结构化的、基于证据的推理，我们提出了MisAgent这一基于Delphi思想的多智能体框架。在这个框架中，各个智能体可以协作性地整合多模态线索与外部证据。实验结果表明，最先进的多模态大语言模型在MisVideoQA任务上的表现较差，而MisAgent则能够持续提升推理准确性和解释质量。总的来说，我们的评估基准和框架为可靠、可解释且基于证据的视频错误信息分析提供了统一的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Frozen LLMs are Native Decoders for High-Norm Semantic Vectors
papers.title_zh: 冻结的大语言模型是适用于高维度语义向量的原生解码器工具
papers.authors: Yunsheng Zeng, Yongmei Tan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are designed for discrete tokens, yet they operate in a continuous embedding space. Recent context compression methods exploit this property by encoding text into dense vectors for frozen LLM decoding. However, a key question remains unanswered: how does a frozen LLM interpret continuous vectors that encode complex semantics? We investigate this through controlled reconstruction experiments. Our analysis reveals a critical geometric property: compression encoders learn to produce vectors with L2 norms two orders of magnitude higher than standard embeddings. We show that this high-norm signal is causally necessary for the frozen LLM to decode compressed information. Based on this finding, we propose a landmark-based compression framework for long contexts. Our encoder uses bidirectional attention over landmark tokens. This design captures global dependencies and avoids semantic fragmentation from segment-based methods. Experiments on text reconstruction and four QA benchmarks validate our approach. At 4x and 16x compression ratios, our method outperforms prior soft compression baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）是为离散的标记而设计的，但它们实际上是在连续的嵌入空间中运行的。最近的上下文压缩方法利用了这一特性，通过将文本编码成密集向量，以便对冻结的LLM进行解码。然而，还有一个关键问题尚未得到解答：冻结的LLM如何解释那些编码了复杂语义的连续向量呢？我们通过控制性重建实验来研究这个问题。我们的分析揭示了一个关键的几何特性：压缩编码器能够生成范数比标准嵌入高出两个数量级的向量。我们发现，这种高范数的信号对于冻结的LLM解码压缩后的信息至关重要。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种针对长上下文的基于地标的压缩框架。我们的编码器采用双向注意力机制来处理地标相关的标记。这种设计能够捕捉到全局性的依赖关系，同时避免了基于片段的方法所带来的语义碎片化问题。在文本重建和四个问答基准测试上的实验验证了我们的方法的有效性。在4倍和16倍的压缩率下，我们的方法表现优于现有的软压缩基线算法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Enhancing Reinforcement Learning for Radiology Report Generation with Evidence-aware Rewards and Self-correcting Preference Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过采用基于证据奖励的激励机制以及自我修正的偏好学习方法，提升放射学报告生成的强化学习效果
papers.authors: Qin Zhou, Guoyan Liang, Qianyi Yang, Jingyuan Chen, Sai Wu, Chang Yao, Zhe Wang
papers.abstract: Recent reinforcement learning (RL) approaches have advanced radiology report generation (RRG), yet two core limitations persist: (1) report-level rewards offer limited evidence-grounded guidance for clinical faithfulness; and (2) current methods lack an explicit self-improving mechanism to align with clinical preference. We introduce clinically aligned Evidence-aware Self-Correcting Reinforcement Learning (ESC-RL), comprising two key components. First, a Group-wise Evidence-aware Alignment Reward (GEAR) delivers group-wise, evidence-aware feedback. GEAR reinforces consistent grounding for true positives, recovers missed findings for false negatives, and suppresses unsupported content for false positives. Second, a Self-correcting Preference Learning (SPL) strategy automatically constructs a reliable, disease-aware preference dataset from multiple noisy observations and leverages an LLM to synthesize refined reports without human supervision. ESC-RL promotes clinically faithful, disease-aligned reward and supports continual self-improvement during training. Extensive experiments on two public chest X-ray datasets demonstrate consistent gains and state-of-the-art performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的强化学习方法在放射学报告生成领域取得了显著进展，但仍然存在两个主要限制：第一，报告级别的奖励无法为临床准确性提供充分的基于证据的指导；第二，当前的方法缺乏一种明确的自我改进机制来符合临床偏好。我们提出了一种具有临床对齐性的、基于证据的自我校正强化学习算法，该算法包含两个关键组成部分。首先，群体级基于证据的对齐奖励机制能够提供基于证据的群体级反馈。这种奖励机制能够增强对真正例的一致性支持，弥补假阴性中的漏检情况，并抑制假阳性中的无依据内容。其次，自我校正偏好学习策略能够从多个噪声观测数据中自动构建出可靠的、与疾病相关的偏好数据集，并利用大语言模型来生成更精细的报告，而无需人工干预。ESC-RL能够产生具有临床准确性的、与疾病相关的奖励，并在训练过程中持续进行自我改进。在两个公开的胸部X光数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法取得了稳定的性能提升，达到了最先进的水平。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VisAidMath: Benchmarking Visual-Aided Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: VisAidMath：基于视觉辅助的数学推理能力评估工具
papers.authors: Jingkun Ma, Runzhe Zhan, Yang Li, Di Sun, Hou Pong Chan, Lidia S. Chao, Derek F. Wong
papers.abstract: A hallmark of advanced artificial intelligence is the capacity to progress from passive visual perception to the strategic modification of visual information to facilitate complex reasoning. This advanced capability, however, remains critically underdeveloped in current Large Multi-modal Models (LMMs). The deficiency is often masked by evaluation metrics that prioritize final-answer accuracy, creating an illusion of competence where genuine reasoning is absent. Using the domain of geometric problem-solving as a precise instrument, we probe this issue through tasks that require constructing visual aids.To this end, we introduce VisAidMath, a challenging benchmark, and our novel Three-Layered Funnel Evaluation Framework. This framework moves beyond simple accuracy (ACCU) to scrutinize the generation of valid visual aids (PVA) and the soundness of subsequent reasoning steps (SPRS). Our extensive experiments on state-of-the-art models, including Doubao-Seed-1.6 and o4, reveal a profound “Reasoning Illusion”. We observe that high surface-level accuracy conceals a catastrophic failure in the models’ ability to produce valid visual aids or to reason from them. Our findings expose a fundamental schism between visual perception and logical deduction in modern LMMs. We provide a public evaluation platform on CodaBench and release the project homepage.
papers.abstract_zh: 先进人工智能的一个显著特点是能够从被动的视觉感知发展到对视觉信息进行策略性处理，从而进行复杂的推理。然而，这种高级能力在当前的大型多模态模型中仍然严重缺失。这种缺陷往往被那些以最终答案准确性为优先的评估指标所掩盖，从而产生了一种看似具备能力的错觉，而实际上真正的推理功能并不存在。我们以几何问题求解领域作为研究的工具，通过需要构建视觉辅助工具的任务来探究这个问题。为此，我们引入了VisAidMath这一具有挑战性的基准测试，以及我们的新型三层漏斗评估框架。该框架不仅关注简单的准确性，还注重有效生成视觉辅助工具的能力以及后续推理步骤的合理性。我们对包括Doubao-Seed-1.6和o4在内的先进模型进行了广泛的实验，发现了一个严重的“推理错觉”。我们发现，表面上的高准确性掩盖了模型在生成有效视觉辅助工具或从这些工具中进行推理方面的严重缺陷。我们的研究结果揭示了现代多模态模型中视觉感知与逻辑推导之间的根本差异。我们在CodaBench上提供了一个公开的评估平台，并发布了该项目的主页。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: RISK: A Framework for GUI Agents in E-commerce Risk Management
papers.title_zh: 风险：电子商务风险管理中图形用户界面代理的框架
papers.authors: Renqi Chen, Zeyin Tao, Jianming Guo, Jingzhe Zhu, Yiheng Peng, Qingqing Sun, Tianyi Zhang, Shuai Chen
papers.abstract: E-commerce risk management requires aggregating diverse, deeply embedded web data through multi-step, stateful interactions, which traditional scraping methods and most existing Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents cannot handle. These agents are typically limited to single-step tasks and lack the ability to manage dynamic, interactive content critical for effective risk assessment. To address this challenge, we introduce RISK, a novel framework designed to build and deploy GUI agents for this domain. RISK integrates three components: (1) RISK-Data, a dataset of 8,492 single-step and 2,386 multi-step interaction trajectories, collected through a high-fidelity browser framework and a meticulous data curation process; (2) RISK-Bench, a benchmark with 802 single-step and 320 multi-step trajectories across three difficulty levels for standardized evaluation; and (3) RISK-R1, a R1-style reinforcement fine-tuning framework considering four aspects: (i) Output Format Constraint, (ii) Single-step and (iii) Multi-step Level Reward, and (iv) Task Level Reweight. Experiments show that RISK-R1 achieves a 6.8% improvement in offline single-step and an 8.8% improvement in offline multi-step, using only 7.2% of the parameters of the SOTA baseline. Moreover, it attains a top task success rate of 70.5% in online evaluation. RISK provides a scalable, domain-specific solution for automating complex web interactions in e-commerce risk management. The code is available at https://github.com/RenqiChen/RISK-GUI.
papers.abstract_zh: 电子商务风险管理需要通过对各种深度嵌入的网页数据进行多步骤、状态相关的处理来整合数据，而传统的抓取方法和大多数现有的图形用户界面（GUI）代理无法胜任这一任务。这些代理通常只能执行单一步骤的操作，缺乏管理动态、交互式内容的能力，而这些内容对于有效的风险评估至关重要。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了RISK这一新型框架，旨在为这一领域构建并部署GUI代理。RISK整合了三个组件：(1) RISK-Data，这是一个包含8,492个单步操作和2,386个多步操作轨迹的数据集，这些数据是通过高保真浏览器框架和精细的数据整理过程收集而来的；(2) RISK-Bench，这是一个基准测试，包含802个单步操作和320个多步操作轨迹，分为三个难度级别，用于标准化评估；(3) RISK-R1，这是一个基于R1风格的强化学习微调框架，考虑了四个方面：(i) 输出格式约束，(ii) 单步操作和多步操作的奖励机制，以及(iii) 任务级别的权重调整。实验表明，RISK-R1在离线单步操作中实现了6.8%的性能提升，在离线多步操作中实现了8.8%的性能提升，同时仅使用了SOTA基线模型7.2%的参数。此外，它在在线评估中取得了70.5%的高成功率。RISK提供了一种可扩展且适用于特定领域的解决方案，能够自动化电子商务风险管理中的复杂网页交互操作。相关代码可以在https://github.com/RenqiChen/RISK-GUI下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MiniRAG: A Lightweight RAG system with Small Language Models
papers.title_zh: MiniRAG：一种基于小型语言模型的轻量级RAG系统
papers.authors: Tianyu Fan, Jingyuan Wang, Xubin Ren, Chao Huang
papers.abstract: The growing demand for efficient and lightweight Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems has highlighted significant challenges when deploying Small Language Models (SLMs) in existing RAG frameworks. Current approaches face severe performance degradation due to SLMs’ limited semantic understanding and text processing capabilities, creating barriers for widespread adoption in resource-constrained scenarios. To address these fundamental limitations, we present MiniRAG, a novel RAG system designed for simplicity and efficiency. MiniRAG introduces two key technical innovations: (1) a semantic-aware heterogeneous graph indexing mechanism that combines text chunks and named entities in a unified structure, reducing reliance on complex semantic understanding, and (2) a lightweight topology-enhanced retrieval approach that leverages graph structures for efficient knowledge discovery without requiring advanced language capabilities. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that MiniRAG achieves comparable performance to LLM-based methods even when using SLMs while requiring only 25% of the storage space. Additionally, we contribute a comprehensive benchmark dataset for evaluating lightweight RAG systems under realistic on-device scenarios with complex queries.
papers.abstract_zh: 对高效且轻量级的检索增强生成（RAG）系统的需求不断增加，这凸显了在现有的RAG框架中部署小型语言模型（SLMs）时所面临的重大挑战。当前的方法由于SLMs有限的语义理解能力和文本处理能力而面临严重的性能下降问题，这阻碍了其在资源受限场景中的广泛应用。为了克服这些根本限制，我们提出了MiniRAG这一旨在提高简单性和效率的新型RAG系统。MiniRAG引入了两项关键技术创新：(1) 一种基于语义的异构图索引机制，它将文本块和命名实体结合在一个统一的结构中，从而减少对复杂语义理解的依赖；(2) 一种利用图结构进行高效知识发现的轻量级拓扑增强检索方法，该方法无需高级语言处理能力即可实现高效的知识检索。我们的大量实验表明，即使使用SLMs，MiniRAG也能达到与基于LLM的方法相当的性能水平，同时所需的存储空间仅为后者的25%。此外，我们还提供了一个全面的基准数据集，用于评估在具有复杂查询的现实设备场景下的轻量级RAG系统性能。

papers.title: Glyph: Scaling Context Windows via Visual-Text Compression
papers.title_zh: 字形：通过视觉文本压缩技术实现缩放上下文窗口的显示
papers.authors: Jiale Cheng, Yusen Liu, Xinyu Zhang, Yulin Fei, Wenyi Hong, Ruiliang Lyu, Weihan Wang, Zhe Su, Xiaotao Gu, Xiao Liu, Yushi Bai, Jie Tang, Hongning Wang, Minlie Huang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) conventionally represent text as sequences of discrete tokens, making long-context scaling largely a matter of processing more tokens more efficiently.We instead explore a complementary direction: increasing how much original context each token represents.To this end, we introduce Glyph, a framework that renders long texts into compact visual pages and processes them with a vision-language model (VLM), allowing a fixed context window to cover substantially more text.To make visual compression practical, Glyph combines continual pre-training on rendered long-text data, an LLM-driven genetic search to identify rendering configurations that balance compression and task performance, and post-training with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.Across multiple long-context benchmarks, Glyph achieves 3–4× token compression while maintaining performance comparable to strong text-only LLMs such as Qwen3-8B, with over 4× faster prefilling and decoding and 2× faster supervised fine-tuning.Under more aggressive compression, a VLM with a 128K context window can handle tasks that would otherwise require up to 1M input tokens.Our code and model are released at https://github.com/thu-coai/Glyph.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常将文本表示为一系列离散的标记，这使得长上下文规模的扩展主要依赖于更高效地处理更多的标记。我们则探索了一个互补的方向：增加每个标记所代表的原始上下文量。为此，我们引入了Glyph框架，该框架能够将长文本转换为紧凑的视觉页面，并使用视觉语言模型对其进行处理，从而使用一个固定的上下文窗口来覆盖更多的文本。为了使视觉压缩变得实用，Glyph结合了针对渲染后的长文本数据的持续预训练、由语言模型驱动的遗传搜索以找出既能保证压缩效果又能提升任务性能的渲染配置，以及训练后的监督式微调与强化学习。在多个长上下文基准测试中，Glyph在保持与强大的纯文本语言模型（如Qwen3-8B）相当的性能的同时，实现了3到4倍的标记压缩效率，其预填充和解码速度分别快了4倍和2倍，而监督式微调的速度则快了2倍。在更严格的压缩条件下，一个具有128K上下文窗口的视觉语言模型可以处理那些通常需要高达100万输入标记的任务。我们的代码和模型可以在https://github.com/thu-coai/Glyph上获取。

papers.title: TA-GRPO-d: Trajectory-Aware GRPO for Optimizing Denoising Trajectories in Diffusion LLMs
papers.title_zh: TA-GRPO-d：基于轨迹优化的GRPO算法，用于优化扩散型LLM中的去噪路径生成
papers.authors: Gyunyeop Kim, Sangwoo Kang
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by repeatedly unmasking a partially noised sequence in parallel, promising lower latency than autoregressive decoding. However, most discrete dLLMs still rely on fixed denoising schedules, which are non-adaptive to input difficulty and cannot learn efficient unmasking orders. This paper introduces a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that transforms dLLM decoding into a trajectory-aware, learnable policy. We propose a confidence-gated denoising strategy that dynamically decides which tokens to unmask and how many to unmask per step, enabling adaptive exploration of denoising trajectories. Building on Group Relative Policy Optimization, we reformulate it into a trajectory-aware variant, TA-GRPO-d, which combines a trajectory-level signal—captured as the z-score of the AUC over intermediate rewards—with a token-level unmasking-time weight. This design allows the model to learn not only the final output quality but also the efficiency of the decoding path itself. Experiments on MATH-500, Countdown, Sudoku, and code benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP) show that TA-GRPO-d maintains or improves accuracy while reducing average denoising steps by up to half, achieving both faster inference and lower computational cost. Our approach provides an RL framework for optimizing dLLM decoding policies toward adaptive, efficient reasoning. Code is available at our GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型（dLLM）通过并行地逐步揭示一个带有噪声的序列来生成文本，这种方式比自回归解码方式具有更低的延迟。然而，大多数离散形式的dLLM仍然依赖于固定的去噪策略，这些策略无法适应输入任务的难度，也无法学习出高效的解噪顺序。本文提出了一个强化学习框架，将dLLM的解码过程转化为一种基于轨迹的可学习策略。我们提出了一种基于置信度控制的去噪策略，该策略能够动态决定在每一步中需要揭示哪些令牌以及揭示的数量，从而实现自适应地探索不同的去噪路径。在基于群体相对策略优化的基础上，我们将该算法改进为一种基于轨迹的变体——TA-GRPO-d。这种变体结合了基于轨迹的信号（以中间奖励的AUC的z分数形式表示）和基于令牌的解噪时间权重。这种设计使得模型不仅能学习到最终输出的质量，还能了解解码过程的效率。在MATH-500、Countdown、Sudoku以及代码基准测试（如HumanEval、MBPP）上的实验表明，TA-GRPO-d在保持或提高准确性的同时，平均去噪步骤减少了近一半，从而实现了更快的推理速度和更低的计算成本。我们的方法为优化dLLM解码策略提供了基于强化学习的解决方案，使得推理过程更加自适应且高效。相关代码可访问我们的GitHub仓库。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AG-GRPO: Answer-Guided GRPO for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: AG-GRPO：针对隐藏式扩散语言模型的引导式GRPO方法
papers.authors: Juhyeong Kim, Gyunyeop Kim, Sangwoo Kang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically evaluates only final outcomes, providing limited learning signal about whether the generated reasoning is consistent with the correct answer. As a result, even when ground-truth answers are available during training, on-policy rollouts can repeatedly produce reasoning that is inconsistent with the answer.We propose Answer-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (AG-GRPO) for masked diffusion language models (dLLMs), which generate text through iterative masked-token restoration. AG-GRPO combines standard answer-free (AF) rollouts, sampled without access to the ground-truth answer, with answer-guided (AG) rollouts. In AG rollouts, the model generates reasoning conditioned on an anchored ground-truth answer suffix, and then re-predicts the answer from the generated reasoning for reward computation. We compute group-relative advantages over the combined AF/AG rollout set, allowing answer-guided training signals to improve the answer-free policy used at test time.Across mathematics, puzzle-solving, and code-generation benchmarks, AG-GRPO consistently improves over the pretrained dLLM and prior RL method for masked dLLMs. We further analyze optimization dynamics to study how shared group-relative advantages support signal transfer and affect convergence. Our code is available at https://github.com/JuHyng/ag_grpo.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通常只评估最终结果，因此很难判断生成的推理是否与正确答案一致。这样一来，即使在训练过程中有真实答案可用，基于策略的扩展式推理仍可能反复产生与答案不符的推理结果。我们提出了一种名为“答案引导的群体相对策略优化”（AG-GRPO）的方法，该方法适用于掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）。AG-GRPO将标准无答案扩展式推理（在无法获取真实答案的情况下进行采样）与答案引导扩展式推理相结合。在答案引导扩展式中，模型根据已有的真实答案生成推理，然后重新预测该推理得出的答案以进行奖励计算。我们通过计算组合使用无答案扩展式推理和答案引导扩展式推理时的群体相对优势，从而让答案引导的训练信号能够在测试时改善无答案策略的效果。在数学、解题和代码生成等基准测试中，AG-GRPO始终优于预训练的dLLMs以及之前针对掩码dLLMs提出的强化学习方法。我们还分析了优化动态，以研究群体相对优势如何支持信号传递并影响收敛情况。我们的代码可在https://github.com/JuHyng/ag_grpo下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Grammar as Control: Modular Language Generation for the Long Tail
papers.title_zh: 语法作为控制：面向长尾场景的模块化语言生成
papers.authors: Ndapa Nakashole
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can, in principle, bootstrap language technologies for long-tail languages due to their pattern recognition capabilities. Yet in practice, without structured guidance, they produce narrow, unrepresentative samples that fail to cover the morphosyntactic space of typologically underrepresented languages.We propose Modular Typology-Informed Generation (mTIG), a prompting framework that transforms descriptive grammars into explicit control mechanisms that guide LLMs to generate typologically balanced synthetic data for downstream training. mTIG decomposes grammars into modular grammar slices, each targeting a specific morphosyntactic phenomenon (e.g., passive voice, causative morphology).Across three low-resource languages, mTIG improves typological entropy by up to 19% and yields a “student-beats-teacher” effect, where distilled models outperform the source LLM by up to +20 chrF in machine translation. These findings show that grammar-as-control can construct training corpora wherever formal linguistic descriptions exist.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）原则上可以利用其模式识别能力来生成针对长尾语言的语料。但实际上，如果没有结构化的指导，这些模型会生成狭窄且缺乏代表性的样本，无法涵盖那些在类型学上被忽视的语言的形态句法空间。我们提出了一种名为“模块化类型学引导生成”（mTIG）的提示框架，该框架将描述性语法转化为明确的控制机制，从而引导LLMs生成在类型学上均衡的合成数据，用于后续训练。mTIG将语法分解为多个模块化的语法片段，每个片段都专注于特定的形态句法现象（例如被动语态、使役形态等）。在三种资源匮乏的语言中，mTIG将类型学熵提升了19%，并产生了“学生优于教师”的效果：经过处理的模型在机器翻译方面的性能比原始LLM高出约20%。这些发现表明，只要有形式语言描述存在的地方，利用语法作为控制手段就可以构建出有效的训练语料库。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MTR-Suite: A Framework for Evaluating and Synthesizing Conversational Retrieval Benchmarks
papers.title_zh: MTR-Suite：一种用于评估与整合对话式检索基准的框架
papers.authors: Junhao Ruan, Abudukeyumu Abudula, Bei Li, Yongjing Yin, Xinyu Liu, Kechen Jiao, Xin Chen, Jingang Wang, Xunliang Cai, Tong Xiao, JingBo Zhu
papers.abstract: Accurate evaluation of conversational retrieval is pivotal for advancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. However, existing conversational retrieval benchmarks suffer from costly, sparse human annotation or rigid, unnatural automated heuristics. To address these challenges, we introduce MTR-Suite, a unified framework for auditing, synthesizing, and benchmarking retrieval. It features: (1) MTR-Eval, an LLM-based auditor quantifying alignment gaps in previous benchmarks; (2) MTR-Pipeline, a multi-agent system using greedy traversal clustering to generate high-fidelity dialogues at 1/400th human cost; and (3) MTR-Bench, a rigorous general-domain benchmark. MTR-Bench mimics production-style challenges (hard topic switching, verbosity), offering superior discriminative power. We make our code and data publicly available to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确评估对话式检索对于提升基于检索增强的生成系统至关重要。然而，现有的对话式检索基准测试存在成本高昂的人工注释问题，或者采用过于机械的自动化方法。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MTR-Suite这一统一框架，用于审核、生成和测试检索功能。该框架包含以下组件：(1) MTR-Eval，一种基于大语言模型的评估工具，能够量化现有基准测试中的对齐差异；(2) MTR-Pipeline，一个多智能体系统，通过贪婪遍历聚类技术来生成高保真度的对话内容，其成本仅为人类的1/400；(3) MTR-Bench，一个严格通用的基准测试平台。MTR-Bench模拟了实际场景中的挑战（如复杂主题切换、冗长文本等），从而提供了更强大的区分能力。我们将我们的代码和数据公开提供，以便未来进行相关研究。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Majority Voting: Towards Fine-grained and More Reliable Reward Signal for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 超越多数投票机制：寻求更细粒度且更可靠的奖励信号，以用于测试阶段的强化学习
papers.authors: Weiqin Wang, Yile Wang, Kehao Chen, Hui Huang
papers.abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning mitigates the reliance on annotated data by using majority voting results as pseudo-labels, emerging as a complementary direction to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for improving reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs). However, this voting strategy often induces confirmation bias and suffers from sparse rewards, limiting the overall performance. In this work, we propose subgroup-specific step-wise confidence-weighted pseudo-label estimation (SCOPE), a framework integrating model confidence and dynamic subgroup partitioning to address these issues. Specifically, SCOPE integrates the proposed step-wise confidence into pseudo-label estimation, prioritizing high-quality reasoning paths over simple frequency count. Furthermore, it dynamically partitions the candidate outputs pool into independent subgroups by balancing reasoning quality against exploration diversity. By deriving local consensus via repeat sampling for each subgroup, SCOPE provides diverse supervision targets to encourage broader exploration. We conduct experiments across various models and benchmarks, experimental results show that SCOPE consistently outperforms recent baselines. Notably, SCOPE achieves relative improvements of 13.1% on challenging AIME 2025 and 8.1% on AMC.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试阶段的强化学习通过利用多数投票结果作为伪标签，来减少对标注数据的依赖。这一方法成为与具有可验证奖励的强化学习相结合的补充方向，有助于提升大语言模型的能力。然而，这种投票策略往往会导致确认偏差，并且由于奖励分布稀疏，从而限制了整体性能。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种基于子组特定步骤的置信度加权伪标签估计方法（SCOPE）。该框架结合了模型置信度和动态子组划分技术，以解决上述问题。具体来说，SCOPE将所提出的置信度因素纳入伪标签估计过程中，优先考虑高质量的推理路径，而非简单的频率统计。此外，它还能通过平衡推理质量和探索多样性，动态地将候选输出池划分为独立的子组。通过对每个子组进行重复采样以得出局部共识，SCOPE提供了多样化的监督目标，从而鼓励更广泛的探索。我们在多种模型和基准测试中进行了实验，实验结果表明，SCOPE始终优于现有的基线算法。值得注意的是，在具有挑战性的AIME 2025比赛中，SCOPE取得了13.1%的相对性能提升；而在AMC比赛中，则取得了8.1%的相对性能提升。

papers.title: Beyond Markovian Forgetfulness: Episodic Memory for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 超越马尔可夫遗忘模型：适用于需要频繁检索的情节记忆机制
papers.authors: Dohyeon Lee, Yeonseok Jeong, Seung-won Hwang
papers.abstract: Reasoning-intensive information retrieval uses large language models to solve complex queries via multi-step reasoning. However, existing methods have critical limitations. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) approaches suffer from inefficiency, while state-based methods, despite better token efficiency, often fall into reasoning cycles that trap the query refinement process. To address these issues, we propose Episodic Memory for Retrieval (EMR), which enhances the state-based framework with an episodic memory. This module stores the full history of prior states for a query, allowing the model to avoid repetition of such cycles. Experiments on the BRIGHT benchmark show that EMR consistently outperforms both CoT and state-based baselines. Moreover, it is highly token-efficient, reducing token usage by 72% on average. Our results show that episodic memory is an effective and token-efficient mechanism for reasoning-intensive retrieval. The gains also generalize across different base models and stay efficient in terms of end-to-end latency. The code is available in https://github.com/ldilab/EMR.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于推理的信息检索利用大语言模型通过多步推理来解决复杂查询问题。然而，现有的方法存在严重缺陷：思维链方法效率低下，而基于状态的 방법虽然能更好地利用标记资源，但往往陷入推理循环，从而阻碍查询的优化过程。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了“情景记忆检索”机制。该机制在基于状态的框架基础上增加了情景记忆功能，用于存储查询历史状态信息，从而避免重复出现的推理循环。在BRIGHT基准测试中的实验表明，EMR始终优于传统的思维链方法和基于状态的基线方法。此外，该机制还具备极高的标记使用效率，平均可减少72%的标记消耗。我们的研究结果表明，情景记忆是一种高效且节省标记的推理密集型检索机制。这种优势在不同基础模型上同样适用，并且在端到端延迟方面依然保持高效。相关代码可访问于https://github.com/ldilab/EMR。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DUAL RM: Beyond Rule-based Preference Reward Modeling via Meta-Reward
papers.title_zh: 双重RM：超越基于规则的偏好奖励模型，通过元奖励实现优化
papers.authors: Xiaobo Liang, Wanfu Wang, Qipeng Huang, Yuyang Ding, Zecheng Tang, Yixin Ji, Qianben Chen, Zhe Zhao, Kehai Chen, Juntao Li, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: The ability to model sparse and underspecified rewards, characteristic of human preferences, is fundamental to scaling Reinforcement Learning (RL). Current preference-based reward modeling largely relies on verifiable rewards, where human-annotated labels define rule-based signals. However, these methods face a fundamental bottleneck we term the Matryoshka Doll Problem: a recursive dependency where each reward verifier requires a meta-verifier, leading to continuous and costly dependence on human annotation. In this work, we propose Dual RM, which couples discriminative and generative reward models (DisRMs and GenRMs) under a non-parametric meta-reward. Rather than verifying the correctness of GenRM’s reasoning, the meta-reward evaluates its practical impact on response quality. Specifically, GenRM identifies multi-dimensional evaluation rubrics and iteratively refines the response, while DisRM quantifies the quality shifts induced by each rubric. Furthermore, we implement rubric-based test-time scaling to improve sample efficiency and preference alignment under both DPO and GRPO. Our experiments demonstrate that Dual RM achieves strong performance across major preference benchmarks. Notably, even when trained exclusively on language modality, it exhibits robust cross-modal transfer on Omni-RewardBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 能够模拟人类偏好中那种稀疏且未完全指定的奖励机制，是扩展强化学习系统的基础。目前基于偏好的奖励建模主要依赖于可验证的奖励，即由人类标注的标签来定义基于规则的信号。然而，这些方法存在一个根本性的瓶颈，我们将其称为“套娃问题”：每个奖励验证者都需要一个元验证者，这就导致了对人类标注的持续且昂贵的依赖。在这项研究中，我们提出了双强化模型，它将判别性奖励模型和生成性奖励模型结合在一起，并通过一个非参数化的元奖励来进行协调。元奖励并非验证生成性奖励模型的推理正确性，而是评估其对响应质量的实际影响。具体来说，生成性奖励模型会识别多维的评估标准，并逐步优化响应结果；而判别性奖励模型则量化每个标准所带来的质量变化。此外，我们还实现了基于标准的测试时间扩展策略，以提高样本效率和在DPO和GRPO下的偏好一致性。我们的实验表明，双强化模型在主要的偏好基准测试中表现非常出色。值得注意的是，即使仅针对语言模态进行训练，它也能在Omni-RewardBench上展现出强大的跨模态迁移能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evolutionary Negative Module Pruning for Better LoRA Merging
papers.title_zh: 用于优化LoRA合并的进化式负模块剪枝技术
papers.authors: Anda Cao, Zhuo Gou, Yi Wang, Kaixuan Chen, Yu Wang, Can Wang, Mingli Song, Jie Song
papers.abstract: Merging multiple Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) experts into a single backbone is a promising approach for efficient multi-task deployment. While existing methods strive to alleviate interference via weight interpolation or subspace alignment, they rest upon the implicit assumption that all LoRA matrices contribute constructively to the merged model. In this paper, we uncover a critical bottleneck in current merging paradigms: the existence of \textit{negative modules}—specific LoRA layers that inherently degrade global performance upon merging. We propose \textbf{E}volutionary \textbf{N}egative \textbf{M}odule \textbf{P}runing (\textbf{ENMP}), a plug-and-play LoRA pruning method to locate and exclude these detrimental modules prior to merging. By leveraging an evolutionary search strategy, ENMP effectively navigates the discrete, non-differentiable landscape of module selection to identify optimal pruning configurations. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that ENMP consistently boosts the performance of existing merging algorithms, achieving a new state-of-the-art across both language and vision domains. Code is available at https://github.com/CaoAnda/ENMP-LoRAMerging.
papers.abstract_zh: 将多个低秩自适应网络（LoRA）专家合并到一个模型中，是一种高效的多任务部署方法。虽然现有的方法试图通过权重插值或子空间对齐来减少干扰，但它们都隐含着一个假设：所有LoRA矩阵都对合并后的模型有积极的贡献。在本文中，我们发现了当前合并方法中的一个关键瓶颈：存在所谓的“负模块”——这些特定的LoRA层在合并后会显著降低整体性能。我们提出了一种名为进化负模块修剪的方法——ENMP，这是一种即插式的LoRA修剪工具，可以在合并之前找到并剔除这些有害的模块。通过利用进化搜索策略，ENMP能够有效地在模块选择的离散且不可微的领域中找到最佳的修剪配置。大量的评估表明，ENMP能够持续提升现有合并算法的性能，在语言和视觉领域都取得了新的最优成果。相关代码可访问于https://github.com/CaoAnda/ENMP-LoRAMerging。

papers.title: Example Quality Matters: Multi-Aspects Example Augmentation for Private Library Programming
papers.title_zh: 例子的重要性：针对私人图书馆活动的多维度改进方案
papers.authors: Yuhao Li, Haifeng Sun, Xuesong Zhang, Shu Yao, Haoyu Zheng, Yvchuan Wang, Huazheng Wang, Zirui Zhuang, Qi Qi, Jianxin Liao, Jingyu Wang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved code-generation capabilities, particularly through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for private libraries. While RAG leverages API documentation to address the scarcity of private code corpora, its performance critically depends on the quality of retrieved examples. Existing approaches often overlook the intrinsic characteristics of these examples, particularly how factors such as complexity, readability, and correctness impact their effectiveness. In this study, we systematically investigate these three critical aspects—complexity, readability, and correctness—and find that optimal examples should exhibit moderate complexity, semantic correctness, and step-by-step execution patterns. Based on these findings, we propose ComboPrompt, a novel example enhancement method that strategically combines existing API examples to improve complexity, refines code structure for readability, and incorporates automated validation ensuring correctness. Extensive evaluations across five private library benchmarks and different LLMs demonstrate that ComboPrompt achieves up to 22% accuracy improvement over baseline approaches. Code is available at Github.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期大语言模型（LLM）的进展显著提升了代码生成能力，尤其是通过检索增强生成技术来处理私有代码库的问题。虽然检索增强生成技术利用了API文档来弥补私有代码语料库的不足，但其性能在很大程度上取决于检索到的示例的质量。现有的方法往往忽略了这些示例的内在特性，特别是诸如复杂性、可读性和正确性等因素对其效果的影响。在这项研究中，我们系统地探讨了这三个关键方面——复杂性、可读性和正确性。研究发现，理想的示例应该具有适度的复杂性、语义上的正确性以及逐步执行的模式。基于这些发现，我们提出了ComboPrompt这一创新的方法，该方法通过策略性地结合现有的API示例来提高复杂性，优化代码结构以提高可读性，并引入自动化验证来确保正确性。在五个私有代码库基准测试以及不同的LLM环境中进行的广泛评估表明，ComboPrompt的准确率比传统方法提高了22%。相关代码可在Github上获取。

papers.title: Resonating with RoPE: Spectral Quantization for High-Fidelity Key Cache Compression
papers.title_zh: 与RoPE共振：用于高保真度键缓存压缩的频谱量化技术
papers.authors: Xuefei Wang, Haoyu Tang, Tianyuan Liang, Zhibin Wang, Yupeng Hu, Weili Guan
papers.abstract: The linear growth of KV cache bottlenecks long-context LLMs, yet RoPE-induced oscillations complicate Key cache quantization. To address this issue, we propose SpectrumQuant, a frequency-domain framework that utilizes the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) to convert these oscillations into sparse spectral representations. Specifically, our pipeline integrates dominant frequency extraction, hybrid bit-width allocation, and high-frequency pre-emphasis to maximize fidelity while minimizing memory footprint. To eliminate computational overhead, we develop fused Triton kernels featuring deferred inverse transformation and on-chip sparse accumulation. Extensive experiments on several benchmarks confirm SpectrumQuant achieves efficient compression with performance and latency comparable to FP16 baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: KV缓存的增长与长上下文大语言模型的瓶颈问题呈线性关系，而RoPE引起的振荡则使得Key缓存的量化变得复杂。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SpectrumQuant这一频域框架。该框架利用离散余弦变换将振荡转化为稀疏的频谱表示。具体来说，我们的处理流程包括主导频率提取、混合位宽分配以及高频预增强等步骤，从而在保持高保真度的同时最小化内存占用。为了降低计算开销，我们开发了融合式Triton内核，该内核采用了延迟逆变换和片上稀疏累积技术。在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，SpectrumQuant能够实现高效的压缩效果，其性能和延迟水平与FP16基线性能相当。

papers.title: CSRP: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Chinese Text Correction via Reinforcement Learning with Efficiency-Aware Rewards
papers.title_zh: CSRP：基于强化学习的汉语文本纠错技术，采用注重效率的奖励机制
papers.authors: Wei Tian, Yuhao Zhou, Man Lan
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) based Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) systems face two critical challenges: general-purpose models lack specialized linguistic priors for subtle grammatical distinctions, and Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Maximum Likelihood Estimation fails to optimize for precision-focused metrics, leading to systematic over-correction. We propose CSRP, a three-stage framework that progressively builds correction capability through Continual Pre-training (CPT) on 5.9M balanced samples to internalize domain knowledge, Chain-of-Thought SFT with explicit error reasoning for diagnostic transparency, and Group Relative Policy Optimization with a novel Efficiency-Aware Reward that explicitly penalizes unnecessary edits. On the NACGEC benchmark, CSRP achieves state-of-the-art performance with 50.99 F_{0.5} and 57.17 precision, substantially outperforming previous best results while effectively mitigating the over-correction bias inherent in MLE-trained models. Our method also advances CSCD spelling correction to 59.61 F1, surpassing GPT-4 by 5.20 points. Comprehensive ablation studies demonstrate that the RL alignment stage contributes a 8% relative gain over the SFT baseline, and that this gain is orthogonal to the contribution of large-scale CPT, validating that explicit optimization for edit efficiency is essential for high-quality grammatical error correction. Our code is available at https://github.com/TW-NLP/ChineseErrorCorrector.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的中文语法错误纠正系统面临着两个关键挑战：通用模型缺乏处理细微语法差异所需的专门语言先验知识；而基于最大似然估计的监督式微调方法在追求精确度的指标时，往往会导致系统的过度纠正。我们提出了CSRP框架，该框架分为三个阶段来逐步提升纠错能力：首先通过持续预训练对590万个平衡样本进行训练，以掌握领域知识；其次采用带有明确错误推理功能的思维链式微调，以提高诊断的透明度；最后通过创新的高效奖励机制，对不必要的编辑进行惩罚。在NACGEC基准测试中，CSRP取得了顶尖性能，达到了50.99 F_{0.5}和57.17的精确度，显著优于以往的最佳结果，同时有效避免了MLE训练模型所固有的过度纠正问题。我们的方法还将CSCD拼写纠正的F1值提升到了59.61，比GPT-4高出5.20分。全面的消融研究表明，强化学习对齐阶段相对于监督式微调基线提升了8%的性能，而且这一提升与大规模持续预训练的贡献是独立的，这验证了针对编辑效率的明确优化对于高质量语法错误纠正至关重要。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/TW-NLP/ChineseErrorCorrector下载。

papers.title: Adaptive Retrieval for Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 自适应检索用于推理
papers.authors: Jongho Kim, Jaeyoung Kim, Jihyuk Kim, Yu Jin Kim, Seung-won Hwang, Moontae Lee
papers.abstract: We study leveraging adaptive retrieval to ensure sufficient “bridge” documents are retrieved for reasoning-intensive retrieval. Bridge documents are those that contribute to the reasoning process yet are not directly relevant to the initial query. While existing reasoning-based reranker pipelines attempt to surface these documents in ranking, they suffer from bounded recall. Naive solution with adaptive retrieval into these pipelines often leads to planning error propagation. To address this, we propose REPAIR, a framework that bridges this gap by repurposing reasoning plans as dense feedback signals for adaptive retrieval. Our key distinction is enabling mid-course correction during reranking through selective adaptive retrieval, retrieving documents that support the pivotal plan. Experimental results on reasoning-intensive retrieval and complex QA tasks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing baselines by 5.6%pt.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究利用自适应检索机制，以确保能够找到足够的“桥梁”文档来进行需要大量推理的检索任务。这些“桥梁”文档对推理过程有贡献，但它们与初始查询并不直接相关。虽然现有的基于推理的重新排序算法试图在排名中突出这些文档，但这些算法存在有限的召回率问题。采用自适应检索的简单解决方案往往会导致规划误差的扩散。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了REPAIR框架，该框架通过将推理计划重新用作自适应检索的密集反馈信号，来填补这一空白。我们的关键创新在于能够在重新排序过程中通过选择性地应用自适应检索来修正错误，从而找到支持关键计划的文档。在需要大量推理的检索任务和复杂的问答任务上的实验结果表明，我们的方法比现有基线方法高出5.6个百分点。

papers.title: On Emergent Social World Models — Evidence for Functional Integration of Theory of Mind and Pragmatic Reasoning in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 关于新兴社会世界模型的研究——有证据表明，心智理论能力和语用推理能力在语言模型中实现了功能上的整合
papers.authors: Polina Tsvilodub, Jan-Felix Klumpp, Amir Mohammadpour, Jennifer Hu, Michael Franke
papers.abstract: This paper investigates whether LMs recruit shared computational mechanisms for general Theory of Mind (ToM) and language-specific pragmatic reasoning in order to contribute to the general question of whether LMs may be said to have emergent “social world models”, i.e., representations of mental states that are repurposed across tasks (the functional integration hypothesis). Using behavioral evaluations and causal-mechanistic experiments via functional localization methods inspired by cognitive neuroscience, we analyze LMs’ performance across seven subcategories of ToM abilities (Beaudoin et al., 2020) on a substantially larger localizer dataset than used in prior like-minded work. Results from stringent hypothesis-driven statistical testing offer suggestive evidence for the functional integration hypothesis, indicating that LMs may develop interconnected “social world models” rather than isolated competencies. This work contributes novel ToM localizer data, methodological refinements to functional localization techniques, and empirical insights into the emergence of social cognition in artificial systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了语言模型是否采用了共同的计算机制来处理一般的心理理论以及特定语言的语用推理问题。这项研究旨在探讨语言模型是否具备所谓的“社会世界模型”——即能够跨任务运用的心理状态表征（功能整合假说）。通过行为评估以及受认知神经科学启发的因果机制实验，我们对语言模型在七种心理理论能力方面的表现进行了分析（Beaudoin等人，2020年）。我们使用的本地化数据集比以往类似的研究要庞大得多。严格的假设驱动统计测试结果表明，语言模型可能形成了相互连接的“社会世界模型”，而非孤立的能力。本研究为心理理论的本地化研究提供了新的数据支持，对功能定位技术进行了方法上的改进，并揭示了人工系统中社会认知的涌现现象。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ToolOmni: Enabling Open-World Tool Use via Agentic learning with Proactive Retrieval and Grounded Execution
papers.title_zh: ToolOmni：通过代理式学习实现开放世界中的工具使用，结合主动检索与基于上下文的执行机制
papers.authors: Shouzheng Huang, Meishan Zhang, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) enhance their problem-solving capability by utilizing external tools. However, in open-world scenarios with massive and evolving tool repositories, existing methods relying on static embedding retrieval or parameter memorization of tools struggle to align user intent with tool semantics or generalize to unseen tools, respectively, leading to suboptimal accuracy of open-world tool retrieval and execution. To address these, we present ToolOmni, a unified agentic framework that enables LLMs for open-world tool use by proactive retrieval and grounded execution within a reasoning loop. First, we construct a cold-start multi-turn interaction dataset to instill foundational agentic capabilities via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Then, we introduce open-world tool learning based on a Decoupled Multi-Objective GRPO algorithm, which simultaneously optimizes LLMs for both tool retrieval accuracy and execution efficacy in online environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ToolOmni achieves state-of-the-art performance both in retrieval and execution, surpassing strong baselines by a significant margin of +10.8% in end-to-end execution success rate, while exhibiting exceptional robustness and generalization capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过利用外部工具来增强其解决问题的能力。然而，在具有庞大且不断变化的工具库的开放世界中，现有的方法依赖于静态嵌入检索或工具的参数记忆，这些方法难以将用户意图与工具语义对齐，也无法泛化到未见过的工具，从而导致开放世界中的工具检索和执行的准确性不佳。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ToolOmni这一统一的智能体框架。该框架使大语言模型能够在推理循环中主动进行检索和基于实际环境执行操作，从而实现开放世界中的工具使用。首先，我们构建了一个多轮交互数据集，通过监督式微调技术来培养智能体的基础能力。然后，我们引入了基于解耦多目标GRPO算法的开放世界工具学习方法，该方法能够同时优化大语言模型在在线环境中的工具检索准确性和执行效率。大量实验表明，ToolOmni在检索和执行方面都取得了卓越的性能，其在端到端执行成功率上比强大的基线模型高出10.8%，同时还展现了出色的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

papers.title: From TDMA to CDMA: A Multi-bit Watermark for Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从TDMA到CDMA：一种适用于扩散语言模型的多位水印技术
papers.authors: Baizhou Huang, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: While DLMs have emerged as an alternative to ARMs, robust content provenance mechanisms for this architecture remain unexplored. Existing multi-bit watermarking schemes, heavily reliant on the sequential context of ARMs, cannot be directly applied to DLMs. In this paper, we reframe the multi-bit watermarking problem through a novel Digital Signal Processing (DSP) lens. We draw an analogy between prior works and TDMA (Time Division Multiple Access) in telecommunications, revealing their inherent limitations. To overcome these limitations, we introduce CDMArk, the first multi-bit watermarking framework tailored for DLMs, orchestrating a paradigm shift from TDMA to CDMA (Code Division Multiple Access). Our method encodes the entire watermark message across all tokens holographically. We further provide rigorous statistical guarantees for the watermark detection process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CDMArk achieves a new state-of-the-art Pareto frontier between imperceptibility and effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然DLM已经成为了ARMs的替代方案，但针对这种架构的可靠内容来源机制仍然有待探索。现有的多比特水印方案严重依赖于ARMs的序列上下文，因此无法直接应用于DLM。在本文中，我们通过一种新的数字信号处理方法来重新思考多比特水印问题。我们将之前的研究与电信领域的TDMA（时分多址）技术进行类比，从而揭示它们固有的局限性。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了CDMArk——首个专为DLM设计的多比特水印框架，实现了从TDMA到CDMA（码分多址）的范式转变。我们的方法能够全息地编码整个水印信息到所有标记上。此外，我们还为水印检测过程提供了严格的统计保证。大量的实验表明，CDMArk在不可感知性与有效性之间取得了新的最优解。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LegalGraphRAG: Multi-Agent Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Reliable Legal Reasoning
papers.title_zh: LegalGraphRAG：基于多智能体图检索的生成式推理技术，旨在实现可靠的法律推理
papers.authors: Zerui Chen, Qinggang Zhang, Zhishang Xiang, Zhimin Wei, Linfeng Gao, Xiao Huang, Zhihong Zhang, Jinsong Su
papers.abstract: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) advances flat document retrieval by structuring knowledge as relational graphs, enabling more coherent and effective reasoning. However, applying it to specific domains like legal reasoning faces critical challenges. (i) Legal corpora are heterogeneous, containing multi-granular knowledge from cases, articles and interpretations. A flat knowledge graph cannot adequately differentiate between factual details, applied rules, and abstract principles, limiting accurate retrieval. (ii) Reliable legal judgment demands transparent, evidence-based reasoning. Traditional RAG passes retrieved context directly to an LLM without verification, resulting in opaque, error-prone reasoning. To this end, we propose LegalGraphRAG, a framework designed for reliable legal reasoning. Our approach introduces two core components: a hierarchical legal graph that hierarchically organizes legal sources to enable retrieval at appropriate abstraction levels, and a multi-agent system for reliable legal reasoning, where a Researcher retrieves candidate evidence, an Auditor rigorously verifies its validity against source documents, and an Adjudicator synthesizes the set of verified evidence to render a final judgment. Extensive experiments show that LegalGraphRAG achieves the state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing GraphRAG baselines in accurate and trustworthy legal analysis. Our code, datasets and implementation details are available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/LegalGraphRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过将知识以关系图的形式进行结构化，提升了平面文档的检索能力，使得推理更加连贯有效。然而，将其应用于法律推理等特定领域时，面临着一些关键挑战。(i) 法律语料库具有异构性，包含来自案例、文章和司法解释的多层次知识。传统的平面知识图谱无法准确区分事实细节、应用规则以及抽象原则，这限制了检索的准确性。(ii) 可靠的法律判断需要透明且基于证据的推理过程。传统的RAG直接将检索到的上下文传递给大语言模型，而无需进行验证，从而导致推理过程不透明且容易出错。为此，我们提出了LegalGraphRAG这一框架，旨在实现可靠的法律推理。我们的方法引入了两个核心组件：一个分层化的法律图结构，用于按层次组织法律来源，从而实现在不同抽象层次上的检索；以及一个多智能体系统，用于实现可靠的法律推理。在这个系统中，研究人员负责检索候选证据，审计员则负责严格验证这些证据与原始文件的一致性，而裁决者则负责整合所有经过验证的证据，以做出最终判断。大量的实验表明，LegalGraphRAG在准确性和可靠性方面均达到了领先水平，其性能优于现有的GraphRAG基线模型。我们的代码、数据集以及实现细节均可在此处查看：https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/LegalGraphRAG

papers.title: Characterizing the Expressivity of Local Attention in Transformers
papers.title_zh: Transformer 中局部注意力表达能力的刻画
papers.authors: Jiaoda Li, Ryan Cotterell
papers.abstract: The transformer is the most popular neural architecture for language modeling. The cornerstone of the transformer is its global attention mechanism, which lets the model aggregate information from all preceding tokens before generating the next token. One common variant of attention is called local attention, which restricts each token to aggregating information from a bounded window of predecessors, reducing the quadratic cost of global attention to linear. Although this restriction is usually motivated by efficiency, it has also been found to improve model quality, a phenomenon that has so far lacked a satisfactory explanation. We provide a formal account of this phenomenon in terms of recognizer expressivity. It has been shown that fixed-precision transformers with global attention correspond to a fragment of linear temporal logic containing a single past operator. We additionally prove that adding local attention introduces a second temporal operator, strictly enlarging the class of recognizable regular languages. Moreover, global and local attention are expressively complementary: neither subsumes the other, and combining them yields the richest fragment. Experiments on formal language recognition and natural language modeling corroborate the theory, showing that hybrid global–local transformers outperform their global-only counterparts.
papers.abstract_zh: Transformer是语言建模中最流行的神经架构。Transformer的核心是其全局注意力机制，该机制允许模型在生成下一个标记之前，整合所有先前标记的信息。注意力机制的一种常见变体称为局部注意力，它限制每个标记只能从有限范围的前身中收集信息，从而将全局注意力的二次计算成本降低到线性级别。虽然这种限制通常是为了提高效率而设计的，但人们也发现它能够提升模型的性能，不过这一现象至今尚未得到令人满意的解释。我们从识别器的表达能力这一角度对这一现象进行了理论上的解释。研究表明，具有全局注意力的固定精度Transformer相当于一个包含单一过去运算子的线性时序逻辑片段。我们还证明了，引入局部注意力会引入第二个时序算子，从而进一步扩展可识别正则语言的类别。此外，全局注意力和局部注意力在表达能力上是互补的：两者互不包含对方，而将它们结合起来则可以得到最丰富的逻辑片段。在形式语言识别和自然语言建模方面的实验验证了这一理论，结果表明，混合了全局和局部注意力的Transformer在性能上优于仅使用全局注意力的模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TH-RAG : Topic-Based Hierarchical Knowledge Graphs for Robust Multi-hop Reasoning in Graph-based RAG Systems
papers.title_zh: TH-RAG：基于主题的分层知识图谱，用于在基于图的语义增强中实现稳健的多跳推理
papers.authors: JungHyoun Kim, Soohyeong Kim, Seok Jun Hwang, Jeonghyeon Park, Yong Suk Choi
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to incorporate external knowledge at inference. Graph-based RAG extends this by organizing corpora into knowledge graphs, improving multi-hop reasoning and offering a global understanding of the corpus. However, triplet-based graphs generated by LLMs are often fragmented and sparsely connected, which reduces coherence and hinders reasoning. Prior enrichment methods such as clustering, community detection, or approximate graph algorithms attempt to restore connectivity but incur high computational cost and risk semantic distortion. To address these issues, we propose TH-RAG, a hierarchical framework that organizes triplets into subtopics and topics, enhancing connectivity, integrating dispersed information, and supporting robust multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on abstractive and specific QA benchmarks show that TH-RAG outperforms strong baselines in accuracy and robustness while remaining efficient, providing a scalable foundation for graph-based RAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术使得大语言模型能够在推理过程中整合外部知识。基于图的RAG通过将语料库组织成知识图谱来扩展这一功能，从而提升多跳推理能力，并实现对整个语料库的全局理解。然而，由语言模型生成的基于三元组的图往往存在碎片化现象，节点之间的连接也较为稀疏，这降低了系统的连贯性，并阻碍了推理过程的顺利进行。以往的一些丰富方法，如聚类、社区检测或近似图算法，虽然试图恢复节点的连通性，但会带来较高的计算成本，并且容易导致语义失真。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了TH-RAG框架。该框架将三元组划分为子主题和主题，从而增强节点的连通性，整合分散的信息，并支持稳健的多跳推理。在抽象性和具体性的问答基准测试中的实验表明，TH-RAG在准确性和鲁棒性方面均优于现有的强基线方法，同时仍保持了高效性，为基于图的RAG技术提供了可扩展的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Static Benchmarks: Synthesizing Harmful Content via Persona-based Simulation for Robust Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 超越静态基准测试：通过基于角色模拟的方法合成有害内容以实现更全面的评估
papers.authors: Huije Lee, Jisu Shin, Hoyun Song, Changgeon Ko, Jong C. Park
papers.abstract: Static benchmarks for harmful content detection face limitations in scalability and diversity, and may also be affected by contamination from web-scale pre-training corpora. To address these issues, we propose a framework for synthesizing harmful content, leveraging persona-guided large language model (LLM) agents. Our approach constructs two-dimensional user personas by integrating demographic identities and topical interests with situational harmful strategies, enabling the simulation of diverse and contextually grounded harmful interactions. We evaluate the framework along three dimensions: harmfulness, challenge level, and diversity. Both human and LLM-based evaluations confirm that our framework achieves a high harmful generation success rate. Experiments across multiple detection systems reveal that our synthetic scenarios are more challenging to detect than those in existing benchmarks. Furthermore, a multi-faceted analysis confirms that our approach achieves linguistic and topical diversity comparable to human-curated datasets, establishing our framework as an effective tool for robust stress-testing of harmful content detection systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于检测有害内容的静态基准测试在可扩展性和多样性方面存在局限性，而且还可能受到网络规模预训练语料库的影响。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种合成有害内容的框架，该框架利用基于人物引导的大语言模型代理。我们的方法通过将人口统计特征、主题兴趣与有害行为的策略相结合，构建出二维的用户角色，从而能够模拟各种具有情境性的有害互动行为。我们对该框架从三个维度进行了评估：危害性、挑战难度和多样性。无论是人工评估还是基于大语言模型的评估都表明，我们的框架在生成有害内容方面取得了很高的成功率。在多个检测系统的实验中发现，我们合成的情景比现有基准测试中的情景更具挑战性。此外，多方面的分析表明，我们的方法在语言和主题多样性方面达到了与人类精心策划的数据集相当的水平，这证明了我们的框架是测试有害内容检测系统有效性的有力工具。

papers.title: DiVE: Decoupling Intra-layer Visual Evidence for Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: DiVE：分离层内视觉信息以缓解大型视觉语言模型中的幻觉问题
papers.authors: Xinwei Li, Li Lin, Hui Jiao, Li Yao, Tien-Tsin Wong, Hanqian Wu
papers.abstract: Recent Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved significant progress yet frequently suffer from visual hallucinations, often stemming from an over-reliance on language priors rather than visual evidence. Existing decoding-based approaches often rely on input perturbations to weaken language priors, but they do not explicitly decouple visual evidence from mixed vision–language representations. To address these limitations, we propose DiVE (Decoupling intra-layer Visual Evidence). DiVE dynamically identifies layers enriched with visual information and performs intra-layer decoupling to extract aggregated visual evidence. By suppressing this evidence to construct a language-prior-dominated reference distribution, DiVE employs contrastive decoding to calibrate the output logits, thereby mitigating hallucinations. Extensive experiments across diverse LVLM architectures demonstrate that DiVE achieves state-of-the-art performance among decoding-based methods on multiple benchmarks. Crucially, it eliminates the latency of an extra forward pass, offering a lightweight and efficient solution.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的大型视觉-语言模型在性能上取得了显著进步，但往往会出现视觉幻觉现象。这种现象通常是由于过度依赖语言先验信息而非视觉证据所导致的。现有的基于解码的方法通常依靠输入扰动来削弱语言先验信息，但它们并未明确地将视觉信息与混合的视觉-语言表示分离开来。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了DiVE（分离层内视觉证据）算法。DiVE能够动态识别富含视觉信息的层，并对其进行层内分离处理，以提取聚合的视觉证据。通过抑制这些视觉证据，DiVE可以构建一个以语言先验信息为主的参考分布，再利用对比度解码技术来调整输出逻辑值，从而减轻幻觉现象。在多种LVLM架构上的广泛实验表明，DiVE在多个基准测试中的表现均处于领先水平。更重要的是，该算法消除了额外前向处理的延迟问题，提供了一种轻量级且高效的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Impatient Users Confuse AI Agents: High-fidelity Simulations of Human Traits for Testing Agents
papers.title_zh: 急躁的用户会误导人工智能代理：用于测试代理的人类特质的高精度模拟
papers.authors: Muyu He, Anand Kumar, Soumyadeep Bakshi, James Zou, Nazneen Rajani
papers.abstract: Despite rapid progress in building conversational AI agents, robustness is still largely untested. Small shifts in user behavior, such as being more impatient, incoherent, or skeptical, can cause sharp drops in agent performance, revealing how brittle current AI agents are. Today’s benchmarks fail to capture this fragility: agents may perform well under standard evaluations but degrade spectacularly in more realistic and varied settings. We address this robustness testing gap by introducing TraitBasis, a lightweight, model-agnostic method for systematically stress testing AI agents. TraitBasis learns directions in activation space corresponding to steerable user traits (e.g., impatience or incoherence), which can be controlled, scaled, composed, and applied at inference time without any fine-tuning or extra data. Using TraitBasis, we extend τ-Bench to τ-bench, where user behaviors are altered via controlled trait vectors. We observe an average 4%–20% performance degradation on τ-bench across frontier models, highlighting the lack of robustness of current AI agents to variations in user behavior. Together, these results highlight both the critical role of robustness testing and the promise of TraitBasis as a simple, data-efficient, and compositional tool. By powering simulation-driven stress tests and training loops, TraitBasis opens the door to building AI agents that remain reliable in the unpredictable dynamics of real-world human interactions. We plan to open-source τ-bench, across four domains: airline, retail, telecom, and telehealth, so the community can systematically QA their agents under realistic, behaviorally diverse intents and trait scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在构建对话式AI代理方面取得了快速进展，但其鲁棒性仍然缺乏充分测试。用户行为的微小变化，比如变得更加急躁、表达不清晰或持怀疑态度，都可能导致代理性能急剧下降，这揭示了当前AI代理的脆弱性。目前的评估标准未能捕捉到这种脆弱性：代理在标准评估下可能表现良好，但在更现实和多样化的环境中却会表现出严重的性能下降。为了解决这一鲁棒性测试方面的不足，我们提出了TraitBasis这一轻量级、与模型无关的方法，用于系统地对AI代理进行压力测试。TraitBasis能够学习出与可操控的用户特征（如急躁或不清晰的表达方式）相对应的激活空间方向，这些特征可以在推理过程中被控制、缩放和应用，而无需任何微调或额外的数据。通过运用TraitBasis，我们将τ-Bench扩展为τ-bench，在τ-bench中，用户行为可以通过可控的特征向量进行改变。我们发现，在τ-bench上，各种前沿模型的性能平均下降了4%到20%，这凸显了当前AI代理在面对用户行为变化时的鲁棒性不足。这些结果共同表明，鲁棒性测试至关重要，而TraitBasis作为一种简单、高效且可组合的工具，具有巨大的潜力。通过支持基于模拟的压力测试和训练过程，TraitBasis为构建能够在现实世界人类互动的不可预测环境中保持可靠性的AI代理打开了大门。我们计划将τ-bench开源，覆盖四个领域：航空、零售、电信和远程医疗，以便社区能够在真实且具有多样行为意图和特征的情况下，系统地评估他们的代理性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Efficient Process Reward Modeling via Contrastive Mutual Information
papers.title_zh: 通过对比互信息实现的高效流程奖励建模
papers.authors: Nakyung Lee, Sangwoo Hong, Jungwoo Lee
papers.abstract: Recent research has devoted considerable effort to verifying the intermediate reasoning steps of chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories using process reward models (PRMs) and other verifier models. However, training a PRM typically requires human annotators to assign reward scores to each reasoning step, which is both costly and time-consuming. Existing automated approaches, such as Monte Carlo (MC) estimation, also demand substantial computational resources due to repeated LLM rollouts. To overcome these limitations, we propose contrastive pointwise mutual information (CPMI), a novel automatic reward labeling method that leverages the model’s internal probability to infer step-level supervision while significantly reducing the computational burden of annotating dataset. CPMI quantifies how much a reasoning step increases the mutual information between the step and the correct target answer relative to hard-negative alternatives. This contrastive signal serves as a proxy for the step’s contribution to the final solution and yields a reliable reward. The experimental results show that CPMI-based labeling reduces dataset construction time by 84% and token generation by 98% compared to MC estimation, while achieving higher accuracy on process-level evaluations and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究投入了大量精力来验证思维链（CoT）轨迹中的中间推理步骤，这些研究使用了过程奖励模型（PRMs）和其他验证模型。然而，训练一个PRM通常需要人类注释者为每个推理步骤分配奖励分数，这一过程既耗费资源又耗时。现有的自动化方法，如蒙特卡洛估计法，也因为需要反复调用大语言模型而需要大量的计算资源。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了对比性逐点互信息（CPMI）方法——这是一种新颖的自动奖励标记方法。该方法利用模型内部的概率来推断各步骤的 supervise 效果，同时显著减少了标注数据集所需的计算负担。CPMI量化了某个推理步骤相对于硬否定选项而言，如何增加了该步骤与正确目标答案之间的互信息。这种对比性信号可以作为该步骤对最终解决方案贡献的代理指标，从而得出可靠的奖励值。实验结果表明，与蒙特卡洛估计法相比，基于CPMI的标记方法可以将数据集构建时间减少84%，令牌生成时间减少98%。同时，该方法在过程级评估以及数学推理基准测试上取得了更高的准确率。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: R^3: End-to-End Reasoning-based Planning for Multi-step Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: R^3：基于端到端推理的多步逆合成规划方法，通过强化学习实现计算
papers.authors: YiFei Wang, Qizhi Pei, Jiangtao Feng, Yuntian Shi, Yi Duan, Lihao Wang, Lei Bai, Lijun Wu, Wei-Ying Ma, Hao Zhou
papers.abstract: Multi-step retrosynthetic planning is a fundamental challenge in organic chemistry, traditionally modeled as a combinatorial search problem guided by single-step prediction models. However, this search-centric paradigm often disconnects from the explicit chemical reasoning processes employed by human experts. In this paper, we propose R^3 (Reinforced Reasoning Retrosynthesis), a novel framework that reformulates this task as end-to-end generative reasoning. Instead of traversing a search tree, R^3 simulates the problem-solving logic of chemists to directly generate complete synthetic pathways. To achieve this, we initialize the model with domain knowledge and employ end-to-end Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize the entire planning policy. Experimental results on Retrobench show that R^3 achieves a state-of-the-art Top-1 accuracy of 43.7%, demonstrating that generative reasoning offers a superior alternative to traditional search algorithms in solving complex retrosynthetic problems.
papers.abstract_zh: 多步骤逆合成规划是有机化学中的一个基本挑战，传统上被建模为一个由单步预测模型引导的组合搜索问题。然而，这种以搜索为中心的范式往往与人类专家所采用的明确化学推理过程脱节。在本文中，我们提出了R^3框架，它将这一任务重新定义为端到端的生成式推理。与遍历搜索树不同，R^3模拟了化学家的解决问题逻辑，直接生成完整的合成路径。为了实现这一目标，我们用领域知识初始化模型，并采用端到端强化学习方法来优化整个规划策略。在Retrobench上的实验结果表明，R^3达到了43.7%的顶尖Top-1准确率，这表明生成式推理在解决复杂的逆合成问题时，提供了优于传统搜索算法的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: River-LLM: Large Language Model Seamless Exit Based on KV Share
papers.title_zh: 河流-大型语言模型：基于键值共享的无缝退出机制
papers.authors: Yingtao Shen, An Zou
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance across diverse domains but are increasingly constrained by high inference latency. Early Exit has emerged as a promising solution to accelerate inference by dynamically bypassing redundant layers. However, in decoder-only architectures, the efficiency of Early Exit is severely bottlenecked by the KV Cache Absence problem, where skipped layers fail to provide the necessary historical states for subsequent tokens. Existing solutions, such as recomputation or masking, either introduce significant latency overhead or incur severe precision loss, failing to bridge the gap between theoretical layer reduction and practical wall-clock speedup. In this paper, we propose River-LLM, a training-free framework that enables seamless token-level Early Exit. River-LLM introduces a lightweight KV-Shared Exit River that allows the backbone’s missing KV cache to be naturally generated and preserved during the exit process, eliminating the need for costly recovery operations. Furthermore, we utilize state transition similarity within decoder blocks to predict cumulative KV errors and guide precise exit decisions. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks demonstrate that River-LLM achieves 1.71\times to 2.16\times practical speedup while maintaining high generation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多个领域都展现出了卓越的性能，但其在推理过程中的高延迟问题日益严重。Early Exit作为一种解决方案被提出来，它通过动态跳过冗余层来加速推理过程。然而，在仅包含解码器的架构中，Early Exit的效率受到了KV缓存缺失问题的严重限制——因为被跳过的层无法为后续令牌提供必要的历史信息。现有的解决方案，如重新计算或掩蔽技术，要么会引入显著的延迟开销，要么会导致严重的精度损失，无法实现理论上的层减少与实际运行速度提升之间的平衡。在本文中，我们提出了River-LLM这一无需训练的框架，它能够实现无缝的令牌级Early Exit。River-LLM引入了一种轻量级的KV共享退出机制，使得主干网络的缺失KV缓存能够在退出过程中自然生成并保留下来，从而避免了昂贵的恢复操作。此外，我们利用解码器块内的状态转换相似性来预测累积的KV误差，并据此做出精确的退出决策。在数学推理和代码生成任务上的广泛实验表明，River-LLM能够实现1.71倍到2.16倍的实际运行速度提升，同时还能保持较高的生成质量。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Execution as Verification: Fine-Grained Self-Correcting Reasoning for Complex KBQA
papers.title_zh: 以执行作为验证：适用于复杂知识图谱问答系统的细粒度自纠正推理机制
papers.authors: Minghan Zhang, Zhen Yang, Haodong Zou, Jie Chen, Zhen Duan, Shu Zhao
papers.abstract: Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) leverages structured knowledge bases to offer superior interpretability and hallucination resistance, making it a critical technology for precise knowledge reasoning. However, the prevailing LLM-based generate-then-execute formulation of semantic parsing is limited by strict syntactic constraints, making it primarily prone to structural deviations that render queries unexecutable, while suffering from semantic deviations that yield incorrect execution results. To address these challenges, we propose the Execution as Verification (EVER) framework, reframing semantic parsing as an iterative, self-correcting reasoning process driven by execution feedback. First, motivated by the insight that query executability serves as a strong proxy for answer correctness, we introduce Fine-Grained Execution-Aware Planning. This mechanism decomposes complex semantic parsing into a sequence of stepwise reasoning processes oriented by executability verification, ensuring high query executability. We further design a Self-Guided Semantic Correction mechanism based on execution result verification, utilizing execution feedback to verify and calibrate semantic deviations, thereby ensuring the semantic correctness of executable queries. Experimental results on the WebQSP and CWQ datasets demonstrate that our method achieves significant improvements in both query executability and answer accuracy, achieving state-of-the-art performance, particularly in complex multi-hop scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/ahu-zmh/EVER.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识库问答技术利用结构化知识库，提供卓越的可解释性和抗幻觉能力，使其成为精确知识推理的关键技术。然而，目前基于大语言模型的语义解析方法存在局限性，其生成-执行模式受到严格的语法限制，容易导致结构上的偏差，使得查询无法执行，同时还会出现语义上的偏差，导致执行结果错误。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了“执行即验证”框架，将语义解析重新定义为一种由执行反馈驱动的迭代式、自我修正的推理过程。首先，基于查询可执行性作为答案正确性的有力指标这一见解，我们引入了细粒度可执行性感知规划机制。该机制将复杂的语义解析分解为一系列以可执行性验证为目标的逐步推理过程，从而确保查询的高可执行性。我们还设计了一种基于执行结果验证的自引导语义校正机制，利用执行反馈来验证和校准语义偏差，从而确保可执行查询的语义正确性。在WebQSP和CWQ数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在查询可执行性和答案准确性方面都取得了显著改进，尤其是在复杂多跳场景中，达到了最先进的性能水平。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ahu-zmh/EVER下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Zero-Shot Detection of LLM-Generated Text using Temperature Sensitivity
papers.title_zh: 利用温度敏感性算法，实现基于大语言模型生成文本的零样本检测
papers.authors: Shixuan Ma, Jiahao Li, Zhendong Mao, Quan Wang
papers.abstract: The widespread deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has spurred significant progress in the detection of LLM-generated text. However, existing detection methods often rely on statistical features that are insufficient for reliable detection; for example, even though LLM-generated and human-written texts exhibit different probability distributions in surrogate models, they can produce nearly identical entropy values, thereby conflating the two types of text. In this paper, we propose that modulating the decoding temperature and monitoring how the probability distributions respond can better probe the intrinsic discrepancies between two types of text. Building upon this insight, we introduce a new feature termed Temperature Sensitivity (TS) and demonstrate that LLM-generated text tends to exhibit higher TS than human-written text. Finally, we propose NTS, a novel and simple zero-shot detector built upon normalized temperature sensitivity. Extensive experiments across three datasets, multiple domains, and various source models demonstrate the superior effectiveness and robustness of our proposed approach. Code avaliable at: https://github.com/Shixuan-Ma/NTS.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用在检测由LLM生成的文本方面取得了显著进展。然而，现有的检测方法往往依赖于统计特征，这些特征对于可靠的检测来说是不够的；例如，尽管LLM生成文本和人工编写文本在替代模型中表现出不同的概率分布，但它们可能会产生几乎相同的熵值，从而混淆了这两种类型的文本。在本文中，我们提出通过调节解码温度并观察概率分布的响应来更好地识别两种类型文本之间的本质差异。基于这一见解，我们引入了一个名为“温度敏感性”的新特征，并证明LLM生成文本的温度敏感性通常高于人工编写文本的温度敏感性。最后，我们提出了一种基于标准化温度敏感性的新型简单零样本检测器——NTS。通过在三个数据集、多个领域以及各种源模型上进行的大量实验，证明了我们提出的方法的优越性和有效性及鲁棒性。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/Shixuan-Ma/NTS。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
