papers.title: MARD: Module-Aware Reasoning Distillation for Language Models with Adaptive Supervision
papers.title_zh: MARD：基于模块感知的推理蒸馏技术，适用于具有自适应监督功能的语言模型
papers.authors: Wenqi Yang, Jianjun Li, Zhibo Zhang, Mingqian Ding, Yushen Fang
papers.abstract: Multi-step reasoning remains challenging for language models with limited capacity. While recent reasoning distillation approaches transfer chain-of-thought supervision from large teacher models, they typically apply uniform supervision across all Transformer components, overlooking the fact that different modules contribute unequally to reasoning. We propose Module-Aware Reasoning Distillation, a parameter-efficient framework that explicitly targets key Transformer components for effective reasoning transfer. Through systematic analysis, we identify the feed-forward network projections and the output projection of self-attention as primary bottlenecks for reasoning. Based on these findings, we introduce lightweight adapter modules at these components while freezing the backbone parameters, enabling focused and efficient distillation. Our approach adopts an offline distillation setting, where a strong teacher model provides reasoning trajectories in advance, and incorporates an adaptive supervision strategy that adjusts the strength of reasoning-related losses according to problem difficulty. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, and ablation studies confirm the importance of both module-aware placement and adaptive supervision.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于能力有限的语言模型来说，多步推理仍然是一个挑战。虽然最近的推理蒸馏方法能够将思维链的监督从大型教师模型中转移过来，但它们通常对所有Transformer组件应用统一的监督策略，而忽略了不同模块对推理的贡献是不均衡的这一点。我们提出了一种名为“模块感知推理蒸馏”的方法，这是一种参数效率高的框架，它能够有针对性地针对关键的Transformer组件进行推理的转移。通过系统的分析，我们发现前馈网络投影和自注意力的输出投影是推理的主要瓶颈。基于这些发现，我们在这些组件处引入了轻量级适配器模块，同时固定了主干模型的参数，从而实现集中且高效的蒸馏。我们的方法采用了离线蒸馏的方式，即由强大的教师模型提前提供推理路径，并采用自适应监督策略来根据问题的难度调整与推理相关的损失函数的强度。在数学推理基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法相比强大的基线模型取得了持续的改进，而消融研究也证实了模块感知的布局方式和自适应监督策略的重要性。

papers.title: Dashboard2Code: Evaluating Multimodal Models on Reconstructing Interactive Dashboards
papers.title_zh: 仪表盘2代码：在重建交互式仪表板上评估多模态模型的效果
papers.authors: Tianhao Niu, Ziyu Han, Qiguang Chen, Shiqi Zhou, Baocai Shan, Hengjie Fang, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che
papers.abstract: Automatic data visualization generation have advanced rapidly with multi-modal large language models, yet existing efforts largely focus on static charts and overlook the interactive dashboards commonly used for real-world data exploration. We introduce Dashboard2Code, a novel task that requires a model to proactively explore an interactive dashboard, acquire and integrate feedback from its own interactions (e.g., clicking and filtering), and generate code that reproduces the target dashboard. To support comprehensive evaluation, we present DashboardMimic, the first Plotly+Dash benchmark for Dashboard2Code, comprising 180 carefully designed and manually verified dashboard–code pairs spanning three difficulty levels and covering eight common real-world interaction patterns. We further propose an automated evaluation framework tailored to dashboards that combines code semantic analysis with dynamic interaction-based testing to assess visual and interaction consistency, showing strong agreement with human judgments. Experiments across a range of open- and closed-source multi-modal models reveal that even the strongest systems struggle on high-complexity dashboards and that a substantial performance gap remains between open-source and closed-source models on the Dashboard2Code task.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着多模态大语言模型的快速发展，自动数据可视化生成技术已经取得了显著进步。然而，现有的研究大多集中在静态图表上，而忽略了用于实际数据探索的交互式仪表板。我们提出了Dashboard2Code这一新任务，要求模型能够主动探索交互式仪表板，从用户自身的操作中获取并整合反馈（例如点击和筛选），然后生成能够复现目标仪表板的代码。为了进行全面的评估，我们开发了DashboardMimic，这是首个针对Dashboard2Code的Plotly+Dash基准测试，包含了180对经过精心设计和人工验证的仪表板与代码对，涵盖了三个难度级别以及八种常见的实际交互模式。我们还提出了一个自动化评估框架，该框架结合了代码语义分析与基于动态交互的测试，以评估视觉和交互的一致性，结果显示该框架与人类判断结果高度一致。通过对各种开源和闭源多模态模型的实验分析发现，即使是最强大的系统也难以处理复杂度较高的仪表板，并且在Dashboard2Code任务上，开源模型和闭源模型之间的性能差距仍然很大。

papers.title: Can Compact Language Models Search Like Agents? Distillation-Guided Policy Optimization for Preserving Agentic RAG Capabilities
papers.title_zh: 紧凑型语言模型能否像智能体一样进行搜索？利用蒸馏技术指导的策略优化，以保留智能体的检索与生成能力
papers.authors: Rikuto Kotoge, Mai Nishimura, Jiaxin Ma
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning has emerged as a dominant post-training approach to elicit agentic RAG behaviors such as search and planning from language models. Despite its success with larger models, applying RL to compact models (e.g., 0.5-1B parameters) presents unique challenges. The compact models exhibit poor initial performance, resulting in sparse rewards and unstable training. To overcome these difficulties, we propose Distillation-Guided Policy Optimization (DGPO), which employs cold-start initialization from teacher demonstrations and continuous teacher guidance during policy optimization. To understand how compact models preserve agentic behavior, we introduce Agentic RAG Capabilities (ARC), a fine-grained metric analyzing reasoning, search coordination, and response synthesis. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that DGPO enables compact models to achieve sophisticated agentic search behaviors, even outperforming the larger teacher model in some cases. DGPO makes agentic RAG feasible in computing resource-constrained environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为一种在训练后用于从语言模型中激发智能体RAG行为的主流方法。尽管该方法在处理更大规模的模型时表现优异，但在应用于规模较小的模型（例如，0.5-1B参数）时却面临独特的挑战。这些小型模型在初始阶段的性能较差，导致奖励稀疏且训练过程不稳定。为了克服这些困难，我们提出了蒸馏引导策略优化方法（DGPO）。该方法采用从教师示范中初始化模型的方式，并在策略优化过程中持续获得教师的指导。为了了解小型模型如何保留智能体的行为特征，我们引入了智能体RAG能力这一细粒度指标，用于分析推理、搜索协调以及响应合成等方面的情况。通过一系列实验表明，DGPO能够使小型模型实现复杂的智能体搜索行为，甚至在某些情况下还能超越较大的教师模型。DGPO使得在计算资源有限的环境中实现智能体RAG成为可能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CE-GPPO: Coordinating Entropy via Gradient-Preserving Clipping Policy Optimization in Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: CE-GPPO：通过保留梯度的裁剪策略优化来实现协调熵在强化学习中的应用
papers.authors: Zhenpeng Su, Leiyu Pan, Minxuan Lv, Yuntao Li, Wenping Hu, Fuzheng Zhang, Kun Gai, Guorui Zhou
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful paradigm for optimizing large language models (LLMs) to handle complex reasoning tasks. A core challenge in this process lies in managing policy entropy, which reflects the balance between exploration and exploitation during training. Existing methods, such as proximal policy optimization (PPO) and its variants, discard valuable gradient signals from low-probability tokens due to the clipping mechanism. We systematically analyze the entropy dynamics and reveal that these clipped tokens play a critical yet overlooked role in regulating entropy evolution. We propose Coordinating Entropy via Gradient-Preserving Policy Optimization (CE-GPPO), a novel algorithm that reintroduces gradients from clipped tokens in native PPO in a gentle and bounded manner. By controlling the magnitude of gradients from tokens outside the clipping interval, CE-GPPO is able to achieve an exploration-exploitation trade-off. We provide theoretical justification and empirical evidence showing that CE-GPPO effectively mitigates entropy instability. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that CE-GPPO consistently outperforms strong baselines across different model scales.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为优化大语言模型以处理复杂推理任务的强大工具。在这个过程中，一个核心挑战在于管理策略熵，它反映了训练过程中探索与利用之间的平衡。现有的方法，如近端策略优化（PPO）及其变体，由于剪裁机制的存在，会丢弃来自低概率标记的宝贵梯度信息。我们系统地分析了熵的动态变化，发现这些被剪裁的标记在调节熵演化过程中起着至关重要但被忽视的作用。我们提出了一种名为“通过保留梯度的策略优化来协调熵”的新算法——CE-GPPO。该算法以一种温和且有限的方式，重新引入来自被剪裁标记的梯度信息到原始的PPO算法中。通过控制超出剪裁区间的标记的梯度大小，CE-GPPO能够实现探索与利用之间的平衡。我们的理论分析和实证结果表明，CE-GPPO能够有效缓解熵的不稳定性。在数学推理基准测试中的广泛实验表明，CE-GPPO在不同模型规模上始终优于其他强大的基线算法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Omni-I2C: A Holistic Benchmark for High-Fidelity Image-to-Code Generation
papers.title_zh: Omni-I2C：一种用于高保真图像转代码生成的全面基准测试工具
papers.authors: Jiawei Zhou, Chi Zhang, Xiang Feng, Qiming Zhang, Haibo Qiu, Lihuo He, Dengpan Ye, Xinbo Gao, Jing Zhang
papers.abstract: We present Omni-I2C, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in converting complex, structured digital graphics into executable code. We argue that this task represents a non-trivial challenge for the current generation of LMMs: it demands an unprecedented synergy between high-fidelity visual perception—to parse intricate spatial hierarchies and symbolic details—and precise generative expression—to synthesize syntactically sound and logically consistent code. Unlike traditional descriptive tasks, Omni-I2C requires a holistic understanding where any minor perceptual hallucination or coding error leads to a complete failure in visual reconstruction. Omni-I2C features 1130 meticulously curated samples, defined by its breadth across subjects, image modalities, and programming languages. By incorporating authentic user-sourced cases, the benchmark spans a vast spectrum of digital content—from scientific visualizations to complex symbolic notations—each paired with executable reference code. To complement this diversity, our evaluation framework provides necessary depth; by decoupling performance into perceptual fidelity and symbolic precision, it transcends surface-level accuracy to expose the granular structural failures and reasoning bottlenecks of current LMMs. Our evaluation reveals a substantial performance gap among leading LMMs; even state-of-the-art models struggle to preserve structural integrity in complex scenarios, underscoring that multimodal code generation remains a formidable challenge. Data and code are available at https://github.com/MiliLab/Omni-I2C.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Omni-I2C这一全面的基准测试，旨在评估大型多模态模型在将复杂、结构化的数字图形转换为可执行代码方面的能力。我们认为，对于当前版本的多模态模型来说，这一任务并非易事：它要求高保真度的视觉感知能力与精确的生成表达能力之间实现前所未有的协同作用——前者负责解析复杂的空间层次结构和符号细节，后者则负责合成语法正确且逻辑一致的代码。与传统的描述性任务不同，Omni-I2C需要全面的理解能力，任何微小的感知幻觉或编码错误都可能导致视觉重建的完全失败。该基准测试包含1130个精心挑选的样本，这些样本涵盖了不同的主题、图像形式以及编程语言。通过结合真实用户提供的案例，该基准测试涵盖了从科学可视化到复杂符号表示的广泛数字内容，每个案例都配有可执行的参考代码。为了补充这种多样性，我们的评估框架提供了必要的深度分析；通过将性能分解为感知保真度和符号精确性两个维度，我们能够揭示当前多模态模型在结构完整性和推理效率方面的缺陷。我们的评估结果显示，领先的多模态模型之间存在显著的性能差距；即使是最先进的模型也难以在复杂场景中保持结构的完整性，这进一步证明了多模态代码生成仍然是一个巨大的挑战。相关数据和支持代码可访问于https://github.com/MiliLab/Omni-I2C。

papers.title: Revealing Procedural Reasoning Structures in Chain-of-Thought Training via Span-Level Gradient Organization
papers.title_zh: 通过片段级梯度组织技术在思维链训练中揭示程序性推理结构
papers.authors: Jia Liu, Jiaxin Luo, Weiwen Xu, Jonathan M. Garibaldi, Xiao-Kun Wu, Yixue Hao, Min Chen
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting enables large language models to produce multi-step reasoning, yet how such reasoning-related structure is expressed during training remains poorly understood. We present Gradient-based Structural Developer (GSD), an unsupervised framework with a principled gradient aggregation view that tracks span-level gradient during fine-tuning on reasoning benchmarks to understand how models develop structured, step-by-step reasoning capabilities. Our analysis shows that while gradients at the level of individual tokens are often noisy, aggregating gradients over contiguous reasoning-related spans reveals stable and recurring directional alignment across samples. We refer to these directionally aligned patterns as aligned sequential stresses, reflecting consistent gradient organization associated with similar reasoning procedures. Beyond capturing semantically similar reasoning instances, such gradient alignment also reveals structurally similar but semantically diverse cases that share common procedural organization. These findings position GSD as a diagnostic framework for analyzing how procedural reasoning structures emerge during training, with downstream selection results serving as auxiliary evidence correlating gradient alignment with adaptation efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链提示能够让大语言模型产生多步推理过程，然而这种与推理相关的结构在训练过程中的表达方式仍然不清楚。我们提出了基于梯度的结构化开发框架（GSD），这是一个无监督框架，它通过追踪推理基准测试中的跨段梯度来学习模型如何发展出结构化的、逐步的推理能力。我们的分析表明，虽然单个词级的梯度往往具有噪声性，但将连续推理相关段的梯度进行聚合后，可以发现样本之间存在着稳定且重复出现的方向性对齐现象。我们将这些方向性对齐的模式称为“对齐的序列应力”，它们反映了与类似推理过程相关的稳定梯度组织方式。除了捕捉语义上相似的推理实例之外，这种梯度对齐还揭示了在结构上相似但在语义上不同的案例，这些案例具有共同的程序化组织方式。这些发现使得GSD成为一种诊断性框架，用于分析程序化推理结构在训练过程中的形成机制，而下游选择结果则可以作为辅助证据，将梯度对齐与适应效率联系起来。

papers.title: StepHint: Multi-level Stepwise Hints Enhance Reinforcement Learning to Reason
papers.title_zh: 提示：多层逐步优化技巧能显著提升强化学习在推理方面的性能
papers.authors: Kaiyi Zhang, Ang Lv, Jinpeng Li, Yongbo Wang, Feng Wang, Haoyuan hu, Rui Yan
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a promising approach for improving the complex reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs). However, current RLVR methods face two significant challenges: the near-miss reward problem, where a small mistake can invalidate an otherwise correct reasoning process, greatly hindering training efficiency; and exploration stagnation, where models tend to focus on solutions within their ”comfort zone”, lacking the motivation to explore potentially more effective alternatives. To address these challenges, we propose StepHint, a novel RLVR algorithm that utilizes multi-level stepwise hints to help models explore the solution space more effectively. StepHint partitions valid reasoning chains into reasoning steps using our proposed adaptive partitioning method. The initial few steps are used as hints, and simultaneously, multiple-level hints (each comprising a different number of steps) are provided to the model. This approach directs the model’s exploration toward a promising solution subspace while preserving its flexibility for independent exploration. By providing hints, StepHint mitigates the near-miss reward problem, thereby improving training efficiency. Additionally, the external reasoning pathways help the model develop better reasoning abilities, enabling it to move beyond its ”comfort zone” and mitigate exploration stagnation. StepHint outperforms competitive RLVR enhancement methods across six mathematical benchmarks and two out-of-domain benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是一种有望提升大语言模型复杂推理能力的有效方法。然而，当前的RLVR方法面临两个主要挑战：近失奖励问题，即微小的错误可能导致原本正确的推理过程失效，这严重影响了训练效率；以及探索停滞问题，即模型倾向于只关注“舒适区”内的解决方案，缺乏探索更优替代方案的动力。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了StepHint这一新颖的RLVR算法。该算法利用多级逐步提示来帮助模型更有效地探索解决方案空间。StepHint通过我们提出的自适应划分方法，将有效的推理链划分为多个推理步骤。最初的几个步骤被用作提示，同时，还会向模型提供多级提示（每级包含不同数量的步骤）。这种方法引导模型的探索方向朝着有希望的解决方案子空间发展，同时保留了模型独立探索的灵活性。通过提供提示，StepHint缓解了近失奖励问题，从而提高了训练效率。此外，外部推理路径有助于模型发展更好的推理能力，使其能够突破“舒适区”，并减少探索停滞现象。在六个数学基准测试和两个领域外基准测试中，StepHint的表现均优于其他竞争性RLVR增强方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Social Dynamics as Critical Vulnerabilities that Undermine Objective Decision-Making in LLM Collectives
papers.title_zh: 社会动态作为关键漏洞，会破坏大型语言模型群体中的客观决策能力
papers.authors: Changgeon Ko, Jisu Shin, Hoyun Song, Huije Lee, Eui Jun Hwang, Jong C. Park
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly acting as human delegates in multi-agent environments, where a representative agent integrates diverse peer perspectives to make a final decision. Drawing inspiration from social psychology, we investigate how the reliability of this representative agent is undermined by the social context of its network. We define four key phenomena—social conformity, perceived expertise, dominant speaker effect, and rhetorical persuasion—and systematically manipulate the number of adversaries, relative intelligence, argument length, and argumentative styles. Our experiments demonstrate that the representative agent’s accuracy consistently declines as social pressure increases: larger adversarial groups, more capable peers, and longer arguments all lead to significant performance degradation. Furthermore, rhetorical strategies emphasizing credibility or logic can further sway the agent’s judgment, depending on the context. These findings reveal that multi-agent systems are sensitive not only to individual reasoning but also to the social dynamics of their configuration, highlighting critical vulnerabilities in AI delegates that mirror the psychological biases observed in human group decision-making.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理在多智能体环境中越来越多地充当人类代表角色，这些代表代理会整合不同个体的观点以做出最终决策。受社会心理学的启发，我们研究了其网络的社会背景如何削弱该代表代理的可靠性。我们定义了四种关键现象——社会一致性、感知的专业性、主导者效应以及修辞说服力。我们通过系统地改变对手数量、相对智力水平、争论长度以及争论风格等方式来研究这些现象。实验结果表明，随着社会压力的增加，代表代理的准确率会持续下降：规模更大的敌对群体、能力更强的同伴以及更长的争论都会导致显著的性能下降。此外，强调可信度或逻辑的修辞策略可以根据具体情境进一步影响代理的判断。这些发现表明，多智能体系统不仅容易受到个体推理的影响，还受到其配置中的社会动态的影响，这揭示了人工智能代表中存在的关键漏洞，这些漏洞与人类群体决策中观察到的心理偏差相似。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FairQE: Multi-Agent Framework for Mitigating Gender Bias in Translation Quality Estimation
papers.title_zh: FairQE：一种多智能体框架，用于减轻翻译质量评估中的性别偏见问题
papers.authors: Jinhee Jang, Juhwan Choi, Dongjin Lee, Seunguk Yu, YoungBin Kim
papers.abstract: Quality Estimation (QE) aims to assess machine translation quality without reference translations, but recent studies have shown that existing QE models exhibit systematic gender bias. In particular, they tend to favor masculine realizations in gender-ambiguous contexts and may assign higher scores to gender-misaligned translations even when gender is explicitly specified. To address these issues, we propose FairQE, a multi-agent-based, fairness-aware QE framework that mitigates gender bias in both gender-ambiguous and gender-explicit scenarios. FairQE detects gender cues, generates gender-flipped translation variants, and combines conventional QE scores with LLM-based unbiased reasoning through a dynamic bias-aware aggregation mechanism. This design preserves the strengths of existing QE models while calibrating their gender-related biases in a plug-and-play manner. Extensive experiments across multiple gender bias evaluation settings demonstrate that FairQE consistently improves gender fairness over strong QE baselines. Moreover, under MQM-based meta-evaluation following the WMT 2023 Metrics Shared Task, FairQE achieves competitive or improved general QE performance. These results show that gender bias in QE can be effectively mitigated without sacrificing evaluation accuracy, enabling fairer and more reliable translation evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 质量评估（QE）的目的是在不依赖参考译文的情况下评估机器翻译的质量。然而，最近的研究表明，现有的QE模型存在系统性的性别偏见。具体来说，这些模型在性别模糊的语境中倾向于偏好男性化的译文表达，并且在性别明确的情况下，仍可能会给性别不对应的译文更高的评分。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了FairQE这一基于多智能体且注重公平性的QE框架。该框架能够减轻性别偏见，适用于性别模糊和性别明确的场景。FairQE能够识别性别线索，生成性别相反的译文版本，并通过动态的自适应聚合机制，将传统的QE评分与基于大语言模型的无偏分析相结合。这种设计既保留了现有QE模型的优势，又能以即插即用的方式调整其与性别相关的偏见。通过在不同性别偏见评估环境下的大量实验表明，FairQE在性别公平性方面始终优于其他强大的QE基线模型。此外，根据WMT 2023指标共享任务进行的元评估显示，FairQE在整体QE性能上取得了令人满意或更好的表现。这些结果表明，可以在不牺牲评估准确性的前提下有效缓解QE中的性别偏见问题，从而实现更公平、更可靠的翻译评估。

papers.title: AdaDPI: Document-level Translation Adaptive Agent via Dynamic Parametric Internalization
papers.title_zh: AdaDPI：通过动态参数化内部化实现文档级翻译自适应代理
papers.authors: Hong Ren, Liting Deng, Shaolin Zhu, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in machine translation. However, maintaining discourse coherence and terminological consistency remains a persistent challenge in document-level translation (DocMT). Existing solutions, such as memory-based agents, predominantly rely on explicit context concatenation. This paradigm treats historical context as a static external resource, which often leads to context dilution, high inference latency, and superficial knowledge integration. To address these limitations, we propose AdaDPI, an adaptive agentic framework that shifts the DocMT paradigm from static retrieval to dynamic parametric internalization. Specifically, we design a linguistic uncertainty monitor (LUM) to actively detect critical discourse discontinuities by the model’s epistemic uncertainty. Upon detection, a context-to-parameter integrator (CPI) compiles retrieved external constraints directly into the model’s intrinsic state via an online parameter adaptation mechanism. Through the online parameter adaptation on a lightweight adapter, AdaDPI internalizes document-specific norms into the model’s intrinsic representations, enabling a progressive evolution of the translation strategy as the discourse unfolds. Extensive experiments on the discourse-rich GuoFeng and IWSLT2017 datasets demonstrate that AdaDPI significantly outperforms the SoTA baselines by more than 5 points on the consistency metric.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在机器翻译领域展现出了卓越的能力。然而，在文档级翻译中保持话语连贯性和术语一致性仍然是一个持续的挑战。现有的解决方案，如基于记忆的代理机制，主要依赖于显式的上下文拼接。这种范式将历史上下文视为一个静态的外部资源，这往往会导致上下文的稀释、较高的推理延迟以及知识整合的肤浅性。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了AdaDPI这一自适应代理框架，它将文档级翻译的范式从静态检索转变为动态的参数化内部化。具体来说，我们设计了一个语言不确定性监测器，用于主动检测模型认知不确定性所带来的话语中断点。一旦检测到这些中断点，上下文到参数的集成器就会通过在线参数调整机制，将检索到的外部约束直接整合到模型的固有状态中。通过轻量级适配器的在线参数调整，AdaDPI能够将文档特定的规范内化为模型的固有表示，从而随着话语的进展而逐步优化翻译策略。在包含丰富话语内容的 GuoFeng 和 IWSLT2017 数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，AdaDPI在一致性指标上的表现比现有的最佳基线方案高出5分以上。

papers.title: Mitigating Over-Refusal in Aligned Large Language Models via Inference-Time Activation Energy
papers.title_zh: 通过推理时激活能量来减轻对齐大型语言模型中的过度拒绝现象
papers.authors: Eric Hanchen Jiang, Weixuan Ou, Run Liu, Shengyuan Pang, Guancheng Wan, Ranjie Duan, Wei Dong, Kai-Wei Chang, XiaoFeng Wang, Ying Nian Wu, Xinfeng Li
papers.abstract: Safety alignment of large language models currently faces a central challenge: existing alignment techniques often prioritize mitigating responses to harmful prompts at the expense of overcautious behavior, leading models to incorrectly refuse benign requests. A key goal of safe alignment is therefore to improve safety while simultaneously minimizing false refusals. In this work, we introduce Energy Landscape Steering (ELS), a novel, fine-tuning free framework designed to resolve this challenge through dynamic, inference-time intervention. We trained a lightweight, external Energy-Based Model (EBM) to assign high energy to undesirable (false refusal or jailbreak) states and low energy to desirable (helpful response or safe reject) ones. During inference, the EBM maps the LLM’s internal activations to an energy landscape, and we use the gradient of the energy function to steer the hidden states toward low-energy regions in real time. This dynamically guides the model toward desirable behavior without modifying its parameters. By decoupling behavioral control from the model’s core knowledge, ELS provides a flexible and computationally efficient solution. Extensive experiments across diverse models demonstrate its effectiveness: raising compliance on the ORB-H benchmark from 57.3% to 82.6% while maintaining the baseline safety performance. Our work establishes a promising paradigm for building LLMs that simultaneously achieve high safety and low false refusal rates.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的安全对齐目前面临一个核心挑战：现有的对齐技术往往倾向于减轻对有害提示的响应，但却导致模型过于谨慎，从而错误地拒绝有益的请求。因此，安全对齐的一个关键目标是在提高安全性的同时，尽量减少错误的拒绝情况。在这项研究中，我们提出了能量景观引导法（Energy Landscape Steering，ELS），这是一种无需微调的框架，旨在通过动态、在推理阶段进行的干预来解决这一挑战。我们训练了一个轻量级的外部基于能量的模型，该模型将高能量分配给不希望出现的状态（如错误拒绝或破坏行为），而将低能量分配给期望出现的状态（如有益响应或安全拒绝）。在推理过程中，该模型将语言模型的内部激活映射到一个能量景观中，并利用能量函数的梯度来实时引导隐藏状态向低能量区域移动。这种动态方式能够引导模型表现出期望的行为，而无需修改其参数。通过将行为控制与模型的核心知识分离开来，ELS提供了一种灵活且计算效率高的解决方案。通过在不同模型上进行的大量实验验证了其有效性：在ORB-H基准测试上，模型的合规率从57.3%提升到了82.6%，同时保持了原有的安全性能。我们的研究为构建既具有高安全性又具有低错误拒绝率的语言模型提供了一个有前景的方法论。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Refining and Reusing Annotation Guidelines for LLM Annotation
papers.title_zh: 完善并复用针对大语言模型注释的指南
papers.authors: Kon Woo Kim, Jin-Dong Kim, Akiko Aizawa
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrates remarkable zero-shot annotation tasks, they often struggle with the specialized conventions of gold-standard benchmarks. We propose the systematic reuse and refinement of annotation guidelines as an alignment mechanism, introducing an iterative moderation framework that simulates the early phases of annotation projects. We evaluate three hypotheses: (1) the efficacy of guideline integration, (2) the advantage of reasoning-optimized models, and (3) the viability of moderation under minimal supervision. Testing across biomedical NER tasks (NCBI Disease, BC5CDR, BioRED) with three LLM families (GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek), our results empirically confirm all three hypotheses. While the iterative moderation framework shows a good potential in effectively refining guidelines, our analysis also reveals a significant room for improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在零样本注释任务中表现出色，但它们往往难以应对标准基准测试中的专业规范。我们提出了一种系统化的注释指南复用与优化方法，将其作为对齐机制，并引入了一个迭代式审核框架，以模拟注释项目的早期阶段。我们验证了三个假设：(1) 指南整合的有效性；(2) 基于推理优化的模型的优势；以及(3) 在最小监督下的审核可行性。通过对生物医学命名实体识别任务（如NCBI Disease、BC5CDR、BioRED）进行实验，并使用了三种语言模型（GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek），我们的实验结果证实了所有三个假设。尽管迭代式审核框架在有效优化指南方面具有良好潜力，但我们的分析也揭示了仍有很大的改进空间。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Cross-Examination Framework: A Task-Agnostic Diagnostic for Information Fidelity in Text-to-Text Generation
papers.title_zh: 交叉审问框架：一种与任务无关的文本生成信息准确性的诊断方法
papers.authors: Tathagata Raha, Clement Christophe, Nada Saadi, Hamza A Javed, Marco AF Pimentel, Ronnie Rajan, Praveenkumar Kanithi
papers.abstract: Traditional metrics like BLEU and BERTScore fail to capture semantic fidelity in generative text-to-text tasks. We adapt the Cross-Examination Framework (CEF) for a reference-free, multi-dimensional evaluation by treating the source and candidate as independent knowledge bases. CEF generates verifiable questions from each text and performs a cross-examination to derive three interpretable scores: Coverage, Conformity, and Consistency. Validated across translation, summarization and clinical note-generation, our framework identifies critical errors, such as content omissions and factual contradictions, missed by standard metrics. A key contribution is a systematic robustness analysis to select a stable judge model. Crucially, the strong correlation between our reference-free and with-reference modes validates CEF’s reliability without gold references. Furthermore, human expert validation demonstrates that CEF mismatching questions align with meaning-altering semantic errors higher than with non-semantic errors, particularly excelling at identifying entity-based and relational distortions.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的评估指标如BLEU和BERTScore在生成式文本到文本任务中无法准确捕捉语义的忠实度。我们采用了交叉检验框架（CEF）来进行无参照的多维评估，将源文本和候选文本视为独立的知识库。CEF能够从每段文本中生成可验证的问题，并通过交叉检验得出三个可解释的评分指标：覆盖度、一致性以及稳定性。我们的框架在翻译、摘要生成以及临床笔记生成等任务中得到了验证，能够识别出标准指标未能发现的重大错误，比如内容缺失、事实矛盾等问题。我们的一个关键贡献是进行了系统的鲁棒性分析，以选择稳定的评判模型。重要的是，无参照模式与有参照模式之间的强相关性证明了CEF在没有黄金参考数据的情况下也能保持可靠性。此外，人类专家验证表明，CEF所提出的问题更多地指向那些会改变意义的语义错误，而非非语义错误。特别是在识别基于实体和关系的扭曲问题上，CEF表现得尤为出色。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AlignCultura: Towards Culturally Aligned Large Language Models?
papers.title_zh: AlignCultura：走向与文化相契合的大型语言模型？
papers.authors: Gautam Siddharth Kashyap, Mark Dras, Usman Naseem
papers.abstract: Cultural alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for producing contextually aware, respectful, and trustworthy outputs. Without it, models risk generating stereotyped, insensitive, or misleading responses that fail to reflect cultural diversity w.r.t Helpful, Harmless, and Honest (HHH) paradigm. Existing benchmarks represent early steps toward cultural alignment; yet, no benchmarks currently enables systematic evaluation of cultural alignment in line with UNESCO’s principles of cultural diversity w.r.t HHH paradigm. Therefore, to address this gap, we built Align-Cultura, two-stage pipeline for cultural alignment. Stage I constructs CULTURAX, the HHH-English dataset grounded in the UNESCO cultural taxonomy, through Query Construction, which reclassifies prompts, expands underrepresented domains (or labels), and prevents data leakage with SimHash. Then, Response Generation pairs prompts with culturally grounded responses via two-stage rejection sampling. The final dataset contains 1,500 samples spanning 30 subdomains of tangible and intangible cultural forms. Stage II benchmarks CULTURAX on general-purpose models, culturally fine-tuned models, and open-weight LLMs (Qwen3-8B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B). Empirically, culturally fine-tuned models improve joint HHH by 4%–6%, reduce cultural failures by 18%, achieve 10%–12% efficiency gains, and limit leakage to 0.3%.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中，文化对齐对于生成具有情境意识、尊重他人且可信赖的输出至关重要。如果没有这种对齐，模型可能会产生刻板、麻木或误导性的回应，从而无法体现与“有益、无害、诚实”原则相关的文化多样性。现有的评估基准只是实现文化对齐的初步尝试；然而，目前还没有任何基准能够系统地评估符合联合国教科文组织文化多样性原则的文化对齐情况。因此，为了填补这一空白，我们开发了Align-Cultura这个两阶段的文化对齐流程。第一阶段通过查询构建来创建CULTURAX数据集，该数据集基于联合国教科文组织的文化分类体系，包括对提示进行重新分类、扩展代表性不足的领域以及使用SimHash技术防止数据泄露。然后，第二阶段通过两阶段拒绝采样机制，将提示与具有文化内涵的回应相结合。最终的数据集包含1500个样本，涵盖了30个有形和无形文化领域的子领域。该基准测试将CULTURAX应用于通用模型、经过文化微调的模型以及开放式的大语言模型（如Qwen3-8B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B）。实验结果表明，经过文化微调的模型能够将整体“有益、无害、诚实”指标提高4%到6%，减少文化方面的错误率18%，提升效率达10%到12%，并将数据泄露率控制在0.3%以下。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: UPDESH: Synthesizing Grounded Instruction Tuning Data for 13 Indic Languages
papers.title_zh: UPDESH：为13种印度语系整合基于实际使用的教学调整数据
papers.authors: Pranjal A Chitale, Varun Gumma, Sanchit Ahuja, Prashant Kodali, Manan Uppadhyay, Deepthi Sudharsan, Sunayana Sitaram
papers.abstract: Developing culturally grounded multilingual AI systems remains challenging, particularly for low-resource languages. While synthetic data offers promise, its effectiveness in multilingual and multicultural contexts is underexplored. We investigate bottom-up synthetic data generation using large open-source LLMs (>= 235B parameters) grounded in language-specific Wikipedia content, complementing dominant top-down translation-based approaches from English. We introduce Updesh, a high-quality large-scale synthetic instruction-following dataset comprising 9.5M data points across 13 Indian languages and English, encompassing diverse reasoning and generative tasks emphasizing on enhancing long-context and multi-turn capabilities while improving alignment with Indian cultural contexts. Comprehensive evaluation using automated metrics and 10K human assessments confirms high data quality. Downstream evaluations performed by fine-tuning models on various datasets and assessing performance across 13 diverse multilingual datasets and model comparative evaluations, demonstrate that models trained on Updesh consistently obtain significant improvements on NLG tasks and remain competitive on NLU tasks. Improvements are most pronounced for low and medium-resource languages, effectively narrowing performance gaps with high-resource languages. Our findings provide empirical evidence that effective multilingual AI development requires multi-faceted, culturally grounded data curation strategies beyond translation-based approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 开发具有文化根基的多语言人工智能系统仍然面临挑战，尤其是对于资源匮乏的语言而言。虽然合成数据具有潜力，但其在多语言和多元文化环境中的有效性尚未得到充分探索。我们采用自下而上的合成数据生成方法，利用大型开源大语言模型（参数数量超过2350亿），这些模型以特定语言的维基百科内容为基础进行训练，以此补充基于英语的自上而下的翻译方法。我们提出了Updesh这一高质量的大规模合成指令遵循数据集，该数据集包含950万个数据点，涵盖13种印度语言和英语，涵盖了多种推理和生成任务，旨在提升模型处理长上下文和多轮对话的能力，同时增强其与印度文化背景的契合度。通过自动化评估指标和1万次人工评估，确认了该数据集的高质量。通过在各种数据集上对模型进行微调，并评估其在13种不同多语言数据集上的性能，以及模型之间的比较评估，我们发现使用Updesh训练的模型在自然语言生成任务上取得了显著的改进，并且在自然语言理解任务上仍然具有竞争力。对于资源较少和中等资源的语言来说，这种改进尤为明显，有效缩小了与资源丰富的语言之间的性能差距。我们的研究结果表明，要实现有效的多语言人工智能发展，除了基于翻译的方法之外，还需要采取多方面的、具有文化根基的数据管理策略。

papers.title: Dynamic Generation of Multi LLM Agents Communication Topologies with Graph Diffusion Models
papers.title_zh: 利用图扩散模型动态生成多LLM智能体之间的通信拓扑结构
papers.authors: Eric Hanchen Jiang, Levina Li, Frank Wan, Xiao Liang, Sophia Yin, Yuchen Wu, Xinfeng Li, Yizhou Sun, Wei Wang, Kai-Wei Chang, Ying Nian Wu
papers.abstract: The efficiency of multi-agent systems driven by large language models (LLMs) largely hinges on their communication topology. However, designing an optimal topology is a non-trivial challenge, as it requires balancing competing objectives such as task performance, communication cost, and robustness. Existing frameworks often rely on static or hand-crafted topologies, which inherently fail to adapt to diverse task requirements, leading to either excessive token consumption for simple problems or performance bottlenecks for complex ones. To address this challenge, we introduce a novel generative framework called Guided Topology Diffusion (GTD). Inspired by conditional discrete graph diffusion models, GTD formulates topology synthesis as an iterative construction process. At each step, the generation is steered by a lightweight proxy model that predicts multi-objective rewards (e.g., accuracy, utility, cost), enabling real-time, gradient-free optimization towards task-adaptive topologies. This iterative, guided synthesis process distinguishes GTD from single-step generative frameworks, enabling it to better navigate complex design trade-offs. We validated GTD across multiple benchmarks, and experiments show that this framework can generate highly task-adaptive, sparse, and efficient communication topologies, significantly outperforming existing methods in LLM agent collaboration. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/diffusion_agent-953C.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的多智能体系统的效率，在很大程度上取决于它们的通信拓扑结构。然而，设计最优的拓扑结构并非易事，因为这需要平衡多个目标：任务性能、通信成本以及系统的鲁棒性。现有的框架往往依赖于静态或手工设计的拓扑结构，这些结构无法适应多样化的任务需求，导致在简单问题上会出现过多的token消耗，而在复杂问题上则可能出现性能瓶颈。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种名为“引导拓扑扩散”的新生成式框架。该框架借鉴了条件离散图扩散模型的理念，将拓扑结构的合成过程转化为一个迭代构建的过程。在每一步中，生成的拓扑结构都由一种轻量级的代理模型来指导，该模型能够预测多种目标奖励（如准确性、效用、成本等），从而实现实时、无梯度优化的拓扑结构优化。这种迭代式的引导合成过程使得GTD能够与单步生成式框架区分开来，使其能够更好地处理复杂的设计权衡问题。我们在多个基准测试中对GTD进行了验证，实验结果表明，该框架能够生成高度适应任务的、稀疏且高效的通信拓扑结构，其性能明显优于现有的LLM智能体协作方法。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/diffusion_agent-953C获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TaxPraBen: A Scalable Benchmark for Structured Evaluation of LLMs in Chinese Real-World Tax Practice
papers.title_zh: TaxPraBen：一种可扩展的基准测试方法，用于结构化评估大型语言模型在现实中国的税务实践中的应用效果
papers.authors: Gang Hu, Yating Chen, Haiyan Ding, Wang Gao, Huang Jiajia, Min Peng, Qianqian Xie, Kun Yue
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in various general domains, they exhibit notable gaps in the highly specialized, knowledge-intensive, and legally regulated Chinese tax domain. Consequently, while tax-related benchmarks are gaining attention, many focus on isolated NLP tasks, neglecting real-world practical capabilities. To address this issue, we introduce TaxPraBen, the first dedicated benchmark for Chinese taxation practice. It combines 10 traditional application tasks, along with 3 pioneering real-world scenarios: tax risk prevention, tax inspection analysis, and tax strategy planning, sourced from 14 datasets totaling 7.3K instances. TaxPraBen features a scalable structured evaluation paradigm designed through process of “structured parsing—field alignment extraction—numerical and textual matching”, enabling end-to-end tax practice assessment while being extensible to other domains. We evaluate 19 LLMs based on Bloom’s taxonomy. The results indicate significant performance disparities: all closed-source large-parameter LLMs excel, and Chinese LLMs like Qwen2.5 generally exceed multilingual LLMs, while the YaYi2 LLM, fine-tuned with some tax data, shows only limited improvement. TaxPraBen[https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TaxPraBen/] serves as a vital resource for advancing evaluations of LLMs in practical applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在多个通用领域表现出色，但在高度专业化的、需要大量知识的、且受法律监管的中国税务领域，它们存在明显的不足。因此，尽管与税务相关的基准测试受到了关注，但许多研究仅专注于孤立的自然语言处理任务，而忽视了实际应用场景中的能力。为了解决这一问题，我们推出了TaxPraBen——首个专为中国税务实践设计的基准测试。该测试结合了10个传统应用任务以及3个现实场景：税务风险预防、税务检查分析以及税务策略规划，这些场景来自14个数据集，共计7.3K个实例。TaxPraBen采用了一种可扩展的结构化评估范式，通过“结构化解析—字段对齐提取—数值和文本匹配”的过程来实现端到端的税务实践评估，同时该框架还可以扩展到其他领域。我们对19种基于布卢姆分类法的语言模型进行了评估。结果表明，各模型的性能存在显著差异：所有开源的大型参数语言模型表现优异，而像Qwen2.5这样的中文语言模型通常优于多语言语言模型；而经过一些税务数据训练的YaYi2语言模型则仅有有限的改进。TaxPraBen[https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TaxPraBen/]为评估语言模型在实际应用中的表现提供了重要的资源。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Think How to Think: Mitigating Overthinking with Autonomous Difficulty Cognition in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 思考的方式：通过大型推理模型中自主的难度感知功能来减少过度思考
papers.authors: Yongjiang Liu, Haoxi Li, Xiaosong Ma, Jie Zhang, Song Guo
papers.abstract: Recent Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel at complex reasoning tasks but often suffer from overthinking, generating overly long and redundant reasoning trajectories. To explore its essence, our empirical analysis reveals that LRMs are primarily limited to recognizing task properties (i.e., difficulty levels) like humans before solving the problem, leading to a one-size-fits-all reasoning strategy. This observation motivates a fundamental question: Can we explicitly bootstrap such ability to alleviate overthinking in LRMs? To this end, we propose Think-How-to-Think (TH2T), a novel two-stage fine-tuning strategy that progressively inspires LRMs’ difficulty cognition and redundancy cognition of LRMs. Specifically, we first inject Difficulty Dypnosis into output prefixes as cues for global, prospective reasoning strategy selection, stimulating the model’s sharper sensitivity to task complexity and adaptive control of reasoning depth. Then, we incorporate Redundancy Hypnosis into in-progress reasoning steps, which serve as local, retrospective signals for behavior correction by identifying and eliminating superfluous reasoning detours. Experiments across 7B/14B/32B models demonstrate that TH2T significantly reduces inference costs by over 70% on easy tasks and 40% on complex ones without compromising performance. The resultant models exhibit a nascent ability for difficulty-aware reasoning, effectively mitigating behaviors like excessive reflection and looping, thereby paving the way for more cognitively efficient LRMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近出现的复杂推理模型在解决复杂推理任务时表现出色，但往往会出现过度思考的问题，导致生成的推理路径过长且冗余。通过实证分析我们发现，这些模型在解决问题之前，主要局限于识别任务的属性（即难度等级），从而采用了一种一刀切的推理策略。这一发现引发了一个基本问题：我们能否明确地引导这些模型来避免过度思考？为此，我们提出了“思考-如何思考-再思考”这一新颖的两阶段微调策略。具体来说，我们首先将“难度催眠”注入输出前缀中，作为全局性推理策略选择的线索，从而提升模型对任务复杂度的感知能力，并使其能够自适应地调整推理深度。接着，我们将“冗余催眠”融入正在进行的推理过程中，作为局部性的回顾信号，用于纠正不必要的推理路径。在7B/14B/32B规模的模型中进行的实验表明，采用TH2T策略后，简单任务的推理成本降低了70%以上，而复杂任务的推理成本则降低了40%左右，同时模型的性能并未受到负面影响。结果表明，这种策略使得模型具备了一定的难度感知能力，有效避免了过度反思和循环推理等行为，为更高效的推理模型奠定了基础。

papers.title: Theory-optimal Quantization Based on Flatness
papers.title_zh: 基于平坦性的理论最优量化方法
papers.authors: Xiusheng Huang, Zhe Li, Xuanwu Yin, Lu Wang, Yequan Wang, Dong Li, Emad Barsoum, Kang Liu
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization has emerged as a widely adopted technique for compressing and accelerating the inference of Large Language Models (LLMs). The primary challenges in LLMs quantization stem from activation outliers, which significantly degrade model performance especially at lower bit precision. While recent approaches attempt to mitigate outliers through linear transformations across feature dimensions, our analysis reveals that the transformed weights and activations still exhibit persistent outlier patterns with concentrated magnitude distributions. In this paper, we first model the mathematical relationship between quantization error and outliers, and then introduce a new metric Flatness to quantify the distribution of outliers. Based on this, we derive the theoretical optimal solution with respect to Flatness. Building on these insights, we propose Bidirectional Diagonal Quantization (BDQ), a novel post-training quantization framework that effectively disperses outlier patterns through optimized matrix transformations. BDQ strategically distributes outlier magnitudes across matrix dimensions via learned diagonal operations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BDQ establishes a new quantization benchmark. It achieves less than 1% accuracy drop in W4A4 quantization on the LLaMA-3-8B model. In the more challenging W2A4KV16 experiment, compared to state-of-the-art approaches, BDQ reduces the performance gap by 39.1% on the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-70B model.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练后量化技术已成为压缩和加速大语言模型推理过程的常用方法。大语言模型量化的主要挑战源于激活值的异常值问题，这些异常值会显著降低模型的性能，尤其是在较低比特精度的情况下。虽然近期的一些方法试图通过特征维度的线性变换来减轻异常值的影响，但我们的分析表明，经过变换后的权重和激活值仍然存在持续的异常值现象，且这些异常值的幅度分布较为集中。在本文中，我们首先建立了量化误差与异常值之间的数学关系模型，然后引入了一个新的指标——平坦度，用于量化异常值的分布情况。基于这一模型，我们推导出了关于平坦度的理论最优解。在此基础上，我们提出了双向对角量化技术，这是一种新颖的训练后量化框架，它通过优化的矩阵变换有效地分散了异常值。双向对角量化技术通过学习到的对角操作，策略性地将异常值的幅度分布在各个矩阵维度上分配。大量的实验表明，双向对角量化技术建立了一个新的量化基准。在LLaMA-3-8B模型的W4A4量化过程中，其准确率下降幅度不到1%。在更具挑战性的W2A4KV16实验中，与现有最先进的方法相比，双向对角量化技术在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-70B模型上的性能提升幅度达到了39.1%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When Background Matters: Breaking Medical Vision Language Models by Transferable Attack
papers.title_zh: 当背景变得重要时：通过可迁移攻击突破医学领域的视觉语言模型
papers.authors: Akash Ghosh, Subhadip Baidya, Sriparna Saha, Xiuying Chen
papers.abstract: Vision–Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used in clinical diagnostics, yet their robustness to adversarial attacks remains largely unexplored, posing serious risks. Existing medical attacks focus on secondary objectives such as model stealing or adversarial fine-tuning, while transferable attacks from natural images introduce visible distortions that clinicians can easily detect. To address this, we propose MedFocusLeak, a highly transferable black-box multimodal attack that induces incorrect yet clinically plausible diagnoses while keeping perturbations imperceptible. The method injects coordinated perturbations into non-diagnostic background regions and employs an attention-distraction mechanism to shift the model’s focus away from pathological areas. Extensive evaluations across six medical imaging modalities show that MedFocusLeak achieves state-of-the-art performance, generating misleading yet realistic diagnostic outputs across diverse VLMs. We further introduce a unified evaluation framework with novel metrics that jointly capture attack success and image fidelity, revealing a critical weakness in the reasoning capabilities of modern clinical VLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型在临床诊断中得到了广泛应用，然而它们对对抗性攻击的鲁棒性仍然缺乏研究，这带来了严重的风险。现有的医学攻击主要集中在诸如模型窃取或对抗性微调等次要目标上，而来自自然图像的可转移攻击则会导致明显的失真，这些失真很容易被临床医生察觉。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了MedFocusLeak这一高度可转移的黑盒多模态攻击方法。该攻击能够产生错误但具有临床合理性的诊断结果，同时使扰动效果难以被察觉。该方法会在非诊断背景区域注入协调一致的扰动，并采用注意力分散机制来转移模型的注意力焦点，使其不关注病理区域。在六种医学影像模式下的广泛评估表明，MedFocusLeak取得了领先的性能水平，能够生成具有误导性的但真实的诊断结果，适用于多种视觉-语言模型。我们还引入了一个统一的评估框架，采用新的指标来同时衡量攻击的成功率和图像的准确性，从而揭示了现代临床视觉-语言模型在推理能力方面的关键弱点。

papers.title: Tears or Cheers? Benchmarking LLMs via Culturally Elicited Distinct Affective Responses
papers.title_zh: 泪水还是欢呼声？通过文化上不同的情感反应来比较大型语言模型的性能
papers.authors: Chongyuan Dai, Yaling Shen, Zihan Gao, Jia Li, Yishun Jiang, Yaxiong Wang, Liu Liu, Zongyuan Ge, Jinpeng Hu
papers.abstract: Culture serves as a fundamental determinant of human affective processing and profoundly shapes how individuals perceive and interpret emotional stimuli. Despite this intrinsic link extant evaluations regarding cultural alignment within Large Language Models primarily prioritize declarative knowledge such as geographical facts or established societal customs. These benchmarks remain insufficient to capture the subjective interpretative variance inherent to diverse sociocultural lenses. To address this limitation, we introduce CEDAR, a multimodal benchmark constructed entirely from scenarios capturing Culturally Elicited Distinct Affective Responses. To construct CEDAR, we implement a novel pipeline that leverages LLM-generated provisional labels to isolate instances yielding cross-cultural emotional distinctions, and subsequently derives reliable ground-truth annotations through rigorous human evaluation. The resulting benchmark comprises 10,962 instances across seven languages and 14 fine-grained emotion categories, with each language including 400 multimodal and 1,166 text-only samples. Comprehensive evaluations of 17 representative multilingual models reveal a dissociation between language consistency and cultural alignment, demonstrating that culturally grounded affective understanding remains a significant challenge for current models.
papers.abstract_zh: 文化是人类情感处理的基本决定因素，它深刻地影响着人们感知和解读情感信息的方式。尽管存在这种内在联系，但关于大语言模型中文化一致性评估的研究往往只关注那些陈述性知识，比如地理事实或既定的社会习俗。这些评估标准不足以捕捉不同社会文化背景下所存在的主观解读差异。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了CEDAR这个多模态基准测试，该测试完全基于能够捕捉文化引发的不同情感反应的场景来构建。为了构建CEDAR，我们采用了一种新颖的方法：利用LLM生成的临时标签来筛选出具有跨文化情感差异的实例，然后通过严格的人工评估来获得可靠的真实标注数据。最终得到的基准测试包含10,962个实例，涉及七种语言以及14个细分的情感类别。每种语言都有400个多模态样本和1,166个纯文本样本。对17种代表性多语言模型的全面评估表明，语言一致性与文化一致性之间存在脱节现象，这进一步证明了对于当前模型来说，基于文化的情感理解仍然是一个重大挑战。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Emergent Misalignment via In-Context Learning: Narrow in-context examples can produce broadly misaligned LLMs
papers.title_zh: 通过上下文学习导致的错位现象：有限的上下文示例可能会导致大型语言模型产生严重的错误对齐问题
papers.authors: Nikita Afonin, Nikita Andriianov, Vahagn Hovhannisyan, Nikhil Bageshpura, Kyle Liu, Kevin Zhu, Sunishchal Dev, Ashwinee Panda, Oleg Rogov, Elena Tutubalina, Alexander Panchenko, Mikhail Seleznyov
papers.abstract: Recent work has shown that narrow finetuning can produce broadly misaligned LLMs, a phenomenon termed emergent misalignment (EM). While concerning, these findings were limited to finetuning and activation steering, leaving out in-context learning (ICL). We therefore ask: does EM emerge in ICL? We find that it does: across four model families (Gemini, Kimi-K2, Grok, and Qwen), narrow in-context examples cause models to produce misaligned responses to benign, unrelated queries. With 16 in-context examples, EM rates range from 1% to 24% depending on model and domain, appearing with as few as 2 examples. Neither larger model scale nor explicit reasoning provides reliable protection, and larger models are typically even more susceptible. Next, we formulate and test a hypothesis, which explains in-context EM as conflict between safety objectives and context-following behavior. Consistent with this, instructing models to prioritize safety reduces EM while prioritizing context-following increases it. These findings establish ICL as a previously underappreciated vector for emergent misalignment that resists simple scaling-based solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，过于精细的微调可能会导致大语言模型产生严重的对齐问题，这种现象被称为“ emergent misalignment”（EM）。尽管这些发现很有意义，但它们仅限于微调和技术上的激活引导调整，而忽略了上下文学习这一关键因素。因此，我们提出这样一个问题：在上下文学习中是否也会出现EM现象？我们发现确实如此：在四种模型家族（Gemini、Kimi-K2、Grok和Qwen）中，有限的上下文示例会导致模型对无关紧要的查询产生错误的响应。当使用16个上下文示例时，EM的发生率从1%到24%不等，具体取决于模型和领域；而使用较少的2个示例时，EM的发生率则更低。无论是更大的模型规模还是明确的推理机制都无法提供可靠的防护效果，而且较大的模型通常更容易受到EM的影响。接下来，我们提出并验证了一个假设：上下文中的EM是由于安全目标与遵循上下文的行为之间的冲突所导致的。这一假设与我们的研究结果一致：指示模型优先考虑安全会降低EM的发生率，而优先考虑遵循上下文则会增加EM的发生率。这些发现表明，上下文学习是导致EM现象的一个重要因素，而这一因素很难通过简单的扩展解决方案来解决。

papers.title: EvoRoute: Experience-Driven Self-Routing LLM Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: EvoRoute：以用户体验为驱动的自动路由大语言模型代理系统
papers.authors: Guibin Zhang, Haiyang Yu, Kaiming Yang, Bingli Wu, Fei Huang, Yongbin Li, Shuicheng Yan
papers.abstract: Complex agentic AI systems, powered by a coordinated ensemble of Large Language Models (LLMs), tool and memory modules, have demonstrated remarkable capabilities on intricate, multi-turn tasks. However, this success is shadowed by prohibitive economic costs and severe latency, exposing a critical, yet underexplored, trade-off. We formalize this challenge as the Agent System Trilemma: the inherent tension among achieving state-of-the-art performance, minimizing monetary cost, and ensuring rapid task completion. To dismantle this trilemma, we introduce EvoRoute, a self-evolving model routing paradigm that transcends static, pre-defined model assignments. Leveraging an ever-expanding knowledge base of prior experience, EvoRoute dynamically selects Pareto-optimal LLM backbones at each step, balancing accuracy, efficiency, and resource use, while continually refining its own selection policy through environment feedback. Experiments on challenging agentic benchmarks such as GAIA and BrowseComp+ demonstrate that EvoRoute, when integrated into off-the-shelf agentic systems, not only sustains or enhances system performance but also reduces execution cost by up to 80% and latency by over 70%.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型、工具和记忆模块协同构成的复杂智能体人工智能系统，在复杂的多轮任务中展现出了惊人的能力。然而，这种成功伴随着高昂的经济成本和严重的延迟问题，这揭示了一个关键但未被充分探索的权衡问题。我们将这一挑战定义为“智能体系统三难困境”：即在实现最先进的性能、最小化经济成本以及确保任务快速完成之间存在的内在矛盾。为了破解这一三难困境，我们提出了EvoRoute模型路由范式。该范式能够超越静态的、预先定义好的模型分配方式，利用不断扩展的先前经验知识库，在每一步都动态选择帕累托最优的大语言模型作为基础模型，从而平衡准确性、效率和资源使用效率。通过不断根据环境反馈调整自身的选择策略，EvoRoute能够在集成到现成的智能体系统中时，不仅提升系统的性能，还能将执行成本降低80%，延迟时间减少70%以上。在GAIA和BrowseComp+等具有挑战性的智能体基准测试中的实验表明，EvoRoute确实能够发挥重要作用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Foresight Optimization for Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中的前瞻性优化策略推理
papers.authors: Jessie Wang, Jiawen Duan, Jian Wang, Kaitao Song, Chunpu Xu, Johnny K. W. Ho, YU Fenggang, Johan F. Hoorn, Wenjie Li
papers.abstract: Reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) have generally advanced significantly. However, it is still challenging for existing reasoning-based LLMs to perform effective decision-making abilities in multi-agent environments, due to the absence of explicit foresight modeling. To this end, strategic reasoning, the most fundamental capability to anticipate the counterpart’s behaviors and foresee its possible future actions, has been introduced to alleviate the above issues. Strategic reasoning is fundamental to effective decision-making in multi-agent environments, yet existing reasoning enhancement methods for LLMs do not explicitly capture its foresight nature. In this work, we introduce Foresight Policy Optimization (FoPO) to enhance strategic reasoning in LLMs, which integrates opponent modeling principles into policy optimization, thereby enabling explicit consideration of both self-interest and counterpart influence. Specifically, we construct two curated datasets, namely Cooperative RSA and Competitive Taboo, equipped with well-designed rules and moderate difficulty to facilitate a systematic investigation of FoPO in a self-play framework. Our experiments demonstrate that FoPO significantly enhances strategic reasoning across LLMs of varying sizes and origins. Moreover, models trained with FoPO exhibit strong generalization to out-of-domain strategic scenarios, substantially outperforming standard LLM reasoning optimization baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力已经取得了显著的进步。然而，由于缺乏明确的预见性建模，现有的基于推理的LLMs在多智能体环境中进行有效决策仍然具有挑战性。为此，我们引入了战略推理这一能力，它能够预测对手的行为并预见其可能的未来行动，从而缓解上述问题。战略推理是多智能体环境中进行有效决策的基础，但现有的LLM推理增强方法并未明确体现其预见性特征。在这项研究中，我们提出了Foresight Policy Optimization（FoPO）方法来增强LLMs的战略推理能力，该方法将对手建模原理融入策略优化过程中，从而能够同时考虑自身利益和对手的影响。具体来说，我们构建了两个经过精心设计的数据集，分别是Cooperative RSA和Competitive Taboo，这些数据集具有合理的规则设计以及适度的难度，有助于在自对弈框架内系统地研究FoPO。我们的实验表明，FoPO显著提升了不同规模和来源的LLMs的战略推理能力。此外，使用FoPO训练的模型能够在非领域战略场景中表现出强大的泛化能力，其性能明显优于标准的LLM推理优化基线模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DetectRL-X: Towards Reliable Multilingual and Real-World LLM-Generated Text Detection
papers.title_zh: DetectRL-X：迈向可靠的多语言文本检测——基于大语言模型的技术方案
papers.authors: Junchao Wu, Yefeng Liu, Chenyu Zhu, Hao Zhang, Zeyu Wu, Tianqi Shi, Yichao Du, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Jinsong Su, Derek F. Wong
papers.abstract: The effective detection and governance of Large Language Model (LLM) generated content has become increasingly critical due to the growing risk of misuse. Despite the impressive performance of existing detectors, their reliability and potential in multilingual, real-world scenarios remain largely underexplored.In this study, we introduce DetectRL-X, a comprehensive multilingual benchmark designed to evaluate advanced detectors across 8 dimensions. The benchmark encompasses 8 languages commonly used in commercial contexts and collects human-written texts from 6 domains highly susceptible to LLM misuse. To better aligned with real-world applications, We create LLM-generated texts using 4 popular commercial LLMs, and include typical AI-assisted writing operations such as polishing, expanding, and condensing to capture authentic usage patterns. Furthermore, we develop a multilingual framework for paraphrasing and perturbation attacks to simulate diverse human modifications and writing noise, enabling stress testing of detectors across languages.Experimental results on DetectRL-X reveal the strengths and limitations of current state-of-the-art detectors when applied to diverse linguistic resources. We further analyze how domains, generators, attack strategies, text length, and refinement operations influence performance in different languages, underscoring DetectRL-X as an effective benchmark for strengthening multilingual and language-specific detectors.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于大语言模型生成内容被滥用的风险日益增加，对其的有效检测与管控变得至关重要。尽管现有检测器表现优异，但其在多语言、现实场景中的可靠性和潜力仍未被充分探索。在本研究中，我们提出了DetectRL-X这一全面的多语言基准测试，旨在从8个维度评估先进检测器性能。该基准测试涵盖了商业场景中常用的8种语言，并收集了来自6个易被大语言模型滥用的领域的文本样本。为了更贴近现实应用，我们使用4种流行的商业大语言模型生成文本，并纳入了润色、扩展和压缩等常见的AI辅助写作操作，以捕捉真实的使用模式。此外，我们还开发了一个用于释义和干扰攻击的多语言框架，以模拟各种人为修改和写作噪声，从而在不同语言中对检测器进行压力测试。在DetectRL-X上的实验结果表明，当前最先进的检测器在应用于不同语言资源时存在优缺点。我们进一步分析了领域特征、生成器类型、攻击策略、文本长度以及优化操作等因素对不同语言性能的影响，从而证明了DetectRL-X作为加强多语言和特定语言检测器的有效基准测试的价值。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ImmersiveTTS: Environment-Aware Text-to-Speech with Multimodal Diffusion Transformer and Domain-Specific Representation Alignment
papers.title_zh: 沉浸式TTS：基于环境感知的文本转语音技术，采用多模态扩散变换器模型，并具备领域特定的表示对齐机制
papers.authors: Jun-Hak Yun, Seung-Bin Kim, Seong-Whan Lee
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in text-guided audio generation have yielded promising results in diverse domains, including sound effects, speech, and music. However, jointly generating speech with environmental audio remains challenging due to the inherent disparities in their acoustic patterns and temporal dynamics. We propose ImmersiveTTS, an environment-aware text-to-speech (TTS) model that generates natural speech seamlessly integrated within environmental contexts by explicitly modeling cross-modal interactions. Our model builds on a multimodal diffusion transformer and fuses transcript-aligned speech latent with text-conditioned environmental context via joint attention. To enhance semantic consistency, we introduce a domain-specific representation alignment objective tailored to environment-aware TTS, leveraging complementary self-supervised representations from speech and audio encoders. Experimental results show that ImmersiveTTS achieves higher naturalness, intelligibility, and audio fidelity than existing approaches across objective metrics and human listening tests.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在文本引导的音频生成领域取得了显著进展，这些成果在多种领域都表现出了良好的效果，包括音效、语音和音乐等方面。然而，将语音与环境音频共同生成仍然具有挑战性，因为这两种音频在声学模式和时间动态上存在显著差异。我们提出了ImmersiveTTS模型，这是一种注重环境的文本转语音模型，它能够通过明确建模跨模态交互，将自然语音无缝地融入环境背景中。我们的模型基于多模态扩散变换器构建，并通过联合注意力机制将与文本对齐的语音潜在表示与环境上下文融合在一起。为了增强语义一致性，我们引入了一个针对环境感知文本转语音任务而设计的特定领域表示对齐目标，利用来自语音和音频编码器的互补自监督表示。实验结果表明，ImmersiveTTS在自然度、可懂度和音频质量方面均优于现有方法，无论是在客观指标还是人类听觉测试中都表现出了卓越的性能。

papers.title: When Efficiency Becomes a Vulnerability: Computational Cost Attacks on WebAgents
papers.title_zh: 当效率成为漏洞：针对WebAgent的计算成本攻击
papers.authors: Liang-Bo Ning, Yuchen Zhu, Heqing Huang, Xin Wang, Yi Chang, Li Qing, Wenqi Fan
papers.abstract: WebAgents have demonstrated strong capabilities in autonomously completing complex web tasks, yet their computational efficiency vulnerabilities have received limited attention. Adversaries can inject malicious prompts into web pages, causing WebAgents to generate unnecessarily long reasoning processes and incur excessive computational cost, termed Computational Cost Attacks (CCA). In this paper, to systematically study this vulnerability under realistic black-box settings, we propose CostBomb, a generation-then-selection attack framework that leverages large language models to generate diverse adversarial prompts and a reinforcement learning–enhanced selector to identify the most effective perturbations. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world web benchmarks reveal that existing WebAgents are highly vulnerable to CCA, suffering substantial increases in computational cost without compromising successful task completion. Our findings highlight an overlooked dimension of WebAgent robustness and underscore the urgent need for efficiency-aware defenses.
papers.abstract_zh: WebAgents在自主完成复杂网络任务方面表现出强大的能力，然而其计算效率方面的漏洞却受到了有限的关注。攻击者可以将恶意提示注入网页中，导致WebAgents生成不必要的冗长推理过程，从而引发过高的计算成本，这种现象被称为计算成本攻击（CCA）。在本文中，为了系统地研究这一漏洞在实际的黑盒环境中的表现，我们提出了CostBomb攻击框架。该框架利用大语言模型生成多样化的对抗性提示，并通过强化学习技术来识别最有效的干扰手段。在多个真实世界的网络基准测试中的大量实验表明，现有的WebAgents极易受到CCA的影响，其计算成本会显著上升，但任务完成的成功率却并未受到影响。我们的研究结果揭示了WebAgents鲁棒性的一个被忽视的方面，并强调了开发注重效率的防御机制的紧迫性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Evolving Beyond Snapshots: Harmonizing Structure and Sequence via Entity State Tuning for Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting
papers.title_zh: 超越快照：通过实体状态调优实现结构与序列的协调，以用于时间感知的知识图谱预测
papers.authors: Siyuan Li, Yunjia Wu, Yiyong Xiao, Pingyang Huang, Peize Li, Ruitong Liu, Yan Wen, Te Sun
papers.abstract: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) forecasting requires predicting future facts by jointly modeling structural dependencies within each snapshot and temporal evolution across snapshots. However, most existing methods are stateless: they recompute entity representations at each timestamp from a limited query window, leading to episodic amnesia and rapid decay of long-term dependencies. To address this limitation, we propose Entity State Tuning (EST), an encoder-agnostic framework that endows TKG forecasters with persistent and continuously evolving entity states. EST maintains a global state buffer and progressively aligns structural evidence with sequential signals via a closed-loop design. Specifically, a topology-aware state perceiver first injects entity-state priors into structural encoding. Then, a unified temporal context module aggregates the state-enhanced events with a pluggable sequence backbone. Subsequently, a dual-track evolution mechanism writes the updated context back to the global entity state memory, balancing plasticity against stability. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that EST consistently improves diverse backbones and achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the importance of state persistence for long-horizon TKG forecasting.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间知识图谱（TKG）预测需要通过对每个快照中的结构依赖关系以及各快照之间的时间演变进行联合建模，来预测未来的事实。然而，目前大多数方法都是无状态的：它们会在每个时间戳上重新计算实体表示，这会导致阶段性记忆丧失以及长期依赖关系的快速衰减。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了“实体状态调整”框架——这是一种与编码器无关的框架，它能够为TKG预测器提供持久且不断演变的实体状态。该框架维护一个全局状态缓冲区，并通过闭环设计逐步将结构证据与序列信号对齐。具体来说，一个具有拓扑感知的状态感知器首先将实体状态先验信息注入到结构编码中。然后，一个统一的时间上下文模块将经过状态增强的事件与可插拔的序列主干相结合。最后，一种双轨演变机制将更新后的上下文写入到全局实体状态内存中，从而在可塑性与稳定性之间取得平衡。在多个基准测试上的实验表明，“实体状态调整”框架能够持续改善不同主干模型的性能，并达到最先进的预测效果，这凸显了状态持久性对于长视界TKG预测的重要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CodeRipple: Wavelet-Based Detection of LLM-Generated Code
papers.title_zh: CodeRipple：基于小波技术的LLM生成代码检测工具
papers.authors: Xingyu Yao, Zhendong Mao, Quan Wang
papers.abstract: Detecting LLM-generated code is crucial for ensuring software provenance, security, reliability, and licensing compliance. Existing training-free detectors, mostly adapted from text-based methods, rely on global statistics of the Token Perplexity Sequence (TPS) and struggle with code. We reveal a key insight: despite the convergence of global statistics, LLM-generated and human-written code differ fundamentally in their local TPS dynamics: the former shows narrow transient spikes while the latter exhibits broad sustained fluctuations. To capture this distinction, we introduce CodeRipple, a novel training-free detection framework that employs wavelet analysis to characterize TPS morphology across scales. It jointly leverages the Stationary Wavelet Transform to model fluctuation shape and the Discrete Wavelet Transform to quantify cross-scale energy distribution. Evaluated on three challenging benchmarks spanning diverse programming languages, multiple generating LLMs, and various evasion strategies, CodeRipple consistently outperforms existing training-free methods, demonstrating its superior effectiveness and generalizability without any model training. Code available at: https://github.com/yaoxingyu77/CodeRipple.
papers.abstract_zh: 检测由大语言模型生成的代码对于确保软件的来源可追溯性、安全性、可靠性以及合规性至关重要。现有的无需训练的检测器大多基于文本处理方法，它们依赖于令牌困惑序列的全局统计特征，但在处理代码时存在困难。我们发现了一个重要现象：尽管全局统计特征具有一致性，但大语言模型生成的和人类编写的代码的局部TPS动态却存在根本差异——前者表现出狭窄的瞬时峰值，而后者则呈现出广泛的持续波动。为了捕捉这一差异，我们提出了CodeRipple这一新型无需训练的检测框架。该框架采用小波分析来表征不同尺度上的TPS形态，同时利用平稳小波变换来模拟波动形状，并利用离散小波变换来量化跨尺度的能量分布。在涵盖多种编程语言、不同生成大语言模型以及各种规避策略的三个具有挑战性的基准测试中，CodeRipple始终表现出优于现有无需训练方法的性能，证明了其无需任何模型训练即可实现的高效性和通用性。CodeRipple的源代码可访问于：https://github.com/yaoxingyu77/CodeRipple。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PHOTON: Hierarchical Autoregressive Modeling for Lightspeed and Memory-Efficient Language Generation
papers.title_zh: 光子：一种用于高效语言生成的层次性自回归建模方法
papers.authors: Yuma Ichikawa, Naoya Takagi, Takumi Nakagawa, Yuzi Kanazawa, Akira Sakai
papers.abstract: Transformers operate as horizontal token-by-token scanners; at each generation step, attending to an ever-growing sequence of token-level states. This access pattern increases prefill latency and makes long-context decoding more memory-bound, as KV-cache reads and writes dominate inference time over arithmetic operations. We propose Parallel Hierarchical Operation for TOp-down Networks (PHOTON), a hierarchical autoregressive model that replaces horizontal scanning with vertical, multi-resolution context scanning. PHOTON maintains a hierarchy of latent streams: a bottom-up encoder compresses tokens into low-rate contextual states, while lightweight top-down decoders reconstruct fine-grained token representations in parallel. We further introduce recursive generation that updates only the coarsest latent stream and eliminates bottom-up re-encoding. Experimental results show that PHOTON is superior to competitive Transformer-based language models regarding the throughput-quality trade-off, providing advantages in long-context and multi-query tasks. In particular, this reduces decode-time KV-cache traffic, yielding up to 10^{3} \times higher throughput per unit memory.
papers.abstract_zh: Transformer模型以水平逐词扫描的方式运行；在每一代中，都会处理越来越长的词级状态序列。这种访问模式会增加预填充的延迟，并且使得长上下文解码更加依赖内存资源，因为KV缓存的读写操作占据了推理时间的绝大部分。我们提出了一种名为“并行分层操作用于自上而下网络”（PHOTON）的层次化自回归模型。该模型用垂直的多分辨率上下文扫描替代了水平扫描方式。PHOTON通过分层存储潜在流来工作：从下到上的编码器将词符压缩成低频率的上下文状态，而轻量级的自上而下解码器则能够并行地重建细粒度的词符表示。此外，我们还引入了递归生成机制，该机制仅更新最底层潜在流，从而避免了自下而上的重新编码过程。实验结果表明，在吞吐量与质量之间做出权衡时，PHOTON优于其他基于Transformer的语言模型，尤其在处理长上下文和多查询任务时表现出优势。具体来说，这种方法减少了KV缓存的访问次数，使得每单位内存的吞吐量提高了10^3倍。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CoMeT: Collaborative Memory Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling
papers.title_zh: CoMeT：协作式记忆转换器，用于高效处理长上下文建模任务
papers.authors: Runsong Zhao, Shilei Liu, Jiwei Tang, Langming Liu, Haibin Chen, Weidong Zhang, Yujin Yuan, Tong Xiao, JingBo Zhu, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: The quadratic complexity and indefinitely growing key-value (KV) cache of standard Transformers pose a major barrier to long-context processing. To overcome this, we introduce the Collaborative Memory Transformer (CoMeT), a novel architecture that enables LLMs to handle arbitrarily long sequences with constant memory usage and linear time complexity. Designed as an efficient, plug-in module, CoMeT can be integrated into pre-trained models with only minimal fine-tuning. It operates on sequential data chunks, using a dual-memory system to manage context: a temporary memory on a FIFO queue for recent events, and a global memory with a gated update rule for long-range dependencies. These memories then act as a dynamic soft prompt for the next chunk. The effectiveness of our approach is remarkable: a model equipped with CoMeT and fine-tuned on 32k contexts can accurately retrieve a passkey from any position within a 1M token sequence. On the SCROLLS benchmark, CoMeT surpasses other efficient methods and achieves performance comparable to a full-attention baseline on summarization tasks. Its practical effectiveness is further validated on real-world agent and user behavior QA tasks, supported by a novel layer-level pipeline parallel training strategy that enables fine-tuning on extremely long contexts. The code is available at: https://github.com/LivingFutureLab/Comet
papers.abstract_zh: 标准的Transformers模型，其二次方的计算复杂度以及无限增长的键值缓存，严重限制了长上下文处理的能力。为了克服这一难题，我们提出了协作记忆Transformer（CoMeT）这一创新架构。该架构使得大语言模型能够以恒定的内存使用量和线性时间复杂度来处理任意长度的序列数据。CoMeT作为一种高效的插件模块，可以轻松地集成到预训练模型中，只需进行少量的微调即可。它采用顺序数据块进行处理，通过双内存系统来管理上下文：一个用于存储最近事件的临时内存，以及一个具有门控更新规则的全局内存，用于处理长期依赖关系。这些内存可以作为下一个数据块的动态提示。我们的方法效果显著：一个配备了CoMeT且经过32k上下文训练的模型，能够在1M令牌序列中的任何位置准确检索到密钥。在SCROLLS基准测试中，CoMeT的性能优于其他高效方法，并且在摘要任务上的表现与全注意力模型的性能相当。其实用性也在真实世界的智能体与用户行为问答任务中得到验证，这一成果得益于一种创新的层级流水线并行训练策略，该策略使得在极长的上下文中也能进行微调。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/LivingFutureLab/Comet
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CheckRLM: Effective Knowledge–Thought Coherence Checking in Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
papers.title_zh: CheckRLM：在检索增强推理中有效的知识与思维连贯性验证机制
papers.authors: Dingling Xu, Ruobing Wang, Qingfei Zhao, Yukun Yan, Zhichun Wang, Daren Zha, Shi Yu, Zhenghao Liu, Shuo Wang, Xu Han, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) have significantly improved performance on complex tasks by extending the reasoning chain. However, these chains are prone to containing factual errors, particularly in knowledge-intensive tasks. To address this issue, we propose CheckRLM, a framework that improves the reliability of the reasoning process through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) by timely checking and correcting factual errors. Specifically, CheckRLM extracts factual claims from the reasoning chain to identify and localize subtle knowledge inconsistencies during inference. Upon detection of errors, a refinement mechanism performs minimal-cost yet precise corrections by leveraging external knowledge, ensuring coherence between the reasoning chain and correct knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CheckRLM substantially outperforms existing baselines, exhibiting a strong capability to mitigate error accumulation in long-horizon reasoning with lower costs. The code and data are available at https://github.com/AI9Stars/CheckRLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理语言模型通过扩展推理链条，显著提升了在复杂任务上的性能。然而，这些推理链条容易包含事实错误，尤其是在需要大量知识的任务中。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CheckRLM框架。该框架通过检索增强生成技术，通过及时检查和纠正事实错误来提高推理过程的可靠性。具体来说，CheckRLM从推理链条中提取事实性陈述，以便在推理过程中识别并定位细微的知识不一致之处。当检测到错误时，优化机制会利用外部知识进行低成本但精确的修正，从而确保推理链条与正确知识之间的连贯性。大量实验表明，CheckRLM在性能上明显优于现有的基线模型，能够以较低的成本有效减少长期推理过程中的错误累积。代码和数据可在https://github.com/AI9Stars/CheckRLM获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CAMEC: Complexity-Aware Multi-Expert Collaboration for Reliable Chinese Medical Question Answering
papers.title_zh: CAMEC：考虑复杂性的多专家协作系统，以实现可靠的中文医疗问题回答功能
papers.authors: Yukang Wu, Xiyuan Jia, Jiayi Wu, HongChen Yu, Yuhan Qiu, Wu Guohua
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are promising for medical question answering (QA) but remain unreliable in Chinese clinical settings due to hallucinations, weak factual grounding, and difficulty handling clinically complex cases. We propose CAMEC (Complexity-Aware Multi-Expert Collaboration), a framework that combines hierarchical medical adaptation with complexity-aware expert routing for reliable Chinese medical QA. We adopt a three-stage LoRA-based supervised fine-tuning pipeline for domain adaptation, instruction following, and clinical reasoning. At inference, CAMEC routes each query by predicted complexity and selectively recruits three experts: an internal chain-of-thought (CoT) expert, a retrieval-augmented expert over a dense medical vector database, and a knowledge graph (KG) expert over a structured medical knowledge base. An LLM-as-a-Judge module evaluates and critiques expert reports, iteratively refining them into a consensus answer. Experiments on four Chinese medical benchmarks show that CAMEC consistentlyoutperforms strong general and medical LLM baselines, achieving 78.86% (CMExam), 84.15% (MedQA-CN), 78.51% (CMMLU-Med), and 74.40% (CMB-exam), with consistent absolute improvements over the previous state-of-the-artHuatuoGPT-o1-7B across all benchmarks. The complexity-aware router reduces expert invocations and inference cost, making CAMEC both highly effective and computationally efficient.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在医学问题回答方面具有巨大潜力，但在中文临床环境中仍不可靠，原因包括幻觉现象、对事实的误判，以及难以处理复杂的临床案例。我们提出了CAMEC框架，该框架结合了分层医学适配和复杂性感知的专家路由机制，以实现可靠的中文医学问题回答。我们采用了基于LoRA的三阶段监督微调流程，用于领域适配、指令遵循以及临床推理。在推理阶段，CAMEC根据预测出的复杂性来路由每个查询，并选择性地调用三位专家：一位内部思维链专家、一位基于密集医学向量数据库的检索增强专家，以及一位基于结构化医学知识库的知识图谱专家。一个以语言模型为评判者的模块负责评估并批判专家报告，从而逐步将其优化为一致的答案。在四个中文医学基准测试上的实验表明，CAMEC的表现始终优于强大的通用和医学语言模型基线，分别取得了78.86%（CMExam）、84.15%（MedQA-CN）、78.51%（CMMLU-Med）和74.40%（CMB-exam）的成绩，且在所有基准测试中均表现出比现有的HuatuoGPT-o1-7B更显著的绝对改进。这种复杂性感知的路由机制减少了专家的调用次数和推理成本，使得CAMEC既高效又具备良好的计算效率。

papers.title: Vocabulary Hijacking in LVLMs: Unveiling Critical Attention Heads by Excluding Inert Tokens to Mitigate Hallucination
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言中词汇的劫持现象：通过排除无用的标记来避免引发幻觉，从而抓住关键的注意力焦点
papers.authors: Yangneng Chen, Junlin Li, Weijun Yao, Xilai Ma, Guodong DU, Wenya Wang, Jing Li
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in multimodal tasks, yet their reliability is persistently undermined by hallucinations—generating text that contradicts visual input. Recent studies often attribute these errors to inadequate visual attention. In this work, we analyze the attention mechanisms via the logit lens, uncovering a distinct anomaly we term Vocabulary Hijacking. We discover that specific visual tokens, defined as Inert Tokens, disproportionately attract attention. Crucially, when their intermediate hidden states are projected into the vocabulary space, they consistently decode to a fixed set of unrelated words (termed Hijacking Anchors) across layers, revealing a rigid semantic collapse. Leveraging this semantic rigidity, we propose Hijacking Anchor-Based Identification (HABI), a robust strategy to accurately localize these Inert Tokens. To quantify the impact of this phenomenon, we introduce the Non-Hijacked Visual Attention Ratio (NHAR), a novel metric designed to identify attention heads that remain resilient to hijacking and are critical for factual accuracy. Building on these insights, we propose Hijacking-Aware Visual Attention Enhancement (HAVAE), a training-free intervention that selectively strengthens the focus of these identified heads on salient visual content. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that HAVAE significantly mitigates hallucinations with no additional computational overhead, while preserving the model’s general capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型在多模态任务上取得了显著进展，但其可靠性却一直受到幻觉的困扰——这些幻觉产生的文本与视觉输入相矛盾。最近的研究通常将这种错误归因于视觉注意力的不足。在这项研究中，我们通过逻辑斯蒂视角分析了注意力机制，发现了一种独特的异常现象，我们将其称为“词汇劫持”。我们发现，某些特定的视觉标记，即惰性标记，会过度吸引注意力。关键的是，当它们的中间隐藏状态被投影到词汇空间时，它们会一致地解码出一组固定的、无关词汇（称为劫持锚点），这揭示了语义上的僵化现象。利用这种语义僵化特性，我们提出了基于劫持锚点的识别方法，这是一种能够准确定位这些惰性标记的稳健策略。为了量化这种现象的影响，我们引入了非劫持视觉注意力比率这一新指标，该指标用于识别那些仍能抵抗劫持且对事实准确性至关重要的注意力区域。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种无需训练的干预措施——劫持感知视觉注意力增强技术，该技术能够选择性地加强这些被识别出的注意力区域的关注焦点，使其专注于显著的视觉内容。通过多个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，HAVAE能够在不增加额外计算负担的情况下显著减少幻觉现象，同时保留模型的通用能力。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: HumanLLM: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Anthropomorphism via Human Cognitive Patterns
papers.title_zh: HumanLLM：通过人类认知模式来评估和改进大型语言模型中的拟人化现象
papers.authors: Xintao Wang, Jian Yang, Weiyuan Li, Rui Xie, Jen-tse Huang, Jun Gao, Shuai Huang, Yueping Kang, Yuanli Guo, Hongwei Feng, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in reasoning and generation, serving as the foundation for advanced persona simulation and Role-Playing Language Agents (RPLAs). However, achieving authentic alignment with human cognitive and behavioral patterns remains a critical challenge for these agents. We present HumanLLM, a framework treating psychological patterns as interacting causal forces.We construct 244 patterns from \sim12,000 academic papers and synthesize 11,359 scenarios where 2-5 patterns reinforce, conflict, or modulate each other, with multi-turn conversations expressing inner thoughts, actions, and dialogue.Our dual-level checklists evaluate both individual pattern fidelity and emergent multi-pattern dynamics, achieving strong human alignment (r=0.90) while revealing that holistic metrics conflate simulation accuracy with social desirability.HumanLLM-8B outperforms Qwen3-32B on multi-pattern dynamics despite 4\times fewer parameters, demonstrating that authentic anthropomorphism requires cognitive modeling—simulating not just what humans do, but the psychological processes generating those behaviors.Our dataset, code, and model are available at:https://github.com/YJGoodbye2024/HumanLLM
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在推理和生成方面展现出了卓越的能力，成为了高级角色模拟和角色扮演语言代理的基础。然而，让这些模型真正符合人类的认知和行为模式仍然是一个重要的挑战。我们提出了HumanLLM框架，该框架将心理模式视为相互影响的因果力量。我们从约12,000篇学术论文中构建了244种心理模式，并综合了11,359个场景，在这些场景中，2到5种心理模式相互强化、冲突或调节关系，多轮对话则表达了内心的想法、行为以及对话内容。我们的双层次检查表既评估了单个模式的准确性，也评估了多种模式之间的动态关系，结果显示模型与人类行为的对齐程度很高（r=0.90）。同时，我们发现整体指标将模拟的准确性与社会可接受性混为一谈。尽管HumanLLM-8B的参数数量只有Qwen3-32B的1/4，但在多模式动态方面表现更优，这表明真实的人性化模拟需要认知建模——不仅要模拟人类的行为，还要模拟产生这些行为的心理过程。我们的数据集、代码和模型可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/YJGoodbye2024/HumanLLM
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
