papers.title: Vision-Language Introspection: Mitigating Overconfident Hallucinations in MLLMs via Interpretable Bi-Causal Steering
papers.title_zh: 视觉-语言内省：通过可解释的双因果策略来减轻多语言大语言模型中的过度自信幻觉问题
papers.authors: Shuliang Liu, Songbo Yang, Dong Fang, Sihang Jia, Yuqi Tang, Lingfeng Su, Ruoshui Peng, Yibo Yan, Xin Zou, Xuming Hu
papers.abstract: Object hallucination critically undermines the reliability of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), often stemming from a fundamental failure in cognitive introspection—where models blindly trust linguistic priors over specific visual evidence. Existing mitigations remain limited: contrastive decoding approaches operate superficially without rectifying internal semantic misalignments, while current latent steering methods rely on static vectors that lack instance-specific precision. We introduce Vision-Language Introspection (VLI), a training-free inference framework that simulates a metacognitive self-correction process. VLI first performs Attributive Introspection to diagnose hallucination risks via probabilistic conflict detection and localize the causal visual anchors. It then employs Interpretable Bi-Causal Steering to actively modulate the inference process, dynamically isolating visual evidence from background noise while neutralizing blind confidence through adaptive calibration. VLI achieves state-of-the-art performance on advanced models, reducing object hallucination rates by 12.67% on MMHal-Bench and improving accuracy by 5.8% on POPE.
papers.abstract_zh: 物体幻觉严重削弱了多模态大语言模型的可靠性，这一现象通常源于认知内省方面的根本缺陷——模型盲目依赖语言先验信息，而忽视了具体的视觉证据。现有的缓解措施仍然有限：对比解码方法虽然能表面上进行处理，但无法纠正内部的语义偏差；而当前的潜在引导方法则依赖于静态向量，缺乏针对具体实例的精确性。我们提出了视觉-语言内省框架（Vision-Language Introspection，VLI），这是一种无需训练的推理框架，能够模拟一种元认知自我修正过程。VLI首先通过属性内省来诊断幻觉风险，并通过概率冲突检测来确定因果视觉锚点。然后，它采用可解释的双因果引导技术，主动调节推理过程，动态地将视觉证据与背景噪声分离，同时通过自适应校准来消除盲目的信任。VLI在先进模型上取得了最先进的性能表现，在MMHal-Bench测试上的物体幻觉率降低了12.67%，在POPE测试上的准确率提高了5.8%。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: v-HUB: A Benchmark for Video Humor Understanding from Vision and Sound
papers.title_zh: v-HUB：一种基于视觉与声音来理解视频幽默的基准模型
papers.authors: Zhengpeng Shi, Yanpeng Zhao, Jianqun Zhou, Yuxuan Wang, Qinrong Cui, Wei Bi, Song-Chun Zhu, Bo Zhao, Zilong Zheng
papers.abstract: AI models capable of comprehending humor hold real-world promise—for example, enhancing engagement in human-machine interactions. To gauge and diagnose the capacity of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for humor understanding, we introduce v-HUB, a novel video humor understanding benchmark. v-HUB comprises a curated collection of non-verbal short videos, reflecting real-world scenarios where humor can be appreciated purely through visual cues. We pair each video clip with rich annotations to support a variety of evaluation tasks and analyses, including a novel study of environmental sound that can enhance humor. To broaden its applicability, we construct an open-ended QA task, making v-HUB readily integrable into existing video understanding task suites. We evaluate a diverse set of MLLMs, from specialized Video-LLMs to versatile OmniLLMs that can natively process audio, covering both open-source and proprietary domains. The experimental results expose the difficulties MLLMs face in comprehending humor from visual cues alone. Our findings also demonstrate that incorporating audio helps with video humor understanding, highlighting the promise of integrating richer modalities for complex video understanding tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 能够理解幽默的AI模型在现实应用中具有巨大潜力——例如，它可以提升人机交互的趣味性。为了评估多模态大语言模型在理解幽默方面的能力，我们提出了v-HUB这一新的视频幽默理解基准测试。v-HUB包含了一系列精心挑选的非语言短视频，这些视频反映了那些只能通过视觉线索来感知幽默的现实场景。我们为每个视频片段添加了丰富的注释信息，以支持多种评估任务和分析工作，其中包括对能够增强幽默效果的环境声音的研究。为了扩大其应用范围，我们设计了一个开放式的问答任务，使得v-HUB可以轻松地被整合到现有的视频理解任务体系中。我们评估了多种不同的大语言模型，包括专门用于处理视频数据的Video-LLMs，以及能够原生处理音频的OmniLLMs，涵盖了开源和专有领域。实验结果表明，大语言模型在仅依赖视觉线索来理解幽默时面临诸多困难。我们的研究还表明，加入音频信息有助于更好地理解视频中的幽默内容，这凸显了在复杂的视频理解任务中整合更多模态信息的价值。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Single Representations: Multi-Model Embedding Fusion for Stable Text Classification
papers.title_zh: 超越单一表示方式：多模型嵌入融合在稳定文本分类中的应用
papers.authors: Jiho Gwak, Yuchul Jung
papers.abstract: Embedding fusion has become a widely adopted technique for enhancing performance across various NLP tasks. While prior research suggests that different layers of language models encode distinct representations and that pooling strategies influence performance, there is a lack of systematic analysis regarding the empirical efficacy of these differences or the impact of combining embeddings from multiple models. This study provides a rigorous, empirical evaluation of layer-wise fusion strategies to determine their actual contribution to classification performance. Our findings reveal that the effectiveness of individual layers is more dependent on dataset characteristics than on the model architecture itself. Furthermore, we demonstrate that fusing embeddings from multiple models yields more robust and consistent representations across tasks, with the influence of any single model diminishing as the number of integrated models increases. Notably, experiments on low-resource datasets show that embedding fusion provides particularly significant gains when training data is scarce, highlighting its robustness and adaptability in data-constrained environments. We also analyze the trade-off between performance gains and computational overhead, and discuss which fusion configurations provide the best balance between stability and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 嵌入融合已成为提升各种自然语言处理任务性能的常用技术。虽然先前的研究表明，不同的语言模型层次会编码出不同的表示方式，而合并策略也会对性能产生影响，但关于这些差异的实际效果以及结合多个模型的嵌入所带来的影响，目前还没有系统的分析。本研究通过严格的实证评估，探讨了不同层次融合策略对分类性能的实际贡献。我们的研究发现，各个层次的效能更多地取决于数据集的特点，而非模型架构本身。此外，我们还发现，当整合多个模型的嵌入时，能够得到更稳健且一致的表示结果，而且随着集成模型数量的增加，单个模型的影响会逐渐减弱。值得注意的是，在资源匮乏的数据集上进行的实验表明，嵌入融合在训练数据有限的情况下能带来显著的性能提升，这充分体现了其在数据受限环境中的鲁棒性和适应性。我们还分析了性能提升与计算开销之间的权衡关系，并探讨了哪种融合配置能在稳定性和效率之间取得最佳平衡。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Confidence Should Be Calibrated More Than One Turn Deep
papers.title_zh: 信任的衡量标准应该经过多次验证才能确定其准确性
papers.authors: Zhaohan Zhang, Chengzhengxu Li, Xiaoming Liu, Chao Shen, Ziquan Liu, Ioannis Patras
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in high-stakes domains such as finance, healthcare, and education, where reliable multi-turn interactions with users are essential. However, existing work on confidence estimation and calibration, a major approach to building trustworthy LLM systems, largely focuses on single-turn settings and overlooks the risks and potential of multi-turn conversations. In this work, we introduce the task of multi-turn calibration to reframe calibration from a static property into a dynamic challenge central to reliable multi-turn conversation, where calibrating model confidence at each turn conditioned on the conversation history is required. We first reveal the risks of this setting: using Expected Calibration Error at turn T (ECE@T), a new metric that tracks calibration dynamics over turns, we show that user feedback (e.g., persuasion) can degrade multi-turn calibration. To address this, we propose MTCal, which minimises ECE@T via a surrogate calibration target, and further leverage calibrated confidence in ConfChat, a decoding strategy that improves both factuality and consistency of the model response in multi-turn interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MTCal achieves outstanding and consistent performance in multi-turn calibration, and ConfChat preserves and even enhances model performance in multi-turn interactions. Our results mark multi-turn calibration as one missing link for scaling LLM calibration toward safe, reliable, and real-world use. The code is available at: https://github.com/petezone/Multiturn-Calibration.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在金融、医疗和教育等高风险领域得到了广泛应用，在这些领域，与用户进行可靠的多次交互至关重要。然而，现有的关于置信度估计和校准的研究，作为构建可信语言模型系统的重要方法，大多集中在单次交互的场景上，而忽视了多次交互所带来的风险和潜在问题。在这项研究中，我们引入了多次交互校准的任务，将校准从一个静态属性转变为一个动态挑战，要求在每次交互时根据对话历史来调整模型的置信度。我们首先揭示了这种设置的风险：使用第T次交互时的预期校准误差这一新指标，可以观察到校准随交互次数的变化情况，我们发现用户的反馈（例如，说服性信息）可能会降低多次交互中的校准效果。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了MTCal算法，该算法通过替代性的校准目标来最小化ECE@T，并进一步在ConfChat解码策略中利用经过校准的置信度，从而提升模型在多次交互中的准确性和一致性。大量实验表明，MTCal在多次交互校准方面表现出色且稳定，而ConfChat则能够保持甚至提升模型在多次交互中的性能。我们的研究结果表明，多次交互校准是扩大语言模型校准规模、使其适用于安全、可靠的实际应用的关键环节。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/petezone/Multiturn-Calibration。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: NaviMaster: Learning a Unified Policy for GUI and Embodied Navigation Tasks
papers.title_zh: NaviMaster：为图形用户界面操作和实体导航任务学习一种统一的策略
papers.authors: Zhihao Luo, Wentao Yan, Jingyu Gong, Min Wang, Zhizhong Zhang, Xuhong Wang, Yuan Xie, Xin Tan
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Graphical User Interface (GUI) and embodied navigation have driven progress, yet these domains have largely evolved in isolation, with disparate datasets and training paradigms. In this paper, we observe that both tasks can be formulated as Markov Decision Processes (MDP), suggesting a foundational principle for their unification. Hence, we present NaviMaster, the first unified agent capable of unifying GUI navigation and embodied navigation within a single framework. Specifically, NaviMaster (i) proposes a visual-target trajectory collection pipeline that generates trajectories for both GUI and embodied tasks using a single formulation. (ii) employs a unified reinforcement learning framework on the mix data to improve generalization. (iii) designs a novel distance-aware reward to ensure efficient learning from the trajectories. Through extensive experiments on out-of-domain benchmarks, NaviMaster is shown to outperform state-of-the-art agents in GUI navigation, spatial affordance prediction, and embodied navigation. Ablation studies further demonstrate the efficacy of our unified training strategy, data mixing strategy, and reward design. Resources will be released to the community.
papers.abstract_zh: 图形用户界面（GUI）和实体化导航领域的最新进展推动了相关技术的发展。然而，这两个领域在很大程度上是独立发展的，它们拥有不同的数据集和训练方法。在本文中，我们发现这两个任务都可以被表述为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），这为它们的统一提供了一个基础原则。因此，我们提出了NaviMaster——首个能够在一个框架内整合GUI导航和实体化导航的统一智能体。具体来说，NaviMaster具有以下特点：(i) 提出了一种视觉目标轨迹生成方法，该方法使用统一的模型来生成适用于GUI和实体化任务的轨迹；(ii) 采用统一的强化学习框架来处理混合数据，以提高泛化能力；(iii) 设计了一种新的距离感知奖励机制，以确保从轨迹中学习到有效信息。通过在不同领域的基准测试中进行大量实验，结果表明NaviMaster在GUI导航、空间感知预测以及实体化导航方面均优于现有的智能体。进一步的消融研究也证明了我们的统一训练策略、数据混合策略和奖励设计的有效性。这些资源将会向公众开放。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Teaching LLMs Human-Like Editing of Inappropriate Argumentation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过强化学习教授大型语言模型进行类似人类水平的不当言论编辑处理技巧
papers.authors: Timon Ziegenbein, Maja Stahl, Henning Wachsmuth
papers.abstract: Editing human-written text has become a standard use case of large language models (LLMs), for example, to make one’s arguments more appropriate for a discussion. Comparing human to LLM-generated edits, however, we observe a mismatch in editing strategies: While LLMs often perform multiple scattered edits and tend to change meaning notably, humans rather encapsulate dependent changes in self-contained, meaning-preserving edits. In this paper, we present a reinforcement learning approach that teaches LLMs human-like editing to improve the appropriateness of arguments. Our approach produces self-contained sentence-level edit suggestions that can be accepted or rejected independently. We train the approach using group relative policy optimization with a multi-component reward function that jointly optimizes edit-level semantic similarity, fluency, and pattern conformity as well as argument-level appropriateness. In automatic and human evaluation, it outperforms competitive baselines and the state of the art in human-like editing, with multi-round editing achieving appropriateness close to full rewriting.
papers.abstract_zh: 编辑人类撰写的文本已成为大语言模型的标准应用场景之一，例如，为了让用户的论点更适合讨论。然而，在比较人类和大语言模型生成的编辑结果时，我们发现两者的编辑策略存在差异：大语言模型通常会进行多次分散性的编辑，并倾向于显著改变句子的含义；而人类则更倾向于将相关的修改整合到独立的、能够保留原意的编辑中。在本文中，我们提出了一种强化学习方法，该方法可以教会大语言模型进行类似人类的编辑，从而提高论点的合理性。我们的方法能够生成独立的句子级编辑建议，这些建议可以被独立地接受或拒绝。我们采用基于组相对策略优化的方法来进行训练，同时结合了一个多组分奖励函数，该函数能够同时优化编辑级别的语义相似性、流畅性以及模式一致性，以及论点级别的合理性。在自动评估和人类评估中，我们的方法均优于现有的竞争基准模型以及最先进的类似人类编辑技术。通过多轮编辑，我们的方法能够实现近乎完全重写的编辑效果，从而提升论点的合理性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FLAIR: Steering LLM Mathematical Problem Solving based on A Fuzzy-Logic-AssIsted Reasoner
papers.title_zh: FLAIR：基于模糊逻辑推理器的引导式大语言模型数学问题求解方法
papers.authors: Hao Wu, Hongru Sun, Wanqing Li, Xinguo Yu, Hao Ming, Xiao Luo, Wenbin Zhang, Jiahong Zhao, Yi Guo, Jie Yang
papers.abstract: Mathematical reasoning is one of the core capabilities for Large Language Models (LLMs). Yet, existing approaches often rely on static heuristics or pre-determined reasoning strategies, limiting their ability to adapt to different intermediate states. To address this limitation, we propose FLAIR (Fuzzy-Logic-AssIsted Reasoner), an adaptive framework that integrates fuzzy theory into LLM-based mathematical reasoning. Specifically, FLAIR characterizes intermediate problem-solving states using fuzzy memberships and employs a parameterized fuzzy rule system to conditionally activate subsequent actions. These rule parameters are further adjusted via Reinforcement Learning using solution-level feedback as the reward signal, enabling adaptive and iterative refinement without reliance on a fixed strategy. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to integrate fuzzy theory into LLM-based mathematical reasoning. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FLAIR consistently outperforms recent state-of-the-art baselines, while offering effective and interpretable diagnostics of intermediate problem-solving states.
papers.abstract_zh: 数学推理是大语言模型的核心能力之一。然而，现有的方法往往依赖于静态的启发式算法或预先确定的推理策略，这限制了模型适应不同中间状态的能力。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了FLAIR（模糊逻辑引导推理器）这一自适应框架。该框架将模糊理论融入基于大语言模型的数学推理中。具体来说，FLAIR利用模糊隶属关系来描述问题解决过程中的不同阶段，并通过参数化的模糊规则系统来触发相应的后续操作。这些规则参数可以通过强化学习进行调整，以解决方案层面的反馈作为奖励信号，从而实现自适应和迭代式的优化，而无需依赖固定的策略。据我们所知，这是第一项将模糊理论整合到基于大语言模型的数学推理中的研究。在多个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，FLAIR始终优于当前最先进的基线方法，同时还能有效且可解释地诊断问题解决过程中的各个阶段。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: QuDAR: Query-Wise Dual-Perspective Adaptive Retrieval
papers.title_zh: QuDAR：基于查询的双向视角自适应检索机制
papers.authors: Joeun Kim, Seunghyouk Yoon, Xuan-Bach Le, Youngeun Nam, Doyoung Kim, Hwanjun Song, Jae-Gil Lee
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation(RAG) systems depend on retrieval modules to supply grounding evidence for large language models. While hybrid approaches combining sparse and dense retrievers improve performance, most rely on fixed weights that ignore query-specific and corpus-specific variation. Similarly, query expansion has long been used to enrich recall, but its integration with original queries is usually static and can introduce noise. We present QuDAR, a dual-perspective adaptive retrieval framework that adapts along two perspectives: retriever type (sparse vs. dense) and query format (original vs.expanded). Leveraging margin-derived confidence (e.g., top-1–top-2 score gaps) and blind LLM-based relevance scoring, QuDAR dynamically assigns query-specific weights, fusing lexical specificity with semantic breadth while mitigating noise. QuDAR is lightweight, retriever-agnostic, and broadly applicable. Experiments show consistent gains over static baselines, improving overall retrieval quality and yielding more stable performance across queries.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统依赖于检索模块为大语言模型提供基础证据。虽然结合稀疏检索器和密集检索器的混合方法能够提升性能，但大多数方法都依赖于固定的权重，而忽略了查询特定性和语料库特定性的差异。同样，查询扩展长期以来被用于增强召回率，但其与原始查询的整合通常是静态的，并且可能会引入噪声。我们提出了QuDAR，这是一种双视角自适应检索框架，它根据两种视角进行调整：检索器类型（稀疏 vs. 密集）和查询格式（原始 vs. 扩展）。通过利用边缘派生的置信度（例如，top-1与top-2分数之间的差距）以及基于LLM的相关性评分，QuDAR能够动态地为每个查询分配特定的权重，同时融合词汇特异性与语义广度，从而减轻噪声的影响。QuDAR具有轻量级、不依赖检索器且适用范围广的特点。实验表明，与静态基线相比，QuDAR取得了显著的改进，提升了整体检索质量，并使得在不同查询下的性能更加稳定。

papers.title: Trait Activation in Silicon: A Situation-Aware Framework for Psychologically Grounded Role-Playing
papers.title_zh: 硅中的特性激活：一种基于情境感知的、注重心理基础的角色扮演框架
papers.authors: Zuolong Li, Pingyu Wu, Xianwen Huang, Tianyi Wei, Wenbo Zhou
papers.abstract: Role-playing agents (RPAs) have made significant strides in mimicking static character identities. However, their personality simulations remain superficial, lacking a profound understanding of complex human psychological mechanisms. We identify a critical bottleneck termed “Personality Inertia”—a behavioral rigidity where RLHF-induced alignment bias traps models in a sanitized, “helpful assistant” persona. This inertia prevents models from adapting to diverse social contexts or expressing essential but negative traits under pressure. To bridge this gap, we propose PD-LLM, a situation-aware framework grounded in Trait Activation Theory. PD-LLM introduces Bipolar Latent Decomposition, which decouples personality traits into bidirectional LoRA adapters. These adapters are dynamically modulated by a situation-aware module based on the DIAMONDS taxonomy, allowing for precise behavioral regulation. Empirical results show that while baseline methods fail to synchronize multidimensional traits under pressure, PD-LLM achieves superior performance in both static fidelity and dynamic adaptability. By advancing from prompt engineering to intrinsic parameter control, PD-LLM effectively overcomes personality rigidity, facilitating the creation of vivid and psychologically consistent agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 角色扮演智能体在模仿静态角色身份方面取得了显著进展。然而，它们的性格模拟仍然停留在表面层次，缺乏对复杂人类心理机制的深刻理解。我们发现了一个关键瓶颈，称为“性格惯性”——这是一种行为僵化现象，由强化学习中的对齐偏见导致模型陷入一种“乐于助人的助手”形象。这种惯性使得模型无法适应不同的社交环境，也无法在压力下表达出一些重要但负面的特质。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了PD-LLM框架，该框架基于特质激活理论设计，具有情境感知能力。PD-LLM引入了双极潜在分解技术，将性格特质分解为双向LoRA适配器。这些适配器通过基于DIAMONDS分类法的情境感知模块进行动态调节，从而实现精确的行为控制。实验结果表明，虽然传统方法在压力下难以同步多维度特质，但PD-LLM在静态逼真度和动态适应性方面都表现出卓越性能。通过从提示工程转向内在参数控制，PD-LLM有效克服了性格的僵化问题，从而能够创造出生动且符合心理学逻辑的智能体。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SPARKLE: A Structured and Plug-and-play Agentic Retrieval Policy for Adaptive RAG Models
papers.title_zh: SPARKLE：一种结构化的、即插使用的智能检索策略，适用于自适应RAG模型
papers.authors: Jinyuan Fang, Zaiqiao Meng, Craig Macdonald
papers.abstract: Adaptive retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) models offer an effective approach for integrating external knowledge. However, existing methods either rely on frozen large language models (LLMs) without explicit supervision or require costly LLM finetuning. Therefore, we propose SPARKLE, a structured and plug-and-play agentic retrieval policy where an additional proxy model is introduced to control the retrieval process. The proxy model leverages knowledge graph-based reasoning to make retrieval decisions in a structured manner, while operating independently of the retriever and the LLM. This plug-and-play design allows SPARKLE to generalise across different retrievers and LLMs. SPARKLE is optimised via reinforcement learning (RL), treating the retriever and the LLM as part of the environment. To enable more effective exploration during RL training, we further introduce a binary tree-structured rollout strategy. Experiments on three in-domain and four out-of-domain QA benchmarks show that SPARKLE outperforms state-of-the-art adaptive RAG baselines, achieving average improvements of 9.17% and 2.85%, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 自适应检索增强生成（RAG）模型为整合外部知识提供了一种有效的方法。然而，现有的方法要么依赖于未经明确监督的冻结大语言模型，要么需要昂贵的LLM微调过程。因此，我们提出了SPARKLE这一结构化的即插即用代理式检索策略。该策略引入了一个额外的代理模型来控制检索过程。这个代理模型利用基于知识图谱的推理方式来进行检索决策，同时独立于检索器和LLM运行。这种即插式的设计使得SPARKLE能够适用于不同的检索器和LLM。SPARKLE通过强化学习进行优化，将检索器和LLM视为环境的一部分。为了在强化学习训练过程中实现更有效的探索，我们还引入了一种二叉树结构的展开策略。在三个领域内的四个外部问答基准测试中的实验表明，SPARKLE的性能优于最先进的自适应RAG基线算法，分别实现了9.17%和2.85%的平均改进。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: G-IdiomAlign: A Gloss-Pivoted Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Idiom Alignment
papers.title_zh: G-IdiomAlign：一种用于跨语言习语对齐的基于光锥法的基准算法
papers.authors: Fengying Ye, Yanming Sun, Runzhe Zhan, Lidia S. Chao, Zheqi Zhang, Derek F. Wong
papers.abstract: Idioms are difficult to transfer across languages due to their non-compositionality and weak surface-form grounding, making literal mappings unreliable. We present G-IdiomAlign, a gloss-pivoted benchmark where each idiom is anchored by an English gloss from Wiktionary. We further construct a high-confidence reference alignment set for reproducible evaluation. G-IdiomAlign supports two protocols: (1) a controlled Multiple-Choice Idiom Equivalence with typed distractors for error attribution; and (2) a Gloss-Contrastive Generation contrasting No-gloss and With-gloss inputs to isolate the effect of an explicit semantic pivot. Across diverse LLMs, a bias to literal translation is a dominant failure mode, especially when the target is a low-resource language. Glosses consistently improve Gloss-Contrastive Generation under an embedding-based semantic proxy, but performance remains modest, indicating substantial headroom in the open output space. Subsequent analysis on Qwen3-8B further suggests that cross-condition differences are concentrated more in attention heads than in layers, while better With-gloss generations coincide with stronger gloss anchoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 成语由于其非组合性以及表面形式的薄弱基础，很难在不同语言之间进行转换，因此直接进行文字映射是不可靠的。我们提出了G-IdiomAlign这一基准测试，其中每个成语都配有来自维基词典的英文注释。我们还构建了一个高可信度的参考对齐集，以便进行可重复的评估。G-IdiomAlign支持两种协议：(1) 通过类型化干扰项来进行的受控成语等价性比较，以便明确错误来源；(2) 通过对比无注释和带注释的输入来进行的语义对比生成，以分离显式语义转换的效果。在多种大语言模型中，直译式的翻译方式往往是主要的失败模式，尤其是在目标语言资源匮乏的情况下。在基于嵌入式的语义代理下，注释能够持续改善语义对比生成的效果，但性能仍然较为有限，这表明开放输出空间还有很大的提升空间。对Qwen3-8B模型进行的后续分析表明，不同条件下的差异更多地集中在注意力机制上，而非层次结构中。而带有更多注释的生成效果则与更强的注释锚定效果相吻合。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SciCoQA: Quality Assurance for Scientific Paper–Code Alignment
papers.title_zh: SciCoQA：科学论文中代码对齐的质量保证机制
papers.authors: Tim Baumgärtner, Iryna Gurevych
papers.abstract: Discrepancies between scientific papers and their code undermine reproducibility, a concern that grows as automated research agents scale scientific output beyond human review capacity. Whether LLMs can reliably detect such discrepancies has not been systematically measured. To this end, we present SciCoQA, a dataset of 635 paper-code discrepancies (92 real, 543 synthetic) for this cross-modal verification task. Across 22 evaluated models, even the best-performing LLMs, Gemini 3.1 Pro and GPT-5 Mini, detect only 46.7% of real-world discrepancies, revealing a critical gap in automated scientific quality assurance. We construct SciCoQA from GitHub issues and reproducibility papers, and propose a synthetic generation pipeline to scale beyond AI to Physics, Quantitative Biology, and other computational sciences. We further introduce a taxonomy of discrepancy types and categories to characterize the occurring mismatches. Our analysis shows that models particularly struggle with omitted paper details, long-context inputs, and papers outside their pre-training corpus.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学论文与其代码之间的不一致性会破坏研究的可复现性。随着自动化研究工具能够处理越来越多的科学成果，这一问题的严重性愈发凸显。目前尚未有系统性的研究来探讨大语言模型是否能够可靠地检测这类不一致性。为此，我们构建了SciCoQA数据集，该数据集包含635个论文与代码之间的不一致案例（其中92个是真实的，543个是合成的），用于进行跨模态验证任务。在22种被评估的模型中，即使是最优秀的模型——Gemini 3.1 Pro和GPT-5 Mini，也只能检测出46.7%的真实不一致案例，这揭示了自动化科学质量保障领域存在的重大缺陷。我们通过收集GitHub上的问题记录以及关于可复现性的论文来构建SciCoQA数据集，并提出了一种合成生成方法，以便将该方法应用于物理学、定量生物学以及其他计算科学领域。我们还提出了一种分类体系，用于描述各种不一致类型。我们的分析表明，模型在处理一些问题时存在困难，比如忽略了一些论文细节、处理长文本上下文信息，或者处理那些不在预训练语料库中的论文。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ImpRIF: Stronger Implicit Reasoning Leads to Better Complex Instruction Following
papers.title_zh: ImpRIF：更强大的隐性推理能力有助于更好地执行复杂的指令操作
papers.authors: Yuancheng Yang, Lin Yang, Xu Wang, Chao Tong, Haihua Yang
papers.abstract: As applications of large language models (LLMs) become increasingly complex, the demand for robust complex instruction following capabilities is growing accordingly. We argue that a thorough understanding of the instruction itself, especially the latent reasoning structure embedded between the lines, is crucial for improving instruction following. Therefore we target complex instructions that involve implicit reasoning, intricate logical relations, and multi-constraint dependencies. We propose ImpRIF, a method to enhance LLMs’ understanding of implicit reasoning instructions, thereby improving its ability to follow complex instructions. We formalize such instructions as verifiable reasoning graphs, enabling programmatic verification and graph-driven chain-of-thought reasoning. Based on this formulation, we synthesize large-scale single- and multi-turn data, propose fine-tuning with graph reasoning, and apply reinforcement learning to explicitly train models to reason along the graph. On five complex instruction following benchmarks, our models substantially outperform their base models. These results demonstrate that enhancing implicit reasoning capabilities can significantly improve complex instruction following. This project will be open-sourced in the near future.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的应用变得越来越复杂，对强大且复杂的指令遵循能力的需求也在不断增加。我们认为，深入理解指令本身，尤其是那些隐藏在文字背后的潜在推理结构，对于提升指令遵循能力至关重要。因此，我们专注于那些涉及隐性推理、复杂逻辑关系以及多约束依赖关系的复杂指令。我们提出了ImpRIF方法，旨在增强大语言模型对隐性推理指令的理解能力，从而提升其处理复杂指令的能力。我们将这类指令形式化为可验证的推理图，从而实现程序化验证和基于图的思维链推理。基于这一框架，我们收集了大规模的单轮和多轮数据，提出了基于图推理的微调方法，并应用强化学习来明确训练模型以沿着图进行推理。在五个复杂的指令遵循基准测试中，我们的模型表现明显优于基础模型。这些结果表明，增强隐性推理能力可以显著改善复杂指令的遵循能力。该项目将在不久的将来开源。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HalluAudio: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Hallucination Detection in Large Audio-Language Models
papers.title_zh: HalluAudio：一种用于大规模音频语言模型中幻觉检测的全面基准测试工具
papers.authors: Feiyu Zhao, Yiming Chen, Wenhuan Lu, Daipeng Zhang, Xianghu Yue, Jianguo Wei
papers.abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have recently achieved strong performance across various audio-centric tasks. However, hallucination, where models generate responses that are semantically incorrect or acoustically unsupported, remains largely underexplored in the audio domain. Existing hallucination benchmarks mainly focus on text or vision, while the few audio-oriented studies are limited in scale, modality coverage, and diagnostic depth. We therefore introduce HalluAudio, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating hallucinations across speech, environmental sound, and music. HalluAudio comprises over 5K human-verified QA pairs and spans diverse task types, including binary judgments, multi-choice reasoning, attribute verification, and open-ended QA. To systematically induce hallucinations, we design adversarial prompts and mixed-audio conditions. Beyond accuracy, our evaluation protocol measures hallucination rate, yes/no bias, error-type analysis, and refusal rate, enabling a fine-grained analysis of LALM failure modes. We benchmark a broad range of open-source and proprietary models, providing the first large-scale comparison across speech, sound, and music. Our results reveal significant deficiencies in acoustic grounding, temporal reasoning, and music attribute understanding, underscoring the need for reliable and robust LALMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在各类以音频为中心的任务中取得了显著的性能提升。然而，在音频领域，模型产生语义错误或音效不合法的回答这一现象仍未被充分研究。现有的幻觉评估基准主要聚焦于文本或视觉任务，而少数针对音频的研究在规模、模态覆盖范围和诊断深度方面存在局限性。因此，我们推出了HalluAudio，这是首个用于评估语音、环境声音和音乐领域幻觉的大规模基准测试。HalluAudio包含超过5K对人类验证过的问答对，涵盖了多种任务类型，包括二元判断、多选推理、属性验证以及开放式问答等。为了系统地诱发幻觉现象，我们设计了对抗性提示和混合音频条件。除了准确性之外，我们的评估方案还包含了幻觉率、是/否偏见分析、错误类型分析以及拒绝率等指标，从而能够细致地分析LALM的失败模式。我们对各种开源和专有模型进行了基准测试，首次实现了语音、声音和音乐领域的全面比较。我们的研究结果揭示了在声学定位、时间推理以及音乐属性理解方面的显著不足，这进一步凸显了开发可靠且强大的LALM的必要性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ReTraceQA: Evaluating Reasoning Traces of Small Language Models in Commonsense Question Answering
papers.title_zh: ReTraceQA：评估小型语言模型在常识问答任务中的推理能力
papers.authors: Francesco Maria Molfese, Luca Moroni, Ciro Porcaro, Simone Conia, Roberto Navigli
papers.abstract: While Small Language Models (SLMs) have demonstrated promising performance on an increasingly wide array of commonsense reasoning benchmarks, current evaluation practices rely almost exclusively on the accuracy of their final answers, neglecting the validity of the reasoning processes that lead to those answers. To address this issue, we present ReTraceQA, a novel benchmark that introduces process-level evaluation for commonsense reasoning tasks. Our expert-annotated dataset reveals that in a substantial portion of instances (14-24%), SLMs provide correct final answers despite flawed reasoning processes, suggesting that the capabilities of SLMs are often overestimated by evaluation metrics that focus only on comparing the final answer with the ground truth. Indeed, we show that, when employing strong Large Language Models (LLMs) as automated judges for reasoning-aware evaluation rather than answer-only metrics, SLM performance drops significantly across all models and datasets, with scores decreasing by up to 25%.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然小型语言模型在越来越多的常识推理基准测试上表现出了令人满意的性能，但当前的评估方式几乎完全依赖于它们最终答案的准确性，而忽视了产生这些答案的推理过程的有效性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ReTraceQA这一新的基准测试，它引入了针对常识推理任务的流程级评估方法。我们的专家标注数据集显示，在相当一部分情况下（占14-24%），尽管推理过程存在缺陷，小型语言模型仍然能够给出正确的最终答案。这表明，那些仅关注将最终答案与真实情况进行比较的评估指标，往往高估了小型语言模型的性能。实际上，当我们使用强大的大语言模型作为自动评判器来进行基于推理能力的评估时，所有模型和数据集的小型语言模型的表现都会显著下降，其得分甚至减少了25%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: BEFT: Bias-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Language Models in Low-Data Regimes
papers.title_zh: BEFT：在低数据环境下对语言模型进行高效优化调整的方法
papers.authors: Baichuan Huang, Ananth Balashankar, Amir Aminifar
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning the bias terms of large language models (LLMs) has the potential to achieve unprecedented parameter efficiency while maintaining competitive performance, particularly in low-data regimes. However, the link between fine-tuning different bias terms (i.e., \boldsymbol{b}_q, \boldsymbol{b}_k, \boldsymbol{b}_v in the query, key, or value projections) and downstream performance remains largely unclear to date. In this paper, we investigate the link between fine-tuning \boldsymbol{b}_q, \boldsymbol{b}_k, \boldsymbol{b}_v with the performance of the downstream task. Our key finding is that directly fine-tuning \boldsymbol{b}_v generally leads to higher downstream performance in low-data regimes, in comparison to \boldsymbol{b}_q and \boldsymbol{b}_k. We extensively evaluate this unique property across a wide range of LLMs spanning encoder-only and decoder-only architectures up to 6.7B parameters (including bias-free LLMs). Our results provide strong evidence for the effectiveness of directly fine-tuning \boldsymbol{b}_v across various downstream tasks. The implementation code is available at https://github.com/whubaichuan/BEFT.
papers.abstract_zh: 微调大语言模型（LLM）的偏置项具有在保持竞争性能的同时实现前所未有的参数效率的潜力，尤其是在数据量较少的情况下。然而，不同偏置项（即查询、键或值投影中的\boldsymbol{b}_q、\boldsymbol{b}_k、\boldsymbol{b}_v）的微调与下游性能之间的关系至今仍不清楚。在本文中，我们研究了直接微调\boldsymbol{b}_q、\boldsymbol{b}_k、\boldsymbol{b}_v与下游任务性能之间的关系。我们的主要发现是，与微调\boldsymbol{b}_q和\boldsymbol{b}_k相比，直接微调\boldsymbol{b}_v通常在数据量较少的情况下能带来更高的下游性能。我们对这一独特特性进行了广泛的评估，涵盖了从仅编码器架构到仅解码器架构的各种LLM，这些模型的参数数量达到了67亿个（包括无偏置的LLM）。我们的研究结果充分证明了直接微调\boldsymbol{b}_v在各种下游任务中的有效性。相关实现代码可在https://github.com/whubaichuan/BEFT获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: JoPR: Joint Emotion Perception and Reasoning for Conversational Emotion Recognition
papers.title_zh: JoPR：用于对话情感识别的联合情绪感知与推理技术
papers.authors: Yumeng Fu, Weitao Huang, Junjie Wu, Hao Teng, Meishan Zhang, Bingquan Liu
papers.abstract: Emotion Recognition in Conversation (ERC), the task of identifying the emotion of each utterance in a conversation, is crucial for human-machine interaction. Existing LLM-based ERC methods focus on standard prompting and slow thinking for emotion analysis. However, they suffer from the lack of human-like emotion reasoning and discrimination between similar emotions, thus limiting accurate emotion predictions. To this end, we present JoPR, jointing perception-curriculum learning and emotional reasoning for conversational emotion recognition. Specifically, we devise a multi-dimension curriculum with long CoT fine-tuning to clone human-like emotion reasoning. We further design an emotion-specific reward function in a novel reinforcement learning framework, thereby enhancing the discernment between similar emotions. Our proposal is extensively evaluated over three widely used benchmark datasets, and experimental results confirm the superiority of JoPR. Furthermore, we provide an in-depth analysis to confirm the emotion perception and reasoning capabilities of JoPR.
papers.abstract_zh: 对话中的情感识别任务，即识别对话中每一句话所表达的情感，对于人机交互来说至关重要。现有的基于大语言模型的情感识别方法主要关注标准的提示方式以及缓慢的情感分析过程。然而，这些方法存在缺乏类似人类情感推理能力的问题，也无法准确区分相似情感，从而限制了情感预测的准确性。为此，我们提出了JoPR模型，该模型结合了感知学习与情感推理技术，用于对话中的情感识别。具体来说，我们设计了一个多维的课程结构，并通过长时间的CoT微调来模拟人类的情感推理能力。此外，我们在新的强化学习框架中设计了针对特定情感的奖励函数，从而提升了区分相似情感的能力。我们的提案在三个广泛使用的基准数据集上进行了充分评估，实验结果表明JoPR具有显著的优越性。此外，我们还进行了深入分析，以验证JoPR在情感感知和推理方面的能力。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Routing for Principled Alignment with MoE Dynamics
papers.title_zh: 考虑不确定性的路由选择方法，以实现与MoE动态之间的合理匹配
papers.authors: Yilong Chen, Junyuan Shang, Yuchen Feng, Zhenyu Zhang, Naibin Gu, Ziqi Wang, Tingwen Liu, Shuohuan Wang, Yu Sun, Hua Wu, Haifeng Wang
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a cornerstone for scaling LLMs, yet its training dynamics remain poorly understood, often leading to sub-optimal specialization. Moving beyond static routing, we present a systematic study of the MoE lifecycle using Helmholtz Free Energyand Router Entropy. We identify a universal Three-Stage Phase Transition—Exploration, Symmetry Breaking, and Stabilization—marked by an Energy Climb and Plateau. This reflects Frustrated Exploration, caused by structural interference between specialization drives and uniformity constraints. To address this, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Routing (UAR), which aligns routing with the model’s epistemic state via: (1) Evidence-Triggered Expansion, increasing active experts for high-energy tokens, and (2) Epistemic Masking, applying load-balancing only in high-uncertainty regimes to shield mature experts. Experiments confirm UAR reduces perplexity and improves expert distinctiveness, offering a principled path toward thermodynamically aligned computation.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合模型是扩展大语言模型的基石，但其训练机制仍缺乏深入理解，这往往导致专业化的效果不尽如人意。我们超越了静态的路由方式，通过亥姆霍兹自由能和路由器熵的概念，对专家混合模型的生命周期进行了系统研究。我们发现了一个普遍存在的三阶段转变过程——探索、对称性破坏和稳定化，这一过程伴随着能量上升和平台期。这种现象反映了由于专业化驱动与均匀性约束之间的结构性冲突而导致的挫败性探索问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了不确定性感知路由机制，该机制通过将路由与模型的知识状态相结合来实现：(1)基于证据的扩展策略，为高能量任务增加活跃专家的数量；(2)知识掩蔽技术，仅在高不确定性情况下进行负载均衡，以保护成熟专家的利益。实验结果表明，不确定性感知路由机制能够降低困惑度，并提高专家的独特性，为实现热力学上最优的计算方式提供了理论依据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: S^4: Operationalizing Speech Act Theory for Strategic Semi-Structured Psychiatric Interview
papers.title_zh: S^4：将言语行为理论应用于战略性半结构化精神病学访谈中
papers.authors: Guanqun Bi, Zhoufu Liu, Zhuang Chen, Dazhen Wan, Xiyao Xiao, Minlie Huang
papers.abstract: Psychiatric interviewing is a strategic, goal-oriented interaction that requires proactively steering the conversation to elicit latent information. However, existing methods often degenerate into rigid interrogation or aimless chitchat due to a lack of strategic planning. In this work, we introduce S4, a comprehensive framework grounded in Speech Act Theory, modeling the interview as a unified process of internal strategy (Illocution and Perlocution) and external realization (Locution). We synthesize a large-scale dataset with fine-grained psychiatric speech act annotations. Trained on this data, S4Dial employs reinforcement learning driven by long-term therapeutic effects to optimize the strategic chaining of atomic acts, aiming to maximally elicit information and maintain patient engagement. Experiments demonstrate that S4 significantly outperforms baselines, validating the effectiveness of our effect-driven strategic modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 精神病学访谈是一种具有战略性和目标导向的互动方式，需要主动引导对话以引出潜在信息。然而，由于缺乏战略规划，现有的方法往往沦为僵化的审问或无目的的闲聊。在这项研究中，我们提出了S4框架，该框架基于言语行为理论，将访谈视为一个由内部策略（话语表达与效果实现）和外部实施（实际执行）构成的统一过程。我们整合了一个包含大量细粒度精神病学言语行为注释的大规模数据集。在这些数据上进行训练后，S4Dial利用长期治疗效果驱动的强化学习算法，优化原子行为的策略性组合，从而最大限度地获取信息并维持患者的参与感。实验表明，S4的表现显著优于现有基线方法，这验证了我们的以效果为导向的战略建模方法的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: More Aligned, Less Diverse? Analyzing the Grammar and Lexicon of Two Generations of LLMs
papers.title_zh: 更趋一致，差异更小？分析两代大型语言模型的语法与词汇特征
papers.authors: Adrián Gude, Roi Santos-Rios, Francis Bond, Dan Flickinger, Carlos Gómez-Rodríguez, Olga Zamaraeva
papers.abstract: This study contributes to a growing line of research in comparing LLM-generated texts with human-authored text, in this case, English news text. We focus in particular on the evaluation of syntactic properties through formal grammar frameworks. Our analysis compares two generations of LLMs in the context of two human-authored English news datasets from two different years. Employing the Head-Driven Phrase Structure Grammar (HPSG) formalism, we investigate the distributions of syntactic structures and lexical types of AI-generated texts and contrast them with the corresponding distributions in the human-authored New Your Times (NYT) articles. We use diversity metrics from ecology and information theory to quantify variation in grammatical constructions and lexical types. Our results show that, while English news text has changed little in the given time frame, newer, instruction-tuned LLMs display reduced syntactic and, especially, lexical diversity compared to older, non-instruction-tuned models. These findings point to future work in studying effects of instruction tuning, which, while enhancing coherence and adherence to prompts, may narrow the expressive range of model output.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究为比较大语言模型生成的文本与人类撰写的文本提供了重要的研究基础。我们特别关注通过形式语法框架来评估句法特性。我们的分析比较了两代大语言模型在两种不同年份的人类撰写英语新闻数据集上的表现。利用头部驱动短语结构语法这一理论框架，我们研究了人工智能生成文本的句法结构和词汇类型的分布，并将其与人类撰写的《纽约时报》文章中的相应数据进行了对比。我们运用了生态学和信息论中的多样性指标来量化语法结构和词汇类型的差异。研究结果表明，尽管在给定的时间范围内，英语新闻文本的变化不大，但较新的、经过指令调优的大语言模型在句法和词汇多样性方面都低于那些未经调优的旧模型。这些发现为后续研究指明了方向，即探讨指令调优对模型输出的影响。虽然指令调优能够提升模型的连贯性和对提示的遵循性，但它也可能限制模型的表达范围。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MemCoRL: Alternating Co-Optimization of Memory Retrieval and Utilization via Collaborative Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: MemCoRL：通过协作强化学习实现内存检索与利用的交替优化
papers.authors: Yuewen Liu, Peng Xu, Muxi Diao, Anyi Zhang, Yang Li, Yutong Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are inherently constrained by their fixed-length context windows, which limits LLMs’ ability to retain and utilize information across long-term interactions. To address this limitation, recent work has proposed external memory modules for LLMs. Using memory modules typically involves two stages: evidence retrieval and memory utilization. While prior work focuses on the architecture of memory modules and the retrieval stage, the equally critical memory utilization stage remains underexplored. Building on this, we propose MemCoRL, a two-stage alternating co-optimization reinforcement learning method. Stage 1 optimizes evidence retrieval using citation feedback and semantic accuracy from utilization as rewards. Stage 2 optimizes utilization with rewards combining semantic similarity and lexical overlap. Iterative co-optimization establishes a positive feedback loop: better retrieval improves memory utilization, which in turn refines retrieval rewards. Experimental results show our approach outperforms the leading baselines on both lexical overlap and semantic similarity metrics, confirming the co-optimization in memory retrieval and memory utilization.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）本质上受到固定长度上下文窗口的限制，这限制了LLM在长期交互中保留和利用信息的能力。为了克服这一限制，近期的研究提出了用于LLM的外部记忆模块。使用记忆模块通常涉及两个阶段：证据检索和记忆利用。虽然之前的研究主要集中在记忆模块的架构以及检索阶段，但同样重要的记忆利用阶段却没有得到充分探索。在此基础上，我们提出了MemCoRL，这是一种两阶段交替优化的强化学习方法。第一阶段通过结合利用过程中的引用反馈和语义准确性来优化证据检索；第二阶段则通过结合语义相似性和词汇重叠性来优化记忆利用过程。这种迭代的优化机制形成了一个正反馈循环：更好的检索效果会提升记忆利用能力，而记忆利用能力的提升又会进一步优化检索奖励。实验结果表明，我们的方法在词汇重叠和语义相似性指标上均优于现有的主流基线算法，这证实了在记忆检索和记忆利用方面的协同优化效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Fast and Accurate Fisher-Guided Quantization via Efficient Kronecker Factorization
papers.title_zh: 通过高效的克罗内克分解实现快速且准确的费舍尔引导量化方法
papers.authors: Viktoriia A. Chekalina, Gerasin Timofey, Andrey Kuznetsov, Evgeny Frolov
papers.abstract: Quantization has shown strong results in preserving model quality under compression. However, under aggressive bit-width reductions, even quantization may require additional information to prevent performance degradation. A natural source of it is second-order curvature information, captured by the Hessian. Since the Hessian of the model layers is prohibitively large, direct computation is infeasible, making structured parameterizations and approximations crucial in practice.In this work, we propose efficient Kronecker-factored approximation yielding state-of-the-art performance when integrated into existing quantization schemes. Evaluations on the LLaMA and Qwen model families show near-baseline quality at 4-bit compression and only a 5–6% degradation at 2-bit. Moreover, our method substantially accelerates the most expensive component in second-order quantization – Hessian parameterization – achieving up to a 10× speedup over prior approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 量化技术在保持模型质量方面取得了显著效果。然而，在大幅减少比特位数的情况下，量化仍可能需要额外的信息来防止性能下降。其中一个自然的补充来源就是二阶曲率信息，这些信息可以通过Hessian矩阵来获取。由于模型层的Hessian矩阵规模庞大，直接计算是不可行的，因此在实际应用中，结构化参数化和近似方法变得至关重要。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种高效的Kronecker分解近似方法，该方法在集成到现有的量化方案中后，能够取得领先的性能表现。在LaMA和Qwen模型家族上的评估结果显示，在4比特压缩率下，该方法的性能接近基线水平；而在2比特压缩率下，性能仅下降了5-6%。此外，我们的方法还大大加速了二阶量化中最耗时的步骤——Hessian参数化过程，其处理速度比现有方法快了10倍。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Discovering a Shared Logical Subspace: Steering LLM Logical Reasoning via Alignment of Natural-Language and Symbolic Views
papers.title_zh: 发现共享的逻辑子空间：通过整合自然语言与符号化描述来引导大语言模型的逻辑推理
papers.authors: Feihao Fang, My T. Thai, Yuanyuan Lei
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) still struggle with multi-step logical reasoning. Existing approaches either purely refine the reasoning chain in natural language form or attach a symbolic solver as an external module. In this work, we instead ask whether LLMs contain a shared internal logical subspace that simultaneously aligns natural-language and symbolic-language views of the reasoning process. Our hypothesis is that this logical subspace captures logical reasoning capabilities in LLMs that are shared across views while remaining independent of surface forms. To verify this, we employ Canonical Correlation Analysis on the paired residual activations from natural-language and symbolic-language reasoning chains, learning a low-dimensional subspace with maximum cross-view correlation. Furthermore, we design a training-free approach that steers LLMs reasoning chain along this logical subspace, thereby leveraging the complementary reasoning signals from both views. Experiments on four logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, improving accuracy by up to 11 percentage points and generalizing well on out-of-domain problems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多步骤逻辑推理方面仍然存在困难。现有的方法要么仅对自然语言形式的推理链进行优化，要么将符号求解器作为外部模块加入模型中。在我们的研究中，我们探讨了语言模型是否包含了一个共享的内部逻辑子空间，该子空间能够同时涵盖自然语言与符号语言的推理方式。我们的假设是，这个逻辑子空间能够捕捉到语言模型在不同视角下共有的逻辑推理能力，同时这些能力与表面的形式无关。为了验证这一假设，我们对自然语言与符号语言推理链中的残差激活值进行了典型相关分析，从而找到了一个具有最大交叉视角相关性的低维子空间。此外，我们还设计了一种无需训练的方法，该方法可以引导语言模型的推理链沿着这个逻辑子空间进行，从而充分利用两种视角下的互补推理信号。在四个逻辑推理基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法非常有效，准确率提高了多达11个百分点，并且在非领域问题上也表现出良好的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: One Refiner to Unlock Them All: Inference-Time Reasoning Elicitation via Reinforcement Query Refinement
papers.title_zh: 通过强化查询的优化来实现所有问题的解决：基于推理时间的推理引导方法
papers.authors: Yixiao Zhou, Dongzhou Cheng, Zhiliang wu, Yi Yang, Yu Cheng, Hehe Fan
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often fail to utilize their latent reasoning capabilities due to a distributional mismatch between ambiguous human inquiries and the structured logic required for machine activation. Existing alignment methods either incur prohibitive O(N) costs by fine-tuning each model individually or rely on static prompts that fail to resolve query-level structural complexity. In this paper, we propose ReQueR (Reinforcement Query Refinement), a modular framework that treats reasoning elicitation as an inference-time alignment task. We train a specialized Refiner policy via Reinforcement Learning to rewrite raw queries into explicit logical decompositions, treating frozen LLMs as the environment. Rooted in the classical Zone of Proximal Development from educational psychology, we introduce the Adaptive Solver Hierarchy, a curriculum mechanism that stabilizes training by dynamically aligning environmental difficulty with the Refiner’s evolving competence. ReQueR yields consistent absolute gains of 1.3%–7.2% across diverse architectures and benchmarks, outperforming strong baselines by 2.1% on average. Crucially, it provides a promising paradigm for one-to-many inference-time reasoning elicitation, enabling a single Refiner trained on a small set of models to effectively unlock reasoning in diverse unseen Solvers. Code is available at https://github.com/newera-xiao/ReQueR.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）往往无法充分利用其潜在的推理能力，这是因为人类提出的模糊问题与机器处理这些问题的结构化逻辑之间存在不匹配。现有的对齐方法要么需要为每个模型单独进行微调，从而带来极高的O(N)计算成本；要么依赖于静态的提示方式，但这无法解决查询层面的结构复杂性问题。在本文中，我们提出了ReQueR这一模块化框架，它将推理引导视为一种推理时间对齐任务。我们通过强化学习训练出一个专门的“精炼器”策略，用于将原始查询重新写成明确的逻辑分解形式，并将固定的LLM视为环境。基于教育心理学中的“最近发展区”概念，我们引入了自适应求解器层次结构这一课程机制，该机制通过动态调整环境难度与精炼器的能力水平来稳定训练过程。ReQueR在不同架构和基准测试中的表现均取得 1.3%–7.2% 的稳定绝对提升，平均而言，其性能比强大的基线模型高出2.1%。重要的是，它提供了一种有效的解决方案，使得仅通过少量模型训练的精炼器能够实现对多种未见求解器的有效推理。代码可访问于https://github.com/newera-xiao/ReQueR。

papers.title: Why Does Reinforcement Learning Generalize? A Feature-Level Mechanistic Study of Post-Training in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 为什么强化学习能够实现泛化？对大型语言模型训练后行为的特征层面机制研究
papers.authors: Dan Shi, Zhuowen Han, Simon Ostermann, Renren Jin, Josef van Genabith, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training often improves the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs) beyond the training domain, while supervised fine-tuning (SFT) frequently leads to general capabilities forgetting. However, the mechanisms underlying this contrast remain unclear.To bridge this gap, we present a feature-level mechanistic analysis methodology to probe RL generalization using a controlled experimental setup, where RL- and SFT-tuned models are trained from the same base model on identical data. Leveraging our interpretability framework, we align internal activations across models within a shared feature space and analyze how features evolve during post-training.We find that SFT rapidly introduces many highly specialized features that stabilize early in training, whereas RL induces more restrained and continually evolving feature changes that largely preserve base models’ representations. Focusing on samples where RL succeeds but the base model fails, we identify a compact, task-agnostic set of features that directly mediate generalization across diverse tasks. Feature-level interventions confirm their causal role: disabling these features significantly degrades RL models’ generalization performance, while amplifying them improves base models’ performance. The code is available at https://github.com/danshi777/RL-generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于强化学习的训练后改进通常能提升大语言模型在训练领域之外的推理能力，而监督式微调则常常导致通用能力的遗忘。然而，造成这种差异的机制仍然不清楚。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种特征级机制分析方法，通过受控实验设置来探究强化学习的泛化能力。在这种设置中，强化学习和监督式微调的模型都从同一个基础模型中训练而来，且使用相同的数据集。利用我们的可解释性框架，我们将不同模型内部的激活函数对齐到一个共享的特征空间中，并分析训练后特征的变化情况。我们发现，监督式微调会迅速引入许多高度专业化的特征，这些特征在训练初期就能稳定下来；而强化学习则会产生更为温和且不断演变的特征变化，这些变化在很大程度上保留了基础模型的表示能力。通过研究强化学习有效但基础模型失效的情况，我们发现了一组简洁、与任务无关的特征，这些特征直接促进了不同任务的泛化能力。特征级的干预措施进一步证实了它们的因果作用：禁用这些特征会显著降低强化学习模型的泛化能力，而增强这些特征则会提升基础模型的性能。相关代码可以在https://github.com/danshi777/RL-generalization下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Polymorphic Universal Transformer
papers.title_zh: 多态通用变换器
papers.authors: Yilong Chen, Zitian Gao, Yihao Xiao, Jason Klein Liu, Xinyu Yang, Yifan Luo, Haoming Luo, Zhengmao Ye, Tingwen Liu, Ran Tao, Bryan Dai
papers.abstract: Although the Universal Transformer (UT) mitigates the diminishing returns of standard LLM scaling by decoupling parameter count from depth, it remains constrained by linear computational costs and rigid weight-sharing mechanisms. These limitations lead to severe functional homogeneity, which subsequently induces over-smoothing, representation rank collapse, and degraded reasoning performance. In this work, we present the first systematic study of Compute Distribution Skew, identifying it as the primary driver of extrapolation failure. This is a pathological phenomenon in ultra-deep recurrent Transformers characterized by a disproportionate distribution of contributions across recurrent steps, resulting in distinct functional states during prefix and suffix processing phases. To address this challenge, we propose the Polymorphic Transformer, which aims to achieve functional polymorphism and depth sparsity within a shared-parameter framework. By integrating conditional sparse subspaces, SiLU Attention, and an uncertainty-aware depth scheduler, our architecture mitigates power-method collapse and effectively decouples logical depth from computational cost. Experiments demonstrate that our model significantly enhances representation rank and robustness, achieving complex reasoning performance comparable to baseline while reducing computation by 64.7%.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管通用变换器通过将参数数量与深度分离来缓解标准大语言模型扩展带来的收益递减问题，但它仍然受到线性计算成本和僵化的权重分配机制的限制。这些限制导致了严重的功能同质性问题，进而引发了过度平滑化、表示等级崩溃以及推理性能下降等问题。在这项研究中，我们首次系统研究了计算分布偏差现象，并将其确定为外推失败的主要诱因。这是一种在超深度循环变换器中出现的病态现象，其特征是各循环步骤之间的贡献分布不均衡，导致在前缀处理和后缀处理阶段出现不同的功能状态。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了多态变换器，该架构旨在在共享参数的框架下实现功能多态性和深度稀疏性。通过整合条件稀疏子空间、SiLU注意力机制以及一种具有不确定性感知的深度调度算法，我们的架构有效缓解了功率方法崩溃问题，并实现了逻辑深度与计算成本的分离。实验表明，我们的模型显著提升了表示等级和鲁棒性，其复杂的推理性能与基线模型相当，同时减少了64.7%的计算量。

papers.title: Can Reasoning Path still be Effective as Input? Bridging Post-Reasoning to Chain-of-Thought Compression
papers.title_zh: “推理路径”作为输入内容，是否仍然有效？在后推理与思维链压缩之间建立联系
papers.authors: Chengzhengxu Li, Xiaoming Liu, Zhaohan Zhang, Shengchao Liu, Guoxin Ma, Yu Lan, Cong Wang, Chao Shen
papers.abstract: Recent developments have enabled advanced reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) via long Chain-of-Thought (CoT), trading efficiency during inference for performance. Existing works focus on compressing generated CoT in reasoning, which impairs the necessary information for deriving the correct answer. In this work, we propose post-reasoning, a reasoning paradigm that takes CoT as a part of context to simplify the reasoning task for LLMs. We find that post-reasoning significantly reduces the generation length of LLMs, but its effectiveness hinges on the efficiency and the reliability of the contextual CoT generation.Therefore, we propose Upfront CoT (UCoT), an efficient post-reasoning framework for CoT compression. UCoT trains a lightweight model (compressor) to provide contextual CoT in form of soft tokens and trains the LLM (executor) to leverage this contextual CoT for producing the final answer. Extensive experiments show that UCoT maintains the powerful reasoning ability of executor while significantly reducing the length of CoT. It is worth mentioning that when applying UCoT to the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model, the usage of tokens on GSM8K dataset is reduced by 50%, while the performance is 3.08% higher than that of the state-of-the-art (SOTA) method. The code is available at: https://github.com/czx-li/UCoT.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究使得大语言模型能够通过长思维链来进行高级推理，从而以较低的推理效率换取更高的性能。现有的研究主要集中在压缩生成的思维链上，但这会忽略得出正确答案所需的关键信息。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种后推理方法，该方法将思维链作为上下文的一部分，从而简化大语言模型的推理任务。我们发现，后推理显著减少了大语言模型的生成长度，但其有效性取决于上下文思维链的生成效率和可靠性。因此，我们提出了一种高效的预推理框架——Upfront CoT（UCoT）。UCoT训练一个轻量级模型来生成上下文思维链，并以软令牌的形式提供这些令牌，然后训练大语言模型来利用这些上下文思维链生成最终答案。大量实验表明，UCoT在显著减少思维链长度的同时，仍然保持了大语言模型强大的推理能力。值得一提的是，当将UCoT应用于Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型时，GSM8K数据集上的令牌使用量减少了50%，而性能则比最先进的方法高出3.08%。相关代码可访问：https://github.com/czx-li/UCoT。

papers.title: REAL: REtrieval-reAsoning and Logic-constructed Attention Behaviors for Long-Context KV Cache Compression
papers.title_zh: REAL：基于检索推理与逻辑构建的注意力行为，用于长上下文键值缓存压缩
papers.authors: Mengjie Li, Yuan Feng, Xike Xie, William J. Song
papers.abstract: The growing sequence length of large language models poses significant challenges for key-value (KV) caches. Existing state-of-the-art cache eviction methods primarily analyze the inference behavior of attention heads in successful retrieval-reasoning cases, often overlooking diverse behaviors in failure cases, such as bias and distraction. This oversight limits the potential to leverage heterogeneous head behaviors for improved eviction performance. Inspired by the confusion matrix, we introduce an Attention Behavior Matrix to comprehensively analyze attention head behaviors in both success and failure scenarios. By maximizing the signal-to-noise ratio — strengthening valid reasoning pathways in success cases while inhibiting noise from bias and distraction in failure cases — we propose REtrieval-reAsoning and Logic-constructed (REAL) KV cache eviction, the first method to leverage multi-behavior analysis. Comprehensive evaluations show that REAL achieves remarkable performance across various models and benchmarks; notably, on LongBench v2, it achieves comparable accuracy to the strongest baseline, HeadKV-R2, while requiring 32x less space. By offering a novel perspective on behavior analysis, we pave the way for a shift from success-only to comprehensive, failure-aware methods in long-context modeling. Our code is available at https://github.com/yonseicasl/REAL.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型不断增长的序列长度给键值缓存带来了重大挑战。现有的最先进的缓存淘汰方法主要关注的是在成功检索推理情况下的注意力头的推理行为，而往往忽略了失败情况下的各种行为，比如偏见和分心等问题。这种忽略限制了利用不同头部行为来提高淘汰性能的可能性。受混淆矩阵的启发，我们引入了注意力行为矩阵，以全面分析注意力头在成功和失败情况下的行为。通过最大化信号与噪声的比例——在成功情况下强化有效的推理路径，同时在失败情况下抑制偏见和分心的干扰——我们提出了REtrieval-reAsoning和Logic-constructed（REAL）键值缓存淘汰方法，这是第一种利用多行为分析的方法。全面的评估表明，REAL在各种模型和基准测试中都表现优异；特别是在LongBench v2上，它的准确率与最强的基线模型HeadKV-R2相当，同时占用的存储空间却减少了32倍。通过提供一种新的行为分析视角，我们为从仅关注成功情况到全面考虑失败情况的方法在长上下文建模中的应用铺平了道路。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/yonseicasl/REAL下载。

papers.title: From Where Words Come: Efficient Regularization of Code Tokenizers Through Source Attribution
papers.title_zh: 从文字的诞生之地：通过源字符串归属实现代码标记器的高效正则化
papers.authors: Pavel Chizhov, Egor Bogomolov, Ivan P. Yamshchikov
papers.abstract: Efficiency and safety of Large Language Models (LLMs), among other factors, rely on the quality of tokenization. A good tokenizer not only improves inference speed and language understanding but also provides extra defense against jailbreak attacks and lowers the risk of hallucinations. In this work, we investigate the efficiency of code tokenization, in particular from the perspective of data source diversity. We demonstrate that code tokenizers are prone to producing unused, and thus under-trained, tokens due to the imbalance in repository and language diversity in the training data, as well as the dominance of source-specific, repetitive tokens that are often unusable in future inference. By modifying the BPE objective and introducing merge skipping, we implement different techniques under the name Source-Attributed BPE (SA-BPE) to regularize BPE training and minimize overfitting, thereby substantially reducing the number of under-trained tokens while maintaining the same inference procedure as with regular BPE. This provides an effective tool suitable for production use.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的效率和安全性，以及其他因素，都依赖于分词的质量。一个好的分词器不仅能够提高推理速度和语言理解能力，还能为模型提供额外的防御措施，降低出现幻觉的风险。在这项研究中，我们探讨了代码分词的效率问题，特别是从数据源多样性的角度来进行分析。我们发现，由于训练数据中代码库和语言多样性的不平衡，以及特定来源、重复性的词元在训练中的主导地位，导致代码分词器容易产生未使用的、因此训练不足的词元。为了改善这一情况，我们采用了名为“源属性BPE”（SA-BPE）的技术，通过修改BPE的目标函数并引入合并跳过机制，从而规范BPE的训练过程，减少过拟合现象，进而大幅减少训练不足的词元数量，同时保持与常规BPE相同的推理流程。这项技术为实际应用提供了有效的工具。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EmoS: A High-Fidelity Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-grained Streaming Emotional Understanding
papers.title_zh: EmoS：一种高保真多模态基准测试平台，适用于细粒度情感流的识别与理解
papers.authors: Pengze Guo, Jingxi Liang, Zhiwen Xie, Qifeng Wang, Derek F. Wong
papers.abstract: In the context of today’s high-pressure, aging society, the demand for large-scale emotional models capable of providing empathetic support is more critical than ever. However, existing benchmarks fail to simultaneously achieve ecological validity, signal clarity, and reliable fine-grained labeling. We introduce EmoS, a high-fidelity bilingual benchmark designed to resolve the limitations of ecological validity and noise in existing datasets by combining strictly filtered static slices with a dynamic Streaming Monologue subset. Supported by a rigorous dual-layer human annotation pipeline, EmoS provides trusted ground truth that captures continuous emotional evolution. Empirical results show that fine-tuning MLLMs (multimodal large language models) on EmoS yields significant gains over zero-shot baselines, laying the foundation for the training and evaluation of future emotion recognition models and empathy models. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/NLP2CT/EmoS.
papers.abstract_zh: 在当今这个压力巨大、社会日益老龄化的背景下，对于能够提供同理心支持的大规模情感模型的需求比以往任何时候都更为迫切。然而，现有的评估基准在生态有效性、信号清晰度以及可靠的细粒度标注方面都存在不足。我们提出了EmoS这一高保真度的双语评估基准，它通过结合严格筛选的静态数据片段与动态流媒体对话数据，从而克服现有数据集在生态有效性和噪声方面的局限性。依托于严谨的双层人类标注流程，EmoS能够提供可靠的真实数据，从而捕捉到持续的情感变化。实验结果表明，在EmoS上进行微调的多模态大语言模型相比零样本基线模型具有显著优势，这为未来情感识别模型和同理心模型的训练与评估奠定了基础。该数据集和代码可在此处免费获取：https://github.com/NLP2CT/EmoS

papers.title: Surprisal Minimisation over Goal-directed Alternatives Predicts Production Choice in Dialogue
papers.title_zh: 针对目标导向选项的惊喜最小化策略，能够预测对话中的生产选择
papers.authors: Thomas P. Utting, Mario Giulianelli, Arabella Sinclair
papers.abstract: We model utterance production as probabilistic cost-sensitive choice over contextual alternatives, using information-theoretic notions of cost. We distinguish between goal-directed alternatives that realise a fixed communicative intent and goal-agnostic alternatives defined only by contextual plausibility, allowing us to derive speaker- and listener-oriented interpretations of different cost measures. We present a procedure to generate both types of alternative sets using language models. Analysing production choices in open-ended dialogue under both deterministic and noisy cost minimisation, we find that surprisal minimisation relative to goal-directed alternatives provides the strongest explanation of production choices. Uniformity-based costs show weaker overall predictive power, but their influence increases markedly when evaluated relative to goal-agnostic alternatives, consistent with listener-oriented accounts. More broadly, our study suggests that alternative-conditioned optimisation with LM-generated alternatives provides a principled framework for studying speaker and listener pressures in naturalistic language production.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们将话语产生过程建模为在多种上下文选项中进行的概率性成本敏感选择，并运用信息论中的成本概念来描述这种选择。我们区分了那些为了实现特定交流意图而选择的、具有目标导向性的选项，以及那些仅由上下文合理性决定的、无目标导向性的选项。通过这种方式，我们可以得出关于不同成本度量的说话者导向和听者导向的解释。我们提出了一种利用语言模型生成这两种类型选项集的方法。通过对开放式对话中在确定性成本和噪声最小化条件下的选择进行分析，我们发现相对于目标导向性选项而言，惊喜最小化原则能够最有效地解释话语产生行为。基于均匀性的成本虽然整体预测能力较弱，但在与无目标导向性选项相比时，其影响显著增强，这与听者导向的解释相一致。更广泛地说，我们的研究表明，利用语言模型生成的选项来进行选项条件优化，为研究自然语言产生过程中的说话者和听者的压力提供了一个有原则的框架。

papers.title: HowToNarrate: A General-Domain Benchmark for Synchronized Video Narration with External Knowledge
papers.title_zh: HowToNarrate：一种用于同步视频解说并整合外部知识的通用基准测试工具
papers.authors: Xueyan Wang, Dingyi Yang, Qin Jin
papers.abstract: We present HowToNarrate, the first general-domain benchmark for Synchronized Video Narration. The benchmark contains 3.2K videos across seven domains, segmented into 37.5K clips with aligned narrations and associated external knowledge. Effective narration requires models to understand visual scenes, incorporate relevant knowledge, and produce coherent, length-appropriate descriptions. We systematically benchmark current Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) on these abilities. Our analysis shows that existing MLLMs overemphasize knowledge retrieval while largely neglecting prior context (receiving less than 10% attention). Moreover, they often conflate narration context with external knowledge, leading to redundancy and incoherence. To mitigate these issues, we propose VideoNarrationAgent, a multi-agent framework that combines context compression, knowledge retrieval, and narration generation. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves MLLM performance. Furthermore, instruction tuning on HowToNarrate enhances both context-awareness and length control, boosting Qwen2.5-VL’s score from 25 to 84. We will release all data and code to support future research in synchronized video narration.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了HowToNarrate这一首个适用于同步视频叙事的通用领域基准测试。该基准测试包含7个领域的3.2K个视频，这些视频被分割成37.5K个片段，每个片段都有对齐的旁白内容以及相关的外部知识。有效的叙事需要模型能够理解视觉场景、整合相关知识，并生成连贯且长度恰当的描述。我们对当前的多模态大语言模型在这些能力上的表现进行了系统的评估。分析结果显示，现有的多模态大语言模型过于强调知识检索，而严重忽视了之前的上下文信息（关注度不足10%）。此外，它们常常将叙事上下文与外部知识混为一谈，导致冗余和不连贯的情况发生。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了VideoNarrationAgent这一多智能体框架，它结合了上下文压缩、知识检索和叙事生成功能。实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了多模态大语言模型的性能。此外，通过调整HowToNarrate的指令参数，我们能够提高模型的上下文感知能力和长度控制能力，使得Qwen2.5-VL的得分从25提升到了84。我们将公开所有数据和代码，以支持未来在同步视频叙事领域的研究工作。

papers.title: Putting HUMANS first: Efficient LAM Evaluation with Human Preference Alignment
papers.title_zh: 将人类需求置于首位：基于人类偏好的高效LAM评估方法
papers.authors: Woody Haosheng Gan, William Barr Held, Diyi Yang
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of large audio models (LAMs) demands efficient approaches for model comparison, yet comprehensive benchmarks are costly. To fill this gap, we investigate whether minimal subsets can reliably evaluate LAMs while reducing costs and data redundancy. Analyzing 10 subset selection methods with 18 audio models across 40 tasks covering major LAM evaluation dimensions, we show that subsets of just 50 examples (0.3% of data) can achieve over 0.93 Pearson correlation with full benchmark scores. To understand how well these scores align with what practitioners ultimately care about—user satisfaction—we collect 776 human preference ratings from realistic voice assistant conversations, finding that both subsets and full benchmark achieve only 0.85 correlation with human. To better predict preferences, we trained regression models on these selected subsets, achieving 0.98 correlation—outperforming regression models trained on both random subsets and the full benchmark. This demonstrates that in regression modeling, well-curated subsets outpredict the full benchmark, showing quality over quantity. We open-source these regression-weighted subsets as the HUMANS benchmark, an efficient proxy for LAM evaluation that captures both benchmark performance and user preferences.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型音频模型（LAMs）的迅速增长，迫切需要高效的模型比较方法，但全面的基准测试成本很高。为了填补这一空白，我们研究了是否可以通过使用最小子集来可靠地评估LAMs，同时降低成本和减少数据冗余。我们分析了10种子集选择方法，涉及18个音频模型和40项任务，涵盖了主要的LAM评估维度。结果表明，仅使用50个样本的子集（占数据的0.3%）就能与完整的基准测试成绩达到超过0.93的皮尔逊相关系数。为了了解这些分数与从业者真正关心的用户满意度之间的关联程度，我们收集了776条来自真实语音助手对话的人类偏好评分，发现无论是使用子集还是完整的基准测试，其相关性都仅为0.85。为了更好地预测偏好，我们在这些选定的子集中训练了回归模型，其相关性达到了0.98——这一结果优于在随机子集和完整基准测试上训练的回归模型。这表明，在回归建模中，精心挑选的子集能够超越完整的基准测试，显示出质量优于数量。我们将这些基于回归权重的子集开源，作为HUMANS基准测试，这是一个高效的LAM评估替代方案，能够同时捕捉到基准测试性能和用户偏好。

papers.title: Towards Fast and Accurate Modeling for Cross-Lingual Label Projection
papers.title_zh: 致力于实现快速且准确的跨语言标签映射建模技术
papers.authors: Thang Le, Huy Huu Nguyen, Anh Tuan Luu, Thamar Solorio, Thien Huu Nguyen
papers.abstract: Information extraction (IE) systems rely on structured data for training, but such annotated data is highly imbalanced across languages, with low-resource languages receiving little attention. Label projection techniques aim to bridge this gap by transferring structured annotations from high-resource to low-resource languages. However, existing methods are either inaccurate or too slow for large-scale use. This work aims to address this problem by developing a more effective method that remains sufficiently efficient for large-scale projection. In particular, we propose to synthesize alignment sequence pairs and fine-tune an encoder model with span alignment objective, while controlling data influence during training. Experimental results across 50+ languages show that our framework consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods while maintaining fast inference speed. In addition, we introduce EXP - the first benchmark for explicit evaluation of label projection, thereby reducing confounders and non-determinism in method assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 信息提取系统依赖结构化数据进行训练，但这种带有注释的数据在不同语言之间的分布极不平衡，资源匮乏的语言往往得不到足够的关注。标签投影技术旨在弥合这一差距，通过将结构化注释从资源丰富的语言转移到资源匮乏的语言中。然而，现有的方法要么精度不高，要么运行速度太慢，无法适用于大规模应用。本研究旨在解决这一问题，开发一种更有效的算法，同时保证其在大规模应用中的高效性。具体来说，我们提出了一种合成对齐序列对的方法，并采用跨度对齐目标来微调编码器模型，同时在训练过程中控制数据的影响。在50多种语言上的实验结果表明，我们的框架在保持快速推理速度的同时，始终优于现有的最先进方法。此外，我们还引入了EXP——首个用于明确评估标签投影的基准测试，从而减少了方法评估中的干扰因素和不确定性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: False Friends or Cognates? A Cross-lingual Semantic Ambiguity Evaluation for Galician, Portuguese and Spanish
papers.title_zh: 真正的朋友还是同源语言？对加利西亚语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语之间语义歧义的跨语言评估
papers.authors: Marta Vázquez Abuín, Jose Camacho-Collados, Marcos Garcia
papers.abstract: The linguistic proximity between Galician, Portuguese, and Spanish results in a lexical overlap that often conceals semantic interference. This is particularly evident in false friends, posing a challenge for NLP systems.In this work, we assess whether state-of-the-art language models can identify and process false friends among these languages. We introduce six cross-lingual datasets –created manually or using semi-automatic methods, with all instances being carefully verified– covering cognates and false friends. We evaluate a broad range of encoder and decoder models of varying sizes via zero-shot and few-shot settings. Our results highlight the challenging nature of the task, but also show the clear progress made by LLMs in recent years, particularly those of a larger size, with smaller language models struggling on the task. Notably, unlike other tasks where language distance poses additional challenges, we find that linguistic proximity itself introduces errors: closely related language pairs tend to perform worse, reflecting the challenge of semantic discrimination due to lexical overlap.
papers.abstract_zh: 加利西亚语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语之间的语言相似性导致词汇上的重叠，这往往会导致语义上的干扰。这种情况在“假朋友”现象中尤为明显，给自然语言处理系统带来了挑战。在这项研究中，我们评估了最先进的语言模型是否能够识别并处理这些语言中的“假朋友”。我们引入了六个跨语言数据集——这些数据集是通过人工方式或半自动方法创建的，所有实例都经过了仔细的验证——其中包含了同源词和“假朋友”。我们通过零样本和少样本的方式，对多种不同规模的编码器和解码器模型进行了评估。我们的研究结果凸显了这项任务的挑战性，同时也显示了大语言模型近年来取得的显著进步，而规模较小的语言模型则在这方面表现较差。值得注意的是，与其他需要应对语言差异带来的挑战的任务不同，我们发现语言本身的接近性本身也会引入错误：关系相近的语言对往往表现更差，这反映了由于词汇重叠而导致的语义区分的困难。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: BlindGuard: Safeguarding LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems under Unknown Attacks
papers.title_zh: BlindGuard：在未知攻击下保护基于大语言模型的多智能体系统
papers.authors: Rui Miao, Yixin Liu, Yili Wang, Xu Shen, Yue Tan, Yiwei Dai, Shirui Pan, Xin Wang
papers.abstract: The security of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) is critically threatened by propagation vulnerability, where malicious agents can distort collective decision-making through inter-agent interactions. While existing supervised defense methods demonstrate promising performance, they may be impractical in real-world scenarios due to their heavy reliance on labeled malicious agents to train a supervised malicious detection model. To enable practical and generalizable MAS defenses, in this paper, we propose BlindGuard, an unsupervised defense method that learns without requiring any attack-specific labels or prior knowledge of malicious behaviors. To this end, we establish a hierarchical agent encoder to capture individual, neighborhood, and global interaction patterns of each agent, providing a comprehensive understanding for malicious agent detection. Meanwhile, we design a corruption-guided detector that consists of directional noise injection and contrastive learning, allowing effective detection model training solely on normal agent behaviors. Extensive experiments show that BlindGuard effectively detects diverse attack types across MAS with various communication patterns while maintaining superior generalizability compared to supervised baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的安全性面临着传播漏洞的严重威胁，恶意智能体可以通过智能体之间的交互来扭曲集体决策。虽然现有的监督式防御方法表现良好，但在现实场景中可能并不实用，因为它们严重依赖带有标签的恶意智能体来训练监督式恶意检测模型。为了实现实用且可泛化的多智能体系统防御机制，本文提出了BlindGuard这一无监督防御方法。该方法无需任何针对攻击的标签或关于恶意行为的先验知识即可进行学习。为此，我们构建了一个分层智能体编码器，能够捕捉每个智能体的个体、邻域以及全局交互模式，从而实现对恶意智能体的全面识别。同时，我们设计了一种基于腐蚀引导的检测器，该检测器通过定向噪声注入和对比学习来实现有效的检测模型训练，使得检测模型仅基于正常智能体的行为就能进行训练。大量实验表明，BlindGuard能够有效检测具有各种通信模式的多种类型的攻击，同时其泛化能力优于传统的监督式防御方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Black-Box Membership Inference Attacks for Video Training Data in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在多模态大语言模型中针对视频训练数据的黑盒会员资格推理攻击
papers.authors: Jinrui Wang, Zhenfeng Gao, Wendan Wang, Huili Wang, Zichen Qin, Linjie Zhu, Hongke Fu, Shangguang Wang, Tao Qi
papers.abstract: The increasing use of video data in training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) raises significant concerns on privacy leakage and copyright violations, highlighting the need for detecting improperly used training videos through membership inference attacks (MIAs). Most existing video MIA methods assess model memorization of key semantic concepts within a video (e.g., the name of a well-known movie character). However, such concepts usually appear repeatedly throughout the training corpus, and memorization of them does not constitute reliable evidence that a specific video was used during training. Besides, while some methods mitigate this limitation by capturing relationships between frames, they require a model logit-accessible setting and are impractical in realistic black-box scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose a black-box MIA framework, named VideoMIA, that can provide reliable evidence of specific video data usage for training MLLMs. The key of our method is to leverage temporal dependencies across video frames to evaluate the model’s memorization of sequential dynamics within the video data, which cannot be inferred solely from general world knowledge or individual image data. The results across ten MLLMs and four benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently achieves superior performance over all baselines in black-box evaluation settings. Code is available in https://github.com/jinruiwang258/VideoMIA.
papers.abstract_zh: 在训练多模态大语言模型时，视频数据的使用日益增多，但这也引发了关于隐私泄露和版权侵犯的重大担忧。因此，需要通过成员推理攻击来检测未经授权的训练视频的使用情况。目前大多数视频成员推理方法都是基于评估模型对视频中关键语义概念的记忆程度（例如，某个知名电影角色的名字）。然而，这类概念在训练语料库中通常会反复出现，而仅仅记住这些概念并不能作为证明某个特定视频在训练过程中被使用的可靠证据。此外，虽然有些方法通过捕捉帧与帧之间的关系来缓解这个问题，但这些方法需要模型以可访问的方式运行，这在实际的黑箱场景中并不实用。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种黑箱成员推理框架——VideoMIA。该框架能够提供关于特定视频数据在训练多模态大语言模型中的使用的可靠证据。我们的方法的关键在于利用视频帧之间的时间依赖性来评估模型对视频数据中序列动态的记忆程度，而这一点无法仅通过一般的世界知识或单个图像数据来推断出来。在十种多模态大语言模型和四个基准测试中的实验结果表明，我们的方法在黑箱评估环境中始终优于所有基线方法。相关代码可以在https://github.com/jinruiwang258/VideoMIA下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Mitigating Safety Context Amnesia in Multimodal Reasoning Models via Intent-Guided Safety Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 通过基于意图的安全推理，减轻多模态推理模型中与安全相关的信息缺失问题
papers.authors: Xiyao Dong, Guangsheng Cheng, YiLong Chen, Xiaojin Zhang, Kun He
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) have enabled explicit chain-of-thought inference across vision and language, substantially improving performance on complex reasoning tasks. Despite these gains, the reasoning process introduces a subtle yet critical vulnerability. We identify an underexplored multimodal safety failure mode in which harmful objectives are embedded within ostensibly benign contexts, leading models to over-prioritize narrative coherence during reasoning. We term this phenomenon Safety Context Amnesia (SCA), wherein models correctly perceive risk-relevant visual cues but fail to enforce safety constraints as the reasoning process becomes dominated by contextual alignment. To mitigate SCA, we propose Intent-Guided Safety Reasoning (IGSR), an inference-time defense that operates without modifying target model parameters. IGSR employs a Perception Decoupler to extract objective visual evidence into a structured intent output, followed by a Cognitive Arbiter that enforces explicit safety constraints prior to generation. Extensive experiments across multiple multimodal safety benchmarks demonstrate that IGSR improves defense success rates by over 62% compared to baselines, while largely preserving task utility. These results highlight the critical role of structured, intent-aware reasoning in achieving robust safety reasoning for multimodal reasoning models.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在多模态大型推理模型方面的进展，使得视觉与语言之间的思维链推理变得更加清晰，从而显著提升了复杂推理任务的性能。尽管取得了这些进步，但推理过程仍然存在一种微妙但关键的漏洞。我们发现了一个被忽视的多模态安全故障模式：有害目标隐藏在看似无害的情境之中，导致模型在推理过程中过度重视叙事的连贯性。我们将这种现象称为“安全情境遗忘症”，即模型能够正确识别与风险相关的视觉线索，但在推理过程中无法执行安全约束。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“意图引导的安全推理”的方法。该方法在推理过程中无需修改目标模型的参数，而是通过感知解耦器将客观视觉证据转化为结构化的意图输出，随后通过认知仲裁器在生成之前强制执行明确的安全约束。在多个多模态安全基准测试中的广泛实验表明，与基线方法相比，IGSR能够将防御成功率提高超过62%，同时基本保持了任务的有效性。这些结果凸显了结构化、注重意图的推理在构建多模态推理模型时对于实现稳健安全推理的重要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: On-policy Reinforcement Fine-tuning with Offline reward for Multi-step Embodied Planning
papers.title_zh: 基于离线奖励的在线策略强化微调技术，用于多步实体规划
papers.authors: Di Wu, Jiaxin Fan, Chloe Gu, Guanbo Wang, Wei Yin, Wenhao Li, Bo Jin
papers.abstract: Embodied planning requires agents to make coherent multi-step decisions based on dynamic visual observations and verbal goals. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) excel at static perception tasks, they struggle in interactive environments. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a natural way to address this limitation, yet online RL approaches suffer from costly interaction and sparse rewards in embodied settings. This paper introduces ORBIT, an On-policy Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) framework with offline rewards for EmBodIed Task Planning, that preserves the generalization benefits of RFT while addressing the challenges of costly interaction and sparse rewards, supported by solid theoretical guarantees. Our approach is evaluated on EmbodiedBench, a recent benchmark for interactive embodied tasks, covering both in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios. Experimental results show that ORBIT achieves SOTA performance on EB-ALFRED, outperforming all closed-source and online-RL-based methods, while being substantially more efficient in training speed and computational cost, remaining robust to sub-optimal expert trajectories, and exhibiting strong generalization to unseen environments. We released all code and data at https://github.com/mail-taii/Reinforced-Reasoning-for-Embodied-Planning.
papers.abstract_zh: 具身规划要求智能体基于动态视觉观测和语言目标做出连贯的多步决策。虽然最近的视语模型在静态感知任务上表现优异，但在交互式环境中却存在困难。强化学习为解决这个问题提供了自然的方法，然而在线强化学习方法在具身环境中面临着交互成本较高以及奖励稀疏的问题。本文介绍了ORBIT这一基于策略的强化学习微调框架，该框架采用离线奖励机制来处理具身任务规划问题，同时保留了强化学习在泛化能力方面的优势，并有效解决了交互成本高和奖励稀疏的问题，其理论基础也相当扎实。我们在EmbodiedBench这个针对交互式具身任务的基准测试平台上对ORBIT进行了评估，涵盖了领域内外的场景。实验结果表明，ORBIT在EB-ALFRED任务上取得了顶尖性能，远远优于所有开源方法和基于在线强化学习的方法。此外，ORBIT在训练速度和计算成本方面具有显著的优势，而且能够很好地应对非最优专家轨迹的情况，同时还能很好地泛化到未见过的环境。我们已将所有代码和数据发布在https://github.com/mail-taii/Reinforced-Reasoning-for-Embodied-Planning网站上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Please refuse to answer me! Mitigating Over-Refusal in Large Language Models via Adaptive Contrastive Decoding
papers.title_zh: 请拒绝回答我的问题！通过自适应对比解码技术在大型语言模型中缓解过度拒绝问题
papers.authors: Yupeng Qi, Ziyu Lyu, Lixin Cui, Lu Bai, Feng Xia
papers.abstract: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) often generate refusal responses to harmless queries due to the over-refusal problem. However, existing methods for mitigating over-refusal cannot maintain a low refusal ratio for harmless queries while keeping a high refusal ratio for malicious ones. In this paper, we analyze how system prompts with varying safety levels affect LLM refusal behaviors when facing over-refusal queries. A key observation is that, when LLMs suffer from the over-refusal issue, non-refusal tokens remain present in the next-token candidate list, but the model systematically fails to select them, despite the generation of refusal tokens. Based on this observation, we propose a training-free and model-agnostic approach, Adaptive Contrastive Decoding (AdaCD), to mitigate over-refusal while maintaining LLM safety. First, AdaCD compares the output distributions of the LLM with or without an extreme safety system prompt to refine the refusal token distribution. Second, we introduce an adaptive contrastive decoding strategy that dynamically incorporates or removes the refusal token distribution, adaptively boosting the probability of selecting refusal or non-refusal tokens. Experimental results on five benchmark datasets show that, on average, AdaCD reduces the refusal ratio for over-refusal queries by 10.35%, yet still increases the refusal ratio for malicious queries by 0.13%. Code is available at https://shorturl.at/Z31Oe.
papers.abstract_zh: 与安全相关的大语言模型在应对无害查询时常常会产生拒绝响应，这是由于过度拒绝问题导致的。然而，现有的缓解过度拒绝的方法无法在保持对恶意查询的高拒绝率的同时，也能对无害查询保持较低的拒绝率。在本文中，我们分析了不同安全级别的系统提示如何影响大语言模型在面对过度拒绝查询时的拒绝行为。我们的关键发现是：当大语言模型出现过度拒绝问题时，非拒绝标记仍然存在于下一个候选标记列表中，但模型会系统性地忽略这些标记，尽管已经生成了拒绝标记。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种无需训练且独立于模型的解决方案——自适应对比解码法，以在保障大语言模型安全的同时缓解过度拒绝问题。首先，自适应对比解码法通过比较带有极端安全提示的模型与不带该提示的模型输出分布，来优化拒绝标记的分配。其次，我们引入了一种自适应对比解码策略，该策略能够动态添加或移除拒绝标记，从而适应性地提高选择拒绝或非拒绝标记的概率。在五个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，平均而言，自适应对比解码法可以将过度拒绝查询的拒绝率降低10.35%，同时还能将恶意查询的拒绝率提高0.13%。代码可访问于https://shorturl.at/Z31Oe。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
