papers.title: Knowledge Injection Exists in MoE? Exploring Expert-Aware Contrast Decoding in MoE for Mitigating LLMs’ Hallucinations
papers.title_zh: 在教育部是否存在知识注入现象？探讨在教育部中运用专家意识对比解码技术，以缓解大型语言模型产生的幻觉问题
papers.authors: Xinyue Fang, Zhiliang Tian, Zhen Huang, Ziyi Pan, Zhihua Wen, Xi Wang, Quntian Fang, Dongsheng Li
papers.abstract: Existing LLM hallucination mitigation methods, including prompt engineering and model optimization, either hardly alter models’ internal knowledge or have poor cross-domain generalization. Contrastive decoding mitigates hallucinations by using layer-wise differences in LLMs. However, prior studies only explore transformer-based models (e.g., GPT), ignoring other effective frameworks like mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. Since MoE alters the traditional transformer architecture, we conduct empirical studies to investigate whether similar layer-wise differences exist in MoEs. Our results show that they do not exist in MoE with shared experts; nevertheless, across different MoEs, higher layers exhibit distinct expert activation patterns between factual and non-factual outputs. Building on these, we propose EAACD, an expert-aware adaptive contrast decoding that uses expert differences in MoE’s higher layers to mitigate hallucinations on QA tasks. EAACD splits high-layer experts into a higher-reliability group and several lower-reliability groups based on their confidence and consistency. It contrasts the higher-reliability group’s prediction with each lower-reliability group’s prediction to calibrate the model’s original predictions. To strengthen this contrast, EAACD amplifies hallucinations from lower-reliability experts via attention and masking to provide stronger negative references. EAACD outperforms all baselines on four datasets
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的大语言模型幻觉缓解方法，包括提示工程和模型优化，要么几乎无法改变模型的内部知识，要么在跨领域泛化能力方面表现不佳。对比解码通过利用大语言模型各层的差异来减轻幻觉。然而，以往的研究只关注基于Transformer的模型（例如GPT），而忽略了其他有效的框架，如混合专家模型。由于混合专家模型改变了传统的Transformer架构，我们进行了实证研究，以调查混合专家模型中是否存在类似的层间差异。我们的结果显示，在具有共享专家的混合专家模型中并不存在这种差异；不过，不同混合专家模型的高层会表现出不同的专家激活模式，这些模式在真实与非真实输出之间有所不同。基于这些发现，我们提出了EAACD——一种注重专家差异的自适应对比解码方法。该方法利用混合专家模型高层的专家差异来减轻问答任务中的幻觉问题。EAACD根据专家的置信度和一致性将高层专家分为高可靠性组和多个低可靠性组。然后，它将高可靠性组的预测与每个低可靠性组的预测进行对比，以校准模型的原始预测。为了增强这种对比效果，EAACD通过注意力机制和掩蔽技术来放大低可靠性专家的幻觉信息，从而提供更强的负面参考。在四个数据集上，EAACD的表现优于所有基线方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ERCThinker: Fast-Slow Thinking for Emotion Recognition in Conversation
papers.title_zh: ERCThinker：用于对话中情感识别的快慢思维方法
papers.authors: Yumeng Fu, Weitao Huang, Junjie Wu, Hao Teng, Shouduo Shang, Meishan Zhang, Bingquan Liu
papers.abstract: Emotion Recognition in Conversation (ERC) aims to identify the emotional states of speakers in conversations. Existing ERC methods perform either fast thinking or slow thinking for emotion predictions. The former lacks interpretability of emotion predictions, and the latter focuses on emotion analysis at shallow semantics. Such insufficient reasoning chains fall short in capturing deep semantics within conversations. To address these limitations, we propose ERCThinker, a Fast-Slow thinking framework for the task of ERC. First, we design different thinking strategies with fine-grained emotion reasoning chains to capture deep semantics that contain topic, discourse structure, speaker characteristic, scene, and emotion shift. Second, we develop an adaptive thinking mechanism in both strategy-level and utterance-level, guiding the model to dynamically perform thinking switching across various scenarios. Furthermore, we utilize Agent-as-Judge to score reasoning chains as reward signals for more accurate emotion predictions. To support training, we construct EmotionCueCoT, the emotion reasoning dataset with supervision in both explanation and judgment. Extensive experiments on various ERC benchmark datasets demonstrate that ERCThinker achieves state-of-the-art performance in both explanation and judgment, making progress in the realm of ERC.
papers.abstract_zh: 对话中的情感识别（ERC）旨在识别对话中说话者的情感状态。现有的ERC方法要么采用快速推理方式来进行情感预测，要么采用慢速推理方式。前者在情感预测的可解释性方面存在不足，而后者则侧重于对浅层语义的情感分析。这种不充分的推理方式无法捕捉对话中的深层语义。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了ERCThinker这一快速-慢速推理框架。首先，我们设计了多种具有精细情感推理链的策略，以捕捉包含主题、话语结构、说话者特征、场景以及情感变化等深层语义的信息。其次，我们在策略层和话语层开发了自适应推理机制，引导模型在不同情境下动态切换推理方式。此外，我们利用“代理作为评判者”的方式，将推理链的结果作为奖励信号，从而实现更准确的情感预测。为了支持训练过程，我们构建了 EmotionCueCoT 这个情感推理数据集，该数据集同时包含了解释性和评判性的数据。在多个ERC基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，ERCThinker在解释性和评判性方面都取得了领先的性能，为ERC领域带来了显著进步。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: REaR : Retrieve, Expand and Refine for Effective Multitable Retrieval
papers.title_zh: REaR：用于高效多表检索的检索、扩展与优化算法
papers.authors: Rishita Agarwal, Himanshu Singhal, Peter Baile Chen, Manan Roy Choudhury, Dan Roth, Vivek Gupta
papers.abstract: Answering natural language queries over relational data often requires retrieving and reasoning over multiple tables, yet most retrievers optimize only for query–table relevance and ignore table–table compatibility. We introduce REaR (Retrieve, Expand and Refine), a three-stage, LLM-free framework that separates semantic relevance from structural joinability for efficient, high-fidelity multi-table retrieval. REaR (i) retrieves query-aligned tables, (ii) expands these with structurally joinable tables via fast, precomputed column-embedding comparisons, and (iii) refines them by pruning noisy or weakly related candidates. Empirically, REaR is retriever-agnostic and consistently improves dense/ sparse retrievers on complex table QA datasets (BIRD, MMQA, and Spider) by improving both multi-table retrieval quality and downstream SQL execution. Despite being LLM-free, it delivers performance competitive with state-of-the-art LLM-augmented retrieval systems (e.g., ARM) while achieving much lower latency and cost. Ablations confirm complementary gains from expansion and refinement, underscoring REaR as a practical, scalable building block for table-based downstream tasks (e.g., Text-to-SQL).
papers.abstract_zh: 回答关于关系数据的自然语言查询时，通常需要检索并处理多个表格的数据。然而，大多数检索系统只关注查询与表格之间的相关性，而忽略了不同表格之间的兼容性问题。我们提出了REaR（检索、扩展和精炼）这一三阶段框架，该框架将语义相关性与结构上的可连接性分离开来，从而实现高效且高精度的多表检索。REaR的具体步骤如下：首先，检索与查询相关的表格；其次，通过快速预计算的列嵌入比对，将这些表格与结构上可连接的表格进行扩展；最后，通过剔除噪声或关联性较弱的候选项来进一步精炼结果。实验表明，REaR不依赖于特定的检索算法，并且在复杂的表格问答数据集上能够持续提升检索质量，同时还能改善后续的SQL执行效率。尽管没有使用LLM，但REaR的性能仍然可以与最先进的LLM增强型检索系统相媲美，同时其延迟和成本也更低。实验结果表明，扩展和精炼过程的协同作用使得REaR成为一个实用且可扩展的工具，适用于基于表格的下游任务，例如文本转SQL。

papers.title: Figure It Out: Improve the Frontier of Reasoning with Executable Visual States
papers.title_zh: 理清思路：通过可执行的视觉元素来拓展推理的边界
papers.authors: Meiqi Chen, Fandong Meng, Jie Zhou
papers.abstract: Complex reasoning problems often involve implicit spatial and geometric relationships that are not explicitly encoded in text. While recent reasoning models perform well across many domains, purely text-based reasoning struggles to capture structural constraints in complex settings. In this paper, we introduce FIGR, which integrates executable visual construction into multi-turn reasoning via end-to-end reinforcement learning. Rather than relying solely on textual chains of thought, FIGR externalizes intermediate hypotheses by generating executable code that constructs diagrams within the reasoning loop. An adaptive reward mechanism selectively regulates when visual construction is invoked, enabling more consistent reasoning over latent global properties that are difficult to infer from text alone. Experiments on seven challenging mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that FIGR outperforms strong text-only chain-of-thought baselines, improving the base model by 13.12% on AIME 2025 and 11.00% on BeyondAIME. These results highlight the effectiveness of precise, controllable figure construction of FIGR in enhancing complex reasoning ability.
papers.abstract_zh: 复杂的推理问题往往涉及隐式的空间和几何关系，这些关系并未在文本中明确表述。虽然最近的推理模型在许多领域都能表现出良好的性能，但纯文本驱动的推理在捕捉复杂环境中的结构约束方面存在困难。在本文中，我们提出了FIGR这一方法。它通过端到端的强化学习，将可执行的视觉构建过程融入多轮推理中。与单纯依赖文本链的思路不同，FIGR通过生成可执行的代码来外部化中间假设，从而在推理过程中构建图表。一种自适应奖励机制可以选择性地调节何时调用视觉构建功能，从而使得对难以从文本中推断出的潜在全局属性的推理更加稳定。在七个具有挑战性的数学基准测试中的实验表明，FIGR的表现优于那些仅依赖文本链的基线方法。在AIME 2025测试中，FIGR的准确率提高了13.12%，而在BeyondAIME测试中则提高了11.00%。这些结果充分证明了FIGR所实现的精确且可控的图形构建能力对于提升复杂推理能力的重要性。

papers.title: MARCH: Multi-Agent Reinforced Check for Hallucination
papers.title_zh: 三月：多智能体强化检查算法用于识别幻觉现象
papers.authors: Zhuo Li, Yupeng Zhang, Pengyu Cheng, Jiajun Song, Mengyu Zhou, Hao Li, Shujie Hu, Yu Qin, Erchao Zhao, Xiaoxi Jiang, Guanjun Jiang
papers.abstract: Hallucination remains a critical bottleneck for large language models (LLMs), undermining their reliability in real-world applications, especially in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. While existing hallucination detection methods employ LLM-as-a-judge to verify LLM outputs against retrieved evidence, they suffer from inherent confirmation bias, where the verifier inadvertently reproduces the errors of the original generation. To address this, we introduce Multi-Agent Reinforced self-Check for Hallucination (MARCH), a framework that enforces rigorous factual alignment by leveraging deliberate information asymmetry. MARCH orchestrates a collaborative pipeline of three specialized agents: a Solver, a Proposer, and a Checker. The Solver generates an initial RAG response, which the Proposer decomposes into claim-level verifiable atomic propositions. Crucially, the Checker validates these propositions against retrieved evidence in isolation, deprived of the Solver’s original output. This well-crafted information asymmetry scheme breaks the cycle of self-confirmation bias. By training this pipeline with multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), we enable the agents to co-evolve and optimize factual adherence. Extensive experiments across hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that MARCH substantially reduces hallucination rates. Notably, an 8B-parameter LLM equipped with MARCH achieves performance competitive with powerful closed-source models. MARCH paves a scalable path for factual self-improvement of LLMs through co-evolution. The code is at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/MARCH.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉仍然是大语言模型面临的一个关键瓶颈，这严重影响了它们在现实应用中的可靠性，尤其是在检索增强生成系统中。现有的幻觉检测方法采用“语言模型作为裁判”的方式来验证语言模型的输出与检索到的证据是否一致，但这些方法存在固有的确认偏差问题，即裁判在验证过程中会无意中重复原始生成的错误。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“多智能体强化幻觉自检”的框架。该框架通过利用刻意制造的信息不对称来强制实现严格的事实一致性。MARCH由三个专门化的智能体组成：求解器、提议者和检查者。求解器生成初始的检索增强生成响应，提议者则将其分解为可验证的原子命题。关键在于，检查者独立于求解器的原始输出，对这些命题进行验证。这种巧妙设计的信息不对称机制打破了自我确认偏差的循环。通过采用多智能体强化学习来训练这一流程，我们能够让各个智能体共同进化并优化事实遵循性。在多个幻觉基准测试中的广泛实验表明，MARCH显著降低了幻觉发生率。值得注意的是，一个拥有8B参数规模的LLM在使用MARCH后，其性能可以与强大的闭源模型相媲美。MARCH为通过共同进化来实现LLM的事实自我改进开辟了一条可扩展的路径。相关代码可以在https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/MARCH下载。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: A Survey of Deep Learning for Geometry Problem Solving
papers.title_zh: 深度学习在几何问题求解中的应用研究
papers.authors: Jianzhe Ma, Wenxuan Wang, Qin Jin
papers.abstract: Geometry problem solving, a crucial aspect of mathematical reasoning, is vital across various domains, including education, the assessment of AI’s mathematical abilities, and multimodal capability evaluation. The recent surge in deep learning technologies, particularly the emergence of multimodal large language models, has significantly accelerated research in this area. This paper presents a survey of the applications of deep learning in geometry problem solving, including (i) a comprehensive summary of the relevant tasks in geometry problem solving; (ii) a thorough review of related deep learning methods; (iii) a detailed analysis of evaluation metrics and methods; and (iv) a critical discussion of state-of-the-art performance, existing challenges, and promising future directions. Our objective is to offer a comprehensive and practical reference of deep learning for geometry problem solving, thereby fostering further advancements in this field. We maintain a list of relevant papers: https://github.com/majianz/dl4gps.
papers.abstract_zh: 几何问题的解决是数学推理中的一个关键方面，它在多个领域都具有重要意义，包括教育、人工智能数学能力的评估以及多模态能力的评价。近年来，深度学习技术的快速发展，尤其是多模态大语言模型的出现，显著加速了这一领域的研究进展。本文对深度学习在几何问题解决中的应用进行了综述，内容包括：(i) 对几何问题解决中相关任务的全面总结；(ii) 对相关深度学习方法进行深入回顾；(iii) 对评估指标和方法的详细分析；(iv) 对当前最先进性能、存在的挑战以及未来发展的前景进行批判性讨论。我们的目标是为几何问题解决的深度学习应用提供一个全面且实用的参考指南，从而推动该领域的进一步发展。我们提供了相关论文的列表：https://github.com/majianz/dl4gps。

papers.title: ConsistRM: Improving Generative Reward Models via Consistency-Aware Self-Training
papers.title_zh: ConsistRM：通过一致性感知的自训练方法改进生成式奖励模型
papers.authors: Yu Liang, Liangxin Liu, Longzheng Wang, Wangyan, Zhang Yueyang, Long Xia, Zhiyuan Sun, Daiting Shi
papers.abstract: Generative reward models (GRMs) have emerged as a promising approach for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences by offering greater representational capacity and flexibility than traditional scalar reward models. However, GRMs face two major challenges: reliance on costly human-annotated data restricts scalability, and self-training approaches often suffer from instability and vulnerability to reward hacking. To address these issues, we propose ConsistRM, a self-training framework that enables effective and stable GRM training without human annotations. ConsistRM incorporates the Consistency-Aware Answer Reward, which produces reliable pseudo-labels with temporal consistency, thereby providing more stable model optimization. Moreover, the Consistency-Aware Critique Reward is introduced to assess semantic consistency across multiple critiques and allocates fine-grained and differentiated rewards. Experiments on five benchmark datasets across four base models demonstrate that ConsistRM outperforms vanilla Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) by an average of 1.5%. Further analysis shows that ConsistRM enhances output consistency and mitigates position bias caused by input order, highlighting the effectiveness of consistency-aware rewards in improving GRMs.Our implementation is available at https://github.com/yuliangCarmelo/ConsistRM.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式奖励模型（GRM）作为一种有前景的方法，通过提供比传统标量奖励模型更高的表征能力和灵活性，有助于使大语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好保持一致。然而，GRM面临两个主要挑战：依赖成本高昂的人工标注数据限制了模型的扩展性；而自训练方法往往存在不稳定性和易受奖励操纵的影响。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ConsistRM这一自训练框架，它能够在不依赖人工标注的情况下实现有效且稳定的GRM训练。ConsistRM引入了“一致性感知奖励”机制，该机制能够产生具有时间一致性的可靠伪标签，从而提供更稳定的模型优化效果。此外，还引入了“一致性感知批评奖励”机制，用于评估多个批评之间的语义一致性，并分配细粒度、差异化的奖励。在四个基础模型上的五个基准数据集上进行的实验表明，ConsistRM的平均性能优于传统的强化微调方法，提升了1.5%。进一步分析显示，ConsistRM能够增强输出的一致性，并减轻由输入顺序引起的位置偏差问题，这充分证明了一致性感知奖励在改进GRM方面的有效性。我们的实现代码可以在https://github.com/yuliangCarmelo/ConsistRM下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Experience Retrieval: Learning to Generate Utility-Optimized Structured Experience for Frozen LLMs
papers.title_zh: 超越经验检索：学会为冻结的大型语言模型生成具有优化功能的结构化体验
papers.authors: Xuancheng Li, Haitao Li, Yujia Zhou, Yiqun Liu, Qingyao Ai
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are largely static and often redo reasoning or repeat mistakes. Prior experience reuse typically relies on external retrieval, which is similarity-based, can introduce noise, and adds latency. We introduce SEAM (Structured Experience Adapter Module), a lightweight, executor-specific plug-in that stores experience in its parameters and generates a structured, instance-tailored experience entry in a single forward pass to guide a frozen LLM executor. SEAM is trained for utility via executor rollouts and GRPO while keeping the executor frozen, and can be further improved with logged-success SFT after deployment. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show consistent accuracy gains across executors with low overhead. Extensive ablation and analysis further elucidate the mechanisms underlying SEAM’s effectiveness and robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常具有静态特性，经常需要重新进行推理或重复犯同样的错误。以往的经验重用通常依赖于外部检索机制，而这种基于相似性的检索方式可能会引入噪声，并导致延迟问题。我们提出了SEAM（结构化体验适配器模块），这是一种轻量级的、针对特定执行器的插件。该插件可以将体验信息存储在其参数中，并在一次前向处理过程中生成结构化的、针对特定实例的体验条目，以指导冻结状态的语言模型执行器。通过执行器迭代和GRPO训练，SEAM能够保持其效用，同时保持执行器的冻结状态。在部署后，还可以通过记录成功的SFT来进一步改进SEAM的性能。在数学推理基准测试上的实验表明，SEAM在不同执行器上都能带来稳定的准确性提升，且开销较低。进一步的消融分析和研究进一步揭示了SEAM有效性和鲁棒性的机制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Zero-shot Large Language Models for Automatic Readability Assessment
papers.title_zh: 零样本大型语言模型：用于自动可读性评估的算法
papers.authors: Riley Grossman, Yi Chen
papers.abstract: Unsupervised automatic readability assessment (ARA) methods have important practical and research applications (e.g., ensuring medical or educational materials are suitable for their target audiences). In this paper, we propose a new zero-shot prompting methodology for ARA and present the first comprehensive evaluation of using large language models (LLMs) as an unsupervised ARA method by testing 10 diverse open-source LLMs (e.g., different sizes and developers) on 14 diverse datasets (e.g., different text lengths and languages). Our findings show that our proposed prompting methodology outperforms prior methods on 13 of the 14 datasets. Furthermore, we propose LAURAE, which combines LLM and readability formula scores to improve robustness by capturing both contextual and shallow (e.g., sentence length) features of readability. Our evaluation demonstrates that LAURAE robustly outperforms prior methods across languages, text lengths, and amounts of technical language.
papers.abstract_zh: 无监督自动可读性评估（ARA）方法在实践和研究中具有重要作用，例如确保医学或教育材料适合目标受众。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的零样本提示方法用于ARA，并通过测试10种不同规模、不同开发者的开源大语言模型，在14种不同的数据集上进行评估，从而首次全面评价了使用大语言模型作为无监督ARA方法的性能。我们的研究结果表明，所提出的提示方法在14个数据集中的13个数据集上表现优于现有方法。此外，我们还提出了LAURAE算法，该算法结合了大语言模型和可读性公式评分，通过捕捉可读性的上下文特征和浅层特征（如句子长度），从而提高了算法的鲁棒性。我们的评估表明，LAURAE在不同语言、文本长度以及技术含量较高的文本中，都表现出优于现有方法的性能。

papers.title: NoisyCausal: A Benchmark for Evaluating Causal Reasoning Under Structured Noise
papers.title_zh: NoisyCausal：一种用于评估在结构化噪声环境下因果推理能力的基准方法
papers.authors: Zhi Xu, Yun Fu
papers.abstract: Causal reasoning in natural language requires identifying relevant variables, understanding their interactions, and reasoning about effects and interventions, often under noisy or ambiguous conditions. While large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general reasoning abilities, they struggle to disentangle correlation from causation, particularly when observations are partially incorrect or irrelevant information is present. In this work, we introduce NoisyCausal, a new benchmark designed to evaluate causal reasoning under structured noise. Each instance is generated from a ground-truth causal graph and contextualized with a natural language scenario by injecting controllable forms of noise, such as irrelevant distractors, value perturbations, confounding, and partial observability. Moreover, we propose a modular reasoning framework that combines LLMs with explicit causal structure to address these challenges. Our method prompts the LLM to extract variables, construct a causal graph from context, and then reformulates the reasoning task as a structured prompt grounded in this graph. Rather than relying on statistical patterns alone, the LLM is guided by symbolic structure, enabling more interpretable and robust inference. Experimental results show that our method significantly outperforms standard prompting and reasoning baselines on NoisyCausal. Furthermore, it generalizes well to external benchmarks such as Cladder without task-specific tuning. Our findings highlight the importance of combining causal abstractions with language-driven reasoning to achieve faithful and robust causal understanding in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在自然语言中进行因果推理需要识别相关变量、理解它们之间的相互作用，并针对各种影响进行推理，而这些过程往往要在噪声或模糊的条件下进行。虽然大语言模型具备强大的通用推理能力，但它们在区分相关性与因果关系方面存在困难，尤其是在观测结果部分不准确或存在无关信息的情况下。在这项研究中，我们提出了NoisyCausal这一新的基准测试，旨在评估在结构化噪声环境下的因果推理能力。每个实例都是基于真实的因果图生成的，并通过注入可控的噪声来使其与自然语言场景相结合，这些噪声包括无关的干扰因素、价值扰动、混杂因素以及部分可观测性等因素。此外，我们提出了一个模块化推理框架，将大语言模型与明确的因果结构结合起来，以应对这些挑战。我们的方法引导大语言模型提取变量，从上下文中构建因果图，然后将推理任务重新表述为基于该图的结构化提示。与单纯依赖统计模式不同，大语言模型受到符号结构的指导，从而实现了更易于解释且更稳健的推理。实验结果表明，我们的方法在NoisyCausal基准测试中显著优于传统的提示和推理基线方法。此外，该方法还能很好地推广到其他外部基准测试，如Cladder，而无需进行特定任务的调整。我们的研究发现强调了将因果抽象与语言驱动的推理相结合的重要性，这样才能在大语言模型中实现忠实且可靠的因果理解。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought as a Lens: Evaluating Structured Reasoning Alignment between Human Preferences and Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 思维链作为工具：评估人类偏好与大型语言模型之间结构化推理的契合度
papers.authors: Boxuan Wang, Zhuoyun Li, Xinmiao Huang, Xiaowei Huang, Yi Dong
papers.abstract: This paper primarily demonstrates a method to quantitatively assess the alignment between multi-step, structured reasoning in large language models and human preferences. We introduce the Alignment Score, a semantic-level metric that compares a model-produced chain of thought traces with a human-preferred reference by constructing semantic-entropy-based matrices over intermediate steps and measuring their divergence. Our analysis shows that Alignment Score tracks task accuracy across models and hop depths, and peaks at 2-hop reasoning. Empirical results further indicate that misalignment at greater reasoning depths is driven mainly by alignment errors such as thematic shift and redundant reasoning. Viewing chain sampling as drawing from a distribution over reasoning paths, we empirically demonstrate a strong and consistent correlation between Alignment Score and accuracy, readability, and coherence, supporting its use as a diagnostic signal. The code is available.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文主要介绍了一种定量评估大语言模型中的多步骤结构化推理与人类偏好之间一致性的方法。我们提出了“一致性得分”这一语义级指标，该指标通过构建基于语义熵的矩阵来比较模型生成的思维链与人类偏好的参考标准，并测量它们之间的差异。我们的分析表明，一致性得分能够反映不同模型在不同推理深度下的任务准确率，并且在2步推理时达到峰值。实证结果表明，在更深的推理层次上，不一致性主要源于诸如主题转移和冗余推理等推理错误。通过将思维链采样视为从一系列推理路径的分布中选取样本，我们证明了一致性得分与准确率、可读性和连贯性之间存在强烈且稳定的相关性，这支持了将其作为诊断信号的实用性。相关代码已公开提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Robust Membership Inference for Large Language Models under Adversarial Generative Corruption
papers.title_zh: 在对抗性生成式破坏场景下，针对大型语言模型的稳健成员推断机制
papers.authors: Yuanhong Huang, Huili Wang, Xueying Bai, Jinrui Wang, Jiajun Liu, Ziqin Wang, Wanchun Ni, Shangguang Wang, Tao Qi
papers.abstract: Membership inference attack (MIA) has emerged as a promising tool for auditing the training data of LLMs, supporting data privacy and copyright protection. Most existing MIA methods rely on the assumption that LLMs assign higher confidence scores to training samples than to non-training ones.However, since LLMs generate text by sampling high-confidence tokens, they naturally produce AI-generated texts (AIGTs) that also satisfy this assumption.In this work, we empirically confirm that such AIGTs, regardless of whether they are generated by the target LLM, can lead existing MIAs to assign even higher membership likelihoods than those of true training samples, thereby significantly undermining their reliability.To address this challenge, we propose a robust membership inference framework for reliably identifying training data.Our method adopts a mixture-of-experts formulation to jointly model interactions across complementary features derived from multiple MIA methods and AIGT detectors, which can remain robust against adversarially generated samples.Furthermore, by leveraging expert components, our method provides explainable insights into the characteristics of member data.Experiments on various datasets and LLMs show that adversarial samples substantially degrade the performance of baselines, whereas our method preserves performance close to that of the unattacked setting.Codes and datasets are released at https://github.com/kong-hyh/MoMIA.
papers.abstract_zh: 成员推断攻击（MIA）已成为审计大语言模型训练数据的一种有前景的方法，有助于保护数据和版权。目前大多数MIA方法都基于这样一个假设：大语言模型会赋予训练样本比非训练样本更高的置信度评分。然而，由于大语言模型通过抽取高置信度的文本来生成文本，因此它们自然会产生符合这一假设的人工智能生成的文本。在这项研究中，我们通过实证验证，这些人工智能生成的文本，无论是否由目标大语言模型生成，都能使现有的MIA方法赋予训练样本的置信度评分远高于真实训练样本，从而严重削弱了其可靠性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种稳健的成员推断框架，以可靠地识别训练数据。我们的方法采用专家混合模型来联合建模来自多种MIA方法和人工智能生成文本检测器得到的互补特征之间的相互作用，这种模型能够很好地抵御敌手生成的样本。此外，通过利用专家组件，我们的方法还能提供对成员数据特征的可解释性分析。在多个数据集和大语言模型上的实验表明，敌手生成的样本会显著降低基线的性能，而我们的方法则能保持接近未受攻击状态下的性能。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/kong-hyh/MoMIA下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Towards Trustworthy Smart Contract Synthesis: A Multi-Agent Framework with Lean-Based Verification
papers.title_zh: 迈向可信智能合约的构建：一种基于多智能体的验证框架
papers.authors: Bowei Zhang, Hanbing Liu, Qixin Tian, Siyu Chen, Ziyuan Wang, Qi Qi
papers.abstract: Smart Contracts are the foundation of Decentralized Finance (DeFi), executing financial logic without trusted intermediaries. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have substantially lowered the barrier to smart contract development by enabling code generation from natural language. However, because smart contracts are immutable and directly manage financial assets, this accessibility introduces a critical trust gap: generated contracts are easy to produce but hard to trust. To bridge this gap, we present LeVer, the first trustworthy smart contract synthesis framework that integrates LLM-based generation with Lean-based auto-formalization and Verification. LeVer employs a closed-loop multi-agent architecture to iteratively generate, verify, attack, and repair contracts, providing both formal guarantees and empirical robustness. To facilitate the adoption of automated formal verification in smart contract generation and audition, we open-source our framework and datasets at: https://github.com/gl-bowei/LeVer
papers.abstract_zh: 智能合约是去中心化金融的核心基础，它能够在没有可信中介的情况下执行金融操作。最近大语言模型的发展显著降低了智能合约开发的门槛，因为现在可以通过自然语言生成代码。然而，由于智能合约是不可篡改的，并且直接管理金融资产，这种可访问性引入了一个关键的信任问题：生成的合约虽然容易创建，但却难以被信任。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了LeVer——首个可靠的智能合约合成框架。该框架结合了基于语言模型的生成技术、基于Lean的自动形式化和验证功能。LeVer采用闭环多智能体架构，能够迭代地生成、验证、攻击和修复合约，同时提供形式化的保证和实证上的鲁棒性。为了促进自动化形式化验证在智能合约生成和测试中的应用，我们将我们的框架及数据集开源如下：https://github.com/gl-bowei/LeVer

papers.title: LoRA on the Go: Instance-level Dynamic LoRA Selection and Merging
papers.title_zh: 可移动的LoRA：实例级动态LoRA选择与合并
papers.authors: Seungeon Lee, Soumi Das, Manish Gupta, Krishna P. Gummadi
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as a parameter-efficient approach for fine-tuning large language models. However, conventional LoRA adapters are typically trained for a single task, limiting their applicability in real-world settings, where inputs may span multiple, diverse task domains. At inference time, existing methods can combine multiple LoRAs to improve cross-task performance, but they require additional labeled data or task-specific training, which is expensive at scale.In this work, we introduce LoRA on the Go (LoGo), a training-free framework that dynamically selects and merges adapters at the instance level without any additional requirements. LoGo leverages signals extracted from a single forward pass through LoRA adapters, to identify the most relevant adapters and determine their contributions on-the-fly. Across 5 NLP benchmarks, 27 datasets, and 3 model families, LoGo outperforms training-based baselines on some tasks upto a margin of 3.6% while remaining competitive on other tasks and maintaining inference throughput, highlighting its effectiveness and practicality.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）作为一种参数高效的方法，被广泛应用于微调大语言模型。然而，传统的LoRA适配器通常只针对单一任务进行训练，这限制了它们在现实世界场景中的适用性，因为现实中的输入可能来自多个不同的任务领域。在推理阶段，现有的方法可以结合多个LoRA适配器来提高跨任务的性能，但这些方法需要额外的标注数据或特定于任务的训练，这在大规模应用中成本较高。在这项研究中，我们提出了基于Go的LoRA框架（LoGo），该框架无需进行训练，能够动态选择并合并实例级别的适配器，而无需任何额外的要求。LoGo通过从单个LoRA适配器的前向传播中提取信号，来识别最相关的适配器，并实时确定它们的贡献程度。在5个自然语言处理基准测试、27个数据集以及3种模型家族中，LoGo在某些任务上的表现优于基于训练的基线方法，优势高达3.6%，同时在其他任务上仍然具有竞争力，并且保持了良好的推理吞吐量，这充分证明了其有效性和实用性。

papers.title: Deep Supervised Contrastive Learning of Pitch Contours for Robust Pitch Accent Classification in Seoul Korean
papers.title_zh: 基于深度监督对比学习的音调轮廓学习，以实现在韩国语语音识别中的稳健音调情感分类
papers.authors: Hyunjung Joo, GyeongTaek Lee
papers.abstract: The intonational structure of Seoul Korean has been defined with discrete tonal categories within the Autosegmental-Metrical model of intonational phonology. However, it is challenging to map continuous F_0 contours to these invariant categories due to variable F_0 realizations in real-world speech. Our paper proposes Dual-Glob, a deep supervised contrastive learning framework to robustly classify fine-grained pitch accent patterns in Seoul Korean. Unlike conventional local predictive models, our approach captures holistic F_0 contour shapes by enforcing structural consistency between clean and augmented views in a shared latent space. To this aim, we introduce the first large-scale benchmark dataset, consisting of manually annotated 10,093 Accentual Phrases in Seoul Korean. Experimental results show that our Dual-Glob significantly outperforms strong baseline models with state-of-the-art accuracy (77.75%) and F1-score (51.54%). Therefore, our work supports AM-based intonational phonology using data-driven methodology, showing that deep contrastive learning effectively captures holistic structural features of continuous F_0 contours.
papers.abstract_zh: 首尔韩语的语调结构在自语段-韵律模型中被划分为不同的音调类别。然而，由于实际语音中F_0值的多样性，将连续的F_0曲线映射到这些固定类别上是一项挑战。我们的论文提出了Dual-Glob框架，这是一种基于深度监督对比学习的算法，能够稳健地分类首尔韩语中的细微音调模式。与传统的局部预测模型不同，我们的方法通过确保在共享潜在空间中清晰视图和增强视图之间保持结构一致性，从而捕捉到完整的F_0曲线形状。为此，我们引入了第一个大规模基准数据集，该数据集包含手动标注的10,093个首尔韩语重音短语。实验结果表明，我们的Dual-Glob框架在准确性和F1分数方面均优于现有的强基线模型，分别达到了77.75%的准确率和51.54% 的 F1 分数。因此，我们的工作支持了基于AM的语调音系学研究，并证明了深度对比学习能够有效捕捉连续F_0曲线的整体结构特征。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DARM: Distribution-Aware Reward Modeling by Alleviating Biases from Low Preference-Context Dependency Data
papers.title_zh: DARM：通过消除低偏好上下文依赖性数据带来的偏差，实现基于分布特性的奖励建模
papers.authors: Shaofan Liu, Guoqiang Zhang, Shihan Dou, Huiyuan Zheng, Yiming Zhou, Junjie Ye, Shaowen Wang, Shichun Liu, Jiazheng Zhang, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Reward models (RMs) are the surrogate objectives in reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and their scores directly steer policy optimization. We show that standard RM training is vulnerable in data subsets where response quality depends only weakly on the context: such instances encourage the RM to ignore the context, leading to context neglect and degraded accuracy. To address this failure mode, we propose Distribution-Aware Reward Modeling (DARM), which augments the RM objective with a conditional mutual information regularizer that maximizes context and the predicted reward conditioned on the response. By explicitly preserving the sensitivity of reward signals to the prompting context, DARM reduces over-reliance on response-only features and improves robustness to contextual variation. Extensive experiments across in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings show that DARM trained RMs deliver more accurate and consistent scoring than strong baselines. We further evaluate its downstream impact in RLHF, where DARM produce better aligned policies. We also demonstrate the necessity of each DARM design component and the impact of key parameters on performance through ablation experiments.
papers.abstract_zh: 奖励模型是来自人类反馈的强化学习中的替代目标，它们的得分直接指导策略优化过程。我们发现，在那些响应质量仅弱依赖于上下文的数据子集中，标准的奖励模型训练方式存在缺陷：这种情况下，奖励模型会忽略上下文信息，从而导致上下文被忽视，进而使模型的准确性下降。为了克服这一缺陷，我们提出了分布感知奖励建模方法。该方法在奖励模型的目标中加入了一个条件互信息正则化项，该正则化项能够最大化与响应相关的上下文信息以及预测到的奖励值。通过明确保留奖励信号对提示上下文的敏感性，DARM减少了模型对仅基于响应的特征的依赖，从而提高了模型对上下文变化的鲁棒性。在跨分布内和分布外的实验中，我们发现经过DARM训练的奖励模型能够提供更准确、更一致的评分结果，其表现优于其他强大的基线模型。我们还评估了DARM在强化学习中的应用效果，结果表明DARM能够生成更符合任务需求的策略。此外，我们通过消融实验证明了DARM各个设计组件的必要性，以及关键参数对模型性能的影响。

papers.title: KnowRL: Exploring Knowledgeable Reinforcement Learning for Factuality
papers.title_zh: KnowRL：探索用于事实验证的知識型强化学习技术
papers.authors: Baochang Ren, Shuofei Qiao, Ningyu Zhang, Da Zheng, Huajun Chen
papers.abstract: Slow-thinking Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities but often suffer from severe hallucinations due to an inability to recognize their knowledge boundaries. Existing Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches typically rely on outcome-oriented rewards, which can inadvertently reinforce fabricated reasoning paths when the final answer is correct. To address this, we propose Knowledge-enhanced RL, KnowRL, a framework that integrates factual supervision directly into the reasoning process. By decomposing the chain of thought into atomic facts and verifying them against the corresponding ground-truth knowledge, KnowRL performs fine-grained checks to encourage models to reason faithfully. Crucially, this process-oriented supervision teaches the model to identify its knowledge boundaries, learning to say “I don’t know” instead of fabricating answers when information is missing. Experimental results demonstrate that KnowRL effectively mitigates hallucinations—reducing the Incorrect Rate on SimpleQA by 20.3% for distillation-based slow-thinking models while maintaining strong performance on complex reasoning benchmarks like GPQA and AIME 2025. Furthermore, our method shows robust transferability to out-of-distribution tasks, indicating that the model learns a generalizable verification behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维迟缓的大语言模型（LLM）虽然展现了强大的推理能力，但由于无法识别自己的知识边界，常常会出现严重的幻觉现象。现有的强化学习方法通常依赖于以结果为导向的奖励机制，这可能会在最终答案正确的情况下，无意中强化了虚假的推理路径。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“知识增强强化学习”的方法——KnowRL。该方法将事实性监督直接融入到推理过程中。通过将思维过程分解为一个个基本事实，并针对相应的真实知识进行验证，KnowRL能够进行细致的检查，从而促使模型进行可靠的推理。关键在于，这种以过程为导向的监督机制教会模型识别自己的知识边界，当缺乏信息时，模型会学会说“我不知道”，而不是编造答案。实验结果表明，KnowRL能够有效减少幻觉现象——对于基于蒸馏技术的思维迟缓模型，其在SimpleQA任务上的错误率降低了20.3%。同时，该方法在复杂的推理任务上也能保持出色的性能，如GPQA和AIME 2025等挑战性任务。此外，我们的方法还表现出对超出训练域的任务的强大迁移能力，这表明模型能够学习到通用的验证行为。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Rethinking Depression Prediction from a Fine-Grained Subscore Modeling Perspective via Multi-Task Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过多任务学习，从细粒度的子评分建模角度重新思考抑郁症的预测方法
papers.authors: Zhenguang Wang, Bo Li, Wenhui Tan, Peng Cao, Yang Wang, Jia Duan, Fei Wang, Osmar Zaiane
papers.abstract: Standard depression assessment relies on instruments such as the clinician-rated Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HAMD) and the patient-reported Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-8), but manual scoring is time-consuming and subject to inter-rater variability. Prior automated approaches typically regress a single total score or coarse severity category, lacking the fine-grained subscore-level supervision needed for precise clinical diagnosis. To address this, we propose MTSP (Multi-Task Subscore Prediction), a fine-grained model for subscore prediction via multi-task learning. MTSP achieves state-of-the-art performance on the public E-DAIC dataset (MAE 3.48, RMSE 4.57) and generalizes well to the public PDCH and a large-scale private clinical dataset (CIDH), outperforming total-score regression baselines and Qwen3-14B direct scoring. We further show that multi-task learning is essential, subscore-level supervision improves assessment by better capturing symptom-cluster structure, and prior constraints plus task-level self-paced learning enhance robustness to subscore difficulty and annotation noise.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准的抑郁评估依赖于诸如临床评定的汉密尔顿抑郁量表（HAMD）和患者自报的患者健康问卷（PHQ-8）等工具。然而，手动评分过程耗时较长，且不同评估者之间可能存在评分差异。以往的自助式方法通常只给出单一的总分或粗略的严重程度分类，缺乏用于精确临床诊断所需的细粒度子分数级监督。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了MTSP（多任务子分数预测）模型，该模型通过多任务学习实现子分数级别的精细预测。在公开的E-DAIC数据集上，MTSP取得了最先进的性能表现（平均绝对误差为3.48，均方根误差为4.57）。此外，该模型在公开的PDCH以及大规模私有临床数据集（CIDH）上也有良好的泛化能力，其性能优于基于总分的回归方法和Qwen3-14B直接评分方法。我们还发现，多任务学习至关重要；子分数级监督能够更准确地捕捉症状群结构，从而改善评估效果；而预先设定的约束条件加上任务级自我调整的学习方式，则增强了模型对子分数难度和注释噪声的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PDTrim: Targeted Pruning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregation in Inference
papers.title_zh: PDTrim：针对预填充-解码分解过程的针对性剪枝算法，适用于推理场景
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Lyu Mengsi, Zhuo Chen, Yulong Ao, Yonghua Lin
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate exceptional capabilities across various tasks, but their deployment is constrained by high computational and memory costs. Model pruning provides an effective means to alleviate these demands. However, existing methods often ignore the characteristics of prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation in practice. In this paper, we propose a pruning method that is highly integrated with PD disaggregation, enabling more precise pruning of blocks. Our approach constructs pruning and distillation sets to perform iterative block removal, obtaining better pruning solutions. Moreover, we analyze the pruning sensitivity of the prefill and decode stages and identify removable blocks specific to each stage, making it well suited for PD disaggregation deployment. Extensive experiments demonstrate our approach consistently achieves strong performance in both PD disaggregation and PD unified (non-PD disaggregation) settings, and can also be extended to other non-block pruning methods. Under the same settings, our method achieves improved performance and faster inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多种任务中展现出卓越的能力，但其部署受到高计算成本和内存成本的限制。模型剪枝提供了一种有效的缓解这些问题的手段。然而，现有的方法往往忽略了实际中预填充-解码分解的特点。在本文中，我们提出了一种与预填充-解码分解高度整合的剪枝方法，能够更精确地去除不必要的模块。我们的方法通过构建剪枝和蒸馏集合来实现迭代式模块移除，从而获得更好的剪枝效果。此外，我们还分析了预填充和解码阶段的剪枝敏感性，并识别出每个阶段特有的可移除模块，这使得该方法非常适合用于预填充-解码分解的部署。大量的实验表明，我们的方法在预填充-解码分解和非预填充-解码分解两种情况下都能取得良好的性能，并且还可以扩展到其他非模块剪枝方法中。在相同的条件下，我们的方法能够实现更好的性能和更快的推理速度。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ASTRA: An Automated Framework for Strategy Discovery, Retrieval, and Evolution for Jailbreaking LLMs
papers.title_zh: ASTRA：一种用于策略发现、检索以及改进越狱版大语言模型的自动化框架
papers.authors: Xu Liu, Yan Chen, Kan Ling, Yichi Zhu, Hengrun Zhang, Guisheng Fan, Huiqun Yu
papers.abstract: Despite extensive safety alignment, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. However, existing methods generally lack the capability for continuous learning and self-evolution from interactions, limiting the diversity and adaptability of attack strategies. To address this, we propose ASTRA, an automated framework capable of autonomously discovering, retrieving, and evolving attack strategies. ASTRA operates on a closed-loop "attack-evaluate-distill-reuse” mechanism, which not only generates attack prompts but also automatically distills reusable strategies from every interaction. To systematically manage these strategies, we introduce a dynamic three-tier strategy library (Effective, Promising, and Ineffective) that categorizes strategies based on performance. This hierarchical memory mechanism enables the framework to enhance efficiency by leveraging successful patterns while optimizing the exploration space by avoiding known failures. Extensive experiments in a black-box setting demonstrate that ASTRA significantly outperforms existing baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在安全性方面进行了大量优化，但它们仍然容易受到越狱攻击。然而，现有的方法通常缺乏从交互中持续学习和自我进化的能力，这限制了攻击策略的多样性和适应性。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了ASTRA这一自动化框架，它能够自主发现、检索并演化攻击策略。ASTRA采用一种闭环机制——“攻击-评估-提炼-复用”，该机制不仅能生成攻击提示，还能自动从每次交互中提取可复用的策略。为了系统地管理这些策略，我们引入了一个动态的三层策略库（有效、有前景和无效），根据性能对策略进行分类。这种分层记忆机制使得框架能够利用成功的模式来提高效率，同时通过避免已知的失败情况来优化探索空间。在黑箱环境下的广泛实验表明，ASTRA的表现显著优于现有的基线算法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLM Safety From Within: Detecting Harmful Content with Internal Representations
papers.title_zh: 从内部检测有害内容：利用内部数据识别不良信息
papers.authors: Difan Jiao, Yilun Liu, Ye Yuan, Zhenwei Tang, Linfeng Du, Haolun Wu, Ashton Anderson
papers.abstract: Guard models are widely used to detect harmful content in user prompts and LLM responses. However, state-of-the-art guard models rely solely on terminal-layer representations and overlook the rich safety-relevant features distributed across internal layers. We present SIREN, a lightweight guard model that harnesses these internal features. By identifying safety neurons via linear probing and combining them through an adaptive layer-weighted strategy, SIREN builds a harmfulness detector from LLM internals without modifying the underlying model. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that SIREN substantially outperforms state-of-the-art open-source guard models across multiple benchmarks while using 250\times fewer trainable parameters. Moreover, SIREN exhibits superior generalization to unseen benchmarks, naturally enables real-time streaming detection, and significantly improves inference efficiency compared to generative guard models. Overall, our results highlight LLM internal states as a promising foundation for practical, high-performance harmfulness detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 保护模型被广泛用于检测用户提示和大语言模型响应中的有害内容。然而，目前最先进的保护模型仅依赖于终端层的表示，而忽略了分布在内部层中的丰富的安全相关特征。我们提出了SIREN这一轻量级保护模型，它能够利用这些内部特征。通过线性探测来识别安全神经元，并通过自适应层加权策略将它们结合起来，SIREN能够在不修改底层模型的情况下，从大语言模型的内部结构中构建出一个有害性检测器。我们的全面评估表明，SIREN在多个基准测试中的表现显著优于目前最先进的开源保护模型，同时其训练参数数量减少了250倍。此外，SIREN在应对未见过的基准测试时表现出色的泛化能力，能够自然实现实时流媒体检测，并且与生成式保护模型相比，显著提高了推理效率。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，大语言模型的内部状态为实际、高性能的有害性检测提供了一个有前景的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AttnPO: Attention-Guided Process Supervision for Efficient Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 致AttnPO：基于注意力导向的过程监控技术，以实现高效的推理运算
papers.authors: Shuaiyi Nie, Dingsiyu, Wenyuan Zhang, Linhao Yu, Tianmeng Yang, Yao Chen, Weichong Yin, Yu Sun, Hua Wu, Tingwen Liu
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models trained with reinforcement learning and verifiable rewards (RLVR) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, yet often overthink, generating redundant reasoning without performance gains. Existing trajectory-level length penalties often fail to effectively shorten reasoning length and degrade accuracy, as they uniformly treat all reasoning steps and lack fine-grained signals to distinguish redundancy from necessity. Meanwhile, process-supervised methods are typically resource-intensive and suffer from inaccurate credit assignment. To address these issues, we propose ATTNPO, a low-overhead process-supervised RL framework that leverages the model’s intrinsic attention signals for step-level credit assignment. We first identify a set of special attention heads that naturally focus on essential steps while suppressing redundant ones. By leveraging the attention scores of these heads, We then employ two sub-strategies to mitigate overthinking by discouraging redundant steps while preserving accuracy by reducing penalties on essential steps. Experimental results show that ATTNPO substantially reduces reasoning length while significantly improving performance across 9 benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过强化学习和可验证奖励训练的大型推理模型在复杂推理任务上表现优异，但往往会出现过度推理的情况，产生冗余的推理过程，而并未带来性能提升。现有的基于轨迹长度惩罚的方法往往无法有效缩短推理长度，并且会降低准确性，因为它们对所有推理步骤一视同仁，缺乏区分冗余与必要性的细粒度信号。与此同时，基于过程监督的方法通常资源消耗较大，且容易出现信用分配不准确的问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ATTNPO这一低开销的过程监督强化学习框架，该框架利用模型自身的注意力信号来进行步骤级别的信用分配。我们首先识别出一组专门负责关注关键步骤的注意力头，同时抑制冗余步骤的影响。通过利用这些注意力头的注意力分数，我们采用两种策略来避免过度推理：通过减少冗余步骤的惩罚来提高准确性，同时保留关键步骤的奖励机制。实验结果表明，ATTNPO能够显著缩短推理长度，并在9个基准测试场景中显著提升性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evaluating LLMs on Large-Scale Graph Property Estimation via Random Walks
papers.title_zh: 通过随机游走来评估大型图属性估计中的大语言模型性能
papers.authors: Sunil Kumar Maurya, Xin Liu
papers.abstract: With the rapidly improving reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), there is also a rising demand to use them in a wide variety of domains. This brings about the need to carefully evaluate the limits of the capabilities of these models with various tests and benchmarks. Graph structures are ubiquitous in real-world data, and are often used to represent and analyze relationship patterns within data. Many benchmarks have already been proposed in the graph literature to test the reasoning ability of LLMs to follow and execute graph algorithms. However, due to the limited context length of LLMs, these benchmarks consist of very small graphs. In real-world data, the size of graphs can be significantly larger, and in many cases, not fully accessible. In this paper, we examine a class of problems that arises with very large graphs having limited accessibility. We propose a large graph benchmark dataset, EstGraph, and introduce four distinct tasks designed to estimate large graph properties. We evaluate the reasoning abilities of LLMs on these tasks using a wide variety of graph datasets. In addition, we provide task-specific prompt constructions based on random walk sampling of large graphs (up to millions of nodes) that effectively convey sufficient information to LLMs within the limits of context length.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力迅速提升，人们越来越希望在 다양한领域中使用这些模型。这就迫切需要通过各种测试和基准来评估这些模型的性能极限。在现实世界的数据中，图结构非常常见，它们常被用来表示和分析数据中的关系模式。在图论领域已经提出了许多用于测试LLM遵循和执行图算法能力的测试基准。然而，由于LLM的上下文长度有限，这些测试基准所涉及的图结构通常都非常小。在现实世界的数据中，图的结构可能要大得多，而且在许多情况下，这些图是无法完全获取到的。在本文中，我们研究了一种在图结构规模非常大且难以获取的情况下出现的问题类别。我们提出了一个大型图基准数据集EstGraph，并介绍了四个不同的任务，用于评估大型图的属性。我们使用各种图数据集来测试LLM在这些任务上的推理能力。此外，我们还基于大规模图的随机游走采样技术，构建了特定于任务的提示结构，这些提示能够在不超出上下文长度限制的情况下，向LLM传递足够的信息。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MedEinst: Benchmarking the Einstellung Effect in Medical LLMs through Counterfactual Differential Diagnosis
papers.title_zh: MedEinst：通过反事实差异诊断来评估医疗大型语言模型中的“态度效应”
papers.authors: Wenting Chen, Guolin Huang, Wenxuan Wang, Zhongrui Zhu
papers.abstract: Despite achieving high accuracy on medical benchmarks, LLMs exhibit the Einstellung Effect in clinical diagnosis—relying on statistical shortcuts rather than patient-specific evidence, causing misdiagnosis in atypical cases. Existing benchmarks fail to detect this critical failure mode. We introduce MedEinst, a counterfactual benchmark with 5,383 paired clinical cases across 49 diseases. Each pair contains a control case and a “trap” case with altered discriminative evidence that flips the diagnosis. We measure susceptibility via Bias Trap Rate—probability of misdiagnosing traps despite correctly diagnosing controls. Evaluation shows frontier models achieve high baseline accuracy but severe bias trap rates. Thus, we propose ECR-Agent, aligning LLM reasoning with Evidence-Based Medicine via two components: (1) Dynamic Causal Inference (DCI) performs structured reasoning through dual-pathway perception, dynamic causal graph reasoning across three levels (association, intervention, counterfactual), and evidence audit for final diagnosis; (2) Critic-Driven Graph Memory Evolution (CGME) iteratively refines the system by storing validated reasoning paths in an exemplar base and consolidating disease-specific knowledge into evolving illness graphs. Source code is to be released.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在医学基准测试中取得了很高的准确率，但在临床诊断中却出现了“态度效应”——它们依赖统计捷径而非针对患者的具体证据进行决策，这导致在非典型病例中出现误诊。现有的测试基准未能检测到这一关键缺陷。我们提出了MedEinst这一反事实基准测试，该测试包含5,383对临床案例，涉及49种疾病。每对案例中都有一个对照案例和一个“陷阱”案例，后者的判别依据被修改，从而导致诊断结果出错。我们通过“偏见陷阱率”来衡量模型的易错性——即在正确诊断对照案例的情况下仍出现误诊的概率。评估结果显示，一些先进模型虽然具有较高的基线准确率，但其偏见陷阱率却非常高。因此，我们提出了ECR-Agent这一解决方案，通过将大语言模型的推理能力与循证医学相结合来改进模型：(1)动态因果推断技术通过双路径感知、跨三个层次（关联、干预、反事实）的动态因果图推理以及最终诊断的证据审核来实现结构化推理；(2)批评驱动图记忆演化技术则通过将经过验证的推理路径存储在示例库中，并将特定疾病的知识整合到不断演变的疾病图中，从而逐步优化模型。源代码即将发布。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Libra-VLA: Achieving Learning Equilibrium via Asynchronous Coarse-to-Fine Dual-System
papers.title_zh: 天秤座-VLA：通过异步的粗到细双系统实现学习平衡
papers.authors: Yifei Wei, Linqing Zhong, Yi Liu, Yuxiang Lu, Xindong He, Maoqing Yao, Guanghui Ren
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a promising paradigm for generalist robotic manipulation by grounding high-level semantic instructions into executable physical actions. However, prevailing approaches typically adopt a monolithic generation paradigm, directly mapping visual-linguistic features to high-frequency motor commands in a flat, non-hierarchical fashion. This strategy overlooks the inherent hierarchy of robotic manipulation, where complex actions can be naturally modeled in a Hybrid Action Space, decomposing into discrete macro-directional reaching and continuous micro-pose alignment, severely widening the semantic-actuation gap and imposing a heavy representational burden on grounding high-level semantics to continuous actions. To address this, we introduce Libra-VLA, a novel Coarse-to-Fine Dual-System VLA architecture. We explicitly decouple the learning complexity into a coarse-to-fine hierarchy to strike a training equilibrium, while simultaneously leveraging this structural modularity to implement an asynchronous execution strategy. The Semantic Planner predicts discrete action tokens capturing macro-directional intent, while the Action Refiner conditions on coarse intent to generate high-frequency continuous actions for precise alignment. Crucially, our empirical analysis reveals that performance follows an inverted-U curve relative to action decomposition granularity, peaking exactly when the learning difficulty is balanced between the two sub-systems. With the asynchronous design, our approach offers a scalable, robust, and responsive solution for open-world manipulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是一种有前景的通用机器人操控范式，它将高级语义指令转化为可执行的物理动作。然而，目前的主流方法通常采用单一生成范式，直接将视觉-语言特征映射到高频运动指令上，这种处理方式缺乏层次性。这忽略了机器人操控的固有层次结构——复杂的动作可以自然地以混合动作空间的形式进行建模，将其分解为离散的宏观方向移动和连续的微观姿态调整。这种处理方式会加大语义与动作之间的差距，同时给将高级语义转化为连续动作的任务带来了巨大的表征负担。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了Libra-VLA这一新颖的粗到细双系统VLA架构。我们将学习复杂性明确地分解为粗到细的层次结构，以实现训练上的平衡；同时，利用这种结构模块化特性，实现异步执行策略。语义规划器预测出能够捕捉宏观方向意图的离散动作标记，而动作细化器则根据粗略的意图来生成高频连续的动作，从而实现精确的动作调整。我们的实证分析表明，性能随着动作分解粒度的增加而呈倒U形曲线变化，当两种子系统的学习难度达到平衡时，性能会达到峰值。通过采用异步设计，我们的方法为开放世界环境下的机器人操控提供了一种可扩展、稳健且响应迅速的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Language Statistics and False Belief Reasoning: Evidence from 41 Open-Weight LMs
papers.title_zh: 语言统计与错误信念推理：来自41个开放权重逻辑模型的研究证据
papers.authors: Sean Trott, Samuel M. Taylor, Cameron Robert Jones, James A. Michaelov, Pamela D. Rivière
papers.abstract: Research on mental state reasoning in language models (LMs) has the potential to inform theories of human social cognition—such as the theory that mental state reasoning emerges in part from language exposure—and our understanding of LMs themselves. Yet much published work on LMs relies on a relatively small sample of closed-source LMs, limiting our ability to rigorously test psychological theories and evaluate LM capacities. Here, we replicate and extend published work on the false belief task by assessing LM mental state reasoning behavior across 41 open-weight models (from distinct model families). We find sensitivity to implied knowledge states in 34% of the LMs tested; however, consistent with prior work, none fully “explain away” the effect in humans. Larger LMs show increased sensitivity and also exhibit higher psychometric predictive power. Finally, we use LM behavior to generate and test a novel hypothesis about human cognition: both humans and LMs show a bias towards attributing false beliefs when knowledge states are cued using a non-factive verb (“John thinks...”) than when cued indirectly (“John looks in the...”). Unlike the primary effect of knowledge states, where human sensitivity exceeds that of LMs, the magnitude of the human knowledge cue effect falls squarely within the distribution of LM effect sizes—suggesting that distributional statistics of language can in principle account for the latter but not the former in humans. These results demonstrate the value of using larger samples of open-weight LMs to test theories of human cognition and evaluate LM capacities.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于语言模型中的心理状态推理的研究，有可能为人类社会认知理论提供启示——比如，心理状态推理在一定程度上是由语言使用所引发的。同时，这项研究也有助于我们更深入地了解语言模型本身的特点。然而，目前关于语言模型的研究大多依赖于数量相对较少的封闭源代码语言模型，这限制了我们严格验证心理学理论以及评估语言模型能力的可能性。在这里，我们通过评估41种开放权重模型在心理状态推理方面的表现，来复制并扩展已有研究的结果。我们发现，在被测试的模型中，有34%的模型能够感知到隐含的知识状态；不过，与之前的研究一致的是，没有任何一个模型能够完全消除这种效应在人类中的表现。规模较大的语言模型表现出更高的感知能力，并且其预测能力也更强。最后，我们利用语言模型的行为数据，提出了一个新的假设：无论是人类还是语言模型，在知识状态通过非主动动词进行提示时（例如“约翰认为……”），都会倾向于将错误信念归因于某人，而间接提示时则不会如此。与知识状态的主要效应不同，后一种效应中人类的感知能力确实高于语言模型，但人类知识提示效应的强度仍然处于语言模型效应大小的范围内——这表明，从分布统计的角度来看，语言在解释后者方面是有可能的，但在解释前者方面则不太可能。这些结果表明，使用更多开放权重语言模型来测试人类认知理论以及评估语言模型的能力是非常有价值的。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Decoding-Unlearning: Fact Forgetting via Entropy-Guided Inference
papers.title_zh: 解码-遗忘：通过熵引导的推理实现事实遗忘
papers.authors: Jingwen Pu, Mingjun Shi, Xinrui Ren, Yizhe Wang, Xinyu Zhang, Zhaokun Wang, Kun She
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit powerful capabilities but inevitably memorize sensitive information, raising privacy, copyright, and safety concerns. Existing LLM unlearning methods typically rely on updating model parameters. While effective, they are often limited in real-world scenarios: fine-tuning large-scale models is costly, may introduce potential irreversible risks, and depends on both forget and retain datasets, which are often difficult to obtain in full. To address these challenges, an ideal solution is to achieve unlearning at inference time. To this end, we propose SEGUE, a training-free, plug-and-play inference-time unlearning strategy. SEGUE employs a probe to detect queries involving forgettable concepts and applies entropy-guided decoding to suppress target knowledge, enabling controllable non-factual generation while preserving overall model capabilities. Experiments on the MUSE, RWKU, and WMDP datasets, covering copyright, entity, and potential-risk knowledge, show that SEGUE effectively balances sensitive knowledge suppression and generation quality, outperforming existing most inference-time unlearning methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）具有强大的能力，但不可避免地会记住敏感信息，这引发了隐私、版权和安全的担忧。现有的LLM忘记策略通常依赖于更新模型参数。虽然这种方法有效，但在实际场景中却存在局限性：对大规模模型进行微调成本高昂，可能会带来不可逆转的风险，而且这种策略需要同时处理遗忘数据和保留数据，而这些数据的完整获取往往非常困难。为了应对这些挑战，理想的解决方案是在推理过程中实现忘记功能。为此，我们提出了SEGUE这一无需训练即可在推理过程中实现忘记的策略。SEGUE利用探针来检测涉及可遗忘概念的查询，并采用熵引导解码技术来抑制目标知识，从而实现可控的非事实生成，同时保留模型的整体能力。在MUSE、RWKU和WMDP数据集上的实验表明，SEGUE能够在抑制敏感知识和保持生成质量之间实现有效平衡，其性能优于现有的大多数推理时间忘记方法。

papers.title: Global Adaptive Momentum Meets Local Personalized Perturbation: Efficient Federated LLM Fine-Tuning with Zeroth-Order Gradients
papers.title_zh: 全球性的自适应动量策略与局部化的个性化扰动相结合：利用零阶梯度进行高效的联邦式大语言模型微调
papers.authors: Zihan Chen, Howard Hao Yang, Tony Quek, Kai Fong Ernest Chong
papers.abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) provides a privacy-preserving approach to deploying pervasive generative AI services, yet the substantial memory overhead of first-order (FO) gradient computation presents significant practical challenges. While zeroth-order (ZO) optimization methods offer memory-efficient alternatives, they remain susceptible to performance degradation brought by data heterogeneity. Specifically, direct ZO-for-FO substitution is incompatible with existing strategies tailored for cross-client discrepancies. In response, we propose a new federated LLM fine-tuning framework, with a holistic revamped design of the entire ZO gradient processing pipeline. Crucially, with our proposed global adaptive optimization and local personalized perturbation, we present a unified solution for incorporating ZO gradients in federated learning, from local personalized perturbation sampling and ZO gradient transmission, to global ZO gradient reconstruction and aggregation with adaptive momentum, thereby directly addressing the challenges of inefficiencies and cross-client discrepancies. Our convergence analysis and experiment results demonstrate the superiority of our proposed framework over diverse heterogeneous data settings, both in terms of generalization and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦式的大语言模型微调提供了一种保护隐私的方式来部署泛化的生成式AI服务。然而，一阶梯度计算所带来的巨大内存开销却带来了显著的实践挑战。虽然零阶优化方法提供了更节省内存的替代方案，但它们仍然容易受到数据异质性导致的性能下降的影响。具体来说，直接用零阶优化来替代一阶优化与现有的针对客户端间差异的优化策略并不兼容。为此，我们提出了一种新的联邦式大语言模型微调框架，对整个零阶梯度处理流程进行了全面改进。关键的是，通过我们的全局自适应优化和局部个性化扰动技术，我们提出了一种统一的解决方案，可以将零阶梯度引入到联邦学习中：从局部个性化扰动采样到零阶梯度传输，再到全局零阶梯度重建和聚合，并采用自适应动量技术，从而直接解决效率低下和客户端间差异问题。我们的收敛分析和实验结果表明，我们的框架在多种异构数据环境下都具有出色的表现，无论是在泛化能力还是效率方面都是如此。

papers.title: Beyond Query Memorization: Large Language Model Routing with Query Decomposition and Historical Matching
papers.title_zh: 超越查询记忆：通过查询分解和历史匹配实现大型语言模型路由
papers.authors: Bo Lv, Jingbo Sun, Jianwei Lv, Chen Tang, Shaojie Zhang, Nayu Liu, Guoxin Yu, Zihao Li, Qichao Zhang, Dongbin Zhao, Ping Luo, Yue Yu
papers.abstract: Optimizing the trade-off among predictive performance and computational cost is a central focus in the deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). Current routing methods primarily rely on direct mapping from queries to models based on surface-level features, making them susceptible to the memorization trap and leading to poor generalizability on out-of-distribution (OOD) data. In this paper, we propose DecoR, a novel routing framework that recasts the routing task as a matching process of sifting similar queries from historical logs, effectively mitigating the memorization trap. To enhance matching accuracy, we introduce a query capability deconstruction method that decouples linguistic surface forms from task-intrinsic requirements, directing matching toward capability dimensions to ground decisions in essential task attributes. Furthermore, we develop CodaSet, a comprehensive benchmark for assessing routing generalization, where experimental results demonstrate that DecoR maintains superior accuracy while substantially lowering inference costs across both in-distribution and OOD settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型的部署中，优化预测性能与计算成本之间的平衡是一个核心问题。当前的路由方法主要依赖于基于表面特征的查询到模型的直接映射，这容易导致记忆陷阱，从而导致在外部数据上的泛化能力较差。在本文中，我们提出了DecoR这一新颖的路由框架，它将路由任务重新定义为从历史日志中筛选相似查询的过程，从而有效避免记忆陷阱。为了提升匹配精度，我们引入了一种查询能力解构方法，该方法将语言表面形式与任务内在要求分离，使匹配过程聚焦于能力维度，从而将决策建立在关键任务属性之上。此外，我们还开发了CodaSet这一全面的评估基准，用于评估路由的泛化能力。实验结果表明，DecoR在保持较高精度的同时，显著降低了推理成本，无论是在内部数据还是外部数据环境下都是如此。

papers.title: Market-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Economic and Trade Competition
papers.title_zh: 市场基准：在经济与贸易竞争领域对大型语言模型进行性能评估
papers.authors: Yushuo Zheng, Huiyu Duan, Zicheng Zhang, Yucheng Zhu, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai
papers.abstract: The ability of large language models (LLMs) to manage and acquire economic resources remains unclear. In this paper, we introduce Market-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates the capabilities of LLMs in economically-relevant tasks through economic and trade competition. Specifically, we construct a configurable multi-agent supply chain economic model where LLMs act as retailer agents responsible for procuring and retailing merchandise. In the procurement stage, LLMs bid for limited inventory in budget-constrained auctions. In the retail stage, LLMs set retail prices, generate marketing slogans, and provide them to buyers through a role-based attention mechanism for purchase. Market-Bench logs complete trajectories of bids, prices, slogans, sales, and balance-sheet states, enabling automatic evaluation with economic, operational, and semantic metrics. Benchmarking on 20 open- and closed-source LLM agents reveals significant performance disparities and winner-take-most phenomenon, i.e., only a small subset of LLM retailers can consistently achieve capital appreciation, while many hover around the break-even point despite similar semantic matching scores. Market-Bench provides a reproducible testbed for studying how LLMs interact in competitive markets.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在管理和获取经济资源方面的能力仍不明确。在本文中，我们引入了Market-Bench这一综合基准测试平台，该平台通过经济与贸易竞争来评估大语言模型在相关任务中的能力。具体来说，我们构建了一个可配置的多智能体供应链经济模型，其中大语言模型作为零售商代理，负责采购和销售商品。在采购阶段，大语言模型会在预算有限的拍卖中竞标有限的库存。在零售阶段，大语言模型设定零售价格、生成营销口号，并通过基于角色的注意力机制将这些信息传递给买家。Market-Bench记录了所有的竞标行为、价格、口号、销售情况以及资产负债表状态，从而能够自动评估经济、运营和语义指标。通过对20个开源和闭源的大语言模型代理进行基准测试，我们发现性能存在显著差异，而且存在“赢者通吃”的现象——只有少数大语言模型零售商能够持续实现资本增值，而许多模型尽管在语义匹配方面表现相似，但始终处于盈亏平衡点附近。Market-Bench提供了一个可复用的测试平台，用于研究大语言模型在竞争市场中的互动方式。

papers.title: Benchmarking Post-Training Quantization of Large Language Models under Microscaling Floating Point Formats
papers.title_zh: 在微尺度浮点格式下，对大型语言模型训练后量化过程的对比分析
papers.authors: Manyi Zhang, Ji-Fu Li, Zhongao Sun, Haoli Bai, Hui-Ling Zhen, Zhenhua Dong, Xianzhi Yu
papers.abstract: Microscaling Floating-Point (MXFP) has emerged as a promising low-precision format for large language models (LLMs). Despite various post-training quantization (PTQ) algorithms being proposed, they mostly focus on integer quantization, while their applicability and behavior under MXFP formats remain largely unexplored. To address this gap, this work conducts a systematic investigation of PTQ under MXFP formats, encompassing over 7 PTQ algorithms, 15 evaluation benchmarks, and 3 LLM families. The key findings include: 1) MXFP8 consistently achieves near-lossless performance, while MXFP4 introduces substantial accuracy degradation and remains challenging; 2) PTQ effectiveness under MXFP depends strongly on format compatibility, with some algorithmic paradigms being consistently more effective than others; 3) PTQ performance exhibits highly consistent trends across model families and modalities, in particular, quantization sensitivity is dominated by the language model rather than the vision encoder in multimodal LLMs; 4) The scaling factor of quantization is a critical error source in MXFP4, and a simple pre-scale optimization strategy can significantly mitigate its impact. Together, these results provide practical guidance on adapting existing PTQ methods to MXFP quantization.
papers.abstract_zh: 微尺度浮点运算（MXFP）作为一种低精度格式，已成为大语言模型（LLM）处理器的理想选择。尽管已经提出了多种训练后量化算法，但这些算法大多专注于整数量化，而它们在MXFP格式下的适用性和性能表现仍未被充分研究。为了填补这一空白，本研究对MXFP格式下的训练后量化进行了系统性的研究，涉及了7种量化算法、15个评估基准以及3种LLM家族。主要研究发现包括：1）MXFP8格式始终能实现接近无损的性能表现，而MXFP4则会导致显著的准确性下降，且仍然具有挑战性；2）在MXFP格式下，训练后量化的效果很大程度上取决于格式兼容性，某些算法范式比其他范式更为有效；3）不同模型家族和模态下的量化性能具有高度一致性，特别是在多模态LLM中，量化敏感性主要由语言模型而非视觉编码器决定；4）在MXFP4中，量化缩放因子是关键的误差来源，采用简单的预缩放优化策略可以显著减轻其影响。综上所述，这些研究结果为将现有的训练后量化方法适配到MXFP量化中提供了实用的指导。

papers.title: HiEdit: Lifelong Model Editing with Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: HiEdit：利用分层强化学习进行终身模型编辑
papers.authors: Yangfan Wang, Tianyang Sun, Chen Tang, Jie Liu, Wei Cai, Jingchi Jiang
papers.abstract: Lifelong model editing (LME) aims to sequentially rectify outdated or inaccurate knowledge in deployed LLMs while minimizing side effects on unrelated inputs. However, existing approaches typically apply parameter perturbations to a static and dense set of LLM layers for all editing instances. This practice is counter-intuitive, as we hypothesize that different pieces of knowledge are stored in distinct layers of the model. Neglecting this layer-wise specificity can impede adaptability in integrating new knowledge and result in catastrophic forgetting for both general and previously edited knowledge. To address this, we propose HiEdit, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that adaptively identifies the most knowledge-relevant layers for each editing instance. By enabling dynamic, instance-aware layer selection and incorporating an intrinsic reward for sparsity, HiEdit achieves precise, localized updates. Experiments on various LLMs show that HiEdit boosts the performance of the competitive RLEdit by an average of 8.48% with perturbing only half of the layers per edit. Our code is available at: https://github.com/yangfanww/hiedit.
papers.abstract_zh: 终身模型编辑（LME）的目标是逐步修正已过时或不准确的知识内容，同时尽量减少对无关输入的负面影响。然而，现有的方法通常会在所有编辑操作中对LLM的静态且密集的层进行参数调整。这种做法违反直觉，因为我们认为不同的知识存储在不同的模型层中。忽略这种逐层特性可能会阻碍新知识的整合能力，从而导致一般知识和之前编辑过的知识出现严重的遗忘问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了HiEdit这一分层强化学习框架。该框架能够自适应地识别出每个编辑操作中最相关的层。通过实现动态、考虑具体实例的层选择机制，并引入对稀疏性的内在奖励机制，HiEdit能够实现精确、局部化的更新。在多种LLM上的实验表明，HiEdit能够将竞争性的RLEdit的性能提升平均8.48%，而每次编辑只调整一半的层。我们的代码可以在以下链接查看：https://github.com/yangfanww/hiedit。

papers.title: Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Efficient LLM Reasoning Compression
papers.title_zh: 太长，需要进行重新加权处理以实现高效的LLM推理压缩
papers.authors: Zhong-Zhi Li, Xiao Liang, Zihao Tang, Lei Ji, Peijie Wang, Haotian Xu, Xing W, Haizhen Huang, Weiwei Deng, Yeyun Gong, Zhijiang Guo, Xiao Liu, Fei Yin, Cheng-Lin Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress on complex reasoning tasks by leveraging extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) techniques. These reasoning processes can be roughly categorized into System-1 (fast and intuitive) and System-2 (slow and deliberate) paradigms. However, excessive reliance on lengthy System-2-style reasoning during inference can produce extremely long outputs, thereby reducing efficiency. In this work, we propose Thinking Length Data Re-weighting (TLDR), that does not rely on sophisticated data annotations or interpolation between multiple models. We continuously balance the weights between the model’s System-1 and System-2 data to eliminate redundant reasoning processes while preserving the model’s reasoning capability. We validate our method across multiple base models, including Deepseek-R1-Distilled Qwen models, as well as on a diverse benchmarks with varying difficulty levels. Our method significantly reduces the number of output tokens by nearly 40% while maintaining the accuracy of the reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂推理任务上取得了显著进展，这得益于扩展的思维链技术。这些推理过程大致可以分为系统1范式（快速且直观）和系统2范式（缓慢且谨慎）。然而，在推理过程中过度依赖冗长的系统2式推理会导致输出结果过长，从而降低效率。在这项研究中，我们提出了“思考时长数据重新加权”方法，该方法无需复杂的数据注释或多模型间的插值处理。我们通过不断调整模型系统1和系统2数据的权重，来消除冗余的推理过程，同时保留模型的推理能力。我们在多个基础模型上验证了该方法的有效性，包括Deepseek-R1-Distilled Qwen模型，同时还针对不同难度级别的基准测试进行了测试。我们的方法能够将输出令牌数量减少近40%，同时保持了推理的准确性。

papers.title: Measuring Social Bias in Vision-Language Models with Face-Only Counterfactuals from Real Photos
papers.title_zh: 利用真实照片中的人脸数据，测量视觉语言模型中存在的社会偏见现象
papers.authors: Haodong Chen, Qiang Huang, Jiaqi Zhao, Qiuping Jiang, Xiaojun Chang, Jun Yu
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, raising concerns about social bias driven by demographic cues. A central challenge in measuring such social bias is attribution under visual confounding: real-world images entangle race and gender with correlated factors such as background and clothing, obscuring attribution. We propose a face-only counterfactual evaluation paradigm that isolates demographic effects while preserving real-image realism. Starting from real photographs, we generate counterfactual variants by editing only facial attributes related to race and gender, keeping all other visual factors fixed. Based on this paradigm, we construct FOCUS, a dataset of 480 scene-matched counterfactual images across six occupations and ten demographic groups, and propose REFLECT, a benchmark comprising three decision-oriented tasks: two-alternative forced choice, multiple-choice socioeconomic inference, and numeric salary recommendation. Experiments on five state-of-the-art VLMs reveal that demographic disparities persist under strict visual control and vary substantially across task formulations. These findings underscore the necessity of controlled, counterfactual audits and highlight task design as a critical factor in evaluating social bias in multimodal models.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在具有社会影响的场景中得到了广泛应用，但这也引发了对由人口统计特征导致的社会偏见问题的担忧。衡量这种社会偏见的一个核心挑战在于如何在视觉干扰的情况下进行归因分析：现实中的图像会将种族和性别与背景、服装等关联因素交织在一起，从而使得归因变得困难。我们提出了一种仅关注面部特征的逆向条件评估方法，该方法能够分离出人口统计因素的影响，同时保留真实图像的真实性。通过从真实照片出发，我们只编辑与种族和性别相关的面部特征，而保持其他视觉因素不变，从而生成逆向条件版本的图像。基于这一方法，我们构建了FOCUS数据集，该数据集包含480张与六种职业和十个人口统计群体相关的逆向条件图像。此外，我们还提出了REFLECT基准测试，该测试包括三项决策导向的任务：两种选择强制选择任务、多项选择的社会经济推断任务以及数值薪资推荐任务。对五种最先进的视觉语言模型的实验表明，即使在严格的视觉控制下，人口统计差异仍然存在，并且不同任务形式下的差异也各不相同。这些发现强调了进行受控逆向条件评估的必要性，并凸显了任务设计在评估多模态模型中的社会偏见方面的关键作用。

papers.title: KASER: Knowledge-Aligned Student Error Simulator for Open-Ended Coding Tasks
papers.title_zh: 卡瑟：适用于开放式编程任务的知识导向学生错误模拟器
papers.authors: Zhangqi Duan, Nigel Fernandez, Andrew Lan
papers.abstract: Open-ended tasks, such as coding problems that are common in computer science education, provide detailed insights into student knowledge. However, training large language models (LLMs) to simulate and predict possible student errors in their responses to these problems can be challenging: they often suffer from mode collapse and fail to fully capture the diversity in syntax, style, and solution approach in student responses. In this work, we present KASER (Knowledge-Aligned Student Error Simulator), a novel approach that aligns errors with student knowledge. We propose a training method based on reinforcement learning using a hybrid reward that reflects three aspects of student code prediction: i) code similarity to the ground-truth, ii) error matching, and iii) code prediction diversity. On two real-world datasets, we perform two levels of evaluation and show that: At the per-student-problem pair level, our method outperforms baselines on code and error prediction; at the per-problem level, our method outperforms baselines on error coverage and simulated code diversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 开放式任务，比如计算机科学教育中常见的编程问题，能够揭示学生的知识状况。然而，训练大语言模型来模拟并预测学生回答这些问题的错误情况却颇具挑战性：这些模型常常会出现模式崩溃的问题，无法完全捕捉到学生回答在语法、风格和解题思路上的多样性。在这项研究中，我们提出了KASER（知识与学生错误模拟器）这一创新方法，该方法能够将错误与学生所学知识进行关联。我们提出了一种基于强化学习的训练方法，使用混合奖励机制来反映学生代码预测的三个方面：i) 代码与真实答案的相似性，ii) 错误匹配程度，iii) 代码预测的多样性。在两个真实世界数据集上进行了评估，结果显示：在每对学生问题层面，我们的方法在代码和错误预测方面优于现有基线方法；在每道问题层面，我们的方法在错误覆盖率和模拟代码多样性方面也优于现有基线方法。

papers.title: GroupToM-Bench: Benchmarking Group Theory of Mind and Nonlinear Social Emergence in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: GroupToM-Bench：在多语言大语言模型中对群体思维能力及非线性社会涌现现象进行基准测试
papers.authors: Weidong Tang, Jierui Li, Yueling Hou, Zihan Mei, Can Zhang, Xinyan Wan, Zhiyuan Liang, Pengfei Zhou, Yang You, Wangbo Zhao
papers.abstract: True general intelligence requires not only a model of the physical world but also a social world model: the capacity to infer how individual mental states interact and crystallize into group-level outcomes. Despite notable progress in individual-level Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning, existing multimodal large language models systematically fail at this: collective behavior emerges non-linearly from social tensions, conformity dynamics, and structural constraints, and cannot be recovered by summing individual intentions. We present GroupToM-Bench, the first multimodal benchmark for group-level ToM, built around a causal chain spanning micro-level BDI states (belief, desire, intention), meso-level group tension and structural constraints, and macro-level outcome prediction and mechanistic attribution. To probe this full arc, we develop a seven-level cognitive audit framework. Experiments reveal that frontier models perform significantly below human levels, exposing fundamental blind spots in modeling social structures and nonlinear collective behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 真正的群体智能不仅需要物理世界的模型，还需要社会世界的模型——即能够推断个体心理状态如何相互作用并转化为群体层面的结果。尽管在个体层面的心智理论推理方面取得了显著进展，但现有的多模态大语言模型在这一点上却存在系统性缺陷：集体行为是由社会紧张关系、从众动态以及结构约束等非线性方式产生的，无法通过简单叠加个体的意图来预测。我们提出了GroupToM-Bench，这是首个用于评估群体层面心智理论的多模态基准测试工具。该测试基于一个因果链，涵盖了微观层面的信念、欲望、意图等心理状态，中观层面的群体紧张状况与结构约束，以及宏观层面的结果预测和机制性归因。为了全面探究这一过程，我们开发了一个七级认知审计框架。实验结果表明，当前的前沿模型的表现远低于人类水平，这揭示了在建模社会结构和非线性集体行为方面的根本缺陷。

papers.title: Assessing the Belief Consistency of Large Language Models on the Logical Conversation Process
papers.title_zh: 评估大型语言模型在逻辑对话过程中的信念一致性
papers.authors: Tomoki Tsujimura, Matīss Rikters, Masaki Asada, Shusaku Egami, Tatsuya Ishigaki, Ken Yano, Hiroya Takamura
papers.abstract: To reliably interpret the evolving context of an LLM as a reasoning trace, the underlying belief of the LLM needs to transition consistently with the progression of the context.We focus on evaluating whether the beliefs held by a model remain consistent before and after the extension of the context.Previous research on consistency evaluation typically uses datasets with ground-truth answers, which is problematic because task-solving ability acts as a confounding factor, obscuring the direct evaluation of consistency.Furthermore, evaluating cases where inconsistency stems from multiple errors poses difficulties.We propose a new evaluation method to assess the consistency of LLMs in a multiple-choice question answering format, designed so that any option chosen is correct, allowing for the evaluation of the proposed belief consistency.It also supports isolation of errors such as reasoning failures and biases.We reveal that the belief consistency does not improve solely with model size scaling,whereas continual pre-training on code and mathematics text improves it.Furthermore, models trained on code and mathematics text show a seemingly contradictory result of increased logical failures, indicating that belief consistency and superficial consistency are not necessarily directly linked.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了可靠地将大语言模型不断变化的上下文解读为推理过程，大语言模型背后的信念需要随着上下文的发展而保持一致。我们重点评估在扩展上下文前后，模型所持有的信念是否保持一致。以往的一致性评估通常使用带有真实答案的数据集，但这存在问题，因为任务解决能力会干扰对一致性的直接评估。此外，评估因多种错误导致的不一致性情况也很困难。我们提出了一种新的评估方法，以选择题的形式来评估大语言模型的一致性。这种方法确保所选的每个选项都是正确的，从而能够评估模型信念的一致性。该方法还支持识别诸如推理失败和偏见等错误。我们发现，信念的一致性并非仅通过模型规模的增加而得到提升，而持续对代码和数学文本进行预训练则能改善这一效果。此外，使用代码和数学文本训练的模型表现出逻辑错误的增加，这表明信念一致性与表面一致性之间并不一定有直接联系。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Textual Steering Vectors Can Improve Visual Understanding in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 文本指导向量能够提升多模态大语言模型的视觉理解能力
papers.authors: Woody Haosheng Gan, Deqing Fu, Julian Asilis, Ollie Liu, Vatsal Sharan, Robin Jia, Willie Neiswanger
papers.abstract: Steering methods have emerged as effective tools for guiding large language models’ behavior, yet multimodal large language models (MLLMs) lack comparable techniques due to architectural diversity and limited availability of multimodal steering vectors. Inspired by this gap, we demonstrate that steering vectors derived solely from text-only LLM backbones can effectively guide and enhance their multimodal counterparts, revealing a novel cross-modal transfer that enables reuse of existing interpretability tools. Using community-standard methods—Sparse Autoencoders (SAE), Mean Shift, and Linear Probing—we validate this transfer effect across diverse MLLM architectures and visual reasoning tasks. Text-derived steering consistently enhances multimodal performance, with Mean Shift achieving up to +7.3% improvement in spatial relationship accuracy and +3.3% in counting accuracy on CV-Bench, and exhibits strong generalization to out-of-distribution datasets, for example reaching +34.2% on CLEVR counting tasks. This reveals that textual representations alone can effectively enhance visual grounding in MLLMs, bridging the mature ecosystem of text-based steering to MLLMs with minimal additional data collection or computational overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 引导方法已成为指导大语言模型行为的有效工具，然而由于架构的多样性以及多模态引导向量的有限可用性，多模态大语言模型缺乏类似的技术支持。受此现象的启发，我们证明了仅基于纯文本的大语言模型骨干所生成的引导向量能够有效引导并提升其多模态版本的性能，从而实现了一种新颖的跨模态迁移机制，使得现有的可解释性工具能够得到复用。通过使用社区标准的方法——稀疏自编码器、均值漂移和线性探测——我们验证了这种迁移效果在多种多模态语言模型架构和视觉推理任务中的有效性。基于文本的引导方法始终能提升多模态性能：在CV-Bench测试集上，均值漂移方法的空间关系准确性提升了7.3%，计数准确性提升了3.3%；此外，该方法还能很好地泛化到非分布数据集上，例如在CLEVR的计数任务中，性能提升了34.2%。这表明，单纯的文本表示就能有效提升多模态语言模型的视觉定位能力，而无需额外的数据收集或计算开销，从而将基于文本的引导技术完美地应用于多模态语言模型领域。

papers.title: Learning Uncertainty from Sequential Internal Dispersion in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从大型语言模型中的序列内部离散性中学习不确定性
papers.authors: Ponhvoan Srey, Xiaobao Wu, Cong-Duy T Nguyen, Anh Tuan Luu
papers.abstract: Uncertainty estimation is a promising approach to detect hallucinations in large language models (LLMs). Recent approaches commonly depend on model internal states to estimate uncertainty. However, they suffer from strict assumptions on how hidden states should evolve across layers, and from information loss by solely focusing on last or mean tokens. To address these issues, we present Sequential Internal Variance Representation (SIVR), a supervised hallucination detection framework that leverages token-wise, layer-wise features derived from hidden states. SIVR adopts a more basic assumption that uncertainty manifests in the degree of dispersion or variance of internal representations across layers, rather than relying on specific assumptions, which makes the method model and task agnostic. It additionally aggregates the full sequence of per-token variance features, learning temporal patterns indicative of factual errors and thereby preventing information loss. Experimental results demonstrate SIVR consistently outperforms strong baselines. Most importantly, SIVR enjoys stronger generalisation and avoids relying on large training sets, highlighting the potential for practical deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 不确定性估计是一种在大语言模型中发现幻觉的有效方法。目前的方法通常依赖模型内部状态来估计不确定性。然而，这些方法存在对隐藏状态在层间演变方式的严格假设要求，并且由于仅关注最后的或平均的标记而会导致信息丢失。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了顺序内部方差表示法（SIVR），这是一种基于监督的幻觉检测框架，它利用从隐藏状态中得到的逐标记、逐层的特征信息进行检测。SIVR采用了一个更基本的假设：不确定性体现在各层内部表示的分散程度或方差上，而不是依赖于特定的假设条件，这使得该方法具有跨任务和跨模型的通用性。此外，SIVR还会汇总每个标记的方差特征序列，从而学习到指示事实错误的时间模式，进而避免信息丢失。实验结果表明，SIVR始终优于其他强大的基线方法。最重要的是，SIVR具有更强的泛化能力，且无需依赖庞大的训练集，这凸显了其在实际应用中的潜力。

papers.title: On-the-Fly VLA Adaptation via Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过测试时间强化学习实现即时VLA调整
papers.authors: Changyu Liu, Yiyang Liu, Taowen Wang, Qiao Zhuang, James Chenhao Liang, Wenhao Yang, Renjing Xu, Qifan Wang, Dongfang Liu, Cheng Han
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for general-purpose robot learning, enabling agents to map visual observations and natural-language instructions into executable robotic actions. Though popular, they are primarily trained via supervised fine-tuning or training-time reinforcement learning, requiring explicit fine-tuning phases, human interventions, or controlled data collection. Consequently, existing methods remain unsuitable for challenging simulated- or physical-world deployments, where robots must respond autonomously and flexibly to evolving environments. To address this limitation, we introduce a Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for VLAs (TT-VLA), a framework that enables on-the-fly policy adaptation during inference. TT-VLA formulates a dense reward mechanism that leverages step-by-step task-progress signals to refine action policies during test time while preserving the SFT/RL-trained priors, making it an effective supplement to current VLA models. Empirical results show that our approach enhances overall adaptability, stability, and task success in dynamic, previously unseen scenarios under simulated and real-world settings. We believe TT-VLA offers a principled step toward self-improving, deployment-ready VLAs.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型最近成为一种强大的通用机器人学习范式，能够使得智能体将视觉观测数据和自然语言指令转化为可执行的机器人动作。尽管这种模型非常流行，但它们主要通过监督式微调或在训练过程中进行强化学习来训练，这需要明确的微调阶段、人工干预或受控的数据收集。因此，现有的方法并不适合在复杂的模拟或物理环境中进行部署，因为在这些环境中，机器人必须自主且灵活地应对不断变化的环境。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种测试时强化学习框架——TT-VLA，该框架能够在推理过程中实时调整策略。TT-VLA采用了一种密集的奖励机制，利用任务进展信号在测试期间逐步优化动作策略，同时保留由SFT/RL训练的先验知识，从而成为当前VLA模型的有效补充。实验结果表明，我们的方法在模拟和现实环境中，提升了机器人在动态且前所未见的场景下的适应能力、稳定性和任务成功率。我们相信，TT-VLA为开发具有自我改进能力的、适用于实际部署的视觉-语言-动作系统提供了有效的途径。

papers.title: AdaMix: Adaptive Mixing for Short and Long Reasoning Adapters
papers.title_zh: AdaMix：适用于短距离和长距离推理适配器的自适应混音技术
papers.authors: Hao Luo, Xiao Yan, Xinyan Li, Qiming Zeng, Yuhao Lin, Shanshan Feng, Hao Wang, Jiawei Jiang
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success on complex tasks by generating detailed Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, they tend to apply a uniform, computation-intensive deep reasoning strategy to all problems, leading to unnecessary overhead on simple tasks. This significantly hinders their efficiency in real-world applications. While existing methods have improved reasoning efficiency to some extent, they still face critical challenges such as conflicting objectives, limited adaptability. To address these limitations, we propose AdaMix, an adaptive reasoning framework via decoupled optimization. To mitigate optimization conflicts, AdaMix first constructs two specialized adapters: an efficiency-oriented short adapter and an accuracy-oriented long adapter. It then incorporates a difficulty-aware routing model that assesses problem complexity to predict a reasoning intensity coefficient. This coefficient is used to dynamically interpolate a mixed adapter from the two base adapters, enabling fine-grained reasoning control. Our experiment demonstrates that our AdaMix reduces the average response length of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B by 54.9% while improving accuracy by up to 4.8% on five mathematical datasets, thus indicating a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在复杂任务上取得了显著的成功，它们能够生成详细的思维链推理结果。然而，这些模型往往对所有问题都采用一种统一的、计算量大的深度推理策略，这导致在简单任务上出现了不必要的开销，严重影响了其在实际应用中的效率。虽然现有的方法在一定程度上提高了推理效率，但它们仍然面临一些关键挑战，比如目标冲突以及适应性有限的问题。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了AdaMix这一自适应推理框架，它通过解耦优化来实现智能调整。为了缓解优化过程中的冲突，AdaMix首先构建了两个专门的适配器：一个以效率为导向的短适配器，以及一个以准确性为导向的长适配器。接着，它引入了一个考虑问题复杂度的路由模型，该模型可以预测推理强度系数。这个系数被用来动态地从两个基础适配器中选择出一个混合适配器，从而实现细粒度的推理控制。我们的实验表明，使用AdaMix后，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B的平均响应长度减少了54.9%，而在五个数学数据集上的准确率则提高了4.8%，这表明AdaMix在准确性和效率之间实现了良好的平衡。
