papers.title: Quantifying and Mitigating Socially Desirable Responding in LLMs: A Desirability-Matched Graded Forced-Choice Psychometric Study
papers.title_zh: 量化并缓解大型语言模型中符合社会期望的反应：基于期望匹配的分级强制选择心理测量研究
papers.authors: Kensuke Okada, Yui Furukawa, Kyosuke Bunji
papers.abstract: Human self-report questionnaires are increasingly used in NLP to benchmark and audit large language models (LLMs), from persona consistency to safety and bias assessments. Yet these instruments presume honest responding; in evaluative contexts, LLMs can instead gravitate toward socially preferred answers—a form of socially desirable responding (SDR)—biasing questionnaire-derived scores and downstream conclusions. We propose a psychometric framework to quantify and mitigate SDR in questionnaire-based evaluation of LLMs. To quantify SDR, the same inventory is administered under HONEST versus FAKE-GOOD instructions, and SDR is computed as a direction-corrected standardized effect size from item response theory (IRT)-estimated latent scores. This enables comparisons across constructs and response formats, as well as against human instructed-faking benchmarks. For mitigation, we construct a graded forced-choice (GFC) Big Five inventory by selecting 30 cross-domain pairs from an item pool via constrained optimization to match desirability. Across nine instruction-following LLMs evaluated on synthetic personas with known target profiles, Likert-style questionnaires show consistently large SDR, whereas desirability-matched GFC substantially attenuates SDR while largely preserving the recovery of the intended persona profiles. These results highlight a model-dependent SDR–recovery trade-off and motivate SDR-aware reporting practices for questionnaire-based benchmarking and auditing of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在自然语言处理领域，人类自报问卷被越来越多地用于评估大语言模型（LLM）的性能，包括角色一致性、安全性及偏见等方面的检测。然而，这些工具假设受访者会做出诚实的回答；但在评估过程中，LLM可能会倾向于选择社会所认可的答案——这种被称为“社会期望回答”的现象，会导致从问卷中得出的评分和后续结论出现偏差。我们提出了一个心理测量框架，以量化并减轻在基于问卷的LLM评估中出现的社会期望回答现象。为了量化社会期望回答，我们在“诚实”与“虚假有益”两种指令下对同一份问卷进行施测，并通过项目反应理论估算的潜在分数来计算社会期望回答的程度。这样就能在不同评估结构和回答方式之间进行比较，同时也能与人类在虚假回答测试中的表现进行对比。为了减轻这种影响，我们通过约束优化方法，从题库中选取了30对跨领域的题目，构建了一个分级强制选择式的大五人格问卷，以匹配不同情境下的期望值。在对九种遵循特定指令的LLM进行施测时，Likert式问卷显示社会期望回答程度始终较高，而通过分级强制选择式问卷则显著降低了社会期望回答的程度，同时较好地保留了预期的角色特征。这些结果凸显了模型依赖性导致的社会期望回答与预期角色特征的矛盾，并为基于问卷的LLM评估和审计工作提出了需要考虑到社会期望回答问题的报告实践。

papers.title: From Curated Data to Scalable Models: Continual Pre-training of Dense and MoE Large Language Models for Tibetan
papers.title_zh: 从精选数据到可扩展模型：持续对密集型和混合记忆网络大型语言模型进行预训练，以用于藏语处理
papers.authors: Lei Yang, Leiyu Pan, Bojian Xiong, Renren Jin, Shaowei Zhang, Yue Chen, Ling Shi, Jiang Zhou, Junru Wu, Zhen Wang, Jianxiang Peng, Juesi Xiao, Tianyu Dong, Zhuowen Han, Zhuo Chen, Yuqi Ren, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of natural language processing tasks, yet their performance remains heavily biased toward high-resource languages. Tibetan, despite its cultural significance and large speaker population, is still substantially underrepresented. In this work, we present a comprehensive pipeline for advancing Tibetan language modeling through large-scale data curation and continual pre-training. We construct a 72 GB high-quality Tibetan corpus, the largest to date, and adapt Qwen2.5-7B through balanced multilingual continual pre-training with Tibetan, Chinese, and English, followed by multilingual instruction tuning. To further scale capacity efficiently, we extend the dense model to a 50B-A10B Mixture-of-Experts architecture. Due to the absence of standardized Tibetan benchmarks, we build multiple evaluation datasets via high-quality translation and human verification. Experimental results show that both dense and MoE models consistently outperform existing open-source and Tibetan-focused models of similar scale across diverse tasks. Our work advances Tibetan-centric LLM research and provides transferable insights for extending LLMs to other low-resource languages. We will release the model weights, evaluation benchmarks, and detailed data processing documentation in the follow-up.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在众多自然语言处理任务中取得了显著成就，但其性能仍然严重偏向那些资源丰富的语言。尽管藏语具有重要的文化意义且使用人数众多，但其在模型中的代表性仍然严重不足。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种全面的方案，通过大规模数据整理和持续预训练来推动藏语语言建模的发展。我们构建了一个高达72GB的高质量藏语语料库，这是迄今为止规模最大的藏语语料库。随后，我们将Qwen2.5-7B模型进行藏语、中文和英文的多语言持续预训练，然后再进行多语言指令调整。为了有效提升模型的性能，我们将密集模型扩展为50B-A10B混合专家架构。由于缺乏标准化的藏语评估基准，我们通过高质量的翻译和人类验证构建了多个评估数据集。实验结果表明，无论是密集模型还是混合专家模型，在多种任务中都能持续优于现有的开源模型和以藏语为重点的模型。我们的研究为藏语中心的语言模型研究做出了贡献，并为将语言模型扩展到其他资源匮乏的语言提供了可借鉴的经验。我们将在后续发布模型中权重、评估基准以及详细的数据处理文档。

papers.title: UrbanGeoEval: A City-Scale Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Geospatial Reasoning
papers.title_zh: UrbanGeoEval：一种适用于评估大型语言模型在地理空间推理能力水平的城市级基准测试
papers.authors: Mutian Bao, Qiuyi Qi, Tian Liang, Jinjian Zhang, Wei Zhou, Ming Kong, Linjian Mo, Qiang Zhu
papers.abstract: Current evaluations of geospatial reasoning in LLMs are frequently impeded by the entanglement of factual recall and spatial logic, which often obscures the models’ true capabilities in complex city-scale environments. To address this, we introduce UrbanGeoEval, a comprehensive benchmark featuring a dual-module framework designed to disentangle these competencies. The Knowledge Module assesses urban memory via scalable map-based queries, while the Reasoning Module isolates pure logical inference across 3,148 realistic tasks by providing necessary geospatial context. Unlike prior benchmarks that hand the model pre-computed spatial text, UrbanGeoEval provides raw geometry and forces the model to act as a spatial computing engine. Our evaluation methodology introduces a reliable hybrid pipeline that merges deterministic programmatic checks with an LLM-as-a-Judge, achieving expert-level evaluation accuracy. Extensive experiments on 18 widely used LLMs uncover critical insights: (1) models exhibit severe geographic biases and resolution gaps; (2) failures in complex multi-hop tasks often stem from brittle foundational spatial skills rather than high-level logic deficits. UrbanGeoEval provides a precise diagnostic tool for advancing urban geospatial intelligence in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前对大语言模型在地理空间推理方面的评估，往往受到事实回忆与空间逻辑相互交织的阻碍，这常常掩盖了模型在复杂城市规模环境中的真正能力。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了UrbanGeoEval这一综合性基准测试，该测试采用双模块框架，旨在分离这两种能力。知识模块通过可扩展的地图查询来评估城市记忆能力，而推理模块则通过提供必要的地理空间背景，实现在3,148个真实任务中的纯逻辑推理。与那些将预计算的空间文本直接交给模型的先前基准测试不同，UrbanGeoEval提供了原始的几何数据，迫使模型充当空间计算引擎的角色。我们的评估方法引入了一种可靠的混合流程，将确定性程序化检查与以语言模型为裁判的方式相结合，从而实现专家级别的评估精度。在18种广泛使用的语言模型上进行的实验揭示了关键发现：(1) 模型存在严重的地理偏见和分辨率不足问题；(2) 在复杂的多跳任务中失败通常源于基础空间技能的薄弱，而非高级逻辑缺陷。UrbanGeoEval为提升语言模型在城市地理空间智能方面的能力提供了精确的诊断工具。

papers.title: TAIGR: Towards Modeling Influencer Content on Social Media via Structured, Pragmatic Inference
papers.title_zh: 泰格：通过结构化、实用的推理方法，模拟社交媒体上 influencers 的内容影响
papers.authors: Nishanth Sridhar Nakshatri, Eylon Caplan, Rajkumar Pujari, Dan Goldwasser
papers.abstract: Health influencers play a growing role in shaping public beliefs, yet their content is often conveyed through conversational narratives and rhetorical strategies rather than explicit factual claims. As a result, claim-centric verification methods struggle to capture the pragmatic meaning of influencer discourse. In this paper, we propose TAIGR (Takeaway Argumentation Inference with Grounded References), a structured framework designed to analyze influencer discourse, which operates in 3 stages: (1) identifying the core influencer recommendation–takeaway; (2) constructing an argumentation graph that captures influencer justification for the takeaway; (3) performing factor graph-based probabilistic inference to validate the takeaway. We evaluate TAIGR on a content validation task over influencer video transcripts on health, showing that accurate validation requires modeling the discourse’s pragmatic and argumentative structure rather than treating transcripts as flat collections of claims.
papers.abstract_zh: 健康领域的网红在塑造公众观念方面发挥着越来越重要的作用，然而他们的内容往往是通过对话式的叙述和修辞策略来传达的，而不是通过明确的事实陈述。因此，以主张为中心的验证方法难以捕捉到网红话语中的实用意义。在本文中，我们提出了TAIGR（基于有根引用的论点推理）这一结构化框架，该框架旨在分析网红的话语，其运作过程分为三个阶段：（1）识别网红的核心推荐与结论；（2）构建能够体现网红对推荐内容的理由的论证图；（3）通过因子图进行概率性推理，以验证该结论的正确性。我们在对健康领域网红视频文字内容的有效性评估中验证了TAIGR的有效性，结果表明，要准确验证内容的真实性，就需要对话语的实用性和论证结构进行建模，而不是简单地将文字内容视为一系列孤立的主张集合。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Afri-MCQA: Multimodal Cultural Question Answering for African Languages
papers.title_zh: Afri-MCQA：用于非洲语言的多模态文化问答系统
papers.authors: Atnafu Lambebo Tonja, Srija Anand, Emilio Villa-Cueva, Israel Abebe Azime, Jesujoba Oluwadara Alabi, Muhidin A. Mohamed, Debela Desalegn Yadeta, Negasi Haile Abadi, Abigail Oppong, Nnaemeka Casmir Obiefuna, Idris Abdulmumin, Naome A Etori, Eric Peter Wairagala, Kanda Patrick Tshinu, Imanigirimbabazi Emmanuel, Gabofetswe Malema, Alham Fikri Aji, David Ifeoluwa Adelani, Thamar Solorio
papers.abstract: Africa is home to over one-third of the world’s languages, yet remains severely underrepresented in multimodal AI research. We introduce Afri-MCQA, the first Multilingual Cultural Question-Answering benchmark containing 7.5k Q A pairs across 15 African languages from 12 countries. The benchmark offers parallel text and speech modalities and was entirely created by native speakers. We find that models show poor performance across evaluated cultures, with near-zero accuracy on open-ended VQA when queried through native language or speech. To test linguistic competence, we include control experiments meant to assess this specific aspect separate from cultural knowledge, and we observe significant performance gaps between native languages and English for both text and speech. These findings underscore the pressing need for speech-first approaches, culturally grounded pretraining, and cross-lingual cultural transfer. We release Afri-MCQA to support more inclusive multimodal AI development.
papers.abstract_zh: 非洲拥有世界上超过三分之一的语言，但在多模态人工智能研究中却严重缺乏相关研究。我们推出了Afri-MCQA这一首个多语言文化问答基准测试，该测试包含来自12个国家的15种非洲语言的7500对问答对。该基准测试同时支持文本和语音模式，并且完全由母语使用者创建。我们发现，模型在评估的各种文化中表现不佳，在使用母语或语音进行开放式VQA问题时，准确率几乎为零。为了测试语言能力，我们设计了对照实验来评估与文化知识无关的这一方面能力，结果发现，无论是文本还是语音方面，不同母语与英语之间的性能存在显著差距。这些发现凸显了采用以语音为先的方法、进行基于文化的预训练以及实现跨语言文化迁移的紧迫性。我们发布Afri-MCQA，以支持更具包容性的多模态人工智能发展。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: E-ViC: Reasoning Beyond Text via Embodied Visual Chain for Spatial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: E-ViC：通过具身视觉链进行文本之外的推理，以提升空间智能
papers.authors: Junbo Qi, Yi Zhang, Hanchu Ni, Che Liu, Zhimin Yao, Ruilin Yang, Xiancong Ren, Liangjian Wen, Wei Ge, Yuya Ieiri, Osamu Yoshie, Yong Dai, Xiaozhu Ju
papers.abstract: Precise spatial reasoning is fundamental to embodied intelligence, yet current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain bottlenecked by text-based Chain-of-Thought (CoT) that relies solely on textual reasoning trajectories, often bypassing active engagement with fine-grained visual details. To address this, we present E-ViC (Embodied Visual Chain), a framework that moves reasoning beyond text and directly into the visual domain. By formulating visual operations (e.g., zooming, marking) as executable primitives, E-ViC transforms perception from static prediction into an active verification process. Distinct from approaches relying on supervised step-wise trajectories, E-ViC is trained via an agentic reinforcement learning paradigm. This enables the model to autonomously discover optimal policies, leading to the emergence of human-like “look-and-confirm” strategies driven solely by task-level rewards. To facilitate this, we curate a comprehensive 24.4K-sample dataset covering diverse embodied tasks. By grounding reasoning in pixel-level interactions, E-ViC reframes spatial intelligence as a verifiable, tool-using capability. Extensive evaluations on external benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms strong VLM baselines with an average gain of 10.1%.
papers.abstract_zh: 精确的空间推理是体现型智能的基础，然而目前的视觉语言模型仍然受到基于文本的推理链的限制，这些模型仅依赖文本推理路径，常常忽略了与精细视觉细节的互动。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了E-ViC框架——一种将推理从文本领域直接转移到视觉领域的解决方案。通过将视觉操作（如缩放、标记等）定义为可执行的原语，E-ViC将感知从静态预测转变为主动验证过程。与依赖监督式逐步推理的方法不同，E-ViC采用代理式强化学习范式进行训练。这使得模型能够自主发现最优策略，从而涌现出类似人类的“观察确认”策略，这些策略完全由任务级奖励驱动。为了支持这一点，我们构建了一个包含24.4K样本的全面数据集，涵盖多种体现型任务。通过将推理建立在像素级交互的基础上，E-ViC将空间智能重新定义为一种可验证的工具使用能力。在外部基准测试中的广泛评估表明，我们的方法始终优于强大的视觉语言模型基线，平均提升了10.1%的性能。

papers.title: MessToClean: Evidence-Grounded Structure-Preserving Reconstruction for Real-World Degraded Exam Paper Images
papers.title_zh: MessToClean：基于证据的结构保护性重建方法，用于修复受损的考试试卷图片
papers.authors: Jiayi Tuo, Cheng Tang, Zihan Wang, Chenyue Zhou, Yao Li, Yanbiao Ma, Chao Wang, Wei Dai, Mingxuan Wang, Shitong Qin, Ziwei Zhao
papers.abstract: Intelligent education systems often collect exam sheets as in-the-wild photos. These photos often suffer from distortions and noise caused by handwriting and occlusions, collectively referred to as Real-World Degraded Exam Images (RDEI). Structure-preserving reconstruction is key to converting RDEI into structured assets for downstream educational applications. Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often fail under RDEI, leading to disrupted structure and evidence-unsupported hallucinations. To tackle these challenges, we propose MessToClean, a backbone-agnostic, evidence-driven pipeline that treats off-the-shelf MLLMs as interchangeable components. By grounding extraction in pixel-aligned evidence and enforcing post-hoc consistency auditing on recovered structures, MessToClean mitigates unsupported hallucinations and enhances both controllability and structural fidelity in question-level reconstruction. We curate RDEI-Exam from our educational platforms and evaluate across 12 state-of-the-art MLLM backbones. Across these, MessToClean improves stem consistency by 1.01-3.18%, figure consistency by 0.50-49.16%, and refusal F1 by 1.06-10.88% across question types.
papers.abstract_zh: 智能教育系统通常会收集考试试卷的照片。这些照片常常因笔迹和遮挡现象而出现失真和噪声，这种现象被称为“真实场景下的劣质考试图像”（RDEI）。保持结构完整的重建是将其转化为可用于后续教育应用的结构化数据的关键。现有的多模态大语言模型在处理RDEI时往往表现不佳，这会导致结构破坏以及无依据的错误识别。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MessToClean这一基于证据驱动的解决方案，该方案将现成的多模态大语言模型视为可互换的组件。通过以像素级证据为基础进行提取，并对恢复后的结构进行事后一致性审核，MessToClean能够有效减少无依据的误识别，同时提高问题级重建的可控性和结构完整性。我们从自己的教育平台上收集RDEI照片，并在12种先进的多模态大语言模型上进行评估。结果表明，MessToClean在不同类型的问题中，分别提高了主干结构的连贯性1.01%-3.18%，图形结构的连贯性0.50%-49.16%，以及拒绝率F1值1.06%-10.88%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Phonemes to the Rescue: Multilingual Tokenization Based on International Phonetic Alphabet
papers.title_zh: 借助国际音标进行多语言标记化：基于国际音标的方法
papers.authors: Milan Miletić, Julie Kallini, Ekaterina Shutova
papers.abstract: Multilingual language models often exhibit performance disparities across languages that can arise as early as the tokenization stage. Widely-used subword tokenization approaches favor high-resource languages, and tokenizer-free methods still yield longer sequences for scripts with a higher bytes-per-character ratio. To address these shortcomings, we propose to use the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) as a language-agnostic input representation for multilingual tokenizers. IPA provides a compact symbol inventory, greater cross-lingual character overlap, and a more balanced byte-per-character distribution across languages. We train matched pairs of text vs. IPA subword tokenizers across 24 languages and 14 scripts and demonstrate that IPA tokenizers consistently improve tokenization quality, especially for non-Latin scripts, and generalize more effectively to unseen languages and scripts.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言模型在不同语言中的性能表现往往存在差异，这种差异可能早在分词阶段就已经出现。常用的子词分词方法更倾向于处理资源丰富的语言，而无需分词器的方法则会在字符占用字节数较高的脚本中生成更长的序列。为了克服这些缺点，我们提出使用国际音标作为多语言分词器的语言无关输入表示方式。国际音标具有简洁的符号体系、更高的跨语言字符重叠度，以及更均衡的字符占用字节数分布。我们在24种语言和14种脚本中训练了文本与国际音标子词分词器的匹配对，结果表明，国际音标分词器能够持续提升分词质量，尤其是在非拉丁脚本中；同时，它还能更有效地泛化到未见过的语言和脚本中。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Structure Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Factual Queries
papers.title_zh: 结构导向的检索增强生成技术，用于事实性查询处理
papers.authors: Miao Xie, Xiao Zhang, Yi Li, Chunli Lv
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has been proposed to mitigate hallucinations in large language models (LLMs), where generated outputs may be factually incorrect. However, existing RAG approaches predominantly rely on vector similarity for retrieval, which is prone to semantic noise and fails to ensure that generated responses fully satisfy the complex conditions specified by factual queries, often leading to incorrect answers. To address this challenge, we introduce a novel research problem, named Exact Retrieval Problem (ERP). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first problem formulation that explicitly incorporates structural information into RAG for factual questions to satisfy all query conditions. For this novel problem, we propose Structure Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation (SG-RAG), which models the retrieval process as an embedding-based subgraph matching task, and uses the retrieved topological structures to guide the LLM to generate answers that meet all specified query conditions. To facilitate evaluation of ERP, we construct and publicly release Exact Retrieval Question Answering (ERQA), a large-scale dataset comprising 120{,}000 fact-oriented QA pairs, each involving complex conditions, spanning 20 diverse domains. The experimental results demonstrate that SG-RAG significantly outperforms strong baselines on ERQA, delivering absolute improvements from 20.68 to 50.88 points across all evaluation metrics, while maintaining reasonable computational overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术被提出用于减轻大语言模型中的幻觉问题，即生成的输出可能存在事实错误的情况。然而，现有的RAG方法主要依赖向量相似性来进行检索，这种方式容易受到语义噪声的影响，无法确保生成的回答完全满足事实查询所指定的复杂条件，从而导致错误的答案。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的研究问题，称为精确检索问题（ERP）。据我们所知，这是第一个将结构信息明确纳入RAG系统以满足所有查询条件的问题框架。针对这一新问题，我们提出了结构引导的检索增强生成（SG-RAG）方法。该方法将检索过程建模为基于嵌入的子图匹配任务，并利用检索到的拓扑结构来指导语言模型生成满足所有指定查询条件的答案。为了便于评估ERP，我们构建并公开了精确检索问答数据集（ERQA），该数据集包含12万个以事实为导向的问答对，每个问答都涉及复杂的条件，涵盖了20个不同的领域。实验结果表明，SG-RAG在ERQA任务上的表现显著优于其他强基线方法，在所有评估指标上的提升幅度从20.68点提高到50.88点，同时保持了合理的计算开销。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GROKE: Vision-Free Navigation Instruction Evaluation via Graph Reasoning on OpenStreetMap
papers.title_zh: GROKE：通过图推理对OpenStreetMap上的导航指引进行评估的方法
papers.authors: Farzad Shami, Subhrasankha Dey, Nico Van de Weghe, Henrikki Tenkanen
papers.abstract: The evaluation of navigation instructions remains a persistent challenge in Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) research. Traditional reference-based metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE fail to capture the functional utility of spatial directives, specifically whether an instruction successfully guides a navigator to the intended destination. Although existing VLN agents could serve as evaluators, their reliance on high-fidelity visual simulators introduces licensing constraints and computational costs, and perception errors further confound linguistic quality assessment. This paper introduces GROKE (Graph-based Reasoning over OSM Knowledge for instruction Evaluation), a vision-free training-free hierarchical LLM-based framework for evaluating navigation instructions using OpenStreetMap data. Through systematic ablation studies, we demonstrate that structured JSON and textual formats for spatial information substantially outperform grid-based and visual graph representations. Our hierarchical architecture combines sub-instruction planning with topological graph navigation, reducing navigation error by 68.5% compared to heuristic and sampling baselines on the Map2Seq dataset. The agent’s execution success, trajectory fidelity, and decision patterns serve as proxy metrics for functional navigability given OSM-visible landmarks and topology, establishing a scalable and interpretable evaluation paradigm without visual dependencies.
papers.abstract_zh: 在视觉与语言导航研究中，导航指令的评估一直是一个难以解决的挑战。传统的基于参考的指标，如BLEU和ROUGE，无法准确反映空间指令的功能性作用，即该指令是否能够成功引导导航器到达预定目的地。虽然现有的视觉与语言导航代理可以担任评估任务，但它们对高保真度视觉模拟器的依赖带来了许可限制和计算成本问题，而感知误差则进一步影响了语言质量的评估。本文提出了GROKE（基于图的推理技术，用于基于OpenStreetMap数据的导航指令评估），这是一种无需视觉输入、无需训练的基于分层大语言模型的框架，能够利用OpenStreetMap数据来评估导航指令。通过系统的消融研究，我们发现，对于空间信息而言，结构化的JSON格式和文本格式的表现明显优于基于网格的表示方式以及视觉图表示方式。我们的分层架构将子指令规划与拓扑图导航相结合，使得导航误差比在Map2Seq数据集上的启发式方法和采样方法降低了68.5%。代理的执行成功率、轨迹的精确性以及决策模式可以作为功能性导航能力的代理指标，这些指标可以在有可见地标和拓扑结构的情况下进行评估，从而建立一种可扩展且易于解释的评估方法，而无需依赖视觉信息。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Emotion-Wheel-Guided Audio-Referred Text Representation for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation
papers.title_zh: 基于情感轮播机制的音频参考文本表示方法，用于对话中的多模态情感识别
papers.authors: Eunseon Seong, Harim Lee, Dahye Kim, Changhyun Kim, Dong-Kyu Chae
papers.abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation aims to identify emotions within a dialogue with multimodal data, including audio, visual, and textual features. While existing methods have made significant improvements, there are two fundamental limitations to be addressed. From the modality fusion perspective, current approaches treat all modalities as functionally equivalent during fusion, overlooking their distinct communicative roles and information capacities, in which text conveys explicit semantic meaning while audio provides paralinguistic cues. From the emotion label perspective, many works ignore the continuous structure of emotion characterized by psychological theory and apply uniform penalties regardless of affective proximity. To address these limitations, we propose EMART, EMotion-Wheel-Guided Audio-Referred Text Representation for ERC, specifically focusing on audio and text modalities. First, we propose a modality-aware fusion strategy capturing linguistic features from text as the primary source and audio as a complementary component. Secondly, we propose an emotion-wheel-guided supervised contrastive loss to encode emotional proximity based on Russell’s circumplex model. Experimental results on IEMOCAP and MELD demonstrate outstanding performance. The code is available at: https://github.com/DILAB-HYU/EMART.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态对话中的情感识别旨在利用包括音频、视觉和文本特征在内的多模态数据来识别对话中的情感。虽然现有方法已经取得了显著进展，但仍然存在两个需要解决的根本问题。从多模态融合的角度来看，当前的方法在融合过程中将所有模态视为功能上等同的，而忽略了不同模态在沟通中的作用和信息承载能力——文本能够传达明确的语义信息，而音频则提供副语言线索。从情感标签的角度来看，许多研究忽视了心理学理论所强调的情感的连续结构，并且采用统一的惩罚机制来处理各种情感状态。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了EMART算法，即基于情感轮导引的音频引导文本表示法，专门用于处理音频和文本模态。首先，我们提出了一种考虑各模态特性的融合策略，将文本中的语言特征作为主要来源，音频作为补充成分。其次，我们采用了基于Russell循环模型情感轮导引的监督式对比损失方法，以编码情感之间的接近程度。在IEMOCAP和MELD数据集上的实验结果表明该算法的性能非常出色。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/DILAB-HYU/EMART.git
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LongVideoAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning with Long Videos
papers.title_zh: LongVideoAgent：针对长视频的多智能体推理机制
papers.authors: Runtao Liu, Ziyi Liu, Jiaqi Tang, Yue Ma, Renjie Pi, Jipeng Zhang, Qifeng Chen
papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal LLMs and systems that use tools for long-video QA point to the promise of reasoning over hour-long episodes. However, many methods still compress content into lossy summaries or rely on limited toolsets, weakening temporal grounding and missing fine-grained cues. We propose a multi-agent framework in which a master LLM coordinates a grounding agent to localize question-relevant segments and a vision agent to extract targeted textual observations. The master agent plans with a step limit, and is trained with reinforcement learning to encourage concise, correct, and efficient multi-agent cooperation. This design helps the master agent focus on relevant clips via grounding, complements subtitles with visual detail, and yields interpretable trajectories. On our proposed LongTVQA and LongTVQA+ which are episode-level datasets aggregated from TVQA/TVQA+, our multi-agent system significantly outperforms strong non-agent baselines. Experiments also show reinforcement learning further strengthens reasoning and planning for the trained agent.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在多模态大语言模型和利用工具进行长视频问答系统的研究进展表明，对长达数小时的视频内容进行推理是有可能的。然而，许多方法仍然将内容压缩成有损的摘要，或者依赖有限的工具集，这削弱了时间上的定位能力，并忽略了细粒度的线索。我们提出了一种多智能体框架：由一个主大语言模型负责协调定位问题相关片段的代理，以及一个视觉代理负责提取目标文本信息。主智能体具有步限规划能力，并通过强化学习训练，以促使其实现简洁、准确且高效的智能体协作。这种设计有助于主智能体通过定位功能专注于相关片段，用视觉细节补充字幕，并生成可解释的推理路径。在我们提出的LongTVQA和LongTVQA+这两个基于TVQA/TVQA+整理的剧集级数据集上，我们的多智能体系统显著优于那些强大的非智能体基线系统。实验还表明，强化学习进一步增强了训练有素的智能体的推理和规划能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: BOSCH: Black-Box Binary Optimization for Short-Context Attention-Head Selection in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 博世：用于大型语言模型中选择适合短上下文处理的注意力机制的黑盒二进制优化方法
papers.authors: Abbas Ghaddar, Ivan Kobyzev, Boxing Chen, Yufei Cui
papers.abstract: Post-training hybridization of large language models (LLMs) often replaces quadratic self-attention with sliding-window attention (SWA) to reduce KV cache usage and improve latency. Existing hybridization schemes are typically defined either at the layer level (e.g., interleaving) or at the head level via static rankings from local to global. Layer-level schemes ignore that local and global dependencies are routed through heads within the same layer, while static head-level rankings suffer from entanglement: a head’s local/global behavior can change after hybridization. We propose BOSCH, Black-box Binary Optimization for Short-context Head Selection, a training-free method that formulates the problem as a Large Neighborhood Search and decomposes it into three subproblems: (i) layer-importance detection via small-budget black-box probes, (ii) adaptive per-layer SWA-ratio assignment based on these sensitivities, and (iii) grouped head-level optimization within ratio buckets. Extensive experiments on 4 LLMs ranging from 1.7B to 30B parameters, across 4 SWA ratios, show that BOSCH consistently outperforms layer-level heuristics and 6 strong static head-level methods, with larger gains at higher SWA ratios. Under continual pretraining, BOSCH recover original long-context performance faster and to a higher level. Analysis of the selected heads reveals substantial turnover for BOSCH across different SWA ratios, underscoring the importance of performing head-level selection for each target ratio rather than relying on fixed locality rankings.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型训练后的融合过程中，通常会用滑动窗口注意力机制替代二次自注意力机制，以减少KV缓存的使用量并提升延迟性能。现有的融合方案通常是在层级别进行定义的（例如，交错处理），或者通过从局部到全局的静态排序来在头部级别进行融合。层级别的方案忽略了局部和全局依赖关系是通过同一层的头部节点传递的这一点，而静态的头部级别排序则存在混乱问题：头部的局部/全局行为在融合后可能会发生变化。我们提出了BOSCH算法，这是一种用于短上下文场景的头部选择方法，它无需训练即可解决问题。该算法将问题分解为三个子问题：(i) 通过低成本的黑盒探针检测各层的 중요성；(ii) 基于这些敏感性自适应地分配每层滑动窗口注意力的比例；(iii) 在预设的比例区间内进行头部优化。我们在4种参数规模从17亿到300亿的大语言模型上进行了大量实验，测试了6种强大的静态头部选择方法，结果表明BOSCH始终优于层级别的启发式方法，并且在更高的滑动窗口注意力比例下表现出更大的优势。在持续预训练的情况下，BOSCH能够更快地恢复原始的长上下文性能，并且效果更为显著。对所选头部的分析显示，BOSCH在不同滑动窗口注意力比例下的表现差异很大，这进一步强调了为每个目标比例进行头部选择的重要性，而不是依赖于固定的局部性排名。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Scaling Reasoning, Losing Control: Evaluating Instruction Following in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 规模效应与推理能力：评估大型推理模型中的指令执行效果
papers.authors: Tingchen Fu, Yafu Li, Jiawei Gu, Xiaoye Qu, Yu Cheng
papers.abstract: Instruction-following is essential for aligning large language models (LLMs) with user intent. While recent reasoning-oriented models exhibit impressive performance on complex mathematical problems, their ability to adhere to natural language instructions remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce MathIF, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating instruction-following in mathematical reasoning tasks. Our empirical analysis reveals a consistent tension between scaling up reasoning capacity and maintaining controllability, as models that reason more effectively often struggle to comply with user directives. We find that models tuned on distilled long chains-of-thought or trained with reasoning-oriented reinforcement learning often degrade in instruction adherence, especially when generation length increases. Furthermore, we show that even simple interventions can partially recover obedience, though at the cost of reasoning performance. These findings highlight a fundamental tension in current LLM training paradigms and motivate the need for more instruction-aware reasoning models.
papers.abstract_zh: 遵循指令对于使大语言模型与用户意图保持一致至关重要。虽然最近的基于推理的模型在复杂的数学问题上表现出色，但它们遵守自然语言指令的能力却尚未得到充分探索。在这项研究中，我们提出了MathIF这一专门用于评估数学推理任务中遵循指令能力的基准测试。我们的实证分析发现，在提升推理能力与保持可控性之间存在着持续的矛盾：那些能够更高效地进行推理的模型往往难以遵循用户的指示。我们发现，那些基于浓缩的长思维链进行训练的模型，或者采用基于推理的强化学习方法进行训练的模型，在遵循指令方面表现较差，尤其是在生成长度增加时。此外，我们还发现，即使进行简单的干预，也能部分恢复模型的服从性，但代价是降低其推理性能。这些发现揭示了当前语言模型训练范式中存在的一个根本性问题，并强调了需要开发更加注重指令执行的推理模型。

papers.title: MirrorQA: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs on Mirror-Orientation Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MirrorQA：在镜像方向推理方面对多模态大语言模型进行性能比较
papers.authors: Jingping Liu, Xingchen Peng, Yan Zhou, Ziyan Liu, Jie Zhai, Ronghao Chen, Huacan Wang, Xiaofeng Jia
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in recent years, yet their ability to perform left–right reasoning in mirror contexts—a fundamental element of spatial cognition—remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce MirrorQA, a manually constructed benchmark with 5,549 samples, designed to evaluate MLLMs’ capability to distinguish left from right from a subject-centered perspective. MirrorQA is built through a three-stage pipeline (annotation, verification, and final review) to ensure high-quality labeling. Comprehensive evaluations on both open- and closed-source MLLMs show that even the best-performing models achieve only 65.40% accuracy, far below the 99.28% accuracy of humans. These results highlight substantial challenges in current MLLMs when reasoning about left and right, and point to promising directions for future research. MirrorQA and its code are publicly available at anonymous link https://github.com/stargazer-zeno/MirrorQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，多模态大语言模型取得了显著进展，然而它们在镜像情境下进行左右推理的能力——这是空间认知的一个基本要素——仍然没有得到充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MirrorQA这个由人工构建的基准测试，该测试包含5,549个样本，旨在评估大语言模型从主体中心的角度区分左右的能力。MirrorQA通过三个阶段的工作流程来构建：标注、验证和最终审核，以确保标签的质量。对开源和闭源大语言模型的全面评估表明，即使是最优秀的模型，其准确率也仅为65.40%，远低于人类的99.28%准确率。这些结果凸显了当前大语言模型在左右推理方面存在的重大挑战，并为未来的研究指明了方向。MirrorQA及其代码可以在匿名链接https://github.com/stargazer-zeno/MirrorQA上免费获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Robust Tool Use via Fission-GRPO: Learning to Recover from Execution Errors
papers.title_zh: 通过裂变GRPO技术稳健地使用工具：学会从执行错误中恢复过来
papers.authors: Zhiwei Zhang, Fei Zhao, Rui Wang, Zezhong Wang, Bin Liang, Jiakang Wang, Yao Hu, Shaosheng Cao, Kam-Fai Wong
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can call tools effectively, yet they remain brittle in multi-turn execution: after a tool-call error, smaller models often fall into repetitive invalid re-invocations instead of interpreting the feedback and recovering. This failure mode persists because current training paradigms do not explicitly teach models how to recover from execution errors. In particular, standard reinforcement learning (RL) collapses rich failure experience into sparse negative rewards, while pre-collected error-correction datasets become mismatched to the policy’s evolving failure modes. To bridge this gap, we propose Fission-GRPO, a framework that converts execution errors into on-policy corrective supervision within the RL training loop. Our core mechanism fissions each failed trajectory into a new training instance by augmenting it with diagnostic feedback from a fine-tuned Error Simulator, then resampling multiple recovery rollouts on-policy. This enables the model to learn from the precise errors it makes during exploration, rather than from static, pre-collected error cases. On BFCL v4 Multi-Turn, Fission-GRPO improves the error recovery rate of Qwen3-8B by 5.7% absolute and overall accuracy by 4.0% (from 42.75% to 46.75%), outperforming both RL baselines and specialized tool-use agents. The method further generalizes to TAU-Bench and TAU2-Bench, achieving leading results across most settings with gains up to +17.4%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够有效地调用工具，但在多轮执行过程中仍然容易出现问题：当工具调用出现错误时，小型模型往往会陷入重复的无效调用，而不是根据反馈进行修复和恢复。这种故障模式持续存在的原因是，当前的训练方法并没有明确教会模型如何从执行错误中恢复。特别是，标准的强化学习方法会将丰富的失败经验转化为稀疏的负面奖励，而预先收集的错误纠正数据集则无法适应策略不断变化的故障模式。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了Fission-GRPO框架，该框架能够将执行错误转化为在策略上的纠正监督，从而改进RL训练过程。我们的核心机制是通过使用经过训练的误差模拟器提供的诊断反馈，将每次失败的轨迹转化为新的训练实例，然后重新采样多个恢复策略。这样，模型就可以从探索过程中遇到的具体错误中学习，而不是从静态、预先收集的错误案例中学习。在BFCL v4多轮测试中，Fission-GRPO将Qwen3-8B的错误恢复率提高了5.7%，整体准确率也提高了4.0%（从42.75%提高到46.75%），其表现优于其他RL基准模型和专门的工具使用代理。该方法还适用于TAU-Bench和TAU2-Bench测试集，在大多数情况下都能取得优异成绩，提升幅度高达17.4%。

papers.title: DimABSA: Building Multilingual and Multidomain Datasets for Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
papers.title_zh: DimABSA：构建多语言、跨领域的数据集，以支持基于维度特征的情感分析研究
papers.authors: Lung-Hao Lee, Liang-Chih Yu, Natalia V Loukachevitch, Ilseyar Alimova, Alexander Panchenko, Tzu-Mi Lin, Zhe-Yu Xu, Jian-Yu Zhou, Guangmin Zheng, Jin Wang, Sharanya Awasthi, Jonas Becker, Jan Philip Wahle, Terry Ruas, Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad, Saif M. Mohammad
papers.abstract: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) focuses on extracting sentiment at a fine-grained aspect level and has been widely applied across real-world domains. However, existing ABSA research relies on coarse-grained categorical labels (e.g., positive, negative), which limits its ability to capture nuanced affective states. To address this limitation, we adopt a dimensional approach that represents sentiment with continuous valence–arousal (VA) scores, enabling fine-grained analysis at both the aspect and sentiment levels. To this end, we introduce DimABSA, the first multilingual, dimensional ABSA resource annotated with both traditional ABSA elements (aspect terms, aspect categories, and opinion terms) and newly introduced VA scores. This resource contains 76,958 aspect instances across 42,590 sentences, spanning six languages and four domains. We further introduce three subtasks that combine VA scores with different ABSA elements, providing a bridge from traditional ABSA to dimensional ABSA. Given that these subtasks involve both categorical and continuous outputs, we propose a new unified metric, continuous F1 (cF1), which incorporates VA prediction error into standard F1. We provide a comprehensive benchmark using both prompted and fine-tuned large language models across all subtasks. Our results show that DimABSA is a challenging benchmark and provides a foundation for advancing multilingual dimensional ABSA. We publicly released the DimABSA dataset, which was used for Track A of SemEval-2026 Task 3, attracting over 300 participants.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于方面的情感分析（Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis，简称ABSA）专注于在细粒度的方面层面提取情感信息，已被广泛应用于现实世界中的各种领域。然而，现有的ABSA研究依赖于粗粒度的分类标签（例如，积极、消极），这限制了其捕捉细微情感状态的能力。为了克服这一限制，我们采用了一种维度化的方法，用连续的情感价值-唤醒度得分来表示情感，从而能够在方面和情感两个层面上进行细致的分析。为此，我们提出了DimABSA这一多语言、维度化的ABSA资源，该资源同时包含了传统的ABSA元素（方面术语、方面类别和观点术语）以及新引入的VA得分。该资源包含76,958个方面实例，分布在42,590句话中，涉及六种语言和四个领域。我们还引入了三个子任务，这些子任务将VA得分与不同的ABSA元素结合起来，为从传统ABSA到维度化ABSA提供了桥梁。由于这些子任务既包含分类输出也包含连续输出，因此我们提出了一种新的统一指标——连续F1（continuous F1，简称cF1），它将VA预测误差纳入了标准F1指标中。我们提供了一个全面的基准测试，使用了各种提示方式和经过微调的大语言模型来完成所有子任务。我们的结果表明，DimABSA是一个具有挑战性的基准测试，它为推进多语言维度化ABSA的研究奠定了基础。我们已经公开了DimABSA数据集，该数据集被用于SemEval-2026任务的A赛道，吸引了超过300名参与者参与。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: CAP: Controllable Alignment Prompting for Unlearning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: CAP：可控制的对齐提示机制，用于在大型语言模型中实现“遗忘”操作
papers.authors: Zhaokun Wang, Jinyu Guo, Jingwen Pu, Hongli Pu, Meng Yang, Xunlei Chen, Jie Ou, Wenyi Li, Guangchun Luo, Wenhong Tian
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) trained on unfiltered corpora inherently risk retaining sensitive information, necessitating selective knowledge unlearning for regulatory compliance and ethical safety. However, existing parameter-modifying methods face fundamental limitations: high computational costs, uncontrollable forgetting boundaries, and strict dependency on model weight access. These constraints render them impractical for closed-source models, yet current non-invasive alternatives remain unsystematic and reliant on empirical experience. To address these challenges, we propose the Controllable Alignment Prompting for Unlearning (CAP) framework, an end-to-end prompt-driven unlearning paradigm. CAP decouples unlearning into a learnable prompt optimization process via reinforcement learning, where a prompt generator collaborates with the LLM to suppress target knowledge while preserving general capabilities selectively. This approach enables reversible knowledge restoration through prompt revocation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAP achieves precise, controllable unlearning without updating model parameters, establishing a dynamic alignment mechanism that overcomes the transferability limitations of prior methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 在未经过滤的语料库上训练的大语言模型（LLM）存在保留敏感信息的风险，因此需要进行有选择性的知识遗忘，以满足监管要求和伦理安全标准。然而，现有的参数修改方法存在根本性的局限性：计算成本过高、遗忘边界难以控制，且严重依赖模型权重的访问方式。这些限制使得这些方法不适用于闭源模型。此外，目前的非侵入式替代方案仍然缺乏系统性，且依赖于经验性判断。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了可控对齐提示遗忘框架（CAP），这是一种端到端的提示驱动遗忘机制。CAP通过将遗忘过程分解为一个可通过强化学习进行优化的提示优化过程来实现，其中提示生成器与LLM协作，在保留模型通用能力的同时选择性地抑制目标知识。这种方法可以通过撤销提示来实现知识的可逆恢复。大量实验表明，CAP能够在不更新模型参数的情况下实现精确且可控的遗忘，从而建立了一种动态对齐机制，克服了以往方法的可迁移性限制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GeoRC: A Benchmark for Geolocation Reasoning Chains
papers.title_zh: GeoRC：地理定位推理链的基准测试工具
papers.authors: Mohit Talreja, Joshua Diao, Jim James, Radu Casapu, Tejas Santanam, Ethan Mendes, Alan Ritter, Wei Xu, James Hays
papers.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are good at recognizing the global location of a photograph – their geolocation prediction accuracy rivals the best human experts. But many VLMs are startlingly bad at explaining which image evidence led to their prediction, even when their location prediction is correct. The reasoning chains produced by VLMs frequently hallucinate scene attributes to support their location prediction (e.g. phantom writing, imagined infrastructure, misidentified flora). In this paper, we introduce the first benchmark for geolocation reasoning chains. We focus on the global location prediction task in the popular GeoGuessr game which draws from Google Street View spanning more than 100 countries. We collaborate with expert GeoGuessr players, including the reigning world champion, to produce 800 “ground truth” reasoning chains for 500 query scenes. These expert reasoning chains address hundreds of different discriminative visual attributes such as license plate shape, architecture, and soil properties to name just a few. We evaluate LLM-as-a-judge and VLM-as-a-judge strategies for scoring VLM-generated reasoning chains against our expert reasoning chains and find that Qwen 3 LLM-as-a-judge correlates best with human scoring. Our benchmark reveals that while large, closed-source VLMs such as Gemini and GPT 5 rival human experts at prediction locations, they still lag behind human experts when it comes to producing auditable reasoning chains. Open weights VLMs such as Llama and Qwen catastrophically fail on our benchmark – they perform only slightly better than a baseline in which an LLM hallucinates a reasoning chain with oracle knowledge of the photo location but no visual information at all. We believe the gap between human experts and VLMs on this task points to VLM limitations at extracting fine-grained visual attributes from high resolution images. We open source our benchmark for the community to use.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在识别照片的全局位置方面表现出色——它们的地理位置预测准确性可与最优秀的人类专家相媲美。然而，许多视觉语言模型在解释是什么图像证据导致了它们的预测时表现得非常糟糕，即使它们的位置预测是正确的。视觉语言模型生成的推理链常常为了支持其位置预测而虚构场景属性（例如，虚假的文字、想象中的基础设施、误认的植物）。在本文中，我们提出了首个用于评估地理位置推理链的基准测试。我们专注于在流行的GeoGuessr游戏中的全局位置预测任务，该游戏基于谷歌街景数据，涵盖了100多个国家。我们与GeoGuessr游戏的顶尖玩家合作，为500个查询场景生成了800条“真实”推理链。这些专家生成的推理链涉及数百种不同的可区分视觉属性，如车牌形状、建筑风格以及土壤特性等。我们评估了使用LLM作为裁判和视觉语言模型作为裁判的策略，以比较视觉语言模型生成的推理链与我们专家生成的推理链的表现。结果表明，Qwen 3作为裁判的策略与人类评分结果最为吻合。我们的基准测试显示，虽然像Gemini和GPT 5这样的大型闭源视觉语言模型在预测位置方面可以与人类专家相媲美，但在生成可验证的推理链方面仍远远落后于人类专家。而像Llama和Qwen这样的开放权重视觉语言模型则表现糟糕——它们的表现仅略优于一种基线情况，即LLM在没有任何视觉信息的情况下，仅凭对照片位置的先验知识来生成推理链。我们认为，人类专家和视觉语言模型在这项任务上的差距表明，视觉语言模型在从高分辨率图像中提取细粒度视觉属性方面存在局限性。我们将我们的基准测试开源出来，供社区使用。

papers.title: SemCSE-Multi: Multifaceted and Decodable Embeddings for Aspect-Specific and Interpretable Scientific Domain Mapping
papers.title_zh: SemCSE-Multi：适用于特定方面且易于理解的嵌入式表示方法，能够实现可解释的科学领域映射
papers.authors: Marc Brinner, Sina Zarrieß
papers.abstract: We propose SemCSE-Multi, a novel unsupervised framework for generating multifaceted embeddings of scientific abstracts, evaluated in the domains of invasion biology and medicine. These embeddings capture distinct, individually specifiable aspects in isolation, thus enabling fine-grained and controllable similarity assessments as well as adaptive, user-driven visualizations of scientific domains. Our approach relies on an unsupervised procedure that produces aspect-specific summarizing sentences and trains embedding models to map semantically related summaries to nearby positions in the embedding space. We then distill these aspect-specific embedding capabilities into a unified embedding model that directly predicts multiple aspect embeddings from a scientific abstract in a single, efficient forward pass. In addition, we introduce an embedding decoding pipeline that decodes embeddings back into natural language descriptions of their associated aspects. Notably, we show that this decoding remains effective even for unoccupied regions in low-dimensional visualizations, thus offering vastly improved interpretability in user-centric settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了SemCSE-Multi这一新颖的无监督框架，用于生成科学摘要的多方面嵌入表示。该框架已在入侵生物学和医学领域得到了验证。这些嵌入表示能够分别捕捉到不同的、可单独描述的方面，从而实现了细粒度的、可控的相似性评估，以及自适应且由用户驱动的科学研究领域可视化。我们的方法依赖于一种无监督过程，该过程会生成针对特定方面的总结性句子，并训练嵌入模型将语义相关的摘要映射到嵌入空间中的相近位置。随后，我们将这些针对特定方面的嵌入能力整合到一个统一的嵌入模型中，该模型能够一次性、高效地从科学摘要中预测出多个方面的嵌入表示。此外，我们还引入了一种嵌入解码流程，可以将嵌入信息重新解码为与其相关方面的自然语言描述。值得注意的是，即使是在低维可视化中那些未被填充的区域，这种解码方式依然有效，因此为用户中心化的分析提供了显著的提升。

papers.title: Rendering Data Unlearnable by Exploiting LLM Alignment Mechanisms
papers.title_zh: 通过利用大语言模型的对齐机制使渲染数据变得不可学习
papers.authors: Ruihan Zhang, Jun Sun
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained on massive, heterogeneous text corpora, raising serious concerns about the unauthorised use of proprietary or personal data during model training. In this work, we address the problem of data protection against unwanted model learning in a realistic black-box setting. We propose Disclaimer Injection, a novel data-level defence that renders text unlearnable to LLMs. Rather than relying on model-side controls or explicit data removal, our approach exploits the models’ own alignment mechanisms: by injecting carefully designed alignment-triggering disclaimers to prevent effective learning. Through layer-wise analysis, we find that fine-tuning on such protected data induces persistent activation of alignment-related layers, causing alignment constraints to override task learning even on common inputs. Consequently, models trained on such data exhibit substantial and systematic performance degradation compared to standard fine-tuning. Our results identify alignment behaviour as a previously unexplored lever for data protection and, to our knowledge, present the first practical method for restricting data learnability at LLM scale without requiring access to or modification of the training pipeline.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地基于庞大的、异构的文本语料库进行训练，这引发了关于在模型训练过程中未经授权使用专有或个人数据的严重担忧。在这项研究中，我们针对在现实中的黑箱环境中防止数据被不必要的模型学习的问题进行了研究。我们提出了“免责声明注入”这一新颖的数据级防御机制，该机制使得文本对LLM来说变得无法被学习到。我们的方法并不依赖于模型端的控制或显式的数据删除，而是利用模型自身的对齐机制：通过注入精心设计的、能够触发对齐的免责声明来防止有效学习的发生。通过逐层分析，我们发现，在如此受保护的数据上进行微调会持续激活与对齐相关的层，导致对齐约束优先于任务学习，即使是在常见的输入情况下也是如此。因此，基于此类数据训练的模型与标准微调相比，表现出显著且系统的性能下降。我们的研究结果表明，对齐行为是一种之前未被充分探索的数据保护手段，而且据我们所知，这是第一种能够在LLM规模上限制数据可学习性的实用方法，而无需访问或修改训练流程。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CAR-bench: Evaluating the Consistency and Limit-Awareness of LLM Agents under Real-World Uncertainty
papers.title_zh: 汽车驾驶模拟：在现实不确定性条件下评估大型语言模型代理的一致性和极限感知能力
papers.authors: Johannes Kirmayr, Lukas Stappen, Elisabeth Andre
papers.abstract: Existing benchmarks for Large Language Model (LLM) agents focus on task completion under idealistic settings but overlook reliability in real-world, user-facing applications. In domains, such as in-car voice assistants, users often issue incomplete or ambiguous requests, creating intrinsic uncertainty that agents must manage through dialogue, tool use, and policy adherence. We introduce CAR-bench, a benchmark for evaluating consistency, uncertainty handling, and capability awareness in multi-turn, tool-using LLM agents in an in-car assistant domain. The environment features an LLM-simulated user, domain policies, and 58 interconnected tools spanning navigation, productivity, charging, and vehicle control. Beyond standard task completion, CAR-bench introduces Hallucination tasks that test agents’ limit-awareness under missing tools or information, and Disambiguation tasks that require resolving uncertainty through clarification or internal information gathering. Baseline results reveal large gaps between occasional and consistent success on all task types. Even frontier reasoning LLMs achieve less than 50% pass rate on Disambiguation tasks due to premature actions, and frequently violate policies or fabricate information to satisfy user requests in Hallucination tasks, underscoring the need for more reliable and self-aware LLM agents in real-world settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前针对大语言模型代理的评估基准主要集中在理想环境下的任务完成能力上，却忽视了在现实世界中的用户端应用中的可靠性问题。在诸如车载语音助手这样的领域里，用户常常提出不完整或模糊的请求，这就带来了内在的不确定性，而代理需要通过对话、工具使用以及政策遵守来应对这种不确定性。我们提出了CAR-bench这一基准测试，用于评估多轮对话中、使用工具的大语言模型代理在车载助手领域的连贯性、不确定性处理能力和自我认知能力。该环境包含了一个由大语言模型模拟的用户、相关领域政策，以及58种相互关联的工具，这些工具涵盖了导航、工作效率提升、充电以及车辆控制等方面。除了标准的任务完成能力之外，CAR-bench还引入了“幻觉任务”，以测试代理在缺少工具或信息情况下的极限认知能力；同时还有“消歧任务”，要求代理通过澄清或内部信息收集来解决不确定性问题。基线测试结果显示，在所有任务类型中，偶尔成功与持续成功之间存在巨大差距。即使是处于前沿水平的大语言模型，在消歧任务上的通过率也低于50%，这是因为它们会过早采取行动；而在幻觉任务中，它们经常违反政策或编造信息来满足用户的请求。这凸显了在现实环境中需要更可靠且具备自我认知能力的大语言模型代理。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Tiny Scales, Great Challenges: The Limits of Multimodal LLMs in Scale Recognition
papers.title_zh: 微小的规模，巨大的挑战：多模态大语言模型在大规模应用中的局限性
papers.authors: Jihang Jin, Ronghao Chen, Hao Zhang, Ziyan Liu, Huacan Wang, Qi Ye, Jingping Liu
papers.abstract: Visual scale recognition is a fundamental aspect for humans to perceive physical quantities in the real world, and it is crucial for enabling human-like intelligence in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing benchmarks typically focus on a single type of quantity (e.g., time) or a specific format (e.g., dials), lacking a comprehensive evaluation of scale recognition capabilities. To address these problems, we propose ScaleBench, a visual scale recognition benchmark built using images from COCO, Open Images, and Flickr, designed to comprehensively evaluate the scale recognition capabilities of MLLMs. To ensure high data quality, we develop detailed annotation guidelines and procedures, resulting in a total of 6,574 annotated samples. Based on this benchmark, we evaluate multiple closed-source and open-source MLLMs. Experimental results reveal that the best-performing model achieves only 42.60% accuracy, far lower than the 97.40% of humans. Furthermore, we conduct in-depth experimental analyses and provide future research directions. Our benchmark and implementation codes are available at https://github.com/Sonder-hang/ScaleBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉尺度识别是人类感知现实世界中物理量的一项基本能力，对于实现多模态大语言模型的人类式智能至关重要。然而，现有的评估基准通常只关注单一类型的量（如时间）或特定格式的数据（如时钟指针），缺乏对尺度识别能力的全面评估。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ScaleBench这一视觉尺度识别基准测试，该测试基于来自COCO、Open Images和Flickr的图像数据，旨在全面评估大语言模型的尺度识别能力。为了确保数据的高质量，我们制定了详细的注释指南和流程，最终获得了6,574个带注释的样本。基于这个基准测试，我们对多个闭源和开源的大语言模型进行了评估。实验结果表明，表现最好的模型准确率仅为42.60%，远低于人类的97.40%。此外，我们还进行了深入的实验分析，并指出了未来的研究方向。我们的基准测试和实现代码可以在https://github.com/Sonder-hang/ScaleBench下载。

papers.title: M^3-VQA: A Benchmark for Multimodal, Multi-Entity, Multi-Hop Visual Question Answering
papers.title_zh: M^3-VQA：一种适用于多模态、多实体、多跳视觉问答任务的基准数据集
papers.authors: Jiatong Ma, Longteng Guo, Yuchen Liu, Zijia Zhao, Dongze Hao, Xuanxu Lin, Jing Liu
papers.abstract: We present M^3-VQA, a novel knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (VQA) benchmark, to enhance the evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in fine-grained multimodal entity understanding and complex multi-hop reasoning. Unlike existing VQA datasets that focus on coarse-grained categories and simple reasoning over single entities, M^3-VQA introduces diverse multi-entity questions involving multiple distinct entities from both visual and textual sources. It requires models to perform both sequential and parallel multi-hop reasoning across multiple documents, supported by traceable, detailed evidence and a curated multimodal knowledge base. We evaluate 16 leading MLLMs under three settings: without external knowledge, with gold evidence, and with retrieval-augmented input. The poor results reveal significant challenges for MLLMs in knowledge acquisition and reasoning. Models perform poorly without external information but improve markedly when provided with precise evidence. Furthermore, reasoning-aware agentic retrieval surpasses heuristic methods, highlighting the importance of structured reasoning for complex multimodal understanding. M^3-VQA presents a more challenging evaluation for advancing the multimodal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/CASIA-IVA-Lab/M3VQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了M^3-VQA这一新的基于知识的视觉问答基准数据集，旨在提升多模态大语言模型在细粒度多模态实体理解和复杂多跳推理方面的性能。与那些专注于粗粒度类别和单一实体简单推理的现有视觉问答数据集不同，M^3-VQA引入了涉及来自视觉和文本来源的多个不同实体的多样化多实体问题。该数据集要求模型能够跨多个文档进行序列性和并行性多跳推理，并需要可追踪的详细证据以及经过精心整理的多模态知识库作为支持。我们对16个领先的多模态大语言模型进行了评估，评估条件包括：没有外部知识的情况、有黄金证据的情况，以及带有检索增强输入的情况。评估结果显示，多模态大语言模型在知识获取和推理方面存在显著挑战。在没有外部信息的情况下，这些模型的性能较差；而当提供精确的证据时，它们的性能则有了显著提升。此外，注重推理能力的智能检索方式优于启发式方法，这凸显了结构化推理对于复杂多模态理解的重要性。M^3-VQA为提升多模态大语言模型的推理能力提供了更具挑战性的评估手段。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/CASIA-IVA-Lab/M3VQA下载。

papers.title: From Selection to Refinement: Iterative Optimization for Instruction Data
papers.title_zh: 从筛选到优化：用于教学数据的迭代优化方法
papers.authors: Hang Hu, Ziyan Liu, Rujie Wen, Ruihui Hou, Xueyan Wu, Mu Zhang, Jianxing Yu, Tong Ruan, Jingping Liu
papers.abstract: Instruction tuning plays a crucial role in enhancing large language models (LLMs) to better understand complex user instructions. While various data selection and revision methods have been explored to optimize instruction tuning datasets, they face two main challenges: unreasonable pruning of potentially valuable low-quality data and the persistence of noise or semantic drift during revision. To address these issues, we propose a novel automated iterative framework for instruction data optimization. Our framework introduces Instruction Quality Differentiation to identify valuable high-quality and low-quality data across multiple dimensions. For low-quality data, we propose a Feedback-driven Iterative Refinement mechanism with an “evaluate-refine-review” process and design an Output Alignment module to improve data quality. Experiments on seven public benchmark datasets show that our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving 2.09% and 2.60% improvements on the Alpaca and Dolly datasets, respectively, with high data efficiency. Our code and data are available at the anonymous link https://github.com/surihuhang/From-Selection-to-Refinement–-Iterative-Optimization-for-Instruction-Data.
papers.abstract_zh: 指令调优在提升大语言模型对复杂用户指令的理解能力方面起着至关重要的作用。虽然已经探索了多种数据选择和修改方法来优化指令调优数据集，但这些方法面临两个主要挑战：可能具有价值的低质量数据的不合理剪除，以及修改过程中出现的噪声或语义漂移问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的自动化迭代框架，用于优化指令数据。我们的框架引入了指令质量区分技术，以从多个维度识别有价值的高质量和低质量数据。对于低质量数据，我们提出了一种基于反馈的迭代优化机制，该机制包含“评估-细化-审核”的过程，并设计了输出对齐模块来提高数据质量。在七个公共基准数据集上的实验表明，我们的框架优于现有最先进的方法，分别在Alpaca和Dolly数据集上实现了2.09%和2.60%的改进，同时具备较高的数据处理效率。我们的代码和数据可以在匿名链接https://github.com/surihuhang/From-Selection-to-Refinement–-Iterative-Optimization-for-Instruction-Data下载。

papers.title: VISTA: Verification In Sequential Turn-based Assessment
papers.title_zh: VISTA：基于顺序轮流的验证方式
papers.authors: Ashley Lewis, Andrew Perrault, Eric Fosler-Lussier, Michael White
papers.abstract: Hallucination—defined here as generated statements unsupported or contradicted by available evidence or conversational context—remains a major obstacle to using conversational AI systems in settings that demand factual reliability. Existing metrics evaluate isolated responses or treat unverifiable content as errors, limiting their use for multi-turn dialogue. We introduce VISTA (Verification In Sequential Turn-based Assessment), a framework for evaluating conversational factuality via claim-level verification and sequential consistency tracking. VISTA decomposes each turn into atomic claims, verifies them against trusted sources and dialogue history, and categorizes unverifiable statements (subjective, contradicted, lacking evidence, or abstaining). Across eight large language models and four dialogue factuality benchmarks (Ais, Begin, FaithDial, and Fade), VISTA substantially improves hallucination detection over FActScore and LLM-as-Judge baselines. Human evaluation confirms that VISTA’s decomposition improves annotator agreement and reveals inconsistencies in existing benchmarks. By modeling factuality as a dynamic property of conversation, VISTA offers a more transparent, human-aligned measure of truthfulness in dialogue systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉——在这里被定义为那些缺乏支持或与现有证据及对话上下文相矛盾的陈述——仍然是使对话式人工智能系统在需要事实准确性的场景中发挥作用的主要障碍。现有的评估方法通常只关注孤立的回应，或将无法验证的内容视为错误，这限制了它们在多轮对话中的应用。我们提出了VISTA（基于序列对话的验证框架），该框架通过针对声明级别的验证和序列一致性跟踪来评估对话中的事实准确性。VISTA将每一轮对话分解为独立的声明，并依据可信来源和对话历史来验证这些声明。对于无法验证的陈述，VISTA会将其归类为主观性、矛盾性、缺乏证据或中立性。在八个大语言模型和四个对话事实准确性基准测试（Ais、Begin、FaithDial和Fade）中，VISTA在幻觉检测方面显著优于FActScore和LLM作为评估器的基线方法。人工评估表明，VISTA的分解方式提高了注释者的一致性，并揭示了现有基准测试中存在的不一致之处。通过将事实准确性建模为对话的动态属性，VISTA提供了一种更透明、更符合人类认知的对话系统真实性衡量标准。

papers.title: Knowledge-to-Verification: Exploring RLVR for LLMs in Knowledge-Intensive Domains
papers.title_zh: 知识验证：探索在知识密集型领域中使用大语言模型进行验证的方法
papers.authors: Zhonghang Yuan, Zhefan Wang, Fang Hu, Zihong Chen, Jinzhe Li, Gang Li, Jie Ying, Huanjun Kong, Songyang Zhang, Nanqing Dong
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated promising potential to enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in domains such as mathematics and coding. However, its applications on knowledge-intensive domains have not been effectively explored due to the scarcity of high-quality verifiable data. Furthermore, current RLVR focuses solely on the correctness of final answers, leading to the limitations of flawed reasoning and sparse reward signals. In this work, we propose Knowledge-to-Verification (K2V), a framework that extends RLVR to knowledge-intensive domains through automated verifiable data synthesis, while enabling verification of the LLM’s reasoning process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that K2V enhances the reasoning of LLM in knowledge-intensive domains without significantly compromising the model’s general capabilities. This study also suggests that integrating automated data synthesis with reasoning verification is a promising direction to enhance model capabilities in these broader domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型在数学和编程等领域中的推理能力方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，由于高质量的可验证数据稀缺，其在知识密集型领域的应用尚未得到有效探索。此外，当前的RLVR仅关注最终答案的正确性，这导致了推理存在缺陷以及奖励信号稀疏的问题。在这项研究中，我们提出了知识到验证框架K2V，该框架通过自动化的可验证数据合成技术，将RLVR扩展到知识密集型领域，同时能够验证大语言模型的推理过程。大量实验表明，K2V能够在不显著损害模型整体能力的情况下，提升大语言模型在知识密集型领域的推理能力。本研究还指出，将自动化数据合成与推理验证相结合，是提升这些领域模型能力的有效途径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mem-Gallery: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Conversational Memory for MLLM Agents
papers.title_zh: Mem-Gallery：针对多模态长期对话记忆的评估方法，适用于MLLM代理
papers.authors: Yuanchen Bei, Tianxin Wei, Xuying Ning, Yanjun Zhao, Zhining Liu, Xiao Lin, Yada Zhu, Hendrik Hamann, Jingrui He, Hanghang Tong
papers.abstract: Long-term memory is a critical capability for multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents, particularly in conversational settings where information accumulates and evolves over time. However, existing benchmarks either evaluate multi-session memory in text-only conversations or assess multimodal understanding within localized contexts, failing to evaluate how multimodal memory is preserved, organized, and evolved across long-term conversational trajectories. Thus, we introduce Mem-Gallery, a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal long-term conversational memory in MLLM agents. Mem-Gallery features high-quality multi-session conversations grounded in both visual and textual information, with long interaction horizons and rich multimodal dependencies. Building on this dataset, we propose a systematic evaluation framework that assesses key memory capabilities along three functional dimensions: memory extraction and test-time adaptation, memory reasoning, and memory knowledge management. Extensive benchmarking across twelve memory systems reveals several key findings, highlighting the necessity of explicit multimodal information retention and memory organization, the persistent limitations in memory reasoning and knowledge management, as well as the efficiency bottleneck of current models. Our benchmark and dataset are available at https://github.com/YuanchenBei/Mem-Gallery.
papers.abstract_zh: 长期记忆是多模态大语言模型代理的一项关键能力，尤其是在对话场景中，信息会随着时间的推移而积累和演变。然而，现有的评估基准要么仅针对纯文本对话中的多会话记忆进行评估，要么只评估在局部上下文下的多模态理解能力，却未能评估多模态记忆如何在长期的对话过程中被保存、组织以及演变。因此，我们提出了Mem-Gallery这一新的评估基准，用于评估多模态长期对话记忆在MLLM代理中的表现。Mem-Gallery的特点是包含高质量的多会话对话，这些对话基于视觉和文本信息，具有较长的交互时间以及丰富的多模态依赖性。基于这个数据集，我们提出了一个系统化的评估框架，该框架从三个功能维度来评估关键的内存能力：记忆提取与测试时适应、记忆推理以及记忆知识管理。通过对十二种记忆系统的广泛评估，我们发现几个重要现象：需要明确的多模态信息保留与记忆组织机制；记忆推理和知识管理方面仍然存在局限性；同时，当前模型的效率也存在瓶颈。我们的评估基准和数据集可以在https://github.com/YuanchenBei/Mem-Gallery获取。

papers.title: HarDBench: A Benchmark for Draft-Based Co-Authoring Jailbreak Attacks for Safe Human–LLM Collaborative Writing
papers.title_zh: HarDBench：一种用于基于协作写作的越狱攻击的测试工具，旨在促进人类与大型语言模型之间的安全合作创作
papers.authors: EunTae Kim, Soomin Han, Buru Chang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as co-authors in collaborative writing, where users begin with rough drafts and rely on LLMs to complete, revise, and refine their content. However, this capability poses a serious safety risk: malicious users could jailbreak the models—filling incomplete drafts with dangerous content—to force them into generating harmful outputs. In this paper, we identify the vulnerability of current LLMs to such draft-based co-authoring jailbreak attacks and introduce HarDBench, a systematic benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness of LLMs against this emerging threat. HarDBench spans a range of high-risk domains—including Explosives, Drugs, Weapons, and Cyberattacks—and features prompts with realistic structure and domain-specific cues to assess the model susceptibility to harmful completions. To mitigate this risk, we introduce a safety-utility balanced alignment approach based on preference optimization, training models to refuse harmful completions while remaining helpful on benign drafts. Experimental results show that existing LLMs are highly vulnerable in co-authoring contexts and our alignment method significantly reduces harmful outputs without degrading performance on co-authoring capabilities. This presents a new paradigm for evaluating and aligning LLMs in human-LLM collaborative writing settings. Our new benchmark and dataset are available on our project page at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HarDBench_data-17E4.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在协作写作中被越来越多地用作共同作者。用户先开始撰写初稿，然后依靠语言模型来完成、修改和完善内容。然而，这种能力也带来了严重的安全风险：恶意用户可能会破解这些模型，用有害内容填充不完整的草稿，从而迫使模型生成有害的输出。在本文中，我们指出了当前语言模型在基于草稿的共同创作场景中的脆弱性，并引入了HarDBench这一系统性的基准测试工具，用于评估语言模型对这类威胁的抵御能力。HarDBench涵盖了包括爆炸物、药物、武器和网络攻击等高风险领域，其提示语具有真实的结构和特定领域的特征，以评估模型对有害完成的敏感性。为了降低这种风险，我们提出了一种基于偏好优化的安全与效用平衡对齐方法，训练模型在拒绝有害完成的同时，仍能对良性草稿进行有用的处理。实验结果表明，现有的语言模型在共同创作场景中非常脆弱，而我们的对齐方法能够显著减少有害输出的产生，同时不会降低共同创作能力。这为评估和对齐语言模型在人类与语言模型的协作写作环境中的表现提供了新的思路。我们的新基准测试和数据集可以在我们的项目页面上找到：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HarDBench_data-17E4
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mind Reader: Latent User Demand-Guided Content Optimization for Generative Search Engine
papers.title_zh: 读心者：基于潜在用户需求的内容优化技术，用于生成式搜索引擎
papers.authors: Tong Chen, JiaWei Guo, Yuxi Li, Baiming Chen, Houxing Ren, Zhang Zhiwei, Yunxiang Zhang, Hanyang Xia, Kun Liang, Zhaoran Fan
papers.abstract: Generative Search Engines (GSEs) have reshaped information retrieval, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) emerges to improve the content visibility in GSEs’ responses. Previous methods mainly rely on empirical strategies or query-dependent preferences of GSEs for content optimization. However, they remain limited in effectiveness as they overlook the latent user search demands in queries that drive content retrieval and response generation of GSEs. To address this, we propose Mind Reader, a novel GEO method to effectively improve the content visibility within the generated responses of GSEs through content optimization guided by the extracted latent demands of user search. Specifically, we propose a decomposition-recombination query augmentation module, which enriches the query with latent semantic information by decomposing it into diverse perspectives, capturing underlying semantic information, and recombining them into variants to support subsequent optimization. Then, we propose a reasoning coverage content optimization module. By optimizing content to cover critical reasoning information of GSEs, we align the content with the user search demands, effectively improving the content visibility. Extensive experiments on widely used GEO-Bench and our proposed PC-GEO show that our method significantly outperforms baselines and effectively improves content visibility (with up to 2.44x objective metrics and 1.23x subjective metrics on average).
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式搜索引擎已经彻底改变了信息检索的方式，而生成式优化技术则旨在提升内容在搜索引擎返回结果中的可见性。以往的方法主要依赖经验性策略或搜索引擎基于查询的偏好来进行内容优化，但这些方法在效果上仍然有限，因为它们忽略了用户查询中隐藏的搜索需求，而这些需求正是驱动搜索引擎进行内容检索和响应生成的关键因素。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了Mind Reader这一创新性的生成式优化方法。该方法通过利用用户搜索中提取出的潜在需求来指导内容优化，从而有效提升内容在搜索引擎返回结果中的可见性。具体来说，我们提出了一种分解-重组查询增强模块，该模块通过将查询分解为多个不同的视角，提取其中的潜在语义信息，然后将这些信息重新组合成不同的变体，以支持后续的优化过程。此外，我们还提出了一种推理覆盖型内容优化模块。通过优化内容以涵盖搜索引擎的关键推理信息，我们可以使内容更符合用户的搜索需求，从而有效提升内容的可见性。在广泛使用的GEO-Bench测试集以及我们提出的PC-GEO测试集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著优于传统方法，能够有效提升内容的可见性（平均而言，目标指标提升了2.44倍，主观指标提升了1.23倍）。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Defense: Adaptive and Controllable Jailbreak Prevention for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于检索增强的防御机制：为大型语言模型提供自适应且可控制的越狱预防方案
papers.authors: Guangyu Yang, Jinghong Chen, Jingbiao Mei, Weizhe Lin, Bill Byrne
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, which attempt to elicit harmful responses from LLMs. The evolving nature and diversity of these attacks pose many challenges for defense systems, including (1) adaptation to counter emerging attack strategies without costly retraining, and (2) control of the trade-off between safety and utility. To address these challenges, we propose Retrieval-Augmented Defense (RAD), a novel framework for jailbreak detection that incorporates a database of known attack examples into Retrieval-Augmented Generation, which is used to infer the underlying, malicious user query and jailbreak strategy used to attack the system. RAD enables training-free updates for newly discovered jailbreak strategies and provides a mechanism to balance safety and utility. Experiments on StrongREJECT show that RAD substantially reduces the effectiveness of strong jailbreak attacks such as PAP and PAIR while maintaining low rejection rates for benign queries. We propose a novel evaluation scheme and show that RAD achieves a robust safety-utility trade-off across a range of operating points in a controllable manner.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型仍然容易受到越狱攻击的威胁，这些攻击试图从语言模型中获取有害的响应。这些攻击的复杂性和多样性给防御系统带来了诸多挑战，其中包括：1）在不进行昂贵重新训练的情况下，适应新的攻击策略；2）在安全性和实用性之间找到平衡。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了检索增强防御机制——一种用于检测越狱攻击的新框架。该框架将已知的攻击示例纳入检索增强生成过程中，从而推断出用于攻击系统的恶意用户查询和越狱策略。这种机制使得新发现的越狱策略可以无需训练即可更新，同时还能实现安全性和实用性的平衡。在StrongREJECT上的实验表明，该框架能够显著降低诸如PAP和PAIR等强越狱攻击的效果，同时仍能保持对良性查询的低拒绝率。我们还提出了一种新的评估方案，并证明该框架能够在不同的运行条件下以可控的方式实现安全性和实用性的平衡。

papers.title: CNSL-bench: Benchmarking the Sign Language Understanding Capabilities of MLLMs on Chinese National Sign Language
papers.title_zh: CNSL-bench：在中文国家手语上评估大型语言模型理解手语的能力
papers.authors: Rui Zhao, Xuewen Zhong, Xiaoyun Zheng, Jinsong Su, Yidong Chen
papers.abstract: Sign language research has achieved significant progress due to the advances in large language models (LLMs). However, the intrinsic ability of LLMs to understand sign language, especially in multimodal contexts, remains underexplored. To address this limitation, we introduce \textbf{CNSL-bench}, the first comprehensive \textbf{C}hinese \textbf{N}ational \textbf{S}ign \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{bench}mark designed for evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in sign language understanding. The proposed CNSL-bench is characterized by: 1) Authoritative grounding, as it is anchored to the officially standardized \textit{National Common Sign Language Dictionary}, mitigating ambiguity from regional or non-canonical variants and ensuring consistent semantic definitions; 2) Multimodal coverage, providing aligned textual descriptions, illustrative images, and sign language videos; and 3) Articulatory diversity, supporting fine-grained analysis across key manual articulatory forms, including air-writing, finger-spelling, and the Chinese manual-alphabet. Using CNSL-bench, we extensively evaluate 21 open-source and proprietary up-to-date MLLMs. Our results reveal that, despite recent advances in multimodal modeling, current MLLMs remain substantially inferior to human performance, exhibiting systematic disparities across input modalities and manual articulatory forms. Additional diagnostic analyses suggest that several performance limitations persist beyond improvements in reasoning and that instruction-following robustness varies substantially across models.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于大语言模型（LLM）的进步，手语研究取得了显著进展。然而，LLM理解手语的能力，尤其是在多模态环境中的能力，仍然没有得到充分探索。为了克服这一限制，我们推出了**CNSL-bench**，这是首个用于评估多模态大语言模型在手语理解方面的综合性**中国国家手语基准测试**。该基准测试的特点包括：1）权威基础，因为它以官方标准化的《中国国家通用手语词典》为依据，避免了因地区差异或非标准变体导致的歧义，并确保语义定义的一致性；2）多模态覆盖，提供一致的文本描述、示例图片以及手语视频；3）发音多样性，能够细致分析关键的手动发音形式，包括空气书写、手指拼写以及中文手写字母。通过CNSL-bench，我们对21个开源和专有的最新大语言模型进行了广泛评估。我们的结果显示，尽管在多模态建模方面取得了一些进展，但当前的大语言模型仍然远远落后于人类的表现，不同输入模式和手动发音形式之间存在系统性差异。此外，进一步的分析表明，即使在推理能力方面有所改进，一些性能限制仍然存在，而且不同模型的指令遵循能力也存在显著差异。

papers.title: Thinking in Schemas: Robust Syllogistic Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 基于模式化的思考：在大型语言模型中实现稳健的推理能力
papers.authors: Federico Ranaldi, Leonardo Ranaldi, Fabio Massimo Zanzotto, Shay B Cohen
papers.abstract: LLMs often mistake what sounds true for what is formally valid. This limitation is especially evident in syllogistic reasoning, where plausible arguments can lead models to endorse conclusions that are logically invalid, a phenomenon known as Content Effect (CE).We present Boethius, a schema-guided framework for syllogistic reasoning that disentangles semantic plausibility from logical validity. Boethius adopts an auditable, quasi-formal reasoning process with two complementary stages: a Schema Module, which deduces the underlying logical form by analysing the formal structure of the premises, and an Instantiation Module, which instantiates this form over the concrete argument and evaluates validity independently of content-level semantics.Our results show that Boethius consistently outperforms existing approaches, improving syllogistic reasoning accuracy while substantially reducing CE. These gains hold for both large models in a pure in-context learning setting and smaller models trained via schema-guided trajectories using supervised fine-tuning and optimisation-based refinement.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型常常将看似正确的内容误认为形式上的有效内容。这种局限性在三段论推理中尤为明显，因为合理的论证可能会导致模型得出逻辑上无效的结论，这种现象被称为“内容效应”。我们提出了Boethius框架，这是一种基于模式引导的三段论推理方法，它能够将语义上的合理性与逻辑有效性分离开来。Boethius采用了一种可验证的、近似形式化的推理过程，该过程包含两个互补的阶段：一个模式模块，通过分析前提的形式结构来推导其背后的逻辑形式；另一个实例化模块，该模块将这一形式应用于具体的论证中，并独立于内容层面的语义来评估其有效性。我们的研究表明，Boethius在提高三段论推理准确性方面表现优于现有方法，同时显著降低了内容效应。这些优势不仅适用于纯上下文学习环境中的大型模型，也适用于通过模式引导的路径进行训练的小型模型，这些模型采用监督微调和优化技术进行优化。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Amadeus: Autoregressive Model with Bidirectional Attribute Modelling for Symbolic Music
papers.title_zh: 阿马德乌斯：一种适用于符号音乐的双向属性建模的自回归模型
papers.authors: Hongju Su, Ke Li, Lan Yang, Honggang Zhang, Yi-Zhe Song
papers.abstract: Existing state-of-the-art symbolic music generation models represent symbolic music as a sequence of attribute tokens with fixed unidirectional dependencies. However, from the perspective of music theory, the attributes of a musical note are inherently a set rather than a sequence. Building on this insight, we propose Amadeus, a novel symbolic music generation framework that adopts a two-level architecture: an autoregressive model for note sequences and a bidirectional discrete diffusion model for note attributes. This design enables flexible attribute control and adjustable decoding speed during inference. To further enhance sequential modeling, we introduce the Conditional Information Enhancement Module (CIEM). We also constructed AMD (Amadeus MIDI Dataset)—the largest open-source symbolic music dataset to date—supporting both pre-training and fine-tuning. We trained two models of different scales, Amadeus and Amadeus-M, and conducted extensive experiments, demonstrating substantial improvements over state-of-the-art methods across both objective and subjective metrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的先进符号音乐生成模型将符号音乐表示为具有固定单向依赖关系的属性序列。然而，从音乐理论的角度来看，音符的属性本质上是一个集合，而非序列。基于这一洞察，我们提出了Amadeus这一新颖的符号音乐生成框架。该框架采用两级架构：一个用于音符序列的自回归模型，以及一个用于音符属性的双向离散扩散模型。这种设计使得属性控制更加灵活，并且在推理过程中可以调节解码速度。为了进一步增强序列建模能力，我们引入了条件信息增强模块（CIEM）。我们还构建了AMD（Amadeus MIDI数据集）——迄今为止最大的开源符号音乐数据集，支持预训练和微调两种模式。我们训练了两个不同规模的模型：Amadeus和Amadeus-M，并进行了广泛的实验验证，结果表明，与现有最先进的方法相比，我们的方法在客观和主观指标上均取得了显著的改进。

papers.title: FedMental: Evaluating Federated Learning for Mental Health Detection from Social Media Data
papers.title_zh: FedMental：评估联邦学习在从社交媒体数据中提取心理健康相关信息方面的应用效果
papers.authors: Nuredin Ali Abdelkadir, Anjali Ratnam, Zeerak Talat, Stevie Chancellor
papers.abstract: Social media text data are often used to train Machine Learning (ML) models to identify users exhibiting high-risk mental health behaviors. However, sharing this sensitive data poses privacy risks and limits the growth of benchmark datasets. We comprehensively evaluate whether privacy-preserving ML techniques can enable safer data sharing while preserving performance. Specifically, we apply federatedlearning (FL) and Differentially Private FL for two widely-studied mental health prediction tasks: depression detection on X (Twitter) and suicide crisis detection on Reddit. We simulate realistic data-sharing scenarios by treating each user as a client in a non-IID setting, evaluating across different client fractions, aggregation strategies, and privacy budgets. While FL achieves comparable performance to centralized training (centralized 𝐹 1 = 85.63; best FL model 𝐹 1 = 83.16) on depression identification, we find that Differentially Private FL has a large performance-privacy trade-off (up to 𝐹 1 = 27.01 drop) even with low levels of noise (𝜖 = 50). This is due to the distortion of highly informative yet sparse mental health linguistic markers related to mental health, like health topics and emotion words. This research empirically demonstrates the potential and limitations of current privacy preservation techniques for mental health inference tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体上的文本数据常被用于训练机器学习模型，以识别表现出高风险心理健康行为的用户。然而，分享这类敏感数据会带来隐私风险，并限制基准数据集的发展。我们全面评估了是否可以通过保护隐私的机器学习技术来实现更安全的数据共享，同时保持良好的性能。具体来说，我们对两种被广泛研究的心理健康预测任务应用了联邦学习技术和差分隐私联邦学习技术：在Twitter上检测抑郁症，以及在Reddit上检测自杀危机。我们通过将每个用户视为非独立同分布设置中的客户端来模拟现实的数据共享场景，并评估不同的客户端比例、聚合策略和隐私预算下的性能。虽然联邦学习技术在抑郁症识别方面的性能与集中式训练相当（集中式𝐹1=85.63；最佳联邦学习模型𝐹1=83.16），但我们发现，即使在噪声水平较低的情况下（𝜖=50），差分隐私联邦学习的性能与隐私之间存在较大的权衡（性能下降幅度高达𝐹1=27.01）。这一情况是由于与心理健康相关的高度信息性但稀疏的心理健康语言标记受到了扭曲，比如健康主题和情绪词汇。这项研究实证展示了当前用于心理健康推断任务的隐私保护技术的潜在优势和局限性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Edit-Aware Reward Modeling for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction
papers.title_zh: 基于编辑意识的汉语语法错误纠正奖励模型
papers.authors: Yilin Li, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: While large language models have achieved remarkable success in various natural language processing tasks, their potential in grammatical error correction remains underexplored. Recent work has applied reinforcement learning with rule-based rewards to CGEC, but these approaches rely on coarse-grained binary signals (exact match or not) that fail to capture fine-grained quality distinctions among correction candidates. In this paper, we propose Edit-Aware Reward Model (EARM), a novel reward modeling framework that explicitly incorporates edit-awareness into preference learning for CGEC. EARM introduces a dual-granularity training objective that jointly optimizes sentence-level and token-level weighted Bradley-Terry ranking losses, where edit tokens receive higher importance weights. When integrated with GRPO, our approach achieves 61.29/63.08 on FCGEC/NaCGEC (single output), and 65.04/64.59 with best-of-16 reranking, surpassing previous best by 5.41 and 1.80 points. Extensive experiments demonstrate that learned edit-aware rewards significantly outperform rule-based alternatives for CGEC preference optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在各类自然语言处理任务中取得了显著成就，但其在语法错误纠正方面的潜力尚未得到充分探索。近期的一些研究采用了基于强化学习的规则式奖励机制来处理CGEC问题，但这些方法依赖于粗略的二元信号（是否完全匹配），无法捕捉到不同修正选项之间的细微质量差异。在本文中，我们提出了Edit-Aware Reward Model（EARM）这一新颖的奖励建模框架，该框架将编辑意识明确地融入了CGEC的偏好学习过程中。EARM引入了一种双粒度训练目标，同时优化句子级和词元级的加权Bradley-Terry排名损失，其中涉及编辑操作的词元被赋予了更高的权重。当与GRPO结合使用时，我们的方法在FCGEEC/NaGEEC（单输出）任务上取得了61.29/63.08的成绩，而在16次重新排序实验中则达到了65.04/64.59的成绩，分别比之前的最佳成绩高出5.41点和1.80点。大量实验表明，这种基于编辑意识的奖励方式在CGEC偏好优化方面明显优于基于规则的替代方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GenPT: Beyond Self-Report for Reliable LLM Psychometrics via Generative Projective Testing
papers.title_zh: GenPT：通过生成性投射测试实现可靠的大型语言模型心理测量——超越单一自我报告方式
papers.authors: Ming Wang, Shuang Wu, Bixuan Wang, Lu Lin, Yuxin Chen, Xiaocui Yang, Daling Wang, Shi Feng, Yifei Zhang, Yufan Sun
papers.abstract: Self-report questionnaires remain the default tool for probing the psychological characteristics of Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet classical instruments (BFI, BDI, MBTI, BSS) inherit three well-known threats under LLMs: contamination from training corpora, directional bias under social-desirability framing, and limited responsiveness to context beyond the item text. We ask whether a projective paradigm can be adapted into a usable psychometric tool for LLM agents. We introduce GenPT (Generative Projective Testing), which reformulates TAT, Rorschach, and SCT with newly generated stimuli and organises assessment as a three-stage pipeline (Behavior Collection \to Interpretation \to Diagnosis) grounded in SCORS-G and a Simplified Rorschach Analysis System. On personality traits (Big Five, MBTI) and mental-health risks (depression, suicide ideation), questionnaires exhibit systematic directional shifts under social-desirability framing, most strongly on suicide ideation, whereas GenPT’s collected behavioral patterns stay near the symmetric baseline; under a longitudinal counselling context, GenPT-based depression assessment shifts by roughly an order of magnitude more than its questionnaire counterpart. Questionnaires remain competitive on clean-persona trait tasks where items align lexically with the persona description. Overall, GenPT complements rather than replaces self-report when contamination resistance, bias asymmetry, and context sensitivity matter. Code and stimuli: https://github.com/sci-m-wang/GenPT.
papers.abstract_zh: 自我报告问卷仍然是探究大语言模型代理心理特征的默认工具。然而，传统的测量工具（如BFI、BDI、MBTI、BSS）在大语言模型环境下面临三大挑战：训练语料库的污染效应、社会期望框架下的方向性偏差，以及对于文本之外情境的响应有限。我们探讨是否可以将投射式测试方法改编成适用于大语言模型代理的心理测量工具。我们提出了GenPT这一方法，它利用新生成的刺激材料对TAT、罗夏墨迹测试和SCT进行了重新设计，并将评估过程分为三个阶段：行为收集→解释→诊断，这些步骤基于SCORS-G和简化的罗夏墨迹分析系统。在人格特质（五大因素模型、MBTI）和心理健康风险（抑郁、自杀念头）方面，问卷调查结果显示出在社会期望框架下明显的方向性变化，尤其是在自杀念头上表现得尤为明显。而GenPT所收集的行为模式则保持接近对称的基线水平。在长期咨询背景下，基于GenPT的抑郁评估结果显示出比传统问卷高出一个数量级的变化幅度。在涉及清洁人物格任务的测试中，问卷仍然具有竞争力，因为问卷中的项目在词汇上与人物格描述高度一致。总体而言，当需要抵抗污染效应、避免偏见不对称以及考虑情境敏感性时，GenPT能够很好地补充而非替代自我报告问卷的使用。代码和刺激材料可在此处获取：https://github.com/sci-m-wang/GenPT
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Still Between Us? Evaluating and Improving Voice Assistant Robustness to Third-Party Interruptions
papers.title_zh: 仍在“我们之间”？评估并提升语音助手对第三方干扰的鲁棒性
papers.authors: Dongwook Lee, Eunwoo Song, Che Hyun Lee, Heeseung Kim, Sungroh Yoon
papers.abstract: While recent Spoken Language Models (SLMs) have been actively deployed in real-world scenarios, they lack the capability to discern Third-Party Interruptions (TPI) from the primary user’s ongoing flow, leaving them vulnerable to contextual failures. To bridge this gap, we introduce TPI-Train, a dataset of 88K instances designed with speaker-aware hard negatives to enforce acoustic cue prioritization for interruption handling, and TPI-Bench, a comprehensive evaluation framework designed to rigorously measure the interruption-handling strategy and precise speaker discrimination in deceptive contexts. Experiments demonstrate that our dataset design mitigates semantic shortcut learning—a critical pitfall where models exploit semantic context while neglecting acoustic signals essential for discerning speaker changes. We believe our work establishes a foundational resource for overcoming text-dominated unimodal reliance in SLMs, paving the way for more robust multi-party spoken interaction. The code for the framework is publicly available at https://tpi-va.github.io
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然最近的口语模型已经在现实场景中得到广泛应用，但它们缺乏识别第三方干扰的能力，无法区分主要用户的持续语音流中的干扰因素，因此容易受到上下文因素的影响而失效。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了TPI-Train数据集，该数据集包含8.8万个实例，其中包含了针对说话者感知的负面样本，以强化对干扰处理的声学信号优先级判断能力。此外，我们还开发了TPI-Bench评估框架，用于严格评估干扰处理策略以及在欺骗性情境下的精确说话者识别能力。实验表明，我们的数据集设计能够避免语义捷径学习的问题——这是模型利用语义上下文而忽略对识别说话者变化至关重要的声学信号的常见缺陷。我们相信，我们的工作为克服口语模型中以文本为主的单模态依赖问题提供了基础资源，为更强大的多主体口语交互奠定了基础。该框架的源代码可以在https://tpi-va.github.io获取。

papers.title: Learning to Conceal Risk: Controllable Multi-turn Red Teaming for LLMs in the Financial Domain
papers.title_zh: 学会隐藏风险：适用于金融领域的大型语言模型的可控多轮式攻击策略
papers.authors: Gang Cheng, Haibo Jin, Wenbin Zhang, Haohan Wang, Jun Zhuang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in finance, where unsafe behavior can lead to serious regulatory risks. However, most red-teaming research focuses on overtly harmful content and overlooks attacks that appear legitimate on the surface yet induce regulatory-violating responses. We address this gap by introducing a controllable black-box multi-turn risk-concealed redteaming framework (CoRT) that progressively conceals surface-level risk while exploiting regulatory-violating behaviors. CoRT contains two key components: (i) a Risk Concealment Attacker (RCA) that generates multiturn prompts via iterative refinement, and (ii) a Risk Concealment Controller (RCC) that predicts a turn-level Risk Concealment Score (RCS) to steer RCA’s follow-up style. We also build a domain-specific benchmark, FinRisk-Bench, with 522 instructions spanning six financial risk categories. Experiments on nine widely used LLMs show that CoRT (RCA) achieves 93.19% average attack success rate (ASR), and CoRT (RCA+RCC) further improves the average ASR to 95.00%. Our code and FinRisk-Bench are available at https://github.com/gcheng128/CoRT.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在金融领域得到了广泛应用，但不当行为可能会带来严重的监管风险。然而，大多数关于“红团队”的研究都集中在那些明显有害的内容上，而忽视了那些表面上看似合法但实际上会引发违反监管规定的行为的攻击。我们为了解决这个问题，提出了一种可控的、能够逐步隐藏表面风险的红团队框架——CoRT。CoRT包含两个关键组件：(i) 风险隐藏攻击者，它通过迭代优化生成多轮提示；(ii) 风险隐藏控制器，它预测每轮提示的风险隐藏得分，以指导攻击者的后续行为。我们还构建了一个针对特定领域的基准测试平台FinRisk-Bench，该测试平台包含了522条指令，涵盖了六个金融风险类别。在九种常用的语言模型上进行实验后，我们发现CoRT（仅包含风险隐藏攻击者）的平均攻击成功率达到了93.19%，而CoRT（包含风险隐藏攻击者和风险隐藏控制器）的平均攻击成功率则提升到了95.00%。我们的代码和FinRisk-Bench可以在https://github.com/gcheng128/CoRT下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
