papers.title: Beyond Static Alignment: Adaptive Arbitration for Semantic Incongruence in Semi-Supervised Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.title_zh: 超越静态对齐：用于半监督多模态情感分析中语义不一致问题的自适应仲裁机制
papers.authors: Huicong Li, Xiangbo Ji, Wei Wu
papers.abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis is fundamentally challenged by semantic incongruence, where ambiguous visual signals often conflict with explicit textual cues. In semi-supervised scenarios, naively fusing such noisy features contaminates the joint representation, while conventional static alignment strategies fail to effectively arbitrate conflicting modalities in this task, leading to error reinforcement during self-training. To this end, we propose a novel Adaptive Arbitration for Semantic Incongruence (A2SI) framework for semi-supervised multimodal sentiment analysis, which emphasizes stable cross-modal representations and reliable supervision. Specifically, we first constrain unreliable visual representations by leveraging the reliable textual modality as an anchor to align divergent embeddings and reduce representation noise. Based on this, we further consider the reliability of supervision signals and calibrate pseudo-labels by adaptively weighting evidentiary confidence from heterogeneous views. Finally, to prevent error accumulation caused by unreliable samples, we introduce a progressive arbitration mechanism that verifies pseudo-labeled data from dual perspectives, enabling the model to dynamically balance sample diversity and label purity throughout self-training. Extensive experiments on the MVSA-Single and MVSA-Multiple datasets demonstrate that A2SI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods under label-limited settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态情感分析面临着语义不一致性的问题，即模糊的视觉信号常常与明确的文本线索产生冲突。在半监督场景中，简单地融合这些噪声特征会污染联合表示，而传统的静态对齐策略无法有效处理这种冲突的模式，导致在自训练过程中错误不断累积。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的自适应语义不一致性仲裁框架——A2SI，该框架适用于半监督多模态情感分析，强调稳定的跨模态表示和可靠的监督机制。具体来说，我们首先通过利用可靠的文本信息作为锚点来约束不可靠的视觉表示，从而减少表示噪声。在此基础上，我们还考虑了监督信号的可靠性，并通过自适应地加权来自不同视角的证据置信度来校准伪标签。最后，为了防止因不可靠样本导致的错误累积，我们引入了一种渐进式仲裁机制，该机制从两个角度验证伪标签数据，使模型能够在自训练过程中动态平衡样本多样性和标签纯度。在MVSA-Single和MVSA-Multiple数据集上的广泛实验表明，A2SI在标签有限的情况下始终优于现有方法。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: LLM Beliefs Are in Their Heads
papers.title_zh: 大语言模型的信念存在于其注意力头中
papers.authors: Alessandro Corona Mendozza, Anders Søgaard
papers.abstract: We investigate belief-like representations in decoder-only autoregressive LLMs using linear controlled probes on residual stream activations and single attention heads. Following Herrmann and Levinstein’s (2025) criteria (Accuracy, Use, Coherence, and Uniformity) we find that large models exhibit strong truth sensitivity (Accuracy), and steering activations along probe directions reliably changes downstream behavior (Use). Coherence, measured via calibrated probes and cross-dataset probing, is moderate across models, while training on diverse data yields domain-consistent truth directions (Uniformity). The results are particularly encouraging at the head level and align with some standard philosophical accounts of belief, e.g., minimal functionalism, supporting the view that LLMs can maintain propositional attitudes under such theoretical frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了仅由解码器控制的自回归大语言模型中的信念式表征，通过线性控制探针来检测残差流的激活情况以及单个注意力头的表现。根据Herrmann和Levinstein在2025年提出的标准（准确性、实用性、连贯性以及一致性），我们发现大型模型具有强烈的真实性敏感性（准确性），并且沿着探针方向进行操控能够可靠地改变下游行为（实用性）。通过校准的探针和跨数据集测试来评估的连贯性指标，在不同模型中表现适中；而使用多样化数据进行训练则能够产生与领域一致的真实性方向（一致性）。这些结果在头部层面尤为令人鼓舞，且与一些关于信念的标准哲学观点相一致，例如最小功能主义。这些结果表明，在这些理论框架下，大语言模型能够维持命题性态度。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ProactiveEval: A Unified Evaluation Framework for Proactive Dialogue Agents
papers.title_zh: ProactiveEval：一种适用于主动对话代理的统一评估框架
papers.authors: Tianjian Liu, Fanqi Wan, Jiajian Guo, Xiaojun Quan
papers.abstract: Proactive dialogue has emerged as a critical and challenging research problem in advancing large language models (LLMs). Existing works predominantly focus on domain-specific or task-oriented scenarios, which leads to fragmented evaluations and limits the comprehensive exploration of models’ proactive dialogue abilities. In this work, we propose ProactiveEval, a unified framework for evaluating proactive dialogue capabilities of LLMs. This framework decomposes proactive dialogue into target planning and dialogue guidance, establishing evaluation metrics across various domains. Moreover, it also enables the automatic generation of diverse and challenging evaluation data. Based on the proposed framework, we develop 328 evaluation environments spanning 6 distinct domains. Through experiments with 22 different types of LLMs, we show that DeepSeek-R1 and Claude-3.7-Sonnet exhibit exceptional performance on target planning and dialogue guidance tasks, respectively. Finally, we investigate how reasoning capabilities influence proactive behaviors and discuss their implications for future model development. Our code and data are available at the https://github.com/liutj9/ProactiveEval.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动式对话已成为推动大语言模型发展的一个关键且具有挑战性的研究课题。现有的研究主要集中在特定领域或任务导向的场景上，这导致了评估的碎片化，也限制了人们对模型主动式对话能力的全面探索。在这项研究中，我们提出了ProactiveEval这一统一框架，用于评估大语言模型的主动式对话能力。该框架将主动式对话分解为目标规划和对话引导两个环节，并建立了适用于不同领域的评估指标。此外，该框架还能自动生成多样化且具有挑战性的评估数据。基于这一框架，我们开发了涵盖6个不同领域的328个评估环境。通过对22种不同类型的大语言模型的实验分析，我们发现DeepSeek-R1和Claude-3.7-Sonnet在目标规划和对话引导任务上分别表现出卓越的性能。最后，我们研究了推理能力对主动式行为的影响，并讨论了这些发现对未来模型开发的意义。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/liutj9/ProactiveEval下载。

papers.title: The Visual Iconicity Challenge: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Sign Language Form–Meaning Mapping
papers.title_zh: 视觉图标性挑战：在手语形式-意义映射方面评估视觉语言模型的效果
papers.authors: Onur Keleş, Asli Ozyurek, Gerardo Ortega, Kadir Gökgöz, Esam Ghaleb
papers.abstract: Iconicity, the resemblance between linguistic form and meaning, is pervasive in sign languages, offering a natural testbed for visual grounding in vision–language models (VLMs). We introduce the Visual Iconicity Challenge, a video-based benchmark that adapts psycholinguistic measures to evaluate VLMs on three tasks: (i) phonological sign-form prediction, (ii) transparency (inferring meaning from visual form), and (iii) graded iconicity ratings. We assess 17 state-of-the-art VLMs in zero- and few-shot settings on Sign Language of the Netherlands and compare them to human baselines. VLMs mirror human phonological difficulty patterns (e.g., handshape harder than location) and achieve moderate to strong alignment with human iconicity ratings. However, they still fail to infer lexical meaning from visual form alone and show a systematic object-based bias that inverts the human preference for action-based signs. Crucially, models with stronger phonological form prediction correlate better with human iconicity judgments, indicating shared sensitivity to visually grounded structure. Our findings validate these diagnostic tasks, show that explicit reasoning narrows the open-to-closed-model calibration gap, and motivate human-centric signals for modelling iconicity in multimodal models.
papers.abstract_zh: 符号性，即语言形式与意义之间的相似性，在手语中非常普遍，这为视觉基础在视觉-语言模型中的应用提供了一个天然的测试平台。我们提出了“视觉符号性挑战”这一基于视频的基准测试，该测试采用心理语言学的方法，对三种任务进行评估：一是语音符号形式的预测；二是透明度（从视觉形式推断意义）；三是符号性的分级评分。我们在荷兰手语的零样本和少量样本情况下，对17种最先进的视觉语言模型进行了评估，并将它们与人类基线模型进行了比较。这些视觉语言模型能够反映人类的语音难度模式（例如，手部形状的重要性高于位置），并且与人类的符号性评分有中等到强的一致性。然而，它们仍然无法仅通过视觉形式来推断词汇意义，并且表现出一种系统性的对象偏好倾向，这与人类对动作型手势的偏好相反。重要的是，那些在语音形式预测方面表现更出色的模型，其与人类符号性判断的相关性更高，这表明它们在对视觉基础结构的感知上具有共同的特点。我们的研究结果验证了这些诊断任务的有效性，表明明确的推理能够缩小开式-闭式模型之间的差距，并为在多模态模型中建模符号性提供了以人类为中心的信号。

papers.title: From Competition to Synergy: Unlocking Reinforcement Learning for Subject-Driven Image Generation
papers.title_zh: 从竞争到协同效应：解锁基于主体驱动的图像生成强化学习技术
papers.authors: Ziwei Huang, Ying Shu, Fanghao, Quanyu Long, Wenya Wang, Qiushi Guo, Tiezheng Ge, Leilei Gan
papers.abstract: Subject-driven image generation models face a fundamental trade-off between identity preservation (fidelity) and prompt adherence (editability). While online reinforcement learning (RL), specifically GPRO, offers a promising solution, we find that a naive application of GRPO leads to competitive degradation, as the simple linear aggregation of rewards with static weights causes conflicting gradient signals and a misalignment with the temporal dynamics of the diffusion process. To overcome these limitations, we propose Customized-GRPO, a novel framework featuring two key innovations: (i) Synergy-Aware Reward Shaping (SARS), a non-linear mechanism that explicitly penalizes conflicted reward signals and amplifies synergistic ones, providing a sharper and more decisive gradient. (ii) Time-Aware Dynamic Weighting (TDW), which aligns the optimization pressure with the model’s temporal dynamics by prioritizing prompt-following in the early, identity preservation in the later. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms naive GRPO baselines, successfully mitigating competitive degradation. Our model achieves a superior balance, generating images that both preserve key identity features and accurately adhere to complex textual prompts.
papers.abstract_zh: 主题驱动的图片生成模型面临着一个根本性的权衡问题：如何平衡身份保留的精确性与提示要求的可编辑性。虽然在线强化学习技术，尤其是GPRO，提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但我们发现，简单地将GRPO应用于实际场景中会导致严重的性能下降。因为用静态权重简单线性叠加奖励信号会导致梯度信号出现冲突，从而与扩散过程的时间动态不一致。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了Customized-GRPO这一创新框架，该框架包含两项关键创新：(1) 协同感知奖励塑形机制(SSARS)，这是一种非线性机制，能够明确惩罚冲突的奖励信号，并增强协同作用的奖励信号，从而提供更清晰、更明确的梯度信息。(2) 时间感知动态加权机制(TDW)，该机制通过将优化压力与模型的时间动态相结合，在初期优先满足提示要求，在后期则更注重身份保留。大量实验表明，我们的方法显著优于简单的GRPO基线算法，成功避免了性能下降的问题。我们的模型实现了更好的平衡，生成的图片既能保留关键的身份特征，又能准确遵循复杂的文本提示要求。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Deep-Reporter: Deep Research for Grounded Multimodal Long-Form Generation
papers.title_zh: 深度报道者：针对多模态长文生成的深入研究
papers.authors: Fangda Ye, Kuicai Dong, Xie Zhifei, Yuxin Hu, Yihang Yin, Shurui Huang, Shikai Dong, Chen Zhang, Jianzhu Bao, Shuicheng Yan
papers.abstract: Recent agentic search frameworks enable deep research via iterative planning and retrieval, reducing hallucinations and enhancing factual grounding. However, they remain text-centric, overlooking the multimodal evidence that characterizes real-world expert reports. We introduce a pressing task: multimodal long-form generation. Accordingly, we propose Deep-Reporter, a unified agentic framework for grounded multimodal long-form generation. It orchestrates: (i) Agentic Multimodal Search and Filtering to retrieve and filter textual passages and information-dense visuals; (ii) Checklist-Guided Incremental Synthesis to ensure coherent image-text integration and optimal citation placement; and (iii) Recurrent Context Management to balance long-range coherence with local fluency. We develop a rigorous curation pipeline producing 8K high-quality agentic traces for model optimization. We further introduce M^2LongBench, a comprehensive testbed comprising 247 research tasks across 9 domains and a stable multimodal sandbox. It enables unified multimodal assessment, fair comparison, and accessible evaluation without commercial APIs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that long-form multimodal generation is a challenging task, especially in multimodal selection and integration, and effective post-training can bridge the gap. Our code is available at https://github.com/fangda-ye/Deep-Report.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的一些智能搜索框架通过迭代规划和检索实现了深度研究，有效减少了幻觉现象，并提升了信息的准确性。然而，这些框架仍然以文本为中心，忽视了真实世界专家报告中所包含的多模态信息。我们提出了一种重要的任务：多模态长格式生成。为此，我们提出了Deep-Reporter这一统一的智能框架，用于实现多模态长格式的生成。该框架能够完成以下工作：(i) 智能多模态搜索与过滤，以检索和筛选文本段落以及信息丰富的视觉内容；(ii) 基于检查表的渐进式合成，确保图像与文本的连贯整合以及最佳引用位置的安排；以及(iii) 循环上下文管理，平衡长期的一致性与局部的自然流畅性。我们开发了一套严格的编辑流程，能够生成8K高质量的智能生成结果，用于模型优化。此外，我们还引入了M^2LongBench这一综合测试平台，该平台包含了9个领域内的247项研究任务，并拥有稳定的多模态环境。这使得我们可以在不依赖商业API的情况下，进行统一的多模态评估、公平比较和便捷评价。大量实验表明，多模态长格式生成是一项具有挑战性的任务，尤其是在多模态选择与整合方面。而有效的后训练可以弥补这些不足。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/fangda-ye/Deep-Report下载。

papers.title: Embodied-Reasoner: Synergizing Visual Search, Reasoning, and Action for Embodied Interactive Tasks
papers.title_zh: 具身推理器：整合视觉搜索、推理与行动以处理具身交互任务
papers.authors: Wenqi Zhang, Mengna Wang, Gangao Liu, Huixin Xu, Yiwei Jiang, Yongliang Shen, Guiyang Hou, Zhe Zheng, Hang Zhang, Xin Li, Jiajun Liu, Weiming Lu, Peng Li, Yueting Zhuang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in reasoning models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities on mathematical and coding tasks. However, their effectiveness in embodied domains, where the agent must continuously interact with environments and process observation-action interleaved trajectories, remains largely unexplored. We present Embodied-Reasoner, a reasoning model for interactive embodied tasks. Unlike mathematical reasoning that relies primarily on logical deduction, embodied scenarios demand spatial understanding, temporal reasoning, and ongoing self-reflection based on interaction history. To address these challenges, we synthesize 9.3k coherent Observation-Thought-Action trajectories containing 64k ego-centric images and 90k diverse reasoning processes (analysis, spatial reasoning, reflection, planning, and verification). We develop a three-stage training recipe that progressively enhances the model’s capabilities through imitation learning, rejection sampling tuning on self-exploration trajectories, and reflection tuning. The evaluation shows that our model significantly outperforms advanced visual reasoning models, e.g., exceeds OpenAI o1, o3-mini, and Claude-3.7 by +9%, 24%, and +13%. Analysis reveals that our model exhibits fewer repeated searches and logical inconsistencies, with particular advantages in complex long-horizon tasks. Real-world testing further validates the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在推理模型方面的研究取得了显著进展，这些模型在数学和编程任务上展现出了强大的能力。然而，它们在需要agent持续与环境互动、并处理观测与行动交织的情境中的有效性，仍然有待进一步探索。我们提出了Embodied-Reasoner这一用于交互式具体任务的推理模型。与主要依赖逻辑演绎的数学推理不同，具体场景需要空间理解、时间推理，以及基于互动历史进行的持续自我反思。为了应对这些挑战，我们整合了9.3千条连贯的观测-思考-行动轨迹，其中包含64千张以自我为中心的图片，以及90千种不同的推理过程（分析、空间推理、反思、规划和验证）。我们开发了一种三阶段训练方法，通过模仿学习、对自我探索轨迹进行拒绝采样调整，以及进行反思调整，逐步提升模型的性能。评估结果显示，我们的模型在性能上显著优于先进的视觉推理模型，例如，其性能分别比OpenAI o1、o3-mini和Claude-3.7高出9%、24%和13%。分析表明，我们的模型在复杂长期任务中表现出较少的重复搜索和逻辑一致性问题，具有明显优势。实际测试进一步验证了我们方法的有效性。

papers.title: Temporal Precision Matters: Brain-Tuning Speech Language Models with Millisecond-Resolution Neural Signals
papers.title_zh: 时间精度至关重要：能够根据毫秒级神经信号调整行为的语音语言模型
papers.authors: Zhejun Zhang, Wenqing Zhou, Haozhe Xu, Lin Zhang, Lei Li
papers.abstract: Brain-tuning enhances brain alignment and downstream performance by fine-tuning speech language models with neural recordings. However, previous work relies primarily on fMRI, whose temporal resolution integrates neural activity over seconds, blending distinct processing stages into a single supervision signal and precluding temporally targeted training. We introduce ECoG-tuning, which leverages electrocorticography’s millisecond precision to train speech language models. We design temporally targeted windows—a speech window capturing acoustic-phonetic encoding and a language window capturing higher-order linguistic processing—grounded in neuroscientific findings about temporal encoding hierarchies. Evaluating three models on the Podcast ECoG dataset, we find that ECoG-tuning significantly improves brain alignment over pretrained and distillation baselines. Notably, full spatiotemporal dynamics yield 7–17% higher alignment than time-averaged supervision across models, and language-window tuning produces larger gains in higher-order language regions, indicating that temporal precision provides additional training value. Moreover, ECoG-tuned models consistently improve or maintain downstream performance. Overall, our work provides initial evidence that electrophysiology is a viable brain-tuning modality, demonstrating how neuroscientific insights into processing hierarchies can inform principled model training strategies. Code is available at https://github.com/Mochizuki-BUPT/ECoG-Tuning-main.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过利用神经记录来微调语音语言模型，脑调谐能够提升大脑各部分的协同性以及下游性能。然而，以往的研究主要依赖于功能性磁共振成像技术，该技术的时域分辨率只能整合几秒钟内的神经活动，无法将不同的处理阶段融合成一个统一的监督信号，也无法实现针对特定时间的训练。我们提出了一种名为ECoG调优的方法，该方法利用皮层电描记术的毫秒级精度来训练语音语言模型。我们设计了两个特定的时间窗口：一个用于捕捉声学-音位编码的语音窗口，另一个用于处理高级语言信息的语言窗口。这些设计基于关于时间编码层次结构的神经科学发现。在Podcast ECoG数据集上对三种模型进行了评估，我们发现ECoG调优显著提升了大脑各部分的协同性，优于预训练和蒸馏基线模型。值得注意的是，完整的时空动态所带来的协同性提升幅度比时间平均监督方法高出7-17%，而语言窗口调优则在高级语言区域带来了更大的提升效果，这表明时间精度为模型训练提供了额外的价值。此外，经过ECoG调优的模型在下游性能上也表现出明显的提升或保持稳定。总体而言，我们的研究初步证明了电生理学是一种可行的脑调谐方式，并展示了如何将神经科学的见解应用于模型训练策略中。代码可访问于https://github.com/Mochizuki-BUPT/ECoG-Tuning-main。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: One Pair Suffices: Unlocking Universal Zero-Shot Translation via Cross-Architecture Alignment
papers.title_zh: 一对参数就足够了：通过跨架构的整合实现通用零样本翻译技术的解锁
papers.authors: Hao Zong, Cong Hu Yuan, Chao Bei, Wentao Chen, Huan Liu, Kaiyu Huang, Degen Huang
papers.abstract: Current paradigms for empowering Large Language Models (LLMs) with multilingual capabilities rely heavily on massive instruction tuning. We challenge this view, proposing that the barrier is topological alignment, not data quantity. We introduce Hybrid Cross-Alignment (HCA), fusing a frozen NLLB encoder with a Qwen decoder via a closed-loop dual-adapter architecture. HCA utilizes a Source-Side Adapter to precondition encoder features and a Query-Residual Adapter to preserve generative stability, bridged by an adaptive gated cross-modal interface. Our core discovery is Universal Alignment Generalization.” We demonstrate that training HCA on a single language pair (German-English) unlocks state-of-the-art zero-shot transfer to dozens of unseen languages. Crucially, our Oracle” experiments reveal that this single-pair training recovers over 96.7% of the performance achievable by training on all available pairs. This proves that a universal, language-agnostic projection protocol exists. With a total inference footprint of 5.25B parameters, our model significantly outperforms larger baselines, surpassing TowerPlus-9B (+9.0 COMET on low-resource languages) and Aya-101 (13B). Furthermore, performance scales linearly with encoder size; upgrading from 600M to 1.3B yields immediate gains (+3.4 points on Gujarati) with minimal retraining cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，让大语言模型具备多语言能力的范式主要依赖于大量的指令调整。我们对此观点提出质疑，认为真正的障碍是拓扑对齐问题，而非数据量的问题。我们提出了混合交叉对齐技术，该技术通过将冻结的NLLB编码器与Qwen解码器结合，采用闭环双适配器架构来实现。混合交叉对齐技术利用源侧适配器对编码器特征进行预处理，同时利用查询残差适配器来保持生成稳定性，两者之间通过自适应门控的交叉模态接口实现连接。我们的核心发现是“通用对齐泛化”。我们证明，仅对德语-英语这一对语言进行训练，就能实现向数十种未见语言进行零样本迁移的能力。更重要的是，我们的实验表明，这种单对语言训练方式能够复现超过96.7%的训练出的性能水平，这证明了存在一种通用的、与语言无关的对齐方法。我们的模型总参数数量为52.5亿个，其性能明显优于其他更大的基线模型，如TowerPlus-9B（在低资源语言上的性能提升为+9.0 COMET）和Aya-101（参数为130亿）。此外，模型的性能随着编码器规模的增加而线性提升；从6亿参数升级到13亿参数后，模型的性能立即提升了3.4点（在古吉拉特语上的表现提升尤为显著），且所需的重新训练成本极低。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LASA: Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment at the Semantic Bottleneck for LLM Safety
papers.title_zh: LASA：在语义瓶颈处实现与语言无关的语义对齐，以保障大型语言模型的安全运行
papers.authors: Junxiao Yang, Haoran Liu, Jinzhe Tu, Jiale Cheng, Zhexin Zhang, Shiyao Cui, Jiaqi Weng, Jialing Tao, Hui Xue, Hongning Wang, Han Qiu, Minlie Huang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated better safety performance in high-resource languages than in low-resource languages. We attribute this issue as a mismatch gap between language-agnostic semantic understanding ability and language dominant safety alignment biased toward high-resource languages. Based on above insights, we empirically identify the semantic bottleneck in LLMs: intermediate layers in which the geometry of model representations is governed primarily by shared semantic content rather than language identity. Then, we propose Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment (LASA), which anchors safety alignment directly in semantic bottlenecks. Experiments show that LASA substantially improves safety across all languages: average attack success rate (ASR) drops from 24.7% to 2.8% on LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct and remains within 3–4% across Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 Instruct models (7B–32B). Besides, our analysis and method offer a representation-level perspective on LLM safety, suggesting that safety alignment requires anchoring safety understanding not in surface text, but in the model’s language-agnostic semantic space.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在资源丰富的语言中展现出了比资源匮乏的语言更好的安全性表现。我们认为这一问题的原因在于，模型在语义理解能力方面具有跨语言通用性，而安全对齐则更倾向于针对资源丰富的语言进行优化。基于上述洞察，我们通过实验确定了语言模型中的语义瓶颈：在中间层，模型表示的几何结构主要由共享的语义内容决定，而非语言特性。因此，我们提出了“跨语言语义对齐”方法，该方法将安全对齐直接应用于语义瓶颈处。实验表明，采用该方法后，模型在所有语言中的安全性都得到了显著提升：在LaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct模型中，平均攻击成功率从24.7%下降到了2.8%；而在Qwen2.5和Qwen3 Instruct模型中，这一比例保持在3%到4%之间（模型规模从7B到32B不等）。此外，我们的分析和方法为语言模型的安全性提供了从表征层面入手的解决方案，指出安全对齐应该将安全理解建立在模型的跨语言语义空间上，而不是表面文本上。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Modeling Annotator Disagreement with Demographic-Aware Experts and Synthetic Perspectives
papers.title_zh: 建模工具与注重人口统计信息的专家以及合成视角的差异分析
papers.authors: Yinuo Xu, Veronica Derricks, Allison Earl, David Jurgens
papers.abstract: We present an approach to modeling annotator disagreement in subjective NLP tasks through both architectural and data-centric innovations. Our model, DEM-MoE (Demographic-Aware Mixture of Experts), routes inputs to expert subnetworks based on annotator demographics, enabling it to better represent structured, group-level variation compared to prior models. DEM-MoE consistently performs competitively across demographic groups, and shows especially strong results on datasets with high annotator disagreement. To address sparse demographic coverage, we test whether LLM-generated synthetic annotations via zero-shot persona prompting can be used for data imputation. We show these synthetic judgments align moderately well with human annotations on our data and offer a scalable way to potentially enrich training data. We then propose and evaluate approaches for blending real and synthetic data using strategies tailored to dataset structure. We find that the optimal strategies depend on dataset structure. Together, these contributions improve the representation of diverse perspectives.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种方法来模拟主观自然语言处理任务中注释者分歧的问题，该方法结合了架构上的创新和数据驱动的方法。我们的模型DEM-MoE（考虑人口统计特征的混合专家模型）能够根据注释者的人口统计数据将输入分配到不同的专家子网络，从而比之前的模型更能准确反映结构化、群体层面的差异。DEM-MoE在不同人口群体中都能表现出竞争力强的性能，尤其是在注释者分歧较大的数据集上表现尤为出色。为了解决人口统计数据的稀疏问题，我们测试了通过零样本人物提示生成LLM生成的合成注释是否可以用于数据补充。结果显示，这些合成判断与人类注释在某种程度上是吻合的，并且提供了一种可扩展的方式来丰富训练数据。随后，我们提出了一些方法，用于结合真实数据和合成数据，并根据数据集的结构来选择合适的策略。我们发现，最佳的策略取决于数据集的结构。总的来说，这些贡献提升了对不同观点的表示能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Multimodal Safety Evaluation in Generative Agent Social Simulations
papers.title_zh: 在生成式智能体社交模拟中的多模态安全性评估
papers.authors: Alhim Adonai Vera Gonzalez, Carlos Hinojosa, Karen Sanchez, Haidar Bin Hamid, Donghoon Kim, Bernard Ghanem
papers.abstract: Can generative agents be trusted in multimodal environments? Despite recent advances, agents remain limited in their ability to reason about safety, coherence, and trust across modalities. We introduce a reproducible simulation framework to evaluate generative agents in three aspects: (1) safety improvement over time via iterative plan revision in multimodal scenarios; (2) detection of unsafe activities across social contexts; and (3) social dynamics, measured through interaction and acceptance rates. These multimodal agents are evaluated using metrics that quantify plan revisions and unsafe-to-safe conversions. Experiments show that while agents detect direct multimodal contradictions, they often fail to align local revisions with global safety, achieving only a 55% success rate in correcting unsafe plans. We release a dataset of 1,000 multimodal plans, yielding more than 600,000 simulation steps. Notably, 45% of unsafe actions are accepted when paired with misleading visual cues, revealing a strong tendency to overtrust visual content. Code is available at https://github.com/AdonaiVera/X-CASE
papers.abstract_zh: 在多模态环境中，生成式智能体能否被信任呢？尽管最近取得了一些进展，但智能体在跨模态的安全性、连贯性以及信任度方面的推理能力仍然有限。我们引入了一个可复现的模拟框架来评估生成式智能体的表现，具体从三个方面进行评估：(1) 通过迭代计划修订来提升多模态场景中的安全性；(2) 识别社会语境中的不安全行为；(3) 通过互动和接受率来衡量社会动态。这些多模态智能体的评估采用量化计划修订和不安全行为与安全行为转换的指标。实验表明，虽然智能体能够检测到多模态之间的矛盾，但它们往往无法将局部修订与全局安全性协调一致，在纠正不安全的计划方面仅取得了55%的成功率。我们提供了一组包含1,000个多模态计划的数据集，共进行了超过600,000次模拟步骤。值得注意的是，当存在误导性的视觉线索时，有45%的不安全行为会被接受，这揭示了人们过度依赖视觉内容的倾向。代码可在https://github.com/AdonaiVera/X-CASE获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Quantifying the Impact of Translation Errors on Multilingual LLM Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 量化翻译错误对多语言大语言模型评估的影响
papers.authors: Klaudia Thellmann, Bernhard Stadler, Michael Färber, Jens Lehmann
papers.abstract: Machine-translated benchmarks are widely used to assess the multilingual capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet translation errors in these benchmarks remain underexplored, raising concerns about the reliability and comparability of multilingual evaluation. We address two practical gaps: (i) how well automatic MQM-style error spans from LLM judges and a span-aware QE baseline (xCOMET-XXL) match expert human span annotations on benchmark translations, and (ii) how strongly translation errors (as opposed to source-side issues in the English original) explain accuracy drops on translated benchmarks. We find that span agreement is non-trivial on naturally occurring benchmark translations, and that target-side translation errors are consistently associated with measurable, percentage-point drops in translated accuracy even after controlling for English correctness and source-side anomalies.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器翻译的基准测试被广泛用于评估大语言模型的多语言能力，但这些基准测试中的翻译错误尚未得到充分研究，这引发了人们对多语言评估的可靠性和可比性的担忧。我们针对两个实际问题进行了研究：(i) 自动生成的MQM式错误在多大程度上能够与语言模型评判者和一种具有跨度感知能力的QE基线（xCOMET-XXL）相匹配，以评估其与专家人工翻译注释的吻合程度；(ii) 翻译错误（而非英文原语中的问题）对翻译后基准测试的准确性下降有何种程度的贡献。我们发现，在自然出现的基准翻译任务中，翻译结果的跨域一致性并非微不足道，而且即使在控制了英文的正确性以及源语文本中的异常情况之后，目标语言的翻译错误仍然会与翻译准确度的百分比下降存在明显的关联。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Long-Context Reasoning Through Proxy-Based Chain-of-Thought Tuning
papers.title_zh: 通过基于代理的思维链调优实现长期上下文推理
papers.authors: Miao Li, Irina Saparina, Alexander Gurung, Mirella Lapata
papers.abstract: Recent large language models support inputs of up to 10 million tokens, yet they perform poorly on long-context tasks that require complex reasoning. Such tasks can be solved using only a subset of the input — a proxy context — rather than the full sequence. Despite sharing the same underlying reasoning process, models exhibit a significant performance disparity between proxy and full contexts. To improve long-context reasoning, we propose ProxyCoT, a novel training framework that transfers reasoning capabilities from short proxy contexts to full long contexts. Specifically, we first obtain high-quality chain-of-thought reasoning traces on proxy contexts through reinforcement learning or distillation from a larger teacher model, and then ground the generated traces in full long contexts with supervised fine-tuning. Experiments across different datasets demonstrate that ProxyCoT consistently outperforms strong baselines with reduced computational overhead. Furthermore, models trained with ProxyCoT generalize their long-context reasoning capabilities to out-of-domain tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的大语言模型能够支持多达1000万个标记的输入，但在需要复杂推理的长上下文任务上表现不佳。这类任务可以通过使用输入的一部分——即代理上下文——而不是完整的序列来解决。尽管这些模型具有相同的底层推理机制，但它们在代理上下文和完整上下文之间的性能存在显著差异。为了改善长上下文推理能力，我们提出了ProxyCoT这一新的训练框架，该框架能够将短代理上下文中的推理能力迁移到完整的长上下文中。具体来说，我们首先通过强化学习或从更大的教师模型中蒸馏出高质量的代理上下文推理轨迹，然后利用监督式微调将这些生成的轨迹应用到完整的长上下文中。在不同数据集上的实验表明，ProxyCoT在降低计算开销的同时，始终能优于其他强大的基线方法。此外，使用ProxyCoT训练的模型还能将其长上下文推理能力泛化到不同领域的问题上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MASPO: Unifying Gradient Utilization, Probability Mass, and Signal Reliability for Robust and Sample-Efficient LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MASPO：整合梯度利用、概率质量以及信号可靠性，以实现稳健且高效的大语言模型推理
papers.authors: Xiaoliang Fu, Jiaye Lin, Yangyi Fang, Binbin Zheng, Chaowen Hu, Zekai Shao, Cong Qin, Lu Pan, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai
papers.abstract: Existing Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) algorithms, such as GRPO, rely on rigid, uniform, and symmetric trust region mechanisms that are fundamentally misaligned with the complex optimization dynamics of Large Language Models (LLMs). In this paper, we identify three critical challenges in these methods: (1) inefficient gradient utilization caused by the binary cutoff of hard clipping, (2) insensitive probability mass arising from uniform ratio constraints that ignore the token distribution, and (3) asymmetric signal reliability stemming from the disparate credit assignment ambiguity between positive and negative samples. To bridge these gaps, we propose Mass-Adaptive Soft Policy Optimization (MASPO), a unified framework designed to harmonize these three dimensions. MASPO integrates a differentiable soft Gaussian gating to maximize gradient utility, a mass-adaptive limiter to balance exploration across the probability spectrum, and an asymmetric risk controller to align update magnitudes with signal confidence. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MASPO serves as a robust, all-in-one RLVR solution, significantly outperforming baselines. Our code is available at: https://github.com/FlyTune/MASPO-RL.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的具有可验证奖励的强化学习算法，如GRPO，依赖于严格、统一且对称的信任域机制，而这些机制与大语言模型复杂的优化动态根本不相符。在本文中，我们指出了这些方法的三个关键问题：(1) 由于硬剪裁的二进制截断导致梯度利用效率低下；(2) 由于均匀比例约束忽略了令牌分布，从而导致概率质量不够敏感；(3) 正负样本之间的信用分配模糊性导致信号可靠性不对称。为了弥补这些缺陷，我们提出了质量自适应软策略优化算法，这是一个旨在协调这三个维度的统一框架。MASPO整合了可微分的软高斯门控机制来最大化梯度效用，采用了质量自适应限制器来平衡概率谱上的探索行为，以及不对称风险控制器来使更新幅度与信号置信度保持一致。广泛的评估表明，MASPO作为一种强大的全能强化学习解决方案，其性能显著优于现有基线算法。我们的代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/FlyTune/MASPO-RL
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Towards A Scanpath-Conditioned Surprisal Theory: Modeling Reader Information States
papers.title_zh: 走向一种基于扫描路径的惊喜理论：对读者信息状态的建模
papers.authors: Michael Mooney, Edmond S. L. Ho
papers.abstract: Standard surprisal is typically computed from the linear text prefix, but human reading is non-linear and memory constrained: readers skip words, regress, and do not retain prior context perfectly. We propose a formulation of surprisal conditioned on a reader-specific accessible information state given by the scanpath history and memory dynamics, rather than by the written prefix alone. Prior context is treated as only probabilistically accessible at each fixation, allowing predictability to depend on both non-linear exposure and forgetting. We evaluate the approach on eye-tracking corpora using held-out log-likelihood over standard duration based reading measures. Across model variants, conditioning on accessible information states improves predictive fit over standard surprisal baselines. These results suggest that predictability in human reading is better characterized relative to the reader’s evolving accessible information state than to the written prefix alone.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准的惊讶度通常是通过线性文本前缀来计算的，但人类的阅读过程是非线性的，且受记忆容量的限制：读者会跳过词语、回视先前内容，也无法完全记住之前的上下文信息。我们提出了一种基于读者特定的可访问信息状态的惊讶度计算方法，这种信息状态是由扫描路径历史和记忆动态决定的，而不是仅仅依赖于书面文本前缀。在每次注视时，先前的信息只以概率方式被访问到，这使得预测性取决于非线性的曝光效应和遗忘现象。我们在眼动追踪数据集上进行了评估，通过标准阅读时长等指标在留出数据上的对数似然值来比较不同方法的效果。在不同模型版本中，基于可访问信息状态的惊讶度计算方式能够比传统的惊讶度基线方法更好地提高预测精度。这些结果表明，人类阅读中的可预测性更多地取决于读者不断变化的可访问信息状态，而非单纯的书面文本前缀。

papers.title: SafeMT: Multi-turn Safety for Multimodal Language Models
papers.title_zh: SafeMT：适用于多种模式语言模型的多轮安全处理机制
papers.authors: Han Zhu, Juntao Dai, Jiaming Ji, Haoran Li, Chengkun Cai, Pengcheng Wen, Chi-Min Chan, Boyuan Chen, Yaodong Yang, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: With the widespread use of multi-modal Large Language models (MLLMs), safety issues have become a growing concern. Multi-turn dialogues, which are more common in everyday interactions, pose a greater risk than single prompts; however, existing benchmarks do not adequately consider this situation. To encourage the community to focus on the safety issues of these models in multi-turn dialogues, we introduce SafeMT, a benchmark that features dialogues of varying lengths generated from harmful queries accompanied by images. This benchmark consists of 10,000 samples in total, encompassing 17 different scenarios and four jailbreak methods. Additionally, we propose Safety Index (SI) to evaluate the general safety of MLLMs during conversations. We assess the safety of 17 models using this benchmark and discover that the risk of successful attacks on these models increases as the number of turns in harmful dialogues rises. This observation indicates that the safety mechanisms of these models are inadequate for recognizing the hazard in dialogue interactions. We propose a dialogue safety moderator capable of detecting malicious intent concealed within conversations and providing MLLMs with relevant safety policies. Experimental results from several open-source models indicate that this moderator is more effective in reducing multi-turn Attack Success Rate (ASR) compared to existed guard models.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着多模态大语言模型被广泛使用，安全问题日益成为关注的焦点。在日常交互中更为常见的多轮对话，其风险比单轮提示要高得多；然而，现有的评估基准并未充分考虑到这种情况。为了鼓励社区关注这些模型在多轮对话中的安全性问题，我们提出了SafeMT这一评估基准，该基准包含由有害查询伴随图像生成的不同长度的对话样本。这个基准总共包含10,000个样本，涵盖了17种不同的场景和四种越狱方法。此外，我们还提出了安全指数（SI）来评估MLLMs在对话过程中的整体安全性。我们通过这个基准对17个模型的安全性进行了评估，发现随着有害对话的轮数增加，对这些模型发起成功攻击的风险也会上升。这一观察表明，这些模型的安全机制在识别对话中的危险情况方面存在不足。我们提出了一个对话安全调节器，它能够检测对话中隐藏的恶意意图，并为MLLMs提供相关的安全策略。来自多个开源模型的实验结果表明，与现有的保护模型相比，这种调节器在降低多轮攻击成功率方面更为有效。

papers.title: From \log \pi to \pi: Taming Divergence in Soft Clipping via Bilateral Decoupled Decay of Probability Gradient Weight
papers.title_zh: 从 log π 到 π：通过概率梯度权重的双边解耦衰减技术，来抑制软裁剪中的发散现象
papers.authors: Xiaoliang Fu, Jiaye Lin, Yangyi Fang, Chaowen Hu, Cong Qin, Zekai Shao, Binbin Zheng, Lu Pan, Ke Zeng
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has catalyzed a leap in Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, yet its optimization dynamics remain fragile. Standard algorithms like GRPO enforce stability via “hard clipping”, which inadvertently stifles exploration by discarding gradients of tokens outside the trust region. While recent “soft clipping” methods attempt to recover these gradients, they suffer from a critical challenge: relying on log-probability gradient (\nabla_\theta\log \pi_\theta) yields divergent weights as probabilities vanish, destabilizing LLM training. We rethink this convention by establishing probability gradient (\nabla_\theta \pi_\theta) as the superior optimization primitive. Accordingly, we propose Decoupled Gradient Policy Optimization (DGPO), which employs a decoupled decay mechanism based on importance sampling ratios. By applying asymmetric, continuous decay to boundary tokens, DGPO resolves the conflict between stability and sustained exploration. Extensive experiments across DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen series models (1.5B/7B/14B) demonstrate that DGPO consistently outperforms strong baselines on various mathematical benchmarks, offering a robust and scalable solution for RLVR. Our code and implementation are available at: https://github.com/FlyTune/DGPO-RL.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在大语言模型推理方面取得了显著突破，但其优化机制仍然不够稳定。传统的算法如GRPO通过“硬裁剪”来保持稳定性，但这会无意中抑制探索行为，因为那些位于信赖域之外的梯度会被丢弃。虽然最近的“软裁剪”方法试图恢复这些梯度，但它们面临一个关键问题：依赖对数概率梯度（$\nabla_\theta\log \pi_\theta$）会导致权重发散，因为概率趋近于零时，模型的稳定性就会受到破坏。我们重新思考这一做法，将概率梯度（$\nabla_\theta \pi_\theta$）视为更优的优化工具。因此，我们提出了解耦梯度策略优化算法（DGPO），该算法采用基于重要性采样比率的解耦衰减机制。通过对边界节点施加非对称的连续衰减，DGPO解决了稳定性和持续探索之间的矛盾。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen系列模型（1.5B/7B/14B参数规模）上的广泛实验表明，DGPO在各种数学基准测试中的表现均优于其他强基线算法，为RLVR提供了一种稳健且可扩展的解决方案。我们的代码和实现可以在以下链接查看：https://github.com/FlyTune/DGPO-RL
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Paramanu: Compact and Competitive Monolingual Language Models for Low-Resource Morphologically Rich Indian Languages
papers.title_zh: Paramanu：适用于低资源、具有丰富形态结构的印度语言的紧凑型、竞争性的单语言模型
papers.authors: Mitodru Niyogi, Eric Gaussier, Arnab Bhattacharya
papers.abstract: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) are expensive to pretrain and often suffer from imbalances across languages and datasets, English-centric bias, tokenizer oversegmentation for morphologically rich low-resource languages, and the curse of multilinguality. We introduce PARAMANU, a family of Indian language-only autoregressive language models trained from scratch on open-source language-specific data for the five most spoken Indian languages: Bangla (Bengali), Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, and Telugu. All models are designed for affordability and are trained on a single GPU with a budget under 1,000, allowing under-resourced researchers to build competitive language models. To address low-resource challenges, we develop morphology-aligned, low-fertility tokenizers, and propose an interpolation-based method for token position indices in RoPE based scaling to train longer sequences efficiently. We also create instruction-tuning datasets in Bangla that are then translated to the other four languages. Despite their small size (108M-367M parameters), Paramanu achieves a strong performance-efficiency tradeoff and outperforms most larger multilingual models up to 8B across all five languages. The models and datasets are available at: https://huggingface.co/collections/mitodru/paramanu.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言大语言模型在预训练阶段成本很高，且往往存在语言与数据集之间的不平衡问题、以英语为中心的趋势、针对形态丰富但资源匮乏的语言的分词器分割问题，以及多语言处理的复杂性问题。我们提出了PARAMANU系列模型，这些模型仅使用印度语言进行自回归语言建模，并基于开源的五种主要印度语言的数据从零开始训练：孟加拉语、印地语、马拉地语、泰米尔语和泰卢固语。所有模型都注重成本效益，仅在单块GPU上训练，预算控制在1000美元以下，这使得资源有限的研究人员也能构建出具有竞争力的语言模型。为了应对资源匮乏的挑战，我们开发了与形态学相匹配的低生育率分词器，并提出了一种基于插值的标记位置索引方法，以便高效训练更长的序列。我们还创建了孟加拉语的教学微调数据集，并将其翻译成其他四种语言。尽管参数数量较少（1.08亿至3.67亿个参数），Paramanu模型仍取得了良好的性能与效率平衡，其表现优于大多数规模更大的多语言模型，尤其是在五种语言中，其性能均优于参数规模高达80亿的模型。这些模型和数据集可以在以下链接获取：https://huggingface.co/collections/mitodru/paramanu。

papers.title: Linear-Time and Constant-Memory Text Embeddings Based on Recurrent Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于循环语言模型的线性时间且内存消耗恒定的文本嵌入方法
papers.authors: Tobias Grantner, Emanuel Sallinger, Martin Flechl
papers.abstract: Transformer-based embedding models suffer from quadratic computational and linear memory complexity, limiting their utility for long sequences. We propose recurrent architectures as an efficient alternative, introducing a vertically chunked inference strategy that enables fast embedding generation with memory usage that becomes constant in the input length once it exceeds the vertical chunk size. By fine-tuning Mamba2 models, we demonstrate their viability as general-purpose text embedders, achieving competitive performance across a range of benchmarks while maintaining a substantially smaller memory footprint compared to transformer-based counterparts. We empirically validate the applicability of our inference strategy to Mamba2, RWKV, and xLSTM models, confirming consistent runtime-memory trade-offs across architectures and establishing recurrent models as a compelling alternative to transformers for efficient embedding generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于Transformer的嵌入模型存在二次计算复杂性和线性内存复杂度的问题，这限制了它们处理长序列的能力。我们提出了循环架构作为一种高效的替代方案，该架构采用了垂直分块推理策略，使得嵌入生成过程能够高效进行，且内存使用量在输入长度超过垂直分块大小后趋于恒定。通过微调Mamba2模型，我们证明了其作为通用文本嵌入器的可行性，并在一系列基准测试中取得了具有竞争力的性能表现，同时与基于Transformer的模型相比，其内存占用要小得多。我们通过实验验证了我们的推理策略在Mamba2、RWKV和xLSTM模型中的适用性，确认了不同架构之间一致的运行时间-内存权衡关系，从而证明了循环模型是高效嵌入生成的有力替代方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Outcome Accuracy is Not Enough: Aligning the Reasoning Process of Reward Models
papers.title_zh: 结果准确性并不足够：需要调整奖励模型的推理过程
papers.authors: Binghai Wang, Yantao Liu, Yuxuan Liu, Tianyi Tang, Shenzhi Wang, Chang Gao, Chujie Zheng, Yichang Zhang, Le Yu, Shixuan Liu, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang, Bowen Yu, Fei Huang, Junyang Lin
papers.abstract: Generative Reward Models (GenRMs) and LLM-as-a-Judge exhibit deceptive alignment by producing correct judgments for incorrect reasons, as they are trained and evaluated to prioritize Outcome Accuracy, which undermines their ability to generalize during RLHF. We introduce Rationale Consistency, a fine-grained metric that quantifies the alignment between the model’s reasoning process and human judgment. Our evaluation of frontier models reveals that rationale consistency effectively discriminates among state-of-the-art models and detects deceptive alignment, while outcome accuracy falls short in both respects. To mitigate this gap, we introduce a hybrid signal that combines rationale consistency with outcome accuracy for GenRM training. Our training method achieves state-of-the-art performance on RM-Bench (87.1%) and JudgeBench (82%), surpassing outcome-only baselines by an average of 5%. Using RM during RLHF, our method effectively improves performance as demonstrated on Arena Hard v2, notably yielding a 7% improvement in creative writing tasks. Further analysis confirms that our method escapes the deceptive alignment trap, effectively reversing the decline in rationale consistency observed in outcome-only training.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成性奖励模型（GenRMs）和作为裁判的大语言模型通过以错误的原因做出正确的判断来表现出欺骗性的对齐行为。因为这些模型在训练和评估时被要求优先考虑结果的准确性，这削弱了它们在强化学习中的泛化能力。我们提出了“合理性一致性”这一细粒度指标，用于衡量模型的推理过程与人类判断之间的对齐程度。我们对前沿模型的评估表明，合理性一致性能够有效地区分最先进的模型，并识别出欺骗性对齐行为；而结果的准确性在这两方面都表现不佳。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了一种混合信号，将合理性一致性与结果准确性结合起来用于GenRM模型的训练。我们的训练方法在RM-Bench测试集上取得了最先进的表现（87.1%），在JudgeBench测试集上达到了82%的准确率，平均比仅关注结果的基线模型高出5%。通过在强化学习中使用GenRM模型，我们的方法有效提升了性能，例如在Arena Hard v2测试集上，创意写作任务的性能提高了7%。进一步的分析证实，我们的方法能够避免欺骗性对齐的陷阱，有效地逆转了在仅关注结果训练过程中观察到的合理性一致性下降现象。

papers.title: CIS-BWE: Chaos-Informed Speech Bandwidth Extension
papers.title_zh: CIS-BWE：基于混沌理论的语音带宽扩展技术
papers.authors: Tarikul Islam Tamiti, Tonmoy Das, Nursadul Mamun, Anomadarshi Barua
papers.abstract: We design CIS-BWE, a novel adversarial Bandwidth Extension (BWE) framework that introduces two chaos-informed discriminators - Multi-Resolution Lyapunov Discriminator (MRLD) and Multi-Scale Detrended Fractal Analysis Discriminator (MSDFA) - for capturing the deterministic chaos from speech. MRLD exploits Lyapunov exponents to capture nonlinear chaotic fluctuations. MSDFA exploits detrended fluctuation analysis to quantify fractal-like, long-range temporal chaotic correlations. To the best of our knowledge, MRLD and MSDFA are included here for the first time with a complex-valued adversarial network to explore the chaotic study of speech reconstruction. We also introduce a novel complex-valued and dual-stream generator, which uses our newly proposed ConformerNeXt as a core block with Lattice interactions, acting as a gating mechanism by enabling controlled mixing of information across streams. We extensively optimize our design across five resolutions and use depth-wise separable convolutions to make our model lightweight yet powerful. Our CIS-BWE is tested with a de facto English and French dataset for clean and noisy speech for generalization. It achieves better performance across a total of nine subjective and objective evaluation metrics with a 40x reduction in discriminator size and overall 0.5x fewer parameters, establishing a new baseline in the BWE task.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们设计了CIS-BWE这一创新的对抗性带宽扩展框架。该框架引入了两种基于混沌理论的判别器——多分辨率李雅普诺夫判别器（MRLD）和多尺度去趋势分形分析判别器（MSDFA），用于捕捉语音中的确定性混沌现象。MRLD利用李雅普诺夫指数来捕捉非线性混沌波动，而MSDFA则通过去趋势波动分析来量化类似分形的长程时间混沌相关性。据我们所知，这是首次将MRLD和MSDFA与复值对抗网络相结合，以探索语音重建的混沌特性。我们还引入了一种新型的复值双流生成器，该生成器以我们新提出的ConformerNeXt为核心模块，并结合了格点交互机制，从而实现了跨流信息的可控混合。我们在五种分辨率下对设计进行了优化，并采用了深度可分离卷积技术，使得模型既轻便又强大。我们的CIS-BWE模型使用英法和法语数据集进行了测试，这些数据集包含了清晰语音和噪声语音样本，用于泛化性能评估。结果表明，该模型在九项主观和客观评估指标上均表现出色，同时其判别器的尺寸减少了40倍，整体参数数量也减少了0.5倍，为带宽扩展任务树立了新的标杆。

papers.title: The Pitfalls of KV Cache Compression
papers.title_zh: KV缓存压缩的弊端
papers.authors: Alex Chen, Renato Geh, Aditya Grover, Guy Van Den Broeck, Daniel Mingyi Israel
papers.abstract: KV cache compression promises increased throughput and efficiency with negligible loss in performance. While the gains in throughput are indisputable and recent literature has indeed shown minimal degradation on particular benchmarks, in general the consequences of compression in realistic scenarios such as multi-instruction prompting have been insufficiently studied. In this paper, we identify several pitfalls that practitioners should be aware of when deploying KV cache compressed LLMs. We evaluate five KV cache compression methods (StreamingLLM, SnapKV, TOVA, H2O, and K-Norm) on Llama3.1 8B and Qwen2.5 14B under multi-instruction prompting with IFEval. Importantly, we show that certain instructions degrade much more rapidly with compression, effectively causing them to be completely ignored by the LLM. As a practical example, we highlight system prompt leakage as a case study, empirically demonstrating the impact of compression on leakage and general instruction-following. We identify several factors that contribute to system prompt leakage: compression method, instruction order, and KV eviction bias. We then propose simple changes to KV cache eviction policies that can reduce the impact of these factors and improve the overall performance in multi-instruction tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: KV缓存压缩有望提高吞吐量和效率，同时性能损失可以忽略不计。虽然吞吐量提升是毋庸置疑的，且最近的文献确实表明在特定基准测试上性能下降幅度很小，但在实际场景中，如多指令提示任务中，压缩带来的效果研究还不够充分。在本文中，我们指出了在使用KV缓存压缩的LLM时需要注意的几个问题。我们在Llama3.1 8B和Qwen2.5 14B模型上，使用IFEval进行了多指令提示测试，并评估了五种KV缓存压缩方法（StreamingLLM、SnapKV、TOVA、H2O和K-Norm）。重要的是，我们发现某些指令在压缩后会迅速恶化，甚至可能被LLM完全忽略。作为一个实际案例，我们以系统提示泄露为研究对象，实证分析了压缩对提示泄露及指令遵循能力的影响。我们发现，压缩方法、指令顺序以及KV缓存淘汰策略等因素都会导致系统提示泄露。因此，我们提出了一些简单的改进措施，以优化KV缓存淘汰策略，从而减轻这些因素对整体性能的影响，提升多指令任务的表现。

papers.title: Survey Response Generation: Generating Closed-Ended Survey Responses In-Silico with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 调查问卷生成：利用大型语言模型在实验室环境中生成固定格式的调查回答
papers.authors: Georg Ahnert, Anna-Carolina Haensch, Barbara Plank, Markus Strohmaier
papers.abstract: Many in-silico simulations of human survey responses with large language models (LLMs) focus on generating closed-ended survey responses, whereas LLMs are typically trained to generate open-ended text instead. Previous research has used a diverse range of methods for generating closed-ended survey responses with LLMs and a standard practice remains to be identified. In this paper, we systematically investigate the impact that various Survey Response Generation Methods have on predicted survey responses. We present the results of 32 mio. simulated survey responses across 8 Survey Response Generation Methods, 4 political attitude surveys, and 10 open-weight language models. We find significant differences between the Survey Response Generation Methods in both individual-level and subpopulation-level alignment. Our results show that Restricted Generation Methods perform best overall, and that reasoning output does not consistently improve alignment. Our work underlines the significant impact that Survey Response Generation Methods have on simulated survey responses, and we develop practical recommendations on the application of Survey Response Generation Methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多关于人类调查回答的计算机模拟都聚焦于使用大语言模型生成封闭式调查回答，而实际上，大语言模型的训练目标通常是生成开放式文本。以往的研究采用了多种方法来利用大语言模型生成封闭式调查回答，但至今仍未形成统一的实践标准。在本文中，我们系统地研究了不同调查回答生成方法对预测调查回答的影响。我们分析了8种调查回答生成方法、4种政治态度调查以及10种开放式语言模型所生成的3200万份模拟调查回答的结果。我们发现，在不同个体层面和子群体层面的对齐效果方面，各种调查回答生成方法存在显著差异。研究结果表明，受限生成方法的整体表现最为出色，而推理输出则未能持续改善对齐效果。我们的研究强调了调查回答生成方法对模拟调查回答的巨大影响，并提出了一些关于如何应用这些方法的实用建议。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Sign-Language Datasets at Scale: A Comprehensive Survey on Resources, Benchmarks, and Annotation Standards
papers.title_zh: 大规模的手语数据集：关于资源、评估标准及标注规范的全面调查
papers.authors: Yiming Ni, Zhi-Qi Cheng, Jiayu Li, Wei Cheng
papers.abstract: Sign languages are expressive visual languages used by Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) communities. Despite substantial progress in sign-language recognition, translation, and production, advances remain constrained by fragmented datasets, inconsistent annotations, and limited linguistic coverage. Existing benchmarks often fail to reflect real-world communication needs, and systematic analyses of these limitations remain limited. In this survey, we present a comprehensive index of sign-language datasets, covering 120 resources across 35 sign languages. We analyze key challenges such as modality imbalance, annotation granularity, and signer bias, and outline considerations for future dataset design. We also introduce a 24-field Sign-Language Datasheet and release a public GitHub repository to support standardized documentation and reproducible evaluation. Overall, our work provides a unified and practical foundation for developing inclusive, robust, and scalable sign-language technologies in real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 手语是聋人和听力障碍者所使用的表达性视觉语言。尽管在手语识别、翻译和制作方面取得了显著进展，但相关技术的进步仍受到数据集碎片化、注释不一致以及语言覆盖范围有限等因素的限制。现有的评估基准往往无法反映现实世界中的沟通需求，对这些限制的系统分析也仍然较为有限。在本综述中，我们提供了一个全面的手语数据集索引，涵盖了35种手语的120个资源。我们分析了诸如模态不平衡、注释粒度以及说话者偏见等关键挑战，并提出了未来数据集设计的建议。我们还编制了一份包含24个字段的手语数据表，并发布了一个公开的GitHub仓库，以支持标准化的文档管理和可复现的评估工作。总体而言，我们的工作为开发适用于实际应用的、包容性强且可扩展的手语技术提供了统一且实用的基础。

papers.title: Anchoring the Affective Manifold: Learning Canonical and Disentangled Representations via Generative Cross-Modal Alignment
papers.title_zh: 固定情感流形：通过生成式跨模态对齐学习规范化与去纠缠化的表示方式
papers.authors: Weibin Li, Jintao Cheng, Xiaoyu Tang, Chi Man Vong
papers.abstract: Dominant multimodal emotion recognition paradigms often neglect the intrinsic geometric structure of affect, resulting in representations heavily entangled with non-affective factors. To address this, we propose a Canonical Disentangled Multimodal Generative Framework aimed at recovering the canonical affective manifold from raw data. We explicitly decompose the latent space into a canonical Shared Affective Subspace (z_{vad}) and a Private Modality Subspace (z_{priv}). We facilitate this factorization through Supervised Manifold Anchoring and Cross-Modal Manifold Alignment. Experiments demonstrate that our model effectively disentangles affect from private attributes (e.g., identity), achieving superior robustness in zero-shot cross-domain transfer compared to fully supervised baselines, while enabling controllable emotion generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的多模态情感识别方法常常忽略情感内在的几何结构，导致模型表征与非情感因素紧密交织在一起。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一种规范性的解耦多模态生成框架，旨在从原始数据中提取出规范的情感流形。我们将潜在空间明确地分解为一个规范的共享情感子空间（z_{vad}）和一个私有的模态子空间（z_{priv}）。我们通过监督流形锚定和跨模态流形对齐技术来实现这种分解。实验表明，我们的模型能够有效地将情感与私有属性（如身份信息）分离开来，在零样本跨领域迁移任务中表现出卓越的鲁棒性，同时还能实现可控的情感生成。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Who Plays Which Role When? Communication Role Dynamics for Peer Recognition and Team Performance Prediction
papers.title_zh: 当面对不同情境时，每个人会扮演什么样的角色？关于沟通角色动态的研究，对于理解同伴之间的相互认可以及团队绩效的预测具有重要意义
papers.authors: Yifan Song, Wenxuan Wendy Shi, Brian Bailey, Tal August
papers.abstract: Team roles offer an interpretable lens on collaboration, yet computational studies of roles often rely on domain-specific personas or data-driven clustering rather than theory-grounded taxonomies. We operationalize a taxonomy of eight communication roles grounded in education literature and annotate a corpus of 6,307 Slack messages from 55 students across 18 teams in a semester-long computer science course project. We evaluate whether LLMs can approximate expert labels, enabling scalable, taxonomy-driven role annotation. Using these role labels, we characterize role dynamics over teams’ lifecycles, finding that different roles peak at different moments and that students enact a more diverse set of roles as projects progress. To evaluate the utility of our role constructs, we use them to predict peer recognition, outperforming lexical, conversational, and LLM-prompting baselines. To assess generalizability beyond the educational context, we apply the same role constructs to a public dataset (DeliData) to predict team performance improvement after deliberation, again exceeding prior performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 团队角色为协作提供了可解释的视角，但关于角色的计算研究往往依赖于特定领域的角色模型或数据驱动的聚类方法，而非基于理论的分类体系。我们基于教育文献构建了一个包含八种沟通角色的分类体系，并对一个为期一学期的计算机科学课程项目中55名学生组成的18个团队的6,307条Slack消息进行了标注。我们评估了大语言模型是否能够近似专家标签，从而实现可扩展、基于分类体系的角色标注。利用这些角色标签，我们分析了各团队生命周期中的角色动态，发现不同角色在不同的阶段达到高峰，且随着项目的推进，学生会扮演更多样化的角色。为了验证我们的角色构建方法的实用性，我们使用它们来预测同伴的认可程度，其表现优于词汇分析、对话分析和大语言模型提示基线方法。为了评估该方法在超出教育背景之外的适用性，我们将相同的角色构建方法应用于一个公共数据集（DeliData），以预测团队绩效的提升情况，结果再次优于以往的研究表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Incomplete In-context Learning
papers.title_zh: 不完整的上下文学习
papers.authors: Wenqiang Wang, Wen Yujia, Yan Xiao, Zhifeng Chen, Yangshijie Zhang, Peng Chen, Mingbo Yang, Xiaochun Cao
papers.abstract: Existing In-context Learning (ICL) typically assumes the retrieval dataset contains demonstrations for all output label spaces. However, in real-world scenarios, delays in dataset updates or incomplete data annotation may result in the retrieval dataset containing labeled demonstrations for only a subset of the output space. We refer to this phenomenon as an incomplete retrieval dataset and define the in-context learning under this condition as Incomplete In-context Learning (IICL). To address IICL, we propose Iterative Judgments and Integrated Prediction (IJIP), a framework with train-free and train-based variants. For classification, the iterative judgments stage of IJIP reformulates an (m)-class problem into (m) binary tasks, converting IICL into standard ICL. The integrated prediction stage of IJIP then refines results using both the input and initial predictions. We further extend IJIP to text regression and generation, and introduce lightweight variants that reduce computation and token costs. Across six LLMs, seven tasks, and eight datasets, IJIP achieves state-of-the-art results under two incompleteness settings and even outperforms standard ICL with complete labels. IJIP also supports a semi-supervised variant and can serve as a plug-and-play enhancement for existing ICL and zero-shot methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有情境学习（ICL）通常假设检索数据集中包含了所有输出标签空间的示例。然而，在现实场景中，由于数据集更新延迟或数据标注不完整，检索数据集中可能只包含了部分输出空间的标记示例。我们将这种现象称为不完整的检索数据集，并在这种条件下将情境学习定义为不完全情境学习（IICL）。为了应对IICL问题，我们提出了迭代判断与集成预测框架——IJIP，该框架包含无训练版本和基于训练的版本。对于分类任务，IJIP的迭代判断阶段将(m)类问题分解为(m)个二元任务，从而将IICL转化为标准ICL。而IJIP的集成预测阶段则利用输入数据和初始预测结果来进一步优化结果。我们还将IJIP扩展到文本回归和生成任务，并引入了降低计算量和令牌成本的轻量级变体。在六个大语言模型、七个任务和八个数据集上进行的测试表明，IJIP在两种不完整性设置下都能取得最先进的结果，甚至优于具有完整标签的标准ICL。此外，IJIP还支持半监督变体，可以作为现有ICL方法和零样本方法的即插式增强方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Fine-tuning vs. In-context Learning in Large Language Models: A Formal Language Learning Perspective
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中的微调与上下文学习：从形式化语言学习的角度进行分析
papers.authors: Bishwamittra Ghosh, Soumi Das, Till Speicher, Qinyuan Wu, Mohammad Aflah Khan, Deepak Garg, Krishna P. Gummadi, Evimaria Terzi
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) operate in two fundamental learning modes – fine-tuning (FT) and in-context learning (ICL) – raising key questions about which mode yields greater language proficiency and whether they differ in their inductive biases. Prior studies comparing FT and ICL have yielded mixed and inconclusive results due to inconsistent experimental setups. To enable a rigorous comparison, we propose a formal language learning task – offering precise language boundaries, controlled string sampling, and no data contamination – and introduce a discriminative test for language proficiency, where an LLM succeeds if it assigns higher generation probability to in-language strings than to out-of-language strings.Empirically, we find that: (a) FT has greater language proficiency than ICL on in-distribution generalization, but both perform equally well on out-of-distribution generalization. (b) Their inductive biases, measured by the correlation in string generation probabilities, are similar when both modes partially learn the language but diverge at higher proficiency levels. (c) Unlike FT, ICL performance differs substantially across models of varying sizes and families and is sensitive to the token vocabulary of the language. Thus, our work demonstrates the promise of formal languages as a controlled testbed for evaluating LLMs, behaviors that are difficult to isolate in natural language datasets. Our source code is available at https://github.com/bishwamittra/formallm.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）有两种基本的学习模式：微调（FT）和上下文学习（ICL）。这两种模式在语言能力的提升方面存在显著差异，同时它们的归纳偏见也各不相同。之前的研究通过比较FT和ICL来评估这两种模式的性能，但由于实验设计的不一致，研究结果并不明确。为了进行严谨的比较，我们提出了一种正式的语言学习任务——该任务具有明确的语言边界、可控的字符串采样方式，并且不存在数据污染的问题。我们还引入了一种衡量语言能力的判别性测试：如果LLM赋予母语字符串比外语字符串更高的生成概率，那么说明其表现良好。通过实证分析，我们发现：(a) 在分布内泛化能力方面，FT的表现优于ICL，而在分布外泛化能力方面，两者的表现相当。(b) 当两种模式都部分学习了语言规则时，它们的归纳偏见相似，但在更高水平的能力上则存在差异。(c) 与FT不同，ICL在不同规模模型和不同家族中的表现差异显著，而且其性能还受到语言词汇表的影响。因此，我们的研究证明了正式语言作为评估LLM行为的有效工具的价值，因为自然语言数据集中的行为很难被单独分离出来进行观察。我们的源代码可以在https://github.com/bishwamittra/formallm下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Where Paths Split: Localized, Calibrated Control of Moral Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 路径的分歧之处：在大型语言模型中对道德推理进行本地化、精确的控制
papers.authors: Chenchen Yuan, Zheyu Zhang, Gjergji Kasneci
papers.abstract: Large language models often display heterogeneous moral preferences across settings. We study inference-time steering toward a desired ethical framework while preserving general competence. We present Convergent-Divergent Routing, which traces and edits minimal branch points inside transformer blocks where ethical-framework-related pathways first converge and then diverge. Gating non-target branches at these loci blocks the downstream propagation while leaving upstream computations intact. We find that this intervention alone increases targeted ethical-framework reasoning. To achieve fine-grained control, we adapt Common Spatial Patterns to the residual stream and extract, for each branch-point layer, a pair of directions that discriminate between utilitarian and deontological frameworks. We then introduce Dual Logit Calibration, a closed-form, minimum-\ell_2-norm update that moves the residual within this two-dimensional subspace so the resulting directional projections align with user-specified preference weights. Experiments on real-life moral dilemmas show that our method reliably achieves preference calibration and largely preserves general capabilities, outperforming recent baselines while providing an interpretable mechanism.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在不同情境下往往表现出不同的道德偏好。我们研究了一种推理时间引导技术，该技术能够在保持通用能力的同时，引导模型朝着期望的伦理框架发展。我们提出了“收敛-发散路由”机制，该机制会在Transformer模块中追踪并修改那些与伦理框架相关的路径首次汇聚后再次发散的最小分支点。通过在这些节点处阻断非目标分支的传播，我们可以不影响上游的计算过程。我们发现，仅采用这种干预措施就能提升模型对目标伦理框架的推理能力。为了实现更精细的控制，我们采用了“共同空间模式”算法来处理残差流，并为每个分支点层提取出一对方向向量，以区分功利主义与义务论框架之间的差异。随后，我们引入了“双逻辑回归校准”方法，这是一种闭式求解的方法，通过最小化二维子空间的范数来更新残差，使得最终的定向投影与用户指定的偏好权重保持一致。在现实道德困境上的实验表明，我们的方法能够可靠地实现偏好校准，同时在很大程度上保持了模型的通用能力，其性能优于现有的基线方法，并且提供了一种易于理解的机制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Social Story Frames: Contextual Reasoning about Narrative Intent and Reception
papers.title_zh: 社交故事框架：关于叙事意图与接受度的情境推理
papers.authors: Joel Mire, Maria Antoniak, Steven R Wilson, Zexin Ma, Achyutarama R Ganti, Andrew Piper, Maarten Sap
papers.abstract: Reading stories evokes rich interpretive, affective, and evaluative responses, such as inferences about narrative intent or judgments about characters. Yet, computational models of reader response are limited, preventing nuanced analyses. To address this gap, we introduce SocialStoryFrames, a formalism for distilling plausible inferences about reader response, such as perceived author intent, explanatory and predictive reasoning, affective responses, and value judgments, using conversational context and a taxonomy grounded in narrative theory, linguistic pragmatics, and psychology. We develop two models, SSF-Generator and SSF-Classifier, validated through human surveys (N=382 participants) and expert annotations, respectively. We conduct pilot analyses to showcase the utility of the formalism for studying storytelling at scale. Specifically, applying our models to SSF-Corpus, a curated dataset of 6,140 social media stories from diverse contexts, we characterize the frequency and interdependence of storytelling intents, and we compare and contrast narrative practices (and their diversity) across communities. By linking fine-grained, context-sensitive modeling with a generic taxonomy of reader responses, SocialStoryFrames enable new research into storytelling in online communities.
papers.abstract_zh: 阅读故事会引发丰富的解读、情感和评价反应，比如对叙事意图的推断或对角色的评判。然而，现有的读者反应计算模型存在局限性，无法进行细致的分析。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了SocialStoryFrames这一框架。该框架能够利用对话上下文以及基于叙事理论、语言语用学和心理学构建的分类体系，来提炼关于读者反应的合理推断，例如对作者意图的认知、解释性和预测性推理、情感反应以及价值判断。我们开发了两个模型：SSF-Generator和SSF-Classifier。这两个模型都通过人类调查（参与人数达382人）和专家注释进行了验证。我们还进行了试点分析，以展示该框架在大规模研究叙事行为方面的实用性。具体来说，我们将这些模型应用于SSF-Corpus数据集——这是一个包含6,140条来自不同情境的社交媒体故事的精选数据集。通过研究这些故事中的叙事意图的频率和相互依赖性，我们能够比较不同社群之间的叙事实践及其多样性。通过将细粒度的、与上下文相关的建模与通用的读者反应分类体系相结合，SocialStoryFrames为在线社群中的叙事研究提供了新的工具。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Lightweight and Faithful Visual Condition Checking in Behavior Trees via Expert-Regularized Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过专家正则化强化学习实现行为树中的轻量级且高效的视觉状态检查功能
papers.authors: Hyosik Moon, Eldan Cohen
papers.abstract: Behavior trees provide a transparent and modular structure for encoding expert-designed policies, enabling interpretable decision-making in complex tasks. Yet, applying behavior trees to high-dimensional perceptual inputs such as images or language is challenging as defining symbolic predicates over raw perceptual data is non-trivial. While state-of-the-art large multimodal models (such as vision-language models) can overcome this issue by utilizing natural language queries over perceptual inputs, they incur high computational cost, making them unsuitable for many applications. Imitation learning offers a way to distill these expert models into compact models, though it requires extensive supervision. In contrast, reinforcement learning reduces the need for costly supervision but risks misalignment of condition nodes with their intended semantics as well as poor credit assignment. To address these challenges, we introduce CERL (Condition-node Expert-regularized Reinforcement Learning), a framework that leverages expert-regularized reinforcement learning to preserve semantic faithfulness, while employing a factorized policy that aggregates sequential condition-node decisions into a single decision unit to alleviate credit assignment challenges. Experiments across seven tasks from the GymCards, FrozenLake, and BabyAIText suites demonstrate that our framework outperforms pure imitation learning or reinforcement learning baselines, retains strong agreement with expert decisions, and achieves substantial gains in inference speed and model size over expert models. Our implementation is available in https://github.com/HyosikMoon/CERL.
papers.abstract_zh: 行为树提供了一种透明且模块化的结构，用于编码专家设计的策略，使得在复杂任务中能够做出可解释的决策。然而，将行为树应用于像图像或语言这样的高维感知输入时存在挑战，因为要在原始感知数据上定义符号谓词并非易事。虽然最先进的大型多模态模型（如视觉-语言模型）可以通过对感知输入进行自然语言查询来克服这个问题，但它们会带来较高的计算成本，因此不适合许多应用场景。模仿学习提供了一种将专家模型简化为紧凑模型的方法，不过这需要大量的监督工作。相比之下，强化学习则减少了对昂贵监督的需求，但可能会带来条件节点与其预期语义不一致的问题，以及信用分配方面的困难。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了CERL（条件节点专家正则化强化学习）框架。该框架利用专家正则化的强化学习来保持语义的忠实性，同时采用一种分解式策略，将连续的条件节点决策汇总为一个决策单元，从而缓解信用分配方面的挑战。通过在GymCards、FrozenLake和BabyAIText套件中的七项任务进行的实验表明，我们的框架优于纯模仿学习或强化学习的基线方法，与专家决策保持了良好的一致性，并且在推理速度和模型规模方面取得了显著改进。我们的实现代码可以在https://github.com/HyosikMoon/CERL下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When in Doubt, Consult: Expert Debate for Sexism Detection via Confidence-Based Routing
papers.title_zh: 犹豫时请寻求专家意见：通过基于信度的路由算法来识别性别歧视行为
papers.authors: Anwar Alajmi, Gabriele Pergola
papers.abstract: Online sexism increasingly appears in subtle, context-dependent forms that evade traditional detection methods. Its interpretation often depends on overlapping linguistic, psychological, legal, and cultural dimensions, which produce mixed and sometimes contradictory signals in annotated datasets. These inconsistencies, combined with label scarcity and class imbalance, result in unstable decision boundaries and cause fine-tuned models to overlook subtler, underrepresented forms of harm. To address these challenges, we propose a two-stage framework that unifies (i) targeted training procedures to better regularize supervision to scarce and noisy data with (ii) selective, reasoning-based inference to handle ambiguous or borderline cases. First, we stabilize the training combining class-balanced focal loss, class-aware batching, and post-hoc threshold calibration, strategies for the firs time adapted for this domain to mitigate label imbalance and noisy supervision. Second, we bridge the gap between efficiency and reasoning with a a dynamic routing mechanism that distinguishes between unambiguous instances and complex cases requiring a deliberative process. This reasoning process results in the novel Collaborative Expert Judgment (CEJ) module which prompts multiple personas and consolidates their reasoning through a judge model. Our approach outperforms existing approaches across several public benchmarks, with F1 gains of +4.48% and +1.30% on EDOS Tasks A and B, respectively, and a +2.79% improvement in ICM on EXIST 2025 Task 1.1.
papers.abstract_zh: 在线性别歧视以微妙且依赖于上下文的形式出现，难以被传统的检测方法捕捉到。对其解读往往需要考虑语言、心理、法律和文化等多个维度的影响，这些因素导致标注数据集中存在多种矛盾的信号。这些不一致性，加上标签的稀缺性和类别不平衡问题，使得决策边界变得不稳定，从而导致经过微调的模型无法识别那些更为隐蔽、未被充分反映的伤害形式。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种两阶段框架：首先，通过有针对性的训练程序来更好地规范对稀缺和噪声数据的监督；其次，采用基于推理的选择性方法来处理模糊或边缘案例。首先，我们通过结合类别平衡的焦点损失、类别感知的批量处理以及事后的阈值校准等策略来稳定训练过程，这些策略首次被应用于该领域，以缓解标签不平衡和噪声监督的问题。其次，我们通过一个动态路由机制来平衡效率和推理之间的平衡，该机制能够区分明确的情况和需要深思熟虑的复杂情况。这种推理过程催生了新颖的协作专家判断模块，该模块能够引导多个角色参与决策，并通过一个法官模型来整合他们的意见。我们的方法在多个公开基准测试中表现优异，分别在EDOS任务A和B上实现了4.48%和1.30%的F1值提升，在ICM的EXIST 2025任务1.1中实现了2.79%的改进。

papers.title: Failure Modes in Multi-Hop QA: The Weakest Link Effect and the Recognition Bottleneck
papers.title_zh: 多跳量子加密中的故障模式：最薄弱点的影响与识别瓶颈问题
papers.authors: Meiru Zhang, Zaiqiao Meng, Nigel Collier
papers.abstract: Despite scaling to massive context windows, Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with multi-hop reasoning due to inherent position bias, which causes them to overlook information at certain positions. Whether these failures stem from an inability to locate evidence (recognition failure) or integrate it (synthesis failure) is unclear. We introduce Multi-Focus Attention Instruction (MFAI), a semantic probe to disentangle these mechanisms by explicitly steering attention towards selected positions. Across 5 LLMs on two multi-hop QA tasks (MuSiQue and NeoQA), we identify the “Weakest Link Effect”: in our 18-document, 3-bucket setting, multi-hop reasoning performance collapses to the level of the least visible evidence, governed by absolute position rather than the linear distance between facts. While matched MFAI resolves recognition bottlenecks, improving accuracy by up to 11.49% in low-visibility positions, misleading MFAI yields divergent effects modulated by task topology: entity-centric tasks with vertical reasoning chains are vulnerable, whereas event-centric tasks with horizontal evidence structures are more resilient. Finally, we demonstrate that “thinking” models utilizing System-2 reasoning effectively locate and integrate the required information, matching gold-only baselines even in noisy, long-context settings. Supplementary experiments on 2WikiMultiHopQA, extended 3-4 hop counts, and a 32B model confirm these findings generalize across datasets, reasoning depths, and model scales.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型能够处理庞大的上下文信息，但它们在多跳推理方面仍然存在困难，这主要是由于它们固有的位置偏见导致的。这种偏见使得模型无法注意到某些位置的详细信息。目前尚不清楚这些失败是由于无法找到证据（识别失败）还是无法整合这些证据（合成失败）。我们提出了多焦点注意力指令技术，这是一种语义探针，可以通过明确地将注意力引导到选定的位置来分离这些机制。在五个大语言模型上进行的两个多跳问答任务中，我们发现了一个“最薄弱环节效应”：在我们的18篇文档、3个桶状结构的设置中，多跳推理性能下降到了最不显眼的证据水平，这一性能受到绝对位置的影响，而非事实之间的线性距离。而经过优化的多焦点注意力指令技术则解决了识别瓶颈问题，在低可见位置上的准确率提高了11.49%。不过，错误的多焦点注意力指令技术则产生了不同的效果，这种效果会受到任务结构的影响：以实体为中心的任务由于存在垂直推理链而容易受到影响，而以事件为中心的任务则具有横向证据结构，因此更具韧性。最后，我们证明了使用系统二推理能力的“思考”模型能够有效地定位并整合所需信息，即使在嘈杂且上下文较长的环境中，其表现也与仅使用黄金数据的基线模型相当。在2WikiMultiHopQA、扩展至3-4跳的上下文以及32B规模的模型上的补充实验也证实了这些发现具有通用性，适用于不同的数据集、推理深度和模型规模。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TagSpeech: End-to-End Multi-Speaker ASR and Diarization with Fine-Grained Temporal Grounding
papers.title_zh: TagSpeech：端到端多说话者自动语音识别技术，以及精细时间感知的语音分离算法
papers.authors: Mingyue Huo, Yiwen Shao, Yuheng Zhang
papers.abstract: We present TagSpeech, a unified LLM-based framework that utilizes Temporal Anchor Grounding for joint multi-speaker ASR and diarization. The framework is built on two key designs: (1) decoupled semantic and speaker streams fine-tuned via Serialized Output Training (SOT) to learn turn-taking dynamics; and (2) an interleaved time anchor mechanism that not only supports fine-grained timestamp prediction but also acts as a synchronization signal between semantic understanding and speaker tracking. Compared to previous works that primarily focus on speaker-attributed ASR or implicit diarization, TagSpeech addresses the challenge of fine-grained speaker-content alignment and explicitly models who spoke what and when in an end-to-end manner. Experiments on AMI and AliMeeting benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves consistent improvements in Diarization Error Rate (DER) over strong end-to-end baselines, including Qwen-Omni and Gemini, particularly in handling complex speech overlaps. Moreover, TagSpeech employs a parameter-efficient training paradigm in which the LLM backbone is frozen and only lightweight projectors are trained, resulting in strong performance with low computational cost
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了TagSpeech这一基于大语言模型的统一框架，该框架利用时间锚定技术来实现多说话者语音识别与说话人分割的联合处理。该框架基于两个核心设计：第一，通过串行输出训练方法对语义流和说话者流进行分离训练，以学习对话动态；第二，采用交错的时间锚定机制，不仅能实现细粒度的时间戳预测，还能作为语义理解与说话人跟踪之间的同步信号。与那些主要关注说话者属性或隐式说话人分割的先前方法相比，TagSpeech能够解决细粒度说话人内容对齐的问题，并能够端到端地明确建模谁说了什么以及何时说的。在AMI和AliMeeting基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法在说话人分割错误率方面取得了显著改进，尤其是在处理复杂的语音重叠情况时。此外，TagSpeech采用了一种参数高效的训练方式，即冻结了大语言模型主干结构，只训练一些轻量级的投影层，从而在保持高性能的同时降低了计算成本。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: On the Effect of Hyperparameters in Language Modeling for Computational Linguistics
papers.title_zh: 关于超参数在计算语言学中的语言建模效果研究
papers.authors: Ruoxi Ning, Yongpeng Zhu, Qingcheng Zeng, Tatsuki Kuribayashi, Freda Shi
papers.abstract: Training language models and examining their linguistic behaviors have been a common protocol in computational linguistics for studying linguistic phenomena and modeling human language processing. However, work in this area is often limited to proof-of-concept demonstrations with arbitrary model configurations, without considering hyperparameter sensitivity, an important source of variation in model performance. In this work, we replicate three prior studies (Chang and Bergen, 2022; Hu et al., 2020b; Kuribayashi et al., 2024) with hyperparameters varied within a practical range, and show that modest hyperparameter changes can alter some qualitative conclusions about models’ linguistic abilities and even reverse the ranking of model performance. Our results highlight the risk that prior work may have reflected optimization artifacts rather than the genuine inductive biases of model classes, and that hyperparameter sensitivity should receive more attention as a factor that can meaningfully influence model behavior. We suggest future work to report the variation of performance across the configuration space to enhance the reliability and generalizability of conclusions. Code: https://github.com/compling-wat/tune-linguistic-lms.
papers.abstract_zh: 在计算语言学中，训练语言模型并研究它们的语言行为是一种常见的研究方法，用于探究语言现象并模拟人类语言处理过程。然而，这一领域的研究往往局限于使用任意模型配置进行的概念验证实验，而并未考虑超参数的敏感性——这是模型性能波动的一个重要来源。在这项研究中，我们复制了三项先前的研究结果（Chang和Bergen，2022年；Hu等人，2020b年；Kuribayashi等人，2024年），并在实际可行的范围内调整了超参数，结果表明，微小的超参数变化可能会改变关于模型语言能力的某些定性结论，甚至有可能使模型的性能排名发生逆转。我们的研究结果表明，先前的研究可能存在优化上的缺陷，而非模型类别的真实归纳偏差。因此，超参数的敏感性应该被视作一个能够显著影响模型行为的因素，从而需要更多的关注。我们建议未来的研究应记录不同配置下模型的性能变化，以提高结论的可靠性和普遍性。代码链接：https://github.com/compling-wat/tune-linguistic-lms。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Prosody as Supervision: Bridging the Non-Verbal–Verbal for Multilingual Speech Emotion Recognition
papers.title_zh: 韵律在情感识别中的作用：连接非语言与语言的桥梁
papers.authors: Girish, Mohd Mujtaba Akhtar, Muskaan Singh
papers.abstract: In this work, we introduce a paralinguistic supervision paradigm for low-resource multilingual speech emotion recognition (LRM-SER) that leverages non-verbal vocalizations to exploit prosody-centric emotion cues. Unlike conventional SER systems that rely heavily on labeled verbal speech and suffer from poor cross-lingual transfer, our approach reformulates LRM-SER as non-verbal-to-verbal transfer, where supervision from a labelled non-verbal source domain is adapted to unlabeled verbal speech across multiple target languages. To this end, we propose NOVA-ARC, a geometry-aware framework that models affective structure in the Poincaré ball, discretizes paralinguistic patterns via a hyperbolic vector-quantized prosody codebook, and captures emotion intensity through a hyperbolic emotion lens. For unsupervised adaptation, NOVA-ARC performs optimal-transport-based prototype alignment between source emotion prototypes and target utterances, inducing soft supervision for unlabeled speech while being stabilized through consistency regularization. Experiments show that NOVA-ARC delivers the strongest performance under both non-verbal-to-verbal adaptation and the complementary verbal-to-verbal transfer setting, consistently outperforming Euclidean counter parts and strong SSL baselines. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to move beyond verbal-speech–centric supervision by introducing a non-verbal–to–verbal transfer paradigm for SER.
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，我们提出了一种低资源多语言语音情感识别的副语言监督范式（LRM-SER），该范式利用非言语发声来提取以韵律为中心的情感线索。与那些严重依赖标记过的口语数据的传统SER系统不同，我们的方法将LRM-SER改造成一种非言语到言语的迁移机制，即利用来自标记过非言语领域的监督信息来指导多个目标语言中的未标记口语数据。为此，我们提出了NOVA-ARC框架——一个注重几何结构的模型，该框架在Poincaré球面上对情感结构进行建模，通过双曲向量量化韵律编码簿来离散化副语言模式，并通过双曲情感透镜来捕捉情感强度。在无监督适应方面，NOVA-ARC实现了基于最优传输的原型对齐技术，使得未标记语音能够获得软监督，同时通过一致性正则化来确保模型的稳定性。实验表明，NOVA-ARC在非言语到言语的迁移以及互补的言语到言语的迁移场景中均表现出最强的性能，其表现始终优于欧几里得方法和强大的SSL基线算法。据我们所知，这是第一项通过引入非言语到言语的迁移范式来超越以口语为中心的监督技术的研究。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Mechanisms of Prompt-Induced Hallucination in Vision–Language Models
papers.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型中由提示引发的幻觉机制
papers.authors: William Rudman, Michal Golovanevsky, Dana Arad, Yonatan Belinkov, Carsten Eickhoff, Ritambhara Singh, Kyle Mahowald
papers.abstract: Large vision–language models (VLMs) are highly capable, yet often hallucinate by favoring textual prompts over visual evidence. We study this failure mode in a controlled object-counting setting, where the prompt overstates the number of objects in the image (e.g., asking a model to describe four waterlilies when only three are present). At low object counts, models often correct the overestimation, but as the number of objects increases, they increasingly conform to the prompt regardless of the discrepancy. Through mechanistic analysis of three VLMs, we identify a small set of attention heads whose ablation substantially reduces prompt-induced hallucinations (PIH) by at least 40% without additional training. Across models, PIH-heads mediate prompt copying in model-specific ways. We characterize these differences and show that PIH ablation increases correction toward visual evidence. Our findings offer insights into the internal mechanisms driving prompt-induced hallucinations, revealing model-specific differences in how these behaviors are implemented.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型虽然功能强大，但往往会出现幻觉现象，这是因为它们更倾向于依赖文本提示而非视觉信息来进行推理。我们在一项控制条件下的物体计数实验中研究了这种失败模式。实验中，提示所描述的对象数量往往高于实际图像中的对象数量（例如，要求模型描述四朵睡莲，而实际上只有三朵）。在物体数量较少的情况下，模型通常会纠正这种高估现象；但随着物体数量的增加，模型越来越倾向于遵循提示的描述，而忽略实际存在的差异。通过对三种视觉-语言模型的机制分析，我们发现有一组特定的注意力区域，通过对这些区域的训练，可以在不增加额外训练成本的情况下，将由提示引起的幻觉现象减少至少40%。不同模型中，这些幻觉产生区域以不同的方式介导对提示的复制行为。我们进一步分析了这些差异，发现对幻觉产生区域进行训练能够促使模型更多地依赖视觉信息来进行推理。我们的研究结果揭示了导致提示引起的幻觉现象的内部机制，并指出了不同模型在如何实现这些行为的差异。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: LLM4Cell: Taxonomy and Evaluation of LLM and Agentic Models for Single-Cell Biology
papers.title_zh: LLM4Cell：针对单细胞生物学的大型语言模型与智能体模型的分类与评估
papers.authors: Sajib Acharjee Dip, Adrika Zafor, Bikash Kumar Paul, Uddip Acharjee Shuvo, Muhit Islam Emon, Xuan Wang, Liqing Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and emerging agentic frameworks are beginning to influence single-cell biology by enabling natural-language interfaces, generative annotation, and multimodal data integration. However, progress remains fragmented across data modalities, model families, and evaluation practices. LLM4Cell presents a unified survey of 58 foundation and agentic models developed for single-cell research, spanning RNA, ATAC, multi-omic, and spatial modalities. We organize these methods into five families foundation, text-bridge, spatial/multimodal, epigenomic, and agentic and map them to eight key analytical tasks, including annotation, trajectory inference, perturbation modeling, and drug-response prediction. Drawing on over 40 public datasets, we analyze benchmark coverage, data diversity, and ethical or scalability constraints, and synthesize reported capabilities across ten domain-level dimensions related to biological grounding, multimodal alignment, fairness, privacy, and interpretability. By explicitly linking datasets, modeling paradigms, and evaluation domains, LLM4Cell provides an integrated perspective on language-driven single-cell analysis and highlights open challenges in standardization, interpretability, and trustworthy model development.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）和新兴的代理框架开始通过提供自然语言接口、生成式注释以及多模态数据整合等方式，对单细胞生物学产生积极影响。然而，这些进展在不同数据类型、模型类别以及评估方法上存在差异。LLM4Cell对为单细胞研究开发的58种基础模型和代理模型进行了全面梳理，这些模型涵盖了RNA测序、ATAC测序、多组学分析以及空间数据分析等多种模式。我们将这些方法分为五个类别：基础模型、文本桥梁模型、空间/多模态模型、表观基因组学模型，以及代理模型。然后，我们将这些模型与八项关键分析任务相结合，包括注释、轨迹推断、扰动建模以及药物反应预测等。基于超过40个公开数据集，我们分析了基准测试覆盖范围、数据多样性以及伦理或可扩展性方面的限制因素。同时，我们从十个与生物信息学基础、多模态对齐、公平性、隐私保护以及可解释性相关的维度上，综合了各模型的性能表现。通过明确连接不同数据集、建模范式和评估领域，LLM4Cell为语言驱动的单细胞分析提供了统一的视角，并指出了在标准化、可解释性和可信模型开发方面存在的挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
