papers.title: Wait! There’s a Way Out: A Decision Mechanism for Forecasting Conversational Derailment
papers.title_zh: 等等！其实还有别的出路：一种用于预测对话偏离正常轨道情况的决策机制
papers.authors: Laerdon Kim, Vivian Nguyen, Cristian Danescu-Niculescu-Mizil
papers.abstract: Forecasting conversational derailment is the task of predicting, as the conversation unfolds, whether it will eventually derail into personal attacks. Since forecasting models operate in an online fashion, they must decide whether to “trigger” an alert after each utterance—for example, to notify participants or a moderator that the conversation is at risk of derailing. Existing approaches make this decision solely based on the estimated likelihood of derailment given the preceding utterances, implicitly assuming that the conversation’s future trajectory is fixed. As a result, they ignore the possibility of future recovery and incur an unnecessarily high rate of false positives.In this work we propose a method for decoupling the decision to trigger from derailment likelihood estimation. Our approach is inspired by the first human baseline on this task, which shows that humans achieve dramatically lower false positive rates by selectively deferring their decision to trigger when they anticipate that tension is likely to subside. We operationalize this insight with a deferral mechanism that uses forward-looking simulations to assess whether a tense moment admits plausible paths to recovery. Incorporating this mechanism into a state-of-the-art forecasting model substantially reduces false positives without sacrificing forecasting accuracy. More broadly, this work highlights the value of treating decision-making as a first-class component of forecasting systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 预测对话的偏离情况，即预测在对话进行过程中是否最终会演变成个人攻击。由于预测模型是实时运行的，因此必须在每次发言后决定是否“触发”警报——例如，通知参与者或主持人，对话有偏离的风险。现有的方法仅基于之前发言所预测的偏离可能性来做出决策，这隐含着认为对话的未来走向是固定的假设。因此，它们忽略了未来恢复的可能性，导致误报率过高。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种将触发决策与偏离可能性估计分离开的方法。我们的方法借鉴了人类在这一任务上的首个基准数据，数据显示，当人类预见到紧张局势可能会缓解时，他们会选择性地推迟触发决策，从而将误报率显著降低。我们通过一种延迟机制来实现这一理念，该机制利用前瞻性模拟来评估某个紧张时刻是否有可行的恢复路径。将这一机制整合到先进的预测模型中，可以在不牺牲预测准确性的情况下大幅降低误报率。更广泛地说，这项工作强调了将决策制定作为预测系统的重要组成部分的重要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Nodes to Narratives: Explaining Graph Neural Networks with LLMs and Graph Context
papers.title_zh: 从节点到叙事：利用大语言模型和图上下文来解释图神经网络的工作原理
papers.authors: Peyman Baghershahi, Gregoire Fournier, Pranav Nyati, Sourav Medya
papers.abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as powerful tools for learning over structured data, including text-attributed graphs (TAGs), which are common in domains such as citation networks, social platforms, and knowledge graphs. GNNs are not inherently interpretable and thus, many explanation methods have been proposed. However, existing explanation methods often struggle to generate interpretable, fine-grained rationales, especially when node attributes include rich natural language. In this work, we introduce GSPELL, a lightweight, post-hoc framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to generate faithful and interpretable explanations for GNN predictions. GSPELL projects GNN node embeddings into the LLM embedding space and constructs hybrid prompts that interleave soft prompts with textual inputs from the graph structure. This enables the LLM to reason about GNN internal representations and to produce natural-language explanations, along with concise explanation subgraphs. Our experiments across real-world TAG datasets demonstrate that GSPELL achieves a favorable trade-off between fidelity and sparsity, while improving human-centric metrics such as insightfulness. GSPELL sets a new direction for LLM-based explainability in graph learning by aligning GNN internals with human reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 图神经网络（GNNs）已成为处理结构化数据的强大工具，包括文本属性图（TAGs），这类图在引用网络、社交平台和知识图谱等领域中非常常见。然而，GNNs本身并不具备可解释性，因此人们提出了许多解释方法。不过，现有的解释方法往往难以生成可解释的、详细的理由，尤其是在节点属性包含丰富的自然语言信息时。在这项研究中，我们提出了GSPELL这一轻量级的后置框架，它利用大语言模型（LLMs）来生成对GNN预测的可解释性解释。GSPELL将GNN节点的嵌入映射到LLM的嵌入空间中，并构建出混合式提示，将软提示与图结构中的文本输入相结合。这样，LLM就能对GNN的内部表示进行推理，并生成自然语言解释以及简洁的解释子图。我们在真实世界的TAG数据集上进行的实验表明，GSPELL在准确性和稀疏性之间取得了良好的平衡，同时提升了以人类为中心的指标，如洞察力。GSPELL为基于LLM的图学习可解释性研究开辟了新的方向，它将GNN的内部结构与人类推理方式进行了对齐。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RealChart2Code: Bridging the Gap in Real-World Chart-to-Code Generation via Multi-Task Evaluation
papers.title_zh: RealChart2Code：通过多任务评估来填补现实世界中图表到代码生成的空白
papers.authors: Jiajun Zhang, Yuying Li, Zhixun Li, Xingyu Guo, Jingzhuo Wu, Leqi Zheng, Yiran Yang, Jianke Zhang, Qingbin Li, Shannan Yan, Changguo Jia, Junfei Wu, Zilei Wang, Qiang Liu, Liang Wang
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in code generation across various domains. However, their ability to replicate complex, multi-panel visualizations from real-world data remains largely unassessed. To address this gap, we introduce RealChart2Code, a new large-scale benchmark with over 2,800 instances grounded in authentic datasets and featuring tasks with clear analytical intent. Crucially, it is the first benchmark to systematically evaluate chart generation from large-scale raw data and assess iterative code refinement in a multi-turn conversational setting. Our comprehensive evaluation of 14 leading VLMs on RealChart2Code reveals significant performance degradation compared to simpler benchmarks, highlighting their struggles with complex plot structures and authentic data. Our analysis uncovers a substantial performance gap between proprietary and open-weight models and confirms that even state-of-the-art VLMs often fail to accurately replicate intricate, multi-panel charts. These findings provide valuable insights into the current limitations of VLMs and guide future research directions.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在多种领域的代码生成任务中展现出了令人印象深刻的性能。然而，它们复制现实世界数据中复杂多面板图表的能力仍然没有得到充分评估。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了RealChart2Code这一新的大规模基准测试，该测试包含超过2800个实例，这些实例都基于真实数据集，且任务具有明确的分析意图。重要的是，这是首个能够系统评估从大规模原始数据生成图表的能力，并在多轮对话环境中评估代码迭代优化的基准测试。我们对14种主流视觉语言模型在RealChart2Code上的表现进行了全面评估，发现与简单的基准测试相比，它们的性能有了显著下降，这凸显了它们在处理复杂图表结构和真实数据时存在的困难。我们的分析还发现，专有模型和开放权重模型之间的性能存在较大差距，甚至最先进的视觉语言模型也常常无法准确复制复杂的多面板图表。这些发现为理解视觉语言模型的当前局限性提供了宝贵的见解，并为未来的研究方向指明了方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Success and Cost Elicit Convention Formation for Efficient Communication
papers.title_zh: 成功与成本促使了高效沟通方式的形成
papers.authors: Saujas Vaduguru, Yilun Hua, Yoav Artzi, Daniel Fried
papers.abstract: Humans leverage shared conversational context to become increasingly successful and efficient at communicating over time. One manifestation of this is the formation of ad hoc linguistic conventions, which allow people to coordinate on short, less costly utterances that are understood using shared conversational context. We present a method to train large multimodal models to form conventions, enabling efficient communication. Our approach uses simulated reference games between models, and requires no additional human-produced data. In repeated reference games involving photographs and tangram images, our method enables models to communicate efficiently with people: reducing the message length by up to 41% while increasing success by 15% over the course of the interaction. Human listeners respond faster when interacting with our model that forms conventions. We also show that training based on success or cost alone is insufficient – both are necessary to elicit convention formation.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类通过利用共同的对话语境，随着时间的推移而变得更加擅长和高效地进行交流。这种现象的一种表现就是特定语言惯例的形成，这些惯例让人们能够用简短且成本较低的表达方式来沟通，而这些表达可以通过共同的对话语境来理解。我们提出了一种方法，用于训练大型多模态模型以形成这些惯例，从而实现高效的交流。我们的方法利用了模型之间的模拟参考游戏，并且不需要额外的人工数据。在涉及照片和七巧板的重复参考游戏中，我们的方法使得模型能够与人类进行高效交流：消息长度减少了41%，而交互过程中的成功率则提高了15%。与那些没有形成惯例的模型相比，人类听众在与我们的模型互动时反应更快。我们还表明，仅基于成功或成本来进行训练是不足以引发惯例形成的——两者都是必要的条件。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Measuring User’s Mental Models of Speech Translation in Human-AI Collaboration
papers.title_zh: 衡量用户在人机交互中对于语音翻译的心理模型
papers.authors: HyoJung Han, Nishant Balepur, Jordan Lee Boyd-Graber, Marine Carpuat
papers.abstract: Millions of people use machine translation (MT) tools daily, yet little is known about their perception of what systems can and cannot do. This paper studies users’ mental models of speech translation systems through a new framework based on cross-lingual question answering, where users either accept MT output or request professional re-translation to answer questions based on the information presented in a foreign language. By analyzing user behavior and accuracy trends across varying translation qualities, we examine to what extent they can predict where the system is likely to be wrong, and how this mental model evolves. Users develop stronger mental models with practice, especially when they have some knowledge of the source language, primarily by relying on surface-level error cues. Moreover, providing speech transcriptions can help users develop better mental models. Our results show the promise of cross-lingual question answering as a downstream task for studying MT mental models and advancing our understanding of human–AI collaboration.
papers.abstract_zh: 每天有数以百万计的人使用机器翻译工具，然而人们对这些系统能做什么和不能做什么却知之甚少。本文通过基于跨语言问题回答的新框架来研究用户对语音翻译系统的认知模型。在这种框架下，用户要么接受机器翻译的结果，要么请求专业人员重新翻译以根据外语中呈现的信息来回答问题。通过分析不同翻译质量下的用户行为和准确性趋势，我们探讨了用户在多大程度上能够预测系统可能出现的错误，以及这种认知模型是如何发展的。随着实践经验的积累，尤其是当用户具备一些源语言知识时，他们能够形成更强大的认知模型，这主要依赖于表面级的错误线索。此外，提供语音转录内容也有助于用户建立更好的认知模型。我们的研究结果表明，跨语言问题回答作为研究机器翻译认知模型的下游任务，具有很大的潜力，有助于我们更深入地了解人类与人工智能的协作关系。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VeriTaS: The First Dynamic Benchmark for Multimodal Automated Fact-Checking
papers.title_zh: VeriTaS：首个用于多模态自动事实核查的动态基准测试工具
papers.authors: Mark Rothermel, Marcus Kornmann, Marcus Rohrbach, Anna Rohrbach
papers.abstract: The growing scale of online misinformation urgently demands Automated Fact-Checking (AFC). Existing benchmarks for evaluating AFC systems, however, are largely limited in terms of task scope, modalities, domain, language diversity, realism, or coverage of misinformation types. Critically, they are static, thus subject to data leakage as their claims enter the pretraining corpora of LLMs. As a result, benchmark performance no longer reliably reflects the actual ability to verify claims.We introduce Verified Theses and Statements (VeriTaS), the first dynamic benchmark for multimodal AFC, designed to remain robust under ongoing large-scale pretraining of foundation models. VeriTaS currently comprises 25,000 real-world claims from 104 professional fact-checking organizations across 54 languages, covering textual and audiovisual content. Claims are added quarterly via a fully automated seven-stage pipeline that normalizes claim formulation, retrieves original media, and maps heterogeneous expert verdicts to a novel, standardized, and disentangled scoring scheme with textual justifications.Through human evaluation, we demonstrate that the automated annotations closely match human judgments.We commit to updating VeriTaS in the future, establishing a leakage-resistant benchmark, supporting meaningful AFC evaluation in the era of rapidly evolving foundation models.The code and data are publicly available under https://veritas.mai.informatik.tu-darmstadt.de.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着在线虚假信息的规模不断扩大，自动化事实核查技术变得愈发重要。然而，现有的事实核查系统评估基准在任务范围、方式、领域、语言多样性、真实性以及虚假信息类型的覆盖方面都存在局限性。更严重的是，这些基准是静态的，因此当它们的结论被输入到大语言模型的预训练语料库中时，容易出现数据泄露问题。这样一来，这些基准的性能就无法可靠地反映实际的事实核查能力了。为此，我们推出了“验证论文与声明”这一动态多模态事实核查基准，旨在在基础模型持续大规模预训练的情况下仍能保持可靠性。目前，VeriTaS包含了来自104个专业事实核查机构的25,000条真实世界案例，这些案例涉及54种语言，涵盖文本和视听内容。这些案例通过全自动的七步流程每季度更新一次，该流程包括规范案例表述、检索原始媒体资料，并将不同专家的意见转化为一种新颖、标准化且易于理解的评分体系，同时提供文本说明。通过人工评估，我们发现自动生成的注释与人类判断非常一致。我们承诺未来会不断更新VeriTaS，打造一个具有抗数据泄露能力的基准，为快速演变的基础模型时代提供有效的事实核查支持。相关的代码和数据可在以下链接获取：https://veritas.mai.informatik.tu-darmstadt.de
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: A Survey of Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Progress and Challenges
papers.title_zh: 关于推理密集型检索的研究：现状与挑战
papers.authors: Yiyang Wei, Tingyu Song, Siyue Zhang, Yilun Zhao
papers.abstract: Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval (RIR) targets retrieval settings where relevance is mediated by latent inferential links between a query and supporting evidence, rather than semantic similarity. Motivated by the emergent reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), recent work integrates these capabilities into the IR field, spanning the entire pipeline from benchmarks to retrievers and rerankers. Despite this progress, the field lacks a systematic framework to organize current efforts and articulate a clear path forward. To provide a clear roadmap for this rapidly growing yet fragmented area, this survey (1) systematizes existing RIR benchmarks by knowledge domains and modalities, providing a detailed analysis of the current landscape; (2) introduces a structured taxonomy that categorizes methods based on where and how reasoning is integrated into the retrieval pipeline, alongside an analysis of their trade-offs and practical applications; and (3) summarizes challenges and future directions to guide research in this evolving field.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理密集型检索（RIR）关注的是那些以查询与支持性证据之间的潜在推理联系为相关性的检索场景，而非基于语义相似性的检索方式。鉴于大语言模型所展现出的强大推理能力，近期的研究将这一能力融入了检索领域，涵盖了从基准测试到检索器及重排序算法的整个流程。尽管取得了这些进展，但该领域仍缺乏一个系统化的框架来整合现有的研究成果，并明确未来的发展方向。为了为这一快速发展的但相对分散的领域提供清晰的路线图，本综述工作做了以下工作：1）按知识领域和模态对现有的RIR基准测试进行系统化整理，对当前的研究现状进行详细分析；2）提出一种结构化的分类体系，根据推理方式及其在检索流程中的整合程度来对方法进行分类，同时分析这些方法之间的权衡以及实际应用情况；3）总结当前面临的挑战以及未来研究的方向，以指导这一不断发展的领域的科研工作。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Which Reasoning Trajectories Teach Students to Reason Better? A Simple Metric of Informative Alignment
papers.title_zh: 哪些推理路径能帮助学生更好地进行思考？一种衡量信息一致性的简单方法
papers.authors: Yuming Yang, Mingyoung Lai, Wanxu Zhao, Xiaoran Fan, Zhiheng Xi, Mingqi Wu, Chiyue Huang, Jun Zhao, Haijun Lv, Jian Tong, Yunhua Zhou, Yicheng Zou, Qipeng Guo, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories provide rich supervision signals for distilling reasoning from teacher to student LLMs. However, both prior work and our experiments show that trajectories from stronger teachers do not necessarily yield better students, highlighting the importance of data-student suitability in distillation. Existing methods assess suitability primarily through student likelihood, favoring trajectories that align closely with the student model’s current behavior but overlooking more informative ones. Addressing this, we propose Rank–Surprisal Ratio (RSR), a simple metric that captures both alignment and informativeness to assess the suitability of a reasoning trajectory. RSR is motivated by the observation that effective trajectories typically balance learning signal strength and behavioral alignment by combining low absolute probability with relatively high-ranked tokens under the student model.Concretely, RSR is defined as the ratio of a trajectory’s average token-wise rank to its average negative log-likelihood, and is straightforward to compute and interpret. Across five student models and reasoning trajectories from 11 diverse teachers, RSR strongly correlates with post-training reasoning performance (average Spearman 0.86), consistently outperforming existing metrics. We further demonstrate its practical utility in both trajectory selection and teacher selection.
papers.abstract_zh: 长链式思维轨迹为从教师到学生的大语言模型提取推理信息提供了丰富的监督信号。然而，无论是先前的研究还是我们的实验都表明，来自更强教师的轨迹并不一定能带来更好的学生表现，这凸显了数据与学生适配性在推理提取中的重要性。现有方法主要通过学生模型的潜在概率来评估数据的适配性，这种方式倾向于选择那些与模型当前行为高度一致的轨迹，而忽略了更具信息量的轨迹。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Rank-Surprisal Ratio（RSR）这一简单指标，它能够同时衡量轨迹的适配性和信息量，从而评估其适配性。RSR的提出基于这样一个观察：有效的轨迹通常能够结合低绝对概率和相对高排名的标记，从而平衡学习信号的强度和行为的适应性。具体来说，RSR被定义为轨迹中每个标记的平均排名与其平均负对数似然的比值，该指标易于计算且易于理解。在11位不同教师的5种学生模型和推理轨迹上进行了测试，结果表明RSR与训练后的推理性能有很强的相关性（Spearman相关系数平均为0.86），并且其表现优于现有的其他评估指标。我们还证明了RSR在轨迹选择和教师选择方面的实际效用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Proof to Program: Characterizing Tool-Induced Reasoning Hallucinations in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从证明到程序：描述大型语言模型中由工具引发的推理现象
papers.authors: Farima Fatahi Bayat, Pouya Pezeshkpour, Estevam Hruschka
papers.abstract: Tool-augmented Language Models (TaLMs) can invoke external tools to solve problems beyond their parametric capacity. However, it remains unclear whether these tool-enabled gains reflect trustworthy reasoning. Focusing on the Code Interpreter tool, we show that even when tools are selected and executed correctly, TaLMs treat tool outputs as substitutes for reasoning, producing solutions that appear correct but lack coherent justification. We term this failure mode Tool-Induced Myopia (TIM), and study it using PyMath, a benchmark of 1,679 competition-level mathematical problems for which Python code is helpful but not sufficient. We further develop a multi-dimensional evaluation suite to quantify reasoning degradation in TaLMs relative to their non-tool counterparts. Our findings reveal that while TaLMs achieve up to a 19.3 percentage point gain in final-answer accuracy, their reasoning behavior consistently deteriorates (e.g., non-tool language models win up to 41.5% more often in pairwise comparisons of reasoning processes). This degradation intensifies with tool use; the more frequently a model invokes tools, the less coherent its reasoning becomes. Moreover, tool use shifts errors from arithmetic mistakes toward global reasoning failures (logic, assumption, creativity). Finally, we propose a preference-optimization-based framework that realigns TaLMs to use tool outputs as assistive evidence, improving both final-answer accuracy and reasoning depth under tool use. Code and data will be released upon publication.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具增强语言模型（TaLMs）能够调用外部工具来解决超出其参数能力的问题。然而，目前尚不清楚这些由工具辅助的改进是否体现了可靠的推理能力。以代码解释器工具为例，我们发现即使正确选择并执行了工具，TaLMs仍会将工具的输出视为推理的替代品，从而得出看似正确的解决方案，但这些解决方案缺乏连贯的论证依据。我们将这种缺陷模式称为“工具诱导的近视”（Tool-Induced Myopia，TIM）。我们使用PyMath这一包含1,679个竞赛级别数学问题的基准测试来研究这一现象，在这些问题中，Python代码虽然有帮助作用，但并不能完全替代人类的推理能力。我们进一步开发了一个多维评估体系，用于量化TaLMs与非工具模型在推理能力上的差异。研究发现，尽管TaLMs在最终答案的准确性上提升了19.3个百分点，但它们的推理能力却持续下降（例如，在非工具语言模型中，在成对比较推理过程时，TaLMs的胜率高达41.5%）。随着工具使用的增加，这种下降更为明显；模型调用工具的频率越高，其推理的连贯性就越差。此外，工具的使用还使得错误从算术错误转变为全局推理失败（如逻辑、假设和创造力方面的问题）。最后，我们提出了一个基于偏好优化的框架，该框架使TaLMs能够将工具输出作为辅助证据来使用，从而在工具使用的情况下提高最终答案的准确性以及推理的深度。相关代码和数据将在论文发表后公开。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Paper Circle: An Open-source Multi-agent Research Discovery and Analysis Framework
papers.title_zh: Paper Circle：一个开源的多智能体研究发现与分析框架
papers.authors: Komal Kumar, Aman Chadha, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Hisham Cholakkal
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of scientific literature has made it increasingly difficult for researchers to efficiently discover, evaluate, and synthesize relevant work. Recent advances in multi-agent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for understanding user intent and are being trained to utilize various tools.In this paper, we introduce Paper Circle, a multi-agent research discovery and analysis system designed to reduce the effort required to find, assess, organize, and understand academic literature. The system comprises two complementary pipelines: (1) a Discovery Pipeline that integrates offline and online retrieval from multiple sources, multi-criteria scoring, diversity-aware ranking, and structured outputs; and (2) an Analysis Pipeline that transforms individual papers into structured knowledge graphs with typed nodes (e.g., concepts, methods, experiments, and figures) and edges, enabling graph-aware question answering and coverage verification. Both pipelines are implemented within a coder LLM–based multi-agent orchestration framework and produce fully reproducible, synchronized outputs (JSON, CSV, BibTeX, Markdown, and HTML) at each agent step. This paper describes the system architecture, agent roles, retrieval and scoring methods, knowledge graph schema, and evaluation interfaces that together form the Paper Circle research workflow. We benchmark Paper Circle on both paper retrieval and paper review generation, reporting hit rate, MRR, and Recall@K. Results show consistent improvements with stronger agent models. We have publicly released the website:https://papercircle.vercel.app/ and code: https://github.com/MAXNORM8650/papercircle.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学文献的快速增长使得研究人员难以高效地发现、评估和分析相关研究成果。最近在多智能体大语言模型领域取得的进展表明，这些模型在理解用户意图方面具有巨大潜力，并且正在被训练以使用各种工具。在本文中，我们介绍了Paper Circle——一个多智能体研究发现与分析系统，旨在减少寻找、评估、整理和理解学术文献所需的努力。该系统由两个互补的流程组成：(1) 发现流程，该流程整合了来自多种来源的离线与在线检索、多标准评分、多样性感知排序以及结构化输出；(2) 分析流程，该流程将单个论文转化为具有不同类型节点（如概念、方法、实验和图表）和边的结构化知识图谱，从而实现基于图的问答和覆盖验证。这两个流程都运行在一个基于编码器语言模型的多智能体协调框架内，并在每个智能体步骤中生成完全可复制且同步的输出（JSON、CSV、BibTeX、Markdown和HTML格式）。本文描述了系统的架构、智能体角色、检索和评分方法、知识图谱结构以及评估接口，这些共同构成了Paper Circle的研究工作流程。我们在论文检索和论文评审生成方面对Paper Circle进行了基准测试，并报告了命中率、MRR和Recall@K等指标。结果表明，随着智能体模型的提升，系统的性能持续改善。我们已经公开发布了网站：https://papercircle.vercel.app/，以及代码：https://github.com/MAXNORM8650/papercircle。

papers.title: PEAR: Pairwise Evaluation for Automatic Relative Scoring in Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: PEAR：用于机器翻译中自动相对评分的成对评估方法
papers.authors: Lorenzo Proietti, Roman Grundkiewicz, Matt Post
papers.abstract: We present PEAR (Pairwise Evaluation for Automatic Relative Scoring), a supervised quality estimation (QE) metric family that reframes reference-free machine translation (MT) evaluation as a graded pairwise comparison. Given a source segment and two candidate translations, PEAR predicts the direction and magnitude of their quality difference. The metrics are trained using pairwise supervision derived from differences in human judgments, with an additional regularization term that encourages sign inversion under candidate order reversal. On the WMT24 meta-evaluation benchmark, PEAR outperforms strictly matched single-candidate QE baselines trained with the same data and backbones, isolating the benefit of the proposed pairwise formulation. Despite using substantially fewer parameters than recent large metrics, PEAR surpasses far larger QE models and reference-based metrics. Our analysis further indicates that PEAR yields a less redundant evaluation signal relative to other top metrics. Finally, we show that PEAR is an effective utility function for minimum Bayes risk (MBR) decoding, reducing pairwise scoring cost at negligible impact.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了PEAR（用于自动相对评分的成对评估）这一监督式质量估计指标系列。该系列将无需参考的机器翻译评估重新定义为一种分级的成对比较方式。给定一段源文本和两个候选翻译结果，PEAR能够预测它们之间质量差异的方向和大小。这些指标是通过基于人类判断差异的成对监督训练得到的，同时还有一个额外的正则化项，该项鼓励在候选翻译顺序反转的情况下改变符号。在WMT24元评估基准测试中，PEAR的表现优于那些使用相同数据和模型训练的单一候选翻译的基准模型，这充分证明了所提出的成对评估方法的有效性。尽管PEAR使用的参数数量远少于其他大型评估指标，但它仍然超越了那些参数数量庞大的质量估计模型和基于参考的评估指标。我们的分析还表明，与其它顶级评估指标相比，PEAR产生的评估信号更为简洁。最后，我们发现PEAR是一种有效的效用函数，可用于最小贝叶斯风险解码，同时还能降低成对评分的成本，而对其影响却非常小。

papers.title: AV-Dialog: Spoken Dialogue Models with Audio-Visual Input
papers.title_zh: AV-Dialog：具有音视输入的语音对话模型
papers.authors: Tuochao Chen, Bandhav Veluri, Hongyu Gong, Shyamnath Gollakota
papers.abstract: Dialogue models falter in noisy, multi-speaker environments, often producing irrelevant responses and awkward turn-taking. We present AV-Dialog, the first multimodal dialog framework that uses both audio and visual cues to track the target speaker, predict turn-taking, and generate coherent responses. By combining acoustic tokenization with multi-task, multi-stage training on monadic, synthetic, and real audio-visual dialogue datasets, AV-Dialog achieves robust streaming transcription, semantically grounded turn-boundary detection and accurate responses, resulting in a natural conversational flow. Experiments show that AV-Dialog outperforms audio-only models under interference, reducing transcription errors, improving turn-taking prediction, and enhancing human-rated dialogue quality. These results highlight the power of seeing as well as hearing for speaker-aware interaction, paving the way for spoken dialogue agents that perform robustly in real-world, noisy environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 在嘈杂、多说话者环境中，对话模型表现不佳，常常产生无关的回应和尴尬的轮流发言情况。我们提出了AV-Dialog这一多模态对话框架，它同时利用音频和视觉线索来追踪目标说话者、预测轮流发言，并生成连贯的回应。通过结合声学标记化技术以及针对单一任务、合成数据和真实音频视频对话数据集的多任务、多阶段训练，AV-Dialog能够实现稳健的流媒体转录、语义精确的轮次检测以及准确的回应，从而营造出自然的对话体验。实验表明，在干扰环境下，AV-Dialog的表现优于仅依赖音频的模型，它能够减少转录错误、改善轮流发言的预测能力，并提高人类评估的对话质量。这些结果凸显了视觉与听觉结合在说话者感知交互中的强大作用，为在现实世界的嘈杂环境中能够稳定运行的口语对话代理提供了可能。

papers.title: A BERTology View of LLM Orchestrations: Token- and Layer-Selective Probes for Efficient Single-Pass Classification
papers.title_zh: 从BERT的角度看待大语言模型的调度：适用于高效单步分类的、具有标记选择性及层选择性特性的探针技术
papers.authors: Gonzalo Ariel Meyoyan, Luciano Del Corro
papers.abstract: Production LLM systems often rely on separate models for safety and other classification-heavy steps, increasing latency, VRAM footprint, and operational complexity. We instead reuse computation already paid for by the serving LLM: we train lightweight probes on its hidden states and predict labels in the same forward pass used for generation. We frame classification as representation selection over the full token\timeslayer hidden-state tensor, rather than committing to a fixed token or fixed layer (e.g., first-token logits or final-layer pooling). To implement this, we introduce a two-stage aggregator that (i) summarizes tokens within each layer and (ii) aggregates across layer summaries to form a single representation for classification. We instantiate this template with direct pooling, a 100K-parameter scoring-attention gate, and a downcast multi-head self-attention (MHA) probe with up to 35M trainable parameters. Across safety and sentiment benchmarks our probes improve over logit-only reuse (e.g., MULI) and are competitive with substantially larger task-specific baselines, while preserving near-serving latency and avoiding the VRAM and latency costs of a separate guard-model pipeline. Multi-backbone experiments on dense and mixture-of-experts architectures (Llama-3.2-3B, GPT-OSS-20B, Qwen3-30B-A3B) confirm that these findings generalize beyond a single model family.
papers.abstract_zh: 生产级大语言模型系统通常需要分别使用不同的模型来处理安全性和其他需要大量分类的任务，这会增加延迟、内存占用以及操作复杂性。我们选择采用一种更高效的方案：利用服务级大语言模型已经处理过的计算资源来训练轻量级预测模型。我们通过对服务级大语言模型的隐藏状态进行训练，从而生成用于分类的标签。我们将分类过程视为对整个令牌×层隐藏状态张量进行表示选择的过程，而不是局限于某个特定的令牌或层（例如，仅使用第一个令牌的日志项或最终层的池化操作）。为了实现这一方案，我们引入了一个两阶段聚合器：首先汇总每一层中的令牌信息，然后将这些信息汇总起来，形成用于分类的单一表示。我们通过直接池化、一个包含10万参数的评分注意力门控机制，以及一个具有高达3500万可训练参数的降维多头自注意力探针来实现这一方案。在安全性和情感分析方面的基准测试中，我们的预测模型表现优于仅使用日志项的重用方法（例如MULI），并且与那些规模更大的特定任务基线模型相比也具有竞争力。同时，我们保持了接近服务级的延迟，避免了使用独立保护模型流程所带来的内存和延迟成本。在密集型和混合专家架构上的多主干实验（如Llama-3.2-3B、GPT-OSS-20B、Qwen3-30B-A3B）表明，这些发现可以推广到多种模型家族。

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Keep Up? Benchmarking Online Adaptation to Continual Knowledge Streams
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否跟上时代的步伐？在线适应技术在与持续变化的知识流互动中的表现如何？
papers.authors: Jiyeon Kim, Hyunji Lee, Dylan Zhou, Sue Hyun Park, Seunghyun Yoon, Trung Bui, Franck Dernoncourt, Sungmin Cha, Minjoon Seo
papers.abstract: LLMs operating in dynamic real-world contexts often encounter knowledge that evolves continuously or emerges incrementally. To remain accurate and effective, models must adapt to newly arriving information on the fly. We introduce Online Adaptation to Continual Knowledge Streams(OAKS) to evaluate this capability, establishing a benchmark for online adaptation over streaming, continually updating knowledge. Specifically, the benchmark is structured as a sequence of fine-grained context chunks where facts change dynamically across time intervals. OAKS comprises two datasets: OAKS-BABI and OAKS-Novel, where individual facts evolve multiple times across context chunks. These datasets include dense annotations to measure whether models track changes accurately. Evaluating 14 models with varied inference approaches, we observe significant limitations in current methodologies. Both state-of-the-art models and agentic memory systems fail to adapt robustly on OAKS, demonstrating delays in state-tracking and susceptibility to distraction within streaming environments. We will open-source the code and datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 在动态的现实世界中运行的大语言模型经常会遇到不断演变或逐步产生的知识。为了保持准确性和有效性，模型必须能够即时适应新到来的信息。我们提出了“在线适应连续知识流”方法，以评估模型的这种能力，为在线适应流式知识、持续更新知识建立了一个基准。具体来说，该基准被设计为一系列细粒度的上下文块，其中事实会在不同的时间间隔内发生变化。OAKS包含两个数据集：OAKS-BABI和OAKS-Novel，在这些数据集中，单个事实会在多个上下文块中多次发生变化。这些数据集包含了密集的注释，用于衡量模型是否能够准确跟踪这些变化。通过对14种具有不同推理方法的模型进行评估，我们发现当前的方法存在显著局限性。无论是最先进的模型还是基于智能体的记忆系统，都无法在OAKS环境中实现有效的适应，这表明它们在状态跟踪方面存在延迟，并且在流式环境中容易受到干扰。我们将开源相关的代码和数据集。

papers.title: Evaluating Language Model Pluralism through In-the-wild Crowd Discussions
papers.title_zh: 通过真实场景中的群体讨论来评估语言模型多样性
papers.authors: Gagan Mundada, Rohan Surana, Nandhini Swaminathan, Bodhisattwa Prasad Majumder, Junda Wu, Julian McAuley, Zhouhang Xie
papers.abstract: When answering subjective questions, an ideal LLM should surface diverse plausible perspectives rather than favoring a single viewpoint, a characteristic known as pluralism. Recent studies show that modern LLMs optimized through preference alignment systematically favor certain positions on subjective queries, making pluralism evaluation increasingly important. However, existing evaluation methods focus dominantly on multiple-choice and question-answering tasks, leaving open-ended generation largely unaddressed.We propose PLURALEVAL, an evaluation framework that assesses LLM pluralism in open-ended generation by comparing outputs against free-form crowd responses. Our approach decomposes ground-truth responses into atomic, non-overlapping claims, then evaluates whether LLMs adequately cover this diverse claim space. We then introduce WildSCOPE, a multi-domain dataset of natural crowd responses, and demonstrate that PLURALEVAL captures novel insights, such as the collapse of pluralism through sycophancy, where LLM systematically degrades in overton pluralism when a user’s belief is revealed. Finally, we discuss the value and actionable insights for preserving and encouraging pluralism from LLM deployers’ side.
papers.abstract_zh: 在回答主观问题时，理想的LLM应该呈现多种合理的观点，而不是只支持一种观点，这一特性被称为多元主义。最近的研究表明，通过偏好对齐优化的现代LLM在回答主观问题时会系统性地偏向某些立场，这使得多元主义的评估变得越来越重要。然而，现有的评估方法主要侧重于选择题和问答任务，而开放性问题生成方面却几乎没有得到关注。我们提出了PLURALEVAL这一评估框架，它通过将LLM的输出与自由形式的群众回应进行比较，来评估其在开放性问题生成方面的多元主义表现。我们的方法将真实回应分解为独立的、不重叠的论点，然后评估LLM是否能够充分涵盖这些多样化的论点。接着，我们引入了WildSCOPE这一多领域自然群众回应数据集，并证明PLURALEVAL能够捕捉到一些新的现象，例如由于阿谀奉承导致的多元主义崩溃——当用户的信念被揭示时，LLM的多元主义表现会系统性地下降。最后，我们讨论了从LLM部署者的角度来看，维护并促进多元主义的价值以及可操作的建议。

papers.title: PRBench: Large-Scale Expert Rubrics for Evaluating High-Stakes Professional Reasoning
papers.title_zh: PRBench：用于评估高难度专业推理能力的大规模专家评分标准
papers.authors: Afra Feyza Akyürek, Advait Gosai, Chen Bo Calvin Zhang, Vipul Gupta, Jaehwan Jeong, Anisha Gunjal, Tahseen Rabbani, Maria Mazzone, David Randolph IV, Mohammad Mahmoudi Meymand, Gurshaan Chattha, Paula Rodriguez, Diego A. Mares Buendia, Pavit Singh, Michael Liu, Subodh Chawla, Peter Cline, Lucy Ogaz, Ernesto Gabriel Hernández Montoya, Zihao Wang, Pavi Bhatter, Marcos Ayestaran, Bing Liu, Yunzhong He
papers.abstract: Frontier model progress is often measured using academic benchmarks that provide a limited view of performance on open-ended, economically consequential tasks in high-stakes professional domains where practical returns matter most. We introduce Professional Reasoning Bench (PRBench), a realistic, open-ended, and difficult benchmark of real-world problems in Finance and Law. We open-source its 1,100 expert-authored tasks and 19,356 expert-curated criteria, making it the largest public, rubric-based benchmark for both legal and finance domains. We recruit 182 qualified professionals, holding JDs, CFAs, or 6+ years of experience, who contributed questions inspired by their actual workflows. This process yields significant diversity, with tasks spanning 114 countries and 47 US jurisdictions. Our expert-curated rubrics are validated through a rigorous quality pipeline, including independent expert validation. Subsequent evaluation of 20 leading models reveals substantial room for improvement, with top scores of only 0.39 (Finance) and 0.37 (Legal) on our Hard subsets. We further catalog associated economic impacts of the prompts and analyze performance using human-annotated rubric categories. Common failure modes include inaccurate judgments, a lack of process transparency and incomplete reasoning, highlighting critical gaps in their reliability for professional adoption.
papers.abstract_zh: 前沿模型的进展通常通过学术基准来衡量，但这些基准只能提供有限的信息，无法反映在高风险专业领域中的开放式、具有经济意义的任务上的表现情况。我们提出了“专业推理基准”（Professional Reasoning Bench，简称PRBench），这是一个真实世界中的开放式、难度较高的基准测试，适用于金融和法律领域。我们将该基准的1,100个由专家编写的测试题以及19,356条由专家精心挑选的标准公开，使其成为法律和金融领域最大的公共基准测试。我们招募了182名具备相关学位、财务分析资格或至少6年以上经验的专业人士来参与这项工作，他们根据自己的实际工作流程设计了测试题。这一过程确保了测试题的多样性，这些测试题来自114个国家和47个司法管辖区。我们的专家精心挑选的标准经过严格的验证流程，包括独立专家的审核。对20个领先模型进行后续评估后发现，它们仍有很大的改进空间。在我们的Hard子集中，顶尖模型的得分仅为0.39（金融领域）和0.37（法律领域）。我们还统计了这些提示所带来的相关经济影响，并使用人工标注的标准分类来分析性能。常见的失败模式包括判断不准确、缺乏过程透明度以及推理不完整等问题，这凸显了这些模型在专业性应用方面的可靠性存在重大不足。

papers.title: Constructing Interpretable Features from Compositional Neuron Groups
papers.title_zh: 从复合神经元群中构建可解释的特征
papers.authors: Or David Shafran, Atticus Geiger, Mor Geva
papers.abstract: A central goal for mechanistic interpretability has been to identify the right units of analysis in large language models (LLMs) that causally explain their outputs. While early work focused on individual neurons, evidence that neurons often encode multiple concepts has motivated a shift toward analyzing directions in activation space. A key question is how to find directions that capture interpretable features in an unsupervised manner. Current methods rely on dictionary learning with sparse autoencoders (SAEs), commonly trained over residual stream activations to learn directions from scratch. However, SAEs often struggle in causal evaluations and lack intrinsic interpretability, as their learning is not explicitly tied to the computations of the model. Here, we tackle these limitations by directly decomposing MLP activations with semi-nonnegative matrix factorization (SNMF), such that the learned features are (a) sparse linear combinations of co-activated neurons, and (b) mapped to their activating inputs, making them directly interpretable. Experiments on Llama 3.1, Gemma 2 and GPT-2 show that SNMF derived features outperform SAEs and a strong supervised baseline (difference-in-means) on causal steering, while aligning with human-interpretable concepts. Further analysis reveals that specific neuron combinations are reused across semantically-related features, exposing a hierarchical structure in the MLP’s activation space. Together, these results position SNMF as a simple and effective tool for identifying interpretable features and dissecting concept representations in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 机械性可解释性的核心目标在于确定大语言模型中的正确分析单元，以因果方式解释其输出结果。虽然早期的研究集中在单个神经元上，但已有证据表明神经元通常能够编码多个概念，这促使人们转向分析激活空间中的方向。一个关键问题是如何以无监督的方式找到能够捕捉可解释特征的方向。目前的方法依赖于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的字典学习技术，通常通过残差流激活来从零开始学习方向。然而，SAE在因果评估方面常常遇到困难，且缺乏内在的可解释性，因为其学习过程并未与模型的计算过程明确关联。为此，我们采用半非负矩阵分解技术对多层感知器（MLP）的激活进行分解，这样学到的特征就具有以下特点：(a)是共同激活的神经元的稀疏线性组合；(b)能够映射到它们的激活输入，从而使其直接具有可解释性。在Llama 3.1、Gemma 2和GPT-2上的实验表明，基于SNMF得到的特征在因果引导任务上的表现优于SAE以及强大的有监督基线方法，同时这些特征也与人类可解释的概念相一致。进一步分析发现，特定的神经元组合会在语义相关的特征中重复出现，这表明MLP的激活空间中存在层次结构。总体而言，这些结果使得SNMF成为一种简单而有效的工具，可用于识别可解释的特征并解析大语言模型中的概念表示。

papers.title: Simulated Students in Tutoring Dialogues: Substance or Illusion?
papers.title_zh: 模拟学生参与辅导对话：现实还是幻觉？
papers.authors: Alexander Scarlatos, Jaewook Lee, Simon Woodhead, Andrew Lan
papers.abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) enable many new innovations in education. However, evaluating the effectiveness of new technology requires real students, which is time-consuming and hard to scale up. Therefore, many recent works on LLM-powered tutoring solutions have used simulated students for both training and evaluation, often via simple prompting. Surprisingly, little work has been done to ensure or even measure the quality of simulated students. In this work, we formally define the student simulation task, propose a set of evaluation metrics that span linguistic, behavioral, and cognitive aspects, and benchmark a wide range of student simulation methods on these metrics. We experiment on a real-world math tutoring dialogue dataset, where both automated and human evaluation results show that prompting strategies for student simulation perform poorly; supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization yield much better but still limited performance, motivating future work on this challenging task.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的进展为教育领域带来了许多新的创新。然而，评估新技术的有效性需要真实的学生数据，而这既耗时又难以大规模实施。因此，许多关于基于LLM的辅导解决方案的研究都采用了模拟学生来进行训练和评估，通常是通过简单的提示机制来实现的。令人惊讶的是，目前几乎没有研究致力于确保甚至衡量模拟学生的质量。在这项研究中，我们正式定义了学生模拟任务，提出了一套涵盖语言、行为和认知方面的评估指标，并对各种学生模拟方法进行了评估。我们在真实的数学辅导对话数据集上进行了实验，结果显示，用于学生模拟的提示策略效果较差；而经过监督式微调和优化后的方法虽然性能有所提升，但仍然有限，这促使我们未来继续研究这一具有挑战性的任务。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Survey of Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning: From Perception, Alignment to Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 关于多模态数学推理的研究：从感知、一致性到推理
papers.authors: Tianyu Yang, Sihong Wu, Yilun Zhao, Zhenwen Liang, Lisen Dai, Chen Zhao, Minhao Cheng, Arman Cohan, Xiangliang Zhang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning (MMR) has recently attracted increasing attention for its capability to solve mathematical problems involving both textual and visual modalities. However, current models still face significant challenges in real-world visual math tasks, often misinterpreting diagrams, failing to align mathematical symbols with visual evidence, or producing inconsistent reasoning steps. Moreover, existing evaluations mainly focus on checking final answers rather than verifying the correctness or executability of each intermediate step. A growing body of recent research addresses these issues by integrating structured perception, explicit alignment, and verifiable reasoning within unified frameworks.To establish a clear roadmap for understanding and comparing different MMR approaches, we systematically review them around four fundamental questions: (1) What to extract from multimodal inputs, (2) How to represent and align textual and visual information, (3) How to perform the reasoning, and (4) How to evaluate the correctness of the overall reasoning process. Finally, we discuss open challenges and share our thoughts on future research directions.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态数学推理（MMR）因其能够解决涉及文本和视觉信息的数学问题而受到越来越多的关注。然而，目前的模型在现实世界的视觉数学任务中仍然面临重大挑战，常常误读图表、无法将数学符号与视觉信息对齐，或者产生不一致的推理步骤。此外，现有的评估主要侧重于检查最终答案，而不是验证每个中间步骤的正确性或可执行性。越来越多的研究通过整合结构化感知、明确的对齐以及可验证的推理来应对这些问题。为了建立理解和比较不同MMR方法的清晰路线图，我们系统地从四个基本问题出发对其进行回顾：（1）应从多模态输入中提取什么信息；（2）如何表示和对齐文本与视觉信息；（3）如何进行推理；（4）如何评估整个推理过程的正确性。最后，我们讨论了面临的开放性问题，并对未来的研究方向提出了自己的想法。

papers.title: Empowering Multi-Turn Tool-Integrated Agentic Reasoning with Group Turn Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: 通过群体轮流策略优化，助力具备多轮工具集成功能的智能推理能力的发展
papers.authors: Yifeng Ding, Hung Le, Songyang Han, Kangrui Ruan, Zhenghui Jin, Varun Kumar, Zijian Wang, Anoop Deoras
papers.abstract: Training Large Language Models (LLMs) for multi-turn Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) – where models iteratively reason, generate code, and verify through execution – remains challenging for existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches. Current RL methods, exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), suffer from coarse-grained, trajectory-level rewards that provide insufficient learning signals for complex multi-turn interactions, leading to training stagnation. To address this issue, we propose Group Turn Policy Optimization (GTPO), a novel RL algorithm specifically designed for training LLMs on multi-turn TIR tasks. GTPO introduces three key innovations: (1) turn-level reward assignment that provides fine-grained feedback for individual turns, (2) return-based advantage estimation where normalized discounted returns are calculated as advantages, and (3) self-supervised reward shaping that exploits self-supervision signals from generated code to densify sparse binary outcome-based rewards. Our comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that GTPO outperforms GRPO by 3.0% across diverse math reasoning benchmarks, establishing its effectiveness. GTPO also improves GRPO by 3.9% on commonsense reasoning and program synthesis tasks, demonstrating its generalizability to non-math domains. Importantly, GTPO incurs negligible overhead, ensuring its practicality for real-world scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练用于多轮工具集成推理的大语言模型——即让模型通过迭代推理、生成代码并进行验证——对于现有的强化学习方法来说仍然具有挑战性。目前的强化学习方法，以群体相对策略优化为例，其采用的粗粒度、轨迹级奖励方式无法为复杂的多轮交互提供足够的学习信号，从而导致训练停滞。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了群体轮次策略优化算法，这是一种专为训练多轮工具集成推理任务中的大语言模型而设计的新型强化学习算法。GTPO引入了三项关键创新：(1) 针对每个轮次的细粒度奖励分配，为个体轮次提供精确反馈；(2) 基于回报的优势估计方法，通过将标准化折扣回报作为优势来计算；(3) 自监督奖励塑形技术，利用生成的代码中的自监督信号来丰富稀疏的二元奖励。我们的全面评估表明，GTPO在多种数学推理基准测试中比GRPO高出3.0%，证明了其有效性。此外，GTPO在常识推理和程序合成任务上的表现比 GRPO 提升了 3.9%，显示出其在非数学领域中的通用性。重要的是，GTPO的开销极低，确保了其在现实场景中的实用性。

papers.title: HypoEval: Hypothesis-Guided Evaluation for Natural Language Generation
papers.title_zh: HypoEval：基于假设的自然语言生成评估方法
papers.authors: Mingxuan Li, Hanchen Li, Chenhao Tan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated great potential for automating the evaluation of natural language generation. Previous frameworks of LLM-as-a-judge fall short in two ways: they either use zero-shot setting without consulting any human input, which leads to low alignment, or fine-tune LLMs on labeled data, which requires a non-trivial number of samples. Moreover, previous methods often provide little reasoning behind automated evaluations. In this paper, we propose HypoEval, Hypothesis-guided Evaluation framework, which first uses a small corpus of human evaluations to generate more detailed rubrics for human judgments and then incorporates a checklist-like approach to combine LLM’s assigned scores on each decomposed dimension to acquire overall scores. With only 30 human evaluations, HypoEval achieves state-of-the-art performance in alignment with both human rankings (Spearman correlation) and human scores (Pearson correlation), on average outperforming G-Eval by 11.86% and fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with at least 3 times more human evaluations by 11.95%. Furthermore, we conduct systematic studies to assess the robustness of HypoEval, highlighting its effectiveness as a reliable and interpretable automated evaluation framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自动化自然语言生成评估方面展现出巨大潜力。以往作为裁判的LLM框架存在两个不足：要么采用无需人工输入的零样本设置，导致对齐效果较差；要么在标记数据上进行LLM微调，这需要大量的样本数据。此外，以往的方法往往无法为自动化评估提供合理的推理依据。在本文中，我们提出了HypoEval——一种基于假设引导的评估框架。该框架首先利用少量人类评估数据来生成更详细的评分标准，然后采用类似检查表的方法，将LLM在每个维度上的得分综合起来，得出整体评分。仅通过30次人类评估，HypoEval就能达到与人类排名（Spearman相关性）和人类评分（Pearson相关性）相当的性能水平，平均而言，其表现优于G-Eval，高出11.86%；而对于经过至少3倍人类评估的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型，其表现则高出11.95%。此外，我们还进行了系统性的研究，以评估HypoEval的鲁棒性，结果表明它作为一种可靠且可解释的自动化评估框架，具有极高的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLMSurgeon: Diagnosing Data Mixture of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: LLMSurgeon：大型语言模型的数据混合情况诊断方法
papers.authors: Yaxin Luo, Jiacheng Cui, Xiaohan Zhao, Xinyi Shang, Jiacheng Liu, Xinyue Bi, Zhaoyi Li, Zhiqiang Shen
papers.abstract: The pretraining data mixture of Large Language Models (LLMs) constitutes their “digital DNA”, shaping model behaviors, capabilities, and failure modes. Yet this composition is rarely disclosed, making post-hoc auditing of data combination or provenance difficult. In this work, we formalize \textbf{Data Mixture Surgery (DMS)}: given only generated text from a target LLM, estimate the domain-level distribution of its pretraining corpus under a predefined taxonomy. We propose \textbf{LLMSurgeon}, a strong framework that casts DMS as an inverse problem under the label-shift assumption. Rather than directly aggregating classifier outputs, LLMSurgeon estimates a calibrated \textit{soft} confusion matrix and solves a constrained inverse problem to correct systematic domain confusion and recover the latent mixture prior. To evaluate, we introduce \textbf{LLMScan}, a recipe-verifiable evaluation suite built from open-source LLMs with transparent pretraining mixtures. Across LLMScan, LLMSurgeon recovers domain mixtures with high fidelity under fixed protocols. Our work presents a practical, post-hoc approach for auditing the \textit{digital DNA} of foundation models without access to their training data. Code is available at: https://github.com/Yaxin9Luo/LLMSurgeon.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的预训练数据混合构成了它们的“数字DNA”，影响着模型的行为、能力和故障模式。然而，这种数据组合方式很少被公开，因此事后审计数据组合或来源信息变得十分困难。在这项研究中，我们提出了**数据混合手术**（DMS）技术：仅给定目标LLM生成的文本，就能根据预定义的分类体系，估算出其预训练语料库的领域级分布。我们还提出了**LLMSurgeon**框架，该框架将DMS视为一个逆问题，在标签偏移假设下进行处理。LLMSurgeon不是直接汇总分类器输出，而是估计一个校准后的**软混淆矩阵**，并解决一个受限的逆问题，以纠正系统中的领域混淆现象，并恢复潜在的混合先验信息。为了评估效果，我们开发了**LLMScan**工具套件，该套件基于开源LLMs构建，其预训练数据的组合方式是透明的。通过LLMScan，LLMSurgeon能够在固定的协议下，高保真度地恢复领域混合数据。我们的研究提供了一种实用的后验方法，无需访问基础模型的训练数据，即可审计其“数字DNA”。相关代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/Yaxin9Luo/LLMSurgeon。

papers.title: The African Languages Lab: A Collaborative Approach to Advancing Low-Resource African NLP
papers.title_zh: 非洲语言实验室：一种协作性的方法，用于推动低资源条件下非洲语言的自然语言处理研究的发展
papers.authors: Sheriff Issaka, Keyi Wang, Yinka Ajibola, Oluwatumininu Samuel-Ipaye, Zhaoyi Zhang, Nicte Aguillon Jimenez, Evans Kofi Agyei, Abraham Lin, Rohan Ramachandran, Sadick Abdul Mumin, Faith Nchifor, Mohammed Shuraim Issah, Erick Rosas Gonzalez, Lieqi Liu, Sylvester Kpei, Jemimah Kusi Osei, Carlene Ajeneza, Persis Boateng, Prisca Adwoa Dufie Yeboah, Saadia Gabriel
papers.abstract: Despite representing nearly one-third of the world’s languages, African languages remain critically underserved by modern NLP technologies, with 88% classified as severely underrepresented or completely ignored in computational linguistics. We present the African Languages Lab (All Lab), a comprehensive research initiative that addresses this technological gap through systematic data collection, model development, and empirical analysis. Our contributions include: (1) a quality-controlled data collection pipeline, yielding the largest validated African multi-modal speech and text dataset spanning 40 languages with 19 billion text tokens and 12,628 hours of aligned speech data; (2) extensive experimental validation demonstrating that even modest-scale models, when fine-tuned on targeted language data, achieve substantial improvements over untrained baselines, averaging +23.69 ChrF++, +0.33 COMET, and +15.34 BLEU points across 31 evaluated languages; and (3) a comparative analysis against Google Translate in which a 1B-parameter model matched or surpassed the commercial system in several languages including Yoruba and Twi, revealing that data scarcity, rather than model scale, constitutes the primary bottleneck for low-resource NLP, and suggesting that systematic dataset development yields disproportionate returns for low-resource languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管非洲语言占世界语言的近三分之一，但现代自然语言处理技术对它们的支持仍然非常不足。在计算语言学领域，有88%的非洲语言被归类为严重缺乏代表或完全被忽视。我们推出了“非洲语言实验室”这一综合性研究项目，通过系统的数据收集、模型开发以及实证分析来弥补这一技术空白。我们的贡献包括：(1) 一套质量控制严格的数据收集流程，成功构建了包含40种语言、190亿个文本标记以及12,628小时对齐语音数据的非洲多模态语音和文本数据集；(2) 广泛的实验验证表明，即使是在目标语言数据上进行微调的模型，也能比未经训练的基线模型取得显著的改进，在31种评估语言中，模型的性能平均提升了23.69 ChrF++、0.33 COMET以及15.34 BLEU分数；(3) 与谷歌翻译进行了对比分析，发现一个拥有1B参数的模型在多个语言上达到了与商业系统相当甚至更好的效果，其中包括约鲁巴语和特威语。这表明，数据稀缺而非模型规模才是低资源语言自然语言处理领域的主要瓶颈，而系统的数据集开发对于低资源语言来说能带来巨大的回报。

papers.title: LogosKG: Hardware-Optimized Scalable and Interpretable Knowledge Graph Retrieval
papers.title_zh: LogosKG：硬件优化型、可扩展且易于理解的知识图谱检索系统
papers.authors: He Cheng, Yifu Wu, Saksham Khatwani, Maya Kruse, Dmitriy Dligach, Timothy A. Miller, Majid Afshar, Yanjun Gao
papers.abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are increasingly integrated with large language models (LLMs) to provide structured, verifiable reasoning. A core operation in this integration is multi-hop retrieval, yet existing systems struggle to balance efficiency, scalability, and interpretability. We introduce LogosKG, a novel, hardware-aligned framework that enables scalable and interpretable k-hop retrieval on large KGs by building on symbolic KG formulations and executing traversal as hardware-efficient operations over decomposed subject, object, and relation representations. To scale to billion-edge graphs, LogosKG integrates degree-aware partitioning, cross-graph routing, and on-demand caching. Experiments show substantial efficiency gains over CPU and GPU baselines without loss of retrieval fidelity. With proven performance in KG retrieval, a downstream two-round KG-LLM interaction demonstrates how LogosKG enables large-scale, evidence-grounded analysis of how KG topology, such as hop distribution and connectivity, shapes the alignment between structured biomedical knowledge and LLM diagnostic reasoning, thereby opening the door for next-generation KG-LLM integration. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/LARK-NLP-Lab/LogosKG, and an online demo is available at https://lark-nlp-lab-logoskg.hf.space/.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识图谱与大语言模型日益融合，以提供结构化、可验证的推理能力。这种融合的核心操作是多跳检索，但现有的系统在效率、可扩展性和可解释性之间难以取得平衡。我们提出了LogosKG这一新型硬件导向框架，该框架基于符号化的知识图谱构建方式，通过高效处理分解后的主体、对象和关系表示来实现可扩展且可解释的k跳检索。为了适应数十亿边的知识图谱，LogosKG还采用了度感知分区、跨图路由以及按需缓存等机制。实验表明，与基于CPU和GPU的基线方法相比，LogosKG在检索效率上取得了显著提升，同时保持了检索结果的准确性。在知识图谱检索方面的出色表现表明，LogosKG能够实现对大规模知识图谱拓扑结构的深入分析，例如跳数分布和连通性等因素如何影响结构化生物医学知识与语言模型诊断推理之间的匹配程度。这为下一代知识图谱与语言模型的集成提供了可能。源代码可在https://github.com/LARK-NLP-Lab/LogosKG获取，在线演示视频可在https://lark-nlp-lab-logoskg.hf.space/查看。

papers.title: GCA Framework: A GCC Countries–Grounded Dataset and Agentic Pipeline for Climate Decision Support
papers.title_zh: GCA框架：一个涵盖GCC国家的基础数据集以及用于气候决策支持的智能处理流程
papers.authors: Muhammad Umer Sheikh, Khawar Shehzad, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Muhammad Haris Khan
papers.abstract: Climate decision-making in the GCC states increasingly demands systems that can translate heterogeneous scientific and policy evidence into actionable guidance, yet general-purpose large language models (LLMs) remain weak both in region-specific climate knowledge and grounded interaction with geospatial and forecasting tools. We present the GCA framework, which unifies (i) GCA-DS, a curated multimodal dataset grounded in the GCC states, and (ii) Gulf Climate Agent (GCA), a tool-augmented agent for climate analysis. GCA-DS comprises nearly 200k question-answer pairs spanning governmental policies and adaptation plans, NGO and international frameworks, academic literature, and event-driven reporting on heatwaves, dust storms, and floods, complemented with remote-sensing inputs that couple imagery with textual evidence. Building on this foundation, the GCA agent orchestrates a modular tool pipeline grounded in real-time and historical signals and geospatial processing that produces derived indices and interpretable visualizations. Finally, we benchmark open and proprietary LLMs on climate tasks in the GCC states and show that domain fine-tuning and tool integration substantially improve reliability over general-purpose baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 海湾合作委员会国家的气候决策越来越需要能够将各种科学和政策数据转化为可操作的指导方案。然而，通用大语言模型在掌握地区特定的气候知识以及与地理空间和预测工具的互动方面仍然存在不足。我们提出了GCA框架，该框架将以下两部分整合在一起：(1) GCA-DS，一个基于海湾合作委员会国家的数据集，包含政府政策、适应计划、非政府组织和国际框架、学术文献，以及关于热浪、沙尘暴和洪水等事件的报告内容；(2) 海湾气候代理，一种用于气候分析的工具增强型代理。GCA-DS包含近20万对问答对，涵盖了各种信息。此外，该数据集还包含了遥感数据，将图像与文本证据相结合。基于这一基础，GCA代理能够利用实时和历史信号以及地理空间处理技术，生成可解释的指标和可视化结果。最后，我们对海湾合作委员会国家的气候任务进行了开源和专有大语言模型的基准测试，结果表明，通过领域微调工具和集成技术，可以显著提高模型的可靠性，优于通用基线模型。

papers.title: Effects of Collaboration on the Performance of Interactive Theme Discovery Systems
papers.title_zh: 协作方式对交互式主题发现系统性能的影响
papers.authors: Alvin Po-Chun Chen, Rohan Das, Dananjay Srinivas, Alexandra Barry, Maksim Seniw, Maria Leonor Pacheco
papers.abstract: NLP-assisted solutions to support qualitative data analysis have gained considerable traction. However, no unified evaluation framework exists which can account for the many different settings in which qualitative researchers may employ them. In this paper, we propose a framework to evaluate the way collaboration settings may produce different research outcomes across a variety of interactive systems. Specifically, we study the impact of synchronous vs. asynchronous collaboration using three different NLP-assisted qualitative research tools and present a comprehensive analysis of the differences in the consistency, cohesiveness, and correctness of their outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 借助自然语言处理技术的定性数据分析解决方案已经获得了广泛的关注。然而，目前还没有一个统一的评估框架来考量定性研究人员在多种不同情境下使用这些工具所能产生的结果。在本文中，我们提出了一个框架，用于评估协作方式如何在不同交互系统中产生不同的研究成果。具体来说，我们研究了同步与异步协作方式的影响，并使用了三种不同的自然语言处理辅助定性研究工具进行了分析。同时，我们对这些工具所产生的结果在一致性、连贯性以及准确性方面的差异进行了全面分析。

papers.title: GraphSynth: Resolving the Diversity-Reliability Trade-off with Probabilistic Factor Graphs
papers.title_zh: GraphSynth：通过概率性因子图来解决多样性与可靠性之间的权衡问题
papers.authors: Zehua Cheng, Wei Dai, Jiahao Sun, Thomas Lukasiewicz
papers.abstract: The large language models offer a scaleable solution for the generation of synthetic data faced with a trade-off between maintaining the diversity of generation and achieving factually accurate results. This paper introduces Graphsynth, a framework which leverages a probabilistic factor graph modeling the universe of attributes. The framework leverages a high-level schema mapping compiled into efficient hard masks during the decoding phase for maintaining the syntactic truth and a span-synchronized verifier for dismissing logical contradictions at the decode time. The experiments conducted on biomedical, legal, and generic domains show that the method outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines with a structural integrity approaching perfection, a coverage of around 94% attributes on the factor graph solution, and a boost in performance on downstream tasks such as +17.9% on TruthfulQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 这些大语言模型提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，用于生成合成数据，同时需要在保持生成数据的多样性与获得事实准确性的结果之间做出权衡。本文介绍了Graphynth框架，该框架利用概率因子图模型来表征各种属性。该框架采用了一种高级模式映射机制，在解码阶段将其转化为高效的硬掩码，从而确保句法上的准确性；同时，还配备了跨段同步的验证器，用于在解码时排除逻辑矛盾。在生物医学、法律以及通用领域进行的实验表明，该方法的表现优于现有的最先进基线方法。其结构完整性接近完美，因子图解决方案对约94%的属性进行了覆盖，并且在后续任务中的性能也有所提升，例如在TruthfulQA任务上的性能提升了17.9%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Structured Clustering Approach for Inducing Media Narratives
papers.title_zh: 一种用于引导媒体叙事的结构化聚类方法
papers.authors: Rohan Das, Advait Deshmukh, Alexandria Leto, Zohar Naaman, I-Ta Lee, Maria Leonor Pacheco
papers.abstract: Media narratives wield tremendous power in shaping public opinion, yet computational approaches struggle to capture the nuanced storytelling structures that communication theory emphasizes as central to how meaning is constructed. Existing approaches either miss subtle narrative patterns through coarse-grained analysis or require domain-specific taxonomies that limit scalability. To bridge this gap, we present a framework for inducing rich narrative schemas by jointly modeling events and characters via structured clustering. Our approach produces explainable narrative schemas that align with established framing theory while scaling to large corpora without exhaustive manual annotation.
papers.abstract_zh: 媒体叙事在塑造公众舆论方面拥有巨大的影响力，然而计算方法在捕捉那些通信理论所强调的、对意义构建至关重要的细微叙事结构方面却存在困难。现有的方法要么通过粗粒度分析忽略了细微的叙事模式，要么需要特定领域的分类体系，这限制了方法的可扩展性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种框架，通过结构化聚类来同时建模事件和角色，从而推导出丰富的叙事结构。我们的方法能够生成可解释的叙事结构，这些结构与已有的框架理论相契合，并且可以在没有大量手动注释的情况下扩展到大型语料库。

papers.title: ACBQ: Adaptive Cross-Block Quantization of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ACBQ：自适应跨块量化技术，用于大型语言模型的处理
papers.authors: Hailing Wang, Jianglin Lu, Yitian Zhang, Huimin Zeng, Yun Fu
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising approach for reducing the memory footprint and computational cost of large language models (LLMs), enabling efficient deployment without full model retraining. However, existing PTQ methods struggle to simultaneously support weight–activation joint quantization and extreme low-bit weight quantization. This limitation primarily arises from the depth of LLMs and their strong cross-layer dependencies, which cause quantization errors to propagate and accumulate across layers, ultimately leading to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we present ACBQ, a simple yet effective framework that simultaneously addresses weight–activation joint quantization and extreme weight quantization. We first propose a granular quantization strategy that treats self-attention and FFN as separate quantization units with module-specific optimization objectives. To mitigate the propagation and accumulation of quantization errors across layers, we introduce an adaptive cross-block quantization strategy that explicitly accounts for cross-layer dependencies by encouraging consistency across blocks. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs, including OPT and the LLaMA family, demonstrate that ACBQ achieves superior performance under both W4A4 and highly aggressive W2 settings, while incurring negligible additional computational overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练后量化技术已成为降低大语言模型内存占用和计算成本的有效方法，使得无需完全重新训练模型即可实现高效部署。然而，现有的量化方法在同时支持权重-激活值联合量化和极低比特数权重量化方面存在困难。这一限制主要源于大语言模型的深度及其强烈的跨层依赖性，这会导致量化误差在层间传播和累积，最终导致性能显著下降。在本文中，我们提出了ACBQ框架，这是一个简单而有效的解决方案，能够同时处理权重-激活值联合量化和极低比特数权重量化问题。我们首先提出了一种细粒度量化策略，将自注意力机制和FFN视为独立的量化单元，并为每个模块设定特定的优化目标。为了减轻量化误差在层间的传播和累积，我们引入了自适应跨块量化策略，该策略通过鼓励不同块之间的一致性来有效处理跨层依赖性问题。通过在多种大语言模型上进行的大量实验，包括OPT和LLaMA系列模型，我们发现ACBQ在W4A4和高度激进的W2量化设置下都能取得优异的性能表现，同时带来的额外计算开销可以忽略不计。

papers.title: SecureGate: Learning When to Reveal PII Safely via Token-Gated Dual-Adapters for Federated LLMs
papers.title_zh: SecureGate：通过令牌机制与双适配器技术，学习何时安全地披露个人身份信息，适用于联邦大语言模型
papers.authors: Mohamed Shaaban, Mohamed Elmahallawy
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training across organizational silos without sharing raw data, making it attractive for privacy-sensitive applications. With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs), federated fine-tuning of generative LLMs has gained attention as a way to leverage distributed data while preserving confidentiality. However, this setting introduces fundamental challenges: (i) privacy leakage of personally identifiable information (PII) due to LLM memorization, and (ii) a persistent tension between global generalization and local utility under heterogeneous data. Existing defenses, such as data sanitization and differential privacy, reduce leakage but often degrade downstream performance. We propose SecureGate, a privacy-aware federated fine-tuning framework for LLMs that provides fine-grained privacy control without sacrificing utility. SecureGate employs a dual-adapter LoRA architecture: a secure adapter that learns sanitized, globally shareable representations, and a revealing adapter that captures sensitive, organization-specific knowledge. A token-controlled gating module selectively activates these adapters at inference time, enabling controlled information disclosure without retraining. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and real-world datasets show that SecureGate improves task utility while substantially reducing PII leakage, achieving up to a 31.66x reduction in inference attack accuracy and a 17.07x reduction in extraction recall for unauthorized requests. Additionally, it maintains 100% routing reliability to the correct adapter and incurs only minimal computational and communication overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/wsu-cyber-security-lab-ai/SecureGate.
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦学习能够在不共享原始数据的情况下，实现不同组织之间的协同训练，因此对于注重隐私的应用程序来说非常具有吸引力。随着大语言模型的迅速普及，对生成式语言模型进行联邦微调已成为一种利用分布式数据同时保持数据机密性的有效方法。然而，这种方式也带来了一些根本性的挑战：(1)由于语言模型的内存存储机制，个人身份信息可能会泄露；(2)在异构数据环境下，如何实现全局通用性与局部效用之间的平衡也是一个难题。现有的防御措施，如数据清洗和差分隐私技术，虽然能减少信息泄露的风险，但往往会降低模型的下游性能。我们提出了SecureGate这一基于隐私保护的联邦微调框架，它能够提供细粒度的隐私控制，同时不牺牲模型的实用性。SecureGate采用了双适配器LoRA架构：一个用于学习经过清洗、可全局共享的表示的安全适配器，另一个则用于捕获与特定组织相关的敏感信息的揭示适配器。通过令牌控制的门控模块，可以在推理时选择性地激活这些适配器，从而实现可控的信息披露，而无需重新训练模型。在多个语言模型和真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，SecureGate不仅提升了任务的实用性，还显著减少了个人身份信息的泄露风险。具体来说，推理攻击的准确率降低了31.66倍，未经授权的请求提取召回率则降低了17.07倍。此外，该框架还能保持100%的路由可靠性，且仅会产生极小的计算和通信开销。相关代码可访问于https://github.com/wsu-cyber-security-lab-ai/SecureGate。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EDUMATH: Generating Standards-aligned Educational Math Word Problems
papers.title_zh: EDUMATH：生成符合标准的数学应用题
papers.authors: Bryan R Christ, Penelope Molitz, Beau LeBlond, Zachary Gottesman, Jonathan Kropko, Thomas Hartvigsen
papers.abstract: Math word problems (MWPs) are critical K-12 educational tools, and customizing them to students’ interests and ability levels can enhance learning. However, teachers struggle to find time to customize MWPs for students given large class sizes and increasing burnout. We propose that LLMs can support math education by generating MWPs customized to student interests and math education standards. We use a joint human expert-LLM judge approach to evaluate over 11,000 MWPs generated by open and closed LLMs and develop the first teacher-annotated dataset for standards-aligned educational MWP generation. We show the value of our data by using it to train a 12B open model that matches the performance of larger and more capable open models. We also use our teacher-annotated data to train a text classifier that enables a 30B open LLM to outperform existing closed baselines without any training. Next, we show our models’ MWPs are more similar to human-written MWPs than those from existing models. We conclude by conducting the first study of customized LLM-generated MWPs with grade school students, finding they perform similarly on our models’ MWPs relative to human-written MWPs but consistently prefer our customized MWPs.
papers.abstract_zh: 数学应用题是K-12教育中的重要工具，根据学生的兴趣和能力水平进行定制可以提升学习效果。然而，由于班级规模庞大以及教师面临的压力不断增加，教师们很难有时间为学生定制这类应用题。我们提出，大语言模型可以通过生成符合学生兴趣和教育标准的应用题来辅助数学教学。我们采用人类专家与大语言模型的联合评估方法，对由开放式和封闭式大语言模型生成出的11,000多道应用题进行了评估，并开发了首个包含教师注释的数据集，用于生成符合教育标准的应用题。我们通过使用这些数据训练了一个拥有120亿参数的开放式模型，其性能与更强大、功能更丰富的开放式模型相当。此外，我们还利用教师注释的数据训练了一个文本分类器，使得一个拥有300亿参数的开放式大语言模型能够在无需任何训练的情况下超越现有的封闭式基准模型。接下来，我们发现我们的模型生成的应用题与人类编写的应用题更为相似。最后，我们对小学生进行了关于定制的大语言模型生成应用题的研究，发现他们在我们的模型生成的应用题中表现与人类编写的应用题相当，但他们始终更喜欢我们定制生成的应用题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AdaFuse: Adaptive Ensemble Decoding for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: AdaFuse：适用于大型语言模型的自适应集成解码技术
papers.authors: Chengming Cui, Tianxin Wei, Ziyi Chen, Ruizhong Qiu, Zhichen Zeng, Zhining Liu, Xuying Ning, Duo Zhou, Jingrui He
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit complementary strengths arising from differences in pretraining data, model architectures, and decoding behaviors. Inference-time ensembling provides a practical way to combine these capabilities without retraining. However, existing ensemble approaches suffer from fundamental limitations. Most rely on fixed fusion granularity, which lacks the flexibility required for mid-generation adaptation and fails to adapt to different generation characteristics across tasks. To address these challenges, we propose AdaFuse, an adaptive ensemble decoding framework that dynamically selects semantically appropriate fusion units during generation. Rather than committing to a fixed granularity, AdaFuse adjusts fusion behavior on the fly based on the decoding context, with words serving as basic building blocks for alignment. To be specific, we introduce an uncertainty-based criterion to decide whether to apply ensembling at each decoding step. Under confident decoding states, the model continues generation directly. In less certain states, AdaFuse invokes a diversity-aware scaling strategy to explore alternative candidate continuations and inform ensemble decisions. This design establishes a synergistic interaction between adaptive ensembling and test-time scaling, where ensemble decisions guide targeted exploration, and the resulting diversity in turn strengthens ensemble quality. Experiments on open-domain QA, arithmetic reasoning, and machine translation demonstrate that AdaFuse consistently outperforms strong ensemble baselines, achieving an average relative improvement of 6.88%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）由于预训练数据、模型架构以及解码行为的差异，各自具有互补的优势。在推理阶段进行集成是一种实用的方法，可以在不重新训练的情况下结合这些优势。然而，现有的集成方法存在根本性的局限性。大多数方法都依赖于固定的融合粒度，这缺乏进行中期调整的灵活性，也无法适应不同任务中的生成特性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AdaFuse这一自适应集成解码框架。该框架在生成过程中动态选择语义上合适的融合单元。AdaFuse不会固定使用某种融合粒度，而是根据解码上下文实时调整融合行为，将单词作为进行对齐的基本单位。具体来说，我们引入了一种基于不确定性的标准来决定在每个解码步骤是否应用集成策略。在确信的情况下，模型会直接继续生成；在不确定的情况下，AdaFuse会采用一种考虑多样性的扩展策略来探索其他可能的延续方式，从而为集成决策提供信息。这种设计实现了自适应集成与测试时扩展之间的协同作用：集成决策引导有针对性的探索，而由此产生的多样性则进一步提升集成模型的性能。在开放域问答、算术推理和机器翻译方面的实验表明，AdaFuse始终优于其他强大的集成基线模型，平均相对提升了6.88%的性能。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Test-Time Search for Optimization Problem Solving
papers.title_zh: 一种考虑不确定性的测试时间搜索方法，用于优化问题求解
papers.authors: Linlin Yu, Xujiang Zhao, Dong Li, Yanchi Liu, Wei Cheng, Zhengzhang Chen, Chen Zhao, Feng Chen, Haifeng Chen
papers.abstract: Automatically solving optimization problems from natural language descriptions with both efficiency and reliability is highly desirable but remains challenging. Language model hallucinations and the limited availability of labeled datasets often result in misaligned formulations, code errors, and feasibility failures We propose UMCTS, an Uncertainty-aware Monte Carlo Tree Search framework that combines the language understanding capability of large language models with the reliability of well-established solvers. UMCTS structures the solution process into four stages: global instruction, assumptions, mathematical formulation, and solver code generation. It employs Monte Carlo Tree Search with semantic-equivalence pruning, prior-guided exploration, and solver-based feasibility checks. An LLM judge provides numerical reward signals, qualitative error information, and uncertainty estimates. These signals are backpropagated to guide the search and flag unreliable outputs. Across six public benchmarks, UMCTS achieves state-of-the-art solution accuracy, improves efficiency by reducing token usage.
papers.abstract_zh: 能够高效且可靠地自动解决基于自然语言描述的优化问题是非常理想的，但这仍然具有挑战性。语言模型的幻觉现象以及标注数据集的有限可用性往往会导致公式表述不一致、代码错误以及可行性评估失败等问题。我们提出了UMCTS框架，这是一种具有不确定性感知功能的蒙特卡洛树搜索方法。该框架结合了大语言模型的语言理解能力以及成熟求解器的可靠性。UMCTS将求解过程分为四个阶段：全局指令生成、假设设定、数学公式构建以及求解器代码生成。它采用蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，并加入了语义等价剪枝、基于先验信息的探索策略以及基于求解器的可行性检查功能。LLM裁判器提供数值奖励信号、定性错误信息以及不确定性估计。这些信号通过反向传播来指导搜索过程，并标记出不可靠的输出结果。在六个公开基准测试中，UMCTS取得了最先进的解决方案精度，同时通过减少令牌使用量提升了效率。

papers.title: TLPO: Token-Level Policy Optimization for Mitigating Language Confusion in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: TLPO：令牌级策略优化，用于减少大型语言模型中的语言混淆问题
papers.authors: Jinho Choo, JunSeung Lee, Jimyeong Kim, Yeeho Song, S. K. Hong, Yeong-Dae Kwon
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong multilingual capabilities, yet often fail to consistently generate responses in the intended language, exhibiting a phenomenon known as language confusion.Prior mitigation approaches based on sequence-level fine-tuning, such as DPO, ORPO, and GRPO, operate at the level of entire responses and can lead to unintended degradation of general model capabilities, motivating the need for more fine-grained alternatives.To address this, we introduce Token-Level Policy Optimization (TLPO), a fine-tuning framework designed to mitigate language confusion through localized, token-level updates. TLPO identifies error-prone positions, explores alternative candidate tokens, and updates the policy using a tailored objective to suppress error-inducing outputs at a granular level.This selective intervention enables effective mitigation of language confusion without compromising the model’s general abilities.Experiments on multiple multilingual LLMs across diverse languages demonstrate that TLPO significantly outperforms baselines in improving language consistency while preserving downstream task accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多语言处理方面表现出强大的能力，但往往无法始终以目标语言生成响应，这种现象被称为语言混淆。以往基于序列级微调的缓解方法，如DPO、ORPO和GRPO，只能针对整个响应进行优化，这可能会导致模型整体能力的非预期下降。因此，有必要采用更细粒度的替代方案来应对这一问题。为此，我们提出了令牌级策略优化技术——TLPO。该框架通过局部化的令牌级更新来减轻语言混淆问题。TLPO能够识别容易出现错误的位置，探索替代的候选令牌，并通过定制化的目标来抑制产生错误输出的部分，从而在细节层面有效缓解语言混淆问题，同时不损害模型的整体性能。在多种多语言LLM上的实验表明，TLPO在提高语言一致性方面显著优于传统方法，同时还能保持下游任务的准确性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: JW-SVD: Bridging the Cross-Modal Mismatch in Post-Training MLLM Compression
papers.title_zh: JW-SVD：解决训练后多模态大语言模型压缩中的跨模式不匹配问题
papers.authors: Runchao Li, Yao Fu, Mu Sheng, Haotian Yu, Xianxuan Long, Kenneth A. Loparo
papers.abstract: Post-training compression of Multimodal LLMs faces a fundamental geometric conflict: parameter subspaces optimized for text often suppress orthogonal visual features. We demonstrate that standard SVD fails to resolve this cross-modal mismatch, causing catastrophic visual degradation. To bridge this gap, we introduce Joint-Whitening SVD (JW-SVD), a dual-objective framework that aligns vision and language manifolds via a Joint Covariance basis, preserving features critical to both. Additionally, we propose Global Spectrum-Aware Truncation to dynamically transfer parameter budget from the redundant Vision Tower to the sensitive Backbone. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and Llama-3-Next confirm that JW-SVD demonstrates superior retention of both text and image capabilities. In addition, it resolves the modality trade-off: it recovers over 30% of perceptual performance lost by baselines while maintaining parity in textual reasoning, enabling robust multimodal performance even at extreme compression rates.
papers.abstract_zh: 在训练后的多模态大语言模型压缩过程中，存在一个根本的几何性问题：为文本优化的参数子空间往往会忽略正交的视觉特征。我们发现，标准的SVD无法解决这种跨模态不匹配问题，从而导致严重的视觉质量下降。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了联合白化SVD（JW-SVD）技术——这是一种双目标框架，通过联合协方差基来对齐视觉和语言的表示空间，从而保留对两者都至关重要的特征。此外，我们还提出了全局谱感知截断算法，该算法能够动态地将参数预算从冗余的视觉模块转移到敏感的语言模块中。在Qwen2.5-VL和Llama-3-Next上的实验表明，JW-SVD在保留文本和图像能力方面表现更为出色。此外，它还解决了模态之间的权衡问题：它能够恢复超过30%的感知性能损失，同时保持文本推理能力的平衡，从而在极高的压缩率下也能实现强大的多模态性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Advancing Reasoning in Diffusion Language Models with Denoising Process Rewards
papers.title_zh: 通过去噪过程奖励来提升扩散语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Shaoan Xie, Lingjing Kong, Xiangchen Song, Xinshuai Dong, Guangyi Chen, Eric P. Xing, Kun Zhang
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based large language models offer a non-autoregressive alternative for text generation, but enabling them to perform complex reasoning remains challenging. Reinforcement learning has recently emerged as an effective post-training strategy for improving their performance; however, existing methods rely primarily on outcome-based rewards, which provide no direct supervision over the denoising process and often result in poorly structured reasoning that is difficult to interpret and inconsistently supports the final prediction. To address this limitation, we introduce denoising process reward, a process-level reinforcement signal defined over the denoising trajectory of diffusion language models. This reward is obtained by estimating the contribution of intermediate denoising intervals to the final task outcome, encouraging the model to favor reasoning trajectories that consistently guide generation toward correct predictions. We further propose an efficient stochastic estimator that reuses standard training rollouts, enabling practical process-level supervision at scale. Experiments on challenging reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach yields consistent improvements in reasoning stability, interpretability, and overall task performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于扩散的大语言模型为文本生成提供了一种非自回归的替代方法，但要让它们执行复杂的推理仍然具有挑战性。强化学习最近被证明是一种有效的训练后策略，可以提升它们的性能；然而，现有的方法主要依赖于基于结果的奖励机制，这种奖励机制无法直接指导去噪过程，往往导致推理结构混乱，难以解释，且对最终预测的支持也不一致。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种去噪过程奖励机制，这是一种针对扩散语言模型去噪轨迹定义的过程级强化信号。该奖励是通过估计中间去噪阶段对最终任务结果的贡献而获得的，从而促使模型倾向于选择能够持续引导生成正确预测的推理路径。我们还提出了一种高效的随机估计方法，该方法可以重用标准的训练样本，从而实现大规模范围内的过程级监督。在具有挑战性的推理基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法在推理稳定性、可解释性和整体任务性能方面都取得了显著的改进。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Estimating the Black-box LLM Uncertainty with Distribution-Aligned Adversarial Distillation
papers.title_zh: 利用分布对齐对抗蒸馏技术来估计黑盒大语言模型的不确定性
papers.authors: Huizi Cui, Huan Ma, Qilin Wang, Yuhang Gao, Changqing Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have progressed rapidly in complex reasoning and question answering, yet LLM hallucination remains a central bottleneck that hinders practical deployment, especially for commercial black-box LLMs accessible only via APIs. Existing uncertainty quantification methods typically depend on computationally expensive multiple sampling or internal parameters, which prevents real-time estimation and fails to capture information implicit in the black-box reasoning process. To address this issue, we propose Distribution-Aligned Adversarial Distillation (DisAAD), which introduces a generation-discrimination architecture to guide a lightweight proxy model to learn the high-quality regions of the output distribution of the black-box LLM, thus effectively endowing it with the ability to “know whether the black-box LLM knows or not”. Subsequently, we use the proxy model to reproduce the specific responses of the black-box LLM and estimate the corresponding uncertainty based on evidence learning. Extensive experiments have verified the effectiveness and promise of our proposed method, indicating that a proxy model even one that only accounts for 1% of the target LLM’s size can achieve reliable uncertainty quantification.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂推理和问答任务上取得了显著进展，但模型产生的幻觉现象仍然是一个阻碍其实际应用的瓶颈问题，尤其是在那些只能通过API访问的商业级黑盒语言模型中。现有的不确定性量化方法通常依赖于计算成本高昂的多次采样或内部参数，这导致无法实现实时估计，也无法捕捉到黑盒推理过程中隐含的信息。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了分布对齐对抗蒸馏算法（DisAAD）。该算法引入了一种生成-判别架构，引导一个轻量级的代理模型学习黑盒语言模型输出分布中的高质量区域，从而有效地赋予该代理模型“判断黑盒语言模型是否知晓某些信息”的能力。随后，我们利用这个代理模型来复现黑盒语言模型的特定响应，并根据证据学习来估计相应的不确定性。大量的实验验证了我们所提出方法的有效性和前景，结果表明，即使代理模型的规模仅相当于目标语言模型大小的1%，也能实现可靠的不确定性量化。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
