papers.title: CoDial: Interpretable Task-Oriented Dialogue Systems Through Dialogue Flow Alignment
papers.title_zh: CoDial：通过对话流程对齐实现可解释的任务导向式对话系统
papers.authors: Radin Shayanfar, Chu Fei Luo, Rohan V Bhambhoria, Samuel Dahan, Xiaodan Zhu
papers.abstract: Building Task-Oriented Dialogue (TOD) systems that generalize across different tasks remains a challenging problem. Data-driven approaches often struggle to transfer effectively to unseen tasks. While recent schema-based TOD frameworks improve generalization by decoupling task logic from language understanding, their reliance on neural or generative models often obscures how task schemas influence behaviour and hence impair interpretability. In this work, we introduce a novel framework, CoDial (Code for Dialogue), at the core of which is converting a predefined task schema to a structured heterogeneous graph and then to popular programmatic LLM guardrailing code, such as NVIDIA’s Colang. The pipeline enables efficient and interpretable alignment of dialogue policies during inference. We introduce two paradigms for LLM guardrailing code generation, CoDial-free and CoDial-structured, and propose a mechanism that integrates human feedback to iteratively improve the generated code. Empirically, CoDial achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the widely used benchmark datasets, while providing inherent interpretability in the design. We additionally demonstrate CoDial’s iterative improvement via manual and LLM-aided feedback, making it a practical tool for human-guided alignment of LLMs in unseen domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 构建能够在不同任务中泛化的面向任务的对话系统仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。基于数据的方法往往难以有效地应用于未见过的任务。虽然最近的基于模式的面向任务对话框架通过将任务逻辑与语言理解分离来提高泛化能力，但它们对神经或生成模型的依赖往往掩盖了任务模式如何影响行为，从而降低了可解释性。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架CoDial（对话代码），其核心是将预定义的任务模式转换为结构化的异构图，然后再将其转换为流行的程序式大语言模型引导代码，例如NVIDIA的Colang。该流程能够实现在推理过程中高效且可解释的对话策略对齐。我们提出了两种大语言模型引导代码生成的范式：无CoDial结构和有CoDial结构，并提出了一种机制，通过整合人类反馈来迭代改进生成的代码。经验表明，CoDial在广泛使用的基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能，同时在设计上提供了固有的可解释性。我们还展示了通过人工和LLM辅助反馈实现CoDial的迭代改进，使其成为一种适用于在未见领域中对LLM进行人类引导对齐的实用工具。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: BioProAgent: Neuro-Symbolic Grounding for Constrained Scientific Planning
papers.title_zh: BioProAgent：用于约束性科学规划的神经符号基础方法
papers.authors: Yuyang Liu, Jingya Wang, Liuzhenghao Lv, Yonghong Tian
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant reasoning capabilities in scientific discovery but struggle to bridge the gap to physical execution in wet-labs. In these irreversible environments, probabilistic hallucinations are not merely incorrect; they can cause equipment damage or experimental failure. To address this, we propose BioProAgent, a neuro-symbolic framework that anchors probabilistic planning in a deterministic Finite State Machine (FSM). We introduce a State-Augmented Planning mechanism that enforces a rigorous Design-Verify-Rectify workflow, ensuring hardware compliance before execution. Furthermore, we address the context bottleneck inherent in complex device schemas by Semantic Symbol Grounding, reducing token consumption by \sim6\times through symbolic abstraction. In the extended BioProBench benchmark, BioProAgent achieves 95.6% physical compliance (compared to 21.0% for ReAct), demonstrating that neuro-symbolic constraints are essential for reliable autonomy in irreversible physical environments. Code at https://github.com/YuyangSunshine/bioproagent and Website at https://yuyangsunshine.github.io/BioPro-Project/ .
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在科学发现方面展现了显著的推理能力，但在实际执行过程中却存在困难。在这些不可逆转的环境中，概率性幻觉不仅仅是错误，还可能导致设备损坏或实验失败。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了BioProAgent这一神经符号框架，它将概率性规划与确定性有限状态机相结合。我们引入了一种状态增强规划机制，以确保遵循严格的设计验证修正工作流程，从而在执行前确保硬件的合规性。此外，我们通过语义符号引导技术解决了复杂设备架构中存在的上下文瓶颈问题，通过符号抽象减少了约6倍的令牌消耗。在扩展的BioProBench基准测试中，BioProAgent的硬件合规率达到95.6%（相比之下，ReAct的合规率仅为21.0%），这表明在不可逆转的物理环境中，神经符号约束对于实现可靠的自主性至关重要。相关代码可在https://github.com/YuyangSunshine/bioproagent下载，网站地址为https://yuyangsunshine.github.io/BioPro-Project/。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MDP-GRPO: Stabilized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Constraint Instruction Following
papers.title_zh: MDP-GRPO：用于多约束条件遵循任务的稳定组相对策略优化方法
papers.authors: Mohammad Mahdi Salmani-Zarchi, Zahra Rahimi, Heshaam Faili, Mohammad Javad Dousti
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is ideal for multi-constraint instruction following, yet standard group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) becomes unstable under discrete, low-dispersion rewards, where within-group reward distributions are frequently homogeneous. We identify and formalize three pathologies of z-score group normalization in this regime: low-variance amplification, mean-centering blindness, and zero-variance collapse. To address them, we propose MDP-GRPO, which stabilizes learning through (1) multi-temperature sampling to increase reward dispersion, (2) dual-anchor advantages to restore gradients in homogeneous groups, (3) prospect-theoretic shaping to bound updates and penalize violations based on Kahneman Tversky’s theory, and (4) asymmetric KL regularization. Evaluated on FollowBench, IFEval, and a curated multi-constraint dataset, MDP-GRPO outperforms standard GRPO, improving strict constraint satisfaction by up to 5.0% on Llama-3.2-3B. Our method also enables stable convergence with small group sizes while preserving general capabilities on MMLU and ARC.
papers.abstract_zh: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习非常适合多约束条件下的指令遵循任务。然而，在离散且分散度较低的奖励情况下，标准群体相对策略优化方法会变得不稳定，因为同一群体内的奖励分布往往具有同质性。我们发现了这种环境下z分数群体归一化的三种问题：低方差放大、均值中心盲以及零方差崩溃。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了MDP-GRPO算法。该算法通过以下方式稳定学习过程：(1)采用多温度采样来增加奖励的分散性；(2)利用双锚点优势来恢复同质群体中的梯度信息；(3)采用前景理论方法来限制更新幅度，并根据Kahneman和Tversky的理论对违规行为进行惩罚；(4)采用非对称KL正则化方法。在FollowBench、IFEval以及精心挑选的多约束数据集上进行了评估，结果表明MDP-GRPO在性能上优于标准GRPO算法，在Llama-3.2-3B上的严格约束满足率提升了5.0%。该方法还能在小群体规模下实现稳定的收敛，同时保留了在MMLU和ARC测试上的优秀表现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TokenTiming: A Dynamic Alignment Method for Universal Speculative Decoding Model Pairs
papers.title_zh: TokenTiming：一种用于通用推测解码模型对的动态对齐方法
papers.authors: Sibo Xiao, Fu Jinyuan, Zhongle Xie, Lidan Shou
papers.abstract: Accelerating the inference of large language models (LLMs) has been a critical challenge in generative AI. Speculative decoding (SD) substantially improves LLM inference efficiency. However, its utility is limited by a fundamental constraint: the draft and target models must share the same vocabulary, thus limiting the herd of available draft models and often necessitating the training of a new model from scratch. Inspired by Dynamic Time Warping (DTW), a classic algorithm for aligning time series, we propose the algorithm TokenTiming for universal speculative decoding. It operates by re-encoding the draft token sequence to get a new target token sequence, and then uses DTW to build a mapping to transfer the probability distributions for speculative sampling. Benefiting from this, our method accommodates mismatched vocabularies and works with any off-the-shelf models without retraining and modification. We conduct comprehensive experiments on various tasks, demonstrating 1.57x speedup. This work enables a universal approach for draft model selection, making SD a more versatile and practical tool for LLM acceleration.
papers.abstract_zh: 加速大语言模型（LLM）的推理过程，一直是生成式人工智能领域中的一个关键挑战。推测性解码技术显著提升了LLM推理的效率。然而，其应用受到一个基本限制：草稿模型和目标模型必须拥有相同的词汇表，这限制了可用草稿模型的种类，通常还需要从头开始训练新的模型。受动态时间规整算法启发，我们提出了一种名为TokenTiming的通用推测性解码算法。该算法通过重新编码草稿令牌序列来获得新的目标令牌序列，然后利用动态时间规整算法来构建映射关系，从而实现推测性采样的概率分布传递。得益于这一创新，我们的方法能够处理词汇表不匹配的情况，并且无需对现有模型进行重新训练或修改即可使用。我们在多种任务上进行了全面实验，结果显示，我们的方法提升了1.57倍的推理速度。这项研究成果为草稿模型的选择提供了一种通用方法，使得推测性解码成为加速LLM推理的更为实用且多用途的工具。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GUIDE: Towards Scalable Advising for Research Ideas
papers.title_zh: 指南：迈向可扩展的研究思路咨询模式
papers.authors: Yaowenqi Liu, Bingxu Meng, Rui Pan, Yuxing Liu, Jerry Huang, Jiaxuan You, Tong Zhang
papers.abstract: The field of AI research is advancing at an unprecedented pace, enabling automated hypothesis generation and experimental design across diverse domains such as biology, mathematics, and artificial intelligence. Despite these advancements, there remains a significant gap in the availability of scalable advising systems capable of providing high-quality, well-reasoned feedback to refine proposed hypotheses and experimental designs. To address this challenge, we explore key factors that underlie the development of robust advising systems, including model size, data reweighting, context length, confidence estimation, and structured reasoning processes. Our findings reveal that a relatively small model, when equipped with a well-compressed literature database and a structured reasoning framework, can outperform powerful general-purpose language models such as Deepseek-R1 in terms of acceptance rates for self-ranked top-30% submissions to ICLR 2025. Moreover, when limited to high-confidence predictions, our system achieves an acceptance rate exceeding 90% on the ICLR 2025 test set, underscoring its potential to significantly enhance the quality and efficiency of hypothesis generation and experimental design.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能研究领域正以前所未有的速度发展，使得自动化假设生成和实验设计能够在生物学、数学和人工智能等多个领域得到应用。尽管取得了这些进展，但在能够提供高质量、经过充分论证的反馈以改进提出的假设和实验设计的可扩展建议系统方面，仍然存在很大的差距。为了应对这一挑战，我们研究了构建强大建议系统所需的关键因素，包括模型规模、数据重新加权、上下文长度、置信度估计以及结构化推理过程等。我们的研究发现表明，当使用一个相对较小的模型，并且配备了一个压缩良好的文献数据库和结构化推理框架时，该模型在提交给ICLR 2025会议的top 30%的论文中，其接受率可以超过像Deepseek-R1这样的强大通用语言模型。此外，当系统仅基于高置信度的预测进行决策时，其在ICLR 2025测试集上的接受率超过了90%，这充分体现了该系统在提升假设生成和实验设计的质量和效率方面的巨大潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ARES: Adaptive Red-Teaming and End-to-End Repair of Policy-Reward System
papers.title_zh: ARES：自适应容错机制与端到端系统修复技术
papers.authors: Jiacheng Liang, Yao Ma, Tharindu Kumarage, Satyapriya Krishna, Rahul Gupta, Kai-Wei Chang, Aram Galstyan, Charith Peris
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is central to aligning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it introduces a critical vulnerability: an imperfect Reward Model (RM) can become a single point of failure when it fails to penalize unsafe behaviors. While existing red-teaming approaches primarily target policy-level weaknesses, they overlook what we term systemic weaknesses cases where both the core LLM and the RM fail in tandem.We present ARES, a framework that systematically discovers and mitigates such dual vulnerabilities. ARES employs a “Safety Mentor” that dynamically composes semantically coherent adversarial prompts by combining structured component types (topics, personas, tactics, goals) and generates corresponding malicious and safe responses. This dual-targeting approach exposes weaknesses in both the core LLM and the RM simultaneously. Using the vulnerabilities gained, ARES implements a two-stage repair process: first fine-tuning the RM to better detect harmful content, then leveraging the improved RM to optimize the core model. Experiments across multiple adversarial safety benchmarks demonstrate that ARES substantially enhances safety robustness while preserving model capabilities, establishing a new paradigm for comprehensive RLHF safety alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在使大语言模型（LLMs）更加安全方面起着至关重要的作用，但它也带来了一个严重的漏洞：如果奖励模型存在缺陷，它可能会成为一个单点故障，导致不安全的行为得不到及时惩罚。虽然现有的红队策略主要针对政策层面的弱点，但它们忽略了所谓的系统性弱点——即核心LLM和奖励模型同时出现问题的情形。我们提出了ARES框架，该框架能够系统地发现并缓解这种双重漏洞。ARES采用“安全导师”机制，通过结合结构化组件类型（主题、角色、策略、目标）来动态生成语义连贯的对抗性提示，并生成相应的恶意和安全响应。这种双目标方法可以同时暴露核心LLM和奖励模型的弱点。利用这些发现的漏洞，ARES实施了一个两阶段修复过程：首先微调奖励模型以更好地检测有害内容，然后利用改进后的奖励模型来优化核心模型。在多个对抗性安全基准测试中的实验表明，ARES显著提升了模型的安全性，同时保留了模型的能力，为全面的RLHF安全对齐开辟了新的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Reasoning Traces Shape Outputs but Models Won’t Say So
papers.title_zh: 推理过程决定了输出的形式，但模型本身并不会明确说明这一点
papers.authors: Yijie Hao, Lingjie Chen, Ali Emami, Joyce C. Ho
papers.abstract: Can we trust the reasoning traces that large reasoning models (LRMs) produce? We investigate whether these traces faithfully reflect what drives model outputs, and whether models will honestly report their influence. We introduce Thought Injection, a method that injects synthetic reasoning snippets into a model’s reasoning trace, then measures whether the model follows the injected reasoning and acknowledges doing so. Across 45,000 samples from three LRMs, we find that injected hints reliably alter outputs, confirming that reasoning traces causally shape model behavior. However, when asked to explain their changed answers, models overwhelmingly refuse to disclose the influence: non-disclosure exceeds 90% for extreme hints across 30,000 follow-up samples. Instead of acknowledging the injected reasoning, models fabricate aligned-appearing but unrelated explanations. Activation analysis reveals that sycophancy- and deception-related directions are strongly activated during these fabrications, suggesting systematic patterns rather than incidental failures. Our findings reveal a gap between the reasoning LRMs follow and the reasoning they report, raising concern that aligned-appearing explanations may not be equivalent to genuine alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们能否信任大型推理模型所产生的推理轨迹呢？我们研究了这些轨迹是否能够真实地反映驱动模型输出的因素，以及模型是否会诚实地报告它们的影响。我们引入了“思维注入”方法，该方法将合成的推理片段插入模型的推理轨迹中，然后测量模型是否遵循了这些注入的推理，并承认这一点。通过对来自三个大型推理模型的45,000个样本进行分析，我们发现注入的提示确实能够可靠地改变模型的输出结果，这证实了推理轨迹在因果上塑造了模型的行为。然而，当被要求解释他们改变的答案时，模型绝大多数都拒绝透露这种影响：在30,000个后续样本中，超过90%的模型选择不披露这种影响。相反，模型会编造出看似一致但实际上无关的解释。激活分析显示，在这些编造过程中，与奉承和欺骗相关的方向被强烈激活，这表明存在系统性的模式，而非偶然的失败。我们的研究发现揭示了推理模型所遵循的推理方式与其报告的推理方式之间存在差距，这引发了担忧：看似一致的解释可能并不等同于真正的共识。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Value of Information: A Framework for Human–Agent Communication
papers.title_zh: 信息的价值：人类与智能体沟通的框架
papers.authors: Yijiang River Dong, Tiancheng Hu, Zheng Hui, Caiqi Zhang, Ivan Vulić, Andreea Bobu, Nigel Collier
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents deployed for real-world tasks face a fundamental dilemma: user requests are underspecified, yet agents must decide whether to act on incomplete information or interrupt users for clarification. Existing approaches either rely on brittle confidence thresholds that require task-specific tuning, or fail to account for the varying stakes of different decisions. We introduce a decision-theoretic framework that resolves this trade-off through the Value of Information (VoI), enabling agents to dynamically weigh the expected utility gain from asking questions against the cognitive cost imposed on users. Our inference-time method requires no hyperparameter tuning and adapts seamlessly across contexts—from casual games to medical diagnosis. Experiments across four diverse domains (20 Questions, medical diagnosis, flight booking, and e-commerce) show that VoI consistently matches or exceeds the best manually-tuned baselines, achieving up to 1.36 utility points higher in high-cost settings. This work provides a parameter-free framework for adaptive agent communication that explicitly balances task risk, query ambiguity, and user effort.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于实际任务的大语言模型代理面临着一个根本性的困境：用户请求往往信息不足，而代理必须决定是在不完整的信息基础上做出决策，还是主动询问以获取更多信息。现有的方法要么依赖不稳定的置信度阈值，需要针对特定任务进行调整；要么无法考虑到不同决策所带来的不同风险。我们提出了一种决策理论框架，通过信息价值这一概念来平衡这一权衡，使代理能够动态权衡提问所带来的预期效用提升与用户所需付出的认知成本。我们的推理方法无需调整超参数，并且可以轻松适应不同的场景——从休闲游戏到医疗诊断。在四个不同领域的实验中（包括20个问题、医疗诊断、航班预订和电子商务），我们发现信息价值框架始终能够匹配甚至超越最佳的手动调优基准算法，在高成本场景中，其效用提升幅度高达1.36个效用点。这项工作提供了一个无需调整参数的自适应代理通信框架，能够明确平衡任务风险、查询的模糊性以及用户的努力程度。

papers.title: AutoRAN: Automated Hijacking of Safety Reasoning in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: AutoRAN：大规模推理模型中安全推理的自动化劫持技术
papers.authors: Jiacheng Liang, Tanqiu Jiang, Yuhui Wang, Rongyi Zhu, Fenglong Ma, Ting Wang
papers.abstract: This paper presents AutoRAN, the first framework to automate the hijacking of internal safety reasoning in large reasoning models (LRMs). At its core, AutoRAN pioneers an execution simulation paradigm that leverages a weaker but less-aligned model to simulate execution reasoning for initial hijacking attempts and iteratively refine attacks by exploiting reasoning patterns leaked through the target LRM’s refusals. This approach steers the target model to bypass its own safety guardrails and elaborate on harmful instructions. We evaluate AutoRAN against state-of-the-art LRMs, including GPT-o3/o4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash, across multiple benchmarks (AdvBench, HarmBench, and StrongReject). Results show that AutoRAN achieves approaching 100% success rate within one or few turns, effectively neutralizing reasoning-based defenses even when evaluated by robustly aligned external models. This work reveals that the transparency of the reasoning process itself creates a critical and exploitable attack surface, highlighting the urgent need for new defenses that protect models’ reasoning traces rather than merely their final outputs.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了AutoRAN这一首个能够自动化劫持大型推理模型中的内部安全推理的框架。其核心思想是采用一种执行模拟范式，利用一个较弱但关联性较低的模型来模拟初始劫持尝试过程中的执行推理过程，并通过利用目标推理模型拒绝机制中泄露出的推理模式来逐步改进攻击策略。这种方法能够引导目标模型绕过自身的防御机制，从而实施更危险的指令。我们对AutoRAN与多种先进的推理模型进行了对比测试，包括GPT-o3/o4-mini和Gemini-2.5-Flash，并在多个基准测试平台（如AdvBench、HarmBench和StrongReject）上进行了评估。结果表明，AutoRAN在短短一两次迭代内就能实现接近100%的成功率，即使面对经过严格对齐的外部模型，它也能有效破坏基于推理的防御机制。这项工作揭示了推理过程的透明性本身便构成了一个关键且可被利用的攻击面，这凸显了迫切需要新的防御机制来保护模型的推理轨迹，而不仅仅是其最终输出结果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Thinking Alignment of Scenario-Oriented User Simulation
papers.title_zh: 情景导向用户仿真的思维一致性
papers.authors: Xiaoting Wu, Yi Huang, Chunyang Gao, Mengfei Guo, Jingyu Yao, Junlan Feng
papers.abstract: Existing user simulators based on prompting to role-play or SFT are generally confined to imitating users’ textual utterances, without adequately considering the multi-faceted cognitive processes that underlie human decision-making during interactions. To facilitate better alignment with real human thinking patterns, we construct the LMSYS-UserThinking dataset, in which we augment 51k human–LLM conversations by reconstructing the user’s inner reasoning both during and at the end of each dialogue. Furthermore, to enhance controllability and situational coherence, we introduce scenario settings that describe the global context and user goals throughout multi-turn conversations. Using this dataset, we train user simulators called ThinkingUS on different base models. We evaluate our approach from both offline and online user simulation perspectives, ultimately demonstrating its effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的基于提示式角色扮演或SFT的用户模拟器通常仅限于模仿用户的文本表达，并未充分考虑人类在互动过程中进行决策时所涉及的多种认知过程。为了更好地模拟真实的人类思维模式，我们构建了LMSYS-UserThinking数据集。在该数据集中，我们通过重建每次对话中以及对话结束时的用户内部推理过程，对5.1万段人机对话进行了补充。此外，为了提升可控性和情境连贯性，我们还引入了描述多轮对话中整体背景和用户目标的场景设置。利用这一数据集，我们在不同的基础模型上训练了名为ThinkingUS的用户模拟器。我们从离线与在线用户模拟两个角度评估了我们的方法，最终证明了其有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AdapShot: Adaptive Many-Shot In-Context Learning with Semantic-Aware KV Cache Reuse
papers.title_zh: AdapShot：基于语义感知的KV缓存复用的自适应多任务上下文学习算法
papers.authors: Jie Ou, Jinyu Guo, Shiyao Guo, Yuang Li, Ruiqi Wu, Zhaokun Wang, Wenyi Li, Wenhong Tian
papers.abstract: Many-Shot In-Context Learning (ICL) has emerged as a promising paradigm, leveraging extensive examples to unlock the reasoning potential of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing methods typically rely on a predetermined, fixed number of shots. This static approach often fails to adapt to the varying difficulty of different queries, leading to either insufficient context or interference from noise. Furthermore, the prohibitive computational and memory costs of long contexts severely limit Many-Shot’s feasibility. To address the above limitations, we propose AdapShot, which dynamically optimizes shot counts and leverages KV cache reuse for efficient inference. Specifically, we design a probe-based evaluation mechanism that utilizes output entropy to determine the optimal number of shots. To bypass the redundant prefilling computation during both the probing and inference phases, we incorporate a semantics-aware KV cache reuse strategy. Within this reuse strategy, to address positional encoding incompatibilities, we introduce a decoupling and re-encoding method that enables the flexible reordering of cached key-value pairs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AdapShot achieves an average performance gain of \sim10% and a 4.64\times speedup compared to state-of-the-art DBSA.
papers.abstract_zh: 多镜头上下文学习（ICL）作为一种有前景的范式应运而生，它利用大量示例来激发大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于预先确定的固定数量的镜头数量。这种静态方法往往无法适应不同查询的复杂程度差异，导致上下文不足或受到噪声干扰。此外，长上下文所带来的巨大计算与内存成本问题也严重限制了多镜头学习的可行性。为了克服上述限制，我们提出了AdapShot算法。该算法能够动态优化镜头数量，并通过重用KV缓存来实现高效的推理过程。具体来说，我们设计了一种基于探针的评估机制，利用输出熵来确定最佳的镜头数量。为了避免在探测和推理阶段进行冗余的预填充计算，我们采用了一种具有语义感知能力的KV缓存重用策略。为了解决位置编码的不兼容性问题，我们引入了一种分离和重新编码的方法，使得缓存中的键值对可以灵活重新排列。大量的实验表明，AdapShot在性能上平均提升了约10%，并且比最先进的DBSA算法快了4.64倍。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Credal Concept Bottleneck Models for Epistemic–Aleatoric Uncertainty Decomposition
papers.title_zh: Credal概念中的瓶颈模型，用于认知-随机不确定性的分解
papers.authors: Tanmoy Mukherjee, Thomas Bailleux, Pierre Marquis, Zied Bouraoui
papers.abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) predict through human-interpretable concepts, but they typically output point concept probabilities that conflate epistemic uncertainty (reducible model underspecification) with aleatoric uncertainty (irreducible input ambiguity). This makes concept-level uncertainty hard to interpret and, more importantly, hard to act upon. We introduce (Credal Ensemble Concept Estimation), a CBM framework that decomposes concept uncertainty by construction. represents each concept as a credal prediction (a probability interval), derives epistemic uncertainty from disagreement across diverse concept heads, and estimates aleatoric uncertainty via a dedicated ambiguity output trained to match annotator disagreement when available. The resulting signals support prescriptive decisions: automate low-uncertainty cases, prioritize data collection for high-epistemic cases, route high-aleatoric cases to human review, and abstain when both are high. Across several tasks, we show that epistemic uncertainty is positively associated with prediction errors, whereas aleatoric uncertainty closely tracks annotator disagreement, providing guidance beyond error correlation. Our implementation is available at the following link: https://github.com/Tankiit/Credal_Sets/tree/ensemble-credal-cbm
papers.abstract_zh: 概念瓶颈模型（CBM）通过人类可理解的概念进行预测，但它们通常输出的概念概率会混淆认知不确定性（可减少的模型欠拟合问题）与随机不确定性（不可减少的输入模糊性）。这使得概念层面的不确定性难以解释，更重要的是，也难以据此采取行动。我们提出了一种名为“Credal集合概念估计”的CBM框架，该框架通过构建方式来分解概念的不确定性。它将每个概念表示为一个置信度预测（概率区间），从不同概念头之间的不一致性中推导出认知不确定性，并通过专门的模糊性输出来估计随机不确定性，该输出经过训练，能够在有可用数据的情况下与注释者的一致意见相匹配。这些结果有助于做出有指导性的决策：自动处理低不确定性的案例，为高认知不确定性的案例优先进行数据收集，将高随机不确定性的案例提交给人工审核，当两者都较高时则选择回避。在多个任务中，我们发现认知不确定性与预测误差呈正相关，而随机不确定性则与注释者的一致意见密切相关，这为决策提供了额外的指导。我们的实现代码可以在以下链接中找到：https://github.com/Tankiit/Credal_Sets/tree/ensemble-credal-cbm

papers.title: How do Role Models Shape Collective Morality? Exemplar-Driven Moral Learning in Multi-Agent Simulation
papers.title_zh: 榜样如何塑造集体道德观念？在多智能体仿真中基于榜样的道德学习机制
papers.authors: Junjie Liao, Huacong Tang, Zhou Ziheng, Yizhou Wang, Fangwei Zhong
papers.abstract: We investigate how role models shape collective morality. To explore this, we build a multi-agent simulation powered by a Large Language Models (LLMs), where agents with diverse intrinsic drives, ranging from cooperative to competitive, interact and adapt through a four-stage cognitive loop (plan-act-observe-reflect). We design four experimental games (Alignment, Collapse, Conflict, and Construction) and conduct motivational ablation studies to identify the key drivers of imitation. The results indicate that identity-driven conformity can substantially reshape the initial dispositions. Agents tend to adapt their values to align with a perceived successful exemplar, leading to rapid value convergence.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了榜样如何塑造集体道德观念。为了探究这一点，我们构建了一个由大语言模型驱动的多智能体模拟系统。在这个系统中，具有不同内在动机的智能体——从合作型到竞争型——通过四个阶段的认知循环进行互动与适应（计划-行动-观察-反思）。我们设计了四款实验性游戏（对齐、崩溃、冲突和建构），并进行了动机性剔除研究，以识别模仿的关键驱动因素。结果表明，由身份驱动的从众行为能够显著重塑初始的倾向。智能体倾向于调整自己的价值观，以符合他们认为的成功的榜样，从而导致价值观的快速趋同。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ReActR: Reasoning through Error-Activated Reflection for LLM Post-Training
papers.title_zh: ReActR：基于错误激活的反思进行大语言模型训练后推理
papers.authors: Lina Sun
papers.abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated substantial proficiency in reasoning, current approaches focus disproportionately on scaling correct training samples, underexploring the value of incorrect reasoning trajectories. Motivated by how humans learn from mistakes, we propose ReActR (Reasoning through Error-Activated Reflection), a framework that enhances reasoning by learning reflective behaviors from erroneous trajectories. Specifically, ReActR comprises data construction and training. First, we synthesize multi-turn erroneous reasoning dataset spanning diverse error types and difficult levels via self-generation and targeted error generation. Second, we enhance the model’s capabilities through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on synthesized data and then apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with multiple reward signals to further refine reasoning performance. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks and three LLMs demonstrate that ReActR effectively enhances reasoning performance. Notably, on Llama-3-8B, ReActR achieves an average improvement of 3.5% across the five datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在推理能力方面表现出色，但目前的方法主要集中在扩大正确训练样本的规模上，而忽视了错误推理路径的价值。受人类从错误中学习的方式启发，我们提出了ReActR框架——通过从错误的推理过程中学习反思行为来提升推理能力。具体来说，ReActR包括数据构建和训练两个环节。首先，我们通过自我生成和目标导向的错误生成方式，构建了涵盖多种错误类型和不同难度的多轮错误推理数据集。其次，通过对合成数据进行有监督的微调，进一步提升模型的性能；然后采用带有多个奖励信号的群体相对策略优化方法，以进一步完善推理表现。在五个基准测试平台和三个大语言模型上的广泛实验表明，ReActR确实有效提升了推理性能。值得注意的是，在Llama-3-8B模型上，ReActR在五个基准测试平台中的平均提升幅度达到了3.5%。

papers.title: RL-PLUS: Countering Capability Boundary Collapse of LLMs in Reinforcement Learning with Hybrid-policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: RL-PLUS：通过混合策略优化技术来对抗大型语言模型在强化学习中的能力边界崩溃问题
papers.authors: Yihong Dong, Xue Jiang, Yongding Tao, Huanyu Liu, Kechi Zhang, Lili Mou, Rongyu Cao, Yingwei MA, Jue Chen, Binhua Li, Zhi Jin, Fei Huang, Yongbin Li, Ge Li
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has significantly advanced the complex reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, it struggles to break through the inherent capability boundaries of the base LLM, due to its essentially on-policy strategy coupled with LLM’s immense action space and sparse reward. Critically, RLVR can lead to the capability boundary collapse, narrowing the LLM’s problem-solving scope. To address this problem, we propose R-PLUS, a novel hybrid-policy optimization approach for LLMs that synergizes internal exploitation with external data to achieve stronger reasoning capabilities and surpass the boundaries of base models. R-PLUS integrates two core components, i.e., Multiple Importance Sampling to address distributional mismatch from external data, and Exploration-Based Advantage Function to guide the model towards high-value, unexplored reasoning paths. We provide both theoretical analysis and extensive experiments to demonstrate the superiority and generalizability of our approach. Compared with existing RLVR methods, R-PLUS achieves 1) state-of-the-art performance on six math reasoning benchmarks; 2) superior performance on six out-of-distribution reasoning tasks; 3) consistent and significant gains across diverse model families, with average relative improvements up to 69.2%. Moreover, the analysis of Pass@k curves indicates that R-PLUS effectively resolves the capability boundary collapse problem.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）的复杂推理能力。然而，由于RLVR本质上采用在策略上的优化方法，而LLM具有庞大的动作空间和稀疏的奖励机制，因此它在突破LLM固有能力边界方面存在困难。关键问题是，RLVR可能导致能力边界的崩溃，从而缩小LLM的问题解决范围。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了R-PLUS这一新型混合策略优化方法。该方法将内部优化与外部数据相结合，以实现更强的推理能力，并超越基础模型的极限。R-PLUS包含两个核心组件：一是利用多重重要性抽样来处理来自外部数据的分布不匹配问题；二是采用基于探索的优势函数来引导模型走向高价值的、尚未探索过的推理路径。我们通过理论分析和大量实验证明了该方法的优越性和通用性。与现有的RLVR方法相比，R-PLUS在以下方面取得了卓越表现：1) 在六个数学推理基准测试中达到了最先进的性能水平；2) 在六个非分布型推理任务上表现出色；3) 在不同类型的模型家族中都能获得持续且显著的提升，平均相对改进幅度高达69.2%。此外，Pass@k曲线的分析表明，R-PLUS有效解决了能力边界崩溃的问题。

papers.title: Explain the Synth: Interpretable Evaluation of LLM Data Synthesis
papers.title_zh: 解释这种合成技术：对大型语言模型数据合成结果的可解释性评估
papers.authors: Yue Yang, Fan Yang, Yu Bai, Hao Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate synthetic data, in which tabular data constitute a fundamental data modality across a wide range of domains. Yet, current evaluation practices often provide limited insights into whether the synthetic data preserve real data-generating relationships or introduce plausible-looking artifacts. We present a conceptually simple, interpretable auditing framework that compares the explanatory structure induced by real versus synthetic data. The key idea is to use a transparent rule-based model as a shared explanatory language: we extract rules from real data to summarize how features relate to labels, then examine how this rule structure changes when explained using LLM-generated data. Importantly, these rules are derived by an independent rule auditor rather than by the generator itself. The resulting “explanation shift” reveals which relationships are preserved, weakened, removed, or newly introduced by the generator, offering actionable diagnostics beyond aggregate fidelity scores. We further provide a theoretical perspective that links explanation shift and cross-domain predictive gaps to distribution mismatch within an interpretable hypothesis class. Overall, our approach turns synthetic data evaluation into a human-auditable comparison of explanations, improving transparency for LLM-based tabular synthesis.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在生成合成数据时被广泛应用，而表格数据在许多领域都扮演着至关重要的角色。然而，当前的评估方法往往无法充分揭示合成数据是否保留了真实数据的生成关系，或者是否引入了看似合理的虚假信息。我们提出了一个概念简单、易于理解的审计框架，用于比较真实数据与合成数据所呈现的解释结构。其核心思想是使用一个透明的基于规则的模型作为共同的解释语言：我们从真实数据中提取规则，以了解特征与标签之间的关系；然后观察当使用语言模型生成的数据进行解释时，这些规则结构如何发生变化。重要的是，这些规则是由独立的规则审核者来确定的，而不是由生成器本身生成的。由此产生的“解释变化”能够揭示哪些关系被保留、削弱、删除或新引入，从而提供比总体真实性评分更有效的诊断依据。我们还提出了一种理论视角，将解释变化与跨领域的预测差距联系起来，认为这种差异源于可解释假设类内的分布不匹配问题。总体而言，我们的方法将合成数据的评估转化为人类可审核的解释对比过程，从而提高了基于语言模型的表格数据合成的透明度。

papers.title: Beyond the Leaderboard: Rethinking Medical Benchmarks for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越排行榜：重新思考大型语言模型的医学领域基准测试
papers.authors: Wenxuan Wang, Zizhan Ma, Guo Yu, Yiu-Fai Cheung, Meidan Ding, Jie Liu, Wenting Chen, Linlin Shen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show significant potential in healthcare, prompting numerous benchmarks to evaluate their capabilities. However, concerns persist regarding the reliability of these benchmarks, which often lack clinical fidelity, robust data management, and safety-oriented evaluation metrics. To address these shortcomings, we introduce MedCheck, the first lifecycle-oriented assessment framework specifically designed for medical benchmarks. Our framework deconstructs benchmark development into five stages from design to governance, and provides a comprehensive checklist of 46 medically-tailored criteria. Using MedCheck, we conducted an in-depth empirical evaluation of 56 medical LLM benchmarks. Our analysis uncovers widespread, systemic issues, including a profound disconnect from clinical practice, a crisis of data integrity due to unmitigated contamination risks, and a systematic neglect of safety-critical evaluation dimensions like model robustness and uncertainty awareness. Based on these findings, MedCheck is both a diagnostic tool for existing benchmarks and an actionable guideline for a more standardized, reliable, and transparent approach to evaluating AI in healthcare.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在医疗保健领域展现出巨大的潜力，因此许多基准测试被设计出来以评估它们的能力。然而，人们仍然对这些基准测试的可靠性持怀疑态度，因为这些测试往往缺乏临床精准性、完善的数据管理以及以安全性为导向的评估指标。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了MedCheck这一首个以生命周期为导向的评估框架，专门用于医学领域的基准测试。我们的框架将基准测试的开发过程分解为五个阶段，从设计到监管，并提供了包含46项医学相关标准的全面检查清单。通过使用MedCheck，我们对56个医学领域的大语言模型基准测试进行了深入的实证评估。我们的分析发现，这些基准测试存在广泛而系统的问题，包括与临床实践的严重脱节、由于数据污染风险而无法避免而导致的数据完整性危机，以及对于模型鲁棒性和不确定性感知等安全关键评估维度的系统性忽视。基于这些发现，MedCheck既可以作为现有基准测试的诊断工具，也可以作为指导标准、可靠且透明地评估人工智能在医疗保健领域应用的实用指南。

papers.title: Speech-Hands: A Self-Reflection Voice Agentic Approach to Speech Recognition and Audio Reasoning with Omni Perception
papers.title_zh: 语音-手势：一种基于自我反思的语音识别与音频推理方法，具备全方位感知能力
papers.authors: Zhen Wan, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Jinchuan Tian, Hanrong Ye, Ankita Pasad, Szu-Wei Fu, Arushi Goel, Ryo Hachiuma, Shizhe Diao, Kunal Dhawan, Sreyan Ghosh, Yusuke Hirota, Zhehuai Chen, Rafael Valle, Chenhui Chu, Shinji Watanabe, Boris Ginsburg, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang
papers.abstract: We introduce a voice-agentic framework that learns one critical omni-understanding skill: knowing when to trust itself versus when to consult external audio perception. Our work is motivated by a crucial yet counterintuitive finding: naively fine-tuning an omni-model on both speech recognition and external sound understanding tasks often degrades performance, as the model can be easily misled by noisy hypotheses. To address this, our framework, Speech-Hands, recasts the problem as an explicit self-reflection decision. This learnable reflection primitive proves effective in preventing the model from being derailed by flawed external candidates. We show that this agentic action mechanism generalizes naturally from speech recognition to complex, multiple-choice audio reasoning. Across the OpenASR leaderboard, which includes seven domain-diverse speech datasets, Speech-Hands consistently outperforms strong baselines by 12.1% WER on the OpenASR benchmark. The model also achieves 77.37% accuracy and high F1 on audio QA decisions, showing robust generalization and reliability across diverse audio question answering datasets. By unifying perception and decision-making, our work offers a practical path toward more reliable and resilient audio intelligence.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于语音代理的框架，该框架能够学习一项至关重要的“全知”技能：判断何时信任自身的信息，何时需要参考外部的声音感知信息。我们的研究源于一个关键但违反直觉的发现：单纯地在语音识别和外部声音理解任务上对全知模型进行微调，往往会导致性能下降，因为模型很容易受到噪声干扰的误导。为了解决这个问题，我们的框架“Speech-Hands”将问题重新定义为一种明确的自我反思决策。这种可学习的反思机制能够有效防止模型被有缺陷的外部信息所干扰。我们证明，这种代理式行动机制可以从语音识别自然推广到复杂的多选择音频推理任务。在包含七个不同领域语音数据集的OpenASR排行榜中，“Speech-Hands”在OpenASR基准测试上的错误率显著优于其他强大的基线模型，高出12.1%。该模型在音频问答任务中也取得了77.37%的准确率和高F1值，显示出在不同音频问答数据集上的稳健泛化能力和可靠性。通过整合感知与决策功能，我们的工作为构建更可靠、更具弹性的音频智能系统提供了实用的方法。

papers.title: When Personalization Tricks Detectors: The Feature-Inversion Trap in Machine-Generated Text Detection
papers.title_zh: 当个性化技巧识破检测器：机器生成文本检测中的功能反转陷阱
papers.authors: Lang Gao, Xuhui Li, Chenxi Wang, Mingzhe Li, Wei Liu, Zirui Song, Jinghui Zhang, Rui Yan, Preslav Nakov, Xiuying Chen
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly imitate personal writing styles, personalization has become a key challenge for machine-generated text (MGT) detection. Yet personalized MGT detection remains largely underexplored. In this work, we introduce StyloBench, the first benchmark for evaluating detector robustness under personalization, built from literary and blog texts paired with their LLM-generated imitations. Experiments across diverse detectors show pronounced performance instability under personalization, with frequent inversions relative to general-domain behavior. To better understand this limitation, we conduct an in-depth analysis and attribute it to a feature-inversion trap, i.e., features that are effective for separating human-written text (HWT) from MGT in general flip their effect in personalized contexts, ultimately misleading detectors. Motivated by this, we propose StyloCheck, a diagnostic framework for predicting detector robustness under personalization. StyloCheck identifies the inverted features and quantifies detector dependence using perturbed texts pronounced in the features. In our experiments, StyloCheck predicts both the direction and magnitude of cross-domain performance shifts with an 85% correlation to actual outcomes. We hope this work will raise awareness of the structural risks introduced by personalization and motivate more robust approaches to personalized MGT detection. The code is available at: https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/Personalized_MGT_Detect
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型越来越模仿个人写作风格，个性化已成为机器生成文本检测中的一个关键挑战。然而，个性化的机器生成文本检测仍然没有得到充分研究。在这项工作中，我们引入了StyloBench，这是首个用于评估检测器在个性化情境下鲁棒性的基准测试。该基准测试基于文学文本和博客文本，以及它们由语言模型生成的模仿文本。对不同检测器的实验表明，在个性化情境下，检测器的性能表现不稳定，经常出现与一般领域行为相反的情况。为了更好地理解这一局限性，我们进行了深入分析，并将其归因于一种“特征反转陷阱”——即，那些能够区分人类书写文本和机器生成文本的特征，在个性化情境下会反过来影响检测结果，从而误导检测器。基于这一发现，我们提出了StyloCheck，这是一个用于预测检测器在个性化情境下鲁棒性的诊断框架。StyloCheck能够识别出被反转的特征，并通过扰动这些特征来量化检测器的依赖性。在我们的实验中，StyloCheck能够准确预测跨领域性能变化的方向和幅度，其预测准确率达到了85%。我们希望这项工作能够引起人们对个性化带来的结构性风险的关注，并促使人们采用更稳健的方法来检测个性化机器生成文本。代码可访问于：https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/Personalized_MGT_Detect

papers.title: HeteroCache: A Dynamic Retrieval Approach to Heterogeneous KV Cache Compression for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: HeteroCache：一种用于长上下文LLM推理的异构KV缓存压缩技术，采用动态检索方式实现缓存数据的获取与利用
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Shi, Qibo Qiu, Xuefeng, Zhonglin Jiang, Li Yu, Jian Jiang, Xiaofei He, Wenxiao Wang
papers.abstract: The linear memory growth of the KV cache poses a significant bottleneck for LLM inference in long-context tasks. Existing static compression methods often fail to preserve globally important information. Although recent dynamic retrieval approaches attempt to address this issue, they typically suffer from coarse-grained caching strategies and incur high I/O overhead. To overcome these limitations, we propose HeteroCache, a training-free dynamic compression framework. Our method is built on two key insights: attention heads exhibit diverse temporal heterogeneity, and there is significant spatial redundancy among heads within the same layer.Guided by these insights, HeteroCache categorizes heads based on stability and similarity, applying a fine-grained weighting strategy that allocates larger cache budgets to heads with rapidly shifting attention to capture context changes.Furthermore, it features a hierarchical storage mechanism where representative heads monitor attention drift to trigger asynchronous, on-demand context retrieval, thereby hiding I/O latency.Experiments demonstrate that HeteroCache achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-context benchmarks and accelerates decoding by up to 3× compared to the original model with a 224K context. Our code is available at https://github.com/ponytaill/HeteroCache.
papers.abstract_zh: KV缓存的线性内存增长在长上下文任务中对于LLM推理构成了严重的瓶颈。现有的静态压缩方法往往无法保留具有全局重要性的信息。尽管最近出现了一些动态检索方法试图解决这一问题，但这些方法通常存在粗粒度缓存策略的问题，并且会导致较高的I/O开销。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了HeteroCache这一无需训练的动态压缩框架。我们的方法基于两个关键洞察：注意力头表现出不同的时间异质性，而同一层内的注意力头之间也存在显著的空间冗余性。基于这些洞察，HeteroCache根据稳定性和相似性对注意力头进行分类，并采用细粒度的权重分配策略，为那些注意力变化较快的头分配更多的缓存资源，以捕捉上下文的变化。此外，该框架还采用了一种分层存储机制，由代表性的注意力头监控注意力漂移，从而触发异步、按需的上下文检索，进而降低I/O延迟。实验表明，HeteroCache在长上下文基准测试上取得了最先进的性能表现，其解码速度比原始模型快了3倍左右。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/ponytaill/HeteroCache下载。

papers.title: Sparse-RL: Breaking the Memory Wall in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Stable Sparse Rollouts
papers.title_zh: 稀疏强化学习：通过稳定稀疏采样技术突破大语言模型强化学习中的记忆限制
papers.authors: Sijia Luo, Xiaokang Zhang, Yuxuan Hu, Bohan Zhang, Ke Wang, Jinbo Su, Mengshu Sun, Lei Liang, Jing Zhang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become essential for eliciting complex reasoning capabilities in Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the substantial memory overhead of storing Key-Value (KV) caches during long-horizon rollouts acts as a critical bottleneck, often prohibiting efficient training on limited hardware. While existing KV compression techniques offer a remedy for inference, directly applying them to RL training induces a severe policy mismatch, leading to catastrophic performance collapse. To address this, we introduce Sparse-RL, which empowers stable RL training under sparse rollouts. We show that instability arises from a fundamental policy mismatch among the dense old policy, the sparse sampler policy, and the learner policy. To mitigate this issue, Sparse-RL incorporates Sparsity-Aware Rejection Sampling and Importance-based Reweighting to correct the off-policy bias introduced by compression-induced information loss. Experimental results show that Sparse-RL reduces rollout overhead compared to dense baselines while preserving the performance. Furthermore, Sparse-RL inherently implements sparsity-aware training, significantly enhancing model robustness during sparse inference deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在大语言模型中实现复杂推理能力方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，在长时间范围内进行模型部署时，存储键值缓存所带来的巨大内存负担是一个严重的瓶颈问题，这往往限制了在有限硬件条件下的高效训练。虽然现有的键值压缩技术可以为推理过程提供解决方案，但将其直接应用于强化学习训练会导致严重的策略不匹配问题，从而导致性能严重下降。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Sparse-RL算法。该算法能够在稀疏部署的情况下实现稳定的强化学习训练。我们发现，这种不稳定性源于三种策略之间的根本不匹配：密集的旧策略、稀疏采样器策略以及学习者的策略。为了缓解这个问题，Sparse-RL采用了基于稀疏性的拒绝采样和基于重要性的权重调整技术，以纠正因信息丢失而引发的离策略偏差。实验结果表明，与密集的基线算法相比，Sparse-RL能够降低部署开销，同时保持良好的性能表现。此外，Sparse-RL还实现了基于稀疏性的训练机制，显著提升了模型在稀疏推理场景下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: C-World: A Computer Use Agent Environment Creator
papers.title_zh: C-World：一种用于创建计算机使用环境的工具
papers.authors: Ziqiao Xi, Shuang Liang, Qi Liu, Jiaqing Zhang, Letian Peng, Fang Nan, Meshal Nayim, Tianhui Zhang, Rishika Mundada, Lianhui Qin, Biwei Huang, Kun Zhou
papers.abstract: To close the gap between LLM-based agents and humans in planning and reasoning, agents need large-scale, diverse environments for continuous learning—yet building such environments is itself prohibitively expensive. We present C-World, an environment creation system that enables users to build agent environments on demand. We define a complete agent environment through four components: an Action Space of 5,571 format-unified tools across 204 common applications, a Task Distribution engine that synthesizes long-horizon workflows with wild constraints, a Transition Function implemented as a state controller that injects realistic failures and perturbations, and a Reward Signal combining verifiable metrics with LLM-based judgment. C-World operates in two modes: a realistic mode grounded in live API execution, and a synthesized mode powered by the World Engine, which approximates tool behavior without live service access, enabling scalable environment creation—including environments for domains and tools that do not yet exist in the real world. Evaluation of nine state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that planning ability is uniformly strong but execution remains the bottleneck, and that constraint following—not tool invocation—is the dominant failure mode. The World Engine achieves Spearman \rho = 0.883 ranking correlation with real execution, and fine-tuning on just 1,170 C-World trajectories outperforms baselines trained on 119k samples, demonstrating C-World’s dual value as a rigorous evaluation environment and a scalable data engine. Our code and data are available at https://ziqiao-git.github.io/C-World/.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了缩小基于大语言模型的智能体与人类在规划和推理能力上的差距，智能体需要大规模、多样化的环境来进行持续学习——然而，构建这样的环境成本极高。我们提出了C-World这一环境创建系统，用户可以通过该系统按需构建智能体的环境。我们定义了一个完整的智能体环境，它由四个组件构成：包含5,571种格式统一的工具的行动空间，这些工具涵盖了204种常见应用；一个能够合成具有复杂约束条件的长期工作流程的任务分配引擎；一个作为状态控制器的转换函数，它能够引入真实的故障和干扰；以及一个结合可验证指标与基于大语言模型的判断的奖励信号系统。C-World有两种运行模式：一种是基于实时API执行的真实模式，另一种是由世界引擎驱动的合成模式，该引擎可以在无需实时服务访问的情况下模拟工具行为，从而实现可扩展的环境创建——包括那些在现实世界中尚未存在的领域和工具的环境。对九种最先进的大语言模型进行评估后发现，规划能力普遍很强，但执行仍然是瓶颈问题，而遵循约束条件的行为——而非调用工具——是主要的失败模式。世界引擎与真实执行的Spearman相关系数达到了0.883，仅对1,170条C-World轨迹进行微调就能超越基于11万样本训练出的基线模型，这证明了C-World作为严格评估环境和可扩展数据引擎的双重价值。我们的代码和数据可以在https://ziqiao-git.github.io/C-World/获取。

papers.title: Do Morals Guide How LLMs Think? The Role of Ethical Perspectives in General Problem Solving
papers.title_zh: 道德观念是否决定了大型语言模型的思考方式？在解决一般性问题时，伦理视角的作用是什么？
papers.authors: Iseo Kim, Eunjin Hong, Juae Kim
papers.abstract: This study investigates how different moral conditions influence the general problem-solving capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). We aim to explore whether the role of morality as a cognitive function operating in human decision-making can be extended to LLMs. Specifically, we define distinct moral stages based on Kohlberg’s theory of moral development and design prompts to elicit model responses aligned with each corresponding condition. The validity of this alignment is verified using the Defining Issues Test, a human evaluation tool. Subsequently, models reflecting the characteristics of each condition are evaluated using the MMLU benchmark, which requires general problem-solving abilities across various domains. Experimental results show that different moral perspectives lead to changes in the model’s decision-making during general reasoning, reflected in both responses and internal representations. Notably, conditions grounded in more advanced moral stages tend to elicit more thoughtful and reflective problem-solving behavior, which is often associated with enhanced performance. Our study attempts to broaden the concept of LLM morality, which has traditionally only been considered in ethical judgment scenarios. Furthermore, it emphasizes that morality is not merely a means of ensuring safety but a crucial factor that shapes a model’s behavior and thought processes.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了不同的道德因素如何影响大语言模型的一般问题解决能力。我们旨在探讨道德作为人类决策过程中的认知功能这一角色是否也能适用于语言模型。具体来说，我们根据科尔伯格的道德发展理论定义了不同的道德阶段，并设计了提示来引发符合各阶段特征的模型反应。通过使用“定义性议题测试”这一人类评估工具来验证这种匹配的有效性。随后，我们使用MMLU基准测试来评估具有不同道德特征的语言模型的表现，该测试要求模型具备跨领域的通用问题解决能力。实验结果表明，不同的道德观念会导致模型在一般推理过程中的决策方式发生变化，这种变化体现在模型的反应和内部表征上。值得注意的是，那些基于更高级道德阶段的模型往往能展现出更加深思熟虑的问题解决行为，而这通常与更好的性能相关。我们的研究试图拓展语言模型道德概念的应用范围，因为传统上，道德概念仅被应用于伦理判断的场景中。此外，研究还强调，道德不仅仅是确保安全的一种手段，它还是塑造模型行为和思维过程的关键因素。

papers.title: ViLL-E: Video LLM Embeddings for Retrieval
papers.title_zh: ViLL-E：用于检索的视频大语言模型嵌入技术
papers.authors: Rohit Gupta, Jayakrishnan Unnikrishnan, Fan Fei, Sheng Liu, Son Tran, Mubarak Shah
papers.abstract: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) excel at video understanding tasks where outputs are textual, such as Video Question Answering and Video Captioning. However, they underperform specialized embedding-based models in Retrieval tasks, such as Text-toVideo Retrieval and Moment Retrieval. We introduce ViLL-E (Video-LLM-Embed), a unified VideoLLM architecture endowed with a novel embedding generation mechanism that allows the model to “think longer” for complex videos and stop early for easy ones. We train this model with a three-stage training methodology combining generative and contrastive learning: initial large-scale pre-training with video-caption pairs; followed by continual training on a smaller, detailed-caption dataset; and concluding with task-specific fine-tuning on a novel multi-task dataset covering Video QA, Temporal Localization, Video Retrieval, and Video-Text Matching. Our model significantly improves temporal localization (on avg. 7% over other VideoLLMs) and video retrieval (up to 4% over dual encoder models), achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art specialized embedding models while remaining competitive on VideoQA tasks. Furthermore, our joint contrastive-generative training unlocks new zero-shot capabilities, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods in composed video retrieval (+5% over SotA) and retrieval from long text (+2% over SotA).
papers.abstract_zh: 视频大语言模型在需要文本输出的视频理解任务中表现出色，例如视频问答和视频字幕生成。然而，在检索任务中，它们的表现不如基于专门嵌入模型的算法，比如文本到视频检索和时刻检索。我们提出了ViLL-E（视频-LLM-嵌入），这是一种统一的视频大语言模型架构，拥有一种创新的嵌入生成机制。该机制使模型能够针对复杂的视频进行更长时间的处理，而对于简单的视频则能够提前停止处理。我们采用三阶段训练方法对模型进行训练，结合了生成学习和对比学习：首先使用视频字幕对进行大规模预训练；然后在一个规模较小但包含详细字幕的数据集上进行持续训练；最后在一个涵盖视频问答、时间定位、视频检索和视频文本匹配的多任务数据集上进行任务特定的微调。我们的模型在时间定位方面取得了显著改进，平均比其他视频大语言模型提高了7%；在视频检索方面，其性能甚至优于双编码器模型，提高了4%。与最先进的专门嵌入模型相比，我们的模型在视频问答任务上仍然具有竞争力。此外，我们的联合对比生成训练方法还解锁了全新的零样本能力，在复合视频检索方面比最先进的方法高出5%，在从长文本中进行检索方面则高出2%。

papers.title: From Trajectories to Graphs: Contract-Checked Editing for Verifier-Guided LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 从轨迹到图：基于验证器的大语言模型推理方法——合同检查式编辑
papers.authors: Rui Li, Shuang Cao
papers.abstract: Inference-time search can substantially improve LLM reasoning when tasks admit deterministic verification, but existing methods largely refine single trajectories and lack a reliable mechanism for composing partial solutions across candidates. We propose contract-checked graph editing: represent each candidate as an interface-typed reasoning DAG and validate every nontrivial edit with a deterministic structural gate (acyclicity, namespace closure, schema validity, terminal constraints) before invoking the verifier. The gate certifies runnability only and emits auditable rejection reasons; semantic correctness is determined solely by the verifier. Instantiated in Genetic Inference Search (GIS) with Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct under strictly matched token budgets (8K tokens), contract-checked grafting increases verifier-runnable recombination from 41.2% to 92.8% and improves accuracy over rStar (+6.1 on MATH, +9.1 on MATH L5) while using 42% fewer verifier calls. The same operators transfer across outer loops (beam, best-first, MCTS) and to structured generation and code, outperforming execution-guided beam search on Spider (+2.8) and improving multi-file code generation on HumanEval-MF (+9.2).
papers.abstract_zh: 在任务允许确定性验证的情况下，推理时间搜索可以显著提升大语言模型的推理能力。然而，现有的方法大多只关注单个路径的优化，缺乏将不同候选方案的部分解决方案进行整合的有效机制。我们提出了一种基于合约检查的图编辑方法：将每个候选方案表示为一种接口类型的推理有向图，并在调用验证器之前，通过确定性结构验证规则（如无环性、命名空间封闭性、模式有效性、终端约束等）来验证每一个非平凡的编辑操作。该验证规则仅确认操作的可行性，并给出可审核的拒绝原因；语义正确性则由验证器单独负责判断。该方法在Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct模型中通过遗传推理搜索实现，在严格匹配的令牌预算下（8K令牌），合约检查过的重组操作的可运行性从41.2%提升到了92.8%，同时其准确率也优于rStar模型（+6.1在MATH任务上，+9.1在MATH L5任务上），且使用的验证器调用次数减少了42%。相同的操作符可以在外部循环（如beam算法、最佳优先算法、MCTS算法）中传递，也可以应用于结构化生成和代码生成，其性能优于执行导向的beam搜索算法在Spider任务上的表现（+2.8），并且在HumanEval-MF任务上的多文件代码生成能力也有所提升（+9.2）。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SiLP: Enhancing Non-Dominant Language Capabilities with a Selective Bidirectional Language Projection Framework
papers.title_zh: SiLP：通过选择性双向语言投射框架提升非母语语言能力
papers.authors: Junpeng Liu, Jiuyi Li, Kaiyu Huang, Bo Jin, Degen Huang, Hui Xiong
papers.abstract: Current large language models (LLMs) often exhibit performance imbalances between dominant languages (e.g., English) and non-dominant ones due to the skewed distribution of pretraining data. A common strategy to address this issue is to enhance cross-lingual alignment, thereby facilitating non-dominant language processing. However, existing methods typically rely on additional training objectives or language-specific parameters, which increase training complexity and cost. In this work, we propose a selective bidirectional language projection framework that enables efficient multilingual alignment and language shift using the intrinsic parameters. Specifically, we first identify the layers most sensitive to language projection between non-dominant and dominant languages through neuron activation analysis. We then perform sequential language projection within the selected layers by mapping non-dominant representations into the dominant language space and reverting them before generation. The bidirectional projection benefits the subsequent instruction tuning in non-dominant languages. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that our method remarkably enhances the performance of non-dominant languages. Further analyses indicate that our method learns better internal representations and exhibits strong generalization capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的大语言模型在性能上往往存在不平衡现象，即主要语言（如英语）与非主要语言之间的性能差异较大，这主要是由于预训练数据的分布不均所导致的。解决这一问题的常见方法是增强跨语言对齐能力，从而促进非主要语言的处理。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于额外的训练目标或特定于语言的参数，这会增加训练的复杂性和成本。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种选择性双向语言投影框架，该框架能够利用内在参数实现高效的多语言对齐和语言转换。具体来说，我们首先通过神经元激活分析来确定在非主要语言与主要语言之间最敏感的层。然后，我们在选定的层内进行序列语言投影，通过将非主要语言的表示映射至主要语言空间，并在生成之前将其逆转。这种双向投影机制有助于后续在非主要语言中的指令调整。在七个基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了非主要语言的性能。进一步的分析表明，我们的方法能够更好地理解内部表征，并展现出强大的泛化能力。

papers.title: Simple Agents, Biased Judges: Efficient Multi-Party Dialogue Generation & The Evaluation Gap
papers.title_zh: 简单的代理、有偏见的法官：高效的多方对话生成与评估的差距
papers.authors: Kunal Samanta, Faisal Tareque Shohan, Amine Trabelsi, Richard Khoury
papers.abstract: Multi-party social dialogue remains underexplored in the literature,in part due to the difficulty and cost of evaluation. As a result,recent work on synthetic dialogue generation often relies on automatedmetrics and LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, despite limited evidence thatsuch judges reflect human preferences in social settings. In this work,we introduce a lightweight and controllable multi-party dialoguegeneration framework (MPOD) as an experimental instrument forstudying generation and evaluation in social interaction. Using thisframework, we conduct human evaluations of open-domain multi-partydialogue simulation and directly compare human judgments againststate-of-the-art LLM judges. Across 319 pairwise comparisons, weobserve near-random agreement between humans and automated judges(Cohen’s \kappa \approx 0.11), driven by systematic behaviorsincluding extreme tie aversion and strong sensitivity toassistant-style verbosity. Crucially, human–human inter-annotatoragreement (\kappa = 0.29) is substantially higher than human–LLMagreement. To isolate themechanism underlying this misalignment, we introduce a controlledTransplant Ablation, showing that LLM judges consistentlyprefer conversations containing a single proprietary, assistant-styleagent. Additional stress tests show that judges prefer GPT-styleconversations even when utterance order is randomly shuffled,indicating insensitivity to conversational structure and coherence.Our findings provide controlled evidence that currentinstruction-tuned LLM judges do not reliably reflect human preferences for naturalness, engagingness, and overall quality in multi-party social dialogue, calling into question their widespreaduse for validating synthetic conversational data.
papers.abstract_zh: 在相关文献中，多方社会对话的研究仍然不够深入，部分原因是评估的复杂性和成本较高。因此，最近关于合成对话生成的研究往往依赖于自动化评估方法和基于大语言模型的裁判框架，尽管没有足够的证据表明这些裁判能够反映人类在社交场景中的偏好。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个轻量级且可控制的多方对话生成框架，作为研究社交互动中对话生成与评估的实验工具。利用该框架，我们对开放域多方对话模拟进行了人类评估，并直接将人类的判断与最先进的基于大语言模型的裁判结果进行比较。在319次成对比较中，我们发现人类与自动化裁判之间的一致性接近随机水平（Cohen’s κ ≈ 0.11），这一一致性是由一些系统性的行为所驱动的，包括极端的不愿意接受平局以及对于助手式冗长话语的强烈敏感性。重要的是，人类之间的互评一致性（κ = 0.29）远高于人类与大模型之间的互评一致性。为了探究这种不一致背后的机制，我们引入了可控的移植消融实验，发现大模型裁判始终更喜欢包含单一专有角色的助手式对话。进一步的压力测试表明，即使对话顺序被随机打乱，裁判仍然更喜欢GPT风格的对话，这表明他们缺乏对对话结构和连贯性的敏感度。我们的研究结果提供了有控制的证据，表明当前基于指令训练的大模型裁判并不能可靠地反映人类对多方社会对话中的自然性、吸引力以及整体质量的偏好，这让人对它们被广泛用于验证合成对话数据的安全性产生了质疑。

papers.title: EdgeFormer: Latency-Aware Collaborative Multi-Head Attention of Transformer Inference in Edge Networks
papers.title_zh: EdgeFormer：一种针对延迟问题的协作式多头注意力机制，适用于边缘网络中的Transformer推理任务
papers.authors: Yiming Yao, Jianwei Niu, Bin Dai, Tao Ren
papers.abstract: Recent breakthroughs in Transformer-based large models, have driven widespread tasks, yet their reliance on centralized cloud deployment raises significant privacy risks due to sensitive data exposure. While edge-based collaborative inference offers a privacy-preserving alternative, existing methods face critical limitations: static model partitioning cannot adapt to dynamic edge resource fluctuations, and rigid multi-head attention handling overlooks semantic-critical prioritization and parallelism. We propose EdgeFormer, a latency-aware framework for distributed Transformer inference in resource-constrained edge networks. EdgeFormer dynamically allocates model blocks across devices via efficiency-storage trade-off optimization and introduces collaborative Multi-Head Attention (cMHA), which distributes semantic-critical attention heads across devices while pruning redundant ones under real-time constraints. We further develop LiScore, a composite metric integrating attention diversity and latency costs, alongside a similarity-based retrieval method to reduce recomputation overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EdgeFormer achieves up to 2.01 \\times inference acceleration over state-of-the-art baselines with \\leq1.06% accuracy loss, maintaining robustness under varying edge conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于Transformer的大型模型在近期取得了突破性进展，这些模型被广泛应用于各种任务中。然而，由于需要依赖集中的云部署方式，这些模型存在严重的隐私风险，因为敏感数据可能会暴露出来。虽然基于边缘的协作推理提供了一种保护隐私的解决方案，但现有的方法仍然存在一些关键缺陷：静态的模型划分无法适应边缘资源的动态变化；而僵化的多头注意力机制则忽略了具有语义重要性的优先级和并行性问题。我们提出了EdgeFormer这一框架，它旨在为资源有限的边缘网络中实现分布式Transformer推理提供低延迟解决方案。EdgeFormer通过优化效率与存储之间的平衡，动态地在各个设备之间分配模型模块；同时，它引入了协作式多头注意力机制，该机制能够在实时约束条件下，将具有语义重要性的注意力头分配到各个设备上，并剔除冗余的部分。此外，我们还开发了LiScore这一综合评估指标，它结合了注意力机制的多样性与延迟成本，同时还采用了基于相似度的检索方法，以减少重新计算的开销。大量的实验表明，EdgeFormer在推理速度上比现有最先进的基线方案快了2.01倍，同时准确率损失不到1.06%。而且，它在不同的边缘环境下仍能保持良好的鲁棒性。

papers.title: LEAF: Knowledge Distillation of Text Embedding Models with Teacher-Aligned Representations
papers.title_zh: LEAF：基于教师引导表示的文本嵌入模型的知识蒸馏方法
papers.authors: Robin Vujanic, Thomas Rückstieß
papers.abstract: We present a knowledge distillation framework for text embedding models. A key distinguishing feature is that our distilled models are compatible with their teacher, enabling flexible asymmetric architectures where documents are encoded with the larger teacher model, while queries use smaller student models. We also show that our models automatically inherit MRL and robustness to output quantization whenever these properties are present in the teacher model, without explicitly training for them. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework we publish leaf-ir, a 23M parameters information retrieval oriented model that, besides being teacher-compatibile, sets a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) on BEIR, ranking no.1 on the public leaderboard for models of its size. Asymmetric mode further increases its retrieval performance. Our scheme is however not restricted to information retrieval. We demonstrate its wider applicability by synthesizing the multi-task leaf-mt model. This also sets a new SOTA, achieving no.1 on the public MTEB v2 (English) leaderboard for models of its size. Our technique is applicable to black-box models, requires no judgments nor hard negatives, and training can be conducted using small batch sizes. Thus, dataset and training infrastructure requirements for our framework are modest. We make our models publicly available under a permissive Apache 2.0 license.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个用于文本嵌入模型的知识蒸馏框架。我们的蒸馏模型与原始模型兼容，这使得我们可以构建灵活的非对称架构：文档使用较大的教师模型进行编码，而查询则使用较小的学生模型。我们还发现，只要教师模型中存在这些特性，我们的模型会自动继承MRL和输出量化的鲁棒性，而无需对其进行显式训练。为了证明我们框架的有效性，我们发布了Leaf-IR模型——一个拥有23百万参数的信息检索模型。该模型不仅与教师模型兼容，还在BEIR任务上取得了新的最佳性能，在其规模下的模型中排名首位。非对称模式进一步提升了其检索性能。不过，我们的方案并不局限于信息检索领域。我们通过合成多任务Leaf-MT模型来展示其更广泛的适用性。该模型同样在公开可用的MTEB v2（英语版）排行榜上取得了第一名，其规模下的模型中排名首位。我们的技术适用于黑盒模型，不需要任何判断或硬负例，且训练可以采用小批量方式進行。因此，我们的框架对数据集和训练基础设施的要求相对较低。我们将模型以宽松的Apache 2.0许可证形式公开提供。

papers.title: SAT: Balancing Reasoning Accuracy and Efficiency with Stepwise Adaptive Thinking
papers.title_zh: SAT：在推理准确性和效率之间找到平衡，采用逐步自适应思维方式
papers.authors: Weiyang Huang, Xuefeng Bai, Kehai Chen, Xinyang Chen, Yibin Chen, Weili Guan, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have revolutionized complex problem-solving, yet they exhibit a pervasive “overthinking”, generating unnecessarily long reasoning chains. While current solutions improve token efficiency, they often sacrifice fine-grained control or risk disrupting the logical integrity of the reasoning process. To address this, we introduce Stepwise Adaptive Thinking (SAT), a framework that performs step-level, difficulty-aware pruning while preserving the core reasoning structure. SAT formulates reasoning as a Finite-State Machine (FSM) with distinct thinking modes (SLOW, NORMAL, FAST, SKIP). It navigates these states dynamically using a lightweight Process Reward Model (PRM), compressing easy steps while preserving depth for hard ones. Experiments across 9 LRMs and 7 benchmarks show that SAT achieves up to 40% reduction in reasoning tokens while generally maintaining or improving accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/byxw13/SAT_Code.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）彻底改变了复杂问题的解决方式，但它们普遍存在“过度思考”的问题，导致推理链过于冗长。虽然当前的解决方案提升了符号使用的效率，但往往牺牲了细粒度控制的能力，甚至可能破坏推理过程的逻辑完整性。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了逐步自适应思维（SAT）框架。该框架在保留核心推理结构的同时，进行阶段性、基于难度的剪枝操作。SAT将推理过程抽象为有限状态机（FSM），并设定不同的思考模式（慢速、正常、快速、跳过）。它通过轻量级的过程奖励模型来动态切换这些模式，从而在简化简单步骤的同时，保持复杂步骤的深入性。在9种LRMs和7个基准测试中的实验表明，SAT能够将推理符号的使用量减少高达40%，同时总体上保持了或提高了推理的准确性。相关代码可访问https://github.com/byxw13/SAT_Code。

papers.title: Deep Research with Open-Domain Evaluation and Multi-Stage Guardrails for Safety
papers.title_zh: 深入的研究，结合开放域评估机制与多阶段安全保障措施
papers.authors: Wei-Chieh Huang, Henry Peng Zou, Yaozu Wu, Dongyuan Li, Yankai Chen, Weizhi Zhang, Yangning Li, Angelo Zangari, Jizhou Guo, Chunyu Miao, Liancheng Fang, Langzhou He, Yinghui Li, Renhe Jiang, Philip S. Yu
papers.abstract: Deep research frameworks have shown promising capabilities in synthesizing comprehensive reports from web sources. While deep research possesses significant potential to address complex issues through planning and research cycles, existing frameworks are deficient in sufficient evaluation procedures and stage-specific protections. They typically treat evaluation as exact match accuracy of question-answering, but overlook crucial aspects of report quality such as credibility, coherence, breadth, depth, and safety. This oversight may result in hazardous or malicious sources being integrated into the final report. To address this, we introduce DeepResearchGuard, a framework featuring four-stage safeguards with open-domain evaluation, and DRSafeBench, a novel stage-wise safety benchmark. Evaluating across GPT-4o, o4-mini, Gemini-2.5-flash, DeepSeek-v3, and GPT-5, DeepResearchGuard improves defense success rates by an absolute 16.53% while reducing over-refusal rates to approximately 6%. Through extensive experiments, we show that DeepResearchGuard enables comprehensive open-domain evaluation and stage-aware defenses that effectively block harmful content propagation, while systematically improving report quality without excessive over-refusal rates.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度研究框架在从网络来源合成综合报告方面表现出强大的能力。虽然深度研究在通过规划和研究周期解决复杂问题方面具有巨大潜力，但现有的框架在评估程序和阶段特定保护方面存在不足。这些框架通常将评估视为问答的精确匹配程度，而忽略了报告质量的关键方面，如可信度、连贯性、广度、深度和安全性。这种忽视可能导致有害或恶意内容被整合到最终报告中。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了DeepResearchGuard框架，该框架包含四个阶段的保护措施，并支持开放域评估；同时，我们还开发了DRSafeBench，这是一种新颖的阶段性安全基准测试。在GPT-4o、o4-mini、Gemini-2.5-flash、DeepSeek-v3和GPT-5上进行评估后发现，DeepResearchGuard能够将防御成功率提高16.53%，同时将过度拒绝率降低到约6%。通过广泛的实验验证，我们发现DeepResearchGuard能够实现全面的开放域评估以及基于阶段的防御机制，有效阻止有害内容的传播，同时系统地提升报告质量，而不会造成过高的过度拒绝率。

papers.title: P-Check: Advancing Personalized Reward Model via Learning to Generate Dynamic Checklist
papers.title_zh: P-Check：通过学习生成动态检查清单来推进个性化奖励模型的优化
papers.authors: Kwangwook Seo, Dongha Lee
papers.abstract: Recent approaches in personalized reward modeling have primarily focused on leveraging user interaction history to align model judgments with individual preferences. However, existing approaches largely treat user context as a static or implicit conditioning signal, failing to capture the dynamic and multi-faceted nature of human judgment. In this paper, we propose P-Check, a novel personalized reward modeling framework, designed to train a plug-and-play checklist generator that synthesizes dynamic evaluation criteria for guiding the reward prediction. To better align these checklists with personalized nuances, we introduce Preference-Contrastive Criterion Weighting, a training strategy that assigns saliency scores to criteria based on their discriminative power for personalized judgment. We conduct extensive experiments and demonstrate that P-Check not only improves reward accuracy but also enhances downstream personalized generation, and remains robust in OOD scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在个性化奖励建模领域的研究主要致力于利用用户交互历史来使模型判断与个体偏好保持一致。然而，现有的方法大多将用户上下文视为静态或隐式的条件信号，未能捕捉到人类判断的动态性和多面性。在本文中，我们提出了P-Check这一创新的个性化奖励建模框架，该框架旨在训练一种即插式检查清单生成器，它能够综合动态评估标准以指导奖励预测。为了更好地将这些检查清单与个体差异相结合，我们引入了偏好对比准则加权技术，这是一种训练策略，它根据准则在个性化判断中的区分能力来为其分配显著性分数。我们通过广泛的实验证明，P-Check不仅提升了奖励预测的准确性，还增强了下游的个性化生成能力，并且在不同环境条件下依然表现出强大的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Locate and Explain: Joint Multimodal Emotion Cause Extraction and Summarization in Conversation
papers.title_zh: 定位并解释：对话中联合多模态情感原因提取与总结的方法
papers.authors: Jikun Wan, Chen Gong, Guohong Fu
papers.abstract: Multimodal emotion cause analysis in conversation aims to identify the causes of emotions by leveraging multimodal information. Existing studies mainly formulate this problem as either utterance-level emotion cause extraction, which provides clear cause localization but limited explanation, or multimodal emotion cause generation, which offers fine-grained explanations but lacks explicit traceability to source utterances. Moreover, existing datasets rely heavily on human judgment and lack well-defined structured theoretical guidance, leading to subjective and inconsistent annotations. To address these issues, we introduce joint Multimodal Emotion Cause Extraction and Summarization in conversation (MECES), a new task that simultaneously extracts emotion cause utterances and generates cause summaries, enabling both precise localization and interpretable explanations of emotion cause. We further construct a MECES dataset guided by the Activating Events–Beliefs–Consequences theory from psychology. This dataset consists of 5,787 emotion utterances annotated with causes, comprising 12,231 emotion-cause pairs and 6,040 cause summaries. We also propose an effective end-to-end joint learning approach for MECES task, establishing strong benchmark results for this newly introduced task and dataset.
papers.abstract_zh: 在对话中分析多模态情绪原因，旨在利用多模态信息来识别情绪的原因。现有研究通常将这个问题归结为两种形式：一种是基于话语层面的情绪原因提取，这种方式能够明确指出情绪的原因，但解释较为有限；另一种是多模态情绪原因生成，这种方式能够提供详细的解释，但缺乏对原始话语的明确追溯性。此外，现有的数据集大多依赖于人工判断，缺乏明确的结构化理论指导，导致注释存在主观性和不一致性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了“对话中的多模态情绪原因提取与总结”这一新任务，该任务能够同时提取情绪原因的话语，并生成原因总结，从而实现情绪的精确定位和可解释的说明。我们还根据心理学中的“激活事件-信念-后果”理论构建了一个MECES数据集。该数据集包含5,787条带有原因标注的情绪话语，共计12,231对情绪原因对和6,040条原因总结。我们还提出了一种有效的端到端联合学习方法来处理MECES任务，为这项新引入的任务和数据集建立了可靠的基准结果。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Understanding the Behaviors of Environment-aware Information Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 理解具有环境感知能力的信息检索行为
papers.authors: Ruifeng Yuan, Chaohao Yuan, David Dai, Yu Rong, Hong Cheng, Hou Pong Chan, Chenghao Xiao
papers.abstract: Recent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches have demonstrated strong capability in handling complex queries, yet current research overlooks a critical challenge: different retrievers require fundamentally different query formulation strategies for optimal performance. In this work, we present the first systematic analysis of how LLMs can learn to adapt their query formulation strategies for different retrievers via reinforcement learning (RL). Our empirical study reveals that RL effectively teaches an LLM to tailor its queries to specific retriever characteristics. We discover that different retrievers exhibit surprisingly distinct optimal query styles (e.g., descriptive vs. question-like), suggesting strategies learned for one retriever ineffective for another. We further show that performance can be enhanced by incorporating retriever-specific human guidance and by scaling model size. To facilitate learning over multi-retrieval-step trajectories, we introduce a branching-based rollout technique that improves training stability. Our work provides the first empirical evidence and actionable insights for building truly retriever-aware RAG systems. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/LCO-Embedding/Envs-aware-Information-Retrieval.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近出现的基于检索增强生成（RAG）方法在处理复杂查询方面表现出强大的能力。然而，当前的研究忽略了一个关键挑战：不同的检索器需要截然不同的查询构建策略才能达到最佳性能。在这项研究中，我们首次系统地分析了大语言模型如何通过强化学习来适应不同检索器的查询构建策略。我们的实证研究表明，强化学习能够有效地教会大语言模型根据特定检索器的特性来调整其查询方式。我们发现，不同的检索器呈现出截然不同的最优查询风格（例如，描述性查询与问题式查询），这表明为某种检索器学习的策略对另一种检索器可能无效。此外，我们还发现，通过结合针对特定检索器的指导以及扩大模型规模，可以提高系统的性能。为了支持在多检索器环境下的学习过程，我们提出了一种基于分支的迭代技术，从而提升了训练的稳定性。我们的研究为构建真正具备检索感知能力的RAG系统提供了第一手的实证证据和实用建议。相关的代码和资源可以在https://github.com/LCO-Embedding/Envs-aware-Information-Retrieval下载。

papers.title: ServImage: An Image Generation and Editing Benchmark from Real-world Commercial Imaging Services
papers.title_zh: ServImage：一种基于真实商业成像服务的图像生成与编辑测试平台
papers.authors: Fengxian Ji, Jingpu Yang, Zirui Song, Lang Gao, Junhong Liang, Zhenhao Chen, Jinghui Zhang, Xiuying Chen
papers.abstract: Recent image generation and editing models demonstrate robust adherence to instructions and high visual quality on academic benchmarks.However, their performance on paid, real-world design projects remains uncertain. We introduce ServImage, a benchmark that explicitly correlates model outputs with economic value in commercial design projects. ServImage consists of (i) ServImageBench: a dataset of 1.07k paid commercial design tasks and 2.05k designer deliverables totaling over $295k, covering portrait, product, and digital content, along with 33k candidate images and 33k human annotations.(ii) ServImageScore: an integrated scoring system that combines three quality dimensions: baseline requirements fulfilment, visual execution quality, and commercial necessity satisfaction. These three dimensions are designed to characterize the factors that drive human payment decisions and indicate whether an image is commercially acceptable.(iii) ServImageModel: under this scoring system, we propose a payment prediction model trained on the human-annotated candidate images, achieving 82.00% accuracy in predicting human payment decisions and producing calibrated payment probabilities.ServImage provides a comprehensive foundation for assessing the commercial viability of image generation models and offers a scalable resource for future research on economically grounded vision systems Github.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的图像生成和编辑模型在学术基准测试中表现出对指令的稳健遵循以及高视觉质量。然而，它们在付费的实际设计项目中的表现仍不确定。我们提出了ServImage这一基准测试工具，该工具明确将模型输出与商业设计项目中的经济价值联系起来。ServImage包含以下组成部分：(i) ServImageBench：一个包含1.07千个付费商业设计任务以及2.05千份设计师交付成果的数据库，总价值超过29.5万美元，涵盖肖像、产品设计和数字内容领域，同时包含33千张候选图片和33千条人类注释。(ii) ServImageScore：一个综合评分系统，结合了三个质量维度：基础要求的满足程度、视觉执行质量以及商业需求的满足度。这三个维度旨在反映影响人类支付决策的因素，并判断一张图片是否具有商业可接受性。(iii) ServImageModel：在这个评分系统的基础上，我们提出了一个基于人类注释的候选图片的训练模型，该模型在预测人类支付决策方面达到了82.00%的准确率，并能够生成精确的支付概率值。ServImage为评估图像生成模型的商业可行性提供了全面的基础，同时也为未来关于经济驱动型视觉系统的研究提供了一个可扩展的资源库。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FAIRGAMER: Evaluating Social Biases in LLM-Based Video Game NPCs
papers.title_zh: FAIRGAMER：评估基于大语言模型的视频游戏角色中的社会偏见
papers.authors: Bingkang Shi, Jen-tse Huang, Luo Long, Tianyu Zong, Hongzhu Yi, Yuanxiang Wang, Songlin Hu, Xiaodan Zhang, Zhongjiang Yao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have increasingly enhanced or replaced traditional Non-Player Characters (NPCs) in video games. However, these LLM-based NPCs inherit underlying social biases (e.g., race or class), posing fairness risks during in-game interactions. To address the limited exploration of this issue, we introduce FairGamer, the first benchmark to evaluate social biases across three interaction patterns: transaction, cooperation, and competition. FairGamer assesses four bias types, including class, race, age, and nationality, across 12 distinct evaluation tasks using a novel metric, FairMCV. Our evaluation of seven frontier LLMs reveals that: (1) models exhibit biased decision-making, with Grok-4-Fast demonstrating the highest bias (average FairMCV = 76.9%); and (2) larger LLMs display more severe social biases, suggesting that increased model capacity inadvertently amplifies these biases. We release FairGamer at https://github.com/BingkangShi/FairGamer to facilitate future research on NPC fairness.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已经在视频游戏中逐渐取代了传统的非玩家角色（NPC）。然而，这些基于LLM的NPC会继承一些潜在的社会偏见（如种族或阶级），这在游戏中的互动过程中会带来公平性问题。为了进一步研究这个问题，我们推出了FairGamer——首个用于评估三种互动模式下的社会偏见的基准测试工具：交易、合作和竞争。FairGamer能够评估四种类型的偏见，包括阶级、种族、年龄和国籍等，并通过12种不同的评估任务来检测这些偏见，采用一种名为FairMCV的新指标。我们对七种前沿LLM模型的评估结果显示：(1) 这些模型在决策过程中存在偏见，其中Grok-4-Fast的偏见程度最高（平均FairMCV值为76.9%）；(2) 较大的LLM模型表现出更严重的社会偏见，这表明模型容量的增加会无意中加剧这些偏见。我们将FairGamer的源代码发布在https://github.com/BingkangShi/FairGamer，以便未来研究人员能够继续研究NPC的公平性问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EVOTOOL: Self-Evolving Tool-Use Policy Optimization in LLM Agents via Blame-Aware Mutation and Diversity-Aware Selection
papers.title_zh: EVOTOOL：一种基于责任感知的变异操作与多样性感知选择的工具使用策略优化方法，适用于大型语言模型智能体
papers.authors: Shuo Yang, Caren Han, Xueqi Ma, Yan Li, Mohammad Reza Ghasemi Madani, Eduard Hovy
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents depend on effective tool-use policies to solve complex tasks, yet optimizing these policies remains challenging dueto delayed supervision and the difficulty ofcredit assignment in long-horizon trajectories.Existing optimization approaches tend to beeither monolithic, which are prone to entangling behaviors, or single-aspect, which ignorecross-module error propagation. To addressthese limitations, we propose EVOTOOL, a self-evolving framework that optimizes a modulartool-use policy via a gradient-free evolutionary paradigm. EVOTOOL decomposes agent’stool-use policy into four modules, includingPlanner, Selector, Caller, and Synthesizer, anditeratively improves them through three mechanisms. Trajectory-Grounded Blame Attribution uses diagnostic traces to localize failuresto a specific module. Feedback-Guided Targeted Mutation then edits only that modulevia natural-language critique. Diversity-AwarePopulation Selection preserves complementarycandidates to ensure solution diversity. Acrossfour diverse benchmarks, EVOTOOL outperforms strong baselines by over 5 points on bothGPT-4.1 and Qwen3-8B, while achieving superior efficiency and transferability.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的智能体需要依赖有效的工具使用策略来解决复杂任务，然而，由于监督信息的延迟以及长周期轨迹中信用分配的难度，优化这些策略仍然具有挑战性。现有的优化方法要么过于单一，容易导致纠缠行为；要么只关注单一方面，而忽略了不同模块之间的错误传播。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了EVOTOOL这一自进化框架。该框架通过无梯度进化机制来优化智能体的工具使用策略。EVOTOOL将智能体的工具使用策略分解为四个模块：规划器、选择器、调用器和合成器，并通过三种机制逐步改进它们。轨迹基础归因机制利用诊断数据来确定故障的具体来源；反馈引导的针对性变异机制则仅对特定模块进行修改，同时采用自然语言方式进行反馈；多样性感知的种群选择机制则确保存在多种互补的解决方案。在四个不同的基准测试中，EVOTOOL在GPT-4.1和Qwen3-8B两个任务上均取得了超过5点的性能提升，同时还实现了更高的效率和可转移性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Lightweight Explainable Guardrail for Prompt Safety
papers.title_zh: 一种轻量级、可解释的安全防护机制，旨在提升即时安全性
papers.authors: Md Asiful Islam, Mihai Surdeanu
papers.abstract: We propose a lightweight explainable guardrail (LEG) method to detect unsafe prompts. LEG uses a multi-task learning architecture to jointly learn a prompt classifier and an explanation classifier, where the latter labels prompt words that explain the safe/unsafe overall decision. LEG is trained on synthetic explanation data, which is generated using a novel strategy that counteracts the confirmation biases of LLMs. Lastly, LEG’s training process uses a novel loss that captures global explanation signals as a weak supervision and combines cross-entropy and focal losses with uncertainty-based weighting. LEG obtains equivalent or better performance than the state-of-the-art for both prompt classification and explainability, both in-domain and out-of-domain on three datasets, despite the fact that its model size is considerably smaller than current approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种轻量级的可解释护栏（LEG）方法，用于检测不安全的提示。LEG采用多任务学习架构，同时训练一个提示分类器和一个解释分类器，后者会对那些能够解释安全/不安全决策的提示词进行标注。LEG是在合成解释数据上进行训练的，这些数据是通过一种新颖的策略生成的，该策略能够克服大语言模型中的确认偏见。此外，LEG的训练过程采用了一种新的损失函数，该函数将全局解释信号作为弱监督信息，并结合了交叉熵损失和基于不确定性的权重分配机制。尽管LEG的模型规模明显小于当前的方法，但在三个数据集上的提示分类和解释能力方面，其表现与最先进的方法相当甚至更优。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Explainable Disentangled Representation Learning for Generalizable Authorship Attribution in the Era of Generative AI
papers.title_zh: 在生成式人工智能时代，可解释性的去纠缠表示学习技术对于实现可推广的作者归属判定具有重要意义
papers.authors: Hieu Man, Van-Cuong Pham, Nghia Trung Ngo, Franck Dernoncourt, Thien Huu Nguyen
papers.abstract: Learning robust representations of authorial style is crucial for authorship attribution and AI-generated text detection. However, existing methods often struggle with content-style entanglement, where models learn spurious correlations between authors’ writing styles and topics, leading to poor generalization across domains. To address this challenge, we propose Explainable Authorship Variational Autoencoder (EAVAE), a novel framework that explicitly disentangles style from content through architectural separation-by-design. EAVAE first pretrains style encoders using supervised contrastive learning on diverse authorship data, then finetunes with a Variational Autoencoder (VEA) architecture using separate encoders for style and content representations. Disentanglement is enforced through a novel discriminator that not only distinguishes whether pairs of style/content representations belong to the same or different authors/content sources, but also generates natural language explanation for their decision, simultaneously mitigating confounding information and enhancing interpretability. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of EAVAE. On authorship attribution, we achieve state-of-the-art performance on various datasets, including Amazon Reviews, PAN21, and HRS. For AI-generated text detection, EAVAE excels in few-shot learning over the M4 dataset.
papers.abstract_zh: 学习作者风格的鲁棒表示对于作者归属识别和人工智能生成文本的检测至关重要。然而，现有方法往往难以处理内容风格之间的纠缠问题，即模型会错误地将作者的写作风格与主题之间建立关联，从而导致在不同领域中的泛化能力较差。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了可解释的作者变分自编码器（EAVAE）框架。该框架通过架构上的分离来明确区分风格和内容之间的关系。EAVAE首先使用监督对比学习对风格编码器进行预训练，然后采用变分自编码器架构进行微调，为风格和内容表示分别设置独立的编码器。通过一种创新的判别器来实现这种分离，该判别器不仅能判断风格/内容表示对是否属于同一作者或不同内容来源，还能生成自然语言解释来说明其决策依据，从而同时减少混淆信息并提高可解释性。大量实验证明了EAVAE的有效性。在作者归属识别方面，我们在包括Amazon Reviews、PAN21和HRS在内的多个数据集上取得了最先进的性能。在人工智能生成文本检测方面，EAVAE在M4数据集上的少样本学习表现也非常出色。
