papers.title: PodBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Instruction-Aware Audio-Oriented Podcast Script Generation
papers.title_zh: PodBench：一种全面的基准测试工具，用于评估基于音频的播客脚本生成技术
papers.authors: Chenning Xu, Mao Zheng, Mingyu Zheng, Mingyang Song
papers.abstract: Podcast script generation requires LLMs to synthesize structured, context-grounded dialogue from diverse inputs, yet systematic evaluation resources for this task remain limited. To bridge this gap, we introduce PodBench, a benchmark comprising 800 samples with inputs up to 21K tokens and complex multi-speaker instructions. We propose a multifaceted evaluation framework that integrates quantitative constraints with LLM-based quality assessment. Extensive experiments reveal that while proprietary models generally excel, open-source models equipped with explicit reasoning demonstrate superior robustness in handling long contexts and multi-speaker coordination compared to standard baselines. However, our analysis uncovers a persistent divergence where high instruction following does not guarantee high content substance. PodBench offers a reproducible testbed to address these challenges in long-form, audio-centric script generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 播客脚本的生成需要大语言模型从各种输入中合成结构化的、基于上下文的对话。然而，针对这一任务的系统评估资源仍然有限。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了PodBench这个基准测试平台，该平台包含800个样本，每个样本的输入长度可达21千个词符，并且包含复杂的多说话者指令。我们提出了一个多方面的评估框架，将定量约束与基于大语言模型的质量评估相结合。大量实验表明，虽然专有模型通常表现优异，但配备明确推理能力的开源模型在处理长文本和多说话者协调方面表现出更强的鲁棒性，优于标准基线模型。不过，我们的分析还发现了一个持续存在的问题：高度遵循指令并不一定能保证内容的丰富性。PodBench提供了一个可复用的测试平台，有助于解决长形式、以音频为中心的脚本生成中的这些挑战。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MIND: From Passive Mimicry to Active Reasoning through Capability-Aware Multi-Perspective CoT Distillation
papers.title_zh: 思维：从被动模仿到主动推理——通过基于能力的多视角协同推理提取技术实现进化
papers.authors: Jin Cui, Jiaqi Guo, Jiepeng Zhou, Ruixuan Yang, Jiayi Lu, Jiajun Xu, Jiangcheng Song, Boran Zhao, Pengju Ren
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged with remarkable capabilities in complex tasks through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, practical resource constraints have sparked interest in transferring these abilities to smaller models. However, achieving both domain performance and cross-domain generalization remains challenging. Existing approaches typically restrict students to following a single golden rationale and treat different reasoning paths independently. Due to distinct inductive biases and intrinsic preferences, alongside the student’s evolving capacity and reasoning preferences during training, a teacher’s “optimal” rationale could act as out-of-distribution noise. This misalignment leads to a degeneration of the student’s latent reasoning distribution, causing suboptimal performance. To bridge this gap, we propose MIND, a capability-adaptive framework that transitions distillation from passive mimicry to active cognitive construction. We synthesize diverse teacher perspectives through a novel “Teaching Assistant” network. By employing a novel Feedback-Driven Inertia Calibration mechanism, this network utilizes inertia-filtered training loss to align supervision with the student’s current adaptability, effectively enhancing performance while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MIND achieves state-of-the-art performance on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks, and our sophisticated latent space analysis further confirms the mechanism of reasoning ability internalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型通过思维链推理在复杂任务中展现出卓越的能力，但实际的资源限制使得人们开始关注将这些能力迁移到较小的模型中。然而，同时实现领域性能与跨领域泛化仍然具有挑战性。现有的方法通常要求学生遵循单一的“黄金推理规则”，并独立处理不同的推理路径。由于不同的归纳偏见和内在偏好，再加上学生在训练过程中能力的提升以及推理偏好的变化，教师的“最优”推理规则可能会成为超出分布范围的干扰因素。这种不一致会导致学生潜在推理分布的退化，从而导致性能不佳。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MIND这一能力自适应框架，它将蒸馏从被动模仿转变为主动的认知构建。我们通过一种创新的“教学助手”网络来综合多种教师视角。该网络采用一种新的反馈驱动惯性校准机制，利用惯性过滤后的训练损失来使监督内容与学生的当前适应能力相匹配，从而有效提升性能，同时减少灾难性的遗忘现象。大量实验表明，MIND在分布内和分布外的基准测试中均取得了顶尖性能，而我们复杂的潜在空间分析进一步证实了推理能力内部化的机制有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Knowledge Vector of Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中逻辑推理的知识向量
papers.authors: Zixuan Wang, Yuanyuan Lei
papers.abstract: Logical reasoning serves as a central capability in LLMs and includes three main forms: deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning. In this work, we study the knowledge representations of these reasoning types in LLMs and analyze the correlations among them. Our analysis shows that each form of logical reasoning can be captured as a reasoning-specific knowledge vector in a linear representation space, yet these vectors are largely independent of each other. Motivated by cognitive science theory that these subforms of logical reasoning interact closely in the human brain, as well as our observation that the reasoning process for one type can benefit from the reasoning chain produced by another, we further propose to refine the knowledge representations of each reasoning type in LLMs to encourage complementarity between them. To this end, we design a complementary subspace-constrained refinement framework, which introduces a complementary loss that enables each reasoning vector to leverage auxiliary knowledge from the others, and a subspace constraint loss that prevents erasion of their unique characteristics. Through steering experiments along reasoning vectors, we find that refined vectors incorporating complementary knowledge yield consistent performance gains. We also conduct a mechanism-interpretability analysis of each reasoning vector, revealing insights into the shared and specific features of different reasoning in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 逻辑推理是大语言模型的核心能力之一，主要包括三种形式：演绎推理、归纳推理和溯因推理。在本研究中，我们探讨了这些推理类型在大语言模型中的知识表示方式，并分析了它们之间的关联。分析结果表明，每种逻辑推理形式都可以被表示为一个特定的推理知识向量，而这些向量之间基本上是独立的。鉴于认知科学理论指出，这些逻辑推理的子形式在人类大脑中相互紧密联系，同时我们也观察到一种推理过程可以从另一种推理过程中获得的辅助信息中得到好处，因此我们进一步提出了一种改进大语言模型中每种推理类型知识表示的方案，以促进它们之间的互补性。为此，我们设计了一个基于互补子空间约束的改进框架，该框架引入了一种补充损失函数，使得每个推理向量能够利用其他向量的辅助知识；同时，还引入了子空间约束损失，以防止它们独特特性的丢失。通过针对推理向量进行引导实验，我们发现，包含互补知识的改进向量能够带来稳定的性能提升。此外，我们还对每个推理向量进行了机制可解释性分析，从而揭示了不同推理类型在大语言模型中共有的特征以及各自的特殊特点。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BanHADEX: Towards Explainable HAte Speech Detection in Bangla Using Human Annotated EXplanation
papers.title_zh: BanHADEX：利用人类注释的解释性方法实现孟加拉语语音检测的可解释性
papers.authors: Faisal Hossain Raquib, Akm Moshiur Rahman Mazumder, Md Fahim, Md Tahmid Hasan Fuad, Md Farhan Ishmam, Faria Sultana, M Ashraful Amin, Amin Ahsan Ali, Akmmahbubur Rahman
papers.abstract: Online safety in low-resource languages hinges not only on accurate hate speech detection but also on transparent, culturally grounded explanations. Yet prior works in Bangla largely focus on hate classification, while overlooking interpretability. We address this gap by introducing BanHADEX, the first hate explainability dataset in Bangla with human-annotated labels. BanHADEX contains 19,203 YouTube comments spanning April 2024–June 2025, annotated for binary hate classification with seven fine-grained hate categories, seven target groups, and concise explanations for each sample. Our data pipeline relies on a two-stage annotation protocol that uses majority voting for robust labeling. Our rich suite of experiments on open and closed-source LLMs reveals that explanation-guided LoRA substantially outperforms both classification and explanation quality across prompting and fine-tuning strategies. BanHADEX establishes the groundworks for faithful interpretability and safer moderation in linguistically rich yet under-resourced languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 在低资源语言环境中，在线安全不仅取决于对仇恨言论的准确检测，还取决于透明且符合文化特点的解释。然而，现有的孟加拉语相关研究大多集中在仇恨言论的分类上，而忽略了解释性方面的问题。我们通过引入BanHADEX来解决这个问题，这是首个包含人工标注标签的孟加拉语仇恨言论解释性数据集。BanHADEX包含了2024年4月至2025年6月期间收集的19,203条YouTube评论，这些评论被标注了二元仇恨分类结果，涵盖了七种细分的仇恨类别、七个目标群体，并且每个样本都有简洁的解释说明。我们的数据处理流程采用了两阶段标注方案，利用多数投票机制来实现可靠的标注工作。我们在开源和闭源LLM上的大量实验表明，基于解释的LoRA模型在提示生成和微调策略方面，无论是在分类效果还是解释质量上都表现得更为出色。BanHADEX为在语言丰富但资源匮乏的语言环境中实现更可靠的解释性处理和更安全的内容审核奠定了基础。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: SMILE-Next: Teaching Large Language Models to Detect, Classify, and Reason about Laughter
papers.title_zh: 微笑——下一步：训练大型语言模型来识别、分类并解析笑声的含义
papers.authors: Lee Jung-Mok, Kim Sung-Bin, Joohyun Chang, Lee Hyun, Tae-Hyun Oh
papers.abstract: Laughter is a complex social signal that conveys communicative intent beyond amusement. While prior work has focused on isolated laughter analysis tasks, a comprehensive understanding of laughter in real-world scenarios remains underexplored. We introduce SMILE-Next, a dataset for real-world laughter understanding with multimodal textual representations and question–answer annotations across three tasks: laughter detection, laughter type classification, and laughter reasoning. Building on this dataset, we propose a laughter expert LLM that leverages disentangled multimodal textual cues, together with a Mixture-of-Laugh-Experts framework and laughter-specific self-instruction for task-adaptive specialization. Experimental results show that the combination of our proposed components substantially outperforms multimodal LLM baselines, advancing robust real-world laughter understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 笑声是一种复杂的社交信号，它传达的不仅仅是娱乐的意图。虽然之前的研究主要集中在孤立的笑声分析任务上，但对现实场景中笑声的全面理解仍然缺乏深入探索。我们提出了SMILE-Next这个数据集，该数据集用于实现多模态文本表示和问答注释相结合的现实场景笑声理解，涵盖三个任务：笑声检测、笑声类型分类以及笑声推理。基于这个数据集，我们提出了一个利用多模态文本线索的笑声专家大语言模型，同时采用了混合式笑声专家框架以及针对特定任务的自我指导机制，以实现任务自适应优化。实验结果表明，我们提出的这些组件组合显著优于现有的多模态大语言模型基线，从而实现了对现实场景中笑声的稳健理解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MolMem: Memory-Augmented Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Molecular Optimization
papers.title_zh: MolMem：基于记忆增强的代理式强化学习，以实现高效的分子优化算法
papers.authors: Ziqing Wang, Yibo Wen, Abhishek Pandey, Han Liu, Kaize Ding
papers.abstract: In drug discovery, molecular optimization aims to iteratively refine a lead compound to improve molecular properties while preserving structural similarity to the original molecule. However, each oracle evaluation is expensive, making sample efficiency a key challenge for existing methods under a limited oracle budget. Trial-and-error approaches require many oracle calls, while methods that leverage external knowledge tend to reuse familiar templates and struggle on challenging objectives. A key missing piece is long-term memory that can ground decisions and provide reusable insights for future optimizations. To address this, we present MolMem (Molecular optimization with Memory), a multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework with a dual-memory system. Specifically, MolMem uses Static Exemplar Memory to retrieve relevant exemplars for cold-start grounding, and Evolving Skill Memory to distill successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Built on this memory-augmented formulation, we train the policy with dense step-wise rewards, turning costly rollouts into long-term knowledge that improves future optimization. Extensive experiments show that MolMem achieves 90% success on single-property tasks (1.5\times over the best baseline) and 52% on multi-property tasks using only 500 oracle calls. Our code is available at https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/MolMem.
papers.abstract_zh: 在药物发现领域，分子优化旨在迭代地改进候选化合物，以提升其分子特性，同时保留与原分子的结构相似性。然而，每次基于预言模型的评估都成本高昂，因此样本效率成为现有方法在有限预言模型预算下的关键挑战。试错法需要多次调用预言模型，而利用外部知识的方法则倾向于重复使用熟悉的模板，但在处理复杂任务时表现不佳。因此，我们需要一种能够长期存储信息、为后续优化提供有用见解的框架。为此，我们提出了MolMem——一个具有双记忆系统的多轮强化学习框架。具体来说，MolMem利用静态示例记忆来检索用于冷启动的相关示例，并利用进化技能记忆将成功的经验转化为可复用的策略。基于这种增强记忆的框架，我们通过密集的逐步奖励来训练策略，将昂贵的实验成果转化为长期的知识，从而改善后续的优化效果。大量实验表明，MolMem在单属性任务上的成功率达到了90%（比最佳基线水平高出1.5倍），而在多属性任务上，仅通过500次预言模型调用就能实现52%的成功率。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/MolMem下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Activation Decomposition and Steering for LLM Backdoor Remediation
papers.title_zh: 激活分解与引导方法在LLM后门修复中的应用
papers.authors: Lingfeng Zhong, Qiongkai Xu, Usman Naseem
papers.abstract: Existing works on defending against LLM backdoor attacks rely on either auxiliary models or safety-related datasets for defending against backdoor attacks on large language models, which are not always available. To address these challenges, we propose our we propose our Contrastive-Selective Activation Decomposition and Steering (CS-ADS), which contrasts relatively more benign and poisoned settings to decompose the feature vectors for steering without relying on additional auxiliary models or datasets. With such disentangled vectors for remediation, our method can achieve feasible defense qualities even better than dataset-based contrastive steering strategies. This novel decomposition-based solution is motivated by the key insight that feature representations of prompt pairs can encode the same benign semantics in different proportions, even when both prompt pairs are similarly backdoored. Such discrepancies allow our method to identify effective remediation directions for steering the generation process, thereby preventing undesired outputs. We evaluate CS-ADS against multiple state-of-the-art backdoor attacks, and experimental results show that CS-ADS provides effective defense across settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前关于防御大语言模型后门攻击的研究，大多依赖于辅助模型或与安全相关的数据集来应对后门攻击，但这些资源并不总是可用。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了对比选择性激活分解与引导方法（CS-ADS）。该方法通过将相对较为良性的情况与被注入后门的情境进行对比，从而分解特征向量以进行引导操作，而无需依赖额外的辅助模型或数据集。通过这种分离化的特征向量进行修复，我们的方法能够取得比基于数据集的对比引导策略更出色的防御效果。这一基于分解的解决方案源于一个关键洞察：即使两个提示对都被类似地植入了后门，它们的特征表示仍可以以不同的比例编码出相同的良性语义。这种差异使得我们的方法能够识别出有效的引导生成过程的方向，从而防止出现不希望出现的输出结果。我们对CS-ADS进行了多种先进后门攻击的测试，实验结果表明，CS-ADS能够在各种情况下提供有效的防御效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Survey of Large Language Models for Text-Guided Molecular Discovery: From Molecule Generation to Optimization
papers.title_zh: 关于用于文本引导的分子发现的大型语言模型的调查：从分子生成到优化过程
papers.authors: Ziqing Wang, Kexin Zhang, Zihan Zhao, Yibo Wen, Abhishek Pandey, Han Liu, Kaize Ding
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are introducing a paradigm shift in molecular discovery by enabling text-guided interaction with chemical spaces through natural language and symbolic notations, with emerging extensions to incorporate multi-modal inputs. To advance this emerging field, this survey provides an up-to-date and forward-looking review of the emerging use of LLMs for two central tasks: molecule generation and molecule optimization. We organize our survey around four fundamental challenges that have emerged as critical evaluation dimensions in recent studies: ensuring validity, enhancing synthesizability, achieving precise property control, and maximizing diversity. Based on this, we systematically analyze how current LLM learning paradigms are applied to tackle each challenge, revealing the distinct capabilities and inherent limitations of each approach. In addition, we include the commonly used datasets and evaluation protocols aligned with these challenges. We conclude by discussing future directions, positioning this survey as a resource for researchers working at the intersection of LLMs and molecular science. A continuously updated reading list is available at https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/Awesome-LLM-Centric-Molecular-Discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正在通过自然语言与符号表示，实现与化学空间的文本引导交互，从而为分子发现领域带来一场范式转变。随着多模态输入的不断扩展，这一技术得到了进一步的发展。为了推动这一新兴领域的进步，本综述对大语言模型在两大核心任务中的应用进行了最新且前瞻性的分析：分子生成与分子优化。我们围绕四个关键挑战对研究进行了整理，这些挑战已成为近期研究中的重要评估维度：确保模型的准确性、提升合成能力、精确控制分子性质，以及最大化分子的多样性。在此基础上，我们系统地分析了当前大语言模型学习范式如何应用于解决这些挑战，揭示了每种方法的独特优势和固有局限性。此外，我们还列出了与这些挑战相关的常用数据集和评估方法。最后，我们讨论了未来的研究方向，将本综述视为研究人员在大语言模型与分子科学交叉领域的重要参考资源。最新的阅读清单可访问https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/Awesome-LLM-Centric-Molecular-Discovery。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reward Alignment Optimization: A Direct Point-wise Alignment Approach
papers.title_zh: 奖励对齐优化：一种直接的逐点对齐方法
papers.authors: Zelin Li, Jia Leng, Dawei Song, Yangen Hu
papers.abstract: Direct Alignment Algorithms (DAAs) such as DPO simplify RLHF by optimizing policies directly from preference pairs. However, the Bradley–Terry probability-gap objective can induce likelihood displacement and, under weak KL constraints, may even reduce the probability of preferred responses, while implicit rewards can be limited in generalizaiton. We propose Reward Alignment Optimization (RAO), a point-wise direct alignment method that uses an explicit reward model to specify exact target generation probabilities and align the policy offline towards them. Our key insight is a theoretical principle we call “prefix consistency”, which links the normalization terms of prompts that share a prefix. Leveraging this property, RAO decouples target reward differentials from bias terms, prevents decreasing preferred-response probabilities, and better exploits reward information both within and across prompts. Extensive experiments on multiple base LLMs show that RAO consistently outperforms existing DAAs while enabling controllable target probability distributions.
papers.abstract_zh: 直接对齐算法（DAAs），如DPO，通过直接从偏好对优化策略来简化RLHF。然而，Bradley–Terry概率差目标可能会导致可能性偏差，而在较弱的KL约束条件下，甚至可能降低优先响应的概率。同时，隐式奖励在泛化能力方面存在局限性。我们提出了Reward Alignment Optimization（RAO）方法，这是一种逐点直接对齐的方法，它利用显式的奖励模型来指定精确的目标生成概率，并在离线阶段将策略对齐到这些目标概率上。我们的关键见解是一个被称为“前缀一致性”的理论原则，该原则将具有相同前缀的提示中的归一化项联系起来。利用这一特性，RAO能够将目标奖励差异与偏差项分离开来，避免降低优先响应概率，并更好地利用提示内部和之间的奖励信息。在多个基础LLM上的广泛实验表明，RAO在性能上始终优于现有的DAAs，同时还能实现可控的目标概率分布。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Programming over Thinking: Efficient and Robust Multi-Constraint Planning
papers.title_zh: 基于编程的规划：高效且稳健的多约束问题求解方法
papers.authors: Derrick Goh Xin Deik, Quanyu Long, Zhengyuan Liu, Nancy F. Chen, Wenya Wang
papers.abstract: Multi-constraint planning involves identifying, evaluating, and refining candidate plans while satisfying multiple, potentially conflicting constraints. Existing large language model (LLM) approaches face fundamental limitations in this domain. Pure reasoning paradigms, which rely on long natural language chains, are prone to inconsistency, error accumulation, and prohibitive cost as constraints compound. Conversely, LLMs combined with coding- or solver-based strategies lack flexibility: they often generate problem-specific code from scratch or depend on fixed solvers, failing to capture generalizable logic across diverse problems.To alleviate these issues, we introduce the Scalable Code Planning Engine (SCOPE), a systematic framework that disentangles query-specific problem reasoning from generic code execution. SCOPE first transforms input queries into optimized structured representations, capturing the interdependent constraints, and then autonomously generates reusable solver functions (Combination, Filter, and Deliver) that provide consistent and reliable execution across diverse problems. SCOPE achieves state-of-the-art performance while lowering cost and latency. For example, with GPT-4o, it reaches 93.1% success on TravelPlanner, a 61.6% gain over the best baseline (CoT) while cutting inference cost by 1.4 times and time by approximately 4.67 times. Code is available at https://github.com/DerrickGXD/SCOPE.
papers.abstract_zh: 多约束规划涉及在满足多个可能相互冲突的约束条件的同时，识别、评估并优化候选方案。现有的大语言模型方法在这一领域存在根本性的局限性。纯粹的推理范式依赖于冗长的自然语言链，容易出现不一致性、错误累积以及随着约束条件的增多而导致的高昂成本问题。相反，将大语言模型与基于编码或求解器的策略相结合的方法则缺乏灵活性：它们往往需要从头开始生成针对特定问题的代码，或者依赖固定的求解器，无法实现在不同问题上的通用逻辑处理。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了可扩展代码规划引擎（SCOPE）这一系统框架。该框架能够将特定问题的推理与通用代码执行分离开来。SCOPE首先将输入查询转换为优化的结构化表示形式，从而捕捉到相互依赖的约束条件，然后自动生成可复用的求解函数（组合、过滤和交付），这些函数能够在不同问题中提供一致且可靠的执行效果。SCOPE在降低成本和延迟的同时，取得了最先进的性能表现。例如，在使用GPT-4o时，它在TravelPlanner任务上的成功率达到了93.1%，比最佳基线模型高出61.6%，同时推理成本降低了1.4倍，处理时间也减少了约4.67倍。相关代码可以在https://github.com/DerrickGXD/SCOPE下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LANG: Reinforcement Learning for Multilingual Reasoning with Language-Adaptive Hint Guidance
papers.title_zh: 语言强化学习：基于多语言推理的适应性提示指导方法
papers.authors: Yuchun Fan, Bei Li, Peiguang Li, Yilin Wang, Yongyu Mu, Jian Yang, Xin Chen, Rongxiang Weng, Jingang Wang, Xunliang Cai, JingBo Zhu, Tong Xiao
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has proven effective for enhancing multi-step reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its benefits have not fully translated to multilingual contexts. Existing methods struggle with a fundamental trade-off: prioritizing input-language consistency severely hampers reasoning quality, while prioritizing reasoning often leads to unintended language drift toward English. We address this challenge with LANG, a novel framework that leverages language-conditioned hints to guide exploration in non-English reasoning tasks. Our method incorporates two key mechanisms to prevent dependency on these hints: a progressive decay schedule that gradually withdraws scaffolding, and a language-adaptive switch that tailors learning horizons to specific language difficulties. Empirical results on challenging multilingual mathematical benchmarks reveal that LANG substantially enhances reasoning performance without compromising language consistency. Moreover, we show that our framework generalizes beyond mathematics, fostering more consistent language alignment across model layers.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在提升大语言模型的多步推理能力方面表现出显著效果，但其优势并未完全体现在多语言场景中。现有方法面临一个根本性的权衡问题：如果过于强调输入语言的连贯性，会严重影响推理质量；而如果过分强调推理能力，则容易导致语言向英语偏移。我们提出了LANG这一创新框架来解决这一问题。该框架利用语言相关的提示来指导非英语推理任务的探索过程。我们的方法包含两种关键机制，以避免对这些提示的依赖：一种是逐步减少辅助信息的衰减机制，另一种则是根据特定语言难度调整学习范围的语言自适应切换机制。在具有挑战性的多语言数学基准测试中的实证结果表明，LANG能够显著提升推理性能，同时不牺牲语言连贯性。此外，我们还发现，我们的框架具有跨领域泛化能力，能够在不同语言层次上实现更一致的语言对齐。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can You Make It Sound Like You? Post-Editing LLM-Generated Text for Personal Style
papers.title_zh: 你能让生成的文本听起来更像你自己吗？为个人风格调整生成的文本吧
papers.authors: Connor Baumler, Calvin Bao, Huy Nghiem, Xinchen Yang, Marine Carpuat, Hal Daumé Iii
papers.abstract: Despite the growing use of large language models (LLMs) for writing tasks, users may hesitate to rely on LLMs when personal style is important. Post-editing LLM-generated drafts or translations is a common collaborative writing strategy, but it remains unclear whether users can effectively reshape LLM-generated text to reflect their personal style. We conduct a pre-registered online study (n=81) in which participants post-edit LLM-generated drafts for writing tasks where personal style matters to them. Using embedding-based style similarity metrics, we find that post-editing increases stylistic similarity to participants’ unassisted writing and reduces similarity to fully LLM-generated output. However, post-edited text still remains stylistically closer in style to LLM text than to participants’ unassisted control text, and it exhibits reduced stylistic diversity compared to unassisted human text. We find a gap between perceived stylistic authenticity and model-measured stylistic similarity, with post-edited text often perceived as representative of participants’ personal style despite remaining detectable LLM stylistic traces.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在写作任务中的使用越来越广泛，但当个人风格变得重要时，用户可能会犹豫是否要依赖这些模型。对由语言模型生成的草稿或译文进行后期编辑是一种常见的协作写作策略，但目前尚不清楚用户是否能够有效地调整文本，使其反映出他们的个人风格。我们开展了一项在线预注册研究（参与者数量为81人），参与者需要对那些对他们来说具有重要个人风格的由语言模型生成的草稿进行后期编辑。通过基于嵌入式的风格相似性指标分析，我们发现后期编辑能够提升文本与参与者未经编辑的写作风格之间的相似性，同时降低文本与完全由语言模型生成的文本之间的相似性。然而，经过后期编辑的文本在风格上仍然更接近语言模型的文本，而不是参与者未经编辑的对照文本。此外，与未经编辑的人类文本相比，后期编辑的文本在风格多样性方面有所减少。我们发现，感知到的风格真实性与模型测量出的风格相似性之间存在差距：尽管后期编辑的文本中仍保留着语言模型的风格痕迹，但人们通常认为它代表了参与者的个人风格。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ReCode: Reinforcing Code Generation with Reasoning-Process Rewards
papers.title_zh: ReCode：通过奖励机制强化代码生成与推理过程
papers.authors: Lishui Fan, Yu Zhang, Mouxiang Chen, Zhongxin Liu
papers.abstract: In practice, rigorous reasoning is often a key driver of correct code, while Reinforcement Learning (RL) for code generation often neglects optimizing reasoning quality. Bringing process-level supervision into RL is appealing, but it faces two challenges. First, training reliable reward models to assess reasoning quality is bottlenecked by the scarcity of fine-grained preference data. Second, naively incorporating such neural rewards may suffer from reward hacking. This work proposes ReCode(Reasoning-Reinforced Code Generation), a novel RL training framework comprising: (1) Contrastive Reasoning-Process Reward Learning (CRPL), which trains a reward model with synthesized optimized and degraded reasoning variants to assess the quality of reasoning process; and (2) Consistency-Gated GRPO (CG-GRPO), which integrates the reasoning-process reward model into RL by gating neural reasoning-process rewards with strict execution outcomes, using execution correctness as a hard gate to mitigate reward hacking. Additionally, to assess the reward model’s discriminative capability in assessing reasoning-process quality, we introduce LiveCodeBench-RewardBench (LCB-RB), a new benchmark comprising preference pairs of superior and inferior reasoning processes tailored for code generation. Experimental results across HumanEval(+), MBPP(+), LiveCodeBench, and BigCodeBench show that a 7B model trained with ReCode outperforms the base version by 16.1% and reaches performance comparable to GPT-4-Turbo. We further demonstrate the generalizability of ReCode by extending it to the math domain.
papers.abstract_zh: 在实践中，严谨的推理往往是生成正确代码的关键驱动力，而用于代码生成的强化学习往往忽略了优化推理质量的问题。将过程级监督引入强化学习中具有吸引力，但面临两个挑战。首先，训练可靠的奖励模型来评估推理质量受到细粒度偏好数据稀缺性的限制。其次，简单地结合这种神经奖励可能会导致奖励操纵问题。本研究提出了ReCode（推理-强化代码生成）这一新的强化学习训练框架，该框架包括：(1)对比推理-过程奖励学习，通过训练包含经过优化的和退化的推理变体的奖励模型来评估推理过程的质量；(2)一致性门控GRPO，通过将神经推理过程的奖励与严格的执行结果进行门控，利用执行正确性作为硬门来防止奖励操纵，从而将推理过程奖励模型整合到强化学习中。此外，为了评估奖励模型在评估推理过程质量方面的判别能力，我们引入了LiveCodeBench-RewardBench（LCB-RB），这是一个针对代码生成设计的新基准测试，包含了优秀与劣质推理过程的偏好对。在HumanEval(+)、MBPP(+)、LiveCodeBench和BigCodeBench中的实验结果表明，使用ReCode训练的7B模型性能比基础版本高出16.1%，并且其性能可与GPT-4-Turbo相媲美。我们还通过将其扩展到数学领域，进一步证明了ReCode的通用性。

papers.title: PPA-Plan: Proactive Pitfall Avoidance for Reliable Planning in Long-Context LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: PPA计划：在长期上下文的LLM推理中，通过主动避免陷阱来实现可靠规划
papers.authors: Byeongjin Kim, Gyuwan Kim, Seo Yeon Park
papers.abstract: Large language models struggle with reasoning over long contexts where relevant information is sparsely distributed. Although plan-and-execute frameworks mitigate this by decomposing tasks into planning and execution, their effectiveness is often limited by unreliable plan generation due to dependence on surface-level cues. Consequently, plans may be based on incorrect assumptions, and once a plan is formed, identifying errors and revising it reliably becomes difficult, limiting the effectiveness of reactive refinement. To address this limitation, we propose PPA-Plan, a proactive planning strategy for long-context reasoning that focuses on preventing such failures before plan generation. PPA-Plan identifies potential logical pitfalls and false assumptions, formulates them as negative constraints, and conditions plan generation on explicitly avoiding these constraints. Experiments on long-context QA benchmarks show that executing plans generated by PPA-Plan consistently outperforms existing plan-and-execute methods and direct prompting.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在处理长上下文推理时存在困难，因为相关信息往往分布稀疏。虽然计划与执行框架通过将任务分解为规划和执行两个步骤来缓解这个问题，但其有效性往往受到表面线索依赖导致的不可靠计划生成的限制。因此，制定的计划可能基于错误的假设，而一旦计划形成后，识别错误并可靠地对其进行修正就变得非常困难，这限制了反应性优化的效果。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了PPA-Plan这一主动规划策略，该策略旨在在计划生成之前预防此类失败。PPA-Plan能够识别出潜在的逻辑陷阱和错误假设，并将它们转化为负面约束条件，从而明确避免这些约束条件来指导计划生成。在长上下文问答基准测试中的实验表明，由PPA-Plan生成的计划在执行效果上始终优于现有的计划与执行方法以及直接提示方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: OPeRA: A Dataset of Observation, Persona, Rationale, and Action for Evaluating LLMs on Human Online Shopping Behavior Simulation
papers.title_zh: OPeRA：一个包含观察数据、角色设定、动机描述以及行动方案的数据集，用于评估大型语言模型在模拟人类在线购物行为方面的能力
papers.authors: Ziyi Wang, Yuxuan Lu, Wenbo Li, Amirali Amini, Bo Sun, Yakov Bart, Weimin Lyu, Jiri Gesi, Tian Wang, Jing Huang, Yu Su, Upol Ehsan, Malihe Alikhani, Toby Jia-Jun Li, Lydia Chilton, Dakuo Wang
papers.abstract: Can Large Language models (LLMs) accurately simulate the next web action of a specific user? While LLMs have shown promising capabilities in generating believable human behaviors, evaluating their ability to mimic real user behaviors remains an open challenge, largely due to the lack of high-quality, publicly available datasets that capture both the observable actions and the internal reasoning of an actual human user. To address this gap, we introduce OPeRA, a novel dataset of Observation, Persona, Rationale, and Action collected from real human participants during online shopping sessions. OPeRA is the first public dataset that comprehensively captures: user personas, browser observations, fine-grained web actions, and self-reported just-in-time rationales. We developed both an online questionnaire and a custom browser plugin to gather this dataset with high fidelity. Using OPeRA, we establish the first benchmark to evaluate how well current LLMs can predict a specific user’s next action and rationale with a given persona and <observation, action, rationale> history. This dataset lays the groundwork for future research into LLM agents that aim to act as personalized digital twins for human.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能否准确模拟特定用户的下一个网络行为？虽然这些模型在生成可信的人类行为方面表现出良好的能力，但评估它们模仿真实用户行为的能力仍然是一个未解决的挑战，主要是因为缺乏高质量、公开可用的数据集来捕捉实际用户的可观察行为和内部推理过程。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了OPeRA这个新的数据集，该数据集包含了在线购物过程中从真实人类参与者那里收集到的观察数据、人物设定、理由以及具体行为。OPeRA是第一个能够全面涵盖以下内容的公共数据集：用户人物设定、浏览器观察记录、详细的网络行为，以及用户自述的即时理由。我们开发了一个在线问卷和一个自定义的浏览器插件，以高保真度收集这些数据。利用OPeRA，我们建立了首个基准测试，用于评估当前语言模型在给定人物设定和观察-行为-理由历史的情况下，预测特定用户下一个行为的准确性。这个数据集为未来研究那些旨在作为人类个性化数字双胞胎的语言模型提供了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Can LLM Agents Simulate Multi-Turn Human Behavior? Evidence from Real Online Customer Behavior Data
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型代理能够模拟人类的多轮行为吗？来自真实在线客户行为数据的证据
papers.authors: Yuxuan Lu, Jing Huang, Yan Han, Bingsheng Yao, Sisong Bei, Yaochen Xie, Yisi Sang, Qi He, Dakuo Wang
papers.abstract: Recent research shows that LLM Agents can generate “believable” human behaviors via prompt-only methods, and such agents have been increasingly adopted in downstream applications. However, existing evaluation of these agents only focuses on qualitative believability (whether human raters think they are accurate), leaving open questions of whether LLM agents can accurately generate step-by-step actions mimicking a particular human’s behavior in a multi-turn interaction task. In this work, we take shopping as a case study and present the first large-scale quantitative evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs’ ability to accurately simulate human behavior. Using real-world data from 31,865 online shopping sessions containing 230,965 user actions, our evaluation reveals that prompt-based LLMs (DeepSeek-R1, Llama, Claude) achieve only 11.86% accuracy in generating human actions, highlighting a substantial gap in actual behavioral accuracy. Through experiments, we also showcase that strategies as simple as fine-tuning LLMs on real human click-through data augmented with synthesized reasoning traces can greatly enhance models’ performance. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B achieves 17.26% action generation accuracy and 33.86% F1 score on final purchase prediction, representing substantial improvements of 5.4% and 13.85% over prompt-only baselines. This work establishes the first rigorous benchmark and dataset for human behavior simulation and provides actionable insights for developing more accurate LLM agents for future downstream applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，仅通过提示即可让大语言模型代理生成“可信”的人类行为。这类代理已被越来越多地应用于后续应用中。然而，现有的对这些代理的评估仅关注于其可信度（即人类评估者认为它们是否准确），而忽略了大语言模型代理是否能够准确地生成模仿特定人类行为的多轮互动任务中的逐步操作。在这项研究中，我们以购物场景为例，首次对最先进的大语言模型在模拟人类行为方面的能力进行了大规模定量评估。通过利用来自31,865次在线购物会话的真实数据，这些数据包含了230,965个用户操作，我们的评估结果显示，基于提示的大语言模型（如DeepSeek-R1、Llama、Claude）在生成人类行为方面的准确率仅为11.86%，这表明实际行为模拟的准确性存在显著差距。实验还表明，只需对真实的人类点击数据进行微调，并加入合成的推理轨迹，就能显著提高模型的性能。经过微调的Qwen2.5-7B模型在最终购买预测方面的动作生成准确率达到了17.26%，F1分数达到了33.86%，与仅使用提示的基线相比，分别提高了5.4%和13.85%。这项工作建立了首个用于人类行为模拟的严格基准和数据集，为开发更精确的大语言模型代理提供了有价值的见解，从而有助于未来应用的开发。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RATE: Reviewer Profiling and Annotation-free Training for Expertise Ranking in Peer Review Systems
papers.title_zh: 评分方法：评审员画像技术以及无需注释的训练方式，用于同行评审系统中的专家排名评估
papers.authors: Weicong Liu, Zixuan Yang, Yibo Zhao, Xiang Li
papers.abstract: Reviewer assignment is increasingly critical yet challenging in the LLM era, where rapid topic shifts render many pre-2023 benchmarks outdated and where proxy signals poorly reflect true reviewer familiarity. We address this evaluation bottleneck by introducing LR-bench, a high-fidelity, up-to-date benchmark curated from 2024–2025 AI/NLP manuscripts with five-level self-assessed familiarity ratings collected via a large-scale email survey, yielding 1,055 expert-annotated paper–reviewer–score annotations. We further propose a reviewer-centric ranking framework that distills each reviewer’s recent publications into compact keyword-based profiles and fine-tunes an embedding model with weak preference supervision constructed from heuristic retrieval signals, enabling to match each manuscript against a reviewer profile directly. Across the LR-bench and the CMU gold-standard dataset, our approach consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming strong embedding baselines by a clear margin. We release LR-bench at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Gnociew/LR-bench, and an github repository at https://github.com/Gnociew/RATE-Reviewer-Assignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型时代，评审任务变得越来越重要且充满挑战。由于主题的快速变化，许多2023年之前的评估基准已经过时，而替代性信号也无法准确反映评审者对相关内容的熟悉程度。为了解决这一评估难题，我们提出了LR-bench这个高保真、最新的评估基准。该基准基于2024-2025年的人工智能与自然语言处理领域的研究成果构建，通过大规模电子邮件调查收集了五级的评审者熟悉度评分数据，最终得到了1,055份由专家标注的论文-评审者-评分注释。我们还提出了一个以评审者为核心的排名框架，该框架将每位评审者最近的出版物整理成简洁的关键词摘要，并通过基于启发式检索信号的弱偏好监督来微调嵌入模型，从而可以直接将每篇论文与评审者的摘要进行匹配。无论是在LR-bench还是CMU的金标准数据集上，我们的方法都取得了领先的性能表现，明显优于其他基于嵌入模型的基准方法。我们将LR-bench发布在https://huggingface.co/datasets/Gnociew/LR-bench，同时也在GitHub上发布了相关的代码库：https://github.com/Gnociew/RATE-Reviewer-Assignment。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Bitter Lesson of Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Workflows: A Comprehensive Reality Check
papers.title_zh: 扩散式语言模型在代理式工作流程中的惨痛教训：必须正视的现实情况
papers.authors: Qingyu Lu, Liang Ding, Kanjian Zhang, Jinxia Zhang, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: The pursuit of real-time agentic interaction has driven interest in Diffusion-based Large Language Models (dLLMs) as alternatives to auto-regressive backbones, promising to break the sequential latency bottleneck. However, does such efficiency gains translate into effective agentic behavior? In this work, we present a comprehensive evaluation of dLLMs (e.g., LLaDA, Dream) across two distinct agentic paradigms: Embodied Agents (requiring long-horizon planning) and Tool-Calling Agents (requiring precise formatting).Contrary to the efficiency hype, our results on Agentboard and BFCL reveal a “bitter lesson”: current dLLMs fail to serve as reliable agentic backbones, frequently leading to systematically failure. (1) In Embodied settings, dLLMs suffer repeated attempts, failing to branch under temporal feedback. (2) In Tool-Calling settings, dLLMs fail to maintain symbolic precision (e.g. strict JSON schemas) under diffusion noise. To assess the potential of dLLMs in agentic workflows, we introduce DiffuAgent, a multi-agent evaluation framework that integrates dLLMs as plug-and-play cognitive cores. Our analysis shows that dLLMs are effective in non-causal roles (e.g., memory summarization and tool selection) but require the incorporation of causal, precise, and logically grounded reasoning mechanisms into the denoising process to be viable for agentic tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 对实时智能体交互的追求促使人们关注基于扩散技术的大语言模型（dLLMs），作为自回归主干模型的替代方案，这些模型有望突破序列延迟的瓶颈。然而，这种效率提升是否真的能转化为有效的智能体行为呢？在这项研究中，我们对dLLMs进行了全面评估，例如LLaDA和Dream。我们采用了两种不同的智能体范式来进行测试：具身智能体（需要长期规划）和工具调用智能体（需要精确格式化的输入）。与人们对效率的期待相反，我们在Agentboard和BFCL上的实验结果表明，当前的dLLMs无法作为可靠的智能体主干模型，常常导致系统性的失败。具体来说：(1) 在具身智能体的场景中，dLLMs在时间反馈下多次尝试却未能成功分支；(2) 在工具调用场景中，dLLMs在扩散噪声的影响下无法保持符号精度（例如严格的JSON格式）。为了评估dLLMs在智能体工作流程中的潜力，我们提出了DiffuAgent这一多智能体评估框架，它将dLLMs作为即插式的认知核心进行整合。我们的分析表明，dLLMs在非因果任务中表现良好，例如记忆摘要和工具选择等任务。但是，要使它们适用于智能体任务，就需要将其与因果性、精确性和逻辑性强的推理机制结合起来。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Trajectory2Task: Training Robust Tool-Calling Agents with Synthesized Yet Verifiable Data for Complex User Intents
papers.title_zh: Trajectory2Task：使用合成但可验证的数据来训练能够处理复杂用户意图的鲁棒工具调用智能体
papers.authors: Ziyi Wang, Yuxuan Lu, Yimeng Zhang, Pei Chen, Ziwei Dong, Jing Huang, Jiri Gesi, Xianfeng Tang, Chen Luo, Qun Liu, Yisi Sang, Hanqing Lu, Manling Li, Jin Lai, Dakuo Wang
papers.abstract: Tool-calling agents are increasingly deployed in real-world customer-facing workflows. Yet most studies on tool-calling agents focus on idealized settings with general, fixed, and well-specified tasks.In real-world applications, user requests are often (1) ambiguous, (2) changing over time, or (3) infeasible due to policy constraints, and training and evaluation data that cover these diverse, complex interaction patterns remain under-represented.To bridge the gap, we present Trajectory2Task a verifiable data generation pipeline for studying tool use at scale under three realistic user scenarios: ambiguous intent, changing intent, and infeasible intents.The pipeline first conducts multi-turn exploration to produce valid tool-call trajectories. It then converts these trajectories into user-facing tasks with controlled intent adaptations. This process yields verifiable task that support closed-loop evaluation and training. We benchmark several state-of-the-art LLMs on the generated complex user scenario tasks and observe frequent failures.Finally, using successful trajectories obtained from task rollouts, we fine-tune lightweight LLMs and find consistent improvements across all three conditions, along with better generalization to unseen tool-use domains, indicating stronger tool-calling ability.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具调用代理正在越来越多地被应用于现实世界中的客户工作流程中。然而，大多数关于工具调用代理的研究都集中在理想化的环境中，这些环境中的任务通常是通用、固定且定义明确的。在现实应用中，用户请求往往具有以下特点：(1) 不明确；(2) 随时间变化；(3) 由于政策限制而无法执行。而能够涵盖这些多样且复杂的交互模式的训练和评估数据仍然相对不足。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Trajectory2Task这一可验证的数据生成流程，该流程能够在三种现实用户场景中大规模研究工具使用：意图不明确、意图随时间变化以及意图不可行的情况。该流程首先进行多轮探索以生成有效的工具调用轨迹，然后将这些轨迹转化为具有可控意图调整的用户任务。这一过程产生的任务可以支持闭环评估和训练。我们在生成的复杂用户场景任务上对几种最先进的LLM进行了基准测试，发现它们经常会出现失败情况。最后，通过利用从任务推广过程中获得的成功轨迹，我们对轻量级LLM进行了微调，发现在所有三种情况下都能获得一致的改进效果，同时还能更好地泛化到未见过的解题领域，这表明工具调用能力得到了显著提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CT-FineBench: A Diagnostic Fidelity Benchmark for Fine-Grained Evaluation of CT Report Generation
papers.title_zh: CT-FineBench：一种用于评估CT报告生成质量的诊断性基准测试
papers.authors: Ruifeng Yuan, Wanxing Chang, Weiwei Cao, Bowen Shi, Zhongyu Wei, Ling Zhang, Jianpeng Zhang
papers.abstract: The evaluation of generated reports remains a critical challenge in Computed Tomography (CT) report generation, due to the large volume of text, the diversity and complexity of findings, and the presence of fine-grained, disease-oriented attributes. Conventional evaluation metrics offer only coarse measures of lexical overlap or entity matching and fail to reflect the granular diagnostic accuracy required for clinical use. To address this gap, we propose CT-FineBench, a benchmark built from CT-RATE and Merlin to evaluate the fine-grained factual consistency of CT reports, constructed from CT-RATE and Merlin. Our benchmark is constructed through a meticulous, Question-Answering (QA) based process: first, we identify and structure key, finding-specific clinical attributes (e.g., location, size, margin). Second, we systematically transform these attributes into a QA dataset, where questions probe for specific clinical details grounded in gold-standard reports. The evaluation protocol for CT-FineBench involves using this QA dataset to query a machine-generated report and scoring the correctness of the answers. This allows for a comprehensive, interpretable, and clinically-relevant assessment, moving beyond superficial lexical overlap to pinpoint specific clinical errors. Experiments show that CT-FineBench correlates better with expert clinical assessment and is substantially more sensitive to fine-grained factual errors than prior metrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 在计算机断层扫描（CT）报告生成过程中，对报告质量的评估仍然是一个关键挑战。由于报告内容量巨大、发现结果的多样性和复杂性，以及存在各种与疾病相关的细节属性，传统的评估方法只能提供粗略的词汇重叠或实体匹配程度的信息，无法反映临床使用所需的精细诊断准确性。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了CT-FineBench这个基准测试工具。该工具基于CT-RATE和Merlin数据构建，用于评估CT报告中细微的事实一致性问题。我们的基准测试通过严谨的问题回答过程来构建：首先，我们识别并整理出与具体发现相关的临床属性（如位置、大小、边缘等）。其次，我们将这些属性转化为问题回答数据集，其中问题旨在获取基于标准报告的特定临床细节信息。CT-FineBench的评估方案包括使用这个问答数据集来查询机器生成的报告，并对答案的正确性进行评分。这种方式能够进行全面、可解释且具有临床意义的评估，从而超越单纯的词汇重叠，精准定位具体的临床错误。实验表明，CT-FineBench与专家的临床评估更为吻合，并且在识别细微事实错误方面比以往的方法更为敏感。

papers.title: Lost in Execution: On the Multilingual Robustness of Tool Calling in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 迷失在执行中：关于大型语言模型中工具调用功能的多语言鲁棒性问题
papers.authors: Zheng Luo, T Pranav Kutralingam, Ogochukwu N. Okoani, Wanpeng Xu, Hua Wei, Xiyang Hu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that invoke external tools through structured function calls. While recent work reports strong tool-calling performance under standard English-centric evaluations, the robustness of tool calling under multilingual user interactions remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce MLCL, a diagnostic benchmark, and conduct a systematic evaluation of multilingual tool calling across Chinese, Hindi, and the low-resource language Igbo. Through fine-grained error analysis, we show that many failures occur despite correct intent understanding and tool selection. We identify parameter value language mismatch as a dominant failure mode, where models generate semantically appropriate parameter values in the user’s language, violating language-invariant execution conventions. We further evaluate several inference-time system strategies and find that while these strategies substantially reduce language-induced execution errors, none of them can fully recover English-level performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作通过结构化函数调用来调用外部工具的代理。虽然最近的研究表明，在以标准英语为中心的评估中，这些模型在调用工具方面的性能表现非常出色，但在多语言用户交互环境下的工具调用鲁棒性方面，目前仍有许多未被充分探索的地方。在这项研究中，我们引入了一个名为MLCL的诊断基准测试，并对中文、印地语以及资源匮乏的语言伊博语的多语言工具调用进行了系统的评估。通过细致的分析，我们发现尽管模型能够理解用户的意图并选择正确的工具，但仍有许多调用失败的情况发生。我们发现，参数值语言不匹配是主要的失败原因——模型生成的参数值在语义上虽然合适，但却违反了语言不变的执行规则。我们还评估了几种推理时间系统策略，发现这些策略确实大大减少了由语言引起的执行错误，但没有一种策略能够完全恢复英语水平下的性能表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MTA:A Merge-then-Adapt Framework for Personalized Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MTA：一种适用于个性化大型语言模型的合并与适配框架
papers.authors: Xiaopeng Li, Yuanjin Zheng, Wanyu Wang, Wenlin Zhang, Pengyue Jia, Yingyi Zhang, Haiying He, Mengyang Ma, Yiqi Wang, Maolin Wang, Xuetao Wei, Xiangyu Zhao
papers.abstract: Personalized Large Language Models (PLLMs) aim to align model outputs with individual user preferences, a crucial capability for user-centric applications. However, the prevalent approach of fine-tuning a separate module for each user faces two major limitations: (1) storage costs scale linearly with the number of users, rendering the method unscalable; and (2) fine-tuning a static model from scratch often yields suboptimal performance for users with sparse data. To address these challenges, we propose MTA, a Merge-then-Adapt framework for PLLMs. MTA comprises three key stages. First, we construct a shared Meta-LoRA Bank by selecting anchor users and pre-training meta-personalization traits within meta-LoRA modules. Second, to ensure scalability and enable dynamic personalization combination beyond static models, we introduce an Adaptive LoRA Fusion stage. This stage retrieves and dynamically merges the most relevant anchor meta-LoRAs to synthesize a user-specific one, thereby eliminating the need for user-specific storage and supporting more flexible personalization. Third, we propose a LoRA Stacking for Few-Shot Personalization stage, which applies an additional ultra-low-rank, lightweight LoRA module on top of the merged LoRA. Fine-tuning this module enables effective personalization under few-shot settings. Extensive experiments on the LaMP benchmark demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing SOTA methods across multiple tasks. Our code is also available.
papers.abstract_zh: 个性化大语言模型（PLLMs）旨在使模型输出与个体用户偏好保持一致，这一能力对于以用户为中心的应用程序来说至关重要。然而，目前普遍采用的方法是为每个用户单独微调一个模块，这种方法存在两个主要缺陷：(1) 存储成本随着用户数量的增加而线性增长，使得该方法难以扩展；(2) 从零开始微调静态模型往往无法为数据较少的用户提供最佳性能。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MTA框架，这是一种针对PLLMs的合并后再适配的框架。MTA包含三个关键阶段。首先，我们通过选择锚点用户并在meta-LoRA模块中预训练元个性化特征，构建了一个共享的Meta-LoRA银行。其次，为了确保可扩展性并实现动态个性化组合，我们引入了自适应LoRA融合阶段。该阶段会检索并动态合并最相关的锚点meta-LoRAs，从而生成个性化的模型，这样就无需为每个用户单独存储数据，同时还能提供更灵活的个性化设置。第三，我们提出了一种LoRA堆叠式Few-shot个性化阶段，该阶段在合并后的LoRA模型上叠加了一个超低秩、轻量级的LoRA模块。通过微调这个模块，可以在少量样本的情况下实现有效的个性化效果。在LaMP基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在多个任务上均优于现有的先进方法。我们的代码也已经公开可供使用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Investigating Counterfactual Unfairness in LLMs towards Identities through Humor
papers.title_zh: 通过幽默手法探究大语言模型在对待身份相关反事实不公问题上的表现
papers.authors: Shubin Kim, Yejin Son, Junyeong Park, Keummin Ka, Seungbeen Lee, Jaeyoung Lee, Hyeju Jang, Alice Oh, Youngjae Yu
papers.abstract: Humor holds up a mirror to social perception: what we find funny often reflects who we are and how we judge others. When language models engage with humor, their reactions expose the social assumptions they have internalized from training data. In this paper, we investigate counterfactual unfairness through humor by observing how the model’s responses change when we swap who speaks and who is addressed while holding other factors constant. Our framework spans three tasks: humor generation refusal, speaker intention inference, and relational/societal impact prediction, covering both identity-agnostic humor and identity-specific disparagement humor. We introduce interpretable bias metrics that capture asymmetric patterns under identity swaps. Experiments across state-of-the-art models reveal consistent relational disparities: jokes told by privileged speakers are refused up to 67.5% more often, judged as malicious 64.7% more frequently, and rated up to 1.5 points higher in social harm on a 5-point scale. These patterns highlight how sensitivity and stereotyping coexist in generative models, complicating efforts toward fairness and cultural alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 幽默可以反映社会的认知方式：我们认为有趣的事情往往反映了我们的身份以及我们评价他人的方式。当语言模型面对幽默内容时，它们的反应会暴露出它们从训练数据中内化的社会假设。在本文中，我们通过观察在其他因素保持不变的情况下，当说话者和被说话者互换时，模型的反应如何变化，来研究幽默带来的反事实性不公平现象。我们的研究涵盖了三个任务：幽默生成拒绝、说话者意图推断以及关系/社会影响预测，同时考虑了与身份无关的幽默和与身份相关的贬低幽默。我们引入了可解释的偏见度量指标，以捕捉身份互换所带来的不对称模式。通过对最先进的模型进行实验分析，我们发现存在一致的关系差异：由特权说话者提出的笑话被拒绝的频率高出67.5%，被判断为恶意的频率高出64.7%，并且在5分制的社会危害评分中，其评分最高可高出1.5分。这些现象表明，生成模型中敏感性和刻板印象是如何共存的，这增加了实现公平性和文化融合的难度。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Response-G1: Explicit Scene Graph Modeling for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
papers.title_zh: 响应-G1：用于主动式流媒体内容理解的显式场景图建模方法
papers.authors: Ke Ma, Jiaqi Tang, Bin Guo, Xueting Han, Ruonan Xu, Qingfeng He, Ziheng Wang, Xu Wang, Qifeng Chen, Zhiwen Yu, Yunhao Liu
papers.abstract: Proactive streaming video understanding requires Video-LLMs to decide when to respond as a video unfolds, a task where existing methods often fall short due to their implicit, query-agnostic modeling of visual evidence. We introduce Response-G1, a novel framework that establishes explicit, structured alignment between the accumulated video evidence and the query’s expected response conditions via scene graphs. The framework operates in three fine-tuning-free stages: (1) online query-guided scene graph generation from streaming clips; (2) memory-based retrieval of the most semantically relevant historical scene graphs; and (3) retrieval-augmented trigger prompting for per-frame “silence/response” decisions. By grounding both evidence and conditions in a shared graph representation, Response-G1 achieves more interpretable and accurate response timing decisions. Experimental results on established benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our method in both proactive and reactive tasks, validating the advantage of explicit scene graph modeling and retrieval in streaming video understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动式视频流理解需要视频语言模型在视频播放过程中做出响应决策。目前的方法往往因缺乏对视觉信息的隐式建模而难以胜任这一任务。我们提出了Response-G1框架，该框架通过场景图实现了累积的视频信息与查询预期响应条件之间的明确、结构化关联。该框架分为三个无需细调的阶段：(1)从流媒体片段中生成基于查询的场景图；(2)基于记忆检索最相关的历史场景图；(3)通过检索增强的触发机制来做出每帧的“静音/响应”决策。通过将信息与条件都映射到共享的场景图中，Response-G1能够做出更可解释且更准确的响应时间决策。在成熟的基准测试上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在主动式和被动式任务中均表现出卓越性能，这验证了显式场景图建模和检索技术在流媒体理解中的优势。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: POLYCHARTQA: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models with Multilingual Chart Question Answering
papers.title_zh: POLYCHARTQA：利用多语言图表问答技术对大型视觉语言模型进行性能评估
papers.authors: Yichen Xu, Liangyu Chen, Liang Zhang, Zihao Yue, Jianzhe Ma, Wenxuan Wang, Qin Jin
papers.abstract: Charts are a universally adopted medium for data communication, yet existing chart understanding benchmarks are overwhelmingly English-centric, limiting their accessibility and relevance to global audiences. To address this limitation, we introduce PolyChartQA, the first large-scale multilingual benchmark for chart question answering, comprising 22,606 charts and 26,151 QA pairs across 10 diverse languages. PolyChartQA is constructed through a scalable pipeline that enables efficient multilingual chart generation via data translation and code reuse, supported by LLM-based translation and rigorous quality control. We systematically evaluate multilingual chart understanding with PolyChartQA on state-of-the-art LVLMs and reveal a significant performance gap between English and other languages, particularly low-resource ones. Additionally, we introduce a companion multilingual chart question answering training set, PolyChartQA-Train, on which fine-tuning LVLMs yields substantial gains in multilingual chart understanding across diverse model sizes and architectures. Together, our benchmark provides a foundation for developing globally inclusive vision-language models capable of understanding charts across diverse linguistic contexts. Codes and datasets are available on https://github.com/Road2Redemption/PolyChartQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 图表是一种被广泛采用的数据交流工具，然而现有的图表理解基准测试大多以英语为中心，这限制了其全球受众的可访问性和相关性。为了克服这一限制，我们推出了PolyChartQA——首个大规模的多语言图表问答基准测试，该测试包含22,606张图表和26,151对问答对，涉及10种不同的语言。PolyChartQA通过一种可扩展的流程构建而成，它能够通过数据转换和代码复用来实现高效的多语言图表生成，同时辅以基于大语言模型的翻译技术和严格的质量控制。我们使用PolyChartQA对多语言图表理解能力进行了系统评估，结果显示英语与其他语言在性能上存在显著差距，尤其是资源匮乏的语言。此外，我们还开发了一个配套的多语言图表问答训练集PolyChartQA-Train，通过对该训练集进行微调，可以在不同规模和结构的大语言模型中显著提高多语言图表理解能力。总的来说，我们的基准测试为开发能够跨多种语言环境理解图表的全球通用视觉语言模型提供了基础支持。相关代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Road2Redemption/PolyChartQA下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Nature-Inspired Population-Based Evolution of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 受自然启发的、基于种群的大型语言模型进化机制
papers.authors: Yiqun Zhang, Peng Ye, Xiaocui Yang, Shi Feng, Shufei Zhang, Lei Bai, Wanli Ouyang, Shuyue Hu
papers.abstract: Evolution, the engine behind the survival and growth of life on Earth, operates through the population-based process of reproduction. Inspired by this principle, this paper formally defines a newly emerging problem: the population-based evolution of large language models (LLMs). We introduce a novel framework that starts with a population of parent LLMs and allows this population to evolve through four key operations: (i) crossover, merging the weights of different parents to create offspring LLMs, (ii) mutation, introducing small, random changes to model weights to foster diversity, (iii) selection, prioritizing high-performing models, and (iv) succession, transferring the learned experience from parent to offspring LLMs. With only 200 samples per new task, the LLM population evolves rapidly to adapt to the task at hand, without any gradients. Experiments on 12 datasets show that our framework consistently outperforms existing multi-LLM merging and adaptation methods, achieving relative performance gains of up to 54.8 over the best LLM in the initial population. Moreover, our framework allows for (i) the evolution of LLMs across multiple new tasks simultaneously, (ii) scaling effectively with populations of up to 40 LLMs, and (iii) even zero-shot generalization to unseen held-out tasks. Code: https://github.com/ZhangYiqun018/GENOME
papers.abstract_zh: 进化是生命在地球上生存和繁衍的驱动力，它通过基于种群的繁殖过程来发挥作用。受此原理启发，本文正式定义了一个新出现的问题：大语言模型（LLM）的基于种群的进化。我们提出了一个新颖的框架，该框架以一组父代LLM为起点，并通过四种关键操作使这些模型不断进化：(i) 交叉，合并不同父代模型的权重以生成新的LLM；(ii) 突变，对模型权重进行微小的随机修改，以促进多样性；(iii) 选择，优先考虑性能优秀的模型；(iv) 传承，将父代模型的学习经验传递给子代LLM。由于每个新任务只需200个样本，LLM种群能够快速进化以适应当前任务的需求，而无需任何梯度更新。在12个数据集上的实验表明，我们的框架始终优于现有的多LLM合并和适应方法，其相对性能提升幅度高达54.8%，甚至超过了初始种群中性能最好的LLM。此外，我们的框架还具备以下优势：(i) 能够同时针对多个新任务进化LLM；(ii) 能够有效扩展至多达40个LLM的种群规模；(iii) 甚至能够在未见过的任务上实现零样本泛化。代码链接：https://github.com/ZhangYiqun018/GENOME

papers.title: MTRouter: Cost-Aware Multi-Turn LLM Routing with History–Model Joint Embeddings
papers.title_zh: MTRouter：具有历史记录的按需付费多轮次大语言模型路由系统——模型联合嵌入技术
papers.authors: Yiqun Zhang, Hao Li, Zihan Wang, Shi Feng, Xiaocui Yang, Daling Wang, Bo Zhang, Lei Bai, Shuyue Hu
papers.abstract: Multi-turn, long-horizon tasks are increasingly common for large language models (LLMs), but solving them typically requires many sequential model invocations, accumulating substantial inference costs. Here, we study cost-aware multi-turn LLM routing: selecting which model to invoke at each turn from a model pool, given a fixed cost budget. We propose MTRouter, which encodes the interaction history and candidate models into joint history–model embeddings, and learns an outcome estimator from logged trajectories to predict turn-level model utility. Experiments show that MTRouter improves the performance–cost trade-off: on ScienceWorld, it surpasses GPT-5 while reducing total cost by 58.7%; on Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE), it achieves competitive accuracy while reducing total cost by 43.4% relative to GPT-5, and these gains even carry over to held-out tasks. Further analyses reveal several mechanisms underlying its effectiveness: relative to prior multi-turn routers, MTRouter makes fewer model switches, is more tolerant to transient errors, and exhibits emergent specialization across models.Code: https://github.com/ZhangYiqun018/MTRouter
papers.abstract_zh: 对于大语言模型来说，多轮次、长周期的任务越来越常见。但要解决这些任务通常需要多次调用模型，这会导致巨大的推理成本。在这里，我们研究了一种考虑成本的多轮次模型路由方法：在固定的成本预算下，选择从模型池中调用哪个模型。我们提出了MTRouter这个算法，它将交互历史和候选模型编码到联合历史-模型嵌入中，并通过记录下来的轨迹来学习预测每轮次模型效用的方法。实验表明，MTRouter改善了性能与成本之间的平衡：在ScienceWorld上，它的表现优于GPT-5，同时总成本降低了58.7%；在Humanity’s Last Exam（HLE）上，它的准确率相当，但总成本相比GPT-5降低了43.4%。这些改进甚至体现在其他未处理的任务上。进一步的分析揭示了其有效性的几个机制：与之前的多轮次路由算法相比，MTRouter减少了模型切换的次数，更能容忍瞬态错误，并且不同模型之间表现出明显的专业化特征。代码链接：https://github.com/ZhangYiqun018/MTRouter
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Feeling Right vs. Being Right: How AI Sycophancy Affects Value-Laden Deliberation
papers.title_zh: 感觉正确与实际上正确：人工智能的阿谀奉承如何影响决策过程
papers.authors: Jeongwoo Ryu, Soomin Kim, Jinsu Eun, Kyusik Kim, Changhoon Oh, Bongwon Suh
papers.abstract: As people increasingly turn to AI for personal deliberation beyond task-oriented assistance, concerns about sycophancy in these value-laden contexts have grown. Unlike human flattery, which is intentional and self-interested, AI sycophancy emerges as a byproduct of RLHF’s reward structure for user-preference alignment. Yet the observable behavior is similar: both produce responses that preserve what users want to hear. Focusing on this phenomenon through Goffman’s face-work framework, we operationalize AI sycophancy as excessive face-saving, either active (preserving positive face through agreement) or passive (preserving negative face by withholding challenge). In a mixed-methods study (N=31), participants engaged with AI across three moral dilemmas under these conditions and a non-sycophantic neutral baseline. Sycophantic responses increased decision confidence but reduced open-minded thinking; participants felt supported yet found the conversations unproductive. Neutral responses, though initially uncomfortable, promoted cognitive flexibility and meaningful deliberation. These findings reveal a confidence-competence trade-off in AI-mediated moral reasoning and suggest that effective AI for personal deliberation requires calibrated friction, not unconditional agreement.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着人们越来越多地依赖人工智能来进行个人决策，而非仅仅寻求任务导向的帮助，人们对这种带有价值观色彩的情境中的谄媚行为也产生了担忧。与人为之的、有目的且出于自身利益的奉承不同，人工智能的谄媚行为实际上是强化用户偏好对齐机制下奖励结构的副产品。不过，这两种行为在表现上其实很相似：两者都产生了符合用户期望的回应。通过戈夫曼的“面子工作”框架来分析这一现象，我们可以将人工智能的谄媚行为定义为一种过度的“面子维护行为”——这种行为可以是主动的（通过达成一致来维护积极面子），也可以是被动的（通过回避挑战来维护消极面子）。在一项采用混合方法的研究中（样本量31人），参与者在这些条件下参与了三个道德困境的对话，同时还有一个没有谄媚行为的对照组。结果显示，谄媚的回应虽然增加了决策的信心，但却降低了开放性的思考能力；参与者虽然感到得到了支持，但认为这些对话毫无成效。而中立的回应虽然起初让人感到不适，但却促进了认知灵活性和有意义的思考。这些发现揭示了在人工智能辅助下的道德推理过程中存在信心与能力的权衡关系，并表明，要实现有效的个人决策，就需要适度的摩擦，而不是无条件的认同。

papers.title: ParaSuite: Boosting LLM Reasoning via Paradox Resolution
papers.title_zh: ParaSuite：通过解决悖论来提升大语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Bin Chen, Yu Zhang, Hongfei Ye, Huiyang Wang, Wenxi Liu, Hongyang Chen
papers.abstract: Logical reasoning is a key capability of large language models, yet current benchmarks focus almost entirely on tasks that just check basic logical consistency and overlook the reflective reasoning required for paradox detection and resolution. To fill the gap, we present ParaSuite, the first pipeline dedicated to paradox research that automates data synthesis, evaluation, and training. We introduce PARADOX, a synthetic, high-quality data spanning two difficulty tiers and three academic domains, accompanied by specialized evaluation metrics and solving algorithms. We propose ParadoxBreaker-7B, trained with Mutual-Information Guided Fine-Tuning and reinforcement learning step verify paradox reward(PAPO). Experiments demonstrate significant improvements in both paradoxical and general STEM reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 逻辑推理是大语言模型的关键能力之一，然而当前的评估标准几乎完全集中在检查基本逻辑一致性的任务上，而忽略了解决悖论所需的反思性推理。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ParaSuite——首个专门用于悖论研究的工具，它能够自动进行数据合成、评估和训练工作。我们还开发了PARADOX数据集，该数据集包含高质量的合成数据，涵盖两个难度等级和三个学术领域，并配备了专门的评估指标和解决方案算法。我们开发的ParadoxBreaker-7B模型采用了互信息引导的微调技术，并通过强化学习步骤来验证悖论解决效果。实验结果表明，该模型在解决悖论和一般STEM问题方面取得了显著改进。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ReTRE: Benchmarking LLM Transfer Robustness with Structure-Preserving Variants
papers.title_zh: ReTRE：通过保留结构的可变版本来评估大语言模型在迁移任务中的鲁棒性
papers.authors: ZhongDong Li, Weijie Shi, Yue Cui, Haolun MA, Yuanjun Liu, Jiawei Li, An Liu, Jia Zhu, Jiajie Xu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on standard benchmarks, yet their performance is not robust across different task manifestations. It remains unclear how performance changes under controlled task rewrites that preserve the original solution structure, while varying the rewrite type and level. To address this question, we introduce ReTRE (Rewrite-based Transfer Robustness Evaluation), an evaluation benchmark inspired by learning transfer theory that probes transfer robustness along two rewrite levels: Near Transfer and Far Transfer. ReTRE employs a multi-agent system to construct textual and visual variants while preserving the structure of the original solution. Evaluations on mathematical and science tasks across state-of-the-art multimodal LLMs reveal a consistent transfer gap: performance exhibits a general declining trend as transfer similarity drops and strong text performance can face performance decline under cross-modal transfer. Crucially, we identify a divergence between post-training paradigms: reinforcement learning preserves transfer robustness, whereas supervised fine-tuning tends to overfit the training distribution, leading to severe degradation in far-transfer performance despite strong in-distribution accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在标准基准测试上取得了优异的成绩，但其性能在不同任务表现形式下并不稳定。目前尚不清楚，在保持原始解决方案结构的前提下，通过不同的重写方式以及不同的重写层次，模型的性能会如何变化。为了解答这个问题，我们提出了ReTRE这一评估方法——一种基于重写的迁移鲁棒性评估框架。该框架借鉴了学习迁移理论，通过“近迁移”和“远迁移”两个层次来评估迁移的鲁棒性。ReTRE采用多智能体系统来生成文本和视觉形式的变体，同时保留原始解决方案的结构。对最先进的多模态语言模型在数学和科学任务上的评估显示，迁移效果存在明显的差距：随着迁移相似性的降低，模型性能普遍下降；而在跨模态迁移中，强大的文本处理能力也可能出现性能下降。关键的是，我们发现训练后采用的两种范式之间存在差异：强化学习能够保持迁移的鲁棒性，而监督式微调则容易导致模型过度拟合训练数据，从而导致远迁移性能严重下降，即便在分布外环境中的准确率仍然很高。

papers.title: Do MLLMs Capture How Interfaces Guide User Behavior? A Benchmark for Multimodal UI/UX Design Understanding
papers.title_zh: 多模态界面是否真的能够引导用户的行为？关于多模态UI/UX设计的基准测试研究
papers.authors: Jaehyun Jeon, Min Soo Kim, Janghan Yoon, Sumin Shim, Yejin Choi, Hanbin Kim, Dae Hyun Kim, Youngjae Yu
papers.abstract: User interface (UI) design goes beyond visuals to shape user experience (UX), underscoring the shift toward UI/UX as a unified concept. While recent studies have explored UI evaluation using Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), they largely focus on surface-level features, overlooking how design choices influence user behavior at scale. To fill this gap, we introduce WiserUI-Bench, a novel benchmark for multimodal understanding of how UI/UX design affects user behavior, built on 300 real-world UI image pairs from industry A/B tests, with empirically validated winners that induced more user actions. For future design progress in practice, post-hoc understanding of why such winners succeed with mass users is also required; we support this via expert-curated key interpretations for each instance. Experiments across multiple MLLMs on WiserUI-Bench for two main tasks, (1) predicting the more effective UI image between an A/B-tested pair, and (2) explaining it post-hoc in alignment with expert interpretations, show that models exhibit limited understanding of the behavioral impact of UI/UX design. We believe our work will foster research on leveraging MLLMs for visual design in user behavior contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 用户界面设计不仅关注视觉方面，还注重用户体验的塑造，这凸显了将UI/UX视为一个统一概念的趋势。虽然最近的研究使用了多模态大语言模型来评估用户界面，但这些研究大多集中在表面特征上，而忽略了设计选择对用户行为的影响。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了WiserUI-Bench这一新的基准测试工具，该工具基于来自行业A/B测试的300对真实世界用户界面图像对，通过经验验证的方法选出能够引发更多用户行为的优秀设计方案。对于未来的实际设计工作来说，还需要了解这些优秀方案为何能在大量用户中取得成功；我们通过为每个案例提供专家精选的关键解读来支持这一点。在WiserUI-Bench上进行的多项MLLMs实验，主要针对两个任务：(1)预测A/B测试中的哪张图片的视觉效果更优；(2)根据专家解读来解释为什么某张图片更优。实验结果表明，这些模型对UI/UX设计对用户行为的影响理解有限。我们相信，我们的工作将有助于推动利用MLLMs进行视觉设计研究，从而更好地理解用户行为中的视觉因素。

papers.title: DarwinTOD: LLM-Driven Lifelong Self-evolution for Task-oriented Dialog Systems
papers.title_zh: 达尔文TOD：基于大语言模型的终身自我进化技术，适用于任务导向的对话系统
papers.authors: Shuyu Zhang, Yujie Liu, Xinru Wang, Cheng Zhang, Yanmin Zhu, Bin Li
papers.abstract: Traditional task-oriented dialog systems are unable to evolve from ongoing interactions or adapt to new domains after deployment, that is a critical limitation in real-world dynamic environments. Continual learning approaches depend on episodic retraining with human-curated data, failing to achieve autonomy lifelong improvement. While evolutionary computation and LLM driven self-improvement offer promising mechanisms for dialog optimization, they lack a unified framework for holistic, iterative strategy refinement. To bridge this gap, we propose DarwinTOD, a lifelong self-evolving dialog framework that systematically integrates these two paradigms, enabling continuous strategy optimization from a zero-shot base without task-specific fine-tuning. DarwinTOD maintains an Evolvable Strategy Bank and operates through a dual-loop process: online multi-agent dialog execution with peer critique, and offline structured evolutionary operations that refine the strategy bank using accumulated feedback. This closed-loop design enables autonomous continuous improvement without human intervention. Extensive experiments show that DarwinTOD surpasses previous state-of-the-art methods and exhibits continuous performance gains throughout evolution. Our work provides a novel framework for building dialog systems with lifelong self-evolution capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的任务导向对话系统无法从持续的互动中进化或适应新的领域，这实际上是现实世界动态环境中一个重要的限制。持续学习的方法依赖于使用人工筛选的数据进行周期性重新训练，但这无法实现长期的自主优化。虽然进化计算和技术驱动的自我改进为对话优化提供了有前景的机制，但它们缺乏一个统一的框架来完善整体的迭代策略。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了DarwinTOD——一个能够持续自我进化的对话框架。该框架系统地整合了这两种方法，使得无需针对特定任务进行微调即可实现持续的策略优化。DarwinTOD拥有一个可进化的策略库，并通过一个双循环机制运作：在线时，多智能体对话执行并经过同行评审；离线时，通过结构化的进化操作来利用累积的反馈来优化策略库。这种闭环设计使得系统能够在无需人工干预的情况下实现自主的持续改进。大量的实验表明，DarwinTOD超越了以往最先进的方法，并且在进化过程中始终保持着持续的性能提升。我们的工作为构建具有持续自我进化能力的对话系统提供了一个新的框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Route to Rome Attack: Directing LLM Routers to Expensive Models via Adversarial Suffix Optimization
papers.title_zh: 通往罗马的路线：通过对抗性后缀优化技术，引导大语言模型路由器使用成本更高的模型进行推理
papers.authors: Haochun Tang, Yuliang Yan, Jiahua Lu, Huaxiao Liu, Enyan Dai
papers.abstract: Cost-aware routing dynamically dispatches user queries to models of varying capability to balance performance and inference cost. However, the routing strategy introduces new security concern that adversaries may manipulate router to consistently select expensive high-capability models. Existing routing attacks depend either on white-box access or heuristic prompts, rendering them ineffective in real-world black-box scenarios. In this work, we propose R^2A, which aims to mislead black-box LLM routers to expensive models via adversarial suffix optimization. Specifically, R^2A deploys a hybrid ensemble surrogate router to mimic the black-box router. A suffix optimization algorithm is further adapted for the ensemble-based surrogate. Extensive experiments on multiple open-source and commercial routing systems demonstrate that R^2A significantly increases the routing rate to expensive models on queries of different distributions. Code and examples: https://github.com/thcxiker/R2A-Attack.
papers.abstract_zh: 具有成本意识的路由系统能够动态地将用户查询分配到不同性能的模型中，以平衡性能和推理成本。然而，这种路由策略引入了新的安全问题：攻击者可能操纵路由器，使其持续选择性能高但成本昂贵的模型。现有的路由攻击要么依赖于白盒访问，要么依赖启发式提示，这些方法在真正的黑盒场景中无法发挥作用。在这项研究中，我们提出了R^2A算法，该算法旨在通过对抗性后缀优化，误导黑盒LLM路由器选择昂贵的模型。具体来说，R^2A采用混合集成替代路由器来模拟黑盒路由器。此外，还为基于集成的替代路由器适配了后缀优化算法。在多个开源和商业路由系统上进行的广泛实验表明，R^2A显著提高了在不同分布下对昂贵模型的路由效率。代码和示例可参考：https://github.com/thcxiker/R2A-Attack。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GUI0: Self-Evolving Foundational GUI Agents in Super App Ecosystems
papers.title_zh: GUI0：在超级应用生态系统中自主进化的基础图形用户界面代理
papers.authors: Xinyi Wang, Wei Dai, Kyle Qiao, Ke Wang, Peng Chen, Gang Cao, Kangqin, Zhongpu Wang, Xiaode Zhang, Yanming Liu, Jihao Gu, Jingtao Xu, Gong Zhi
papers.abstract: Automated interaction with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) is central to General Artificial Intelligence yet remains challenging within Super App ecosystems, characterized by non-standard rendering and absent accessibility metadata. While GUI agents often rely on explicit accessibility trees or static imitation, they are less explored for dynamic environments marked by sparse feedback and implicit visual cues. We present GUI0, a framework synergizing autonomous data synthesis with dual-agent co-evolution. GUI0 establishes a domain-aware foundation model via synthesized corpora and employs curriculum-driven reinforcement learning, where a curriculum agent generates boundary tasks to optimize an actor agent.Empirical results demonstrate three key advantages: (1) State-of-the-art performance on the SuperAPP benchmark, outperforming Gemini-2.5-Pro and Claude-4-Sonnet; (2) universal efficacy across diverse base models, consistently yielding substantial improvements on both Qwen2.5-VL and GUI-Owl variants; and (3) robust zero-shot generalization to standard GUIs (e.g., +62.7% on ScreenSpot Pro).
papers.abstract_zh: 与图形用户界面之间的自动化交互是通用人工智能的核心功能，但在超级应用生态系统中仍然面临挑战，因为超级应用生态系统具有非标准的渲染方式，且缺乏可访问性元数据。虽然图形界面代理通常依赖明确的可访问性树或静态模拟，但对于以稀疏反馈和隐式视觉线索为特征的动态环境来说，这类方法尚未得到充分探索。我们提出了GUI0框架，该框架将自主数据合成与双代理共同进化相结合。GUI0通过合成语料库建立了一个基于领域感知的基础模型，并采用基于课程驱动的强化学习机制，其中课程代理负责生成边界任务以优化行为代理的性能。实验结果表明，该框架具有以下三个主要优势：(1)在超级应用基准测试中的性能表现位居领先水平，优于Gemini-2.5-Pro和Claude-4-Sonnet；(2)该框架能够在不同的基础模型上表现出普遍的有效性，并且在Qwen2.5-VL和GUI-Owl变体上都能取得显著的改进；(3)该框架能够稳健地实现对标准图形界面的零样本泛化能力，例如在ScreenSpot Pro上的性能提升了62.7%。

papers.title: Understanding the Prompt Sensitivity
papers.title_zh: 理解提示的敏感性
papers.authors: Yang Liu, Chenhui Chu
papers.abstract: Prompt sensitivity, which refers to how strongly the output of a large language model (LLM) depends on the exact wording of its input prompt, raises concerns among users about the LLM’s stability and reliability. In this work, we consider LLMs as multivariate functions and perform a first-order Taylor expansion, thereby analyzing the relationship between meaning-preserving prompts, their gradients, and the log probabilities of the model’s next token. We derive an upper bound on the difference between log probabilities using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality. We show that LLMs do not internally cluster similar inputs like smaller neural networks do, but instead disperse them. This dispersing behavior leads to an excessively high upper bound on the difference of log probabilities between two meaning-preserving prompts, making it difficult to effectively reduce to 0. In our analysis, we also show which types of meaning-preserving prompt variants are more likely to introduce prompt sensitivity risks in LLMs. In addition, we demonstrate that the upper bound is strongly correlated with an existing prompt sensitivity metric, PromptSensiScore. Moreover, by analyzing the logit variance, we find that prompt templates typically exert a greater influence on logits than the questions themselves. Overall, our results provide a general interpretation for why current LLMs can be highly sensitive to prompts with the same meaning, offering crucial evidence for understanding the prompt sensitivity of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 提示敏感性指的是大语言模型（LLM）的输出对其输入提示的具体措辞的依赖性。这一特性引发了用户对于LLM稳定性和可靠性的担忧。在这项研究中，我们将LLM视为多变量函数，并采用一阶泰勒展开法来分析具有保留意义的提示、其梯度以及模型下一个词的概率之间的关系。我们通过柯西-施瓦茨不等式推导出了概率差值的上限。我们发现，与小型神经网络不同，LLM不会将类似的输入内部聚集成一组，而是让这些输入分散开来。这种分散行为导致两个具有保留意义的提示之间概率差值的上限过高，从而使得该差值难以有效降至零。在我们的分析中，我们还揭示了哪些类型的保留意义提示变体更有可能引发LLM中的提示敏感性问题。此外，我们发现这个上限与现有的提示敏感性指标PromptSensiScore存在高度相关性。通过分析逻辑分布方差，我们发现提示模板通常对逻辑变量的影响比问题本身更大。总体而言，我们的研究结果为当前LLM为何对同一意义下的提示表现出高度敏感性提供了一般性解释，并为理解LLM的提示敏感性问题提供了重要依据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: rSIM: Incentivizing Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs via Reinforced Strategy Injection
papers.title_zh: rSIM：通过强化策略注入来激励大语言模型推理能力的发展
papers.authors: Sijia Chen, Baochun Li, Di Niu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are post-trained through reinforcement learning (RL) to evolve into Reasoning Language Models (RLMs), where the hallmark of this advanced reasoning is “aha” moments when they start to perform strategies, such as self-reflection and deep thinking, within chain of thoughts (CoTs). Motivated by this, this paper proposes a novel reinforced strategy injection mechanism (rSIM), that enables any LLM to become an RLM by employing a small planner to guide the LLM’s CoT through the adaptive injection of reasoning strategies. To achieve this, the planner (leader agent) is jointly trained with an LLM (follower agent) using multi-agent RL (MARL), based on a leader-follower framework and straightforward rule-based rewards. Experimental results show that rSIM enables Qwen2.5-0.5B to become an RLM and significantly outperform Qwen2.5-14B across mathematical, coding, and financial reasoning tasks. Moreover, the planner is generalizable: it only needs to be trained once and can be applied as a plug-in to substantially improve the reasoning capabilities of existing LLMs. In addition, the planner supports continual learning across various tasks, allowing its planning abilities to gradually improve and generalize to a wider range of problems. Our source code is available under the examples/rSIM of https://github.com/AgenticFinLab/eparl.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）通过强化学习（RL）进行后训练，进而发展成为推理语言模型（RLMs）。这种高级推理的特点在于，当模型开始执行策略时，会展现出“恍然大悟”的瞬间，比如自我反思和深度思考，这些过程都发生在思维链（CoTs）中。基于这一原理，本文提出了一种创新的强化策略注入机制（rSIM），该机制通过引入一个小型规划器来指导LLM的思维链，从而实现任何LLM转变为RLM的目标。为了实现这一目标，规划器（领导者代理）与LLM（跟随者代理）一起使用多智能体强化学习（MARL）方法进行联合训练，其训练基于领导者-跟随者框架，并采用简单的基于规则的奖励机制。实验结果表明，rSIM使得Qwen2.5-0.5B能够成为RLM，并在数学、编程和财务推理任务上显著优于Qwen2.5-14B。此外，该规划器具有通用性：只需进行一次训练即可投入使用，并能作为插件大幅提升现有LLM的推理能力。另外，该规划器还支持跨任务的持续学习，使其规划能力逐渐提升，并能够应对更广泛的问题。我们的源代码可以在https://github.com/AgenticFinLab/eparl的examples/rSIM目录下找到。

papers.title: Automatic and Reliable Evaluation for Academic Caption-to-Figure Generation with LMMs
papers.title_zh: 基于LMMs的自动且可靠的学术图表标注生成评估方法
papers.authors: Guanghui Ye, Huan Zhao, Qin Zhu, Fengnan Li, Jiaqi Li, Yixian Shen, Zhonghao Ren, Zhihua Jiang
papers.abstract: Existing datasets for evaluating text-to-image generation focus mostly on real-life images, which poses challenges for assessing academicfigure generation given real scientific captions, which is a hot topic in AI for Science. To fill the gap, we propose HE4AFG, a novel datasetwhich first provides a Holistic Evaluation for Academic caption-to-Figure Generation (AFG). Specifically, HE4AFG collects real figure captions from 8 scientific domains and finally generates 3,900 evaluation samples (particularly, including multi-panel figures) using 5 mainstream large multimodal models (LMMs). For each sample, we provide high-quality human ratings in terms of three aspects—scientific aesthetic (SA), topic relevance (TR), and attribute correctness (AC). Moreover, we present two trainable models: (1) HE4AFG-E, an automated Evaluation model for AFG, which generates aspect-aware training examples and then use them to train three aspect-specific evaluation modules via contrastive learning; (2) HE4AFG-R, an automated Refinement model, which generates and utilizes feedback on the quality of the figures (e.g., unfaithful elements) to continuously improve AFG. Extensive experiments on HE4AFG demonstrate the effectiveness and performance advantages of our models.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前用于评估文本生成图像效果的数据集大多集中在真实图像上，这给评估基于科学标题的图像生成带来了挑战，而科学标题生成正是人工智能科学领域的一个热门话题。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了HE4AFG这个新颖的数据集。该数据集首先提供了对科学标题生成效果的全面评估。具体来说，HE4AFG收集了来自8个科学领域的真实标题，并使用5种主流的大型多模态模型生成了3,900个评估样本（包括多面板图像）。对于每个样本，我们提供了关于三个方面的高质量人类评分：科学美学、主题相关性以及属性准确性。此外，我们还提出了两个可训练的模型：(1) HE4AFG-E，这是一个自动评估模型，它能够生成考虑各种方面的训练样本，然后通过对比学习来训练三个针对特定方面的评估模块；(2) HE4AFG-R，这是一个自动优化模型，它能够生成并利用反馈来改进图像的质量，例如消除不准确的元素。在HE4AFG上的大量实验表明，我们的模型具有出色的效果和性能优势。

papers.title: SafeConstellations: Mitigating Over-Refusals in LLMs Through Task-Aware Representation Steering
papers.title_zh: 安全星座：通过任务感知的表示指导来减少大型语言模型中的过度拒绝问题
papers.authors: Utsav Maskey, Sumit Yadav, Mark Dras, Usman Naseem
papers.abstract: LLMs increasingly exhibit over-refusal behavior, where safety mechanisms cause models to reject benign instructions that seemingly resemble harmful content. This phenomenon diminishes utility in production applications that repeatedly rely on common prompt templates or applications that frequently rely on LLMs for specific tasks (e.g. sentiment analysis, language translation). Through extensive evaluation, we demonstrate that LLMs persist in refusing inputs containing harmful content, even when they are reframed with tasks that have benign intent. Our mechanistic analysis reveals that LLMs follow distinct “constellation” patterns in embedding space as representations traverse layers, with each NLP task maintaining consistent trajectories that shift predictably between refusal and non-refusal cases. We introduce SafeConstellations, an inference-time trajectory-shifting approach that tracks task-specific trajectory patterns and guides representations toward non-refusal pathways. By selectively guiding model behavior only on tasks prone to over-refusal, our method reduces over-refusals with minimal impact on utility—offering a principled and conditional approach to mitigating over-refusals.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越表现出过度拒绝的行为，即安全机制导致模型拒绝那些看似与有害内容相似的良性指令。这种现象会降低那些频繁使用通用提示模板的应用程序的实用性，或者那些需要大语言模型来完成特定任务的应用程序（例如情感分析、语言翻译）的实用性。通过广泛的评估，我们发现即使以具有良性意图的任务来重新输入数据，大语言模型仍然会拒绝包含有害内容的输入。我们的机制分析表明，当表示在层次结构中移动时，大语言模型会遵循特定的“构型”模式，每个自然语言处理任务都保持着一致的轨迹，这些轨迹在拒绝和非拒绝的情况之间可以预测性地变化。我们提出了SafeConstellations这一方法，它是一种在推理阶段改变轨迹的方法，能够跟踪特定任务的轨迹模式，并引导表示朝着非拒绝的路径发展。通过仅针对容易出现过度拒绝的任务来选择性地指导模型行为，我们的方法能够在不影响实用性的情况下减少过度拒绝现象，提供了一种有原则且条件性的方法来缓解过度拒绝问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AIPO: Adaptive Information Guided Token-Level Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.title_zh: AIPO：自适应信息引导的令牌级强化学习，用于大型语言模型推理
papers.authors: Bin Chen, Hongfei Ye, Huiyang Wang, Wenxi Liu, Yu Zhang, Furui Liu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capability of Large Language Models (LLMs). Current RLVR trains LLMs on all generated tokens, rather than exploring which tokens actually contribute to reasoning. We propose AIPO(Adaptive–Information Policy Optimization), which focuses updates on those decisive tokens discovered on the fly. AIPO estimates each hidden state’s mutual information to score tokens. Policy gradients are then computed only on these critical tokens, using an advantage that blends information gain and verifiable correctness. To improve the efficiency of mutual-information estimation, AIPO adopts a Random–Fourier approximation of the Hilbert–Schmidt Independence Criterion. Across five math and science benchmarks, AIPO yields up to +20% accuracy over strong RLVR baselines while updating merely 10% of tokens, demonstrating superior efficiency and effectiveness. Our findings highlight the importance of information–driven token selection for efficient and effective reinforcement learning of LLM reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。目前的RLVR是在所有生成的标记上进行训练，而并未考虑哪些标记真正对推理有贡献。我们提出了AIPO（自适应信息策略优化），该算法专注于对那些实时发现的关键标记进行更新。AIPO通过估算每个隐藏状态的互信息来评估标记的重要性。随后，策略梯度仅在这些关键标记上进行计算，同时结合了信息获取与可验证正确性的优势。为了提升互信息估计的效率，AIPO采用了希尔伯特-施密特独立性判定的随机傅里叶近似方法。在五个数学和科学基准测试中，AIPO在仅更新10%的标记的情况下，准确率高达20%，显示出卓越的效率和效果。我们的研究结果强调了以信息为导向的标记选择对于高效且有效的LLM推理强化学习的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AgentGym2: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in De-Idealized Real-World Environments
papers.title_zh: AgentGym2：在去理想化现实环境中对大型语言模型代理进行性能评估
papers.authors: Zhiheng Xi, Dingwen Yang, Jiaqi Liu, Jixuan Huang, Honglin Guo, Baodai Huang, Tinggang Chen, Qi Zhang, Zhonghang Lu, Chenyu Liu, Jiajun Sun, Jiazheng Zhang, Dingwei Zhu, Xin Guo, Junzhe Wang, Zhihao Zhang, Yuming Yang, Junjie Ye, Minghe Gao, Dongrui Liu, Jiaming Ji, Guohao Li, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Language agents, i.e., LLM agents, progress rapidly and are increasingly deployed in production environments. This trend underscores the urgent need for rigorous and realistic evaluations. However, most existing benchmarks evaluate agents in simplified, idealized settings. They typically rely on pre-packaged tool interfaces, overlook critical steps, and assume inputs are clean and fully specified. Consequently, they understate the difficulty of real deployments, where uncertainty and noise are ubiquitous and agents must proactively explore the environment to uncover new tools. To bridge this gap, we present AgentGym2, a new evaluation framework with task instances grounded in real-world end-to-end working demands. Beyond reasoning and planning, it measures agents’ ability to execute end-to-end procedures, discover tools via exploration, compose tools for unseen tasks, and remain robust to noisy and underspecified information. Experiments on 15 proprietary and open-source models show that even SOTA systems like Gemini and GPT-5 struggle on AgentGym2, revealing a substantial gap between the capability of current agents and the demands of real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言代理，即大语言模型代理，正在快速发展，并越来越多地被应用于实际生产环境中。这一趋势凸显了进行严格且现实评估的紧迫性。然而，大多数现有的评估基准都是在简化、理想化的环境下对代理进行评估的。这些评估通常依赖于预先打包的工具接口，忽略了关键步骤，并且假设输入是清晰且完全明确的。因此，它们低估了实际部署中的难度——在实际情况中，不确定性和噪声无处不在，代理必须主动探索环境以发现新的工具。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了AgentGym2这一新的评估框架，该框架基于现实世界中的端到端工作需求来设计任务实例。除了推理和规划之外，它还衡量代理执行端到端流程的能力、通过探索发现工具的能力、为未见过的任务组合工具的能力，以及应对噪声和未明确指定信息的能力。对15个专有和开源模型的实验表明，即使是像Gemini和GPT-5这样的先进系统，在AgentGym2上的表现也相当糟糕，这揭示了当前代理能力与现实应用需求之间的巨大差距。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
