papers.title: Through the Magnifying Glass: Adaptive Perception Magnification for Hallucination-Free VLM Decoding
papers.title_zh: 通过放大镜：适用于无幻觉虚拟语音识别的自适应感知放大技术
papers.authors: Shunqi Mao, Chaoyi Zhang, Weidong Cai
papers.abstract: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) often suffer from visual hallucination, where the generated responses contain inaccuracies that are not grounded in the visual input. Efforts to address this issue without model finetuning primarily mitigate hallucination by contrastively reducing language biases or amplifying the weights of visual embedding during decoding. However, these approaches remain limited in their ability to capture fine-grained visual details. In this work, we propose the Perception Magnifier (PM), a novel visual decoding method that iteratively isolates relevant visual tokens based on attention and magnifies the corresponding regions, spurring the model to concentrate on fine-grained visual details during decoding. By magnifying critical regions while preserving the structural and contextual information at each decoding step, PM allows the VLM to enhance its scrutiny of the visual input, hence producing more accurate and faithful responses. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that PM not only achieves superior hallucination mitigation but also enhances language generation while preserving strong reasoning capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的视觉语言模型常常存在视觉幻觉问题，即生成的响应中包含一些与视觉输入无关的不准确信息。为了解决这一问题而进行的改进措施，主要是通过对比性方式减少语言偏见，或者在解码过程中增强视觉嵌入的权重，从而减轻幻觉现象。然而，这些方法在捕捉细微的视觉细节方面仍然存在局限性。在这项研究中，我们提出了“感知放大器”这一新颖的视觉解码方法。该方法基于注意力机制，逐步提取相关的视觉特征，并对相应区域进行放大处理，从而使模型在解码过程中能够专注于细微的视觉细节。通过在每次解码过程中对关键区域进行放大处理，同时保留结构和上下文信息，感知放大器使得视觉语言模型能够更好地分析视觉输入，进而生成更精确、更真实的响应。大量的实验结果表明，感知放大器不仅能够有效减轻幻觉现象，还能提升语言生成能力，同时保持强大的推理能力。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Fully Random Masking: Attention-Guided Denoising and Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越完全随机掩码技术：基于注意力机制的去噪与优化方法在扩散语言模型中的应用
papers.authors: Jia Deng, Junyi Li, Xin Zhao, Jinpeng Wang, Hongyu Lu, Ji-Rong Wen
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer an efficient alternative to autoregressive models through parallel decoding, yet existing post-training methods largely rely on random masking strategies that overlook intrinsic token dependencies. In this work, we present an empirical analysis of attention in dLLMs and show that tokens attending more strongly to revealed context exhibit greater generation stability and play a critical role in reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we propose AGDO, an attention-guided denoising and optimization framework that aligns both training and optimization with attention-derived dependencies. AGDO determines the denoising order based on attention structure and emphasizes attention-critical tokens during supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Experiments on mathematical and coding benchmarks demonstrate that AGDO consistently improves reasoning performance, outperforming state-of-the-art post-training methods for dLLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型（dLLMs）通过并行解码提供了一种高效的自回归模型的替代方案。然而，现有的后训练方法大多依赖于随机掩蔽策略，而这些策略忽略了 词元 之间的内在依赖关系。在这项研究中，我们对 dLLMs 中的注意力机制进行了实证分析，发现那些对揭示出的上下文有更强关注关系的 词元，其生成稳定性更高，并且在推理过程中发挥着关键作用。基于这些发现，我们提出了 AGDO 这一基于注意力机制的去噪与优化框架。该框架将训练过程与优化过程都与注意力机制所衍生的依赖关系相结合。AGDO 根据注意力结构来确定去噪的顺序，并在监督式微调与强化学习过程中重点关注那些对注意力至关重要的 词元。在数学和编程基准测试中的实验表明，AGDO 能够持续提升推理性能，其效果优于目前最先进的 dLLMs 后训练方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MemRec: Collaborative Memory-Augmented Agentic Recommender System
papers.title_zh: MemRec：一种基于协作式记忆增强的代理推荐系统
papers.authors: Weixin Chen, Yuhan Zhao, Jingyuan Huang, Zihe Ye, Mingxuan Ju, Tong Zhao, Neil Shah, Li Chen, Yongfeng Zhang
papers.abstract: The evolution of recommender systems has shifted from traditional collaborative filtering to LLM-based agentic systems, which rely on semantic user and item memories to make predictions. However, existing agents maintain these memories in isolation. This overlooks crucial collaborative signals, such as user-item co-engagements and peer relationships across the community, which significantly limits their ability to uncover hidden preferences and accurately infer user needs, particularly for data-sparse users. To bridge this gap, we introduce collaborative memory, a paradigm that connects isolated semantics to enable the sharing of relational insights. Yet, naively utilizing collaborative memory causes severe context overload and introduces noise to downstream LLMs, alongside prohibitive computational costs. To resolve this, we propose MemRec, a framework that architecturally decouples memory management from reasoning. MemRec introduces a dedicated, lightweight language model LM_Mem to efficiently manage and synthesize a dynamic collaborative memory graph in the background. It provides only distilled, high-signal contexts to a downstream, heavyweight large language model (LLM_Rec) for the final recommendation. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that MemRec achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code: https://github.com/rutgerswiselab/memrecHomepage: https://memrec.weixinchen.com
papers.abstract_zh: 推荐系统的演变已经从传统的协同过滤模式转变为基于大语言模型的智能系统。这些系统依靠用户对物品语义的记忆来做出预测。然而，现有的智能系统只是独立地维护这些记忆，这忽略了一些重要的协同信号，比如用户与物品的互动关系以及社区内的同伴关系。这些因素对于揭示用户的隐藏偏好和准确推断用户需求至关重要，尤其是对于数据较少的用户来说。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了“协同记忆”的概念，它将孤立的语义信息连接起来，从而实现关系性信息的共享。不过，单纯使用协同记忆会导致严重的上下文过载问题，还会给下游的大语言模型带来噪声干扰，同时还会产生极高的计算成本。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MemRec框架。该框架将内存管理和推理过程分离开来。MemRec引入了一个专门的轻量级语言模型LM_Mem，用于高效地管理和合成动态协同记忆图。它只向下游的重型大语言模型LLM_Rec提供经过筛选的高价值上下文信息，以用于最终推荐。在四个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，MemRec取得了领先的性能表现。代码链接：https://github.com/rutgerswiselab/memrec官网：https://memrec.weixinchen.com
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: INFACT: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Induced Faithfulness and Factuality Hallucinations in Video-LLMs
papers.title_zh: 事实上：一种用于评估视频聊天机器人中诱导的忠实度以及事实性幻觉现象的诊断基准
papers.authors: Yangjunqi, Yuecong Min, Jie Zhang, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen
papers.abstract: Despite rapid progress, Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) remain unreliable due to hallucinations, which are outputs that contradict either video evidence (faithfulness) or verifiable world knowledge (factuality).Existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of factuality hallucinations and predominantly evaluate models only in clean settings.We introduce INFACT, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 9,800 QA instances with fine-grained taxonomies for faithfulness and factuality, spanning real and synthetic videos.INFACT evaluates models in four modes: Base (clean), Visual Degradation, Evidence Corruption, and Temporal Intervention for order-sensitive items.Reliability under induced modes is quantified using Resist Rate (RR) and Temporal Sensitivity Score (TSS).Experiments on 14 representative Video-LLMs reveal that higher Base-mode accuracy does not reliably translate to higher reliability in the induced modes, with evidence corruption reducing stability and temporal intervention yielding the largest degradation.Notably, many open-source baselines exhibit near-zero TSS on factuality, indicating pronounced temporal inertia on order-sensitive questions.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管视频大语言模型取得了快速进展，但由于出现幻觉现象，这些模型仍然不可靠。所谓幻觉，指的是那些与视频证据或可验证的常识相矛盾的输出结果。现有的基准测试在评估常识性幻觉方面存在局限性，而且主要只在干净的环境中对模型进行测评。我们提出了INFACT这一诊断基准测试，该测试包含9,800个问答实例，并针对真实和合成视频分别提供了关于准确性和常识性的细粒度分类。INFACT通过四种模式来评估模型性能：基础模式（干净环境）、视觉退化、证据破坏以及针对时间敏感问题的时间干预。在诱导模式下，模型的可靠性通过抗干扰率（RR）和时间敏感性得分（TSS）来量化。对14种代表性视频大语言模型的实验表明，较高的基础模式准确率并不能可靠地转化为诱导模式下更高的可靠性。证据破坏会降低模型的稳定性，而时间干预则会导致模型性能的显著下降。值得注意的是，许多开源基准测试在常识性问题上表现出接近零的时间敏感性得分，这表明它们在处理时间敏感问题时存在明显的时间惰性问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CLAOCS-TX: Cross-Lingual Triplet Extraction with Aspect-Opinion-Aware Code-Switched Prompting and LLM-Guided Contrastive Distillation
papers.title_zh: CLAOCS-TX：基于多语言三元组提取技术，结合情感感知的混合语码提示机制，以及大型语言模型引导的对比蒸馏方法
papers.authors: Lipika Dewangan, Chandresh Kumar Maurya
papers.abstract: Cross-lingual learning enables the transfer of structured sentiment knowledge from high-resource languages to unlabeled or low-resource languages, but prior work has largely focused on coarse-grained sentiment classification or aspect extraction. In contrast, zero-shot cross-lingual aspect–opinion–sentiment triplet extraction (ASTE), which extracts sentiment triplets of the form (\textit{aspect term}, \textit{opinion term}, \textit{sentiment polarity}), remains underexplored. We propose a unified framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) as both structured pseudo-label generators and semantic teachers for ASTE. Our approach employs stepwise structured prompting over aspect- and opinion-aware code-switched variants to generate reliable pseudo triplets, followed by a multi-variant consistency filter to retain high-confidence supervision. We further introduce a triplet-aware contrastive distillation objective that aligns student triplet representations with LLM-encoded semantic embeddings. During inference, only the student ASTE model is used, without requiring LLM access. Experiments on four non-Indic and four low-resource Indic target languages show consistent improvements over strong cross-lingual and LLM-based baselines. The proposed method yields an absolute micro-F1 improvement of 5.3 points on non-Indic languages and 3.8 points on low-resource Indic languages compared to the best competing approach. Ablation results further validate the complementary roles of aspect- and opinion-aware code-switched prompting and triplet-aware contrastive distillation, with larger relative gains observed in low-resource Indic settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨语言学习能够将结构化情感知识从资源丰富的语言转移到缺乏标注或资源匮乏的语言中。不过，以往的研究主要集中在粗粒度情感分类或方面提取上。相比之下，零样本跨语言方面-观点-情感三元组提取技术尚未得到充分探索。我们提出了一种统一的框架，利用大语言模型作为结构化伪标签生成器和语义指导工具来辅助这种三元组提取任务。我们的方法采用逐步结构化的提示方式，结合考虑方面和观点的混合编码变体来生成可靠的伪三元组，然后通过多变量一致性过滤机制来保留高可信度的监督信息。此外，我们还引入了一种三元组感知的对比蒸馏目标，将学生三元组表示与大语言模型编码的语义嵌入进行对齐。在推理过程中，仅使用学生端的ASTE模型，无需访问大语言模型。在四种非印地语和四种资源匮乏的印地语目标语言上的实验表明，该方法相较于优秀的跨语言和基于大语言模型的基线方法，取得了持续的改进效果。在非印地语语言中，该方法的绝对微F1分数提高了5.3分；在资源匮乏的印地语语言中，提高了3.8分。消融实验进一步验证了考虑方面和观点的混合编码提示以及三元组感知的对比蒸馏之间的互补作用，特别是在资源匮乏的印地语环境中，这种互补性带来了更大的相对收益。

papers.title: DAC-Bench: A Decision-Aware Benchmark for Compositional Mobile GUI Tasks
papers.title_zh: DAC-Bench：一种针对组合式移动图形用户界面任务的决策性基准测试
papers.authors: Yuqing Zhang, Honghui Sheng, Xueyu Hu, Shengyu Zhang, Fei Wu
papers.abstract: Mobile GUI agents powered by LMMs can perceive screens and follow instructions, yet existing benchmarks largely target short, linear workflows and step-level accuracy, offering limited insight into long-horizon planning and decision-making under branching structures. We present DAC-Bench, a decision-aware benchmark with compositional tasks comprising 830 episodes and 11,345 action steps across 35 applications on Android and iOS. Tasks are organized into Sequential, Conjunctive, Conditional, and Hierarchical structures, reflecting real-world multi-step and branching interaction patterns. To complement standard step-level evaluation, we introduce weighted longest common subsequence to capture length-sensitive progress and decision accuracy for branch correctness. Evaluations across 7 diverse agents show substantial performance degradation compared to prior benchmarks, with success rates dropping below 5% on 6–8 step tasks and branch accuracy averaging 38%, highlighting challenges in conditional decision-making. By exposing these failure modes, DAC-Bench provides a challenging and diagnostic benchmark for advancing decision-aware mobile GUI agents. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/YuqingZhangMirror12/DAC-Bench.
papers.abstract_zh: 由LMMs驱动的移动GUI代理能够感知屏幕并遵循指令。然而，现有的基准测试大多针对的是简短、线性的工作流程和步骤级精度，这无法提供关于长期规划以及在分支结构下的决策制定的有效信息。我们提出了DAC-Bench这一具有决策意识的基准测试，该测试包含830个任务案例和11,345个动作步骤，涵盖了Android和iOS平台上的35种应用程序。这些任务被组织成顺序型、联合型、条件型和层次型结构，反映了现实世界中的多步骤和分支式交互模式。为了补充标准的步骤级评估，我们引入了加权最长公共子序列算法，以捕捉与长度相关的进展以及分支正确性的决策准确性。对7种不同代理进行的评估显示，与之前的基准测试相比，其性能有了显著下降：在6到8步的任务中，成功率低于5%，而分支正确性的平均值为38%，这凸显了条件性决策面临的挑战。通过揭示这些失败模式，DAC-Bench为提升决策意识的移动GUI代理提供了一个具有挑战性和诊断性的基准测试。我们的代码和数据集可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/YuqingZhangMirror12/DAC-Bench。

papers.title: GMoE: Global Mixture of Experts with Logit Propagation
papers.title_zh: GMoE：全局专家混合模型，采用逻辑斯蒂传播算法
papers.authors: Geonwoo Hong, Taehwan Kim
papers.abstract: Sparse Mixture of Experts (SMoE) architectures reduce computational cost by activating only a subset of experts per token, yet they often retain large memory footprints and exhibit significant redundancy, both within and across layers. We propose GMoE, a sparse MoE architecture designed to explicitly address these inefficiencies. Instead of maintaining separate expert sets for each layer, GMoE uses Global Experts shared across all layers and adds a Local Expert per layer for layer-specific adaptation. This architecture reuses Global Experts across layers, thereby mitigating inter-layer redundancy while substantially reducing model parameters. In addition, we introduce a Global Router with a GRU-based recurrent component shared across layers and layer-specific routing heads that propagate routing logits across layers. This routing mechanism couples routing decisions across layers, progressively refines routing paths, and helps mitigate intra-layer redundancy. Across diverse language modeling corpora and downstream benchmarks, GMoE remains competitive while using substantially fewer parameters. Routing path analyses and an ablation study show that GMoE reduces cross-layer routing concentration and increases path diversity, with the Global Experts, the Local Expert, and the Global Router all contributing to the gains. The code is available at https://github.com/GEONWOOHONG/GMoE.
papers.abstract_zh: 稀疏混合专家（SMoE）架构通过仅为每个令牌激活一部分专家来降低计算成本，但同时它们通常占用较大的内存资源，并且在不同层之间表现出显著的冗余性。我们提出了GMoE这一稀疏混合专家架构，旨在明确解决这些效率问题。与为每个层维护独立的专家集不同，GMoE使用跨所有层的全局专家，并为每层添加局部专家以实现针对特定层的自适应调整。这种架构在层间重用全局专家，从而减少了层间的冗余性，同时大幅降低了模型参数数量。此外，我们还引入了一个具有基于GRU的循环组件的全局路由器，该组件可在各层之间共享，同时还有针对各层的路由头，它们负责在各层之间传递路由逻辑。这种路由机制将各层的路由决策结合起来，逐步优化路由路径，有助于减少层内冗余性。在多种语言建模语料库和下游基准测试中，GMoE仍然表现出竞争力，同时使用的参数数量也大大减少。路由路径分析和消融实验表明，GMoE减少了跨层的路由集中性，增加了路径多样性，而全局专家、局部专家和全局路由器的共同作用都促进了这一效果的提升。相关代码可访问于https://github.com/GEONWOOHONG/GMoE。

papers.title: When Does Language Matter? Multilingual Instructions Reveal Step-wise Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: 语言何时才具有重要性？多语言说明揭示了视觉-语言-动作模型中对语言的逐步敏感程度
papers.authors: Xuan Dong, Zhe Han, Tianhao Niu, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet their robustness to linguistic variation remains poorly understood. In this work, We present the first systematic multilingual evaluation of VLA models by translating the LIBERO benchmark into ten languages, revealing severe performance degradation under non-English instructions, with success rates dropping by 30–50%. Through fine-grained analysis of task executions, we find that language influence is highly non-uniform across steps: certain steps exhibit strong language dependence and dominate overall task failure, while others are largely language-agnostic. Based on this insight, we propose a step-wise inference-time intervention that aligns representations according to step language sensitivity, substantially improving performance under linguistic variation. Our results indicate that language robustness in VLA models is fundamentally a step-wise control problem, highlighting the importance of temporally structured analysis for reliable embodied agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在基于语言的机器人操控任务中表现优异，但其在面对语言差异时的鲁棒性仍不明确。在本研究中，我们首次对VLA模型进行了系统的多语言评估，将LIBERO基准测试转化为十种语言进行测试。结果显示，在非英语指令下，模型的性能出现了严重下降，成功率降低了30%至50%。通过对任务执行过程的细致分析，我们发现语言对各个步骤的影响并不均匀：某些步骤对语言依赖性极强，容易导致整体任务失败；而另一些步骤则几乎不受语言影响。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种分阶段的时间干预策略，根据步骤的语言敏感性来调整模型表示，从而显著提升了模型在语言变化环境下的性能。我们的研究结果表明，VLA模型中语言的鲁棒性问题本质上是一个分阶段的控制问题，这进一步强调了对于可靠具身智能体而言，进行时间结构化的分析至关重要。

papers.title: DialDefer: A Framework for Detecting and Mitigating LLM Dialogic Deference
papers.title_zh: DialDefer：一种用于检测与缓解大型语言模型对话中的延迟问题的框架
papers.authors: Parisa Rabbani, Priyam Sahoo, Ruben Mathew, Aishee Mondal, Harshita Ketharaman, Nimet Beyza Bozdag, Dilek Hakkani-Tür
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as third-party judges, yet their reliability when evaluating speakers in dialogue remains poorly understood. We show that LLMs judge identical claims differently depending on framing: the same content receives different verdicts when presented as a statement to verify (“Is this statement correct?”) versus attributed to a speaker (“Is this speaker correct?”). We call this dialogic deference and introduce DialDefer, a framework for detecting and mitigating these framing-induced judgment shifts. Our Dialogic Deference Score (DDS) captures directional shifts that aggregate accuracy obscures. Across ten domains, 3k+ instances, and five models, conversational framing induces large shifts (mean |DDS| = 15.9 percentage points (pp) across models, p < .0001) while accuracy remains stable (<2 pp), with effects amplifying 2–5× on naturalistic Reddit conversations. This effect is domain-dependent: a single model can shift toward disagreement (skepticism) on graduate-level science and toward agreement (deference) on social judgment. Ablations reveal that human-vs-LLM attribution drives the largest shifts (17.7 pp swing), suggesting models treat disagreement with humans as more costly than with AI. Mitigation attempts can reduce deference but over-correct into skepticism, revealing a calibration problem beyond accuracy optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作第三方评判者，然而它们在评估对话中的发言者时所表现出的可靠性仍然难以捉摸。我们发现，大语言模型对相同陈述的评判方式会因表述方式的不同而有所差异：当该内容被呈现为“这个陈述是否正确？”这样的陈述时，与作为某个发言者的观点呈现时相比，会得到不同的评判结果。我们将这种现象称为“对话式顺从”，并提出了DialDefer这一框架，用于检测并缓解这种因表述方式引起的判断偏差。我们的对话式顺从得分指标能够捕捉到那些被准确性掩盖的方向性变化。在十个领域、3000多个实例以及五个模型中进行的研究表明，对话式的表述方式会导致较大的判断偏差（各模型的均值|DDS|为15.9个百分点，p<0.0001），而准确性则保持稳定（小于2个百分点）。在自然界的Reddit对话中，这种效应会放大2到5倍。这种效应具有领域依赖性：同一个模型在讨论研究生水平的科学问题时可能会倾向于持反对意见（怀疑态度），而在讨论社会判断问题时则可能倾向于同意意见（顺从态度）。分析还显示，人类与大语言模型的判断差异导致了最大的判断偏差（17.7个百分点），这表明模型在处理与人类的意见分歧时，认为其代价比处理与AI的意见分歧更为高昂。尝试减轻这种偏差可以减少顺从倾向，但也可能导致过度纠正为怀疑态度，这揭示了除了准确性优化之外，还存在一个校准问题。

papers.title: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Error Detection in Multimodal Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 在多模态推理中对比不同方法在细粒度错误检测方面的性能
papers.authors: Chi-Min Chan, Han Zhu, Chunyang Jiang, Jiaming Ji, Juntao Dai, Wei Xue, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: Multimodal Process Reward Models (MPRMs) have emerged as a pivotal framework for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, the research community currently lacks a dedicated benchmark to rigorously assess the error discernment capabilities of these models.To address this gap, we introduce PRMBench-V, a novel benchmark specifically designed to evaluate MPRMs’ proficiency in detecting erroneous reasoning steps across diverse error categories. Leveraging a semi-automated annotation pipeline augmented with human verification, we construct a comprehensive dataset comprising 907 unique queries, each annotated with nine distinct error types, resulting in 8,163 test cases with fine-grained step-level error labels.Through extensive experiments involving over 15 open- and closed-source models, we uncover several key findings: (1) even the strongest existing MPRMs achieve only \textasciitilde30\% accuracy in error identification; (2) while partial error detection achieves moderate precision and recall (\textasciitilde60\%), overall accuracy remains low (\textasciitilde20\%); and (3) benchmark scores exhibit a strong correlation with downstream task performance gains (r=0.86). Furthermore, we demonstrate that PRMBench-V can inform the development of more robust MPRMs: by introducing the Bayesian Rater Reliability Process Reward Model (BR2-PRM), we achieve up to a 4.8% performance improvement through test-time scaling.We believe that PRMBench-V will serve as a valuable resource for advancing MPRM research, enabling more rigorous evaluation and fostering the development of models with fine-grained multimodal reasoning capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态过程奖励模型（MPRMs）已成为提升多模态大语言模型推理能力的关键框架。然而，目前研究界缺乏一个专门的基准测试来严格评估这些模型的错误识别能力。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了PRMBench-V这一新型基准测试工具，专门用于评估MPRMs在检测不同错误类型时的性能。通过结合半自动注释流程与人工验证的方式，我们构建了一个包含907个独特查询的全面数据集，每个查询都带有九种不同的错误类型，从而形成了8,163个具有细粒度步骤级错误标签的测试案例。通过对超过15个开源和闭源模型进行广泛实验，我们得到了几个重要发现：(1)即使是最强大的现有MPRMs，在错误识别方面的准确率也仅达到30%；(2)虽然部分错误检测具有中等精度和召回率（60%），但整体准确率仍然很低（20%）；(3)基准测试成绩与下游任务性能提升之间存在较强的相关性（r=0.86）。此外，我们还证明了PRMBench-V可以为开发更强大的MPRMs提供指导：通过引入贝叶斯评分者可靠性过程奖励模型（BR2-PRM），我们在测试时实现了高达4.8%的性能提升。我们相信，PRMBench-V将成为推动MPRMs研究发展的宝贵资源，有助于进行更严格的评估，并促进具有细粒度多模态推理能力的模型的开发。

papers.title: Parallel Test-Time Scaling for Latent Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 用于潜在推理模型的并行测试时间缩放技术
papers.authors: Runyang You, Yongqi Li, Meng Liu, Wenjie Wang, Liqiang Nie, Wenjie Li
papers.abstract: Parallel test-time scaling (TTS) is a pivotal approach for enhancing large language models (LLMs), typically by sampling multiple token-based chains-of-thought in parallel and aggregating outcomes through voting or search. Recent advances in latent reasoning, where intermediate reasoning unfolds in continuous vector spaces, offer a more efficient alternative to explicit Chain-of-Thought, yet whether such latent models can similarly benefit from parallel TTS remains open, mainly due to the absence of sampling mechanisms in continuous space, and the lack of probabilistic signals for advanced trajectory aggregation. This work enables parallel TTS for latent reasoning models by addressing the above issues. For sampling, we introduce two uncertainty-inspired stochastic strategies: Monte Carlo Dropout and Additive Gaussian Noise. For aggregation, we design a Latent Reward Model (LatentRM) trained with step-wise contrastive objective to score and guide latent reasoning. Extensive experiments and visualization analyses show that both sampling strategies scale effectively with compute and exhibit distinct exploration dynamics, while LatentRM enables effective trajectory selection. Together, our explorations open a new direction for scalable inference in continuous spaces. Code and checkpoint are included as supplementary materials.GitHub Project: https://github.com/ModalityDance/LatentTTS
papers.abstract_zh: 并行测试时间扩展技术是一种提升大语言模型性能的关键方法。该方法通常通过并行采样多个基于令牌的思维链，并通过投票或搜索的方式汇总结果。最近在潜在推理领域的进展表明，中间推理过程可以在连续向量空间中进行，这为显式思维链提供了一种更高效的替代方案。不过，目前尚不清楚这种潜在模型是否也能从并行测试时间扩展中受益，主要是因为连续空间中没有采样机制，且缺乏用于高级轨迹聚合的概率性信号。本研究通过解决上述问题，实现了对潜在推理模型的并行测试时间扩展。在采样方面，我们引入了两种基于不确定性的随机策略：蒙特卡洛降噪法和加性高斯噪声法。在聚合方面，我们设计了一种基于逐步对比目标的潜在奖励模型，以评估并指导潜在推理过程。大量的实验和可视化分析表明，这两种采样策略都能有效利用计算资源，并且具有不同的探索特性，而潜在奖励模型则能够实现有效的轨迹选择。总的来说，我们的研究为在连续空间中实现可扩展的推理提供了新的方向。代码和检查点作为补充材料提供。GitHub项目链接：https://github.com/ModalityDance/LatentTTS
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SciMDR: Advancing Scientific Multimodal Document Reasoning
papers.title_zh: SciMDR：推进科学多模态文档推理领域的发展
papers.authors: Ziyu Chen, Yilun Zhao, Chengye Wang, Rilyn R. Han, Manasi Patwardhan, Arman Cohan
papers.abstract: Constructing scientific multimodal document reasoning datasets for foundation model training involves an inherent trade-off among scale, faithfulness, and realism. To address this challenge, we introduce the synthesize-and-reground framework, a two-stage pipeline comprising: (1) Claim-Centric QA Synthesis, which generates faithful, isolated QA pairs and reasoning on focused segments, and (2) Document-Scale Regrounding, which programmatically re-embeds these pairs into full-document tasks to ensure realistic complexity. We present SciMDR, a large-scale training dataset for cross-modal comprehension, comprising 300K QA pairs with explicit reasoning chains across 20K scientific papers. We further construct SciMDR-Eval, an expert-annotated benchmark to evaluate multimodal comprehension within full-length scientific workflows. Experiments demonstrate that models fine-tuned on SciMDR achieve significant improvements across multiple scientific QA benchmarks, particularly in tasks requiring complex document-level reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 为基础模型训练构建科学多模态文档推理数据集时，必然要在规模、准确性和现实性之间做出权衡。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了“合成与重嵌入”框架，该框架包含两个阶段：(1)以主题为中心的问答合成，能够生成忠实且独立的问答对，并对特定内容进行推理；(2)大规模重嵌入处理，通过程序化方式将这些问答对重新嵌入到完整的文档任务中，以确保其复杂性符合实际情况。我们开发了SciMDR，这是一个大规模的训练数据集，用于跨模态理解能力的评估，包含30万个问答对，这些问答对来自2万篇科学论文，并带有明确的推理链。此外，我们还构建了SciMDR-Eval，这是一个由专家标注的基准测试集，用于评估在完整科学工作流程中的多模态理解能力。实验表明，在SciMDR上进行微调的模型在多个科学问答基准测试中取得了显著改进，尤其是在需要复杂文档级推理的任务中。

papers.title: When Benchmarks Leak: Inference-Time Decontamination for LLMs
papers.title_zh: 当基准测试数据泄露时：针对大语言模型的推理时间净化技术
papers.authors: Jianzhe Chai, YU Zhe, Jun Sakuma
papers.abstract: Benchmark-based evaluation is the de facto standard for comparing large language models (LLMs). However, its reliability is increasingly threatened by test set contamination, where test samples or their close variants leak into training data and artificially inflate reported performance. To address this issue, prior work has explored two main lines of mitigation. One line attempts to identify and remove contaminated benchmark items before evaluation, but this inevitably alters the evaluation set itself and becomes unreliable when contamination is moderate or severe. The other line preserves the benchmark and instead suppresses contaminated behavior at evaluation time; however, such interventions often interfere with normal inference and lead to noticeable performance degradation on clean inputs. We propose DeconIEP, a decontamination framework that operates entirely during evaluation by applying small, bounded perturbations in the input embedding space. Guided by a relatively less-contaminated reference model, DeconIEP learns an instance-adaptive perturbation generator that steers the evaluated model away from memorization-driven shortcut pathways. Across multiple open-weight LLMs and benchmarks, extensive empirical results show that DeconIEP achieves strong decontamination effectiveness while incurring only minimal degradation in benign utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于基准的评估是比较大语言模型的标准方法。然而，其可靠性正受到测试集污染问题的威胁——测试样本或其近似变体会混入训练数据中，从而人为地提升模型的性能表现。为了解决这一问题，现有研究提出了两种主要的缓解方案。一种方法是尝试在评估前识别并移除受污染的基准样本，但这种方法不可避免地会改变评估集本身，在污染程度较严重的情况下会导致评估结果不可靠。另一种方法是保留基准数据，但在评估时抑制受污染样本的影响；不过，这种干预措施往往会干扰正常的推理过程，导致在干净输入上的性能出现明显下降。我们提出了DeconIEP这一去污染框架，该框架仅在评估过程中发挥作用，通过在输入嵌入空间中施加微小的、有界扰动来实现去污染效果。在相对未受污染的参考模型的指导下，DeconIEP能够学习出一种实例自适应扰动生成器，从而引导被评估模型避免依赖记忆的捷径路径进行推理。通过多个开放权重的大语言模型和多种基准测试，大量的实验结果表明，DeconIEP在有效去除污染的同时，对模型性能的负面影响极小。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: HSGraphAgent: Knowledge-Graph-Guided Large Language Models for Harmonized System Code Classification
papers.title_zh: HSGraphAgent：基于知识图谱的大型语言模型，用于协调统一的代码分类系统
papers.authors: Qiang Xia, Zijian Zhang, Ao Wang, Wenhan Wang, Xiangyu Wang, Jian Li
papers.abstract: Harmonized System (HS) code classification is a hierarchically structured and regulation-constrained task, often complicated by short and noisy product descriptions. Misclassification can lead to tariff misapplication, regulatory violations, or delayed customs clearance, which in turn requires predictions to be both semantically appropriate and hierarchically valid. While large language models (LLMs) show strong semantic understanding, their unconstrained generation is poorly aligned with these requirements, often producing non-existent or hierarchically inconsistent codes. We propose HSGraphAgent a knowledge-graph-guided LLM framework that formulates HS classification as a stepwise, regulation-aware reasoning process over an explicit HS knowledge graph. By encoding hierarchical containment relations and regulatory exclusion rules, and enforcing them through a Select-Redirect mechanism, HSGraphAgent constrains inference to legally valid paths while producing explicit and traceable reasoning trajectories. Experiments on taxonomy-wide 4-digit and fine-grained 6-digit HS benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over direct generation and retrieval-augmented baselines, with particularly strong gains in fine-grained and regulation-sensitive classification settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 协调制度编码分类是一项结构层次分明且受规则约束的任务，而简短且信息不完整的产品描述往往会使这一过程变得更加复杂。错误分类可能导致关税应用不当、违反监管规定或通关延误等问题，因此需要对预测结果进行语义上的准确处理，并确保其符合层次结构的要求。虽然大语言模型在语义理解方面表现出强大的能力，但其无限制的生成方式却难以满足这些要求，常常导致生成出的编码代码不存在或存在层次结构上的不一致性。我们提出了HSGraphAgent这一基于知识图谱引导的LLM框架，它将HS分类过程分解为一系列逐步进行的、考虑规则的推理过程，并基于明确的HS知识图谱来进行推理。通过编码层次结构上的包含关系以及监管限制规则，并通过Select-Redirect机制来强制执行这些规则，HSGraphAgent能够确保推理结果符合法律要求，同时生成出明确且可追踪的推理路径。在涵盖整个分类体系的四位数和六位数的HS分类基准测试中，该框架的表现优于直接生成法和基于检索增强法的基线方法，尤其是在对细节和监管要求敏感的分类场景中，其性能提升尤为显著。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Truth as a Trajectory: What Internal Representations Reveal About Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 作为路径的“真相”：内部表征揭示了关于大型语言模型推理的奥秘
papers.authors: Hamed Damirchi, Imezadelajara, Ehsan Abbasnejad, Afshar Shamsi, Zhen Zhang, Javen Qinfeng Shi
papers.abstract: Existing explainability methods for Large Language Models (LLMs) typically treat hidden states as static points in activation space, assuming that correct and incorrect inferences can be separated using representations from an individual layer. However, these activations are saturated with polysemantic features, leading to linear probes learning surface-level lexical patterns rather than underlying reasoning structures. We introduce Truth as a Trajectory (TaT), which models the transformer inference as an unfolded trajectory of iterative refinements, shifting analysis from static activations to layer-wise geometric displacement. By analyzing displacement of representations across layers, TaT captures structural patterns in the evolution of inference that distinguish valid reasoning from spurious behavior. We evaluate TaT across dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures on benchmarks spanning commonsense reasoning, question answering, and toxicity detection. Without access to the activations themselves and using only changes in activations across layers, we show that TaT effectively mitigates reliance on static lexical confounds, outperforming conventional probing, and establishes trajectory analysis as a complementary perspective on LLM explainability.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前用于大语言模型的可解释性方法通常将隐藏状态视为激活空间中的静态点，假设可以通过单个层的表示来区分正确和错误的推理。然而，这些激活值被多义特征所饱和，导致线性探测只能学习到表层词汇模式，而无法捕捉到潜在的推理结构。我们提出了“真理作为轨迹”的方法，它将Transformer的推理过程建模为一系列迭代修正的连续轨迹，将分析从静态激活值转移到逐层几何位移上。通过分析不同层次间表示的位移，TaT能够捕捉到推理过程中体现的结构性模式，从而区分有效的推理和虚假行为。我们在涵盖常识推理、问题回答和毒性检测等任务上的基准测试中评估了TaT在密集结构和混合专家架构中的表现。通过仅使用不同层次间激活值的变化，我们发现TaT能够有效减少对静态词汇干扰的依赖，其性能优于传统的探测方法，并使得轨迹分析成为理解大语言模型可解释性的一种补充视角。

papers.title: VL-Calibration: Decoupled Confidence Calibration for Large Vision-Language Models Reasoning
papers.title_zh: VL-校准：适用于大型视觉语言模型推理的脱耦置信度校准方法
papers.authors: Wenyi Xiao, Xinchi XU, Leilei Gan
papers.abstract: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal reasoning but frequently exhibit hallucinations and incorrect responses with high certainty, which hinders their usage in high-stakes domains. Existing verbalized confidence calibration methods, largely developed for text-only LLMs, typically optimize a single holistic confidence score using binary answer-level correctness. This design is mismatched to LVLMs: an incorrect prediction may arise from perceptual failures or from reasoning errors given correct perception, and a single confidence conflates these sources while visual uncertainty is often dominated by language priors. To address these issues, we propose VL-Calibration, a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly decouples confidence into visual and reasoning confidence. To supervise visual confidence without ground-truth perception labels, we introduce an intrinsic visual certainty estimation that combines (i) visual grounding measured by KL-divergence under image perturbations and (ii) internal certainty measured by token entropy. We further propose token-level advantage reweighting to focus optimization on tokens based on visual certainty, suppressing ungrounded hallucinations while preserving valid perception. Experiments on thirteen benchmarks show that VL-Calibration effectively improves calibration while boosting visual reasoning accuracy, and it generalizes to out-of-distribution benchmarks across model scales and architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型在多模态推理方面表现出强大的能力，但往往会出现幻觉以及高概率的错误响应，这限制了它们在高风险领域的应用。现有的基于文本的语言模型置信度校准方法，通常仅通过二元答案正确性来优化整体置信度评分。这种设计并不适用于视觉语言模型：错误的预测可能是由于感知失误或即使感知正确但由于推理错误导致的。此外，单一的置信度评分会混淆这些不同的原因，而视觉不确定性往往受到语言先验的支配。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了VL-Calibration这一强化学习框架，该框架能够明确地将置信度分解为视觉置信度和推理置信度。为了在没有真实感知标签的情况下监督视觉置信度，我们引入了一种内在视觉确定性估计方法，该方法结合了：(i) 在图像扰动下的KL散度所测量的视觉定位信息；(ii) 通过令牌熵所测量的内部确定性。我们还提出了令牌级的优势重新加权机制，以根据视觉确定性来优化令牌的选择，从而抑制无根据的幻觉，同时保留有效的感知效果。在十三个基准测试上的实验表明，VL-Calibration能够有效提高校准精度，同时提升视觉推理的准确性。而且，该框架能够在不同模型规模和架构下泛化到非分布式的基准测试中。

papers.title: Don’t Corrupt the Fact: A Trustworthy RAG Watermarking Framework based on Dual Factual Shield
papers.title_zh: 不要歪曲事实：一种基于双事实保护技术的可信赖水印标注框架
papers.authors: Hao Huang, JiaTang Luo, Ruihua Zhou, Yunpeng Li, Yuling Liu
papers.abstract: While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are designed to enhance factual fidelity by grounding LLMs in provided sources, the application of current watermarking techniques creates a paradoxical failure mode. These methods, being inherently fact-agnostic, force the model to deviate from the very source documents it is supposed to follow. This leads to “faithfulness hallucinations"—a critical flaw where the generated output contradicts its own grounding context. Consequently, these watermarks undermine the core value of RAG, rendering even the most secure schemes untrustworthy for high-stakes applications. To resolve this RAG-specific conflict, we introduce the Dual Factual Shield (DFS) framework, a novel architecture designed to enforce knowledge loyalty. The DFS framework employs a defense-in-depth strategy through two synergistic layers: a source-anchored algorithmic safeguard that shields critical terms from the retrieved context, and prompt-based semantic guidance that protects against factual corruption. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we enhance a state-of-the-art, spoofing-aware contrastive watermarking baseline with our framework. Experiments show that our framework drastically reduces the Knowledge Corruption Rate (KCR)—a new metric we introduce—while preserving its original high security and robustness. This work establishes a new paradigm for watermarking, evolving it from merely secure to truly trustworthy. We demonstrate that traceability and truth can, and must, coexist, paving the way for the responsible deployment of traceable AI in knowledge-critical domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然检索增强生成（RAG）系统旨在通过将大语言模型基于提供的文本来源来提高事实的准确性，但当前的水印技术应用却导致了一种矛盾的现象。这些技术本质上是不依赖于事实的，但它们迫使模型偏离了原本应该遵循的源文档。这就产生了“忠实性幻觉”——即生成的输出与其所依据的上下文相矛盾的情况。因此，这些水印破坏了RAG的核心价值，使得即使是最安全的方案也无法在高风险应用中获得信任。为了解决这一与RAG相关的冲突问题，我们提出了双事实保护框架（DFS），这是一种旨在确保知识忠诚性的新型架构。DFS框架采用了一种纵深防御策略，通过两个协同作用的功能层来实现这一目标：一个是基于源文本的算法防护层，用于保护关键术语不受检索到的上下文影响；另一个是基于提示的语义指导层，用于防止事实信息的破坏。为了验证其有效性，我们对一种先进的、能够识别欺骗行为的对比水印基线进行了改进。实验表明，我们的框架显著降低了知识腐败率这一新指标，同时保留了该方案原有的高安全性和鲁棒性。这项工作为水印技术开辟了新的范式，使其从仅仅具有安全性转变为真正可信赖的技术。我们证明了可追溯性和真实性是可以且必须共存的，这为在需要可靠知识的领域负责任地部署可追溯型人工智能铺平了道路。

papers.title: I2E: From Image Pixels to Actionable Interactive Environments for Text-Guided Image Editing
papers.title_zh: I2E：从图像像素到适用于文本引导式图像编辑的互动环境
papers.authors: Jinghan Yu, Junhao Xiao, Chenyu Zhu, Jiaming Li, Jia Li, HanMing Deng, Xirui Wang, Guoli Jia, Jianjun Li, Xiang Bai, Bowen Zhou, Zhiyuan Ma
papers.abstract: Existing text-guided image editing methods primarily rely on end-to-end pixel-level inpainting paradigm. Despite its success in simple scenarios, this paradigm still significantly struggles with compositional editing tasks that require precise local control and complex multi-object spatial reasoning. This paradigm is severely limited by 1) the implicit coupling of planning and execution, 2) the lack of object-level control granularity, and 3) the reliance on unstructured, pixel-centric modeling. To address these limitations, we propose I2E, a novel "Decompose-then-Action” paradigm that revisits image editing as an actionable interaction process within a structured environment. I2E utilizes a Decomposer to transform unstructured images into discrete, manipulable object layers and then introduces a physics-aware Vision-Language-Action Agent to parse complex instructions into a series of atomic actions via Chain-of-Thought reasoning. Further, we also construct I2E-Bench, a benchmark designed for multi-instance spatial reasoning and high-precision editing. Experimental results on I2E-Bench and multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that I2E significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in handling complex compositional instructions, maintaining physical plausibility, and ensuring multi-turn editing stability.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的图像编辑方法主要依赖于端到端的像素级修复范式。尽管这种范式在简单场景下表现良好，但在需要精确局部控制以及复杂多对象空间推理的复合编辑任务上仍然存在明显不足。该范式存在以下三个严重问题：1）规划和执行之间的耦合不够明确；2）缺乏对象级控制的精细度；3）依赖非结构化的、以像素为中心的建模方式。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了I2E这一新颖的“分解-行动”范式。I2E将图像编辑视为一个可以在结构化环境中进行操作的流程。该范式使用分解器将非结构化图像转化为可操作的独立对象层，然后通过物理感知的视觉-语言-动作代理将复杂的指令分解为一系列原子操作。此外，我们还构建了I2E-Bench这一用于多实例空间推理和高精度编辑的基准测试平台。在I2E-Bench及多个公开基准测试中的实验结果表明，I2E在处理复杂复合指令、保持物理合理性以及确保多轮编辑稳定性方面显著优于现有方法。

papers.title: TInR: Exploring Tool-Internalized Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: TInR：探索大型语言模型中的工具内化推理机制
papers.authors: Qiancheng Xu, Yongqi Li, Fan Liu, Hongru Wang, Min Yang, Wenjie Li
papers.abstract: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) has emerged as a promising direction by extending Large Language Models’ (LLMs) capabilities with external tools during reasoning. Existing TIR methods typically rely on external tool documentation during reasoning. However, this leads to tool mastery difficulty, tool size constraints, and inference inefficiency. To mitigate these issues, we explore Tool-Internalized Reasoning (TInR), aiming at facilitating reasoning with tool knowledge internalized into LLMs. Achieving this goal presents notable requirements, including tool internalization and tool-reasoning coordination. To address them, we propose TInR-U, a tool-internalized reasoning framework for unified reasoning and tool usage. TInR-U is trained through a three-phase pipeline: 1) tool internalization with a bidirectional knowledge alignment strategy; 2) supervised fine-tuning warm-up using high-quality reasoning annotations, and 3) reinforcement learning with TInR-specific rewards. We comprehensively evaluate our method across in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Experiment results show that TInR-U achieves superior performance in both settings, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency. The codes are attached in the supplementary file for review.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具集成推理（TIR）作为一种有前景的研究方向逐渐兴起，它通过将大语言模型的能力与外部工具相结合来实现推理功能。现有的TIR方法通常依赖于外部工具的文档信息来进行推理操作。然而，这种方法会导致工具掌握难度增加、工具规模受限以及推理效率低下等问题。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了工具内化推理（TInR）的概念，旨在将工具知识内化为大语言模型的一部分，从而简化推理过程。实现这一目标需要满足一些关键要求，包括工具的内化以及工具与推理过程的协调。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了TInR-U框架，该框架旨在实现工具内化的推理功能，并支持工具的统一使用。TInR-U通过三个阶段进行训练：1）利用双向知识对齐策略对工具进行内化；2）使用高质量的推理注释进行监督式微调；3）采用针对TInR的特定奖励进行强化学习。我们对该方法在领域内部和外部场景下的表现进行了全面评估。实验结果表明，TInR-U在两种场景下都表现出卓越的性能，充分体现了其有效性和高效性。相关代码附在补充文件中，可供查阅。

papers.title: Fine-Grained Analysis of Shared Syntactic Mechanisms in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 语言模型中共享句法机制的细粒度分析
papers.authors: Ryoma Kumon, Hitomi Yanaka
papers.abstract: While language models demonstrate sophisticated syntactic capabilities, the extent to which their internal mechanisms align with cross-constructional principles studied in linguistics remains poorly understood. This study investigates whether models employ shared neural mechanisms across different syntactic constructions by applying causal interpretability methods at a granular level. Focusing on filler-gap dependencies and negative polarity item (NPI) licensing, we utilize activation patching to identify the functional roles of specific attention heads and MLP blocks. Our results reveal a highly localized and shared mechanism for filler-gap dependencies located in the early to middle layers, whereas NPI processing exhibits no such unified mechanism. Furthermore, we find that these mechanisms identified by activation patching generalize to out-of-distribution, while distributed alignment search, a supervised interpretability method, is susceptible to overfitting on narrow linguistic distributions. Finally, we validate our findings by demonstrating that the manipulation of the identified components improves model performance on acceptability judgment benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然语言模型展现了复杂的句法能力，但它们的内部机制在多大程度上与语言学中所研究的跨构式原则相一致，目前仍不清楚。本研究通过采用因果可解释性方法，在微观层面上探讨模型是否采用了跨不同句法构式的共同神经机制。我们重点关注填充词-间隔依赖关系以及否定极性项（NPI）的许可问题，利用激活拼接技术来识别特定注意力单元和MLP模块的功能作用。研究结果表明，填充词-间隔依赖关系具有高度局部化的共享机制，这种机制存在于早期到中期层次结构中；而NPI处理则没有这种统一的机制。此外，我们发现通过激活拼接技术识别出的这些机制能够在超出分布范围的情况下仍然有效，而分布式对齐搜索作为一种有监督的可解释性方法，则容易在狭窄的语言分布上产生过拟合现象。最后，我们通过实验验证发现，对识别出的组件进行操控能够提升模型在可接受性判断基准测试中的性能。

papers.title: One Persona, Many Cues, Different Results: How Sociodemographic Cues Impact LLM Personalization
papers.title_zh: 单一角色，多种线索，不同结果：社会人口学线索如何影响大语言模型的个性化推荐功能
papers.authors: Franziska Weeber, Vera Neplenbroek, Jan Batzner, Sebastian Padó
papers.abstract: Personalization of LLMs by sociodemographic subgroup often improves user experience, but can also introduce or amplify biases and unfair outcomes across groups. Prior work has employed so-called personas, sociodemographic user attributes conveyed to a model, to study bias in LLMs by relying on a single cue to prompt a persona, such as user names or explicit attribute mentions. This disregards LLM sensitivity to prompt variation and the rarity of some cues in real interactions (external validity). We compare six commonly used persona cues across seven open and proprietary LLMs on four writing and advice tasks. While cues are overall highly correlated, they produce substantial variance in responses across personas that can change findings on persona-induced differences and bias. We therefore caution against claims based on single persona cues, especially when they are overly explicit and have low external validity.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过社会人口学子群体对大语言模型进行个性化设置通常能够改善用户体验，但也可能引入或加剧各群体之间的偏见和不公平结果。之前的研究采用所谓的“人物角色”这一概念，即向模型传递用户的社会人口学属性，以此来研究大语言模型中的偏见问题。这种研究方法仅依赖单一提示来触发人物角色，例如用户的名字或具体的属性描述。然而，这种方法忽略了大语言模型对提示变化的敏感性，以及在实际交互中某些提示出现的频率较低的问题（即外部效度不足）。我们在七种公开和专有的大语言模型上，针对四项写作和建议任务，比较了六种常用的人物角色提示。虽然这些提示总体上具有高度相关性，但它们在不同人物角色之间会产生显著的差异，这可能会改变关于人物角色引起的差异和偏见的研究结果。因此，我们建议不要仅仅基于单一的人物角色提示来做出结论，尤其是当这些提示过于具体且缺乏外部效度时。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Lost in the Mix: Evaluating LLM Understanding of Code-Switched Text
papers.title_zh: 迷失在混乱之中：评估大型语言模型对混合语码文本的理解能力
papers.authors: Amr Mohamed, Yang Zhang, Michalis Vazirgiannis, Guokan Shang
papers.abstract: Code-switching (CSW) is the act of alternating between two or more languages within a single discourse. This phenomenon is widespread in multilingual communities and increasingly prevalent online, exposing large language models (LLMs) to mixed-language inputs. We present a systematic evaluation of LLM comprehension under code-switching by generating linguistically grounded CSW variants of established benchmarks (Belebele, MMLU, XNLI) across five typologically diverse languages. Our contributions are: (i) a controlled pipeline for producing CSW test sets that respect linguistic constraints on code-switching; (ii) a multi-model, multi-language analysis showing that inserting non-English tokens into English consistently reduces accuracy on comprehension and reasoning benchmarks, whereas embedding English into non-English contexts often improves it; and (iii) a mitigation study contrasting in-context learning (ICL) with fine-tuning. Across model families, ICL cues yield inconsistent, and sometimes negative, effects, while fine-tuning on CSW data provides modest but reliable gains, partially recovering accuracy under CSW.
papers.abstract_zh: 语码转换是指在同一话语中交替使用两种或多种语言的行为。这种现象在多语言社区中非常普遍，在线上环境中也愈发常见，这使得大语言模型面临混合语言输入的情况。我们通过对五种不同语言类型的标准测试集（如Belebele、MMLU、XNLI等）进行语码转换处理，系统地评估了大语言模型在语码转换下的理解能力。我们的研究贡献包括：首先，我们设计了一种受控的语码转换测试集生成方法，该方法能够遵守语码转换的语言约束；其次，我们通过多模型、多语言分析发现，将非英语词汇插入英语文本会持续降低模型的理解能力和推理能力，而将英语元素嵌入非英语文本则通常能改善这些性能；最后，我们还进行了对比研究，比较了基于上下文学习的训练方法和微调方法的效果。研究发现，基于上下文学习的训练方法往往会产生不一致甚至负面的效果，而针对语码转换数据的微调方法则能带来适度但可靠的提升，部分情况下还能恢复语码转换环境下的准确性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Building LLMs Like LEGO: Two-dimensional Architecture Reassembly of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 像拼装乐高积木一样构建大型语言模型：对大型语言模型进行二维架构的重组
papers.authors: Xingyu Wu, Yu Zhou, KC Tan
papers.abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) are typically reused as indivisible artifacts, adapted, merged, or ensembled as a whole. In this study, we show that LLMs can instead be structurally recomposed as modular building blocks to create new architectures without access to original training data. We introduce architecture-level reassembly as a new reuse paradigm, in which Transformer blocks from heterogeneous models are treated as reusable components. This idea is formalized through a two-dimensional reassembly space that supports both vertical recombination across depth and horizontal composition within layers. To make this space tractable, we propose a chromosome-based architectural encoding and perform a bi-level multi-objective evolutionary optimization over vertical structure and horizontal composition. To resolve representation incompatibility across heterogeneous blocks, we introduce lightweight glue layers trained via data-free knowledge distillation, enabling valid information flow without modifying pretrained parameters. Our results demonstrate that architecture-level reassembly unlocks a new dimension of flexibility in model reuse, pointing toward a modular and evolutionary view of LLM design.
papers.abstract_zh: 预训练的大语言模型通常被视为不可分割的实体，需要被重新组合、合并或集成在一起使用。在本研究中，我们证明了大语言模型可以被结构化为模块化的构建块，从而在不依赖原始训练数据的情况下创建新的架构。我们提出了一种基于架构级别的重组方法，将来自不同模型的Transformer模块视为可复用的组件。这一想法通过一种二维重组空间来实现，该空间支持在深度方向上的垂直重组以及层内水平组合。为了使这种重组变得可行，我们提出了一种基于染色体的架构编码方式，并采用双层多目标进化优化方法来处理垂直结构和水平组合问题。为了解决不同模块之间的表示不兼容性问题，我们引入了通过无数据知识蒸馏训练的轻量级粘合层，从而实现无需修改预训练参数的有效信息传输。我们的研究结果表明，架构级别的重组为模型复用带来了新的灵活性，为大语言模型的设计提供了一种模块化且进化的视角。

papers.title: How Long Reasoning Chains Influence LLMs’ Judgment of Answer Factuality
papers.title_zh: 推理链条的持续时间对大型语言模型对答案真实性的判断有何影响
papers.authors: Minzhu Tu, Shiyu Ni, Keping Bi
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted as scalable judges for open-ended generation, yet how they form judgments remains insufficiently understood. Meanwhile, modern LLMs frequently produce answers accompanied by explicit reasoning, making reasoning chains a natural but understudied source of information for model-based evaluation. This work takes a first step toward understanding how exposing reasoning influences LLM-based judgment. Empirical results across factual question-answering (QA) and mathematical datasets show that the presence of reasoning substantially alters judgment behavior, with clear differences across judge capabilities. Weaker judges become more likely to accept incorrect answers when reasoning is present, suggesting over-reliance on persuasive explanations. In contrast, stronger judges exhibit more selective behavior and, in some cases, achieve higher judgment accuracy by leveraging reasoning content. Further analysis reveals that both reasoning fluency and factuality critically shape judgment outcomes. Together, these findings suggest that examining how models interpret reasoning is essential for understanding and improving LLM-based evaluation, with broader implications for the design of reliable automatic judges and evaluation protocols.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作可扩展的生成评判工具，然而它们如何形成判断的机制仍然缺乏充分理解。与此同时，现代LLM在生成答案时通常会附带明确的推理过程，这使得推理链成为基于模型的评估中一个自然但被忽视的信息来源。本研究首次尝试探讨揭示推理信息对LLM判断的影响。通过事实问答和数学数据集的实证分析发现，推理信息的存在显著改变了判断行为，不同评判者之间的表现也存在明显差异。当存在推理信息时，较弱的评判者更有可能接受错误的答案，这表明他们过于依赖有说服力的解释。相反，较强的评判者则表现出更具选择性的行为，在某些情况下，通过利用推理内容还能提高判断准确性。进一步分析表明，推理的流畅性和事实性对判断结果有着至关重要的影响。综上所述，研究结果表明，了解模型如何解读推理信息对于理解和改进基于LLM的评估至关重要，这对设计可靠的自动评判工具和评估协议具有广泛意义。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MMErroR: A Benchmark for Erroneous Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: MMErroR：一种用于评估视觉语言模型中错误推理的基准测试
papers.authors: Yang Shi, Yifeng Xie, Minzhe Guo, Liangsi Lu, Mingxuan Huang, Jingchao Wang, Zhihong Zhu, Boyan Xu, Zhiqi Huang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have improved performance in multi-modal learning, raising the question of whether these models truly understand the content they process. Crucially, can VLMs detect when a reasoning process is wrong and identify its error type? To answer this, we present MMErroR, a multi-modal benchmark of 1997 samples, each embedding a single coherent reasoning error. These samples span 24 subdomains across six top-level domains, ensuring broad coverage and taxonomic richness. Unlike existing benchmarks that focus on answer correctness, MMErroR targets a process-level, error-centric evaluation that requires models to detect incorrect reasoning and classify the error type within both visual and linguistic contexts. We evaluate 12 representative VLMs, and even the best model, Gemini-3-Pro-Preview, classifies the error correctly in only 66.65% of cases, underscoring the challenge of identifying erroneous reasoning. Furthermore, the ability to accurately identify errors offers valuable insights into the capabilities of multi-modal models.Project Page: https://mmerror-benchmark.github.io
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在多模态学习方面的性能得到了显著提升，这引发了这样一个问题：这些模型是否真正理解了它们处理的内容？关键在于，视觉语言模型能否检测到推理过程出错的位置，并识别出错误的类型？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了MMErroR这个多模态基准测试，该测试包含1997个样本，每个样本都包含一个连贯的推理错误。这些样本涵盖了六个顶级领域的24个子领域，确保了广泛的覆盖性和分类的丰富性。与那些仅关注答案正确性的现有基准测试不同，MMErroR注重对过程层面的、以错误为中心的评估，要求模型能够检测出不正确的推理，并在视觉和语言语境中分类错误的类型。我们对12个代表性的视觉语言模型进行了评估，即便是最优秀的模型Gemini-3-Pro-Preview，也只有66.65%的情况下能够正确地识别错误，这凸显了识别错误推理的难度。此外，准确识别错误的能力有助于我们了解多模态模型的能力。项目页面：https://mmerror-benchmark.github.io

papers.title: Learning How and What to Memorize: Cognition-Inspired Two-Stage Optimization for Evolving Memory
papers.title_zh: 学习如何学习以及应该记住什么：基于认知理论的双阶段优化方法在记忆发展中的应用
papers.authors: Derong Xu, Shuochen Liu, Pengfei Luo, Pengyue Jia, Yingyi Zhang, Yi Wen, Yimin Deng, Wenlin Zhang, Enhong Chen, Xiangyu Zhao, Tong Xu
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents require long-term user memory for consistent personalization, but limited context windows hinder tracking evolving preferences over long interactions. Existing memory systems mainly rely on static, hand-crafted update rules; although reinforcement learning (RL)-based agents learn memory updates, sparse outcome rewards provide weak supervision, resulting in unstable long-horizon optimization. Drawing on memory schema theory and the functional division between prefrontal regions and hippocampus regions, we introduce MemCoE, a cognition-inspired two-stage optimization framework that learns how memory should be organized and what information to update. In the first stage, we propose Memory Guideline Induction to optimize a global guideline via contrastive feedback interpreted as textual gradients; in the second stage, Guideline-Aligned Memory Policy Optimization uses the induced guideline to define structured process rewards and performs multi-turn RL to learn a guideline-following memory evolution policy. We evaluate on three personalization memory benchmarks, covering explicit and implicit preferences as well as different sizes and noise levels, and observe consistent improvements over strong baselines with favorable robustness, transferability, and efficiency[https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/ACL2026_MemCoE].
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理需要长期用户记忆以实现持续的个性化服务，但有限的上下文窗口限制了跟踪长时间互动中不断变化的偏好。现有的记忆系统主要依赖静态的、人工制定的更新规则；虽然基于强化学习的代理能够学习记忆更新方法，但稀疏的结果奖励提供了较弱的监督机制，从而导致长期优化的稳定性不足。借鉴记忆模式理论以及前额叶区域与海马体区域的功能分工，我们提出了MemCoE这一受认知启发的两阶段优化框架。该框架能够学习记忆应该如何组织，以及哪些信息需要更新。在第一阶段，我们提出了记忆指导准则归纳算法，通过对比反馈来优化全局指导准则，这种反馈被解释为文本梯度；在第二阶段，指导准则对齐记忆策略优化则利用所归纳的准则来定义结构化的过程奖励，并通过多轮强化学习来学习遵循指导准则的记忆演化策略。我们在三个个性化记忆评估基准上进行了测试，涵盖了显性和隐性偏好、不同规模及噪声水平的情况，结果发现我们的方法相较于强大的基线算法取得了持续的改进，同时具有出色的鲁棒性、可迁移性和效率。[https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/ACL2026_MemCoE]
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PolitNuggets: Benchmarking Agentic Discovery of Long-Tail Political Facts
papers.title_zh: 政治洞察：基于代理的长尾政治信息挖掘
papers.authors: Yifei Zhu
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) embedded in agentic frameworks have transformed information retrieval from static, long-context question answering into open-ended exploration. Yet real-world use requires models to discover and synthesize “long-tail” facts from dispersed sources, a capability that remains under-evaluated. We introduce PolitNuggets, a multilingual benchmark for agentic information synthesis via constructing political biographies for 400 global elites, covering over 10000 political facts. We standardize evaluation with an optimized Supervisor–Searcher multi-agent system and propose FactNet, an evidence-conditional protocol that scores discovery, fine-grained accuracy, and efficiency. Across models and settings, we find that current systems often struggle with fine-grained details, and vary substantially in efficiency. Finally, using benchmark diagnostics, we relate agent performance to underlying model capabilities, highlighting the importance of short-context extraction, multilingual robustness, and reliable tool use.
papers.abstract_zh: 嵌入在智能体框架中的大型推理模型已经将信息检索从静态的、基于长上下文的问题回答，转变为开放式探索。然而，在实际应用中，模型需要能够从分散的来源发现和合成“长尾”事实，这一能力仍然没有得到充分的评估。我们提出了PolitNuggets这一多语言基准测试，它通过为400位全球精英人物构建政治传记来推动智能体信息合成工作，涵盖了超过10000条政治事实。我们通过优化的监督者-搜索者多智能体系统来标准化评估过程，并提出了FactNet这一基于证据的条件协议，该协议能够评估发现能力、细粒度准确性和效率。在不同模型和场景中，我们发现当前系统往往在处理细粒度细节时存在困难，且在效率方面也存在显著差异。最后，通过基准诊断分析，我们将智能体的性能与底层模型的能力联系起来，强调了短上下文提取、多语言鲁棒性以及可靠工具使用的重要性。

papers.title: Diagnosing and Remedying Representation Deficiencies for Deterministic Reasoning in KGQA
papers.title_zh: 诊断并修复确定性推理在KGQA中的表示缺陷
papers.authors: Gewen Liang, Mufan Xu, Kehai Chen, Wei Wang, Yuwei Wang, Muyun Yang, Tiejun Zhao, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated increasingly strong reasoning capabilities, achieving remarkable progress in knowledge graph question answering (KGQA). However, a key challenge in such systems is non-deterministic reasoning, where the model indecisively activates multiple semantically related knowledge graph edges for a given query, frequently leading to incorrect answers. To address this issue, we propose Diagnosing and Remedying Representation Deficiencies for Deterministic Reasoning in KGQA (DR2). DR2 identifies and localizes non-deterministic reasoning behaviors, uncovering the underlying semantic representation deficiencies in LLMs. Building on this diagnosis, we design abductive reasoning-based preference learning, which promotes fine-grained semantic discrimination and mitigates non-deterministic reasoning errors. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed DR2 significantly outperforms several strong baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the widely used WebQSP and CWQ benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在推理能力方面取得了显著进步，在知识图谱问答领域也取得了卓越成果。然而，这类系统面临的一个关键挑战是非确定性推理问题——即模型在面对特定查询时，可能会错误地选择多个语义相关的知识图谱边，从而导致错误的答案。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了“诊断与修复知识图谱问答中非确定性推理的表征缺陷”的方法。该方法能够识别并定位非确定性推理行为，揭示出语言模型中存在的语义表征缺陷。在此基础上，我们设计了基于溯因推理的偏好学习机制，以进一步提升语义辨别能力，从而减轻非确定性推理带来的错误。实验结果表明，所提出的DR2方法在性能上明显优于其他强大的基准算法，在广泛使用的WebQSP和CWQ基准测试上取得了领先的性能表现。

papers.title: Revealing the Seen, Imagining the Beyond: A Survey of Image-Grounded Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
papers.title_zh: 揭示可见之境，想象不可及之域：关于多模态大语言模型中基于图像的思维链推理机制的研究综述
papers.authors: Qihua Dong, Yitian Zhang, Huimin Zeng, Yizhou Wang, Jianglin Lu, Kuo Yang, Yun Fu
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are making rapid strides in complex visual reasoning. This survey synthesizes the emerging paradigm of Image-Grounded Chain-of-Thought (IG-CoT), where models ground intermediate inferences by interleaving textual rationales with visual state updates. We formalize IG-CoT, present a method-centric taxonomy covering prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning, and map these techniques to representative benchmarks. Our analysis identifies two domains where IG-CoT offers significant advantages: detail-oriented reasoning requiring meticulous perception, and imagined-world reasoning for simulating unseen states in games, geometry, and planning. We discuss the practical trade-offs of current methods regarding controllability, data, and compute. We conclude by highlighting key challenges (efficiency, data quality, and generative capabilities) and outlining promising future directions, including lightweight architectures, richer intermediate supervision, and method-aware evaluations that better assess faithfulness and long-horizon reasoning. We maintain a continuously updated paper list at https://github.com/dddraxxx/Awesome-Image-Grounded-CoT.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在复杂的视觉推理方面取得了迅速的进步。本综述总结了图像基础思维链（Image-Grounded Chain-of-Thought, IG-CoT）这一新兴范式，该范式通过将文本性理由与视觉状态更新交织在一起，从而为模型提供中间推理的支撑。我们对该范式进行了形式化描述，提出了一种以方法为中心的分类体系，涵盖了提示技术、有监督微调以及强化学习等方面。我们的分析指出，IG-CoT在两个方面具有显著优势：一是需要精细感知的细节导向推理；二是用于模拟游戏、几何和规划中未见状态的想象世界推理。我们还讨论了当前方法在可控性、数据资源以及计算能力方面的实际权衡问题。最后，我们指出了关键挑战（如效率、数据质量以及生成能力），并展望了未来发展的方向，包括轻量级架构、更丰富的中间层监督机制，以及能够更好评估模型准确性和长视距推理能力的评估方法。我们的论文列表会持续更新，网址为https://github.com/dddraxxx/Awesome-Image-Grounded-CoT。

papers.title: Learning Faster with Better Tokens: Parameter-Efficient Vocabulary Adaptation for Specialized Text Summarization
papers.title_zh: 使用更高效的令牌实现更快的学习：适用于专业文本摘要处理的参数高效词汇适配技术
papers.authors: Gunjan Balde, Soumyadeep Roy, Mainack Mondal, Niloy Ganguly
papers.abstract: Large language models pretrained on general-domain corpora often exhibit tokenization inefficiencies when applied to specialized domains. Although continual pretraining for domain adaptation partially alleviate performance degradation, it does not resolve the fundamental vocabulary mismatch. To address this gap, we introduce a targeted parameter-efficient domain adaptation approach that combines vocabulary adaptation with pretraining for LLM-based text summarization. Our unified framework augments pretrained tokenizers with domain-specific tokens while selectively replacing under-trained and unreachable tokens to limit parameter growth. We evaluate our approach on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B across legal and medical summarization tasks on a challenge-oriented evaluation protocol focused on expert-driven text and summaries which typically has higher concentration of over-fragmented Out-of-Vocabulary (OOV) words. The vocabulary adaptation algorithm enhances the overall quality of the summarization model by improving semantic similarity between the generated summaries and their references. In addition, the adapted model produces summaries that incorporate more appropriate novel and domain-specific words, leading to improved coherence, relevance, and faithfulness. We further observe that our proposed approach significantly reduce training time by 35-55% over continual pretraining and reduce parameter counts up to 37% w.r.t expansion-only methods. We make codebase publicly available at url.
papers.abstract_zh: 在通用领域语料库上预训练的大语言模型在应用于专业领域时，往往会出现分词效率低下的问题。虽然持续预训练可以部分缓解性能下降的问题，但并不能解决词汇表不匹配这一根本问题。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种有针对性的参数高效领域适应方法，该方法结合了词汇表调整与基于大语言模型的文本摘要预训练技术。我们的统一框架通过添加特定领域的词汇来提升预训练分词器的性能，同时选择性地替换那些训练不足或无法处理的词汇，从而限制参数的增长。我们在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上进行评估，涵盖了法律和医学领域的摘要任务。我们的评估方案以专家主导的文本和摘要为例，这些文本和摘要通常包含大量超出词汇表的词汇。词汇表调整算法通过提高生成摘要与其参考内容之间的语义相似性，提升了摘要的整体质量。此外，经过调整的模型生成的摘要中包含了更多合适的新型词汇和特定领域的词汇，从而提高了摘要的连贯性、相关性和准确性。我们还观察到，与持续预训练相比，我们的方法显著减少了35-55%的训练时间，并且参数数量减少了37%，相比仅进行扩展的方法而言。我们的代码库已公开提供，网址为[url]。

papers.title: Adversarial Metric Learning for Fine-Grained Emotion Classification
papers.title_zh: 用于细粒度情感分类的对抗性度量学习
papers.authors: Junfan Chen, Sizhe Wu, Richong Zhang, Chunming Hu
papers.abstract: Fine-grained emotion classification (FEC) requires distinguishing subtly different emotions, where the dominant errors come from closely confusable categories. Recent progress relies on contrastive learning with hard-pair mining, implicitly assuming that a fixed similarity metric is sufficient to optimize informative pairs. We argue that this assumption is fragile because defining whether two utterances are similar becomes a problem when the label space is crowded, and hard-pair mining under a fixed metric can systematically miss the worst confusions. Thus, we treat the similarity function as a learnable component and design an adversarial metric learning (AML) framework. It follows theoretical interpretations of metric-robust representations that better separate confusable emotions. AML trains a pairwise discriminator to maximally confuse two targeted hard pair types, while training the encoder to remain discriminative under this worst-case learned metric. Our code and data are released on GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 细粒度情感分类（FEC）需要区分那些细微不同的情感，而主要的错误往往来自那些容易混淆的类别。目前的研究主要依赖于基于对比学习的硬对匹配方法，这种方法隐含地认为一个固定的相似度度量就足以优化出有信息量的配对对。我们认为这个假设是脆弱的，因为当标签空间过于拥挤时，判断两个表达是否相似就会变得困难。在固定相似度度量下进行的硬对匹配可能会系统性地遗漏最糟糕的混淆情况。因此，我们将相似度函数视为一个可学习的组件，并设计了一个对抗性度量学习框架。该框架基于度量鲁棒表示的理论解释，能够更有效地区分容易混淆的情感。通过训练成对判别器来最大程度地混淆两种特定的硬对类型，同时训练编码器以在这种最坏情况下的度量下保持判别能力。我们的代码和数据集已发布在GitHub上。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: OMIBench: Benchmarking Olympiad-Level Multi-Image Reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: OMIBench：在大型视觉语言模型中进行奥林匹克水平多图像推理能力的基准测试
papers.authors: Qiguang Chen, Chengyu Luan, Jiajun Wu, Qiming Yu, Yi Yang, Yizhuo Li, Jingqi Tong, Xiachong Feng, Libo Qin, Wanxiang Che
papers.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have made substantial advances in reasoning tasks at the Olympiad level. Nevertheless, current Olympiad-level multimodal reasoning benchmarks for these models often emphasize single-image analysis and fail to exploit contextual information across multiple images. We present OMIBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate Olympiad-level reasoning when the required evidence is distributed over multiple images. It contains problems from biology, chemistry, mathematics, and physics Olympiads, together with manually annotated rationales and evaluation protocols for both exact and semantic answer matching. Across extensive experiments on OMIBench, we observe meaningful performance gaps in existing models. Even the strongest LVLMs, such as Gemini-3-Pro, attain only about 50% on the benchmark. These results position OMIBench as a focused resources for studying and improving multi-image reasoning in LVLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型在奥林匹克级别推理任务上取得了显著进展。然而，目前这些模型的奥林匹克级别多模态推理基准测试往往侧重于单张图片的分析，未能充分利用多张图片之间的上下文信息。我们提出了OMIBench这一基准测试，旨在评估当所需证据分布在多张图片上时，模型在奥林匹克级别推理能力的表现。该基准测试包含来自生物学、化学、数学和物理奥林匹克竞赛的问题，并附有手动标注的解析说明以及用于精确答案和语义答案匹配的评估方案。通过对OMIBench进行的广泛实验，我们发现现有模型在性能上存在明显差距。即使是最强大的视觉语言模型，如Gemini-3-Pro，在该基准测试中的表现也仅达到约50%。这些结果使得OMIBench成为研究和改进视觉语言模型中多图像推理能力的重点资源。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Authorship Attribution in Multilingual Machine-Generated Texts
papers.title_zh: 多语言机器生成文本中的作者归属问题
papers.authors: Lucio La Cava, Dominik Macko, Robert Moro, Ivan Srba, Andrea Tagarelli
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) have reached human-like fluency and coherence, distinguishing machine-generated text (MGT) from human-written content becomes increasingly difficult. While early efforts in MGT detection have focused on binary classification, the growing landscape and diversity of LLMs require a more fine-grained yet challenging authorship attribution (AA), i.e., being able to identify the precise generator (LLM or human) behind a text. However, AA remains nowadays confined to a monolingual setting, with English being the most investigated one, overlooking the multilingual nature and usage of modern LLMs. In this work, we introduce the problem of Multilingual Authorship Attribution, which involves attributing texts to human or multiple LLM generators across diverse languages. Focusing on 18 languages—covering multiple families and writing scripts—and 8 generators (7 LLMs and the human-authored class), we investigate the multilingual suitability of monolingual AA methods in terms of their cross-lingual transferability, and the impact of generators on attribution performance. Our results reveal that while certain monolingual AA methods can be adapted to multilingual settings, significant limitations and challenges remain, particularly in transferring across diverse language families, underscoring the complexity of multilingual AA and the need for more robust approaches to better match real-world scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）达到与人类相似的流畅性和连贯性，区分机器生成的文本和人类撰写的文本内容变得越来越困难。虽然早期的MGT检测工作主要集中在二元分类上，但LLM的多样性和复杂性要求我们对作者归属进行更细致且更具挑战性的识别，即能够确定文本背后的具体生成器是LLM还是人类。然而，目前作者归属问题仍然局限于单语言环境，英语是最常被研究的语言，而现代LLM的多语言特性和使用方式则被忽视了。在这项研究中，我们提出了多语言作者归属的问题，即如何将文本归属于人类或多种LLM生成器所创作的不同语言文本。我们选取了18种语言——涵盖多个语系和书写系统——以及8种生成器（7种LLM和1种人类撰写类），来研究单语言作者归属方法在多语言环境中的适用性，以及生成器对归属效果的影响。我们的研究结果表明，尽管某些单语言作者归属方法可以适应多语言环境，但在跨不同语系的语言中仍然存在显著的局限性和挑战，这凸显了多语言作者归属问题的复杂性，以及需要更稳健的方法来更好地应对现实世界中的情况。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Layer-Wise High-Impact Parameter Ratio Optimization in Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在大规模语言模型的训练后量化过程中，逐层优化高影响参数比率
papers.authors: Cuong Pham, Anh Dung Hoang, Cuong C. Nguyen, Trung Le, Gustavo Carneiro, Thanh-Toan Do
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced natural language processing, but their massive parameter counts create computational and memory challenges during deployment. Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising approach to mitigate these challenges. While existing PTQ methods can effectively quantize LLMs, they experience substantial accuracy loss at extremely low bit-widths due to high-impact parameters. Several approaches address this by retaining high-impact parameters in FP16 format, but they apply fixed ratios across all layers, overlooking layer-wise sensitivity variations. We propose a quadratic optimization framework that determines layer-specific ratios of high-impact parameters while considering inter-layer dependencies. We quantize high-impact parameters to moderate bit-widths while the remaining parameters are quantized to extremely low bit-widths. Under the same resource budget, this preserves more high-impact parameters than methods retaining a few in FP16 format. Our framework enables leveraging advanced quantization methods for high-impact parameters while applying lightweight computational quantization methods to the rest, achieving an effective balance between computational efficiency and accuracy during quantization process.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自然语言处理领域取得了显著进展，但其庞大的参数数量在部署过程中带来了计算和内存方面的挑战。训练后量化技术作为一种有效的解决方案被提出来应对这些挑战。虽然现有的量化方法能够成功地对大语言模型进行量化，但在极低的比特宽度下，由于某些高影响参数的存在，会导致量化精度大幅下降。一些方法试图通过将高影响参数保留在FP16格式中来解决这个问题，但这些方法采用固定的比例进行量化，而忽略了不同层之间的敏感性差异。我们提出了一种二次优化框架，该框架能够确定各层高影响参数的具体比例，同时考虑层与层之间的依赖关系。我们采用中等比特宽度的量化方式来处理高影响参数，而将其余参数量化到极低的比特宽度。在相同资源预算下，这种方法能够保留更多的高影响参数，相比那些仅保留少量高影响参数到FP16格式的方法来说，具有更高的效率。我们的框架使得我们可以充分利用先进的量化方法来处理高影响参数，同时采用轻量化的计算量化方法来处理其他参数，从而在量化过程中实现计算效率和精度的有效平衡。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: On the Role of Discriminative Models in Generative Relation Extraction
papers.title_zh: 关于判别性模型在生成式关系提取中的作用
papers.authors: Guozheng Li, Peng Wang, Zijie Xu, Jing Zhou, Jiajun Liu, Ziyu Shang
papers.abstract: Relation extraction (RE) identifies semantic relations between entities in text, with existing methods falling into two main paradigms: discriminative and generative. Discriminative models encode sentences and entities into relation representations and classify the most likely relation, whereas generative models directly produce relation labels through sequence generation. Although the latter have benefited from recent advances in large language models (LLMs), their performance remains limited by bottlenecks. In this work, we present the systematic investigation of how discriminative models can support generative RE. We propose the Discriminative-to-Generative (D2G) framework, which first leverages discriminative models to produce a top-k set of candidate relations, and then integrates this knowledge into generative models via in-context or prompt learning. Extensive experiments on five widely used RE benchmarks demonstrate that D2G consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with notable gains on long-tailed relation classes.
papers.abstract_zh: 关系提取（Relation Extraction，简称RE）旨在识别文本中实体之间的语义关系。现有的方法主要可以分为两类：判别式方法和生成式方法。判别式模型将句子和实体编码为关系表示，并判断最可能的关联关系；而生成式模型则通过序列生成直接产生关系标签。尽管生成式方法在大语言模型的发展下取得了显著进步，但其性能仍受到一些瓶颈的限制。在这项研究中，我们系统地探讨了如何使判别式模型能够支持生成式关系提取。我们提出了“判别式到生成式”框架（Discriminative-to-Generative，简称D2G），该框架首先利用判别式模型生成前k个候选关系，然后通过上下文学习或提示学习的方式将这些信息整合到生成式模型中。在五个常用的关系提取基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，D2G框架始终能够取得领先的性能表现，尤其是在处理长尾关系类别时表现尤为出色。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Speculative End-Turn Detector for Efficient Speech Chatbot Assistant
papers.title_zh: 用于高效语音聊天机器人的投机性终端检测装置
papers.authors: Hyunjong Ok, Suho Yoo, Jaeho Lee
papers.abstract: Spoken dialogue systems powered by large language models have demonstrated remarkable abilities in understanding human speech and generating appropriate spoken responses.However, these systems struggle with end-turn detection (ETD)—the ability to distinguish between user turn completion and hesitation. This limitation often leads to premature or delayed responses, disrupting the flow of spoken conversations.In this paper, we introduce the OpenETD Dataset, the first public dataset for end-turn detection. The OpenETD dataset consists of both synthetic speech data generated with text-to-speech models and real-world speech data collected from web sources. We also propose SpeculativeETD, a novel collaborative inference framework that balances efficiency and accuracy to improve real-time ETD in resource-constrained environments. Our approach jointly employs a lightweight GRU-based model, which rapidly detects the non-speaking units in real-time on local devices, and a high-performance Wav2vec-based model running on the server to make a more challenging classification of distinguishing turn ends from mere pauses. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed SpeculativeETD significantly improves ETD accuracy while keeping the required computations low.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的语音对话系统在理解人类语音和生成适当的语音回应方面表现出惊人的能力。然而，这些系统在识别结束轮次方面存在困难——即区分用户完成轮次和犹豫不决的情况。这一限制常常导致响应过早或延迟，从而破坏语音对话的流畅性。在本文中，我们介绍了OpenETD数据集，这是首个用于识别结束轮次的公开数据集。OpenETD数据集包含通过文本转语音模型生成的合成语音数据，以及从网络来源收集的真实语音数据。我们还提出了SpeculativeETD这一新颖的协作推理框架，该框架在资源有限的环境中平衡了效率和准确性，以改进实时结束轮次的识别。我们的方法结合了基于轻量级GRU模型的局部设备快速检测非说话单元的功能，以及运行在服务器上的高性能Wav2vec模型，以便对轮次结束进行更精确的分类。实验表明，所提出的SpeculativeETD显著提高了结束轮次的识别准确率，同时降低了计算需求。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TwiUSD: A Benchmark Dataset and Structure-Aware LLM Framework for User Stance Detection
papers.title_zh: TwiUSD：一个用于用户态度检测的基准数据集以及基于结构感知的LLM框架
papers.authors: Fuqiang Niu, Zini Chen, Zhiyu Xie, Hu Huang, Qing Liao, Qianlong Wang, Genan Dai, Bowen Zhang
papers.abstract: Political user-level stance detection is vital for analyzing polarization, yet progress is hindered by the scarcity of high-quality benchmarks integrating linguistic and social signals. Existing datasets, largely relying on noisy heuristic or distant supervision, limit model robustness and generalizability. To address this, we introduce TwiUSD, a large-scale, expert-annotated benchmark for political user-level stance detection with explicit social network structure. TwiUSD comprises 16,211 users and 47,757 tweets, labeled by domain experts using a protocol that integrates both user content and followee signals, ensuring high-quality annotations (kappa > 0.9). Building upon TwiUSD, we propose MRFG, a Multi-scale Relevance Filtering and Graph-aware framework that leverages large language models to filter stance-relevant followee content and adaptively routes features based on structural informativeness. This design enables robust stance prediction by jointly modeling semantic and relational cues. Extensive experiments show that MRFG significantly outperforms strong baselines, highlighting the importance of relevance filtering and structure-aware modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 政治用户立场检测对于分析两极分化现象至关重要，然而，由于缺乏能够整合语言和社会信号的高质量基准数据集，这一领域的进展受到了限制。现有的数据集大多依赖于噪声启发式方法或远程监督机制，这限制了模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了TwiUSD——一个大规模、由专家标注的政治用户立场检测基准数据集，该数据集包含了明确的社会网络结构信息。TwiUSD包含16,211名用户和47,757条推文，这些数据由领域专家通过一种结合了用户内容和关注者信息的标注协议进行标注，从而确保了高质量的注释质量（kappa值超过0.9）。在TwiUSD的基础上，我们提出了MRFG框架——一个多尺度相关性过滤和图感知框架。该框架利用大语言模型来过滤与立场相关的关注者内容，并根据结构信息适应性地调整特征处理方式。这种设计使得通过联合建模语义和关系线索来实现稳健的立场预测成为可能。广泛的实验表明，MRFG在性能上显著优于其他强大的基线方法，这充分说明了相关性过滤和结构化建模的重要性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
