papers.title: Breaking the Impasse: Dual-Scale Evolutionary Policy Training for Social Language Agents
papers.title_zh: 打破僵局：针对社会语言代理的双尺度进化策略训练方法
papers.authors: Minzheng Wang, Run Luo, Yanbo Wang, Zichen Liu, Yuqiao Tan, Tao Tan, Nan Xu, Lu Wang, Wenji Mao
papers.abstract: While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has proven effective for closed-ended tasks, extending it to open-ended social language games via self-play reveals a critical issue: evolution impasse. Due to the vast strategy space, language agents frequently converge to homogenized behaviors, leading to deterministic match outcomes that eliminate the gradient signals necessary for policy evolution. To tackle this issue, we propose Dual-scale Evolutionary Policy Training (DEPT) for social language games. DEPT introduces a time-scaled evolutionary perception mechanism that detects impasse by quantifying dual-scale value baseline divergence alongside match entropy. Upon perceiving the collapse, it then activates asymmetric advantage reshaping to dynamically modulate the optimization landscape for intervention. Thus, our method effectively restores gradient signals and enforces sustained strategic exploration. Extensive experiments on multiple social language games demonstrate that DEPT outperforms strong baselines, avoiding policy degeneration and driving the continuous evolution of social language agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在封闭性任务中表现出有效性，但将其扩展到开放性的社交语言游戏中时却遇到了一个关键问题：进化停滞。由于策略空间极其庞大，语言智能体往往会收敛到相同的行为模式，从而导致匹配结果变得确定性强，从而消除了推动策略进化的梯度信号。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种适用于社交语言游戏的双尺度进化策略训练方法——DEPT。DEPT引入了一种时间分段的进化感知机制，通过量化双尺度价值基线的差异以及匹配熵来检测进化停滞现象。当检测到进化停滞时，该方法会激活非对称优势重塑机制，以动态调节优化环境，从而实现干预。因此，我们的方法能够有效地恢复梯度信号，并促使智能体持续进行策略探索。在多个社交语言游戏上的广泛实验表明，DEPT的表现优于其他强大的基线方法，能够避免策略退化，并促进社交语言智能体的持续进化。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Render-of-Thought: Rendering Textual Chain-of-Thought as Images for Visual Latent Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 思维渲染：将文本式思维链转化为图像形式，以实现视觉上的潜在推理功能
papers.authors: Yifan Wang, Shiyu Li, Peiming Li, Xiaochen Yang, Zheng Wei, Yang Tang
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has achieved remarkable success in unlocking the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). Although CoT prompting enhances reasoning, its verbosity imposes substantial computational overhead. Recent works often focus exclusively on outcome alignment and lack supervision on the intermediate reasoning process. These deficiencies obscure the analyzability of the latent reasoning chain. To address these challenges, we introduce Render-of-Thought (RoT), the first framework to reify the reasoning chain by rendering textual steps into images, making the latent rationale explicit and traceable. Specifically, we leverage the vision encoders of existing Vision Language Models (VLMs) as semantic anchors to align the vision embeddings with the textual space. This design ensures plug-and-play implementation without incurring additional pre-training overhead. Extensive experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves 3-4\times token compression and substantial inference acceleration compared to explicit CoT. Furthermore, it demonstrates a competitive efficiency-accuracy Pareto exploration compared to other methods, validating the feasibility of this paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/TencentBAC/RoT
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链提示在激发大语言模型推理能力方面取得了显著成效。虽然思维链提示能够提升推理能力，但其冗长的提示内容会带来巨大的计算负担。目前的研究往往只关注于结果的匹配问题，而忽略了中间推理过程的监督处理。这些缺陷使得潜在推理链的可分析性受到阻碍。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了思维渲染技术——RoT。该技术通过将文本步骤转化为图像，使潜在的推理过程变得清晰可追踪。具体来说，我们利用现有视觉语言模型的视觉编码器作为语义锚点，将视觉嵌入与文本空间进行对齐。这种设计无需额外的预训练开销，即可实现即插即用式的应用。在数学和逻辑推理方面的实验表明，与传统的思维链提示相比，我们的方法能够实现3-4倍的token压缩效果，并显著提升推理速度。此外，与其他方法相比，我们的技术在效率与准确性之间实现了良好的平衡，证明了这一方法的可行性。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/TencentBAC/RoT获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Legal Judgment Prediction: A Reflection on the State of the Art
papers.title_zh: 法律判决预测：对当前技术水平的反思
papers.authors: Yi Feng, Chuanyi Li, Vincent Ng
papers.abstract: Automatic legal judgment prediction (LJP) has recently received increasing attention in the natural language processing community because of its practical values in the real world. Significant progress has been achieved on LJP in the past decade. However, most existing LJP research primarily focuses on developing methods that achieve better performance on standard evaluation datasets, with limited emphasis on the long-term advancement of the field beyond improving evaluation metrics. In this position paper, we reflect on the state of the art in LJP research, and explore issues that should motivate researchers to think beyond merely enhancing performance metrics, with the ultimate goal of sparking discussions among LJP researchers about the future trajectory of the field.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动法律判断预测技术近年来在自然语言处理领域受到了越来越多的关注，因为它在现实世界中有着重要的应用价值。在过去的十年里，关于自动法律判断预测的研究已经取得了显著的进展。然而，目前大多数相关研究主要致力于开发能够在标准评估数据集上取得更好性能的方法，而对该领域的长期发展则关注较少，没有充分考虑如何超越单纯改进评估指标这一目标。在这篇综述文章中，我们回顾了当前自动法律判断预测研究的最新进展，并探讨了那些能够激励研究人员超越单纯提升性能指标的问题，最终目的是引发自动法律判断预测研究者们对这一领域未来发展的讨论。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GRAD: Generalizing RAG Adaptation with Decoding
papers.title_zh: GRAD：通过解码技术实现RAG适应的泛化
papers.authors: Youngwon Lee, Seung-won Hwang, Zhewei Yao, Yuxiong He
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation needs generation to follow retrieved evidence across shifting domains and prompt layouts, but training a new stronger model per task is costly. To this end, we propose GRAD, an adaptive decoding-time framework that keeps the base generator fixed and composes small, objective-specific guidance at inference. A key advantage of this design is enabling mix and match diverse RAG objectives: model scaling (MS), domain adaptation (DA) and positional debiasing (DB) can be integrated as token-level guidance terms, and new objectives can be easily plugged in. Across public benchmarks and private settings with no in-domain labels, GRAD improves accuracy with favorable latency, offering strong trade-offs versus scaling while reliably activating helpful objectives and suppressing harmful ones, adaptively to tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成需要模型能够在不同的领域和提示布局中根据检索到的信息进行调整，但为每个任务训练一个新的、更强大的模型是非常耗费资源的。为此，我们提出了GRAD这一自适应解码时间框架。该框架固定了基础生成器，并在推理过程中添加针对特定任务的少量指导信息。这种设计的一个关键优势是能够灵活组合多种RAG目标：模型扩展、领域适应和位置去偏见等目标可以作为令牌级指导条件来整合，同时还可以轻松添加新的目标。在公开基准测试以及没有领域标签的私有场景中，GRAD都能在较低的延迟下提升准确率，同时在实现有用目标与抑制有害目标之间实现了良好的权衡，能够自适应地应对不同的任务需求。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SHARP: Self-adaptive Harmful Category-aware Prompt Generation for Black-box Jailbreaking
papers.title_zh: SHARP：一种自适应的、能够识别有害内容的提示生成算法，适用于黑盒越狱操作
papers.authors: Yingjie Xue, Xingyou Xia, Jun Zhang, Yunbo Cao, Dengpan Ye, Guotong Geng, Fei Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely applied in various domains such as education and healthcare, making safety assurance crucial. Jailbreak attacks, a method used in red-teaming, can help evaluate and improve the defensive strategies of LLMs. However, existing jailbreak methods often overlook the semantic differences across categories of harmful questions, leading to inconsistent success rates and reduced overall attack effectiveness. We propose the first category-aware jailbreak framework, SHARP, which incorporates the semantic category of harmful questions into prompt generation. Trained on a verified jailbreak dataset, SHARP enables the model to learn category-specific semantic features and adaptively generate prompts that bypass safety mechanisms. The method combines two-stage LoRA fine-tuning, and DPO-based reinforcement learning to optimize both attack success and category alignment. Experiments show that SHARP significantly improves attack success rates and achieves better cross-category robustness compared to the state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines, providing an efficient and scalable tool for evaluating LLM safety.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在教育和医疗等多个领域得到了广泛应用，因此确保模型的安全性至关重要。越狱攻击是一种用于恶意攻击的方法，可以帮助评估和改进语言模型的防御策略。然而，现有的越狱方法往往忽略了不同类别有害问题的语义差异，导致成功率不稳定且整体攻击效果下降。我们提出了首个考虑类别差异的越狱框架SHARP，该框架将有害问题的语义类别纳入提示生成过程中。通过在经过验证的越狱数据集上进行训练，SHARP能够学习到与类别相关的语义特征，并自适应地生成能够绕过安全机制的提示。该方法结合了两阶段LoRA微调技术和基于DPO的强化学习技术，以优化攻击的成功率和类别匹配度。实验表明，SHARP显著提高了攻击成功率，并且相比现有最先进的基线方法，具有更好的跨类别鲁棒性，为评估语言模型的安全性提供了一种高效且可扩展的工具。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Unveiling the Limits of Large Language Models in Inferring Pragmatic Meaning from Non-Verbal Responses
papers.title_zh: 揭示大型语言模型在从非言语回应中推断语用意义时的局限性
papers.authors: Sugyeong Eo, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable progress in pragmatic language understanding, prior research has focused mainly on their comprehension of verbal behavior. Nonetheless, non-verbal behavior remains a fundamental component of human communication, especially when deliberately utilized in isolation to convey indirect meanings. In this work, we present the first systematic evaluation of LLMs’ ability to infer pragmatic meaning in dialogue consisting solely of non-verbal responses. We explore three research questions: (1) Can LLMs recognize indirect intent conveyed through non-verbal responses? (2) When and how do LLMs fail to capture non-verbal intent? (3) How can we improve LLMs’ ability to interpret non-verbal intent?. Through the evaluation, we observe that LLMs struggle to infer underlying meaning from non-verbal responses, with accuracy dropping by up to 60% points compared to verbal ones. Further extensive analysis reveals a behavioral pattern in LLMs’ interpretations of non-verbal behavior and demonstrates that in-context learning facilitates pragmatic inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在理解实际语言方面取得了显著进展，但以往的研究主要集中在它们对言语行为的理解上。然而，非言语行为仍然是人类交流的基本组成部分，尤其是在被刻意用来传达间接含义时。在这项研究中，我们首次系统地评估了大语言模型在仅由非言语回应构成的对话中推断语用意义的能力。我们探讨了三个研究问题：(1) 大语言模型能否识别通过非言语回应传达的间接意图？(2) 大语言模型何时以及如何无法捕捉到非言语意图？(3) 我们如何提升大语言模型解读非言语意图的能力？通过评估我们发现，大语言模型在从非言语回应中推断出潜在意义方面存在困难，其准确率比从言语回应中推断出的准确率低了高达60%。进一步的深入分析揭示了大语言模型对非言语行为解读的行为模式，并表明上下文学习有助于语用推理。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Does RLVR Extend Reasoning Boundaries? Investigating Capability Expansion in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: RLVR能否扩展推理的边界？探究视觉语言模型的能力拓展可能性
papers.authors: Minghe Shen, Zhuo Zhi, Chonghan Liu, Shuo Xing, Zhengzhong Tu, Che Liu
papers.abstract: Recent studies posit that Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) primarily amplifies behaviors inherent to the pre-training distribution rather than inducing new capabilities, but these insights are predominantly limited to language-only domains, leaving the dynamics of visual-centric spatial reasoning under-explored. To examine the impact of RLVR on the capability boundaries of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), we introduce Ariadne, a controlled framework based on synthetic maze navigation where the reasoning difficulty is precisely regulated by path length and the number of turns. We demonstrate that applying RLVR extends the spatial reasoning boundary, achieving success on problems where the base policy VLM consistently attains 0% accuracy despite increasing pass@k sampling budgets, indicating that the optimized policy successfully navigates search spaces that were effectively unreachable by the base distribution. Furthermore, despite being trained exclusively on synthetic mazes, we evaluate the model on two real-world navigation benchmarks (MapBench and ReasonMap) in a zero-shot setting. The observed improvements in these out-of-domain tasks suggest genuine spatial reasoning capability expansion rather than mere sampling efficiency. Our code is available at: https://github.com/MingheShen/Ariadne
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，带有可验证奖励的强化学习主要增强了预训练过程中固有的行为模式，而不是创造出新的能力。不过，这些研究主要集中在语言领域，对于以视觉为中心的空间推理机制的研究仍然不足。为了探讨RLVR对视觉-语言模型能力边界的影响，我们引入了一个名为Ariadne的框架。该框架基于合成迷宫导航，通过路径长度和转弯次数精确控制推理难度。我们的实验表明，应用RLVR能够扩展空间推理的能力边界，即使在不断增加的采样预算下，基础策略在相关任务上的准确率仍保持在0%，这表明优化后的策略能够成功导航那些原本无法被基础模型处理的搜索空间。此外，尽管该模型仅使用合成迷宫进行训练，但我们仍将其应用于两个真实世界的导航基准测试（MapBench和ReasonMap），并进行了零样本预测。在这些跨领域任务中观察到的改进表明，模型确实具备真正的空间推理能力，而不仅仅是提升了采样效率。我们的代码可以在以下链接下载：https://github.com/MingheShen/Ariadne

papers.title: Perception, Understanding and Reasoning: A Multimodal Benchmark for Video Fake News Detection
papers.title_zh: 感知、理解与推理：用于视频虚假新闻检测的多模态基准方法
papers.authors: Cui Yakun, Peng Qi, Fushuo Huo, Hang Du, Weijie Shi, Juntao Dai, Zhenghao Zhu, Sirui Han
papers.abstract: The advent of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) has greatly advanced research on video fake news detection (VFND) tasks. Existing benchmarks typically focus on the detection accuracy, while failing to provide fine-grained assessments for the entire detection process. To address these limitations, we introduce POVFNDB (Process-oriented Video Fake News Detection Benchmark), a process-oriented benchmark comprising 10 tasks designed to systematically evaluate MLLMs’ perception, understanding, and reasoning capabilities in VFND. This benchmark contains 36,240 human-annotated question-answer (QA) in structured or open-ended formats, spanning 15 distinct evaluation dimensions that characterize different aspects of the video fake news detection process.Using POVFNDB, we conduct comprehensive evaluations on both proprietary and open-source MLLMs. Moreover, We fine-tune Qwen2.5VL-7B-Instruct on a reasoning dataset generated by our proposed POVFND-CoT, a chain-of-thought method that utilizes rationales from evaluation results and rationale validation. The resulting model achieves sota performance on VFND.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型的出现极大地推动了视频虚假新闻检测领域的研究进展。现有的基准测试通常只关注检测准确性，而未能对整个检测过程进行细致评估。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了POVFNDB——一个以流程为导向的基准测试，包含10个任务，旨在系统评估大语言模型在视频虚假新闻检测中的感知、理解和推理能力。该基准测试包含36,240条由人类标注的问答式题目，题目形式包括结构化格式和开放式格式，涵盖了15个不同的评估维度，这些维度分别反映了视频虚假新闻检测过程中的不同方面。通过使用POVFNDB，我们对专有和开源的大语言模型进行了全面评估。此外，我们还利用我们提出的POVFND-CoT方法对Qwen2.5VL-7B-Instruct模型进行了微调，该方法基于评估结果和推理验证来生成推理数据。最终得到的模型在视频虚假新闻检测任务上取得了优异的性能表现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: RV-HATE: Reinforced Multi-Module Voting for Implicit Hate Speech Detection
papers.title_zh: RV-HATE：强化多模块投票算法，用于隐式仇恨言论的检测
papers.authors: Yejin Lee, Hyeseon An, Yo-Sub Han
papers.abstract: Hate speech remains prevalent in human society and continues to evolve in its forms and expressions. Modern advancements in the internet and online anonymity accelerate its rapid spread and complicate its detection. However, hate speech datasets exhibit diverse characteristics primarily because they are constructed from different sources and platforms, each reflecting different linguistic styles and social contexts. Despite this diversity, prior studies on hate speech detection often rely on fixed methodologies without adapting to data-specific features. We introduce RV-HATE, a detection framework designed to account for the dataset-specific characteristics of each hate speech dataset. RV-HATE consists of multiple specialized modules, where each module focuses on distinct linguistic or contextual features of hate speech. The framework employs reinforcement learning to optimize weights that determine the contribution of each module for a given dataset. A voting mechanism then aggregates the module outputs to produce the final decision. RV-HATE offers two primary advantages: (1) it improves detection accuracy by tailoring the detection process to dataset-specific attributes, and (2) it also provides interpretable insights into the distinctive features of each dataset. Consequently, our approach effectively addresses implicit hate speech and achieves superior performance compared to conventional static methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 仇恨言论在人类社会中仍然普遍存在，其形式与表达方式也在不断演变。互联网的发展和在线匿名性的实现加速了仇恨言论的迅速传播，同时也使其检测变得更加复杂。然而，仇恨言论的数据集具有多样性，因为它们来自不同的来源和平台，每个数据集都反映了不同的语言风格和社会背景。尽管存在这种多样性，但以往关于仇恨言论检测的研究往往依赖于固定的方法，而没有根据数据的具体特征进行调整。我们提出了RV-HATE这一检测框架，该框架旨在考虑每个仇恨言论数据集的独特特征。RV-HATE由多个专业模块组成，每个模块专注于仇恨言论的不同语言或上下文特征。该框架采用强化学习技术来优化权重，从而确定每个模块在给定数据集中的贡献程度。然后通过投票机制将各个模块的输出来综合得出最终决策。RV-HATE有两个主要优势：(1) 通过针对数据集特定属性调整检测过程，从而提高检测准确性；(2) 还能提供对每个数据集独特特征的清晰理解。因此，我们的方法能够有效应对隐性仇恨言论，并比传统的静态方法取得更好的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Cross-Prompt Automated Essay Scoring of Multiple Traits: Making Sense of the State of the Art
papers.title_zh: 多特征自动作文评分：理解当前的技术水平
papers.authors: Shengjie Li, Vincent Ng
papers.abstract: Despite the recent progress made in cross-prompt essay scoring, there is little analysis of what makes a state-of-the-art cross-prompt scorer work well. To this end, we present an empirical analysis of how the key components of a cross-prompt scorer interact with each other and impact its overall performance. In addition, we examine for the first time the application of transductive learning to cross-prompt scoring, which represents an important starting point for providing a practical way to improve cross-prompt scorers for use in the rarely-studied classroom setting without the need for additional labeled training data.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在跨提示作文评分方面取得了一些进展，但关于什么因素使得跨提示评分系统能够高效运行的分析却很少。为此，我们进行了实证分析，研究跨提示评分系统的各个关键组件如何相互作用，以及这些因素如何影响系统的整体性能。此外，我们首次探讨了将迁移学习应用于跨提示评分的方法，这为解决如何在缺乏额外标记训练数据的情况下改进跨提示评分系统提供了重要的思路。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: JARVIS or Ultron? A Survey on the Safety and Security Threats of Computer-Using Agents
papers.title_zh: 贾维斯还是奥创？关于使用计算机的程序员面临的安全威胁调查
papers.authors: Ada Chen, Yongjiang Wu, Junyuan Zhang, Jingyu Xiao, Shu Yang, Jen-tse Huang, Kun Wang, Wenxuan Wang, Shuai Wang
papers.abstract: Recently, AI-driven interactions with computing devices have advanced from basic prototype tools to sophisticated, LLM-based systems that emulate human-like operations in graphical user interfaces. We are now witnessing the emergence of Computer-Using Agents (CUAs), capable of autonomously performing tasks such as navigating desktop applications, web pages, and mobile apps. However, as these agents grow in capability, they also introduce novel safety and security risks. Vulnerabilities in LLM-driven reasoning, with the added complexity of integrating multiple software components and multimodal inputs, further complicate the security landscape. In this paper, we present a systematization of knowledge on the safety and security threats of CUAs. We conduct a comprehensive literature review and distill our findings along four research objectives: (i) define the CUA that suits safety analysis; (ii) categorize current safety threats among CUAs; (iii) propose a comprehensive taxonomy of existing defensive strategies; (iv) summarize prevailing benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation metrics used to assess the safety and performance of CUAs. Building on these insights, our work provides future researchers with a structured foundation for exploring unexplored vulnerabilities and offers practitioners actionable guidance in designing and deploying secure Computer-Using Agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，由人工智能驱动的与计算设备的交互已经从基本的原型工具发展到了能够模拟人类操作行为的复杂大语言模型系统。我们现在看到的是“使用计算机的人工智能体”的出现，这些智能体能够自主执行任务，比如导航桌面应用程序、网页以及移动应用。然而，随着这些智能体的能力不断提升，它们也带来了新的安全风险。基于大语言模型的推理机制存在漏洞，再加上需要整合多个软件组件和多模态输入这一复杂性，使得安全形势变得更加复杂。在本文中，我们系统地整理了对使用计算机的人工智能体所面临的安全威胁的相关知识。我们通过全面的文献回顾，从四个研究目标出发来提炼我们的发现：(i) 定义适合进行安全分析的智能体类型；(ii) 对当前使用计算机的人工智能体所面临的安全威胁进行分类；(iii) 提出一套完整的防御策略分类体系；(iv) 总结目前用于评估使用计算机的人工智能体的安全性和性能的标准、数据集以及评估指标。基于这些见解，我们的工作为未来的研究人员提供了探索尚未被发现的漏洞的坚实基础，同时也为实践者提供了设计和部署安全使用计算机的人工智能体的实用指导。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rose-SQL: Role-State Evolution Guided Structured Reasoning for Multi-Turn Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: Rose-SQL：基于角色状态进化的结构化推理方法，适用于多轮文本转SQL处理场景
papers.authors: Le Zhou, Feng Yao, Fengcai Qiao, Bo Xu, Fangyuan Wang, Boyan Xu
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) trained with Long Chain-of-Thought have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in code generation and mathematical reasoning. However, their potential in multi-turn Text-to-SQL tasks remains largely underexplored. Existing approaches typically rely on unstable API-based inference or require expensive fine-tuning on small-scale models. In this work, we present Rose-SQL, a training-free framework that leverages small-scale LRMs through in-context learning to enable accurate context-dependent parsing. We introduce the Role-State, a fine-grained representation that bridges the structural gap between schema linking and SQL generation by serving as a structural blueprint. To handle conversational dependencies, Rose-SQL traces the evolution of Role-State through historical context via structural isomorphism checks, guiding the model to infer the possible SQL composition for the current question through verified interaction trajectories. Experiments on the SParC and CoSQL benchmarks show that, within the Qwen3 series, Rose-SQL outperforms in-context learning baselines at the 4B scale and substantially surpasses state-of-the-art fine-tuned models at the 8B and 14B scales, while showing consistent gains on additional reasoning backbones.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在大型推理模型（LRM）方面的研究进展表明，这些模型在代码生成和数学推理方面具有出色的能力。然而，它们在多轮文本转SQL任务中的潜力仍未被充分探索。现有的方法通常依赖于不稳定的基于API的推理机制，或者需要针对小规模模型进行昂贵的微调。在这项研究中，我们提出了Rose-SQL这一无需训练的框架，该框架通过上下文学习来利用小规模LRM实现准确的上下文依赖解析。我们引入了Role-State这种细粒度表示方式，它作为结构蓝图，填补了模式链接与SQL生成之间的结构空白。为了处理对话中的依赖关系，Rose-SQL通过结构同构检查来追踪Role-State的历史演变，从而引导模型根据验证过的交互轨迹推断出当前问题的可能SQL组合。在SParC和CoSQL基准测试上的实验表明，在Qwen3系列模型中，Rose-SQL在4B规模的数据上优于基于上下文学习的基线方法，并且在8B和14B规模的数据上显著超越了最先进的微调模型。此外，它在其他推理任务上也表现出持续的提升效果。

papers.title: Why Do More Experts Fail? A Theoretical Analysis of Model Merging
papers.title_zh: 为什么更多的专家会失败？模型合并的理论分析
papers.authors: Zijing Wang, Xingle Xu, YongKang Liu, Yiqun Zhang, Peiqin Lin, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Xiaocui Yang, Hinrich Schuetze
papers.abstract: Model merging dramatically reduces storage and computational resources by combining multiple expert models into a single multi-task model. However, existing methods struggle to maintain performance gains as the number of merged models increases. In this paper, we investigate the key obstacles that limit the scalability of model merging. We prove that the limited effective parameter space imposes a strict constraint on the number of models that can be successfully merged. Through Gaussian Width analysis, we show that marginal benefits diminish according to a strictly concave function as more models are merged. Using Approximate Kinematics Theory, we further prove the existence of a unique optimal threshold beyond which additional models yield negligible improvements. To address this limitation, we propose a straightforward Reparameterized Heavy-Tailed method to extend the merged model’s coverage and enhance performance. Empirical results on 19 benchmarks, including both knowledge-intensive and general-purpose tasks, validate our theoretical analysis. We believe that these results spark further research beyond the current scope of model merging.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型合并通过将多个专家模型组合成一个多任务模型，显著减少了存储和计算资源的需求。然而，现有方法在合并的模型数量增加时，难以保持性能提升。在本文中，我们研究了限制模型合并可扩展性的关键障碍。我们证明，有限的有效参数空间对能够成功合并的模型数量提出了严格的限制。通过高斯宽度分析，我们发现随着合并的模型数量增加，边际收益会按照严格凹函数的方式逐渐下降。利用近似运动学理论，我们进一步证明了存在一个唯一的最优阈值，超过这个阈值后，额外的模型所带来的改进效果几乎可以忽略不计。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种简单的重新参数化重尾方法，以扩展合并模型的覆盖范围并提升性能。我们在19个基准测试上的实证结果表明，我们的理论分析是有效的。我们相信，这些结果将激发更多关于模型合并的研究，超越当前的研究范围。

papers.title: Combining Distantly Supervised Models with In Context Learning for Monolingual and Cross-Lingual Relation Extraction
papers.title_zh: 将远程监督模型与上下文学习相结合，用于单语言和跨语言关系提取任务
papers.authors: Vipul Kumar Rathore, Malik Hammad Faisal, Parag Singla, Mausam
papers.abstract: Distantly Supervised Relation Extraction (DSRE) remains a long-standing challenge in NLP, where models must learn from noisy bag-level annotations while making sentence-level predictions. While existing state-of-the-art (SoTA) DSRE models rely on task-specific training, their integration with in-context learning (ICL) using large language models (LLMs) remains underexplored. A key challenge is that the LLM may not learn relation semantics correctly, due to noisy annotation.In response, we propose HYDRE – HYbrid Distantly Supervised Relation Extraction framework. It first uses a trained DSRE model to identify the top-k candidate relations for a given test sentence, then uses a novel dynamic exemplar retrieval strategy that extracts reliable, sentence-level exemplars from training data, which are then provided in LLM prompt for outputting the final relation(s).We further extend HYDRE to cross-lingual settings for RE in low-resource languages. Using available English DSRE training data, we evaluate all methods on English as well as a newly curated benchmark covering four diverse low-resource Indic languages - Oriya, Santali, Manipuri, and Tulu. HYDRE achieves up to 20 F1 point gains in English and, on average, 17 F1 points on Indic languages over prior SoTA DSRE models and naive prompting baselines. Detailed ablations exhibit HYDRE’s efficacy compared to other prompting strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 远程监督关系提取（DSRE）仍然是自然语言处理领域中的一个长期挑战。在模型需要基于噪声的词汇级注释进行句子级预测的情况下，如何有效学习关系语义是一个关键问题。目前最先进的DSRE模型依赖于特定任务的训练方式，而它们与利用大语言模型进行上下文学习的整合方面则尚未得到充分研究。一个主要的问题是，由于注释存在噪声，大语言模型可能无法正确理解关系的语义。为此，我们提出了HYDRE——一种混合式远程监督关系提取框架。该框架首先使用经过训练的DSRE模型来识别给定测试句子中排名前k的关系候选项，然后采用一种新的动态示例检索策略，从训练数据中提取可靠的句子级示例，这些示例随后被用作大语言模型的提示输入，以得出最终的关系结果。我们还扩展了HYDRE，使其适用于低资源语言的跨语言关系提取任务。利用现有的英语DSRE训练数据，我们对所有方法进行了评估，同时还在四种低资源的印度语言上构建了新的基准测试——奥里亚语、桑塔利语、马尼普里语和图卢语。与之前的DSRE模型和简单的提示方法相比，HYDRE在英语上的F1分数提高了20点，而在印度语言上的F1分数平均提高了17点。详细的实验结果表明，HYDRE比其他提示策略更为有效。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Explaining Sources of Uncertainty in Automated Fact-Checking
papers.title_zh: 解释自动化事实核查中存在的不确定性来源
papers.authors: Jingyi Sun, Greta Warren, Irina Shklovski, Isabelle Augenstein
papers.abstract: Human–AI collaboration in knowledge-intensive tasks such as fact-checking requires understanding model uncertainty in multi-document reasoning amid conflicting/agreeing evidence. Yet, existing methods only express uncertainty as numbers or hedges without revealing which evidence conflicts cause the uncertainty, leaving users unable to resolve disagreements. We present CLUE (Conflict- Agreement-aware Language-model Uncertainty Explanations), a plug-and-play white-box framework that, to our knowledge, is the first to generate natural-language explanations of model uncertainty grounded in conflicting/agreeing evidence. CLUE (i) identifies span-level claim–evidence and inter-evidence relations that signal conflict or agreement without supervision, and (ii) uses these relations to steer explanation generation, articulating how they drive the model’s uncertainty. Across three language models and two fact-checking datasets, CLUE produces explanations that more faithfully track model uncertainty and better align with the model’s fact-checking decisions than span-agnostic explanation prompting; human raters also judge them more helpful, more informative, less redundant, and more logically consistent with the input. By explicitly tying uncertainty to evidence conflicts and agreements, CLUE supports practical fact-checking and other tasks that require reasoning over complex, conflicting information.
papers.abstract_zh: 在需要知识密集型任务中的人机协作，比如事实核查，就需要理解模型在多文档推理过程中的不确定性，尤其是在存在冲突或一致的证据情况下。然而，现有的方法只是用数字或模糊表述来表示不确定性，而没有指出是什么证据导致了这种不确定性，这使得用户无法解决这些分歧。我们提出了CLUE（考虑冲突与一致性的语言模型不确定性解释）这一即插即用型白盒框架。据我们所知，这是第一个能够基于冲突或一致的证据生成自然语言解释的系统。CLUE能够识别跨片段的声明-证据关系以及证据之间的相互关系，从而无需监督就能判断出是否存在冲突或一致性。同时，它利用这些关系来指导解释的生成，说明这些因素是如何影响模型的不确定性的。在三个不同的语言模型和两个事实核查数据集上的测试表明，CLUE生成的解释能够更准确地反映模型的不确定性，并且与模型的事实核查决策更加一致。与那些不依赖于片段关系的解释提示相比，CLUE的解释更为有用、信息量更大、冗余度更低，且逻辑上更符合输入数据。通过将不确定性明确地与证据中的冲突和一致性联系起来，CLUE为实际的事实核查以及其他需要处理复杂、冲突信息的任务提供了支持。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: TRACE: A Corpus of Team Creative Discussions
papers.title_zh: TRACE：团队创意讨论的语料库
papers.authors: Yixuan Jiang, Tiancheng Hu, Jose Hernandez-Orallo, David Stillwell, Luning Sun
papers.abstract: Understanding how discussion dynamics shape team creativity has been limited by the difficulty of measuring process at scale. We introduce Trace, a corpus of 309 group discussions from 103 teams (460 participants) across six creative problem-solving tasks. The dataset follows an input-process-output framework, integrating team composition (demographics, personalities), full discussion transcripts, and creativity outcomes. Using sentence embeddings and factor analysis, we identify four interpretable discussion dimensions: Coherence, Exploration, Convergence, and Participation. Analysis reveals a depth-breadth trade-off: coherent idea development inversely relates to semantic exploration. Larger teams explore more broadly but converge less effectively while team diversity shapes participation patterns more than discussion content. Novelty and usefulness in the creativity outcomes follow distinct pathways: Exploration and Convergence predict novelty, whereas Coherence predicts usefulness. These findings ground our understanding of how teams talk their way to creative solutions and provide guidance for designing multiagent systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 要理解讨论动态如何塑造团队创造力，一直存在难以大规模测量过程的难题。我们引入了“Trace”数据集，该数据集包含来自6项创意问题解决任务的103个团队的309次小组讨论记录，共有460名参与者。该数据集遵循输入-过程-输出的框架，整合了团队构成（人口统计信息、性格特征）、完整的讨论记录以及创造成果。通过句子嵌入技术和因子分析，我们确定了四个可解释的讨论维度：一致性、探索性、收敛性和参与度。分析显示存在一个深度与广度的权衡关系：连贯的创意发展与语义探索程度呈负相关。规模较大的团队会进行更广泛的探索，但收敛效果较差；而团队多样性对参与模式的塑造作用大于讨论内容的塑造作用。在创造成果方面，新颖性和实用性有着不同的形成路径：探索性和收敛性可以预测新颖性，而一致性则可以预测实用性。这些发现有助于我们理解团队如何通过对话找到创造性的解决方案，并为设计多智能体系统提供指导。

papers.title: Evaluating Structure-Aware Retrieval and Safety in Statute-Centric Legal QA
papers.title_zh: 评估基于结构的检索方式在法规中心阶段的法律质量保障中的效果
papers.authors: Kyubyung Chae, Jewon Yeom, Jeongjae Park, Seunghyun Bae, Ijun Jang, Hyunbin Jin, Jinkwan Jang, Taesup Kim
papers.abstract: Legal QA benchmarks have predominantly focused on case law, overlooking the unique challenges of statute-centric regulatory reasoning. In statutory domains, relevant evidence is distributed across hierarchically linked documents, creating a statutory retrieval gap where conventional retrievers fail and models often hallucinate under incomplete context. We introduce SearchFireSafety, a structure- and safety-aware benchmark for statute-centric legal QA. Instantiated on fire-safety regulations as a representative case, the benchmark evaluates whether models can retrieve hierarchically fragmented evidence and safely abstain when statutory context is insufficient. SearchFireSafety adopts a dual-track evaluation framework combining real-world questions that require citation-aware retrieval and synthetic partial-context scenarios that stress-test hallucination and refusal behavior. Experiments across multiple large language models show that graph-guided retrieval substantially improves performance, but also reveal a critical safety trade-off: domain-adapted models are more likely to hallucinate when key statutory evidence is missing. Our findings highlight the need for benchmarks that jointly evaluate hierarchical retrieval and model safety in statute-centric regulatory settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 法律问答基准测试主要集中在案例法上，而忽视了以法规为中心的监管推理所面临的独特挑战。在法规领域，相关证据分布在层次结构复杂的文档中，这就导致了传统检索工具无法有效获取信息的情况，而模型在缺乏完整上下文的情况下往往会出现错误推断。我们提出了SearchFireSafety这一针对以法规为中心的法律问答的基准测试框架。该基准测试以消防安全法规为典型案例，评估模型是否能够检索到层次结构复杂的证据，并在法规上下文不足时做出正确的判断。SearchFireSafety采用了双轨制评估框架，既包含需要考虑引用关系的现实问题，也包含用于测试模型错误推断能力的合成部分上下文场景。实验结果表明，基于图的检索方法显著提升了模型的性能，但同时也揭示了一个关键的安全权衡问题：当关键法规证据缺失时，适应性强的模型更容易出现错误推断。我们的研究发现强调了需要建立能够同时评估层次结构检索能力和模型安全性的基准测试框架的必要性。

papers.title: PRISMA: Preference-Reinforced Self-Training Approach for Interpretable Emotionally Intelligent Negotiation Dialogues
papers.title_zh: PRISMA：一种基于偏好强化自训练的方法，用于实现可解释的情感智能谈判对话系统
papers.authors: Prajwal Vijay Kajare, Priyanshu Priya, Bikash Santra, Asif Ekbal
papers.abstract: Emotion plays a pivotal role in shaping negotiation outcomes, influencing trust, cooperation, and long-term relationships. Developing negotiation dialog systems that can recognize and respond strategically to emotions is therefore essential to create more effective human-centered interactions. Beyond generating emotionally appropriate responses, interpretability - understanding how a system generates a particular emotion-aware response, is critical for fostering reliability and building rapport. Driven by these aspects, in this work, we introduce PRISMA, an interpretable emotionally intelligent negotiation dialogue system targeting two application domains, viz. job interviews and resource allocation. To enable interpretability, we propose an Emotion-aware Negotiation Strategy-informed Chain-of-Thought (ENS-CoT) reasoning mechanism, which mimics human negotiation by perceiving, understanding, using, and managing emotions. Leveraging ENS-CoT, we curate two new datasets: JobNego (for job interview negotiation) and ResNego (for resource allocation negotiation). We then leverage these datasets to develop PRISMA by augmenting self-training with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), guiding agents toward more accurate, interpretable, and emotionally appropriate negotiation responses. Automatic and human evaluations on JobNego and ResNego datasets demonstrate that PRISMA substantially enhances the interpretability and generates appropriate emotion-aware responses, while improving overall negotiation effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 情绪在塑造谈判结果中起着至关重要的作用，它影响着信任、合作以及长期关系。因此，开发能够识别并战略性地应对情绪的谈判对话系统，对于打造更有效的以人为中心的互动至关重要。除了产生符合情绪要求的回应之外，系统的可解释性——即理解系统是如何生成特定情绪感知回应的过程——对于提升系统的可靠性和建立良好关系同样重要。基于这些考虑，我们在本文中提出了PRISMA这一可解释的情绪智能谈判对话系统，该系统适用于两个应用场景：工作面试和资源分配。为了实现可解释性，我们提出了一种基于情绪感知的谈判策略引导的推理机制——ENS-CoT。该机制通过感知、理解、运用和管理情绪来模拟人类谈判行为。利用ENS-CoT机制，我们构建了两个新的数据集：JobNego（用于工作面试谈判）和ResNego（用于资源分配谈判）。随后，我们通过结合直接偏好优化技术，进一步增强了PRISMA的自我训练能力，从而引导代理产生更准确、可解释且符合情绪要求的谈判回应。在JobNego和ResNego数据集上的自动和人类评估表明，PRISMA显著提升了系统的可解释性，并产生了恰当的情绪感知回应，同时提高了整体谈判效果。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: SkMTEB: Slovak Massive Text Embedding Benchmark and Model Adaptation
papers.title_zh: SkMTEB：斯洛伐克大规模文本嵌入基准测试及模型适配挑战赛
papers.authors: Marek Suppa, Andrej Ridzik, Daniel Hládek, Natália Kňažeková, Viktória Ondrejová
papers.abstract: We introduce SkMTEB, the first comprehensive MTEB-style text embedding benchmark for Slovak, a low-resource West Slavic language, comprising 31 datasets across 7 task types—nearly 4\times the depth of existing multilingual benchmark coverage for Slovak. Our evaluation of 31 embedding models reveals that large instruction-tuned multilingual models achieve the strongest performance, while existing Slovak-specific models trained for NLU tasks transfer poorly to embedding tasks. To address the need for efficient, locally-deployable Slovak embeddings, we develop e5-sk-small (45M parameters) and e5-sk-large (365M) by applying vocabulary trimming and fine-tuning to Multilingual E5 models. Despite size reductions of up to 62%, our open-source models achieve competitive performance with proprietary APIs while remaining locally deployable for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We release the benchmark, models, datasets, and code openly, hoping our approach offers a replicable path for other under-resourced languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了SkMTEB，这是首个针对斯洛伐克语的综合性MTEB风格文本嵌入基准测试。斯洛伐克语是一种资源匮乏的西斯拉夫语言，我们的测试包含7种任务类型的31个数据集——其深度几乎是现有多语言斯洛伐克语基准测试覆盖范围的4倍。我们对31种嵌入模型的评估结果显示，经过大规模指令调整的多种语言模型表现最为出色，而那些为自然语言处理任务专门训练的现有斯洛伐克语模型在嵌入任务中的表现则较差。为了满足对高效、可本地部署的斯洛伐克语嵌入需求，我们通过对多语言E5模型进行词汇精简和微调，开发了e5-sk-small（45百万参数）和e5-sk-large（3.65亿参数）模型。尽管模型规模减少了62%，但我们的开源模型仍然能够与专有API竞争，同时仍具备用于语义搜索和基于检索增强的生成技术的能力。我们将该基准测试、模型、数据集以及代码公开提供，希望我们的方法能为其他资源匮乏的语言提供一种可复制的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Linguistics-Aware LLM Watermarking via Syntactic Predictability
papers.title_zh: 一种基于句法可预测性的语言学意识LLM水印技术
papers.authors: Shinwoo Park, Hyejin Park, Hyeseon An, Yo-Sub Han
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance rapidly, reliable governance tools have become critical. Publicly verifiable watermarking is particularly essential for fostering a trustworthy AI ecosystem. A central challenge persists: balancing text quality against detection robustness. Recent studies have sought to navigate this trade-off by leveraging signals from model output distributions (e.g., token-level entropy); however, their reliance on these model-specific signals presents a significant barrier to public verification, as the detection process requires access to the logits of the underlying model. We introduce STELA, a novel framework that aligns watermark strength with the linguistic degrees of freedom inherent in language. STELA dynamically modulates the signal using part-of-speech (POS) n-gram–modeled linguistic indeterminacy, weakening it in grammatically constrained contexts to preserve quality and strengthening it in contexts with greater linguistic flexibility to enhance detectability. Our detector operates without access to any model logits, thus facilitating publicly verifiable detection. Through extensive experiments on typologically diverse languages—analytic English, isolating Chinese, and agglutinative Korean—we show that STELA surpasses prior methods in detection robustness. Our code is available at https://github.com/Shinwoo-Park/stela_watermark.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，可靠的治理工具变得至关重要。公开可验证的水印技术对于构建可信的人工智能生态系统尤为重要。一个核心挑战在于：如何在文本质量与检测可靠性之间找到平衡。最近的研究试图通过利用模型输出分布中的信号来应对这一权衡问题（例如，词级熵）；然而，这些依赖特定模型信号的解决方案存在显著障碍，因为检测过程需要访问底层模型的日志项数据。我们提出了STELA这一创新框架，该框架将水印强度与语言中的语言自由度相结合。STELA能够动态调节信号强度，利用词性标注n-gram模型来减弱语法受限上下文中的信号强度，从而保持文本质量；而在语法自由度较高的上下文中，则增强信号强度以提高检测能力。我们的检测器无需访问任何模型日志项数据即可运行，从而实现了公开可验证的检测效果。通过对多种类型语言进行的广泛实验——包括分析型英语、孤立型中文和黏着型韩语——我们发现，STELA在检测可靠性方面优于以往的方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Shinwoo-Park/stela_watermark下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Selective Contrastive Learning For Gloss Free Sign Language Translation
papers.title_zh: 选择性对比学习在无字手势语翻译中的应用
papers.authors: Chang Hao Lai, Rui Zhao, Xuewen Zhong, Jinsong Su, Yidong Chen
papers.abstract: Sign language translation (SLT) converts continuous sign videos into spoken-language text, yet it remains challenging due to the intrinsic modality mismatch between visual signs and written text, particularly in gloss-free settings. Recent SLT systems increasingly adopt CLIP-like Vision-Language pretraining (VLP) for cross-modal alignment, but the random in-batch contrast provides few, batch-dependent negatives and may mislabel semantically similar (or even identical) pairs as negatives, introducing noisy and potentially inconsistent alignment supervision.In this work, we first conduct a preliminary trajectory-based analysis that tracks negative video-text similarity over training. The results show that only a small subset of negatives exhibits the desired behavior of being consistently pushed away, while the remaining negatives display heterogeneous and often non-decreasing similarity dynamics, suggesting that random in-batch negatives are frequently uninformative for effective alignment.Inspired by this, we propose Selective Contrastive Learning for SLT (SCL-SLT) with a Pair Selection (PS) strategy. PS scores candidate negatives using similarity dynamics from reference checkpoints and constructs mini-batches via a curriculum that progressively emphasizes more challenging negatives, thereby strengthening contrastive supervision while reducing the influence of noisy or semantically invalid negatives.
papers.abstract_zh: 手语翻译（SLT）能够将连续的手语视频转换为口语文本，但由于视觉符号与书面文字之间的固有模式不匹配，尤其是在没有注释的情况下，这项任务仍然具有挑战性。最近的SLT系统越来越多地采用类似CLIP的视觉-语言预训练技术来实现跨模态对齐，但随机生成的批次内负例数量有限，且可能会将语义上相似甚至相同的成对样本错误地标记为负例，从而导致对齐监督出现噪声和不一致的问题。在这项研究中，我们首先进行了基于轨迹的初步分析，以追踪训练过程中视频文本之间的负例相似性。结果表明，只有少数负例表现出被持续排除的预期行为，而其余的负例则表现出异质性的、通常呈非递减的相似性动态，这表明随机生成的批次内负例对于有效的对齐来说往往缺乏信息价值。受此启发，我们提出了一种选择性对比学习算法用于SLT，该算法采用了配对选择策略。该策略通过参考点的相似性动态来评估候选负例，并通过逐步强调更具挑战性的负例来构建小批量数据，从而加强对比监督的效果，同时减少噪声或语义无效的负例的影响。

papers.title: SciCustom: A Framework for Custom Evaluation of Scientific Capabilities in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SciCustom：一种用于评估大型语言模型科学能力的框架
papers.authors: Yiyang Gu, Junwei Yang, Junyu Luo, Ye Yuan, Bin Feng, Yingce Xia, Shufang Xie, Kaili Liu, Bohan Wu, Qi Shi, Haoran Li, Beier Xiao, Zhiping Xiao, Xiao Luo, Weizhi Zhang, Philip S. Yu, Zequn Liu, Ming Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to scientific research, yet existing evaluations often fail to reflect the fine-grained capabilities required in practice. Most benchmarks are manually curated or domain-generic, limiting scalability and alignment with real scientific use cases. In this paper, we propose a new framework named SciCustom to address the problem. It enables the custom construction of benchmarks from large-scale scientific data to evaluate application-specific scientific capabilities in LLMs. SciCustom first organizes scientific knowledge into ontology-grounded knowledge units with controlled granularity and trains a tagger to map large-scale data instances into this knowledge space. Given a custom requirement, relevant knowledge units are identified via voting-based multi-model consensus. These units enable relevance-aware benchmark retrieval via binary search, followed by proxy subset selection and data-grounded benchmark generation for efficient evaluation. Experiments in chemistry and healthcare demonstrate that SciCustom reveals fine-grained differences in LLM scientific capabilities that standard benchmarks overlook, while requiring neither expert annotation nor synthetic question generation. This work provides a scalable and application-aware foundation for benchmarking scientific capabilities in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在科学研究中的应用日益广泛，然而现有的评估方法往往无法充分反映实际工作中所需的精细能力。大多数评估基准都是人工构建的，或者具有通用性，这限制了其可扩展性和与真实科学应用场景的匹配度。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为SciCustom的新框架来解决这个问题。该框架能够基于大规模科学数据自定义构建评估基准，从而评估大语言模型在特定科学任务中的能力。SciCustom首先将科学知识组织成以本体为基础的知识单元，这些知识单元的粒度是可控的。然后，系统训练一个标记器，将大规模数据实例映射到这个知识空间中。当遇到特定需求时，可以通过基于投票的多模型共识机制来识别相关的知识单元。这些知识单元通过二进制搜索的方式进行检索，随后通过代理子集选择来生成符合数据特性的评估基准，从而实现高效的评估。在化学和医疗保健领域的实验表明，SciCustom能够揭示标准评估基准所忽视的关于大语言模型能力的细微差异，同时无需专家注释或合成问题生成。这项工作为评估大语言模型的科学能力提供了一个可扩展且注重实际应用的基础框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: NSF-SciFy: Mining the NSF Awards Database for Scientific Claims
papers.title_zh: NSF-SciFy：从NSF奖项数据库中挖掘科学研究成果
papers.authors: Delip Rao, Weiqiu You, Eric Wong, Chris Callison-Burch
papers.abstract: We introduce NSF-SciFy, a comprehensive dataset of scientific claims and investigation proposals extracted from National Science Foundation award abstracts. While previous scientific claim verification datasets have been limited in size and scope, NSF-SciFy represents a significant advance with 2.8 million claims from 400,000 abstracts spanning all science and mathematics disciplines. We present two focused subsets: NSF-SciFy-MatSci with 114,000 claims from materials science awards, and NSF-SciFy-20K with 135,000 claims across five NSF directorates. Using zero-shot prompting, we develop a scalable approach for joint extraction of scientific claims and investigation proposals. We demonstrate the dataset’s utility through three downstream tasks: non-technical abstract generation, claim extraction, and investigation proposal extraction. Fine-tuning language models on our dataset yields substantial improvements, with relative gains often exceeding 100%, particularly for claim and proposal extraction tasks. Our error analysis reveals that extracted claims exhibit high precision but lower recall, suggesting opportunities for further methodological refinement. NSF-SciFy enables new research directions in large-scale claim verification, scientific discovery tracking, and meta-scientific analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了NSF-SciFy这一综合性数据集，该数据集包含了从美国国家科学基金会奖项摘要中提取出的科学主张和调查提案信息。虽然之前用于验证科学主张的数据集在规模和范围上都有所限制，但NSF-SciFy则取得了显著的进步——该数据集包含280万条主张信息，这些主张来自40万个摘要，涵盖了所有科学和数学领域。我们进一步划分了两个子数据集：NSF-SciFy-MatSci，包含来自材料科学领域的11.4万条主张信息；以及NSF-SciFy-20K，包含来自美国国家科学基金会五个部门内的13.5万条主张信息。通过零样本提示技术，我们开发了一种可扩展的方法，能够同时提取科学主张和调查提案信息。我们通过三项下游任务验证了该数据集的实用性：非技术性摘要生成、主张提取以及调查提案提取。在我们的数据集上进行语言模型微调后，性能得到了显著提升，尤其是在主张和提案提取任务中，相对提升幅度常常超过100%。我们的错误分析表明，所提取的主张具有较高的精确度，但召回率较低，这为我们进一步改进研究方法提供了机会。NSF-SciFy为大规模主张验证、科学发现跟踪以及元科学分析提供了新的研究方向。

papers.title: Learning Invariant Modality Representation for Robust Multimodal Learning from a Causal Inference Perspective
papers.title_zh: 从因果推理的角度学习不变模态表示，以实现稳健的多模态学习
papers.authors: Sijie Mai, Shiqin Han
papers.abstract: Multimodal affective computing aims to predict humans’ sentiment, emotion, intention, and opinion using language, acoustic, and visual modalities. However, current models often learn spurious correlations that harm generalization under distribution shifts or noisy modalities. To address this, we propose a causal modality-invariant representation (CmIR) learning framework for robust multimodal learning. At its core, we introduce a theoretically grounded disentanglement method that separates each modality into ‘causal invariant representation’ and ‘environment-specific spurious representation’ from a causal inference perspective. CmIR ensures that the learned invariant representations retain stable predictive relationships with labels across different environments while preserving sufficient information from the raw inputs via invariance constraint, mutual information constraint, and reconstruction constraint. Experiments across multiple multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that CmIR achieves state-of-the-art performance. CmIR particularly excels on out-of-distribution data and noisy data, confirming its robustness and generalizability.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态情感计算旨在利用语言、声学和视觉等多种方式来预测人类的情感、情绪、意图和观点。然而，当前的模型常常会学习到一些虚假的相关性，这些相关性会在分布发生变化或数据存在噪声时影响模型的泛化能力。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种因果模态不变表示学习框架（CmIR），以实现稳健的多模态学习。其核心思想是一种理论上有根据的解耦方法，该方法从因果推断的角度将每种模态分解为“因果不变表示”和“环境特定的虚假表示”。CmIR能够确保学习到的不变表示在不同环境下仍能保持与标签的稳定预测关系，同时通过不变性约束、互信息约束和重构约束保留了来自原始输入的足够信息。在多个多模态基准测试中的实验表明，CmIR取得了领先的性能表现。特别是在非分布数据和噪声数据的情况下，CmIR表现出色的鲁棒性和泛化能力得到了验证。

papers.title: Multi-Task Representation Alignment on Language Understanding: A Mutual Information Perspective
papers.title_zh: 语言理解中的多任务表示对齐：从互信息角度入手的方法
papers.authors: Dou Hu, Lingwei Wei, Hongjiang Xiao, Songlin Hu, Yuan Zhang
papers.abstract: Multi-task learning (MTL) enables joint learning over multiple tasks based on shared representations, but suffers from task interference issue during optimization. Existing works mainly focus on task balancing or probabilistic modeling but fail to address the issue since they struggle to learn sufficient representations for all target tasks. To address this, we propose a multi-task representation alignment (MTRA) framework to achieve task-specific alignment and self-alignment on the shared representations from a mutual information perspective. MTRA ensures that the learned representations contain task-relevant features while mitigating the negative effects of task-irrelevant features. First, we design a task-specific alignment objective to align the shared representations and task-specific representations with the expected targets of all tasks via information maximization. Besides, we design a self-alignment objective to eliminate task-irrelevant features via conditional information minimization. Experiments on two multi-task language benchmarks show that MTRA outperforms 13 representative MTL methods under the same settings, particularly under label-noisy and data-constrained conditions. Further analysis shows that the learned shared representations exhibit sufficient task informativeness and superior alignment properties.
papers.abstract_zh: 多任务学习（MTL）能够基于共享的表示进行多项任务的联合学习，但在优化过程中存在任务干扰问题。现有的研究主要集中在任务平衡或概率建模上，但未能有效解决这一问题，因为它们在为所有目标任务学习足够的表示方面存在困难。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种多任务表示对齐框架（MTRA），该框架从互信息的角度实现特定任务的对齐以及共享表示的自我对齐。MTRA确保学习到的表示包含与任务相关的特征，同时减轻与任务无关特征的负面影响。首先，我们设计了一个特定任务对齐目标，通过信息最大化来使共享表示与所有任务的预期目标保持一致。此外，我们还设计了一个自我对齐目标，通过条件信息最小化来消除与任务无关的特征。在两个多任务语言基准测试上的实验表明，在相同条件下，MTRA的表现优于13种代表性的MTL方法，尤其是在标签噪声较大和数据受限的情况下。进一步分析显示，学习到的共享表示具有足够的任务信息性和卓越的对齐性能。

papers.title: EconProver: Towards More Economical Test-Time Scaling for Automated Theorem Proving
papers.title_zh: EconProver：实现更经济的自动定理证明测试时间调整方法
papers.authors: Mukai Li, Linfeng Song, Zhenwen Liang, Jiahao Xu, Shansan Gong, Qi Liu, Haitao Mi, Dong Yu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently advanced the field of Automated Theorem Proving (ATP), attaining substantial performance gains through widely adopted test-time scaling strategies, notably reflective Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and increased sampling passes. However, they both introduce significant computational overhead for inference. Moreover, existing cost analyses typically regulate only the number of sampling passes, while neglecting the substantial disparities in sampling costs introduced by different scaling strategies. In this paper, we systematically compare the efficiency of different test-time scaling strategies for ATP models and demonstrate the inefficiency of the current state-of-the-art (SOTA) open-source approaches. We then investigate approaches to significantly reduce token usage and sample passes while maintaining the original performance. Specifically, we propose two complementary methods that can be integrated into a unified EconRL pipeline for amplified benefits: (1) a dynamic Chain-of-Thought (CoT) switching mechanism designed to mitigate unnecessary token consumption, and (2) Diverse parallel-scaled reinforcement learning (RL) with trainable prefixes to enhance pass rates under constrained sampling passes. Experiments on miniF2F and ProofNet demonstrate that our EconProver-GD achieves comparable performance to baseline methods with only 12% of the computational cost. This work provides actionable insights for deploying lightweight ATP models without sacrificing performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）最近在自动定理证明领域取得了显著进展，通过广泛采用的测试时间扩展策略，如反射式思维链推理和增加采样次数，实现了性能的巨大提升。然而，这些模型在推理过程中会引入巨大的计算开销。此外，现有的成本分析通常只关注采样次数的多少，而忽略了不同扩展策略所带来的采样成本差异。在本文中，我们系统地比较了不同测试时间扩展策略在ATP模型中的效率，并证明了当前最先进的开源方法的低效性。随后，我们探讨了在保持原有性能的前提下，大幅减少令牌使用量和采样次数的方法。具体来说，我们提出了两种互补的方法，可以将它们整合到一个统一的EconRL流程中，以获得更好的效果：(1) 一种动态的思维链切换机制，旨在避免不必要的令牌消耗；(2) 采用可训练前缀的多样化并行强化学习算法，以在有限的采样次数下提高成功率。在miniF2F和ProofNet上的实验表明，我们的EconProver-GD在仅占用12%的计算资源的情况下，达到了与基准方法相当的性能水平。这项工作为在不牺牲性能的情况下部署轻量级ATP模型提供了可行的思路。

papers.title: Thinking-Based Non-Thinking: Solving the Reward Hacking Problem in Training Hybrid Reasoning Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 基于思考的非思考：通过强化学习解决混合推理模型训练中的奖励优化问题
papers.authors: Siyuan Gan, Jiaheng Liu, Boyan Wang, Tianpei Yang, Runqing Miao, Yuyao Zhang, Fanyu Meng, Junlan Feng, Linjian Meng, Jing Huo, Yang Gao
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have attracted much attention due to their exceptional performance. However, their performance mainly stems from thinking, a long Chain of Thought (CoT), which significantly increase computational overhead. To address this overthinking problem, existing work focuses on using reinforcement learning (RL) to train hybrid reasoning models that automatically decide whether to engage in thinking or not based on the complexity of the query. Unfortunately, using RL will suffer the the reward hacking problem, e.g., the model engages in thinking but is judged as not doing so, resulting in incorrect rewards.To mitigate this problem, existing works either employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which incurs high computational costs, or enforce uniform token limits on non-thinking responses, which yields limited mitigation of the problem.In this paper, we propose Thinking-Based Non-Thinking (TNT). It does not employ SFT, and sets different maximum token usage for responses not using thinking across various queries by leveraging information from the solution component of the responses using thinking. Experiments on five mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that TNT reduces token usage by around 50\\%$ compared to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B and DeepScaleR-1.5B, while significantly improving accuracy. In fact, TNT achieves the optimal trade-off between accuracy and efficiency among all tested methods. Additionally, the probability of reward hacking problem in TNT’s responses, which are classified as not using thinking, remains below $10\\%$ across all tested datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型因其卓越的性能而受到广泛关注。然而，它们的性能主要依赖于思维过程，即长链思维过程，这大大增加了计算开销。为了解决过度思考的问题，现有研究倾向于使用强化学习来训练混合推理模型，这些模型能够根据查询的复杂性自动决定是否进行思考。不幸的是，使用强化学习会导致奖励操纵问题，例如，模型虽然进行了思考，但被判断为没有思考，从而导致错误的奖励分配。为了缓解这个问题，现有方法要么采用有监督的微调技术，这会带来较高的计算成本；要么对非思考响应实施统一的令牌限制，但这只能在一定程度上解决问题。在本文中，我们提出了基于思考的非思考策略。该策略不采用有监督的微调技术，而是通过利用使用思考的响应的解决方案信息，为不同查询中的非思考响应设定不同的最大令牌使用量。在五个数学基准测试上的实验表明，与DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B和DeepScaleR-1.5B相比，TNT能够将令牌使用量减少约50%，同时显著提高了准确性。实际上，在所有测试方法中，TNT在准确性和效率之间实现了最优的平衡。此外，在被分类为非思考的响应中，奖励操纵问题的概率在所有测试数据集中都低于10%。

papers.title: LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems for Clinical Workflows: A Survey of AI Hospitals
papers.title_zh: 基于机器学习算法的多智能体系统在临床工作流程中的应用：人工智能医院领域的综述
papers.authors: Zonghai Yao, Hong yu
papers.abstract: This survey reviews LLM-based multi-agent systems for clinical and healthcare workflows, including diagnosis, triage, consultation, discharge, mental health, and EHR-linked decision support. We define AI hospitals as workflow-level clinical systems in which agents take explicit roles, hand off shared state, use EHR- or guideline-grounded tools, and operate with safety gates and audit-ready logs. We argue that these systems should be compared at the workflow level, rather than only by model components or end-task accuracy, because clinical action, evidence, and accountability are expressed through state transitions and handoffs. We organize the literature through a workflow-level taxonomy covering roles and handoffs, memory and evidence, tools, and reasoning, control, and escalation. We further synthesize major workflow settings and task families, introduce a four-layer evaluation stack spanning safety, process, outcome, and operations, and connect model capabilities to workflow observables relevant to deployment. Finally, we present Integration Readiness Levels (IRL1-IRL6), task-level instrumentation requirements, and recurring workflow failure modes as a practical framework for comparing, evaluating, and deploying clinical LLM agents and AI hospitals.
papers.abstract_zh: 本调查探讨了基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在临床和医疗工作流程中的应用，包括诊断、分类、咨询、出院、心理健康以及与电子健康记录相关的决策支持。我们将人工智能医院定义为一种工作流层面的临床系统，在这种系统中，智能体承担明确角色，共享状态信息，使用基于电子健康记录或指南的工具，并采用安全机制以及易于审计的日志记录。我们认为，这些系统应该在工作流层面进行比较，而不是仅通过模型组件或最终任务准确性来评判，因为临床行动、证据和问责制都是通过状态转换和信息传递来实现的。我们按照工作流层面的分类体系对相关文献进行了整理，涵盖了角色与信息传递、记忆与证据、工具使用以及推理、控制与升级等方面。此外，我们还总结了主要的工作流程场景和任务类型，引入了一个涵盖安全性、流程、结果和运营四个层面的评估框架，并将模型能力与与部署相关的流程可观测指标联系起来。最后，我们提出了集成准备等级（IRL1至IRL6）、任务级别的工具需求以及常见的流程故障模式，以此作为比较、评估和实施临床大语言模型智能体及人工智能医院的实用框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mind’s Eye: A Benchmark of Visual Abstraction, Transformation and Composition for Multimodal LLMs
papers.title_zh: 《心灵之眼》：多模态大型语言模型在视觉抽象、转换与组合方面的标杆
papers.authors: Rohit Sinha, Aditya Sanjiv Kanade, Sai Srinivas Kancheti, Vineeth N. Balasubramanian, Tanuja Ganu
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive progress on vision language benchmarks, yet their capacity for cognitive and psychological reasoning remains largely unexplored. We introduce Mind’s Eye, a multiple-choice benchmark of eight visuo-cognitive tasks inspired by classic human intelligence tests and organized under a novel A–R–T taxonomy: Abstraction, Relation, and Transformation. The tasks probe core processes of fluid intelligence such as pattern induction, analogical Relation mapping, and mental Transformation. We evaluate a diverse suite of closed-source and open-source MLLMs and compare their performance with human participants. Humans achieve 80% accuracy, while top performing MLLMs remain below 50%. Error analysis reveals failures in (i) visual attention allocation, (ii) internal perceptual manipulation, (iii) over reliance on domain priors, and (iv) weak abstraction of underlying visual concepts. Our findings suggest that current MLLMs exhibit limited fluid reasoning and visuo-cognitive integration compared with human participants, highlighting the need for cognitively grounded evaluation frameworks like Mind’s Eye.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在视觉语言基准测试中取得了显著进展，然而它们在认知和心理推理方面的能力仍未被充分探索。我们提出了“Mind’s Eye”这一多选择测试框架，该框架包含八个视觉认知任务，这些任务借鉴了经典的人类智力测试，并按照“抽象、关系、转换”的新分类方式进行组织。这些任务涵盖了流体智力的核心过程，如模式归纳、类比关系映射以及心理转换等。我们对多种开源和闭源的大语言模型进行了评估，并比较了它们的表现与人类参与者的成绩。人类的表现达到了80%的准确率，而表现最好的大语言模型准确率则低于50%。错误分析显示，这些模型在以下几个方面存在不足：(i) 视觉注意力分配问题；(ii) 内部感知处理问题；(iii) 过度依赖领域先验知识；(iv) 对底层视觉概念的理解能力不足。我们的研究结果表明，当前的大语言模型在流体推理能力和视觉认知整合方面与人类参与者相比存在明显差距，这凸显了需要像“Mind’s Eye”这样的基于认知的评估框架来改进模型性能。

papers.title: EverMemOS: A Self-Organizing Memory Operating System for Structured Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.title_zh: EverMemOS：一种用于结构化长期推理的自组织记忆操作系统
papers.authors: Chuanrui Hu, Xingze Gao, Zuyi Zhou, Dannong Xu, Yi Bai, Xintong Li, Hui Zhang, Tong Li, Chong Zhang, Lidong Bing, Yafeng Deng
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as long-term interactive agents, yet their limited context windows make it difficult to sustain coherent behavior over extended interactions. Existing memory systems for LLMs often store isolated records and retrieve fragments, limiting their ability to consolidate evolving experience and resolve conflicts. We introduce EverMemOS, a self-organizing memory operating system that implements an engram-inspired lifecycle for computational memory. First, Episodic Trace Formation converts dialogue streams into MemCells that capture episodic traces, atomic facts, and time-bounded foresight. Second, Semantic Consolidation organizes MemCells into thematic MemScenes, distilling stable semantic structures and updating user profiles. Finally, Reconstructive Recollection performs MemScene-guided agentic retrieval to compose the necessary and sufficient context for downstream reasoning. Experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and PersonaMem-v2 show that EverMemOS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on memory-augmented reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作长期交互式智能体，然而其有限的上下文窗口使得在长时间交互中维持连贯的行为变得困难。现有的LLM记忆系统通常只存储孤立的记录并检索片段，这限制了它们整合不断变化的经验和解决冲突的能力。我们提出了EverMemOS这一自组织记忆操作系统，它实现了一种受记忆体启发的计算记忆生命周期机制。首先，情景轨迹生成功能将对话流转化为记忆单元，这些记忆单元能够捕捉情景性痕迹、基本事实以及有时间限制的预见能力。其次，语义整合功能将记忆单元组织成主题性的记忆场景，从而提炼出稳定的语义结构并更新用户档案。最后，重构记忆功能则通过以记忆场景为引导的智能体检索方式，为后续推理提供必要且充分的上下文。在LoCoMo、LongMemEval和PersonaMem-v2上的实验表明，EverMemOS在增强记忆功能的推理任务上显著优于现有最先进的方法。

papers.title: Interpretable Coreference Resolution Evaluation Using Explicit Semantics
papers.title_zh: 基于显式语义的可解释指称共存解决评估方法
papers.authors: Bruno Gatti, Giuliano Martinelli, Roberto Navigli
papers.abstract: Coreference resolution is typically evaluated using aggregate statistical metrics such as CoNLL-F1, which measure structural overlap between predicted and gold clusters. While widely used, these metrics offer limited diagnostic insights, penalizing errors without revealing whether a system struggles with specific semantic categories, such as people, locations, or events, and making it difficult to interpret model capabilities or derive actionable improvements. We address this gap by introducing a semantically-enhanced evaluation framework for coreference resolution. Our approach overlays Concept and Named Entity Recognition (CNER) onto coreference outputs, assigning semantic labels to nominal mentions and propagating them to entire coreference clusters. This enables the computation of typed scores aimed at evaluating mention extraction and linking capabilities stratified by semantic class. Across our experiments on OntoNotes, LitBank, and PreCo, we show that our framework uncovers systematic weaknesses that remain obscured by aggregate metrics. Furthermore, we show that these diagnostics can be used to design targeted, low-cost data augmentation strategies, achieving measurable out-of-domain improvements.
papers.abstract_zh: 共指消解通常是通过综合统计指标来评估的，例如CoNLL-F1指标，该指标用于衡量预测结果与真实数据之间的结构重叠程度。虽然这些指标被广泛使用，但它们提供的诊断信息有限，无法揭示系统在处理特定语义类别时的弱点，比如人物、地点或事件。此外，这些指标也难以解释模型的能力或提出可行的改进方案。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种语义增强的共指消解评估框架。我们的方法将概念识别与命名实体识别技术应用到共指结果上，为名义化提及分配语义标签，并将这些标签传播到整个共指集群中。这样就能计算出不同类型的评分，从而评估按语义类别划分的提及提取和链接能力。在我们对OntoNotes、LitBank和PreCo数据集进行的实验中，我们发现我们的框架能够发现那些被综合指标掩盖的系统性问题。此外，我们还发现这些诊断结果可以用来设计有针对性的、低成本的数据增强策略，从而实现可测量的领域外性能提升。

papers.title: SURE or Not? Investigating Semantic Understanding in Dense Retrieval Models
papers.title_zh: 确定还是不确定？探究密集检索模型中的语义理解机制
papers.authors: Lingdi Kong, Xuanang Chen, Ben He, Le Sun
papers.abstract: Dense retrieval has become a core technique in applications like web search and retrieval-augmented generation. Despite their empirical success, it remains unclear whether these models truly understand semantics. To address this gap, this paper conducts a systematic investigation by introducing SURE, a benchmark for Semantic Understanding in dense REtrieval built upon the MSMARCO, NQ, and FiQA datasets. SURE characterizes semantic understanding in dense retrieval along three dimensions: semantic precision, semantic abstraction, and semantic equivalence. We evaluate ten representative models ranging from 110M to 8B parameters, including both general-purpose and domain-specific models. Results show that current dense retrievers struggle to distinguish fine-grained semantic differences across texts with varying information density, and to recognize semantic consistency under lexical paraphrasing. Moreover, larger models do not necessarily exhibit stronger semantic understanding, and diverse training data generally enhances semantic understanding on challenging retrieval tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 密集检索已成为诸如网络搜索和基于检索增强生成等应用中的核心技术。尽管这些模型在实证上取得了成功，但人们仍然不清楚它们是否真正理解了语义。为了填补这一空白，本文通过引入SURE这一基于MSMARCO、NQ和FiQA数据集构建的密集检索语义理解基准测试，对这一现象进行了系统的研究。SURE从三个维度来评价密集检索中的语义理解能力：语义精确性、语义抽象度以及语义等价性。我们评估了十种代表性模型，这些模型的参数数量从1.1亿到80亿不等，其中包括通用模型和特定领域的模型。结果表明，当前的密集检索模型在区分不同信息密度文本之间的细微语义差异方面存在困难，并且在词汇释义的情况下也难以识别语义一致性。此外，较大的模型并不一定表现出更强的语义理解能力，而多样化的训练数据通常能提升在具有挑战性的检索任务上的语义理解能力。

papers.title: When High Accuracy Hides Poor Calibration: Rethinking Confidence Evaluation in Transformer-Based Text Classification with Balanced Brier Score
papers.title_zh: 当高精度模型出现校准偏差时：重新思考基于Transformer的文本分类中的置信度评估问题——以平衡布里尔分数作为衡量标准
papers.authors: Guilherme Fonseca, Gabriel Prenassi, Washington Cunha, Leonardo Chaves Dutra da Rocha, Marcos André Gonçalves
papers.abstract: Transformer-based Small (SLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong effectiveness in text classification (TC), yet deployment requires reliable confidence estimates. Although miscalibration in Transformers has been reported, evidence for TC under fine-tuning remains limited. We evaluate the calibration of fine-tuned SLMs and LLMs against Logistic Regression, a classical, well-calibrated baseline, and find that, despite superior effectiveness, Transformers remain markedly overconfident. Crucially, we show that widely used calibration metrics, such as Expected Calibration Error and Brier Score, become biased in high-effectiveness regimes, where the dominance of correct predictions masks severe miscalibration on errors, sometimes even suggesting better calibration than Logistic Regression, a well-known calibrated method. To address this limitation, we propose the Balanced Brier Score (BBS), which balances the contribution of correct and incorrect predictions within confidence bins. BBS reveals substantially poorer calibration in both SLMs and LLMs, consistent with qualitative evidence from calibration curves. These findings challenge current calibration assessment practices and provide a more reliable alternative for evaluating confidence quality in Transformer-based TC.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于Transformer的小型语言模型（SLMs）和大语言模型（LLMs）在文本分类任务中表现出强大的效果，但其在部署时需要可靠的置信度估计。尽管已经报道了Transformer模型在校准方面的误差问题，但在微调阶段对文本分类的校准效果仍然缺乏足够的证据支持。我们评估了经过微调的SLMs和LLMs与逻辑回归之间的校准效果——逻辑回归是一种经过良好校准的经典基线方法。研究发现，尽管这些模型在效果上更优，但它们的置信度估计仍然过高。关键的是，我们发现一些常用的校准指标，如预期校准误差和布里尔分数，在高效果的场景中会出现偏差，因为正确的预测占据了主导地位，而错误的预测则被忽视了。有时，这些模型的校准效果甚至优于逻辑回归这种经过良好校准的方法。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了平衡布里尔分数（BBS）这一指标，它能够平衡正确和错误预测的贡献。实验结果显示，SLMs和LLMs的校准效果都相当差，这与校准曲线的定性分析结果一致。这些发现挑战了当前的校准评估方法，并为评估基于Transformer的文本分类模型的置信度质量提供了更可靠的替代方案。

papers.title: Doc-V^*: Coarse-to-Fine Interactive Visual Reasoning for Multi-Page Document VQA
papers.title_zh: Doc-V^*：用于多页文档的从粗到细的交互式视觉推理技术 VQA
papers.authors: Yuanlei Zheng, Pei Fu, Hang Li, Ziyang Wang, Yuyi Zhang, Wenyu Ruan, Xiaojin Zhang, Zhongyu Wei, Zhenbo Luo, Jian Luan, Wei Chen, Xiang Bai
papers.abstract: Multi-page Document Visual Question Answering requires reasoning over semantics, layouts, and visual elements in long, visually dense documents. Existing OCR-free methods face a trade-off between capacity and precision: end-to-end models scale poorly with document length, while visual retrieval-based pipelines are brittle and passive. We propose Doc-V^*, an OCR-free agentic framework that casts multi-page DocVQA as sequential evidence aggregation. Doc-V^* begins with a thumbnail overview, then actively navigates via semantic retrieval and targeted page fetching, and aggregates evidence in a structured working memory for grounded reasoning. Trained by imitation learning from expert trajectories and further optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization, Doc-V^* balances answer accuracy with evidence-seeking efficiency. Across five benchmarks, Doc-V^* outperforms open-source baselines and approaches proprietary models, improving out-of-domain performance by up to 47.9% over RAG baseline. Other results reveal effective evidence aggregation with selective attention, not increased input pages.
papers.abstract_zh: 多页文档视觉问答任务需要处理长文本中的语义、布局以及视觉元素。现有的无需OCR的方法在准确性和处理能力之间面临着权衡：端到端模型在处理长文档时表现不佳，而基于视觉检索的方案则容易出现缺陷且效率低下。我们提出了Doc-V*这一无需OCR的智能框架，它将多页文档视觉问答任务视为一系列证据的汇总过程。Doc-V*首先通过缩略图概览开始处理，然后通过语义检索和针对性页面提取来主动导航，并将证据汇总到结构化的工作记忆中，以便进行推理。通过从专家行为中学习并采用群体相对策略优化技术，Doc-V*能够在保证答案准确性的同时，提高证据检索的效率。在五个基准测试中，Doc-V*均优于开源基线模型，并且在专有模型面前也表现出色，其跨领域性能比RAG基线模型提升了47.9%。其他结果表明，Doc-V*通过选择性注意力机制实现了有效的证据汇总，而无需增加输入页面的数量。

papers.title: Privacy-R1: Privacy-Aware Multi-LLM Agent Collaboration via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 隐私保护-R1：通过强化学习实现具有隐私意识的多大型语言模型协作代理
papers.authors: Zheng Hui, Yijiang River Dong, Sanhanat Sivapiromrat, Ehsan Shareghi, Nigel Collier
papers.abstract: When users submit queries to Large Language Models (LLMs), their prompts can often contain sensitive data, forcing a difficult choice: Send the query to a powerful proprietary LLM providers to achieving state-of-the-art performance and risk data exposure, or relying on smaller, local models guarantees data privacy but often results in a degradation of task performance. Prior approaches have relied on static pipelines that use LLM rewriting, which shatters linguistic coherence and indiscriminately removes privacy-sensitive information, including task-critical content. We reformulate this challenge (Privacy-Conscious Delegation) as a sequential decision-making problem and introduce a novel reinforcement learning (RL) framework called Privacy-R1 to solve it. Our framework trains an agent to dynamically route text chunks, learning a policy that optimally balances the trade-off between privacy leakage and task performance. It implicitly distinguishes between replaceable Personally Identifiable Information (PII) (which it shields locally) and task-critical PII (which it strategically sends to the remote model for maximal utility). To validate our approach in complex scenarios, we also introduce a new medical dataset with high PII density. Our framework achieves a new state-of-the-art on the privacy-utility frontier, demonstrating the necessity of learned, adaptive policies for deploying LLMs in sensitive environments. Dataset can be found at: https://github.com/zackhuiiiii/Privacy-R1.
papers.abstract_zh: 当用户向大语言模型提交查询时，他们的提示信息中往往包含敏感数据，这给开发者带来了艰难的选择：要么将查询发送给那些能够提供卓越性能的强大专有语言模型提供商，从而面临数据泄露的风险；要么选择使用规模较小的本地模型，虽然能确保数据隐私，但可能会降低模型的任务处理能力。以往的方法依赖于静态的管道流程，这些流程通过语言模型的重写功能来处理查询，但这种方式会破坏语言的连贯性，并且会无差别地删除包含隐私敏感信息的部分内容，包括对任务至关重要的信息。我们将这一挑战重新定义为一个序列决策问题，并引入了一种名为Privacy-R1的新强化学习框架来解决这个问题。我们的框架训练出一个智能体，它能够动态地处理文本片段，从而制定出一种能够最佳平衡隐私泄露与任务处理能力的策略。该框架能够区分可替换的个人身份信息（这些信息会在本地得到保护）和对任务至关重要的个人身份信息（这些信息会被策略性地发送到远程模型中，以实现最大化的效用）。为了验证我们的方法在复杂场景下的有效性，我们还引入了一个新的医学数据集，该数据集包含了大量包含隐私敏感信息的样本。我们的框架在隐私与效用之间取得了新的最优解，这表明在敏感环境中使用语言模型时，需要采用经过学习的、自适应性的策略。该数据集可以在以下链接找到：https://github.com/zackhuiiiii/Privacy-R1。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion LLMs via Energy-Based Gibbs Alignment
papers.title_zh: 基于能量基吉布斯对齐的扩散型大型语言模型的强化学习
papers.authors: Yijia Fan, Jing Yang, Mingyu Liu, Kaitong Cai, Jian Wang, Keze Wang, Jusheng Zhang
papers.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising non-autoregressive paradigm for text generation, offering parallel decoding and bidirectional context modeling. However, aligning dLLMs with reinforcement learning (RL) remains a significant challenge, as the marginal likelihood of sequences in masked diffusion is typically intractable, rendering standard policy gradient methods unstable or computationally prohibitive. In this work, we propose Diffusion-Gibbs Alignment (DGA), a novel variational framework that reformulates RL for dLLMs as a distribution matching problem. DGA bypasses the explicit computation of log-probabilities by leveraging a learned energy function to model the relative quality of samples. The optimization is decoupled into two stable steps: (1) contrastive energy ranking to capture global reward structures, and (2) weighted diffusion alignment to update the policy via importance sampling. Empirically, DGA establishes a new state-of-the-art across logical reasoning (Sudoku, Countdown), mathematical reasoning (GSM8K, Math500), and code generation (HumanEval, MBPP) benchmarks. DGA offers a novel variational perspective for dLLM alignment, achieving better performance while simultaneously enhancing training speed and memory efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）作为一种有前景的非自回归文本生成范式而崭露头角，它具备并行解码和双向上下文建模的能力。然而，将dLLMs与强化学习（RL）进行对齐仍然是一个重大挑战，因为掩码扩散中序列的边际概率通常难以处理，这导致标准的策略梯度方法变得不稳定或计算成本高昂。在这项研究中，我们提出了扩散-吉布斯对齐算法（DGA），这是一种创新的变分框架，它将dLLms的RL问题重新表述为分布匹配问题。DGA通过利用学习到的能量函数来模拟样本的相对质量，从而避免了显式计算对数概率的繁琐过程。优化过程分为两个稳定步骤：（1）对比能量排序，以捕捉全局奖励结构；（2）加权扩散对齐，通过重要性采样来更新策略。从实验结果来看，DGA在逻辑推理（如数独、倒计时）、数学推理（如GSM8K、Math500）以及代码生成（如HumanEval、MBPP）等基准测试中取得了领先成绩。DGA为dLLm对齐提供了一种新的变分视角，不仅提升了性能，还显著提高了训练速度和内存效率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
