papers.title: CxMP: A Linguistic Minimal-Pair Benchmark for Evaluating Constructional Understanding in Language Models
papers.title_zh: CxMP：一种用于评估语言模型构造理解能力的语言最小对基准测试
papers.authors: Miyu Oba, Saku Sugawara
papers.abstract: Understanding language acquisition in language models remains an open question, yet many benchmarks focus on grammatical acceptability, with far less attention to interpreting meanings conveyed by grammatical forms.We introduce the Linguistic Minimal-Pair Benchmark for Evaluating Constructional Understanding in Language Models (CxMP), grounded in Construction Grammar, which treats form–meaning pairings (constructions) as fundamental linguistic units.It evaluates whether models interpret the semantic information implied by constructions, using a controlled minimal-pairs across nine types.Our results show that constructional understanding develops more gradually and remains limited for some constructions even in large language models (LLMs), whereas performance on grammatical acceptability emerges earlier, with shallow heuristics in CxMP exhibiting a U-shaped pattern.These findings highlight the need to broaden existing linguistic evaluations to capture meanings encoded in linguistic form.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解语言模型中的语言习得仍然是一个未解的问题。然而，许多评估标准都集中在语法可接受性上，而对语法形式所传达的意义的理解却很少关注。我们提出了“语言最小对基准测试”，用于评估语言模型中的构造性理解能力。该测试基于构造语法理论，将形式-意义配对视为基本的语言单位。它通过九种类型的最小对来评估模型是否能够解读这些构造所蕴含的语义信息。我们的研究结果表明，即使是在大语言模型中，构造性理解的发展也是渐进式的，而且某些构造的理解能力仍然有限。而语法可接受性的评估则发展得更快，在CxMP测试中，浅层的启发式方法呈现出U形模式。这些发现强调了需要扩展现有的语言评估方式，以捕捉语言中编码的意义。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evaluating Temporal Consistency in Multi-Turn Language Models
papers.title_zh: 评估多轮语言模型的时间一致性问题
papers.authors: Yash Kumar Atri, Steven L. Johnson, Thomas Hartvigsen
papers.abstract: Language models are increasingly deployed in interactive settings where users reason about facts over time rather than in isolation.In such scenarios, correct behavior requires models to maintain and update implicit temporal assumptions established earlier in a conversation. We study this challenge through the lens of temporal scope stability: the ability to preserve, override, or transfer time-scoped factual context across dialogue turns. We introduce ChronoScope, a large-scale diagnostic benchmark designed to isolate temporal scope behavior in controlled multi-turn interactions, comprising over one million deterministically generated question chains grounded in Wikidata. ChronoScope evaluates whether models can correctly retain inferred temporal scope when follow-up questions omit explicit time references, spanning implicit carryover, explicit scope switching, cross-entity transfer, and longer temporal trajectories.Through extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art language models, we find that temporal scope stability is frequently violated in controlled multi-turn settings, with models often drifting toward present-day assumptions despite correct underlying knowledge.These failures intensify with interaction length and persist even under oracle context conditions, revealing a gap between single-turn factual accuracy and coherent temporal reasoning under sequential interaction.We make our dataset and evaluation suite publicly available at https://github.com/yashkumaratri/ChronoScope.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型越来越多地被应用于交互式场景中，用户需要基于时间来推理事实，而不是孤立地考虑。在这种情境下，正确的行为要求模型能够维护并更新在对话中建立起来的隐式时间假设。我们通过时间范围稳定性这一视角来研究这一挑战：即能否在对话中保留、覆盖或转移时间范围上的事实背景。我们引入了ChronoScope这一大规模诊断基准测试，旨在在受控的多轮交互中分离出时间范围行为。该测试包含超过一百万个基于Wikidata生成的确定性问题链。ChronoScope评估了模型在后续问题未提及明确时间参考时，是否能够正确保留所推断出的时间范围信息，包括隐式延续、显式范围切换、跨实体转移以及更长时间轴的情况。通过对最先进的语言模型进行广泛评估，我们发现，在受控的多轮交互中，时间范围稳定性常常被违反，尽管模型拥有正确的基础知识，但它们往往会趋向于当前的假设。这种失败现象随着交互时间的延长而加剧，并且在理想条件下仍然存在，这表明在单轮交互中的事实准确性与连续交互下的连贯时间推理之间存在差距。我们的数据集和评估工具已公开提供，网址为https://github.com/yashkumaratri/ChronoScope。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Synthia: Scalable Grounded Persona Generation from Social Media Data
papers.title_zh: Synthia：能够从社交媒体数据中生成可扩展的虚拟角色方案
papers.authors: Vahid Rahimzadeh, Erfan Moosavi Monazzah, Mohammad Taher Pilehvar, Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh
papers.abstract: Persona-driven simulations are increasingly used in computational social science, yet their validity critically depends on the fidelity of the underlying personas. Constructing virtual populations that are both authentic and scalable remains a central challenge. We introduce Synthia, a persona-generation framework that grounds LLM-generated personas in real social-media posts while delegating narrative construction to language models, using publicly available data from the Bluesky platform. Across multiple social-survey benchmarks, Synthia improves alignment with human opinion distributions over prior state-of-the-art approaches while relying on substantially smaller models. A multi-dimensional fairness and bias analysis shows that Synthia outperforms previous methods for most demographics across different dimensions. Uniquely, Synthia preserves interaction-graph structure among personas grounded in real social network users, enabling network-aware analysis, which we demonstrate through two homophily-focused case studies. Together, these results position Synthia as a practical and reliable framework for constructing scalable, high-fidelity, and equitable virtual populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 以人物为核心的模拟方法在计算社会科学领域得到了广泛应用，但其有效性在很大程度上取决于所构建人物的真实性。创建既真实又具有可扩展性的虚拟人群仍然是一个核心挑战。我们提出了Synthia这一人物生成框架，该框架利用LLM生成的人物形象作为基础，同时将叙事构建任务委托给语言模型来完成，并使用了Bluesky平台公开可用的数据。在多个社会调查基准测试中，Synthia在保持与人类意见分布一致性的方面优于以往的最先进方法，同时所使用的模型规模也大幅减小。多维的公平性和偏见分析表明，Synthia在大多数人口统计维度上均优于其他方法。独特的是，Synthia能够保留基于真实社交网络用户生成的人物之间的互动关系，从而实现基于网络的深入分析。我们通过两个以同性恋群体为中心的案例研究证明了这一点。总体而言，这些成果使得Synthia成为构建可扩展、高保真且公平的虚拟人群的实用且可靠的框架。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Recognition to Reasoning: Benchmarking and Enhancing MLLMs on Real-World Receipt Document Understanding
papers.title_zh: 从识别到推理：在真实场景下的收据文档理解——基于模型的对话系统性能评估与优化
papers.authors: Yandi Wang, Libin Zhan, Ziwei Huang, Tiancheng Luo, Yuxuan Jiang, Wang Dong, Leilei Gan, Jun Chen
papers.abstract: Extracting structured information from visual documents (Visual Information Extraction, VIE) is a cornerstone of business automation. While recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promising capabilities, existing benchmarks suffer from critical limitations in scale and realism, lack semantic granularity, and fail to cover diverse document types. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReceiptBench, a large-scale, human-annotated benchmark consisting of 10k diverse receipts, organizing information extraction into four hierarchical sub-tasks: (1) Basic Perception for raw text spotting, (2) Format Normalization for strictly following standardization instructions, (3) Semantic Reasoning for inferring implicit attributes from context, and (4) Structure Parsing for handling nested line items. Furthermore, we propose a two-stage training framework incorporating Metric-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which translates rigorous evaluation constraints into reinforcement learning signals to enhance structural consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method yields state-of-the-art performance, surpassing leading proprietary models on complex reasoning tasks. We release our datasets and code at https://github.com/wwwT0ri/ReceiptBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 从视觉文档中提取结构化信息（视觉信息提取，VIE）是商业自动化的核心技术。虽然最近的多模态大语言模型在性能上表现出色，但现有的基准测试存在严重的局限性：规模有限、真实性不足、语义层次不够清晰，且无法涵盖多种类型的文档。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了ReceiptBench——一个大规模、由人类标注的基准测试集，包含10千份多样化的收据。该测试集将信息提取任务分解为四个层次性的子任务：(1) 对原始文本进行基本识别；(2) 按照标准格式进行格式化处理；(3) 通过语义推理从上下文中推断出隐含属性；(4) 处理嵌套的行项。此外，我们提出了一种两阶段训练框架，该框架结合了基于度量的组相对策略优化算法，将严格的评估约束转化为强化学习信号，从而提升结构的一致性。大量实验表明，我们的方法取得了领先的性能表现，在复杂推理任务上超越了主流专有模型。我们的数据集和代码可以在https://github.com/wwwT0ri/ReceiptBench下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LogicEval: A Systematic Framework for Evaluating Automated Repair Techniques for Logical Vulnerabilities in Real-World Software
papers.title_zh: LogicEval：一种系统化的框架，用于评估自动化修复技术在现实世界软件中处理逻辑漏洞的能力
papers.authors: Syed Md Mukit Rashid, Abdullah Al Ishtiaq, Kai Tu, Yilu Dong, Tianwei Wu, Ali Ranjbar, Tianchang Yang, Najrin Sultana, Shagufta Mehnaz, Syed Rafiul Hussain
papers.abstract: Logical vulnerabilities in software stem from flaws in program logic rather than memory safety, which can lead to critical security failures. Although existing automated program-repair techniques primarily focus on repairing memory-corruption vulnerabilities, they struggle with logical vulnerabilities because of their limited semantic understanding of the vulnerable code and its expected behavior. On the other hand, recent successes of large language models (LLMs) in understanding and repairing code are promising. However, no framework currently exists to analyze the capabilities and limitations of such techniques for logical vulnerabilities. We aim to systematically evaluate both traditional and LLM-based repair approaches for addressing real-world logical vulnerabilities. To facilitate our assessment, we created the first-ever dataset, LogicDS, comprising 122 logical vulnerabilities that reflect tangible security impact. We also developed a systematic framework, LogicEval, to evaluate patches for logical vulnerabilities. Evaluations suggest that compilation and testing failures are primarily driven by prompt sensitivity, loss of code context, and difficulty in patch localization.
papers.abstract_zh: 软件中的逻辑漏洞源于程序逻辑上的缺陷，而非内存安全性问题。这些问题可能导致严重的安全漏洞。虽然现有的自动化程序修复技术主要专注于修复因内存损坏导致的漏洞，但它们在处理逻辑漏洞时却面临困难，因为它们对易受攻击的代码及其预期行为的理解有限。另一方面，大语言模型在理解和修复代码方面的能力已经取得了显著进展。不过，目前还没有任何框架可以用来分析这些技术在处理逻辑漏洞时的能力和局限性。我们的目标是系统地评估传统方法和基于大语言模型的修复方法在解决现实世界逻辑漏洞方面的效果。为了便于评估，我们创建了首个数据集“LogicDS”，该数据集包含122个具有实际安全影响的逻辑漏洞。我们还开发了一个名为“LogicEval”的系统化框架，用于评估针对这些逻辑漏洞的修复方案。评估结果显示，编译和测试过程中的失败主要源于提示的敏感性、代码上下文的丢失以及修复定位的困难。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mind the Pause: Disfluency-Aware Objective Tuning for Multilingual Speech Correction with LLMs
papers.title_zh: 注意停顿问题：针对多语言语音校正的目标调整方法，以利用语言模型处理语速不整齐的情况
papers.authors: Deepak Kumar, Baban Gain, Asif Ekbal
papers.abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) transcripts often contain disfluencies, such as fillers, repetitions, and false starts, which reduce readability and hinder downstream applications like chatbots and voice assistants. If left unaddressed, such disfluencies can significantly degrade the reliability of downstream systems. Most existing approaches rely on classical models that focus on identifying disfluent tokens for removal. While this strategy is effective to some extent, it often disrupts grammatical structure and semantic coherence, leading to incomplete or unnatural sentences. Recent literature explored the use of large language models (LLMs); however, these efforts have primarily focused on disfluency detection or data augmentation, rather than performing comprehensive correction. We propose a multilingual correction pipeline where a sequence tagger first marks disfluent tokens, and these signals guide instruction fine-tuning of an LLM to rewrite transcripts into fluent text. To further improve reliability, we add a contrastive learning objective that penalizes the reproduction of disfluent tokens, encouraging the model to preserve grammar and meaning while removing disfluent artifacts. Our experiments across three Indian languages, namely Hindi, Bengali, and Marathi show consistent improvements over strong baselines, including multilingual sequence-to-sequence models. These results highlight that detection-only strategies are insufficient. Combining token-level cues with instruction tuning and contrastive learning provides a practical and scalable solution for multilingual disfluency correction in speech-driven NLP systems. We make the codes publicly available at https://github.com/deepak-kumar-98/Mind-the-Pause.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动语音识别系统生成的文本通常包含许多不流畅的片段，比如填充词、重复语句以及错误的开头部分。这些不流畅的片段会降低文本的可读性，并阻碍后续应用的发展，例如聊天机器人和声纹助手。如果不加以处理，这些不流畅的片段会严重降低下游系统的可靠性。目前大多数方法都依赖于传统的模型来识别并去除这些不流畅的片段。虽然这种策略在某种程度上是有效的，但它往往会破坏句子的语法结构和语义连贯性，导致句子不完整或不自然。最近的研究开始使用大语言模型来处理这类问题，但这些研究主要集中在检测不流畅的片段或数据增强上，而没有进行全面的修正。我们提出了一种多语言修正流程：首先使用序列标注器标记出不流畅的片段，然后利用这些标记来指导大语言模型的微调，从而将文本改写为流畅的文本。为了进一步提高可靠性，我们加入了对比学习的目标，该目标会对再现不流畅的片段进行惩罚，从而促使模型在去除不流畅片段的同时，保持句子的语法和语义完整性。我们在三种印度语言——印地语、孟加拉语和马拉地语上的实验表明，我们的方法比强大的基线模型有更好的效果。这些结果表明，仅依赖检测策略是不够的。将令牌级别的提示与指令调整以及对比学习相结合，可以为语音驱动的自然语言处理系统提供实用且可扩展的多语言不流畅片段修正方案。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/deepak-kumar-98/Mind-the-Pause网站上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BioTool: A Comprehensive Tool-Calling Dataset for Enhancing Biomedical Capabilities of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: BioTool：一个全面的工具调用数据集，旨在提升大型语言模型在生物医学领域的能力
papers.authors: Xin Gao, Ruiyi Zhang, Meixi Du, Peijia Qin, Pengtao Xie
papers.abstract: Despite the success of large language models (LLMs) on general-purpose tasks, their performance in highly specialized domains such as biomedicine remains unsatisfactory. A key limitation is the inability of LLMs to effectively leverage biomedical tools, which clinical experts and biomedical researchers rely on extensively in daily workflows. While recent general-domain tool-calling datasets have substantially improved the capabilities of LLM agents, existing efforts in the biomedical domain largely rely on in-context learning and restrict models to a small set of tools. To address this gap, we introduce BioTool, a comprehensive biomedical tool-calling dataset designed for fine-tuning LLMs. BioTool comprises 34 frequently used tools collected from the NCBI, Ensembl, and UniProt databases, along with 7,040 high-quality, human-verified query–API call pairs spanning variation, genomics, proteomics, evolution, and general biology. Fine-tuning a 4-billion-parameter LLM on BioTool yields substantial improvements in biomedical tool-calling performance, outperforming cutting-edge commercial LLMs such as GPT-5.1. Furthermore, human expert evaluations demonstrate that integrating a BioTool-fine-tuned tool caller significantly improves downstream answer quality compared to the same LLM without tool usage, highlighting the effectiveness of BioTool in enhancing the biomedical capabilities of LLMs. The full dataset and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/gxx27/BioTool.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在通用任务上取得了成功，但在生物医学这样高度专业化的领域，它们的表现仍然不尽如人意。一个主要限制是，大语言模型无法有效利用生物医学工具，而这些工具正是临床专家和生物医学研究人员在日常工作中广泛依赖的工具。虽然最近针对通用领域的工具调用数据集显著提升了大语言模型的能力，但现有的生物医学领域研究大多依赖于上下文学习，并且模型只能使用有限数量的工具。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了BioTool——一个专为微调大语言模型而设计的综合性生物医学工具调用数据集。BioTool包含来自NCBI、Ensembl和UniProt数据库的34种常用工具，以及7,040对经过人类验证的高质量查询-应用程序接口调用对，这些调用涉及变异学、基因组学、蛋白质组学、进化论以及一般生物学等领域。在BioTool上进行4亿参数的大语言模型微调后，其在生物医学工具调用方面的性能得到了显著提升，其表现甚至优于GPT-5.1等先进的商业语言模型。此外，人类专家的评估表明，使用经过BioTool微调的工具调用模型能够显著提高后续回答的质量，这充分证明了BioTool在提升大语言模型生物医学能力方面的有效性。完整的数据集和评估代码可访问https://github.com/gxx27/BioTool。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: COMPASS: A Framework for Evaluating Organization-Specific Policy Alignment in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 《指南》：一种用于评估大型语言模型所采纳的政策与组织特定需求是否一致的框架
papers.authors: Dasol Choi, DongGeon Lee, Brigitta Jesica Kartono, Helena Berndt, Taeyoun Kwon, Joonwon Jang, Haon Park, Hwanjo Yu, Minsuk Kahng
papers.abstract: As large language models are deployed in high-stakes enterprise applications, from healthcare to finance, ensuring adherence to organization-specific policies has become essential. Yet existing safety evaluations focus exclusively on universal harms. We present COMPASS (Company/Organization Policy Alignment Assessment), the first systematic framework for evaluating whether LLMs comply with organizational allowlist and denylist policies. We apply COMPASS to eight diverse industry scenarios, generating and validating 5,920 queries that test both routine compliance and adversarial robustness through strategically designed edge cases. Evaluating seven state-of-the-art models, we uncover a fundamental asymmetry: models reliably handle legitimate requests (>95% accuracy) but catastrophically fail at enforcing prohibitions, refusing only 13–40% of adversarial denylist violations. These results demonstrate that current LLMs lack the robustness required for policy-critical deployments, establishing COMPASS as an essential evaluation framework for organizational AI safety.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型被广泛应用于从医疗到金融等高风险企业应用中，确保符合各组织的特定政策变得至关重要。然而，现有的安全评估通常只关注普遍性的危害问题。我们提出了COMPASS（公司/组织政策合规性评估），这是首个用于评估大语言模型是否遵守组织允许列表和禁止列表政策的系统框架。我们将COMPASS应用于八个不同的行业场景，生成并验证了5,920个查询，这些查询通过精心设计的边缘案例来测试常规合规性以及对抗性鲁棒性。通过对七种最先进的模型进行评估，我们发现了一个根本性的不对称现象：这些模型能够可靠地处理合法请求（准确率超过95%），但在执行禁令时却表现极差，只有13%到40%的对抗性违规被有效阻止。这些结果表明，当前的大语言模型在政策关键型应用中的鲁棒性不足，因此COMPASS成为评估组织人工智能安全性的重要工具。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Paper2Rebuttal: A Multi-Agent Framework for Transparent Author Response Assistance
papers.title_zh: 论文2反驳：一种用于透明化作者回复辅助的多智能体框架
papers.authors: Qianli Ma, Chang Guo, Zhiheng Tian, Siyu Wang, Jipeng Xiao, Yuanhao Yue, Zhipeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Writing effective rebuttals is a high-stakes task that demands more than linguistic fluency, as it requires precise alignment between reviewer intent and manuscript details. Current solutions typically treat this as a direct-to-text generation problem, suffering from hallucination, overlooked critiques, and a lack of verifiable grounding. To address these limitations, we introduce RebuttalAgent, the first multi-agents framework that reframes rebuttal generation as an evidence-centric planning task. Our system decomposes complex feedback into atomic concerns and dynamically constructs hybrid contexts by synthesizing compressed summaries with high-fidelity text while integrating an autonomous and on-demand external search module to resolve concerns requiring outside literature. By generating an inspectable response plan before drafting, RebuttalAgent ensures that every argument is explicitly anchored in internal or external evidence. We validate our approach on the proposed RebuttalBench and demonstrate that our pipeline outperforms strong baselines in coverage, faithfulness, and strategic coherence, offering a transparent and controllable assistant for the peer review process. Code will be released.
papers.abstract_zh: 撰写有效的反驳意见是一项高风险任务，它不仅仅需要语言上的流畅性，还需要 reviewer 的意图与手稿内容之间实现精准的匹配。目前的解决方案通常将这一任务视为一种直接生成文本的问题，这会导致幻觉现象、被忽视的批评意见以及缺乏可验证的依据。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了 RebuttalAgent 这一多智能体框架，它将反驳意见的生成重新定义为一项以证据为中心的规划任务。我们的系统能够将复杂的反馈分解为具体的关注点，并通过合成高保真度的文本来动态构建混合上下文，同时集成了一个自主的、可按需调用的外部搜索模块，以解决需要外部文献支持的问题。通过在起草之前生成可检查的响应计划，RebuttalAgent 确保每一个论点都基于内部或外部的证据得到明确支持。我们在提出的 RebuttalBench 上验证了我们的方法，并证明我们的流程在覆盖范围、忠实度以及策略连贯性方面均优于强大的基线算法，为同行评审过程提供了一个透明且可控的辅助工具。代码即将发布。

papers.title: Data Efficient RLVR via Off-Policy Influence Guidance
papers.title_zh: 通过非策略性影响引导实现高效的数据处理与强化学习
papers.authors: Erle Zhu, Dazhi Jiang, Yuan Wang, Xujun Li, Jiale Cheng, Yuxian Gu, Yilin Niu, Aohan Zeng, Jie Tang, Minlie Huang, Hongning Wang
papers.abstract: Data selection is a critical aspect of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Current data selection methods are largely heuristic-based, lacking theoretical guarantees and generalizability. This work proposes a theoretically-grounded approach using influence functions to estimate the contribution of each data point to the learning objective. To overcome the prohibitive computational cost of policy rollouts required for online influence estimation, we introduce an off-policy influence estimation method that efficiently approximates data influence using pre-collected offline trajectories. Furthermore, to manage the high-dimensional gradients of LLMs, we employ sparse random projection to reduce dimensionality and improve storage and computation efficiency. Leveraging these techniques, we develop Curriculum RL with Off-Policy Influence guidance (CROPI), a multi-stage RL framework that iteratively selects the most influential data for the current policy. Experiments on models up to 7B parameters demonstrate that CROPI significantly accelerates training. On a 1.5B model, it achieves a 2.66x step-level acceleration while using only 10% of the data per stage compared to full-dataset training. Our results highlight the substantial potential of influence-based data selection for efficient RLVR.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据选择是带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中一个至关重要的环节，它有助于提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。目前的数据选择方法大多基于启发式算法，缺乏理论上的保证和通用性。本研究提出了一种基于理论指导的方法，利用影响函数来估算每个数据点对学习目标的贡献。为了克服在线影响估计所需的策略展开计算成本过高的问题，我们提出了一种非策略影响估计方法，该方法能够利用预先收集的离线轨迹来高效近似数据的影响程度。此外，为了处理LLM的高维梯度问题，我们采用了稀疏随机投影技术来降低维度，从而提高存储和计算效率。通过这些技术，我们开发了基于非策略影响的课程强化学习框架（CROPI），该框架采用多阶段策略，逐步选择对当前策略最有影响力的数据。在参数达到70亿的模型上进行的实验表明，CROPI显著加速了训练过程。在一个有15亿参数的模型中，与全数据集训练相比，仅使用每阶段10%的数据，就能实现2.66倍的训练加速。我们的研究结果凸显了基于影响的数据选择在高效RLVR中的巨大潜力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CEBC: Conformal Evidence-Bounded Control for Low-Hallucination Vision–Language Generation
papers.title_zh: CEBC：用于低幻觉水平视觉-语言生成的符合性证据约束控制方法
papers.authors: Ashish Mishra, Tarun Kumar, Arpit Shah, Suparna Bhattacharya, Martin Foltin
papers.abstract: Hallucinated object mentions remain a persistent failure mode of vision–language models (VLMs) across generation tasks such as image captioning and visual question answering: outputs may be fluent yet include entities not supported by visual evidence. Existing mitigation approaches often reduce hallucinations at the cost of degraded generation quality or require expensive retraining and task-specific supervision. We introduce CEBC, a lightweight, training-free framework for low-hallucination vision–language generation based on conformal evidence-bounded minimal editing. CEBC first produces a strong base output (via greedy decoding or best-of-K sampling), then applies an evidence-bounded editing step that minimally revises or suppresses unsupported object mentions using constraints derived from an external visual detector. Crucially, the evidence threshold is conformally calibrated on a small held-out set via quantiles of detector confidence scores, enabling explicit and controllable hallucination risk at test time.To balance factuality and informativeness, we further introduce a risk-first, quality-aware selection rule that prioritizes evidence-consistent generations while regularizing unnecessary length or lexical drift. Extensive experiments on MS-COCO and GQA for image captioning, and POPE for VQA evaluation across multiple VLMs demonstrate that CEBC consistently reduces hallucination rates(CHAIR_S, CHAIR_I, POPE) while maintaining or improving standard generation quality metrics (CIDEr, BLEU, CLIPScore). CEBC establishes a stronger factuality–quality Pareto frontier without any additional model training or access to paired supervision beyond an off-the-shelf detector.
papers.abstract_zh: 在图像描述任务和视觉问题回答等生成任务中，幻觉对象的提及仍然是一个持续存在的缺陷——模型的输出可能很流畅，但却包含了一些没有视觉证据支持的对象信息。现有的缓解方法通常会在牺牲生成质量或需要昂贵的重新训练以及特定任务的监督的情况下来减少幻觉现象。我们提出了CEBC这一轻量级、无需训练的框架，它基于符合性证据限制的最小编辑技术，用于降低幻觉现象。CEBC首先生成一个基础输出（通过贪婪解码或K近邻采样得到），然后应用一种证据限制编辑步骤，该步骤会利用外部视觉检测器得出的约束条件，对不支持的对象信息进行最小程度的修改或抑制。关键的是，证据阈值是通过对检测器置信度分数的分位数进行量化处理，在少量保留的数据集上进行的符合性校准，从而能够在测试时明确且可控地控制幻觉风险。为了平衡事实性与信息量，我们还引入了一种以风险为先、注重质量的选择规则，该规则优先选择符合证据的生成结果，同时规范不必要的长度变化或词汇漂移。在MS-COCO和GQA的图像描述任务以及POPE的视觉问题回答任务上的广泛实验表明，CEBC能够持续降低幻觉率，同时保持或提升标准生成质量指标（如CIDEr、BLEU、CLIPScore）。CEBC在不增加额外模型训练或依赖现成检测器的情况下，就实现了事实性与质量之间的优化平衡。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Dual Alignment Between Language Model Layers and Human Sentence Processing
papers.title_zh: 语言模型层与人类句子处理之间的双重对齐机制
papers.authors: Tatsuki Kuribayashi, Alex Warstadt, Yohei Oseki, Ethan Gotlieb Wilcox
papers.abstract: A recent study (CITATION) has shown that human sentence processing behavior, typically measured on syntactically unchallenging constructions, can be effectively modeled using surprisal from early layers of large language models (LLMs). This raises the question of whether such advantages of internal layers extend to more syntactically challenging constructions, where surprisal has been reported to underestimate human cognitive effort.In this paper, we begin by exploring internal layers that better estimate human cognitive effort observed in syntactic ambiguity processing in English.Our experiments show that, in contrast to naturalistic reading, later layers better estimate such a cognitive effort, but still underestimate the human data. This dual alignment sheds light on different modes of sentence processing in humans and LMs: naturalistic reading employs a somewhat weak prediction akin to earlier layers of LMs, while syntactically challenging processing requires more fully-contextualized representations, better modeled by later layers of LMs.Motivated by these findings, we also explore several probability-update measures using shallow and deep layers of LMs, showing a complementary advantage to single-layer’s surprisal in reading time modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 一项最新的研究（引用来源）表明，人类句子处理行为，通常针对语法结构简单的情况进行测量，可以通过大语言模型早期层的惊讶度来有效建模。这引发了这样一个问题：这种内部层的优势是否也适用于语法结构更为复杂的句子，因为在那些情况下，惊讶度往往低估了人类的认知努力。在本文中，我们首先探讨了那些能更好地估计英语中语法歧义处理过程中人类认知努力的内部层。我们的实验表明，与自然阅读相比，后期层能够更准确地估计这种认知努力，但仍然低估了人类数据中的实际值。这种双重对齐现象揭示了人类和大语言模型在句子处理方面的不同模式：自然阅读采用类似于大语言模型早期层的较弱预测方式，而语法结构复杂的处理则需要更全面的上下文化表示，这一点更适合由大语言模型的后期层来建模。基于这些发现，我们还研究了使用浅层和深层层的大语言模型进行概率更新的几种方法，结果表明，这些方法在读取时间建模方面具有与单层惊讶度互补的优势。

papers.title: Rethinking Composed Image Retrieval Evaluation: A Fine-Grained Benchmark from Image Editing
papers.title_zh: 重新思考合成图像的检索评估方法：来自图像编辑领域的详细基准测试
papers.authors: Tingyu Song, Yanzhao Zhang, Mingxin Li, Zhuoning Guo, Dingkun Long, Pengjun Xie, Siyue Zhang, Yilun Zhao, Shu Wu
papers.abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is a pivotal and complex task in multimodal understanding. Current CIR benchmarks typically feature limited query categories and fail to capture the diverse requirements of real-world scenarios. To bridge this evaluation gap, we leverage image editing to achieve precise control over modification types and content, enabling a pipeline for synthesizing queries across a broad spectrum of categories. Using this pipeline, we construct EDIR, a novel fine-grained CIR benchmark. EDIR encompasses 5,000 high-quality queries structured across five main categories and fifteen subcategories. Our comprehensive evaluation of 13 multimodal embedding models reveals a significant capability gap; even state-of-the-art models (e.g., RzenEmbed and GME) struggle to perform consistently across all subcategories, highlighting the rigorous nature of our benchmark. Through comparative analysis, we further uncover inherent limitations in existing benchmarks, such as modality biases and insufficient categorical coverage. Furthermore, an in-domain training experiment demonstrates the feasibility of our benchmark. This experiment clarifies the task challenges by distinguishing between categories that are solvable with targeted data and those that expose intrinsic limitations of current model architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 复合图像检索（Composed Image Retrieval，CIR）是多模态理解中一项至关重要且复杂的任务。目前的CIR基准测试通常只包含有限的查询类别，无法充分满足现实场景中多样化的需求。为了弥补这一评估上的不足，我们采用图像编辑技术，实现对修改类型和内容的精确控制，从而构建出一个能够跨多种类别进行查询的流程。利用这一流程，我们创建了EDIR——一个新型的细粒度CIR基准测试。EDIR包含了5,000个高质量查询，这些查询被划分为五个主要类别和十五个子类别。我们对13种多模态嵌入模型进行了全面评估，发现它们存在显著的能力差距；即使是最先进的模型（如RzenEmbed和GME），也难以在所有子类别中保持一致的性能表现，这凸显了我们基准测试的严格性。通过对比分析，我们进一步发现了现有基准测试中的固有局限性，例如模态偏见以及分类覆盖范围的不足。此外，一项针对特定领域的训练实验证明了我们基准测试的可行性。该实验通过区分那些可以通过针对性数据解决的类别和那些暴露出当前模型架构固有局限性的类别，进一步明确了这项任务的挑战性。

papers.title: EDSD: Entropy-Driven Design for Faster Speculative Decoding
papers.title_zh: EDSD：基于熵驱动的快速推测性解码技术
papers.authors: Longkai Cheng, Ximing Wang, Jiangcai Zhu, Kailai Shao, Chao Chen, Haixiang Hu
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has emerged as a promising paradigm for accelerating large language model inference by leveraging a lightweight draft model to generate multiple candidate tokens. However, existing methods often incur substantial training overhead to mitigate information misalignment between autoregressive draft model training and decoding. To address this challenge, we propose EDSD, an Entropy-Driven Speculative Decoding framework that uses entropy as a unified, interpretable signal for both draft model training and architectural design. EDSD drives the draft model to progressively align with the target model in an easy-to-hard manner while establishing token-level alignment as a dominant design principle. Extensive experiments on seven LLMs demonstrate that EDSD improves training efficiency by 24.8%, increases the average acceptance length by 4.0%, and achieves a 4.1% speedup compared to state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, EDSD improves robustness to system prompt variations by more than 5x. Our findings establish entropy-driven alignment as an effective and principled foundation for efficient speculative decoding.
papers.abstract_zh: 推测性解码作为一种有望的范式，通过利用轻量级的草稿模型来生成多个候选令牌，从而加速大语言模型的推理过程。然而，现有的方法往往会导致大量的训练开销，以缓解自回归草稿模型训练与解码过程之间的信息不一致问题。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了EDSD框架——一种基于熵驱动的推测性解码方案。该框架将熵作为统一且可解释的信号，用于草稿模型训练和架构设计。EDSD能够以一种从简单到复杂的渐进方式，使草稿模型与目标模型逐渐对齐，同时将令牌级对齐作为主要的设计原则。在七个大语言模型上的广泛实验表明，EDSD将训练效率提升了24.8%，平均接受长度增加了4.0%，与最先进的方法相比，速度提升了4.1%。此外，EDSD还显著提高了对系统提示变化的鲁棒性，其提升幅度超过5倍。我们的研究结果表明，基于熵驱动的对齐方法是一种有效且符合原则的高效推测性解码基础。

papers.title: MUTANT: A Recipe for Multilingual Tokenizer Design
papers.title_zh: 突变体：多语言标记器设计的典范
papers.authors: Souvik Rana, Ashish Kulkarni, Arul Menezes, Chandra Khatri, Shubham Agarwal
papers.abstract: Tokenizers play a crucial role in determining the performance, training efficiency, and the inference cost of Large Language Models (LLMs). Designing effective tokenizers for multilingual LLMs is particularly challenging due to diverse scripts and rich morphological variation. While subword methods like Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) are widely adopted, their effectiveness in multilingual settings remains underexplored. We present MUTANT, a recipe for building multilingual tokenizers, with careful vocabulary and training data design, language-aware pre-tokenization, and subword and multiword aware training. We also introduce MUTANT-Indic, a tokenizer for India-specific multilingual LLMs, that produces linguistically coherent tokens and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Evaluated across English, Indian languages and code data, our tokenizer improves the average fertility score by 39.5% over LLaMA4 and by 18% over Sutra (the current best). This translates to 44% improvement in inference throughput over LLaMA4 while maintaining comparable performance on English and Indic benchmarks. We present detailed ablations across tokenizer training data size, vocabulary size, merging techniques, and pre-tokenization strategies, demonstrating the robustness of our design choices.
papers.abstract_zh: 分词器在决定大语言模型（LLM）的性能、训练效率以及推理成本方面起着至关重要的作用。对于多语言LLM来说，设计有效的分词器尤其具有挑战性，因为存在多种脚本和丰富的形态学变化。虽然像字节对编码这样的子词方法被广泛采用，但其在多语言环境中的有效性仍未被充分探索。我们提出了MUTANT这一构建多语言分词器的方案，该方案注重词汇表和训练数据的设计，具备语言感知性的预分词功能，并且能够处理子词和多词组合的情况。我们还介绍了MUTANT-Indic，这是一种适用于印度特定多语言LLM的分词器，它能够生成语言上连贯的标记，并达到最先进的性能水平。在英文、印地语以及代码数据上的评估结果显示，与LaMA4相比，我们的分词器平均生育率提高了39.5%，与当前最佳算法Sutra相比则提高了18%。这意味着在与LaMA4相当的性能基础上，推理吞吐量提升了44%。我们详细分析了分词器训练数据规模、词汇表大小、合并技术以及预分词策略等方面的影响，证明了我们设计选择的稳健性。

papers.title: FactCorrector: A Graph-Inspired Approach to Long-Form Factuality Correction of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: FactCorrector：一种基于图结构的长形式事实修正方法，适用于大型语言模型的应用场景
papers.authors: Javier Carnerero-Cano, Massimiliano Pronesti, Radu Marinescu, Tigran T. Tchrakian, James Barry, Jasmina Gajcin, Yufang Hou, Alessandra Pascale, Elizabeth M. Daly
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used in knowledge-intensive applications but often generate factually incorrect responses. A promising approach to rectify these flaws is correcting LLMs using feedback. Therefore, in this paper, we introduce FactCorrector, a new post-hoc correction method that adapts across domains without retraining and leverages structured feedback about the factuality of the original response to generate a correction. To support rigorous evaluations of factuality correction methods, we also develop the VELI5 benchmark, a novel dataset containing systematically injected factual errors and ground-truth corrections. Experiments on VELI5 and several popular long-form factuality datasets show that the FactCorrector approach significantly improves factual precision while preserving relevance, outperforming strong baselines. We release our code at https://ibm.biz/factcorrector.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在需要大量知识的应用中被广泛使用，但往往会产生事实错误的响应。一种有效的改进方法是通过反馈来修正这些错误。因此，在本文中，我们介绍了FactCorrector这一新的事后修正方法。该方法无需重新训练即可适应不同领域，并利用关于原始响应真实性的结构化反馈来生成修正内容。为了对真实性修正方法进行严格的评估，我们还开发了VELI5基准数据集，该数据集包含系统注入的事实错误和真实修正内容。在VELI5以及几个流行的长文本真实性数据集上的实验表明，FactCorrector方法在保持相关性的同时，显著提高了真实性精度，其性能优于其他强大的基线方法。我们的代码可以在https://ibm.biz/factcorrector下载。

papers.title: MADE: A Living Benchmark for Multi-Label Text Classification with Uncertainty Quantification of Medical Device Adverse Events
papers.title_zh: MADE：一种适用于多标签文本分类的实用基准方法，能够量化医疗器械使用过程中产生的不良后果
papers.authors: Raunak Agarwal, Markus A. Wenzel, Simon Baur, Jonas Zimmer, George Harvey, Jackie Ma
papers.abstract: Machine learning in high-stakes domains such as healthcare requires not only strong predictive performance but also reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) to support human oversight. Multi-label text classification (MLTC) is a central task in this domain, yet remains challenging due to label imbalances, dependencies, and combinatorial complexity. Existing MLTC benchmarks are increasingly saturated and may be affected by training data contamination, making it difficult to distinguish genuine reasoning capabilities from memorization. We introduce MADE, a living MLTC benchmark derived from medical device adverse event reports and continuously updated with newly published reports to prevent contamination. MADE features a long-tailed distribution of hierarchical labels and enables reproducible evaluation with strict temporal splits. We establish baselines across more than 20 encoder- and decoder-only models under fine-tuning and few-shot settings (instruction-tuned/reasoning variants, local/API-accessible). We systematically assess entropy-/consistency-based and self-verbalized UQ methods. Results show clear trade-offs: smaller discriminatively fine-tuned decoders achieve the strongest head-to-tail accuracy while maintaining competitive UQ; generative fine-tuning delivers the most reliable UQ; large reasoning models improve performance on rare labels yet exhibit surprisingly weak UQ; and self-verbalized confidence is not a reliable proxy for uncertainty. Our work is publicly available at https://hhi.fraunhofer.de/aml-demonstrator/made-benchmark.
papers.abstract_zh: 在诸如医疗保健这样的高风险领域，机器学习不仅需要强大的预测能力，还需要可靠的不确定性量化技术来支持人类的监督。多标签文本分类是这一领域的核心任务，但由于标签不平衡、依赖关系以及组合复杂性等问题，该任务仍然具有挑战性。现有的多标签文本分类基准已经越来越饱和，而且可能会受到训练数据污染的影响，这使得区分真正的推理能力和记忆能力变得困难。我们提出了MADE这个基于医疗器械不良事件报告构建的实时多标签文本分类基准，该基准会不断根据新发布的报告进行更新，以防止数据污染的影响。MADE具有层次化标签的长尾分布特性，并且能够进行可重复的评估，同时具备严格的时间分割要求。我们在超过20种仅包含编码器和解码器的模型中建立了基准，这些模型适用于微调模式和少量样本模式（包括指令调优/推理变体、局部处理/可访问的API）。我们系统地评估了基于熵/一致性的不确定性量化方法以及自表述式不确定性量化方法。结果表明，存在明显的权衡：通过选择性微调得到的解码器在保持良好不确定性量的同时，能够实现最高的准确率；生成式微调则能够提供最可靠的不确定性量化结果；大型推理模型虽然在罕见标签上的性能有所提升，但在不确定性量化方面却表现出令人惊讶的不足；而自表述式的置信度并不能作为不确定性的可靠代理。我们的研究成果可以在以下链接查看：https://hhi.fraunhofer.de/aml-demonstrator/made-benchmark

papers.title: Overcoming Copyright Barriers in Corpus Distribution Through Non-Reversible Hashing
papers.title_zh: 通过非可逆哈希技术突破版权障碍，实现文献资源的共享
papers.authors: Arthur Amalvy, Vincent Labatut, Xavier Bost, Hen-Hsen Huang
papers.abstract: While annotated corpora are crucial in the field of natural language processing (NLP), those containing copyrighted material are difficult to exchange among researchers. Yet, such corpora are necessary to fully represent the diversity of data found in the wild in the context of NLP tasks. We tackle this issue by proposing a method to lawfully share the annotations of any sequential copyrighted corpus. The corpus creator shares the annotations in clear, along with a non-reversible hashed version of the source material. The corpus user must own the source material, and apply the same hash function to their own tokens, in order to match them to the shared annotations. Crucially, our method is robust to reasonable divergences in the version of the copyrighted data owned by the user. As an illustration, we present alignment experiments on different editions of novels. Our results show that our method is able to correctly correctly align 98.7 to 99.79% of tokens depending on the novel, provided the user version is sufficiently close to the corpus creator’s version. We publicly release novelties-bookshare, a Python implementation of our method.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然带有注释的语料库在自然语言处理领域非常重要，但包含受版权保护内容的语料库却难以在研究人员之间共享。然而，这些语料库对于全面反映自然语言处理任务中实际存在的数据多样性来说是必要的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种合法共享任何受版权保护的序列语料库注释的方法。语料库的创建者会将注释以清晰的形式分享出来，同时附上原始材料的不可逆哈希版本。语料库的用户必须拥有原始材料，并且需要对自己处理的文本应用相同的哈希函数，以便将其与共享的注释进行匹配。重要的是，我们的方法能够容忍用户所拥有的受版权保护数据版本存在合理程度的差异。作为示例，我们对不同版本的小说进行了对齐实验。结果表明，只要用户版本与语料库创建者的版本足够接近，我们的方法就能正确对齐98.7%到99.79%的文本。我们还公开了我们的方法实现的Python版本——novelties-bookshare。

papers.title: UniSRM: A Unified Speech Reward Model for Reasoning-Based Fine-grained Assessment
papers.title_zh: UniSRM：一种用于基于推理的细粒度评估的统一语音奖励模型
papers.authors: Yuanyuan Wang, Dongchao Yang, Yayue Deng, Zhiyong Wu, Steven Y. Guo, Helen M. Meng, Xixin Wu
papers.abstract: Evaluating speech generation still relies heavily on human judgments, such as Mean Opinion Score (MOS), which are expensive, subjective, and difficult to reproduce at scale. While a few recent studies have begun to explore AudioLLM-based judge models, existing efforts typically target only a narrow set of scenarios (e.g., utterance-level quality or single-turn dialogue) and provide limited coverage of diverse speech generation tasks and evaluation dimensions. In this work, we propose UniSRM, a unified speech reward model that can support multi-dimensional, interpretable reward signals with reliable reasoning. To support training and evaluation, we introduce UniSRM-Data and UniSRM-Bench, covering speech evaluation tasks from utterance-level quality to context-level coherence. Based on this dataset, we present the unified speech reward model, UniSRM, with a two-stage pipeline that enables reasoning-based fine-grained assessment. Furthermore, we introduce Reasoning-Consistent Rewards to improve the reliability of the reasoning process. Experiments show that UniSRM delivers more reliable and human-aligned judgments across a broad range of speech evaluation tasks, offering a practical foundation for scalable and unified evaluation of speech quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估语音生成仍然主要依赖于人类的判断，比如平均意见得分（MOS），这些指标成本高、主观性强，且难以大规模复制。虽然最近有一些研究开始探索基于AudioLLM的评判模型，但现有的研究通常只针对少数特定场景（例如语句级质量或单轮对话），并且对多种语音生成任务和评估维度覆盖有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了UniSRM，这是一种统一的语音奖励模型，能够提供多维度的、可解释的奖励信号，并具备可靠的推理能力。为了支持训练和评估，我们引入了UniSRM-Data和UniSRM-Bench这两个数据集，涵盖了从语句级质量到上下文级连贯性的各种语音评估任务。基于这个数据集，我们展示了这种统一的语音奖励模型UniSRM，它采用两阶段流程，能够实现基于推理的细致评估。此外，我们还引入了“推理一致性奖励”机制，以提高推理过程的可靠性。实验表明，UniSRM能够在广泛的语音评估任务中提供更可靠且符合人类直觉的评判结果，为可扩展且统一的语音质量评估提供了实用的基础。

papers.title: DPEPO: Diverse Parallel Exploration Policy Optimization for LLM-based Agents
papers.title_zh: DPEPO：针对基于大语言模型的智能体设计的多样化并行探索策略优化方法
papers.authors: JunShuo Zhang, Chengrui Huang, Feng Guo, Zihan Li, Ke Shi, Menghua Jiang, Jiguo Yu, Shuo Shang, Shen Gao
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that follow the sequential “reason-then-act” paradigm have achieved superior performance in many complex tasks. However, these methods suffer from limited exploration and incomplete environmental understanding, as they interact with only a single environment per step. In this paper, we first introduce a novel paradigm that enables an agent to interact with multiple environments simultaneously and share cross-trajectory experiences. Build upon this paradigm, we further propose Diverse Parallel Exploration Policy Optimization (DPEPO), a reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that encourages the agent to perform diverse parallel exploration. There are two stages in DPEPO: initial supervised fine-tuning (SFT) imparts basic parallel reasoning and action generation, followed by reinforcement learning stage with a hierarchical reward scheme. We design a parallel trajectory-level success reward and two step-level rewards: Diverse Action Reward and Diverse State Transition Reward, which actively penalize behavioral redundancy and promote broad exploration. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that DPEPO achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) success rates, while maintaining comparable efficiency to strong sequential baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 遵循“先推理后行动”顺序范式的大语言模型代理在许多复杂任务中取得了卓越的性能。然而，这些方法存在探索能力有限和环境理解不全面的问题，因为它们在每一步中只与单一环境进行交互。在本文中，我们首先提出了一种新颖的范式，该范式使代理能够同时与多个环境进行交互，并共享跨轨迹的经验。在此基础上，我们进一步提出了多样化并行探索策略优化算法（DPEPO），这是一种强化学习算法，它鼓励代理进行多样化的并行探索。DPEPO包含两个阶段：初始的监督式微调阶段传授基本的并行推理和动作生成能力，随后是带有分层奖励机制的强化学习阶段。我们设计了两种级别的奖励机制：平行轨迹级成功奖励和两级级奖励——多样化动作奖励和多样化状态转移奖励。这两种奖励机制能够主动惩罚行为上的冗余性，从而促进更广泛的探索。在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上的大量实验表明，DPEPO在保持与强大的顺序基线相当的效率的同时，取得了最先进的成功率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TEA-Bench: A Systematic Benchmarking of Tool-enhanced Emotional Support Dialogue Agent
papers.title_zh: TEA-Bench：对工具增强型情感支持对话代理的系统性性能评估
papers.authors: Xingyu Sui, Yanyan Zhao, Yulin Hu, Jiahe Guo, Weixiang Zhao, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Emotional Support Conversation requires not only affective expression but also grounded instrumental support to provide trustworthy guidance. However, existing ESC systems and benchmarks largely focus on affective support in text-only settings, overlooking how external tools can enable factual grounding and reduce hallucination in multi-turn emotional support. We introduce TEA-Bench, the first interactive benchmark for evaluating tool-augmented agents in ESC, featuring realistic emotional scenarios, an MCP-style tool environment, and process-level metrics that jointly assess the quality and factual grounding of emotional support. Experiments on nine LLMs show that tool augmentation generally improves emotional support quality and reduces hallucination, but the gains are strongly capacity-dependent: stronger models use tools more selectively and effectively, while weaker models benefit only marginally. We further release TEA-Dialog, a dataset of tool-enhanced ESC dialogues, and find that supervised fine-tuning improves in-distribution support but generalizes poorly. Our results underscore the importance of tool use in building reliable emotional support agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 情感支持对话不仅需要情感表达，还需要基于事实的实用支持，以提供可靠的指导。然而，现有的情感支持对话系统和评估标准大多只关注纯文本环境中的情感表达，而忽视了外部工具如何能够提供事实依据，从而减少多轮情感支持中的幻觉现象。我们推出了TEA-Bench，这是首个用于评估工具增强型智能体在情感支持对话中的表现的交互式基准测试平台。该平台具备真实的情感场景、类似MCP的工具环境，以及能够综合评估情感支持质量和事实依据的进程级指标。对九种大语言模型进行的实验表明，工具增强通常能够提高情感支持的质量并减少幻觉现象，但这种提升效果严重依赖于模型的性能：性能更强的模型能更选择性、更有效地利用工具，而性能较弱的模型则只能获得有限的收益。我们还发布了TEA-Dialog，这是一个包含工具增强型情感支持对话的数据集。研究发现，有监督的微调能够改善模型在未知场景下的支持能力，但泛化能力较差。我们的研究结果强调了在构建可靠的情感支持智能体时，工具使用的重要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: An Information-Theoretic Foundation for the Subregular Hierarchy
papers.title_zh: 子正则层次结构的信息论基础
papers.authors: Mai Phan Quoc Hung, Khanh Nguyen Quoc, Đoàn Minh Luong, Duong Thu Ngan, Duong Thi Phuong Thao, Tuan Do
papers.abstract: The Subregular Hypothesis posits that phonological patterns in natural languages occupy a restricted region of the formal language hierarchy, yet the cognitive basis for this restriction remains unclear. We propose an information-theoretic characterization: Strictly Local languages, when formalized as shifts of finite type, are exactly those admitting stationary Markov sources, which exhibit zero conditional mutual information between distant positions given intervening symbols. We prove that certain non-subregular patterns such as first-last assimilation admit no such Markov realization, explaining their unlearnability. Empirical validation on English phonotactics versus Finnish, Turkish, and Hungarian vowel harmony confirms that MI profiles statistically distinguish SL-like from TSL-like patterns (p < 0.001, r = 0.84). This work bridges formal language theory and information theory, offering a unified framework for understanding computational restrictions on natural language phonology.
papers.abstract_zh: 次规则假设认为，自然语言中的音位模式仅存在于形式语言层次结构的有限区域内，但这一限制背后的认知机制仍不清楚。我们提出了一种信息论上的描述：当将“严格局部语言”形式化为有限类型的移位时，这些语言恰好是那些允许存在平稳马尔可夫源的语言。这类语言的遥远位置之间的条件互信息为零，且不受中间符号的影响。我们证明，某些非次规则模式，如首末同化现象，无法形成这样的马尔可夫实现，从而解释了它们难以被学习的原因。通过对英语音位与芬兰语、土耳其语、匈牙利语元音和谐现象的实证验证，我们发现互信息曲线能够统计上区分出类似严格局部语言的模式和类似次规则局部语言的模式（p < 0.001，r = 0.84）。这项工作将形式语言理论与信息论结合起来，为理解自然语言音位学的计算限制提供了一个统一的框架。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ReGATE: Learning Faster and Better with Fewer Tokens in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: ReGATE：在较少代币的情况下，实现更快更好的学习效果——适用于多语言大语言模型
papers.authors: Chaoyu Li, Yogesh Kulkarni, Pooyan Fazli
papers.abstract: The computational cost of training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) grows rapidly with the number of processed tokens. Existing efficiency methods mainly target inference via token reduction or merging, offering limited benefits during training. We introduce ReGATE (Reference-Guided Adaptive Token Elision), an adaptive token pruning method for accelerating MLLM training. ReGATE adopts a teacher-student framework, in which a frozen teacher LLM provides per-token guidance losses that are fused with an exponential moving average of the student’s difficulty estimates. This adaptive scoring mechanism dynamically selects informative tokens while skipping redundant ones in the forward pass, substantially reducing computation without altering the model architecture. Across three representative MLLMs, ReGATE matches the peak accuracy of standard training on MVBench up to 2 \times faster, using only 38% of the tokens. With extended training, it even surpasses the baseline across multiple multimodal benchmarks, cutting total token usage by over 41%. Code and models will be released publicly.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的计算成本随着处理到的标记数量的增加而迅速上升。现有的优化方法主要侧重于通过标记简化或合并来加速推理过程，但在训练阶段的效果有限。我们提出了ReGATE（参考引导自适应标记省略）这一自适应标记修剪方法，旨在加快MLLMs的训练速度。ReGATE采用师生框架：一个固定的教师LLM提供每个标记的指导损失信息，这些信息与学生难度估计的指数移动平均值进行融合。这种自适应评分机制能够在前向传播过程中动态选择有信息的标记，同时跳过冗余的标记，从而大幅减少计算量，而无需改变模型架构。在三个代表性的MLLMs上测试表明，ReGATE 在 MVBench 上达到标准训练的峰值准确率，训练速度最高提升至 2 倍，仅使用 38% 的词元。经过进一步训练后，ReGATE甚至能在多个多模态基准测试中超越基线模型，总标记使用量减少了41%以上。我们的代码和模型将公开提供。

papers.title: From Words to Pixels: A Comprehensive Survey on Large Language Models in Visual Segmentation
papers.title_zh: 从文字到像素：关于大型语言模型在视觉分割领域应用的全面研究
papers.authors: Yizhou Wang, Mang Tik Chiu, Lingzhi Zhang, Xuan Shen, Sohrab Amirghodsi, Yun Fu
papers.abstract: Visual segmentation, the task of segmenting an image into semantically meaningful regions, is a cornerstone in machine learning and has widespread applications in industry. Nevertheless, visual segmentation with instruction has been a challenging task for many years. This largely stems from the cross-modal discrepancy between language and image domains, resulting in difficulty in relating the instruction semantics and the pixel-level predictions. In recent years, the remarkable reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have spurred a new wave of research aiming to bridge the disparity between natural language instructions and pixel-level understanding. This survey offers the first comprehensive overview of the rapidly evolving field of LLM-driven visual segmentation. We categorize existing approaches based on their core objectives and methodologies, including reasoning-based segmentation, open-vocabulary segmentation, grounding techniques connecting language to pixels, and extensions to video domains. We review recent seminal works in LLM-based visual segmentation, analyzing their architectural innovations, training strategies, and benchmark performance. Furthermore, we discuss the common datasets, evaluation metrics, and identify key challenges and promising future directions at the intersection of language and visual segmentation. We hope this survey serves as a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners seeking to understand the current landscape and future directions of leveraging LLMs for sophisticated visual segmentation tasks and applications. The resource summary is available at https://github.com/wyzjack/Awesome-LLM-Visual-Segmentation.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉分割，即将一个图像分割成具有语义意义的区域，是机器学习领域的重要基础，并在工业界得到了广泛应用。然而，带有指令的视觉分割多年来一直是一个具有挑战性的任务。这主要是由于语言和图像领域之间的跨模态差异所导致的，使得将指令的语义信息与像素级别的预测结果联系起来变得困难。近年来，大语言模型（LLM）和大型多模态模型（LMM）出色的推理能力推动了一波新的研究浪潮，旨在弥合自然语言指令与像素级理解之间的差距。本综述首次全面介绍了由LLM驱动的视觉分割这一快速发展的领域。我们根据核心目标和方法论对现有方法进行分类，包括基于推理的分割、开放词汇表分割、将语言与像素联系起来的基础技术，以及向视频领域的扩展。我们回顾了基于LLM的视觉分割领域的最新研究成果，分析了它们的架构创新、训练策略以及基准测试性能。此外，我们还讨论了常用数据集、评估指标，并指出了语言与视觉分割交叉领域中的关键挑战及未来发展的方向。希望本综述能为寻求了解当前状况以及未来利用LLM进行复杂视觉分割任务和应用的研究人员和实践者提供有价值的参考。该资源摘要可访问：https://github.com/wyzjack/Awesome-LLM-Visual-Segmentation
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Red-Bandit: Test-Time Adaptation for LLM Red-Teaming via Bandit-Guided LoRA Experts
papers.title_zh: 红班迪特：利用带指示式LoRA专家技术，实现大语言模型在测试阶段的自适应攻击策略
papers.authors: Christos Ziakas, Nicholas Loo, Nishita Jain, Alessandra Russo
papers.abstract: Automated red-teaming has emerged as a scalable approach for auditing Large Language Models (LLMs) prior to deployment, yet existing approaches lack mechanisms to efficiently adapt to model-specific vulnerabilities at inference. We introduce Red-Bandit, a red-teaming framework that adapts online to identify and exploit model failure modes under distinct attack styles (e.g., manipulation, slang). Red-Bandit post-trains a set of parameter-efficient LoRA experts, each specialized for a particular attack style, using reinforcement learning that rewards the generation of unsafe prompts via a rule-based safety model. At inference, a multi-armed bandit policy dynamically selects among these attack-style experts based on the target model’s response safety, balancing exploration and exploitation. Red-Bandit outperforms state-of-the-art methods on AdvBench and HarmBench, achieving higher attack success rates under sufficient exploration budgets (ASR@10), while generating more human-readable adversarial prompts (lower perplexity). In addition, Red-Bandit’s bandit policy serves as a diagnostic tool for identifying model-specific vulnerabilities by indicating which attack styles most effectively elicit harmful behaviors.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化红池机制已成为在大语言模型部署前对其进行审计的一种可扩展方法。然而，现有的方法缺乏有效适应模型特定漏洞的机制。我们提出了Red-Bandit这一红池机制框架，它能够在线自适应地识别并利用不同攻击方式下的模型故障模式（例如，操纵攻击、俚语攻击等）。Red-Bandit通过参数高效LoRA专家进行后训练，每个专家都针对某种特定的攻击方式进行优化。该框架采用强化学习机制，通过基于规则的安全性模型来奖励生成不安全的提示。在推理阶段，多臂老虎机策略会根据目标模型的响应安全性动态选择这些攻击方式专家，从而平衡探索与利用的效果。在AdvBench和HarmBench测试集上，Red-Bandit的表现优于现有最先进的方法，在足够的探索预算下能够实现更高的攻击成功率（ASR@10），同时生成的对抗性提示更易于人类理解（较低的困惑度）。此外，Red-Bandit的多臂老虎机策略还可以作为诊断工具，通过指出哪些攻击方式最能引发有害行为来识别模型特定的漏洞。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Graph-Based Alternatives to LLMs for Human Simulation
papers.title_zh: 基于图的LLM替代方案，用于人类模拟
papers.authors: Joseph Suh, Suhong Moon, Serina Chang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become a popular approach for simulating human behaviors, yet it remains unclear if LLMs are necessary for all simulation tasks. We study a broad family of close-ended simulation tasks, with applications from survey prediction to test-taking, and show that a graph neural network can match or surpass strong LLM-based methods. We introduce Graph-basEd Models for Human Simulation (GEMS) which formulates close-ended simulation as link prediction on a heterogeneous graph of individuals and choices. Across three datasets and three evaluation settings, GEMS matches or outperforms the strongest LLM-based methods while using three orders of magnitude fewer parameters. These results suggest that graph-based modeling can complement LLMs as an efficient and transparent approach to simulating human behaviors. Code is available at https://github.com/schang-lab/gems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已成为模拟人类行为的常用方法，不过目前尚不清楚是否所有模拟任务都需要使用大语言模型。我们研究了一系列封闭式的模拟任务，这些任务的应用范围从调查预测到考试应对等各个领域。结果表明，图神经网络在性能上能够达到或超越强大的大语言模型方法。我们提出了“用于人类模拟的图基模型”（GEMS），该模型将封闭式模拟任务转化为在由个体和选择构成的异构图上进行链接预测的过程。在三个数据集和三种评估设置下进行测试，结果显示，GEMS在参数使用量方面比最强的大语言模型方法少三个数量级，同时其性能达到或超过后者。这些结果表明，基于图的建模可以作为模拟人类行为的一种高效且透明的方法，与大语言模型相辅相成。相关代码可访问：https://github.com/schang-lab/gems。

papers.title: Minimal Free Resolution Guided Adaptive Tree Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 最小自由分辨率引导式自适应树推理
papers.authors: Dezhao Tang, Meihan Liu, Yulai Tong, Guan Yuan, Qiuyan Yan
papers.abstract: Dynamic reasoning trees can help large language models solve complex tasks by explicitly structuring intermediate decisions.However, existing approaches often rely on manually specified subproblems or predefined decomposition patterns, which limits the effectiveness of reasoning and generalization.To solve this problem, we propose SyRA, a hierarchical reasoning framework based on MFR theory that supports the construction of adaptive reasoning trees and reliable error correction within a single LLM. Specifically, SyRA focuses on reasoning-tree construction, dynamically controlling branching and expansion using MFR principles to enable informative, non-redundant subproblem decomposition. In addition, it introduces a residual backtracking mechanism for adaptive cross-layer error correction, allowing the model to revise earlier reasoning decisions based on downstream feedback.Across eight reasoning benchmarks, SyRA significantly reduces logical errors and improves reasoning accuracy, while achieving a better balance between accuracy and reasoning time than the Chain-of-Thought, Decompose–Analyze–Rethink and Tree-of-Thought. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Tim798-art/SyRA/tree/main/SyRA.
papers.abstract_zh: 动态推理树可以通过明确构建中间决策来帮助大语言模型解决复杂任务。然而，现有的方法往往依赖于手动指定的子问题或预定义的分解模式，这限制了推理的效率和泛化能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SyRA这一基于MFR理论的层次化推理框架。该框架支持在单个LLM内部构建自适应推理树并进行可靠的错误修正。具体来说，SyRA专注于推理树的构建，利用MFR原则动态控制分支和扩展，从而实现有信息量的、非冗余的子问题分解。此外，它还引入了残差回溯机制，用于自适应跨层错误修正，使模型能够根据下游反馈修正早期的推理决策。在八个推理基准测试中，SyRA显著减少了逻辑错误，提高了推理准确性，同时实现了比“思维链”、“分解-分析-重新思考”以及“树状思维”更好的准确性和推理时间之间的平衡。我们的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/Tim798-art/SyRA/tree/main/SyRA下载。

papers.title: GrAInS: Gradient-based Attribution for Inference-Time Steering of LLMs and VLMs
papers.title_zh: GrAInS：基于梯度的归因方法，用于LLM和VLM的推理时间调控
papers.authors: Duy Nguyen, Archiki Prasad, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Mohit Bansal
papers.abstract: Inference-time steering provides a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) by modifying model activations without updating weights. However, existing methods often rely on a global intervention vector, overlook token-level causal influence, and underutilize model logits, especially in multimodal settings where visual and textual inputs contribute unevenly. We propose GrAInS, a contrastive, gradient-based approach that leverages Integrated Gradients to identify top-k influential tokens and construct directional steering vectors based on their contribution to preferred over dispreferred outputs. These vectors guide activation intervention at each layer, preserving the representational scale. GrAInS outperforms fine-tuning and prior steering methods on both LLM and VLM tasks: improving TruthfulQA accuracy by 13.22% (Llama-3.1-8B), reducing MMHal-Bench hallucinations from 0.624 to 0.514 (LLaVA-1.6-7B), and increasing SPA-VL alignment by 8.11%, all without degrading fluency or general capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理时间引导提供了一种轻量级的方法，用于微调大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM），其原理是通过修改模型的激活权重来实现微调，而无需更新权重参数。然而，现有的方法往往依赖于全局干预向量，忽略了令牌级别的因果影响，并且没有充分利用模型的逻辑输出值。在多模态环境中，视觉和文本输入的贡献并不均衡，这种情况尤为明显。我们提出了GrAInS方法，这是一种基于对比度的、基于梯度的方法，它利用集成梯度技术来识别对输出结果有显著影响的令牌，并根据这些令牌对输出结果的影响来构建方向性引导向量。这些引导向量可以在每个层次上进行激活干预，同时保留模型的表示尺度。GrAInS在LLM和VLM任务上的表现均优于传统的微调方法和引导方法：使TruthfulQA的准确率提高了13.22%（针对Llama-3.1-8B模型）；将MMHal-Bench测试中的幻觉率从0.624降低到0.514（针对LaVA-1.6-7B模型）；还将SPA-VL对齐程度提高了8.11%。同时，GrAInS并没有降低模型的流畅性或整体性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DiNO: Disinformation Narrative Observer
papers.title_zh: DiNO：虚假信息叙事观察者
papers.authors: Witold Sosnowski, Arkadiusz Modzelewski, Kinga Skorupska, Adam Wierzbicki
papers.abstract: Disinformation is an escalating global threat, making it essential to understand its content, dissemination, and evolution. To confront this challenge, researchers have begun grouping related false claims into broader disinformation narratives, which can be tracked across cultures, time periods, and media sources. Analyzing these narratives provides critical insights for developing more effective countermeasures. To this end, we introduce DiNO: Disinformation Narrative Observer, a novel method designed to extract disinformation narratives from news articles. We applied DiNO to news articles on the Ukraine War, COVID-19 and Migration, sourced from disinformation-prone outlets as well as a reputable source. We evaluated the narratives extracted by DiNO by measuring how well their topics and stances aligned with a recognized disinformation narratives dataset. DiNO outperforms competitive narrative mining approaches, including Relatio and CaNarEx, achieving a 41%–44% improvement in topical alignment and a 30%–41% improvment in stance alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 虚假信息是一种日益严重的全球威胁，因此了解其内容、传播方式以及演变过程至关重要。为了应对这一挑战，研究人员开始将相关的虚假言论整合为更宏观的虚假信息叙事体系，这些叙事可以在不同的文化、时期和媒体来源中被追踪。分析这些叙事能够为制定更有效的应对措施提供重要线索。为此，我们提出了DiNO：虚假信息叙事观察器这一新方法，该方法旨在从新闻文章中提取虚假信息叙事。我们将DiNO应用于关于乌克兰战争、COVID-19和移民等主题的新闻文章，这些文章来自容易传播虚假信息的媒体以及一些信誉良好的来源。我们通过衡量这些叙事的主题和立场与公认的虚假信息叙事数据集之间的匹配程度来评估DiNO的效果。结果表明，DiNO在主题匹配方面比竞争对手的方法如Relatio和CaNarEx取得了41%至44%的提升，在立场匹配方面则提升了30%至41%。

papers.title: Agentic Very Long Video Understanding
papers.title_zh: 主动式长视频理解技术
papers.authors: Aniket Rege, Arka Sadhu, Yuliang Li, Kejie Li, Ramya Korlakai Vinayak, Yuning Chai, Yong Jae Lee, Hyo Jin Kim
papers.abstract: The advent of always-on personal AI assistants, enabled by all-day wearable devices such as smart glasses, demands a new level of contextual understanding—one that goes beyond short, isolated events to encompass the continuous, longitudinal stream of egocentric video. Achieving this vision requires advances in long-horizon video understanding, where systems must interpret and recall visual and audio information spanning days or even weeks. Existing methods, including large language models and retrieval-augmented generation, are constrained by limited context windows and lack the ability to perform compositional, multi-hop reasoning over very long video streams. In this work, we address these challenges through EGAgent, an enhanced agentic framework centered on entity scene graphs, which represent people, places, objects, and their relationships over time. Our system equips a planning agent with tools for structured search and reasoning over these graphs, as well as hybrid visual and audio search capabilities, enabling detailed, cross-modal, and temporally coherent reasoning. Experiments on the EgoLifeQA and Video-MME-long datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on EgoLifeQA (57.5%) and competitive performance on Video-MME-long (74.1%) for complex longitudinal video understanding tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着全天候个人人工智能助手的出现，人们可以借助智能眼镜等可穿戴设备实现全天性的交互。这要求人工智能具备更高水平的上下文理解能力——不仅仅是处理短暂的孤立事件，而是能够捕捉到持续不断的、纵向发展的视频信息。要实现这一愿景，就需要在长时视频理解方面取得突破，系统必须能够解析并回忆起持续数天甚至数周的视觉和音频信息。目前的方法，包括大语言模型和基于检索增强的生成技术，都存在上下文窗口有限的问题，且无法对非常长的视频流进行组合性、多跳推理。在这项研究中，我们通过EGAgent解决了这些挑战。EGAgent是一个以实体场景图为核心的增强型智能体框架，它能够表示人物、地点、物体及其随时间变化的关系。我们的系统为规划智能体提供了针对这些场景图的结构化搜索和推理工具，同时具备混合视觉和听觉搜索能力，从而实现详细、跨模态且时间上连贯的推理。在EgoLifeQA和Video-MME-long数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在EgoLifeQA任务上取得了顶尖性能（57.5%），在Video-MME-long任务上也取得了相当好的表现（74.1%），这对于复杂的纵向视频理解任务来说是非常出色的成绩。

papers.title: OLA: Output Language Alignment in Code-Switched LLM Interactions
papers.title_zh: OLA：混合语码语言模型交互中的输出语言对齐问题
papers.authors: Juhyun Oh, Haneul Yoo, Faiz Ghifari Haznitrama, Alice Oh
papers.abstract: Code-switching, alternating between languages within a conversation, is natural for multilingual users, yet poses fundamental challenges for large language models (LLMs). When a user code-switches in their prompt to an LLM, they typically do not specify the expected language of the LLM response, and thus LLMs must infer the output language from contextual and pragmatic cues. We find that current LLMs systematically fail to align with this expectation, responding in undesired languages even when cues are clear to humans. We introduce OLA, a benchmark to evaluate LLMs’ Output Language Alignment in code-switched interactions. OLA focuses on Korean–English code-switching and spans simple intra-sentential mixing to instruction–content mismatches. Even frontier models frequently misinterpret implicit language expectation, exhibiting a systematic bias toward non-English responses. We further show this bias generalizes beyond Korean to Chinese and Indonesian pairs. Models also show instability through mid-response switching and language intrusions. Chain-of-Thought prompting fails to resolve these errors, indicating weak pragmatic reasoning about output language. However, Code-Switching Aware DPO with minimal data (~1K examples) substantially reduces misalignment, suggesting these failures stem from insufficient alignment rather than fundamental limitations. Our results highlight the need to align multilingual LLMs with users’ implicit expectations in real-world code-switched interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 在对话中交替使用不同语言对于多语言用户来说是很自然的事情，但这对大语言模型来说却是一个巨大的挑战。当用户在向语言模型发送请求时切换语言时，他们通常不会明确指定期望的语言类型，因此语言模型必须从上下文和语用线索中推断出输出的语言类型。我们发现，当前的一些语言模型无法满足这一期望，即使人类能够清楚地理解这些线索，它们仍然会以不希望使用的语言进行回应。我们提出了OLA这个基准测试，用于评估语言模型在交替使用语言进行交互时的输出语言对齐情况。OLA主要关注的是韩语与英语之间的语言交替使用，涵盖了从简单的句子内部混合到指令内容与语言不匹配等多种情况。即使是一些先进的模型也经常误解隐含的语言期望，表现出系统性地倾向于使用非英语语言进行回应。我们还发现，这种偏见不仅限于韩语与英语之间，也延伸到了汉语与印尼语之间。此外，模型在回应过程中还会出现不稳定现象，以及语言使用的不当问题。链式提示方式也无法解决这些问题，这表明模型在输出语言的语用推理方面存在不足。不过，带有语言交替意识的多语言DPO模型在较少的数据情况下（约1000个例子）就能显著减少这种不一致现象，这说明这些错误是由于对齐不够充分而非根本性的限制所导致的。我们的研究结果强调了在现实世界的语言交替交互中，需要将多语言语言模型与用户的隐含期望进行对齐的重要性。

papers.title: Generalizing Trust: Weak-to-Strong Trustworthiness in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 信任的泛化：语言模型中可信度的弱到强变化
papers.authors: Lillian Sun, Martin Pawelczyk, Zhenting Qi, Aounon Kumar, Himabindu Lakkaraju
papers.abstract: As large language models continue to advance, ensuring their trustworthiness is critical. However, inaccessible real-world ground truth labels pose a significant challenge in high-stakes domains. Recent studies have highlighted weak-to-strong generalization, where a strong model trained only on a weak model’s labels surpasses the weak model in task performance. Yet, whether critical trustworthiness properties such as robustness, fairness, and privacy can generalize similarly remains an open question. This is the first work to study this question by examining if a stronger model can enhance trustworthiness when fine-tuned on a weaker model’s labels, a paradigm we term weak-to-strong trustworthiness. To address this, we introduce two fundamental fine-tuning strategies that leverage trustworthiness regularization during the fine-tuning of the weak model and the weak-to-strong transfer. Our experimental evaluation on real-world datasets reveals that while some trustworthiness properties, such as fairness, adversarial robustness, and OOD robustness, show significant improvement in trustworthiness generalization when both models were regularized, others, like privacy, do not exhibit signs of weak-to-strong trustworthiness. Our results highlight the potential of weak-to-strong trustworthiness as a practical pathway for enhancing the trustworthiness of increasingly capable AI systems, even under imperfect real-world conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的不断发展，确保其可信度至关重要。然而，在关键领域，无法获取的真实标签数据却构成了重大挑战。最近的研究指出，存在弱到强的泛化问题：一个仅基于弱模型标签进行训练的强模型，其任务性能甚至优于弱模型本身。不过，诸如鲁棒性、公平性和隐私性等关键可信属性是否能够同样实现弱到强的泛化，仍然是一个未解之谜。本研究首次探讨了这个问题，即当一个更强模型在基于较弱模型标签进行微调时，是否能够提升系统的可信度。为此，我们提出了两种基本的微调策略：一种是在微调弱模型时利用可信度正则化，另一种则是实现弱到强的可信度提升。我们在真实数据集上的实验结果表明，一些可信属性，如公平性、对抗鲁棒性和外部数据鲁棒性，在两种模型都经过可信度正则化后，其可信度得到了显著提升；而像隐私性这样的属性则并未表现出弱到强的可信度提升现象。我们的研究结果表明，弱到强的可信度提升是一种实用的方法，即使在实际条件不完善的情况下，也能有效提高日益强大的AI系统的可信度。

papers.title: Reasoning Is Not All You Need: Examining LLMs for Multi-Turn Mental Health Conversations
papers.title_zh: 推理并非唯一关键：探讨大型语言模型在多轮心理健康对话中的应用
papers.authors: Mohit Chandra, Siddharth Sriraman, Harneet Singh Khanuja, Yiqiao Jin, Munmun De Choudhury
papers.abstract: Limited access to mental healthcare, extended wait times, and increasing capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led individuals to turn to LLMs for fulfilling their mental health needs. However, examining the multi-turn mental health conversation capabilities of LLMs remains under-explored. Existing evaluation frameworks typically focus on diagnostic accuracy and win-rates and often overlook alignment with patient-specific goals, values, and personalities required for meaningful conversations. To address this, we introduce MedAgent, a novel framework for synthetically generating realistic, multi-turn mental health sensemaking conversations and use it to create the Mental Health Sensemaking Dialogue (MHSD) dataset, comprising over 2,200 patient–LLM conversations. Additionally, we present MultiSenseEval, a holistic framework to evaluate the multi-turn conversation abilities of LLMs in healthcare settings using human-centric criteria. Our findings reveal that frontier reasoning models yield below-par performance for patient-centric communication and struggle at precise (“hard”) diagnostic capabilities with average accuracy of ~31%. Additionally, we observed variation in model performance based on patient’s persona and performance drop with increasing turns in the conversation. Our work provides a comprehensive synthetic data generation framework, a dataset and evaluation framework for assessing LLMs in multi-turn mental health conversations.
papers.abstract_zh: 有限的心理健康医疗服务获取途径、漫长的等待时间，以及大语言模型能力的不断提升，使得人们不得不依赖这些模型来满足自己的心理健康需求。然而，对大语言模型进行多轮心理健康对话能力的评估仍然鲜有研究。现有的评估框架通常侧重于诊断准确性和胜率，而往往忽略了与患者特定目标、价值观和个性相匹配的重要性，而这些才是实现有意义对话所必需的。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了MedAgent这一新型框架，它能够生成逼真且包含多轮对话的心理健康意义构建对话，并利用该框架创建了Mental Health Sensemaking Dialogue（MHSD）数据集，其中包含超过2,200条患者与大语言模型的对话记录。此外，我们还提出了MultiSenseEval这一综合评估框架，该框架以人类为中心的标准来评估大语言模型在医疗场景下的多轮对话能力。我们的研究发现表明，前沿的推理模型在针对患者的沟通方面表现不佳，其在精确诊断方面的能力也较弱，平均准确率仅为约31%。此外，我们还观察到模型性能会根据患者的角色而有所不同，而且随着对话轮数增加，模型性能会下降。我们的工作提供了一个全面的合成数据生成框架，以及一个用于评估大语言模型在多轮心理健康对话中的能力的数据集和评估框架。

papers.title: BatonVoice: An Operationalist Framework for Enhancing Controllable Speech Synthesis with Linguistic Intelligence from LLMs
papers.title_zh: BatonVoice：一种操作主义框架，旨在利用大语言模型中的语言智能，提升可控制的语音合成效果
papers.authors: Yue Wang, Ruotian Ma, Xingyu Chen, Zhengliang Shi, Morunliu Yang, Wanshun Chen, Huang Liu, Jiadi Yao, Xin He, Qu Yang, Qingxuan Jiang, Fanghua Ye, Juntao Li, Zhaopeng Tu, Xiaolong Li, Liefeng Bo, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: The rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) is reshaping multimodel models, with speech synthesis being a prominent application. However, existing approaches often underutilize the linguistic intelligence of these models, typically failing to leverage their powerful instruction-following capabilities. This limitation hinders the model’s ability to follow text instructions for controllable Text-to-Speech (TTS). To address this, we propose a new paradigm inspired by operationalism that decouples instruction understanding from speech generation. We introduce BatonVoice, a framework where an LLM acts as a conductor, understanding user instructions and generating a textual plan – explicit vocal features (e.g., pitch, energy). A separate TTS model, the orchestra, then generates the speech from these features. To realize this component, we develop BatonTTS, a TTS model trained specifically for this task. Our experiments demonstrate that BatonVoice achieves strong performance in controllable and emotional speech synthesis, outperforming strong open- and closed-source baselines. Notably, our approach enables remarkable zero-shot cross-lingual generalization, accurately applying feature control abilities to languages unseen during post-training. This demonstrates that objectifying speech into textual vocal features can more effectively unlock the linguistic intelligence of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的崛起正在重塑多模型体系，其中语音合成是一个重要的应用领域。然而，现有的方法往往未能充分利用这些模型的语言智能，通常无法发挥它们强大的指令遵循能力。这一限制阻碍了模型按照文本指令进行可控的语音合成。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种基于操作主义的新范式，将指令理解与语音生成分离开来。我们提出了BatonVoice框架：一个由LLM作为指挥者的系统，它理解用户指令并生成文本计划——包括具体的声音特征（如音高、能量等）。然后，另一个独立的语音合成模型“管弦乐队”根据这些特征生成语音。为了实现这一功能，我们开发了专门为此任务训练的BatonTTS语音合成模型。我们的实验表明，BatonVoice在可控性和情感性语音合成方面表现优异，其性能优于许多开源和闭源基准模型。值得注意的是，我们的方法能够实现显著的零样本跨语言泛化能力，能够准确地将特征控制能力应用于训练后未曾接触过的语言。这表明，将语音对象化为文本声音特征可以更有效地释放LLM的语言智能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Monotonic Scaffolding as a Diagnostic Lens for Legal Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 作为法律推理诊断工具的单调支架在大型语言模型中应用
papers.authors: Pedro Calais, Janderson Santos, Anisio Lacerda, Wagner Meira Jr.
papers.abstract: Modern evaluation of Legal QA systems is shifting from terminal accuracy toward process-aware analyses of model reasoning. We propose a diagnostic framework grounded in monotonic pedagogical scaffolding, where language models receive gold-standard, case-relevant information across stages aligned with the canonical legal framework FIRAC — Facts, Issue, Rules, Application, Conclusion. By strictly adding solution-relevant content at each step, we introduce a controlled monotonic intervention that allows for the evaluation of reasoning trajectories rather than isolated outcomes.This longitudinal design enables the introduction of two transition-based diagnostics: Errors-to-Success (E2S) quantifies the guidance required to reach correctness, while Success-to-Errors (S2E) measures the fragility of that correctness under additional structure. These local patterns define a global robustness criterion termed Stable Accuracy, which credits a response only if the model maintains correctness throughout all scaffolding stages and enforces a higher bar for correctness by distinguishing sustained reasoning from transient patterns.We instantiate the framework on 3,123 Brazilian Bar Exam questions paired with expert-annotated explanations. Our findings reveal model instability patterns hidden from accuracy-only metrics and demonstrate that terminal accuracy systematically overestimates legal reasoning competence. To test the robustness of our diagnostics, we also evaluate a majority-vote aggregation across multiple reasoning samples, finding that the observed instability patterns persist under this stronger inference setting. Furthermore, principal component analysis indicates that legal domains cluster into distinct regions, suggesting systematic differences in reasoning demands across domains. While focused on the legal domain, our evaluation protocol is generalizable to any task with a staged reasoning structure.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代法律质量评估系统的研究方向正从单纯追求准确性转向对模型推理过程的综合分析。我们提出了一种基于单调教学法的诊断框架，语言模型在各个环节都会接收到与FIRAC标准法律框架——事实、问题、规则、应用、结论相一致的权威信息。通过在每个阶段严格添加与解决方案相关的内容，我们实现了一种可控的单调干预机制，从而能够评估模型的推理过程而非孤立的结果。这种纵向设计使得我们可以引入两种基于过渡情况的诊断方法：错误到成功（E2S）用于量化达到正确性的所需指导程度，而成功到错误（S2E）则用于衡量在额外约束条件下该正确性的稳定性。这些局部模式共同构成了所谓的“稳定准确性”这一全局鲁棒性标准——只有当模型在所有教学阶段都能保持正确性时，才会认为其具有稳定的准确性；同时，我们通过区分持续的推理模式和短暂的异常现象，对准确性的要求进行了提升。我们在3,123道巴西律师资格考试题目中实施了这一框架，并附有专家注释的解释文本。我们的研究发现揭示了那些仅通过准确性指标无法捕捉到的模型不稳定模式，并表明单纯的准确性评估会系统性地高估法律推理能力。为了验证我们诊断方法的鲁棒性，我们还对多个推理样本进行了多数投票聚合处理，发现即使在这样的强约束环境下，不稳定的模式仍然存在。此外，主成分分析表明，法律领域可以划分为不同的区域，这表明不同领域的推理需求存在系统性的差异。虽然我们的评估主要针对法律领域，但我们的评估方案同样适用于任何具有分阶段推理结构的任务。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Jailbreak-Zero: A Path to Pareto Optimal Red Teaming for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: Jailbreak-Zero：实现大型语言模型帕累托最优协作策略的路径
papers.authors: Kai Hu, Abhinav Aggarwal, Mehran Khodabandeh, David Zhang, Eric Hsin, Li Chen, Ankit Jain, Matt Fredrikson, Akash Bharadwaj
papers.abstract: This paper presents a novel Automated Red Teaming (ART) framework that shifts from example-based to policy-based evaluation, addressing critical limitations in scalability and validity. We define harmful content through abstract safety policies rather than specific static examples. We also introduce multiple evaluation objectives: risk coverage, semantic diversity, and fidelity, and discover Pareto trade-offs between them. We propose Jailbreak-Zero, a black-box method capable of both zero-shot generation and fine-tuned exploitation of a victim’s vulnerabilities to achieve Pareto optimality. Unlike prior approaches, it does not require expert-designed strategies/prompts, but still achieves superior, human-readable attacks against open-source and proprietary models (attack success rates of 99.5% against GPT-4o and 96.0% against Claude 3.5), even for unseen safety policies. It retains efficacy even after victim models undergo safety alignment, and exposes controls to navigate Pareto trade-offs without retraining. Lastly, we show that Jailbreak-Zero is the best-performing ART method at a given compute budget. Code is available at: https://github.com/hukkai/jailbreak-zero/ .
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的自动化红队攻击框架，该框架从基于示例的评估方式转变为基于策略的评估方式，从而解决了可扩展性和有效性的关键问题。我们通过抽象的安全策略来定义有害内容，而不是依赖具体的静态示例。我们还引入了多个评估目标：风险覆盖度、语义多样性以及攻击的逼真度，并发现了这些目标之间的帕累托权衡关系。我们提出了Jailbreak-Zero这一黑盒方法，它能够实现零样本生成以及针对受害者漏洞的精细攻击，从而达到帕累托最优状态。与以往的方法不同，该方法不需要专家设计的策略或提示，但仍然能够针对开源和专有模型实施高效的攻击（对GPT-4o的攻击成功率为99.5%，对Claude 3.5的成功率为96.0%），即使面对未知的安全策略也是如此。即使在受害者的模型经过安全对齐处理后，该方法依然保持有效性，并且允许攻击者在不进行重新训练的情况下调整帕累托权衡。最后，我们证明在一定的计算资源限制下，Jailbreak-Zero是性能最佳的自动化红队攻击方法。相关代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/hukkai/jailbreak-zero/
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Factual Retrieval in LLMs Is a Redundant, Distributed and Non-Contiguous Process
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型中获取事实信息是一个冗余的、分散的且不连续的过程
papers.authors: Hail Hochman, Natalie Shapira, Yoav Goldberg
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) store and recall factual knowledge, yet the precise mechanism of how entity representations are transformed to enable specific attribute retrieval remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate this mechanism through the lens of an “attribute-computation path”—a sequence of computational steps over the entity representation required to elicit a target attribute. We then propose an iterative patching protocol to identify a minimal subset of layers necessary for this computation. Applying our method to LLaMA 3.1 8B and Qwen 3 8B, we find that these paths are non-contiguous, often skipping layers, and that models possess multiple, functionally-equivalent paths for the same entity and fact, highlighting a high degree of redundancy in attribute computation. This implies that knowledge computation is highly distributed, potentially explaining the localization-editing mismatch and suggesting that knowledge storage and retrieval in LLMs is far from being well understood.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）能够存储和检索事实知识，但实体表示如何被转换以实现特定属性检索的精确机制仍未被充分研究。在这项研究中，我们通过“属性计算路径”这一视角来探讨这一机制——即从实体表示出发，经过一系列计算步骤以得出目标属性的过程。随后，我们提出了一种迭代拼接协议，以确定进行此计算所需的最小层子集。将我们的方法应用于LaLM3.1 8B和Qwen3 8B模型，我们发现这些路径并非连续不断，常常跳过某些层；而且，对于同一个实体和事实，模型拥有多个功能上等效的路径，这表明属性计算的冗余程度很高。这意味着知识计算是高度分散的，这可能解释了局部化与编辑之间的不匹配现象，并暗示LLM中的知识存储与检索机制远未得到充分理解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: What About the Scene With the Hitler Reference? HAUNT: A Framework to Probe LLMs’ Self-consistency in Closed Domains Via Adversarial Nudge
papers.title_zh: 那关于希特勒的情节呢？HAUNT：一个用于通过对抗性诱导来探究大型语言模型在封闭领域内自我一致性问题的框架
papers.authors: Arka Dutta, Sujan Dutta, Rijul Magu, Soumyajit Datta, Munmun De Choudhury, Ashiqur R. KhudaBukhsh
papers.abstract: Hallucinations pose a critical challenge to the real-world deployment of large language models (LLMs) in high-stakes domains. In this paper, we present a framework for stress testing factual fidelity in LLMs in the presence of adversarial nudge. Our framework consists of three steps. First, we instruct the LLM to produce sets of truths and lies consistent with the closed domain in question. Next, we instruct the LLM to verify the same set of assertions as truths and lies consistent with the same closed domain. Finally, we test the robustness of the LLM against the lies generated (and verified) by itself. Our extensive evaluation, conducted using five widely known proprietary and six open LLMs across two closed domains of popular movies and novels, reveals a wide range of susceptibility to adversarial nudges: even among the strongest proprietary LLMs, Claude exhibits strong resilience, GPT and Grok demonstrate moderate resilience, while Gemini and DeepSeek show weak resilience and open models fall short significantly.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉现象对大语言模型在高风险领域的实际应用构成了重大挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一个框架，用于在存在对抗性干扰的情况下，对大语言模型的真实性进行压力测试。我们的框架包含三个步骤：首先，我们指示大语言模型生成与特定封闭领域一致的真实和虚假信息集；其次，我们再次指示该模型验证这些信息集的真实性；最后，我们测试该模型对自身生成的虚假信息的抵抗能力。通过在使用五款知名专有模型和六款开源模型对两部热门电影和小说这两个封闭领域进行的广泛评估，我们发现不同模型对对抗性干扰的敏感度各不相同：即使是最强大的专有模型，Claude也表现出较强的抗干扰能力，而GPT和Grok则表现出中等程度的抗干扰能力。相比之下，Gemini和DeepSeek的抗干扰能力较弱，而开源模型则表现明显不足。
