papers.title: GitChameleon 2.0: Evaluating AI Code Generation Against Python Library Version Incompatibilities
papers.title_zh: GitChameleon 2.0：评估AI代码生成技术在处理Python库版本冲突时的表现
papers.authors: Diganta Misra, Nizar Islah, Victor May, Brice Rauby, Zihan Wang, Justine Gehring, Antonio Orvieto, Muawiz Sajjad Chaudhary, Eilif B. Muller, Irina Rish, Samira Ebrahimi Kahou, Massimo Caccia
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of software libraries poses a considerable hurdle for code generation, necessitating continuous adaptation to frequent version updates while preserving backward compatibility. While existing code evolution benchmarks provide valuable insights, they typically lack execution-based evaluation for generating code compliant with specific library versions. To address this, we introduce GitChameleon 2.0, a novel, meticulously curated dataset comprising 328 Python code completion problems, each conditioned on specific library versions and accompanied by executable unit tests. GitChameleon 2.0 rigorously evaluates the capacity of contemporary large language models (LLMs), LLM-powered agents, code assistants, and RAG systems to perform version-conditioned code generation that demonstrates functional accuracy through execution. Our extensive evaluations indicate that state-of-the-art systems encounter significant challenges with this task; enterprise models achieving baseline success rates in the 48-51% range, underscoring the intricacy of the problem. By offering an execution-based benchmark emphasizing the dynamic nature of code libraries, GitChameleon 2.0 enables a clearer understanding of this challenge and helps guide the development of more adaptable and dependable AI code generation methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 软件库的快速演变给代码生成带来了巨大的挑战，需要不断适应频繁的版本更新，同时保持向后兼容性。虽然现有的代码演化基准测试提供了宝贵的见解，但它们通常缺乏基于执行的评估，以生成符合特定库版本的代码。为了应对这一挑战，我们推出了GitChameleon 2.0，这是一个精心策划的新数据集，包含328个Python代码补全问题，每个问题都针对特定的库版本进行设计，并附有可执行的单元测试。GitChameleon 2.0能够严格评估当前大语言模型、基于LLM的代理、代码助手以及RAG系统在执行层面上进行版本依赖型代码生成的能力，从而确保生成的代码具有功能上的准确性。我们的广泛测试表明，最先进的系统在这一任务上面临着重大挑战；企业级模型在48-51%的成功率范围内勉强达到基线水平，这充分说明了这个问题的复杂性。通过提供一个强调代码库动态特性的基于执行的基准测试，GitChameleon 2.0有助于更清晰地理解这一挑战，并为开发更加灵活可靠的AI代码生成方法提供指导。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Knowledge without Wisdom: Measuring Misalignment between LLMs and Intended Impact
papers.title_zh: 知识而无智慧：衡量大型语言模型与预期效果之间的不匹配程度
papers.authors: Michael Hardy, Yunsung Kim
papers.abstract: LLMs increasingly excel on AI benchmarks, but doing so does not guarantee validity for downstream tasks. This study contrasts LLM alignment on benchmarks, downstream tasks, and, importantly the intended impact of those tasks. We evaluate the performance of leading LLMs (i.e., generative pre-trained base models) on difficult-to-verify tasks of the teaching and learning of schoolchildren. Across all LLMs, inter-model behaviors on disparate tasks correlate higher than they do with expert human behaviors on target tasks. These biases shared across LLMs are poorly aligned with downstream measures of teaching quality and often negatively aligned with the intended impact of student learning outcomes. Further, we find multi-model ensembles, both unanimous model voting and expert-weighting by benchmark performance, further exacerbate misalignment with learning. We measure that selection of LLM and/or prompting strategy only reliably accounts for 15% of all measured misalignment error and that variation in misalignment error is shared across LLMs, suggesting that common pretraining accounts for much of the misalignment in these tasks. We demonstrate methods for robustly measuring alignment of complex tasks and provide unique insights into practical applications of LLMs in high-noise contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在人工智能基准测试中表现越来越出色，但这一成绩并不能保证其在下游任务中的有效性。本研究对比了大语言模型在基准测试、下游任务中的表现，尤其是这些任务的预期影响。我们评估了领先的大语言模型（即生成式预训练基础模型）在儿童教学与学习这一难以验证的任务上的表现。在所有大语言模型中，不同任务之间的模型行为相关性高于它们与专家在目标任务上的行为相关性。这些跨模型的偏差与下游的教学质量指标并不一致，且往往会对学生学习的预期效果产生负面影响。此外，我们发现，无论是采用单一模型投票还是根据基准性能进行专家加权的方法，都会进一步加剧这种与学习效果的偏差。我们发现，仅通过选择合适的大语言模型和/或提示策略，能够解释大约15%的偏差误差，而偏差误差的差异在不同大语言模型中普遍存在，这表明共同的预训练过程在很大程度上导致了这些任务中的偏差问题。我们提出了一些方法来稳健地衡量复杂任务的对齐情况，并为大语言模型在高噪声环境下的实际应用提供了独特的见解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Apertus: Democratizing Open and Compliant LLMs for Global Language Environments
papers.title_zh: Apertus：让开放且兼容的大型语言模型走向全球语言环境
papers.authors: Alejandro Hernández-Cano, Alexander Hägele, Allen Hao Huang, Angelika Romanou, Antoni-Joan Solergibert, Barna Pásztor, Bettina Messmer, Dhia Garbaya, Eduard Frank Ďurech, Ido Hakimi, Juan Garcia Giraldo, Mete Ismayilzada, Negar Foroutan, Skander Moalla, Tiancheng Chen, Vinko Sabolčec, Yixuan Xu, Michael Aerni, Badr AlKhamissi, Inés Altemir Marinas, Mohammad Hossein Amani, Matin Ansaripour, Ilia Badanin, Harold Benoit, Emanuela Boros, Nicholas John Browning, Fabian Bösch, Maximilian Böther, Niklas Canova, Camille Challier, Clément Charmillot, Jonathan Coles, Jan Milan Deriu, Arnout Devos, Lukas Drescher, Daniil Dzenhaliou, Maud Ehrmann, Dongyang Fan, Simin Fan, Silin Gao, Miguel Gila, María Grandury, Diba Hashemi, Alexander Miserlis Hoyle, Jiaming Jiang, Mark Klein, Andrei Kucharavy, Anastasiia Kucherenko, Frederike Lübeck, Roman Machacek, Theofilos Ioannis Manitaras, Andreas Marfurt, Kyle Matoba, Simon Matrenok, Henrique Mendonça, Fawzi Roberto Mohamed, Syrielle Montariol, Luca Mouchel, Sven Najem-Meyer, Jingwei Ni, Gennaro Oliva, Matteo Pagliardini, Elia Palme, Andrei Panferov, Léo Paoletti, Marco Passerini, Ivan Pavlov, Auguste Poiroux, Kaustubh Ponkshe, Nathan Ranchin, Javier Rando, Mathieu Sauser, Jakhongir Saydaliev, Mukhammadali Sayfiddinov, Marian Schneider, Stefano Schuppli, Marco Scialanga, Andrei Semenov, Kumar Shridhar, Raghav Singhal, Anna Sotnikova, Alexander Sternfeld, Ayush Kumar Tarun, Paul Teiletche, Jannis Vamvas, Xiaozhe Yao, Hao Zhao, Alexander Ilic, Ana Klimovic, Andreas Krause, Caglar Gulcehre, David Rosenthal, Elliott Ash, Florian Tramèr, Joost VandeVondele, Livio Veraldi, Martin Rajman, Thomas C. Schulthess, Torsten Hoefler, Antoine Bosselut, Martin Jaggi, Imanol Schlag
papers.abstract: Open LLMs enable AI practitioners to control development costs by building on an existing foundation for downstream applications. While offering substantial promise, current models often fail to meet the needs of users needing open solutions aligned with responsible AI principles, including data compliance, transparency, and inclusivity. In this work, we present Apertus, a fully open suite of large language models (LLMs) designed to address responsibility shortcomings in today’s open model ecosystem, namely data responsibility and global representation. Unlike many prior models that release weights without reproducible data pipelines or regard for content-owner rights, Apertus models are pretrained exclusively on openly available data, retroactively respecting robots.txt exclusions and filtering for non-permissive, toxic, and personally identifiable content. To mitigate risks of data memorization, we also adopt the Goldfish objective during pretraining, strongly suppressing verbatim recall of data while retaining downstream task performance. Apertus also drastically expands multilingual coverage, training on 15T tokens from over approximately 1800 languages, with about 40% of pretraining data allocated to non-English content. Released at 8B and 70B scales, Apertus approaches state-of-the-art results among fully open models on multilingual benchmarks, rivaling or surpassing open-weight counterparts.
papers.abstract_zh: 开放式大语言模型让AI从业者能够通过基于现有基础来构建下游应用，从而控制开发成本。虽然这些模型具有巨大的潜力，但目前的模型往往无法满足那些需要符合负责任AI原则的开源解决方案的用户需求，这些原则包括数据合规性、透明度以及包容性。在这项研究中，我们提出了Apertus——一套完全开放的大语言模型套件，旨在解决当前开源模型生态系统中存在的责任缺失问题，尤其是数据责任和全球代表性方面的问题。与许多在发布权重时缺乏可复制的数据流程或不考虑内容所有者权利的模型不同，Apertus模型完全基于公开可用的数据进行预训练，同时会尊重robots.txt中的排除规则，并过滤掉非许可性、有害以及个人身份信息的内容。为了降低数据记忆的风险，我们在预训练过程中还采用了Goldfish目标函数，有效抑制了对数据的逐字引用，同时保留了下游任务的性能。Apertus还大幅扩展了多语言覆盖能力，在约1800种语言的数据上进行了训练，其中约40%的预训练数据来自非英语内容。Apertus在80亿和700亿规模下发布的模型，在多语言基准测试中取得了与最先进开源模型相当甚至更好的成绩。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reframing Responsibility: Framing-Aware Event Causality Identification
papers.title_zh: 重新定义责任：意识到的事件因果关系识别
papers.authors: Jin Zhao, Jiayi Yao, Xinrui Hu, Nianwen Xue
papers.abstract: Causal explanations in political narratives are often framed and contested. Different sources may explain the same event by assigning responsibility to different actors and expressing varying levels of certainty. Standard Event Causality Identification (ECI) focuses on detecting causal links and does not capture these distinctions. We introduce Framing-Aware Event Causality Identification (FrECI), a framing-aware extension of ECI that models causal explanations as structured claims including responsibility targets, evaluative framing, source type, and epistemic modality grounded in established framing theories. We construct a multilingual dataset aligned across English, Chinese, and Arabic narratives using shared event anchors. We evaluate FrECI using prompt-based large language model baselines and supervised neural models. Results show that prompt-based baselines struggle to recover complete framed causal claims, while joint supervised models perform substantially better. Finally, we demonstrate that FrECI enables quantitative analysis of divergent causal attribution across narratives.
papers.abstract_zh: 在政治叙事中，因果解释往往被不同地构建和质疑。不同的来源可能会通过将责任归咎于不同的行为者来解释同一事件，并且表达出不同的确定性程度。标准的事件因果关系识别方法主要关注于检测因果联系，而未能捕捉到这些差异。我们提出了一种名为“框架意识事件因果关系识别”的方法，这是一种对标准ECI的扩展，它将因果解释视为结构化的陈述，包括责任对象、评价性框架、信息源类型以及基于既定框架理论的知识模态。我们创建了一个多语言数据集，该数据集包含英语、中文和阿拉伯语叙事，并使用共享的事件锚点进行对齐。我们通过基于提示的大语言模型基准测试和监督神经模型来评估FrECI的性能。结果表明，基于提示的基准测试在恢复完整的框架化因果陈述方面存在困难，而联合监督模型则表现得更为出色。最后，我们证明了FrECI能够定量分析不同叙事中的不同因果归因。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Adaptive Instruction Composition for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
papers.title_zh: 适用于自动化LLM攻击防御的自适应指令组合技术
papers.authors: Jesse Zymet, Andy Luo, Swapnil Shinde, Sahil Wadhwa, Emily Chen
papers.abstract: Many approaches to LLM red-teaming leverage an attacker LLM to discover jailbreaks against a target. Several of them task the attacker with identifying effective strategies through trial and error, resulting in a semantically limited range of successes. Another approach discovers diverse attacks by combining crowdsourced harmful queries and tactics into instructions for the attacker, but does so at random, limiting effectiveness. This article introduces a novel framework, Adaptive Instruction Composition, that combines crowdsourced texts according to an adaptive mechanism trained to jointly optimize effectiveness with diversity. We use reinforcement learning to balance exploration with exploitation in a combinatorial space of instructions to guide the attacker toward diverse generations tailored to target vulnerabilities. We demonstrate that our approach substantially outperforms random combination on a set of effectiveness and diversity metrics, even under model transfer. Further, we show that it surpasses a host of recent adaptive approaches on Harmbench. We employ a lightweight neural contextual bandit that adapts to contrastive embedding inputs, and provide ablations suggesting that the contrastive pretraining enables the network to rapidly generalize and scale to the massive space as it learns.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多针对大语言模型红帽化攻击的方法都利用攻击者的大语言模型来发现针对目标的漏洞。其中一些方法要求攻击者通过反复试验来寻找有效的策略，但这会导致成功的策略范围非常有限。另一种方法则是通过将众包得出的有害查询和战术结合起来，为攻击者提供攻击指令，但这种方法的随机性限制了其效果。本文提出了一种新颖的框架——自适应指令组合，该框架根据一种自适应机制来组合众包文本，从而同时优化效果和多样性。我们采用强化学习技术，在指令的组合空间中平衡探索与利用，引导攻击者生成多样化的攻击方案，以针对目标漏洞进行攻击。我们的研究表明，即使在模型迁移的情况下，我们的方法在效果和多样性指标上仍然显著优于随机组合方法。此外，我们在Harmbench测试平台上证明，我们的方法在多个指标上均优于当前流行的自适应攻击方法。我们采用了一种轻量级的神经上下文带赌机模型，该模型能够适应对比度嵌入输入，并通过实验分析表明，这种对比度预训练使得网络能够在学习过程中快速泛化和扩展至庞大的空间。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CHOIR: Harmonizing Structured Persona Diversity for Robust Collaborative LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 合唱团：协调结构化角色多样性，以实现高效的协作式LLM推理
papers.authors: Xiangjue Dong, Cong Wang, Maria Teleki, Millennium Bismay, Ruihong Huang, James Caverlee
papers.abstract: Persona-assigned Large Language Models can adopt diverse roles, enabling personalized and context-aware reasoning. However, even minor demographic perturbations in personas, such as simple pronoun swaps, can alter reasoning trajectories, leading to divergent sets of correct answers on reasoning benchmarks. We explore the potential of these variations as a constructive resource to improve LLM reasoning performance. We propose CHOIR (Collaborative Harmonization fOr Inference Robustness), a test-time framework that harmonizes a set of demographically perturbed, persona-conditioned reasoning signals into a unified prediction. CHOIR orchestrates a collaborative decoding process among counterfactual personas perturbed across dimensions of gender, race, religion, disability, and age, dynamically balancing agreement and divergence in their reasoning paths to improve performance. Experiments demonstrate that CHOIR consistently enhances LLM reasoning across model architectures, scales, and tasks. Improvements reach up to 20.1% for individual groups and 15.1% on average, and we show that CHOIR remains effective even when base personas are suboptimal.
papers.abstract_zh: 角色化的大语言模型可以承担多种角色，从而实现个性化且基于上下文的推理。然而，即使是在角色层面进行微小的 demographic 调整，比如简单的代词替换，也可能改变推理路径，导致在推理基准测试中出现不同的正确答案。我们探索了这些变化作为提升 LLM 推理性能的一种建设性资源的潜力。我们提出了 CHOIR（用于提高推理鲁棒性的协作协调机制），这是一种在测试阶段使用的框架，它能够将经过 demographic 调整和角色条件化的推理信号整合成一个统一的预测结果。CHOIR 通过协同解码过程，协调不同性别、种族、宗教、残疾和年龄维度的反事实角色之间的推理，动态地平衡它们推理路径中的一致性和差异性，以提高性能。实验表明，CHOIR 能够持续提升不同模型架构、规模以及任务下的 LLM 推理能力。单个组的性能提升了 20.1%，平均而言则提升了 15.1%。我们还发现，即使基础角色设置并不理想，CHOIR 仍然能够有效发挥作用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TabReX: Tabular Referenceless eXplainable Evaluation
papers.title_zh: TabReX：表格式、无需参考即可理解的评估方法
papers.authors: Tejas Anvekar, Junha Park, Aparna Garimella, Vivek Gupta
papers.abstract: Evaluating the quality of tables generated by large language models (LLMs) remains an open challenge: existing metrics either flatten tables into text, ignoring structure, or rely on fixed references that limit generalization. We present TabReX, a reference-less, property-driven framework for evaluating tabular generation via graph-based reasoning. TabReX converts both source text and generated tables into canonical knowledge graphs, aligns them through an LLM-guided matching process, and computes interpretable, rubric-aware scores that quantify structural and factual fidelity. The resulting metric provides controllable trade-offs between sensitivity and specificity, yielding human-aligned judgments and cell-level error traces. To systematically asses metric robustness, we introduce TabReX-Bench, a large-scale benchmark spanning six domains and twelve planner-driven perturbation types across three difficulty tiers. Empirical results show that TabReX achieves the highest correlation with expert rankings, remains stable under harder perturbations, and enables fine-grained model-vs-prompt analysis establishing a new paradigm for trustworthy, explainable evaluation of structured generation systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型生成的表格质量仍然是一个未解决的挑战：现有的评估方法要么将表格内容简化为文本，从而忽略了表格的结构；要么依赖于固定的参考标准，这限制了模型的泛化能力。我们提出了TabReX这一基于图推理的、无需参考标准的表格生成评估框架。TabReX能够将源文本和生成的表格转换为规范化的知识图谱，并通过一个由大语言模型引导的匹配过程对它们进行对齐，进而计算出可解释且包含评分标准的分数，以量化表格的结构性和事实准确性。该评估方法能够在敏感性和特异性之间实现可控的平衡，能够得出与人类判断相一致的评估结果，并能够追踪单元格级别的错误情况。为了系统地评估该评估方法的鲁棒性，我们开发了TabReX-Bench这一大规模基准测试，该测试涵盖了六个领域和十二种由规划器驱动的扰动类型，以及三个难度等级。实验结果表明，TabReX与专家评测结果具有最高的相关性，即使在更复杂的扰动条件下也能保持稳定，同时还能实现针对模型和提示的细致分析，为可信且可解释的结构化生成系统评估提供了新的范式。

papers.title: DREAM-S: Speculative Decoding with Searchable Drafting and Target-Aware Refinement for Multimodal Generation
papers.title_zh: DREAM-S：用于多模态生成的推测性解码技术，包含可搜索的草案生成以及目标感知的优化机制
papers.authors: Zining Liu, Yunhai Hu, Tianhua Xia, BO Bao, Eric Sather, Vithursan Thangarasa, Sai Qian Zhang
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) has proven to be an effective technique for accelerating autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs), however its application to vision-language models (VLMs) remains relatively unexplored. We propose DREAM-S, a novel SD framework designed specifically for fast and efficient decoding in VLMs. DREAM-S leverages a neural architecture search (NAS) framework with target-aware supernet training to automatically identify both the optimal interaction strategy between the draft and target models, and the most suitable draft model architecture for the underlying hardware implementation platform. DREAM-S additionally incorporates adaptive intermediate feature distillation, guided by attention entropy, to enable efficient draft training. Experiments on a range of well-established VLMs show that DREAM-S achieves up to a 3.85\times speedup compared to standard decoding approaches and significantly outperforms existing SD baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 推测性解码（SD）已被证明是加速大语言模型（LLM）中自回归生成的有效技术，不过其在视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的应用却相对较少被研究。我们提出了DREAM-S这一新型SD框架，该框架专为在VLM中实现快速高效的解码而设计。DREAM-S采用了一种神经架构搜索（NAS）框架，并结合了目标感知超网络训练技术，能够自动确定草稿模型与目标模型之间的最佳交互策略，以及最适合底层硬件平台的草稿模型架构。此外，DREAM-S还引入了自适应中间特征蒸馏技术，该技术以注意力熵为引导，从而实现高效的草稿模型训练。在一系列成熟的VLM上进行实验表明，与标准解码方法相比，DREAM-S的加速效果高达3.85倍，且显著优于现有的SD基线算法。

papers.title: Revisiting Non-Verbatim Memorization in Large Language Models: The Role of Entity Surface Forms
papers.title_zh: 重新审视大型语言模型中的非文本记忆机制：实体表面形式的作用
papers.authors: Yuto Nishida, Naoki Shikoda, Yosuke Kishinami, Ryo Fujii, Makoto Morishita, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Taro Watanabe
papers.abstract: Understanding what kinds of factual knowledge large language models (LLMs) memorize is essential for evaluating their reliability and limitations.Entity-based QA is a common framework for analyzing non-verbatim memorization, but typical evaluations query each entity using a single canonical surface form, making it difficult to disentangle fact memorization from access through a particular name.We introduce RedirectQA, an entity-based QA dataset that uses Wikipedia redirect information to associate Wikidata factual triples with categorized surface forms for each entity, including alternative names, abbreviations, spelling variants, and common erroneous forms.Across 13 LLMs, we examine surface-conditioned factual memorization and find that prediction outcomes often change when only the entity surface form changes.This inconsistency is category-dependent: models are more robust to minor orthographic variations than to larger lexical variations such as aliases and abbreviations.Frequency analyses further suggest that both entity- and surface-level frequencies are associated with accuracy, and that entity frequency often contributes beyond surface frequency.Overall, factual memorization appears neither purely surface-specific nor fully surface-invariant, highlighting the importance of surface-form diversity in evaluating non-verbatim memorization.
papers.abstract_zh: 了解大语言模型所记忆的事实知识类型，对于评估它们的可靠性和局限性至关重要。基于实体的问答是一种常用的分析非逐字记忆的框架，但典型的评估方法会使用单一的规范表面形式来查询每个实体，这使得难以区分事实的记忆与通过特定名称进行访问的情况。我们引入了RedirectQA这一基于实体的问答数据集，该数据集利用维基百科的重定向信息，将Wikidata中的事实三元组与每个实体的分类表面形式相关联，包括替代名称、缩写、拼写变体以及常见的错误形式。在13个大语言模型上，我们研究了表面条件化的事实记忆现象，发现当仅改变实体的表面形式时，预测结果往往会发生变化。这种不一致性取决于类别：模型对较小的正字法变化更为敏感，而对诸如别名和缩写这样的较大词汇变化则不太敏感。频率分析进一步表明，实体级别和表面级别的频率都与准确性相关，而且实体频率往往对准确性有更大的贡献。总体而言，事实记忆既不是完全依赖于表面形式的，也不是完全不受表面形式影响的，这凸显了在评估非逐字记忆时，表面形式多样性的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ChatAnime: Towards User-Centered Emotional Support in LLM-based Virtual Character Chat
papers.title_zh: ChatAnime：迈向基于大语言模型的虚拟角色聊天中的以用户为中心的情感支持服务
papers.authors: Lanlan Qiu, Sophia Xiao Pu, Yeqi Feng, Wenchang Gao, Tianxing He
papers.abstract: With the growing popularity of virtual character platforms like Character.AI, users are increasingly turning to role-playing agents for emotional support in daily life. Yet existing research mainly focuses on character consistency in fictional or game-based scenarios, overlooking user-centered interactions such as companionship and psychological support. To bridge this gap, we propose Emotionally Supportive Role-Playing (ESRP), a framework designed to align role-playing with real-world user scenarios and emotional needs. We focus on typical users of these platforms, i.e., anime enthusiasts—including students, office workers, freelancers, and self-employed individuals—and design scenario-based questions that reflect their everyday struggles such as work stress and social loneliness. Through a two-round data collection involving 40 anime fans and 10 Large Language Models (LLMs), we build ChatAnime: the first ESRP dataset with 2,400 human-written and 24,000 LLM-generated responses, supported by over 132,000 fine-grained human annotations. We also provide the ESRP evaluation framework featuring 9 fine-grained metrics across three dimensions: basic dialogue, role-playing and emotional support, along with an overall metric for diversity. Experimental results under our evaluation setting show that top-performing LLMs surpass anime fans in role-playing and emotional support, while humans still lead in diversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着像Character.AI这样的虚拟角色平台越来越受欢迎，用户们在日常生活中越来越多地依赖角色扮演代理来获得情感支持。然而，现有的研究主要集中在虚构或游戏化场景中的角色一致性上，而忽视了诸如陪伴和心理支持等以用户为中心的互动需求。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了“情感支持型角色扮演”框架，该框架旨在将角色扮演与现实世界中的用户场景和情感需求相结合。我们重点关注这些平台的典型用户，即动漫爱好者——包括学生、办公室工作人员、自由职业者和个体经营者——并设计了反映他们日常困扰的基于场景的问题，例如工作压力和社会孤独感。通过两轮数据收集，涉及40名动漫爱好者和10个大语言模型，我们构建了ChatAnime：这是第一个包含2,400条人工编写回复和24,000条由大语言模型生成的回复的ESRP数据集，并得到了超过132,000条细粒度的人类注释支持。我们还提供了ESRP评估框架，包含三个维度的9个细粒度指标：基本对话、角色扮演和情感支持，以及用于衡量多样性的综合指标。在我们的评估设置下进行的实验结果显示，表现最佳的大语言模型在角色扮演和情感支持方面超越了动漫爱好者，而人类在多样性方面仍然处于领先地位。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DyBBT: Dynamic Balance via Bandit-inspired Targeting for Dialog Policy with Cognitive Dual Systems
papers.title_zh: DyBBT：通过受“强盗”算法启发的目标定位机制来实现动态平衡，从而优化具有认知双系统的对话策略
papers.authors: Shuyu Zhang, Yifan Wei, Jialuo Yuan, Xinru Wang, Yanmin Zhu, Yujie Liu, Bin Li
papers.abstract: Task oriented dialog systems often rely on static exploration strategies that do not adapt to dynamic dialog contexts, leading to inefficient exploration and suboptimal performance. We propose DyBBT, a novel dialog policy learning framework that formalizes the exploration challenge through a structured cognitive state space \mathcal{C} that captures dialog progression, user uncertainty, and slot dependency. DyBBT proposes a bandit-inspired meta-controller that dynamically switches between a fast intuitive inference (System 1) and a slow deliberative reasoner (System 2) based on real-time cognitive states and visitation counts. Extensive experiments on single- and multi-domain benchmarks show that DyBBT achieves SOTA performance in success rate, efficiency, and generalization, with human evaluations confirming that its decisions are well-aligned with expert judgment.
papers.abstract_zh: 任务导向的对话系统通常依赖于静态的探索策略，这些策略无法适应动态的多轮对话环境，从而导致探索效率低下以及性能不佳。我们提出了DyBBT这一新颖的对话策略学习框架，该框架通过结构化的认知状态空间$\mathcal{C}$来规范化探索过程，该空间能够捕捉对话的进展、用户的不确定性以及槽位之间的依赖关系。DyBBT采用一种受“赌博机”启发设计的元控制器，能够根据实时认知状态和访问次数在快速直观的推理方式（系统1）和缓慢的理性思考方式（系统2）之间动态切换。在单域和多域基准测试中的大量实验表明，DyBBT在成功率、效率和泛化能力方面均达到了最佳水平，而人类评估也证实其决策与专家判断高度一致。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SciPedia: Unlocking the Value of Scientific Data for Pre-training
papers.title_zh: SciPedia：释放科学数据在预训练中的价值
papers.authors: Yiwei Qin, Zhen Huang, Tiantian Mi, Weiye Si, Qipeng Guo, Siyuan Feng, Pengfei Liu
papers.abstract: High-quality scientific data is critical for advancing LLMs, yet academic literature remains largely underutilized. This work addresses the fundamental question: How can we systematically unlock scientific data’s value for pre-training? First, we construct a large-scale raw scientific corpus but identify a critical Learnability Gap, revealing that direct pre-training yields negligible gains. To bridge this, we develop a multi-stage pipeline featuring content cleaning and pedagogical augmentation, resulting in SciPedia, a 900B-token corpus. Finally, we establish a controlled verification framework: we develop SciPedia-Eval benchmark and conduct 600B tokens of continued pre-training (CPT) starting from transparent base models (3B/7B) trained from scratch. Compared to a CPT baseline trained with general-purpose data, our approach with SciPedia data boosts average performance by +2.12 (3B) and +2.95 (7B), reaching +5.60 and +8.40 on in-domain tasks. This setup further allows us to derive empirical guidelines for data composition and model configurations.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量的科学数据对于推动大语言模型的进步至关重要，然而学术文献却大多未被充分利用。本研究旨在解决一个根本性问题：如何系统地挖掘科学数据的价值以用于预训练？首先，我们构建了一个大规模的原始科学语料库，但发现存在一个关键的学习能力差距，表明直接进行预训练并不能带来显著的提升。为了弥补这一不足，我们开发了一种多阶段流程，包括内容清洗和教育性增强处理，最终得到了SciPedia这一包含9000亿个令牌的语料库。最后，我们建立了一个可控的验证框架：我们开发了SciPedia-Eval基准测试，并对6000亿个令牌进行了持续预训练，这些令牌是从从头开始训练的透明基础模型（3B/7B）中获得的。与使用通用数据进行持续预训练相比，我们使用SciPedia数据进行预训练后，平均性能分别提升了2.12（3B）和2.95（7B），在领域任务上的性能分别达到了+5.60和+8.40。这一方法还使我们能够推导出关于数据组成和模型配置的经验性指导原则。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Word Sequences to Behavioral Sequences: Adapting Modeling and Evaluation Paradigms for Longitudinal NLP
papers.title_zh: 从词语序列到行为序列：为纵向自然语言处理调整建模与评估方法
papers.authors: Adithya V Ganesan, Vasudha Varadarajan, Oscar Kjell, Whitney Ringwald, Scott M. Feltman, Benjamin J. Luft, Roman Kotov, Ryan L. Boyd, H. Andrew Schwartz
papers.abstract: While NLP typically treats documents as independent and unordered samples, in longitudinal studies, this assumption rarely holds: documents are nested within authors and ordered in time, forming person-indexed, time-ordered \textit{behavioral sequences}.Here, we demonstrate the need for and propose a longitudinal modeling and evaluation paradigm that consequently updates four parts of the NLP pipeline: (1) evaluation splits aligned to generalization over people (\textit{cross-sectional}) and/or time (\textit{prospective}); (2) accuracy metrics separating between-person differences from within-person dynamics; (3) sequence inputs to incorporate history by default; and (4) model internals that support different \textit{coarseness} of latent state over histories (pooled summaries, explicit dynamics, or interaction-based models).We demonstrate the issues ensued by traditional pipeline and our proposed improvements on a dataset of 17k daily diary transcripts paired with PTSD symptom severity from 238 participants, finding that traditional document-level evaluation can yield substantially different and sometimes reversed conclusions compared to our ecologically valid modeling and evaluation. We tie our results to a broader discussion motivating a shift from word-sequence evaluation toward \textit{behavior-sequence} paradigms for NLP.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然自然语言处理通常将文档视为独立且无序的样本，但在纵向研究中，这一假设很少成立：文档实际上是嵌套在作者个体内部的，并且按照时间顺序进行排序，形成了以人为索引、按时间顺序排列的“行为序列”。在这里，我们强调了采用纵向建模与评估方法的必要性，并提出了一种相应的模型框架。该框架能够更新自然语言处理流程中的四个环节：(1)评估分割方式应兼顾对不同人群和时间的泛化能力；(2)准确率指标应能区分个体间的差异与个体内部的行为动态；(3)序列输入应默认包含历史信息；(4)模型内部结构应支持在历史数据上实现不同“粗糙度”的潜在状态表示（如汇总摘要、显式动态描述或基于交互的模型）。我们通过一个包含17千份日常日记记录的数据集进行了实验验证，这些记录与238名参与者的PTSD症状严重程度相关联。结果表明，传统的文档级评估方式往往会导致截然不同的结论，有时甚至与我们的生态有效建模与评估方法产生相反的结果。我们将这些结果与更广泛的讨论联系起来，这些讨论呼吁从词序列评估转向行为序列范式来处理自然语言处理问题。

papers.title: Why Mean Pooling Works: Quantifying Second-Order Collapse in Text Embeddings
papers.title_zh: 为什么“平均池化”方法有效：量化文本嵌入中的二阶崩溃现象
papers.authors: Tomomasa Hara, Hiroto Kurita, Masaaki Imaizumi, Kentaro Inui, Sho Yokoi
papers.abstract: For constructing text embeddings, mean pooling, which averages token embeddings, is the standard approach. This paper examines whether mean pooling actually works well in real models. First, we note that mean pooling can collapse information beyond the first-order statistics of the token embeddings, such as second-order statistics that capture their spatial structure, potentially mapping distinct token embedding distributions to similar text embeddings. Motivated by this concern, we propose a simple metric to quantify such a collapse induced by mean pooling. Then, using this metric, we empirically measure how often this collapse occurs in actual models and texts, and find that modern text encoders are robust to this collapse. In particular, contrastive fine-tuned text encoders tend to be less prone to the collapse than their pretrained backbone models. We also find that the robustness of these text encoders lies in the concentration of token embeddings within each text. In addition, we find that robustness to the collapse, as quantified by our proposed metric, correlates with downstream task performance. Overall, our findings offer a new perspective on why modern text encoders remain effective despite relying on seemingly coarse mean pooling.
papers.abstract_zh: 在构建文本嵌入时，平均池化是一种标准方法，它会对词嵌入进行平均处理。本文探讨了平均池化在实际模型中是否真的有效。首先，我们注意到平均池化可能会忽略一些信息，这些信息超出了词嵌入的一阶统计特征，比如能够捕捉空间结构的二阶统计特征，这可能导致不同的词嵌入分布被映射到相似的文本嵌入上。基于这一担忧，我们提出了一种简单的度量方法来量化由平均池化引起的这种信息丢失现象。然后，利用这一度量方法，我们实证研究了这种现象在实际模型和文本中出现的频率，发现现代文本编码器对这种现象具有鲁棒性。特别是，经过对比度微调的文本编码器比其预训练的骨干模型更不容易出现这种信息丢失现象。我们还发现，这些文本编码器的鲁棒性在于它们能够集中处理每个文本中的词嵌入。此外，我们发现，根据我们所提出的度量方法所衡量的对信息丢失现象的鲁棒性，与下游任务的性能之间存在关联。总体而言，我们的研究结果为我们理解为什么现代文本编码器尽管依赖于看似粗糙的平均池化技术，却仍然能够保持有效性提供了新的视角。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Self-Guided Alignment: Adaptive Preference Sensing for Multi-Objective Generation
papers.title_zh: 自主导航对齐：用于多目标优化的自适应偏好感知技术
papers.authors: Ning Wang, Zhanyang Liu, Taotao Zhou, Xinrui Zhang, Zongru Shao, Haojie Zhou
papers.abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with diverse and potentially conflicting human values necessitates navigating complex multi-objective landscapes. However, existing prompt-conditioned approaches face a critical training-inference discrepancy: they rely on ground-truth scores during training while requiring manual user-specification at inference. We introduce prediction of implicit preferences to bridge this gap while reducing user burden. To this end, we propose Self-Guided Alignment (SGA), a framework that transforms passive reward dependency into an intrinsic adaptive sensing capability. It employs a dual-head architecture to unify preference internalization with conditional generation, enabling the model to learn a latent mapping between raw prompts and preference profiles. Through adaptive preference sensing, the model autonomously predicts the latent preference score to self-guide the generation, thereby eliminating the need for manual specification at inference. Extensive experiments across diverse model scales demonstrate that SGA often outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior multi-objective trade-offs and improved preference alignment. Code is available at https://github.com/python-yyds/SGA.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型与多样且可能存在冲突的人类价值观进行对齐，需要应对复杂的多目标问题。然而，现有的基于提示条件化的方法存在一个关键的问题：它们在训练阶段依赖真实的评分结果，而在推理阶段则需要用户手动指定参数。我们提出了一种预测隐性偏好的方法，以弥补这一差距，同时减少用户的负担。为此，我们提出了自引导对齐框架（SGA），该框架将被动的奖励依赖转化为内在的自适应感知能力。它采用双头部架构，将偏好内化与条件生成相结合，使模型能够学习到原始提示与偏好 profile 之间的潜在映射关系。通过自适应偏好感知，模型能够自主预测潜在的偏好分数，从而自行指导生成过程，无需在推理阶段进行手动指定。在多种模型规模上的广泛实验表明，SGA通常优于最先进的基线方法，能够实现更好的多目标权衡和更优的偏好对齐效果。代码可访问于https://github.com/python-yyds/SGA。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ReasMark: A Robust Watermark for Attributing LLM Reasoning Under Knowledge Distillation Attacks
papers.title_zh: ReasMark：一种强大的水印技术，可用于在知识蒸馏攻击下仍准确追踪大语言模型的推理过程
papers.authors: Peizhuo Lv, Ruihua Zhou, Yunpeng Li, Ruigang Liang, Xingshuo Han, XiaoFeng Wang, Wei Dong, Yuling Liu
papers.abstract: Reasoning-enhanced large language models rely on intermediate reasoning signals to solve complex, multi-step tasks, making reasoning behavior a valuable form of intellectual property. Meanwhile, knowledge distillation enables an adversary to replicate this behavior in a realistic black-box setting by repeatedly querying a deployed model on a target domain and training a local student to imitate its outputs, including reasoning traces. Existing LLM watermarks primarily operate on surface text and decoding-time token biases, and thus fail to provide reliable attribution of reasoning behavior once it is transferred through knowledge distillation. ReasMark entangles the watermark with the target-domain input distribution by selecting watermark tokens from high-frequency prompts, so distillation queries naturally activate it. It then embeds the watermark by score-conditioned losses that create a detectable reasoning-length gap for black-box verification. Comprehensive experiments across multiple LLMs, datasets, and distillation settings demonstrate that ReasMark consistently outperforms existing baselines while preserving task utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于推理增强的大语言模型依靠中间推理信号来解决复杂的多步骤任务，因此推理行为成为一种有价值的知识产权形式。同时，知识蒸馏使得对手能够在真实的黑箱环境中复制这种行为——通过反复对目标领域中的部署模型进行查询，并训练一个本地模型来模仿其输出，包括推理过程。现有的大语言模型水印主要作用于表面文本和解码时的令牌偏见，因此当推理行为通过知识蒸馏传递时，它们无法提供可靠的推理行为归属信息。ReasMark通过将水印令牌从高频提示中选择出来，将水印与目标领域的输入分布相结合，从而使蒸馏查询能够自然激活水印。接着，它通过基于得分的损失函数来嵌入水印，从而创造出可检测的推理长度差异，便于进行黑箱验证。在多种大语言模型、数据集和蒸馏设置下的综合实验表明，ReasMark在保持任务实用性的同时，始终优于现有的基线方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: One Single Hub Text Breaks CLIP: Identifying Vulnerabilities in Cross-Modal Encoders via Hubness
papers.title_zh: 一个单中心文本断点剪辑：通过中心性来识别跨模式编码中的漏洞
papers.authors: Hiroyuki Deguchi, Katsuki Chousa, Yusuke Sakai
papers.abstract: The hubness problem, in which hub embeddings are close to many unrelated examples, occurs often in high-dimensional embedding spaces and may pose a practical threat for purposes such as information retrieval and automatic evaluation metrics.In particular, since cross-modal similarity between text and images cannot be calculated by direct comparisons, such as string matching, cross-modal encoders that project different modalities into a shared space are helpful for various cross-modal applications, and thus, the existence of hubs may pose practical threats.To reveal the vulnerabilities of cross-modal encoders, we propose a method for identifying the hub embedding and its corresponding hub text.Experiments on image captioning evaluation in MSCOCO and nocaps along with image-to-text retrieval tasks in MSCOCO and Flickr30k showed that our method can identify a single hub text that unreasonably achieves comparable or higher similarity scores than human-written reference captions in many images, thereby revealing the vulnerabilities in cross-modal encoders.
papers.abstract_zh: 枢纽性问题在高维嵌入空间中经常出现，即枢纽嵌入与许多无关的样本过于接近，这可能会对信息检索和自动评估指标等应用造成实际威胁。特别是，由于文本与图像之间的跨模态相似性无法通过直接比较（如字符串匹配）来计算，因此将不同模态投影到同一空间中的跨模态编码器对于各种跨模态应用非常有用。然而，枢纽的存在可能会带来实际威胁。为了揭示跨模态编码器的脆弱性，我们提出了一种识别枢纽嵌入及其对应枢纽文本的方法。在MSCOCO中的图像描述任务以及nocaps任务，以及MSCOCO和Flickr30k中的图像到文本检索任务上的实验表明，我们的方法能够识别出单个枢纽文本，该文本在许多图像中获得的相似度得分远高于人工编写的参考描述，从而揭示了跨模态编码器的脆弱性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Awakening Dormant Experts:Counterfactual Routing to Mitigate MoE Hallucinations
papers.title_zh: 唤醒沉睡的专家：反事实路由技术，以缓解MoE引发的幻觉问题
papers.authors: Wentao Hu, Yanbo Zhai, Xiaohui Hu, Mingkuan Zhao, Shanhong yu, Xue Liu, Kaidong Yu, Shuangyong Song, Xuelong Li
papers.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have achieved remarkable scalability, yet they remain vulnerable to hallucinations, particularly when processing long-tail knowledge. We identify that this fragility stems from static Top-k routing: routers tend to favor high-frequency patterns over rare factual associations. Consequently, “specialist experts” possessing critical long-tail knowledge are often assigned low gating scores and remain “dormant”—under-prioritized for specific tokens despite their proven causal importance on other inputs. To address this, we propose Counterfactual Routing (CoR), a training-free inference framework designed to awaken these dormant experts. CoR integrates layer-wise perturbation analysis with the Counterfactual Expert Impact (CEI) metric to dynamically shift computational resources from syntax-dominant to knowledge-intensive layers while maintaining a constant total activation count, effectively retrieving causally decisive experts via virtual ablation. Extensive experiments on TruthfulQA, FACTOR, and TriviaQA demonstrate that CoR improves factual accuracy by 3.1% on average without increasing the inference budget, establishing a superior Pareto frontier compared to static scaling strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 稀疏混合专家模型在可扩展性方面取得了显著成就，但仍然存在易受幻觉影响的问题，尤其是在处理长尾知识时。我们发现，这种脆弱性源于静态的Top-k路由机制：路由器倾向于优先选择高频模式，而忽视罕见的事实关联。因此，那些拥有关键长尾知识的“专家”往往会被赋予较低的门控分数，从而处于“休眠”状态——尽管这些知识对其他输入具有显著的因果重要性，但它们却得不到足够的优先级。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了反事实路由算法。该算法是一种无需训练的推理框架，旨在唤醒这些休眠的专家。反事实路由算法结合了逐层扰动分析与反事实专家影响指标，能够动态地将计算资源从以语法为主的部分转移到以知识密集型部分为重心，同时保持总激活数的恒定。通过虚拟剔除的方式，能够有效识别出在因果关系上起决定作用的专家。在TruthfulQA、FACTOR和TriviaQA等任务上的广泛实验表明，反事实路由算法平均可将事实准确性提高3.1%，且不会增加推理成本。与静态扩展策略相比，反事实路由算法在优化效率方面表现更为优越。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Characterizing and Evaluating Working Emotion Vocabularies in Multilingual Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 对多语言大型语言模型中的工作情感词汇进行特征描述与评估
papers.authors: Nicholas Deas, Ivan Ernesto Perez Mejia, Ellie Yang, Kathleen McKeown
papers.abstract: Prior work evaluating emotion and affective understanding in large language models (LLMs) typically rely on predetermined label sets or focus on a singular evaluation task (e.g., emotion detection). We consider affective states, referring to the much broader variety of terms people use to label their emotional experiences. We evaluate multilingual language models’ understanding of affective states in English and Spanish through three different tasks: 1) identification, where models predict an affective state given text, 2) expression, where models generate text expressing a given affective state, and 3) verification, where models report whether a given term refers to an affective state. We show that performance on one task is not necessarily predictive of performance on another. Using these three tasks, we then begin to explore when and why models struggle to understand particular affective states compared to others. We examine systematic patterns in the affective state terms that are well and poorly understood by models, characterizing the working emotion vocabulary of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 之前关于大语言模型在情感与情绪理解方面的研究，通常依赖于预先设定的标签集，或者只专注于某一特定的评估任务（例如情绪检测）。我们在这里考虑的是“情感状态”，指的是人们用来描述自己情绪体验的更为广泛的术语类别。我们通过三项不同的任务来评估多语言语言模型对英语和西班牙语中情感状态的理解能力：1）识别任务，即模型根据文本预测出对应的情感状态；2）表达任务，即模型生成表示特定情感状态的文本；3）验证任务，即模型判断某个术语是否指代某种情感状态。我们发现，某一任务的性能并不一定能够预示其他任务的性能。通过这三项任务，我们开始探索模型为何难以理解某些情感状态，以及何时会出现这种困难。我们还研究了模型中对于情感状态术语的认知规律，从而揭示了大语言模型所掌握的“工作情感词汇”的特点。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: HalluCitation Matters: Revealing the Impact of Hallucinated References with 300 Hallucinated Papers in ACL Conferences
papers.title_zh: 《幻觉引用的影响：通过300篇涉及幻觉内容的论文揭示幻觉性引用的影响》——在ACL会议上探讨这一现象的影响
papers.authors: Yusuke Sakai, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Taro Watanabe
papers.abstract: Recently, we have often observed hallucinated citations or references that do not correspond to any existing work in papers under review, preprints, or published papers. Such hallucinated citations pose a serious concern to scientific reliability. When they appear in accepted papers, they may also negatively affect the credibility of conferences. In this study, we refer to hallucinated citations as “HalluCitation” and systematically investigate their prevalence and impact. We analyze all papers published at ACL, NAACL, and EMNLP in 2024 and 2025, including main conference, Findings, and workshop papers. Our analysis reveals that nearly 300 papers contain at least one HalluCitation, most of which were published in 2025. Notably, half of these papers were identified at EMNLP 2025, the most recent conference, indicating that this issue is rapidly increasing. Moreover, more than 100 such papers were accepted as main conference and Findings papers at EMNLP 2025, affecting the credibility.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，我们经常发现一些与现有研究无关的虚假引用或参考文献。这类虚假引用严重影响了科学的可靠性。当这些虚假引用出现在已接受的论文中时，还会对会议的可信度产生负面影响。在这项研究中，我们将这类虚假引用称为“HalluCitation”，并系统地研究了它们的普遍性和影响程度。我们分析了2024年和2025年发表在ACL、NAACL和EMNLP上的所有论文，包括主会议论文、成果论文以及研讨会论文。分析结果显示，近300篇论文至少包含一篇HalluCitation，其中大部分论文发表于2025年。值得注意的是，这些论文中有一半是在最近的会议EMNLP 2025上被发现的，这表明这个问题的严重性正在迅速增加。此外，在EMNLP 2025上，还有超过100篇论文被作为主会议论文或成果论文接受，这进一步影响了会议的可信度。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Solve-Detect-Verify: Inference-Time Scaling with Flexible Generative Verifier
papers.title_zh: 解决—检测—验证：基于灵活生成式验证器的推理时间缩放技术
papers.authors: Jianyuan Zhong, Zeju Li, Zhijian Xu, Xiangyu Wen, Kezhi Li, Qiang Xu
papers.abstract: Complex reasoning with Large Language Models (LLMs) demands a careful balance between accuracy and computational cost. Verification is crucial for reliability but faces trade-off: robust process-based verifiers are computationally prohibitive, while fast verifiers lack precision. We introduce flexive, a unified generative verifier designed to navigate this trade-off by dynamically allocating compute between rapid fast thinking and deliberative slow thinking. A key innovation is our training strategy: we use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to specifically enhance the reliability of the fast mode. This targeted training generalizes effectively, elevating the slow mode to state-of-the-art open-source performance. To deploy flexive, we propose the solve-detect-verify (SDV) pipeline. Moving beyond static Best-of-N ranking, SDV employs an iterative refinement process that utilizes likelihood-based probing to detect solution completion, curtailing overthinking, and leverages flexive’s feedback for targeted correction. Solve-detect-verify establishes a new open-source state-of-the-art on ProcessBench, outperforming GenPRM-32B while requiring ~2.3x fewer TFLOPS and 15x less training data. On AIME 2024, the full SDV pipeline achieves 83.3% accuracy, surpassing strong baselines while using significantly fewer tokens.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型（LLMs）中进行复杂的推理需要精确性与计算成本之间的巧妙平衡。验证对于确保模型的可靠性至关重要，但面临着一个权衡问题：虽然基于过程的强大验证方法在计算上代价高昂，但快速验证方法却缺乏精确度。我们提出了flexive这一统一的生成式验证工具，它能够通过动态分配计算资源来平衡这两种需求，从而有效应对这种权衡问题。我们的关键创新在于训练策略：我们采用群体相对政策优化算法，专门用于提升快速模式的可靠性。这种有针对性的训练方式能够有效泛化，使慢速模式达到最先进的开源性能水平。为了部署flexive，我们提出了solve-detect-verify（SDV）流程。与传统的静态最佳排名方式不同，SDV采用了迭代细化过程，利用基于似然的探测方法来检测解决方案的完整性，避免不必要的过度思考，并利用flexive的反馈进行有针对性的修正。在ProcessBench测试上，solve-detect-verify建立了新的开源最先进水平，其性能优于GenPRM-32B，同时所需的计算资源减少了约2.3倍，训练数据也减少了15倍。在AIME 2024比赛中，完整的SDV流程达到了83.3%的准确率，远远超过了强大的基线模型，同时使用的标记数量也显著减少。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SPARD: Self-Paced Curriculum for RL Alignment via Integrating Reward Dynamics and Data Utility
papers.title_zh: SPARD：通过整合奖励机制与数据效用来实现强化学习课程的自定进度学习机制
papers.authors: Xuyang Zhi, Peilun Zhou, Chengqiang Lu, Hang Lv, Yiwei Liang, Rongyang Zhang, Yan Gao, Yiwu, Yao Hu, Hongchao Gu, Defu Lian, Hao Wang, Enhong Chen
papers.abstract: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) is shifting the focus from single, verifiable tasks toward complex, open-ended real-world scenarios, imposing significant challenges on the post-training phase. In these settings, the scale and complexity of reward systems have grown significantly, transitioning toward multi-objective formulations that encompass a comprehensive spectrum of model capabilities and application contexts. However, traditional methods typically rely on fixed reward weights, ignoring non-stationary learning dynamics and struggling with data heterogeneity across dimensions. To address these issues, we propose SPARD, a framework that establishes an automated, self-paced curriculum by perceiving learning progress to dynamically adjust multi-objective reward weights and data importance, thereby synchronizing learning intent with data utility for optimal performance. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SPARD significantly enhances model capabilities across all domains. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/USTC-StarTeam/SPARD.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的演变使得研究重点从单一的、可验证的任务转向了复杂的、开放式的现实世界场景，这给训练后的阶段带来了巨大的挑战。在这种情况下，奖励系统的规模和复杂性显著增加，逐渐转变为多目标的形式，涵盖了模型能力的全方位以及不同的应用情境。然而，传统的方法通常依赖于固定的奖励权重，忽视了非平稳的学习动态，并且难以处理不同维度上的数据异质性问题。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了SPARD框架。该框架通过感知学习进度来动态调整多目标的奖励权重和数据重要性，从而将学习意图与数据效用相结合，以实现最佳性能。在多个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，SPARD显著提升了模型在所有领域的能力。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/USTC-StarTeam/SPARD上免费获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Lost in Simulation: LLM-Simulated Users are Unreliable Proxies for Human Users in Agentic Evaluations
papers.title_zh: 迷失在模拟之中：在代理评估中，由大型语言模型模拟的用户并不适合作为人类用户的可靠替代对象
papers.authors: Preethi Seshadri, Samuel Cahyawijaya, Ayomide Odumakinde, Sameer Singh, Seraphina Goldfarb-Tarrant
papers.abstract: Agentic benchmarks increasingly rely on LLM-simulated users to scalably evaluate agent performance, yet the robustness, validity, and fairness of this approach remain unexamined. Through a user study with participants across the United States, India, Kenya, and Nigeria, we investigate whether LLM-simulated users serve as reliable proxies for real human users in evaluating agents on τ-Bench retail tasks. We find that user simulators lack robustness, with agent success rates varying up to 9 percentage points across different user LLMs. Furthermore, simulated users systematically miscalibrate performance, underestimating success on challenging tasks while overestimating moderately difficult ones. African American Vernacular English (AAVE) speakers experience consistently worse success rates and calibration errors than Standard American English (SAE) speakers, with disparities compounding significantly with age. We also find simulated users to be a differentially effective proxy for different populations, performing worst for AAVE and Indian English. Additionally, simulated users introduce conversational artifacts and surface different failure patterns than human users. These findings demonstrate that current evaluation practices risk misrepresenting agent capabilities across diverse user populations and may obscure real-world deployment challenges.
papers.abstract_zh: 在评估智能体性能时，大多数基准测试都依赖由大语言模型模拟的用户来进行大规模测试。然而，这种方法的可靠性、有效性和公平性仍然缺乏充分验证。通过在美国、印度、肯尼亚和尼日利亚招募参与者进行用户研究，我们探讨了由大语言模型模拟的用户是否可以作为真实人类用户在τ-Bench零售任务中评估智能体的可靠代理。研究发现，这些模拟用户缺乏可靠性，不同大语言模型所模拟的智能体的成功率差异高达9个百分点。此外，模拟用户还存在系统性误校准问题：它们低估了在具有挑战性任务中的成功概率，而高估了在中等难度任务中的成功概率。非裔美国人方言英语使用者在评估智能体性能时的成功率与校准误差均明显低于标准美国英语使用者，且这种差异随着年龄的增长而进一步加剧。我们还发现，模拟用户对不同人群的效果存在差异，对于非裔美国人方言和印度英语使用者来说，其表现最为糟糕。此外，模拟用户还会产生对话中的异常现象，并且出现的失败模式也与人类用户有所不同。这些研究结果表明，当前的评估方法可能会错误地反映不同用户群体的智能体能力，从而掩盖了实际部署过程中面临的挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Toward Robust Evaluation for Multilingual Grammatical Error Correction: Can Large Language Models Replace Human References?
papers.title_zh: 针对多语言语法错误修正的稳健评估方法：大型语言模型能否替代人类专家的判断？
papers.authors: Alla Rozovskaya, Dan Roth
papers.abstract: A standard method for evaluating grammatical error correction systems severely underestimates performance, as it compares outputsagainst a small, fixed set of human references, despite the large space of possible valid corrections. Prior research has shown that using aclosest-gold reference – i.e., a human reference generated with respect to the system output rather than the original text – yields more accurate performance estimates. Yet, producing such references for each system individually is costly. We introduce an automated method for generating closest-gold references by prompting a large language model (LLM) with system outputs. We find that performance scores computed using automatic closest-gold references correlate well with human closest-golds, whereas standard reference-based evaluations show weak or no correlation.Building on this insight, we use both fixed human references and closest-gold references generated by Claude and Llama to compare theperformance of supervised models and GPT-4 across 14 benchmarks spanning 12 languages. Consequently, while prior work has shown that GPT-4 appears to lag behind traditional models, we demonstrate that this is due to the failures of the standard evaluation method that systematically underestimates GPT-4 performance more severely than that of supervised models. We show that a more appropriate evaluation approach, based on the closest gold method, reveals that GPT-4 outperforms traditional state-of- the-art models on almost all languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 一种用于评估语法错误纠正系统的标准方法严重低估了系统的性能，因为它只是将系统输出与人类参考集进行比对，而实际上存在大量有效的修正方案。先前的研究表明，使用“最接近黄金标准”的参考——即基于系统输出而非原始文本生成的人类参考——能够得出更准确的性能估计。然而，为每个系统单独生成这样的参考是非常耗费资源的。我们提出了一种自动化方法，通过向大语言模型输入系统输出来生成“最接近黄金标准”的参考。我们发现，使用自动生成的“最接近黄金标准”参考计算出的性能评分与人工生成的参考结果具有很好的相关性，而基于标准参考的评估则显示出较弱或没有相关性。基于这一发现，我们同时使用固定的人类参考和由Claude及Llama生成的“最接近黄金标准”参考，来比较监督式模型和GPT-4在14个基准测试中的表现，这些测试涵盖了12种语言。结果表明，虽然先前的研究表明GPT-4的性能不如传统模型，但我们认为这是由于标准评估方法的缺陷导致的，该方法系统性地低估了GPT-4的性能，使其表现比监督式模型更差。我们证明，采用基于“最接近黄金标准”的更合适的评估方法后，可以发现GPT-4在几乎所有语言上的表现都优于传统的最先进模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Cell-Based Representation of Relational Binding in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 语言模型中关系结合的基于细胞的表示方式
papers.authors: Qin Dai, Benjamin Heinzerling, Kentaro Inui
papers.abstract: Understanding a discourse requires tracking entities and the relations that hold between them. While Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on relational reasoning, the mechanism by which they bind entities, relations, and attributes remains unclear. We study discourse-level relational binding and show that LLMs encode it via a Cell-based Binding Representation (CBR): a low-dimensional linear subspace in which each “cell” corresponds to an entity–relation index pair, and bound attributes are retrieved from the corresponding cell during inference. Using controlled multi-sentence data annotated with entity and relation indices, we identify the CBR subspace by decoding these indices from attribute-token activations with Partial Least Squares regression. Across domains and two model families, the indices are linearly decodable and form a grid-like geometry in the projected space. We further find that context-specific CBR representations are related by translation vectors in activation space, enabling cross-context transfer. Finally, activation patching shows that manipulating this subspace systematically changes relational predictions and that perturbing it disrupts performance, providing causal evidence that LLMs rely on CBR for relational binding.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解一篇文本需要追踪其中的各个实体以及它们之间的关系。虽然大语言模型在关系推理方面表现良好，但它们如何将实体、关系和属性进行绑定仍然不清楚。我们研究了文本层面的关系绑定机制，并发现大语言模型通过基于单元格的绑定表示来实现这一功能：这是一个低维的线性子空间，其中每个“单元格”对应一个实体-关系索引对，而绑定后的属性则可以在推理过程中从相应的单元格中获取。通过使用带有实体和关系索引的多句数据，我们通过使用偏最小二乘回归从属性-标记激活值中解码这些索引，从而确定了该子空间的结构。在不同领域和两个模型家族中，这些索引都是可以线性解码的，并且在投影空间中形成了类似网格的几何结构。我们还发现，特定上下文下的绑定表示可以通过激活空间中的平移向量进行关联，从而实现跨上下文的传递。最后，激活值的拼接表明，系统地操控这个子空间会改变关系预测的结果，而对其进行干扰则会破坏模型的性能，这提供了证据，证明大语言模型依赖基于单元格的绑定表示来进行关系绑定。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LOTUS: Evolving Multimodal Unlearning via Hyperbolic Entailment and Lorentz Transport
papers.title_zh: LOTUS：通过双曲推理和洛伦兹传输实现多模态遗忘机制的发展
papers.authors: Zekun Wang, Jingjie Zeng, Yingxu Li, Hongfei Lin, Liang Yang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face critical privacy challenges due to the indiscriminate memorization of sensitive data. Existing unlearning methods, largely adapted from Euclidean paradigms, suffer from a geometric mismatch: they fail to disentangle specific instances from general concepts, causing catastrophic forgetting or unsafe substitution. We introduce LOTUS (Lorentz Transport for Unlearning Strategies), a framework for surgical semantic pruning within the Lorentz manifold. Leveraging hyperbolic geometry’s hierarchical nature, LOTUS employs an Inverted Entailment Cone Loss to sever the inheritance of sensitive concepts and a Lorentz Transport mechanism to align pruned features within the tangent space, ensuring compatibility with Euclidean backbones via a safety refusal prior. Experiments on MLLMU-Bench with LLaVA and Qwen show that LOTUS significantly outperforms baselines, effectively erasing targeted visual data while preserving general utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型面临着严重的隐私挑战，因为它们会无差别地记住敏感数据。现有的去学习方法大多基于欧几里得范式，但存在几何上的不匹配问题：它们无法将特定实例与通用概念区分开来，导致灾难性的遗忘或不安全的替换。我们提出了LOTUS（洛伦兹运输去学习策略），这是一个在洛伦兹流形内进行语义修剪的框架。利用双曲几何的层次结构，LOTUS采用反蕴含锥损失来切断敏感概念的继承关系，并通过洛伦兹运输机制将修剪后的特征在切线上对齐，从而确保与欧几里得模型之间的兼容性。在使用MLLMU-Bench、LLaVA和Qwen进行的实验中，LOTUS显著优于基线方法，能够有效删除目标视觉数据，同时保留通用功能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: KARL: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Agents on Multi-Turn Knowledge-Intensive Agentic Tasks
papers.title_zh: 卡尔：在需要多轮迭代、知识密集型任务中，强化学习在大型语言模型代理中的应用
papers.authors: Xueqiao Sun, Xiao Liu, Bowen Lv, Hanchen Zhang, Bohao Jing, Zehan Qi, Yifan Xu, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models have shown remarkable potential as autonomous agents, but their effectiveness in knowledge-intensive tasks remains limited by passive knowledge utilization. We introduce KARL (Knowledge-Augmented Reinforcement Learning), a framework that enables LLM agents to dynamically explore structured knowledge sources through multi-turn interactions. Unlike existing retrieval-augmented approaches, KARL empowers agents to proactively decide when and what knowledge to acquire during task execution. Our framework incorporates online reinforcement learning with curiosity-driven reward shaping, explicitly incentivizing knowledge exploration while optimizing tool-use behaviors end-to-end. Extensive evaluation across six structured knowledge benchmarks demonstrates that KARL achieves state-of-the-art performance, with our Qwen2.5-14B-based agent significantly outperforming GPT-4o, Claude-4, and o4-mini on both knowledge graph and database tasks.Source code is available at https://github.com/THUDM/KARL.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型作为自主智能体展现出巨大的潜力，但在知识密集型任务中的表现仍受到被动知识利用的限制。我们提出了KARL框架，该框架使LLM智能体能够通过多轮交互动态探索结构化知识资源。与现有的检索增强方法不同，KARL让智能体能够主动决定在任务执行过程中何时获取何种知识。我们的框架结合了在线强化学习以及基于好奇心的奖励机制，从而在优化工具使用行为的同时，明确激励知识探索。在六个结构化知识基准测试中的广泛评估表明，KARL取得了领先的性能水平，以Qwen2.5-14B为基础的智能体在知识图谱和数据库任务上显著优于GPT-4o、Claude-4和o4-mini。源代码可访问https://github.com/THUDM/KARL。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FIGMA: Towards FIne-Grained Music retrievAl
papers.title_zh: FIGMA：迈向精细音乐检索的彼岸
papers.authors: Nishit Anand, Ashish Seth, Sreyan Ghosh, Dinesh Manocha, Ramani Duraiswami
papers.abstract: Retrieving music using natural language descriptions has improved with contrastive audio–text models such as CLAP, but current systems remain limited to coarse semantic queries. When descriptions specify fine-grained musical attributes such as tempo, key, chord progression, or rhythmic structure, existing models often fail to retrieve the correct audio. We show that this limitation stems from the contrastive learning objective itself: despite being trained on long captions, CLAP-based models effectively utilize only the first few tokens, discarding much of the information encoded in detailed prompts. Then, we propose FIGMA (Fine-Grained Music Retrieval), a multi-view contrastive architecture that addresses this limitation by jointly optimizing global audio–text alignment and frame-level, token-wise alignment. This design enables FIGMA to capture both high-level semantic context and fine-grained musical attributes within a unified representation space. Moreover, we formalize the task of Fine-Grained Music Retrieval and construct Fine-Grained Music Caption dataset (FGMCaps), a large-scale dataset of 380K music–caption pairs for training along with a 10K test set, both annotated with tempo, key, chord progression, beat count, as well as genre and mood. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FIGMA consistently outperforms existing CLAP-based music retrieval models across multiple music retrieval benchmarks, including out-of-domain evaluations, with relative improvements of up to 73.3%.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用自然语言描述来检索音乐的效果已经得到了提升，这得益于诸如CLAP这样的对比性音文本模型。不过，目前的系统仍然局限于对语义的粗略查询。当描述中涉及到诸如节奏、调性、和弦进程或节奏结构等细粒度音乐属性时，现有的模型往往无法准确检索到正确的音频内容。我们发现，这种局限性源于对比学习的目标本身：尽管CLAP模型是在长文本描述上进行训练的，但它们实际上只利用了前几个标记，而忽略了详细提示中包含的大量信息。因此，我们提出了FIGMA（细粒度音乐检索）这一多视图对比式架构，它通过联合优化全局音频-文本对齐以及帧级、标记级的对齐来解决这一问题。这种设计使得FIGMA能够同时捕捉到高层次的语义上下文和细粒度的音乐属性，并将它们统一在一个表示空间中。此外，我们还对细粒度音乐检索任务进行了形式化定义，并构建了一个名为FGMCaps的大规模数据集，其中包含38万对音乐与标题的配对数据，可供训练使用。该数据集还包含1万个测试集，这些测试集都标注了节奏、调性、和弦进程、节拍数以及音乐类型和情绪等信息。大量的实验表明，FIGMA在多个音乐检索基准测试中始终优于现有的基于CLAP的音乐检索模型，其性能提升幅度高达73.3%。

papers.title: MathSight: A Benchmark Exploring Have Vision-Language Models Really Seen in University-Level Mathematical Reasoning?
papers.title_zh: MathSight：一项旨在探讨视觉语言模型是否真的能够应用于大学水平数学推理的测试
papers.authors: Yuandong Wang, Yao Cui, Yuxin Zhao, Zhen Yang, Yangfu Zhu, Zhenzhou Shao
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved impressive progress in multimodal mathematical reasoning. Yet, howmuch visual information truly contributes to reasoning remains unclear. Existing benchmarks report strong overall performance but seldom isolate the role of the image modality, leaving open whether VLMs genuinely leverage visual understanding or merely depend on linguistic priors. To address this, we present MathSight, a university-level multimodal mathematical reasoning benchmark designed to disentangle and quantify the effect of visual input. Each problem includes multiple visual variants—original, hand-drawn, photocaptured—and a text-only condition for controlled comparison. Experiments on state-of-the-art VLMs reveal a consistent trend: the contribution of visual information diminishes with increasing problem difficulty. Remarkably, Qwen3-VL without any image input surpasses both its multimodal variants and GPT-5, underscoring the need for benchmarks like MathSight to advance genuine vision-grounded reasoning in future models. The project page is available at https://cnu-bot-group.github.io/MathSight/.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，视觉语言模型在多模态数学推理领域取得了显著进展。然而，视觉信息究竟对推理有多大的贡献仍然不清楚。现有的基准测试显示这些模型的整体性能相当出色，但很少单独分析图像模态的作用，因此无法判断视觉语言模型是真正利用了视觉理解能力，还是仅仅依赖于语言先验知识。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了MathSight这一大学级别的多模态数学推理基准测试，旨在明确并量化视觉输入的影响。每个问题都包含多种视觉变体——原始形式、手绘形式、拍照形式——同时还有仅文本形式的对照组，以便进行对比分析。对最先进的视觉语言模型的实验结果表明：随着问题的难度增加，视觉信息的贡献会逐渐减少。值得注意的是，Qwen3-VL这种完全不需要图像输入的模型，其性能超过了所有包含图像输入的视觉语言模型以及GPT-5，这凸显了像MathSight这样的基准测试对于推动未来模型中基于视觉的推理能力的提升至关重要。该项目的页面可以在https://cnu-bot-group.github.io/MathSight/查看。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TokDrift: When LLM Speaks in Subwords but Code Speaks in Grammar
papers.title_zh: TokDrift：当大型语言模型使用子词来表达意思时，而代码却遵循语法规则进行编写
papers.authors: Yinxi Li, Yuntian Deng, Pengyu Nie
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) for code rely on subword tokenizers, such as byte-pair encoding (BPE), learned from mixed natural language text and programming language code but driven by statistics rather than grammar. As a result, semantically identical code snippets can be tokenized differently depending on superficial factors such as whitespace or identifier naming. To measure the impact of this misalignment, we introduce TokDrift, a framework that applies semantic-preserving rewrite rules to create code variants differing only in tokenization. Across nine code LLMs, including large ones with over 30B parameters, even minor formatting changes can cause substantial shifts in model behavior. Layer-wise analysis shows that the issue originates in early embeddings, where subword segmentation fails to capture grammar token boundaries. Our findings identify misaligned tokenization as a hidden obstacle to reliable code understanding and generation, highlighting the need for grammar-aware tokenization for future code LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于代码的大语言模型（LLM）依赖于子词分词器，例如字节对编码（BPE）。这些分词器是从混合的自然语言和编程代码中学习得到的，但其运作基于统计学原理而非语法规则。因此，在语义上相同的代码片段可能会因为一些表面因素而有所不同，比如空白字符或标识符的命名方式。为了衡量这种不一致性带来的影响，我们提出了TokDrift这个框架，该框架采用保持语义不变的重写规则来生成仅在分词方式上有所不同的代码变体。在包括参数超过300亿的大型LLM在内的九种代码LLM中，即使是微小的格式变化也会导致模型行为的显著变化。逐层分析表明，问题源于早期的嵌入过程，此时子词分割未能准确捕捉到语法上的词符边界。我们的研究发现，分词方式的不一致是阻碍可靠代码理解和生成的隐藏障碍，这凸显了未来代码LLM需要采用考虑语法的分词方式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: REVEALER: Reinforcement-Guided Visual Reasoning for Element-Level Text-Image Alignment Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 揭示者：一种基于强化学习的视觉推理方法，用于元素级文本与图像之间的对齐评估
papers.authors: FuLin Shi, Wenyi Xiao, Leilei Gan, Liang Ding, Binchen
papers.abstract: Evaluating the alignment between textual prompts and generated images is critical for ensuring the reliability and usability of text-to-image (T2I) models. However, most existing evaluation methods rely on coarse-grained metrics or static Question Answering (QA) pipelines, which lack fine-grained interpretability and struggle to reflect human preferences. To address this, we propose \textbf{REVEALER}, a reinforcement-guided visual reasoning framework for element-level text-to-image alignment evaluation. Adopting a structured ''grounding–reasoning–conclusion'' paradigm, our method enables Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to explicitly localize semantic elements and derive interpretable alignment judgments. We optimize the model via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using a multi-dimensional reward function that targets format compliance, localization precision, and alignment accuracy.Extensive experiments confirm that REVEALER achieves state-of-the-art results across four benchmarks. Notably, on EvalMuse-40K, it surpasses the strong proprietary Gemini 3 Pro and Training-based baselines with absolute accuracy gains of \textbf{+4.2\%} and \textbf{+13.3\%}, respectively. Ablation studies further demonstrate the efficacy of our method, contributing a cumulative \textbf{19.6\%} improvement over the base model.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估文本提示与生成图像之间的对齐情况对于确保文本到图像模型的可靠性和可用性至关重要。然而，大多数现有的评估方法依赖于粗粒度指标或静态的问答流程，这些方法缺乏细粒度的可解释性，且难以反映人类的偏好。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了**REVEALER**，这是一个基于强化学习的视觉推理框架，用于评估元素级别的文本到图像对齐情况。该方法采用“基础化——推理——结论”的结构化范式，使多模态大语言模型能够明确定位语义元素，并得出可解释的对齐判断。我们通过多维奖励函数来优化模型，该函数针对格式合规性、定位精度和对齐准确性进行优化。大量实验表明，REVEALER在四个基准测试中都取得了领先的成绩。值得注意的是，在EvalMuse-40K测试中，它的绝对准确率分别比强大的专有Gemini 3 Pro和基于训练的基线模型提高了**+4.2%**和**+13.3%**。进一步的消融研究进一步证明了该方法的有效性，与基础模型相比，它总共提升了**19.6%**的性能。

papers.title: ReasonAny: Incorporating Reasoning Capability to Any Model via Simple and Effective Model Merging
papers.title_zh: 原因：通过简单有效的模型合并机制，将推理能力整合到任何模型中
papers.authors: Junyao Yang, Chen Qian, Wen Shen, Yong Liu, Jing Shao, Dongrui Liu
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) with long chain-of-thought reasoning have recently achieved remarkable success. Yet, equipping domain-specialized models with such reasoning capabilities, referred to as “Reasoning + X”, remains a significant challenge. While model merging offers a promising training-free solution, existing methods often suffer from a destructive performance collapse: existing methods tend to both weaken reasoning depth and compromise domain-specific utility. Interestingly, we identify a counter-intuitive phenomenon underlying this failure: reasoning ability predominantly resides in parameter regions with low gradient sensitivity, contrary to the common assumption that domain capabilities correspond to high-magnitude parameters. Motivated by this insight, we propose ReasonAny, a novel merging framework that resolves the reasoning–domain performance collapse through Contrastive Gradient Identification. Experiments across safety, biomedicine, and finance domains show that ReasonAny effectively synthesizes “Reasoning + X” capabilities, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines while retaining robust reasoning performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）凭借其复杂的思维链推理能力，最近取得了显著的成就。然而，为特定领域的模型赋予这种推理能力仍然是一个重大挑战。虽然模型合并提供了一种有前景的无训练解决方案，但现有方法往往会出现性能下降的问题：这些方法往往会削弱推理深度，同时也会降低模型的领域特异性。有趣的是，我们发现了一个与常规假设相悖的现象：推理能力主要存在于梯度敏感度较低的参数区域，而传统观念认为领域能力与高梯度的参数相关。基于这一发现，我们提出了ReasonAny这一新型合并框架，它通过对比梯度识别技术来解决推理能力与领域性能之间的冲突问题。在安全性、生物医学和金融领域进行的实验表明，ReasonAny能够有效地整合“推理+X”能力，其性能显著优于现有的最先进基线算法，同时保持了强大的推理能力。

papers.title: Do LLM Agents Mirror Socio-Cognitive Effects in Power-Asymmetric Conversations?
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型代理在权力不对称的对话中是否会反映社会认知效应？
papers.authors: Anvesh Rao Vijjini, Sagar B. Manjunath, Snigdha Chaturvedi
papers.abstract: Power differences shape human communication through well-documented socio-cognitive effects, including language coordination, pronoun usage, authority bias, and harmful compliance. We examine whether large language models (LLMs) exhibit similar behaviors when assigned high- or low-status personas. Using personas from diverse professions, we simulate multi-turn, power-asymmetric dialogues (e.g., principal–teacher, justice–lawyer) and measure (i) linguistic coordination, (ii) pronoun usage, (iii) persuasion success, and (iv) compliance with unsafe requests. Our results show that LLMs show key socio-cognitive effects of power, albeit with nuances and variability, linking simulated interactions to both desirable and unsafe behaviors.
papers.abstract_zh: 权力差异通过一系列有充分记录的社会认知效应影响着人类交流，这些效应包括语言协调、代词使用、权威偏见以及有害的服从行为。我们研究大语言模型在扮演高或低地位角色时是否也会表现出类似的行为。通过模拟来自不同职业的角色，我们进行了多轮次的权力不对称对话（例如，校长与教师、法官与律师之间的对话），并测量了以下方面：(i) 语言协调情况；(ii) 代词使用方式；(iii) 说服效果；(iv) 对不安全请求的服从程度。我们的结果显示，尽管存在细微差别和变异性，大语言模型确实表现出与权力相关的关键社会认知效应，这些效应既涉及理想行为，也涉及不安全行为。

papers.title: CIG: Measuring Conversational Information Gain in Deliberative Dialogues with Semantic Memory Dynamics
papers.title_zh: CIG：在考虑语义记忆动态的情况下，测量对话中的信息获取情况
papers.authors: Ming-Bin Chen, Jey Han Lau, Lea Frermann
papers.abstract: Measuring the quality of public deliberation requires evaluating not only civility or argument structure, but also the informational progress of a conversation. We introduce a framework for Conversational Information Gain (CIG) that evaluates each utterance in terms of how it advances collective understanding of the target topic. To operationalize CIG, we model an evolving semantic memory of the discussion: the system extracts atomic claims from utterances and incrementally consolidates them into a structured memory state. Using this memory, we score each utterance along three interpretable dimensions: Novelty, Relevance, and Implication Scope. We annotate 80 segments from two moderated deliberative settings (TV debates and community discussions) with these dimensions and show that memory-derived dynamics (e.g., the number of claim updates) correlate more strongly with human-perceived CIG than traditional heuristics such as utterance length or TF–IDF. We develop effective LLM-based CIG predictors paving the way for information-focused conversation quality analysis in dialogues and deliberative success.
papers.abstract_zh: 衡量公共讨论的质量，不仅需要评估对话的文明程度或论证结构，还需要评估对话中的信息进展。我们提出了一种“对话信息增益”框架，该框架通过评估每个发言如何推动对目标主题的集体理解来评价每个发言。为了实现这一框架，我们对讨论过程中的语义记忆进行了建模：系统从发言中提取出各个原子性主张，并将其逐步整合到结构化的记忆状态中。利用这种记忆，我们根据三个可解释的维度来评估每个发言：新颖性、相关性和含义范围。我们对来自两种有组织的讨论场景（电视辩论和社区讨论）的80段文本进行了这些维度的标注，结果表明，由记忆动态产生的信息增益指标（例如，主张更新的次数）与人类感知到的对话信息增益之间的相关性要高于传统的启发式方法，如发言长度或TF-IDF值。我们还开发了基于大语言模型的对话信息增益预测器，为在对话和讨论中分析信息质量以及提高讨论效果提供了可能。

papers.title: A Multilingual Social Bias Benchmark Incorporating Thinking Processes
papers.title_zh: 一种多语言社交偏见基准测试，包含思维过程分析
papers.authors: Masahiro Kaneko, Danushka Bollegala, Timothy Baldwin
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can learn both useful knowledge and harmful stereotypes, making bias evaluation essential.Existing frameworks fall into two types: those considering reasoning steps (Thinking Process-Aware Evaluation, TPAE) and those focusing only on final outputs (Straight-to-the-Answer Evaluation, SAE).Prior TPAE studies showed effectiveness in assessing gender bias but relied on template-based, word-counting prompts, limiting generalization to other bias types, languages, and reasoning-based methods.In this study, we introduce MBTP, a multilingual social bias benchmark that incorporates human-generated pro- and anti-stereotype reasoning as part of the thinking process, and propose a few-shot meta-evaluation method that enables scalable bias assessment without model fine-tuning.From experiments evaluating 13 social bias categories across 8 languages, we find that human-generated thinking consistently yields higher-quality evaluations than LLM-generated or template-based approaches.Furthermore, TPAE demonstrates superior performance over SAE, highlighting the importance of considering reasoning processes in bias evaluation.We will release the MBTP dataset upon paper acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够学习到有用的知识和有害的刻板印象，因此进行偏见评估至关重要。现有的框架分为两类：一类是考虑推理过程的评估方法（思维过程感知评估），另一类则是仅关注最终结果的评估方法（直接答案评估）。之前的思维过程感知评估研究表明，这种方法在评估性别偏见方面效果不错，但该方法依赖于基于模板的、以单词数量为标准的提示方式，这限制了其对其他类型偏见、不同语言的适用性，以及与其他基于推理的方法的兼容性。在本研究中，我们提出了MBTP这一多语言社会偏见基准测试，该测试将人类生成的支持或反对刻板印象的推理过程纳入了评估过程中。我们还提出了一种少样本元评估方法，该方法无需对模型进行微调即可实现可扩展的偏见评估。通过对8种语言中的13种社会偏见类别进行的实验分析，我们发现，由人类生成的评估结果始终比由语言模型生成或基于模板的方法得出的评估结果质量更高。此外，思维过程感知评估在性能上优于直接答案评估，这凸显了在偏见评估中考虑推理过程的重要性。一旦论文被接受，我们将发布MBTP数据集。

papers.title: Preference Heads in Large Language Models: A Mechanistic Framework for Interpretable Personalization
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中的偏好处理机制：一种可解释的个人化算法的机械性框架
papers.authors: Weixu Zhang, Ye Yuan, Changjiang Han, Yuxing Tian, Zipeng Sun, Linfeng Du, Jikun Kang, Hong Kang, Xue Liu, Haolun Wu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong implicit personalization ability, yet most existing approaches treat this behavior as a black box, relying on prompt engineering or fine tuning on user data. In this work, we adopt a mechanistic interpretability perspective and hypothesize the existence of a sparse set of Preference Heads, attention heads that encode user specific stylistic and topical preferences and exert a causal influence on generation. We introduce Differential Preference Steering (DPS), a training free framework that (1) identifies Preference Heads through causal masking analysis and (2) leverages them for controllable and interpretable personalization at inference time. DPS computes a Preference Contribution Score (PCS) for each attention head, directly measuring its causal impact on user aligned outputs. During decoding, we contrast model predictions with and without Preference Heads, amplifying the difference between personalized and generic logits to selectively strengthen preference aligned continuations. Experiments on widely used personalization benchmarks across multiple LLMs demonstrate consistent gains in personalization fidelity while preserving content coherence and low computational overhead. Beyond empirical improvements, DPS provides a mechanistic explanation of where and how personalization emerges within transformer architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型具备强大的隐性个性化能力，但目前大多数方法都将这种特性视为一个黑箱，依赖于提示工程或对用户数据的微调。在这项研究中，我们采取了机制性可解释性的视角，假设存在一组稀疏的偏好头——这些注意力头能够编码出用户特定的风格和主题偏好，并对生成内容产生因果影响。我们提出了差分偏好引导技术（Differential Preference Steering，DPS），这是一种无需额外训练即可使用的框架：它首先通过因果掩蔽分析来识别偏好头，然后在推理阶段利用这些偏好头来实现可控且可解释的个人化效果。DPS为每个注意力头计算一个偏好贡献得分，从而直接衡量其对用户期望输出的因果影响。在解码过程中，我们会将模型预测结果与有无偏好头的版本进行对比，从而放大个性化逻辑与通用逻辑之间的差异，进而选择性地强化符合用户偏好的内容生成。在多个大语言模型所采用的广泛个人化基准测试上进行的实验表明，DPS能够在保持内容连贯性的同时，显著提升个性化效果，且计算开销较低。除了实际的性能提升之外，DPS还提供了对个性化机制的具体解释，让我们明白个性化是如何在Transformer架构中产生的。

papers.title: Influence-based Online Experience Selection for Effective RLHF
papers.title_zh: 基于影响力的在线体验选择，以实现高效的强化学习人机交互
papers.authors: Yifan Gong, Jing Yao, Xiting Wang, Xunlong Wang, Xiaoyuan Yi, Xing Xie
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a crucial technique for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, existing RLHF methods face key challenges, including poor sample efficiency, high computational overhead, and slow convergence. Recent studies highlight the importance of data selection in RL, but how to effectively select the most beneficial experiences for RL training remains an open problem. Existing data selection methods for RL rely on heuristic metrics, failing to establish an interpretable connection between data and optimization objectives. To address this problem, we propose InfOES (Influence-based Online Experience Selection), a novel data selection method for RLHF that dynamically estimates the influence of individual training samples on policy optimization. By incorporating data attribution into the policy gradient, InfOES can identify and filter out detrimental samples on the fly, ensuring effective convergence toward alignment objectives. Our approach is compatible with various RL algorithms (e.g., PPO, GRPO, REINFORCE++). Extensive experiments demonstrate that InfOES significantly enhances training effectiveness, achieving superior alignment performance with fewer optimization steps.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已成为使大语言模型与人类偏好相匹配的关键技术。然而，现有的RLHF方法面临着诸多挑战，包括样本效率低下、计算成本过高以及收敛速度缓慢等问题。最近的研究强调了数据选择在RL中的重要性，但如何有效地选择对强化学习训练最有益的样本仍然是一个未解决的问题。目前用于RL的数据选择方法依赖于启发式指标，无法建立数据与优化目标之间的可解释性联系。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了InfOES这一新颖的数据选择方法。该方法能够动态估计单个训练样本对策略优化的影响，通过将数据归因纳入策略梯度中，可以实时识别并剔除有害样本，从而确保朝着对齐目标有效收敛。我们的方法适用于多种RL算法（如PPO、GRPO、REINFORCE++）。大量实验表明，InfOES显著提升了训练效果，能够在更少的优化步骤下实现更好的对齐性能。

papers.title: NaturalGAIA: A Verifiable Benchmark and Hierarchical Framework for Long-Horizon GUI Tasks
papers.title_zh: NaturalGAIA：一个可验证的基准测试工具，适用于长期运行的GUI任务的处理需求，同时具备分层架构设计
papers.authors: Zihan Zheng, Tianle Cui, Taoran Wang, Fengtao Wang, Jiahui Pan, Lewei He, Qianglong Chen
papers.abstract: Despite significant advances in LLM-driven GUI agents, the field remains constrained by the challenge of reconciling high-fidelity realism with verifiable evaluation accuracy. To address this, we introduce NaturalGAIA, a verifiable evaluation dataset grounded in real-world human GUI interaction intents. By decoupling logical causal pathways from linguistic narratives, it rigorously simulates natural human intent, characterized by cognitive non-linearity and contextual dependencies. Furthermore, we propose LightManus-Jarvis, a hierarchical collaborative framework where LightManus manages dynamic topological planning and context evolution, while Jarvis ensures execution precision via hybrid visual-structural perception. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves a Weighted Pathway Success Rate of 45.6%, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline (21.1%), while reducing token consumption by 75% and execution time by 76%. These results validate the efficacy of the macro-planning and micro-execution paradigm in handling complex naturalized tasks. Our code is publicly available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NatureGAIA-721F/.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在基于大语言模型驱动的图形用户界面代理方面取得了显著进展，但该领域仍然面临着如何将高保真现实性与可验证的评估准确性相结合的挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了NaturalGAIA——一个基于真实人类图形用户界面交互意图的可验证评估数据集。通过将逻辑因果路径与语言描述分离，该数据集能够严格模拟自然的人类意图，这些意图具有认知的非线性和上下文依赖性。此外，我们还提出了LightManus-Jarvis这一分层协作框架：LightManus负责动态拓扑规划和上下文演化，而Jarvis则通过混合视觉-结构感知来确保执行的精确性。实验表明，我们的方法实现了45.6%的加权路径成功率，显著优于现有的最先进基线方法（21.1%），同时还将令牌消耗减少了75%，执行时间减少了76%。这些结果验证了宏观规划与微观执行范式在处理复杂任务时的有效性。我们的代码可以在以下链接获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NatureGAIA-721F/

papers.title: Look Within or Beyond? A Theoretical Comparison Between Parameter-Efficient and Full Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 内部调整还是全面微调？参数高效调优与全范围微调之间的理论比较
papers.authors: YongKang Liu, Xingle Xu, Ercong Nie, Zijing Wang, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Qian Li, Hinrich Schuetze
papers.abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become a popular alternative to Full-Parameter Fine-Tuning (FFT), achieving similar performance on many benchmarks with far lower computational and memory costs. Yet, its effectiveness on complex tasks such as reasoning and instruction-following remains unclear. In this work, we provide a theoretical and empirical comparison of PEFT and FFT in terms of representational capacity and robustness. We show that PEFT’s solution space is a strict subset of FFT’s and derive upper bounds revealing how its restricted parameterization limits expressiveness and increases vulnerability to perturbations. Experiments on 20 datasets and 11 adversarial test sets support these findings, indicating that while PEFT performs well on standard tasks, its weaknesses on complex and adversarial settings call for new directions beyond current PEFT paradigms.The source code is in the anonymous GitHub repository[https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PEFTEval-E2AC ].
papers.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）已成为全参数微调（FFT）的一种流行替代方案，它在许多基准测试中的表现与FFT相当，但计算量和内存成本却要低得多。然而，它在推理和指令遵循等复杂任务上的效果仍不清楚。在这项研究中，我们从理论和实证的角度对PEFT和FFT在表示能力和鲁棒性方面进行了比较。我们发现PEFT的解空间是FFT解空间的严格子集，并且我们得出了一些上限，这些上限揭示了其受限的参数化方式如何限制了表达能力，并增加了对干扰的脆弱性。通过对20个数据集和11个对抗性测试集的实验验证，这些发现得到了支持。结果表明，虽然PEFT在标准任务上表现良好，但在复杂和具有对抗性的环境中，它的弱点表明需要超越当前PEFT范式的新的研究方向。源代码可以在匿名GitHub仓库中找到：[https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PEFTEval-E2AC]
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Tackling the Root of Misinformation by Teaching Laypeople about Logical Fallacies via Socratic Questioning and Critical Argumentation
papers.title_zh: 通过苏格拉底式提问和批判性论证来教育普通民众，从而从根本上解决错误信息的问题
papers.authors: Minjing Shi, Junling Wang, Jingwei Ni, Sankalan Pal Chowdhury, Mrinmaya Sachan
papers.abstract: Identifying logical fallacies (LFs) in everyday discourse is challenging for many people. This challenge is amplified in the era of Large Language Models (LLMs), where malicious agents can deploy fallacious arguments to disseminate misinformation at scale. In this work, we explore the potential of LLMs as part of the solution. We introduce LFTutor, an intelligent tutoring system which uses LLMs to tutor humans and help them learn about logical fallacies. LFTutor integrates intent-driven Socratic questioning and critical argumentation principles to actively engage learners to reflect on their reasoning. Through both automatic and human evaluations, we demonstrate that LFTutor significantly outperforms baseline LLMs lacking such pedagogical strategies. This work highlights the promise of combining LLMs with pedagogical scaffolding to foster critical thinking and argument literacy in the age of AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 在日常对话中识别逻辑谬误对许多人来说都是一项挑战。在大语言模型时代，这一挑战变得更加严峻，因为恶意程序可以利用这些模型来大规模传播错误信息。在这项研究中，我们探讨了将大语言模型作为解决方案的一部分的潜力。我们推出了LFTutor这个智能辅导系统，它利用大语言模型来指导人类学习逻辑谬误。LFTutor结合了基于意图的苏格拉底式提问和批判性论证原则，引导学习者反思自己的推理过程。通过自动和人类评估的结果表明，LFTutor在性能上明显优于那些缺乏这种教学策略的基线大语言模型。这项工作凸显了在人工智能时代，将大语言模型与教学辅助手段相结合，以培养批判性思维和论证能力的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TRAC: Teacher-Guided Token Reward with Adaptive Calibration for Robust Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: TRAC：教师引导的代币奖励机制，结合自适应校准技术，以实现稳健的政策优化
papers.authors: Sitong Wu, Haoru Tan, Xichen Zhang, Bin Xia, Wenhu Zhang, Xiaojuan Qi, Bei Yu, Jiaya Jia
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) with sparse outcome rewards suffers from inefficient credit assignment in complex LLM reasoning tasks. While utilizing stronger LLMs as teachers to derive dense token-level supervision offers a cost-effective alternative to proprietary reward models, it relies on the flawed assumption that teachers are perfect oracles. In reality, teacher models exhibit capability limitations and uncertainty, producing noisy signals that make student policies susceptible to reward hacking. To address this, we propose Teacher Reward Adaptive Calibration (TRAC), a robust framework that filters noisy supervision by dynamically modulating teacher influence via a multi-granularity calibration mechanism. TRAC evaluates teacher reliability across three principled dimensions: problem-level expertise, trajectory-level discrimination, and token-level confidence. Furthermore, we integrate TRAC with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), formulating as TRAC-GRPO, which treats calibrated teacher-derived reward as an additive advantage reshaping term to ensure fair advantage estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TRAC effectively mitigates teacher noise, significantly enhancing the reasoning capabilities and training stability of LLMs compared to standard baselines. The code will be available at: https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/TRAC.
papers.abstract_zh: 在具有稀疏奖励结果的强化学习场景中，复杂的LLM推理任务面临着信用分配效率低下的问题。虽然使用更强大的LLM作为“教师”来提供密集的令牌级监督是一种成本效益较高的替代方案，但这种做法基于了一个错误的假设，即“教师”是完美的预言器。实际上，“教师”模型存在能力限制和不确定性，这会导致产生噪声信号，从而使学生策略容易受到奖励操纵的影响。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了“教师奖励自适应校准”框架（TRAC）。该框架通过多粒度校准机制动态调节“教师”的影响力，从而过滤掉噪声监督信息。TRAC从三个原则性维度来评估“教师”的可靠性：问题级别的专业知识、轨迹级别的区分能力以及令牌级别的可信度。此外，我们将TRAC与群体相对策略优化技术相结合，形成了TRAC-GRPO，它将经过校准的“教师”生成的奖励视为一种附加优势，以确保公平的优势估计。大量实验表明，TRAC能够有效减少“教师”产生的噪声，显著提升了LLM的推理能力和训练稳定性，优于标准基线方法。相关代码可访问：https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/TRAC。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
