papers.title: Macaron: Controlled, Human-Written Benchmark for Multilingual and Multicultural Reasoning via Template-Filling
papers.title_zh: 马卡龙：一种由人类编写的、具有控制性的基准测试，用于评估跨语言与跨文化的推理能力，通过模板填充方式实现
papers.authors: Alaa Elsetohy, Sama Hadhoud, Haryo Akbarianto Wibowo, Chenxi Whitehouse, Genta Indra Winata, Fajri Koto, Alham Fikri Aji
papers.abstract: Multilingual benchmarks rarely test reasoning over culturally grounded premises: translated datasets keep English-centric scenarios, while culture-first datasets often lack control over the reasoning required. We propose Macaron, a template-first benchmark that factorizes reasoning type and cultural aspect across question languages. Using 100 language-agnostic templates that cover 7 reasoning types, 22 cultural aspects, native annotators create scenario-aligned English and local-language multiple-choice questions, and systematically derived True/False questions. Macaron contains 11,862 instances spanning 20 countries/cultural contexts, 10 scripts, and 20 languages and dialects (including low-resource ones like Amharic, Yoruba, Zulu, Kyrgyz, and some Arabic dialects). In zero-shot evaluation of 21 multilingual LLMs, reasoning-mode models achieve the strongest performance (80.8% overall) and near-parity between English and local languages (∆MC = −1.3%), while open-weight models degrade substantially in local languages (∆MC = −6.8%) and often approach chance on T/F tasks. Culture-grounded mathematical and counting templates are consistently the hardest. The data can be accessed here https://huggingface.co/datasets/AlaaAhmed2444/Macaron.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言基准测试很少针对基于文化的推理进行考核：翻译后的数据集通常只包含以英语为中心的情境，而注重文化因素的数据库往往无法有效控制推理过程。我们提出了Macaron这一基于模板的基准测试，它能够将推理类型和文化因素分解为不同语言版本的问题中加以考虑。该测试使用了100种与语言无关的模板，涵盖了7种推理类型和22种文化因素。由母语标注者负责创建与具体情境相匹配的英语及当地语言的多项选择题，同时还会生成真假判断题。Macaron包含了11,862个实例，涉及20个国家/文化背景、10种语言，以及20种语言方言（包括一些资源匮乏的语言，如阿姆哈拉语、约鲁巴语、祖鲁语、吉尔吉斯语以及一些阿拉伯方言）。在对21种多语言大语言模型进行的零样本评估中，采用推理模式的模型表现最为出色（整体得分达到80.8%），并且其在英语和当地语言之间的性能接近（差异为-1.3%）。而开放权重模型的当地语言表现则明显较差（差异为-6.8%），在真假判断题上的表现也常常接近于随机水平。那些基于文化因素的计数和数学模板则始终是最难处理的。这些数据的访问链接为：https://huggingface.co/datasets/AlaaAhmed2444/Macaron。

papers.title: Typology-Aware Multilingual Morphosyntactic Parsing with Joint Abstract Node Modeling
papers.title_zh: 基于类型学原理的多语言形态句法解析方法，包含抽象节点的联合建模机制
papers.authors: Kutay Acar, Gülşen Eryiğit
papers.abstract: The UniDive 2025 Morphosyntactic Parsing (MSP) shared task introduces a representation unifying dependency structure, morphological features, and unrealized arguments. Unlike Universal Dependencies, MSP encodes abstract nodes (e.g., dropped subjects, implicit pronouns) as labels projected onto content words, which standard UD parsers cannot model. We present a multilingual, typology-aware joint system integrating word-type prediction, content-only parsing, morphological tagging, and an abstract-node component within a single architecture. The model combines the baseline joint framework with typology-conditioned adapters and progressive weighting for abstract supervision. On the MSP test set, our model outperforms the leading submission by 3.23 percentage points in MSLAS, 3.35 in LAS, and 1.78 in FEATS macro F1, demonstrating the effectiveness of typology-sensitive multi-task learning in MSP.
papers.abstract_zh: UniDive 2025形态句法解析（MSP）共享任务提出了一种统一依存结构、形态特征以及未处理参数的表示方法。与通用依存关系不同，MSP将抽象节点（如省略的主语、隐含的代词）作为标签嵌入到实词中，这是标准UD解析器无法实现的。我们提出了一个多语言、考虑类型学的联合系统，该系统整合了词型预测、仅内容解析、形态标注功能，以及一个用于抽象节点的组件，所有这些功能都集成在单一架构中。该模型结合了基线联合框架、基于类型的适配器以及用于抽象监督的渐进式加权策略。在MSP测试集上，我们的模型在MSLAS指标上比领先提交方案高出3.23个百分点，在LAS指标上高出3.35个百分点，在FEATS宏F1指标上高出1.78个百分点，这充分证明了针对类型学的多任务学习在MSP领域中的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SharVeT: Similarity-aware Parameter Sharing with Vector-based Tuning for Efficient LLM Compression
papers.title_zh: SharVeT：基于向量调度的相似性感知参数共享技术，实现高效的大语言模型压缩
papers.authors: Jeongin Yun, Jaeri Lee, Jongjin Kim, Minjun Kim, Jinho Song, U Kang
papers.abstract: How can we share parameters within large language models to significantly reduce memory costs while preserving accuracy? While parameter sharing is a promising solution to the memory overhead of large language models, existing methods rely on naive grouping and fail to correct sharing-induced discrepancies. We propose an accurate and efficient parameter sharing framework, SharVeT (Similarity-aware sharing with Vector-based Tuning), which performs similarity-based grouping to ensure accurate sharing, allocates parameters adaptively to preserve diversity within each group, and applies lightweight refinement with knowledge distillation to correct sharing-induced discrepancies. Experiments show that SharVeT outperforms existing sharing methods, achieving up to 32.1% lower perplexity and 23.3% higher few-shot reasoning accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们如何在大语言模型内部共享参数，以显著降低内存成本，同时保持准确性？虽然参数共享是解决大语言模型内存开销问题的有前景的方法，但现有的方法依赖于简单的数据分组方式，无法纠正因参数共享而产生的差异。我们提出了一种准确且高效的参数共享框架——SharVeT（基于向量调优的相似性感知共享）。该框架通过基于相似性的分组来确保参数的准确共享，能够自适应地分配参数以保持每个组内的多样性，并通过知识蒸馏进行轻量级优化，以纠正因参数共享而产生的差异。实验表明，SharVeT在性能上优于现有的共享方法，其困惑度降低了32.1%，少样本推理准确率提高了23.3%。

papers.title: Beyond Variance: Knowledge-Aware LLM Compression via Fisher-Aligned Subspace Diagnostics
papers.title_zh: 超越变异性：基于费舍尔对齐子空间的知识感知大语言模型压缩技术
papers.authors: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma
papers.abstract: Post-training activation compression is essential for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) on resource-constrained hardware. However, standard methods like Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) are gradient-blind: they preserve high-variance dimensions regardless of their impact on factual knowledge preservation. We introduce Fisher-Aligned Subspace Compression (FASC), a knowledge-aware compression framework that selects subspaces by directly modeling activation-gradient coupling, minimizing a second-order surrogate of the loss function. FASC leverages the Fisher Information Matrix to identify dimensions critical for factual knowledge, which often reside in low-variance but high-gradient-sensitivity subspaces. We propose the Dependence Violation Score (ρ) as a general-purpose diagnostic metric that quantifies activation-gradient coupling, revealing where factual knowledge is stored within transformer architectures. Extensive experiments on Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B demonstrate that FASC preserves 6–8% more accuracy on knowledge-intensive benchmarks (MMLU, LAMA) compared to variance-based methods at 50% rank reduction, effectively enabling a 7B model to match the factual recall of a 13B uncompressed model. Our analysis reveals that ρ serves as a fundamental signal of stored knowledge, with high-ρ layers emerging only when models internalize factual associations during training
papers.abstract_zh: 训练后的激活值压缩对于在资源有限的硬件上部署大语言模型至关重要。然而，像奇异值分解这样的标准方法是不考虑梯度变化的：它们会保留高方差的维度，而忽略这些维度对事实知识保存的影响。我们提出了Fisher对齐子空间压缩技术，这是一种注重知识保存的压缩框架。该技术通过直接建模激活值与梯度的耦合关系来选取子空间，从而最小化损失函数的二阶替代指标。Fisher对齐子空间压缩利用Fisher信息矩阵来识别对事实知识至关重要的维度，这些维度通常存在于低方差但高梯度敏感性的子空间中。我们提出了依赖性违反分数作为通用诊断指标，该指标可以量化激活值与梯度的耦合程度，从而揭示事实知识在Transformer架构中的存储位置。在Mistral-7B和Llama-3-8B上的大量实验表明，与基于方差的方法相比，Fisher对齐子空间压缩在需要较多知识的基准测试（如MMLU、LAMA）中能提升6-8%的准确率。在50%的排名降低情况下，Fisher对齐子空间压缩能够有效使7B模型的真实召回率达到未压缩的13B模型的水平。我们的分析表明，ρ可以作为存储知识的根本信号，只有当模型在训练过程中内部化了事实关联时，才会出现高ρ值的层。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: REMIND: Memorization and Unlearning in LLMs Through the Lens of Input Loss Landscapes
papers.title_zh: 提醒：从输入缺失的视角来看，大语言模型中的记忆与遗忘机制
papers.authors: Liran Cohen, Yaniv Nemcovsky, Avi Mendelson
papers.abstract: Understanding how large language models (LLMs) store, retain, and remove knowledge is critical for interpretability, reliability, and privacy compliance. We reveal a key phenomenon: machine unlearning imprints distinct geometric signatures in the model’s input loss landscape (ILL), with unlearned examples forming flat, low-curvature plateaus that contrast sharply with the high-curvature basins of retained or unseen examples. Remarkably, these patterns emerge even when pointwise losses overlap, exposing residual memorization through input-output behavior alone. Building on this insight, we introduce REMIND (Residual Memorization in Neighborhood Dynamics), a framework that diagnoses memorization states (retained, forgotten, holdout) by probing local ILL curvature over semantically coherent neighborhoods. REMIND operates using only loss queries and a novel embedding-proximity perturbation method to generate controlled, interpretable variants. In evaluations, REMIND achieves 82% multi-class ROC-AUC, outperforming baselines like ROUGE-L and MIN-K%++, with roughly 2× higher AUC at 1% FPR, and remains robust on paraphrased inputs. This neighborhood-level geometric analysis provides a practical, interpretable lens on LLM knowledge retention and unlearning, detecting subtle residual signals missed by pointwise or aggregated metrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 了解大语言模型如何存储、保留和删除知识，对于模型的可解释性、可靠性和隐私合规性至关重要。我们发现了一个关键现象：机器忘记过程会在模型的输入损失图中留下独特的几何特征，被遗忘的样本会形成平坦、低曲率的平台状区域，这与被保留或未见过的样本所构成的高曲率区域形成鲜明对比。值得注意的是，即使不同样本的损失点相互重叠，这些模式仍然会出现，这表明模型仍然存在残留的记忆效应，这种效应可以通过输入-输出行为直接观察到。基于这一发现，我们提出了REMIND框架，该框架通过探测语义上连贯的邻域中的局部损失曲率，来诊断模型的记忆状态（保留、遗忘、保留但未完全遗忘）。REMIND仅使用损失查询和一种新颖的嵌入-邻近扰动方法，生成出可控且可解释的模型变体。在评估中，REMIND达到了82%的多类ROC-AUC分数，优于ROUGE-L和MIN-K%++等基线算法。在1%的假阳性率情况下，其AUC分数大约高出两倍，并且对释义输入仍然具有鲁棒性。这种基于邻域级别的几何分析方法为理解语言模型的知识保留与忘记过程提供了实用且可解释的工具，能够检测到那些被点状或聚合指标忽略的微妙残留信号。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reinforced Efficient Reasoning via Semantically Diverse Exploration
papers.title_zh: 通过语义上多样化的探索来强化高效推理能力
papers.authors: Ziqi Zhao, Zhaochun Ren, Jiahong Zou, Liu Yang, Zhiwei Xu, Xuri Ge, Zhumin Chen, Xinyu Ma, Daiting Shi, Shuaiqiang Wang, Dawei Yin, Xin Xin
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has proven effective in enhancing the reasoning of large language models (LLMs). Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based extensions improve upon vanilla RLVR (e.g., GRPO) by providing tree-based reasoning rollouts that enable fine-grained and segment-level credit assignment. However, existing methods still suffer from limited exploration diversity and inefficient reasoning. To address the above challenges, we propose reinforced efficient reasoning via semantically diverse explorations, i.e., ROSE, for LLMs. To encourage more diverse reasoning exploration, our method incorporates a semantic-entropy-based branching strategy and an \varepsilon-exploration mechanism. The former operates on already sampled reasoning rollouts to capture semantic uncertainty and select branching points with high semantic divergence to generate new successive reasoning paths, whereas the latter stochastically initiates reasoning rollouts from the root, preventing the search process from becoming overly local. To improve efficiency, we design a length-aware segment-level advantage estimator that rewards concise and correct reasoning while penalizing unnecessarily long reasoning chains. Extensive experiments on various mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Qwen and Llama models validate the effectiveness and efficiency of ROSE. Codes are available at https://github.com/ZiqiZhao1/ROSE-rl.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力方面表现出显著效果。基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的扩展方法通过提供基于树的推理策略，改进了传统的RLVR（例如GRPO），使得能够进行细粒度和分段的信用分配。然而，现有的方法仍然存在探索多样性不足和推理效率低下的问题。为了应对上述挑战，我们提出了一种通过语义多样性探索来实现高效推理的方法，即ROSE。为了鼓励更多样化的推理探索，我们的方法采用了基于语义熵的分支策略和ε-探索机制。前者通过对已采样的推理策略进行处理，捕捉语义上的不确定性，并选择具有较高语义差异性的分支点来生成新的推理路径；而后者则随机从根节点开始启动推理过程，避免搜索过程变得过于局部化。为了提高效率，我们设计了一种长度感知的分段级优势估计器，该估计器能够奖励简洁且正确的推理，同时惩罚不必要的长推理链。在多种数学推理基准测试中对Qwen和Llama模型进行的广泛实验验证了ROSE的有效性和高效性。代码可在https://github.com/ZiqiZhao1/ROSE-rl获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Is Chain-of-Thought Really Not Explainability? Chain-of-Thought Can Be Faithful without Hint Verbalization
papers.title_zh: 思维链真的无法解释模型的行为吗？其实，思维链可以在不需要提示的情况下仍然保持准确性
papers.authors: Kerem Zaman, Shashank Srivastava
papers.abstract: Recent work, using the Biasing Features metric, labels a CoT as unfaithful if it omits a prompt-injected hint that affected the prediction. We argue this metric adopts a narrow notion of faithfulness and confuses unfaithfulness with incompleteness, the lossy compression needed to turn distributed transformer computation into a linear natural language narrative. On multi-hop reasoning tasks with instruct-tuned and reasoning models, many CoTs flagged as unfaithful by Biasing Features are judged faithful by other metrics, exceeding 50% in some models. With a new faithful@k metric, we show that larger inference-time budgets greatly increase hint verbalization (up to 90% in some settings), suggesting much apparent unfaithfulness is due to tight token limits. Using Causal Mediation Analysis, we further show that even non-verbalized hints can causally mediate prediction changes through the CoT. We therefore caution against relying solely on hint-based evaluations and advocate a broader interpretability toolkit, including causal mediation and corruption-based metrics. We do not claim all CoTs are faithful, only that the absence of hint words alone does not prove unfaithfulness.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究中，使用“偏置特征”指标来判定某个CoT是否“不忠实”。如果某个CoT忽略了那些影响预测的提示信息，那么就被标记为不忠实。我们认为这个指标对“忠实性”的定义过于狭隘，它将“不忠实”与“不完整性”混淆了——其实“不完整性”只是将分布式Transformer的计算方式转化为线性自然语言叙事所必要的有损压缩过程而已。在具有指令调整和推理模型的多跳推理任务中，许多被“偏置特征”指标判定为不忠实的CoT，实际上被其他指标判定为忠实，在某些模型中这一比例甚至超过了50%。通过新的“faithful@k”指标，我们发现更大的推理时间预算能够显著增加提示信息的表达量（在某些情况下甚至可达90%），这表明很多表面上的“不忠实”现象实际上是由于令牌限制导致的。通过因果中介分析，我们进一步发现，即使是没有被语言化的提示信息，也能通过CoT引起预测结果的改变。因此，我们建议不要仅仅依赖基于提示信息的评估方法，而应采用更全面的解释性工具包，包括因果中介分析和基于腐败现象的度量方法。我们并不声称所有的CoT都是忠实的，只是单纯的缺少提示信息并不能证明它们是不忠实的。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: MegaRAG: Multimodal Knowledge Graph-Based Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: MegaRAG：基于知识图谱的多模态检索增强生成技术
papers.authors: Chi-Hsiang Hsiao, Yi-Cheng Wang, Tzung-Sheng Lin, Yi-Ren Yeh, Chu-song Chen
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to dynamically access external information, which is powerful for answering questions over previously unseen documents. Nonetheless, they struggle with high-level conceptual understanding and holistic comprehension due to limited context windows, which constrain their ability to perform deep reasoning over long-form, domain-specific content such as full-length books. To solve this problem, knowledge graphs (KGs) have been leveraged to provide entity-centric structure and hierarchical summaries, offering more structured support for reasoning. However, existing KG-based RAG solutions remain restricted to text-only inputs and fail to leverage the complementary insights provided by other modalities such as vision. On the other hand, reasoning from visual documents requires textual, visual, and spatial cues into structured, hierarchical concepts. To address this issue, we introduce a multimodal knowledge graph-based RAG that enables cross-modal reasoning for better content understanding. Our method incorporates visual cues into the construction of knowledge graphs, the retrieval phase, and the answer generation process. Experimental results across both global and fine-grained question answering tasks show that our approach consistently outperforms existing approaches on both textual and multimodal benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术使得大语言模型能够动态访问外部信息，这对于回答关于前所未见文档的问题非常有用。然而，由于上下文窗口的限制，这类模型在高级概念理解和整体理解方面存在困难，这限制了它们对长篇、特定领域内容（如整本书籍）进行深度推理的能力。为了解决这个问题，人们利用知识图谱来提供以实体为中心的结构化和层次化的摘要，从而为推理提供更结构化的支持。不过，现有的基于知识图谱的RAG解决方案仍然局限于纯文本输入，无法充分利用其他模态（如视觉信息）所提供的补充信息。另一方面，从视觉文档中进行推理需要文本、视觉和空间线索来构建结构化、层次化的概念。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种基于多模态知识图谱的RAG方法，它能够实现跨模态推理，从而更好地理解文本内容。我们的方法将视觉线索融入到知识图谱的构建、检索阶段以及答案生成过程中。在全局级和细粒度问题回答任务中的实验结果表明，我们的方法在文本和多模态基准测试中始终优于现有方法。

papers.title: SELECting over Tokens: Curating Pre-training Data at Scale via Token Classification
papers.title_zh: 选择更多代币：通过令牌分类来整理大规模预训练数据
papers.authors: Xin Tong, Weidong Zhang, Jiaang Li, Haibin Chen, Shilei Liu, Langming Liu, Kangtao Lv, Yujin Yuan, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: The quality of pre-training data critically impacts the capabilities of large language models. Existing pipelines rely on expert-crafted heuristic rules, which primarily operate at the sample level and are based on coarse statistical indicators, thus lacking content-aware, fine-grained noise detection. While recent generative approaches, e.g., ProX-C, enable token-level refinement, their reliance on synthesizing Python code incurs prohibitive computational cost at scale and can introduce hallucinations into the refined data. To overcome these limitations, we propose Selecting over Tokens (SelecT), a novel framework that reframes data refinement as a highly efficient token classification task. SelecT classifies each token as either informative or noisy and subsequently removes the latter. This design achieves fine-grained data optimization while avoiding the inefficiency of generation, ensuring scalability. When evaluated on diverse downstream benchmarks, the model trained on SelecT-refined corpora, on average, outperforms the one trained on raw data by over 2% and exceeds the best heuristic baselines by more than 1% while preserving 17% more tokens than the latter. Furthermore, SelecT achieves higher average performance than the generative ProX-C across all experimental settings, and is 2.5x faster at inference, even with twice the parameters. Our results establish SelecT as an effective, efficient, and scalable solution for pre-training data optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 预训练数据的质量对大语言模型的能力有着至关重要的影响。现有的处理流程依赖于专家制定的启发式规则，这些规则主要在样本层面进行操作，并且基于粗略的统计指标，因此缺乏内容感知、细粒度的噪声检测能力。而最近的生成式方法，例如ProX-C，虽然能够实现token级别的精细化处理，但它们依赖人工编写Python代码的方式，会导致大规模计算成本过高，同时还会在精炼数据中引入幻觉现象。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了“选择令牌”（SelecT）这一创新框架。该框架将数据精炼任务重新定义为一种高效的令牌分类任务。SelecT将每个令牌分为信息丰富的类别和噪声类别，然后去除噪声类别的令牌。这种设计能够在避免生成式方法的低效性的同时，实现细粒度的数据优化，并确保了模型的可扩展性。在多种下游基准测试中的评估结果显示，使用SelecT进行预训练的模型，其性能平均比使用原始数据进行训练的模型高出2%以上，且比最佳启发式基线模型还要优秀1%以上，同时保留的令牌数量多出17%。此外，SelecT在所有实验设置中都能取得比生成式模型ProX-C更高的平均性能，并且在推理速度上快2.5倍，即使参数数量是ProX-C的两倍。我们的研究结果证明了SelecT是一种有效、高效且可扩展的数据预训练优化解决方案。

papers.title: TROJail: Trajectory-Level Optimization for Multi-Turn Large Language Model Jailbreaks with Process Rewards
papers.title_zh: TROJail：针对多轮次大型语言模型越狱过程的轨迹级优化算法，该算法基于过程奖励机制进行设计
papers.authors: Xiqiao Xiong, Ouxiang Li, Zhuo Liu, Moxin Li, Wentao Shi, Fengbin Zhu, Qifan Wang, Fuli Feng
papers.abstract: Large language models have seen widespread adoption, yet they remain vulnerable to multi-turn jailbreak attacks, threatening their safe deployment. This has led to the task of training automated multi-turn attackers to probe model safety vulnerabilities. However, existing approaches typically rely on turn-level optimization, which is insufficient for learning long-term attack strategies. To bridge this gap, we formulate this task as a multi-turn reinforcement learning problem, directly optimizing the harmfulness of the final-turn response as the outcome reward. To address the sparse supervision of the outcome reward, we introduce TROJail, which employs two process rewards to evaluate the utility of intermediate prompts and integrate them into advantage estimation. These rewards (1) penalize overly harmful prompts that trigger the model’s refusal mechanism, and (2) encourage steering the semantic relevance of responses toward the targeted harmful content. Experimental results show improved attack success rates across multiple models and benchmarks, highlighting the effectiveness of our approach. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TROJail. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful content.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已经得到了广泛的采用，但它们仍然容易受到多轮越狱攻击的威胁，这严重影响了它们的安全部署。因此，需要训练自动化多轮攻击者来探测模型的漏洞。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于单轮优化，这对于学习长期的攻击策略来说是不够的。为了填补这一空白，我们将这个问题转化为一个多轮强化学习问题，直接将最终一轮响应的危害性作为奖励来优化。为了解决结果奖励的稀疏监督问题，我们引入了TROJail算法，该算法利用两个过程奖励来评估中间提示的效用，并将其整合到优势估计中。这些奖励一方面会对那些引发模型拒绝机制的过度有害提示进行惩罚，另一方面则鼓励引导响应的语义相关性朝着目标有害内容方向发展。实验结果表明，我们的方法在多种模型和基准测试中的攻击成功率有所提高，这充分证明了我们方法的有效性。代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TROJail获取。警告：本文包含有害内容的示例。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Accurate and Efficient Statistical Testing for Word Semantic Breadth
papers.title_zh: 准确且高效的词汇语义宽度统计检验方法
papers.authors: Yo Ehara
papers.abstract: Measuring the breadth of a word’s meaning, or its spread across contexts, has become feasible with contextualized token embeddings. A word type can be represented as a cloud of token vectors, with dispersion-based statistics serving as proxies for contextual diversity (Nagata and Tanaka-Ishii, ACL2025). These measurements are useful for deciding appropriate sense distinctions when constructing thesauri and domain-specific dictionaries. However, when comparing the breadth of two word types, naive hypothesis testing on dispersion can be misleading: differences in semantic direction can masquerade as dispersion differences, inflating Type-I error and yielding “statistically significant” outcomes even when there is no true breadth difference. This is problematic because significance testing should distinguish genuine effects from incidental fluctuations in small-difference regimes. We propose a Householder-aligned permutation test to isolate dispersion differences from directional differences. Our method applies a single Householder reflection to align the mean directions of the two word types and then performs a permutation test on the aligned token clouds, yielding calibrated, non-parametric p-values. For practicality, we introduce a GPU-oriented implementation that batches permutations and linear algebra operations. Empirically, our alignment reduced Type-I error by 32.5% while preserving sensitivity to genuine breadth differences, and achieved a 23\times speedup over the CPU baseline.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过上下文相关的令牌嵌入技术，可以测量一个词的含义范围以及其在不同上下文中的分布情况。一个词类型可以被表示为一组令牌向量的集合，而基于分散度的统计指标则可以作为上下文多样性的代理指标（Nagata和Tanaka-Ishii，ACL2025）。这些测量值在构建词库和领域特定词典时，对于确定合适的语义区分具有重要意义。然而，在比较两种词类型的范围时，对分散度进行简单的假设检验可能会带来误导：语义方向上的差异可能会被误认为是分散度上的差异，从而导致第一类错误增加，即使实际上并不存在真正的范围差异，也会得到“统计上显著”的结果。这是一个问题，因为显著性检验应该能够区分真正的影响与小差异情况下的偶然波动。我们提出了一种与Householder方法相一致的排列检验方法，以分离分散度差异和方向性差异。我们的方法采用单一的Householder反射技术来对齐两种词类型的平均方向，然后对这些对齐后的令牌向量进行排列检验，从而得到经过校准的非参数p值。为了实用起见，我们还引入了一种面向GPU的实现方式，它能够批量处理排列操作和线性代数运算。从经验来看，我们的对齐方法将第一类错误减少了32.5%，同时仍然能够敏感地识别真正的范围差异，并且比CPU基准实现快了23倍。

papers.title: Constructing coherent spatial memory in LLM agents through graph rectification
papers.title_zh: 通过图结构重构，在大型语言模型代理中构建连贯的空间记忆机制
papers.authors: Puzhen Zhang, Xuyang Chen, Yu Feng, Yuhan Jiang, Liqiu Meng
papers.abstract: Given a map description through global traversal navigation instructions, an LLM can often infer the implicit spatial layout and answer user queries by providing shortest paths. However, such context-dependent querying becomes incapable as environments grow larger, motivating the need for incremental map construction that builds a complete topological graph from stepwise observations. We propose a framework for LLM-driven construction and map repair, designed to detect, localize, and correct structural inconsistencies in incrementally constructed navigation graphs. Central to our method is the Version Control, which records the full history of graph edits and their source observations, enabling fine-grained rollback, conflict tracing, and repair evaluation. We further introduce an Edge Impact Score to prioritize minimal-cost repairs based on structural reachability, path usage, and conflict propagation. To properly evaluate our approach, we create a refined version of the MANGO benchmark dataset by systematically removing non-topological actions and inherent structural conflicts, providing a cleaner testbed for LLM-driven construction and map repair. Our approach significantly improves map correctness and robustness, especially in scenarios with entangled or chained inconsistencies. Our results highlight the importance of introspective, history-aware repair mechanisms for maintaining coherent spatial memory in LLM agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过全局导航指令提供的地图描述，大语言模型通常能够推断出隐含的空间布局，并通过提供最短路径来回答用户的查询。然而，随着环境的不断扩大，这种依赖上下文的查询方式变得不再适用，因此有必要进行逐步的地图构建，从逐步获得的观测数据中构建出完整的拓扑图。我们提出了一种由大语言模型驱动的地图构建和修复框架，该框架旨在检测、定位并纠正逐步构建的导航图中的结构不一致性。我们的方法的核心在于版本控制机制，它记录了所有图编辑操作及其来源观测数据的完整历史，使得可以进行精细的回滚、冲突追踪以及修复评估。我们还引入了“边影响得分”机制，根据结构可达性、路径使用情况和冲突传播情况来优先选择成本最低的修复方案。为了充分评估我们的方法，我们通过系统地移除非拓扑性操作和固有的结构冲突，对MANGO基准数据集进行了优化，从而为大语言模型驱动的地图构建和修复提供了一个更清晰的测试环境。我们的方法显著提高了地图的正确性和鲁棒性，尤其是在存在复杂或连锁不一致性的情况下。我们的研究结果强调了具有自省能力且能记住历史信息的修复机制对于维护大语言模型代理的连贯空间记忆的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Punctuation-Steered Representation Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 标点符号引导的表示方式优化
papers.authors: Zheng Gong, Ying Sun, Ping Li, Yi Zheng, Zhefeng Wang
papers.abstract: Representation Fine-tuning (ReFT), a recently proposed parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PeFT) method, significantly improves parameter efficiency by modifying the representation space alone. However, directly applying ReFT, which alters a fixed number of representations at the beginning and end positions of each layer, results in suboptimal performance for two reasons. (i) The impact of these fixed-position representations on the output is uncertain; (ii) As the sequence length increases, fine-tuning a fixed number of representations may have diminishing effects on the final results. Based on our observations that punctuation plays a crucial role in integrating representations from preceding layers and modulating those of subsequent layers, we introduce Punctuation-steered Representation Fine-tuning (PuReFT), a straightforward yet powerful approach that additionally fine-tunes punctuation representations to achieve performance improvements. Extensive evaluations on common-sense, arithmetic, and code datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and versatility of PuReFT. Furthermore, our analysis of its training speed and memory overhead confirms its greater ease of use and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 表示微调（ReFT）是一种最近提出的参数高效微调方法，它通过仅修改表示空间来显著提高参数效率。然而，直接应用ReFT时，由于会在每层的开头和结尾位置固定地修改表示，这会导致性能不佳，原因有二：(i) 这些固定位置的表示对输出的影响是不确定的；(ii) 随着序列长度的增加，微调固定数量的表示对最终结果的改善效果会逐渐减弱。基于我们的观察，标点符号在整合前一层表示以及调节后一层表示方面起着至关重要的作用，我们提出了基于标点符号的表示微调方法——PuReFT。这是一种简单而强大的方法，它还能进一步微调标点符号的表示，从而提升性能。在常见的算术和代码数据集上的广泛评估表明，PuReFT具有出色的有效性和通用性。此外，我们对其训练速度和内存开销的分析也证明了它的易用性和高效性。

papers.title: Does Self-Consistency Improve the Recall of Encyclopedic Knowledge?
papers.title_zh: 自我一致性是否能够提高对百科知识的理解能力？
papers.authors: Sho Hoshino, Ukyo Honda, Peinan Zhang
papers.abstract: While self-consistency is known to improve performance on symbolic reasoning, its effect on the recall of encyclopedic knowledge is unclear due to a lack of targeted evaluation grounds. To address this, we establish such a knowledge recall split for the popular MMLU benchmark by applying a data-driven heuristic from prior work. We validate this split by showing that the performance patterns on the symbolic reasoning and knowledge recall subsets mirror those of GSM8K and MedMCQA, respectively. Using this solid ground, we find that self-consistency consistently improves performance across both symbolic reasoning and knowledge recall, even though its underlying CoT prompting is primarily effective for symbolic reasoning. As a result, we achieve an 89% accuracy on MMLU, the best performance to date with the use of GPT-4o.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然自我一致性已知能提升符号推理的性能，但由于缺乏针对性的评估手段，其对百科知识检索效果的影响尚不清楚。为了解决这一问题，我们采用了之前工作中提出的数据驱动启发式方法，为流行的MMLU基准测试建立了这样的知识检索分割方式。我们通过展示在符号推理和知识检索两个子任务上的性能模式与GSM8K和MedMCQA的表现一致来验证这一分割方法的有效性。基于这一可靠的基础，我们发现，尽管自我一致性机制的主要作用在于符号推理，但它能够持续提升符号推理和知识检索两个方面的性能。最终，我们使用GPT-4o在MMLU任务上取得了89%的准确率，这是迄今为止使用该模型所取得的最佳成绩。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LaMI: Augmenting Large Language Models via Late Multi-Image Fusion
papers.title_zh: LaMI：通过晚期多图像融合技术提升大型语言模型的性能
papers.authors: Guy Yariv, Idan Schwartz, Yossi Adi, Sagie Benaim
papers.abstract: Commonsense reasoning often requires both textual and visual knowledge, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) trained solely on text lack visual grounding (e.g., “what color is an emperor penguin’s belly?”). Visual Language Models (VLMs) perform better on visually grounded tasks but face two limitations: (i) often reduced performance on text-only commonsense reasoning compared to text-trained LLMs, and (ii) adapting newly released LLMs to vision input typically requires costly multimodal training. An alternative augments LLMs with test-time visual signals, improving visual commonsense without harming textual reasoning, but prior designs often rely on early fusion and a single image, which can be suboptimal. We propose a late multi-image fusion method: multiple images are generated from the text prompt with a lightweight parallel sampling, and their prediction probabilities are combined with those of a text-only LLM through a late-fusion layer that integrates projected visual features just before the final prediction. Across visual commonsense and NLP benchmarks, our method significantly outperforms augmented LLMs on visual reasoning, matches VLMs on vision-based tasks, and, when applied to strong LLMs such as LLaMA 3, also improves NLP performance while adding only modest test-time overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 常识推理通常需要文本和视觉信息，然而仅基于文本训练的大语言模型在缺乏视觉信息的情况下表现不佳（例如，“帝企鹅的腹部是什么颜色？”）。视觉语言模型在基于视觉信息的任务中表现更好，但存在两个局限性：(i)与基于文本训练的LLM相比，它们在纯文本条件下的常识推理能力通常较差；(ii)将新发布的LLM适配到视觉输入通常需要成本高昂的多模态训练。另一种方法是为LLM添加测试时的视觉信号，从而改善视觉常识推理能力，同时不影响文本推理能力。不过，之前的设计往往依赖于早期融合和单一图像，这可能不是最优方案。我们提出了一种后期多图像融合方法：从文本提示中生成多张图像，并通过轻量级的并行采样方式获取这些图像的概率分布。然后将这些概率与仅基于文本的LLM的预测结果进行结合，通过一个后期融合层来实现这一整合过程，该层在最终预测之前整合了投影出的视觉特征。在视觉常识推理和自然语言处理方面的基准测试中，我们的方法在视觉推理能力方面显著优于传统的增强型LLM，在基于视觉的任务上则与视觉语言模型相当。而当应用于像LLaMA 3这样的强大LLM时，我们的方法还能提升自然语言处理性能，同时只增加了适度的测试时间开销。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Full-Duplex-Bench-v2: A Multi-Turn Evaluation Framework for Duplex Dialogue Systems with an Automated Examiner
papers.title_zh: 全双工测试框架v2：一种用于评估双向对话系统的多轮评估框架，包含自动评估机制
papers.authors: Guan-Ting Lin, Shih-Yun Shan Kuan, Jiatong Shi, Kai-Wei Chang, Siddhant Arora, Shinji Watanabe, Hung-yi Lee
papers.abstract: While full-duplex speech agents enable natural, low-latency interaction by speaking and listening simultaneously, their consistency and task performance in multi-turn settings remain underexplored. We introduce Full-Duplex-Bench-v2 (FDB-v2), a streaming framework that integrates with an automated examiner that enforces staged goals under two pacing setups (Fast vs. Slow). FDB-v2 covers four task families—Daily, Correction, Entity Tracking, and Safety—and reports turn-taking fluency, multi-turn instruction following, and task-specific competence. The framework is extensible, supporting both commercial APIs and open-source models. When we test full-duplex systems with FDB-v2, they often get confused when people talk at the same time, struggle to handle corrections smoothly, and sometimes lose track of who or what is being talked about. Through an open-source, standardized streaming protocol and a task set, FDB-v2 makes it easy to extend to new task families, allowing the community to tailor and accelerate evaluation of multi-turn full-duplex systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然全双工语音助手能够通过同时说话和倾听来实现自然且低延迟的互动，但其在多轮对话环境中的一致性和任务执行能力仍有待深入研究。我们提出了Full-Duplex-Bench-v2（FDB-v2）这一流式框架，该框架可以与自动化评估工具集成，在两种节奏设置下实现分阶段的目标达成（快速与慢速）。FDB-v2涵盖了四种任务类型：日常事务、纠错、实体跟踪以及安全相关任务，并能够评估多轮对话中的流畅性、多轮指令遵循能力以及特定任务的胜任度。该框架具有可扩展性，支持商业API和开源模型的使用。当我们使用FDB-v2测试全双工系统时，发现这些系统常常在处理多人同时发言时会出现混乱，难以顺利处理纠错任务，有时甚至无法分辨正在讨论的对象或内容。通过一种开源的标准化流式协议和任务集，FDB-v2使得向新的任务类型扩展变得容易，从而让社区能够定制并加速对多轮全双工系统的评估。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Situated Embedding Models for Context-Aware Dense Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 适用于上下文感知密集检索的嵌入模型
papers.authors: Junjie Wu, Jiangnan Li, Yuqing Li, Lemao Liu, Liyan Xu, Jiwei Li, Dit-Yan Yeung, Jie Zhou, Mo Yu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over long documents typically involves splitting the text into smaller chunks, which serve as the basic units for retrieval. However, due to dependencies across the original document, contextual information is often essential for accurately interpreting each chunk. To address this, prior work has explored encoding longer context windows to produce embeddings for longer chunks, yet their gains in retrieval and downstream tasks remain limited. This is because (1) longer chunks strain the capacity of embedding models due to the increased amount of information they must encode, and (2) many real-world applications still require returning localized evidence due to constraints on model or human bandwidth. To this end, we propose an alternative approach to this challenge by representing short chunks in a way that is conditioned on a broader context window to enhance retrieval performance – i.e., situating a chunk’s meaning within its context. We further show that existing embedding models are not well-equipped to encode such situated context effectively, and thus introduce a new training paradigm and develop the first situated embedding model. To evaluate our method, we curate a book-plot retrieval dataset specifically designed to assess situated retrieval capabilities. On this benchmark, our 1B-parameter model substantially outperforms state-of-the-art embedding models, including several with up to 7B parameters.
papers.abstract_zh: 在长文档的检索增强生成中，通常需要将文本分割成较小的片段，这些片段被用作检索的基本单位。然而，由于原始文档之间的依赖关系，上下文信息对于准确解释每个片段至关重要。为了解决这个问题，之前的研究尝试通过编码更长的上下文窗口来生成更长片段的嵌入向量，但其在检索和下游任务上的提升效果仍然有限。这是因为：(1) 较长的片段会加大嵌入模型的负担，因为它们需要编码的信息量更大；(2) 许多现实世界的应用仍然需要返回局部化的证据，因为受到模型或人类处理能力的限制。为此，我们提出了一种替代方法：以基于更广泛上下文窗口的方式来表示短片段，从而提升检索性能——即让片段的含义与其上下文相关联。我们还发现，现有的嵌入模型无法有效编码这种情境化上下文，因此我们引入了一种新的训练范式，并开发了首个情境化嵌入模型。为了评估我们的方法，我们专门构建了一个书籍情节检索数据集，专门用于评估情境化检索能力。在这个基准测试上，我们的10亿参数模型的表现明显优于最先进的嵌入模型，包括那些拥有高达70亿参数的模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Big AI is Accelerating the Metacrisis: What Can We Do?
papers.title_zh: 大型人工智能正在加速这一元危机的爆发：我们能做些什么呢？
papers.authors: Steven Bird
papers.abstract: The world is in the grip of ecological, meaning, and language crises that are converging into a metacrisis. Big AI is accelerating them all. LLM engineering sits at the core. Despite the public good motives of language engineers and the promise of LLMs, this work is being leveraged to create unprecedented wealth and power for a handful of individuals and corporations while causing existential harm to life on earth. As a profession, we urgently need to come together to explore alternatives and to design a life-affirming future for our field of natural language processing that is centered on human flourishing on a living planet.
papers.abstract_zh: 世界正陷入生态、意义以及语言方面的危机之中，这些危机正在融合成一场宏观危机。大型人工智能的快速发展正在加速这一切进程。大语言模型工程正是解决这些问题的关键所在。尽管语言工程师们有着造福社会的动机，且大语言模型也带来了诸多潜力，但实际上，这项技术却被用来为少数人和企业创造前所未有的财富与权力，同时给地球上的生命带来了毁灭性的危害。作为一门专业，我们迫切需要团结起来，寻找替代方案，并设计一个能够促进人类发展的自然语言处理未来，让人类能够在宜居的星球上繁荣发展。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Factuality to Meta-Factivity: A Cognitive Blueprint for Trustworthy LLMs
papers.title_zh: 从事实性到元复杂性：构建可信大语言模型的认知框架
papers.authors: Daohuan Liu, Lun Xia, Yuer Wang, Jiaoyang Su, Xuri Tang
papers.abstract: Current research on Event Factuality Prediction (EFP) predominantly treats LLMs as passive classifiers, where high aggregate metrics often mask shortcut learning and unreliable reasoning. In this position paper, we argue for a focus shift from event factuality to meta-factivity. We introduce the Meta-Factivity Framework (MFF), a theoretical roadmap that moves evaluation beyond surface recognition to belief trajectory reasoning and epistemic regulation. By framing hallucination as a failure of meta-cognitive control, we advocate for a transition from measuring black-box accuracy to evaluating white-box cognition, laying the groundwork for a more rigorous benchmark for explainable self-governance.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前关于事件真实性预测的研究大多将大语言模型视为被动的分类器，而高综合指标往往掩盖了模型的捷径学习和不可靠的推理能力。在这篇论文中，我们主张将研究重点从事件真实性转向元活动性。我们提出了“元活动性框架”这一理论框架，该框架将评估工作从表面识别扩展到信念轨迹推理和认知调控层面。通过将幻觉视为元认知控制的失败，我们倡导从衡量黑盒精度转变为评估白盒认知，从而为建立更严格的、可解释的自主控制基准奠定基础。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Attention Sinks Are Provably Necessary in Softmax Transformers: Evidence from Trigger-Conditional Tasks
papers.title_zh: 注意池在Softmax变换器中确实是必需的：来自触发条件任务的证据
papers.authors: Yuval Ran-Milo
papers.abstract: Transformers often display an attention sink: probability mass concentrates on a fixed, content-agnostic position. Are sinks a byproduct of the optimization/training regime? Or are they sometimes functionally necessary in softmax Transformers? We prove that, in some settings, it is the latter: computing a simple trigger-conditional behavior necessarily induces a sink in softmax self-attention models. Our results formalize a familiar intuition: normalization over a probability simplex must force attention to collapse onto a stable anchor to realize a default state (e.g., when the model needs to ignore the input). We instantiate this with a concrete task: when a designated trigger token appears, the model must return the average of all preceding token representations, and otherwise output zero, a task which mirrors the functionality of attention heads in the wild (Barbero et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2024). We also prove that non-normalized ReLU attention can solve the same task without any sink, confirming that the normalization constraint is the fundamental driver of sink behavior. Experiments validate our predictions and demonstrate they extend beyond the theoretically analyzed setting: softmax models develop strong sinks while ReLU attention eliminates them in both single-head and multi-head variants.
papers.abstract_zh: Transformer模型常常会出现注意力聚集现象：概率质量集中在某个固定的、与内容无关的位置上。这种聚集现象是优化/训练过程的副产品吗？还是说在softmaxTransformer模型中，这种聚集有时是功能上的必要需求呢？我们证明，在某些情况下，正是后者：在计算基于触发条件的简单行为时，必然会在softmax自注意力模型中产生聚集现象。我们的研究结果证实了一个常见的直觉：对概率空间进行归一化处理，必然会迫使注意力集中在某个稳定的锚点上，从而实现默认状态（例如，当模型需要忽略输入数据时）。我们通过一个具体的任务来验证这一结论：当某个指定的触发词出现时，模型必须返回所有先前词表示的平均值；否则就输出零值。这个任务实际上反映了现实世界中注意力头的运作方式（Barbero等人，2025年；Guo等人，2024年）。我们还证明了，非归一化的ReLU注意力机制可以在没有任何聚集现象的情况下完成同样的任务，这进一步证实了归一化约束是导致聚集现象的根本原因。实验验证了我们的预测，并表明这些现象不仅存在于理论分析中的情境下：在softmax模型中，聚集现象非常明显；而在ReLU注意力模型中，无论是单头还是多头结构，聚集现象都消失了。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Mechanistic Account of Attention Sinks in GPT-2: One Circuit, Broader Implications for Mitigation
papers.title_zh: GPT-2中注意力机制的失效机制：一个电路模型，对缓解该问题的更广泛意义
papers.authors: Yuval Ran-Milo, Hila Ofek, Shahar Mendel
papers.abstract: Transformers commonly exhibit an attention sink: disproportionately high attention to the first position. We study this behavior in GPT-2–style models with learned query biases and absolute positional embeddings. Combining structural analysis with causal interventions, validated across natural-language, mathematical, and code inputs, we find that the sink arises from the interaction among (i) a learned query bias, (ii) the first-layer MLP transformation of the positional encoding, and (iii) structure in the key projection. Crucially, each component we identify is individually dispensable: architectures omitting each of them robustly exhibit sinks. This indicates that attention sinks may arise through distinct circuits across architectures. These findings inform mitigation of sinks, and motivate broader investigation into why sinks emerges.
papers.abstract_zh: Transformer模型通常表现出一种注意力消耗现象：对第一个位置的关注程度异常高。我们在采用学习到的查询偏差和绝对位置嵌入的GPT-2风格模型中研究了这种行为。通过结合结构分析与因果干预手段，并在自然语言、数学和代码输入数据上进行了验证，我们发现这种注意力消耗现象源于以下三个因素的结合：(i) 学习到的查询偏差；(ii) 位置编码的第一层MLP变换；以及(iii) 键投影中的结构特征。关键的是，我们发现的每个因素都是独立存在的：即使去除其中任何一个因素，模型仍然能够稳定地表现出注意力消耗现象。这表明，注意力消耗现象可能通过不同的机制在多种架构中产生。这些发现为缓解注意力消耗现象提供了思路，并促使我们对为什么会出现这种现象进行更深入的研究。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Is a Document Educational or Just Wikipedia-Style? — Pitfalls of Classifier-Based Quality Filtering
papers.title_zh: 这是一份具有教育意义的文档，还是仅仅像维基百科那样的内容呢？——基于分类器的质量过滤存在的缺陷
papers.authors: Mateusz Klimaszewski, Piotr Andruszkiewicz
papers.abstract: Classifier-based Quality Filtering has recently emerged as a fundamental technique in constructing pre-training corpora. The ability to deploy a single model that can replace or supplement a set of heuristics has proven effective across numerous Large Language Models. In this work, we expose a critical vulnerability in this approach by demonstrating how a straightforward Wikipedia-style reformatting operation can substantially alter a model’s quality assessment and enable low-quality content to surpass filtering thresholds. Our analysis reveals that the FineWeb-Edu CQF model would reverse its filtering decision for approximately 7% of evaluated documents, thereby admitting content into the pre-training corpus that would otherwise have been excluded.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于分类器的质量过滤技术最近已成为构建预训练语料库的关键技术之一。能够使用单一模型来替代或补充一系列启发式方法的做法，已被证明在众多大语言模型中非常有效。在这项研究中，我们揭示了这种方法中的一个关键缺陷：通过简单的维基百科风格的重格式化操作，可以显著改变模型的评估结果，使得低质量内容能够突破过滤阈值。我们的分析表明，FineWeb-Edu CQF模型在大约7%的文档上会做出相反的过滤决策，从而让原本会被排除在预训练语料库之外的低质量内容进入该语料库。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: On the Hidden Objective Biases of Group-based Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 关于基于群体的强化学习中的隐藏目标偏差问题
papers.authors: Aleksandar Fontana, Marco Simoni, Giulio Rossolini, Paolo Mori, Andrea Saracino
papers.abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning methods, like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), are widely used nowadays to post-train large language models. Despite their empirical success, they exhibit structural mismatches between reward optimization and the underlying training objective. In this paper, we present a theoretical analysis of GRPO style methods by studying them within a unified surrogate formulation. This perspective reveals recurring properties that affect all the methods under analysis: (i) non-uniform group weighting induces systematic gradient biases on shared prefix tokens; (ii) interactions with the AdamW optimizer make training dynamics largely insensitive to reward scaling; and (iii) optimizer momentum can push policy updates beyond the intended clipping region under repeated optimization steps. We believe that these findings highlight fundamental limitations of current approaches and provide principled guidance for the design of future formulations.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于群体的强化学习方法，如群体相对策略优化（GRPO），如今被广泛用于大语言模型的后期训练。尽管这些方法在实证上取得了成功，但它们在奖励优化与底层训练目标之间存在结构性不匹配的问题。在本文中，我们通过在一个统一的替代框架内研究GRPO风格的方法，对其进行了理论分析。这一视角揭示了影响所有被分析方法的共同特性：(i) 非均匀的群体权重会导致共享前缀标记出现系统性梯度偏差；(ii) 与AdamW优化器的交互使得训练动态对奖励缩放的敏感性大大降低；以及(iii) 优化器的动量可以在重复优化过程中使策略更新超出预期的裁剪范围。我们认为，这些发现凸显了当前方法的基本局限性，并为未来算法的设计提供了原则性的指导。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: StructMem: Structured Memory for Long-Horizon Behavior in LLMs
papers.title_zh: StructMem：适用于大型语言模型长视野场景的结构化内存技术
papers.authors: Buqiang Xu, Yijun Chen, Jizhan Fang, Ruobin Zhong, Yunzhi Yao, Yuqi Zhu, Lun Du, Shumin Deng
papers.abstract: Long-term conversational agents need memory systems that capture relationships between events, not merely isolated facts, to support temporal reasoning and multi-hop question answering. Current approaches face a fundamental trade-off: flat memory is efficient but fails to model relational structure, while graph-based memory enables structured reasoning at the cost of expensive and fragile construction. To address these issues, we propose StructMem, a structure-enriched hierarchical memory framework that preserves event-level bindings and induces cross-event connections. By temporally anchoring dual perspectives and performing periodic semantic consolidation, StructMem improves temporal reasoning and multi-hop performance on LoCoMo, while substantially reducing token usage, API calls, and runtime compared to prior memory systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 长期对话智能体需要能够捕捉事件之间关系的记忆系统，而不仅仅是孤立的事实，这样才能支持时间推理和多跳问题回答。当前的方法面临着一个根本性的权衡：平面记忆虽然高效，但无法模拟关系结构；而基于图的记忆则能够实现结构化推理，但代价是构建过程复杂且容易出错。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了StructMem这一结构增强型分层记忆框架。该框架保留了事件级绑定关系，并建立了跨事件的连接。通过时间上的双视角锚定以及定期的语义整合，StructMem在LoCoMo任务上提升了时间推理能力及多跳回答性能，同时与之前的记忆系统相比，显著减少了token使用量、API调用次数以及运行时间。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Z3D: Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding from Images
papers.title_zh: Z3D：基于图像的零样本3D视觉定位技术
papers.authors: Nikita Drozdov, Andrey Lemeshko, Nikita Gavrilov, Anton Konushin, Danila Rukhovich, Maksim Kolodiazhnyi
papers.abstract: 3D visual grounding (3DVG) aims to localize objects in a 3D scene based on natural language queries. In this work, we explore zero-shot 3DVG from multi-view images alone, without requiring any geometric supervision or object priors. We introduce Z3D, a universal grounding pipeline that flexibly operates on multi-view images while optionally incorporating camera poses and depth maps. We identify key bottlenecks in prior zero-shot methods causing significant performance degradation and address them with (i) a state-of-the-art zero-shot 3D instance segmentation method to generate high-quality 3D bounding box proposals and (ii) advanced reasoning via prompt-based segmentation, which utilizes full capabilities of modern VLMs. Extensive experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance among zero-shot methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 3D视觉定位（3DVG）的目标是根据自然语言查询来定位3D场景中的物体。在这项研究中，我们探讨了仅依赖多视图图像进行零样本3DVG的方法，无需任何几何监督或物体先验信息。我们提出了Z3D这一通用定位框架，该框架能够灵活地处理多视图图像，并可以选择性地结合相机姿态和深度图。我们发现，现有的零样本方法中存在一些关键瓶颈，这些瓶颈会导致性能显著下降。针对这些问题，我们采取了以下措施：(i) 采用最先进的零样本3D实例分割方法，以生成高质量的3D边界框提议；(ii) 通过基于提示的分割技术进行高级推理，充分利用现代视觉语言模型的全部能力。在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在零样本方法中取得了领先的性能表现。

papers.title: Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation without Taxonomy-based Error Categorization
papers.title_zh: 在无需基于分类的错误分类的情况下，提升检索增强生成技术的性能
papers.authors: Gongbo Zhang, Yifan Peng, Chunhua Weng
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the factual accuracy of large language model (LLM) outputs by grounding generation in external knowledge. Recent agentic RAG systems extend this paradigm by introducing critic agents that evaluate model responses and iteratively refine outputs. However, most prior work implicitly assumes reliable critic feedback and focuses on planning strategies, while paying limited attention to the robustness of the error correction process itself, which is often hindered by misaligned error categories and ineffective or incorrect corrections. We hypothesize that RAG performance can be improved without explicit error categorization. To this end, we propose RePAIR, a response–action learning paradigm that directly maps flawed RAG outputs to error-mitigating action plans without relying on fine-grained error taxonomies or explicit critic supervision. Across multiple benchmarks, RePAIR consistently improves agentic RAG performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将生成过程与外部知识相结合，提高了大语言模型输出的准确性。最近的智能体RAG系统在此基础上进一步扩展，引入了评估模型响应的批评者代理，从而能够迭代地优化输出结果。然而，大多数先前的研究都隐含地假设了可靠的批评者反馈，并且主要关注策略规划，而对错误校正过程的鲁棒性关注不足。错误校正过程往往受到错误分类不准确或校正方法不当的阻碍。我们认为，无需明确区分错误类型，也可以提升RAG的性能。为此，我们提出了RePAIR这一响应-行动学习范式，它能够直接将有缺陷的RAG输出转化为可实施的纠错方案，而无需依赖细粒度的错误分类或明确的批评者监督。在多个基准测试中，RePAIR始终能够提升智能体RAG的性能。

papers.title: Deep Kernel Fusion for Transformers
papers.title_zh: 面向 Transformer 的深度核融合
papers.authors: Zixi Zhang, Zhiwen Mo, Yiren Zhao, Robert D. Mullins
papers.abstract: Agentic LLM inference with long contexts is increasingly limited by memory bandwidth rather than compute. In this setting, SwiGLU MLP blocks, whose large weights exceed cache capacity, become a major yet under-optimized bottleneck in the Transformer architecture. We propose DeepFusionKernel, a deeply fused kernel that cuts HBM traffic and boosts cache reuse, delivering up to 13.2% speedup on H100 and 9.7% on A100 over SGLang. Integrated with SGLang and paired with a kernel scheduler, DeepFusionKernel ensures consistent accelerations across generation lengths, while remaining adaptable to diverse models, inference configurations, and hardware platforms.
papers.abstract_zh: 在具有长上下文的AGENTIC LLM推理中，限制因素越来越多地来自内存带宽，而非计算能力。在这种情况下，SwiGLU MLP模块由于其较大的权重超出了缓存容量，成为了Transformer架构中的一个主要且未得到充分优化的瓶颈。我们提出了DeepFusionKernel这一深度融合的核函数，它能够减少HBM的流量消耗并提高缓存的复用率，从而在H100上实现了高达13.2%的速度提升，在A100上则达到了9.7%的速度提升，相比SGLang而言有显著优势。通过将DeepFusionKernel与SGLang集成在一起，并配合一个内核调度器使用，我们可以确保在不同的生成长度下都能获得稳定的加速效果，同时还能适应各种模型、推理配置以及硬件平台的需求。

papers.title: Anchoring Depends on Confidence and Post-Training in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 锚定效应取决于对语言模型的信任程度以及使用这些模型后的学习情况
papers.authors: Hillary N. Owusu, Naomi H. Feldman
papers.abstract: Anchoring bias causes large language models (LLMs) to shift quantitative judgments in response to irrelevant numerical primes. We analyze this bias as a function of model confidence and accuracy in base, instruction-tuned, and distilled variants of Llama and Qwen models. We find that anchoring susceptibility is negatively correlated with model confidence without regard to accuracy: confidently incorrect models resist anchoring as effectively as accurate ones, provided their internal priors are sufficiently strong. We further show that post-training impacts the strength of this relationship, and that models are more susceptible to high anchors than to low anchors. Our findings suggest anchoring resistance is a structural property of distributional concentration (certainty) rather than knowledge correctness (factual accuracy), with implications for deploying LLMs in numerical reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 锚定偏见会导致大语言模型在面临不相关的数值输入时，对定量判断产生偏差。我们分析了这种偏见与模型置信度以及Llama和Qwen模型的基准版、指令调优版和蒸馏版之间的关系。研究发现，无论准确性如何，锚定易感性都与模型置信度呈负相关：那些被自信地判定为错误的模型，只要其内部先验足够强，就能像准确的模型一样有效抵抗锚定效应。我们还发现，训练后的模型对这种关系的依赖性更强，且模型更容易受到高锚定的影响，而不是低锚定的影响。我们的研究结果表明，抵抗锚定效应的能力是分布集中性（确定性）的结构性特征，而非知识正确性（事实准确性）的体现。这一发现对于在数值推理任务中部署语言模型具有重要意义。

papers.title: LLMs Underperform Graph-Based Parsers on Supervised Relation Extraction for Complex Graphs
papers.title_zh: 基于图的解析器在处理复杂图的结构化关系提取任务时表现不佳
papers.authors: Paolo Gajo, Domenic Rosati, Hassan Sajjad, Alberto Barrón-Cedeño
papers.abstract: Relation extraction represents a fundamental component in the process of creating knowledge graphs, among other applications. Large language models (LLMs) have been adopted as a promising tool for relation extraction, both in supervised and in-context learning settings. However, in this work we show that their performance still lags behind much smaller architectures when the linguistic graph underlying a text has great complexity. To demonstrate this, we evaluate four LLMs against a graph-based parser on six relation extraction datasets with sentence graphs of varying sizes and complexities. Our results show that the graph-based parser increasingly outperforms the LLMs, as the number of relations in the input documents increases. This makes the much lighter graph-based parser a superior choice in the presence of complex linguistic graphs.
papers.abstract_zh: 关系提取是构建知识图谱过程中的一个基本组成部分，同时也在其他应用中发挥着重要作用。大语言模型已被视为在监督学习和上下文学习场景中进行关系提取的有力工具。然而，在我们的研究中我们发现，当文本背后的语言图结构非常复杂时，大语言模型的性能仍然远远落后于那些架构更简单的模型。为了验证这一点，我们在六个不同规模和复杂度的句子图数据集上，对四种大语言模型与基于图的解析器进行了对比测试。结果表明，随着输入文档中关系的数量增加，基于图的解析器的性能逐渐优于大语言模型。因此，在复杂的语言图结构情况下，基于图的解析器无疑是一个更为理想的选择。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Evolutionary Strategies at Scale lead to Catastrophic Forgetting
papers.title_zh: 在大规模应用中采用进化策略会导致灾难性的遗忘现象
papers.authors: Immanuel Abdi, Akshat Gupta, Micah Mok, Alex Lu, Nicholas Lee, Gopala Anumanchipalli
papers.abstract: One of biggest missing capabilities in state-of-the-art AI systems is the ability to learn continually after deployment. However, implementing an inference-time learning system has several challenges including the large memory requirement of gradient-based algorithms that are used to train state-of-the-art LLMs. Evolutionary Strategies (ES) have recently re-emerged as a gradient-free alternative to traditional learning algorithms and have shown encouraging performance on specific tasks in LLMs. In this paper, we perform a more comprehensive analysis of ES and specifically evaluate its forgetting curves when training for a larger number of update steps. We find that although ES is able to reach performance numbers closer to GRPO for math and reasoning tasks, it is accompanied by significant forgetting of prior abilities. We also show that the updates made using ES are much less sparse and have a larger l2 norm compared to corresponding GRPO updates, explaining the contrasting forgetting curves between the two algorithms. With this study, we aim to specifically highlight the issue of forgetting in gradient-free algorithms like ES and hope to inspire future work to mitigate these issues.
papers.abstract_zh: 在最新的AI系统中，最缺失的一项能力就是能够在部署后持续进行学习。然而，实现推理时学习的系统面临着诸多挑战，其中包括用于训练最新一代大语言模型的基础梯度算法的巨大内存需求。最近，进化策略作为一种无梯度的替代学习算法重新受到关注，并且在大语言模型的特定任务上展现出了令人鼓舞的性能。在本文中，我们对进化策略进行了更为全面的分析，并特别评估了在大量更新步骤下进行训练时其遗忘曲线的情况。我们发现，尽管进化策略在数学和推理任务上的性能接近GRPO算法，但它会显著地遗忘之前学到的能力。我们还发现，使用进化策略进行的更新比相应的GRPO更新更加稀疏，且L2范数也更大，这解释了两种算法之间遗忘曲线的差异。通过这项研究，我们希望能够明确指出像进化策略这样的无梯度算法所面临的遗忘问题，并为未来解决这些问题提供灵感。

papers.title: Too Correct to Learn: Reinforcement Learning on Saturated Reasoning Data
papers.title_zh: 过于精确而无法学习：在饱和推理数据上的强化学习
papers.authors: Zhenwen Liang, Yujun Zhou, Sidi Lu, Xiangliang Zhang, Haitao Mi, Dong Yu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) enhances LLM reasoning, yet a paradox emerges as models scale: strong base models saturate standard benchmarks (e.g., MATH), yielding correct but homogeneous solutions. In such environments, the lack of failure cases causes the advantage signal in group-relative algorithms (e.g., GRPO) to vanish, driving policies into mode collapse. To address this, we propose Constrained Uniform Top-K Sampling (CUTS), a parameter-free decoding strategy enforcing structure-preserving exploration. Unlike standard sampling that follows model biases, CUTS flattens the local optimization landscape by sampling uniformly from constrained high-confidence candidates. We integrate this into Mixed-CUTS, a training framework synergizing exploitative and exploratory rollouts to amplify intra-group advantage variance. Experiments on Qwen3 models demonstrate that our approach prevents policy degeneration and significantly boosts out-of-domain generalization. Notably, Mixed-CUTS improves Pass@1 accuracy on the challenging AIME25 benchmark by up to 15.1% over standard GRPO, validating that maintaining diversity within the semantic manifold is critical for rigorous reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习能够提升大语言模型的推理能力，但随着模型规模的扩大，会出现一个悖论：强大的基础模型能够在标准基准测试中取得满分，从而得出正确但单一化的解决方案。在这种环境下，由于缺乏失败案例，群体相对算法中的优势信号会消失，导致策略陷入模式崩溃状态。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了约束均匀Top-K采样方法（CUTS），这是一种无需调整参数的解码策略，它能够确保探索过程保持结构稳定性。与遵循模型偏见的传统采样方法不同，CUTS通过从具有较高可信度的候选样本中进行均匀采样，来平滑局部优化空间。我们将这一方法整合到了混合CUTS训练框架中，该框架结合了探索性采样和利用性采样，从而增强群体内部的优势差异。在Qwen3模型上的实验表明，我们的方法能够有效防止策略退化，并显著提升了跨领域泛化能力。值得注意的是，混合CUTS在具有挑战性的AIME25基准测试上，将Pass@1准确率提高了15.1%，这证明了在语义空间中保持多样性对于实现严谨的推理至关重要。

papers.title: Reliable Use of Lemmas via Eligibility Reasoning and Section-Aware Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过资格推理和分段感知强化学习来实现引理的可靠应用
papers.authors: Zhikun Xu, Xiaodong Yu, Ben Zhou, Jiang Liu, Jialian Wu, Ze Wang, Ximeng Sun, Hao Chen, Zicheng Liu
papers.abstract: Recent large language models (LLMs) perform strongly on mathematical benchmarks yet often misapply lemmas, importing conclusions without validating assumptions. We formalize lemma-judging as a structured prediction task: given a statement and a candidate lemma, the model must output a precondition check and a conclusion-utility check, from which a usefulness decision is derived. We present RULES, which encodes this specification via a two-section output and trains with reinforcement learning plus section-aware loss masking to assign penalty to the section responsible for errors. Training and evaluation draw on diverse natural-language and formal proof corpora; robustness is assessed with a held-out perturbation suite; and end-to-end evaluation spans competition-style, perturbation-aligned, and theorem-based problems across various LLMs. Results show consistent in-domain gains over both a vanilla model and a single-label RL baseline, larger improvements on applicability-breaking perturbations, and parity or modest gains on end-to-end tasks; ablations indicate that the two-section outputs and section-aware reinforcement are both necessary for robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的大语言模型在数学基准测试中表现优异，但往往错误地应用了引理，直接得出结论而无需验证假设。我们将引理判断形式化为一项结构化预测任务：给定一条陈述和一个候选引理，模型需要输出一个前提检查和一个结论效用检查，然后根据这些检查结果来做出有用性判断。我们提出了RULES算法，该算法通过两部分输出来编码这一规范，并通过强化学习以及针对特定部分的损失掩蔽技术来惩罚导致错误的部分。训练和评估过程中使用了多种自然语言与形式化证明语料库；通过保留一部分扰动数据来评估模型的鲁棒性；而端到端评估则涵盖了竞赛式、扰动相关以及基于定理的各种问题，这些评估都适用于不同的大语言模型。结果表明，与普通模型和单一标签的强化学习基线相比，RULES算法在领域内取得了稳定的提升效果；在处理与适用性相关的扰动时，其性能有显著提升；而在端到端任务上，RULES算法也取得了相当或适度的进步。实验表明，两部分输出结构和针对特定部分的强化学习机制对于提高模型的鲁棒性都是必不可少的。

papers.title: Attention Under Attack: Analog Noise Effects and Mechanistic Vulnerabilities in Transformer Models
papers.title_zh: 注意被攻击了：模拟噪声的影响以及Transformer模型中的机制性漏洞
papers.authors: Mafizur Rahman, Lijun Qian
papers.abstract: Analog in-memory computing (AIMC) offers substantial efficiency gains for transformer inference but introduces hardware-induced noise that can distort attention behavior. Prior studies primarily focus on AIMC evaluations for vision tasks and CNN-based models. They largely overlook how hardware-induced noise perturbs internal attention dynamics in NLP models. In this work, we present the first fine-grained analysis of analog vulnerability in pretrained transformers, examining projection submodules, attention heads, and layer-wise dynamics across multiple NLP tasks. Results show that query (Q), key (K), and value (V) projections are the most sensitive components, while feed-forward layers remain comparatively robust. Also, analog noise yields depth-dependent degradation in higher layers, leading to scattered attention and disrupted token routing. This pre-deployment analysis mitigates potential resource misuse before physical deployment and offers practical guidance for designing noise-resilient analog NLP transformers.
papers.abstract_zh: 模拟内存计算技术为Transformer模型的推理过程带来了显著的效率提升，但同时也引入了由硬件引起的噪声，这些噪声可能会干扰模型的注意力机制。以往的研究主要集中在针对视觉任务和基于CNN的模型的模拟内存计算评估上，而忽略了硬件噪声对自然语言处理模型中内部注意力机制的干扰。在本研究中，我们首次对预训练的Transformer模型中的模拟噪声进行了详细分析，重点关注了投影子模块、注意力头以及不同层次上的动态变化。研究结果表明，查询向量、键向量和值向量的投影部分是最容易受到噪声影响的环节，而前馈层则相对较为稳定。此外，模拟噪声会在高层结构中导致性能下降，进而使注意力分布变得分散，并破坏令牌的路由机制。这种在部署前的分析有助于避免潜在的资源滥用问题，并为设计具有抗噪声能力的模拟式自然语言处理模型提供实用指导。

papers.title: ReproEvalCard: A Reporting Standard for Reproducible Evaluation of LLM Pipelines
papers.title_zh: ReproEvalCard：一种用于可重复评估大型语言模型处理流程的报告标准
papers.authors: Priyaranjan Pattnayak, Apoorv Bhatia
papers.abstract: Evaluation of modern large language model (LLM) systems increasingly relies on multi-stage pipelines such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool-using agents, and prompt chains. Reproducing reported evaluation results for these systems often requires evaluation-specific artifacts beyond model weights and datasets, including prompts, judge configurations, retrieval snapshots, and intermediate traces, yet their availability has not been systematically examined.We introduce ReproEvalCard, a lightweight reporting standard that specifies the minimal artifacts required to reproduce and validate evaluations of LLM pipelines. To motivate this standard, we audit 55 pipeline-based LLM papers published between 2022 and 2025 and quantify the availability of reproducibility-critical evaluation artifacts. We find that randomness controls are missing in 75% of papers and intermediate execution traces in 61%, substantially limiting evaluation reproducibility. We further demonstrate ReproEvalCard through a worked example and provide a concise checklist for authors and reviewers, aiming to improve reproducibility and comparability in LLM evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代大语言模型系统的评估越来越依赖于多阶段流程，例如检索增强生成、工具使用代理以及提示链等。要重现这些系统的评估结果，通常需要一些特定的评估工具，这些工具包括提示、评判配置、检索快照以及中间执行记录等。然而，这些工具的可用性尚未得到系统的研究。我们提出了ReproEvalCard这一轻量级报告标准，它规定了重现和验证大语言模型系统评估所需的最小工具清单。为了推动这一标准的实施，我们对2022年至2025年间发表的55篇基于多阶段流程的大语言模型论文进行了审计，并量化了这些论文中是否存在对可重复性至关重要的评估工具。结果发现，75%的论文缺少随机性控制机制，61%的论文缺少中间执行记录，这些因素严重限制了评估的可重复性。我们通过一个实际案例进一步说明了ReproEvalCard的作用，并为作者和审稿人提供了一个简洁的检查清单，旨在提高大语言模型评估的可重复性和可比性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Test-Time Reasoners Are Strategic Multiple-Choice Test-Takers
papers.title_zh: 测试时间推理者是一种具有策略性的多项选择测试参与者
papers.authors: Nishant Balepur, Atrey Desai, Rachel Rudinger
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now give reasoning before answering, excelling in tasks like multiple-choice question answering (MCQA). Yet, a concern is that LLMs do not solve MCQs as intended, as work finds LLMs sans reasoning succeed in MCQA without using the question, i.e., choices-only. Such partial-input success is often deemed problematic, but reasoning traces could reveal if these strategies are truly shallow in choices-only settings. To study these strategies, reasoning LLMs solve MCQs in full and choices-only inputs; test-time reasoning often boosts accuracy on full and in choices-only half the time. While possibly due to shallow shortcuts, choices-only success is barely affected by the length of reasoning traces, and after finding traces pass faithfulness tests, we show they use less problematic strategies like inferring missing questions. In all, we challenge claims that partial-input success is always a flaw, so we discuss how reasoning traces could separate problematic data from less problematic reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型现在在回答问题之前会先进行推理，在诸如选择题回答这类任务上表现出色。然而，存在一个问题：LLM并没有像预期那样解决选择题问题。研究表明，即使在没有问题的情况下，仅依赖选项输入的LLM也能成功解决选择题。这种部分输入成功的表现通常被认为存在问题，但推理过程可以揭示这些策略在仅依赖选项的情况下是否真的过于简单。为了研究这些策略，我们测试了LLM在完整输入和仅选项输入的情况下解决选择题的能力；结果显示，在测试过程中，完全推理与仅使用选项推理的准确率相差不大。虽然这可能是由于简单的捷径导致的，但仅使用选项成功的状况几乎不受推理过程长度的影响。在验证推理过程能够通过可靠性测试后，我们发现它们使用了一些较为合理的策略，比如推断缺失的选项。总的来说，我们挑战了“部分输入成功总是有缺陷”的说法，并探讨了如何通过分析推理过程来区分那些存在问题的数据和那些问题较少的数据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MARCH: Multi-Agent Radiology Clinical Hierarchy for CT Report Generation
papers.title_zh: 三月：用于生成CT报告的多智能体放射学系统架构
papers.authors: Yi Lin, Yihao Ding, Yonghui Wu, Yifan Peng
papers.abstract: Automated 3D radiology report generation often suffers from clinical hallucinations and a lack of the iterative verification found in human practice. While recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced the field, they typically operate as monolithic “black-box” systems without the collaborative oversight characteristic of clinical workflows. To address these challenges, we propose MARCH (Multi-Agent Radiology Clinical Hierarchy), a multi-agent framework that emulates the professional hierarchy of radiology departments and assigns specialized roles to distinct agents. MARCH utilizes a Resident Agent for initial drafting with multi-scale CT feature extraction, multiple Fellow Agents for retrieval-augmented revision, and an Attending Agent that orchestrates an iterative, stance-based consensus discourse to resolve diagnostic discrepancies. On the RadGenome-ChestCT dataset, MARCH significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both clinical fidelity and linguistic accuracy. Our work demonstrates that modeling human-like organizational structures enhances the reliability of AI in high-stakes medical domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动生成的三维放射学报告常常存在临床上的错误，且缺乏人类实践中所采用的迭代验证机制。虽然最近的视觉语言模型已经取得了显著进展，但它们通常作为单一的“黑箱”系统运行，无法像临床工作流程那样实现协作式的监督。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MARCH（多智能体放射学临床层级结构）框架。该框架模拟了放射科部门的专业层级结构，为不同的代理分配了专门的角色。MARCH使用一名住院医师代理进行初步的文档编写，利用多尺度CT特征提取技术；多名研究员代理负责基于检索的修订工作；而主任医师代理则负责协调迭代式的、基于立场的共识讨论，以解决诊断上的分歧。在RadGenome-ChestCT数据集上，MARCH在临床准确性和语言准确性方面均显著优于现有的最先进基线方法。我们的研究表明，建模类似人类的组织结构可以提高人工智能在高风险医疗领域的可靠性。

papers.title: Prefix Parsing is Just Parsing
papers.title_zh: 前缀解析其实就是普通的解析过程
papers.authors: Clemente Pasti, Andreas Opedal, Timothy J. O’Donnell, Ryan Cotterell, Tim Vieira
papers.abstract: Prefix parsing asks whether an input prefix can be extended to a complete string generated by a given grammar. In the weighted setting, it also provides prefix probabilities, which are central to context-free language modeling, psycholinguistic analysis, and syntactically constrained generation from large language models. We introduce the prefix grammar transformation, an efficient reduction of prefix parsing to ordinary parsing. Given a grammar, our method constructs another grammar that generates exactly the prefixes of its original strings. Prefix parsing is then solved by applying any ordinary parsing algorithm on the transformed grammar without modification. The reduction is both elegant and practical: the transformed grammar is only a small factor larger than the input, and any optimized implementation can be used directly, eliminating the need for bespoke prefix-parsing algorithms. We also present a strategy—based on algorithmic differentiation—for computing the next-token weight vector, i.e., the prefix weights of all one-token extensions, enabling efficient prediction of the next token. Together, these contributions yield a simple, general, and efficient framework for prefix parsing.
papers.abstract_zh: 前缀解析问题旨在判断某个输入前缀是否可以通过给定的语法规则扩展为完整的字符串。在加权环境下，该问题还涉及到前缀概率的计算，这些概率对于上下文无关语言建模、心理语言学分析以及从大语言模型中生成符合语法约束的文本至关重要。我们提出了一种前缀语法转换方法，该方法能够将前缀解析问题高效地转化为普通解析问题。给定一种语法规则，我们的方法可以构造出另一种语法规则，该规则能够精确生成原始字符串的所有前缀。之后，只需对转换后的语法规则应用任何普通的解析算法即可解决前缀解析问题，而无需进行额外的处理。这种转换方法既优雅又实用：转换后的语法规则仅比原始输入大一个很小的因子，因此可以直接使用任何优化的实现方式，从而避免了需要专门设计的前缀解析算法。我们还提出了一种基于算法差异化的策略来计算下一个词元的权重向量，即所有单词元扩展形式的前缀权重，从而能够高效地预测下一个词元。总的来说，这些研究成果为前缀解析提供了一个简单、通用且高效的框架。

papers.title: Privacy-preserving Prosody Representation Learning
papers.title_zh: 保护隐私的韵律表示学习
papers.authors: Kevin Everson, Mari Ostendorf
papers.abstract: Speech representations that capture prosodic information can be useful for both understanding and generation. However, speaker characteristics are reflected in acoustic-prosodic features (e.g., pitch). To address privacy concerns from the leakage of identity information, we propose a new self-supervised approach to learning prosody representations that incorporates speaker disentanglement strategies. We evaluate our encoder on three tasks to probe representation capabilities, including pitch reconstruction and detection of different prosodic events. Our encoder outperforms raw prosody and HuBERT-base baselines, achieving strong speaker disentanglement without adverse impact on prosody-related downstream tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 能够捕捉韵律信息的语音表示对于理解和生成都是非常有用的。然而，说话者的特征会体现在声学-韵律特征中（例如音高）。为了应对身份信息泄露的隐私问题，我们提出了一种新的自监督方法，用于学习韵律表示，该方法包含了说话者分离策略。我们在三个任务上对我们的编码器进行了评估，以检验其表示能力，包括音高的重建以及不同韵律事件的检测。我们的编码器在性能上优于原始的韵律表示和HuBERT基础模型，能够在不严重影响与韵律相关的下游任务的情况下实现强大的说话者分离效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Enhancing Linguistic Competence of Language Models through Pre-training with Language Learning Tasks
papers.title_zh: 通过预训练结合语言学习任务来提高语言模型的语言能力
papers.authors: Atsuki Yamaguchi, Maggie Mi, Nikolaos Aletras
papers.abstract: Language models (LMs) are pre-trained on raw text datasets to generate text sequences token-by-token. While this approach facilitates the learning of world knowledge and reasoning, it does not explicitly optimize for linguistic competence. To bridge this gap, we propose L2T, a pre-training framework integrating Language Learning Tasks alongside standard next-token prediction. Inspired by human language acquisition, L2T transforms raw text into structured input-output pairs to provide explicit linguistic stimulation. Pre-training LMs on a mixture of raw text and L2T data not only improves overall performance on linguistic competence benchmarks but accelerates their acquisition, while maintaining competitive performance on general reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型（LMs）是在原始文本数据集上进行预训练的，用于逐词生成文本序列。虽然这种方法有助于学习世界知识和进行推理，但它并没有明确优化语言能力。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了L2T框架——一个结合了语言学习任务和标准下一个词预测的预训练框架。受人类语言习得的启发，L2T将原始文本转化为结构化的输入-输出对，从而提供明确的语言刺激。在原始文本和L2T数据的混合环境下对语言模型进行预训练，不仅提升了其在语言能力评估中的表现，还加速了模型的语言能力提升，同时仍然能够在一般推理任务中保持竞争力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rethinking Data Mixing from the Perspective of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从大型语言模型的视角重新思考数据混合策略
papers.authors: Yuanjian Xu, Tianze Sun, Changwei Xu, XinLong Zhao, Jianing Hao, Ran Chen, Yang Liu, Ruijie Xu, Stephen Chen, Guang Zhang
papers.abstract: Data mixing strategy is essential for large language model (LLM) training. Empirical evidence shows that inappropriate strategies can significantly reduce generalization. Although recent methods have improved empirical performance, several fundamental questions remain open: what constitutes a domain, whether human and model perceptions of domains are aligned, and how domain weighting influences generalization. We address these questions by establishing formal connections between gradient dynamics and domain distributions, offering a theoretical framework that clarifies the role of domains in training dynamics. Building on this analysis, we introduce DoGraph, a reweighting framework that formulates data scheduling as a graph-constrained optimization problem. Extensive experiments on GPT-2 models of varying scales demonstrate that DoGraph consistently achieves competitive performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据混合策略对于大语言模型（LLM）的训练至关重要。实证结果表明，不恰当的策略会显著降低模型的泛化能力。尽管最近的方法在性能上有所提升，但仍有几个基本问题尚未得到解答：什么才算是某个领域？人类与模型对领域的认知是否一致？领域权重又如何影响模型的泛化能力呢？我们通过建立梯度动态与领域分布之间的正式联系来解答这些问题，从而提供了一个理论框架，明确了领域在训练过程中的作用。基于这一分析，我们提出了DoGraph这一重新加权框架，它将数据调度问题转化为一个基于图的优化问题。针对不同规模的GPT-2模型进行的广泛实验表明，DoGraph能够始终取得具有竞争力的性能。

papers.title: Translation or Recitation? Calibrating Evaluation Scores for Machine Translation of Extremely Low-Resource Languages
papers.title_zh: 翻译还是复述？如何调整针对极低资源语言机器翻译的评估分数
papers.authors: Danlu Chen, Ka Sing He, Jiahe Tian, Chenghao Xiao, Zhaofeng Wu, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Freda Shi
papers.abstract: The landscape of extremely low-resource machine translation (MT) is characterized by perplexing variability in reported performance, often making results across different language pairs difficult to contextualize. For researchers focused on specific language groups—such as ancient languages—it is nearly impossible to determine if breakthroughs reported in other contexts (e.g., African or American languages) result from superior methodologies or are merely artifacts of benchmark collection. To address this, we introduce the FRED Difficulty Metrics—Fertility Ratio (F), Retrieval Proxy (R) Pre-training Exposure (E) and Corpus Diversity (D) —that serve as dataset-intrinsic metrics to contextualize reported scores. Our findings reveal that a significant portion of result variability is explained by train-test overlap and pre-training exposure rather than model capability. Additionally, we identify that underperforming XLR languages—particularly extinct and non-Latin indigenous languages—suffer from poor tokenization coverage (high token fertility), highlighting structural limitations of transfer learning for languages outside pre-trained models’ representation space. By providing these indices alongside performance scores, we enable more transparent evaluation of cross-lingual transfer and provide a more reliable foundation for the XLR MT community.
papers.abstract_zh: 资源极其匮乏的机器翻译领域，其性能表现存在令人困惑的变异性，这使得不同语言对之间的结果难以进行合理的上下文分析。对于专注于特定语言群体（如古代语言）的研究人员来说，很难判断在其他语言领域（例如非洲或美洲语言）取得的突破是源于更先进的方法论，还是仅仅是由于测试集的局限性所导致的。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了FRED难度指标——生育率（F）、检索代理（R）、预训练曝光度（E）以及语料库多样性（D）——这些指标可以作为数据集固有的度量标准，帮助我们对报告的性能结果进行更合理的上下文分析。我们的研究发现表明，大部分性能变异可以归因于训练与测试数据的重叠情况以及预训练期间的曝光程度，而非模型本身的性能。此外，我们还发现，那些表现不佳的XLR语言——尤其是已经灭绝的非拉丁语系本土语言——普遍存在标记化覆盖不足的问题（即高生育率），这揭示了迁移学习在超出预训练模型表示空间的语言上的结构性限制。通过提供这些指标以及性能评分，我们可以更透明地评估跨语言迁移效果，并为XLR语言的机器翻译研究提供一个更可靠的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CheckMIABench: Firm Foundations For Membership Inference Attacks on Language Models
papers.title_zh: CheckMIABench：语言模型成员推断攻击的坚实基础
papers.authors: Jeffrey George Wang, Jason Wang, Marvin Li, Seth Neel
papers.abstract: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are a canonical way to assess a machine learning model’s privacy properties. Although several attempts have been made to evaluate MIAs on language models, the extant literature has suffered numerous difficulties in constructing clean evaluations to test new techniques. In particular, subtle distribution shifts between member and non-member sets can undermine the statistical validity of MIAs; recent work has underscored this by showing that “blind” methods with no access to the underlying model can perform far better than published methods on the same benchmarks. This paper constructs a benchmark for principled evaluation of MIAs against LLMs, by leveraging the insight that training data before and after a fixed point during training are drawn from the same distribution. Therefore, all open-source models with intermediate checkpoints and public training data can be converted into MIA testbeds. We apply our framework to a half-dozen published attacks on the Pythia and OLMo family of models, from 70M to 7B parameters. To facilitate further privacy research, we open-source a modular library for designing and implementing attacks in this setting: https://github.com/safr-ai-lab/pandora_llm.
papers.abstract_zh: 成员推断攻击是一种用于评估机器学习模型隐私特性的标准方法。尽管已经有许多尝试来评估语言模型上的成员推断攻击，但现有文献在构建有效的评估方法时遇到了许多困难。特别是，成员集与非成员集之间的细微分布变化可能会破坏成员推断攻击的统计有效性。最近的研究表明，那些无法访问底层模型的“盲法”在相同的基准测试上表现得比现有的方法要好得多。本文通过利用这样一个原理来构建针对大语言模型的成员推断攻击的评估基准：即在训练过程中，固定点之前和之后的训练数据来自同一分布。因此，所有具有中间检查点的开源模型以及公开的训练数据都可以被转化为成员推断攻击的测试平台。我们将我们的框架应用于对Pythia和OLMo系列模型进行的六种攻击案例，这些模型的参数数量从7000万到70亿不等。为了促进进一步的隐私研究，我们开源了一个模块化库，用于设计和实施此类攻击：https://github.com/safr-ai-lab/pandora_llm。

papers.title: Luring as a Proxy: Evaluating Corpus Transferability for Cybergrooming Detection
papers.title_zh: 利用诱骗行为作为代理手段：评估用于网络诱捕检测的数据集可转移性
papers.authors: Shiying Fan, Mareike Bassenge, Martin Steinebach
papers.abstract: As the use of digital devices and social media grows among younger users, cybergrooming has emerged as a critical social concern for protecting vulnerable minors online. However, research on automated cybergrooming detection remains limited due to data scarcity. Building on previous studies that conceptualize cybergrooming as a form of luring communication, this paper investigates the potential transferability of corpora from luring or manipulative contexts for cybergrooming detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着年轻用户对数字设备和社交媒体的使用日益增加，网络诱骗行为已成为保护未成年人在网上安全的重要社会问题。然而，由于数据资源的匮乏，关于自动检测网络诱骗行为的研究仍然十分有限。本文基于之前将网络诱骗行为视为一种诱导性沟通形式的研究思路，探讨了从诱导或操控性情境中提取的语料库在检测网络诱骗行为方面的潜在应用价值。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Narrow Unlearning to Emergent Misalignment in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 从狭隘的遗忘过程到大型语言模型中的新兴不一致现象
papers.authors: Erum Mushtaq, Anil Ramakrishna, Satyapriya Krishna, Sattvik Sahai, Prasoon Goyal, Kai-Wei Chang, Tao Zhang, Rahul Gupta
papers.abstract: Recent work has shown that fine-tuning on insecure code data can trigger an emergent misalignment (EMA) phenomenon, where models generate malicious responses even to prompts unrelated to the original insecure code-writing task. Such cross-domain generalization of harmful behavior underscores the need for a deeper understanding of the algorithms, tasks, and datasets that induce emergent misalignment. In this work, we extend this study by demonstrating that emergent misalignment can also arise from narrow refusal unlearning in specific domains. We perform refusal unlearning on Cybersecurity and Safety concept, and evaluate EMA by monitoring refusal scores across seven responsible AI (RAI) domains, Cybersecurity, Safety, Toxicity, Bias, Sensitive Content, Medical/Legal, and Privacy. Our work shows that narrow domain unlearning can yield compliance responses for the targeted concept, however, it may also propagate EMA to unrelated domains. Among the two intervened concepts, Cybersecurity and Safety, we find that the safety concept can have larger EMA impact, i.e, causing lower refusal scores, across other unrelated domains such as bias. We observe this effect consistently across two model families, Mistral-7b-0.3v, and Qwen-7b-2.5. Further, we show that refusal unlearning augmented with cross-entropy loss function on a small set of retain data from the affected domains can largely, if not fully, restore alignment across the impacted domains while having lower refusal rate on the concept we perform unlearning on. To investigate the underlying causes of EMA, we analyze concept entanglements at the representation level via concept vectors. Our analysis reveals that concepts with higher representation similarity in earlier layers are more susceptible to EMA after intervention when the refusal stream is altered through targeted refusal unlearning.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，对不安全的代码数据进行微调可能会引发一种“ emergent misalignment”现象。这种现象会导致模型即使面对与原始不安全代码编写任务无关的提示，也会产生恶意响应。这种跨领域的有害行为现象，凸显了我们需要更深入地了解那些导致 emergent misalignment 的算法、任务和数据集。在这项研究中，我们进一步证明了 emergent misalignment 也可能源于特定领域内的狭义拒绝学习行为。我们对网络安全与安全概念进行了拒绝学习处理，并通过监测七个负责任人工智能领域的拒绝得分来评估 emergent misalignment 现象。这些领域包括网络安全、安全、毒性、偏见、敏感内容、医疗/法律以及隐私。我们的研究结果表明，狭义领域的拒绝学习可以为目标概念产生合规响应，但也可能将 emergent misalignment 传播到无关领域。在这两个被干预的概念中，我们发现安全概念在其他无关领域如偏见中会产生更大的 emergent misalignment 影响，即导致更低的拒绝得分。我们在两个模型家族——Mistral-7b-0.3v 和 Qwen-7b-2.5 中一致观察到这一效应。此外，我们还发现，通过在受影响领域的少量保留数据上叠加交叉熵损失函数，可以在很大程度上恢复受影响领域的对齐状态，同时降低我们所进行拒绝学习的概念的拒绝率。为了探究 emergent misalignment 的根本原因，我们通过概念向量在表示层面分析了概念之间的关联程度。我们的分析表明，在早期层中，如果概念在表示上的相似性较高，那么在通过有针对性的拒绝学习改变拒绝流之后，这些概念更容易受到 emergent misalignment 的影响。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
