papers.title: Reliable Evaluation Protocol for Low-Precision Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 适用于低精度检索的可靠评估协议
papers.authors: Kisu Yang, Yoonna Jang, Hwanseok Jang, Kenneth Choi, Isabelle Augenstein, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Lowering the numerical precision of model parameters and computations is widely adopted to improve the efficiency of retrieval systems. However, when computing relevance scores between the query and documents in low-precision, we observe spurious ties due to the reduced granularity. This introduces high variability in the results based on tie resolution, making the evaluation less reliable. To address this, we propose a more robust retrieval evaluation protocol designed to reduce score variation. It consists of: (1) High-Precision Scoring (HPS), which upcasts the final scoring step to higher precision to resolve tied candidates with minimal computational cost; and (2) Tie-aware Retrieval Metrics (TRM), which report expected scores, range, and bias to quantify order uncertainty of tied candidates. Our experiments test multiple models with three scoring functions on twelve retrieval datasets to demonstrate that HPS dramatically reduces tie-induced instability, and TRM accurately recovers expected metric values. This combination enables a more consistent and reliable evaluation system for lower-precision retrieval.
papers.abstract_zh: 降低模型参数和计算的数值精度被广泛采用，以提高检索系统的效率。然而，在低精度下计算查询与文档之间的相关性评分时，由于粒度降低，会出现虚假的匹配情况。这导致基于匹配结果的评估结果出现很大的变异性，使得评估的可靠性下降。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种更稳健的检索评估方案，旨在减少评分的波动。该方案包括：(1) 高精度评分机制，通过将最终评分步骤提升到更高的精度，以最小的计算成本解决匹配候选者的问题；(2) 考虑匹配情况的检索指标，该指标能够报告预期分数、范围以及偏差，从而量化匹配候选者的顺序不确定性。我们的实验在十二个检索数据集上测试了多种模型和三种评分函数，结果表明，高精度评分机制显著减少了因匹配导致的不稳定性问题，而考虑匹配情况的检索指标则能够准确恢复预期的指标值。这种组合方式使得低精度检索的评估系统更加一致且可靠。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When More Words Say Less: Decoupling Length and Specificity in Image Description Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 当更多的言语反而意味着更少的表达时：图像描述中长度与特异性之间的分离
papers.authors: Rhea Kapur, Robert D. Hawkins, Elisa Kreiss
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to make visual content accessible via text-based descriptions. In current systems, however, description specificity is often conflated with their length. We argue that these two concepts must be disentangled: descriptions can be concise yet dense with information, or lengthy yet vacuous. We define specificity relative to a contrast set, where a description is more specific to the extent that it picks out the target image better than other possible images. We construct a dataset that controls for length while varying information content, and validate that people reliably prefer more specific descriptions regardless of length. We find that controlling for length alone cannot account for differences in specificity; it matters how the length budget is applied. These results support evaluation approaches that directly prioritize specificity over verbosity.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型被越来越多地用于通过文本描述来创建可访问的视觉内容。然而，在当前的系统中，描述的精确性往往与其长度被混为一谈。我们认为这两个概念必须区分开来：描述可以既简洁又包含丰富的信息，也可以冗长但信息空洞。我们定义了一个与对比集相关的精确性指标，即描述越能准确地识别出目标图像，其精确性就越高。我们构建了一个数据集，该数据集在改变信息内容的同时控制了描述的长度，并验证人们无论描述的长度如何，都会更倾向于选择更精确的描述。我们发现，仅控制长度并不能解释精确性的差异；如何分配长度资源才是关键。这些结果支持了那种直接优先考虑精确性而非冗长的评估方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Selective Span-Level Unlearning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 针对大型语言模型的选择性层次式遗忘机制
papers.authors: Chaewon Yoon, Dongjun Kim, Hyun-Je Song
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) trained on massive text corpora may inadvertently memorize sensitive or copyrighted content, motivating the need for more targeted unlearning. Selective LLM unlearning focuses on identifying token-level or span-level unlearning targets within a text, rather than treating entire sequences as unlearning targets. However, many existing selective approaches depend on external supervision to identify unlearning targets, which may misalign unlearning objectives with the model’s internal behavior. In this paper, we propose a selective span-level unlearning method that is grounded entirely in model-intrinsic information. Our method first estimates token-level importance scores by contrasting gradient information induced by forget and retain datasets, identifying tokens that disproportionately contribute to information targeted for unlearning. These token-level importance scores are then used as anchors to identify coherent span-level unlearning targets via a self-consistency–based generation process, allowing the model to determine stable spans based on its own predictions. Experiments on two LLM unlearning benchmarks show that our approach achieves comparable unlearning performance while substantially better preserving retained knowledge.
papers.abstract_zh: 在庞大的文本语料库上训练的大语言模型可能会无意中记住敏感或受版权保护的内容，这就迫切需要更精准的“忘却”操作。选择性LLM忘却技术专注于识别文本中的单个词级或片段级忘却目标，而不是将整个序列视为忘却目标。然而，许多现有的选择性方法依赖于外部监督来识别忘却目标，这可能会导致忘却目标与模型内部行为不一致。在本文中，我们提出了一种完全基于模型内在信息的选择性片段级忘却方法。我们的方法首先通过比较遗忘集和保留集所诱导的梯度信息来估计词级重要性得分，从而识别出对忘却目标贡献较大的词。这些词级重要性得分随后被用作锚点，通过自洽生成过程来识别连贯的片段级忘却目标，使模型能够基于自己的预测来确定稳定的片段。在两项LLM忘却基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法在实现相似忘却效果的同时，能够更有效地保留保留下来的知识。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Calibrated? Not for Everyone: How Sexual Orientation and Religious Markers Distort LLM Accuracy and Confidence in Medical QA
papers.title_zh: 经过校准？但并不适合所有人：性取向和宗教相关因素如何扭曲大语言模型在医学领域问答任务中的准确性和可靠性
papers.authors: Alberto Testoni, Iacer Calixto
papers.abstract: Safe clinical deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) requires not only high accuracy but also robust uncertainty calibration to ensure models defer to clinicians when appropriate. Our paper investigates how social descriptors of a patient (specifically sexual orientation and religious affiliation) distort these uncertainty signals and model accuracy. Evaluating nine general-purpose and biomedical LLMs on 2,364 medical questions and their counterfactual variants, we demonstrate that identity markers cause a “calibration crisis”. Homosexual markers consistently trigger performance drops, and intersectional identities produce idiosyncratic, non-additive harms to calibration. Moreover, a clinician-validated case study in an open-ended generation setting confirms that these failures are not an artifact of the multiple-choice format. Our results demonstrate that the presence of social identity cues does not merely shift predictions; it affects the reliability of confidence signals, posing a significant risk to equitable care and safe deployment in confidence-based clinical workflows.
papers.abstract_zh: 在临床环境中安全部署大语言模型（LLM）不仅需要高准确性，还需要强大的不确定性校准机制，以确保模型能够在适当的时候为临床医生提供支持。我们的研究探讨了患者的社会特征信息（特别是性取向和宗教归属）如何干扰这些不确定性信号以及模型的准确性。通过对2,364个医学问题及其反事实变体进行评估，我们发现了身份标记会导致“校准危机”的现象。同性恋相关标记会持续导致模型性能下降，而跨性别身份则会对校准过程产生特殊的、非加性的负面影响。此外，一项针对开放式生成场景的、经过临床验证的案例研究证实，这些性能下降并非由于选择题格式造成的。我们的研究结果表明，社会身份线索的存在不仅会改变模型的预测结果，还会影响置信度的可靠性，从而给基于置信度的临床工作流程带来重大风险。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DIXITWORLD: Evaluating Multimodal Abductive Reasoning in Vision-Language Models with Multi-Agent Dixit Gameplay
papers.title_zh: DIXITWORLD：在基于多智能体的Dixit游戏中评估视觉-语言模型的多模态演绎推理能力
papers.authors: Yunxiang MO, Tianshi Zheng, Qing Zong, Jiayu Liu, Baixuan Xu, Yauwai Yim, Chunkit Chan, Jiaxin Bai, Yangqiu Song
papers.abstract: Multimodal abductive reasoning — the generation and selection of explanatory hypotheses from partial observations — is a cornerstone of intelligence. Current evaluations of such ability in vision–language models (VLMs) are largely confined to static, single-agent tasks. Inspired by Dixit, we introduce DixitWorld, a comprehensive evaluation suite designed to deconstruct this challenge. DixitWorld features two core components: DixitArena, a dynamic, multi-agent environment that evaluates both hypothesis generation (a “storyteller” crafting cryptic clues) and hypothesis selection (“listeners” choosing the target image from decoys) under imperfect information; and DixitBench, a static QA benchmark that isolates the listener’s task for efficient, controlled evaluation. Results from DixitArena reveal distinct, role-dependent behaviors: smaller open-source models often excel as creative storytellers, producing imaginative yet less discriminative clues, whereas larger proprietary models demonstrate superior overall performance, particularly as listeners. Performance on DixitBench strongly correlates with listener results in DixitArena, validating it as a reliable proxy for hypothesis selection. Our findings reveal a key trade-off between generative creativity and discriminative understanding in multimodal abductive reasoning, a central challenge for developing more balanced and capable vision-language agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态推理——从部分观测数据中生成和选择解释性假设——是智能的核心能力之一。目前对视觉-语言模型这种能力的评估大多局限于静态的、单一智能体的任务中。受Dixit项目的启发，我们推出了DixitWorld，这是一个全面的评估工具，旨在破解这一挑战。DixitWorld包含两个核心组件：DixitArena，一个动态的多智能体环境，可以评估假设生成（即“讲故事者”提出具有误导性的线索）以及假设选择（即“听众”从干扰项中挑选目标图像）在信息不完全条件下的表现；还有DixitBench，一个静态的问答基准测试，专门用于高效、可控地评估听众的任务。DixitArena的结果显示，不同规模的模型表现出不同的行为模式：较小的开源模型通常作为创意故事讲述者表现出色，它们提出的线索虽然富有想象力但缺乏区分度；而较大的专有模型则表现出更出色的整体性能，尤其是在充当听众方面。DixitBench的表现与DixitArena中的听众任务结果高度相关，这验证了它作为假设选择指标的有效性。我们的研究发现揭示了多模态推理中生成性创造力和区分性理解之间的关键权衡，这也是开发更平衡、更强大的视觉-语言智能体所面临的重大挑战。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: UERLens: Understanding Event Relations in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: UERLens：理解大型语言模型中的事件关系
papers.authors: Yong Guan, Zhiyuan Li, Shaoru Guo
papers.abstract: Events exhibit rich semantic relations that are essential for understanding the unfolding of real-world processes. Although large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on event relation extraction, how event relations are internally represented and utilized remains unclear. In this paper, we present UERLens, an interpretability framework for understanding event relations in LLMs. Specifically, we first construct UERBench, a counterfactual dataset for event relation analysis that covers causal, temporal, and sub-event relations. Based on counterfactual pairs, we identify relation-sensitive internal features by comparing model activations. We then examine the functional role of these features through model manipulation, including model intervention and model training. Experimental results show that event relations are encoded through structured and layer-specific internal features. Disabling relation-sensitive features leads to performance drops of over 22%, while enhancing them yields improvements of up to 7%. Furthermore, leveraging these interpretable features to train a lightweight classifier significantly improves event relation extraction, achieving F1 gains of up to 24% for causal relations.
papers.abstract_zh: 事件之间存在着丰富的语义关系，这些关系对于理解现实世界中的过程至关重要。尽管大语言模型在事件关系提取方面取得了显著的性能提升，但事件关系在内部是如何被表示和使用的仍然不清楚。在本文中，我们提出了UERLens这一可解释性框架，用于理解大语言模型中的事件关系。具体来说，我们首先构建了UERBench这一反事实数据集，该数据集涵盖了因果关系、时间关系和子事件关系。基于这些反事实对，我们通过比较模型的激活值来识别与关系相关的内部特征。然后，我们通过模型干预和模型训练等方式，研究这些特征的功能作用。实验结果表明，事件关系是通过结构化和特定于层的内部特征来编码的。禁用与关系相关的特征会导致性能下降超过22%，而增强这些特征则能使性能提升多达7%。此外，利用这些可解释的特征来训练一个轻量级分类器，可以显著改善事件关系的提取效果，对于因果关系，F1分数甚至可以提高24%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GOLEMcoref: A Multilingual Coreference Dataset of Fiction
papers.title_zh: GOLEM核心指代数据集：一个包含多语言指代关系的虚构文本数据库
papers.authors: Andreas van Cranenburgh, Xiaoyan Yang, Alvanita, Cecilia Nicole Di Domenico, Maria Ferragud, Arianna Graciotti, Andreea Gabriela Ion, Byungjun Kim, Seonyeong Park, Noa Visser Solissa, Xiaoyu Zhou, Federico Pianzola
papers.abstract: We present a multilingual coreference dataset of 827k tokens of fiction in 7 languages: Bahasa Indonesia, Chinese, Dutch, English, Italian, Korean, and Spanish. The dataset includes full stories of diverse lengths, ranging from 500 to 17k words. We discuss our annotation scheme focusing on characters and language-specific challenges we encountered. Finally we present evaluation results of a neural coreference system trained on our dataset. We show that jointly training a system across all languages provides a strong improvement over monolingually trained models. The dataset is available under a creative commons license in CoNLL-2012 and CorefUD format at https://github.com/GOLEM-lab/GOLEMcoref/
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提供了一个多语言共指数据集，包含827千个标记，这些文本来自7种语言：印尼语、中文、荷兰语、英语、意大利语、韩语和西班牙语。该数据集包括各种长度的故事，从500字到1.7万字不等。我们讨论了我们的注释方案，重点介绍了在角色识别和语言特定挑战方面所遇到的困难。最后，我们展示了基于该数据集训练的神经共指系统的评估结果。结果表明，同时训练所有语言的系统比单独训练单一语言的模型效果要好得多。该数据集以Creative Commons许可协议提供，可在https://github.com/GOLEM-lab/GOLEMcoref/获取，格式为CoNLL-2012和CorefUD格式。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Language-Aware Token Boosting: LLM Language Confusion Reduction Without Tuning
papers.title_zh: 语言感知令牌增强：无需调优即可减少大型语言模型中的语言混淆问题
papers.authors: Trapoom Ukarapol, Pakhapoom Sarapat, Nut Chukamphaeng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) sometimes exhibit language confusion when generating non-English text. Existing approaches typically rely on fine-tuning to mitigate this issue. In contrast, we propose a tuning-free paradigm for reducing language confusion. Within this paradigm, we introduce two methods: Language-Aware Token Boosting (LATB), which applies targeted perturbations to tokens associated with the desired language, and Adaptive Language-Aware Token Boosting (Adaptive-LATB), which dynamically adjusts these perturbations based on the model’s confidence in the intended language. Experiments demonstrate that our methods effectively improve multilingual alignment by reducing language confusion, while maintain the summarization quality without requiring any additional fine-tuning. Our code is publicly available.[https://github.com/scbdatax/genai-datax-language-aware-token-boosting].
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在生成非英语文本时有时会出现语言混淆的问题。现有的方法通常依赖于微调来缓解这个问题。相比之下，我们提出了一种无需微调的减少语言混淆的方法。在这一方法中，我们引入了两种技术：语言感知令牌增强（LATB），该技术会对与目标语言相关的令牌进行有针对性的调整；以及自适应语言感知令牌增强（Adaptive-LATB），该技术会根据模型对目标语言的判断来动态调整这些调整。实验表明，我们的方法通过减少语言混淆，有效提升了多语言对齐的效果，同时还能保持摘要的质量，而无需进行任何额外的微调操作。我们的代码可以公开获取：[https://github.com/scbdatax/genai-datax-language-aware-token-boosting]
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Pref-CTRL: Preference Driven LLM Alignment using Representation Editing
papers.title_zh: Pref-CTRL：通过表示编辑技术实现偏好驱动的大语言模型对齐
papers.authors: Imranul Ashrafi, Inigo Jauregi Unanue, Massimo Piccardi
papers.abstract: Test-time alignment methods offer a promising alternative to fine-tuning by steering the outputs of large language models (LLMs) at inference time with lightweight interventions on their internal representations. Recently, a prominent and effective approach, RE-Control (Kong et al., 2024), has proposed leveraging an external value function trained over the LLM’s hidden states to guide generation via gradient-based editing. While effective, this method overlooks a key characteristic of alignment tasks, i.e. that they are typically formulated as learning from human preferences between candidate responses. To address this, in this paper we propose a novel preference-based training framework, Pref-CTRL, that uses a multi-objective value function to better reflect the structure of preference data. Our approach has outperformed RE-Control on two benchmark datasets and showed greater generalization on out-of-domain datasets. Our source code is available at https://github.com/UTS-nlPUG/pref-ctrl.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时间对齐方法为微调提供了一种有前景的替代方案，即通过在对语言模型进行推理时对其内部表示施加轻量级干预来优化模型的输出。最近，一种既突出又有效的方法是RE-Control（Kong等人，2024年），该方法提出利用在语言模型的隐藏状态上训练得到的外部价值函数来指导生成过程，通过基于梯度的编辑来实现这一目标。虽然这种方法很有效，但它忽略了一个关键特性，即对齐任务通常是以学习人类对候选答案的偏好来形式化的。为了解决这一问题，我们在本文中提出了一种新的基于偏好的训练框架Pref-CTRL，该框架使用多目标价值函数来更好地反映偏好数据的结构。我们的方法在两个基准数据集上的表现优于RE-Control，并且在非领域数据集上展现了更好的泛化能力。我们的源代码可以在https://github.com/UTS-nlPUG/pref-ctrl获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Dark & Stormy: Modeling Humor in Sentences from the Bulwer-Lytton Fiction Contest
papers.title_zh: 黑暗与风暴：在布尔沃-利顿的小说中营造幽默感
papers.authors: Venkata S Govindarajan, Laura Biester
papers.abstract: Textual humor is enormously diverse and computational studies need to account for this range, including intentionally bad humor. In this paper, we curate and analyze a novel corpus of sentences from the Bulwer-Lytton Fiction Contest to better understand “bad” humor in English. Standard humor detection models perform poorly on our corpus, and an analysis of literary devices finds that these sentences combine features common in existing humor datasets (e.g., puns, irony) with metaphor, metafiction and simile. LLMs prompted to synthesize contest-style sentences imitate the form but exaggerate the effect by over-using certain literary devices, and including far more novel adjective-noun bigrams than human writers.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本幽默的形式极其多样，计算研究需要考虑到这种多样性，其中包括故意营造的糟糕幽默。在本文中，我们整理并分析了来自布尔沃-利顿小说比赛的若干句子样本，以更深入地了解英语中的“糟糕”幽默。传统的幽默检测模型在我们的样本上表现不佳，而通过对文学手法的分析发现，这些句子中融合了现有幽默数据集中的常见元素（如双关语、反讽）以及隐喻、元小说和明喻等手法。被引导来合成比赛风格句子的大语言模型虽然模仿了原有的形式，但过度使用某些文学手法，从而夸大了效果；此外，这些模型所使用的形容词-名词对的数量也远远超过了人类作家所使用的数量。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Personalization Trap: How User Memory Alters Emotional Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 个性化陷阱：用户记忆如何改变大语言模型中的情感推理机制
papers.authors: Xi Fang, Weijie Xu, Yuchong Zhang, Scott Nickleach, Stephanie Eckman, Chandan K. Reddy
papers.abstract: When an AI assistant remembers that Sarah is a single mother working two jobs, does it interpret her stress differently than if she were a wealthy executive? As personalized AI systems increasingly incorporate long-term user memory, understanding how this memory shapes emotional reasoning is critical. We investigate how user memory affects emotional intelligence in large language models (LLMs) by evaluating 15 models on human validated emotional intelligence tests. We find that identical scenarios paired with different user profiles produce systematically divergent emotional interpretations. Across validated user-independent emotional scenarios and diverse user profiles, systematic biases emerged in several high-performing LLMs where advantaged profiles received more accurate emotional interpretations. Moreover, LLMs demonstrate significant disparities across demographic factors in emotion understanding and supportive recommendations tasks, indicating that personalization mechanisms can embed social hierarchies into models’ emotional reasoning. These results highlight a key challenge for memory-enhanced AI: systems designed for personalization may inadvertently reinforce social inequalities.
papers.abstract_zh: 当人工智能助手记住莎拉是一位同时从事两份工作的单身母亲时，它对她压力的解读是否会与她是一名富有的高管时有所不同呢？随着个性化人工智能系统越来越多地融入用户的长期记忆，了解这种记忆如何塑造情感推理方式变得至关重要。我们通过评估15种大语言模型在人类验证的情感智力测试中的表现，来研究用户记忆对情感智力的影响。我们发现，相同的情境搭配不同的用户背景会导致情感解读出现系统性差异。在经过验证的、与用户无关的情感情境以及多样化的用户背景中，一些表现优异的大语言模型中出现了系统性偏见，那些处于优势地位的用户的情感解读更为准确。此外，这些大语言模型在情感理解和提供支持性建议的任务上，因人口统计因素而表现出显著差异，这表明个性化机制可能会将社会等级制度融入到模型的情感推理过程中。这些结果凸显了增强记忆功能的人工智能面临的一个关键挑战：为个性化设计而开发的系统可能会无意中强化社会不平等现象。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Original Character Companionship and Interaction
papers.title_zh: 神经符号式智能代理长期原创角色陪伴与互动强化学习
papers.authors: Zhenhan Huang
papers.abstract: As human-agent interaction (HAI) evolves toward long-term social companionship, users expect Original Character (OC) agents to maintain a consistent persona, manage shared memories, and adapt to ever-changing preferences. However, LLM-based agents optimized by prompting or SFT exhibit a generalization gap: they behave as myopic instruction followers, leading to cascading errors in multi-turn interactions. For the agents to learn trajectory-level value functions that enable farsighted decision-making, we propose the NSARL framework, which formalizes OC companion agents’ interactions as a POMDP and decomposes the agent into three sub-policies (Router, Memory, and Persona), optimized via closed-loop RL from AI feedback (RLAIF) with verifiable rewards in a graph-constrained action space. Our preliminary experiments indicate a trade-off: SFT yields stronger persona generation, while NSARL improves structural logic, through conservative strategies (e.g., over-routing) that increase workflow completeness, advocating for a hybrid deployment strategy.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着人类与智能体的交互方式逐渐演变为长期的社会伴侣关系，用户期望原始角色智能体能够保持一致的个性形象、管理共同记忆，并适应不断变化的偏好。然而，那些通过提示或序列强化学习优化的大语言模型智能体却存在行为上的局限性：它们只是机械地遵循指令，这导致在多轮交互中容易出现连锁错误。为了让智能体能够学习到能够实现前瞻性决策的轨迹级价值函数，我们提出了NSARL框架。该框架将原始角色智能体的交互过程形式化为一个概率马尔可夫决策过程，并将智能体分解为三个子策略——路由器、记忆体和个性形象。这些子策略通过闭环强化学习算法进行优化，同时利用可验证的奖励来指导智能体的行为，整个系统运行在一个受图结构约束的动作空间中。我们的初步实验表明，这两种方法之间存在权衡：序列强化学习能更好地生成具有连贯个性的智能体，而NSARL则通过采用更为保守的策略（如过度路由）来改善系统的结构性逻辑，从而提高工作流程的完整性。因此，我们建议采用混合式部署策略，结合这两种方法的优势。

papers.title: Taming Extreme Tokens: Covariance-Aware GRPO with Gaussian-Kernel Advantage Reweighting
papers.title_zh: 驯服极端代币：具有高斯核函数的方差容忍度调整机制
papers.authors: Cheng Wang, Qin Liu, Wenxuan Zhou, Muhao Chen
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a promising approach for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, it struggles to effectively balance the trade-off between exploration and exploitation during training, often resulting in suboptimal performance. Motivated by the theoretical insight that changes in entropy are governed by the covariance between token probabilities and their corresponding advantages, we propose a hyperparameter-free, covariance-weighted optimization method that dynamically down-weights extreme token-level updates via a Gaussian kernel. This approach automatically reduces the instability caused by the exploration-exploitation trade-off while preserving informative learning signals. Extensive empirical evaluations show that our approach improves downstream performance across reasoning benchmarks compared with GRPO, and effectively stabilizes entropy as training progresses.
papers.abstract_zh: 群体相对策略优化（GRPO）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的一种有前景的方法。然而，它在训练过程中难以有效平衡探索与利用之间的权衡，常常导致性能不佳。基于这样一个理论见解：熵的变化是由令牌概率与其对应优势之间的协方差所控制的，我们提出了一种无需超参数的、基于协方差加权的优化方法。该方法通过高斯核动态降低极端令牌级更新的重要性。这种方法能够自动减少探索与利用权衡带来的不稳定性，同时保留有意义的学习信号。大量的实证评估表明，与GRPO相比，我们的方法在推理基准测试中的下游性能得到了提升，并且能够有效稳定熵值，随着训练的进行，这种稳定性得到了进一步保障。

papers.title: On the Rejection Criterion for Proxy-based Test-time Alignment
papers.title_zh: 关于基于代理的测试时间同步的拒绝准则
papers.authors: Ayoub Hammal, Pierre Zweigenbaum, Caio Corro
papers.abstract: Recent works proposed test-time alignment methods that rely on a small aligned model as a proxy that guides the generation of a larger base (unaligned) model. The implicit reward approach skews the large model distribution, whereas the nudging approach defers the generation of the next token to the small aligned model when the large base one is unconfident about its outcome. In this work, we first show that both approaches can be reduced to sampling from similar graphical models, where they differ only in the definition of a rejection criterion (or distribution). Moreover, we argue that the confidence criterion is ill-motivated due to linguistic phenomena like ambiguous phrasing. We propose a novel rejection criterion based on a conservative confidence bet. Experimentally, our novel approach outperforms previous work on several datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期的研究提出了一些测试时对齐方法，这些方法利用一个小型的已对齐模型作为代理，来指导更大规模的基础模型（未对齐模型）的生成。隐式奖励方法会扭曲大型模型的分布，而调整方法则会在大型基础模型对结果不确定时，将下一个令牌的生成任务推迟到小型已对齐模型上完成。在这项研究中，我们首先证明了这两种方法都可以归结为从类似的图形模型中采样，它们之间的区别仅在于拒绝标准的定义。此外，我们认为由于语言现象如模糊表述的存在，基于置信度的拒绝标准并不合理。我们提出了一种基于保守置信度假设的新拒绝标准。实验结果表明，我们的新方法在多个数据集上的表现优于以往的研究方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Defense Against Knowledge Poisoning Attack on GraphRAG
papers.title_zh: 针对GraphRAG的知识 poisoning攻击防御机制
papers.authors: Havva Alizadeh Noughabi, Fattane Zarrinkalam, Ali Dehghantanha
papers.abstract: GraphRAG augments large language models with structured knowledge graphs, enabling graph-based context selection and a more integrated view of the knowledge space. However, recent work shows that GraphRAG exposes a new attack surface: corpus-level knowledge poisoning can inject spurious entities and relationships during graph construction, corrupting query-specific subgraphs and steering the generator toward incorrect answers. We propose Hop-wise Guard for GraphRAG (HoG-GRAG), a defense layer between retriever and generator that decomposes multi-hop questions into ordered subqueries, monitors hop-wise execution for poisoning-induced inconsistencies, and locally repairs the retrieved subgraph by pruning compromised entities and relationships and adding only minimal missing evidence. Experiments on multi-hop datasets and multiple GraphRAG configurations show that HoG-GRAG recovers a large fraction of the lost performance. The code is available at https://github.com/CyberScienceLab/HoG-GRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: GraphRAG通过将结构化知识图谱融入大语言模型，实现了基于图的上下文选择以及更完整的知识空间视图。然而，最近的研究表明，GraphRAG暴露了一个新的攻击面：在图构建过程中，语料库层面的知识污染可能会引入虚假的实体和关系，从而破坏特定子图的准确性，并引导生成器指向错误的答案。我们提出了一种名为Hop-wise Guard for GraphRAG（HoG-GRAG）的防御机制，该机制位于检索器和生成器之间，它将多跳问题分解为有序的子问题，监控因污染引起的执行不一致性，并通过剪除受损的实体和关系，仅添加最少的缺失证据来局部修复被损坏的子图。在多个多跳数据集和不同GraphRAG配置下的实验表明，HoG-GRAG能够恢复大部分因污染而损失的性能。相关代码可访问https://github.com/CyberScienceLab/HoG-GRAG。

papers.title: PExA: Parallel Exploration Agent for Complex Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: PExA：用于复杂文本与SQL转换的并行探索代理
papers.authors: Tanmay Parekh, Ella Hofmann-Coyle, Shuyi Wang, Sachith Sri Ram Kothur, Srivas Prasad, Yunmo Chen
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents for text-to-SQL often struggle with latency-performance trade-off, where performance improvements come at the cost of latency or vice versa. We reformulate text-to-SQL generation within the lens of software test coverage where the original query is prepared with a suite of test cases with simpler, atomic SQLs that are executed in parallel and together ensure semantic coverage of the original query. After iterating on test case coverage, the final SQL is generated only when enough information is gathered, leveraging the explored test case SQLs to ground the final generation. We validated our framework on a state-of-the-art benchmark for text-to-SQL, Spider 2.0, achieving a new state-of-the-art with 70.2% execution accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的文本转SQL代理在延迟与性能之间常常面临权衡问题，即提高性能可能会牺牲延迟，反之亦然。我们在软件测试覆盖率的框架下重新设计了文本转SQL的生成机制：首先通过一系列简单的、原子性的SQL测试用例来准备原始查询，这些测试用例可以并行执行，从而确保对原始查询的语义覆盖。在迭代了多个测试用例之后，只有当收集到足够的信息时才会生成最终的SQL语句。我们利用了这些测试用例中的SQL语句来指导最终生成的SQL语句。我们在最新的文本转SQL基准测试——Spider 2.0上验证了我们的框架，取得了70.2%的执行准确率，达到了新的最优水平。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Skill-Aware Data Selection and Fine-Tuning for Data-Efficient Reasoning Distillation
papers.title_zh: 基于技能的数据选择及微调，以实现高效的数据推理提取
papers.authors: Lechen Zhang, Yunxiang Zhang, Wei Hu, Lu Wang
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 and their distilled variants achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks. Yet, distilling these models often demands large-scale data for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), motivating the pursuit of data-efficient training methods. To address this, we propose a skill-centric distillation framework that efficiently transfers reasoning ability to weaker models with two components: (1) Skill-based data selection, which prioritizes examples targeting the student model’s weaker skills, and (2) Skill-aware fine-tuning, which encourages explicit skill decomposition during problem solving. With only 1,000 training examples selected from a 100K teacher-generated corpus, our method surpasses random SFT baselines by +1.6% on Qwen3-4B and +1.4% on Qwen3-8B across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Further analysis confirms that these gains concentrate on skills emphasized during training, highlighting the effectiveness of skill-centric training for efficient reasoning distillation.
papers.abstract_zh: 像DeepSeek-R1这样的大型推理模型及其简化版本在复杂的推理任务上表现优异。然而，对这些模型进行简化训练通常需要大规模的数据来进行有监督的微调（SFT），这就促使人们寻求数据效率更高的训练方法。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种以技能为中心的蒸馏框架，该框架能够高效地将推理能力转移到较弱的模型中。这一框架包含两个关键组成部分：(1)基于技能的数据选择，优先选择那些针对模型较弱技能的样本；(2)基于技能的微调，鼓励在解决问题过程中明确分解技能。我们的方法仅从10万个由教师生成的样本中提取1000个训练样本，就能在五个数学推理基准测试中分别比随机SFT基线高出1.6%和1.4%。进一步分析表明，这些优势主要体现在训练中强调的技能上，这充分证明了以技能为中心的训练方式对于实现高效的推理蒸馏是有效的。

papers.title: Experiments or Outcomes? Probing Scientific Feasibility in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 实验或成果？探究大型语言模型的科学可行性
papers.authors: Seyedali Mohammadi, Manas Gaur, Francis Ferraro
papers.abstract: Scientific feasibility assessment asks whether a claim is consistent with established knowledge and whether experimental evidence could support or refute it. We frame feasibility assessment as a diagnostic reasoning task in which, given a hypothesis, a model predicts feasible or infeasible and justifies its decision. We evaluate large language models (LLMs) under controlled knowledge conditions (hypothesis-only, with experiments, with outcomes, or both) and probe robustness by progressively removing portions of the experimental and/or outcome context. Across multiple LLMs and two datasets, providing outcome evidence is generally more reliable than providing experiment descriptions. Outcomes tend to improve accuracy beyond what internal knowledge alone provides, whereas experimental text can be brittle and may degrade performance when the context is incomplete. These findings clarify when experimental evidence benefits LLM-based feasibility assessment and when it introduces fragility.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学可行性评估旨在判断某个主张是否与现有知识一致，以及实验证据是否能够支持或反驳该主张。我们将这一评估任务视为一种诊断性推理过程：在给定假设的情况下，模型会预测该假设是否可行，并为其决策提供理由。我们通过在受控的知识条件下对大语言模型进行评估（仅基于假设、结合实验数据、同时考虑实验结果，或三者都具备），并逐步移除实验数据和/或结果的某些部分，来测试模型的鲁棒性。通过对多个语言模型和两个数据集进行评估发现，提供实验结果通常比提供实验描述更为可靠。实验结果往往能提升模型的准确性，超出单纯依靠内部知识的水平；而实验文本则可能因缺乏完整上下文而表现不佳。这些研究结果明确了实验证据在何种情况下有助于基于语言模型的可行性评估，以及在何种情况下会导致评估结果的不可靠性。

papers.title: CaBSALLM: Efficient Context-Aware Batch Annotation of Conversational Streams with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: CaBSALLM：利用大型语言模型对对话流进行高效、上下文感知的批量标注处理
papers.authors: Mohammadsadegh Abolhasani, Reza Mousavi, Paul Jen-Hwa Hu
papers.abstract: Analyses of parasocial cues in live-stream chats require accurate, efficient, and scalable annotation. However, manual annotation is tedious, and large language models (LLMs) often make mistakes when applying subjective, discourse-dependent labels. This study proposes Context-aware Batching for Stream Annotation with LLMs (CaBSALLM), an efficient pipeline that incorporates lightweight conversational context and a novel dynamic batching method to improve throughput and scalability. Compared with state-of-the-art pipelines, this generalizable approach is significantly more time- and cost-efficient while achieving comparable or better predictive performance and agreement.
papers.abstract_zh: 在直播聊天中分析准社交线索需要准确、高效且可扩展的标注工作。然而，手动标注非常繁琐，而大语言模型在应用主观性、依赖于话语的标签时常常会出现错误。本研究提出了一种名为“基于上下文的直播标注方法——使用大语言模型”（CaBSALLM）的高效流程。该流程结合了轻量级的对话上下文处理技术和新颖的动态批处理技术，从而提升了标注的吞吐量和可扩展性。与现有的最先进流程相比，这种通用化的方法在时间和成本上都具有显著的优势，同时还能实现相当或更好的预测性能和准确性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Challenging the Explanation Based on Preceding Tokens: Discovering Transferable Non-Literal Biasing
papers.title_zh: 挑战基于前序令牌的解释：发现可迁移的非字面性偏见
papers.authors: Yuchen Huang, Junpeng Zhang, Quanshi Zhang
papers.abstract: In this paper, we find that the generated preceding tokens, which are not directly related to the answer, may still significantly push the large language model (LLM) towards the target answer. More crucially, the biased connotations of target answer in the preceding tokens can also transfer to other prompts. This finding suggests that the LLM may intentionally use the semantically unrelated tokens to help the generation of the target answer. Our finding offers a new perspective on understanding the long-range dependency phenomena in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们发现那些与答案没有直接关联的前置标记，仍然能够显著推动大语言模型朝向目标答案发展。更为关键的是，目标答案在前置标记中的偏见性含义，也可能被传递到其他提示中。这一发现表明，大语言模型可能会故意使用语义上不相关的标记来帮助生成目标答案。我们的研究结果为理解大语言模型中长期的依赖现象提供了新的视角。

papers.title: One-step Nonautoregressive Natural Language Generation with Shortcut Flow Matching Models
papers.title_zh: 一步式非自回归自然语言生成技术，结合快捷流程匹配模型
papers.authors: Jędrzej Warczyński, Ondrej Dusek, Mateusz Lango
papers.abstract: While having a significant potential for parallel processing in theory, diffusion-based non-autoregressive text generation remains inefficient due to the need for multiple denoising steps. Performance degrades sharply if a low number of steps is used, such as in flow matching. To enable accurate one-step generation, we propose a novel shortcut flow-matching model that learns to directly predict multi-step denoising outcomes in a single step. Experiments conducted on three datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over classic flow-matching, with BLEU scores more than doubling on two datasets. We also tested five different ways of extending shortcut models with commonly used techniques.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然从理论上讲，基于扩散的非自回归文本生成具有显著的并行处理潜力，但由于需要多个去噪步骤，其效率仍然较低。如果使用较少的步骤，比如在流匹配中，性能会显著下降。为了实现一步精确的生成，我们提出了一种新颖的快捷流匹配模型，该模型能够直接预测多步去噪后的结果，只需一步操作即可完成。在三个数据集上的实验表明，与传统的流匹配方法相比，我们的模型取得了显著的改进，其中两个数据集的BLEU分数增加了两倍以上。我们还测试了五种不同的方法，试图用常用技术来扩展这种快捷模型的功能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SED-SFT: Selectively Encouraging Diversity in Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: SED-SFT：在监督式微调过程中选择性地促进多样性
papers.authors: Yijie Chen, Yijin Liu, Fandong Meng
papers.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as the standard post-training paradigm for large language models (LLMs). However, the conventional SFT process, driven by Cross-Entropy (CE) loss, often induces mode collapse, where models over-concentrate on specific response patterns. This lack of distributional diversity severely restricts the exploration efficiency required for subsequent RL. While recent studies have attempted to improve SFT by replacing CE loss, aiming to preserve diversity or refine the update policy, they fail to adequately balance diversity and accuracy, thereby achieving sub-optimal performance after RL. To address the mode collapse problem, we propose SED-SFT, which adaptively encourages diversity based on the token exploration space. This framework introduces a selective entropy regularization term with a selective masking mechanism into the optimization objective. Extensive experiments across eight mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that SED-SFT significantly enhances generation diversity with a negligible computational overhead increase compared with CE loss, yielding average improvements of 2.06 and 1.20 points in subsequent RL performance over standard CE-based baselines on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 在训练后的大规模语言模型应用中，监督式微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）的结合已成为标准方法。然而，传统的SFT过程依赖于交叉熵损失，这往往会导致模式崩溃现象，即模型过度集中于特定的响应模式。这种分布多样性的缺失严重限制了后续强化学习所需的探索效率。近期的研究试图通过替代交叉熵损失来改进SFT，以保留多样性或优化更新策略，但这些尝试未能充分平衡多样性和准确性，从而导致强化学习后的性能不佳。为了解决模式崩溃问题，我们提出了SED-SFT方法，该方法基于令牌探索空间自适应地促进多样性。该框架在优化目标中引入了一个选择性熵正则化项以及选择性掩蔽机制。在八个数学基准测试中的广泛实验表明，SED-SFT显著提升了生成多样性，且计算开销的增加可以忽略不计。在Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct两个基准测试中，与基于交叉熵损失的基线相比，SED-SFT分别使后续强化学习的性能提升了2.06点和1.20点。

papers.title: Frame-Semantic Knowledge Injection for Event-Level Inference in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 用于大语言模型事件级推理的框架-语义知识注入技术
papers.authors: Shahid Iqbal Rai, Danilo Croce, Roberto Basili
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are fluent but often brittle when interpretation depends on external information (e.g., events or participant roles), as next-token prediction does not explicitly encode situation-level semantic constraints. FrameNet provides a structured account of semantics through its inventory of frames, roles, and relations. We present a scalable framework that injects frame-semantic knowledge into LLMs via LoRA, moving from fact-oriented prompting to principle-oriented supervision over the full FrameNet inventory. The supervision encodes semantic constraints through semantic types, sense-aware definitions, frame relations, and role-annotated examples. To test whether this knowledge generalizes beyond surface cues, we use Natural Language Inference (NLI) as a diagnostic task for event-level reasoning. Experiments on CONFER and SNLI show consistent gains over Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in zero-shot and few-shot settings, especially for entailment and contradiction. Complementary semantic role labeling analyses further indicate improved sensitivity to frame, role, and span structure.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解释时往往缺乏稳定性，因为当解释依赖于外部信息（如事件或参与者角色）时，模型就无法准确处理情境层面的语义约束。FrameNet通过框架、角色和关系的结构化描述来提供语义的清晰表达。我们提出了一个可扩展的框架，该框架通过LoRA技术将框架语义知识注入到大语言模型中，从而将提示方式从以事实为导向转变为以原则为导向，覆盖整个FrameNet体系。这种监督机制通过语义类型、意义感知定义、框架关系以及带有角色注释的示例来编码语义约束。为了验证这些知识是否能够超越表面线索而得到广泛应用，我们使用自然语言推理任务作为事件级推理的诊断工具。在CONFER和SNLI数据集上的实验表明，与Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct相比，该框架在零样本和少量样本情况下都能取得显著的性能提升，尤其是在蕴含关系和矛盾判断方面。此外，补充性的语义角色标注分析进一步表明，该框架对框架结构、角色以及跨度结构的识别能力有所提高。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Exploring Cross-Client Memorization of Training Data in Large Language Models for Federated Learning
papers.title_zh: 探索在大型语言模型中跨客户端共享训练数据的机制，以实现联邦学习
papers.authors: Tinnakit Udsa, Can Udomcharoenchaikit, Patomporn Payoungkhamdee, Sarana Nutanong, Norrathep Rattanavipanon
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training without raw data sharing, but still risks training data memorization. Existing FL memorization detection techniques focus on one sample at a time, underestimating more subtle risks of cross-sample memorization. In contrast, recent work on centralized learning (CL) has introduced fine-grained methods to assess memorization across all samples in training data, but these assume centralized access to data and cannot be applied directly to FL. We bridge this gap by proposing a framework that quantifies both intra- and inter-client memorization in FL using fine-grained cross-sample memorization measurement across all clients. Based on this framework, we conduct two studies: (1) measuring subtle memorization across clients and (2) examining key factors that influence memorization, including decoding strategies, prefix length, and FL algorithms. Our findings reveal that FL models do memorize client data, particularly intra-client data, more than inter-client data, with memorization influenced by training and inferencing factors.
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦学习（FL）能够实现无需共享原始数据的协作训练，但仍然存在训练数据被记忆的风险。现有的FL记忆检测技术通常只关注单个样本，而忽视了跨样本记忆所带来的更微妙的风险。相比之下，最近关于集中式学习（CL）的研究提出了细粒度的方法来评估训练数据中所有样本的记忆情况，但这些方法需要集中式的数据访问方式，因此无法直接应用于FL。我们通过提出一个框架来填补这一空白，该框架能够量化FL中客户端内部和客户端之间的记忆情况，同时采用细粒度的跨样本记忆测量方法来评估所有客户端的记忆状况。基于这个框架，我们进行了两项研究：(1) 测量不同客户端之间的微妙记忆现象；(2) 探讨影响记忆的关键因素，包括解码策略、前缀长度以及FL算法。我们的研究发现表明，FL模型确实会记住客户端数据，尤其是客户端内部的 데이터，而较少记住客户端之间的数据。记忆情况受到训练和推理因素的影响。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FL-MSCL: A Unified Figurative Language Detection Model Driven by Multi-Type Signals and Contrastive Learning
papers.title_zh: FL-MSCL：一种统一的形象语言检测模型，基于多种信号的融合以及对比学习机制运行
papers.authors: Lu Shijia, Fumiyo Fukumoto, Huang Xiaoxi, Yoshimi Suzuki
papers.abstract: Figurative language recognition poses significant challenges in NLP, particularly when distinguishing between fine-grained rhetorical categories such as metaphor, metonymy, and simile. This paper formulates the problem as a four-way sentence-level classification task and proposes FL-MSCL, a unified framework integrating prompt-based knowledge injection with supervised contrastive learning. Experiments across both unified and single-class benchmarks demonstrate that FL-MSCL achieves competitive performance compared to State-of-the-Art (SOTA) methods, indicating consistent advantages in cross-category generalization and category-specific detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 修辞语言识别在自然语言处理中面临着重大挑战，尤其是在区分诸如隐喻、转喻和明喻等细微的修辞类别时。本文将这一问题定义为一个四向的句子级分类任务，并提出了FL-MSCL这一统一框架。该框架结合了基于提示的知识注入技术和有监督的对比学习方法。通过在不同类别的基准测试中的实验表明，FL-MSCL在性能上可与最先进的方法相媲美，显示出在跨类别泛化能力和特定类别检测方面的持续优势。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Revisiting Evaluation of Question Answering Systems in Low-Resource Indic Languages: Bridging Human and Metric Alignment
papers.title_zh: 重新审视在低资源印度语环境中对问答系统的评估方法：实现人类评估与客观评估之间的衔接
papers.authors: Anuj Kumar, Satyadev Ahlawat, Yamuna Prasad, Virendra Singh
papers.abstract: Evaluating Question Answering (QA) systems in low-resource Indic languages remains challenging due to the scarcity of annotated data, high linguistic diversity, and the absence of reliable evaluation metrics. Many Indian languages are severely underrepresented, making it difficult to accurately assess the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on QA tasks. Commonly used metrics like BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore, while successful in machine translation and resource-rich scenarios, tend to perform poorly in low-resource QA settings. These metrics often exhibit issues such as compressed scoring ranges, excessive zero scores, and weak alignment with human judgments. To overcome these limitations, this work introduces the LRM^{2}QAS (Language Robust Multi-aspect Metrics for Question Answering Systems). This composite evaluation framework integrates semantic similarity, factual completeness, numerical accuracy, and contextual relevance. The proposed metric is evaluated across eight Indic-language QA tasks using multiple LLMs, as well as on open-domain benchmarks NaturalQuestions (NQ) and TriviaQA (TQ). Across all settings, LRM^2QAS demonstrates stronger agreement with human evaluation, as measured by Pearson, Spearman, and Kendall correlation coefficients. Experimental findings highlight that LRM^2QAS provides more precise distinctions between model outputs and aligns more closely with human judgment, offering a reliable framework for evaluating multilingual QA in low-resource Indic languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 在资源匮乏的印度语系中评估问答系统仍然具有挑战性，因为标注数据稀缺、语言多样性高，且缺乏可靠的评估指标。许多印度语言被严重忽视，这使得难以准确评估大语言模型在问答任务上的表现。常用的评估指标如BLEU、ROUGE-L和BERTScore虽然在机器翻译和资源丰富的场景中表现良好，但在资源匮乏的问答环境中表现不佳。这些指标常常存在评分范围过窄、零分过多以及与人类判断偏差较大等问题。为了克服这些限制，本研究提出了LRM^2QAS这一综合评估框架。该框架结合了语义相似性、事实完整性、数值准确性和上下文相关性等多个维度。通过多种大语言模型在八项印度语系问答任务中的测试，以及使用开放领域基准测试NaturalQuestions (NQ)和TriviaQA (TQ)，发现LRM^2QAS在所有人机评估中表现出更强的一致性，其Pearson相关系数、Spearman相关系数和Kendall相关系数均表明其具有较高的评估精度。实验结果表明，LRM^2QAS能够更精确地区分模型输出与人类判断之间的差异，为在资源匮乏的印度语系中评估多语言问答提供了一个可靠的框架。

papers.title: Data-efficient Targeted Token-level Preference Optimization for LLM-based Text-to-Speech
papers.title_zh: 针对大语言模型的应用于文本转语音功能的高效数据驱动令牌级优化策略
papers.authors: Rikuto Kotoge, Yuichi Sasaki
papers.abstract: Aligning text-to-speech (TTS) system outputs with human feedback through preference optimization has been shown to effectively improve the robustness and naturalness of LLM-based TTS models. Current approaches primarily require paired desirable and undesirable samples at the utterance level. However, such pairs are often limited in TTS output data, and utterance-level formulation prevents fine-grained token-level optimization needed for accurate pronunciation alignment. In this study, we propose TKTO that eliminates the need for paired data, enabling a more data-efficient training paradigm, and directly targets token-level units, automatically providing fine-grained alignment signals without token-level annotations. TKTO improves the challenging Japanese TTS accuracy by 39% and reduces CER by 54%, leveraging 6× more training data and assigning 12.8× stronger reward to targeted tokens.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过偏好优化来使文本到语音系统的输出与人类反馈保持一致，已被证明能够有效提升基于大语言模型的文本到语音模型的鲁棒性和自然性。目前的方法主要在 utterance 级别需要成对的可喜样本和不可喜样本。然而，这样的成对样本在文本到语音的输出数据中往往有限，而 utterance 级别的设定则无法实现用于精确发音对齐的细粒度 token 级别优化。在这项研究中，我们提出了 TKTO 算法，该算法无需使用成对数据，从而实现了更高效的训练方式。TKTO 直接针对 token 级别的单位进行优化，自动提供细粒度的对齐信号，而无需依赖 token 级别的注释。通过 TKTO 算法，日语文本到语音的准确率提升了 39%，错误率也降低了 54%。同时，TKTO 利用了 6 倍的训练数据，并对目标 token 赋予了 12.8 倍的更强奖励。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: How Do Inpainting Artifacts Propagate to Language?
papers.title_zh: 如何使修复后的艺术元素能够融入语言中呢？
papers.authors: Pratham Yashwante, Davit Abrahamyan, Shresth Grover, Sukruth Rao
papers.abstract: We study how visual artifacts introduced by diffusion-based inpainting affect language generation in vision-language models. We use a two-stage diagnostic setup in which masked image regions are reconstructed and then provided to captioning models, enabling controlled comparisons between captions generated from original and reconstructed inputs. Across multiple datasets, we analyze the relationship between reconstruction fidelity and downstream caption quality. We observe consistent associations between pixel-level and perceptual reconstruction metrics and both lexical and semantic captioning performance. Additional analysis of intermediate visual representations and attention patterns shows that inpainting artifacts lead to systematic, layer-dependent changes in model behavior. Together, these results provide a practical diagnostic framework for examining how visual reconstruction quality influences language generation in multimodal systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了基于扩散修复技术所引入的视觉伪影对视觉-语言模型中语言生成过程的影响。我们采用了一种两阶段诊断方法：首先重建被遮蔽的图像区域，然后将这些图像区域提供给字幕模型，从而能够有针对性地比较从原始输入和重建输入生成的字幕质量。在多个数据集上，我们分析了重建质量与下游字幕质量之间的关系。我们发现，像素级重建指标与感知性重建指标之间存在一致的关联，而且这些指标与词汇级和语义级字幕性能也有良好的相关性。进一步分析中间视觉表示和注意力模式后发现，修复过程中的伪影会导致模型行为的系统性、层依赖性的变化。总的来说，这些研究结果为我们提供了一个实用的诊断框架，用于探究视觉重建质量如何影响多模态系统中的语言生成过程。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA: A Benchmark for Logical Commonsense Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 逻辑常识推理：一种用于评估逻辑常识性推理能力的基准测试
papers.authors: Obed Junias, Maria Leonor Pacheco
papers.abstract: Commonsense reasoning often involves evaluating multiple plausible interpretations rather than selecting a single atomic answer, yet most benchmarks rely on single-label evaluation, obscuring whether statements are jointly plausible, mutually exclusive, or jointly implausible. We introduce LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA, a benchmark that reframes commonsense reasoning as logical composition over pairs of atomic statements using plausibility-level operators (AND, OR and NEITHER/NOR). Evaluating instruction-tuned, reasoning-specialized, and fine-tuned models under zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting, we find that while models perform reasonably on conjunctive and moderately on disjunctive reasoning, performance degrades sharply on negation-based questions. LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA exposes fundamental reasoning limitations and provides a controlled framework for advancing compositional commonsense reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 常识推理通常需要评估多种可能的解释，而不是选择单一的答案。然而，大多数评估标准都依赖于单一标签的评估方式，这导致无法判断某个陈述是共同合理的、相互排斥的，还是共同不合理的。我们提出了LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA这一基准测试，它将常识推理重新定义为对成对原子陈述进行逻辑组合的过程，使用“与”、“或”以及“既不……也不……”等逻辑运算符。通过对经过指令调整、专门进行推理处理且经过微调的模型进行零样本、少样本以及思维链提示下的评估，我们发现这些模型在联合推理方面表现尚可，在分离推理方面则表现一般，但在基于否定问题的推理上表现明显下降。LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA揭示了常识推理的基本局限性，并为推进组合式常识推理提供了有效的框架。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: BioHiCL: Hierarchical Multi-Label Contrastive Learning for Biomedical Retrieval with MeSH Labels
papers.title_zh: BioHiCL：基于层次多标签对比学习的方法，用于带有医学术语标签的生物医学信息检索
papers.authors: Mengfei Lan, Lecheng Zheng, Halil Kilicoglu
papers.abstract: Effective biomedical information retrieval requires modeling domain semantics and hierarchical relationships among biomedical texts. Existing biomedical generative retrievers built on coarse binary relevance signals, limiting their ability to capture semantic overlap. We propose BioHiCL - Biomedical Retrieval with Hierarchical Multi-Label Contrastive Learning, which leverages hierarchical MeSH annotations to provide structured supervision for multi-label contrastive learning. Our models, BioHiCL-Base (0.1B) and BioHiCL-Large (0.3B), achieve promising performance on biomedical retrieval, sentence similarity, and question answering tasks, while remaining computationally efficient for deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的生物医学信息检索需要建模领域语义以及生物医学文本之间的层次关系。现有的基于粗略二元相关性的生成式检索算法，其能力有限，难以捕捉语义上的重叠部分。我们提出了BioHiCL——一种基于层次化多标签对比学习的生物医学检索方法。该方法利用层次化的医学术语集注释，为多标签对比学习提供结构化的监督支持。我们的模型BioHiCL-Base（0.1B参数规模）和BioHiCL-Large（0.3B参数规模），在生物医学检索、句子相似度判断以及问题回答任务上取得了令人满意的性能，同时具备较高的计算效率，适合实际应用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Dialogue is the Plan: From Interface to Joint Action in Agentic AI
papers.title_zh: 对话是解决方案：从界面设计到智能体的联合行动
papers.authors: Mert Inan, Malihe Alikhani, Anthony Sicilia
papers.abstract: Large Language Model agents can seeminglyplan and act, yet their language use is oftentreated primarily as an interface for instructingactions and reporting results. We argue that thisframing is one important cause of recurrent coordination failures in human-facing and multiagent settings, including ungrounded assumptions, silent goal misalignment, brittle protocoladherence, and failures to maintain or updateshared dialogue state over time, a limitation previously linked to the absence of explicit common ground tracking in collaborative systems(Geib et al., 2022). Drawing from classical dialogue system research on joint action, commonground, grounding, repair, and incremental processing, we re-frame dialogue as part of theplanning loop itself (rather than its output). Wedistill this re-framing into concrete implicationsfor agentic architecture and evaluation, including explicit representations of shared commitments, clarification as a first class action available to the policy, and process metrics that approximate grounding behavior, repair, and commitment formation rather than task completionalone. We lastly discuss how dialogue-centeredrequirements can inform standards and governance for safe deployment of agentic systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理似乎能够进行规划和行动，然而它们的语言使用往往被主要视为指导行动和报告结果的接口。我们认为，这种处理方式是人类协作和多智能体环境中反复出现协调失败的一个重要原因，包括无根据的假设、目标不一致、协议遵守的脆弱性，以及无法持续维护或更新共享对话状态等问题。这些缺陷之前被认为是由于协作系统中缺乏明确的共同基础跟踪所导致的（Geib等人，2022年）。借鉴经典对话系统研究中关于联合行动、共同基础、修复和增量处理的内容，我们将对话重新定义为规划循环的一部分，而不是其输出结果。我们将这种重新定义转化为对代理架构和评估的具体影响，包括明确表达共享承诺、将对话作为政策者可执行的优先行动，以及能够衡量基础行为、修复过程和承诺形成能力的流程指标，而非仅关注任务完成度。最后，我们讨论了以对话为中心的要求如何为代理系统的安全部署提供标准和治理依据。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Late Code Chunking: A Code Chunking Strategy for Repository-Level Code Completion
papers.title_zh: 晚期代码块处理：一种用于代码库级别代码补全的策略
papers.authors: Seungmin Oh, Eunseok Lee
papers.abstract: This paper introduces Late Code Chunking (LC^2), a chunking strategy designed to improve the semantic understanding of code segments for Large Language Models (LLMs). Repository-level code completion requires predicting the completion of unfinished code by leveraging cross-file context spread across a repository. However, when retrieved fragments have missing semantics—the loss of structural or behavioral information during chunking—LLMs struggle to interpret the target code. To address this, LC^2 refines retrieved chunks by constructing a dual context: a “Code Retrieval Context” optimized for similarity-based search, and a “Code Comprehension Context” that serves as a late enrichment step through context expansion and augmentation. This dual-context design reduces information loss due to chunking and enhances the ability of LLMs to utilize retrieved code. Additionally, we introduce an Asymmetric Query-Chunk Sizing strategy to further optimize retrieval quality by minimizing query noise. Our experiments demonstrate that LC^2 provides robust performance gains, achieving a statistically significant 19.7% improvement in Exact Match accuracy on the CrossCodeEval benchmark compared to the best existing chunking method.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Late Code Chunking（LC^2）这一编码分段策略，该策略旨在提升大语言模型对代码段的语义理解能力。在仓库级别的代码补全过程中，需要利用整个仓库中的跨文件上下文信息来预测未完成代码的补全内容。然而，当检索到的代码片段缺乏语义信息时——即在分段过程中丢失了结构或行为相关的信息——大语言模型就难以准确解析目标代码。为解决这一问题，LC^2通过构建双重上下文来优化检索到的代码片段：一个是针对基于相似性搜索优化的“代码检索上下文”，另一个是作为后期扩展和增强步骤的“代码理解上下文”。这种双重上下文设计能够有效减少因分段而产生的信息损失，从而提升大语言模型对检索到的代码的使用效率。此外，我们还提出了一种不对称查询-代码片段大小的策略，以进一步优化检索质量，减少查询噪声的影响。我们的实验表明，LC^2在性能上取得了显著的提升，在CrossCodeEval基准测试上，精确匹配准确率提高了19.7%，这一提升幅度比现有最佳编码分段方法更为显著。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Temporal Leakage in Search-Engine Date-Filtered Web Retrieval: A Retrospective Forecasting Case Study
papers.title_zh: 搜索引擎在日期筛选网页检索中的时间泄露问题：一项回顾性预测案例研究
papers.authors: Ali El Lahib, Ying-Jieh Xia, Zehan Li, Yuxuan Wang, Xinyu Pi
papers.abstract: Search-engine date filters are widely used to enforce pre-cutoff retrieval in retrospective evaluations of search-augmented forecasters. We show this approach is unreliable across two major search engines: auditing Google Search’s before: filter and DuckDuckGo’s date-range filter, we find that at least one retrieved page contains major post-cutoff leakage for 71% of questions on Google and 81% on DuckDuckGo, and the answer is directly revealed for 41% and 55%, respectively. Using gpt-oss-120b to forecast with these leaky documents, we demonstrate inflated prediction accuracy (Brier score 0.10 vs. 0.24 with leak-free documents). We characterize recurring leakage mechanisms, including updated articles, related-content modules, unreliable metadata, and absence-based signals, and argue that date-restricted search on these engines is insufficient for credible retrospective evaluation. We recommend stronger retrieval safeguards or evaluation on frozen, time-stamped web snapshots.
papers.abstract_zh: 搜索引擎的日期过滤功能被广泛用于在回顾性评估中限制检索范围，以控制由搜索算法辅助生成的预测结果。我们发现，这种方法在两种主要搜索引擎上并不可靠：通过审计谷歌搜索的“之前”过滤功能以及DuckDuckGo的日期范围过滤功能，我们发现至少有1个检索到的页面存在严重的泄漏问题，其中在谷歌上有71%的问题出现泄漏，而在DuckDuckGo上有81%的问题出现泄漏；在41%和55%的情况下，答案被直接显示出来。使用gpt-oss-120b模型对这些有泄漏问题的文档进行预测后，我们发现预测准确率有所提升（在有泄漏问题的文档中，布里尔分数分别为0.10和0.24，而在没有泄漏问题的文档中，布里尔分数分别为0.24）。我们分析了常见的泄漏机制，包括更新的文章、相关内容模块、不可靠的元数据以及基于时间缺失的信号。我们认为，仅在这些引擎上使用日期限制的搜索方式，无法实现可靠的回顾性评估。因此，我们建议采用更强的检索保护机制，或者在对网页进行时间戳处理后进行评估。

papers.title: A Shared Geometry of Difficulty in Multilingual Language Models
papers.title_zh: 多语言模型中的难度共通性
papers.authors: Stefano Civelli, Pietro Bernardelle, Nicolò Brunello, Gianluca Demartini
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) encode problem difficulty as an internal signal that can be linearly decoded from their residuals. Given their multilingual capabilities, we investigate whether this meta-cognitive signal is language-agnostic and how it is organized across the model’s layers by training linear probes on the AMC subset of the Easy2Hard benchmark, translated into 21 languages. We found that difficulty-related signals emerge at two distinct stages of the model internals, corresponding to shallow (early-layers) and deep (later-layers) internal representations, that exhibit functionally different behaviors. Probes trained on deep representations achieve high accuracy when evaluated on the same language but exhibit weaker cross-lingual transfer. In contrast, probes trained on shallow representations generalize better across languages, despite achieving lower within-language performance. This closely aligns with existing findings in LLM interpretability, showing that models tend to operate in an abstract conceptual space before producing language-specific outputs. Our results suggest that this two-stage organizational principle extends beyond simple semantic processing to meta-cognitive properties such as problem difficulty, highlighting an internal control signal that is not tied to surface meaning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型将问题的难度编码为一种内部信号，该信号可以从模型的残差中线性解码出来。鉴于这些模型的多语言能力，我们研究了这种元认知信号是否不受语言影响，以及它在模型各层中的组织方式。我们通过在“Easy2Hard”基准测试的数据集上训练线性探针来实现这一目标，这些数据集被翻译成了21种语言。我们发现，与难度相关的信号在模型内部的两个不同阶段出现，分别对应于浅层（早期层）和深层（后期层）的内部表示，它们表现出不同的行为特征。在深层表示上训练的探针，在同一语言上的评估中表现非常准确，但在跨语言迁移方面则表现较弱。相反，在浅层表示上训练的探针能够在不同语言间更好地进行泛化，尽管它们在同一语言内的表现较低。这与现有的关于语言模型可解释性的研究结果一致，表明模型在产生特定语言的输出之前，往往先在一个抽象的概念空间中运作。我们的结果表明，这种两阶段的组织原则不仅仅涉及简单的语义处理，还涉及到诸如问题难度这样的元认知属性，这表明存在一种与表面意义无关的内部控制信号。

papers.title: T^\star: Progressive Block Scaling for Masked Diffusion Language Models Through Trajectory Aware Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: T^\star：基于轨迹感知强化学习的掩码扩散语言模型渐进式块缩放技术
papers.authors: Hanchen Xia, Baoyou Chen, Yutang Ge, Guojiang Zhao, Siyu Zhu
papers.abstract: We present T^\star, a simple TraceRL-based curriculum for progressive block-size scaling in masked diffusion language models (MDMs).Starting from an AR-initialized small-block MDM, T^\star gradually increases the block size while re-optimizing the denoising policy at each stage, enabling higher-parallelism decoding with limited degradation on math reasoning benchmarks. Across two SDAR scales and three benchmarks, T^\star consistently outperforms direct large-block TraceRL and is substantially more stable during training. Our schedule analysis suggests that the learned policy does not simply revert to a strictly left-to-right order; instead, it retains block-size-specific non-monotone updates while improving accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了T^\star，这是一个基于TraceRL的简单课程，用于掩蔽扩散语言模型中的渐进式块大小扩展。该模型从一个以AR初始化的小块MDM开始，逐步增加块大小，同时在每个阶段重新优化去噪策略，从而实现更高级别的解码并行性，同时在数学推理基准测试上的性能下降幅度较小。在两种SDAR规模和三个基准测试中，T^\star始终优于直接使用大块块的TraceRL，并且在训练过程中表现出更高的稳定性。我们的调度分析表明，学习到的策略并不会简单地恢复到严格的从左到右的顺序；相反，它保留了与块大小相关的非单调更新方式，同时提高了准确性。

papers.title: Learning from Emptiness: De-biasing Listwise Rerankers with Content-Agnostic Probability Calibration
papers.title_zh: 从“空无”中学习：基于内容不可知概率校准的列表式重排序算法
papers.authors: Hang Lv, Hongchao Gu, Ruiqing Yang, Liangyue Li, Zulong Chen, Defu Lian, Hao Wang, Enhong Chen
papers.abstract: Generative listwise reranking leverages global context for superior retrieval but is plagued by intrinsic position bias, where models exhibit structural sensitivity to input order independent of relevance. Existing mitigations present a dilemma: inference-time aggregation incurs prohibitive latency, while training-based methods often fail to eradicate ingrained priors, particularly in compact models. To resolve this dilemma, we propose CapCal (Content-Agnostic Probability Calibration), a training-free framework that mechanically decouples positional bias from ranking decisions. By estimating the bias distribution via content-free placeholders, CapCal rectifies output logits through an entropy-adaptive contrastive mechanism. Evaluations across 10 benchmarks confirm that CapCal achieves superior performance among training-free methods while preserving single-pass efficiency. Notably, it unlocks the latent potential of lightweight models (e.g., 0.6B), delivering absolute NDCG gains exceeding 10 points and outperforming computationally expensive data augmentation strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式列表重新排序算法利用全局上下文来实现更高效的检索，但存在固有的位置偏差问题——模型对输入顺序表现出结构性敏感性，而这与相关性无关。现有的解决方案存在困境：在推理阶段进行聚合会带来过高的延迟，而基于训练的方法往往无法消除根深蒂固的先验信息，尤其是在小型模型中。为了解决这一难题，我们提出了CapCal（内容不可知概率校准）框架。该框架无需训练即可自动分离位置偏差与排名决策之间的关系。通过利用与内容无关的占位符来估计偏差分布，CapCal通过熵自适应对比机制来调整输出逻辑值。在10个基准测试中的评估结果表明，CapCal在保持单遍效率的同时，表现优于其他无训练方法。值得注意的是，它还能充分发挥轻量级模型（例如0.6B规模模型）的潜力，实现超过10点的绝对NDCG提升，其效果优于那些计算成本较高的数据增强策略。

papers.title: Decoupling Generalization and Adaptation in Meta-Learning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型的元学习中分离泛化与适应功能
papers.authors: Nitin Vetcha, Binqian Xu, Dianbo Liu
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) for downstream tasks remains expensive, even with parameter-efficient methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). In this regard, meta-learning approaches such as Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for LLMs (MAML-en-LLM) and Amortized Bayesian Meta-Learning for LoRA (ABMLL) have emerged as promising solutions for rapid downstream LLM adaptation. However, these methods fundamentally couple two distinct objectives: learning generalizable initializations and enabling efficient task adaptation. We argue that this coupling limits both the quality of learned representations and adaptation efficiency. In this paper, we introduce DeGAML-LLM (Decoupled Generalization and Adaptation in Meta-Learning for LLMs), a novel framework that explicitly separates these two objectives through dedicated parameter spaces. Specifically, we maintain a generalization module that learns task-agnostic representations across the task distribution, and an adaptation module that specializes in rapid task-specific adjustment. Extensive experiments on common-sense reasoning, mathematics, logic, social, medical and coding benchmarks across model scales demonstrate that DeGAML-LLM outperforms existing meta-learning and standard multi-task baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 即使使用低秩适应等参数高效的方法，对大语言模型进行微调以适应下游任务仍然非常昂贵。在这方面，诸如模型不可知元学习算法以及摊销式贝叶斯元学习算法等元学习方法，已成为实现快速下游模型适应的有效解决方案。然而，这些方法本质上将两个不同的目标结合在一起：一是学习可泛化的初始参数配置，二是实现高效的任务适应。我们认为，这种结合会限制学习到的表示的质量以及适应效率。在本文中，我们提出了DeGAML-LLM这一新颖框架，该框架通过独立的参数空间来明确分离这两个目标。具体来说，我们保留了一个用于学习跨任务分布的、与任务无关的表示的一般化模块，以及一个专门用于快速调整特定任务的适应模块。在常识推理、数学、逻辑、社交、医学和编程等多个领域的广泛实验中，我们发现DeGAML-LLM在性能上优于现有的元学习和标准多任务基准模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: What Makes AI Research Replicable? Executable Knowledge Graphs as Scientific Knowledge Representations
papers.title_zh: 什么使得人工智能研究具有可复制性？作为科学知识表示的可执行知识图谱
papers.authors: Yujie Luo, Zhuoyun Yu, Xuehai Wang, Yuqi Zhu, Ningyu Zhang, Lanning Wei, Lun Du, Da Zheng, Huajun Chen
papers.abstract: Replicating AI research is a crucial yet challenging task for large language model (LLM) agents. Existing approaches often struggle to generate executable code, primarily due to insufficient background knowledge and the limitations of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods, which fail to capture latent technical details hidden in referenced papers. Furthermore, previous approaches tend to overlook valuable implementation-level code signals and lack structured knowledge representations that support multi-granular retrieval and reuse. To overcome these challenges, we propose Executable Knowledge Graphs (xKG), a pluggable, paper-centric knowledge base that automatically integrates code snippets and technical insights extracted from scientific literature. When integrated into three agent frameworks with two different LLMs, xKG shows substantial performance gains (10.9% with o3-mini) on PaperBench, demonstrating its effectiveness as a general and extensible solution for automated AI research replication.
papers.abstract_zh: 复制人工智能研究成果对于大语言模型代理来说是一项至关重要但充满挑战的任务。现有的方法往往难以生成可执行的代码，主要是因为背景知识不足，以及检索增强生成方法的局限性——这些方法无法捕捉到参考文献中隐藏的技术细节。此外，以往的方法往往忽略了有价值的实现级代码信息，也缺乏支持多层次检索和再利用的结构化知识表示。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了可执行知识图谱（xKG）这一可插拔的、以论文为中心的知识库。它能够自动整合从科学文献中提取的代码片段和技术见解。当将其集成到三个使用两种不同大语言模型的代理框架中时，xKG在PaperBench测试上的性能有了显著提升（在o3-mini上提升了10.9%），这表明它作为一种通用且可扩展的解决方案，在自动化人工智能研究复制方面具有显著效果。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Degrades Visual Spatial Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs
papers.title_zh: 思维链降低了多模态大语言模型在视觉空间推理能力方面的表现
papers.authors: Sai Srinivas Kancheti, Aditya Sanjiv Kanade, Vineeth N. Balasubramanian, Tanuja Ganu
papers.abstract: Multimodal Reasoning Models (MRMs) leveraging Chain-of-Though (CoT) based thinking have revolutionized mathematical and logical problem-solving. However, we show that this paradigm struggles with generalized spatial intelligence. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of sixteen models across thirteen spatial benchmarks and identify a critical gap: CoT prompting consistently degrades performance in visual spatial reasoning. Furthermore, through a novel No-Image++ ablation, we demonstrate that MRMs and CoT prompted MLMs suffer from severe shortcut learning, and hallucinate visual details from textual priors even when the image is absent. These findings challenge the efficacy of text-only CoT for spatial tasks and underscore the need for vision-centric reasoning paradigms.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用链式思维（CoT）的多模态推理模型已经彻底改变了数学和逻辑问题的解决方法。然而，我们发现这种范式在通用空间智能方面存在不足。我们对16种模型进行了全面的评估，涵盖了13个空间基准测试，并发现了一个关键问题：链式思维提示会持续降低视觉空间推理的性能。此外，通过一项新颖的无图像++消融实验，我们发现多模态推理模型和基于链式思维的机器学习模型存在严重的捷径学习现象，即使在没有图像的情况下，它们也会从文本信息中推断出视觉细节。这些发现挑战了仅依赖文本进行链式思维在空间任务中的有效性，并强调了需要以视觉为中心的推理范式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reviving Iterative Refinement in Diffusion-based NER with an Initializer-Restorer Approach
papers.title_zh: 采用初始化器-恢复器方法，重新启用基于扩散算法的词性标注技术中的迭代细化算法
papers.authors: Long Hai Trieu, Phí Minh Hieu, Makoto Miwa
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have introduced a generative paradigm for Named Entity Recognition (NER), formulating the task as refining entityspans from noise. While promising, our analysis on the ACE2004 dataset reveals a limitation when training with Exponential MovingAverage (EMA): the model performance often peaks at a single inference step (γ = 1) and plateaus or degrades with additional steps. Thissuggests that under standard stable training configurations, the model may function primarily as a one-step generator rather thanleveraging the iterative refinement capability characteristic of diffusion models. To address this, we propose an Initializer-Restorerapproach. Instead of initializing the reverse process from random Gaussian noise, we utilize a preliminary set of candidate spansgenerated by a standard NER model (e.g., BERT or GLiNER). This allows the diffusion model to start from an informed, diverse prior,enabling effective iterative restoration. We investigate different training strategies for the restorer and find that a hybrid strategy mixingground truth and noisy predictions is essential. Experiments on ACE2004, GENIA, and CleanCoNLL show that our approach improvesperformance over the baseline, particularly when multiple restoration steps are employed. For instance, on CleanCoNLL, our methodachieves an F1 score of 94.70%, compared to 93.79% for the baseline. Our code is available at https://github.com/longtrieu-ai/Initializer-Restorer-NER.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散模型为命名实体识别任务引入了一种生成式范式，将任务定义为从噪声中提炼出实体范围。尽管这种方法很有前景，但我们对ACE2004数据集的分析发现，使用指数移动平均法进行训练时存在局限性：模型的性能往往在单个推理步骤（γ=1）时达到峰值，而随着步骤的增加，性能又会趋于平稳或下降。这表明，在标准稳定的训练配置下，该模型可能主要起到一步生成器的作用，而无法充分发挥扩散模型所具有的迭代细化能力。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种初始化器-恢复器方案。我们不是从随机高斯噪声开始反向过程，而是利用标准NER模型（如BERT或GLiNER）生成的候选实体范围作为初始条件。这样，扩散模型可以从一个信息丰富、多样化的先验开始，从而实现有效的迭代恢复。我们研究了不同的恢复器训练策略，发现结合真实值和噪声预测的混合策略非常重要。在ACE2004、GENIA和CleanCoNLL上的实验表明，我们的方法在多个恢复步骤的情况下，性能优于基线方法。例如，在CleanCoNLL上，我们的方法获得了 94.70% 的 F1 分数，而基线方法的 F1 分数为 93.79%。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/longtrieu-ai/Initializer-Restorer-NER下载。

papers.title: Protein-STORY: Semantic Text-Oriented Representation Yields biologically meaningful Protein embeddings
papers.title_zh: 蛋白质故事：基于语义的文本导向表示方法，能够生成具有生物学意义的蛋白质嵌入数据
papers.authors: Nabil Ibtehaz, Daisuke Kihara
papers.abstract: Unsupervised representation learning using masked language modeling on the language of life has transformed protein research, enabling the analysis of a protein universe that is expanding at an exponential pace. However, most current models rely solely on sequence data, overlooking decades of expert-curated biological knowledge stored in natural language. While recent multimodal and knowledge-graph-based approaches attempt to bridge this gap, they often rely on shallow functional labels that lack the contextual depth of full textual narratives. We present Protein-STORY, a general pipeline that synthesizes protein embeddings from diverse, multi-source text descriptions. At the core of our approach is a novel network architecture designed for the semantic compression of multi document embeddings, which integrates high-fidelity functional and structural insights into a unified representation. Our experiments demonstrate that Protein-STORY produces biologically meaningful embeddings (r \approx 0.75) that outperform existing models on diverse downstream tasks (+2 pts F1 in function prediction). Furthermore, by projecting the story of a protein into a natural language semantic space, our model enables effective zero-shot text-prompted protein search.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用基于掩码语言建模的无监督表示学习技术，在生命语言的背景下对蛋白质进行研究已经取得了显著成果。这种技术使得我们能够分析以指数速度不断扩展的蛋白质世界。然而，目前大多数模型仅依赖于序列数据，而忽略了存储在自然语言中的数十年的专业生物知识。虽然最近的一些多模态和基于知识图谱的方法试图弥补这一缺陷，但它们往往依赖于缺乏上下文深度的浅层功能标签。我们提出了Protein-STORY这一通用流程，它能够从多样化的多源文本描述中合成蛋白质嵌入。我们的方法核心是一种新颖的网络架构，旨在对多文档嵌入进行语义压缩，将高精度的功能和结构信息整合到统一的表示中。实验表明，Protein-STORY生成的蛋白质嵌入具有生物学意义（r约为0.75），并且在多种下游任务上的表现优于现有模型（功能预测方面的F1分数提高了2分）。此外，通过将蛋白质的“故事”转化为自然语言语义空间，我们的模型能够实现有效的零样本文本提示式蛋白质搜索。

papers.title: Diving into the Decoding Space of Non-Autoregressive Models via Lexically Constrained Search
papers.title_zh: 通过词汇约束搜索，深入非自回归模型的解析领域
papers.authors: Chenyang Huang, Osmar Zaiane
papers.abstract: Non-autoregressive (NAR) models have been mainly developed to improve decoding efficiency. Lately, they have also shown great potential in controlled text generation tasks. In this work, we investigate the decoding space of NAR models through lexically constrained machine translation tasks, and develop a search-based decoding algorithm named LexMAP, which is comparable to the autoregressive Grid Beam Search (GBS) method. Our analysis reveals several interesting properties of NAR decoding: 1) the NAR-based method does not suffer from the MAP degradation issue as the autoregressive method does; 2) AR beam search exhibits strong positional bias, in which the candidates only diverge at the end of the sequence; 3) NAR search explores a larger portion of the probability space, suggesting that the search algorithm better exploits the model’s potential.
papers.abstract_zh: 非自回归（NAR）模型主要是为了提升解码效率而开发的。最近，它们在控制文本生成任务中也展现出了巨大的潜力。在这项研究中，我们通过词汇受限的机器翻译任务来探究NAR模型的解码空间，并开发了一种基于搜索的解码算法，名为LexMAP。该算法与自回归的Grid Beam Search（GBS）方法相当。我们的分析揭示了NAR解码的几个有趣特性：1）基于NAR的方法不会像自回归方法那样出现MAP退化问题；2）自回归束搜索存在强烈的位置偏差，即候选解只在序列末端才发生分歧；3）NAR搜索能够探索更大的概率空间，这表明搜索算法更好地发挥了模型的潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Interpreto: An Explainability Library for Transformers
papers.title_zh: 解释器：一种适用于Transformers模型的解释性工具库
papers.authors: Antonin Poché, Thomas Mullor, Gabriele Sarti, Frédéric Boisnard, Corentin Friedrich, Charlotte Claye, Francois Hoofd, Raphael Bernas, Nicholas Asher, Celine Hudelot, Fanny Jourdan
papers.abstract: Interpreto is an open-source Python library for interpreting HuggingFace language models, from early BERT variants to LLMs. It provides two complementary families of methods: attribution methods and concept-based explanations. The library bridges recent research and practical tooling by exposing explanation workflows through a unified API for both classification and text generation. A key differentiator is its end-to-end concept-based pipeline (from activation extraction to concept learning, interpretation, and scoring), which goes beyond feature-level attributions and is uncommon in existing libraries.
papers.abstract_zh: Interpreto是一个开源的Python库，用于解释HuggingFace的语言模型，涵盖从早期的BERT变体到大语言模型的各种模型。该库提供了两种互补的方法：归因方法和基于概念的解释方法。通过统一的API，该库将最新的研究成果与实际工具相结合，为分类和文本生成提供了解释流程的支持。其独特之处在于采用了端到端的基于概念的处理流程（从激活提取到概念学习、解释和评分），这超越了特征级别的归因方式，在现有的库中并不常见。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Copyright Detective: A Forensic System to Evidence LLMs Flickering Copyright Leakage Risks
papers.title_zh: 版权检测工具：一种用于识别大语言模型产生的版权泄露风险的系统
papers.authors: Guangwei Zhang, Jianing Zhu, Cheng Qian, Neil Zhenqiang Gong, Rada Mihalcea, Zhaozhuo Xu, Jingrui He, Jiaqi W. Ma, Chaowei Xiao, Bo Li, Ahmed Abbasi, Dongwon Lee, Heng Ji, Denghui Zhang
papers.abstract: We present Copyright Detective, the first interactive forensic system for detecting, analyzing, and visualizing potential copyright risks in LLM outputs. The system treats copyright infringement versus compliance as an evidence discovery process rather than a static classification task due to the complex nature of copyright law. It integrates multiple detection paradigms, including content recall testing, paraphrase-level similarity analysis, persuasive jailbreak probing, and unlearning verification, within a unified and extensible framework. Through interactive prompting, response collection, and iterative workflows, our system enables systematic auditing of verbatim memorization and paraphrase-level leakage, supporting responsible deployment and transparent evaluation of LLM copyright risks even with black-box access. In our experiments with GPT-4o-mini, we demonstrate that the specific persuasive strategy “Pathos” shifts the leakage distribution from about 0.1 (ROUGE-L) to 0.7. Our live system is hosted on Streamlit server, with a demonstration video included as supplementary material.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了“版权检测器”，这是首个用于检测、分析和可视化大语言模型输出中潜在版权风险的互动式取证系统。由于版权法的复杂性，该系统将版权侵权与合规视为一个证据发现过程，而非静态的分类任务。它整合了多种检测方法，包括内容回忆测试、改写级相似性分析、有说服力的破解探测以及遗忘验证，所有这些方法都集成在一个统一且可扩展的框架中。通过交互式提示、响应收集以及迭代工作流程，我们的系统能够系统地审计逐字记忆和改写级泄露现象，即使在没有透明数据的情况下，也能支持对大语言模型版权风险的负责任部署和透明评估。在我们对GPT-4o-mini进行的实验中，我们发现特定的说服策略“情感表达”能够将泄露率从约0.1（ROUGE-L）提升到0.7。我们的实时系统运行在Streamlit服务器上，并附带有演示视频作为补充材料。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PROTEA: Offline Evaluation and Iterative Refinement for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
papers.title_zh: PROTEA：用于多智能体大语言模型工作流的离线评估与迭代优化技术
papers.authors: Kazuki Kawamura, Satoshi Waki, Kei Tateno
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM workflows, which are AI systems composed of multiple role-specialized LLM calls, often outperform single prompts, but they are notoriously difficult to debug and refine. Failures can originate from subtle mistakes in intermediate artifacts that silently propagate downstream, forcing developers to read long traces and guess which agent to edit. We present PROTEA, a unified UI that closes the loop for offline, test-case–driven improvement of multi-agent workflows, enabling developers to efficiently diagnose and fix errors without manual inspection of long traces. PROTEA executes a workflow, scores intermediate artifacts with configurable evaluators, and overlays per-node states and rationales on the workflow graph to localize likely bottlenecks. To address the difficulty of preparing intermediate reference in complex systems, PROTEA performs backward node evaluation by inferring each node’s ideal expected output from terminal supervision and graph context, and comparing it with the observed node output. For a selected node, it proposes a targeted prompt patch as an editable diff, then automatically re-runs and re-evaluates the workflow to show before/after output diffs and score trajectories within the same interface. Using PROTEA, users can visually pinpoint system-wide bottlenecks at a glance, streamline remediation via semi-automated prompt patching, and immediately verify pre- and post-correction outcomes within a unified loop.
papers.abstract_zh: 多智能体LLM工作流程是由多个具有特定功能的LLM组成的AI系统。这类系统的性能通常优于单一提示方式，但调试和优化过程却非常困难。故障可能源于中间结果的细微错误，这些错误会悄悄传播到下游，迫使开发者阅读冗长的日志并猜测需要编辑哪个智能体。我们提出了PROTEA这一统一的用户界面，它能够实现多智能体工作流程的离线、基于测试案例的改进，使开发者能够在不需手动查看冗长日志的情况下，高效地诊断并修复错误。PROTEA可以执行工作流程，使用可配置的评估器对中间结果进行评分，并将每个节点的状态和原因信息叠加在工作流程图上，从而定位可能的瓶颈。为了解决在复杂系统中准备中间参考数据的难题，PROTEA通过从终端监督和图上下文中推断出每个节点的理想预期输出，并将其与观察到的节点输出进行比较，来进行反向节点评估。对于选定的节点，它会提出一个可编辑的提示修改建议，然后自动重新运行并重新评估工作流程，以在同一界面上显示输出差异和评分轨迹的变化。通过使用PROTEA，用户可以一目了然地发现整个系统中的瓶颈，通过半自动的提示修改来简化修复过程，并立即在统一的循环中验证修正前后的效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SymbolicThought: Integrating Language Models and Symbolic Reasoning for Consistent and Interpretable Human Relationship Understanding
papers.title_zh: SymbolicThought：将语言模型与符号推理相结合，以实现对人类关系的连贯且可解释性的理解
papers.authors: Runcong Zhao, Qinglin Zhu, Hainiu Xu, Bin Liang, Lin Gui, Yulan He
papers.abstract: Understanding character relationships is essential for interpreting complex narratives and conducting socially grounded AI research. However, manual annotation is time-consuming and low in coverage, while large language models (LLMs) often produce hallucinated or logically inconsistent outputs. We present SymbolicThought, a human-in-the-loop framework that combines LLM-based extraction with symbolic reasoning. The system constructs editable character relationship graphs, refines them using seven types of logical constraints, and enables real-time validation and conflict resolution through an interactive interface. To support logical supervision and explainable social analysis, we release a dataset of 160 interpersonal relationships with corresponding logical structures. Experiments show that SymbolicThought improves annotation accuracy and consistency while significantly reducing time cost, offering a practical tool for narrative understanding, explainable AI, and LLM evaluation. The source code and dataset are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/BLPXSPG/SymbolicThought).
papers.abstract_zh: 理解角色关系对于解读复杂的叙事以及进行基于社会背景的AI研究至关重要。然而，手动注释既耗时又覆盖范围有限，而大语言模型往往会产生幻觉性或逻辑上不一致的输出结果。我们提出了SymbolicThought这一人工干预框架，它结合了基于语言模型的提取技术与符号推理方法。该系统能够构建可编辑的角色关系图，并通过七种逻辑约束对其进行优化，同时通过交互式界面实现实时验证和冲突解决。为了支持逻辑监督和可解释的社会分析，我们还发布了一个包含160种人际关系及其相应逻辑结构的数据集。实验表明，SymbolicThought能够提高注释的准确性和一致性，同时显著减少时间成本，为叙事理解、可解释AI以及语言模型评估提供了实用的工具。源代码和数据集可在GitHub上获取（https://github.com/BLPXSPG/SymbolicThought）。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LiTS: A Modular Framework for LLM Tree Search
papers.title_zh: LiTS：一种用于大语言模型树搜索的模块化框架
papers.authors: Xinzhe Li, Yaguang Tao
papers.abstract: LiTS is a modular Python framework for LLM reasoning via tree search. It decomposes tree search into three reusable components—Policy, Transition, and RewardModel—that plug into algorithms like MCTS and BFS. A decorator-based registry enables domain experts to extend to new domains by registering components, and algorithmic researchers to implement custom search algorithms. We demonstrate composability on MATH500 (language reasoning), Crosswords (environment planning), and MapEval (tool use), showing that components and algorithms are orthogonal: components are reusable across algorithms within each task type, and algorithms work across all components and domains. We also report a mode-collapse finding: in infinite action spaces, LLM policy diversity—not reward quality—is the bottleneck for effective tree search. A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/nRGX43YrR3I. The package is released under the Apache 2.0 license at https://github.com/xinzhel/lits-llm, including installation instructions and runnable examples that enable users to reproduce the demonstrated workflows.
papers.abstract_zh: LiTS是一个基于Python的模块化框架，用于通过树搜索实现大语言模型推理。它将树搜索分解为三个可复用的组件：策略模块、转换模块和奖励模型模块，这些组件可以集成到MCTS和BFS等算法中。通过装饰器式的注册机制，领域专家可以通过注册组件来扩展应用范围，而算法研究人员则可以实现自定义的搜索算法。我们在MATH500（语言推理）、Crosswords（环境规划）和MapEval（工具使用）任务上展示了该框架的可组合性，表明各个组件和算法之间是正交的：不同组件可以在同一任务类型的不同算法中重复使用，而不同的算法则可以在所有组件和领域之间通用。我们还发现了一个有趣的现象：在无限的动作空间中，有效树搜索的瓶颈并非奖励质量，而是大语言模型策略的多样性。演示视频可在https://youtu.be/nRGX43YrR3I查看。该软件包以 Apache 2.0 许可证在 https://github.com/xinzhel/lits-llm 发布，相关安装说明和可运行的示例可以帮助用户重现所展示的工作流程。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AutoFigure-Edit: Generating Editable Scientific Illustrations via Reference-Guided Styling
papers.title_zh: AutoFigure-Edit：通过参考引导的样式设计方法生成可编辑的科学插图
papers.authors: Zhen Lin, Qiujie Xie, Minjun Zhu, Shichen Li, QiYao Sun, Enhao Gu, Yiran Ding, Ke Sun, Fang Guo, Panzhong Lu, Zhiyuan Ning, Yixuan Weng, Yue Zhang
papers.abstract: High-quality scientific illustrations are essential for communicating complex scientific and technical concepts, yet existing automated systems remain limited in editability, stylistic controllability, and efficiency. We present AutoFigure-Edit, an end-to-end system that generates fully editable scientific illustrations from long-form scientific text while enabling flexible style adaptation through user-provided reference images. By combining long-context understanding, reference-guided styling, and native SVG editing, it enables efficient creation and refinement of high-quality scientific illustrations. To facilitate further progress in this field, we release the video at https://youtu.be/10IH8SyJjAQ, the full codebase at https://github.com/ResearAI/AutoFigure-Edit and provide a live demo for easy access and interactive use at https://autofigure.cc/.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量的科学插图对于传达复杂的科学和技术概念至关重要。然而，现有的自动化系统在编辑性、风格控制以及效率方面仍然存在局限性。我们提出了AutoFigure-Edit这一端到端的系统，它能够从长篇的科学文本中生成完全可编辑的科学插图，同时通过用户提供的参考图片实现灵活的风格调整。通过结合长上下文理解、参考引导的样式设计以及原生SVG编辑功能，该系统能够高效创建并优化高质量的科学插图。为了促进该领域的进一步发展，我们在https://youtu.be/10IH8SyJjAQ发布了相关视频，完整的代码库可在https://github.com/ResearAI/AutoFigure-Edit获取，同时我们在https://autofigure.cc/提供了实时演示，方便用户进行互动体验。
