papers.title: QFinZero: A Unified Financial Toolchain for LLM-Based Trading Agents
papers.title_zh: QFinZero：一款统一的金融工具链，适用于基于大语言模型的交易代理程序
papers.authors: Haochen Luo, Yifan LI, Ho Tin Ko, An Binh Minh, Junjie Xu, Tang Pok Hin, Wang Chak Wong, Gao Yuan, Zhengzhao Lai, Yuan Zhang, Chen Liu
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly applied to financial decision-making tasks that require interaction with external tools, including market data retrieval, news analysis, and trade execution. However, existing trading systems rely on fragmented and task-specific APIs, resulting in inconsistent schemas, complex integration, and limited reproducibility. We present QFinZero, a unified trading environment for LLM-based financial agents. QFinZero standardizes three core capabilities: (i) multi-frequency market and derivatives data access, (ii) structured news and event retrieval, and (iii) stateful brokerage simulation with explicit order lifecycle management. All tools adopt consistent JSON schemas and time-aligned interfaces, enabling agents to acquire information and execute trades within a coherent framework. By abstracting financial interaction into composable, agent-invokable primitives, QFinZero reduces engineering overhead and supports reproducible evaluation through comprehensive logging and deterministic replay. We argue that such a standardized trading environment is essential for scalable research on LLM-based financial agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地被应用于需要与外部工具交互的金融决策任务中，这些外部工具包括市场数据检索、新闻分析和交易执行等。然而，现有的交易系统依赖于分散且针对特定任务的API，这导致架构不一致、集成复杂以及可重复性受限。我们提出了QFinZero，这是一个为基于LLM的金融代理设计的统一交易环境。QFinZero实现了三个核心功能：(i) 多频率市场与衍生品数据访问；(ii) 结构化新闻和事件检索；以及(iii) 具有明确订单生命周期管理的状态化经纪模拟。所有工具都采用一致的JSON架构和时间同步接口，使得代理能够在统一的框架内获取信息并执行交易。通过将金融交互抽象为可组合、可调用 primitive，QFinZero降低了工程实施难度，并通过全面的日志记录和确定性重放功能，支持可重复的评估。我们认为，这样的标准化交易环境对于基于LLM的金融代理的研究来说至关重要，它能够实现可扩展性的研究。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: dLLM: Simple Diffusion Language Modeling
papers.title_zh: dLLM：简单扩散语言建模
papers.authors: Zhanhui Zhou, Lingjie Chen, Hanghang Tong, Dawn Song
papers.abstract: Although diffusion language models (DLMs) are evolving quickly, many recent models converge on a set of shared components. These components, however, are distributed across ad-hoc research codebases or lack transparent implementations, making them difficult to reproduce or extend. As the field accelerates, there is a clear need for a unified framework that standardizes these common components while remaining flexible enough to support new methods and architectures.To address this gap, we introduce dLLM, an open-source framework that unifies the core components of diffusion language modeling—training, inference, and evaluation—and makes them easy to customize for new designs. With dLLM, users can reproduce, finetune, deploy, and evaluate open-source large DLMs such as LLaDA and Dream through a standardized pipeline.The framework also provides minimal, reproducible recipes for building small DLMs from scratch with accessible compute—including converting any BERT-style encoder or autoregressive LM into a DLM. We also release the checkpoints of these small DLMs to make DLMs more accessible and accelerate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管扩散语言模型正在迅速发展，但许多最新的模型都收敛于一组共享的组件上。然而，这些组件往往分散在不同的研究代码库中，或者缺乏透明的实现方式，这使得它们难以被复制或扩展。随着该领域的快速发展，显然需要一个统一的框架来标准化这些常见组件，同时又能保持足够的灵活性以支持新的方法和架构。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了dLLM这个开源框架。该框架将扩散语言建模的核心组件——训练、推理和评估功能——整合在一起，并使其易于针对新设计进行定制。通过dLLM，用户可以通过标准化的流程来复现、微调、部署和评估诸如LLaDA和Dream这样的开源大型扩散语言模型。此外，该框架还提供了从零开始构建小型扩散语言模型的最小化、可复现的方法，使用户能够利用简单的计算资源来实现这一目标——包括将任何基于BERT风格的编码器或自回归语言模型转换为扩散语言模型。我们还发布了这些小型扩散语言模型的检查点文件，从而让更多研究人员能够更容易地使用这些模型，并促进未来的研究发展。

papers.title: Fast-MIA: Efficient and Scalable Membership Inference for LLMs
papers.title_zh: 快速会员推理：适用于大语言模型的高效可扩展的成员资格推断方法
papers.authors: Hiromu Takahashi, Shotaro Ishihara
papers.abstract: We propose Fast-MIA (https://github.com/Nikkei/fast-mia), a Python library for efficiently evaluating membership inference attacks (MIA) against large language models (LLMs). MIA has emerged as a crucial technique for auditing privacy risks and copyright infringement in LLMs. However, computational demands have grown substantially: recent methods rely on repeated inference, while practical auditing requires large-scale evaluation. Progress is further hindered by existing implementations that execute methods independently, redundantly computing shared intermediate results such as log-probabilities. To address these challenges, Fast-MIA combines two strategies: (1) high-throughput batch inference via vLLM, achieving approximately 5\times speedup, and (2) a cross-method caching architecture that computes intermediate results once and shares them across methods.The library includes representative MIA methods under a unified framework, integrates with established benchmarks, and supports flexible YAML configuration.We release Fast-MIA under the Apache License 2.0 to support scalable and reproducible MIA research.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Fast-MIA（https://github.com/Nikkei/fast-mia），这是一个用于高效评估针对大语言模型（LLMs）的成员资格推理攻击的Python库。MIA已成为审计LLMs中的隐私风险和版权侵权问题的重要技术。然而，其计算需求已经大幅增加：目前的方法依赖于反复的推理过程，而实际的审计则需要大规模的计算资源。现有的实现方式存在缺陷，它们各自独立地执行方法，同时会冗余地计算共享的中间结果，比如日志概率。为了解决这些问题，Fast-MIA结合了两种策略：(1)通过vLLM实现高吞吐量批量推理，从而实现大约5倍的加速效果；(2)采用跨方法缓存架构，一次计算出中间结果，并将这些结果在不同方法中共享。该库在统一的框架下包含了多种代表性的MIA方法，能够与现有的基准测试集成，并且支持灵活的YAML配置。我们将Fast-MIA以Apache License 2.0许可证发布，以支持可扩展且可复现的MIA研究。

papers.title: CodeDistiller: Automatically Generating Code Libraries for Scientific Coding Agents
papers.title_zh: CodeDistiller：自动生成用于科学编程代理的代码库工具
papers.authors: Peter Jansen, Samiah Hassan, Pragnya Narasimha
papers.abstract: Automated Scientific Discovery (ASD) systems can help automatically generate and run code-based experiments, but their capabilities are limited by the code they can reliably generate from parametric knowledge alone. As a result, current systems either mutate a small number of manually-crafted experiment examples, or operate solely from parametric knowledge, limiting quality and reach. We introduce CodeDistiller, a system that automatically distills large collections of scientific Github repositories into a vetted library of working domain-specific code examples, allowing ASD agents to expand their capabilities without manual effort. Using a combination of automatic and domain-expert evaluation on 250 materials science repositories, we find the best model is capable of producing functional examples for 74% of repositories, while our downstream evaluation shows an ASD agent augmented with a CodeDistiller generated library produces more accurate, complete, and scientifically sound experiments than an agent with only general materials-science code examples. We also evaluate LLM-as-a-judge ratings against domain-expert ratings in an A/B testing paradigm, finding moderate agreement and suggesting that inexpensive proxy metrics may be feasible for evaluating scientific discovery systems at scale.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化科学发现系统能够自动生成并运行基于代码的实验，但其能力受到限于仅能从参数知识中可靠生成的代码这一限制。因此，当前系统要么只能生成少量经过人工设计的实验示例，要么完全依赖参数知识来运作，这限制了系统的质量和适用范围。我们提出了CodeDistiller系统，它能够自动从大量的科学GitHub仓库中提取出经过筛选的、适用于特定领域的代码示例库，从而使科学发现系统无需人工干预就能扩展其功能。通过对250个材料科学仓库进行自动评估以及领域专家评估的结合，我们发现最佳模型能够为74%的仓库生成可运行的代码示例。而后续评估表明，使用CodeDistiller生成的代码示例库的智能体所执行的实验比仅使用通用材料科学代码示例的智能体更为准确、完整且符合科学规范。我们还通过A/B测试的方式，将大语言模型作为评估工具与领域专家评估结果进行了对比，发现两者之间存在中等程度的一致性。这表明，在大规模科学发现系统的评估中，使用廉价的替代指标也是可行的。

papers.title: IDP Accelerator: Agentic Document Intelligence from Extraction to Compliance Validation
papers.title_zh: IDP加速器：从文档提取到合规性验证的主动式文档智能处理方案
papers.authors: Md Mofijul Islam, Md Sirajus Salekin, Joe King, Priyashree Roy, Vamsi Thilak Gudi, Spencer Romo, Akhil Nooney, Bob Strahan, Boyi Xie, Diego A. Socolinsky
papers.abstract: Understanding and extracting structured insights from unstructured documents remains a foundational challenge in industrial NLP. While Large Language Models (LLMs) enable zero-shot extraction, traditional pipelines often fail to handle multi-document packets, complex reasoning, and strict compliance requirements. We present IDP (Intelligent Document Processing) Accelerator, a framework enabling agentic AI for end-to-end document intelligence with four key components: (1) DocSplit, a novel benchmark dataset and multimodal classifier using BIO tagging to segment complex document packets; (2) configurable Extraction Module leveraging multimodal LLMs to transform unstructured content into structured data; (3) Agentic Analytics Module, compliant with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) providing data access through secure, sandboxed code execution; and (4) Rule Validation Module replacing deterministic engines with LLM-driven logic for complex compliance checks. The interactive demonstration enables users to upload document packets, visualize classification results, and explore extracted data through an intuitive web interface. We demonstrate effectiveness across industries, highlighting a production deployment at a leading healthcare provider achieving 98% classification accuracy, 80% reduced processing latency, and 77% lower operational costs over legacy baselines. IDP Accelerator is open-sourced with a live demonstration available to the community.
papers.abstract_zh: 从非结构化文档中理解和提取结构化信息仍然是工业自然语言处理领域的一项基础挑战。虽然大语言模型能够实现零样本提取，但传统的处理流程往往无法应对多文档组合、复杂的推理需求以及严格的合规要求。我们提出了IDP（智能文档处理加速器）这一框架，它利用四个关键组件来实现端到端的文档智能处理：(1) DocSplit，这是一个创新的基准数据集和多模态分类器，采用BIO标注技术对复杂文档进行分割；(2) 可配置的提取模块，利用多模态语言模型将非结构化内容转化为结构化数据；(3) 智能分析模块，遵循模型上下文协议，通过安全的沙箱化代码执行方式提供数据访问；(4) 规则验证模块，用基于语言模型的逻辑替代确定性引擎，以处理复杂的合规性检查。该工具通过交互式界面使用户能够上传文档、查看分类结果，并探索提取出的数据。我们在多个行业进行了测试，结果显示该工具具有出色的性能：在一家领先的医疗保健公司中，该工具的分类准确率达到了98%，处理延迟降低了80%，运营成本则降低了77%。IDP加速器已开源，社区可以观看其实时演示。

papers.title: AInterviewer: A Platform for Designing and Conducting AI-led Qualitative Interviews
papers.title_zh: 面试官：一个用于设计和实施由人工智能主导的定性访谈的平台
papers.authors: Tobias Gårdhus, Nikolas Vitsakis, Fie Lejre Frederiksen, Anna Rogers, Hjalmar Bang Carlsen
papers.abstract: There are now multiple proposals for systems based on Large Language Models(LLMs) to conduct automated qualitative interviews. This approach scales up qualitative interview techniques that have traditionally been constrained by the high costs of data collection. However, most of the current solutions rely on proprietary LLMs, which compromise reproducibility and data security. They also rely on LLMs for all interview tasks, which limits standardisation of question wording as well as control over question order. To address these issues, we introduce the AInterviewer platform, based on a multi-agent framework that combines controlled question administration of survey software with the flexibility of LLMs. AInterviewer can run with locally hosted models to ensure security and transparency. Our platform provides a web-based GUI supporting each phase of data collection: from interview guide design and pilot testing to interview distribution and data collection monitoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前有多种基于大语言模型的技术方案被用于进行自动化的定性访谈。这种方法的优势在于能够扩展传统上因数据收集成本高昂而受到限制的定性访谈技术。不过，目前大多数解决方案都依赖于专有的大语言模型，这会影响研究的可重复性和数据安全性。此外，这些方案将所有访谈任务都交给大语言模型来处理，这就限制了问题表述的标准化以及问题的排序控制。为了解决这些问题，我们推出了AInterviewer平台。该平台基于多智能体框架设计，能够将调查软件中受控的问题管理功能与大语言模型的灵活性相结合。AInterviewer可以使用本地部署的模型来运行，从而确保系统的安全性和透明度。我们的平台提供了基于网页的图形用户界面，可以支持数据收集过程中的每一个环节：从访谈指南设计和试点测试，到访谈分配和数据收集监控。

papers.title: AutoForest: Automatically Generating Forest Plots from Biomedical Studies with End-to-End Evidence Extraction and Synthesis
papers.title_zh: AutoForest：基于生物医学研究数据，自动生成森林图结构，并实现端到端的证据提取与整合功能
papers.authors: Massimiliano Pronesti, Angelo Miculescu, Mohsin Kapdi, Paul Flanagan, Oisín Redmond, Joao H Bettencourt-Silva, Gurdeep Singh Mannu, Spiros Denaxas, Rui Providencia, Anya Belz, Yufang Hou
papers.abstract: Systematic reviews rely on forest plots to synthesise quantitative evidence across biomedical studies, but generating them remains a fragmented and labour-intensive process. Researchers must interpret complex clinical texts, manually extract outcome data from trials, define appropriate interventions and comparators, harmonise inconsistent study designs, and carry out meta-analytic computations—typically using specialised software that demands structured inputs and domain expertise. While recent work has demonstrated that large language models can extract study-level data from unstructured text, no existing system automates the complete pipeline from raw documents to synthesised forest plots. To address this gap, we introduce AutoForest, the first end-to-end system that generates publication-ready forest plots directly from biomedical papers. Given one or more study papers, AutoForest automatically suggests ICO (Intervention, Comparator, Outcome) elements, extracts outcome data, performs statistical synthesis, and renders the final forest plot. We describe the system architecture, user interface and demonstrate its effectiveness on real-world examples through a user study involving clinicians, showing how AutoForest can accelerate evidence synthesis and substantially lower the barrier to conducting meta-analyses.
papers.abstract_zh: 系统评价依赖于森林图来整合生物医学研究中的定量证据，但生成这些森林图仍然是一个分散且需要大量人工操作的过程。研究人员必须解读复杂的临床文本，手动提取试验中的结果数据，确定合适的干预措施和比较对象，协调不一致的研究设计，并进行元分析计算——这通常需要使用专门的软件，而这些软件要求有结构化的输入数据和领域专业知识。虽然最近的研究表明，大语言模型可以从非结构化文本中提取研究级数据，但目前还没有系统能够自动化从原始文档到合成森林图的整个流程。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了AutoForest——首个能够从生物医学论文直接生成可用于发表的森林图的端到端系统。给定一篇或多篇研究论文，AutoForest会自动推荐ICO元素（干预措施、比较对象、结果），提取结果数据，进行统计综合处理，并生成最终的森林图。我们描述了该系统的架构和用户界面，并通过涉及临床医生的用户研究，展示了其在实际案例中的有效性，从而证明了AutoForest如何能够加速证据整合过程，并大大降低进行元分析的难度。

papers.title: Dash-M5H: An Interactive Dashboard for Multi-Modal, Multi-Model Mental Health Assessment
papers.title_zh: Dash-M5H：一种用于多模态、多模型心理健康评估的互动式仪表盘
papers.authors: Raymond Alavo, Xinyuan Zhang, Gemza Ademaj, Junhui Cai, Hyeokhyen Kwon, Robert Cotes, Gari D. Clifford, Ahmed Abbasi
papers.abstract: We present Dash-M5H, an interactive dashboard for multi-modal, multi-model mental health assessment that helps clinicians and researchers jointly inspect multimodal behavioral data with multi-model signal outputs of recorded clinical interviews. Guided by signal detection and integrated sensemaking theories, Dash-M5H synchronizes transcript text, audio, and facial behavior (action units and gaze) to support overview-to-detail evidence tracing; and it integrates extracted signals (e.g., sentiment and facial activity) with a clinically grounded VLM prediction pipeline that produces DSM-5-aligned depression predictions. Dash-M5H (https://dash-m5h.io) is implemented in a lightweight, browser-based stack (Quarto + Observable JS + D3), supports local data import and time-synced clinical annotation with export. We demonstrate Dash-M5H through a depression screening scenario, evaluate its note-taking and screening capabilities through a user experiment, and release a live demo (https://youtu.be/w3qCJ02k6bw) and code (https://github.com/nd-hal/M5H-Dashboard-VLM) to facilitate reproducible evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了Dash-M5H，这是一个用于多模态、多模型心理健康评估的互动仪表板。它能够帮助临床医生和研究人员共同检查多模态行为数据以及记录下来的临床访谈的多模型信号输出。在信号检测和综合意义理解理论指导下，Dash-M5H能够同步处理文本、音频和面部行为（动作单元和视线）数据，从而支持从整体到细节的证据追踪；同时，它还能将提取出的信号（如情绪和情感活动）与基于临床的VLM预测流程相结合，生成符合DSM-5标准的抑郁症预测结果。Dash-M5H的官网为https://dash-m5h.io，该工具采用轻量级、基于浏览器的框架实现（Quarto + Observable JS + D3），支持本地数据导入、时间同步的临床注释功能以及数据导出。我们通过一个抑郁症筛查场景来演示Dash-M5H的功能，并通过用户实验评估了其笔记记录和筛查能力。此外，我们还提供了实时演示视频（https://youtu.be/w3qCJ02k6bw）和代码库（https://github.com/nd-hal/M5H-Dashboard-VLM），以便其他人能够重复进行相关评估。

papers.title: MixtureKit: A General Framework for Composing, Training, and Visualizing Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.title_zh: MixtureKit：一种用于构建、训练以及可视化混合专家模型的通用框架
papers.authors: Ahmad Chamma, Omar El Herraoui, Guokan Shang
papers.abstract: We introduce MixtureKit, a modular open-source framework for constructing, training, and analyzing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models from arbitrary pre-trained or fine-tuned checkpoints. MixtureKit supports three complementary strategies: (i) Traditional MoE, using a single router per transformer block to select experts; (ii) BTX (Branch-Train-Mix), adding routers at user-specified sub-layers for fine-grained token routing; and (iii) BTS (Branch-Train-Stitch), preserving experts intact and introducing lightweight stitch layers for controlled hub–expert information exchange. Given a single configuration dictionary, MixtureKit automatically modifies model configuration, patches decoder and causal LM classes, and exports a unified transformers-compatible checkpoint ready for inference or further fine-tuning. We also provide a visualization interface to inspect token routing, expert weight distributions, and layer-wise contributions. Experiments on multilingual code-switched (Arabic–Latin) data show that BTX models built with MixtureKit can outperform dense baselines across multiple benchmarks. The library is accessible at: https://github.com/MBZUAI-Paris/MixtureKit.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了MixtureKit，这是一个模块化的开源框架，用于构建、训练和分析由任意预训练或微调的检查点生成的混合专家模型。MixtureKit支持三种互补的策略：(i) 传统的混合专家模型，每个变换器块使用一个路由器来选择专家；(ii) BTX策略（分支训练混合），在用户指定的子层添加路由器以实现细粒度的令牌路由；以及(iii) BTS策略（分支训练缝合），保持专家结构不变，并引入轻量级的缝合层以控制中心与专家之间的信息交换。通过单一的配置字典，MixtureKit能够自动修改模型配置、调整解码器和因果语言模型类，并生成一个与Transformers兼容的统一检查点，可供推理或进一步微调使用。我们还提供了一个可视化界面，用于查看令牌路由、专家权重分布以及各层的贡献情况。在多语言混合语码（阿拉伯语-拉丁语）数据上的实验表明，使用MixtureKit构建的BTX模型在多个基准测试中的表现优于基于密集模型的基线模型。该库可以在以下链接访问：https://github.com/MBZUAI-Paris/MixtureKit。

papers.title: Squrve: A Unified and Modular Framework for Complex Real-World Text-to-SQL Tasks
papers.title_zh: Squrve：一种适用于复杂现实世界文本转SQL任务的统一且模块化框架
papers.authors: Yihan Wang, Peiyu Liu, Runyu Chen, Jiaxing Pu, Wei Xu
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL technology has evolved rapidly, with diverse academic methods achieving impressive results. However, deploying these techniques in real-world systems remains challenging due to limited integration tools. Despite these advances, we introduce Squrve, a unified, modular, and extensive Text-to-SQL framework designed to bring together research advances and real-world applications. Squrve first establishes a universal execution paradigm that standardizes invocation interfaces, then proposes a multi-actor collaboration mechanism based on seven abstracted effective atomic actor components. Experiments on widely adopted benchmarks demonstrate that the collaborative workflows consistently outperform the original individual methods, thereby opening up a new effective avenue for tackling complex real-world queries. The codes are available at https://github.com/LLM-Cube/Squrve.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本转SQL技术已经取得了迅速的发展，各种学术方法都取得了令人瞩目的成果。然而，由于集成工具的局限性，将这些技术应用于实际系统仍然具有挑战性。尽管取得了这些进展，我们推出了Squrve这一统一、模块化且功能丰富的文本转SQL框架，旨在将研究成果与实际应用相结合。Squrve首先建立了一个通用的执行范式，标准化了调用接口；然后提出了一种基于七个抽象化有效原子组件的多主体协作机制。在广泛采用的基准测试上的实验表明，这种协作工作流程始终优于单独使用单一方法的性能，从而为处理复杂的实际查询问题开辟了一条新的有效途径。相关代码可以在https://github.com/LLM-Cube/Squrve下载。

papers.title: RiskLab: A Controlled Toolkit for Probing Emergent Risks in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: RiskLab：一个用于探究基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中出现的风险的受控工具集
papers.authors: Yu Jiang, Wenjie Wang, Yue Huang, Yanbo Wang, Zhenhong Zhou, Xiuying Chen, Yang Liu, Pin-Yu Chen, Wei Wang, Xiangliang Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in multi-agent settings where failures emerge from interaction dynamics rather than isolated model errors. We introduce RiskLab, an open-source toolkit for instantiating, probing, and measuring emergent risks in LLM-based multi-agent systems under controlled conditions. Each experiment is defined as a structured topology–environment–protocol–agent–task quintuple, enabling reproducible studies of how communication structure, coordination mechanisms, and incentives shape system-level risks. RiskLab provides flexible communication topologies, swappable interaction protocols, trajectory-grounded evaluation, and extensible registries for risk detectors and agent backends. We demonstrate the toolkit across representative risks, including collusion, resource overreach, semantic drift, and strategic misreporting, and support one-file reproducibility via configuration.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地运行在多智能体环境中，其中的故障是由交互动态引起的，而非孤立的模型错误。我们推出了RiskLab这个开源工具包，用于在受控条件下实例化、探测和衡量基于LLM的多智能体系统中的风险。每个实验都被定义为一个结构化的拓扑-环境-协议-代理-任务五元组，这使得我们可以重现性地研究通信结构、协调机制和激励因素如何影响系统级风险。RiskLab提供了灵活的通信拓扑、可更换的交互协议、基于轨迹的评估方式，以及可扩展的风险检测器和代理后端存储机制。我们通过该工具包展示了多种典型风险，包括共谋、资源过度使用、语义漂移以及策略性误报等问题。同时，我们还支持通过配置实现一键式重现实验。

papers.title: ArcLight: A Lightweight LLM Inference Architecture for Many-Core CPUs
papers.title_zh: ArcLight：一种适用于多核CPU的轻量级大语言模型推理架构
papers.authors: Yuzhuang Xu, Xu Han, Yuxuan Li, Wanxiang Che
papers.abstract: Although existing frameworks for large language model (LLM) inference on CPUs are mature, they fail to fully exploit the computational potential of many-core CPU platforms. Many-core CPUs are widely deployed in web servers and high-end networking devices, and are typically organized into multiple NUMA nodes that group cores and memory. Current frameworks largely overlook the substantial overhead of cross-NUMA memory access, limiting inference scalability and intelligence enabling on such platforms. To address this limitation, we build ArcLight, a lightweight LLM inference architecture designed from the ground up for many-core CPUs. ArcLight integrates efficient memory management and thread scheduling, and introduces finely controlled tensor parallelism to mitigate the cross-node memory access wall. Experimental results show that ArcLight significantly surpasses the performance ceiling of mainstream frameworks, achieving up to 46% higher inference throughput. Moreover, ArcLight maintains compatibility with arbitrary CPU devices. ArcLight is publicly available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/ArcLight.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然现有的在CPU上进行大语言模型推理的框架已经相当成熟，但它们未能充分挖掘多核CPU平台的计算潜力。多核CPU被广泛用于网络服务器和高端网络设备，通常被划分为多个NUMA节点，这些节点负责管理核心和内存。当前的框架往往忽略了跨NUMA节点内存访问所带来的巨大开销，这限制了此类平台上的推理可扩展性和智能性。为了克服这一限制，我们开发了ArcLight——一种专为多核CPU设计的轻量级语言模型推理架构。ArcLight实现了高效的内存管理和线程调度，并引入了精细控制的张量并行处理机制，以缓解跨节点内存访问带来的挑战。实验结果表明，ArcLight的性能远远超过了主流框架的性能上限，其推理吞吐量最高可达主流框架的46%。此外，ArcLight还保持了与任意CPU设备的兼容性。ArcLight可以在https://github.com/OpenBMB/ArcLight上免费下载使用。

papers.title: DialogGuard: Multi-Agent Psychosocial Safety Evaluation Interface of Sensitive LLM Responses
papers.title_zh: DialogGuard：针对敏感大语言模型输出的多智能体心理社会安全评估接口
papers.authors: Han Luo, Guy Laban
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed for mental-health support and crisis counselling, yet recent evaluations reveal that commercial therapy chatbots respond appropriately only about half the time in clinical scenarios.Clinicians and safety engineers are called upon to audit these systems, but existing tools do not surface the subtler psychosocial harms (manipulation, discrimination, psychological distress) nor produce the explainable rationales that practitioners need.We present DialogGuard, an open-source system that lets practitioners inspect, stress-test, and create audit trails for prompted LLM agents across five psychosocial safety dimensions.The system wraps around arbitrary generative models through four LLM-as-a-judge pipelines (single-agent scoring, dual-agent correction, multi-agent debate, and majority voting), each grounded in shared three-level rubrics.Through its web interface, practitioners evaluate agents in two modes (Live Chat and Manual Input) and review per-dimension risk scores with natural-language rationales.Experiments on PKU-SafeRLHF show that dual-agent correction provides the best accuracy-robustness trade-off, and a formative study with 12 practitioners confirms that the system supports prompt auditing, safety inspection, and supervisory decision-making.Code and demo: https://github.com/lhannnn/dialogguard-web.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体越来越多地被用于心理健康支持和危机咨询领域。然而，最近的评估显示，商业化的治疗聊天机器人在临床场景中只有大约一半的时间能够做出恰当的响应。临床医生和安全性工程师需要对这些系统进行审查，但现有的工具无法揭示那些更为隐蔽的心理社会危害（如操纵、歧视、心理困扰），也无法提供从业者所需的解释性依据。我们提出了DialogGuard这一开源系统，它允许从业者对提示式的大语言模型智能体进行监控、压力测试，并生成审计记录，涵盖五个心理社会安全维度。该系统通过四种大语言模型作为评判器的方法来处理各种生成模型的问题：单智能体评分、双智能体修正、多智能体辩论以及多数投票。这些方法都基于统一的三个级别的评价标准。通过系统的网页界面，从业者可以以两种模式对智能体进行评估：实时聊天和手动输入，同时可以查看每个维度的风险评分以及相应的自然语言解释。在PKU-SafeRLHF上的实验表明，双智能体修正方法在准确性和稳健性之间提供了最佳的平衡。一项由12名从业者参与的形成性研究也证实了该系统的有效性，它能够支持对智能体的监控、安全检查以及决策制定。代码和演示版本可访问：https://github.com/lhannnn/dialogguard-web
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ClinQueryAgent: A Conversational Agent for Population Health Management
papers.title_zh: ClinQueryAgent：一种用于人口健康管理的对话式智能代理
papers.authors: Joseph Spartacus Boyle, Anthony Michael Dranfield, Mike O’Neil, Maria Liakata, Alison Q. Smithard
papers.abstract: In this paper we introduce CLINQUERYAGENT, a system for translating natural language population health questions into executable database queries using agents with access to both local and external knowledge bases. Our novel architecture enables the use of powerful cloud-based language models whilst ensuring that no patient data leaves the secure environment. To combat inaccuracies over the course of longer dialogues due to context rot, information retrieval is delegated to a sub-agent. We deploy the system via a chat window embedded within an existing population health management platform where it has been used by 128 staff from 15 healthcare practices covering a total of 148,319 patients in the UK’s National Health Service (NHS). We evaluate the system’s capacity to autonomously handle a range of health informatics tasks on three datasets and via a beta-testing phase. Our results show that both analysts and clinicians are able to easily generate actionable information from patient health records using natural language requests requiring no programming expertise to verify. A public demo of the system is available to try: https://clinqueryagent.josephsboyle.com/
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了CLINQUERYAGENT系统。该系统能够利用具备本地和外部知识库访问权限的代理，将自然语言中的人群健康问题转化为可执行的数据库查询语句。我们的创新架构使得可以使用强大的基于云的语言模型，同时确保患者数据不会离开安全环境。为了应对长时间对话过程中由于上下文变化导致的信息不准确问题，我们将信息检索任务委托给一个子代理来处理。我们通过将该系统嵌入到现有的人群健康管理平台上来实现系统的部署。目前，该系统已被英国国家卫生服务体系中的15家医疗机构的128名工作人员使用，涵盖了英国全国148,319名患者。我们对该系统在三个数据集上的自动处理能力进行了评估，并通过测试阶段验证了其效果。结果表明，分析师和临床医生都能够轻松地通过自然语言请求从患者健康记录中提取出有用的信息，且无需编程专业知识即可完成验证。您可以访问该系统的公开演示版本进行尝试：https://clinqueryagent.josephsboyle.com/

papers.title: Rankify: A Comprehensive Python Toolkit for Retrieval, Re-Ranking, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: Rankify：一个全面的Python工具包，用于检索、重新排序以及结合检索机制进行生成式生成文本处理
papers.authors: Abdelrahman Abdallah, Bhawna Piryani, Jamshid Mozafari, Andreas Herzinger, Jamie Holdcroft, Adam Jatowt
papers.abstract: Building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems often requires combining separate tools for retrieval, re-ranking, and generation, with incompatible data formats, evaluation pipelines, and deployment workflows. We present Rankify, an open-source Python toolkit that unifies these stages in a single modular framework. Rankify provides 42 benchmark datasets with pre-retrieved documents and pre-built indices, 15 retrievers (sparse, dense, and reasoning-augmented), and 24 re-ranking models spanning 41 pointwise, pairwise, and listwise variants. It also supports 6 RAG strategies across four inference backends (Hugging Face, vLLM, LiteLLM, and OpenAI), enabling consistent experimentation from local models to hosted APIs. A unified pipeline interface allows users to compose retrieve–rerank–generate workflows in a few lines of code, while an agentic assistant (RankifyAgent), aREST server (RankifyServer), and an interactive web playground support deployment and non-programmatic exploration. Across 200+ configurations on QA and BEIR/TREC benchmarks with six generator LLMs, re-ranking consistently improves downstream performance, yielding gains of 5–15 points in Exact Match and up to 8.5 points in RAGAS context precision across diverse retriever–generator combinations. Rankify is released under the Apache-2.0 License.
papers.abstract_zh: 构建基于检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常需要结合多种工具来完成检索、重新排序和生成任务，而这些工具往往具有不兼容的数据格式、评估流程以及部署方式。我们提出了Rankify这一开源Python工具包，它能够将这些阶段整合到一个模块化的框架中。Rankify提供了42个基准数据集，其中包含预先检索出的文档和预构建的索引；同时拥有15种检索器（包括稀疏检索器、密集检索器以及增强推理功能的检索器），以及24种重新排序模型，涵盖了41种不同的点状、成对和列表式重新排序方法。此外，该工具还支持6种RAG策略，并适用于4种推理后端（Hugging Face、vLLM、LiteLLM和OpenAI），使得用户能够从本地模型到托管API进行一致的实验。统一的流程接口允许用户用几行代码就能组合出检索-重新排序-生成的完整工作流程；而智能助手RankifyAgent、aREST服务器以及交互式网络平台则支持非编程式的部署与探索功能。在200多种配置下，通过QA和BEIR/TREC基准测试，结合6种生成式LLM，重新排序机制能够持续提升下游性能，在精确匹配指标上实现了5至15点的提升，在RAGAS上下文精度方面则达到了8.5点的改善，这种效果在不同检索器与生成器的组合中都能得到体现。Rankify采用Apache-2.0许可证进行发布。

papers.title: ScheMatiQ: From Research Question to Structured Data through Interactive Schema Discovery
papers.title_zh: ScheMatiQ：从研究问题出发，通过交互式模式发现机制来实现结构化数据的生成
papers.authors: Shahar Levy, Eliya Habba, Reshef Mintz, Barak Raveh, Renana Keydar, Gabriel Stanovsky
papers.abstract: Many disciplines pose natural-language research questions over large document collections whose answers typically requires structured evidence, traditionally obtained by manually designing an annotation schema and exhaustively labeling the corpus, a slow and error-prone process. We introduce ScheMatiQ, which leverages calls to a backbone LLM to take a question and a corpus to produce a schema and a grounded database, with a web interface that lets steer and revise the extraction. In collaboration with domain experts, we show that ScheMatiQ yields outputs that support real-world analysis in law and computational biology. We release ScheMatiQ as open source with a public web interface, and invite experts across disciplines to use it with their own data. All resources, including the website, source code, and demonstration video, are available at: www.ScheMatiQ-ai.com.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多学科都面临着关于大量文档集合的自然语言研究问题，而这些问题通常需要结构化的证据来解答。传统上，这些证据的获取是通过手动设计注释模式并对整个语料库进行详尽标注来实现的，这一过程既耗时又容易出错。我们提出了ScheMatiQ这一工具，它利用强大的大语言模型来处理问题以及语料库，从而生成注释模式和结构化数据库。该工具还拥有网页界面，用户可以随时对提取过程进行操控和修改。通过与领域专家的合作，我们发现ScheMatiQ能够生成适用于法律和计算生物学领域分析的结果。我们将ScheMatiQ以开源形式发布，并提供了公共网页界面，欢迎各个学科的专家使用我们的工具来处理自己的数据。所有相关资源，包括网站、源代码和演示视频，都可以访问：www.ScheMatiQ-ai.com。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GovScape: A Public Multimodal Search System for 70 Million Pages of Government PDFs
papers.title_zh: GovScape：一个用于搜索7000万页政府文档的公共多模态搜索系统
papers.authors: Ying-Hsiang Huang, Claire Gong, Shreya Shaji, Alison R Yan, Leslie Harka, Albert Du, Anjali Shubha Gopal, Samuel J Klein, Shannon Zejiang Shen, Mark E. Phillips, Trevor Owens, Kyle Deeds, Benjamin Charles Germain Lee
papers.abstract: Efforts over the past three decades have produced web archives containing billions of webpage snapshots and petabytes of data. The End of Term Web Archive alone contains millions of PDFs produced by the federal government. While preservation with web archives has been successful, significant challenges for access and discoverability remain. In this paper, we introduce GovScape, a public search system that supports multimodal searches across 10,015,993 federal government PDFs from the 2020 End of Term crawl (70,958,487 total PDF pages) – to our knowledge, all renderable PDFs in the 2020 crawl that are 50 pages or under. GovScape supports four primary forms of search: in addition to providing (1) filter conditions over metadata facets including domain and crawl date and (2) exact text search against the PDF text, we provide (3) semantic text search and (4) visual search against the PDFs across individual pages, enabling users to structure queries such as “redacted documents” or “pie charts.” We detail GovScape’s search affordances, embedding pipeline, system architecture, and open source codebase. Significantly, the total estimated compute cost for GovScape’s pre-processing pipeline for 10 million PDFs was approximately 1,500, equivalent to 47,000 PDF pages per dollar spent on compute, demonstrating the potential for immediate scalability. We evaluate GovScape by (1) analyzing 1,679 search queries and (2) benchmarking vector and keyword index efficiency using these queries. GovScape can be found at https://www.govscape.net.
papers.abstract_zh: 在过去三十年中，人们努力创建了包含数十亿网页快照和数拍字节数据的网络档案。仅“End of Term Web Archive”这一档案就包含了由联邦政府生成的数百万份PDF文件。虽然通过网络档案进行保存已经取得了成功，但在访问和可发现性方面仍然存在重大挑战。在本文中，我们介绍了GovScape——一个公共搜索系统，它能够跨10,015,993份来自2020年“End of Term”数据收集过程中的联邦政府PDF文件进行多模态搜索（总PDF页面数为70,958,487页）。据我们所知，这些文件中所有页数不超过50页的可渲染PDF文件都包含在GovScape的搜索范围内。GovScape支持四种主要的搜索方式：除了能够针对元数据字段设置过滤条件，如域名和收集日期之外，还能进行精确的文本搜索；此外，它还提供了语义文本搜索以及针对单个页面的视觉搜索功能，使用户能够构建诸如“已编辑文档”或“饼图”等查询。我们详细介绍了GovScape的搜索功能、处理流程、系统架构以及开源代码库。值得注意的是，对于1000万份PDF文件，GovScape的预处理流程的总计算成本约为1,500美元，这意味着每花费1美元就可以处理大约47,000页PDF文件，这显示了其具备立即扩展的能力。我们通过以下两种方式对GovScape进行了评估：(1)分析了1,679个搜索查询；(2)使用这些查询对向量索引和关键词索引的效率进行了基准测试。GovScape的官方网站为https://www.govscape.net。

papers.title: Bridging Kernel Drivers and Virtual Device Models with LLM-Powered Automation
papers.title_zh: 利用基于大语言模型的自动化技术，实现内核驱动程序与虚拟设备模型之间的无缝连接
papers.authors: Mingyu Wang, Bin Yu, Wenjian Lu, Zhi Wang, Gao Kefeng, Cheng Wen, Xu Lu, Cong Tian
papers.abstract: Linux kernel device drivers are tightly coupled with hardware, making them difficult to execute and test without physical devices. This heavily limits automated code analysis and vulnerability discovery. While manual modeling is unscalable, Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a new approach to scale virtual device construction across the Linux driver ecosystem. In this paper, we present DevGen, an LLM-powered tool that generates QEMU-based virtual devices directly from Linux driver source code. DevGen combines static analysis to gather necessary context, guides the LLM through step-by-step prompting, and uses an automated self-correction loop driven by compilation and execution feedback. To further reduce errors, similar fixes are retrieved from a library of common modeling failures and incorporated into the repair prompt, which supports more targeted corrections in later iterations. The generated devices finally integrate with QEMU and Syzkaller, enabling driver fuzzing without physical hardware. DevGen is evaluated on 50 PCI/PCIe drivers from Linux 6.18 using three mainstream LLMs, and successfully generates usable models for 44 drivers. In these drivers, 24% of them achieve significant improvements in fuzzing coverage, and 7 previously unknown crashes are triggered with 1 CVE assigned. These results demonstrate the practical capability of LLMs to automate complex, system-level code generation tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: Linux内核设备驱动程序与硬件紧密耦合，因此在没有物理设备的情况下很难执行和测试。这极大地限制了自动化代码分析和漏洞发现的能力。虽然手动建模无法实现规模化，但大语言模型为在Linux驱动程序生态系统中构建虚拟设备提供了一种新的方法。在本文中，我们介绍了DevGen这一由语言模型驱动的工具，它能够直接从Linux驱动程序的源代码生成基于QEMU的虚拟设备。DevGen结合了静态分析来收集必要的上下文信息，通过逐步提示引导语言模型进行生成，并采用由编译和执行反馈驱动的自动自我修复机制。为了进一步减少错误，DevGen还会从常见的建模失败案例中提取类似的修复方案，并将其纳入修复提示中，从而在后续的迭代过程中实现更精准的修复。最终生成的虚拟设备可以与QEMU和Syzkaller集成，从而实现无需物理硬件即可进行驱动程序模糊测试。我们在Linux 6.18版本下对50个PCI/PCIe驱动程序进行了测试，使用了三种主流语言模型，结果显示DevGen成功地为44个驱动程序生成了可用的虚拟设备模型。在这些驱动程序中，有24%的驱动程序在模糊测试覆盖率方面取得了显著改善，同时还有7个此前未知的崩溃问题被触发，并获得了相应的CVE评级。这些结果证明了语言模型在自动化复杂系统级代码生成任务方面的实际能力。

papers.title: BabelDOC: Better Layout-Preserving PDF Translation via Intermediate Representation
papers.title_zh: BabelDOC：通过中间表示方式实现更高效的PDF翻译，同时保留文档布局不变
papers.authors: Yang Qi, Xiangyao Ma, Xiao Wang, Hao Wang, Rui Wang
papers.abstract: As global cross-lingual communication intensifies, language barriers in visually rich documents such as PDFs remain a practical bottleneck. Existing document translation pipelines face a tension between linguistic processing and layout preservation: text-oriented Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) systems often discard structural metadata, while document parsers focus on extraction and do not support faithful re-rendering after translation. We introduce BabelDOC, an Intermediate Representation (IR)-based framework for layout-preserving PDF translation. BabelDOC decouples visual layout metadata from semantic content, enabling document-level translation operations such as terminology extraction, cross-page context handling, glossary-constrained generation, and formula placeholdering. The translated content is then re-anchored to the original layout through an adaptive typesetting engine. Experiments on a curated 200-page benchmark, together with human evaluation and multimodal LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, show that BabelDOC improves layout fidelity, visual aesthetics, and terminology consistency over representative baselines, while maintaining competitive translation precision. The open-source toolkit and its interactive downstream applications have garnered over 7.8k stars on GitHub https://github.com/funstory-ai/BabelDOC. A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/chwrlApH7a4.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着全球跨语言交流的日益频繁，像PDF这样包含丰富视觉内容的文档中的语言障碍仍然是一个实际难题。现有的文档翻译流程面临着语言处理与布局保留之间的矛盾：以文本为中心的计算机辅助翻译系统常常会丢弃结构元数据，而文档解析工具则侧重于内容提取，无法在翻译后实现准确的重新渲染。我们提出了BabelDOC这一基于中间表示技术的框架，它能够实现在保留布局的前提下进行PDF翻译。BabelDOC将视觉布局元数据与语义内容分离，从而可以执行文档级别的翻译操作，如术语提取、跨页面上下文处理、受词汇表约束的生成以及公式占位符的设置等。经过翻译的内容随后会通过自适应排版引擎重新定位到原始布局中。在针对200页文档的基准测试中进行的一系列实验，结合人工评估和基于多模态大语言模型的多重评估表明，BabelDOC在保持布局的精确性、视觉美观性和术语一致性方面均优于同类基准算法，同时其翻译精度也具备竞争力。该开源工具包及其交互式下游应用已在GitHub上获得了超过7.8千个星标，相关链接为https://github.com/funstory-ai/BabelDOC。演示视频可查看于https://youtu.be/chwrlApH7a4。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: JointCoder: Exploring Automated ICD Coding on Real-World Chinese EHRs with a Multi-Agent Framework
papers.title_zh: JointCoder：利用多智能体框架，探索在真实的中国电子健康记录上自动进行ICD编码的潜力
papers.authors: Kangjun Liu, Zhenyu Li, Jianlei Wang, Hongjiao Guan, Ying Lian, Guoqiang Chen, Tao Xin, Wenpeng Lu
papers.abstract: Automated ICD coding is a critical task for standardizing clinical information from electronic health records (EHRs) and supporting downstream healthcare administration.However, existing automated ICD coding systems face several fundamental challenges. First, the majority of existing research focuses on English ICD tasks, with limited attention to Chinese-language clinical contexts due to the scarcity of publicly available Chinese ICD datasets. Second, most approaches primarily target disease coding, overlooking procedure coding as well as the multi-stage workflows followed in real-world clinical practice. Moreover, many recent methods rely heavily on closed-source large language models or substantial computational resources, which limits their scalability and deployability in clinical environments.To address these gaps, this paper proposes JointCoder, which includes a real-world Chinese ICD coding dataset and a multi-agent framework that reformulates automated ICD coding as a joint disease-procedure coding task. JointCoder explicitly models real-world clinical coding workflows through stage-wise agent collaboration.All agents are instantiated using locally deployed 1.7B-parameter models, enabling scalable and privacy-preserving deployment.Extensive experiments on real-world Chinese ICD coding datasets demonstrate JointCoder’s superiority over state-of-the-art baselines across all evaluation metrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化ICD编码是标准化电子健康记录中的临床信息以及支持后续医疗管理的重要任务。然而，现有的自动化ICD编码系统面临着一些根本性的挑战。首先，目前大多数研究都集中在英语ICD编码上，由于公开可用的中文ICD数据集较少，因此对于中文临床环境的关注相对较少。其次，大多数方法主要侧重于疾病编码，而忽略了手术编码以及现实临床实践中所遵循的多阶段工作流程。此外，许多最新方法严重依赖闭源的大语言模型或大量的计算资源，这限制了它们在临床环境中的可扩展性和适用性。为了弥补这些不足，本文提出了JointCoder这一解决方案。该方案包含了一个真实世界的中文ICD编码数据集以及一个多智能体框架，将自动化ICD编码任务重新定义为疾病与手术编码的结合任务。JointCoder通过分阶段智能体的协作来模拟真实的临床编码流程。所有智能体都使用本地部署的17亿参数模型来实现，从而实现了可扩展且保护隐私的部署方式。在真实世界的中文ICD编码数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，JointCoder在各项评估指标上均优于现有的最先进基线算法。

papers.title: Hindsight: Structured Agent Memory that Retains, Recalls, and Reflects
papers.title_zh: 事后看来：一种结构化的代理记忆机制，能够存储、回忆并反思过往事件
papers.authors: Christopher Latimer, Nicolò Boschi, Andrew Neeser, Chris Bartholomew, Gaurav Srivastava, Xuan Wang, Naren Ramakrishnan
papers.abstract: We demonstrate Hindsight, a working memory system for AI agents that organizes long-term memory into four logical networks and exposes three core operations. The world, experience, observation, and opinion networks separate objective facts from subjective beliefs, giving developers visibility into what an agent knows versus what it believes. The retain, recall, and reflect operations handle ingestion, retrieval, and reasoning respectively, with a parallel pipeline that combines vector search, keyword matching, graph traversal, and temporal filtering, backed by PostgreSQL with pgvector. Unlike existing systems such as MemGPT, Zep, and Mem0, Hindsight is the only one that jointly provides fact-belief separation, temporal entity graphs, evolving opinions with confidence scores, and configurable behavioral profiles. On LongMemEval and LoCoMo, Hindsight with a 20B open-source model reaches 83.6% and 83.2% accuracy, outperforming full-context GPT-4o and all prior memory systems; with Gemini-3 Pro, LongMemEval accuracy reaches 91.4%. Our interactive demo lets users build memory graphs through multi-session conversations, inspect how memories are classified, and watch opinions form and change. The system is open-source under the MIT license, available as a Python package (pip install hindsight-all) and Docker image, with 13.3K GitHub stars and 763 forks to date, and in production use at Fortune 500 enterprises. Video demo: https://youtu.be/4M2wS-yEmVA.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Hindsight这一用于AI代理的工作记忆系统。该系统将长期记忆划分为四个逻辑网络，并提供了三种核心操作。世界网络、经验网络、观察网络和意见网络分别负责处理客观事实与主观信念，从而使开发者能够了解代理所知道的信息与所相信的信息。保留、回忆和反思操作分别负责信息的摄取、检索和推理，这些操作通过向量搜索、关键词匹配、图遍历和时间过滤等机制协同工作，其计算框架基于PostgreSQL和pgvector。与MemGPT、Zep和Mem0等现有系统不同，Hindsight是唯一一个能够同时实现事实与信念分离、时间实体图处理、带有置信度得分的演变意见生成以及可配置行为特征的系统。在LongMemEval和LoCoMo测试中，使用20B开源模型的Hindsight分别达到了83.6%和83.2%的准确率，远超全上下文GPT-4o以及所有先前的记忆系统；而在Gemini-3 Pro上，LongMemEval的准确率达到了91.4%。我们的互动演示让用户可以通过多会话对话构建记忆图谱，查看记忆是如何被分类的，以及意见是如何形成和变化的。该系统采用MIT许可证进行开源发布，可作为Python包（pip install hindsight-all）或Docker镜像使用。目前，该系统的GitHub星数已达13.3K，拥有763个分支，已被多家财富500强企业采用。视频演示链接：https://youtu.be/4M2wS-yEmVA。

papers.title: Semantic XPath: Structured Agentic Memory Access for Conversational AI
papers.title_zh: 语义XPath：用于对话式人工智能的结构化代理式内存访问机制
papers.authors: Yifan Simon Liu, Ruifan Wu, Liam Gallagher, Jiazhou Liang, Armin Toroghi, Scott Sanner
papers.abstract: Conversational AI (ConvAI) agents increasingly maintain structured memory to support long-term, task-oriented interactions. In-context memory approaches append the growing history to the model input, which scales poorly under context-window limits. RAG-based methods retrieve request-relevant information, but most assume flat memory collections and ignore structure. We propose Semantic XPath, a tree-structured memory module to access and update structured conversational memory. Semantic XPath improves performance over flat-RAG baselines by 176.7% while using only 9.1% of the tokens required by in-context memory. We also introduce SemanticXPath Chat, an end-to-end ConvAI demo system that visualizes the structured memory and query execution details. Overall, this paper demonstrates a candidate for the next generation of long-term, task-oriented ConvAI systems built on structured memory.
papers.abstract_zh: 对话式人工智能（ConvAI）代理越来越依赖结构化记忆来支持长期的、以任务为导向的互动。上下文记忆方法是将不断增长的记忆内容附加到模型输入中，但这种方法在上下文窗口限制下表现不佳。基于RAG的方法能够检索与请求相关的信息，但大多数方法都假设记忆集合是扁平的，而忽略了记忆的结构性特征。我们提出了一种名为“语义XPath”的树状结构记忆模块，用于访问和更新结构化对话记忆。与基于扁平RAG的基线方法相比，语义XPath的性能提升了176.7%，同时仅使用了与上下文记忆相同的9.1%的令牌量。我们还介绍了“语义XPath聊天”这一端到端的ConvAI演示系统，该系统可以可视化结构化记忆和查询执行细节。总体而言，本文展示了一种适用于下一代长期、以任务为导向的ConvAI系统的候选方案，该方案基于结构化记忆构建。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Graph of Trace: Visualizing Execution Traces of Scientific Agents
papers.title_zh: 执行轨迹图：可视化科学代理的执行过程
papers.authors: Tianci Gao, Haoxuan Li, Jian He Li, Tianxiang Zhao, Shi Runze, Weiran Wang, Zezhao Wu, Lu Mi
papers.abstract: Scientific AI agents can autonomously carry out complex research workflows, yet these unfolded workflows often remains difficult for humans to inspect and review, limiting interpretable, controllable and effective human–AI collaboration. To address this challenge, we present a monitoring and visualization framework that records fine-grained execution events and organizes them into a directed graph that make agent workflows explicit as they proceed. The system records intermediate steps (e.g. tool calls and code executions), and renders them as real-time updated visual traces that expose workflow structure. This allows users to examine how results are produced, identify where failures emerge, and better understand agent behavior across different stages of the research process.We conduct an evaluation on complex research tasks with domain experts of interdisciplinary background in AI, neuroscience and biology. Experts report that structured traces visualization improves understanding of agent workflows, perceived interpretability, and usability for analysis and further interaction.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学人工智能代理能够自主执行复杂的科研工作流程。然而，这些复杂的工作流程往往难以被人类观察和审查，这限制了人类与人工智能之间的可解释、可控且有效的协作。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种监控与可视化框架。该框架能够记录详细的执行事件，并将这些事件组织成有向图，从而明确代理工作流程的进展。系统会记录中间步骤（如工具调用和代码执行），并以实时更新的可视化形式呈现这些步骤，从而揭示工作流程的结构。这样，用户可以了解结果的产生过程，识别失败发生的位置，并更好地理解代理在科研过程中的不同阶段的行为。我们对具有人工智能、神经科学和生物学领域背景的专家进行了复杂的科研任务评估。专家们指出，结构化的可视化方式有助于提高对代理工作流程的理解，提升可解释性，并增强分析的实用性以及后续交互的便利性。

papers.title: ScaleBox: Enabling High-Fidelity and Scalable Code Verification for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ScaleBox：为大型语言模型提供高保真且可扩展的代码验证功能
papers.authors: Jiasheng Zheng, Xin Zheng, Boxi Cao, Pengbo Wang, Zhengzhao Ma, Qiming Zhu, Jiazhen Jiang, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Xianpei Han, Le Sun
papers.abstract: Code sandboxes have emerged as a critical infrastructure for advancing the coding capabilities of large language models, providing verifiable feedback for both RL training and evaluation. However, existing systems fail to provide accurate verification and efficiency under high-concurrency workloads. We present ScaleBox, a high-fidelity and scalable system designed to address these limitations in large-scale code training. ScaleBox introduces automated special-judge generation and management, fine-grained parallel execution across test cases with seamless multi-node coordination, and a configuration-driven evaluation suite for reproducible benchmarking. A series of experiments demonstrates that ScaleBox significantly enhances code verification accuracy and efficiency. Our further RLVR experiments show that ScaleBox substantially improves both performance on LiveCodeBench and training stability, significantly outperforming heuristic-matching baselines. By providing a reliable and high-throughput infrastructure, ScaleBox facilitates more effective research and development in large-scale code training.
papers.abstract_zh: 代码沙箱已成为提升大语言模型编码能力的关键基础设施，能够为强化学习训练和评估提供可验证的反馈。然而，现有的系统在并发工作负载下无法提供准确的验证效果和高效率。我们提出了ScaleBox这一高保真且可扩展的系统，旨在解决大规模代码训练中的这些难题。ScaleBox实现了自动化的特殊裁判生成与管理、对测试用例进行细粒度并行执行，并具备无缝的多节点协调功能，同时拥有基于配置驱动的评估套件，以实现可复现的基准测试。一系列实验表明，ScaleBox显著提升了代码验证的准确性和效率。我们的进一步强化学习验证实验也显示，ScaleBox在LiveCodeBench上的性能表现和训练稳定性都得到了显著提升，其性能远超基于启发式匹配的基线算法。通过提供可靠且高吞吐量的基础设施，ScaleBox为大规模代码训练领域的研发工作提供了有力支持。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DataArc-SynData-Toolkit: A Unified Closed-Loop Framework for Multi-Path, Multimodal, and Multilingual Data Synthesis
papers.title_zh: DataArc-SynData工具包：一种统一的闭环框架，适用于多路径、多模态以及多语言数据的整合处理
papers.authors: Zhichao Shi, Cehao Yang, Hao Zhou, Xiaojun Wu, Huajie Li, Xuhui Jiang, Chengjin Xu, Yuanzhuo Wang, Jian Guo
papers.abstract: Synthetic data has emerged as a crucial solution to the data scarcity bottleneck in large language models (LLMs), particularly for specialized domains and low-resource languages. However, the broader adoption of existing synthetic data tools is severely hindered by convoluted workflows, fragmented data standards, and limited scalability across modalities.To address these limitations, we develop DataArc-SynData-Toolkit, an open-source framework featuring: (1) a configuration-driven, end-to-end pipeline equipped with an intuitive visual interface and simplified CLI for exceptional usability; (2) a unified, quality-controllable synthesis paradigm that standardizes multi-source data generation to ensure high reusability; and (3) a highly modular architecture designed for seamless multimodal, multilingual, and multi-task adaptation.We apply the toolkit in multiple application scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that our toolkit achieves an optimal balance between generation efficiency and data quality. By offering an end-to-end and visually interactive pipeline, DataArc-SynData-Toolkit significantly lowers the technical barrier to synthetic data generation and subsequent model training, accelerating its practical deployment in real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 合成数据已成为解决大语言模型数据稀缺问题的重要方案，尤其适用于专业领域和资源匮乏的语言场景。然而，现有合成数据工具的广泛应用受到复杂工作流程、分散的数据标准以及跨模态的可扩展性限制而受到阻碍。为了克服这些限制，我们开发了DataArc-SynData工具包——一个开源框架，具有以下特点：(1) 采用配置驱动的端到端流程，拥有直观的视觉界面和简化的命令行接口，使用起来非常方便；(2) 采用统一的、可控制质量的标准化合成方法，能够标准化多源数据的生成，从而提高数据的可重复使用性；(3) 采用高度模块化的架构设计，能够实现多模态、多语言和多任务的无缝适配。我们在多个应用场景中应用了该工具包，实验结果表明，该工具包在生成效率与数据质量之间实现了最佳平衡。通过提供端到端的、可视化的操作流程，DataArc-SynData工具包显著降低了合成数据生成及后续模型训练的技术门槛，从而加快了其在实际应用中的部署速度。

papers.title: HuoziIME: An On-Device LLM-Enhanced Input Method for Deep Personalization
papers.title_zh: HuoziIME：一种基于设备内置LLM的增强式输入法，能够实现深度个性化设置
papers.authors: Baocai Shan, Yuzhuang Xu, Wanxiang Che
papers.abstract: Mobile input method editors (IMEs) are the primary interface for text input, yet they remain constrained to manual typing and struggle to produce personalized text. While lightweight large language models (LLMs) make on-device auxiliary generation feasible, enabling deeply personalized, privacy-preserving, and real-time generative IMEs poses fundamental challenges. To this end, we present HUOZIIME, a personalized on-device IME powered by LLM. We endow HUOZIIME with initial human-like prediction ability by post-training a base LLM on synthesized personalization data. Notably, a hierarchical memory mechanism is designed to continually capture and leverage user-specific input history. Furthermore, we perform systemic optimizations tailored to on-device LLM-based IME deployment, ensuring efficient and responsive operation under mobile constraints. Experiments demonstrate efficient on-device execution and high-fidelity memory-driven personalization. Code and package are available at https://github.com/Shan-HIT/HuoziIME.
papers.abstract_zh: 移动输入法编辑器是文本输入的主要界面，但它们仍然受到手动输入的限制，难以实现个性化文本的生成。虽然轻量级的大语言模型使得在设备上进行辅助生成成为可能，但实现高度个性化、保护隐私且实时的生成式移动输入法编辑器则面临着根本性的挑战。为此，我们提出了HUOZIIME——一种由大语言模型驱动的个性化移动输入法编辑器。我们通过在合成的个人化数据上训练基础大语言模型，赋予了HUOZIIME初步的类似人类的预测能力。值得注意的是，我们设计了分层记忆机制，以持续捕获并利用用户特定的输入历史信息。此外，我们还对基于大语言模型的移动输入法编辑器的部署进行了系统优化，确保在移动设备限制下的高效和响应迅速的操作。实验表明，该编辑器在设备上的运行效率很高，并且具有高度逼真的记忆驱动个性化功能。相关代码和库可以在https://github.com/Shan-HIT/HuoziIME下载。

papers.title: WIGVO: Real-Time Bidirectional Speech Translation over Legacy PSTN Calls via Dual-Session Echo Gating
papers.title_zh: WIGVO：通过双会话回声控制技术，在传统PSTN电话通话中实现实时双向语音翻译
papers.authors: Hyeong-seob Kim, Sang-Woo Son, Hyun-woo Cho, Hyeonsang Kim, Jinmo Kim
papers.abstract: Real-time speech translation with large language models (LLMs) has become feasible in controlled wideband settings—mobile apps, web browsers, and end-to-end full-duplex systems pushing latency below 200 ms—where developers can assume client-side echo cancellation. However, deploying such systems over the Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) remains challenging due to narrowband G.711 audio, unpredictable round-trip delays, and absence of client-side signal processing. We present WIGVO (WIGTN Voice-Only), a server-side relay system that enables bidirectional LLM-based speech translation over ordinary telephone calls without requiring app installation or carrier integration. A central contribution is addressing what we term echo-induced self-reinforcing translation loops: synthesized speech echoing back through the PSTN gets re-ingested and repeatedly translated. WIGVO solves this through a dual-session architecture with deterministic silence injection and energy-based voice activity detection (VAD) gating. We evaluate WIGVO on 155 Korean–English PSTN calls (148 instrumented, 147 completed) across three communication modes—voice-to-voice (V2V), text-to-voice (T2V), and full-agent—observing 555 ms median caller-to-callee latency and 2,684 ms median callee-to-caller latency, zero echo-induced translation loops, COMET semantic adequacy of 0.71 (en→ko) and 0.62 (ko→en) against offline LLM references, and USD 0.28 per minute cost. The system is deployed at https://wigvo.wigtn.com, with a video walkthrough at https://youtu.be/4Uf6zMPOInY. Evaluation scripts and anonymized call logs are available in the open-source repository.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的实时语音翻译在受控的宽带环境中已经变得可行——比如移动应用、网页浏览器以及能够实现低于200毫秒延迟的端到端全双工系统。在这些场景中，开发者可以假设客户端会进行回声消除处理。然而，由于公共交换电话网络（PSTN）采用窄带G.711音频编码方式、往返延迟难以预测，且缺乏客户端信号处理功能，因此在PSTN网络上部署此类系统仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了WIGVO（仅语音传输系统），这是一种服务器端中继系统，它能够通过普通电话通话实现基于大语言模型的双向语音翻译，而无需用户安装应用程序或与运营商进行集成。我们的创新之处在于解决了所谓的“回声引发的自我强化翻译循环”问题：通过PSTN网络传回的合成语音会被重新接收并再次进行翻译处理。WIGVO通过双会话架构来解决这个问题，同时采用了确定性静音注入技术和基于能量分析的语音活动检测技术。我们在155个韩英PSTN电话通话中测试了WIGVO的性能，其中148次通话进行了数据记录，147次通话完成。测试结果显示，呼叫者与被叫者之间的平均延迟为555毫秒，被叫者与被叫者之间的平均延迟为2,684毫秒。此外，没有出现因回声引起的翻译循环现象。与离线大语言模型参考结果相比，WIGVO的语义准确性分别为0.71（英语到韩语）和0.62（韩语到英语）。系统的成本约为每分钟0.28美元。该系统可在https://wigvo.wigtn.com获取，相关视频演示可查看https://youtu.be/4Uf6zMPOInY。评估脚本和匿名通话记录也可在开源仓库中找到。

papers.title: MASEval: Extending Multi-Agent Evaluation from Models to Systems
papers.title_zh: MASEval：将多智能体评估机制从模型层面扩展到系统层面
papers.authors: Cornelius Emde, Alexander Rubinstein, Anmol Goel, Ahmed Heakl, Sangdoo Yun, Seong Joon Oh, Martin Gubri
papers.abstract: The rapid adoption of LLM-based agentic systems has produced a rich ecosystem of frameworks (smolagents, LangGraph, AutoGen, CAMEL, LlamaIndex, i.a.). Yet many existing benchmarks are model-centric: they fix the agentic setup and do not compare other system components. We argue that implementation decisions substantially impact performance, including choices such as topology, orchestration logic, and error handling. MASEval addresses this evaluation gap with a Python library that treats the entire agentic system as the unit of analysis. Important design decisions such as harness and context engineering are first-class citizens. MASEval helps practitioners identify the best implementation for their use case and researchers systematically study agentic systems, opening new avenues for principled system design. Through the first systematic system-level comparison across 3 benchmarks, 3 models, and 3 frameworks, we find that, across models of comparable cost and capability, framework choice matters as much as model choice. MASEval is available under the MIT licence at https://github.com/maseval/MASEval.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体系统的迅速普及，催生了一个丰富的框架生态系统（如smolagents、LangGraph、AutoGen、CAMEL、LlamaIndex等）。然而，许多现有的评估基准都是以模型为中心的：它们固定了智能体的配置，而不比较其他系统组件。我们认为，实施决策对性能有着重要影响，包括拓扑结构、协调逻辑以及错误处理等方面的选择。MASEval通过一款Python库解决了这一评估上的空白问题，该库将整个智能体系统视为一个分析单元。诸如资源管理和上下文处理这样的关键设计决策在这里具有头等重要的地位。MASEval帮助从业者找到最适合其应用场景的实现方案，同时让研究人员能够系统地研究智能体系统，为系统的合理设计开辟了新的途径。通过对3个基准测试、3种模型和3种框架进行首次系统的系统级比较，我们发现，在成本和能力相当的不同模型之间，框架的选择与模型的选择同样重要。MASEval可以在https://github.com/maseval/MASEval上以MIT许可证获得。

papers.title: MASFactory: A Graph-centric Framework for Orchestrating LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems with Vibe Graphing
papers.title_zh: MASFactory：一个以图结构为核心的框架，用于调度基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，并支持图式化建模功能
papers.authors: Yang Liu, Jinxuan Cai, Yishen Li, Qi Meng, Zedi Liu, Xin Li, Chen Qian, Chuan Shi, Cheng Yang
papers.abstract: Large language model-based (LLM-based) multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly used to extend agentic problem solving via role specialization and collaboration. MAS workflows can be naturally modeled as directed computation graphs, where nodes execute agents or sub-workflows and edges encode dependencies and message passing. However, implementing complex graph workflows in current frameworks still requires substantial manual effort, offers limited reuse, and makes it difficult to integrate heterogeneous external context sources. To overcome these limitations, we present MASFactory, a graph-centric framework for orchestrating LLM-based MAS. It introduces Vibe Graphing, a human-in-the-loop approach that compiles natural-language intent into an editable workflow specification and then into an executable graph. In addition, the framework provides reusable components, skill support, multimodal message handling, and pluggable context integration, as well as a visualizer for topology preview, runtime tracing, and human-in-the-loop interaction. We evaluate MASFactory on seven public benchmarks, validating both reproduction consistency for representative MAS methods and the effectiveness of Vibe Graphing. Our code (https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/MASFactory, licensed under Apache-2.0) and video demonstration (https://youtu.be/ANynzVfY32k) are publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，越来越多地被用于通过角色专长和协作来扩展智能体的问题解决能力。多智能体系统的工作流程可以自然地被建模为有向计算图，其中节点代表智能体或子工作流程，边则编码了依赖关系和消息传递。然而，在当前框架中实现复杂的图式工作流程仍然需要大量的手动操作，且重复使用的可能性有限，同时也难以整合异构的外部上下文资源。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了MASFactory这一以图为中心的工具，用于协调基于语言模型的多个智能体系统。该工具采用了Vibe Graphing技术，这是一种人工干预的方法，它将自然语言意图编译成可编辑的工作流规范，然后再转化为可执行的图式结构。此外，该框架还提供了可复用的组件、技能支持、多模态消息处理功能以及可插拔的上下文集成机制，同时还具备拓扑预览、运行时追踪以及人工干预交互的功能。我们在七个公开基准测试上对MASFactory进行了评估，验证了其对于代表性多智能体系统的一致性再现能力，以及Vibe Graphing技术的有效性。我们的代码（https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/MASFactory，采用Apache-2.0许可协议）和视频演示（https://youtu.be/ANynzVfY32k）均可免费获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FactSearch: An Interactive Agentic Fact Search System for Verifying Large Language Model Outputs
papers.title_zh: FactSearch：一种交互式的主动事实搜索系统，用于验证大型语言模型的输出结果
papers.authors: Meng Fang, Harry Mackenzie
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate factually incorrect or unverifiable statements, motivating tool-augmented verification systems that combine model reasoning with external evidence retrieval. For factuality evaluation to be scientifically reliable, verification pipelines must be controllable and reproducible: retrieval configuration and reasoning behaviour should be explicitly configurable and stable across runs. In practice, many existing systems depend on commercial search APIs whose ranking policies and retrieval behaviours are opaque and externally controlled, introducing uncontrolled variability into evaluation. This makes it difficult to disentangle reasoning errors from retrieval effects. We present FactSearch, a reproducibility-oriented agentic fact search system for claim-level factuality verification, built on a locally aggregated open-source search infrastructure. FactSearch follows an agentic verification workflow: it decomposes model outputs into atomic factual claims, generates targeted search queries, retrieves supporting evidence via a self-hosted meta-search engine, and performs modular verification within a fully configurable pipeline. By treating retrieval infrastructure as a first-class component, the system enables systematic analysis of retrieval–reasoning interactions. An interactive web interface supports transparent inspection and practical deployment. The project is available at https://factsearch.github.io.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型经常生成事实错误或无法验证的声明，这促使人们开发了结合模型推理与外部证据检索的工具增强型验证系统。为了使事实评估具有科学可靠性，验证流程必须可控且可重现：检索配置和推理行为应能够明确配置，并在不同运行环境中保持稳定。实际上，许多现有系统依赖于商业搜索API，而这些API的排名策略与检索行为都是不透明的，并且由外部人员控制，这导致评估过程中出现不可控的变异性。这就使得很难将推理错误与检索效果区分开来。我们提出了FactSearch，这是一个以可复现性为目标的智能事实搜索系统，用于进行声明级的事实验证。该系统基于本地聚合的开源搜索基础设施构建。FactSearch采用智能验证工作流程：它将模型输出分解为独立的事实陈述，生成有针对性的搜索查询，通过自托管的元搜索引擎检索支持性证据，并在完全可配置的流程中进行模块化验证。通过将检索基础设施视为核心组件，该系统能够系统地分析检索与推理之间的相互作用。该系统的交互式网络界面支持透明化的检查和实用性的部署。该项目可以在https://factsearch.github.io获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Potato 2.0: A Comprehensive Annotation Platform with AI-in-the-Loop Support
papers.title_zh: 马铃薯2.0：一个具备人工智能实时支持的全面注释平台
papers.authors: David Jurgens, Michael Chen, Lina Iyer
papers.abstract: Annotated data remains essential for training and evaluating NLP systems. Large language models have broadened the kinds of data researchers need, including multimodal and agentic system data. Here, we introduce Potato 2.0, a major update to our open source annotation platform designed for easy deployment, customization, and fully reproducible and shareable annotation designs. Potato offers broad support for many types of annotations in NLP, including 39 different types of annotation tasks, support for text, audio, image, and video modalities, or mixtures thereof. Potato 2.0 includes robust support for labeling agentic system outputs through reading common trace formats, or live interaction and annotation with agents in multiple settings, such as chatting, web-browsing, and coding. Potato also includes multiple AI-assistance features to help annotators more easily label data. Finally, Potato introduces a new agentic AI-in-the-loop workflow where a single human annotator collaborates with an LLM through iterative prompt refinement, uncertainty-driven instance selection, and progressive autonomy—enabling efficient dataset creation without a large annotation team.
papers.abstract_zh: 注释数据对于训练和评估自然语言处理系统仍然至关重要。大语言模型扩展了研究人员所需的数据类型，包括多模态数据和智能体系统数据。在这里，我们介绍了Potato 2.0，这是我们开源标注平台的重大更新版本，该平台旨在实现便捷的部署、定制以及完全可复制和共享的标注方案。Potato为多种类型的自然语言处理标注提供了广泛支持，包括39种不同类型的标注任务，同时支持文本、音频、图像和视频等多种模态，或它们的混合形式。Potato 2.0还提供了强大的智能体系统输出标注功能，能够读取常见的跟踪格式，或者在不同场景下与智能体进行实时交互和标注，例如聊天、网页浏览和编程等。此外，Potato还包含了多种人工智能辅助功能，帮助标注人员更轻松地完成数据标注工作。最后，Potato引入了一种新的智能体AI在环工作流程，通过迭代式提示优化、基于不确定性的实例选择以及逐步提升的自主性，使得单个人类标注人员能够与大语言模型协作，从而高效地创建数据集，而无需庞大的标注团队。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: mllm-shap: A Shapley Value Explainability Platform for Text-Audio Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: mllm-shap：一种用于文本-音频多模态大型语言模型的Shapley值解释平台
papers.authors: Jakub Muszyński, Paweł Pozorski, Maria Ganzha
papers.abstract: We present mllm-shap, an open-sourcePython platform for researchers and ML practitioners that extends Shapley value (SV)explainability from text-only large languagemodels to multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) thatjointly process text and audio. Buildingon the token-level SV framework introducedby TokenSHAP, mllm-shap addresses threechallenges absent in the text-only setting:(1) modality-aware coalition masking thathandles the coexistence of text tokens anddense audio encoder frames within a single input, (2) multi-turn conversation tracking withper-token role and modality metadata, and(3) audio token grouping via phonetic alignment that reduces the coalition space by 10–50 times. The platform ships as a pip-installablepackage implementing five SV estimation strategies – including a Complementary Contributions estimator with Neyman-optimal allocation that outperforms Monte Carlo baselines – together with an interactive web GUIfor real-time attribution visualization. Toour knowledge, mllm-shap is the first publicly available framework for complete, reproducible SV-based explainability of text-audioMLLMs. The package is MIT-licensed withfull source code on GitHub and a demonstration video included as supplementary material.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了mllm-shap，这是一个开源的Python平台，专为研究人员和机器学习从业者设计。该平台将Shapley值的可解释性从仅基于文本的大语言模型扩展到了同时处理文本和音频的多模态LLM。在TokenSHAP提出的令牌级Shapley值框架的基础上，mllm-shap解决了在仅基于文本的环境中不存在的三个挑战：(1) 考虑到不同模态的联盟掩蔽技术，能够同时处理文本令牌和密集的音频编码帧；(2) 通过每个令牌的角色和模态元数据来跟踪多轮对话；(3) 通过语音对齐来实现音频令牌的分组，从而将联盟空间缩小10到50倍。该平台以pip安装包的形式提供，包含了五种Shapley值估计策略——其中包括一种采用Neyman最优分配方法的补充贡献估计器，其性能优于蒙特卡洛基线的估计方法——同时还提供了交互式网页界面，方便实时进行归因可视化分析。据我们所知，mllm-shap是首个公开可用的框架，能够为文本-音频LLM提供完整且可复现的基于Shapley值的可解释性。该软件包采用MIT许可证发布，完整的源代码可在GitHub上获取，同时附带有演示视频作为补充材料。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: PaperMentor: A Human-Centered Multi-Agent Writing Tutor for AI Research Papers in Overleaf
papers.title_zh: PaperMentor：一款以用户为中心的多智能体写作辅导工具，适用于在Overleaf平台上撰写人工智能研究论文
papers.authors: Jiarui Liu, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Ryan Faulkner, Xuanqiang Angelo Huang, Vilém Zouhar, Dominik Glandorf, Isabel Dahlgren, Rishit Dagli, Yuen Chen, Felix Leeb, Van Q. Truong, Punya Syon Pandey, Yves Bicker, Suvajit Majumder, Wenyuan Jiang, Zeju Qiu, Sankalan Pal Chowdhury, Mrinmaya Sachan, Bernhard Schölkopf, Mona T. Diab, Zhijing Jin
papers.abstract: Expert writing feedback from experienced researchers is critical for early-career scholars to improve their manuscripts, yet high-quality feedback often remains scarce because reviewing research papers is labor-intensive. Emerging AI-powered writing assistants largely focus on grammar fixes or simulating peer review with final scores, yet they fall short of providing concrete, actionable suggestions that help students improve their papers during drafting. We present PaperMentor, a human-centered writing assistant system that delivers actionable suggestions as Overleaf-native inline comments while leaving the actual writing entirely to human authors. PaperMentor integrates an expert skill library carefully curated from established researchers’ writing advice with 12 specialized agents covering different aspects of paper writing, such as formatting compliance, phrasing accuracy, and terminology consistency. In a user study (n=14), 90.6% of the generated comments were rated actionable and 67.5% were rated valid, significantly outperforming a GPT-5.2 baseline without the skill library. We release PaperMentor as open source for public use.
papers.abstract_zh: 经验丰富的研究人员提供的写作反馈对于初出茅庐的学者来说至关重要，这有助于他们改进自己的论文。然而，高质量的反馈往往难以获得，因为评审研究论文是一项耗费精力的工作。目前流行的基于人工智能的写作助手主要侧重于语法修正或模拟同行评审并给出评分，但它们无法提供具体可行的建议来帮助学生在进行论文撰写时取得进步。我们推出了PaperMentor这一以人为中心的写作助手系统，它能够以Overleaf格式的内嵌评论形式提供可行的建议，而实际的写作工作则由人类作者完成。PaperMentor整合了从知名研究人员那里精心挑选出的写作技巧库，其中包含12个专门负责不同写作方面的智能助手，比如格式合规性、措辞准确性以及术语一致性等。在一项用户研究中（样本量14人），有90.6%的生成评论被评定为具有可操作性，67.5%的评论被认为是正确的。这一表现显著优于没有该技能库的GPT-5.2基线模型。我们将PaperMentor开源，供公众使用。

papers.title: Gardener: An Agentic AI System for Single-Cell RNA Sequence Analysis
papers.title_zh: 园艺师：一种用于单细胞RNA序列分析的智能AI系统
papers.authors: Junhan Liu, Zhenke Liu, Yongcheng Shi, Peilin Yu, Minxing Zhang, Jiapeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Gardener is an interactive agentic system for single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) analysis that enables expert-steered, iterative workflows under strict data-residency requirements. Existing large language model (LLM)-based analysis agents commonly encode workflow progress as implicit conversational state and rely on cloud-centric execution, which hinders traceability and auditability and complicates keeping sensitive expression data on-device. Gardener grounds cloud-side reasoning in a local, on-device scientific engine and an Experiment Management Kernel (EMK) that externalizes analysis progress as persistent, immutable snapshots linked by lineage. This explicit state representation supports rollback, branching, and comparison of alternative analysis paths while reusing prior computation. Gardener enforces data isolation by design: cloud-hosted LLMs operate only on snapshot identifiers and sanitized summaries, while raw expression matrices and local artifacts remain on the user’s device. A local graphical user interface (GUI) provides human-in-the-loop steering and inspection of workflow state and outputs. Gardener is released as an open-source desktop application for macOS and Windows under the Apache License 2.0.
papers.abstract_zh: Gardener是一款用于单细胞RNA测序分析的交互式自动化系统，它能够在严格的数据保留要求下实现由专家指导的迭代工作流程。目前基于大语言模型的分析工具通常将工作流的进展以隐式的对话状态来编码，并且依赖于基于云端的执行方式，这导致了可追溯性和可审计性的困难，同时也使得敏感的表达数据难以保持在设备上。Gardener则将云端端的推理功能与本地设备上的科学引擎以及实验管理内核相结合，将分析进度以持久不变的快照形式进行外部化存储，这些快照通过谱系关系进行连接。这种明确的状态表示方式支持回退、分支以及比较不同的分析路径，同时还能复用之前的计算结果。Gardener从设计上就实现了数据隔离：云端的大语言模型仅能在快照标识符和经过处理的摘要上进行操作，而原始的表达矩阵以及本地产生的文件则始终保存在用户的设备上。该软件还提供了本地化的图形用户界面，方便人类用户进行流程控制和状态查看。Gardener作为开源软件，面向macOS和Windows平台发布，采用Apache许可证2.0版本进行许可。

papers.title: TokCollate: A Comprehensive Tool for Tokenizer Evaluation and Visualization across Languages
papers.title_zh: TokCollate：一种用于跨语言进行分词器评估与可视化的综合工具
papers.authors: Dušan Variš, Abishek Stephen, Jindřich Libovický
papers.abstract: Tokenization quality varies significantly across languages, contributing to disparities in LLM performance and cost for speakers of less-resourced languages – a phenomenon known as the “token premium” problem. Despite growing research interest, no existing tool provides a comprehensive intrinsic evaluation of tokenizers paired with interactive visualization. We present TokCollate (pronounced similarly to chocolate), a Python-based evaluation framework combined with a JavaScript visualization interface that addresses this gap. TokCollate implements a wide range of intrinsic metrics, including monolingual measures such as average token length and Rényi/Shannon efficiency, and cross-lingual measures such as vocabulary overlap, Jensen-Shannon divergence, alignment-based Eflomal scores, and length ratios. It further enables analysis across language groups defined by genealogical families, scripts, geographic regions, speaker populations, and estimated data availability. TokCollate is open-source under the MIT license and available on GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 不同语言的标记化质量存在显著差异，这导致了使用资源较少的语言进行大语言模型处理时，性能与成本方面的差异——这种现象被称为“标记溢价”问题。尽管相关研究日益增多，但目前仍没有工具能够提供对标记器的全面内在评估，同时还能结合交互式可视化功能进行分析。我们提出了TokCollate这一基于Python的评估框架，并配套开发了JavaScript可视化接口，旨在填补这一空白。TokCollate实现了多种内在指标，包括单语言指标，如平均标记长度、Rényi/Shannon效率；以及跨语言指标，如词汇重叠度、Jensen-Shannon散度、基于对齐的Eflomal评分、长度比率等。此外，它还能够根据谱系家族、文字系统、地理区域、语言使用者群体以及数据可用性等因素，对不同的语言群体进行分析。TokCollate采用MIT许可证开源，可在GitHub上获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A System for Dynamically Tracking Content Moderation on Reddit
papers.title_zh: 一种用于动态跟踪Reddit上内容审核状态的系统
papers.authors: George Arthur Baker, Bharadwaj Kadiyala
papers.abstract: Recent work in natural language processing, human-computer interaction, and computational social science takes interest in the study of decentralized content moderation, in which individual communities largely determine their own norms, rules, and enforcement thereof. A key challenge to this body of work is that, once moderated, content and related variables become difficult or impossible to recover; previous work often relied on 3rd-party historical data sources, but recent world events, legal disputes, and policy shifts have significantly disrupted these services, practically disabling their research use-cases. As a result, in order to conduct new research and reproduce previous results, researchers must record content as it’s created, and monitor variables of interest over time. In this paper we present and publicly release a software system for the dynamic monitoring of Reddit posts, communities, and moderation actions, to enable scalable and reproducible research on decentralized platform governance and content moderation. To the authors’ knowledge, at the time of publication this system is the only available solution for general-purpose, real-time, policy-compliant longitudinal data collection on Reddit. Furthermore, the system’s integration with the official Reddit API enables the collection of authentication-gated data such as community engagement metrics and moderation team information, which was unavailable in previous historical data sources.
papers.abstract_zh: 在自然语言处理、人机交互和计算社会科学领域的最新研究开始关注去中心化的内容审核机制。在这种机制下，各个社区能够自主决定自己的规范、规则以及相应的执行方式。然而，这一研究领域的核心挑战在于：一旦内容被审核后，相关的数据和变量就难以或无法被恢复。以往的研究通常依赖第三方的历史数据来源，但最近发生的世界事件、法律纠纷和政策变化严重破坏了这些服务，使得相关研究的实际应用变得几乎不可能。因此，为了进行新的研究并复现以往的研究成果，研究人员必须在实际创作过程中记录内容，并持续监测相关变量。在本文中，我们公开推出了一套用于动态监控Reddit上的帖子、社区以及审核行为的软件系统。这套系统能够实现针对去中心化平台治理和内容审核的可扩展且可重复性的研究。据作者所知，在出版时，这是唯一可用于实时收集Reddit上符合政策要求的纵向数据的解决方案。此外，该系统与Reddit官方API的集成还使得能够收集一些只有特定权限才能访问的数据，比如社区的参与度指标和审核团队的信息，而这些数据在以往的历史数据来源中是无法获得的。

papers.title: AI Steerability 360: A Toolkit for Steering Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: AI操控360：用于操控大型语言模型的工具包
papers.authors: Erik Miehling, Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy, Praveen Venkateswaran, Ching-Yun Ko, Pierre Dognin, Moninder Singh, Tejaswini Pedapati, Avinash Balakrishnan, Matthew Riemer, Dennis Wei, Inge Vejsbjerg, Elizabeth M. Daly, Kush R. Varshney
papers.abstract: The AI Steerability 360 toolkit is an extensible, open-source Python library for steering LLMs. Steering abstractions are designed around four model control surfaces: input (modification of the prompt), structural (modification of the model’s weights or architecture), state (modification of the model’s activations and attentions), and output (modification of the decoding or generation process). Steering methods exert control on the model through a common interface, termed a steering pipeline, which additionally allows for the composition of multiple steering methods. Comprehensive evaluation and comparison of steering methods/pipelines is facilitated by use case classes (for defining tasks) and a benchmark class (for performance comparison on a given task). The functionality provided by the toolkit significantly lowers the barrier to developing and comprehensively evaluating steering methods. The toolkit is Hugging Face native and is released under an Apache 2.0 license at https://github.com/IBM/AISteer360.
papers.abstract_zh: AI操控360工具包是一个可扩展的开源Python库，用于操控大语言模型。操控机制基于四个模型控制层面：输入层面（对提示语进行修改）、结构层面（对模型的权重或架构进行修改）、状态层面（对模型的激活函数和注意力机制进行修改）以及输出层面（对解码或生成过程进行修改）。操控方法通过一种名为“操控流水线”的通用接口来控制系统，同时还能将多种操控方法组合使用。通过使用案例类（用于定义任务）和基准测试类（用于比较特定任务的性能），可以方便地评估与对比不同的操控方法或流水线。该工具包提供的功能显著降低了开发和评估操控方法的难度。该工具包是Hugging Face官方开发的，采用Apache 2.0许可证发布，网址为https://github.com/IBM/AISteer360。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Media-to-Insights: A Multi-Agent AI System for Continuous Media Monitoring, Analysis, and Reporting
papers.title_zh: 从媒体中获取洞察：一种用于持续监控、分析并生成报告的多智能体人工智能系统
papers.authors: Ashraf Hatim Elneima, Ozan Yilmaz, Hadi Nasrallah, Sanjika Hewavitharana, Mohamed Al-Badrashiny, Hassan Sawaf
papers.abstract: Continuous monitoring of high-volume media streams requires systems that go beyond keyword alerts to deliver structured, actionable intelligence. We present a multi-agent media monitoring system that processes streaming articles through three stages: (1) a Matching Agent that uses a hybrid keyword-then-semantic matching approach, reducing agent invocations by 2̃0% (2) a batched multi-agent feature extraction, reducing core feature-extraction calls from 7 to 2 per article - a 71% reduction - with bounded quality tradeoffs; and (3) a Report Generation Agent that uses deterministic deduplication and density-based clustering. Four autonomous life-cycle agents manage the evolution of watchers.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于大量媒体流的持续监控，需要一种能够超越关键词警报的系统，以提供结构化、可操作的情报。我们提出了一种多智能体媒体监控系统，该系统通过三个阶段来处理流式文章：(1) 匹配代理采用混合关键词-语义匹配方法，将代理的调用次数减少了20%；(2) 批量处理的多智能体特征提取功能，将每篇文章的特征提取调用次数从7次减少到2次，减少了71%——但与此同时，质量有所降低；(3) 报告生成代理采用确定性去重和基于密度的聚类技术。四个自主生命周期代理负责管理监控器的运行方式。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LinkNav: Surfacing Interconnected Information in Scientific Articles
papers.title_zh: LinkNav：在科学论文中呈现相互关联的信息
papers.authors: Sebastian Antony Joseph, Jennifer Healey, Junyi Jessy Li, Ani Nenkova
papers.abstract: We present LinkNav, an enhanced experience for reading academic papers which makes explicit connections between related but non-adjacent passages. To create the experience, we instruct a language model to generate questions that may arise while reading a passage and then search for answer-bearing passages elsewhere in the document, forming intra-document connections when answers are found. We confirm that these building blocks work well to power the experience, with an answer detection pipeline that works with high precision, resulting in a reasonable number of such connections being made for a document. On a dataset of academic papers, we find that connected segments are on average ten segments away from each other, making explicit connections that a reader may have otherwise missed.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了LinkNav，这是一种增强型学术论文阅读体验工具，它能够明确连接那些相关但看似不相关的段落。为了打造这一体验，我们让语言模型生成在阅读过程中可能出现的问题，然后搜索文档中其他包含答案的段落，当找到答案时，就形成文档内部的连接。我们确认这些基础机制能够很好地支持这一体验，其答案检测流程具有高精度，因此对于一篇文档而言，能够建立相当数量的此类连接。在学术论文数据集上，我们发现，被连接的段落平均相距十个段落左右，这使得读者能够发现原本可能忽略的明确联系。

papers.title: FourCorners: Grounded Thai Legal Research over a Temporal Knowledge Graph
papers.title_zh: 四角点：基于时间知识图谱的泰国法律研究
papers.authors: Pawitsapak Akarajaradwong, Thitiwat Nopparatbundit, Treephop Saeteng, Kasidit Phoncharoen, Sarana Nutanong, Chompakorn Chaksangchaichot
papers.abstract: Legal practitioners in Thailand must navigate fragmented government websites to research over 3,800 active laws and 87,000 Supreme Court decisions, with no unified tool for cross-referencing, version tracking, or structural navigation. We present FourCorners, a deployed platform that addresses five practitioner pain points through three modules built on a temporal legal knowledge graph covering 552K nodes and 6.3M edges: (1) an AI legal assistant that performs grounded generation via structured graph retrieval, streaming verified source content inline with responses; (2) an interactive law reader that translates graph structure into navigation and comparison features; and (3) a court decision explorer with version-aware citations produced by temporal entity resolution across 87,394 rulings. The system discovers implicit cross-corpus relationships through co-citation analysis of Supreme Court decisions. Interviews with 20 legal professionals reveal that inline source verification fundamentally changes how practitioners interact with AI-generated legal content, and that cross-corpus enrichment surfaces legal relationships that existing tools leave invisible.
papers.abstract_zh: 在泰国，法律从业者必须浏览分散的政府网站，以研究超过3,800项现行法律和87,000项最高法院的判决。目前没有统一的工具来进行交叉引用、版本跟踪或结构导航。我们推出了FourCorners平台，该平台通过三个模块解决了法律从业者的五个问题。这三个模块基于一个包含55.2万个节点和630万个边的法律知识图谱构建：(1) 一种人工智能法律助手，能够通过结构化图检索来执行生成式内容生成，并实时将经过验证的源内容与回复相结合；(2) 一种交互式法律阅读器，能够将图结构转化为导航和比较功能；(3) 一种法院判决浏览器，能够通过对87,394项判决进行时间性实体解析，生成带有版本信息的引用。该系统通过最高法院判决的共引分析，发现隐式的跨文本关系。与20位法律专业人士的访谈表明，实时源内容验证从根本上改变了法律从业者与人工智能生成的法律内容的交互方式，而跨文本丰富化则揭示了现有工具未能发现的法律关系。

papers.title: rosaOS: Agentic Operating System for Embodied LLMs
papers.title_zh: rosaOS：适用于实体化大型语言模型的操作系统
papers.authors: Yijun Ge, Kushaldeep Mujral, Karthik Nambiar, Jimmy Lin
papers.abstract: We present rosaOS, an open-source agentic operating system for embodied LLMs: interactive, LLM-driven agents coordinate various software tools and physical devices through a desktop companion, the Reachy Mini robot. Existing LLM–robotic systems are generally built as a tight, intertwined stack, making it difficult to switch hardware, add extra capabilities, or expand to multiple devices without bespoke integration. Our system aims to provide a classic OS-inspired architecture where an agentic kernel manages all task execution and mediates device access, while process agents invoke tools to perform actions. We adopt industry-standard interfaces with MCP for agentic tool-calling and ROS for robot interactions, and demonstrate rosaOS on a multi-device setup including a quadruped robot, a wheeled mobile robot, and a smart lamp, all controlled through interactions with the Reachy Mini. By incorporating MCP extensibility with ROS hardware interoperability, rosaOS enables a plug-and-play ecosystem for building embodied agentic systems. Our OS is available at rosaos.ai.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了rosaOS，这是一个开源的代理式操作系统，专为实体型大语言模型设计。该操作系统中的交互式、由大语言模型驱动的代理可以通过桌面伴侣Reachy Mini机器人来协调各种软件工具和物理设备。现有的大语言模型与机器人系统通常都是紧密集成在一起的，因此在不进行专门集成的情况下，很难更换硬件、添加额外功能或扩展到多个设备上。我们的系统旨在提供一种经典的、受操作系统启发的架构：代理核心负责管理所有任务执行和调解设备访问，而进程代理则负责调用工具来执行各种操作。我们采用了行业标准接口，其中MCP用于代理工具的调用，ROS则用于机器人之间的交互。我们已经在包含四足机器人、轮式移动机器人以及智能灯等多台设备的环境中测试了rosaOS的功能，所有这些设备都可以通过与Reachy Mini的互动来控制。通过结合MCP的可扩展性与ROS的硬件互操作性，rosaOS能够形成一个即插即用的生态系统，从而帮助构建实体型代理式系统。我们的操作系统可以在rosaos.ai网站上获取。
