papers.title: CritiSense: Critical Digital Literacy and Resilience Against Misinformation
papers.title_zh: CritiSense：批判性数字素养与抵御虚假信息的能力
papers.authors: Firoj Alam, Fatema Ahmad, Ali Ezzat Shahroor, Mohamed Bayan Kmainasi, Elisa Sartori, Giovanni Da San Martino, Abul Hasnat, Raian Ali
papers.abstract: Misinformation on social media undermines informed decision-making and public trust. Prebunking offers a proactive complement by helping users recognize manipulation tactics before they encounter them in the wild. We present CritiSense, a mobile media-literacy app that builds these skills through short, interactive challenges with instant feedback. It is the first multilingual (supporting nine languages) and modular platform, designed for rapid updates across topics and domains. We report a usability study with 93 users: 83.9% expressed overall satisfaction and 90.1% rated the app as easy to use. Qualitative feedback indicates that CritiSense helps improve digital literacy skills. Overall, it provides a multilingual prebunking platform and a testbed for measuring the impact of microlearning on misinformation resilience. Over 6 months, we have reached 500+ active users. It is freely available on the Apple App Store and Google [Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.critisense hl=en).
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体上的错误信息会破坏人们做出明智决策的能力，并损害公众的信任。Prebunking则通过帮助用户识别各种操纵手段来提供积极的补充作用。我们推出了CritiSense这款移动媒体素养应用，它通过简短的互动式挑战来培养用户的这些技能，并且能立即获得反馈。这是首个多语言（支持九种语言）且模块化平台，旨在快速更新不同主题和领域的知识。我们对93名用户进行了可用性研究：83.9%的用户表示非常满意，90.1%的用户认为该应用易于使用。定性反馈表明，CritiSense有助于提升数字素养能力。总体而言，它提供了一个多语言的预训练平台，同时也是衡量微学习对应对错误信息能力影响的试验场。在6个月的时间里，我们已经吸引了500多名活跃用户。该应用可在Apple App Store和Google [Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.critisense hl=en)上免费下载。

papers.title: MED-COPILOT: A Medical Assistant Powered by GraphRAG and Similar Patient Case Retrieval
papers.title_zh: MED-副驾驶：由GraphRAG技术驱动的医疗助理，能够高效检索患者病例信息
papers.authors: Shuheng Chen, Namratha Patil, Haonan Pan, Angel Hsing-Chi Hwang, Yao Du, Ruishan Liu, Jieyu Zhao
papers.abstract: Clinical decision-making requires synthesizing heterogeneous evidence, including patient histories, clinical guidelines, and trajectories of comparable cases. While large language models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities, they remain prone to hallucinations and struggle to integrate long, structured medical documents. We present MED-COPILOT, an interactive research prototype for evidence-aware clinical reasoning, designed to help clinicians and medical trainees inspect guideline-level and patient-level evidence. MED-COPILOT combines guideline-grounded GraphRAG retrieval with hybrid semantic-keyword similar-patient retrieval to support transparent and evidence-aware clinical reasoning. The system builds a structured knowledge graph from WHO and NICE guidelines, applies community-level summarization for efficient retrieval, and maintains a 36,000-case similar-patient database derived from SOAP-normalized MIMIC-IV notes and Synthea-generated records.We evaluate our framework on clinical note completion and medical question answering, and demonstrate that it consistently outperforms parametric LLM baselines and standard RAG, improving generation fidelity and benchmark QA accuracy. The full system is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/shuhengc/MED-COPILOT, enabling users to inspect retrieved evidence, visualize token-level similarity contributions, and conduct guided follow-up analysis. Our results suggest a practical and interpretable approach to integrating structured guideline knowledge with patient-level analogical evidence for clinical LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 临床决策需要综合各种证据，包括患者病史、临床指南以及类似病例的数据。虽然大语言模型具备强大的推理能力，但它们仍容易产生幻觉，且难以处理长篇幅、结构化的医学文档。我们提出了MED-COPILOT这一交互式研究原型，旨在帮助医生和医学生检查指南级别和患者级别的证据。MED-COPILOT结合了基于指南的GraphRAG检索方式，以及混合语义关键词和相似患者数据检索方式，从而实现透明且基于证据的临床推理。该系统从世界卫生组织和英国国家健康研究所的指南中构建出结构化知识图谱，采用社区级摘要技术来提高检索效率，并维护着一个包含36,000例患者的相似患者数据库，该数据库来源于S SOAP标准化的MIMIC-IV记录以及Synthea生成的记录。我们在临床笔记补全和医疗问题回答方面对这套系统进行了评估，结果表明其性能始终优于参数化的语言模型和标准的RAG方法，提升了生成准确性和基准测试的成绩。完整的系统可以在https://huggingface.co/spaces/shuhengc/MED-COPILOT获取，用户可以通过该系统查看检索到的证据，可视化令牌级别的相似性贡献，并进行有针对性的后续分析。我们的研究结果表明，这是一种实用且可解释的方法，可以将结构化指南知识与患者级别的类比证据相结合，用于临床语言模型的应用。

papers.title: PathBuilder: A Quality-Controlled LLM System for Personalized Learning Pathways
papers.title_zh: PathBuilder：一种用于个性化学习路径的高质量控制型大语言系统
papers.authors: Jasper Meynard Arana, John Andrew Mañacop, John Allen Manacop, Roy Andrew Garcia, Keith Rick Piniera, Kristine Ann M. Carandang, Ethan Robert Casin, Christian Alis, Christopher Monterola
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable scalable content generation for personalized learning, but reliability and pedagogical alignment remain open challenges. We present PathBuilder, a web-based system that integrates expert-validated assessment, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and an LLM-as-a-Judge validation loop within a closed instructional pipeline. The system uses a 17,758-item curriculum-aligned question bank, including 1,018 expert-approved LLM-generated items, to construct diagnostic and post-tests for fine-grained learner profiling. In a real-world deployment with 179 registered users (75 matched learners), PathBuilder achieved a mean absolute gain of 37.9 percentage points, Hake’s normalized gain of 0.760, and a large effect size (Cohen’s d = 0.98). A controlled study of the judge mechanism showed consistent high-quality instructional outputs with a 100% threshold pass rate. These results demonstrate that structured curriculum alignment combined with retrieval grounding and automated validation can support reliable LLM-based personalization in deployed learning systems. A live demonstration of PathBuilder is available at https://demo.pathbuilderedu.com.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够实现可扩展的内容生成，从而为个性化学习提供支持。然而，模型的可靠性和教学相关性仍然是一个亟待解决的挑战。我们提出了PathBuilder这一基于网络的系统，该系统将专家验证的评估方法、基于检索增强的生成技术以及以语言模型作为评判者的验证机制整合在一个封闭的教学流程中。该系统使用了一个包含17,758个项目的题库，其中1,018个项目是由语言模型生成的，这些项目经过专家审核。该系统能够利用这些项目来构建诊断性测试以及用于精细分析学习者情况的测试。在真实环境中的部署实验中，有179名注册用户参与测试（其中75名为匹配的学习者），PathBuilder的平均绝对增益达到了37.9个百分点，Hake的标准化增益为0.760，效应量也相当大（Cohen's d = 0.98）。对评判机制的对照研究表明，该系统能够持续提供高质量的教学结果，其通过率达到了100%。这些结果表明，结合结构化课程设计、检索增强技术以及自动化验证机制，可以确保在部署中的学习系统中实现可靠的基于语言模型的个性化教学。目前，可以在https://demo.pathbuilderedu.com网站上查看PathBuilder的实时演示效果。

papers.title: AutoChecklist: Composable Pipelines for Checklist Generation and Scoring with LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.title_zh: 自动检查清单：利用大型语言模型作为评判器，实现检查清单的生成与评分
papers.authors: Karen Zhou, Chenhao Tan
papers.abstract: Checklists have emerged as a popular approach for interpretable and fine-grained evaluation, particularly with LLM-as-a-Judge. Beyond evaluation, these structured criteria can serve as signals for model alignment, reinforcement learning, and self-correction. To support these use cases, we present AutoChecklist, an open-source library that unifies checklist-based evaluation into composable pipelines. At its core is a taxonomy of five checklist generation abstractions, each encoding a distinct strategy for deriving evaluation criteria. A modular \textit{Generator $\rightarrow$ Refiner $\rightarrow$ Scorer} pipeline connects any generator with a unified scorer, and new configurations can be registered via prompt templates alone. The library ships with ten built-in pipelines implementing published approaches and supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, OpenRouter, vLLM). Beyond the Python API, the library includes a CLI for off-the-shelf evaluation and a web interface for interactive exploration. Validation experiments confirm that these checklist methods significantly align with human preferences and quality ratings, and a case study on ICLR peer review rebuttals demonstrates flexible domain adaptation. AutoChecklist is publicly available at https://github.com/ChicagoHAI/AutoChecklist.
papers.abstract_zh: 清单工具已成为一种受欢迎的、用于可解释性和细粒度评估的方法，尤其是在使用大语言模型作为评判者的情况下。除了评估功能外，这些结构化的标准还可以作为模型对齐、强化学习以及自我修正的依据。为了支持这些应用场景，我们开发了AutoChecklist这个开源库，它将基于清单的评估方式整合到可组合的流程中。该库的核心是一个包含五种清单生成抽象方法的分类体系，每种方法都对应着不同的评估标准推导策略。一个模块化的“生成器→细化器→评分器”流程能够将任何生成器与统一的评分器相连，而且新的配置可以通过提示模板轻松注册。该库提供了十种内置流程，实现了已发布的方法，并支持多种大语言模型提供商（如OpenAI、OpenRouter、vLLM）。除了Python接口之外，该库还包含用于离线评估的命令行工具和用于交互式探索的网页界面。验证实验表明，这些清单方法与人类偏好和质量评价高度一致。在ICLR同行评审反驳案例研究中的表现也证明了其灵活的领域适应性。AutoChecklist可以在https://github.com/ChicagoHAI/AutoChecklist上免费获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: JobMatchAI - An Intelligent Job Matching Platform Using Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Search and Explainable AI
papers.title_zh: JobMatchAI——一个利用知识图谱、语义搜索和可解释人工智能技术的智能职业匹配平台
papers.authors: Mayank Vyas, Abhijit Chakraborty, Vivek Gupta
papers.abstract: Recruiters and job seekers rely on search systems to navigate labor markets, making candidate matching engines critical for hiring outcomes. Most systems act as keyword filters, failing to handle skill synonyms and nonlinear careers, resulting in missed candidates and opaque match scores. We introduce JobMatchAI, a production-ready system integrating Transformer embeddings, skill knowledge graphs, and interpretable reranking. Our system optimizes utility across skill fit, experience, location, salary, and company preferences, providing factor-wise explanations through resume-driven search workflows. We release JobSearch-XS benchmark and a hybrid retrieval stack combining BM25, knowledge graph and semantic components to evaluate skill generalization. We assess system performance on JobSearch-XS across retrieval tasks, provide a demo video, a hosted website and installable package.
papers.abstract_zh: 招聘人员和求职者都依赖搜索系统来在劳动力市场中寻找合适的人选。因此，候选者匹配引擎对于招聘效果至关重要。大多数系统只是使用关键词过滤器，无法处理技能的同义词和非线性的职业路径，这会导致错过合适的候选人，同时匹配分数也不透明。我们推出了JobMatchAI系统，这是一个已准备好投入使用的系统，它结合了Transformer嵌入、技能知识图谱以及可解释的重新排序算法。我们的系统能够优化在技能适配、经验、地理位置、薪资和公司偏好等方面的表现，并通过基于简历的搜索流程，为用户提供详细的解释。我们还发布了JobSearch-XS基准测试，以及一个结合BM25、知识图谱和语义组件的混合检索堆栈，以评估技能的泛化能力。我们在JobSearch-XS上进行了多项检索任务的性能评估，并提供了演示视频、托管网站以及可安装的软件包。

papers.title: Qayyem: A Real-time Platform for Scoring Proficiency of Arabic Essays
papers.title_zh: 卡耶姆：一个用于实时评估阿拉伯语作文水平的平台
papers.authors: Hoor Tamer Elbahnasawi, Marwan Sayed, Sohaila Eltanbouly, Fatima Zahra Brahamia, Tamer Elsayed
papers.abstract: Over the past years, Automated Essay Scoring (AES) systems have gained increasing attention as scalable and consistent solutions for assessing proficiency of student writing. Despite recent progress, support for Arabic AES remains limited due to linguistic complexity and scarcity of large publicly-available annotated datasets. In this work, we present Qayyem, a Web-based platform designed to support Arabic AES by providing an integrated workflow for assignment creation, batch essay upload, scoring configuration, and per-trait essay evaluation. Qayyem abstracts the technical complexity of interacting with scoring server APIs, allowing instructors to access advanced scoring services through a user-friendly interface. The platform deploys a number of state-of-the-art Arabic essay scoring models with different effectiveness and efficiency figures.
papers.abstract_zh: 在过去的几年里，自动作文评分系统作为评估学生写作能力的一种可扩展且一致的解决方案，受到了越来越多的关注。尽管最近取得了一些进展，但由于语言的复杂性以及公开可用的标注数据集的稀缺性，阿拉伯语自动作文评分系统的支持仍然有限。在这项研究中，我们提出了Qayyem这一基于网络的平台，该平台旨在为阿拉伯语自动作文评分提供支持，通过提供完整的作业创建、批量上传作文、评分配置以及针对各个方面的作文评估等功能，来简化这一过程。Qayyem消除了与评分服务器API交互的技术复杂性，使得教师可以通过一个用户友好的界面来使用先进的评分功能。该平台采用了多种先进的阿拉伯语作文评分模型，这些模型在效果和效率方面都表现出色。

papers.title: PhyVer: Physics-Grounded Material Claim Verification with Multi-Fidelity Physical Evidence
papers.title_zh: 物理验证：基于物理原理的材料索赔确认方法，结合多层次物理证据
papers.authors: Jianpeng Chen, Wangzhi Zhan, Haohui Wang, Brian Mayer, Dongqi Fu, Dawei Zhou
papers.abstract: Material claims in papers, patents, etc., often involve physical feasibility (e.g., stability under conditions, property consistency), not just textual feasibility. Yet most claim verifiers operate over language, therefore producing ungrounded judgments. On the other hand, directfirst-principles verification (e.g., density functional theory, DFT) is inflexible and hard to invoke from underspecified free-form claims.Therefore, we introduce PhyVer, a physics-grounded material claim verification system that bridges this gap by translating claimsinto multi-fidelity physical evidence and interpretable verdicts. To support human-in-the-loop inspection, we present an interactive web interface that visualizes the instantiated structure, optimization trajectories, DFT summaries, and the final decision. On expert-labeled claims, PhyVer improves agreement with experts over text-only GPT-5.1, reducing MAE from 1.54 to 1.20 and Signed MAE from0.95 to 0.82, and increasing Accuracy@±1 from 50% to 70%.
papers.abstract_zh: 在论文、专利等文件中提出的材料权利要求，往往涉及物理上的可行性（例如，在特定条件下的稳定性、性质的一致性），而不仅仅是文本层面的可行性。然而，大多数权利要求的验证工作都是基于文本的，因此会产生没有根据的判断。另一方面，直接基于第一性原理的验证方法（例如密度泛函理论DFT）则缺乏灵活性，难以适用于描述不明确的自由形式权利要求。因此，我们提出了PhyVer这一基于物理原理的材料权利要求验证系统，该系统通过将权利要求转化为多尺度的物理证据和可解释的判决结果，来填补这一空白。为了支持人工审核流程，我们还提供了一个交互式的网络界面，可以可视化所构建的结构、优化轨迹、DFT计算结果以及最终的判决结果。在由专家标记的权利要求上，PhyVer与仅基于文本的GPT-5.1相比，其准确性得到了提升：平均绝对误差从1.54降到了1.20，签名平均绝对误差从0.95降到了0.82，而精度水平从50%提升到了70%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: pAtChWoRK: Patching the Pieces of Public Procurement Documents
papers.title_zh: 处理公共采购文件中的各种问题：对公共采购文件中的各个部分进行整理和修复
papers.authors: Lorena Calvo-Bartolomé, Saúl Blanco Fortes, Erick Cedeño, Jerónimo Arenas-García
papers.abstract: Public procurement data is legally open, yet practically locked inside thousands of unstructured PDFs and inconsistent portal metadata. pAtChWoRK starts with these fragmented, unstructured sources then leverages a hybrid pipeline (traditional NLP with LLM-based technologies) to restructure this information into a navigable knowledge base. Specifically, pAtChWoRK corrects manual classification errors, extracts complex unstructured fields such as award and solvency criteria and tenders’ objectives, and assists users in easily navigating the tender landscape. This unified process enables more effective handling of the transparency bottlenecks that hinder competition and oversight in public administration. A user study with practitioners across different procurement
papers.abstract_zh: 公共采购数据在法律上是可以公开的，但实际上却隐藏在成千上万的非结构化PDF文件中，且门户的元数据也并不一致。pAtChWoRK从这些分散、非结构化的数据源开始工作，然后利用混合处理流程（结合传统自然语言处理技术和基于大语言模型的先进技术）将这些信息重新整理成易于导航的知识库。具体来说，pAtChWoRK能够纠正手动分类中的错误，提取复杂的非结构化字段，如奖项标准、偿付能力要求以及招标目标等，并帮助用户更轻松地理解招标相关的内容。这一统一的处理流程有助于有效解决那些阻碍公共行政领域竞争和监管效率的问题。我们对不同领域的采购从业者进行了用户研究……

papers.title: UltraEval-Audio: A Unified Framework for Comprehensive Evaluation of Audio Foundation Models
papers.title_zh: UltraEval-Audio：一种用于全面评估音频基础模型的统一框架
papers.authors: Qundong Shi, Jie Zhou, Biyuan Lin, Junbo Cui, Guoyang Zeng, Yixuan Zhou, Ziyang Wang, Xin Liu, Zhen Luo, Yudong Wang, Zhiyuan Liu
papers.abstract: The development of audio foundation models has accelerated rapidly since the emergence of GPT-4o. However, the lack of comprehensive evaluation has become a critical bottleneck for further progress in the field, particularly in audio generation. Current audio evaluation faces three major challenges: (1) audio evaluation lacks a unified framework, with datasets and code scattered across various sources;(2) audio codec, as a key component of audio foundation models, lacks a widely accepted and holistic evaluation methodology; (3) existing speech benchmarks are heavily reliant on English, making it challenging to objectively assess models’ performance on Chinese.We introduce UltraEval-Audio, a unified framework addressing these challenges through a modular architecture supporting 10 languages, 14 task categories, 24 models, and 36 benchmarks with one-command evaluation and real-time leaderboards. For audio codec, we propose a three-dimensional evaluation scheme covering semantic accuracy, timbre fidelity, and acoustic quality. For Chinese evaluation, we introduce two new benchmarks: SpeechCMMLU and SpeechHSK. Our code, benchmarks, and leaderboards are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/UltraEval-Audio.
papers.abstract_zh: 自从GPT-4o出现以来，音频基础模型的发展速度迅速加快。然而，缺乏全面的评估体系已成为该领域进一步发展的关键瓶颈，尤其是在音频生成方面。当前音频评估面临三大挑战：(1) 音频评估缺乏统一的框架，各种数据集和代码分散在不同的来源中；(2) 作为音频基础模型的关键组成部分，音频编解码器缺乏被广泛接受的整体评估方法；(3) 现有的语音评估基准大多基于英语，这使得客观评估模型在中文上的性能变得困难。我们提出了UltraEval-Audio这一统一框架，它通过模块化架构来解决这些问题，支持10种语言、14个任务类别、24种模型和36个评估基准，并且可以通过一条命令完成评估并实时获取排行榜。对于音频编解码器，我们提出了一种三维评估方案，包括语义准确性、音色保真度和声学质量等方面。在中文评估方面，我们引入了两个新的评估基准：SpeechCMMLU和SpeechHSK。我们的代码、评估基准和排行榜可以在https://github.com/OpenBMB/UltraEval-Audio下载。

papers.title: Paper2Web: Let’s Make Your Paper Alive!
papers.title_zh: Paper2Web：让您的论文更加生动有趣！
papers.authors: Yuhang Chen, Tianpeng Lv, Yao Wan, Philip S. Yu, Dongping Chen
papers.abstract: Academic project websites can more effectively disseminate research when they clearly present core content and enable intuitive navigation and interaction. However, current approaches such as direct Large Language Model (LLM) generation, templates, or direct HTML conversion struggle to produce layout-aware, interactive sites, and a comprehensive evaluation suite for this task has been lacking. In this paper, we introduce Paper2Web, a benchmark dataset and multi-dimensional evaluation framework for assessing academic webpage generation. It incorporates rule-based metrics like Connectivity, Completeness and human-verified LLM-as-a-Judge (covering interactivity, aesthetics, and informativeness), and PaperQuiz, which measures paper-level knowledge retention. We further present PWAgent, an autonomous pipeline that converts scientific papers into interactive and multimedia-rich academic homepages. The agent iteratively refines both content and layout through MCP tools that enhance emphasis, balance, and presentation quality. Our experiments show that PWAgent consistently outperforms end-to-end baselines like template-based webpages and arXiv/alphaXiv versions by a large margin while maintaining low cost, achieving the Pareto-front in academic webpage generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 学术项目网站在清晰呈现核心内容并具备直观的导航和交互功能时，能够更有效地传播研究成果。然而，目前常用的方法，如直接利用大语言模型进行生成、使用模板或直接转换为HTML格式等方式，往往难以打造出具有布局意识且交互性强的网站。针对这一任务，目前还缺乏一套全面的评估体系。在本文中，我们介绍了Paper2Web——一个用于评估学术网页生成的基准数据集和多维度评估框架。该框架包含了基于规则的评估指标，如连通性、完整性，以及由人类验证的语言模型进行的交互性、美观性和信息含量的评估。此外，我们还引入了PaperQuiz，用于衡量用户对论文知识的掌握程度。我们还开发了一种名为PWAgent的自主化工具，可以将科学论文转化为具有交互性和多媒体内容的学术主页。该工具通过MCP工具不断优化内容和布局，从而提升重点突出度、平衡性和展示质量。我们的实验表明，PWAgent在保持低成本的同时，始终能大幅超越基于模板的网页以及arXiv/alphaXiv版本的同类产品，从而在学术网页生成领域取得了显著的成果。

papers.title: OxyGent: Making Multi-Agent Systems Modular, Observable, and Evolvable via Oxy Abstraction
papers.title_zh: OxyGent：通过Oxy抽象技术，使多智能体系统具有模块化、可观测性以及可进化特性
papers.authors: Junxing Hu, Tianlong Li, Lei Yu, Ai Han
papers.abstract: Deploying production-ready multi-agent systems (MAS) in complex industrial environments remains challenging due to limitations in scalability, observability, and autonomous evolution. We present OxyGent, an open-source framework driven by two core novelties: a unified Oxy abstraction and the OxyBank evolution engine. The unified abstraction encapsulates agents, tools, LLMs, and reasoning flows as pluggable atomic components, enabling Lego-like scalable system composition and non-intrusive monitoring. To enhance observability, OxyGent introduces permission-driven dynamic planning that replaces rigid workflows with execution graphs generated at runtime, providing adaptive visualizations. Furthermore, to support continuous evolution, OxyBank serves as an AI asset management platform that drives automated data backflow, annotation, and joint evolution. Empirical evaluations and real-world case studies show that OxyGent provides a robust and scalable foundation for MAS. OxyGent is fully open-sourced under the Apache License 2.0 at https://github.com/jd-opensource/OxyGent.
papers.abstract_zh: 在复杂的工业环境中部署适用于生产的多智能体系统（MAS）仍然具有挑战性，因为这些系统面临着可扩展性、可观测性和自主进化的限制。我们提出了OxyGent这一开源框架，该框架基于两个核心创新点：统一的Oxy抽象机制以及OxyBank进化引擎。这种统一的抽象机制将智能体、工具、大语言模型以及推理流程封装为可插拔的原子组件，从而实现类似乐高的可扩展系统组合方式，同时还能实现非侵入式的监控。为了提升可观测性，OxyGent引入了基于权限的动态规划机制，用运行时生成的执行图替代僵化的工作流程，从而提供自适应化的可视化效果。此外，为了支持持续的进化过程，OxyBank还充当了一个AI资产管理平台，能够自动进行数据回流、注释处理以及系统的联合进化。实证评估和实际案例研究表明，OxyGent为MAS提供了强大且可扩展的基础架构。目前，OxyGent已完全开源，遵循Apache License 2.0协议，相关代码可在https://github.com/jd-opensource/OxyGent下载。

papers.title: EduCoder: An Open-Source Annotation System for Education Transcript Data
papers.title_zh: EduCoder：一个用于教育转录数据处理的开源标注系统
papers.authors: Saad Ashraf, Jim Malamut, Vishal Kumar, Guanzhong Pan, HyunJi Nam, Mei Tan, Lucía Langlois, Liliana Carolina Santos-Deonizio, Helen Spencer Higgins, Dorottya Demszky
papers.abstract: We present EduCoder, an open-source web platform designed for annotating classroom conversation transcripts. Existing annotation tools do not support the team-based workflows or access to instructional context that education discourse research requires. EduCoder addresses these gaps by combining transcript text, synchronized video, and instructional materials within a single workspace. The platform supports scoping annotation to specific portions of a lesson, coordinating work across annotation teams, and optionally integrating LLM-generated annotations with structured human–LLM comparison. EduCoder is freely accessible at https://edu-coder.com.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了EduCoder，这是一个开源的Web平台，旨在用于注释课堂对话记录。现有的注释工具无法支持基于团队的工作流程，也无法提供教育话语研究所需的教学背景信息。EduCoder通过在一个工作空间中整合文本、同步视频和教学材料来弥补这些不足。该平台支持对课程特定部分进行注释，协调不同注释团队的工作，并可选地与大语言模型生成的注释进行结构化的人机对比。EduCoder可以在https://edu-coder.com上免费使用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CPTCoder: A Reliable LLM System for Medical Procedure Code Prediction
papers.title_zh: CPTCoder：一种可靠的LLM系统，用于预测医疗操作相关的代码
papers.authors: Benlu Wang, Ziyao Shangguan, Kyle Tegtmeyer, Zhenyu Zhang, Sophie Chheang, Arman Cohan
papers.abstract: We present CPTCoder, a human-in-the-loop system that predicts standardized medical procedure codes from clinical text. Clinical procedure coding is an extreme multi-label classification problem over a long-tailed space of short numeric identifiers, where a single-digit difference denotes an entirely different procedure. CPTCoder adapts an instruction-tuned LLM with a code-aware vocabulary and constrained decoding that guarantees all outputs are valid codes. To support human review, we derive per-code posterior inclusion probabilities from n-best reweighting, producing interpretable confidence scores that rank predictions and flag uncertain cases. A post-decoding constraint repair step enforces mutual-exclusion rules between conflicting codes. To enable reproducible research in this underexplored setting, we release MIMIC-CPT, a PhysioNet-accessible benchmark of 37,885 expert-cleaned report–code pairs with a deliberately hardened test split: 88% of test examples contain label combinations unseen during training, and over a third include codes with five or fewer training occurrences. We additionally provide 413,085 weakly aligned pairs and evaluate on a separate live dataset from a hospital, which includes out-of-domain radiology reports with billing-expert-verified labels. CPTCoder achieves 0.61 and 0.51 micro-F1 on the hardened MIMIC split and Hospital-298 respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 12 and 5 absolute points while reducing digit-level near-miss errors.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了CPTCoder这一人工干预系统，它能够从临床文本中预测标准化的医疗程序代码。临床程序编码是一个极端的多标签分类问题，涉及大量的短数字标识符，其中单个数字的差异就代表着完全不同的程序。CPTCoder利用经过指令优化的大语言模型，该模型拥有针对代码的词汇表，并且具有约束性的解码机制，确保所有输出都是有效的代码。为了支持人类审核，我们通过选择最优解的方式计算出每个代码的后验包含概率，从而生成可解释的置信度分数，对预测结果进行排序，并标记出不确定的情况。解码后的约束修复步骤则确保了冲突代码之间的互斥性。为了在这个尚未充分探索的领域实现可复制的研究，我们发布了MIMIC-CPT这一基于PhysioNet的基准测试，该测试包含了37,885对经过专家筛选后的报告与代码对。这些测试样本中有88%包含训练期间未见过的标签组合，超过三分之一的样本包含的代码在训练过程中出现的次数不超过五个。我们还提供了413,085对弱对齐的数据对，并在另一家医院的真实数据集上进行了评估，这些数据集包括带有账单专家验证标签的放射学报告。在硬化后的MIMIC分割集和Hospital-298数据集上，CPTCoder分别取得了0.61和0.51微F1值，比最强的基线模型高出12和5个绝对点，同时减少了数字级的错误率。

papers.title: ParseJargon: Personalized Real-time Jargon Support in Online Meetings
papers.title_zh: ParseJargon：在线会议中的个性化实时术语支持服务
papers.authors: Yifan Song, Wing Yee Au, Hon Yung Wong, Brian Bailey, Tal August
papers.abstract: Effective interdisciplinary communication is frequently hindered by domain-specific terms. These terms, or jargon, are dependent on a listener’s background, and rarely do listeners seek explanations due to distraction and social concerns. To address these concerns, we built ParseJargon, an interactive LLM-powered system providing real-time personalized jargon support tailored to users’ individual backgrounds in online meetings. We first evaluated the effectiveness of personalization in a controlled setting with human participants. By comparing ParseJargon against baseline (no support) and general-purpose (non-personalized) conditions, we found that ParseJargon provided more precise jargon identification, and enhanced participants’ comprehension, engagement, and appreciation of colleagues’ work. We then evaluated the potential for using ParseJargon in real-time meetings through a latency test.
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的跨学科沟通往往受到特定领域术语的阻碍。这些术语或行话取决于听者的背景，而由于注意力分散和社会因素，听者很少会寻求解释。为了解决这些问题，我们开发了ParseJargon——一个由大语言模型驱动的交互式系统，能够在在线会议中为用户提供实时、个性化的术语支持，以符合用户的个人背景。我们首先在有人参与的控制环境中评估了个性化功能的有效性。通过将ParseJargon与无支持状态以及通用型（非个性化）条件进行比较，我们发现ParseJargon能够更准确地识别术语，并提升了参与者对同事工作的理解、参与度以及欣赏程度。随后，我们通过延迟测试评估了在实时会议中使用ParseJargon的可能性。

papers.title: The olmOCR Project: Building Fully Open OCR using VLMs
papers.title_zh: olmOCR项目：利用视觉语言模型构建完全开源的文字识别工具
papers.authors: Jake Poznanski, Kyle Lo, Luca Soldaini
papers.abstract: We present olmOCR, a fully open OCR system developed through iterative public releases and community feedback. The system combines a 7B vision-language model trained in two stages: supervised finetuning on 260K diverse PDF pages, followed by reinforcement learning with visual unit tests over synthetic documents. Visual unit tests are binary checks of structural fidelity, including tables and equations, and serve both as an interpretable evaluation framework and as direct optimization targets. We also introduce olmOCR-Bench, a benchmark of 1.4K challenging PDFs evaluated via visual unit tests, on which olmOCR achieves state-of-the-art performance among open systems and proprietary APIs at a fraction of the cost. We have deployed olmOCR at scale to 100M+ PDFs to curate pretraining data for Olmo 3. We share lessons from our open development process and release all models, data, and code across two major releases.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了olmOCR，这是一个完全开源的OCR系统。该系统通过多次公开发布和社区反馈来不断完善。该系统的视觉语言模型由7B参数组成，经过两个阶段训练：首先在26万份不同的PDF页面上进行监督式微调，然后通过对合成文档进行视觉单元测试来进行强化学习。视觉单元测试是对结构准确性的二进制检查，包括表格和方程式等元素，它们既可以作为可解释的评估框架，也可以作为直接优化的目标。我们还推出了olmOCR-Bench，这是一个包含1.4万份具有挑战性的PDF文件的基准测试，这些文件都经过了视觉单元测试。在olmOCR的测试中，它在开源系统和专有API中取得了最先进的性能，而且成本却更低。我们已经大规模部署了olmOCR，处理了超过1亿份PDF文件，为Olmo 3的预训练数据收集工作做出了贡献。我们分享了开源开发过程中的经验，并在两次主要版本中发布了所有模型、数据和代码。

papers.title: AiraXiv: An AI-Driven Open-Access Platform for Human and AI Scientists
papers.title_zh: AiraXiv：一个由人工智能驱动的开源平台，为人类科学家和AI科学家提供支持
papers.authors: Junshu Pan, Panzhong Lu, Yixuan Weng, QiYao Sun, Fang Guo, Zijie Yang, Qiji Zhou, Yue Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have accelerated the growth of both human-authored and AI-generated research outputs, placing increasing strain on traditional academic publishing systems and challenging the scalability of conference- and journal-centered paradigms amid rising submission volumes, reviewer workload, and venue size. To address these challenges, we explore an AI-era publishing paradigm in which both human and AI scientists participate as authors and readers, and papers evolve through continuous, feedback-driven iteration. We propose AiraXiv, an AI-driven open-access platform built on open preprints, AI-augmented analysis and review, and reader feedback. AiraXiv supports human scientists through an interactive UI and AI scientists through Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based interactions. We validate AiraXiv through real-world deployments, including serving as the submission platform for ICAIS 2025, demonstrating its potential as a fast, inclusive, and scalable research infrastructure for the AI era. AiraXiv is publicly available at https://airaxiv.com.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能领域的最新进展加速了人类撰写和人工智能生成的研究成果的增长，这给传统的学术出版系统带来了巨大压力。在提交论文的数量不断增加、审稿人工作量增大以及会议和期刊的规模不断扩大的情况下，以会议和期刊为中心的出版模式面临着可扩展性的挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种人工智能时代的出版模式：人类科学家和人工智能科学家都可以作为作者和读者参与进来，论文通过持续的反馈迭代来不断完善。我们开发了AiraXiv这一基于人工智能的开放获取平台，该平台采用开放的预印本形式，结合人工智能辅助的分析与评审机制，以及读者的反馈功能。AiraXiv通过交互式用户界面为人类科学家提供支持，同时通过基于模型上下文协议的互动方式为人工智能科学家提供帮助。我们通过实际部署来验证AiraXiv的有效性，包括将其作为ICAIS 2025的提交平台使用，从而证明了它作为人工智能时代快速、包容且可扩展的研究基础设施的潜力。AiraXiv的官方网站为https://airaxiv.com。

papers.title: TruthSplit: Operationalizing Conditional Validity in Arguments Through Multi-Perspective Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 真理分割：通过多视角推理实现论证中的条件有效性
papers.authors: Benjamin Stieger, Maximilian Terberger, Thomas Huber, Christina Niklaus
papers.abstract: We present TruthSplit, an interactive system for multi-perspective argument analysis. Existing argumentation tools typically analyze properties of the argument itself, such as structure, quality, stance, or persuasiveness, while leaving perspective-specific background knowledge implicit. TruthSplit addresses this gap by supporting an exploratory analysis of how the same claim can lead to different conclusions when interpreted through worldview-specific values, assumptions, and conceptual definitions. We refer to this perspective-dependent analysis as conditional validity.Given an input argumentative text, TruthSplit extracts claims and premises, applies a three-layer natural language inference (NLI) approach to assess both logical and worldview-specific normative consistency, and conditions large language model (LLM) reasoning on structured worldview profiles that encode core values and decision principles. The system then generates perspective-specific interpretations, identifies value conflicts and assumption gaps, and visualizes divergence through interactive analytical interfaces.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了TruthSplit，这是一个用于多视角论证分析的互动系统。现有的论证工具通常只分析论证本身的属性，如结构、质量、立场或说服力，而忽略了特定视角的背景知识。TruthSplit通过支持对同一主张在不同世界观下的解读结果进行分析来弥补这一不足。这种基于视角的分析被称为“条件有效性”。在输入一个论证文本后，TruthSplit会提取其中的主张和前提，采用三层自然语言推理方法来评估逻辑上的一致性以及世界观特定的规范性一致性。同时，该系统还会将大语言模型的推理基于结构化世界观模型进行限制，这些模型包含了核心价值观和决策原则。最后，系统会生成特定视角的解释，识别价值冲突和假设漏洞，并通过交互式分析界面可视化出不同的观点差异。

papers.title: TONY: an open-source TOolkit for Nlp in psYchology
papers.title_zh: TONY：一款用于心理学领域自然语言处理的开源工具包
papers.authors: Federico Ravenda, Sofia Irene Ravenda, Volodymyr Karpenko, Daniele Montagnani, Andrea Raballo, Antonietta Mira
papers.abstract: The growing demand for Mental Health (MH) services highlights the need for scalable computational tools, yet progress in computational psychology is hindered by scarce sensitive data, complex assessment procedures, and high technical barriers. While language is a well-established marker of different MH conditions, existing NLP solutions are often fragmented, closed-source, or difficult to use, limiting their adoption in interdisciplinary research.We present TONY, an open-source, python TOolkit for NLP in clinical psYchology. TONY bridges traditional psycholinguistic analysis and modern NLP by combining interpretable lexical features with state-of-the-art lightweight transformer models within a unified and easy-to-use framework. This hybrid approach enables robust and transparent text analysis without relying on large-scale models or closed-source software.TONY is designed for researchers and practitioners working at the intersection of NLP and MH, facilitating collaboration across disciplines. Compared to the few existing systems, TONY offers a more comprehensive and exhaustive solution, reducing the barrier to entry through a unified, modular, and reproducible pipeline that integrates classical and neural approaches in a single open framework. The toolkit is released under an open-source license and is evaluated through multiple MH–related datasets, demonstrating its flexibility and effectiveness in low-resource settings
papers.abstract_zh: 对心理健康服务的需求不断增加，这凸显了开发可扩展计算工具的必要性。然而，计算心理学的进展受到敏感数据稀缺、评估流程复杂以及技术门槛高等因素的制约。虽然语言是区分不同心理健康状况的重要标志，但现有的自然语言处理解决方案往往存在碎片化、依赖闭源代码或难以使用等问题，这些因素限制了它们在跨学科研究中的应用。我们提出了TONY，这是一个开源的Python工具包，用于临床心理学中的自然语言处理工作。TONY通过将可解释的词汇特征与最先进的轻量级Transformer模型相结合，在一个统一且易于使用的框架内实现了传统心理语言学分析与现代自然语言处理的融合。这种混合方法使得文本分析能够在不依赖大规模模型或闭源软件的情况下实现稳健且透明的结果。TONY专为从事自然语言处理与心理健康交叉领域的研究人员和从业者设计，有助于促进跨学科的协作。与现有的少数系统相比，TONY提供了更为全面和详尽的解决方案，通过统一的、模块化的、可复用的流程，将传统方法和神经方法整合到同一个开放框架中，从而降低了进入该领域的门槛。该工具包采用开源许可证发布，并通过多个与心理健康相关的数据集进行了评估，证明了其在资源有限环境下的灵活性和有效性。

papers.title: Formally Specifying the Intended Behavior of the Program: LLM-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Program Specification Synthesis
papers.title_zh: 正式指定程序的预期行为：由大语言模型驱动的神经符号程序规范合成方法
papers.authors: Cheng Wen, Hu Junjie, YiKun Hu, Jie Su, Bin Yu, Dugang Liu, Zhiwu Xu, Weidi Sun, Shengchao Qin, Cong Tian
papers.abstract: Formal verification can provide strong mathematical guarantees about software correctness, but it typically requires developers to write detailed formal specifications (e.g., contracts and loop invariants), which is costly and error-prone. We introduce AutoSpec+, an LLM-driven neuro-symbolic demonstration system that reframes specification writing as constrained structured synthesis: large language models generate candidate specifications at the granularity of proof-relevant program components, while a symbolic verifier acts as a deterministic critic that checks legality, satisfiability, and proof adequacy, rejecting or repairing candidates in an iterative loop. This design turns unconstrained text generation into constrained structured synthesis, substantially reducing hallucinations and producing proof-ready annotations. We evaluate AutoSpec+ on seven benchmark suites, showing strong effectiveness. We release an open-source, Dockerized system with ensemble LLM backends and inter-modular verification support for reproducible demonstration and deployment
papers.abstract_zh: 形式化验证能够为软件的正确性提供强有力的数学保证，但通常需要开发者编写详细的形式化规范（例如契约和循环不变量），这一过程既耗时又容易出错。我们提出了AutoSpec+这一由大语言模型驱动的神经符号演示系统，它将规范的编写重新定义为约束性结构化合成：大语言模型以与证明相关的程序组件粒度生成候选规范，而符号验证器则充当确定性评估者，负责检查规范的法律性、可满足性以及证明的完备性，对不符合要求的候选规范进行拒绝或修正。这种设计将无约束的文本生成转化为约束性结构化合成，显著减少了幻觉现象，并生成了可用于证明的注释。我们在七个基准测试集上对AutoSpec+进行了评估，结果显示其具有强大的有效性。我们还发布了一种开源的Docker化系统，该系统配备了集成式语言模型后端以及模块间验证功能，方便进行可复制的演示和部署。

papers.title: AnnoHID: LLM-Assisted Annotation Framework for Low-Resource Medical Texts
papers.title_zh: AnnoHID：一种适用于低资源医学文本的LLM辅助注释框架
papers.authors: Annisa Maulida Ningtyas, Guntur Budi Herwanto, Yunita Sari, Rifki Afina Putri, Filip Kovacevic, Alaa El-Ebshihy, Varvara Arzt, Florina Piroi
papers.abstract: This paper introduces AnnoHID, a semi-automated annotation framework designed for medical texts in low-resource languages. The system integrates large language models (LLMs) for pre-annotation and human validation to support efficient and consistent annotation. We demonstrate its application to Bahasa Indonesia medical social media texts from Alodokter, a medical Q A platform, for Named Entity Recognition (NER) and Medical Concept Normalization (MCN). We conducted a user study with 21 participants to demonstrate the effectiveness of AnnoHID. The results show that LLM-assisted annotation yields higher inter-annotator agreement for both NER (\kappa = 0.76) and MCN (\kappa = 0.63) and that human review improves raw LLM NER output, raising the F1 score from 0.39 to 0.45. However, LLM assistance did not reduce annotation time and may introduce normalization bias in MCN. The framework is multilingual, human-in-the-loop, and interoperable with standard medical terminologies, such as SNOMED-CT. Future work focuses on mitigating pre-annotation bias, reducing annotation overhead, and scaling evaluations to larger datasets and additional low-resource languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了AnnoHID，这是一个专为低资源语言医学文本设计的半自动化注释框架。该系统整合了大语言模型进行预注释工作，并结合人工验证以确保注释的效率和一致性。我们将其应用于Alodokter平台提供的印尼语医学社交媒体文本，对命名实体识别（NER）和医学概念规范化（MCN）进行了处理。我们对21名参与者进行了用户研究，以验证AnnoHID的有效性。结果表明，借助语言模型的注释方式在命名实体识别（κ=0.76）和医学概念规范化（κ=0.63）方面能提升注释者之间的一致性；而人工审核则能够改善基于语言模型的原始NER结果，使F1分数从0.39提升到0.45。不过，语言模型的辅助功能并未减少注释时间，且可能在医学概念规范化过程中引入标准化偏差。该框架具有多语言支持、人工干预机制，并且能够与标准医学术语如SNOMED-CT进行互操作。未来的研究将重点在于减轻预注释过程中的偏差问题、减少注释工作量，以及将评估扩展到更大的数据集和更多的低资源语言上。

papers.title: RECAP: An End-to-End Platform for Capturing, Replaying, and Analyzing AI-Assisted Programming Interactions
papers.title_zh: 总结：这是一个端到端的平台，能够捕捉、重新播放并分析由人工智能辅助进行的编程交互过程
papers.authors: Keyu He, Qianou Ma, Valerie Chen, Wayne Chi, Tongshuang Wu
papers.abstract: Understanding how developers interact with AI coding assistants requires more than chat logs or git histories in isolation; it requires reconstructing the full context: which prompt led to which edit, what the developer tried and discarded, and how their strategy evolved over time. We present RECAP (Replay and Examine Captured AI Programming), an open-source platform that (1) passively records AI chat sessions and fine-grained code edits inside VS Code without disrupting the developer’s workflow, (2) merges them into a unified timeline for interactive session replay, and (3) exposes an extensible analysis layer, with example modules for behavioral classification and AI reliance measurement. Deployed in a university software engineering course, RECAP captured 2,034 prompts and 8,239 code edits from 41 students across a multi-week project. We demonstrate how the platform’s linked data and replay capabilities enable analyses of developer-AI interaction patterns that no single data source could support.
papers.abstract_zh: 要理解开发者如何与AI编程助手进行交互，仅仅依靠聊天记录或代码历史是不够的。我们需要重建完整的上下文：哪些提示导致了哪些代码修改，开发者尝试了哪些方案并放弃了哪些方案，以及他们的策略是如何随着时间而变化的。我们提出了RECAP（重现与分析捕获的AI编程过程）这一开源平台。该平台能够（1）在不打断开发者工作流程的情况下，被动记录VS Code中的AI对话会话和详细的代码修改；（2）将这些记录合并成一个统一的时间线，以便进行交互式回放；（3）提供一个可扩展的分析层，包含用于行为分类和AI依赖度测量的示例模块。该平台被应用于一所大学的软件工程课程中，在为期多周的项目中，共记录了41名学生提出的2,034条提示和8,239次代码修改。我们展示了该平台的关联数据和回放功能如何使得对开发者与AI交互模式的分析成为可能，而这些分析是单一数据源无法实现的。

papers.title: A Dynamic Self-Evolving Extraction System
papers.title_zh: 一种动态自进化救援系统
papers.authors: Moin Aminnaseri, Hannah Kim, Estevam Hruschka
papers.abstract: The extraction of structured information from raw text is a fundamental component of many NLP applications, including document retrieval, ranking, and relevance estimation. High-quality extractions often require domain-specific accuracy, up-to-date understanding of specialized taxonomies, and the ability to incorporate emerging jargon and rare outliers. In many domains–such as medical, legal, and HR–the extraction model must also adapt to shifting terminology and benefit from explicit reasoning over structured knowledge. We propose DySECT, a Dynamic Self-Evolving Extraction and Curation Toolkit, which continually improves as it is used. The system incrementally populates a versatile, self-expanding knowledge base (KB) with triples extracted by the LLM. The KB further enriches itself through the integration of probabilistic knowledge and graph-based reasoning, gradually accumulating domain concepts and relationships. The enriched KB then feeds back into the LLM extractor via prompt tuning, sampling of relevant few-shot examples, or fine-tuning using KB-derived synthetic data. As a result, the system forms a symbiotic closed-loop cycle in which extraction continuously improves knowledge, and knowledge continuously improves extraction.
papers.abstract_zh: 从原始文本中提取结构化信息是许多自然语言处理应用的基本组成部分，包括文档检索、排序和相关性估计。高质量的提取通常需要特定领域的准确性、对专业分类法的最新理解，以及能够融入新兴术语和罕见异常值的能力。在许多领域——如医学、法律和人力资源领域——提取模型还必须适应不断变化的术语，并能够从结构化知识中受益。我们提出了DySECT，一个动态自进化的提取与整理工具包。该系统在使用过程中不断改进。系统逐步通过LLM提取的三元组来填充一个多功能、自我扩展的知识库。该知识库还通过整合概率知识和基于图的推理来进一步丰富自己，逐渐积累领域概念和关系。然后，这个丰富后的知识库通过提示调整、采样相关的小样本示例或使用知识库生成的合成数据进行微调，反馈到LLM提取器中。因此，该系统形成了一个共生性的闭环循环：提取不断改善知识，而知识又不断促进提取能力的提升。

papers.title: ThinkBooster: A Unified Framework for Seamless Test-Time Scaling of LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ThinkBooster：一种用于实现大型语言模型推理功能在测试过程中无缝扩展的统一框架
papers.authors: Vladislav Smirnov, Quang-Chieu Nguyen, Sergey Senichev, Minh Ngoc Ta, Ekaterina Fadeeva, Artem Vazhentsev, Daria Galimzianova, Nikolai Rozanov, Viktor Mazanov, Jingwei Ni, Tianyi Wu, Igor Kiselev, Mrinmaya Sachan, Iryna Gurevych, Preslav Nakov, Timothy Baldwin, Artem Shelmanov
papers.abstract: Test-time compute (TTC) scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning by allocating additional compute during inference, e.g., via multi-sample generation and verifier-based reranking. Existing TTC scaling strategies and reasoning scorers remain fragmented, evaluated under inconsistent protocols, and are rarely analyzed through the lens of quality-cost trade-offs. We introduce ThinkBooster, a unified framework for seamless test-time compute scaling of LLM reasoning, which consists of (i) a modular Python library implementing state-of-the-art TTC scaling strategy and scorer families, (ii) a benchmark that jointly evaluates performance and computational efficiency, and (iii) a deployable OpenAI-compatible proxy service that enables drop-in integration of adaptive reasoning into real-world applications. We further provide a demo visual debugger for inspecting the reasoning trajectories, intermediate selection decisions, and alternative reasoning paths. Empirical results on mathematical and coding tasks reveal the performance-compute trade-offs of TTC scaling strategies and scoring methods and demonstrate that ThinkBooster provides practical gains in real-world tasks. The code is available online under an MIT license.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时计算（TTC）扩展技术已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的有效手段。通过在推理过程中分配额外的计算资源，例如通过多样本生成和基于验证器的重新排序，可以显著提高模型的推理能力。然而，现有的TTC扩展策略和推理评估方法仍然较为分散，且评估标准不统一，很少从质量与成本之间的权衡角度进行分析。我们提出了ThinkBooster这一统一的框架，用于无缝实现大语言模型推理的测试时计算扩展。该框架包括：(i) 一个模块化的Python库，实现了最先进的TTC扩展策略和评估方法；(ii) 一个能够同时评估性能和计算效率的基准测试工具；(iii) 一个可部署的OpenAI兼容代理服务，使得自适应推理功能能够轻松集成到实际应用中。我们还提供了可视化调试工具，用于查看推理过程、中间选择决策以及不同的推理路径。在数学和编程任务上的实验结果表明，TTC扩展策略和评估方法在性能与计算资源消耗之间取得了良好的平衡。此外，ThinkBooster在实际任务中也能带来显著的性能提升。该代码的代码库已以MIT许可证的形式在线提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FinReporting: An Agentic Workflow for Localized Reporting of Cross-Jurisdiction Financial Disclosure
papers.title_zh: FinReporting：一种用于跨司法管辖区财务信息披露的自动化工作流程工具
papers.authors: Fan Zhang, Mingzi Song, Rania Elbadry, Yankai Chen, Shaobo Wang, Yixi Zhou, Xunwen Zheng, Yueru He, Yuyang Dai, Georgi Nenkov Georgiev, Ayesha Gull, Muhammad Usman Safder, Fan Wu, Liyuan Meng, Fengxian Ji, Junning Zhao, Xueqing Peng, Jimin Huang, YU Chen, Xue Liu, Preslav Nakov, Zhuohan Xie
papers.abstract: Financial reporting systems increasingly leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract and summarize corporate disclosures. However, most existing approaches assume a single-market setting and overlook structural differences across jurisdictions. Variations in accounting taxonomies, tagging infrastructures (e.g., XBRL vs. PDF), and aggregation conventions introduce substantial challenges for semantic alignment and reliable verification. Here, we aim to bridge this gap. We present FinReporting, an agentic workflow for localized cross-jurisdiction financial reporting. The system constructs a unified canonical ontology spanning the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement, and decomposes reporting into auditable stages, including filing acquisition, extraction, canonical mapping, and anomaly logging. Rather than treating LLMs as free-form generators, FinReporting employs them as constrained verifiers operating under explicit decision rules with evidence grounding.Evaluated on annual filings from the USA, Japan, and China, FinReporting improves consistency and reliability under heterogeneous reporting regimes. We further release an interactive demo that enables cross-market inspection and supports structured export of localized financial statements. Our demo is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/BoomQ/FinReporting-Demo. A video describing our system is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f65jdEL31Kk.
papers.abstract_zh: 财务报告系统越来越多地利用大语言模型来提取和总结企业披露信息。然而，大多数现有方法都假设市场环境是统一的，而忽略了不同司法管辖区之间的结构差异。会计分类体系、标记基础设施（例如XBRL与PDF）以及汇总惯例的差异，给语义对齐和可靠验证带来了巨大挑战。为此，我们提出了FinReporting这一用于跨司法管辖区本地化财务报告的自动化工作流程。该系统构建了一个统一的规范本体，涵盖损益表、资产负债表和现金流量表，并将报告过程分解为可审核的环节，包括文件提交、数据提取、规范映射以及异常记录等步骤。FinReporting并非将语言模型视为自由形式的生成器，而是将其作为受约束的验证工具，在明确的决策规则下运行，并基于证据进行验证。我们在美国、日本和中国年度报告中进行了测试，发现FinReporting能够在不同的报告环境下提高一致性和可靠性。我们还提供了一个交互式演示版，可以跨市场进行比对，并支持结构化导出本地化财务报表。我们的演示版本可以在https://huggingface.co/spaces/BoomQ/FinReporting-Demo查看。关于我们系统的视频可以在https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f65jdEL31Kk观看。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Expert Calibration Lens for Pruning Mixture of Experts
papers.title_zh: 用于集成专家系统的专家校准透镜
papers.authors: Luis Frentzen Salim, Chia-Chun Wu, Tran Van Nhiem, Lun-Wei Ku, Yung-Hui Li
papers.abstract: Expert pruning is a practical deployment technique for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. It reduces resource usage and mitigates expert redundancy, but its success depends strongly on the calibration set used for pruning. In domain-general settings, it is unclear which properties of the calibration data drive good pruning outcomes, and the effects of calibration perturbations are often unintuitive. We observe, for example, that calibration sets in different languages can lead to very similar pruning results despite appearing dissimilar on the surface.To address this, we propose Expert Calibration Lens, a lightweight analysis tool that compares expert activation patterns across datasets to predict the impact of calibration perturbations without repeatedly running expensive pruning procedures. We use activations that are quick to compute and evaluate the resulting analysis for downstream task performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家修剪是一种适用于混合专家模型的实际部署技术。它能够减少资源消耗并避免专家之间的冗余问题，但其效果在很大程度上取决于用于修剪的校准数据集。在领域通用的情况下，目前尚不清楚校准数据的哪些特性能够带来良好的修剪效果，而且校准数据的扰动所带来的影响往往并不直观。例如，我们发现，不同语言下的校准数据集即使表面上看似不同，但所得到的修剪结果却非常相似。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了“专家校准透镜”这一轻量级分析工具。该工具通过比较不同数据集中的专家激活模式，来预测校准数据扰动的影响，而无需反复执行复杂的修剪操作。我们使用易于计算的激活方式，并评估由此产生的分析结果对下游任务性能的影响。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Ryze: Evidence-Enriched Data Synthesis from Biomedical Papers
papers.title_zh: 瑞泽：从生物医学论文中提炼出更有价值的数据信息
papers.authors: Yeqi Huang, Yue Chen, Yanwei Ye, Guanhao Su, Luo Mai
papers.abstract: General-purpose VLMs remain unreliable for biomedical research because valid answers in scientific papers depend on evidence split across figures, tables, charts, captions, and referring text.Existing post-training pipelines are bottlenecked by costly expert annotation and by synthetic data that drops this evidence structure.We present Ryze, a fully automated system that converts raw biomedical papers into an evidence-enriched training set and a domain-specialized VLM.Ryze synthesizes QA pairs with complete supporting evidence (visual element, caption, extracted structure, and referring paragraphs), reduces layout and OCR errors via chart/table-aware extraction and LLM-based cleansing, and applies a two-stage post-training strategy combining supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning.Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B, Ryze produces BioVLM-8B at under $200, achieving 48.0% weighted accuracy on LAB-Bench—outperforming the base model by +12.6% and surpassing GPT-5.2 by +3.8%.We release Ryze as open source together with the trained BioVLM-8B model.
papers.abstract_zh: 通用型视觉语言模型在生物医学研究中仍然不可靠，因为科学论文中的有效答案依赖于分布在图表、表格、标题和参考文本中的各种证据。现有的后训练流程受到昂贵的专家注释工作以及破坏这些证据结构的合成数据的限制。我们提出了Ryze系统，它是一个完全自动化的系统，能够将原始生物医学论文转换为富含证据的训练集以及针对特定领域的视觉语言模型。Ryze能够生成带有完整支持性证据的问答对（包括视觉元素、标题、提取出的结构和相关段落），通过基于图表的提取和大语言模型的清洗功能来减少布局和OCR错误，并采用两阶段训练后策略，结合监督式微调与强化学习。以Qwen3-VL-8B为基础，Ryze能够生成BioVLM-8B模型，其成本低于200美元，在LAB-Bench测试上的加权准确率达到了48.0%，比基础模型提升了12.6%，并且超过了GPT-5.2模型3.8%。我们将Ryze以及训练好的BioVLM-8B模型以开源方式提供给大家。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Agentic CLEAR: Automating Multi-Level Evaluation of LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 主动式CLEAR：自动化多层次LLM智能体评估机制
papers.authors: Asaf Yehudai, Lilach Eden, Michal Shmueli-Scheuer
papers.abstract: Agentic systems are becoming more capable: agents define strategies, take actions, and interact with different environments. This autonomy poses serious challenges for overseeing and assessing agent behavior. Most current tools are limited, focusing on observability with basic evaluation or creating a static taxonomy of agent errors. To address this gap, we present Agentic CLEAR, an automatic, dynamic, and easy-to-use evaluation framework. It produces textual insights into the agent behavior on three levels of granularity: system, trace, and node. Agentic CLEAR operates above the observability layer, enabling seamless integration and featuring an intuitive UI that makes agent evaluation highly accessible. In our experiments on four benchmarks, seven agentic settings, and tens of thousands of LLM calls, we show that Agentic CLEAR produces high-quality, data-driven, insightful feedback. Our analysis shows strong alignment with human-annotated errors and the ability to predict task success rate.
papers.abstract_zh: 智能体系统正变得越来越强大：智能体能够定义策略、执行行动，并与各种环境进行交互。这种自主性给监控和评估智能体行为带来了严峻的挑战。目前大多数工具都存在局限性，它们主要关注可观测性，提供基本的评估功能，或者只能创建静态的智能体错误分类体系。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了Agentic CLEAR——一个自动化、动态且易于使用的评估框架。该框架能够在系统级、轨迹级和节点级三个粒度层次上生成关于智能体行为的文本化洞察。Agentic CLEAR在可观测性层之上运行，能够实现无缝集成，并且拥有直观的用户界面，使得智能体评估变得非常容易操作。在我们的实验中，我们针对四个基准测试、七种智能体配置以及数万次大语言模型调用进行了测试，结果表明Agentic CLEAR能够产生高质量、数据驱动的、具有洞察力的反馈。我们的分析显示，Agentic CLEAR与人类标注的错误情况高度一致，并且能够预测任务的成功率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FD-NL2SQL: Feedback-Driven Clinical NL2SQL that Improves with Use
papers.title_zh: FD-NL2SQL：基于反馈的临床NL2SQL转换工具，随着使用次数的增加而逐渐改进
papers.authors: Suparno Roy Chowdhury, Tejas Anvekar, Manan Roy Choudhury, Muhammad Ali Khan, Kaneez Zahra Rubab Khakwani, M Bassam Sonbol, Irbaz Bin Riaz, Vivek Gupta
papers.abstract: Clinicians exploring oncology trial repositories often need ad-hoc, multi-constraint queries over biomarkers, endpoints, interventions, and time, yet writing SQL requires schema expertise. We demo FD-NL2SQL, a feedback-driven clinical NL2SQL assistant for SQLite-based oncology databases. Given a natural-language question, a schema-aware LLM decomposes it into predicate-level sub-questions, retrieves semantically similar expert-verified NL2SQL exemplars via sentence embeddings, and synthesizes executable SQL conditioned on the decomposition, retrieved exemplars, and schema, with post-processing validity checks. To improve with use, FD-NL2SQL incorporates two update signals: (i) clinician edits of generated SQL are approved and added to the exemplar bank; and (ii) lightweight logic-based SQL augmentation applies a single atomic mutation (e.g., operator or column change), retaining variants only if they return non-empty results. A second LLM generates the corresponding natural-language question and predicate decomposition for accepted variants, automatically expanding the exemplar bank without additional annotation. The demo interface exposes decomposition, retrieval, synthesis, and execution results to support interactive refinement and continuous improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 从事肿瘤学试验数据库研究的临床医生经常需要针对生物标志物、终点、干预措施和时间等维度进行特定条件下的多约束查询。然而，编写SQL需要专业的模式知识。我们开发了FD-NL2SQL这一基于反馈的Clinical NL2SQL辅助工具，适用于基于SQLite的肿瘤学数据库。当接收到自然语言问题时，该工具会利用模式知识将问题分解为子问题，通过句子嵌入技术检索与问题语义相似的、经过专家验证的NL2SQL示例，并根据这些示例以及数据库模式生成可执行的SQL语句，同时还会进行后处理以验证SQL的正确性。为了便于使用，FD-NL2SQL引入了两种更新机制：(1) 临床医生对生成的SQL进行编辑后，这些编辑会被批准并添加到示例库中；(2) 基于轻量级逻辑的规则调整功能可以只对SQL中的单个原子操作进行修改（例如操作符或列的变化），只有当这些修改能产生非空结果时，才会保留相应的变体。第二个LLM会为被批准的变体生成对应的自然语言问题和谓词分解，从而自动扩展示例库，而无需额外的注释操作。该演示界面可以展示分解、检索、合成以及执行结果，从而支持交互式的优化和持续改进。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DIAGRAMS : A Review Framework for Reasoning-Level Attribution in Diagram QA
papers.title_zh: 图表：一种用于推理层面归因分析的框架
papers.authors: Anirudh Iyengar Kaniyar Narayana Iyengar, Tampu Ravi Kumar, Manan Suri, Raviteja Bommireddy, Dinesh Manocha, Puneet Mathur, Vivek Gupta
papers.abstract: Diagram question answering (Diagram QA) requires reasoning-level attribution that links each question-answer pair to all visual regions needed to derive the answer, rather than only the region containing the final response. Creating such structured evidence across diagrams, charts, maps, circuits, and infographics is time-consuming, and existing annotation tools tightly couple their interfaces to dataset-specific formats. We present DIAGRAMS, a lightweight, schema-driven review framework that decouples interface logic from dataset-specific JSON structures through an internal meta-schema and dataset adapters. Given an image and QA pair with optional candidate regions, the system performs QA-conditioned evidence selection and proposes the regions required for reasoning. When QA pairs or candidate regions are missing, it generates them and supports human verification and refinement. Across six Diagram QA datasets, model-suggested evidence achieves 85.39% precision and 75.30% recall against reviewer-final selections (micro-averaged). These results indicate that the review-first framework reduces the number of regions that annotators must create from scratch. Human reviewers accept, edit, or reject each proposed region before export, which structurally limits over-reliance on AI proposals. We release a public demo and installable package to support dataset auditing, grounded supervision creation, and grounded evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 图表问答（Diagram QA）需要达到推理级别的关联能力，即将每对问题-答案链接到所有用于推导答案的视觉区域，而不仅仅是指向包含最终回答的区域。在图表、地图、电路图和信息图中创建这种结构化证据是非常耗时的，而现有的注释工具则将其界面紧密地与特定数据集的格式绑定在一起。我们提出了DIAGRAMS这一轻量级、基于模式的审查框架，它通过内部元模式和数据集适配器，将界面逻辑与特定数据集的JSON结构分离开来。系统接收到一张图片以及带有可选候选区域的问答对后，会进行基于问答条件的证据选择，并提出用于推理所需的区域。当缺少问答对或候选区域时，系统会生成这些区域，并支持人工验证和修正。在六个图表问答数据集上测试表明，模型推荐的证据在精确度上达到了85.39%，召回率达到了75.30%，相对于评审员的最终选择而言（微平均）。这些结果表明，这种以审查为先的框架减少了注释员需要从头开始创建区域的数量。人工评审员可以在导出之前接受、编辑或拒绝每个被推荐的区域，从而结构上限制了过度依赖人工智能提出的方案。我们发布了公开演示版和可安装的软件包，以支持数据集审计、基于数据的监督创建以及基于数据的评估工作。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SlideGuard: AI-Driven Evaluation of Graduate Student Presentation Materials
papers.title_zh: SlideGuard：基于人工智能的毕业生展示材料评估工具
papers.authors: Nikolay Alekseevich Butakov, Maria Khodorchenko, Mazein Nikita, Daniil Gareev, Yuri Falevskiy, Georgii Konev, Denis Nasonov
papers.abstract: Preparing graduate students for effective professional communication remains a central goal of higher education, yet consistently assessing the quality of presentation slide decks - particularly in fast-growing AI/ML programs - poses significant challenges.We introduce SlideGuard, an evaluation agent that assesses slide decks against a comprehensive framework of expert-defined criteria using a visual language model.The criteria, developed in collaboration with domain experts, span visual design, narrative coherence, and argumentative structure.SlideGuard delivers explicit, interpretable justifications for its scoring decisions, and its content-hash-based caching enables efficient re-evaluation after incremental edits, reducing the time educators spend on slide deck evaluation and accelerating feedback delivery to students.We evaluate the approach on a dataset of 150 annotated slide decks and show that it detects the majority of expert-identified issues, with stronger results on structural and visual criteria and known limitations on subjective dimensions such as research quality.SlideGuard is released under the Apache 2.0 license and is available on GitHub,[https://github.com/Industrial-AI-Research-Lab/SlideGuard] including all criterion prompts, configuration files, and evaluation scripts to facilitate replication.
papers.abstract_zh: 为研究生提供有效的专业沟通能力培养，仍然是高等教育的核心目标。然而，持续评估演示幻灯片的质量——尤其是在快速发展的AI/ML领域——却面临着巨大的挑战。我们推出了SlideGuard这一评估工具，它利用视觉语言模型，根据由领域专家制定的全面标准来评估幻灯片质量。这些标准包括视觉设计、叙事连贯性以及论证结构等方面。SlideGuard能够给出明确且可解释的评分依据，而其基于内容哈希值的缓存功能则使得在进行少量编辑后仍能高效重新评估，从而减少了教育工作者在幻灯片评估上的时间，并加快了反馈的传递速度。我们在包含150份标注过幻灯片的数据集上进行了测试，结果表明，该工具能够检测出大多数由专家识别出的问题，尤其在结构和视觉标准方面表现更为出色；而在一些主观指标上，如研究质量方面，则存在一定的局限性。SlideGuard采用Apache 2.0许可证发布，可以在GitHub上获取其源代码：[https://github.com/Industrial-AI-Research-Lab/SlideGuard]，其中包含所有标准的提示语、配置文件以及评估脚本，方便其他人进行复制使用。

papers.title: Spectra: A Mechanistic Interpretability Library for Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: Spectra：一种用于视觉语言模型的机制可解释性库
papers.authors: Clement Neo, Yongsen Zheng, Kwok-Yan Lam, Luke Ong
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have become increasingly important in AI applications, yet interpretability tools for these models lag behind those available for text-only language models. While libraries like TransformerLens have enabled significant progress in understanding language models, existing tools for VLMs are limited to basic activation probing and saving. We introduce Spectra, a library specifically designed for mechanistic interpretability of VLMs that provides unified abstractions for activation patching, attention pattern analysis, and meta-functions across diverse VLM architectures. Built on HuggingFace’s Transformers, our library handles architecture-specific complexities through per-checkpoint configurations while maintaining a simple, high-level interface. We demonstrate the library’s capabilities by performing interpretability experiments on a counting task, showing how researchers can easily perform experiments that were previously cumbersome to do. The library currently supports Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL, LLaVA 1.5 and SmolVLM, with a design that facilitates extension to additional architectures. The library can be found at github.com/clemneo/vlm-spectra.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在人工智能应用中变得越来越重要，然而，这些模型的可解释性工具仍然落后于仅基于文本的语言模型的相关工具。虽然像TransformerLens这样的库在理解语言模型方面取得了显著进展，但现有的视觉语言模型工具仅限于基本的激活探测和保存功能。我们推出了Spectra库，该库专为实现视觉语言模型的可解释性而设计，它为激活插补、注意力模式分析以及不同视觉语言模型架构下的元函数操作提供了统一的抽象框架。该库基于HuggingFace的Transformers框架构建，通过针对每个检查点进行配置来处理特定于架构的复杂性问题，同时保持了简单且高层次的接口。我们通过在一个计数任务上进行可解释性实验来展示该库的能力，结果表明研究人员可以轻松地进行以前难以进行的实验。目前，该库支持Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL、LaVA 1.5和SmolVLM等模型，其设计也便于扩展到其他架构。该库可以在github.com/clemneo/vlm-spectra上找到。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Demonstrating ViviDoc: Generating Interactive Documents through Human-Agent Collaboration
papers.title_zh: 演示ViviDoc的功能：通过人机协作生成交互式文档
papers.authors: Yinghao Tang, Yupeng Xie, Yingchaojie Feng, Tingfeng Lan, Wei Chen
papers.abstract: Interactive articles help readers engage with complex ideas through exploration, yet creating them remains costly, requiring both domain expertise and web development skills. Recent LLM-based agents can automate content creation, but naively applying them yields uncontrollable and unverifiable outputs. We present Vividoc, a human-agent collaborative system that generates interactive educational documents from a single topic input. Vividoc introduces a multi-agent pipeline (Planner, Executor, Evaluator) and the Document Specification (DocSpec), a human-readable intermediate representation that decomposes each interactive visualization into State, Render, Transition, and Constraint components. The DocSpec enables educators to review and refine generation plans before code is produced, bridging the gap between pedagogical intent and executable output. We collect a dataset of 101 real-world interactive documents across 11 domains and conduct a user study showing that ViviDoc produces documents comparable in quality to human-authored ones. Our demo is available at https://vividoc.vercel.app/ and a video demonstration at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rJrnPJLyHUI.
papers.abstract_zh: 交互式文章通过探索的方式帮助读者理解复杂的概念，但创建这些文章仍然需要高昂的成本，既需要领域专业知识，也需要网页开发技能。最近基于大语言模型的智能体可以自动化内容创作，但如果盲目应用它们，就会得到无法控制且难以验证的结果。我们提出了Vividoc系统，这是一个人机协作的系统，它能够从单一主题输入中生成交互式教育文档。Vividoc采用了多智能体流程（规划器、执行器、评估器），以及文档规范（DocSpec）这一人类可读的中间表示形式，该表示将每个交互式可视化元素分解为状态、渲染、转换和约束等组件。文档规范使得教育工作者能够在生成代码之前审查和优化生成计划，从而弥合了教学意图与可执行输出之间的差距。我们收集了101份来自11个领域的真实世界交互式文档数据集，并进行了用户研究，结果表明Vividoc生成的文档质量与人类撰写的文档相当。我们的演示可以在https://vividoc.vercel.app/查看，视频演示则可以在https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rJrnPJLyHUI观看。

papers.title: Praat++: Multimedia Annotation System for Speech and Vocalization
papers.title_zh: Praat++：用于语音和发声多媒體标注的系统
papers.authors: Weiran Zhang, Kenny Q. Zhu
papers.abstract: High-quality time-aligned annotation is fundamental to speech processing and animal vocalization research, yet precise boundary localization and consistent labeling remain challenging in collaborative settings. We present Praat++, a web-based multimedia annotation system designed for collaborative, video-informed, and AI-assisted timeline labeling of audio and video data. The system tightly synchronizes waveform, spectrogram, pitch, intensity, and time-aligned video playback with fine-grained region-based editing, enabling precise boundary refinement and improved label accuracy within a unified interface. Praat++ further incorporates role-aware workflow management and human-in-the-loop AI-assisted pre-annotation to enhance inter-annotator consistency and reduce labeling time. Through real-world multimodal speech and animal vocalization annotation scenarios, we demonstrate that Praat++ provides an integrated infrastructure for improving annotation quality and efficiency in dataset construction workflows. The demo video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YboCoBRF5lg), website (https://redgiant.uta.edu/praat) and source code (https://github.com/UTA-ACL2/PraatPlusPlus) are now publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量的、时间对齐的标注对于语音处理和动物发声研究至关重要。然而，在协作环境中，精确的边界定位以及一致的标注仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了Praat++——一个基于网络的多媒体标注系统，旨在实现基于视频的、由人工智能辅助的时间线标注，适用于音频和视频数据的标注工作。该系统能够紧密同步波形、频谱图、音高、强度以及时间对齐的视频播放，并通过细粒度的区域编辑功能，实现精确边界的细化，从而在统一的界面内提高标注的准确性。此外，Praat++还包含了注重角色的工作流程管理，以及由人工智能辅助的人工标注前处理环节，从而增强不同标注者之间的一致性，并减少标注时间。通过实际的多模态语音和动物发声标注案例，我们证明了Praat++为提升数据集构建过程中的标注质量和效率提供了有效的基础设施。演示视频（https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YboCoBRF5lg）、官方网站（https://redgiant.uta.edu/praat）以及源代码（https://github.com/UTA-ACL2/PraatPlusPlus）现已公开提供。

papers.title: AgentFactory: A Self-Evolving Framework Through Executable Subagent Accumulation and Reuse
papers.title_zh: AgentFactory：一个通过构建可执行的子代理并对其进行重复利用来实现自我进化的框架
papers.authors: Zhang Zhang, Shuqi Lu, Hongjin Qian, Di He, Zheng Liu
papers.abstract: Building LLM-based agents has become increasingly important. Recent works on LLM-based agent self-evolution primarily record successful experiences as textual prompts or reflections, which cannot reliably guarantee efficient task re-execution in complex scenarios. We propose AgentFactory, a new self-evolution paradigm that preserves successful task solutions as executable subagent code rather than textual experience. Crucially, these subagents are continuously refined based on execution feedback, becoming increasingly robust and efficient as more tasks are encountered. Saved subagents are pure Python code with standardized documentation, enabling portability across any Python-capable system. We demonstrate that AgentFactory enables continuous capability accumulation: its library of executable subagents grows and improves over time, progressively reducing the effort required for similar tasks without manual intervention. Our implementation is open-sourced at https://github.com/zzatpku/AgentFactory, and our demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/iKSsuAXJHW0.
papers.abstract_zh: 构建基于大语言模型的智能体变得越来越重要。最近关于基于大语言模型智能体自我进化的研究，主要将成功的经验以文本提示或反思的形式记录下来，但这并不能可靠地保证在复杂场景中能够高效地重新执行任务。我们提出了AgentFactory这一新的自我进化范式，它将成功的任务解决方案以可执行的子代理代码形式保存下来，而不是以文本形式存储。关键的是，这些子代理会根据执行反馈不断得到优化，随着处理更多任务，它们的性能和效率也会不断提高。保存下来的子代理是纯Python代码，并带有标准化的文档说明，这使得它们可以在任何支持Python的系统中进行移植。我们证明了AgentFactory能够实现持续的能力积累：其可执行的子代理库会随着时间的推移不断增长和完善，从而逐步减少类似任务所需的手动干预次数。我们的实现代码已开源，地址为https://github.com/zzatpku/AgentFactory，演示视频可在https://youtu.be/iKSsuAXJHW0观看。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: OpenGlass: A Sensing-Computing Split Architecture for Local MLLM-Driven Real-Time Visual Assistance
papers.title_zh: OpenGlass：一种感知与计算相结合的架构设计，适用于基于本地MLLM技术的实时视觉辅助系统
papers.authors: Mengzhang Li, Yuan Yao
papers.abstract: We present OpenGlass, an open-source, privacy-oriented, local-first system for low-latency multimodal visual assistance, with a primary focus on blind and low-vision users. Cloud MLLM assistants offer strong visual understanding, but often require uploading first-person visual data and can suffer multi-second network delays; wearable glasses are ideal for sensing, but cannot host large models under tight compute and power budgets. OpenGlass addresses this gap with a sensing-computing split: an ESP32-based glasses-side unit captures visual context, while a nearby consumer-grade device performs local MLLM inference and local speech output, reducing cloud reliance and keeping raw egocentric visual data on user-controlled devices by default. We evaluate response quality, query-ready-to-audio latency, safety-aware abstention, and auditable logs. Under real ESP32 Wi-Fi capture, OpenGlass reaches 993 ms median user-to-audio latency with resized payloads and 1625 ms with raw 1280\times720 payloads; 97.5% and 93.3% of trials fall below 2 s, respectively. OpenGlass is a user-initiated visual-assistance reference platform for obstacle/hazard awareness, sign/object queries, and image-quality self-checking, rather than a certified navigation aid. We release source code, hardware instructions, prompts, evaluation data, and logs.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了OpenGlass，这是一个开源的、注重隐私保护的本地化多模态视觉辅助系统，主要面向盲人和低视力用户。云端的多模态语言模型助手能够提供强大的视觉理解能力，但通常需要上传第一人称的视觉数据，并且可能会遇到数秒的网络延迟问题；而可穿戴眼镜则非常适合进行感知功能，但在有限的计算资源和电力预算下无法承载大型模型。OpenGlass通过分离感知与计算的功能来解决这个问题：基于ESP32的眼镜端设备负责捕捉视觉信息，而附近的消费级设备则负责进行本地多模态语言模型推理和语音输出，从而减少了对云端的依赖，并默认将原始以自我为中心的视觉数据保存在用户控制的设备上。我们对OpenGlass的响应质量、查询到音频的延迟时间、安全意识的暂停功能以及可审计的日志进行了评估。在实际的ESP32 Wi-Fi环境下，OpenGlass在调整了负载大小后，用户到音频的中值延迟达到了993毫秒；而在使用原始的1280×720分辨率负载时，这一数值达到了1625毫秒。在97.5%的试验中，延迟时间低于2秒，而在93.3%的试验中，延迟时间控制在2秒以内。OpenGlass是一个由用户发起的视觉辅助参考平台，主要用于障碍物/危险物的识别、标志/物体的查询以及图像质量的自我检查，而不是一种经过认证的导航辅助工具。我们已发布源代码、硬件说明、提示语、评估数据和日志。

papers.title: TartanMaroon: Multi-Agent Academic Advising with Iterative Negotiation and Transparent Collaboration
papers.title_zh: TartanMaroon：基于迭代协商和透明协作的多智能体学术指导系统
papers.authors: Peidi Dong, Houda Bouamor, Yunze Xiao, Devi G Kurup
papers.abstract: We present TartanMaroon, a deployable multi-agent academic advising system that handles the full complexity spectrum of student queries, from factual lookups to constrained multi-semester planning. We make three contributions: (1) a proposal–critique negotiation protocol in which a Planning Agent generates degree plans evaluated in parallel by domain-specialized agents, enabling detection of cross-domain constraint violations that single-pass outputs miss; (2) a real-time transparency interface streaming agent reasoning and negotiation rounds to users, supported by pilot feedback showing increased trust over standard LLM chatbots; and (3) TartanBench, a difficulty-stratified benchmark of 220 advising queries across five complexity tiers, released open-source without exposing individual student records. A five-configuration ablation study establishes a complexity–necessity curve: single-agent systems perform competitively on simple queries, while multi-agent coordination yields gains of up to +31 points on planning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了TartanMaroon，这是一个可部署的多智能体学术指导系统，能够处理学生查询的各种复杂情况，从事实查询到多学期的约束性规划。我们的贡献主要有三点：(1) 一种提案与评估协商协议，其中规划智能体生成度计划，这些计划由特定领域的智能体并行评估，从而能够发现单遍输出无法解决的跨领域约束问题；(2) 一个实时透明界面，它将智能体的推理过程和协商过程呈现给用户，通过试点反馈表明，该系统的信任度高于传统的LLM聊天机器人；(3) TartanBench，这是一个难度分级的基准测试，包含220个学术指导查询，分为五个复杂度等级。该测试库以开源形式发布，同时不会泄露学生的个人记录。一项包含五种配置的实验研究表明，复杂性与必要性之间存在一定的关系：单一智能体系统在简单查询上的表现相当不错，而多智能体协作则在规划任务上带来了高达+31点的提升。

papers.title: GAMED.AI: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Educational Game Generation
papers.title_zh: GAMED.AI：一种分层多智能体框架，用于自动生成教育性游戏
papers.authors: Shiven Agarwal, Yash Shah, Ashish Raj Shekhar, Priyanuj Bordoloi, Vivek Gupta
papers.abstract: We introduce GameDAI, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that transforms instructor-provided questions into fully playable, pedagogically grounded educational games validated through formal mechanic contracts. Built on phase-based LangGraph sub-graphs, deterministic Quality Gates, and structured Pydantic schemas, GameDAI supports two template families encompassing 15 interaction mechanics across spatial reasoning, procedural execution, and higher-order Bloom’s Taxonomy objectives.Evaluated on 200 questions spanning five subject domains, the system achieves a 90% validation pass rate, 98.3% schema compliance, and 73% token reduction over ReAct agents 73,500 → 19,900 tokens/game) at 0.46 per game. Within this model configuration, these results suggest that phase-bounded architectural structure correlates more strongly with alignment quality than prompting strategy alone.Our demonstration lets attendees generate Bloom's-aligned games from natural language in under 60 seconds, inspect Quality Gate outputs at each pipeline phase, and browse a curated library of 50 games spanning all 15 mechanic types.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了GameDAI，这是一个分层多智能体框架，能够将教师提供的问题转化为完全可玩且具有教育意义的游戏。这些游戏通过正式的机制合同得到了验证。GameDAI基于分阶段LangGraph子图、确定性质量门控以及结构化的Pydantic模式构建，支持两种模板类型，涵盖了15种互动机制，包括空间推理、程序执行以及高阶布鲁姆分类目标等。在针对五个学科领域的200个问题上进行评估后，该系统实现了90%的验证通过率、98.3%的模式合规性，与 ReAct 智能体相比，词元使用量减少了 73%，从每款游戏 73,500 个降至 19,900 个，每款游戏成本为 0.46。在这种模型配置下，这些结果表明，分阶段架构结构与对齐质量的关联程度比提示策略更为紧密。我们的演示表明，参与者可以在不到60秒的时间内从自然语言生成符合布鲁姆分类标准的游戏，可以查看每个流程阶段的质量门控输出结果，并浏览一个包含50款游戏的精选库，这些游戏涵盖了所有15种互动机制。

papers.title: MOOSE-Copilot: A Web-Based Interactive Assistant for Unified Exploratory and Fine-Grained Scientific Hypothesis Discovery
papers.title_zh: MOOSE-Copilot：一种基于网络的互动助手，旨在帮助人们发现统一的、具有探索性的以及详细的科学假设
papers.authors: Hongran An, Zonglin Yang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show remarkable potential in scientific hypothesis discovery. However, existing approaches face two critical limitations: they treat divergent exploratory search and convergent fine-grained refinement as isolated tasks, and they operate autonomously with little to no human guidance. We present MOOSE-Copilot, the first unified framework to bridge this abstraction gap through a formalized human–AI interaction (HAII) protocol. Our system empowers scientists to steer the generative process via three explicit signals: initial blueprints, inter-stage routing, and intra-stage feedback. Using an oracle-simulated evaluation in which an LLM provides idealized expert signals, we show that injecting these structured signals significantly outperforms purely autonomous baselines, characterizing the gains achievable under high-quality guidance. Furthermore, we build a web-based interface that turns the framework into a no-code workflow: researchers pose a question, watch the hypothesis search unfold as an interactive tree, and steer it by selecting hypotheses, routing between stages, and injecting feedback—no command-line agents required. This makes end-to-end hypothesis discovery directly accessible to interdisciplinary researchers.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在科学假设发现方面展现出巨大的潜力。然而，现有的方法存在两个关键局限性：它们将发散性的探索搜索与收敛性的细粒度优化视为独立的任务，并且这些过程几乎完全由机器自主运行，几乎没有人类的干预。我们提出了MOOSE-Copilot这一首个能够弥合这种抽象差距的统一框架，它通过正式化的人机交互协议来实现这一目标。我们的系统允许科学家通过三种明确的信号来操控生成过程：初始蓝图、阶段间路由以及阶段内反馈。通过一种基于神谕模拟的评估方式，即让语言模型提供理想化的专家信号，我们发现注入这些结构化信号后，模型的性能明显优于纯自主运行的基线模型，这证明了在高质量指导下所能获得的改进效果。此外，我们还开发了一个基于网络的接口，使得该框架可以成为一个无需编写代码的流程：研究人员可以提出问题，观察假设搜索的过程，并通过选择假设、在阶段之间切换以及注入反馈来操控整个过程——无需使用命令行工具。这样，跨学科的研究人员就可以直接进行端到端的假设发现了。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Multi-Agent Reasoning Improves Compute Efficiency: Pareto-Optimal Test-Time Scaling
papers.title_zh: 多智能体推理提升了计算效率：达到帕累托最优的解在测试时间上的优化策略
papers.authors: Florian Valentin Wunderlich, Lars Benedikt Kaesberg, Jan Philip Wahle, Terry Ruas, Bela Gipp
papers.abstract: Advances in inference methods have enabled language models to improve their predictions without additional training. These methods often prioritize raw performance over cost-effective compute usage. However, computational efficiency is key for real-world applications with resource constraints. We provide a systematic analysis of the inference scaling strategies self-consistency, self-refinement, multi-agent debate, and mixture-of-agents, to study their computational performance tradeoffs. We evaluate methods on two reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, BBH) and include extensive parameter configurations (e.g., scaling the number of parallel predictions, agents, and debate rounds) across different model sizes. Across 34 configurations and over 100 evaluations, we compute the Pareto-optimal front to select methods that achieve the best accuracy with the lowest computational budget.Notably, inference scaling improves accuracy by up to +7.1% points over chain-of-thought at the highest evaluated budgets (20× the CoT compute budget) on MMLU-Pro. With an equal computing budget, debate and mixture-of-agents outperform self-consistency by 1.3% and 2.7% points, respectively. While self-consistency saturates earlier, multi-agent gains persist, particularly on more complicated tasks. We identify a simple multi-agent design guideline: mixture-of-agents is most efficient when the number of parallel generations exceeds the number of sequential aggregations.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理方法的进步使得语言模型能够在无需额外训练的情况下提升预测精度。这些方法通常更重视性能表现，而非计算资源的利用效率。然而，对于资源有限的实际应用来说，计算效率至关重要。我们对自洽推理、自我精炼、多智能体辩论以及混合智能体等推理扩展策略进行了系统分析，以研究它们在计算性能上的权衡关系。我们在两个推理基准测试（MMLU-Pro、BBH）上评估了这些方法，并考虑了不同模型规模下的多种参数配置（例如，增加并行预测的数量、智能体的数量以及辩论轮数）。通过对34种配置和超过100次评估，我们找到了在不同计算预算下精度与成本达到帕累托最优的方案。值得注意的是，在最高评估预算下（是CoT计算预算的20倍），推理扩展策略的准确率比思维链提升了高达7.1个百分点。在相同的计算资源下，辩论和混合智能体方法的准确率分别比自洽推理高出1.3个百分点和2.7个百分点。虽然自洽推理较早达到收益饱和，但多智能体推理的优势仍然持续存在，尤其是在更复杂的任务中。我们总结出一个简单的多智能体设计原则：当并行生成的数量超过顺序聚合的数量时，混合智能体方式才是最高效的。

papers.title: Claim Verification in the Age of Large Language Models: A Survey
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型时代下的索赔验证：一项调查
papers.authors: Alphaeus Dmonte, Roland R Oruche, Marcos Zampieri, Prasad Calyam, Isabelle Augenstein
papers.abstract: The large and ever-increasing amount of data available on the Internet, coupled with the laborious task of manual claim and fact verification, has sparked interest in the development of automated claim verification systems. Several deep learning and transformer-based models have been proposed for this task over the years. With the introduction of Large Language Models (LLMs) and their superior performance in several NLP tasks, we have seen a surge of LLM-based approaches to claim verification along with the use of novel methods such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). In this survey, we present a comprehensive account of recent claim verification frameworks using LLMs. We describe the different components of the claim verification pipeline used in these frameworks in detail, including common approaches to retrieval, prompting, and fine-tuning. Finally, we describe publicly available English datasets for this task.
papers.abstract_zh: 互联网上存在着大量不断增加的数据，再加上手动进行索赔和事实验证的繁琐工作，这引发了对开发自动化索赔验证系统的兴趣。多年来，已有多种基于深度学习和变换器的模型被提出用于这一任务。随着大语言模型在多个自然语言处理任务中的卓越表现，基于LLM的索赔验证方法也得到了广泛应用，同时还采用了诸如检索增强生成等新的方法。在这项调查中，我们全面介绍了使用LLM的最新索赔验证框架。我们详细描述了这些框架中使用的索赔验证流程的各个组成部分，包括常见的检索、提示和微调方法。最后，我们还介绍了可用于此任务的公开可用的英语数据集。

papers.title: Language Directions in Multilingual LLMs: A Layer-wise Diagnostic Study of Token Alignment and Pretraining Imprint
papers.title_zh: 多语言大语言模型中的语言方向问题：对词汇对齐与预训练印记的逐层诊断研究
papers.authors: JaeSeong Kim, Suan Lee
papers.abstract: We investigate how multilingual representations emerge across depth in large language models.Using a unified probing framework, we analyze six multilingual LLMs across five languages (EN/ES/ZH/FR/DE), decomposing behavior into (i) early-layer dynamics, (ii) linear vs. MLP separability, and (iii) token–language alignment that tracks where vocabulary sharing peaks.Across models, we observe a consistent and substantial early jump: accuracy rises by +73.5 to +80.7 points from L0 to L1 on average, indicating that language-relevant signals become accessible immediately after the embedding layer.Moreover, representations are largely linearly separable: for 5/6 models, the mean gap between MLP and linear probes remains within \pm0.5 points.Token–language alignment further reveals systematic structure, with peak vocabulary mass exceeding 48% in some models and substantial variation in the depth of peak sharing.These findings provide a compact, cross-model characterization of how multilingual information is organized across depth and introduce simple alignment metrics that complement accuracy-based evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了多语言表示如何在大语言模型的各个层次中形成。通过使用统一的探测框架，我们对六种多语言大语言模型进行了分析，这些模型支持五种语言（英语、西班牙语、中文、法语、德语）。我们将模型的行为分解为三个方面：(i) 早期层的动态变化；(ii) 线性表示与多层感知机表示的可分性；(iii) 词元与语言的对齐情况，以及词汇共享的峰值位置。在多个模型中，我们发现了一个一致且显著的早期增长：从L0到L1阶段，准确率平均提升了73.5到80.7个百分点，这表明与语言相关的信息在嵌入层之后就能被直接获取。此外，这些表示在很大程度上是线性可分的：对于5/6个模型来说，多层感知机表示与线性表示之间的平均差异保持在±0.5个百分点以内。词元与语言的对齐情况还显示出系统性的结构特征，某些模型中的词汇量峰值超过了48%，而不同模型在词汇共享峰值的深度上也存在显著差异。这些发现为我们提供了一个简洁的、跨模型的多语言信息组织方式的描述，并且引入了简单的一致性评估指标，以补充基于准确度的评估方法。

papers.title: Emergence of Minimal Circuits for Indirect Object Identification in Attention-Only Transformers
papers.title_zh: 用于间接宾语识别的最小化电路在仅关注变换器中的出现
papers.authors: Rabin Adhikari
papers.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability aims to reverse-engineer large language models (LLMs) into human-understandable computational circuits. However, the complexity of pretrained models often obscures the minimal mechanisms required for specific reasoning tasks. In this work, we train small, attention-only transformers from scratch on a symbolic version of the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) task, a benchmark for studying coreference-like reasoning in transformers. Surprisingly, a single-layer model with only two attention heads achieves perfect IOI accuracy, despite lacking MLPs and normalization layers. Through residual stream decomposition, spectral analysis, and embedding interventions, we find that the two heads specialize into additive and contrastive subcircuits that jointly implement IOI resolution. Furthermore, we show that a two-layer, one-head model achieves performance comparable to that of a multi-head model by composing information across layers primarily through query-key interactions. These results demonstrate that task-specific training induces highly interpretable, minimal circuits, offering a controlled testbed for probing the computational foundations of transformer reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 机制可解释性旨在将大语言模型逆向工程成人类能够理解的计算电路。然而，预训练模型的复杂性往往掩盖了完成特定推理任务所需的最小化机制。在这项研究中，我们从一个符号化的间接宾语识别任务开始，训练出小型的、仅使用注意力的变换器模型。令人惊讶的是，一个只有两个注意力头的单层模型能够实现完美的间接宾语识别准确率，尽管它缺乏多层感知器和归一化层。通过残差流分解、频谱分析和嵌入处理，我们发现这两个注意力头分别实现了加法和对比子电路，这些子电路共同完成了间接宾语识别的任务。此外，我们还发现，一个两层、一个注意头的模型通过查询-键交互来整合各层的信息，其性能可以与多头模型相媲美。这些结果表明，针对特定任务的训练能够产生高度可解释的、最小化的电路结构，为探究变换器推理的计算基础提供了一个可控的实验平台。
