papers.title: Why Large Language Models can Secretly Outperform Embedding Similarity in Information Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 为什么大型语言模型在信息检索方面能够超越嵌入相似性算法
papers.authors: Matei Benescu, Ivo Pascal de Jong
papers.abstract: With the emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs), new methods in Information Retrieval are available in which relevance is estimated directly through language understanding and reasoning, instead of embedding similarity. We argue that similarity is a short-sighted interpretation of relevance, and that LLM-Based Relevance Judgment Systems (LLM-RJS) (with reasoning) have potential to outperform Neural Embedding Retrieval Systems (NERS) by overcoming this limitation. Using the TREC-DL 2019 passage retrieval dataset, we compare various LLM-RJS with NERS, but observe no noticeable improvement. Subsequently, we analyze the impact of reasoning by comparing LLM-RJS with and without reasoning. We find that human annotations also suffer from short-sightedness, and that false-positives in the reasoning LLM-RJS are primarily mistakes in annotations due to short-sightedness. We conclude that LLM-RJS do have the ability to address the short-sightedness limitation in NERS, but that this cannot be evaluated with standard annotated relevance datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的出现，出现了新的信息检索方法。这些方法通过语言理解和推理直接判断相关性，而非依赖嵌入相似性来进行分析。我们认为，相似性是一种短视的对相关性的理解方式。基于语言模型的关联判断系统（LLM-RJS）通过推理机制，有望克服这一局限性，从而超越神经嵌入检索系统（NERS）。我们使用TREC-DL 2019的段落检索数据集，比较了各种LLM-RJS与NERS的性能，但并未发现明显的改进。随后，我们通过对比有无推理机制的LLM-RJS，进一步分析了推理机制的影响。我们发现，人类的注释也存在短视的问题，而推理过程中出现的错误，主要是由于注释中的短视导致的。因此，我们可以得出结论：LLM-RJS确实能够解决NERS中的短视问题，但这种能力无法通过标准的相关性标注数据集来评估。

papers.title: Detecting Hallucinations in Large Language Models via Internal Attention Divergence Signals
papers.title_zh: 通过内部注意力差异信号来检测大型语言模型中的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Gijs van Dijk
papers.abstract: We propose a lightweight and single-pass uncertainty quantification method for detecting hallucinations in Large Language Models. The method uses attention matrices to estimate uncertainty without requiring repeated sampling or external models. Specifically, we measure the Kullback–Leibler divergence between each attention head’s distribution and a uniform reference distribution, and use these features in a logistic regression probe. Across multiple datasets, task types, and model families, attention divergence is strongly predictive of answer correctness and performs competitively with existing uncertainty estimation methods. We find that this signal is concentrated in middle layers and on factual tokens such as named entities and numbers, suggesting that attention dynamics provides an efficient and interpretable white-box signal of model uncertainty.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种轻量级且单遍的不确定性量化方法，用于检测大语言模型中的幻觉现象。该方法利用注意力矩阵来估计不确定性，无需重复采样或依赖外部模型。具体来说，我们通过计算每个注意力头的分布与均匀参考分布之间的Kullback-Leibler散度，并将这些特征用于逻辑回归分析中。在多个数据集、任务类型以及不同的模型家族中，注意力散度都能很好地预测答案的正确性，其性能与现有的不确定性估计方法相当。我们发现，这种信号主要集中在中间层以及诸如命名实体和数字这样的事实标记上，这表明注意力动态提供了一种高效且可解释的模型不确定性白盒信号。

papers.title: Reflection in the Dark: Exposing and Escaping the Black Box in Reflective Prompt Optimization
papers.title_zh: 黑暗中的反思：揭示并逃离反射式提示优化中的“黑箱”问题
papers.authors: Shiyan Liu, Qifeng Xia, Qiyun Xia, Yisheng Liu, Xinyu Yu, Rui Qu
papers.abstract: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving LLM performance without manual prompt engineering. Reflective APO methods such as GEPA iteratively refine prompts by diagnosing failure cases, but the optimization process remains black-box and label-free, leading to uninterpretable trajectories and systematic failure. We identify and empirically demonstrate four limitations: on GSM8K with a defective seed, GEPA degrades accuracy from 23.81% to 13.50%. We propose VISTA, a multi-agent APO framework that decouples hypothesis generation from prompt rewriting, enabling semantically labeled hypotheses, parallel minibatch verification, and interpretable optimization trace. A two-layer explore-exploit mechanism combining random restart and epsilon-greedy sampling further escapes local optima. VISTA recovers accuracy to 87.57% on the same defective seed and consistently outperforms baselines across all conditions on GSM8K and AIME2025.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动提示优化技术已成为提升大语言模型性能的强大手段，无需人工设计提示。诸如GEPA这样的反思性自动提示优化方法通过诊断失败案例来逐步改进提示，但优化过程仍然属于黑箱操作，缺乏明确的标签标注，从而导致优化轨迹难以解释且容易出现系统性问题。我们发现了四个限制因素：在GSM8K平台上，当使用有缺陷的种子时，GEPA的准确率从23.81%下降到了13.50%。我们提出了VISTA框架，这是一种多智能体自动提示优化方案，它将假设生成与提示重写分离开来，从而能够生成带有语义标签的假设、进行并行的小批量验证，并生成可解释的优化轨迹。该框架采用双层探索-利用机制，结合随机重启和ε-贪婪采样策略，从而避免陷入局部最优解。在相同的缺陷种子条件下，VISTA将准确率恢复到了87.57%，并且在GSM8K和AIME2025上的所有测试条件下都优于现有基线算法。

papers.title: Thesis Proposal: LLMs post-training for multilingual medical tasks. Instruction-Tuning, Continual-Pretraining or Reasoning?
papers.title_zh: 论文提案：大型语言模型在多语言医疗任务中的后续训练应用。采用指令调优、持续预训练还是推理机制？
papers.authors: Pietro Ferrazzi, Alberto Lavelli, Bernardo Magnini
papers.abstract: Adapting Large Language Models to the medical domain remains an active area of research, with multiple strategies proposed to leverage annotated and unannotated data effectively. In this work, we propose a thesis outline to compare three common adaptation approaches—Instruction Tuning, Continual Pretraining, and Reasoning-oriented Training. We identify 5 dimensions to analyse: i) the interaction between the adaptation technique and the tasks; ii) the impact of the data size on the downstream performance; iii) the differences between datasets required by the three techniques; iv) the impact of the techniques given the model size; v) the impact of the techniques given the language.We construct an evaluation framework composed by 5 multilingual medical NLP tasks (named entity recognition, relation extraction, question answering, case report form filling, argument mining), spanning on 21 datasets in English, Italian, and Spanish, for a total of 61 combinations of language and sub-task.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型应用于医学领域仍然是一个活跃的研究领域，人们提出了多种策略来有效利用标注数据和未标注数据。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个研究大纲，用于比较三种常见的适应方法：指令调整、持续预训练和基于推理的训练。我们确定了五个分析维度：i) 适应技术与任务之间的相互作用；ii) 数据大小对下游性能的影响；iii) 这三种技术所需的数据集之间的差异；iv) 在模型规模给定的情况下，这些技术的效果；v) 在语言类型给定的情况下，这些技术的效果。我们构建了一个评估框架，包含5种多语言医学自然语言处理任务（包括命名实体识别、关系提取、问答、病例报告填写、论点挖掘），这些任务分布在21个英语、意大利语和西班牙语的数据集中，总共有61种语言和子任务的组合。

papers.title: Peek2: Regex-free Byte-level Byte-Pair Encoding Pretokenizer for LLM Inference on Edge Devices
papers.title_zh: Peek2：一种无需正则表达式的字节级字节对编码预编码器，适用于在边缘设备上进行大语言模型推理
papers.authors: Liu Zai, Iraklis A. Klampanos
papers.abstract: Pretokenization is a crucial, sequential pass in Byte-level BPE tokenizers, yet little work has been done to optimize it for edge-side inference. Our proposed new implementation, Peek2, serves as a drop-in replacement for cl100k-like pretokenizers used in GPT-3, LLaMa-3, and Qwen-2.5. After breaking down and analyzing the logic of the original cl100k pretokenizer, we introduced a new pretokenization algorithm with linear time complexity and constant, trivial memory usage, suited for edge scenarios. Test results show that it increases microbenchmarking throughput by up to 2.48\times and delivers a 1.14\times improvement in overall throughput across the entire Byte-level BPE encoding process, depending on the dataset, while providing identical results as the baseline Regex-based tokenizer.
papers.abstract_zh: 预分词是字节级BPE分词器中的一个关键步骤，然而针对边缘计算场景的优化工作却很少。我们提出的新型实现方案Peek2，可以替代GPT-3、LLaMa-3和Qwen-2.5中使用的cl100k类预分词器。通过对原始cl100k预分词器的逻辑进行分析，我们提出了一种时间复杂度低、内存占用小的新预分词算法，非常适合边缘计算场景。测试结果表明，该算法在微基准测试中的吞吐量提升了2.48倍，在整个字节级BPE编码过程中，整体吞吐量也提高了1.14倍，同时其性能与基于正则表达式的基线分词器相当。

papers.title: Annotation Entropy Predicts Per-Example Learning Dynamics in LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 注释熵能预测LoRA微调过程中的逐例学习动态
papers.authors: Brady Steele
papers.abstract: Annotator disagreement on tasks like natural language inference (NLI) reflects genuine linguistic ambiguity, yet most fine-tuning recipes treat every example as equally learnable. We ask whether this external signal of ambiguity predicts per-example learning dynamics under LoRA, the most widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, and find that it does. Correlating annotation entropy (from ChaosNLI’s 100 labels per example) with per-example area under the loss curve (AULC) on SNLI and MNLI, the correlation is positive in all 25conditions tested (Spearman \rho {=} 0.06-0.43), with decoder-only models showing stronger correlations than encoders at matched LoRA rank. More strikingly, under LoRA contested examples exhibit un-learning: their gold-label loss increases during training, a pattern that is largely absent under full fine-tuning and IA^3 in the encoder setting where matched comparisons are available, and that we also observe under LoRA on two decoder-only models. The effect survives partial-correlation controls and replicates across seeds and datasets. A preliminary noise-injection experiment is consistent with these findings.
papers.abstract_zh: 注释者对自然语言推理等任务的看法存在分歧，这反映了语言上的模糊性。然而，大多数微调方法都将每个样本视为同等可学习的对象。我们探讨了这种模糊性的外部信号是否能在LoRA这种被广泛使用的参数高效微调方法下预测出每个样本的学习动态，结果发现确实如此。将注释熵（来自ChaosNLI的每例100个标签数据）与SNLI和MNLI上每个样本的损失曲线下面积进行关联分析，结果显示在所有25种测试条件下，两者之间存在正相关关系（Spearman相关系数在0.06到0.43之间）。其中，仅使用解码器的模型显示出比使用编码器的模型更强的相关性，且这种相关性在LoRA排名相同的情况下更为明显。更值得注意的是，在LoRA框架下，有争议的样本会出现“不学习”的现象：这些样本的黄金标签损失会在训练过程中增加，而在全微调或编码器设置中，由于有匹配的对比数据，这种现象几乎不存在。我们在两个仅使用解码器的模型上也观察到了这一现象。这种效应在部分相关性控制下仍然存在，并且在不同种子数据和数据集上都能得到验证。一项初步的噪声注入实验结果与这些发现一致。

papers.title: Semantic Contrastive Adaptation for Multimodal Figurative Language Understanding
papers.title_zh: 用于多模态比喻性语言理解的语义对比适应机制
papers.authors: Ayaan Siddiqui
papers.abstract: Understanding idiomatic and figurative language in images remains a fundamental challenge for vision–language models, as it requires reasoning beyond literal image–text alignment. Although large pretrained models such as CLIP and BLIP-2 perform well on literal recognition, they consistently fail on multimodal figurative benchmarks, often favoring visually salient but semantically literal interpretations. We show that this failure arises from a systematic literal alignment bias rather than limited model capacity. Motivated by this observation, we reformulate multimodal figurative understanding as a contrastive semantic deviation problem, where figurative images must be distinguished from visually plausible literal alternatives. We introduce a parameter-efficient adaptation of CLIP using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with hard literal negative mining, achieving targeted reshaping of multimodal representations without full fine-tuning. Experiments on the IRFL benchmark across idioms, metaphors, and similes demonstrate substantial improvements over zero-shot CLIP, BLIP- 2, ensemble-based, and knowledge-augmented baselines. Finally, we introduce FIGMENT, a multilingual figurative grounding evaluation spanning five idiom-rich languages, and show that the adapted model generalizes across languages despite being trained exclusively on English supervision.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解图像中的习语和比喻性语言对于视觉-语言模型来说仍然是一个基本挑战，因为这需要超越字面意义上的图像-文本对齐的推理能力。虽然像CLIP和BLIP-2这样的大型预训练模型在字面识别方面表现良好，但在多模态比喻性任务上却经常失败，它们往往倾向于选择那些在视觉上明显但语义上符合字面意义的解释。我们发现，这种失败是由于系统性的字面对齐偏差导致的，而不是模型能力的限制。基于这一观察，我们将多模态比喻性理解重新定义为一种对比性语义偏离问题，即需要将比喻性图像与在视觉上可行的字面解释区分开来。我们提出了一种使用低秩自适应技术对CLIP进行参数高效调整的方案，该技术通过硬字面否定挖掘来实现对多模态表示的针对性重塑，而无需进行完全的微调。在IRFL基准测试上的实验表明，与零样本CLIP、BLIP-2、基于集成的方法以及知识增强基线相比，我们的方法取得了显著的改进。最后，我们引入了FIGMENT这一多语言比喻性理解评估工具，它涵盖了五种富含习语的语言。结果表明，尽管该模型仅使用英语进行监督训练，但它能够在不同语言间实现泛化能力。

papers.title: Think Less, Code Better: Probing When Chain-of-Thought Hurts and How to Route Around It
papers.title_zh: 少思考，写好代码：应对思维链带来的问题以及如何绕过它
papers.authors: Rajarshi Ghoshal, Debadri Basak, Salma E. Abdelhalim, Pratibha K. Arora
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting is the dominant strategy for eliciting step-by-step reasoning in large language models, but its effect on code generation is poorly understood. We present a controlled 2×2 study of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B and DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B (each in base and instruction-tuned variants) on HumanEval, MBPP, and LiveCodeBench, plus scale-validation runs on Qwen2.5-Coder at 7B and 14B and a preliminary evaluation of CodeLlama-7B. We find that instruction tuning reverses CoT’s effect on small Qwen models: CoT improves the 1.5B base (+13.4pp, p<0.001) but significantly degrades the 1.5B instruct variant (-15.2pp, p<0.001). The reversal is sharply scale-bounded — it disappears at 7B (-0.6pp) and goes slightly positive at 14B (+2.4pp) — while CoT’s positive effect on base models grows monotonically with scale (+13.4 → +28.7 pp). DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B is insensitive regardless of regime. A direct token-count and truncation analysis shows the mechanism: at 1.5B, CoT inflates Qwen Instruct’s mean output length by 112 tokens and pushes 7.6× more generations into truncation, where Pass@1 is 0%; at 14B, the same prefix produces complete code well within budget. Layer-wise probing shows all four small models encode prompt type by Layer 1–4 (>90% accuracy) — universally, whether CoT helps or hurts — demonstrating that representation does not determine interpretation: the same internal signal drives divergent downstream behavior depending on training regime and capacity. Building on these mechanistic findings, we develop a probe-guided style router that, when trained per model on a labeled training split, selects among 12 prompt styles via a single 84 ms forward pass; it is statistically indistinguishable from the best fixed style in 7/8 settings and significantly outperforms CoT where CoT is most harmful (p=0.012, h=+0.40). Our results argue against applying CoT blindly to small instruct code models: its effect depends on architecture, training regime, and scale in ways that are mechanistically detectable from early-layer activations.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链提示是激发大语言模型逐步推理的主要策略，但其对代码生成的影响尚不清楚。我们在Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B和DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B两个模型中进行了控制性研究（每个模型都有基础版本和经过指令调优的版本），测试了它们在HumanEval、MBPP和LiveCodeBench上的表现。此外，我们还对Qwen2.5-Coder的7B和14B版本进行了规模验证，并对CodeLlama-7B模型进行了初步评估。研究发现，指令调优能够逆转思维链提示对小模型的影响：对于1.5B的基础版本，思维链提示提升了模型的性能，提高了13.4个百分点，但这一效果在1.5B的指令调优版本中显著下降，降低了15.2个百分点。这种逆转现象在7B规模时消失，而在14B规模时略有提升，即增加了2.4个百分点。而思维链提示对基础模型的积极影响则随着规模的增加而持续上升，从13.4上升到28.7个百分点。DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B模型在不同规模下表现稳定，不受指令调优的影响。通过直接分析令牌数量和截断情况，我们发现：在1.5B规模时，思维链提示会使Qwen Instruct的平均输出长度增加112个令牌，并导致模型生成的代码数量增加7.6倍，此时Pass@1的准确率仅为0%；而在14B规模时，相同的提示方式可以生成完整的代码，且成本极低。层级分析表明，这四个小模型都能根据第1到第4层的信息来编码提示类型，准确率超过90%。无论思维链提示是有助于还是阻碍模型性能，它都起到了关键作用。这表明，表示方式并不决定模型的解释能力：相同的内部信号会根据训练方式和模型容量的不同而引发不同的下游行为。基于这些机制性的发现，我们开发了一种基于探针引导的风格选择器，该选择器可以在标记过的训练数据上针对每个模型进行训练，通过一次84毫秒的前向处理就能从12种提示风格中选择出合适的风格。在7/8种情况下，该选择器的性能与最佳固定风格无显著差异，而在思维链提示最不利的情况下，其性能明显优于思维链提示（p=0.012，h=+0.40）。我们的研究结果表明，不应盲目地将思维链提示应用于小型指令代码模型，因为其效果取决于架构、训练方式和规模等因素，而这些因素可以通过早期层的激活模式来检测。

papers.title: Probing Functional Correctness in Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: 探究扩散语言模型的功能正确性
papers.authors: Guan-Ming Chiu, Jeng-Yue Liu
papers.abstract: Diffusion language models generate text by iteratively denoising all tokens in parallel, but when and where their hidden states encode whether the output will be functionally correct remains unknown.We present the first probing study of DLM internals, training linear classifiers on hidden states to predict functional correctness.Across two models (LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B) and four tasks, we find that DLMs uniquely accumulate correctness signal across denoising steps (AUC gains of 0.08–0.11 on reasoning tasks), absent in single-pass AR decoding. However, step-0 signal reflects prompt difficulty rather than diffusion-specific computation. Signal emergence is task-dependent: structural tasks show flat profiles while reasoning tasks show gradual buildup. The two models exhibit distinct layer dynamics, with LLaDA concentrating signal in upper layers while Dream redistributes toward lower layers. We further show that probe confidence can identify likely failures, enabling selective generation that avoids 36–98% of wasted compute.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型通过并行迭代地去除所有标记来生成文本，但它们的隐藏状态究竟何时以及如何在编码输出是否功能正确的信息方面发挥作用，目前仍不清楚。我们首次对DLM的内部机制进行了探究性研究，通过在隐藏状态上训练线性分类器来预测功能正确性。在两种模型（LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B）和四个任务中，我们发现DLM能够在去除标记的过程中逐步积累正确的信号（在推理任务上的AUC提升了0.08–0.11），而单遍AR解码则无法做到这一点。不过，第0步产生的信号反映的是提示的难度，而非扩散过程中的特定计算。信号的出现取决于任务类型：结构化任务中的信号水平较为平稳，而推理任务则显示出逐渐累积的趋势。这两种模型在层级的信号分布上也有显著差异：LLaDA将信号集中在高层，而Dream则将信号重新分配到较低层次。我们还发现，通过探测置信度可以识别出可能出现的错误，从而实现选择性生成，从而避免了36%到98%的计算资源浪费。

papers.title: Thesis Proposal: On the Granularity-Robustness Trade-off in Text-Derived Knowledge Graphs
papers.title_zh: 论文提案：关于文本衍生知识图谱中粒度与鲁棒性的权衡问题
papers.authors: Surawat Pralomram
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) based on dense embeddings has become a dominant paradigm for text retrieval. However, many real-world applications require attribute-specific querying, where explicit values or properties must be extracted from text (e.g., symptoms in clinical notes or dosage values in medical reports). Dense retrieval handles paraphrastic variation well but often entangles multiple attributes within a single embedding, making value extraction difficult. Knowledge graphs (KGs), in contrast, support explicit attribute access but are brittle under linguistic and structural variation, leading to low recall.This thesis proposal aims to investigate the representational trade-off underlying these approaches. We study knowledge graph representations from an information-theoretic and optimal coding perspective, focusing on the tension between fine-grained factorization and compact canonicalization of concepts. Building on this perspective, we propose a query-driven framework for constructing and retrieving knowledge graphs from text, aiming to combine the robustness of dense retrieval with the explicit queryability of symbolic representations.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于密集嵌入的检索增强生成技术，已成为文本检索领域的主流方法。然而，许多实际应用场景需要针对特定属性的查询，此时需要从文本中提取具体的数值或属性信息（例如，临床记录中的症状或医疗报告中的剂量数据）。密集检索技术能够很好地处理语义上的变化，但往往会在单个嵌入中混淆多个属性，从而使得属性值的提取变得困难。相比之下，知识图谱则支持对具体属性的直接访问，但在语言和结构上的变化下容易出错，导致召回率较低。本论文提案旨在研究这些方法背后的表示权衡问题。我们从信息论和最优编码的角度来研究知识图谱的表示方法，重点关注细粒度分解与概念紧凑化之间的平衡。基于这一视角，我们提出了一个以查询为驱动的框架，用于从文本中构建和检索知识图谱，旨在将密集检索的鲁棒性与符号表示的明确可查询性相结合。

papers.title: TokLens: A Multilingual Lens on Tokenizer Quality for LLMs
papers.title_zh: TokLens：一种用于评估LLM分词器质量的多语言工具
papers.authors: Guan-Ming Chiu
papers.abstract: We introduce TokLens, an open-source toolkit for evaluating tokenizer quality across languages using six intrinsic metrics: fertility, characters per token, compression ratio, normalized sequence length, single-token retention rate, and cross-lingual parity. We evaluate 24 tokenizers from major LLM families across 15 typologically diverse languages and correlate these metrics with downstream performance. Our analysis reveals stark disparities: GPT-2 produces 56x more tokens per word in Japanese than in English, while newer tokenizers like Qwen2.5 and Gemma-2 reduce this gap to under 4x. No intrinsic metric predicts English benchmark performance after controlling for model size. However, on multilingual benchmarks (MMLU-ProX), linear mixed-effects models show that tokenizer metrics significantly predict per-language performance (STRR: \beta = +5.7, z = 18.5, p < 0.001). A controlled experiment on the Qwen2.5 family further shows that languages with higher single-token retention rate exhibit steeper scaling slopes (\rho = 0.91, p < 0.001). These results indicate that tokenizer quality is significantly associated with multilingual LLM performance, though the evidence remains correlational and partially confounded with pretraining data composition.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了TokLens，这是一个开源工具包，用于通过六个核心指标来评估不同语言中的分词器质量：词频、每个词的字符数、压缩比、归一化序列长度、单词保留率以及跨语言公平性。我们对来自15种不同类型语言的24种分词器进行了评估，并将这些指标与下游性能进行了关联分析。我们的分析显示出了显著的差异：GPT-2在日语中每单词产生的词频是英语的56倍，而像Qwen2.5和Gemma-2这样的新型分词器则将这一差距缩小到了4倍以下。在控制模型规模后，没有任何一个核心指标能够预测英语领域的基准性能。然而，在多语言基准测试（MMLU-ProX）中，线性混合效应模型表明，分词器指标可以显著预测每种语言的表现（STRR：β=+5.7，z=18.5，p<0.001）。对Qwen2.5系列的分词器进行的实验进一步表明，那些单词保留率较高的语言表现出更陡峭的性能增长趋势（ρ=0.91，p<0.001）。这些结果表明，分词器的质量与多语言大语言模型的性能密切相关，不过这种相关性仍然具有相关性，并且部分受到预训练数据组成的影响。

papers.title: Phase Transitions in Affective Meaning Divergence: The Hidden Drift Before the Break
papers.title_zh: 情感意义差异的相位转换：破裂前的隐性趋势
papers.authors: Napassorn Litchiowong
papers.abstract: One partner says “Fine” meaning resolution; the other hears surrender. The word is shared; the affective uptake is not. We formalize this as affective meaning divergence (AMD), the total-variation distance between interlocutors’ anchor-conditioned affect distributions. Building on speech-act theory, common-ground accumulation, and entropy-regularized game theory, we derive a logit best-response map whose dynamics undergo a saddle-node bifurcation: when \beta\alpha > 4, a monotone increase in AMD-driven load produces an abrupt, hysteretic collapse of repair coordination. On Conversations Gone Awry (CGA-Wiki; N=652), derailing conversations exhibit critical-slowing-down (CSD) signatures across multiple levels: lexical divergence variance (p<0.001, d=0.36), AMD variance (p=0.001, d=0.26), and dialog-act repair variance (p=0.016, d=0.20), all significant after correction and stronger than toxicity and sentiment baselines. AMD provides a distinct temporal signature, with retrospectively measured variance peaking at the bifurcation point while toxicity variance peaks earlier, and is the only indicator grounded in the theoretical framework. Boundary-condition analysis on CGA-CMV (N=1,169) yields mixed but directionally consistent evidence.
papers.abstract_zh: 一个对话伙伴说“好”，意味着解决方案已经达成；另一个伙伴则听到的是“放弃”。这两个词是共享的，但情感上的接受却不同。我们将这种现象定义为情感意义分歧（AMD），即双方基于锚定条件的情感分布之间的总差异距离。基于言语行为理论、共同基础积累以及熵正则化博弈论，我们推导出一个逻辑斯蒂最佳响应映射，该映射的动态过程会经历鞍点分岔：当βα大于4时，由AMD驱动的负荷呈单调增加，导致修复协调机制的突然、滞后性的崩溃。在《出错的对话》（CGA-Wiki；样本量652）中，偏离正常轨道的对话表现出多个层面的关键减速特征：词汇差异方差显著（p<0.001，d=0.36）、AMD方差显著（p=0.001，d=0.26），以及对话行为修复的方差显著（p=0.016，d=0.20）。这些差异在经过修正后依然显著，且比毒性和情绪基线的差异更为明显。AMD提供了一种独特的时间特征，通过回顾性测量发现，其方差在分岔点达到峰值，而毒性方差的峰值则更早。AMD是唯一基于理论框架得出的指标。对CGA-CMV进行边界条件分析后，得到了混合但方向一致的证据。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Sycophantic Anchors: Localizing and Quantifying User Agreement in Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 阿谀奉承的“锚点”：在推理模型中定位与量化用户同意程度
papers.authors: Jacek Duszenko, Przemyslaw Kazienko, Jan Kocon
papers.abstract: Reasoning models frequently agree with incorrect user suggestions - a behavior known as sycophancy. However, it is unclear where in the reasoning trace this agreement originates and how strong the commitment is. We introduce sycophantic anchors - sentences identified via counterfactual analysis that commit models to user agreement. Across four reasoning models spanning three architecture families (Llama, Qwen, Falcon-hybrid) and 1.5B - 8B parameters, we analyze over 200,000 counterfactual rollouts and show that linear probes reliably detect sycophantic anchors (74 - 85% balanced accuracy), outperforming text-only baselines at high commitment levels -confirming they capture internal states beyond surface vocabulary. Regressors further predict commitment strength from activations (R^2 up to 0.74). We observe a consistent asymmetry: sycophancy leaves a stronger mechanistic footprint than correct reasoning. We also find that sycophancy builds gradually during generation rather than being determined by the prompt. These findings enable sentence-level detection and quantification of model misalignment mid-inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理模型常常同意用户不正确的建议——这种行为被称为阿谀奉承。然而，我们并不清楚这种一致性在推理过程中是从哪里产生的，以及其强度如何。我们引入了“阿谀奉承锚点”——这些是通过反事实分析识别出的句子，它们促使模型同意用户的建议。我们在四种推理模型中进行了研究，这些模型涵盖了三种架构家族（Llama、Qwen、Falcon-hybrid），并且模型的参数数量从15亿到80亿不等。我们分析了超过20万次反事实推理实验，结果显示线性探针能够可靠地检测到阿谀奉承锚点（平衡准确率为74%至85%），其性能优于仅基于文本的基础模型，尤其是在模型承诺强度较高的情况下——这表明它们能够捕捉到超出表面词汇量的内部状态。此外，回归模型还能根据激活值来预测承诺的强度（R²高达0.74）。我们发现了一个一致的不对称性：阿谀奉承留下的机制痕迹比正确推理更为明显。我们还发现，阿谀奉承是在生成过程中逐渐形成的，而不是由提示直接决定的。这些发现使得我们在推理过程中能够检测和量化模型的偏差情况。

papers.title: NEAT-IR: Neural Explainable Analysis Tool for Information Retrieval
papers.title_zh: NEAT-IR：一种用于信息检索的神经网络可解释分析工具
papers.authors: Lev Sukherman, Artem Frenk, Nina Klimenkova, Connor Jason
papers.abstract: Neural IR models achieve strong performance but remain difficult to interpret. We present NEAT-IR, a black-box analysis framework that explains ColBERT’s ranking behavior using 26 classical IR features (BM25, TF-IDF, IDF measures, positional signals). We analyze ColBERT through two complementary lenses: regression (predicting exact scores) and learning-to-rank (predicting relative order), evaluated on MS MARCO (48,250 query-passage pairs). Our key finding is a score-rank gap: classical features preserve ColBERT’s rankings nearly perfectly (NDCG@5 \approx 0.99) yet explain only R^2 \approx 0.28 of score variance. Feature attribution reveals that regression and ranking models rely on distinct feature subsets: query-level IDF signals dominate score prediction, while document-matching features (BM25, cosine TF-IDF) drive ranking preservation. These findings suggest that ColBERT’s ordinal behavior on MS MARCO is largely recoverable from classical signals, while neural contributions primarily affect score magnitude. NEAT-IR enables practitioners to diagnose when neural rankers deviate from classical patterns, supporting interpretable model auditing and informed hybrid pipeline design.
papers.abstract_zh: 神经信息检索模型虽然性能优异，但依然难以解释。我们提出了NEAT-IR这一黑箱分析框架，该框架利用26种经典信息检索特征（如BM25、TF-IDF、IDF指标、位置信号）来解释ColBERT的排名行为。我们通过两种互补的方法来分析ColBERT：回归分析（预测具体得分）和学习排序（预测相对顺序），并在MS MARCO数据集上进行了评估，该数据集包含48,250对查询与文档的对齐样本。我们的主要发现是存在一个得分与排名之间的差距：经典特征几乎完美地保留了ColBERT的排名稳定性（NDCG@5约为0.99），但仅能解释约0.28的得分方差。特征归因分析表明，回归模型和排序模型依赖于不同的特征子集：查询级别的IDF信号在得分预测中起着主导作用，而文档匹配特征（如BM25、余弦TF-IDF）则负责维持排名的稳定性。这些发现表明，ColBERT在MS MARCO数据集上的排序行为在很大程度上可以从经典特征中恢复出来，而神经模型的贡献主要体现在得分的大小上。NEAT-IR使得研究人员能够诊断神经排序模型何时偏离了经典模式，从而支持可解释的模型审计以及有根据的混合式管道设计。

papers.title: BanglaSocialBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Sociopragmatic and Cultural Alignment of LLMs in Bangladeshi Social Interaction
papers.title_zh: 孟加拉语社交平台：用于评估大型语言模型在孟加拉国社交互动中的语用能力及文化适应性的一项基准测试
papers.authors: Tanvir Ahmed Sijan, S. M. Golam Rifat, Pankaj Partha, Md. Tanjeed Islam, Md Musfique Anwar
papers.abstract: Large Language Models have demonstrated strong multilingual fluency, yet fluency alone does not guarantee socially appropriate language use. In high-context languages, communicative competence requires sensitivity to social hierarchy, relational roles, and interactional norms that are encoded directly in everyday language. Bangla exemplifies this challenge through its three-tiered pronominal system, kinship-based addressing, and culturally embedded social customs. We introduce BanglaSocialBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate sociopragmatic competence in Bangla through context-dependent language use rather than factual recall. The benchmark spans three domains: Bangla Address Terms, Kinship Reasoning, and Social Customs, comprising 1,719 culturally grounded instances written and verified by native Bangla speakers. We evaluate twelve contemporary LLMs in a zero-shot setting and observe systematic patterns of cultural misalignment. Models frequently default to overly formal address forms, fail to recognize multiple socially acceptable address pronouns, and conflate kinship terminology across religious contexts. Our findings show that sociopragmatic failures are often structured and non-random; for example, inappropriate addressing choices concentrate heavily in downward-hierarchy (Elder\rightarrowYounger) and informal contexts. This reveals persistent limitations in how current LLMs infer and apply culturally appropriate language use in realistic Bangladeshi social interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多语言处理方面表现出强大的能力，但仅凭这种能力并不能保证使用符合社会规范的语言。在高语境语言中，交际能力要求人们能够敏感地理解社会等级、关系角色以及日常语言中直接体现的互动规范。孟加拉语就面临着这样的挑战——其代词系统分为三个层级、基于亲属关系的称呼方式，以及根深蒂固的社会习俗，都体现了这一挑战。我们推出了BanglaSocialBench这个基准测试工具，该工具旨在通过依赖上下文的语言使用来评估孟加拉语的社会语用能力，而非仅仅依靠事实记忆。该基准测试涵盖三个领域：孟加拉语称呼术语、亲属关系推理以及社会习俗，共包含1,719个由孟加拉语母语者编写并验证的文化相关实例。我们在零样本环境下对十二种现代大语言模型进行了评估，发现它们存在系统性的人文差异问题。这些模型常常采用过于正式的称呼形式，无法识别多种社会认可的称呼代词，还会在不同宗教背景下混淆亲属称谓。我们的研究结果表明，这些语言模型的社交语用失误往往是有规律的，而非随机现象；例如，不恰当的称呼选择主要集中在较低等级（长辈→年轻人）和非正式场合。这揭示了当前大语言模型在推断和应用适合孟加拉国现实社会互动的语言使用方面的持续局限性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Interpretability of LLM Classifiers via the Rational Inattention Theory with Application to Hate Speech Detection
papers.title_zh: 利用理性注意力理论解析大语言模型分类器的可解释性，并应用于仇恨言论检测领域
papers.authors: Yuan Zhao, Ali Abdi
papers.abstract: Hate speech detection is essential for maintaining healthy online communities. Large language models (LLMs) perform well on text classification, yet their decision strategies need to be better understood. While post-hoc rationales can justify individual decisions, they substantially increase inference cost and limit scalability in high-throughput settings. As another approach, we propose an extended rational inattention model that parameterizes linguistic noise and information processing cost, providing an interpretable behavioral framework for black-box LLM classifiers. Treating LLMs as rational decision-makers under information constraints allows us to estimate - from the observed classification behavior - the parameters that represent information processing cost and noise sensitivity. As a case study and using a hate-speech dataset spanning multiple noise environments, we evaluate four commercial LLMs and show that the introduced extended rational inattention model predictions closely match the observed performance across different noise levels. We further test the performance under various noise mechanisms and find that the inferred information cost parameters remain consistent while the noise parameters vary with the distortion mechanism. Overall, our introduced framework offers a cost-efficient and quantitative approach to derive interpretable indices of LLM moderation behavior and decisions, without additional rationale generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 仇恨言论检测对于维护健康的在线社区至关重要。大语言模型在文本分类任务上表现良好，但其决策策略仍需进一步研究。虽然事后理由可以解释个别决策，但这会大幅增加推理成本，并限制在高吞吐量环境下的可扩展性。作为另一种方法，我们提出了一种扩展的理性忽略模型，该模型能够参数化语言噪声和信息处理成本，为黑盒式语言模型分类器提供了一个可解释的行为框架。将语言模型视为在信息约束下的理性决策者，我们可以根据观察到的分类行为来估计代表信息处理成本和噪声敏感性的参数。通过案例研究，并利用一个涵盖多种噪声环境的仇恨言论数据集，我们对四种商业语言模型进行了评估，结果表明，所提出的扩展理性忽略模型的预测结果与不同噪声水平下的实际表现非常吻合。我们还测试了在不同噪声机制下的性能，发现推断出的信息成本参数保持一致，而噪声参数则随着失真机制的变化而变化。总体而言，我们提出的框架提供了一种高效且定量的方法，用于得出可解释的语言模型调节行为和决策指标，而无需额外的理由生成过程。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Shape of Vulnerability: How Adversarial Perturbations Reshape the Topology of Language Model Latent Spaces
papers.title_zh: 脆弱性的形态：对抗性扰动如何重塑语言模型潜在空间的拓扑结构
papers.authors: Angelina Tsai, Shreya Subramanian, Catherine Liu, Kimberly Lopez, Leif Zinn-Brooks, Alexia E. Schulz, Adaku Uchendu
papers.abstract: Adversarial perturbations in the context of large language models (LLMs) are subtle changes added to input data (i.e., images or text) that are designed to alter predictions or outputs of machine learning models. We introduce several novel visualizations using topological data analysis (TDA) (leveraging persistent homology) to characterize how adversarial perturbations act on text inputs, specifically, how sandbagging and code-injection attacksalter the geometric structure of attention heads in transformer models. By computing persistent homology metrics from attention maps across different model architectures (such as BERT, RoBERTa, ELECTRA, DistilGPT, etc.), we find that adversarial inputs alter higher-dimensional topological features (H_{1} loops and H_{2} voids) in ways that distinguish them from clean, non-adversarial inputs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型（LLM）的语境中，对抗性扰动指的是对输入数据（如图像或文本）进行的细微修改，这些修改旨在改变机器学习模型的预测结果或输出。我们采用了拓扑数据分析技术（利用持久同调），通过多种新颖的可视化方法来研究对抗性扰动对文本输入的影响。具体来说，我们研究了“沙袋填充”攻击和“代码注入”攻击如何改变Transformer模型中注意力头的几何结构。通过对不同模型架构下的注意力图进行持久同调分析，我们发现对抗性输入会改变高维拓扑特征（如H_1环和H_2空洞），而这些变化使得对抗性输入与干净、无对抗性的输入有所区别。

papers.title: LLM-based Literal Example Generation for Japanese Multiword Expressions
papers.title_zh: 基于LLM的日语多词表达字面意思生成技术
papers.authors: Mio Ohashi, Hajime Kiyama, Zhidong Ling, Mamoru Komachi
papers.abstract: We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can generate literal usage examples for Japanese multiword expressions (MWEs), whose literal readings are structurally low-frequency in available corpora.Prior work on MWEs has largely focused on detecting idiomatic usages in context, leaving literal usages underrepresented particularly for Japanese MWEs whose literal readings are rare and structurally diverse.Because literal readings are rarely attested in corpora, we design a lexicon-grounded setup that uses corpus non-literal usages as contrastive cues for controlled prompting. We evaluate the generated sentences using automatic literalness judgments and human literalness judgments, together with manual inspection.Our results show that providing contrastive non-literal information stabilizes literal generation and improves quality compared with prompts that include only literal information or no hints. In addition, we conduct an LLM-based understanding test that compares model predictions of literal and idiomatic plausibility with human judgments.The results indicate that the model aligns more closely with human judgments for idiomatic interpretations than for literal ones, highlighting the relative difficulty of modeling literal readings of MWEs.The study demonstrates that LLMs can complement existing resources by supplying frequency-independent literal examples and offers a controlled framework for examining contextual meaning understanding of Japanese MWEs.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了大语言模型是否能够为日语多词表达生成实际用法示例。这些多词表达的实际读法在现有语料库中的出现频率较低。之前关于多词表达的研究主要集中在检测上下文中的习语用法，而实际用法则被严重忽视了——尤其是对于日语多词表达来说，其实际读法非常罕见且结构多样。由于实际读法在语料库中很少被记录，我们设计了一种基于词汇表的方案，利用语料库中的非字面用法作为对比线索来进行有控制的提示。我们通过自动判断、人类判断以及人工检查来评估生成的句子。研究结果表明，提供对比性的非字面信息能够稳定地生成实际用法，并且其质量比仅包含字面信息或没有任何提示的提示要好。此外，我们还进行了基于大语言模型的理解测试，将模型对实际用法的判断与人类的判断进行比较。结果显示，模型在判断习语用法时与人类判断更为一致，而在判断实际用法时则存在较大差异，这凸显了建模多词表达实际读法的相对难度。这项研究表明，大语言模型可以通过提供与频率无关的实际用法示例来补充现有的资源，并为检验日语多词表达的上下文意义理解提供了一个可控的框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Presentation Slide Translation and Layout Error Correction by LLMs
papers.title_zh: 演示幻灯片翻译与布局错误修正——基于大语言模型的解决方案
papers.authors: Futo Kajita, Nobuyori Nishimura, Takehito Utsuro, Naoki Muto, Chee Siang Leow, Hiromitsu Nishizaki
papers.abstract: We propose a novel approach to translating Japanese slides into English andto correcting their layout errors by utilizing multimodal LLMs with slide images and XML structures.Existing translation tools often suffer from layout errors after translationdue to text expansion during the translation process, causing text to overlap with figures or other items in slides and thereby reducing readability. To overcome this issue, our proposed framework introduces two steps consisting of (i) translating text fragments within the slide, and (ii) correcting layout errors by optimizing layout placement based on visual consistency. In step (ii), we empirically show that few-shot prompts are quite effective in layout error correction. Given that the optimal combination of steps (i) and (ii) varies depending on the slide layout, our method generates eight different layout candidates. Consequently, we introduce a third step that automatically selects the optimal output from these eight candidates.The experimental results showed that the proposed method outperformed baselines and achieved 4.1% layout error rate and over 80% model selection success rate.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法，利用多模态大语言模型将日语幻灯片翻译成英文，并纠正其布局错误。现有的翻译工具在翻译过程中由于文本扩展而经常出现布局错误，导致文本与幻灯片中的图表或其他元素重叠，从而降低可读性。为了克服这个问题，我们的框架分为两个步骤：(i) 翻译幻灯片内的文本片段；(ii) 通过优化布局位置来纠正布局错误。在第二步中，我们通过实验证明，少样本提示在纠正布局错误方面非常有效。由于步骤(i)和(ii)的最佳组合会根据幻灯片的布局而有所不同，我们的方法会生成八种不同的布局候选方案。因此，我们还引入了第三步，该步骤会自动从这八种候选方案中选出最佳输出。实验结果表明，所提出的方法优于现有基线方法，其布局错误率降低了4.1%，模型选择成功率达到了80%以上。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Constructing a Japanese Rap Lyric Generation Model with GRPO
papers.title_zh: 利用GRPO构建日语说唱歌词生成模型
papers.authors: Hayato Ogawa, Daisuke Kawahara
papers.abstract: Rap is a vocal style rooted in Hip-Hop culture, characterized by producing rhymes in synchrony with a rhythmic beat.This paper proposes a method for generating Japanese rap lyrics with a large language model (LLM) whose rhyming behavior is improved via reinforcement learning.We design a reward function that evaluates end rhymes between two generated bars and apply GRPO, a reinforcement-learning method, to encourage Japanese rhyming without using existing Japanese rap lyrics as training data.Experimental results show that, although output collapse is observed in some cases, GRPO increases the proportion of outputs that receive moderate or high human ratings on rhyme-related criteria.
papers.abstract_zh: 说唱是一种源自嘻哈文化的声乐风格，其特点是以与节奏节拍同步的方式创作歌词。本文提出了一种利用大语言模型生成日语说唱歌词的方法，通过强化学习来改进模型的押韵能力。我们设计了一个奖励函数，用于评估两个生成的歌词之间的押韵效果，并采用GRPO这种强化学习方法，以鼓励生成符合日语押韵规则的歌词，而无需使用现有的日语说唱歌词作为训练数据。实验结果表明，虽然在某些情况下会出现输出内容重复的情况，但GRPO能够增加那些在押韵方面获得中等或高评价的输出比例。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Tracking the Evolution of Foresight Signals in News Data: The Case of the European Electric Vehicle Market
papers.title_zh: 追踪新闻数据中预见性信号的演变：以欧洲电动汽车市场为例
papers.authors: Karine Navasartian
papers.abstract: To prepare for an uncertain future, organizations must continuously monitor emerging trends and early signals of change. The increasing availability of web-based textual data has boosted natural language processing (NLP) methods in strategic foresight, particularly in the scanning phase. While prior studies have extensively focused on the identification of signals in such data, considerably less attention has been paid to how these signals evolve over time and gain relevance as they become more visible. This study addresses this gap by examining whether tracking the temporal dynamics of signals can improve their assessment for strategic decision-making. Demonstrated on the use case of the European electric vehicle market, we find three dominant signal trajectories and show that burst dynamics tend to surface signal consolidation rather than the early detection of weak signals. The results indicate that foresight research should move beyond static, one-off analyses toward a dynamic temporal perspective capable of identifying signals at earlier stages of emergence.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了应对不确定的未来，组织必须持续关注新兴趋势以及变化的早期信号。基于网络的文本数据日益丰富，这为战略预测中的自然语言处理技术提供了更多机会，尤其是在扫描阶段。虽然之前的研究主要集中在识别这些数据中的信号上，但对于这些信号如何随时间演变以及如何随着其变得更加明显而变得重要，却缺乏足够的关注。本研究试图填补这一空白，探讨跟踪信号的时间动态是否有助于更好地进行战略决策。通过以欧洲电动汽车市场为例进行实证研究，我们发现存在三种主要的信号轨迹，并且发现突发性的动态往往会导致信号的整合，而不是弱信号的早期识别。研究结果表明，战略预测研究应该从静态、一次性分析转向动态的时间视角，以便能够在信号出现的早期阶段就识别出它们。

papers.title: Debiasing Logical Fallacy Detection for Real-World Robustness via Counterfactually Augmented Data
papers.title_zh: 通过补充性数据来检测逻辑谬误，从而实现在现实场景中的稳健应用
papers.authors: Navyansh Singh
papers.abstract: Logical fallacy detection models frequentlyover-flag valid reasoning due to reliance onsurface-level spurious correlations. We in-troduce 703 LLM-generated CounterfactuallyAugmented Data (CAD) pairs—minimally dif-ferentiated valid and fallacious arguments—todebias models through targeted augmentation.Fine-tuning DeBERTa-v3-large on CoCoLoFaaugmented with these pairs yields marginalin-distribution improvement (+0.4% F1) butsubstantial out-of-distribution robustness: 58%relative reduction in false positive rate (64%→ 26.7%) on a 300-sample Reddit-sourcedevaluation set. While recent LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B) achieve high perfor-mance under optimized prompts (F1 90–94%),they degrade severely under simple human-like prompts (F1 63–72%, FPR 54–74%).Our lightweight, prompt-invariant approachachieves competitive robustness (F1 85.9%,FPR 26.7%) across all prompting regimes with-out prompt engineering, making it stable forproduction deployment with unpredictable userinput. The dataset and model are publicly re-leased.
papers.abstract_zh: 逻辑谬误检测模型由于依赖表面上的虚假相关性，常常过度标记有效的推理。我们引入了703对由大语言模型生成的“事实增强数据”对——这些数据包含差异最小的有效和错误论点——以通过有针对性的增强来消除模型偏差。在CoCoLoF数据集上，对DeBERTa-v3-large模型进行微调并加入这些数据对后，模型的性能有所提升（F1分数提高了0.4%），同时获得了显著的鲁棒性：在300个样本的红迪网评估集上，假阳性率降低了58%（从64%降至26.7%）。虽然最近的一些大语言模型（如Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B）在优化后的提示下表现优异（F1分数达到90-94%），但在简单的类似人类提示下，它们的性能会严重下降（F1分数仅为63-72%，假阳性率达到54-74%）。我们的轻量级、不依赖于特定提示的方法能够在所有提示条件下实现具有竞争力的鲁棒性（F1分数达到85.9%，假阳性率仅为26.7%），无需对提示进行特殊设计，因此适用于具有不可预测用户输入的生产环境部署。该数据集和模型已公开提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Bring Linguistics Back to Cryptanalysis: Using Attestation to Break the Advanced Encryption Standard
papers.title_zh: 让语言学重新服务于密码分析：利用认证机制突破高级加密标准
papers.authors: Madeline Boese
papers.abstract: The Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) is currently considered the preferred standard of encryption for secure messaging by the National Institute of Standards and Technology. While its predecessor, the Data Encryption Standard (DES), can be analyzed in mere seconds with modern cryptanalysis algorithms, those same algorithms are unfeasible for cryptanalysis of AES. This is primarily because the key, or the list of values used during encryption, was increased from a length of 56 bits to 128 bits. The list of all possible combinations, also called the probability space, is tens of magnitudes larger in AES than DES. Current DES cryptanalysis methods use mathematical methods to find the most statistically likely approximate key in the entire probability space. The increased probability space in AES is too large to find an approximation using these formulas. However, these methods operate under the assumption that every key is possible. While this is mathematically true, when looked at from the lens of a linguist, many of these keys create messages that are impossible in language. Linguistic attestation is the documentation that a word, grapheme, sound, or other linguistic feature exists in a language. This thesis proposal presents an algorithm that eliminates AES keys using linguistic attestation. I apply the idea that any grammatical message encrypted by AES will not contain any “unattested” data in its input. The algorithm proposes trimming the probability space by removing keys that are unattested. Once a smaller probability space has been created, any method that searches the probability space for a solution may be applied to find the key from the new, smaller list of filtered keys.
papers.abstract_zh: 高级加密标准（AES）目前被美国国家标准与技术研究院视为安全消息传递的首选加密标准。虽然其前身——数据加密标准（DES）——可以用现代密码分析算法在几秒钟内被破解，但同样的算法对于破解AES来说是不可行的。这主要是因为密钥的长度从56位增加到了128位。在AES中，所有可能组合的数量比DES多出数十倍。目前的DES密码分析方法采用数学方法，在全部概率空间中寻找统计上最有可能接近的正确密钥。而AES中增大的概率空间太大，无法用这些公式来寻找近似密钥。不过，这些方法假设每个密钥都是可能的。虽然这在数学上是成立的，但从语言学角度来看，许多这样的密钥所生成的消息在语言上是不合理的。语言认证是指证明某个词、字符、声音或其他语言特征确实存在于某种语言中的过程。本论文提案提出了一种利用语言认证来排除无效密钥的算法。我基于这样一个观点：任何通过AES加密的语法正确的消息，其输入中都不会包含任何“未经验证”的数据。该算法通过移除那些未经验证的密钥来缩小概率空间。一旦得到了一个更小的概率空间，就可以使用任何方法来搜索这个新的、经过筛选的密钥列表，从而找到正确的密钥。

papers.title: Garden Path Recovery in Causal and Masked Language Models
papers.title_zh: 因果语言模型和掩码语言模型中的花园小径恢复机制
papers.authors: Sanjan Baitalik, Rajashik Datta
papers.abstract: Garden-path sentences offer a controlled probe of English incremental sentence processing because they require a reader to revise an initially plausible parse when a later region disambiguates the structure. We present an architecture-aware comparison of garden-path recovery in causal and masked language models using 100 English garden-path/control pairs (200 sentences) spanning three constructions: NP/Z, where a noun phrase is initially read as a direct object but must be reanalyzed as the subject of a zero-complement clause; NP/S, where a noun phrase must be reanalyzed as the subject of an embedded sentence; and MV/RR, where an apparent main verb must be reanalyzed as a reduced relative modifier. Causal models are evaluated with left-to-right word surprisal, whereas masked models are evaluated with pseudo-surprisal derived from masked language model scoring. Beyond the disambiguating word, we analyze cumulative excess surprisal, area-under-curve recovery summaries, and layer-wise hidden-state divergence between each garden-path sentence and its minimally different control. Across the audit-valid model set, causal models show larger within-model disambiguation effects than masked models overall, with the clearest family-level difference on NP/Z constructions. We interpret this difference cautiously because surprisal and pseudo-surprisal are not numerically commensurable across architectures or tokenizers. The results nevertheless show that architecture changes which recovery signals are observable: decoder-only models exhibit sharper online disruption at the point of syntactic revision, while bidirectional encoders appear comparatively buffered at the disambiguator due to right-context access. More broadly, the findings argue that garden-path evaluation should emphasize recovery dynamics, not merely end-state plausibility or task accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 花园路径句子提供了一种对英语渐进式句子处理机制的有控制的研究方式，因为它们要求读者在后续区域消除结构歧义时，重新分析最初看似合理的句法结构。我们采用架构感知的方法，对比了因果模型和掩码语言模型在恢复花园路径方面的表现，使用了100对包含花园路径/对照句的英语句子（共200个句子），这些句子来自三种句法结构：NP/Z结构，其中名词短语最初被解读为直接宾语，但必须重新分析为零补语从句的主语；NP/S结构，其中名词短语必须重新分析为嵌入式句子的主语；MV/RR结构，其中明显的主动词必须重新分析为简化的相对修饰成分。因果模型通过从左到右的词语惊讶度进行评估，而掩码模型则通过从掩码语言模型评分中得出的伪惊讶度来评估。除了消除歧义的词语之外，我们还分析了累积的过度惊讶度、曲线下面积恢复摘要，以及每个花园路径句子与其最小差异对照句之间的层级隐藏状态差异。在经过验证的模型集上，因果模型总体上显示出比掩码模型更大的内部消歧效果，尤其是在NP/Z结构上这种差异最为明显。我们对这种差异的解释持谨慎态度，因为惊讶度和伪惊讶度在不同架构或分词器之间是无法数值比较的。尽管如此，研究结果表明，架构的变化决定了哪些恢复信号是可观察到的：仅使用解码器的模型在句法修正点表现出更明显的在线干扰效应，而双向编码器由于能够访问右侧上下文，在消除歧义阶段表现得相对平稳。更广泛地说，这些发现表明，在评估花园路径时，应该关注恢复的动态过程，而不仅仅是最终状态的合理性或任务的准确性。

papers.title: Confidence as a Tie-Breaker: Reassessing Multilingual Hedging Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 信任程度作为附加因素：重新评估以语言模型作为裁判时的多语言对冲偏见问题
papers.authors: Rajashik Datta, Sanjan Baitalik
papers.abstract: LLM judges are often used to score generated answers, but their decisions may be affected by surface style rather than semantic correctness. We introduce PolyJudge-Uncertain, a controlled benchmark for studying multilingual hedging effects in LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. The benchmark contains 5,120 short factual QA instances across English, Hindi, Hinglish, and Bengali, balancing assertive versus hedged style and correct versus incorrect answers. A small pilot suggested a large pointwise penalty against hedged answers. After repairing multilingual templates and adding quality-control checks, this pointwise effect largely disappears: final pointwise accuracy is 99.8%, with no meaningful assertive-hedged gap. The robust remaining effect is pairwise: when two answers are equally correct and differ only in style, the judge prefers the assertive answer in 1,276 of 1,280 cases. We interpret this as a protocol- and task-specific assertiveness preference, not as a universal bias against hedging. Our findings highlight benchmark auditing as a central requirement for multilingual judge-bias research.
papers.abstract_zh: LLM裁判通常用于评分生成的答案，但他们的判断可能会受到表面风格的影响，而非语义的正确性。我们引入了PolyJudge-Uncertain这一对照基准测试，用于研究在LLM作为裁判评估中的多语言修饰效果。该基准测试包含5,120个简短的事实性问答实例，涉及英语、印地语、英印混合语和孟加拉语，同时平衡了肯定式风格与修饰式风格，以及正确与错误的答案。初步实验表明，对修饰式答案有较大的点惩罚力度。经过修复多语言模板并添加质量控制检查后，这种点惩罚效应基本消失：最终的点准确率达到了99.8%，且肯定式与修饰式答案之间没有明显的差异。剩下的稳健效应是成对出现的：当两个答案同样正确且仅在风格上有所不同时，裁判在1,280个案例中有1,276个情况下更倾向于选择肯定式答案。我们认为这是一种与协议和任务相关的肯定性偏好，而不是一种普遍存在的反对修饰的偏见。我们的研究结果强调了基准审计在多语言裁判偏见研究中的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BanglaSTEM: A Parallel Corpus and Term-Weighted Evaluation for Technical Bangla-English Translation
papers.title_zh: 孟加拉语科技文献：一个平行语料库以及用于技术类孟加拉语-英语翻译的术语加权评估方法
papers.authors: Kazi Reyazul Hasan, A. B. M. Alim Al Islam, Muhammad Abdullah Adnan
papers.abstract: Large language models excel at technical problem solving in English but struggle when questions are posed in Bangla. While translation offers a practical solution, existing Bangla-English systems frequently mistranslate specialized terminology, altering problem semantics and degrading downstream performance. We present BanglaSTEM, a dataset of 5,000 Bangla-English sentence pairs covering computer science, mathematics, physics, chemistry, and biology. Our pipeline extracts matching passages from official bilingual curriculum textbooks using OCR, then uses LLMs to align sentences and mark technical terms. These aligned examples serve as few-shot prompts for generating over 12,000 new translation pairs from LLMs, avoiding copyright issues. Human evaluators then select the best 5,000 pairs that correctly preserve technical terminology. We also test a term-weighted BLEU metric that gives higher weight to technical words, since standard metrics treat terminology errors and common word errors equally. We show that our weighted metric correlates better with downstream accuracy in code generation and math solving, while standard BLEU gives high scores even for wrong translations. The full implementation, dataset, and model will be made publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解决英语技术问题方面表现出色，但在用孟加拉语提出问题时却表现不佳。虽然翻译可以作为一种实用的解决方案，但现有的孟加拉语-英语系统经常误译专业术语，这会改变问题的语义，从而降低后续处理的性能。我们提出了BanglaSTEM数据集，该数据集包含5,000对孟加拉语和英语的句子对，涵盖计算机科学、数学、物理、化学和生物学领域。我们的方法首先使用OCR从官方双语教材中提取相应的段落，然后利用大语言模型对句子进行对齐并标记专业术语。这些对齐后的例子可以作为少量样本，用于生成超过12,000对新的翻译对，从而避免版权问题。人类评估者随后会选出最优秀的5,000对翻译对，这些翻译对能够准确保留专业术语。我们还测试了一种基于术语权重的BLEU指标，该指标对专业词汇给予更高的权重，因为标准指标对术语错误和普通单词错误是同等对待的。我们发现，这种加权指标与代码生成和数学解题的下游准确率有更好的相关性，而标准BLEU指标即使对于错误的翻译也能获得高分。完整的实现方案、数据集以及模型都将公开提供。

papers.title: Disentangling the Effects of Unlearning in Measuring Parametric Faithfulness of Chain-of-Thought
papers.title_zh: 解析“遗忘效应”在衡量思维链的参数忠实度方面的作用
papers.authors: Ryo Mitsuhashi, Gaku Morio, Ayana Niwa, Masahiro Kaneko, Kentaro Inui, Terufumi Morishita, Yuta Koreeda, Yasuhiro Sogawa
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) in large language models (LLMs) has been widely debated in terms of whether it faithfully reflects an internal reasoning process of models. Parametric faithfulness is a recently proposed metric that uses unlearning to assess whether a model encodes parametric beliefs corresponding to a reasoning chain. This paper refines this metric by accounting for the unintended artifacts of unlearning. We introduce control tasks that unlearn irrelevant knowledge and word-shuffled content and show that these control tasks yield substantial parametric faithfulness values, suggesting the non-negligible effect of unlearning. We also found that control tasks help explain the significant variations in parametric faithfulness observed across different model sizes and CoT lengths. We conclude that the effects of unlearning need to be considered when measuring parametric faithfulness.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中，思维链技术是否真正反映了模型的内部推理过程一直存在争议。参数忠实度是一种新提出的评估指标，它通过反学习的方式来判断模型是否包含了与推理链相对应的参数化信念。本文通过考虑反学习过程中产生的意外结果，对这一指标进行了改进。我们引入了一些控制任务，这些任务用于消除无关知识和随机排列的内容，结果表明这些控制任务能够显著提高参数忠实度，这表明反学习的效应是不可忽视的。此外，我们还发现，这些控制任务有助于解释不同模型规模和思维链长度下参数忠实度的显著差异。因此，在衡量参数忠实度时，需要考虑反学习的效应。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FedPAGR: Federated Prototype Alignment via Geometric Refinement for Heterogeneous Architectures
papers.title_zh: FedPAGR：通过几何优化实现异构架构的模型对齐
papers.authors: Kris Prasad, Md Abdullah Al Hafiz Khan
papers.abstract: Federated learning with heterogeneous client architectures cannot rely on parameter aggregation. Prototype-based methods address architectural heterogeneity by exchanging class-level representations, but naively averaging prototypes across non-IID clients leads to semantic drift and poor inter-class separation. We propose FedPAGR, a framework where heterogeneous clients project their features into a shared consensus space and exchange class prototypes with a central server. The server refines aggregated prototypes through a geometric regularization objective that enforces agreement with client submissions and inter-class angular separation. Clients anchor their classifiers to the refined prototypes and train with a composite objective combining classification, prototype alignment, and entropy regularization. We evaluate FedPAGR across multiple domains, including four image benchmarks and a clinical NLP task using heterogeneous ClinicalBERT variants, with five architectures per federation under severe label heterogeneity (\alpha{=}0.1). FedPAGR achieves the highest ensemble accuracy across all four image datasets and the highest local test accuracy on low-class and clinical tasks, including a 4.99-point improvement over the strongest baseline on MIMIC-IV, while remaining competitive on high-class benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 在具有不同架构的客户端环境中进行联邦学习时，无法依赖参数聚合方式。基于原型的方法可以通过交换类级表示来处理架构上的差异性问题，但简单地对来自非独立同分布客户端的原型进行平均处理会导致语义漂移以及类间分离效果不佳的问题。我们提出了FedPAGR框架：该框架允许异构客户端将其特征投影到共享的共识空间中，并与中央服务器交换类原型。中央服务器通过几何正则化目标来优化聚合原型，以确保原型与客户端提交的数据一致，并保持良好的类间角度分离。客户端将分类器锚定在优化后的原型上，并通过结合分类任务、原型对齐以及熵正则化的复合目标来进行训练。我们在多个领域对FedPAGR进行了评估，包括四个图像数据集以及一个使用异构ClinicalBERT变体的临床自然语言处理任务。在每个联邦中，我们使用了五种不同的架构，这些架构面临着严重的标签异质性（α=0.1）。结果表明，FedPAGR在所有四个图像数据集上都取得了最高的集成准确率，同时在低类别和临床任务上实现了最高的局部测试准确率。在MIMIC-IV数据集上，FedPAGR的表现比最强的基线方法提升了4.99个百分点，同时仍然能够在高类别基准测试中保持竞争力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Sentiment Analysis of Yelp Review Dataset: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Methods
papers.title_zh: Yelp评论数据集的情感分析：不同机器学习方法的比较研究
papers.authors: Krishna Thakar, Mohamed Abu Sheha, Emmanuel Thompson
papers.abstract: Sentiment analysis involves analyzing text to determine whether the sentiment expressed is positive, negative, or neutral. In the context of online reviews, such as those on Yelp, sentiment analysis helps businesses assess customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. Given the large volume of user-generated content, restaurants often struggle to extract actionable insights from feedback, making sentiment analysis an efficient tool for categorizing reviews and highlighting customer concerns. This study focuses on sentiment analysis of Yelp reviews. The main research question is: How can Natural Language Processing (NLP) combined with statistical machine learning methods be applied to classify sentiment in Yelp reviews and provide actionable insights for improving customer satisfaction, service quality, and business performance? The study used 21,000 Yelp reviews, utilizing NLP approaches - tokenization, stop-word removal, and vectorization. Comparative classification predictive modeling and analysis were done across traditional machine learning (Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naïve Bayes, Random Forest), deep learning methods (CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, GRU, RNN), and an advanced transformer-based (RoBERTa) model. Results showed that RoBERTa outperformed the other candidate methods. These findings highlight the potential of advanced NLP techniques to offer businesses practical ways to address customer complaints, enhance service quality, and drive overall business performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 情感分析涉及对文本进行分析，以确定所表达的情感是积极的、消极的还是中性的。在在线评论领域，比如Yelp上的评论，情感分析可以帮助企业评估客户满意度并找出需要改进的地方。由于用户生成的内容量巨大，餐厅往往难以从反馈中提取有用的信息，因此情感分析成为分类评论和凸显客户关切问题的有效工具。本研究重点是对Yelp评论进行情感分析。主要研究问题是：如何将自然语言处理技术结合统计机器学习方法应用于分类Yelp评论中的情感，从而提供有助于提升客户满意度、服务质量和业务绩效的实用建议？本研究使用了21,000条Yelp评论，采用了自然语言处理技术——分词、去除停用词以及向量化等步骤。通过比较传统的机器学习方法（逻辑回归、支持向量机、朴素贝叶斯、随机森林）和深度学习方法（卷积神经网络、长短期记忆网络、双向长短期记忆网络、门控循环单元、递归神经网络），以及先进的Transformer模型（RoBERTa），进行了分类预测建模与分析。结果表明，RoBERTa的表现优于其他候选方法。这些发现突显了先进的自然语言处理技术在为企业解决客户投诉问题、提高服务质量以及提升整体业务绩效方面所具有的潜力。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Semantic Span Annotation: An Exploratory Study of LLM Annotation
papers.title_zh: 语义范围标注：对大型语言模型标注功能的探索性研究
papers.authors: Tejas Goyal, Dhriti Krishnan, Anuj Gupta, Jaromir Savelka
papers.abstract: Structured span extraction research is siloed by context length, annotation task, and domain, making it difficult to assess how well large language models (LLMs) generalize across realistic extraction settings. We introduce SSA (Structured Span Annotation), a unified evaluation framework bringing together five datasets across four domains: finance, biomedicine, affective analysis, and privacy, under a common JSONL format with character-level offsets. We conduct an exploratory study evaluating seven models (three closed, four open-weight) under three prompting configurations: zero-shot, definition-augmented, and few-shot, formulating extraction as inline XML generation where models reproduce the document with tagged spans. Our results reveal two distinct performance regimes: on tasks requiring complex ontology reasoning, zero-shot performance is near zero (e.g., 0.00% F1 on FiNER-139) but improves substantially with label definitions (e.g., Claude Opus 4.6 rises from 8.8% to 57.5% F1); on pattern-based tasks like PII detection, definitions consistently hurt performance across all models. These findings suggest that prompting strategy must be matched to task structure, and that unified evaluation frameworks spanning varied domains and input lengths are essential for understanding LLM extraction capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 结构化跨度提取研究因上下文长度、注释任务以及领域差异而陷入孤立状态，这使得难以评估大语言模型在现实提取场景中的泛化能力。我们提出了SSA（结构化跨度注释）这一统一的评估框架，它将四个领域的五个数据集整合在一起，采用通用的JSONL格式，并包含字符级偏移信息。我们进行了探索性研究，对七种模型（三种封闭式模型、四种开放式模型）在三种提示配置下进行了评估：零样本、定义增强型以及少样本。我们将提取任务转化为在线XML生成，模型需要再现带有标记跨度的文档。我们的研究结果揭示了两种不同的性能表现：在需要复杂本体推理的任务上，零样本性能几乎为零（例如，在FiNER-139数据集上的F1分数仅为0.00%），但随着标签定义的引入，性能有了显著提升（例如，Claude Opus的F1分数从8.8%提升到了57.5%）；而在基于模式的任务上，如个人身份信息检测，定义的存在会显著降低所有模型的性能。这些发现表明，提示策略必须与任务结构相匹配，而跨越不同领域和输入长度的统一评估框架对于理解大语言模型的提取能力至关重要。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Thesis Proposal: An Explainable Multimodal Framework for Detecting Harmful Content in Code-Switched Children’s Media
papers.title_zh: 论文提案：一种可解释的多模态框架，用于检测混合语码儿童媒体中的有害内容
papers.authors: Juliana Isabelle A. Guillermo, Jasper Kyle Catapang, Nathaniel Oco
papers.abstract: Current automated content moderation systems fail to protect children from harmful YouTube content, particularly in under-resourced, code-switched settings. These systems are often text-only, English-centric, and operate as ’black boxes,’ lacking the multimodal understanding and transparency needed for effective moderation. This thesis proposes a novel hybrid framework for the explainable multimodal detection of harmful content in videos with code-switching. The proposed framework integrates a fine-tuned classifier for accurate, scalable detection with an LLM-powered module that synthesizes the classifier’s internal evidential signals (e.g., text attention and visual heat maps) to generate faithful, human-readable rationales for each decision. As a primary case study, the framework will be developed and validated on an English–Filipino code-switched dataset. Expected contributions include a new dataset publicly available under controlled access (de-identified transcripts, blacked-out frames, extracted feature representations, and metadata via data-sharing agreement) and a blueprint for building more equitable, transparent, and trustworthy AI safety systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的自动化内容审核系统无法保护儿童免受有害的YouTube内容的侵害，尤其是在资源匮乏、语码转换频繁的环境中。这些系统通常只支持文本形式，以英语为中心，且表现为“黑箱”式操作，缺乏有效审核所需的多模态理解和透明度。本论文提出了一种新颖的混合框架，用于解释性多模态检测视频中的有害内容。该框架结合了经过微调的分类器来实现准确、可扩展的检测功能，同时利用LLM模块来生成分类器的内部证据信号（如文本注意力值和视觉热图），从而为每个决策生成易于理解的解释。作为主要案例研究，该框架将在英菲拉宾语码转换数据集上进行开发和验证。预期贡献包括提供一个新的公开可用数据集（包含去标识化的文本、被遮盖的画面、提取的特征表示以及通过数据共享协议获得的元数据），以及一份构建更公平、透明和可信的人工智能安全系统的蓝图。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Test-Time Strategies for More Efficient and Accurate Agentic RAG
papers.title_zh: 更高效、更准确的代理式RAG实现策略
papers.authors: Abhinav Sharma, Brian Zhang, Deepti Guntur, Zhiyang Zuo, Shreyas Chaudhari, Wenlong Zhao, Franck Dernoncourt, Puneet Mathur, Ryan A. Rossi, Nedim Lipka
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems face challenges with complex, multi-hop questions, and iterative agentic frameworks such as Search-R1 (Jin et al., 2025) have been proposed to address these complexities. However, such approaches can introduce inefficiencies, including repetitive retrieval of previously processed information and challenges in contextualizing retrieved results effectively within the current generation prompt. Such issues can lead to unnecessary retrieval turns, suboptimal reasoning, inaccurate answers, and increased token consumption. In this paper, we investigate test-time modifications to Search-R1’s open-source Qwen2.5-7B pipeline to mitigate these identified shortcomings. Specifically, we explore the integration of two components and their combination: a contextualization module to better integrate relevant information from retrieved documents into reasoning, and a de-duplication module that replaces previously retrieved documents with the next most relevant ones. We evaluate our approaches using the HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018) and the Natural Questions (Kwiatkowski et al., 2019) datasets, reporting the exact match (EM) score, an LLM-as-a-Judge assessment of answer correctness, and the average number of turns. Our best-performing variant (contextualization) achieves a 5.6% increase in EM score and reduces the average number of turns by 10.5% compared to the Search-R1 baseline. While contextualization itself introduces additional LLM calls, our results demonstrate improved answer accuracy and reduced retrieval load.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统在处理复杂、多跳的问题时面临挑战。为了解决这些复杂性问题，人们提出了诸如Search-R1这样的迭代式框架（Jin等人，2025年）。然而，这类方法可能会引入效率低下的问题，比如重复检索已处理过的信息，以及难以在当前的生成提示中有效上下文化检索到的结果。这些问题可能导致不必要的检索轮次、次优的推理过程、不准确的答案，以及增加的令牌消耗。在本文中，我们研究了对Search-R1的开源Qwen2.5-7B流程进行测试时进行的修改，以缓解这些缺陷。具体来说，我们探讨了两个组件的整合及其组合：一个用于更好地将文档中的相关信息整合到推理过程中的上下文化模块，以及一个用于用下一个最相关的文档替换已检索过的文档的去重模块。我们使用HotpotQA（Yang等人，2018年）和自然问题数据集（Kwiatkowski等人，2019年）来评估我们的方法，并报告了精确匹配分数、LLM作为评判者对答案正确性的评估结果，以及平均轮次数。我们表现最好的变体（上下文化模块）相比Search-R1基线，精确匹配分数提高了5.6%，平均轮次数减少了10.5%。虽然上下文化本身会引入额外的LLM调用，但我们的结果表明，答案的准确性得到了提升，同时检索负担也减轻了。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Eye Movement Features Can Predict Human Preferences on Machine-Generated Texts
papers.title_zh: 眼动特征能够预测人类对机器生成文本的偏好
papers.authors: Xiaoshan He, Xiaoqun Liu, Haodong He, Yu Wang, Yang Xu
papers.abstract: Eye movement offers valuable insights into human visual attention during assessment of machine-generated texts, yet existing research and resources in this area are limited. To bridge this gap, we introduce Gaze Responses for Evaluating AI Texts (GREAT), a comprehensive dataset capturing human eye-movement features during screen reading of passages generated by large language models (LLMs). The dataset includes raw eye-movement recordings, reading-time measurements, and post-reading evaluations for LLM-generated passage pairs, alongside rigorous validation metrics. The collected eye-movement features demonstrate strong explanatory power in predicting text quality. When integrated with negative log-likelihood (NLL), a commonly used metric for evaluating text quality, it substantially enhances model performance across all standard statistical criteria. These findings demonstrate that eye-movement can act as an effective source of information that complements probabilistic metrics, for the task of automatic text quality assessment. The full dataset and some processing code are publicly available at https://github.com/qwurd231/GREAT.
papers.abstract_zh: 眼球运动在评估机器生成的文本时提供了宝贵的视觉注意力信息，但当前在这一领域的研究和资源仍然有限。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了“用于评估人工智能文本的眼球运动数据集”（Gaze Responses for Evaluating AI Texts，简称GREAT）。该数据集包含了人们在阅读由大语言模型生成的文本时的眼球运动特征、阅读时间数据以及阅读后的评估结果，同时还具备严格的验证指标。收集到的眼球运动特征在预测文本质量方面表现出很强的解释力。当将这些特征与负对数似然值（NLL）结合使用时——这是一种常用的文本质量评估指标——模型的性能在所有标准统计指标上都得到了显著提升。这些研究结果表明，眼球运动可以作为有效的信息来源，为自动文本质量评估任务提供补充，与概率性指标相辅相成。整个数据集以及一些处理代码均可在此处免费获取：https://github.com/qwurd231/GREAT。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Thesis Proposal: Diagnosing and Mitigating Semantic Interference in Script-Sharing Low-Resource Language Models: A Case Study on Square Bai Script
papers.title_zh: 论文提案：诊断并缓解脚本共享型低资源语言模型中的语义干扰问题——以方块白文为例进行研究
papers.authors: Jingting Zheng, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Multilingual language models now cover more languages than ever, yet script-sharing low-resource languages remain vulnerable to failures driven by script and dominant-language priors. This dissertation studies one such failure mode, semantic interference, in Square Bai Script, where many forms resemble Chinese characters but often differ in meaning. We argue that current adaptation pipelines underperform not only because Bai is low-resource, but because they treat visible overlap as safe transfer by default. Building on an expert-validated corpus of 28,382 Bai-Chinese sentence pairs, an out-of-domain epigraphic set and a reproducible encoding pipeline, the dissertation will (1) diagnose semantic interference, (2) compare adaptation strategies under realistic compute constraints, and (3) estimate when shared-script transfer helps or harms adaptation. The long-term goal is Bai-capable understanding and generation. The dissertation addresses the prerequisite problem of safe and effective adaptation in a script-sharing low-resource setting.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言模型如今能够覆盖的语言种类比以往任何时候都要多，然而那些使用共享文字且资源匮乏的语言仍然容易受到因文字差异和语言先验知识导致的失败影响。本论文研究的就是其中一种失败模式——语义干扰现象，它发生在方块白文这种文字体系中。方块白文的许多字形与汉字相似，但含义往往不同。我们认为，当前的中文转换方法表现不佳的原因不仅在于方块白文资源匮乏，还在于这些方法默认认为文字的重叠是可以安全转换的。基于一个由专家验证的包含28,382对方块白文-中文句子对的语料库、一个跨领域的文本集以及一个可复现的编码流程，本文将：(1)诊断语义干扰现象；(2)在实际的计算限制条件下比较不同的转换策略；(3)评估使用共享文字进行转换对翻译效果的影响。长期目标是实现方块白文环境下的理解和生成能力。本论文旨在解决在文字共享且资源匮乏的情况下如何进行安全有效的翻译这一难题。

papers.title: Does Locality Cost in Polish Medical Text Classification? Duplicate-Aware Evaluation of Federated Learning
papers.title_zh: 在波兰语医疗文本分类中，地域信息是否起到了重要作用？对联邦学习的重复检测评估
papers.authors: Daniel Cieślak, Andrzej Czyżewski
papers.abstract: Federated learning is often framed as a practical trade-off in clinical NLP: safer data handling at the cost of lower predictive performance. We revisit this assumption in a benchmark-specific study of Polish medical text classification. A key issue is evaluation granularity: the test split contains 10,634 rows but only 670 unique normalized text hashes, with 18 inconsistent groups removed in strict grouped evaluation. We therefore compare centralized and federated training under both conventional instance-level scoring and a stricter hash-level protocol that controls duplicate inflation. In the strongest reported settings, federated training matches or slightly exceeds the centralized baseline, reaching instance-level Macro-F1 of 0.8826 ± 0.0177 versus 0.8689 ± 0.0124, and hash-level Macro-F1 of 0.8908 ± 0.0220 versus 0.8841 ± 0.0078. The claim is deliberately narrow: we do not argue that federated learning is generally superior to centralized training, nor do we claim formal privacy guarantees. Rather, we show that in this duplicate-heavy Polish medical text benchmark, conclusions about locality depend strongly on evaluation hygiene.
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦学习通常被描述为临床自然语言处理中的一个实际权衡：以更安全的数据处理为代价来换取较低的预测性能。我们在一项针对波兰医学文本分类的基准测试中重新审视了这一假设。一个关键问题是评估的粒度问题：测试数据集中有10,634行数据，但只有670个唯一的规范化文本哈希值，而在严格的分组评估中，有18组数据被移除。因此，我们比较了在传统实例级评分和一种更严格的哈希级协议下的集中式与联邦式训练效果。在最优化的设置下，联邦式训练的准确率或略高于集中式训练，实例级的Macro-F1分数分别为0.8826 ± 0.0177和0.8689 ± 0.0124，而哈希级Macro-F1分数则分别为0.8908 ± 0.0220和0.8841 ± 0.0078。这里的结论是有一定局限性的：我们并不认为联邦学习通常优于集中式训练，也不声称能提供正式的隐私保护保证。相反，我们表明，在这种包含大量重复数据的波兰医学文本基准测试中，关于局部性的结论很大程度上取决于评估的严谨性。

papers.title: Analyzing Hate Speech Amplification on Fringe Platforms
papers.title_zh: 分析仇恨言论在边缘平台上的传播情况
papers.authors: Anika Ghosh Basu, Humberto Jesus Carlon, Junyi Liu
papers.abstract: Fringe platforms like Gab harbor high volumes of hate speech due to minimal moderation and insular communities. Our study examines thefactors that determine how hate speech amplifies on these platforms. We prepared a novel dataset of 5K+ threads and 50K+ responses from four fringe platforms (Gab, 4chan, Stormfront, and Vanguard), including both structural features (e.g., timestamps, metadata) and con-tent features (e.g., original text, hate intensity of posts), where hate speech amplification was measured using platform-specific engagement metrics. We trained both Generalized Linear Models and Gradient Boosted Tree models to estimate how several features influence the amplification of hate speech on fringe platforms, and used Shapley value estimates to identify the relative importance of the features. Our analysis shows that research insights from social network analysis (SNA) of mainstream sites like X do not directly generalize to fringe platforms. For instance, our experiments show that using features like thread structure and disagreements in early response windows can give up to 74% lift in Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of predicting reply counts for hateful posts on fringe platforms, compared to a baseline model that has features like hate intensity and thread age (which would be considered predictive by regular SNA methods).
papers.abstract_zh: 像Gab这样的边缘化平台由于监管不足和社区封闭性，充斥着大量的仇恨言论。我们的研究探讨了导致仇恨言论在这些平台上加剧的因素。我们整理了一个包含5千多个帖子和5万个回复的数据集，这些数据来自四个边缘化平台（Gab、4chan、Stormfront和Vanguard）。数据包括结构特征（如时间戳、元数据）和内容特征（如原始文本、帖子的仇恨强度），而仇恨言论的加剧程度则通过平台特定的互动指标来衡量。我们训练了广义线性模型和梯度提升树模型，以估计各种特征对边缘化平台上仇恨言论加剧的影响，并使用Shapley值来识别这些特征的相对重要性。我们的分析表明，来自主流网站如X的社会网络分析研究成果并不能直接适用于边缘化平台。例如，我们的实验表明，使用诸如帖子结构和早期回复中的分歧等特征，可以在预测边缘化平台上仇恨帖子回复数量的平均平方误差方面，提高高达74%的效果。相比之下，使用仇恨强度和帖子年龄等特征的基线模型，其预测效果被认为具有预测性，但效果较差。

papers.title: The Silence of the Facts: Popularity as a Barrier to Machine Unlearning
papers.title_zh: 事实的沉默：流行度成为机器遗忘知识的障碍
papers.authors: Anna Borisiuk, Andrey Savchenko, Alexander Panchenko, Elena Tutubalina
papers.abstract: Machine Unlearning is a valuable ability of LLMs, enabling the removal of unsafe, outdated, or private information. Existing unlearning methods, however, are often evaluated under the assumption that all facts are equally challenging to forget. Controllable knowledge removal is essential for reliable NLP systems. In this paper, we investigate whether fact popularity influences the efficiency of LLM unlearning. To answer this question, we build UNLamb benchmark designed to systematically investigate this relationship. It consists of 11.6k question-answer pairs derived from real-world knowledge in Wikidata, explicitly partitioned into rare and popular facts. Using this benchmark, we perform a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art unlearning algorithms on a set of models of different sizes. We conduct a comprehensive analysis of four unlearning methods across three validation sets and two LLMs. We show that larger models struggle more to forget popular entities, often damaging related knowledge in the process. In contrast, it is much easier to remove rare facts without side effects.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器忘记是大语言模型的一项宝贵能力，它能够清除那些不安全、过时或私密的信息。然而，现有的忘记方法通常是在假设所有事实都同样难以被遗忘的前提下进行评估的。可控的知识移除对于可靠的自然语言处理系统来说至关重要。在本文中，我们研究了事实的流行程度是否会影响大语言模型忘记的效率。为了回答这个问题，我们构建了一个名为UNLamb的基准测试，旨在系统地研究这种关系。该基准测试包含11.6千对问题-答案对，这些对来自Wikidata中的现实世界知识，并被明确划分为罕见事实和常见事实。利用这个基准测试，我们对不同规模模型的最先进忘记算法进行了全面评估。我们对四种忘记方法在三个验证集和两个大语言模型上的表现进行了综合分析。我们发现，较大的模型在忘记常见实体时面临更大的困难，这往往会导致相关知识的损失。相比之下，删除罕见事实则相对容易，且不会产生副作用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Leakage-Aware User-Level ADHD Signal Classification from Social Media: When Graph Aggregation Helps, and When It Does Not
papers.title_zh: 基于社交媒体的、考虑数据泄露问题的用户级ADHD信号分类方法：何时使用图聚合算法有助于分类，何时则不然
papers.authors: Daniel Cieślak, Władysław Średniawa
papers.abstract: User-level ADHD-related text classification from social media is methodologically challenging because predictions must aggregate many short posts, performance can be inflated by direct diagnostic leakage, and screening-adjacent settings require calibrated probabilities rather than discrimination alone. We introduce a leakage-aware evaluation framework organized around two controlled axes: evidence budget, i.e., the number of tweets available per user, and leakage control. Within this setup, we compare document-level transformers, strong non-graph embedding-pooling baselines, and heterogeneous graph models combining semantic tweet embeddings, psycholinguistic features, and temporal structure. The main result is regime-dependent: graph aggregation is most useful when user evidence is scarce, whereas simple embedding pooling becomes highly competitive and often slightly stronger as more evidence becomes available. Overall, the main contribution is a controlled benchmarking framework and a clearer account of when graph-based aggregation is actually beneficial.
papers.abstract_zh: 在社交媒体中对用户级别的注意力缺陷多动障碍相关文本进行分类具有方法上的挑战性：因为需要整合大量的短帖子进行预测，而且直接诊断信息的泄露可能会导致预测效果被夸大；此外，筛选相关的设置还需要使用经过校准的概率模型，而不仅仅是单纯的区分能力。我们提出了一个考虑信息泄露问题的评估框架，该框架以两个关键维度为基准：信息预算，即每个用户可使用的推文数量；以及泄露控制机制。在这个框架下，我们比较了文档级转换模型、强大的非图嵌入聚合基线模型，以及结合了语义推文嵌入、心理语言学特征和时间结构的异构图模型。主要结果表明，当用户信息稀缺时，基于图的聚合方法最为有效；而当信息增多时，简单的嵌入聚合方法则变得非常具有竞争力，且往往表现略优。总体而言，我们的主要贡献在于提供了一个可控的基准测试框架，并更清晰地说明了何时使用基于图的聚合方法才是最有效的选择。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: CAL-Log: Cost-Aware Active Learning with Logarithmic Cognitive Effort Modeling and Online Adaptation to Human Annotation Behavior
papers.title_zh: CAL-Log：基于成本意识的主动学习算法，采用对数形式的认知努力模型，并能够实时调整自身行为以适人类标注的需求
papers.authors: Vihanga Supasan Kariyakaranage, Banuka Athuraliya
papers.abstract: Active learning (AL) reduces labeled data requirements in NLP, yet most methods optimize label efficiency while ignoring annotation cost. Standard uncertainty sampling assumes uniform effort, leading to suboptimal resource allocation when documents vary in length. Supasan and Athuraliya (2026) introduced CAL-Log, a cost-aware AL variant using logarithmic cost modeling C(x)=α+β log(1+L(x)), where C(x) is the predicted annotation time for document x and L(x) is its token length, grounded in information foraging theory (Pirolli and Card, 1999) and psycholinguistic studies of human skimming (Rayner, 1998). This paper presents CAL-Log in full, extending that preliminary framework with two new contributions: temperature-scaled calibrated entropy and online per-annotator cost adaptation, which together resolve the cold-start calibration bottleneck identified in the prior work. Experiments on ten text classification benchmarks demonstrate a 3.3× speedup over BADGE (Batch Active learning by Diverse Gradient Embeddings; Ash et al., 2020) and 3.9× over Entropy sampling to reach F1=0.80, with large effect sizes (Cohen’s d>0.8). A live annotation deployment with preliminary user evaluation (N=7) confirms that the online cost model produces reading-speed classifications consistent with annotator self-reports, and that a transparency interface successfully communicates the scoring rationale to non-expert users.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动学习能够减少自然语言处理中的标注数据需求，但大多数方法在优化标签效率的同时忽略了标注成本。标准的不确定性采样假设所有文档的标注工作量相同，当文档长度不同时，这会导致资源分配不尽合理。Supasan和Athuraliya在2026年提出了CAL-Log这一基于成本意识的主动学习算法，该算法采用对数成本模型C(x)=α+β log(1+L(x))来描述标注时间，其中C(x)是文档x的预计标注时间，L(x)是其标记长度。该模型基于信息觅食理论（Pirolli和Card，1999）以及关于人类快速阅读的心理语言学研究（Rayner，1998）。本文详细介绍了CAL-Log算法，并在原有框架的基础上增加了两项新功能：温度缩放的校准熵和在线针对每个标注者成本的调整。这些功能共同解决了先前研究中存在的冷启动校准难题。在十个文本分类基准测试上的实验表明，与BADGE算法相比，CAL-Log算法的速度提升了3.3倍；与熵采样算法相比，其性能提升了3.9倍，最终达到了F1=0.80的评分，且效应量较大（Cohen’s d>0.8）。通过实际部署并初步进行用户评估（样本数量N=7），发现在线成本模型生成的标注结果与标注者自己的报告一致，而且透明的界面能够向非专业用户清晰地解释评分依据。

papers.title: Thesis Proposal: Targeted and Unified Cross-Lingual Unlearning from Multilingual Language Models
papers.title_zh: 论文提案：针对多种语言模型进行有目的且统一的跨语言“去学习”操作
papers.authors: Jan Bronec, Jindřich Helcl
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLM) trained on massive corpora scraped from the web exhibit the capability to reproduce sensitive and copyright-protected data, the field of machine unlearning has emerged to address the arising ethical and legal concerns.While previous research has provided a unified evaluation of LLM unlearning methods, this unification remains constrained to English-only models and datasets.We aim to address the prevailing fragmentation in recent cross-lingual unlearning research by extending existing unified benchmarks with multilingual data.To that end, we plan to compile a dataset of parallel translations of question-answer pairs consisting of real-world facts and synthetic personally identifiable information.Moreover, we will focus on mitigating model degradation during unlearning by selectively editing only those layers that contain the given knowledge.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着在从网络上抓取的大量语料库上训练的大语言模型能够再现敏感且受版权保护的数据，机器反学习领域应运而生，以应对由此引发的伦理和法律问题。虽然之前的研究已经对大语言模型的反学习方法进行了统一的评估，但这种统一仍然局限于仅使用英语模型和数据集的情况。我们的目标是通过引入多语言数据来弥补当前跨语言反学习研究的碎片化问题。为此，我们计划编制一个包含真实世界事实和合成个人身份信息的问题-答案对的平行翻译数据集。此外，我们将重点研究如何通过选择性地编辑那些包含给定知识的层来减轻反学习过程中模型的退化问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A11y-Compressor: A Framework for Enhancing the Efficiency of GUI Agent Observations through Visual Context Reconstruction and Redundancy Reduction
papers.title_zh: A11y-Compressor：通过视觉上下文重构和冗余减少来提高GUI代理观测效率的框架
papers.authors: Michito Takeshita, Takuro Kawada, Takumi Ohashi, Shunsuke Kitada, Hitoshi Iyatomi
papers.abstract: AI agents that interact with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) require effective observation representations for reliable grounding.The accessibility tree is a commonly used text-based format that encodes UI element attributes, but it suffers from redundancy and lacks structural information such as spatial relationships among elements.We propose A11y-Compressor, a framework that transforms linearized accessibility trees into compact and structured representations.Our implementation, Compressed-a11y, applies a lightweight and structured transformation pipeline with modal detection, redundancy reduction, and semantic structuring.Experiments on the OSWorld benchmark show that Compressed-a11y reduces input tokens to 22% of the original while improving task success rates by 5.1 percentage points on average.
papers.abstract_zh: 与图形用户界面交互的AI代理需要有效的观测表示来实现可靠的定位。可访问性树是一种常用的基于文本的格式，它可以编码UI元素的属性，但存在冗余问题，且缺乏元素间空间关系等结构信息。我们提出了A11y-Compressor框架，该框架能够将线性化的可访问性树转换为紧凑且结构化的表示形式。我们的实现工具Compressed-a11y采用了一种轻量级且结构化的转换流程，包括模态检测、冗余减少以及语义结构化处理。在OSWorld基准测试上的实验表明，Compressed-a11y可以将输入令牌的数量减少22%，同时平均使任务成功率提高了5.1个百分点。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Counterspeech Generation using Small Language Models
papers.title_zh: 利用小型语言模型生成反话
papers.authors: Abubakar Sadiq Muhammad, Simona Frenda, Gavin Abercrombie
papers.abstract: Counterspeech offers a way to tackle harmful content online without restricting freedom of expression. This work explores counterspeech generation using small language models (SLMs) as lightweight and cost-effective alternatives to large language models. We evaluate SLMs ranging from 100 million to 3 billion parameters using simple prompting strategies as well as fine-tuning, combining automatic and robust human evaluations. Our findings demonstrate that small language models can generate relevant, coherent, and high-quality counterspeech, suggesting their potential suitability for efficient and responsible deployments.
papers.abstract_zh: 反言论提供了一种处理网络有害内容的方式，同时不会限制表达自由。本研究探讨了使用小型语言模型生成反言论的方法，这些模型可以作为大语言模型的轻量级、经济高效的替代方案。我们评估了参数范围从1亿到30亿的小型语言模型，采用了简单的提示策略以及微调方法，并结合了自动评估与人工评估的结果。我们的研究结果表明，小型语言模型能够生成相关、连贯且高质量的反言论，这表明它们具有适用于高效且负责任的部署的潜力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
