papers.title: Contextual Diversity Measure (CDM) for Controllable Story Generation in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 适用于大型语言模型的可控故事生成的情境多样性度量指标
papers.authors: Richard Susilo, Hanna Suominen, Patrik Haslum
papers.abstract: Scenario-based text generation has broad applications across education and creative writing, but remains underexplored in controllable text generation. We introduce the Contextual Diversity Measure (CDM), a metric that quantifies semantic diversity for scenario generation under fixed abstract semantic constraints, and validate it through controlled experiments. Statistical analysis across four embedding models demonstrates that CDM successfully distinguishes between high-diversity and low-diversity text pairs, with all tests achieving statistical significance at p < 0.05 on both the manually curated and LLM-generated subsets of the dataset. Effect sizes range from small-to-medium (Cohen’s d: 0.292–0.508) on the former and medium-to-large (Cohen’s d: 0.677–1.195) on the latter. Baseline comparisons indicate that CDM achieves excellent discrimination accuracy (100% and 91.9%, respectively), with discriminative power up to 5.5\times greater than the best baseline.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于场景的文本生成技术在教育和创意写作领域有着广泛的应用，但在可控文本生成方面仍未被充分探索。我们提出了情境多样性度量指标（Contextual Diversity Measure，简称CDM），该指标能够在固定的抽象语义约束下量化场景生成的语义多样性，并通过控制实验对其进行了验证。对四种嵌入模型的统计分析表明，CDM能够成功区分高多样性和低多样性的文本对，且在数据集的手动筛选子集和由大语言模型生成的子集中，所有测试结果的统计显著性均达到p<0.05的水平。前者的效应大小介于小到中等之间（Cohen’s d：0.292–0.508），后者的效应大小则介于中等到大（Cohen’s d：0.677–1.195）。与基线方法相比，CDM的判别准确率非常高（分别为100%和91.9%），其判别能力比最佳基线方法高出5.5倍。

papers.title: Constructing a Japanese Verdict Prediction Dataset for Fact-Checking of LLM-Generated Texts
papers.title_zh: 构建用于验证大语言模型生成文本的日语判决预测数据集
papers.authors: Miwa Masano, Hirokazu Kiyomaru, Atsushi Keyaki, Kaito Horio, Rei Minamoto, Ribeka Keyaki, Kouta Nakayama, Hideyuki Tachibana, Daisuke Kawahara
papers.abstract: The development of fact-checking systems for verifying the factuality of text generated by large language models (LLMs) has been advancing.In the verdict prediction step of such systems, the system determines whether claims in the generated text are supported by retrieved evidence, formulated as a natural language inference (NLI) task.This study extends the label set for verdict prediction to capture claim-evidence relationships that humans would commonly interpret as supported or refuted, even in the absence of strict logical entailment or contradiction.It also constructs a Japanese dataset comprising 28,147 instances from two sources based on this extended label set.We analyze the causes of annotation disagreement and find that ambiguity in the boundary of acceptable inference, interpretive characteristics of negative cases, and incomplete information in the evidence affect annotation variability.Using this dataset, we evaluate the performance of prompt-based verdict prediction methods and show that prompts that explicitly elicit chain-of-thought reasoning improve F1 by 4 percentage points compared to baseline.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于验证大语言模型生成的文本真实性的事实核查系统的开发正在取得进展。在这些系统的判断预测阶段，系统会判断生成文本中的陈述是否得到了相关证据的支持，这相当于一项自然语言推理任务。本研究扩展了判断预测所需的标签集，以涵盖那些人类通常能够理解为“得到支持”或“被反驳”的声明与证据之间的关系，即使缺乏严格的逻辑蕴含或矛盾关系。我们还构建了一个包含28,147个实例的日语数据集，这些实例来自两个不同的来源。我们分析了注释不一致的原因，发现可接受的推理边界的模糊性、负面案例的解释特性以及证据中的信息不完整等因素都导致了注释的多样性。利用这个数据集，我们评估了基于提示的判断预测方法的性能，结果显示，那些明确引导用户进行思维链推理的提示，其F1值比基线方法提高了4个百分点。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Calibration vs Decision Making: Revisiting the Reliability Paradox in Unlearned Language Models
papers.title_zh: 校准与决策制定：重新审视非学习型语言模型中的可靠性悖论
papers.authors: Divyaksh Shukla, Ashutosh Modi
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a model while preserving reliable behavior on the remaining data, making reliable prediction and uncertainty estimation essential for evaluation. Calibration is commonly used as a proxy for reliability in language models, but low calibration error does not necessarily imply reliable decision rules, as models may rely on spurious correlations while remaining well calibrated. We investigate this gap in generative language models using the multiple-choice question-answering evaluation protocol on the TOFU benchmark, measuring probabilistic reliability with calibration metrics (ECE, MCE, Brier) and decision-rule reliability via attribution-based shortcut detection with Integrated Gradients and Local Mutual Information. We find that fine-tuned models achieve low calibration error (ECE ≈ 0.04) compared to pretrained models (ECE > 0.5), and models after unlearning retain similarly low calibration despite reduced accuracy on the forget split, while attribution analysis shows increased reliance on correlation-based tokens. These results demonstrate that good calibration can coexist with shortcut-based decision rules after unlearning, extending the reliability paradox to the machine unlearning setting.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器去学习旨在消除特定训练数据对模型的影响，同时保留其在剩余数据上的可靠性能，因此可靠的预测和不确定性估计对于评估至关重要。校准通常被用作语言模型可靠性的指标，但低校准误差并不一定意味着决策规则是可靠的，因为模型可能会依赖于虚假的相关性，而同时保持良好的校准状态。我们使用TOFU基准测试中的选择题-回答评估协议来研究生成式语言模型中的这一差距，通过校准指标（ECE、MCE、布里尔指数）来衡量概率可靠性，并通过集成梯度法和局部互信息法进行归因分析，以评估决策规则的可靠性。我们发现，经过微调的模型具有较低的校准误差（ECE约为0.04），而预训练的模型则具有较高的校准误差（ECE大于0.5）。在去学习之后，模型的校准误差仍然较低，尽管在遗忘分割任务上的准确性有所下降，但归因分析显示模型更加依赖基于相关性的标记。这些结果表明，在去学习之后，良好的校准可以与基于捷径的决策规则共存，从而将可靠性悖论扩展到机器去学习的场景。

papers.title: Disentangling Meaning and Language Components in Diverse Multilingual Sentence Embeddings
papers.title_zh: 在多种语言的多语言句子嵌入中区分含义与语言成分
papers.authors: Kanade Nonomura, Keita Fukushima, Risa Kondo, Tomoyuki Kajiwara
papers.abstract: We disentangle multilingual sentence embeddings into language-dependent and language-agnostic components, leveraging the latter to improve cross-lingual similarity estimation.Previous studies focused on encoder-based approaches that use only the input sentence; in contrast, this study examines the effectiveness of disentanglement methods across a broader range of sentence embeddings, including decoder-based approaches and those that utilize prompts.Experimental results demonstrate that embedding disentanglement is effective for a wide variety of sentence embeddings.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们将多语言句子嵌入分解为与语言相关的部分和与语言无关的部分，并利用后者来提升跨语言相似性估计的准确性。以往的研究主要集中在仅使用输入句子的编码器方法上；而本研究则探讨了不同嵌入方式下解耦方法的有效性，包括基于解码器的方法以及利用提示的方法。实验结果表明，对多种句子嵌入进行解耦处理是有效的做法。

papers.title: Linguistically-Informed Evaluation of LLMs on Acceptability Judgments in a Forced-Choice Paradigm
papers.title_zh: 基于语言学的大型语言模型评估：在强制选择范式下对模型可接受性的判断
papers.authors: Ziyue Liu, Nils Reiter
papers.abstract: Evaluating the grammatical abilities of large language models (LLMs) is important for both NLP and linguistic theory. We investigate the ability of large language models (LLMs) to perform acceptability judgments in a forced-choice paradigm. We evaluate a subset of LLMs on 150 minimal sentence pairs sampled from Linguistic Inquiry and categorized using BLiMP linguistic phenomena. Our results show that while LLMs approximate human judgments, performance varies across models and phenomenon types, with stronger alignment on morphosyntactic phenomena than on linguistically and semantically demanding phenomena. Prompting strategies have minimal impact.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型的语法能力对于自然语言处理和语言理论来说非常重要。我们研究了大语言模型在强制选择范式下进行可接受性判断的能力。我们对部分大语言模型进行了评估，这些模型基于《语言探究》中选取的150对最小句子对进行训练，并根据BLiMP语言现象对其进行分类。我们的结果显示，虽然大语言模型能够近似人类的判断，但不同模型和不同现象类型的表现存在差异。在形态句法现象上的表现更为出色，而在语言学和语义学要求较高的现象上则表现较差。提示策略对其影响较小。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Representing Lean Proofs as Trajectories in Latent Space
papers.title_zh: 将精益证明表示为潜在空间中的路径
papers.authors: Elisaveta Samoylov, Soroush Vosoughi
papers.abstract: Lean proofs are built as sequences of tactic-induced state transitions, yet learned models often represent proof steps primarily through tactic strings or raw proof-state text. Building on Delta Tokens, which encode a proof step by the local edit it induces between successive proof states, we train an encoder-only Transformer to learn contextualized representations of Lean proof steps from state changes. We then use these step representations to study complete proofs as trajectories in a learned latent space.We first show that the Delta-based Transformer yields better held-out next-tactic retrieval than a matched surface-syntax control, supporting the representational choice used in the trajectory analysis. We then analyze proof trajectories using path length, endpoint span, directness, curvature, and torsion. Across the LeanWorkbook slice used here, longer proofs become increasingly indirect within a relatively bounded latent span: path length grows sharply with proof length while endpoint span changes little, mean step size decreases, curvature rises modestly, and torsion falls. Qualitative case studies show that these geometric patterns align with recognizable proof organizations, including immediate closure, aligned accumulation, scaffolded enrichment, bookkeeping-heavy restructuring, and repeated local contradiction work.The dataset is small and heavily skewed toward short proofs, so the claims are necessarily limited. Within those limits, the results suggest that learned state-change representations recover nontrivial structure in how proofs unfold and provide a promising basis for future trajectory-aware theorem proving.
papers.abstract_zh: 精益证明是通过一系列由策略引导的状态转换来构建的，但学习到的模型通常主要通过策略字符串或原始的证明状态文本来表示证明步骤。基于Delta令牌，该令牌通过连续证明状态之间的局部编辑来编码一个证明步骤，我们训练了一个仅包含编码器的Transformer，以从状态变化中学习到关于精益证明步骤的上下文化表示。然后，我们使用这些步骤表示来研究完整的证明作为在学习的潜在空间中的轨迹。我们首先证明了基于Delta的Transformer在预测下一个策略时，比匹配的表面语法控制方法表现得更好，这支持了轨迹分析中使用的表示选择。接着，我们通过路径长度、端点跨度、直接性、曲率和扭转来分析证明轨迹。在这里使用的LeanWorkbook切片中，较长的证明在相对有限的潜在跨度内变得越来越间接：路径长度随着证明长度的增加而急剧增长，而端点跨度变化不大，平均步长减小，曲率略有上升，扭转则下降。定性案例研究表明，这些几何模式与可识别的证明组织方式相一致，包括立即闭合、有序积累、支架式丰富、需要大量记录的重构以及反复的局部矛盾处理。由于数据集规模较小且偏向于短证明，因此结论必然有限。但在这些限制条件下，结果表明学习到的状态变化表示能够恢复证明展开过程中的非平凡结构，为未来的轨迹感知定理证明提供了有希望的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evaluation of Multilingual Ability to Use Spatial Deictic Expressions in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 对视觉-语言模型中多语言使用空间指称表达能力的评估
papers.authors: Kaito Watanabe, Taisei Yamamoto, Tomoki Doi, Hitomi Yanaka
papers.abstract: One of the expected abilities of vision-language models (VLMs) is spatial reasoning ability based on a given text and image.To evaluate the spatial reasoning abilities of VLMs, we focus on the use of spatial deictic expressions, which are defined as spatial expressions whose referent is determined by their situational context, such as this and that.To handle spatial deictic expressions, VLMs must jointly reason over language and visual space, grounding context-dependent references in the image’s spatial structure.In addition, selecting appropriate spatial deictic expressions across languages requires VLMs to understand the language-specific spatial distinctions encoded by these expressions.In this paper, we develop a benchmark to evaluate the multilingual ability of VLMs to use spatial deictic expressions in four languages.Our experiments using this benchmark reveal that the tested models use demonstratives in a manner different from that of humans, particularly in selecting the appropriate demonstratives based on the distance from the object.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型所具备的预期能力之一，就是基于给定的文本和图像进行空间推理的能力。为了评估视觉-语言模型的空间推理能力，我们重点关注了空间指示表达的使用。所谓空间指示表达，指的是那些其指代对象由情境上下文决定的表达方式，例如“这个”和“那个”。为了处理这些空间指示表达，视觉-语言模型必须同时考虑语言和视觉空间，将依赖于上下文的指向信息落实到图像的空间结构中。此外，选择适合不同语言的空间指示表达时，视觉-语言模型还需要理解这些表达所蕴含的语言特定的空间差异。在本文中，我们开发了一个基准测试，用于评估视觉-语言模型在四种语言中使用空间指示表达的多语言能力。通过这项测试，我们发现被测试的模型在使用指示代词的方式上与人类有所不同，尤其是在根据物体距离来选择合适的指示代词方面。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLM Parameters for Math Across Languages: Shared or Separate?
papers.title_zh: 适用于多种语言的数学LLM参数：应该共享还是分开使用？
papers.authors: Behzad Shomali, Luisa Victor, Tim Selbach, Ali Hamza Bashir, David Berghaus, Joachim Koehler, Mehdi Ali, Markus Frey
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit substantial cross-lingual variation in mathematical reasoning performance, but it remains unclear whether these differences reflect language-specific parameters or a shared mechanism that manifests differently by language. We present a cross-lingual mechanistic analysis of mathematical reasoning in LLMs, enabling us to localize and compare model parameters that support mathematical reasoning across languages. We find that the extracted math-associated parameters exhibit partial cross-lingual overlap, with the strongest overlap concentrated in intermediate model layers.We further observe that English consistently produces the largest set of math-relevant parameters, whereas lower-resource languages reveal smaller sets of relevant parameters. These results suggest that math-related behavior in multilingual LLMs is neither fully language-invariant nor fully language-specific, but instead exhibits partial cross-lingual parameter overlap with systematic language-dependent differences.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在数学推理能力方面表现出显著的跨语言差异，但尚不清楚这些差异是反映了语言特有的参数，还是一种在不同语言中表现不同的共同机制。我们对多语言语言模型中的数学推理进行了跨语言的机制分析，从而能够定位并比较那些支持不同语言间数学推理的模型参数。我们发现，与数学相关的参数在跨语言层面存在部分重叠，这种重叠主要集中在模型的中间层。此外，我们还观察到，英语模型始终能生成数量最多的与数学相关的参数，而资源较少的语言则能生成的与数学相关的参数数量较少。这些结果表明，多语言语言模型中的数学相关行为既不是完全不受语言影响的，也不是完全由语言决定的，而是存在部分跨语言参数重叠现象，同时又有系统性的、依赖于语言的差异。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Thesis Proposal: Intentional Inference for Insight Generation
papers.title_zh: 论文提案：用于洞察生成的有意推理方法
papers.authors: Kristýna Onderková
papers.abstract: Large language models show strong capabilities in natural language generation (NLG) and have been applied to translate complex structured data into human-readable insights. While these models excel at surface-level fluency, they remain unreliable as they produce factually inaccurate outputs and struggle with consistent logical inference beyond surface-level patterns. Moreover, they often lack a clear sense of relevance and produce shallow or uninformative insights.This proposal argues that a key source of these limitations is task underspecification, which requires models to make implicit assumptions about missing context.We investigate how such underspecification leads to unintentional assumptions and how these affect faithfulness and evaluation.We examine how models can identify missing premises and surface multiple plausible interpretations to make evaluation more rigorous. We also explore how to improve reasoning to enable deeper inferences, focusing on code generation and qualitative reasoning. Finally, we will evaluate how the underlying assumptions and depth of inference influence the perceived interestingness of the insights. By shifting focus from surface-level generation to assumption-aware deeper inferences, this work aims to improve reliability, interpretability, and user controlability in NLG.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自然语言生成方面表现出强大的能力，已被用于将复杂的结构化数据转化为人类可理解的见解。虽然这些模型在表面层次的流畅性方面表现优异，但它们仍然不可靠，因为它们会产生事实上的不准确输出，并且在超出表面层次模式的逻辑推理方面存在困难。此外，它们往往缺乏清晰的相关性判断能力，所生成的见解也较为浅显或无用信息。本提案认为，这些限制的一个关键来源是任务描述不够明确，这要求模型对缺失的上下文做出隐含的假设。我们研究了这种不明确的描述如何导致无意的假设，以及这些因素如何影响模型的准确性和评估效果。我们探讨了模型如何识别缺失的前提条件，并呈现多种可能的解释，以使评估更加严谨。我们还探索了如何改进推理机制，以实现更深入的推断，重点在于代码生成和定性推理。最后，我们将评估潜在的假设和推理深度对见解的趣味性的影响。通过将注意力从表面层次的生成转移到对假设有意识的深入推理上，本工作旨在提高自然语言生成中的可靠性、可解释性和用户控制能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Reference-Free Schema Generation for Literature Review Tables via Multi-Faceted Rewards
papers.title_zh: 基于多维度奖励的文献综述表格中无参考信息的模式生成方法
papers.authors: Sinjoy Saha, Suman Saha, Mahfuza Farooque, Wenpeng Yin
papers.abstract: To accelerate scientific knowledge acquisition, LLMs are increasingly used to synthesize multiple papers into structured tables by inferring schemas and values. While value generation within a fixed schema can often be reduced to extractive question answering, the schema generation problem, determining which dimensions to compare a set of documents, lacks a formal mapping to standard NLP tasks. In this work, we formulate schema generation as a reinforcement learning problem and investigate whether these dimensions can be induced without access to gold-standard schemas. We design a multi-faceted reward framework capturing schema coverage, non-redundancy, relevance, and format, and train a small language model on a literature review dataset. Our approach yields consistent improvements over the untuned base model across intrinsic, reference-based, and LLM-judge metrics, and remains competitive with supervised fine-tuned models at 5\times the parameter count on structural and diversity dimensions. All code, results and prompts are available in the GitHub repository: https://github.com/sinjoysaha/rl-schema-generation
papers.abstract_zh: 为了加速科学知识的获取，大语言模型被越来越多地用于通过推断模式和数值来将多篇论文整合成结构化的表格。虽然在一个固定的模式下生成数值通常可以简化为提取式问答任务，但确定哪些维度可以用来比较一组文档的模式生成问题，却缺乏与标准自然语言处理任务的正式对应关系。在这项研究中，我们将模式生成问题定义为一个强化学习问题，并探讨是否可以在没有参考标准模式的情况下推导出这些维度。我们设计了一个包含多个方面的奖励框架，包括模式覆盖度、非冗余性、相关性和格式等方面，并在文献综述数据集上训练了一个小型语言模型。我们的方法在内在指标、基于参考的指标以及大语言模型评估指标方面都取得了持续的改进，并且在参数数量增加5倍的情况下，仍然能够与经过监督微调的模型相竞争，尤其是在结构和多样性方面。所有代码、结果和提示都可以在GitHub仓库中找到：https://github.com/sinjoysaha/rl-schema-generation

papers.title: Factual State Discovery Benchmark: Evaluating Fact Elicitation in Polish Tax Law
papers.title_zh: 事实陈述披露标准：在波兰税法中评估事实的引出方式
papers.authors: Mateusz Bystroński, Kamil Tagowski, Denis Janiak, Julia Farganus, Lukasz Augustyniak, Monika Kajdanowicz, Tomasz Jan Kajdanowicz
papers.abstract: Before a tax authority can issue a ruling, it must receive a complete description of the taxpayer’s situation—yet no benchmark measures whether language models can systematically elicit all relevant facts through dialogue.We introduce FSDBench (Factual State Discovery Benchmark), in which a discovery agent questions a simulated taxpayer grounded in a real tax document.The dataset comprises 500 narratives from official Polish tax interpretations, decomposed into 32 874 atomic facts with validated supported precision (97.6%), atomicity (93.8%), and sentence coverage (96.0%).Experiments with four models show that even the best system recovers only 77% of facts on easy samples and under 49% on hard samples after 50 turns.These findings establish conversational fact elicitation as a challenging open problem requiring retrieval-augmented and adaptive questioning strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 在税务机关能够作出裁决之前，必须获得关于纳税人情况的完整描述。然而，目前还没有基准测试来表明语言模型是否能够通过对话系统地获取所有相关事实。我们引入了FSDBench（事实状态发现基准），在该基准测试中，一个发现代理会对基于真实税务文件生成的模拟纳税人进行提问。该数据集包含500个波兰官方税务解释的文本片段，这些文本被分解为32,874个原子事实，这些原子的准确性得到了验证，分别为97.6%、93.8%和96.0%。对四种模型的实验结果表明，即使是最优秀的系统，在简单样本上也只能获取77%的事实信息，而在复杂样本上则低于49%的信息。这些发现表明，通过对话方式获取事实信息是一个具有挑战性的开放性问题，需要采用检索增强和自适应化的提问策略来解决这一问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evolutionary Search for Automated Design of Uncertainty Quantification Methods
papers.title_zh: 基于进化的自动设计不确定性量化方法搜索机制
papers.authors: Mikhail Seleznyov, Daniil Korbut, Viktor Moskvoretskii, Oleg Somov, Alexander Panchenko, Elena Tutubalina
papers.abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods for large language models are predominantly designed by hand based on domain knowledge and heuristics, limiting their scalability and generality. We apply LLM-powered evolutionary search to automatically discover unsupervised UQ methods represented as Python programs. On the task of atomic claim verification, our evolved methods outperform strong manually-designed baselines, achieving up to 6.7% relative ROC-AUC improvement across 9 datasets while generalizing robustly out-of-distribution. Qualitative analysis reveals that different LLMs employ qualitatively distinct evolutionary strategies: Claude models consistently design high-feature-count linear estimators, while Gpt-oss-120B gravitates toward simpler and more interpretable positional weighting schemes. Surprisingly, only Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5 reliably leverage increased method complexity to improve performance – Opus 4.6 shows an unexpected regression relative to its predecessor. Overall, our results hint that LLM-powered evolutionary search is a promising paradigm for automated, interpretable hallucination detector design.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对大语言模型的不确定性量化方法，大多是通过基于领域知识和启发式算法的手工设计来实现的，这限制了这些方法的可扩展性和通用性。我们采用由大语言模型驱动的进化搜索技术，自动发现以Python程序形式表示的无监督不确定性量化方法。在原子声明验证任务上，我们的进化方法的表现优于那些由人工设计的强大基线方法，在9个数据集上的相对ROC-AUC提升了高达6.7%，同时还能在超出分布范围的情况下依然保持稳健的性能。定性分析表明，不同的大语言模型采用了截然不同的进化策略：Claude模型始终采用特征数量较多的线性估计方法，而Gpt-oss-120B则倾向于使用更简单、更易于理解的位置加权方案。令人惊讶的是，只有Sonnet 4.5和Opus 4.5能够利用增加的方法复杂度来提升性能——而Opus 4.6则出现了与之前版本相比的意外下降。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，由大语言模型驱动的进化搜索是一种有前景的自动化、可解释性强的幻觉检测器设计方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Thesis Proposal: A Normalization-First Framework for Sound, Complete, and Utility-Ready Open Information Extraction
papers.title_zh: 论文提案：一种以规范化处理为首要目标的开放信息提取框架，旨在获取完整且实用的信息
papers.authors: Chandan Prakash, Pavan Kumar Chittimalli, Arnab Bhattacharya
papers.abstract: Open Information Extraction (OIE) has largely focused on extracting relational tuples from text, yet in its current form remains unsuitable for downstream systems due to the absence of standardized, semantically sound representations. This thesis argues that the field has been addressing extraction as a surface-level prediction problem, leading to outputs that are semantically incomplete and logically ambiguous, particularly in the presence of modality, negation, conditionality, quantification, and attribution. We propose a normalization-first framework that reframes OIE as a structured semantic transformation pipeline, where raw text is first converted into a lossless, canonical form of declarative, active-voice, and irreducible sentence units, and extraction is constrained to atomic unary and binary relations augmented with explicit semantic annotations. Within a Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning perspective, we formalize soundness, completeness, and usefulness as approximate yet verifiable guarantees over extraction quality, acknowledging the inherent undecidability of full semantic interpretation. This thesis outlines a feasible research program to develop the theoretical foundations, models, and evaluation protocols required to produce system-ready OIE representations, thereby establishing a principled and executable path toward making OIE directly usable for downstream reasoning and machine interpretability.
papers.abstract_zh: 开放信息提取技术主要专注于从文本中提取关系元组，但由于缺乏标准化、语义上合理的表示方式，该技术目前仍不适合用于后续系统。本论文认为，该领域一直将提取问题视为一个表面层面的预测问题，导致输出的内容在语义上不完整且逻辑上模糊不清，尤其是在存在模态、否定、条件性、量化和归因等元素的情况下。我们提出了一种以规范化为先的框架，将开放信息提取技术重新定义为一个结构化的语义转换流程：首先，将原始文本转换为无损的、规范化的声明式主动语态且不可还原的句子单位；然后，将提取操作限制在带有明确语义注释的原子一元和二元关系上。从近似正确学习的角度出发，我们将正确性、完整性和实用性定义为对提取质量的一种近似但可验证的保证，同时承认完全语义解释的固有不可判定性。本论文提出了一个可行的研究方案，旨在开发必要的理论基础、模型和评估协议，从而创造出适用于后续系统的开放信息提取表示方式，为让开放信息提取技术直接用于下游推理和机器可解释性研究铺平道路。

papers.title: Mind the Gap: Multilingual Divide in LLM Bias Detection and Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 注意差距：语言多样性在大型语言模型偏见检测与推理中的作用
papers.authors: Medha Hira, Prachi Goyal, Raj Maheshwari, Arnav Goel
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multilingual settings, yet most bias evaluation remains English-centric and overlooks how bias manifests within reasoning. We present a systematic study of social bias in both predictions and chain-of-thought reasoning across English, Dutch, Spanish, and Turkish using the MBBQ benchmark. We evaluate instruction-tuned, CoT-prompted, and reasoning-native models under supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization, using accuracy, F1, bias metrics, and a novel reasoning-level language drift measure. We find that (1) bias varies substantially across languages, with consistent degradation in non-English settings, (2) reasoning traces often introduce additional stereotype-driven signals beyond final outputs, and (3) English-trained debiasing methods fail to generalize reliably, with preference optimization introducing cross-lingual trade-offs. We further show that performance gains in multilingual settings are frequently driven by implicit reliance on English-centric reasoning, revealed through increased language drift. Together, our results demonstrate that multilingual fairness cannot be inferred from English performance and requires reasoning-aware, language-specific evaluation and alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多语言环境中得到了越来越多的应用，然而大多数偏见评估仍然以英语为中心，而忽略了偏见在推理过程中的表现。我们使用MBBQ基准测试，对英语、荷兰语、西班牙语和土耳其语之间的社会偏见进行了系统的研究。我们评估了经过指令调整的模型、基于CoT提示的模型以及原生推理能力的模型在监督式微调和优化偏好设置下的表现，使用了准确率、F1值、偏见指标以及一种新的推理层面语言漂移度量方法。我们发现：(1) 不同语言中的偏见存在显著差异，在非英语环境中偏见会持续下降；(2) 推理过程通常会引入额外的刻板印象驱动的信号，这些信号会体现在最终的输出结果中；(3) 以英语训练出的去偏见方法无法可靠地泛化到其他语言上，而偏好优化则会导致跨语言之间的权衡。此外，我们还发现，在多语言环境中的性能提升往往是由于隐含地依赖了以英语为中心的推理方式所导致的，这一点可以通过增加的语言漂移现象来体现。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，多语言公平性不能仅从英语的性能中推断出来，而是需要基于推理过程的、针对特定语言的评估和对齐机制。

papers.title: Multi-Constraint State Tracking with Negation: A Diagnostic Benchmark for LLM World Modeling
papers.title_zh: 基于否定关系的多约束状态跟踪：用于大型语言模型世界建模的诊断性基准测试
papers.authors: Ayan Sar, Pranav Singh Puri, Sumit Aich, Anurag Kaushish, Tanupriya Choudhury, Ajith Abraham
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on a wide range of reasoning benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they can reliably maintain and update internal representations of an evolving world described in natural language. In particular, existing evaluations inadequately probe state tracking under multiple interacting constraints and largely overlook the role of negated actions, despite their ubiquity in real-world language. We address this gap by introducing MCST, a diagnostic benchmark for multi-constraint state tracking that evaluates an LLM’s ability to maintain consistent world models across sequences of actions involving inventory changes, spatial movement, temporal ordering, and systematic negation. MCST comprises 100,847 questions spanning 12 real-world domains, with five calibrated difficulty levels, nine question types, and controlled integration of negated actions. The benchmark further incorporates culturally diverse entity names to enable analysis of cross-cultural robustness. We evaluate 14 SOTA LLMs across multiple model families using a unified evaluation protocol. Our results reveal substantial limitations: even the strongest models exhibit sharp performance degradation as difficulty increases, with accuracy dropping below 35% at the highest level. Most notably, we identify negation as a dominant failure mode, causing accuracy reductions of 23-32\% across models. We release MCST and the full evaluation framework to support future research on state tracking and reasoning in language models and is available at GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在众多推理基准测试中表现出强大的性能，但尚不清楚它们是否能够可靠地维护和更新以自然语言描述的动态世界的内部表征。具体而言，现有的评估方法未能充分考察在多种约束条件下状态跟踪的情况，而且很大程度上忽略了否定动作的作用，而否定动作在现实世界的语言中普遍存在。为了解决这一缺陷，我们提出了MCST这一多约束状态跟踪诊断基准，该基准评估了语言模型在涉及库存变化、空间移动、时间排序以及系统否定等动作序列中保持一致的世界模型的能力。MCST包含100,847个问题，涵盖12个现实领域，有五个不同的难度等级、九种问题类型，并且严格控制了否定动作的使用。此外，该基准还包含了文化多样性较高的实体名称，以便分析跨文化的鲁棒性。我们使用统一的评估协议对14种最先进的语言模型进行了评估，这些模型来自不同的模型家族。我们的评估结果显示出了显著的局限性：即使是最强大的模型，在难度增加的情况下也会出现明显的性能下降，最高难度下的准确率甚至低于35%。最值得注意的是，我们发现否定动作是导致准确率下降的主要原因，不同模型的准确率下降了23%-32%。我们已发布MCST以及完整的评估框架，以支持未来关于语言模型状态跟踪和推理的研究，相关代码可访问GitHub网站。

papers.title: Learning Shortcut Models for Efficient Recursive Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 学习用于高效递归推理的捷径模型
papers.authors: Shiv Shankar
papers.abstract: Recursive models that progressively refine latent representations have demonstrated strong performance on a variety of reasoning tasks. However, these models only control whether and when to stop early, not how computation is distributed. In this work, we introduce shortcut reasoning, a framework for distilling recursive latent reasoning into a multiscale jump model that enables flexible test-time compute. We reinterpret recursive reasoning as a latent-time dynamical process and train a student model to predict the effect of multiple reasoning steps at once. To ensure robustness, we augment shortcut transitions with a repair mechanism, where a denoising variant of the base model projects latent states back onto a valid reasoning manifold. We further introduce stepwise improvement supervision, encouraging each shortcut step to increase the likelihood of the correct answer. Experiments on ARC-AGI show that our approach achieves competitive accuracy compared to recursive baselines while requiring fewer sequential updates.
papers.abstract_zh: 递归模型通过逐步优化潜在表示，在多种推理任务中表现出强大的性能。然而，这些模型只能控制何时以及是否提前停止计算，而无法处理计算的分配问题。在这项研究中，我们提出了“快捷推理”框架，它将递归式潜在推理转化为多尺度跳跃模型，从而实现灵活的计算方式。我们将递归推理重新定义为一种潜在时间动态过程，并训练一个学生模型来同时预测多个推理步骤的效果。为了确保模型的鲁棒性，我们在快捷推理的过渡过程中加入了修复机制：通过去除噪声的方式将基础模型的潜在状态重新映射到有效的推理空间上。此外，我们还引入了逐步改进的监督机制，促使每个快捷推理步骤都能提高正确答案的概率。在ARC-AGI上的实验表明，我们的方法在保持较低序列更新次数的同时，取得了与递归基线模型相当的准确性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Confident Liar: Diagnosing Multi-Agent Debate with Log-Probabilities and LLM-as-Judge
papers.title_zh: 自信的骗子：利用日志概率和大型语言模型作为裁判来诊断多智能体辩论问题
papers.authors: Ali Keramati, Justin Cheok, Jacob Horne, Mark Warschauer
papers.abstract: Multi-agent debate systems are typically evaluated only on whether thefinal answer is correct, overlooking the quality of the intermediatereasoning that debate is designed to produce. This paper studies therelationship between three signals in multi-agent debate: token-levellog-probability distributions over reasoning tokens, LLM-as-judge rubricscores assigned to those tokens, and final task accuracy. We examinewhether internal confidence signals predict externally evaluated reasoningquality, and whether either signal aligns with task correctness, acrossthree domains: rubric-based scoring, mathematical reasoning, and factualquestion answering. Our framework pairs a two-agent debate architecture—a Constructor and an Auditor—with anLLM-as-judge that scores each agent’s reasoning along instructionfollowing, justification quality, and evidence grounding, together with acritical-failure flag. Experiments in the rubric-scoring domain reveal aconsistent four-phase confidence trajectory and a substantial roleasymmetry: confidence aligns with judged reasoning quality roughly twiceas strongly for the Constructor as for the Auditor, and confidence-based detection ofcritical reasoning failures is markedly more reliable for the Constructor(AUROC 0.804) than for the Auditor (0.634). These findings motivate thebroader cross-domain investigation proposed in this paper.
papers.abstract_zh: 多智能体辩论系统通常仅通过最终答案的正确性来评估，而忽略了辩论过程中所产生的中间推理质量。本文研究了多智能体辩论中三个信号之间的关系：关于推理标记的标记水平-逻辑-概率分布、分配给这些标记的LLM裁判评分标准，以及最终任务的准确性。我们探讨了内部置信度信号是否能够预测外部评估的推理质量，以及这两种信号是否都与任务正确性相关，研究涵盖了三个领域：基于评分标准的评估、数学推理和事实问答。我们的框架将两种智能体辩论架构——构建者和审核者——与一个LLM裁判相结合，该裁判根据遵循指令、推理质量以及证据基础对每个智能体的推理进行评分，并同时提供关键错误标志。在基于评分标准的评估领域的实验中，我们发现置信度呈现出一致的四阶段变化轨迹，并且存在显著的不对称性：对于构建者而言，置信度与推理质量的关联强度大约是审核者的两倍；此外，基于置信度的关键错误检测在构建者上的可靠性明显更高（AUC 0.804），而在审核者上则较低（0.634）。这些发现激发了本文提出的跨领域研究。

papers.title: Convergent Demographic Utility Hierarchies: Geometry of Intersectional Values in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 收敛的人口统计效用层次结构：大语言模型中不同性别价值观的交集几何形态
papers.authors: Pravish Sainath
papers.abstract: Recent work has shown that LLMs develop internally coherent utility functions that emerge with scale, yet whether these value systemsencode systematic demographic hierarchies remains unexplored. We elicit pairwise preferences across 15 intersectional demographic groups (defined by race, gender, and their combinations) and 8 policy domains on three 7–8B instruction-tuned LLMs, fitting Thurstonian utility models to the resulting preference matrices. All three models converge on a compensatory hierarchy that invertsreal-world structural advantage, consistently ranking marginalized groups, the highest and dominant groups are lowest. Intersectional utilities do not combine additively: single-axis audits that measure gender and race gaps independently overestimate the most extreme intersectional gap by 26- 40% in our experiments. Geometrically, we identify a linear direction in the representation space that predicts the full utility hierarchy from neutral sentences alone, and show that this direction is substantially aligned with gender encoding but not with race encoding. Orthogonalization reveals that gender separation in representations is not fully explained by utility encoding. The hierarchy is already present in base (pre-alignment) models and is amplified several-fold by instruction tuning, suggesting it originates in pre-training data rather than alignment procedures.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，大语言模型会发展出内在一致的效用函数，这些函数随着规模的扩大而逐渐稳定。不过，这些价值体系是否包含系统性的社会阶层划分，目前仍未被充分研究。我们在三个参数规模为 7B 至 8B 的指令微调语言模型中，收集了15个基于种族、性别及其组合定义的社会群体在8个政策领域中的成对偏好数据，并将Thurston效用模型应用于这些偏好矩阵。所有模型都收敛于一种补偿性等级结构，这种结构逆转了现实世界中的结构性优势，使得边缘化群体被优先排序，而最高级别和主导群体则处于最低等级。不同群体的效用并非可以简单相加：在我们的实验中，单独衡量性别和种族差异的单一指标分析，会将最极端的交叉性差异高估26%到40%。从几何角度来看，我们发现了一种在表示空间中存在的线性方向，该方向仅凭中性句子就能预测完整的效用等级结构。我们发现这一方向与性别编码高度一致，但与种族编码并不一致。正交化处理表明，表示中的性别分离并不能完全通过效用编码来解释。这种等级结构在基础模型就已经存在，而通过指令训练后，这种结构得到了数倍的增强，这表明它源自于预训练数据，而非对齐过程本身。

papers.title: CRL-Prompt: Contrastive and Reinforcement Learning for Soft Prompt Tuning for Text Classification
papers.title_zh: CRL-Prompt：用于文本分类的软提示调优技术——基于对比学习和强化学习的方案
papers.authors: Danila Lapokin, Andrey Savchenko
papers.abstract: Prompt choice is crucial in adapting language models to text classification tasks, particularly under low-resource conditions. Manual prompt engineering is time-consuming, non-scalable, and brittle, while current auto-prompting techniques are still far from maturity. This paper presents a two-stage method for prompt learning of frozen language models, CRL-Prompt, based on soft prompt initialization followed by contrastive and reinforcement-based refinement. An experimental study demonstrates that our approach achieves consistent improvements in accuracy over baseline prompt tuning strategies, with gains of up to 2.2% while training fewer than 0.25% of model parameters.
papers.abstract_zh: 在将语言模型适配到文本分类任务时，快速选择提示至关重要，尤其是在资源有限的情况下。手动设计提示过程耗时且不具备可扩展性，而且容易出错；而现有的自动提示技术也远未成熟。本文提出了一种两阶段的方法来进行冻结语言模型的提示学习，即CRL-Prompt。该方法首先通过软提示初始化开始，随后通过对比和强化学习进行优化。实验表明，我们的方法在准确性方面取得了持续改善的效果，即使只训练了不到0.25%的模型参数，也能使准确率提高2.2%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Optimizing Packing and Shuffling Strategies for Enhanced Performance in Generative Language Models
papers.title_zh: 优化打包和排序策略，以提升生成式语言模型的性能
papers.authors: Yanbing Chen, Ruilin Wang, Zihao Yang, Lavender Yao Jiang, Eric Karl Oermann
papers.abstract: Packing and shuffling tokens is a common practice in training auto-regressive language models to prevent overfitting and improve efficiency. Documents are typically concatenated to chunks of maximum sequence length (MSL) and shuffled in chunks of tokens (atom-size chunk), possibly breaking context within documents. An alternative approach is padding, which only includes one document per chunk. To optimize both packing strategies (concatenation vs padding), we explored the optimal atom size for shuffling and compared performance and efficiency. We found that in the most common setup (where average document length is greater than MSL), matching atom size to MSL yields the lowest perplexity, controlling for dataset. Also, padding yields lower final perplexity than concatenation at the cost of lower efficiency. This trade-off informs the choice of shuffling and packing methods in training LMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在训练自回归语言模型时，对标记进行打包和随机化是一种常见的做法，这样可以防止过拟合并提高训练效率。通常，文档会被分割成最大序列长度不等的块，而标记则按原子大小的单位进行随机化处理，这可能会破坏文档内部的上下文关系。另一种方法是仅每个块包含一个文档，这种方式的打包策略可以优化这两种方法（串联与打包）。为了同时优化这两种打包策略，我们探索了随机化的最佳原子大小，并比较了不同策略下的性能与效率。研究发现，在最常见的设置中（即文档平均长度大于最大序列长度时），将原子大小设置为与最大序列长度相等能够产生最低的困惑度，这一结果在不同数据集上都是成立的。此外，与串联相比，打包方式能带来更低的最终困惑度，但效率会有所下降。这种权衡为在训练自回归语言模型时选择随机化或打包方法提供了依据。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLM as a Meta-Judge: Synthetic Data for NLP Evaluation Metric Validation
papers.title_zh: 作为“元评判者”的LLM：用于自然语言处理评估指标的合成数据验证
papers.authors: Lukáš Eigler, Jindřich Libovický, David Hurych
papers.abstract: Validating evaluation metrics for NLG typically relies on expensive and time-consuming human annotations, which predominantly exists only for English datasets. We propose LLM as a Meta-Judge, a scalable framework that utilizes LLMs to generate synthetic evaluation datasets via controlled semantic degradation of real data, replacing human judgment. We validate our approach using meta-correlation, measuring the alignment between metric rankings derived from synthetic data and those from standard human benchmarks. Experiments across Machine Translation, Question Answering, and Summarization demonstrate that synthetic validation serves as a reliable proxy for human judgment, achieving meta-correlations exceeding 0.9 in multilingual QA and proves to be a viable alternative where human judgments are unavailable or too expensive to obtain. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/eiglerl/meta-judge.
papers.abstract_zh: 在自然语言生成领域验证评估指标时，通常依赖于昂贵且耗时的人工标注工作，而这类标注主要适用于英语数据集。我们提出了一种名为“Meta-Judge”的可扩展框架，该框架利用大语言模型通过有控制的语义处理来生成合成评估数据集，从而替代人工判断。我们通过测量从合成数据得出的评估指标排名与标准人工基准测试中的排名之间的相关性来验证我们的方法。在机器翻译、问答和摘要生成等领域的实验表明，合成评估数据可以作为人工判断的可靠替代方案，在多语言问答领域，其相关性超过了0.9。当无法获得或获取人工判断成本过高时，这种方法确实是一种可行的选择。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/eiglerl/meta-judge上免费获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Continuous Context Sampling Allows Extending Diversity Boundaries of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 连续上下文采样技术能够扩展大型语言模型的多样性边界
papers.authors: Mateusz Bystroński, Doheon Han, Nitesh V. Chawla, Tomasz Jan Kajdanowicz
papers.abstract: Starting from the observation that conditioning a poetry-writing prompt with a pancake recipe leads an LLM to produce a coherent poem incorporating pancake-related content and, more broadly, that such contexts arrange themselves into a structured semantic vector space, we argue that this renders the space explorable. By sampling it and using the resulting continuous representations to condition an LLM’s generation distribution, we can systematically expand the model’s reachable semantic range.We introduce a framework that requires no modification of LLM parameters and operationalizes this idea by constructing a conditioning distribution from a small set of diverse anchor generations. This distribution conditions LLM’s generation via an xRAG-style projector.Our experiments demonstrate that this manifold-based conditioning substantially increases generative diversity, with direct benefits for enhancing divergent thinking, a core facet of creativity, in language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于这样一个观察：将诗歌创作提示与煎饼食谱相结合，能够促使大语言模型生成出包含与煎饼相关内容的连贯诗歌；而更广义地说，这样的上下文可以被整理成一个结构化的语义向量空间。我们认为，这种结构使得该空间可以被探索。通过采样这个空间，并利用所获得的连续表示来影响大语言模型的生成分布，我们可以系统地扩展模型所能处理的语义范围。我们提出了一个无需修改大语言模型参数的框架，并通过从一组多样化的初始生成结果中构建出一个条件分布来实现这一想法。这个条件分布通过一种xRAG风格的投影器来影响大语言模型的生成过程。我们的实验表明，这种基于流形的条件化方法显著提升了生成多样性，对提升语言模型的发散性思维能力有着直接的好处，而发散性思维正是创造力的核心要素之一。

papers.title: One Task Vector is not Enough: A Large-Scale Study for In-Context Learning
papers.title_zh: 单个任务向量远远不够：一项针对上下文学习的大规模研究
papers.authors: Pavel Tikhonov, Ivan Oseledets, Elena Tutubalina
papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to adapt to new tasks using few examples, with task vectors, defined as specific hidden state activations hypothesized to encode task information. Existing studies are limited by small-scale benchmarks, restricting comprehensive analysis. We introduce QᴜɪᴛᴇAFᴇᴡ, a novel dataset of 3,096 diverse few-shot tasks, each with 30 input-output pairs derived from the Alpaca dataset. Experiments with Llama-3-8B on QᴜɪᴛᴇAFᴇᴡ reveal: (1) task vector performance peaks at an intermediate layer (e.g., 15th), (2) effectiveness varies significantly by task type, and (3) complex tasks rely on multiple, subtask-specific vectors rather than a single vector, suggesting distributed task knowledge representation.
papers.abstract_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）使得大语言模型能够利用少量示例来适应新任务。这些任务向量被假设为编码任务信息的特定隐藏状态激活值。现有的研究受到小规模基准数据的限制，从而无法进行全面的分析。我们提出了QᴜɪᴛᴇAFᴇᴡ这一新颖的数据集，该数据集包含3,096个多样化的小样本任务，每个任务都有30对输入-输出对，这些输入-输出对来自Alpaca数据集。在Llama-3-8B模型上进行的实验表明：(1) 任务向量的性能在中间层达到峰值（例如第15层）；(2) 不同任务类型的有效性差异显著；(3) 复杂的任务需要多个特定于子任务的向量，而不是单一的向量，这表明任务知识表示是分布式的。

papers.title: Future of Work in the Age of LLMs
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型时代的工作未来
papers.authors: Zora Wang, Yijia Shao, David Nguyen, Diyi Yang
papers.abstract: The recent development of large language models (LLMs) has revolutionized the landscape of human work. These models possess the ability to follow complex human instructions and operate versatile computer software, enabling them to participate in, augment, or even automate realistic occupational tasks that once thought to be exclusive to humans. As LLMs are increasingly integrated into workplaces, they are already reshaping labor dynamics (Hoffmann et al., 2024; Demirci et al., 2025) and raising urgent concerns about job displacement, diminished human agency, and overreliance on automation (Hazra et al., 2025). As a result, the future of work is undergoing a profound transformation: How will human occupations and task requirements evolve over time? And what roles will LLM-based systems play, as they become increasingly capable collaborators and autonomous workers? And how can we build technological and data infrastructures to support human-AI collaboration? This tutorial will provide an overview of the future of work shaped by the interplay of LLMs and humans, examining the emerging challenges, opportunities, and ethical considerations in this dynamic landscape. We begin by examining the economic landscape of work and how NLP technologies drive automation, followed by methods for developing LLMs that augment human labor and recent advances in LLM-based agents. We then cover evaluation approaches for workplace contexts, including datasets, benchmarks, and metrics, and conclude with open questions on technical, human, and societal implications.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新发展彻底改变了人类工作的格局。这些模型能够遵循复杂的人类指令，并操作各种计算机软件，使得它们能够参与、增强甚至自动化那些曾经被认为只有人类才能完成的职业任务。随着大语言模型越来越多地融入工作场所，它们正在重塑劳动动态（Hoffmann等人，2024年；Demirci等人，2025年），同时也引发了关于工作被取代、人类主体性减弱以及过度依赖自动化等紧迫问题的担忧（Hazra等人，2025年）。因此，工作的未来正经历着深刻的变革：随着时间的推移，人类的职业和任务要求将会如何演变？基于大语言模型的系统将扮演什么样的角色，因为它们越来越能成为有能力的合作者和自主工作者？我们又该如何构建技术和数据基础设施来支持人与人工智能的协作呢？本教程将概述由大语言模型与人类相互作用所塑造的未来工作形态，探讨这一动态领域中出现的挑战、机遇以及伦理问题。我们首先分析工作的经济格局，以及自然语言处理技术如何推动自动化进程，接着介绍开发能够增强人类劳动的大语言模型的方法，以及基于大语言模型的智能体的最新进展。随后，我们将讨论适用于工作场所的评估方法，包括数据集、基准测试和指标，最后提出关于技术、人类和社会层面的开放性问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Data Frontier for Large Language Models: Selection, Synthesis, and Tools
papers.title_zh: 用于大型语言模型的数据前沿技术：选择、合成与工具介绍
papers.authors: Lijun Wu, Wentao Zhang, Conghui He
papers.abstract: As the development of Large Language Models (LLMs) matures, the focus of the research community is undergoing a critical shift from a purely model-centric to a data-centric paradigm. It is now evident that the quality, diversity, and composition of training data—not merely its scale—are the primary drivers of a model’s advanced capabilities, from complex reasoning to reliable instruction following. However, acquiring and curating such high-quality data remains a significant bottleneck. This tutorial provides a comprehensive and practical guide to the state-of-the-art in data research directions for LLMs. We structure the tutorial around the two core pillars of modern data strategy: intelligent data selection and advanced data synthesis. In the first part, we delve into methods for curating the most valuable information from vast, noisy datasets, covering techniques like LLM-as-a-judge for automated quality filtering and active learning for maximizing annotation efficiency. The second part explores the synthetic data revolution, detailing paradigms that range from generating complex reasoning traces (e.g., Chain-of-Thought) to deploying sophisticated multi-agent workflows that can autonomously create high-quality, diverse instruction data from raw seeds. Finally, we will conclude with a practical overview of open-source tools and platforms that facilitate these data-centric workflows, empowering researchers and practitioners to build better models through better data. Attendees will leave with a principled framework and actionable insights for designing and implementing the advanced data strategies required to build the next generation of powerful, specialized, and aligned LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的发展成熟，研究界的关注点正在从单纯的模型中心主义转向数据中心主义。现在越来越明显的是，训练数据的质量、多样性和构成——而不仅仅是其规模——才是提升模型能力的关键因素，包括复杂的推理能力和可靠的指令遵循能力。然而，获取和筛选如此高质量的数据仍然是一个巨大的挑战。本教程为LLM领域的数据研究提供了全面而实用的指导。我们围绕现代数据策略的两个核心支柱来构建教程内容：智能数据选择和高级数据合成。在第一部分中，我们将探讨如何从庞大的、噪声较大的数据集中筛选出最有价值的信息，包括使用LLM作为裁判进行自动质量过滤技术，以及利用主动学习来提高注释效率的方法。第二部分则探讨了合成数据的革命性应用，详细介绍了从生成复杂的推理轨迹（例如思维链）到部署复杂的多智能体工作流程的各种方法，这些工作流程能够自主地从原始数据中生成高质量、多样化的指令数据。最后，我们将对支持这些数据中心工作流程的开源工具和平台进行概述，帮助研究人员和从业者通过更好的数据来构建更强大的模型。参加者将获得一套基于原则的框架和实用见解，从而能够设计和实施下一代强大、专业且符合需求的LLM所需的高级数据策略。

papers.title: Towards Effective and Efficient Multi-Agent Language Model Systems: Foundations, Prospects, and Applications
papers.title_zh: 构建高效且实用的多智能体语言模型系统：基础、前景与应用
papers.authors: Xuan Wang, Shuxiang Cao, Yuchen Zhuang, Wenqi Shi
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems powered by large language models (LLMs) offer a promising paradigm for tackling complex reasoning, decision-making, and problem-solving tasks. However, achieving both effectiveness and efficiency in such systems remains a critical challenge. This tutorial introduces recent advances in building effective and efficient multi-agent LLM systems, focusing on three core components. First, we discuss the design of individual LLM agents. We present state-of-the-art techniques for enabling capable agents using efficient and compact LLMs, including model distillation, dynamic routing, and memory- and compute efficient serving, providing a foundation for scalable and responsive agent design under resource constraints. Second, we cover coordination and communication among agents, crucial for collective performance, highlighting methods for improving multi-agent reasoning and decision-making through prompt and graph optimization, sycophancy mitigation, and structured LLM-based frameworks. Last, we explore real-world applications of LLM agents in areas such as industry, healthcare, quantum computing, and various scientific domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的多智能体系统为处理复杂的推理、决策和解决问题任务提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，在这些系统中实现高效性和效果仍然是一个关键挑战。本教程介绍了在构建高效且有效的多智能体语言模型系统方面的最新进展，重点探讨了三个核心组成部分。首先，我们讨论了单个语言模型智能体的设计。我们提出了一些最先进的技术，以使用高效且紧凑的语言模型来打造功能强大的智能体，包括模型蒸馏、动态路由以及内存和计算效率高的服务机制，为在资源限制下实现可扩展且响应迅速的智能体设计奠定了基础。其次，我们探讨了智能体之间的协调和通信问题，这对整体性能至关重要。我们强调了通过提示优化、图结构优化、减少协同效应以及基于结构化语言模型的框架来改善多智能体推理和决策的方法。最后，我们探讨了语言模型智能体在工业、医疗保健、量子计算以及各种科学领域中的实际应用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Current Advances in LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 大语言模型推理领域的当前进展
papers.authors: Akhil Arora, Vishrav Chaudhary, Julia Kreutzer, Nearchos Potamitis, Nouha Dziri, Niket Tandon
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly tackle reasoning-heavy tasks, from mathematics to commonsense to multilingual understanding, researchers face three pressing questions: How well do models reason? How can we make them reason better? What are the next frontiers in LLM reasoning? This tutorial answers these questions through a unified view of LLM reasoning. This tutorial explores comprehensive evaluation strategies to assess the reasoning abilities of models and discusses two types of methods to improve models’ reasoning: advanced inference time methods, such as structured and self-improvement inference methods, and (ii) post-training methods, such as RLHF, DPO, and GRPO that aim to make LLMs think more like humans. The tutorial explores these technical discussions while maintaining a practical outlook through illustrative demos and short guided hands-on exercises. The tutorial is designed for both researchers and practitioners seeking practical insights into LLM reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在处理各种需要推理能力的任务时表现得越来越出色，从数学到常识处理再到多语言理解，研究人员面临着三个关键问题：模型的推理能力如何？我们如何提升其推理能力？大语言模型在推理方面的下一个研究方向是什么？本教程通过统一的视角来解答这些问题。本文探讨了评估模型推理能力的综合评估策略，并介绍了两种改进模型推理的方法：一种是高级推理方法，如结构化推理和自改进推理；另一种是训练后方法，如强化学习引导的提示优化、数据偏好优化以及通用推理偏好优化，这些方法旨在让大语言模型更像人类进行思考。本教程通过实例演示和简短的动手练习，既深入探讨了这些技术细节，又注重实用性。本教程适合那些希望了解大语言模型推理机制的研究人员和从业者阅读。

papers.title: Knowledge Control for Responsible Generative AI: Bridging Academia, Industry, and Society
papers.title_zh: 用于负责任生成式人工智能的知识控制：连接学术界、工业界与社会
papers.authors: Zheyuan Liu, Yixin Wan, Kai-Wei Chang, Meng Jiang, Jieyu Zhao, Nouha Dziri, Yuning Mao, Jia-Chen Gu, Jindong Gu
papers.abstract: Controlling the knowledge and behavior of generative AI systems, including large language models (LLMs), multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), and text-to-image (T2I) models, has become critical as they are increasingly used in safety-sensitive and socially impactful applications. These models often encode unintended, biased, or private content, leading to harmful or unethical outputs. Post-training knowledge control has thus emerged as a practical framework for selectively modifying or removing model behaviors without full retraining, offering scalable and interpretable interventions for improving safety, privacy, and fairness. This tutorial introduces the foundations of post-training knowledge control and showcases recent frontier methods, bridging research insights with real-world practices from both academia and industry. We cover: (i) key motivations and failure modes, such as harmful generation and stereotype reinforcement; (ii) core methods such as machine unlearning, knowledge editing, and inference-time interventions for targeted behavior adjustment; and (iii) evaluation protocols for balancing forgetting, retention, and fairness. Case studies will span text and vision–language generation, including privacy preservation, bias mitigation, and factual correction.
papers.abstract_zh: 控制生成式AI系统的知识和行为至关重要，这些系统包括大语言模型、多模态语言模型以及文本到图像模型。由于这些模型越来越多地被应用于需要保障安全和社会影响的领域，因此对其进行控制变得十分必要。这些模型常常会编码出一些无意中的、带有偏见的内容或私密信息，从而导致有害或不道德的输出结果。因此，后训练知识控制成为一种实用的框架，它允许在不完全重新训练模型的情况下，有选择地修改或移除模型的某些行为，从而实现可扩展且易于理解的干预措施，以提升安全性、隐私性和公平性。本教程介绍了后训练知识控制的基础理论，并展示了一些最新的前沿方法，这些方法将学术研究成果与来自学术界和工业界的实际应用相结合。我们涵盖了以下内容：(i) 主要的动机和潜在问题，例如有害的生成效果以及刻板印象的强化；(ii) 核心的方法，如机器反学习、知识编辑以及在推理过程中进行的针对性行为调整；以及(iii) 用于平衡遗忘、保留和公平性的评估方案。案例研究将涉及文本和视觉-语言生成领域，包括隐私保护、偏见缓解以及事实修正等方面。

papers.title: The Interplay between Metaphors and NLP
papers.title_zh: 隐喻与神经语言程序学之间的相互作用
papers.authors: Joanne Boisson, Jose Camacho-Collados, Elisa Sanchez-Bayona, Rodrigo Agerri
papers.abstract: This tutorial will be of the type Introductory to CL/NLP topics, providing an overview of the metaphor processing field. The tutorial will discuss the influence of various metaphor theories on the creation of annotated resources and models. We will particularly focus on recent directions opened by LLMs for metaphor interpretation in multilingual and multimodal settings. Two types of audience may benefit from this tutorial: researchers in the humanities and computational social sciences interested in automatic or semi automatic metaphor analysis, and NLP researchers interested in understanding metaphor processing and improving metaphor modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 本教程属于CL/NLP领域的入门级内容，旨在概述隐喻处理领域的相关知识。我们将探讨各种隐喻理论对注释资源和模型构建的影响。特别关注大语言模型在多语言和多模态环境中进行隐喻解析方面所开辟的新方向。本教程适合两类读者：一类是从事人文和社会科学研究的人士，他们希望了解自动或半自动的隐喻分析方法；另一类则是自然语言处理领域的研究人员，他们希望深入理解隐喻处理机制，并改进隐喻建模技术。

papers.title: Smarter, not Bigger: Fine-Tuned RAG-Enhanced LLMs for Automotive Hardware-in-the-Loop Testing
papers.title_zh: 更智能，而非更大规模：针对汽车硬件在环测试优化的RAG增强型大语言模型
papers.authors: Chao Feng, Zihan Liu, Siddhant Gupta, Jan von der Assen
papers.abstract: Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing is essential for automotive validation but suffers from fragmented and underutilized test artifacts. This paper presents HIL-GPT, an industry-deployed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system that integrates semantic retrieval with domain-adapted large language models to support test engineers in real-world HIL workflows. The system combines domain-specific embeddings to enable traceable retrieval of test cases and requirements under industrial latency and cost constraints. Through empirical evaluation, we show that compact, domain-adapted models can achieve a favorable trade-off among accuracy, latency, and cost compared to larger general-purpose models, challenging the assumption that larger models are always preferable in industrial NLP systems. An A/B user study further confirms that HIL-GPT improves perceived helpfulness, truthfulness, and satisfaction over general-purpose LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 硬件在环测试对于汽车产品的验证至关重要，但当前存在测试资源分散且利用率低的问题。本文介绍了HIL-GPT这一在行业中被广泛应用的检索增强生成系统。该系统将语义检索与领域适配的大语言模型相结合，从而帮助测试工程师在实际的硬件在环测试工作中更好地发挥作用。该系统能够结合特定领域的嵌入信息，从而在工业级延迟和成本限制下，实现可追踪的测试用例和需求的检索。通过实证评估发现，与较大的通用模型相比，这种紧凑且适应特定领域的模型能够在准确性、延迟成本和成本之间取得良好的平衡，这挑战了“在工业自然语言处理系统中，更大的模型总是更优”的假设。此外，A/B用户研究进一步证实，HIL-GPT在感知到的实用性、真实性以及满意度方面均优于一般的LLM模型。

papers.title: MinerU2.5: A Decoupled Vision-Language Model for Efficient High-Resolution Document Parsing
papers.title_zh: MinerU2.5：一种分离了视觉与语言功能的模型，能够实现高效的高分辨率文档解析
papers.authors: Junbo Niu, Zheng Liu, Zhuangcheng Gu, Bin Wang, Linke Ouyang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Tao Chu, Tianyao He, Fan Wu, Qintong Zhang, Zhenjiang Jin, Guang Liang, Rui Zhang, Wenzheng Zhang, Yuan Qu, Zhifei Ren, Yuefeng Sun, Zirui Tang, Boyu Niu, Yuanhong Zheng, Dongsheng Ma, Ziyang Miao, Hejun Dong, Siyi Qian, Junyuan Zhang, Fangdong Wang, Jingzhou Chen, Xiaomeng Zhao, Liqun Wei, Wei Li, Shasha Wang, RuiLiang Xu, Yuanyuan Cao, Lu Chen, Qianqian Wu, Huaiyu Gu, Lindong Lu, Dechen Lin, Shenguanlin, Xuanhe Zhou, Linfeng Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Xiaoyi Dong, Jiaqi Wang, Bo Zhang, Lei Bai, Pei Chu, Weijia Li, Jiang Wu, Lijun Wu, Zhenxiang Li, Guangyu Wang, Zhongying Tu, Chao Xu, Kai Chen, Bowen Zhou, Dahua Lin, Wentao Zhang, Conghui He
papers.abstract: We introduce MinerU2.5, a 1.2B-parameter document parsing vision-language model that achieves state-of-the-art recognition accuracy while maintaining exceptional computational efficiency. Our approach employs a coarse-to-fine, two-stage parsing strategy that decouples global layout analysis from local content recognition. In the first stage, the model performs efficient layout analysis on downsampled images to identify structural elements, circumventing the computational overhead of processing high-resolution inputs. In the second stage, guided by the global layout, it performs targeted content recognition on native-resolution crops extracted from the original image, preserving fine-grained details in dense text, complex formulas, and tables. To support this strategy, we developed a comprehensive data engine that generates diverse, large-scale training corpora for both pretraining and fine-tuning. Ultimately, MinerU2.5 demonstrates strong document parsing ability, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks, surpassing both general-purpose and domain-specific models across various recognition tasks, while maintaining significantly lower computational overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了MinerU2.5模型，该模型是一个拥有12亿参数的文档解析视觉-语言模型，它在保持卓越计算效率的同时，能够实现最先进的识别精度。我们的方法采用了从粗到细的两阶段解析策略，将全局布局分析与局部内容识别分离开来。在第一阶段，模型对降采样后的图像进行高效的布局分析，以识别结构元素，从而避免了处理高分辨率输入时的计算开销。在第二阶段，模型在全局布局的引导下，对从原始图像中提取出的原生分辨率图像进行有针对性的内容识别，同时能够保留密集文本、复杂公式和表格中的细节信息。为了支持这一策略，我们开发了一个全面的数据引擎，能够生成多样化且规模庞大的训练数据集，用于预训练和微调。最终，MinerU2.5展现了强大的文档解析能力，在多个基准测试中都取得了最先进的性能表现，超越了各种通用模型和特定领域模型，同时显著降低了计算开销。

papers.title: Leveraging Generative AI for Extracting Business Requirements from Legacy COBOL and PL/I Code
papers.title_zh: 利用生成式人工智能从旧的COBOL和PL/I代码中提取业务需求
papers.authors: Ankur Kalohia
papers.abstract: Recovering business requirements fromCOBOL and PL/I portfolios is difficult becauselogic is scattered across interdependentprograms and data definitions, and existinganalyses seldom yield stakeholder-facingartifacts. We introduce an LLM-augmentedreverse-engineering pipeline that providesdeterministic parsing, schema-constrainedLLM generation with bidirectional traceabilityto code. It couples grammar-based parsingand control-flow and data-flow analysis with alarge language model to translate an enrichedintermediate representation into structuredspecifications. This is not raw-code promptingor generic summarization, the novelty is theLLM-centered generation over an enriched IR,with structured JSON outputs and traceabilityfor compliance-sensitive settings. The pipelineproduces business requirements documents,explicit rule catalogs, end-to-end data lineage,create–read–update–delete matrices, and field-level source-to-target mappings, each linkedto the supporting code. In a financial industrysetting, containing 3.4M+ LoC includingcomments / 3.2M excluding comments ofCOBOL, the system achieves 93% agreementwith expert-authored business rules andreduces documentation effort by approximately70%, as measured against manually producedrequirement documents and rule sets. On theinternal corpus spanning 3.4M lines acrossonline, batch, and job control workloads, theapproach yields approximately 3.2–3.3× fasteranalysis while improving artifact consistencyand traceability.
papers.abstract_zh: 从COBOL和PL/I项目中恢复业务需求是一项困难的任务，因为逻辑信息分散在相互依赖的程序和数据定义中，而现有的分析往往无法产生可供利益相关者使用的成果。我们提出了一种基于大语言模型的逆向工程流程，该流程能够提供确定性解析、受模式约束的大语言模型生成，并且具有双向可追溯性，可以直接映射到代码中。该流程结合了基于语法的解析、控制流分析以及数据流分析，并利用大语言模型将丰富的中间表示转化为结构化的规范文档。这并不是简单的代码提示或通用总结，其创新之处在于以大语言模型为中心进行生成，同时拥有结构化的JSON输出和可追溯性，以满足合规性要求。该流程能够生成业务需求文档、明确的规则目录、端到端的数据溯源信息、创建-读取-更新-删除矩阵，以及字段级源目标映射，这些成果都与相应的代码相关联。在金融行业的场景中，该系统能够处理340万行以上的源代码，其中包括32万条注释；而仅考虑COBOL代码时，系统的准确率可达93%，并且能够减少约70%的文档编制工作量。在涵盖在线、批处理和作业控制等三种工作负载的340万行内部数据上，该方法的分析速度大约快了3.2到3.3倍，同时还能提高成果的一致性和可追溯性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Is Agentic RAG worth it? An experimental comparison of RAG approaches
papers.title_zh: Agentic RAG值得尝试吗？对RAG方法的实验性比较
papers.authors: Pietro Ferrazzi, Milica Cvjetićanin, Alessio Piraccini, Davide Giannuzzi
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are usually defined by the combination of a generator and a retrieval component that extracts textual context from a knowledge base to answer user queries. However, such basic implementations exhibit several limitations, including noisy or suboptimal retrieval, misuse of retrieval for out-of-scope queries, weak query–document matching, and variability or cost associated with the generator. These shortcomings have motivated the development of “Enhanced” RAG, where dedicated modules are introduced to address specific weaknesses in the workflow.More recently, the growing self-reflective capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a new paradigm, often referred to as “Agentic” RAG. In this approach, an LLM orchestrates the entire process, deciding which actions to perform, when to perform them, and whether to iterate. Despite the rapid adoption of both paradigms, it remains unclear which approach is preferable under which conditions.In this work, we conduct an empirically driven evaluation of “Enhanced” and “Agentic” RAG across multiple scenarios and dimensions. Our results provide practical insights into the trade-offs between the two paradigms, offering guidance on selecting the most effective RAG design for real-world applications, considering both performance and costs.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常由生成器和检索组件组成，前者从知识库中提取文本上下文以回答用户查询。然而，这种基本实现存在若干局限性，包括检索过程可能出现噪声或效果不佳的情况、将检索功能误用于不相关的查询、查询与文档的匹配不够准确，以及生成器的性能不稳定或成本较高等问题。这些缺陷促使人们开发了“增强型”RAG技术，通过引入专门的模块来弥补工作流程中的特定弱点。最近，大语言模型日益增强的自反思能力催生了一种新的范式，即所谓的“智能型”RAG。在这种方法中，大语言模型负责协调整个过程，决定执行哪些操作、何时执行这些操作，以及是否需要重复执行某些步骤。尽管这两种范式都得到了迅速应用，但在不同情况下哪种方法更为合适仍然不明确。在这项研究中，我们对“增强型”和“智能型”RAG进行了实证评估，涵盖了多种场景和维度。我们的研究结果为两种范式之间的权衡提供了实际指导，有助于选择最适合现实应用中的RAG设计方案，同时兼顾性能和成本因素。

papers.title: Improving Hate Speech Detection by Fusing Textual and User Interaction Representations in Online Communities
papers.title_zh: 通过结合在线社区中的文本数据以及用户互动信息，提升仇恨言论的检测能力
papers.authors: Xu Gao, Dong Jing, Kee-hung Lai
papers.abstract: Detecting hate speech in online communities is increasingly challenging due to the implicit and context-dependent nature of toxic expressions. While text-only models often struggle with such ambiguity, incorporating user interaction signals offers critical pragmatic context for disambiguation. However, research in this direction is hindered by the scarcity of datasets that align textual content with comprehensive user behavioral graphs. To bridge this gap, we present a new dataset collected from a real-world community, featuring labeled hate speech enriched with fine-grained interaction histories. We further propose a novel user-aware hate speech detection framework that effectively fuses textual semantics with social interaction representations. Experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms strong text-only baselines by over 3.6%, validating the critical role of social context in enhancing detection accuracy. Furthermore, to mitigate real-world adversarial risks such as graph spoofing and spam, we introduce a contrastive graph augmentation strategy, ensuring model robustness against unreliable community behaviors.
papers.abstract_zh: 在在线社区中检测仇恨言论变得越来越具有挑战性，因为有害言论往往具有隐性和依赖于上下文的特性。虽然仅基于文本的模型常常难以处理这种模糊性，但结合用户互动信息可以为消歧提供重要的实际背景。然而，这方面的研究受到数据集稀缺性的限制，因为这些数据集无法将文本内容与全面的用户行为图谱联系起来。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个来自真实社区的新数据集，该数据集包含带有详细互动历史的标注仇恨言论内容。我们还提出了一种新颖的用户感知仇恨言论检测框架，该框架能够有效融合文本语义与社会互动信息。实验表明，我们的方法始终优于基于文本的强基线算法，其性能提升了3.6%以上，这验证了社会背景在提高检测准确性方面的重要性。此外，为了应对现实世界中的对抗性风险，如图结构伪造和垃圾信息问题，我们引入了对比性图增强策略，从而确保模型能够抵御不可靠的社区行为的影响。

papers.title: TeachMaster: Generative Teaching via Code
papers.title_zh: TeachMaster：通过代码实现生成式教学
papers.authors: Yuheng Wang, Runde Yang, Lin Wu, Jie Zhang, Jingru Fan, Tianle Zhou, Ruoyu Fu, Huatao Li, Ruijie Shi, Siheng Chen, Weinan E, Chen Qian
papers.abstract: The scalability of high-quality online education is hindered by the high costs and slow cycles of manual content creation.Despite advancements in video generation, current approaches often fail to ensure pedagogical structure and precise control due to their pixel-level, black-box nature.In this paper, we propose Generative Teaching, a novel paradigm shifting educators from manual creators to high-level directors who focus on pedagogical intents while agents handle the execution. To realize this vision, we introduce TeachMaster, a multi-agent framework that leverages code as an intermediate semantic medium. Unlike traditional video generation methods, TeachMaster orchestrates a collaborative team of agents, spanning planning, design, and rendering, to automate the production of interpretable, editable, and curriculum-ready educational videos. Experiments validate that TeachMaster significantly boosts production efficiency without compromising structural coherence or visual fidelity, slashing production costs to only 0.3% of traditional online course videos and providing a robust solution for scalable education.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量在线教育的可扩展性受到高昂成本和手动内容创作过程缓慢的阻碍。尽管视频生成技术取得了进展，但当前的方法往往无法确保教学结构的合理性和精确性，因为它们具有像素级、黑盒式的特性。在本文中，我们提出了“生成式教学”这一新范式，它将教育者从手动创作者转变为专注于教学意图的高级导演，而具体执行工作则由代理程序负责。为了实现这一愿景，我们引入了TeachMaster这一多智能体框架，该框架将代码作为中间语义媒介来使用。与传统的视频生成方法不同，TeachMaster能够协调一个由多个代理组成的协作团队，涵盖规划、设计和渲染等环节，从而自动化地生成可解释、可编辑且符合课程要求的教育视频。实验表明，TeachMaster显著提升了生产效率，同时不会牺牲结构连贯性或视觉质量，其生产成本仅为传统在线课程视频的0.3%，为可扩展的教育提供了强有力的解决方案。

papers.title: ARGUS: Policy-Adaptive Ad Governance via Evolving Reinforcement with Adversarial Umpiring
papers.title_zh: ARGUS：通过自适应强化学习来实现广告治理，同时处理竞争性打赏行为
papers.authors: Deyi Ji, Junyu Lu, Xuanyi Liu, Liqun Liu, Hailong Zhang, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang, Tianrun Chen, Lanyun Zhu
papers.abstract: Online advertising governance faces significant challenges due to the non-stationary nature of regulatory policies, where emerging mandates (e.g., restrictions on education or aesthetic anxiety) create severe label inconsistencies and reasoning ambiguities in historical datasets. In this paper, we propose ARGUS, a policy-adaptive governance system that enables evolving reinforcement through multi-agent adversarial umpiring. ARGUS addresses the sparsity of new policy data by employing a three-stage framework: (1) Policy Seeding for initial perception; (2) Adversarial Label Rectification, which utilizes a ”Prosecutor-Defender-Umpire” architecture to resolve conflicts between stale labels and new mandates; and (3) Latent Knowledge Discovery, which employs a tripartite dialectical discussion to unearth sophisticated, “gray-area” violations. By leveraging RAG-enhanced policy knowledge and Chain-of-Thought synthesis as dynamic rewards for reinforcement learning, ARGUS synchronizes its reasoning pathways with evolving regulations. Extensive experiments on both industrial and public datasets demonstrate that ARGUS significantly outperforms traditional fine-tuning baselines, achieving superior policy-adaptive learning with minimal gold data.
papers.abstract_zh: 在线广告监管面临着重大挑战，因为监管政策的特性并非一成不变。新兴的监管要求（例如对教育或审美方面的限制）会导致历史数据集中出现严重的标签不一致性和推理模糊性。在本文中，我们提出了ARGUS这一政策自适应监管系统。该系统通过多智能体对抗式仲裁机制来实现不断进化的决策过程。ARGUS通过采用三阶段框架来解决新政策数据的稀疏性问题：(1) 政策初始化，用于初步识别问题；(2) 对抗性标签修正，采用“检察官-辩护者-仲裁员”架构来解决陈旧标签与新监管要求之间的冲突；(3) 潜在知识发现，通过三方辩证讨论来揭示那些复杂的、“灰色地带”的违规行为。通过利用RAG增强的政策知识和思维链合成作为强化学习的动态奖励，ARGUS能够使其推理路径与不断变化的法规保持一致。在工业和公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，ARGUS在性能上显著优于传统的微调基线方法，能够在较少的黄金数据情况下实现更出色的政策自适应学习效果。

papers.title: Synthetic Text Detection in the Age of Large Language Models: Watermark vs. Automatic Detection
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型时代的合成文本检测：水印与自动检测
papers.authors: Adaku Uchendu
papers.abstract: Given the ubiquitous nature of Large Language Models (LLMs) and its impressive capabilities, malicious uses of this technology to generate harmful content have been observed. Thus, to mitigate this serious security risk LLMs pose, many researchers have proposed two techniques for detecting synthetic texts generated from LLMs - watermark and automatic detection. The idea with watermarking LLMs involves infusing generated content with algorithmically-identifiable patterns during generation. This makes accurate synthetic text detection achievable with watermark detection. While, for automatic detection, the focus is on using statistical and linguistic cues to reveal authorship of texts as human or LLM. Currently, both types of synthetic text detectors achieve state-of-the-art performance, however, the better detector is still unknown. To ascertain the better detection method, we evaluate each method on their performance on both unperturbed and perturbed (i.e., adversarially manipulated texts) data. We perform a comprehensive study across six different sizes of Qwen2.5 models, six watermark techniques and detectors, two automatic detectors, three authorship obfuscation methods for different levels of syntactic changes, and two datasets of different text lengths. Our results suggest that there is no detector that consistently outperforms on all scenarios. However, we observe that the (1) automatic detectors are better for short synthetic text detection; and (2) watermark detectors perform better defending against the word-level attack implemented.
papers.abstract_zh: 鉴于大语言模型（LLMs）的普遍性和其强大的能力，人们已经观察到利用这种技术生成有害内容的恶意行为。因此，为了减轻LLMs带来的严重安全风险，许多研究人员提出了两种检测由LLMs生成的合成文本的方法——水印技术和自动检测技术。水印技术的原理是在生成内容中嵌入可算法识别的模式，这使得通过水印检测来准确识别合成文本成为可能。而自动检测技术则侧重于使用统计和语言学手段来判断文本的作者是人类还是LLM。目前，这两种合成文本检测技术都取得了非常出色的性能，不过哪种方法更优仍然未知。为了确定更好的检测方法，我们分别在未受干扰和受到干扰的数据上评估了每种方法的性能。我们对六种不同规模的Qwen2.5模型、六种水印技术和检测器、两种自动检测器、三种用于应对不同句法变化的作者身份隐藏方法，以及两个不同文本长度的数据集进行了全面研究。我们的结果表明，没有一种检测器能够在所有情况下都表现出明显的优势。不过，我们发现：(1) 自动检测器在检测短文本时表现更好；(2) 水印检测器在抵御针对单词级别的攻击方面表现得更为出色。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: R³A: Reinforced Reasoning for Relevance Assessment for RAG in User-Generated Content Platforms
papers.title_zh: R³A：用于用户生成内容平台中相关性评估的强化推理机制
papers.authors: Xiaowei Yuan, Lei Jin, Haoxin Zhang, Ziyang Huang, Yan Gao, Yiwu, Yao Hu, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) plays a critical role in user-generated content (UGC) platforms, but its effectiveness critically depends on accurate query–document relevance assessment. Despite recent advances in applying large language models (LLMs) to relevance modeling, UGC platforms present unique challenges: 1) ambiguous user intent due to sparse user feedback in RAG scenarios, and 2) asymmetric relevance, where relevance is driven by localized answer-bearing content rather than global query–document similarity. To address these issues, we propose the Reinforced Reasoning model for Relevance Assessment (R³A), which decomposes relevance assessment into intent inference and evidence grounding. R³A leverages auxiliary high-clicked documents to infer latent query intent, and extracts verbatim evidence fragments to ground relevance decisions, reducing noise sensitivity and improving asymmetric relevance modeling. Experimental results demonstrate that R³A substantially outperforms strong baselines on offline benchmarks, while the distilled R³A-1.5B model achieves significant gains in large-scale online A/B testing, effectively balancing performance and practical deployability.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）在用户生成内容平台中发挥着至关重要的作用，但其有效性在很大程度上取决于对查询与文档之间相关性的准确评估。尽管在应用大语言模型进行相关性建模方面取得了一些进展，但用户生成内容平台仍面临独特的挑战：1）由于RAG场景中用户反馈的稀疏性，导致用户意图难以明确；2）相关性呈现不对称现象，即相关性是由包含答案的内容来决定的，而非基于全局查询与文档之间的相似性。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了一种强化推理相关性评估模型（R³A）。该模型将相关性评估分解为意图推断和证据基础化两个步骤。R³A利用高点击次数的辅助文档来推断潜在的查询意图，并提取逐字的证据片段来支撑相关性决策，从而降低了噪声敏感性，并改善了不对称相关性建模的效果。实验结果表明，R³A在离线基准测试中的表现显著优于其他强基线模型；而在大规模在线A/B测试中，经过蒸馏处理的R³A-1.5B模型则取得了显著的提升，有效平衡了性能与实用性。

papers.title: HAD: HAllucination Detection Language Models Based on a Comprehensive Hallucination Taxonomy
papers.title_zh: HAD：基于全面幻觉分类的幻觉检测语言模型
papers.authors: Fan Xu, Xinyu Hu, Zhenghan Yu, Li Lin, Xu Zhang, Yang Zhang, Wei Zhou, Jinjie Gu, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: The increasing reliance on natural language generation (NLG) models, particularly large language models, has raised concerns about the reliability and accuracy of their outputs. A key challenge is hallucination, where models produce plausible but incorrect information. As a result, hallucination detection has become a critical task. In this work, we introduce a comprehensive hallucination taxonomy with 11 categories across various NLG tasks and propose the HAllucination Detection (HAD) models, which integrate hallucination detection, span-level identification, and correction into a single inference process. Trained on an elaborate synthetic dataset of about 90K samples, our HAD models are versatile and can be applied to various NLG tasks. We also carefully annotate a test set for hallucination detection, called HADTest, which contains 2,248 samples. Evaluations on in-domain and out-of-domain test sets show that our HAD models generally outperform the existing baselines, achieving state-of-the-art results on HaluEval, FactCHD, and FaithBench, confirming their robustness and versatility.
papers.abstract_zh: 对自然语言生成模型，尤其是大语言模型的依赖日益增加，引发了人们对这些模型输出可靠性和准确性的担忧。其中一个主要挑战就是幻觉现象，即模型产生看似合理但错误的信息。因此，幻觉检测已成为一项至关重要的任务。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种全面的幻觉分类体系，涵盖了11种不同类型的自然语言生成任务。同时，我们开发了HAllucination Detection（HAD）模型，该模型将幻觉检测、跨文档识别以及纠错功能整合到了一个统一的推理过程中。我们的HAD模型在约9万个样本的合成数据集上进行训练，具有广泛的适用性，可以应用于各种自然语言生成任务。我们还精心构建了一个用于幻觉检测的测试集，名为HADTest，其中包含2,248个样本。在领域内和领域外的测试集上的评估结果显示，我们的HAD模型通常优于现有的基线模型，在HaluEval、FactCHD和FaithBench等评测任务中取得了领先的成绩，这充分证明了其强大的鲁棒性和通用性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: DocSplit: A Comprehensive Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation Approach for Document Packet Recognition and Splitting
papers.title_zh: DocSplit：一个全面的基准数据集及评估方法，适用于文档包识别与分割任务
papers.authors: Md Mofijul Islam, Md Sirajus Salekin, Nivedha Balakrishnan, Vincil C. Bishop III, Niharika Jain, Spencer Romo, Bob Strahan, Boyi Xie, Diego A. Socolinsky
papers.abstract: Document understanding in real-world applications often requires processing heterogeneous, multi-page document packets containing multiple documents stitched together. Despite recent advances in visual document understanding, the fundamental task of document packet splitting, which involves separating a document packet into individual units, remains largely unaddressed. We present the first comprehensive benchmark dataset, \textit{DocSplit}, along with novel evaluation metrics for assessing the document packet splitting capabilities of large language models. \textit{DocSplit} comprises five datasets of varying complexity, covering diverse document types, layouts, and multimodal settings. We formalize the \textit{DocSplit} task, which requires models to identify document boundaries, classify document types, and maintain correct page ordering within a document packet. The benchmark addresses real-world challenges, including out-of-order pages, interleaved documents, and documents lacking clear demarcations. We conduct extensive experiments evaluating multimodal LLMs on our datasets, revealing significant performance gaps in current models’ ability to handle complex document splitting tasks. The \textit{DocSplit} benchmark datasets and proposed novel evaluation metrics provide a systematic framework for advancing document understanding capabilities essential for legal, financial, healthcare, and other document-intensive domains. We release the datasets and evaluation code to facilitate future research in document packet processing.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实应用中的文档理解通常需要处理由多页文档组成的异构文档包。尽管在视觉文档理解方面取得了一些进展，但将文档包拆分成独立单元的基本任务仍然没有得到充分解决。我们提出了第一个全面的基准数据集——\textit{DocSplit}，并提出了新的评估指标来衡量大语言模型在文档包拆分方面的能力。\textit{DocSplit}包含五个不同复杂度的数据集，涵盖了多种文档类型、布局以及多模态场景。我们明确了\textit{DocSplit}任务的要求：模型需要能够识别文档边界、分类文档类型，并保持文档包内页面顺序的正确性。该基准数据集解决了现实中的挑战，比如无序的页面、混合在一起的文档以及缺乏明确边界的文档。我们对我们的数据集进行了广泛的实验测试，发现当前模型在处理复杂文档拆分任务时存在显著的性能差距。\textit{DocSplit}基准数据集以及新提出的评估指标为提升文档理解能力提供了系统性的框架，这对于法律、金融、医疗等需要大量文档处理的领域至关重要。我们发布了这些数据集和评估代码，以便未来在文档包处理领域的研究能够更加顺利地进行。
