papers.title: TaoType: Predicting Fine-Grained Typing Intent for Faster Search
papers.title_zh: TaoType：预测用户细粒度的输入意图，从而实现更快速的搜索体验
papers.authors: Yipeng Yu, Yichen Yuan, Chengxiao Feng, Xu Liu
papers.abstract: “Is the user’s current query input exactly what they intend to search for?” Our work aims to answer this question by determining, at each typing, whether the current query is complete. If so, a search is implicitly triggered in advance without waiting for user confirmation. This approach reduces response time and enhances the user search experience. Specifically, we propose TaoType, a client-side framework that introduces innovation in data sampling, feature selection, model design and training, and online strategy. Experiments in a leading mobile shopping application named Taobao validate its effectiveness, achieving offline precision/recall/accuracy of 0.7936/0.8196/0.7742, respectively, and decreasing online response time by 640.51±93.65 milliseconds, which is of great benefit to the search system. Unlike prior work that focuses on optimizing server-side engineering pipelines or simplifying ranking models, our method leverages client-side typing behavior for real-time early prediction, utilizing on-device computation to gain response time reducing. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to identify and address this problem. This work also introduces App Intelligence, a new paradigm for enhancing mobile applications by integrating on-device AI to boost business value and user experience.
papers.abstract_zh: “用户当前的查询输入是否正是他们想要搜索的内容？”我们的工作旨在通过每次输入时判断当前查询是否完整来回答这个问题。如果查询完整，则无需等待用户确认即可自动触发搜索。这种方法能够缩短响应时间，提升用户的搜索体验。具体来说，我们提出了TaoType这一客户端框架，它在数据采样、特征选择、模型设计和训练以及在线策略方面都进行了创新。在一家领先的移动购物应用——淘宝上的实验验证了该框架的有效性：离线情况下的精确率、召回率和准确率分别达到了0.7936、0.8196和0.7742，同时在线响应时间减少了640.51±93.65毫秒，这对搜索系统来说具有很大的好处。与那些专注于优化服务器端工程流程或简化排名模型的先前研究不同，我们的方法利用客户端输入行为进行实时预测，通过设备端计算来减少响应时间。据我们所知，我们的工作是第一个识别并解决这个问题的研究。此外，我们还提出了App Intelligence这一新范式，通过整合设备端人工智能来增强移动应用，从而提高业务价值和用户体验。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Calibrating LLM Judges: Linear Probes for Fast and Reliable Uncertainty Estimation
papers.title_zh: 校准大型语言模型评估器：用于快速可靠的不确定性估计的线性探针
papers.authors: Bhaktipriya Radharapu, Eshika Saxena, Kenneth Li, Chenxi Whitehouse, Adina Williams, Nicola Cancedda
papers.abstract: As LLM-based judges become integral to industry applications, obtaining well-calibrated uncertainty estimates efficiently has become critical for production deployment. However, existing techniques, such as verbalized confidence and multi-generation methods, are often either poorly calibrated or computationally expensive. We introduce linear probes trained with a Brier score-based loss to provide calibrated uncertainty estimates from reasoning judges’ hidden states, requiring no additional model training. We evaluate our approach on both objective tasks (reasoning, mathematics, factuality, coding) and subjective human preference judgments. Our results demonstrate that probes achieve superior calibration compared to existing methods with x computational savings, generalize robustly to unseen evaluation domains, and deliver higher accuracy on high-confidence predictions. However, probes produce conservative estimates that underperform on easier datasets but may benefit safety-critical deployments prioritizing low false-positive rates. Overall, our work demonstrates that interpretability-based uncertainty estimation provides a practical and scalable plug-and-play solution for LLM judges in production.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着基于大语言模型的裁判器成为行业应用中的不可或缺组成部分，高效地获得精确的不确定性估计对于生产部署来说至关重要。然而，现有的技术，如基于口头表达的置信度估计以及多代方法，往往要么校准不准确，要么计算成本过高。我们提出了一种采用基于布里尔得分的损失函数进行训练的线性探针方法，该方法能够从裁判器的隐藏状态中获取精确的不确定性估计，且无需额外的模型训练。我们在客观任务（推理、数学、事实判断、编程）以及主观的人类偏好判断方面对这种方法进行了评估。我们的结果表明，与现有方法相比，该探针方法在校准精度上表现更优，同时大幅降低了计算成本。此外，该方法能够在未见过的评估领域中表现出强大的泛化能力，并且在高置信度预测上能够提供更高的准确性。不过，该探针方法产生的估计值较为保守，在较简单的数据集上表现不佳，但对于需要严格控制误报率的安全关键型部署来说，却可能具有很大的优势。总体而言，我们的研究表明，基于可解释性的不确定性估计方法为生产环境中的大语言模型裁判器提供了一种实用且可扩展的即插即用解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Detecting AI-Generated Content on Social Media with Multi-modal Language Models
papers.title_zh: 利用多模态语言模型在社交媒体上检测人工智能生成的内容
papers.authors: Chenyang Yang, Shen Yan, Yibo Yang, Litao Hu, Yuchen Liu, Yuan Zeng, Hanchao Yu, Yinan Zhu, Sumedha Singla, Brian Vanover, Huijun Qian, Zihao Wang, Fujun Liu, Aashu Singh, Jianyu Wang, Xuewen Zhang
papers.abstract: Generative AI has enabled the creation of photorealistic images and videos that are increasingly disseminated on social media, often used for spam, misinformation, manipulation, and fraud. Existing AI-generated content (AIGC) detection methods face challenges including poor generalization to new generation models, reliance on single modalities, and lack of interpretable explanations. We present our pipeline that mitigates these issues by continuously curating diverse multi-modal social media data and training a compact vision-language model for detection and explanation. Our model achieves state-of-the-art detection performance on public benchmarks and demonstrates robust detection and explanation capabilities on internal social media datasets across multiple platforms. We deployed our model for post recommendation on social media platforms and observed positive downstream impacts on user engagement, demonstrating that it is feasible to perform effective AIGC detection in dynamic, real-world social media environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能使得创建高度逼真的图像和视频成为可能，这些作品越来越多地出现在社交媒体上。然而，这类内容常被用于发送垃圾信息、传播虚假信息、进行操纵和欺诈行为。现有的人工智能生成内容检测方法存在诸多问题：对新型模型的泛化能力较差；依赖单一模态的数据处理；缺乏可解释性的说明机制。我们提出了一种解决方案：通过持续收集多样化的多模态社交媒体数据，并训练一个紧凑的视觉-语言模型来辅助检测和处理这些内容。我们的模型在公开基准测试中取得了领先的检测性能，并且在多个平台的内部社交媒体数据集上展现了强大的检测和解释能力。我们将该模型应用于社交媒体平台上的帖子推荐功能，发现它能够有效提升用户参与度，这表明在动态的现实世界社交媒体环境中实现有效的AI生成内容检测是可行的。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: IceBreaker for Conversational Agents: Breaking the First-Message Barrier with Personalized Starters
papers.title_zh: 用于对话式代理程序的破冰工具：通过个性化开场白突破第一句话的障碍
papers.authors: Hongwei Zheng, Weiqi Wu, Zhengjia Wang, Guanyu Jiang, Haoming Li, Tianyu Wu, Yongchun Zhu, Jingwu Chen, Feng Zhang
papers.abstract: Conversational agents, such as ChatGPT and Doubao, have become essential daily assistants for billions of users. To further enhance engagement, these systems are evolving from passive responders to proactive companions. However, existing efforts focus on activation within ongoing dialogues, while overlooking a key real-world bottleneck. In the conversation initiation stage, users may have a vague need but no explicit query intent, creating a first-message barrier where the conversation holds before it begins. To overcome this, we introduce Conversation Starter Generation: generating personalized starters to guide users into conversation. However, unlike in-conversation stages where immediate context guides the response, initiation must operate in a cold-start moment without explicit user intent. To pioneer in this direction, we present IceBreaker that frames human ice-breaking as a two-step handshake: (i) evoke resonance via Resonance-Aware Interest Distillation from session summaries to capture trigger interests, and (ii) stimulate interaction via Interaction-Oriented Starter Generation, optimized with personalized preference alignment and a self-reinforced loop to maximize engagement. Online A/B tests on one of the world’s largest conversational agent products show that IceBreaker improves user active days by +1.84‰ and click-through rate by +94.25‰, and has been deployed in production.
papers.abstract_zh: 像ChatGPT和Doubao这样的对话机器人，已经成为了数十亿用户不可或缺的日常助手。为了进一步提升用户的参与度，这些系统正在从被动的回应者转变为主动的伴侣。然而，现有的研究主要集中在持续对话中的激活环节，而忽略了现实世界中的一个关键瓶颈：在对话启动阶段，用户可能只有模糊的需求，但没有明确的查询意图，这就形成了一种“先发信息障碍”，导致对话在开始之前就陷入停滞。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“对话启动生成”技术：通过生成个性化的开场白来引导用户进入对话。不过，与对话进行过程中的即时上下文引导不同，启动阶段的对话必须在一个没有明确用户意图的情况下进行。为了在这方面取得突破，我们开发了“破冰器”技术。该技术的核心是将人类破冰过程分解为两个步骤：（1）通过“共鸣感知兴趣提取”从会话摘要中捕捉到触发兴趣点，从而引发共鸣；（2）通过“以互动为导向的开场生成”来激发互动，同时利用个性化偏好匹配和自强化循环机制来最大化用户的参与度。我们在全球最大的对话机器人产品之一上进行了在线A/B测试，结果显示，“破冰器”技术能够将用户的活跃天数提高1.84‰，点击率提高94.25‰。目前，这项技术已投入生产应用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Motivating Next-Gen Accelerators with Flexible N{:}M Activation Sparsity via Benchmarking Lightweight Post-Training Sparsification Approaches
papers.title_zh: 通过基准测试来激励下一代加速器采用灵活的N:M激活稀疏化策略，从而实现训练后轻量级稀疏化处理
papers.authors: Shirin Alanova, Kristina Kazistova, Ekaterina Galaeva, Alina Kostromina, Vladimir Smirnov, Redko Dmitry, Alexey Dontsov, Maxim Zhelnin, Evgeny Burnaev, Egor Shvetsov
papers.abstract: The demand for efficient large language model inference has spurred interest in sparsification, yet current hardware support remains narrowly focused on 2:4 weight sparsity. In this work, we argue that activation sparsity despite being overlooked in hardware design offers a promising path for dynamic, input-adaptive compression with significant I/O and memory benefits. We present a comprehensive post-training study of N{:}M activation pruning across four LLMs (Llama2-7B-chat, Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Gemma3-4B-Instruct), demonstrating that activation pruning consistently outperforms weight pruning at matched sparsity levels. We evaluate lightweight, plug-and-play error mitigation and selection strategies that require minimal or no calibration data across four sparsity patterns: 2:4, 4:8, 8:16, and 16:32. Among these, 16:32 approaches the performance of unstructured 50% sparsity and is is approximately 2.7\times better than 2:4, while 8:16 offers an optimal balance of accuracy and practicality. Our results provide evidence that next-generation accelerators should consider native support for N{:}M activation sparsity and can serve as a strong baseline for the future methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 对高效大语言模型推理的需求激发了人们对稀疏化的兴趣，不过目前的硬件支持主要集中在2:4的权重稀疏性上。在这项研究中，我们认为尽管激活稀疏性在硬件设计中被忽视了，但它为动态、输入自适应压缩提供了有前景的路径，能够显著减少I/O和内存的使用。我们对四种大语言模型进行了N{:}M激活剪枝的全面后训练研究（Llama2-7B-chat、Llama3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Gemma3-4B-Instruct），结果表明在相同的稀疏性水平下，激活剪枝始终优于权重剪枝。我们评估了四种稀疏性模式下的轻量级、即插即用错误缓解和选择策略：2:4、4:8、8:16和16:32。其中，16:32模式的性能接近无结构稀疏性的50%稀疏性，比2:4的模式高出约2.7倍；而8:16模式则实现了准确性和实用性的最佳平衡。我们的研究结果表明，下一代加速器应该考虑对N{:}M激活稀疏性的原生支持，这可以作为未来方法的强大基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Sommelier: Scalable Open Multi-turn Audio Pre-processing for Full-duplex Speech Language Models
papers.title_zh: 品酒师：可扩展的开放式多轮音频预处理技术，适用于全双工语音语言模型
papers.authors: Kyudan Jung, Jihwan Kim, Soyoon Kim, Jeonghoon Kim, Jaegul Choo, Cheonbok Park
papers.abstract: As the paradigm of AI shifts from text-based LLMs to Speech Language Models (SLMs), there is a growing demand for full-duplex systems capable of real-time, natural human-computer interaction.However, the development of such models is constrained by the scarcity of high-quality, multi-speaker conversational data, as existing large-scale resources are predominantly single-speaker or limited in volume.Addressing the complex dynamics of natural dialogue, such as overlapping and back-channeling remains a challenge, with standard processing pipelines suffering from diarization errors and ASR hallucinations.To bridge this gap, we present a robust and scalable open-source data processing pipeline designed for full-duplex model.Our code and project page are publicly available at https://anonymous-2001-j.github.io/sommelier.github.io/.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着人工智能的范式从基于文本的大语言模型转向语音语言模型，人们对能够实现实时、自然的人机交互的全双工系统的需求日益增加。然而，这类模型的开发受到高质量多话者对话数据的限制，因为现有的大规模资源大多为单话者数据或数据量有限。应对自然对话中的复杂动态，如对话重叠和背景信息干扰问题仍然是一个挑战，传统的处理流程常常会出现分离错误和自动语音识别幻觉等问题。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种适用于全双工模型的强大且可扩展的开源数据处理流程。我们的代码和项目页面可在以下地址公开获取：https://anonymous-2001-j.github.io/sommelier.github.io/
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Proximity-Based Multi-Turn Optimization: Practical Credit Assignment for LLM Agent Training
papers.title_zh: 基于接近度的多轮优化：适用于大型语言模型代理训练的实际信用分配方法
papers.authors: Yangyi Fang, Jiaye Lin, Xiaoliang Fu, Cong Qin, Haolin Shi, Chang Liu
papers.abstract: Multi-turn LLM agents are becoming pivotal to production systems, spanning customer service automation, e-commerce assistance, and interactive task management, where accurately distinguishing high-value informative signals from stochastic noise is critical for sample-efficient training. In real-world scenarios, a failure in a trivial task may reflect random instability, whereas success in a high-difficulty task signifies a genuine capability breakthrough. Yet, existing group-based policy optimization methods rigidly rely on statistical deviation within discrete batches, frequently misallocating credit when task difficulty fluctuates. To address this issue, we propose Proximity-based Multi-turn Optimization (ProxMO), a practical and robust framework engineered specifically for the constraints of real-world deployment. ProxMO integrates global context via two lightweight mechanisms: success-rate-aware modulation dynamically adapts gradient intensity based on episode-level difficulty, while proximity-based soft aggregation derives baselines through continuous semantic weighting at the step level. Extensive evaluations on ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks demonstrate that ProxMO yields substantial performance gains over existing baselines with negligible computational cost. Ablation studies further validate the independent and synergistic efficacy of both mechanisms. Crucially, ProxMO offers plug-and-play compatibility with standard GRPO frameworks, facilitating immediate, low-friction adoption in existing industrial training pipelines. Our implementation is available at: https://github.com/GithubX-F/ProxMO-RL.
papers.abstract_zh: 多轮LLM智能体正在成为生产系统中的关键组件，广泛应用于客户服务自动化、电子商务辅助以及交互式任务管理等领域。在这些场景中，准确区分高价值的信息信号与随机噪声对于实现高效训练至关重要。在现实场景中，简单的任务失败可能只是由于随机的不稳定性导致的，而高难度任务的成功则意味着真正的能力提升。然而，现有的基于群体的策略优化方法严重依赖于离散批次内的统计偏差，当任务难度发生变化时，常常会导致错误的信用分配。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了基于接近度的多轮优化框架ProxMO。该框架专为现实世界部署的约束条件而设计，通过两种轻量级机制整合全局上下文：基于成功率调整的调制机制能够根据任务难度动态调整梯度强度；而基于接近度的软聚合机制则通过连续语义加权在步骤级别生成基准值。在ALFWorld和WebShop基准测试中的广泛评估表明，ProxMO在保持较低计算成本的同时，显著提升了性能表现。进一步的消融研究验证了这两种机制的独立性和协同效应。重要的是，ProxMO能够轻松与标准的GRPO框架兼容，从而便于在现有的工业训练流程中快速应用。我们的实现代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/GithubX-F/ProxMO-RL。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mixture of Heterogeneous Grouped Experts for Language Modeling
papers.title_zh: 用于语言建模的异质群体专家混合方法
papers.authors: Zhicheng Ma, Xiang Liu, Zhaoxiang Liu, Ning Wang, Yi Shen, Kai Wang, Shuming Shi, Shiguo Lian
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) based on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) are pivotal in industrial applications for their ability to scale performance efficiently. However, standard MoEs enforce uniform expert sizes, creating a rigidity that fails to align computational costs with varying token-level complexity. While heterogeneous expert architectures attempt to address this by diversifying expert sizes, they often suffer from significant system-level challenges, specifically unbalanced GPU utilization and inefficient parameter utilization, which hinder practical deployment.To bridge the gap between theoretical heterogeneity and robust industrial application, we propose Mixture of Heterogeneous Grouped Experts (MoHGE) which introduces a two-level routing mechanism to enable flexible, resource-aware expert combinations. To optimize inference efficiency, we propose a Group-Wise Auxiliary Loss, which dynamically steers tokens to the most parameter-efficient expert groups based on task difficulty.To address the critical deployment challenge of GPU load balancing, we introduce an All-size Group-decoupling Allocation strategy coupled with an Intra-Group Experts Auxiliary Loss. These mechanisms collectively ensure uniform computation distribution across GPUs.Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MoHGE matches the performance of MoE architectures while reducing the total parameters by approximately 20% and maintaining balanced GPU utilization. Our work establishes a scalable paradigm for resource-efficient MoE design, offering a practical solution for optimizing inference costs in real-world scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于混合专家架构的大语言模型在工业应用中发挥着至关重要的作用，因为它们能够高效地提升性能。然而，传统的混合专家架构要求所有专家的规模保持一致，这种刚性结构使得计算成本与不同token级别的复杂性之间难以达到平衡。虽然异构专家架构试图通过多样化专家规模来解决这个问题，但它们往往面临一些严重的系统级挑战，比如GPU利用率不平衡以及参数使用效率低下，这些问题都阻碍了模型的实际应用。为了弥合理论上的异构性与实际应用的差距，我们提出了混合异构分组专家架构。该架构引入了两级路由机制，从而实现灵活且注重资源利用的专家组合。为了优化推理效率，我们提出了一种基于任务难度的动态分配机制，该机制会根据任务难度将token分配到参数利用效率最高的专家组中。为了解决GPU负载均衡这一关键问题，我们采用了一种全尺寸分组解耦分配策略，并结合了组内专家辅助损失函数。这些机制共同确保了GPU上计算资源的均匀分布。广泛的测试表明，混合异构分组专家架构在保持性能的同时，总参数数量减少了约20%，同时还能实现平衡的GPU利用率。我们的研究为资源高效的混合专家架构设计提供了一种可扩展的范式，为现实场景中的推理成本优化提供了实用的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Policy Compliance of User Requests in Natural Language for AI Systems
papers.title_zh: 人工智能系统中自然语言用户请求的政策合规性处理
papers.authors: Pedro Cisneros-Velarde
papers.abstract: Consider an organization whose users send requests in natural language to an AI system that fulfills them by carrying out specific tasks. In this paper, we consider the problem of ensuring such user requests comply with a list of diverse policies determined by the organization with the purpose of guaranteeing the safe and reliable use of the AI system. We propose, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark consisting of annotated user requests of diverse compliance with respect to a list of policies. Our benchmark is related to industrial applications in the technology sector. We then use our benchmark to evaluate the performance of various LLM models on policy compliance assessment under different solution methods. We analyze the differences on performance metrics across the models and solution methods, showcasing the challenging nature of our problem.
papers.abstract_zh: 假设有一个组织，其用户向人工智能系统发送自然语言请求，该系统通过执行特定任务来响应这些请求。在本文中，我们探讨了如何确保这些用户请求符合组织制定的各种政策要求，从而确保人工智能系统的安全可靠使用。据我们所知，我们提出了第一个包含注释用户请求的基准测试，这些请求在政策合规性方面具有多样性。我们的基准测试与科技领域的工业应用相关。我们利用该基准测试来评估不同大语言模型在不同解决方案下的政策合规性评估性能。我们分析了不同模型和解决方案在性能指标上的差异，这充分展示了我们问题的复杂性。

papers.title: Better Literary Translation: A Multi-Aspect Data Generation and LLM Training Approach
papers.title_zh: 更优质的文学翻译：一种多维度数据生成与大型语言模型训练方法
papers.authors: Zhihao Lin, Ziqi Zhu, Hao Huang, Guanghui Wang, Peiyang He
papers.abstract: Literary translation poses unique challenges due to the scarcity of high-quality annotated data and the need to balance expression fluency with literary effect. We present a multi-aspect iterative refinement framework that generates high-quality translation references and preference data through specialized LLM translators, each targeting a distinct quality dimension. We leverage the generated data for supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Experiments show that our generated references outperform the original ground truth for SFT by 8.65 CEA100 points. For reinforcement learning, we find that DPO leads to performance degradation in this setting, while leveraging an explicit reward model for GRPO yields an additional 1.51 point improvement. We attribute this to the stability of two-stage training and GRPO’s online exploration capability. Our resulting models, LitMT-8B and LitMT-14B, achieve 67.25 and 69.07 CEA100 respectively on the MetaphorTrans English-to-Chinese literary translation benchmark, competitive with Claude Sonnet 4.5 at 68.43, and demonstrate strong generalization to out-of-domain literary work (i.e., O. Henry).
papers.abstract_zh: 文学翻译面临着独特的挑战，因为高质量的有注释数据非常稀缺，同时还需要在表达流畅性与文学效果之间找到平衡。我们提出了一种多维度迭代优化框架，通过专门的LLM翻译器来生成高质量的翻译参考文本和偏好数据，每个翻译器都专注于不同的质量维度。我们利用这些生成的数据进行监督式微调以及强化学习。实验表明，我们的翻译参考文本在SFT任务上的表现比原始真实文本高出8.65 CEA100分。在强化学习方面，我们发现DPO会导致性能下降，而使用显式奖励模型进行GRPO则能额外提高1.51分。我们认为这是由于两阶段训练的稳定性以及GRPO的在线探索能力所决定的。我们的模型LitMT-8B和LitMT-14B在MetaphorTrans英语到中文文学翻译基准测试中的得分分别达到了67.25和69.07 CEA100，与Claude Sonnet 4.5的68.43分相当，并且能够很好地泛化到其他领域的文学作品（例如O. Henry的作品）。

papers.title: SSR-A: Spatial- and Semantic-Aware Instructions and Curriculum Reinforcement for Advertisement Compliant Rectification
papers.title_zh: SSR-A：针对广告合规要求的空间与语义智能指令及课程优化方案
papers.authors: Cao Te, Mengge Xue, Zhenyu Hu, Yuan Chen, Liqun Liu, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang
papers.abstract: While advertising is a cornerstone of commercial growth, it is constrained by online violation detection systems that reject non-compliant content at a million-scale daily. Advertisers urgently require automated solutions to rectify these advertisements, especially visual ads, as manual fixing is unscalable. Although recent safety-driven methods can achieve compliance, they typically suffer from over-editing, destroying the original commercial intent and perceptual similarity.To address this, we present SSR-A, a framework tailored for the minimalist rectification of non-compliant image ads.Instead of fine-tuning image editing models directly, SSR-A focuses on translating violation policies into targeted editing instructions.We first introduce a Spatial- and Semantic-Aware Instruction Synthesis Pipeline, where MLLMs synthesize candidate instructions—incorporating spatial grounding and semantic guidance—and select the optimal instruction via multi-dimensional evaluation. Furthermore, we align the model using Curriculum Reinforcement Learning, employing GRPO with multi-faceted rewards to progressively navigate the trade-off between compliance and visual preservation. Extensive experiments and online A/B tests show that SSR-A significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both compliance and preservation of visual and commercial consistency.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然广告是商业增长的重要支柱，但它受到在线违规检测系统的限制，这些系统每天会拒绝数以百万计的不合规内容。广告商迫切需要自动化解决方案来修复这些广告，尤其是视觉广告，因为人工修复的方式难以扩展。尽管最近一些以安全为导向的方法能够实现合规性，但它们通常会导致过度编辑，从而破坏原本的广告意图和视觉一致性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SSR-A框架，该框架专门用于对不合规的图像广告进行最小限度的修复。与直接微调图像编辑模型不同，SSR-A着重将违规政策转化为有针对性的编辑指令。我们首先引入了一个空间与语义感知的指令合成流程，其中多语言大语言模型生成候选指令——这些指令包含空间定位和语义指导——并通过多维评估来选择最优指令。此外，我们使用课程强化学习来使模型保持一致，采用GRPO方法结合多方面的奖励机制，逐步在合规性和视觉保真度之间找到平衡。大量的实验和在线A/B测试表明，SSR-A在合规性和保持视觉及商业一致性方面显著优于现有的最先进基线方法。

papers.title: \mathcal{R}^3: Advertisement Compliance \mathcal{R}ectification via Group-\mathcal{R}elative Experience Extractor and Curriculum \mathcal{R}einforcement
papers.title_zh: $\mathcal{R}^3$：通过群体相关体验提取器来加强广告合规性与正确性，同时完善相关课程训练
papers.authors: Yuan Chen, Zhenyu Hu, Mengge Xue, Cao Te, Liqun Liu, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang
papers.abstract: Rigorous content moderation is crucial for online advertising but leads to millions of daily rejections. This scale renders manual rectification infeasible, particularly for video advertisements.However, existing safety-driven methods often suffer from aggressive over-editing, which compromises the advertiser’s original semantic intent merely to satisfy compliance.In this work, we target the rectification of textual violations in video ads, covering both speech transcripts and on-screen text. We propose \mathcal{R}^3, a novel framework designed to harmonize compliance with original semantic intent preservation.Our approach integrates three key innovations: (1) an experience-driven data synthesis framework that bootstraps high-quality supervision via group-Relative compliance experience extractor; (2) a curriculum Reinforcement learning strategy with hierarchical rewards designed to enforce compliance while maximizing semantic consistency;and (3) a comprehensive video Rectification framework seamlessly integrating text recognition, rewriting, and re-rendering for industrial deployment. Extensive experiments on industrial datasets and online A/B testing demonstrate that \mathcal{R}^3 significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an optimal trade-off between violation rectification and intent preservation.
papers.abstract_zh: 严格的内容审核对于在线广告来说至关重要，但这一过程每天会导致数百万条广告被拒绝。如此庞大的数量使得人工修正变得不可行，尤其是针对视频广告而言。然而，现有的基于安全性的方法往往存在过度编辑的问题，这可能会破坏广告主的原始语义意图，仅仅是为了满足合规性要求。在这项研究中，我们专注于修复视频广告中的文本违规问题，包括语音文字和屏幕上的文字。我们提出了$\mathcal{R}^3$框架，该框架旨在在确保合规性的同时，保留广告的原有语义意图。我们的方法包含了三个关键创新点：(1) 一种以用户体验为驱动的数据合成框架，通过群体相对合规体验提取器来生成高质量的监督数据；(2) 一种具有分层奖励的课程式强化学习策略，旨在在最大化语义一致性的同时，确保合规性；(3) 一个全面的视频修复框架，能够无缝集成文本识别、重写和重新渲染功能，适用于工业部署。在工业数据集上的广泛实验以及在线A/B测试表明，$\mathcal{R}^3$框架在违规修复与意图保留之间实现了最佳平衡，其性能显著优于现有最先进的基线方法。

papers.title: GrocLM: Grocery Category Recommendation in E-Commerce with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: GrocLM：基于大型语言模型的电子商务领域食品杂货推荐系统
papers.authors: Yuan Zhong, Chuanwei Ruan, Moein Hasani, Tejaswi Tenneti, Haixun Wang, Fenglong Ma
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of online grocery shopping requires recommendation systems that capture cyclical purchasing behavior and diverse user intents. Traditional item-level methods face scalability and accuracy challenges, motivating category-level recommendation as a more structured and practical alternative. We present GrocLM, a fine-tuned language model for grocery category recommendation in a real-world production environment. GrocLM employs a two-stage LoRA-based training strategy to encode cyclical purchasing patterns directly into model parameters, enabling more effective utilization of rebuying signals compared to prompt-based conditioning. To ensure valid and controllable outputs, we further introduce a trie-based constrained decoding mechanism over a predefined category space. Experiments on both proprietary production data and a public benchmark demonstrate that GrocLM consistently outperforms strong baselines. In a live production restocking task, GrocLM achieves a 7.5% relative improvement in cart-adds per impression while maintaining efficient inference by generating all categories jointly. These results highlight the effectiveness and practicality of integrating large language models into structured recommendation systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 在线购物业务的快速增长需要能够捕捉周期性购买行为和多样化用户意图的推荐系统。传统的项目级方法在可扩展性和准确性方面存在挑战，因此类别级推荐作为一种更结构化、更实用的替代方案应运而生。我们提出了GrocLM，这是一种在真实生产环境中经过微调的语言模型，用于食品类别推荐。GrocLM采用两阶段LoRA训练策略，将周期性购买模式直接编码到模型参数中，从而比基于提示的条件化方式更有效地利用重复购买信号。为了确保输出的有效性和可控制性，我们还引入了一种基于Trie的约束解码机制，该机制适用于预定义的类别空间。在专有生产数据和公开基准测试上的实验表明，GrocLM始终优于其他强大的基线模型。在实际的生产补货任务中，GrocLM每 impressions能增加7.5%的购物车商品数量，同时通过联合生成所有类别来实现高效的推理过程。这些结果充分证明了将大语言模型整合到结构化推荐系统中的有效性和实用性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DeepResearch Retail: Benchmarking Tool-Augmented Deep Research in the E-Commerce Domain
papers.title_zh: DeepResearch零售：基于基准测试工具的电子商务领域深度研究工具
papers.authors: Rafael Ferreira, Flavio Di Palo, Huilin Lu, Ayush Jain, Harsha Aduri
papers.abstract: Deep Research (DR) systems autonomously retrieve and synthesize information from web sources, however, industrial DR applications face a critical gap: effective integration of internal tools with web search. In this work, we introduce DeepResearch Retail, an evaluation framework grounded in real-world e-commerce data for assessing Deep Research with tools (DR+Tools) in realistic commercial settings. The framework evaluates both factual faithfulness and multidimensional response quality when reasoning over heterogeneous web and internal data sources.We further present Hybrid-ReAct, a multi-agent architecture that demonstrates how collaborative reasoning and tool use can produce evidence-grounded answers. Experimental results validate our framework’s utility, showing improvements in agent’s performance when leveraging web-page information and multi-agent specialization.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度研究系统能够自主地从网络来源检索和整合信息。然而，工业领域的深度研究应用存在一个关键问题：如何有效地将内部工具与网络搜索功能相结合。在这项研究中，我们提出了DeepResearch Retail这一评估框架，该框架基于真实的电子商务数据，用于评估在现实商业环境中使用深度研究工具时的表现。该框架能够同时评估事实忠实度以及对异构网页和内部数据进行推理时的多维响应质量。此外，我们还介绍了Hybrid-ReAct这一多智能体架构，它展示了如何通过协作推理和工具使用来生成基于证据的答案。实验结果表明，我们的框架具有实用性，当利用网页信息以及多智能体的专业化能力时，系统的性能得到了提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GeoGround: Uncertainty-Weighted Multi-Task Learning for Geo-Alignment and Address Defect Detection
papers.title_zh: GeoGround：一种基于不确定性加权多任务学习的方法，适用于地理对齐和地址缺陷检测任务
papers.authors: Srinivas Virinchi, Aman Gulati, Anoop Saladi
papers.abstract: Address intelligence in e-commerce demands accurate geocoding and proactive defect detection under strict sub-50 ms latency constraints. These tasks are inherently coupled: precise spatial grounding provides a strong prior for defect propensity, yet prior approaches optimize them independently. While generative LLMs offer rich semantic representations, they lack spatial inductive bias and fail to meet real-time serving requirements. We introduce GeoGround, a multi-task learning framework that jointly models coordinate grounding and address defect detection. The model combines a hierarchical spatial grounding objective with Focal Loss for defect classification, using uncertainty-based task weighting to balance optimization under severe class imbalance. To strengthen supervision, we curate a large-scale noisy address dataset using LLM-assisted data construction, augmenting the training corpus with signals that are costly to obtain manually. GeoGround achieves 5.86\times gains in address defect detection precision and up to 4.86\times improvements in location prediction accuracy over strong encoder baselines, while remaining 75\times more efficient than decoder LLMs such as Qwen2-1.5B. A two-week online A/B test in a large-scale delivery pipeline confirms real-world impact, yielding a 50 bps uplift in defect detection, a 40 bps gain in location prediction, and an estimated operational savings of $3.09M annually.
papers.abstract_zh: 在电子商务领域，地址智能处理需要精确的地理编码以及能够在严格的50毫秒以下延迟限制下进行主动缺陷检测。这些任务本质上是相互关联的：精确的空间定位能够为缺陷倾向提供有力的先验信息，但以往的方法往往独立地优化这两个方面。虽然生成式大语言模型能够提供丰富的语义表示，但它们缺乏空间归纳性，无法满足实时服务的需求。我们提出了GeoGround这一多任务学习框架，该框架同时实现了坐标定位和缺陷检测的联合建模。该模型结合了分层空间定位目标与用于缺陷分类的Focal损失，并通过基于不确定性的任务权重分配来平衡在严重类别不平衡情况下的优化问题。为了加强监督效果，我们利用大语言模型辅助的数据构建方法，创建了一个大规模的噪声地址数据集，从而增加了训练数据量，并获取了那些难以手动获得的信号。与强大的编码器基线相比，GeoGround在地址缺陷检测精度上提升了5.86倍，在位置预测准确性上提升了4.86倍，而其运行效率则比Qwen2-1.5B这样的解码器大语言模型高出75倍。在大规模配送流程中进行的为期两周的在线A/B测试证实了其实际效果：缺陷检测准确率提高了50个基点，位置预测准确性提高了40个基点，每年可节省约309万美元的成本。

papers.title: Pre-Deployment Advertisement Ranking under Data Scarcity via Context-Aware Criteria Generation with VLMs
papers.title_zh: 在数据稀缺性背景下，通过利用视觉语言模型生成上下文感知的筛选标准，来实现部署前广告的排名优化
papers.authors: Kyungho Kim, Yeonje Choi, Gyurim Hwang, Sejin Chung, Hongseok Lee, Myeong Ho Song, Yeongho Kim, Sunwoo Kim, Jongha Lee, Juyeon Kim, Kijung Shin
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on general multimodal tasks, yet applying them to real-world advertisement (ad) evaluation is challenging due to strong brand specificity and limited labeled data. We introduce a new practical task, brand-specific ad ranking, which aims to rank ads for a target brand prior to deployment by modeling brand-specific effectiveness. To this end, we propose ADvisor, which derives explicit brand-aware decision criteria using VLMs, augments limited brand context with ads from similar brands, and applies reflection-based scoring for ranking. Experiments on real-world advertising data from 10 brands, collected through actual ad campaigns, show that ADvisor outperforms strong baselines by up to 7.2%. Further analyses show the generated criteria capture meaningful brand specificity, and ADvisor also performs strongly in online A/B testing. Our code is available at https://github.com/K-Kyungho/ADvisor.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在一般的多模态任务中表现良好，但将其应用于现实世界的广告评估却颇具挑战性，因为广告具有强烈的品牌特异性，且标注数据有限。我们提出了一种新的实用任务——针对特定品牌的广告排名，该任务旨在通过建模特定品牌的效果来在广告投放前对其进行排序。为此，我们开发了ADvisor工具。该工具利用视觉语言模型推导出明确的、考虑品牌特性的决策标准，并通过添加类似品牌的广告来增强有限的品牌上下文信息，同时采用基于反射的评分方法来进行排名。通过对来自10个品牌的真实广告数据进行实验，结果显示ADvisor的性能优于一些强大的基线算法，性能提升幅度高达7.2%。进一步分析表明，所生成的决策标准能够充分捕捉到品牌特异性信息，而ADvisor在在线A/B测试中的表现也相当出色。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/K-Kyungho/ADvisor下载。

papers.title: Agent-Ops: A Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework for End-to-End SOP Automation in E-Commerce Operations
papers.title_zh: 代理操作：一种多智能体协调框架，用于电子商务运营中的端到端标准操作自动化
papers.authors: Apoorva Singh, Sanjay Agrawal, Sayanta Adhikari, Vinayak S Puranik, Shivam Tiwari, Dheeraj Assudani
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models excel at reasoning and language understanding, they struggle with multi-step operational workflows requiring precise procedural adherence, which is fundamental for industrial automation. Existing SOP-guided agents assume well-defined procedures and structured APIs, failing to address enterprise realities like incomplete SOPs, dynamic web interfaces, and unpredictable document formats. We present Agent-Ops, an end-to-end multi-agent framework automating Standard Operating Procedures in e-commerce. Agent-Ops contributes: (1) SOP Groomer, a human-AI framework transforming ambiguous documentation into automation-ready specifications, improving accuracy by 13.2%, (2) WebAgent, achieving 91.3% task completion and 86.5% execution consistency through demonstration-based learning, and (3) a Document Verification Agent performing multi-lingual validation across tax invoices, certificates, and supply chain documents with 94.2% accuracy. Deployed across seven SOP categories in three geographic regions, Agent-Ops achieves 85-97% end-to-end accuracy while reducing case resolution from 30 to 5 minutes (83% reduction). Production deployment with over 1000 Account Managers validates that LLM-based agents achieve enterprise-grade reliability when augmented with robust web automation, comprehensive document understanding, and systematic SOP refinement.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在推理和语言理解方面表现出色，但在需要精确遵循多步骤操作流程的场景中却表现不佳，而这些流程正是工业自动化所不可或缺的。现有的基于标准操作程序的智能体只能处理定义明确的程序和结构化API，无法应对企业实际中的各种挑战，比如不完整的标准操作程序、动态的网络界面以及不可预测的文档格式。我们提出了Agent-Ops这一端到端的多智能体框架，它能够自动化电子商务领域的标准操作程序。Agent-Ops具备以下优势：(1) SOP Groomer，这是一种人机结合的技术，能够将模糊的文档转化为可自动执行的规范，使准确性提升了13.2％；(2) WebAgent，通过基于示范的学习方式，其任务完成率为91.3％，执行一致性达到了86.5％；(3) 文档验证智能体，它能够对税务发票、证书和供应链文件进行多语言验证，准确率达到94.2％。在三个地理区域中的七个标准操作程序类别上部署后，Agent-Ops实现了85%-97%的端到端准确率，同时将案例解决时间从30分钟缩短至5分钟（减少了83%）。超过1000名客户经理的实际应用表明，当结合强大的网络自动化、全面的文档理解和系统的标准操作程序优化时，基于大语言模型的智能体能够达到企业级可靠性水平。

papers.title: Reason-Code: Reliable Code Generation via Test-Driven Monte Carlo Tree Search
papers.title_zh: 原因代码：通过测试驱动的方法实现可靠的代码生成——采用蒙特卡洛树搜索算法
papers.authors: Zixu Li, Zhiqi Peng
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used for code generation, but their performance degrades on tasks requiring multi-step logical reasoning. In practice, reliability is often improved through multi-sample inference, but its cost grows linearly with the sample size, making it impractical under strict latency constraints. To address this, we propose Reason-Code, an inference-time framework that formulates code generation as a search process guided by execution feedback. It integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with a lightweight execution sandbox, where candidate programs are evaluated via unit tests. To control inference cost, Reason-Code adopts a conditional budgeting strategy that activates search only when greedy generation fails. Compared with large-sample Best-of-N sampling, Reason-Code is designed to improve reliability without paying the full linear cost of additional sampling under strict latency budgets. Experiments on HumanEval and MBPP show that Reason-Code matches strong sampling baselines (e.g., Best-of-10) with lower token cost and no regression. Additional matched-budget analyses show that execution-guided adaptive inference improves over independent sampling/filtering baselines, while differences between UCB-guided search and simpler iterative repair are limited at low budget.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成中得到了广泛应用，但在需要多步骤逻辑推理的任务上，其性能会下降。实际上，通过多样本推理可以提高模型的可靠性，但成本会随着样本数量的增加而线性增长，这在严格的延迟限制下是不切实际的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Reason-Code这一推理时间框架。该框架将代码生成过程视为一个由执行反馈引导的搜索过程。它结合了蒙特卡洛树搜索算法和轻量级执行环境，其中候选程序通过单元测试进行评估。为了控制推理成本，Reason-Code采用了条件预算策略，仅在贪婪生成失败时才激活搜索功能。与大规模的最佳采样方法相比，Reason-Code能够在不增加额外采样成本的情况下提高可靠性。在HumanEval和MBPP上的实验表明，Reason-Code能够以较低的令牌成本实现与强采样基准（如最佳10次采样）相当的性能，且不会出现回归问题。进一步的预算匹配分析显示，基于执行的自适应推理方式优于独立采样/过滤的基准方法。而在低预算情况下，UCB引导的搜索方式与简单的迭代修复方法之间的差异并不明显。

papers.title: Optimizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation for E-Commerce How-To Assistance
papers.title_zh: 优化基于检索增强生成的电子商务智能助手技术
papers.authors: Gilad Fuchs, Leonid Ekimov, Fei Dong, Jiahong Xie, Wei Liu, Maxim Manco, Alexander Nus
papers.abstract: Conversational AI is increasingly used at eBay to deliver personalized customer support. We present a production RAG-based How-To Assistant that answers support and how-to queries by grounding responses in a proprietary knowledge base. We study three factors that drive quality: (1) document chunking and contextualization for indexing, (2) query refinement methods, and (3) automatic LLM-based evaluation for rapid iteration and reliable measurement. We also describe the end-to-end system workflow - from offline indexing to real-time serving and report deployment metrics, offering practical guidance for building scalable, high-precision RAG assistants in commercial support settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 在eBay上，对话式AI被越来越多地用于提供个性化的客户支持。我们开发了一个基于RAG技术的操作指南助手，该助手能够通过专有知识库来回答支持和操作相关的问题。我们研究了影响服务质量的三个关键因素：(1)文档的分块和上下文化处理以进行索引；(2)查询的优化方法；(3)基于大语言模型的自动评估机制，以实现快速迭代和可靠的测量。我们还描述了从离线索引到实时服务以及报告指标部署的完整系统工作流程，为在商业支持场景中构建可扩展、高精度的RAG助手提供了实用指导。

papers.title: UNIVID: Unified Vision-Language Model for Video Moderation
papers.title_zh: UNIVID：统一的视觉与语言模型，用于视频内容审核
papers.authors: Kejuan Yang, Yizhuo Zhang, Mingyuan Du, Yue Zhang, Dixin Zheng, Kaili Zhao, Yang Xiao, Hanzhong Liang, Kenan Xiao
papers.abstract: Global-scale video moderation faces a dual challenge: the need for fine-grained multimodal reasoning and the demand for interpretable outputs to support downstream enforcement. Traditional moderation systems often rely on fragmented black-box classifiers that are difficult to maintain and lack transparency.In this paper, we present UNIVID, a Unified Vision-Language model for Video Moderation. Unlike standard classification models, UNIVID generates policy-aware captions that serve as an interpretable intermediate representation, enabling human-verifiable decisions and multi-task reusability. While existing open-source and commercial VLMs often suffer from safety-guardrail refusals and lack fine-grained policy alignment, we develop a specialized training data recipe that combines expert human-refined labels with synthetic data to align the model with our safety guidelines.By integrating UNIVID as the core captioner, we design a novel end-to-end video moderation system that reduces violation leakage by 42.7% and overkill rate by 37.0% relatively. Meanwhile, by replacing over 1,000 policy-specific models with a single UNIVID backbone, we recycle extensive computational resources while significantly reducing engineering maintenance overhead. To our knowledge, this is one of the first reports of a high-efficiency captioning VLM successfully supporting industrial-scale moderation and cross-functional business.
papers.abstract_zh: 全球范围内的视频审核面临着双重挑战：需要精细的多模态推理能力，同时还需要可解释的输出结果以支持后续的监管工作。传统的审核系统往往依赖于一些难以维护且缺乏透明度的黑盒分类器。在本文中，我们提出了UNIVID——一种用于视频审核的统一视觉-语言模型。与标准的分类模型不同，UNIVID能够生成符合政策的标题，这些标题可以作为可解释的中间表示形式，从而支持人类可验证的决策以及多任务复用性。虽然现有的开源和商用视觉语言模型常常存在安全限制问题，且缺乏精细的政策对齐机制，但我们开发了一种专门的训练数据方案，该方案结合了由专家精心设计的标签和合成数据，以将模型与我们的安全指南进行对齐。通过将UNIVID作为核心组件来构建视频审核系统，我们成功地将违规信息的泄露率降低了42.7%，过度处理的比率则降低了37.0%。此外，通过用单一的UNIVID主干模型替换了超过1000个特定于政策的模型，我们不仅节省了大量的计算资源，还显著减少了工程维护的工作量。据我们所知，这是首次有报道称一种高效的视觉语言模型能够成功支持工业规模的视频审核工作，并适用于多种业务场景。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Learning from Textual Radiology Reports: A Benchmark Dataset for Coronary CT Angiography
papers.title_zh: 从文本放射学报告中学习：用于冠状动脉CT造影的基准数据集
papers.authors: Sudharshan Balaji, Zhiyu Liu, Zhengyuan Jiang, Shuo Lei, Yimin Chen, Yang Xiao, Shone O. Almeida, Mathew Joseph Karivelil, Christopher Malanga, Ning Wang
papers.abstract: While coronary imaging is widely used for anatomical assessment, CCTA reports play a distinct last-mile role in clinical care. Ratherthan serving as an intermediate signal, CCTA provides an assessment of coronary disease severity (known as the CAD-RADS score) toguide patient management. However, real-world clinical text exhibits substantial heterogeneity in terminology and structure, leadingto inconsistent interpretation by automated systems, even for clinically similar cases. Recent work leverages a direct application ofLLMs for automated CAD-RADS scoring, but is limited by small, non-public, and homogeneous clinical data. We introduce CCTA-RADS, the largest publicly available dataset of 940 real-world CCTA reports from a major cardiovascular center, each annotated with CAD-RADS scores. Our analysis reveals that direct approaches, including state-of-the-art LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-o3) and fine-tuned BERT models underperform on diverse real-world clinical data. To address these limitations, we propose a two-stage pipeline that decouples structuring from classification: an LLM-based parser normalizes heterogeneous reports into structured format, followed by fine-tuned BERT classification. This approach substantially improves the F1-score by 6%-13% compared with direct methods. We deploy our system as an interactive web interface that allows clinicians to upload CCTA reports for automated CAD-RADS assessment with SHAP and LIME explainability visualizations.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然冠状动脉成像被广泛用于解剖学评估，但CCTA报告在临床护理中发挥着独特的作用。CCTA并非作为中间信号，而是提供冠状动脉疾病的严重程度评估（即CAD-RADS评分），以指导患者管理。然而，实际临床文本在术语和结构上存在很大差异，导致自动化系统对类似病例的解释也不一致。最近的研究利用大语言模型进行自动CAD-RADS评分，但受限于规模小、非公开且同质化的临床数据，其效果有限。我们提出了CCTA-RADS，这是一份来自主要心血管中心的最大的公开数据集，包含940份真实世界的CCTA报告，每份报告都带有CAD-RADS评分。我们的分析表明，包括最先进的语言模型和经过微调的BERT模型在内的直接方法在多种真实临床数据上的表现不佳。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种两阶段流程：首先将异构报告通过基于语言模型的解析器转换为结构化格式，然后再进行经过微调的BERT分类。与直接方法相比，这种方法将F1分数提高了6%至13%。我们将该系统部署为交互式网络界面，允许临床医生上传CCTA报告进行自动CAD-RADS评估，并支持使用SHAP和LIME进行可解释性分析。

papers.title: Teaching LLM to be Persuasive: Reward-Enhanced Policy Optimization for Alignment from Heterogeneous Rewards
papers.title_zh: 教授大型语言模型如何具有说服力：基于奖励增强的策略优化方法，以实现对不同类型奖励的灵活应对
papers.authors: Xia Zeng, Yihan Chen, Luhui Liu, Chao Luo, Ye Chen, Zhuangzhuoran
papers.abstract: We deploy large language models (LLMs) as business development (BD) agents for persuasive price negotiation in online travel agencies (OTAs). The agent must follow a multi-stage Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and strict guardrails (no over-promising and no hallucinations), while remaining human-like and effective over long, multi-turn dialogues.We propose Reward-Enhanced Policy Optimization (REPO), a reinforcement learning post-training method that combines heterogeneous rewards: a preference-trained reward model (RM), an LLM-as-a-judge (RJ) for nuanced behaviors (e.g., emotional value and SOP compliance), and rule-based reward functions (RF) (mainly regex-based) for deterministic checks on numerics, formatting, and guardrails. In expert consensus evaluation (three human experts; 30 online conversations and 45 curated bad cases), REPO improves average dialogue rating to 4.63 (+0.33 over GRPO) and raises the share of conversations with at least one excellent response to 66.67% (+23.34 pp over GRPO), while achieving a 93.33% bad-case fix rate with 75.56% clean fixes.In a production A/B test on 9,653 real customer conversations (vs. an intent-driven dialogue system), REPO improves response rate by +12.14 pp and task success rate by +5.94 pp (p<0.001).
papers.abstract_zh: 我们将大语言模型作为业务开发代理，用于在线旅行社中的有说服力的价格谈判。该代理必须遵循多阶段的标准操作程序，并遵守严格的约束条件（不得过度承诺或产生幻觉），同时能够在长时间的多次对话中保持类似人类的行为并发挥有效作用。我们提出了奖励增强策略优化方法，这是一种强化学习后训练方法，它结合了多种类型的奖励：一种基于偏好训练的奖励模型；一个用于评估细微行为的语言模型，例如情感价值和是否遵守标准操作程序；以及基于规则的奖励函数，主要用于对数字、格式和约束条件的确定性检查。在专家共识评估中（三位人类专家参与，共进行了30次在线对话和45个精心挑选的负面案例），REPO将平均对话评分提高了4.63分（相比GRPO提高了0.33分），同时将至少有一个优秀回答的对话比例提高到了66.67%（相比GRPO提高了23.34个百分点）。此外，REPO在解决负面案例方面的成功率达到了93.33%，其中75.56%的案例中问题得到了彻底解决。在针对9,653个真实客户对话的生产环境A/B测试中，REPO将响应率提高了12.14个百分点，任务成功率提高了5.94个百分点（p<0.001）。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: NEST: Nested Evidence Survival for Retrieval
papers.title_zh: NEST：嵌套证据推理的生存分析方法
papers.authors: Akshay Verma, Siddharth Pillai, Prateek Sircar, Deepak Gupta
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems degrade sharply under extreme noise, where relevant evidence is sparse and easily pruned by static retrieval decisions. Existing approaches fixed top-k retrieval, hierarchical chunking, cross-encoder reranking, or policy-based iterative control- either rely on rigid heuristics or incur substantial computational overhead, and often fail to recover context-dependent evidence without introducing redundancy or latency. We introduce NEST (Nested Evidence Survival for Retrieval), a lightweight, training-free RAG framework that improves factual grounding by explicitly separating recall amplification from precision selection. NEST first maximizes recall through Nested Evidence Survival, evaluating candidates under nested retrieval contexts to rescue evidence that would otherwise be pruned by static chunking. It then applies a survival-consistent Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) selection mechanism to retain evidence that remains salient across retrieval scopes, removing redundancy without harming recall. Evaluated on WebQuestions, HotpotQA (distractor setting), and a proprietary InternalQA benchmark with 50M Common Crawl distractors, NEST consistently outperforms strong adaptive RAG baselines, including DeepRAG, improving EM by up to +2.4 pp and F1 by +2.1 pp, while increasing retrieval recall by +6.8 pp. These gains are achieved with only 12–18 ms additional latency. Ablation studies confirm that Nested Evidence Survival drives recall improvements, while MRR-based selection converts these gains into precision, demonstrating that recall-first retrieval with principled pruning can outperform iterative control and model scaling in retrieval-augmented generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统在极端噪声环境下性能会显著下降，此时相关证据较为稀少，且容易被静态检索决策所筛选掉。现有的方法要么采用top-k检索策略，要么采用分层分块处理，要么采用跨编码器重新排序，又或者采用基于策略的迭代控制方式。但这些方法要么依赖固定的启发式规则，要么会带来巨大的计算开销，而且往往无法在不引入冗余或延迟的情况下恢复与上下文相关的证据。我们提出了NEST（嵌套证据生存机制检索），这是一种轻量级、无需训练的RAG框架，它通过明确分离召回增强和精确性选择，从而提升事实的准确性。NEST首先通过嵌套证据生存机制来最大化召回率，即在嵌套的检索上下文中对候选内容进行评估，以保留那些可能会被静态分块处理所筛选掉的证据。然后，它采用一种与生存机制一致的均值相对排名选择机制，以保留在多种检索范围内仍然具有显著性的证据，从而在不损害召回率的情况下消除冗余。在WebQuestions、HotpotQA（干扰设置）以及包含5000万Common Crawl干扰项的专有InternalQA基准测试上进行的评估表明，NEST始终优于强大的自适应RAG基线模型，包括DeepRAG。NEST将EM提升了2.4个百分点，F1值提升了2.1个百分点，同时检索召回率提高了6.8个百分点。这些改进仅增加了12到18毫秒的延迟时间。消融研究证实，嵌套证据生存机制确实能带来召回率的提升，而基于均值相对排名的选择则能将这种提升转化为精确性，这表明，以召回率为优先的检索方式，结合合理的剪枝策略，可以在检索增强生成中超越迭代控制和模型扩展。

papers.title: Search-P1: Path-Centric Reward Shaping for Stable and Efficient Agentic RAG Training
papers.title_zh: 搜索-P1：以路径为中心的奖励设计，用于稳定且高效的智能体RAG训练
papers.authors: Tianle Xia, Ming Xu, Lingxiang Hu, Yiding Sun, Wenwei Li, Linfang Shang, Liqun Liu, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge, yet traditional single-round retrieval struggles with complex multi-step reasoning.Agentic RAG addresses this by enabling LLMs to dynamically decide when and what to retrieve, but current RL-based training methods suffer from sparse outcome rewards that discard intermediate signals and low sample efficiency where failed samples contribute nothing.We propose Search-P1, a framework that introduces path-centric reward shaping for agentic RAG training, comprising two key components: (1) Path-Centric Reward, which evaluates the structural quality of reasoning trajectories through order-agnostic step coverage and soft scoring that extracts learning signals even from failed samples, and (2) Dual-Track Path Scoring with offline-generated reference planners that assesses paths from both self-consistency and reference-alignment perspectives.Experiments on multiple QA benchmarks demonstrate that Search-P1 achieves significant improvements over Search-R1 and other strong baselines, with an average accuracy gain of 7.7 points.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过结合外部知识来提升大语言模型的能力，然而传统的单轮检索在处理复杂的多步骤推理时存在困难。主动RAG通过让LLM动态决定何时以及要检索哪些信息来解决这个问题，但目前的基于强化学习的训练方法存在以下问题：奖励分布稀疏，无法捕捉中间阶段的信号；样本效率低下，失败的样本无法为模型提供任何学习机会。我们提出了Search-P1框架，该框架为主动RAG训练引入了以路径为中心的奖励机制，主要包括两个关键组件：(1) 以路径为中心的奖励机制，它通过不依赖顺序的步长覆盖和软评分来评估推理路径的结构质量，从而能够从失败的样本中提取学习信号；(2) 双轨路径评分机制，利用离线生成的参考规划器从自洽性和参考对齐两个方面来评估路径。在多个问答基准测试中的实验表明，Search-P1相比Search-R1和其他强大的基线模型取得了显著的改进，平均准确率提升了7.7个百分点。

papers.title: AgenticQwen: Training Small Agentic Language Models with Dual Data Flywheels for Industrial-Scale Tool Use
papers.title_zh: AgenticQwen：利用双数据驱动方法训练小型代理式语言模型，以实现工业规模的应用
papers.authors: Yuanjie Lyu, Chengyu Wang, Haonan Zheng, Yuanhao Yue, Junbing Yan, Ming Wang, Jun Huang
papers.abstract: Modern industrial applications increasingly demand language models that act as agents, capable of multi-step reasoning and tool use in real-world settings. These tasks are typically performed under strict cost and latency constraints, making small agentic models highly desirable. In this paper, we introduce the AgenticQwen family of models, trained via multi-round reinforcement learning (RL) on synthetic data and a limited amount of open-source data. Our training framework combines reasoning RL and agentic RL with dual data flywheels that automatically generate increasingly challenging tasks. The reasoning flywheel increases task difficulty by learning from errors, while the agentic flywheel expands linear workflows into multi-branch behavior trees that better reflect the decision complexity of real-world applications. We validate AgenticQwen on public benchmarks and in an industrial agent system. The models achieve strong performance on multiple agentic benchmarks, and in our industrial agent system, close the gap with much larger models on search and data analysis tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代工业应用越来越需要能够作为智能体运行的语言模型，这些模型能够在现实环境中进行多步骤推理和工具使用。这类任务通常在严格的成本和延迟限制下进行，因此小型智能体模型非常受欢迎。在本文中，我们介绍了AgenticQwen系列模型。这些模型是通过在多轮强化学习的基础上，利用合成数据和少量开源数据进行训练的。我们的训练框架结合了推理强化学习和智能体强化学习技术，并采用了双数据生成机制，能够自动生成越来越具有挑战性的任务。推理机制通过从错误中学习来提高任务的难度，而智能体机制则将线性工作流程扩展为多分支行为树结构，从而更好地反映现实应用中决策的复杂性。我们在公共基准测试以及工业智能体系统中对AgenticQwen进行了验证。这些模型在多个智能体基准测试中表现优异，在我们的工业智能体系统中，它们在搜索和数据分析任务上已经接近甚至超过了那些规模更大的模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Short Video to Clickable Search: RLVR-Enabled Listwise Query Suggestion with Retrieval-Augmented Context
papers.title_zh: 从短视频到可点击搜索：基于强化学习技术的列表式查询建议与增强型检索上下文支持
papers.authors: Mingkai Tian, Xuye, Long Meng, Liwei Chen, Zhiheng Qin, Yi Wang
papers.abstract: Short-video platforms now present tappable search entries beneath the video player, making it effortless for users to shift from passively watching to actively searching for information. Prior work on bottom-bar query generation conditions on titles and OCR to generate a single query per forward pass, constrains decoding with a trie, and evaluates against a single reference using edit-distance–style supervision—making it difficult to cover the diverse intents a video can trigger and to credit semantically equivalent query variants. Motivated by these limitations, we propose four complementary improvements. First, we reformulate the task as one-shot list generation, producing multiple distinct queries per video, and build multi-query ground truth from exposure and CTR logs. Second, we redesign offline evaluation with \operatorname{CTR\text{-}HungF1}, a CTR-weighted set-matching metric via optimal assignment over token-level F1 score. Third, we enrich context with a video-to-video-to-query (V2V2Q) RAG pipeline to provide behavior-grounded background knowledge. Finally, we apply thinking-free RLVR with deterministic format checks and \operatorname{CTR\text{-}HungF1} rewards to train a compact LLM without reward models or CoT distillation. The resulting system yields strong offline and online improvements, and has been deployed on Kuaishou to serve hundreds of millions of users daily.
papers.abstract_zh: 短视频平台现在在视频播放器下方提供了可点击的搜索入口，使用户能够轻松地从被动观看转变为主动搜索信息。以往的研究针对底部栏中的标题进行查询生成条件的处理，以及通过OCR生成每次转发一次的单一查询，这些处理方式会限制解码过程，并且采用编辑距离式的监督方法来评估查询结果——这使得难以涵盖视频可能引发的多种意图，也难以对语义上相同的查询变体进行区分。鉴于这些局限性，我们提出了四项互补性的改进措施。首先，我们将任务重新定义为一次性列表生成，为每个视频生成多个不同的查询，并通过曝光率和点击率日志来构建多查询的基准数据。其次，我们重新设计了离线评估方法，采用了\operatorname{CTR\text{-}HungF1}这一基于最优分配的CTR加权匹配度量标准，该标准以令牌级别的F1分数为基础进行计算。第三，我们通过视频到视频再到查询的RAG管道来丰富上下文信息，以提供基于行为的背景知识。最后，我们采用无需思考的RLVR方法，结合确定性格式检查和\operatorname{CTR\text{-}HungF1}奖励机制，来训练一个紧凑的LLM，而无需使用奖励模型或CoT蒸馏技术。最终得到的系统在离线效果和在线表现方面都取得了显著提升，并已部署在快手平台上，每天为数亿用户提供服务。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Small Agents, Big Gains: Journey-Aware and Critic-Guided Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Dialogues
papers.title_zh: 小型代理，巨大收益：基于路径感知的、由评论者引导的模拟方法在长时段购物对话中的应用
papers.authors: Qing Ping, Changyou Chen, Binxuan Huang
papers.abstract: Modern e-commerce assistants must go beyond simple product search to support inspiration, comparison, and tool-grounded fact-checking across non-linear shopping journeys. However, distilling these complex behaviors into efficient, deployable models is bottle-necked by a lack of post-training data: trajectories must cover diverse agentic workflows with high fidelity, yet the desired outputs are open-ended without a single ground truth. We propose a closed-loop Multi-Agent Simulation Framework to synthesize diverse, faithful, and policy-aligned shopping trajectories. The system orchestrates a journey-aware, stateful user simulator to drive exploration, a shopping agent that manages both tools and UI elements, and a critic agent that provides rubric-driven feedback to iteratively refine the data. On a domain-specific benchmark, this synthetic data enables a small model to significantly outperform same-size baselines and surpass a large-model baseline, achieving near-zero tool-calling errors with 8\times higher inference throughput.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代电子商务助手必须超越简单的产品搜索功能，支持用户在非线性购物过程中进行灵感激发、商品比较以及基于工具的事实验证。然而，将这些复杂行为转化为高效、可部署的模型却受到训练后数据不足的制约：轨迹需要涵盖多种用户操作流程，并且要求具有高度真实性的描述，但所需的输出结果却是开放式的，没有单一的基准数据可供参考。我们提出了一种闭环多智能体仿真框架，用于合成多样化、真实且符合策略要求的购物轨迹。该系统包含一个注重购物流程的、具有状态管理的用户模拟器，用于推动用户的探索行为；还有一个负责管理工具和用户界面元素的购物智能体，以及一个提供基于评分标准的反馈的智能体，以逐步优化数据质量。在针对特定领域的基准测试中，这种合成数据使得小型模型能够显著超越同规模的基础模型，甚至超过大型模型的基线性能，同时实现了几乎零的调用工具错误率，并且推理效率提高了8倍。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Progressive Fine-Tuning for Cost-Effective Structured Attribute Generation in E-commerce
papers.title_zh: 渐进式精细调优技术，用于实现电子商务领域结构化属性的高效生成
papers.authors: Lakshman Kolasani, Fatemeh Taheri Dezaki
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at structured information generation but face cost and latency challenges when deployed at scale in user-facing products. We present a parameter efficient supervised fine-tuning pipeline for adapting a small language model (SLM) to structured attribute generation in e-commerce product listing, enabling continuous model improvement with implicit user feedback without expensive manual annotation. Our approach involves completeness-deficit guided curation, which ranks samples by divergence between model predictions and catalog listing attributes, selecting the highest completeness gap examples for progressive fine-tuning. Our system is deployed on a large-scale product listing service, reducing inference costs by 98% and p90 latency by 70% using a fine-tuned SLM relative to the baseline LLM while preserving an 86.4% user acceptance rate, translating to significant monthly infrastructure savings.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在生成结构化信息方面表现出色，但在大规模应用于用户产品时面临着成本和延迟方面的挑战。我们提出了一种参数高效的监督式微调方法，可以将小型语言模型用于电子商务商品列表中的结构化属性生成，从而通过隐式的用户反馈实现模型的持续优化，而无需进行昂贵的手动标注工作。我们的方法采用了完整性-缺陷引导的筛选机制，根据模型预测与商品列表属性之间的差异对样本进行排序，选择完整性差距最大的样本进行逐步微调。我们的系统被部署在大规模的商品列表服务上，与基准语言模型相比，使用经过微调的小型语言模型可以将推理成本降低98%，第 90 百分位（p90）延迟降低70%。同时，系统的用户接受度保持在86.4%，这意味着每月可以节省大量的基础设施成本。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Grounded Multimodal In-Context Learning for Product Weight Estimation at Scale in E-commerce
papers.title_zh: 基于多模态上下文学习的产品重量估算方法——适用于电子商务领域的规模化应用
papers.authors: Bhavuk Singhal, Arsh Keshari, Ravindra Kumar Yadav
papers.abstract: Accurately inferring implicit physical attributes of products, such as weight, is critical for large-scale e-commerce logistics but challenging due to sparse or unreliable textual metadata and high visual variability. We formulate weight estimation as a grounded multimodal reasoning problem and investigate whether large vision-language models (LVLMs) can infer discretized weight buckets through in-context learning (ICL) over product images and descriptions. We introduce a scalable inference framework that conditions predictions on automatically retrieved, category-specific exemplars and propose a distribution-calibrated retrieval strategy that aligns few-shot contexts with the empirical weight distribution of each product sub-category. This calibration substantially improves few-shot multimodal reasoning compared to random or embedding-based retrieval baselines. Across 14 high-variance categories, our approach significantly outperforms strong multimodal KNN baselines in both exact-match accuracy and near-bucket reliability. Deployed in production on a large e-commerce platform, our system processes millions of listings daily and reduces shipping-related revenue leakage by \sim22%, demonstrating that multimodal ICL can serve as a practical and cost-effective alternative to manual or hardware-based verification.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确推断产品的隐含物理属性，如重量，对于大规模电子商务物流来说至关重要，但由于文本元数据稀疏或不可靠，且产品外观变化较大，这一任务颇具挑战性。我们将重量估计问题定义为一种基于多模态的推理问题，并研究大型视觉-语言模型是否能够通过对产品图片和描述进行上下文学习来推断出具体的重量区间。我们提出了一个可扩展的推理框架，该框架基于自动检索到的、与类别相关的样本来进行预测，并提出了一种分布校准的检索策略，该策略将少量样本的上下文信息与每个产品子类别的实际重量分布相结合。这种校准方式显著提升了少量样本的多模态推理能力，优于基于随机或嵌入方法的检索基线方法。在14个高方差类别中，我们的方法在精确匹配准确性和接近重量区间的可靠性方面均优于强大的多模态KNN基线方法。在我们的系统部署于一个大型电子商务平台后，该系统每天能够处理数百万条商品信息，并将与运输相关的收入损失减少了约22%，这表明多模态上下文学习可以作为手动或硬件验证的一种实用且经济高效的替代方案。

papers.title: Towards Faithful Industrial RAG: A Reinforced Co-adaptation Framework for Advertising QA
papers.title_zh: 迈向可靠的工业RAG：一种用于广告质量检测的强化协同适应框架
papers.authors: Wenwei Li, Ming Xu, Tianle Xia, Lingxiang Hu, Yiding Sun, Linfang Shang, Liqun Liu, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang
papers.abstract: Industrial advertising question answering (QA) is a high-stakes task in which hallucinated content, particularly fabricated URLs, can lead to financial loss, compliance violations, and legal risk. Although Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely adopted, deploying it in production remains challenging because industrial knowledge is inherently relational, frequently updated, and insufficiently aligned with generation objectives. We propose a reinforced co-adaptation framework that jointly optimizes retrieval and generation through two components: (1) Graph-aware Retrieval (GraphRAG), which models entity-relation structure over a high-citation knowledge subgraph for multi-hop, domain-specific evidence selection; and (2) evidence-constrained reinforcement learning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with multi-dimensional rewards covering faithfulness, style compliance, safety, and URL validity. Experiments on an internal advertising QA dataset show consistent gains across expert-judged dimensions including accuracy, completeness, and safety, while reducing the hallucination rate by 72%. A two-week online A/B test demonstrates a 28.6% increase in like rate, a 46.2% decrease in dislike rate, and a 92.7% reduction in URL hallucination. The system has been running in production for over half a year and has served millions of QA interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 工业广告问答任务是一项高风险任务，其中虚假内容，尤其是伪造的网址，可能导致财务损失、合规问题以及法律风险。尽管检索增强生成技术已被广泛采用，但在实际生产环境中应用仍面临挑战，因为工业领域的知识本质上是关系型的，且经常需要更新，同时与生成目标之间的关联不够紧密。我们提出了一种强化协同适应框架，通过两个组件来优化检索和生成：(1) 图感知检索技术，该技术能够针对高引用度的知识子图建模实体关系结构，从而实现多跳、特定领域的证据选择；(2) 基于证据约束的强化学习技术，通过群体相对策略优化方法，结合涵盖准确性、风格合规性、安全性和网址有效性等多维奖励机制。在内部广告问答数据集上的实验表明，该框架在准确性、完整性以及安全性等专家评估的指标上取得了持续提升，同时将虚假网址的出现率降低了72%。为期两周的在线A/B测试显示，该系统使点赞率增加了28.6%，反对率减少了46.2%，而伪造网址的出现率则降低了92.7%。该系统已投入生产运行超过半年，处理了数百万次问答交互。

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Modeling Heterogeneous Financial Data via Dual-Granularity Prompting
papers.title_zh: 一种用于建模异构金融数据的统一框架——基于双粒度提示的方法
papers.authors: Yu Lei, Zixuan Wang, Yiqing Feng, Junru Zhang, Yahui Li, Liu Chu, Wang Tongyao, Dongyang Li
papers.abstract: Recent industrial credit scoring models remain heavily reliant on manually tuned statistical learning methods. Despite their potential, deep learning architectures have struggled to consistently outperform traditional statistical models in industrial credit scoring, largely due to the complexity of heterogeneous financial data and the challenge of modeling evolving creditworthiness. To bridge this gap, we introduce FinLangNet, a novel framework that reformulates credit scoring as a multi-scale sequential learning problem. FinLangNet processes heterogeneous financial data through a dual-module architecture that combines tabular feature extraction with temporal sequence modeling, generating probability distributions of users’ future financial behaviors across multiple time horizons. A key innovation is our dual-prompt mechanism within the sequential module, which introduces learnable prompts operating at both feature-level granularity for capturing fine-grained temporal patterns and user-level granularity for aggregating holistic risk profiles. Notably, real world deployment yielded a 6.3 pp improvement in KS, along with a 9.9% reduction in bad debt rate.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的工业信贷评分模型仍然严重依赖人工调整的统计学习方法。尽管深度学习架构具有潜力，但在工业信贷评分方面，它们往往难以持续超越传统统计模型。这主要是由于异构金融数据的复杂性以及信用状况变化建模的困难所致。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了FinLangNet这一创新框架。该框架将信贷评分重新定义为一个多尺度序列学习问题。FinLangNet通过双模块架构来处理异构金融数据，结合表格式特征提取与时间序列建模技术，从而生成用户未来多种时间范围内的财务行为概率分布。我们的关键创新在于序列模块中的双提示机制，该机制引入了可在特征级和用户级进行操作的提示函数，分别用于捕捉细微的时间模式以及汇总整体风险状况。值得注意的是，在实际应用过程中，该模型的KS评分提高了6.3个百分点，同时坏账率也降低了9.9%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DuIVRS-2: An LLM-based Interactive Voice Response System for Large-scale POI Attribute Acquisition
papers.title_zh: DuIVRS-2：一种基于大语言模型的互动式语音响应系统，适用于大规模兴趣点属性的获取
papers.authors: Le Zhang, Shengming Zhang, Rui Zha, Wu Yunpeng, Jingbo Zhou, Jizhou Huang
papers.abstract: Accurate Point of Interest (POI) attribute acquisition is essential for location-based services, yet traditional modular Interactive Voice Response (IVR) systems suffer from error accumulation and high maintenance overhead. We present DuIVRS-2, a large language model (LLM)-based end-to-end framework designed for large-scale POI attribute acquisition at Baidu Maps. To address the long-tail distribution of real-world interactions, our methodology first employs a finite state machine (FSM)-guided data augmentation strategy to synthesize a balanced and diverse training dataset. We then streamline dialogue management via a selective generation scheme combined with a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism, which ensures output stability and effectively eliminates hallucinations in industrial settings. To facilitate continuous policy refinement with minimal manual effort, we design a cooperative iterative learning framework that leverages a dual-evaluator voting system. Deployed in production for two months, DuIVRS-2 processed 0.4 million calls daily and achieved a 83.9% Task Success Rate (TSR), outperforming its predecessor by 4 percentage points while maintaining a low reaction time of 130ms. This work provides a production-proven reference for developing robust, cost-effective LLM agents for large-scale industrial dialogue applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确获取兴趣点（POI）属性对于基于位置的服务至关重要，然而传统的模块化交互式语音应答系统存在错误累积和高维护成本的问题。我们提出了DuIVRS-2，这是一个基于大语言模型的端到端框架，旨在为百度地图的大规模POI属性获取任务提供服务。为了应对现实世界中复杂的交互情况，我们的方法首先采用有限状态机引导的数据增强策略，以生成平衡且多样化的训练数据集。接着，我们通过结合思维链机制的选择性生成方案来简化对话管理流程，从而确保输出的稳定性，并有效消除工业环境中的幻觉现象。为了能够在最小的手动干预下持续优化策略，我们设计了一个协作式迭代学习框架，该框架利用双评估器投票系统来实现决策优化。在两个月的生产实践中，DuIVRS-2每天能够处理40万次呼叫，任务成功率达到了83.9%，比其前身提升了4个百分点，同时反应时间保持在130毫秒左右。这项工作为开发适用于大规模工业对话应用的、既可靠又经济高效的LLM代理提供了可靠的参考方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SAJA: A Simple Approach to Judge Alignment for LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.title_zh: SAJA：一种简单的LLM作为裁判的判罚一致性评估方法
papers.authors: Sneha Kola, Pankaj Kumar Sharma, Soumyadeep Dey, Bamdev Mishra, Mayur Datar
papers.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge systems are increasingly used to evaluate text at scale, yet production deployment demands low latency, minimal cost, and compatibility with closed-source APIs. Current approaches fall short in different ways: some require many LLM calls and per-dataset prompt tuning, others depend on logit access unavailable in commercial APIs, and yet others demand multiple rounds of LLM interaction for iterative feature discovery. We present SAJA (Simple Approach to Judge Alignment), built on the principle that task-specific alignment should reside in a lightweight calibration head, not in elaborate prompts or model internals. SAJA makes exactly one LLM call per item using a fixed structured rubric prompt, extracts a multi-dimensional feature vector, and maps it to a human-aligned score via a calibration head trained on a small number of human labels. No iterative prompt search, no logit access, and no multi-round LLM interaction are needed. Yet SAJA matches far more complex systems across four evaluation paradigms: 86% F1 on MT-Bench pairwise preference (vs. 78% uncalibrated), competitive performance on five classification benchmarks with a single call, and +5.71% F1 over prompt-optimized baselines on proprietary data. Ablations confirm that multi-dimensional rubric features outperform one-dimensional calibration (SummEval \rho improves from 0.60 to 0.74) and that coarse rubric outputs recover the same human alignment as full logit distributions (\rho = 0.36 vs. 0.37), establishing that logit access is unnecessary for calibrated judge alignment. Moreover, SAJA is model-agnostic: a 9B open-source model with SAJA (\rho{=}0.70) surpasses raw GPT-4.1 (\rho{=}0.60). Its single-call design yields up to 4.8\times cost savings over per-question approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 作为裁判系统的LLM在大规模文本评估中得到了广泛应用，但实际部署要求低延迟、低成本，并且要与闭源API兼容。目前的方法存在各种不足：有些方法需要多次调用LLM，并对每个数据集进行提示调整；有些方法依赖于商业API中无法提供的logit访问功能；还有些方法需要多轮LLM交互以实现迭代特征发现。我们提出了SAJA（简单裁判对齐方法），其原理是任务特定的对齐应该存在于一个轻量级的校准头中，而不是复杂的提示或模型内部结构。SAJA每次处理一个项目时只调用一次LLM，使用固定的结构化提示提取多维特征向量，然后通过一个基于少量人类标签训练的校准头将其映射到符合人类判断的评分上。无需迭代的提示搜索、logit访问或多轮LLM交互。然而，SAJA能够在四种评估范式中与更复杂的系统相匹配：在MT-Bench成对偏好任务上的F1分数达到86%（而非未校准方法的78%），在五个分类基准测试中的表现具有竞争力，且在与专有数据相关的基准测试中，SAJA的F1分数比优化过的提示基线高出5.71%。消融实验表明，多维评分特征的性能优于一维校准（SummEval的ρ从0.60提高到0.74），而且粗略的评分输出也能恢复与完整logit分布相同的准确性（ρ=0.36对比0.37），这说明对于校准后的裁判对齐来说，logit访问是不必要的。此外，SAJA是模型无关的：一个拥有9B参数的开源模型在使用SAJA时，其ρ值达到0.70，超过了原始GPT-4.1的ρ值0.60。其单次调用设计使得成本相比每次问题单独处理的方案降低了4.8倍。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ColorBrowserAgent: Complex Long-Horizon Browser Agent with Adaptive Knowledge Evolution
papers.title_zh: ColorBrowserAgent：一种复杂的长视界浏览器代理程序，具备自适应知识进化功能
papers.authors: Jihong Wang, Jiamu Zhou, Weiming Zhang, Teng Wang, Weiwen Liu, Zhuosheng Zhang, Xingyu Lou, Weinan Zhang, Huarong Deng, Jun Wang
papers.abstract: With the advancement of vision-language models, web automation has made significant progress. However, deploying autonomous agents in real-world settings remains challenging, primarily due to site heterogeneity, where generalist models lack domain-specific priors for diverse interfaces, and long-horizon instability, characterized by the accumulation of decision drift over extended interactions. To address these challenges, we introduce ColorBrowserAgent (Complex Long-Horizon Browser Agent), a knowledge-evolving agent for robust web automation. Our approach addresses these challenges through two synergistic mechanisms: human-in-the-loop knowledge adaptation that transforms sparse human feedback into reusable domain knowledge, and knowledge-aligned progressive summarization that stabilizes long interactions through memory compression. Extensive experiments on WebArena, WebChoreArena and industrial deployment show that ColorBrowserAgent consistently outperforms strong baselines. It achieves a state-of-the-art success rate of 71.2% on WebArena and maintains 47.4% performance under zero-shot transfer setting on WebChoreArena. In commercial deployment, it improves user satisfaction by 19.3% relatively, verifying its robustness in real-world scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着视语模型的不断发展，网络自动化取得了显著进步。然而，在现实环境中部署自主代理仍然面临挑战，主要原因在于环境的异质性——通用模型缺乏针对不同界面的领域特定先验知识；此外，长期不稳定性的问题也时有发生，表现为在长时间交互过程中决策偏差的累积。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ColorBrowserAgent这一知识演化型代理，它能够实现强大的网络自动化功能。我们的解决方案通过两种协同机制来应对这些挑战：一种是“人在环中”的知识适应机制，它将稀疏的人类反馈转化为可复用的领域知识；另一种是“知识对齐”的渐进式总结机制，它通过内存压缩来稳定长时间的交互过程。在WebArena、WebChoreArena以及工业环境中的广泛实验表明，ColorBrowserAgent始终优于其他强大的基线算法。在WebArena上，它的成功率达到了71.2%；而在WebChoreArena上，即使在零样本迁移环境下，其性能依然保持在47.4%。在商业应用中，它使用户满意度提高了19.3%，充分证明了其在现实场景中的强大能力。

papers.title: ClinDet-Bench: Beyond Abstention, Evaluating Judgment Determinability of LLMs in Clinical Decision-Making
papers.title_zh: ClinDet-Bench：超越回避行为，评估大语言模型在临床决策中的判断能力
papers.authors: Yusuke Watanabe, Yohei Kobashi, Takeshi Kojima, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yasushi Okuno, Yutaka Matsuo
papers.abstract: Clinical decisions are often required under incomplete information. Clinical experts must identify whether available information is sufficient for judgment, as both premature conclusions and unnecessary abstention can compromise patient safety. To evaluate this capability of large language models (LLMs), we developed ClinDet-Bench, a benchmark based on clinical scoring systems that decomposes incomplete-information scenarios into determinable and undeterminable conditions. Identifying determinability requires considering all hypotheses about missing information, including unlikely ones, and verifying whether the conclusion holds across them. We find that recent LLMs fail to identify determinability under incomplete information, producing both premature conclusions and excessive abstention, despite correctly explaining the underlying scoring knowledge and performing well under complete information. These findings suggest that existing benchmarks are insufficient to evaluate the safety of LLMs in clinical settings. ClinDet-Bench provides a framework for evaluating determinability recognition, leading to appropriate abstention, with potential applicability to medicine and other high-stakes domains, and is publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 在信息不完整的情况下，常常需要做出临床决策。临床专家必须判断现有信息是否足以支持决策，因为过早的结论或不必要的回避都可能危及患者安全。为了评估大语言模型的能力，我们开发了ClinDet-Bench这一基准测试，该测试基于临床评分系统，能够将信息不完整的情况分为可确定和不可确定的情况。判断信息的确定性需要考虑关于缺失信息的所有假设，包括不太可能的假设，并验证这些假设下得出的结论是否成立。我们发现，最近的LLM在信息不完整的情况下无法判断出信息的确定性，导致过早的结论和不必要的回避，尽管它们在完全信息的情况下能够正确地解释评分逻辑并且表现良好。这些发现表明，现有的基准测试不足以评估LLM在临床环境中的安全性。ClinDet-Bench提供了一个评估确定性识别能力的框架，从而能够做出适当的回避决策。该工具具有潜在的医学及其他高风险领域的应用前景，并且已经公开可用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AIDA-SEAT: Towards Reliable AI Doctor Assistant via State-Evaluation-Action Tree Enhanced LLMs in Online Hospital
papers.title_zh: AIDA-SEAT：通过状态评估与动作树相结合的大语言模型，实现在线医院中可靠的AI医生助手系统
papers.authors: Lianxin Sun, Xiaoying Ying, Guangya Yu, Weiyan Zhang, Chenhao Guan, Hao He, Mingxi Shang, Jianhua Li, ChunMing Wang, Tong Ruan
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence doctor assistants (AIDAs) help streamline clinical decision-making and reduce physician workload. While existing systems primarily utilize Large Language Models (LLMs) or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), these methods typically retrieve static facts—whether as text passages or structured graphs—lacking the explicit logical pathways essential for multi-step reasoning. In this paper, we propose the AIDA-SEAT framework to provide reliable clinical decision-making support. First, we design the state-evaluation-action tree (SEAT), which covers diagnosis, treatment, and examination. To develop this tree, we refine and transform SEAT collected from medical documents and doctors. Then, we propose an adaptive method to select optimal trees tailored to the current patients’ state. Finally, we leverage LLMs to perform state assessment, evaluation, and action execution based on the tree, thereby generating reliable responses. To evaluate the effectiveness of our method, we conducted extensive experiments on a self-built dataset. Our method achieves 1.01% higher than current state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines across five departments, including common RAG-based methods. Furthermore, analysis of 200 consultation records during deployment on an online hospital revealed that system-assisted responses are 24.16 seconds faster on average than manual ones, improving efficiency by 26.85%.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能医生助理（AIDA）有助于简化临床决策过程，减轻医生的工作负担。虽然现有的系统主要使用大语言模型或检索增强生成技术，但这些方法通常只能检索静态信息——无论是文本段落还是结构化图表——缺乏进行多步骤推理所需的明确逻辑路径。在本文中，我们提出了AIDA-SEAT框架，以提供可靠的临床决策支持。首先，我们设计了状态评估-行动树（SEAT），该树涵盖了诊断、治疗和检查等环节。为了构建这一树状结构，我们对从医疗文件和医生那里收集到的数据进行了优化和转换。然后，我们提出了一种自适应方法，能够根据当前患者的状态选择最优的树状结构。最后，我们利用语言模型根据树状结构进行状态评估、评估和行动执行，从而生成可靠的响应。为了评估我们的方法有效性，我们在自建的数据集上进行了广泛的实验。我们的方法在五个领域中的表现均优于当前最先进的基线方法，提升了1.01%。此外，在一家在线医院部署该系统后，通过对200份咨询记录的分析发现，系统辅助的响应平均比人工响应快24.16秒，效率提高了26.85%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: IndustryAssetEQA: A Neurosymbolic Operational Intelligence System for Embodied Question Answering in Industrial Asset Maintenance
papers.title_zh: IndustryAssetEQA：一种基于神经符号的运营智能系统，用于工业资产维护中的问答处理
papers.authors: Chathurangi Shyalika, Dhaval C Patel, Amit Sheth
papers.abstract: Industrial maintenance environments increasingly rely on AI systems to assist operators in understanding asset behavior, diagnosing failures, and evaluating interventions. Although large language models (LLMs) enable fluent natural-language interaction, deployed maintenance assistants routinely produce generic explanations that are weakly grounded in telemetry, omit verifiable provenance, and offer no testable support for counterfactual or action-oriented reasoning that undermine trust in safety-critical settings. We present IndustryAssetEQA, a neurosymbolic operational intelligence system that combines episode-centric telemetry representations with a Failure Mode and Effects Analysis Knowledge Graph (FMEA-KG) to enable Embodied Question Answering (EQA) over industrial assets. We evaluate on four datasets covering four industrial asset types, including rotating machinery, turbofan engines, hydraulic systems, and cyber–physical production systems. Compared to LLM-only baselines, IndustryAssetEQA improves structural validity by up to +0.51, counterfactual accuracy by up to +0.47, and explanation entailment by +0.64, while reducing severe expert-rated overclaims from 28% to 2% ( 93%). Code, datasets, and the FMEA-KG are available at: https://github.com/IBM/AssetOpsBench/tree/IndustryAssetEQA/IndustryAssetEQA
papers.abstract_zh: 在工业维护环境中，人工智能系统越来越被用于帮助操作员理解资产行为、诊断故障以及评估各种干预措施的效果。虽然大语言模型能够实现流畅的自然语言交互，但部署在维护系统中的助手往往只能提供一些泛泛的解释，这些解释缺乏基于遥测数据的支持，且无法为反事实推理或行动导向的推理提供可验证的依据，这严重影响了人们对安全关键系统的信任。我们提出了IndustryAssetEQA这一神经符号式运营智能系统，该系统将以事件为中心的遥测数据表示与故障模式与影响分析知识图谱相结合，从而实现针对工业资产的问答功能。我们在涵盖四种工业资产类型的四个数据集上进行了测试，这些资产包括旋转机械、涡轮风扇发动机、液压系统以及网络物理生产系统。与仅使用语言模型的基线相比，IndustryAssetEQA在结构有效性方面提高了0.51倍，反事实准确性提高了0.47倍，解释相关性提高了0.64倍。同时，它还将专家评分中的过度声明率从28%降低到了2%（93%）。相关代码、数据集以及故障模式与影响分析知识图谱均可在此处获取：https://github.com/IBM/AssetOpsBench/tree/IndustryAssetEQA/IndustryAssetEQA

papers.title: Evidence-Driven Reasoning for Industrial Maintenance Using Heterogeneous Data
papers.title_zh: 基于证据的工业维护推理方法，利用异构数据实现决策
papers.authors: Fearghal O’Donncha, Nianjun Zhou, Natalia Martinez, James T Rayfield, Fenno F. Heath III, Abigail Langbridge, Roman Vaculin
papers.abstract: Industrial maintenance platforms contain rich but fragmented evidence, including free-text work orders, heterogeneous operational sensors or indicators, and structured failure knowledge. These sources are often analyzed in isolation, producing alerts or forecasts that do not support conditional decision-making: given this asset history and behavior, what is happening and what action is warranted?We present Condition Insight Agent, a deployed decision-support framework that integrates maintenance language, behavioral abstractions of operational data, and engineering failure semantics to produce evidence-grounded explanations and advisory actions. The system constrains reasoning through deterministic evidence construction and structured failure knowledge, and applies a rule-based verification loop to suppress unsupported conclusions.Case studies from production CMMS deployments show that this verification-first design operates reliably under heterogeneous and incomplete data while preserving human oversight. Our results demonstrate how constrained LLM-based reasoning can function as a governed decision-support layer for industrial maintenance.
papers.abstract_zh: 工业维护平台包含丰富但分散的数据资源，其中包括自由文本的工作订单、异构的运营传感器或指标，以及结构化的故障知识。这些数据通常被孤立地分析，从而得出一些无法支持有条件决策的警报或预测结果：根据这一资产的历史记录和行为特征，当前发生了什么情况，又需要采取何种行动？我们提出了Condition Insight Agent这一决策支持框架，它整合了维护相关的语言、运营数据的行为抽象以及工程故障的语义信息，从而能够生成基于证据的解释和建议性措施。该系统通过确定性证据构建和结构化故障知识来约束推理过程，并采用基于规则的验证机制来排除那些没有依据的结论。来自生产管理系统部署的案例研究表明，这种以验证为先的设计方式能够在异构且不完整的数据环境下可靠运行，同时还能保留人类的监督作用。我们的研究结果表明，基于大语言的推理可以作为一种受控的决策支持层，用于工业维护领域。

papers.title: MobileLLM-Flash: Latency-Guided On-Device LLM Design for Industry Scale Deployment
papers.title_zh: MobileLLM-Flash：一种基于延迟优化的设备内大语言模型设计，适用于工业规模的应用场景
papers.authors: Hanxian Huang, Igor Fedorov, Andrey Gromov, Bernard Beckerman, Naveen Suda, David Eriksson, Maximilian Balandat, Rylan Conway, Patrick Huber, Chinnadhurai Sankar, Ayushi Dalmia, Zechun Liu, Lemeng Wu, Tarek Elgamal, Adithya Sagar, Vikas Chandra, Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi
papers.abstract: Real-time AI experiences call for on-device large language models (OD-LLMs) optimized for efficient deployment on resource-constrained hardware. The most useful OD-LLMs produce near-real-time responses and exhibit broad hardware compatibility, maximizing user reach. We present a methodology for designing such models using hardware-in-the-loop architecture search under mobile latency constraints. This system is amenable to industry-scale deployment: it generates models deployable without custom kernels and compatible with standard mobile runtimes like Executorch. Our methodology avoids specialized attention mechanisms and instead uses attention skipping for long-context acceleration. Our approach jointly optimizes model architecture (layers, dimensions) and attention pattern. To efficiently evaluate candidates, we treat each as a pruned version of a pretrained backbone with inherited weights, thereby achieving high accuracy with minimal continued pretraining. We leverage the low cost of latency evaluation in a staged process: learning an accurate latency model first, then searching for the Pareto-frontier across latency and quality.This yields MobileLLM-Flash, a family of foundation models (350M, 650M, 1.4B) for efficient on-device use with strong capabilities, supporting up to 8k context length. MobileLLM-Flash delivers up to 1.8x and 1.6x faster prefill and decode on mobile CPUs with comparable or superior quality. Our analysis of Pareto-frontier design choices offers actionable principles for OD-LLM design.
papers.abstract_zh: 实时AI体验需要能够在设备端高效部署的大语言模型（OD-LLMs），以适用于资源有限的硬件环境。最实用的OD-LLMs能够产生近乎实时的响应，并且具有广泛的硬件兼容性，从而最大限度地扩大用户覆盖范围。我们提出了一种基于硬件在环架构搜索的方法来设计此类模型，同时考虑移动设备的延迟限制。该系统适用于工业规模部署：无需定制内核即可生成模型，并且与Executorch等标准移动运行时兼容。我们的方法避免了使用专门的注意力机制，而是采用注意力跳过技术来加速长上下文处理。我们的方法同时优化了模型架构（层数和维度）以及注意力模式。为了有效评估候选模型，我们将每个模型视为经过预训练的骨干网络的修剪版本，并保留其权重结构，从而实现在最小持续预训练的情况下获得高精度。我们通过分阶段的方式进行延迟评估：首先学习准确的延迟模型，然后寻找延迟与质量之间的帕累托前沿。由此诞生了MobileLLM-Flash系列基础模型（3.5亿、6.5亿、14亿参数），这些模型可在设备端高效使用，具备强大的处理能力，支持长达8千的上下文长度。MobileLLM-Flash在移动CPU上的预填充和解码速度分别快了1.8倍和1.6倍，而性能却相当或更优。我们对帕累托前沿设计选择的分析为OD-LLM的设计提供了可操作的原则。
