papers.title: LEAP: Layer-wise Exit-Aware Pretraining for Efficient Transformer Inference
papers.title_zh: LEAP：基于分层退出的预训练方法，以实现高效的Transformer推理
papers.authors: Shashank Kapadia, Deep Narayan Mishra, Sujal Reddy Alugubelli, Haoan Wang, Saipraveen Vabbilisetty, Rishi Bhatia, Anupriya Sharma
papers.abstract: Layer-aligned distillation and convergence-based early exit represent two predominant computational efficiency paradigms for transformer inference; yet we establish that they exhibit fundamental incompatibility under standard deployment conditions for convergence-based early exit. Distillation objectives that align intermediate student layers to teacher representations suppress the representational convergence that early-exit mechanisms exploit, rendering such mechanisms ineffective on distilled models.We introduce LEAP (Layer-wise Exit-Aware Pretraining), an auxiliary training objective that reconciles this incompatibility. LEAP requires no architectural modifications; it augments standard distillation with a single constraint ensuring intermediate layers approximate final-layer representations. LEAP-MiniLM achieves 1.61\times measured wall-clock speedup (batch = 1, NVIDIA L4) at \theta = 0.95, with 91.9% of samples exiting by layer 7 and 1.80\times theoretical layer reduction, where standard distilled models achieve zero effective speedup. We validate across sentence similarity (STS-B: 0.760 \pm 0.006) and retrieval benchmarks (BEIR), providing operational guidance including latency measurements, decision thresholds, and deployment criteria.
papers.abstract_zh: 层对齐蒸馏和基于收敛性的提前退出是Transformer推理中两种主要的计算效率方法；然而我们发现，在标准部署条件下，这两种方法存在根本的不兼容性。那些将中间层与教师表示对齐的蒸馏目标会抑制早期退出机制所利用的表征收敛性，使得这种机制在经过蒸馏后的模型中无法发挥作用。我们提出了LEAP（层级提前退出预训练）这一辅助训练目标，它能够解决这种不兼容性问题。LEAP不需要任何架构上的修改，它只是通过增加一个约束条件来补充标准的蒸馏方法，即确保中间层能够逼近最终层的表示方式。在θ=0.95的情况下，LEAP-MiniLM实现了1.61倍的实时加速效果（批处理规模为1，使用NVIDIA L4硬件）；有91.9%的样本在第七层之前就完成了退出过程，同时实现了1.80倍的理论层数减少效果。而传统的蒸馏模型则无法实现如此显著的加速效果。我们在句子相似性测试（STS-B：0.760±0.006）和检索基准测试（BEIR）中验证了LEAP的有效性，并提供了包括延迟测量、决策阈值以及部署标准在内的操作指南。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Think Like You Execute: Verifiable Chain of Thought from Program Traces
papers.title_zh: 像自己一样思考，然后付诸行动：从程序执行过程中可验证的思维链条
papers.authors: Shailja Thakur, Vaibhav Saxena, Rohan Kulkarni, Shivdeep Singh, Parameswaran Selvam, Hiroshi Kanayama, Hima Patel
papers.abstract: Teaching language models to reason about code execution is still an open problem. Current synthetic Chain-of-Thought (CoT) training data often consists of plausible-sounding explanations generated by teacher models, not verifiable accounts of actual program behavior. This causes models to learn logically flawed reasoning patterns despite syntactic correctness.We address this by grounding CoT generation directly in program execution traces. Our pipeline instruments code to capture dynamic behavior, narrates execution traces into natural language, and actively verifies each rationale against the trace. We systematically create 54,000 execution-verified, bi-directional rationales that teach models to reason both forward (input\rightarrowoutput) and backward (output\rightarrowinput). Models fine-tuned on our verified data achieve substantial improvements, with a performance boost of +24.2 on LiveCodeBench-Exec, +22.3 on CruxEval-Output, and +21.1 on CruxEval-Input, demonstrating that verification quality directly determines both reasoning and code generation capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 教会语言模型进行代码执行推理仍然是一个未解决的问题。目前用于合成思维链（CoT）训练的数据通常包含由教师模型生成的看似合理的解释，而这些解释并不能真实反映程序的实际情况。这就导致模型在语法正确的情况下，仍然会学习出逻辑上有缺陷的推理模式。我们通过将CoT生成直接基于程序执行轨迹来解决这个问题。我们的方法包括：利用工具捕获动态行为，将执行轨迹转化为自然语言，并主动验证每个推理结果与执行轨迹的一致性。我们系统地创建了54,000个经过执行验证的双向推理示例，这些示例能够教会模型进行正向（输入→输出）和反向（输出→输入）的推理。在经过验证的数据上进行微调的模型取得了显著的改进：在LiveCodeBench-Exec测试上的性能提升了24.2%，在CruxEval-Output测试上的性能提升了22.3%，在CruxEval-Input测试上的性能提升了21.1%。这表明，验证质量直接决定了模型的推理能力和代码生成能力。

papers.title: From Relevance to Authority: Authority-aware Generative Retrieval in Web Search Engines
papers.title_zh: 从相关性到权威性：网络搜索引擎中的权威性生成式检索机制
papers.authors: Sunkyung Lee, Jihye Back, Donghyeon Jeon, Soonhwan Kwon, Moonkwon Kim, Inho Kang, Jongwuk Lee
papers.abstract: Generative information retrieval (GenIR) formulates the retrieval process as a text-to-text generation task, leveraging the vast knowledge of large language models. However, existing works primarily optimize for relevance while often overlooking document trustworthiness. This is critical in high-stakes domains like healthcare and finance, where relying solely on semantic relevance risks retrieving unreliable information. To address this, we propose an Authority-aware Generative Retriever (AuthGR), the first framework that incorporates authority into GenIR. AuthGR consists of three key components: (i) Multimodal Authority Scoring, which employs a vision-language model to quantify authority from textual and visual cues; (ii) a Three-stage Training Pipeline to progressively instill authority awareness into the retriever; and (iii) a Hybrid Ensemble Pipeline for robust deployment. Offline evaluations demonstrate that AuthGR successfully enhances both authority and accuracy, with our 3B model matching a 14B baseline. Crucially, large-scale online A/B tests and human evaluations conducted on the commercial web search platform confirm significant improvements in real-world user engagement and reliability.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式信息检索（GenIR）将检索过程表述为文本到文本的生成任务，利用大语言模型的丰富知识。然而，现有的研究主要专注于相关性优化，却常常忽视文档的可靠性问题。在医疗和金融等高风险领域，仅依赖语义相关性可能会检索到不可靠的信息。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种具有权威感知功能的生成式检索器（AuthGR），这是首个将权威因素纳入GenIR框架的模型。AuthGR由三个关键组件构成：(i) 多模态权威评分机制，该机制利用视觉-语言模型来从文本和视觉线索中量化权威性；(ii) 三阶段训练流程，逐步将权威意识融入检索器中；(iii) 混合集成部署方案，以实现稳健的检索效果。离线评估表明，AuthGR成功提升了权威性和准确性，我们的3B模型与14B基准模型性能相当。重要的是，在商业网络搜索平台上进行的大规模在线A/B测试以及人工评估都证实了该模型在提升用户参与度和可靠性方面取得了显著成效。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Enhancing Online Recruitment with Category-Aware MoE and LLM-based Data Augmentation
papers.title_zh: 通过考虑类别特性的机器学习算法和基于大语言模型的数据增强技术，提升在线招聘的效果
papers.authors: Minping Chen, Bing Xu, Zulong Chen, Chuanfei Xu, Ying Zhou, Zui Tao, Zeyi Wen
papers.abstract: Person-Job Fit (PJF) is a critical component for online recruitment. Existing approaches face several challenges, particularly in handling low-quality job descriptions and similar candidate-job pairs, which impair model performance. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a large language model (LLM) based method with two novel techniques: (1) LLM-based data augmentation, which polishes and rewrites low-quality job descriptions by leveraging chain-of-thought (COT) prompts, and (2) category-aware Mixture of Experts (MoE) that assists in identifying similar candidate-job pairs. This MoE module incorporates category embeddings to dynamically assign weights to the experts and learns more distinguishable patterns for similar candidate-job pairs. We perform offline evaluations and online A/B tests on our recruitment platform. Our method relatively surpasses existing methods by 2.40% in AUC and 7.46% in GAUC, and boosts click-through conversion rate (CTCVR) by 19.4% in online tests, saving millions of CNY in external headhunting expenses.
papers.abstract_zh: 人员与职位匹配度是在线招聘中的一个关键指标。现有的方法面临着诸多挑战，尤其是在处理质量较低的职位描述以及相似的人才-职位配对时，这些因素都会影响模型的性能。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的方法，该方法包含两种创新技术：(1) 基于大语言模型的数据增强技术，通过利用思维链提示来改进和重新编写质量较低的职位描述；(2) 类别感知的混合专家模型，该模型有助于识别相似的人才-职位配对。该混合专家模块结合了类别嵌入技术，能够动态为各个专家分配权重，从而更好地识别相似的人才-职位配对。我们在招聘平台上进行了离线评估以及在线A/B测试。结果表明，我们的方法在AUC指标上比现有方法高出2.40%，在GAUC指标上高出7.46%。此外，在在线测试中，我们的方法还将点击转化率提升了19.4%，同时节省了数百万人民币的外部猎头服务费用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EfficientTool: A Cost-Effective Aligning Framework for Tool-Conditioned Agents in SME Scenarios
papers.title_zh: EfficientTool：一种适用于中小企业场景的、成本效益高的工具整合框架
papers.authors: Yuanqi Mu, Bingfeng Pi, Defei Xia, Lei Zuo, Yongqi Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in downstream industries, yet aligning proprietary agents remains challenging due to limited high-quality data and hardware constraints in small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).We propose EfficientTool, a cost-effective, tool-conditioned alignment framework forming a closed loop over data collection, iterative training, and deployment-oriented evaluation.EfficientTool adopts a self-evolving bootstrapping-based Trajectory Collection Pipeline for high-quality trajectory generation, followed by iterative Model Training Pipeline using tool-conditioned parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT).We evaluate the model with Interaction and Evaluation Pipeline in public and private benchmarks, and deploy for an internal enterprise agent.Results show that EfficientTool effectively aligns model in SME scenarios while preserving general tool-calling capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在下游行业中得到了越来越多的应用，但由于中小型企业中高质量数据的有限以及硬件资源的限制，让这些模型与专有代理对齐仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了EfficientTool这一成本效益高的工具条件对齐框架，该框架涵盖了数据收集、迭代训练以及部署导向的评估等环节。EfficientTool采用了一种自进化的引导式轨迹收集流程来生成高质量的轨迹数据，随后通过工具条件化的参数高效微调方法进行迭代模型训练。我们在公共和私有基准测试中对该模型进行了评估，并将其应用于一家内部企业的代理系统中。结果表明，EfficientTool能够在保持通用调用能力的同时，有效实现中小型企业场景中的模型对齐。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Unleashing Low-Bit Inference on Ascend NPUs: A Comprehensive Evaluation of HiFloat Formats
papers.title_zh: 在Ascend NPU上实现低位推理：对HiFloat格式的全面评估
papers.authors: Pengxiang Zhao, Hui-Ling Zhen, Xing Li, Han Bao, Weizhe Lin, Zhiyuan Yang, Yu Zi Wei, Xin Wang, Mingxuan Yuan, Xianzhi Yu, Zhenhua Dong
papers.abstract: As LLMs scale, low-bit floating-point formats like MXFP and NVFP4 offer new opportunities for precision and efficiency. In this work, we evaluate HiFloat (HiF8 and HiF4), a family of formats tailored for Ascend NPUs. Through rigorous comparison across weight-activation and KV-cache tasks, we provide three key insights: (1) INT8 suits narrow-range data, while floating-point formats excel with high-variance data; (2) in 4-bit regimes, HiF4’s hierarchical scaling prevents the accuracy collapse seen in integer formats; and (3) HiFloat is fully compatible with state-of-the-art post-training quantization frameworks. Overall, HiFloat provides a solution for high-efficiency LLM inference on NPUs.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型规模的扩大，像MXFP和NVFP4这样的低位浮点格式为精确性和效率带来了新的机会。在这项研究中，我们评估了HiFloat（包括HIF8和HIF4），这是一种专为Ascend NPU设计的浮点格式。通过在不同权重激活和KV缓存任务中进行严格对比，我们得到了三个重要发现：(1) INT8适用于范围较窄的数据，而浮点格式则更适合处理高方差数据；(2)在4位制下，HIF4的层次化缩放机制避免了整数格式所出现的精度下降问题；(3)HiFloat完全兼容最先进的训练后量化框架。总体而言，HiFloat为在NPU上进行高效的大语言模型推理提供了解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Securing the Tool Layer: A Threat Taxonomy and Runtime Defense Framework for Model Context Protocol Deployments
papers.title_zh: 保护工具层：针对模型上下文协议部署的威胁分类与运行时防御框架
papers.authors: Saurabh Yergattikar
papers.abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has rapidly emerged as the dominant standard for connecting large language models to external tools, databases, and services. Yet this convenience introduces a fundamentally new attack surface that existing LLM safety measures fail to address: adversaries can now compromise AI agents not through the user prompt, but through the tools the agent trusts. We present ShieldMCP, a runtime security framework grounded in two contributions. First, we introduce a structured threat taxonomy derived from analysis of 80+ attack techniques catalogued under the SAFE-MCP initiative within the Linux Foundation’s OpenSSF, spanning 14 tactical categories adapted from the MITRE ATT CK methodology. Second, we describe an interception architecture that performs real-time validation of MCP tool calls and responses, combining structural analysis with semantic intent verification to detect tool poisoning, indirect prompt injection through tool outputs, and supply chain manipulation. In red-team evaluation across five popular LLM backends, ShieldMCP reduces attack success rates from 74% to under 9% for tool poisoning and from 47% to under 6% for indirect prompt injection via tool responses, while adding fewer than 120ms of median latency per tool call. We discuss deployment considerations, the tension between security and agent utility, and lessons applicable to any organization integrating MCP into production workflows. Our framework is categorized as an Emerging system intended for real-world deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）迅速成为连接大语言模型与外部工具、数据库和服务的主要标准。然而，这种便利性引入了一个全新的攻击面，现有的LLM安全措施无法应对这一问题：攻击者现在可以通过AI代理所信任的工具来攻击它，而不是通过用户的提示。我们提出了ShieldMCP这一运行时安全框架，该框架基于两项创新成果构建。首先，我们提出了一套结构化的威胁分类体系，该分类体系源自对Linux基金会OpenSSF下的SAFE-MCP项目中所记录的80多种攻击技术的分析，涵盖了从MITRE ATT CK方法中提取出的14个战术类别。其次，我们描述了一种拦截架构，它能够实时验证MCP工具的调用和响应，结合结构分析和语义意图验证来检测工具中毒、通过工具输出进行的间接提示注入以及供应链操纵行为。在针对五种常见LLM后端的红队评估中，ShieldMCP将工具中毒的攻击成功率从74%降低到低于9%，而通过工具响应进行的间接提示注入的成功率则从47%降低到低于6%。同时，每个工具调用的平均延迟时间减少了不到120毫秒。我们还讨论了部署方面的考虑因素、安全性与代理功能之间的平衡问题，以及适用于任何将MCP集成到生产工作流程中的组织的经验教训。我们的框架被归类为“新兴系统”，适用于实际部署场景。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Enhancing Job Evaluation with Data Augmentation and Text Classification
papers.title_zh: 通过数据增强和文本分类技术提升职位评估的准确性
papers.authors: Samaneh Jalilian, Niels van Weeren, Mohammad Shokri, Thijmen Bijl, Suzan Verberne
papers.abstract: Accurate job grading and evaluation are essential for ensuring fair compensation in Human Resources (HR) planning. In this research, we propose to improve job evaluation by semi-automating a manual, time-consuming, and inconsistent process with text-based classification models. We address three prediction tasks: job title classification, grading, and compensation prediction. For job title classification, we fine-tune a RoBERTa model for classification and use Gemini to generate synthetic job descriptions for rare job titles. For grade and compensation prediction, we compare TF-IDF and transformer-based embeddings (DistilRoBERTa, MPNet, MiniLM) in combination with deep neural networks and tree-based models (Random Forest, XGBoost). We optimize all models using grid search with hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation. The results show that job title classification by RoBERTa with Gemini-generated descriptions works well with an accuracy of about 97%. In our regression experiments, our models get promising results: for grade prediction, a tuned TF-IDF + XGBoost model achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.185, and for annual salary prediction, MiniLM embeddings with XGBoost get an MAE of €1,587. These findings demonstrate that a semi-automated pipeline can enhance traditional manual processes by boosting consistency, speeding up HR workflows, and reducing biased assessments.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确的工作等级划分和评估对于在人力资源规划中确保公平薪酬至关重要。在这项研究中，我们提出通过采用基于文本的分类模型来半自动化处理这一耗时且不一致的工作评估流程，从而改进工作评估工作。我们承担了三个预测任务：职位名称分类、等级划分以及薪酬预测。在职位名称分类方面，我们优化了RoBERTa模型用于分类，并使用Gemini生成罕见职位的合成职位描述。在等级和薪酬预测方面，我们比较了TF-IDF和基于Transformer的嵌入方式（如DistilRoBERTa、MPNet、MiniLM），并结合深度神经网络和树状模型（如随机森林、XGBoost）进行建模。我们通过网格搜索和超参数调整以及交叉验证来优化所有模型。实验结果表明，使用RoBERTa模型结合Gemini生成的职位描述进行职位名称分类的准确率达到了约97%。在回归实验中，我们的模型取得了令人满意的结果：在等级预测方面，经过调整的TF-IDF + XGBoost模型的均绝对误差为0.185；在年薪预测方面，使用MiniLM嵌入方式和XGBoost模型的均绝对误差为1,587欧元。这些发现表明，半自动化的流程可以通过提高一致性、加快人力资源工作流程以及减少偏见评估来提高传统手动流程的效率。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When Good OCR Is Not Enough: Benchmarking OCR Robustness for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 当良好的OCR效果并不足够时：针对检索增强生成模型的OCR鲁棒性评估
papers.authors: Lin Sun, Wangdexian, Jingang Huang, Linglin Zhang, Change Jia, Zhengwei Cheng, Xiangzheng Zhang
papers.abstract: Industrial Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems depend on optical character recognition (OCR) to transform visual documents into text. Existing OCR benchmarks rely on character-level metrics, which inadequately measure downstream RAG effectiveness under real-world conditions. We introduce an OCR benchmark for industrial RAG systems covering 11 challenging document types, including extreme layouts, high-resolution pages, complex or watermarked backgrounds, historical documents with non-standard reading orders, visually decorated text, and documents containing tables and mathematical formulas. Evaluating recent SOTA OCR models under a controlled OCR-first RAG pipeline shows clear performance degradation on realistic industrial documents despite strong conventional benchmark scores. We find that high OCR accuracy does not necessarily translate into strong downstream RAG performance: structural and semantic errors can cause substantial retrieval failures even when WER/CER remains low. Further analysis shows that this mismatch is category-dependent, arises through both retrieval-side and downstream generation-side failures, and remains stable across representative OCR-first pipeline choices. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/Qihoo360/InduOCRBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 工业检索增强生成（RAG）系统依赖于光学字符识别技术，将视觉文档转换为文本。现有的OCR评估基准主要基于字符级指标，但这些指标无法充分反映实际环境下RAG系统的性能。我们为工业RAG系统开发了一个OCR评估基准，涵盖了11种具有挑战性的文档类型，包括极端布局的文档、高分辨率页面、带有复杂背景或水印的文档、具有非标准阅读顺序的历史文档、带有视觉装饰的文本，以及包含表格和数学公式的文档。在受控的“先OCR后RAG”流程下对最新流行的OCR模型进行评估时，我们发现尽管这些模型在传统的基准测试中的表现优异，但在真实的工业文档上却出现了明显的性能下降。我们发现，较高的OCR识别准确率并不一定能带来良好的RAG性能：即使误识率/语义错误率保持较低水平，结构性和语义性错误仍可能导致严重的检索失败。进一步分析表明，这种不匹配现象取决于具体类别，它既源于检索端的问题，也源于生成端的问题，并且这种不匹配在多种代表性的“先OCR后RAG”流程选择中仍然存在。该评估基准可在此链接上免费获取：https://github.com/Qihoo360/InduOCRBench
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Aggregate vs. Personalized Judges in Business Idea Evaluation: Evidence from Expert Disagreement
papers.title_zh: 在商业创意评估中，采用整体评价方式还是个性化评价方式：专家意见不一致的证据
papers.authors: Wataru Hirota, Tomoki Taniguchi, Tomoko Ohkuma, Kosuke Takahashi, Takahiro Omi, Kosuke Arima, Takuto Asakura, Chung-Chi Chen, Tatsuya Ishigaki
papers.abstract: Evaluating LLM-generated business ideas is often harder to scale than generating them.Unlike standard NLP benchmarks, business idea evaluation relies on multi-dimensional criteria such as feasibility, novelty, differentiation, user need, and market size, and expert judgments often disagree.This paper studies a methodological question raised by such disagreement: should an automatic judge approximate an aggregate consensus, or model evaluators individually?We introduce PBIG-DATA, a dataset of approximately 3,000 individual scores across 300 patent-grounded product ideas, provided by domain experts on six business-oriented dimensions:specificity, technical validity, innovativeness, competitive advantage, need validity, and market size.Analyses show substantial expert disagreement on fine-grained ordinal scores, while agreement is higher under coarse selection, suggesting structured heterogeneity rather than random noise.We then compare three judge configurations: a rubric-only zero-shot judge, an aggregate judge conditioned on mixed evaluator histories, and a personalized judge conditioned on the target evaluator’s scoring history.Across dimensions and model sizes, personalized judges align more closely with the corresponding evaluator than aggregate judges, and evaluator agreement correlates with similarity of judge-generated reasoning only under personalized conditioning.These results indicate that pooled labels can be a fragile target in pluralistic evaluation settings and motivate evaluator-conditioned judge designs for business idea assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估由大语言模型生成的企业想法往往比生成这些想法要困难得多。与标准的自然语言处理基准测试不同，企业想法的评估需要考虑多个维度，如可行性、新颖性、差异化、用户需求以及市场规模等。然而，专家们的判断常常存在分歧。本文探讨了这种分歧所引发的一个方法论问题：应该让自动评分器得出一个综合共识，还是分别对每个模型进行评估呢？我们提出了PBIG-DATA数据集，该数据集包含约3000个个人评分结果，涉及300个基于专利的产品想法。这些评分由领域专家在六个商业相关维度上进行评估：特异性、技术有效性、创新性、竞争优势、需求有效性以及市场规模。分析结果显示，专家们对于细粒度的序数评分存在较大分歧，而在粗略选择的情况下，专家们的一致性更高，这表明存在结构化的异质性，而非随机的噪声。接着，我们比较了三种评分配置：仅使用评分标准的零样本评分器、基于混合评估者历史记录的综合评分器，以及基于目标评估者评分历史的个性化评分器。在不同维度和模型规模下，个性化评分器与相应评估者的匹配度更高；而评估者之间的一致性仅在个性化条件下才与评分器生成的推理结果相似。这些结果表明，在多元化的评估环境中，汇总后的标签可能是一个不稳定的目标，因此有必要设计基于评估者条件的评分器来评估企业想法。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Structured Backpropagation for On-Device LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 一种高效的结构化反向传播算法，适用于设备上的大语言模型微调
papers.authors: JuneYoung Park, Yuri Hong, Seongwan Kim, Jaeho Lee
papers.abstract: On-device fine-tuning enables privacy-preserving personalization of large language models, but mobile devices impose severe memory constraints, typically 6–12GB shared across all workloads. Existing approaches force a trade-off between exact gradients with high memory (MeBP) and low memory with noisy estimates (MeZO). We propose Memory-efficient Structured Backpropagation (MeSP), which bridges this gap by manually deriving backward passes that exploit LoRA’s low-rank structure. Our key insight is that the intermediate projection h = xA can be recomputed during backward at minimal cost since rank r \ll d_{in}, eliminating the need to store it. MeSP achieves 49% average memory reduction compared to MeBP on Qwen2.5 models (0.5B–3B) while computing mathematically identical gradients. Our analysis also reveals that MeZO’s gradient estimates show near-zero correlation with true gradients (cosine similarity \approx0.001), explaining its slow convergence. MeSP reduces peak memory from 361MB to 136MB for Qwen2.5-0.5B, enabling fine-tuning scenarios previously infeasible on memory-constrained devices.
papers.abstract_zh: 在设备上进行微调可以实现对大语言模型的隐私保护式个性化处理，但移动设备面临着严重的内存限制，通常所有工作负载共享的可用内存仅为6–12GB。现有的方法需要在高内存消耗（MeBP）与低内存消耗但估计值存在噪声（MeZO）之间做出权衡。我们提出了一种内存高效的结构化反向传播算法（MeSP），该算法通过手动推导反向传播过程来利用LoRA的低秩结构，从而弥补了这一差距。我们的关键洞察是：由于rank r远小于d_in，因此可以在反向传播过程中重新计算中间投影h = xA，而无需存储它。与MeBP相比，MeSP在Qwen2.5模型（0.5B–3B参数数量）上实现了49%的平均内存减少，同时计算的梯度仍然完全一致。我们的分析还表明，MeZO的梯度估计值与真实梯度的相关性几乎为零（余弦相似度约为0.001），这解释了其收敛速度较慢的原因。对于Qwen2.5-0.5B模型，MeSP将峰值内存从361MB降低至136MB，使得在内存受限的设备上进行微调成为可能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Terminology-Constrained Machine Translation in Industrial Localization
papers.title_zh: 用于术语约束机器翻译的多智能体调度技术——在工业本地化中的应用
papers.authors: Emanuele Di Rosa
papers.abstract: Accurate terminology is a non-negotiable requirement in industrial localization processes: a single mistranslated domain term can violate contractual obligations and erode client trust.We present AIDA\textsubscript{term}, a deployed multi-agent LLM pipeline that orchestrates four specialized agents—Analysis, Translation, Post-editing, and Review—for terminology-constrained machine translation.The system introduces terminology-aware pre-analysis, explicit glossary injection at every pipeline stage, and a reasoning-enabled Review agent.We evaluate six configurations on the WMT25 Terminology Translation benchmark (Track 1: en\tode/es/ru, IT domain), enabling systematic ablation of each design choice.Our best configuration achieves 99.4% average terminology accuracy while attaining the highest ChrF2++ scores across all three language pairs, outperforming all 20 systems submitted to the shared task.Unlike other multi-agent approaches in WMT25 that rely on generate-and-select strategies, AIDA\textsubscript{term} is the first to apply a role-specialized sequential pipeline to terminology-constrained MT, and is deployed with native XLIFF integration for seamless CAT tool interoperability.The system processes thousands of terminology-constrained requests daily at a large localization provider.
papers.abstract_zh: 在工业本地化过程中，准确的术语选择是一个不可妥协的要求：一个翻译错误的术语可能会违反合同义务，并损害客户的信任。我们提出了AIDA\textsubscript{term}这一多智能体LLM解决方案，该方案由四个专业智能体组成——分析、翻译、编辑和审核——用于解决术语限制下的机器翻译问题。该系统引入了基于术语的分析预处理、在每个处理阶段进行术语表插入的功能，以及具备推理能力的审核智能体。我们在WMT25术语翻译基准测试上评估了六种配置方案（第1组：英语/西班牙语/俄语，IT领域），从而能够系统地分析每种设计方案的优缺点。我们的最佳配置达到了99.4%的平均术语准确率，同时在所有三种语言对中都取得了最高的ChrF2++分数，优于所有参与该任务的20个系统。与WMT25中其他依赖生成与选择策略的多智能体方法不同，AIDA\textsubscript{term}是第一个采用角色专业化顺序流程来处理术语限制下的机器翻译问题的方案。该系统还实现了与XLIFF的集成，确保了与CAT工具的无缝协作。该系统每天能够处理数千个涉及术语限制的问题，其应用范围覆盖了许多大型本地化服务提供商。

papers.title: TrendPulse: A Simple yet Efficient Framework for Capturing Viral E-Commerce Spikes via LLM-Driven Contextualization
papers.title_zh: TrendPulse：一个简单而高效的框架，通过基于大语言模型的上下文处理技术，能够捕捉到电子商务领域的快速增长趋势
papers.authors: Arin Jain, Devashish Gupta, Bhavuk Singhal, Divay Jindal, Vinit Rongata, Ravindra Kumar Yadav
papers.abstract: Anticipating and capturing transient demand spikes is a critical challenge for e-commerce platforms, as reactive discovery mechanisms often fail to surface relevant products during rapid cultural or seasonal shifts. We propose TrendPulse, a three-stage framework that identifies regional search momentum, leverages Large Language Model (LLM) to transform spikes into semantic trends, and employs a cross-attention mechanism to provide personalized catalog recommendations. Our comprehensive ablation experiments and evaluations validate the impact of each architectural component, showing consistent improvements across multiple critical business metrics. TrendPulse’s effectiveness is further validated through online A/B experiments, where it drives measurable gains in both business metrics and overall user experience. Finally, we outlined the deployment strategy in detail, providing a reproducible blueprint that can be readily applied to similar industry-scale applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 预测并抓住短暂的需求高峰是电子商务平台面临的一项关键挑战。因为传统的发现机制在文化或季节的快速变化中往往无法及时找到相关产品。我们提出了TrendPulse这一三阶段框架：首先识别区域性的搜索趋势；其次利用大语言模型将短暂的需求高峰转化为语义化的趋势；最后通过交叉注意力机制提供个性化的商品推荐。我们通过全面的实验和评估验证了每个架构组件的有效性，结果显示它在多个关键业务指标上都取得了显著的提升。TrendPulse的有效性还通过在线A/B测试得到了验证，它显著提升了业务指标和整体用户体验。最后，我们详细描述了该系统的部署策略，提供了一个可复制的蓝图，可以轻松应用于类似的行业规模应用中。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ACRM: Multi-Agent Trajectory Learning for Automated Credit Risk Model Refreshing in Production
papers.title_zh: ACRM：多智能体轨迹学习，用于在生产环境中自动更新信用风险模型
papers.authors: Liangzu Liu, Mengzhe Ruan, Xiaotian Chen, HaonanChen, XudongNiu, Wendi Yuan, YuechenLi, Yang Liu, Guanjun Wang
papers.abstract: Credit risk models suffer from rapid performance decay due to distribution shifts, requiring frequent updates to meet strict operational guardrails. However, manual refreshing takes weeks of trial-and-error across upstream data engineering and downstream training. We present ACRM, a deployed multi-agent framework that automates the end-to-end credit modeling workflow by treating it as a learnable trajectory of agent interactions. Unlike AutoML, which optimizes hyperparameters on fixed datasets, ACRM’s action space extends to upstream data semantics—cohort selection, observation windowing, feature screening—where the majority of performance recovery occurs. A central Orchestrator coordinates specialist agents through a three-stream decision stack: rule-based safety guardrails, retrieval-augmented grounding from historical workflows, and preference alignment via DPO on expert-labeled trajectories. Deployed at a major fintech institution for three months across six business scenarios, ACRM reduced the average model refresh cycle from weeks to 1.1 days and iteration rounds by 65%, while maintaining superior stability metrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 信用风险模型由于分布变化而出现性能迅速下降的问题，因此需要频繁更新才能满足严格的运营要求。然而，手动更新需要花费数周时间进行反复试验，涉及上游数据工程和下游训练环节。我们提出了ACRM这一多智能体框架，它能够通过自动化处理智能体交互的整个过程来提升信用建模的效率。与在固定数据集上优化超参数的AutoML不同，ACRM的动作空间涵盖了上游数据的语义特征——群体选择、观测窗口设置、特征筛选等，这些环节往往是性能恢复的关键所在。一个中央协调器负责协调各个智能体，通过三个流程来做出决策：基于规则的安全保障机制、从历史工作流程中提取的辅助信息、以及通过DPO对专家标记的轨迹进行偏好调整。该框架在一个重要的金融科技机构中进行了三个月的应用测试，在六个业务场景中，平均模型更新周期从几周缩短到1.1天，迭代次数也减少了65%，同时保持了出色的稳定性指标。

papers.title: From 2:4 to 8:16 sparsity patterns in LLMs for Outliers and Weights with Variance Correction
papers.title_zh: 在2:04到8:16之间，带有方差修正的LLM中，异常值和不同权重所导致的稀疏性模式
papers.authors: Egor Maximov, Yulia Kuzkina, Egor Shvetsov, Azamat Kanametov, Aleksandr Prutko, Maxim Zhelnin, Aleksei Goncharov
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) grow in size, efficient compression techniques like quantization and sparsification are critical. While quantization maintains performance with reduced precision, structured sparsity methods, such as N:M sparsification, often fall short due to limited flexibility and sensitivity to outlier weights. We explore 8:16 semi-structured sparsity, demonstrating its ability to surpass the Performance Threshold—where a compressed model matches the accuracy of its uncompressed or smaller counterpart under equivalent memory constraints. Compared to 2:4 sparsity, 8:16 offers greater flexibility with minimal storage overhead (0.875 vs. 0.75 bits/element). We also apply sparse structured patterns for salient weights, showing that structured sparsity for outliers is competitive with unstructured approaches, leading to equivalent or better results. Finally, we demonstrate that simple techniques such as variance correction and SmoothQuant-like weight equalization improve sparse models performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）规模的扩大，高效的压缩技术如量化和稀疏化变得至关重要。虽然量化可以在降低精度的同时保持性能，但诸如N:M稀疏化这样的结构化稀疏化方法，往往因灵活性有限以及对异常权重敏感而表现不佳。我们研究了8:16半结构化稀疏化方法，证明它能够超越性能阈值——即在一个压缩模型在相同的内存限制下，其准确性与未压缩或更小规模的模型相当。与2:4稀疏化相比，8:16提供了更大的灵活性，同时存储开销极小（0.875比特/元素对比0.75比特/元素）。我们还应用了针对显著权重的稀疏结构模式，结果表明，对于异常值而言，结构化稀疏化与非结构化方法具有竞争力，能够取得相当甚至更好的效果。最后，我们证明了诸如方差校正和类似SmoothQuant的权重均衡等简单技术能够提升稀疏模型的性能。

papers.title: An Efficient Framework for Whole-Page Reranking via Single-Modal Supervision
papers.title_zh: 一种高效的整页重新排序框架，仅需单一模式进行监督处理
papers.authors: Zishuai Zhang, Sihao Yu, Xiewenyi, Ying Nie, Junfeng Wang, Zhiming Zheng, Dawei Yin, Hainan Zhang
papers.abstract: The whole-page reranking integrates retrieval results from multiple modalities and is critical for user experience of search engines, yet it requires costly large-scale expert annotations due to the complexity of assessing cross-modal relevances. In this paper, we propose SMAR, a novel whole-page reranking framework that converts single-modal rankers into page-level guidance by constructing budget-aware candidates for cross modal annotations and distilling intra-modality preferences to align relevance scales across modalities. Specifically, we use pre-trained single-modal rankers to construct candidate pages for limited cross-modal annotation at the page level. The whole-page reranker is then trained on these samples, enforcing consistency with single-modal preferences to preserve intra-modal ranking quality. Experiments on the Qilin and CrossRank datasets demonstrate that SMAR reduces annotation costs by 70-90% while outperforming the fully-annotated reranking baselines. Further offline and online A/B tests confirm significant gains in both ranking metrics and user experience, validating the effectiveness and practical value of our approach in real-world search scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 整页重新排序功能能够整合来自多种模态的检索结果，对搜索引擎的用户体验至关重要。然而，由于评估跨模态相关性的复杂性，这种功能需要耗费大量的人力来标注大规模的数据。在本文中，我们提出了SMAR这一新型整页重新排序框架。该框架通过将单一模态的排序结果转化为页面级别的指导信息，从而构建出兼顾预算限制的跨模态标注候选页面。同时，该框架还能提取各模态内部的偏好信息，以调整不同模态之间的相关性尺度。具体来说，我们使用预训练的单一模态排序器来生成用于跨模态标注的候选页面。随后，整页重新排序器在这些样本上进行训练，从而确保与单一模态的偏好保持一致，进而保持各模态内部排序的质量。在Qilin和CrossRank数据集上的实验表明，SMAR能够将标注成本降低70%-90%，同时其性能优于那些完全经过标注的重新排序基线方法。进一步的离线和在线A/B测试也证实了该方法在排名指标和用户体验方面取得了显著改善，这充分证明了我们的方法在现实搜索场景中的有效性和实用性。

papers.title: LLM as a Risk Manager: LLM Semantic Filtering for Lead–Lag Trading in Prediction Markets
papers.title_zh: 作为风险管理员的LLM：利用LLM的语义过滤技术进行预测市场中的领先-滞后交易策略
papers.authors: Sumin Kim, Minjae Kim, Jihoon Kwon, Yoon Kim, Oscar Levy, Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Yongjae Lee, Chanyeol Choi
papers.abstract: Prediction markets provide a unique setting where event-level time series are directly tied to natural-language descriptions, yet discovering robust lead–lag relationships remains challenging due to spurious statistical correlations. We propose a hybrid two-stage causal screener to address this challenge: (i) a statistical stage that uses Granger causality to identify candidate leader–follower pairs from market-implied probability time series, and (ii) an LLM-based semantic stage that re-ranks these candidates by assessing whether the proposed direction admits a plausible economic transmission mechanism based on event descriptions. Because causal ground truth is unobserved, we evaluate the ranked pairs using a fixed, signal-triggered trading protocol that maps relationship quality into realized profit and loss (PnL).On Kalshi Economics markets, our hybrid approach consistently outperforms the statistical baseline. Across rolling evaluations, the win rate increases from 51.4% to 54.5%. Crucially, the average magnitude of losing trades decreases substantially from 649 USD to 347 USD. This reduction is driven by the LLM’s ability to filter out statistically fragile links that are prone to large losses, rather than relying on rare gains. These improvements remain stable across different trading configurations, indicating that the gains are not driven by specific parameter choices. Overall, the results suggest that LLMs function as semantic risk managers on top of statistical discovery, prioritizing lead–lag relationships that generalize under changing market conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 预测市场提供了一个独特的环境，在这个环境中，事件级时间序列直接与自然语言描述相关联。然而，由于虚假的统计相关性，发现稳健的领先-滞后关系仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种混合的两阶段因果筛选方法来应对这一挑战：第一阶段是统计阶段，利用格兰杰因果关系从市场暗示的概率时间序列中识别出潜在的领导者-追随者对；第二阶段是基于大语言模型的语义阶段，该阶段通过评估所提出的方向是否具备合理的经济传导机制，从而对这些候选对进行重新排序。由于因果真相无法被观测到，我们使用一种固定的、信号触发的交易协议来评估这些排序后的对，该协议将关系质量转化为实际盈亏。在Kalshi经济学市场上，我们的混合方法始终优于统计基线方法。在连续的评估中，胜率从51.4%上升到54.5%。重要的是，亏损交易的平均规模显著减少，从649美元降至347美元。这种减少得益于大语言模型能够过滤掉那些容易导致巨大损失的统计上脆弱的关联，而不是依赖于罕见的收益。这些改进在不同交易配置下保持稳定，表明收益并非由特定的参数选择所驱动。总体而言，结果表明，大语言模型在统计发现的基础上发挥了语义风险管理的功能，优先处理在变化的市场条件下仍然有效的领先-滞后关系。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Diffusion-Pretrained Dense and Contextual Embeddings
papers.title_zh: 扩散预训练的密集嵌入与上下文嵌入
papers.authors: Sedigheh Eslami, Maksim Gaiduk, Markus Krimmel, Louis Mark Milliken, Bo Wang, Denis Bykov
papers.abstract: We introduce pplx-embed, a family of multilingual embedding models that employ multi-stage contrastive learning on a diffusion-pretrained language model backbone for web-scale retrieval.By leveraging bidirectional attention through diffusion-based pretraining, our models capture comprehensive bidirectional context within passages, enabling the use of mean pooling to better preserve global context across long documents.We release pplx-embed-v1 for standard retrieval, and pplx-embed-context-v1 for contextualized embeddings that incorporate global document context into passage representations.pplx-embed-v1 achieves competitive performance on the MTEB(Multilingual, v2), MTEB(Code), BERGEN, and ToolRet retrieval benchmarks, while pplx-embed-context-v1 sets new records on the ConTEB benchmark.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了pplx-embed系列多语言嵌入模型，这些模型采用多阶段对比学习技术，基于扩散预训练的语言模型框架来实现大规模检索任务。通过利用基于扩散训练的双向注意力机制，我们的模型能够捕捉文本中的全面双向上下文信息，从而使用均值池化方法更好地保留长文档的整体上下文信息。我们发布了用于标准检索的pplx-embed-v1版本，以及用于将全局文档上下文融入段落表示的pplx-embed-context-v1版本。pplx-embed-v1在MTEB（多语言，v2版）、MTEB（代码版）、BERGEN和ToolRet等检索基准测试中取得了具有竞争力的性能，而pplx-embed-context-v1则在ConTEB基准测试中创下了新的记录。

papers.title: Actionable Interpretability for Churn Classification: A Text Bottleneck Model Case Study at a Major Telecom Provider
papers.title_zh: 适用于流失用户分类的可操作可解释性方法：以一家主要电信公司的案例研究为例
papers.authors: Adrian Sauter, Vera Neplenbroek, Georgios Vlassopoulos, Gianluigi Bardelloni
papers.abstract: In subscription-based businesses, understanding why a customer intends to churn is as vital as the classification itself. We present a casestudy at a large European telecommunications provider, where we implement Text Bottleneck Models (TBMs) for post-call churn classifica-tion. The TBM distills dialogues into a sparse set of human-interpretable concepts and provides faithful, snippet-based evidence for everydecision. We show that the TBM performs competitively with black-box baselines and demonstrate potential business impact via automatedcall profiling and an interactive stakeholder dashboard. Our work demonstrates that the perceived trade-off between interpretability andpredictive performance can be bridged, providing the high-accuracy evidence needed for industrial retention strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 在基于订阅的业务中，了解客户为何想要流失客户与分类本身同样重要。我们以一个欧洲大型电信供应商的案例进行研究，在该案例中，我们采用了文本瓶颈模型来进行售后流失客户的分类。该模型将对话内容提炼成一组易于人类理解的概念，并为每个决策提供可靠的、基于片段的证据。我们发现，该模型的性能与黑盒基线模型相当，并且通过自动呼叫分析和交互式利益相关者仪表板，展示了其潜在的商业价值。我们的研究表明，可以在可解释性和预测性能之间找到平衡点，从而为企业的保留策略提供高精度的依据。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Decoding Text Spans for Efficient and Accurate Named-Entity Recognition
papers.title_zh: 解码文本区间，以实现高效且准确的命名实体识别
papers.authors: Andrea Maracani, Savas Ozkan, Junyi Zhu, Sinan Mutlu, Mete Ozay
papers.abstract: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a key component in industrial information extraction pipelines, where systems must satisfy strict latency and throughput constraints in addition to strong accuracy. State-of-the-art NER accuracy is often achieved by span-based frameworks, which construct span representations from token encodings and classify candidate spans. However, many span-based methods enumerate large numbers of candidates and process each candidate with marker-augmented inputs, substantially increasing inference cost and limiting scalability in large-scale deployments. In this work, we propose SpanDec, an efficient span-based NER framework that targets this bottleneck. Our main insight is that span representation interactions can be computed effectively at the final transformer stage, avoiding redundant computation in earlier layers via a lightweight decoder dedicated to span representations. We further introduce a span filtering mechanism during enumeration to prune unlikely candidates before expensive processing. Across multiple benchmarks, SpanDec matches competitive span-based baselines while improving throughput and reducing computational cost, yielding a better accuracy–efficiency trade-off suitable for high-volume serving and on-device applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 命名实体识别（NER）是工业信息提取流程中的关键组件，系统必须在满足严格的延迟和吞吐量要求的同时，保持极高的准确性。目前最先进的NER准确率通常是通过基于跨度的框架来实现的，这些框架从词元编码中构建跨度表示，并对候选跨度进行分类。然而，许多基于跨度的方法会枚举大量的候选对象，并且对每个候选对象都使用带有标记增强的输入进行处理，这大大增加了推理成本，并限制了大规模部署的可扩展性。在这项研究中，我们提出了SpanDec这一高效的基于跨度的NER框架，旨在解决这一瓶颈问题。我们的主要思路是：可以在最终transformer阶段有效计算跨度表示的相互作用，从而避免在早期层进行冗余计算，而采用一个专门用于处理跨度表示的轻量级解码器。此外，我们在枚举过程中引入了跨度过滤机制，以便在处理之前剔除不太可能的候选对象。在多个基准测试中，SpanDec在保持与同类基于跨度的基线算法相当的性能的同时，提升了吞吐量并降低了计算成本，从而实现了更好的准确率与效率平衡，非常适合高并发服务以及设备端应用。

papers.title: EVE: A Domain-Specific LLM Framework for Earth Intelligence
papers.title_zh: EVE：一种针对地球智能领域设计的大型语言模型框架
papers.authors: Àlex R. Atrio, Antonio Lopez, Jino Rohit, Yassine El Ouahidi, Marcello Politi, Vijayasri Iyer, Umar Jamil, Sébastien Bratières, Nicolas Longépé
papers.abstract: We introduce Earth Virtual Expert (EVE), the first open-source, end-to-end initiative for developing and deploying domain-specialized LLMs for Earth Intelligence. At its core is EVE-Instruct, a domain-adapted 24B model built on Mistral Small 3.2 and optimized for reasoning and question answering. On newly constructed Earth Observation and Earth Sciences benchmarks, it outperforms comparable models while preserving general capabilities.We release curated training corpora and the first systematic domain-specific evaluation benchmarks, covering MCQA, open-ended QA, and factuality. EVE further integrates RAG and a hallucination-detection pipeline into a production system deployed via API and GUI, supporting 350 pilot users. All models, datasets, and code are publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了Earth Virtual Expert（EVE），这是首个开源的端到端解决方案，旨在开发和部署适用于地球智能领域的领域特定大语言模型。其核心模块是EVE-Instruct，这是一个基于Mistral Small 3.2构建的、针对特定领域优化的240亿参数模型，专为推理和问答任务而设计。在新建的地球观测和地球科学基准测试上，该模型的性能优于同类模型，同时保留了其通用能力。我们还发布了经过精心挑选的训练数据集，以及首批系统化的领域特定评估基准，涵盖多轮问答、开放式问答以及事实性判断等方面。EVE还整合了RAG技术和幻觉检测机制，并通过API和GUI实现生产环境的部署，目前已有350名试点用户使用该系统。所有模型、数据集和代码均公开可用。

papers.title: Hemolix.TabGen: Optimized Table Generation from Documents
papers.title_zh: Hemolix.TabGen：从文档中优化表格生成的工具
papers.authors: Gyanendra Shrestha, Todor Ivanov, Karthik Vemireddy, Anna Pyayt, Michael Gubanov
papers.abstract: Modern Data Lakes contain vast and heterogeneous document collections, making table generation from documents a persistent and nontrivial challenge. Traditional approaches are often rigid — i.e. domain-specific, require extensive supervision, or are limited to set of pre-defined schemas; LLM-based approaches are more flexible, but typically suffer from hallucinations, non-determinism, and high computational costs. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Hemolix.TabGen, a novel scalable LLM-based table generation systemthat comprehends documents and generates Bi-dimensional tables based on the entire document content. We evaluated TabGen on 4 publicly available datasets spanning multiple domains and observed an Average Precision delta up to 30% compared to vanilla LLMs
papers.abstract_zh: 现代数据湖包含大量且结构各异的文档集合，因此从文档中生成表格是一项具有挑战性的任务。传统方法往往较为僵化——即只适用于特定领域，需要大量的监督工作，或者仅限于预定义的模式；而基于大语言模型的方法则更加灵活，但通常会面临幻觉、不确定性以及高计算成本等问题。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了Hemolix.TabGen这一新型的可扩展基于大语言模型的表格生成系统。该系统能够理解文档内容，并根据整个文档内容生成二维表格。我们在四个公开可用的数据集上对TabGen进行了测试，发现与传统的基于大语言模型的方法相比，其平均精度提高了多达30%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Harmonizing Dense and Sparse Signals in Multi-turn RL: Dual-Horizon Credit Assignment for Industrial Sales Agents
papers.title_zh: 在多轮RL中协调密集信号与稀疏信号：适用于工业销售代理的双视野信用分配算法
papers.authors: Haojin Yang, Ai Jian, Yiwei Wang, Xinyue Huang, Weipeng Zhang, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai, Jingqing Ruan
papers.abstract: Optimizing large language models for industrial sales requires balancing long-term commercial objectives (e.g., conversion rate) with immediate linguistic constraints such as fluency and compliance. Conventional reinforcement learning often merges these heterogeneous goals into a single reward, causing high-magnitude session-level rewards to overwhelm subtler turn-level signals, which leads to unstable training or reward hacking.To address this issue, we propose Dual-Horizon Credit Assignment (DuCA), a framework that disentangles optimization across time scales. Its core, Horizon-Independent Advantage Normalization (HIAN), separately normalizes advantages from turn-level and session-level rewards before fusion, ensuring balanced gradient contributions from both immediate and long-term objectives to the policy update.Extensive experiments with a high-fidelity user simulator show DuCA outperforms the state-of-the-art GRPO baseline, achieving a 6.82% relative improvement in conversion rate, reducing inter-sentence repetition by 82.28%, and lowering identity detection rate by 27.35%, indicating a substantial improvement for an industrial sales scenario that effectively balances the dual demands of strategic performance and naturalistic language generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了优化大语言模型以适用于工业销售场景，需要平衡长期的商业目标（如转化率）与即时性的语言约束，例如流畅性和合规性。传统的强化学习通常会将这些不同的目标合并为单一的奖励机制，这会导致高额的会话级奖励掩盖了更微妙的回合级信号，从而导致训练不稳定或奖励被操纵。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了双视野信用分配框架（Dual-Horizon Credit Assignment，DuCA）。该框架能够分离不同时间尺度上的优化过程。其核心技术是视界独立优势归一化（Horizon-Independent Advantage Normalization，HIAN），它分别对回合级和会话级奖励的优势进行归一化处理，然后再进行融合，从而确保来自即时和长期目标的梯度贡献都能均衡地影响策略更新。通过大量实验验证，DuCA在工业销售场景中表现出显著的优势：相对转化率提升了6.82%，句子间重复次数减少了82.28%，身份检测率降低了27.35%。这表明DuCA能够有效地平衡战略性能与自然语言生成之间的双重需求，为工业销售场景提供了有效的解决方案。

papers.title: Know What You See: Grounded localization of product components
papers.title_zh: 清楚自己看到的是什么：产品零部件的精准定位
papers.authors: Manan Soni, Abinesh Kanagarajan, Shyam Mohan
papers.abstract: Many real-world decisions about products (e.g. how they function, how they should be used) depend on their components rather than the object as a whole. Accurately identifying product component has applications like automated defect detection, visual spare-parts search, and verified assembly. However, existing object detectors treat components as isolated objects, ignoring their inherent structure. We propose Know What You See (KWYS), where we localize components by grounding them using a textual knowledge base (e.g., manuals or web descriptions). KWYS converts raw text into a hierarchical component taxonomy, which then guides an open-vocabulary object detector using a hierarchical verification algorithm. We evaluate on 1,000 product images across 5 diverse categories, improving component localization accuracy by 11% along with reducing component hallucinations by 25%.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中，许多关于产品的决策（例如产品的工作原理、使用方式等）都取决于其各个组件，而非整个产品本身。准确识别产品组件对于自动化缺陷检测、视觉零部件搜索以及可靠组装等操作具有重要意义。然而，现有的物体检测技术往往将组件视为独立的个体，忽略了它们固有的结构特征。我们提出了“知你所见”算法（Know What You See，KWYS），该算法通过文本知识库（如手册或网络描述）来定位组件的位置。KWYS将原始文本转化为分层化的组件分类体系，从而引导开放词汇表的物体检测器进行精确检测。我们在5000张不同类别的产品图片上进行测试，结果显示，组件定位的准确率提高了11%，同时组件误识别率也降低了25%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SCAIR: Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning for Enterprise Knowledge Graphs
papers.title_zh: SCAIR：针对企业知识图谱的基于模式条件的迭代推理机制
papers.authors: Prateek Chaturvedi, Yuqicheng Zhu, Hongkuan Zhou, Dongzhuoran Zhou, Yunjie He, Steffen Staab, Fei Du, Jie Tang, Evgeny Kharlamov
papers.abstract: Knowledge Graph–based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG) enables natural language interaction with structured enterprise knowledge, yet existing agentic approaches that perform well on public benchmarks often fail to generalize to real-world enterprise Knowledge Graphs (KGs), which are dense, schema-driven, and operationally constrained. To address these limitations, we propose SCAIR (Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning), a training-free framework that integrates structured planning with controlled iterative reasoning by injecting schema-conditioned structural priors and enforcing schema-aware traversal during multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on an enterprise-oriented benchmark constructed from a real-world Configuration Management DataBase (CMDB) demonstrate that SCAIR substantially improves performance over existing KG-RAG methods. Crucially, our study highlights that reliable enterprise graph reasoning cannot rely on generic agentic designs; instead, it must explicitly incorporate the target domain’s structural and operational constraints into the reasoning process. We demonstrate that by aligning agent design with business logic, substantial performance gains can be achieved without the need for costly model retraining.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于知识图谱的检索增强生成技术，能够实现与结构化企业知识的自然语言交互。然而，目前那些在公开基准测试中表现良好的代理式方法，往往无法适用于现实世界中的企业知识图谱——因为这些知识图谱具有高度结构化、依赖特定模式，并且存在操作上的限制。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了SCAIR这一无需训练的框架。该框架通过将结构化规划与可控的迭代推理相结合，通过注入基于模式的先验信息，并在多跳推理过程中强制执行模式感知的遍历方式，从而提升了性能。在基于真实世界配置管理数据库构建的企业级基准测试上进行的实验表明，SCAIR显著提升了性能，优于现有的基于知识图谱的检索增强生成方法。我们的研究还指出，可靠的企业图推理不能依赖于通用的代理式设计；相反，必须明确地将目标领域的结构性和操作性约束纳入推理过程。我们通过将代理设计与业务逻辑相结合，证明了无需进行昂贵的模型重新训练即可实现显著的性能提升。

papers.title: FROST: Factual Reasoning via Optimized Stochastic Trajectories in Large Language Models during Inference
papers.title_zh: 霜冻：通过优化随机路径来实现大型语言模型在推理过程中的事实推理
papers.authors: Soumedhik Bharati, Ebad Shabbir, Jiechao Gao
papers.abstract: Large language models face a trade-off between factual consistency and reasoningdiversity: deterministic decoding prioritizes reliability but may miss alternativesolution paths, while high-temperature sampling increases exploration at the costof accuracy. We present FROST (Factual Reasoning via Optimized StochasticTrajectories), an inference-time framework that balances exploration andexploitation without additional training or context augmentation. FROST combinesdeterministic inference from a large model with targeted stochastic sampling froma smaller model, selecting outputs via multi-criteria validation over coherence,factual grounding, and semantic novelty. Across HotpotQA, CommonsenseQA, andMMLU, FROST achieves 2–5 percentage point improvements over standard chain-of-thoughtprompting and reduces unsupported outputs by 40% relative to Standard CoT. Comparedto Self-Consistency ensembles, FROST delivers comparable accuracy at 28% lowerinference cost through strategic delegation to smaller models. On an adversarialsubset with unanswerable queries, FROST abstains on 34% of cases versus 8% forstandard chain-of-thought, reducing false positives by 45%. Task-stratifiedevaluation shows that exploration benefits scale with problem ambiguity.Generalization to mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multimodal domainsremains future work.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型面临着事实一致性与推理多样性之间的权衡：确定性解码更注重可靠性，但可能会错过其他解决方案；而高温采样则能在牺牲准确性的代价下增加探索性。我们提出了FROST（通过优化随机轨迹进行事实推理），这是一种在无需额外训练或上下文增强的情况下平衡探索与利用的推理框架。FROST结合了大型模型的确定性推理和小型模型的针对性随机采样，通过多标准验证来选择输出结果，包括连贯性、事实基础以及语义新颖性等方面。在HotpotQA、CommonsenseQA和MMLU任务中，FROST相比标准的思维链提示方法提升了2到5个百分点，并且与标准CoT相比，减少了40%的无支持输出。与自我一致性集成方法相比，FROST在较低的推理成本下实现了相当的准确性，其成本仅为后者的28%。在包含无法回答问题的对抗性数据集上，FROST在34%的情况下选择不给出答案，而标准思维链提示方法仅出现8%的情况，从而减少了45%的误报。任务分层评估表明，探索性收益随着问题复杂度的增加而提升。将这一方法推广到数学推理、代码生成和多模态领域仍属于未来的研究课题。

papers.title: SchemaRAG: Dynamic Large Schema Reduction for LLM-driven Structured Information Extraction
papers.title_zh: SchemaRAG：用于由大语言模型驱动的结构化信息提取的动态大规模模式简化技术
papers.authors: Sin Yu Bonnie Ho, Arlie Coles, Erik Larsson, Eric Marshall, Nathan Bodenstab, Paul Vozila
papers.abstract: Extracting structured data from unstructured text using large language models (LLMs) becomes challenging when the target schemas are large and complex. In such cases, including the full schema in the prompt increases cost and latency, risks lost-in-the-middle performance degradation, and can exceed context length limits. We propose SchemaRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework that dynamically prunes the output schema space for schema-conditioned information extraction tasks by leveraging schema metadata and few-shot examples (when available). We evaluate SchemaRAG on real-world healthcare and e-commerce datasets. Our results show that SchemaRAG can achieve up to an 8.8% increase in micro-F1, a 47% reduction in latency, and a 48% reduction in token costs, demonstrating its practicality for large-schema extraction.
papers.abstract_zh: 当目标模式庞大且复杂时，使用大语言模型从非结构化文本中提取结构化数据变得具有挑战性。在这种情况下，如果在提示中包含所有模式信息，将会增加成本并延长处理时间，还可能导致性能下降，甚至超出上下文长度的限制。我们提出了SchemaRAG这一检索增强生成框架，该框架通过利用模式元数据以及少量示例（如果可用），动态筛选输出模式空间，以完成基于模式的提取任务。我们在实际的医疗和电子商务数据集上对SchemaRAG进行了测试。结果表明，SchemaRAG能够将微F1分数提高8.8%，延迟减少47%，令牌成本降低48%，充分体现了其在处理庞大模式时的实用性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DQA: Diagnostic Question Answering for IT Support
papers.title_zh: DQA：用于信息技术支持的诊断型问答系统
papers.authors: Vishaal Kapoor, Mariam Dundua, Evren Yortucboylu, Sarthak Ahuja, Neda Kordjazi, Yiming Li, Vaibhavi padala, Derek Ho, Jennifer Whitted, Rebecca Steinert
papers.abstract: Enterprise IT support interactions are fundamentally diagnostic: effective resolution requires iterative evidence gathering from ambiguous user reports to identify an underlying root cause. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides grounding through historical cases, standard multi-turn RAG systems lack explicit diagnostic state and therefore struggle to accumulate evidence and resolve competing hypotheses across turns.We introduce DQA, a diagnostic question-answering framework that maintains persistent diagnostic state and aggregates retrieved cases at the level of root causes rather than individual documents. DQA combines conversational query rewriting, retrieval aggregation, and state-conditioned response generation to support systematic troubleshooting under enterprise latency and context constraints.We evaluate DQA on 150 anonymized enterprise IT support scenarios using a replay-based protocol. Averaged over three independent runs, DQA achieves a 78.7% success rate under a trajectory-level success criterion, compared to 41.3% for a multi-turn RAG baseline, while reducing average turns from 8.4 to 3.9. This improvement reflects the benefit of explicitly representing competing explanations and aggregating evidence across turns in unscripted troubleshooting.
papers.abstract_zh: 企业IT支持中的交互本质上是基于诊断的：有效的解决方案需要从模糊的用户报告中逐步收集证据，以找出根本原因。虽然检索增强生成技术可以通过历史案例来提供指导，但标准的多轮检索增强生成系统缺乏明确的诊断状态，因此难以积累证据并解决不同轮次中出现的各种假设问题。我们提出了DQA这一诊断问答框架，它能够保持持续的诊断状态，并将检索到的案例汇总到根本原因层面，而不是单个文档层面。DQA结合了对话式查询重写、检索聚合以及基于状态的响应生成技术，能够在企业级的延迟和上下文限制下实现系统的故障排查。我们在150个匿名的企业IT支持场景中测试了DQA的性能，采用基于重放的方案进行评估。在三次独立运行的基础上，DQA的平均成功率达到了78.7%，而多轮检索增强生成技术的平均成功率仅为41.3%。同时，DQA将平均轮数从8.4减少到3.9。这一改进体现了在无脚本的故障排除过程中，明确表达不同解释并跨轮次汇总证据所带来的优势。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Agentic Economic Modeling
papers.title_zh: 能动式经济模型
papers.authors: Bohan Zhang, Jiaxuan Li, Ali Hortacsu, Xiaoyang Ye, Victor Chernozhukov, Anqi Ni, Edward W Huang
papers.abstract: We introduce Agentic Economic Modeling (AEM), a framework that aligns synthetic LLM choices with small-sample human evidence for reliable econometric inference. AEM first generates task-conditioned synthetic choices via LLMs, then learns a bias-correction mapping from task features and raw LLM choices to human-aligned choices, upon which standard econometric estimators perform inference to recover demand elasticities and treatment effects. We validate AEM in two experiments. In a large scale conjoint study with millions of observations, using only 10% of the original data to fit the correction model lowers the error of the demand-parameter estimates, while uncorrected LLM choices even increase the errors. In a regional field experiment, a mixture model calibrated on 10% of geographic regions estimates an out-of-domain treatment effect of -65\pm10 bps, closely matching the full human experiment (-60\pm8 bps). Under time-wise extrapolation, training with only day-one human data yields -24 bps (95% CI: [-26, -22], p<1e-5), improving over the human-only day-one baseline (-17 bps, 95% CI: [-43, +9], p=0.2049). These results demonstrate AEM’s potential to improve RCT efficiency and establish a foundation method for LLM-based counterfactual generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了代理经济建模（AEM）这一框架，该框架能够将合成的大语言模型选择与少量人类证据相结合，从而实现可靠的经济计量学推断。AEM首先通过大语言模型生成任务相关的合成选择，然后学习一种偏差校正映射方法，将任务特征和原始大语言模型选择转化为符合人类认知的选择。基于这些符合人类认知的选择，标准的经济计量学估计器可以进行推断，以恢复需求弹性和处理效应。我们在两项实验中验证了AEM的有效性。在一项涉及数百万观测数据的大规模联合研究中，仅使用原始数据的10%来拟合校正模型，能够降低需求参数估计的误差；而未经校正的大语言模型选择则会导致误差增加。在一项区域实地实验中，基于10%的地理区域数据构建的混合模型估计出的领域外处理效应为-65±10个基点，这与完整的人类实验结果（-60±8个基点）非常接近。在时间上进行了外推分析后，仅使用第一天的人类数据进行训练得到的估计值为-24个基点（95%置信区间：[-26, -22]，p<1e-5），这优于仅使用第一天人类数据的基线值（-17个基点，95%置信区间：[-43, +9]，p=0.2049）。这些结果表明，AEM具有提高随机对照试验效率的潜力，并为基于大语言模型的反事实生成提供了一种基础方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Robust Explanations for User Trust in Enterprise NLP Systems
papers.title_zh: 让企业自然语言处理系统获得用户信任的可靠方案
papers.authors: Guilin Zhang, Kai Zhao, Jeffrey Friedman, Xu Chu, Amine Anoun
papers.abstract: Robust explanations are increasingly required for user trust in enterprise NLP, yet pre-deployment validation is difficult in the common case of black-box deployment (API-only access) where representation-based explainers are infeasible and existing studies provide limited guidance on whether explanations remain stable under real user noise, especially when organizations migrate from encoder classifiers to decoder LLMs. To close this gap, we propose a unified black-box robustness evaluation framework for token-level explanations based on leave-one-out occlusion, and operationalize explanation robustness with top-token flip rate under realistic perturbations (swap, deletion, shuffling, and back-translation) at multiple severity levels. Using this protocol, we conduct a systematic cross-architecture comparison across three benchmark datasets and six models spanning encoder and decoder families (BERT, RoBERTa, Qwen 7B/14B, Llama 8B/70B; 64,800 cases). We find that decoder LLMs produce substantially more stable explanations than encoder baselines (73% lower flip rates on average), and that stability improves with model scale (44% gain from 7B to 70B). Finally, we relate robustness improvements to inference cost, yielding a practical cost–robustness tradeoff curve that supports model and explanation selection prior to deployment in compliance-sensitive applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 在企业的自然语言处理领域，为了获得用户的信任，人们越来越需要可靠的解释。然而，在常见的黑盒部署情况下（仅通过API进行访问），进行预部署验证是非常困难的，因为基于表示的解释方法在这种情况下是不可行的。现有的研究也未能提供足够的指导，无法判断解释在实际的用户干扰下是否仍然稳定，尤其是在组织从编码器分类器转向解码器LLM时。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个统一的黑盒鲁棒性评估框架，用于基于“留一法遮挡”的令牌级解释评估。我们通过在不同严重程度的实际扰动下对顶级令牌进行翻转操作，来量化解释的鲁棒性。利用这一方法，我们对三个基准数据集和六种模型进行了系统的跨架构比较，这些模型涵盖了编码器和解码器系列（BERT、RoBERTa、Qwen 7B/14B、Llama 8B/70B；共64,800个案例）。我们发现，与编码器基线模型相比，解码器LLM产生的解释更加稳定（平均翻转率降低了73%），并且随着模型规模的扩大，稳定性有所提高（从7B扩展到70B时，稳定性提高了44%）。最后，我们将鲁棒性的提升与推理成本联系起来，从而得出一个实用的成本-鲁棒性权衡曲线，为在合规要求较高的应用中选择和部署模型以及解释提供了依据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VEG: Verbal \epsilon-greedy for Semantic Exploration in Multi-Turn RL Agents
papers.title_zh: VEG：在多轮强化学习环境中，采用语言上的ε-贪婪策略进行语义探索
papers.authors: Yongchang Hao, Jie Hao, Yongsheng Mei, Ze Ye, Junyi Chai, Bin Guo, Benjamin Z. Yao, Chenlei Guo, Lili Mou
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a cornerstone of the post-training pipeline for large language models (LLMs), enabling capabilities such as complex reasoning and tool use. However, standard RL approaches face significant challenges due to reward sparsity. Moreover, LLMs typically exhibit mode-seeking behavior, concentrating probability mass on high-likelihood regions. This lack of diversity biases the model toward premature exploitation, hindering the exploration necessary for optimal learning. To address this, we propose VEG (verbal \epsilon-greedy), a novel framework that leverages external feedback as a dynamic control variable to explicitly balance exploration and exploitation within the semantic space. This method not only supplements sparse final rewards with intermediate signals but also enforces sustained exploration throughout the training process. Experiments on Tau Bench and SearchQA demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy compared to standard RL baselines. Notably, the trained policy eventually outperforms the external feedback model itself, demonstrating that VEG enables the agent to effectively filter and improve upon the guidance it receives.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为大语言模型训练后流程的基石，它赋予了模型复杂推理和工具使用等能力。然而，由于奖励的稀疏性，传统的强化学习方法面临着重大挑战。此外，大语言模型通常表现出模式寻求行为，将概率质量集中在高可能性区域。这种缺乏多样性的特性使得模型容易过早利用现有信息，从而妨碍了实现最优学习所需的探索过程。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了VEG（基于语言的ε-贪婪策略）这一创新框架。该框架利用外部反馈作为动态控制变量，从而在语义空间中明确平衡探索与利用之间的关系。这种方法不仅通过中间信号补充了稀疏的最终奖励，还确保了训练过程中持续进行探索。在Tau Bench和SearchQA上的实验表明，我们的方法比传统强化学习基线取得了更高的准确率。值得注意的是，经过训练的策略最终甚至超越了外部反馈模型本身，这表明VEG能够让智能体有效过滤并改进所接收到的指导信息。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FlowHN: Adaptive Token Routing for Efficient Parallel Hybrid Networks
papers.title_zh: FlowHN：自适应令牌路由算法，实现高效并行混合网络传输
papers.authors: Mohammad Mahdi Moradi, Walid Ahmed, Shuangyue Wen, Sudhir Mudur, Weiwei Zhang, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Production LLMs must balance modeling quality with predictable latency, stable accelerator utilization, and cost-efficient scaling—constraints that remain difficult for existing architectures. Transformers provide strong reasoning but incur quadratic complexity, while state-space models (SSMs) scale efficiently yet lack fine-grained interactions; prior hybrids either introduce sequential bottlenecks or rely on learned routing that complicates deployment. We present FlowHN, a deployment-oriented parallel hybrid architecture that enables deterministic conditional computation via FLOP-aware token circulation across attention and SSM branches. Instead of dynamic expert routing, FlowHN performs hardware-aligned token scheduling that balances workloads, reduces synchronization stalls, and preserves full parameter utilization. Across 135M–1B models, FlowHN achieves up to 4× higher throughput and 15% higher MFU than strong Transformer, SSM, and hybrid baselines while maintaining competitive accuracy on reasoning, coding, and long-context tasks up to 32K tokens. FlowHN is designed to integrate directly into existing Hybrid pipelines without changes to optimizers, training stacks, or inference serving infrastructure, making it practical for real-world deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 生产型大语言模型必须在模型质量、可预测的延迟时间、稳定的加速器利用率以及成本效益的扩展性之间找到平衡——这些挑战对于现有的架构来说仍然难以克服。Transformer模型虽然具备强大的推理能力，但其计算复杂度呈二次方增长；而状态空间模型则能够高效扩展，但缺乏精细化的交互机制。之前的混合模型要么存在顺序性瓶颈，要么依赖于学习到的路由方式，这会增加部署的复杂性。我们提出了FlowHN这一面向部署的并行混合架构，它通过考虑FLOP的令牌循环机制，使得条件计算能够具有确定性。FlowHN采用与硬件相一致的令牌调度策略，从而平衡工作负载、减少同步停顿，并充分利用所有参数资源。在1.35亿到10亿个模型的测试中，FlowHN的吞吐量比强大的Transformer模型、状态空间模型以及混合模型基线高出4倍，模型平均使用率也高出15%。同时，FlowHN在推理、编码以及长达32K个令牌的长上下文任务上的准确率也与这些模型相当。FlowHN的设计使得它可以直接集成到现有的混合模型中，无需对优化器、训练堆栈或推理服务基础设施进行任何修改，因此非常适合实际部署应用。

papers.title: MemoPhishAgent: Memory-Augmented Multi-Modal LLM Agent for Phishing URL Detection
papers.title_zh: MemoPhishAgent：一种基于记忆增强的多模态大语言模型代理，用于检测钓鱼网站链接
papers.authors: Xuan Chen, Hao Liu, Tao Yuan, Mehran Kafai, Piotr Habas, Xiangyu Zhang
papers.abstract: Traditional phishing website detection relies on static heuristics or reference lists, which lag behind rapidly evolving attacks. While recent systems incorporate large language models (LLMs), they are still prompt-based, deterministic pipelines that underutilize reasoning capability.We present MemoPhishAgent (MPA), a memory-augmented multi-modal LLM agent that dynamically orchestrates phishing-specific tools and leverages episodic memories of past reasoning trajectories to guide decisions on recurring and novel threats.On two public datasets, MPA outperforms three state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines, improving recall by 13.6%.To better reflect realistic, user-facing phishing detection performance, we further evaluate MPA on a benchmark of real-world suspicious URLs actively crawled from five social media platforms, where it improves recall by 20%.Detailed analysis shows episodic memory contributes up to 27% recall gain without introducing additional computational overhead.The ablation study confirms the necessity of the agent-based approach compared to prompt-based baselines and validates the effectiveness of our tool design.Finally, MPA is deployed in production, processing \sim60K targeted high-risk URLs weekly, and achieving 91.44% recall, providing proactive protection for millions of customers.Together, our results show that combining multi-modal reasoning with episodic memory yields robust, adaptable phishing detection in realistic user-exposure settings.Our implementation is available at https://github.com/XuanChen-xc/MemoPhishAgent.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的钓鱼网站检测依赖于静态启发式方法或参考列表，这些方法难以应对快速演变的攻击手段。虽然最近的一些系统采用了大语言模型，但这些系统仍然基于提示进行决策，缺乏有效的推理能力。我们提出了MemoPhishAgent（MPA），这是一种增强记忆的多模态语言模型代理，它能够动态调度特定的钓鱼检测工具，并利用过往的推理经验来指导对重复出现的新威胁的决策。在两个公开的数据集上，MPA的表现优于三个最先进的基线算法，召回率提高了13.6%。为了更真实地反映用户面临的钓鱼检测场景，我们在来自五个社交媒体平台的真实可疑URL上进行测试，结果显示MPA的召回率提升了20%。详细分析表明，利用情景记忆可以提升高达27%的召回率，同时不会增加额外的计算负担。消融实验证实了基于代理的方法相对于基于提示的基线的必要性，并验证了我们的工具设计的有效性。最终，MPA已投入生产使用，每周处理约6万个高风险目标URL，召回率达到91.44%，为数百万客户提供主动保护。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，结合多模态推理与情景记忆能够在实际用户环境中实现高效、可适应的钓鱼检测。我们的实现代码可以在https://github.com/XuanChen-xc/MemoPhishAgent.git获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Adaptive Weighted Proxy Tuning: Efficient Gray-Box Steering for Image Captioning.
papers.title_zh: 自适应加权代理调优：用于图像标注的高效灰箱引导技术
papers.authors: Nafew Azim, Fuad Rahman, Nabeel Mohammed
papers.abstract: Adapting Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to specialized domains typically demands resource-intensive fine-tuning or access to proprietary parameters (“white-box” access). While decoding-time strategies like Proxy Tuning offer a parameter-efficient alternative, they rely on rigid, static logit arithmetic that fails to account for instance-specific variations in model certainty and domain shift. In this work, we introduce Adaptive Weighted Proxy Tuning (AWPT), a gray-box steering framework that dynamically modulates the logit contributions of a large base model, a fine-tuned expert, and an untuned anti-expert. Unlike static approaches, AWPT introduces two instance-aware mechanisms: (1) a lightweight ViT-based Weight Predictor that performs amortized inference to estimate optimal mixing coefficients in real-time with negligible added latency (\sim0.03s overhead), and (2) a Per-Sample Optimization objective that establishes theoretical performance bounds via gradient-based logit steering. Extensive evaluation across medical (ROCOv2, IU-Xray) and general domains (Flickr30k, MS COCO, TextCaps) demonstrates that AWPT achieves performance parity with fully fine-tuned models while remaining parameter-free regarding the generator. Crucially, our dynamic weighting acts as an effective regularizer, significantly reducing object hallucinations and establishing AWPT as a robust solution for deploying general-purpose LVLMs in safety-critical contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大型视觉语言模型应用于特定领域通常需要资源密集型微调，或者需要访问专有参数以实现“白盒”访问。虽然像代理调优这样的解码时间策略提供了一种参数高效的替代方案，但它们依赖于固定的、静态的逻辑回归算法，无法考虑到实例特定的模型不确定性以及领域变化的影响。在这项研究中，我们提出了自适应加权代理调优方法，这是一种灰色框引导框架，能够动态调节大型基础模型、经过微调的专家模型以及未经微调的反专家模型的逻辑回归贡献。与静态方法不同，自适应加权代理调优引入了两种考虑实例的机制：(1) 基于ViT的轻量级权重预测器，它能够进行摊销式推理，实时估计最佳混合系数，且增加的延迟可以忽略不计（约0.03秒的开销）；(2) 每个样本优化目标，它通过基于梯度的逻辑回归引导来建立理论性能界限。在医学领域（ROCOv2、IU-Xray）和通用领域（Flickr30k、MS COCO、TextCaps）进行的广泛评估表明，自适应加权代理调优方法在性能上可以与完全微调的模型相媲美，同时无需对生成器进行任何参数调整。重要的是，我们的动态加权机制起到了有效的正则化作用，显著降低了对象幻觉现象，使得自适应加权代理调优方法成为在安全关键环境中部署通用视觉语言模型的可靠解决方案。

papers.title: CLARITY: A Framework and Benchmark for Conversational Language Ambiguity and Unanswerability in Interactive NL2SQL Systems
papers.title_zh: 清晰性：一种框架与基准，用于评估交互式自然语言到SQL系统的对话语言中的歧义问题及无法回答的问题
papers.authors: Tabinda Sarwar, Farhad Moghimifar, Cong Duy Vu Hoang, Xiaoxiao Ma, Shawn Chang Xu, Fahimeh Saleh, Poorya Zaremoodi, Avirup Sil, Katrin Kirchhoff
papers.abstract: NL2SQL systems deployed in industry settings often encounter ambiguous or unanswerable queries, particularly in interactive scenarios with incomplete user clarification. Existing benchmarks typically assume a single source of ambiguity and rely on user interaction for resolution, overlooking realistic failure modes.We introduce Clarity, a framework for automatically generating an NL2SQL benchmark with multi-faceted ambiguities and diverse user behaviors across both single- and multi-turn settings. Using a constraint-driven pipeline, Clarity transforms executable SQL into ambiguous queries, augmented with grounded conversational continuations and schema-level metadata.Empirical evaluation on Spider and BIRD shows that leading NL2SQL systems, including those based on strong LLMs, suffer significant performance degradation under multi-faceted ambiguity. While these systems often detect ambiguity, they struggle to accurately localize and resolve the underlying schema-level sources. Our results highlight the need for more robust ambiguity detection and resolution in industry-grade NL2SQL systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 在工业环境中部署的NL2SQL系统经常会遇到模糊或无法解答的查询问题，尤其是在用户说明不完整的交互场景中。现有的基准测试通常假设单一的模糊来源，并依赖用户互动来解决问题，这忽略了现实中可能出现的各种故障模式。我们提出了Clarity框架，该框架能够自动生成包含多重模糊因素的NL2SQL基准测试，并考虑单轮或多轮交互中的不同用户行为。通过约束驱动的流程，Clarity可以将可执行的SQL转换为具有模糊性的查询语句，同时结合基于对话的连续性和模式级元数据进行处理。在Spider和BIRD上的实验表明，包括那些基于强大大语言模型的领先NL2SQL系统在面对多重模糊因素时，性能会显著下降。虽然这些系统能够检测到模糊性，但它们在准确定位和解决潜在的模式级来源方面存在困难。我们的研究结果强调了在工业级别的NL2SQL系统中，需要更强大的模糊检测与解决机制。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Toward Scalable Verifiable Reward: Proxy State-Based Evaluation for Multi-turn Tool-Calling LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 迈向可扩展的验证性奖励机制：基于代理状态的评估方法在多轮对话中用于智能体调用模型的应用
papers.authors: Yun-Shiuan Chuang, Chaitanya Kulkarni, Alec M. Chiu, Avinash Thangali, Zijie Pan, Shivani Shekhar, Yirou Ge, Yixi Li, Uma Kona, Linsey Pang, Prakhar Mehrotra
papers.abstract: Interactive large language model (LLM) agents operating via multi-turn dialogue and multi-step tool calling are increasingly used in production. Benchmarks for these agents must both reliably compare models and yield on-policy training data. Prior agentic benchmarks (e.g., tau-bench, tau^2-bench, AppWorld) rely on fully deterministic backends, which are costly to build and iterate. We propose Proxy State-Based Evaluation, an LLM-driven simulation framework that preserves final state-based evaluation without a deterministic database. Specifically, a scenario specifies the user goal, user/system facts, expected final state, and expected agent behavior, and an LLM state tracker infers a structured proxy state from the full interaction trace. LLM judges then verify goal completion and detect tool/user hallucinations against scenario constraints. Empirically, our benchmark produces stable, model-differentiating rankings across families and inference-time reasoning efforts, and its on- and off-policy rollouts provide supervision that transfers to unseen scenarios. Careful scenario specification yields near-zero simulator hallucination rates, as supported by ablation studies. The framework also supports sensitivity analyses over user personas. Human-LLM judge agreement exceeds 90%, indicating reliable automated evaluation. Overall, proxy state-based evaluation offers a practical, scalable alternative to deterministic agentic benchmarks for industrial LLM agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 交互式大语言模型（LLM）代理通过多轮对话和多步工具调用的方式运行，在工业生产中得到了广泛应用。对这些代理的评估标准必须能够可靠地比较不同模型的表现，并生成符合策略训练的训练数据。现有的代理评估基准（如tau-bench、tau^2-bench、AppWorld等）依赖于完全确定性的后端，但这种后端构建和迭代的成本很高。我们提出了基于代理状态的评估方法，这是一种由LLM驱动的仿真框架，可以在不依赖确定性数据库的情况下进行最终状态的评估。具体来说，一个场景需要包含用户目标、用户/系统信息、预期的最终状态以及预期的代理行为。然后，LLM状态跟踪器会从完整的交互记录中推断出结构化的代理状态。LLM评估者随后会根据场景约束来验证任务是否完成，并检测工具或用户的幻觉现象。从经验来看，我们的评估基准能够产生稳定且能区分不同模型的评估结果，其策略内策略外策略的评估方式能够为未见过的情况提供指导。通过仔细设计场景，我们可以实现几乎零的模拟器幻觉率，这一点也得到了实验研究的支持。该框架还支持对用户角色进行敏感性分析。人类语言模型评估者的一致度超过了90%，这表明自动评估是可靠的。总体而言，基于代理状态的评估方法为工业级LLM代理提供了一种实用且可扩展的替代方案，可以取代传统的确定性代理评估基准。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Ada-RS: Adaptive Rejection Sampling for Selective Thinking
papers.title_zh: Ada-RS：自适应拒绝采样法，用于选择性思维的实现
papers.authors: Yirou Ge, Yixi Li, Alec M. Chiu, Shivani Shekhar, Zijie Pan, Avinash Thangali, Yun-Shiuan Chuang, Chaitanya Kulkarni, Uma Kona, Linsey Pang, Prakhar Mehrotra
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in cost- and latency-sensitive settings. While chain-of-thought improves reasoning, it can waste tokens on simple requests. We study selective thinking for tool-using LLMs and introduce Adaptive Rejection Sampling (Ada-RS), an algorithm-agnostic sample filtering framework for learning selective and efficient reasoning. For each given context, Ada-RS scores multiple sampled completions with an adaptive length-penalized reward then applies stochastic rejection sampling to retain only high-reward candidates (or preference pairs) for downstream optimization. We demonstrate how Ada-RS plugs into both preference pair (e.g. DPO) or grouped policy optimization strategies (e.g. DAPO). Using Qwen3-8B with LoRA on a synthetic tool call-oriented e-commerce benchmark, Ada-RS improves the accuracy-efficiency frontier over standard algorithms by reducing average output tokens by up to ∼80% and reducing thinking rate by up to ∼95% while maintaining or improving tool call accuracy. We further demonstrate that these gains generalize across model scales (Qwen3-1.7B, 8B, 14B) and domains (τ 2-Bench airline and telecom). These results highlight that training signal selection is a powerful lever for efficient reasoning in latency-sensitive deployments.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在注重成本和延迟的应用场景中得到了越来越多的应用。虽然上下文推理能够提升推理能力，但可能会在简单的请求上浪费计算资源。我们研究了适用于工具使用型大语言模型的选择性思维机制，并提出了自适应拒绝采样算法——这是一种与算法无关的样本过滤框架，用于学习选择性且高效的推理方法。对于每一个给定的上下文，自适应拒绝采样会对多个采样出的解决方案进行评分，并采用自适应长度惩罚机制来奖励那些表现较好的解决方案，然后通过随机拒绝采样的方式只保留那些获得高奖励的解决方案（或偏好对），以便后续优化时使用。我们展示了自适应拒绝采样如何与偏好对优化策略或分组策略优化策略相结合。在使用Qwen3-8B模型和LoRA技术进行合成工具调用导向的电子商务测试时，自适应拒绝采样通过减少平均输出token量约80%，以及降低推理速度约95%的方式，同时保持或提升了工具调用的准确性，从而改善了准确性和效率的平衡。此外，我们还发现这些改进效果可以在不同模型规模（Qwen3-1.7B、8B、14B）和不同领域（如τ 2-Bench航空和电信领域）中得到通用应用。这些结果表明，在注重延迟的应用中，训练信号的选择是实现高效推理的重要手段。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: IPS: In-Prompt Process Supervision for Short Video Content Moderation
papers.title_zh: IPS：基于提示的短视频内容审核流程监控机制
papers.authors: Mingchao Liu, Yu Sun, Ruixiao Sun, Xin Dong, Xiang Shen, Hongwei Wang, Hongyu Xiong, Yang Song
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are effective at capturing the semantics of short video content; however, they often fail to attend to the policy-specific details required for reliable content moderation.To address this limitation, we introduce IPS, a novel framework that integrates In-prompt Process Supervision into MLLMs by introducing sequential reasoning over ancillary questions during fine-tuning. IPS consistently outperforms baseline MLLMs on public and proprietary benchmarks.Moreover, replacing human-annotated ancillary labels with MLLM-generated ones results in only marginal performance degradation, demonstrating robustness to noisy supervision and strong scalability with model-generated annotations.These findings establish IPS as a scalable and effective solution for complex multimodal classification in large-scale industrial settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在捕捉短视频内容的语义方面表现出色；然而，它们往往无法处理可靠内容审核所需的特定政策细节。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了IPS框架。该框架通过将过程监督机制融入多模态大语言模型，在微调过程中对辅助问题进行序列推理，从而实现了对多模态数据的有效处理。在公开和专有基准测试中，IPS的表现始终优于传统的多模态大语言模型。此外，用多模态大语言模型生成的辅助标签替代人工标注的标签后，模型的性能仅出现轻微下降，这表明IPS能够很好地应对噪声监督问题，并且具有强大的可扩展性，能够使用模型生成的注释来处理复杂的数据。这些发现表明，IPS是一种适用于大规模工业场景、可扩展且有效的多模态分类解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RedOne 2.0: Rethinking Domain-specific LLM Post-Training in Social Networking Services
papers.title_zh: RedOne 2.0：重新思考在社交网络服务中针对特定领域进行大语言模型训练后的处理方式
papers.authors: Fei zhao, Chonggang Lu, Haofu Qian, Fangcheng Shi, Zijie Meng, Jianzhao Huang, Zheyong Xie, Shaosheng Cao
papers.abstract: As a primary medium for human interaction and information exchange, social networking services (SNS) present distinct challenges for large language models (LLMs): rapidly evolving norms and slang, and culturally diverse content that causes knowledge distribution shift. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can improve in-domain performance, it often induces a ”seesaw” trade-off with out-of-domain robustness, especially for smaller models. To address these challenges, we present RedOne 2.0, an SNS-oriented LLM developed with a progressive, RL-prioritized post-training paradigm for fast and stable adaptation. Our pipeline has three stages: (1) Exploratory Learning on curated SNS corpora to establish initial alignment and surface systematic weaknesses; (2) Targeted Fine-Tuning that applies SFT only to diagnosed gaps while mixing a small amount of general data to reduce forgetting; and (3) Refinement Learning that re-applies RL with SNS-centric signals to consolidate gains and balance trade-offs across tasks. Across various tasks in three categories, our 4B model improves by 2.41 on average over the prior 7B RedOne baseline. It also yields an 8.74 average gain over its Qwen3-4B base while using less than half the data required by the SFT-centric method, demonstrating superior data efficiency and stability at compact scales. Overall, RedOne 2.0 provides a competitive, cost-effective baseline for SNS-specific LLMs, improving capability without sacrificing robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 作为人类互动和信息交换的主要媒介，社交网络服务为大语言模型带来了独特的挑战：不断变化的规范和俚语，以及文化多样的内容导致知识分布的转变。虽然监督式微调可以提升模型在特定领域的表现，但它往往会导致与领域外鲁棒性之间的“权衡”，尤其是在处理较小规模模型时。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了RedOne 2.0——一款以社交网络服务为目标的语言模型。该模型采用渐进式的、基于强化学习的训练后优化策略，以实现快速且稳定的适应能力。我们的训练流程分为三个阶段：(1)在精心挑选的社交网络服务语料库上进行探索性学习，以建立初步的模型对齐，并发现系统中的薄弱环节；(2)有针对性的微调，仅对已识别的缺陷进行微调，同时加入少量通用数据以减少遗忘现象；(3)再学习阶段，再次利用强化学习算法，结合社交网络服务的特征信息，巩固已有的成果，并在不同任务之间实现平衡。在三个类别的不同任务中，我们的4B模型平均性能提升了2.41，相比之前的7B版本的RedOne基线有了显著改进。此外，该模型在使用了不到一半的数据量的情况下，其性能相较于Qwen3-4B基线模型提升了8.74，充分体现了其在小规模数据集下的高效性和稳定性。总体而言，RedOne 2.0为针对社交网络服务的语言模型提供了一个具有竞争力的、成本效益高的基准方案，能够在不牺牲鲁棒性的前提下提升模型能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: How to Train a Real-World Silicon Concierge? Internalizing Complex Business Workflow to Only OneModel
papers.title_zh: 如何培养一名真正的“硅产业管家”？让复杂的业务流程只适用于一个模型之中
papers.authors: Yongqi Tong, Xiaoyun Feng, Lyuxin Xue, Jianshe Li, Xin Zhang, Jiang-Ming Yang
papers.abstract: Traditional industrial agents rely on modular pipelines, including Router, Retriever, Planner, Executor, Responder, Reviewer and so on, which inevitably fracture into a labyrinth of ad-hoc patches, leading to cascading errors and high latency. We propose OneModel, an applicable paradigm shift from external workflows to internalized knowledge representation. Unlike modular systems that slice fluid user intents into static steps, OneModel consolidates complex business logic and SOPs directly into the model’s parameters.Through Continual Pre-training (CPT) and logic-compilation SFT, we transform fragmented business rules into the model’s intuitive reasoning within a unified attention space. Deployed in our global financial service system, OneModel effectively breaks the impossible triangle of latency, accuracy, and complexity. Online A/B testing demonstrates end-to-end latency reduction of more than 50% (18.7s \rightarrow 8s) while the Intelligent Resolution Rate (IRR) jumps from 64.3% to 83.3%. The results demonstrate our paradigm OneModel effectively replaces brittle engineering logic with internalized cognitive intuition, offering a scalable and future-proof blueprint for transitioning industrial agents from complex, error-prone workflow to unified model architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的工业代理系统依赖于模块化流程，包括路由器、检索器、规划器、执行器、响应器、评审器等组件。这些组件不可避免地会分裂成无数个零散的修补程序，导致级联错误和高延迟问题。我们提出了OneModel这一创新理念，它实现了从外部工作流程向内部化知识表示的转变。与那些将用户意图分割成静态步骤的模块化系统不同，OneModel将复杂的业务逻辑和标准化操作直接整合到模型的参数中。通过持续预训练和逻辑编译技术，我们将分散的业务规则转化为模型内部的直观推理机制，从而在一个统一的注意力空间中实现处理。在我们的全球金融服务系统中应用OneModel后，我们成功打破了延迟、准确性和复杂性之间的恶性循环。在线A/B测试表明，整体延迟减少了50%以上（从18.7秒降至8秒），而智能分辨率也从64.3%提升到了83.3%。这些结果证明了我们的理念——OneModel能够有效地用内部化的认知直觉替代脆弱的工程逻辑，为工业代理系统提供了一个可扩展且适应未来的解决方案，帮助它们从复杂且容易出错的工作流程转变为统一的模型架构。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FinRAG-12B: A Production-Validated Recipe for Grounded Question Answering in Banking
papers.title_zh: FinRAG-12B：一种经过实际验证的、适用于银行领域限制性问题回答的解决方案
papers.authors: Denys Katerenchuk, Pablo Duboue, Keelan Evanini
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly being adopted across various domains. However, their adoption in banking industry faces resistance due to demands for high accuracy, regulatory compliance, and the need for verifiable and grounded responses. We present a unified, data-efficient framework for training grounded domain-specific LLMs that optimizes answer quality, citation grounding, and calibrated refusal under real-world deployment constraints. First, we describe a data generation pipeline that combines LLM-as-a-Judge filtering, citation annotation, and curriculum learning with only 143M tokens. The resulting 12B model achieves high answer quality outperforming GPT-4.1 on citation grounding, with a modest citation tradeoff versus the untuned base. Second, we propose a calibrated refusal mechanism: training on 22% unanswerable examples yield a 12% “I don’t know” rate, substantially improving over the base model’s unsafe 4.3% rate while avoiding GPT-4.1’s over-refusal (20.2%). Third, we present an end-to-end methodology spanning from data curation to quantized serving. The system is deployed at 40+ financial institutions, achieving a 7.1percentage point improvement in query resolution (p < 0.001). Additionally, the model delivers 3–5x faster responses at 20–50x lower cost compared to GPT-4.1.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正在迅速被应用于各个领域。然而，它们在银行业的应用却面临着阻力，因为需要达到高准确率、符合监管要求，并且需要得到可验证且基于事实的回答。我们提出了一个统一的、高效的数据训练框架，用于训练针对特定领域的语言模型。该框架能够优化答案质量、确保信息的准确性，并在实际部署的限制下实现合理的拒绝处理。首先，我们描述了一种数据生成流程，该流程结合了语言模型作为评判器进行过滤、信息引用标注以及课程学习机制，仅使用了1.43亿个标记。由此产生的120亿参数的模型在答案质量方面表现优异，其在信息引用方面的表现甚至超过了GPT-4.1。不过，在引用数量上，该模型与未经优化的基础模型相比有一些损失。其次，我们提出了一种合理的拒绝机制：通过对22%的不可回答样本进行训练，模型的“我不知道”比例达到了12%，这比基础模型的不安全拒绝率4.3%有了显著改善，同时避免了GPT-4.1那种过度拒绝的情况（20.2%）。第三，我们提出了一种从数据整理到量化服务的端到端方法。该系统已在40多家金融机构中部署，在查询解决效率上提升了7.1个百分点（p < 0.001）。此外，该模型在响应速度上快了3到5倍，成本则降低了20到50倍，相比GPT-4.1具有显著优势。
