papers.title: Agentic Context Strategies for Multi-Format Document Understanding: When Should Language Models Use Tools?
papers.title_zh: 多格式文档理解的主动式上下文策略：语言模型应该在何时使用工具呢？
papers.authors: Mansi Uniyal, Mukul Singh, Ryan Nadel
papers.abstract: Large language models face fundamental trade-offs when processing long documents: full context is expensive and may exceed limits, while RAG risks missing relevant information. We evaluate four context strategies across six frontier models on three document formats (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint). Our key finding: agentic tool-augmented approaches dramatically outperform passive strategies, with RAG+Tools achieving 46% accuracy vs 6% for RAG-only. Tool benefits are consistent across formats (+28-40 points) and models. We further show that (1) intelligent routing matters more than iteration count, (2) tools provide unique capability beyond reasoning loops, and (3) forcing active exploration matches providing context proactively. These results suggest tool augmentation is crucial for complex document QA.
papers.abstract_zh: 在处理长文档时，大语言模型面临着一些根本性的权衡：获取全部上下文信息成本很高，且可能会超出系统的限制；而基于RAG的方法则有可能遗漏重要信息。我们在三种文档格式（Word、Excel和PowerPoint）上，对六种前沿模型中的四种上下文处理策略进行了评估。我们的主要发现是：采用工具辅助的主动式处理方法明显优于被动式处理方法，其中RAG+工具的准确率达到了46%，而仅使用RAG方法的准确率仅为6%。不同格式的文档以及不同模型下，工具带来的优势都是一致的（+28-40分）。此外，我们还发现：（1）智能路由方式比迭代次数更为重要；（2）工具除了具备推理能力外，还拥有独特的优势；（3）强制进行主动探索与主动提供上下文信息是相辅相成的。这些结果表明，在复杂的文档问答场景中，工具辅助机制至关重要。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MM-BizRAG: Rethinking Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for General Purpose Enterprise Q&A
papers.title_zh: MM-BizRAG：重新思考基于多模态检索的生成式问答技术在通用企业问答场景中的应用
papers.authors: Hanoz Bhathena, Parin Rajesh Jhaveri, Rohan Mittal, Prateek Singh, Aymen Kallala, Rachneet Kaur, Yiqiao Jin, Zhen Zeng, Adwait Ratnaparkhi, Denis Kochedykov
papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (MM-RAG) have shifted toward minimal parsing, relying on page-level images for producing retriever embeddings and for answer generation. While efficient, this trend often neglects explicit handling of the rich, structured information in complex enterprise documents, instead depending on pre-trained embeddings or vision-language models to implicitly capture such structure. In this work, we take a more direct approach: MM-BizRAG proactively extracts and represents document structure via a document structure-aware split that dynamically routes documents through orientation-specific ingestion pipelines, applying explicit layout-aware parsing for vertically structured documents (e.g., reports) and holistic page-level representations for horizontally structured documents (e.g., slide decks). A unified LLM-driven artifact transformation pipeline with placeholder-based positional alignment preserves natural reading order, while inference-time multimodal assembly decouples retrieval representations from generation context, enabling richer, more grounded answers without any finetuning requirement. Through experiments on a large, heterogeneous enterprise dataset and two public benchmarks (SlideVQA and FinRAGBench-V), MM-BizRAG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art vision-centric baselines by up to 32% points, with especially strong gains on report-style layouts. Furthermore, we introduce FastRAGEval, a single-call LLM Judge metric for fine-grained generative recall that halves RAGChecker’s cost while achieving stronger human alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 在多模态检索增强生成技术方面，近期取得了显著进展。这一技术逐渐转向了最小化的解析方式，通过页面级别的图片来生成检索嵌入和答案。虽然这种方法效率较高，但它往往忽略了复杂企业文档中丰富且结构化的信息，而是依赖预训练的嵌入或视觉-语言模型来隐式地捕捉这些结构。在这项研究中，我们采取了更为直接的方法：MM-BizRAG主动提取并表示文档结构，通过一种注重文档结构的分割方式，动态地将文档送入特定方向的处理流程。对于垂直结构的文档（如报告），采用明确的布局感知解析；而对于水平结构的文档（如幻灯片演示文稿），则使用整体性的页面级表示方式。我们采用了一种统一的LLM驱动的工件转换流程，该流程利用占位符进行位置对齐，从而保持自然的阅读顺序。而在推理过程中，多模态组装将检索表示与生成上下文分离开来，从而能够生成更丰富、更贴近实际的解答，而无需进行任何微调。通过在大型异构企业数据集以及两个公开基准测试（SlideVQA和FinRAGBench-V）上的实验，MM-BizRAG的表现始终优于现有的以视觉为中心的基线方法，其性能最多提升32个百分点，尤其是在报告类文档的布局处理上表现尤为出色。此外，我们还提出了FastRAGEval这一单一调用的LLM评估指标，它能够实现细粒度的生成召回率，其成本仅为RAGChecker的一半，同时还能更好地符合人类的需求。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AesX: Enhance Your Images with Stunning Aesthetic Beauty
papers.title_zh: AesX：用令人惊叹的美感提升你的图片质量
papers.authors: Yuyan Chen, Zhendong Hou, Lei Xia, Jiahao Li, Zhuolin Ji, Zhixu Li
papers.abstract: In the fields of advertising design, artistic creation, and cultural dissemination, there is an increasingly urgent demand for high-quality images that cater to fine-grained aesthetic preferences. Although existing large-scale models can generally meet basic requirements for clarity and alignment with textual elements, they still face significant bottlenecks in achieving precise control and aesthetic optimization. To address this limitation, we propose a set of comprehensive preference indicators across two major dimensions, text-image consistency and aesthetic quality, encompassing multiple criteria ranging from exposure and clarity to visual guidance and innovativeness. Building on these indicators, we have developed a generative framework named AesX to steer the model consistently toward a generation path that more closely aligns with human aesthetic sensibilities. Our experimental findings demonstrate that this approach yields significant improvements in both target recognition accuracy and overall visual aesthetic presentation.
papers.abstract_zh: 在广告设计、艺术创作和文化传播领域，对于能够满足精细审美偏好的高质量图像的需求日益迫切。虽然现有的大规模模型通常能够满足清晰度和与文本元素对齐的基本要求，但在实现精确控制和美学优化方面仍然存在显著瓶颈。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一套涵盖两个主要维度的综合偏好指标：文本-图像一致性和美学质量。这些指标包括从曝光度、清晰度到视觉引导性和创新性等多个方面的标准。基于这些指标，我们开发了一个名为AesX的生成框架，以引导模型始终朝着更符合人类审美感知的方向发展。我们的实验结果表明，这种方法在目标识别准确性和整体视觉美学表现方面都取得了显著的提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Transfer Learning for Generalizable Automated LLM Improvement Pipeline for IVR Navigation
papers.title_zh: 迁移学习技术，用于实现可泛化的自动语言模型改进方案，以应用于语音识别系统的导航功能中
papers.authors: Vishal Sankar Ram, Jason Kushner, Manas Paldhe, Youngseo Son
papers.abstract: Administrative tasks in the healthcare domain share linguistic commonalities, but it can be time-consuming to manually design LLM prompts for each use case. When calling health insurers, interactive voice response (IVR) systems cause delays in patient care and increase provider burnout due to complex routing and long hold times. Thus, IVR navigation models can offer significant time savings and reduce barriers to care. We propose a production-quality automated LLM pipeline which leverages a small number of human-labeled ground truth datasets to transfer specialized prompts from one task to another; specifically, we perform a cross-task transfer of our IVR navigation logic, adapting the prompt from reaching the claims department to reaching the patient benefit department. Our approach reduces prompt complexity by up to 80% and obtains 82% turn-level accuracy in real-world industrial healthcare settings, surpassing a human-designed prompt at 79%.
papers.abstract_zh: 在医疗保健领域，行政任务具有一些语言上的共性，但为每个用例手动设计大语言模型的提示可能会耗费大量时间。当与健康保险公司进行通话时，交互式语音应答系统会导致患者护理的延迟，并且由于复杂的路由处理和长时间的等待，医护人员的疲劳度也会增加。因此，交互式语音应答导航模型可以显著节省时间，并降低就医障碍。我们提出了一种高质量的自动化大语言模型流程，该流程利用少量由人类标记的真实数据集来转换不同任务所需的提示语。具体来说，我们将交互式语音应答导航逻辑从处理理赔事务转移到处理患者福利事务。我们的方法将提示语的复杂性降低了80%，并且在实际工业医疗环境中达到了82%的转轮级准确率，这一准确率超过了人工设计的提示语所达到的79%的准确率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Instruction Optimization: Multi-Agent Error-Driven Class Description Refinement for LLM-Based Classification
papers.title_zh: 超越教学优化：基于多智能体的错误驱动类描述改进技术，用于基于大语言模型的分类任务
papers.authors: Hamvir Dev, Shivam Ratnakant Mhaskar, Sasanka Vutla, Anup Pattnaik
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable efficacy in classification tasks, yet their performance depends on two critical prompt components: Task Instructions (HOW to classify) and Class Descriptions (WHAT defines each class). While prompt engineering research has extensively explored instruction optimization, class descriptions have received comparatively less attention, often being treated as fixed inputs or simple label names. This represents a critical gap for real-world classification tasks, particularly in contact center domains, where labels often suffer from ambiguous boundaries, overlapping definitions, and incomplete coverage of possible cases—substantially limiting accuracy regardless of instruction quality.We propose a multi-agent framework for iteratively refining class descriptions based on classification errors. By analyzing misclassified instances, language agents automatically generate improved descriptions that better capture class distinctions and resolve ambiguities. Empirical evaluation across contact center and public benchmark datasets demonstrates upto 20.71% accuracy improvements over static class descriptions, addressing an orthogonal dimension to existing instruction optimization techniques.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在分类任务中展现出了显著的效果，但其性能取决于两个关键的提示要素：任务说明（如何进行分类）以及类别描述（定义每个类别的内容）。虽然关于提示工程的研究已经广泛探讨了说明的优化，但关于类别描述的优化却相对较少受到关注，通常将其视为固定的输入或简单的标签名称。这在实际分类任务中是一个重要的缺陷，尤其是在客服中心领域，因为这里的标签往往存在边界模糊、定义重叠以及无法涵盖所有可能情况的问题——这些因素都会严重限制分类的准确性，而无论说明的质量如何都是如此。我们提出了一种多智能体框架，通过基于分类错误来迭代改进类别描述。通过分析被错误分类的实例，语言模型能够自动生成更完善的描述，从而更好地捕捉类别之间的差异并解决模糊性问题。在客服中心和公共基准数据集上的实证评估表明，与静态类别描述相比，这种改进方法能够提高高达20.71%的准确率，这为现有的说明优化技术提供了一个新的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TEN: Table Explicitization, Neurosymbolically
papers.title_zh: 十：表格化表达，神经符号主义
papers.authors: Nikita Mehrotra, Aayush Kumar, Sumit Gulwani, Arjun Radhakrishna, Ashish Tiwari
papers.abstract: We present TEN, a neurosymbolic approach for extracting tabular data from semistructured text such as copy-pasted content from PDFs, emails, or OCR-flattened outputs. This task poses real-world challenges in domains like finance and healthcare, where manual copy-paste into spreadsheets introduces errors and OCR distortions compromise data integrity, leading to financial losses and flawed decisions.Purely neural methods suffer from hallucinations and structural inconsistencies, hindering deployment robustness. TEN addresses this via a novel triadic feedback loop that iteratively refines table hypotheses to enforce constraints and achieve verifiable convergence.Experiments show TEN outperforms neural baselines in exact match accuracy and lower hallucination rates. A 21-participant user study rates TEN tables more accurate and preferred in over 60% of pairwise comparisons, though verification and correction effort did not differ significantly between conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了TEN这一神经符号方法，用于从半结构化文本中提取表格数据，比如从PDF文件、电子邮件或OCR处理后的输出中复制粘贴的内容。在金融和医疗等领域，这种任务面临着现实中的挑战：手动将内容复制到电子表格中容易引入错误，而OCR识别的误差则会影响数据的完整性，从而导致财务损失和错误的决策。纯神经方法存在幻觉和结构不一致的问题，这限制了其应用的鲁棒性。TEN通过一种新颖的三重反馈机制来解决这个问题，该机制能够迭代地优化表格假设，从而确保约束条件的满足并实现可验证的收敛效果。实验表明，TEN在精确匹配准确性和降低幻觉率方面优于基于神经网络的基线方法。一项包含21名参与者的用户调查显示，在超过60%的成对比较中，用户认为TEN生成的表格更加准确且更受青睐，不过在验证和纠错方面的努力在两种条件下并没有显著差异。

papers.title: RADAR: Risk-Aware Distilled Adaptive Routing for Efficient Short-Form Video Platform Ecosystem Governance
papers.title_zh: RADAR：基于风险意识的自适应路由算法，旨在高效管理短视频平台生态系统
papers.authors: Baoyu Jing, Zixuan Wang, Junwen Chen, Xin Dong, Bingfeng Deng
papers.abstract: Large-scale integrity enforcement on short-form video platforms typically relies on multiple specialized vertical modules, each dedicated to a specific risk category. However, exhaustively executing these computationally intensive modules over massive content streams leads to substantial inference overhead, despite the fact that most content is benign and violations are usually confined to limited policy domains. To address this inefficiency, we propose RADAR, a lightweight risk-aware routing framework that selectively releases low-risk content while dispatching high-risk instances to appropriate vertical modules. Industrial deployment of such routing systems presents two major challenges: (1) systematic label sparsity caused by disjoint annotation pipelines across risk categories, and (2) the capacity-efficiency tradeoff inherent to compact routing architectures. To overcome these challenges, RADAR incorporates Validity-Aware Masking to handle fragmented supervision and Expert-Guided Knowledge Distillation to transfer knowledge from heavyweight expert models into the lightweight router. Experiments on large-scale real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed masking strategy effectively mitigates disjoint annotation issues, while distillation substantially enhances routing accuracy, enabling the lightweight router to achieve competitive or superior performance compared to specialized expert models.
papers.abstract_zh: 在短视频平台上实施大规模完整性监管，通常需要多个专业化的垂直模块来负责不同的风险类别。然而，在庞大的内容流中逐一执行这些计算密集型模块会导致巨大的推理负担，尽管大多数内容都是无害的，违规行为通常也仅限于某些特定的政策范畴。为了克服这种效率问题，我们提出了RADAR这一轻量级的风险感知路由框架。该框架能够选择性地放行低风险内容，同时将高风险内容分配给相应的垂直模块进行处理。不过，这种路由系统的应用存在两个主要挑战：(1) 由于不同风险类别的标注流程不连贯，导致标签分布不均；(2) 紧凑型路由架构本身存在容量与效率之间的矛盾。为了解决这些问题，RADAR采用了有效性感知的掩蔽技术来处理分散的监督信息，并通过专家指导的知识蒸馏技术将复杂专家模型的知识转移到轻量级路由器中。在大规模真实数据集上的实验表明，这种掩蔽策略能够有效解决标注不一致的问题，而知识蒸馏则显著提升了路由的准确性，使得轻量级路由器能够在性能上达到甚至超越专业专家模型的水平。

papers.title: From Graph to Text and Back: Semantic Fidelity in Automated Industrial Knowledge Graphs
papers.title_zh: 从图到文本再回归图：自动化工业知识图谱中的语义准确性问题
papers.authors: Kamyar Zeinalipour, Silvia Severini, Alessia Borghini, Sara Cardarelli, Marco Maggini, Marco Gori
papers.abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are the backbone of reliable industrial data strategies, yet verbalizing them with Large Language Models (LLMs) often leads to unacceptable risks for high-stakes applications, such as hallucinations or omitted relations. To enforce strict semantic fidelity in KG-to-text generation, we introduce a self-supervised round-trip pipeline. The system verbalizes KG triples into text and immediately attempts to reconstruct the original graph from that text; only verbalizations that enable perfect graph recovery are retained. This creates a closed feedback loop that guarantees the generated text is semantically equivalent to the source data. Experiments confirm that our automated round-trip consistency score correlates strongly with expert judgment, effectively acting as a scalable proxy for human review. Furthermore, we show that standard LLMs can bootstrap their own KG-extraction and generation capabilities by fine-tuning on this trusted synthetic data. Our approach yields significant improvements in triple-extraction accuracy and verbalization faithfulness without relying on costly manual annotation or massive teacher models, offering a practical path to deploying trustworthy, KG-grounded AI systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识图谱是构建可靠工业数据策略的基石。然而，使用大语言模型将知识图谱中的三元组转化为文本时，往往会导致不可接受的风险，例如幻觉现象或遗漏关系。为了确保在从知识图谱到文本的转化过程中保持严格的语义一致性，我们提出了一种自监督的往返流程。该系统会将知识图谱中的三元组转化为文本，并立即尝试从文本中重构出原始的图结构；只有那些能够完美还原原始图的文本才会被保留下来。这样形成了一个闭环反馈机制，确保生成的文本在语义上等同于原始数据。实验表明，我们的自动往返一致性评分与专家判断结果高度相关，有效地充当了人类审核的可扩展替代方案。此外，我们还发现，标准的大语言模型可以通过对这种可信合成数据进行微调，从而自行提升对知识图谱的三元组提取和生成能力。我们的方法在不依赖昂贵的手动注释或庞大的教师模型的情况下，显著提高了三元组提取的准确性和文本生成的可靠性，为部署可信赖的知识图谱驱动人工智能系统提供了实用的方法。

papers.title: Learning Selective LLM Autonomy from Copilot Feedback in Enterprise Customer Support Workflows
papers.title_zh: 在企业客户支持工作流程中，通过Copilot的反馈来学习选择性的大型语言模型自主性控制方法
papers.authors: Nikita Borovkov, Elisei Rykov, Olga Tsymboi, Sergei Filimonov, Nikita Surnachev, Dmitry Bitman, Anatolii Potapov
papers.abstract: We present a deployed system that automates end-to-end customer support workflows inside an enterprise Business Process Management (BPM) platform. The approach is scalable in production and reaches selective automation within two weeks for a new process, leveraging supervision already generated at scale: structured per-case UI interaction traces and low-overhead copilot feedback, where operators either accept a suggestion or provide a correction. A staged deployment pipeline trains a next UI action policy, learns a critic from copilot feedback to calibrate abstention, and executes only high-confidence steps in the background while deferring uncertain decisions to operators and resuming from the updated UI state. This setup lets one operator supervise multiple concurrent sessions and be interrupted only when the system is uncertain. The system operates on a schema-driven view of the BPM interface and includes monitoring and safe fallbacks for production. In production, it automated 45% of sessions and reduced average handling time by 39% without degrading support quality level.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们展示了一个部署好的系统，该系统能够自动化企业业务流程管理平台内的客户支持工作流程。该系统的可扩展性足以在生产环境中应用，并且能够在两周内为新的流程实现部分自动化操作。该系统利用了大规模生成的监督数据：结构化的情况化用户界面交互记录以及低开销的协同反馈机制。操作员可以选择接受建议或进行修正。该系统采用分阶段部署的方式，先训练下一个用户界面操作策略，然后从协同反馈中学习出评估标准，以调整延迟处理的行为。只有高度可信的步骤才会在后台执行，而不确定的决策则留待操作员处理，之后可以从更新后的用户界面状态继续工作。这种设置使得一名操作员可以同时监督多个并发会话，并且只有在系统不确定时才会被中断。该系统基于模式驱动的方式来操作业务流程界面，并提供了监控和安全回退功能，以确保在生产环境中的稳定运行。在实际生产中，该系统已经自动化处理了45%的会话，并将平均处理时间减少了39%，同时并未降低支持的质量水平。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Prompt-Level Distillation: A Non-Parametric Alternative to Model Fine-Tuning for Efficient Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 即时层次蒸馏：一种非参数化的模型微调方法，旨在实现高效的推理能力
papers.authors: Sanket Badhe, Deep Shah
papers.abstract: Advanced reasoning typically requires Chain-of-Thought prompting, which is accurate but incurs prohibitive latency and substantial test-time inference costs. The standard alternative, fine-tuning smaller models, often sacrifices interpretability while introducing significant resource and operational overhead. To address these limitations, we introduce Prompt-Level Distillation (PLD). We extract explicit reasoning patterns from a Teacher model and organize them into a structured list of expressive instructions for the Student model’s System Prompt. Evaluated using Gemma-3 4B, PLD improved Macro F1 scores on StereoSet (57% to 90.0%) and Contract-NLI (67% to 83%), while increasing LogiQA accuracy to 70%. Similar results on Mistral Small 3.1 demonstrate cross-architecture generalizability, enabling these compact models to match frontier performance with negligible latency overhead. These expressive instructions render the decision-making process transparent, allowing for full human verification of logic, making this approach ideal for regulated industries such as law, finance, and content moderation, as well as high-volume use cases and edge devices.
papers.abstract_zh: 高级推理通常需要使用思维链提示机制，这种方式的准确性较高，但会带来巨大的延迟以及大量的推理时间成本。另一种替代方案是微调较小的模型，但这种方法往往会牺牲模型的可解释性，同时还会增加资源和操作上的负担。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了提示级蒸馏技术。我们从教师模型中提取出明确的推理模式，并将它们整理成结构化的指令列表，供学生模型的系统提示使用。通过Gemma-3 4B进行评估，我们发现提示级蒸馏技术在StereoSet数据集上提升了F1分数，从57%提高到了90.0%，在Contract-NLI数据集上也提升了67%到83%。此外，该技术的LogiQA准确率也提升到了70%。在Mistral Small 3.1平台上进行的测试表明，这种技术具有跨架构的通用性，使得这些小型模型能够在几乎不增加延迟的情况下达到与先进模型相当的性能。这些富有表达力的指令使得决策过程变得透明，从而可以完全由人类来验证逻辑的正确性。因此，这种方法非常适合法律、金融和内容审核等受监管的行业，同时也适用于高并发场景和边缘设备。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MTIVE: Multi-Task Image Verification Engine Using Vision-Language Models for E-commerce
papers.title_zh: 目标：利用视觉与语言模型实现的多任务图像验证引擎，适用于电子商务领域
papers.authors: Yu-Tong Cao, Vishnu Prabhakaran, Arunita Das, Purav Aggarwal, Anoop Saladi
papers.abstract: Vision-language models show promise for e-commerce automation but struggle with noisy real-world images and multi-task requirements. We introduce MTIVE, a curriculum learning framework that progressively adapts base models through three stages: continued pre-training on large-scale e-commerce datasets with contrastive learning and diverse dialogue templates, instruction tuning on synthetic data, and modular task-specific expert training. Our architecture uses frozen base weights with stacked LoRA adapters—shared modules for domain knowledge and lightweight task-specific experts—enabling continual learning without catastrophic forgetting. MTIVE outperforms open-source and proprietary baselines in both standard and continual learning settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型在电子商务自动化方面展现出巨大潜力，但在处理噪声较大的现实世界图像和多任务需求时却面临挑战。我们提出了MTIVE这一课程学习框架，该框架通过三个阶段逐步优化基础模型：在大规模电子商务数据集上进行持续预训练，采用对比学习和多样化的对话模板；在合成数据上进行指令调整训练；以及针对特定任务的模块化专家训练。我们的架构采用了固定的基础权重和堆叠式的LoRA适配器——这些共享模块用于传递领域知识，而轻量级的任务特定专家则负责实现特定任务的优化。通过这种方式，我们可以实现持续学习，同时避免灾难性的遗忘现象。在标准和持续学习场景中，MTIVE均优于开源和专有基线模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Measuring and Mitigating Racial Bias in Embedding Models: A Comparative Study for Law Enforcement Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 在嵌入模型中测量与缓解种族偏见：针对执法检索的对比研究
papers.authors: Archan Dutta
papers.abstract: Embedding models are often used for semantic retrieval in high-stakes domains such as law enforcement, where biased outputs can have severe consequences. We systematically measure racial bias in six widely used embedding models by computing similarity scores between crime incident texts that include racial identity tokens and simple law enforcement queries. The analysis reveals that racial descriptors consistently affect cosine similarity scores and retrieval rankings for semantically identical crime incidents. All models exhibit statistically significant bias, with magnitude varying across models. This study provides a comprehensive methodology and metrics to aid the selection of embedding models when deploying NLP-based systems in the law enforcement domain. Organizations can reduce bias at low cost through informed model selection. The methodology establishes reproducible metrics for measuring bias in embedding-based systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 嵌入模型常用于法律执行等高风险领域的语义检索工作，因为这些领域中的偏见性输出可能会带来严重的后果。我们通过计算包含种族身份标识和简单法律执行相关查询的犯罪事件文本之间的相似度得分，系统地测量了六种常用嵌入模型中的种族偏见问题。分析结果显示，种族描述符会持续影响余弦相似度得分以及语义相同的犯罪事件的检索排名。所有模型都表现出统计学上的显著偏见，且这种偏见的程度在不同模型中有所不同。本研究提供了一种全面的方法论和评估指标，有助于在执法领域部署基于自然语言处理的系统时选择合适的嵌入模型。通过明智地选择模型，组织可以以较低的成本减少偏见。该方法论还建立了可复现的评估指标，用于衡量基于嵌入技术的系统中的偏见问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VishBox v2: A Multi-Agent System for Adaptive Voice Phishing Simulation
papers.title_zh: VishBox v2：一种用于自适应语音钓鱼模拟的多智能体系统
papers.authors: Sungmi Park, Daon Choi, Yoonmo Yang, Hong Yunyi, Heedou Kim
papers.abstract: Voice phishing is a multi-round social engineering attack in which strategy and victim psychology co-evolve, yet real transcripts are rarely accessible for systematic analysis. We present VishBox v2, a multi-agent architecture that generates structured phishing simulations grounded in crime-script procedures and persuasion principles. A Main Agent orchestrates a Dialogue Agent and a Tactic Search Agent, combining multi-round dialogue generation, web-based tactic mining, and emotion-driven vulnerability tracking. Across 571 rounds, results including police-expert evaluation support procedural realism and show that VishBox v2 captures tactic concentration, vulnerability transitions, and web-search-induced procedural disruptions. The framework provides a controlled foundation for safer red-teaming and security training research.
papers.abstract_zh: 语音钓鱼是一种多轮次的社会工程攻击，其中攻击策略与受害者的心理特征相互演变。然而，真实的攻击过程文本往往难以被系统分析。我们提出了VishBox v2这一多智能体架构，它能够生成基于犯罪脚本程序和说服原则的结构化钓鱼模拟场景。该框架由主代理、对话代理和策略搜索代理组成，它们共同实现了多轮对话生成、基于网络的策略挖掘以及基于情绪的漏洞追踪功能。在571轮次的实验中，实验结果得到了警方专家的评估支持，证明了VishBox v2能够准确捕捉到策略的集中性、漏洞的转移情况，以及网络搜索引发的程序中断现象。该框架为更安全的红队活动和安全培训研究提供了可靠的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ResoDiff-44k: High-Fidelity Cross-Lingual Speech and Singing Synthesis via Discrete Diffusion
papers.title_zh: ResoDiff-44k：通过离散扩散技术实现高保真多语言语音和歌唱合成
papers.authors: Gyanendra Das, Sai Satyam Jena
papers.abstract: While large-scale generative speech models have achieved remarkable semantic coherence, industrial deployment remains constrained by a fidelity ceiling typically capped at lower sampling rates. A fundamental limitation is the reliance on intermediate mel-spectrograms, a low-dimensional bottleneck that discards phase and high-frequency information, causing artifacts in expressive scenarios like singing. In this work, we introduce ResoDiff-44k, a production-grade generative foundation model designed for cinema-quality, 44.1kHz audio synthesis. Departing from standard masked audio modeling and mel-spectrogram inversion, ResoDiff-44k leverages Discrete Diffusion over a pure Descript Audio Codec latent space. We pre-train ResoDiff-44k on a massive 150K -hour multilingual dataset to establish a robust acoustic prior, followed by targeted fine-tuning on a curated regional mixed-language and singing corpus. Our experiments demonstrate that replacing the standard prediction head with a discrete diffusion trajectory significantly reduces misalignment in long sequences. We report a double-blind subjective evaluation showing that ResoDiff-44k achieves a 4.6 Mean Opinion Score in 44.1kHz singing synthesis and a 71% reduction in character error rate on regional mixed-language prompts compared to strong baselines. The proposed pipeline offers a viable path for deploying high-fidelity, culturally adaptive conversational agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大规模的生成语音模型已经实现了显著的语义连贯性，但其在工业领域的应用仍然受到采样率限制的影响。一个根本的限制是依赖于中间梅尔频谱图，这种低维瓶颈会丢弃相位和高频信息，从而导致在诸如歌唱等表达性场景中出现伪影。在这项研究中，我们提出了ResoDiff-44k这一生产级生成基础模型，旨在实现44.1kHz音频的合成，满足电影级的质量要求。该模型基于标准的掩码音频建模和梅尔频谱图反演技术，并采用了离散扩散算法，通过纯Descript音频编码器的潜在空间进行建模。我们在包含15万小时的多语言数据集上预训练了ResoDiff-44k，以建立稳健的声学先验，随后又在精心挑选的区域性混合语言和歌唱语料库上进行针对性微调。实验表明，用离散扩散轨迹替代标准预测头可以显著减少长序列中的不一致性问题。我们的双盲主观评估结果显示，ResoDiff-44k在44.1kHz歌唱合成中取得了4.6的平均意见得分，与强大的基线模型相比，其区域混合语言提示的字符错误率降低了71%。所提出的流程为部署高保真度、具有文化适应性的对话机器人提供了可行的途径。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TingIS: Real-time Risk Event Discovery from Noisy Customer Incidents at Enterprise Scale
papers.title_zh: TingIS：在大型企业规模下，从嘈杂的客户事件中实时识别风险事件
papers.authors: Jun Wang, Ziyin Zhang, Rui Wang, Hang Yu, Peng Di, Rui Wang
papers.abstract: Real-time detection and mitigation of technical anomalies are critical for large-scale cloud-native services, where even minutes of downtime can result in massive financial losses and diminished user trust. While customer incidents serve as a vital signal for discovering risks missed by monitoring, extracting actionable intelligence from this data remains challenging due to extreme noise, high throughput, and semantic complexity of diverse business lines. In this paper, we present TingIS, an end-to-end system designed for enterprise-grade incident discovery. At the core of TingIS is a multi-stage event unification engine that synergizes efficient indexing techniques with Large Language Models (LLMs) to make informed decisions on event merging, enabling the stable extraction of actionable incidents from just a handful of diverse user descriptions. This engine is complemented by a cascaded routing mechanism for precise business attribution and a multi-dimensional noise reduction pipeline that integrates domain knowledge, statistical patterns, and behavioral filtering. Deployed in a production environment handling a peak throughput of over 2,000 messages per minute and 300,000 messages per day, TingIS achieves a P90 alert latency of 3.5 minutes and a 95% discovery rate for high-priority incidents. Benchmarks constructed from real-world data demonstrate that TingIS significantly outperforms baseline methods in routing accuracy, clustering quality, and Signal-to-Noise Ratio.
papers.abstract_zh: 实时检测与应对技术异常对于大规模云原生服务至关重要，因为哪怕几分钟的停机时间都可能导致巨大的经济损失并降低用户信任度。虽然客户事件是发现监控遗漏风险的重要线索，但由于数据中的极端噪声、高处理量以及不同业务领域的语义复杂性，从这些数据中提取有价值的信息仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们介绍了TingIS——一个专为企业级事件检测而设计的端到端系统。TingIS的核心是一个多阶段事件统一引擎，该引擎将高效的索引技术与大语言模型相结合，以做出明智的事件合并决策，从而能够从少量不同的用户描述中稳定地提取出有用的事件信息。该引擎还配备了级联路由机制，用于精确的业务归属判断，以及一个多维噪声减少流程，该流程结合了领域知识、统计模式和行为过滤技术。在真实生产环境中运行时，TingIS每分钟能够处理超过2000条消息，每天处理300000条消息。其P90警报延迟为3.5分钟，高优先级事件的发现率达到了95%。基于真实数据构建的基准测试表明，TingIS在路由准确性、聚类质量以及信号与噪声比方面均显著优于传统方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LoCar: Localization-Aware Evaluation of In-Vehicle Assistants through Fine-Grained Sociolinguistic Control
papers.title_zh: LoCar：通过精细的社会语言控制来实现车载辅助系统的本地化评估
papers.authors: Seogyeong Jeong, Kiwoong Park, Seyoung Song, Eunsu Kim, Ken E Friedl, Jaeho Kim, Alice Oh
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into in-vehicle conversational systems, identifying the optimal model remains challenging due to the lack of domain-specific evaluation standards tailored to real-world deployment requirements. In this paper, we propose a novel evaluation framework for in-vehicle assistants, with a particular focus on Korean-language localization. Our empirical analysis reveals notable patterns in model behavior. First, fine-grained Korean honorific control remains unstable in current LLMs, indicating that precise speech-level realization must be explicitly evaluated in localization settings. Second, models exhibit weaker performance in strategic conversational metrics like clarification and proactivity. Our analysis suggests this stems from the inherent subjective complexity of these tasks, where our framework adopts a conservative evaluation stance to prioritize reliability. Together, our findings underscore that automotive AI must move beyond general competence toward precise linguistic tailoring and reliable, safety-oriented interaction management.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被整合到车载对话系统中，但由于缺乏针对实际部署需求而专门设计的领域特定评估标准，确定最佳模型仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了一个针对车载助手的新型评估框架，特别关注韩语本地化功能。我们的实证分析揭示了模型行为中的一些显著规律。首先，当前的大语言模型中，对韩语敬称的精细控制仍然不稳定，这表明在本地化场景中必须明确评估精确的语音级实现方式。其次，模型在诸如澄清和主动回应等战略性对话指标上的表现较弱。我们的分析表明，这源于这些任务本身所具有的主观复杂性，因此我们的框架采取了保守的评估策略，以优先考虑模型的可靠性。总的来说，我们的研究发现强调了汽车人工智能必须超越一般能力，朝着更精确的语言定制以及可靠、以安全为导向的交互管理方向发展。

papers.title: Index-Time Prefix Injection for Multi-Tenant Retrieval: Improving Search Relevance Without Model Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 针对多租户检索的索引时间前缀注入技术：无需模型调优即可提升搜索相关性
papers.authors: Vaibhav Varshney, Manjunatha Naik Mc
papers.abstract: Multi-tenant enterprise search platforms serve hundreds of customers through a single shared retrieval model. Fine-tuning on individual customer data is typically prohibited by contractual and regulatory constraints, and maintaining per-customer models does not scale. We present index-time prefix injection, a training-free method that improves retrieval relevance by prepending domain-descriptive natural-language prefixes to documents during indexing. For example, prepending “IT service management knowledge article:” to an IT knowledge base shifts its embeddings into a tighter, more domain-coherent region of the vector space. Prefixes are discovered through a tiered strategy: LLM-based generation from document samples when data policies allow, domain-expert curation when they do not, and a standardized prefix library as fallback. Deployed across 18 languages and 400+ customer instances, the approach yields 3–8% Hit@5 improvements with zero model training. A/B tests confirm a 4.2% CTR lift. We describe the system design, evaluation at scale, and deployment lessons including failure modes.
papers.abstract_zh: 多租户企业搜索平台通过统一的检索模型为数百个客户提供服务。由于合同和监管限制，通常禁止对单个客户数据进行微调，而维护针对每个客户的模型也无法实现扩展。我们提出了索引时前缀注入的方法——这是一种无需训练的方法，通过在索引过程中在文档前添加描述该领域的自然语言前缀来提高检索相关性。例如，在IT知识库文档前添加“IT服务管理知识文章：”可以将该文档的嵌入向量引导到更集中、更符合领域特性的区域。前缀的确定采用分层策略：在数据政策允许的情况下，使用LLM从文档样本中生成前缀；在数据政策不允许的情况下，则依靠领域专家进行筛选；而在所有情况下，都会使用标准化的前缀库作为备选方案。该方法已应用于18种语言，并服务于400多个客户实例，其效果表现为Hit@5指标提高了3%至8%，且无需任何模型训练。A/B测试证实，该方法的点击率提升了4.2%。我们详细描述了系统的设计、大规模评估过程以及部署过程中的注意事项，包括可能出现的故障模式。

papers.title: Benchmarking Testing in Automated Theorem Proving
papers.title_zh: 在自动定理证明中进行的基准测试
papers.authors: Jongyoon Kim, Hojae Han, Seung-Won Hwang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in formal theorem proving, yet evaluating semantic correctness remains challenging. Existing evaluations rely on indirect proxies such as lexical overlap with human-annotated proof,or expensive manual inspection.Inspired by the shift from lexical comparison to test-based evaluation in code generation, we propose T^2, a framework that evaluates the semantic correctness of formal theorems: a generated theorem is considered correct only if all dependent successor theorems compile successfully, analogous to integration testing.We construct a benchmark from 5 real-world Lean 4 repositories, comprising 2,206 problems paired with 41 successor theorems on average, automatically extracted without human effort.Experiments demonstrate that while state-of-the-art models achieve high compilation success, they perform significantly worse under our semantic metric.The best model, Claude-Sonnet-4.5, achieves only 38.9% Testing Accuracy on the full set, given both natural language proof and successor theorems as context, revealing a critical gap in current theorem generation capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展在形式化定理证明方面展现出巨大潜力，但评估语义正确性仍然是一个挑战。现有的评估方法依赖于间接的代理指标，比如与人工注释的证明内容在词汇上的重叠，或者昂贵的手动检查。受启发于从词汇比较转向基于测试的代码生成评估方式，我们提出了T^2框架，用于评估形式化定理的语义正确性：只有当所有相关的后续定理能够成功编译时，生成的定理才被视为正确的，这类似于集成测试。我们通过5个真实的Lean 4仓库构建了一个基准测试集，其中包含2,206个问题，每个问题平均对应41个后续定理，这些定理都是无需人工干预即可自动提取的。实验表明，尽管最先进的模型在编译成功率上表现优异，但在我们的语义评估指标下，它们的表现明显较差。最好的模型Claude-Sonnet-4.5在整个测试集上的准确率仅为38.9%，这一结果表明，即使结合自然语言证明和后续定理作为上下文，当前的形式化定理生成能力仍存在显著不足。

papers.title: Graph-Based Phonetic Error Correction of Noisy ASR
papers.title_zh: 基于图的噪声自动语音识别语音错误修正技术
papers.authors: Pratik Rakesh Singh, Mohammadi Zaki, Aneesh Mukkamla, Pankaj Wasnik
papers.abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems, despite low overall word error rates, produce residual lexical errors that disproportionately affect semantically critical tokens such as named entities, negations, and sentiment-bearing words. These errors are often structured, arising from phonetic similarity rather than random noise, making naive token-level correction insufficient.We propose a structured ASR correction framework, that we call G-SPIN, that combines phonetic graph modeling with contextual language understanding. A graph neural network (GNN) first constructs acoustically plausible candidate neighborhoods for flagged tokens, explicitly restricting the correction search space to phonetic alternatives. A masked language model (MLM) then provides local contextual scoring, and an instruction-tuned large language model (LLM) performs final context-aware re-ranking over this compact candidate set. By decoupling structured phonetic reasoning from contextual semantic selection, our method avoids unconstrained generation while improving correction accuracy. The framework is lightweight, modular, and operates entirely at inference time.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动语音识别系统虽然整体单词错误率较低，但仍然存在一些词汇级错误，这些错误对诸如命名实体、否定词以及带有情感色彩的词语等语义上至关重要的词汇产生了不成比例的影响。这些错误往往具有结构性，其产生源于语音的相似性，而非随机噪声，因此简单的词级纠错方法并不足够。我们提出了一种结构化的自动语音识别纠错框架，称之为G-SPIN。该框架结合了语音图模型与上下文语言理解技术。首先，图神经网络为被标记出的词汇构建出在语音上可行的候选邻域，从而明确限定了纠错搜索空间仅限于语音上的替代方案。接着，掩码语言模型提供局部上下文评分，而经过指令调优的大语言模型则对这一有限的候选集合进行最终的上下文感知重新排序。通过将结构化语音推理与上下文语义选择分离开来，我们的方法避免了无约束的生成过程，同时提升了纠错的准确性。该框架具有轻量级、模块化特点，且完全在推理阶段运行。

papers.title: CAT: Confidence-Adaptive Thinking for Efficient Reasoning of Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: CAT：基于自信的适应性思维，用于高效处理大型推理模型
papers.authors: Qizhi Jiang, Shuo Wang, Pei Ke, Yuhang Song, Ke Qin
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success on complex tasks by leveraging long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories, yet they frequently exhibit overthinking on simple queries, resulting in significant token overhead and reduced inference efficiency. However, existing compression methods predominantly apply uniform length reduction or rely on coarse-grained difficulty estimation, often leading to performance degradation on difficult problems. To address this limitation, we propose Confidence-Adaptive Thinking (CAT), a framework that incorporates the model’s intrinsic self-certainty signals as confidence into the preference optimization process, which autonomously modulates reasoning lengths based on problem difficulty. Experimental results show that CAT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on reasoning accuracy across multiple benchmarks on different base models. Our work enables LRMs to effectively compress confident responses while deliberating on uncertain ones, offering a potentially robust solution for balancing accuracy and latency in practical industrial scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在解决复杂任务时取得了显著的成功，这得益于它们能够处理复杂的思维链。然而，这些模型在处理简单问题时往往会过度思考，从而导致大量的token开销以及推理效率的下降。不过，现有的压缩方法大多采用统一长度的缩减方式，或者依赖粗略的难度估计，这往往会导致在困难问题上的性能下降。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种名为“置信自适应思维”的框架。该框架将模型自身的确定性信号作为置信度因素纳入偏好优化过程中，从而能够根据问题的难度自动调整推理的长度。实验结果表明，CAT在多个基准测试中的推理准确率均优于现有的最先进基线模型。我们的方法使得大型推理模型能够在处理不确定问题时有效压缩响应，从而在实际工业场景中为平衡准确性和延迟性提供了潜在的稳健解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LatentGate: Low-Latency Semantic Routing via Frozen-Backbone Probing of Small Language Models
papers.title_zh: LatentGate：通过冻结主干网络对小型语言模型进行低延迟语义路由处理的方法
papers.authors: Shivam Ratnakar, Abhiroop Talasila, Vinayak K Doifode
papers.abstract: As Multi-Agent Systems scale to hundreds of specialized agents, routing becomes a critical bottleneck. Prompt-based LLM routers deliver strong semantic reasoning but incur prohibitive latency (~1500–2000ms) and cost that scales with agent count, while embedding-based routers are fast (25–50ms) but collapse semantically similar yet functionally distinct agents. We identify representation anisotropy, the geometric collapse of hidden-state vectors into a narrow cone, as a key mechanism underlying embedding-based routing failure. We propose LatentGate, a non-generative router that extracts mean-pooled hidden states from a frozen small language model (SLM), applies PCA-whitening to resolve the anisotropy, and trains a lightweight linear probe for agent classification. Across 5 SLM backbones and 100 enterprise agents, LatentGate achieves 98.8% in-domain and 80.0% OOD accuracy on natural queries, 13–22 absolute points above embedding baselines, and 92.9% on CLINC150. It takes ~28ms to run on a T4 GPU, with the SLM forward pass independent of agent count and classification adding a negligible O(Ck) term. We demonstrate the potential of using a lightweight linear probe to enable sub-10ms warm-start retraining from user feedback, providing a foundation for continual learning in production environments. Benchmarking prompt-based routing with GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1-nano, and Gemini 2.5 Flash confirms degradation to 70–77% accuracy at 100 agents with 1500–2000ms latency, motivating non-generative alternatives.
papers.abstract_zh: 当多智能体系统扩展到数百个专业智能体时，路由问题就成为了一个关键的瓶颈。基于提示的大语言模型路由器能够提供强大的语义推理能力，但带来的延迟却高达1500到2000毫秒，而且成本随着智能体数量的增加而上升。而基于嵌入的路由器虽然速度较快（25到50毫秒），但却会导致语义相似但功能不同的智能体被合并在一起。我们发现，隐藏状态向量的几何性崩溃，即它们被压缩到一个狭窄的范围内，是导致基于嵌入的路由失败的关键原因。我们提出了LatentGate这一非生成式路由器，它可以从冻结的小语言模型中提取平均化的隐藏状态，然后通过PCA白化技术来解决这种几何性崩溃问题，并训练出一个轻量级的线性探针来进行智能体分类。在5种小语言模型基础架构和100个企业智能体的测试中，LatentGate在自然查询任务上的准确率达到了98.8%和80.0%，比基于嵌入的基线方法高出13到22个百分点，在CLINC150测试集上的准确率更是达到了92.9%。在T4 GPU上运行LatentGate大约需要28毫秒，而小语言模型的前向处理过程与智能体数量无关，分类过程的复杂度也极低。我们证明了使用轻量级线性探针可以实现低于10毫秒的冷启动重新训练，这为生产环境中的持续学习提供了基础。通过与GPT-4.1、GPT-4.1-nano以及Gemini 2.5 Flash进行基准测试，我们发现，在100个智能体和1500到2000毫秒的延迟情况下，基于提示的路由系统的准确率下降到了70%到77%，这促使我们探索非生成式的替代方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Thinking with Reasoning Skills: Fewer Tokens, More Accuracy
papers.title_zh: 运用推理能力进行思考：使用更少的“代币”，实现更高的准确性
papers.authors: Guangxiang Zhao, Qilong Shi, Xusen Xiao, Xiangzheng Zhang, Tong Yang, Lin Sun
papers.abstract: Reasoning LLMs often spend substantial tokens on long intermediate reasoning traces (e.g., chain-of-thought) when solving new problems. We propose to summarize and store reusable reasoning skills distilled from extensive deliberation and trial-and-error exploration, and to retrieve these skills at inference time to guide future reasoning. Unlike the prevailing reasoning from scratch paradigm, our approach first recalls relevant skills for each query, helping the model avoid redundant detours and focus on effective solution paths. We evaluate our method on coding and mathematical reasoning tasks, and find that it significantly reduces reasoning tokens while improving overall performance. The resulting lower per-request cost indicates strong practical and economic potential for real-world deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理大语言模型在解决新问题时，通常会花费大量资源来生成冗长的中间推理过程（例如，思维链）。我们提出了一种方法，即总结并存储从大量思考和试错过程中提炼出的可复用推理技能，并在推理时调用这些技能以指导后续的推理过程。与现有的从头开始进行推理的方法不同，我们的方法首先为每个查询检索相关的技能，帮助模型避免不必要的重复路径，从而专注于有效的解决方案。我们在编程和数学推理任务上评估了我们的方法，发现该方法显著减少了推理所需的资源，同时提升了整体性能。较低的每请求成本表明，该方法具有强大的实际应用价值，适合在现实世界中进行部署。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: I Don’t Need Solution. I Need Emotional Support : Empathetic LLMs based on Emotional Validation
papers.title_zh: 我不需要解决方案。我需要情感上的支持：基于情感验证的富有同情心的大型语言模型
papers.authors: Suhyune Son, Jungwoo Lim, Myunghoon Kang, Seongtae Hong, Yuna Hur, Evelyn H. Zi, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Empathy plays a crucial role in prosocial behavior and supportive human interactions. According to emotional validation theory, effective empathetic conversations require observing and reflecting on the help-seeker’s situation before offering emotional support and guidance. While recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have enabled fluent and coherent dialogue generation, our preliminary study reveals that existing LLMs struggle to generate emotional support response. Instead, they tend to offer repetitive solutions without sufficiently considering the emotional needs of help-seekers. To address this limitation, we propose EVA: empathetic LLMs with Emotional VAlidation. EVA enhances empathetic response generation through a two-stage training process: empathy acquisition and emotional validation alignment. For the emotional validation alignment, we introduce the Emotional Validation Aware Dataset (EVAD), which is annotated with levels of emotional validation theory as conversations progress. Additionally, we propose EVAEval, a novel evaluation metric designed to assess whether a model-generated response aligns with emotional validation theory. Experimental results demonstrate that the EVA method significantly improves empathetic response generation, achieving superior performance in both automatic and human evaluations. Furthermore, comprehensive analyses confirm that the EVA method effectively mitigates patterned responses while ensuring adherence to emotional validation principles.
papers.abstract_zh: 同理心在亲社会行为和人际互动中起着至关重要的作用。根据情感验证理论，有效的同理心对话需要在提供情感支持和指导之前，先观察并反思求助者的处境。虽然大语言模型在最近取得了显著进展，能够生成流畅且连贯的对话内容，但我们的初步研究表明，现有的大语言模型在生成情感支持回应方面存在困难。它们往往只能提出重复性的解决方案，而未能充分考虑到求助者的情感需求。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了EVA：带有情感验证的同理心大语言模型。EVA通过两阶段训练过程来增强同理心响应生成：同理心获取和情感验证对齐。在情感验证对齐方面，我们引入了情感验证感知数据集（EVAD），该数据集在对话过程中会标注出符合情感验证理论的情感验证水平。此外，我们还提出了EVAEval这一新的评估指标，用于判断模型生成的回应是否符合情感验证理论。实验结果表明，EVA方法显著提升了同理心响应生成的能力，在自动评估和人工评估中均表现出色。进一步的分析表明，EVA方法能够有效避免模式化的回应，同时确保遵循情感验证原则。

papers.title: Extraction of Texters’ Explicit Emotion Expressions in Crisis Conversations
papers.title_zh: 在危机对话中提取说话者明确的情感表达
papers.authors: Greg Buda, Ignacio J. Tripodi, Kelly L. Zuromski, Margaret Meagher, Elizabeth A. Olson
papers.abstract: Understanding the emotions that individuals in crisis express is a clinically relevant goal. Here, we introduce an automated method for extracting present and past personal emotion expressions from text-based crisis conversations, enabling nuanced analyses of how these emotional profiles vary by age. We develop a three-tier emotion taxonomy and leverage both real conversation data and synthetic sentences to train a transformer-based model that captures contextual distinctions between true personal emotion expressions and other mentions. Our RoBERTa-based classifier outperforms both a regex baseline and a model trained only on real conversation data, achieving an F1 score of 0.856. Subsequent analysis of 338,924 crisis conversations shows that age is correlated with distinct patterns in emotional expressions. These findings underscore the clinical value of age-sensitive emotion analysis and constitute an initial step toward characterizing lexical variations across demographic groups.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解处于危机中的个体所表达的情绪是一个具有临床意义的课题。在这里，我们提出了一种自动化方法，可以从基于文本的危机对话中提取当前和过去的个人情绪表达，从而能够细致分析这些情绪特征如何随年龄而变化。我们构建了一个三层次的情绪分类体系，并利用真实对话数据以及合成句子来训练一个基于Transformer的模型，以捕捉真实个人情绪表达与其他表述之间的上下文差异。我们的RoBERTa分类器在F1分数方面表现优于仅使用正则表达式进行基线分析或仅基于真实对话数据训练的模型，其F1分数达到了0.856。对338,924条危机对话的后续分析表明，年龄与情绪表达的不同模式之间存在相关性。这些发现凸显了针对年龄差异进行情绪分析的临床价值，并为描述不同人群在词汇上的差异提供了初步依据。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: WikiVideo: Article Generation from Multiple Videos
papers.title_zh: 维基视频：基于多段视频生成文章
papers.authors: Alexander Martin, Reno Kriz, William Gantt Walden, Kate Sanders, Hannah Recknor, Eugene Yang, Francis Ferraro, Benjamin Van Durme
papers.abstract: We introduce the task of grounded article generation with the goal of creating a Wikipedia-style article from multiple diverse videos about real-world events—from natural disasters to political elections—where all the information in the article is supported by video evidence. Videos are intuitive sources for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), but most contemporary RAG workflows focus heavily on text while existing methods for video-based summarization focus on low-level scene understanding rather than high-level event semantics. To close this gap, we introduce , a benchmark consisting of expert-written articles and densely annotated videos that provide evidence for articles’ claims, facilitating the integration of video into RAG pipelines and enabling the creation of in-depth content that is grounded in multimodal sources. We further propose Collaborative Article Generation (CAG), a novel interactive method for article creation from multiple videos. CAG leverages an iterative interaction between an r1-style reasoning model and a VideoLLM to draw higher-level inferences about the target event than is possible with VideoLLMs alone, which fixate on low-level visual features. We benchmark state-of-the-art VideoLLMs and CAG in both oracle retrieval and RAG settings and find that CAG consistently outperforms alternative methods, while suggesting intriguing avenues for future work.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了基于视频的生成任务，其目标是从多部关于现实世界事件的视频中，创作出类似维基百科风格的文章——这些事件包括自然灾害到政治选举等各个领域。文章中的所有信息都需要有视频证据作为支撑。视频是检索增强生成技术的理想数据源，但目前大多数检索增强工作流程主要关注文本处理，而基于视频的摘要方法则侧重于低层次场景理解，而非高层次的事件语义分析。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个基准测试：该测试包含由专家撰写的文章以及带有详细注释的视频，这些视频为文章中的观点提供了证据支持，从而有助于将视频元素整合到检索增强生成流程中，进而创造出基于多模态数据的深入内容。我们还提出了协作文章生成技术，这是一种新颖的互动式文章创作方法。该方法利用r1风格推理模型与VideoLLM之间的迭代交互，能够得出比单独使用VideoLLM更为高级的目标事件推断结果，因为后者往往只关注低层次的视觉特征。我们在真实检索和检索增强两种环境下对最先进的VideoLLM和协作文章生成技术进行了对比测试，发现协作文章生成技术在性能上始终优于其他方法，同时也为未来的研究指明了方向。

papers.title: Large Language Models Are Effective Human Annotation Assistants, But Not Good Independent Annotators
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型可以成为有效的人类注释辅助工具，但它们并不能很好地替代独立注释者的工作
papers.authors: Feng Gu, Zongxia Li, Carlos R. Colon, Benjamin Evans, Ishani Mondal, Jordan Lee Boyd-Graber
papers.abstract: Event annotation is important for identifying, monitoring, and understanding sociological trends. Although expert annotators set the gold standard, they are expensive and inefficient. While state-of-the-art NLP models are an attractive alternative, they are often evaluated on standalone subtasks rather than entire workflows. Thus, we evaluate a holistic workflow that summarizes news with event coreference resolution and argument extraction in three modes: AI-only, AI assistance, and human only. Although AI’s recall is seven times higher than the tf-idf baseline at coreference resolution, it is far from replacing experts. However, experts adopt AI-extracted arguments 60% of the time, reducing extraction time by 25%. Our code and data are in https://github.com/Obertura777/gtd-data.
papers.abstract_zh: 事件注释对于识别、监控和理解社会学趋势非常重要。虽然专业的注释者能够树立行业标准，但他们成本高昂且效率低下。而先进的自然语言处理模型则是一种有吸引力的替代方案，不过这些模型通常只针对某些子任务进行评估，而非整个工作流程。因此，我们评估了一种综合工作流程，该流程通过事件共指解析和论点提取功能，在三种模式下处理新闻数据：仅使用人工智能模式、结合人工智能与人工模式的模式，以及完全依赖人工模式的模式。尽管在共指解析方面，人工智能的召回率比基于TF-IDF的基线方法高出七倍，但它还远无法取代专家的判断。不过，专家在60%的情况下会采用人工智能提取出的论点，这大大缩短了提取时间，减少了25%。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/Obertura777/gtd-data下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Accelerating LLM Fine-Tuning via Embedding Knowledge Transfer
papers.title_zh: 通过嵌入知识转移加速大语言模型的微调过程
papers.authors: Meishu Peng, Ziyue Zhang, Yi Zhang, Pengyang Wang, Zixuan Yuan, Denghui Zhang
papers.abstract: Incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs) for downstream tasks has recently garnered considerable attention, where fine-tuning plays a key role in LLMs’ adaptation. These LLMs, often consisting of billions of parameters, require vast amounts of computational resources when customizing them for new tasks. To mitigate this, researchers have proposed the parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) as a practical solution by adjusting fewer parameters of a pre-trained LLM. However, these methods heavily rely on their own structural modifications that fail to establish an efficient knowledge-sharing mechanism to distill rich knowledge from other expert models, which may lead to inefficient fine-tuning. In this paper, we propose Pen2Sword, a lightweight fine-tuning framework for domain adaptation which efficiently transfers knowledge from a small expert model to a target large model via embedding layers, significantly enhancing the fine-tuning efficiency of large models. Specifically, we first selects optimal expert models via a preserving function, then facilitates knowledge transfer through vocabulary alignment and embedding expansion, and finally accelerates domain adaptation with a fast fine-tuning paradigm. Extensive empirical evaluations across multiple domains demonstrate that our Pen2Sword framework consistently accelerates domain-specific fine-tuning, improves model performance (e.g., +13.6% in code and +20.1% in math), and remains robust across diverse model families and PEFT methods. The codes and data are available at https://github.com/pengmeishu/Pen2Sword.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型应用于下游任务最近受到了广泛关注，其中微调在大语言模型的适配过程中起着关键作用。这些通常由数十亿参数组成的大语言模型，在针对新任务进行定制时需要大量的计算资源。为了缓解这一问题，研究人员提出了参数高效微调方法，通过调整预训练语言模型的少量参数来实现高效的模型适配。然而，这些方法严重依赖于自身的结构性修改，无法建立有效的知识共享机制来从其他专家模型中提取丰富的知识，这可能导致微调效率低下。在本文中，我们提出了Pen2Sword这一轻量级微调框架，该框架能够通过嵌入层有效地将知识从小型专家模型传输到目标大型模型中，从而显著提高大型模型的微调效率。具体来说，我们首先通过保留函数选择出最优的专家模型，然后通过词汇对齐和嵌入扩展来促进知识的传递，最后通过快速微调范式加速领域适配过程。在多个领域的广泛实证评估表明，我们的Pen2Sword框架能够持续提高特定领域的微调效率，提升模型性能（例如，代码任务提升了13.6%，数学任务提升了20.1%），并且能够在不同的模型家族和参数高效微调方法下保持稳定性能。相关的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/pengmeishu/Pen2Sword下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Understanding Secret Leakage Risks in Code LLMs: A Tokenization Perspective
papers.title_zh: 理解代码语言模型中的秘密泄露风险：从分词角度进行分析
papers.authors: Meifang Chen, Zhe Yang, Huang Nianchen, Yizhan Huang, Yichen LI, Zihan Li, Michael R. Lyu
papers.abstract: Code secrets are sensitive assets for software developers, and their leakage poses significant cybersecurity risks. While the rapid development of AI code assistants powered by Code Large Language Models (CLLMs), CLLMs are shown to inadvertently leak such secrets due to a notorious memorization phenomenon. This study first reveals that Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenization leads to unexpected behavior of secret memorization, which we term as gibberish bias. Specifically, we identified that some secrets are among the easiest for CLLMs to memorize. These secrets yield high character-level entropy, but low token-level entropy. Then, this paper supports the biased claim with numerical data. We identified that the roots of the bias are the token distribution shift between the CLLM training data and the secret data. We further discuss how gibberish bias manifests under the “larger vocabulary” trend. To conclude the paper, we discuss potential mitigation strategies and the broader implications on current tokenizer design.
papers.abstract_zh: 代码秘钥是软件开发者极为敏感的资产，其泄露会带来严重的网络安全风险。随着基于大语言模型的人工智能代码助手的发展，人们发现这些模型会由于一种著名的“记忆现象”而无意中泄露这些秘钥。本研究首先揭示了字节对编码（BPE）分词方式会导致秘钥记忆出现异常行为，我们将其称为“无意义偏见”。具体来说，我们发现某些秘钥是最容易被大语言模型记住的。这些秘钥在字符级具有较高熵值，但在词元级却很低。随后，本文通过数值数据支持了这种偏见的存在。我们发现，这种偏见的根源在于大语言模型训练数据与秘钥数据之间的词元分布差异。我们还探讨了在“词汇量较大”的情况下，这种无意义偏见是如何出现的。最后，本文讨论了潜在的缓解策略以及这对当前分词器设计的影响。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MALLM-GAN: Multi-Agent Large Language Model as Generative Adversarial Network for Synthesizing Tabular Data
papers.title_zh: MALLM-GAN：一种基于生成对抗网络的多智能体大型语言模型，用于合成表格数据
papers.authors: Yaobin Ling, Xiaoqian Jiang, Yejin Kim
papers.abstract: In the era of big data, access to abundant data is crucial to driving research forward. However, such data are often inaccessible due to privacy concerns or high costs, particularly in the healthcare domain. Generating synthetic (tabular) data can address this, but existing models typically require substantial amounts of data to train effectively, contradicting our objective of solving data scarcity. To address this challenge, we propose a novel framework to generate synthetic tabular data, powered by large language models (LLMs) that emulates the architecture of a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). By incorporating the data generation process as contextual information and utilizing LLM as the optimizer, our approach significantly enhances the quality of synthetic data generation in common scenarios with small sample sizes. Our experimental results on public and private datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms several state-of-art models regarding generating higher quality synthetic data for downstream tasks while keeping the privacy of the real data in low data regime. Code is available at https://github.com/yling1105/MALLM-GAN.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大数据时代，获取丰富的数据对于推动研究进展至关重要。然而，由于隐私问题或高昂的成本，这类数据往往难以获取，尤其是在医疗保健领域。生成合成数据可以解决这个问题，但现有的模型通常需要大量数据才能有效训练，这与我们解决数据稀缺问题的目标相悖。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，利用大语言模型来生成合成表格数据，该模型模仿了生成对抗网络的结构。通过将数据生成过程作为上下文信息，并利用大语言模型作为优化器，我们的方法显著提升了在样本量较小的情况下生成高质量合成数据的能力。我们在公共和私有数据集上的实验结果表明，与现有模型相比，我们的模型能够在保持真实数据隐私性的同时，生成出更高质量的合成数据，适用于各种下游任务。代码可访问于https://github.com/yling1105/MALLM-GAN。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EMCompress: Video-LLMs with Endomorphic Multimodal Compression
papers.title_zh: EMCompress：基于内态多模态压缩技术的视频低延迟传输方案
papers.authors: Zheyu Fan, Jiateng Liu, Yuji Zhang, Zihan Wang, Yi R. Fung, Manling Li, Heng Ji
papers.abstract: Video-LLMs face a fundamental tension in long-video reasoning: static, sparse frame sampling either dilutes evidence across task-irrelevant segments at significant cost or misses fine-grained temporal semantics altogether. We propose a novel, cognitively-inspired task — Endomorphic Multimodal Compression (EMC) — as a structurally-constrained sufficient-statistic problem for VideoQA, and formulate it as an endomorphic transformation F_EMC : (V, Q) → (v, q) that compresses the multimodal input while preserving answer invariance across reasonable downstream models. The endomorphic form keeps the compressed output in the downstream pipeline’s native task space — a structural mirror of the filter-then-reason mechanism in the cognitive literature motivating EMC — distinguishing it from latent-code compression (IB / VIB) and making the formulation extensible to other multimodal settings. Under the Markov chain A → (V, Q) → (v, q), EMC realizes the classical sufficiency condition I((v, q); A) = I((V, Q); A) in its VideoQA-natural form. As a modular front-end, EMC plugs into both Video Instruction Tuning and Video Question Answering pipelines. We release the first dedicated benchmark and propose ReSimplifyIt, an EMC baseline surpassing prior methods by 0.40 F-1 with competitive query rewriting. Integrating EMC yields relative gains of 7.33% in training and 33.7% in inference for video-language understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 在长视频推理中，视频LLM面临着一个根本性的矛盾：静态的、稀疏的帧采样要么会严重削弱与任务无关片段中的证据，要么完全忽略细微的时间语义信息。我们提出了一种基于认知原理的新方法——端形多模态压缩（EMC），将其作为一种结构约束的充足性问题来解决视频问答任务。我们将该问题表述为端形变换F_EMC：(V, Q) → (v, q)，该变换能够在保留答案不变性的同时，对多模态输入进行压缩处理。这种端形形式使得压缩后的输出能够保持在下游处理流程的原生任务空间中——这与认知文献中“先过滤再推理”的机制类似，这也是选择EMC而非潜在代码压缩（IB/VIB）的原因。此外，这种模型的可扩展性使其适用于其他多模态场景。在马尔可夫链A → (V, Q) → (v, q)的基础上，EMC实现了经典的充足性条件I((v, q); A) = I((V, Q); A)。作为模块化前端，EMC可以集成到视频指令调优和视频问答处理流程中。我们发布了首个专用基准测试，并提出了ReSimplifyIt这一EMC基线模型，其性能比现有方法高出0.40 F-1，并且在查询重写方面也表现出竞争力。通过整合EMC，我们在视频-语言理解方面的训练和推理效率分别提高了7.33%和33.7%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Learning from Contrastive Prompts: An Automated Prompt Optimization Framework
papers.title_zh: 从对比式提示中学习：一种自动提示优化框架
papers.authors: Mingqi Li, Karan Aggarwal, Yong Xie, Aitzaz Ahmad, Stephen Lau
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, significant effort is spent on manually crafting prompts to unlock their full potential. While existing prompt optimization methods automate this process, they often underperform due to their reliance on learning exclusively from incorrect samples. We propose the Learning from Contrastive Prompts (LCP) framework, which leverages contrastive prompts to distinguish between high- and low-performing cases. By identifying and amplifying the differences that make prompts effective, LCP systematically extracts principles underlying successful prompt design. On the Big-Bench Hard benchmark, LCP achieves an 87.5% win rate on Claude-3-Sonnet and 75.7% on Claude-4-Sonnet. Experiments on DeepSeek-R1 (88.2% win rate) and SuperGLUE further confirm that LCP generalizes across both proprietary and open-source models and diverse NLU benchmarks.The framework offers a principled and scalable foundation for automated prompt engineering, reducing manual intervention in adapting LLMs to diverse applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的发展，人们投入了大量精力来手动设计提示以充分发挥其潜力。虽然现有的提示优化方法可以自动化这一过程，但由于它们仅依赖于从错误的样本中进行学习，因此往往效果不佳。我们提出了“从对比性提示中学习”框架，该框架利用对比性提示来区分高性能和低性能的情况。通过识别并放大使提示有效的差异，LCP能够系统地提取出成功提示设计背后的原理。在Big-Bench Hard基准测试中，LCP在Claude-3-Sonnet上的胜率为87.5%，在Claude-4-Sonnet上的胜率为75.7%。在DeepSeek-R1（胜率88.2%）和SuperGLUE上的实验进一步证实，LCP能够在专有模型和开源模型以及各种自然语言处理基准测试中取得良好的效果。该框架为自动提示设计提供了原则性强且可扩展的基础，减少了在将LLM适应于不同应用时需要手动干预的工作。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Private Seeds, Public LLMs: Realistic and Privacy-Preserving Synthetic Data Generation
papers.title_zh: 私有种子，公共大型语言模型：实用且能保护隐私的合成数据生成方法
papers.authors: Qian Ma, Sarah Rajtmajer
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful tool for synthetic data generation. A particularly important use case is producing synthetic replicas of private text, which requires carefully balancing privacy and utility. We propose Realistic and Privacy-Preserving Synthetic Data Generation (RPSG), which uses private seeds and integrates privacy-preserving strategies, including a formal differential privacy (DP) mechanism in the candidate selection, to generate realistic synthetic data. Comprehensive experiments against state-of-the-art private synthetic data generation methods demonstrate that RPSG achieves high fidelity to private data while providing strong privacy protection.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已成为生成合成数据的强大工具。其中一个非常重要的应用场景就是生成私人文本的合成副本，这需要在隐私与实用性之间做出谨慎的平衡。我们提出了一种名为“真实且保护隐私的合成数据生成”的方法，该方法使用私有种子，并整合了多种保护隐私的策略，包括在候选数据选择阶段采用正式的差分隐私机制，从而生成逼真的人工合成数据。针对最先进的私人合成数据生成方法的全面实验表明，RPSG能够在保证高度隐私性的同时，实现与原始数据的高度一致性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ToolScope: An Agentic Framework for Vision-Guided and Long-Horizon Tool Use
papers.title_zh: ToolScope：一种基于视觉引导的长周期工具使用框架
papers.authors: Mengjie Deng, Guanting Dong, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable problem-solving capabilities by autonomously integrating with external tools for collaborative reasoning. However, due to the inherently complex and diverse nature of multimodal information, enabling multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to flexibly and efficiently utilize external tools during reasoning remains an underexplored challenge. In this work, we introduce ToolScope, an agentic framework designed to unify global planning with local multimodal perception, adopting a specialized Perceive tool to mitigates visual context degradation in long-horizon VQA task. ToolScope comprises three primary components: the Global Navigator, the Agentic Executor, and the Response Synthesizer. The Global Navigator functions as a "telescope”, offering high-level strategic guidance. The Agentic Executor operates iteratively to augment MLLM with local perception through the integration of external tools—Search, Code, and Perceive. Finally, the Response Synthesizer consolidates and organizes the reasoning process into a coherent, user-friendly output. We evaluate ToolScope on four VQA benchmarks across diverse domains, including VQA 2.0, ScienceQA, MAT-Search and MathVista. It demonstrates strong generalization capabilities, achieving an average performance improvement of up to +6.69% across all datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/dengmengjie/ToolScope.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，大语言模型通过自主与外部工具集成进行协作推理，展现出了出色的解决问题的能力。然而，由于多模态信息的复杂性和多样性，使得多模态大语言模型能够在推理过程中灵活高效地利用外部工具，这一挑战尚未得到充分探索。在这项研究中，我们提出了ToolScope这一智能框架，该框架旨在将全局规划与局部多模态感知相结合，并通过专门的Perceive工具来减轻长视界视觉问答任务中的视觉上下文退化问题。ToolScope由三个主要组件构成：全局导航器、智能执行器以及响应合成器。全局导航器充当“望远镜”，提供高层次的战略指导；智能执行器则通过整合搜索、代码和感知等外部工具，逐步增强多模态大语言模型的局部感知能力；最后，响应合成器将推理过程整合并组织成易于理解的输出结果。我们在包括VQA 2.0、ScienceQA、MAT-Search和MathVista在内的四个视觉问答基准测试平台上对ToolScope进行了评估，结果显示其具有强大的泛化能力，在所有数据集上的平均性能提升最高达6.69%。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/dengmengjie/ToolScope下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VChain: Chain-of-Visual-Thought for Reasoning in Video Generation
papers.title_zh: VChain：一种用于视频生成的视觉思维链推理系统
papers.authors: Ziqi Huang, Ning Yu, Gordon Chen, Haonan Qiu, Paul Debevec, Ziwei Liu
papers.abstract: Recent video generation models can produce smooth and visually appealing clips, but they often struggle to synthesize complex dynamics with a coherent chain of consequences. Accurately modeling visual outcomes and state transitions over time remains a core challenge. In contrast, large language and multimodal models (e.g., GPT-4o) exhibit strong visual state reasoning and future prediction capabilities. To bridge these strengths, we introduce VChain, a novel inference-time chain-of-visual-thought framework that injects visual reasoning signals from multimodal models into video generation. Specifically, VChain contains a dedicated pipeline that leverages large multimodal models to generate a sparse set of critical keyframes as snapshots, which are then used to guide the sparse inference-time visual-state adaptation of a pre-trained video generator only at these key moments. Our approach is tuning-efficient, introduces minimal overhead and avoids dense supervision. Extensive experiments on complex, multi-step scenarios show that VChain significantly enhances the quality of generated videos.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的视频生成模型能够创造出流畅且视觉上吸引人的视频片段，但它们往往难以合成具有连贯因果关系的复杂动态。准确模拟视觉效果以及随时间变化的状态转换仍然是一个核心挑战。相比之下，大型语言模型和多模态模型（例如GPT-4o）则具备强大的视觉状态推理能力和未来预测能力。为了结合这两种模型的优势，我们提出了VChain这一新型的视频生成时间链框架。该框架将来自多模态模型的视觉推理信号融入视频生成过程中。具体来说，VChain包含一个专门的流程，它利用大型多模态模型生成一组关键的关键帧快照，这些快照随后被用来指导预训练过的视频生成器在这些关键时刻进行稀疏的视觉状态适应。我们的方法具有高效的调优能力，几乎不增加额外的开销，同时避免了密集的监督需求。在复杂的多步骤场景中的大量实验表明，VChain显著提升了生成视频的质量。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Diversity Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: Structural Coupling and Collective Failure in Open-Ended Idea Generation
papers.title_zh: 多智能体大语言模型系统中的多样性崩溃：结构耦合与集体失效在开放式创意生成中的表现
papers.authors: Nuo Chen, Yicheng Tong, Yuzhe Yang, Yufei He, Xueyi Zhang, Zou Qingyun, Qian Wang, Bingsheng He
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly used for open-ended idea generation, driven by the expectation that collective interaction will broaden the exploration diversity. However, when and why such collaboration truly expands the solution space remains unclear. We present a systematic empirical study of diversity in MAS-based ideation across three bottom-up levels: model intelligence, agent cognition, and system dynamics. At the model level, we identify a compute efficiency paradox, where stronger, highly aligned models yield diminishing marginal diversity despite higher per-sample quality. At the cognition level, authority-driven dynamics suppress semantic diversity compared to junior-dominated groups. At the system level, group-size scaling yields diminishing returns and dense communication topologies accelerate premature convergence. We characterize these outcomes as collective failures emerging from structural coupling, a process where interaction inadvertently contracts agent exploration and triggers diversity collapse. Our analysis shows that this collapse arises primarily from the interaction structure rather than inherent model insufficiency, highlighting the importance of preserving independence and disagreement when designing MAS for creative tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xtra-Computing/MAS_Diversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 多智能体系统在开放式创意生成中的应用越来越广泛，人们认为集体互动能够拓宽探索的多样性。然而，这种合作究竟何时以及为何能真正拓展解决方案的空间，仍然不清楚。我们开展了一项系统的实证研究，探讨基于多智能体的创意生成过程中的多样性问题，涉及三个层次：模型智能、智能体认知以及系统动态。在模型层面，我们发现了一个计算效率悖论：虽然高度协同的模型能够提升每个样本的质量，但其带来的边际多样性却逐渐下降。在认知层面，由权威主导的动态模式会抑制语义多样性，而由年轻成员主导的群体则更容易出现这种情况。在系统层面，群体规模的增加会导致回报递减，而密集的通信结构则会加速系统的过早收敛。我们将这些结果归因于结构性耦合所带来的集体失败——这种耦合机制会无意中限制智能体的探索行为，从而导致多样性的崩溃。我们的分析表明，这种崩溃主要源于交互结构的问题，而非模型本身的不足，这凸显了在设计用于创造性任务的多智能体系统时，保持独立性和分歧的重要性。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Xtra-Computing/MAS_Diversity下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Justice in Judgment: Unveiling (Hidden) Bias in LLM-assisted Peer Reviews
papers.title_zh: 公正的裁决：揭示由大型语言模型辅助的同行评审中的偏见问题
papers.authors: Sai Suresh Macharla Vasu, Ivaxi Sheth, Hui-Po Wang, Ruta Binkyte, Mario Fritz
papers.abstract: The adoption of large language models (LLMs) is transforming the peer review process, from assisting reviewers in writing detailed evaluations to generating entire reviews automatically. While these capabilities offer new opportunities, they also raise concerns about fairness and reliability. In this paper, we investigate bias in LLM-generated peer reviews through controlled interventions on author metadata, including affiliation, gender, seniority, and publication history. Our analysis consistently shows a strong affiliation bias favoring authors from highly ranked institutions. We also identify directional preferences associated with seniority and prior publication record, which can influence acceptance decisions for borderline papers. Gender effects are smaller but present in several models. Notably, implicit biases become more pronounced when examining token-level soft ratings, suggesting that alignment may mask but not fully eliminate underlying preferences.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的采用正在改变同行评审的过程，它们不仅能够帮助评审员撰写详细的评价，还能自动生成完整的评审内容。虽然这些功能带来了新的机会，但也引发了关于公平性和可靠性的担忧。在本文中，我们通过对作者元数据进行控制性干预，来研究LLM生成的同行评审中的偏见现象。这些元数据包括机构隶属关系、性别、学术资历以及发表历史等。我们的分析一致表明，存在明显的偏向性，即那些来自排名较高的机构的作者更容易获得青睐。我们还发现了与学术资历和以往发表记录相关的偏好趋势，这些偏好可能会影响对边缘论文的接受决策。性别因素的影响相对较小，但在一些模型中仍然存在。值得注意的是，当检查 词元 级别的软性评分时，隐性偏见表现得更为明显，这表明一致性可能掩盖了潜在的偏好倾向，但并未完全消除这些偏好。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Study of LLMs’ Preferences for Libraries and Programming Languages
papers.title_zh: 关于大语言模型对编程语言和库的选择偏好研究
papers.authors: Lukas Twist, Mark Harman, Don Syme, Joost Noppen, Helen Yannakoudakis, Detlef Nauck, Jie M. Zhang
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid progress of large language models (LLMs) in code generation, existing evaluations focus on functional correctness or syntactic validity, overlooking how LLMs make critical design choices such as which library or programming language to use.To fill this gap, we perform the first empirical study of LLMs’ preferences for libraries and programming languages when generating code, covering eight diverse LLMs.We observe a strong tendency to overuse widely adopted libraries such as NumPy; in up to 45% of cases, this usage is not required and deviates from the ground-truth solutions.The LLMs we study also show a significant preference toward Python as their default language.For high-performance project initialisation tasks where Python is not the optimal language, it remains the dominant choice in 58% of cases, and Rust is not used once.These results highlight how LLMs prioritise familiarity and popularity over suitability and task-specific optimality;underscoring the need for targeted fine-tuning, data diversification, and evaluation benchmarks that explicitly measure language and library selection fidelity.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在代码生成方面取得了迅速的进步，但现有的评估大多集中在功能正确性或语法有效性上，而忽略了模型在如何选择库或编程语言等关键设计决策上的表现。为了填补这一空白，我们进行了首次关于语言模型在生成代码时对库和编程语言偏好的实证研究，涉及了八种不同的语言模型。我们发现，这些模型普遍存在过度使用广泛采用的库（如NumPy）的现象；在高达45%的情况下，这种使用是不必要的，且偏离了真正的解决方案。我们研究的语言模型还表现出对Python的显著偏好，将其作为默认编程语言。在需要高性能的项目初始化任务中，当Python不是最佳选择时，它仍然占据了58%的情况下的主导地位，而Rust则从未被使用过。这些结果凸显了语言模型在优先考虑熟悉度和流行度而非适用性和特定任务的最优性方面存在的问题，这进一步强调了进行针对性微调、数据多样化以及建立能够明确衡量语言和库选择准确性的评估基准的必要性。

papers.title: Unveiling Inherent Visual Grounding in Multimodal LLMs for Text-Rich Images
papers.title_zh: 在多模态大语言模型中揭示用于包含文本的图像的固有视觉基础
papers.authors: Shijie Zhou, Jihyung Kil, Ming Li, Jiuxiang Gu, Curtis Wigington, Rajiv Jain, Changyou Chen, Ruiyi Zhang
papers.abstract: Visual text grounding provides interpretable evidence for document question answering. Due to the complex layouts and mixed visual-text contents in text-rich images, effective visual text grounding requires strong visual and spatial reasoning to localize multiple referenced regions. Existing multimodal large language model (MLLM) approaches often struggle to align query tokens with visual–text patches, heavily relying on lengthy OCR inputs. To tackle this problem, we propose Doc-AGround, an OCR-free approach that leverages the MLLM’s inherent multi-head attention for multi-patch grounding. Doc-AGround extracts a patch-wise attention map as the grounding prediction. Concurrently, it introduces an effective multi-head weighting mechanism to amplify the attention heads’ intrinsic role in connecting vision and text. Empirical results of Doc-AGround show state-of-the-art performance on challenging document grounding benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed attention-based grounding design.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉文本定位为文档问答提供了可解释的答案。由于富含文本的图像中布局复杂且视觉文本内容多样，有效的视觉文本定位需要强大的视觉和空间推理能力来定位多个参考区域。现有的多模态大语言模型方法往往难以将查询令牌与视觉文本片段进行对齐，这很大程度上依赖于冗长的OCR输入。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Doc-AGround这一无需OCR的方法，该方法利用大语言模型的多头注意力机制来实现多片段定位。Doc-AGround提取出逐片注意力图作为定位预测结果。同时，它引入了一种有效的多头加权机制，以强化注意力头在连接视觉和文本方面的作用。实验结果表明，Doc-AGround在具有挑战性的文档定位基准测试中表现优异，证明了所提出的基于注意力的定位设计的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PUMA: Projected Universal Multilingual ASR for Low-Resource Settings. Application to Diverse African Languages
papers.title_zh: PUMA：适用于资源有限环境下的通用多语言语音识别系统。该系统可应用于多种非洲语言
papers.authors: Ilyes Oukid, Bilal Faye, Hanane Azzag, Mustapha Lebbah, Said Yacine Boulahia
papers.abstract: Multilingual ASR systems often fail to generalize to low-resource and linguistically diverse languages while remaining costly to scale. We introduce PUMA, a unified multilingual ASR model that improves low-resource performance with reduced model complexity. PUMA employs a Universal Language Projection (ULP) module that integrates a learnable language token with acoustic representations, enabling language-aware processing through shared parameters. Experiments on diverse African languages show consistent word error rate reductions over strong multilingual baselines, highlighting improved robustness and generalization. Our code is available at the following GitHub URL: https://github.com/ilyes-okd/PUMA
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言自动语音识别系统往往难以适应资源匮乏且语言多样化的语言环境，同时其扩展成本也较高。我们提出了PUMA模型，这是一种统一的多语言自动语音识别模型，它能够以较低的模型复杂度提升对资源匮乏语言的识别性能。PUMA采用了一种通用语言投影模块，该模块将可学习的语言标记与声学表示相结合，通过共享参数实现语言感知处理。在多种非洲语言的实验结果表明，与强大的多语言基线模型相比，PUMA在单词错误率方面取得了显著的改善，充分体现了其更强的鲁棒性和泛化能力。我们的代码可以在以下GitHub链接中找到：https://github.com/ilyes-okd/PUMA
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MGPO: Thinking with Images via Multi-Turn Grounding-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: MGPO：基于多轮基础学习的图像思维强化学习方法
papers.authors: Xinyu Huang, Yuhao Dong, Weiwei Tian, Bo Li, Rui Feng, Ziwei Liu
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art large multi-modal models (LMMs) face challenges when processing high-resolution images, as these inputs are converted into enormous visual tokens, many of which are irrelevant to the downstream task. In this paper, we propose Multi-turn Grounding-based Policy Optimization (MGPO), an end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) framework that enables LMMs to iteratively focus on key visual regions by automatically cropping sub-images, based on model-predicted grounding coordinates within a multi-turn conversation framework. Compared to supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which requires costly additional grounding annotations, our approach highlights that LMMs can emerge robust grounding abilities during the RL training process, leveraging only a binary reward function derived from the correctness of the final answer. Additionally, we observe that LMMs struggle to autonomously trigger visual grounding during the rollout process. To address this cold start problem, we design a multi-turn conversational template and restrict policy loss computation to model outputs generated across multiple dialogue rounds, thereby promoting stable optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, when trained on standard visual-question-short answering data without grounding annotations, MGPO effectively elicits stronger grounding capabilities compared to GRPO, leading to 5.4% improvement on in-distribution MME-Realworld and 5.2% improvement on the challenging out-of-distribution (OOD) V* Bench. Notably, MGPO post-training on Qwen2.5-VL-7B with 21K samples surpasses OpenAI’s o1 and GPT-4o models on the OOD V* Bench.
papers.abstract_zh: 先进的大型多模态模型在处理高分辨率图像时面临挑战，因为这些输入会被转化为庞大的视觉标记，其中许多与下游任务无关。在本文中，我们提出了基于多轮引导的策略优化方法（MGPO），这是一种端到端的强化学习框架，它能够通过自动裁剪子图像，基于模型预测的引导坐标，让多模态模型逐步聚焦于关键的视觉区域。与需要大量额外引导注释的监督式微调（SFT）相比，我们的方法表明，多模态模型在强化学习训练过程中可以展现出强大的引导能力，而只需使用基于最终答案正确性的二元奖励函数即可。此外，我们发现多模态模型在滚动过程中难以自主触发视觉引导。为了解决这一冷启动问题，我们设计了一个多轮对话模板，并将策略损失计算限制在多个对话回合生成的模型输出上，从而促进稳定的优化过程。大量实验表明，当在缺乏引导注释的标准视觉问答数据上进行训练时，MGPO能够有效提升多模态模型的引导能力，其效果优于传统的GRPO方法，分别使在分布内的MME-Realworld任务表现提升了5.4%，而在具有挑战性的外部数据V*基准测试中提升了5.2%。值得注意的是，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型上训练后，使用21K样本的数据集训练的MGPO在OOD V*基准测试中的表现超过了OpenAI的o1和GPT-4o模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: How Grounded is Wikipedia? A Study on Structured Evidential Support and Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 维基百科的结构化证据支持程度如何？一项关于结构化证据支持机制及检索算法的研究
papers.authors: William Gantt Walden, Kathryn Ricci, Miriam Wanner, Zhengping Jiang, Chandler May, Rongkun Zhou, Benjamin Van Durme
papers.abstract: Wikipedia is a critical resource for modern NLP, serving as a rich repository of up-to-date and citation-backed information on a wide variety of subjects. The reliability of Wikipedia—its groundedness in its cited sources—is vital to this purpose. This work analyzes both how grounded Wikipedia is and how readily fine-grained grounding evidence can be retrieved. To this end, we introduce PeopleProfiles—a large-scale, multi-level dataset of claim support annotations on biographical Wikipedia articles. We show that: ~22% of claims in Wikipedia lead sections are unsupported by the article body; ~30% of annotated claims in the article body are unsupported by their (publicly accessible) sources; and real-world Wikipedia citation practices often differ from documented standards. Finally, we show that complex evidence retrieval remains a challenge—even for recent reasoning rerankers.
papers.abstract_zh: 维基百科是现代自然语言处理领域的重要资源，它拥有关于各种主题的丰富且最新的、以引用为基础的信息。维基百科的可靠性——其信息源自可靠的引用来源——对于实现这一目的至关重要。本研究分析了维基百科信息的可靠性程度，以及如何便捷地获取详细的证据支持信息。为此，我们引入了一个名为“PeopleProfiles”的大规模多层级数据集，该数据集包含了关于维基百科文章中的人物传记信息的证据注释。研究表明：约22%的维基百科中的声明没有得到文章内容的支持；约30%的带有注释的声明其来源信息并未得到公开可访问的引用资源的支持；此外，现实中的维基百科引用方式往往与记录的标准有所不同。最后，我们发现，即使对于最新的推理重排序算法来说，复杂证据的检索仍然是一个挑战。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Jailbreaking Attacks vs. Content Safety Filters: How Far Are We in the LLM Safety Arms Race?
papers.title_zh: 越狱攻击与内容安全过滤：我们在大型语言模型安全领域上已经推进到什么程度？
papers.authors: Yuan Xin, Dingfan Chen, Linyi Yang, Michael Backes, Xiao Zhang
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed, ensuring their safe use is paramount. Jailbreaking, adversarial prompts that bypass model alignment to trigger harmful outputs, present significant risks, with existing studies reporting high success rates in evading common LLMs. However, previous evaluations have focused solely on the models, neglecting the full deployment pipeline, which typically incorporates additional safety mechanisms like content moderation filters. To address this gap, we present a systematic evaluation of jailbreak attacks targeting LLM safety alignment, assessing their success across the full inference pipeline, including both input and output filtering stages. Our findings yield two key insights: first, nearly all evaluated jailbreak techniques can be detected by at least one safety filter, suggesting that prior assessments may have overestimated the practical success of these attacks; second, while safety filters are effective in detection, there remains room to better balance recall and precision to further optimize protection and user experience.We highlight critical gaps and call for further refinement of detection accuracy and usability in LLM safety systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用，确保其安全使用至关重要。越狱攻击和那些绕过模型对齐以触发有害输出的对抗性提示，带来了巨大的风险。现有研究指出，这些攻击的成功率相当高。然而，之前的评估仅关注于模型本身，而忽略了完整的部署流程，这一流程通常包含内容审核过滤器等额外的安全机制。为了填补这一空白，我们对针对LLM安全对齐的越狱攻击进行了系统性的评估，考察了这些攻击在整个推理流程中的成功情况，包括输入和输出过滤阶段。我们的研究发现有两个重要发现：首先，几乎所有被评估的越狱技术都可以被至少一个安全过滤器检测到，这表明之前的对策可能高估了这些攻击的实际成功率；其次，虽然安全过滤器在检测方面非常有效，但在提高保护效果和用户体验方面，仍有改进召回率和精确度的空间。我们指出了当前存在的关键问题，并呼吁进一步提升LLM安全系统的检测准确性和易用性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
