papers.title: BrowseConf: Confidence-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Web Agents
papers.title_zh: BrowseConf：基于信心的网络代理测试时间调整策略
papers.authors: Litu Ou, Kuan Li, Huifeng Yin, Liwen Zhang, Zhongwang Zhang, Xixi Wu, Rui Ye, Zile Qiao, Yong Jiang, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang, Jingren Zhou
papers.abstract: Confidence in LLMs is a useful indicator of model uncertainty and answer reliability. Existing work mainly focused on single-turn scenarios, while research on confidence in complex multi-turn interactions is limited. In this paper, we investigate whether LLM-based search agents have the ability to communicate their own confidence through verbalized confidence scores after long sequences of actions, a significantly more challenging task compared to outputting confidence in a single interaction. Experimenting on open-source agentic models, we first find that models exhibit much higher task accuracy at high confidence while having near-zero accuracy when confidence is low. Based on this observation, we propose Test-Time Scaling (TTS) methods that use confidence scores to determine answer quality, encourage the model to try again until reaching a satisfactory confidence level. Results show that our proposed methods significantly reduce token consumption while demonstrating competitive performance compared to baseline fixed budget TTS methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 对大语言模型的信任度是衡量模型不确定性和答案可靠性的重要指标。现有的研究主要集中在单轮对话场景中，而关于复杂多轮交互中信任度的研究则相对较少。在本文中，我们探讨了基于大语言模型的搜索代理是否能够在长时间的交互过程中通过口头表达信任度来传达自己的信任程度。这一任务比在单次交互中输出信任度要困难得多。通过对开源代理模型进行实验，我们发现，当模型对问题的信任度较高时，其任务准确率会显著提高；而当信任度较低时，其准确率几乎为零。基于这一观察，我们提出了一种名为“测试时间缩放”的方法，该方法利用信任度分数来评估答案的质量，并促使模型不断尝试直到达到令人满意的信任度水平。实验结果表明，我们提出的方法显著减少了令牌消耗，同时与基准的固定预算测试时间缩放方法相比，其性能也具有竞争力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HyperEdit: Unlocking Instruction-based Text Editing in LLMs via Hypernetworks
papers.title_zh: HyperEdit：通过超网络技术实现在大型语言模型中解锁基于指令的文本编辑功能
papers.authors: Yiming Zeng, Jinghan Cao, Zexin Li, Wanhao Yu, Zhankai Ye, Dawei Xiang, Ting Hua, Xin Liu, Shangqian Gao, Tingting Yu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have fundamentally transformed natural language processing (NLP), demonstrating remarkable capabilities across a wide spectrum of tasks. However, when applied to instruction-based text editing, LLMs continue to exhibit some limitations. Different from free-form generation, instruction-based editing requires precise, targeted modifications that respect two essential properties: faithfully implementing the specific instruction and local fidelity. Existing approaches often overlook these properties, treating editing as a generic text generation problem. As a result, they either over-edit or fail to apply modifications consistently. To address this gap, we propose HyperEdit, a framework that adaptively processes each editing request to best align with it. To achieve this, HyperEdit generates request-specific dynamic weights that guide the editing process. The computational overhead of producing these weights is minimized through a carefully designed hypernetwork. With this design, HyperEdit achieves a relatively 9% improvement over the state-of-the-art editing model.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）从根本上改变了自然语言处理领域，在众多任务中展现出了卓越的能力。然而，当这些模型应用于基于指令的文本编辑时，仍然存在一些局限性。与自由形式的生成不同，基于指令的编辑需要精确的、有针对性的修改，同时必须遵循两个重要原则：忠实执行具体的指令以及保持局部的一致性。现有的方法往往忽略了这两个原则，将编辑视为一种通用的文本生成问题。因此，这些方法要么过度编辑，要么无法有效地进行修改。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了HyperEdit框架。该框架能够自适应地处理每一个编辑请求，使其与请求内容最为匹配。为了实现这一目标，HyperEdit会生成特定于请求的动态权重，以指导编辑过程。通过精心设计的超网络，这些权重的生成计算开销被最小化。凭借这种设计，HyperEdit在编辑性能上相比现有最先进的编辑模型提升了约9%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Strategy-Induct: Task-Level Strategy Induction for Instruction Generation
papers.title_zh: 策略归纳：用于生成教学内容的任务级策略归纳方法
papers.authors: Po-Chun Chen, Hen-Hsen Huang, Hsin-Hsi Chen
papers.abstract: Designing effective task-level prompts is crucial for improving the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). While prior work on instruction induction demonstrates that LLMs can infer better instructions with limited examples, existing approaches often rely on input-output pairs, where obtaining labeled answers can be difficult or costly. To address this limitation, we propose Strategy-Induct, a framework that derives task-level instructions solely from a small set of example questions without requiring labeled answers. Our approach first prompts the model to generate explicit reasoning strategies for each question, forming (strategy, question) pairs. These pairs are then used to induce a task instruction that guides reasoning. Experiments across multiple tasks and model scales demonstrate that Strategy-Induct outperforms state-of-the-art methods in question-only settings. Furthermore, we observe that jointly utilizing LLMs and Large Reasoning Models for both task instruction generation and inference can lead to further performance improvements.
papers.abstract_zh: 设计有效的任务级提示对于提升大语言模型的性能至关重要。虽然之前关于指令提取的研究表明，在有限的示例情况下，大语言模型能够更准确地推断出更好的指令，但现有的方法往往依赖于输入-输出对，而获取带有标签的回答可能会很困难或成本较高。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了Strategy-Induct框架——该框架仅通过少量示例问题来推导任务级指令，而无需使用带有标签的回答。我们的方法首先促使模型为每个问题生成明确的推理策略，形成（策略、问题）对。然后，这些对被用来推导出指导推理的任务指令。在多个任务和不同模型规模上的实验表明，Strategy-Induct在仅有问题的场景中的表现优于现有最先进的方法。此外，我们发现，将大语言模型和大型推理模型结合起来用于任务指令的生成和推理，可以进一步提升性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Idiom Understanding as a Tool to Measure the Dialect Gap
papers.title_zh: 将方言理解视为衡量方言差异的工具
papers.authors: David Beauchemin, Yan Tremblay, Mohamed Amine Youssef, Richard Khoury
papers.abstract: The tasks of idiom understanding and dialect understanding are both well-established benchmarks in natural language processing. In this paper, we propose combining them, and using regional idioms as a test of dialect understanding. Towards this end, we propose three new benchmark datasets for the Quebec dialect of French: QFrCoRE, which contains 4,633 instances of idiomatic phrases, and QFrCoRT, which comprises 171 regional instances of idiomatic words, and a new benchmark for French Metropolitan expressions, MFrCoE, which comprises 4,938 phrases.We explain how to construct these corpora, so that our methodology can be replicated for other dialects. Our experiments with 111 LLMs reveal a critical disparity in dialectal competence: while models perform well on French Metropolitan, 65.77% of them perform significantly worse on Quebec idioms, with only 9.0% favoring the regional dialect. These results confirm that our benchmarks are a reliable tool for quantifying the dialect gap and that prestige-language proficiency does not guarantee regional dialect understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 成语理解和方言理解这两项任务都是自然语言处理领域中已经确立的基准测试。在本文中，我们提出了将它们结合起来的方法，并将地区性成语作为衡量方言理解的指标。为此，我们为魁北克法语方言提出了三个新的基准数据集：QFrCoRE，包含4,633个成语短语；QFrCoRT，包含171个地区性成语词汇；以及一个新的法语都市表达基准数据集MFrCoE，包含4,938个短语。我们详细说明了如何构建这些语料库，以便我们的方法可以应用于其他方言。我们对111个大语言模型进行的实验表明，各模型在法语都市方言方面的表现相当不错，但其中 65.77% 在魁北克习语上的表现显著较差，只有 9.0% 的模型更偏向该地区方言。这些结果证实，我们的基准测试是量化方言差异的可靠工具，同时也表明，掌握优势语言并不能保证对地区性方言的理解能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Logic Jailbreak: Efficiently Unlocking LLM Safety Restrictions Through Formal Logical Expression
papers.title_zh: 逻辑突破：通过形式化的逻辑表达，有效解除大型语言模型的安全限制
papers.authors: Jingyu Peng, Maolin Wang, Nan Wang, Jiatong Li, Yuchen Li, Yuyang Ye, Wanyu Wang, Pengyue Jia, Kai Zhang, Xiangyu Zhao
papers.abstract: Despite substantial advancements in aligning LLMs with human values, current safety mechanisms remain susceptible to jailbreak attacks. We attribute this vulnerability to the distributional discrepancies between alignment-oriented prompts and malicious prompts. To investigate this, and drawing inspiration from logic-driven NLP tasks, we introduce LogiBreak, a universal black-box jailbreak method that utilizes logical expression translation to bypass LLM safety mechanisms. By converting harmful natural language prompts into formal logical expressions, LogiBreak exploits the distributional gap between alignment data and logic-expressed inputs, preserving the underlying semantic intent and readability while evading safety constraints. Furthermore, to fill the gap of existing benchmarks that lack systematic resources specifically targeting logical expression-based attacks against LLM robustness, we construct a novel multilingual logical expression jailbreak dataset for evaluation. Our evaluations of LogiBreak in five languages demonstrate its effectiveness and generalizability in various linguistic contexts. The code is available at https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/ACL2026_Logibreak.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在使大语言模型符合人类价值观方面取得了显著进展，但目前的安全机制仍然容易受到破解攻击。我们认为这种漏洞源于以符合人类价值观为导向的提示与恶意提示之间的分布差异。为了研究这一问题，并借鉴逻辑驱动的自然语言处理任务中的思路，我们提出了LogiBreak这一通用性的黑盒破解方法。该方法利用逻辑表达式转换来绕过大语言模型的安全机制。通过将有害的自然语言提示转化为形式化的逻辑表达式，LogiBreak能够利用对齐数据与逻辑表达输入之间的分布差异，同时保留潜在的语义意图和可读性，从而规避安全限制。此外，由于现有的基准测试缺乏专门针对基于逻辑表达式的攻击的系统性资源，我们构建了一个新的多语言逻辑表达式破解数据集用于评估。我们在五种语言中对LogiBreak进行了测试，结果表明它在不同的语言环境中具有有效的破解能力以及广泛的适用性。该代码的下载链接为：https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/ACL2026_Logibreak。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Two Heads Are Better Than One: Audio-Visual Speech Error Correction with Dual Hypotheses
papers.title_zh: 双头优于单头：利用双重假设进行视听语言错误修正
papers.authors: Sungnyun Kim, Kangwook Jang, Sungwoo Cho, Joon Son Chung, Hoi-Rin Kim, Se-Young Yun
papers.abstract: This paper introduces a new paradigm for generative error correction (GER) framework in audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) that reasons over modality-specific evidences directly in the language space. Our framework, DualHyp, empowers a large language model (LLM) to compose independent N-best hypotheses from separate automatic speech recognition (ASR) and visual speech recognition (VSR) models. To maximize the effectiveness of DualHyp, we further introduce RelPrompt, a noise-aware guidance mechanism that provides modality-grounded prompts to the LLM. RelPrompt offers the temporal reliability of each modality stream, guiding the model to dynamically switch its focus between ASR and VSR hypotheses for an accurate correction. Under various corruption scenarios, our framework attains up to 57.7% error rate gain on the LRS2 benchmark over standard ASR baseline, contrary to single-stream GER approaches that achieve only 10% gain. To facilitate research within our DualHyp framework, we release the code and the dataset comprising ASR and VSR hypotheses at https://github.com/sungnyun/dualhyp.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的生成式错误校正框架——DualHyp，该框架适用于音频-视觉语音识别领域。该框架直接在语言空间中对不同模态的证据进行推理处理。我们的DualHyp框架能够让大语言模型从独立的自动语音识别和视觉语音识别模型中获取最优假设方案。为了提升DualHyp的有效性，我们引入了RelPrompt这一噪声感知的引导机制，它为语言模型提供基于特定模态的提示信息。RelPrompt能够确保每个模态流的时间可靠性，从而引导模型在自动语音识别和视觉语音识别假设之间动态切换焦点，从而实现更准确的错误校正。在各种损坏场景下，我们的框架在LRS2基准测试中的错误率提升了57.7%，而传统的单流生成式错误校正方法仅能提升10%。为了促进对DualHyp框架的研究，我们已在https://github.com/sungnyun/dualhyp上发布了相关代码和包含自动语音识别与视觉语音识别假设的数据集。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Towards Hierarchical Multi-Step Reward Models for Enhanced Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 迈向分层多步骤奖励模型：提升大型语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Teng Wang, Jiang Zhangyi, Zhenqi He, Hailei Gong, Shenyang Tong, Wenhan Yang, Zeyu Li, Yanan Zheng, Zifan He, Zewen Ye, Shengjie Ma, Jianping Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong mathematical reasoning abilities through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. However, existing Process Reward Models (PRMs) are vulnerable to reward hacking and require expensive, large-scale annotation of reasoning steps, limiting their reliability and scalability. To address the first problem, we propose a novel reward model approach, Hierarchical Reward Model (HRM), which evaluates both individual and consecutive reasoning steps from fine-grained and coarse-grained level. HRM excels at assessing multi-step mathematical reasoning coherence, particularly in cases where a flawed step is later corrected through self-reflection. Furthermore, to address the inefficiency of autonomously annotating PRM training data via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), we propose a lightweight data augmentation strategy, Hierarchical Node Compression (HNC), which merges consecutive reasoning steps within the tree structure. Applying HNC to MCTS-generated reasoning trajectories increases the diversity and robustness of HRM training data, while introducing controlled noise with minimal computational overhead. Empirical results on the PRM800K dataset demonstrate that HRM, in conjunction with HNC, achieves superior stability and reliability in evaluation compared to PRM. Furthermore, cross-domain evaluations on MATH500 and GSM8K dataset confirm HRM’s superior generalization and robustness across diverse mathematical reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在经过有监督的微调与强化学习训练后，展现出了强大的数学推理能力。然而，现有的过程奖励模型却容易受到奖励操纵的影响，同时还需要进行成本高昂的大规模标注工作，这限制了它们的可靠性和可扩展性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种创新的奖励模型方法——分层奖励模型。该模型能够同时评估个体推理步骤以及连续推理步骤，既具备细粒度分析能力，又能处理粗粒度问题。分层奖励模型在评估多步数学推理的连贯性方面表现出色，尤其是在某个错误步骤通过自我反思得到修正的情况下。此外，为了克服使用蒙特卡洛树搜索法自动标注过程奖励模型训练数据的低效性，我们提出了一种轻量级的数据增强策略——分层节点压缩。这种策略可以将树结构中的连续推理步骤合并起来，从而提升分层奖励模型训练数据的多样性和鲁棒性，同时以最小的计算开销引入可控的噪声。在PRM800K数据集上的实验结果表明，结合分层奖励模型和分层节点压缩策略的系统，其评估稳定性和可靠性均优于传统的过程奖励模型。此外，在MATH500和GSM8K数据集上的跨领域评估也证实了分层奖励模型在多种数学推理任务中的卓越泛化能力和鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SciVQR: A Multidisciplinary Multimodal Benchmark for Advanced Scientific Reasoning Evaluation
papers.title_zh: SciVQR：一种适用于高级科学推理评估的跨学科、多模态基准方法
papers.authors: Longteng Guo, Xuanxu Lin, Dongze Hao, Tongtian Yue, Pengkang Huo, Jiatong Ma, Yuchen Liu, Jing Liu
papers.abstract: Scientific reasoning is a key aspect of human intelligence, requiring the integration of multimodal inputs, domain expertise, and multi-step inference across various subjects. Existing benchmarks for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often fail to capture the complexity and traceability of reasoning processes necessary for rigorous evaluation. To fill this gap, we introduce SciVQR, a multimodal benchmark covering 54 subfields in mathematics, physics, chemistry, geography, astronomy, and biology. SciVQR includes domain-specific visuals, such as equations, charts, and diagrams, and challenges models to combine visual comprehension with reasoning. The tasks range from basic factual recall to complex, multi-step inferences, with 46% including expert-authored solutions. SciVQR not only evaluates final answers but also examines the reasoning process, providing insights into how models reach their conclusions. Our evaluation of leading MLLMs, including both proprietary and open-source models, reveals significant limitations in handling complex multimodal reasoning tasks, underscoring the need for improved multi-step reasoning and better integration of interdisciplinary knowledge in advancing MLLMs toward true scientific intelligence. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/CASIA-IVA-Lab/SciVQR.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学推理是人类智慧的关键方面，它要求整合多种输入、领域专业知识以及跨不同主题的多步骤推理过程。现有的多模态大语言模型基准测试往往无法充分捕捉出进行严格评估所需的推理过程的复杂性和可追溯性。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了SciVQR这一多模态基准测试，该测试涵盖了数学、物理、化学、地理、天文学和生物学领域的54个子领域。SciVQR包含了特定领域的可视化元素，如方程式、图表和示意图，并挑战模型将视觉理解与推理相结合。任务范围从基本的事实回忆到复杂的多步骤推理，其中46%的任务包含由专家提供的解决方案。SciVQR不仅评估最终答案，还审查推理过程，从而揭示模型是如何得出结论的。我们对主流大语言模型的评估结果显示，无论是专有模型还是开源模型，在处理复杂的多模态推理任务时都存在显著局限性。这凸显了改进多步骤推理能力以及更好地整合跨学科知识的重要性，以推动大语言模型朝着真正的科学智能方向发展。该数据集和评估代码可在https://github.com/CASIA-IVA-Lab/SciVQR获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: UrBLiMP: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Linguistic Competence of Large Language Models in Urdu
papers.title_zh: UrBLiMP：用于评估大型乌尔都语语言模型语言能力的基准测试
papers.authors: Farah Adeeba, Brian Dillon, Hassan Sajjad, Rajesh Bhatt
papers.abstract: Evaluating how large language models (LLMs) capture the grammatical structure of low-resource languages remains underexplored. This paper presents the Urdu Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs (UrBLiMP)—a diagnostic suite of 5,696 minimal pairs that contrast grammatical acceptability across ten core syntactic and morpho-syntactic phenomena in Urdu. The dataset is constructed from the Urdu Treebank and diverse text corpora, and human validation achieves a 96.1% inter-annotator agreement, confirming its reliability. We evaluate twenty one multilingual LLMs, including LLaMA-3-70B and Gemma-3-27B-PT, and additionally assess the proprietary GPT-4o model using grammar-prompting techniques. GPT-4o (grammar-prompted) attains the highest average accuracy (97.4%), reaching near-human performance on regular phenomena such as aspect agreement and ergativity. However, all models continue to struggle with flexible syntactic patterns like word-order variation and long-distance subject–verb agreement. UrBLiMP provides the first controlled evaluation framework for probing morpho-syntactic competence in Urdu and highlights both the progress and remaining challenges of multilingual and proprietary LLMs in low-resource settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，关于大语言模型如何捕捉低资源语言的语法结构的研究仍然不够充分。本文提出了乌尔都语语言最小对基准数据集（UrBLiMP）——该数据集包含5,696对最小对，用于对比乌尔都语中十种核心句法和形态句法现象的语法可接受性。该数据集基于乌尔都语树库和多种文本语料库构建，人工验证结果显示，不同注释者之间的一致性达到了96.1%，这充分证明了该数据集的可靠性。我们评估了21种多语言大语言模型，包括LaLM-3-70B和Gemma-3-27B-PT，同时还使用语法提示技术对专有模型GPT-4o进行了评估。GPT-4o在语法提示模式下取得了最高的平均准确率（97.4%），在诸如主语与谓语的一致性等常规现象上表现接近人类水平。然而，所有模型在处理灵活的句法模式时仍然存在困难，比如词序的变化以及远距离的主谓一致问题。UrBLiMP为探究乌尔都语的形态句法能力提供了首个受控评估框架，同时也揭示了多语言和专有大语言模型在低资源环境下的进展与面临的挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ANCHOR: LLM-driven Subject Conditioning for Text-to-Image Synthesis
papers.title_zh: 锚点：基于大语言模型的主题条件化技术，用于文本到图像的合成
papers.authors: Aashish Anantha Ramakrishnan, Sharon X Huang, Dongwon Lee
papers.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models have achieved remarkable progress in high-quality image synthesis, yet most benchmarks rely on simple, self-contained prompts, failing to capture the complexity of real-world captions. Human-written captions often involve multiple interacting subjects, rich contextual references, and abstractive phrasing, conditions under which current image-text encoders like CLIP struggle. To systematically study these deficiencies, we introduce ANCHOR, a large-scale dataset of 70K+ abstractive captions sourced from five major news media organizations. Analysis with ANCHOR reveals persistent failures in multi-subject understanding, context reasoning, and nuanced grounding. Motivated by these challenges, we propose Subject-Aware Fine-tuning (SAFE), which uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract key subjects and enhance their representation at the embedding-level. Experiments with contemporary models show that SAFE significantly improves image-caption consistency and human preference alignment, serving as a practical and scalable solution. The dataset and code will be released upon publication.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到图像（T2I）模型在高质量图像合成方面取得了显著进展，但大多数基准测试仍然依赖于简单、封闭式的提示方式，无法捕捉到现实世界中标题的复杂性。人类编写的标题通常包含多个相互作用的主体、丰富的上下文信息以及抽象化的表述方式，这些情况是当前图像-文本编码器如CLIP难以处理的。为了系统地研究这些不足，我们引入了ANCHOR这一大规模数据集，该数据集包含7万多条来自五大新闻媒体的抽象化标题。对ANCHOR数据的分析表明，模型在多主体理解、上下文推理以及细微层次上的定位方面仍然存在问题。基于这些挑战，我们提出了主题感知微调（SAFE）方法，该方法利用大语言模型在嵌入层面提取关键主体并增强其表示能力。实验结果表明，SAFE显著提升了图像与标题的一致性以及人类偏好之间的匹配度，是一种实用且可扩展的解决方案。该数据集及其代码将在论文发表后正式发布。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Personalized Benchmarking: Evaluating LLMs by Individual Preferences
papers.title_zh: 个性化评估：根据个人偏好来评价大型语言模型
papers.authors: Cristina Garbacea, Heran Wang, Chenhao Tan
papers.abstract: With the rise in capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and their deployment in real-world tasks, evaluating LLM alignment with human preferences has become an important challenge. Current benchmarks average preferences across all users to compute aggregate ratings, overlooking individual user preferences when establishing model rankings. Since users have varying preferences in different contexts, we call for personalized LLM benchmarks that rank models according to individual needs. We compute personalized model rankings using ELO ratings and Bradley-Terry coefficients for 115 active Chatbot Arena users and analyze how user query characteristics (topics and writing style) relate to LLM ranking variations. We demonstrate that individual rankings of LLM models diverge dramatically from aggregate LLM rankings, with Bradley-Terry correlations averaging only \rho = 0.04 (57% of users show near-zero or negative correlation) and ELO ratings showing moderate correlation (\rho = 0.43). Through topic modeling and style analysis, we find users exhibit substantial heterogeneity in topical interests and communication styles, influencing their model preferences. We further show that a compact combination of topic and style features provides a useful feature space for predicting user-specific model rankings. Our results provide strong quantitative evidence that aggregate benchmarks fail to capture individual preferences for most users, and highlight the importance of developing personalized benchmarks that rank LLM models according to individual user preferences.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型能力的提升及其在现实任务中的应用，评估这些模型与人类偏好的契合度已成为一项重要挑战。目前的基准测试通常采用所有用户的偏好数据进行平均计算，从而得出综合评分，但这种方式忽略了个体用户的偏好差异，无法准确反映模型的排名情况。由于不同情境下用户的偏好各不相同，因此我们需要采用个性化的基准测试来根据每个用户的特定需求对模型进行排名。我们通过ELO评分和Bradley-Terry系数，对115名活跃的Chatbot Arena用户进行了个性化模型排名分析，并研究了用户查询特征（主题和写作风格）与模型排名变化之间的关系。研究发现，单个用户对模型的选择与整体模型排名存在显著差异：Bradley-Terry相关性平均值仅为ρ=0.04（57%的用户表现出近乎零或负的相关性），而ELO评分则显示出中等程度的相关性（ρ=0.43）。通过主题建模和风格分析，我们发现用户在主题兴趣和沟通风格方面存在显著的异质性，这影响了他们对模型的偏好选择。此外，我们进一步发现，结合主题特征和风格特征的简洁组合，可以为预测特定用户的模型排名提供一个有用的特征空间。我们的研究结果有力地证明了，传统的综合基准测试无法捕捉到大多数用户的个人偏好，从而强调了开发基于个体用户偏好的个性化基准测试的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Op-Fed: Opinion, Stance, and Monetary Policy Annotations on FOMC Transcripts Using Active Learning
papers.title_zh: OP-Fed：关于联邦公开市场委员会会议纪要的观点、立场及货币政策分析——采用主动学习方法进行处理
papers.authors: Alisa Kanganis, Katherine A. Keith
papers.abstract: The U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) regularly discusses and sets monetary policy, affecting the borrowing and spending decisions of hundreds of millions of people. In this work, we release Op-Fed, a dataset of 1044 human-annotated sentences and their contexts from FOMC transcripts that captures monetary policy stance—specifically, whether an individual FOMC member expresses support for tightening or loosening policy. We faced two major technical challenges in dataset creation: imbalanced classes—we estimate fewer than 8% of sentences express a non-neutral stance toward monetary policy—and inter-sentence dependence—65% of instances require context beyond the sentence-level to annotate. To address these challenges, we developed a five-stage hierarchical schema to isolate aspects of opinion, monetary policy, and stance toward monetary policy, as well as the level of context needed. Second, we selected instances to annotate using active learning, approximately doubling the number of positive instances across all schema aspects. Using Op-Fed, we found a top-performing, closed-weight LLM achieves 0.80 zero-shot accuracy in opinion classification but only 0.61 zero-shot accuracy classifying stance toward monetary policy—below our human baseline of 0.89. We expect Op-Fed to be useful for future model training, confidence calibration, and as a seed dataset for future annotation efforts.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）定期讨论并制定货币政策，这些政策影响着数亿人的借贷和支出决策。在这项研究中，我们发布了Op-Fed数据集，该数据集包含1044条由人类标注的句子及其上下文信息，这些信息来自FOMC的会议记录。这些记录能够反映货币政策的立场——具体来说，就是某个FOMC成员是支持收紧货币政策还是放松货币政策。在数据集创建过程中，我们面临两个主要的技术挑战：一类是类别不平衡问题——我们估计有不到8%的句子表达了对货币政策的非中立态度；另一类是句子之间的依赖性问题——有65%的情况需要超出句子级别的上下文信息来进行标注。为了应对这些挑战，我们开发了一个五阶段的层次化架构，以区分不同方面的观点、货币政策以及针对货币政策的立场，同时确定所需的上下文级别。其次，我们通过主动学习的方法选择要标注的样本，这使得所有方面的积极样本数量大约增加了一倍。利用Op-Fed数据集，我们发现一个表现优异的封闭权重大语言模型在观点分类上的零样本准确率达到了0.80，但在对货币政策立场进行零样本分类时，准确率仅为0.61——这一数值低于我们人类标注的基线水平0.89。我们预计Op-Fed数据集在未来模型的训练、置信度校准以及作为后续标注工作的基础数据集方面都将具有重要作用。

papers.title: C^3D: Enhancing LLM Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Contrastive Decoding
papers.title_zh: C^3D：通过置信引导的对比解码技术提升大语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Yufeng Zhang, Xuepeng Wang, Lingxiang Wu, Jinqiao Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are prone to distraction by contextual information during reasoning. Previous work primarily focuses on improving the generation of the next token while overlooking the potential bias introduced by existing premises. We propose a novel decoding method to mitigate such biases. Our framework uses predicted logits to estimate the model’s confidence. By decomposing the full context into multiple premises, we gain a clearer understanding of the relevance of each premise to the question. During next-token prediction, we refine the output by contrasting the logits with the highest and lowest confidence. Our method effectively reveals how the model dynamically activates and adjusts its consideration of each premise as reasoning progresses.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在推理过程中容易受到上下文信息的干扰。以往的研究主要集中在改进下一个词符的生成上，而忽视了现有前提可能带来的偏见。我们提出了一种新颖的解码方法来减轻这种偏见。我们的框架利用预测出的逻辑值来估计模型的置信度。通过将整个上下文分解为多个前提，我们能够更清晰地了解每个前提与问题的相关性。在下一个词符的预测过程中，我们通过对比置信度最高和最低的逻辑值来优化输出结果。我们的方法有效地揭示了模型在推理过程中如何动态地调整对每个前提的考虑方式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Do LLMs Really Know What They Don’t Know? Internal States Mainly Reflect Knowledge Recall Rather Than Truthfulness
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型真的知道自己不知道什么吗？它们的内部状态主要反映的是知识记忆，而非真实情况
papers.authors: Chi Seng Cheang, Hou Pong Chan, Wenxuan Zhang, Yang Deng
papers.abstract: Recent work suggests that LLMs “know what they don’t know”, positing that hallucinated and factually correct outputs arise from distinct internal processes and can therefore be distinguished using internal signals.However, hallucinations have multifaceted causes: beyond simple knowledge gaps, they can emerge from training incentives that encourage models to exploit statistical shortcuts or spurious associations learned during pretraining.In this paper, we argue that when LLMs rely on such learned associations to produce hallucinations, their internal processes are mechanistically similar to those of factual recall, as both stem from strong statistical correlations encoded in the model’s parameters.To verify this, we propose a novel taxonomy categorizing hallucinations into Unassociated Hallucinations (UHs), where outputs lack parametric grounding, and Associated Hallucinations (AHs), which are driven by spurious associations. Through mechanistic analysis, we compare their computational processes and hidden-state geometries with factually correct outputs.Our results show that hidden states primarily reflect whether the model is recalling parametric knowledge rather than the truthfulness of the output itself. Consequently, AHs exhibit hidden-state geometries that largely overlap with factual outputs, rendering standard detection methods ineffective. In contrast, UHs exhibit distinctive, clustered representations that facilitate reliable detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，大语言模型“知道自己不知道什么”，这意味着幻觉产生的输出和真实正确的输出源自不同的内部过程，因此可以通过内部信号来区分。然而，幻觉的产生有多种原因：除了简单的知识缺失之外，它们还可能源于训练中的激励因素，这些因素促使模型利用统计捷径或在预训练过程中学到的虚假关联。在本文中，我们认为，当大语言模型依赖这些学来的关联来产生幻觉时，它们的内部过程与真实回忆的过程在机制上是相似的，因为两者都源于模型参数中编码的强统计相关性。为了验证这一点，我们提出了一种新的分类方法，将幻觉分为无关联幻觉（UHs）和关联幻觉（AHs）。无关联幻觉是指输出缺乏参数化基础的情况，而关联幻觉则是由虚假关联驱动的。通过机制分析，我们将它们的计算过程和隐藏状态几何结构与真实正确的输出进行了比较。我们的研究结果表明，隐藏状态主要反映了模型是在回忆参数化知识，而不是输出的真实性。因此，关联幻觉的隐藏状态几何结构在很大程度上与真实输出重叠，这使得标准检测方法无法有效识别它们。相比之下，无关联幻觉则表现出独特的、聚集式的表示方式，这有助于可靠地检测这些幻觉。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Enhancing Hallucination Detection via Future Context
papers.title_zh: 通过未来背景信息提升幻觉检测能力
papers.authors: Joosung Lee, Cheonbok Park, Hwiyeol Jo, Jeonghoon Kim, Joonsuk Park, Kang Min Yoo
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used to generate plausible text on online platforms, without revealing the generation process.As users increasingly encounter such black-box outputs, detecting hallucinations has become a critical challenge.To address this challenge, we focus on developing a hallucination detection framework for black-box generators.Motivated by the observation that hallucinations, once introduced, tend to persist, we sample future contexts.The sampled future contexts provide valuable clues for hallucination detection and can be effectively integrated with various sampling-based methods.We extensively demonstrate performance improvements across multiple methods using our proposed sampling approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型被广泛用于在线平台上生成合理的文本，而生成过程却不会被揭示。随着用户越来越多地遇到这种黑盒式输出，检测幻觉已成为一个至关重要的挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们专注于为这些黑盒生成器开发一种幻觉检测框架。鉴于我们发现，一旦产生了幻觉，它们往往会持续存在，因此我们会采样未来的上下文信息。这些被采样的未来上下文为幻觉检测提供了宝贵的线索，并且可以与各种基于抽样的检测方法有效结合。通过我们提出的采样方法，我们在多种方法中展示了显著的性能提升。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: MTO: A Multi-turn Conversational Text-to-OverpassQL Dataset for Enhanced OpenStreetMap Query Generation
papers.title_zh: MTO：一个多轮对话式文本到桥梁查询数据集，旨在提升OpenStreetMap的查询功能
papers.authors: Haodi Zhang, Xinrui Zhu, Mingze Kong, Zhidan Liu, Tao Fan, Kaishun Wu, Yuanfeng Song
papers.abstract: We propose a comprehensive framework for constructing multi-turn Text-to-OverpassQL dialogue datasets. Under this framework, we introduce the first multi-turn Text-to-OverpassQL dataset built upon the OverpassNL corpus. Our dataset comprises over 7,800 dialogues, each containing 2 to 4 user utterances, resulting in more than 20,000 individual utterances aligned with executable Overpass queries. To generate high-quality multi-turn dialogues, we design a four-stage pipeline. First, we convert Overpass queries into syntax trees using a custom parser developed based on the official OverpassQL grammar. This enables structural manipulation while preserving syntactic and executable validity. Second, we apply a diverse set of tree-editing templates, including both simple keyword-level changes and complex structural decompositions, to produce multiple valid and diverse Overpass queries. Third, we leverage a prompt-based approach to guide large language models in generating context-aware natural language questions, ensuring increasing inter-turn dependency across the dialogue. Finally, we implement a hybrid filtering strategy that combines manual annotation with model-assisted selection to validate alignment and correctness at scale. In addition to presenting the dataset, we evaluate the performance of several mainstream large language models and demonstrate that our end-to-end baseline model achieves competitive results. This work offers a new benchmark for studying executable semantic parsing and contextual understanding in map-based query tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个全面的框架，用于构建多轮Text-to-OverpassQL对话数据集。在这个框架下，我们首次基于OverpassNL语料库构建了一个多轮Text-to-OverpassQL数据集。我们的数据集包含超过7,800条对话，每条对话包含2到4个用户发言，共计超过20,000个与可执行Overpass查询相对应的独立发言内容。为了生成高质量的多轮对话，我们设计了一个四阶段流程。首先，我们使用基于官方OverpassQL语法开发的自定义解析器将Overpass查询转换为语法树结构。这样可以在保持语法和可执行性不变的前提下进行结构操作。其次，我们采用多种树编辑模板，包括简单的关键词级修改和复杂的结构分解，来生成多个有效且多样化的Overpass查询。第三，我们采用基于提示的方法引导大语言模型生成具有上下文意识的自然语言问题，从而确保对话之间不断增强的依赖性。最后，我们实施了一种混合过滤策略，结合人工注释和模型辅助选择，以大规模验证数据的一致性和正确性。除了展示数据集外，我们还评估了几种主流大语言模型的性能，并证明我们的端到端基线模型取得了有竞争力的结果。这项工作为研究基于地图的查询任务中的可执行语义解析和上下文理解提供了新的基准。

papers.title: A Dual-Phase Self-Evolution Framework for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 一种适用于大型语言模型的双阶段自我进化框架
papers.authors: Haoran Sun, Zekun Zhang, Shaoning Zeng
papers.abstract: The capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) are limited to some extent by pre-training, so some researchers optimize LLMs through post-training. Existing post-training strategies, such as memory-based retrieval or preference optimization, improve user alignment yet fail to enhance the model’s domain cognition. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel Dual-Phase Self-Evolution (DPSE) framework that jointly optimizes user preference adaptation and domain-specific competence. DPSE introduces a Censor module to extract multi-dimensional interaction signals and estimate satisfaction scores, which guide structured data expansion via topic-aware and preference-driven strategies. These expanded datasets support a two-stage fine-tuning pipeline: supervised domain grounding followed by frequency-aware preference optimization. Experiments across general NLP benchmarks and long-term dialogue tasks demonstrate that DPSE consistently outperforms Supervised Fine-Tuning, Preference Optimization, and Memory-Augmented baselines. Ablation studies validate the contribution of each module. In this way, our framework provides an autonomous path toward continual self-evolution of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的能力在一定程度上受到预训练的限制，因此一些研究人员通过训练后优化来改进这些模型。现有的训练后策略，如基于记忆的检索或偏好优化，能够提升用户满意度，但未能增强模型的领域认知能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新颖的双阶段自进化框架——DPSE。该框架同时优化了用户偏好适配和特定领域的专业能力。DPSE引入了一个“审查器”模块，用于提取多维交互信号并估算满意度得分，从而通过主题感知和偏好驱动的策略来扩展结构化数据。这些扩展后的数据集支持两阶段的微调流程：先进行有监督的领域引导，然后进行频率感知的偏好优化。在通用自然语言处理基准测试和长期对话任务中的实验表明，DPSE始终优于有监督微调、偏好优化以及带有记忆增强功能的基线模型。消融研究也验证了每个模块的积极作用。通过这种方式，我们的框架为语言模型的持续自进化提供了自主的路径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Preference-Aware Memory Update for Long-Term LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 考虑用户偏好的内存更新机制，适用于长期运行的LLM智能体
papers.authors: Haoran Sun, Zekun Zhang, Shaoning Zeng
papers.abstract: One of the key factors influencing the reasoning capabilities of LLM-based agents is their ability to leverage long-term memory. Integrating long-term memory mechanisms allows agents to make informed decisions grounded in historical interactions. While recent advances have significantly improved the storage and retrieval components—e.g., by encoding memory into dense vectors for similarity search or organizing memory as structured knowledge graphs—most existing approaches fall short in memory updating. In particular, they lack mechanisms for dynamically refining preference memory representations in response to evolving user behaviors and contexts. To address this gap, we propose a Preference-Aware Memory Update Mechanism (PAMU) that enables dynamic and personalized memory refinement. By integrating sliding window averages (SW) with exponential moving averages (EMA), PAMU constructs a fused preference-aware representation that captures both short-term fluctuations and long-term user tendencies. We conduct experiments on five task scenarios of the LoCoMo dataset, and the results show that our mechanism can significantly improve the output quality of LLM in five baselines, validating its effectiveness in long-term conversations.
papers.abstract_zh: 影响基于大语言模型的智能体推理能力的关键因素之一，在于它们能否利用长期记忆。整合长期记忆机制使得智能体能够基于历史交互做出明智的决策。虽然近期的研究显著提升了存储和检索功能——例如，通过将记忆编码为密集向量以进行相似性搜索，或将记忆组织成结构化的知识图谱——但大多数现有方法在记忆更新方面仍存在不足。特别是，它们缺乏根据用户行为和情境的变化动态调整偏好记忆表示的能力。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了一种“偏好感知记忆更新机制”，该机制能够实现动态且个性化的记忆优化。通过结合滑动窗口平均值和指数移动平均值，PAMU构建了一种融合的偏好感知表示，既能捕捉短期波动，又能体现用户的长期趋势。我们在LoCoMo数据集的五种任务场景中进行了实验，结果表明，我们的机制能够在五个基准测试中显著提升大语言模型的输出质量，从而验证了其在长期对话中的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Understanding In-Context Learning Beyond Transformers: An Investigation of State Space and Hybrid Architectures
papers.title_zh: 理解基于上下文的学习：对状态空间和混合架构的研究
papers.authors: Shenran Wang, Timothy Tin-Long Tse, Jian Zhu
papers.abstract: We perform in-depth evaluations of in-context learning (ICL) on state-of-the-art transformer, state-space, and hybrid large language models over two categories of knowledge-based ICL tasks. Using a combination of behavioral probing and intervention-based methods, we have discovered that, while LLMs of different architectures can behave similarly in task performance, their internals could remain different. We discover that function vectors (FVs) responsible for ICL are primarily located in the self-attention and Mamba layers, and speculate that Mamba2 uses a different mechanism from FVs to perform ICL. FVs are more important for ICL involving parametric knowledge retrieval, but not for contextual knowledge understanding. Our work contributes to a more nuanced understanding across architectures and task types. Methodologically, our approach also highlights the importance of combining both behavioural and mechanistic analyses to investigate LLM capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们对最先进的Transformer、状态空间模型和混合大语言模型在两种基于知识的ICL任务上的表现进行了深入评估。通过结合行为探测和干预方法，我们发现尽管不同架构的LLM在任务表现上可能相似，但它们的内部机制却可能存在差异。我们发现负责ICL的函数向量主要位于自注意力层和Mamba层中，并推测Mamba2采用与函数向量不同的机制来执行ICL。对于涉及参数化知识检索的ICL来说，函数向量更为重要，而对于上下文知识理解则并非如此。我们的研究有助于更细致地了解不同架构和任务类型的性能差异。从方法论角度来看，我们的方法也强调了结合行为分析和机制分析来探究LLM能力的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: C^2DLM: Causal Concept-Guided Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: C^2DLM：基于因果概念引导的扩散语言模型
papers.authors: Kairong Han, Nuanqiao Shan, Ziyu Zhao, Zijing Hu, Xinpeng Dong, Ye Jun Jian, Lujia Pan, Fei Wu, Kun Kuang
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) language models and Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) constitute the two principal paradigms of large language models. However, both paradigms suffer from insufficient reasoning capabilities. Human reasoning inherently relies on causal knowledge and thought, which are reflected in natural language. But in the AR paradigm, language is modeled as next token prediction (a strictly left-to-right, token-by-token order), whereas natural language itself exhibits more flexible causal structures. In the DLM paradigm, the attention mechanism is fully connected, which entirely disregards causal order. To fill this gap, we propose the Causal Concept-Guided Diffusion Language Model (C^2DLM). Starting from DLM’s fully connected attention, C^2DLM first obtains a concept-level causal graph from the teacher model, and then explicitly guides attention to learn causal relationships between concepts. By focusing on causal relationships and avoiding interference from difficult subgoals involving causal inversion, C^2DLM achieves a 12% improvement and a 3.2× training speedup on the COT-OrderPerturb task, along with an average gain of 1.31% across six downstream reasoning tasks. Code and data are available here.
papers.abstract_zh: 自回归语言模型和扩散语言模型是大语言模型的两种主要范式。然而，这两种范式都存在推理能力不足的缺陷。人类的推理本质上依赖于因果知识和思维，而这些特征都体现在自然语言中。但在自回归范式中，语言被建模为下一个标记的预测过程（严格遵循从左到右、逐标记的顺序），而自然语言本身则表现出更为灵活的因果结构。在扩散语言模型范式中，注意力机制是完全连接的，这完全忽略了因果顺序。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了因果概念引导的扩散语言模型（C^2DLM）。该模型从扩散语言模型的完全连接注意力机制出发，首先从教师模型中获取概念级别的因果图，然后明确引导注意力去学习概念之间的因果关系。通过专注于因果关系，并避免涉及因果反转的复杂子目标的干扰，C^2DLM在COT-OrderPerturb任务上实现了12%的性能提升和3.2倍的训练速度，同时在六个下游推理任务中平均获得了1.31%的性能提升。相关代码和数据可在此处获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CMTD: Cognitive Modeling with Traits and Distortions for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations
papers.title_zh: CMTD：基于特征与扭曲信息的认知建模技术，用于对话中的多模态情感识别
papers.authors: Minh-Tien Nguyen, Huu-Loi Le, Manh-Cuong Phan, Hajime Hotta
papers.abstract: This paper introduces a new multi-agent framework, CMTD (Cognitive Modeling with Traits and Distortions), for multimodal emotion recognition in conversations (MERC). Instead of relying on shallow analysis of emotions, CMTD reconstructs a cognitive model by taking advantage of stable personality traits, dynamic cognitive distortions, visual and acoustic features of interlocutors to enhance the emotional intelligence of LLMs. CMTD includes trait, distortion detection, vision, and speech agents that provide psychological and multimodal indicators for the fusion agent to make the final prediction. Experimental results on MELD and IEMOCAP show that traits temper negativity bias from distortions, and cognitive modeling with psychological, visual, and acoustic information can improve the performance of MERC.CMTD is flexible and easy to adapt to advanced emotional AI systems (Github link: https://github.com/Shaun-le/CMTD.git).
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的多智能体框架——CMTD（带有特征与扭曲的认知建模），用于对话中的多模态情绪识别。与依赖简单的情绪分析不同，CMTD通过利用稳定的个性特征、动态的认知扭曲以及对话双方的视觉和听觉特征，来构建认知模型，从而提升大语言模型的情绪感知能力。CMTD包含特征检测、扭曲检测、视觉处理以及语音处理模块，这些模块提供了心理和多模态信息，以便融合器做出最终预测。在MELD和IEMOCAP上的实验结果表明，特征能够缓解由扭曲引起的负面情绪偏差，而结合心理、视觉和听觉信息的认知建模可以提升MERC的性能。CMTD具有灵活性，易于应用于先进的情感人工智能系统中（GitHub链接：https://github.com/Shaun-le/CMTD.git）。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Bridging the Culture Gap: A Framework for LLM-Driven Socio-Cultural Localization of Math Word Problems in Low-Resource Languages
papers.title_zh: 缩小文化差异：一种基于大语言模型的社会文化数学问题本地化方法框架，适用于资源匮乏的语言环境
papers.authors: Israel Abebe Azime, Tadesse Destaw Belay, Dietrich Klakow, Philipp Slusallek, Anshuman Chhabra
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant capabilities in solving mathematical problems expressed in natural language. However, multilingual and culturally-grounded mathematical reasoning in low-resource languages lags behind English due to the scarcity of socio-cultural task datasets that reflect accurate native entities such as person names, organization names, and currencies. Existing multilingual benchmarks are predominantly produced via translation and typically retain English-centric entities, owing to the high cost associated with human annotator-based localization. Moreover, automated localization tools are limited, and hence, truly localized datasets remain scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce a framework for LLM-driven cultural localization of math word problems that automatically constructs datasets with native names, organizations, and currencies from existing sources. We find that translated benchmarks can obscure true multilingual math ability under appropriate socio-cultural contexts. Through extensive experiments, we also show that our framework can help mitigate English-centric entity bias and improve robustness when native entities are introduced across various languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解决以自然语言表述的数学问题方面展现出了显著的能力。然而，由于缺乏能够反映真实本土实体（如人名、组织名称以及货币等）的社会文化任务数据集，多语言且基于文化的数学推理能力在低资源语言中仍然落后于英语水平。现有的多语言基准测试大多是通过翻译生成的，这些测试通常保留以英语为中心的实体，因为人工注释过程成本高昂。此外，自动本地化工具也存在局限性，因此真正具有本地化特征的数据集仍然十分稀缺。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种由语言模型驱动的文化本地化方法，该方法能够自动从现有来源构建包含本土名称、组织和货币的数据集。我们发现，在适当的文化背景条件下，翻译后的基准测试可能会掩盖真正的多语言数学能力。通过大量实验，我们还发现我们的框架有助于减少以英语为中心的实体偏见，并在引入不同语言的本土实体时提升模型的鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Stop Guessing When to Stop Testing: Efficient Model Evaluation with Just Enough Data
papers.title_zh: 停止猜测何时进行测试：利用适当数量的数据实现高效的模型评估
papers.authors: Ofir Arviv, Kristjan Greenewald, Yotam Perlitz, Hadar Mulian, Michal Shmueli-Scheuer, Leshem Choshen
papers.abstract: The inherent rigidity of fixed-size benchmarks makes them an inefficient tool for model evaluation. Diverse evaluation objectives, including model ranking, model selection and testing throughout development, demand varying levels of statistical power. The mismatch between fixed sample sizes and these diverse needs results in either excessive computational cost or compromised reliability – a critical concern for model evaluation. To overcome these limitations, we call for adoption of sequential testing in our field. We provide an adaptive evaluation framework, that provides a principled way to navigate the trade-off between efficiency and reliability in model evaluation. Our framework combines the established statistical paradigm of sequential testing with stopping criteria tailored to common evaluation needs such as diminishing returns detection, and minimum detectable effect size. We demonstrate its ability to adaptively manage the efficiency-reliability trade-off on the Open VLM Leaderboard, including, for example, a 80% reduction in computational cost compared to fixed-size evaluation (with a 2.5-point CI width allowance) while maintaining statistical significance.
papers.abstract_zh: 固定大小的基准测试由于其固有的刚性，使其成为模型评估中效率不高的工具。不同的评估目标，包括模型排名、模型选择以及开发过程中的测试，都需要不同级别的统计能力。固定样本大小与这些多样化需求之间的不匹配，会导致计算成本过高或可靠性下降——这对模型评估来说是一个严重的问题。为了克服这些限制，我们呼吁在领域内采用序列测试方法。我们提出了一个自适应评估框架，该框架提供了一种原则性的方法来平衡模型评估中的效率与可靠性之间的关系。我们的框架将序列测试的成熟统计方法，与针对常见评估需求而设计的停止准则相结合，例如减少收益检测、最小可检测效应大小等。我们在Open VLM排行榜上展示了该框架在动态调整效率与可靠性之间平衡的能力，例如，与固定大小评估相比，计算成本降低了80%（同时允许2.5点的置信区间宽度），同时保持了统计显著性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AnyGraph: Graph Foundation Model in the Wild
papers.title_zh: AnyGraph：真正被使用的图基础模型
papers.authors: Lianghao Xia, Chao Huang
papers.abstract: The ubiquity of text-attributed graph data has highlighted the need for graph learning models with exceptional generalization across diverse textual and structural contexts. Current approaches struggle to extract generalizable insights from heterogeneous graph data, requiring extensive fine-tuning and limiting versatility across domains. In this work, we propose AnyGraph, a unified graph foundation model designed to handle key challenges: i) Structure Heterogenity - addressing distribution shift in graph structural patterns; ii) Feature Heterogenity - handling diverse textual representations; iii) Fast Adaptation - efficiently adapting to new graph-text domains. We build AnyGraph upon a Graph Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with a lightweight expert routing mechanism that effectively manages cross-domain distribution shift. Extensive experiments on 38 diverse datasets demonstrate AnyGraph’s strong zero-shot performance across domains with significant distribution shift, validating its fast adaptation ability and scaling law emergence. Our model is open-sourced and available at: https://github.com/HKUDS/AnyGraph.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本归因图数据的普遍性凸显了需要具有出色泛化能力的图学习模型，以适用于不同的文本和结构环境。当前的方法在从异构图数据中提取可推广的见解方面存在困难，需要大量的微调工作，且在不同领域中的适用性受到限制。在这项研究中，我们提出了AnyGraph这一统一的图基础模型，旨在解决以下关键挑战：i) 结构异质性——处理图结构模式的分布变化；ii) 特征异质性——处理多种文本表示方式；iii) 快速适应——能够高效适应新的图-文本领域。我们基于图混合专家架构构建了AnyGraph，并采用了一种轻量级专家路由机制，能够有效管理跨领域的分布变化。在38个不同数据集上的广泛实验表明，AnyGraph在具有显著分布变化的领域中也表现出强大的零样本性能，这验证了其快速适应能力以及规模扩展规律的出现。我们的模型已开源，可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/HKUDS/AnyGraph。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DOSE: Data Selection for Multi-Modal LLMs via Off-the-Shelf Models
papers.title_zh: 剂量：利用现成模型为多模态大型语言模型选择数据
papers.authors: Biao Wu, Yiwu Zhong, Meng Fang, Ling Chen
papers.abstract: High-quality and diverse multimodal data are essential for improving vision–language models (VLMs), yet existing datasets often contain noisy, redundant, and poorly aligned samples. To address these problems, data filtering is commonly used to enhance the efficiency and performance of multimodal learning, but it introduces extra computational cost because filtering models are usually trained on the same data they are meant to screen. To reduce this cost, we study DOSE, which explores whether off-the-shelf pretrained models that have never seen the target data can be used to select training samples for larger and stronger multimodal models without any task-specific training. Even without fine-tuning, these models can effectively assess text quality and image–text alignment to guide data selection. Based on this, we build a joint quality–alignment distribution and apply adaptive weighted sampling to select informative samples while maintaining long-tail diversity. This approach greatly enhances data diversity and enables models trained on DOSE-filtered data to achieve comparable or even better results than those trained on the full dataset in standard VQA and math benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability of our method.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量且多样化的多模态数据对于提升视觉-语言模型的效果至关重要。然而，现有的数据集往往包含大量噪声、冗余以及对齐不佳的样本。为了解决这些问题，通常会采用数据过滤的方法来提高多模态学习的效率和性能，但这种方法会引入额外的计算成本，因为过滤模型通常是在用于筛选的数据上进行训练的。为了降低这种成本，我们研究了DOSE这一方法。DOSE旨在探索是否可以利用那些从未见过目标数据的现成预训练模型来为更大、更强的多模态模型选择训练样本，而无需进行任何特定任务的训练。即使不进行微调，这些模型也能有效评估文本质量和图像与文本之间的对齐情况，从而指导数据选择。基于这一原理，我们构建了质量与对齐信息的联合分布，并采用自适应加权采样方法来选择有信息价值的样本，同时保持样本的多样性。这种方法显著提升了数据的多样性，使得在DOSE过滤数据上训练的模型能够在标准VQA和数学基准测试中取得与全数据集训练的模型相当甚至更好的效果。大量的实验证明了我们方法的有效性、高效性和可扩展性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MergeIT: From Selection to Merging for Efficient Instruction Tuning
papers.title_zh: MergeIT：从选择到合并，以实现高效的指令调优
papers.authors: Hongyi Cai, Yuqian Fu, Hongming Fu, Bo Zhao
papers.abstract: Instruction tuning is crucial for optimizing Large Language Models (LLMs), as the quality and diversity of instructional data significantly influence model performance. This naturally underscores the importance of an effective and efficient data selection strategy. However, recent mainstream data selection methods typically rely on LLMs to score instruction quality—taking advantage of their capabilities, but at the cost of high computational overhead and reduced data diversity. To address these limitations, in this paper, we propose MergeIT, a novel LLM-based Merging strategy for better Instruction Tuning that shifts the focus from selection to synthesis. MergeIT consists of two stages: first, topic-aware filtering clusters and refines the dataset, preserving diversity while eliminating redundancy without relying on LLM-based scoring, significantly reducing time and computational cost. Second, LLM-based merging synthesizes semantically similar instructions into more informative and compact training data, enhancing data richness while further reducing the size of the dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that MergeIT enables efficient, diverse, and scalable instruction selection and synthesis, establishing LLM-based merging as a promising alternative to prior scoring-based selection methods for instruction tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 指令调优对于优化大语言模型至关重要，因为指令数据的质量和多样性会显著影响模型的性能。这自然强调了一种有效且高效的数据选择策略的重要性。然而，目前主流的数据选择方法通常依赖大语言模型来评估指令的质量——利用它们的能力，但代价是较高的计算开销以及降低的数据多样性。为了克服这些限制，本文提出了MergeIT这一基于大语言模型的新型合并策略，该策略将重点从数据选择转移到数据合成上。MergeIT包含两个阶段：首先，进行主题感知的过滤聚类，以精炼数据集，在保留多样性的同时消除冗余，而无需依赖基于大语言模型的评分机制，从而大幅减少时间和计算成本。其次，基于大语言模型的合并功能可以将语义相似指令合成出更具信息量且更紧凑的训练数据，从而提升数据的丰富性，同时进一步减小数据集的大小。实验结果表明，MergeIT能够实现高效、多样且可扩展的指令选择与合成，使得基于大语言模型的合并成为替代传统基于评分的方法的一种有前景的选择。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Illusion of Insight in Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 推理模型中的“洞察幻觉”
papers.authors: Liv G. d’Aliberti, Manoel Horta Ribeiro
papers.abstract: Do reasoning models have “Aha!” moments?Prior work suggests that models like DeepSeek-R1-Zero undergo sudden mid-trace realizations that lead to accurate outputs, implying an intrinsic capacity for self-correction. Yet, it remains unclear whether such intrinsic shifts in reasoning strategy actually improve performance.Here, we study mid-reasoning shifts and instrument training runs to detect them. Our analysis spans 1M+ reasoning traces, hundreds of training checkpoints, three reasoning domains, and multiple decoding temperatures and model architectures.We find that reasoning shifts are rare, do not become more frequent with training, and seldom improve accuracy, indicating that they do not correspond to prior perceptions of model insight. However, their effect varies with model uncertainty. Building on this finding, we show that artificially triggering extrinsic shifts under high entropy reliably improves accuracy. Our results show that mid-reasoning shifts are symptoms of unstable inference behavior rather than an intrinsic mechanism for self-correction.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理模型是否会有“顿悟”时刻呢？先前的研究表明，像DeepSeek-R1-Zero这样的模型在推理过程中会突然出现一些突然的改进，从而得出准确的输出结果，这暗示了它们具有自我修正的能力。然而，目前尚不清楚这种推理策略上的内在变化是否真的能提升模型的性能。在这里，我们研究了推理过程中的这些变化，并通过多种方法来检测它们。我们的分析涵盖了100多万条推理记录、数百个训练检查点、三个不同的推理领域，以及多种解码温度和模型架构。我们发现，推理过程中的这些变化非常罕见，随着训练的进行，它们的频率并不会增加，而且很少能提升模型的准确性。这表明，这些变化并不符合人们之前对模型有洞察力的认知。不过，这些变化的效果会随着模型的不确定性而变化。基于这一发现，我们证明了在高熵状态下人为触发这些变化，确实能够显著提升模型的准确性。我们的结果表明，推理过程中的这些变化实际上是不稳定推理行为的症状，而不是一种内在的自我修正机制。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Adaptive Layer Selection for Layer-Wise Token Pruning in LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: 适用于LLM推理过程中的分层标记剪枝的自适应层选择机制
papers.authors: Rei Taniguchi, Yuyang Dong, Makoto Onizuka, Chuan Xiao
papers.abstract: Due to the prevalence of large language models (LLMs), key-value (KV) cache reduction for LLM inference has received remarkable attention. Among numerous works that have been proposed in recent years, layer-wise token pruning approaches, which select a subset of tokens at particular layers to retain in KV cache and prune others, are one of the most popular schemes. They primarily adopt a set of pre-defined layers, at which tokens are selected. Such design is inflexible in the sense that the accuracy significantly varies across tasks and deteriorates in harder tasks such as KV retrieval. In this paper, we propose ASL, a training-free method that adaptively chooses the selection layer for KV cache reduction, exploiting the variance of token ranks ordered by attention score. The proposed method balances the performance across different tasks while meeting the user-specified KV budget requirement. ASL operates during the prefilling stage and can be jointly used with existing KV cache reduction methods such as SnapKV to optimize the decoding stage. By evaluations on the InfiniteBench, RULER, and NIAH benchmarks, we show that ASL, equipped with one-shot token selection, adaptively trades inference speed for accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art layer-wise token pruning methods in difficult tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于大语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用，针对LLM推理进行键值（KV）缓存缩减已经受到了广泛关注。在近年来提出的众多方法中，逐层标记剪枝方法是最受欢迎的一种方案。该方法会选取特定层中的一部分标记保留在KV缓存中，而剪除其他标记。这种设计存在局限性，因为不同任务的准确率差异较大，尤其是在KV检索这类难度较高的任务中，性能会显著下降。在本文中，我们提出了ASL这一无训练过程的方法，该方法能够自适应地选择用于KV缓存缩减的层，并利用按注意力得分排序后的标记排名差异来实现这一目标。该方法能够在满足用户指定的KV预算要求的同时，平衡不同任务的性能表现。ASL在预填充阶段发挥作用，可以与现有的KV缓存缩减方法如SnapKV结合使用，以优化解码阶段。通过在InfiniteBench、RULER和NIAH基准测试中的评估，我们发现ASL通过一次性标记选择的方式，能够自适应地牺牲一些推理速度来换取更高的准确率，从而在困难任务中超越现有的逐层标记剪枝方法。

papers.title: Aligning What LLMs Do and Say: Towards Self-Consistent Explanations
papers.title_zh: 使大型语言模型的行为与表述保持一致：迈向自洽的解释方式
papers.authors: Sahar Admoni, Ofra Amir, Assaf Hallak, Yftah Ziser
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) seem to offer an easy path to interpretability: just ask them to explain their answers. Yet the features driving an answer often differ from those emphasized in its explanation, meaning post-hoc rationales can misrepresent what actually shaped the model’s output. We quantify this gap by comparing the feature-importance distributions of answers and their explanations. Prior analyses reveal such discrepancies, but large-scale study has been limited by the high computational cost of attribution methods. To address this, we introduce the Post-hoc Self-Consistency Bank (PSCB), a large-scale benchmark linking model decisions with diverse explanations and attribution vectors across datasets, methods, and model families. Using PSCB, we find that Spearman rank correlation provides a more reliable signal of alignment than cosine similarity. Building on this insight, we apply Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to attribution-based preference data, improving alignment without degrading task accuracy, and show that standard supervised fine-tuning on the same data fails to achieve comparable gains. These improvements generalize robustly across domains, paving the way toward scalable and faithful alignment between LLM decisions and their natural language explanations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型似乎为可解释性提供了便捷途径：只需让模型解释其答案即可。然而，驱动答案的特征往往与解释中强调的特征不同，这意味着事后推理可能会歪曲实际影响模型输出的因素。我们通过比较答案及其解释的特征重要性分布来量化这一差异。先前的研究已经揭示了这种差异，但大规模研究由于归因方法的高计算成本而受到限制。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了“事后自一致性库”这一大规模基准测试，它将模型决策与不同数据集、方法和模型家族中的多种解释和归因向量联系起来。利用PSCB，我们发现Spearman等级相关性比余弦相似度更能可靠地反映模型决策与解释之间的对齐程度。基于这一发现，我们将直接偏好优化技术应用于基于归因的偏好数据，从而在不降低任务准确性的情况下提高对齐效果。结果表明，对同一数据进行标准的监督微调并不能取得类似的改进效果。这些改进在多个领域都能得到稳健的应用，为在大语言模型的决策与其自然语言解释之间实现可扩展且忠实的对齐铺平了道路。

papers.title: TARo: Token-level Adaptive Routing for LLM Test-time Alignment
papers.title_zh: TARo：用于LLM测试阶段调优的令牌级自适应路由机制
papers.authors: Arushi Rai, Qiang Zhang, Hanqing Zeng, Yunkai Zhang, Dipesh Tamboli, Xiangjun Fan, Zhuokai Zhao, Lizhu Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities but typically require expensive post-training to reach high performance. Recent test-time alignment methods offer a lightweight alternative, but have been explored mainly for preference alignment rather than reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose Token-level Adaptive Routing (TARo), which steers frozen LLMs toward structured reasoning entirely at inference time. Specifically, we first train reward models on step-wise mathematical traces to capture fine-grained logical consistency signals, then introduce a learnable token-level router that automatically controls the guidance of the reward model to the base model. Extensive experiments show that TARo significantly improves reasoning performance by up to +22.4% over base model and +8.4% over existing token-level test-time alignment methods, while also boosting out-of-distribution clinical reasoning (MedXpertQA) and instruction following (AlpacaEval). Furthermore, TARo also generalizes from small to large backbones without retraining, extending test-time alignment from preference optimization to robust, cross-domain reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）具备强大的推理能力，但通常需要昂贵的后训练才能达到高性能。最近出现的测试时间对齐方法提供了一种轻量级的替代方案，但这些方法主要被用于偏好对齐，而非推理任务。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了令牌级自适应路由技术（TARo）。该技术能够在推理过程中引导固定的LLM进行结构化推理。具体来说，我们首先通过逐步的数学轨迹来训练奖励模型，以捕捉细粒度的逻辑一致性信号；然后引入一个可学习的令牌级路由器，该路由器能够自动控制奖励模型对基础模型的引导方式。大量实验表明，TARo显著提升了推理性能，相比基础模型提升了22.4%，相比现有的令牌级测试时间对齐方法提升了8.4%。同时，该技术还提升了超出分布范围的临床推理能力（MedXpertQA）以及指令遵循能力（AlpacaEval）。此外，TARo还能从小型到大型的基础模型中进行泛化应用，而无需重新训练，从而将测试时间对齐从偏好优化扩展到稳健的跨领域推理能力。

papers.title: ProRank: Prompt Warmup via Reinforcement Learning for Small Language Models Reranking
papers.title_zh: ProRank：通过强化学习实现小型语言模型的快速预热与重新排序技术
papers.authors: Xianming LI, Aamir Shakir, Rui Huang, Julius Lipp, Benjamin Clavié, Jing Li
papers.abstract: Reranking is fundamental to information retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation, with recent Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly advancing reranking quality. Most current works rely on large-scale LLMs (>7B parameters), presenting high computational costs. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a promising alternative because of computational efficiency. However, our preliminary quantitative analysis reveals key limitations of SLMs: their representation space is narrow, leading to reduced expressiveness, and they struggle with understanding task prompts without fine-tuning. To address these issues, we introduce a novel two-stage training approach, ProRank, for SLM-based document reranking. We propose using reinforcement learning to improve the understanding of task prompts. Additionally, we introduce fine-grained score learning to enhance representation expressiveness and further improve document reranking quality. Extensive experiments suggest that ProRank consistently outperforms both the most advanced open-source and proprietary reranking models. Notably, our ProRank even surpasses powerful LLM reranking models on the BEIR benchmark, establishing that properly trained SLMs can achieve superior document reranking performance while maintaining computational efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 重新排序在信息检索和基于检索的生成中起着至关重要的作用。最近的大语言模型在提升重新排序质量方面取得了显著进展。目前大多数相关工作都依赖于参数超过70亿的大语言模型，这带来了较高的计算成本。而小型语言模型由于计算效率较高，因此提供了一个有前景的替代方案。然而，我们的初步定量分析揭示了小型语言模型的一些关键局限性：它们的表示空间较为狭窄，导致表达能力下降；而且在没有进行精细调优的情况下，它们难以理解任务提示。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段训练方法——ProRank，用于基于小型语言模型的文档重新排序。我们采用强化学习来提升对任务提示的理解能力。此外，我们还引入了细粒度评分学习机制，以增强表示的表达性，从而进一步提升文档重新排序的质量。大量的实验表明，ProRank始终能够超越最先进的开源和专有重新排序模型。值得注意的是，我们的ProRank甚至在BEIR基准测试上超越了强大的大语言模型重新排序模型，这表明经过适当训练的小型语言模型可以在保持计算效率的同时，实现更出色的文档重新排序性能。

papers.title: ChemAmp: Amplified Chemistry Tools via Composable Agents
papers.title_zh: ChemAmp：通过组合式工具实现的化学研究利器
papers.authors: Zhucong Li, Powei Chang, Jin Xiao, Zhijian Zhou, Qianyu He, Jiaqing Liang, Fenglei Cao, Xu Yinghui, Yuan Qi
papers.abstract: Although LLM-based agents are proven to master tool orchestration in scientific fields, particularly chemistry, their single-task performance remains limited by underlying tool constraints. To this end, we propose tool amplification, a novel paradigm that enhances the collective capabilities of specialized tools through optimized, dynamic coordination within individual tasks. Instantiating this paradigm, we introduce ChemAmp, a computationally lightweight framework that dynamically treats chemistry tools (e.g., UniMol2, Chemformer) as composable building-block agents. It constructs task-specialized super-agents that transcend atomic tool constraints with limited data (≤10 samples). Our evaluations across four core chemistry tasks molecular design, molecule captioning, reaction prediction, and property prediction demonstrate that ChemAmp outperforms chemistry-specialized models, generalist LLMs, and agent systems with tool orchestration. Critically, this bottom-up construction strategy enables 94% inference token cost reductions versus vanilla multi-agent systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管基于大语言模型的智能体在科学领域，尤其是化学领域，已被证明能够熟练处理工具协同问题，但它们的单任务性能仍受到底层工具限制的影响。为此，我们提出了“工具放大”这一创新理念，该理念通过优化和动态协调各个任务中的工具使用，从而提升专业工具的集体能力。具体实施方面，我们开发了ChemAmp这一计算成本较低的框架，它能够将化学工具（如UniMol2、Chemformer）视为可组合的构建块。该框架能够构建出针对特定任务的超级智能体，这些超级智能体能够在有限的数据条件下（≤10个样本）克服单个工具的局限性。我们在四个核心化学任务上的评估结果显示，ChemAmp的表现优于那些专注于化学领域的模型、通用型大语言模型以及具备工具协同能力的智能体系统。更重要的是，这种自下而上的构建策略使得推理令牌成本比传统多智能体系统降低了94%。

papers.title: CodeContests-O: Powering LLMs via Feedback-Driven Iterative Test Case Generation
papers.title_zh: CodeContests-O：通过基于反馈的迭代测试用例生成方法来驱动大型语言模型运行
papers.authors: Jianfeng Cai, Jinhua Zhu, Ruopei Sun, Kangwen Zhao, Dongyun Xue, Mingxiao Feng, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li
papers.abstract: The rise of reasoning models necessitates large-scale verifiable data, for which programming tasks serve as an ideal source. However, while competitive programming platforms provide abundant problems and solutions, high-quality test cases for verification remain scarce. Existing approaches attempt to synthesize test cases using Large Language Models (LLMs), but rely solely on the model’s intrinsic generation capabilities without external feedback, frequently resulting in insufficiently diverse cases. To address this limitation, we propose a \textbf{Feedback-Driven Iterative Framework} for comprehensive test case construction. Specifically, our method leverages the LLM to generate initial test cases, executes them against known correct and incorrect solutions, and utilizes the failed results as feedback to guide the LLM in refining the test cases toward high fidelity and discriminability. We then apply this method to the CodeContests dataset to construct an optimized high-quality derivative, \textbf{CodeContests-O}. Evaluating against the entire pool of solutions (1.1 \times 10^7 in total), our dataset achieves an average True Positive Rate (TPR) of 89.35% and True Negative Rate (TNR) of 90.30%, significantly outperforming the CodeContests and CodeContests+ by margins of 4.30% and 8.78%, respectively. Furthermore, fine-tuning the Qwen2.5-7B model on CodeContests-O results in a 9.52% improvement on LiveCodeBench (Pass@1). Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework and the quality of CodeContests-O.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理模型的兴起需要大规模、可验证的数据，而编程任务正是获取这些数据的理想来源。然而，尽管竞争性的编程平台提供了大量的问题和解决方案，但用于验证的高质量测试案例仍然十分稀缺。现有的方法试图利用大语言模型来生成测试案例，但这些方法仅依赖模型自身的生成能力，缺乏外部反馈，因此生成的测试案例多样性往往不足。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种基于反馈的迭代框架，用于构建全面的测试案例。具体来说，我们的方法利用语言模型生成初始测试案例，然后将这些案例与已知的正确和错误解决方案进行比对，并将失败的结果作为反馈，以指导语言模型进一步完善测试案例，使其具有更高的准确性和区分性。随后，我们将这种方法应用于CodeContests数据集，从而生成了一个优化后的高质量衍生数据集，名为CodeContests-O。在对比了全部解决方案后（总共1.1×10^7个解决方案），我们的数据集实现了89.35%的平均真阳性率（TPR）和90.30%的真阴性率（TNR），分别比CodeContests和CodeContests+高出4.30%和8.78%。此外，对Qwen2.5-7B模型进行微调后，在LiveCodeBench上的性能提升了9.52%（通过率为Pass@1）。实验证明了我们的框架的有效性以及CodeContests-O的质量。

papers.title: Hybrid-Vector Retrieval for Visually Rich Documents: Combining Single-Vector Efficiency and Multi-Vector Accuracy
papers.title_zh: 用于视觉丰富文档的混合向量检索方法：结合单向量处理的高效性与多向量处理的准确性
papers.authors: Juyeon Kim, Geon Lee, Dongwon Choi, Taeuk Kim, Kijung Shin
papers.abstract: Retrieval over visually rich documents is essential for tasks such as legal discovery, scientific search, and enterprise knowledge management. Existing approaches fall into two paradigms: single-vector retrieval, which is efficient but coarse, and multi-vector retrieval, which is accurate but computationally expensive. To address this trade-off, we propose HEAVEN, a plug-and-play two-stage hybrid-vector framework. In the first stage, HEAVEN efficiently retrieves candidate pages using a single-vector method over Visually-Summarized Pages (VS-Pages), which assemble representative visual layouts from multiple pages. In the second stage, it reranks candidates with a multi-vector method while filtering query tokens by linguistic importance to reduce redundant computations. To evaluate retrieval systems under realistic conditions, we also introduce ViMDoc, a benchmark for visually rich, multi-document, and long-document retrieval. Across four benchmarks, HEAVEN attains 99.87% of the Recall@1 performance of multi-vector models on average while reducing per-query computation by 99.82%, achieving efficiency and accuracy. Our code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/juyeonnn/HEAVEN
papers.abstract_zh: 对于法律证据收集、科学搜索和企业知识管理等任务来说，对视觉丰富的文档进行检索至关重要。现有的方法主要分为两种范式：单向量检索方式，这种方式效率较高但精度较低；多向量检索方式，虽然精度高但计算成本较高。为了平衡这两种方法的优缺点，我们提出了HEAVEN这一即插即用、两阶段混合向量框架。在第一阶段，HEAVEN利用单向量方法高效地检索候选页面，这些页面是从多个页面中整合出的具有代表性的视觉布局。在第二阶段，HEAVEN通过多向量方法对候选页面进行重新排序，同时根据语言重要性过滤查询词项，以减少冗余计算。为了在实际环境中评估检索系统性能，我们还引入了ViMDoc这一针对视觉丰富、多文档和长文档检索的基准测试工具。在四个基准测试中，HEAVEN平均实现了与多向量模型相同的99.87%的Recall@1性能，同时将每次查询的计算量减少了99.82%，从而实现了效率和准确性的平衡。我们的代码和数据集可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/juyeonnn/HEAVEN

papers.title: Multi-Scale Spectral Selection and Entropy-Guided Uncertainty Fusion for Multimodal Rumor Detection
papers.title_zh: 多尺度光谱选择与熵驱动的不确定性融合技术在多模态谣言检测中的应用
papers.authors: Zongliang Han, Wenyu Guo, Guoqing Jin, Yang Liu, Fan Li, Dong Yu, Yan Song, Zhangfengzhen
papers.abstract: Multimodal content combining textual and visual information poses significant challenges for rumor detection on social media. Compared to traditional spatial domain features, frequency domain features have attracted increasing attention due to their stronger discriminative capabilities. However, existing methods still fall short in capturing cross-modal semantic inconsistencies and often overlook inherent noise in multimodal features, which limits overall detection performance. To address these issues, we propose a novel multimodal rumor detection method based on multi-scale spectral selection and entropy-guided uncertainty fusion. Specifically, we first apply the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) to image and text features to convert them into the frequency domain. Then, multi-scale convolutional filters are employed to extract fine-grained information across different frequency scales. Next, modality separation is performed to capture both shared and modality-specific features, enabling more effective cross-modal representation learning. Finally, entropy is used to estimate the uncertainty of each prediction branch, calculate confidence scores, and perform adaptive weighted fusion accordingly. Experimental results on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in multimodal rumor detection, demonstrating stronger detection capability and robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 结合文本和视觉信息的多模态内容在社交媒体上的谣言检测中面临着重大挑战。与传统的空间域特征相比，频域特征由于其更强的区分能力而受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有的方法在捕捉跨模态的语义不一致性方面仍然存在不足，并且常常忽略多模态特征中的固有噪声，这限制了整体检测性能。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于多尺度谱选择和熵引导的不确定性融合的新颖多模态谣言检测方法。具体来说，我们首先应用离散余弦变换将图像和文本特征转换为频域形式。然后，使用多尺度卷积滤波器提取不同频率尺度下的细粒度信息。接下来，进行模态分离，以捕获共享特征和特定模态特征，从而实现更有效的跨模态表示学习。最后，利用熵来估计每个预测分支的不确定性，计算置信度分数，并据此进行自适应加权融合。在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在多模态谣言检测方面优于现有的最先进方法，展现了更强的检测能力和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Covariance Matrix-Driven Image Channel Allocation for Multimodal Fake News Detection
papers.title_zh: 基于协方差矩阵的图片通道分配方法，用于多模态虚假新闻检测
papers.authors: Zongliang Han, Wenyu Guo, Guoqing Jin, Yang Liu, Yan Song, Dong Yu, Wang Min
papers.abstract: With the widespread proliferation of the Internet, the spread of fake news has accelerated significantly, evolving from single-text content to multimodal forms that include images and videos. The task of Multimodal Fake News Detection (MFND) takes both text and relevant images as input for fake news identification. However, issues such as image noise and inaccurate focus of visual features often lead to insufficient attention to critical information within images during multimodal fusion. To effectively address these challenges, we propose a covariance matrix-driven image channel allocation method. This method first expands the number of original channel maps, then evaluates the importance of image channels through the covariance matrix and assigns importance scores to the expanded channel maps, thereby redirecting the focus of visual features. Subsequently, we design a multimodal fusion strategy based on a multilayer co-attention mechanism to achieve dynamic fusion across modalities. Finally, a contrastive learning loss is introduced to enhance the alignment between textual and visual modalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on three public multimodal fake news detection benchmark datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着互联网的广泛普及，虚假新闻的传播速度显著加快，从单纯的文本内容发展到包含图片和视频的多模态形式。多模态虚假新闻检测任务需要将文本和相关图片作为输入来进行虚假新闻识别。然而，图像噪声问题以及视觉特征焦点的不准确性等问题，常常导致在多模态融合过程中对图像中关键信息的关注不足。为了有效应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于协方差矩阵的图像通道分配方法。该方法首先增加了原始通道映射的数量，然后通过协方差矩阵来评估各图像通道的重要性，并为这些扩展后的通道映射分配重要性分数，从而重新调整视觉特征的焦点。随后，我们设计了一种基于多层共注意力机制的多模态融合策略，以实现不同模态之间的动态融合。最后，引入对比学习损失来提升文本与视觉模态之间的对齐效果。大量实验表明，我们的方法在三个公开的多模态虚假新闻检测基准数据集上取得了领先的性能表现。

papers.title: Mechanistic Insights into Deferred Semantic Drift in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 对大型语言模型中语义漂移问题的机制性分析
papers.authors: Jingjie Zeng, Huayang Li, Liang Yang, Shaowu Zhang, Yuanyuan Sun, Hongfei Lin
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) face a fundamental challenge with delayed disambiguation: How is the meaning of an ambiguous word updated when clarifying context arrives only after it has been processed? While LLMs possess the latent capacity to resolve such ambiguities—as revealed when a full, non-causal context is provided—their unidirectional architecture prevents immediate updates. We investigate the underlying computational mechanism and show this semantic re-evaluation is deferred to subsequent tokens in a process we term “Deferred Semantic Drift (DSD)”. Through targeted analysis of attentional pathways, we find that later tokens actively retrieve context-dependent “informational packets” from the ambiguous word’s value vector to steer the final interpretation. We demonstrate this mechanism in metaphor comprehension and provide causal validation by steering model outputs towards literal or metaphorical meanings via targeted activation interventions. This research uncovers a key computational strategy for meaning construction, offering crucial insights for understanding and guiding the behavior of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在延迟消歧问题上面临一个根本性的挑战：当上下文的澄清是在模型处理之后才到来时，如何更新那个模糊词语的含义呢？虽然大语言模型具备解决此类模糊性的潜在能力——当提供完整的非因果性上下文时就能体现出来——但它们单向的架构却阻碍了即时更新。我们研究了这一计算机制，发现这种语义重新评估被推迟到后续词元上，我们将其称为“延迟语义漂移”。通过对注意力路径的针对性分析，我们发现后续的词元会主动从模糊词语的值向量中检索出与上下文相关的“信息包”，以指导最终的解释。我们在隐喻理解方面验证了这一机制，并通过有针对性的激活干预，将模型输出引导至字面意义或隐喻意义，从而提供了因果验证。这项研究揭示了意义构建的关键计算策略，为理解和指导大语言模型的行为提供了重要的见解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: JointCQ: Improving Factual Hallucination Detection with Joint Claim and Query Generation
papers.title_zh: JointCQ：通过结合声明与查询生成来提升事实幻觉检测的效果
papers.authors: Fan Xu, Huixuan Zhang, Zhenliang Zhang, Jiahao Wang, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: Current large language models (LLMs) often suffer from hallucination issues, i,e, generating content that appears factual but is actually unreliable. A typical hallucination detection pipeline involves response decomposition (i.e., claim extraction), query generation, evidence collection (i.e., search or retrieval), and claim verification. However, existing methods exhibit limitations in the first two stages, such as context loss during claim extraction and low specificity in query generation, resulting in degraded performance across the hallucination detection pipeline. In this work, we introduce JointCQ, a joint claim-and-query generation framework designed to construct an effective and efficient claim-query generator. Our framework leverages elaborately designed evaluation criteria to filter synthesized training data, and finetunes a language model for joint claim extraction and query generation, providing reliable and informative inputs for downstream search and verification. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms previous methods on multiple open-domain QA hallucination detection benchmarks, advancing the goal of more trustworthy and transparent language model systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的大语言模型常常存在幻觉问题，即生成的内容看似真实，但实际上不可靠。典型的幻觉检测流程包括响应分解（即 Claim 提取）、查询生成、证据收集（即搜索或检索）以及 Claim 验证。然而，现有方法在前两阶段存在局限性，例如 Claim 提取过程中会出现上下文丢失的问题，而查询生成的特异性较低，这导致整个幻觉检测流程的性能下降。在本研究中，我们提出了 JointCQ 这一联合 Claim 和查询生成框架，旨在构建高效且有效的 Claim-Query 生成器。我们的框架利用精心设计的评估标准来筛选合成的训练数据，并微调语言模型以进行联合 Claim 提取和查询生成，从而为下游搜索和验证提供可靠且富有信息量的输入。实验结果表明，我们的方法在多个开放领域问答幻觉检测基准测试中表现优于以往的方法，有助于实现更可信且透明的语言模型系统。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
