papers.title: Pseudo2Real: Task Arithmetic for Pseudo-Label Correction in Automatic Speech Recognition
papers.title_zh: Pseudo2Real：用于自动语音识别中伪标签修正的任务计算处理
papers.authors: Yi-Cheng Lin, Yu-Hsuan Li Liang, Hsuan Su, Tzu-Quan Lin, Shang-Tse Chen, Yun-Nung Chen, Hung-yi Lee
papers.abstract: Robust ASR under domain shift is crucial because real-world systems encounter unseen accents and domains with limited labeled data. Although pseudo-labeling offers a practical workaround, it often introduces systematic, accent-specific errors that filtering fails to fix. We ask: How can we correct these recurring biases without target ground truth? We propose a simple parameter-space correction: in a source domain containing both real and pseudo-labeled data, two ASR models are fine-tuned from the same initialization, one on ground-truth labels and the other on pseudo-labels, and their weight difference forms a correction vector that captures pseudo-label biases.When applied to a pseudo-labeled target model, this vector enhances recognition, achieving up to a 35% relative Word Error Rate (WER) reduction on AfriSpeech-200 across ten African accents with the Whisper tiny model.
papers.abstract_zh: 在领域转换情况下，强大的自动语音识别系统至关重要，因为现实世界中的系统会遇到未知口音和标注数据有限的领域。虽然伪标注提供了一种实用的解决方案，但它常常会导致系统性、与口音相关的错误，而过滤机制无法解决这些问题。我们思考的问题是：如何在不依赖目标真实数据的情况下纠正这些反复出现的偏见呢？我们提出了一种简单的参数空间修正方法：在一个包含真实数据和伪标注数据的源领域里，两个自动语音识别模型从相同的初始化开始进行微调，其中一个模型基于真实数据标注进行训练，另一个模型基于伪标注进行训练。这两个模型的权重差异构成了一个修正向量，该向量能够捕捉到伪标注带来的偏见。当将这个修正向量应用于伪标注的目标模型时，它能够提升识别效果，在AfriSpeech-200数据集上，使用Whisper tiny模型时，相对词错误率减少了高达35%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SGA-MCTS: Decoupling Planning from Execution via Training-Free Atomic Experience Retrieval
papers.title_zh: SGA-MCTS：通过无需训练的原子级体验检索，实现规划与执行的分离
papers.authors: Xin Xie, Dongyun Xue, Wuguannan Yao, Mingxiao Feng, Wengang Zhou, Xiang Qi, Houqiang Li, Peng Zhang
papers.abstract: LLM-powered systems require complex multi-step decision-making abilities to solve real-world tasks, yet current planning approaches face a trade-off between the high latency of inference-time search and the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning. To address this limitation, we introduce SGA-MCTS, a framework that casts LLM planning as non-parametric retrieval. Offline, we leverage Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explore the solution space and distill high-fidelity trajectories into State-Goal-Action (SGA) atoms. These atoms are de-lexicalized primitives that abstract concrete entities into symbolic slots, preserving reusable causal logic while discarding domain-specific noise. Online, a retrieval-augmented agent employs a hybrid symbolic-semantic mechanism to fetch relevant SGAs and re-ground them into the current context as soft reasoning hints. Empirical results on complex benchmarks demonstrate that this paradigm enables frozen, open-weights models to match the performance of SOTA systems (e.g., GPT-5) without task-specific fine-tuning. By effectively amortizing the heavy computational cost of search, SGA-MCTS achieves System 2 reasoning depth at System 1 inference speeds, rendering autonomous planning both scalable and real-time feasible.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的系统需要复杂的多步骤决策能力来解决现实世界中的任务。然而，当前的规划方法面临着推理时间搜索的高延迟与监督式微调的有限泛化能力之间的权衡。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了SGA-MCTS框架，它将大语言模型的规划视为非参数化检索过程。在离线阶段，我们利用蒙特卡洛树搜索算法来探索解决方案空间，并将高保真度的轨迹转化为状态-目标-动作原子。这些原子是去词汇化的基本单元，它们将具体实体抽象为符号槽，从而保留可复用的因果逻辑，同时排除特定领域的噪声。在在线阶段，带有检索功能的智能体采用混合的符号-语义机制来获取相关的状态-目标-动作原子，并将其重新转化为当前上下文中的软推理提示。在复杂的基准测试上的实证结果表明，这种范式使得冻结的、开放权重的模型能够在无需针对特定任务进行微调的情况下，达到与最先进系统（如GPT-5）相当的性能水平。通过有效分摊搜索过程中的巨大计算成本，SGA-MCTS能够在系统1的推理速度下实现系统2的推理深度，从而使自主规划变得既可扩展又实时可行。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Robustness via Referencing: Defending against Prompt Injection Attacks by Referencing the Executed Instruction
papers.title_zh: 通过引用实现健壮性：通过引用已执行的指令来抵御指令注入攻击
papers.authors: Yulin Chen, Haoran Li, Yuan Sui, Yue Liu, Yufei He, Xiaoling Bai, Chi Fei, Li Yabo, Haozhe Ma, Yangqiu Song, Bryan Hooi
papers.abstract: Prompt injection attacks manipulate large language models (LLMs) by misleading them to deviate from the original input instructions and execute maliciously injected instructions, because of their instruction-following capabilities and inability to distinguish between the original input instructions and maliciously injected instructions. Currently, various prompt injection defense methods have been proposed, including prompt-engineering-based approaches and fine-tuning methods. Most of these methods instruct the model to follow the original input instructions, suppressing its inherent tendencies to follow the injected instructions. However, experimental results reveal that suppressing the model’s instruction-following tendencies is challenging. After analyzing successful attack cases, we find that the LLMs can correctly reference the instructions they are executing in some cases. Motivated by this finding, we propose a defense method that leverages LLMs’ instruction-following abilities rather than suppressing them. Our approach prompts LLMs to generate responses that include both the answers and their corresponding instruction references. Based on these references, we filter out answers whose references are not to the original input instructions. We conduct comprehensive experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed method. The results show that our approach outperforms prompt-engineering-based baselines and is comparable to fine-tuning methods, reducing the ASR to nearly 0% in some scenarios. Moreover, our approach has minimal impact on overall utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 提示注入攻击通过误导大语言模型偏离原始输入指令，并执行恶意注入的指令来操控它们。由于大语言模型具有遵循指令的能力，且无法区分原始输入指令与恶意注入的指令，因此这种攻击方式非常有效。目前，已经提出了多种针对提示注入的防御方法，包括基于提示工程的方法和微调方法。这些方法大多都是指导模型遵循原始输入指令，从而抑制模型遵循注入指令的倾向。然而，实验结果表明，抑制模型的遵循指令的倾向是非常困难的。通过分析成功的攻击案例，我们发现在某些情况下，大语言模型仍然能够正确地引用所执行的指令。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种防御方法，该方法利用大语言模型的遵循指令能力，而不是抑制它们。我们的方法要求大语言模型生成包含答案及其对应指令参考信息的响应。根据这些参考信息，我们可以过滤掉那些参考信息并非原始输入指令的回答。我们通过全面的实验来评估我们所提出的方法的有效性。结果表明，我们的方法优于基于提示工程的基础方法，并且与微调方法相当，能够在某些情况下将攻击成功率降至几乎为零。此外，我们的方法对整体性能的影响很小。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Differentially Private Synthetic Text Generation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
papers.title_zh: 用于检索增强生成技术的差异化私有合成文本生成方法
papers.authors: Junki Mori, Kazuya Kakizaki, Taiki Miyagawa, Jun Sakuma
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by grounding them in external knowledge. However, its application in sensitive domains is limited by privacy risks. Existing private RAG methods typically rely on query-time differential privacy (DP), which requires repeated noise injection and leads to accumulated privacy loss. To address this issue, we propose DP-SynRAG, a framework that uses LLMs to generate differentially private synthetic RAG databases. Unlike prior methods, the synthetic text can be reused once created, thereby avoiding repeated noise injection and additional privacy costs. To preserve essential information for downstream RAG tasks, DP-SynRAG extends private prediction, which instructs LLMs to generate text that mimics subsampled database records in a DP manner. Experiments show that DP-SynRAG achieves superior performance to the state-of-the-art private RAG systems while maintaining a fixed privacy budget, offering a scalable solution for privacy-preserving RAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将大语言模型与外部知识相结合，提升了其性能。然而，在敏感领域中的应用受到隐私风险的限制。现有的私有RAG方法通常依赖于查询时差分隐私技术，但这需要反复注入噪声，从而导致隐私损失的增加。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了DP-SynRAG框架——该框架利用大语言模型生成差分隐私保护的合成RAG数据库。与以往的方法不同，这些合成文本在创建后可以被重复使用，从而避免了重复注入噪声以及额外的隐私成本。为了保留下游RAG任务所需的关键信息，DP-SynRAG扩展了私有预测功能，即指导大语言模型以差分隐私方式生成模仿子采样数据库记录的文本。实验表明，DP-SynRAG在保持固定隐私预算的前提下，取得了优于现有私有RAG系统的性能，为隐私保护的RAG提供了可扩展的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When Slower Isn’t Truer: Inverse Scaling Law of Truthfulness in Multimodal Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 当速度较慢并非必然意味着真实：多模态推理中真实性逆向缩放规律
papers.authors: Sitong Fang, Wenjing Cao, Jiahao Li, Xuyao Wang, Chi-Min Chan, Sirui Han, Juntao Dai, Yike Guo, Yaodong Yang, Jiaming Ji
papers.abstract: Reasoning models have attracted increasing attention for their ability to tackle complex tasks, embodying the System II (slow thinking) paradigm in contrast to System I (fast, intuitive responses). Yet a key question remains: Does slower reasoning necessarily lead to more truthful answers? Our findings suggest otherwise. We conduct the first systematic study of the inverse scaling law in slow-thinking paradigms for multimodal reasoning. We find that when confronted with incomplete or misleading visual inputs, slow-thinking models are more prone to fabricating plausible yet false details to justify untruthful reasoning. To analyze this behavior, we construct a 5,000-sample hierarchical prompt dataset annotated by 50 human participants. The prompts progressively increase in complexity, revealing a consistent pattern: slower reasoning models tend to follow depth-first search (DFS) thinking, persistently exploring flawed premises, while faster chat models favor breadth-first search (BFS) inference, showing greater caution under uncertainty. These findings reveal a critical vulnerability of reasoning models: while effective in structured domains such as math, their DFS-style reasoning becomes fragile when confronted with ambiguous, multimodal inputs.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理模型因其能够处理复杂任务而受到越来越多的关注。这种能力体现了与系统一（快速、直觉性反应）相对应的系统二（缓慢思考）模式。然而，还有一个关键问题：较慢的推理是否必然会导致更真实的答案呢？我们的研究结果表明并非如此。我们进行了第一项关于慢速思考模式下多模态推理逆向缩放规律的系统性研究。我们发现，当面对不完整或误导性的视觉输入时，慢速思考模型更容易编造出看似合理但实际上错误的细节来为不真实的推理辩护。为了分析这种行为，我们构建了一个包含5000个样本的分层提示数据集，并由50名人类参与者进行标注。这些提示的复杂性逐渐增加，结果显示出一个一致的模式：较慢的推理模型倾向于采用深度优先搜索思维方式，持续探索有缺陷的前提条件；而较快的聊天模型则更倾向于采用广度优先搜索推理方式，在不确定情况下表现出更高的谨慎性。这些发现揭示了推理模型的一个关键弱点：虽然它们在数学等结构化领域表现有效，但当面对模糊且多模态的输入时，它们以深度优先搜索方式的推理就会变得脆弱。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: StressTest: Can YOUR Speech LM Handle the Stress?
papers.title_zh: 压力测试：您的语音处理系统能否应对压力？
papers.authors: Iddo Yosha, Gallil Maimon, Yossi Adi
papers.abstract: Sentence stress refers to emphasis on words within a spoken utterance to highlight or contrast an idea. It is often used to imply an underlying intention not explicitly stated. Recent speech-aware language models (SLMs) have enabled direct audio processing, allowing models to access the full richness of speech to perform audio reasoning tasks such as spoken question answering. Despite the crucial role of sentence stress in shaping meaning and intent, it remains largely overlooked in evaluation and development of SLMs. We address this gap by introducing StressTest, a benchmark designed to evaluate models’ ability to distinguish between meanings of speech based on the stress pattern. We evaluate leading SLMs, and find that despite their overall capabilities, they perform poorly on such tasks. Hence, we propose a novel data generation pipeline, and create Stress-17k, a training set that simulates change of meaning implied by stress variation. Results suggest, that our finetuned model, StresSLM, generalizes well to real recordings and notably outperforms existing SLMs on sentence stress reasoning and detection. Models, code, data, samples - https://pages.cs.huji.ac.il/adiyoss-lab/stresstest.
papers.abstract_zh: 句子重音指的是在口语表达中对某些词语的强调，以突出或对比某个概念。它常被用来暗示一些未明确表述的潜在意图。最近的语音感知语言模型已经能够实现直接的音频处理，使模型能够充分利用语音信息来完成诸如问答式语音任务等音频推理任务。尽管句子重音在塑造意义和意图方面起着至关重要的作用，但在语音感知语言模型的评估与开发中，这一因素却往往被忽视。我们为了解决这个问题，提出了StressTest这个基准测试，用于评估模型根据重音模式来区分语音含义的能力。我们对主流语音感知模型进行了评估，发现尽管它们整体能力很强，但在这类任务上的表现却相当差。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的数据生成方法，并创建了Stress-17k训练集，该训练集模拟了由重音变化所暗示的意义变化。实验结果表明，经过微调的StresSLM模型能够很好地泛化到真实录音数据，并且在句子重音推理和检测方面明显优于现有的语音感知模型。相关模型、代码和数据样本可访问：https://pages.cs.huji.ac.il/adiyoss-lab/stresstest
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EVADE: LLM-Based Explanation Generation and Validation for Error Detection in NLI
papers.title_zh: EVADE：基于大语言模型的解释生成与验证技术，用于自然语言推理问题中的错误检测
papers.authors: Longfei Zuo, Barbara Plank, Siyao Peng
papers.abstract: High-quality datasets are critical for training and evaluating reliable NLP models. In tasks like natural language inference (NLI), human label variation (HLV) arises when multiple labels are valid for the same instance, making it difficult to separate annotation errors from plausible variation. An earlier framework, VariErr (Weber-Genzel et al., 2024), asks multiple annotators to explain their label decisions in the first round and flags errors through validity judgments in the second round. However, conducting two rounds of manual annotation is costly and may limit the coverage of plausible labels or explanations. Our study proposes a new framework, EVADE, for generating and validating explanations to detect errors using large language models (LLMs). We perform a comprehensive analysis comparing human- and LLM-detected errors for NLI across distribution comparison, validation overlap, and impact on model fine-tuning. Our experiments demonstrate that LLM validation refines generated explanation distributions to more closely align with human annotations, and that removing LLM-detected errors from training data yields improvements in fine-tuning performance than removing errors identified by human annotators. This highlights the potential to scale error detection, reducing human effort while improving dataset quality under label variation.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量的数据集对于训练和评估可靠的自然语言处理模型至关重要。在诸如自然语言推理这样的任务中，当同一个实例有多个有效的标签时，就会出现人类标注变异的问题，这使得区分标注错误和合理的变异变得困难。早期的框架VariErr（Weber-Genzel等人，2024年）要求多个标注者在第一轮中解释他们的标注决策，并在第二轮通过有效性判断来标记错误。然而，进行两轮手动标注既费时又可能限制对合理标签或解释的覆盖范围。我们的研究提出了一种新的框架EVADE，用于生成和验证解释，以利用大语言模型检测错误。我们进行了全面的分析，比较了人类检测和大语言模型检测出的自然语言推理错误，包括分布对比、验证重叠以及对这些错误对模型微调的影响。实验表明，大语言模型的验证能够改进生成的解释分布，使其更接近于人类注释；此外，从训练数据中移除大语言模型检测出的错误，比移除人类标注者识别出的错误更能提升模型微调的性能。这凸显了扩展错误检测能力的潜力，可以在减少人工劳动的同时，提高数据集的质量，尤其是在存在标注变异的情况下。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AgenticRAGTracer: A Hop-Aware Benchmark for Diagnosing Multi-Step Retrieval Reasoning in Agentic RAG
papers.title_zh: AgenticRAGTracer：一种基于跳转点的基准测试，用于诊断代理式语义关联中的多步检索推理问题
papers.authors: Qijie You, Wenkai Yu, Hao Liang, Zhen Hao Wong, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of agent-based methods in recent years, Agentic RAG has undoubtedly become an important research direction. Multi-hop reasoning, which requires models to engage in deliberate thinking and multi-step interaction, serves as a critical testbed for assessing such capabilities. However, existing benchmarks typically provide only final questions and answers, while lacking the intermediate hop-level questions that gradually connect atomic questions to the final multi-hop query. This limitation prevents researchers from analyzing at which step an agent fails and restricts more fine-grained evaluation of model capabilities. Moreover, most current benchmarks are manually constructed, which is both time-consuming and labor-intensive, while also limiting scalability and generalization. To address these challenges, we introduce AgenticRAGTracer, the first Agentic RAG benchmark that is primarily constructed automatically by large language models and designed to support step-by-step validation. Our benchmark spans multiple domains, contains 1,305 data points, and has no overlap with existing mainstream benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that even the best large language models perform poorly on our dataset. For instance, GPT-5 attains merely 22.6% EM accuracy on the hardest portion of our dataset. Hop-aware diagnosis reveals that failures are primarily driven by distorted reasoning chains—either collapsing prematurely or wandering into over-extension. This highlights a critical inability to allocate steps consistent with the task’s logical structure, providing a diagnostic dimension missing in traditional evaluations. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/YqjMartin/AgenticRAGTracer.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，基于智能体的方法取得了迅速的发展，因此智能体RAG无疑已成为一个重要的研究方向。多跳推理需要模型进行有意识的思考和多步交互，这成为了评估此类能力的重要测试平台。然而，现有的基准测试通常只提供最终的问题和答案，而缺乏将原子问题逐步连接到最终多跳查询的中间层次问题。这一限制使得研究人员无法分析智能体在哪个步骤中失败，同时也限制了对模型能力的更细致评估。此外，目前大多数基准测试都是人工构建的，这不仅耗时且劳动密集，还限制了可扩展性和泛化能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了AgenticRAGTracer——首个由大语言模型自动构建并旨在支持逐步验证的智能体RAG基准测试。我们的基准测试涵盖了多个领域，包含1,305个数据点，并且与现有的主流基准测试没有重叠。大量实验表明，即使是最优秀的大语言模型在我们的数据集上表现不佳。例如，GPT-5在我们数据集最困难的部分仅达到了22.6%的EM准确率。基于跳数感知的诊断结果显示，失败主要源于推理链的错误——要么是过早崩溃，要么是过度扩展。这表明模型在分配步骤时严重缺乏与任务逻辑结构一致的能力，这为传统评估提供了缺失的诊断维度。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/YqjMartin/AgenticRAGTracer获取。

papers.title: Attention to Non-Adopters
papers.title_zh: 关注那些不采用该方案的人
papers.authors: Kaitlyn Zhou, Kristina Gligorić, Myra Cheng, Michelle S. Lam, Vyoma Raman, Boluwatife Aminu, Caeley Woo, Michael Brockman, Hannah Cha, Dan Jurafsky
papers.abstract: Although language model–based chat systems are increasingly used in daily life, most Americans remain non-adopters of chat-based LLMs — as of June 2025, 66% had never used ChatGPT. At the same time, LLM development and evaluation rely mainly on data from adopters (e.g., logs, preference data), focusing on the needs and tasks for a limited demographic group of adopters in terms of geographic location, education, and gender. In this position paper, we argue that incorporating non-adopter perspectives is essential for developing broadly useful and capable LLMs. We contend that relying on methods that focus primarily on adopters will risk missing a range of tasks and needs prioritized by non-adopters, entrenching inequalities in who benefits from LLMs, and creating oversights in model development and evaluation. To illustrate this claim, we conduct case studies with non-adopters and show: how non-adopter needs diverge from those of current users, how non-adopter needs point us towards novel reasoning tasks, and how to systematically integrate non-adopter needs via human-centered methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管基于语言模型的聊天系统在日常生活中越来越被使用，但大多数美国人仍然不采用基于聊天的大语言模型——截至2025年6月，有66%的人从未使用过ChatGPT。与此同时，大语言模型的开发和评估主要依赖于采用者的数据（如日志、偏好数据），这些评估主要集中在特定地理区域、教育背景和性别的采用者群体所面临的需求和任务上。在这篇论文中，我们认为纳入非采用者的观点对于开发具有广泛适用性和能力的大语言模型至关重要。我们认为，如果仅依赖以采用者为重点的方法，就有可能忽视非采用者所重视的各种需求和任务，从而加剧那些能够从中受益的人群之间的不平等现象，同时也会在模型开发和评估过程中产生疏漏。为了说明这一观点，我们进行了针对非采用者的案例研究，发现：非采用者的需求与当前用户的需求有所不同；非采用者的需求为我们指出了新的推理方向；此外，还可以通过以人为中心的方法系统地整合非采用者的需求。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Ready to Translate, Not to Represent? Bias and Performance Gaps in Multilingual LLMs Across Language Families and Domains
papers.title_zh: 准备进行翻译，而非代为表达？不同语言家族和领域中的多语言大语言模型在偏见与性能差异方面的问题
papers.authors: Md. Faiyaz Abdullah Sayeedi, Subhey Sadi Rahman, Md. Mahbub Alam, Md. Adnanul Islam, Jannatul Ferdous Deepti, Tasnim Mohiuddin, Md Mofijul Islam, Swakkhar Shatabda
papers.abstract: The rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) has redefined Machine Translation (MT), enabling context-aware and fluent translations across hundreds of languages and textual domains. Despite their remarkable capabilities, LLMs often exhibit uneven performance across language families and specialized domains. Moreover, recent evidence reveals that these models can encode and amplify different biases present in their training data, posing serious concerns for fairness, especially in low-resource languages. To address these gaps, we introduce Translation Tangles, a unified framework and dataset for evaluating the translation quality and fairness of open-source LLMs. Our approach benchmarks 24 bidirectional language pairs across multiple domains using different metrics. We further propose a hybrid bias detection pipeline that integrates rule-based heuristics, semantic similarity filtering, and LLM-based validation. We also introduce a high-quality, bias-annotated dataset based on human evaluations of 1,439 translation-reference pairs. The code and dataset are accessible on GitHub: https://github.com/faiyazabdullah/TranslationTangles
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的兴起重新定义了机器翻译技术，使得跨数百种语言和文本领域进行上下文感知且流畅的翻译成为可能。尽管这些模型具有出色的性能，但它们在不同语言家族和专业领域中的表现往往并不均衡。此外，最新研究表明，这些模型能够编码并放大训练数据中存在的各种偏见，这给公平性带来了严重的问题，尤其是在资源匮乏的语言中。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了Translation Tangles这一统一框架和数据集，用于评估开源语言模型的翻译质量和公平性。我们的方法通过多种指标对24对双向语言进行基准测试。我们还提出了一种混合式偏见检测流程，该流程结合了基于规则的启发式方法、语义相似性过滤以及基于语言模型的验证机制。此外，我们还构建了一个基于人类评估的高质量、带有偏见注释的数据集，该数据集包含1,439对翻译参考对。相关的代码和数据集可以在GitHub上获取：https://github.com/faiyazabdullah/TranslationTangles
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Music Audio-Visual Question Answering Requires Specialized Multimodal Designs
papers.title_zh: 音乐音频可视化问答需要专门的多模态设计方案
papers.authors: Wenhao You, Xingjian Diao, Wenjun Huang, Chunhui Zhang, Keyi Kong, Weiyi Wu, Chiyu Ma, Zhongyu Ouyang, Tingxuan Wu, Ming Cheng, Soroush Vosoughi, Jiang Gui
papers.abstract: While recent Multimodal Large Language Models exhibit impressive capabilities for general multimodal tasks, specialized domains like music necessitate tailored approaches. Music Audio-Visual Question Answering (Music AVQA) particularly underscores this, presenting unique challenges with its continuous, densely layered audio-visual content, intricate temporal dynamics, and the critical need for domain-specific knowledge. Through a systematic analysis of Music AVQA datasets and methods, this paper identifies that specialized input processing, architectures incorporating dedicated spatial-temporal designs, and music-specific modeling strategies are critical for success in this domain. Our study provides valuable insights for researchers by highlighting effective design patterns empirically linked to strong performance, proposing concrete future directions for incorporating musical priors, and aiming to establish a robust foundation for advancing multimodal musical understanding. We aim to encourage further research in this area and provide a GitHub repository of relevant works: https://github.com/WenhaoYou1/Survey4MusicAVQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然最近的多模态大语言模型在通用多模态任务上展现出了令人印象深刻的性能，但像音乐这样的专业领域则需要采用专门的方法。音乐音频-视觉问答任务尤其需要这样的方法，因为它具有连续、密集的音频-视觉内容，复杂的时间动态特性，以及对特定领域知识的迫切需求。通过对音乐音频-视觉问答任务的数据集和方法进行系统分析，本文指出，专门的输入处理机制、包含专用时空设计的架构，以及针对音乐的建模策略，对于在该领域取得成功至关重要。我们的研究为研究人员提供了宝贵的见解，通过实证验证了与高性能相关的有效设计模式，提出了将音乐先验信息纳入模型的具体方向，并旨在为推进多模态音乐理解的研究奠定坚实的基础。我们希望能够鼓励该领域的进一步研究，并提供一个包含相关工作的GitHub仓库：https://github.com/WenhaoYou1/Survey4MusicAVQA。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TemporalVLM: Video LLMs for Temporal Reasoning in Long Videos
papers.title_zh: TemporalVLM：适用于长视频中时间推理的视频大语言模型
papers.authors: Fawad Javed Fateh, Umer Ahmed, Hamza Khan, Zeeshan Zia, Quoc-Huy Tran
papers.abstract: We introduce TemporalVLM, a video large language model (video LLM) for temporal reasoning and fine-grained understanding in long videos. Our approach includes a visual encoder for mapping a long-term video into features which are time-aware and contain both local and global cues. It first divides an input video into short-term clips, which are jointly encoded with timestamps and fused across overlapping temporal windows into time-sensitive local features. Next, the local features are passed through a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) module for global feature aggregation. Moreover, to facilitate the evaluation of TemporalVLM, we present a large-scale long video dataset of industry assembly processes, namely IndustryASM, consisting of videos recorded on factory floors with actions and timestamps annotated by industrial engineers for time and motion studies and temporal action segmentation evaluation. Finally, extensive experiments show that TemporalVLM outperforms previous methods across temporal reasoning and fine-grained understanding tasks, i.e., dense video captioning, temporal video grounding, video highlight detection, and temporal action segmentation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了TemporalVLM，这是一种用于长视频中的时间推理和细粒度理解的视频大语言模型。我们的方法包含一个视觉编码器，能够将长视频映射成具有时间感知性的特征，这些特征同时包含局部和全局线索。首先，我们将输入视频分割成短期片段，这些片段与时间戳一起被编码，并在重叠的时间窗口中融合成对时间敏感的局部特征。接下来，这些局部特征通过双向长短期记忆模块进行全局特征聚合。此外，为了便于评估TemporalVLM的性能，我们提供了一个大规模的长视频数据集——IndustryASM，该数据集包含了工厂车间拍摄的视频，其中包含了工业工程师为时间和动作研究以及时间动作分割评估而标注的动作和时间戳信息。最后，大量的实验表明，TemporalVLM在时间推理和细粒度理解任务上表现优于以往的方法，例如密集视频字幕生成、时间视频定位、视频高亮检测以及时间动作分割等任务。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mitigating Judgment Preference Bias in Large Language Models through Group-Based Polling
papers.title_zh: 通过群体投票机制来减轻大型语言模型中的偏好偏见
papers.authors: Shuliang Liu, Zhipeng Xu, Zhenghao Liu, Yukun Yan, Minghe Yu, Yu Gu, Chong Chen, Huiyuan Xie, Ge Yu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) as automatic evaluators, commonly referred to as LLM-as-a-Judge, have also attracted growing attention. This approach plays a vital role in aligning LLMs with human judgments, providing accurate and reliable assessments. However, LLM-based judgment models often exhibit judgment preference bias during the evaluation phase, tending to favor responses generated by themselves, undermining the reliability of their judgments. This paper introduces the Group-Based Polling Optimization (Genii), an unsupervised multi-agent collaborative optimization framework that mitigates the inherent judgment preference bias of judgment models. Specifically, Genii integrates various LLM-based judgment models into a multi-agent system and simulates the interactive client-server polling mechanism to optimize each client agent unsupervisedly. Our experiments demonstrate that Genii outperforms supervised models trained on annotated judgment data, while requiring no human-labeled annotations. Genii consistently improves performance across different client agents during the polling, even when weaker models act as server agents. Further analysis reveals that Genii effectively mitigates judgment preference bias of LLM-based judgment models, demonstrating its effectiveness. All codes are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/Genii.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型作为自动评估工具，通常被称为“LLM作为裁判”，也受到了越来越多的关注。这种方法在使LLM与人类判断保持一致方面发挥着重要作用，能够提供准确可靠的评估结果。然而，基于LLM的评判模型在评估阶段往往会出现判断偏好偏差，倾向于偏爱自身生成的回答，从而削弱了其判断的可靠性。本文介绍了一种名为“群体投票优化”的无监督多智能体协作优化框架——Genii，该框架能够有效缓解评判模型固有的判断偏好偏差。具体来说，Genii将各种基于LLM的评判模型整合到一个多智能体系统中，并通过模拟交互式的客户端-服务器投票机制来无监督地优化每个客户端智能体的表现。我们的实验表明，Genii在不需要人工标注数据的情况下，其性能优于那些基于标注数据进行训练的监督模型。即使在较弱的模型作为服务器智能体时，Genii也能在不同客户端智能体之间持续提高性能。进一步分析显示，Genii确实有效缓解了基于LLM的评判模型的判断偏好偏差，证明了其有效性。所有代码均可在此链接下载：https://github.com/NEUIR/Genii
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Enhancing Long-Chain Reasoning Distillation through Error-Aware Self-Reflection
papers.title_zh: 通过注重错误的自我反思，提升长链推理的精度
papers.authors: Zhuoyang Wu, Xinze Li, Zhenghao Liu, Yukun Yan, Zhiyuan Liu, Minghe Yu, Cheng Yang, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have exhibited strong reasoning capabilities and achieved remarkable performance in mathematical problem-solving tasks. Recently, distilling reasoning ability from long-form Chains-of-Thought (CoTs) has emerged as a promising approach for enhancing Small Language Models (SLMs). Existing studies typically treat SLMs as student models and use long-form CoTs as supervision signals for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to transfer reasoning ability. However, such long-form CoT teachers are usually unaware of the student model’s capacity, which limits the effective utilization of the provided reasoning traces. To overcome this limitation, we propose error-aware self-reflection (ORION), a framework that refines teacher CoTs through an Error-Aware Reflection process. ORION enables the student model to construct more tailored teacher CoTs by refining teacher CoTs and incorporating its own reasoning errors. Experiments on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ORION consistently improves performance by more than 2% over all baselines. Further analysis reveals that the CoTs constructed by ORION exhibit higher coherence and logical consistency, thereby serving as more effective supervision signals for SFT. All codes are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/ORION.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解决数学问题方面展现出了强大的推理能力，并取得了显著的性能表现。最近，从长形式的思维链中提取推理能力已成为提升小型语言模型性能的一种有前景的方法。现有的研究通常将小型语言模型视为学生模型，并使用长形式的思维链作为监督信号来进行有监督的微调，以传递推理能力。然而，这样的长形式思维链教师往往不了解学生模型的能力，这限制了所提供的推理痕迹的有效利用。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种基于错误感知的自反思框架——ORION。该框架通过错误感知的反思过程来改进教师提供的思维链。ORION能够让学生模型通过改进教师提供的思维链并结合自身的推理错误来构建更个性化的教学素材。在多个数学推理基准测试上的实验表明，ORION的性能相比所有基线方法提升了超过2%。进一步分析发现，ORION构建的思维链具有更高的连贯性和逻辑一致性，因此可以作为更有力的监督信号用于有监督的微调。所有代码均可在此链接下载：https://github.com/NEUIR/ORION。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: New Compendium of a Myriad of Plants: A New Dataset Describing Ancient Chinese Plants
papers.title_zh: 《众多植物的新汇编：一份描述中国古代植物的新数据集》
papers.authors: Xiaobin Shen, Zhongqing Wang, Shichen Li, Chu-Ren Huang, Guodong Zhou
papers.abstract: In ancient China, a variety of datasets depicted humanistic scenes, geographical features, and plants. However, these datasets, compiled long ago, often contain errors, lack comprehensiveness, and are inconsistent with modern realities. To meet current demands, we aim to expand and improve ancient datasets using large language model. Focusing on the Great Compendium of Myriad Flowers, an invaluable ancient plants dataset, we gather information on numerous previously excluded plants, carefully select and organize classical Chinese poetry and prose, and construct a comprehensive botanical encyclopedia knowledge system. Additionally, we collect ancient paintings and modern photographs of plants to enrich the dataset. Furthermore, we propose a novel multi-modal plant classification model designed to integrate multi-modal information from both classical and contemporary sources, enabling the extraction of plant-related information from classical Chinese poetry and prose. Extensive experiments demonstrate the importance of the proposed new ancient plants dataset, and also indicate the effectiveness of our proposed multi-modal plant classification model.
papers.abstract_zh: 在中国古代，有多种数据集描绘了人文场景、地理特征以及植物。然而，这些早就被编纂出来的数据集往往存在错误，缺乏全面性，且与现代现实不符。为了满足当前的需求，我们计划利用大语言模型来扩展和完善这些古代数据集。以《万花大观》为例，这是一个非常珍贵的古代植物数据集。我们收集了大量之前被忽视的植物信息，精心挑选并整理了中国古典诗歌和散文中的相关内容，从而构建了一个完整的植物百科全书知识体系。此外，我们还收集了古代绘画和现代拍摄的植物照片，以丰富数据集的内容。更重要的是，我们提出了一种新颖的多模态植物分类模型，该模型能够整合来自古典和当代的多模态信息，从而从中国古典诗歌和散文中提取与植物相关的信息。大量的实验表明，所提出的新古代植物数据集具有重要意义，同时也证明了我们所提出的多模态植物分类模型的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Generative Interfaces for Language Models
papers.title_zh: 用于语言模型的生成式接口
papers.authors: Jiaqi Chen, Yanzhe Zhang, Yutong Zhang, Yijia Shao, Diyi Yang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly seen as assistants, copilots, and consultants, capable of supporting a wide range of tasks through natural conversation. However, most systems remain constrained by a linear request-response format that often makes interactions inefficient in multi-turn, information-dense, and exploratory tasks. To address these limitations, we propose Generative Interfaces for Language Models, a paradigm in which LLMs respond to user queries by proactively generating user interfaces (UIs) that enable more adaptive and interactive engagement. Our framework leverages structured interface-specific representations and iterative refinements to translate user queries into task-specific UIs. For systematic evaluation, we introduce a multidimensional assessment framework that compares generative interfaces with traditional chat-based ones across diverse tasks, interaction patterns, and query types, capturing functional, interactive, and emotional aspects of user experience. Results show that generative interfaces consistently outperform conversational ones, with up to a 72% improvement in human preference. These findings clarify when and why users favor generative interfaces, paving the way for future advancements in human-AI interaction. Data and code are available at https://github.com/SALT-NLP/GenUI.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被视为助手、协同员和顾问，能够通过自然对话来支持各种任务。然而，大多数系统仍然受到线性请求-响应格式的限制，这往往使得在多轮、信息密集且需要探索性的任务中交互效率低下。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了生成式语言模型接口这一理念。在这种模式下，LLM通过主动生成用户界面来回应用户查询，从而实现更加自适应和互动式的交互体验。我们的框架利用结构化的界面特定表示和迭代优化技术，将用户查询转化为特定任务的用户界面。为了进行系统评估，我们引入了一个多维评估框架，该框架在不同任务、交互模式和查询类型下比较生成式接口与传统的基于聊天方式的接口，从而捕捉用户体验的功能性、互动性和情感方面。结果表明，生成式接口始终优于基于对话的接口，在用户偏好方面甚至提升了72%。这些发现揭示了用户为何以及何时青睐生成式接口，为未来人机交互的发展铺平了道路。相关数据代码可访问于https://github.com/SALT-NLP/GenUI。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EvoEdit: Evolving Null-space Alignment for Robust and Efficient Knowledge Editing
papers.title_zh: EvoEdit：一种能够自动调整零空间对齐方式的方法，从而实现稳健且高效的知识编辑操作
papers.authors: Sicheng Lyu, Yu Gu, Xinyu Wang, Jerry Huang, Sitao Luan, Yufei Cui, Xiao-Wen Chang, Peng Lu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require continual updates to rectify outdated or erroneous knowledge. Model editing has emerged as a compelling paradigm for introducing targeted modifications without the computational burden of full retraining. Existing approaches are mainly based on a locate-then-edit framework. However, in sequential editing contexts, where multiple updates are applied over time, they exhibit significant limitations and suffer from catastrophic interference, i.e., new edits compromise previously integrated updates and degrade preserved knowledge. To address these challenges, we introduce EvoEdit, a novel editing strategy that mitigates catastrophic interference through sequential null-space alignment, enabling stable and efficient model editing. By performing sequential null-space alignment for each incoming edit, EvoEdit preserves both original and previously modified knowledge representations and maintains output invariance on preserved knowledge even across long edit sequences, effectively mitigating interference. Evaluations on real-world sequential knowledge-editing benchmarks show that EvoEdit achieves better or comparable performance than prior state-of-the-art locate-then-edit techniques, with up to 3.53× speedup. Overall, these results underscore the necessity of developing more principled approaches for designing LLMs in dynamically evolving information settings, while providing a simple yet effective solution with strong theoretical guarantees.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型需要持续更新，以修正过时或错误的知识。模型编辑成为一种有吸引力的方法，可以在不增加完全重新训练的计算负担的情况下进行有针对性的修改。现有的方法主要基于“定位-编辑”框架。然而，在连续编辑的场景中，当多次进行更新时，这些方法存在显著的限制，并且会出现灾难性干扰现象，即新的编辑会破坏之前已整合的更新，从而降低知识的可靠性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了EvoEdit这一新型编辑策略。该策略通过连续零空间对齐来减轻灾难性干扰，从而实现稳定且高效的模型编辑。通过对每个即将进行的编辑进行连续零空间对齐，EvoEdit能够保留原始知识和之前修改过的知识表示，并且在长时间的编辑过程中仍能保持对保留知识的不变性，从而有效避免干扰。在真实世界的连续知识编辑基准测试中的评估表明，EvoEdit的性能优于现有的“定位-编辑”技术，其处理速度甚至快了3.53倍。总体而言，这些结果强调了在动态变化的信息环境中设计大语言模型的必要性，同时提供了一种简单而有效的解决方案，并具有强大的理论保障。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Efficient Reasoning for LLMs through Speculative Chain-of-Thought
papers.title_zh: 通过推测性思维链来实现LLM的高效推理
papers.authors: Jikai Wang, Juntao Li, Jianye Hou, Yan Bowen, Lijun Wu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Large reasoning language models such as OpenAI-o1 and Deepseek-R1 have recently attracted widespread attention due to their impressive task-solving abilities. However, the enormous model size and the generation of lengthy thought chains introduce significant reasoning costs and response latency. Existing methods for efficient reasoning mainly focus on reducing the number of model parameters or shortening the chain-of-thought length. In this paper, we introduce Speculative Chain-of-Thought (SCoT), which reduces reasoning latency from another perspective by accelerated average reasoning speed through large and small model collaboration. SCoT conducts thought-level drafting using a lightweight draft model. Then it selects the best CoT draft and corrects the error cases with the target model. The proposed thinking behavior alignment improves the efficiency of drafting and the draft selection strategy maintains the prediction accuracy of the target model for complex tasks. Experimental results on GSM8K, MATH, GaoKao, CollegeMath and Olympiad datasets show that SCoT reduces reasoning latency by 48%\sim66% and 21%\sim49% for Deepseek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B and Deepseek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B while achieving near-target-model-level performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 像OpenAI-o1和Deepseek-R1这样的大型推理语言模型，因其出色的任务解决能力而受到了广泛关注。然而，庞大的模型规模以及冗长的思维链生成过程，会带来显著的推理成本和响应延迟问题。目前现有的高效推理方法主要致力于减少模型参数数量或缩短思维链的长度。在本文中，我们提出了“推测性思维链”技术（Speculative Chain-of-Thought，简称SCoT）。该技术通过大模型和小型模型的协作，从另一个角度降低了推理延迟。SCoT利用轻量级的草稿模型进行思维层面的构思，然后选择最佳的草稿版本，并用目标模型修正其中的错误。所提出的思维行为对齐机制提升了构思效率，而草稿选择策略则确保了目标模型在复杂任务中的预测准确性。在GSM8K、MATH、GaoKao、CollegeMath和Olympiad等数据集上的实验结果表明，SCoT能够将推理延迟分别降低48%～66%和21%～49%，同时还能实现接近目标模型水平的性能表现。

papers.title: From Coarse to Fine: Self-Adaptive Hierarchical Planning for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 从粗糙到精细：适用于大型语言模型智能体的自适应分层规划方法
papers.authors: Haoran Tan, Zeyu Zhang, Chen Ma, Tianze Liu, Quanyu Dai, Xu Chen
papers.abstract: Large language model-based agents have recently emerged as powerful approaches for solving dynamic and multi-step tasks. Most existing agents employ planning mechanisms to guide long-term actions in dynamic environments. However, current planning approaches face a fundamental limitation that they operate at a fixed granularity level. Specifically, they either provide excessive detail for simple tasks or insufficient detail for complex ones, failing to achieve an optimal balance between simplicity and complexity. Drawing inspiration from the principle of progressive refinement in cognitive science, we propose AdaPlan-H, a self-adaptive hierarchical planning mechanism that mimics human planning strategies. Our method initiates with a coarse-grained macro plan and progressively refines it based on task complexity. It generates self-adaptive hierarchical plans tailored to the varying difficulty levels of different tasks, which can be optimized by imitation learning and capability enhancement. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly improves task execution success rates while mitigating overthinking at the planning level, providing a flexible and efficient solution for multi-step complex decision-making tasks. To contribute to the community, our code and data will be made publicly available at https://github.com/import-myself/AHP.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体最近成为解决动态和多步骤任务的强大方法。目前大多数智能体都采用规划机制来指导在动态环境中的长期行动。然而，当前的规划方法存在一个根本性的局限性，即它们以固定的粒度级别进行操作。具体来说，对于简单任务，它们提供的细节过于详尽；而对于复杂任务，则细节不足，无法在简单性和复杂性之间实现最佳平衡。受认知科学中逐步细化原则的启发，我们提出了AdaPlan-H这一自适应的分层规划机制，该机制模仿了人类的规划策略。我们的方法从粗粒度的宏观计划开始，然后根据任务复杂度逐步对其进行细化。这种方法能够生成适应不同任务难度水平的自适应分层计划，这些计划可以通过模仿学习和能力增强来进行优化。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著提高了任务执行的成功率，同时避免了在规划层面过度思考的问题，为多步骤复杂的决策任务提供了灵活且高效的解决方案。为了向社区贡献我们的成果，我们的代码和数据将在https://github.com/import-myself/AHP上公开提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Data-Centric Perspectives on Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Survey
papers.title_zh: 以数据为中心的视角来看待由智能检索技术支持的生成式生成方式：一项综述研究
papers.authors: Jingwen Deng, Jihao Huang, Zhen Hao Wong, Hao Liang, Quanqing Xu, Bin Cui, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at natural language understanding and generation, yet their reliance on static pre-training corpora may lead to outdated knowledge, hallucinations, and limited adaptability. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates these issues by grounding model outputs with external retrieval, but conventional RAG remains constrained by a fixed retrieve-then-generate routine and struggles with multi-step reasoning and tool calls. Agentic RAG addresses these limitations by enabling LLM agents to actively decompose tasks, issue exploratory queries, and refine evidence through iterative retrieval. Despite growing interest, the development of Agentic RAG is impeded by data scarcity: unlike traditional RAG, it requires challenging tasks that require planning, retrieval, and multiple reasoning decisions, and corresponding rich, interactive agent trajectories. This survey presents the first data-centric overview of Agentic RAG, framing its data lifecycle—data collecting, data preprocessing and task formulation, task construction, data for evaluation, and data enhancement for training—and cataloging representative training datasets and benchmarks in different domains (e.g. question answering, web, software engineering). From data perspectives, we aim to guide the creation of scalable, high-quality datasets for the next generation of adaptive, knowledge-seeking LLM agents. The project page is at https://github.com/fatty-belly/Awesome-AgenticRAG-Data/.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在理解生成自然语言方面表现出色，但其对静态预训练语料库的依赖可能导致知识过时、产生幻觉以及适应性有限。检索增强生成技术通过引入外部检索来减轻这些问题，但传统的检索增强生成仍受到固定检索-生成流程的限制，且在多步骤推理和工具调用方面存在困难。代理式检索增强生成则通过让语言模型代理主动分解任务、提出探索性查询以及通过迭代检索来完善证据来解决这些限制。尽管人们对代理式检索增强生成的研究兴趣日益浓厚，但数据的稀缺性仍然阻碍了其发展：与传统检索增强生成不同，代理式检索增强生成需要具有规划、检索和多层次推理能力的复杂任务，同时还需要相应的丰富且交互式的代理行为轨迹。本综述首次从数据角度对代理式检索增强生成进行了全面介绍，涵盖了数据的生命周期——数据收集、数据预处理与任务构建、任务实施、评估数据以及用于训练的データ增强——并列举了不同领域中的代表性训练数据集和基准测试（如问答、网络搜索、软件工程等）。从数据的角度来看，我们的目标是为下一代能够自适应地寻找知识的语言模型代理创建可扩展且高质量的数据集。该项目的相关页面地址为：https://github.com/fatty-belly/Awesome-AgenticRAG-Data/。

papers.title: WISCA: A Lightweight Model Transition Method to Improve LLM Training via Weight Scaling
papers.title_zh: WISCA：一种轻量级模型转换方法，通过权重缩放来优化大语言模型的训练过程
papers.authors: Jiacheng Li, Jianchao Tan, Zhidong Yang, Pingwei Sun, Feiye Huo, Jiayu Qin, Xiangyu Zhang, Maoxin He, Guangming Tan, Weile Jia, Xunliang Cai, Tong Zhao
papers.abstract: Transformer architecture gradually dominates the LLM field. Recent advances in training optimization for Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) primarily focus on architectural modifications or optimizer adjustments. However, these approaches lack systematic optimization of weight patterns during training. Weight pattern refers to the distribution and relative magnitudes of weight parameters in a neural network. To address this issue, we propose a Weight Scaling method called WISCA to enhance training efficiency and model quality by strategically improving neural network weight patterns—without changing network structures. By rescaling weights while preserving model outputs, WISCA indirectly optimizes the model’s training trajectory. Experiments demonstrate that WISCA significantly improves convergence quality (measured by generalization capability and loss reduction), particularly in LLMs with Grouped Query Attention (GQA) architectures and LoRA fine-tuning tasks. Empirical results show 5.6% average improvement on zero-shot validation tasks and 2.12% average reduction in training perplexity across multiple architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: Transformer架构逐渐主导了大语言模型领域。近期针对基于Transformer的大语言模型训练优化的进展，主要集中在架构调整或优化器改进上。然而，这些方法在训练过程中缺乏对权重模式的系统性优化。权重模式指的是神经网络中权重参数的分布和相对大小。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为WISCA的权重缩放方法，通过策略性地改善神经网络的权重模式来提高训练效率和模型质量，而无需改变网络结构。通过在保留模型输出的同时重新调整权重，WISCA能够间接优化模型的训练过程。实验表明，WISCA显著提升了收敛质量（以泛化能力和损失减少来衡量），尤其是在采用分组查询注意力机制架构以及LoRA微调任务的LLM中。实证结果显示，WISCA在零样本验证任务上平均提升了5.6%，在多个架构上平均减少了2.12%的训练困惑度。

papers.title: Disentangling Codemixing in Chats: The NUS ABC Codemixed Corpus
papers.title_zh: 解析聊天中的代码混合问题：NUS ABC代码混合语料库
papers.authors: Svetlana Churina, Akshat Gupta, Nur Insyirah Binte Imam Mujtahid, Kokil Jaidka
papers.abstract: Code-mixing involves the seamless integration of linguistic elements from multiple languages within a single discourse, reflecting natural multilingual communication patterns. Despite its prominence in informal interactions such as social media, chat messages and instant-messaging exchanges, there has been a lack of publicly available corpora that are author-labeled and suitable for modeling human conversations and relationships. This study introduces the first labeled and general-purpose corpus for understanding code-mixing in context while maintaining rigorous privacy and ethical standards. It includes over 355,641 messages spanning various code-mixing patterns, with a primary focus on English, Mandarin, and other languages. We expect the Codemix Corpus to serve as a foundational dataset for research in computational linguistics, sociolinguistics, and NLP applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 代码混合指的是在单一话语中无缝融合来自多种语言的语言元素，这反映了自然的多语言交流模式。尽管这种现象在社交媒体、聊天消息和即时通讯等非正式交流中非常常见，但目前缺乏可供公开使用的、带有作者标注且适合用于建模人类对话和关系的语料库。本研究首次提出了这样一个带有标注的通用语料库，用于理解语境中的代码混合现象，同时严格遵循隐私保护和伦理标准。该语料库包含超过355,641条消息，涵盖了各种代码混合模式，主要聚焦于英语、普通话以及其他语言。我们相信，这个代码混合语料库将成为计算语言学、社会语言学以及自然语言处理领域研究的基础数据集。

papers.title: When Thoughts Meet Facts: Reusable Reasoning for Long-Context LMs
papers.title_zh: 当思维与事实相遇时：用于长上下文记忆模型的重复利用推理方法
papers.authors: Soyeong Jeong, Taehee Jung, Sung Ju Hwang, Joo-Kyung Kim, Dongyeop Kang
papers.abstract: Recent Long-Context Language Models (LCLMs) can process hundreds of thousands of tokens in a single prompt, enabling new opportunities for knowledge-intensive multi-hop reasoning by integrating large sets of retrieved documents or, in some cases, directly all necessary information. However, simply feeding more documents into the context window fails to capture how evidence should be connected. We address this gap with thought templates, reusable reasoning patterns derived from prior problem solving that structure how evidence is combined and guide multi-hop inference alongside factual documents. To keep these templates effective, we propose an update strategy that iteratively refines templates derived from training data through natural-language feedback. Across diverse benchmarks and LCLM families, our approach delivers consistent gains over strong baselines in both retrieval-based and retrieval-free settings. Furthermore, we show that optimized templates can be distilled into relatively smaller open-source models, demonstrating its broad applicability. We refer to our framework as Thought Template Augmented LCLMs (ToTAL).
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的长期上下文语言模型能够在一个提示中处理数十万个标记，这为需要大量知识的多跳推理提供了新的机会。通过整合大量检索到的文档，或者在某些情况下直接获取所有必要信息，这种模型能够发挥更大的作用。然而，仅仅向上下文窗口中添加更多文档并不能解决证据之间如何相互关联的问题。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了思维模板的概念——这些模板是从以往的问题解决过程中衍生出来的可复用的推理模式，它们用于指导证据的组合方式，并辅助进行多跳推理。为了确保这些模板的有效性，我们提出了一种更新策略，通过自然语言反馈来不断改进从训练数据中得出的模板。在多种基准测试和不同的语言模型家族中，我们的方法在基于检索和无检索的场景下都取得了显著的性能提升。此外，我们还发现，经过优化的模板可以压缩成相对较小的开源模型，这进一步证明了其广泛的适用性。我们将我们的框架称为“思维模板增强型长上下文语言模型”（Thought Template Augmented LCLMs，简称ToTAL）。

papers.title: Infinity-Parser: Layout-Aware Reinforcement Learning with High-quality Document Parsing Dataset
papers.title_zh: 无限解析器：基于布局优化的强化学习技术，拥有高质量文档解析数据集支持
papers.authors: Baode Wang, Biao Wu, Weizhen Li, Meng Fang, Zuming Huang, Jun Huang, Yanjie Liang, Haozhe Wang, Ling Chen, Wei Chu, Yuan Qi
papers.abstract: Document parsing from scanned images into structured formats remains a significant challenge due to its complexly intertwined elements such as text paragraphs, figures, formulas, and tables. Existing supervised fine-tuning methods often struggle to generalize across diverse document types, leading to poor performance, particularly on out-of-distribution data. This issue is further exacerbated by the limited availability of high-quality training data for layout-aware parsing tasks. To address these challenges, we introduce layoutRL, a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes layout understanding through composite rewards integrating normalized edit distance, paragraph count accuracy, and reading order preservation. To support this training, we construct the Infinity-Doc-400K dataset, which we use to train Infinity-Parser, a vision-language model demonstrating robust generalization across various domains. Extensive evaluations on benchmarks including OmniDocBench, olmOCR-Bench, PubTabNet, and FinTabNet show that Infinity-Parser consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across a broad range of document types, languages, and structural complexities, substantially outperforming both specialized document parsing systems and general-purpose vision-language models. We will release our code, dataset, and model to facilitate reproducible research in document parsing.
papers.abstract_zh: 从扫描图像中将文档解析成结构化格式仍然是一个重大挑战，因为其中包含了复杂的元素，如文本段落、图表、公式和表格。现有的监督式微调方法往往难以在不同类型的文档中实现泛化，导致性能不佳，尤其是在非分布数据上的表现。这一问题因可用于布局感知解析任务的高质量训练数据有限而更加严重。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了layoutRL这一强化学习框架，该框架通过结合标准化编辑距离、段落数量准确性以及阅读顺序保留等复合奖励来优化布局理解能力。为了支持这一训练过程，我们构建了Infinity-Doc-400K数据集，并利用该数据集来训练Infinity-Parser模型。该模型是一种视觉语言模型，能够在各种领域中实现强大的泛化能力。在包括OmniDocBench、olmOCR-Bench、PubTabNet和FinTabNet在内的多个基准测试中的广泛评估表明，Infinity-Parser在多种文档类型、语言和结构复杂度下都能持续达到最先进的性能水平，其表现远远优于专门的文档解析系统和通用视觉语言模型。我们将公开我们的代码、数据集和模型，以便促进文档解析领域的可重复研究。

papers.title: Lunar-Bench: Towards Evaluating Task-Oriented Reasoning of LLMs in Lunar Exploration Scenarios
papers.title_zh: 月球实验室：在月球探索场景中评估大型语言模型的任务导向推理能力
papers.authors: Xin-Yu Xiao, Ye Tian, Erwei Yin, Zhixian He, Shiqi Wang, Yalei Liu, Qianchen Xia
papers.abstract: The increasing complexity of lunar exploration calls for intelligent systems capable of supporting autonomous operations and scientific decision-making under uncertain and resource-limited conditions. Advances in large language models (LLMs) create new opportunities for mission planning, but their reliability in dynamic, safety-critical environments remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks focus on static, context-independent reasoning tasks and fail to capture the constraints and dependencies of lunar missions. To address this gap, we introduce Lunar-Bench, a benchmark designed to assess the task-oriented reasoning and decision-making performance of LLMs through 3,000 tasks derived from mission procedures and documentation. We further propose the Environmental Scenario Indicators, a process-based framework that evaluates safety, efficiency, integrity, and alignment beyond conventional accuracy. Experiments on 36 representative models show that the best achieves 47.8% accuracy compared with 65.1% for human experts. Lunar-Bench and ESI together provide a principled foundation for developing reliable systems for future missions.
papers.abstract_zh: 月球探索的复杂性日益增加，这要求智能系统能够在不确定且资源有限的情况下支持自主操作和科学决策。大语言模型的发展为任务规划带来了新的机会，但其在动态、安全关键环境中的可靠性仍未被充分评估。现有的基准测试主要集中在静态、与上下文无关的推理任务上，无法捕捉到月球任务的约束和依赖关系。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了Lunar-Bench这一基准测试平台，该平台通过来自任务程序和文档的3000个任务来评估大语言模型的任务导向型推理和决策能力。我们还提出了环境场景指标这一基于过程的框架，该框架能够评估安全性、效率、完整性和一致性，而不仅仅是传统的准确性。对36个代表性模型的实验表明，最好的模型达到了47.8%的准确率，而人类专家的准确率则达到了65.1%。Lunar-Bench和ESI共同为开发未来任务的可靠系统提供了原则性的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BV-Blend: Uncertainty-Weighted Historical Baselines for Stable Critic-Free RL with Verifiable Rewards
papers.title_zh: BV-混合方法：基于不确定性加权的历史基线，用于稳定且无错误的强化学习，同时保证奖励的可验证性
papers.authors: Yupeng Chang, Yuan Wu, Yi Chang
papers.abstract: Critic-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), avoids training a value function (critic) and reduces memory and compute overhead relative to critic-based PPO pipelines for aligning large language models. However, GRPO-style advantage estimation depends on prompt-local (within-prompt-group) reward statistics and can be unstable. In particular, when all rollouts in a prompt group receive identical rewards, the within-group reward variance becomes zero, and group normalization yields zero advantages for that group, impeding learning in cold-start regimes with binary verifiers. We introduce BV-Blend, a critic-free framework that stabilizes advantage estimation by combining prompt-local on-policy statistics with semantic-cluster-conditioned historical moments. BV-Blend maintains EMA-tracked reward moments for each cluster, derives a confidence weight from a standard error of the mean (SEM) proxy, and uses this weight to blend historical and prompt-local baseline and variance statistics into a standardized advantage for PPO-style clipped updates. Experiments on verifiable reasoning benchmarks show that BV-Blend improves training stability and performance, and remains robust in regimes where group-normalized methods may stall.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的无评论家强化学习（RLVR），以群体相对策略优化（GRPO）为例，它避免了训练价值函数（评论家），并且与基于评论家的PPO流程相比，减少了内存和计算开销，从而能够更好地对齐大语言模型。然而，GRPO风格的优势估计依赖于提示局部（同一提示组内）的奖励统计数据，这种估计可能会不稳定。特别是当某个提示组中的所有提示都获得相同奖励时，组内奖励的方差会变为零，导致该组的优势值也为零，这会在具有二元验证器的冷启动情况下阻碍学习过程。我们提出了BV-Blend这一无评论家框架，它通过结合提示局部的策略统计数据和基于语义簇的历史数据来稳定优势估计。BV-Blend为每个簇维护着基于EMA的奖励数据，从均值的标准误差代理中提取置信度权重，并利用这个权重将历史数据和提示局部的数据融合在一起，形成标准化的优势值，用于PPO风格的裁剪式更新。在可验证推理基准测试中的实验表明，BV-Blend提升了训练的稳定性和性能，并且在那些群体标准化方法可能出现停滞的情况中依然表现出强大的鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Rethinking Research on Stereotypes: An Analysis through Social Psychological and Computational Perspectives
papers.title_zh: 重新思考关于刻板印象的研究：从社会心理学和计算科学的角度进行分析
papers.authors: Kaustubh Shivshankar Shejole, Pushpak Bhattacharyya
papers.abstract: Stereotypes are social constructs shaping human perception and behavior that can produce harmful outcomes under specific conditions. Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) may inherit and amplify such social harms. However, most existing research often focuses only upon stereotypical biases and overlooks stereotypes and the rich social psychological literature on them, resulting in resource wastage and slowed progress in stereotype research.We argue that meaningful progress in mitigating stereotypes in LLMs requires tighter integration between social psychology and computational research. To address this gap, we review core social psychological theories and frameworks and analyze their computational operationalization, highlighting substantial open opportunities.We also analyze computational progress across media narratives, body imaging, and multilingual, multicultural, and multimodal contexts, identifying key gaps and limitations in each domain.We also present a unified analysis of challenges in stereotype research.We further discuss implications for responsible AI, highlighting stereotypes as a major source of downstream harms, and briefly examine the limitations of current mitigation approaches along with potential improvements via explainability and interpretability. We frame stereotypes in AI as socio-technical phenomena and urge further research in responsible AI, informed by the perspectives and future directions presented in this paper.
papers.abstract_zh: 刻板印象是塑造人类认知与行为的社会建构，在特定情况下可能会带来有害的后果。最近的研究表明，大语言模型可能会继承并放大这种社会危害。然而，目前大多数研究仅关注刻板偏见问题，而忽视了刻板印象本身以及与之相关的丰富社会心理学文献，这导致了资源的浪费，也阻碍了刻板印象研究的进展。我们认为，要有效减轻大语言模型中的刻板印象问题，就需要将社会心理学与计算研究更紧密地结合起来。为了弥补这一空白，我们回顾了核心的社会心理学理论和框架，并分析了它们的计算实现方式，指出了许多有待探索的机遇。我们还分析了不同媒体叙事、身体形象呈现以及多语言、多元文化、多模态情境下的计算进展，发现了每个领域中的关键缺陷和局限性。此外，我们对刻板印象研究中的挑战进行了统一分析。最后，我们讨论了这对负责任的人工智能的意义，指出刻板印象是下游危害的主要来源，并简要探讨了当前缓解方法的局限性，以及通过可解释性和可理解性来改进这些方法的潜力。我们将人工智能中的刻板印象视为一种社会技术现象，呼吁在负责任的人工智能研究方面进行更深入的探索，以借鉴本文提出的观点和未来研究方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Do LLMs Catch Their Own Mistakes? A Comprehensive Benchmark for Reflective Tool Use LLMs
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能发现自己犯下的错误吗？关于反思性工具使用的全面评估基准
papers.authors: Zheyuan Liu, Liqiang Xiao, Yang Li, Hyokun Yun, Lihong Li, Chao Zhang, Meng Jiang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on external tools to complete complex tasks, yet their ability to recognize and correct their own tool-use mistakes remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate planning and execution success, overlooking the self-reflective dimension of tool use. To address this gap, we present ReflecTool-Bench, the first benchmark designed to assess LLMs’ self-reflective reasoning in tool-augmented multi-turn dialogues. ReflecTool-Bench covers 10 domains with 88 distinct APIs and 968 annotated dialogues, systematically injecting diverse error types arising from both user and assistant behavior. The benchmark defines two complementary evaluation setups: the Critique task, where models diagnose errors in third-party dialogues, and the Self-Reflection Task, where models must detect and repair their own prior tool-use mistakes. We introduce fine-grained metrics for error detection, error classification, correction accuracy, and explanation quality, enabling a holistic assessment of reflective reasoning. Evaluations across 12 state-of-the-art models, including both API-based closed source models and open source models, reveal that while models can reliably identify user-originated errors, they struggle with assistant-originated ones, and performance drops sharply when moving from critique to self-reflection.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在完成复杂任务时越来越依赖外部工具，然而它们识别并纠正自身工具使用错误的能力却尚未得到充分研究。现有的评估基准主要侧重于规划和执行的成功与否，而忽视了工具使用中的自我反思层面。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ReflecTool-Bench——首个用于评估大语言模型在工具辅助的多轮对话中进行的自我反思推理的基准测试。该基准测试涵盖了10个领域，包含88种不同的API和968条带有注释的对话，系统地引入了由用户和助手行为引起的各种错误类型。该基准测试定义了两种互补的评估方式：批判任务，模型负责诊断第三方对话中的错误；自我反思任务，模型则需要检测并修复自身的工具使用错误。我们引入了细粒度的指标来评估错误检测、错误分类、纠错准确性和解释质量，从而全面评估模型的反思能力。对12种先进模型的评估结果显示，虽然模型能够可靠地识别由用户引起的错误，但在处理由助手引起的错误时表现不佳，而且从批判任务转向自我反思任务时，模型的性能会显著下降。

papers.title: Understanding Generalization in Role-Playing Models via Information Theory
papers.title_zh: 通过信息论来理解角色扮演模型中的泛化现象
papers.authors: Yongqi Li, Hao Lang, Fei Huang, Tieyun Qian, Yongbin Li
papers.abstract: Role-playing models (RPMs) are widely used in real-world applications but underperform when deployed in the wild. This degradation can be attributed to distribution shifts, including user, character, and dialogue compositional shifts. Existing methods like LLM-as-a-judge fall short in providing a fine-grained diagnosis of how these shifts affect RPM generalization, and thus there lack formal frameworks to characterize RPM generalization behaviors. To bridge these gaps, we introduce an information-theoretic metric, named reasoning-based effective mutual information difference (R-EMID), to measure RPM performance degradation in an interpretable way. We also derive an upper bound on R-EMID to predict the worst-case generalization performance of RPMs and theoretically reveal how various shifts contribute to the RPM performance degradation. Moreover, we propose a co-evolving reinforcement learning framework to adaptively model the connection among user, character, and dialogue context and thus enhance the estimation of dialogue response generation probability, which is critical for calculating R-EMID. Finally, we evaluate the generalization performance of various RPMs using R-EMID, finding that user shift poses the highest risk among all shifts and reinforcement learning is the most effective approach for enhancing RPM generalization. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/DAMO-ConvAI/tree/main/RPM-Generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 角色扮演模型在现实世界的应用中得到了广泛应用，但在实际部署时表现不佳。这种性能下降可以归因于分布的变化，包括用户、角色和对话内容的分布变化。现有的方法，如将大语言模型作为评判器的方法，无法对这些变化如何影响角色扮演模型的泛化能力进行细致的分析，因此缺乏用于描述角色扮演模型泛化行为的正式框架。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种信息论度量指标——基于推理的有效互信息差异（R-EMID），以可解释的方式衡量角色扮演模型的性能下降情况。我们还推导出了R-EMID的上限值，从而预测角色扮演模型在最坏情况下的泛化性能，并理论上揭示了各种变化是如何导致角色扮演模型性能下降的。此外，我们提出了一个协同进化的强化学习框架，用于自适应地模拟用户、角色和对话上下文之间的关系，从而更准确地估计对话响应的生成概率，这对于计算R-EMID至关重要。最后，我们使用R-EMID评估了不同角色扮演模型的泛化性能，发现用户方面的变化所带来的风险最大，而强化学习是提升角色扮演模型泛化能力的最有效方法。代码和数据可以在https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/DAMO-ConvAI/tree/main/RPM-Generalization获取。

papers.title: A Multilingual Dataset and Empirical Validation for the Mutual Reinforcement Effect in Information Extraction
papers.title_zh: 一个多语言数据集，以及用于验证信息提取中相互强化效应的实验性验证结果
papers.authors: Chengguang Gan, Sunbowen Lee, Qingyu Yin, Yunhao Liang, Xinyang He, Hanjun Wei, Younghun Lim, Shijian Wang, Hexiang Huang, QingHao Zhang, Shiwen Ni, Tatsunori Mori
papers.abstract: The Mutual Reinforcement Effect (MRE) describes a phenomenon in information extraction where word-level and sentence-level tasks can mutually improve each other when jointly modeled. While prior work has reported MRE in Japanese, its generality across languages and task settings has not been empirically validated, largely due to the lack of multilingual MRE datasets. To address this limitation, we introduce the Multilingual MRE Mix dataset (MMM), which consists of 21 sub-datasets covering English, Japanese, and Chinese. We propose an LLM-assisted dataset translation and alignment framework that significantly reduces manual annotation effort while preserving the structural requirements of MRE tasks. Building on MMM, we adopt a unified input-output framework to train an open-domain information extraction model and conduct extensive empirical studies, including full fine-tuning ablations and the construction of knowledgeable verbalizers based on MRE-mix data. Experimental results show that 76 percent of the MMM sub-datasets consistently exhibit the Mutual Reinforcement Effect across languages. These findings provide systematic empirical validation of MRE in multilingual settings and demonstrate its practical value for information extraction.
papers.abstract_zh: 相互强化效应（Mutual Reinforcement Effect，MRE）描述了在信息提取领域中的一种现象：当将词汇级和句子级任务共同建模时，它们可以相互促进对方的性能提升。虽然之前的研究已经报道了日语中的MRE现象，但其在不同语言和任务设置中的普遍性尚未得到实证验证，这主要是由于缺乏多语言MRE数据集的原因。为了克服这一限制，我们引入了多语言MRE混合数据集（Multilingual MRE Mix Dataset，MMM），该数据集包含21个子数据集，涵盖英语、日语和中文。我们提出了一种由大语言模型辅助的数据集转换与对齐框架，该框架显著减少了手动注释的工作量，同时保留了MRE任务的结构要求。在MMM的基础上，我们采用了统一的输入-输出框架来训练开放域信息提取模型，并进行了广泛的实证研究，包括完整的微调操作以及基于MRE混合数据的知识型生成器构建。实验结果表明，76%的MMM子数据集在不同语言中都能持续表现出相互强化效应。这些发现为多语言环境下MRE现象的系统性实证验证提供了支持，同时也证明了它在信息提取领域的实际价值。

papers.title: TRACE: An Experiential Framework for Coherent Multi-hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.title_zh: TRACE：一种用于连贯的多跳知识图谱问答的框架
papers.authors: Yingxu Wang, Jiaxin Huang, Mengzhu Wang, Nan Yin
papers.abstract: Multi-hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) requires coherent reasoning across relational paths, yet existing methods often treat each reasoning step independently and fail to effectively leverage experience from prior explorations, leading to fragmented reasoning and redundant exploration. To address these challenges, we propose Trajectoryaware Reasoning with Adaptive Context and Exploration priors (TRACE), an experiential framework that unifies LLM-driven contextual reasoning with exploration prior integration to enhance the coherence and robustness of multihop KGQA. Specifically, TRACE dynamically translates evolving reasoning paths into natural language narratives to maintain semantic continuity, while abstracting prior exploration trajectories into reusable experiential priors that capture recurring exploration patterns. A dualfeedback re-ranking mechanism further integrates contextual narratives with exploration priors to guide relation selection during reasoning. Extensive experiments on multiple KGQA benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 多跳知识图谱问答（KGQA）需要跨关系路径进行连贯的推理，但现有方法往往独立处理每个推理步骤，无法有效利用之前探索的经验，导致推理缺乏连贯性且存在冗余的探索。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为“基于轨迹感知的推理与自适应上下文及探索先验”的方法（TRACE）。该框架将基于大语言模型的上下文推理与探索先验整合在一起，从而提升多跳KGQA的连贯性和鲁棒性。具体来说，TRACE能够动态地将不断变化的推理路径转化为自然语言叙述，以保持语义的连续性；同时，它将之前的探索轨迹抽象为可复用的经验先验，以捕捉重复出现的探索模式。此外，该算法还采用了双反馈排序机制，将上下文叙述与探索先验相结合，从而在推理过程中指导关系选择。在多个KGQA基准测试上的广泛实验表明，TRACE始终优于现有的最先进基线方法。

papers.title: Can LLMs See Without Pixels? Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence from Textual Descriptions
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能无需像素就能进行视觉感知吗？从文本描述中评估空间智能能力
papers.authors: Zhongbin Guo, Zhen Yang, Yushan Li, Xinyue Zhang, Wenyu Gao, Jiacheng Wang, Chengzhi Li, Xiangrui Liu, Ping Jian
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Spatial Intelligence (SI) have predominantly relied on Vision-Language Models (VLMs), yet a critical question remains: does spatial understanding originate from visual encoders or the fundamental reasoning backbone? Inspired by this question, we introduce SiT-Bench, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the SI performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) without pixel-level input, comprises over 3,800 expert-annotated items across five primary categories and 17 subtasks, ranging from egocentric navigation and perspective transformation to fine-grained robotic manipulation. By converting single/multi-view scenes into high-fidelity, coordinate-aware textual descriptions, we challenge LLMs to perform symbolic textual reasoning rather than visual pattern matching. Evaluation results of state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs reveals that while models achieve proficiency in localized semantic tasks, a significant “spatial gap” remains in global consistency. Notably, we find that explicit spatial reasoning significantly boosts performance, suggesting that LLMs possess latent world-modeling potential. Our proposed dataset SiT-Bench serves as a foundational resource to foster the development of spatially-grounded LLM backbones for future VLMs and embodied agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，空间智能领域的发展主要依赖于视觉语言模型。然而，有一个关键问题尚未得到解答：空间理解究竟是源于视觉编码器，还是源于基本的推理机制？受此问题的启发，我们提出了SiT-Bench这一新的基准测试平台，旨在评估大语言模型在空间智能方面的表现，而无需进行像素级别的输入处理。该基准测试包含超过3,800个由专家标注的测试项，涵盖五个主要类别和17个子任务，这些任务包括从以自我为中心的导航到精细的机器人操控等场景。通过将单视图或多视图场景转化为高保真度的、具有坐标信息的文本描述，我们挑战大语言模型进行符号化文本推理，而非单纯的视觉模式匹配。对最先进的语言模型进行评估后发现，虽然这些模型在局部语义任务上表现出色，但在整体一致性方面仍存在显著的“空间差距”。值得注意的是，明确的空间推理能力显著提升了模型的性能，这表明大语言模型具有潜在的世界建模能力。我们提出的SiT-Bench数据集为开发基于空间智能的大语言模型基础框架提供了重要的资源支持，这将有助于未来开发面向视觉语言模型和具身智能体的模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Lil: Less is Less When Applying Post-Training Sparse-Attention Algorithms in Long-Decode Stage
papers.title_zh: Lil：在长解码阶段应用训练后的稀疏注意力算法时，减少计算量才是最有效的做法
papers.authors: Junhao Hu, Fangze Li, Mingtao Xu, Feifan Meng, Shiju Zhao, Tiancheng Hu, Ting Peng, Anmin Liu, Wenrui Huang, Chenxu Liu, Ziyue Hua, Tao Xie
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities across a wide range of complex tasks and are increasingly deployed at scale, placing significant demands on inference efficiency. Prior work typically decomposes inference into prefill and decode stages, with the decode stage dominating total latency. To reduce time and memory complexity in the decode stage, a line of work introduces sparse-attention algorithms. In this paper, we show, both empirically and theoretically, that sparse attention can paradoxically increase end-to-end complexity: information loss often induces significantly longer sequences, a phenomenon we term “Less is Less” (Lil). To mitigate the Lil problem, we propose an early-stopping algorithm that detects the threshold where information loss exceeds information gain during sparse decoding. Our early-stopping algorithm reduces token consumption by up to 90% with a marginal accuracy degradation of less than 2% across reasoning-intensive benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在众多复杂任务中展现出强大的能力，其应用规模日益扩大，这给推理效率带来了巨大挑战。以往的研究通常将推理过程分为预填充阶段和解码阶段，其中解码阶段的延迟占总延迟的绝大部分。为了降低解码阶段的时间和内存消耗，一些研究引入了稀疏注意力算法。在本文中，我们通过实证和理论分析表明，稀疏注意力算法反而会增加端到端处理的复杂性：信息丢失往往会导致序列长度显著延长，这种现象我们称之为“少即是多”（Less is Less，简称Lil）。为了缓解Lil问题，我们提出了一种提前停止算法，该算法能够检测出在稀疏解码过程中信息损失超过信息增益的临界点。我们的提前停止算法可将令牌消耗减少90%，同时推理测试中的准确率下降幅度不到2%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Static Models, Dynamic World: A Unified Perspective on Temporal Perception in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 静态模型与动态世界：对大型语言模型中时间感知的统一理解
papers.authors: Chenhao Li, Dandan Song, Changzhi Zhou, Jun Yang, Yuhang Tian, Huipeng Ma, Guangyuan Feng, Luan Zhang, Xudong Li, Ke Duan
papers.abstract: Large language models are trained on static corpora but deployed in a dynamic world, leading to systematic temporal failures—from mis-anchored expressions and inconsistent timelines to hallucinated future events, stale world knowledge, and related issues. Existing surveys on temporal knowledge graphs, retrieval-augmented generation, hallucination, and knowledge editing cover only isolated fragments of this space: they are typically task-centric and do not offer a holistic theoretical account of how frozen LLMs represent and reason about time. This survey provides a unified perspective on temporal reasoning in LLMs. We formalize temporal queries in an information-theoretic framework based on the parametric reachability of temporal premises and answers, which induces four temporal information regimes corresponding to internal reasoning, answer recency, premise anchoring, and genuine world indeterminacy. Under this lens, we delineate the landscape of temporal failure modes, consolidate methodologies for diagnosing temporal deficiencies, and synthesize mitigation approaches into a coherent design space. Together, these contributions provide a systematic roadmap toward reliable time-aware large language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型是在静态语料库上训练的，但在动态世界中运行时会出现系统性时间处理问题——从错误的表达定位、不一致的时间线到虚构的未来事件、过时的世界知识等相关问题。现有的关于时间知识图谱、检索增强生成、幻觉现象以及知识编辑的调研仅涵盖了这一领域的部分内容：这些研究通常只关注特定任务，并未提供关于冻结型大语言模型如何表示和推理时间的全面理论描述。本综述旨在为理解大语言模型中的时间推理提供一个统一的视角。我们基于信息论框架对时间查询进行了形式化描述，该框架以时间前提与答案的参数可达性为基础，从而区分出四种时间信息状态：内部推理、答案时效性、前提定位以及真实世界的不确定性。通过这种视角，我们明确了时间处理问题的各种模式，整合了诊断时间缺陷的方法论，并将相应的缓解措施整合成一个连贯的设计方案。总的来说，这些贡献为构建可靠的时间感知大语言模型提供了系统的路线图。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Decomposed Trust: Privacy, Adversarial Robustness, Ethics, and Fairness in Low-Rank LLMs
papers.title_zh: 失效的信任：在低秩语言模型中保护隐私、确保对抗性鲁棒性、遵循伦理准则以及实现公平性
papers.authors: Daniel Agyei Asante, Md Mokarram Chowdhury, Yang Li
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have driven major advances across domains, yet their massive size hinders deployment in resource-constrained settings. Low-rank factorization addresses this challenge by compressing models to effectively reduce their computation and memory consumption while maintaining accuracy. While these compressed models boast benign performance and system-level advantages, their trustworthiness implications remain poorly understood. In this paper, we present the first comprehensive study of how low-rank factorization affects LLM trustworthiness across privacy, adversarial robustness, ethics, and fairness, complemented by an explainability-driven analysis of the internal mechanisms behind these trust-related changes. We evaluate multiple LLMs of different sizes and architectures compressed with various low-rank factorization algorithms, revealing key insights: (1) low-rank factorization preserves training data privacy but weakens the protection of personally identifiable information during conversations; (2) adversarial robustness is generally enhanced under compression; (3) ethics degrades in zero-shot prompting but partially recovers in few-shot prompting; (4) fairness declines under compression. Beyond compression, we investigate how model scale and fine-tuning affect trustworthiness. Additionally, to move beyond black-box analysis, we employ a gradient-based attribution to identify which layers of LLMs contribute most to adversarial robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多个领域取得了重大进展，但其庞大的规模限制了其在资源有限环境下的部署。低秩分解技术通过压缩模型来有效降低计算量和内存消耗，同时保持模型的准确性。虽然这些压缩后的模型在性能和系统层面具有优势，但其可信度问题仍缺乏深入的研究。在本文中，我们首次全面研究了低秩分解对语言模型可信度的影响，包括隐私保护、对抗性鲁棒性、伦理性和公平性等方面。我们还对这些变化背后的内部机制进行了可解释性分析。我们对不同规模和架构的多个语言模型进行了压缩实验，发现以下关键现象：(1) 低秩分解能够保护训练数据的隐私，但会削弱对话过程中个人身份信息的保护；(2) 压缩后模型的对抗性鲁棒性通常会提高；(3) 在零样本提示下，模型的伦理表现会下降，但在少样本提示下会部分恢复；(4) 压缩后模型的公平性会下降。除了压缩效应外，我们还研究了模型规模和微调对可信度的影响。此外，为了超越黑盒分析，我们采用了基于梯度的归因方法，以确定语言模型的哪些层对对抗性鲁棒性贡献最大。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Token Length: Step Pruner for Efficient and Accurate Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越令牌长度：用于大型语言模型高效精准推理的步长剪枝算法
papers.authors: Canhui Wu, Qiong Cao, Chang Li, Zhenfang Wang, Chao Xue, Yuwei Fan, Wei Xi, Xiaodong He
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) demonstrate strong performance on complex tasks but often suffer from excessive verbosity, known as “overthinking.” Existing solutions via reinforcement learning (RL) typically penalize generated tokens to promote conciseness. However, these methods encounter two challenges: responses with fewer tokens do not always correspond to fewer reasoning steps, and models may develop hacking behavior in later stages of training by discarding reasoning steps to minimize token usage. In this work, we introduce Step Pruner (SP), an RL framework that steers LRMs toward more efficient reasoning by favoring compact reasoning steps. Our step-aware reward function prioritizes correctness while imposing penalties for redundant steps, and withholds rewards for incorrect responses to prevent the reinforcement of erroneous reasoning. Moreover, we propose a dynamic stopping mechanism to prevent hacking behavior caused by step merging. Extensive experiments across four reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SP achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while significantly reducing response length. For instance, on AIME24, SP reduces token usage by 69.7%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在复杂任务上表现出强大的性能，但往往会出现过度冗长的现象，这种现象被称为“过度思考”。现有的强化学习解决方案通常会对生成的答案进行惩罚，以追求简洁性。然而，这些方法面临两个挑战：使用较少符号的回答并不总是意味着推理步骤更少，而且模型在训练后期可能会通过丢弃推理步骤来减少符号使用量，从而出现作弊行为。在这项研究中，我们提出了Step Pruner（SP）这一强化学习框架，它通过鼓励使用更简洁的推理步骤，帮助大型推理模型实现更高效的推理。我们的基于步骤的奖励函数会优先考虑正确性，同时对冗余步骤进行惩罚，并且不会为错误的回答提供奖励，从而避免强化错误的推理行为。此外，我们还提出了一种动态停止机制，以防止因合并步骤而导致的作弊行为。在四个推理基准测试中的广泛实验表明，SP能够在显著减少回答长度的同时，保持最先进的准确性。例如，在AIME24测试中，SP使符号使用量减少了69.7%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Exploring Reasoning Reward Model for Agents
papers.title_zh: 探索性推理奖励模型在智能体中的应用
papers.authors: Kaixuan Fan, Kaituo Feng, Manyuan Zhang, Tianshuo Peng, Zhixun Li, Yilei Jiang, Shuang Chen, Xiangyu Yue
papers.abstract: Agentic Reinforcement Learning (Agentic RL) has achieved notable success in enabling agents to perform complex reasoning and tool use. However, most methods still relies on sparse outcome-based reward for training. Such feedback fails to differentiate intermediate reasoning quality, leading to suboptimal training results. In this paper, we introduce Agent Reasoning Reward Model (Agent-RRM), a multi-faceted reward model that produces structured feedback for agentic trajectories, including (1) an explicit reasoning trace , (2) a focused critique that provides refinement guidance by highlighting reasoning flaws, and (3) an overall score that evaluates process performance. Leveraging these signals, we systematically investigate three integration strategies: Reagent-C (text-augmented refinement), Reagent-R (reward-augmented guidance), and Reagent-U (unified feedback integration). Extensive evaluations across 12 diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Reagent-U yields substantial performance leaps, achieving 43.7% on GAIA and 46.2% on WebWalkerQA, validating the effectiveness of our reasoning reward model and training schemes. Code, models, and datasets will be released to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 代理强化学习在使代理能够执行复杂推理和工具使用方面取得了显著成果。然而，大多数方法仍然依赖于基于稀疏结果的奖励来进行训练。这种反馈方式无法区分中间阶段的推理质量，从而导致训练效果不尽如人意。在本文中，我们提出了代理推理奖励模型（Agent-RRM），这是一种多层次的奖励模型，能够为代理的推理过程提供结构化的反馈，包括：（1）明确的推理记录；（2）有针对性的批评意见，通过指出推理中的缺陷来提供改进建议；（3）用于评估整个过程性能的总体得分。利用这些信号，我们系统地研究了三种整合策略：Reagent-C（文本增强的改进）、Reagent-R（奖励增强的引导）以及Reagent-U（统一反馈整合）。通过在12个不同的基准测试中进行广泛评估，我们发现Reagent-U能够带来显著的性能提升，在GAIA任务上的表现提升了43.7%，在WebWalkerQA任务上的表现提升了46.2%。这验证了我们的推理奖励模型和训练方案的有效性。我们的代码、模型和数据集将被公开，以便未来进行进一步的研究。

papers.title: MTMCS-Bench: Evaluating Contextual Safety of Multimodal Large Language Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues
papers.title_zh: MTMCS-Bench：评估多模态大型语言模型在多轮对话中的上下文安全性
papers.authors: Zheyuan Liu, Dongwhi Kim, Yixin Wan, Xiangchi Yuan, Zhaoxuan Tan, Fengran Mo, Meng Jiang
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed as assistants that interact through text and images, making it crucial to evaluate contextual safety when risk depends on both the visual scene and the evolving dialogue. Existing contextual safety benchmarks are mostly single-turn and often miss how malicious intent can emerge gradually or how the same scene can support both benign and exploitative goals. We introduce the Multi-Turn Multimodal Contextual Safety Benchmark (MTMCS-Bench), a benchmark of realistic images and multi-turn conversations that evaluates contextual safety in MLLMs under two complementary settings, escalation-based risk and context-switch risk. MTMCS-Bench offers paired safe and unsafe dialogues with structured evaluation. It contains over 30 thousand multimodal (image+text) and unimodal (text-only) samples, with metrics that separately measure contextual intent recognition, safety-awareness on unsafe cases, and helpfulness on benign ones. Across eight open-source and seven proprietary MLLMs, we observe persistent trade-offs between contextual safety and utility, with models tending to either miss gradual risks or over-refuse benign dialogues. Finally, we evaluate five current guardrails and find that they mitigate some failures but do not fully resolve multi-turn contextual risks.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型越来越多地被用作通过文本和图像进行交互的助手，因此评估上下文安全性变得至关重要，因为风险取决于视觉场景以及不断变化的对话。现有的上下文安全性基准测试大多只针对单轮对话，往往无法捕捉到恶意意图是如何逐渐产生的，或者同一个场景如何同时支持良性目标和利用性目标。我们提出了多轮多模态上下文安全性基准测试（MTMCS-Bench），该测试基于真实图像和多轮对话，旨在评估多模态大语言模型在两种互补环境下的上下文安全性：基于升级的风险环境和上下文切换风险环境。MTMCS-Bench提供了配对的安全和不安全对话，并进行了结构化的评估。该测试包含超过3万个多模态（图像+文本）和单模态（仅文本）样本，并设置了不同的指标来分别衡量上下文意图识别能力、对不安全情况的警觉性以及对于良性情况的帮助程度。通过对8个开源模型和7个专有模型的多轮测试，我们发现上下文安全性和实用性之间存在持续的权衡关系，模型要么无法识别渐进式风险，要么过度回应良性对话。最后，我们对现有的五种防护措施进行了评估，发现它们能够缓解一些问题，但并不能完全解决多轮上下文风险问题。
