papers.title: REAP: Towards Effective Training-Free Chemical Reasoning with Explicit Atomic Priors
papers.title_zh: REAP：利用显式原子先验实现有效的免训练化学推理
papers.authors: Mingxu Zhang, Dazhong Shen, Qi Zhang, Ying Sun
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong general reasoning but struggle in molecular science due to the lack of explicit priors required for precise chemical reasoning. Current solutions inject priors into parameters, but this static coupling hinders rapid knowledge updates and often compromises the model’s general capabilities. To address this, we introduce REAP, a training-free framework that equips LLMs with an external knowledge base, enabling them to reason over retrieved chemical priors dynamically. REAP implements a structured reasoning pipeline that autonomously selects relevant priors from our constructed atom-level knowledge base, retrieves analogue exemplars, and synthesizes these information to guide the LLM’s decision-making. This architecture ensures interpretability and adaptability while preserving the LLM’s intrinsic general intelligence. Experiments show that REAP outperforms current reasoning methods and rivals state-of-the-art training-based models, demonstrating the effectiveness of our framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在通用推理方面表现出强大的能力，但在分子科学领域却面临挑战，因为缺乏进行精确化学推理所需的明确先验知识。目前的解决方案是通过向模型参数中注入先验信息来解决问题，但这种静态的耦合方式会阻碍知识的快速更新，并且通常会损害模型的通用能力。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了REAP这一无需训练的框架。该框架为语言模型提供了一个外部知识库，使其能够动态地从知识库中检索相关的化学先验信息，并据此做出决策。REAP采用了一种结构化的推理流程：自动从构建的原子级知识库中选取相关的先验信息，查找相应的示例案例，并将这些信息综合起来以指导语言模型的决策。这种架构既保证了模型的可解释性和适应性，又保留了语言模型固有的通用智能。实验结果表明，REAP在推理性能上优于现有的方法，甚至可以与最先进的基于训练的模型相媲美，这充分证明了我们框架的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Towards Self-Improving Error Diagnosis in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 关于多智能体系统中自我改进的错误诊断机制
papers.authors: Jiazheng Li, Emine Yilmaz, Bei Chen, Thu Le
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) enable complex problem-solving but introduce significant debugging challenges, characterized by long interaction traces, inter-agent dependencies, and delayed error manifestation. Existing diagnostic approaches often rely on expensive expert annotation or ”LLM-as-a-judge” paradigms, which struggle to pinpoint decisive error steps within extended contexts. In this paper, we introduce ErrorProbe, a self-improving framework for semantic failure attribution that identifies responsible agents and the originating error step. The framework operates via a three-stage pipeline: (1) operationalizing the MAS failure taxonomy to detect local anomalies, (2) performing symptom-driven backward tracing to prune irrelevant context, and (3) employing a specialized multi-agent team (Strategist, Investigator, Arbiter) to validate error hypotheses through tool-grounded execution. Crucially, ErrorProbe maintains a verified episodic memory that updates only when error patterns are confirmed by executable evidence, without the need for annotation. Experiments across the TracerTraj and Who When benchmarks demonstrate that ErrorProbe significantly outperforms baselines, particularly in step-level localization, while the verified memory enables robust cross-domain transfer without retraining.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统能够实现复杂的问题解决，但同时也带来了重大的调试挑战。这些挑战表现为长时间的交互记录、不同智能体之间的依赖关系以及错误现象的延迟显现。现有的诊断方法往往依赖于昂贵的专家注释工作，或者采用“语言模型作为裁判”的范式，但这些方法在复杂环境中很难确定具体的错误步骤。在本文中，我们提出了ErrorProbe这一自改进框架，它能够对语义层面的故障进行归因分析，并识别出负责的智能体以及错误的来源步骤。该框架通过三个阶段来实现故障诊断：（1）构建多智能体系统的故障分类体系，以检测局部异常现象；（2）通过症状驱动的逆向追踪，剔除无关的背景信息；（3）利用专门的多智能体团队（策略师、调查员、仲裁者）来通过工具化的执行来验证错误假设。关键在于，ErrorProbe能够维护一个经过验证的事件记忆，只有当错误模式得到可执行证据的支持时，才会更新记忆内容，而无需进行额外的注释工作。在TracerTraj和Who When基准测试中的实验表明，ErrorProbe在错误定位方面明显优于传统方法，尤其是在步骤级定位方面。此外，经过验证的记忆能够使得系统在跨领域应用时能够保持稳定性能，而无需重新训练。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MulDimIF: A Multi-Dimensional Constraint Framework for Evaluating and Improving Instruction Following in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MulDimIF：一种多维约束框架，用于评估和改进大型语言模型的指令执行能力
papers.authors: Junjie Ye, Caishuang Huang, Zhuohan Chen, Wenjie Fu, Chenyuan Yang, Leyi Yang, Yilong Wu, Peng Wang, Meng Zhou, Xiaolong Yang, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Zhongchao Shi, Jianping Fan, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Instruction following refers to the ability of large language models (LLMs) to generate outputs that satisfy all specified constraints. Existing research has primarily focused on constraint categories, offering limited evaluation dimensions and little guidance for improving instruction-following abilities. To address this gap, we introduce MulDimIF, a multi-dimensional constraint framework encompassing three constraint patterns, four constraint categories, and four difficulty levels. Based on this framework, we design a controllable instruction generation pipeline. Through constraint expansion, conflict detection, and instruction rewriting, we construct 9,106 code-verifiable samples. We evaluate 18 LLMs from six model families and find marked performance differences across constraint settings. For instance, average accuracy decreases from 80.82% at Level I to 36.76% at Level IV. Moreover, training with data generated by our framework significantly improves instruction following without compromising general performance. In-depth analysis indicates that these gains stem largely from parameter updates in attention modules, which strengthen constraint recognition and adherence. Code and data are available in https://github.com/Junjie-Ye/MulDimIF.
papers.abstract_zh: 指令遵循能力指的是大语言模型（LLM）生成符合所有指定约束条件的输出的能力。现有的研究主要集中在约束类别上，提供的评估维度有限，对于提升指令遵循能力也缺乏有效的指导。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MulDimIF这一多维约束框架，该框架包含三种约束模式、四种约束类别以及四个难度等级。基于这一框架，我们设计了一个可控的指令生成流程。通过约束扩展、冲突检测以及指令重写等操作，我们构建了9,106个可验证的代码样本。我们对来自六个模型家族的18个LLM进行了评估，发现不同约束设置下它们的性能存在显著差异。例如，平均准确率从一级的80.82%下降到四级的36.76%。此外，使用我们框架生成的数据进行训练能够显著改善指令遵循能力，同时不会影响模型的整体性能。深入分析表明，这些改进主要源于注意力模块的参数更新，这些更新增强了模型对约束条件的识别与遵守能力。相关的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/Junjie-Ye/MulDimIF下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Text2Mem: A Unified Memory Operation Language for Memory Operating System
papers.title_zh: Text2Mem：一种用于内存操作系统的统一内存操作语言
papers.authors: Leo Wang, Lihai Yang, Boyu Chen, Kerun Xu, Gongyi Zou, Bo Tang, Feiyu Xiong, Siheng Chen, Zhiyu li
papers.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly rely on memory to support long-horizon interaction, yet existing frameworks expose only a small set of low-level primitives and lack a formal, executable specification for memory control. As a result, higher-order operations such as promotion, consolidation, or lifecycle governance are missing or inconsistently implemented, leading to unpredictable behavior across systems. We introduce Text2Mem, a unified memory operation language that standardizes the translation of natural-language instructions into reliable execution. Text2Mem defines a compact and expressive operation set spanning encoding, storage, and retrieval, and represents each instruction as a schema-based contract with explicit fields and semantic invariants. Validated schemas are parsed into typed operation objects and executed through a unified pipeline that supports both a SQL reference backend and real memory frameworks, enabling safe, deterministic, and portable behavior across heterogeneous systems. We further outline the Text2Mem Benchmark, which decouples schema generation from backend execution to systematically evaluate planning accuracy and execution fidelity. Together, Text2Mem and its benchmark establish a standardized foundation for controllable and reproducible memory management in LLM-based agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理越来越依赖内存来支持长期交互，但现有的框架仅提供了一组低级的原语，且缺乏用于内存控制的正式、可执行的规范。因此，诸如晋升、整合或生命周期管理这样的高级操作要么缺失，要么实施不一致，导致系统间出现不可预测的行为。我们提出了Text2Mem这一统一的记忆操作语言，它将自然语言指令转换为可靠的执行方式。Text2Mem定义了一套简洁而富有表现力的操作集，涵盖编码、存储和检索等方面，并将每条指令表示为一个基于模式的契约，包含明确的字段和语义不变性。经过验证的模式会被解析为类型化的操作对象，并通过一个统一的管道进行执行，该管道支持SQL引用后端和真实内存框架，从而实现在异构系统中安全、确定性和可移植性的行为。我们还介绍了Text2Mem基准测试，它将模式生成与后端执行分离，以便系统地评估规划准确性和执行可靠性。总的来说，Text2Mem及其基准测试为基于LLM的代理提供了可控且可复现的内存管理标准基础。

papers.title: AMO-Bench: Large Language Models Still Struggle in High School Math Competitions
papers.title_zh: AMO-Bench：大型语言模型在高中数学竞赛中仍然面临挑战
papers.authors: Junlin Liu, Shengnan An, Shuang Zhou, Dan Ma, Yehao Lin, Xinxuan Lv, Xuanlin Wang, Xiaoyu Li, Ziwen Wang, Xuezhi Cao, Xunliang Cai
papers.abstract: We present AMO-Bench, an Advanced Mathematical reasoning benchmark with Olympiad level or even higher difficulty, comprising 50 human-crafted problems. Existing benchmarks have widely leveraged high school math competitions for evaluating mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, many existing math competitions are becoming less effective for assessing top-tier LLMs due to performance saturation (e.g., AIME24/25). To address this, AMO-Bench introduces more rigorous challenges by ensuring all 50 problems are (1) cross-validated by experts to meet at least the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) difficulty standards, and (2) entirely original problems to prevent potential performance leakages from data memorization. Experimental results across 36 LLMs on AMO-Bench highlights three key findings: (1) high-level mathematical reasoning remains challenging for current LLMs, with even the best-performing model achieving only 63.1% accuracy and most LLMs scoring below 50%; (2) scaling test-time compute remains a highly effective strategy for substantially improving reasoning performances, and (3) open-source models are progressively narrowing the performance gap with proprietary models. Additionally, we conduct further analysis about reasoning efficiency, volatility, and cross-lingual robustness, providing deeper insights behind the reasoning performances.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了AMO-Bench，这是一个高级数学推理测试平台，其难度相当于或高于奥林匹克竞赛水平，包含50道由人类设计的题目。现有的测试平台通常借助高中数学竞赛来评估大语言模型的数学推理能力。然而，由于性能饱和问题（例如AIME24/25赛事），许多现有的数学竞赛在评估顶级语言模型时效果逐渐下降。为了解决这一问题，AMO-Bench引入了更严格的挑战机制：所有50道题目都经过专家交叉验证，以确保至少达到国际数学奥林匹克竞赛的标准；同时，这些题目都是完全原创的，以避免因数据记忆而导致的性能泄露。在36种语言模型上的实验结果表明：当前语言模型在高级数学推理方面仍然存在挑战，即使是最优秀的模型也只能达到63.1%的准确率，而大多数模型的准确率低于50%；扩展计算资源仍然是显著提升推理性能的有效策略；此外，开源模型正在逐步缩小与专有模型的性能差距。我们还对推理效率、波动性以及跨语言鲁棒性进行了进一步分析，从而更深入地了解推理性能背后的原理。

papers.title: Solver-Independent Automated Problem Formulation via LLMs for High-Cost Simulation-Driven Design
papers.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的、与求解器无关的自动化问题建模方法，适用于高成本仿真驱动的设计流程
papers.authors: Yuchen Li, Handing Wang, Bing Xue, Mengjie Zhang, Yaochu Jin
papers.abstract: In the high-cost simulation-driven design domain, translating ambiguous design requirements into a mathematical optimization formulation is a bottleneck for optimizing product performance. This process is time-consuming and heavily reliant on expert knowledge. While large language models (LLMs) offer potential for automating this task, existing approaches either suffer from poor formalization that fails to accurately align with the design intent or rely on solver feedback for data filtering, which is unavailable due to the high simulation costs. To address this challenge, we propose automated problem formulation (APF), a solver-independent framework that utilizes LLMs to convert engineers’ natural language requirements into executable optimization models. The core of this framework is an innovative pipeline for automatically generating high-quality data, which overcomes the difficulty of constructing suitable fine-tuning datasets in the absence of high-cost solver feedback with the help of data generation and test instance annotation. The generated high-quality dataset is used to perform supervised fine-tuning on LLMs, significantly enhancing their ability to generate accurate and executable optimization problem formulations. Experimental results on antenna design demonstrate that APF significantly outperforms the existing methods in both the accuracy of requirement formalization and the quality of resulting radiation efficiency curves in meeting the design goals.
papers.abstract_zh: 在成本高昂的仿真驱动设计领域，将模糊的设计需求转化为数学优化模型是提升产品性能的关键环节。这一过程耗时较长，且严重依赖专家知识。虽然大语言模型具有自动化处理这一任务的潜力，但现有方法要么存在形式化不足的问题，无法准确反映设计意图；要么依赖于求解器的反馈来进行数据筛选，但由于仿真成本过高，这种反馈往往难以获得。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了自动化问题建模技术（APF），这是一种与求解器无关的框架，它利用大语言模型将工程师的自然语言需求转化为可执行的优化模型。该框架的核心是一个创新的流程，能够自动生成高质量的数据，从而在缺乏高成本求解器反馈的情况下，通过数据生成和测试实例标注来克服构建合适微调数据集的困难。生成的高质量数据集可用于对大语言模型进行监督式微调，从而显著提升其生成精确且可执行的优化问题模型的能力。在天线设计的实验结果表明，APF在需求形式化的准确性以及最终辐射效率曲线的质量方面，都显著优于现有的方法。

papers.title: When Facts Change: Temporal Knowledge Conflict Resolution in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 当事实发生变化时：大语言模型中的时间认知冲突解决机制
papers.authors: Jonas Wallat, Wolfgang Nejdl, Sandipan Sikdar
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems require large language models (LLMs) to reconcile discrepancies between their parametric memory—knowledge encoded during training—and contextual inputs provided at inference. When these sources conflict, models often exhibit unstable reasoning and inconsistent factual behavior. We investigate how LLMs resolve such conflicts when the discrepancy arises from temporal misalignment—facts that have changed since the model’s knowledge cutoff—and whether mutability, the changeability of facts, can serve as a mediating signal in this process. To do so, we provide WIKIRECENTCHANGES, a temporally grounded benchmark with stable and recently updated facts derived from Wikidata.Our results show that while models spontaneously produce temporal reasoning for facts that actually changed — but almost never for stable ones — this differentiation rarely propagates to their final predictions. Explicitly prompting them to consider mutability increases references to temporal change but does not improve factual accuracy, revealing a disconnect between verbalized reasoning and prediction behavior. We further show that the failure point is scale-dependent: smaller models rarely detect the underlying conflict, while larger models detect it but fail to act on their mutability judgments.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统需要大语言模型来协调其参数化记忆——即在训练过程中编码的知识——与推理时提供的上下文信息之间的矛盾。当这两种信息发生冲突时，模型往往会表现出不稳定的推理能力和不一致的事实判断。我们研究了当矛盾源于时间错位——即自模型知识截止点以来发生变化的事实——时，大语言模型如何解决这些冲突，以及事实的可变性是否可以作为这一过程中的中介信号。为此，我们开发了WIKIRECENTCHANGES这个基于时间的基准测试，该测试包含来自Wikidata的稳定且最近更新的事实。我们的研究表明，虽然模型能够自发地对已经发生变化的事实进行时间推理——但几乎无法对稳定的事实进行此类推理——但这种差异很少会影响到模型的最终预测结果。明确提示模型考虑事实的可变性确实会增加对时间变化的关注，但并未提高事实判断的准确性，这表明模型在语言表达推理与预测行为之间存在脱节。此外，我们还发现，这种冲突的失效点取决于模型规模：较小的模型很少能检测到潜在的冲突，而较大的模型虽然能检测到冲突，但却无法根据事实的可变性做出正确的判断。

papers.title: SCRIPT: A Subcharacter Compositional Representation Injection Module for Korean Pre-Trained Language Models
papers.title_zh: 脚本：一种用于韩语预训练语言模型的子字符组合表示注入模块
papers.authors: SungHo Kim, Juhyeong Park, Eda Atalay, SangKeun Lee
papers.abstract: Korean is a morphologically rich language with a featural writing system in which each character is systematically composed of subcharacter units known as Jamo. These subcharacters not only determine the visual structure of Korean but also encode frequent and linguistically meaningful morphophonological processes. However, most current Korean language models (LMs) are based on subword tokenization schemes, which are not explicitly designed to capture the internal compositional structure of characters. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{SCRIPT}, a model-agnostic module that injects subcharacter compositional knowledge into Korean PLMs.\textbf{SCRIPT} allows to enhance subword embeddings with structural granularity, without requiring architectural changes or additional pre-training.As a result, \textbf{SCRIPT} consistently enhances all baselines across various Korean natural language understanding (NLU) and generation (NLG) tasks. Moreover, beyond performance gains, detailed linguistic analyses show that \textbf{SCRIPT} reshapes the embedding space in a way that better captures grammatical regularities and semantically cohesive variations. Our code is available at https://github.com/SungHo3268/SCRIPT.
papers.abstract_zh: 韩语是一种形态丰富的语言，其书写系统中的每个字符都是由称为“Jamo”的子字符单元构成的。这些子字符不仅决定了韩语的视觉结构，还编码了那些在语言学上具有重要意义的形式音系过程。然而，目前大多数韩语语言模型都是基于词块分词方案设计的，这些方案并未明确考虑捕捉字符的内部构成结构。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种与模型无关的模块——**SCRIPT**，该模块能够将子字符的构成知识融入韩语的语言模型之中。**SCRIPT**能够在不进行架构调整或额外预训练的情况下，增强词嵌入的结构性细节。结果表明，**SCRIPT**在各种韩语自然语言理解和生成任务中都能持续提升性能。此外，从详细的语言分析来看，**SCRIPT**改变了嵌入空间的结构，使其更能捕捉语法规律以及语义上的连贯性变化。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/SungHo3268/SCRIPT下载。

papers.title: PibE-MPP: A Play-it-by-Ear Masking Performance Plug-in for LLMs
papers.title_zh: PibE-MPP：一种适用于大语言模型的“按耳朵播放”掩蔽式表演插件
papers.authors: Mengwei Wang, Simin Niu, Xun Liang, Yuefeng Ma, Sensen Zhang, Jiawei Yang, Shichao Song, Hanyu Wang, Huayi Lai
papers.abstract: Treating random masking as a performance plug-in for large language models (LLMs) offers three advantages: low coupling to the task, the model, and training resources. However, the critical drawback is that its gains are highly stochastic. Motivated by this, we propose play-it-by-ear masking performance plug-in (PibE-MPP), which enables LLMs to adaptively select masking target combinations for each task, retaining these advantages and mitigating the drawback. Specifically, we pose two core questions—what are the masking targets and what is the masking strategy under 7 constraints obtained from these advantages and a drawback. For the first question, we select all attention heads in the last layer as masking targets by constructing a first-order Markov process with alternating hidden state and information fusion. The feasibility of this target is validated by random masking experiments. For the second question, we first construct a small yet interpretable candidate set by proposing a three-axis mapping and a mean-based criterion for fusion features of masking targets. We then propose an axis-variance minimization to select a compact masking-target combination, reducing sensitivity to outlier targets. Experiments on 6 LLMs (Qwen and LLaMA) and 24 datasets demonstrate PibE-MPP’s effectiveness and generality, gain stability, and domain performance, and verify the necessity of its final module, providing empirical evidence of its transferability across tasks and models. The code is available at https://github.com/wtctcop/PibE-MPP.
papers.abstract_zh: 将随机掩码视为大语言模型（LLM）的性能插件具有以下三个优势：与任务、模型和训练资源的耦合度较低。然而，其关键缺点是所带来的收益具有高度随机性。基于这一特点，我们提出了一种基于经验的掩码性能插件（PibE-MPP），该插件使LLM能够自适应地为每个任务选择掩码目标组合，从而保留这些优势并缓解随机性的负面影响。具体来说，我们提出了两个核心问题：在遵循上述优势和缺点所确定的7个约束条件下，掩码目标应该是什么？掩码策略又该如何制定？对于第一个问题，我们通过构建一阶马尔可夫过程，结合交替隐藏状态和信息融合技术，将所有最后层的注意力头选为掩码目标。通过随机掩码实验验证了这种目标的可行性。对于第二个问题，我们首先通过提出一种三轴映射方法和基于均值的标准来构建一组小型且易于理解的候选掩码目标组合。然后，我们采用轴方差最小化算法来选取一个简洁的掩码目标组合，从而降低了对异常目标的敏感性。在6种LLM（如Qwen和LaLA）以及24个数据集上的实验表明，PibE-MPP具有有效性、通用性、稳定的收益以及良好的领域表现。这些实验还验证了其作为最终模块的必要性和跨任务和模型的适用性。代码可在https://github.com/wtctcop/PibE-MPP获取。

papers.title: RoleCDE: Benchmarking and Mitigating Role–Alignment Trade-offs in Role-Playing Agents
papers.title_zh: RoleCDE：在角色扮演型智能体中平衡角色定位与性能优化之间的关系研究
papers.authors: Huayi Lai, Shichao Song, Simin Niu, Hanyu Wang, Jiawei Yang, Zhouxing Wang, Zhiqiang Yin, Xun Liang
papers.abstract: Role-playing agents(RPAs) are widely used to steer large language models(LLMs) toward role-consistent behavior, yet existing benchmarks mainly evaluate surface-level fidelity and offer limited insight into decision making under role–alignment value conflicts. To address this gap, we introduce RoleCDE, the first benchmark designed to evaluate RPAs under structured conflicts between role-specific values and alignment-oriented constraints. RoleCDE formulates role-aware decision making as cognitive dilemma scenarios, jointly evaluating role–scenario grounding, value conflict resolution, and decision tendencies. The benchmark is constructed at scale, covering approximately 8k diverse role profiles and scenarios and nearly 240k dilemma instances across three difficulty levels and eight role categories. Evaluation of several mainstream LLMs reveals a “Role Value Decoupling” phenomenon, where agents systematically default to alignment- and morality-consistent decisions rather than role-specific values when the two conflict, even under explicit role conditioning. This behavior is largely invariant to dilemma difficulty but varies substantially across role categories. We further show that RoleCDE-based fine-tuning effectively mitigates this decoupling by improving value trade-off reasoning, while preserving general role-playing fidelity and general reasoning performance. Code is available at: https://github.com/rabbitrose/RoleCDE.
papers.abstract_zh: 角色扮演智能体被广泛用于引导大语言模型表现出符合角色要求的行为。然而，现有的评估基准主要关注的是表面上的忠实度，对于在角色一致性与特定价值观之间出现冲突时的决策过程却缺乏深入的分析。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了RoleCDE这一新的评估基准。该基准旨在评估智能体在角色特定价值观与一致性约束之间存在结构性冲突时的表现。RoleCDE将角色感知的决策过程转化为认知困境场景，综合评估角色场景的匹配程度、价值观冲突的解决方式以及决策倾向。该基准具有大规模的数据集，涵盖了大约8000种不同的角色特征和场景，以及近24万个困境实例，这些实例分为三个难度等级和八个不同的角色类别。对多个主流语言模型的评估结果显示，存在一种“角色价值分离”现象：当两种价值观发生冲突时，智能体会系统性地选择符合一致性和道德要求的决策，而不是遵循特定角色的价值观。这种行为在不同难度级别的困境中基本保持不变，但在不同角色类别之间则存在显著差异。我们还发现，基于RoleCDE的微调技术能够有效缓解这种价值分离现象，通过改善价值权衡推理能力来提升智能体的性能，同时保持良好的角色扮演忠实度和推理能力。相关代码可访问：https://github.com/rabbitrose/RoleCDE。

papers.title: PolicyLLM: Towards Excellent Comprehension of Public Policy for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 政策与语言模型：致力于让大型语言模型更好地理解公共政策
papers.authors: Han Bao, Penghao Zhang, Yue Huang, Zhengqing Yuan, Yanchi Ru, SU Rui, Yujun Zhou, Xiangqi Wang, Kehan Guo, Nitesh V Chawla, Yanfang Ye, Xiangliang Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into real-world decision-making, including in the domain of public policy. Yet, their ability to comprehend and reason about policy-related content remains underexplored. To fill this gap, we present PolicyBench, the first large-scale bilingual benchmark evaluating policy comprehension, comprising 21K cases across a broad spectrum of policy areas, capturing the diversity and complexity of real-world governance. Following Bloom’s taxonomy, the benchmark assesses three core capabilities: (1) Memorization: factual recall of policy knowledge, (2) Understanding: conceptual and contextual reasoning, and (3) Application: problem-solving in real-life policy scenarios. Building on this benchmark, we further propose PolicyMoE, a domain-specialized Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with expert modules aligned to each cognitive level. The proposed models demonstrate stronger performance on application-oriented policy tasks than on memorization or conceptual understanding, and yields the highest accuracy on structured reasoning tasks. Our results reveal key limitations of current LLMs in policy understanding and suggest paths toward more reliable, policy-focused models
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被应用于现实世界的决策过程中，包括公共政策领域。然而，它们对政策相关内容的理解和推理能力仍未被充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了PolicyBench——首个大规模双语基准测试平台，用于评估政策理解能力。该基准测试包含21,000个案例，涵盖了广泛的政策领域，充分体现了现实世界治理的多样性和复杂性。根据布卢姆分类法，该基准测试评估了三个核心能力：（1）记忆：对政策知识的实际回忆；（2）理解：概念性和情境性推理；（3）应用：在现实政策场景中解决问题。在此基础上，我们进一步提出了PolicyMoE模型，这是一种针对特定领域的混合专家模型，其专家模块与各个认知层次相匹配。与单纯的记忆或概念理解任务相比，该模型在应用性政策任务上的表现更为出色，并且在结构化推理任务中取得了最高的准确率。我们的研究结果揭示了当前LLM在政策理解方面存在的关键局限性，并为构建更可靠、以政策为中心的模型提供了方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BOOKAGENT: Orchestrating Safety-Aware Visual Narratives via Multi-Agent Cognitive Calibration
papers.title_zh: 图书代理：通过多智能体认知校准，打造注重安全的视觉叙事方式
papers.authors: Bo Gao, Chang Liu, Yuyang Miao, SiYuan Ma, Ser-Nam Lim
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Large Generative Models (LGMs) have revolutionized multi-modal generation. However, generating illustrated storybooks remains an open challenge, where prior works mainly decompose this task into separate stages, and thus, holistic multi-modal grounding remains limited. Besides, while safety alignment is studied for text- or image-only generation, existing works rarely integrate child-specific safety constraints into narrative planning and sequence-level multi-modal verification. To address these limitations, we propose BookAgent, a safety-aware multi-agent collaboration framework designed for high-quality, safety-aware visual narratives. Different from prior story visualization models that assume a fixed storyline sequence, BookAgent targets end-to-end storybook synthesis from a user draft by jointly planning, scripting, illustrating, and globally repairing inconsistencies. To ensure precise multi-modal grounding, BookAgent dynamically calibrates page-level alignment between textual scripts and visual layouts. Furthermore, BookAgent calibrates holistic consistency from the temporal dimension, by verifying-then-rectifying global inconsistencies in character identity and storytelling logic. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BookAgent significantly outperforms current methods in narrative coherence, visual consistency, and safety compliance, offering a robust paradigm for reliable agents in complex multi-modal creation. The implementation will be publicly released at https://github.com/bogao-code/BookAgent/tree/main.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在大型生成模型领域取得的进展彻底改变了多模态生成的模式。然而，生成带有插图的故事书仍然是一个尚未解决的挑战。以往的研究通常将这一任务分解为多个独立阶段，因此，多模态数据的整体对齐仍然存在局限性。此外，虽然已经研究了针对文本或图像生成的安全性对齐问题，但现有研究很少将儿童特定的安全约束因素融入到叙事规划和多模态验证过程中。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了BookAgent这一基于安全性意识的多智能体协作框架，旨在实现高质量且符合安全要求的视觉叙事。与那些假设固定故事情节顺序的先前故事可视化模型不同，BookAgent能够从用户提供的草稿出发，通过联合规划、脚本编写、插图绘制以及全局修复不一致性来实现故事书的整體合成。为了确保精确的多模态对齐，BookAgent能够动态调整文本脚本与视觉布局之间的页面级对齐关系。此外，BookAgent还能从时间维度上确保整体的一致性，通过验证并修正角色身份和叙事逻辑中的全局不一致性来实现这一目标。大量实验表明，BookAgent在叙事连贯性、视觉一致性以及安全性方面均优于当前的方法，为复杂多模态创作中的可靠智能体提供了一个强大的解决方案。该框架的实现代码已公开在https://github.com/bogao-code/BookAgent/tree/main网站上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Feedback-Driven Tool-Use Improvements in Large Language Models via Automated Build Environments
papers.title_zh: 基于反馈的大型语言模型工具使用改进——通过自动化构建环境实现
papers.authors: Junjie Ye, Changhao Jiang, Zhengyin Du, Yufei Xu, Xuesong Yao, Zhiheng Xi, Xiaoran Fan, Qi Zhang, Tao Gui, Xuanjing Huang, Jiecao Chen
papers.abstract: Effective tool use is essential for large language models (LLMs) to interact with their environment. However, progress is limited by the lack of efficient reinforcement learning (RL) frameworks specifically designed for tool use, due to challenges in constructing stable training environments and designing verifiable reward mechanisms. To address this, we propose an automated environment construction pipeline, incorporating scenario decomposition, document generation, function integration, complexity scaling, and localized deployment. This enables the creation of high-quality training environments that provide detailed and measurable feedback without relying on external tools. Additionally, we introduce a verifiable reward mechanism that evaluates both the precision of tool use and the completeness of task execution. When combined with trajectory data collected from the constructed environments, this mechanism integrates seamlessly with standard RL algorithms to facilitate feedback-driven model training. Experiments on LLMs of varying scales demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances the models’ tool-use performance without degrading their general capabilities. Our analysis suggests that these gains result from improved context understanding and reasoning, driven by updates to the lower-layer MLP parameters in models. Code and data are available at https://github.com/bytedance/FTRL.
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的工具使用对于大语言模型与环境的互动至关重要。然而，由于缺乏专门为工具使用设计的高效强化学习框架，这一进展受到了限制。由于难以构建稳定的训练环境以及设计可验证的奖励机制，这方面的研究进展十分有限。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种自动化的环境构建流程，该流程包括场景分解、文档生成、功能整合、复杂性调整以及本地化部署等步骤。通过这种方式，我们可以创建出高质量的训练环境，从而提供详细且可量化的反馈，而无需依赖外部工具。此外，我们还引入了一种可验证的奖励机制，该机制能够评估工具使用的准确性以及任务执行的完整性。当这种机制与从构建出的环境中收集到的轨迹数据相结合时，它能够与标准强化学习算法无缝集成，从而实现以反馈为驱动的模型训练。针对不同规模的大语言模型的实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了模型的工具使用能力，同时并未降低模型的整体性能。我们的分析表明，这些改进得益于对模型底层MLP参数的优化，从而提升了模型的上下文理解和推理能力。相关的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/bytedance/FTRL上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Do Domain-specific Experts exist in MoE-based LLMs?
papers.title_zh: 在基于领域特定专家的LLMs中，是否存在这样的专家呢？
papers.authors: Giang Do, Hung Le, Truyen Tran
papers.abstract: In the era of Large Language Models (LLMs), the Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture has emerged as an effective approach for training extremely large models with improved computational efficiency. This success builds upon extensive prior research aimed at enhancing expert specialization in MoE-based LLMs. However, the nature of such specializations and how they can be systematically interpreted remain open research challenges. In this work, we investigate this gap by posing a fundamental question: Do domain-specific experts exist in MoE-based LLMs? To answer the question, we evaluate ten advanced MoE-based LLMs ranging from 3.8B to 120B parameters and provide empirical evidence for the existence of domain-specific experts. Building on this finding, we propose Domain Steering Mixture of Experts (DSMoE), a training-free framework that introduces zero additional inference cost and outperforms both well-trained MoE-based LLMs and strong baselines, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Experiments on four advanced open-source MoE-based LLMs across both target and non-target domains demonstrate that our method achieves strong performance and robust generalization without increasing inference cost or requiring additional retraining.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型时代，混合专家架构被证明是一种有效的训练超大规模模型的方法，其计算效率得到了显著提升。这一成果建立在大量先前研究的基础上，这些研究旨在增强基于混合专家的LLM在专业能力方面的优势。然而，这些专业能力的本质以及如何对其进行系统性的解读，仍然是一个尚未解决的研究难题。在这项研究中，我们通过提出一个基本问题来探索这一空白：基于混合专家的LLM中是否存在特定领域的专家？为了回答这个问题，我们评估了十种先进的基于混合专家的LLM，它们的参数规模从38亿到1200亿不等，并提供了关于特定领域专家存在的实证证据。基于这一发现，我们提出了领域指导混合专家框架（DSMoE），这是一种无需训练的框架，它不会增加额外的推理成本，并且其性能优于那些经过良好训练的基于混合专家的LLM以及强大的基准模型，包括有监督微调模型。我们在四个先进的开源基于混合专家的LLM上进行实验，这些模型涵盖了目标领域和非目标领域，结果表明，我们的方法能够在不增加推理成本或需要额外重新训练的情况下，实现强大的性能和稳健的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AutoUE: Automated Generation of 3D Games in Unreal Engine via Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: AutoUE：利用多智能体系统在Unreal Engine中自动生成3D游戏
papers.authors: Lei Yin, Wentao Cheng, Zhida Qin, Tianyu Huang, Yidong Li, Gangyi Ding
papers.abstract: Automatically generating 3D games in commercial game engines remains a non-trivial challenge, as it involves complex engine-related workflows for generating assets such as scenes, blueprints, and code. To address this challenge, we propose a novel multi-agent system, AutoUE, which coordinates multiple agents to end-to-end generate 3D games, covering model retrieval, scene generation, gameplay and interaction code synthesis, and automated game testing for evaluation. In order to mitigate tool-use hallucinations in LLMs, we introduce a retrieval-augmented generation mechanism that grounds agents with relevant UE tool documentation. Additionally, we incorporate game design patterns and engine constraints into the code generation process to ensure the generation of correct and robust code. Furthermore, we design an automated play-testing pipeline that generates and executes runtime test commands, enabling systematic evaluation of dynamic behaviors. Finally, we construct a game generation dataset and conduct a series of experiments that demonstrate AutoUE’s ability to generate 3D games end-to-end, and validate the effectiveness of these designs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在商业游戏引擎中自动生成3D游戏仍然是一个非易事的挑战，因为这涉及到复杂的引擎相关工作流程，以生成诸如场景、蓝图和代码等资产。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的多智能体系统AutoUE，该系统能够协调多个智能体来端到端地生成3D游戏，包括模型检索、场景生成、游戏玩法和交互代码的合成，以及自动化的游戏测试评估。为了减轻大语言模型中的工具使用幻觉问题，我们引入了一种基于检索增强的生成机制，该机制通过相关的UE工具文档来引导智能体的行为。此外，我们将游戏设计模式和引擎约束纳入代码生成过程中，以确保生成出正确且健壮的代码。我们还设计了一个自动化的游戏测试流程，该流程能够生成并执行运行时测试命令，从而实现动态行为的系统性评估。最后，我们构建了一个游戏生成数据集，并开展了一系列实验，这些实验证明了AutoUE能够端到端地生成3D游戏，并验证了这些设计的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Comprehensive Benchmarking of Long-Form Speech Generation in Diverse Scenarios
papers.title_zh: 对不同场景下长文本语音生成的全面评估
papers.authors: Changhao Pan, Rui Yang, Han Wang, Zhuan Zhou, Xuming He, Wenxiang Guo, Ziyue Jiang, Ruiqi Li, Yu Zhang, Chenyuhao Wen, Ke Lei, Xiang Yin, Jingyu Lu, Zhiyuan Zhu, Zhou Zhao
papers.abstract: Recent advances in speech generation have enabled high-fidelity synthesis, yet systematic evaluation of models under long-context conditions remains largely underexplored. A comprehensive evaluation benchmark for long-form speech is indispensable for two reasons: 1) existing test scenarios are often confined to limited domains, creating a significant gap with the diverse downstream applications; 2) existing metrics overlook critical long-text factors such as consistency and coherence, failing to generalize reliably. To this end, we propose LFSBench, a comprehensive benchmark that decomposes “long-form speech quality” into specific, disentangled dimensions. LFSBench has three key properties. 1) Rich speech scenarios: Focusing on long-form speech generation and multi-speaker dialog generation, LFSBench covers acoustics, semantics, and expressiveness challenges, and consists of 1,101 samples spanning 17 common speech scenarios; 2) Comprehensive evaluation dimensions: Along the acoustics, semantics, and expressiveness axes, LFSBench defines an automated evaluation protocol with seven metrics to provide a comprehensive, accurate, and standardized assessment; 3) Valuable Insights: Through extensive experiments, we reveal that current models still struggle in highly expressive scenarios and exhibit a notable gap in consistency and hierarchy compared to real recordings.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，语音生成技术取得了显著进展，使得高保真度的合成成为可能。然而，对于长文本环境下的模型进行系统评估仍然是一个尚未充分探索的领域。建立一个全面的长文本语音评估基准至关重要，原因有二：首先，现有的测试场景往往局限于特定领域，这与 다양한实际应用需求存在较大差距；其次，现有的评估指标忽略了长文本中的关键要素，如一致性和连贯性，这些因素对于评估结果的可靠性至关重要。为此，我们提出了LFSBench这一全面的评估基准，它将“长文本语音质量”分解为多个具体的、可分离的维度。LFSBench具有三个主要特点：1）丰富的语音场景：专注于长文本语音生成和多说话者对话生成，LFSBench涵盖了声学、语义和表达力方面的挑战，包含了1,101个样本，涵盖17种常见的语音场景；2）全面的评估维度：在声学、语义和表达力这三个维度上，LFSBench定义了一个包含七项指标的自动化评估协议，以提供全面、准确且标准化的评估；3）有价值的洞察：通过广泛的实验，我们发现当前模型在高度表达性的场景中仍然存在困难，与真实录音相比，它们在一致性和层次结构方面也存在明显的差距。

papers.title: CAST: Achieving Stable LLM-based Text Analysis for Data Analytics
papers.title_zh: 成果：实现了基于大语言模型的稳定文本分析技术，为数据分析提供了有力支持
papers.authors: Jinxiang Xie, Zihao Li, Wei He, Rui Ding, Shi Han, Dongmei Zhang
papers.abstract: Text analysis of tabular data relies on two core operations: summarization for corpus-level theme extraction and tagging for row-level labeling. A critical limitation of employing large language models (LLMs) for these tasks is their inability to meet the high standards of output stability demanded by data analytics. To address this challenge, we introduce CAST (Consistency via Algorithmic Prompting and Stable Thinking), a framework that enhances output stability by constraining the model’s latent reasoning trajectory. CAST combines (i) Algorithmic Prompting to impose a procedural scaffold over valid reasoning transitions and (ii) Thinking-before-Speaking to enforce explicit intermediate commitments before final generation. To measure progress, we introduce CAST-S and CAST-T, stability metrics for bulleted summarization and tagging, and validate their alignment with human judgments. Experiments across publicly available benchmarks on multiple LLM backbones show that CAST consistently achieves the best stability among all baselines, improving Stability Score by up to 16.2%, while maintaining or improving output quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格数据的文本分析依赖于两个核心操作：对语料库级别的主题进行总结，以及对行级数据进行标注。使用大语言模型进行这些任务的一个关键限制是，它们无法达到数据分析所要求的高水平输出稳定性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了CAST（通过算法提示和稳定思维实现一致性）框架。该框架通过约束模型的潜在推理路径来提高输出稳定性。CAST结合了两种机制：(i) 算法提示，为有效的推理过程提供程序化的指导；(ii) 先思考后发言的机制，在最终生成之前强制进行明确的阶段性决策。为了衡量进展，我们引入了CAST-S和CAST-T两种稳定性评估指标，用于评估摘要总结和标注任务的稳定性，并验证了这些指标与人类判断的一致性。在多个基于大语言模型的公开基准测试中的实验表明，CAST在所有基线模型中始终表现出最佳的稳定性，其稳定性评分提高了16.2%，同时保持了或提升了输出质量。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: WavAlign: Enhancing Intelligence and Expressiveness in Spoken Dialogue Models via Adaptive Hybrid Post-Training
papers.title_zh: WavAlign：通过自适应混合式预训练技术，提升语音对话模型的智能性与表现力
papers.authors: Yifu Chen, Shengpeng Ji, Qian Chen, Tianle Liang, Yangzhuo Li, Ziqing Wang, Wen Wang, Jingyu Lu, Haoxiao Wang, Xueyi Pu, Fan Zhuo, Zhou Zhao
papers.abstract: End-to-end spoken dialogue models have garnered significant attention because they offer a higher potential ceiling in expressiveness and perceptual ability than cascaded systems. However, the intelligence and expressiveness of current open-source spoken dialogue models often remain below expectations. Motivated by the success of online reinforcement learning(RL) in other domains, one might attempt to directly apply preference optimization to spoken dialogue models, yet this transfer is non-trivial. We analyze these obstacles from the perspectives of reward modeling and rollout sampling, focusing on how sparse preference supervision interacts with dense speech generation under shared-parameter updates. Based on the analysis, we propose a modality-aware adaptive post-training recipe that makes RL practical for spoken dialogue: it constrains preference updates to the semantic channel and improves acoustic behavior via explicit anchoring, while dynamically regulating their mixture from rollout statistics to avoid unreliable preference gradients. We evaluate the method across multiple spoken dialogue benchmarks and representative architectures, and observe consistent improvements in semantic quality and speech expressiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 端到端的语音对话模型受到了广泛关注，因为它们在表达能力和感知能力方面具有更高的潜力。然而，当前开源语音对话模型的智能水平和表达能力往往未能达到预期。鉴于在线强化学习在其他领域取得的成功，人们可能会尝试直接将偏好优化方法应用于语音对话模型，但实际上这种迁移并不简单。我们从奖励建模和样本集选取的角度分析了这些障碍，重点关注稀疏偏好监督与密集语音生成在共享参数更新下的相互作用。基于上述分析，我们提出了一种考虑模态特性的自适应后训练方法，使得强化学习能够适用于语音对话领域：该方法将偏好更新限制在语义层面，并通过明确的锚定机制改善语音表现，同时根据样本数据动态调节混合效果，以避免出现不可靠的偏好梯度。我们在多个语音对话基准测试以及代表性架构上对该方法进行了评估，发现其在语义质量和语音表达能力方面都取得了显著的提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: OmniCompliance-100K: A Multi-Domain, Rule-Grounded, Real-World Safety Compliance Dataset
papers.title_zh: OmniCompliance-100K：一个涵盖多个领域、基于规则的实际安全合规数据集
papers.authors: Wenbin Hu, Huihao Jing, Haochen Shi, Changxuan Fan, Haoran Li, Yangqiu Song
papers.abstract: Ensuring the safety and compliance of large language models (LLMs) is of paramount importance. However, existing LLM safety datasets often rely on ad-hoc taxonomies for data generation and suffer from a significant shortage of rule-grounded, real-world cases that are essential for robustly protecting LLMs. In this work, we address this critical gap by constructing a comprehensive safety dataset from a compliance perspective. Using a powerful web-searching agent, we collect a rule-grounded, real-world case dataset OmniCompliance-100K, sourced from multi-domain authoritative references. The dataset spans 74 regulations and policies across a wide range of domains, including security and privacy regulations, content safety and user data privacy policies from leading AI companies and social media platforms, financial security requirements, medical device risk management standards, educational integrity guidelines, and protections of fundamental human rights. In total, our dataset contains 12,985 distinct rules and 106,009 associated real-world compliance cases. Our analysis confirms a strong alignment between the rules and their corresponding cases. We further conduct extensive benchmarking experiments to evaluate the safety and compliance capabilities of advanced LLMs across different model scales. Our experiments reveal several interesting findings that have great potential to offer valuable insights for future LLM safety research.
papers.abstract_zh: 确保大语言模型的安全性与合规性至关重要。然而，现有的大语言模型安全数据集往往依赖于临时性的分类方式来进行数据生成，并且缺乏大量基于规则的真实案例，而这些案例对于有效保护大语言模型来说是非常必要的。在这项研究中，我们试图通过构建一个全面的、从合规角度出发的安全数据集来弥补这一缺陷。我们利用强大的网络搜索工具，收集了一个名为OmniCompliance-100K的基于规则的真实案例数据集，该数据集来源于多个领域的权威参考资料。这个数据集涵盖了74项不同领域的法规和政策，包括安全和隐私法规、主要人工智能公司和社交媒体平台的内容安全与用户数据隐私政策、金融安全要求、医疗器械风险管理标准、教育诚信指南以及基本人权的保护等方面。总体而言，我们的数据集包含了12,985条不同的规则以及106,009个相关的真实合规案例。我们的分析表明，这些规则与其对应的案例之间存在着高度的一致性。此外，我们还进行了广泛的基准测试实验，以评估先进大语言模型在不同模型规模下的安全性和合规性能力。我们的实验发现了一些有趣的发现，这些发现为未来大语言模型安全研究提供了宝贵的见解。

papers.title: AutoMonitor-Bench: Evaluating the Reliability of LLM-Based Misbehavior Monitor
papers.title_zh: AutoMonitor-Bench：评估基于大语言模型的不良行为监测系统的可靠性
papers.authors: Shu Yang, Jingyu Hu, Tong Li, Hanqi Yan, Wenxuan Wang, Di Wang
papers.abstract: We introduce AutoMonitor-Bench, the first benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the reliability of LLM-based misbehavior monitors across diverse tasks and failure modes. AutoMonitor-Bench consists of 3,010 carefully annotated test samples spanning question answering, code generation, and reasoning, with paired misbehavior and benign instances. We evaluate monitors using two complementary metrics: Miss Rate (MR) and False Alarm Rate (FAR), capturing failures to detect misbehavior and oversensitivity to benign behavior respectively. Evaluating 12 proprietary and 10 open-source LLMs, we observe substantial variability in monitoring performance and a consistent trade-off between MR and FAR, revealing an inherent safety–utility tension. To further explore the limits of monitor reliability, we construct a large-scale training corpus of 153,581 samples and fine-tune Qwen3-4B-Instruction, to investigate whether training on known, relatively easy-to-construct misbehavior datasets improves monitoring performance on unseen and more implicit misbehaviors. Our results highlight the challenges of reliable, scalable misbehavior monitoring and motivate future work on task-aware designing and training strategies for LLM-based monitors.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了AutoMonitor-Bench这一基准测试工具，这是首个旨在系统评估基于大语言模型的不良行为监测工具在不同任务和故障模式下的可靠性的工具。AutoMonitor-Bench包含3,010个经过仔细标注的测试样本，这些样本涵盖了问答、代码生成和推理等场景，其中包含了与不良行为相对应的实例以及正常行为的实例。我们通过两个互补的指标来评估这些监测工具的性能：误报率（Miss Rate, MR）和误警率（False Alarm Rate, FAR），分别用于衡量检测不良行为的准确性以及对正常行为的过度敏感程度。通过对12种专有大语言模型和10种开源大语言模型进行评估，我们发现不同模型在监测性能上存在显著差异，同时MR和FAR之间也存在一种稳定的权衡关系，这揭示了安全性与实用性之间的内在矛盾。为了进一步探索监测工具可靠性的极限，我们构建了一个包含153,581个样本的大规模训练数据集，并对Qwen3-4B-Instruction模型进行了微调，以研究在已知且相对容易构造的不良行为数据集上进行训练是否能够提高监测工具对未知且更隐秘的不良行为的识别能力。我们的研究结果凸显了实现可靠且可扩展的不良行为监测工具的挑战性，并为未来针对基于大语言模型的监测工具进行任务感知的设计和训练策略的研究提供了启示。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Adaptive and Representative Multi-Interest Modeling for Recommendation with Large Language Model
papers.title_zh: 基于大型语言模型的自适应且具有代表性的多兴趣建模技术，用于推荐系统
papers.authors: Ziyan Wang, Yingpeng Du, Tianjun Wei, Haoyan Chua, Jieyi Bi, Jie Zhang, Zhu Sun
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show potential for multi-interest analysis of users in recommender systems, going beyond heuristic assumptions in existing methods, e.g., co-occurring items indicate the same interest. Despite the effectiveness, two key challenges remain. First, the granularity of raw generation of LLMs for multi-interests is agnostic, possibly leading to overly fine or coarse interest grouping. Second, adopting LLM to analyze individual user behaviors lacks a global perspective on how items relate across users. In this paper, we propose an LLM-driven adaptive and representative multi-interest modeling framework to address these challenges. At the user-individual level, we exploit LLM analysis and alleviate the agnostic granularity by adaptively aggregating semantic clusters to collaborative multi-interests. At the user-crowd level, to mitigate the limited insights in individual behaviors, we formulate a max covering problem to expand the scope of LLM analysis with compactness and representativeness, disentangling interest representations from global perspectives. Experiments on real-world datasets show that our approach outperforms various baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在推荐系统中具有分析用户多兴趣倾向的潜力，这超越了现有方法中的启发式假设，例如，同时出现的事物可能表明用户具有相同的兴趣。尽管这种方法非常有效，但仍然存在两个主要挑战。首先，大语言模型用于多兴趣分析的原始生成粒度是不确定的，这可能导致兴趣分组过于细致或粗糙。其次，使用大语言模型来分析个体用户行为时，缺乏对物品在不同用户之间关系的全局视角。在本文中，我们提出了一种由大语言模型驱动的自适应且具有代表性的多兴趣建模框架，以解决这些挑战。在个体用户层面，我们利用大语言模型的分析能力，通过自适应地聚合语义簇来形成协作性的多兴趣分类，从而消除不确定性的粒度问题。在用户群体层面，为了弥补个体行为分析中的局限性，我们提出了一个最大覆盖问题，以扩大大语言模型分析的范围，同时保持紧凑性和代表性，从而从全局角度分离出兴趣特征。在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法优于各种基线算法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MathMixup: Boosting LLM Mathematical Reasoning with Difficulty-Controllable Data Synthesis and Curriculum Learning
papers.title_zh: MathMixup：通过可控制难度的数据生成与课程学习来提升大语言模型的数学推理能力
papers.authors: Xuchen Li, Jing Chen, Xuzhao Li, Hao Liang, Xiaohuan Zhou, Taifeng Wang, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: In mathematical reasoning tasks, the advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) relies heavily on high-quality training data with clearly defined and well-graded difficulty levels. However, existing data synthesis methods often suffer from limited diversity and lack precise control over problem difficulty, making them insufficient for supporting efficient training paradigms such as curriculum learning. To address these challenges, we propose MathMixup, a novel data synthesis paradigm that systematically generates high-quality, difficulty-controllable mathematical reasoning problems through hybrid and decomposed strategies. Automated self-checking and manual screening are incorporated to ensure semantic clarity and a well-structured difficulty gradient in the synthesized data. Building on this, we construct the MathMixupQA dataset and design a curriculum learning strategy that leverages these graded problems, supporting flexible integration with other datasets. Experimental results show that MathMixup and its curriculum learning strategy significantly enhance the mathematical reasoning performance of LLMs. Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B achieves an average score of 52.6% across seven mathematical benchmarks, surpassing previous state-of-the-art methods. These results fully validate the effectiveness and broad applicability of MathMixup in improving the mathematical reasoning abilities of LLMs and advancing data-centric curriculum learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 在数学推理任务中，大语言模型的发展在很大程度上依赖于具有明确且分级的难度的高质量训练数据。然而，现有的数据合成方法往往存在多样性不足的问题，并且对问题难度的控制不够精确，这使得它们无法有效支持诸如课程学习这样的高效训练范式。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MathMixup这一新颖的数据合成方法。该方法通过混合和分解策略，系统地生成了高质量、难度可控的数学推理问题。同时，我们采用了自动自我检查和人工筛选的方式，以确保合成数据的语义清晰性和结构良好的难度梯度。在此基础上，我们构建了MathMixupQA数据集，并设计了一种利用这些分级问题的课程学习策略，从而能够灵活地与其他数据集进行整合。实验结果表明，MathMixup及其课程学习策略显著提升了大语言模型的数学推理能力。经过微调的Qwen2.5-7B模型在七个数学基准测试中的平均得分达到了52.6%，远远超过了以往最先进的方法。这些结果充分证明了MathMixup在提升大语言模型数学推理能力以及推动以数据为中心的课程学习方面的有效性和广泛性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Model Agreed, But Didn’t Learn: Diagnosing Surface Compliance in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 模型虽然达成了共识，但并未真正发挥作用：如何诊断大型语言模型表面的合规性问题
papers.authors: Xiaojie Gu, Ziying Huang, Weicong Hong, Jian Xie, Renze Lou, Kai Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) internalize vast world knowledge as parametric memory, yet inevitably inherit the staleness and errors of their source corpora. Consequently, ensuring the reliability and malleability of these internal representations is imperative for trustworthy real-world deployment. Knowledge editing offers a pivotal paradigm for surgically modifying memory without retraining. However, while recent editors demonstrate high success rates on standard benchmarks, it remains questionable whether current evaluation frameworks that rely on assessing output under specific prompting conditions can reliably authenticate genuine memory modification. In this work, we introduce a rigorous diagnostic framework that subjects models to discriminative self-assessment under diverse contextual pressures, specifically designed to scrutinize the subtle behavioral nuances induced by memory modifications. This probing reveals a pervasive phenomenon of Surface Compliance, where editors achieve high benchmark scores by merely mimicking target outputs without structurally overwriting internal beliefs. Moreover, we find that recursive modifications accumulate representational residues, triggering cognitive instability and permanently diminishing the reversibility of the model’s memory state. These insights underscore the risks of current editing paradigms and highlight the pivotal role of robust memory modification in building trustworthy, long-term sustainable LLM systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）将庞大的世界知识内化为参数化记忆，但不可避免地会继承源语料库中的陈旧性和错误。因此，确保这些内部表示的可靠性和可塑性对于实现可靠的现实世界应用至关重要。知识编辑提供了一种关键的方法，可以在不重新训练的情况下对记忆进行精细修改。然而，尽管最近的编辑工具在标准基准测试上取得了较高的成功率，但那些依赖于在特定提示条件下评估输出的现有评估框架是否能够可靠地验证真正的记忆修改效果，仍然是一个值得质疑的问题。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个严格的诊断框架，让模型在不同的上下文压力下进行自我评估，以便能够仔细检查由记忆修改引起的细微行为变化。这一分析揭示了“表面合规”现象的存在，即编辑工具仅通过模仿目标输出来获得高分，而并没有真正覆盖内部的信念。此外，我们发现递归修改会积累表示残留物，从而引发认知不稳定，并永久性地降低模型记忆状态的可逆性。这些发现强调了当前编辑方法的潜在风险，并凸显了稳健的记忆修改在构建可信、长期可持续的LLM系统中的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AWARE: Agentic Knowledge Warehousing for Contextual Intelligence
papers.title_zh: AWARE：用于情境智能的主动知识存储系统
papers.authors: Hongjin Qian, Siqi Bao, Zhao Cao, Zheng Liu
papers.abstract: Information seeking bridges the knowledge gap between a query and its answer. Although LLMs perform well broadly, their ability to close this gap is limited by pretraining and degrades on specialized or up-to-date queries. A common remedy augments LLMs with external knowledge, either by injecting retrieved evidence into context or interleaving retrieval with reasoning. The former limits exploration of layered dependencies, while the latter is bounded by context length, constraining efficiency and scalability. For complex tasks with intricate dependencies and large text volumes, both approaches become inadequate.To tackle this bottleneck, we present AWARE (Agentic Knowledge Warehouse), an agentic knowledge warehousing framework that transforms heterogeneous, unstructured data into minimal, task-conditioned knowledge representations consumable by LLMs. Rather than exposing raw text, AWARE constructs knowledge through intent planning, online multi-threaded exploration, and map-reduce evidence integration, producing compact, LLM-ready context under finite budgets. Specifically, it applies offline document structuring to generate document headers that support controlled access, performs exploration with targeted refinement to recover layered information dependencies, and integrates distributed evidence into task-aware representations for downstream answer generation. Experiments on GAIA, WebWalker, and BrowseComp-Plus show improvements over all baselines
papers.abstract_zh: 信息检索能够填补查询与答案之间的知识空白。虽然大语言模型在一般情况下表现良好，但它们弥补这一空白的能力受到预训练的限制，并且在处理特定或最新的查询时性能会下降。一种常见的解决方案是向大语言模型添加外部知识，要么通过将检索到的证据注入上下文中进行处理，要么将检索结果与推理相结合。前者限制了层次性依赖关系的探索，而后者则受到上下文长度的限制，从而影响了效率和可扩展性。对于具有复杂依赖关系且文本量较大的复杂任务来说，这两种方法都显得不够理想。为了克服这一瓶颈，我们提出了AWARE（智能知识仓库）框架。该框架能够将异构、非结构化数据转化为可由大语言模型处理的简洁、任务相关的知识表示形式。与直接呈现原始文本不同，AWARE通过意图规划、在线多线程探索以及MapReduce式证据整合等方式来构建知识，从而在有限的预算下生成紧凑的、适合大语言模型的上下文信息。具体来说，它采用离线文档结构化处理来生成支持可控访问的文档标题，通过有针对性的细化操作来恢复层次化的信息依赖关系，并将分布式证据整合到任务感知的表示中，以便后续生成答案。在GAIA、WebWalker和BrowseComp-Plus上的实验表明，AWARE相比所有基线方法取得了更好的效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Alignment Tuning for Large Language Models: A Data-Centric Lens on Alignment Data Pipelines
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型的对齐调整：以数据为中心的视角看待对齐数据处理流程
papers.authors: Hwanjun Song
papers.abstract: Much of the alignment tuning literature is organized around optimization objectives, while the construction of alignment data is often treated implicitly. In this survey, we adopt a data centric perspective and reframe alignment tuning as a pipeline design problem. We decompose alignment data construction into three interacting stages, response synthesis, preference evaluation, and preference instantiation, and use this framework to organize existing alignment methods into a unified taxonomy. Through this lens, we identify recurring design trade-offs and failure modes observed across prior alignment methods, and distill a set of high level principles that clarify how pipeline design choices influence the resulting optimization signal. Finally, we outline open challenges for alignment data pipelines, including prompt-level alignment, agentic settings, and alignment under evolving objectives.
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数关于对齐调优的文献都是围绕优化目标来组织的，而对齐数据的构建则往往被忽视。在这项调查中，我们采取了以数据为中心的观点，将对齐调优重新定义为一个流程设计问题。我们将对齐数据的构建分解为三个相互关联的阶段：响应合成、偏好评估以及偏好实例化。利用这一框架，我们将现有的对齐方法整理成一个统一的分类体系。通过这种视角，我们发现了先前对齐方法中常见的设计权衡和失败模式，并总结了一套高级原则，这些原则阐明了流程设计选择如何影响最终的优化结果。最后，我们指出了对齐数据流程中存在的挑战，包括提示级对齐、代理设置问题，以及在不同目标下进行的对齐工作。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Purging the Gray Zone: Latent-Geometric Denoising for Precise Knowledge Boundary Awareness
papers.title_zh: 清除灰色地带：用于精确识别知识边界的潜势几何去噪技术
papers.authors: Hao An, Yibin Lou, Jiayi Guo, Yang Xu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit hallucinations due to their inability to accurately perceive their own knowledge boundaries. Existing abstention fine-tuning methods typically partition datasets directly based on response accuracy, causing models to suffer from severe label noise near the decision boundaries and consequently exhibit high rates of abstentions or hallucinations. This paper adopts a latent space representation perspective, revealing a “gray zone” near the decision hyperplane where internal belief ambiguity constitutes the core performance bottleneck. Based on this insight, we propose the GeoDe (Geometric Denoising) framework for abstention fine-tuning. This method constructs a truth hyperplane using linear probes and performs “geometric denoising” by employing geometric distance as a confidence signal for abstention decisions. This approach filters out ambiguous boundary samples while retaining high-fidelity signals for fine-tuning. Experiments across multiple models (Llama3, Qwen3) and benchmark datasets (TriviaQA, NQ, SciQ, SimpleQA) demonstrate that GeoDe significantly enhances model truthfulness and demonstrates strong generalization in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/Notbesidemoon/GeoDe.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常常因为无法准确感知自身的知识边界而出现幻觉现象。现有的 abstention 微调方法通常直接根据响应准确性来划分数据集，这会导致模型在决策边界附近出现严重的标签噪声，从而导致较高的 abstention 率或幻觉现象。本文采用了潜在空间表示的方法，发现决策超平面附近存在一个“灰色区域”，内部的信念模糊性正是性能瓶颈的核心所在。基于这一洞察，我们提出了 GeoDe 框架来进行 abstention 微调。该方法通过线性探针构建真实超平面，并利用几何距离作为 abstention 决策的置信信号进行“几何去噪”。这种方法能够过滤掉模糊的边界样本，同时保留高保真度的信号用于微调。在多个模型（如 Llama3、Qwen3）和基准数据集（如 TriviaQA、NQ、SciQ、SimpleQA）上的实验表明，GeoDe 显著提升了模型的真实性，并在非分布范围内表现出强大的泛化能力。代码可访问于 https://github.com/Notbesidemoon/GeoDe。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Temporal Token Matters: Investigating and Interpreting the Consistency of Temporal Ordering in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 时间顺序的重要性：探究和解释大型语言模型中时间排序的一致性
papers.authors: Zhen Yang, Xinyue Zhang, Ping Jian, Chengzhi Li, Zhongbin Guo, Jiaping Feng, Wenpeng Lu
papers.abstract: Despite the remarkable performance across numerous tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) still exhibit notable deficiencies in temporal reasoning, even in simple event ordering tasks. For instance, a slight alteration in the temporal phrasing of the question (e.g., changing "Is event A before B?” to “Is event A after B?”) can lead LLMs to hallucinate and produce inconsistent answers, reflecting a lack of robust temporal reasoning. Although many prior studies have focused on benchmarking and improving the temporal reasoning ability of LLMs, little is known about the intrinsic mechanisms within LLMs when performing temporal reasoning. In this work, we investigate the mechanistic interpretability of temporal ordering within event temporal reasoning through a structured "Identify-Interpret-Verify” pipeline. We first employ path patching to identify a sparse subset of attention heads that are causally responsible for reasoning outcomes. Detailed pattern analysis reveals that these key heads specialize in attending to either temporal keywords (semantic cues) or structural delimiters (syntactic cues). Furthermore, we rigorously validate the observed mechanism through comprehensive intervention-based experiments, ranging from head ablation to targeted attention modulation. We demonstrate that dynamically modulating the attention of these specific heads can robustly enhance model performance, which serves as strong empirical evidence that our identified mechanism faithfully captures the internal logic of temporal ordering in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在众多任务中表现出色，但在时间推理方面仍然存在明显缺陷，即使是在简单的事件排序任务中也是如此。例如，对问题的时间表述进行轻微调整（比如将“事件A是否在B之前？”改为“事件A是否在B之后？”），可能会导致大语言模型产生错误的判断，给出不一致的答案，这反映出它们在时间推理方面的能力不足。虽然许多先前的研究都致力于评估和提高大语言模型的时间推理能力，但关于它们在执行时间推理时内部的运作机制，我们知之甚少。在这项研究中，我们通过一个结构化的“识别-解释-验证”流程，来探究事件时间推理中时间排序的机制性可解释性。我们首先使用路径拼接技术，识别出那些对推理结果负有因果责任的注意力头单元。详细的分析表明，这些关键注意力头单元分别专注于处理时间关键词或结构分隔符。此外，我们通过一系列基于干预的实验来验证这一机制，包括针对特定注意力头的消融实验以及有针对性的注意力调节。我们发现，动态调节这些特定注意力头的注意力水平，能够有效提升模型的性能。这一结果有力地证明了我们所发现的机制能够准确反映大语言模型在时间排序方面的内部逻辑。

papers.title: Towards LLM Agents for Earth Observation
papers.title_zh: 面向地球观测任务的大型语言模型代理
papers.authors: Chia Hsiang Kao, Wenting Zhao, Cheryl Lam, Aarush Umap, Shreelekha Revankar, Samuel Speas, Snehal Bhagat, Rajeev Datta, Cheng Perng Phoo, Utkarsh Mall, Carl Vondrick, Kavita Bala, Bharath Hariharan
papers.abstract: Earth Observation (EO) provides critical planetary data for environmental monitoring, disaster management, climate science, and other scientific domains. In this work we ask: Are AI systems ready for reliable Earth Observation? To answer this, we introduce UnivEARTH, a coding benchmark of 408 yes/no questions from NASA Earth Observatory articles across 7 various topics and over 15 satellite instruments and sources. Using Google Earth Engine API as a tool in a zero-shot setup, LLM agents achieve an accuracy of 40.0% where the code fails to run over 44% of the time. To better understand LLM agent behavior, we also analyze the impact of using the JavaScript API versus Python and the effect of providing documentation. Furthermore, we find that using a reflexion framework significantly reduces errors: Claude-4.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and GPT-5 accuracies rise to around 60%. However, these results remain only marginally above random chance. Taken together, our findings identify significant challenges to be solved before AI agents can automate earth observation, and suggest paths forward.
papers.abstract_zh: 地球观测为环境监测、灾害管理、气候科学以及其他科学领域提供了重要的数据支持。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个问题：人工智能系统是否具备处理可靠地球观测数据的能力？为了回答这个问题，我们开发了UnivEARTH这一编码基准测试，其中包含408个关于NASA地球观测机构发布的文章中的是非问题，涉及7个不同的主题以及超过15种卫星仪器和数据源。通过使用Google Earth Engine API作为工具，在零样本条件下，大语言模型代理的准确率达到了40.0%，而代码运行失败的比例则超过了44%。为了更好地理解大语言模型代理的行为，我们还分析了使用JavaScript API与Python API的差异，以及提供文档对模型性能的影响。此外，我们发现使用反射框架可以显著减少错误：Claude-4.5-Sonnet、Gemini-2.5-Pro和GPT-5的准确率分别达到了约60%。不过，这些结果仍然仅略高于随机水平。综合来看，我们的研究发现指出了在人工智能代理能够自动化地球观测之前需要解决的重大挑战，并提出了一些解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Jamendo-MT-QA: A Benchmark for Multi-Track Comparative Music Question Answering
papers.title_zh: Jamendo-MT-QA：多轨道对比式音乐问答的基准模型
papers.authors: Junyoung Koh, Jaeyun Lee, Soo Yong Kim, Gyu Hyeong Choi, Jung In Koh, Jordan Phillips, Yeonjin Lee, Min Song
papers.abstract: Recent work on music question answering (Music-QA) has primarily focused on single-track understanding, where models answer questions about an individual audio clip using its tags, captions, or metadata. However, listeners often describe music in comparative terms, and existing benchmarks do not systematically evaluate reasoning across multiple tracks. Building on the Jamendo-QA dataset, we introduce Jamendo-MT-QA, a dataset and benchmark for multi-track comparative question answering. From Creative Commons-licensed tracks on Jamendo, we construct 36,519 comparative QA items over 12,173 track pairs, with each pair yielding three question types: yes/no, short-answer, and sentence-level questions. We describe an LLM-assisted pipeline for generating and filtering comparative questions, and benchmark representative audio-language models using both automatic metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期关于音乐问答领域的研究主要集中在单轨理解方面，即模型通过音频片段的标签、字幕或元数据来回答相关问题。然而，听众通常会用比较性的方式来描述音乐，而现有的评估基准并未系统地考察多轨之间的推理能力。基于Jamendo-QA数据集，我们提出了Jamendo-MT-QA，这是一个用于多轨比较性问答的数据集和评估基准。我们从Jamendo上获取了经过Creative Commons许可的音频片段，共构建了36,519个比较性问答项目，涉及12,173对音频片段对。每对音频片段对应三种类型的提问：是/否型问题、简短回答型问题和句子级问题。我们提出了一种由大语言模型辅助生成和筛选比较性问题的流程，并使用自动指标和“大语言模型作为裁判”的方式进行了对代表性音频-语言模型的评估。

papers.title: Chinese Live-Streaming E-Commerce Morph Resolution: Datasets and Methods
papers.title_zh: 中国直播电商的变革之路：数据集与方法论
papers.authors: Jipeng Qiang, Jiahao Zhu, Yi Zhu, Chaowei Zhang
papers.abstract: Live-stream E-commerce faces significant challenges from morphs, deliberate linguistic variants used to evade real-time voice filters and amplify product claims illegally. While critical for regulatory enforcement, Live Auditory Morph Resolution (LiveAMR) research is hindered by limited datasets: prior work relied on narrow, redundant health domain corpora, restricting model robustness. To bridge this gap, we introduce two datasets: (1) HealthAMR, a refined health-domain corpus via deduplication and re-annotation. (2) GeneralAMR, a general domain benchmark with 28K annotated sentences from 77 channels across 7 E-commerce categories. Further, we propose JointMRE, a multi-task framework that jointly resolves morphs and generates structured explanations, transferring grammatical insights from large language models to enhance generalization. Predictions are refined by our Conflict-aware Dual-output Refinement Framework (CDRF), which detects inconsistencies between corrections and explanations. Experiments show CDRF significantly improves morph resolution accuracy and interpretability. Our datasets and code are available [https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Morph-Resolution-Datasets-and-Methods-611E].
papers.abstract_zh: 直播电商面临着诸多挑战，比如语音中的形态变化、为规避实时语音过滤而使用的刻意语言变体，以及非法放大产品宣传内容的行为。虽然语音形态识别技术对于监管执法至关重要，但相关研究由于数据集有限而受到限制：以往的研究主要依赖狭窄且重复性的健康领域语料库，这限制了模型的鲁棒性。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了两个新的数据集：(1) HealthAMR，这是一个经过去重和重新注释的优化健康领域语料库。(2) GeneralAMR，这是一个通用领域的基准数据集，包含来自7个电商类别的77个渠道的28,000条带注释的句子。此外，我们还提出了JointMRE这一多任务框架，它能够同时处理语音形态变化问题并生成结构化的解释，将大语言模型的语法洞察应用到实践中以提高模型的泛化能力。我们的预测结果通过冲突感知双输出精炼框架进行优化，该框架能够检测修正与解释之间的不一致性。实验表明，CDRF框架显著提升了形态识别的准确性和可解释性。我们的数据集和代码可在此处获取：[https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Morph-Resolution-Datasets-and-Methods-611E]

papers.title: MemoBrain: Executive Memory as an Agentic Brain for Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MemoBrain：作为推理中枢的执行性记忆系统
papers.authors: Hongjin Qian, Zhao Cao, Zheng Liu
papers.abstract: Complex reasoning in tool-augmented agent frameworks is inherently long-horizon, causing reasoning traces and transient tool artifacts to accumulate and strain the bounded working context of large language models. Without explicit memory mechanisms, such accumulation disrupts logical continuity and undermines task alignment. This positions memory not as an auxiliary efficiency concern, but as a core component for sustaining coherent, goal-directed reasoning over long horizons.We propose MemoBrain, an executive memory model for tool-augmented agents that constructs a dependency-aware memory over reasoning steps, capturing salient intermediate states and their logical relations. Operating as a co-pilot alongside the reasoning agent, MemoBrain organizes reasoning progress without blocking execution and actively manages the working context. Specifically, it prunes invalid steps, folds completed sub-trajectories, and preserves a compact, high-salience reasoning backbone under a fixed context budget. Together, these mechanisms enable explicit cognitive control over reasoning trajectories rather than passive context accumulation.We evaluate MemoBrain on challenging long-horizon benchmarks, including GAIA, WebWalker, and BrowseComp-Plus, demonstrating consistent improvements over strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 在工具辅助的智能体框架中，复杂的推理过程本质上需要长期视角，这会导致推理痕迹和短暂的工具产物不断积累，从而给大语言模型有限的工作环境带来压力。如果没有明确的记忆机制，这种积累会破坏逻辑的连贯性，并削弱任务的一致性。因此，记忆不应被视为一种辅助性的效率问题，而应被视为维持长期、连贯且目标导向的推理的核心要素。我们提出了MemoBrain这一用于工具辅助智能体的执行记忆模型。该模型能够构建一种基于依赖关系的记忆结构，捕捉重要的中间状态及其逻辑关系。作为推理智能体的辅助系统，MemoBrain能够有序地组织推理过程，同时避免阻塞执行流程，并主动管理工作环境。具体来说，它会对无效的推理步骤进行剪除，合并已完成的子路径，并在固定的上下文预算下，保留一个简洁且高感知度的推理框架。通过这些机制，我们可以实现对推理轨迹的明确控制，而不是被动地积累上下文信息。我们在包括GAIA、WebWalker和BrowseComp-Plus等具有挑战性的长期视角基准测试中评估了MemoBrain的性能，结果显示其在与强大基线相比时取得了持续的改进。

papers.title: Exploring the Capability Boundaries of LLMs in Mastering of Chinese Chouxiang Language
papers.title_zh: 探索大语言模型在掌握中文这一语言领域中的能力边界
papers.authors: Dianqing Lin, Tian Lan, Jiali Zhu, Jiang Li, Wei Chen, Xu Liu, Aruukhan, Xiangdong Su, Hongxu Hou, Guanglai Gao
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in general language tasks, their performance on Chouxiang Language, a representative subcultural language in the Chinese internet context, remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce Mouse, a specialized benchmark designed to evaluate the capabilities of LLMs on NLP tasks involving Chouxiang Language across six tasks. Experimental results show that, current state-ofthe-art (SOTA) LLMs exhibit clear limitations on multiple tasks, while performing well on tasks that involve contextual semantic understanding. In addition, we further discuss the reasons behind the generally low performance of SOTA LLMs on Chouxiang Language, examine whether the LLM-as-a-judge approach adopted for translation tasks aligns with human judgments and values, and analyze the key factors that influence Chouxiang translation. Our study aims to promote further research in the NLP community on multicultural integration and the dynamics of evolving internet languages. Our code and data are publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在通用语言任务上取得了显著的成功，但它们在中文互联网语境中一种代表性的亚文化语言——潮汕话上的表现却仍未被充分研究。在本文中，我们介绍了Mouse这一专门的评估基准，旨在评估大语言模型在涉及潮汕话的六项自然语言处理任务上的能力。实验结果表明，当前最先进的语言模型在多项任务上存在明显局限性，但在涉及上下文语义理解的任务上表现良好。此外，我们还探讨了导致最先进语言模型在潮汕话上表现不佳的原因，分析了用于翻译任务的“模型作为裁判”方法是否与人类的判断和价值观相符，并研究了影响潮汕话翻译的关键因素。我们的研究旨在推动自然语言处理领域对多元文化融合以及互联网语言演变动态方面的进一步研究。我们的代码和数据均可公开获取。

papers.title: RECOR: Reasoning-focused Multi-turn Conversational Retrieval Benchmark
papers.title_zh: RECOR：以推理为核心的多轮对话检索基准测试
papers.authors: Mohammed Ali, Abdelrahman Abdallah, Amit Agarwal, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Adam Jatowt
papers.abstract: Existing benchmarks treat multi-turn conversation and reasoning-intensive retrieval separately, yet real-world information seeking requires both. To bridge this gap, we present a benchmark for reasoning-based conversational information retrieval comprising 707 conversations (2,971 turns) across eleven domains. To ensure quality, our Decomposition-and-Verification framework transforms complex queries into fact-grounded multi-turn dialogues through multi-level validation, where atomic facts are verified against sources and explicit retrieval reasoning is generated for each turn. Comprehensive evaluation reveals that combining conversation history with reasoning doubles retrieval performance (Baseline .236 \rightarrow History+Reasoning .479 nDCG@10), while reasoning-specialized models substantially outperform dense encoders. Despite these gains, further analysis highlights that implicit reasoning remains challenging, particularly when logical connections are not explicitly stated in the text. [https://github.com/RECOR-Benchmark/RECOR]
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的评估基准通常将多轮对话和需要推理的检索任务分开处理，但实际上，现实世界的信息检索需求同时涉及这两方面。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个基于推理的对话式信息检索基准测试，该测试包含11个领域内的707段对话（共2971轮对话）。为了确保评估的准确性，我们的“分解与验证”框架通过将复杂的查询转化为基于事实的多轮对话来进行处理。在多层次验证过程中，原子性事实会经过来源验证，同时每轮对话还会生成相应的检索推理过程。综合评估结果显示，将对话历史与推理相结合可以显著提高检索性能（从基线水平的0.236提升到结合历史信息与推理后的0.479 nDCG@10），而专注于推理的模型则明显优于基于密集编码器的模型。尽管取得了这些进步，但进一步分析表明，隐性推理仍然是一个挑战，尤其是在文本中没有明确表述逻辑联系的情况下。[https://github.com/RECOR-Benchmark/RECOR]

papers.title: Data Selection for Multi-turn Dialogue Instruction Tuning
papers.title_zh: 多轮对话指导调整中的数据选择
papers.authors: Bo Li, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
papers.abstract: Instruction-tuned language models increasingly rely on large multi-turn dialogue corpora, but these datasets are often noisy and structurally inconsistent, with topic drift, repetitive chitchat, and mismatched answer formats across turns. We address this from a data selection perspective and propose MDS (Multi-turn Dialogue Selection), a dialogue-level framework that scores whole conversations rather than isolated turns. MDS combines a global coverage stage that performs bin-wise selection in the user-query trajectory space to retain representative yet non-redundant dialogues, with a local structural stage that evaluates within-dialogue reliability through entity-grounded topic grounding and information progress, together with query-answer form consistency for functional alignment. MDS outperforms strong single-turn selectors, dialogue-level LLM scorers, and heuristic baselines on three multi-turn benchmarks and an in-domain Banking test set, achieving the best overall rank across reference-free and reference-based metrics, and is more robust on long conversations under the same training budget. Code and resources are included in the supplementary materials.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于指令调优的语言模型越来越依赖大型多轮对话数据集，但这些数据集往往存在噪声问题，且结构不统一，会出现话题漂移、重复性的闲聊现象，以及不同轮次之间的回答格式不匹配等问题。我们从数据选择的角度来解决这个问题，提出了MDS（多轮对话选择）这一对话级框架。该框架对整段对话进行评分，而不是仅针对单个轮次进行评分。MDS结合了全局覆盖阶段和局部结构评估阶段：全局覆盖阶段在用户查询轨迹空间内进行分组选择，以保留具有代表性的、不过于冗余的对话内容；局部结构评估阶段则通过实体导向的话题定位、信息进展以及查询-回答形式的一致性来评估对话内部的可靠性，从而实现功能上的对齐。在三个多轮基准测试以及一个针对银行领域的测试集上，MDS的表现优于那些采用单轮选择方法、基于对话级大语言模型评分的方法以及启发式算法。无论是在无参考还是有参考的情况下，MDS都取得了最佳排名。而且，在相同训练预算下，MDS在处理长对话时表现得更为稳健。相关代码和资源已包含在补充材料中。

papers.title: AgentGC: Evolutionary Learning-based Lossless Compression for Genomics Data with LLM-driven Multiple Agent
papers.title_zh: AgentGC：基于进化学习的基因组数据无损压缩技术，采用LLM驱动的多智能体协作机制
papers.authors: Sun Hui, Ding Yanfeng, Huidong Ma, Chang Xu, Keyan Jin, Lizheng Zu, Cheng Zhong, Xiaoguang Liu, Gang Wang, Wentong Cai
papers.abstract: Lossless compression has made significant advancements in Genomics Data (GD) storage, sharing and management. Current learning-based methods are non-evolvable with problems of low-level compression modeling, limited adaptability, and user-unfriendly interface. To this end, we propose AgentGC, the first evolutionary Agent-based GD Compressor, consisting of 3 layers with multi-agent named Leader and Worker. Specifically, the 1) User layer provides a user-friendly interface via Leader combined with LLM; 2) Cognitive layer, driven by the Leader, integrates LLM to consider joint optimization of algorithm-dataset-system, addressing the issues of low-level modeling and limited adaptability; and 3) Compression layer, headed by Worker, performs compression decompression via a automated multi-knowledge learning-based compression framework. On top of AgentGC, we design 3 modes to support diverse scenarios: CP for compression-ratio priority, TP for throughput priority, and BM for balanced mode. Compared with 14 baselines on 9 datasets, the average compression ratios gains are 16.66%, 16.11%, and 16.33%, the throughput gains are 4.73x, 9.23x, and 9.15x, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 无损压缩在基因组数据存储、共享和管理方面取得了显著进展。目前基于学习的方法存在无法进化的问题，包括低层次压缩建模、适应性有限以及用户界面不友好等缺陷。为此，我们提出了AgentGC——首个基于进化的基因组数据压缩器。该工具由三层结构组成，其中“领导者”和“工作者”是核心多智能体节点。具体来说：1）用户层通过“领导者”与大语言模型相结合，提供友好的用户界面；2）认知层由“领导者”驱动，利用大语言模型进行算法-数据集-系统之间的联合优化，从而解决低层次建模和适应性有限的问题；3）压缩层由“工作者”负责，通过自动化的多知识学习压缩框架来实现数据的压缩与解压。除了AgentGC之外，我们还设计了三种模式以支持不同的应用场景：CP模式注重压缩率优先，TP模式注重吞吐量优先，而BM模式则实现平衡模式。与9个数据集上的14种基准方法相比，我们的平均压缩率分别提高了16.66%、16.11%和16.33%，而吞吐量则分别提高了4.73倍、9.23倍和9.15倍。

papers.title: Think Outside the Policy: In-Context Steered Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: 跳出政策的局限：基于具体情境的政策优化
papers.authors: Hsiu-Yuan Huang, Chenming Tang, Weijie Liu, Clive Bai, Saiyong Yang, Yunfang Wu
papers.abstract: Existing Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), have achieved remarkable progress in improving the reasoning capabilities of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). However, they exhibit limited exploration due to reliance on on-policy rollouts which are confined to the current policy’s distribution, resulting in narrow trajectory diversity. Recent approaches attempt to expand policy coverage by incorporating trajectories generated from stronger expert models, yet this reliance increases computational cost and such advanced models are often inaccessible. To address these issues, we propose In-Context Steered Policy Optimization (ICPO), a unified framework that leverages the inherent in-context learning capability of LRMs to provide expert guidance using existing datasets. ICPO introduces mixed-policy GRPO with implicit expert forcing, which expands exploration beyond the current policy distribution without requiring advanced LRM trajectories. To further stabilize optimization, ICPO integrates expert region reject sampling to filter unreliable off-policy trajectories and annealed expert-bonus reward shaping to balance early expert guidance with later autonomous improvement. Results demonstrate that ICPO consistently enhances RLVR performance and training stability on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, revealing a scalable and effective RLVR paradigm for LRMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Celine-hxy/ICPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的基于可验证奖励的强化学习方法，如群体相对策略优化算法，在提升大型推理模型的推理能力方面取得了显著进展。然而，这些方法由于依赖当前策略下的展开策略，导致探索范围有限，从而影响了轨迹多样性的拓展。近期的一些方法试图通过结合来自更强大专家模型的轨迹来扩大策略覆盖范围，但这种做法会增加计算成本，而且这类高级模型往往难以获取。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了上下文引导策略优化算法——这是一种统一的框架，它利用大型推理模型固有的上下文学习能力，通过现有数据集提供专家指导。ICP0采用了混合策略的群体相对策略优化算法，并加入了隐式专家强制机制，从而在不需要高级推理模型轨迹的情况下，扩展探索范围。为了进一步稳定优化过程，ICP0还引入了专家区域拒绝采样技术，以过滤掉不可靠的离策略轨迹；同时，通过退火式专家奖励 shaping 技术，实现了早期专家指导与后期自主改进的平衡。实验结果表明，ICP0能够持续提升基于可验证奖励的强化学习的性能以及训练稳定性，在数学推理基准测试中表现出良好的效果。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/Celine-hxy/ICPO 下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Where CoT Reasoning Commits: Entropy Traces Identify Interpretable Attention Heads
papers.title_zh: CoT推理的局限性：熵迹识别可解释的注意力焦点
papers.authors: Tianhe Zhang, Yonghong Deng, Ping Jian, Zhen Yang, Boyang Wang, Xinyue Zhang
papers.abstract: While LLMs demonstrate impressive reasoning capabilities, their internal decision dynamics remain opaque. To render these process interpretable and intervenable, we propose Dynamic Entropy Tracing, a mechanism-aware framework that interprets the evolving “choice state” of attention heads during CoT generation through stepwise head-wise option-logit and entropy tracing. Our analysis reveals distinct functional behaviors at attention heads: Steadfast Heads, characterized by consistently low entropy and producing a sharp, option-selective logit pattern with a stable top choice, and Wavering Heads, characterized by consistently high entropy and producing flat or oscillatory option logits without a persistent winner. Leveraging these traces, we identify a set of intervention targets and perform Selective Head Fine-Tuning, updating solely these selected heads against a frozen backbone. Experiments across the LLaMA and Qwen families reveal a striking plasticity hierarchy: fine-tuning just 30 Wavering Heads recovers over 98% of the performance achieved by full-parameter tuning, and in some settings modestly exceeds it. In contrast, intervening on Steadfast Heads yields much less gains. Our findings translate process-level mechanistic observables into a principled criterion for selective fine-tuning, offering a fundamental insight: the most effective tuning knobs are not the components that signal the final decision, but those that retain uncertainty, and thus plasticity, during its formation.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型展现了令人印象深刻的推理能力，但其内部决策过程仍然难以捉摸。为了使得这些过程可解释且可干预，我们提出了动态熵追踪机制——一种基于机制的框架，它通过逐步追踪注意力头的“选择状态”，来理解注意力生成过程中的决策过程。我们的分析揭示了不同注意力头的功能特性：稳重头部表现为持续较低的熵值，产生具有稳定首选选项的尖锐选择性逻辑分布；而摇摆头部则表现为持续的较高熵值，产生的逻辑分布要么平坦，要么呈振荡状，且没有明确的胜者。利用这些追踪数据，我们确定了一组干预目标，并对选定的头部进行微调，而其余部分则保持不变。在LLaMA和Qwen系列模型中进行的实验表明，存在显著的可塑性层次结构：仅对30个摇摆头部进行微调，就能恢复高达98%的全参数调优性能，在某些情况下甚至还能取得更好的效果。相比之下，对稳重头部进行干预则能带来的提升要小得多。我们的研究发现将过程层面的机制性特征转化为选择性微调的准则，从而揭示了这样一个基本规律：最有效的调整因素并非那些直接指示最终决策的组件，而是那些在决策形成过程中保持不确定性的组件，也就是具有可塑性的组件。
