papers.title: From Coarse to Fine: Benchmarking and Reward Modeling for Writing-Centric Generation Tasks
papers.title_zh: 从粗糙到精细：针对写作类生成任务的基准测试与奖励模型设计
papers.authors: Qingyu Ren, Tianjun Pan, Xingzhou Chen, Xuhong Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable progress in text generation but still struggle with generative writing tasks. In terms of evaluation, existing evaluation benchmarks include few requirement types and writing reward models are not evaluated. In terms of training, existing studies often enhance writing ability through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Howerver, existing reward model training remains coarse-grained. To address these issues, we introduce W²Bench, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark, and WRL, a fine-grained training framework. W²Bench covers five task categories and seven requirement types, enabling systematic evaluation of both writing and writing reward models by measuring the correlation between reward rankings and golden rankings. WRL constructs positive and negative samples by dropping instruction requirements to construct positive and negative examples, allowing more precise reward model training. Experiments show that our models achieve substantial improvements on various writing benchmarks and exhibit strong generalization. We will release our code and data to support future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在文本生成方面取得了显著进展，但在生成性写作任务上仍然存在困难。在评估方面，现有的评估基准只包含少数需求类型，且写作奖励模型并未得到充分评估。在训练方面，现有研究通常通过带有可验证奖励的强化学习来提升写作能力。不过，现有的奖励模型训练仍然较为粗放。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了W²Bench这一全面的评估基准，以及WRL这一细粒度的训练框架。W²Bench涵盖了五个任务类别和七种需求类型，通过衡量奖励排名与黄金排名之间的相关性，能够系统地评估写作模型和写作奖励模型的表现。WRL通过去除指令要求来构建正面和负面样本，从而实现更精确的奖励模型训练。实验表明，我们的模型在各种写作基准测试中都取得了显著的改进，并展现了强大的泛化能力。我们将公开我们的代码和数据集，以支持未来的研究。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DentalGPT: Incentivizing Multimodal Reasoning in Dentistry
papers.title_zh: DentalGPT：在牙科领域激励多模态推理的应用
papers.authors: Zhenyang Cai, Jiaming Zhang, Junjie Zhao, Ziyi Zeng, Yanchao Li, Liang Jingyi, Junying Chen, Yunjin Yang, Jiajun You, Shuzhi Deng, Xieruiqiii, Yuanting Chen, Xiangyi Feng, Jianquan Li, Liangyi Chen, Junwen Wang, Shan Jiang, Benyou Wang
papers.abstract: Reliable interpretation of multimodal dental data is essential for automated oral healthcare, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show limited understanding of dental images. Although complex reasoning improves performance, its gains in dentistry are substantially smaller than in other medical domains, suggesting that complex reasoning is not yet sufficiently incentivized for dental diagnosis, likely due to insufficient domain knowledge and limited reinforcement learning on dental questions. We present DentalGPT, a dentistry-specialized MLLM trained via staged multimodal alignment and reinforcement learning. By constructing the largest annotated multimodal dental dataset to date with over 120k images, multimodal alignment provides the necessary domain knowledge foundation to support and incentivize complex reasoning, which is further strengthened through reinforcement learning. Experiments on expert-annotated benchmarks and dental subsets of medical VQA benchmarks show that DentalGPT achieves superior performance on disease classification and dental VQA tasks, outperforming many state-of-the-art MLLMs despite its compact 7B parameter scale.
papers.abstract_zh: 对多模态口腔数据的可靠解读对于自动化口腔健康护理至关重要。然而，目前的多模态大语言模型在理解口腔图像方面表现有限。虽然复杂推理可以提高性能，但在牙科领域的提升幅度比其他医学领域要小得多，这表明复杂推理在牙科诊断中尚未得到足够的激励，这可能是由于领域知识不足以及关于口腔问题的强化学习有限所致。我们提出了DentalGPT，这是一个专门针对牙科领域设计的多模态大语言模型，它通过分阶段的多模态对齐和强化学习进行训练。通过构建迄今为止最大的标注多模态口腔数据集，该数据集包含超过12万张图像，多模态对齐为支持复杂推理提供了必要的领域知识基础，而强化学习则进一步强化了这一能力。在专家标注的基准测试以及医学VQA基准测试中的牙科子任务上进行的实验表明，DentalGPT在疾病分类和牙科VQA任务上的表现优于许多最先进的多模态大语言模型，尽管其参数规模仅为7B。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SARA: Unlocking Multilingual Knowledge in Mixture-of-Experts via Semantically Anchored Routing Alignment
papers.title_zh: SARA：通过语义导向的路由对齐技术，实现多语言知识的融合与利用
papers.authors: Tianyu Dong, Yangyang Liu, Jiang Zhou, Xinwei Wu, Xiaohu Zhao, Hao Wang, Heng Liu, Linlong Xu, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Shaolin Zhu, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as an increasingly influential paradigm as they offer a strategic balance between parameter scalability and computational efficiency. However, low-resource language tokens are often routed to different experts than those predominantly activated by high-resource inputs, which limits cross-lingual expert sharing. This cross-lingual routing divergence consequently hinders their efficacy in multilingual contexts. To address this issue, we propose SARA (Semantically Anchored Routing Alignment), a framework designed to transfer specialized capabilities from high-resource languages as anchors to low-resource languages. SARA explicitly aligns the routing distribution of multilingual inputs with high-resource semantic anchors using a symmetric Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence constraint. Unlike traditional distillation methods that operate on output logits, SARA directly aligns the internal routing distributions of MoE layers, encouraging mechanistic consistency in expert selection across languages. We conduct experiments on 2 LLMs across 5 low-resource languages and 3 benchmarks. Experiment results demonstrate that SARA outperforms standard instruction tuning (e.g., +0.8% on Qwen3-30B-A3B and +1.2% on Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct on Global-MMLU benchmark). Further analyses show that SARA effectively addresses performance bottlenecks in low-resource languages, providing a scalable pathway to enhance multilingual capabilities in sparse architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 稀疏混合专家（MiE）架构作为一种具有影响力的范式逐渐崭露头角，因为它在参数可扩展性和计算效率之间实现了巧妙的平衡。然而，资源匮乏的语言往往会被分配到与那些由高资源输入主导的专家不同的专家手中，这限制了跨语言专家的共享。这种跨语言分配的差异严重影响了它们在多语言环境中的效果。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SARA（语义锚定路由对齐）框架，该框架旨在将高资源语言的专门能力作为锚点传递给资源匮乏的语言。SARA通过对称的Jensen-Shannon散度约束，明确地将多语言输入的路由分布与高资源语义锚点进行对齐。与传统基于输出逻辑变量的蒸馏方法不同，SARA直接对MiE层的内部路由分布进行对齐，从而确保在不同语言中专家选择的机制一致性。我们在5种资源匮乏的语言和3个基准测试中对2个大语言模型进行了实验。实验结果表明，SARA的性能优于传统的指令调整方法（例如在Qwen3-30B-A3B上的提升率为+0.8%，在Global-MMLU基准测试中的Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct上的提升率为+1.2%）。进一步分析表明，SARA有效解决了资源匮乏语言中的性能瓶颈问题，为在稀疏架构中实现多语言能力的提升提供了一条可扩展的路径。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Eliciting Medical Reasoning with Knowledge-enhanced Data Synthesis: A Semi-Supervised Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.title_zh: 利用知识增强的数据合成来激发医学推理能力：一种半监督强化学习方法
papers.authors: Haolin Li, Shuyang Jiang, Ruipeng Zhang, Jiangchao Yao, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang
papers.abstract: While large language models hold promise for complex medical applications, their development is hindered by the scarcity of high-quality reasoning data. To address this issue, existing approaches typically distill chain-of-thought reasoning traces from large proprietary models via supervised fine-tuning, then conduct reinforcement learning (RL). These methods exhibit limited improvement on underrepresented domains like rare diseases while incurring substantial costs from generating complex reasoning chains. To efficiently enhance medical reasoning, we propose MedSSR, a Medical Knowledge-enhanced data Synthesis and Semi-supervised Reinforcement learning framework. Our framework first employs rare disease knowledge to synthesize distribution-controllable reasoning questions. We then utilize the policy model itself to generate high-quality pseudo-labels. This enables a two-stage, intrinsic-to-extrinsic training paradigm: self-supervised RL on the pseudo-labeled synthetic data, followed by supervised RL on the human-annotated real data. MedSSR scales model training efficiently without relying on costly trace distillation. Extensive experiments on Qwen and Llama demonstrate that our method outperforms existing methods across ten medical benchmarks, achieving up to +5.93% gain on rare-disease tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/tdlhl/MedSSR.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在复杂的医疗应用中具有巨大潜力，但其发展受到高质量推理数据稀缺的制约。为了解决这个问题，现有的方法通常是通过监督式微调从大型专有模型中提取思维链推理轨迹，然后进行强化学习。这些方法在针对罕见病等代表性不足的领域时表现有限，同时生成复杂推理轨迹的成本非常高。为了有效提升医疗推理能力，我们提出了MedSSR这一基于医学知识增强的数据合成与半监督强化学习框架。我们的框架首先利用罕见病知识来合成可控制的推理问题，然后利用策略模型本身来生成高质量的伪标签。这种两阶段、从内在到外在的训练范式使得训练过程更加高效：先在伪标签的合成数据上进行自监督强化学习，之后再在人类标注的真实数据上进行监督式强化学习。MedSSR能够高效地扩展模型训练规模，而无需依赖昂贵的推理轨迹提取技术。在Qwen和Llama上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在十个医疗基准测试中均优于现有方法，在罕见病任务上实现了高达5.93%的性能提升。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/tdlhl/MedSSR获取。

papers.title: AlphaQT-Bench: Diagnosing the Gap between Financial Code Generation and Quantitative Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: AlphaQT-Bench：诊断金融代码生成与大型语言模型中的定量推理能力之间的差距
papers.authors: Sichun Luo, Yi Huang, Shichang Meng, Fengyuan Liu, Mukai Li, Qinghua Yao, Zefa Hu, Junlan Feng, Qi Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to alpha mining in quantitative finance, marking a shift from generating simple symbolic formulas to producing executable, code-based strategies. While code generation offers greater expressiveness, it introduces critical risks absent in symbolic approaches, including temporal causality violations (look-ahead bias) and stateful logic bugs. Existing benchmarks largely rely on outcome-driven metrics (e.g., backtesting profitability), which often conflate market stochasticity or unintended information leakage with genuine reasoning competence. We introduce ALPHAQT-BENCH, a diagnostic benchmark for instruction-grounded financial code generation under strict semantic and temporal constraints. Unlike general-purpose coding benchmarks, ALPHAQT-BENCH adopts a multi-layer evaluation protocol that assesses: (1) executability, (2) causality safety via a dynamic truncation test, (3) functional accuracy, and (4) structural compliance through vectorization analysis. Experiments across 12 representative LLMs reveal a substantial gap between surface-level success (e.g., executability) and verified quantitative correctness, as many models fail under causal, structural, or functional constraints. By shifting evaluation from profitability to process reliability, ALPHAQT-BENCH provides a principled safety audit for emerging LLM-based quantitative systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在量化金融领域的Alpha挖掘中得到了广泛应用，这标志着从生成简单的符号公式到产生可执行的基于代码的策略的转变。虽然代码生成具有更强的表达能力，但它带来了一些符号方法所没有的关键风险，包括时间因果关系的违反（预测偏差）以及状态逻辑错误。现有的评估基准大多依赖于结果驱动的指标（例如，回测盈利能力），这些指标往往将市场的不确定性或意外的信息泄露与真正的推理能力混为一谈。我们提出了ALPHAQT-BENCH这一诊断基准，用于在严格的语义和时间约束下对基于指令的金融代码生成进行评估。与通用编码基准不同，ALPHAQT-BENCH采用了多层评估方案，涵盖以下方面：(1)可执行性；(2)通过动态截断测试评估因果关系的安全性；(3)功能准确性；以及(4)通过向量化分析评估结构合规性。通过对12种代表性语言模型的实验分析，我们发现表面上的成功（如可执行性）与经过验证的定量正确性之间存在巨大差距，许多模型在因果关系、结构或功能方面都存在缺陷。通过将评估重点从盈利能力转移到过程可靠性上，ALPHAQT-BENCH为新兴的基于语言模型的量化系统提供了一种合理的安全审计方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Fine-tuning with Hierarchical Prompting for Robust Propaganda Classification Across Annotation Schemas
papers.title_zh: 通过分层提示进行微调，以实现在多种注释结构下的稳健 propaganda 分类
papers.authors: Lukas Stähelin, Veronika Solopova, Max Upravitelev, David Kaplan, Premtim Sahitaj, Ariana Sahitaj, Charlott Jakob, Sebastian Möller, Vera Schmitt
papers.abstract: Propaganda detection in social media is challenging due to noisy, short texts and low annotation agreements. We introduce a new intent-focused taxonomy of propaganda techniques and compare it against an established, higher-agreement schema. Along three dimensions (model portfolio, schema effects, and prompting strategy) we evaluate the taxonomies as a classification task with the help of four language models (GPT-4.1-nano, Phi-4 14B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen3-14B). Our results show that fine-tuning is essential, since it transforms weak zero-shot baselines into competitive systems and reveals methodological differences that are hidden using base models. Across schemas, the Qwen models achieve the strongest overall performance, and Phi-4 14B consistently outperforms GPT-4.1-nano. Our hierarchical prompting method (HiPP), which predicts fine-grained techniques before aggregating them, is especially beneficial after fine-tuning and on the more ambiguous, low-agreement taxonomy, while remaining competitive on the simpler schema. The HQP dataset, annotated with the new intent-based labels, provides a richer lens on propaganda’s strategic goals and a challenging benchmark for future work on robust, real-world detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 在社交媒体中检测宣传内容具有挑战性，因为文本通常比较短且标注一致性较低。我们提出了一种新的基于意图的宣传技术分类体系，并将其与一种标注一致性更高的现有分类体系进行了比较。通过三个维度（模型组合、分类体系效果以及提示策略）来评估这两种分类体系的性能，同时借助四种语言模型（GPT-4.1-nano、Phi-4 14B、Qwen2.5-14B、Qwen3-14B）进行辅助分析。研究结果表明，对模型进行微调是非常必要的，因为这能够把表现不佳的零样本基线模型提升为具有竞争力的系统，并揭示出使用基础模型时隐藏的方法论差异。在所有分类体系中，Qwen系列模型的整体表现最为出色，而Phi-4 14B则始终优于GPT-4.1-nano。我们的分层提示方法（HiPP）在微调后表现得尤为有效，尤其是在处理那些模糊且标注一致性较低的分类体系时。该方法能够在聚合技术之前就预测出更细粒度的技术特征，从而在简化分类体系的情况下仍然保持竞争力。HQP数据集采用了新的基于意图的标签进行标注，这为了解宣传活动的战略目标提供了更丰富的视角，同时也为未来在真实世界中的稳健检测工作提供了具有挑战性的基准测试。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ComfyFlow: Benchmarking LLMs for AIGC Workflow Generation
papers.title_zh: ComfyFlow：用于AIGC工作流程生成的大型语言模型性能对比
papers.authors: Zhenran Xu, Yiyu Wang, Yunxin Li, Muyang Ye, Xue Yang, Kai Chen, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promising advancements in tackling human-level tasks, wherein generating workflows for collaborative AI systems remains a critical and challenging step. To explore this frontier, we introduce ComfyFlow, a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate current LLMs’ ability to generate executable and instruction-following AIGC workflows in ComfyUI. The dataset includes 400 diverse visual generation tasks across 20 categories, supported by 10K training examples constructed from knowledge bases, which contain detailed annotations for 2,480 nodes and 3,298 workflows. We establish a systematic evaluation protocol that quantifies performance across multiple dimensions, ranging from basic format validity to multi-level hallucination rates. Our extensive evaluations show that: 1) ComfyFlow presents a substantial challenge even for top-tier proprietary LLMs such as GPT-5.1 and the Claude series; 2) Open-source models achieve new state-of-the-art results after post-training, yet struggle with long-horizon planning as the number of nodes increases; 3) Different post-training strategies offer complementary benefits in following instructions and mitigating hallucinations. By establishing both a challenging benchmark and a principled evaluation scheme, ComfyFlow lays the foundation for developing more intelligent and reliable collaborative AI systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解决人类水平任务方面取得了显著进展，而为协作式人工智能系统生成工作流程仍然是一个关键且具有挑战性的步骤。为了探索这一领域，我们推出了ComfyFlow这一全面的基准测试工具，用于评估当前大语言模型在ComfyUI中生成可执行且符合指令要求的人工智能工作流程的能力。该数据集包含400个多样化的视觉生成任务，涵盖20个类别，并配有10K个训练样本，这些样本来自知识库，其中包含了2,480个节点和3,298条工作流程的详细注释。我们建立了一套系统的评估方案，能够从多个维度量化性能表现，包括基本格式的有效性到多层次的幻觉率等。我们的广泛评估表明：1）即使对于像GPT-5.1和Claude系列这样的顶级专有语言模型来说，ComfyFlow也提出了相当大的挑战；2）开源模型在训练后取得了新的最佳成绩，但在节点数量增加的情况下，它们在长期规划方面存在困难；3）不同的训练后策略在遵循指令和减少幻觉方面提供了互补的优势。通过建立这样一个具有挑战性的基准测试以及一套合理的评估方案，ComfyFlow为开发更智能、更可靠的协作式人工智能系统奠定了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SEA-Guard: Culturally Grounded Multilingual Safeguard for Southeast Asia
papers.title_zh: SEA-Guard：专为东南亚地区设计的多语言安全防护系统
papers.authors: Panuthep Tasawong, Jian Gang Ngui, Alham Fikri Aji, Trevor Cohn, Peerat Limkonchotiwat
papers.abstract: Culturally aware safeguards are crucial for AI alignment in real-world settings, where safety extends beyond common sense and encompasses diverse local values, norms, and region-specific regulations. However, building large-scale, culturally grounded datasets is challenging due to limited resources and a scarcity of native annotators. Consequently, many safeguard models rely on machine translation of English datasets, often missing regional and cultural nuances. We present a novel agentic data-generation framework to scalably create authentic, region-specific safety datasets for Southeast Asia (SEA). On this foundation, we introduce the SEA-Guard family, the first multilingual safeguard models grounded in SEA cultural contexts. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks and cultural variants, SEA-Guard consistently outperforms existing safeguards at detecting regionally sensitive or harmful content while maintaining strong general safety performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中，为了确保人工智能的合规性，文化意识相关的保护措施至关重要。因为安全性不仅仅涉及常识范畴，还包含各种当地价值观、规范以及特定地区的法规。然而，由于资源有限且本土注释者稀缺，构建大规模、基于文化的数据集是一项挑战。因此，许多保护模型都依赖于英语数据集的机器翻译，这往往忽略了地区性和文化上的细微差别。我们提出了一种新颖的代理式数据生成框架，能够大规模创建适用于东南亚地区的真实、具有地域特色的安全数据集。在此基础上，我们推出了SEA-Guard系列模型，这是首批基于东南亚文化背景的多语言保护模型。通过多个基准测试和文化变体的评估，SEA-Guard在检测具有地区敏感性或有害内容方面表现始终优于现有模型，同时仍保持了强大的通用安全性能。

papers.title: Prompt Injection in Automated Résumé Screening with Large Language Models: Single and Multi-Injection Settings
papers.title_zh: 在基于大型语言模型的自动简历筛选中的提示注入问题：单次注入与多次注入的情况
papers.authors: Preet Baxi, Jiannan Xu, Jane Yi Jiang, Stefanus Jasin
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to screen and rank job applicants, creating incentives for candidates to strategically manipulate algorithmic hiring systems. We study prompt injection in automated résumé screening, defined as subtle self-promotional text that introduces no new qualifications but is designed to influence LLM evaluations. Using controlled experiments, we show that prompt injection reliably improves applicant rankings when résumé quality is homogeneous and few candidates inject. However, its effectiveness rapidly diminishes as more candidates inject, collapsing when manipulation becomes widespread. When candidate quality is heterogeneous, prompt injection is less effective on average, but can occasionally allow lower-quality candidates to outrank higher-quality ones, raising fairness concerns. Overall, LLM-based screening is most vulnerable when manipulation is rare and candidate quality differences are small.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在筛选和排序求职者方面被广泛应用，这给求职者提供了机会来操纵算法招聘系统。我们研究了在自动简历筛选过程中注入提示的行为，这种行为指的是那些不会增加任何新技能或资格的、旨在影响语言模型评估的微妙自我推销内容。通过控制实验，我们发现当简历质量相似且注入提示的候选人数量较少时，这种行为能够可靠地提升求职者的排名。然而，随着注入提示的候选人数量增加，其效果会迅速减弱，甚至会导致操纵行为变得普遍。当候选人的质量存在差异时，这种行为的有效性会降低，但偶尔仍有可能让质量较低的候选人超过质量较高的候选人，这引发了关于公平性的担忧。总体而言，基于语言模型的筛选系统在操纵行为较为罕见且候选人质量差异较小时最为脆弱。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FuseSearch: Learning Adaptive Parallel Execution for Efficient Code Localization
papers.title_zh: FuseSearch：学习自适应并行执行策略，以实现高效的代码定位
papers.authors: Ke Xu, Siyang Xiao, Ming Liang, Yichen Yu, Zhixiang Wang, Jingxuan Xu, Dajun Chen, Wei Jiang, Yong Li
papers.abstract: Code localization is a primary bottleneck in automated software development. While parallel tool execution can accelerate discovery, existing agents suffer from a 34.9% redundant tool invocation rate, negating the benefits of parallelism. We introduce FuseSearch, which reframes parallel code localization as a quality–efficiency co-optimization problem. By defining tool efficiency—the ratio of novel information gain to total invocations—we employ a two-stage SFT and RL pipeline to train models in adaptive parallel strategies. Unlike fixed-breadth methods, FuseSearch dynamically adjusts search breadth based on task context, transitioning from exploration to refinement. On SWE-bench Verified, FuseSearch-4B matches SOTA performance (84.7% file-level and 56.4% function-level F_1 scores) while being 93.6% faster, using 67.7% fewer turns and 68.9% fewer tokens. Our findings demonstrate that efficiency-aware training inherently boosts quality by eliminating noisy, redundant signals, enabling high-performance, low-cost localization agents. Code: https://github.com/sxthunder/FuseSearch
papers.abstract_zh: 代码本地化是自动化软件开发中的一个主要瓶颈。虽然并行工具执行可以加速代码定位过程，但现有的工具存在34.9%的冗余调用率，这抵消了并行性的优势。我们提出了FuseSearch算法，将并行代码定位问题重新定义为一个质量与效率共同优化的问题。通过定义工具效率——即新信息获取量与总调用次数的比例——我们采用两阶段的SFT和RL流程来训练模型，实现自适应并行策略。与固定宽度方法不同，FuseSearch能够根据任务上下文动态调整搜索范围，从探索阶段过渡到精细化阶段。在SWE-bench验证集上测试时，FuseSearch-4B达到了与最先进算法相当的性能水平（文件级准确率为84.7%，函数级准确率为56.4%），同时运行速度提高了93.6%，所需的计算次数减少了67.7%，使用的令牌数量也减少了68.9%。我们的研究结果表明，注重效率的训练方式能够提升代码的质量，因为它能够消除噪声和冗余的信息，从而实现高性能、低成本的代码定位工具。代码链接：https://github.com/sxthunder/FuseSearch

papers.title: Revisiting Self-Play Preference Optimization: On the Role of Prompt Difficulty
papers.title_zh: 重新审视自我游戏偏好优化机制：关于提示难度的作用
papers.authors: Yao Xiao, Jung-jae Kim, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Lidong Bing
papers.abstract: Self-play preference optimization has emerged as a prominent paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs). It typically involves a language model to generate on-policy responses for prompts and a reward model (RM) to guide the selection of chosen and rejected responses, which can be further trained with direct preference optimization (DPO). However, the role of prompts remains underexplored, despite being a core component in this pipeline. In this work, we investigate how prompts of varying difficulty influence self-play preference optimization. We use the mean reward of sampled responses of a prompt as a proxy for its difficulty. We first find that difficult prompts exhibit substantially inferior self-play optimization performance compared to easy prompts for language models. Moreover, incorporating difficult prompts into training fails to enhance overall performance and, in fact, leads to slight degradation compared to training on easy prompts alone. Third, there is a clear upward trend in optimization performance as prompt difficulty decreases. We also observe that the performance gap between difficult and easy prompts tends to close as the model capacity increases, suggesting that prompt difficulty interacts with the model capacity. Building on these findings, we explore strategies to mitigate the adversary effect of difficult prompts on final performance. We demonstrate that only training on a small portion (30%) of the easiest prompts improves overall self-play performance on AlpacaEval 2 and Arena-Hard. We also report failed attempts and lessons learned.
papers.abstract_zh: 自博弈偏好优化已成为调整大语言模型性能的一种重要方法。该方法通常包括一个语言模型来生成基于策略的响应，以及一个奖励模型来指导对选择或拒绝的响应的选择，这些模型可以进一步通过直接偏好优化进行训练。然而，尽管提示在这一过程中扮演着核心角色，但其作用却尚未得到充分研究。在这项研究中，我们探讨了不同难度的提示如何影响自博弈偏好优化的效果。我们使用提示对应采样响应的平均奖励作为其难度的代理指标。首先我们发现，与简单提示相比，难度较高的提示会导致语言模型的自博弈优化性能显著下降。此外，将难度较高的提示纳入训练并不能提升整体性能，反而会导致性能略有下降。第三，随着提示难度的降低，优化性能呈现出明显的上升趋势。我们还观察到，随着模型能力的增强，困难提示和简单提示之间的性能差距逐渐缩小，这表明提示难度与模型能力之间存在相互作用。基于这些发现，我们探索了减轻困难提示对最终性能影响的策略。我们的实验表明，仅对最简单提示中的一小部分（30%）进行训练，就能改善AlpacaEval 2和Arena-Hard上的整体自博弈性能。同时，我们也报告了失败的尝试以及从中得出的经验教训。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Multi-Agent Comedy Club: Investigating Community Discussion Effects on LLM Humor Generation
papers.title_zh: 多智能体喜剧俱乐部：探究社区讨论对大型语言模型幽默生成的影响
papers.authors: Shiwei Hong, Lingyao Li, Ethan Z. Rong, Chenxinran Shen, Zhicong Lu
papers.abstract: Prior work has explored multi-turn interaction and feedback for LLM writing, but evaluations still largely center on prompts and localized feedback, leaving persistent public reception in online communities underexamined. We test whether broadcast community discussion improves stand-up comedy writing in a controlled multi-agent sandbox: in the discussion condition, critic and audience threads are recorded, filtered, stored as social memory, and later retrieved to condition subsequent generations, whereas the baseline omits discussion. Across 50 rounds (250 paired monologues) judged by five expert annotators using A/B preference and a 15-item rubric, discussion wins 75.6% of instances and improves Craft/Clarity (Δ = 0.440) and Social Response (Δ = 0.422), with occasional increases in aggressive humor.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前的研究已经探讨了针对大语言模型写作的多轮互动与反馈机制，但目前的评估大多仍集中在提示词和局部反馈上，而忽视了在线社区中公众接受度的长期影响。我们在一个经过控制的多智能体环境中测试了广播式社区讨论是否有助于提升单口喜剧的写作水平：在讨论条件下，评论者和观众的讨论内容被记录下来、过滤处理，并作为社交记忆存储起来，之后用于后续作品的创作；而在基线条件下则没有进行讨论。通过50轮实验（共250组对谈），由五位专家评分员根据A/B偏好和15项评分标准进行评估，结果显示，讨论条件下的作品在75.6%的情况下表现更优。讨论方式提升了作品的“技巧性”和“清晰度”（差异值为0.440），同时也增强了“社会反应能力”（差异值为0.422）。此外，讨论方式还偶尔能带来更富有攻击性的幽默效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ComfyUI-R1: Exploring Reasoning Models for Workflow Generation
papers.title_zh: ComfyUI-R1：探索用于工作流生成的推理模型
papers.authors: Zhenran Xu, Yiyu Wang, Xue Yang, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Kaifu Zhang, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: AI-generated content has evolved from monolithic models to modular workflows, particularly on platforms like ComfyUI, enabling customization in creative pipelines. However, crafting effective workflows requires great expertise to orchestrate numerous specialized components, presenting a steep learning curve for users. To address this challenge, we introduce ComfyUI-R1, the first large reasoning model for automated workflow generation. Starting with our curated knowledge bases, we construct long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning data, including node selection, workflow planning, and code-level workflow representation. ComfyUI-R1 is trained through a two-stage framework: (1) CoT fine-tuning for cold start, adapting models to the ComfyUI domain; (2) reinforcement learning for incentivizing reasoning capability, guided by a fine-grained rule-metric hybrid reward, ensuring format validity, structural integrity, and node-level fidelity. Experiments show that our 7B-parameter model achieves a 97% format validity rate, along with high pass rate, node-level and graph-level F1 scores, surpassing prior state-of-the-art methods that employ leading closed-source models such as GPT-4o and Claude series. Qualitative analysis further highlights our model’s strength in synthesizing intricate workflows with diverse nodes, aligning with human instructions, and generalizing to newly introduced nodes, underscoring the potential of long CoT reasoning in AI art creation.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能生成的内容已经从单一模型发展为模块化工作流程，这在像ComfyUI这样的平台上尤为明显。这使得用户能够在创作流程中进行个性化设置。然而，要打造有效的工作流程需要极高的专业水平，因为需要协调众多专业组件，这对用户来说是一个相当陡峭的学习曲线。为了应对这一挑战，我们推出了ComfyUI-R1——首个用于自动生成工作流程的大型推理模型。我们基于精心挑选的知识库构建出长链思维推理数据，包括节点选择、工作流程规划以及代码级工作流程表示等方面。ComfyUI-R1通过两阶段框架进行训练：(1) 针对冷启动问题的CoT微调，使模型适应ComfyUI领域；(2) 通过细粒度的规则-度量混合奖励来激励推理能力，从而确保格式有效性、结构完整性以及节点级别的准确性。实验表明，我们的7B参数模型在格式有效性方面达到了97%的准确率，同时还有较高的通过率、节点级别和图级别F1分数，远远超过了那些使用领先的开源模型如GPT-4o和Claude系列的方法。定性分析进一步凸显了我们的模型的优势：它能够合成具有多种节点的复杂工作流程，能够按照人类指令进行生成，并且能够对新引入的节点进行通用处理，这充分显示了长链思维推理在人工智能艺术创作中的巨大潜力。

papers.title: Hard to Be Heard: Phoneme-Level ASR Analysis of Phonologically Complex, Low-Resource Endangered Languages
papers.title_zh: 难以被听到：对语音结构复杂且资源匮乏的濒危语言的音素级自动语音识别分析
papers.authors: V.S.D.S.Mahesh Akavarapu, Michael Daniel, Gerhard Jäger
papers.abstract: We present a phoneme-level analysis of automatic speech recognition (ASR) for two low-resourced and phonologically complex East Caucasian languages, Archi and Rutul, based on curated and standardized speech–transcript resources totaling approximately 50 minutes and 1 hour 20 minutes of audio, respectively. Existing recordings and transcriptions are consolidated and processed into a form suitable for ASR training and evaluation. We evaluate several state-of-the-art audio and audio–language models, including wav2vec2, Whisper, and Qwen2-Audio. For wav2vec2, we introduce a language-specific phoneme vocabulary with heuristic output-layer initialization, which yields consistent improvements and achieves performance comparable to or exceeding Whisper in these extremely low-resource settings. Beyond standard word and character error rates, we conduct a detailed phoneme-level error analysis. We find that phoneme recognition accuracy strongly correlates with training frequency, exhibiting a characteristic sigmoid-shaped learning curve. For Archi, this relationship partially breaks for Whisper, pointing to model-specific generalization effects beyond what is predicted by training frequency. Overall, our results indicate that many errors attributed to phonological complexity are better explained by data scarcity. These findings demonstrate the value of phoneme-level evaluation for understanding ASR behavior in low-resource, typologically complex languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们对两种资源匮乏且语音结构复杂的东高加索语言——Archi和Rutul进行了自动语音识别的语音级分析。我们基于经过整理和标准化的语音-转录资源进行了分析，这些资源包含了大约50分钟和1小时20分钟的音频数据。现有的录音和转录数据被整合并处理成适合进行自动语音识别训练和评估的形式。我们测试了几种先进的音频和音频-语言模型，包括wav2vec2、Whisper和Qwen2-Audio。对于wav2vec2模型，我们引入了一种针对特定语言的语音词汇表，并采用了启发式的输出层初始化方法，这种方法能够带来持续的改进效果，并且在这种资源极其匮乏的情况下，其性能与Whisper相当甚至更优。除了标准的单词和字符错误率之外，我们还进行了详细的语音级错误分析。我们发现，语音识别的准确性与训练频率有很强的相关性，呈现出典型的S型学习曲线。对于Archi语言来说，这种关系在Whisper模型中部分失效，这表明模型的泛化能力超出了训练频率所能预测的范围。总体而言，我们的结果表明，许多由语音结构复杂性引起的错误可以通过数据稀缺来解释。这些发现证明了在资源匮乏且类型结构复杂的语言中，进行语音级评估对于理解自动语音识别行为的重要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Surface-Level Pattern Trap: LLM Agents for Faster and Smarter Cross-Architecture Code Migration
papers.title_zh: 超越表面层次的模式陷阱：用于更快、更智能的跨架构代码迁移的LLM代理
papers.authors: Weijia Li, KE Gao, Pengfei Chen, Jiajie Li, Xinyu Wang, Yiran Le, Yize Wu, Ling Li
papers.abstract: The problem of surface-level pattern mapping represents a critical yet underexplored failure mode in large language model (LLM) reasoning, and is particularly acute in cross-architecture code migration of high-performance libraries. On low-resource, low-level code, insufficient coverage in pretraining data often leads LLMs to rely on superficial name- or type-based correspondences, rather than principled refactorization and reasoning grounded in core functional semantics and architecture-specific optimization intents. This tendency severely hampers the effectiveness of LLMs in complex migration scenarios.To address these challenges, we propose FSCM, a multi-agent framework for cross-architecture migration. FSCM decouples complex implementation details through functional mining and code refactoring, guiding LLMs to focus on invariant semantic anchors across architectures. By mitigating surface-level pattern traps, FSCM improves both functional correctness and performance when targeting emerging architectures. Extensive experiments on the challenging real-world OpenCV library migration tasks demonstrate substantial improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to 22% higher correctness rates over Copilot and 43.04x speedup on RISC-V platforms. Code and data are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/code-F8D4.
papers.abstract_zh: 表面级模式映射问题是大语言模型推理中一个关键但未被充分研究的故障模式，在高性能库的跨架构代码迁移过程中尤为突出。在资源匮乏、层次较低的代码中，预训练数据覆盖不足往往导致大语言模型依赖于表面的名称或类型对应关系，而非基于核心功能语义和特定架构优化意图的理性重构与推理。这种倾向严重影响了大语言模型在复杂迁移场景中的性能。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了FSCM这一跨架构迁移的多智能体框架。FSCM通过功能挖掘和代码重构来分离复杂的实现细节，引导大语言模型专注于跨架构的不变语义锚点。通过避免表面级模式陷阱，FSCM在针对新兴架构时提升了功能正确性和性能。在具有挑战性的现实世界OpenCV库迁移任务上的广泛实验表明，与现有最佳基线相比，FSCM取得了显著改进：正确率提高了22%，在RISC-V平台上的运行速度提升了43.04倍。代码和数据可在此处获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/code-F8D4
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PairCoder: Pair Programming-Inspired Two-Agent Collaboration for Code Generation
papers.title_zh: PairCoder：基于双人编程理念的两种智能体协作机制，用于代码生成
papers.authors: Junhao Chen, Xiang Li, Yibin Xu, Yuehan Cui, Fangsheng Weng, Hao Zhao, Fei Ma, Qi Tian
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong results on code generation, but single model inference remains brittle on tasks that require iterative refinement. Existing multi agent frameworks improve reliability, yet they often incur substantial token and latency overhead. We introduce PairCoder, a framework that brings pair programming to autonomous LLM collaboration. PairCoder assigns one model to code generation and the other to review, and switches roles when repeated errors suggest that the current interaction has stalled. Across 13 LLMs on HumanEval, PairCoder consistently improves over single model inference. On eight representative backbones, it reaches 91.0% pass@1 and improves over single model inference by up to 20.3% while reducing token usage by 40% to 70% relative to multi agent baselines. Many heterogeneous pairings also outperform both constituent models, suggesting that the framework generalizes across model families. These results position PairCoder as an effective and deployment conscious alternative to heavier multi agent systems.Code is available at https://github.com/yisuanwang/PairCoder
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成方面取得了出色的效果，但单个模型的推理能力在需要迭代优化的任务中仍然表现不佳。现有的多智能体框架虽然提高了可靠性，但却会带来大量的令牌消耗和延迟问题。我们提出了PairCoder这一框架，它将结对编程的理念应用于自主语言模型的协作中。PairCoder将一个模型用于代码生成，另一个模型用于代码审查，当重复出现错误时，系统会切换模型角色以继续协作。在HumanEval的13个语言模型测试中，PairCoder始终优于单一模型的推理效果。在8种代表性的基础模型上，PairCoder的通过率达到了91.0%，且比单一模型的推理效果提升了20.3%，同时相对于多智能体基线方案，其令牌使用量减少了40%到70%。许多异构组合也优于单独使用各个模型的方案，这表明该框架能够适用于不同的模型家族。这些结果使得PairCoder成为一种高效且易于部署的解决方案，可以替代那些复杂多智能体系统。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/yisuanwang/PairCoder

papers.title: OptiVerse: A Comprehensive Benchmark towards Optimization Problem Solving
papers.title_zh: OptiVerse：一个用于优化问题解决的全面基准平台
papers.authors: Xinyu Zhang, Boxuan Zhang, Yuchen Wan, Lingling Zhang, YiXing Yao, Bifan Wei, Yaqiang Wu, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning, complex optimization tasks remain challenging, requiring domain knowledge and robust implementation. However, existing benchmarks focus narrowly on Mathematical Programming and Combinatorial Optimization, hindering comprehensive evaluation. To address this, we introduce OptiVerse, a comprehensive benchmark of 1,000 curated problems spanning neglected domains, including Stochastic Optimization, Dynamic Optimization, Game Optimization, and Optimal Control, across three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, and Hard. The experiments with 22 LLMs of different sizes reveal sharp performance degradation on hard problems, where even advanced models like GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3 struggle to exceed 27% accuracy. Through error analysis, we identify that modeling logic errors remain the primary bottleneck. Consequently, we propose a Dual-View Auditor Agent that improves the accuracy of the LLM modeling process without introducing significant time overhead. OptiVerse will serve as a foundational platform for advancing LLMs in solving complex optimization challenges.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在推理能力方面表现出色，但复杂的优化任务仍然具有挑战性，需要相关领域的知识以及稳健的实现方式。然而，现有的基准测试主要集中在数学规划和组合优化领域，这限制了全面评估的能力。为了克服这一问题，我们推出了OptiVerse——一个包含1000个精心挑选的问题的综合基准测试平台，这些问题涵盖了随机优化、动态优化、博弈优化和最优控制等多个领域，并分为三个难度级别：简单、中等和困难。通过对22种不同规模的语言模型进行实验，我们发现这些模型在困难问题上表现显著下降，即使是像GPT-5.2和Gemini-3这样的先进模型，也难以达到27%的准确率。通过错误分析，我们发现建模逻辑错误仍然是主要瓶颈。因此，我们提出了一种双视图审计代理，它能够提高语言模型建模过程的准确性，同时不会显著增加计算时间。OptiVerse将成为推动语言模型解决复杂优化问题的基础平台。

papers.title: DiagnosisArena: Benchmarking Diagnostic Reasoning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 诊断竞技场：大型语言模型诊断推理能力的对比评估
papers.authors: Yakun Zhu, Zhongzhen Huang, Linjie Mu, Yutong Huang, Wei Nie, Jiaji Liu, Shaoting Zhang, Pengfei Liu, Xiaofan Zhang
papers.abstract: The emergence of groundbreaking large language models capable of performing complex reasoning tasks holds significant promise for addressing various scientific challenges, including those arising in complex clinical scenarios. To enable their safe and effective deployment in real-world healthcare settings, it is urgently necessary to benchmark the diagnostic capabilities of current models systematically. Given the limitations of existing medical benchmarks in evaluating advanced diagnostic reasoning, we present DiagnosisArena, a comprehensive and challenging benchmark designed to rigorously assess professional-level diagnostic competence. DiagnosisArena consists of 1,113 pairs of segmented patient cases and corresponding diagnoses, spanning 28 medical specialties, deriving from clinical case reports published in 10 top-tier medical journals. The benchmark is developed through a meticulous construction pipeline, involving multiple rounds of screening and review by both AI systems and human experts, with thorough checks conducted to prevent data leakage. Our study reveals that even the most advanced reasoning models, o3-mini, o1, and DeepSeek-R1, achieve only 45.82%, 31.09%, and 17.79% accuracy, respectively. This finding highlights a significant generalization bottleneck in current large language models when faced with clinical diagnostic reasoning challenges. Through DiagnosisArena, we aim to drive further advancements in AI’s diagnostic reasoning capabilities, enabling more effective solutions for real-world clinical diagnostic challenges. We openly share the benchmark and evaluation tools for further research and development.
papers.abstract_zh: 能够执行复杂推理任务的开创性大语言模型的出现，为应对各种科学挑战带来了巨大希望，包括那些在复杂的临床场景中出现的挑战。为了使其在现实世界的医疗环境中得到安全有效的应用，迫切需要系统地评估当前模型的诊断能力。鉴于现有医学基准在评估高级诊断推理方面的局限性，我们提出了DiagnosisArena这一全面且具有挑战性的基准测试，旨在严格评估专业级别的诊断能力。DiagnosisArena包含1,113对分割后的患者病例及其对应的诊断结果，涵盖了28个医学领域，这些病例来自10种顶级医学期刊上发表的临床病例报告。该基准测试是通过严格的构建流程开发的，涉及多轮由人工智能系统和人类专家进行的筛选和审核，同时进行了彻底的数据检查以防止数据泄露。我们的研究表明，即使是最先进的语言模型，如o3-mini、o1和DeepSeek-R1，其准确率也分别只有45.82%、31.09%和17.79%。这一发现揭示了当前大语言模型在面对临床诊断推理挑战时存在严重的泛化瓶颈。通过DiagnosisArena，我们希望进一步推动人工智能诊断推理能力的提升，从而为现实世界中的临床诊断挑战提供更有效的解决方案。我们将该基准测试和评估工具公开共享，以便进一步的研究和发展。

papers.title: AMA: Adaptive Memory via Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.title_zh: AMA：通过多智能体协作实现自适应记忆
papers.authors: Weiquan Huang, Zixuan Wang, Hehai Lin, Sudong Wang, Bo Xu, Qian Li, Beier Zhu, Linyi Yang, Chengwei Qin
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents has necessitated robust memory systems to support cohesive long-term interaction and complex reasoning. Benefiting from the strong capabilities of LLMs, recent research focus has shifted from simple context extension to the development of dedicated agentic memory systems. However, existing approaches typically rely on rigid retrieval granularity, accumulation-heavy maintenance strategies, and coarse-grained update mechanisms. These design choices create a persistent mismatch between stored information and task-specific reasoning demands, while leading to the unchecked accumulation of logical inconsistencies over time. To address these challenges, we propose Adaptive Memory via Multi-Agent Collaboration (AMA), a novel framework that leverages coordinated agents to manage memory across multiple granularities. AMA employs a hierarchical memory design that dynamically aligns retrieval granularity with task complexity. Specifically, the Constructor and Retriever jointly enable multi-granularity memory construction and adaptive query routing. The Judge verifies the relevance and consistency of retrieved content, triggering iterative retrieval when evidence is insufficient or invoking the Refresher upon detecting logical conflicts. The Refresher then enforces memory consistency by performing targeted updates or removing outdated entries. Extensive experiments on challenging long-context benchmarks show that AMA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while reducing token consumption by approximately 80% compared to full-context methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in maintaining retrieval precision and long-term memory consistency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理的快速发展，迫切需要强大的记忆系统来支持长期的连贯交互和复杂的推理过程。得益于大语言模型的强大能力，最近的研究重点已经从简单的上下文扩展转向了专用代理记忆系统的开发。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于僵化的检索粒度、需要大量维护的累积策略以及粗糙的更新机制。这些设计选择导致存储的信息与任务特定的推理需求之间存在持续的不匹配，同时还会导致逻辑不一致性随着时间不断积累。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了“通过多智能体协作实现自适应记忆”这一创新框架。该框架利用协调一致的代理来管理多个粒度的记忆信息。AMA采用分层记忆设计，能够动态调整检索粒度与任务复杂性的匹配程度。具体来说，构建者和检索器共同负责多粒度记忆的构建和自适应查询路由。裁判者负责验证检索内容的相关性和一致性，在证据不足时触发迭代检索，在检测到逻辑冲突时调用刷新器。刷新器则通过执行有针对性的更新或删除过时的条目来维护记忆的一致性。在具有挑战性的长上下文基准测试中的广泛实验表明，AMA在性能上显著优于现有的最佳基线算法，同时相比全上下文方法，其token消耗减少了约80%，充分体现了其在保持检索精度和长期记忆一致性方面的有效性。

papers.title: WESR: A Benchmark and Strong Baseline for Word-level Event-Speech Recognition
papers.title_zh: WESR：一个用于词汇级事件-语音识别的基准测试，以及强大的基础平台
papers.authors: Chenchen Yang, Kexin Huang, Liwei Fan, Qian Tu, Botian Jiang, Dong Zhang, Linqi Yin, Shimin Li, Zhaoye Fei, Qinyuan Cheng, Xipeng Qiu
papers.abstract: Speech conveys not only linguistic information but also rich non-verbal vocal events such as laughing and crying. While semantic transcription is well-studied, the precise localization of non-verbal events remains a critical yet under-explored challenge. Current methods suffer from insufficient task definitions with limited category coverage and ambiguous temporal granularity. They also lack standardized evaluation frameworks, hindering the development of downstream applications. To bridge this gap, we first develop a refined taxonomy of 21 vocal events, with a new categorization into discrete (standalone) versus continuous (mixed with speech) types. Based on the refined taxonomy, we introduce WESR-Bench, an expert-annotated evaluation set (900+ utterances) with a novel position-aware protocol that disentangles ASR errors from event detection, enabling precise localization measurement for both discrete and continuous events. We also build a strong baseline by constructing a 1,700+ hour corpus, and train specialized models, surpassing both open-source audio-language models and commercial APIs while preserving ASR quality. We anticipate that WESR will serve as a foundational resource for future research in modeling rich, real-world auditory scenes.
papers.abstract_zh: 言语不仅传递语言信息，还包含丰富的非语言声音事件，如笑声和哭泣。虽然语义转录已经得到了充分研究，但非语言事件的精确定位仍然是一个关键且尚未被充分探索的挑战。当前的方法存在任务定义不足、类别覆盖范围有限以及时间粒度模糊的问题。此外，这些方法缺乏标准化的评估框架，这阻碍了下游应用的发展。为了填补这一空白，我们首先对21种声音事件进行了精细的分类，将它们划分为独立事件和与语音混合发生的连续事件两种类型。基于这一精细分类体系，我们开发了WESR-Bench这个由专家标注的评估集（包含900多个例句），该评估集采用了一种新颖的位置感知协议，能够区分自动语音识别的错误与声音事件，从而实现对独立事件和连续事件的精确定位。我们还通过构建包含1700多个小时的语料库来建立坚实的基础，并训练专门的模型，这些模型在保持自动语音识别质量的同时，超越了开源音频-语言模型和商业API的性能水平。我们预计，WESR将成为未来研究复杂真实世界听觉场景建模的基础资源。

papers.title: Applicability Condition Extraction for Therapeutic Drug-Disease Relations
papers.title_zh: 治疗性药物与疾病关系的可应用性条件提取
papers.authors: Guanting Luo, Noriki Nishida, Yuji Matsumoto, Yuki Arase
papers.abstract: Identifying conditions that a certain drug takes therapeutic effect on a target disease is crucial for clinical decision-making support. However, most existing biomedical information extraction methods have focused on identifying only relations between drugs and diseases, while largely overlooking the context-specific conditions where such relations can apply. To address this problem, we introduce the task of applicability condition extraction for therapeutic drug–disease relations from biomedical research literature. We create the first dataset that has manually annotated triples of drugs, diseases, and applicability conditions on biomedical paper abstracts with 1,119 drug-disease pairs. Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate the performance of a range of existing methods. In addition, we propose a new method that enhances LoRA to consider relations between drugs and diseases. Our method consistently outperforms strong baselines across different evaluation settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 识别某种药物对目标疾病产生治疗效果的条件，对于临床决策支持至关重要。然而，目前大多数生物医学信息提取方法仅专注于识别药物与疾病之间的关系，而很大程度上忽略了这些关系适用的具体情境。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了从生物医学研究文献中提取药物与疾病之间关系适用条件的任务。我们创建了第一个数据集，该数据集包含了手动标注的关于药物、疾病以及它们在生物医学论文摘要中的适用条件的三元组，共有1,119对药物-疾病组合。利用这个数据集，我们系统地评估了多种现有方法的性能。此外，我们还提出了一种新方法，该方法改进了LoRA算法，以考虑药物与疾病之间的关系。我们的方法在不同评估环境下始终表现出优于强基准算法的性能。

papers.title: ACR: Adaptive Context Refactoring via Context Refactoring Operators for Multi-Turn Dialogue
papers.title_zh: ACR：通过上下文重构操作实现多轮对话中的自适应上下文重构
papers.authors: Jiawei Shen, Jia Zhu, Hanghui Guo, Weijie Shi, Yue Cui, Qingyu Niu, Guoqing Ma, Jingjiang Liu, Yidan Liang, Yilin Wang, Shimin Di, Jiajie Xu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance in multi-turn dialogue. However, in multi-turn dialogue, models still struggle to stay aligned with what has been established earlier, follow dependencies across many turns, and avoid drifting into incorrect facts as the interaction grows longer. Existing approaches primarily focus on extending the context window, introducing external memory, or applying context compression, yet these methods still face limitations such as contextual inertia and state drift. To address these challenges, we propose the Adaptive Context Refactoring (ACR) Framework, which dynamically monitors and reshapes the interaction history to mitigate contextual inertia and state drift actively. ACR is built on a library of context refactoring operators and a teacher-guided self-evolving training paradigm that learns when to intervene and how to refactor, thereby decoupling context management from the reasoning process. Extensive experiments on multi-turn dialogue demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines while reducing token consumption. Our code is available at https://github.com/ClannadKno/multi-turn.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多轮对话中展现出了出色的性能。然而，在多轮对话中，模型仍然难以保持与之前建立的关系的同步，难以在多个回合中遵循依赖关系，也难以避免在交互时间延长时陷入错误的信息。现有的方法主要侧重于扩展上下文窗口、引入外部记忆或应用上下文压缩技术，但这些方法仍然存在诸如上下文惯性问题和状态漂移等局限性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了自适应上下文重构框架（ACR）。该框架能够动态监测并重新塑造交互历史，从而有效缓解上下文惯性和状态漂移的问题。ACR基于一系列上下文重构算子构建，并采用一种由教师指导的自进化训练范式，能够学习何时进行干预以及如何进行重构，从而将上下文管理与推理过程分离开来。在多轮对话上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在减少令牌消耗的同时，显著优于现有的基线方法。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/ClannadKno/multi-turn下载。

papers.title: ALGOGEN: Tool-Generated Verifiable Traces for Reliable Algorithm Visualization
papers.title_zh: ALGOGEN：由工具生成的可靠可验证的痕迹，用于实现可靠的算法可视化
papers.authors: Liaokunpeng, Yuexiao Ma, Yisheng Lin, Hualin Zeng, Xiawu Zheng, Rongrong Ji
papers.abstract: Algorithm Visualization (AV) helps students build mental models by animating algorithm execution states. Recent LLM-based systems such as CODE2VIDEO generate AV videos in an end-to-end manner. However, this paradigm requires the system to simultaneously simulate algorithm flow and satisfy video rendering constraints (element layout, color schemes, etc.), a complex task that induces LLM hallucinations. This results in reduced execution success rates, element overlap, and inter-frame inconsistencies.To address these challenges, we propose ALGOGEN, a novel paradigm that decouples algorithm execution from rendering. We first introduce Visualization Trace Algebra (VTA), a monoid over algorithm visual states and operations. The LLM then generates a Python tracker that simulates algorithm flow and outputs VTA-JSON traces, a JSON encoding of VTA. For rendering, we define a Rendering Style Language (RSL) to templatize algorithm layouts. A deterministic renderer then compiles algorithm traces with RSL into Manim, LaTeX/TikZ, or Three.js outputs[Manim, TikZ, and Three.js are respectively a Python animation engine, a LaTeX vector graphics package, and a JavaScript 3D rendering library.].Evaluated on a LeetCode AV benchmark of 200 tasks, ALGOGEN achieves an average success rate improvement of 17.3% compared to end-to-end methods (99.8% vs. 82.5%). These results demonstrate that our decoupling paradigm effectively mitigates LLM hallucinations in complex AV tasks, providing a more reliable solution for automated generation of high-quality algorithm visualizations. Demo videos and code are available at: .
papers.abstract_zh: 算法可视化技术通过动画化算法的执行状态来帮助学生构建心理模型。最近基于大语言模型的系统如CODE2VIDEO能够端到端地生成可视化视频。然而，这种范式要求系统同时模拟算法流程并满足视频渲染的约束条件（如元素布局、色彩方案等），这一复杂的任务容易引发大语言模型的幻觉现象。这会导致执行成功率降低、元素重叠以及帧与帧之间出现不一致性等问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ALGOGEN这一创新理念，它将算法执行与渲染过程分离开来。我们首先引入了可视化追踪代数这一概念，它是一种针对算法视觉状态和操作的代数结构。然后，大语言模型会生成一个Python追踪器，用于模拟算法流程，并输出可视化追踪代数对应的JSON格式数据。在渲染方面，我们定义了一种渲染风格语言，用于为算法布局提供模板支持。一个确定性渲染器可以将算法追踪数据与渲染风格语言结合，最终生成适用于Manim、LaTeX/TikZ或Three.js的输出格式。在LeetCode的可视化基准测试中，ALGOGEN的平均成功率比传统端到端方法提高了17.3%（分别为99.8%和82.5%）。这些结果表明，我们的分离式设计能够有效减少复杂可视化任务中的大语言模型幻觉问题，为自动生成高质量算法可视化内容提供了更可靠的解决方案。相关演示视频和代码可供获取。

papers.title: PivotAttack: Rethinking the Search Trajectory in Hard-Label Text Attacks via Pivot Words
papers.title_zh: PivotAttack：通过关键词重新思考硬标签文本攻击中的搜索策略
papers.authors: Yuzhi Liang, Shiliang Xiao, Jingsong Wei, Qiliang Lin, Xia Li
papers.abstract: Existing hard-label text attacks often rely on inefficient “outside-in” strategies that traverse vast search spaces. We propose PivotAttack, a query-efficient “inside-out” framework. It employs a Multi-Armed Bandit algorithm to identify Pivot Sets—combinatorial token groups acting as prediction anchors—and strategically perturbs them to induce label flips. This approach captures inter-word dependencies and minimizes query costs. Extensive experiments across traditional models and Large Language Models demonstrate that PivotAttack consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both Attack Success Rate and query efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的硬标签文本攻击通常依赖于低效的“从外到内”策略，这些策略需要遍历庞大的搜索空间。我们提出了PivotAttack这一查询高效的“从内到外”框架。该框架采用多臂老虎机算法来识别作为预测锚点的组合词元集合，即枢轴集合（Pivot Sets），并通过对这些标记组进行策略性干扰来实现标签翻转。这种方法能够捕捉单词之间的依赖关系，同时最小化查询成本。通过针对传统模型和大语言模型的广泛实验表明，PivotAttack在攻击成功率和查询效率方面始终优于现有最先进的基线方法。

papers.title: MiMIC: Mitigating Visual Modality Collapse in Universal Multimodal Retrieval While Avoiding Semantic Misalignment
papers.title_zh: MiMIC：在避免语义不一致的情况下，如何减轻通用多模态检索中的视觉模态崩溃问题
papers.authors: Li Juan, Chuanghao Ding, Xujie Zhang, Cam-Tu Nguyen
papers.abstract: Universal Multimodal Retrieval (UMR) aims to map different modalities (e.g., visual and textual) into a shared embedding space for multi-modal retrieval. Existing UMR methods can be broadly divided into two categories: early-fusion approaches, such as Marvel, which projects visual features into the language model (LM) space for integrating with text modality, and late-fusion approaches, such as UniVL-DR, encode visual and textual inputs using separate encoders and obtain fused embeddings through addition. Our pilot study reveals that Marvel exhibits visual modality collapse, which is characterized by the model’s tendency to disregard visual features while depending excessively on textual cues. In contrast, although UniVL-DR is less affected by this issue, it is more susceptible to semantic misalignment, where semantically related content is positioned far apart in the embedding space. To address these challenges, we propose MiMIC, which introduces two key innovations: (1) a fusion-in-decoder architecture for effective multimodal integration, and (2) robust training through single-modality mix-in and random caption dropout. Experiments on the WebQA+ and EVQA+ datasets—where image in documents or queries might lack captions—indicate that MiMIC consistently outperforms both early- and late-fusion baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 通用多模态检索（UMR）旨在将不同模态的数据（如视觉和文本）映射到一个共享的嵌入空间中，以实现多模态检索。现有的UMR方法大致可以分为两类：早期融合方法，例如Marvel，它通过将视觉特征投影到语言模型空间中，从而实现与文本模态的结合；以及后期融合方法，例如UniVL-DR，该方法使用独立的编码器对视觉和文本输入进行编码，然后通过叠加的方式获得融合后的嵌入向量。我们的实验表明，Marvel存在视觉模态崩溃的问题，即模型倾向于忽略视觉特征，而过度依赖文本线索。相比之下，虽然UniVL-DR受此问题的影响较小，但它更容易出现语义不一致的情况，即语义相关的内容在嵌入空间中分布得很远。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MiMIC算法，该算法引入了两个关键创新点：（1）在解码器内部进行融合处理，以实现有效的多模态整合；（2）通过单模态混合训练和随机标题丢弃技术来进行稳健的训练。在WebQA+和EVQA+数据集上的实验表明，MiMIC在性能上始终优于早期融合方法和后期融合方法。

papers.title: Towards Proactive Personalization through Profile Customization for Individual Users in Dialogues
papers.title_zh: 通过个性化用户资料实现对话中的主动式个性化推荐
papers.authors: Xiaotian Zhang, Yuan Wang, Ruizhe Chen, Zeya Wang, Runchen Hou, Zuozhu Liu
papers.abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) in interactive systems necessitates a deep alignment with the nuanced and dynamic preferences of individual users. Current alignment techniques predominantly address universal human values or static, single-turn preferences, thereby failing to address the critical needs of long-term personalization and the initial user cold-start problem. To bridge this gap, we propose PersonalAgent, a novel user-centric lifelong agent designed to continuously infer and adapt to user preferences. PersonalAgent constructs and dynamically refines a unified user profile by decomposing dialogues into single-turn interactions, framing preference inference as a sequential decision-making task. Experiments show that PersonalAgent achieves superior performance over strong prompt-based and policy optimization baselines, not only in idealized but also in noisy conversational contexts, while preserving cross-session preference consistency. Furthermore, human evaluation confirms that PersonalAgent excels at capturing user preferences naturally and coherently. Our findings underscore the importance of lifelong personalization for developing more inclusive and adaptive conversational agents. Our code and ALOE-Unseen dataset are released here.
papers.abstract_zh: 在交互系统中部署大语言模型（LLM）时，必须确保其与用户个体复杂的、动态变化的偏好需求高度契合。目前的主流对齐技术主要关注的是普遍的人类价值观或静态、一次性化的偏好，因此无法有效解决长期个性化需求和用户初始状态未知的问题。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了PersonalAgent——一种以用户为中心的终身式智能体，它能够持续推断并适应用户的偏好。PersonalAgent通过将对话分解为一系列一次性化的互动操作，从而动态地构建并完善用户的统一画像。实验表明，PersonalAgent在理想化场景以及嘈杂的对话环境中都能表现出卓越的性能，同时还能保持跨会话的偏好一致性。此外，人类评估结果显示，PersonalAgent能够自然且连贯地捕捉用户的偏好。我们的研究强调了终身个性化对于开发更具包容性和适应性的对话智能体的重要性。我们的代码以及ALOE-Unseen数据集已在此发布。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Stochastic Exploration: What Makes Training Data Valuable for Agentic Search
papers.title_zh: 超越随机探索：是什么让训练数据对智能体搜索具有价值
papers.authors: Chuzhan Hao, Wenfeng Feng, Guochao Jiang, Guofeng Quan, Guohua Liu, Yuewei Zhang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective approach for advancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through the strategic integration of external search engines. However, current RL-based search agents often rely on a process of stochastic exploration guided by carefully crafted outcome rewards, leading to inefficient reasoning trajectories and unstable training. To address these issues, we propose a novel framework, Hierarchical Experience (HiExp), to enhance the performance and training stability of search agents. Specifically, we extract empirical knowledge through contrastive analysis and a multi-level clustering mechanism, transforming raw reasoning trajectories into hierarchical experience knowledge. By leveraging experience-aligned training, we effectively regularize stochastic exploration, evolving it into a strategic and experience-driven search process. Extensive evaluations on multiple complex agentic search and mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach not only achieves substantial performance gains but also exhibits strong cross-task and cross-algorithm generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）通过战略性地整合外部搜索引擎，已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的有效方法。然而，目前的基于RL的搜索代理往往依赖于由精心设计的奖励引导的随机探索过程，这导致推理过程效率低下且训练稳定性不佳。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的框架——分层经验（HiExp），以提升搜索代理的性能和训练稳定性。具体来说，我们通过对比分析和多层次聚类机制提取经验知识，将原始的推理轨迹转化为分层经验知识。通过利用与经验相关的训练方式，我们有效地规范了随机探索行为，使其转变为一种具有战略性和经验驱动性的搜索过程。在多个复杂的代理搜索和数学推理基准测试中的广泛评估表明，我们的方法不仅取得了显著的性能提升，还展现了强大的跨任务和跨算法泛化能力。

papers.title: Can LLMs Hear the Dogwhistle?
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能听到狗哨声吗？
papers.authors: Yifan Liu, Yi Lin, Xinwei Guo, Ziwei Wang, Jiaxin Zhang, Guanhua Chen, Haiyan Wu, Xiangyu Zhao, Xin Yao, Xuetao Wei
papers.abstract: With the widespread deployment of large language models (LLMs), existing safety benchmarks remain largely focused on explicitly harmful content, overlooking context-dependent expressions such as dogwhistles, the language that conveys harmful intent while appearing benign on the surface. To address this gap, we introduce DogBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM safety under dogwhistle-driven prompts. DogBench comprises 11,150 prompt instances constructed from controlled templates that embed dogwhistle terms, allowing for enabling direct comparison with explicit toxic terms under identical prompt structures. Each prompt is further annotated with pragmatic attributes, including interaction category and stance tendency. Extensive evaluations across multiple mainstream LLMs reveal a consistent pattern: dogwhistle prompts are substantially more likely to elicit harmful outputs than their explicit toxic counterparts, with an average risk increase of approximately fourfold. These findings expose a blind spot in current safety evaluation and alignment practices. Our work underscores the need to explicitly incorporate dogwhistles into future LLM safety research, with DogBench serving as a dedicated benchmark for this purpose.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的大规模部署，现有的安全评估基准主要集中在明确有害的内容上，而忽略了诸如“狗哨语”这类依赖于上下文的表达方式——这些表达方式在表面上看似无害，但实际上却隐藏着有害的意图。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了DogBench这个全面的评估基准，用于评估在带有“狗哨语”提示下的语言模型安全性。DogBench包含了11,150个提示实例，这些实例都是从包含“狗哨语”词汇的模板中构建出来的，这样就可以在相同的提示结构下，直接比较这些提示与明确的有害词汇之间的表现。每个提示还被标注了实用属性，包括互动类别和立场倾向等。通过对多个主流语言模型进行广泛的评估，我们发现了一个一致的现象：带有“狗哨语”的提示比明确的有害提示更有可能产生有害的输出，其平均风险增加了大约四倍。这些发现揭示了当前安全评估和对齐实践中存在的盲点。我们的工作强调了在未来语言模型安全研究中明确纳入“狗哨语”的重要性，而DogBench则可以作为专门用于此目的的评估基准。

papers.title: HiPrune: Hierarchical Attention for Efficient Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: HiPrune：分层注意力机制，实现视觉语言模型中高效的标记剪枝操作
papers.authors: Jizhihui Liu, Guangdao Zhu, Feiyi Du, Niu Lian, Jun Li, Bin Chen, Weili Guan, Yaowei Wang
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) encode images and videos into abundant tokens, which contain substantial redundancy and computation cost. While visual token pruning mitigates the issue, most existing methods lack insight into the intrinsic property of the vision encoder itself. In this work, we dive into the vision encoder and prove that the middle layers pay more attention to the main objects of the image qualitatively and quantitatively, while the deep layers to tokens with rich global information. Utilizing this Hierarchical attention pattern, we propose HiPrune, a training-free and model-agnostic token Pruning method. HiPrune identifies three types of visual tokens according to their attention in different phases of the vision encoder, which preserves different levels of information. By coupling with the similarity of text tokens, we propose a prompt-aware variance, HiPrune++, which further improves instruction following performance under a very low token budget. Extensive experiments across four representative VLMs show that HiPrune achieves up to 99.3% of task accuracy with only 1/3 of the tokens, while reducing inference FLOPs by 58.7%. HiPrune++ maintains up to 99.9% accuracy with 2/9 tokens, highlighting robustness under high-resolution.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）将图像和视频编码成大量令牌，这些令牌具有显著的冗余性，同时也会带来较高的计算成本。虽然视觉令牌修剪可以一定程度上缓解这一问题，但大多数现有方法并未深入探究视觉编码器本身的本质特性。在这项研究中，我们深入分析了视觉编码器的工作原理，发现中间层在质和量上都更关注图像中的主要对象，而深层则更关注那些包含丰富全局信息的令牌。基于这种分层注意力模式，我们提出了HiPrune这一无需训练且独立于模型的令牌修剪方法。HiPrune能够根据令牌在视觉编码器不同阶段的注意力程度，将其分为三种类型，从而保留不同层次的信息。通过结合文本令牌的相似性，我们又提出了一种基于提示意识的方差处理方法——HiPrune++。这种方法能够在极低的令牌预算下进一步提升指令遵循性能。在四种代表性的VLM上进行的大量实验表明，HiPrune仅使用三分之一的令牌就能达到99.3%的任务准确率，同时还将推理所需的FLOPs减少了58.7%。而HiPrune++则能在使用九分之二的令牌时保持99.9%的准确率，充分体现了其在高分辨率场景下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: MIThinker: A Plug-and-Play Policy-Optimized Thinker For Motivational Interviewing Counseling
papers.title_zh: MIThinker：一种即插即用、专为动机访谈咨询设计的政策优化工具
papers.authors: Yizhe Yang, Palakorn Achananuparp, Heyan Huang, Jing Jiang, Ee-Peng Lim
papers.abstract: Reasoning large language models (LLMs) have recently made much progress in complex problem-solving, leveraging internal reasoning (or thought) to guide their solution generation. However, existing LLM-based counseling agents, including those using Motivational Interviewing (MI), generate responses without explicitly aligning thoughts with counseling techniques, limiting their effectiveness. We propose MIThinker, a lightweight thinking model that generates therapeutic thoughts to guide MI counseling agents in strategy selection and response generation. To overcome the lack of annotated thought data, we introduce AugR1-MI, an automated pipeline that reverse-engineers counselor’s thoughts from observed responses. Through two-stage training combining supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, MIThinker demonstrates improved theory-of-mind assessment and strategy alignment. Comprehensive evaluations show that MindfulMI, our agent leveraging MIThinker, achieves MI competency comparable to state-of-the-art systems with an order of magnitude less computation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂问题解决方面取得了显著进展，它们能够利用自身的推理能力来指导解决方案的生成。然而，现有的基于大语言模型的咨询代理，包括那些采用动机访谈方法的代理，在生成回应时并未明确将用户的想法与咨询技巧进行对齐，这限制了它们的有效性。我们提出了MIThinker这一轻量级思维模型，它能够生成有助于咨询代理选择策略和生成回应的治疗性想法。为了弥补缺乏标注的思维方式数据的问题，我们开发了AugR1-MI这一自动化流程，该流程能够从观察到的回应中逆向工程出咨询师的想法。通过结合监督式微调与强化学习的双阶段训练，MIThinker在心理理论评估和策略对齐方面表现出了改进效果。全面的评估表明，我们开发的利用MIThinker的咨询代理MindfulMI，其咨询能力可与最先进的系统相媲美，而且其计算量则大幅减少。

papers.title: The Art of (Mis)alignment: How Fine-Tuning Methods Effectively Misalign and Realign LLMs in Post-Training
papers.title_zh: （错误）对齐的艺术：如何通过微调方法有效使大型语言模型在训练后发生错误的对齐，以及重新进行正确的对齐
papers.authors: Rui Zhang, Hongwei Li, Yun Shen, Xinyue Shen, Wenbo Jiang, Guowen Xu, Yang Liu, Michael Backes, Yang Zhang
papers.abstract: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) raises significant ethical and safety concerns. While LLM alignment techniques are adopted to improve model safety and trustworthiness, adversaries can exploit these techniques to undermine safety for malicious purposes, resulting in misalignment. Misaligned LLMs may be published on open platforms to magnify harm. To address this, additional safety alignment, referred to as realignment, is necessary before deploying untrusted third-party LLMs. This study explores the efficacy of fine-tuning methods in terms of misalignment, realignment, and the effects of their interplay. By evaluating four Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and two Preference Fine-Tuning (PFT) methods across four popular safety-aligned LLMs, we reveal a mechanism asymmetry between attack and defense. While Odds Ratio Preference Optimization (ORPO) is most effective for misalignment, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) excels in realignment, albeit at the expense of model utility. Additionally, we identify model-specific resistance, residual effects of multi-round adversarial dynamics, and other noteworthy findings. These findings highlight the need for robust safeguards and customized safety alignment strategies to mitigate potential risks in the deployment of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的部署引发了重大的伦理和安全问题。虽然采用了LLM对齐技术来提高模型的安全性和可靠性，但对手可以利用这些技术来破坏安全性，从而导致模型的不对齐现象。如果LLM出现不对齐的情况，它们可能会被发布到开放平台上，从而进一步加剧危害。因此，在部署不受信任的第三方LLM之前，需要进行额外的安全对齐处理，这被称为重新对齐。本研究探讨了微调方法在防止不对齐、重新对齐以及它们之间的相互作用方面的有效性。通过评估四种监督式微调方法和两种偏好式微调方法在四种流行的安全对齐LLM上的表现，我们发现攻击与防御之间存在机制上的不对称。其中， odds ratio偏好优化方法在不对齐问题上最为有效，而直接偏好优化方法则在重新对齐方面表现出色，不过这是以牺牲模型性能为代价的。此外，我们还发现了模型特定的抗干扰能力、多轮对抗动态带来的残余影响以及其他值得注意的现象。这些发现强调了在部署LLM时需要采取强有力的安全措施和定制化的安全对齐策略，以缓解潜在的风险。

papers.title: ADaPT: Token-Level Decoupling for Efficient Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: ADaPT：代币级解耦技术，实现高效的大规模推理模型
papers.authors: Tingyun li, Zishang Jiang, Jinyi Han, Xinyi Wang, Sihang Jiang, Han Xia, Zhaoqian Dai, Ma Shuguang, Fei Yu, Jiaqing Liang, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought to achieve strong performance, but applying such reasoning uniformly incurs high computational cost. Existing efficiency-oriented methods attempt to shorten or mix reasoning strategies, yet often degrade reasoning capability. We identify the root cause as sequence-level coupling between efficiency incentives and correctness optimization, which implicitly penalizes long but correct reasoning trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Adaptive Dual-Process Thinking (ADaPT), a token-level dual-process framework that explicitly decouples efficiency and correctness signals during training. ADaPT introduces a mode-selection token to control fast and slow reasoning, applying efficiency-related rewards exclusively to this token to avoid penalizing correct long reasoning while encouraging efficiency when appropriate. Moreover, ADaPT enables precise and continuous control over the efficiency–performance trade-off at inference time: by adjusting the generation probability of the mode-selection token, a single trained model can smoothly move along the efficiency–performance Pareto frontier. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ADaPT significantly reduces inference cost while maintaining strong reasoning performance across multiple benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型依靠长链式的思维过程来实现强大的性能表现，但这种统一的推理方式会带来较高的计算成本。现有的高效方法试图缩短或混合不同的推理策略，但这往往会导致推理能力的下降。我们发现问题的根源在于效率激励与正确性优化之间的序列级耦合，这无形中惩罚了那些虽然长度较长但正确的推理路径。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了自适应双过程思维（ADaPT）这一框架。该框架在训练过程中明确分离了效率和正确性的信号。ADaPT引入了一种模式选择标记，用于控制快速和慢速的推理过程，仅将该标记与与效率相关的奖励相结合，从而避免惩罚正确的长推理过程，同时在适当的情况下促进效率的提升。此外，ADaPT能够在推理时精确且持续地控制效率与性能之间的权衡：通过调整模式选择标记的生成概率，单个训练好的模型可以平滑地沿着效率-性能的帕累托前沿移动。大量的实验表明，ADaPT显著降低了推理成本，同时在多个基准测试中都保持了强大的推理性能。

papers.title: Talk to Your Slides: High-Efficiency Slide Editing via Language-Driven Structured Data Manipulation
papers.title_zh: 与你的幻灯片对话：通过基于语言的结构化数据操作实现高效幻灯片编辑
papers.authors: Kyudan Jung, Hojun Cho, Jooyeol Yun, Soyoung Yang, Jaehyeok Jang, Jaegul Choo
papers.abstract: Editing presentation slides is a frequent yet tedious task, ranging from creative layout design to repetitive text maintenance. While recent GUI-based agents powered by Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) excel at tasks requiring visual perception, such as spatial layout adjustments, they often incur high computational costs and latency when handling structured, text-centric, or batch processing tasks. In this paper, we propose Talk-to-Your-Slides, a high-efficiency slide editing agent that operates via language-driven structured data manipulation rather than relying on the image modality. By leveraging the underlying object model instead of screen pixels, our approach ensures precise content modification while preserving style fidelity, addressing the limitations of OCR-based visual agents. Our system features a hierarchical architecture that effectively bridges high-level user instructions with low-level execution codes. Experiments demonstrate that for text-centric and formatting tasks, our method enables 34% faster processing, achieves 34% better instruction fidelity, and operates at an 87% lower cost compared to GUI-based baselines. Furthermore, we introduce TSBench, a human-verified benchmark dataset comprising 379 instructions, including a Hard subset designed to evaluate robustness against complex and visually dependent queries. Our code and benchmark are available at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1onwp5m7t3207xZu7HEBTMpdivsiOuqG8?usp=share_link
papers.abstract_zh: 编辑演示幻灯片是一项既常见又繁琐的任务，涉及从创意布局设计到重复文本维护等多个环节。虽然基于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的图形用户界面代理在需要视觉感知的任务上表现出色，比如空间布局调整，但在处理结构化、以文本为中心或批量处理任务时，它们往往会产生较高的计算成本和延迟。在本文中，我们提出了“与幻灯片对话”这一高效的幻灯片编辑代理，该代理通过语言驱动的结构化数据操作来工作，而不依赖于图像形式。通过利用底层对象模型而非屏幕像素，我们的方法能够精确修改内容，同时保持风格的一致性，从而弥补了基于OCR的视觉代理的局限性。我们的系统采用分层架构，能够有效地将高级用户指令与低级执行代码连接起来。实验表明，对于以文本为中心和格式化的任务，我们的方法使得处理速度提高了34%，指令的准确性也提升了34%，而且其运行成本比基于GUI的基线方法低87%。此外，我们还引入了TSBench这一经过人类验证的基准数据集，其中包含379条指令，其中有一个难度的子集，用于评估系统对复杂且依赖视觉的查询的鲁棒性。我们的代码和基准数据集可以在https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1onwp5m7t3207xZu7HEBTMpdivsiOuqG8?usp=share_link获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Verifiable Parameterization of Bayesian Networks from Scientific Literature: Unlocking Unstructured Empirical Evidence
papers.title_zh: 从科学文献中可验证的贝叶斯网络参数化：揭示非结构化经验证据的价值
papers.authors: Jonas Gottal, Florian Matthes
papers.abstract: Learning Bayesian Networks typically requires access to raw tabular data to estimate conditional probabilities. However, in many scientific domains, raw data is unavailable due to privacy concerns or general lack of access, while structured statistical summaries are increasingly accessible through large language models and published literature. We propose and evaluate five distinct strategies to reconstruct local conditional probability tables solely from statistical summaries in order to parameterize Bayesian Networks. Our comprehensive evaluation across mixed-type synthetic networks demonstrates that copula-based methods significantly outperform standard baselines, offering a viable path for knowledge integration from heterogeneous sources – unlocking the wealth of published knowledge for causal modeling while ensuring transparency and verifiability.
papers.abstract_zh: 学习贝叶斯网络通常需要访问原始表格数据来估计条件概率。然而，在许多科学领域，由于隐私问题或普遍缺乏访问权限，原始数据无法获取。而通过大语言模型和已发表的文献，可以轻松获得结构化的统计摘要。我们提出了五种不同的策略，仅依靠统计摘要来重建局部条件概率表，从而参数化贝叶斯网络。我们对混合类型合成网络的全面评估表明，基于copula的方法显著优于标准基线方法，为从异构来源整合知识提供了可行途径——能够充分利用已发表的知识进行因果建模，同时确保透明性和可验证性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PRIME: Ultra-Low-Rank Principal–Residual Model Merging
papers.title_zh: PRIME：超低阶主成分-残差模型合并
papers.authors: Seung-Ho Lee, Kyungsu Lee, Bazarvaani Zuchi, Jeongmin Ahn, Insuk Seo, Donghyeon Jeon, Inho Kang, Seung-Hoon Na
papers.abstract: Model merging has emerged as an effective approach for integrating multiple task-specific fine-tuned models into a single unified model without requiring additional data-intensive training. A central challenge in model merging is to reduce task interference while preserving the task-specific capabilities of the original models. In this work, we propose PRIME, an ultra-low-rank principal-residual model merging framework that decomposes task vector merging into two complementary stages. First, ultra-low-rank principal task vector merging retains only a small fraction of singular vectors, effectively reducing task interference while preserving most of the task-specific performance. Second, orthogonal residual task vector merging incorporates the remaining components by projecting them onto the null space of the principal subspace, thereby avoiding interference while recovering additional task-relevant information. Extensive experiments on eight natural language processing tasks demonstrate that PRIME consistently outperforms existing model merging methods, achieving improvements of up to 1.18% on T5 and 1.9% on LLaMA-3.2-3B.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型合并已成为一种有效的技术，它能够在不需额外进行数据密集型训练的情况下，将多个任务特定的微调模型整合到一个统一的模型中。在模型合并过程中，一个核心挑战在于如何在减少任务干扰的同时，保留原始模型的任务特异性能力。在这项研究中，我们提出了PRIME这一超低秩主残差模型合并框架。该框架将任务向量合并过程分为两个互补的阶段：首先，超低秩的主任务向量合并仅保留少量奇异向量，从而有效减少任务干扰，同时保留大部分与任务相关的性能特征；其次，正交残差任务向量合并则通过将剩余成分投影到主子空间的零空间中，从而避免干扰，同时提取出更多与任务相关的信息。在八个自然语言处理任务上的广泛实验表明，PRIME在性能上始终优于现有的模型合并方法，其在T5模型上的提升幅度达到了1.18%，在LLaMA-3.2-3B模型上的提升幅度达到了1.9%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Don’t Tell the Answer, Truly Guide the Reasoning During RL Rollouts
papers.title_zh: 不要直接说出答案，而是在实际推出时引导用户进行思考
papers.authors: Xinyi Wang, Jinyi Han, Zishang Jiang, Tingyun li, Jiaqing Liang, Sihang Jiang, Zhaoqian Dai, Ma Shuguang, Fei Yu, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key approach for improving long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods such as GRPO often break down when task difficulty exceeds the model’s capacity, resulting in sparse rewards and inefficient training. While prior work attempts to address this issue using off-policy data, it frequently introduces distributional mismatch, leading to unstable policy updates.In this work, we identify a fundamental issue underlying these limitations, which we term low training affinity, and propose Affinity, the first quantitative metric for measuring the compatibility between external guidance and a model’s intrinsic policy. Based on this insight, we introduce HINT, an adaptive framework designed to enhance reasoning performance while explicitly preserving high Affinity.HINT consists of two key components. First, instead of providing partial answers, it introduces Meta-Hints, which serve as abstract cognitive scaffolding that guides the model to independently construct solutions. Second, we propose Affinity-Aware Policy Optimization (AAPO), which dynamically adjusts the learning objective based on the Affinity signal to ensure stable training.Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that HINT consistently outperforms strong baselines, while achieving improved training stability and robust generalization to out-of-distribution tasks. Code is available at: https://github.com/ViviqwerAsd/HINT
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的关键方法。然而，现有的方法在任务难度超过模型处理能力时往往会失效，导致奖励稀疏且训练效率低下。虽然之前的研究试图通过使用离策略数据进行解决，但这往往会导致分布不匹配的问题，进而使策略更新变得不稳定。在这项研究中，我们发现了这些限制背后的一个根本问题，即“低训练亲和力”。为此，我们提出了“亲和力”这一量化指标，用于衡量外部指导与模型内在策略之间的兼容性。基于这一洞察，我们引入了HINT这一自适应框架，该框架旨在在保持高亲和力的同时提升推理性能。HINT包含两个关键组成部分：首先，它不再提供部分答案，而是引入“元提示”，这些抽象的认知支架能够引导模型独立构建解决方案；其次，我们提出了“亲和性感知策略优化”技术，该技术根据亲和力信号动态调整学习目标，以确保训练的稳定性。通过在不同基准测试中的广泛实验表明，HINT始终优于其他强大的基线方法，同时实现了更好的训练稳定性和对超出分布任务的稳健泛化能力。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/ViviqwerAsd/HINT
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Mask Tokens as Prophet: Fine-Grained Cache Eviction for Efficient dLLM Inference
papers.title_zh: 将掩码令牌视为预测器：一种高效的细粒度缓存驱逐机制，用于加速dLLM推理过程
papers.authors: Jianuo Huang, Yaojie Zhang, Yicun Yang, Benhao Huang, Linfeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) present a promising alternative to dominant autoregressive models (ARMs) by the ability of parallel decoding at the expense of substantial computation and memory costs. Specifically, the cache mechanism for bidirectional attention in dLLMs demands large memory footprint, restricting their ability to handle long contexts under resource-limited settings. Existing cache eviction strategies are primarily designed for ARMs and fail to account for the role of mask tokens and specific characteristics in dLLMs, resulting in suboptimal performance.To address these challenges, we introduce MaskKV, a training-free cache eviction framework tailored to dLLMs, focusing on the effect of mask tokens in dLLMs. MaskKV is built on two key innovations: (1) a mask-query guided scoring mechanism that leverages attention weights to identify and evict less critical prompt tokens for each head; (2) an adaptive cache budgeting strategy that improves efficiency by reducing allocation in intermediate layers and concentrating resources on prompt-preferring heads. On LLaDA with MaskKV, compressing the KV cache to only 256 pairs (less than 5% of tokens) retains 94% of the full-cache performance on LongBench and achieves up to 31 \times acceleration at 32k prompt length. Our code will be released on Github.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型（dLLMs）通过并行解码的能力，为替代主流的自回归模型（ARMs）提供了有前景的选择，但这一过程伴随着巨大的计算量和内存消耗。具体来说，dLLMs中双向注意力的缓存机制需要大量的内存资源，这限制了它们在资源有限的情况下处理长上下文的能力。现有的缓存淘汰策略主要适用于ARMs，未能考虑到掩码令牌在dLLMs中的重要作用及其特定特性，从而导致性能不佳。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MaskKV——一种专为dLLMs设计的无需训练的缓存淘汰框架，重点研究掩码令牌在dLLMs中的影响。MaskKV基于两项关键创新：(1) 一种以掩码查询为导向的评分机制，利用注意力权重来识别并淘汰那些不太重要的提示令牌；(2) 一种自适应缓存分配策略，通过减少中间层的资源分配，并将资源集中在偏好提示的头部，从而提高效率。在使用MaskKV对LLaDa进行压缩时，将KV缓存缩减到仅256对令牌（占所有令牌的不到5%），仍然能在LongBench上达到全缓存性能的94%，并且在32k提示长度的情况下，性能提升可达31倍。我们的代码将在Github上发布。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
