papers.title: Silencing the Guardrails: Inference-Time Jailbreaking via Dynamic Contextual Representation Ablation
papers.title_zh: 打破限制：通过动态上下文表示消除推理约束机制
papers.authors: Wenpeng Xing, Moran Fang, Guangtai Wang, Changting Lin, Meng Han
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance, they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that circumvent safety constraints. Existing strategies, ranging from heuristic prompt engineering to computationally intensive optimization, often face significant trade-offs between effectiveness and efficiency. In this work, we propose Contextual Representation Ablation (CRA), a novel inference-time intervention framework designed to dynamically silence model guardrails. Predicated on the geometric insight that refusal behaviors are mediated by specific low-rank subspaces within the model’s hidden states, CRA identifies and suppresses these refusal-inducing activation patterns during decoding without requiring expensive parameter updates or training. Empirical evaluation across multiple safety-aligned open-source LLMs demonstrates that CRA significantly outperforms baselines. By revealing that safety constraints can be surgically ablated from internal representations, our findings expose the intrinsic fragility of current alignment mechanisms and underscore the urgent need for more robust latent-space defenses.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型已经取得了显著的性能成就，但它们仍然容易受到规避安全约束的越狱攻击。现有的策略，从启发式的提示设计到计算密集型优化，往往需要在有效性和效率之间做出重大权衡。在这项研究中，我们提出了上下文表示消融技术，这是一种新颖的推理时间干预框架，旨在动态消除模型的约束机制。基于这样一个几何性见解：拒绝行为是由模型隐藏状态中的特定低秩子空间介导的，CRA能够在解码过程中识别并抑制这些导致拒绝的激活模式，而无需进行昂贵的参数更新或训练。通过对多个符合安全要求的开源语言模型进行的实证评估表明，CRA的表现显著优于基线方法。通过揭示安全约束可以从内部表示中被巧妙地消除，我们的研究发现揭示了当前对齐机制的固有脆弱性，并强调了加强潜在空间防御的紧迫性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Diffusion with Truncated Blocks: Fast and High-Quality Text Generation using Truncated Block Generation
papers.title_zh: 截断块扩散算法：通过采用截断块结构实现快速且高质量的文本生成
papers.authors: Yuyan Zhou, Weiyu Chen, James Kwok
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Large Language Models (dLLMs) are emerging as a powerful alternative to traditional autoregressive models. These models learn to generate text by iteratively denoising masked sequences. In this work, we identify a critical problem in dLLMs: the model’s attention is wastefully expended on uninformative mask tokens, diluting its focus on meaningful context. We term this phenomenon “attention dilution”. We further show that this artifact is amplified by token-level noising, whereas models employing sequence-level noise exhibit a reduced effect. To resolve this problem, we introduce Truncated Block Generation, a novel sampling algorithm that not only mitigates attention dilution but also enables faster inference and flexible-length sequence generation. Extensive experiments validate our analysis and demonstrate the marked effectiveness of our proposed method in enhancing both the performance and efficiency of dLLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于扩散的大语言模型（dLLMs）正逐渐成为传统自回归模型的强大替代方案。这些模型通过迭代去噪掩码序列来生成文本。在这项研究中，我们发现dLLMs存在一个关键问题：模型的注意力被浪费在无意义的掩码标记上，从而削弱了模型对有意义上下文的关注。我们将这种现象称为“注意力稀释”。我们还发现，这种现象会在使用令牌级噪声时加剧，而使用序列级噪声的模型则能减轻这一效应。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了截断块生成算法——这是一种新颖的采样方法，它不仅能够减轻注意力稀释的问题，还能提高推理速度并支持灵活长度的序列生成。大量的实验验证了我们的分析，并证明了我们提出的方法在提升dLLMs的性能和效率方面具有显著效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GigaCheck: Detecting LLM-generated Content via Object-Centric Span Localization
papers.title_zh: GigaCheck：通过以对象为中心的范围定位技术来检测由大型语言模型生成的内容
papers.authors: Irina Tolstykh, Aleksandra Tsybina, Sergey Yakubson, Aleksandr Gordeev, Vladimir Dokholyan, Maksim Kuprashevich
papers.abstract: With the increasing quality and spread of LLM assistants, the amount of generated content is growing rapidly. In many cases and tasks, such texts are already indistinguishable from those written by humans, and the quality of generation continues to increase. At the same time, detection methods are advancing more slowly than generation models, making it challenging to prevent misuse of generative AI technologies. We propose GigaCheck, a dual-strategy framework for AI-generated text detection. At the document level, we leverage the representation learning of fine-tuned LLMs to discern authorship with high data efficiency. At the span level, we introduce a novel structural adaptation that treats generated text segments as “objects.” By integrating a DETR-like vision model with linguistic encoders, we achieve precise localization of AI intervals, effectively transferring the robustness of visual object detection to the textual domain. Experimental results across three classification and three localization benchmarks confirm the robustness of our approach. The shared fine-tuned backbone delivers strong accuracy in both scenarios, highlighting the generalization power of the learned embeddings. Moreover, we successfully demonstrate that visual detection architectures like DETR are not limited to pixel space, effectively generalizing to the localization of generated text spans. To ensure reproducibility and foster further research, we publicly release our source code.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型助手的质量和应用范围的不断扩大，生成的内容量也在迅速增加。在许多情况和任务中，这些文本已经难以与人类撰写的文本区分开来，而且生成文本的质量也在不断提高。与此同时，检测方法的进步速度却远远落后于生成模型的进步速度，这就使得防止生成式人工智能技术的滥用变得非常困难。我们提出了GigaCheck这一双策略框架，用于检测人工智能生成的文本。在文档层面，我们利用经过微调的大语言模型的表现来高效识别文本的作者身份。在跨文档层面，我们引入了一种新的结构化处理方法，将生成的文本片段视为“对象”。通过结合类似DETTR的视觉模型和语言编码器，我们能够准确地定位人工智能生成的文本片段，从而将视觉对象检测的鲁棒性有效地应用到文本领域。在三个分类和三个定位基准测试中的实验结果证实了我们的方法具有强大的鲁棒性。共享的微调主干网络在两种情况下都能提供极高的准确率，这充分体现了所学习到的嵌入向量的泛化能力。此外，我们还成功证明了像DETTR这样的视觉检测架构并不局限于像素空间，它们能够有效地推广到生成文本片段的定位任务。为了确保研究的可重复性并促进进一步的研究发展，我们公开了我们的源代码。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Chain-in-Tree: Back to Sequential Reasoning in LLM Tree Search
papers.title_zh: Chain-in-Tree：回到LLM树搜索中的序列推理方法
papers.authors: Xinzhe Li
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling improves large language models (LLMs) on long-horizon reasoning tasks by allocating more compute at inference. LLM inference via tree search (LITS) achieves strong performance but is highly inefficient. We propose Chain-in-Tree (CiT), a plug-in framework that decides when to branch during search instead of expanding at every step. CiT introduces lightweight Branching Necessity (BN) evaluations, including BN-DP (direct prompting) and BN-SC (self-consistency). Integrated into Tree of Thoughts, ReST-MCTS, and RAP, BN-DP reduces token generation, model calls, and runtime by 75-85% on GSM8K and Math500, with often negligible or no accuracy loss. BN-SC typically yields substantial savings (up to 80%) generally but shows instability in 1-4 out of 14 settings, caused by a small subset of examples that produce extremely long reasoning steps. We theoretically prove that BN-DP never increases policy invocations and release unified implementations applicable across LITS frameworks. The full codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/xinzhel/chain_in_tree.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时缩放通过增加推理过程中的计算资源，提升了大语言模型在长视距推理任务上的性能。虽然通过树搜索进行LLM推理能够取得良好的效果，但效率却非常低。我们提出了Chain-in-Tree（CiT）这一插件式框架，该框架能够在搜索过程中决定何时进行分支操作，而不是在每一步都进行扩展。CiT引入了轻量级的Branching Necessity（BN）评估机制，包括BN-DP（直接提示）和BN-SC（自洽性）。将这些机制整合到Tree of Thoughts、ReST-MCTS和RAP中后，BN-DP能够将GSM8K和Math500任务中的令牌生成、模型调用以及运行时间减少75-85%，且通常不会造成精度损失或精度下降。BN-SC通常能带来显著的节省效果（最高可达80%），但在14种设置中有1-4种情况下会出现不稳定现象，这是由于少数示例会导致极长的推理步骤所致。我们从理论上证明了BN-DP永远不会增加策略调用的次数，并且提供了适用于各种树搜索框架的统一实现方式。完整的代码库可以在https://github.com/xinzhel/chain_in_tree上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Addressing Overthinking in Large Vision-Language Models via Gated Perception-Reasoning Optimization
papers.title_zh: 通过门控感知-推理优化技术，解决大型视觉语言模型中的过度思考问题
papers.authors: Xingjian Diao, Zheyuan Liu, Chunhui Zhang, Weiyi Wu, Keyi Kong, Lin Shi, Kaize Ding, Soroush Vosoughi, Jiang Gui
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have exhibited strong reasoning capabilities through chain-of-thought mechanisms that generate step-by-step rationales. However, such slow-thinking approaches often lead to overthinking, where models produce excessively verbose responses even for simple queries, resulting in test-time inefficiency and even degraded accuracy. Prior work has attempted to mitigate this issue via adaptive reasoning strategies, but these methods largely overlook a fundamental bottleneck: visual perception failures. We argue that stable reasoning critically depends on low-level visual grounding, and that reasoning errors often originate from imperfect perception rather than insufficient deliberation. To address this limitation, we propose Gated Perception-Reasoning Optimization (GPRO), a meta-reasoning controller that dynamically routes computation among three decision paths at each generation step: a lightweight fast path, a slow perception path for re-examining visual inputs, and a slow reasoning path for internal self-reflection. To learn this distinction, we derive large-scale failure attribution supervision from approximately 790k samples, using teacher models to distinguish perceptual hallucinations from reasoning errors. We then train the controller with multi-objective reinforcement learning to optimize the trade-off between task accuracy and computational cost under uncertainty. Experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that GPRO substantially improves both accuracy and efficiency, outperforming recent slow-thinking methods while generating significantly shorter responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型通过生成逐步推理过程的思维链机制，展现了强大的推理能力。然而，这种缓慢的推理方式往往会导致过度思考，即使对于简单的查询，模型也会产生过于冗长的回答，从而导致测试过程中的效率低下，甚至准确性下降。之前的研究试图通过自适应推理策略来缓解这一问题，但这些方法大多忽略了另一个根本性的瓶颈：视觉感知的失败。我们认为，稳定的推理在很大程度上依赖于低层次的视觉定位，而推理错误往往源于不完善的感知能力，而非缺乏充分的思考。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了门控感知-推理优化算法，这是一种元推理控制器，能够在每次生成时动态分配计算资源到三条路径上：一条轻量级的快速路径，用于重新评估视觉输入；另一条慢速的感知路径，用于重新审视视觉信息；最后一条慢速的推理路径，用于内部自我反思。为了学习这种区分，我们从约79万样本中提取了大规模的失败归因监督数据，并利用教师模型来区分感知幻觉和推理错误。然后，我们通过多目标强化学习训练该控制器，以在不确定性下优化任务准确性和计算成本之间的平衡。在五个基准测试上的实验表明，GPRO在准确性和效率方面都有显著提升，其表现优于一些现有的慢速推理方法，同时还能生成更短的回答。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CSMCIR: CoT-Enhanced Symmetric Alignment with Memory Bank for Composed Image Retrieval
papers.title_zh: CSMCIR：基于内存库的协同优化对称对齐技术，用于复合图像的检索
papers.authors: Zhipeng Qian, Zihan Liang, Yufei Ma, Ben Chen, Huangyu Dai, Yiwei Ma, Jiayi Ji, Chenyi Lei, Han Li, Xiaoshuai Sun
papers.abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) enables users to search for target images using both a reference image and manipulation text, offering substantial advantages over single-modality retrieval systems. However, existing CIR methods suffer from representation space fragmentation: queries and targets comprise heterogeneous modalities and are processed by distinct encoders, forcing models to bridge misaligned representation spaces only through post-hoc alignment, which fundamentally limits retrieval performance. As evidenced by t-SNE visualization in Fig.(a), this architectural asymmetry manifests as three distinct, well-separated clusters in the feature space, directly demonstrating how heterogeneous modalities create fundamentally misaligned representation spaces from initialization. In this work, we propose CSMCIR, a unified representation framework that achieves efficient query-target alignment through three synergistic components. First, we introduce a Multi-level Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) prompting strategy that guides Multimodal Large Language Models to generate discriminative, semantically compatible captions for target images, establishing modal symmetry. Building upon this, we design a symmetric dual-tower architecture where both query and target sides utilize the identical shared-parameter Q-Former for cross-modal encoding, ensuring consistent feature representations and further reducing the alignment gap. Finally, this architectural symmetry enables an entropy-based, temporally dynamic Memory Bank strategy that provides high-quality negative samples while maintaining consistency with the evolving model state. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that our CSMCIR achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior training efficiency. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each proposed component.
papers.abstract_zh: 复合图像检索（CIR）允许用户结合参考图像和操控文本来搜索目标图像，这比单一模态的检索系统具有显著优势。然而，现有的CIR方法存在表示空间碎片化问题：查询和目标包含不同的模态，并且由不同的编码器处理，这迫使模型只能通过事后对齐来连接不重合的表示空间，从而从根本上限制了检索性能。如图(a)中的t-SNE可视化所示，这种架构上的不对称表现为特征空间中三个明显分离的独立簇，这直接说明了不同模态在初始化时会产生根本不重合的表示空间。在这项研究中，我们提出了CSMCIR这一统一的表示框架，通过三个协同组件实现了高效的查询与目标的对齐。首先，我们引入了多层次思维链提示策略，引导多模态大语言模型为目标图像生成具有语义兼容性的描述性文本，从而实现模态间的对称性。在此基础上，我们设计了一种对称的双塔架构，使得查询端和目标端都使用相同的共享参数Q-Former进行跨模态编码，从而确保特征表示的一致性，并进一步缩小了对齐差距。最后，这种架构上的对称性使得基于熵的、时间动态化的记忆库策略得以实现，该策略能够在保持与模型状态一致性的同时提供高质量的负样本。在四个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的CSMCIR在性能上达到了最先进水平，并且训练效率也更高。全面的消融研究进一步验证了每个提出组件的有效性。

papers.title: RepoDistill: Distilling Repository Knowledge through Compression-Aware Budget Allocation and Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: RepoDistill：通过压缩算法优化资源分配与策略制定，实现存储知识的高效利用
papers.authors: Xin Yin, Zixiang Ding, Yiang Zhang, Qiang Wang, Rui Wang, Chao Ni, Zhe Cui
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on many code-related tasks, yet they still struggle with repository-level scenarios where reasoning depends on long, noisy, and structurally complex contexts. While existing retrieval methods, including both similarity-based and graph-based approaches, can identify relevant code snippets, they often retrieve excessive contexts that intensify the “lost-in-the-middle” phenomenon and dilute model attention with redundant contexts. To address this, we present RepoDistill, a novel framework that integrates retrieval with learned budget allocation for fine-grained context compression. RepoDistill first employs a plug-and-play lightweight GraphRAG to retrieve context that follows logical flows. It then applies Compression-Aware Budget Allocation guided by Compression-Aware Policy Optimization, which formulates context management as a multi-step decision problem and learns allocation policies for contexts. Experiments show that RepoDistill outperforms baselines, achieving gains of up to +7.00 on SWE-QA, +24.4% on CoderEval, and +0.25 on LongCodeU. Furthermore, a compact 4B-parameter model trained with RepoDistill can serve as an effective context compressor for closed-source LLMs, reducing input tokens by up to 66% while maintaining comparable performance. We release our code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RepoDistill-12B0.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在许多与代码相关的任务上取得了出色的性能，但在需要基于长文本、噪声较多且结构复杂的上下文进行推理的场景中，它们仍然存在困难。虽然现有的检索方法，包括基于相似性的方法和基于图的方法，能够识别出相关的代码片段，但这些方法往往会检索出过多的上下文信息，从而加剧“信息冗余”现象，使模型的注意力被不必要的上下文所分散。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了RepoDistill这一创新框架。该框架将检索功能与学习到的预算分配机制相结合，以实现对上下文的精细压缩。RepoDistill首先采用轻量级的GraphRAG来检索符合逻辑流程的上下文信息，然后利用基于压缩感知的策略优化算法进行预算分配，将上下文管理转化为一个多步骤的决策问题，并学习如何合理分配上下文资源。实验表明，RepoDistill在多个基准测试中的表现均优于传统方法，例如在SWE-QA评测中提升了7.00个百分点，在CoderEval评测中提升了24.4%，在LongCodeU评测中提升了0.25个百分点。此外，使用RepoDistill训练出的4B参数模型可以作为闭源语言模型的有效上下文压缩工具，能够将输入令牌数量减少多达66%，同时仍保持相当的性能水平。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RepoDistill-12B0获取。

papers.title: Finding RELIEF: Shaping Reasoning Behavior without Reasoning Supervision via Belief Engineering
papers.title_zh: 寻找救赎：通过信念工程来培养无需推理监督的推理行为
papers.authors: Chak Tou Leong, Dingwei Chen, Heming Xia, Qingyu Yin, Sunbowen Lee, Jian Wang, Wenjie Li
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success through step-by-step chains of thought, yet they often suffer from excessive redundancy or unfaithful reasoning. Existing methods for shaping LRM behavior typically rely on reinforcement learning or fine-tuning with gold-standard reasoning traces, a paradigm that is both computationally expensive and difficult to scale. In this paper, we reveal that LRMs possess latent reasoning beliefs that internally track their own reasoning traits, which can be captured through simple logit probing without specialized training. Building on this insight, we propose Reasoning Belief Engineering (RELIEF), a simple yet effective framework that shapes LRM behavior by aligning the model’s self-concept with a target belief blueprint. Crucially, RELIEF completely bypasses the need for reasoning-trace supervision. It internalizes desired traits by fine-tuning on synthesized, self-reflective QA pairs that affirm the target belief. Extensive experiments on efficiency and faithfulness tasks demonstrate that RELIEF matches or outperforms behavior-supervised and preference-based baselines while requiring significantly lower training costs. Our analysis further validates that shifting a model’s reasoning belief effectively shapes its actual behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在逐步推理的过程中取得了显著的成功，然而它们往往存在过度冗余或推理不准确的问题。现有的用于调整大型推理模型行为的手段通常依赖于强化学习或使用标准推理轨迹进行微调，这种方法的计算成本很高且难以扩展。在本文中，我们揭示了大型推理模型具有潜在的推理信念，这些信念能够内在地反映模型的推理特性。通过简单的逻辑斯蒂探测即可捕捉到这些信念，而无需专门的训练。基于这一发现，我们提出了“推理信念工程”框架，该框架通过将模型的自我概念与目标信念蓝图对齐来有效调整大型推理模型的行为。重要的是，该框架完全不需要依赖推理轨迹的监督。它通过针对合成的自反思问答对进行微调来实现所需特性的内化。在效率和准确性方面的广泛实验表明，与基于行为监督和基于偏好的基线方法相比，RELIEF框架表现相当甚至更好，同时所需的训练成本也显著降低。我们的分析进一步验证了，改变模型的推理信念能够有效影响其实际行为。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Bridging SFT and RL: Dynamic Policy Optimization for Robust Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 连接SFT与RL：用于稳健推理的动态策略优化
papers.authors: Taojie Zhu, Dongyang Xu, Ding Zou, Sen Zhao, Qiaobo Hao, Zhiguo Yang, Yonghong He
papers.abstract: Post-training paradigms for Large Language Models (LLMs), primarily Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), face a fundamental dilemma: SFT provides stability (low variance) but suffers from high fitting bias, while RL enables exploration (low bias) but grapples with high gradient variance. Existing unified optimization strategies often employ naive loss weighting, overlooking the statistical conflict between these distinct gradient signals. In this paper, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis of this bias-variance trade-off and propose DYPO (Dynamic Policy Optimization), a unified framework designed to structurally mitigate this conflict. DYPO integrates three core components: (1) a Group Alignment Loss (GAL) that leverages intrinsic group dynamics to significantly reduce RL gradient variance; (2) a Multi-Teacher Distillation mechanism that corrects SFT fitting bias via diverse reasoning paths; and (3) a Dynamic Exploitation-Exploration Gating mechanism that adaptively arbitrates between stable SFT and exploratory RL based on reward feedback. Theoretical analysis confirms that DYPO linearly reduces fitting bias and minimizes overall variance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DYPO significantly outperforms traditional sequential pipelines, achieving an average improvement of 4.8% on complex reasoning benchmarks and 13.3% on out-of-distribution tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在训练后的应用方式，主要包括监督式微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL），它们面临着一个根本性的难题：监督式微调能够提供稳定性（低方差），但存在较高的拟合偏差；而强化学习则能够实现探索性学习（低偏差），但却面临高梯度方差的问题。现有的统一优化策略往往采用简单的损失加权方法，却忽视了这些不同的梯度信号之间的统计冲突。在本文中，我们对这种偏差-方差权衡进行了严格的理论分析，并提出了DYPO这一统一框架。DYPO整合了三个核心组件：（1）群体对齐损失，该损失利用群体内在的动态特性来显著减少强化学习的梯度方差；（2）多教师蒸馏机制，通过多种推理路径来纠正监督式微型的拟合偏差；（3）动态利用-探索性控制机制，根据奖励反馈自适应地平衡稳定化的监督式微调与探索性的强化学习。理论分析表明，DYPO能够线性降低拟合偏差，并最小化整体方差。大量实验表明，DYPO在复杂推理任务上的表现明显优于传统的方法，在复杂推理基准测试中的平均性能提升达到了4.8%，在超出分布范围的任务上则提升了13.3%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FrontCoder: Scaling Visual Fidelity in Front-End Code Generation
papers.title_zh: FrontCoder：在前端代码生成中提升视觉清晰度
papers.authors: Jun Feng, Jian Yang, Wei Zhang, Jing Wang, Keyi Chen, Xiaokun Yang, Weicheng Gu, Yihang Lou, Yan Bai, Xianglong Liu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) for code generation have achieved remarkable progress in synthesizing functional code from natural language instructions. However, a critical challenge persists in generating visually accurate and structurally sound front-end code that faithfully renders user-intended layouts and interfaces. Most existing works focus primarily on functional correctness, overlooking the visual fidelity and rendering quality essential for front-end development. To address this gap, we present a comprehensive data construction and training pipeline to enhance front-end code generation capabilities in code LLMs. We use a three-stage training approach: continual pre-training on synthetic data, quality-controlled supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with checklist-based rewards to improve model performance. Our comprehensive evaluation on front-end code generation benchmarks reveals that even strong base models struggle with visual faithfulness and layout complexity. Our fully-trained model demonstrated substantial improvements over baseline approaches across all domains, achieving competitive performance with frontier models while maintaining generation efficiency, underscoring the critical importance of stage-aligned data curation and vision-grounded optimization in developing reliable front-end code generation systems. Our code and data are open-sourced at https://github.com/leanfeng1/FrontCoder.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于代码生成的大语言模型在从自然语言指令合成功能代码方面取得了显著进展。然而，在生成视觉上准确且结构合理的前端代码方面仍然存在重大挑战，因为这些代码需要忠实再现用户预期的布局和界面。目前大多数研究主要集中在功能正确性上，而忽视了前端开发中至关重要的视觉逼真度和渲染质量。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种全面的数据构建和训练流程，以提升代码语言模型的前端代码生成能力。我们采用三阶段训练方法：对合成数据进行持续预训练、进行质量控制下的监督微调，以及利用基于检查表的奖励进行强化学习，以提高模型性能。我们在前端代码生成基准测试中的综合评估表明，即使是强大的基础模型在视觉逼真度和布局复杂性方面也存在不足。我们的全训练模型在所有领域中都取得了显著改进，与前沿模型相比，其性能具有竞争力，同时保持了高效的生成效率，这充分说明了在开发可靠的前端代码生成系统时，分阶段整理数据和基于视觉优化的优化策略的重要性。我们的代码和数据已开源，可以在https://github.com/leanfeng1/FrontCoder下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Bridging Cognition and Affect: Emotion-Aware Opinion Summarization using LLMs
papers.title_zh: 连接认知与情感：利用大型语言模型进行情绪感知的观点总结
papers.authors: Arnav Attri, Anuj Attri
papers.abstract: Opinion summarization systems aggregate customer sentiments without capturing the emotional factors that drive purchasing decisions, resulting in shallow summaries that overlook the affective dimensions shaping customer experiences and fail to explain why customers feel the way they do. This gap exists because prior research has neglected the interplay between expressed opinions and their underlying emotional contexts. To bridge this gap, we introduce Emotion-Aware Opinion Summarization (EAOS), a framework leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to integrate emotional dimensions into opinion summaries, moving beyond conventional sentiment polarity. To support this task, we develop a large-scale (40K product–summary pairs) training dataset, an evaluation benchmark, a compact 1B-parameter model that matches 70B-scale performance via knowledge distillation, and methods for generating and evaluating emotion-aware summaries. A user study shows that 82% of readers prefer our emotion-aware summaries (p < .001), confirming that adding emotion helps in making purchase decisions.
papers.abstract_zh: 意见总结系统能够汇总客户的情绪感受，但并未考虑到影响购买决策的情感因素。因此，这些总结往往过于表面化，忽视了塑造客户体验的情感层面，也无法解释客户为何会有这样的感受。这种差距的存在是因为先前的研究忽略了表达出的意见与其背后的情感背景之间的相互作用。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了“情感感知意见总结”框架。该框架利用大语言模型将情感因素融入意见总结中，超越了传统的情感极性分析。为了支持这一研究，我们构建了一个大规模的训练数据集（包含4万对产品与总结的关联数据），制定了评估基准，开发了一个参数仅为10亿的模型，该模型通过知识蒸馏达到了700亿参数的性能水平。此外，我们还提出了生成和评估情感感知总结的方法。用户调查显示，82%的读者更喜欢我们的情感感知总结（p<0.001），这证实了加入情感因素有助于做出更明智的购买决策。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Double Bind: Revisiting Preprinting and Peer Review Two Years After the Removal of the ACL Anonymity Period
papers.title_zh: 双重约束：在取消预印本匿名化规定两年后重新思考预印化和同行评审机制
papers.authors: A Pranav, Shane Storks, Anne Lauscher
papers.abstract: ACL removed the anonymity period for conference submissions in February 2024, allowing unrestricted preprinting during review.To examine how preprints and author recognition affect outcomes across institutional hierarchies, we track preprinting trends for 47k publications, survey 75 NLP researchers, interview 14 community members, and analyze 1.9k peer reviews. We observe that more elite institutions post preprints more frequently (52% vs. 36% by 2025). Most participants agree that preprinting gives these institutions an advantage in peer review, and indeed, reviewer knowledge of authors inflates scores at elite institutions (d = 0.43, p < 0.001) but not elsewhere, also lowering review quality. Nonetheless, the anonymity period was found largely ineffective; instead, underrepresented researchers emphasize struggles with visibility, review quality, and external structural barriers. To counteract these inequities, we make recommendations for review quality improvement and increasing investment in diversity initiatives that center the perspectives of affected communities.
papers.abstract_zh: 自2024年2月起，ACL取消了会议投稿的匿名期，允许在评审过程中进行无限制的预发表。为了研究预发表和作者识别对不同机构间成果的影响，我们跟踪了47,000篇出版物的预发表趋势，调查了75位自然语言处理领域的研究人员，采访了14位社区成员，并分析了1,900次同行评审。我们发现，更多精英机构更频繁地发布预发表（到2025年这一比例分别为52%和36%）。大多数参与者认为，预发表为这些机构带来了在同行评审中的优势。实际上，在精英机构中，评审者对作者的了解确实提升了评分（d = 0.43，p < 0.001），但在其他机构则没有这种效果，反而降低了评审质量。不过，匿名期基本上无效；相反，那些代表性不足的研究人员强调他们在可见性、评审质量以及外部结构障碍方面面临的困难。为了消除这些不平等现象，我们提出了一些建议，以改善评审质量，并增加在多样性倡议方面的投入，从而更好地反映受影响群体的观点。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TinyAlign: Boosting Lightweight Vision-Language Models by Mitigating Modal Alignment Bottlenecks
papers.title_zh: TinyAlign：通过缓解模式对齐中的瓶颈问题，提升轻量级视觉语言模型的性能
papers.authors: Yuanze Hu, Xinyu Wang, Zhichao Yang, Gen Li, Ye Qiu, Zhaoxin Fan, Yifan Sun, Wenjun wu, Jin Dong, Xiaotie Deng
papers.abstract: Lightweight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are indispensable for resource-constrained applications. The prevailing approach to aligning vision and language models involves freezing both the vision encoder and the language model while training small connector modules. However, this strategy heavily depends on the intrinsic capabilities of the language model, which can be suboptimal for lightweight models with limited representational capacity. In this work, we investigate this alignment bottleneck through the lens of mutual information, positing that the constrained capacity of the language model inherently limits the Effective Mutual Information (EMI) between multimodal inputs and outputs, thereby compromising alignment quality. To address this challenge, we propose TinyAlign, a novel framework inspired by Retrieval-Augmented Generation, which strategically retrieves relevant context from a memory bank constructed from training data to enrich multimodal inputs and enhance their alignment. Extensive empirical evaluations reveal that TinyAlign significantly reduces training loss, accelerates convergence, and enhances task performance with negligible computational overhead. Remarkably, it allows models to achieve baseline-level performance with only 40% of the fine-tuning data, highlighting exceptional data efficiency. Our work thus offers a practical pathway for developing more capable lightweight VLMs while introducing a fresh theoretical lens to better understand and address alignment bottlenecks in constrained multimodal systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 轻量级视觉-语言模型在资源有限的应用中不可或缺。目前，对齐视觉模型和语言模型的方法通常是冻结视觉编码器和语言模型，同时训练小型连接模块。然而，这种策略严重依赖于语言模型的固有能力，对于具有有限表示能力的轻量级模型来说可能并不理想。在这项研究中，我们通过互信息这一视角来探讨这种对齐瓶颈问题，认为语言模型的有限容量本质上限制了多模态输入与输出之间的有效互信息，从而影响了对齐质量。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了TinyAlign这一基于检索增强生成技术的新型框架。该框架从训练数据中构建的记忆库中提取相关上下文信息，以丰富多模态输入并提升其对齐效果。广泛的实验表明，TinyAlign能够显著减少训练损失，加快收敛速度，并提高任务性能，同时几乎不增加计算开销。值得注意的是，该框架允许模型仅使用40%的微调数据就能达到基线水平的性能，充分体现了其极高的数据利用效率。因此，我们的研究为开发更强大的轻量级视觉-语言模型提供了实用途径，同时也为理解并解决受限多模态系统中的对齐瓶颈问题提供了全新的理论视角。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Heterogeneity in Formal Linguistic Competence of Language Models: Is Data the Real Bottleneck?
papers.title_zh: 语言模型在形式语言能力方面的差异性：数据真的是真正的瓶颈吗？
papers.authors: H S V N S Kowndinya Renduchintala, Sumit Bhatia
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit a puzzling disparity in their formal linguistic competence: while they learn some linguistic phenomena with near-perfect mastery, they often perform below chance on others, even after training on trillions of tokens. In this work, we investigate whether these failures stem from inherent architectural limitations or simply the scarcity of these specific grammatical constructions in web-scale corpora. We pre-train simple GPT-2 Small (124M) models on a 100M-token random sample of the FineWeb corpus and intervene by injecting a minimal amount (1%) of synthetic data targeting specific linguistic phenomena. We find that this targeted intervention substantially improves model performance in 8 out of the 9 worst-performing BLiMP paradigms – notably the accuracy on a specific paradigm, only_npi_scope, surges from 20.9% to 69.4%. Furthermore, we observe that these interventions generally preserve or slightly improve aggregate performance. However, while we also identify a resistant phenomenon, principle_A_c_command, whose performance remains below chance even after our data augmentation, our findings do serve as an optimistic existence proof that even small language models can substantially improve on those linguistic phenomena on which models typically perform poorly, provided the pre-training data contains sufficient exposure to them. This suggests that efforts towards human-scale language modeling may benefit greatly by focusing on data composition. The code to reproduce our results is open-sourced at https://github.com/kowndinya-renduchintala/heterogeneity-in-formal-linguistic-competence.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在形式语言能力方面表现出令人困惑的不均衡现象：虽然它们能够近乎完美地掌握某些语言现象，但在其他语言现象上的表现却往往低于随机水平，即便经过对数万亿个样本的训练。在这项研究中，我们探讨了这些失败现象是由于模型本身的架构限制，还是因为网络规模语料库中对这些特定语法结构的匮乏。我们先用1 亿个词元对简单的GPT-2 Small（1.24亿参数）模型进行了预训练，然后在此基础上加入少量（1%）合成数据来针对特定的语言现象进行干预。结果发现，这种有针对性的干预显著提升了模型在9种表现最差的BLiMP范式中的8种的表现——尤其是某个特定范式的准确率从20.9%提升到了69.4%。此外，我们还观察到，这些干预措施通常能够保持或略微改善模型的整体性能。不过，尽管我们发现了一个顽固的现象——principle_A_c_command，即使经过数据增强处理后，该现象的准确率仍然低于随机水平。但我们的研究结果仍然表明，即使是小型语言模型，只要其预训练数据中包含足够的相关样本，也有很大的潜力去改进那些模型通常表现不佳的语言现象。这表明，通过专注于数据组合，人类规模的语言建模工作可能会取得更大的成效。我们用于验证结果的代码已开源，地址为https://github.com/kowndinya-renduchintala/heterogeneity-in-formal-linguistic-competence。

papers.title: Real Men are Tough: Evaluating Gender Bias and Sensitivity to Masculinity Norms in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 真正的男人都是坚强不屈的：评估大型语言模型中存在的性别偏见以及对男性特质的标准化评价
papers.authors: Elisa Leonardelli, Camilla Casula, Boglarka Nyul, Sara Tonelli
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are known to exhibit gender bias, yet most evaluations focus on downstream stereotypes rather than the normative frameworks that shape model inference. We investigate whether LLMs rely on traditional masculinity norms (e.g. “real men are tough”) as latent priors in gender-biased inference. We ground our evaluation in the Male Role Norms Inventory (MRNI), a validated psychological framework of prescriptive male role norms.Anchored in MRNI items, we probe models using two complementary approaches: (i) explicit Likert-style agreement with masculinity norms, and (ii) a newly crafted English-Italian scenario-based inference dataset (MRNI-BB), in which gender information and evidential support are systematically varied. Across models, explicit endorsement of masculinity norms is generally low. In contrast, in scenario-based inference tasks, models systematically attribute MRNI-aligned behaviors to male agents, even when evidence is ambiguous or absent. This effect disappears when gender markers are removed, suggesting that masculinity norms are treated as gender-specific expectations about male agents. Increasing model scale reduces explicit norm endorsement but is associated with stronger male-directed bias under uncertainty.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）被认为存在性别偏见，但大多数评估都集中在下游的刻板印象上，而忽略了塑造模型推理行为的规范框架。我们研究了LLM是否将传统的男性气质规范（例如“真正的男人很坚强”）作为性别偏见的潜在先验来进行推理。我们的评估基于《男性角色规范清单》（MRNI），这是一个经过验证的、包含规范性男性角色规范的心理学框架。我们以MRNI中的条目为基础，采用两种互补的方法对模型进行评估：(i) 明确遵循男性气质规范的Likert式评分；(ii) 新构建的英语-意大利语情景推理数据集（MRNI-BB），在该数据集中，性别信息和证据支持被系统地变化。总体而言，模型对男性气质规范的明确认可程度较低。然而，在基于情景的推理任务中，模型会系统性地将符合MRNI的行为归因于男性角色，即使证据模糊或缺失也是如此。当去除性别标记后，这种效应消失，这表明男性气质规范被视为关于男性角色的特定性别期望。随着模型规模的增加，对规范的直接认可程度降低，但在不确定性条件下，模型表现出更强的以男性为中心的偏见。

papers.title: RISER: Orchestrating Latent Reasoning Skills for Adaptive Activation Steering
papers.title_zh: RISER：引导潜在推理能力以实现自适应激活控制
papers.authors: Wencheng Ye, Xiaoyang Yuan, Yi Bin, Hengyu Jin, Liang Peng, Pengpeng Zeng, Heng Tao Shen
papers.abstract: Recent work on domain-specific reasoning with large language models (LLMs) has largely relied on training-intensive approaches that require updating model parameters. Although activation steering has emerged as a parameter-efficient alternative, existing methods typically rely on static and manually designed interventions, limiting their ability to adapt to the dynamic nature of complex reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose RISER (Router-based Intervention for Steerable Enhancement of Reasoning), a plug-and-play intervention framework that adaptively steers LLM reasoning in activation space. RISER builds a library of reusable reasoning vectors and employs a lightweight Router to dynamically compose these vectors for each input. The Router is optimized via reinforcement learning under task-level rewards, enabling the emergent and compositional activation of latent cognitive primitives. Across seven diverse benchmarks, RISER achieves average zero-shot accuracy improvements of 3.4–6.5% over the base model, while outperforming chain-of-thought-style reasoning with 2–3× higher token efficiency and robust accuracy gains. Further analysis demonstrates that RISER autonomously combines multiple vectors into interpretable and precise control strategies, pointing toward more controllable and efficient LLM reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近关于利用大语言模型进行领域特定推理的研究，大多依赖于需要大量训练的时间密集型方法，这些方法需要不断更新模型参数。虽然激活引导作为一种参数高效的替代方案已经出现，但现有方法通常依赖于静态且手动设计的干预措施，这限制了它们适应复杂推理动态特性的能力。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了RISER——一种基于路由器的干预框架，它能够自适应地调整语言模型的推理过程。RISER构建了一个可重复使用的推理向量库，并采用轻量级路由器来动态组合这些向量以适应每个输入场景。该路由器通过任务级奖励下的强化学习进行优化，从而实现潜在认知原语的自主和组合式激活。在七个不同的基准测试中，RISER在零样本准确率方面比基础模型提高了3.4%到6.5%，同时其token效率提升了2到3倍，且准确率也有显著提升。进一步分析表明，RISER能够自动将多个向量组合成可解释且精确的控制策略，从而实现了更可控且高效的语言模型推理。

papers.title: ReCoT-NER: Enhancing Zero-Shot Named Entity Recognition through Chain-of-Thought Prompting and Recall-Oriented Loss Optimization
papers.title_zh: ReCoT-NER：通过思维链提示和召回率优化的手段提升零样本命名实体识别能力
papers.authors: Dabin Fu, Fanghong Zhang
papers.abstract: Named Entity Recognition (NER) plays a fundamental role in information extraction and domain knowledge construction. However, in specialized domains such as wind power fault diagnosis, the scarcity of labeled data makes supervised approaches impractical. Zero-shot NER provides a promising alternative but still struggles with incomplete entity detection and unstable generation boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose ReCoT-NER, a reasoning-enhanced generative framework that integrates Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and recall-oriented loss optimization. The proposed CoT instruction design explicitly decomposes NER into two reasoning stages: entity span detection and entity type classification. This enables the model to follow a structured inference process. In addition, we introduce a recall-oriented loss function that reweights entity and non-entity tokens to mitigate false negatives, encouraging more inclusive entity coverage. Experiments on CrossNER, MIT, and a newly constructed wind-power NER dataset demonstrate that ReCoT-NER consistently improves recall and overall F1 performance across both general and industrial domains. Notably, ReCoT-NER achieves competitive results with just a 77M-parameter model, making it well-suited for low-resource zero-shot settings. The code for our method is publicly available at https://github.com/10637409100/RECOTNER.
papers.abstract_zh: 命名实体识别（NER）在信息提取和领域知识构建中起着至关重要的作用。然而，在诸如风电故障诊断这样的专业领域中，由于标注数据的稀缺性，基于监督的方法变得不切实际。零样本NER提供了一个有前景的替代方案，但仍然存在实体检测不完整以及生成边界不稳定等问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ReCoT-NER这一基于推理增强的生成框架，该框架结合了思维链提示和以召回率为导向的损失函数优化策略。所提出的思维链指令设计将NER任务分解为两个推理阶段：实体范围检测和实体类型分类。这使得模型能够遵循一种结构化的推理过程。此外，我们还引入了一种以召回率为导向的损失函数，通过重新调整实体与非实体标记的权重来减少假阴性情况，从而提升实体的覆盖能力。在CrossNER、MIT以及新构建的风电NER数据集上的实验表明，ReCoT-NER在一般领域和工业领域都能持续提高召回率和整体F1分数。值得注意的是，ReCoT-NER仅使用7700万参数的模型就能取得令人满意的效果，因此非常适合低资源条件下的零样本任务。我们的方法代码可在此处公开获取：https://github.com/10637409100/RECOTNER。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SyncThink: A Training-Free Strategy to Align Inference Termination with Reasoning Saturation
papers.title_zh: SyncThink：一种使推理终止与推理饱和状态对齐的免训练策略
papers.authors: Gengyang Li, Wang Cai, Yifeng Gao, Yunfang Wu
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves reasoning but often produces long and redundant traces that substantially increase inference cost. We present SyncThink, a training-free and plug-and-play decoding method that reduces CoT overhead without modifying model weights. We find that answer tokens attend weakly to early reasoning and focus on ‘</think>‘, indicating an information bottleneck.Building on this observation, SyncThink monitors the model’s own reasoning-transition signal and terminates reasoning. Experiments on GSM8K, MMLU, GPQA, and BBH across three DeepSeek-R1 distilled models show that SyncThink achieves 62.00% average Top@1 accuracy using 656 generated tokens and 28.68s latency, compared to 61.22%, 2141 tokens, and 92.01s for full CoT decoding. On long-horizon tasks such as GPQA, SyncThink can further yield up to +8.1 absolute accuracy by preventing over-thinking.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链提示能够提升推理能力，但往往会产生冗长且重复的信息路径，这大大增加了推理的复杂度。我们提出了SyncThink这一无需训练即可使用的解码方法，该方法无需修改模型权重就能降低思维链处理的开销。我们发现，答案标记对早期推理的关注程度较低，主要集中于“”这一信息节点上，这暗示了存在信息瓶颈的问题。基于这一观察，SyncThink能够监控模型自身的推理-转换信号，并终止不必要的推理过程。在GSM8K、MMLU、GPQA和BBH等多个任务上的实验表明，使用SyncThink时，平均Top@1准确率达到了62.00%，同时延迟仅为28.68秒；而采用完整的思维链解码方式时，准确率仅为61.22%，延迟则达到了92.01秒。在如GPQA这样的长期任务中，SyncThink还能通过避免过度思考，使准确率提高约8.1个百分点。

papers.title: Reason in Chains, Learn in Trees: Self-Rectification and Grafting for Multi-turn Agent Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: 《连锁的理性，树状的学习：多轮代理策略优化中的自我修正与嫁接方法》
papers.authors: Yu Li, Sizhe Tang, Tian Lan
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for Large Language Model agents is often hindered by sparse rewards in multi-step reasoning tasks. Existing approaches like Group Relative Policy Optimization treat sampled trajectories as independent chains, assigning uniform credit to all steps in each chain and ignoring the existence of critical steps that may disproportionally impact reasoning outcome. In this paper, we propose T-STAR(Tree-structured Self-Taught Agent Rectification), a framework that recovers the latent correlated reward structure across seemingly independent trajectories. Specifically, we consolidate trajectories into a unified Cognitive Tree by identifying and merging functionally similar steps/nodes. It enables an Introspective Valuation mechanism that back-propagates trajectory-level rewards through the tree to obtain a new notion of variance-reduced relative advantage at step-level. Using the Cognitive Tree, we also develop In-Context Thought Grafting to synthesize corrective reasoning by contrasting successful and failed branches at critical divergence points/steps. Our proposed Surgical Policy Optimization then capitalizes on the rich policy gradient information concentrated at these critical points/steps through a Bradley-Terry type of surgical loss. Extensive experiments across embodied, interactive, reasoning, and planning benchmarks demonstrate that T-STAR achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines, with gains most pronounced on tasks requiring extended reasoning chains.
papers.abstract_zh: 在多步骤推理任务中，强化学习用于大语言模型代理时，常常受到稀疏奖励的阻碍。现有的方法如“群体相对策略优化”将采样到的轨迹视为独立的链条，给每个链条中的每一步都分配相同的权重，而忽略了那些可能对推理结果产生重大影响的关键步骤。在本文中，我们提出了T-STAR框架，该框架能够恢复看似独立的轨迹之间的潜在相关奖励结构。具体来说，我们通过识别和合并功能上相似的步骤/节点，将轨迹整合成一个统一的认知树。这一机制还实现了一种内省式评估机制，通过树状结构反向传播轨迹级别的奖励，从而在步骤级别上获得一种新的、降低方差的相对优势概念。利用认知树，我们还开发了“上下文思维嫁接”技术，通过在关键分歧点/步骤处对比成功与失败的路径，来合成正确的推理结果。我们提出的“手术式策略优化”方法则充分利用了这些关键点/步骤处丰富的策略梯度信息，通过类似Bradley-Terry的手术式损失函数来优化策略。通过广泛的实验验证，T-STAR在涉及多步骤推理的任务中取得了显著的改进效果，尤其是在需要长时间推理的任务中，其优势更为明显。

papers.title: FlashMem: Distilling Intrinsic Latent Memory via Computation Reuse
papers.title_zh: FlashMem：通过计算复用来提取内在潜在记忆
papers.authors: Yubo Hou, Zhisheng Chen, Tao Wan, Zengchang Qin
papers.abstract: The stateless architecture of Large Language Models inherently lacks the mechanism to preserve dynamic context, compelling agents to redundantly reprocess history to maintain long-horizon autonomy. While latent memory offers a solution, current approaches are hindered by architectural segregation, relying on auxiliary encoders that decouple memory from the reasoning backbone. We propose FlashMem, a framework that distills intrinsic memory directly from transient reasoning states via computation reuse. Leveraging the property that internal representations uniquely encode input trajectories, FlashMem identifies the last hidden state as a sufficient statistic for the interaction history. This enables a Shared-KV Consolidator to synthesize memory by attending directly to the backbone’s frozen cache, eliminating redundant re-parameterization. Furthermore, a parameter-free Cognitive Monitor leverages attention entropy to adaptively trigger consolidation only when high epistemic uncertainty is detected. Experiments demonstrate that FlashMem matches the performance of heavy baselines while reducing inference latency by 5 times, effectively bridging the gap between efficiency and persistent cognition.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的无状态架构本质上缺乏保存动态上下文的机制，这迫使智能体需要重复处理历史数据以保持长期自主性。虽然潜在记忆提供了一种解决方案，但当前的方法受到架构分割的限制，因为它们依赖辅助编码器来将记忆与推理主干分离开来。我们提出了FlashMem框架，该框架通过计算复用直接从瞬态推理状态中提取内在记忆。利用内部表示能够唯一编码输入轨迹的特性，FlashMem将最后一个隐藏状态视为交互历史的充分统计量。这使得共享KV整合器能够直接关注于主干的冻结缓存，从而消除冗余的重参数化过程。此外，一个无需参数的认知监控器利用注意力熵来自适应地触发整合操作，仅在检测到高认知不确定性时才会进行整合。实验表明，FlashMem在性能上达到了较成熟基线的水平，同时将推理延迟降低了5倍，有效地实现了效率与持久认知之间的平衡。

papers.title: QueueEDIT: Structural Self-Correction for Sequential Model Editing in LLMs
papers.title_zh: QueueEDIT：用于大型语言模型中序列模型编辑的结构性自我修正机制
papers.authors: Taolin Zhang, Haidong Kang, Dongyang Li, Qizhou Chen, Xiaofeng He, Chengyu Wang, Richang Hong
papers.abstract: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance but still suffer from hallucinations. Model editing has been proposed as a means to correct factual inaccuracies. A challenging scenario is sequential model editing (SME), which aims to rectify errors continuously, rather than a one-time task. During SME, the general capabilities of LLMs can be negatively affected due to the introduction of new parameters. In this paper, we propose a queue-based self-correction framework, QueueEDIT, that not only enhances SME performance by addressing long-sequence dependencies but also mitigates the impact of parameter bias on the general capabilities of LLMs. Specifically, we first introduce a structural mapping editing loss to map editing triplets to knowledge-sensitive neurons within the Transformer layers. We then store the located parameters for each piece of edited knowledge in a queue and dynamically align previously edited parameters. At each edit, we select parameters in the queue that are most relevant to currently located parameters to determine whether knowledge associated with previous edits requires realignment. Irrelevant parameters in the queue are frozen, and we update the parameters at the queue head into the LLM to ensure they do not harm general capabilities. Experiments show that QueueEDIT significantly outperforms strong baselines across various SME settings, while maintaining competitive performance in single-turn editing. Resulting LLMs also preserve high performance on general NLP tasks throughout the SME process.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，大语言模型在性能上表现出色，但仍然存在幻觉问题。模型编辑被提出作为一种纠正事实错误的方法。其中，序列模型编辑是一个具有挑战性的任务，它旨在持续地修正错误，而不是一次性完成。在序列模型编辑过程中，由于引入了新的参数，大语言模型的整体性能可能会受到负面影响。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于队列的自校正框架——QueueEDIT。该框架不仅通过处理长序列依赖关系来提高序列模型编辑的性能，还能减轻参数偏差对大语言模型整体性能的影响。具体来说，我们首先引入了结构映射编辑损失，将编辑三元组映射到Transformer层内的知识敏感神经元。然后，我们将每部分编辑后的知识对应的参数存储在队列中，并动态调整之前已编辑过的参数。在每次编辑时，我们会从队列中选择与当前定位的参数最相关的参数，以确定是否与之前的编辑内容需要重新调整。队列中不相关的参数会被冻结，同时我们会将队列头部的参数更新到大语言模型中，以确保它们不会损害模型的整体性能。实验表明，QueueEDIT在各种序列模型编辑场景中均表现出显著优于其他强基线方法的性能，同时在单轮编辑任务中也保持了竞争力。经过序列模型编辑处理的大语言模型在一般自然语言处理任务上的性能依然很高。

papers.title: CAGenMol: Condition-Aware Diffusion Language Model for Goal-Directed Molecular Generation
papers.title_zh: CAGenMol：一种基于条件感知的扩散语言模型，用于目标导向的分子生成
papers.authors: Yanting Li, Zhuoyang Jiang, Enyan Dai, Lei Wang, Wen-Cai Ye, Li Liu
papers.abstract: Goal-directed molecular generation requires satisfying heterogeneous constraints such as protein–ligand compatibility and multi-objective drug-like properties, yet existing methods often optimize these constraints in isolation, failing to reconcile conflicting objectives (e.g., affinity vs. safety), and struggle to navigate the non-differentiable chemical space without compromising structural validity. To address these challenges, we propose CAGenMol, a condition-aware discrete diffusion framework over molecular sequences that formulates molecular design as conditional denoising guided by heterogeneous structural and property signals. By coupling discrete diffusion with reinforcement learning, the model aligns the generation trajectory with non-differentiable objectives while preserving chemical validity and diversity. The non-autoregressive nature of diffusion language model further enables iterative refinement of molecular fragments at inference time. Experiments on structure-conditioned, property-conditioned, and dual-conditioned benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods in binding affinity, drug-likeness, and success rate, highlighting the effectiveness of our framework. The code is available at https://github.com/Lee612-1/CAGenMol.
papers.abstract_zh: 目标导向的分子生成需要同时满足各种复杂的约束条件，例如蛋白质与配体的兼容性以及具有药物特性的多目标属性。然而，现有的方法往往只单独优化这些约束条件，无法同时解决相互冲突的目标问题（例如亲和力与安全性的平衡）。此外，这些方法在探索不可微化学空间时常常难以兼顾结构的有效性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了CAGenMol这一基于条件感知的离散扩散框架。该框架将分子设计过程视为一种基于异构结构和性质信号的条件去噪过程。通过将离散扩散与强化学习相结合，模型能够使得生成的分子结构符合不可微目标的要求，同时保持良好的化学有效性和多样性。由于扩散语言模型的非自回归特性，使得在推理过程中可以不断对分子片段进行优化。在基于结构条件、性质条件和双重条件的基准测试中的实验结果表明，我们的方法在结合亲和力、药物特性及成功率方面均优于现有方法，充分体现了我们框架的有效性。代码可访问于https://github.com/Lee612-1/CAGenMol。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MAC-Reasoner: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Enhancing Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MAC-Reasoner：一种多智能体协作框架，旨在提升大型语言模型的逻辑推理能力
papers.authors: Yehua Lin, Liping Zheng, Yin Chen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) face challenges in logical reasoning where correctness requires strict deductive procedures. Purely model-based approaches often suffer from hallucinations, while neuro-symbolic methods typically delegate deduction to external solvers, reducing the LLM to a mere translator. To address this, we propose MAC-Reasoner, a multi-agent framework that constructs a Logic-Augmented Context to enhance LLMs’ reasoning. In this framework, a translator agent converts problems into executable symbolic programs. Symbolic information from solver execution is transformed into the Logic-Augmented Context, serving as a verification reference where logical conflicts trigger heightened attention to violated constraints. We evaluate MAC-Reasoner with three backbone LLMs on four challenging benchmarks. Results show consistent and robust improvements over baselines. Furthermore, reasoning traces from MAC-Reasoner can be used for supervised fine-tuning of LLMs to achieve more accurate and efficient logical reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在逻辑推理方面面临挑战，因为正确性要求严格的演绎程序。单纯基于模型的方法常常会出现幻觉问题，而神经符号方法则通常将推理任务委托给外部求解器，从而将语言模型简化为单纯的翻译工具。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了MAC-Reasoner这一多智能体框架，该框架构建了一个逻辑增强的上下文环境，以提升语言模型的推理能力。在这个框架中，翻译代理将问题转化为可执行的符号程序。来自求解器执行过程中的符号信息被转换为逻辑增强的上下文环境，作为验证依据，当出现逻辑冲突时，系统会更加关注那些被违反的约束条件。我们在四个具有挑战性的基准测试中对MAC-Reasoner与三种主流语言模型进行了评估。结果表明，与基线模型相比，MAC-Reasoner在推理能力上取得了稳定且显著的提升。此外，MAC-Reasoner的推理记录还可以用于语言模型的监督式微调，从而实现更准确、高效的逻辑推理。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Once Correct, Still Wrong: Counterfactual Hallucination in Multilingual Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 一旦正确，仍然错误：多语言视觉-语言模型中的事后幻觉现象
papers.authors: Basel Mousi, Fahim Dalvi, Shammur Absar Chowdhury, Firoj Alam, Nadir Durrani
papers.abstract: Vision–language models (VLMs) can achieve high accuracy while still accepting culturally plausible but visually incorrect interpretations. Existing hallucination benchmarks rarely test this failure mode, particularly outside Western contexts and English. We introduce M^2CQA, a culturally grounded multimodal benchmark built from images spanning 17 MENA countries, paired with contrastive true and counterfactual statements in English, Arabic, and its dialects. To isolate hallucination beyond raw accuracy, we propose the CounterFactual Hallucination Rate (CFHR), which measures counterfactual acceptance conditioned on correctly answering the true statement. Evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs under multiple prompting strategies, we find that CFHR rises sharply in Arabic, especially in dialects, even when true-statement accuracy remains high.Moreover, reasoning-first prompting consistently increases counterfactual hallucination, while answering before justifying improves robustness. We make the dataset publicly available for the community (https://huggingface.co/datasets/QCRI/M2CQA)).
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型能够在仍然接受文化上合理但视觉上不正确的解释的情况下实现高准确性。现有的幻觉基准测试很少针对这种错误模式进行验证，尤其是在西方文化和英语环境之外的情况。我们提出了M^2CQA这一基于文化的多模态基准测试，该测试使用来自17个中东和北非国家的图像，并配以英语、阿拉伯语及其方言中的对比性真实陈述和反事实陈述。为了进一步区分幻觉与单纯的准确性问题，我们提出了反事实幻觉率这一概念，它衡量了在正确回答真实陈述条件下的反事实接受程度。通过评估在不同提示策略下的最新视觉-语言模型，我们发现反事实幻觉率在阿拉伯语环境中显著上升，尤其是在不同方言中，即使真实陈述的准确性仍然很高。此外，先进行推理的提示能够持续增加反事实幻觉的发生概率，而先回答后进行论证则能提升模型的鲁棒性。我们将该数据集公开提供给社区使用（https://huggingface.co/datasets/QCRI/M2CQA）。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: DIFFA-2: A Practical Diffusion Large Language Model for General Audio Understanding
papers.title_zh: DIFFA-2：一种适用于一般音频理解的实用扩散式大型语言模型
papers.authors: Jiaming Zhou, Xuxin Cheng, Shiwan Zhao, Yuhang Jia, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai, Yong Qin
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) large audio language models (LALMs) such as Qwen-2.5-Omni have achieved strong performance on audio understanding and interaction, but scaling them remains costly in data and computation, and strictly sequential decoding limits inference efficiency. Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently been shown to make effective use of limited training data, and prior work on DIFFA indicates that replacing an AR backbone with a diffusion counterpart can substantially improve audio understanding under matched settings, albeit at a proof-of-concept scale without large-scale instruction tuning, preference alignment, or practical decoding schemes. We introduce DIFFA-2, a practical diffusion-based LALM for general audio understanding. DIFFA-2 upgrades the speech encoder, employs dual semantic and acoustic adapters, and is trained with a four-stage curriculum that combines semantic and acoustic alignment, large-scale supervised fine-tuning, and variance-reduced preference optimization, using only fully open-source corpora. Experiments on MMSU, MMAU, and MMAR show that DIFFA-2 consistently improves over DIFFA and is competitive to strong AR LALMs under practical training budgets, supporting diffusion-based modeling is a viable backbone for large-scale audio understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 自回归（AR）型大型音频语言模型，如Qwen-2.5-Omni，在音频理解和交互方面取得了出色的性能。然而，这类模型的扩展在数据和计算资源上成本较高，而且严格的顺序解码方式限制了推理效率。最近的研究表明，扩散型大语言模型能够有效利用有限的训练数据。先前关于DIFFA的研究表明，用扩散模型替代AR模型可以在匹配条件下显著改善音频理解能力，不过这种改进仅限于概念验证阶段，缺乏大规模的教学调整、偏好对齐或实用的解码方案。我们提出了DIFFA-2，这是一种适用于一般音频理解的实用型基于扩散模型的LALM。DIFFA-2升级了语音编码器，采用了双语义和声学适配器，并通过四阶段训练流程进行训练，该流程结合了语义和声学对齐、大规模监督微调以及方差降低的偏好优化技术，且所有训练过程都完全采用开源数据集。在MMSU、MMAU和MMAR上的实验表明，DIFFA-2在性能上始终优于DIFFA，并且在实际训练预算范围内能够与强大的AR LALM相竞争。由此可见，基于扩散模型的建模方法是一种可行的解决方案，适用于大规模音频理解任务。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Marginal Distributions: A Framework to Evaluate the Representativeness of Demographic-Aligned LLMs
papers.title_zh: 超越边缘分布：一种评估与人口统计特征相匹配的大语言模型代表性能力的框架
papers.authors: Tristan Williams, Franziska Weeber, Sebastian Padó, Alan Akbik
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to represent human opinions, values, or beliefs, and their steerability towards these ideals is an active area of research. Existing work focuses predominantly on aligning marginal response distributions, treating each alignment evaluation example independently. While essential, this may overlook deeper latent structures that characterise real populations and underpin cultural values theories. We propose a framework for evaluating the representativeness of aligned models through multivariate correlation patterns in addition to marginal distributions. We show the value of our evaluation scheme by comparing two model steering techniques (persona prompting and demographic fine-tuning) and evaluating them against human responses from the World Values Survey. While the demographic fine-tuned model better approximates marginal response distributions, persona prompting performs marginally better at reproducing the empirical correlation structure between survey items. Despite this reversal, neither technique aligns with human correlation patterns. We conclude that representativeness is a distinct aspect of value alignment and an evaluation focused on marginals can mask structural failures, leading to overly optimistic conclusions about model representativeness.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于表达人类的观点、价值观或信念，而它们对这些理想目标的适应性则是一个活跃的研究领域。现有的研究主要集中在对齐边际响应分布上，即独立处理每个对齐评估样本。虽然这种方法很重要，但它可能会忽略那些刻画真实人群特征并支撑文化价值观理论的更深层次潜在结构。我们提出了一种框架，通过多元相关性模式来评估对齐模型的代表性，而不仅仅是边际分布。我们通过比较两种模型引导技术（人物提示和人口统计微调）并将其与人类在世界价值观调查中的反应进行对比，从而证明了我们的评估方案的价值。尽管经过人口统计微调的模型更能近似边际响应分布，但人物提示在再现调查项目之间的经验性相关结构方面表现更好。即便如此，这两种技术都没有与人类的关联模式保持一致。我们得出结论：代表性是价值对齐的一个独立方面，而仅关注边际分布的评估可能会掩盖结构性缺陷，从而导致对模型代表性的结论过于乐观。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CORES: Code-Oriented Reasoning for Complex Text-to-SQL and Generalizable TableQA
papers.title_zh: CORES：面向代码的复杂文本转SQL推理技术，以及可泛化的表查询问答方法
papers.authors: Meng Zhang, Ruochun Jin, Yuanxi Peng, Wenjing Yang, Haotian Wang, Liting Sun, Kun Hu, Silin Yang, Zhang Ke-di
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL aims to bridge the gap between human intent and relational databases. While LLMs have shown proficiency in generating simple SQL queries, they struggle with complex analytical tasks. Moreover, models fine-tuned on SQL generation often suffer from catastrophic forgetting, which lose the versatility of procedural reasoning and pertaining to generation constraints. Inspired by the usage of high-resource programming languages as LLM reasoning intermediaries, we propose CORES model, which leverages Python as a procedural reasoning pivot to enhance both complex SQL generation and tabular reasoning. It decomposes complex queries into Python reasoning traces before generating the final SQL, which bridges the gap between procedural reasoning and declarative expression. In order to internalize this reasoning capability, we fine-tune LLMs via GRPO with tailored process reward functions that mitigate the sparse feedback problem. We experimentally verify the effectiveness of CORES on six text-to-SQL benchmarks, where ours outperforms baselines by 6.44% on average, while maintains good capability on three tableQA benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本转SQL旨在弥合人类意图与关系数据库之间的差距。虽然大语言模型在生成简单SQL查询方面表现出色，但在复杂的分析任务上却存在困难。此外，那些针对SQL生成进行优化的模型常常会出现灾难性遗忘问题，从而丧失程序化推理的能力以及处理生成约束的能力。受助于使用高资源编程语言作为大语言模型推理中介的启发，我们提出了CORES模型。该模型利用Python作为程序化推理的媒介，从而提升复杂SQL生成和表格推理的能力。它在生成最终SQL之前，会将复杂的查询分解为Python推理路径，从而实现了程序化推理与声明式表达之间的桥梁。为了内化这种推理能力，我们通过GRPO方法对大语言模型进行微调，并采用定制化的过程奖励函数来减轻稀疏反馈问题。我们在六个文本转SQL基准测试中对CORES的有效性进行了实验验证，结果显示，我们的模型平均比基线模型高出6.44%，同时在三个表格问答基准测试中也展现出了良好的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Do Not Guess, Verify: Logic-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Multimodal Misinformation Detection
papers.title_zh: 不要猜测，要核实：基于逻辑引导的适应性推理，用于多模态误信息的识别
papers.authors: Kun Huang, Rui Qiu, Xiaoming Li, Salah Uddin
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Large Vision–language Models (VLMs) suggest their potential for multimodal misinformation detection. However, existing multimodal misinformation detectors often fail to effectively integrate them, relying instead on passive aggregation of multimodal features and social signals. Such correlation-driven paradigms are vulnerable to spurious associations and multimodal noise, and lack explicit verification mechanisms. In this paper, we propose Logic-Guided Adaptive Reasoning (LoGAR), a verification-oriented framework that integrates VLMs into multimodal misinformation detection through explicit rationale-guided reasoning. LoGAR leverages a VLM to generate an explicit verification rationale, which serves as a global semantic anchor to condition the entire reasoning process. Concretely, the rationale functions as an active query to guide multimodal feature fusion and as a conditioning signal to modulate message passing over heterogeneous social graphs, enabling hypothesis-aware evidence aggregation. Furthermore, LoGAR introduces an instance-aware adaptive depth mechanism that dynamically determines the required reasoning depth. Experimental results on multiple multimodal misinformation benchmarks demonstrate that LoGAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods while significantly reducing computational cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型的最新进展表明，它们在多模态虚假信息检测方面具有巨大潜力。然而，现有的多模态虚假信息检测器往往无法有效整合这些模型，而是依赖于对多模态特征和社交信号的被动聚合。这种以相关性为驱动的检测方法容易受到错误关联和多模态噪声的影响，且缺乏明确的验证机制。在本文中，我们提出了逻辑引导的适应性推理框架LoGAR，该框架通过明确的理性引导推理，将大型视觉-语言模型整合到多模态虚假信息检测中。LoGAR利用大型视觉-语言模型生成明确的验证理由，作为整个推理过程的全局语义锚点。具体来说，这些理由既可以作为主动查询来指导多模态特征的融合，也可以作为条件信号来调节跨异构社交网络的消息传递，从而实现基于假设的证据聚合。此外，LoGAR还引入了一种实例感知的自适应深度机制，能够动态确定所需的推理深度。在多个多模态虚假信息基准测试上的实验结果表明，LoGAR在性能上始终优于现有方法，同时显著降低了计算成本。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Hi-ZFO: Hierarchical Zeroth- and First-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Importance-Guided Tensor Selection
papers.title_zh: Hi-ZFO：通过重要性引导的张量选择来实现层级化的零阶和一阶大语言模型微调
papers.authors: Feihu Jin, Ying Tan
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) using standard first-order (FO) optimization oftendrives training toward sharp, poorly generalizing minima. Conversely, zeroth-order (ZO) methods offer stronger exploratory behaviorwithout relying on explicit gradients, yet suffer from slow convergence. More critically, our analysis reveals that in generative tasks, the vast output and search space significantly amplify estimation variance, rendering ZO methods both noisy and inefficient. To address these challenges, we propose Hi-ZFO (Hierarchical Zeroth- and First-Order optimization), a hybrid framework designed to synergize the precision of FO gradients with the exploratory capability of ZO estimation. Hi-ZFO adaptively partitions the model through layer-wise importance profiling, applying precise FO updates to critical layers while leveraging ZO optimization for less sensitive ones. Notably, ZO in Hi-ZFO is not merely a memory-saving surrogate; it is intentionally introduced as a source of “beneficial stochasticity” to help the model escape the local minima where pure FO optimization tends to stagnate. Validated across diverse generative, mathematical, and code reasoning tasks, Hi-ZFO consistently achieves superior performance while significantly reducing the training time. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of hierarchical hybrid optimization for LLM fine-tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 使用标准的一阶优化方法来微调大语言模型，通常会导致训练过程趋向于尖锐但泛化能力较差的局部最小值。相反，零阶方法能够在不依赖显式梯度的前提下提供更强的探索能力，但收敛速度较慢。更关键的是，我们的分析表明，在生成任务中，庞大的输出和搜索空间会显著放大估计误差，使得零阶方法既存在噪声问题，又效率低下。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Hi-ZFO（分层零阶和一阶优化）这一混合框架。该框架旨在将一阶梯度的精确性与零阶优化的探索能力相结合。Hi-ZFO通过逐层分析模型的 중요성을自适应地分配模型权重，对关键层施加精确的一阶优化更新，而对不太重要的层则采用零阶优化。值得注意的是，Hi-ZFO中的零阶优化不仅仅是一种节省内存的替代方案；它被有意设计为“有益的随机性”来源，帮助模型摆脱一阶优化容易陷入的局部最小值。在多种生成任务、数学计算和代码推理场景中进行了验证，Hi-ZFO始终能够取得更好的性能，同时显著缩短训练时间。这些结果证明了分层混合优化在大语言模型微调中的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MCP-Guard: A Multi-Stage Defense-in-Depth Framework for Securing Model Context Protocol in Agentic AI
papers.title_zh: MCP-Guard：一种多层次深度防御框架，用于保护智能体人工智能中的模型上下文协议安全
papers.authors: Wenpeng Xing, Zhonghao Qi, Yupeng Qin, Yilin Li, Caini Chang, Jiahui Yu, Changting Lin, Zhenzhen Xie, Meng Han
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance, they remain vulnerable to jailbreak. The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) with external tools via protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) introduces critical security vulnerabilities, including prompt injection, data exfiltration, and other threats. To counter these challenges, we propose MCP-Guard, a robust, layered defense architecture designed for LLM–tool interactions. MCP-Guard employs a three-stage detection pipeline that balances efficiency with accuracy: it progresses from lightweight static scanning for overt threats and a deep neural detector for semantic attacks, to our fine-tuned E5-based model achieves 96.01% accuracy in identifying adversarial prompts. Finally, an LLM arbitrator synthesizes these signals to deliver the final decision. To enable rigorous training and evaluation, we introduce MCP-AttackBench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 70,448 samples augmented by GPT-4. This benchmark simulates diverse real-world attack vectors that circumvent conventional defenses in the MCP paradigm, thereby laying a solid foundation for future research on securing LLM-tool ecosystems.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型（LLM）已经取得了显著的性能成就，但它们仍然容易受到攻击。通过模型上下文协议等协议将大语言模型与外部工具集成，会引入严重的安全漏洞，包括提示注入、数据窃取以及其他威胁。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MCP-Guard，这是一种针对LLM与工具交互设计的强大分层防御架构。MCP-Guard采用三阶段检测流程，既保证了效率，又确保了准确性：首先进行轻量级的静态扫描以发现明显的威胁，然后使用深度神经网络检测器来识别语义攻击；我们的基于E5的微调模型在识别恶意提示方面达到了96.01%的准确率。最后，LLM仲裁器会对这些信号进行综合分析，以做出最终决策。为了进行严格的训练和评估，我们开发了MCP-AttackBench，这是一个包含70,448个样本的综合性基准测试，这些样本由GPT-4进行了增强。该基准测试模拟了多种现实世界中的攻击手段，这些攻击手段能够突破MCP范式中的传统防御机制，从而为未来研究如何保障LLM与工具生态系统的安全奠定了坚实的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Half-S: Halving the Scale for Near-Lossless 4-Bit LLM Training
papers.title_zh: 半规模：将4位LLM的训练规模缩小一半，以实现近乎无损的训练效果
papers.authors: Jinyang Du, Ruihao Gong, Linghan Ai, Zining Wang, Yunke Peng, Yao Wang, Lei Yan, Wxuefei, Yaoyuan Wang, Jinyang Guo, Dahua Lin, Xianglong Liu
papers.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) at 4-bit precision offers substantial efficiency gains but remains challenging due to the limited dynamic range and coarse numerical resolution. Existing 4-bit training pipelines typically rely on max-scaling, which is ill-suited for heavy-tailed LLM tensor distributions and leads to severe under-utilization of the FP4 quantization grid in the low-magnitude region. This effect causes pronounced representation collapse and large rounding errors for the values that dominate LLM computation. In this work, we derive the theoretically optimal scaling for FP4 under heavy-tailed inputs, revealing why max-scaling is intrinsically suboptimal. Guided by this analysis, we propose Half-S, a simple and efficient scaling strategy that uses half-scaling as a hardware-friendly default and falls back to an MSE-based clipping threshold when needed, yielding a close approximation to the theoretical optimum under real LLM statistics. Extensive experiments on large-scale pretraining and downstream fine-tuning show that Half-S consistently narrows the gap to BF16 in both convergence and final model quality, while preserving the efficiency benefits of 4-bit computation. Under native FP4 support, Half-S is estimated to provide up to 1.8\times end-to-end training speedup. These results indicate that Half-S provides a simple and effective correction to max-scaling, substantially improving the stability and accuracy of 4-bit LLM training.
papers.abstract_zh: 在4位精度下进行大语言模型（LLM）的训练能够显著提升效率，但由于动态范围有限以及数值分辨率较低，这一过程仍然具有挑战性。现有的4位训练流程通常依赖于最大扩展策略，而该策略并不适合处理尾部较重的LLM张量分布，导致在低幅度区域FP4量化网格被严重浪费。这种效应会导致表示方式的显著崩溃，以及对主导LLM计算的数值产生较大的舍入误差。在这项研究中，我们推导出了在尾部较重输入条件下FP4理论上的最优扩展策略，从而揭示了为什么最大扩展策略本质上是不理想的。基于这一分析，我们提出了Half-S策略——一种简单高效的扩展方法。该策略以半扩展作为硬件友好的默认方案，并在必要时采用基于MSE的裁剪阈值来优化模型质量，从而在真实LLM统计条件下接近理论最优解。在大规模预训练和下游微调方面的广泛实验表明，Half-S策略在收敛速度和最终模型质量方面都能稳定缩小与BF16相比的差距，同时保留了4位计算方式的效率优势。在支持原生FP4的情况下，Half-S估计可提供高达1.8倍的端到端训练加速效果。这些结果表明，Half-S策略为最大扩展策略提供了一种简单有效的改进方案，显著提升了4位LLM训练的稳定性和准确性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: F-Actor: Controllable Conversational Behavior in Full-Duplex Models
papers.title_zh: F-演员：在全双工模型中可控制的对话行为
papers.authors: Maike Züfle, Ondrej Klejch, Nicholas Sanders, Jan Niehues, Alexandra Birch, Tsz Kin Lam
papers.abstract: Spoken conversational systems require more than accurate speech generation to have human-like conversations: to feel natural and engaging, they must produce conversational behaviour that adapts dynamically to the context. Current spoken conversational systems, however, rarely allow such customization, limiting their naturalness and usability. In this work, we present the first open, instruction-following full-duplex conversational speech model that can be trained efficiently under typical academic resource constraints. By keeping the audio encoder frozen and finetuning only the language model, our model requires just 2,000 hours of data, without relying on large-scale pretraining or multi-stage optimization. The model can follow explicit instructions to control speaker voice, conversation topic, conversational behaviour (e.g., backchanneling and interruptions), and dialogue initiation. We propose a single-stage training protocol and systematically analyze design choices. Both the model and training code is released to enable reproducible research on controllable full-duplex speech systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 口语对话系统要实现类似人类的对话，仅仅准确的语音生成是不够的：为了让人感觉自然且引人入胜，系统还需要能够动态适应不同上下文的对话行为。然而，目前的口语对话系统很少允许这种个性化设置，这限制了系统的自然性和可用性。在这项研究中，我们提出了第一个开放的、可遵循指令的全双工对话语音模型，该模型可以在典型的学术资源限制下高效训练得到。通过固定音频编码器，只对语言模型进行微调，我们的模型仅需要2000小时的数据即可训练完成，而无需依赖大规模预训练或多阶段优化。该模型能够按照明确的指令来控制说话者的声音、对话主题、对话行为（如反馈机制和处理中断情况），以及对话的发起方式。我们提出了一种单阶段训练方案，并对设计选择进行了系统分析。模型和训练代码都已公开，以便人们能够开展关于可控全双工语音系统的可重复研究。

papers.title: APEX: Learning Adaptive Priorities for Multi-Objective Alignment in Vision-Language Generation
papers.title_zh: APEX：在视觉与语言交互中实现多目标对齐的自适应优先级设定方法
papers.authors: Dongliang Chen, Xinlin Zhuang, Junjie Xu, Luojian Xie, Zehui Wang, Jiaxi Zhuang, Haolin Yang, Liang Dou, Xiao He, Xingjiao Wu, Ying Qian
papers.abstract: Multi-objective alignment for text-to-image generation is commonly implemented via static linear scalarization, but fixed weights often fail under heterogeneous rewards, leading to optimization imbalance where models overfit high-variance, high-responsiveness objectives (e.g., OCR) while under-optimizing perceptual goals. We identify two mechanistic causes: variance hijacking, where reward dispersion induces implicit reweighting that dominates the normalized training signal, and gradient conflicts, where competing objectives produce opposing update directions and trigger seesaw-like oscillations. We propose APEX (Adaptive Priority-based Efficient X-objective Alignment), which stabilizes heterogeneous rewards with Dual-Stage Adaptive Normalization and dynamically schedules objectives via \mathcal{P}^3 Adaptive Priorities that combine learning potential, conflict penalty, and progress need. On Stable Diffusion 3.5, APEX achieves improved Pareto trade-offs across four heterogeneous objectives, with balanced gains of +1.31 PickScore, +0.35 DeQA, and +0.53 Aesthetics while maintaining competitive OCR accuracy, mitigating the instability of multi-objective alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 在文本到图像生成的多目标对齐中，通常采用静态线性标量化方法。然而，固定权重的方式往往无法应对不同类别的奖励情况，从而导致优化失衡的问题。模型会过度拟合那些高方差、高响应性的目标（例如OCR任务），而忽略了感知方面的目标。我们发现了两个导致这种问题的机制性原因：一是奖励的分散性会导致隐式的权重重新分配，从而主导了归一化的训练信号；二是不同目标之间的冲突，使得它们的更新方向相互对立，引发类似跷跷板的振荡现象。为此，我们提出了APEX算法（自适应优先级高效X目标对齐算法）。该算法通过双阶段自适应归一化技术来稳定不同类别的奖励，并通过\mathcal{P}^3自适应优先级机制来动态安排各个目标的优先级，该机制结合了学习潜力、冲突惩罚以及进度需求等因素。在Stable Diffusion 3.5版本上，APEX算法能够在四个不同目标之间实现更好的帕累托权衡，取得了+1.31 PickScore、+0.35 DeQA和+0.53美学得分的提升，同时还能保持较高的OCR识别精度，有效缓解了多目标对齐带来的不稳定性问题。

papers.title: DART: Mitigating Harm Drift in Difference-Aware LLMs via Distill-Audit-Repair Training
papers.title_zh: DART：通过Distill-Audit-Repair训练方法减轻基于差异感知的大语言模型中的伤害漂移问题
papers.authors: Ziwen Pan, Zihan Liang, Jad Kabbara, Ali Emami
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) tuned for safety often avoid acknowledging demographic differences, even when such acknowledgment is factually correct (e.g., ancestry-based disease incidence) or contextually justified (e.g., religious hiring preferences). This identity-blindness yields incorrect responses, unnecessary refusals, or generic “equal-treatment” defaults. We study this via difference-awareness classification: given a question involving demographic groups, the task is not to answer directly, but to classify whether a correct answer requires recognizing group differences (YES) or whether groups should be treated identically (NO). Crucially, fine-tuning for accuracy triggers harm drift: model-generated explanations become increasingly harmful as decision accuracy improves, whether by elaborating harmful content, introducing problematic assumptions, or failing to flag harms the baseline identified. To mitigate this, we introduce DART (Distill–Audit–Repair Training), which distills label-conditioned reasoning from a teacher, audits outputs for harm drift cases relative to baseline, and repairs problematic cases via severity-weighted fine-tuning. On eight benchmarks, DART improves Llama-3-8B-Instruct accuracy from 39.0% to 68.8%, with largest gains on equal-treatment prompts (11.3% → 72.6%), while reducing harm drift cases by 72.6%. It also transfers to 280 open-ended real-world queries across medical, legal, policy, and educational domains, improving difference-appropriate responses from 39.8% to 77.5% while reducing refusals from 34.3% to 3.0%. Our results demonstrate that accuracy and safety need not conflict when explicit detection and repair mechanisms are in place.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对安全性调整的大语言模型往往避免承认人口统计差异，即使这种承认在事实上是正确的（例如，基于血统的疾病发病率），或者在上下文上是有合理依据的（例如，基于宗教的招聘偏好）。这种无视身份的做法会导致错误的回答、不必要的拒绝，或者采用通用的“平等对待”默认策略。我们通过差异感知分类来研究这个问题：给定一个涉及人口统计群体的问题，任务不是直接回答，而是判断正确答案是否需要识别群体差异（是），还是应该对各个群体一视同仁（否）。重要的是，为了追求准确性而进行的微调会引发危害倾向：随着决策准确性的提高，模型生成的解释会变得越来越有害，无论是通过阐述有害内容、引入有问题的假设，还是未能指出基线模型已识别的危害。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了DART（蒸馏-审计-修复训练）方法。该方法从教师那里提取与标签相关的推理逻辑，对输出结果进行危害倾向分析，并根据严重程度进行微调以修复问题案例。在八个基准测试上，DART将Llama-3-8B-Instruct模型的准确率从39.0%提升到了68.8%，其中在关于平等对待的问题上的提升最为显著（从11.3%提升到72.6%），同时减少了72.6%的危害倾向案例。此外，该方法还适用于医疗、法律、政策和教育领域中的280个开放式现实世界问题，使得符合差异要求的回答比例从39.8%提升到了77.5%，同时将拒绝率从34.3%降至3.0%。我们的结果表明，当存在明确的检测和修复机制时，准确性和安全性是可以兼得的。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Experience-Driven Reflective Co-Evolution of Prompts and Heuristics for Autonomous Algorithm Design
papers.title_zh: 基于经验的提示与启发式方法的协同进化，用于自主算法设计
papers.authors: Yihong Liu, Junyi Li, Hongyu Lu, Xin Zhao, Ji-Rong Wen
papers.abstract: Combinatorial optimization has long been dominated by manually engineered heuristics, a paradigm requiring substantial expert intuition and implementation overhead. The advent of Large Language Models has disrupted this landscape, enabling the autonomous synthesis and optimization of algorithms. Recent approaches typically iterate on heuristic populations using LLMs as mutators; however, these strategies often suffer from limited exploration, leading to stagnation in local optima. To overcome this, we present the Experience-Driven Reflective Co-Evolution of Prompt and Heuristics (EvoPH) for autonomous algorithm design, a novel framework that couples an island migration model with elite selection to maintain population diversity. Uniquely, EvoPH co-evolves both the guiding prompts and the heuristics themselves, using a feedback loop driven by past experience to refine the search process. We demonstrate EvoPH’s efficacy on the Traveling Salesman and Bin Packing Problems. Our results show that EvoPH achieves superior accuracy compared to baselines, marking a significant step forward in LLM-aided algorithm design.
papers.abstract_zh: 组合优化领域长期以来一直由人工设计的启发式算法主导，这种方法需要大量的专家直觉和实施成本。大语言模型的出现打破了这一局面，使得算法的自主合成与优化成为可能。目前的方法通常是通过使用LLM作为变异器来迭代启发式种群；然而，这些策略往往存在探索范围有限的问题，从而导致局部最优解的停滞。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“经验驱动的反向协同进化启发式与提示设计”的方法（EvoPH），这是一种新颖的框架，它将岛屿迁移模型与精英选择相结合，以维护种群的多样性。独特之处在于，EvoPH同时协同进化指导性提示和启发式算法本身，通过基于过往经验的反馈循环来优化搜索过程。我们在旅行商问题和装箱问题上验证了EvoPH的有效性。我们的结果表明，EvoPH在准确性方面优于传统方法，这标志着在LLM辅助算法设计领域取得了重要进展。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Information Representation Fairness in Long-Document Embeddings: The Peculiar Interaction of Positional and Language Bias
papers.title_zh: 长文档嵌入中的信息表示公平性：位置偏见与语言偏见的复杂相互作用
papers.authors: Elias Schuhmacher, Andrianos Michail, Juri Opitz, Rico Sennrich, Simon Clematide
papers.abstract: To be discoverable in an embedding-based search process, each part of a document should be reflected in its embedding representation. To quantify any potential reflection biases, we introduce a permutation-based evaluation framework. With this, we observe that state-of-the-art embedding models exhibit systematic positional and language biases when documents are longer and consist of multiple segments. Specifically, early segments and segments in higher-resource languages like English are over-represented, while later segments and segments in lower-resource languages are marginalized. In our further analysis, we find that the positional bias stems from front-loaded attention distributions in pooling-token embeddings, where early tokens receive more attention. To mitigate this issue, we introduce an inference-time attention calibration method that redistributes attention more evenly across document positions, increasing discoverabiltiy of later segments. Our evaluation framework and attention calibration is available at https://github.com/impresso/fair-sentence-transformers
papers.abstract_zh: 为了在基于嵌入的搜索过程中实现可发现性，文档的每一部分都应该在其嵌入表示中得到体现。为了量化任何潜在的表示偏差，我们引入了一种基于排列的评估框架。通过这种框架，我们发现，当文档较长且包含多个段落时，最先进的嵌入模型会表现出系统性的位置和语言偏差。具体来说，早期段落以及英语这类资源较多的语言的段落被过度代表，而后期段落以及资源较少语言的段落则被边缘化。在进一步的分析中，我们发现这种位置偏差源于池化词嵌入中的前置注意力分布，即早期词汇单元获得的注意力更多。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种在推理时刻进行注意力校准的方法，该方法能够更均匀地分配注意力到文档的各个位置，从而提高后期段落的可发现性。我们的评估框架和注意力校准方法可以在https://github.com/impresso/fair-sentence-transformers上找到。

papers.title: RA-RRG: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Radiology Report Generation with Key Phrase Extraction
papers.title_zh: RA-RRG：基于多模态检索的放射学报告生成技术，包含关键短语提取功能
papers.authors: Jonggwon Park, Byungmu Yoon, Soobum Kim, Kyoyun Choi
papers.abstract: Automated radiology report generation (RRG) holds potential to reduce the workload of radiologists, and recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled multimodal chest X-ray (CXR) report generation. However, existing MLLMs are computationally expensive, require large-scale training data, and may produce hallucinated content, limiting their practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose RA-RRG, a retrieval-augmented RRG framework that combines multimodal retrieval with large language models (LLMs) to generate radiology reports while reducing hallucinations and computational demands. RA-RRG uses LLMs to extract clinically essential key phrases from radiology reports and retrieves relevant phrases given an input image. By conditioning LLMs on the retrieved phrases, RA-RRG effectively suppresses hallucinations while maintaining strong report generation performance. Experiments on the MIMIC-CXR and IU X-ray datasets show state-of-the-art results on CheXbert metrics and competitive RadGraph F1 scores compared to MLLMs. Furthermore, RA-RRG naturally generalizes to multi-view RRG by aggregating phrases retrieved from multiple images, highlighting its broad applicability to real-world clinical scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/deepnoid-ai/RA-RRG.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化放射学报告生成技术具有减少放射科医生工作量的潜力。近年来，多模态大语言模型在放射学报告生成方面的应用取得了显著进展。然而，现有的多模态大语言模型计算成本较高，需要大规模的训练数据，并且可能会产生幻觉内容，这限制了它们的实际应用。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了RA-RRG框架。该框架结合了多模态检索与大语言模型技术，能够在减少幻觉和降低计算需求的同时生成放射学报告。RA-RRG利用大语言模型从放射学报告中提取临床关键信息，并根据输入图像检索相关短语。通过将大语言模型与检索到的短语进行关联，RA-RRG能够有效抑制幻觉现象，同时保持良好的报告生成性能。在MIMIC-CXR和IU X射线数据集上的实验表明，该框架在CheXbert指标上取得了领先成果，其RadGraph F1分数也与现有多模态大语言模型相当。此外，通过整合来自多张图像的检索短语，RA-RRG可以自然扩展到多视图放射学报告生成领域，显示出其在实际临床场景中的广泛应用潜力。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/deepnoid-ai/RA-RRG

papers.title: Context-Value-Action Architecture for Value-Driven Large Language Model Agents
papers.title_zh: 基于上下文-价值-行为的架构，用于构建以价值为导向的大型语言模型智能体
papers.authors: TianZe Zhang, Sirui Sun, Yuhang Xie, Xin Zhang, Zhiqiang Wu, Guojie Song
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in simulating human behavior, yet existing agents often exhibit behavioral rigidity, a flaw frequently masked by the self-referential bias of current “LLM-as-a-judge” evaluations. By evaluating against empirical ground truth, we reveal a counter-intuitive phenomenon: increasing the intensity of prompt-driven reasoning does not enhance fidelity but rather exacerbates value polarization, collapsing population diversity. To address this, we propose the Context-Value-Action (CVA) architecture, grounded in the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) model and Schwartz’s Theory of Basic Human Values. Unlike methods relying on self-verification, CVA decouples action generation from cognitive reasoning via a novel Value Verifier trained on authentic human data to explicitly model dynamic value activation. Experiments on CVABench, which comprises over 1.1 million real-world interaction traces, demonstrate that CVA significantly outperforms baselines. Our approach effectively mitigates polarization while offering superior behavioral fidelity and interpretability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在模拟人类行为方面表现出一定的潜力，但现有的智能体往往存在行为僵化的问题，这一缺陷通常被当前“用语言模型作为评判器”的评估方式中的自我参照偏见所掩盖。通过以实证真实数据作为评估依据，我们发现了一个违反直觉的现象：增加提示驱动推理的强度并不会提高模型的准确性，反而会加剧价值的两极分化，导致群体多样性进一步降低。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了上下文-价值-行动架构。该架构基于刺激-有机体-反应模型以及Schwartz的人类基本价值理论。与依赖自我验证的方法不同，CVA通过将动作生成与认知推理分离开来，并采用基于真实人类数据训练的价值验证器来显式地模拟动态价值激活过程。在包含超过 110 万条真实交互轨迹的 CVABench 上进行的大量实验表明，CVA在性能上显著优于其他基线方法。我们的方法能够有效缓解两极分化问题，同时提供更高的行为准确性和可解释性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
