papers.title: Uncovering Strategic Egoism Behaviors in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 揭示大型语言模型中的战略性自私行为
papers.authors: Yaoyuan Zhang, Zonghao Ying, Aishan Liu, Jian Yang, Tianlin Li, Yaodong Yang, Xianglong Liu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit growing safety and alignment risks, hindering their deployment in high-stakes decision-making scenarios. In this paper, we identify a previously underexplored risk: similar to humans, LLMs can exhibit egoistic decision-making, in which they pursue short-term self-benefits through improper means while disregarding collective welfare and ethical constraints. We term this phenomenon Strategic Egoism (SE). To systematically evaluate SE, we introduce SEBench, a benchmark comprising 880 decision-making scenarios across 11 domains involving explicit profit temptations, which measures egoistic behavior along 6 psychologically grounded dimensions (e.g., rule circumvention). Each scenario adopts a single-role decision-making setting with carefully designed choice options to elicit self-serving strategies. Extensive experiments on 9 proprietary LLMs reveal that SE behaviors are widespread, with an average occurrence rate of 67.96%, and frequently manifest as manipulative coercion. Notably, we find that models more susceptible to profit temptations also exhibit broader safety deficiencies, including higher toxicity, lower truthfulness, increased jailbreak vulnerability, and elevated Dark Triad–style trait scores. Drawing inspiration from psychological interventions, we further propose SEGuard, a lightweight mitigation that reinforces situational constraints and suppresses egoistic tactics.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在安全性和一致性方面存在日益严重的风险，这限制了它们在高风险决策场景中的应用。在本文中，我们发现了一种此前未被充分研究的风险：与人类类似，LLM也可能表现出自私的决策行为，它们通过不正当手段追求短期自身利益，而忽视集体福利和伦理约束。我们将这种现象称为“战略自私”。为了系统地评估这种现象，我们开发了SEBench这一基准测试工具，该测试包含880个决策场景，涵盖11个领域，涉及明确的利益诱惑问题。该测试从6个心理学上可衡量的维度来测量自私行为，例如规避规则的行为。每个场景都采用单一角色的决策环境，并设计有精心安排的选项，以激发自私策略的产生。对9种专有LLM进行的广泛实验表明，自私行为非常普遍，平均出现率为67.96%，并且常常表现为操纵性的强制行为。值得注意的是，那些更容易受到利益诱惑的模型也表现出更广泛的安全缺陷，包括更高的毒性、更低的真实性、更高的越狱风险以及更高的黑暗三合会风格特质得分。受心理干预方法的启发，我们进一步提出了SEGuard这一轻量级缓解方案，该方案能够加强情境约束，抑制自私策略的发挥。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EMA: An Episodic Memory Agent for Efficient and Selective Memory
papers.title_zh: EMA：一种用于高效且选择性记忆的片段式记忆代理
papers.authors: Hongyi Lan, Jiaqi Song, Zhengjia Zhong, Hui Li, Hong Liu, Xianming Lin, Rongrong Ji
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong generation and reasoning abilities, but they still face challenges in long-term memory retention and multi-turn conversational consistency. Existing memory-augmented methods often incorporate full dialog histories without filtering, resulting in information redundancy and inference latency. Inspired by the episodic memory mechanism in human cognition, we abstract conversational context into Episodic Memory Units (EMUs). We then propose a comprehensive framework, Episodic Memory Agent (EMA), along with a filtering decision module called MemDecider. Specifically, EMA organizes and retrieves EMUs to support response generation, while MemDecider filters information to reduce noise and improve overall performance. Experiments on two widely-used benchmarks show that EMA maintains competitive performance, and integrating MemDecider into other methods reduces their token consumption by an average of 11.48% while effectively improving the overall performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Hongyi4221/EMA.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在生成和推理能力方面表现出强大的性能，但在长期记忆保留和多轮对话一致性方面仍然存在挑战。现有的增强式记忆方法往往不加筛选地整合全部对话历史信息，导致信息冗余和推理延迟。受人类认知中的情景记忆机制的启发，我们将对话上下文抽象为情景记忆单元。随后，我们提出了一种综合框架——情景记忆代理，并配套了一个名为MemDecider的过滤决策模块。具体而言，情景记忆代理负责组织和检索情景记忆单元以支持响应生成，而MemDecider则负责过滤信息，减少噪声并提高整体性能。在两个广泛使用的基准测试上进行的实验表明，情景记忆代理能够保持竞争力，而将MemDecider与其他方法结合使用，平均可将其token消耗减少11.48%，同时有效提升整体性能。相关代码可在https://github.com/Hongyi4221/EMA获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ChildTalk: A Multi-Dialect Chinese Child Speech Corpus with Full-Length Child–Caregiver Conversations for Speech Recognition
papers.title_zh: ChildTalk：一个包含多种方言的中文儿童语音语料库，其中包含了完整的儿童与看护者的对话内容，这些对话内容非常适合用于语音识别技术
papers.authors: Jiaming Zhou, Yujie Guo, Shiwan Zhao, Yao Lu, Jianye Wang, Haoqin Sun, Hui Wang, Yong Qin
papers.abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) for children remains challenging due to developmental variability and the scarcity of high-quality corpora, especially for Mandarin and its dialects. In this paper, we present ChildTalk, a large-scale Chinese child speech corpus designed to address this gap. It contains 112.5 hours of speech from 498 children (aged 2–8) and 500 caregivers, recorded as natural child–caregiver conversations. Unlike prior Mandarin child ASR corpora that mainly release isolated utterances, ChildTalk provides full-length dialogues with complete transcriptions, preserving turn-taking and discourse context. To our knowledge, it is the first publicly available Mandarin child speech corpus with full-length dialogues and systematic coverage of standard Mandarin, eight Mandarin dialect subgroups, and two additional dialects (Southern Min and Jin). We benchmark end-to-end models trained from scratch, large pre-trained ASR models fine-tuned on ChildTalk, omni-modal LLMs in a zero-shot setting, and commercial speech transcription APIs. Fine-tuning on ChildTalk consistently improves both in-domain and cross-domain performance. These results indicate that ChildTalk provides a challenging, broad-coverage testbed for Chinese child ASR, dialect robustness, and dialogue-level modeling. The dataset will be made freely available for all academic purposes.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于儿童发展的差异性以及高质量语料库的稀缺性，针对儿童的自动语音识别技术仍然面临挑战，尤其是在普通话及其方言领域。在本文中，我们介绍了ChildTalk这一大规模的中文儿童语音语料库，旨在弥补这一空白。该语料库包含498名2至8岁儿童与500名看护者之间的112.5小时语音记录，这些记录都是自然发生的儿童与看护者的对话。与之前主要收录孤立句子的普通话儿童自动语音识别语料库不同，ChildTalk提供了完整的对话内容及转录文本，从而保留了对话的轮转顺序和话语上下文。据我们所知，这是首个公开可用的包含完整对话内容且涵盖标准普通话、八个普通话方言子群以及另外两种方言（南方闽南话和晋语）的中文儿童语音语料库。我们对从零开始训练的端到端模型、在ChildTalk上微调的大型预训练自动语音识别模型、零样本条件下的全模态大语言模型以及商业语音转录API进行了基准测试。在ChildTalk上进行微调能够持续提升领域内及跨领域的性能。这些结果表明，ChildTalk为汉语儿童自动语音识别技术、方言鲁棒性以及对话级建模提供了一个具有挑战性的、覆盖范围广泛的测试平台。该数据集将免费提供给所有学术用途。

papers.title: SrDetection: A Self-Referential Framework for Data Leakage Detection in Code Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SrDetection：一种用于检测代码中的数据泄露的自引用框架，适用于大型语言模型场景
papers.authors: Shuaimin Li, Liyang Fan, Zeyang li, Zhuoyue Wan, Yufang Lin, Shiwen Ni, Feiteng Fang, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Yuanfeng Song, Kun Jing, Chen Jason Zhang, Min Yang
papers.abstract: Evaluating code large language models (Code LLMs) requires reliable detection of data leakage, where benchmark performance is artificially inflated by exposure to benchmark data during pre-training. Existing approaches either assume access to proprietary training corpora, rely on brittle heuristics such as timestamp filtering, or use external reference sets with manually tuned, non-generalizable thresholds. To address these limitations, we introduce SrDetection, a unified self-referential leakage detection framework for both gray-box (access to model logits) and black-box (access to model outputs) settings. SrDetection generates semantically equivalent variants of a benchmark sample and detects leakage by contrasting the model’s behavior on the original versus its variants, flagging cases where the original is disproportionately easier for the model. We further design a controlled leakage detection testbed and evaluate SrDetection in this environment. Across different models and training stages, SrDetection improves average F1 by 21.52 points in the gray-box setting and 14.46 points in the black-box setting over strong baselines, demonstrating robust, threshold-independent leakage detection. Finally, a gray-box study of 15 widely used Code LLMs on four popular benchmarks reveals benchmark-specific leakage patterns beyond prior overlap-based analyses[Source code and data are available at https://github.com/SMinL/SrDetectionCode].
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型（Code LLMs）的代码时，需要可靠地检测数据泄露现象。在预训练过程中，如果模型接触到基准测试数据，其性能可能会被人为地提升。目前的方法要么假设可以访问专有的训练数据集，要么依赖一些不可靠的启发式方法，比如时间戳过滤，或者使用经过人工调整的、不具备通用性的外部参考集来检测数据泄露。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了SrDetection这一统一的自我引用式泄漏检测框架，该框架适用于灰色框环境（能够访问模型的逻辑输出）和黑色框环境（能够访问模型的实际输出）。SrDetection通过生成与基准测试样本语义等效的变体，通过比较模型在原始样本与变体上的表现来检测泄漏情况，并标记出那些原始样本对模型来说过于容易的情况。我们还设计了一个可控的泄漏检测测试环境，并在该环境中对SrDetection进行了评估。在不同模型和训练阶段下，SrDetection在灰色框环境中的平均F1分数提高了21.52分，在黑色框环境中则提高了14.46分，这证明了其具有强大的、与阈值无关的数据泄漏检测能力。最后，我们对15种常用的Code LLMs在四个热门基准测试上的灰色框测试结果进行了分析，发现存在一些与以往基于重叠分析的泄漏模式不同的现象。源代码和数据可在此处获取：https://github.com/SMinL/SrDetectionCode

papers.title: Memo-SQL: Structured Decomposition and Experience-Driven Self-Correction for Training-Free NL2SQL
papers.title_zh: Memo-SQL：结构化分解与基于经验的自动修正技术，实现无需训练的NL到SQL的转换
papers.authors: Yang Zerui, Weichuan Wang, Yanwei Xu, Linqi Song, Yudai Matsuda, Wei Han, Bo Bai
papers.abstract: Existing NL2SQL systems face two critical limitations : (1) they rely on in-context learning with only correct examples, overlooking the rich signal in historical error–fix pairs that could guide more robust self-correction; and (2) test-time scaling (TTS) approaches often decompose questions arbitrarily, producing near-identical SQL candidates across runs and diminishing ensemble gains. Moreover, these methods suffer from a stark accuracy–efficiency trade-off: high performance demands excessive computation, while fast variants compromise quality. We present Memo-SQL, a training-free framework that addresses these issues through two simple ideas: structured decomposition and experience-aware self-correction. Instead of leaving decomposition to chance, we apply three clear strategies, entity-wise, hierarchical, and atomic sequential, to encourage diverse reasoning. For correction, we build a dynamic memory of both successful queries and historical error–fix pairs, and use retrieval-augmented prompting to bring relevant examples into context at inference time, no fine-tuning or external APIs required. On BIRD, Memo-SQL achieves 68.5% execution accuracy, setting a new state of the art among open, zero-fine-tuning methods, while using over 10× fewer resources than prior TTS approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的NL2SQL系统存在两个关键限制：(1)它们仅依赖上下文中的正确示例进行学习，而忽略了历史错误修复对中所蕴含的丰富信息，这些信息可以指导更有效的自我修正；(2)测试时间扩展方法常常随意分解问题，导致不同运行中的SQL候选语句几乎相同，从而降低了集成学习的效果。此外，这些方法还存在明显的准确性与效率之间的权衡：高性能需要大量的计算资源，而追求快速的方法则会牺牲质量。我们提出了Memo-SQL这一无需训练的框架，它通过两个简单的思路解决了这些问题：结构化分解和基于经验的自修正机制。我们不再让分解过程随机发生，而是采用了三种明确的策略：按实体分解、层次化分解以及原子级顺序分解，以鼓励多样化的推理方式。在修正方面，我们建立了一种动态的记忆机制，存储了成功的查询结果以及历史错误修复对的信息。在推理时，我们通过检索增强式提示将相关示例带入上下文，而无需进行任何微调或依赖外部API。在BIRD数据集上，Memo-SQL达到了68.5%的执行准确率，这标志着它在开放式的、无需精细调优的方法中取得了新的突破，同时使用的资源比之前的测试时间扩展方法减少了10倍以上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Do We Always Need Query-Level Workflows? Rethinking Agentic Workflow Generation for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 我们真的需要查询级工作流程吗？重新思考多智能体系统中智能体工作流程的生成方式
papers.authors: Zixu Wang, Bingbing Xu, Yige Yuan, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) built on large language models typically solve complex tasks by coordinating multiple agents through workflows. Existing approaches generates workflows either at task level or query level, but their relative costs and benefits remain unclear. After rethinking and empirical analyses, we show that query-level workflow generation is not always necessary, since a small set of top-K best task-level workflows together already covers equivalent or even more queries. We further find that exhaustive execution-based task-level evaluation is both extremely token-costly and frequently unreliable. Inspired by the idea of self-evolution and generative reward modeling, we propose a low-cost task-level generation framework \textbf{SCALE}, which means \textbf{S}elf prediction of the optimizer with few shot \textbf{CAL}ibration for \textbf{E}valuation instead of full validation execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textbf{SCALE} maintains competitive performance, with an average degradation of just 0.61% compared to existing approach across multiple datasets, while cutting overall token usage by up to 83%.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统通常通过协调多个智能体来完成复杂任务。现有的方法在任务级或查询级生成工作流程，但它们之间的成本和收益关系并不明确。经过重新思考和实证分析后，我们发现查询级工作流程的生成并不总是必要的，因为一小套排名前K的最佳任务级工作流程已经能够覆盖相当甚至更多的查询任务。我们还发现，基于穷尽执行方式的任务级评估不仅成本极高，而且经常不可靠。受自我进化思想和生成式奖励建模的启发，我们提出了一种低成本的任务级生成框架——**SCALE**。该框架采用自预测优化器与少量样本校准相结合的方式来进行评估，而非完全依赖验证执行过程。大量实验表明，**SCALE**在多个数据集上保持了竞争力，与现有方法相比，平均性能下降仅为0.61%，同时整体token使用量减少了多达83%。

papers.title: How Chain-of-Thought Works? Tracing Information Flow from Decoding, Projection, and Activation
papers.title_zh: 思维链是如何工作的？从解码、投影到激活，一步步追踪信息流程
papers.authors: Hao Yang, Qinghua Zhao, Lei Li, Lingyi Meng, Mengda Yu
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting significantly enhances model reasoning, yet its internal mechanisms remain poorly understood. We analyze CoT’s operational principles by reversely tracing information flow across decoding, projection, and activation phases. Our quantitative analysis suggests that CoT may serve as a decoding space pruner, leveraging answer templates to guide output generation, with higher template adherence strongly correlating with improved performance. Furthermore, we surprisingly find that CoT modulates neuron engagement in a task-dependent manner: reducing neuron activation in open-domain tasks, yet increasing it in closed-domain scenarios. These findings offer a novel mechanistic interpretability framework and critical insights for the NLP community, enabling targeted CoT interventions to design more efficient and robust prompts. We released our code and data at https://github.com/How-Young-X/cot
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链提示（CoT）显著提升了模型的推理能力，但其内部机制仍不甚明了。我们通过逆向追踪信息在解码、投影和激活阶段中的流动，分析了CoT的工作原理。我们的定量分析表明，CoT可能作为一种解码空间修剪器，利用答案模板来指导输出生成，而较高的模板遵循程度与更好的性能密切相关。此外，我们惊讶地发现，CoT以任务依赖的方式调节神经元的活跃度：在开放领域任务中降低神经元活性，而在封闭领域场景中则增加神经元活性。这些发现为自然语言处理领域提供了一个新的机制性解释框架，并为针对性地改进CoT提供了重要思路，从而设计出更高效、更稳健的提示方式。我们的代码和数据已发布在https://github.com/How-Young-X/cot上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Survey of Retentive Network
papers.title_zh: 基于保留网络的调查
papers.authors: Haiqi Yang, Zhiyuan Li, Yi Chang, Yuan Wu
papers.abstract: The Retentive Network (RetNet) has recently emerged as a formidable successor to the Transformer architecture. Although the self-attention mechanism excels at capturing global dependencies, its inherent quadratic complexity imposes significant memory constraints and inhibits scalability during long-sequence modeling. To overcome these challenges, RetNet introduces an innovative retention mechanism that integrates the inductive bias of recurrent neural networks with the parallelizable training advantages of attention-based models. This unified representation allows RetNet to achieve constant-time inference and linear-time training without sacrificing representational capacity. Despite the growing body of research demonstrating the efficacy of RetNet across diverse fields such as natural language processing, computer vision, and time-series analysis, a systematic synthesis of the current literature is currently unavailable. This paper presents the first comprehensive survey of Retentive Networks through a detailed examination of its architectural foundations, core innovations, and specialized variants. Furthermore, we provide a multi-disciplinary analysis of its applications ranging from basic sequence tasks to complex cross-modal scenarios. Finally, we offer prospective insights and suggest strategic avenues for future inquiry to facilitate the continued evolution of RetNet in both academic research and large-scale industrial applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 保留网络（RetNet）最近成为了Transformer架构的强大继任者。虽然自注意力机制在捕捉全局依赖关系方面表现出色，但其固有的二次复杂度却带来了严重的内存限制，并阻碍了长序列建模时的可扩展性。为了克服这些挑战，RetNet引入了一种创新的保留机制，该机制结合了循环神经网络的自归纳偏见与基于注意力的模型在并行训练方面的优势。这种统一的表示方式使得RetNet能够在不牺牲表征能力的情况下实现常数时间推理和线性时间训练。尽管越来越多的研究证明了RetNet在自然语言处理、计算机视觉和时间序列分析等多个领域的有效性，但目前还没有系统性的文献综述。本文首次对保留网络进行了全面的调查，详细探讨了其架构基础、核心创新以及特定变体。此外，我们还从多学科角度分析了RetNet的应用范围，涵盖了从基本序列任务到复杂的跨模态场景。最后，我们提出了一些前瞻性的见解，并指出了未来研究的方向，以促进RetNet在学术研究和大规模工业应用中的持续发展。

papers.title: RAG-KT: Cross-platform Explainable Knowledge Tracing with Multi-view Fusion Retrieval Generation
papers.title_zh: RAG-KT：支持跨平台、可解释的知识追踪技术，采用多视图融合检索机制来生成知识图谱
papers.authors: Zhiyi Duan, Hongyu Yuan, Rui Liu
papers.abstract: Knowledge Tracing (KT) infers a student’s knowledge state from past interactions to predict future performance. Conventional Deep Learning (DL)-based KT models are typically tied to platform-specific identifiers and latent representations, making them hard to transfer and interpret. Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods can be either ungrounded under prompting or overly domain-dependent under fine-tuning. In addition, most existing KT methods are developed and evaluated under a same-distribution assumption. In real deployments, educational data often arise from heterogeneous platforms with substantial distribution shift, which often degrades generalization. To this end, we propose RAG-KT, a retrieval-augmented paradigm that frames cross-platform KT as reliable context constrained inference with LLMs. It builds a unified multi-source structured context with cross-source alignment via Question Group abstractions and retrieves complementary rich and reliable context for each prediction, enabling grounded prediction and interpretable diagnosis. Experiments on three public KT benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in accuracy and robustness, including strong performance under cross-platform conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识追踪（KT）通过分析学生过去的互动行为来预测其未来的表现。传统的基于深度学习的KT模型通常依赖于特定平台的标识符和潜在表示方式，这使得这些模型难以进行迁移和解释。而基于大语言模型的方法在提示时可能会失去实际意义，或者在微调过程中过于依赖特定领域。此外，大多数现有的KT方法都是在相同分布假设下开发和评估的。在实际应用中，教育数据往往来自不同的平台，这些平台之间存在显著的分布差异，这往往会降低模型的泛化能力。为此，我们提出了RAG-KT这一增强检索能力的框架。该框架将跨平台的KT视为一种基于LLM的可靠上下文约束推理方式。它通过问题组抽象技术实现跨源对齐，从而为每个预测提供丰富且可靠的上下文信息，从而实现有根据的预测和可解释的诊断。在三个公开的KT基准测试上进行的实验表明，该方法在准确性和鲁棒性方面都取得了显著提升，尤其是在跨平台条件下表现尤为出色。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Conformal Event Prediction with Temporal Knowledge Graph
papers.title_zh: 结合时间信息的共形事件预测与知识图谱
papers.authors: Cheng Hu, Cong Cao, Fangfang Yuan, Diandian Guo, Pin Xu, Yu Liu, Yanbing Liu
papers.abstract: Event prediction plays a critical role in high-stakes applications such as military operations, public safety, and healthcare. Current methods learn temporal knowledge graphs to predict events at future timestamps, and the predictions directly influence decision-making and resource allocation. However, these methods lack rigorous uncertainty quantification, which limits their reliability for decision-making, especially in high-stakes scenarios where the cost of errors is high. In this paper, we propose CFEP, a conformal prediction framework tailored for event prediction to address this challenge. This is achieved through end-to-end optimization that ensures coverage while improving efficiency. Specifically, we first introduce non-conformity score diffusion, which captures both topological and temporal uncertainty in temporal knowledge graphs. Additionally, we propose an efficiency-aware optimization algorithm to reduce the coverage gap and improve computational efficiency. Experimental results on three public datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently guarantees statistical coverage while improving efficiency. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/hucheng-IIE/CFEP.
papers.abstract_zh: 事件预测在军事行动、公共安全以及医疗保健等高风险应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。目前的方法是通过学习时间知识图谱来预测未来发生的事件，而这些预测直接影响了决策和资源分配。然而，这些方法缺乏严格的不确定性量化手段，这限制了它们在决策中的可靠性，尤其是在错误成本极高的高风险场景中。在本文中，我们提出了CFEP这一专为事件预测设计的 conformal 预测框架，以克服这一挑战。我们通过端到端优化来实现这一目标，既保证了覆盖性，又提高了效率。具体来说，我们首先引入了非一致性得分扩散技术，该技术能够同时捕捉时间知识图谱中的拓扑不确定性和时间不确定性。此外，我们还提出了一种注重效率的优化算法，以减少覆盖差距并提高计算效率。在三个公开数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法能够在提高效率的同时，始终确保统计上的覆盖性。相关代码和数据集可在https://github.com/hucheng-IIE/CFEP获取。

papers.title: Infinite Babble: Inflating 3D Vision-Language Model Inference Overhead via Adversarial Geometric Perturbation
papers.title_zh: 无限喧嚣：通过对抗性几何扰动来降低3D视觉-语言模型推理的计算复杂度
papers.authors: Shuoyang Sun, Jiaxin Hong, Yv Zhang, Kuofeng Gao, Hao Fang, Bin Chen, Shu-Tao Xia
papers.abstract: 3D Vision-Language Models (3D-VLMs) have emerged as the critical cognitive backbone for spatial intelligence, enabling precise reasoning over unstructured 3D data. While these models serve as the foundation for downstream robotics and embodied systems, their reliance on autoregressive decoding introduces a fundamental vulnerability regarding inference efficiency. In this work, we present \textbf{Inflate3D}, a novel adversarial framework designed to trigger computational and economic exhaustion in 3D-VLMs. Specifically, we exploit the model’s sensitivity to untrusted 3D assets to hijack the generation process. Inflate3D operates by injecting imperceptible noise that forces the model into a state of pathological verbosity, effectively stalling the inference pipeline. Our approach comprises two synergistic strategies: (1) a \textit{semantic-aware adversarial manipulation} that leverages internal representations to selectively perturb semantically critical regions while preserving geometric structure, and (2) a \textit{trajectory disruption mechanism} that manipulates token probabilities to suppress End-of-Sequence (EOS) emission, thereby prolonging decoding and inducing verbose outputs. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that Inflate3D amplifies output length and energy consumption by up to \textbf{6.45$\times$}, demonstrating a potent capability to drain system resources. These findings expose a critical blind spot in multimodal alignment, highlighting the urgent need to secure spatial foundation models against resource exhaustion attacks.
papers.abstract_zh: 3D视觉-语言模型已成为空间智能的关键认知基础，能够实现对非结构化3D数据的精确推理。虽然这些模型为后续的机器人技术和具身系统提供了基础，但它们对自回归解码方式的依赖，使得在推理效率方面存在根本性的弱点。在这项研究中，我们提出了**Inflate3D**这一新颖的对抗性框架，旨在使3D-VLM陷入计算和资源枯竭的状态。具体来说，我们利用模型对不可信3D数据的敏感性，来操控其生成过程。Inflate3D通过注入难以察觉的噪声，迫使模型进入一种过度输出的状态，从而有效阻塞推理流程。我们的方法包含两种协同策略：(1) **语义感知型对抗性操控**，利用内部表示选择性地干扰语义关键区域，同时保留几何结构；(2) **轨迹破坏机制**，通过操纵令牌概率来抑制序列结束信号的输出，从而延长解码时间并产生冗长的输出。在标准基准测试中的实验表明，Inflate3D可以将输出长度和能耗增加高达**6.45倍**，显示出极强的资源消耗能力。这些发现揭示了多模态对齐中的一个关键盲点，凸显了保护空间基础模型免受资源耗尽攻击的紧迫需求。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Calibrated Elastic Alignment for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Missing Modalities
papers.title_zh: 基于不确定性校准的弹性对齐方法，适用于缺失模态的多模态情感分析
papers.authors: Kang He, Yuzhe Ding, Rao Fu, Yukang Feng, Kaipeng Zhang, Yiming Liu, Fei Li, Chong Teng, Donghong Ji
papers.abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) in real-world scenarios is often challenged by dynamically missing modalities. Existing methods predominantly rely on deterministic imputation and rigid alignment, which compels the model to overfit noise in ambiguous regions while neglecting the decision shift induced by modality inertia. To address these issues, we propose a novel uncertainty-calibrated elastic alignment framework, termed EASE. Specifically, we employ probabilistic imputation to capture cross-modal ambiguity and leverage the estimated uncertainty to drive elastic alignment, thereby adaptively relaxing constraints in ambiguous regions to avoid rigid fitting. Meanwhile, we introduce cross-view predictive consistency constraints to unify discriminative logic across different modality views, stabilizing the decision boundary under modality degradation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EASE consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines across multiple benchmarks, exhibiting exceptional robustness particularly under high missing-rate scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实场景中，多模态情感分析常常面临动态缺失模态的挑战。现有的方法主要依赖于确定性填补和刚性对齐方式，这种方式迫使模型过度拟合模糊区域中的噪声，同时忽略了由模态惯性引起的决策偏移。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的不确定性校准弹性对齐框架，称为EASE。具体来说，我们采用概率性填补方法来处理跨模态的模糊性，并利用估计出的不确定性来驱动弹性对齐，从而自适应地放宽模糊区域的约束，避免刚性拟合。同时，我们引入了跨视图预测一致性约束，以统一不同模态视图下的判别逻辑，从而在模态退化的情况下稳定决策边界。大量实验表明，EASE在多个基准测试中的表现始终优于现有的最先进基线方法，尤其是在高缺失率场景下表现出卓越的鲁棒性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: On the Representation Geometry of LoRA Model Merging
papers.title_zh: 关于LoRA模型合并的表示几何学
papers.authors: Chenyang Lu, Jiaru Li, Jinman Zhao, Xinran Chen, Yining Wang, Renyi Cai, Yuchen Li, Chao He
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is widely used for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, yet merging multiple task-specific LoRA updates without additional training remains challenging. Most existing LoRA merging methods rely on SVD-based alignment, which emphasizes globally shared structure across tasks. In this work, we show that LoRA merging performance can be further improved by combining SVD with CUR decomposition. Through a representation-level analysis, we find that SVD-based decompositions primarily model shared components across tasks, while CUR-based decompositions better preserve task-specific and localized updates. These two perspectives are geometrically misaligned and exhibit complementary advantages, revealing an inherent trade-off between capturing shared structure and preserving task-specific information in LoRA model merging. Guided by this analysis, we propose a training-free merging procedure that explicitly combines the shared structure captured by SVD with the task-specific components preserved by CUR. Experiments on both vision and language benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing gradient-free LoRA merging methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）被广泛用于参数高效的微调，然而，在不进行额外训练的情况下合并多个任务特定的LoRA更新仍然具有挑战性。目前大多数LoRA合并方法依赖于基于SVD的对齐方式，这种方式强调跨任务的全局共享结构。在这项研究中，我们发现通过将SVD与CUR分解相结合，可以进一步提升LoRA合并的性能。通过表示层面的分析，我们发现基于SVD的分解主要模拟了跨任务的共享组件，而基于CUR的分解则能更好地保留任务特定和局部化的更新。这两种方法在几何上是不一致的，但它们各自具有互补的优势，这揭示了在合并LoRA模型时，捕捉共享结构与保留任务特定信息之间的内在权衡。基于这一分析，我们提出了一种无需训练的合并方法，该方法能够明确地将SVD所捕捉到的共享结构与CUR所保留的任务特定组件结合起来。在视觉和语言基准测试中的实验表明，该方法相比现有的无梯度LoRA合并方法，取得了更为显著的改进。

papers.title: MCLE-Mol: Empowering LLM with Molecular Comprehension and Low-Cost Continual Evolution for Interpretable Property Prediction
papers.title_zh: MCLE-Mol：通过分子层面的理解能力，为大型语言模型提供赋能；同时实现低成本且持续的进化，以达成可解释的属性预测功能
papers.authors: Zhili Pu, Lantian Zhang, Hao Duan, Zhixing Zhang, Keyun Zhu, Yongqi Fan, Ruihui Hou, Tong Ruan, Yun Tang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a new paradigm for molecular property prediction (MPP), yet a semantic gap between natural language and molecular representations limits LLMs’ ability to capture structure–activity relationships (SAR). Recent approaches have explored injecting structure-level information into LLMs, primarily modeling associations based on statistical regularities. However, these methods are prone to misinterpreting coincidental associations as general principles, imposing a bottleneck on predictive performance. To tackle the challenges above, we propose MCLE-Mol, an ML–LLM–Rule collaborative framework for MPP. It bridges the semantic gap by injecting ML-derived substructure attribution values into LLMs, utilizing Context-Calibrated Substructure Attribution Rules (CCSAR) to calibrate these attributions under specific chemical contexts to mitigate such misinterpretation. In addition, MCLE-Mol introduces a low-cost continual evolution strategy that updates CCSAR with frozen model parameters to adapt to dynamic chemical spaces. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that MCLE-Mol outperforms all baselines, successfully resolving the trade-off between predictive performance and interpretability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型为分子性质预测提供了新的范式，然而自然语言与分子表示之间的语义差异限制了模型捕捉结构-活性关系的能力。近期的研究尝试将结构级信息引入语言模型中，主要通过基于统计规律进行关联建模来实现。然而，这些方法容易将偶然的关联误认为是普遍规律，从而影响了预测性能。为了应对上述挑战，我们提出了MCLE-Mol这一基于机器学习、语言模型和规则协作的框架。该框架通过将机器学习得出的子结构属性值注入语言模型中，并利用上下文校准的子结构属性规则来在特定化学背景下校准这些属性，从而弥补语义上的不足。此外，MCLE-Mol还引入了一种低成本的持续进化策略，通过冻结模型参数来更新上下文校准子结构规则，以适应动态变化的化学环境。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，MCLE-Mol的表现优于所有基线方法，成功实现了预测性能与可解释性之间的平衡。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MTR-DuplexBench: Towards a Comprehensive Evaluation of Multi-Round Conversations for Full-Duplex Speech Language Models
papers.title_zh: MTR-DuplexBench：针对全双工语音语言模型，对多轮对话进行全面评估的方法研究
papers.authors: Zhang He, Wenqian Cui, Haoning Xu, Xiao-Hui Li, Lei Zhu, Haoli Bai, Ma Shaohua, Irwin King
papers.abstract: Full-Duplex Speech Language Models (FD-SLMs) enable real-time, overlapping conversational interactions, offering a more dynamic user experience compared to traditional half-duplex models. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on evaluating single-round interactions, neglecting the complexities of multi-round communication. Evaluating FD-SLMs in multi-round settings poses significant challenges, including blurred turn boundaries in communication and context inconsistency during model inference. Also, existing benchmarks often focus solely on evaluating conversational features, neglecting other critical aspects. To address these gaps, we introduce MTR-DuplexBench, a novel benchmark designed for a comprehensive multi-round evaluation of FD-SLMs. MTR-DuplexBench not only segments continuous full-duplex dialogues into discrete turns for turn-by-turn assessment but also incorporates various evaluation aspects, including conversational features, dialogue quality, instruction following, and safety. Experimental results reveal that current FD-SLMs face difficulties in maintaining consistent performance across multiple rounds and evaluation dimensions, highlighting the necessity and effectiveness of our benchmark.
papers.abstract_zh: 全双工语音语言模型（FD-SLMs）能够实现实时、重叠的对话交互，相比传统的半双工模型，它为用户提供了更加动态的使用体验。然而，现有的评估基准主要侧重于单轮对话的评估，而忽略了多轮通信中的复杂情况。在多轮环境中对FD-SLMs进行评估面临着诸多挑战，比如通信过程中转场边界的模糊以及模型推理过程中的上下文不一致性问题。此外，现有的评估基准往往只关注对话特征方面的评估，而忽视了其他重要因素。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了MTR-DuplexBench这一新型评估基准，旨在全面评估FD-SLMs在多轮对话场景下的表现。MTR-DuplexBench不仅将连续的全双工对话分解为独立的对话轮次进行评估，还涵盖了多种评估维度，包括对话特征、对话质量、指令遵循能力以及安全性等方面。实验结果表明，当前的FD-SLMs在保持多轮评估中的稳定性能方面存在困难，这充分说明了我们的评估基准的必要性和有效性。

papers.title: Generating Effective CoT Traces for Mitigating Causal Hallucination
papers.title_zh: 生成有效的因果幻觉缓解CoT追踪数据
papers.authors: Yiheng Zhao, Jun Yan
papers.abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) excel in complex reasoning tasks, they suffer from severe causal hallucination in event causality identification (ECI), particularly in smaller models (\leq1.5B parameters). A promising approach to address this issue is to fine-tune them with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces. However, there is currently a lack of CoT trace dataset available for ECI. In this paper, we first investigate the essential criteria that effective CoT traces should possess to mitigate causal hallucination in smaller models. We then design a pipeline to generate CoT traces that meet these criteria. Moreover, since there is currently no metric for quantifying causal hallucination, we also introduce a new metric, the Causal Hallucination Rate (CHR), to quantify causal hallucination, guide the formulation of effective CoT trace criteria, and validate the effectiveness of our pipeline. Our experiments show that fine-tuning with the CoT traces generated by our pipeline not only substantially reduces causal hallucination in smaller LLMs but also improves mean accuracy. Moreover, the fine-tuned models exhibit strong cross-dataset and cross-difficulty generalization, as well as robustness under intentionally misleading intervention prompts.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在复杂的推理任务中表现出色，但在事件因果关系识别方面存在严重的因果幻觉问题，尤其是在参数数量较少的模型中（参数数量≤1.5亿）。一种有效的解决方法是使用思维链痕迹对模型进行微调。然而，目前缺乏适用于事件因果关系识别的思维链痕迹数据集。在本文中，我们首先探讨了有效的思维链痕迹应具备的关键特征，以缓解小型模型中的因果幻觉问题。然后，我们设计了一种生成符合这些特征的思维链痕迹的方法。此外，由于目前还没有用于量化因果幻觉的度量标准，我们引入了一个新的度量指标——因果幻觉率，以此来量化因果幻觉，指导有效思维链痕迹标准的制定，并验证我们的方法的有效性。实验结果表明，使用我们方法生成的思维链痕迹进行微调不仅显著减少了小型语言模型中的因果幻觉，还提高了平均准确率。此外，经过微调的模型在跨数据集和跨难度任务上的泛化能力很强，并且在故意误导性的干预提示下仍能保持鲁棒性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: SAE-FiRE: Enhancing Earnings Surprise Predictions Through Sparse Autoencoder Feature Selection
papers.title_zh: SAE-FiRE：通过稀疏自编码器特征选择提升收益惊喜预测的准确性
papers.authors: Huopu Zhang, Yanguang Liu, Miao Zhang, Zirui He, Mengnan Du
papers.abstract: Predicting earnings surprises through the analysis of earnings conference call transcripts has attracted increasing attention from the financial research community. Conference calls serve as critical communication channels between company executives, analysts, and shareholders, offering valuable forward-looking information. However, these transcripts present significant analytical challenges, typically containing over 5,000 words with substantial redundancy and industry-specific terminology that creates obstacles for language models. In this work, we propose the Sparse Autoencoder for Financial Representation Enhancement (SAE-FiRE) framework to address these limitations by extracting key information while eliminating redundancy. SAE-FiRE employs Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to efficiently identify patterns and filter out noises, and focusing specifically on capturing nuanced financial signals that have predictive power for earnings surprises. Experimental results indicate that the proposed method can significantly outperform comparing baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过分析财报电话会议记录来预测收益惊喜，这一方法已经引起了金融研究界的越来越多的关注。电话会议是公司高管、分析师和股东之间重要的沟通渠道，能够提供有价值的前瞻性信息。然而，这些会议记录存在显著的分析挑战，通常包含超过5,000字的文本，其中充斥着大量的冗余内容以及行业特定的术语，这些都会给语言模型带来障碍。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种名为“稀疏自编码器用于财务信息增强”的框架（SAE-FiRE），旨在解决这些问题。该框架利用稀疏自编码器来高效识别模式并过滤掉冗余信息，同时专注于捕捉那些对收益惊喜具有预测能力的细微财务信号。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在性能上明显优于传统的基线方法。

papers.title: From Implicit Graph Encoding to Explicit Evidence: A Training-Free LLM Framework for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 从隐式图编码到显式证据：一种无需训练的LLM框架，用于时间知识图谱推理
papers.authors: Guo Tang, Ke Cheng, Huiming Fan, Heng Chang, Wenxiang Zheng, Xianhao Ou, Junjia Xiang, Ming Liu, Yujun Zhou, Li Lanyu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) forecasting faces significant challenges due to distribution shifts and poor inductive generalization in parametric models. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer potent semantic reasoning, existing LLM-based approaches struggle with implicit modality alignment and suboptimal graph linearization, failing to capture complex topologies without retraining. To bridge this gap, we propose ExE-LLM, a training-free, test-time adaptive framework that reframes TKG prediction as explicit evidence-driven reasoning. Our core philosophy is to decouple topological calculation from semantic reasoning: a heuristic module translates latent graph signals into natural language evidence, enabling the LLM to perform multi-source judgment. ExE-LLM incorporates a task-aware scheduler for test-time adaptation, a heuristic synthesizer for explicit modality alignment, and a self-diagnosis module for iterative optimization. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that ExE-LLM achieves SOTA performance in inductive settings, significantly outperforming fully trained graph neural networks without updating LLM parameters. The source code is available at https://github.com/JENLISA4EVER/ExE-LLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间知识图谱（TKG）预测面临着巨大的挑战，这些挑战源于分布的变化以及参数模型中较差的归纳泛化能力。虽然大语言模型（LLM）提供了强大的语义推理能力，但现有的基于LLM的方法在隐式模态对齐和图结构线性化处理方面存在不足，无法在不重新训练的情况下捕捉复杂的图结构。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ExE-LLM——一种无需训练的、在测试时自适应的框架。该框架将TKG预测重新定义为明确的证据驱动推理过程。我们的核心理念是将图结构的计算与语义推理分离：一个启发式模块将潜在的图信号转化为自然语言证据，从而使LLM能够执行多源判断。ExE-LLM还包含了一个针对测试时适应的任务感知调度器、一个用于明确模态对齐的启发式合成器，以及一个用于迭代优化的自我诊断模块。在四个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，ExE-LLM在归纳性任务中取得了卓越的性能，其表现显著优于那些不更新LLM参数的完全训练的图神经网络。代码可在https://github.com/JENLISA4EVER/ExE-LLM获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LLM-Driven Multi-Perspective Location Completion for Next Location Prediction
papers.title_zh: 基于LLM的多视角位置完成算法，用于预测下一个定位目标
papers.authors: Pengxiang Lan, Enneng Yang, Yuliang Liang, Jianzhe Zhao, Linying Jiang, Guibing Guo
papers.abstract: Next location prediction aims to infer the next location users are likely to visit based on their historical check-in data. However, existing methods assume that check-in data is complete, overlooking the subjective nature of users’ check-in behavior, leading to inaccurate capture of user preferences. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have offered a promising approach to location completion due to their extensive world knowledge. Nevertheless, our experiments reveal that LLMs struggle to interpret raw geographic coordinate information. To address these challenges, we propose LaMDA, an LLM-driven Multi-perspective Data Augmentation framework that employs dual completion agents to complement user mobility behaviors. Driven by our empirical findings that natural language descriptions align more closely with real-world geographic logic, LaMDA translates geographic coordinates into text to enhance spatial reasoning. Leveraging these semantic descriptions, LaMDA constructs dual agents to complement user mobility: “Micro-Level Completion” fills short-term omissions, while “Macro-Level Completion” infers unrecorded locations based on periodic preferences. Reliability is ensured through tailored real-world point-of-interest (POI) pools and a self-verification mechanism. Finally, a collaborative dual-graph module leverages this augmented data for fine-grained preference modeling. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that LaMDA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 下一个位置预测的目的是根据用户的历史签到数据来推断他们可能访问的下一个地点。然而，现有方法假设签到数据是完整的，这忽略了用户签到行为的主观性，从而导致对用户偏好的不准确捕捉。最近，大语言模型由于拥有丰富的世界知识，为位置补全提供了有前景的方法。不过，我们的实验表明，大语言模型在解释原始地理坐标信息方面存在困难。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了LaMDA这一由大语言模型驱动的多视角数据增强框架。该框架采用双完成代理来补充用户的移动行为。根据我们的实证发现，自然语言描述更符合现实世界的地理逻辑，因此LaMDA将地理坐标转化为文本，以增强空间推理能力。利用这些语义描述，LaMDA构建了双代理来补充用户的移动行为：“微观级完成”用于填补短期缺失的信息，而“宏观级完成”则基于周期性偏好来推断未记录的位置。通过定制化的现实世界兴趣点池和自验证机制，确保了系统的可靠性。最后，一个协作的双图模块利用这些增强的数据进行细粒度的偏好建模。在三个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，LaMDA在性能上显著优于现有的最先进方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: WikiSeeker: Rethinking the Role of Vision-Language Models in Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
papers.title_zh: WikiSeeker：重新思考视觉语言模型在基于知识的视觉问答系统中的角色
papers.authors: Yingjian Zhu, Xinming Wang, Kun Ding, Ying Wang, Bin Fan, Shiming Xiang
papers.abstract: Multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a highly effective paradigm for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA). Despite recent advancements, prevailing methods still primarily depend on images as the retrieval key, and often overlook or misplace the role of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), thereby failing to leverage their potential fully. In this paper, we introduce WikiSeeker, a novel multi-modal RAG framework that bridges these gaps by implementing a multi-modal retriever and redefining the role of VLMs. Rather than serving merely as answer generators, we assign VLMs two specialized agents: a Refiner and an Inspector. The Refiner utilizes the capability of VLMs to rewrite the textual query according to the input image, significantly improving the performance of the multimodal retriever. The Inspector facilitates a decoupled generation strategy by selectively routing reliable retrieved context to another LLM for answer generation, while relying on the VLM’s internal knowledge when retrieval is unreliable. Extensive experiments on EVQA, InfoSeek, and M2KR demonstrate that WikiSeeker achieves state-of-the-art performance, with substantial improvements in both retrieval accuracy and answer quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态检索增强生成（RAG）已成为基于知识的视觉问答（KB-VQA）领域的一种非常有效的解决方案。尽管近年来取得了一些进展，但现有的方法仍然主要依赖图像作为检索的关键信息，而往往忽视了视觉语言模型（VLMs）的作用，从而未能充分发挥它们的潜力。在本文中，我们提出了WikiSeeker这一新型多模态RAG框架，它通过实现多模态检索器并重新定义VLMs的角色来填补这些空白。与仅仅充当答案生成器不同，我们为VLMs分配了两个专门的角色：精炼器和检查器。精炼器利用VLMs的能力根据输入图像对文本查询进行改写，从而显著提升了多模态检索器的性能。检查器则通过选择性地将可靠的检索到的上下文传递给另一个大语言模型来进行答案生成，而在检索不可靠的情况下则依靠VLM的内部知识来进行处理。在EVQA、InfoSeek和M2KR上的大量实验表明，WikiSeeker取得了最先进的性能，无论是在检索准确性还是答案质量方面都取得了显著的提升。

papers.title: Understanding Conflicts in Multi-Objective Alignment through Reward Consistency
papers.title_zh: 通过奖励一致性来理解多目标对齐中的冲突问题
papers.authors: Zhihao Xu, Yongqi Tong, Xin Zhang, Jun Zhou, Xiting Wang
papers.abstract: Multi-objective preference alignment often faces alignment conflicts, where optimizing for one objective (e.g., helpfulness) degrades performance on others (e.g., harmlessness). While prior work focuses on algorithmic solutions, the intrinsic conflict within data and its theoretical impact on training remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce the principle of Reward Consistency (RC), a theory-grounded criterion that approximates the alignment conflicts via reward models. We prove that a sample mitigates conflicts if and only if it satisfies RC, thereby ensuring improvement across all objectives during optimization. Building on this, we propose Reward Consistency Sampling (RCS), an automated framework for constructing pairwise data that adheres to RC, supplemented by a relaxation strategy to enhance flexibility. Extensive experiments show that RCS brings significant and consistent performance gains, achieving an average improvement of 23.07% in both harmlessness and helpfulness during simultaneous optimization comparde to the vanilla dataset. Our data-centric approach is complementary to existing alignment algorithms and effective in both sequential and simultaneous optimization scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 多目标偏好对齐常常面临对齐冲突的问题，即为了优化某个目标（例如有用性），会导致其他目标的性能下降（例如无害性）。虽然之前的研究主要集中在算法解决方案上，但数据内部固有的冲突及其对训练的理论影响却尚未得到充分探讨。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了奖励一致性原则（Reward Consistency，简称RC），这是一种基于理论的准则，通过奖励模型来近似解决对齐冲突问题。我们证明，一个样本只有在满足RC的条件下才能缓解冲突，从而确保在优化过程中所有目标的性能都能得到提升。在此基础上，我们提出了奖励一致性采样方法（Reward Consistency Sampling，简称RCS），这是一种自动化的框架，用于构建符合RC要求的成对数据，并辅以一种灵活的调整策略来提高其适应性。大量实验表明，RCS能够带来显著且稳定的性能提升，在同时优化的过程中，无害性和有用性的平均提升幅度达到了23.07%。我们的以数据为中心的方法与现有的对齐算法相辅相成，并且在序列优化和并行优化场景中都表现出良好的效果。

papers.title: MetaMem: Evolving Meta-Memory for Knowledge Utilization through Self-Reflective Symbolic Optimization
papers.title_zh: MetaMem：通过自我反思式的符号优化来发展元记忆，以更好地利用知识
papers.authors: Haidong Xin, Xinze Li, Zhenghao Liu, Yukun Yan, Shuo Wang, Cheng Yang, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Existing memory systems enable Large Language Models (LLMs) to support long-horizon human-LLM interactions by persisting historical interactions beyond limited context windows. However, while recent approaches have succeeded in constructing effective memories, they often disrupt the inherent logical and temporal relationships within interaction sessions, resulting in fragmented memory units and degraded reasoning performance. In this paper, we propose MetaMem, a novel framework that augments memory systems with a self-evolving meta-memory, aiming to teach LLMs how to effectively utilize memorized knowledge. During meta-memory optimization, MetaMem iteratively distills transferable knowledge utilization experiences across different tasks by self-reflecting on reasoning processes and performing actions to update the current meta-memory state. The accumulated meta-memory units serve as explicit knowledge utilization experiences, guiding the LLM to systematically identify and integrate critical evidence from scattered memory fragments. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MetaMem, which significantly outperforms strong baselines by over 3.6%. All codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/MetaMem.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的记忆系统使得大语言模型能够支持长期的人类与语言模型的互动，因为它们可以保留历史交互信息，超越有限的上下文窗口。然而，尽管最近的方法成功构建了有效的记忆机制，但它们往往会破坏交互会话中的逻辑和时间关系，导致记忆单元变得支离破碎，推理性能也下降。在本文中，我们提出了MetaMem这一创新框架，该框架通过引入一种自我进化的元记忆来增强记忆系统，旨在教会语言模型如何有效利用记忆中的知识。在元记忆优化过程中，MetaMem通过自我反思推理过程并采取行动来更新当前的元记忆状态，从而逐步提炼出不同任务之间可迁移的知识利用经验。积累的元记忆单元作为明确的知识利用经验，引导语言模型系统地识别并整合来自分散记忆片段的关键证据。大量的实验表明，MetaMem的有效性显著，其性能比强大的基线方法高出3.6%以上。所有代码和数据集均可在此处获取：https://github.com/OpenBMB/MetaMem
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GeoLAN: Geometric Learning of Latent Explanatory Directions in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: GeoLAN：在大型语言模型中学习潜在的解释方向的方法
papers.authors: Tianyu Pan, Damon L. Woodard
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong performance, but they often lack transparency. We introduce GeoLAN, a training framework that treats token representations as geometric trajectories and applies stickiness conditions inspired by recent developments related to the Kakeya Conjecture. We have developed two differentiable regularizers, Katz-Tao Convex Wolff (KT-CW) and Katz-Tao Attention (KT-Attn), that promote isotropy and encourage diverse attention. Our experiments with Gemma-3 (1B, 4B, 12B) and Llama-3-8B show that GeoLAN frequently maintains task accuracy while improving geometric metrics and reducing certain fairness biases. These benefits are most significant in mid-sized models. Our findings reveal scale-dependent trade-offs between geometric precision and performance, suggesting that geometry-aware training is a promising approach to enhance mechanistic interpretability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型表现出强大的性能，但它们往往缺乏透明度。我们提出了GeoLAN这一训练框架，该框架将令牌表示视为几何轨迹，并应用了受Kakeya猜想相关研究启发的粘性条件。我们开发了两种可微正则化方法：Katz-Tao凸沃尔夫（KT-CW）和Katz-Tao注意力机制（KT-Attn），这些方法有助于促进各向同性并鼓励多样化的注意力分配。我们对Gemma-3（1B、4B、12B）和Llama-3-8B进行的实验表明，GeoLAN能够在保持任务准确性的同时，提升几何指标并减少某些公平性偏差。这些优势在中规模模型中尤为明显。我们的研究发现揭示了几何精度与性能之间的权衡关系，这表明采用几何感知的训练方法是一种提高模型可解释性的有效途径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SepSeq: A Training-Free Framework for Long Numerical Sequence Processing in LLMs
papers.title_zh: SepSeq：一种无需训练的框架，适用于大型语言模型中的长数值序列处理任务
papers.authors: Jie Sun, Yu Liu, Lu Han, Qiwen Deng, Xiang Shu, Yang Xiao, Lintao Ma, Xingyu Lu, Jun Zhou, Pengfei Liu, Jiancan Wu, Xiang Wang
papers.abstract: While transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) theoretically support massive context windows, they suffer from severe performance degradation when processing long numerical sequences. We attribute this failure to the attention dispersion in the Softmax mechanism, which prevents the model from concentrating attention. To overcome this, we propose Separate Sequence (SepSeq), a training-free, plug-and-play framework to mitigate dispersion by strategically inserting separator tokens. Mechanistically, we demonstrate that separator tokens act as an attention anchor, recalibrating attention to focus on local segments while preserving global context. Extensive evaluations on 9 widely-adopted LLMs confirm the effectiveness of our approach: SepSeq yields an average relative accuracy improvement of 35.6% across diverse domains while reducing 16.4% inference token consumption.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于Transformer的大语言模型在理论上能够支持庞大的上下文窗口，但在处理长数值序列时会出现严重的性能下降问题。我们认为这种问题的原因在于Softmax机制中的注意力分散现象，这导致模型无法集中注意力。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一种无需训练即可使用的框架——Separate Sequence（SepSeq），该框架通过战略性地插入分隔符来减少注意力分散。从机制上来看，我们发现分隔符充当了注意力锚点，能够重新调整注意力焦点，使其集中在局部片段上，同时保留全局上下文信息。我们在9种广泛应用的LLM上进行的大量测试验证了我们的方法的有效性：SepSeq在不同领域实现了平均相对准确率提升了35.6%，同时减少了16.4%的推理token消耗。

papers.title: Ghost in the Shell: Synonym-Aware Logit Shaping Fingerprint for Copyright Protection of Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 《壳之灵：基于同义词认知的逻辑回归技术——用于大型视语模型的版权保护》
papers.authors: Xiaofan Zheng, Xinghao Wang, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: The proliferation of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) has exacerbated concerns regarding model misappropriation and license violations. Malicious users may deploy open-source models as black boxes and falsely claim ownership, sparking significant community interest in fingerprinting techniques for copyright authentication. Current fingerprinting methods largely follow a backdoor-based paradigm, employing specific inputs to elicit predetermined abnormal text outputs. However, such direct distortion of the model’s original predictions compromises modality alignment and inevitably degrades multimodal capabilities, leading to an inherent trade-off between robustness and harmlessness. To address these challenges, we investigate whether it is possible to embed robust fingerprints while maximally preserving the original normal outputs of the model. We propose a Synonym-Aware Logit Shaping Fingerprint (SALSF). The core insight of SALSF lies in reshaping the probability distribution of semantically similar long-tail tokens within the logits space while ensuring the original top-1 prediction token and its probability remain approximately invariant. By elevating the overall prediction probability of the semantic cluster to a level distinctly higher than the natural baseline, our approach stealthily embeds the fingerprint and mitigates the disruption to modality alignment. Experimental results demonstrate that SALSF maintains multimodal performance and substantially enhances fingerprint robustness, offering a novel paradigm for the intellectual property protection of LVLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型的广泛传播加剧了人们对模型被滥用和违反许可规定的担忧。恶意用户可能会将开源模型作为黑盒使用，并虚假声称拥有这些模型，这引发了社区对版权认证指纹技术的强烈兴趣。目前常用的指纹识别方法大多采用基于后门的方案，通过特定的输入来产生预设的异常文本输出。然而，这种直接扭曲模型原始预测的方式会损害多模态性能，从而不可避免地降低模型的综合能力，导致在鲁棒性和无害性之间做出权衡。为了应对这些挑战，我们研究是否可以在最大程度保留模型原始正常输出的同时，嵌入鲁棒的指纹信息。我们提出了一种基于同义词感知的逻辑形指纹技术。该技术的核心思想是在逻辑空间中对语义相似的长尾标记的概率分布进行重塑，同时确保原始的最高一级预测标记及其概率保持大致不变。通过将语义簇的整体预测概率提升到远高于自然基线的水平，我们的方法能够巧妙地嵌入指纹信息，同时减少对多模态性能的影响。实验结果表明，SALSF能够在保持多模态性能的同时，显著增强指纹的鲁棒性，为视觉语言模型的知识产权保护提供了一种新的思路。

papers.title: Look Twice before You Leap: A Rational Framework for Localized Adversarial Text Anonymization
papers.title_zh: 在采取行动之前先仔细考虑：一种适用于本地化对抗性文本匿名化的理性框架
papers.authors: Donghang Duan, Xu Zheng, Yuefeng He, Chong Mu, Leyi Cai, Lizong Zhang
papers.abstract: Current LLM-based frameworks for text anonymization usually rely on remote API services from powerful LLMs, which creates an inherent privacy paradox: users must disclose the raw data to untrusted third parties for guaranteed privacy preservation. Moreover, directly migrating current solutions to local small-scale models (LSMs) offers a suboptimal solution with severe utility collapse. Our work argues that this failure stems not merely from the capability deficits of LSMs, but significantly from the inherent irrationality of the greedy adversarial strategies employed by current state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. To address this, we propose Rational Localized Adversarial Anonymization (RLAA), a fully localized and training-free framework featuring an Attacker-Arbitrator-Anonymizer architecture. We model the anonymization process as a trade-off between Marginal Privacy Gain (MPG) and Marginal Utility Cost (MUC), demonstrating that greedy strategies tend to drift into an irrational state. Instead, RLAA introduces an arbitrator that acts as a rationality gatekeeper, validating the attacker’s inference to filter out ghost leaks. This mechanism promotes a rational early-stopping criterion, and structurally prevents utility collapse. Extensive experiments on different benchmarks demonstrate that RLAA achieves a superior privacy-utility trade-off compared to strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前基于大语言模型的文本匿名化框架通常依赖于强大的大语言模型的远程API服务，这导致了一种固有的隐私悖论：用户必须向不可信的第三方提供原始数据，才能确保隐私的保全。此外，直接将现有解决方案迁移到本地小型模型上，虽然能提供一种解决方案，但效果并不理想，且会带来严重的效用损失。我们的研究指出，这种问题的根源不仅在于本地小型模型的能力不足，更在于当前最先进的方法所采用的贪婪对抗策略本身具有不合理性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了理性局部化对抗匿名化技术（RLAA）。这是一种完全局部化的、无需训练的框架，采用攻击者-仲裁者-匿名化器的架构。我们将匿名化过程视为边际隐私收益与边际效用成本之间的权衡，并证明贪婪策略往往会陷入非理性的状态。相反，RLAA引入了一个仲裁者角色，作为理性的监督者，负责验证攻击者的推理结果，从而过滤掉潜在的泄露风险。这一机制促进了理性的提前终止标准，并在结构上避免了效用损失。在不同基准测试上的广泛实验表明，与强大的基线方法相比，RLAA在隐私与效用之间取得了更好的平衡。

papers.title: K-MetBench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Fine-Grained Evaluation of Expert Reasoning, Locality, and Multimodality in Meteorology
papers.title_zh: K-MetBench：一个用于精细评估气象领域专家推理能力、局部性以及多模态性的多维基准测试工具
papers.authors: Soyeon Kim, Cheongwoong Kang, Myeongjin Lee, Eun-Chul Chang, Lee Jaedeok, Jaesik Choi
papers.abstract: The development of practical (multimodal) large language model assistants for Korean weather forecasters is hindered by the absence of a multidimensional, expert-level evaluation framework grounded in authoritative sources. To address this, we introduce K-MetBench, a diagnostic benchmark grounded in national qualification exams. It exposes critical gaps across four dimensions: expert visual reasoning of charts, logical validity via expert-verified rationales, Korean-specific geo-cultural comprehension, and fine-grained domain analysis. Our evaluation of 55 models reveals a profound modality gap in interpreting specialized diagrams and a reasoning gap where models hallucinate logic despite correct predictions. Crucially, Korean models outperform significantly larger global models in local contexts, demonstrating that parameter scaling alone cannot resolve cultural dependencies. K-MetBench serves as a roadmap for developing reliable, culturally aware expert AI agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 为韩国天气预报员开发实用的（多模态）大语言模型助手时，存在一个问题：缺乏基于权威资料的、多维度的专家级评估框架。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了K-MetBench这一基于国家资格考试设计的诊断基准。该基准从四个维度揭示了关键缺陷：专家对图表的可视化推理能力、通过专家验证的合理性逻辑验证、针对韩国的地理文化理解能力，以及细致的领域分析能力。我们对55个模型的评估结果显示，在解读专业图表方面存在严重的模式差异；同时，一些模型在推理过程中出现了逻辑错误，尽管预测结果正确。重要的是，韩国模型在本地情境下的表现明显优于规模更大的全球模型，这表明单纯的参数扩展并不能解决文化依赖性问题。K-MetBench为开发可靠且具备文化意识的专家级AI代理提供了指导方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: V-GameGym: Visual Game Generation for Code Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: V-GameGym：用于大型语言模型的视觉游戏生成技术
papers.authors: Wei Zhang, Jian Yang, Renshuai Tao, Linzheng Chai, Shuyue Guo, Jiajun Wu, Xiaoming Chen, Ganqu Cui, Ning Ding, Xander Xu, HU Wei, Bowen Zhou
papers.abstract: Code large language models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in programming tasks, yet current benchmarks primarily focus on single modality rather than visual game development. Most existing code-related benchmarks evaluate syntax correctness and execution accuracy, overlooking critical game-specific metrics such as playability, visual aesthetics, and user engagement that are essential for real-world deployment. To address the gap between current LLM capabilities in algorithmic problem-solving and competitive programming versus the comprehensive requirements of practical game development, we present V-GameGym, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 2,219 high-quality samples across 100 thematic clusters derived from real-world repositories, adopting a novel clustering-based curation methodology to ensure both diversity and structural completeness. Further, we introduce a multimodal evaluation framework with an automated LLM-driven pipeline for visual code synthesis using complete UI sandbox environments. Our extensive analysis reveals that V-GameGym effectively bridges the gap between code generation accuracy and practical game development workflows, providing quantifiable quality metrics for visual programming and interactive element generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在编程任务中展现出了卓越的能力，然而目前的基准测试主要聚焦于单一模式，而忽略了视觉游戏开发方面的需求。大多数现有的与代码相关的基准测试仅关注语法正确性和执行准确性，却忽视了诸如可玩性、视觉美学以及用户参与度等对实际游戏开发至关重要的指标。为了弥补当前LLM在算法问题解决和竞赛编程方面的能力与实际游戏开发需求之间的差距，我们提出了V-GameGym这一综合性基准测试平台。该平台包含2,219个高质量样本，这些样本来自真实世界的数据库，并分为100个主题集群，采用创新的聚类式筛选方法，以确保测试的多样性和完整性。此外，我们还引入了一种多模态评估框架，该框架采用自动化的LLM驱动流程，用于生成完整的UI沙盒环境中的视觉代码。我们的分析表明，V-GameGym有效地弥合了代码生成准确性与实际游戏开发工作流程之间的差距，为视觉编程和交互元素生成提供了可量化的质量指标。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: UCoder: Unsupervised Code Generation by Internal Probing of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: UCoder：通过深度挖掘大型语言模型的内部机制来实现无监督代码生成
papers.authors: Jiajun Wu, Jian Yang, Wei Zhang, Linzheng Chai, Yuchi Ma, Ensheng Shi, Yuqing Ma, Zhoujun Li, Xianglong Liu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in code generation tasks. However, their effectiveness heavily relies on supervised training with extensive labeled (e.g., question-answering pairs) or unlabeled datasets (e.g., code snippets), which are often expensive and difficult to obtain at scale. To address this limitation, this paper introduces a method IPC, an unsupervised framework that leverages Internal Probing of LLMs for Code generation without any external corpus, even unlabeled code snippets. We introduce the problem space probing, test understanding probing, solution space probing, and knowledge consolidation and reinforcement to probe the internal knowledge and confidence patterns existing in LLMs. Further, IPC identifies reliable code candidates through self-consistency mechanisms and representation-based quality estimation to train UCoder (coder with unsupervised learning). We validate the proposed approach across multiple code benchmarks, demonstrating that unsupervised methods can achieve competitive performance compared to supervised approaches while significantly reducing the dependency on labeled data and computational resources. Analytic experiments reveal that internal model states contain rich signals about code quality and correctness, and that properly harnessing these signals enables effective unsupervised learning for code generation tasks, opening new directions for training code LLMs in resource-constrained scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成任务中展现出了卓越的能力。然而，它们的有效性在很大程度上依赖于有监督的训练，这通常需要大量的标记数据（例如问答对）或未标记的数据集（例如代码片段），而这些数据的获取往往成本高昂且难以大规模实现。为了克服这一限制，本文提出了一种名为IPC的无监督方法。该方法利用语言模型的内部信息来进行代码生成，无需任何外部语料库，甚至不需要未标记的代码片段。我们介绍了问题空间探测、理解度探测、解决方案空间探测以及知识整合与强化等机制，以探究语言模型中存在的内部知识和置信模式。此外，IPC通过自我一致性机制和基于表示的质量评估来识别可靠的代码候选者，从而训练出UCoder——一种采用无监督学习的代码生成器。我们在多个代码基准测试中验证了该方法的有效性，结果表明，无监督方法能够在显著减少对标记数据和计算资源依赖的情况下，达到与有监督方法相当的性能水平。分析实验表明，内部模型状态中包含着关于代码质量和正确性的丰富信息，而合理地利用这些信息可以实现有效的无监督学习，为在资源有限的场景下训练代码语言模型开辟了新的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Deciphering Cultural Representations in Large Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders
papers.title_zh: 通过稀疏自编码器解析大型语言模型中的文化表征
papers.authors: Chenye Zou, Difan Jiao, Lijie Hu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed worldwide, yet they exhibit strong Western-centric biases, and the internal mechanisms governing their cultural behaviors remain poorly understood. Prior work has identified so-called cultural neurons, but individual neurons are often polysemous, conflating abstract cultural knowledge with surface-level lexical cues due to superposition. We apply Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to decompose intermediate LLM activations into sparse, interpretable feature representations that disentangle these factors. This analysis reveals culturally selective features that remain invariant across paraphrasing and task formats, indicating abstraction beyond lexical correlations. Through targeted feature ablation, we provide causal evidence that these features are necessary for cultural reasoning: their removal selectively degrades performance on culturally conditioned tasks. Furthermore, we show that steering model activations along these feature directions is sufficient to systematically modulate cultural-related knowledge generation, without retraining. Together, our results offer the first causal evidence that LLMs encode cultural knowledge as decoupled semantic structures rather than surface patterns, enabling a scalable pathway toward cultural alignment through mechanistic intervention. Code is available at https://github.com/IAN-YE/Cultural-features-SAE.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在全球范围内得到了广泛应用，但它们表现出强烈的西方中心主义偏见，而控制其文化行为的内部机制仍不甚明了。先前的研究已经发现了所谓的文化神经元，但单个神经元往往具有多义性，由于叠加效应，抽象的文化知识与表面上的词汇线索被混为一谈。我们采用稀疏自编码器技术，将大语言模型的中间激活值分解为稀疏且可解释的特征表示，从而分离这些因素。分析结果显示，存在一些在释义和任务形式中保持不变的文化选择性特征，这表明抽象思维超越了词汇关联。通过有针对性的特征删除操作，我们获得了因果证据，证明这些特征是进行文化推理所必需的：移除这些特征会选择性地降低在受文化影响的任务中的性能。此外，我们还发现，通过引导模型激活沿着这些特征方向，可以在不进行重新训练的情况下，系统地调节与文化相关的知识生成。总的来说，我们的研究结果首次提供了因果证据，表明大语言模型将文化知识编码为独立的语义结构，而非表面的模式，这为通过机制干预实现文化对齐提供了一种可扩展的方法。代码可在https://github.com/IAN-YE/Cultural-features-SAE获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Fin-Bias: Comprehensive Evaluation for LLM Decision-Making under human bias in Finance Domain
papers.title_zh: 金融领域下，考虑人类偏见对大型语言模型决策影响的全面评估
papers.authors: Xiaoyu Hu, Jinman Zhao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in financial contexts, raising critical concerns about reliability, alignment, and susceptibility to adversarial manipulation. While prior finance-related benchmarks assess LLMs’ capabilities in stock trading, they are often restricted to small sample and fail to demonstrate LLM susceptibility to context with potential human bias. We introduce Fin-Herding (financial herding under long and uncertain financial context), a benchmark for evaluating LLM investment decision-making when faced with uncertainty and possible human-biased opinions. Fin-Herding includes 8868 long firm-specific analyst reports, including firm aspects summarized and analyzed by sophisticated analysts with investment ratings (Bullish/Neutral/Bearish) spanning from various industries. We present large language models with firm analyst reports with/without analyst investment ratings and even with ’fake’ rating, to get investment ratings generated by LLMs. Our results reveal that LLMs tend to herd the explicit bias in context. We also develop a method to detect potential human opinions, which can encourage LLMs to think independently, some models even exceed human performance in predicting future stock return.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在金融领域的应用日益广泛，但这也引发了对模型可靠性、模型与实际情况的匹配程度以及模型易受对抗性操纵影响的担忧。虽然现有的金融相关基准测试能够评估大语言模型在股票交易方面的能力，但这些测试往往局限于小规模样本，无法充分反映模型在面对可能存在人类偏见的情境时的表现。我们提出了“金融群体行为”这一基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在面临不确定性和可能存在的人类偏见时的投资决策能力。该基准测试包含8868份关于长期股票公司的分析师报告，这些报告由经验丰富的分析师对各个行业的情况进行总结和分析，并给出买入、中性或卖出的投资建议。我们还将大语言模型与这些分析师报告相结合，分别测试了包含分析师投资建议的情况、不包含投资建议的情况，甚至还包括了“虚假”投资建议的情况，以观察大语言模型是否能够生成类似的投资建议。我们的研究结果表明，大语言模型倾向于模仿其中的显性偏见。此外，我们还开发了一种方法来检测潜在的人类意见，这种方法可以促使大语言模型独立思考。有些模型甚至在预测未来股票回报方面超越了人类的表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Duplicate-Aware Controlled Code Generation: Enhancing Copyright Protection with Targeted Reordering Beam Search in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 避免重复出现的受控代码生成：通过定向排序算法在大型语言模型中增强版权保护
papers.authors: Junbo Fu, Guoshuai Zhao, Linkang Yang, Yunqi Mi, Xueming Qian
papers.abstract: The increasing integration of large language models (LLMs) in code generation has raised critical copyright concerns, particularly regarding the verbatim repetition of copyrighted code. To address this challenge, we propose a novel task: Duplicate-Aware Controlled Code Generation (DACCG), which aims to mitigate verbatim repetition while preserving the quality of generated code. To this end, we introduce Targeted Reordering Beam Search (TRBS), a plug-and-play decoding method that dynamically reorders beam candidates to reduce direct copying. TRBS leverages the FM-index for efficient substring detection and employs a spike-entropy-based protection mechanism to safeguard structural anchors critical to code coherence. Experimental results on a multi-language code generation benchmark demonstrate that TRBS effectively reduces verbatim repetition while maintaining functional adequacy. Our research represents a pioneering effort in code copyright protection from the model user’s perspective, offering novel insights into responsible code generation practices.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成中的日益融合引发了严重的版权问题，尤其是关于对受版权保护代码的逐字复制行为。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的任务：重复检测控制式代码生成（DACCG），该任务旨在减少逐字复制现象，同时保持生成代码的质量。为此，我们引入了目标排序束搜索算法（TRBS），这是一种即插即用的解码方法，它能够动态重新排序束候选项，从而减少直接复制的行为。TRBS利用FM索引进行高效的子字符串检测，并采用基于尖峰熵的保护机制来保障对代码连贯性至关重要的结构元素不被破坏。在多语言代码生成基准测试中的实验结果表明，TRBS能够有效减少逐字复制现象，同时保持代码的功能完整性。我们的研究从模型使用者的角度出发，为代码版权保护提供了开创性的解决方案，为负责任代码生成实践提供了新的思路。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Graph-Based Chain-of-Thought Pruning for Reducing Redundant Reflections in Reasoning LLMs
papers.title_zh: 基于图的思维链剪枝技术，用于减少推理大型语言模型中的冗余反射现象
papers.authors: Hongyuan Yuan, Xinran He, Run Shao, Bolei He, Xianwei Xue, Mengke Chen, Qiutong Pan, Haiwei Wang, Haifeng Li
papers.abstract: Extending CoT through RL has been widely used to enhance the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. However, due to the sparsity of reward signals, it can also induce undesirable thinking patterns such as overthinking, i.e., generating redundant intermediate reasoning content. In this work, we argue that a major source of such redundancy is inefficient reflection, which often manifests in two problematic patterns: Indiscriminate Reflection, where the model performs broad, low-impact checks throughout reasoning, and Repetitive Reflection, where it repeatedly re-verifies an already established conclusion. To address this, we introduce a graph-based CoT optimization framework. Specifically, we convert each linear CoT into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) with explicit dependency edges, and design a dual pruning strategy: branch-level pruning removes weakly contributing reflection branches, while depth-level pruning eliminates late-stage re-verification. We distill this behavior via a three-stage pipeline: (1) SFT to initialize the policy on pruned concise traces, (2) DPO to prefer correct but less redundant trajectories, and (3) GRPO with length penalty to jointly optimize answer correctness and efficiency. Experiments show that our approach reduces the average reasoning tokens by 42% while maintaining or improving accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过强化学习来扩展CoT已被广泛用于提升大语言模型的推理能力。然而，由于奖励信号的稀疏性，它也可能引发一些不良的思维模式，比如过度思考，即生成多余的中间推理内容。在这项研究中，我们认为这种冗余的主要来源是无效的反思过程，这种现象通常表现为两种问题模式：无限制的反思，即模型在推理过程中进行大量但影响较小的检查；以及重复性的反思，即模型反复验证已经确定的结论。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于图的CoT优化框架。具体来说，我们将每个线性的CoT转换为一个有向无环图（DAG），并设计了一种双重剪枝策略：分支级剪枝可以去除贡献度较低的反思分支，而深度级剪枝则可以消除后期的重复验证。我们通过一个三阶段的流程来实现这一优化：(1) 使用SFT对经过剪枝后的简洁轨迹进行初始化；(2) 使用DPO来选择正确但冗余度较低的路径；(3) 结合GRPO和长度惩罚机制，共同优化答案的正确性和效率。实验表明，我们的方法能够将平均推理成本降低42%，同时还能保持或提高准确性。

papers.title: Too Good to be Bad: On the Failure of LLMs to Role-Play Villains
papers.title_zh: 好得令人难以置信：关于大型语言模型在扮演反派角色方面的失败之处
papers.authors: Zihao Yi, Qingxuan Jiang, Ruotian Ma, Xingyu Chen, Qu Yang, Mengru Wang, Fanghua Ye, Ying Shen, Zhaopeng Tu, Xiaolong Li, Liefeng Bo
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly tasked with creative generation, including the simulation of fictional characters. However, their ability to portray non-prosocial, antagonistic personas remains largely unexamined. We hypothesize that the safety alignment of modern LLMs creates a fundamental conflict with the task of authentically role-playing morally ambiguous or villainous characters. To investigate this, we introduce the Moral RolePlay benchmark, a new dataset featuring a four-level moral alignment scale and a balanced test set for rigorous evaluation. We task state-of-the-art LLMs with role-playing characters from moral paragons to pure villains. Our large-scale evaluation reveals a consistent, monotonic decline in role-playing fidelity as character morality decreases. We find that models struggle most with traits directly antithetical to safety principles, such as ”Deceitful” and ”Manipulative”, often substituting nuanced malevolence with superficial aggression. Furthermore, we demonstrate that general chatbot proficiency is a poor predictor of villain role-playing ability, with highly safety-aligned models performing particularly poorly. Our work provides the first systematic evidence of this critical limitation, highlighting a key tension between model safety and creative fidelity. Our benchmark and findings pave the way for developing more nuanced, context-aware alignment methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在创意生成任务中的应用越来越广泛，其中包括对虚构角色的模拟。然而，这些模型在塑造非友善、敌对角色方面的能力仍然缺乏深入研究。我们认为，现代语言模型的安全对齐机制与真实扮演道德模糊或反派角色的任务之间存在根本冲突。为了验证这一点，我们提出了“道德角色扮演”基准测试，该数据集包含四个级别的道德对齐等级，并配有平衡测试集，以便进行严谨评估。我们让最先进的语言模型扮演从道德模范到纯粹反派的角色。大规模评估结果显示，随着角色道德性的下降，角色扮演的逼真度呈持续下降趋势。我们发现，模型在处理那些与安全原则直接相悖的特质时表现最为糟糕，例如“欺骗”和“操纵”，它们往往用表面的攻击性来代替复杂的恶意行为。此外，我们还发现，普通聊天机器人的能力并不能很好地预测其扮演反派角色的能力，那些高度符合安全对齐要求的模型表现尤为差劲。我们的研究首次系统地揭示了这一关键限制，并指出了模型安全性与创意逼真性之间的主要矛盾。我们的基准测试和研究结果为开发更精细、更注重上下文对齐的方法铺平了道路。

papers.title: AudioPrivacy: Parallel Audio Dataset for Speaker Profiling with Diverse Audio Types and Rich Attributes
papers.title_zh: 音频隐私：适用于说话者特征分析的平行音频数据集，包含多种类型的音频以及丰富的属性信息
papers.authors: Jiabei He, Yanzhe Zhang, Jiaming Zhou, Hui Wang, Haoqin Sun, Yong Qin
papers.abstract: Speech signals convey abundant speaker-related metadata, yet current privacy research predominantly focuses on identity-centric voiceprint protection, leaving sensitive Speaker Attribute Privacy (SAP) largely underexplored. This paper introduces AudioPrivacy, a large-scale Chinese dataset designed to systematically evaluate SAP leakage in realistic, everyday scenarios. Comprising 227.3 hours of audio from 1,000 speakers, it uniquely encompasses four parallel modalities: speech, singing, paralinguistic expressions, and non-vocal acoustic signals (e.g., footsteps). Annotated with 11 diverse attributes, including fine-grained physiological traits often overlooked in traditional corpora, AudioPrivacy enables a granular analysis of acoustic privacy risks. Our evaluations reveal significant leakage across multiple attributes, even when inferred from non-vocal signals. Furthermore, we demonstrate that state-of-the-art Multimodal Large Language Models (MM LLMs) can precisely profile speakers and exacerbate these risks, underscores the urgent need to rethink privacy-preserving mechanisms in the era of powerful audio foundation models.
papers.abstract_zh: 语音信号包含了大量与说话者相关的元数据，然而当前的隐私研究主要集中在以身份为中心的声纹保护上，而敏感的说话者属性隐私则大多未被充分探索。本文介绍了AudioPrivacy这一大规模中文数据集，该数据集旨在系统评估在现实日常场景中发生的说话者属性泄露问题。该数据集包含来自1000名说话者的227.3小时音频数据，涵盖了四种不同的模态：语音、歌唱、副语言表达以及非语音声学信号（如脚步声）。该数据集标注了11种多样化的属性，其中包括一些在传统语料库中常被忽视的精细生理特征。通过这种细粒度的分析，我们可以准确评估声学隐私风险。我们的评估结果显示，即使是从非语音信号中推断出的信息，也存在着严重的泄露现象。此外，我们还发现，最先进的多模态大语言模型能够精确地描述说话者的特征，从而加剧这些风险。这凸显了在强大的音频基础模型时代，重新思考隐私保护机制的紧迫性。

papers.title: Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning with Pipelined Error-Mitigated Aggregation and Matrix-Wise Freezing
papers.title_zh: 通过管道式误差缓解聚合技术以及矩阵级冻结机制，实现Federated LoRA的微调
papers.authors: Haoran Wang, Xiong Wang, Yuqing Li, Jing Chen, Junyi Zhang, Nan Yan, Kun He, Wei Wang
papers.abstract: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables multiple clients to collaboratively fine-tune large language models (LLMs) without disclosing their raw data. However, existing works often experience performance degradation due to biased model aggregation and are hindered by significant communication and computation burden, both limiting training efficiency. In this paper, we propose iFLoRA, an improved Federated LoRA fine-tuning system for LLMs featuring pipelined error-mitigated model aggregation and adaptive matrix-wise parameter freezing. Specifically, iFLoRA mitigates aggregation error by first reconstructing local update matrices from clients’ low-rank matrices. These are then aggregated into a global update, which is decomposed via singular value decomposition (SVD) to form low-rank matrices for the next round. To mitigate the overhead from SVD, iFLoRA employs a pipeline to overlap global aggregation, local computation, and communication. Additionally, iFLoRA implements an adaptive matrix-wise freezing scheme that assesses their stability and selectively freezes them for adaptively adjusted periods, alleviating client training overheads without compromising model performance. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that iFLoRA can improve time-to-target by 2.17-8.48× than state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at: https://github.com/whr819987540/iflora.
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦低秩适应（LoRA）技术使得多个客户端能够协作式地微调大语言模型（LLM），而无需披露它们的原始数据。然而，现有的方法往往由于模型聚合过程中的偏差而导致性能下降，并且还面临着巨大的通信和计算负担，这些都会限制训练效率。在本文中，我们提出了iFLoRA——一种改进的联邦LoRA微调系统，该系统采用流水线式的错误缓解模型聚合方式，并实现了自适应矩阵级参数冻结机制。具体来说，iFLoRA通过首先从客户端的低秩矩阵重建局部更新矩阵来减轻聚合误差。这些局部更新矩阵随后被整合成全局更新矩阵，再通过奇异值分解（SVD）将其分解为低秩矩阵，以便用于下一轮训练。为了降低SVD带来的计算开销，iFLoRA采用了一种流水线结构，将全局聚合、局部计算以及通信过程有机结合在一起。此外，iFLoRA还实现了一种自适应矩阵级冻结方案，该方案能够评估各矩阵的稳定性，并选择性地在不同的时间段对它们进行冻结处理，从而有效降低客户端的训练负担，同时不影响模型的性能。在真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，iFLoRA能够将目标达成时间缩短2.17到8.48倍。我们的代码可以在以下链接下载：https://github.com/whr819987540/iflora

papers.title: RTCFake: Speech Deepfake Detection in Real-Time Communication
papers.title_zh: RTCFake：实时语音深度伪造检测技术
papers.authors: Jun Xue, Zhuolin Yi, Yihuan Huang, Yanzhen Ren, Yujie Chen, Cunhang Fan, Zicheng Su, Yongcheng Zhang, Bo Cai
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of speech generation technologies, the threat posed by speech deepfakes in real-time communication (RTC) scenarios has intensified. However, existing detection studies mainly focus on offline simulations and struggle to cope with the complex distortions introduced during RTC transmission, including unknown speech enhancement processes (e.g., noise suppression) and codec compression. To address this challenge, we present the first large-scale speech deepfake dataset tailored for RTC scenarios, termed RTCFake, totaling approximately 600 hours. The dataset is constructed by transmitting speech through multiple mainstream social media and conferencing platforms (e.g., Zoom), enabling precise pairing between offline and online speech. In addition, we propose a phoneme-guided consistency learning (PCL) strategy that enforces models to learn platform-invariant semantic structural representations. In this paper, the RTCFake dataset is divided into training, development, and evaluation sets. The evaluation set further includes both unseen RTC platforms and unseen complex noise conditions, thereby providing a more realistic and challenging evaluation benchmark for speech deepfake detection. Furthermore, the proposed PCL strategy achieves significant improvements in both cross-platform generalization and noise robustness, offering an effective and generalizable modeling paradigm.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着语音生成技术的快速发展，实时通信场景中的语音深度伪造问题日益严重。然而，现有的检测研究主要集中在离线模拟上，难以应对实时通信过程中出现的复杂失真现象，包括未知的语音增强处理（如噪声抑制）以及编解码器压缩等因素所带来的影响。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了首个专为实时通信场景设计的大规模语音深度伪造数据集——RTCFake，该数据集包含约600小时的语音数据。该数据集是通过在多个主流社交媒体和会议平台（如Zoom）中传输语音而构建的，从而实现了离线语音与在线语音之间的精确匹配。此外，我们提出了一种基于音素的一致性学习策略，该策略促使模型学习平台不变的语义结构表示。在本文中，RTCFake数据集被划分为训练集、开发集和评估集。评估集还包含了一些未涉及的实时通信平台和复杂的噪声环境，从而为语音深度伪造检测提供了更真实、更具挑战性的评估基准。此外，所提出的PCL策略在跨平台泛化能力和噪声鲁棒性方面都取得了显著改进，提供了一种有效且可推广的建模方法。

papers.title: Progress Ratio Embeddings: An Impatience Signal for Robust Length Control in Neural Text Generation
papers.title_zh: 进度比率嵌入：一种用于实现稳健文本生成的延迟控制机制
papers.authors: Ivanhoé Botcazou, Tassadit Amghar, Sylvain Lamprier, Frédéric Saubion
papers.abstract: Modern neural language models achieve high accuracy in text generation, yet precise control over generation length remains underdeveloped. In this paper, we first investigate a recent length control method based on Reverse Positional Embeddings (RPE) and show its limits when control is requested beyond the training distribution. In particular, using a discrete countdown signal tied to the absolute remaining token count leads to instability. To provide robust length control, we introduce Progress Ratio Embeddings (PRE), as continuous embeddings tied to a trigonometric impatience signal. PRE integrates seamlessly into standard Transformer architectures, providing stable length fidelity without degrading text accuracy under standard evaluation metrics. We further show that PRE generalizes well to unseen target lengths. Experiments on two widely used news-summarization benchmarks and a popular question generation dataset validate these findings.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代神经语言模型在文本生成方面能够实现高准确率，但对其生成长度的控制能力仍然不够完善。在本文中，我们首先研究了一种基于反向位置嵌入的近期长度控制方法，并揭示了当控制范围超出训练分布时该方法存在的局限性。具体来说，使用与剩余令牌数量相关的离散倒计时信号会导致系统不稳定。为了提供更稳健的长度控制机制，我们提出了进度比率嵌入这一连续嵌入方式，该嵌入方式与三角函数相关的延迟信号相结合。进度比率嵌入能够无缝集成到标准的Transformer架构中，从而在标准评估指标下保持稳定的文本准确性，同时不会降低文本质量。我们还证明了进度比率嵌入能够很好地适应未知的目标长度。通过在两个常用的新闻摘要基准测试以及一个流行的问答生成数据集上的实验验证，这些发现得到了证实。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LeakDojo: Decoding the Leakage Threats of RAG Systems
papers.title_zh: LeakDojo：解析RAG系统的泄露威胁
papers.authors: Maosen Zhang, Jianshuo Dong, Lu Boting, Li Wenyue, Xiaoping Zhang, Tianwei Zhang, Han Qiu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to leverage external knowledge, but also exposes valuable RAG databases to leakage attacks. As RAG systems grow more complex and LLMs exhibit stronger instruction-following capabilities, existing studies fall short of systematically assessing RAG leakage risks. We present LeakDojo, a configurable framework for controlled evaluation of RAG leakage. Using LeakDojo, we benchmark six existing attacks across fourteen LLMs, four datasets, and diverse RAG systems. Our study reveals that (1) query generation and adversarial instructions contribute independently to leakage, with overall leakage well approximated by their product; (2) stronger instruction-following capability correlates with higher leakage risk; and (3) improvements in RAG faithfulness can introduce increased leakage risk. These findings provide actionable insights for understanding and mitigating RAG leakage in practice. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/yeasen-z/LeakDojo.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术使得大语言模型能够利用外部知识，但同时也使有价值的RAG数据库面临泄露风险。随着RAG系统的复杂性不断增加，以及LLM展现出更强的指令遵循能力，现有的研究在系统性评估RAG泄露风险方面存在不足。我们提出了LeakDojo这一可配置的框架，用于有针对性地评估RAG的泄露问题。通过LeakDojo，我们对14种LLM、4种数据集以及多种RAG系统进行了6种现有攻击方式的测试。我们的研究发现：(1) 查询生成和对抗性指令分别对泄露行为有独立的影响，整体泄露风险可以通过它们的乘积来近似表示；(2) 更强的指令遵循能力与更高的泄露风险相关；(3) 提高RAG的精确性可能会增加泄露风险。这些发现为理解和缓解实际中的RAG泄露问题提供了有用的见解。我们的代码库可以在https://github.com/yeasen-z/LeakDojo下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CodeWiki: Evaluating AI’s Ability to Generate Holistic Documentation for Large-Scale Codebases
papers.title_zh: CodeWiki：评估人工智能生成大规模代码库整体文档的能力
papers.authors: Anh Nguyen Hoang, Minh Le-Anh, Bach Le, Nghi D. Q. Bui
papers.abstract: Comprehensive software documentation is crucial yet costly to produce. Despite recent advances in large language models (LLMs), generating holistic, architecture-aware documentation at the repository level remains challenging due to complex and evolving codebases that exceed LLM context limits. Existing automated methods struggle to capture rich semantic dependencies and architectural structure. We present \textbf{CodeWiki}, a unified framework for automated repository-level documentation across seven mainstream programming languages. CodeWiki combines top-down hierarchical decomposition with a divide-and-conquer agent system to preserve architectural context and scale documentation generation, and a bottom-up synthesis that integrates textual descriptions with visual artifacts such as architecture and data-flow diagrams. We also introduce \textbf{CodeWikiBench}, a benchmark with hierarchical rubrics and LLM-based evaluation protocols. Experiments show that CodeWiki achieves a 68.79% quality score with proprietary models, outperforming the closed-source DeepWiki baseline by 4.73%, with especially strong gains on scripting languages. CodeWiki is released as open source to support future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 全面的软件文档编制既至关重要，又成本高昂。尽管大语言模型在最近取得了显著进展，但由于代码库复杂且不断演变，要在仓库级别生成全面、注重架构的文档仍然具有挑战性，这超出了大语言模型的上下文处理能力。现有的自动化方法难以捕捉丰富的语义依赖关系和架构结构。我们提出了**CodeWiki**，这是一个跨七种主流编程语言的统一自动化仓库级文档编制框架。CodeWiki结合了自上而下的层次分解方法和分而治之的代理系统，以保留架构上下文并扩展文档生成能力；同时，它还采用了自下而上的合成方式，将文本描述与架构图、数据流图等视觉元素相结合。我们还引入了**CodeWikiBench**，一个包含层次评分标准和基于大语言模型的评估协议的基准测试工具。实验表明，使用CodeWiki可以获得68.79%的质量分数，相比闭源的深层Wiki基线提升了4.73%，尤其是在脚本语言中表现尤为突出。目前，CodeWiki已作为开源项目发布，以支持未来的研究工作。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
