papers.title: ARISE: An Adaptive Resolution-Aware Metric for Test-Time Scaling Evaluation in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: ARISE：一种自适应分辨率感知的度量标准，用于评估大型推理模型中的测试时间伸缩能力
papers.authors: Zhangyue Yin, Qiushi Sun, Zhiyuan Zeng, Zhiyuan Yu, Qipeng Guo, Xuanjing Huang, Xipeng Qiu
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling has emerged as a transformative paradigm for enhancing the performance of large reasoning models, enabling dynamic allocation of computational resources during inference. However, as the landscape of reasoning models rapidly expands, a critical question remains: how can we systematically compare and evaluate the test-time scaling capabilities across different models? In this paper, we introduce ARISE (Adaptive Resolution-aware Scaling Evaluation), a novel metric specifically designed to assess the test-time scaling effectiveness of large reasoning models. Unlike existing evaluation approaches, ARISE incorporates two key innovations: (1) sample-level awareness that effectively penalizes negative scaling behaviors where increased computation leads to performance degradation, and (2) a dynamic sampling mechanism that mitigates the impact of accuracy fluctuations and token count instability on the final assessment. We conduct comprehensive experiments evaluating state-of-the-art reasoning models across diverse domains including mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic tasks. Our results demonstrate that ARISE provides a reliable and fine-grained measurement of test-time scaling capabilities, revealing significant variations in scaling efficiency across models. Notably, our evaluation identifies Claude Opus as exhibiting superior scaling characteristics compared to other contemporary reasoning models.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时间缩放已成为提升大型推理模型性能的一种变革性方法，它能够实现在推理过程中动态分配计算资源。然而，随着推理模型的种类迅速增加，一个关键问题依然存在：我们如何系统地比较和评估不同模型的测试时间缩放能力呢？在本文中，我们提出了ARISE（自适应分辨率感知缩放评估）这一新型指标，专门用于评估大型推理模型的测试时间缩放效果。与现有的评估方法不同，ARISE包含了两项关键创新：(1) 样本级感知机制，能够有效惩罚那些导致性能下降的负面缩放行为；(2) 动态采样机制，能够减轻准确性波动和令牌数量不稳定对最终评估结果的影响。我们通过广泛的实验对包括数学推理、代码生成以及智能体任务在内的多个领域中的先进推理模型进行了评估。我们的结果表明，ARISE提供了一种可靠且细致的测量方法，能够揭示不同模型在缩放效率上的显著差异。值得注意的是，我们的评估结果显示，Claude Opus比其他当代推理模型具有更出色的缩放特性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Breaking the Static Graph: Context-Aware Traversal for Graph-Based RAG
papers.title_zh: 打破静态图表的限制：基于上下文的图式检索方法
papers.authors: Kwun Hang Lau, Fangyuan Zhang, Boyu Ruan, Yingli Zhou, Qintian Guo, Ruiyuan Zhang, Xiaofang Zhou
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have shifted from simple vector similarity to structure-aware approaches like HippoRAG, which leverage Knowledge Graphs (KGs) and Personalized PageRank (PPR) to capture multi-hop dependencies. However, these methods suffer from a “Static Graph Fallacy”: fixed transition probabilities set during indexing ignore query-dependent edgerelevance, causing semantic drift where random walks are diverted into high-degree “hub” nodes before reaching critical evidence. Models often achieve high partial recall but fail to retrieve the complete evidence chain for multi-hop queries. To address this, we propose CatRAG, Context-Aware Traversal for robust RAG, which builds on the HippoRAG 2 and transforms the static KG into a query-adaptive navigation structure. CatRAG steers the random walk via three mechanisms: (1) Symbolic Anchoring, injecting weak entity constraints to regularize the random walk; (2) QueryAware Dynamic Edge Weighting, dynamically modulating graph structure to prune irrelevant paths and amplify query-aligned ones; and (3) Key-Fact Passage Weight Enhancement, a cost-efficient bias anchoring the walk to key evidence. Experiments across multi-hop benchmarks show that CatRAG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. While standard Recall gains are modest, CatRAG achieves substantial improvements in reasoning completeness—the capacity to recover entire evidence chains without gaps. These results reveal that CatRAG effectively bridges the gap between retrieving partial context and enabling fully grounded reasoning. Resources are available at https://github.com/kwunhang/CatRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在检索增强生成技术方面的进展，已经从简单的向量相似性分析转向了基于结构感知的方法，例如HippoRAG。这些方法利用知识图谱和个性化PageRank算法来捕捉多跳依赖关系。然而，这些方法存在“静态图谬误”：在索引过程中固定的转移概率忽略了查询相关的边相关性，导致语义漂移，使得随机游走会优先指向高度连接的“枢纽节点”，从而无法找到关键证据。通常，这些模型能够取得较高的部分召回率，但无法为多跳查询提供完整的证据链。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CatRAG——一种基于上下文感知的遍历技术，它能够将静态知识图谱转化为适应查询需求的导航结构。CatRAG通过三种机制来实现对随机游走的引导：(1)符号锚定，注入弱实体约束以规范随机游走；(2)查询感知的动态边权重调整，动态调整图结构以剔除无关路径，并强化与查询相关的路径；(3)关键事实传递权重增强，以一种成本效益高的方式将游走引导至关键证据。在多个多跳基准测试中的实验表明，CatRAG的表现优于现有的最先进基线方法。虽然标准的召回率提升幅度不大，但CatRAG在推理完整性方面取得了显著改进——即能够在不遗漏任何信息的情况下恢复完整的证据链。这些结果表明，CatRAG有效地弥合了获取部分上下文信息与实现完全基于证据的推理之间的差距。相关资源可访问https://github.com/kwunhang/CatRAG。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: POP: Prefill-Only Pruning for Efficient Large Model Inference
papers.title_zh: POP：仅对预填充数据进行修剪，以实现高效的大型模型推理
papers.authors: Junhui He, Zhihui Fu, Jun Wang, Qingan Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities.However, their deployment is hindered by significant computational costs. Existing structured pruning methods, while hardware-efficient, often suffer from significant accuracy degradation. In this paper, we argue that this failure stems from a stage-agnostic pruning approach that overlooks the asymmetric roles between the prefill and decode stages. By introducing a virtual gate mechanism, our importance analysis reveals that deep layers are critical for next-token prediction (decode) but largely redundant for context encoding (prefill). Leveraging this insight, we propose Prefill-Only Pruning (POP), a stage-aware inference strategy that safely omits deep layers during the computationally intensive prefill stage while retaining the full model for the sensitive decode stage. To enable the transition between stages, we introduce independent Key-Value (KV) projections to maintain cache integrity, and a boundary handling strategy to ensure the accuracy of the first generated token. Extensive experiments on Llama-3.1, Qwen3-VL, and Gemma-3 across diverse modalities demonstrate that POP achieves up to 1.37\times speedup in prefill latency with minimal performance loss, effectively overcoming the accuracy-efficiency trade-off limitations of existing structured pruning methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）展现出了卓越的能力。然而，它们的部署受到高昂计算成本的阻碍。现有的结构化剪枝方法虽然能在硬件上实现高效运行，但往往会导致准确性显著下降。在本文中，我们认为这种失败源于一种不区分不同阶段的剪枝方法，该方法忽略了预填充阶段和解码阶段之间的不对称关系。通过引入虚拟门机制，我们的重要性分析表明，深层网络对于预测下一个词（解码阶段）至关重要，但对于上下文编码（预填充阶段）则几乎毫无用处。基于这一洞察，我们提出了“仅预填充剪枝”策略，这是一种考虑不同阶段特性的推理方法。该策略在计算量较大的预填充阶段安全地省略深层网络，而在敏感的解码阶段则保留完整的模型。为了促进不同阶段之间的过渡，我们引入了独立的键值投影机制来维护缓存的完整性，并采用了边界处理策略来确保第一个生成的词的准确性。在Llama-3.1、Qwen3-VL和Gemma-3等不同模态上的广泛实验表明，“仅预填充剪枝”策略在减少预填充延迟的同时，性能损失最小，有效克服了现有结构化剪枝方法在准确性和效率之间的权衡问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Guardian-as-an-Advisor: Advancing Next-Generation Guardian Models for Trustworthy LLMs
papers.title_zh: 以顾问身份守护者：推动下一代守护者模型的研发，以实现更可靠的大语言模型
papers.authors: Yue Huang, Haomin Zhuang, Jiayi Ye, Han Bao, Yanbo Wang, Hang Hua, Siyuan Wu, Pin-Yu Chen, Xiangliang Zhang
papers.abstract: Hard-gated safety checkers often over-refuse and misalign with a vendor’s model spec; prevailing taxonomies also neglect robustness and honesty, yielding safer-on-paper yet less useful systems. This work introduces Guardian-as-an-Advisor (GaaA), a soft-gating pipeline where a guardian predicts a binary risk label plus a concise explanation and prepends this advice to the original query for re-inference, keeping the base model operating under its original spec. To support training and evaluation, GuardSet is constructed—a 208k+ multi-domain dataset unifying harmful and harmless cases with targeted robustness and honesty slices. GuardAdvisor is trained via SFT followed by RL to enforce label–explanation consistency. GuardAdvisor attains competitive detection accuracy while enabling the advisory workflow; when used to augment inputs, responses improve over unaugmented prompts. A latency study shows advisor inference uses below 5% of base-model compute and adds only 2–10% end-to-end overhead under realistic harmful-input rates. Overall, GaaA steers models to comply with the model spec, maintaining safety while reducing over-refusal.
papers.abstract_zh: 硬门控的安全检查机制往往过度拒绝请求，且与供应商的模型规范不符；现有的分类体系也忽视了系统的稳健性和可靠性，导致系统虽然表面上看起来更安全，但实际上实用性较差。本研究提出了“Guardian-as-Advisor”机制，这是一种软门控流程：由守护者模块对风险进行二元标签标注，并附上简洁的解释，然后将这些建议添加到原始查询中重新进行推理，使基础模型能够按照其原始规范运行。为了支持训练和评估，我们构建了GuardSet数据集——该数据集包含20.8万条多领域数据，涵盖了有害与无害案例，同时具备针对性的稳健性和可靠性要求。GuardAdvisor通过监督学习进行训练，随后通过强化学习来确保标签与解释的一致性。该模型在保持咨询流程的同时，能够实现具有竞争力的检测准确率；当用于增强输入时，其响应效果优于未经增强的提示。延迟测试表明， Advisor的推理过程所使用的计算资源不到基础模型的5%，并且在实际有害输入情况下，端到端的处理开销仅增加2-10%。总体而言，GaaA机制有助于模型遵循规范，既保证了安全性，又减少了过度拒绝的情况。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: StructBreak: Structural Cognitive Overload-Induced Safety Failures in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: 结构破坏：由结构认知过载引发的安全故障在大型在线角色扮演游戏中
papers.authors: Yang Luo, Liu Xinran, TianTian Ji, Zhiyi Yin, Lingyun Peng, Shuyu Li
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at structural reasoning yet suffer from a sharp logical brittleness in structural consistency. We term this phenomenon Structural Cognitive Overload (SCO), a byproduct of the contention between deep reasoning and safety alignment. However, prior work has predominantly targeted typographic and pixel-level perturbations, leaving the study of SCO largely unexplored. To this end, we propose StructBreak, an automated end-to-end framework designed to quantify SCO. By leveraging StructBreak, we uncover a novel higher-order cognitive overload attack paradigm; notably, this attack operates under a practical black-box setting, requiring no internal model access. Consequently, we utilize this framework to establish a comprehensive benchmark spanning ten diverse threat scenarios. Empirical evaluations on six leading MLLMs reveal that SCO readily triggers toxic generation, yielding a 92% average ASR (up to 97% on Gemini 2.5). To elucidate the mechanism of SCO, we further conduct model-level interpretations spanning attention dynamics, latent space topology, and geometric analysis. Our findings reveal that StructBreak acts as a novel structural channel to circumvent safety filters. Furthermore, the limited efficacy of inherent safety mechanisms underscores that current alignment paradigms are insufficient for the era of complex multimodal reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在结构推理方面表现出色，但在结构一致性方面存在严重的逻辑脆弱性。我们将这种现象称为“结构认知过载”（SCO），这是深度推理与安全对齐之间矛盾所导致的副产品。然而，以往的研究主要集中在字型和像素级别的扰动上，而对SCO的研究却鲜有涉及。为此，我们提出了一种名为StructBreak的自动化端到端框架，用于量化SCO。通过利用StructBreak，我们发现了一种新的高阶认知过载攻击方式；值得注意的是，这种攻击可以在实际的非透明环境中进行，无需访问内部模型。因此，我们利用该框架建立了一个涵盖十种不同威胁场景的全面基准测试。对六种主流MLLMs进行的实证评估表明，SCO很容易引发有害的生成行为，其平均准确率达到了92%，在Gemini 2.5上的准确率甚至高达97%。为了阐明SCO的机制，我们还进行了模型层面的分析，包括注意力动态、潜在空间拓扑结构和几何分析。我们的研究发现表明，StructBreak作为一种新的结构通道，可以绕过安全过滤器。此外，现有安全机制的有限效果表明，当前的对齐范式已经无法满足复杂多模态推理时代的需求。

papers.title: Role-Sensitive Neurons: A Neuron-Level Gain Control Mechanism for Confidence Steering
papers.title_zh: 角色敏感神经元：一种基于神经元级别的信心调节控制机制
papers.authors: Peiwen Huang, Chih-Hao Hsu, Tzu-Hung Huang, Shou-De Lin
papers.abstract: Role-playing prompts effectively steer Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the neural mechanism driving this behavioral shift remains unclear. In this work, we identify Role-Sensitive Neurons (RSNs)—a sparse sub-network (≈ 0.5% of all neurons) governing the transition from hesitation to action. Using a novel evaluation framework with explicit abstention (MMLU-E), we reveal a Confidence-Performance Decoupling: roles primarily modulate the model’s probabilistic “willingness to act” rather than its underlying knowledge representation. We demonstrate that RSNs function as a mechanistic gain control system: causal intervention on this subspace allows precise regulation of abstention behavior. Furthermore, cross-model transfer experiments confirm that these circuits are indigenous to pre-training, with Instruction Tuning (SFT) acting merely as a “signal sharpener” to refine latent gain dynamics. Finally, we identify a critical safety boundary: in knowledge-deficient models, amplifying RSNs induces “unwarranted certainty,” highlighting decisiveness as a tunable gain parameter distinct from epistemic truth.
papers.abstract_zh: 角色扮演提示能够有效地引导大语言模型的行为，但驱动这种行为转变的神经机制仍然不清楚。在这项研究中，我们发现了一种名为“角色敏感神经元”的特殊神经元亚群——它们只占所有神经元的约0.5%，却负责调控从犹豫到行动的过渡过程。通过采用一种新的评估框架，并引入明确的回避机制（MMLU-E），我们发现模型的行为与模型的置信度之间存在分离：角色主要影响模型“愿意采取行动”的概率，而非其潜在的知识表示。我们证明，这些角色敏感神经元实际上充当了一种机制性的增益控制系统：对这部分子空间的干预可以精确调节回避行为。此外，跨模型转移实验表明，这些电路在预训练阶段就已经存在，而指令调整则只是起到“信号强化”的作用，用于优化潜在的增益动态。最后，我们发现了一个关键的安全边界：在知识匮乏的模型中，增强这些角色敏感神经元会导致“不必要的确定性”，这表明决策性可以被视为一个可调节的增益参数，它与认知上的真实性是不同的。

papers.title: StreamingEval: A Unified Evaluation Framework towards Realistic Streaming Video Understanding
papers.title_zh: StreamingEval：一个统一的评估框架，旨在实现真实场景下的流媒体视频理解
papers.authors: Tang Guowei, Tianwen Qian, Huanran Zheng, Wang Yifei, Xiaoling Wang
papers.abstract: Real-time, continuous understanding of visual signals is essential for real-world interactive AI applications, and poses a fundamental system-level challenge. Existing research on streaming video understanding, however, typically focuses on isolated aspects such as question-answering accuracy under limited visual context or improvements in encoding efficiency, while largely overlooking practical deployability under realistic resource constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce StreamingEval, a unified evaluation framework for assessing the streaming video understanding capabilities of Video-LLMs under realistic constraints. StreamingEval benchmarks both mainstream offline models and recent online video models under a standardized protocol, explicitly characterizing the trade-off between efficiency, storage and accuracy. Specifically, we adopt a fixed-capacity memory bank to normalize accessible historical visual context, and jointly evaluate visual encoding efficiency, text decoding latency, and task performance to quantify overall system deployability. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets reveal substantial gaps between current Video-LLMs and the requirements of realistic streaming applications, providing a systematic basis for future research in this direction. Codes will be released upon acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 实时、持续地理解视觉信号对于现实世界中的交互式人工智能应用至关重要，这同时也面临着一个基本的系统级挑战。然而，现有的流媒体视频理解研究通常只关注一些孤立的方面，比如在有限的视觉上下文下的问答准确性，或者编码效率的提升，而很大程度上忽略了在现实资源限制下的实际应用可行性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了StreamingEval这一统一的评估框架，用于评估视频语言模型在现实约束条件下的流媒体视频理解能力。StreamingEval通过标准化的协议对主流的离线模型和最新的在线视频模型进行基准测试，明确指出了效率、存储和准确性之间的权衡关系。具体来说，我们采用固定容量的内存库来规范可访问的历史视觉上下文，并联合评估视觉编码效率、文本解码延迟以及任务性能，从而量化整个系统的实际应用能力。在多个数据集上的广泛实验表明，当前的视频语言模型与现实流媒体应用的需求之间存在显著差距，这为未来在这个方向上的研究提供了系统性的基础。代码将在项目被接受后发布。

papers.title: CogGen: A Cognitively Inspired Recursive Framework for Deep Research Report Generation
papers.title_zh: CogGen：一种基于认知创新的递归框架，用于生成深度研究报告
papers.authors: Kuo Tian, Pengfei Sun, Zhen Wu, Junran Ding, Xinyu Dai
papers.abstract: The autonomous synthesis of deep research reports represents a critical frontier for Large Language Models (LLMs), demanding sophisticated information orchestration and non-linear narrative logic. Current approaches rely on rigid predefined linear workflows, which cause error accumulation, preclude global restructuring from subsequent insights, and ultimately limit in-depth multimodal fusion and report quality. We propose CogGen, a Cognitively inspired recursive framework for deep research report Generation. Leveraging a Hierarchical Recursive Architecture to simulate cognitive writing, CogGen enables flexible planning and global restructuring. To extend this recursivity to multimodal content, we introduce Abstract Visual Representation (AVR): a concise intent-driven language that iteratively refines visual-text layouts without pixel-level regeneration overhead. We further present CLEF, a Cognitive Load Evaluation Framework, and curate a new benchmark from Our World in Data (OWID). Extensive experiments show CogGen achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source systems, generating reports comparable to professional analysts’ outputs and surpassing Gemini Deep Research. Our code and dataset will be publicly available upon publication.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度研究报告的自主生成是大语言模型面临的一个关键挑战，它需要复杂的信息编排和非线性叙事逻辑。当前的方法依赖于固定的线性工作流程，这会导致错误累积，无法从后续见解中进行全局重构，从而限制了多模态信息的深度融合以及报告质量。我们提出了CogGen这一基于认知机制的递归框架，用于生成深度研究报告。该框架采用分层递归架构来模拟认知写作过程，从而实现灵活的规划和全局重构。为了将这种递归性扩展到多模态内容，我们引入了抽象视觉表示技术：一种简洁的、以意图为导向的语言，它能够在不产生像素级重建开销的情况下逐步优化视觉文本布局。此外，我们还提出了认知负荷评估框架CLEF，并从我们的数据平台中挑选了新的基准测试样本。大量实验表明，CogGen在开源系统中取得了领先成果，生成的报告质量可与专业分析师的输出相媲美，甚至超越了Gemini Deep Research。我们的代码和数据集将在论文发表后公开提供。

papers.title: Debate to Align: Reliable Entity Alignment through Two-Stage Multi-Agent Debate
papers.title_zh: 辩论对齐：通过两阶段多智能体辩论实现可靠实体对齐
papers.authors: Cunda Wang, Ziying Ma, Po Hu, Weihua Wang, Feilong Bao
papers.abstract: Entity alignment (EA) aims to identify entities referring to the same real-world object across different knowledge graphs (KGs). Recent approaches based on large language models (LLMs) typically obtain entity embeddings through knowledge representation learning and use embedding similarity to identify an alignment-uncertain entity set. For each uncertain entity, a candidate entity set (CES) is then retrieved based on embedding similarity to support subsequent alignment reasoning and decision making. However, the reliability of the CES and the reasoning capability of LLMs critically affect the effectiveness of subsequent alignment decisions. To address this issue, we propose AgentEA, a reliable EA framework based on multi-agent debate. AgentEA first improves embedding quality through entity representation preference optimization, and then introduces a two-stage multi-role debate mechanism consisting of lightweight debate verification and deep debate alignment to progressively enhance the reliability of alignment decisions while enabling more efficient debate-based reasoning. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks under cross-lingual, sparse, large-scale, and heterogeneous settings demonstrate the effectiveness of AgentEA.
papers.abstract_zh: 实体对齐（Entity Alignment, EA）的目的是在不同知识图谱中识别出指代同一现实对象的实体。基于大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的最新方法通常通过知识表示学习来获取实体嵌入，并利用嵌入的相似性来识别对齐不确定的实体集。对于每一个不确定的实体，会根据嵌入的相似性检索出一个候选实体集，以支持后续的对齐推理和决策制定。然而，候选实体集的可靠性以及LLMs的推理能力会严重影响后续对齐决策的有效性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了AgentEA——一个基于多智能体辩论的可靠实体对齐框架。AgentEA首先通过优化实体表示偏好来提高嵌入质量，然后引入了一个两阶段的多角色辩论机制，包括轻量级辩论验证和深度辩论对齐，从而逐步提升对齐决策的可靠性，同时实现更高效的基于辩论的推理。在跨语言、稀疏数据、大规模和异构环境下的公共基准测试中的广泛实验证明了AgentEA的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Exploring Multilingual Pre-trained Language Model for Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis
papers.title_zh: 探索用于基于方面的情感分析的多语言预训练语言模型
papers.authors: Ye Wang, Ruijun Jiang, Zhongqing Wang, Guodong Zhou
papers.abstract: Aspect-based sentiment analysis has garnered increasing attention in the research community; however, most studies have predominantly focused on English datasets, with other languages such as Chinese, Japanese, and German being neglected due to the limited availability of adequately labeled data. Even within English, labeled data is scarce. To address these challenges, this study investigates the utilization of a multilingual pre-trained setting to leverage resources from diverse languages for aspect-based sentiment analysis. Specifically, we propose a Cross-lingual Knowledge Fusion framework that explores various single-round and two-round bilingual pre-training configurations. This framework utilizes both the original and translated texts, along with their corresponding labels, to pre-train the multilingual model. Evaluation results reveal that our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art performance across multiple languages, highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed multilingual pre-trained language model for aspect-based sentiment analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于方面的情感分析在研究界受到了越来越多的关注；然而，大多数研究主要集中在英语数据集上，由于有足够标记的数据资源有限，其他语言如中文、日语和德语则被忽视了。即使在英语领域，标记化的数据也非常稀缺。为了应对这些挑战，本研究探讨了利用多语言预训练模型来从不同语言中获取资源进行方面基础的情感分析的方法。具体来说，我们提出了一种跨语言知识融合框架，该框架探索了多种单轮和两轮双语预训练配置。该框架利用了原始文本及其翻译版本以及相应的标签来进行多语言模型的预训练。评估结果显示，我们的模型在多种语言上的表现显著优于现有最先进的模型，这充分证明了所提出的多语言预训练语言模型在方面基础情感分析中的有效性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Mid-Think: Training-Free Intermediate-Budget Reasoning via Token-Level Triggers
papers.title_zh: 中期思考：通过标记级触发器实现无需训练的中级预算推理能力
papers.authors: Van Yang, Shouren Wang, Debargha Ganguly, Xinpeng Li, Chaoda Song, Vikash Singh, Vipin Chaudhary, Xiaotian Han
papers.abstract: Reasoning language models are controlled through explicit modes such as Think and No-think, yet we find that these behaviors are largely governed by a few token-level triggers rather than high-level instructions. Through attention analysis and controlled prompting experiments, we show that a leading “Okay” token induces reasoning behavior, while the newline pattern following ‘</think>‘ suppresses it. Based on this observation, we propose Mid-Think, a simple training-free prompting format that combines these triggers to achieve intermediate-budget reasoning, consistently outperforming fixed-token and prompt-based baselines in terms of the accuracy–length trade-off. Furthermore, applying Mid-Think to RL training after SFT reduces training time by approximately 15% while improving final performance of Qwen3-8B on AIME from 69.8% to 72.4% and on GPQA from 58.5% to 61.1%, demonstrating its effectiveness for both inference-time control and RL-based reasoning training.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理语言模型是通过诸如“思考”和“不思考”等明确模式来控制的，但我们发现这些行为主要由一些标记级别的触发条件所主导，而非高级指令。通过注意力分析和控制性提示实验，我们发现一个关键的“ okay ”标记能够引发推理行为，而紧随其后的换行符则会抑制这种行为。基于这一发现，我们提出了Mid-Think这一简单的无训练提示格式，该格式结合了这些触发条件，以实现中等预算下的推理能力，并且在准确性与长度之间的权衡方面，始终优于固定标记和基于提示的基线模型。此外，将Mid-Think应用于SFT之后的强化学习训练中，可以将训练时间减少约15%，同时提高Qwen3-8B在AIME上的最终性能，从69.8%提升到72.4%；在GPQA上的性能则从58.5%提升到61.1%。这表明Mid-Think在推理时间控制和基于强化学习的推理训练方面都表现出有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SSR-Zero: Simple Self-Rewarding Reinforcement Learning for Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: SSR-Zero：适用于机器翻译的简单自我奖励强化学习算法
papers.authors: Wenjie Yang, Mao Zheng, Mingyang Song, Zheng Li, Sitong Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in machine translation (MT). However, most advanced MT-specific LLMs rely heavily on external supervision during training, such as human-annotated reference data or trained reward models (RMs), which are expensive to obtain and difficult to scale. To address this limitation, we propose Simple Self-Rewarding (SSR), a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for MT that is reference-free and relies solely on self-judging rewards. Using only 13K monolingual examples and Qwen-2.5-7B as the backbone, SSR-Zero-7B outperforms existing MT-specific LLMs as well as larger general LLMs such as Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct on English \leftrightarrow Chinese translation benchmarks including WMT23, WMT24, and FLORES200. It further demonstrates strong generalization to low-resource language pairs. In addition, when augmented with external supervision from COMET, our strongest model, SSR-X-Zero-7B, surpasses all existing open-source models under 72B parameters and performs competitively with leading closed-source systems in English \leftrightarrow Chinese translation. Our analysis highlights the effectiveness and generalizability of the self-rewarding mechanism relative to external LLM-as-a-judge approaches and demonstrates its complementary benefits when combined with trained RMs. We will publicly release our code, data, and models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在机器翻译领域展现出了显著的能力。然而，大多数先进的针对机器翻译的LLM在训练过程中严重依赖外部监督，比如由人类标注的参考数据或经过训练的奖励模型。这些资源获取成本高昂，且难以大规模扩展。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了Simple Self-Rewarding（SSR）这一强化学习框架，该框架无需参考数据，完全依赖于自我评估的奖励机制。仅使用13K单语言示例以及Qwen-2.5-7B作为骨干模型，SSR-Zero-7B在包括WMT23、WMT24和FLORES200在内的英译中翻译任务中，表现优于现有的针对机器翻译的LLM以及更大规模的通用LLM，如Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct。此外，当结合COMET提供的外部监督时，我们的最强模型SSR-X-Zero-7B在参数规模不超过72B的情况下，仍能够超越所有现有的开源模型，并在英译中翻译任务中与领先的闭源系统展开竞争。我们的分析表明，与传统的外部LLM作为评判机制相比，自我奖励机制具有更高的有效性和泛化能力。同时，当与经过训练的奖励模型结合使用时，这种机制还能发挥额外的优势。我们将公开我们的代码、数据和模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HisDoc-OCR: Restoring Visual Grounding in MLLMs for Chinese Historical Document OCR
papers.title_zh: HisDoc-OCR：在中文历史文档的OCR处理中恢复视觉上的层次感
papers.authors: Jiahuan Cao, Yongxin Shi, Zeyu Shan, Zhengyang Lu, Lianwen Jin
papers.abstract: Chinese historical documents encode millennia of cultural heritage, yet remain largely inaccessible to computational analysis. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on modern document OCR, their application to historical Chinese texts suffers from severe hallucinations, character fabrication, uncontrolled repetition, and semantic drift. We identify the root cause as visual-textual misalignment: models prioritize linguistic priors over visual evidence, particularly problematic when archaic orthography and degraded image quality destabilize cross-modal correspondences. To address this, we propose HisDoc-OCR, which restores visual grounding through three synergistic strategies: (1) Layout Injection, which encodes two-dimensional layout structures into textual outputs using layout-aware delimiters; (2) First-Occurrence Boost, which emphasizes vision-dependent characters during training by reweighting first-occurrence characters; (3) Self-Distilled Attention Focusing, which guides the model’s attention by distilling patterns from the most focused layer to the remaining layers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HisDoc-OCR consistently outperforms general-purpose and OCR-specific MLLMs. The code will be publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 中国历史文献承载着数千年的文化遗产，但至今仍难以通过计算机分析进行解读。虽然多模态大语言模型在现代文档OCR方面取得了显著成效，但在处理中国历史文本时却存在严重的错误识别、字符生成问题、重复现象失控以及语义漂移等问题。我们认为问题的根源在于视觉与文本之间的不匹配：模型更倾向于依赖语言上的先验知识而非视觉信息，尤其是在古老的书写方式或图像质量不佳的情况下，这种不匹配会进一步加剧问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了HisDoc-OCR算法。该算法通过三种协同策略来恢复视觉信息：第一，利用布局注入技术，将二维布局结构编码到文本输出中，使用具有布局感知的标记符；第二，通过“首次出现字符强化”策略，在训练过程中给予视觉依赖性较强的字符更高的权重；第三，采用“自提取注意力聚焦”技术，将模型注意力集中在最活跃的区域，从而引导模型正确解析文本。大量实验表明，HisDoc-OCR在性能上始终优于通用大语言模型和专用OCR模型。该算法的代码已公开提供，可供大家使用。

papers.title: One LLM Does Not Simulate All Students: Ability-Aware Student Simulation via Cognitive Diagnosis Guided LLM Assignment
papers.title_zh: 单个大语言模型无法模拟所有学生的情况：通过认知诊断来模拟具有不同能力的学生，这一过程由大语言模型负责完成
papers.authors: Huixing Que, Qi Liu, Weibo Gao, Zhenya Huang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become integral to personalized education systems, particularly in the realm of student behavior simulation. By predicting fine-grained learning behaviors, these simulations enable intelligent systems to provide tailored instructional support. However, most existing methods rely on a single high-capacity LLM to represent an entire population of diverse learners. In this work, we demonstrate that this “one-size-fits-all” approach induces a systematic ability-dependent bias, where high-capacity models tend to overestimate low-ability students while lower-capacity models underestimate high-ability ones. To mitigate this distortion, we propose an ability-aware student simulation framework that dynamically matches students with appropriate LLM backbones through cognitive alignment. We leverage Neural Cognitive Diagnosis (NeuralCD) to extract multidimensional cognitive profiles for both human students and LLM agents within a shared skill space, subsequently pairing each student with the most cognitively representative model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach substantially reduces simulation bias and consistently outperforms single-model baselines across the entire proficiency spectrum. Our findings suggest that faithful behavior simulation necessitates the alignment of model capacity with student ability, establishing cognitive diagnosis as a principled mechanism for model assignment in educational AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为个性化教育系统的核心组成部分，尤其是在学生行为模拟领域。通过预测细致的学习行为，这些模拟技术使得智能系统能够提供个性化的教学支持。然而，目前大多数方法都依赖于一个高容量的LLM来代表所有不同能力的学生群体。在这项研究中，我们发现这种“一刀切”的方法会导致系统性地基于能力的偏差——高容量模型往往高估低能力学生的表现，而低容量模型则低估高能力学生的表现。为了减轻这种偏差，我们提出了一种基于能力感知的学生模拟框架，该框架通过认知对齐机制，动态地将学生与合适的LLM模型进行匹配。我们利用神经认知诊断技术，从共享技能空间中提取人类学生和LLM代理的多维认知特征，然后将每个学生与最具认知代表性的模型进行配对。大量实验表明，我们的方法显著减少了模拟中的偏差，并且在整个能力范围内始终优于单一模型的基线方法。我们的研究结果表明，要实现真实的行为模拟，就必须使模型的能力与学生的能力相匹配，因此，认知诊断可以被视为在教育人工智能中分配模型的一种有效机制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Interactive Learning for LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 用于大型语言模型推理的交互式学习
papers.authors: Hehai Lin, Shilei Cao, Sudong Wang, Haotian Wu, Minzhi Li, Linyi Yang, Juepeng Zheng, Chengwei Qin
papers.abstract: Existing multi-agent learning approaches explicitly foster collaboration among Large Language Models (LLMs) to build stronger multi-agent systems (MAS), yet they still rely on re-executing the MAS during inference. This contrasts with human cognition, wherein individuals can internalize insights from interactions to improve later independent reasoning. To investigate whether multi-agent interaction can enhance LLMs’ independent problem-solving ability, we propose ILR (Interactive Learning for LLM Reasoning), a co-learning framework that integrates Dynamic Interaction and Perception Calibration. Dynamic Interaction adaptively selects cooperative or competitive strategies based on question difficulty and model capability, after which LLMs exchange information via Idea3 framework (Idea Sharing, Idea Analysis, and Idea Fusion), an interaction paradigm simulating human discussion, before producing final answers. Perception Calibration employs Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) while integrating one LLM’s reward characteristics into another’s to strengthen interaction cohesion. We evaluate the effectiveness of ILR across three LLMs from two model families of varying scales on five mathematical and one coding benchmarks. We further investigate the advantage of Dynamic Interaction (i.e., boosting the robustness of stronger LLMs and surpassing pure strategy), and the scalability of ILR beyond two-model interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的多智能体学习方法明确促进了大语言模型之间的协作，以构建更强大的多智能体系统。不过，这些方法仍然需要在推理过程中重新执行多智能体的交互过程。这与人类认知不同，人类能够将从互动中获得的见解内化为自己的能力，从而提升后续的独立推理能力。为了研究多智能体交互是否能够提高大语言模型的独立解决问题的能力，我们提出了ILR——一种结合动态交互和感知校准的协同学习框架。动态交互会根据问题的难度和模型的性能自适应地选择合作或竞争策略，之后大语言模型通过Idea3框架进行信息交换（即想法分享、想法分析和想法融合），这种交互方式模拟了人类的讨论过程，最终得出答案。感知校准则采用群体相对策略优化技术，同时将一个大语言模型的奖励特征融入另一个模型中，以增强交互的凝聚力。我们在五个数学基准测试和一个编程基准测试上评估了ILR的有效性，这些测试涉及来自两个不同模型家族的三种大语言模型。我们还研究了动态交互的优势，即提升较强大语言模型的鲁棒性并超越纯策略，以及ILR在超过两个模型交互时的可扩展性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Style Amnesia: Investigating Speaking Style Degradation and Mitigation in Multi-Turn Spoken Language Models
papers.title_zh: 风格遗忘：探究多轮语音模型中的说话风格退化问题及其缓解方法
papers.authors: Yu-Xiang Lin, Cheng-Han Chiang, Hung-yi Lee
papers.abstract: In this paper, we show that when spoken language models (SLMs) are instructed to speak in a specific speaking style at the beginning of a multi-turn conversation, they cannot maintain the required speaking styles after several turns of interaction; we refer to this as the style amnesia of SLMs. We focus on paralinguistic speaking styles, including emotion, accent, volume, and speaking speed. We evaluate three proprietary and two open-source SLMs, demonstrating that none of these models can maintain a consistent speaking style when instructed to do so. We further show that while SLMs can recall the style instruction when prompted in later turns, they still fail to express it, but through explicit recall can mitigate style amnesia. In addition, SLMs struggle more when the style instruction is placed in system messages rather than user messages, even though system messages are specifically designed to provide persistent, conversation-level instructions. Our findings highlight a systematic gap in current SLMs’ ability to maintain speaking styles, highlighting the need for improved style adherence in future models. Our code and evaluation data are publicly available at https://github.com/YuXiangLin1234/SLM-Style-Amnesia.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们指出，当口语模型在多轮对话开始时被要求采用特定的说话风格时，它们无法在多次互动后保持该说话风格。我们将这种现象称为口语模型的“风格遗忘”。我们重点关注副语言方面的说话风格，包括情绪、口音、声音大小和说话速度等。我们对三种专有模型和两种开源模型进行了评估，结果表明，这些模型在被迫保持某种说话风格时都无法做到一致。此外，虽然口语模型可以在后续对话中被提示时回忆起之前的风格指令，但它们仍然无法真正表达出这种风格，不过通过明确的回忆可以一定程度上缓解风格遗忘问题。另外，当风格指令出现在系统消息中而不是用户消息中时，口语模型的表现会更差，尽管系统消息的设计初衷就是提供持续性的、符合对话要求的指令。我们的研究结果揭示了当前口语模型在保持说话风格方面的系统性缺陷，这凸显了未来模型需要改进其风格一致性能力。我们的代码和评估数据可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/YuXiangLin1234/SLM-Style-Amnesia
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: NeuroSym-Cal: Bridging the Reasoning-Execution Gap in Code Generation via Hierarchical Calibration
papers.title_zh: NeuroSym-Cal：通过分层校准来弥补代码生成中的推理与执行之间的差距
papers.authors: Peiyang Liu, Yining Wang, Youru Li, Long Li, Zhi Cai, Wei Ye
papers.abstract: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning enhances code generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), it introduces a critical challenge in uncertainty estimation: Confidence Saturation. Existing calibration methods, such as Self-Consistency, rely on the assumption that consensus implies correctness. This assumption fails under systematic errors, where models confidently repeat flawed logic, leading to miscalibrated high-confidence predictions. To address this, we introduce NeuroSym-Cal, a hierarchical calibration framework. We posit that reliable confidence requires interrogating the model at two complementary levels: the extrinsic consensus of its symbolic outputs and the intrinsic sensitivity of its latent reasoning. Specifically, we propose Reasoning Sensitivity Analysis to measure the local curvature of the deductive process via latent perturbation, providing a fine-grained signal that persists even when output consensus saturates. These orthogonal features are fused by a Contextual Calibration Network to predict correctness. Experiments across state-of-the-art reasoning models (e.g., DeepSeek-R1) demonstrate that NeuroSym-Cal effectively de-saturates overconfident errors, achieving state-of-the-art Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and superior selective generation performance on Out-Of-Domain (OOD) benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然思维链推理能够提升大语言模型中的代码生成能力，但它也带来了不确定性估计中的一个关键挑战：置信度饱和问题。现有的校准方法，如自我一致性方法，都基于这样一个假设：达成共识就意味着模型是正确的。然而，在系统错误的情况下，这种假设就不成立了，因为模型可能会自信地重复有缺陷的逻辑，从而导致高置信度的预测出现偏差。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种分层校准框架——NeuroSym-Cal。我们认为，要获得可靠的置信度，需要在两个互补的层面上进行模型评估：其一是其符号输出的外在一致性；其二是其潜在推理的内在敏感性。具体来说，我们提出了推理敏感性分析这一方法，通过潜在的扰动来测量演绎过程的局部曲率，这种方法能够提供一种细粒度的信号，即使输出的一致性达到了饱和状态，这种信号仍然持续存在。这些正交特征通过上下文校准网络进行融合，以预测模型的正确性。在最新的推理模型（例如DeepSeek-R1）上的实验表明，NeuroSym-Cal能够有效地消除过度自信的错误，从而在领域外基准测试中取得了领先的性能表现，其预期校准误差指标也达到了最佳水平。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GOBench: Stage-Wise Diagnostics and the Visual Paradox in Multimodal Graph Optimization
papers.title_zh: GOBench：分阶段诊断方法以及多模态图优化中的视觉悖论
papers.authors: Yinghao Chen, Wantong Xie, Shuli Zeng, Sijia Zhang, Xiaotian Pan, Feng Wu, Xiangyang Li
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as optimization assistants to produce solutions, generate solver-executable programs, or both. However, current evaluations are misaligned with deployment in three ways: they (P1) fail to represent multimodal problem specifications, (P2) score outcomes only and cannot localize where failures occur along the modeling pipeline, and (P3) rarely report inference cost, obscuring reliability–cost trade-offs. We introduce Graph Optimization benchmark (GOBench), an aligned multimodal benchmark with solver-derived oracles and a four-layer diagnostic protocol that evaluates intermediate artifacts as well as end results, together with the Visual Inference Penalty (VIP) to measure multimodal overhead. Across frontier and open-weight models under paired text-only vs. T+V settings, we find that vision reliably increases inference cost, while its reliability impact is regime-dependent: frontier models often benefit from visual grounding, whereas several mid-tier/open models exhibit a Visual Paradox where vision reduces downstream executability and verification coverage. End-to-end success is frequently bottlenecked by intermediate-stage dropout; supervised fine-tuning on intermediate targets can mitigate this attrition in open models, enabling a reproducible harness for diagnosing failure modes and quantifying reliability–cost trade-offs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）和视觉-语言模型（VLM）越来越多地被用作优化辅助工具，以生成解决方案、编写可执行的求解程序，或者同时实现这两种功能。然而，当前的评估方式在三个方面与实际部署存在不匹配的情况：首先，这些评估无法准确反映多模态问题的特性；其次，它们仅对结果进行评分，而无法定位建模过程中出现的故障点；最后，它们很少报告推理成本，这导致难以判断可靠性与成本之间的权衡关系。我们提出了图优化基准测试（GOBench），这是一个针对多模态问题的对齐基准测试，包含由求解器生成的预言器以及一套四层诊断协议，该协议能够评估中间产物以及最终结果，同时还引入了视觉推理惩罚指标来衡量多模态处理过程中的开销。在文本单独输入与文本与视觉信息共同输入的情况下，我们发现视觉信息确实会增加推理成本，而其影响程度则因模型类型而异：前沿模型通常可以从视觉引导中受益，而一些中等级别或开源模型则会出现“视觉悖论”现象，即视觉信息会降低下游的可执行性和验证覆盖率。端到端的成功往往受到中间阶段的损失所限制；通过对中间目标进行有监督的微调，可以减轻开源模型中这种损失现象，从而为诊断故障模式和量化可靠性与成本之间的权衡关系提供了一种可复用的方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Sparse Growing Transformer: Training-Time Sparse Depth Allocation via Progressive Attention Looping
papers.title_zh: 稀疏生长变换器：通过渐进式注意力循环实现训练过程中的稀疏深度分配
papers.authors: Yao Chen, Yilong Chen, Yinqi Yang, Junyuan Shang, Zhenyu Zhang, Zefeng Zhang, Shuaiyi Nie, Shuohuan Wang, Yu Sun, Hua Wu, Haifeng Wang, Tingwen Liu
papers.abstract: Existing approaches to increasing the effective depth of Transformers predominantly rely on parameter reuse, extending computation through recursive execution.Under this paradigm, the network structure remains static along the training timeline, and additional computational depth is uniformly assigned to entire blocks at the parameter level.This rigidity across training time and parameter space leads to substantial computational redundancy during training.In contrast, we argue that depth allocation during training should not be a static preset, but rather a progressively growing structural process. Our systematic analysis reveals a deep-to-shallow maturation trajectory across layers, where high-entropy attention heads play a crucial role in semantic integration. Motivated by this observation, we introduce the Sparse Growing Transformer (SGT).SGT is a training-time sparse depth allocation framework that progressively extends recurrence from deeper to shallower layers via targeted attention looping on informative heads. This mechanism induces structural sparsity by selectively increasing depth only for a small subset of parameters as training evolves.Extensive experiments across multiple parameter scales demonstrate that SGT consistently outperforms training-time static block-level looping baselines under comparable settings, while reducing the additional training FLOPs overhead from approximately 16–20% to only 1–3% relative to a standard Transformer backbone.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前提高Transformer有效深度的方法主要依赖于参数复用，通过递归执行来扩展计算量。在这种模式下，网络结构在训练过程中保持不变，而额外的计算深度则被均匀地分配给整个模块中的参数。这种在训练时间和参数空间上的固定性导致了训练过程中的大量计算冗余。相反，我们认为在训练过程中对深度的分配不应是固定的预设，而应是一个逐渐增长的结构化过程。我们的系统分析揭示了不同层之间从深到浅的成熟轨迹，其中高熵注意力机制在语义整合中起着关键作用。基于这一观察，我们提出了稀疏生长Transformer（SGT）模型。SGT是一种在训练过程中进行稀疏深度分配的框架，它通过有针对性地关注某些信息丰富的层，逐步将递归计算扩展到更深层次的层。这种机制通过仅在训练过程中选择性地增加少数参数的深度，从而实现了结构的稀疏性。在多个参数规模下的广泛实验表明，SGT在类似条件下始终优于那些采用静态块级循环的基线模型，同时还将额外的训练计算量开销从大约16-20%降低到仅1-3%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Computational Narrative Understanding for Expressive Text-to-Speech
papers.title_zh: 用于表达性文本转语音功能的计算性叙事理解技术
papers.authors: Gaspard Michel, Elena V. Epure, Christophe Cerisara
papers.abstract: Recent advances in text-to-speech (TTS) have been driven by large, multi-domain speech corpora, yet the expressive potential of audiobook data remains underexamined. We argue that human-narrated audiobooks, particularly fictional works, contain rich and diverse prosodic cues arising from the natural alternation between neutral narration and expressive character dialogue. Building from this observation, we introduce LibriQuote, a large-scale 5.3K hours of expressive speech drawn from character quotations.Each quote is supplemented with contextual pseudo-labels for speech verbs and adverbs that characterize the intended delivery of direct speech (e.g., “he whispered softly”).We found that fine-tuning a flow-matching model on LibriQuote yields substantial improvements in expressivity and intelligibility, while training from scratch enhances expressiveness of an autoregressive TTS model.Benchmarking on LibriQuote-test highlights significant variability across systems in generating expressive speech.We publicly release the dataset, code, and evaluation resources to facilitate reproducibility.Audio samples can be found at https://libriquote.github.io/.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，文本转语音技术取得了显著进展，这主要得益于大规模、多领域的语音语料库。然而，有声书数据的表现力潜力仍然没有得到充分探索。我们认为，由人类讲述的有声书，尤其是虚构作品，包含了丰富多样的韵律特征，这些特征源于中性叙述与富有表现力的角色对话之间的自然交替。基于这一观察，我们推出了LibriQuote数据集，该数据集包含5.3千小时的角色台词数据。每个台词都附有上下文标签，用于标注说话者的动词和副词，以体现直接引语的呈现方式（例如，“他轻声说道”）。我们发现，在LibriQuote数据集上微调流匹配模型可以显著提高语音的表现力和可理解性；而从头开始训练自回归式语音合成模型则能进一步提升其表现力。在LibriQuote测试集上的基准测试表明，不同系统在生成富有表现力的语音方面存在显著差异。我们公开了该数据集、代码以及评估资源，以便其他研究人员能够复现我们的研究成果。音频样本可以在https://libriquote.github.io/下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DataSage: Multi-agent Collaboration for Insight Discovery with External Knowledge Retrieval, Multi-role Debating, and Multi-path Reasoning
papers.title_zh: DataSage：支持多智能体协作的洞察发现工具，具备外部知识检索功能、多角色讨论机制以及多路径推理能力
papers.authors: Xiaochuan Liu, Yuanfeng Song, Xiaoming Yin, Xing Chen
papers.abstract: In today’s data-driven era, fully automated end-to-end data analytics, particularly insight discovery, is critical for discovering actionable insights that assist organizations in making effective decisions. With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), LLM-driven agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for automating insight discovery. However, existing data insight agents remain limited in several key aspects, often failing to deliver satisfactory results due to: (1) insufficient utilization of domain knowledge, (2) shallow analytical depth, and (3) error-prone code generation. To address these issues, we propose DataSage, a novel multi-agent framework that incorporates three innovative features including external knowledge retrieval to enrich the analytical context, a multi-role debating mechanism to simulate diverse analytical perspectives and deepen analytical depth, and multi-path reasoning to improve the accuracy of the generated code and insights. Extensive experiments on InsightBench demonstrate that DataSage consistently outperforms existing data insight agents across all difficulty levels, improving by 7.5% and 13.9% respectively in the insight-level and summary-level metrics. It offers an effective solution for automated data insight discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 在当今这个以数据为驱动的时代，完全自动化的端到端数据分析，尤其是洞察发现，对于发现有助于组织做出有效决策的可操作见解至关重要。随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，由LLM驱动的智能体已成为自动化洞察发现的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的数据洞察智能体在多个关键方面仍然存在局限性，常常因为以下原因而无法提供令人满意的结果：(1) 对领域知识的利用不足；(2) 分析深度浅；(3) 代码生成容易出错。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了DataSage这一新型多智能体框架。该框架具有三个创新特性：通过外部知识检索来丰富分析背景；通过多角色辩论机制来模拟不同的分析视角并加深分析深度；通过多路径推理来提高生成代码和见解的准确性。在InsightBench上的广泛实验表明，DataSage在所有难度级别上均优于现有的数据洞察智能体，在洞察级和摘要级指标上分别提高了7.5%和13.9%。它为自动化数据洞察发现提供了一种有效的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Eliminating Out-of-Domain Recommendations in LLM-based Recommender Systems: A Unified View
papers.title_zh: 在基于大语言模型的推荐系统中剔除域外推荐：一种统一的视角
papers.authors: Hao Liao, Jiwei Zhang, Jianxun Lian, Wensheng Lu, Mingqi Wu, Shuowangg, Yong Zhang, Yitian Huang, Mingyang Zhou, Rui Mao
papers.abstract: Recommender systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs) are often plagued by hallucinations of out-of-domain (OOD) items. To address this, we propose RecLM, a unified framework that bridges the gap between retrieval and generation by instantiating three grounding paradigms under a single architecture: embedding-based retrieval, constrained generation over rewritten item titles, and discrete item-tokenizer generation. Using the same backbone LLM and prompts, we systematically compare these three views on public benchmarks. RecLM strictly eradicates OOD recommendations (OOD@10 = 0) across all variants, and the constrained generation variants RecLM-cgen and RecLM-token achieve overall state-of-the-art accuracy compared to both strong ID-based and LLM-based baselines. Our unified view provides a systematic basis for comparing three distinct paradigms to reduce item hallucinations, offering a practical framework to facilitate the application of LLMs to recommendation tasks. Source code is at https://github.com/microsoft/RecAI.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的推荐系统常常受到领域外项目幻觉问题的困扰。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了RecLM这一统一框架，该框架通过在一个架构下实现三种不同的生成方式，来弥补检索与生成之间的差距：基于嵌入的检索、对重写后的项目标题进行约束性生成，以及离散的项目标记生成。我们使用相同的主干语言模型和提示语，在公共基准测试中对这三种方式进行了系统的比较。RecLM能够严格消除所有变体中的领域外推荐问题（OOD@10 = 0），而受限生成变体RecLM-cgen和RecLM-token的准确率则达到了与基于强ID的方法和基于LLM的方法相当的水平。我们的统一框架为比较这三种不同的生成方式提供了系统性的基础，有助于减少项目幻觉问题，并为将LLM应用于推荐任务提供了实用的框架。源代码可以在https://github.com/microsoft/RecAI获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Evian: Towards Explainable Visual Instruction-tuning Data Auditing
papers.title_zh: 依云：迈向可解释的视觉教学调整数据审核技术
papers.authors: Zimu Jia, Mingjie Xu, Andrew Estornell, Jiaheng Wei
papers.abstract: The efficacy of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) is critically dependent on the quality of their training data, requiring a precise balance between visual fidelity and instruction-following capability. Existing datasets, however, are plagued by inconsistent quality, and current data filtering methods rely on coarse-grained scores that lack the granularity to identify nuanced semantic flaws like logical fallacies or factual errors. This creates a fundamental bottleneck in developing more reliable models. To address this, we make three core contributions. First, we construct a large-scale, 300K-sample benchmark by systematically injecting diverse, subtle defects to provide a challenging testbed for data auditing. Second, we introduce a novel “Decomposition-then-Evaluation” paradigm that breaks model responses into constituent cognitive components: visual description, subjective inference, and factual claim, enabling targeted analysis. Third, we instantiate this paradigm via EVIAN (Explainable Visual Instruction-tuning Data AuditiNg), an automated framework that evaluates these components along the orthogonal axes of Image-Text Consistency, Logical Coherence, and Factual Accuracy. Our empirical findings challenge the prevailing scale-centric paradigm: a model fine-tuned on a compact, high-quality subset curated by EVIAN consistently surpassed models trained on orders-of-magnitude larger datasets. We also reveal that dividing complex auditing into verifiable subtasks enables robust curation, and that Logical Coherence is the most critical factor in data quality evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型的有效性在很大程度上取决于其训练数据的质量，需要在视觉逼真度和指令遵循能力之间找到精确的平衡。然而，现有的数据集存在质量不统一的问题，当前的数据过滤方法依赖于粗略的评分标准，缺乏识别细微语义缺陷的精细度，比如逻辑谬误或事实错误。这成为了开发更可靠模型的根本瓶颈。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了三项核心贡献。首先，我们构建了一个包含30万样本的大规模基准测试集，通过系统地引入各种细微的缺陷来提供具有挑战性的数据审计平台。其次，我们提出了一种新颖的“分解-评估”范式，将模型响应分解为多个认知组成部分：视觉描述、主观推理和事实陈述，从而实现有针对性的分析。第三，我们通过EVIAN（可解释视觉指令调整数据审计）这一自动化框架来实现这一范式，该框架能够沿着图像-文本一致性、逻辑连贯性和事实准确性这三个正交轴来评估这些组成部分。我们的实证研究发现挑战了目前以规模为中心的范式：一个在EVIAN精心挑选的简洁且高质量的数据子集上进行的模型微调，其性能始终优于在规模大几个数量级的数据集上训练的模型。我们还发现，将复杂的审计任务分解为可验证的子任务能够实现有效的数据筛选，而逻辑连贯性是评估数据质量时最重要的因素。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Iterative Self-Correction for Text-Driven Person Re-Identification with Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于大型视觉语言模型的文本驱动人物重识别迭代自我校正方法
papers.authors: Guijin Luo, Zequn Xie, Sihang Cai, Chuxin Wang, Zhou Zhao, Yixuan Tang
papers.abstract: Person Re-Identification (ReID) has long struggled with the semantic gap between low-level visual features and high-level identity concepts. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer promising semantic understanding, existing methods typically adopt a static “one-pass” paradigm, converting images to text once for retrieval. This approach suffers from two critical flaws: Information Bottleneck, where converting rich visuals into text causes detail loss, and Open-Loop Failure, where initial hallucinations propagate without recourse. To address this, we propose Auto-ReID, a novel framework that reformulates ReID as an iterative “Think-and-Refine” process. We first introduce a Hierarchical Progressive Tuning strategy to transform a generic VLM into a specialized Re-ID expert. During inference, we deploy a closed-loop architecture comprising a Reasoner for structured attribute extraction, a Hybrid Retriever that anchors dynamic semantic queries with stable visual features to prevent drift, and a Corrector that deconstructs and verifies candidates to iteratively optimize the search. Extensive experiments on ReID datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, particularly in complex occlusion scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 人物识别问题长期以来一直存在低级视觉特征与高级身份概念之间的语义鸿沟。虽然视觉语言模型在语义理解方面具有潜力，但现有方法通常采用静态的“一次性处理”模式，即一次将图像转换为文本以便检索。这种方法的两个关键缺陷是：信息瓶颈问题，即将丰富的视觉信息转换为文本会导致细节丢失；以及开放循环失败问题，即初始的幻觉现象会持续传播而得不到解决。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了Auto-ReID这一创新框架，它将人物识别问题重新定义为一个迭代的“思考与优化”过程。我们首先采用了分层渐进式调优策略，将通用的视觉语言模型转化为专门的人物识别专家模型。在推理过程中，我们采用了闭环架构，包括用于结构化属性提取的推理器、能够将动态语义查询与稳定视觉特征相结合以防止漂移的混合检索器，以及用于分解和验证候选对象的修正器，从而逐步优化搜索过程。在大量人物识别数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在复杂遮挡场景下表现显著优于现有方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Breaking Contextual Inertia: Reinforcement Learning with Single-Turn Anchors for Stable Multi-Turn Interaction
papers.title_zh: 打破情境惯性：利用单轮次锚点进行强化学习，以实现稳定多轮次交互
papers.authors: Xingwu Chen, Zhanqiu Zhang, Steven Y. Guo, Difan Zou
papers.abstract: While LLMs demonstrate strong reasoning capabilities when provided with full information in a single turn, they exhibit substantial vulnerability in multi-turn interactions. Specifically, when information is revealed incrementally or requires updates, models frequently fail to integrate new constraints, leading to a collapse in performance compared to their single-turn baselines. We term the root cause as Contextual Inertia: a phenomenon where models rigidly adhere to previous reasoning traces. Even when users explicitly provide corrections or new data in later turns, the model ignores them, preferring to maintain consistency with its previous (incorrect) reasoning path. To address this, we introduce Reinforcement Learning with Single-Turn Anchors (RLSTA), a generalizable training approach designed to stabilize multi-turn interaction across diverse scenarios and domains. RLSTA leverages the model’s superior single-turn capabilities as stable internal anchors to provide reward signals. By aligning multi-turn responses with these anchors, RLSTA empowers models to break contextual inertia and self-calibrate their reasoning based on the latest information. Experiments show that RLSTA significantly outperforms standard fine-tuning and abstention-based methods. Notably, our method exhibits strong cross-domain generalization (e.g., math to code) and proves effective even without external verifiers, highlighting its potential for general-domain applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在一次性提供完整信息时能够展现出强大的推理能力，但在多轮交互中却存在显著缺陷。具体来说，当信息逐步被揭示或需要更新时，模型往往无法整合新的约束条件，导致其性能与一次性交互时的基准水平相比大幅下降。我们认为问题的根源在于“上下文惯性”：即模型固执地遵循之前的推理路径。即使用户在后续轮次中明确提供了修正或新数据，模型仍会忽略这些信息，坚持使用之前错误的推理路径。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了基于单轮锚点的强化学习方法（RLSTA）。这是一种通用的训练方法，旨在稳定不同场景和领域中的多轮交互。RLSTA利用模型在单次交互中的优势能力作为稳定的内部锚点来提供奖励信号。通过将多轮交互结果与这些锚点进行对齐，RLSTA能够促使模型打破上下文惯性，并根据最新信息自行调整其推理方式。实验表明，RLSTA的性能明显优于传统的微调方法和基于回避的方法。值得注意的是，我们的方法具有出色的跨领域泛化能力（例如，从数学到编程），并且即使没有外部验证器也能表现出良好的效果，这凸显了其在通用领域应用中的潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Label Words as Local Task Vectors in In-Context Learning
papers.title_zh: 在上下文学习中，将标签词视为局部任务向量
papers.authors: Bowen Zheng, Ming Ma, Zhongqiao Lin, Tianming Yang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable abilities, one of the most important being in-context learning (ICL). With ICL, LLMs can derive the underlying rule from a few demonstrations and provide answers that comply with the rule. Previous work hypothesized that the network creates a task vector in specific positions during ICL. The task vector can be computed by averaging across the dataset. It conveys the overall task information and can thus be considered global. Patching the global task vector allows LLMs to achieve zero-shot performance with dummy inputs comparable to few-shot learning. However, we find that such a global task vector does not exist in all tasks, especially in tasks that rely on rules that can only be inferred from multiple demonstrations, such as categorization tasks. Instead, the information provided by each demonstration is first transmitted to its answer position and forms a local task vector associated with the demonstration. In some tasks but not in categorization tasks, all demonstrations’ local task vectors converge in later layers, forming the global task vector. We further show that local task vectors encode a high-level abstraction of rules extracted from the demonstrations. Our study provides novel insights into the mechanism underlying ICL in LLMs, demonstrating how ICL may be achieved through an information aggregation mechanism.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）展现出了卓越的能力，其中最重要的能力之一就是上下文学习（ICL）。通过ICL，LLM能够从少量示例中推导出底层规则，并给出符合该规则的答案。之前的研究认为，在ICL过程中，网络会在特定位置生成任务向量。这个任务向量可以通过对数据集进行平均运算得到，它代表了整个任务的信息，因此可以被视为全局性的。通过填充这个全局任务向量，LLM能够在使用虚拟输入时实现零样本性能，这与少样本学习的效果相当。然而，我们发现并非所有任务都存在这样的全局任务向量，尤其是在那些需要基于多个示例才能推断出的规则的任务中，比如分类任务。相反，每个示例提供的信息首先会被传输到对应的答案位置，从而形成与该示例相关的局部任务向量。在某些任务中，这些局部任务向量会在后期阶段汇聚，形成全局任务向量。我们还发现，局部任务向量编码了从示例中提取出的高级规则抽象。我们的研究为理解LLM中ICL的机制提供了新的见解，表明ICL可能是通过信息聚合机制来实现的。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CoGR-MoE: Concept-Guided Expert Routing with Consistent Selection and Flexible Reasoning for Visual Question Answering
papers.title_zh: CoGR-MoE：基于概念的专家路由算法，能够实现一致的选路决策与灵活的推理机制，适用于视觉问答领域的问题解决
papers.authors: Xiyin Zeng, Yi Lu, Hao Wang
papers.abstract: Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires models to identify the correct answer options based on both visual and textual evidence. Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) methods improve option reasoning by grouping similar concepts or routing based on examples. However, unstable routing can lead to inconsistent expert selection in the same question type, while overly stable routing may reduce flexibility. To address this, we propose Concept-Guided Routing framework (CoGR-MoE), which incorporates semantics of the answer options to guide expert selection in the training phase.Next, option features are used to reweight the selected experts, producing discriminative representations for each candidate option. These option-level representations are further used for option comparison and optimized via contrastive learning. The experimental results indicate that CoGR-MoE delivers strong performance across multiple VQA tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉问答任务（VQA）要求模型能够根据视觉和文本信息来识别正确的答案选项。最近的混合专家方法通过分组相似的概念或基于示例进行路由处理，从而提升了选项推理的能力。然而，不稳定的路由处理可能会导致同一问题类型中专家选择的不一致性，而过于稳定的路由处理则可能降低灵活性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了概念引导路由框架（CoGR-MoE），该框架在训练阶段结合答案选项的语义信息来指导专家选择。接下来，利用选项特征对选定的专家进行重新加权，为每个候选选项生成具有区分性的表示。这些选项级别的表示随后被用于选项比较，并通过对比学习进行优化。实验结果表明，CoGR-MoE在多个VQA任务中表现出强大的性能，证明了我们的方法的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Which Pieces Does Unigram Tokenization Really Need?
papers.title_zh: 究竟哪些词语需要被进行单字分词处理呢？
papers.authors: Sander Land, Yuval Pinter
papers.abstract: The Unigram tokenization algorithm offers a probabilistic alternative to the greedy heuristics of Byte-Pair Encoding. Despite its theoretical elegance, its implementation in practice is complex, limiting its adoption to the SentencePiece package and adapters thereof. We bridge this gap between theory and practice by providing a clear guide to implementation and parameter choices. We also identify a simpler algorithm that accepts slightly higher training loss in exchange for improved compression.
papers.abstract_zh: Unigram分词算法提供了一种概率性的替代方案，用于取代Byte-Pair编码中的贪婪启发式方法。尽管该算法在理论上有很高的效率，但在实际实现过程中却相当复杂，因此它的应用主要局限于SentencePiece框架及其相关适配器。我们通过提供一份清晰的实现指南和参数选择建议，来弥合理论与实践之间的差距。此外，我们还提出了一种更简单的算法，这种算法虽然接受的训练损失略高，但能够带来更好的压缩效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Step Potential Advantage Estimation: Harnessing Intermediate Confidence and Correctness for Efficient Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 步势优势估计：利用中等程度的置信度与准确性来实现高效的数学推理
papers.authors: Fei Wu, Zhenrong Zhang, Qikai Chang, Jianshu Zhang, Quan Liu, Jun Du
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) elicits long chain-of-thought reasoning in large language models (LLMs), but outcome-based rewards lead to coarse-grained advantage estimation. While existing approaches improve RLVR via token-level entropy or sequence-level length control, they lack a semantically grounded, step-level measure of reasoning progress. As a result, LLMs fail to distinguish necessary deduction from redundant verification: they may continue checking after reaching a correct solution and, in extreme cases, overturn a correct trajectory into an incorrect final answer. To remedy the lack of process supervision, we introduce a training-free probing mechanism that extracts intermediate confidence and correctness and combines them into a Step Potential signal that explicitly estimates the reasoning state at each step. Building on this signal, we propose Step Potential Advantage Estimation (SPAE), a fine-grained credit assignment method that amplifies potential gains, penalizes potential drops, and applies penalty after potential saturates to encourage timely termination. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show SPAE consistently improves accuracy while substantially reducing response length, outperforming strong RL baselines and recent efficient reasoning and token-level advantage estimation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/cii030/SPAE-RL.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够激发大语言模型中的复杂思维过程，但基于结果的奖励方式会导致优势估计过于粗略。虽然现有方法通过令牌级熵或序列级长度控制来改进RLVR，但它们缺乏一种具有语义基础、能够精确衡量推理进度的评估机制。因此，大语言模型难以区分必要的推导与多余的验证工作：它们可能会在找到正确解决方案后继续检查，在极端情况下，甚至会将正确的路径转变为错误的答案。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了一种无需训练的探测机制，该机制可以提取中间层的置信度与正确性信息，并将它们整合为“步长势能信号”，从而明确反映每一步的推理状态。在此基础上，我们提出了“步长势能优势估计”方法，这是一种细粒度的奖励分配机制，它能够放大潜在的收益，对潜在的损失进行惩罚，并在潜在收益达到饱和时施加惩罚措施，以促进模型的及时终止。在多个基准测试中的实验表明，SPAE能够持续提升准确性，同时显著缩短响应时间，其表现优于现有的强AI基线模型以及最近出现的高效推理和令牌级优势估计方法。相关代码可在https://github.com/cii030/SPAE-RL下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When depth is redundant: Efficient transformer-based speech anti-spoofing
papers.title_zh: 当深度特征变得多余时：基于变换器的语音防冒名顶替技术变得非常高效
papers.authors: Hoan My Tran, Damien Lolive, Aghilas Sini, Arnaud Delhay, Pierre-Francois Marteau, David Guennec
papers.abstract: Detecting speech deepfakes is critical for protecting society against fraud, identity theft, and the misuse of modern speech synthesis technologies. Despite recent progress, existing countermeasures often exhibit limited generalization to unseen spoofing attacks, particularly in out-of-domain evaluation settings, even when achieving strong in-domain performance. Transformer architectures have become ubiquitous in anti-spoofing, serving both as feature extractors (e.g., wav2vec 2.0) and as classifiers. However, deep transformer stacks exhibit substantial representational redundancy across adjacent layers, with similarity increasing toward deeper layers. As a result, task-specific specialization is largely concentrated in the final layers, while shallow layers remain underutilized during fine-tuning. In this work, we analyze the layer-wise behavior of transformer-based classifiers for speech deepfake detection and propose a training strategy that explicitly aligns shallow and intermediate representations with those of the final transformer layer. By encouraging all layers to mimic the task-specialized representation learned at depth, the model more effectively exploits early-layer features while preserving discriminative capacity in deeper layers. This design improves robustness to unseen spoofing attacks and enhances out-of-domain generalization. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent performance gains over strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 检测语音深度伪造对于保护社会免受欺诈、身份盗窃以及现代语音合成技术的滥用至关重要。尽管最近取得了一些进展，但现有的对策往往在面对未见过的伪造攻击时表现有限，尤其是在域外评估场景中，即使在这些场景中的性能表现优异。Transformer架构在反伪造技术中已经变得非常普遍，它们既可以作为特征提取器（例如wav2vec 2.0），也可以作为分类器使用。然而，深度Transformer堆栈在相邻层之间存在着显著的表示冗余性，随着层次加深，相似性逐渐增加。因此，任务特定的专门化主要集中在前几个层，而较浅的层在微调过程中则被过度利用。在这项研究中，我们分析了基于Transformer的分类器在语音深度伪造检测方面的逐层行为，并提出了一种训练策略，该策略将浅层和中间层的表示与最终Transformer层的表示进行明确对齐。通过鼓励所有层模仿在深层学到的任务特定表示，模型能够更有效地利用早期层的特征，同时保留深层层的判别能力。这种设计提高了模型对未见过的伪造攻击的鲁棒性，并增强了域外泛化能力。在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，该模型的性能始终优于强大的基线模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GCoT-Decoding: Unlocking Deep Reasoning Paths for Universal Question Answering
papers.title_zh: GCoT解码：解锁实现通用问答系统深度推理的路径
papers.authors: Guanran Luo, Wentao Qiu, Zhongquan Jian, Meihong Wang, Qingqiang Wu
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning can enhance large language models (LLMs), but it requires manually designed prompts to guide the model. Recently proposed CoT-decoding enables the model to generate CoT-style reasoning paths without prompts, but it is only applicable to problems with fixed answer sets. To address this limitation, we propose a general decoding strategy—GCoT-decoding—that extends applicability to a broader range of question-answering tasks. GCoT-decoding employs a two-stage branching method combining Fibonacci sampling and heuristic error backtracking to generate candidate decoding paths. It then splits each path into a reasoning span and an answer span to accurately compute path confidence, and finally aggregates semantically similar paths to identify a consensus answer, replacing traditional majority voting. We conduct extensive experiments on six datasets covering both fixed and free QA tasks. Our method not only maintains strong performance on fixed QA but also achieves significant improvements on free QA, demonstrating its generality.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链推理能够提升大语言模型的能力，但这种方法需要手动设计提示来引导模型进行推理。最近提出的思维链解码技术使得模型能够在没有提示的情况下生成类似思维链推理的路径，不过该技术仅适用于具有固定答案集的问题。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种通用的解码策略——GCoT解码，该策略能够将适用范围扩展到更多类型的问题解答任务中。GCoT解码采用两阶段分支方法，结合斐波那契采样和启发式错误回溯技术来生成候选解码路径。然后，它将每条路径划分为推理段和答案段，从而准确计算路径的置信度。最后，通过汇总语义相似的路径来识别共识答案，从而替代传统的多数投票方式。我们在包含固定答案集和自由答案集的六个数据集上进行了广泛的实验验证。我们的方法不仅在固定答案集的问题上保持了出色的性能，而且在自由答案集的问题上也取得了显著的改进，充分体现了其通用性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PerMemSafe: Benchmarking Implicit Personalized Safety of Long Horizon Self-Evolving Agents
papers.title_zh: PerMemSafe：针对长期运行的自进化智能体，评估其隐式个性化安全性的基准测试
papers.authors: Hengyu An, Minxi Li, Naen Xu, Chunyi Zhou, Xiaogang Xu, Tianyu Du, Jinbao Li, Shouling Ji
papers.abstract: Self-evolving agents achieve personalization by accumulating user-specific memories over long horizons. This capability, however, introduces novel safety risks, as responses that are generally safe may become harmful in user-specific contexts. Such safety-relevant contexts often emerge implicitly and evolve over time during long-horizon conversations, rendering traditional context-independent safety evaluations insufficient. To address this, we formally define Implicit Personalized Safety and present PerMemSafe, the first benchmark for evaluating implicit personalized safety of self-evolving agents in long-horizon interactions. Empirical results reveal significant limitations of existing self-evolving agents, with even the strongest achieving only around 50% safety rate, highlighting systematic failures in reasoning about personalized safety risks. To mitigate this, we propose SentinelMem, an active risk-aware memory framework that explicitly models personalized risk inference and memory evolution. Experiments show that SentinelMem improves implicit personalized safety by 23.8% over prior memory frameworks while maintaining helpfulness in long-horizon interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 自我进化的智能体通过积累长期范围内的用户特定记忆来实现个性化。然而，这种能力也带来了新的安全风险，因为那些通常安全的响应在特定用户情境下可能会变得有害。这类与安全相关的情境往往是在长期对话过程中隐式产生的，并且会随时间演变，因此传统的与情境无关的安全性评估方法已经不足以应对这种情况。为了解决这一问题，我们正式定义了“隐性个性化安全性”概念，并提出了PerMemSafe——首个用于评估自我进化智能体在长期互动中的隐性个性化安全性的基准测试。实验结果表明，现有的自我进化智能体存在显著局限性，即使是最强大的智能体，其安全性也只有大约50%，这凸显了在个性化安全风险推理方面的系统性缺陷。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了SentinelMem——一个主动的风险感知记忆框架，它能够明确模拟个性化风险推断和记忆的演变过程。实验表明，SentinelMem在保持长期互动中有效性的同时，能够将隐性个性化安全性提升23.8%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TagRAG: Tag-guided Hierarchical Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: TagRAG：基于标签引导的层次化知识图谱检索增强生成技术
papers.authors: Wenbiao Tao, Xinyuan Li, Yunshi Lan, Weining Qian
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation enhances language models by retrieving external knowledge to support informed and grounded responses. However, traditional RAG methods rely on fragment-level retrieval, limiting their ability to address query-focused summarization queries. GraphRAG introduces a graph-based paradigm for global knowledge reasoning, yet suffers from inefficiencies in information extraction, costly resource consumption, and poor adaptability to incremental updates. To overcome these limitations, we propose TagRAG, a tag-guided hierarchical knowledge graph RAG framework designed for efficient global reasoning and scalable graph maintenance. TagRAG introduces two key components: (1) Tag Knowledge Graph Construction, which extracts object tags and their relationships from documents and organizes them into hierarchical domain tag chains for structured knowledge representation, and (2) Tag-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation, which retrieves domain-centric tag chains to localize and synthesize relevant knowledge during inference. This design significantly adapts to smaller language models, improves retrieval granularity, and supports efficient knowledge increment. Extensive experiments on UltraDomain datasets spanning Agriculture, Computer Science, Law, and cross-domain settings demonstrate that TagRAG achieves an average win rate of 78.36% against baselines while maintaining about 14.6x construction and 1.9x retrieval efficiency compared with GraphRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成通过检索外部知识来增强语言模型，从而支持有根据且合理的回答。然而，传统的RAG方法依赖于片段级别的检索，这限制了它们处理以查询为中心的摘要问题的能力。图RAG引入了基于图的全局知识推理范式，但存在信息提取效率低下、资源消耗较大以及难以适应增量更新的问题。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了TagRAG——一种以标签引导的层次化知识图谱RAG框架，旨在实现高效的全局推理和可扩展的图维护功能。TagRAG包含两个关键组件：(1) 标签知识图谱构建，该组件从文档中提取对象标签及其关系，并将它们组织成层次化的领域标签链，以实现结构化的知识表示；(2) 标签引导的检索增强生成，该组件检索以领域为中心的标签链，在推理过程中定位并合成相关知识。这种设计能够很好地适应较小的语言模型，提高检索的粒度，并支持高效的知识更新。在涵盖农业、计算机科学、法律等多个领域的UltraDomain数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，TagRAG在平均胜率方面达到了78.36%，同时与GraphRAG相比，其构建效率和检索效率分别提高了约14.6倍和1.9倍。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Danger Depends on the Mind: A Theory-of-Mind Grounded Dataset and Model for Context-Dependent Dangerous Speech
papers.title_zh: 危险源于心理：一种基于思维能力的数据集及模型，用于分析情境依赖的危险言语行为
papers.authors: Yuanchen Shi, Longyin Zhang, Guodong Zhou, Fang Kong
papers.abstract: Dangerous speech detection is a well-studied task, but existing approaches typically treat utterances in isolation, relying on binary labels that ignore who is speaking and in what mental state. We formulate a context-dependent variant of this task by grounding it in Theory-of-Mind (ToM). In cognitive science, ToM studies how humans attribute latent mental states-such as emotions, intentions, and actions-to others. We argue that such states are key signals for assessing the risk of an utterance. Building on this view, we construct ToM-DS, a 79K-instance dataset where each utterance is paired with structured speaker profiles, ToM states (emotion, intent, action), and topic hierarchies. During data construction, we first identify context-dependent sentences and generate diverse safe and dangerous scenarios surrounding them. High-quality annotations are obtained with state-of-the-art LLMs and a multi-stage cross-agent validation pipeline, yielding a comprehensive and reliable resource for context-dependent dangerous speech detection and fine-grained risk level classification. We further propose ToMGuard, a lightweight model with a dynamic ToM attention mechanism that adaptively weighs different mental-state cues. ToMGuard outperforms strong proprietary and open-source LLMs with significantly fewer parameters. Experimental results show that ToMGuard sets a new benchmark for context-dependent dangerous speech detection and risk level classification on ToM-DS.
papers.abstract_zh: 危险言论检测是一项已被广泛研究的任务，但现有的方法通常将话语孤立处理，仅依赖二元标签来识别谁在说话以及其心理状态。我们提出了一种基于心理模型的理论的、依赖于上下文的任务变体。在认知科学中，心理模型研究人类如何将对潜在的心理状态（如情绪、意图和行动）进行归因。我们认为，这些状态是评估言论风险的关键信号。基于这一观点，我们构建了一个包含7.9万条实例的数据集ToM-DS，其中每条话语都伴随着结构化的说话者信息、心理模型状态（情绪、意图、行动）以及主题层次结构。在数据构建过程中，我们首先识别出依赖于上下文的句子，并生成围绕这些句子的各种安全与危险场景。通过使用最先进的大语言模型和多阶段跨代理验证流程，我们获得了高质量的注释数据，从而形成了一种全面且可靠的资源，用于基于上下文的危险言论检测以及细粒度的风险等级分类。此外，我们还提出了ToMGuard模型，这是一个轻量级模型，具有动态的心理模型注意力机制，能够自适应地权衡不同的心理状态线索。ToMGuard在参数数量显著减少的情况下，表现优于许多强大的专有和开源大语言模型。实验结果表明，ToMGuard为基于上下文的危险言论检测及ToM-DS上的风险等级分类设定了新的基准。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: One Token Is Enough: Improving Diffusion Language Models with a Sink Token
papers.title_zh: 一个标记就足够了：利用“ sink token”来改进扩散语言模型
papers.authors: Zihou Zhang, Zheyong Xie, Li Zhong, Haifeng Liu, Shaosheng Cao
papers.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as a compelling alternative to autoregressive approaches, enabling parallel text generation with competitive performance. Despite these advantages, there is a critical instability in DLMs: the moving sink phenomenon. Our analysis indicates that sink tokens exhibit low-norm representations in the Transformer’s value space, and that the moving sink phenomenon serves as a protective mechanism in DLMs to prevent excessive information mixing. However, their unpredictable positions across diffusion steps undermine inference robustness. To resolve this, we propose a simple but effective extra sink token implemented via a modified attention mask. Specifically, we introduce a special token constrained to attend solely to itself, while remaining globally visible to all other tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that introducing a single extra token stabilizes attention sinks, substantially improving model performance. Crucially, further analysis confirms that the effectiveness of this token is independent of its position and characterized by negligible semantic content, validating its role as a robust and dedicated structural sink.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）作为一种有竞争力的替代自回归方法出现，能够实现并行文本生成，并具备出色的性能。尽管具有这些优势，但DLM存在一个关键的不稳定性问题：移动源现象。我们的分析表明，源节点在Transformer的价值空间中呈现出低范数表示，而移动源现象在DLM中起到了防止信息过度混合的保护机制作用。然而，源节点在不同扩散步骤中的不可预测位置会削弱模型的推理能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种简单但有效的额外源节点方案，该节点通过修改注意力掩码来实现。具体来说，我们引入了一个特殊的节点，该节点仅关注自身，同时仍然对其它所有节点可见。实验结果表明，引入一个额外的节点能够稳定源节点行为，显著提升模型性能。更重要的是，进一步分析证实，这个节点的有效性与其位置无关，且其语义内容可以忽略不计，这验证了它作为稳健且专门的结构性源节点的作用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Thunder-KoNUBench: A Corpus-Aligned Benchmark for Korean Negation Understanding
papers.title_zh: Thunder-KOConUBench：一种与韩语否定理解相关的基准测试算法
papers.authors: Sungmok Jung, Yeonkyoung So, Joonhak Lee, Sangho Kim, Yelim Ahn, Jaejin Lee
papers.abstract: Although negation is known to challenge large language models (LLMs), benchmarks for evaluating negation understanding—especially in Korean—are scarce. We conduct a corpus-based analysis of Korean negation and show that LLM performance degrades under negation. We then introduce Thunder-KoNUBench, a sentence-level negation understanding benchmark that reflects the empirical distribution of Korean negation phenomena. Evaluating 47 LLMs on Thunder-KoNUBench, we analyze the effects of model size and instruction tuning, and perform error analysis to better understand model behavior. We further show that fine-tuning on Thunder-KoNUBench improves negation understanding and broader contextual comprehension in Korean.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然已知否定句会挑战大语言模型（LLM）的性能，但用于评估否定句理解能力的基准测试——尤其是在韩语中——却非常少。我们对韩语中的否定句进行了基于语料库的分析，发现当存在否定句时，LLM的性能会下降。随后，我们开发了Thunder-KoNUBench这一句子级否定句理解基准测试，该测试能够反映韩语否定句的实际情况。我们在Thunder-KoNUBench上对47个LLM进行了评估，分析了模型规模及指令调整对性能的影响，并进行了错误分析以更好地理解模型的行为。此外，我们还发现，在Thunder-KoNUBench上进行微调可以提升LLM对韩语否定句的理解和更广泛的上下文理解能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Progra: Progress-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Function Calling
papers.title_zh: Progra：基于进度的强化学习，适用于多轮函数调用场景
papers.authors: Huacan Chai, Zijie Cao, Maolin Ran, Yingxuan Yang, Jianghao Lin, Xin Peng, Hairui Wang, Renjie Ding, Ziyu Wan, Muning Wen, Weiwen Liu, Weinan Zhang, Fei Huang, Ying Wen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive success in single-turn function calling, yet real-world applications such as travel planning or multi-stage data analysis typically unfold across multi-turn conversations. In these settings, LLMs must not only issue accurate function calls at each step but also maintain progress awareness, the ability to summarize past interactions and plan future actions to ensure coherent, long-horizon task execution. Existing approaches, however, either reduce multi-turn training to isolated single-turn samples, which neglects task-level planning, or employ end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) that struggles with redundancy and lacks explicit integration of progress awareness. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Progra, a framework that explicitly incorporates progress awareness into LLM training for multi-turn function calling. Progra combines (i) a Progress Awareness Generation (PAG) pipeline, which automatically constructs datasets coupling conversation summaries with future task planning, and (ii) a Progress Awareness-Guided Reinforcement Learning (PAG-RL) algorithm, which integrates progress awareness into RL training to reduce contextual redundancy and improve alignment between local actions and global task completion. Empirical results on two public benchmarks demonstrate that Progra significantly outperforms existing methods, highlighting the effectiveness of progress awareness in enabling robust and efficient multi-turn function calling. Our code is available at https://github.com/FatCatCHC/Progra .
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在单轮功能调用方面取得了显著的成功，然而在实际应用场景中，如旅行规划或多阶段数据分析，通常需要进行多轮对话。在这种情况下，大语言模型不仅要能够在每一轮中准确调用功能，还要具备进度感知能力，即能够总结之前的互动情况并规划未来的行动，以确保任务的长期有效执行。不过，现有的方法要么将多轮训练简化为单轮样本，从而忽略了任务级别的规划；要么采用端到端强化学习算法，但这种方式难以处理冗余问题，且缺乏对进度感知的明确整合。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了Progra框架。该框架将进度感知能力明确地融入到了大语言模型的多轮功能调用训练中。Progra结合了两种机制：(1) 进度感知生成模块，它能够自动构建将对话摘要与未来任务规划相结合的数据集；(2) 进度感知引导强化学习算法，该算法将进度感知能力整合到强化学习训练中，从而减少上下文冗余，提高局部行动与全局任务完成之间的协同性。在两个公开基准测试上的实验结果表明，Progra在性能上明显优于现有方法，这充分证明了进度感知在实现高效多轮功能调用中的重要作用。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/FatCatCHC/Progra下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Towards Modern Topic Models: A Survey of Taxonomies and Paradigm Shifts from Algorithm-Centric to LLM-Centered Topic Analysis
papers.title_zh: 迈向现代主题模型：从以算法为中心到以大型语言模型为中心的主题分析分类与范式转变研究综述
papers.authors: Xuan Xu, Zhongliang Yang, Haolun Li, Rui Tian, Beilin Chu, J Song, Yu Li, Shaolin Tan, Linna Zhou
papers.abstract: LLMs have become foundational across many NLP applications, driving a shift from an algorithm-centric to a context-centric paradigm. As an important task in text mining, the landscape of topic modeling (TM) is similarly being reshaped by a growing body of LLM-driven research.We review recent TM developments and categorize existing methods into three groups: Classical Algorithm-Centric, LLM-Assisted, and LLM-Centric. For traditional algorithm-centric methods, we refine prior taxonomies and highlight recent advances. For the LLM-Assisted and LLM-Centric settings, we introduce a new taxonomy that emphasizes the role of LLMs and the design of end-to-end workflows, respectively. We examine two key transformations brought by LLM-centric TM: expanded task scope and a shift from model-level improvements to system-level engineering. We also propose a future roadmap for more optimized LLM-Centric TMs and identify ongoing critical challenges. We aim for this survey to spur closer integration between TM and LLMs and to further drive the progress of modern TM.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已成为许多自然语言处理应用的基础技术，推动着从以算法为中心到以上下文为中心的发展模式转变。作为文本挖掘中的重要任务，主题建模领域也正在被越来越多基于大语言模型的研究所重塑。我们回顾了近期主题建模的发展情况，并将现有方法分为三类：以传统算法为中心的方法、以大语言模型辅助的方法以及以大语言模型为中心的方法。对于传统的以算法为中心的方法，我们进一步细化了之前的分类体系，并重点介绍了最新的进展。而对于以大语言模型辅助和以大语言模型为中心的方法，我们提出了新的分类体系，分别强调了大语言模型的作用以及端到端工作流程的设计。我们探讨了以大语言模型为中心的主题建模带来的两个关键变革：任务范围的扩大以及从模型层面的改进向系统层面工程的转变。我们还为更优化的以大语言模型为中心的主题建模提出了未来发展方向，并指出了当前面临的关键挑战。我们希望这份综述能够促进主题建模与大语言模型的更紧密结合，从而进一步推动现代主题建模的发展。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Templates: Dynamic Adaptation of Reasoning Demonstrations via Feasibility-Aware Exploration
papers.title_zh: 超越模板：通过考虑可行性的探索来实现推理演示的动态调整
papers.authors: Yong Wu, Weihang Pan, Ke Li, Chen Binhui, Ping Li, Binbin Lin
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet aligning such abilities to small language models (SLMs) remains a challenge due to distributional mismatches and limited model capacity. Existing reasoning datasets, typically designed for powerful LLMs, often lead to degraded performance when directly applied to weaker models. In this work, we introduce Dynamic Adaptation of Reasoning Trajectories (DART), a novel data adaptation framework that bridges the capability gap between expert reasoning trajectories and diverse SLMs. Instead of uniformly imitating expert steps, DART employs a selective imitation strategy guided by step-wise adaptability estimation via solution simulation. When expert steps surpass the student’s capacity—signaled by an Imitation Gap—the student autonomously explores alternative reasoning paths, constrained by outcome consistency. We validate DART across multiple reasoning benchmarks and model scales, demonstrating that it significantly improves generalization and data efficiency over static fine-tuning. Our method enhances supervision quality by aligning training signals with the student’s reasoning capabilities, offering a scalable solution for reasoning alignment in resource-constrained models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）展现了出色的推理能力，然而由于分布差异和模型能力的限制，将这些能力适配到小型语言模型（SLM）上仍然是一个挑战。现有的推理数据集通常是为强大的LLM设计的，直接应用于较弱的模型时往往会导致性能下降。在这项研究中，我们提出了“动态适应推理轨迹”方法（DART），这是一种新颖的数据适配框架，能够弥合专家推理轨迹与不同SLM之间的能力差距。DART并非简单地模仿专家的每一步操作，而是采用一种选择性模仿策略，通过模拟解决方案来估算每一步的操作适应性。当专家的某些步骤超出了学生的能力范围——这可以通过“模仿差距”来体现——学生会自主探索其他推理路径，同时受到结果一致性的约束。我们在多个推理基准测试和不同的模型规模上验证了DART的有效性，结果表明，与静态微调相比，DART显著提升了泛化能力和数据利用效率。我们的方法通过将训练信号与学生推理能力相结合，提高了监督质量，为资源有限的模型中实现推理适配提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。
