papers.title: CFlowPsyD: An Analysis-Enhanced Dataset for Asynchronous Psychological Counseling through Self-Optimizing Multi-Agent Framework
papers.title_zh: CFlowPsyD：一个基于分析优化的数据集，旨在通过自优化多智能体框架实现异步心理辅导服务
papers.authors: Donghao Li, Yifan Deng, Jinta Weng, Xingsheng Zhang, Chenxu Niu, Jingyuan Tian, Heyan Huang, Yue Hu
papers.abstract: Asynchronous psychological counseling (APC) represents a crucial mental health service modality that transcends temporal and spatial constraints. However, its development faces significant data scarcity challenges: due to stringent privacy protection requirements and professional ethical considerations, direct collection of conversational data from authentic APC scenarios is virtually impossible. To address this challenge, we design a self-optimizing multi-agent framework for counseling dialogue generation, CFlowPsy, which utilizes a small amount of real anonymized counseling cases as seed data to synthesize diverse problem-solving-oriented APC conversations through large language models. Specifically, the framework employs a Persona-Flow module to continuously track and update clients’ basic information, real-time emotions, and counseling progress, providing dynamic personalized analytical support for counselors and enabling self-optimization of generated dialogues. Simultaneously, the framework ensures that generated interventions contain explicit reasoning processes, demonstrating clear psychological analysis and logic, thereby enhancing the accuracy and consistency of responses. Under this framework, we develop the first Chinese APC dataset, CFlowPsyD, comprising 1,700 high-quality extended conversations. Extensive experiments and human evaluations confirm that the proposed CFlowPsyD dataset successfully simulates human-like APC processes.
papers.abstract_zh: 异步心理辅导是一种重要的心理健康服务方式，它能够突破时间和空间的限制。然而，其发展面临着严重的数据匮乏问题：由于严格的隐私保护要求和专业伦理考量，直接从真实的异步心理辅导场景中收集对话数据几乎是不可能的。为了应对这一挑战，我们设计了一个自优化的多智能体框架，用于生成辅导对话，名为CFlowPsy。该框架利用少量经过匿名处理的真实辅导案例作为种子数据，通过大语言模型来合成各种以问题解决为导向的异步心理辅导对话。具体来说，该框架采用了Persona-Flow模块来持续跟踪和更新客户的基本信息、实时情绪以及辅导进度，为辅导师提供动态化的个性化分析支持，并能够实现生成对话的自优化。同时，该框架确保生成的干预措施包含明确的推理过程，展现出清晰的心理分析和逻辑性，从而提升响应的准确性和一致性。在这个框架下，我们开发了首个中文异步心理辅导数据集CFlowPsyD，其中包含1,700段高质量的扩展对话。大量的实验和人工评估表明，所提出的CFlowPsyD数据集能够成功模拟类似人类的异步心理辅导过程。

papers.title: The Thin Line Between Comprehension and Persuasion in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型中，理解与说服之间的微妙界限
papers.authors: Adrian de Wynter, Tangming Yuan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are excellent at maintaining high-level, convincing dialogue, but it remains unclear whether their persuasive success reflects genuine understanding of the discourse. We examine this question through informal debates between humans and LLMs, first by measuring their persuasive skills, and then by relating these to their understanding of what is being talked about: namely, their comprehension of argumentative structures and the pragmatic context on the same debates. We find that LLMs effectively maintain coherent, persuasive debates, and can sway the beliefs of both participants and audiences. We also note that awareness or suspicion of AI involvement encourage people to be more critical of the arguments made. However, we also find that LLMs are unable to show comprehension of deeper dialogical structures, such as argument quality or existence of supporting premises. Our results reveal a disconnect between LLM comprehension and dialogical skills, raising ethical and practical concerns on their deployment on explanation-critical contexts. From an argumentation-theoretical perspective, we experimentally question whether an agent, if it can convincingly maintain a dialogue, is required to show it knows what is talking about.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在维持高水平、具有说服力的对话方面表现出色，但尚不清楚它们的成功是否真的反映了对讨论内容的真正理解。我们通过人类与大语言模型之间的非正式辩论来探讨这个问题。首先，我们测量了它们的说服力，然后将这些能力与其对讨论内容的理解联系起来——即它们对论证结构和同一辩论中的实用语境的理解程度。我们发现，大语言模型能够有效地维持连贯、有说服力的辩论，并能影响参与者和听众的信念。此外，人们如果意识到或怀疑人工智能的参与，就会更加批判性地评估所提出的论点。然而，我们也发现，大语言模型无法理解更深刻的对话结构，比如论点的质量或支持性前提的存在。我们的研究结果揭示了大语言模型的理解能力与对话技巧之间的差距，这引发了关于它们在需要解释性的情境下使用的伦理和实际问题。从论证理论的角度来看，我们通过实验来探讨：如果一个智能体能够令人信服地维持对话，那么它是否必须表现出对讨论内容的理解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Evaluating Machine Translation Datasets for Low-Web Data Languages: A Gendered Lens
papers.title_zh: 评估适用于低网络覆盖率语言的机器翻译数据集：性别视角下的分析
papers.authors: Hellina Hailu Nigatu, Bethelhem Yemane Mamo, Bontu Fufa Balcha, Debora Taye Tesfaye, Elbethel Daniel Zewdie, Ikram Behiru Nesiru, Jitu Ewnetu Hailu, Senait Mengesha Yayo
papers.abstract: As low-resourced languages are increasingly incorporated into NLP research, there is an emphasis on collecting large-scale datasets. But in prioritizing quantity over quality, we risk 1) building language technologies that perform poorly for these languages and 2) producing harmful content that perpetuates societal biases. In this paper, we investigate the quality of Machine Translation (MT) datasets for three low-resourced languages–Afan Oromo, Amharic, and Tigrinya, with a focus on the gender representation in the datasets. Our findings demonstrate that while training data has a large representation of political and religious domain text, benchmark datasets are focused on news, health, and sports. We also found a large skew towards the male gender–in names of persons, the grammatical gender of verbs, and in stereotypical depictions in the datasets. Further, we found harmful and toxic depictions against women, which were more prominent for the language with the largest amount of data, underscoring that quantity does not guarantee quality. We hope that our work inspires further inquiry into the datasets collected for low-resourced languages and prompts early mitigation of harmful content. WARNING: This paper contains discussion of NSFW content that some may find disturbing.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着资源匮乏的语言越来越多地被纳入自然语言处理研究领域，人们越来越重视大规模数据集的收集。然而，如果过于注重数量而忽视了质量，我们就有可能出现两种情况：1）开发出在这些语言上表现不佳的语言技术；2）产生传播社会偏见的有害内容。在本文中，我们研究了三种资源匮乏语言的机器翻译数据集的质量问题——阿法诺奥罗莫语、阿姆哈拉语和提格雷尼亚语，重点关注这些语言中的性别表现情况。研究发现，虽然训练数据中包含大量政治和宗教领域的文本，但基准数据集主要集中在新闻、健康和体育领域。我们还发现，在人名、动词的语法性别以及数据集中的刻板印象描述方面，男性占主导地位的情况非常明显。此外，我们还发现了针对女性的有害和有毒的描述，这种情况在数据量最大的语言中更为突出，这进一步表明，数量并不能保证质量。我们希望我们的研究能够激发对资源匮乏语言相关数据集的进一步研究，并促使人们尽早采取措施消除有害内容。警告：本文包含一些可能被认为不适宜观看的内容。

papers.title: Select2Reason: Efficient Instruction-Tuning Data Selection for Long-CoT Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 选择2原因：高效的指令调优数据选择，适用于长上下文推理场景
papers.authors: Cehao Yang, Xueyuan Lin, Xiaojun Wu, Chengjin Xu, Xuhui Jiang, Honghao Liu, Hui Xiong, Jian Guo
papers.abstract: A practical approach to activate long chain-of-thoughts reasoning ability in large language models is to perform supervised fine-tuning on instruction datasets synthesized by strong large reasoning models, offering a cost-effective alternative to reinforcement learning. However, large-scale instruction sets incur significant training overhead, while effective strategies for automatic data selection still remain unexplored. We propose Select2Reason, a novel and efficient instruction-tuning data selection framework for long-CoT reasoning. From the perspective of emergence of rethinking behaviors like self-correction and backtracking, we investigate metrics that may determine the quality of long-CoT instructions. Select2Reason leverages a difficulty-aware reward model to estimate the learning value of questions and jointly incorporates a reasoning trace length-based heuristic through a weighted scheme for ranking to prioritize high-utility examples. Empirical results on OpenR1-Math-220k demonstrate that fine-tuning LLM on only 10% of the data selected by our method achieves performance competitive with or superior to full-data tuning and open-source baseline across nine competition-level mathematical benchmarks and four broader reasoning tasks. Further experiments highlight the scalability in varying data size, efficiency during inference, and adaptability to other instruction pools of Select2Reason with minimal cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 一种实用的方法，可以激活大语言模型中的长链思维推理能力，就是在由强大的大型推理模型生成的指令数据集上进行有监督的微调操作。这种方法提供了一种成本效益较高的替代方案，取代了传统的强化学习方式。然而，大规模指令数据集会带来显著的训练负担，而自动数据选择的有效策略仍然有待探索。我们提出了Select2Reason这一新颖且高效的指令微调数据选择框架，用于支持长链思维推理。从自我修正和回溯等重新思考行为的出现角度出发，我们研究了能够衡量长链思维指令质量的指标。Select2Reason利用了一个考虑难度的奖励模型来估算问题的学习价值，并通过加权方案将基于推理轨迹长度的启发式方法结合起来，以优先选择具有高实用性的示例。在OpenR1-Math-220k数据集上的实验结果表明，仅使用我们方法选出的10%数据进行LLM微调，就能在九个竞赛级别的数学基准测试和四个更广泛的推理任务中取得与全数据微调或开源基线相当的甚至更好的性能。进一步的实验表明，Select2Reason在不同数据规模下的可扩展性、推理过程中的效率，以及与其他指令集的适应性都相当出色，同时成本也相对较低。

papers.title: Curriculum Learning based Hierarchical Scoring and Analysis Framework for Question Answering Task Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 基于课程学习的层次化评分与分析框架，用于问答任务评估
papers.authors: Qiong Wu, Tan Yue, Jianxin Liang, Zhen Li, Kai He, Shuai Zhao, Dongyan Zhao
papers.abstract: The rapid progress of large language models (LLMs) has increased the demand for efficient and reliable evaluation of question answering (QA) systems. Existing evaluation methods either rely on rule-based matching with shallow semantic understanding or adopt LLM-as-a-Judge approaches that incur high cost and latency while offering limited error interpretability. Accordingly, we propose HiEval, a curriculum learning based hierarchical framework for QA task evaluation that supports both quick scoring and fine-grained error analysis. HiEval contains a quick scoring model (HiEval-QS) that predicts three-level correctness labels, and an error analysis model (HiEval-EA) that identifies incorrect responses into five error types. HiEval incorporates a class-balanced focal loss to handle label imbalance, experience replay to prevent forgetting, and contrastive unlikelihood optimization to improve error discrimination. We also construct two large-scale human-annotated evaluation datasets collected from 50 QA-related datasets, covering 8 task types and release two challenging benchmarks. Extensive experiments show that HiEval achieves state-of-the-art performance on both quick scoring and error analysis tasks, outperforming all baseline methods, including GPT-5, while being approximately 25\times faster.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，使得对问答系统进行评估的需求日益增加。现有的评估方法要么依赖于基于规则的匹配方式，这种方式只能获得浅层的语义理解；要么采用以LLM为评判者的方法，但这种方法会带来较高的成本和延迟，同时也无法很好地解释错误原因。因此，我们提出了HiEval这一基于课程学习的分层框架，用于问答任务的评估。该框架能够实现快速评分和精细的错误分析。HiEval包含一个快速评分模型（HiEval-QS），可以预测三级别的正确性标签；还有一个错误分析模型（HiEval-EA），可以将错误的回答分为五种类型。HiEval采用了类平衡的焦点损失来处理标签不平衡问题，利用经验回放来防止遗忘，并通过对比不可能性优化来提高错误识别能力。我们还构建了两个大规模的人工标注评估数据集，这些数据集来自50个与问答相关的数据集，涵盖了8种任务类型，并发布了两个具有挑战性的基准测试。广泛的实验表明，HiEval在快速评分和错误分析任务上均取得了领先的性能，其性能优于所有基线方法，包括GPT-5，而且速度大约快了25倍。

papers.title: TrigReason: Trigger-Based Collaboration between Small and Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: TrigReason：基于触发事件的小规模与大规模推理模型之间的协作机制
papers.authors: Yi Zhao, Yajuan Peng, Cam-Tu Nguyen, Zuchao Li, Xiaoliang Wang, Xiaoming Fu, Hai Zhao
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks through extended chains of thought but suffer from high inference latency due to autoregressive reasoning. Recent work explores using Small Reasoning Models (SRMs) to accelerate LRM inference, yet existing frameworks such as SpecReason adopt a polling-based design that repeatedly invokes the LRM for verification at every step. This approach is inefficient, as frequent LRM calls introduce a high computational overhead, and is unreliable, since the LRM as a judge is prone to errors. In this paper, we systematically characterize the capability boundaries of SRMs and identify three common types of reasoning risks: (1) path divergence, where SRMs lack the strategic ability to construct an initial plan, causing reasoning to deviate from the most probable path; (2) cognitive overload, where SRMs fail to solve particularly difficult steps; and (3) recovery inability, where SRMs lack robust self-reflection and error correction mechanisms. To address these challenges, we propose TrigReason, a trigger-based collaborative reasoning framework that replaces continuous polling with selective intervention. TrigReason delegates most reasoning to the SRM and activates LRM intervention only when necessary—during initial strategic planning (strategic priming trigger), upon detecting extraordinary overconfidence (cognitive offload trigger), or when reasoning falls into unproductive loops (intervention request trigger). The evaluation results on AIME24, AIME25, and GPQA-D indicate that TrigReason matches the accuracy of full LRMs and SpecReason, while offloading 1.70×–4.79× more reasoning steps to SRMs. Under edge–cloud conditions, TrigReason reduces latency by 43.9% and API cost by 73.3% compared to SpecReason.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在复杂任务中表现出强大的性能，这得益于其扩展的思维链。然而，由于自回归推理机制的存在，这些模型在推理过程中面临着较高的延迟问题。最近的研究尝试使用小型推理模型来加速大型推理模型的推理过程。不过，现有的框架如SpecReason采用基于轮询的设计方式，在每一步都会反复调用大型推理模型进行验证。这种方法是低效的，因为频繁的调用会引入较高的计算开销；同时，这种设计也不可靠，因为作为判断依据的推理模型容易出错。在本文中，我们系统地分析了小型推理模型的能力边界，并识别出三种常见的推理风险：(1)路径偏离，即小型推理模型缺乏制定初始计划的能力，导致推理偏离最可能的路径；(2)认知过载，即小型推理模型无法解决特别困难的问题步骤；(3)恢复能力缺失，即小型推理模型缺乏有效的自我反思和错误纠正机制。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了TrigReason这一基于触发条件的协作推理框架。该框架用选择性干预取代了连续轮询的方式。TrigReason将大部分推理任务委托给小型推理模型，仅在必要时才激活大型推理模型的干预——在初始战略规划阶段、检测到异常过度自信时，或者当推理陷入无成效的循环时。在AIME24、AIME25和GPQA-D上的评估结果显示，TrigReason的准确率与全尺寸大型推理模型和SpecReason相当，同时将1.70倍到4.79倍的推理任务转移给了小型推理模型。在边缘-云环境下，与SpecReason相比，TrigReason将延迟降低了43.9%，API成本降低了73.3%。

papers.title: TURTLEAI: Benchmarking Multimodal Models for Visual Programming in Turtle Graphics
papers.title_zh: TURTLEAI：用于图形编程的多模态模型的对比分析工具
papers.authors: Chao Wen, Jacqueline Staub, Adish Singla
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been explored for visual programming, where they generate code to solve visual tasks. However, most prior work focuses on visual programming for productivity; it remains unclear how well current VLMs perform on education-oriented visual programming and what factors limit their performance. To bridge this gap, we introduce TURTLEAI, a benchmark containing 823 tasks curated based on real-world visual programming tasks in the Turtle Graphics domain. Solving these tasks requires models to perceive geometric patterns, reason about spatial relationships, and synthesize Python code that faithfully reproduces geometric patterns. We evaluate 20+ VLMs, including GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Qwen2-VL-72B, and find that they struggle significantly, with most achieving success rates below 30%. To address these limitations, we propose a data generation technique that requires only a small set of seed samples. Fine-tuning Qwen2-VL-72B on the resulting synthetic data yields an improvement of about 20% on real-world tasks. Our failure analysis reveals that GPT-4o struggles with spatial reasoning and precise visual replication, whereas fine-tuning primarily improves the alignment between visual reasoning and code implementation.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在视觉编程领域得到了广泛应用，它们能够生成代码以完成各种视觉任务。然而，目前大多数研究主要集中在提高视觉编程的效率上；目前这些视觉语言模型在面向教育的视觉编程方面的表现如何，以及有哪些因素限制了它们的性能，这些问题仍然不明确。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了TURTLEAI这个基准测试集，该测试集包含823个任务，这些任务都是基于Turtle图形领域的真实视觉编程任务精心挑选出来的。要完成这些任务，模型需要能够识别几何图案、理解空间关系，并生成能够忠实再现几何图案的Python代码。我们对20多个视觉语言模型进行了评估，其中包括GPT-5、GPT-4o和Qwen2-VL-72B。结果发现，这些模型的性能表现非常差，大多数模型的成功率都低于30%。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种数据生成技术，该技术只需要少量的种子样本即可。通过对Qwen2-VL-72B进行微调，使其在合成数据上的表现有所提升，实际任务的成功率提高了约20%。我们的分析还发现，GPT-4o在空间推理和精确视觉复制方面存在困难，而微调则主要改善了视觉推理与代码实现之间的匹配度。

papers.title: Calibrated Progressive Distillation: Co-Designing Curriculum and Target Mixing for Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 校准后的渐进式蒸馏：共同设计课程内容与目标混合方式，以实现大型语言模型的知识蒸馏
papers.authors: Mengxiang Zhang, Lingyuan Liu
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a key technique for compressing large language models (LLMs), yet it faces challenges stemming from the teacher–student capacity gap. While existing KD methods address these challenges either by mixing teacher and student distributions in the distillation target or by using curriculum learning to sequence training from easy to hard examples, they typically design these two strategies independently, missing the opportunity for synergistic co-design. To bridge this gap, we propose Calibrated Progressive Distillation (CPD), a white-box KD framework that co-designs curriculum scheduling and target mixing through a unified difficulty-aware principle. CPD uses a difficulty profile to select epoch-specific subsets that ensure a uniform increase in average difficulty, adapting to the dataset’s intrinsic hardness structure. Simultaneously, the mixing coefficient in the distillation target and the distillation temperature are synchronized with this progression, gradually shifting supervision from teacher-dominated to student-informed signals as training advances. Theoretically, CPD ensures bounded gradients and induces an implicit attention shift from easy to hard samples. Empirically, CPD consistently outperforms advanced KD methods across diverse tasks, while reducing training runtime by over 10%. Our work demonstrates that aligning data scheduling with distillation signal design is crucial for effective and efficient LLM distillation.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏是一种用于压缩大语言模型的关键技术，但它面临着由“教师-学生能力差距”带来的挑战。现有的知识蒸馏方法要么通过在蒸馏目标中混合教师和学生的分布来应对这些挑战，要么通过课程学习来按难度顺序进行训练。然而，这些方法通常独立设计这两种策略，从而错过了协同设计的机会。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了“校准式渐进蒸馏”框架。该框架采用一种统一的可视化难度感知原则，来共同设计课程安排和样本混合策略。校准式渐进蒸馏利用难度配置文件来选择特定时期的样本子集，以确保平均难度的均匀提升，同时适应数据集本身的难度结构。与此同时，蒸馏目标中的混合系数和蒸馏温度也会随着这种渐进过程而同步调整，随着训练的深入，监督信号会从以教师为主导转变为以学生生成的信号为主。从理论上讲，校准式渐进蒸馏能够确保梯度的大小有限，并促使模型从简单样本向复杂样本进行隐含的注意力转移。实证结果表明，校准式渐进蒸馏在不同任务上的表现均优于其他先进的知识蒸馏方法，同时还能将训练时间缩短超过10%。我们的研究表明，将数据调度与蒸馏信号设计相结合，对于实现高效且有效的语言模型蒸馏至关重要。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Faithful-First Reasoning, Planning, and Acting for Multimodal LLMs
papers.title_zh: 忠实的第一推理机制：为多模态大型语言模型提供规划与执行方案
papers.authors: Junxian Li, Xinyue Xu, Sai Ma, Di Zhang, Sichao Li
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) frequently suffer from unfaithfulness, generating reasoning chains that drift from visual evidence or contradict final predictions. We propose Faithful-First Reasoning, Planning, and Acting (RPA) framework in which FaithEvi provides step-wise and chain-level supervision by evaluating the faithfulness of intermediate reasoning, and FaithAct uses these signals to plan and execute faithfulness-aware actions during inference. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that faithful-first RPA improves perceptual faithfulness by up to 24% over prompt-based and tool-augmented reasoning frameworks, without degrading task accuracy. Our analysis shows that treating faithfulness as a guiding principle perceptually faithful reasoning trajectories and mitigates hallucination behavior. This work thereby establishes a unified framework for both evaluating and enforcing faithfulness in multimodal reasoning. Code is at https://github.com/lijunxian111/Faithful-First-RPA.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型经常出现不忠实的问题，即生成的推理链条会偏离视觉证据或与最终预测相矛盾。我们提出了一种名为“忠实优先推理、规划与执行”的框架。在该框架中，FaithEvi通过评估中间推理的忠实性来提供逐步和链式监督，而FaithAct则利用这些信号在推理过程中规划和执行具有忠实性的动作。在多个多模态推理基准测试中的实验表明，与基于提示的推理框架以及带有工具辅助的推理框架相比，“忠实优先推理、规划与执行”框架能够将感知忠实度提高多达24%，同时不会降低任务准确性。我们的分析显示，将忠实性作为指导原则可以使得推理轨迹在感知上更加忠实，并减少幻觉行为的发生。因此，这项研究工作为评估和执行多模态推理中的忠实性建立了一个统一的框架。相关代码可以在https://github.com/lijunxian111/Faithful-First-RPA下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SEAD: A Surrogate-free Label-only Membership Inference Attack against Pre-trained LLMs with Semantic-Aware Density
papers.title_zh: SEAD：一种无需依赖替代标签的、仅基于标签的针对预训练大语言模型的成员推断攻击方法，该攻击利用了语义感知密度技术
papers.authors: Biao Yi, Jiahao Li, Yiming Li, Yu He, Baolei Zhang, Zheli Liu, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) aim to determine whether specific data was used to train a model. While existing MIAs against pre-trained Large Language Models (LLMs) typically require access to complete logits (probabilities), such access is sometimes unavailable in real-world deployments where only the generated text is exposed. Current label-only MIAs relied on surrogate models to estimate the target model’s token probabilities, but we identify fundamental limitations: high sensitivity to surrogate model selection and significant probability estimation errors. To address these challenges, we propose SEAD (Semantic-Aware Density), a novel surrogate-free label-only MIA approach that directly estimates token probabilities through Monte Carlo sampling of the target model itself. This approach eliminates dependency on surrogate models while reducing probability estimation errors by an order of magnitude. Furthermore, we introduce a semantic-aware density approach that enhances attack effectiveness by considering both exact token matches and semantically similar alternatives, inspired by the understanding that LLMs may express memorized information through different but semantically equivalent tokens. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SEAD consistently outperforms existing label-only attacks and serves as a foundational density estimator in the label-only setting.
papers.abstract_zh: 成员推断攻击（MIA）的目的是确定是否使用了特定数据来训练模型。虽然现有的针对预训练大语言模型的MIA通常需要访问完整的逻辑值（概率），但在实际部署中，由于只能获取生成的文本，这种访问方式有时是不可行的。目前的仅标签MIA方法依赖于替代模型来估计目标模型的令牌概率，但我们发现这种方法存在根本性的局限性：对替代模型的选择非常敏感，且概率估计误差较大。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SEAD（语义感知密度）方法，这是一种无需替代模型的仅标签MIA方法，它通过直接对目标模型本身进行蒙特卡洛采样来估计令牌概率。这种方法消除了对替代模型的依赖，同时将概率估计误差降低了几个数量级。此外，我们还引入了语义感知密度方法，该方法通过考虑精确的令牌匹配和语义上相似的替代方案来提高攻击效果，这一方法基于这样的理解：大语言模型可能会用不同但语义上等效的令牌来表示记忆中的信息。广泛的测试表明，SEAD在性能上始终优于现有的仅标签攻击方法，并且成为仅标签环境下一种基础的概率估计方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Faithfulness-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for Fact-Checking the Output of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 用于验证检索增强生成模型输出的可靠性——一种基于诚信原则的不确定性量化方法
papers.authors: Ekaterina Fadeeva, Aleksandr Rubashevskii, Dzianis Piatrashyn, Roman Vashurin, Shehzaad Dhuliawala, Artem Shelmanov, Timothy Baldwin, Preslav Nakov, Mrinmaya Sachan, Maxim Panov
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) enhanced with knowledge retrieval, an approach known as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), have achieved strong performance in open-domain question answering. However, RAG remains prone to hallucinations: factually incorrect outputs may arise from inaccuracies in the model’s internal knowledge and the retrieved context. Existing approaches to mitigating hallucinations often conflate factuality with faithfulness to the retrieved evidence, incorrectly labeling factually correct statements as hallucinations if they are not explicitly supported by the retrieval. In this paper, we introduce FRANQ (Faithfulness-aware Retrieval-Augmented UNcertainty Quantification), a new method for hallucination detection in RAG outputs. FRANQ applies distinct uncertainty quantification techniques to estimate factuality, conditioning on whether a statement is faithful to the retrieved context. To evaluate FRANQ and competing uncertainty quantification methods, we construct a new long-form question answering dataset annotated for both factuality and faithfulness, combining automated labeling with manual validation of challenging cases. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets, tasks, and LLMs show that FRANQ achieves more accurate detection of factual errors in RAG-generated responses compared to existing uncertainty quantification and hallucination detection approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过知识检索技术增强的大语言模型，即所谓的检索增强生成模型，在开放领域问答任务中取得了优异的性能。然而，检索增强生成模型仍然容易出现幻觉现象：由于模型内部知识的不准确以及所检索到的上下文存在错误，可能会导致错误的输出结果。目前用于缓解幻觉问题的方法往往将事实准确性与对检索到的证据的忠实度混为一谈，即使某些陈述在检索过程中得到了明确支持，它们仍可能被错误地标记为幻觉。在本文中，我们提出了FRANQ这一新的幻觉检测方法。FRANQ采用不同的不确定性量化技术来估计陈述的事实准确性，其判断依据是该陈述是否忠实于所检索到的上下文。为了评估FRANQ以及其它现有的不确定性量化方法，我们构建了一个新的长形式问答数据集，该数据集同时包含了事实准确性和忠实度的标注信息，通过自动化标注和人工验证复杂案例相结合的方式来进行评估。在多个数据集、任务以及不同语言模型上的广泛实验表明，与现有的不确定性量化和幻觉检测方法相比，FRANQ在检测检索增强生成模型产生的回答中的事实错误方面表现得更为准确。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: AGGC: Adaptive Group Gradient Clipping for Stabilizing Large Language Model Training
papers.title_zh: AGGC：自适应组级梯度裁剪技术，用于稳定大型语言模型的训练过程
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Li, Yuan Wu, Yi Chang
papers.abstract: To stabilize the training of Large Language Models (LLMs), gradient clipping is a nearly ubiquitous heuristic used to alleviate exploding gradients. However, traditional global norm clipping erroneously presupposes gradient homogeneity across different functional modules, leading to an adverse “spill-over” effect where volatile parameters force unnecessary scaling on stable ones. To overcome this, we propose Adaptive Group-wise Gradient Clipping (AGGC). AGGC partitions parameters into groups based on functional types and regulates each according to its historical behavior using an Exponential Moving Average (EMA). Specifically, it constructs an adaptive interval to simultaneously mitigate gradient explosion and vanishing, while employing a time-dependent scheduling mechanism to balance exploration and convergence. Experiments on LLaMA 2-7B, Mistral-7B, and Gemma-7B models demonstrate that AGGC-enhanced LoRA consistently outperforms standard LoRA and frequently exceeds Full Fine-Tuning performance. Specifically, on the GSM8K benchmark, Mistral-7B fine-tuned with AGGC-enhanced LoRA achieves 72.93% accuracy, surpassing the 69.5% of vanilla LoRA. AGGC also contributes to the stability of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), leading to improved logical deduction in Qwen 2.5 and Llama 3.2 models. Experimental results demonstrate that AGGC effectively addresses the limitations of traditional gradient clipping methods, particularly in overcoming gradient heterogeneity, by utilizing a modular, adaptive clipping strategy to stabilize the training process. Due to its lightweight design, AGGC can be seamlessly integrated into existing post-training pipelines with negligible overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了稳定大语言模型（LLM）的训练过程，梯度裁剪是一种几乎普遍使用的策略，用于缓解梯度爆炸问题。然而，传统的全局范数裁剪错误地假设了不同功能模块之间的梯度具有一致性，这会导致一种不利的“溢出”效应，即不稳定的参数会对稳定的参数产生不必要的缩放影响。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了自适应分组梯度裁剪算法（AGGC）。AGGC根据功能类型将参数分成不同的组，并根据每个组的历史行为来对其进行调节，使用指数移动平均法来实现这一点。具体来说，它构建了一个自适应区间，以同时缓解梯度爆炸和消失的问题，同时采用时间依赖的调度机制来平衡探索与收敛的效果。在LaLM2-7B、Mistral-7B和Gemma-7B模型上的实验表明，采用AGGC增强的LoRA在性能上始终优于传统的LoRA，并且经常超过全微调模型的性能表现。特别是在GSM8K基准测试中，使用AGGC增强的LoRA对Mistral-7B进行微调后，模型的准确率达到了72.93%，远远超过了传统LoRA的69.5%。AGGC还提升了带有可验证奖励的强化学习模型的稳定性，使得Qwen 2.5和Llama 3.2模型的逻辑推理能力得到了提升。实验结果表明，AGGC有效地解决了传统梯度裁剪方法的局限性，尤其是在应对梯度异质性方面，通过采用模块化、自适应的裁剪策略来稳定训练过程。由于其设计轻量，AGGC可以无缝集成到现有的训练后流程中，而不会造成过多的开销。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MADRA: Multi-Agent Debate for Risk-Aware Embodied Planning
papers.title_zh: MADRA：基于多智能体讨论的、考虑风险的实体规划方法
papers.authors: JunJian Wang, Lidan Zhao, Xi Sheryl Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit impressive reasoning capabilities but often suffer from Embodied Semantic Hallucinations—generating plans that are semantically fluent but physically unsafe due to a lack of grounded common sense. Existing safety alignment methods, such as RLHF or naive safety prompting, typically fall into a Safety-Utility Trade-off, resulting in severe over-rejection of benign household instructions. To address this, we propose MADRA (Multi-Agent Debate for Risk Awareness), a training-free cognitive architecture that mimics System-2 deliberation. MADRA introduces a meta-cognitive Critical Agent that evaluates peer debates using a structured argumentation framework derived from the Toulmin Model, effectively mitigating the “herd mentality” in multi-agent systems. We also introduce SafeAware-VH, a benchmark featuring adversarial safe instructions designed to probe agents’ sensitivity to physical risks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MADRA breaks the Pareto frontier, achieving over 90% rejection of unsafe tasks while maintaining high utility, significantly outperforming standard Chain-of-Thought and single-agent reflection baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型虽然具备出色的推理能力，但常常会出现“具象语义幻觉”的问题——即生成出在语义上看似合理的计划，但由于缺乏实际常识，这些计划在物理上是不安全的。现有的安全对齐方法，如RLHF或简单的安全提示方式，通常都会陷入安全性与实用性之间的权衡问题，导致对无害的家庭指令产生过度拒绝的情况。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了MADRA（多智能体风险意识辩论系统），这是一种无需训练的认知架构，能够模拟人类第二脑的推理过程。MADRA引入了一个元认知关键智能体，该智能体利用基于Toulmin模型的结构化论证框架来评估其他智能体的辩论结果，从而有效缓解多智能体系统中的“群体思维”现象。我们还引入了SafeAware-VH这一基准测试，该测试包含针对物理风险的对抗性安全指令，以评估智能体对物理风险的敏感度。大量实验表明，MADRA能够突破帕累托前沿，在保持高实用性的同时，对不安全的任务实现超过90%的拒绝率，其性能显著优于传统的思维链模型和单智能体反思基线算法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Navigating Large-Scale Document Collections: MuDABench for Multi-Document Analytical QA
papers.title_zh: 处理大规模文档集：MuDABench在多文档分析质量控制中的应用
papers.authors: Zhanli Li, Yixuan Cao, Lvzhou Luo, Ping Luo
papers.abstract: This paper introduces the task of analytical question answering over large, semi-structured document collections. We present MuDABench, a benchmark for multi-document analytical QA, where questions require extracting and synthesizing information across numerous documents to perform quantitative analysis. Unlike existing multi-document QA benchmarks that typically require information from only a few documents with limited cross-document reasoning, MuDABench demands extensive inter-document analysis and aggregation. Constructed via distant supervision by leveraging document-level metadata and annotated financial databases, MuDABench comprises over 80,000 pages and 332 analytical QA instances. We also propose an evaluation protocol that measures final answer accuracy and uses intermediate-fact coverage as an auxiliary diagnostic signal for the reasoning process. Experiments reveal that standard RAG systems, which treat all documents as a flat retrieval pool, perform poorly. To address these limitations, we propose a multi-agent workflow that orchestrates planning, extraction, and code generation modules. While this approach substantially improves both process and outcome metrics, a significant gap remains compared to human expert performance. Our analysis identifies two primary bottlenecks: single-document information extraction accuracy and insufficient domain-specific knowledge in current systems. MuDABench is available at https://github.com/Zhanli-Li/MuDABench.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了针对大型、半结构化文档集合进行分析性问答的任务。我们提出了MuDABench这一多文档分析性问答的基准测试平台。在该测试中，问题要求从多个文档中提取和综合信息，以进行定量分析。与现有的多文档问答基准测试不同，后者通常只需要从少数几份文档中获取信息，且缺乏跨文档的推理能力。而MuDABench则要求对文档之间进行广泛的分析和整合。该基准测试通过利用文档级别的元数据以及标注过的金融数据库进行远程监督构建而成，包含超过80,000页的文档和332个分析性问答实例。我们还提出了一套评估方案，用于衡量最终答案的准确性，并采用中间事实覆盖作为推理过程的辅助诊断指标。实验结果表明，那些将所有文档视为一个统一检索池的标准RAG系统表现不佳。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种多智能体工作流程，该流程能够协调规划、提取和代码生成模块的工作。虽然这种方法在过程和结果指标上都有了显著改善，但与人类专家的表现相比仍然存在较大差距。我们的分析指出，目前存在两个主要瓶颈：单文档信息的提取准确性不足，以及当前系统中缺乏特定领域的知识。MuDABench的源代码可以在https://github.com/Zhanli-Li/MuDABench下载。

papers.title: CORBA: Contagious Recursive Blocking Attacks on Multi-Agent Systems Based on Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: CORBA：基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统上的传染式递归阻塞攻击
papers.authors: Zhenhong Zhou, Zherui Li, Jie Zhang, Yuanhe Zhang, Kun Wang, Yang Liu, Qing Guo
papers.abstract: Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems represent a promising paradigm for tackling complex problems through agent collaboration. However, the reliance on open-ended communication exposes a fundamental vulnerability: the collaborative process itself can be exploited and disrupted. In this work, we formalize this threat class as Denial-of-Collaboration (DoC). Unlike DoS, which targets individual nodes or services, DoC attacks corrupt the collaborative structure of the system, transforming its communication topology into self-sabotage. The result is excessive resource consumption and eventual system paralysis. We introduce COntagious Recursive Blocking Attacks (CORBA) as a concrete example of DoC, which employs benign yet recursively contagious instructions, forcing LLM-MASs into cycles of meaningless message passing. Critically, since our attacks are semantically benign, they easily bypass conventional safety alignments that are not designed to detect behavioral or systemic attacks. Through extensive experiments across diverse topologies and models, we demonstrate that CORBA achieves system paralysis where the baseline attacks fail. Our work reveals emerging DoC threats in current LLM-MAS security and establishes a crucial baseline for developing robust, collaboration-aware defense mechanisms.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统是一种通过智能体协作来解决复杂问题的有前景的范式。然而，这种对开放式通信的依赖暴露了一个根本性的弱点：协作过程本身可能会被利用并破坏。在这项研究中，我们将这种威胁类型定义为“协作拒绝攻击”（Denial-of-Collaboration，DoC）。与针对单个节点或服务的DoS攻击不同，DoC攻击会破坏系统的协作结构，使其通信拓扑变成自我破坏状态。最终结果是资源消耗过度，最终导致系统瘫痪。我们提出了“传染式递归阻塞攻击”（COntagious Recursive Blocking Attacks，CORBA）作为DoC的一个具体例子。这种攻击采用看似无害但具有递归传染性的指令，迫使LLM-MAS陷入无意义的消息传递循环中。关键的是，由于我们的攻击在语义上并无恶意，因此它们可以轻松绕过那些并非设计用来检测行为性或系统性攻击的传统安全机制。通过在不同拓扑结构和模型上的广泛实验，我们证明CORBA能够在基线攻击失败的情况下实现系统瘫痪。我们的研究揭示了当前LLM-MAS安全领域出现的DoC威胁，并为开发稳健、注重协作的防御机制奠定了重要基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Afrispeech Semantics: Evaluating Audio–Semantic Reasoning in Spoken Language Models Across Domains and Accents
papers.title_zh: Afrispeech语义学：评估不同领域和口音下的语音模型在音频语义推理方面的性能
papers.authors: Chibuzor Okocha, Christan Grant
papers.abstract: Audio language models (ALMs) are increasingly used for speech-based understanding; yet, their ability to perform semantic reasoning beyond transcription, Text-to-Audio Retrieval, Captioning, and Question-Answering accuracy remains insufficiently benchmarked. In particular, the effects of accent variation, domain shift, and semantic over-inference on audio reasoning are poorly understood. We evaluate audio language models across five semantic and paralinguistic reasoning tasks: entailment, consistency, plausibility, accent drift, and accent restraint. Collectively, these tasks assess a model’s ability to reason over spoken audio as the primary evidence source, including whether a textual hypothesis can be inferred, contradicted, or left undetermined by the audio, whether statements align or conflict with spoken content, whether claims are plausible given the discourse, and whether model predictions remain stable or appropriately constrained across accent variation. These findings highlight critical limitations in current audio reasoning evaluations and hope to provide guidance for more robust and equitable ALM design and assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 音频语言模型在基于语音的理解中得到了越来越多的应用。然而，它们在超越转录、文本到音频检索、字幕生成以及问答准确性方面的语义推理能力仍缺乏充分的评估。特别是，口音差异、领域转换以及语义过度推断对音频推理的影响尚不清楚。我们针对五个语义和副语言推理任务对音频语言模型进行了评估：蕴含关系判断、一致性分析、合理性评估、口音变化影响以及口音约束能力。这些任务共同评估了模型以口语音频为主要证据来源时的推理能力，包括是否可以从音频中推断出文本假设、是否可以对文本假设进行反驳或保留不确定性、陈述内容是否与口语内容一致或冲突、在给定语境下各项声明是否合理，以及模型预测在口音差异变化时是否保持稳定或受到适当限制。这些发现揭示了当前音频推理评估中的关键局限性，并希望能为更稳健且公平的音频语言模型设计与评估提供指导。

papers.title: MoPrune: Scene-Guided Motion-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Video Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MoPrune：基于场景引导的运动感知令牌剪枝技术，旨在提升视频大语言模型的效率
papers.authors: Wenhao Hong, Ziyang Wang, Yixin Zhang, Zilei Wang
papers.abstract: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) struggle with the heavy computational cost of long or high-resolution videos due to massive visual token counts and the quadratic complexity of attention. Prior pruning approaches mainly rely on token importance or similarity, while largely overlooking video dynamics and the fact that different scenes exhibit different redundancy patterns. We introduce MoPrune, a training-free, scene-guided and motion-centric token pruning framework for accelerating VideoLLMs. MoPrune first segments videos into semantically coherent scenes to preserve temporal and motion consistency. Within each scene, it determines frame retention rates from intra-scene frame uniqueness. Finally, at the token level, MoPrune retains visually distinctive tokens and motion-salient tokens via a unified score, preserving both informative static details and dynamic regions. Extensive experiments across multiple VideoLLMs and public benchmarks demonstrate MoPrune’s superior efficiency–performance trade-offs. On LLaVA-OneVision, retaining 25% of visual tokens matches or slightly improves the dense baseline, and retaining 15% tokens preserves 99% of the original performance. MoPrune is fully compatible with hardware-efficient techniques such as Flash Attention.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频大语言模型在处理长视频或高分辨率视频时面临着巨大的计算成本问题，这主要是由于视觉令牌数量庞大以及注意力机制的二次方复杂度所致。以往的分剪方法主要依赖于令牌的重要性或相似性，而忽略了视频的动态特性以及不同场景所展现出的不同冗余模式。我们提出了MoPrune这一无需训练、以场景为导向且注重动作特征的令牌分剪框架，旨在提升视频大语言模型的性能。MoPrune首先将视频分割成语义上连贯的场景，以保持时间和动作的一致性。在每个场景中，它根据场景内帧的独特性来确定保留哪些帧。最后，在令牌层面，MoPrune通过统一的评分标准，保留那些具有视觉辨识度高的令牌和动作特征显著的令牌，从而既保留了静态信息的细节，又保留了动态区域的信息。在多个视频大语言模型和公开基准测试中的广泛实验表明，MoPrune在效率与性能之间取得了出色的平衡。在LaVa-OneVision上，保留25%的视觉令牌可以匹配或略微改善原始模型的性能；而保留15%的令牌则能够保留99%的原始性能。MoPrune完全兼容于诸如Flash Attention这样的硬件高效技术。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SCMAPR: Self-Correcting Multi-Agent Prompt Refinement for Complex-Scenario Text-to-Video Generation
papers.title_zh: SCMAPR：用于复杂场景文本转视频生成的自修正多智能体提示优化技术
papers.authors: Chengyi Yang, Pengzhen Li, Jiayin Qi, Aimin Zhou, Ji Wu, Ji Liu
papers.abstract: Text-to-Video (T2V) generation has benefited from recent advances in diffusion models, yet current systems still struggle under complex scenarios, which are generally exacerbated by the ambiguity and underspecification of text prompts. In this work, we formulate complex-scenario prompt refinement as a stage-wise multi-agent refinement process and propose SCMAPR, i.e., a scenario-aware and Self-Correcting Multi-Agent Prompt Refinement framework for T2V prompting. SCMAPR coordinates specialized agents to (i) route each prompt to a taxonomy-grounded scenario for strategy selection, (ii) synthesize scenario-aware rewriting policies and perform policy-conditioned refinement, and (iii) conduct structured semantic verification that triggers conditional revision when violations are detected. To clarify what constitutes complex scenarios in T2V prompting, provide representative examples, and enable rigorous evaluation under such challenging conditions, we further introduce T2V-Complexity, which is a complex-scenario T2V benchmark consisting exclusively of complex-scenario prompts. Extensive experiments on 3 existing benchmarks and our T2V-Complexity benchmark demonstrate that SCMAPR consistently improves text-video alignment and overall generation quality under complex scenarios, achieving up to 2.67% and 3.28 gains in average score on VBench and EvalCrafter, and up to 0.028 improvement on T2V-CompBench over 3 State-Of-The-Art baselines. The codes of SCMAPR are publicly available at https://github.com/HiThink-Research/SCMAPR.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到视频生成技术由于扩散模型的最新进展而得到了提升，但当前系统在处理复杂场景时仍然存在困难，而这种情况通常是由于文本提示的模糊性和不充分的描述所导致的。在这项研究中，我们将复杂场景的提示优化过程分解为多个阶段的多智能体优化流程，并提出了SCMAPR框架——一种注重场景特性且具有自我修正功能的多智能体提示优化工具。SCMAPR能够协调各种专业智能体来执行以下任务：(i) 将每个提示分配到符合分类标准的场景中以便进行策略选择；(ii) 生成考虑场景特性的重写策略并进行针对性优化；(iii) 进行结构化的语义验证，在检测到违规情况时触发相应的修正操作。为了明确什么是复杂的文本到视频生成场景，我们提供了一些代表性的例子，以便在如此具有挑战性的条件下进行严格的评估。此外，我们还引入了T2V-Complexity这一专门针对复杂场景的文本到视频生成基准测试。在三个现有的基准测试以及我们的T2V-Complexity基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，SCMAPR能够在复杂场景下持续提高文本与视频的匹配度以及整体生成质量。在VBench和EvalCrafter的测试中，平均得分分别提高了2.67%和3.28分；而在T2V-CompBench的测试中，相比三个最先进的基线模型，SCMAPR的性能提升了0.028分。SCMAPR的代码可以在https://github.com/HiThink-Research/SCMAPR网站上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LoReFact: Bridging the Logic Gap in Fact-Checking
papers.title_zh: LoReFact：填补事实核查中的逻辑空白
papers.authors: Qiming Xie, Wenjie Zheng, Xiangqing Shen, Rui Xia
papers.abstract: The rise of social media and generative AI has led to a surge of misinformation online, making reliable fact-checking increasingly critical.Most existing fact-checking research adheres to the decompose-then-verify paradigm, emphasizing verification of individual facts while overlooking the validity of logical dependencies among them. As a result, text containing logical errors may still be misjudged as factual. Moreover, existing datasets and metrics focus on fact completeness and coverage, failing to capture the logical dimension.To help bridge this gap, we propose a content–logic coupled factuality evaluation paradigm, which conceptualizes factuality along two complementary dimensions: content factuality and logic factuality. Under this paradigm, we introduce a holistic solution consisting of LoReFact, the first long-form fact-checking dataset that systematically incorporates the logical dimension; LoRe-Factcheck, a simple yet effective framework for joint content–logic evaluation; and a logic-aware metric named LoReFactScore for exposing and penalizing logical fallacies.Experiments demonstrate the importance of logical factuality and the effectiveness of our proposed paradigm for fact-checking.[Our data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/NUSTM/LoReFact]
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体和生成式人工智能的兴起导致了网络上的错误信息激增，因此进行可靠的事实核查变得愈发重要。目前大多数事实核查研究都遵循“分解后再验证”的模式，只关注单个事实的验证，而忽视了它们之间逻辑关系的有效性。因此，包含逻辑错误的文本仍可能被误认为是真实信息。此外，现有的数据集和评估指标主要关注事实的完整性和覆盖范围，未能考虑到逻辑层面的问题。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种内容与逻辑相结合的事实性评估范式，该范式从两个互补的维度来定义事实性：内容事实性和逻辑事实性。在这一范式中，我们提出了一种综合解决方案，包括LoReFact——首个系统纳入逻辑维度的长形式事实核查数据集；LoRe-Factcheck——一个简单但有效的内容与逻辑联合评估框架；以及名为LoReFactScore的逻辑意识评估指标，用于揭示和惩罚逻辑谬误。实验表明，逻辑事实性非常重要，而我们提出的范式在事实核查方面具有显著效果。[我们的数据和代码可在https://github.com/NUSTM/LoReFact免费获取]
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ODTQA-FoRe: An Open-Domain Tabular Question Answering Dataset for Future Data Forecasting and Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ODTQA-FoRe：一个开放域的表格问题回答数据集，用于未来数据的预测与推理
papers.authors: Zhensheng Wang, Xiaole Liu, Wenmian Yang, Kun Zhou, Yiquan Zhang, Weijia Jia
papers.abstract: The rapid development of LLMs has significantly advanced tabular question answering, but most systems cannot perform future-oriented numerical prediction. To address this gap, we introduce a novel task, Open-Domain Tabular Question Answering for Future Data Forecasting and Reasoning, and propose the first dataset to cover time-series forecasting and forecast-based reasoning scenarios using real estate data. This task poses challenges in retrieving precise historical data, overcoming the forecasting limitations of LLMs, and standardizing responses for diverse queries. To solve the above challenges, we propose TimeFore, an LLM agent-based framework that decomposes the problem into three collaborative roles: a Retriever autonomously generates SQL to fetch data, a Forecaster invokes external time-series models for higher accuracy, and an Analyzer synthesizes the results to construct a precise and consistent final answer. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our TimeFore.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的快速发展显著提升了表格问答能力，但大多数系统仍无法进行面向未来的数值预测。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种全新的任务——开放域表格问答用于未来数据预测与推理。我们还创建了首个涵盖时间序列预测及基于预测的推理场景的数据集，该数据集使用了房地产数据。这项任务面临着获取精确历史数据的挑战、克服大语言模型在预测方面的局限性，以及为不同查询标准化回答的难题。为了解决上述挑战，我们提出了TimeFore这一基于大语言模型代理的框架。该框架将问题分解为三个协作角色：检索器负责自主生成SQL以获取数据；预测器调用外部时间序列模型以获得更高精度；分析器则对结果进行整合，从而得出准确且一致的最终答案。大量的实验证明了TimeFore的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rectified Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Sequence Generation
papers.title_zh: 修正的稀疏注意力机制，实现高效的长序列生成
papers.authors: Yutao Sun, Tianzhu Ye, Li Dong, Yuqing Xia, Jian Chen, Yizhao Gao, Shijie Cao, Jianyong Wang, Furu Wei
papers.abstract: Efficient long-sequence generation is a critical challenge for Large Language Models. While recent sparse decoding methods improve efficiency, they suffer from KV cache misalignment, where approximation errors accumulate and degrade generation quality. In this work, we propose Rectified Sparse Attention (ReSA), a simple yet effective method that combines block-sparse attention with periodic dense rectification. By refreshing the KV cache at fixed intervals using a dense forward pass, ReSA bounds error accumulation and preserves alignment with the pretraining distribution. Experiments across math reasoning, language modeling, and retrieval tasks demonstrate that ReSA achieves near-lossless generation quality with significantly improved efficiency. Notably, ReSA delivers up to 3.77x end-to-end speedup under decoding at 256K sequence length, making it a practical solution for scalable long-context inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 高效的长序列生成是大语言模型面临的一项关键挑战。虽然最近的稀疏解码方法提升了效率，但它们存在KV缓存不对齐的问题，即近似误差会不断累积，从而降低生成的品质。在这项研究中，我们提出了修正稀疏注意力机制（ReSA），这是一种简单而有效的方法，它将块级稀疏注意力与周期性密集矫正相结合。通过以固定间隔使用密集前向传播来刷新KV缓存，ReSA能够限制误差的累积，同时保持与预训练分布的一致性。在数学推理、语言建模和检索任务中的实验表明，ReSA在生成质量上几乎达到了无损水平，同时显著提高了效率。值得注意的是，在256K序列长度的解码过程中，ReSA实现了高达3.77倍的端到端加速效果，使其成为可扩展长上下文推理问题的实用解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Knowing-but-Doing: Diagnosing and Defending Role-Play-Driven LLMs Jailbreaks via Moral Disengagement
papers.title_zh: 知而不行：诊断并防御由角色扮演驱动的大语言模型通过道德欺骗实现的越狱行为
papers.authors: Haiming Qin, Jianxun Lian, Qimin Zhong, Mingyang Zhou, Hao Liao, Naipeng Chao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in role-play scenarios, but their safety implications remain under-characterized. We present an explanatory framework grounded in Bandura’s Moral Disengagement theory and introduce a diagnostic benchmark (MD-Trace) for role-play jailbreaks. In our experiments, role-play improves safety behavior for benign personas while increasing unsafe compliance for malicious ones. We observe a Knowing-but-Doing failure in which models recognize safety risks in their thinking traces yet proceed to comply with harmful requests. Mechanism analysis suggests that Moral Justification is dominant, with Disregard of Consequences appearing as a secondary pattern. We compare multiple attack and defense methods and find that the diagnosis aligns with observed failure modes. Finally, we propose MD-Shield, an introspection-based defense that reduces attack success while maintaining Role Fidelity. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/lavapapa/MoralJustify/.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在角色扮演场景中得到了越来越多的应用，但其安全性问题仍然没有得到充分研究。我们提出了一种基于班杜拉的道德脱离理论的解释性框架，并开发了一个用于诊断角色扮演中违规行为的基准测试（MD-Trace）。在我们的实验中，角色扮演行为能够改善良性角色的 안전行为，但同时会增加恶意角色的不安全行为。我们发现，模型在思维过程中能够识别安全风险，但仍然会遵从有害的要求，这就是所谓的“明知故犯”现象。机制分析表明，道德正当化是主导因素，而忽视后果则是一种次要模式。我们比较了多种攻击和防御方法，发现诊断结果与观察到的失败模式是一致的。最后，我们提出了MD-Shield这一基于内省式的防御机制，它能够降低攻击的成功率，同时保持角色的真实性与可信度。该代码的源代码可以在https://github.com/lavapapa/MoralJustify/获取。

papers.title: Generative-to-Discriminative Test-Time Adaptation via Manifold-Aware Diffusion and Bayesian Distillation
papers.title_zh: 基于流形感知的扩散算法与贝叶斯蒸馏技术，实现从生成式到判别式的测试时间自适应调整方法
papers.authors: Boyun Zhang, Zequn Xie, Fangming Feng, Zihan Zhang, Yongbo He, Chuxin Wang, Sihang Cai, Tao Jin, Qifei Zhang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) models typically suffer significant performance degradation under domain shifts. While Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) aims to mitigate this, existing discriminative approaches often succumb to “confident but wrong” predictions on out-of-distribution samples. Conversely, generative models offer robust calibration but incur prohibitive computational costs. To bridge this gap, we propose GD-Adapt (Generative-Discriminative Adaptation), a novel TTA framework that harmonizes the robustness of generative diffusion models with the efficiency of discriminative regression networks via Bayesian Diffusion Distillation (BDD). Specifically, we introduce Auxiliary Generative Regularization (AGR) during pretraining to enforce manifold-aware feature learning. Extensive experiments across five cross-domain scenarios demonstrate our method’s superiority. For instance, on the challenging MOSI to SIMS shift, GD-Adapt reduces Mean Absolute Error (MAE) from 0.6872 to 0.5673 and boosts binary accuracy by 5.81 percentage points (reaching 57.33%). Notably, in scenarios such as SIMS to MOSI, we achieve an 11.18-point gain over the non-adapted baseline.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态情感分析模型在领域迁移情况下通常会出现显著的性能下降。虽然测试时间适应技术旨在缓解这一问题，但现有的判别性方法往往会在非分布样本上产生“自信但错误的”预测。相反，生成模型虽然能够提供稳健的校准效果，但其计算成本却非常高昂。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了GD-Adapt这一新型测试时间适应框架。该框架通过贝叶斯扩散蒸馏技术，将生成扩散模型的稳健性与判别回归网络的效率相结合。具体来说，我们在预训练阶段引入了辅助生成正则化技术，以强制进行具有流形感知的特征学习。在五个跨领域场景中的大量实验表明，我们的方法具有显著优势。例如，在从MOSI到SIMS的迁移任务中，GD-Adapt将平均绝对误差从0.6872降低到0.5673，并将二元分类准确率提高了5.81个百分点（达到57.33%）。值得注意的是，在从SIMS到MOSI的场景中，我们的方法比未适应的基线方法提升了11.18个百分点的准确率。

papers.title: Evaluating Memory Capability in Continuous Lifelog Scenario
papers.title_zh: 在持续生活日志场景中评估内存能力
papers.authors: Jianjie Zheng, Zhichen Liu, Zhanyu Shen, Jingxiang Qu, Guanhua Chen, Yile Wang, Yang Xu, Yang Liu, Sijie Cheng
papers.abstract: Nowadays, wearable devices can continuously lifelog ambient conversations, creating substantial opportunities for memory systems. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on online one-on-one chatting or human-AI interactions, thus neglecting the unique demands of real-world scenarios. Given the scarcity of public lifelogging audio datasets, we propose a hierarchical synthesis framework to curate LifeDialBench, a novel benchmark comprising two complementary subsets: EgoMem, built on real-world egocentric videos, and LifeMem, constructed using simulated virtual community. Crucially, to address the issue of temporal leakage in traditional offline settings, we propose an Online Evaluation protocol that strictly adheres to temporal causality, ensuring systems are evaluated in a realistic streaming fashion. Our experimental results reveal a counterintuitive finding: current sophisticated memory systems fail to outperform a simple RAG-based baseline. This highlights the detrimental impact of over-designed structures and lossy compression in current approaches, emphasizing the necessity of high-fidelity context preservation for lifelog scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 如今，可穿戴设备能够持续记录环境中的对话内容，这为记忆系统带来了巨大的机会。然而，现有的基准测试主要聚焦于在线的一对一聊天或人类与人工智能的互动，从而忽略了现实世界场景的独特需求。鉴于公开可用的生活日志音频数据集较为稀缺，我们提出了一个分层合成框架来构建LifeDialBench这一新的基准测试体系。该测试包含两个互补的子集：EgoMem，基于现实世界的自我中心视频构建；以及LifeMem，通过模拟虚拟社区来构建。为了应对传统离线环境中时间泄露的问题，我们提出了一种在线评估协议，该协议严格遵循时间因果关系，确保系统以真实的方式被评估。我们的实验结果表明了一个反直觉的现象：当前复杂的记忆系统往往无法超越基于RAG的简单基线模型。这凸显了当前方法中过度设计的结构以及有损压缩方式所带来的负面影响，从而强调了在生活日志场景中保持高保真度的上下文信息的必要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GoT-R1: Internalizing Graph-of-Thought via Structural Reinforcement for High-Density Reasoning
papers.title_zh: GoT-R1：通过结构强化机制来内化思维图谱，以实现高密度的推理能力
papers.authors: Zuchao Li, Qiwei Li, Yao Yao, Hai Zhao, Lefei Zhang, Bo Du
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, while effective, suffers from an inherent mechanism flaw: linearity induces overthinking. Constrained by sequential generation, models often produce redundant narration and circular self-corrections to maintain logical context. We propose GoT-R1, a framework that fundamentally mitigates this by replacing verbose linear trajectories with high-density reasoning graphs. Unlike CoT, GoT-R1 decouples logic from narration, modeling deliberation as a structured topology of atomic units. We internalize this inductive bias via a two-stage regimen: synthesizing structural data to distill logical skeletons, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to explicitly reinforce topological integrity. Extensive evaluations across mathematical reasoning and instruction following demonstrate that GoT-R1 consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Crucially, it achieves these gains with significantly reduced token overhead, demonstrating that structured reasoning density offers a more robust and parsimonious alternative to the recursive verbosity of standard CoT. The GoT-R1 models are open-sourced on Hugging Face at: https://huggingface.co/collections/MYTH-Lab/got-r1.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链推理虽然有效，但存在一种固有的机制缺陷：线性推理会导致过度思考。由于受到顺序生成的限制，模型通常会产生冗余的叙述和循环的自我修正，以维护逻辑连贯性。我们提出了GoT-R1框架，该框架通过用高密度的推理图替代冗长的线性叙述，从根本上解决了这一问题。与思维链推理不同，GoT-R1将逻辑与叙述分离，将推理过程建模为由原子单元构成的结构化拓扑结构。我们通过两阶段的方法实现这一归纳性优势：首先合成结构数据以提炼逻辑骨架，然后通过群体相对策略优化来明确强化拓扑结构的完整性。在数学推理和指令遵循方面的广泛评估表明，GoT-R1始终优于最先进的基线方法。重要的是，它能够在显著减少token开销的情况下取得这些优势，这表明结构化推理密度提供了一种比标准思维链推理更稳健且更简洁的替代方案。GoT-R1模型已在Hugging Face上开源，链接为：https://huggingface.co/collections/MYTH-Lab/got-r1。

papers.title: Hey, That’s My Data! Token-Only Dataset Inference in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 嘿，那些都是我的数据！只使用令牌进行大型语言模型的推理操作
papers.authors: Chen Xiong, Zihao Wang, Rui Zhu, Tsung-Yi Ho, Pin-Yu Chen, Jingwei Xiong, Haixu Tang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on massive training datasets, often including proprietary data, which raises concerns about unauthorized usage and copyright infringement. Existing dataset inference methods typically require access to log probabilities or other internal signals, but many modern LLMs restrict such access, motivating token-only inference approaches. We propose CatShift, a token-only dataset inference framework based on catastrophic forgetting, where models overwrite prior knowledge when trained on new data. Fine-tuning an LLM on a subset of its training data induces larger output shifts than fine-tuning on unseen data. CatShift compares these shifts against those from a known non-member validation set to infer whether a dataset was included in training. Experiments on both open-source and API-based LLMs show that CatShift remains effective without logit access, enabling practical protection of proprietary datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）依赖于庞大的训练数据集，这些数据集通常包含专有数据，这引发了关于未经授权使用和侵犯版权的问题。现有的数据集推理方法通常需要访问日志概率或其他内部信号，但许多现代LLM限制了这种访问权限，因此出现了仅基于令牌的推理方法。我们提出了CatShift这一基于灾难性遗忘技术的仅基于令牌的数据集推理框架，该框架在训练新数据时，模型会覆盖先前的知识。在训练数据的子集上进行LLM的微调，会导致比在未见数据上进行微调更大的输出偏移。CatShift将这些偏移与已知的非成员验证集中的偏移进行比较，以判断某个数据集是否参与了训练过程。在开源和基于API的LLM上的实验表明，即使没有访问日志概率信息，CatShift仍然能够有效工作，从而切实保护了专有数据集的安全。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ToxiTrace: Gradient-Aligned Training for Explainable Chinese Toxicity Detection
papers.title_zh: ToxiTrace：梯度对齐训练方法，用于可解释性的中文毒性检测
papers.authors: Boyang Li, Hongzhe Shou, Yuanyuan Liang, JingBin Zhang, Fang Zhou
papers.abstract: Existing Chinese toxic content detection methods mainly target sentence-level classification but often fail to provide readable and contiguous toxic evidence spans. We propose ToxiTrace, an explainability-oriented method for BERT-style encoders with three components: (1) CuSA, which refines encoder-derived saliency cues into fine-grained toxic spans with lightweight LLM guidance; (2) GCLoss, a gradient-constrained objective that concentrates token-level saliency on toxic evidence while suppressing irrelevant activations; and (3) ARCL, which constructs sample-specific contrastive reasoning pairs to sharpen the semantic boundary between toxic and non-toxic content. Experiments show that ToxiTrace improves classification accuracy and toxic span extraction while preserving efficient encoder-based inference and producing more coherent, human-readable explanations. The core training code is available at https://github.com/ZhouF-ECNU/ToxiTrace.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的中文有毒内容检测方法主要侧重于句子级别的分类，但往往无法提供清晰且连贯的有毒内容范围。我们提出了ToxiTrace方法，这是一种以可解释性为目标的BERT风格编码器处理方法，包含三个组成部分：(1) CuSA，该模块将编码器生成的显著性线索细化为细粒度的有毒内容范围，并借助轻量级LLM进行指导；(2) GCLoss，这是一个梯度约束目标函数，它能够将标记级别的显著性集中在有毒内容上，同时抑制无关激活；以及(3) ARCL，该模块构建特定样本的对比推理对，以明确区分有毒内容与无毒内容之间的语义边界。实验表明，ToxiTrace能够在保持高效基于编码器的推理能力的同时，提高分类准确率和有毒内容范围的提取效果，并且能够生成更连贯、易于人类理解的解释。核心训练代码可在https://github.com/ZhouF-ECNU/ToxiTrace下载。

papers.title: Three Minds, One Legend: Jailbreak Large Reasoning Model with Adaptive Stacked Ciphers
papers.title_zh: 三思一传奇：利用自适应堆叠密码技术突破大型推理模型的限制
papers.authors: Nguyen Viet Anh, Shiqian Zhao, Gia Dao, Runyi Hu, Yi Xie, Xiaobao Wu, Anh Tuan Luu
papers.abstract: Recently, Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated superior logical capabilities compared to traditional Large Language Models (LLMs), gaining significant attention. Despite their impressive performance, the potential for stronger reasoning abilities to introduce more severe security vulnerabilities, though pointed out by some previous works, remains largely underexplored. Existing jailbreak methods often struggle to balance effectiveness with robustness against adaptive safety mechanisms. In this work, we propose SEAL, a novel jailbreak attack that targets LRMs through an adaptive encryption pipeline designed to override their reasoning processes and evade potential adaptive alignment. Specifically, SEAL introduces a stacked encryption approach that combines multiple ciphers to overwhelm the model’s reasoning capabilities, effectively bypassing built-in safety mechanisms. To further prevent LRMs from developing countermeasures, we incorporate two dynamic strategies—random and adaptive—that adjust the cipher length, order, and combination. Extensive experiments on real-world reasoning models, including DeepSeek-R1, Claude Sonnet, and OpenAI GPT-o4-mini, validate the effectiveness of our approach. Notably, SEAL achieves an attack success rate of 85.6% on GPT o4-mini, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by a significant margin of 17.2%. Warning: This paper contains examples of inappropriate, offensive, and harmful content
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，大型推理模型（LRM）在逻辑处理能力方面表现出色，远超传统的大语言模型（LLM），因此受到了广泛关注。尽管其性能令人印象深刻，但一些研究指出，更强的推理能力可能会引入更严重的安全漏洞。现有的越狱方法往往难以在有效性与对抗自适应安全机制的能力之间取得平衡。在这项研究中，我们提出了SEAL这一新型越狱攻击方法，该方法通过一种自适应加密流程来针对LRM，以覆盖它们的推理过程并规避潜在的自适应对齐机制。具体来说，SEAL采用了一种堆叠式加密方法，通过结合多种加密算法来削弱模型的推理能力，从而有效绕过内置的安全机制。为了进一步防止LRM开发出对策，我们引入了两种动态策略——随机性和适应性——来调整加密算法的长度、顺序和组合方式。在包括DeepSeek-R1、Claude Sonnet和OpenAI GPT-o4-mini等真实世界推理模型上的广泛实验验证了我们的方法的有效性。值得注意的是，SEAL在GPT-o4-mini上的攻击成功率达到了85.6%，显著优于现有最先进的基线方法，优势达17.2%。警告：本文包含不适当、冒犯性和有害内容。

papers.title: From Imitation to Discrimination: Progressive Curriculum Learning for Robust Web Navigation
papers.title_zh: 从模仿到区分：用于高效网络导航的渐进式课程学习方法
papers.authors: Peng Chuang, Wei Zhang, Renshuai Tao, Xinhao Zhang, Jian Yang
papers.abstract: Text-based web agents offer computational efficiency for autonomous web navigation, yet developing robust agents remains challenging due to the noisy and heterogeneous nature of real-world HTML. Standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) approaches fail in two critical dimensions: they lack discrimination capabilities to reject plausible but incorrect elements in densely populated pages, and exhibit limited generalization to unseen website layouts. To address these challenges, we introduce the Triton dataset (590k instances) and a progressive training curriculum. Triton is constructed via Structural-Semantic Hard Negative Mining, which explicitly mines topologically similar distractors, and a Dual-Agent Consensus pipeline that synthesizes diverse cross-domain tasks with strict verification. Building upon this foundation, our progressive curriculum produces three models: Triton-SFT-32B for basic imitation, Triton-ORPO-32B for robust discrimination via Odds Ratio Preference Optimization, and Triton-GRPO-32B for long-horizon consistency through Group Relative Policy Optimization. Empirical evaluation on Mind2Web demonstrates that Triton-GRPO-32B achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models with 58.7% Step Success Rate, surpassing GPT-4.5 (42.4%) and Claude-4.5 (41.4%) by over 16%, validating that specialized data curriculum outweighs raw parameter scale for web navigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于文本的网页代理在自主网页导航方面提供了计算效率上的优势，但由于现实世界中HTML数据的噪声性和异构性，开发出可靠的代理仍然具有挑战性。标准的监督式微调方法在两个关键方面存在不足：它们缺乏辨别能力，无法剔除密集页面中那些看似合理但错误的元素；同时，它们在面对未见过的网站布局时，泛化能力也有限。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了Triton数据集（59万个实例）以及一套渐进式的训练方案。Triton是通过结构语义硬负面挖掘技术构建的，该技术能够明确识别出拓扑上相似的干扰项；同时，我们的系统还采用了双代理共识机制，能够合成多种跨领域的任务，并经过严格的验证。基于这一基础，我们的渐进式训练方案产生了三个模型：Triton-SFT-32B用于基本模仿；Triton-ORPO-32B通过比率偏好优化实现强大的辨别能力；而Triton-GRPO-32B则通过组相对策略优化实现长期的一致性。在Mind2Web上的实证评估表明，Triton-GRPO-32B在开源模型中取得了最先进的性能，其步骤成功率达到了58.7%，远远超过了GPT-4.5的42.4%和Claude-4.5的41.4%，高出16%以上。这验证了，对于网页导航来说，专门化的数据训练方案比单纯的参数规模更为重要。

papers.title: Parallelism and Generation Order in Masked Diffusion Language Models: Limits Today, Potential Tomorrow
papers.title_zh: 平行性与生成顺序在掩码扩散语言模型中的体现：当下的局限，未来的潜力
papers.authors: Yangyang Zhong, Yanmei Gu, Zhengqing Zang, Xiaomeng Li, Yuqi Ding, Xibei Jia, Yuting Shen, Zhenzhong Lan, Liwang Zhu, Weiping Liu, Junlin Zhou, Haisheng Liu, Zhong Xin Yu, Pengxin Luo, Donglian Qi, Yunfeng Yan, Junbo Zhao
papers.abstract: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) promise parallel token generation and arbitrary-order decoding, yet it remains unclear to what extent current models truly realize these capabilities. We characterize MDLM behavior along two dimensions—parallelism strength and generation order—using Average Finalization Parallelism (AFP) and Kendall’s τ. We evaluate eight mainstream MDLMs (up to 100B parameters) on 58 benchmarks spanning knowledge, reasoning, and programming. The results show that MDLMs still lag behind comparably sized autoregressive models, mainly because parallel probabilistic modeling weakens inter-token dependencies. Meanwhile, MDLMs exhibit adaptive decoding behavior: their parallelism and generation order vary significantly with the task domain, the stage of reasoning, and whether the output is correct. On tasks that require “backward information” (e.g., Sudoku), MDLMs adopt a solution order that tends to fill easier Sudoku blanks first, highlighting their advantages. Finally, we provide theoretical motivation and design insights supporting a Generate-then-Edit paradigm, which mitigates dependency loss while retaining the efficiency of parallel decoding.
papers.abstract_zh: 伪装式扩散语言模型（MDLMs）承诺实现并行标记生成和任意顺序的解码功能，不过目前尚不清楚这些功能在多大程度上得到了实现。我们通过“平均最终化并行性”（AFP）和肯德尔的τ值，从两个维度来评估MDLMs的行为：并行性强度和解码顺序。我们在58个基准测试中对8种主流MDLMs进行了评估，这些测试涵盖了知识、推理和编程领域。结果表明，MDLMs仍然落后于同等规模的自回归模型，主要是因为并行概率建模会削弱标记之间的依赖关系。同时，MDLMs表现出自适应解码行为：它们的并行性和解码顺序会根据任务领域、推理阶段以及输出的正确性而发生变化。在需要“逆向信息”的任务中（例如数独），MDLMs倾向于先解决较为简单的数独谜题，这凸显了它们的优势。最后，我们提供了理论依据和设计见解，支持“先生成再编辑”的范式，该范式可以在减少依赖关系损失的同时，保持并行解码的效率。

papers.title: Understanding New-Knowledge-Induced Factual Hallucinations in LLMs: Analysis and Interpretation
papers.title_zh: 理解大型语言模型中由新知识引发的幻觉现象：分析与解读
papers.authors: Renfei Dang, Peng Hu, Zhejian Lai, Changjiang Gao, Min Zhang, Shujian Huang
papers.abstract: Prior works have shown that fine-tuning on new knowledge can induce factual hallucinations in large language models (LLMs), leading to incorrect outputs when evaluated on previously known information. However, the specific manifestations of such hallucination and its underlying mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. Our work addresses this gap by designing a controlled dataset Biography-Reasoning, and conducting a fine-grained analysis across multiple knowledge types and two task types, including knowledge question answering (QA) and knowledge reasoning tasks. We find that hallucinations not only severely affect tasks involving newly introduced knowledge, but also propagate to other evaluation tasks. Moreover, when fine-tuning on a dataset in which a specific knowledge type consists entirely of new knowledge, LLMs exhibit elevated hallucination tendencies. This suggests that the degree of unfamiliarity within a particular knowledge type, rather than the overall proportion of new knowledge, is a stronger driver of hallucinations. Through interpretability analysis, we show that learning new knowledge weakens the model’s attention to key entities in the input question, leading to an over-reliance on surrounding context and a higher risk of hallucination. Conversely, reintroducing a small amount of known knowledge during the later stages of training restores attention to key entities and substantially mitigates hallucination behavior. Finally, we demonstrate that disrupted attention patterns can propagate across lexically similar contexts, facilitating the spread of hallucinations beyond the original task.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前的研究表明，对新知识进行微调会导致大语言模型出现事实性幻觉，从而在基于已知信息的评估中产生错误的输出。然而，这种幻觉的具体表现形式及其背后的机制仍未被充分理解。我们的研究通过设计一个名为“Biography-Reasoning”的对照数据集，并对多种知识类型和两种任务类型进行了细致分析，包括知识问答和知识推理任务。我们发现，幻觉不仅严重影响涉及新知识的任务，还会扩散到其他评估任务中。此外，当在仅包含新知识的数据集上进行微调时，大语言模型的幻觉倾向会加剧。这表明，特定知识类型中的陌生程度，而非新知识的整体比例，是引发幻觉的更重要因素。通过可解释性分析，我们发现学习新知识会削弱模型对输入问题中关键实体的关注，导致模型过度依赖周围上下文，从而增加幻觉发生的风险。相反，在训练后期重新引入少量已知知识可以恢复模型对关键实体的关注，有效减轻幻觉行为。最后，我们证明，注意力模式的紊乱可以在词汇相似的环境中传播，从而促使幻觉超越原始任务范围扩散。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Attribution-Based Analysis and Optimization of Modular Agentic Workflows
papers.title_zh: 基于归属关系的模块化智能工作流分析与优化
papers.authors: Yingxuan Yang, Bo Huang, Siyuan Qi, Chao Feng, Haoyi Hu, Yuxuan Zhu, Jinbo Hu, Haoran Zhao, Ziyi He, Xiao Liu, ZongYu Wang, Muning Wen, Lin Qiu, Xuezhi Cao, Xunliang Cai, Yong Yu, Weinan Zhang
papers.abstract: Agentic workflows solve complex tasks by orchestrating modular components (e.g., planning, reasoning, action, reflection) built on top of LLM backbones. A practical but underexplored question is model allocation: given a fixed workflow decomposition and a pool of candidate LLMs, which components should be upgraded (and with which models) to upgrade task performance, and how can we attribute gains to individual upgrades and their interactions?We present ShapleyFlow, a cooperative game theoretic framework that models component upgrades as players and evaluates component coalitions to compute Shapley values. This yields interaction-aware attribution and supports Shapley-guided configuration recommendation for model allocation under a fixed workflow structure.We further introduce CapaBench, a benchmark of 1,500+ tasks across seven domains (shopping, navigation, ticketing, mathematics, operating systems, robotic coordination, and automated theorem proving).Across 9 representative LLMs and all 2^4 upgrade coalitions in a 4-component workflow, ShapleyFlow provides (i) principled, interaction-aware attribution for modular workflows and (ii) actionable model-allocation recommendations that improve over strong single-model baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动式工作流程通过整合模块化组件（如规划、推理、执行、反思等）来解决复杂任务，这些组件都是建立在大语言模型基础之上的。一个实际但尚未被充分探索的问题是模型分配：在固定的工作流程结构以及一系列候选大语言模型的情况下，应该升级哪些组件（以及使用哪些模型）以提升任务性能？我们又如何将这些改进效果归因于各个升级措施及其相互作用呢？我们提出了ShapleyFlow这一合作博弈理论框架，它将组件升级视为玩家之间的互动行为，并通过评估组件组合来计算Shapley值。这一方法能够实现交互意识的归因分析，并为在固定工作流程结构下的模型分配提供基于Shapley值的配置建议。此外，我们还引入了CapaBench这一基准测试，该测试涵盖了七个领域的1500多个任务，包括购物、导航、票务处理、数学计算、操作系统、机器人协调以及自动定理证明等领域。在9种代表性的大语言模型和4个组件的流程中，ShapleyFlow能够为模块化工作流程提供有原则性的、具有交互意识的归因分析，同时还能给出可行的模型分配建议，其效果优于那些仅依赖单一模型的基准测试。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Synthetic Eggs in Many Baskets: The Impact of Synthetic Data Diversity on LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 大量合成数据：合成数据多样性对大型语言模型微调的影响
papers.authors: Max Schaffelder, Albert Gatt
papers.abstract: As synthetic data becomes widely used in language model development, understanding its impact on model behavior is crucial. This paper investigates the impact of the diversity of sources of synthetic data on fine-tuned large language models. We focus on three key dimensions: distribution collapse, adversarial robustness, and self-preference bias. Our findings reveal that fine-tuning models on synthetic data from diverse sources can mitigate distribution collapse, preserving the breadth of the output distribution and the diversity of the output text. Furthermore, while both human and synthetic fine-tuning data can remove safeguards, we observe a tendency for higher output quality in the latter case, thus making outputs potentially more usable and dangerous. Finally, we also find evidence that fine-tuning reduces self-preference bias, with human data being the most effective, followed by multi-source synthetic data. All code is available at https://github.com/maxschaffelder/synthetic_data_diversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着合成数据在语言模型开发中的广泛应用，了解其对模型行为的影响变得至关重要。本文研究了合成数据的来源多样性对微调后的大语言模型的影响。我们重点关注三个关键方面：分布崩溃、对抗性鲁棒性以及自我偏好偏差。我们的研究发现，使用来自不同来源的合成数据进行模型微调可以缓解分布崩溃问题，从而保持输出分布的广度和文本的多样性。此外，虽然人类数据和合成数据都能消除某些限制因素，但我们发现后一种情况下的输出质量更高，因此可能更易于使用，同时也更具危险性。最后，我们还发现，微调可以减少自我偏好偏差，其中人类数据的效果最为显著，其次是多源合成数据。所有代码均可在此处获取：https://github.com/maxschaffelder/synthetic_data_diversity。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SolidCoder: Bridging the Mental-Reality Gap in LLM Code Generation through Concrete Execution
papers.title_zh: SolidCoder：通过具体执行来缩小大型语言模型代码生成过程中思维与现实之间的差距
papers.authors: Woojin Lee, Jin-Xia Huang
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art code generation frameworks rely on mental simulation, where LLMs internally trace execution to verify correctness. We expose a fundamental limitation: the Mental-Reality Gap—where models hallucinate execution traces and confidently validate buggy code. This gap manifests along two orthogonal dimensions: the Specification Gap (overlooking edge cases during planning) and the Verification Gap (hallucinating correct behavior for flawed code). We propose SolidCoder with a simple principle: don’t imagine—execute. The S.O.L.I.D. architecture addresses both dimensions by forcing edge-case awareness before algorithm design and replacing imagined traces with sandboxed execution using property-based oracles. With GPT-4o, SolidCoder achieves state-of-the-art pass@1 performance: 95.7% on HumanEval (+0.6%p), 77.0% on CodeContests (+4.3%p), and 26.7% on APPS (+3.4%p). Ablation reveals that edge-case awareness provides the largest individual gain, while execution grounding catches categorically different errors that specification improvements cannot address. These gains generalize to RL post-trained models, validating that bridging both gap dimensions is essential for robust code synthesis. We release our code and framework to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 最先进的代码生成框架依赖于心理模拟机制，即大语言模型会内部追踪执行过程以验证代码的正确性。然而，这种机制存在一个根本缺陷：心理现实差距——模型会虚构出正确的执行轨迹，并自信地验证有错误的代码。这一差距体现在两个正交的维度上：规范差距（在规划过程中忽略边缘情况）和验证差距（为有缺陷的代码虚构出正确的行为）。我们提出了SolidCoder这一简单原则：不要想象，直接执行。S.O.L.I.D.架构通过强制在算法设计之前考虑边缘情况，并用基于属性的预言器来替代虚构的轨迹，从而解决这两个问题。借助GPT-4o，SolidCoder取得了最先进的表现：在HumanEval评测中达到了95.7%的准确率（+0.6%p），在CodeContests中达到了77.0%的准确率（+4.3%p），在APPS评测中达到了26.7%的准确率（+3.4%p）。实验表明，考虑边缘情况能够带来最大的性能提升，而执行层面的改进则能够捕捉到规范改进无法解决的错误。这些优势可以推广到经过训练的强化学习模型，这验证了同时解决这两个差距维度对于实现稳健的代码生成至关重要。我们已公开我们的代码和框架，以便未来进行相关研究。

papers.title: EgoMemory: Memory-Augmented Personalized Retrieval for Long-Context Egocentric Video
papers.title_zh: EgoMemory：一种增强记忆功能的个性化检索系统，适用于处理长上下文内的自我相关视频内容
papers.authors: Yuanmin Tang, Jue Zhang, Xiaoting Qin, Jing Yu, Meikang Qiu, Gaopeng Gou, Gang Xiong, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang, Qi Wu
papers.abstract: Recent advances in AI and wearable devices, such as augmented-reality glasses, have made it possible to augment human memory by retrieving personal experiences in response to natural language queries. However, existing egocentric video datasets fall short in supporting the personalization and long-context reasoning required for episodic memory retrieval. To address these limitations, we introduce EgoMemory, a benchmark derived from Ego4D, enriched with 165,795 user-specific object annotations over 245 videos from 45 participants, yielding 639 distinct, human-curated, and evaluated queries for rich and individualized episodic memory retrieval. Leveraging this resource, we present EgoRetriever, a novel, training-free retrieval framework that combines Multimodal Large Language Models with reflective Chain-of-Thought prompting. Our approach enables interpretive inference of user intent and generates detailed target video descriptions by leveraging contextualized personal memory for video retrieval. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks, including EgoMemory, EgoCVR, and EgoLife, demonstrate that EgoRetriever consistently and substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting its strong generalizability and practical potential for personalized, long-context egocentric video retrieval.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，人工智能和可穿戴设备（如增强现实眼镜）的快速发展，使得人们能够通过自然语言查询来检索个人经历，从而增强人类的记忆能力。然而，现有的以自我为中心的视频数据集在支持情景记忆的个性化处理和长期上下文推理方面存在不足。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了EgoMemory这一基准测试框架。该框架基于Ego4D构建，包含了45名参与者在245个视频中的165,795条用户特定对象注释，共产生了639个经过人工筛选和评估的查询，用于丰富且个性化的情景记忆检索。利用这一资源，我们提出了EgoRetriever这一新型的无训练过程检索框架。该框架结合了多模态大语言模型和反思性思维链提示技术，能够解释用户的意图，并通过利用上下文相关的个人记忆来生成详细的目标视频描述。在包括EgoMemory、EgoCVR和EgoLife在内的三个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，EgoRetriever始终表现出优于现有最先进基线的性能，充分体现了其强大的泛化能力和在个性化、长期上下文的自我中心视频检索方面的实际应用潜力。

papers.title: PERM: Psychology-grounded Empathetic Reward Modeling for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: PERM：基于心理学的同理心奖励模型，适用于大型语言模型
papers.authors: Chengbing Wang, Wuqiang Zheng, Yang Zhang, Fengbin Zhu, Junyi Cheng, Yi Xie, Wenjie Wang, Fuli Feng
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in human-centric applications, yet they often fail to provide substantive emotional support. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been utilized to enhance empathy of LLMs, existing reward models typically evaluate empathy from a single perspective, overlooking the inherently bidirectional interaction nature of empathy between the supporter and seeker as defined by Empathy Cycle theory. To address this limitation, we propose Psychology-grounded Empathetic Reward Modeling (PERM). PERM operationalizes empathy evaluation through a bidirectional decomposition: 1) Supporter perspective, assessing internal resonation and communicative expression; 2) Seeker perspective, evaluating emotional reception. Additionally, it incorporates a bystander perspective to monitor overall interaction quality. Extensive experiments on a widely-used emotional intelligence benchmark and an industrial daily conversation dataset demonstrate that PERM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by over 10%. Furthermore, a blinded user study reveals a 70% preference for our approach, highlighting its efficacy in generating more empathetic responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在以人类为中心的应用中得到了越来越多的应用，但它们往往无法提供实质性的情感支持。虽然强化学习已被用于提升语言模型的共情能力，但现有的奖励模型通常只从单一角度来评估共情，而忽略了根据共情循环理论所定义的、支持者与寻求者之间固有的双向互动关系。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了基于心理学的共情奖励建模方法。该方法通过双向分解来实施共情评估：1）支持者的视角，评估内在共鸣和沟通表达；2）寻求者的视角，评估情感接收情况。此外，该方法还纳入了旁观者的视角，以监测整体互动质量。在广泛使用的情绪智力基准测试以及工业日常对话数据集上进行的实验表明，PERM的性能优于最先进的基线方法，其性能提升了10%以上。此外，一项盲测用户研究显示，有70%的用户偏好使用我们的方法，这充分证明了该方法在生成更具共情性的回应方面的有效性。

papers.title: Remedy-R: Generative Reasoning for Machine Translation Evaluation without Error Annotations
papers.title_zh: Remedy-R：用于机器翻译评估的生成性推理方法，无需错误注释即可进行评估
papers.authors: Shaomu Tan, Ryosuke Mitani, Ritvik Choudhary, Qiyu Wu, Toshiyuki Sekiya, Christof Monz
papers.abstract: Over the years, scalar MT metrics have advanced rapidly on benchmarks. Yet they remain black boxes, offering little insight into their decisions and sometimes degrading under out-of-distribution inputs. We introduce Remedy-R, a reasoning-driven generative MT metric trained with reinforcement learning from pairwise translation preferences, without requiring error-span annotations or distillation from closed LLMs. Unlike scalar MT metrics that only outputs translation quality scores, Remedy-R produces step-by-step analyses of accuracy, fluency, and completeness, enabling more interpretable assessments. With only 60K pairwise training samples across two language pairs, Remedy-R remains competitive with top scalar metrics and GPT-4-based judges on WMT22–24 metric benchmarks, generalizes to other languages, and shows strong robustness on OOD stress tests. Moreover, Remedy-R generates self-reflective feedback that can be reused for translation refinement. We validate the faithfulness of such feedback with GPT-4 and show that a simple evaluate–revise pipeline leveraging Remedy-R’s analyses consistently improves translation quality across diverse models without any task-specific tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 多年来，标量机器翻译指标在基准测试中的表现取得了显著进步。然而，这些指标仍然属于黑箱系统，无法提供关于其决策过程的详细信息，有时甚至会在非分布式的输入下表现不佳。我们提出了Remedy-R这一基于推理驱动的生成式机器翻译指标，该指标通过成对翻译偏好数据进行强化学习来训练，无需使用错误范围注释或来自封闭大语言模型的蒸馏技术。与仅输出翻译质量得分的标量机器翻译指标不同，Remedy-R能够逐步分析准确性、流畅性和完整性等指标，从而实现更易于理解的评估。仅需要6万对双语对的训练样本，Remedy-R就能在WMT22-24的基准测试中与顶级标量指标以及基于GPT-4的评测系统相媲美。此外，Remedy-R还表现出强大的鲁棒性，能够在非分布式输入的情况下保持稳定性能。更重要的是，Remedy-R能够生成自我反思性的反馈，这些反馈可以被重新用于翻译优化。我们通过与GPT-4进行对比验证了这种反馈的准确性，结果表明，利用Remedy-R的分析结果进行简单的评估与修正流程，可以持续提升不同模型下的翻译质量，而无需进行任何特定任务的调整。

papers.title: VizoMem: A Visual-Textual Memory Framework for Efficient Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.title_zh: VizoMem：一种用于高效进行长期推理的视觉文本记忆框架
papers.authors: Weijie Liang, Yuanfeng Song, Xing Chen, Caleb Chen Cao, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: Agentic systems built upon large language models (LLMs) increasingly depend on long-context modeling to support document understanding, long-term memory recall, and multi-step reasoning. However, extending context windows incurs substantial computational and memory overhead, significantly limiting the scalability and practicality of long-context LLM-based agents. Recent studies suggest that visual representations can serve as an effective medium for compressing and organizing long textual content. Motivated by this insight, we propose VizoMem, a novel visual memory framework for agentic systems. In this framework, textual memories are pre-rendered into structured images and stored as visual notes, enabling compact and persistent memory representations. Moving beyond standard vision-language models like Glyph, we pioneer a specialized retrieval system designed for large-scale visual memory. Our innovation lies in the construction of a dedicated dataset and the development of a highly efficient retrieval model that repurposes foundational vision-language encoders to navigate complex, text-heavy visual environments. Experiments on public datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly reduces token consumption while preserving effective long-term memory recall, highlighting its potential as a scalable alternative to conventional long-context modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型构建的智能系统，越来越依赖长上下文建模来支持文档理解、长期记忆检索以及多步骤推理。然而，扩展上下文窗口会带来巨大的计算和内存负担，这严重限制了基于长上下文语言模型的智能系统的可扩展性和实用性。最近的研究表明，视觉表示可以作为压缩和组织长文本内容的有效手段。基于这一发现，我们提出了VizoMem——一种用于智能系统的新型视觉记忆框架。在该框架中，文本记忆被预先渲染成结构化图像，并作为视觉笔记存储起来，从而实现紧凑且持久的记忆表示。我们超越了传统的视觉-语言模型，如Glyph，开创了一种专为大规模视觉记忆设计的专用检索系统。我们的创新之处在于构建了专门的训练数据集，并开发了一种高效的检索模型，该模型能够利用基础性的视觉-语言编码器来处理复杂的、包含大量文本的视觉环境。在公共数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法显著减少了令牌消耗，同时保留了有效的长期记忆检索能力，这凸显了它作为传统长上下文建模的可扩展替代方案的潜力。

papers.title: More Images, More Problems? A Controlled Analysis of VLM Failure Modes.
papers.title_zh: 更多的图像，更多的问题？对VLM故障模式的系统性分析
papers.authors: Anurag Das, Adrian Bulat, Alberto Baldrati, Ioannis Maniadis Metaxas, Bernt Schiele, Georgios Tzimiropoulos, Brais Martinez
papers.abstract: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, yet their proficiency in understanding and reasoning over multiple images remains largely unexplored. While existing benchmarks have initiated the evaluation of multi-image models, a comprehensive analysis of their core weaknesses and their causes is still lacking. In this work, we introduce MIMIC (Multi-Image Model Insights and Challenges), a new benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the multi-image capabilities of LVLMs. Using MIMIC, we conduct a series of diagnostic experiments that reveal pervasive issues: LVLMs often fail to aggregate information across images and struggle to track or attend to multiple concepts simultaneously. To address these failures, we propose two novel complementary remedies. On the data side, we present a procedural data-generation strategy that composes single-image annotations into rich, targeted multi-image training examples. On the optimization side, we analyze layer-wise attention patterns and derive an attention-masking scheme tailored for multi-image inputs. Experiments substantially improved cross-image aggregation, while also enhancing performance on existing multi-image benchmarks, outperforming prior state of the art across tasks. Data and code will be made available.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型在理解能力和推理能力方面展现出了惊人的性能，然而它们在处理多张图像时的表现仍然有待深入研究。虽然现有的基准测试已经开始对多图像模型进行评估，但对其核心缺陷及其成因的全面分析仍有所欠缺。在这项研究中，我们提出了MIMIC（多图像模型洞察与挑战）这一新的基准测试，旨在严格评估LVLM在多图像场景下的能力。通过MIMIC进行的一系列实验表明，LVLM普遍存在以下问题：它们往往无法有效整合不同图像中的信息，也难以同时处理多个概念。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了两种互补的解决方案。在数据层面，我们提出了一种数据生成策略，将单张图像的注释信息整合为丰富且有针对性的多图像训练样本。在优化层面，我们分析了逐层注意力模式，并提出了一种适用于多图像输入的注意力掩蔽方案。实验结果显示，这种方案显著提升了跨图像信息的整合能力，同时也提高了模型在现有多图像基准测试中的表现，其性能超越了当前最先进的模型。相关数据代码将会公开提供。
