papers.title: EOP-LLM: Energy Oriented Pruning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: EOP-LLM：针对大型语言模型的能源导向剪枝算法
papers.authors: Guan Huang, Tao Shu
papers.abstract: In deployed large language models (LLMs), inference energy consumption has grown rapidly and has emerged as a key bottleneck in large-scale deployment, yet most existing inference efficiency methods focus on reducing FLOPs or latency, rather than explicitly modeling or enforcing end-to-end inference energy constraints. We propose EOP-LLM, an energy-oriented dynamic pruning framework that enables LLM inference under explicit per-sequence energy budgets. EOP-LLM combines a device-calibrated energy proxy with lightweight token and feed-forward (FFN) selectors, coordinated through a global dual variable, to dynamically allocate computation while preserving model quality. Extensive experiments on LLaMA 3.2 (1B/3B) and LLaMA 3.1 (8B) demonstrate that EOP-LLM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art dynamic pruning baselines under matched energy budgets, while strictly adhering to per-sequence energy constraints.
papers.abstract_zh: 在部署的大语言模型中，推理能耗呈快速增长趋势，已成为大规模部署中的一个关键瓶颈。然而，目前大多数推理效率提升方法主要集中在减少浮点运算次数或延迟上，而并未明确建模或强制执行端到端推理的能耗约束。我们提出了EOP-LLM这一以能源为导向的动态剪枝框架，该框架能够在明确的序列能耗预算下实现大语言模型的推理。EOP-LLM结合了设备校准后的能耗代理以及轻量级的令牌和前馈选择器，通过全局双变量进行协调，从而动态分配计算资源，同时保持模型质量。在LaLaMA 3.2（1B/3B）和LaLaMA 3.1（8B）上的广泛实验表明，EOP-LLM在符合能耗预算的前提下，始终优于现有的动态剪枝基准算法，同时严格遵循了序列能耗约束。

papers.title: Sentipolis: Emotion-Aware Agents for Social Simulations
papers.title_zh: Sentipolis：适用于社交模拟的情感感知智能代理
papers.authors: Chiyuan Fu, Lyuhao Chen, Yunze Xiao, Weihao Xuan, Carlos Busso, Mona T. Diab
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for social simulation, yet emotion is often treated as a transient cue, causing emotional amnesia and weak long-horizon continuity. We present Sentipolis, a framework for emotionally stateful agents that integrates continuous Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance (PAD) representation, dual-speed emotion dynamics, and emotion–memory coupling. Across thousands of interactions over multiple base models and evaluators, Sentipolis improves emotionally grounded behavior, boosting communication, and emotional continuity. Gains are model-dependent: believability increases for higher-capacity models but can drop for smaller ones, and emotion-awareness can mildly reduce adherence to social norms, reflecting a human-like tension between emotion-driven behavior and rule compliance in social simulation. Network-level diagnostics show reciprocal, moderately clustered, and temporally stable relationship structures, supporting the study of cumulative social dynamics such as alliance formation and gradual relationship change.
papers.abstract_zh: LLM智能体在社交模拟中的应用越来越广泛，然而情绪往往被视作一种短暂的信号，这会导致情绪记忆的缺失以及长期行为的连贯性减弱。我们提出了Sentipolis框架，该框架为具有情绪感知的智能体设计了一套系统。该框架融合了连续的愉悦-兴奋-支配状态表示、双速情绪动态机制，以及情绪与记忆的耦合机制。通过数千次交互实验，在不同基础模型和评估器的测试中，Sentipolis显著提升了智能体的情感基础行为表现，增强了沟通能力和情绪连贯性。其效果取决于所使用的模型：对于容量较大的模型，模型的可信度会提高；而对于容量较小的模型，可信度则可能下降。此外，情绪感知可能会略微降低智能体对社会规范的遵守程度，这反映了在社交模拟中，情绪驱动的行为与规则遵守之间存在的类似人类式的矛盾关系。网络层面的分析表明，这些智能体之间存在相互关联、适度聚集且时间上稳定的关系结构，这为研究诸如联盟形成和关系逐渐变化等累积性社会动态提供了支持。

papers.title: Bidirectional Semantic Enhancement for Schema Routing Across Large-Scale Databases
papers.title_zh: 用于大规模数据库之间模式路由的双向语义增强技术
papers.authors: Yuyang Wu, Xiaoliang Wang, Cam-Tu Nguyen
papers.abstract: With the prevalence of Large Language Models (LLMs), Text-to-SQL has made significant progress, yet applying it to massive, real-world databases remains a challenge. While previous works adopt a retrieve-then-generate framework, they struggle with the profound semantic gap between user queries and vague schema definitions. Existing methods relying on unidirectional query expansion often fail to bridge lexical mismatches, while graph-based approaches struggle to navigate schemas when explicit structural links (e.g., foreign keys) are missing. To address this, we propose Bi-SR, a retrieval framework that bridges this gap through a bidirectional semantic enhancement strategy. We simultaneously enrich vague table schemas offline and perform online generative query expansion—specifically predicting potential schema structures—to align user intent. Crucially, we introduce a dual-augmented contrastive training objective for the dense retriever, which trains the dense retriever to recognize the semantic correspondence between the LLM-expanded query intent and the detailed schema descriptions. Experiments on massive schema routing benchmarks constructed from BIRD and Spider demonstrate that Bi-SR achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly empowers smaller models for cost-effective deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的发展，文本到SQL技术取得了显著进步，但将其应用于庞大的真实世界数据库仍然是一个挑战。虽然之前的研究采用了检索后再生成的框架，但它们在用户查询与模糊的架构定义之间存在着巨大的语义差距。那些依赖单向查询扩展的方法往往无法解决词汇上的不匹配问题，而基于图的方法则难以处理缺乏明确结构链接（如外键）的架构问题。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了Bi-SR这一检索框架，它通过双向语义增强策略来弥补这一差距。我们同时离线丰富模糊的表结构，并在线上进行生成式查询扩展——具体来说，就是预测潜在的架构结构——以匹配用户的意图。关键的是，我们为密集检索器引入了一个双增强对比训练目标，该目标训练密集检索器识别LLM扩展后的查询意图与详细架构描述之间的语义对应关系。在基于BIRD和Spider构建的大规模架构路由基准测试上进行的实验表明，Bi-SR取得了最先进的性能，并且显著提升了小型模型的部署效果，使其能够以更低的成本实现应用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DeepPlanner: Scaling Planning Capability for Deep Research Agents via Advantage Shaping
papers.title_zh: DeepPlanner：通过优势塑造技术，提升深度研究智能体规划能力
papers.authors: Wei Fan, Wenlin Yao, Zheng Li, Feng Yao, Xin Liu, Liang Qiu, Qingyu Yin, Yangqiu Song, Bing Yin
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) augmented with multi-step reasoning and action generation abilities have shown promise in leveraging external tools to tackle complex tasks that require long-horizon planning. However, existing approaches either rely on implicit planning in the reasoning stage or introduce explicit planners without systematically addressing how to optimize the planning stage. As evidence, we observe that under vanilla reinforcement learning (RL), planning tokens exhibit significantly higher entropy than other action tokens, revealing uncertain decision points that remain under-optimized. To address this, we introduce DeepPlanner, an end-to-end RL framework that effectively enhances the planning capabilities of deep research agents. Our approach shapes token-level advantage with an entropy-based term to allocate larger updates to high entropy tokens, and selectively upweights sample-level advantages for planning-intensive rollouts. Extensive experiments across seven deep research benchmarks demonstrate that DeepPlanner improves planning quality and achieves state-of-the-art results under a substantially lower training budget.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通过多步推理和动作生成能力的增强，在利用外部工具处理需要长期规划的复杂任务方面表现出良好的效果。然而，现有的方法要么依赖推理阶段的隐式规划，要么引入显式的规划器，但并未系统地解决如何优化规划阶段的问题。作为证据，我们发现，在普通的强化学习环境中，规划标记所呈现的熵值明显高于其他动作标记，这表明存在未得到优化的不确定决策点。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了DeepPlanner这一端到端的强化学习框架，它能够有效提升深度研究智能体的规划能力。我们的方法通过基于熵值的机制来分配更大的权重给高熵标记，同时选择性地加强样本级优势，以适用于需要大量规划的场景。在七个深度研究基准测试中的广泛实验表明，DeepPlanner能够提升规划质量，并在较低的训练预算下取得最先进的结果。

papers.title: SupChain-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Real-World Supply Chain Management
papers.title_zh: SupChain-Bench：针对实际供应链管理的大型语言模型性能评估基准
papers.authors: Shengyue Guan, Yihao Liu, Lang Cao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in complex reasoning and tool-based decision making, motivating their application to real-world supply chain management. However, supply chain workflows require reliable long-horizon, multi-step orchestration grounded in domain-specific procedures, which remains challenging for current models. To systematically evaluate LLM performance in this setting, we introduce SupChain-Bench, a unified real-world benchmark that assesses both supply chain domain knowledge and long-horizon tool-based orchestration grounded in standard operating procedures (SOPs). Our experiments reveal substantial gaps in execution reliability across models. We further propose SupChain-ReAct, an SOP-free framework that autonomously synthesizes executable procedures for tool use, achieving the strongest and most consistent tool-calling performance. Our work establishes a principled benchmark for studying reliable long-horizon orchestration in real-world operational settings and highlights significant room for improvement in LLM-based supply chain agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂推理和基于工具的决策制定方面表现出良好的性能，这促使人们将其应用于现实世界的供应链管理。然而，供应链工作流程需要基于特定领域程序的可靠、长期性的多步骤协调操作，这对当前模型来说仍然是一个挑战。为了系统地评估这些模型在这方面的性能，我们提出了SupChain-Bench这一统一的现实世界基准测试工具，它能够同时评估供应链领域的知识以及基于标准操作程序的长期性工具协调操作。我们的实验表明，不同模型在执行可靠性方面存在显著差距。此外，我们还提出了SupChain-ReAct这一无需遵循标准操作程序的框架，该框架能够自动生成可执行的工具使用流程，从而实现最强大且最一致的工具调用效果。我们的研究为研究现实世界运营环境中可靠的长期性协调操作提供了一个有原则的基准测试工具，同时也揭示了基于语言模型的供应链代理在改进方面仍有很大的提升空间。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: How Hypocritical Is Your LLM judge? Listener-Speaker Asymmetries in the Pragmatic Competence of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 你的大型语言模型裁判者有多虚伪？在大型语言模型的实用能力方面，存在怎样的“听者-说话者”不对称现象？
papers.authors: Judith Sieker, Sina Zarrieß
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied as repositories of linguistic knowledge. In this line of work, models are commonly evaluated both as generators of language and as judges of linguistic output, yet these two roles are rarely examined in direct relation to one another. As a result, it remains unclear whether success in one role aligns with success in the other. In this paper, we address this question for pragmatic competence by comparing LLMs’ performance as pragmatic listeners, judging the appropriateness of linguistic outputs, and as pragmatic speakers, generating pragmatically appropriate language. We evaluate multiple open-weight and proprietary LLMs across three pragmatic settings. We find a robust asymmetry between pragmatic evaluation and pragmatic generation: many models perform substantially better as listeners than as speakers. Our results suggest that pragmatic judging and pragmatic generation are only weakly aligned in current LLMs, calling for more integrated evaluation practices.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作语言知识的存储库进行研究。在这项工作中，这些模型通常既被评估为语言的生成器，也被评估为语言输出的评判者，然而这两种角色很少被直接联系在一起进行考察。因此，目前尚不清楚在某一角色上的成功是否意味着在另一角色上的成功。在本文中，我们通过比较LLM作为实用语能力评判者的表现、判断语言输出的适当性，以及作为实用语能力生成者的表现，来探讨这个问题。我们在三种实用语用情境下对多个开源和专有LLM进行了评估。我们发现，实用语用评判与实用语用生成之间存在显著的不对称性：许多模型在作为评判者时的表现明显优于作为生成者时的表现。我们的结果表明，当前LLM在实用语用评判和实用语用生成方面的能力之间只有较弱的关联，这提示我们需要采用更综合的评估方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CoopQ: Cooperative Game Inspired Layerwise Mixed Precision Quantization for LLMs
papers.title_zh: CoopQ：基于合作博弈思想的分层混合精度量化技术，适用于大型语言模型
papers.authors: Junchen Zhao, Ali Derakhshan, Jayden Hyman, Junhao Dong, Sangeetha Abdu Jyothi, Ian Harris
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) promise impressive capabilities, yet their multi-billion parameter scale makes on-device or low-resource deployment prohibitive. Mixed precision quantization offers a compelling solution, but existing methods struggle when the average precision drops below four bits, as they rely on isolated, layer-specific metrics that overlook critical inter-layer interactions affecting overall performance. To address these limitations, we first frame the mixed-precision quantization problem as a cooperative game among layers and introduce Shapley-based Progressive Quantization Estimation (SPQE) to efficiently obtain accurate Shapley estimates of layer sensitivities and inter-layer interactions. Leveraging the SPQE estimates, we propose Cooperative Game Inspired Mixed-Precision Quantization (CoopQ) which translates these Shapley estimates into a binary quadratic optimization formulation, assigning either 2 or 4-bit precision to layers under strict memory constraints. Comprehensive experiments conducted on Llama-3, Gemma-2, and Qwen models across three independent PTQ backends (Quanto, HQQ, GPTQ) demonstrate CoopQ’s scalability and consistently superior performance compared to methods relying solely on isolated metrics. Across average precisions spanning 4 bit down to 2 bit, CoopQ cuts Perplexity by 20 – 80 % relative to the best baseline, with the margin growing as the bit-width tightens.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）拥有令人印象深刻的性能，但其数十亿参数的规模使得在设备端或资源有限的环境中部署变得困难。混合精度量化提供了一种有效的解决方案，但现有方法在平均精度低于四位时表现不佳，因为它们依赖于孤立的、特定于层的指标，而忽略了影响整体性能的层间相互作用。为了克服这些限制，我们首先将混合精度量化问题视为层之间的合作博弈，并引入基于Shapley的渐进式量化估计方法，以高效地获得层敏感性及层间相互作用的准确估计值。利用这些估计值，我们提出了一种受合作博弈启发的混合精度量化方法——CoopQ。该方法将这些Shapley估计值转化为二元二次优化公式，在严格的内存限制下为各层分配2位或4位的精度。在Llama-3、Gemma-2和Qwen模型上进行的综合实验表明，CoopQ具有出色的可扩展性，其性能始终优于仅依赖孤立指标的方法。在从4位到2位的各种平均精度范围内，CoopQ能够将困惑度降低20%至80%，且随着位宽的增加，这一优势更加明显。

papers.title: Breaking Language Preference in Multilingual RAG via Language-Controllable Retrieval and Language-Agnostic Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 通过语言可控检索和语言无关推理，打破多语言RAG中的语言偏好问题
papers.authors: Wenshuai Huo, Xiaocheng Feng, Baohang Li, Chengpeng Fu, Yichong Huang, Hui Wang, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly improves the factual accuracy and generation quality of large language models by incorporating external knowledge. However, in multilingual settings, RAG systems suffer from severe language preference. On the one hand, the retrieval stage is sensitive to the query language: semantically equivalent queries expressed in different languages often lead to substantially different retrieval results. On the other hand, when retrieved documents contain knowledge written in multiple languages, large language models tend to be influenced by surface-level language forms, rather than reasoning solely based on semantic relevance to the query.To address these challenges, we propose a unified optimization framework that explicitly disentangles multilingual RAG into language-controllable retrieval and language-agnostic reasoning. Our framework allows LLM to adaptively select retrieval languages while enforcing cross-lingual consistency during reasoning, thereby mitigating language bias without modifying existing retrievers or translators. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach effectively reduces language bias in multilingual RAG and consistently outperforms baselines across multiple multilingual benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合外部知识，显著提升了大语言模型的事实准确性和生成质量。然而，在多语言环境中，RAG系统存在严重的语言偏好问题。一方面，检索阶段对查询语言非常敏感：用不同语言表达的语义等效查询往往会导致截然不同的检索结果。另一方面，当检索到的文档包含多种语言的文本时，大语言模型容易受到表面语言形式的干扰，而非仅基于与查询的语义相关性进行推理。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一个统一的优化框架，该框架将多语言RAG分解为语言可控的检索阶段和语言无关的推理阶段。我们的框架允许LLM在推理过程中自适应选择检索语言，同时确保跨语言的一致性，从而在不修改现有检索器或翻译器的情况下减轻语言偏见。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够有效减少多语言RAG中的语言偏见，并在多个多语言基准测试中始终优于传统方法。

papers.title: From Scoring to Explanations: Evaluating SHAP and LLM Rationales for Rubric-based Teaching Quality Assessment
papers.title_zh: 从评分到解释：利用SHAP模型和大型语言模型来评估基于评分标准的教学质量评估方法
papers.authors: Ivo Bueno, Babette Bühler, Philipp Stark, Tim Fütterer, Ulrich Trautwein, Dorottya Demszky, Heather Hill, Enkelejda Kasneci
papers.abstract: Automated scoring models are increasingly used to assign rubric-based quality ratings to complex language performances, including classroom transcripts, yet they typically provide little insight into why a particular score is produced. We propose a general framework for sentence-level interpretability of rubric-based scoring that combines model-agnostic Shapley-value attributions with rationales generated by large language models (LLMs). Instantiated on the Quality of Feedback dimension of the CLASS framework using the NCTE corpus, the framework enables systematic comparison of fine-tuned pretrained language models (PLMs) and prompted LLMs on both scoring performance and explanation faithfulness. Across 6k annotated transcript segments, fine-tuned PLMs outperform LLMs in prediction accuracy but exhibit label compression toward mid-scale scores. Deletion-based tests show that SHAP identifies sentences that reliably drive model predictions, producing typically larger and more coherent prediction shifts than LLM-generated rationales. Cross-model analyses further reveal that SHAP attributions transfer robustly across architectures, whereas LLM rationales exert limited and inconsistent influence. Overall, the findings demonstrate that SHAP provides more faithful and transferable explanations for rubric-based scoring, and that the proposed framework offers a principled basis for evaluating both scoring models and their explanations in high-stakes educational settings and other rubric-based language assessment tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化评分模型被越来越多地用于为复杂的语言表现分配基于评分标准的质量评级，这些表现包括课堂记录。然而，这些模型通常无法提供关于为何会产生特定评分的详细解释。我们提出了一个通用框架，旨在实现基于评分标准的句子级可解释性。该框架结合了不依赖于具体模型的Shapley值赋值方法，以及由大语言模型生成的解释性说明。该框架基于CLASS框架中的“反馈质量”维度，使用NCTE语料库进行实验。通过该系统，我们可以系统地比较经过微调的预训练语言模型和由大语言模型生成的解释性说明在评分性能和解释准确性方面的表现。在6000个带有注释的课堂记录片段中，经过微调的语言模型在预测准确性方面优于大语言模型，并且在处理中等级别的分数时表现出更好的标签压缩能力。基于删除测试的结果表明，Shapley值赋值能够准确识别出那些对模型预测有影响的句子，并且这些解释通常比大语言模型生成的解释更为详细和连贯。跨模型分析进一步表明，Shapley值赋值的解释能够在不同架构之间稳健地传递，而大语言模型的解释则具有有限且不一致的影响。总体而言，这些研究发现表明，Shapley值赋值能够为基于评分标准的评分提供更可靠、更易于理解的解释。所提出的框架为在高风险教育环境以及其他基于评分标准的语言评估任务中评估评分模型及其解释提供了理论基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LycheeCluster: Efficient Long-Context Inference with Structure-Aware Chunking and Hierarchical KV Indexing
papers.title_zh: LycheeCluster：基于结构感知的片段分割和分层键值索引技术，实现高效的长上下文推理
papers.authors: Dongfang Li, Zixuan Liu, Gang Lin, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: The quadratic complexity of the attention mechanism and the substantial memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache present severe computational and memory challenges for Large Language Models (LLMs) processing long contexts. Existing retrieval-based methods often compromise semantic integrity through fixed-size chunking and suffer from inefficient linear scanning. In this paper, we propose LycheeCluster, a novel method for efficient KV cache management. LycheeCluster preserves local semantic coherence via boundary-aware chunking and constructs a recursive hierarchical index rooted in the triangle inequality. This design transforms cache retrieval from a linear scan into a theoretically bounded, logarithmic-time pruning process, while a lazy update strategy supports efficient streaming generation. Experiments demonstrate that LycheeCluster achieves up to a 3.6\times end-to-end inference speedup with negligible degradation in model performance, outperforming state-of-the-art KV cache management methods (e.g., Quest, ClusterKV).
papers.abstract_zh: 注意力机制的二次复杂性和键值缓存的巨大内存占用，给大语言模型处理长文本时带来了严重的计算和内存挑战。现有的基于检索的方法往往通过固定大小的切块方式来牺牲语义完整性，并且存在线性扫描效率低下的问题。在本文中，我们提出了LycheeCluster这一高效键值缓存管理方法。LycheeCluster通过考虑边界的切块方式来保持局部语义的连贯性，并构建了一个以三角不等式为基础的递归式分层索引结构。这种设计将缓存检索从线性扫描转变为理论上有界的对数时间修剪过程，同时采用懒惰更新策略来支持高效的流式生成。实验表明，LycheeCluster在保持模型性能不下降的情况下，能够实现高达3.6倍的端到端推理速度提升。其性能优于目前最先进的键值缓存管理方法（如Quest、ClusterKV）。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HiRAS: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Framework for Paper-to-Code Generation and Execution
papers.title_zh: HiRAS：一种用于代码生成与执行的分层多智能体框架
papers.authors: Hanhua Hong, Yizhi LI, Jiaoyan Chen, Sophia Ananiadou, Xiaoli Li, Jung-jae Kim, Chenghua Lin
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models have highlighted their potential to automate computational research, particularly reproducing experimental results. However, existing approaches still use fixed sequential agent pipelines with weak global coordination, which limits their robustness and overall performance. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Research Agent System (HiRAS), a hierarchical multi-agent framework for end-to-end paper reproduction that employs supervisory manager agents to coordinate specialised agents across fine-grained stages. We also identify limitations in the reference-free evaluation of the Paper2Code benchmark and introduce Paper2Code-Extra (P2C-Ex), a refined protocol that incorporates repository-level information and better aligns with the original reference-based metric. We conduct extensive evaluation, validating the effectiveness and robustness of our proposed methods, and observing improvements, including >10% relative performance gain above the previous state-of-the-art using open-source backbone models and significantly reduced hallucination in the evaluation. All code and data will be made publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展凸显了它们在自动化计算研究方面的潜力，尤其是在复现实验结果方面。然而，现有的方法仍然采用固定的顺序代理流程，这种方式的全局协调能力较弱，这限制了它们的鲁棒性和整体性能。在这项研究中，我们提出了分层研究代理系统（HiRAS），这是一种用于端到端论文复现的分层多智能体框架。该系统通过监督管理代理来协调各个阶段的专业代理。我们还发现了关于Paper2Code基准测试的无参考评估存在的局限性，并提出了改进版的Paper2Code-Extra（P2C-Ex）方案，该方案包含了仓库级别的信息，从而更好地与基于原始参考的度量标准相衔接。我们进行了广泛的评估，验证了所提出方法的有效性和鲁棒性，并观察到性能提升，例如相对于使用开源主干模型的先前最先进技术而言，性能提升了超过10%，同时评估中的幻觉现象也显著减少。所有代码和数据都将公开提供。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: RoadMapper: A Multi-Agent System for Roadmap Generation of Solving Complex Research Problems
papers.title_zh: RoadMapper：一个用于解决复杂研究问题的多智能体系统，旨在帮助生成研究路线图
papers.authors: Jiacheng Liu, Zichen Tang, Zhongjun Yang, Xinyi Hu, Xueyuan Lin, Linwei Jia, Ruofei Bai, Rongjin Li, Shiyao Peng, Haocheng Gao, Haihong E
papers.abstract: People commonly leverage structured content to accelerate knowledge acquisition and research problem solving. Among these, roadmaps guide researchers through hierarchical subtasks to solve complex research problems step by step. Despite progress in structured content generation, the roadmap generation task has remained unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoadMap, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of large language models (LLMs) to construct high-quality roadmaps for solving complex research problems. Based on this, we identify three limitations of LLMs: (1) lack of professional knowledge, (2) unreasonable task decomposition, and (3) disordered logical relationships. To address these challenges, we propose RoadMapper, an LLM-based multi-agent system that decomposes the research roadmap generation task into three key stages (i.e., initial generation, knowledge augmentation, and iterative “critique-revise-evaluate”). Extensive experiments demonstrate that RoadMapper can improve LLMs’ ability for roadmap generation, while enhancing average performance by more than 8% and saving 84% of the time required by human experts, highlighting its effectiveness and application potential.
papers.abstract_zh: 人们通常利用结构化内容来加速知识获取和解决研究问题。在这些方法中，路线图能够引导研究人员通过分层次的子任务逐步解决复杂的研究问题。尽管在结构化内容生成方面取得了进展，但路线图生成任务仍然未被充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了RoadMap这一新的评估基准，用于衡量大语言模型在构建高质量路线图以解决复杂研究问题方面的能力。基于这一基准，我们发现了大语言模型的三个局限性：(1)缺乏专业知识；(2)任务分解不合理；(3)逻辑关系混乱。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了RoadMapper——一个基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，它将研究路线图的生成任务分解为三个关键阶段：初始生成、知识增强以及迭代性的“评估-修订-评估”过程。大量实验表明，RoadMapper能够提升大语言模型生成路线图的能力，同时平均性能提升超过8%，并节省人类专家所需时间的84%。这充分体现了其有效性和应用潜力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: On Temperature-Constrained Non-Deterministic Machine Translation: Potential and Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 在温度约束下的非确定性机器翻译：潜力与评估
papers.authors: Weichuan Wang, Mingyang Liu, Chen Ma, Linqi Song
papers.abstract: In recent years, the non-deterministic properties of language models have garnered considerable attention and have shown a significant influence on real-world applications. However, such properties remain under-explored in machine translation (MT), a complex, non-deterministic NLP task. In this study, we systematically evaluate modern MT systems and identify temperature-constrained Non-Deterministic MT (ND-MT) as a distinct phenomenon. Additionally, we demonstrate that ND-MT exhibits significant potential in addressing the multimodality issue that has long challenged MT research and provides higher-quality candidates than Deterministic MT (D-MT) under temperature constraints. However, ND-MT introduces new challenges in evaluating system performance. Specifically, the evaluation framework designed for D-MT fails to yield consistent evaluation results when applied to ND-MT. We further investigate this emerging challenge by evaluating state-of-the-art ND-MT systems using both lexical-based and semantic-based metrics at varying sampling sizes. The results reveal a Buckets Effect across these systems: the ranking of ND-MT systems is dominated by the worst-quality candidate translation, as shown by automatic evaluation metrics. To mitigate this issue, we propose ExpectoSample, a strategy that first identifies reliable metrics and then enables robust ND-MT system selection for real-world.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，语言模型的非确定性特性受到了广泛关注，并且对现实世界中的应用产生了重要影响。然而，在复杂的非确定性自然语言处理任务——机器翻译中，这类特性仍然没有得到充分研究。本研究系统地评估了现代机器翻译系统，并将温度约束的非确定性机器翻译定义为一种独特的现象。此外，我们发现非确定性机器翻译在解决长期以来困扰机器翻译研究的多模态问题方面具有巨大潜力，并且在温度约束下能够产生比确定性机器翻译更高质量的翻译结果。不过，非确定性机器翻译在评估系统性能时带来了新的挑战。具体来说，为确定性机器翻译设计的评估框架在应用于非确定性机器翻译时无法得到一致的评估结果。我们通过使用基于词汇和基于语义的度量标准，并在不同的采样规模下评估最先进的非确定性机器翻译系统，进一步研究了这一挑战。结果表明，这些系统存在“桶效应”：自动评估指标显示，非确定性机器翻译系统的排名往往被质量最差的翻译结果所主导。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了ExpectoSample策略，该策略首先识别出可靠的评估指标，然后能够实现针对实际场景的非确定性机器翻译系统的稳健选择。

papers.title: ExaGPT: Example-Based Machine-Generated Text Detection for Human Interpretability
papers.title_zh: ExaGPT：基于示例的机器生成文本检测技术，旨在实现人类可理解的文本生成
papers.authors: Ryuto Koike, Masahiro Kaneko, Ayana Niwa, Preslav Nakov, Naoaki Okazaki
papers.abstract: Detecting texts generated by Large Language Models (LLMs) could cause grave mistakes due to incorrect decisions, such as undermining student’s academic dignity. LLM text detection thus needs to ensure the interpretability of the decision, which can help users judge how reliably correct its prediction is. When humans verify whether a text is human-written or LLM-generated, they intuitively investigate with which of them it shares more similar spans. However, existing interpretable detectors are not aligned with the human decision-making process and fail to offer evidence that users easily understand. To bridge this gap, we introduce ExaGPT, an interpretable detection approach grounded in the human decision-making process for verifying the origin of a text. ExaGPT identifies a text by checking whether it shares more similar spans with human-written vs. with LLM-generated texts from a datastore. This approach can provide similar span examples that contribute to the decision for each span in the text as evidence. Our human evaluation demonstrates that providing similar span examples contributes more effectively to judging the correctness of the decision than existing interpretable methods. Moreover, extensive experiments in four domains and three generators show that ExaGPT massively outperforms prior interpretable detectors by up to +37.0 points of accuracy at a false positive rate of 1%.
papers.abstract_zh: 检测由大语言模型生成的文本可能会因错误的判断而引发严重的后果，例如损害学生的学术尊严。因此，语言模型文本检测需要确保判断结果的可解释性，这有助于用户判断其预测结果的可靠性。当人类判断一段文本是人工撰写还是由语言模型生成时，他们会直观地比较该文本与人工撰写文本之间的相似程度。然而，现有的可解释检测算法并未遵循人类的决策过程，也无法提供易于理解的证据。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ExaGPT——一种基于人类决策过程的、用于验证文本来源的可解释检测方法。ExaGPT通过检查文本与人工撰写文本之间的相似程度来识别文本的来源。这种方法能够为文本中的每个段落提供类似的示例，作为判断其正确性的依据。我们的人类评估表明，与现有可解释方法相比，提供类似示例更能有效地帮助判断判断结果的准确性。此外，在四个领域和三种生成器上的广泛实验表明，ExaGPT的准确率高达+37.0个百分点，而误报率仅为1%。

papers.title: Zipage: Maintain High Request Concurrency for LLM Reasoning through Compressed PagedAttention
papers.title_zh: Zipage：通过压缩的PagedAttention技术，实现LLM推理的高并发请求处理能力
papers.authors: Mengqi Liao, Lu Wang, Chaoyun Zhang, Bo Qiao, Si Qin, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang, Huaiyu Wan
papers.abstract: With reasoning becoming the generative paradigm for large language models, the memory bottleneck caused by KV cache during the inference phase has become a critical factor limiting high-concurrency service capabilities. Although existing KV cache eviction methods address the memory issue, most of them are impractical for industrial-grade applications. This paper introduces Compressed PagedAttention, a method that combines token-wise KV cache eviction with PagedAttention. We propose a comprehensive scheduling strategy and support prefix caching and asynchronous compression for Compressed PagedAttention. Based on this, we have developed a high-concurrency inference engine, Zipage. On large-scale mathematical reasoning tasks, Zipage achieves around 95% of the performance of Full KV inference engines while delivering over 2.1 speedup.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着推理方式成为大语言模型的核心范式，KV缓存在推理阶段所带来的内存瓶颈，已成为限制高并发服务能力的关键因素。虽然现有的KV缓存淘汰方法能够解决内存问题，但大多数方法对于工业级应用来说并不适用。本文介绍了Compressed PagedAttention这一方法，它结合了按令牌进行KV缓存淘汰与PagedAttention技术。我们提出了一种全面的调度策略，并支持对Compressed PagedAttention进行前缀缓存和异步压缩处理。基于这些技术，我们开发出了一种高并发的推理引擎——Zipage。在大规模数学推理任务中，Zipage的性能达到了全KV推理引擎的约95%，同时实现了超过2.1倍的性能提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Overlooked Role of Graded Relevance Thresholds in Multilingual Dense Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 多语言密集检索中分级相关性阈值被忽视的作用
papers.authors: Tomer Wullach, Ori Shapira, Amir David Nissan Cohen
papers.abstract: Dense retrieval models are typically fine-tuned with contrastive learning objectives that require binary relevance judgments, even though relevance is inherently graded. We analyze how graded relevance scores and the threshold used to convert them into binary labels affect multilingual dense retrieval. Using a multilingual dataset with LLM-annotated relevance scores, we examine monolingual, multilingual mixture, and cross-lingual retrieval scenarios. Our findings show that the optimal threshold varies systematically across languages and tasks, often reflecting differences in resource level. A well-chosen threshold can improve effectiveness, reduce the amount of fine-tuning data required, and mitigate annotation noise, whereas a poorly chosen one can degrade performance. We argue that graded relevance is a valuable but underutilized signal for dense retrieval, and that threshold calibration should be treated as a principled component of the fine-tuning pipeline.
papers.abstract_zh: 密集检索模型通常是通过对比学习来进行微调的，这种学习方法需要二元的相关性判断，尽管相关性本身是具有分级性质的。我们分析了分级相关性评分以及用于将这些评分转换为二元标签的阈值如何影响多语言密集检索的效果。我们使用了一个包含由大语言模型标注的相关性的多语言数据集，研究了单语言、多语言混合以及跨语言检索场景。我们的研究发现，最优阈值在不同语言和任务中会有系统性的差异，这通常反映了资源水平的差异。一个选得合适的阈值可以提高检索效果，减少所需的微调数据量，并减轻注释噪声的影响；而一个选得不当的阈值则可能会降低性能。我们认为，分级相关性是一种有价值但被低估的密集检索信号，因此阈值校准应该被视为微调流程中的一个关键组成部分。

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling in Multimodal Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Generation and Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 多模态基础模型中测试时间缩放技术：生成与推理方面的全面研究综述
papers.authors: Cong Wan, Ying He, Zhongzhan Huang, Hefeng Wu
papers.abstract: Test-time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as a pivotal research direction for enhancing model performance by dynamically allocating computational resources during inference. Recent advancements have adapted this paradigm to Multimodal Foundation Models (MFMs), unlocking their potential in multimodal reasoning and generation. Despite rapid progress, the field lacks a systematic survey and unified theoretical framework to delineate the developmental landscape of multimodal TTS. To bridge this gap, we present the first comprehensive review of TTS research for MFMs, proposing a unified taxonomic framework that categorizes existing methodologies into three distinct strategies: sampling-based, feedback-based, and search-based approaches. We further summarize representative applications and benchmarks commonly utilized to evaluate multimodal TTS capabilities in generation and reasoning tasks. Finally, this survey discusses open challenges and outlines future research directions, providing a systematic roadmap for subsequent studies in this rapidly evolving field.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时扩展技术（Test-Time Scaling，TTS）已成为提升模型性能的关键研究方向，它通过在推理过程中动态分配计算资源来优化模型性能。近期的研究进展将这一理念应用于多模态基础模型（Multimodal Foundation Models，MFMs）中，从而充分挖掘了它们在多模态推理和生成任务中的潜力。尽管取得了显著进展，但该领域仍缺乏系统的调研和统一的理论框架来梳理多模态TTS的发展现状。为了填补这一空白，我们首次对MFMs领域的TTS研究进行了全面综述，提出了一个统一的分类框架，将现有方法分为三种策略：基于采样的、基于反馈的以及基于搜索的方法。我们还总结了常用于评估多模态TTS在生成和推理任务中能力的代表性应用和基准测试。最后，本综述讨论了当前面临的挑战，并指出了未来的研究方向，为这一快速发展的领域后续研究提供了系统性的指导。

papers.title: PsyScore: A Psychometrically-Aware Framework for Trait-Adaptive Essay Scoring and ZPD-Scaffolded Feedback
papers.title_zh: PsyScore：一个具有心理学依据的框架，用于自适应评分以及基于zone of development的反馈机制
papers.authors: Wei Xia, Jin Wu, Haoran Shi, Xiangyu Wang, Chanjin Zheng
papers.abstract: Effective Automated Essay Scoring (AES) are expected to support both reliable assessment and actionable instructional feedback. However, existing approaches often treat scoring and feedback as separate components: neural scoring models provide limited interpretability, while Large Language Model (LLM)-based feedback is typically insensitive to learners’ proficiency levels. To address this fragmentation, this work proposes PsyScore, a psychometrically-aware framework that integrates diagnostic assessment with instructional scaffolding through a shared latent ability representation. PsyScore comprises three key modules: a Trait-Adaptive Neural IRT Scorer that incorporates the Graded Partial Credit Model (GPCM) into a neural architecture, enabling the precise estimation of student ability while maintaining psychometric interpretability, a ZPD-Scaffolded Feedback Generator, which conditions multi-agent feedback strategies on the diagnosed ability parameter to adapt instructional focus across different proficiency levels, and a Multi-Perspective Feedback Evaluation Strategy that assesses feedback quality via pairwise preference judgments and student revision simulations. Experiments on the ASAP++ dataset demonstrate that PsyScore achieves competitive scoring performance while providing more pedagogically aligned feedback.
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的自动作文评分系统（AES）有望为可靠的评估以及具有操作性的教学反馈提供支持。然而，现有的方法往往将评分和反馈视为两个独立的组成部分：神经评分模型的可解释性有限，而基于大语言模型的反馈通常对学习者的水平并不敏感。为了克服这种割裂现象，本研究提出了PsyScore这一具有心理测量学意识的框架。该框架将诊断性评估与通过共享的潜在能力表示进行的教学指导相结合。PsyScore包含三个关键模块：一种特征自适应神经IRT评分器，它将分级部分学分模型融入神经架构中，从而实现对学生能力的精确估计，同时保持良好的心理测量学可解释性；一个基于ZPD的教学反馈生成器，它根据诊断出的能力参数来调整多智能体反馈策略，从而在不同水平的学习者中调整教学重点；以及一个多视角反馈评估策略，它通过成对偏好判断和学生修改模拟来评估反馈质量。在ASAP++数据集上的实验表明，PsyScore在提供更具教育意义的反馈的同时，也取得了具有竞争力的评分性能。

papers.title: FinMaster: A Holistic Benchmark for Full-Pipeline Financial Management with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: FinMaster：一种基于大型语言模型的全面财务管理工具
papers.authors: Junzhe Jiang, Chang Yang, Aixin Cui, Sihan Jin, Yujing Zhang, Yilin Xiao, Ruiyu Wang, Bo Li, Xiao Huang, Danny Dongning Sun, Xinrun Wang
papers.abstract: Financial management is high-stakes, where small errors can propagate into reporting deviations and costly downstream decisions, yet real-world workflows remain labor-intensive and fragmented, and existing automation supports only isolated steps rather than complete workflows. Large language models (LLMs) show promise in automating financial workflows, but current benchmarks lack domain-specific data, realistic workflow-level task design, and standardized workflow-level evaluation. To address these gaps, we present FinMaster, a benchmark for evaluating large language models on full financial management workflows spanning financial literacy, accounting, auditing, and consulting. FinMaster comprises three modules: FinSim generates synthetic datasets compliant with real-world accounting standards for diverse company types, enabling realistic evaluation without relying on proprietary financial records. FinSuite offers 183 tasks across core financial domains. FinEval provides a unified evaluation framework. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art models including GPT-4o-mini, Claude-3.7-Sonnet, and DeepSeek-V3 reveal critical capability gaps in financial reasoning, with accuracy dropping from over 90% on basic tasks to 40% on complex scenarios requiring multi-step reasoning. This degradation reflects error propagation, where accuracy reaches 58% for single-metric calculations but decreases to 37% in multi-metric settings. FinMaster provides scalable and reproducible benchmarking for realistic end-to-end financial workflows, helping advance reliable deployment of LLMs in financial practice.
papers.abstract_zh: 财务管理是一项高风险的工作，微小的错误可能会引发报告偏差，进而导致成本高昂的后续决策。然而，现实中的工作流程仍然依赖人工操作，且缺乏自动化支持，现有的自动化技术只能处理部分流程，而无法实现完整的自动化。大语言模型在自动化财务工作流程方面具有潜力，但目前的评估基准缺乏特定领域的数据、真实的工作流程设计以及标准化的评估方法。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了FinMaster这一基准测试平台，用于评估大语言模型在全面的财务管理工作流程中的表现，涵盖财务知识、会计、审计和咨询等领域。FinMaster包含三个模块：FinSim负责生成符合实际会计准则的合成数据集，适用于各种类型的公司，从而无需依赖专有财务记录即可进行真实评估；FinSuite提供了183个针对核心财务领域的任务；FinEval则提供了一个统一的评估框架。对包括GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3.7-Sonnet和DeepSeek-V3在内的先进模型进行的实验表明，大语言模型在财务推理方面的能力存在明显缺陷——在简单任务上的准确率高达90%以上，而在需要多步骤推理的复杂场景中，准确率却降至40%。这种下降反映了错误的传播现象：在单一指标计算时，准确率可达58%，但在多指标环境下，准确率则降至37%。FinMaster提供了一种可扩展且可复现的基准测试方式，有助于推动大语言模型在财务领域的可靠应用。

papers.title: PersonaForge: Psychology-Grounded Dual-Process Architecture for Personality-Consistent Role-Playing Agents
papers.title_zh: PersonaForge：基于心理学原理的双过程架构，用于实现符合人格特征的角色扮演智能体
papers.authors: Jizhou Tong, Sirui Zou
papers.abstract: Large Language Models excel at role-playing but struggle to maintain consistent personalities across extended multi-turn interactions. We propose PersonaForge, combining (1) a three-layer personality architecture grounded in psychological theory and (2) a dual-process generation mechanism inspired by cognitive science. We test two falsifiable claims: Claim 1 (Orthogonality): Psychology-grounded dimensions (Big Five + Defense Mechanisms) provide more orthogonal constraints than natural language descriptions, reducing long-dialogue drift. Claim 2 (Integration Necessity): High-dimensional personality constraints create “production interference” requiring a cognitive workspace (Inner Monologue) to resolve—removing it degrades performance below simpler baselines. Experiments on 88 characters demonstrate: (1) +19.4% personality consistency (PC) with human correlation r=0.82, (2) reduced drift over 50-turn conversations (6.3% vs. 24.8% baseline), and (3) +64.7% defense mechanism manifestation. External validation on RoleBench confirms generalization (73.2% win-rate, drift 8.4% vs. 20.4%). Selective dual-process activation achieves 96% of full-system performance with only 13.4% token overhead. Human evaluation confirms more authentic and psychologically coherent character behaviors. Code and data: https://github.com/fQwQf/PersonaForge.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在角色扮演方面表现出色，但在长时间的多轮互动中难以保持稳定的性格特征。我们提出了PersonaForge方案，该方案结合了：(1)基于心理学理论的三层性格架构；(2)受认知科学启发的双过程生成机制。我们测试了两个可验证的假设：假设1（正交性）：基于心理学的维度（大五人格模型+防御机制）比自然语言描述提供了更严格的正交约束，从而减少了长时间对话中的性格变化。假设2（整合必要性）：高维度的性格约束会产生“生产干扰”，需要认知工作空间（内心独白）来解决这一问题——否则性能会下降，低于简单的基础水平。对88个角色的实验表明：(1)性格一致性提高了19.4%，与人类相关性为r=0.82；(2)在50轮对话中的性格变化减少了6.3%（对比基线24.8%）；(3)防御机制的体现增加了64.7%。在RoleBench平台上的外部验证表明该方案具有通用性（胜率73.2%，变化率为8.4%对比20.4%）。通过选择性激活双过程机制，可以实现96%的全系统性能，仅需13.4%的标记开销。人类评估表明，该方案产生的角色行为更加真实且符合心理学原理。代码和数据可在此处获取：https://github.com/fQwQf/PersonaForge。

papers.title: Graph Explorer: Training Faithful KG Agents with Visibility-Grounded Supervision
papers.title_zh: 图形探索器：利用可见性基础监督方法训练可靠的KG智能体
papers.authors: Yifeng Chen, Sicheng Wan, Tianyi Zhang, Xuezhou Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are strong reasoners but still hallucinate and make unreliable decisions on knowledge-intensive questions. Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide explicit, auditable facts, motivating KGQA agents that interact with KGs via tool calls to reduce hallucinations. However, LLM agents often struggle to reliably manipulate KG-specific symbols (entity IDs and relation names), leading to invalid or hallucinated tool-call arguments, and high-quality step-by-step supervision for such tool use is scarce. Meanwhile, large datasets of expert SPARQL programs exist for Freebase KGQA, but naively converting them into action supervision is brittle: SPARQL assumes a global view of the KG, while an agent acts from a truncated, local prompt, so expert steps can reference KG IDs (entity/relation/attribute symbols) that are not visible at decision time. We present Graph Explorer, a fully automatic data synthesis pipeline that turns expert SPARQL into executable, visibility-grounded (actions may use only IDs shown in the prompt) tool supervision without manual trace labeling. Graph Explorer compiles SPARQL into tool-call plans, executes them under the same context-control policy used at inference, and retains only tool-interaction traces whose tool-call arguments are visible at decision time, yielding clean (context, next-action) pairs for action-centric fine-tuning. We evaluate with a strict finish-or-fail protocol (success only if the agent issues a valid Finish within budget). Under this protocol, our fine-tuned Qwen3-8B reaches 74.0/80.2 Hit@1 on CWQ/WebQSP, improving over a reproduced prompting baseline by +22.5/+16.2 points, indicating more faithful multi-step graph exploration from visible evidence.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型虽然具有强大的推理能力，但在处理需要大量知识的问题时仍会出现幻觉并做出不可靠的决策。知识图谱能够提供明确且可验证的事实信息，这为通过工具调用与知识图谱交互的知识质量评估代理提供了依据，从而减少幻觉的发生。然而，大语言模型的代理往往难以可靠地操控与知识图谱相关的符号（实体ID和关系名称），导致工具调用的参数出现无效或幻觉的情况。此外，针对知识质量评估而编制的大量专家SPARQL程序数据，如果直接转化为行动指导的话，其效果并不稳定：SPARQL假设对知识图谱有一个全局性的视图，而代理则基于局部化的提示进行行动，因此专家的步骤可能会引用到在决策时刻无法看到的知识图谱标识符（实体/关系/属性符号）。我们提出了Graph Explorer这一全自动的数据合成流程，它能够将专家编写的SPARQL代码转化为可执行的、以可见性为约束的工具使用指导方案，而无需手动标记痕迹。Graph Explorer将SPARQL编译成工具调用计划，并在与推理相同的上下文控制策略下执行这些计划。同时，它只保留那些在决策时刻能够看到工具调用参数的工具交互痕迹，从而为以行动为中心的微调提供清晰的操作指令对。我们的评估采用了严格的完成或失败协议——只有当代理在预算范围内发出有效的“完成”指令时，才视为成功。根据这一协议，我们经过微调的Qwen3-8B模型在CWQ/WebQSP任务上的得分达到了74.0/80.2 Hit@1，比基准提示方案提高了22.5/16.2分，这表明该模型能够从可见的证据中更精确地进行多步图探索。

papers.title: Robust Uncertainty Quantification for Self-Evolving Large Language Models via Continual Domain Pretraining
papers.title_zh: 通过持续领域预训练，实现对自演化大型语言模型的稳健不确定性量化处理
papers.authors: Xiaofan Zhou, Lu Cheng
papers.abstract: Continual Learning (CL) is essential for enabling self-evolving large language models (LLMs) to adapt and remain effective amid rapid knowledge growth. Yet, despite its importance, little attention has been given to establishing statistical reliability guarantees for LLMs under CL, particularly in the setting of continual domain pretraining (CDP). Conformal Prediction (CP) has shown promise in offering correctness guarantees for LLMs, but it faces major challenges in CDP: testing data often stems from unknown or shifting domain distributions, under which CP may no longer provide valid guarantees. Moreover, when high coverage is required, CP can yield excessively large prediction sets for unanswerable queries, reducing informativeness. To address these challenges, we introduce an adaptive rejection and non-exchangeable CP framework. Our method first estimates the distribution of questions across domains in the test set using transformer-based clustering, then reweights or resamples the calibration data accordingly. Building on this, adaptive rejection CP allows the LLM to selectively abstain from answering when its confidence or competence shifts significantly. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework enhances both the effectiveness and reliability of CP under CDP scenarios. Our code is available at: https://github.com/AlearZhou/CPCL
papers.abstract_zh: 持续学习对于使自进化的大语言模型能够在知识快速增长的情况下保持适应性和有效性至关重要。然而，尽管这一点非常重要，但在为持续学习环境下的大语言模型建立统计可靠性保障方面，人们却很少关注。共形预测在为大语言模型提供正确性保障方面显示出潜力，但在持续领域预训练场景中面临着重大挑战：测试数据往往来自未知或不断变化的领域分布，在这种情况下，共形预测可能无法提供有效的保障。此外，当需要高覆盖率时，共形预测可能会为无法回答的查询生成过大的预测集，从而降低其信息量。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种自适应拒绝和非可交换的共形预测框架。我们的方法首先使用基于Transformer的聚类算法来估计测试集中不同领域的问题分布，然后相应地重新加权或重新采样校准数据。在此基础上，自适应拒绝共形预测允许大语言模型在置信度或能力发生显著变化时选择性地拒绝回答。大量实验表明，我们的框架在持续领域预训练场景下提升了共形预测的有效性和可靠性。我们的代码可以在以下链接查看：https://github.com/AlearZhou/CPCL
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Exploring Graph Learning Tasks with Pure LLMs: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Investigation
papers.title_zh: 利用纯大型语言模型探索图学习任务：一项全面的基准测试与研究
papers.authors: Yuxiang Wang, Xinnan Dai, Wenqi Fan, Yao Ma
papers.abstract: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising candidates for graph tasks. Many studies leverage natural language to describe graphs and apply LLMs for reasoning, yet most focus narrowly on performance benchmarks without fully comparing LLMs to graph learning models or exploring their broader potential. In this work, we present a comprehensive study of LLMs on graph learning tasks, evaluating both off-the-shelf and instruction-tuned models across a variety of scenarios. Beyond accuracy, we discuss data leakage concerns and computational overhead, and assess their performance under few-shot/zero-shot settings, domain transfer, structural understanding, and robustness. Our findings show that LLMs, particularly those with instruction tuning, greatly outperform traditional graph learning models in few-shot settings, exhibit strong domain transferability, and demonstrate excellent generalization and robustness. Our study highlights the broader capabilities of LLMs in graph learning and provides a foundation for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，大语言模型在图任务中展现出巨大的潜力。许多研究利用自然语言来描述图结构，并运用大语言模型进行推理操作。不过，大多数研究都仅关注性能基准测试，而没有充分比较大语言模型与传统的图学习模型，也没有探索它们的更广泛应用潜力。在这项研究中，我们对大语言模型在图学习任务上的表现进行了全面分析，评估了各种场景下现成的模型以及经过指令调优的模型的表现。除了准确性之外，我们还讨论了数据泄露问题以及计算开销问题，并评估了它们在少样本/零样本场景、领域迁移、结构理解以及鲁棒性方面的表现。我们的研究发现表明，尤其是那些经过指令调优的大语言模型，在少样本场景中表现得远远优于传统的图学习模型，具有强大的领域迁移能力，并且具备出色的泛化能力和鲁棒性。我们的研究揭示了大语言模型在图学习领域的广泛能力，为未来的研究提供了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 超越拒绝采样：用于扩展数学推理能力的轨迹融合方法
papers.authors: Jie Deng, Hanshuang Tong, Jun Li, Shining Liang, Ning Wu, Hongzhi Li, Yutao Xie
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made impressive strides in mathematical reasoning, often fine-tuned using rejection sampling, which retains only correct reasoning trajectories. While effective, this paradigm treats supervision as a binary filter that systematically excludes teacher-generated errors, leaving a gap in how reasoning failures are modeled during training. In this paper, we propose TrajFusion, a fine-tuning strategy that reframes rejection sampling as a structured supervision construction process. Specifically, TrajFusion forms fused trajectories that explicitly model trial-and-error reasoning by interleaving selected incorrect trajectories with reflection prompts and correct trajectories. The length of the fused sample is adaptively controlled based on the frequency and diversity of teacher errors, providing richer supervision for challenging problems while safely reducing to vanilla rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) when error signals are uninformative. TrajFusion requires no changes to the architecture or training objective. Extensive experiments across multiple math benchmarks demonstrate that TrajFusion consistently outperforms RFT, particularly on challenging and long-form reasoning problems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在数学推理方面取得了显著进展，这些模型通常通过拒绝采样方法进行微调，这种方法只保留正确的推理路径。虽然这种方法很有效，但它将监督视为一个二元过滤器，系统性地排除了教师生成的错误，从而在训练过程中对推理失败的处理存在不足。在本文中，我们提出了TrajFusion这一微调策略，它将拒绝采样重新定义为一种结构化的监督构建过程。具体来说，TrajFusion通过将对选定的错误路径与反思提示以及正确路径进行交织，从而形成融合路径，从而明确模拟试错推理过程。融合样本的长度会根据教师错误的频率和多样性进行自适应控制，为具有挑战性的问题提供更为丰富的监督信息；而当错误信号无用时，则能安全地简化为普通的拒绝采样微调方式。TrajFusion不需要对架构或训练目标进行任何修改。通过在多个数学基准测试中的广泛实验表明，TrajFusion始终优于RFT，尤其是在具有挑战性和长形式的推理问题上。

papers.title: ReasonRec: A Reasoning-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Unified Recommendation
papers.title_zh: ReasonRec：一种基于推理功能的多模态智能体，旨在实现统一的推荐服务
papers.authors: Yihua Zhang, Mingfu Liang, Jiyan Yang, Rong Jin, Wen-Yen Chen, Yiping Han, Huayu Li, Buyun Zhang, Liang Luo, Luke Simon, Sijia Liu, Tianlong Chen, Xi Liu
papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal recommenders excel at feature fusion but remain opaque and inefficient decision-makers, lacking explicit reasoning and self-awareness of uncertainty. To address this, we introduce ReasonRec, a reasoning-augmented multimodal agent structured around a three-stage explicit reasoning pipeline: Observe, via a pretrained Vision-Language Model (VLM) encoder; Deliberate, by formulating recommendation as chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning tasks and explicitly quantifying prediction uncertainty through an evidence-horizon-aware curriculum; and Act, through dynamic delegation of uncertain or challenging queries to lightweight classical recommendation models. Specifically, we propose a reasoning-aware visual instruction tuning strategy that systematically transforms diverse recommendation tasks into unified CoT prompts, enabling the VLM to explicitly articulate intermediate decision steps. Additionally, our evidence-horizon curriculum progressively enhances the reasoning complexity to better handle cold-start and long-tail user scenarios, significantly boosting model generalization. Furthermore, the uncertainty-guided delegation mechanism empowers the agent to assess its own confidence, strategically allocating computational resources to optimize both recommendation accuracy and inference efficiency. Comprehensive experiments on four standard recommendation tasks (sequential recommendation, direct recommendation, CTR prediction, and explanation generation) across five real-world datasets demonstrate that ReasonRec achieves over 30% relative improvement in key ranking metrics (e.g., HR@5, NDCG@5) compared to state-of-the-art multimodal recommenders. Crucially, ReasonRec substantially reduces inference latency by dynamically delegating up to 35% of queries to efficient sub-models without compromising accuracy. Extensive ablation studies further confirm that each proposed reasoning and planning mechanism individually contributes substantially to ReasonRec’s overall effectiveness. Collectively, our results illustrate a clear pathway towards interpretable, adaptive, and efficient multimodal recommendation through explicit reasoning and agentic design.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在多模态推荐领域取得的进展表明，现有的推荐系统在特征融合方面表现出色，但决策过程仍然不够透明且效率低下，缺乏明确的推理能力和对不确定性的自我认知。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ReasonRec这一基于三阶段推理流程的多模态智能体：首先通过预训练的视觉语言模型编码器进行“观察”阶段；接着通过将推荐任务转化为思维链推理任务，并通过基于证据视界的训练策略来明确量化预测的不确定性；最后通过动态地将不确定或具有挑战性的查询委托给轻量级的传统推荐模型来实现“行动”阶段。具体来说，我们提出了一种基于推理意识的视觉指令调整策略，该策略能够系统地将各种推荐任务转化为统一的思维链提示，使视觉语言模型能够明确地表达中间决策步骤。此外，我们的基于证据视界的训练策略逐步提升了推理的复杂性，从而更好地处理冷启动和长尾用户场景，显著提高了模型的泛化能力。更重要的是，这种基于不确定性的委托机制使得智能体能够评估自身的置信度，并战略性地分配计算资源，以优化推荐准确性和推理效率。在五个真实世界数据集上的四项标准推荐任务（序列推荐、直接推荐、点击率预测和解释生成）的广泛实验中表明，与最先进的多模态推荐系统相比，ReasonRec在关键排名指标上实现了超过30%的相对提升（例如HR@5、NDCG@5）。尤为重要的是，ReasonRec通过动态地将高达35%的查询委托给高效的子模型，有效降低了推理延迟，同时并未牺牲准确性。深入的消融研究进一步证实，所提出的每种推理和规划机制都对ReasonRec的整体效果有着显著的贡献。总的来说，我们的研究结果展示了通过明确的推理和智能体设计来实现可解释、自适应且高效的多模态推荐的方法路径。

papers.title: Does Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Help Mobile GUI Agents? An Empirical Study
papers.title_zh: 思维链推理有助于移动图形用户界面代理吗？一项实证研究
papers.authors: Li Zhang, Longxi Gao, Mengwei Xu
papers.abstract: Reasoning capabilities have significantly improved the performance of vision-language models (VLMs) in domains such as mathematical problem-solving, coding, and visual question-answering. However, their impact on real-world applications remains unclear. This paper presents a large-scale empirical study on the effectiveness of reasoning-enabled VLMs in mobile GUI agents. We evaluate six pairs of VLMs, including both commercial and open-source lightweight models, by comparing their base and reasoning-enhanced versions across static and interactive benchmarks. Our findings show that reasoning-enabled VLMs generally provide only marginal improvements over their non-reasoning counterparts and can even degrade performance in certain agent configurations. Notably, reasoning and non-reasoning VLMs fail on different sets of tasks, suggesting that reasoning does have an impact, but its benefits and drawbacks counterbalance each other. We attribute these inconsistencies to the limitations of benchmarks and VLMs. Based on the findings, we provide insights for further enhancing mobile GUI agents in terms of benchmarks, VLMs, and their adaptability in dynamically invoking reasoning VLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理能力显著提升了视觉-语言模型在解决数学问题、编程和视觉问答等领域的性能。然而，它们在现实应用中的影响仍不明确。本文开展了一项大规模实证研究，探讨启用了推理功能的视觉-语言模型在移动图形用户界面代理中的有效性。我们通过比较不同版本的视觉-语言模型（包括商业版和开源轻量级模型）的基础版本与增强推理功能的版本，在静态和交互式测试环境中进行了评估。研究发现，启用了推理功能的视觉-语言模型通常仅能带来微小的性能提升，甚至在某些代理配置下还会降低性能。值得注意的是，启用了推理功能的视觉-语言模型与非启用的模型在任务集上表现不同，这表明推理确实具有影响，但其利弊相互抵消。我们将这些不一致现象归因于测试基准和视觉-语言模型的局限性。基于这些发现，我们提出了一些建议，以进一步提升移动图形用户界面代理在测试基准、视觉-语言模型以及动态调用推理功能方面的能力。

papers.title: Asymmetric Relational-Geometry Driven Universal Adversarial Perturbations for Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 用于视觉语言模型的非对称关系几何驱动通用对抗扰动方法
papers.authors: Jiaxin Ye, Weihai Li, Ying Wang, Simeng Qin, Zhitao Zeng, Zikai Xu
papers.abstract: Although vision-language pre-trained (VLP) models have achieved remarkable success across multimodal tasks, they remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations.Existing universal adversarial perturbation (UAP) methods in multimodal settings—whether generator-based or optimization-based—often suffer from limited cross-model transferability, especially in black-box scenarios.We attribute this limitation to the prevalent use of symmetric or distribution-level objectives that overlook the asymmetric roles of image and text modalities and the relational nature of vision-language representations.To address this issue, we propose ARG-Attack, an optimization-based framework that learns universal perturbations under an asymmetric relational-geometry driven objective.Our method integrates three complementary components: a cosine-based loss that induces directional semantic drift in visual features, a center shift loss that geometrically regularizes adversarial embeddings toward a shared semantic center, and a relational polarity loss that explicitly disrupts image–text matching relationships.Together, these objectives enable effective cross-modal interaction without relying on model-specific training losses or probabilistic distribution matching.In addition, we adopt an adaptive gradient update strategy inspired by Adam optimization to stabilize training and accelerate convergence.Extensive experiments across multiple vision-language models and tasks demonstrate that ARG-Attack achieves competitive white-box performance and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in black-box transfer settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管视觉-语言预训练模型在多种多模态任务中取得了显著成就，但它们仍然容易受到对抗性扰动的影响。现有的多模态环境下的通用对抗扰动方法——无论是基于生成器的还是基于优化的方法——往往存在跨模型的可转移性有限的问题，尤其是在黑盒场景中。我们认为这种限制是由于普遍使用对称或分布级目标所导致的，这些目标忽略了图像和文本模态之间的非对称性以及视觉-语言表示之间的关系特性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ARG-Attack这一基于优化的框架，该框架能够在非对称关系几何驱动的目标下学习出通用的扰动方法。我们的方法整合了三个互补的组件：一个基于余弦的损失函数，用于诱导视觉特征的方向性语义漂移；一个中心偏移损失，用于使对抗嵌入在几何上朝着共同的语义中心进行规整；以及一个关系极性损失，用于明确破坏图像与文本之间的匹配关系。这些目标共同实现了有效的跨模态交互，而无需依赖特定于模型的训练损失或概率分布匹配。此外，我们采用了一种受Adam优化算法启发的自适应梯度更新策略，以稳定训练并加速收敛过程。通过针对多种视觉-语言模型和任务的广泛实验表明，ARG-Attack在黑盒迁移场景中取得了具有竞争力的白盒性能，并且显著优于现有最先进的方法。

papers.title: PaperScope: A Multi-Modal Multi-Document Benchmark for Agentic Deep Research Across Massive Scientific Papers
papers.title_zh: PaperScope：一个适用于大规模科学论文的跨模态多文档评估基准，旨在支持智能助手在深度研究中的应用
papers.authors: Lei Xiong, Huaying Yuan, Zheng Liu, Zhao Cao, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Leveraging Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to accelerate frontier scientific research is promising, yet how to rigorously evaluate such systems remains unclear. Existing benchmarks mainly focus on single-document understanding, whereas real scientific workflows require integrating evidence from multiple papers, including their text, tables, and figures. As a result, multi-modal, multi-document scientific reasoning remains underexplored and lacks systematic evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce PaperScope, a multi-modal multi-document benchmark designed for agentic deep research. PaperScope presents three advantages: (1) Structured scientific grounding. It is built on a knowledge graph of over 2,000 AI papers spanning three years, providing a structured foundation for research-oriented queries. (2) Semantically dense evidence construction. It integrates semantically related key information nodes and employs optimized random-walk article selector to sample thematically coherent paper sets, thereby ensuring adequate semantic density and task complexity. (3) Multi-task evaluation of scientific reasoning. It contains over 2,000 QA pairs across reasoning, retrieval, summarization, and problem solving, enabling evaluation of multi-step scientific reasoning. Experimental results show that even advanced systems such as OpenAI Deep Research and Tongyi Deep Research achieve limited scores on PaperScope, highlighting the difficulty of long-context retrieval and deep multi-source reasoning. PaperScope thus provides a rigorous benchmark alongside a scalable pipeline for constructing large-scale multi-modal, multi-source deep research datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用多模态大语言模型来加速前沿科学研究具有巨大潜力，然而如何对这类系统进行严格评估仍然是个难题。现有的评估基准主要侧重于单文档的理解，而真实的科学研究流程需要整合来自多篇论文的证据，包括它们的文本、表格和图表。因此，多模态、多文档的科学推理目前尚未得到充分探索，也缺乏系统的评估机制。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了PaperScope——一个专为深度研究设计的多模态多文档评估基准。PaperScope具有三大优势：(1) 结构化的科学基础。它基于涵盖三年时间、包含2000多篇人工智能论文的知识图谱构建，为以研究为导向的查询提供了坚实的基础。(2) 语义密集的证据构建。它整合了语义相关的关键信息节点，并采用优化的随机游走文章选择器来抽取主题连贯的论文集，从而确保足够的语义密度和任务复杂性。(3) 多任务科学推理评估。它包含了超过2000对问答对，涵盖了推理、检索、总结和问题解决等方面，使得多步骤科学推理的评估成为可能。实验结果表明，即使是像OpenAI Deep Research和Tongyi Deep Research这样的先进系统，在PaperScope上的得分也相当有限，这凸显了长上下文检索和深度多源推理的困难性。因此，PaperScope提供了一个严格的评估基准，同时还有一套可扩展的管道，用于构建大规模的多模态、多源深度研究数据集。

papers.title: When Personalization Misleads: Understanding and Mitigating Hallucinations in Personalized LLMs
papers.title_zh: 当个性化处理导致误导时：理解并缓解在个性化大语言模型中出现的幻觉问题
papers.authors: Zhongxiang Sun, Yi Zhan, Chenglei Shen, Weijie Yu, Xiao Zhang, Ming He, Jun Xu
papers.abstract: Personalized large language models (LLMs) adapt model behavior to individual users to enhance user satisfaction, yet personalization can inadvertently distort factual reasoning. We show that when personalized LLMs face factual queries, there exists a phenomenon where the model generates answers aligned with a user’s prior history rather than the objective truth, resulting in personalization-induced hallucinations that degrade factual reliability and may propagate incorrect beliefs, due to representational entanglement between personalization and factual representations. To address this issue, we propose Factuality-Preserving Personalized Steering (FPPS), a lightweight inference-time approach that mitigates personalization-induced factual distortions while preserving personalized behavior. We further introduce PFQABench, the first benchmark designed to jointly evaluate factual and personalized question answering under personalization. Experiments across multiple LLM backbones and personalization methods show that FPPS substantially improves factual accuracy while maintaining personalized performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 个性化大语言模型（LLM）通过调整模型行为来提升用户体验，但这种个性化处理可能会无意中扭曲事实推理。我们发现，当个性化LLM面对事实性问题时，会出现一种现象：模型生成的答案往往与用户的历史经验相关，而非客观真相。这种由个性化处理引起的偏差会导致事实可靠性下降，并可能使错误信念得以传播，因为个性化处理与事实表征之间存在关联。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了“保持事实真实性的个性化引导方法”（FPPS），这是一种轻量级的推理时间处理方法，能够在保留个性化行为的同时，有效缓解由个性化处理引起的事实失真问题。我们还引入了PFQABench这一首个专门用于评估在个性化处理下的事实性和个性化问答能力的基准测试。通过对多种LLM框架和个性化处理方法的实验验证，我们发现FPPS能够显著提高事实的准确性，同时保持良好的个性化表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Law in Silico: Simulating Legal Society with LLM-Based Agents
papers.title_zh: 硅基法律：利用基于大语言模型的智能体模拟法律社会
papers.authors: Yiding Wang, Yuxuan Chen, Fanxu Meng, Xifan Chen, Xiaolei Yang, Muhan Zhang
papers.abstract: Since real-world legal experiments are often costly or infeasible, simulating legal societies with Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems provides an effective alternative for testing and advancing legal theory, as well as supporting legal administration. Large Language Models (LLMs), with their world knowledge and role-playing capabilities, are strong candidates to serve as the foundation for legal society simulation. However, the application of LLMs to simulate legal systems remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce Law in Silico, a unified LLM-based agent framework for simulating legal scenarios that incorporate individual decision-making and institutional mechanisms, such as legislation, adjudication, and enforcement. We calibrate agent behaviors against real-world crime data, demonstrating that LLM-based agents can capture realistic sociological correlations. Building on this foundation, we structure our simulation through a ”Micro-to-Macro” process: we conduct micro-level simulations in representative conflict-driven scenarios, allowing legal rules to evolve through agent-institution interactions naturally. These evolved laws are then deployed back into macro-scale populations to evaluate their effectiveness in regulating behaviors. Through comprehensive experiments, our results reveal that a well-functioning, transparent, and adaptive legal system can mitigate “cat-and-mouse” regulatory dynamics and offer better protection for vulnerable individuals.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于现实世界中的法律实验往往成本高昂或难以实施，因此利用人工智能系统模拟法律社会为测试和发展法律理论提供了有效的替代方案，同时也有助于支持法律执行工作。大语言模型凭借其丰富的知识库和角色扮演能力，非常适合作为法律社会模拟的基础。不过，将大语言模型应用于模拟法律体系方面仍缺乏深入的研究。在这项研究中，我们提出了“法律在硅中”这一基于大语言模型的智能体框架，该框架能够模拟包含个人决策以及立法、司法和执行等机构机制的法律场景。我们通过将智能体的行为与实际犯罪数据进行校准，证明了基于大语言模型的智能体能够捕捉到真实的社会学关联。在此基础上，我们采用“微观到宏观”的过程来构建我们的模拟体系：首先在具有代表性的冲突驱动场景中开展微观层面的模拟，使法律规则能够通过智能体与机构的互动自然演变。这些演变后的法律随后被应用到宏观层面的人群中，以评估其在规范行为方面的有效性。通过一系列全面的实验，我们的研究结果表明，一个运作良好、透明且具有适应性的法律体系能够有效缓解“猫捉老鼠”式的监管动态，并为弱势群体提供更好的保护。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MT-Video-Bench: A Holistic Video Understanding Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs in Multi-Turn Dialogues
papers.title_zh: MT-Video-Bench：一种全面的视频理解评估基准，用于评价多模态大型语言模型在多轮对话中的表现
papers.authors: Yaning Pan, Qianqian Xie, Guohui Zhang, Zekun Moore Wang, Yongqian Wen, Yuanxing Zhang, Haoxuan Hu, Zhiyu Pan, Yibing Huang, Zhidong Gan, Yonghong Lin, An Ping, Shihao Li, Yanghai Wang, Tianhao Peng, Jiaheng Liu
papers.abstract: The recent development of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has significantly advanced AI’s ability to understand visual modalities. However, existing evaluation benchmarks remain limited to single-turn question answering, overlooking the complexity of multi-turn dialogues in real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{MT-Video-Bench}, a holistic video understanding benchmark for evaluating MLLMs in multi-turn dialogues. Specifically, our MT-Video-Bench mainly assesses six core competencies that focus on perceptivity and interactivity, encompassing 1,000 meticulously curated multi-turn dialogues from diverse domains. These capabilities are rigorously aligned with real-world applications, such as interactive sports analysis and multi-turn video-based intelligent tutoring. With MT-Video-Bench, we extensively evaluate various state-of-the-art open-source and closed-source MLLMs, revealing their significant performance discrepancies and limitations in handling multi-turn video dialogues. The benchmark will be publicly available to foster future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近多模态大语言模型的发展显著提升了人工智能理解视觉信息的能力。然而，现有的评估基准仍然局限于单轮问答场景，未能考虑到现实场景中多轮对话的复杂性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了**MT-Video-Bench**，这是一个全面的视频理解评估基准，用于评价在多轮对话中的多模态大语言模型性能。具体来说，我们的MT-Video-Bench主要评估六项核心能力，这些能力涉及感知性和交互性，涵盖了来自不同领域的1000个精心策划的多轮对话场景。这些能力与现实世界的应用紧密关联，例如互动式体育分析和基于视频的多轮智能辅导系统。通过MT-Video-Bench，我们可以全面评估各种先进的开源和闭源多模态大语言模型，发现它们在实际应用中的显著差异以及处理多轮视频对话时的局限性。该评估基准将公开提供，以促进未来的研究发展。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Query-Aware Graph Attention for Precise Subgraph Retrieval in Knowledge-Augmented Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 基于查询意识的图注意力机制：在知识增强推理中用于精确子图检索
papers.authors: Yuanye Xu, Linyi Guo, Yue Zhang, Fu Ning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on external knowledge to mitigate hallucinations, yet retrieving precise multi-hop evidence for knowledge-augmented reasoning remains difficult. Existing Knowledge Graph (KG)-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems insufficiently model the interaction between query semantics and relation types, resulting in imprecise subgraph retrieval and unstable reasoning. We propose Query-aware Subgraph Retrieval Augmented Generation (QSRAG), a retrieval framework built upon a Query-Relational Graph Attention Network (QR-GAT) that integrates query semantics and relation embeddings directly into the attention mechanism, enabling fine-grained triple scoring and scalable subgraph construction. This query–relation conditioning improves relevance estimation and suppresses noisy edges, producing faithful reasoning subgraphs. Experiments on WebQSP and CWQ establish new state-of-the-art results in both Triple Recall and Answer Recall, and significantly enhance LLMs reasoning accuracy without fine-tuning. These findings underscore the effectiveness of modeling query–relation interactions for reliable knowledge-augmented reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在缓解幻觉现象时，越来越依赖外部知识。然而，为基于知识的推理检索出精确的多跳证据仍然很困难。现有的基于知识图谱的检索增强生成系统未能充分模拟查询语义与关系类型之间的交互，导致子图的检索不够精确，推理结果也不稳定。我们提出了一种名为“查询感知子图检索增强生成”的方法，该框架基于查询-关系图注意力网络构建，能够将查询语义和关系嵌入直接整合到注意力机制中，从而实现细粒度的三元组评分和可扩展的子图构建。这种查询-关系条件化方法提升了相关性估计的准确性，并消除了噪声边的影响，从而生成出可靠的推理子图。在WebQSP和CWQ上的实验表明，该方法在三元组召回率和答案召回率方面取得了新的最佳成绩，并且无需微调就能显著提升语言模型的推理准确性。这些发现强调了建模查询-关系交互对于实现可靠的知识增强推理的重要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LIBERTy: A Causal Framework for Benchmarking Concept-Based Explanations of LLMs with Structural Counterfactuals
papers.title_zh: Liberty：一种基于因果关系的框架，用于评估基于概念的大型语言模型的解释能力，同时考虑结构性的反事实因素
papers.authors: Gilat Toker, Nitay Calderon, Ohad Amosy, Roi Reichart
papers.abstract: Concept-based explanations quantify how high-level concepts (e.g., gender or experience) influence model behavior, which is crucial for decision-makers in high-stakes domains. Recent work evaluates the faithfulness of such explanations by comparing them to reference causal effects estimated from counterfactuals. In practice, existing benchmarks rely on costly human-written counterfactuals that serves as imperfect proxy. To address this, we introduce a framework for constructing datasets containing structural counterfactual pairs: LIBERTy (LLM-based Interventional Benchmark for Explainability with Reference Targets). LIBERTy is grounded in explicitly defined Structured Causal Models (SCMs) of the text generation, interventions on a concept propagate through the SCM until an LLM generates the counterfactual. We introduce three datasets (disease detection, CV screening, and workplace violence prediction) together with a new evaluation metric, order-faithfulness. Using them, we evaluate a wide range of methods across five models and identify substantial headroom for improving concept-based explanations. LIBERTy also enables systematic analysis of model sensitivity to interventions: we find that proprietary LLMs show markedly reduced sensitivity to demographic concepts, likely due to post-training mitigation. Overall, LIBERTy provides a much-needed benchmark for developing faithful explainability methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于概念的解释能够量化高级概念（如性别或经验）对模型行为的影响，这对于处于高风险领域的决策者来说至关重要。最近的研究通过将这些解释与从反事实中估算出的参考因果效应进行比较，来评估这些解释的准确性。实际上，现有的基准测试依赖于成本高昂的人工编写的反事实，而这些反事实并不是完美的替代指标。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一个构建包含结构化反事实对的数据集的框架：LIBERTy（基于大语言模型的解释性基准测试，带有参考目标）。LIBERTy基于明确定义的结构化因果模型，其中概念上的干预会通过该模型传播，直到大语言模型生成相应的反事实。我们引入了三个数据集（疾病检测、CV筛查和职场暴力预测），并提出了一种新的评估指标——顺序准确性。利用这些数据集，我们对五种模型下的多种方法进行了评估，发现仍有很大的改进空间来提高基于概念的解释能力。LIBERTy还使得系统分析模型对干预的敏感性成为可能：我们发现，专有大语言模型对人口统计概念的反应明显减弱，这可能是由于训练后的缓解措施导致的。总体而言，LIBERTy为开发可靠的解释性方法提供了不可或缺的基准测试。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Contract-Coding: Towards Repo-Level Generation via Structured Symbolic Paradigm
papers.title_zh: 合同编码：通过结构化符号化方法实现代码生成，达到与仓库级别相同的效果
papers.authors: Yilin, Lujin Zhao, Yijie Shi
papers.abstract: The shift toward intent-driven software engineering (often termed “Vibe Coding”) exposes a critical Context-Fidelity Trade-off: vague user intents overwhelm linear reasoning chains, leading to architectural collapse in complex repo-level generation. We propose Contract-Coding, a structured symbolic paradigm that bridges unstructured intent and executable code via Autonomous Symbolic Grounding. By projecting ambiguous intents into a formal Language Contract, our framework serves as a Single Source of Truth (SSOT) that enforces topological independence, effectively inter-module implementation details, decreasing a topological execution depth and unlocking Architectural Parallelism. Empirically, while state-of-the-art agents suffer from different hallucinations on the Greenfield-5 benchmark, Contract-Coding achieves 47% functional success while maintaining near-perfect structural integrity. Our work marks a critical step towards repository-scale autonomous engineering: transitioning from strict “specification-following” to robust, intent-driven architecture synthesis. Our code is available at https://github.com/imliinyi/Contract-Coding
papers.abstract_zh: 向以意图驱动的软件工程转变（通常称为“Vibe Coding”）带来了一个关键的问题：上下文忠实度的权衡。模糊的用户意图会淹没线性推理链，导致在复杂的仓库级生成过程中出现架构崩溃。我们提出了合同编码这一结构化符号化方法，它通过自主符号化基础技术，将非结构化的意图与可执行的代码联系起来。通过将模糊的意图转化为形式化的语言契约，我们的框架成为了一个单一真理源，从而实现了拓扑上的独立性，有效减少了模块间的实现细节，降低了拓扑执行深度，并提升了架构的并行性。从经验来看，尽管最先进的智能体在Greenfield-5基准测试上会出现不同的幻觉问题，但合同编码在保持近乎完美的结构完整性的同时，实现了47%的功能成功率。我们的工作标志着迈向仓库级自主工程的重要一步：从严格的“遵循规范”转变为稳健的、以意图驱动的架构合成方式。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/imliinyi/Contract-Coding下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Adaptive Text Anonymization: Learning Privacy-Utility Trade-offs via Prompt Optimization
papers.title_zh: 自适应文本匿名化：通过优化提示来实现隐私与便利性的权衡
papers.authors: Gabriel Loiseau, Damien Sileo, Damien Riquet, Maxime Meyer, Marc Tommasi
papers.abstract: Anonymizing textual documents is a highly context-sensitive problem: the appropriate balance between privacy protection and utility preservation varies with the data domain, privacy objectives, and downstream application. However, existing anonymization methods rely on static, manually designed strategies that lack the flexibility to adjust to diverse requirements and often fail to generalize across domains. We introduce adaptive text anonymization, a new task formulation in which anonymization strategies are automatically adapted to specific privacy–utility requirements. We propose a framework for task-specific prompt optimization that automatically constructs anonymization instructions for language models, enabling adaptation to different privacy goals, domains, and downstream usage patterns. To evaluate our approach, we present a benchmark spanning five datasets with diverse domains, privacy constraints, and utility objectives. Across all evaluated settings, our framework consistently achieves a better privacy–utility trade-off than existing baselines, while remaining computationally efficient and effective on open-source language models, with performance comparable to larger closed-source models. Additionally, we show that our method can discover novel anonymization strategies that explore different points along the privacy–utility trade-off frontier.
papers.abstract_zh: 对文本文档进行匿名化处理是一个高度依赖具体情境的问题：在保护隐私与保留有用信息之间找到合适的平衡，会因数据领域、隐私目标以及后续应用的不同而有所变化。然而，现有的匿名化方法往往依赖于静态的、人工设计的策略，这些策略缺乏适应多种需求的灵活性，且通常无法在不同领域间通用。我们提出了自适应文本匿名化这一新方法，该方法能够自动调整匿名化策略，以满足特定的隐私与效用需求。我们还构建了一个针对特定任务的优化框架，该框架能够自动为语言模型生成匿名化指令，从而适应不同的隐私目标、领域以及后续使用场景。为了评估我们的方法，我们选取了五个具有不同领域特征、隐私限制和效用目标的数据集作为测试对象。在所有测试环境中，我们的框架始终能够比现有基线方法取得更好的隐私与效用平衡，同时仍保持了对开源语言模型的高效处理能力，其性能与那些规模较大的闭源模型相当。此外，我们还发现我们的方法能够发现新的匿名化策略，这些策略可以在隐私与效用之间找到更合理的平衡点。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SWE-QA: Can Language Models Answer Repository-level Code Questions?
papers.title_zh: SWE-QA：语言模型能否回答与代码库相关的问题？
papers.authors: Weihan Peng, Yuling Shi, Yuhang Wang, Xinyun Zhang, Beijun Shen, Xiaodong Gu
papers.abstract: Understanding and reasoning about entire soft-ware repositories is an essential capability for intelligent software engineering tools. While existing benchmarks such as CoSQA and CodeQA have advanced the field, they predominantly focus on small, self-contained code snippets. These setups fail to capture the complexity of real-world repositories, where effective understanding and reasoning often require navigating multiple files, understanding software architecture, and grounding answers in long-range code dependencies. In this paper, we present SWE-QA, a repository-level code question answering (QA) benchmark designed to facilitate research on automated QA systems in realistic code environments. SWE-QA involves 720 high-quality question-answer pairs spanning diverse categories, including intention understanding, cross-file reasoning, and multi-hop dependency analysis. To construct SWE-QA, we first crawled 77,100 GitHub issues from 12 popular repositories. Based on an analysis of naturally occurring developer questions extracted from these issues, we developed a two-level taxonomy of repository-level questions and constructed a set of seed questions for each category. For each category, we manually curated and validated questions and collected their corresponding answers. We evaluate six advanced LLMs on SWE-QA under various context augmentation strategies. Experimental results highlight the promise of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解和推理整个软件库是智能软件工程工具的重要能力。虽然现有的基准测试，如CoSQA和CodeQA，已经推动了该领域的发展，但这些测试主要关注的是小型、独立的代码片段。这些测试方法无法捕捉到真实世界库的复杂性，因为要有效进行理解和推理，通常需要处理多个文件、理解软件架构，并且需要基于长期的代码依赖关系来得出答案。在本文中，我们提出了SWE-QA这一针对仓库级别的代码问答基准测试，旨在促进在真实代码环境中对自动化问答系统的研究。SWE-QA包含720对高质量的问题与答案对，涵盖多种类别，包括意图理解、跨文件推理和多跳依赖关系分析。为了构建SWE-QA，我们首先从12个流行的GitHub仓库中爬取了77,100个问题。基于对这些问题中提取的自然出现的开发者问题的分析，我们制定了仓库级别问题的两级分类体系，并为每个类别构建了种子问题集。对于每个类别，我们手动筛选并验证了问题，并收集了相应的答案。我们在不同的上下文增强策略下，对六款先进的LLM在SWE-QA上的表现进行了评估。实验结果表明，LLM具有巨大的潜力。

papers.title: Efficient PRM Training Data Synthesis via Formal Verification
papers.title_zh: 通过形式化验证实现高效的PRM训练数据合成
papers.authors: Ryo Kamoi, Yusen Zhang, Nan Zhang, Sarkar Snigdha Sarathi Das, Ranran Haoran Zhang, Wenpeng Yin, Rui Zhang
papers.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have emerged as a promising approach for improving LLM reasoning capabilities by providing process supervision over reasoning traces. However, existing approaches for constructing PRM training data remain costly and noisy, as they typically rely on human annotation or sampling-based labeling methods that require repeated LLM calls. In this work, we propose FoVer, a framework that synthesizes PRM training data from formal reasoning tasks by annotating step-level error labels using formal verification tools such as Z3 and Isabelle. By leveraging formal verification, FoVer enables efficient and accurate PRM data construction without requiring human annotation or additional LLM calls. Using FoVer, we create PRM training data from formal logic and theorem proving tasks. Experiments on 12 reasoning benchmarks show that fine-tuning on our training data improves PRMs not only on math and logic reasoning tasks, which are informal variants of the training tasks, but also on NLI and BBH benchmarks, which differ substantially from the tasks used to construct the training data. These results demonstrate the practical effectiveness of FoVer, showing that PRM training data created using formal verification improves PRMs on informal reasoning tasks written in natural language. The datasets, models, and code are provided at https://github.com/psunlpgroup/FoVer.
papers.abstract_zh: 过程奖励模型（PRM）作为一种有前景的方法，通过为推理过程提供监督，提升了大语言模型的推理能力。然而，现有的PRM训练数据构建方法往往成本高昂且存在大量噪声，因为这些方法通常依赖于人工注释或基于采样的标注方式，而这需要反复调用大语言模型。在这项研究中，我们提出了FoVer框架，该框架利用Z3和Isabelle等形式化验证工具，对形式化推理任务中的步骤级错误进行标注，从而合成PRM训练数据。通过利用形式化验证，FoVer能够在不依赖人工注释或额外调用大语言模型的情况下，高效且准确地构建PRM训练数据。通过使用FoVer，我们从形式逻辑和定理证明任务中生成了PRM训练数据。在12个推理基准测试上的实验表明，在我们的训练数据上进行微调不仅提升了数学和逻辑推理任务的PRM性能，还提升了自然语言推理和问答任务中的PRM性能。这些结果证明了FoVer的实际有效性，即利用形式化验证生成的PRM训练数据能够有效提升以自然语言形式表述的推理任务的性能。相关数据集、模型和代码可在https://github.com/psunlpgroup/FoVer下载。

papers.title: Revealing the Attention Floating Mechanism in Masked Diffusion Models
papers.title_zh: 揭示掩码扩散模型中的注意力浮动机制
papers.authors: Xin Dai, Pengcheng Huang, Zhenghao Liu, Shuo Wang, Yukun Yan, Chaojun Xiao, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs), which leverage bidirectional attention and a denoising process, are narrowing the performance gap with autoregressive models (ARMs). However, their internal attention mechanisms remain under-explored. This paper investigates the attention behaviors in MDMs, revealing the phenomenon of Attention Floating. Unlike ARMs, where attention converges to a fixed sink, MDMs exhibit dynamic, dispersed attention anchors that shift across denoising steps and layers. Further analysis reveals its Shallow Structure-Aware, Deep Content-Focused attention mechanism: shallow layers utilize floating tokens to build a global structural framework, while deeper layers allocate more capability toward capturing semantic content. Empirically, this distinctive attention pattern provides a mechanistic explanation for the strong in-context learning capabilities of MDMs, allowing them to double the performance compared to ARMs in knowledge-intensive tasks. All codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/Attention-Floating.
papers.abstract_zh: 掩蔽扩散模型（MDMs）利用双向注意力机制以及去噪过程，正在缩小与自回归模型（ARMs）在性能上的差距。然而，这些模型的内部注意力机制仍未被充分探索。本文研究了MDMs中的注意力行为，发现了“注意力浮动”现象。与注意力会收敛到固定节点的ARMs不同，MDMs表现出动态且分散的注意力锚点，这些锚点在不同的去噪步骤和层中都会发生变化。进一步分析表明，MDMs具有一种浅层结构感知、深层内容聚焦的注意力机制：浅层利用浮动令牌构建全局结构框架，而深层则更多地用于捕捉语义内容。从经验来看，这种独特的注意力模式为MDMs强大的上下文学习能力提供了机制上的解释，使得它们在知识密集型任务中的性能能够比ARMs高出两倍。所有代码和数据集均可在此处获取：https://github.com/NEUIR/Attention-Floating

papers.title: Balancing Knowledge Breadth and Task Depth for Effective Domain Adaptation Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 在知识广度和任务深度之间找到平衡，以实现有效的领域自适应微调
papers.authors: Mu Zhang, Yuxiang Chu, Guangya Yu, Yongqi Fan, Weiyan Zhang, Hang Hu, Tong Ruan, Jingping Liu
papers.abstract: Training large language models for domain adaptation poses a significant challenge in balancing the acquisition of domain knowledge with the retention of general abilities, often leading to catastrophic forgetting. While curriculum learning offers a promising direction, conventional methods typically rely on a single dimension of knowledge or task, which is insufficient to navigate the trade-off between knowledge breadth and task depth. In this paper, we propose a two-dimensional curriculum learning framework that coordinates model training along two orthogonal axes: the knowledge dimension and the task dimension. We first reconstruct the dataset by clustering instances according to their semantic similarity to general-domain data, and subsequently annotate them with a task hierarchy. Then, we design an integrated curriculum that develops from general to domain-specific knowledge clusters, and within each cluster, from lower- to higher-order cognitive tasks. Compared with the second-best method, our method improves accuracy on medical evaluations by 2.49% and on financial evaluations by 1.2%. Ablation and cross-domain experiments further demonstrate our method as a scalable and effective framework for structured domain adaptation in large language model fine-tuning. We have released the code in an anonymous repository at https://github.com/Melo-1017/Balancing-Knowledge-Breadth-and-Task-Depth.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练大语言模型以实现领域适配面临着一个重大挑战，即如何在获取领域知识与保持通用能力之间取得平衡，这往往会导致灾难性的遗忘问题。虽然课程学习提供了一种有前景的方向，但传统方法通常只依赖单一维度的知识或任务，这不足以解决知识广度与任务深度之间的权衡问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种二维课程学习框架，该框架沿着两个正交轴来协调模型训练：知识维度和任务维度。我们首先通过根据实例与通用领域数据的语义相似性进行聚类来重构数据集，然后为这些实例标注任务层次结构。接着，我们设计了一个从通用知识到特定领域知识的逐步发展的课程体系，在每个知识簇内，任务也从低阶逐渐过渡到高阶。与第二种最佳方法相比，我们的方法在医学评估上的准确率提高了2.49%，在金融评估上的准确率提高了1.2%。通过消融实验和跨领域实验进一步证明了我们的方法是用于大语言模型微调中结构化领域适配的一种可扩展且有效的框架。我们已经在https://github.com/Melo-1017/Balancing-Knowledge-Breadth-and-Task-Depth这个匿名仓库中发布了相关代码。
