papers.title: Explain the Flag: Contextualizing Hate Speech Beyond Censorship
papers.title_zh: 解释这一标志的含义：将仇恨言论的问题置于更广泛的背景之下，而不仅仅是通过审查来解决
papers.authors: Jason Liartis, Eirini Kaldeli, Lamprini Gyftokosta, Eleftherios Chelioudakis, Orfeas Menis Mastromichalakis
papers.abstract: Hate, derogatory, and offensive speech remains a persistent challenge in online platforms and public discourse. While automated detection systems are widely used, most focus on censorship or removal, raising concerns for transparency and freedom of expression, and limiting opportunities to explain why content is harmful. To address these issues, explanatory approaches have emerged as a promising solution, aiming to make hate speech detection more transparent, accountable, and informative. In this paper, we present a hybrid approach that combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with three newly created and curated vocabularies to detect and explain hate speech in English, French, and Greek. Our system captures both inherently derogatory expressions tied to identity characteristics and direct group-targeted content through two complementary pipelines: one that detects and disambiguates problematic terms using the curated vocabularies, and one that leverages LLMs as context-aware evaluators of group-targeting content. The outputs are fused into grounded explanations that clarify why content is flagged. Human evaluation shows that our hybrid approach is accurate, with high-quality explanations, outperforming LLM-only baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 仇恨、贬低和冒犯性言论仍然是在线平台和公共讨论中持续存在的挑战。虽然自动检测系统被广泛使用，但大多数系统都侧重于审查或删除内容，这引发了人们对透明度和言论自由性的担忧，同时也限制了人们解释内容为何有害的机会。为了应对这些问题，解释性方法成为一种有前景的解决方案，旨在使仇恨言论的检测更加透明、负责任且富有信息性。在本文中，我们提出了一种混合方法，该方法结合了大语言模型与三个新创建并精心挑选的词汇库，用于检测和解释英语、法语和希腊语中的仇恨言论。我们的系统能够捕捉到与身份特征相关的贬低性表达，以及针对特定群体的直接内容。该系统通过两个互补的流程来实现这一目标：一个流程是使用精心挑选的词汇库来检测和消除问题术语；另一个流程则利用大语言模型作为评估针对特定群体的内容的工具。这些输出被融合成详细的解释，以阐明为什么某个内容会被标记为仇恨言论。人类评估表明，我们的混合方法具有高精度，并且能够提供高质量的解释，其效果优于仅使用大语言模型的基线方法。

papers.title: EnvScaler: Scaling Tool-Interactive Environments for LLM Agent via Programmatic Synthesis
papers.title_zh: EnvScaler：一种用于大型语言模型智能体的交互式环境扩展工具，通过程序化合成实现规模调整
papers.authors: Xiaoshuai Song, Haofei Chang, Guanting Dong, Yutao Zhu, Ji-Rong Wen, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are expected to be trained to act as agents in various real-world environments, but this process relies on rich and varied tool-interaction sandboxes. However, access to real systems is often restricted; LLM-simulated environments are prone to hallucinations and inconsistencies; and manually built sandboxes are hard to scale. In this paper, we propose EnvScaler, an automated framework for scalable tool-interaction environments via programmatic synthesis. EnvScaler comprises two components. First, SkelBuilder constructs diverse environment skeletons through topic mining, logic modeling, and quality evaluation. Then, ScenGenerator generates multiple task scenarios and rule-based trajectory validation functions for each environment. With EnvScaler, we synthesize 191 environments and about 7K scenarios, and apply them to Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Qwen3 series models. Results on three benchmarks show that EnvScaler significantly improves LLMs’ ability to solve tasks in complex environments involving multi-turn, multi-tool interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）被期望被训练成能够在各种现实环境中充当智能体的角色，但这一过程依赖于丰富且多样化的工具交互环境。然而，对真实系统的访问往往受到限制；由LLM模拟的环境容易出现幻觉和不一致性；而手动构建的环境则难以进行扩展。在本文中，我们提出了EnvScaler这一自动化框架，它通过程序化合成的方式创建可扩展的工具交互环境。EnvScaler包含两个部分：首先，SkelBuilder通过主题挖掘、逻辑建模和质量评估来构建多样化的环境骨架；然后，ScenGenerator为每个环境生成多种任务场景以及基于规则的轨迹验证函数。通过使用EnvScaler，我们合成了191种环境和大约7千种场景，并将它们应用于Qwen3系列模型的监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）任务中。在三个基准测试中的结果表明，EnvScaler显著提升了LLM在涉及多轮次、多工具交互的复杂环境中的任务解决能力。

papers.title: Iterative Knowledge Graph Refinement and Integration for Medical Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 用于医学问答的迭代知识图谱优化与整合技术
papers.authors: Haochen Zou, Yongli Wang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are challenged by generating hallucinations and factually incorrect responses, particularly in complex and specialized medical question answering (QA). Integrating knowledge graphs (KGs) through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods has emerged as a promising direction. However, existing graph-based RAG methods heuristically retrieve and refine question-relevant subgraphs, potentially introducing redundant and noisy factual information that is difficult for LLMs to process, ultimately limiting reasoning capability. To incorporate a concise yet informative evidence subgraph, we propose an iterative medical QA framework. It optimizes graph-based RAG methods by selectively retrieving focused knowledge from KGs to construct a precise evidence subgraph and progressively pruning it utilizing structured feature representations. The targeted KG integration maintains coherent and reliable inference. Experiments on three medical QA benchmark datasets demonstrate that the framework achieves state-of-the-art performance against representative baseline competitors, highlighting the importance of efficient KG integration.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在生成幻觉和事实错误回答方面存在挑战，尤其是在处理复杂且专业化的医学问题回答时。通过检索增强生成技术来整合知识图谱，已成为一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的基于图的检索增强生成方法通常采用启发式方式检索和筛选与问题相关的子图，这可能会引入冗余和噪声性的事实信息，使得大语言模型难以处理这些信息，从而限制了其推理能力。为了整合简洁而富有信息量的证据子图，我们提出了一种迭代式的医学问题回答框架。该框架通过选择性地从知识图谱中检索相关知识点，来构建精确的证据子图，并通过结构化特征表示逐步对其进行精简处理。这种有针对性的知识图谱整合方式能够保持推理过程的连贯性和可靠性。在三个医学问题回答基准数据集上的实验表明，该框架在性能上达到了与同类基准模型相当的水平，这充分证明了高效的知识图谱整合的重要性。

papers.title: Lang2Act: Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning through Self-Emergent Linguistic Toolchains
papers.title_zh: Lang2Act：通过自涌现的语言工具链实现细粒度的视觉推理
papers.authors: Yuqi Xiong, Chunyi Peng, Zhipeng Xu, Zhenghao Liu, Zulong Chen, Yukun Yan, Shuo Wang, Yu Gu, Ge Yu
papers.abstract: Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VRAG) enhances Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by incorporating external visual documents to address a given query. Existing VRAG frameworks usually depend on rigid, pre-defined external tools to extend the perceptual capabilities of VLMs, typically by explicitly separating visual perception from subsequent reasoning processes. However, this decoupled design can lead to unnecessary loss of visual information, particularly when image-based operations such as cropping are applied. In this paper, we propose Lang2Act, which enables fine-grained visual perception and reasoning through self-emergent linguistic toolchains. Rather than invoking fixed external engines, Lang2Act collects self-emergent actions as linguistic tools and leverages them to enhance the visual perception capabilities of VLMs. To support this mechanism, we design a two-stage Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based training framework. Specifically, the first stage optimizes VLMs to self-explore high-quality actions for constructing a reusable linguistic toolbox, and the second stage further optimizes VLMs to exploit these linguistic tools for downstream reasoning effectively. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of Lang2Act in substantially enhancing the visual perception capabilities of VLMs, achieving performance improvements of over 4%. All code and data are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/Lang2Act.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉检索增强生成（VRAG）技术通过引入外部视觉文档来增强视觉语言模型（VLMs）的能力，从而解决特定查询问题。现有的VRAG框架通常依赖于固定的、预定义的外部工具来扩展VLMs的感知能力，这种设计方式通常会将视觉感知与后续的推理过程分离开来。然而，这种分离的设计可能会导致不必要的视觉信息损失，尤其是在执行诸如裁剪之类的基于图像的操作时。在本文中，我们提出了Lang2Act技术，该技术通过自产生的语言工具链来实现细粒度的视觉感知和推理。Lang2Act不是调用固定的外部引擎，而是收集自产生的动作作为语言工具，并利用这些工具来增强VLMs的视觉感知能力。为了支持这一机制，我们设计了一个基于强化学习的双阶段训练框架。具体来说，第一阶段优化VLMs以自我探索出高质量的行动，从而构建可复用的语言工具集；第二阶段则进一步优化VLMs，使其能够有效利用这些语言工具进行下游推理。实验结果表明，Lang2Act技术在显著提升VLMs的视觉感知能力方面表现出显著效果，性能提升超过了4%。所有代码和数据均可在此处获取：https://github.com/NEUIR/Lang2Act。

papers.title: Lost in Stories: Consistency Bugs in Long Story Generation by LLMs
papers.title_zh: 迷失在故事中：大型语言模型生成长文本时出现的连贯性缺陷
papers.authors: Junjie Li, Xinrui Guo, Yuhao Wu, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Hongzhi Li, Yutao Xie
papers.abstract: What happens when a storyteller forgets its own story? Large Language Models (LLMs) can now generate narratives spanning tens of thousands of words, but they often fail to maintain consistency throughout. When generating long-form narratives, these models can contradict their own established facts, character traits, and world rules. Existing story generation benchmarks focus mainly on plot quality and fluency, leaving consistency errors largely unexplored. To address this gap, we present ConStory-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate narrative consistency in long-form story generation. It contains 2,000 prompts across four task scenarios and defines a taxonomy of five error categories with 19 fine-grained subtypes. We also develop ConStory-Checker, an automated pipeline that detects contradictions and grounds each judgment in explicit textual evidence. Evaluating a range of LLMs through five research questions, we find that consistency errors show clear tendencies: they are most common in factual and temporal dimensions, tend to appear around the middle of narratives, occur in text segments with higher token-level entropy, and certain error types tend to co-occur. These findings can inform future efforts to improve consistency in long-form narrative generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 当讲故事的人忘记了自己的故事时会发生什么？大语言模型如今能够生成长达数万字的叙事文本，但它们往往无法保持一致性。在生成长篇叙事时，这些模型可能会与自身设定的事实、人物特征以及世界规则产生矛盾。现有的故事生成基准测试主要关注情节质量和流畅性，而一致性问题则大多未被充分研究。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ConStory-Bench这一基准测试，旨在评估长篇叙事生成过程中的一致性问题。该基准测试包含2000个提示，涵盖四种任务场景，并定义了五个错误类别的分类体系，每个类别下又包含19种细分的错误类型。我们还开发了一种名为ConStory-Checker的自动化工具，它能够检测其中的矛盾之处，并将每项判断都基于明确的文本证据进行验证。通过对多种语言模型进行五项研究问题的评估，我们发现一致性错误存在一些明显的规律：这类错误在事实和时间维度上最为常见；它们通常出现在叙事的中间部分；发生在具有较高令牌级熵值的文本片段中；某些错误类型往往同时出现。这些发现可以为未来改进长篇叙事生成过程中一致性的工作提供指导。

papers.title: Chinese Court Simulation with LLM-Based Agents System
papers.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的法庭模拟系统
papers.authors: Kaiyuan Zhang, Jiaqi Li, Yueyue Wu, Haitao Li, Cheng Luo, Shaokun Zou, Yujia Zhou, Weihang Su, Yiqun Liu, Qingyao Ai
papers.abstract: Mock trial has long served as an important platform for professional legal training and education. Traditional mock trials are difficult to access by the public because they rely on professional tutors and human participants. Fortunately, the rise of large language models (LLMs) provides new opportunities for creating more accessible and scalable court simulations. While promising, existing research ignored the systematic design and procedure evaluation of court simulations, which are critical to the credibility and usage of court simulation in practice. To this end, we propose a novel court simulation paradigm, i.e. SimCourt, based on the real-world procedure structure of Chinese courts, and design a comprehensive evaluation framework focusing on both legal judgment prediction and court procedure analysis. Experiments show that our framework can generate simulated trials that better guide the system in predicting the imprisonment, probation, and fine of each case. Further procedure evaluations show that agents’ responses under our simulation framework even outperform judges and lawyers from the real trials in many aspects. These demonstrate the potential of LLM-based court simulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 模拟法庭长期以来一直是专业法律培训和教育的重要平台。传统的模拟法庭由于需要专业导师和真人参与，因此公众难以接触。幸运的是，大语言模型的兴起为创建更易于获取且可扩展的法庭模拟提供了新机会。尽管前景广阔，但现有的研究忽视了法庭模拟的系统设计和程序评估，而这些方面对于法庭模拟在实际中的可信度和应用至关重要。为此，我们提出了一种创新的法庭模拟范式——SimCourt，该范式基于中国法庭的实际运作流程，并设计了一个全面的评估框架，该框架既关注法律判断的预测，也注重法庭程序的分析。实验表明，我们的框架能够生成更精确的模拟案件判决结果，从而更好地指导系统预测每个案件的监禁、缓刑和罚款金额。进一步的程序评估显示，在我们的模拟框架下，代理人在许多方面的表现甚至优于真实庭审中的法官和律师。这些成果证明了基于语言模型的法庭模拟所具有的巨大潜力。

papers.title: SPASM: Stable Persona-driven Agent Simulation for Multi-turn Dialogue Generation
papers.title_zh: SPASM：一种基于人物性格驱动的代理模拟系统，用于多轮对话生成
papers.authors: Han Luo, Guy Laban
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in multi-turn settings such as tutoring, support, and counseling, where reliability depends on preserving consistent roles, personas, and goals across long horizons. This requirement becomes critical when LLMs are used to generate synthetic dialogues for training and evaluation, since LLM–LLM conversations can accumulate identity-related failures such as persona drift, role confusion, and “echoing”, where one agent gradually mirrors its partner. We introduce SPASM (Stable Persona-driven Agent Simulation for Multi-turn dialogue generation), a modular, stability-first framework that decomposes simulation into (i) persona creation via schema sampling, plausibility validation, and natural-language persona crafting, (ii) Client–Responder dialogue generation, and (iii) termination detection for coherent stopping. To improve long-horizon stability without changing model weights, we propose Egocentric Context Projection (ECP): dialogue history is stored in a perspective-agnostic representation and deterministically projected into each agent’s egocentric view before generation. Across three LLM backbones (GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen-Plus) and nine Client–Responder pairings, we construct a dataset of 4,500 personas and 45,000 conversations (500 personas × 10 conversations per pairing). Ablations show ECP substantially reduces persona drift and, under human validation, eliminates echoing; embedding analyses recover persona structure and reveal strong responder-driven interaction geometry. Our code is available at https://github.com/lhannnn/SPASM.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被应用于多轮对话场景，例如辅导、支持和咨询等领域。在这些场景中，可靠性取决于能否在长时间范围内保持一致的角色、身份和目标。当大语言模型被用于生成用于训练和评估的合成对话时，这一要求变得尤为重要，因为大语言模型之间的对话可能会引发与身份相关的问题，比如角色漂移、角色混淆以及“回声效应”——即一个代理逐渐模仿其伙伴的行为。我们提出了SPASM（稳定角色驱动的多轮对话生成算法），这是一个以稳定性为首要目标的模块化框架。该框架将模拟过程分解为三个步骤：(1)通过模式采样、合理性验证以及自然语言角色构建来创建角色；(2)生成客户端与响应者之间的对话；(3)检测对话的终止点，以确保对话的连贯性。为了在不改变模型权重的情况下提高长期稳定性，我们提出了以自我为中心的场景投影技术：对话历史数据被存储在一个与视角无关的表示形式中，并在生成之前确定性地投影到每个代理的自我中心视角中。我们在三种大语言模型基础架构（GPT-4o-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen-Plus）和九对客户端-响应者组合上构建了一个包含4,500个角色和45,000条对话的数据集（每对组合包含500个角色和10条对话）。实验结果表明，以自我为中心的场景投影技术显著减少了角色漂移现象，并且在人类验证下消除了“回声效应”；嵌入分析还揭示了角色结构以及响应者主导的互动机制。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/lhannnn/SPASM下载。

papers.title: Telling Speculative Stories to Help Humans Imagine the Harms of Healthcare AI
papers.title_zh: 讲述一些富有想象力的故事，帮助人们理解医疗人工智能带来的危害
papers.authors: Xingmeng Zhao, Tongnian Wang, Dan Schumacher, Veronica Rammouz, Anthony Rios
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming healthcare, enabling the fast development of tools such as stress monitors, wellness trackers, and mental health chatbots. However, this rapid and low-barrier development can also introduce risks, including bias, privacy violations, and unequal access, especially when systems overlook real-world contexts, diverse user needs, and cultural settings. Many recent approaches use AI to identify such risks automatically, but this can reduce human engagement in understanding how harms arise, who they affect, and which stakeholder needs remain unspoken. We present a human-centered ethical foresight framework that generates speculative user stories and supports multi-agent discussions to help people reflect on potential benefits and harms of healthcare AI before deployment. In a user study, participants who engaged with stories identified a broader range of harms, distributing their responses more evenly across all 17 harm types, whereas those who did not engage with stories focused primarily on privacy and well-being (79.1%). Overall, our findings suggest that storytelling helps people anticipate potential risks and benefits and reflect more broadly on how AI systems may affect different users, contexts, and often unspoken needs.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能正在迅速改变医疗保健领域，使得压力监测器、健康追踪器以及心理健康聊天机器人等工具的研发得以快速推进。然而，这种快速且低门槛的发展也可能带来风险，包括偏见、隐私侵犯以及不平等的获取机会等问题。特别是当系统忽略现实世界中的各种情况、不同用户的需求以及文化环境时，这些问题就会更加突出。许多最新的方法利用人工智能来自动识别这些风险，但这可能会减少人们去了解这些风险是如何产生的、它们会影响哪些人，以及哪些利益相关者的需求尚未被充分考虑。我们提出了一个以人为中心的伦理预见框架，该框架通过生成假设性的用户故事，并支持多智能体讨论，帮助人们在部署医疗人工智能之前，能够更全面地思考其潜在的好处和危害。在一项用户研究中，参与讨论的参与者能够识别出更广泛的危害类型，他们的反应在所有17种危害类型上分布得更均匀；而那些没有参与讨论的参与者则主要关注隐私和福祉问题（占79.1%）。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，通过讲故事的方式，人们能够更好地预见潜在的风险和好处，并更广泛地思考人工智能系统对不同用户、不同情境以及往往未被提及的需求可能产生的影响。

papers.title: Masking or Mitigating? Deconstructing the Impact of Query Rewriting on Retriever Biases in RAG
papers.title_zh: 隐藏还是缓解？解析查询重写对RAG中检索器偏见的影响
papers.authors: Agam Goyal, Koyel Mukherjee, Apoorv Saxena, Anirudh Phukan, Eshwar Chandrasekharan, Hari Sundaram
papers.abstract: Dense retrievers in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems exhibit systematic biases—including brevity, position, literal matching, and repetition biases—that can compromise retrieval quality. Query rewriting techniques are now standard in RAG pipelines, yet their impact on these biases remains unexplored. We present the first systematic study of how query enhancement techniques affect dense retrieval biases, evaluating five methods across six retrievers. Our findings reveal that simple LLM-based rewriting achieves the strongest aggregate bias reduction (54%), yet fails under adversarial conditions where multiple biases combine. Mechanistic analysis uncovers two distinct mechanisms: simple rewriting reduces bias through increased score variance, while pseudo-document methods achieve reduction through genuine decorrelation from bias-inducing features. However, no technique uniformly addresses all biases, and effects vary substantially across retrievers. Our results provide practical guidance for selecting query enhancement strategies based on specific bias vulnerabilities. More broadly, we establish a taxonomy distinguishing query-document interaction biases from document encoding biases, clarifying the limits of query-side interventions for debiasing RAG systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 在基于检索增强生成（RAG）系统中，密集检索技术会表现出系统性偏差——包括简洁性、位置选择、字面匹配和重复性等偏差——这些偏差会严重影响检索结果的准确性。虽然查询重写技术现在已成为RAG流程中的标准手段，但其在消除这些偏差方面的影响仍未被充分研究。我们首次系统研究了查询增强技术对密集检索偏差的影响，对六种检索算法进行了五种方法的评估。研究发现，基于大语言模型的简单重写技术能够显著减少整体偏差（达54%），但在多种偏差同时存在的复杂情况下，这种效果会减弱。机制分析发现两种不同的作用机制：简单的重写通过增加得分的多样性来降低偏差；而伪文档方法则通过真正地与导致偏差的特征脱钩来实现偏差的减少。然而，没有任何一种技术能够同时解决所有类型的偏差问题，且不同检索算法的效果差异很大。我们的研究结果为根据具体的偏差类型来选择查询增强策略提供了实用指导。更广泛地说，我们建立了一个分类体系，区分了查询与文档交互引起的偏差与文档编码引起的偏差，从而明确了在RAG系统中进行查询端干预所能达到的偏差消除极限。

papers.title: Unifying Inference-Time Planning Language Generation
papers.title_zh: 统一推理时间规划语言生成
papers.authors: Prabhu Prakash Kagitha, Bo Sun, Ishan Desai, Andrew Zhu, Cassie Huang, Manling Li, Ziyang Li, Li Zhang
papers.abstract: A line of work in planning uses LLM not to generate a plan, but to generate a formal representation in some planning language, which can be input into a symbolic solver to deterministically find a plan. While showing improved trust and promising performance, dozens of recent publications have proposed scattered methods on a variety of benchmarks under different experimental settings. We attempt to unify the inference-time LLM-as-formalizer methodology for classical planning by proposing a unifying organizational framework based on intermediate representations. We thus systematically evaluate more than a dozen pipelines that subsume most existing work, while proposing novel ones that involve syntactically similar but high-resource intermediate languages (such as a Python wrapper of PDDL). We provide recipes for planning language generation pipelines, draw a series of conclusions showing the efficacy of their various components, and evidence their robustness against problem complexity.
papers.abstract_zh: 在规划领域，大语言模型的作用并非直接生成计划，而是以某种规划语言的形式表达规划方案。这些表达可以被输入到符号求解器中，从而确定性地找到最优的规划方案。尽管这类方法已经展现出更高的可信度和良好的性能，但近期已有数十篇论文在不同实验环境下提出了多种相关方法。我们试图通过构建一个基于中间表示的统一框架，来整合现有的各种规划方法。我们系统地评估了十几种规划语言生成方法，其中一些方法涵盖了现有研究的大部分成果；同时，我们也提出了一些新的方法，这些方法使用了语法相似但资源需求较高的中间语言（例如用Python实现PDDL）。我们为规划语言的生成提供了具体的实施步骤，并得出了关于各组件有效性的结论，同时证明了这些方法能够应对不同复杂度的规划问题。

papers.title: EmoRes: Toward Adaptive Psychological Support via User-Agnostic Benchmark and Topic-Mining Agent
papers.title_zh: EmoRes：通过用户不可知的基准测试和主题挖掘算法来实现自适应心理支持
papers.authors: Zhengwei Zou, Xuanming Jiang, Baoyi An, Dingyu Nie, Zhengxing Fang, Qingyu Liu, Xueming Qian, Guoshuai Zhao, Zhongyu Yang
papers.abstract: Large language models exhibit significant potential for psychological support, yet they often generate fragmented and emotionally inconsistent dialogues that lack the therapeutic structure necessary for reliable assessment.To address these issues, we introduce VeilEval, a clinically grounded and privacy-preserving benchmark equipped with interpretable metrics for evaluating multi-turn psychological dialogues.Furthermore, we propose Emotion-Resonance (EmoRes), a multi-agent framework that boosts psychological reasoning via a Topic-Mining Emotional Agent and a multi-perspective Self-Reflection Agent, thereby jointly improving topic continuity, emotional coherence, and clinical interpretability.Experiments demonstrate that EmoRes achieves up to \sim 3\times improvement over strong baselines on VeilEval, with its effectiveness further validated by ablation studies and human evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在提供心理支持方面具有巨大潜力，但它们往往会产生片段化且情绪不连贯的对话，这些对话缺乏进行可靠评估所需的稳定结构。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了VeilEval这一基于临床需求且注重隐私保护的基准测试工具，该工具拥有可解释性的评估指标，可用于评价多轮心理对话。此外，我们还提出了EmoRes这一多智能体框架，它通过主题挖掘情感智能体和多视角自我反思智能体的结合，提升了心理推理能力，从而共同提高了对话的连贯性、情绪的连贯性以及临床上的可解释性。实验表明，EmoRes在VeilEval测试集上的表现比强大的基线方法提升了约3倍，其有效性还通过消融研究和人类评估得到了验证。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Budget-Aware Anytime Reasoning with LLM-Synthesized Preference Data
papers.title_zh: 基于预算的随时推理，使用由大语言模型生成的偏好数据
papers.authors: Xuanming Zhang, Shwan Ashrafi, Aziza Mirsaidova, Amir H. Rezaeian, Miguel Ballesteros, Lydia Chilton, Zhou Yu, Dan Roth
papers.abstract: We study the reasoning behavior of large language models (LLMs) under limited computation budgets. In such settings, producing useful partial solutions quickly is often more practical than exhaustive reasoning, which incurs high inference costs. Many real-world tasks, such as trip planning, require models to deliver the best possible output within a fixed reasoning budget. We introduce an anytime reasoning framework and the Anytime Index, a metric that quantifies how effectively solution quality improves as reasoning tokens increase. To further enhance efficiency, we propose an inference-time self-improvement method using LLM-synthesized preference data, where models learn from their own reasoning comparisons to produce better intermediate solutions. Experiments on NaturalPlan (Trip), AIME, and GPQA datasets show consistent gains across Grok-3, GPT-oss, GPT-4.1/4o, and LLaMA models, improving both reasoning quality and efficiency under budget constraints.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在有限计算预算下大语言模型（LLM）的推理行为。在这种情况下，快速生成有用的部分解决方案通常比进行全面的推理更为实际，因为后者会带来较高的推理成本。许多现实世界中的任务，比如旅行规划，要求模型在固定的推理预算内提供最佳的结果。我们提出了一种随时可进行的推理框架，以及“Anytime指数”这一指标，该指标可以量化随着推理代币的增加，解决方案质量提升的效果。为了进一步提高效率，我们提出了一种基于LLM合成偏好数据的推理时间自我改进方法，通过让模型从自身的推理对比中学习，从而生成更优的中间解决方案。在NaturalPlan（旅行规划）、AIME和GPQA数据集上的实验表明，Grok-3、GPT-oss、GPT-4.1/4o以及LLaMA模型都能获得持续的改进效果，从而在预算限制下提升了推理质量和效率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mitigating Cultural Bias in LLMs via Multi-Agent Cultural Debate
papers.title_zh: 通过多智能体文化辩论来减轻大型语言模型中的文化偏见
papers.authors: Qian Tan, Lei Jiang, Yuting Zeng, Shuoyang Ding, Xiaohua Xu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit systematic Western-centric bias, yet whether prompting in non-Western languages (e.g., Chinese) can mitigate this remains understudied. Answering this question requires rigorous evaluation and effective mitigation, but existing approaches fall short on both fronts: evaluation methods force outputs into predefined cultural categories without a neutral option, while mitigation relies on expensive multi-cultural corpora or agent frameworks that use functional roles (e.g., Planner–Critique) lacking explicit cultural representation. To address these gaps, we introduce CEBiasBench, a Chinese–English bilingual benchmark, and Multi-Agent Vote (MAV), which enables explicit "no bias” judgments. Using this framework, we find that Chinese prompting merely shifts bias toward East Asian perspectives rather than eliminating it. To mitigate such persistent bias, we propose Multi-Agent Cultural Debate (MACD), a training-free framework that assigns agents distinct cultural personas and orchestrates deliberation via a "Seeking Common Ground while Reserving Differences” strategy. Experiments demonstrate that MACD achieves 57.6% average No Bias Rate evaluated by LLM-as-judge and 86.0% evaluated by MAV (vs. 47.6% and 69.0% baseline using GPT-4o as backbone) on CEBiasBench and generalizes to the Arabic CAMeL benchmark, confirming that explicit cultural representation in agent frameworks is essential for cross-cultural fairness.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型普遍存在以西方为中心的偏见，然而使用非西方语言（如中文）进行模型训练是否能够缓解这种偏见，目前尚未得到充分研究。要回答这个问题，需要严格的评估以及有效的解决方案，但现有的方法在这两个方面都存在不足：评估方法会将模型输出强制归入预先定义的文化类别中，而缺乏中立的选择；而缓解偏见的方法则依赖于昂贵的多文化语料库或基于功能角色的角色框架（例如“规划者-批评者”），这些框架缺乏明确的文化表征。为了弥补这些缺陷，我们提出了CEBiasBench这一中文-英文双语基准测试，以及Multi-Agent Vote（MAV）算法，该算法能够实现明确的“无偏见”判断。通过这一框架，我们发现中文训练仅能将偏见转向东亚视角，而无法真正消除偏见。为了缓解这种持续的偏见问题，我们提出了Multi-Agent Cultural Debate（MACD）框架。该框架无需训练即可为角色分配不同的文化身份，并通过“寻求共识同时保留差异”的策略来引导讨论。实验表明，在CEBiasBench基准测试中，MACD的平均无偏见率达到了57.6%，而使用MAV评估时则达到了86.0%（相比之下，使用GPT-4o作为基础模型的基线水平分别为47.6%和69.0%）。此外，该框架还适用于阿拉伯语CAMeL基准测试，这证明了在角色框架中明确文化表征对于实现跨文化公平性至关重要。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ToolRM: Towards Agentic Tool-Use Reward Modeling
papers.title_zh: ToolRM：关于代理式工具使用奖励建模的研究
papers.authors: Renhao Li, Jianhong Tu, Yang Su, Yantao Liu, Fei Huang, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Derek F. Wong, Junyang Lin, Min Yang
papers.abstract: Reward models (RMs) play a critical role in aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. Yet in the domain of tool learning, the lack of RMs specifically designed for function-calling tasks has limited progress toward more capable agentic AI. We introduce ToolRM, a family of lightweight reward models tailored for general tool-use scenarios. To build these models, we propose a novel pipeline that constructs high-quality pairwise preference data using rule-based scoring and multidimensional sampling. This yields ToolPref-Pairwise-30K, a diverse, balanced, and challenging preference dataset that supports both generative and discriminative reward modeling. We also introduce TRBench_{BFCL}, a benchmark built on the agent evaluation suite BFCL to evaluate RMs on tool calling tasks. Trained on our constructed data, models from the Qwen3-4B/8B series achieve up to 17.94% higher accuracy, substantially outperforming frontier LLMs and RMs in pairwise reward judgments. Beyond training objectives, generative ToolRM generalizes to broader critique tasks, including Best-of-N sampling and self-correction. Experiments on ACEBench highlight its effectiveness and efficiency, enabling inference-time scaling while reducing output token usage by over 66%. Its support for downstream RL training further validates its practical utility. We release data to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 奖励模型在使大语言模型符合人类偏好方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，在工具学习领域，由于缺乏专门为功能调用任务设计的奖励模型，使得更强大的智能体人工智能的发展受到了限制。我们提出了ToolRM这一系列轻量级奖励模型，这些模型专为通用工具使用场景而设计。为了构建这些模型，我们提出了一种新颖的流程，该流程利用基于规则的评分和多维采样技术来生成高质量的成对偏好数据。由此产生的ToolPref-Pairwise-30K数据集具有多样性、平衡性以及挑战性，能够支持生成式与判别式奖励模型的建模。我们还引入了TRBench_{BFCL}，这是一个基于代理评估套件BFCL构建的基准测试，用于评估奖励模型在工具调用任务上的表现。在我们构建的数据上进行训练的Qwen3-4B/8B系列模型，其准确率高达17.94%，远远超过了前沿语言模型和奖励模型在成对奖励判断方面的表现。除了训练目标之外，生成式ToolRM还能应用于更广泛的批评任务，包括最佳N次采样和自我修正等。在ACEBench上的实验表明，该模型具有高效性，能够在推理时实现规模扩展，同时减少超过66%的输出令牌使用量。其对下游强化学习训练的支撑进一步验证了其实用性。我们公开了这些数据，以推动未来的研究发展。

papers.title: MDocRAG-RL: Empowering Multi-Modal Document RAG via Complex Visual Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: MDocRAG-RL：通过复杂的视觉推理与强化学习技术，实现多模态文档的RAG处理
papers.authors: Zhongyu Wang
papers.abstract: While Retrieval-Augmented Generation(RAG) enhances multi-modal large language models(MLLMs) by introducing external knowledge, existing RAG systems still face significant limitations when dealing with complex visual reasoning. On one hand, MLLMs, being generative models, produce suboptimal embeddings for retrieval tasks. On the other hand, existing methods naively insert images into context without adequate visual perception, thereby limiting reasoning capabilities. To address these challenges, we propose MDocRAG-RL, a novel RAG framework for complex visual reasoning. We design specialized pre-training and fine-tuning tasks to enable MLLMs to compress visual document representations and align textual and visual embeddings for improved retrieval efficiency. Additionally, we design a visual perception action space for the generator that allows progressive coarse-to-fine information acquisition from visually-rich documents. Furthermore, we develop a reinforcement learning framework to enhance the complex visual reasoning capability of the RAG system. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging benchmarks demonstrate the significant effectiveness of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art performance across various benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于检索增强生成（RAG）技术通过引入外部知识提升了多模态大语言模型的能力，但现有的RAG系统在处理复杂的视觉推理任务时仍然存在显著的限制。一方面，作为生成模型的MLLMs在检索任务中产生的嵌入效果并不理想；另一方面，现有方法在将图像插入上下文时缺乏有效的视觉感知能力，从而限制了推理能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MDocRAG-RL这一用于复杂视觉推理的新型RAG框架。我们设计了专门的预训练和微调任务，使MLLMs能够压缩视觉文档表示，并将文本和视觉嵌入进行对齐，从而提高检索效率。此外，我们还为生成器设计了一个视觉感知动作空间，使其能够从富含视觉信息的文档中获取渐进式的信息。同时，我们开发了一个强化学习框架，以进一步提升RAG系统的复杂视觉推理能力。在多个具有挑战性的基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法具有显著的效果，能够在各种基准测试中取得顶尖的性能表现。

papers.title: MARS: Unleashing the Power of Speculative Decoding via Margin-Aware Verification
papers.title_zh: MARS：通过考虑边际效应的验证方法，释放投机性解码的力量
papers.authors: Jingwei Song, Xinyu Wang, Hanbin Wang, Xiaoxuan Lei, Tianyu Shi, Shixin Han, Eric Yang, Xiao-Wen Chang, Lynn Ai
papers.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive large language model (LLM) inference by decoupling generation and verification. While recent methods improve draft quality by tightly coupling the drafter with the target model, the verification mechanism itself remains largely unchanged, relying on strict token-level rejection sampling. In practice, modern LLMs frequently operate in low-margin regimes where the target model exhibits weak preference among top candidates. In such cases, rejecting plausible runner-up tokens yields negligible information gain while incurring substantial rollback cost, leading to a fundamental inefficiency in verification.We propose Margin-Aware Speculative Verification, a training-free and domain-agnostic verification strategy that adapts to the target model’s local decisiveness. Our method conditions verification on decision stability measured directly from the target logits and relaxes rejection only when strict verification provides minimal benefit. Importantly, the approach modifies only the verification rule and is fully compatible with existing target-coupled speculative decoding frameworks. Extensive experiments across model scales ranging from 8B to 235B demonstrate that our method delivers consistent and significant inference speedups over state-of-the-art baselines while preserving generation quality across diverse benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/5SSjw/MARS.
papers.abstract_zh: 投机性解码（SD）通过分离生成与验证过程，从而加速自回归大语言模型（LLM）的推理过程。虽然最近的一些方法通过将生成器与目标模型紧密耦合来提高草稿的质量，但验证机制本身却基本保持不变，仍然依赖于严格的词级拒绝采样策略。实际上，现代LLM通常在低边际的情况下运行，此时目标模型在多个候选选项中表现出较弱的偏好。在这种情况下，拒绝那些看似合理的次优选项所获得的信息收益微乎其微，同时还会带来巨大的成本开销，这导致了验证过程中的根本效率低下。我们提出了一种基于边际意识的投机性验证策略，这是一种无需训练且不受领域限制的验证方法，能够适应目标模型的局部决策特性。我们的方法以直接从目标逻辑值中获得的决策稳定性作为验证的条件，并且仅在严格验证无法带来明显收益时才进行拒绝操作。重要的是，该方法仅修改了验证规则，并且与现有的基于目标耦合的投机性解码框架完全兼容。我们在从8B到235B不同规模的模型中进行了广泛的实验，结果表明，我们的方法能够在保持生成质量的同时，显著提升推理速度，超越了当前最先进的基准算法。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/5SSjw/MARS。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AI, Take the Wheel: What Drives Delegation and Trust in Human–Computer Cooperative Question Answering?
papers.title_zh: 人工智能，掌控局面：是什么推动了人类与计算机协作问答模式中的委派机制与信任关系的建立？
papers.authors: Maharshi Gor, Yoo Yeon Sung, Yu Hou, Eve Fleisig, Zhu Irene Ying, Tianyi Zhou, Jordan Lee Boyd-Graber
papers.abstract: AI systems are fallible, and humans can make mistakes in deciding whether to trustAI over their own judgment. Thus, improving human-AI collaboration requires that we understand when,why, and how humans decide to rely on AI. We study two reliance decisions: delegating a task toAI without seeing its output (whether AI is used) and evaluating AI suggestions to decidewhether to adopt them how AI output shapes final decisions).Both matter for effective collaboration, yet prior work lacks naturalistic experiments capturing both patternsfor the same users. We address this gap by studying collaborative human–AI teams competing in aquestion-answering game in which humans can choose when and how to work with AI agents to win.Our 24 matches pair 23 expert humans with 16 AI agents, capturing 387 delegation and 1440 adoption decisions.While human–AI collaboration performs better than either AI or humansalone, humans make suboptimal collaboration decisions, bothunder-relying on correct AI suggestions (3.7% of opportunities missed) and over-relying when AI misleads them (1.5%).Both parties contribute wrong answers: reported model confidence is near chance when humans and AI disagree, while confirmation bias drives higher under-reliance (60.7%) when an AI suggestion agrees with humans’ initial incorrect answer.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能系统存在出错的可能性，人类在决定是否信任人工智能而非自己的判断时也可能犯错。因此，要改善人与人工智能的协作关系，就需要了解人类是在何时、为何以及如何决定依赖人工智能的。我们研究了两种依赖决策：将任务委托给人工智能而不查看其输出结果，以及评估人工智能的建议来决定是否采纳这些建议，以及人工智能的输出如何影响最终决策。这两种情况都对有效的协作至关重要，但之前的研究缺乏能够捕捉到同一组用户在不同情况下的自然实验。我们通过研究合作型人机团队在问答游戏中的表现来填补这一空白，在这个游戏中，人类可以决定何时以及如何与人工智能代理合作以获胜。我们的24场比赛涉及23名专家级人类和16个人工智能代理，共记录了387次任务委托和1440次决策过程。虽然人与人工智能的协作效果优于单独使用人工智能或人类，但人类的协作决策并不理想：他们要么对正确的人工智能建议依赖不足（错过了 3.7% 的机会），要么在人工智能误导他们时仍过度依赖其建议（1.5%）。双方都给出了错误的答案：当人类和人工智能意见不一致时，模型给出的置信度接近随机水平；而当人工智能的建议与人类最初的错误答案一致时，确认偏误导致他们对人工智能建议的依赖不足更为严重（达到60.7%）。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Self-Reinforcing Controllable Synthesis of Rare Relational Data via Bayesian Calibration
papers.title_zh: 通过贝叶斯校准实现稀有关系数据的自我强化可控合成
papers.authors: Chongsheng Zhang, Hao Wang, Zelong Yu, Esteban Garces Arias, Julian Rodemann, Zhanshuo Zhang, Qilong Li, Gaojuan Fan, Krikamol Muandet, Christian Heumann
papers.abstract: Imbalanced data are commonly present in real-world applications. While data synthesis can effectively mitigate data scarcity for rare classes, and LLMs have revolutionized text generation, the application of LLMs to the synthesis of relational/structured tabular data remains underexplored. Moreover, existing approaches lack an effective feedback mechanism to guide LLMs in continuously optimizing the quality of the generated data throughout the synthesis process. In this work, we propose RDDG, Relational Data generator with Dynamic Guidance, which is a unified in-context learning framework that employs progressive chain-of-thought (CoT) steps to generate tabular data for enhancing downstream imbalanced classification performance. RDDG first uses core set selection to identify representative samples from the original data, then utilizes in-context learning to discover the inherent patterns and correlations among attributes within the core set, and subsequently generates tabular data while preserving the aforementioned constraints. More importantly, it incorporates a self-reinforcing feedback mechanism that provides automatic assessments of the quality of the generated data, enabling continuous quality optimization throughout the generation process. Experimental results on multiple real and synthetic datasets demonstrate that RDDG outperforms existing approaches in both data fidelity and downstream imbalanced classification performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界的应用中，不平衡的数据现象非常常见。虽然数据合成可以有效地缓解稀有类别数据的稀缺问题，而且大语言模型也彻底改变了文本生成的方式，但将大语言模型应用于关系型/结构化表格数据的合成方面仍然缺乏深入研究。此外，现有的方法缺乏有效的反馈机制来指导大语言模型在整个合成过程中不断优化生成数据的质量。在这项研究中，我们提出了RDDG——带有动态引导的关系型数据生成器。这是一个统一的上下文学习框架，采用逐步的思维链步骤来生成表格数据，以提高下游不平衡分类任务的性能。RDDG首先使用核心数据集选择方法来从原始数据中识别出具有代表性的样本，然后利用上下文学习来发现核心数据集内属性之间的内在模式和关联，最后在保持上述约束的同时生成表格数据。更重要的是，它包含了一个自我强化的反馈机制，能够自动评估生成数据的质量，从而实现整个生成过程中的持续质量优化。在多个真实和合成数据集上的实验结果表明，RDDG在数据准确性和下游不平衡分类任务的表现上均优于现有方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: WaveDetect: Robust Framework for Machine-Generated Text Detection via Wavelet Transform
papers.title_zh: WaveDetect：一种基于小波变换的机器生成文本检测框架，具有强大的检测能力
papers.authors: Zhichen Liu, Kaitong Qin, Linhan He, Yang Xu
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models asymptotically approach human-level fluency in natural language generation, solely relying on surface-level semantic artifacts for detecting LLM-generated texts has become increasingly precarious. Existing detectors often falter when facing three critical challenges: adversarial perturbations, cross-domain shifts, and the rapid temporal evolution of the foundation model. To address these issues, we propose , a novel framework that reformulates text detection as a signal processing task within the time-frequency domain. Unlike previous methods that analyze static token probability distributions, models the generated output as a probability signal, upon which a differentiable Continuous Wavelet Transform is applied to convert them into learnable spectral representations. This process reveals the intrinsic “spectral fingerprints” in machine-generated texts–patterns that remain invisible in time domain. Comprehensive evaluations on three well-curated datasets (RAID, EvoBench, and Domain-Shift) show that our method achieves a new state-of-the-art. It not only achieves superior accuracy but also exhibits remarkable robustness against sophisticated attacks, generalization across out-of-distribution topics and unseen evolving LLMs. Our results validate the efficacy of spectral analysis as a promising paradigm for LLM-generated texts detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在自然语言生成方面逐渐接近人类水平的流畅性，仅依赖表面级的语义特征来检测由LLM生成的文本变得越来越不可靠。现有的检测算法在面对三个关键挑战时常常表现不佳：对抗性干扰、跨领域差异以及基础模型的快速时间演变。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，将文本检测重新定义为时频域内的信号处理任务。与之前分析静态令牌概率分布的方法不同，我们的模型将生成的输出视为一个概率信号，然后应用可微分的连续小波变换将其转换为可学习的频谱表示。这一过程能够揭示机器生成的文本中的内在“频谱指纹”——这些模式在时域中是无法被观察到的。在三个精心挑选的数据集（RAID、EvoBench和Domain-Shift）上的全面评估表明，我们的方法取得了新的领先水平。它不仅具有出色的准确性，还表现出对复杂攻击的强大抵抗能力，并且能够适应不同主题以及不断演变的LLM。我们的研究结果验证了频谱分析作为检测LLM生成文本的有效方法的潜力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AHEAD: Attention Head Energy-Aware Dynamics for Hallucination Mitigation in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: 领先：请注意，针对幻视缓解的头部能量感知动力学技术，适用于MLLMs环境
papers.authors: Jiale Chang, Ying Li, Siliang Tang, Yueting Zhuang
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models excel at vision-language tasks but remain prone to hallucinations that undermine their reliability. Existing approaches predominantly treat hallucinations as classification errors, overlooking the heterogeneous behaviors of attention heads and their dynamic influences during inference. We revisit MLLM reasoning from an energy perspective and identify that hallucinations stem from imbalances between visual potential and language prior potential: when visual information is ambiguous or language priors dominate, attention heads tend to be driven by linguistic statistical patterns, generating content inconsistent with visual evidence. We propose AHEAD, a framework that quantifies the energetic properties of each attention head during object generation through two potential networks—the Visual Grounding Potential Network and the Language Prior Potential Network—and dynamically adjusts their contributions at inference time. Specifically, we amplify attention heads with strong visual grounding capacity while suppressing those overly reliant on language priors. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that AHEAD significantly reduces hallucination rates without fine-tuning the base MLLM while maintaining generation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在视觉-语言任务上表现出色，但容易出现幻觉现象，这会降低模型的可靠性。现有的方法通常将幻觉视为分类错误，而忽视了注意力头的异质行为以及它们在推理过程中的动态影响。我们从能量的角度重新审视了多模态大语言模型的推理机制，发现幻觉的产生源于视觉潜力与语言先验潜力之间的不平衡：当视觉信息模糊或语言先验占据主导地位时，注意力头往往会受到语言统计模式的驱动，从而产生与视觉证据不一致的内容。我们提出了AHEAD框架，该框架通过两个潜在网络——视觉基础潜力网络和语言先验潜力网络，来量化每个注意力头在物体生成过程中的能量特性，并在推理时动态调整它们的贡献程度。具体来说，我们会增强那些具有强大视觉基础能力的注意力头，同时抑制那些过度依赖语言先验的注意力头。通过在多个基准测试中的实验验证，我们发现AHEAD能够在不微调基础多模态大语言模型的情况下，显著降低幻觉发生率，同时保持生成质量。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: TopoSHIELD: Reshaping the Flow of Malice via Spatio-Temporal Risk-Aware Topological Evolution in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: TopoSHIELD：通过时空风险感知的拓扑演化技术，重新塑造多智能体系统中恶意行为的传播方式
papers.authors: Ruiyang Huang, Chenxi Wang, Tinghe Zhang, Fengrui Liu, Jiayan Sun, Haocheng Wang, Yifan Wu
papers.abstract: While LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) demonstrate remarkable problem-solving capabilities, their interconnectivity acts as a conduit for the rapid spread of malicious injections. Addressing the limitations of static defenses, we present TopoSHIELD, a framework that reshapes the flow of malice via risk-aware topological evolution. Our approach utilizes a spatio-temporal graph neural network to monitor interaction dynamics, calculating node risk entropy (NRE) and edge attack conductivity (EAC) to pinpoint vulnerabilities. Guided by these metrics, TopoSHIELD executes precise structural interventions, pruning high-risk edges and isolating compromised communities to block attack diffusion. Empirically, TopoSHIELD reduces toxicity by 58% on GPT-4o while preserving high utility (>90% success rate), outperforming existing baselines in both suppression efficiency and scalability.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于大语言模型的多智能体系统展现了出色的解决问题的能力，但它们的互联互通性却为恶意代码的快速传播提供了途径。为了克服静态防御的局限性，我们提出了TopoSHIELD这一框架，该框架通过基于风险的拓扑演化来重新塑造恶意行为的传播路径。我们的方法利用时空图神经网络来监测交互动态，通过计算节点风险熵和边攻击传导率来识别漏洞。根据这些指标，TopoSHIELD能够执行精确的结构性干预措施，修剪高风险边并隔离受损的社区，从而阻止攻击的扩散。实验表明，TopoSHIELD在GPT-4o上的毒性降低了58%，同时仍保持了较高的实用性（成功率超过90%），在抑制效率和可扩展性方面均优于现有的基线方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Sycophancy and Skepticism in LLM Causal Judgment
papers.title_zh: 识别并缓解大型语言模型因果判断中的谄媚与怀疑行为
papers.authors: Edward Y Chang
papers.abstract: Do frontier LLMs reason causally, or do they pattern-match, yielding under pressure and hedging under uncertainty? We frame causal judgment as evaluation along three axes, Utility, Safety, and Wise Refusal, across Pearl’s Ladder. We introduce Recursive Causal Audit (RCA), a process-integrity evaluator whose Judge has no access to gold labels: it checks whether a model’s answer is entailed by itsown derivation, internally consistent, and not dominated by user hints under pressure. RCA unifies persona and pressure: prompt tone is the intervention that regulates pressure-induced drift. For fine diagnostic resolution we use CAUSALT3, with explicit trap families and standardized pressure protocols. CAUSALT3 reveals a Skepticism Trap (Claude Haiku rejects 60% of valid L1 links) and a Scaling Paradox (GPT-5.2 underperforms GPT-4-Turbo by 55 points on L3, driven by paralysis rather than hallucination). Under RCA, operating points shift toward the high-Utility, high-Safety quadrant without retraining, consistent with much of the observed failure arising from how answers are rendered under pressure rather than from missing causal knowledge.
papers.abstract_zh: 前沿大语言模型是进行因果推理，还是通过模式匹配来应对压力并在不确定性情况下进行对冲？我们将因果判断分解为三个维度：效用、安全性和明智拒绝，这些维度贯穿了珀尔阶梯的评估体系。我们引入了递归因果审计机制，这是一种过程完整性评估工具，其评判者无法获取“黄金标签”：该机制会检查模型的答案是否由其自身的推导过程所决定，是否内部一致，以及在压力下是否不受用户提示的影响。递归因果审计将人物特征与压力因素结合起来：提示的语气就是调节压力导致的偏差的干预手段。为了进行更精细的诊断分析，我们使用了CAUSALT3模型，该模型具有明确的陷阱分类标准和标准化的压力处理方案。CAUSALT3发现了一个怀疑陷阱（克劳德·海库拒绝了60%有效的初级链接），以及一个规模悖论（GPT-5.2在第三层评估中的表现比GPT-4-Turbo低55分，这一差异主要是由于思维迟缓而非幻觉造成的）。在递归因果审计的框架下，操作点会向高效用、高安全性的象限移动，而无需重新训练模型。这与许多观察到的失败现象一致，这些失败现象源于模型在压力下给出的答案质量不佳，而非缺乏因果知识。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SuperWriter: Reflection-Driven Long-Form Generation with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SuperWriter：基于反射机制的长文生成技术，结合大型语言模型
papers.authors: Yuhao Wu, Yushi Bai, Zhiqiang Hu, Juanzi Li, Roy Ka-Wei Lee
papers.abstract: Long-form text generation remains a significant challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly in maintaining coherence, ensuring logical consistency, and preserving text quality as sequence length increases. To address these limitations, we propose \textit{SuperWriter}-Agent, an agent-based framework designed to enhance the quality and consistency of long-form text generation. \textit{SuperWriter}-Agent introduces explicit structured thinking-through planning and refinement stages—into the generation pipeline, guiding the model to follow a more deliberate and cognitively grounded process akin to that of a professional writer. Based on this framework, we construct a supervised fine-tuning dataset to train a 7B \textit{SuperWriter}-LM. We further develop a hierarchical Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) procedure that uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to propagate final quality assessments and optimize each generation step accordingly. Empirical results across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that \textit{SuperWriter}-LM achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing even larger-scale baseline models in both automatic evaluation and human evaluation. Furthermore, comprehensive ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of hierarchical DPO and underscore the value of incorporating structured thinking steps to improve the quality of long-form text generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 长文本生成仍然是大语言模型面临的重要挑战，尤其是在随着序列长度的增加，如何保持文本的连贯性、逻辑一致性以及文本质量方面。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种名为“SuperWriter-Agent”的基于代理的框架，旨在提升长文本生成的质量和一致性。“SuperWriter-Agent”在生成过程中引入了明确的结构化思考与优化步骤，引导模型遵循一种更为审慎且基于认知的过程，类似于专业作家的创作方式。基于这一框架，我们构建了一个监督式微调数据集，用于训练一个拥有70亿参数的“SuperWriter-LM”。此外，我们还开发了一种分层直接偏好优化算法，该算法利用蒙特卡洛树搜索技术来传递最终的质量评估结果，并据此优化每一轮生成过程。通过在不同基准测试中的实证分析表明，“SuperWriter-LM”取得了领先的性能表现，无论是在自动评估还是人类评估方面，其性能都超越了更大规模的基线模型。进一步的全面实验研究也证明了分层直接偏好优化的有效性，并强调了引入结构化思考步骤对于提高长文本生成质量的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ProxyPrompt: Securing System Prompts against Prompt Extraction Attacks
papers.title_zh: ProxyPrompt：保护系统提示信息免受提示提取攻击的威胁
papers.authors: Zhixiong Zhuang, Maria-Irina Nicolae, Hui-Po Wang, Mario Fritz
papers.abstract: The integration of large language models (LLMs) into a wide range of applications has highlighted the critical role of well-crafted system prompts, which require extensive testing and domain expertise. These prompts enhance task performance but may also encode sensitive information and filtering criteria, posing security risks if exposed. Recent research shows that system prompts are vulnerable to extraction attacks, while existing defenses are either easily bypassed or require constant updates to address new threats. In this work, we introduce ProxyPrompt, a novel defense mechanism that prevents prompt leakage by replacing the original prompt with a proxy. This proxy maintains the original task’s utility while obfuscating the extracted prompt, ensuring attackers cannot reproduce the task or access sensitive information. Comprehensive evaluations on 264 LLM and system prompt pairs show that ProxyPrompt protects 94.70% of prompts from extraction attacks, outperforming the next-best defense, which only achieves 42.80%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）被广泛应用于各种场景中，这凸显了精心设计的系统提示的重要性。这些提示需要经过大量测试，并且需要相关领域的专业知识才能有效使用。虽然这些提示能够提升任务执行效率，但它们也可能包含敏感信息和过滤条件，一旦这些信息被泄露，就会带来安全风险。最近的研究表明，系统提示容易受到提取攻击，而现有的防御措施要么容易被绕过，要么需要不断更新以应对新的威胁。在这项研究中，我们提出了ProxyPrompt这一新型防御机制。该机制通过将原始提示替换为代理提示来防止提示信息泄露。这种代理提示保留了原始任务的实用功能，同时隐藏了提取出的提示内容，从而确保攻击者无法重现任务或获取敏感信息。通过对264对LLM和系统提示进行的全面评估，我们发现ProxyPrompt能够在94.70%的情况下保护提示信息免受提取攻击的侵害，其防护效果优于其他防御措施，后者仅能达到42.80%的保护效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Cogito: A Cognitive Agentic Framework Driven by Dynamic Graph of Thoughts for Financial Report Generation
papers.title_zh: Cogito：一种基于动态思维图谱的认知代理框架，用于生成财务报告
papers.authors: Chen Lifan, Wei Ding, Jingwen Yang, Xiuze Zhou, Jingan Chen, Fan Lin
papers.abstract: Financial report generation is a complex task that requires gathering and reasoning over multi-source information. Recent advances in Large Language Models have made them a promising solution for automating this process. However, the reasoning paths in traditional Chain-of-Thought paradigms are inherently constrained by predefined, static computational topologies, rendering them ill-equipped to handle the dynamic uncertainties of real-world financial environments. To tackle this challenge, we propose Cogito, a cognitively grounded agentic framework for professional financial report generation. At its core, Cogito is driven by Dynamic Graph of Thoughts, a novel reasoning mechanism that models the agent’s reasoning process as an evolving topology for adaptive exploration.We further introduce a Social Collaboration Mechanism to facilitate coordinated agent interaction. Finally, Cogito is instantiated as a multi-agent system, where four specialized agents collaboratively execute the end-to-end report generation task. Extensive experiments on enterprise- and industry-level financial report generation benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of Cogito in data quality, analytical validity, and presentation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 财务报告生成是一项复杂的任务，需要收集并分析来自多种来源的信息。大语言模型的最新进展使其成为自动化这一过程的有力解决方案。然而，传统思维链范式中的推理路径受到预定义、静态计算结构的限制，这使得它们难以应对现实世界金融环境中的动态不确定性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Cogito——一个基于认知的、用于专业财务报告生成的智能体框架。其核心是“动态思维图”机制，这是一种创新的推理机制，它将智能体的推理过程建模为可进化的拓扑结构，从而实现自适应探索。我们还引入了一种社会协作机制，以促进智能体的协同互动。最终，Cogito被实现为一个多智能体系统，由四个专门的智能体共同完成端到端的报告生成任务。在企业和行业级别的财务报告生成基准测试中的大量实验表明，Cogito在数据质量、分析有效性以及呈现效果方面都表现出卓越的性能。

papers.title: From Coarse to Fine: A Multi-Granularity Multimodal Framework for Teacher Sentiment Analysis
papers.title_zh: 从粗糙到精细：一种适用于教师情感分析的多粒度多模态框架
papers.authors: Zhiyi Duan, Xiangren Wang, Jiangshan Guan, Bing Jia, Qianli Xing
papers.abstract: Teacher sentiment analysis is pivotal for understanding instructional dynamics, yet it remains challenging because classroom expressions are professionally regulated performances rather than spontaneous outbursts. However, existing approaches typically treat sentiment as a static, monolithic label, failing to capture this structured heterogeneity. To effectively model this complexity, we decompose teacher sentiment into three granularities: coarse-level performativity, medium-level intra-class heterogeneity, and fine-level cross-modal complementarity. Guided by this perspective, we propose CF-TSA, a coarse-to-fine multimodal framework. Specifically, we employ CLS-guided cross-modal attention to recover effective signals from regulated displays (coarse-level), thresholded substyle discovery to identify latent pedagogical styles (medium-level), and substyle-aware contrastive learning to align dynamic multimodal cue compositions (fine-level). Experiments on T-MED and CMU-MOSEI demonstrate that CF-TSA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the effectiveness of the coarse-to-fine perspective and the hierarchical modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 教师情绪分析对于理解教学动态至关重要，但由于课堂表达是受到严格规范的行为而非即兴的宣泄，因此这一任务仍然具有挑战性。然而，现有的方法通常将情绪视为一种静态、单一的分类标签，无法捕捉到这种结构化的异质性。为了有效建模这种复杂性，我们将教师情绪分解为三个层次：宏观层面的表现力、中观层面的班级内部异质性，以及微观层面的跨模态互补性。基于这一视角，我们提出了CF-TSA框架——一个从宏观到微观的多模态模型。具体来说，我们采用CLS引导的跨模态注意力机制来从规范化的行为中提取有效信号；通过阈值化子风格发现来识别潜在的教学风格；再通过子风格感知的对比学习来调整动态多模态线索的构成。在T-MED和CMU-MOSEI上的实验表明，CF-TSA始终优于现有的最先进基线模型，这验证了从宏观到微观的视角以及分层建模的有效性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: PBEBench: A Multi-Step Programming by Examples Reasoning Benchmark inspired by Historical Linguistics
papers.title_zh: PBEBench：一种基于示例的多步编程推理测试平台，其设计灵感来源于历史语言学领域的研究
papers.authors: Atharva Naik, Darsh Agrawal, Prakam, Yash Mathur, Manav Kapadnis, Yuwei An, Clayton Marr, Carolyn Rose, David Mortensen
papers.abstract: While many benchmarks evaluate the reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), few isolate reasoning as a capability independent of domain knowledge. We introduce a new benchmark for inductive reasoning inspired by Sound Law Induction (SLI) in historical linguistics and formulated in a simple multi-step Programming by Example (PBE) framework. The task requires inducing a cascade of string rewrite programs that transform inputs into target outputs. We present PBEBench, a fully automated evaluation approach that generates such problems with controllable difficulty and ordering constraints, enabling scalable and contamination-resistant evaluation of sequential inductive reasoning. Using this approach, we construct three datasets that show a large gap between models that leverage test-time compute or long chain-of-thought reasoning and those that do not. Although recent models such as GPT-5 and gpt-oss-120b show promise, solve rates remain below 5% on hard PBEBench instances with long program cascades, even under computationally expensive scaling strategies. Finally, we show that PBEBench scores are more predictive of performance on real SLI than are other inductive reasoning benchmarks. We will release code and data to support further research.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然许多基准测试都评估大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但很少有测试将推理能力视为与领域知识无关的能力。我们引入了一个新的归纳推理基准测试，该测试借鉴了历史语言学中的声音法则归纳法，并采用简单的多步骤示例编程框架来构建。该任务要求推导出一系列字符串重写程序，将这些输入转换为目标输出。我们提出了PBEBench，这是一种完全自动化的评估方法，能够生成具有可控难度和顺序约束的问题，从而实现可扩展且不受干扰的序列归纳推理评估。通过这种方法，我们构建了三个数据集，这些数据集表明，那些依赖测试时计算或长链思维推理的模型与那些不依赖这些机制的模型之间存在巨大差距。尽管像GPT-5和gpt-oss-120b这样的近期模型表现出一定的潜力，但在具有长程序链的困难PBEBench实例上，它们的解决率仍然低于5%，即使是在计算成本较高的扩展策略下也是如此。最后，我们发现PBEBench的得分在预测实际SLI性能方面比其他归纳推理基准测试更具预测性。我们将发布代码和数据以支持更多的研究工作。

papers.title: T2I-ReasonBench: Benchmarking Reasoning-Informed Text-to-Image Generation
papers.title_zh: T2I-ReasonBench：基于推理的文本到图像生成性能评估
papers.authors: Kaiyue Sun, Rongyao Fang, Chengqi Duan, Xian Liu, Aoxue Li, Xihui Liu
papers.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) generative models have achieved remarkable progress, demonstrating exceptional capability in synthesizing high-quality images from textual prompts. While existing research and benchmarks have extensively evaluated the ability of T2I models to follow the literal meaning of prompts, their ability to reason over prompts with domain knowledge to uncover implicit meaning and contextual nuances remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce T2I-ReasonBench, a novel benchmark designed to explore the knowledge-driven reasoning capabilities of T2I models.T2I-ReasonBench comprises 800 meticulously designed prompts organized into four dimensions: (1) Idiom Interpretation, (2) Textual Image Design, (3) Entity Reasoning, and (4) Scientific Reasoning. These dimensions challenge models to integrate domain knowledge, infer implicit meaning, and resolve contextual ambiguities. To quantify the performance, we introduce a two-stage evaluation framework: a large language model (LLM) generates prompt-specific question-criterion pairs that evaluate if the image includes the essential elements resulting from correct reasoning; a multimodal LLM (MLLM) then scores the generated image against these criteria. Our comprehensive study across 16 state-of-the-art diffusion and unified multimodal models (UMMs) reveal two primary bottlenecks. First, many models lack the foundational reasoning ability to fully comprehend complex prompts. Second, even models with stronger reasoning modules exhibit a persistent gap between their internal understanding and the final generated image. This highlights an urgent need for the next generation of T2I systems to not only improve their reasoning capability but also to enhance integration between reasoning and synthesis.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到图像生成模型已经取得了显著的进展，在根据文本提示合成高质量图像方面展现了卓越的能力。虽然现有的研究和基准测试已经充分评估了T2I模型遵循提示字面意思的能力，但它们利用领域知识对提示进行推理以揭示隐含意义和上下文细微差别的能力仍然没有得到充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了T2I-ReasonBench这一新的基准测试，旨在探索T2I模型的基于知识的推理能力。T2I-ReasonBench包含800个精心设计的提示，这些提示分为四个维度：(1)成语解释；(2)文本图像设计；(3)实体推理；(4)科学推理。这些维度要求模型整合领域知识、推断隐含意义并解决上下文上的歧义。为了量化性能表现，我们采用了一种两阶段评估框架：一个大语言模型生成特定于提示的问题-标准对，以评估图像是否包含了正确推理得出的关键元素；然后由一个多模态语言模型对这些生成的图像进行评分。我们对16种先进的扩散模型和统一多模态模型进行了全面研究，发现了两个主要瓶颈。首先，许多模型缺乏完全理解复杂提示的基础推理能力。其次，即使那些具有更强推理模块的模型，其内部理解与最终生成的图像之间仍然存在明显的差距。这凸显出下一代T2I系统迫切需要不仅提升其推理能力，还要加强推理与合成之间的整合。

papers.title: CGBridge: Bridging Code Graphs and Large Language Models for Better Structure-Aware Code Understanding
papers.title_zh: CGBridge：连接代码图与大型语言模型，以实现更有效的代码理解——基于结构感知的方法
papers.authors: Zeqi Chen, Zhaoyang Chu, Yi Gui, Feng Guo, Yao Wan, Chuan Shi
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in code intelligence tasks such as code generation, summarization, and translation. However, their reliance on linearized token sequences makes them brittle to long-range program dependencies and superficial lexical shifts such as identifier renaming. Existing structure-aware approaches typically treat structure as serialized text prompts or auxiliary training objectives, which often inflate context length or rely on internalized structural priors, failing to provide explicit guidance during inference. To address these limitations, we propose CGBridge, a novel plug-and-play method that enhances LLMs with Code Graph information through an external, trainable Bridge module. It aligns Code Property Graph structure with code semantics and compresses them into compact soft-prefixes, decoupling structural reasoning from textual generation without updating the backbone. Experiments across multiple code LLM backbones and scales show consistent gains over both text-only adaptation and graph-augmented baselines. Furthermore, CGBridge remains robust under identifier renaming and enables over 4× faster inference than LoRA-tuned models, demonstrating both effectiveness and efficiency in structure-aware code understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成、摘要和翻译等代码智能任务中展现出了卓越的性能。然而，由于它们依赖于线性化的标记序列，因此对于长期程序依赖关系和简单的词汇变化（如标识符重命名）表现得十分敏感。现有的基于结构的处理方法通常将结构视为序列化文本提示或辅助训练目标，这往往会增加上下文长度，或者依赖内部化的结构先验知识，从而在推理过程中无法提供明确的指导。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了CGBridge这一创新的方法。该方法通过外部可训练的桥梁模块，将代码图信息整合到语言模型中。它将代码属性图结构与代码语义进行对齐，并将它们压缩成紧凑的软前缀，从而将结构推理与文本生成分离，而无需更新主干模型。在多个代码语言模型主干模型和不同规模上的实验表明，CGBridge无论是在仅文本适应还是基于图的基线模型中，都能带来持续的性能提升。此外，CGBridge在标识符重命名的情况下仍然表现出强大的鲁棒性，其推理速度比LoRA调优模型快了4倍以上，充分体现了其在结构感知代码理解方面的有效性和效率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Candidate-Aware Retrieval and Reranking for Multiple-Choice Question Answering: Arabic as a Case Study
papers.title_zh: 针对多选问题的候选信息检索与重新排序：以阿拉伯语为例进行研究
papers.authors: Yassine Bouziane, Youness Moukafih, Mounir Ghogho
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently achieved impressive results on multiple-choice question answering (MCQA), with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) emerging as an effective strategy for improving the performance of smaller models. However, existing RAG formulations face persistent challenges: retrieving too many passages often introduces noise, and even when relevant content is retrieved, models may still struggle with partially relevant or conflicting information. Moreover, while LLMs perform strongly on English benchmarks, their accuracy declines substantially on Arabic multi-task evaluations, revealing ongoing issues in cross-lingual transfer and domain adaptation. In this paper, we propose a novel approach, using Arabic as a representative case study, that jointly models the relevance of both the question and its candidate answers when selecting contextual passages. The method employs a lightweight reranker trained with a hybrid regression–triplet loss objective to identify passages that provide discriminative and reliable evidence. Extensive experiments across multiple model sizes and humanities domains show that our approach consistently outperforms both standard RAG baselines and reranker baselines, delivering two- to threefold improvements while remaining competitive with considerably larger models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多项选择问题回答任务上取得了令人瞩目的成绩，其中基于检索增强生成的方法被证明是提升小型模型性能的有效策略。然而，现有的检索增强生成算法仍面临诸多挑战：检索过多的段落往往会引入噪声；即使检索到了相关内容，模型也可能难以处理部分不相关或相互矛盾的信息。此外，虽然大语言模型在英语基准测试中的表现非常出色，但在阿拉伯语多任务评估中，其准确率显著下降，这表明跨语言迁移和领域适应方面仍存在问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，以阿拉伯语作为案例研究，该方法能够同时考虑问题及其候选答案的相关性，从而在选择上下文段落时发挥重要作用。该方法采用了一个轻量级的重新排序器，该重新排序器通过混合回归与三元组损失的目标进行训练，以识别出能够提供有区分性和可靠证据的段落。通过在多种模型规模和人文领域进行的广泛实验表明，我们的方法始终优于传统的检索增强生成基线和重新排序器基线，其性能提升了两到三倍，同时仍然能够与更大规模的模型相竞争。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Logical Structure as Knowledge: Enhancing LLM Reasoning via Structured Logical Knowledge Density Estimation
papers.title_zh: 逻辑结构作为知识：通过结构化逻辑知识密度估计提升大语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Zhen Bi, Zhenlin Hu, Xueshu Chen, Mingyang Chen, Cheng Deng, Yida Xue, Zhen Wang, Qing Shen, Ningyu Zhang, Jungang Lou
papers.abstract: The reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly attributed to training data quality rather than mere parameter scaling. However, existing data-centric paradigms often equate quality with factuality or diversity and ignore the internal logical complexity of training samples. In this work, we propose that natural language harbors Structured Logical Knowledge manifested through entailment relationships and logical topologies. To quantify this, we introduce Structured Logical Knowledge Density (SLKD), a novel metric that measures logical information content by decomposing natural language into executable predicates and logical primitives. Our analysis reveals a significant logical disparity in current datasets where sparse logical signals predominate. Consequently, we propose a density-aware re-cognizing optimization strategy that prioritizes high-density logical samples to align training with the model’s reasoning boundary. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach enhances reasoning performance and generalization without increasing total data volume. These results, further validated within a reinforcement learning framework, suggest that elevating logical density is more critical than expanding data scale for realizing the full cognitive potential of LLMs. The anonymized code is available in the Appendix C.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力越来越被归因于训练数据的质量，而非单纯的参数规模。然而，现有的以数据为中心的方法往往将数据的质量等同于事实性或多样性，而忽视了训练样本内部的逻辑复杂性。在这项研究中，我们提出自然语言蕴含着通过蕴含关系和逻辑拓扑所体现的结构化逻辑知识。为了量化这一点，我们引入了“结构化逻辑知识密度”这一概念，这是一种通过将自然语言分解为可执行的谓词和逻辑原语来衡量逻辑信息内容的新指标。我们的分析显示，当前的数据集中存在显著的逻辑差异，其中稀疏的逻辑信号占主导地位。因此，我们提出了一种注重密度的重新认知优化策略，该策略优先处理高密度逻辑样本，以使训练过程与模型的推理边界保持一致。大量的实验表明，我们的方法能够在不增加总数据量的情况下提升推理性能和泛化能力。这些结果在强化学习框架中得到了进一步验证，这表明提高逻辑密度比扩大数据规模更为重要，这样才能充分发挥LLM的认知潜力。匿名代码可在附录C中找到。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ACSE: An Ancient Character Semantic-Aware Embedding for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ACSE：一种适用于大型语言模型的古老字符语义嵌入方法
papers.authors: Zhihan Zhou, Daqian Shi, Lida Shi, Rui Song, Peiqiang Qiu, Xiaolei Diao, Hao Xu
papers.abstract: Research on ancient Chinese language is of great significance for tracing Chinese history and civilization. In the field of large language models, studies on the pre-Qin excavated documents such as Oracle Bone Inscriptions, Bronze Inscriptions, and Bamboo Book of Chu remain insufficient. This is because these ancient characters have a low level of digitization, training corpora are extremely scarce, and they typically contain complex and rich semantic information. Therefore, we propose an ancient character semantic-aware embedding for large language models. This embedding integrates both the glyph and lexicality of ancient characters and maps them to the modern Chinese semantic space. We also design a two-stage method for lightweight and parameter-efficient training of the embedding. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments on excavated documents from the pre-Qin period, and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 对古代汉语的研究对于追溯中国的历史和文明具有重要意义。在大语言模型领域，对于先秦时期出土文献的研究仍然不够充分，例如甲骨文、青铜铭文以及《楚辞》等文献。这是因为这些古代文字的数字化程度较低，训练语料库极为稀缺，而且它们通常包含复杂且丰富的语义信息。因此，我们提出了一种适用于大语言模型的古代文字语义感知嵌入方法。这种嵌入方式同时考虑了古代文字的字形特征和词汇性特征，并将它们映射到现代汉语的语义空间上。我们还设计了一种两阶段的方法，以实现嵌入模型的轻量级且参数高效的训练。最后，我们对先秦时期的出土文献进行了广泛的实验验证，结果表明我们的方法确实有效。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reasoning as Gradient: Scaling MLE Agents Beyond Tree Search
papers.title_zh: 基于梯度的推理：让最大似然代理突破树搜索的限制
papers.authors: Yifei Zhang, Xu Yang, Xiao Yang, Bowen Xian, Qizheng Li, Shikai Fang, Jingyuan Li, Jian Wang, Minrui Xu, Yuge Zhang, Weiqing Liu, Jiang Bian
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents for machine learning engineering (MLE) predominantly rely on tree search, a form of gradient-free optimization that uses scalar validation scores to rank candidates. As LLM reasoning capabilities improve, exhaustive enumeration becomes increasingly inefficient compared to directed updates, analogous to how accurate gradients enable efficient descent over random search. We introduce Gome, an MLE agent that operationalizes gradient-based optimization. Gome maps structured diagnostic reasoning to gradient computation, success memory to momentum, and multi-trace execution to distributed optimization. Under a closed-world protocol that isolates architectural effects from external knowledge, Gome achieves a state-of-the-art 35.1% any-medal rate on MLE-Bench with a restricted 12-hour budget on a single V100 GPU. Scaling experiments across 10 models reveal a critical crossover: with weaker models, tree search retains advantages by compensating for unreliable reasoning through exhaustive exploration; as reasoning capability strengthens, gradient-based optimization progressively outperforms, with the gap widening at frontier-tier models. Given the rapid advancement of reasoning-oriented LLMs, this positions gradient-based optimization as an increasingly favorable paradigm. We release our codebase and GPT-5 traces at: https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的机器学习工程代理主要依赖树搜索算法，这是一种无梯度优化方法，它利用标量验证分数来对候选方案进行排序。随着大语言模型推理能力的提升，与有向更新相比，穷举搜索变得越来越低效。正如精确的梯度能够使得随机搜索变得高效一样，树搜索也能在推理能力增强的情况下发挥重要作用。我们提出了Gome这一机器学习工程代理，它能够将基于梯度的优化策略应用到实际场景中。Gome将结构化的诊断推理映射到梯度计算上，将成功的记忆转化为动量效应，同时将多轨迹执行方式转化为分布式优化机制。在一个封闭世界协议中，该代理能够将架构效应与外部知识分离开来。在单个V100 GPU上，Gome在有限的12小时预算内，取得了35.1%的顶尖性能评分，这一成绩在MLE-Bench测试集上属于领先水平。通过对10种模型的扩展实验发现，当模型性能较弱时，树搜索通过穷举搜索来弥补不可靠的推理能力，从而保持优势；而当推理能力增强后，基于梯度的优化策略逐渐占据优势，尤其是在前沿模型上，这种优势更为明显。鉴于面向推理的大语言模型发展迅速，基于梯度的优化策略无疑成为了一种越来越有前景的方法。我们的代码库以及GPT-5的追踪数据可以在以下链接找到：https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Speak No Evil, Just Prompt: Low-resource Multilingual Toxic Speech Detection with Audio Language Model
papers.title_zh: 拒绝使用邪恶的语言吧！只需使用音频语言模型即可有效检测低资源环境下的多语言有害言论
papers.authors: Mingzi Zuo, Lei Zhang, Hailiang Sun, Shengzhi Huo, Changyu Dong, Xin Wang, Bo Wang, Hao Liu
papers.abstract: The widespread dissemination of toxic content on online platforms poses a critical threat to user experience. Toxicity detection in speech receives significantly less research attention than its text counterpart. Most existing methods rely on high-resource languages and employ a cascaded pipeline combining automatic speech recognition (ASR) and text classifiers. These designs limit robustness in low-resource languages and discard important acoustic cues. To address the lack of datasets, we construct PolySpeechTox, the first toxicity-annotated speech dataset spanning 53 languages and accent varieties, with a focus on low-resource languages and multiple accents. Based on PolySpeechTox, we conduct the first systematic study of toxic speech detection under low-resource, multilingual, and multi-accent conditions. We propose SoftPrompt-TSD, a prompt-based adaptation framework that leverages a frozen audio language model to perform end-to-end toxicity detection without ASR. The decomposed soft-prompt design balances global task alignment, cross-lingual generalization, and language-specific or accent-specific calibration. On PolySpeechTox, SoftPrompt-TSD achieves a micro-averaged ROC-AUC of 98.07%, mitigating the severe failures observed in baseline methods for several languages. In three generalization experiments, SoftPrompt-TSD demonstrates superior generalization capability and maintains robust performance against distribution shifts.
papers.abstract_zh: 在线平台上有毒内容的广泛传播对用户体验构成了严重威胁。与文本相比，语音中的毒性检测受到的关注要少得多。目前大多数方法依赖于资源丰富的语言，并采用结合自动语音识别（ASR）和文本分类器的多层次流程。这些设计限制了在低资源语言中的鲁棒性，同时也忽略了重要的声学线索。为了弥补数据集的不足，我们构建了PolySpeechTox，这是第一个包含53种语言和方言的有毒语音标注数据集，重点关注低资源语言和多方言情况。基于PolySpeechTox，我们进行了首次关于低资源、多语言和多种方言条件下有毒语音检测的系统性研究。我们提出了SoftPrompt-TSD这一基于提示的适应框架，该框架利用固定的音频语言模型进行端到端的毒性检测，而无需ASR。这种分解式软提示设计能够平衡全局任务一致性、跨语言泛化能力以及针对特定语言或方言的校准效果。在PolySpeechTox数据集上，SoftPrompt-TSD取得了98.07%的微平均ROC-AUC评分，有效缓解了基线方法在几种语言中出现的严重失败情况。在三项泛化实验中，SoftPrompt-TSD表现出卓越的泛化能力，并且能够在分布偏移的情况下保持稳定的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EmotionTalk: An Interactive Chinese Multimodal Emotion Dataset With Rich Annotations
papers.title_zh: EmotionTalk：一个具有丰富注释的互动式中文多模态情感数据集
papers.authors: Haoqin Sun, Jinghua Zhao, Xuechen Wang, Shiwan Zhao, Jiaming Zhou, Hui Wang, Xi Yang, Yequan Wang, Yonghua Lin
papers.abstract: The advancement of Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) in Chinese is significantly hindered by the scarcity of high-quality, spontaneous dialogue datasets compared to their English counterparts. In this work, we introduce EmotionTalk, the first interactive Chinese multimodal dataset designed to capture the nuance of authentic emotional interplay. Collected from 19 professional actors, the dataset spans 23.6 hours of dyadic conversations across diverse scenarios. A key contribution of EmotionTalk is its multi-grained annotation system, which integrates standard categorical and dimensional labels with fine-grained emotional speaking style captions, enabling research into interpretable emotion analysis. We establish comprehensive benchmarks for emotion recognition and captioning tasks, verifying the dataset’s effectiveness and the necessity of multimodal fusion. EmotionTalk serves as a critical resource for bridging the gap in non-English affective computing and is publicly released for the research community.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态情感识别技术在中文领域的发展受到了严重限制，因为与英语相比，高质量、自然对话的数据集非常匮乏。在这项研究中，我们引入了EmotionTalk——首个旨在捕捉真实情感互动细节的互动式中文多模态数据集。该数据集由19名专业演员参与录制，涵盖了23.6小时的不同场景下的双人对话内容。EmotionTalk的一个关键特点是其多层次的注释系统，该系统结合了标准的分类标签和维度标签，以及详细的情感表达风格描述，从而有助于进行可解释的情感分析研究。我们为情感识别和文本描述任务建立了全面的基准测试，证明了该数据集的有效性以及多模态融合的必要性。EmotionTalk作为连接非英语语言情感计算领域的关键资源，现已公开发布，供研究界使用。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: What Prompts Don’t Say: Understanding and Managing Underspecification in LLM Prompts
papers.title_zh: 引发沉默的诱因：理解并应对大语言模型提示中的信息不足问题
papers.authors: Chenyang Yang, Yike Shi, Qianou Ma, Michael Xieyang Liu, Christian Kaestner, Tongshuang Wu
papers.abstract: Prompt underspecification is a common challenge when interacting with LLMs. In this paper, we present an in-depth analysis of this problem, showing that while LLMs can often infer unspecified requirements by default (41.1%), such behavior is fragile: Under-specified prompts are 2x as likely to regress across model or prompt changes, sometimes with accuracy drops exceeding 20%. This instability makes it difficult to reliably build LLM applications. Moreover, simply specifying all requirements does not consistently help, as models have limited instruction-following ability and requirements can conflict. Standard prompt optimizers likewise provide little benefit. To address these issues, we propose requirements-aware prompt optimization mechanisms that improve performance by 4.8% on average over baselines. We further advocate for a systematic process of proactive requirements discovery, evaluation, and monitoring to better manage prompt underspecification in practice.
papers.abstract_zh: 在与大语言模型交互时，提示信息不足是一个常见的挑战。在本文中，我们对这个问题进行了深入分析，发现虽然大语言模型通常能够默认推断出未明确指定的要求（占比为41.1%），但这种行为存在脆弱性：提示信息不足的情况在模型或提示发生变更时，出现错误的概率会翻倍，有时甚至会导致准确率下降超过20%。这种不稳定性使得可靠地构建基于大语言模型的应用程序变得困难。此外，简单地列出所有要求并不能带来一致的效果，因为模型的能力有限，而且各种要求之间可能会相互冲突。标准的提示优化方法同样效果有限。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于需求意识的提示优化机制，该机制平均能够将性能提升4.8%。我们还建议采用系统化的流程来主动发现、评估和监督需求，以更好地应对提示信息不足的问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AffectCodec: Emotion-Preserving Neural Speech Codec for Expressive Speech Modeling
papers.title_zh: AffectCodec：用于实现情感保留的神经语音编码算法，能够准确模拟富有表现力的语音效果
papers.authors: Jiacheng Shi, Hongfei Du, Xinyuan Song, Y. Alicia Hong, Yanfu Zhang, Ashley Gao
papers.abstract: Neural speech codecs provide discrete representations for speech language models, but emotional cues are often degraded during quantization. Existing codecs mainly optimize acoustic reconstruction, leaving emotion expressiveness insufficiently modeled at the representation level. We propose an emotion-guided neural speech codec that explicitly preserves emotional information while maintaining semantic fidelity and prosodic naturalness. Our framework combines emotion–semantic guided latent modulation, relation-preserving emotional–semantic distillation, and emotion-weighted semantic alignment to retain emotionally salient cues under compression. Extensive evaluations across speech reconstruction, emotion recognition, and downstream text to speech generation demonstrate improved emotion consistency and perceptual quality without sacrificing content accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 神经语音编解码器为语音语言模型提供了离散的表示方式，但在量化过程中，情感线索往往会被削弱。现有的编解码器主要专注于声学重建方面的优化，导致情感表达在表示层面没有得到充分的体现。我们提出了一种以情感为导向的神经语音编解码器，它能够在保持语义准确性和韵律自然性的同时，明确保留情感信息。我们的框架结合了情感-语义引导的潜在调制、保持关系的情感-语义蒸馏，以及基于情感权重的语义对齐技术，从而在压缩过程中依然能够保留具有情感意义的线索。通过广泛的评估测试，包括语音重建、情感识别以及下游的文本到语音生成等方面，我们发现该编解码器在保持内容准确性的同时，显著提升了情感一致性和感知质量。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Agentic Conversational Search with Contextualized Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过强化学习实现带有上下文推理的主动对话搜索
papers.authors: Fengran Mo, Yifan Gao, Sha Li, Hansi Zeng, Xin Liu, Zhaoxuan Tan, Xian Li, Jianshu Chen, Dakuo Wang, Meng Jiang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a popular interface for human–AI interaction, supporting information seeking and task assistance through natural, multi-turn dialogue. To respond to users within multi-turn dialogues, the context-dependent user intent evolves across interactions, requiring contextual interpretation, query reformulation, and dynamic coordination between retrieval and generation. Existing studies usually follow static “rewrite, retrieve, and generate” pipelines, which optimize different procedures separately and overlook the mixed-initiative action optimization simultaneously. Although the recent developments in deep search agents demonstrate the effectiveness in jointly optimizing retrieval and generation via reasoning, these approaches focus on single-turn scenarios, which might lack the ability to handle multi-turn interactions. We introduce a conversational agent that interleaves search and reasoning across turns, enabling exploratory and adaptive behaviors learned through reinforcement learning (RL) training with tailored rewards towards evolving user goals. The experimental results across four widely used conversational benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods by surpassing several existing strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已成为人类与人工智能交互的常用接口，通过自然的多轮对话来支持信息检索和任务协助。在多轮对话中回应用户时，依赖上下文的用户意图会随交互不断演变，这要求对上下文进行解读、重新构建查询语句，并协调检索与生成过程。现有的研究通常遵循静态的“重写、检索、生成”流程，即分别优化不同的步骤，而忽略了同时优化混合主动行为的问题。尽管最近在深度搜索代理方面的研究展示了通过推理来联合优化检索和生成的有效性，但这些方法主要关注单轮交互场景，可能缺乏处理多轮交互的能力。我们提出了一种对话式代理，它能够在不同轮次之间交替使用搜索和推理机制，从而实现通过强化学习训练获得的探索性和适应性行为，同时针对不断变化的用户目标提供相应的奖励。在四个常用的对话基准测试中的实验结果表明，我们的方法具有有效性，成功超越了多个现有的强基线算法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Do Multimodal RAG Systems Leak Data? A Comprehensive Evaluation of Membership Inference and Image Caption Retrieval Attacks
papers.title_zh: 多模态RAG系统会泄露数据吗？对成员推断攻击和图像标注检索攻击的全面评估
papers.authors: Ali Al-Lawati, Suhang Wang
papers.abstract: The growing adoption of multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (mRAG) pipelines for vision-centric tasks (e.g., visual QA) introduces important privacy challenges. In particular, while mRAG provides a practical capability to connect private datasets and improve model performance, it risks the leakage of private information from these datasets. In this paper, we perform an empirical study to analyze the privacy risks inherent in the mRAG pipeline observed through standard model prompting. Specifically, we implement a case study that attempts to determine whether a visual asset (e.g., image) is included in the mRAG, and, if present, to leak the metadata (e.g., caption) related to it.Our findings highlight the need for privacy-preserving mechanisms and motivate future research on mRAG privacy. Our code is published online: https://github.com/aliwister/mrag-attack-eval.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着多模态检索增强生成（mRAG）技术越来越多地被用于以视觉为中心的任务（例如视觉问答），随之而来的还有重要的隐私挑战。具体来说，虽然mRAG能够有效地将私有数据集整合在一起，从而提高模型的性能，但这也带来了私有信息泄露的风险。在本文中，我们进行了实证研究，分析了通过标准模型提示所观察到的mRAG流程中的隐私风险。具体而言，我们实施了一个案例研究，试图确定某个视觉资源（例如图像）是否包含在mRAG中，如果包含的话，是否会泄露与之相关的元数据（例如标题）。我们的研究发现强调了需要采用隐私保护机制，并为未来关于mRAG隐私的研究提供了动力。我们的代码已在线发布：https://github.com/aliwister/mrag-attack-eval

papers.title: PED: Route-Decoupled Diagnostics for Persona Consistency in Spoken Agents
papers.title_zh: PED：用于语音代理角色一致性的路径分离式诊断技术
papers.authors: Weihao Liu, Junrui Wei, Zhao Zhang, Ju Zhang
papers.abstract: Maintaining a stable persona is central to sustained spoken role-playing, yet when an agent breaks character, current evaluations often do not isolate which component caused the failure, making fixes slow and ad hoc.We propose PED (Persona-Emotion Decoupling), a diagnostic evaluation framework that decomposes persona expression into two observable routes: what the agent says (text) and how it sounds (speech).PED operationalizes the affective slice of persona expression by projecting transcripts and audio into a shared affective measurement space for route-comparable, reference-based analyses of separability, drift, failures, and coupling.We demonstrate PED via two worked instantiations spanning an end-to-end Speech LLM and a cascaded LLM+TTS pipeline under a fixed dialogue protocol.Within this setting, PED surfaces four recurring diagnostic signatures:(i) route-level separability is bounded by reference overlap and can differ sharply across architectures,(ii) text-route drift is stress-linked and tends toward a neutral-heavy region,(iii) text-audio consistency is weakly coupled, yielding route-asymmetric failures,and (iv) audio-route structure can be materially shaped by an explicit intermediate style cue in cascaded pipelines.Overall, PED reframes holistic “voice+character” grading as turn-level, fault-localizing signals for faster debugging and iteration.
papers.abstract_zh: 保持稳定的角色形象是持续进行口语角色扮演的关键。然而，当角色扮演者打破角色设定时，现有的评估方法往往无法明确识别出导致失败的具体因素，因此修复过程变得缓慢且缺乏系统性。我们提出了PED（角色-情感分离）这一诊断评估框架，该框架将角色表达分解为两个可观测的维度：角色所说的内容（文本）以及其发音方式（语音）。PED通过将文本和音频数据映射到共同的情感测量空间中，从而实现基于参考点的分析，以判断角色表达的分离性、变化趋势以及潜在的耦合问题。我们通过两个实际案例来演示PED的有效性：一个是对话式语音生成模型，另一个则是基于LLM与TTS的串联流程。在这些案例中，PED揭示了四个常见的诊断特征：(i) 不同架构下，文本与语音之间的分离性受到参考信息的限制，且差异显著；(ii) 文本与语音的变化趋势具有压力相关性，且趋向于中性或偏重的区域；(iii) 文本与语音的一致性较弱，导致角色表达出现不对称的问题；(iv) 在串联流程中，音频与语音的结构可以通过明确的风格提示来加以调整。总体而言，PED将复杂的“声音+角色”组合重新定义为可在特定环节定位问题的信号，从而加快调试和迭代的过程。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
