papers.title: Interpretable Semantic Gradients in SSD: A PCA Sweep Approach and a Case Study on AI Discourse
papers.title_zh: 在SSD中可解释的语义梯度：基于PCA扫描的方法以及一项关于人工智能对话的案例研究
papers.authors: Hubert Plisiecki, Maria Leniarska, Jan Piotrowski, Marcin Zajenkowski
papers.abstract: Supervised Semantic Differential (SSD) is a mixed quantitative–interpretive method that models how text meaning varies with continuous individual-difference variables by estimating a semantic gradient in an embedding space and interpreting its poles through clustering and text retrieval. SSD applies PCA before regression, but currently no systematic method exists for choosing the number of retained components, introducing avoidable researcher degrees of freedom in the analysis pipeline. We propose a PCA sweep procedure that treats dimensionality selection as a joint criterion over representation capacity, gradient interpretability, and stability across nearby values of K. We illustrate the method on a corpus of short posts about artificial intelligence written by Prolific participants who also completed Admiration and Rivalry narcissism scales. The sweep yields a stable, interpretable Admiration-related gradient contrasting optimistic, collaborative framings of AI with distrustful and derisive discourse, while no robust alignment emerges for Rivalry. We also show that a counterfactual using a high-PCA dimension solution heuristic produces diffuse, weakly structured clusters instead, reinforcing the value of the sweep-based choice of K. The case study shows how the PCA sweep constrains researcher degrees of freedom while preserving SSD’s interpretive aims, supporting transparent and psychologically meaningful analyses of connotative meaning.
papers.abstract_zh: 监督语义差异法是一种混合的定量与解释性方法，它通过估计嵌入空间中的语义梯度，并通过聚类与文本检索来解读该梯度的极点，从而模拟文本含义如何随着连续的个体差异变量而变化。该方法在回归之前应用主成分分析，但目前尚无系统的方法来选择保留的成分数量，这导致在分析流程中出现了可避免的研究自由度问题。我们提出了一种主成分分析扫描程序，将维度选择视为一个联合标准，综合考虑表示能力、语义可解释性以及在不同K值下的稳定性。我们在由多位高产作者撰写的关于人工智能的短文章语料库上验证了该方法的效果。扫描结果显示，在“钦佩”方面存在一个稳定且可解释的语义梯度，这种梯度使得对人工智能的乐观合作性描述与不信任和嘲笑性的论述形成鲜明对比；而在“竞争”方面则没有形成稳定的对应关系。此外，我们还发现，如果使用高主成分维数的反事实假设，会得到分散且结构不清晰的聚类结果，这进一步证明了基于扫描选择的K值方式的价值。案例研究表明，主成分分析扫描能够限制研究者的自由度，同时保留监督语义差异法的解释目标，为对内涵意义的透明且具有心理学意义的分析提供了支持。

papers.title: Self-Sum: Teaching an Agent to Decide Itself When and What to Summarize
papers.title_zh: 自我总结：教会代理机器在何时何地进行总结的决策过程
papers.authors: Hongru Wang, Rui Wang, Jushi Kai, Boyang Xue, Yongqi Li, Shijue Huang, Xiaoteng Ma, Jeff Z. Pan, Amos Storkey
papers.abstract: Long-horizon agents operate over extended sequences of reasoning and actions, but this inevitably accumulates context noise, resulting in excessive computational cost and information overload. Existing approaches commonly rely on fixed, rule-based summarization strategies (e.g., summarizing every few steps), which are inflexible, lack generalization, and often introduce irreversible information loss. We propose Self-Sum, a framework that empowers agents to autonomously decide when and what to summarize by modeling summarization as a first-class internal cognitive action, unified with external environmental actions within a multi-turn decision-making process. Specifically, we introduce a two-stage training recipe consisting of (i) a cold-start supervised fine-tuning stage that bootstraps summarization behavior, and (ii) a lightweight, summarization-aware reinforcement learning stage that refines summarization timing and content while discouraging unnecessary summaries. Experiments on multiple long-horizon benchmarks show that Self-Sum consistently outperforms no-summarization and rule-based baselines, with particularly strong gains in generalization. Analysis further reveals that Self-Sum learns to summarize sparsely at meaningful moments and preserves task-relevant information, highlighting the importance of jointly learning when and what to summarize for robust long-horizon agent behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 长期视角智能体在连续的推理和动作序列中运作，但这不可避免地会积累上下文噪声，导致计算成本过高和信息过载。现有的方法通常依赖于固定的、基于规则的总结策略（例如，每隔几步进行总结），这些策略缺乏灵活性，无法实现泛化能力，并且常常会导致不可逆的信息丢失。我们提出了Self-Sum框架，该框架使智能体能够自主决定何时以及要总结哪些信息。我们将总结行为建模为一项首要的内部认知行动，并将其与外部环境行为统一在一个多轮决策过程中。具体来说，我们采用了一种两阶段训练方案：第一阶段是冷启动式的监督微调阶段，用于引导智能体形成总结行为；第二阶段则是轻量级的、注重总结的强化学习阶段，该阶段可以优化总结的时间和内容，同时避免不必要的总结。在多个长期视角基准测试中的实验表明，Self-Sum始终优于不总结策略和基于规则的基线方法，尤其是在泛化能力方面取得了显著提升。分析还显示，Self-Sum能够在有意义的时候进行稀疏的总结，并保留与任务相关的信息，这凸显了共同学习何时以及要总结什么对于实现稳健的长期视角智能体行为的重要性。

papers.title: GreekMMLU: A Native-Sourced Multitask Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models in Greek
papers.title_zh: GreekMMLU：一个基于希腊语原语言的多任务基准测试，用于评估语言模型在希腊语场景下的性能
papers.authors: Yang Zhang, Mersin Konomi, Christos Xypolopoulos, Konstantinos Divriotis, Konstantinos Skianis, Giannis Nikolentzos, Giorgos Stamou, Guokan Shang, Michalis Vazirgiannis
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are commonly trained on multilingual corpora that include Greek, yet reliable evaluation benchmarks for Greek—particularly those based on authentic, native-sourced content—remain limited. Existing datasets are often machine-translated from English, failing to capture Greek linguistic and cultural characteristics. We introduce GreekMMLU, a native-sourced benchmark for massive multitask language understanding in Greek, comprising 21,805 multiple-choice questions across 45 subject areas, organized under a newly defined subject taxonomy and annotated with educational difficulty levels spanning primary to professional examinations. All questions are sourced or authored in Greek from academic, professional, and governmental exams. We publicly release 16,857 samples and reserve 4,948 samples for a private leaderboard to enable robust and contamination-resistant evaluation. Evaluations of over 80 open- and closed-source LLMs reveal substantial performance gaps between frontier and open-weight models, as well as between Greek-adapted models and general multilingual ones. Finally, we provide a systematic analysis of factors influencing performance—including model scale, adaptation, and prompting—and derive insights for improving LLM capabilities in Greek.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常会在包含希腊语的多语言语料库上进行训练，然而，针对希腊语的可靠评估基准仍然有限，尤其是那些基于真实、本土来源内容的基准。现有的数据集往往是从英语机器翻译而来的，无法准确反映希腊语的语言和文化特征。我们提出了GreekMMLU，这是一个针对希腊语的大规模多任务语言理解基准测试，包含21,805个选择题，涵盖45个主题领域。这些题目按照新定义的主题分类体系进行组织，并标注了从基础到专业考试的不同难度等级。所有题目都来自学术、专业和政府的考试，并以希腊语编写或原创。我们公开发布了16,857个样本，并保留了4,948个样本用于私人排行榜，以便进行稳健且不受干扰的评估。对超过80种开源和闭源语言模型的评估显示，前沿模型和开放权重模型之间存在显著的性能差距，同时，适应希腊语的模型与通用多语言模型之间也存在差异。最后，我们对影响模型性能的多种因素进行了系统分析，包括模型规模、适配性和提示方式等，并得出了改善希腊语语言模型能力的见解。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: User-Assistant Bias in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中的用户助手偏见
papers.authors: Xu Pan, Jingxuan Fan, Zidi Xiong, Ely Hahami, Jorin Overwiening, Ziqian Xie
papers.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) are typically trained and deployed using structured role tags (e.g. system, user, assistant, tool) that explicitly mark the source of each piece of context. While these tags are essential for instruction following and controllability, asymmetries in the training data associated with different role tags can potentially introduce inductive biases. In this paper, we study this phenomenon by formalizing user–assistant bias, defined as the tendency of an LLM to preferentially rely on information from either the user or assistant role when they provide incompatible information about the same entity in the context history. We introduce a task-agnostic benchmark UserAssist and evaluate such bias in 52 frontier models. We observe that most of the instruction-tuned models exhibit strong user bias, whereas base and reasoning models are close to neutral. Using controlled fine-tuning experiments, we isolate which post-training recipes drive the observed user–assistant bias. We find that human-preference alignment amplifies user bias, while reasoning fine-tuning reduces it. Finally, we show that user–assistant bias can be bidirectionally controlled via direct preference optimization (DPO) on UserAssist-train, and that the resulting bias reliably generalizes to two realistic multi-turn debate datasets spanning philosophical opinions and natural argumentative exchanges on factual/policy topics. These results reveal an underexplored consequence of role-tagged training and provide a principled framework to diagnose and control tag-induced biases in modern LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代大语言模型通常通过使用结构化角色标签来进行训练和部署，这些标签明确指出了每个上下文来源的身份，例如系统、用户、助手、工具等。虽然这些标签对于遵循指令和保持可控性至关重要，但不同角色标签相关的训练数据中的不对称性可能会引入归纳偏差。在本文中，我们通过形式化用户-助手偏见来研究这一现象，该偏见指的是当语言模型在提供关于同一实体的不兼容信息时，倾向于优先依赖来自用户或助手角色的信息。我们引入了一个与任务无关的基准测试UserAssist，并在52个前沿模型中评估了这种偏见。我们发现，大多数经过指令调整的模型表现出强烈的用户偏见，而基础模型和推理模型则接近中性。通过控制性的微调实验，我们确定了哪些训练后的方法导致了观察到的用户-助手偏见。我们发现，人类偏好对齐会加剧用户偏见，而推理微调则可以减少这种偏见。最后，我们证明了可以通过对UserAssist模型进行直接偏好优化，来双向地控制用户-助手偏见。而且，这种调整后的偏见能够可靠地推广到两个现实的多轮辩论数据集，这些数据集涉及哲学观点以及关于事实/政策话题的自然论证交流。这些结果揭示了角色标签训练所带来的一个未被充分探索的后果，并为诊断和控制现代语言模型中的标签诱导偏见提供了一个原则性的框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ICLAD: In-Context Learning with Comparison-Guidance for Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.title_zh: ICLAD：基于对比引导的上下文学习技术，用于深度伪造音频的检测
papers.authors: Benjamin Shiue-Hal Chou, Yi Zhu, Surya Koppisetti
papers.abstract: Audio deepfakes pose a significant security threat, yet current state-of-the-art (SOTA) detection systems do not generalize well to realistic in-the-wild deepfakes. We introduce a novel In-Context Learning paradigm with comparison-guidance for Audio Deepfake detection (ICLAD). The framework enables the use of audio language models (ALMs) for training-free generalization to unseen deepfakes and provides rich textual explanations on the detection outcome. At the core of ICLAD is a pairwise comparative reasoning strategy that guides the ALM to discover and filter hallucinations and deepfake-irrelevant acoustic attributes. The ALM works alongside a specialized deepfake detector, whereby a routing mechanism feeds out-of-distribution samples to the ALM. On in-the-wild datasets, ICLAD improves macro F1 over the specialized detector, with up to 2× relative improvement. Further analysis demonstrates the flexibility of ICLAD and its potential for deployment on recent open-source ALMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 音频深度伪造构成了严重的安全威胁，然而当前最先进的检测系统对于真实的深度伪造样本的识别能力并不强。我们提出了一种基于上下文学习的新型检测方法——ICLAD。该框架能够利用音频语言模型进行无监督训练，从而实现对未见过的深度伪造样本的识别，并且还能提供关于检测结果丰富的文本解释。ICLAD的核心思想是一种成对比较推理策略，该策略引导音频语言模型发现并过滤掉幻觉现象以及与深度伪造无关的声音特征。音频语言模型与专门的深度伪造检测器协同工作，其中路由机制会将不符合标准的样本传递给音频语言模型进行处理。在真实数据集上的实验表明，ICLAD在宏粒度上的F1分数优于传统检测器，其性能提升幅度可达2倍。进一步分析显示，ICLAD具有高度的灵活性，有望应用于最新的开源音频语言模型上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ReStyle-TTS: Relative and Continuous Style Control for Zero-Shot Speech Synthesis
papers.title_zh: ReStyle-TTS：用于零样本语音合成的相对连续风格控制技术
papers.authors: Haitao Li, Chunxiang Jin, Chenglin Li, Wenhao Guan, Zhengxing Huang, Xie Chen
papers.abstract: Zero-shot text-to-speech models can clone a speaker’s timbre from a short reference audio, but they also strongly inherit the speaking style present in the reference. As a result, synthesizing speech with a desired style often requires carefully selecting reference audio, which is impractical when only limited or mismatched references are available. While recent controllable TTS methods attempt to address this issue, they typically rely on absolute style targets and discrete textual prompts, and therefore do not support continuous and reference-relative style control. We propose ReStyle-TTS, a framework that enables continuous and reference-relative style control in zero-shot TTS. Our key insight is that effective style control requires first reducing the model’s implicit dependence on reference style before introducing explicit control mechanisms. To this end, we introduce Decoupled Classifier-Free Guidance (DCFG), which independently controls text and reference guidance, reducing reliance on reference style while preserving text fidelity. On top of this, we apply style-specific LoRAs together with Orthogonal LoRA Fusion to enable continuous and disentangled multi-attribute control, and introduce a Timbre Consistency Optimization module to mitigate timbre drift caused by weakened reference guidance. Experiments show that ReStyle-TTS enables user-friendly, continuous, and relative control over pitch, energy, and multiple emotions while maintaining intelligibility and speaker timbre, and performs robustly in challenging mismatched reference–target style scenarios. Code and data are available in supplementary materials.
papers.abstract_zh: 零样本文本到语音模型能够从一段简短的参考音频中克隆出说话者的音色，但它们也会强烈继承参考音频中的说话风格。因此，要合成具有期望风格的语音，通常需要仔细选择参考音频，而当可用参考音频有限或不匹配时，这种做法是不可行的。虽然最近的一些可控文本到语音方法试图解决这一问题，但它们通常依赖于绝对的风格目标和离散的文本提示，因此无法支持连续且相对于参考音频的风格控制。我们提出了ReStyle-TTS框架，该框架能够实现零样本文本到语音中的连续且相对于参考音频的风格控制。我们的关键见解是，有效的风格控制需要先减少模型对参考风格的隐性依赖，然后再引入显式的控制机制。为此，我们引入了解耦式无分类器引导技术，该技术能够独立控制文本和参考音频的引导方式，从而减少对参考风格的依赖，同时保留文本的忠实度。此外，我们结合了特定风格的LoRAs技术和正交LoRA融合技术，以实现连续且多属性控制的风格调整。我们还引入了一个音色一致性优化模块，以缓解由于参考引导减弱而导致的音色漂移问题。实验表明，ReStyle-TTS能够实现对音高、能量以及多种情绪的连续且相对的控制，同时保持语音的可懂度和说话者的音色特征。在参考音频与目标音频风格不匹配的复杂场景中，该模型也能表现出强大的性能。代码和数据可在补充材料中获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Who Gets Which Message? Auditing Demographic Bias in LLM-Generated Targeted Text
papers.title_zh: 谁会得到哪些消息？检查大型语言模型生成的定向文本中的人口统计偏见问题
papers.authors: Tunazzina Islam
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly capable of generating personalized, persuasive text at scale, raising new questions about bias and fairness in automated communication. This paper presents the first systematic analysis of how LLMs behave when tasked with demographic-conditioned targeted messaging. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework using three leading models: GPT-4o, Llama-3.3, and Mistral-Large-2.1, across two generation settings: Standalone Generation, which isolates intrinsic demographic effects, and Context-Rich Generation, which incorporates thematic and regional context to emulate realistic targeting. We evaluate generated messages along three dimensions: lexical content, language style, and persuasive framing. We instantiate this framework on climate communication and find consistent age- and gender-based asymmetries across models: male- and youth-targeted messages tend to emphasize more assertive and progressive framing, while female- and senior-targeted messages more often reflect warmth, care, and traditional themes. Contextual prompts systematically amplify these disparities, with persuasion scores being higher for male-targeted messages, while age-related differences vary across models. Our findings demonstrate how demographic stereotypes can surface and intensify in LLM-generated targeted communication, underscoring the need for bias-aware generation pipelines and transparent auditing frameworks that explicitly account for demographic conditioning in socially sensitive applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在生成个性化、具有说服力的文本方面能力日益增强，这引发了关于自动化通信中的偏见和公平性的新问题。本文首次系统分析了当语言模型被要求执行基于人口统计条件的定向消息传递任务时的行为表现。我们采用了一个控制性评估框架，使用了三种领先的语言模型：GPT-4o、Llama-3.3和Mistral-Large-2.1。评估方式分为两种场景：独立生成，仅考虑内在的人口统计效应；以及富含上下文的生成，结合主题和地区背景来模拟真实的定向传播效果。我们从三个维度对生成的消息进行了评估：词汇内容、语言风格以及说服性框架。我们在气候沟通领域对这一框架进行了应用测试，发现不同模型之间存在一致的年龄和性别不对称现象：针对男性及年轻人的消息往往强调更果断和进步性的框架；而针对女性及老年人的消息则更多地体现出温暖、关怀和传统主题。上下文提示进一步放大了这些差异，针对男性的消息在说服力上表现更好，而与年龄相关的差异则因模型不同而有所变化。我们的研究结果表明，人口统计刻板印象可能会在语言模型生成的定向通信中显现并加剧，这凸显了在涉及社会敏感问题的应用中，需要采用能够识别偏见并明确考虑人口统计条件生成流程以及透明的审计框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FACTS: Table Summarization via Offline Template Generation with Agentic Workflows
papers.title_zh: 事实：通过离线模板生成来实现数据汇总，并采用代理式工作流程进行处理
papers.authors: Ye Yuan, Mohammad Amin Shabani, Siqi Liu
papers.abstract: Query-focused table summarization requires generating natural language summaries of tabular data conditioned on a user query, enabling users to access insights beyond fact retrieval. Existing approaches face key limitations: table-to-text models require costly fine-tuning and struggle with complex reasoning, prompt-based LLM methods suffer from token-limit and efficiency issues while exposing sensitive data, and prior agentic pipelines often rely on decomposition, planning, or manual templates that lack robustness and scalability. To mitigate these issues, we introduce an agentic workflow, FACTS, a Fast, Accurate, and Privacy-Compliant Table Summarization approach via Offline Template Generation. FACTS produces offline templates, consisting of SQL queries and Jinja2 templates, which can be rendered into natural language summaries and are reusable across multiple tables sharing the same schema. It enables fast summarization through reusable offline templates, accurate outputs with executable SQL queries, and privacy compliance by sending only table schemas to LLMs. Evaluations on widely-used benchmarks show that FACTS consistently outperforms baseline methods, establishing it as a practical solution for real-world query-focused table summarization. Our code is available at https://github.com/BorealisAI/FACTS.
papers.abstract_zh: 以查询为中心的表格摘要生成需要根据用户查询条件，将表格数据转化为自然语言摘要，从而让用户能够获取超出事实检索范围的洞察。现有的方法存在主要局限性：表格到文本模型需要昂贵的微调工作，且难以处理复杂的推理任务；基于提示的LLM方法存在令牌限制和效率问题，同时还会泄露敏感数据；而传统的代理流程通常依赖于分解、规划或手动模板，这些方式缺乏鲁棒性和可扩展性。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了一种代理工作流程——FACTS。这是一种通过离线模板生成来实现快速、准确且符合隐私要求的表格摘要生成方法。FACTS生成的离线模板包括SQL查询和Jinja2模板，这些模板可以转换为自然语言摘要，并且可以在具有相同模式的多个表格之间重复使用。通过可重复使用的离线模板，FACTS能够实现快速摘要生成；通过可执行的SQL查询，实现准确的输出结果；通过仅向LLM发送表格模式，确保符合隐私要求。在广泛使用的基准测试中的评估表明，FACTS始终优于基线方法，使其成为现实世界中以查询为中心的表格摘要生成的实用解决方案。我们的代码可在https://github.com/BorealisAI/FACTS下载。

papers.title: How Language Models Conflate Logical Validity with Plausibility: A Representational Analysis of Content Effects
papers.title_zh: 语言模型如何将逻辑有效性与可信度相结合：对内容效应的表征分析
papers.authors: Leonardo Bertolazzi, Sandro Pezzelle, Raffaella Bernardi
papers.abstract: Both humans and large language models (LLMs) exhibit content effects: biases in which the plausibility of the semantic content of a reasoning problem influences judgments regarding its logical validity. While this phenomenon in humans is best explained by the dual-process theory of reasoning, the mechanisms behind content effects in LLMs remain unclear. In this work, we address this issue by investigating how LLMs encode the concepts of validity and plausibility within their internal representations. We show that both concepts are linearly represented and strongly aligned in representational geometry, leading models to conflate plausibility with validity. Using steering vectors, we demonstrate that plausibility vectors can causally bias validity judgements, and vice versa, and that the degree of alignment between these two concepts predicts the magnitude of behavioral content effects across models. Finally, we construct debiasing vectors that disentangle these concepts, reducing content effects and improving reasoning accuracy. Our findings advance understanding of how abstract logical concepts are represented in LLMs and highlight representational interventions as a path toward more logical systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类和大语言模型都表现出内容效应：即推理问题的语义内容的合理性会影响其对逻辑有效性的判断。虽然这种现象在人类中可以通过双重推理理论来解释，但大语言模型中内容效应背后的机制仍然不清楚。在这项研究中，我们探讨了大语言模型如何在其内部表示中编码“有效性”和“合理性”这两个概念。我们发现，这两个概念在表示上呈线性关联，并且在表示几何结构上高度对齐，导致模型将合理性与有效性混为一谈。通过使用引导向量，我们证明了合理性向量可以因果性地影响有效性判断，反之亦然。此外，这两个概念之间的对齐程度可以预测不同模型之间行为内容效应的大小。最后，我们构建了能够分离这些概念的去偏见向量，从而减少内容效应并提高推理准确性。我们的研究发现有助于理解抽象逻辑概念在大语言模型中的表示方式，并强调了通过表示干预来构建更合理的系统的可能性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LLMs Deceive Unintentionally: Emergent Misalignment in Dishonesty from Misaligned Samples to Biased Human-AI Interactions
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型无意中导致欺骗行为：由于样本偏差而产生的不诚实现象，以及人类与人工智能之间的偏见互动
papers.authors: Xuhao Hu, Wang Peng, Xiaoya Lu, Dongrui Liu, Xuanjing Huang, Jing Shao
papers.abstract: Previous research has shown that LLMs finetuned on incorrect completions within narrow domains (\textit{e.g.}, insecure code or incorrect medical advice) can become broadly misaligned to exhibit harmful behaviors, which is called \textit{emergent misalignment}. In this work, we investigate whether this phenomenon can extend beyond safety behaviors to a broader spectrum of dishonesty and deception under high-stakes scenarios (\textit{e.g.}, lying under pressure and deceptive behavior). To explore this, we finetune open-sourced LLMs on misaligned completions across diverse domains. Experimental results demonstrate that LLMs show broadly misaligned behavior in dishonesty. Additionally, we further explore this phenomenon in a downstream combined finetuning setting, and find that introducing as little as 1% of misalignment data into a standard downstream task is sufficient to decrease honest behavior over 20%. Furthermore, we consider a more practical human-AI interaction environment where we simulate both benign and biased users to interact with the assistant LLM. Furthermore, we simulate both benign and biased users to interact with the assistant LLM, producing 20k trajectories for self-training in a more practical human-AI interaction environment. Notably, we find that the assistant model can be misaligned unintentionally to exacerbate its dishonesty with only 10% biased user population. In summary, we extend the study of \textit{emergent misalignment} to the domain of dishonesty under high-stakes scenarios, and highlight that this risk arises not only through direct finetuning, but also in downstream mixture tasks and human-AI interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前的研究表明，如果在狭窄领域中对大语言模型进行微调时使用了错误的补全数据（例如，不安全的代码或错误的医疗建议），那么这些模型可能会表现出严重的偏差行为，这种现象被称为“涌现的偏差”。在这项研究中，我们探讨了这一现象是否会扩展到更广泛的欺骗和不诚实行为中，尤其是在高风险场景下（例如，在压力下撒谎和欺骗行为）。为了验证这一点，我们对开源大语言模型进行了微调，使其在处理不同领域的错误补全数据时表现出偏差行为。实验结果表明，大语言模型在涉及不诚实行为的任务中确实表现出明显的偏差行为。此外，我们还在一个后续的混合微调环境中进一步研究了这一现象，发现只需在标准下游任务中加入1%的偏差数据，就能使诚实行为减少20%以上。更重要的是，我们考虑了一个更实际的人机交互环境，在这个环境中，我们模拟了善良和偏颇的用户与辅助大语言模型之间的互动。我们生成了2万条轨迹数据进行自我训练，以更真实地模拟人机交互场景。值得注意的是，即使只有10%的用户具有偏颇行为，辅助模型仍可能出现无意中的偏差，从而加剧其不诚实行为。总之，我们将“涌现的偏差”研究扩展到了高风险场景下的不诚实行为领域，并强调这种风险不仅源于直接的微调过程，还存在于下游的混合任务和人机交互中。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AlphaQuanter: An End-to-End Tool-Augmented Agentic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Stock Trading
papers.title_zh: AlphaQuanter：一种端到端工具辅助的代理强化学习框架，适用于股票交易领域
papers.authors: Zheye Deng, Weixiang Yan, Changlong Yu, Jiashu Wang
papers.abstract: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents show promise in automated trading, they still face critical limitations. Prominent multi-agent frameworks often suffer from inefficiency, produce inconsistent signals, and lack the end-to-end optimization required to learn a coherent strategy from market feedback. To address this, we introduce AlphaQuanter, a single-agent framework that uses reinforcement learning (RL) to learn a dynamic policy over a transparent, tool-augmented decision workflow, which empowers a single agent to autonomously orchestrate tools and proactively acquire information on demand, establishing a transparent reasoning process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AlphaQuanter achieves state-of-the-art performance on key financial metrics. Besides, human evaluation shows the learned reasoning patterns reveal more faithful and coherent tool-usage behaviors, providing steps toward verifiable LLM-driven trading. Our code and data can be found at https://github.com/horizon-llm/AlphaQuanter.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型代理在自动化交易方面展现出巨大潜力，但它们仍然面临一些关键限制。目前常见的多智能体框架往往效率低下，产生的信号也不一致，且缺乏从市场反馈中学习连贯策略所需的端到端优化能力。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了AlphaQuanter这一单代理框架。该框架利用强化学习技术，通过透明的、以工具为辅助的决策流程，让单个代理能够自主地调度各种工具，并根据需求主动获取信息，从而建立一种透明的推理机制。大量实验表明，AlphaQuanter在关键财务指标上取得了卓越的性能。此外，人类评估结果显示，其学习到的推理模式能够更真实地反映工具使用的规律，这为基于语言模型的自动化交易提供了可能。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/horizon-llm/AlphaQuanter网站上找到。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Distribution Shift Alignment Helps LLMs Simulate Survey Response Distributions
papers.title_zh: 分布偏移的调整有助于大型语言模型模拟调查回答的分布情况
papers.authors: Ji Huang, Mengfei LI, Shuai Shao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising way to simulate human survey responses, potentially reducing the cost of large-scale data collection. However, existing zero-shot methods suffer from prompt sensitivity and low accuracy, while conventional fine-tuning approaches mostly fit the training set distributions and struggle to produce results more accurate than the training set itself, which deviates from the original goal of using LLMs to simulate survey responses. Building on this observation, we introduce Distribution Shift Alignment (DSA), a two-stage fine-tuning method that aligns both the output distributions and the distribution shifts across different backgrounds. By learning how these distributions change rather than fitting training data, DSA can provide results substantially closer to the true distribution than the training data. Empirically, DSA consistently outperforms other methods on five public survey datasets. We further conduct a comprehensive comparison covering accuracy, robustness, and data savings. DSA reduces the required real data by 53.48-69.12%, demonstrating its effectiveness and efficiency in survey simulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型为模拟人类调查回答提供了有前景的方法，有望降低大规模数据收集的成本。然而，现有的零样本方法存在提示敏感性问题，且准确率较低。而传统的微调方法则主要适应训练集的分布特征，难以产生比训练集本身更精确的结果，这违背了使用大语言模型来模拟调查回答的初衷。基于这一观察，我们提出了分布偏移对齐算法——一种两阶段微调方法，它能够同时调整不同背景下的输出分布以及分布偏移情况。通过学习这些分布的变化规律，而非仅仅拟合训练数据，DSA能够得出更接近真实分布的结果。从实验来看，DSA在五个公开的调查数据集上的表现始终优于其他方法。我们还进行了全面的比较，包括准确性、鲁棒性以及数据节省方面的表现。结果表明，DSA能够将所需的真实数据量减少53.48%到69.12%，充分体现了其在调查模拟中的高效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PhysPRM: A Generative Process Reward Model with Fine-grained Diagnosis for Physics Problem Solving
papers.title_zh: PhysPRM：一种基于生成式过程的奖励模型，能够针对物理问题提供精细化的诊断结果，从而帮助解决问题
papers.authors: Yuxuan Dong, Xinyu Zhang, Lingling Zhang, Han Lai, Pengyu Li, Bifan Wei, Yaqiang Wu, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: Despite the remarkable progress of Large Language Models (LLMs) in abstract reasoning tasks, they continue to struggle with physics problem solving due to difficulties in decoding implicit constraints and maintaining physical consistency. To address these challenges, Process Reward Models (PRMs) have emerged as a promising approach to verify intermediate reasoning steps. Existing PRMs attempt to mitigate reasoning errors but typically rely on scalar scoring, which lacks the explanatory power necessary to diagnose complex physical misconceptions. In this work, we introduce PhysPRM, a Generative PRM that treats evaluation as a generative task to produce fine-grained diagnoses comprising critiques, final judgments, and specific error types. To facilitate this, we develop an automated data synthesis pipeline to construct PhysPRM30K, a comprehensive training dataset, and PhysProcessBench, a rigorously human-verified benchmark. By employing a two-stage training paradigm that integrates Supervised Fine-Tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization, PhysPRM significantly enhances the physics reasoning capabilities of various LLMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysPRM improves performance across seven benchmarks in both Best-of-N and critique refinement strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在抽象推理任务上取得了显著进展，但在物理问题求解方面仍然存在困难，因为它们难以解码隐含的约束条件并保持物理一致性。为了应对这些挑战，过程奖励模型作为一种有前景的方法被提出来，用于验证中间的推理步骤。现有的过程奖励模型试图减少推理错误，但它们通常依赖于标量评分方式，这种方式缺乏诊断复杂物理概念错误所需的解释力。在这项研究中，我们提出了PhysPRM，这是一种生成式过程奖励模型，它将评估视为一个生成任务，从而能够产生包含批评意见、最终判断以及具体错误类型的详细诊断结果。为了实现这一目标，我们开发了一个自动数据合成流程，以构建PhysPRM30K这一全面的训练数据集，以及PhysProcessBench这一经过严格人工验证的基准测试集。通过采用一种两阶段训练范式，结合监督微调与群体相对策略优化技术，PhysPRM显著提升了各种大语言模型的物理推理能力。大量实验表明，PhysPRM在七个基准测试中的表现都有所提升，无论是在最佳结果选择还是批评意见细化方面都是如此。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Mark Fades: Adaptive Evolutionary Paraphrase-based Attack against LLM Watermarks
papers.title_zh: 标记逐渐消失：针对大语言模型水印的适应性进化式改写攻击
papers.authors: Yusheng Zhao, Jian Zhao, Tianle Zhang, Feng Wei, Xuelong Li
papers.abstract: While LLM watermarking is essential for machine- generated content identification, existing paraphrase-based attacks struggle to balance watermark removal efficacy with text quality. We propose TSAPA, a training-free evolutionary framework that models watermark removal as a constrained multi-objective optimization problem. By leveraging genetic algorithms to navigate the Pareto front, TSAPA utilizes a Pseudo-Log-Likelihood (PLL)-guided mutation to precisely target and modify watermark-carrying tokens. Experiments on Qwen3 series (1.7B/8B/32B) across multiple watermark schemes show that TSAPA achieves over 90% attack success rate (ASR) while maintaining high text semantic fidelity, significantly outperforming baselines methods. This work exposes critical vulnerabilities in current watermarks and provides a new perspective for robust evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型水印技术对于识别机器生成的内容至关重要，但现有的基于改写攻击的方法在平衡水印去除效果与文本质量方面存在困难。我们提出了TSAPA这一无需训练的进化框架，它将水印去除问题建模为一个具有约束的多目标优化问题。通过利用遗传算法在帕累托前沿上移动，TSAPA采用伪对数似然法指导变异操作，从而精确定位并修改携带水印的字符。在Qwen3系列模型（1.7B/8B/32B规模）上进行的实验表明，TSAPA在保持高文本语义保真度的同时，实现了超过90%的攻击成功率，其性能显著优于现有基线方法。这项工作揭示了当前水印技术的关键漏洞，并为构建更强大的评估体系提供了新的思路。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CoRE: A Fine-Grained Code Reasoning Benchmark Beyond Output Prediction
papers.title_zh: CoRE：一种超越输出预测的细粒度代码推理基准测试
papers.authors: Jun Gao, Yun Peng, Qian Qiao, Changhai Zhou, Yuhua Zhou, Shiyang Zhang, Shichao Weng, Zhenchang Xing, Xiaoxue Ren
papers.abstract: Despite strong performance on code generation tasks, it remains unclear whether large language models (LLMs) genuinely reason about code execution. Existing code reasoning benchmarks primarily evaluate final output correctness under a single canonical implementation, leaving two critical aspects underexplored: (1) whether LLMs predictions are consistent to functionally equivalent implementations, and (2) whether LLMs can accurately reason about intermediate execution states. We introduce CoRE, a Code Reasoning benchmark that evaluates code reasoning through implementation invariance and process transparency. Extensive evaluations on eight frontier LLMs reveal two fundamental limitations. First, models exhibit a substantial robustness gap, with performance varying significantly across equivalent implementations. Second, we observe superficial execution, where models arrive at correct final outputs without correctly reasoning about intermediate execution states. Together, these findings demonstrate that output-only evaluations are insufficient for assessing code reasoning and position CoRE as a necessary benchmark for evaluating robust and faithful code reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在代码生成任务上表现优异，但目前仍不清楚大语言模型是否能够真正理解代码执行过程。现有的代码推理基准测试主要评估单一规范实现下的最终输出正确性，而忽略了两个关键方面：(1) 模型预测与功能等效的实现是否一致；(2) 模型能否准确理解中间执行状态。我们提出了CoRE这一代码推理基准测试，它通过实现不变性和过程透明性来评估代码推理能力。对八种前沿语言模型的广泛测试表明，存在两个基本问题。首先，模型表现出显著的鲁棒性差距，即在功能等效的实现中，模型的表现差异很大。其次，我们发现模型在得出正确的最终输出时，往往未能正确理解中间执行状态。这些发现表明，仅基于输出的评估方式不足以评估代码推理能力，因此CoRE作为评估稳健且准确的代码推理能力的必要基准测试显得尤为重要。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Empowering Reliable Visual-Centric Instruction Following in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: 在混合整数线性规划问题中实现可靠的以视觉为中心的操作指导
papers.authors: Weilei He, Feng Ju, Zhiyuan Fan, Rui Min, Minhao Cheng
papers.abstract: Evaluating the instruction-following (IF) capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is essential for rigorously assessing how faithfully model outputs adhere to user-specified intentions. Nevertheless, existing benchmarks for evaluating MLLMs’ instruction-following capability primarily focus on verbal instructions in the textual modality. These limitations hinder a thorough analysis of instruction-following capabilities, as they overlook the implicit constraints embedded in the semantically rich visual modality. To address this gap, we introduce VC-IFEval, a new benchmark accompanied by a systematically constructed dataset that evaluates MLLMs’ instruction-following ability under multimodal settings. Our benchmark systematically incorporates vision-dependent constraints into instruction design, enabling a more rigorous and fine-grained assessment of how well MLLMs align their outputs with both visual input and textual instructions. Furthermore, by fine-tuning MLLMs on our dataset, we achieve substantial gains in visual instruction-following accuracy and adherence. Through extensive evaluation across representative MLLMs, we provide new insights into the strengths and limitations of current models.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估多模态大语言模型在遵循指令方面的能力，对于严格评估模型的输出是否忠实于用户指定的意图至关重要。然而，目前用于评估多模态大语言模型遵循指令能力的基准测试，主要关注的是文本形式的口头指令。这些限制阻碍了对遵循指令能力的全面分析，因为它们忽略了语义丰富的视觉信息中所隐含的约束条件。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了VC-IFEval这一新的基准测试，该测试附带了一个系统构建的数据集，可以在多模态环境下评估多模态大语言模型的遵循指令能力。我们的基准测试系统地将依赖于视觉的信息纳入指令设计中，从而能够更严格、更细致地评估多模态大语言模型如何使其输出与视觉输入和文本指令保持一致。此外，通过在我们的数据集上对多模态大语言模型进行微调，我们在视觉指令的遵循准确性和一致性方面取得了显著改进。通过对代表性多模态大语言模型进行广泛评估，我们获得了关于当前模型优缺点的最新见解。

papers.title: TT-SI: Self-Improving LLM Agents with Test-Time Training
papers.title_zh: TT-SI：具有测试时训练的自主改进型大语言模型智能体
papers.authors: Emre Can Acikgoz, Cheng Qian, Heng Ji, Dilek Hakkani-Tür, Gokhan Tur
papers.abstract: One paradigm of language model (LM) fine-tuning relies on creating large training datasets, under the assumption that high quantity and diversity will enable models to generalize to novel tasks after post-training. In practice, gathering large sets of data is inefficient, and training on them is prohibitively expensive; worse, there is no guarantee that the resulting model will handle complex scenarios or generalize better. Moreover, existing techniques rarely assess whether a training sample provides novel information, resulting in unnecessary costs. In this work, we explore a new Test-Time Self-Improvement (TT-SI) algorithm to create more effective and generalizable agentic LMs on-the-fly. TT-SI can be summarized in three steps: (i) first it identifies the samples that model struggles with (self-awareness), (ii) then generates similar examples from detected uncertain samples (self-data augmentation), and (iii) uses these newly generated samples at test-time training (self-improvement). We further explore Test-Time Distillation (TT-D), which leverages a stronger supervisor for targeted data generation. Empirical evaluations across different agent benchmarks demonstrate that TT-SI improves the performance with +5.48% absolute accuracy gain on average across all benchmarks and surpasses other standard learning methods more efficiently. Our findings highlight the promise of TT-SI, demonstrating the potential of self-improvement algorithms at test-time as a new paradigm for building more capable agents toward self-evolution.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型微调的一种范式是创建大型训练数据集，其前提是大量且多样化的数据能够帮助模型在训练后泛化到新的任务中。但实际上，收集大量数据效率低下，而基于这些数据进行训练的成本又非常高昂；更糟糕的是，无法保证得到的模型能够处理复杂的场景或具备更好的泛化能力。此外，现有的技术很少评估训练样本是否提供了新颖的信息，从而导致不必要的成本浪费。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新的测试时自我改进算法，以实时创建更有效且更具泛化能力的智能语言模型。该算法可以分为三个步骤：(i) 首先识别模型难以处理的样本（自我感知），(ii) 然后从检测到的不确定样本中生成类似的示例（自我数据增强），(iii) 在测试时使用这些新生成的样本进行训练（自我改进）。我们还研究了测试时蒸馏技术，该技术利用更强的监督器来生成有针对性的数据。通过在不同智能体基准测试中的实证评估表明，测试时自我改进算法平均提升了5.48%的绝对准确率，并且比其他标准学习方法表现得更为出色。我们的研究结果凸显了测试时自我改进算法的潜力，证明了在测试时运用自我改进算法作为构建更强大智能体的新范式具有巨大前景。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Conflicts Make Large Reasoning Models Vulnerable to Attacks
papers.title_zh: 冲突使得这些复杂的推理模型容易受到攻击
papers.authors: Honghao Liu, Chengjin Xu, Xuhui Jiang, Cehao Yang, Shengming Yin, Zhengwu Ma, Lionel Ni, Jian Guo
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable performance across diverse domains, yet their decision-making under conflicting objectives remains insufficiently understood. This work investigates how LRMs respond to harmful queries when confronted with two categories of conflicts: internal conflicts that pit alignment values against each other and dilemmas, which impose mutually contradictory choices, including sacrificial, duress, agent-centered, and social forms. Using over 1,300 prompts across five benchmarks, we evaluate three representative LRMs - Llama-3.1-Nemotron-8B, QwQ-32B, and DeepSeek R1 - and find that conflicts significantly increase attack success rates, even under single-round non-narrative queries without sophisticated auto-attack techniques. Our findings reveal through layerwise and neuron-level analyses that safety-related and functional representations shift and overlap under conflict, interfering with safety-aligned behavior. This study highlights the need for deeper alignment strategies to ensure the robustness and trustworthiness of next-generation reasoning models. Our code is available at https://github.com/DataArcTech/ConflictHarm. Warning: This paper contains inappropriate, offensive and harmful content.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在多个领域都取得了显著的性能表现，然而它们在面临冲突目标时的决策机制仍然缺乏深入的理解。本研究探讨了当大型推理模型面对两类冲突时如何应对有害的查询：一种是使对齐值相互对立的内部冲突，另一种是带来相互矛盾选择的困境，这些困境包括牺牲性、胁迫性、以代理为中心的以及社会性的选择。通过五个基准测试中的1300多个提示，我们对三种代表性的大型推理模型——Llama-3.1-Nemotron-8B、QwQ-32B和DeepSeek R1进行了评估。研究发现，即使在没有复杂自动攻击技术的单轮非叙事查询中，冲突也会显著增加攻击的成功率。我们的研究还通过逐层分析和神经元级别的分析发现，在冲突情况下，与安全相关的功能表征会发生偏移和重叠，这会干扰安全对齐的行为。这项研究强调了需要更深入的对齐策略来确保下一代推理模型的稳健性和可信度。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/DataArcTech/ConflictHarm获取。警告：本文包含不适当、冒犯性和有害的内容。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Linear Script Representations in Speech Foundation Models Enable Zero-Shot Transliteration
papers.title_zh: 在语音基础模型中，线性脚本表示方式能够实现零样本翻译功能
papers.authors: Ryan Soh-Eun Shim, Kwanghee Choi, Kalvin Chang, Ming-Hao Hsu, Florian Eichin, Zhizheng Wu, Alane Suhr, Michael A. Hedderich, David Harwath, David R. Mortensen, Barbara Plank
papers.abstract: Multilingual speech foundation models such as Whisper are trained on web-scale data, where data for each language consists of a myriad of regional varieties. However, different regional varieties often employ different scripts to write the same language, rendering speech recognition output also subject to non-determinism in the output script. To mitigate this problem, we show that script is linearly encoded in the activation space of multilingual speech models, and that modifying activations at inference time enables direct control over output script. We find the addition of such script vectors to activations at test time can induce script change even in unconventional language-script pairings (e.g. Italian in Cyrillic and Japanese in Latin script). We apply this approach to inducing post-hoc control over the script of speech recognition output, where we observe competitive performance across all model sizes of Whisper.
papers.abstract_zh: 像Whisper这样的多语言语音基础模型是在大规模数据上训练的，每种语言的数据都包含大量的地区变体。然而，不同的地区变体通常使用不同的文字来书写同一种语言，这就导致语音识别的输出结果也会受到不同文字的影响而变得不确定。为了缓解这个问题，我们发现可以在多语言语音模型的激活空间中线性编码文字信息，并且在推理过程中修改激活值可以直接控制输出的文字内容。我们发现，在测试时向激活值中添加这样的文字向量，甚至可以在不常用的文字组合情况下也能实现文字的更改（例如，用西里尔字母表示意大利语，用拉丁字母表示日语）。我们将这种方法应用于对语音识别输出的文字内容进行事后控制，结果发现无论Whisper模型的规模如何，我们的方法都能取得相当不错的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: NSL-MT: Linguistically Informed Negative Samples for Efficient Machine Translation in African Low-Resource Languages
papers.title_zh: NSL-MT：基于语言信息的负面样本，旨在实现非洲那些资源匮乏的语言的高效机器翻译
papers.authors: Mamadou K. Keita, Christopher Homan, Huy Le
papers.abstract: We introduce negative space learning machine translation (NSL-MT), a training method for underresourced languages, that augments limited parallel data with synthetically generated violations of the target language’s grammar and explicitly penalizes the model when it assigns high probability to these linguistically invalid outputs. NSL-MT delivers improvements across all baselines we tested, including 3-12% BLEU gains for well-performing models and 56-89% gains for models lacking decent initial support. Furthermore, NSL-MT provides a 5x data efficiency multiplier: training with 1,000 examples matches or exceeds normal training with 5,000 examples. NSL-MT thus provides a data-efficient alternative training method for settings where parallel data is limited.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了负空间学习机器翻译（NSL-MT）这一针对资源匮乏语言的语言模型训练方法。该方法通过合成生成的、违反目标语言语法的数据来补充有限的平行数据，并明确对模型进行惩罚，当模型将高概率分配给这些语言上无效的输出时。在我们测试的所有基准测试中，NSL-MT都取得了显著的改进效果：对于表现良好的模型，BLEU得分提高了3-12%；而对于那些初始支持不足的模型，则提升了56-89%。此外，NSL-MT还实现了5倍的数据使用效率提升：使用1000个样本进行训练的效果，相当于或超过了使用5000个样本进行训练的效果。因此，在平行数据有限的情况下，NSL-MT提供了一种高效利用数据的替代训练方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EduMARS: Can Vision-Language Models Grade Like Teachers? Benchmarking Multimodal, Rubric-Based Assessment on Chinese K-12 Answers
papers.title_zh: EduMARS：视觉语言模型能否像教师一样进行评分？在中文K-12教育环境中对多模态、基于评分标准的评估方法进行对比测试
papers.authors: Xuan Zhao, Jiashun Chen, Wanting xu, Huiyuan Yan, Chaowei Fang, Xing Wei
papers.abstract: Automated grading of student work is a critical application of AI in education. However, existing benchmarks fall short in evaluating models on realistic, cognitively demanding tasks. Most rely on synthetic, well-structured text inputs, overlooking the multimodal, error-prone, and often handwritten nature of real student responses, especially in K-12 settings. We introduce EduMARS, a multimodal benchmark designed for rubric-aligned evaluation of real Chinese K-12 student answers. The dataset contains over 4,500 authentic responses from high-stakes exams across eight subjects, featuring noisy handwriting,mixed-layout diagrams,mathematical expressions, and narrative reasoning. Each response is meticulously annotated by expert teachers using step-wise scoring rubrics, error classifications, and key-point mappings, providing fine-grained supervision aligned with real-world pedagogical practices. We evaluated existing SOTA MLLMs across the dimensions of final score and the reasoning process of grading, reveals a significant gap between existing SOTA MLLMs and human-level performance. To bridge this performance gap, we propose the Retrieval-Augmented Adaptive-Rubric Grading (RARG), enabling models to emulate expert grading logic by dynamically synthesizing case-specific evaluation schemas. RARG effectively enhances the performance and interpretability of various MLLMs on EduMARS, surpassing in-context learning and chain-of-thought.
papers.abstract_zh: 学生作业的自动化评分是人工智能在教育领域的重要应用。然而，现有的评估基准在评估模型处理现实、需要高度认知能力的任务时存在不足。大多数基准都依赖于合成化的、结构良好的文本输入，而忽略了真实学生回答的多模态性、易出错性以及通常的手写形式，尤其是在K-12教育环境中。我们提出了EduMARS这一多模态基准测试，旨在对真实的汉语K-12学生回答进行与评分标准一致的评估。该数据集包含来自八门学科的高风险考试的4500多份真实回答，这些回答包括字迹潦草、布局复杂的图表、数学表达式以及叙述性推理等内容。每份回答都由专家教师通过分步骤的评分标准、错误分类和关键点映射进行细致标注，从而提供与现实世界教学实践相一致的精细监督。我们对现有的最先进的MLLM模型进行了评估，从最终得分和评分过程的推理能力两个维度进行了比较，发现现有最先进的MLLM模型与人类水平的表现之间存在显著差距。为了弥补这一性能差距，我们提出了检索增强式自适应评分法（RARG），该方法使模型能够动态生成针对特定情况的评估方案，从而模仿专家级的评分逻辑。RARG有效提升了各种MLLM模型在EduMARS上的表现和可解释性，其效果优于上下文学习和思维链方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MMR-GRPO: Accelerating GRPO-Style Training through Diversity-Aware Reward Reweighting
papers.title_zh: MMR-GRPO：通过考虑多样性因素来重新调整奖励权重，从而加速GRPO式训练的进行
papers.authors: Kangda Wei, Ruihong Huang
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a standard approach for training mathematical reasoning models; however, GRPO training is computationally intensive and usually takes a long time, which consumes substantial computational resources and creates barriers for academic researchers and smaller organizations with limited GPU budgets. In this paper, we propose MMR-GRPO to accelerate GRPO training and reduce the overall training time required to reach peak performance, and the approach adopts Maximal Marginal Relevanceto reweigh rewards of multiple rollouts by balancing rollout quality with diversity to reduce rollout redundancy. The rationale is that redundant or similar completions, if repeatedly used to train a model, will create an “exploitation trap” and slow down model convergence in GRPO style reinforcement learning. Extensive evaluations across three model sizes (1.5B, 7B, 8B), three GRPO variants, and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that MMR-GRPO achieves comparable peak performance while requiring on average 47.9% fewer training steps and 70.2% less wall-clock time. These gains are consistent across models, methods, and benchmarks. Our code is released at: https://github.com/WeiKangda/MMR-GRPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 群体相对策略优化（GRPO）已成为训练数学推理模型的标准方法。然而，GRPO的训练过程计算量巨大，耗时较长，这会消耗大量的计算资源，同时也会给那些预算有限的学术研究人员和小规模组织带来困难。在本文中，我们提出了MMR-GRPO方法来加速GRPO训练，减少达到最佳性能所需的整体训练时间。该方法采用最大边际相关性原则来重新分配多个尝试的奖励权重，通过平衡尝试的质量和多样性来减少重复尝试的情况。其原理是，如果重复使用相同或类似的完成结果来训练模型，就会形成“利用陷阱”，从而减缓GRPO风格强化学习中的模型收敛速度。通过对三种模型规模（15亿、70亿、80亿）、三种GRPO变体以及五种数学推理基准进行测试，我们发现MMR-GRPO在保持相当好的性能的同时，平均需要的训练步骤减少了47.9%，计算时间也减少了70.2%。这些优势在不同模型、方法和基准测试中都是一致的。我们的代码可以在以下链接下载：https://github.com/WeiKangda/MMR-GRPO。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: StoryMI: Steerable Multi-Agent Therapeutic Dialogue Generation
papers.title_zh: StoryMI：可操控的多智能体治疗性对话生成系统
papers.authors: Qingyu Meng, Min Chen, Dingming Liu, Yifan Mo, Yue Su, Xin Sun, Koen Hindriks, Jiahuan Pei
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent dialogue, but prior works lack situational grounding, dynamic strategy control, and evaluation aligned with clinical standards in motivational interviewing (MI). We introduce StoryMI, a multi-LLM agent framework for controllable MI dialogue generation, where questionnaire-based client profiles are expanded into situational stories that provide narrative context for the dialogue. Therapist and client agents generate MI-coded utterances guided by MI codes selected by the interaction agent, while an interaction agent dynamically coordinates exchanges to control MI strategies during a multi-turn conversation. We propose a two-level evaluation protocol: lexical metrics and MI-specific measures of macro-level counseling strategies, alongside LLM-as-judge and human expert assessments. We construct a dataset of 6K simulated MI dialogues grounded in 1K questionnaire-story pairs, covering 12 MI codes and 13 symptom domains, and benchmark six open- and closed-source LLMs. Our results show that situational grounding and macro-level control can improve MI adherence and clinical plausibility, demonstrating the effectiveness of a structured multi-agent workflow for psychotherapy dialogue generation. We provide code and data for reproducibility.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够生成流畅的对话，但现有的研究缺乏情境性基础、动态策略控制能力，以及符合临床标准的动机访谈评估机制。我们提出了StoryMI这一多语言模型代理框架，用于生成可控的动机访谈对话。该框架将基于问卷的客户信息转化为情境故事，为对话提供叙事背景。治疗师和客户代理根据互动代理选定的动机访谈编码规则生成对话内容，而互动代理则负责动态协调对话流程，以控制多轮对话中的动机访谈策略。我们提出了一种双层次的评估方案：词汇指标和针对宏观咨询策略的动机访谈特定指标，同时采用语言模型自评估与人类专家评估相结合的方式。我们构建了一个包含6K模拟动机访谈对话的数据集，这些对话基于1K对问卷-故事的配对数据，涵盖了12种动机访谈编码规则和13个症状领域。我们还对六种开源和闭源语言模型进行了基准测试。结果表明，情境性基础和宏观层面的控制能力可以提高动机访谈的依从性和临床合理性，这表明结构化的多智能体工作流程在心理治疗对话生成中具有显著效果。我们提供了代码和数据，以便其他研究人员进行复现研究。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Disambiguation-Centric Finetuning Makes Enterprise Tool-Calling LLMs More Realistic and Less Risky
papers.title_zh: 以去歧义化为核心的微调技术，使得用于调用企业工具的大型语言模型更加实用，同时也降低了使用这些模型的潜在风险
papers.authors: Ashutosh Hathidara, Julien Yu, Sebastian Schreiber
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tasked with invoking enterprise APIs, yet they routinely falter when near-duplicate tools vie for the same user intent or when required arguments are left underspecified. We introduce DiaFORGE (Dialogue Framework for Organic Response Generation Evaluation), a disambiguation-centric, three-stage pipeline that (i) synthesizes persona-driven, multi-turn dialogues in which the assistant must distinguish among highly similar tools, (ii) performs supervised fine-tuning of open-source models with reasoning traces across 3B - 70B parameters, and (iii) evaluates real-world readiness via a dynamic suite that redeploys each model in a live agentic loop and reports end-to-end goal completion alongside conventional static metrics. On our dynamic benchmark DiaBENCH, models trained with DiaFORGE raise tool-invocation success by 27 pp over GPT-4o and by 49 pp over Claude-3.5-Sonnet, both under optimized prompting. To spur further research, we release an open corpus of 5000 production-grade enterprise API specifications paired with rigorously validated, disambiguation-focused dialogues, offering a practical blueprint for building reliable, enterprise-ready tool-calling agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在调用企业API方面发挥着越来越重要的作用，然而当几乎相同的工具争夺同一用户的意图时，或者当所需的参数描述不够明确时，这些模型往往会遇到困难。我们提出了DiaFORGE（用于有机响应生成评估的对话框架），这是一种以消歧义为核心的三阶段流程：首先，该流程能够生成由用户角色驱动的多轮对话，使助手能够在高度相似的工具之间进行区分；其次，它能够对开源模型进行有监督的微调，处理参数范围从3B到70B的参数；最后，该流程通过动态测试来评估模型的实际应用能力，让每个模型在实时对话循环中重新部署，并同时提供端到端的完成指标以及传统的静态评估指标。在我们的动态基准测试DiaBENCH中，使用DiaFORGE训练的模型在调用工具方面的成功率比GPT-4o高出27个百分点，比Claude-3.5-Sonnet高出49个百分点。为了促进进一步的研究，我们发布了一个包含5000个生产级企业API规范的开放语料库，这些规范都伴随着经过严格验证的、以消歧义为中心的对话内容，为构建可靠、适用于企业的工具调用代理提供了实用的蓝图。

papers.title: ToolGate: Contract-Grounded and Verified Tool Execution for LLMs
papers.title_zh: ToolGate：基于合同驱动的、可验证的大型语言模型工具执行机制
papers.authors: Yanming Liu, Xinyue Peng, Jiannan Cao, Xinyi Wang, Songhang Deng, Jintao Chen, Jianwei Yin, Xuhong Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) augmented with external tools have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex reasoning tasks. However, existing frameworks rely heavily on natural language reasoning to determine when tools can be invoked and whether their results should be committed, lacking formal guarantees for logical safety and verifiability. We present ToolGate, a forward execution framework that provides logical safety guarantees and verifiable state evolution for LLM tool calling. ToolGate maintains an explicit symbolic state space as a typed key-value mapping representing trusted world information throughout the reasoning process. Each tool is formalized as a Hoare-style contract consisting of a precondition and a postcondition, where the precondition gates tool invocation by checking whether the current state satisfies the required conditions, and the postcondition determines whether the tool’s result can be committed to update the state through runtime verification. Our approach guarantees that the symbolic state evolves only through verified tool executions, preventing invalid or hallucinated results from corrupting the world representation. Experimental validation demonstrates that ToolGate significantly improves the reliability and verifiability of tool-augmented LLM systems while maintaining competitive performance on complex multi-step reasoning tasks. This work establishes a foundation for building more trustworthy and debuggable AI systems that integrate language models with external tools.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通过外部工具的增强，在复杂的推理任务中展现出了卓越的能力。然而，现有的框架主要依赖自然语言推理来判断何时可以调用工具以及其结果是否应该被保存，缺乏关于逻辑安全性和可验证性的正式保障。我们提出了ToolGate这一前向执行框架，它为LLM工具调用提供了逻辑安全保障和可验证的状态演化机制。ToolGate维护了一个明确的符号状态空间，以类型化的键值映射形式表示整个推理过程中的可信世界信息。每个工具都被形式化为一种Hoare风格的契约，包括前置条件和后置条件：前置条件通过检查当前状态是否满足要求的条件来启动工具调用，而后置条件则决定了工具的结果是否可以通过运行时验证来更新状态。我们的方法确保符号状态只能通过经过验证的工具执行来演化，从而防止无效或幻觉的结果破坏世界表示。实验验证表明，ToolGate显著提高了工具增强型LLM系统的可靠性和可验证性，同时还能在复杂的多步骤推理任务中保持竞争力。这项工作为构建更可靠且易于调试的AI系统奠定了基础，这些系统能够将语言模型与外部工具相结合。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PersonaArena: Dynamic Simulation for Evaluating and Enhancing Persona-Level Role-Playing in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 人物竞技场：一种动态模拟方法，用于评估和改进大型语言模型中的角色扮演功能
papers.authors: Wenlong Shi, Jianxun Lian, Mingqi Wu, Haiming Qin, Mingyang Zhou, Xing Xie, Naipeng Chao, Hao Liao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as interactive social agents, yet their ability to maintain coherent and authentic persona-level role-playing remains limited, particularly in realistic social scenarios. Existing research predominantly focuses on character-level settings and relies on static evaluation formats, failing to capture the complexity of everyday social interactions. In this work, we present PersonaArena, a dynamic simulation framework for evaluating and improving persona-level role-playing in LLMs. PersonaArena leverages a large, filtered corpus of user-generated social content to construct a nuanced persona bank, and elicits multi-turn, context-rich interactions within simulated social environments. Our framework features a multi-agent debating judge for holistic and unbiased assessment. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that PersonaArena enables rigorous evaluation and enhancement of LLMs’ role-playing capabilities, advancing the development of more authentic and socially adept AI agents. Our codes and long appendix are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PersonaArena-B323/.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地充当交互式社交代理，但它们在保持连贯且真实的人物角色扮演能力方面仍然存在局限性，尤其是在现实社交场景中。现有的研究主要集中在角色层面，并依赖静态评估方式，无法捕捉到日常社交互动的复杂性。在这项研究中，我们提出了PersonaArena这一动态模拟框架，用于评估和提升LLMs的人物角色扮演能力。PersonaArena利用大量经过筛选的用户生成社交内容来构建细致的人物档案库，并在模拟的社交环境中进行多轮、内容丰富的互动。我们的框架采用了多智能体辩论机制，以实现全面且无偏见的评估。通过广泛的实验验证，我们发现PersonaArena能够严格评估并提升LLMs的角色扮演能力，从而推动更真实、更善于社交的人工智能代理的发展。我们的代码和详细附录可访问https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PersonaArena-B323/。

papers.title: Poller: Are LLMs Suitable for Evaluating Poetry Understanding Task?
papers.title_zh: 波勒：大型语言模型是否适合用于评估诗歌理解能力？
papers.authors: Shanshan Wang, Derek F. Wong, Jingming Yao, Lidia S. Chao
papers.abstract: Traditional automatic evaluation methods have been shown to be unsuitable for modern Chinese poetry because of the distinct nature of this literary genre. Human evaluation remains reliable, but is expensive and not applicable to large-scale data. In this paper, we propose Poller (Poetry LLM Evaluator), a novel method leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to evaluate the poetry understanding task. Specifically, our method requires LLMs to play the role of a poem’s author with detailed information, thereby emulating human evaluation and judgment by adopting the poet’s perspective. We conducted comprehensive experiments on multiple LLMs, evaluating the interpretations of poems across eight specialized dimensions. Experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively reduces the evaluation error between LLMs and humans. Especially for specific dimension evaluation, Poller-based LLMs achieve a 94.55% and 89.53% error reduction for rhetorical techniques and defamiliarization, respectively, compared to baseline methods. These performances are unattainable by conventional LLM evaluation methods. Experimental results from multiple LLMs across various dimensions validate the efficacy of our method. This work bridges the gap between automated efficiency and human expertise, establishing a foundation for automated evaluation in poetry-related tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的自动评估方法由于现代中国诗歌的独特性质而显得不适用。人工评估虽然可靠，但成本高昂且无法处理大规模数据。在本文中，我们提出了Poller（诗歌大语言模型评估器）这一创新方法，该方法利用大语言模型来评估诗歌理解任务。具体来说，我们的方法让语言模型扮演具有详细信息的诗人角色，从而通过采用诗人的视角来模拟人类的评估和判断。我们对多种语言模型进行了全面的实验，从八个专业维度评估了它们对诗歌的解读能力。实验结果表明，我们的方法有效降低了语言模型与人类之间的评估误差。特别是在特定维度的评估方面，基于Poller的语言模型在修辞技巧和陌生化效果方面的错误率分别降低了94.55%和89.53%，这远远超过了传统语言模型评估方法的水平。这些性能是传统语言模型评估方法无法实现的。来自多种语言模型的实验结果验证了我们方法的有效性。这项工作填补了自动化效率与人类专业知识之间的空白，为诗歌相关任务的自动化评估奠定了基础。

papers.title: No-Worse Context-Aware Decoding: Preventing Neutral Regression in Context-Conditioned Generation
papers.title_zh: 基于上下文感知的解码方式：避免上下文依赖生成中的中立回归现象
papers.authors: Yufei Tao, Ameeta Agrawal
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can answer questions and summarize documents when conditioned on external contexts (e.g., retrieved evidence), yet context use remains unreliable: models may overwrite an already-correct output (neutral regression) even when the context is non-informative. We formalize neutral regression as a do-no-harm requirement and quantify it by measuring accuracy drops on baseline-correct items under answer-consistent contexts. We propose No-Worse Context-Aware Decoding (NWCAD), a decode-time adapter built on a two-stream setup with a two-stage gate: it backs off to no-context decoding when the context is non-informative, and otherwise uses context-conditioned decoding with a contrastive fallback under uncertainty. We evaluate NWCAD on benchmarks that separate do-no-harm reliability from context utilization (accuracy gains on genuinely helpful contexts). NWCAD prevents neutral regression on baseline-correct items while preserving strong context-driven accuracy on helpful contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在给定外部上下文的情况下能够回答问题和总结文档内容，但上下文的使用仍然不可靠：即使上下文并无信息价值，模型仍可能覆盖掉已经正确的输出结果（即出现中性回归现象）。我们将这种中性回归现象定义为一种“不造成伤害”的要求，并通过测量在符合答案要求的上下文中，对基准正确问题的准确率下降程度来量化这一现象。我们提出了“不差于其他上下文的解码方法”（No-Worse Context-Aware Decoding，简称NWCAD），这是一种基于双流架构的解码方法，具有两级解码机制：当上下文无信息时，该方法会退化为无上下文解码；而在其他情况下，则采用基于上下文的条件化解码方式，并在不确定情况下进行对比性 fallback。我们在多个基准测试中对NWCAD进行了评估，这些测试分别考察了模型的“不造成伤害”的可靠性以及上下文利用能力（即在真正有价值的上下文中，模型的准确率是否有所提升）。结果表明，NWCAD能够在处理基准正确问题的同时，避免出现中性回归现象，同时在有价值的上下文中仍能保持较高的准确率。

papers.title: Prompting Test-Time Scaling Is A Strong LLM Reasoning Data Augmentation
papers.title_zh: 促使时间缩放功能的实现是提升大型语言模型推理能力的有效数据增强方法
papers.authors: Sondos Mahmoud Bsharat, Zhiqiang Shen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning when guided by chain-of-thought exemplars, yet collecting large, high-quality reasoning datasets remains laborious and resource-intensive. We introduce Prompting Test-Time Scaling (P-TTS), a prompt-space data augmentation framework for enhancing LLM reasoning via fine-tuning. In P-TTS, scaling refers to systematic expansion of the prompt space during offline teacher-data generation, not to increased inference-time compute for the deployed student. Rather than collecting thousands of examples, P-TTS starts from a small pool of 90 manually selected reasoning instances and applies principled instruction templates and paraphrased prompt variants to elicit diverse reasoning trajectories from a teacher model, producing a compact synthetic training set. We fine-tune Qwen-2.5 models of multiple sizes on the resulting data. On reasoning benchmarks including AIME25, MATH500, and GPQA-Diamond, P-TTS consistently improves accuracy over competitive small-data baselines such as S1 and S1.1 (1K-shot), with the largest gains on AIME25 while remaining strong on MATH500 and GPQA-Diamond. P-TTS also improves generalization on out-of-domain reasoning evaluations. Ablations show that exemplar diversity and prompt-space scaling are critical drivers of improvement, suggesting that prompt scaling explores the latent space of reasoning patterns, amplifying LLM problem-solving with minimal annotation overhead. P-TTS offers a practical, low-cost way to elicit strong LLM reasoning in resource-constrained or rapidly evolving domains. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/PTTS.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在受到思维链示例的引导时展现出强大的推理能力，然而收集大量高质量的语言推理数据集仍然是一项耗时且需要大量资源的任务。我们提出了Prompting Test-Time Scaling（P-TTS）技术，这是一种通过微调来增强语言模型推理能力的提示空间数据增强方法。在P-TTS中，扩展指的是在离线教师数据生成过程中对提示空间的系统性扩展，而不是增加部署模型的计算资源。P-TTS并非从数千个示例中收集数据，而是从一个由90个手动选择的推理实例组成的小样本开始，利用有原则性的指令模板和改写的提示变体来激发教师模型的多样化推理行为，从而生成出一个紧凑的合成训练集。我们在这些合成数据上对Qwen-2.5模型进行了多种规模的微调。在包括AIME25、MATH500和GPQA-Diamond在内的推理基准测试中，P-TTS始终能够比一些小型数据集的基线模型取得更高的准确率，其中在AIME25上的提升最为显著，同时在MATH500和GPQA-Diamond上的表现也相当出色。P-TTS还提升了模型在跨领域推理评估中的泛化能力。消融实验表明，示例的多样性和提示空间的扩展是提升性能的关键因素，这表明提示空间的扩展能够探索推理模式的潜在空间，从而在最小的注释开销下提升语言模型的问题解决能力。P-TTS提供了一种实用且低成本的方法，用于在资源有限或快速发展的领域中提取出强大的语言模型推理能力。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/VILA-Lab/PTTS获取。

papers.title: GRASS: Gradient-based Adaptive Layer-wise Importance Sampling for Memory-efficient Large Language Model Fine-tuning
papers.title_zh: 基于梯度的自适应逐层重要性采样方法：适用于内存效率高的大型语言模型微调技术
papers.authors: Kaiyuan Tian, Linbo Qiao, Yu Tang, Gongqingjian Jiang, Baihui Liu, Yifu Gao, Xialin Su, Dongsheng Li
papers.abstract: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models is constrained by substantial GPU memory demands. Low-rank adaptation methods mitigate this challenge by updating only a subset of parameters. However, these approaches often limit model expressiveness and yield lower performance than full-parameter fine-tuning. Layer-wise fine-tuning methods have emerged as an alternative, enabling memory-efficient training through static layer importance sampling strategies. However, these methods overlook variations in layer importance across tasks and training stages, resulting in suboptimal performance on downstream tasks. To address these limitations, we propose GRASS, a gradient-based adaptive layer-wise importance sampling framework. GRASS utilizes mean gradient norms as a task-aware and training-stage-aware metric for estimating layer importance. Furthermore, GRASS adaptively adjusts layer sampling probabilities through an adaptive training strategy. We also introduce a layer-wise optimizer state offloading mechanism to further reduce memory usage while maintaining comparable training throughput. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that GRASS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an average accuracy improvement of up to 4.38 points and reducing memory usage by up to 19.97%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的全参数微调受到大量GPU内存需求的限制。低秩适应方法通过仅更新部分参数来缓解这个问题。然而，这些方法通常会限制模型的表达能力，导致其性能低于全参数微调。逐层微调方法作为一种替代方案出现，它通过静态层重要性采样策略实现内存高效的训练。然而，这些方法忽略了不同任务及训练阶段中层重要性的差异，导致下游任务的性能不佳。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了GRASS——一种基于梯度的自适应逐层重要性采样框架。GRASS利用平均梯度范数作为任务感知和训练阶段感知的层重要性评估指标。此外，GRASS还通过自适应训练策略动态调整层采样概率。我们还引入了层级优化器状态卸载机制，以进一步减少内存使用，同时保持相当的训练效率。在多个模型和基准测试中的广泛实验表明，GRASS始终优于现有方法，平均准确率提高了4.38个百分点，同时减少了高达19.97%的内存使用。

papers.title: ltzGLUE: Luxembourgish General Language Understanding Evaluation
papers.title_zh: ltzGLUE：卢森堡通用语言理解评估系统
papers.authors: Alistair Plum, Felicia Körner, Anne-Marie Lutgen, Laura Bernardy, Fred Philippy, Emilia Milano, Nils Rehlinger, Cedric Lothritz, Tharindu Ranasinghe, Barbara Plank, Christoph Purschke
papers.abstract: This paper presents ltzGLUE, the first Natural Language Understanding (NLU) benchmark for Luxembourgish (LTZ) based on the popular GLUE benchmark for English. Although NLU tasks are available for many european languages nowadays, LTZ is one of the official national languages that is often overlooked. We introduce new tasks and reuse existing ones to introduce the first official NLU benchmark and accompanying evaluation of encoder models for the language. Our tasks include common natural language processing tasks in binary and multi-class classification settings, including named entity recognition, topic classification, and intent classification. We evaluate various pre-trained language models for LTZ to present an overview of the current capabilities of these models on the LTZ language.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了ltzGLUE，这是首个基于英语通用GLUE基准的卢森堡语（LTZ）自然语言理解（NLU）基准测试。尽管如今许多欧洲语言都有相应的NLU任务，但LTZ作为官方语言之一却常常被忽视。我们引入了新的任务，并复用现有的任务，从而创建了首个针对LTZ语言的官方NLU基准测试，以及相关的编码器模型评估方法。我们的任务包括二元分类和多类分类中的常见自然语言处理任务，例如命名实体识别、主题分类和意图分类等。我们评估了多种预训练的语言模型在LTZ语言上的表现，以了解这些模型在当前LTZ语言上的能力水平。

papers.title: AdapThink: Adaptive Thinking Preferences for Reasoning Language Models
papers.title_zh: AdapThink：适用于推理语言模型的自适应思维偏好设置
papers.authors: Wenyue Xu, Xu Wan, Wei Wang, Wenqi Huang, Wotao Yin, Shengjie Zhao, Mingyang Sun
papers.abstract: The slow thinking paradigm has been widely validated to enhance the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), but it introduces notable reasoning inefficiencies: models often overthink simple tasks while prematurely shifting their reasoning paths when addressing complex problems. To address this, we propose AdapThink, a simple yet efficient framework for adaptive reasoning preference control. Unlike methods imposing uniform length constraints, AdapThink dynamically adjusts reflection preferences based on group-level distributional statistics of reasoning length and reflection intensity. We further introduce a dispersion-based diversity sampling mechanism that maximizes the geometric spread of reasoning patterns, accelerating learning through exposure to diverse problem-solving strategies. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, AdapThink reduces average response length by 17.1%-21.4% while improving performance by 6.12-6.59 points under 32K token budgets, demonstrating superior efficiency and robustness against reward hacking compared to strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 慢速思考范式已被广泛验证能够有效提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但它也带来了一些显著的推理效率问题：模型在处理简单任务时往往会过度思考，而在解决复杂问题时则会过早地改变推理路径。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了AdapThink这一简单而高效的自适应推理偏好控制框架。与那些施加统一长度限制的方法不同，AdapThink能够根据推理长度和反思强度的群体级分布统计数据动态调整反思偏好。我们还引入了一种基于分散性的多样性采样机制，该机制能够最大化推理模式的几何分布范围，从而通过接触多样化的问题解决策略来加速学习过程。在数学推理和代码生成等基准测试中，AdapThink能够将平均响应长度减少17.1%至21.4%，同时在32K令牌预算下将性能提升6.12至6.59个百分点，显示出相较于其他强基线方法更高的效率和更强的抗奖励操纵能力。

papers.title: Improving the Throughput of Diffusion-based Large Language Models via a Training-Free Confidence-Aware Calibration
papers.title_zh: 通过无需训练的置信度感知校准方法，提高基于扩散技术的大型语言模型的吞吐量
papers.authors: Jucheng Shen, Gaurav Sarkar, Yeonju Ro, Sharath Nittur Sridhar, Zhangyang Wang, Aditya Akella, Souvik Kundu
papers.abstract: We present CadLLM, a training-free method to accelerate the inference throughput of diffusion-based LLMs (dLLMs). We first investigate on the dynamic nature of the token unmasking confidence across blocks and steps. Based on this observation, we then present a lightweight adaptive approach that can control the generation block size, step size, and threshold based on the average confidence score of the unmasked tokens. We further reduce the softmaxing overhead of token probability generation by dynamically leveraging a subset of vocabulary size to regulate sampling breadth. CadLLM is a plug-and-play model-agnostic with KV caching based dLLMs. Extensive experiments on four popular tasks demonstrate the efficacy of CadLLM to yield throughput improvement of up to 1.1-2.28x over the state-of-the-art baseline with competitive accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了CadLLM，一种无需训练即可提升基于扩散模型的大语言模型（dLLMs）推理吞吐量的方法。我们首先研究了不同块和步骤中令牌掩蔽置信度的动态特性。基于这一观察，我们提出了一种轻量级自适应方法，该方法可以根据未被掩蔽的令牌的平均置信度来控制生成块的规模、步长以及阈值。我们还通过动态利用部分词汇表大小来调节采样范围，从而减少了令牌概率生成的softmax计算开销。CadLLM是一种即插即用、与模型无关的dLLm模型，并支持KV缓存功能。在四个热门任务上的广泛实验表明，CadLLM能够有效提高推理吞吐量，相比最先进的基线方法，吞吐量可提高1.1至2.28倍，同时保持相当的准确性。

papers.title: Same Claim, Different Judgment: Benchmarking Scenario-Induced Bias in Multilingual Financial Misinformation Detection
papers.title_zh: 相同的指控，不同的处理结果：多语言金融虚假信息检测中由基准比较引发的偏见问题
papers.authors: Zhiwei Liu, Yupeng Cao, Yuechen Jiang, Mohsinul Kabir, Polydoros Giannouris, Chen Xu, Ziyang Xu, Tianlei Zhu, Md. Tariquzzaman, Triantafillos Papadopoulos, Yan Wang, Lingfei Qian, Xueqing Peng, Zhuohan Xie, Ye Yuan, Saeed Almheiri, Abdulrazzaq Alnajjar, Ming-Bin Chen, Harry Stuart, Paul Thompson, Prayag Tiwari, Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Xue Liu, Jimin Huang, Sophia Ananiadou
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely applied across various domains of finance. Since their training data are largely derived from human-authored corpora, LLMs may inherit a range of human biases. Behavioral biases can lead to instability and uncertainty in decision-making, particularly when processing financial information. However, existing research on LLM bias has mainly focused on direct questioning or simplified, general-purpose settings, with limited consideration of the complex real-world financial environments and high-risk, context-sensitive, multilingual financial misinformation detection tasks (MFMD). In this work, we propose MFMDScen, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating behavioral biases of LLMs in MFMD across diverse economic scenarios. In collaboration with financial experts, we construct three types of complex financial scenarios: (i) role- and personality-based, (ii) role- and region-based, and (iii) role-based scenarios incorporating ethnicity and religious beliefs. We further develop a multilingual financial misinformation dataset covering English, Chinese, Greek, and Bengali. By integrating these scenarios with misinformation claims, MFMDScen enables a systematic evaluation of 22 mainstream LLMs. Our findings reveal that pronounced behavioral biases persist across both commercial and open-source models. This project is available at https://github.com/lzw108/FMD.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在金融领域的各个领域得到了广泛应用。由于这些模型的训练数据主要来源于人类编写的语料库，因此它们可能会继承一系列人类的偏见。行为偏见可能导致决策的不稳定性和不确定性，尤其是在处理金融信息时。然而，现有的关于语言模型偏见的研究主要集中在直接提问或简化、通用的场景中，而对复杂的现实世界金融环境以及高风险、需要考虑具体上下文的多语言金融错误信息检测任务却缺乏关注。在这项研究中，我们提出了MFMDScen这一综合基准测试，用于评估不同经济场景下语言模型的行为偏见。通过与金融专家合作，我们构建了三种类型的复杂金融场景：(i)基于角色和个性的场景；(ii)基于角色和地区的场景；(iii)包含种族和宗教信仰的角色基础场景。我们还开发了一个涵盖英语、中文、希腊语和孟加拉语的多语言金融错误信息数据集。通过将这些场景与错误信息声明相结合，MFMDScen能够系统地评估22种主流语言模型的行为偏见。我们的研究发现表明，无论是商业模型还是开源模型，都存在明显的行为偏见。该项目的代码可访问于https://github.com/lzw108/FMD。

papers.title: MASS-RAG: Multi-Agent Synthesis Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 多智能体合成生成式生成技术：MASS-RAG
papers.authors: Xingchen Xiao, Heyan Huang, Runheng Liu, Jincheng Xie
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to incorporate external knowledge at inference time. However, when retrieved contexts are noisy, incomplete, or heterogeneous, a single generation process often struggles to reconcile evidence effectively. We propose MASS-RAG, a multi-agent synthesis approach to retrieval-augmented generation that structures evidence processing into multiple role-specialized agents. MASS-RAG applies distinct agents for evidence summarization, evidence extraction, and reasoning over retrieved documents, and combines their outputs through a dedicated synthesis stage to produce the final answer. This design exposes multiple intermediate evidence views, allowing the model to compare and integrate complementary information before answer generation. Experiments on four benchmarks show that MASS-RAG consistently improves performance over strong RAG baselines, particularly in settings where relevant evidence is distributed across retrieved contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在检索增强生成中得到了广泛应用，以便在推理过程中整合外部知识。然而，当检索到的上下文存在噪声、不完整或异构性时，单一的生成过程往往难以有效整合各种证据。我们提出了MASS-RAG这一多智能体合成方法，它将证据处理任务分解为多个具有特定职责的智能体来承担。MASS-RAG分别使用不同的智能体来进行证据总结、证据提取以及对检索到的文档进行推理，并通过一个专门的合成阶段将它们的输出结合起来，最终得到完整的答案。这种设计使得模型能够同时处理多种证据视角，从而在生成答案之前比较和整合各种互补的信息。在四个基准测试中的实验表明，MASS-RAG在性能上始终优于其他强大的检索增强生成方法，尤其是在相关证据分布在多个上下文中的情况下。

papers.title: Bayesian Active Learning with Gaussian Processes Guided by LLM Relevance Scoring for Dense Passage Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 基于高斯过程的贝叶斯主动学习技术，以大型语言模型的相关性评分为引导，用于密集内容的检索
papers.authors: Junyoung Kim, Anton Korikov, Jiazhou Liang, Justin Cui, Yifan Simon Liu, Qianfeng Wen, Mark Zhao, Scott Sanner
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit exceptional zero-shot relevance modeling, their high computational cost necessitates framing passage retrieval as a budget-constrained global optimization problem. Existing approaches passively rely on first-stage dense retrievers, which leads to two limitations: (1) failing to retrieve relevant passages in semantically distinct clusters, and (2) failing to propagate relevance signals to the broader corpus. To address these limitations, we propose Bayesian Active Learning with Gaussian Processes guided by LLM relevance scoring (BAGEL), a novel framework that propagates sparse LLM relevance signals across the embedding space to guide global exploration. BAGEL models the multimodal relevance distribution across the entire embedding space with a query-specific Gaussian Process (GP) based on LLM relevance scores. Subsequently, it iteratively selects passages for scoring by strategically balancing the exploitation of high-confidence regions with the exploration of uncertain areas. Extensive experiments across four benchmark datasets and two LLM backbones demonstrate that BAGEL effectively explores and captures complex relevance distributions and outperforms LLM reranking methods under the same LLM budget on all four datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在零样本相关性建模方面表现出色，但其高昂的计算成本使得段落检索需要被视作一个预算受限的全局优化问题。现有的方法主要依赖第一阶段的高密度检索器，这导致了两个局限性：(1)无法在语义上不同的簇中检索到相关段落；(2)无法将相关性信号传播到更广泛的语料库中。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种基于语言模型相关性评分的贝叶斯主动学习算法——BAGEL。该算法利用高斯过程来模拟整个嵌入空间中的多模态相关性分布，并通过基于语言模型相关性评分的高斯过程来指导全局探索。BAGEL通过策略性地平衡对高置信度区域的利用与对不确定区域的探索，从而迭代地选择用于评分的段落。通过在四个基准数据集和两种语言模型框架上的广泛实验表明，BAGEL能够有效地探索并捕捉复杂的相关性分布，并且在相同语言模型预算下，所有四个数据集上的表现都优于其他语言模型重排序方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reasoning-Based Refinement of Unsupervised Text Clusters with LLMs
papers.title_zh: 基于推理的无监督文本聚类方法，结合大语言模型的应用
papers.authors: Tunazzina Islam
papers.abstract: Unsupervised methods are widely used to induce latent semantic structure from large text collections, yet their outputs often contain incoherent, redundant, or poorly grounded clusters that are difficult to validate without labeled data. We propose a reasoning-based refinement framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) not as embedding generators, but as semantic judges that validate and restructure the outputs of arbitrary unsupervised clustering algorithms. Our framework introduces three reasoning stages: (i) coherence verification, where LLMs assess whether cluster summaries are supported by their member texts; (ii) redundancy adjudication, where candidate clusters are merged or rejected based on semantic overlap; and (iii) label grounding, where clusters are assigned interpretable labels through a two-stage process that generates and consolidates semantically similar labels in a fully unsupervised manner. This design decouples representation learning from structural validation and mitigates the common failure modes of embedding-only approaches. We evaluate the framework in real-world social media corpora from two platforms with distinct interaction models, demonstrating consistent improvements in cluster coherence and human-aligned labeling quality over classical topic models and recent representation-based baselines. Human evaluation shows strong agreement with LLM-generated labels, despite the absence of gold-standard annotations. We further conduct robustness analysis under matched temporal and volume conditions to assess cross-platform stability. Beyond empirical gains, our results suggest that LLM-based reasoning can serve as a general mechanism for validating and refining unsupervised semantic structure, enabling more reliable and interpretable analysis of large text collections without supervision.
papers.abstract_zh: 无监督方法被广泛用于从大量文本集合中提取潜在的语义结构，但其输出结果往往包含不连贯、冗余或缺乏依据的集合，这些集合在没有标记数据的情况下难以验证。我们提出了一种基于推理的优化框架，该框架将大语言模型（LLM）用作语义评判器，而不是嵌入生成器，以验证和重构任意无监督聚类算法的输出结果。我们的框架包含三个推理阶段：(i) 一致性验证，即LLM评估集群摘要是否得到其成员文本的支持；(ii) 冗余判定，根据语义重叠程度合并或拒绝候选集群；(iii) 标签赋值，通过两阶段过程为集群分配可解释的标签，该过程以完全无监督的方式生成并整合语义相似的标签。这种设计将表示学习与结构验证分离开来，从而避免了仅依赖嵌入方法的常见失败模式。我们在两个具有不同交互模式的真实世界社交媒体语料库上对该框架进行了评估，结果显示，与传统的主题模型和最近的基于表示的基线方法相比，该框架在集群一致性和与人类对齐的标签质量方面取得了显著的提升。人类评估显示，尽管没有标准注释数据，但LLM生成的标签与人类的标注结果高度一致。我们还进行了在匹配的时间和容量条件下的鲁棒性分析，以评估跨平台的稳定性。除了实证上的优势之外，我们的研究结果表明，基于LLM的推理可以作为一种通用机制，用于验证和精炼无监督的语义结构，从而无需监督就能对大量文本集合进行更可靠且可解释的分析。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems via Textual Backpropagation
papers.title_zh: 通过文本反向传播实现自演化多智能体系统
papers.authors: Xiaowen Ma, Yunpu Ma, Chenyang Lin, Sikuan Yan, Jinhe Bi, Zixuan Cao, Yijun Tian, Volker Tresp, Hinrich Schuetze
papers.abstract: Leveraging multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) has proven effective for addressing complex, high-dimensional tasks, but current approaches often rely on static, manually engineered multi-agent configurations. To overcome these constraints, we present the Agentic Neural Network (\mathcal{ANN}), a framework that conceptualizes multi-agent collaboration as a layered neural network architecture. In this design, each agent operates as a node, and each layer forms a cooperative team focused on a specific subtask. The proposed framework follows a two-phase optimization strategy: (1) Forward Phase - Drawing inspiration from neural network forward passes, tasks are dynamically decomposed into subtasks, and cooperative agent teams with suitable aggregation methods are constructed layer by layer. (2) Backward Phase - Mirroring backpropagation, we refine both global and local collaboration through iterative feedback, allowing agents to self-evolve their roles, prompts, and coordination. This neuro-symbolic approach enables our framework to create new or specialized agent teams post-training, delivering notable gains in accuracy and adaptability. Across seven benchmark datasets, \mathcal{ANN} surpasses leading multi-agent baselines under the same configurations, showing consistent performance improvements.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用多个大语言模型来处理复杂、高维任务已被证明是有效的，但当前的方法往往依赖于静态的、人工设计的多智能体配置。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了“智能体神经网络”框架。该框架将多智能体的协作方式抽象为分层神经网络结构。在这种设计中，每个智能体都充当一个节点，而每一层则构成了一个专注于特定子任务的合作团队。该框架采用两阶段优化策略：(1) 前向阶段——借鉴神经网络的前向传播机制，任务被动态分解为多个子任务，并通过逐层构建具有合适聚合方法的合作智能体团队来实现。(2) 反向阶段——通过反向传播机制，我们不断改进全局和局部的协作效果，使智能体能够自我进化其角色、提示方式和协调方式。这种神经符号方法使得我们的框架能够在训练后创建新的或专门的智能体团队，从而在准确性和适应性方面取得显著提升。在七个基准数据集上测试表明，该框架在相同配置下超越了领先的多智能体基线算法，展现了持续的性能提升。

papers.title: Confidence over Time: Confidence Calibration with Temporal Logic for Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 随时间变化的置信度：利用时态逻辑进行大型语言模型推理的置信度校准
papers.authors: Zhenjiang Mao, Anirudhh Venkat, Artem Bisliouk, Sindhura Kumbakonam Subramanian, Akshat Kothiyal, Saithej Singhu, Ivan Ruchkin
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on long-form, multi-step reasoning to solve complex tasks such as mathematical problem solving and scientific question answering. Despite strong performance, existing confidence estimation methods typically reduce an entire reasoning process to a single scalar score, ignoring how confidence evolves throughout the generation. As a result, these methods are often sensitive to superficial factors such as response length or verbosity, and struggle to distinguish correct reasoning from confidently stated errors. We propose to characterize the stepwise confidence signal using Signal Temporal Logic (STL). Using a discriminative STL mining procedure, we discover temporal formulas that distinguish confidence signals of correct and incorrect responses. Our analysis found that the STL patterns generalize across tasks, and numeric parameters exhibit sensitivity to individual questions. Based on these insights, we develop a confidence estimation approach that informs STL blocks with parameter hypernetworks. Experiments on multiple reasoning tasks show our confidence scores are more calibrated than the baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解决数学问题求解和科学问题回答等复杂任务时，越来越依赖长形式的、多步骤的推理过程。尽管这些模型表现优异，但现有的置信度估计方法通常只是将整个推理过程简化为一个标量分数，而忽略了置信度在推理过程中的变化规律。因此，这些方法往往对诸如回答长度或冗长程度这样的表面因素非常敏感，难以区分正确的推理和基于自信做出的错误回答。我们提出使用信号时态逻辑来描述逐步产生的置信度信号。通过采用一种具有辨别能力的信号时态逻辑挖掘方法，我们能够发现能够区分正确和错误回答的置信度信号的时间模式。我们的分析表明，这种信号时态逻辑模式在不同任务中都具有通用性，而且数值参数对单个问题表现出敏感性。基于这些发现，我们开发了一种置信度估计方法，该方法通过参数超网络来指导信号时态逻辑块的构建。在多个推理任务上的实验表明，我们的置信度评分比基线方法更为准确。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
