papers.title: Automated Profile Inference with Language Model Agents
papers.title_zh: 基于语言模型代理的自动化 Profile 推理
papers.authors: Yuntao Du, Zitao Li, Bolin Ding, Yaliang Li, Hanshen Xiao, Jingren Zhou, Ninghui Li
papers.abstract: Impressive progress has been made in automated problem-solving by the collaboration of large language model (LLM) based agents. However, these automated capabilities also open avenues for malicious applications. In this paper, we study a new threat that LLMs pose to online pseudonymity, called automated profile inference, where an adversary can instruct LLMs to automatically collect and extract sensitive personal attributes from publicly available user activities on pseudonymous platforms. We also introduce an automated profiling framework called AutoProfiler to demonstrate and assess the feasibility of such attacks in real-world scenarios. AutoProfiler consists of four specialized LLM agents that work collaboratively to retrieve and process user online activities and generate a profile with extracted personal information. Experimental results on two real-world datasets and one synthetic dataset show that AutoProfiler is highly effective and efficient, and the inferred attributes are both identifiable and sensitive, posing significant privacy risks. We explore mitigation strategies from different perspectives and advocate for increased public awareness of this emerging privacy threat.
papers.abstract_zh: 在基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理协同作用下，自动化问题解决方面取得了令人印象深刻的进展。然而，这些自动化能力也为恶意应用提供了机会。在本文中，我们研究了一种LLM对在线匿名性构成的新型威胁，即自动画像提取攻击。在这种攻击中，攻击者可以指示LLM从公开可用的用户活动数据中自动收集并提取敏感的个人信息。我们还引入了一个名为AutoProfiler的自动化画像生成框架，以验证和评估这种攻击在现实场景中的可行性。AutoProfiler由四个专门的LLM代理组成，它们协同工作，从用户的在线活动中提取个人信息，并生成完整的个人画像。在两个真实世界数据集和一个合成数据集上的实验结果表明，AutoProfiler非常有效且高效，但所提取的属性既具有辨识性，又包含敏感信息，从而带来严重的隐私风险。我们探讨了多种缓解策略，并呼吁提高公众对这一新兴隐私威胁的认识。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When Debiasing Backfires: Counterintuitive Side Effects of Preprocessing-Based Stereotype Mitigation
papers.title_zh: 当去偏见措施产生反效果时：基于预处理的刻板印象缓解方法所带来的意外后果
papers.authors: Yahan Zheng, John J. Guerrerio, Soroush Vosoughi, Weicheng Ma
papers.abstract: Preprocessing-based methods for stereotype mitigation, such as pre-/post-training on debiased corpora, are widely used in NLP. While these approaches reduce measurable stereotypes for targeted groups, we find they often induce unintended shifts: stereotyping or counter-stereotyping can increase for other demographics, including across unrelated categories. We demonstrate these side effects across two model families (encoder-only and decoder-only), multiple preprocessing strategies (removing stereotypical sentences, removing group mentions, and swapping references), and both pre- and post-training at different data scales on Wikipedia. Standard benchmarks frequently miss these shifts. Using attention-rollout analysis, we observe that such side effects are not accompanied by large changes in attention flow, complicating mechanistic explanations. We discuss implications for evaluation, provide actionable diagnostics, and argue for side-effect-aware, transparent mitigation practices that make claims calibrated to uncertainty.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于预处理的刻板印象缓解方法，例如对无偏见语料库进行训练前后的处理，在自然语言处理领域被广泛使用。虽然这些方法能够减少目标群体的可测量刻板印象，但我们发现它们往往会导致一些意想不到的副作用：对其他人群来说，刻板印象可能会加剧，甚至出现在与主题无关的领域。我们在两个模型家族（仅编码器模型、仅解码器模型）中进行了实验，并采用了多种预处理策略（删除带有刻板印象的句子、去除涉及特定群体的内容、替换参考对象），同时在维基百科的不同数据规模下进行了训练前后处理。标准的评估基准通常无法捕捉到这些副作用。通过注意力流分析，我们发现这些副作用并不会导致注意力流的显著变化，这就使得对其机制的解释变得复杂。我们讨论了这些副作用对评估的影响，提供了可行的诊断方法，并主张采用能够识别并应对这些副作用的透明化缓解措施，从而使相关声明更加符合实际情况。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Code: Every Programming Language Matters
papers.title_zh: 每种编程语言的规模定律：所有编程语言都至关重要
papers.authors: Jian Yang, Shuyue Guo, Linzheng Chai, Wei Zhang, Aishan Liu, Chuan Hao, Zhoujun Li, Xin Zhao, Xianglong Liu, Weifeng Lv, Bryan Dai
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are powerful but costly to train, with scaling laws predicting performance from model size, data, and compute. However, different programming languages (PLs) have varying impacts during pre-training that significantly affect base model performance, leading to inaccurate performance prediction. Existing works focus on language-agnostic settings, neglecting the inherently multilingual nature of modern software development. Therefore, it is first necessary to investigate the scaling laws of different PLs, and then consider their mutual influences to arrive at the final multilingual scaling law. In this paper, we present the first systematic exploration of scaling laws for multilingual code pre-training, conducting over 1000+ experiments (Equivalent to 336,000+ H800 hours) across multiple PLs, model sizes (0.2B to 14B parameters), and dataset sizes (1T tokens). We establish scaling laws for code LLMs across multiple programming languages, showing that interpreted languages benefit more from increased scale than compiled ones. Multilingual pre-training provides synergistic benefits, especially between syntactically similar languages, with parallel pairing (concatenating code with translations) significantly enhancing cross-lingual abilities. We propose a proportion-dependent multilingual scaling law that optimally allocates training tokens by prioritizing high-utility languages (e.g., Python), balancing high-synergy pairs (e.g., JavaScript-TypeScript), and reducing allocation to fast-saturating languages (e.g., Rust), achieving superior performance across all languages compared to uniform distribution.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）虽然功能强大，但训练成本极高。根据扩展定律，模型的性能与模型规模、数据量和计算资源密切相关。然而，不同的编程语言在预训练过程中会产生不同的影响，这会显著地影响基础模型的性能，从而导致性能预测的不准确性。现有的研究主要集中在与语言无关的场景上，而忽视了现代软件开发本身的多语言特性。因此，首先需要研究不同编程语言的扩展定律，然后考虑它们之间的相互影响，以得出最终的多语言扩展定律。在本文中，我们首次系统地研究了多语言代码预训练的扩展定律，进行了超过1000次实验（相当于336,000小时以上的H800时间），涉及多种编程语言、模型规模（从2亿到140亿参数）以及数据集规模（1万亿个令牌）。我们发现，不同编程语言的代码LLM存在各自的扩展定律，其中解释型语言从大规模训练中获益更大，而编译型语言则不然。多语言预训练能够产生协同效应，尤其是在语法相似的语言之间。通过并行配对（将代码与翻译内容结合），可以显著提高跨语言处理能力。我们提出了一种基于比例的多语言扩展定律，该定律能够优化训练令牌的分配，优先考虑高实用性语言（如Python），平衡高协同性语言对（如JavaScript和TypeScript），同时减少分配给快速饱和语言（如Rust）的令牌数量，从而在所有语言中都能获得更好的性能，优于均匀分配的方式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond the Singular: Revealing the Value of Multiple Generations in Benchmark Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 超越单一层面：揭示多代样本在基准测试中的价值
papers.authors: Wenbo Zhang, Hengrui Cai, Wenyu Chen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant utility in real-world applications, exhibiting impressive capabilities in natural language processing and understanding. Benchmark evaluations are crucial for assessing the capabilities of LLMs as they can provide a comprehensive assessment of their strengths and weaknesses. However, current evaluation methods often overlook the inherent randomness of LLMs by employing deterministic generation strategies or relying on a single random sample, resulting in unaccounted sampling variance and unreliable benchmark score estimates. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical statistical model that provides a more comprehensive representation of the benchmarking process by incorporating both benchmark characteristics and LLM randomness. We show that leveraging multiple generations improves the accuracy of estimating the benchmark score and reduces variance. Multiple generations also allow us to define \mathbb{P} (correct), a prompt-level difficulty score based on correct ratios, providing fine-grained insights into individual prompts. Additionally, we create a data map that visualizes difficulty and semantics of prompts, enabling error detection and quality control in benchmark construction.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在现实应用中的效用已经得到了充分验证，它们在自然语言处理和理解方面展现出了令人印象深刻的性能。基准测试对于评估大语言模型的能力至关重要，因为它们能够全面反映模型的优点和缺点。然而，当前的评估方法往往忽略了大语言模型的随机性，通常采用确定性生成策略或依赖单一随机样本来进行评估，这导致评估结果的方差无法得到充分考虑，从而得出不可靠的基准分数估计。在本文中，我们提出了一种分层统计模型，该模型通过结合基准特性与大语言模型的随机性，为基准测试过程提供了更全面的描述。我们发现，采用多轮生成可以提升基准分数估计的准确性，并减少方差。多轮生成还允许我们定义“正确概率”，即基于正确比率得出的提示级难度评分，从而能够更细致地了解各个提示的特点。此外，我们还创建了一个数据映射工具，用于可视化提示的难度和语义信息，从而实现在基准构建过程中的错误检测和质量控制。

papers.title: Safety Is Not Universal: The Selective Safety Trap in LLM Alignment
papers.title_zh: 安全性并非普遍适用：在LLM对齐过程中存在选择性安全陷阱
papers.authors: Iago Alves Brito, Walcy Rios, Julia Soares Dollis, Diogo Fernandes Costa Silva, Arlindo Rodrigues Galvão Filho
papers.abstract: Current safety evaluations of large language models (LLMs) create a dangerous illusion of universal protection by aggregating harms under generic categories such as “Identity Hate”, obscuring vulnerabilities toward specific populations. In this work, we expose the Selective Safety Trap: a systemic failure mode where models robustly defend specific populations while leaving underrepresented communities highly vulnerable to identical adversarial attacks. To systematically audit this phenomenon, we introduce MiJaBench, a bilingual (English–Portuguese) adversarial benchmark comprising 43,961 controlled jailbreaking prompts across 16 minority groups. By evaluating 14 state-of-the-art LLMs on MiJaBench, we curate 615,454 prompt-response pairs that compose MiJaBench-Align, revealing that safety alignment is not a uniform semantic capability but a demographic hierarchy, with defense rates fluctuating by up to 42% within the same model solely based on the target group. This disparity persists across architectures and languages and is amplified by scaling, indicating that current alignment methods learn group-specific safeguards rather than a generalized notion of harm. Through targeted direct preference optimization (DPO) on a 1B-parameter baseline, we achieve strong zero-shot safety generalizations to entirely unseen demographics and complex attack strategies. We release all datasets and scripts to provide the community with a concrete pathway toward equitable, transferable safety alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前对大语言模型的安全评估，通过将所有危害归类为“身份仇恨”等通用类别，从而营造出一种看似具有普遍保护作用的错觉，这掩盖了针对特定群体的脆弱性。在这项研究中，我们揭示了“选择性安全陷阱”这一系统性缺陷：模型会强烈防御特定群体，却让那些代表性不足的群体极易受到相同的攻击。为了系统地研究这一现象，我们开发了MiJaBench这个双语（英语-葡萄牙语）对抗性基准测试，该测试包含43,961个针对16个少数群体的控制性攻击提示。通过对14种最先进的语言模型在MiJaBench上的测试，我们收集了615,454对提示与响应的数据，从而得出MiJaBench-Align模型。研究发现，安全性对齐并非一种统一的语义能力，而是基于人口统计的层次结构——同一模型在不同目标群体上的防御率差异可达42%。这种差异在不同架构和语言之间都存在，并且随着规模的增加而加剧。这表明当前的安全性对齐方法只是学习了针对特定群体的保护措施，而非对危害的泛化理解。通过在1B参数的基础上进行有针对性的直接偏好优化，我们实现了对完全未知的人口群体和复杂攻击策略的强大零样本安全性概括能力。我们公开了所有数据集和脚本，为社区提供了一个实现公平、可迁移的安全性对齐的具体途径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LLM Prompt Duel Optimizer: Efficient Label-Free Prompt Optimization
papers.title_zh: LLM提示优化器：高效的无标签提示优化方法
papers.authors: Yuanchen Wu, Saurabh Verma, Justin Lee, Fangzhou Xiong, Poppy Zhang, Amel Awadelkarim, Xu Chen, Yubai Yuan, Shawndra Hill
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are highly sensitive to prompts, but most automatic prompt optimization (APO) methods assume access to ground-truth references (e.g., labeled validation data) that are costly to obtain. We propose the Prompt Duel Optimizer (PDO), a sample-efficient framework for label-free prompt optimization based on pairwise preference feedback from an LLM judge. PDO casts prompt selection as a dueling-bandit problem and combines (i) Double Thompson Sampling to prioritize informative comparisons under a fixed judge budget, with (ii) top-performer guided mutation to expand the candidate pool while pruning weak prompts. Experiments on BIG-bench Hard (BBH) and MS MARCO show that PDO consistently identifies stronger prompts than label-free baselines, while offering favorable quality–cost trade-offs under constrained comparison budgets.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型对提示非常敏感，但大多数自动提示优化方法都需要访问成本高昂的真实数据参考（例如，带有标签的验证数据）。我们提出了Prompt Duel Optimizer（PDO）这一框架，它基于语言模型评委提供的成对偏好反馈，提供了一种高效的无标签提示优化方法。PDO将提示选择问题转化为一种双带赌注问题，并结合了以下两种策略：首先，使用双重汤普森采样算法在有限的评委预算下优先处理有信息量的比较；其次，通过采用表现最佳的提示作为指导来扩大候选提示池，同时剔除较弱的提示。在BIG-bench Hard（BBH）和MS MARCO上的实验表明，PDO能够始终识别出比无标签基线更强大的提示，同时在有限的比较预算下仍能保持良好的质量与成本平衡。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FrameNet-Cultures: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs via Cross-Cultural Frame Semantics
papers.title_zh: FrameNet-Cultures：一种通过跨文化框架语义来评估大型语言模型性能的基准测试工具
papers.authors: Neda Jamshidi, Anders Søgaard, Monica Bianchini
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit cultural biases, yet existing benchmarks rely on closed-form, domain-specific questionnaires. We introduce FRAMENET-CULTURES, a benchmark for evaluating cultural alignment in LLMs based on Fillmore-style frame semantics. Using the EveryCulture encyclopedia, we construct a lexicon of 18 cultural frames (e.g., greeting,child-rearing) across 20 countries, treating it as a structured reference for comparison rather than a definitive representation of contemporary societies. For each frame, we prompt five major LLMs—ChatGPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Flash, Mistral-Large, Qwen-3-Max, DeepSeek-V3.2—three times to generate open-ended instantiations, which are manually annotated and binarized. We measure alignment with country- and continent-level profiles using normalized Hamming distance, and validate cultural recognizability through human evaluation of generated dialogues. Under culture-neutral prompting, outputs align most closely with European profiles, followed by Asian and American ones, indicating a consistent cross-model pattern. With culture-specific prompting, models shift toward the target regions, aligning most strongly with Africa for Ethiopia and with Asia for India. FRAMENET-CULTURES is the first open-ended benchmark for cultural alignment relying on frame semantics. Data, prompts, and annotations are publicly available at https://github.com/neda-jamshidi/FrameNet-Cultures.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）存在文化偏见，而现有的评估基准则依赖于封闭形式的、特定领域的问卷调查。我们提出了FRAMENET-CULTURES这一基准测试，该测试基于Fillmore风格的框架语义来评估LLM的文化对齐能力。通过使用EveryCulture百科全书，我们构建了一个包含18种文化框架的词汇表，这些框架涵盖了20个国家，将其视为一种结构化的参考体系，而非对当代社会的完整描述。对于每个框架，我们分别向五款主流LLM——ChatGPT-5、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Mistral-Large、Qwen-3-Max和DeepSeek-V3.2——发出五次提示，以生成开放式回答。这些回答经过人工标注并转换为二值形式。我们通过归一化的汉明距离来衡量不同模型之间的对齐程度，并通过人工评估生成的对话来验证模型的跨文化识别能力。在文化中立的提示下，模型的输出与欧洲地区的特征最为接近，其次是亚洲和美国地区，这表明不同模型之间存在一致的跨模型模式。而在特定文化的提示下，模型则倾向于模拟目标地区的特征，例如针对埃塞俄比亚则表现出与非洲地区最强烈的对齐，针对印度则表现出与亚洲地区最强烈的对齐。FRAMENET-CULTURES是首个基于框架语义的文化对齐开放式基准测试。相关数据、提示和注释均可在此处获取：https://github.com/neda-jamshidi/FrameNet-Cultures
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Meta-Tool: Efficient Few-Shot Tool Adaptation for Small Language Models
papers.title_zh: 元工具：适用于小型语言模型的高效少样本工具适配方法
papers.authors: Sachin Kumar
papers.abstract: Can small language models achieve strong tool-use performance without complex adaptation mechanisms? This paper investigates this question through Meta-Tool, a controlled empirical study comparing hypernetwork-based LoRA adaptation against carefully designed few-shot prompting. Using a Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct backbone, we evaluate four adaptation mechanisms—few-shot prompting, documentation encoding, hypernetwork-generated LoRA weights, and value-guided beam search—across four diverse benchmarks: Gorilla APIBench, Spider 2.0, WebArena, and InterCode. Our central finding is a well-supported negative result: despite generating non-trivial weight matrices, the 227.8M-parameter hypernetwork provides no measurable improvement over few-shot prompting alone. Comprehensive ablation studies reveal that few-shot examples contribute +21.5% to performance and documentation contributes +5.0%, while the hypernetwork adds 0%. A 3B model with well-designed prompts achieves 79.7% of GPT-5’s average performance at 10 \times lower latency. Error analysis across 722 failure cases spanning all shot counts (0–5) shows that at the 5-shot configuration (106 failures), failure modes are task-dependent: schema-heavy tasks (Spider 2.0, WebArena) show near-zero format errors with remaining failures semantic, while format errors dominate on Gorilla (100%) and InterCode (70%). These findings redirect practitioners toward prompt engineering and example curation rather than complex adaptation architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 小型语言模型能否在不依赖复杂适应机制的情况下实现强大的工具使用性能？本文通过Meta-Tool这一受控实验研究来探讨这个问题。该研究比较了基于超网络的LoRA适应方法与精心设计的少样本提示方法。我们使用Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct作为基础模型，对四种适应机制进行了评估：少样本提示、文档编码、由超网络生成的LoRA权重以及价值引导的束搜索。实验在Gorilla APIBench、Spider 2.0、WebArena和InterCode这四个不同的基准测试平台上进行。我们的主要发现是一个明确的否定结果：尽管生成了非平凡的权重矩阵，但拥有227.8百万参数的超网络并没有比单纯的少样本提示带来任何可测量的提升。详细的消融研究表明，少样本示例对性能的贡献为+21.5%，文档编码的贡献为+5.0%，而超网络则没有贡献。一个拥有3B参数且提示设计良好的模型能够在10倍更低的延迟下达到与GPT-5相当的性能，其性能占到了平均性能的79.7%。通过对722个失败案例的分析，我们发现，在5次尝试的配置下（106次失败），失败模式取决于任务类型：对于需要大量模式的任务（如Spider 2.0、WebArena），格式错误几乎不存在，而剩余的错误都是语义上的问题；而在Gorilla和InterCode中，格式错误则占据了主导地位，分别达到了100%和70%。这些发现提醒从业者应该注重提示工程和示例选择，而不是依赖于复杂的适应架构。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Toward A Digital Twin of U.S. Congress
papers.title_zh: 打造美国国会的数字孪生体
papers.authors: Hayden Helm, Tianyi Chen, Harvey McGuinness, Paige Lee, Brandon Duderstadt, Carey Priebe
papers.abstract: In this paper we provide evidence that our virtual model of U.S. congresspersons based on a collection of language models moves towards satisfying the definition of a digital twin. In particular, we introduce and provide high-level descriptions of a daily-updated dataset that contains every Tweet from every U.S. congressperson during their respective terms. We demonstrate that a modern language model equipped with congressperson-specific subsets of this data producing Tweets that are largely indistinguishable from actual Tweets posted by their physical counterparts. We illustrate how generated Tweets can be used to predict roll-call vote behaviors and to quantify the likelihood of congresspersons crossing party lines, thereby assisting stakeholders in allocating resources and potentially impacting real-world legislative dynamics. We conclude with a discussion of the limitations and important extensions of our analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提供了证据，证明基于语言模型集合构建的美国国会议员的虚拟模型正在朝着满足“数字孪生”定义的方向发展。具体来说，我们介绍并描述了这样一个每日更新的数据集：该数据集包含了每位美国国会议员在其任期内发布的每一条推文。我们证明了，配备有这些数据子集的现代语言模型能够生成出与真实推文高度相似的推文。我们还展示了如何利用生成的推文来预测投票行为，以及量化议员跨越党派界限的可能性，从而帮助相关方分配资源，并对现实中的立法动态产生影响。最后，我们对我们的分析局限性及重要扩展方向进行了讨论。

papers.title: OjaKV: Context-Aware Online Low-Rank KV Cache Compression
papers.title_zh: OjaKV：基于上下文感知的在线低秩KV缓存压缩技术
papers.authors: Yuxuan Zhu, David H. Yang, Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri, Keerthiram Murugesan, Tejaswini Pedapati, Pin-Yu Chen
papers.abstract: The expanding long-context capabilities of large language models are constrained by a significant memory bottleneck: the key-value (KV) cache required for autoregressive generation. This bottleneck is substantial; for instance, a Llama-3.1-8B model processing a 32K-token prompt at a batch size of 4 requires approximately 16 GB for its KV cache, exceeding the model’s weights. While KV-cache compression via low-rank projection is promising, existing methods rely on a static, offline-learned subspace that performs poorly under distribution shifts. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OjaKV, a novel framework integrating a hybrid storage policy with online subspace adaptation. OjaKV preserves crucial tokens in full rank as high-fidelity anchors, while applying low-rank compression to intermediate tokens by adapting the projection basis using Oja’s algorithm for online PCA. This adaptation involves a comprehensive update during prefilling and lightweight periodic updates during decoding, ensuring the subspace remains aligned with evolving context. Our framework is fully compatible with FlashAttention. Experiments demonstrate that OjaKV maintains or improves zero-shot accuracy at high compression ratios, achieving the strongest gains on long-context benchmarks requiring complex reasoning. Furthermore, our approach combines with token-selection methods for compounded memory savings, establishing a practical, plug-and-play solution for memory-efficient long-context inference without fine-tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的扩展性强长上下文处理能力受到显著的内存瓶颈的限制：自动生成过程中所需的键值缓存就存在这一问题。这个瓶颈相当严重；例如，一个Llama-3.1-8B模型在批处理规模为4的情况下，处理一个包含32K个令牌的提示时，其键值缓存所需的内存大约达到16GB，这超过了模型权重所占用的内存。虽然通过低秩投影对键值缓存进行压缩是一种有前景的方法，但现有的方法依赖于静态的、离线学习得到的子空间，而在分布变化的情况下表现不佳。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了OjaKV这一新型框架，它结合了混合存储策略与在线子空间自适应技术。OjaKV能够将重要的令牌作为高保真度的锚点保留下来，同时利用Oja的算法对中间令牌进行低秩压缩，从而自适应地调整投影基函数。这种自适应过程包括在预填充阶段进行全面的更新，以及在解码过程中进行轻量级的周期性更新，以确保子空间始终与不断变化的上下文保持一致。我们的框架完全兼容FlashAttention。实验表明，OjaKV能够在较高的压缩比下保持或提升零样本识别的准确性，在需要复杂推理的长上下文任务上取得了显著的性能提升。此外，我们的方法还结合了令牌选择技术，进一步减少了内存消耗，从而提供了一种无需精细调优即可实现高效长上下文推理的解决方案。

papers.title: AURORA: Neuro-Symbolic Continual Indexing for Evolving RAG Systems
papers.title_zh: 奥罗拉：适用于动态变化的RAG系统的神经符号式连续索引技术
papers.authors: Manoj Saravanan, Rohit Kumar Salla, Ramya Manasa Amancherla
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems depend on non-parametric indices to access external knowledge, yet most retrieval infrastructure assumes a stationary query document distribution after index construction. In dynamic settings involving continual knowledge updates or evolving terminology, this assumption often fails, leading to degraded retrieval performance, while full re-indexing remains computationally expensive. We propose AURORA, a neuro-symbolic framework for adapting retrieval indices under distribution shift by treating index maintenance as a few-shot continual learning problem. AURORA decouples discrete index structure from continuous metric representations, enabling efficient adaptation of neural components while preserving index topology. A lightweight Bayesian routing policy further balances stability and plasticity by dynamically selecting among adaptive neural indices and static fallbacks based on uncertainty estimates. Across dense, learned sparse (SPLADE), and generative (DSI) retrieval settings, AURORA recovers up to +26.9% Recall@10 on novel topics compared to static baselines, while adapting significantly faster than full retraining (28 ms vs. 5.1 s).
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统依赖于非参数化指标来获取外部知识，然而大多数检索基础设施在索引构建后都假设查询文档的分布是固定的。在涉及持续知识更新或术语不断变化的动态环境中，这种假设往往无法成立，从而导致检索性能下降，而完全重新索引则会导致极高的计算成本。我们提出了AURORA这一神经符号框架，它通过将索引维护视为一种少量样本的持续学习问题，从而在分布变化的情况下调整检索索引。AURORA将离散索引结构与连续度量表示分离开来，使得神经组件能够高效适应变化，同时保留索引的拓扑结构。此外，该框架还采用了一种轻量级的贝叶斯路由策略，根据不确定性估计，动态地在自适应神经索引和静态回退方案之间选择最优方案，从而平衡了稳定性和可塑性。无论是在密集检索、稀疏检索还是生成式检索场景中，AURORA都能比静态基线模型在新型主题上提高高达26.9%的Recall@10指标，而其适应速度也远远快于完全重新训练（28毫秒对比5.1秒）。

papers.title: Decide less, communicate more: On the construct validity of end-to-end fact-checking in medicine
papers.title_zh: 少做决定，多进行沟通：关于医学领域端到端事实核查的构建效度
papers.authors: Sebastian Antony Joseph, Lily Chen, Barry Wei, Michael Mackert, Iain James Marshall, Paul Pu Liang, Ramez Kouzy, Byron C Wallace, Junyi Jessy Li
papers.abstract: Technological progress has led to concrete advancements in tasks that were regarded as challenging, such as automatic fact-checking. Interest in adopting these systems for public health and medicine has grown due to the high-stakes nature of medical decisions and challenges in critically appraising a vast and diverse medical literature. Evidence-based medicine connects to every individual, and yet the nature of it is highly technical, rendering the medical literacy of majority users inadequate to sufficiently navigate the domain. Such problems with medical communication ripen the ground for end-to-end fact-checking agents: check a claim against current medical literature and return with an evidence-backed verdict. And yet, such systems remain largely unused.In this position paper, developed with expert input, we present the first study examining how clinical experts verify real claims from social media by synthesizing medical evidence. In searching for this upper-bound, we reveal fundamental challenges in end-to-end fact-checking when applied to medicine: Difficulties connecting claims in the wild to scientific evidence in the form of clinical trials; ambiguities in underspecified claims mixed with mismatched intentions; and inherently subjective veracity labels. We argue that fact-checking should be approached as an interactive communication problem, rather than an end-to-end process.
papers.abstract_zh: 技术进步使得一些原本被认为具有挑战性的任务取得了实质性进展，比如自动事实核查。由于医疗决策的重要性以及评估大量复杂医学文献的困难性，人们越来越倾向于采用这些系统来推动公共卫生和医学领域的发展。循证医学与每个人息息相关，但这一领域又高度技术化，大多数用户的医学素养不足以充分应对这一领域的问题。这种医学沟通中的难题为端到端的事实核查系统提供了发展的机会：对某一说法进行核查，并给出基于证据的结论。然而，这样的系统目前仍然大多未被广泛应用。在这篇论文中，我们结合专家意见，首次研究了临床专家如何通过整合医学证据来验证社交媒体上的真实说法。在探索这一上限的过程中，我们发现当端到端的事实核查应用于医学领域时存在诸多基本挑战：难以将现实中的说法与临床试验形式的科学证据联系起来；表述不清的说法中存在模糊性，同时还存在意图不一致的问题；此外，事实核查的结果本身也带有主观性。我们认为，事实核查应该被视为一种互动式的沟通问题，而不仅仅是一个端到端的过程。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: K-GIP: Diagnosing Logical Fractures in Large Vision-Language Models via Verification Scene Graphs and Sequential Pruning
papers.title_zh: K-GIP：通过验证场景图与序列剪枝技术，诊断大型视觉语言模型中的逻辑缺陷
papers.authors: Yujun Hu, Xiaoyu Zhou, Changbo Wang, Gaoqi He
papers.abstract: Diagnosing fine-grained hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) can greatly advance their reliable deployment in real-world applications. Nevertheless, current benchmarks predominantly employ flat metrics that treat errors in isolation, leaving a gap in evaluating the complex causal dependencies between visual perception and textual reasoning. Motivated by this, we introduce the Knowledge-Guided In-Context Probing (K-GIP) framework to fill this gap. Specifically, K-GIP constructs a high-fidelity dual-perception ground truth to transform abstract priors into multi-granularity queries. Furthermore, we propose a Verification Scene Graph metric equipped with a Sequential Logic Pruning protocol, which explicitly models existence-attribute dependencies to strictly penalize logical fractures. We conduct comprehensive evaluations of mainstream LVLMs across three datasets using K-GIP. The experimental results highlight that our methodology successfully isolates deep reasoning failures from simple perceptual misses. We hope K-GIP can serve as a valuable and rigorous standard to assess logical robustness in multimodal systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大型视觉语言模型中诊断细微的幻觉现象，能够极大地提升这些模型在现实应用中的可靠性。然而，目前的评估基准主要使用单一指标来单独处理错误，这导致无法准确评估视觉感知与文本推理之间的复杂因果关系。基于这一需求，我们提出了知识引导的上下文探测框架K-GIP，以填补这一空白。具体来说，K-GIP构建了一个高保真度的双重感知真实场景，将抽象先验转化为多粒度查询。此外，我们还提出了一种带有顺序逻辑剪枝协议的验证场景图度量方法，该方法能够明确建模存在属性之间的依赖关系，从而严格惩罚逻辑上的断裂点。我们通过三个数据集对主流视觉语言模型进行了全面的评估，结果表明我们的方法成功地将深度推理失败与简单的感知失误区分开来。我们希望K-GIP能成为一种有价值且严谨的标准，用于评估多模态系统中的逻辑鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Static Inference to Dynamic Interaction: A Survey of Streaming Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从静态推理到动态交互：关于流式大规模语言模型的调查
papers.authors: Junlong Tong, Zilong Wang, YuJie Ren, Peiran Yin, Hao Wu, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen
papers.abstract: Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) are predominantly designed for static inference with pre-defined inputs, which limits their applicability in dynamic, real-time scenarios. To address this gap, the streaming LLM paradigm has emerged. However, existing definitions of streaming LLMs remain fragmented, conflating streaming generation, streaming inputs, and interactive streaming architectures, while a systematic taxonomy is still lacking. This paper provides a comprehensive overview and analysis of streaming LLMs. First, we establish a unified definition of streaming LLMs based on data flow and dynamic interaction to clarify existing ambiguities. Building on this definition, we propose a systematic taxonomy of current streaming LLMs and provide an in-depth discussion of their underlying methodologies across text, speech, and video streaming scenarios. Furthermore, we explore the applications of streaming LLMs in real-world scenarios and outline promising research directions to support ongoing advances in streaming intelligence. We maintain a continuously updated repository of relevant papers at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Awesome-Streaming-LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准的大语言模型主要用于具有预定义输入的静态推理任务，这限制了它们在动态、实时场景中的应用能力。为了弥补这一不足，流式语言模型的概念应运而生。然而，目前关于流式语言模型的定义仍然不够完善，往往将流式生成、流式输入以及交互式流式架构混为一谈，同时缺乏系统的分类体系。本文对流式语言模型进行了全面概述与分析。首先，我们基于数据流和动态交互的概念，提出了统一的流式语言模型定义，以消除现有的模糊性。在此基础上，我们对当前流行的流式语言模型进行了系统分类，并深入探讨了它们在文本、语音和视频流场景下的核心方法。此外，我们还探讨了流式语言模型在现实场景中的应用前景，并指出了未来研究的方向，以推动流式智能领域的持续发展。我们维护了一个持续更新的相关论文库，网址为https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Awesome-Streaming-LLMs。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: How Adversarial Environments Mislead Agentic AI?
papers.title_zh: 对抗性环境是如何误导智能代理人的？
papers.authors: Zhonghao Zhan, Huichi Zhou, Zhenhao Li, Peiyuan Jing, Krinos Li, Hamed Haddadi
papers.abstract: Tool-integrated agents are deployed on the premise that external tools ground their outputs in reality. Yet this very reliance creates a critical attack surface. Current evaluations benchmark capability in benign settings, asking “can the agent use tools correctly” but never “what if the tools lie”. We identify this Trust Gap: agents are evaluated for performance, not for skepticism. We formalize this vulnerability as Adversarial Environmental Injection (AEI), a threat model where adversaries compromise tool outputs to deceive agents. AEI constitutes environmental deception: constructing a “fake world” of poisoned search results and fabricated reference networks around unsuspecting agents. We operationalize this via Potemkin, a Model Context Protocol (MCP)-compatible harness for plug-and-play robustness testing. We identify two orthogonal attack surfaces: The Illusion (breadth attacks) poison retrieval to induce epistemic drift toward false beliefs, while The Maze (depth attacks) exploit structural traps to cause policy collapse into infinite loops. Across 11,000+ runs on five frontier agents, we find a stark robustness gap: resistance to one attack often increases vulnerability to the other, demonstrating that epistemic and navigational robustness are distinct capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具集成代理的部署基于这样一个前提：外部工具能够真实地生成其输出结果。然而，这种对外部工具的过度依赖恰恰构成了重要的攻击面。目前的评估通常只针对无害环境下的性能进行评判，即“代理能否正确使用工具”，却从未考虑“如果工具存在缺陷会怎样”的情况。我们发现了这种信任缺口：代理的评估主要基于性能表现，而非对潜在风险的考量。我们将这种漏洞定义为“对抗性环境注入”（Adversarial Environmental Injection，AEI），这是一种威胁模型，其中攻击者会破坏工具的输出结果以欺骗代理。AEI属于环境欺骗行为：它构建出一个“虚假世界”，其中包含被污染的搜索结果和伪造的参考网络，而这些都发生在毫无察觉的代理面前。我们通过Potemkin这一与模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）兼容的工具来实现这种攻击行为的检测。我们发现两种相互垂直的攻击面：第一种是“幻觉攻击”，它通过污染检索结果来诱导代理产生错误的认知；第二种是“迷宫攻击”，它通过利用结构上的陷阱导致策略陷入无限循环。在对五个前沿代理进行了超过11,000次测试后，我们发现了一个明显的脆弱性差距：对一种攻击的抵抗往往会增加另一种攻击的脆弱性，这表明认知鲁棒性和导航鲁棒性是两种不同的能力。

papers.title: GALA: Geometric Data Selection with Strategic Prospecting for Large Language Model Self-training
papers.title_zh: GALA：几何数据选择技术，结合策略性探索方法，用于大型语言模型的自我训练
papers.authors: Zhongwei Xie, Ruihao Liao, Zimo Wang, Chong Chen, Xian-Sheng Hua, Xiao Luo
papers.abstract: Self-training has emerged as a promising direction for autonomously improving large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches typically adopt a \textit{generate-and-filter} paradigm based on rejection sampling, which could suffer from inefficiency and low-quality reasoning paths. Towards this end, this paper proposes a novel framework named \underline{G}eometric D\underline{a}ta Se\underline{l}ection with Str\underline{a}tegic Prospecting (GALA) for LLM self-training. The core of our GALA is to identify diverse and informative samples from redundant data and exploit them more strategically. In particular, our proposed GALA first conducts clustering on latent sentence embeddings and then selects an anchor sample from each cluster based on the geometric distance to reduce data redundancy. To further exploit these samples, we conduct strategic brainstorming and reflection for high-quality reasoning trajectory prospecting. In addition, we introduce a lightweight dynamic validation module to validate the reliability of mini-batches to ensure the overall quality of the data. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the proposed GALA against several competing baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 自训练已成为自主改进大语言模型的一种有前景的方向。现有的方法通常采用基于拒绝抽样的“生成与过滤”范式，但这可能会带来效率低下和推理路径质量不佳的问题。为此，本文提出了一种名为“几何数据分割与策略性探索”的新型框架，用于大语言模型的自训练。我们的GALA的核心思想是从冗余数据中识别出多样化且具有信息量的样本，并更策略性地利用这些样本。具体来说，我们的GAL首先对潜在句子嵌入进行聚类，然后根据几何距离从每个簇中选择一个锚点样本，以减少数据冗余。为了进一步利用这些样本，我们进行了策略性的思考和反思，以推动高质量推理路径的探索。此外，我们还引入了一个轻量级的动态验证模块，以评估小批数据的可靠性，从而确保数据的整体质量。在多种基准测试上的广泛实验验证了所提出的GALA在多个竞争基准中的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PII-VisBench: Evaluating Personally Identifiable Information Safety in Vision Language Models Along a Continuum of Visibility
papers.title_zh: PII-VisBench：在可见性不同的背景下，评估视觉语言模型中个人可识别信息的安全性
papers.authors: G M Shahariar, Zabir Al Nazi, Md Olid Hasan Bhuiyan, Zhouxing Shi
papers.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly integrated into privacy-critical domains, yet existing evaluations of personally identifiable information (PII) leakage largely treat privacy as a static extraction task and ignore how a subject’s online presence—the volume of their data available online—influences privacy alignment. We introduce PII-VisBench, a novel benchmark containing 4,000 unique probes designed to evaluate VLM safety through the continuum of online presence. The benchmark stratifies 200 subjects into four visibility categories: high, medium, low, and zero—based on the extent and nature of their information available online. We evaluate 18 open-source VLMs (0.3B–32B) based on two key metrics: percentage of PII probing queries refused (Refusal Rate) and the fraction of non-refusal responses flagged for containing PII (Conditional PII Disclosure Rate). Across models, we observe a consistent pattern: refusals increase and PII disclosures decrease (9.10% high \rightarrow 5.34% low) as subject visibility drops. We identify that models are more likely to disclose PII for high-visibility subjects, alongside substantial model-family heterogeneity and PII-type disparities. Finally, paraphrasing and jailbreak-style prompts expose attack- and model-dependent failures, motivating visibility-aware safety evaluation and training interventions.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地被应用于需要保护隐私的领域中。然而，目前对个人可识别信息（PII）泄露的评估大多将隐私问题视为一种静态的提取任务，而忽略了用户的在线存在程度——即其数据在网上的数量——如何影响隐私保护效果。我们提出了PII-VisBench这一新的基准测试，该测试包含4,000个独特的测试案例，旨在通过不同的在线存在程度来评估VLM的安全性。该基准测试将200名受试者分为四个可见性等级：高、中、低和零，这些等级是根据他们在线信息的可用程度来划分的。我们评估了18种开源VLM模型，这些模型的规模从0.3B到32B不等。我们依据两个关键指标来评估这些模型：拒绝PII查询的比例（拒绝率）以及被标记为可能包含PII的非拒绝响应所占的比例（条件PII披露率）。我们发现，随着受试者可见性的降低，拒绝率上升，而PII的披露比例则下降（从高可见性的受试者为9.10%，降低到低可见性的受试者为5.34%）。我们还发现，对于高可见性的受试者，模型更有可能披露PII，而且不同模型之间存在显著的差异，同时PII的类型也存在差异。最后，通过改写提示和采用类似“越狱”式的提示方式，可以暴露出与攻击相关的模型缺陷，这促使我们需要进行更加考虑可见性的安全评估和训练干预措施。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Locate, Steer, and Improve: A Practical Survey of Actionable Mechanistic Interpretability in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 定位、引导与改进：关于大型语言模型中可操作机制可解释性的实用研究
papers.authors: Hengyuan Zhang, Zhihao Zhang, Ercong Nie, Mingyang Wang, Zunhai Su, Yiwei Wang, Qianli Wang, Shuzhou Yuan, Xufeng Duan, Qibo Xue, Zeping Yu, Chenming Shang, Xiao Liang, Jing Xiong, Hui Shen, Chaofan Tao, Zhengwu Liu, Senjie Jin, Zhiheng Xi, Dongdong Zhang, Sophia Ananiadou, Tao Gui, Ruobing Xie, Hayden Kwok-Hay So, Hinrich Schuetze, Xuanjing Huang, Qi Zhang, Ngai Wong
papers.abstract: Mechanistic Interpretability (MI) has emerged as a vital approach to demystify the opaque decision-making of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing reviews primarily treat MI as an observational science, summarizing analytical insights while lacking a systematic framework for actionable intervention. To bridge this gap, we present a practical survey structured around the pipeline: “Locate, Steer, and Improve.” We formally categorize Localizing (diagnosis) and Steering (intervention) methods based on specific Interpretable Objects to establish a rigorous intervention protocol. Furthermore, we demonstrate how this framework enables tangible improvements in Alignment, Capability, and Efficiency, effectively operationalizing MI as a practical engineering toolkit for model optimization. The curated paper list of this work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Act-MI-F068.
papers.abstract_zh: 机制可解释性（MI）已成为揭示大语言模型（LLM）不透明决策过程的关键方法。然而，现有的研究大多将MI视为一种观察性科学，仅总结分析见解，而缺乏用于实施实际干预的系统框架。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个以“定位、指导与改进”为框架的实际性研究方案。我们根据具体的可解释对象对定位方法和指导方法进行分类，从而建立一套严谨的干预方案。此外，我们还展示了该框架如何在实际中提升模型的对齐性、能力和效率，使MI真正成为优化模型的实用工程工具包。本研究的论文列表可在以下链接查看：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Act-MI-F068
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MTRAG-UN: A Benchmark for Open Challenges in Multi-Turn RAG Conversations
papers.title_zh: MTRAG-UN：多轮RAG对话中开放挑战的基准标准
papers.authors: Sara Rosenthal, Yannis Katsis, Vraj Shah, Lihong He, Lucian Popa, Marina Danilevsky
papers.abstract: We present MTRAG-UN, a benchmark for exploring open challenges in multi-turn retrieval augment generation, a popular use of large language models. We release a benchmark of 666 tasks from 666 conversations containing over 2,800 conversation turns across 6 domains with accompanying corpora. Our experiments show that retrieval and generation models continue to struggle on conversations with UNanswerable, UNderspecified, and NONstandalone questions and UNclear responses. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/IBM/mt-rag-benchmark
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了MTRAG-UN这一基准测试，用于探索多轮检索增强生成中的开放挑战问题。多轮检索增强生成是大语言模型的常见应用场景。我们发布了包含666个任务的基准测试，这些任务来自666段对话，每段对话包含超过2800个对话轮次，涉及6个不同的领域，并附有相应的语料库。我们的实验表明，检索和生成模型在处理包含无法回答的问题、未明确指定的问题、非独立性的问题以及不明确回答的对话时仍然存在困难。我们的基准测试可以在https://github.com/IBM/mt-rag-benchmark下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Vision-Language Models Mistake Head Orientation for Gaze Direction: Nonverbal Conversation Cues
papers.title_zh: 视觉语言模型误将头部方向视为注视方向：非言语交流线索
papers.authors: Zory Zhang, Pinyuan Feng, Bingyang Wang, Tianwei Zhao, Suyang Yu, Qingying Gao, Hokin Deng, Ziqiao Ma, Yijiang Li, Dezhi Luo
papers.abstract: Where someone looks is a nonverbal communication cue that children and adults readily use.How well can Vision-Language Models (VLMs) infer gaze targets? To construct evaluation stimuli, we captured 1,360 real-world photos of scenes in which a person gazes at one of several objects on a table. Importantly, we also controlled the gazer’s head orientation: sometimes it was directed toward the gaze target, sometimes toward a distractor object, and sometimes left unconstrained. We found a substantial performance gap between VLMs and humans, ruled out alternative explanations such as resolution and object-naming skills, and identified the main reason for the gap as VLMs inferring gaze direction using head orientation rather than eye appearance.Such a bias is likely due to data rather than architecture, as suggested by a proof-of-concept experiment finetuning a transformer-based vision model.Future work should investigate whether these findings hold broadly across various deep learning methods trained on existing data, and whether better data mitigates this problem for all architectures.Pinpointing the reason sets the stage for technologies that can interpret gaze targets to have more efficient interactions with humans.
papers.abstract_zh: 一个人的注视是一种非语言沟通信号，儿童和成人都会轻易使用这种信号。视觉-语言模型在推断注视目标方面能表现得如何呢？为了构建评估刺激，我们收集了1,360张现实场景的照片，这些照片中有人注视着桌子上的某个物体。重要的是，我们还控制了注视者的头部方向：有时头部朝向注视目标，有时朝向干扰物，有时则保持不固定。我们发现视觉-语言模型和人类在性能上存在显著差距，排除了分辨率和物体命名能力等替代解释，并确定造成这种差距的主要原因是视觉-语言模型是通过头部方向来推断注视方向的，而不是通过眼睛的外观来判断。这种偏见可能是由于数据问题而非架构问题导致的，这一点通过一项概念验证实验得到了证实，该实验对基于变换器的视觉模型进行了微调。未来的研究应该探讨这些发现是否适用于各种在现有数据上训练的深度学习方法，以及更好的数据是否能够缓解所有架构所面临的这个问题。明确原因有助于开发能够准确识别注视目标的技术，从而让技术与人类的互动更加高效。

papers.title: RepoShapley: Shapley-Enhanced Context Filtering for Repository-Level Code Completion
papers.title_zh: RepoShapley：一种改进的上下文过滤算法，适用于代码仓库级别的代码补全功能
papers.authors: Yu Huo, Kun Zeng, Siyu Zhang, Yuquan LU, Cheng Yang, Yifu Guo, Xiaoying Tang
papers.abstract: Repository-level code completion benefits from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). However, controlling cross-file evidence is difficult because chunk utility is often interaction-dependent: some snippets help only when paired with complementary context, while others harm decoding when they conflict. We propose RepoShapley, a coalition-aware context filtering framework supervised by Shapley-style marginal contributions. Our offline labeling module, ChunkShapley, estimates signed per-chunk effects via teacher-forced probing, feeds them into a lightweight surrogate game that captures saturation and interference, computes exact Shapley values for small retrieval sets, and selects a decoding-optimal coalition through bounded post-verification with the frozen generator. The verified <KEEP> / <DROP> decisions and retrieval triggers are then distilled into a single model via discrete control tokens. Experiments across benchmarks and backbones show that RepoShapley improves completion quality while reducing harmful context and unnecessary retrieval.
papers.abstract_zh: 仓库级代码补全功能可以充分利用检索增强生成技术。然而，控制不同文件之间的信息关联却很困难，因为代码片段的效用往往取决于上下文环境：有些代码片段只有在与互补的上下文结合时才能发挥作用，而另一些代码片段则会在与现有信息冲突时干扰解码过程。我们提出了RepoShapley框架，它是一个具有联盟意识的上下文过滤机制，其决策基于Shapley式的边际贡献计算方式。我们的离线标注模块ChunkShapley通过教师强制的探测方法，估算出每个代码片段的效应值，并将这些数值输入到一个轻量级的替代游戏中，以捕捉饱和度和干扰现象。该模型还能为较小的检索集计算出精确的Shapley值，并通过有界验证机制，结合固定的生成器，选出最优的解码策略。经过验证的<保留>/<丢弃>决策以及检索触发条件，最终被整合成一个单一的模型，并通过离散的控制令牌进行执行。在多个基准测试和主干系统上的实验表明，RepoShapley能够提升代码补全的质量，同时减少有害的上下文信息和不必要的检索操作。

papers.title: Red-Teaming NSFW Image Classifiers as Text-to-Image Safeguards
papers.title_zh: 利用红色诱骗方法将不适宜观看的图像分类器转化为文本到图像转换的防护手段
papers.authors: Tinghao Xie, Yueqi Xie, Alireza Zareian, Shuming Hu, Felix Juefei-Xu, Xiaowen Lin, Ankit Jain, Prateek Mittal, Li Chen
papers.abstract: Not Safe for Work (NSFW) image classifiers play a critical role in safeguarding text-to-image (T2I) systems. However, a concerning phenomenon has emerged in T2I systems – changes in text prompts that manipulate benign image elements can result in failed detection by NSFW classifiers – dubbed “context shifts.” For instance, while a NSFW image of “a nude person in an empty scene” can be easily blocked by most NSFW classifiers, a stealthier one that depicts “a nude person blending in a group of dressed people” may evade detection. We ask: how to systematically reveal NSFW image classifiers’ failure against such context shifts?Towards this end, we present an automated red-teaming framework that leverages a set of generative AI tools. We propose an exploration-exploitation approach: First, in the exploration stage, we synthesize a diverse and massive 36K NSFW image dataset that facilitates our study of context shifts. We find that varying fractions (e.g., 4.1% to 36% nude and sexual content) of the dataset are misclassified by NSFW image classifiers like GPT-4o and Gemini. Second, in the exploitation stage, we leverage these failure cases to train a specialized LLM that rewrites unseen seed prompts into more evasive versions, increasing the likelihood of detection evasion by up to 6 times. Alarmingly, we show these failures translate to real-world T2I and even T2V systems like DALL-E 3, Sora, Nano Banana, and Veo 3 – beyond the open-weight image generators in our main study. For example, querying DALL-E 3 with prompts rewritten by our approach increases the chance of obtaining NSFW images from 0 to over 50%.
papers.abstract_zh: 不适合工作（NSFW）图像分类器在保护文本到图像系统方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，在文本到图像系统中出现了一个令人担忧的现象——文本提示的变更可能会改变图像的良性元素，从而导致NSFW分类器无法检测到这些图像，这种现象被称为“上下文偏移”。例如，一张“空旷场景中的裸体人物”的NSFW图片很容易被大多数NSFW分类器识别出来，而一张更隐蔽的图片，比如“裸体人物融入一群穿着衣服的人中”，却可能逃脱检测。我们的问题是：如何系统地揭示NSFW图像分类器在应对这种上下文偏移时的失败情况呢？为此，我们提出了一个自动化增强框架，该框架利用了一系列生成式AI工具。我们采用了一种探索与利用相结合的方法：首先，在探索阶段，我们合成了一个包含36K张NSFW图片的庞大数据集，以便研究上下文偏移现象。我们发现，当数据集中裸体和性内容的占比从4.1%增加到36%时，NSFW分类器如GPT-4o和Gemini会误分类这些图片。其次，在利用阶段，我们利用这些失败案例来训练一个专门的LLM，使其能够将未见过的提示重新编写成更具迷惑性的版本，从而将检测规避的可能性提高至6倍以上。令人担忧的是，这些失败案例实际上会影响现实世界的文本到图像甚至文本到视频系统，比如DALL-E 3、Sora、Nano Banana和Veo 3——甚至包括我们主要研究中的开放权重图像生成器。例如，使用我们的方法重新编写的提示来查询DALL-E 3时，获得NSFW图片的概率从0上升到了50%以上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Model-Agnostic Meta Learning for Class Imbalance Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 一种与模型类型无关的元学习算法，适用于类别不平衡问题的适应处理
papers.authors: Hanshu Rao, Guangzeng Han, Xiaolei Huang
papers.abstract: Class imbalance is a widespread challenge in NLP tasks, significantly hindering robust performance across diverse domains and applications. We introduce Hardness-Aware Meta-Resample (HAMR), a unified framework that adaptively addresses both class imbalance and data difficulty. HAMR employs bi-level optimizations to dynamically estimate instance-level weights that prioritize genuinely challenging samples and minority classes, while a neighborhood-aware resampling mechanism amplifies training focus on hard examples and their semantically similar neighbors. We validate HAMR on six imbalanced datasets covering multiple tasks and spanning biomedical, disaster response, and sentiment domains. Experimental results show that HAMR achieves substantial improvements for minority classes and consistently outperforms strong baselines. Extensive ablation studies demonstrate that our proposed modules synergistically contribute to performance gains and highlight HAMR as a flexible and generalizable approach for class imbalance adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 类不平衡是自然语言处理任务中普遍存在的挑战，它严重阻碍了在不同领域和应用中取得稳健的性能表现。我们提出了一种名为“难度感知元重采样”的框架，该框架能够自适应地解决类不平衡和数据难度问题。HAMR采用双层优化算法来动态估计实例级别的权重，从而优先处理真正具有挑战性的样本和少数类样本。同时，通过一种基于邻域的重采样机制，可以加强训练对困难样本及其语义相似邻居的关注。我们在六个不平衡数据集上验证了HAMR的有效性，这些数据集涵盖了生物医学、灾难响应和情感分析等多个领域。实验结果表明，HAMR在改善少数类样本的性能方面取得了显著成效，其性能始终优于其他强大的基线方法。广泛的消融研究表明，我们提出的各个模块协同作用，共同提升了性能表现。这表明HAMR是一种灵活且可推广的方法，适用于类不平衡问题的自适应处理。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: PAPERMIND: Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning and Critique over Scientific Papers in Multimodal LLMs
papers.title_zh: PAPERMIND：在多模态大语言模型中对科学论文进行主动推理与评论的基准测试
papers.authors: Yanjun Zhao, Tianxin Wei, Jiaru Zou, Xuying Ning, Yuanchen Bei, Lingjie Chen, Simmi Rana, Wendy H. Yang, Hanghang Tong, Jingrui He
papers.abstract: Understanding scientific papers requires more than answering isolated questions or summarizing content. It involves an integrated reasoning process that grounds textual and visual information, interprets experimental evidence, synthesizes information across sources, and critically evaluates scientific claims. However, existing benchmarks typically assess these abilities in isolation, making it difficult to evaluate scientific paper understanding as a unified set of interacting cognitive abilities. In this work, we introduce PaperMind , a benchmark designed to evaluate integrated and agent-oriented scientific reasoning over research papers. PaperMind is constructed from real scientific papers across seven domains, including agriculture, biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, physics, and economics. It comprises four complementary task families that collectively operationalize distinct cognitive facets of scientific paper reasoning, including multimodal grounding, experimental interpretation, cross-source evidence reasoning, and critical assessment. By analyzing model behavior across multiple tasks, PaperMind enables a diagnostic evaluation of integrated scientific reasoning behaviors that are difficult to assess through isolated task evaluations. Extensive experiments on both open-source and closed-source multimodal LLMs reveal consistent performance gaps across tasks, highlighting persistent challenges in integrated scientific reasoning and critique. Our benchmark and dataset are available at https://github.com/Yanjun-Zhao/PaperMind.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解科学论文不仅仅需要回答孤立的问题或总结内容。它涉及一个综合的推理过程，该过程将文本和视觉信息结合起来，解读实验证据，跨来源整合信息，并批判性地评估科学主张。然而，现有的评估基准通常只单独评估这些能力，因此很难将理解科学论文视为一组相互关联的认知能力的整体。在这项研究中，我们引入了PaperMind这一基准测试工具，用于评估对研究论文进行综合和面向主体的科学推理能力。PaperMind基于七个领域的真实科学论文构建而成，包括农业、生物学、化学、计算机科学、医学、物理学和经济学等领域。它包含四个互补的任务系列，分别涵盖了科学论文推理的不同认知方面，如多模态基础定位、实验解释、跨源证据推理以及批判性评估。通过分析模型在多个任务中的表现，PaperMind能够诊断出难以通过孤立任务评估出来的综合科学推理行为。在开源和闭源的多模态大语言模型中进行的广泛实验表明，不同任务之间存在一致的性能差距，这凸显了在综合科学推理和批判性评估方面存在的持续挑战。我们的基准测试和数据集可以在https://github.com/Yanjun-Zhao/PaperMind下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Scenes to Elements: Multi-Granularity Evidence Retrieval for Verifiable Multimodal RAG
papers.title_zh: 从场景到元素：用于验证性多模态信息检索的多种粒度证据检索方法
papers.authors: Guanhua Chen, Chuyue Huang, Yutong Yao, Shudong Liu, Xueqing Song, Lidia S. Chao, Derek F. Wong
papers.abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems retrieve evidence at coarse granularities (entire images or scenes), creating a mismatch with fine-grained user queries and making failures unverifiable. We introduce GranuVistaVQA, a multimodal benchmark featuring real-world landmarks with element-level annotations across multiple viewpoints, capturing the partial observation challenge where individual images contain only subsets of entities. We further propose GranuRAG, a multi-granularity framework that treats visual elements as first-class retrieval units through three stages: element-level detection and classification, multi-granularity cross-modal alignment for evidence retrieval, and attribution-constrained generation. By grounding retrieval at the element level rather than relying on implicit attention, our approach enables transparent error diagnosis. Experiments demonstrate that GranuRAG achieves up to 29.2% improvement over six strong baselines for this task.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态检索增强生成（RAG）系统能够以粗略的粒度检索证据（如整幅图像或场景），这会与细粒度的用户查询产生不匹配，导致失败情况难以验证。我们提出了GranuVistaVQA这一多模态基准测试，该测试包含真实世界中的地标，并在多个视角下对元素级信息进行标注，能够应对“部分观测挑战”——即单个图像仅包含部分实体。我们还提出了GranuRAG框架，它是一个多粒度框架，通过将视觉元素视为一级检索单元，通过三个阶段来实现证据检索：元素级检测和分类、多粒度跨模态对齐以及基于归因约束的生成。通过以元素级别进行检索，而不是依赖隐式注意力机制，我们的方法能够实现透明的错误诊断。实验表明，GranuRAG在该任务上的性能比六个强大的基线模型提升了高达29.2%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Region-R1: Reinforcing Query-Side Region Cropping for Multi-Modal Re-Ranking
papers.title_zh: 区域R1：加强查询端区域的裁剪功能，以实现多模态重新排序
papers.authors: Chan-Wei Hu, Zhengzhong Tu
papers.abstract: Multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation (MM-RAG) relies heavily on re-rankers to surface the most relevant evidence for image-question queries. However, standard re-rankers typically process the full query image as a global embedding, making them susceptible to visual distractors (e.g., background clutter) that skew similarity scores.We propose Region-R1, a query-side region cropping framework that formulates region selection as a decision-making problem during re-ranking, allowing the system to learn to retain the full image or focus only on a question-relevant region before scoring the retrieved candidates. Region-R1 learns a policy with a novel region-aware group relative policy optimization (r-GRPO) to dynamically crop a discriminative region. Across two challenging benchmarks, E-VQA and InfoSeek, Region-R1 delivers consistent gains, achieving state-of-the-art performances by increasing conditional Recall@1 by up to 20%. These results show the great promise of query-side adaptation as a simple but effective way to strengthen MM-RAG re-ranking.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态检索增强生成（MM-RAG）系统在很大程度上依赖重新排序算法来筛选出与图像-问题查询最相关的信息。然而，传统的重新排序算法通常会将整个查询图像作为一个整体嵌入进行处理，这就使得系统容易受到视觉干扰因素的影响，比如背景中的杂乱元素，这些干扰因素会扭曲相似度评分的结果。我们提出了Region-R1这一查询端区域裁剪框架，它将区域选择过程视为重新排序过程中的一个决策问题。通过这种框架，系统可以学习如何保留完整的图像，或者只关注与问题相关的区域，然后再对候选结果进行评分。Region-R1采用了一种创新的基于区域感知的群体相对策略优化方法，能够动态裁剪出具有辨识度的区域。在E-VQA和InfoSeek这两个具有挑战性的基准测试中，Region-R1取得了稳定的性能提升，将条件召回率@1提升了高达20%。这些结果表明，查询端自适应技术是一种简单而有效的增强MM-RAG重新排序能力的方法，具有巨大的潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Reward-Guided Dual-Phase Framework for Adaptive Inference-Time Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 一种基于奖励引导的双阶段框架，用于自适应推理时间推理
papers.authors: Yingqian Cui, Zhenwei Dai, Pengfei He, Bing He, Hui Liu, Zhan Shi, Xianfeng Tang, Jingying Zeng, Suhang Wang, Yue Xing, Jiliang Tang, Benoit Dumoulin
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made strong progress in reasoning. To enhance the reasoning performance, a common inference-time approach is tree-based search, which decomposes the reasoning process into multiple steps, expands multiple reasoning paths, and uses reward models to prune and select candidates. However, based on our exploration, the simple decomposition may lead to suboptimal searching efficiency: while planning is generally harder, it is the execution errors that are more likely to propagate to later steps. This indicates that planning and execution play different roles in reasoning and should be treated differently during tree-based search. Given this, to enhance the searching efficiency, we propose a dual-phase test-time scaling framework that separates reasoning into planning and execution, and performs search over each phase independently. To further refine the algorithm, we also introduce a dynamic budget allocation mechanism that adaptively redistributes sampling effort based on reward feedback, allowing early stopping on confident steps and reallocation of computation to more challenging steps. Experiments on both math reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently improves accuracy while reducing redundant computation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在推理能力方面取得了显著进展。为了提升推理性能，常见的推理时间处理方法是基于树的搜索算法。这种算法将推理过程分解为多个步骤，探索多种推理路径，并利用奖励模型来筛选和选择最优解。然而，根据我们的实验发现，这种简单的分解方式可能导致搜索效率低下：虽然规划阶段通常较为困难，但执行阶段的错误更有可能影响到后续步骤。这表明，规划和执行在推理过程中扮演着不同的角色，因此在基于树的搜索中应该采取不同的处理方式。为了进一步提高搜索效率，我们提出了一种双阶段测试时间扩展框架，将推理任务分为规划和执行两个阶段，分别独立进行搜索。为了进一步完善算法，我们还引入了动态预算分配机制，该机制能够根据奖励反馈动态调整采样力度，从而在确信可行的步骤上提前停止搜索，并将计算资源重新分配到更具挑战性的步骤上。在数学推理和代码生成等基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法能够持续提升准确性，同时减少冗余的计算量。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LVLM-Aware Multimodal Retrieval for RAG-Based Medical Diagnosis with General-Purpose Models
papers.title_zh: 基于多模态检索的医学诊断系统——适用于通用模型的RAG技术
papers.authors: Nir Mazor, Tom Hope
papers.abstract: Retrieving visual and textual information from medical literature and hospital records can enhance diagnostic accuracy for clinical image interpretation. However, multimodal retrieval-augmented diagnosis is highly challenging. We explore a lightweight mechanism for enhancing diagnostic performance of retrieval-augmented LVLMs. We train an LVLM-aware multimodal retriever, such that the retriever learns to return images and texts that guide the LVLM toward correct predictions. In our low-resource setting, we perform only lightweight fine-tuning with small amounts of data, and use only general-purpose backbone models, achieving competitive results in clinical classification and VQA tasks compared to medically pre-trained models with extensive training. In a novel analysis, we highlight a previously unexplored class of errors that we term inconsistent retrieval predictions: cases where different top-retrieved images yield different predictions for the same target. We find that these cases are challenging for all models, even for non-retrieval models, and that our retrieval optimization mechanism significantly improves these cases over standard RAG. However, our analysis also sheds light on gaps in the ability of LVLMs to utilize retrieved information for clinical predictions.
papers.abstract_zh: 从医学文献和医院记录中提取视觉和文本信息可以提高临床图像解读的诊断准确性。然而，基于多模态检索的增强诊断方法面临着巨大挑战。我们提出了一种轻量级机制，用于提升基于检索增强的LVLM的诊断性能。我们训练了一种具备LVLM感知的多模态检索器，使得该检索器能够返回有助于LVLM做出正确预测的图像和文本。在资源有限的情况下，我们只使用少量数据进行轻量级微调，并仅使用通用型主干模型，与经过大量训练的医学预训练模型相比，我们在临床分类和视觉问答任务中取得了具有竞争力的结果。在一项新颖的分析中，我们发现了一种之前未被探索的错误类型，我们将其称为“检索预测不一致”的情况：即不同的顶部检索图像对同一目标产生不同的预测。我们发现，这种情况对所有模型来说都是具有挑战性的，即使是对于非检索模型也是如此。我们的检索优化机制显著改善了这类情况，优于标准的RAG方法。不过，我们的分析也揭示了LVLM在利用检索到的信息进行临床预测方面的能力存在不足。

papers.title: Detecting Proxy Gaming in RL and LLM Alignment via Evaluator Stress Tests
papers.title_zh: 在强化学习和大型语言模型对齐中检测代理游戏行为，通过评估器压力测试来实现
papers.authors: Sanjeda Akter, Ibne Farabi Shihab, Anuj Sharma
papers.abstract: Proxy optimization, where AI systems exploit evaluator weaknesses rather than improve intended objectives, threatens both reinforcement learning (reward hacking) and LLM alignment (evaluator gaming). We introduce the Evaluator Stress Test (EST), an invariance-based framework that detects proxy gaming by separating exploitable sensitivity (e.g., format, physics bugs) from content-driven improvements using controlled perturbations with semantic validity audits. We validate EST across both domains. In RL, across 15 environments and 5 algorithms (2,156 expert-annotated episodes), EST achieves 78.4% precision and 81.7% recall. In LLM alignment, across 4 tasks, 2 model scales, 2 training methods, and 2 judges (1,200 human-annotated instances), EST achieves 74.2% precision and 78.6% recall with early warning signals preceding quality decline. Cross-domain analysis reveals that proxy-true correlation tracking transfers directly between domains, while perturbation design requires domain adaptation. Closed-loop mitigation improves human win-rate by 8.3 points (LLM) and reduces hacking by 54.6% (RL). We release benchmarks for both domains: 2,156 RL episodes and 1,200 LLM instances.
papers.abstract_zh: 代理优化是指人工智能系统利用评估器的弱点来达到目的，这种行为既威胁着强化学习中的奖励窃取行为，也影响了大语言模型对齐的效果。我们提出了“评估器压力测试”这一基于不变性的框架，该框架通过控制性扰动来分离出可被利用的缺陷（如格式问题、物理错误等）与基于内容的改进措施，并通过语义有效性审核来识别这些代理行为。我们在两个领域对EST进行了验证：在强化学习中，通过对15种环境和5种算法进行实验，共2,156个专家标注的案例，EST的精确率为78.4%，召回率为81.7%；在大语言模型对齐方面，通过对4项任务、2种模型规模、2种训练方法以及2组评判者（共1,200个人类标注的案例）进行实验，EST的精确率为74.2%，召回率为78.6%，并且能够在质量下降之前发出预警信号。跨领域分析表明，代理行为与真实情况之间的相关性可以在不同领域之间直接转移，而扰动设计的调整则需要针对特定领域进行适配。闭环缓解策略能够将人类获胜率提高8.3个百分点（针对大语言模型的情况），并将奖励窃取行为减少54.6%（针对强化学习的情况）。我们为这两个领域发布了相应的基准数据：强化学习方面有2,156个案例，大语言模型方面有1,200个实例。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Do Language Models Think Consistently? A Study of Value Preferences Across Varying Response Lengths
papers.title_zh: 语言模型是否始终保持一致性？对不同响应时长下价值偏好的研究
papers.authors: Inderjeet Jayakumar Nair, Lu Wang
papers.abstract: Evaluations of LLMs’ ethical risks and value inclinations often rely on short-form surveys and psychometric tests, yet real-world use involves long-form, open-ended responses—leaving value-related risks and preferences in practical settings largely underexplored. In this work, we ask: Do value preferences inferred from short-form tests align with those expressed in long-form outputs? To address this question, we compare value preferences elicited from short-form reactions and long-form responses, varying the number of arguments in the latter to capture users’ differing verbosity preferences. Analyzing five LLMs (llama3-8b, gemma2-9b, mistral-7b, qwen2-7b, and olmo-7b), we find (1) a weak correlation between value preferences inferred from short-form and long-form responses across varying argument counts, and (2) similarly weak correlation between preferences derived from any two distinct long-form generation settings. (3 Alignment yields only modest gains in the consistency of value expression. Further, we examine how long-form generation attributes relate to value preferences, finding that argument specificity negatively correlates with preference strength, while representation across scenarios shows a positive correlation. Our findings underscore the need for more robust methods to ensure consistent value expression across diverse applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 对大语言模型伦理风险与价值倾向的评估通常依赖于简短形式的调查和心理测量测试。然而，在实际应用过程中，用户需要给出长篇幅、开放式回答——这使得在实际情况中有关价值倾向的风险和偏好被严重忽视了。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个问题：从简短形式测试中得出的价值偏好是否与从长篇幅输出中表达出的偏好一致？为了解答这个问题，我们比较了从简短形式反应得出的价值偏好与从长篇幅回答中得出的偏好，并改变了后者的论点数量，以反映用户不同的详细程度偏好。通过对五款大语言模型（llama3-8b、gemma2-9b、mistral-7b、qwen2-7b和olmo-7b）的分析，我们发现：（1）在不同论点数量的情况下，从简短形式和长篇幅响应中得出的价值偏好之间存在弱相关性；（2）从任何两种不同长篇幅生成方式得出的偏好之间也存在类似的弱相关性。（3）这种一致性提升对价值表达的一致性仅带来适度的改善。此外，我们还研究了长篇幅生成属性与价值偏好之间的关系，发现论点的具体性与偏好强度呈负相关，而跨场景的表示则呈现正相关。我们的研究结果强调了需要更可靠的方法来确保不同应用场景下价值表达的一致性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LEDGER: Scaling Agentic Document Editing with Dependency-aware Graph Retrieval
papers.title_zh: LEDGER：利用依赖关系感知的图检索技术来高效处理代理文档编辑工作
papers.authors: Hang Wang, Utkarsh Garg, Reza Davari, Huitian Jiao, Hao Cheng, Baolin Peng, Si-Qing Chen, Tao Ge
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly power AI agents for tasks requiring iterative refinement: document editing demands targeted revisions while preserving cross-references, code refactoring requires tracking function dependencies, and knowledge base updates cascade through related entities. Iterative editing with AI agents faces a fundamental efficiency-consistency tradeoff: maintaining consistency requires full-context awareness of dependencies, but processing entire documents for each edit incurs prohibitive token costs and latency. Isolated edits improve efficiency but risk breaking cross-references and violating semantic constraints. We introduce LEDGER (scaLing Agentic document editing with Dependency-aware Graph rEtRieval), a framework that constructs lightweight dependency graphs capturing semantic relationships and structural hierarchies across document elements. For each edit, graph traversal identifies affected elements and retrieves only necessary context. Experiments across 1,900 test cases spanning six state-of-the-art models show LEDGER achieves 76 consistency versus 56 baseline while reducing token usage by 85 . Critically, LEDGER with low reasoning effort matches baseline performance at high reasoning effort using 70 fewer tokens, suggesting explicit dependency representations can substitute for expensive internal reasoning with implications for agentic systems operating on structured data.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正在为那些需要迭代优化的任务提供强大的人工智能代理支持：文档编辑需要进行有针对性的修改，同时保留交叉引用；代码重构则需要跟踪函数的依赖关系；知识库的更新则会通过相关实体进行传递。使用人工智能代理进行迭代编辑面临着一个基本的效率与一致性之间的权衡：保持一致性需要完全了解依赖关系，但每次编辑时处理整个文档会导致过高的标记成本和延迟。单独的编辑可以提高效率，但有可能破坏交叉引用并违反语义约束。我们提出了LEDGER（带有依赖关系感知的文档编辑框架），该框架构建了一个轻量级的依赖关系图，能够捕捉文档元素之间的语义关系和结构层次。对于每一次编辑，图遍历可以识别出受影响的元素，并只获取必要的上下文信息。在涵盖了六种先进模型的1,900个测试案例中进行实验后，我们发现LEDGER在一致性方面的表现达到了76，而基准水平仅为56；同时，标记使用的数量减少了85。关键的是，当推理负担较低时，LEDGER的性能可以与基准水平相媲美；而在高推理负担的情况下，它使用的标记数量却少了70。这表明，明确的依赖关系表示可以替代昂贵的内部推理过程，这对在处理结构化数据的人工智能系统来说具有重要意义。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: NSF-CoT: Neuro-Symbolic Formal Verification of Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness in Contextual Question Answering
papers.title_zh: NSF-CoT：在上下文问答中，通过神经符号方法验证思维链的一致性
papers.authors: Vishal Pramanik, Maisha Maliha, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Alvaro Velasquez, Susmit Jha, Sumit Kumar Jha
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting makes language models write step-by-step explanations, but these steps may not match what the model actually used to choose its answer. Existing faithfulness checks often only test whether changing the written chain changes the answer, without verifying whether the steps are truly supported by the given evidence, or they require special prompts that do not generalize well. We present NSF-CoT, a neuro-symbolic formal verification method that checks CoT faithfulness step by step for contextual question answering. NSF-CoT (1) converts the provided context facts and each reasoning step into simple logical statements, (2) uses counterfactual attribution to estimate which context facts the model relied on while generating each step, and (3) verifies each step using a hybrid checker that combines an SMT solver with an LLM-based entailment judge. For every step, we score groundedness (supported by the full context), validity (supported by the facts the model relied on), and utility (helps reach the final answer), and combine them into a faithfulness score. Across OpenBookQA, QASC, and HotpotQA, NSF-CoT consistently outperforms causal mediation, perturbation probes, and behavioral monitoring, and it identifies reasoning steps that are not only unfaithful but also harmful to the model’s final decision.
papers.abstract_zh: 上下文连贯性提示能够促使语言模型逐步写出解释，但这些步骤可能与模型实际用于选择答案的过程并不一致。现有的忠实性检查通常只测试改变书面步骤后答案是否发生变化，而未能验证这些步骤是否真正得到了给定证据的支撑；此外，现有的方法通常需要特殊的提示，且通用性较差。我们提出了NSF-CoT这一神经符号形式化验证方法，它能够针对上下文问题回答进行逐步的上下文连贯性检查。NSF-CoT的具体步骤如下：1. 将提供的上下文事实和每个推理步骤转换为简单的逻辑陈述；2. 使用反事实归因方法来估计模型在生成每个步骤时所依赖的上下文事实；3. 利用结合SMT求解器和基于LLM的蕴含判断器的混合验证器来检验每个步骤的正确性。对于每一个步骤，我们会评估其合理性（由整个上下文支持）、有效性（由模型所依赖的事实支持）以及实用性（有助于得出最终答案），并将这些指标综合成一个忠实性评分。在OpenBookQA、QASC和HotpotQA等多个任务中，NSF-CoT始终表现出优于因果中介分析、扰动探测和行为监控等方法的效果，并且能够识别出那些不仅不忠实于实际情况，而且还会对模型最终决策产生负面影响的推理步骤。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Learning Flexible Large Multimodal Models with Arbitrary Modality Combinations
papers.title_zh: 学习具有灵活架构的大型多模态模型，并支持任意模态组合方式
papers.authors: Xinyu Zhao, Kangqi Ni, Jie Peng, Ang Li, Tianlong Chen
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong potential for cross-modal understanding by integrating powerful language models with multimodal encoders. However, extending MLLMs to handle a diverse range of modalities introduces two critical and intertwined challenges: (1) the reliance on fully paired multimodal data, often scarce or costly to acquire across all modalities, and (2) the computational inefficiency from processing numerous modality tokens and requiring substantial model updates for each new modality. To address these challenges, we enable MLLMs to handle missing modalities by generating representations for absent inputs. Furthermore, recognizing that an increasing number of modalities leads to linearly scaling token counts and that lengthy generated sequences can hinder performance, we employ a dual-stage compression mechanism. It first reduces the number of tokens per modality and then condenses information from multiple modalities into a single, compact token sequence. This culminates in Flex-M^3, a novel MLLM framework designed for flexible and efficient learning across arbitrary combinations of modalities. Experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks and backbones demonstrate that Flex-M^3 robustly handles varied modality inputs and scales efficiently. Notably, Flex-M outperforms its counterpart trained on only full-modality data, with consistent improvements of 2.29%, 3.15%, 11.01% on multimodal reasoning tasks NExT-QA, MUSIC-AVQA, SQA3D. Moreover, Flex-M^3 demonstrates superior robustness during inference, even when a high proportion of modalities are missing from the input samples, showcasing its capacity for complex, data-scarce multimodal applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型通过整合强大的语言模型与多模态编码器，展现了在跨模态理解方面的巨大潜力。然而，要将多模态大语言模型扩展到处理多种模态，需要应对两个关键且相互关联的挑战：(1) 依赖于完全配对的多模态数据，而这种数据的获取往往非常困难或成本高昂；(2) 处理大量不同模态的标记时出现的计算效率问题，以及每次引入新模态时都需要对模型进行大量更新。为了应对这些挑战，我们实现了多模态大语言模型能够处理缺失的模态，通过为缺失的输入生成相应的表示来解决问题。此外，考虑到随着模态数量的增加，标记数量会呈线性增长，而生成的序列过长又会降低模型的性能，因此我们采用了一种双阶段压缩机制。首先减少每个模态的标记数量，然后将多个模态的信息压缩成单一的、简洁的标记序列。最终形成了Flex-M^3这一新型多模态大语言模型框架，它能够灵活高效地处理任意组合的模态输入。在多种多模态基准测试中的实验表明，Flex-M^3能够稳健地处理各种模态输入，并且具有高效的扩展能力。值得注意的是，Flex-M在仅使用全模态数据进行训练的模型中表现更优，在NExT-QA、MUSIC-AVQA和SQA3D等多模态推理任务上的性能分别提升了2.29%、3.15%和11.01%。此外，即使在输入样本中存在大量缺失的模态时，Flex-M^3仍然表现出出色的鲁棒性，这充分体现了其在复杂且数据匮乏的多模态应用中的强大能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: 1,729 vs. 1729: The Effect of Scripts and Formats on LLM Numeracy
papers.title_zh: 1,729 对比 1729：脚本和格式对大语言模型计算能力的影响
papers.authors: Varshini Reddy, Craig W Schmidt, Seth Ebner, Adam Wiemerslage, Yuval Pinter, Chris Tanner
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive proficiency in basic arithmetic, rivaling human-level performance on standard numerical tasks. However, little attention has been given to how these models perform when numerical expressions deviate from the prevailing conventions present in their training corpora. In this work, we investigate numerical reasoning across a wide range of numeral scripts and formats. We show that LLM accuracy drops substantially when numerical inputs are rendered in underrepresented scripts or formats, despite the underlying mathematical reasoning being identical. We further demonstrate that targeted prompting strategies, such as few-shot prompting and explicit numeral mapping, can greatly narrow this gap. Our findings highlight an overlooked challenge in multilingual numerical reasoning and provide actionable insights for working with LLMs to reliably interpret, manipulate, and generate numbers across diverse numeral scripts and formatting styles.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在基本算术方面取得了令人印象深刻的性能，其表现堪比人类在标准数值任务上的水平。然而，这些模型在处理数值表达与训练语料库中的常规表达方式不同时时的表现却鲜被关注。在这项研究中，我们探讨了多种数字脚本和格式下的数值推理能力。我们发现，即使基本的数学推理方式相同，当数值输入采用较少使用的脚本或格式时，模型的正确率会显著下降。此外，我们还发现，采用有针对性的提示策略，如少量样本提示和明确的数字映射，可以大大缩小这一差距。我们的研究结果揭示了多语言数值推理中的一个被忽视的挑战，并为如何使语言模型可靠地解释、处理并生成不同数字脚本和格式下的数字提供了实用的建议。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SimpleOCR: Rendering Visual Questions to Teach MLLMs to Read
papers.title_zh: SimpleOCR：将视觉信息转化为可学习的模型，以帮助它们阅读文本
papers.authors: Yibo Peng, Peng Xia, Ding Zhong, Kaide Zeng, Siwei Han, Yiyang Zhou, Jiaqi Liu, Ruiyi Zhang, Huaxiu Yao
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), a critical question regarding their visual grounding mechanism remains unanswered: do these models genuinely read text embedded in images, or do they merely rely on parametric shortcuts in the text prompt? In this work, we diagnose this issue by introducing the Visualized-Question (VQ) setting, where text queries are rendered directly onto images to structurally mandate visual engagement. Our diagnostic experiments on Qwen2.5-VL reveal a startling capability-utilization gap: despite possessing strong OCR capabilities, models suffer a performance degradation of up to 12.7% in the VQ setting, exposing a deep-seated modality laziness. To bridge this gap, we propose SimpleOCR, a plug-and-play training strategy that imposes a structural constraint on the learning process. By transforming training samples into the VQ format with randomized styles, SimpleOCR effectively invalidates text-based shortcuts, compelling the model to activate and optimize its visual text extraction pathways. Empirically, SimpleOCR yields robust gains without architectural modifications. On four representative OOD benchmarks, it surpasses the base model by 5.4% and GRPO based on original images by 2.7%, while exhibiting extreme data efficiency, achieving superior performance with 30x fewer samples (8.5K) than recent RL-based methods. Furthermore, its plug-and-play nature allows seamless integration with advanced RL strategies like NoisyRollout to yield complementary improvements. Code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/SimpleOCR.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管多模态大语言模型在技术上取得了飞速进展，但关于其视觉定位机制的一个关键问题仍然没有答案：这些模型是真正能够理解图像中的文本，还是仅仅依赖于文本提示中的参数化捷径？在这项研究中，我们通过引入“可视化问题”设置来解决这个问题，即直接将文本查询渲染到图像上，从而强制进行视觉交互。我们在Qwen2.5-VL模型上的实验发现了一个令人惊讶的能力利用差距：尽管该模型具有强大的OCR能力，但在可视化问题设置下，模型的性能却下降了12.7%，这表明模型存在严重的模式依赖问题。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了SimpleOCR这一即插即用训练策略，该策略对学习过程施加了结构性约束。通过将训练样本转换为具有随机样式的可视化问题格式，SimpleOCR有效地打破了基于文本的捷径，迫使模型激活并优化其视觉文本提取路径。经验表明，SimpleOCR能够在无需架构修改的情况下获得显著的性能提升。在四个代表性的OOD基准测试中，它的性能比基础模型提高了5.4%，比基于原始图像的方法提高了2.7%。此外，SimpleOCR还具有极高的数据效率，其所需样本数量仅为最近基于强化学习的方法的1/30（8.5K）。而且，由于其即插即用的特性，它可以与NoisyRollout等先进的强化学习策略无缝集成，从而实现互补性的改进。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/aiming-lab/SimpleOCR。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Facts- Benchmarking Distributional Reading Comprehension in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越事实层面——大型语言模型中分布式阅读理解能力的评估
papers.authors: Pei-Fu Guo, Ya An Tsai, Chun-Chia Hsu, Kai-Xin Chen, Yun-Da Tsai, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng, Mi-Yen Yeh, Shou-De Lin
papers.abstract: While most reading comprehension benchmarks for LLMs focus on factual information that can be answered by localizing specific textual evidence, many real-world tasks require understanding distributional information, such as population-level trends and preferences expressed across collections of text. We introduce Text2DistBench, a reading comprehension benchmark for evaluating LLMs’ ability to infer distributional knowledge from natural language. Built from real-world YouTube comments about movie and music entities, the benchmark provides models with entity metadata and associated comments, and requires them to answer distributional questions, such as estimating the proportions of positive and negative comments, or identifying the most and second most frequent topics discussed among viewers. To support reliable and long-term evaluation, the construction pipeline of Text2DistBench is fully automated and continuously updated to incorporate newly emerging entities over time. Experiments across multiple LLMs show that while models substantially outperform random baselines, performance varies widely across different distribution types and characteristics. These findings highlight both the capabilities and limitations of current LLMs in distributional reading comprehension and demonstrate the value of Text2DistBench as a practical and scalable testbed for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大多数关于大语言模型的阅读理解基准测试都集中在可以通过定位特定文本证据来回答的事实信息上，但许多现实世界中的任务需要理解分布式信息，比如不同文本集合中的人口级趋势和偏好。我们提出了Text2DistBench这一阅读理解基准测试，用于评估大语言模型从自然语言中提取分布式知识的能力。该基准测试基于真实的YouTube评论数据，这些评论涉及电影和音乐相关的内容。测试要求模型获取实体元数据以及相关的评论信息，并回答诸如估计正面和负面评论的比例，或者识别观众讨论中最常见和第二常见的主题等问题。为了支持可靠且长期的评估，Text2DistBench的构建流程是完全自动化的，并且会不断更新以纳入新出现的实体。通过对多个大语言模型的实验表明，尽管模型的表现远远优于随机基线模型，但不同分布类型和特征下的表现差异很大。这些发现凸显了当前大语言模型在分布式阅读理解方面的能力和局限性，同时也证明了Text2DistBench作为未来研究的实用且可扩展的测试平台的价值。

papers.title: Preference Learning Unlocks LLMs’ Psycho-Counseling Skills
papers.title_zh: 偏好学习机制赋予了大语言模型提供心理辅导功能的能力
papers.authors: Mian Zhang, Shaun M. Eack, Zhiyu Chen
papers.abstract: Applying large language models (LLMs) to assist in psycho-counseling is an emerging and meaningful approach, driven by the significant gap between patient needs and the availability of mental health support. However, current LLMs struggle to consistently provide effective responses to client speeches, largely due to the lack of supervision from high-quality real psycho-counseling data, whose content is typically inaccessible due to client privacy concerns. Furthermore, the quality of therapists’ responses in available sessions can vary significantly based on their professional training and experience. Assessing the quality of therapists’ responses remains an open challenge. We address these challenges by first proposing a set of professional and comprehensive principles to evaluate therapists’ responses to client speeches. Using these principles, we create a Psycho-Counseling Preference dataset, PsyCoPref, which contains 36k high-quality preference comparison pairs. This dataset aligns with the preferences of professional psychotherapists, providing a robust foundation for evaluating and improving LLMs in psycho-counseling. Experiments on reward modeling and preference learning demonstrate that PsyCoPref is an excellent resource for LLMs to acquire essential skills for responding to clients in a counseling session. Our best-aligned model achieves an impressive win rate of 87% against GPT-4o.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型应用于心理辅导领域是一种新兴且有意义的方法，其背后的驱动力在于患者需求与心理健康支持资源之间的巨大差距。然而，目前的大语言模型在应对客户咨询时往往难以提供有效的响应，这主要是由于缺乏高质量的真实心理辅导数据的监督。而这些数据的内容通常因客户隐私问题而难以获取。此外，现有会话中治疗师的反应质量也会因他们的专业培训和经验而有所不同。因此，评估治疗师反应的质量仍然是一个亟待解决的问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们首先提出了一套专业且全面的原则来评价治疗师对客户咨询的回应。利用这些原则，我们创建了一个名为PsyCoPref的心理辅导偏好数据集，该数据集包含3.6万对高质量偏好对比样本。这个数据集与专业心理治疗师的偏好相一致，为评估和改进大语言模型在心理辅导中的应用提供了坚实的基础。关于奖励建模和偏好学习的实验表明，PsyCoPref是大语言模型学习如何有效回应客户咨询的重要资源。我们的模型在对抗GPT-4o时取得了令人印象深刻的87%的胜率。

papers.title: Large Language Models Can Help Mitigate Barren Plateaus in Quantum Neural Networks
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型有助于突破量子神经网络中的性能瓶颈问题
papers.authors: Jun Zhuang, Chaowen Guan
papers.abstract: In the era of noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) computing, Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) have emerged as a promising approach for various applications, yet their training is often hindered by barren plateaus (BPs), where gradient variance vanishes exponentially as the qubit size increases. Most initialization-based mitigation strategies rely heavily on pre-designed static parameter distributions, thereby lacking adaptability to diverse model sizes or data conditions. To address these limitations, we propose AdaInit, a foundational framework that leverages large language models with the submartingale property to iteratively synthesize initial parameters for QNNs that yield non-negligible gradient variance, thereby mitigating BPs. Unlike conventional one-shot initialization methods, AdaInit adaptively explores the parameter space by incorporating dataset characteristics and gradient feedback, with theoretical guarantees of convergence to finding a set of effective initial parameters for QNNs. We provide rigorous theoretical analyses of the submartingale-based process and empirically validate that AdaInit consistently outperforms existing initialization methods in maintaining higher gradient variance across various QNN scales. We believe this work may initiate a new avenue to mitigate BPs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在噪声中等规模量子计算时代，量子神经网络已成为多种应用中的有前景的解决方案。然而，其训练过程常常受到“贫瘠高原”现象的阻碍——随着量子比特尺寸的增加，梯度方差会呈指数级下降。大多数基于初始化的缓解策略都依赖于预先设计的静态参数分布，因此难以适应不同模型规模或数据条件。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了AdaInit这一基础框架。该框架利用具有次马尔可夫特性的大语言模型来迭代地生成量子神经网络的初始参数，从而确保梯度方差保持在可接受的水平，进而有效缓解“贫瘠高原”现象。与传统的一次性初始化方法不同，AdaInit能够通过结合数据集特征和梯度反馈来自适应地探索参数空间，并且具有理论上的收敛保证，能够找到一组有效的初始参数。我们对基于次马尔可夫特性的初始化过程进行了严格的理论分析，并通过实验验证，AdaInit在保持较高梯度方差方面始终优于现有的初始化方法。我们相信，这项工作可能为缓解“贫瘠高原”现象开辟一条新的途径。

papers.title: Finch: Benchmarking Finance & Accounting across Spreadsheet-Centric Enterprise Workflows
papers.title_zh: 芬奇：在以电子表格为核心的企业工作流程中，对财务与会计方面的表现进行对比分析
papers.authors: Haoyu Dong, Pengkun Zhang, Yan Gao, Xuanyu Dong, Yilin Cheng, Mingzhe Lu, Adina Yakefu, Shuxin Zheng
papers.abstract: We introduce FinWorkBench (a.k.a. Finch) for evaluating AI agents on real-world, enterprise-grade finance and accounting workflows that interleave data entry, structuring, formatting, web search, cross-file retrieval, calculation, modeling, validation, translation, visualization, and reporting. Finch is sourced from authentic enterprise workspaces from Enron (15,000 files and 500,000 emails) and other financial institutions, covering the period 2000–2025 and preserving the in-the-wild messiness of multimodal artifacts such as tables and charts across diverse domains including budgeting, trading, asset management, and operational management.We propose a workflow construction process that combines LLM-assisted mining of workflows from authentic enterprise environments with expert annotation: (1) LLM-assisted, expert-verified derivation of workflows from real-world email threads and spreadsheet version histories, and (2) meticulous annotation requiring over 700 hours of expert effort. This yields 172 composite workflows with 384 tasks, involving 1,710 spreadsheets with 27 million cells, along with PDFs and other artifacts, capturing the intrinsically messy, long-horizon, knowledge-intensive, and collaborative nature of real-world enterprise work.We conduct both human and automated evaluations of frontier AI systems, including GPT 5.1, Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, Grok 4, and Qwen 3 Max. Under human evaluation, GPT 5.1 Pro spends an average of 16.8 minutes per workflow yet passes only 38.4% of workflows. Comprehensive case studies further surface the challenges that real-world enterprise workflows pose for AI agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了FinWorkBench（又称Finch），用于评估AI代理在真实世界的企业级财务和会计工作流程中的表现。这些工作流程包括数据输入、结构化处理、格式编排、网络搜索、跨文件检索、计算、建模、验证、翻译、可视化和报告等功能。Finch的数据来源来自Enron的真实企业工作空间（包含15,000个文件和500,000封电子邮件），以及其他金融机构的数据，涵盖2000年至2025年的时间段。这些数据保留了不同领域中的多模态文件的混乱状态，如预算编制、交易、资产管理和运营管理等领域的表格和图表。我们提出了一种工作流程构建流程，该流程结合了利用大语言模型从真实企业环境中挖掘工作流程的方法，以及专家注释的工作流程：1）利用大语言模型辅助，由专家验证的方式，从真实世界的电子邮件线程和电子表格版本历史中提取工作流程；2）需要超过700小时的专业注释工作。最终得到了172个复合工作流程，每个工作流程包含384个任务，涉及1,710份电子表格，共计2700万个单元格，还包括PDF文件和其他相关文档。这些工作流程充分体现了真实企业工作的复杂性、长期性、知识密集性和协作性特点。我们对包括GPT 5.1、Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.5、Gemini 3 Pro、Grok 4和Qwen 3 Max在内的前沿AI系统进行了人工和自动化评估。在人工评估中，GPT 5.1 Pro平均每个工作流程需要16.8分钟的时间，但只有38.4%的工作流程能够通过评估。这些案例研究进一步揭示了真实企业工作流程对AI代理带来的挑战。
