papers.title: Exploiting Tree Structure for Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在基于大型语言模型的强化学习中，利用树状结构进行信用分配
papers.authors: Hieu Tran, Zonghai Yao, Hong yu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has shown strong promise for strengthening the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), but sparse, delayed rewards over long chains make token-level credit assignment a central challenge. Actor–critic methods like PPO provide token-level credit but require training a value network alongside the policy, which introduces complexity and can encourage overfitting. Critic-free alternatives such as GRPO avoid this burden but rely on sequence-level outcomes, distributing a single reward uniformly across tokens and ignoring structural differences between responses. We propose Prefix-to-Tree (P2T), which organizes the sampled responses of a prompt into a prefix tree and computes nonparametric prefix values by aggregating descendant outcomes. Building on this idea, we develop TEMPO (Tree-Estimated Mean Prefix Value for Policy Optimization), a critic-free algorithm that enriches GRPO with branch-aware temporal-difference (TD) corrections. Across Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B, TEMPO consistently improves both convergence and final performance over PPO and GRPO on in-distribution benchmarks (MATH, MedQA) and out-of-distribution settings (GSM-HARD, AMC23, MedMCQA, MMLU-Medical), achieving higher validation accuracy within comparable wall-clock time.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，由于长期内奖励分布稀疏且延迟发放，如何在令牌级别进行奖励分配成为了一个核心挑战。像PPO这样的演员-评论家方法虽然能够提供令牌级别的奖励，但需要同时训练价值网络和策略，这会增加系统的复杂性，并可能导致过拟合问题。而GRPO这类无评论家方法的替代方案则避免了这一负担，但它们依赖于序列级别的结果，将单一奖励均匀分配给各个令牌，同时忽略了不同响应之间的结构差异。我们提出了Prefix-to-Tree（P2T）算法，该算法将提示中采样的响应组织成前缀树，并通过汇总子节点的结果来计算非参数化的前缀值。基于这一思想，我们开发了TEMPO算法——一种无评论家算法，它通过在GRPO的基础上引入考虑分支特性的时间差分校正，从而提升了模型的性能。在Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B模型中，TEMPO在分布内基准测试（如MATH、MedQA）和分布外场景（如GSM-HARD、AMC23、MedMCQA、MMLU-Medical）中，均表现出优于PPO和GRPO的收敛速度和最终性能，并且在可比较的运算时间内实现了更高的验证准确率。

papers.title: Demystify the Role of Memory in Machine Learning Engineering Agents
papers.title_zh: 揭示记忆在机器学习工程智能体中的作用机制
papers.authors: Xinyu Zhao, Junpeng Wang, Yuzhong Chen, Menghai Pan, Chin-Chia Michael Yeh, Jiarui Sun, Yan Zheng, Mahashweta Das, Tianlong Chen
papers.abstract: While memory is a core component in agent systems, its behavioral impact in complex, long-horizon domains like machine learning engineering (MLE) remains poorly understood. Unlike short, reactive exchanges, MLE agents solve tasks through cycles of experimentation and improvement where past errors can inform future success. This paper presents a systematic study dissecting how memory influences agent behavior and performance across diverse MLE challenges. We first introduce a dynamic coding memory designed to capture and reuse debugging experiences, and integrate it into two representative agent paradigms: a sequential, chain-based agent that mirrors human-like iterative refinement, and a parallel, tree-based agent that performs broad, self-exploratory search in the code space. Our central finding is that the role of memory is contingent on the agent’s underlying architecture. For chain-based agents, memory proves highly beneficial, enabling them to avoid recurring mistakes and engage in more coherent, iterative refinement, which significantly improves reliability and task success. In contrast, for tree-based search agents, memory introduces a critical trade-off: it enhances procedural stability at the cost of constraining search diversity, which can prematurely narrow exploration and lead to suboptimal final solutions. These findings reveal a fundamental trade-off between procedural reliability and solution innovation modulated by memory, offering insights for designing more effective and robust MLE agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然记忆是智能体系统中的核心组成部分，但在像机器学习工程这样的复杂、长期领域里，记忆的行为影响仍然鲜为人知。与短暂的、反应性强的交互不同，机器学习工程智能体通过一系列的实验和改进来完成任务，过去的错误可以为未来的成功提供启示。本文开展了一项系统研究，探讨记忆如何在不同机器学习工程挑战中影响智能体的行为和性能。我们首先介绍了一种动态编码记忆机制，该机制旨在捕捉并复用调试经验，并将其整合到两种代表性的智能体模式中：一种是基于链的序列式智能体，它模仿人类式的迭代优化过程；另一种是基于树的并行式智能体，它在代码空间中进行广泛的自我探索搜索。我们的主要发现是，记忆的作用取决于智能体的底层架构。对于基于链的智能体来说，记忆非常有益，它能够避免重复犯错，并进行更连贯的迭代优化，从而显著提高可靠性和任务成功率。相反，对于基于树的搜索智能体来说，记忆则带来了一个关键权衡：它增强了程序运行的稳定性，但代价是限制了搜索的多样性，这可能会导致探索范围过早缩小，从而导致最优解的出现。这些发现揭示了程序可靠性与解决方案创新之间的基本权衡关系，为设计更有效、更强大的机器学习工程智能体提供了重要启示。

papers.title: Characterizing Web Search in The Age of Generative AI
papers.title_zh: 在生成式人工智能时代下的网络搜索特点
papers.authors: Elisabeth Kirsten, Jost Große Perdekamp, Qinyuan Wu, Mihir Upadhyay, Krishna P. Gummadi, Muhammad Bilal Zafar
papers.abstract: The advent of LLMs has given rise to generative search, a new search paradigm in which LLMs retrieve information from the web related to a query and synthesize it into a single, coherent response. This paradigm differs fundamentally from traditional web search, where results are returned as a ranked list of independent web pages. In this paper, we ask: Along what dimensions does generative search differ from traditional search?We conduct a systematic comparison between Google organic search and five generative search systems from three providers: Google, OpenAI, and Perplexity. Our analysis reveals substantial variation among engines in their reliance on internal v.s. external knowledge, source diversity, and stability. While generative systems often achieve topical coverage comparable to traditional search, they do so using markedly different retrieval footprints and synthesis strategies. We further show that the outputs of generative search can vary across time and executions, raising new challenges for robustness. Our findings demonstrate that generative search introduces new dimensions that are not captured by existing evaluation paradigms, motivating the development of evaluations that explicitly account for retrieval behavior, synthesis, and stability in generative search systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的出现催生了生成式搜索这一新的搜索范式。在这种模式下，大语言模型从互联网上检索与查询相关的信息，并将其整合成一个连贯的响应。这种范式与传统的网络搜索有着根本的区别：传统搜索的结果是作为一系列独立网页的列表来返回的。在本文中，我们提出了一个问题：生成式搜索在哪些方面与传统搜索不同？我们对谷歌的有机搜索以及来自谷歌、OpenAI和Perplexity这三家公司的五种生成式搜索系统进行了系统的比较。我们的分析显示，这些搜索引擎在依赖内部知识与外部知识、信息来源多样性以及稳定性方面存在显著差异。虽然生成式系统通常能够实现与传统搜索相当的主题覆盖能力，但它们所使用的检索方式和合成策略却截然不同。此外，我们还发现生成式搜索的输出可能会随着时间和执行次数的变化而发生变化，这给系统的鲁棒性带来了新的挑战。我们的研究结果表明，生成式搜索引入了现有评估范式无法捕捉的新维度，因此有必要开发能够明确考虑生成式搜索系统中检索行为、合成能力和稳定性的评估方法。

papers.title: HypEHR: Hyperbolic Modeling of Electronic Health Records for Efficient Question Answering
papers.title_zh: HypEHR：用于高效问答的电子健康记录超文本建模技术
papers.authors: Yuyu Liu, Sarang Rajendra Patil, Mengjia Xu, Tengfei Ma
papers.abstract: Electronic health record (EHR) question answering is often handled by LLM-based pipelines that are costly to deploy and do not explicitly leverage the hierarchical structure of clinical data. Motivated by evidence that medical ontologies and patient trajectories exhibit hyperbolic geometry, we propose HypEHR, a compact Lorentzian model that embeds codes, visits, and questions in hyperbolic space and answers queries via geometry-consistent cross-attention with type-specific pointer heads. HypEHR is pretrained with next-visit diagnosis prediction and hierarchy-aware regularization to align representations with the ICD ontology. On two MIMIC-IV-based EHR-QA benchmarks, HypEHR approaches LLM-based methods while using far fewer parameters. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yuyuliu11037/HypEHR.
papers.abstract_zh: 电子健康记录（EHR）的问答处理通常依赖于基于大语言模型的解决方案，但这些方案部署成本较高，且并未充分利用临床数据的层次结构。鉴于医学本体和患者轨迹具有双曲几何特性的证据，我们提出了HypEHR模型。该模型将代码、就诊记录和问题嵌入到双曲空间中，并通过符合几何特性的交叉注意力机制来回答查询，同时使用类型特定的指针头来标识相关信息。HypEHR经过预训练，能够预测下一次就诊的诊断结果，并采用层次化正则化方法来调整表示与ICD本体的对齐方式。在两个基于MIMIC-IV的EHR-QA基准测试中，HypEHR在参数使用量远少于基于大语言模型的方法的情况下，取得了良好的性能。我们的代码可在此处公开获取：https://github.com/yuyuliu11037/HypEHR

papers.title: What Users Leave Unsaid: Under-Specified Queries Limit Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 用户未说出的话：查询信息不足导致的语言模型性能限制
papers.authors: Dasol Choi, Guijin Son, Hanwool Lee, Minhyuk Kim, Hyunwoo Ko, Teabin Lim, Eungyeol Ahn, Jungwhan Kim, Seunghyeok Hong, Youngsook Song
papers.abstract: Current vision-language benchmarks predominantly feature well-structured questions with clear, explicit prompts. However, real user queries are often informal and underspecified. Users naturally leave much unsaid, relying on images to convey context. We introduce HAERAE-Vision, a benchmark of 653 real-world visual questions from Korean online communities (0.76% survival from 86K candidates), each paired with an explicit rewrite, yielding 1,306 query variants in total. Evaluating 39 VLMs, we find that even state-of-the-art models (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) achieve under 50% on the original queries. Crucially, query explicitation alone yields 8 to 22 point improvements, with smaller models benefiting most. We further show that even with web search, under-specified queries underperform explicit queries without search, revealing that current retrieval cannot compensate for what users leave unsaid. Our findings demonstrate that a substantial portion of VLM difficulty stem from natural query under-specification instead of model capability, highlighting a critical gap between benchmark evaluation and real-world deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的视觉-语言评估基准主要包含结构清晰、提示明确的题目。然而，真实用户的查询往往不够明确且非正式。用户通常会留下许多未言明的信息，依靠图像来传达上下文。我们提出了HAERAE-Vision这一基准测试，该测试包含了来自韩国在线社区的653个真实视觉问题（在86,000个候选答案中，有0.76%的答案为有效）。每个问题都配有一个明确的改写版本，总共形成了1,306种查询变体。我们对39个视觉语言模型进行了评估，发现即使是最先进的模型（如GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro）在原始查询上的表现也低于50%。值得注意的是，仅仅通过明确化查询就能带来8到22点的性能提升，而较小的模型受益最大。我们还发现，即使使用了网络搜索功能，那些描述不明确的查询仍然不如有明确描述的查询，这表明当前的检索技术无法弥补用户未言明的信息。我们的研究结果表明，视觉语言模型的难度在很大程度上源于自然查询的不明确性，而非模型本身的能力不足，这凸显了基准测试评估与实际应用之间的巨大差距。

papers.title: Selective Steering: Norm-Preserving Control Through Discriminative Layer Selection
papers.title_zh: 选择性导向：通过选择具有区分能力的层来实现控制方案与标准的兼容
papers.authors: Quy-Anh Dang, Chris Ngo
papers.abstract: Despite significant progress in alignment, large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks that elicit harmful behaviors. Activation steering techniques offer a promising inference-time intervention approach, but existing methods suffer from critical limitations: activation addition requires careful coefficient tuning and is sensitive to layer-specific norm variations, while directional ablation provides only binary control. Recent work on Angular Steering introduces continuous control via rotation in a 2D subspace, but its practical implementation violates norm preservation, causing distribution shift and generation collapse, particularly in models below 7B parameters. We propose Selective Steering, which addresses these limitations through two key innovations: (1) a mathematically rigorous norm-preserving rotation formulation that maintains activation distribution integrity, and (2) discriminative layer selection that applies steering only where feature representations exhibit opposite-signed class alignment. Experiments across nine models demonstrate that Selective Steering achieves 5.5 higher attack success rates than prior methods while maintaining zero perplexity violations and approximately 100% capability retention on standard benchmarks. Our approach provides a principled, efficient framework for controllable and stable LLM behavior modification.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在对齐方面取得了显著进展，大语言模型仍然容易受到引发有害行为的对抗性攻击。激活引导技术提供了一种有前景的推理时间干预方法，但现有方法存在关键缺陷：激活添加需要仔细调整系数，并且对特定层的范数变化非常敏感；而方向性消融则只能提供二进制控制。最近关于角向引导的研究引入了通过二维子空间旋转来实现连续控制的方案，但其实际实施会破坏范数的保持性，导致分布偏移和生成崩溃，尤其是在参数数量低于70亿的模型中。我们提出了选择性引导技术，该技术通过两个关键创新解决了这些问题：(1) 一种数学上严谨的、能够保持激活分布完整性的旋转公式；(2) 选择性引导仅适用于那些特征表示表现出相反符号类对齐的情况。在九个模型上的实验表明，选择性引导技术的攻击成功率比以往的方法高出5.5倍，同时避免了任何困惑度违规情况，并且在标准基准测试中的能力保留率约为100%。我们的方法为可控且稳定的语言模型行为修改提供了一个原则性强、效率高的框架。

papers.title: From Bytes to Subwords: Challenges of Input Representations in NLP
papers.title_zh: 从字节到子词：自然语言处理中输入表示的挑战
papers.authors: Rob van der Goot
papers.abstract: A first decision for any automated natural language processing system is the granularity of the input units. Traditionally, characters or words have been used, but recently, subwords have become the standard. In this paper, we investigate trends in input processing steps and discuss common shortcomings in this foundational first step of model design. We start by providing an overview of currently used tokenizers, showing that there is only minimal variety, with three highly similar designs dominating current models, and many of the tokenizers being exact duplicates. Next, we reconsider Unicode normalization strategies. Previous work has recommended applying consistent normalization; however, we argue that this removes signal and we show how this can harm performance for language classification. Finally, we take a closer look at UTF-8 character encoding, the very first layer of representation used in many language models. We argue that UTF-8 is not optimized for efficiency, nor for fairness across languages, and propose proof of concept alternatives focused on fairness and efficiency. Based on our findings, we recommend future work to 1) put more thought into subword segmentation and explore more diversity, 2) apply normalization only when beneficial 3) consider alternative character encodings for models operating on the byte-level.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于任何自动化的自然语言处理系统来说，第一个需要决定的因素就是输入单元的粒度。传统上，人们使用字符或单词作为输入单位，但最近，子词成为了标准做法。在本文中，我们探讨了输入处理步骤的趋势，并讨论了这一模型设计基础阶段常见的不足之处。首先，我们对目前使用的分词器进行了概述，发现它们的设计方式几乎没有差异，只有三种非常相似的分词器主导了当前的模型，而且许多分词器实际上是完全相同的重复版本。接下来，我们重新考虑了Unicode规范化策略。之前的研究建议采用一致的规范化方式，但我们认为这种规范化会破坏数据的信号特性，并且会损害语言分类的性能。最后，我们仔细研究了UTF-8字符编码——这是许多语言模型中使用的第一层表示方式。我们认为UTF-8在效率方面并不优化，同时在不同语言之间也没有实现公平性，因此我们提出了一些专注于公平性和效率的概念验证替代方案。基于我们的研究发现，我们建议未来的研究应该做到以下几点：1）进一步思考子词分割的问题，并探索更多样化的设计方法；2）仅在必要时才进行规范化处理；3）为在字节级别运行的模型考虑其他字符编码方式。

papers.title: The Learnability of Model-Theoretic Interpretation Functions in Artificial Neural Networks
papers.title_zh: 人工神经网络中模型理论解释函数的可学习性
papers.authors: Adrian Brasoveanu, Jakub Dotlacil
papers.abstract: The systematicity of natural language interpretation—our ability to understand novel expressions by compositionally combining familiar elements—has been central to debates about symbolic versus neural approaches to cognition since Fodor and Pylyshyn (1988). We investigate whether artificial neural networks can learn model-theoretic interpretation functions that generalize systematically to out-of-training-sample sentences, framing interpretation as an encoding task from discrete linguistic input to continuous truth-conditional representations. We extend Frank et al. (2009) with entity-level semantic representations, modern architectures (GRU, LSTM, Attention with AbsPE/RoPE), principled competing event generation, extended systematicity tests (∼350 vs. ∼80 sentences), and a two- dimensional difficulty analysis disaggregating results by modifier complexity. Across 140 trained models (7 architectures), we find that capacity-matched architectures perform comparably on easy tests, but gated recurrent networks (GRU and LSTM) significantly outperform transformer architectures on the hardest compositional generalization test (Basic Event), while ungated SRN does not—indicating that the gating mechanism is a critical factor. Entity vectors significantly improve scores on Basic Event across most architectures, with gated architectures benefiting most, validating formal semantics’ treatment of entities as important theoretical primitives. The extended test set reveals that systematicity difficulty has two dimensions: the type of systematicity test (as in Frank et al. 2009), and the number of modifiers being composed.
papers.abstract_zh: 自然语言解释的系统性——我们通过组合熟悉的元素来理解新表达的能力——自Fodor和Pylyshyn在1988年提出这一理论以来，一直是关于符号主义与神经主义认知方法的争论焦点。我们研究人工神经网络是否能够学习到能够系统地应用于非训练样本句子的模型论解释函数，将解释视为从离散的语言输入到连续的真值条件表示的编码任务。我们扩展了Frank等人2009年的研究，引入了实体级语义表示、现代架构（GRU、LSTM、带有AbsPE/RoPE的注意力机制）、基于原则的竞争事件生成方法，并增加了系统性测试的数量（约350句对比约80句），同时采用二维难度分析方法来区分不同修饰语复杂性的结果。在140个训练有素的模型中（包括7种架构），我们发现，在简单的测试中，具有足够能力的架构表现相当；但在最复杂的组合泛化测试（基本事件）中，带门控的循环网络（GRU和LSTM）的表现明显优于变换器架构，而无门控的SRN则表现不佳，这表明门控机制是一个关键因素。在大多数架构中，实体向量显著提升了基本事件测试的成绩，其中带门控的架构受益最大，这验证了形式语义学将实体视为重要理论原语的观点。扩展的测试集显示，系统性的难度有两个维度：一是测试的类型（如Frank等人2009年的研究），二是需要组合的修饰语数量。

papers.title: A Mechanistic Perspective and Circuit-Guided Difficulty Metric for Unlearning
papers.title_zh: 从机制角度看待遗忘过程，以及基于电路结构的难度评估方法
papers.authors: Jiali Cheng, Ziheng Chen, Chirag Agarwal, Hadi Amiri
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning is becoming essential for building trustworthy and compliant language models. Yet unlearning success varies considerably across individual samples: some are reliably erased, while others persist despite the same procedure. We argue that this disparity is not only a data-side phenomenon, but also reflects model-internal mechanisms that encode and protect memorized information. We study this problem from a mechanistic perspective based on model circuits–structured interaction pathways that govern how predictions are formed. We propose Circuit-guided Unlearning Difficulty (CUD), a pre-unlearning metric that assigns each sample a continuous difficulty score using circuit-level signals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CUD reliably separates intrinsically easy and hard samples, and remains stable across unlearning methods. We identify key circuit-level patterns that reveal a mechanistic signature of unlearning difficulty: easy-to-unlearn samples are associated with shorter, shallower interactions concentrated in earlier-to-intermediate parts of the original model, whereas hard-to-unlearn samples rely on longer and deeper pathways closer to late-stage computation. Compared to existing qualitative studies, CUD takes a first step toward a principled, fine-grained, and interpretable analysis of unlearning difficulty; and motivates the development of unlearning methods grounded in model mechanisms.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器去学习对于构建可信且合规的语言模型来说变得越来越重要。然而，不同样本在去学习过程中的效果差异很大：有些样本能够被可靠地清除，而另一些则即使经过相同的处理仍然保留下来。我们认为，这种差异不仅仅是一种数据层面的现象，它还反映了模型内部的机制，这些机制负责编码和保护记忆中的信息。我们从模型电路的角度来研究这个问题——电路是控制预测形成的结构化交互路径。我们提出了“电路引导的去学习难度”这一预去学习指标，该指标利用电路级信号为每个样本分配一个连续的难度评分。大量实验表明，CUD能够可靠地区分容易和难处理的样本，并且在不同去学习方法下都能保持稳定。我们发现了一些关键的电路级模式，这些模式揭示了去学习难度的机制特征：容易处理的样本与较短、较浅的交互路径相关，这些路径集中在模型的早期到中期部分；而难以处理的样本则依赖于更长、更深的交互路径，这些路径更靠近模型的后期计算阶段。与现有的定性研究相比，CUD朝着一种基于原理的、细粒度的、可解释性的去学习难度分析迈出了第一步；它为基于模型机制的去学习方法的开发提供了动力。

papers.title: UCS: Estimating Unseen Coverage for Improved In-Context Learning
papers.title_zh: UCS：估算未覆盖区域的情况，以改进上下文学习效果
papers.authors: Jiayi Xin, Xiang Li, Evan Qiang, Weiqing He, Tianqi Shang, Weijie J Su, Qi Long
papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) performance depends critically on which demonstrations are placed in the prompt, yet most existing selectors prioritize heuristic notions of relevance or diversity and provide limited insight into the \textbf{coverage} of a demonstration set. We propose \textbf{Unseen Coverage Selection (UCS)}, a training-free, subset-level coverage prior motivated by the principle that a good demonstration set should \textbf{expose the model to latent cluster unrevealed by the currently selected subset}. UCS operationalizes this idea by \textbf{(1)} inducing discrete latent \textbf{clusters} from model-consistent embeddings and \textbf{(2)} estimating the number of unrevealed clusters within a candidate subset via a Smoothed Good-Turing estimator from its empirical frequency spectrum. Unlike previous selection methods, UCS is coverage-based and training-free, and can be seamlessly combined with both query-dependent and query-independent selection baselines via a simple regularized objective. Experiments on multiple intent-classification and reasoning benchmarks with frontier Large Language Models show that augmenting strong baselines with UCS consistently improves ICL accuracy by up to \textbf{2-6}% under the same selection budget, while also yielding insights into task- and model-level latent cluster distributions. Code is available at https://github.com/Raina-Xin/UCS.
papers.abstract_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）的性能在很大程度上取决于哪些演示内容被包含在提示中。然而，目前大多数选择算法都倾向于基于启发式的关联性或多样性标准进行选择，而这些方法对于演示集的覆盖范围却缺乏有效的分析。我们提出了一种名为“未见覆盖选择”（UCS）的方法，这是一种无需训练的、基于子集覆盖度的选择算法。我们的核心思想是：一个优秀的演示集应该能够让模型接触到那些当前所选子集未能揭示的潜在聚类结构。UCS通过以下两种方式实现这一目标：（1）从模型一致的嵌入数据中推断出离散的潜在聚类结构；（2）利用平滑良好图灵估计器，根据候选子集的经验频率谱来估算未被揭示的聚类数量。与以往的选择方法不同，UCS是一种基于覆盖度且无训练负担的方法，可以轻松地与各种基于查询的依赖性和非依赖性的选择算法相结合。在多个意图分类和推理基准测试中对前沿大语言模型进行的实验表明，在相同的选择预算下，使用UCS能够显著提高ICL的准确性，提高幅度可达2-6%。同时，该方法还能帮助我们了解任务和模型层面的潜在聚类分布。相关代码可在https://github.com/Raina-Xin/UCS下载。

papers.title: Talent or Luck? Evaluating Attribution Bias in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 天赋还是运气？评估大型语言模型中的归因偏差
papers.authors: Chahat Raj, Mahika Banerjee, Jinhao Pan, Aylin Caliskan, Antonios Anastasopoulos, Ziwei Zhu
papers.abstract: When a student fails an exam, do we tend to blame their effort or the test’s difficulty? Attribution, defined as how reasons are assigned to event outcomes, shapes perceptions, reinforces stereotypes, and influences decisions. Attribution Theory explains how people attribute causes to internal factors (effort, ability) or external ones (task difficulty, luck). LLMs’ attribution of event outcomes based on demographics carries important fairness implications. Most works exploring social biases in LLMs focus on surface-level associations or isolated stereotypes. This work proposes a cognitively grounded bias evaluation framework to identify how models’ reasoning disparities shape demographic bias across three contexts: single-actor, actor–actor, and actor–observer, capturing comparative and perspective-driven biases overlooked in prior work. Introducing a 140k-prompt benchmark covering ten scenarios and four social dimensions, our analyses reveal attribution asymmetries across identities that vary in multi-actor and observer settings, suggesting that other identities influence bias. This work underscores the need for cognitively grounded bias evaluation and informs future debiasing efforts through the proposed framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 当学生考试不及格时，我们倾向于责怪他们的努力还是考试的难度呢？归因方式，即人们如何为事件结果分配原因，会影响人们的认知、强化刻板印象并影响决策。归因理论解释了人们如何将原因归因于内部因素（如努力、能力）或外部因素（如任务难度、运气）。大语言模型根据人口统计特征对事件结果进行归因的行为，具有重要的公平性意义。大多数研究社会偏见的研究都集中在表面上的关联或孤立的刻板印象上。本研究提出了一个基于认知的偏见评估框架，以识别模型推理差异如何在三种情境下影响人口统计方面的偏见：单一主体、主体与主体之间以及主体与观察者之间的关系，从而捕捉到以往研究中被忽视的比较性和视角驱动的偏见。通过引入一个包含十种情景和四个社会维度的14万条提示基准数据，我们的分析揭示了在多主体和观察者情境下，不同身份之间的归因不对称现象，这表明其他身份因素也会影响偏见的形成。这项工作强调了基于认知的偏见评估的必要性，并通过所提出的框架为未来的去偏见工作提供了指导。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification of Large Language Models through Multiple Uncertainty Sources
papers.title_zh: 通过多种不确定性来源来量化大型语言模型的不确定性
papers.authors: Tiejin Chen, Xiaoou Liu, Longchao Da, Jia Chen, Evangelos E. Papalexakis, Hua Wei
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse domains. However, the reliability of responses from LLMs remains a question. Uncertainty quantification (UQ) of LLMs is crucial for ensuring their reliability, especially in areas such as healthcare. Existing UQ methods, often designed around a single resource such as Natural Language Inference (NLI) or graph-based metrics, fail to capture the multifaceted nature of uncertainty in natural language generation. In this work, we propose MS-UQ, a novel Multi-Resource Uncertainty Quantification framework that integrates heterogeneous uncertainty signals into a unified measure. Our approach concatenates matrices from diverse resources and employs tensor decomposition to orthogonally disentangle unique and shared information. To ensure scalability, we construct an adaptive ensemble of outputs from different decomposition methods, enabling the incorporation of new uncertainty sources. Experiments on CoQA, NQ_Open, and HotpotQA demonstrate that MS-UQ consistently outperforms existing methods, offering a comprehensive and scalable solution for uncertainty estimation in black-box LLMs and a more robust framework for enhancing LLM reliability in high-stakes applications. Our code can be accessed at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MDUQ-First-202E/README.md.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多个领域展现出了卓越的能力。然而，这些模型给出的回答的可靠性仍然是一个值得关注的问题。对于大语言模型来说，不确定性量化至关重要，尤其是在医疗等领域。现有的不确定性量化方法往往只基于单一资源进行设计，例如自然语言推理或基于图的度量方法，这些方法无法充分捕捉自然语言生成中不确定性的复杂性。在这项研究中，我们提出了MS-UQ这一新颖的多资源不确定性量化框架，该框架能够将不同来源的不确定性信号整合到一个统一的衡量标准中。我们的方法通过连接来自不同资源的矩阵，并利用张量分解技术来分离出独特的信息和共享信息。为了确保可扩展性，我们构建了一个自适应输出集合，能够结合新的不确定性来源。在CoQA、NQ_Open和HotpotQA上的实验表明，MS-UQ在性能上始终优于现有方法，为黑盒语言模型的不确定性估计提供了一个全面且可扩展的解决方案，同时也为提升高风险应用中的语言模型可靠性提供了更强大的框架。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MDUQ-First-202E/README.md获取。

papers.title: Dual Hierarchical Dialogue Policy Learning for Legal Inquisitive Conversational Agents
papers.title_zh: 用于具有法律探究性质的对话型智能体的双层次对话策略学习方法
papers.authors: Xubo Lin, Zezhi Deng, Shihao Wang, Grace Hui Yang, Yang Deng
papers.abstract: Most existing dialogue systems are user-driven, primarily designed to fulfill user requests. However, in many critical real-world scenarios, a conversational agent must proactively extract information to achieve its own objectives rather than merely respond. To address this gap, we introduce Inquisitive Conversational Agents (ICAs) and develop an ICA specifically tailored to U.S. Supreme Court oral arguments. We propose a Dual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning framework featuring two cooperating RL agents, each with its own policy, to coordinate strategic dialogue management and fine-grained utterance generation. By learning when and how to ask probing questions, the agent emulates judicial questioning patterns and systematically uncovers crucial information to fulfill its legal objectives. Evaluations on a U.S. Supreme Court dataset show our method outperforms single-agent RL baselines in multiple metrics. Although specialized to a single legal domain, it represents an important first step toward broader high-stakes, domain-specific applications. We attached a part of the code as supplementary material. All code will be released upon publication for reproducibility.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前大多数对话系统都是由用户驱动的，其主要目的是满足用户的请求。然而，在许多重要的现实场景中，对话智能体必须主动提取信息以实现自己的目标，而不仅仅是回应用户的提问。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了“好奇型对话智能体”这一概念，并专门为美国最高法院的口头辩论开发了一种专门的ICA模型。我们提出了一种双层次强化学习框架，该框架包含两个协作的强化学习智能体，每个智能体都有自己的一套策略，从而能够协调战略性的对话管理和精细化的话语生成。通过学会何时以及如何提出深入的问题，这些智能体能够模仿司法询问的模式，系统地挖掘关键信息以达成其法律目标。在针对美国最高法院的数据集进行的评估中，我们的方法在多个指标上均优于单一智能体的强化学习基线算法。虽然这种模型是专为某个法律领域设计的，但它为更广泛的高风险、特定领域的应用奠定了基础。我们将部分代码作为补充材料提供，所有代码在发表后都会公开，以便其他人可以复现研究成果。

papers.title: [b] = [d] - [t] + [p]: Self-supervised Speech Models Discover Phonological Vector Arithmetic
papers.title_zh: [b] = [d] - [t] + [p]：自监督语音模型中的音位向量运算方法
papers.authors: Kwanghee Choi, Eunjung Yeo, Cheol Jun Cho, David Harwath, David R. Mortensen
papers.abstract: Self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) are known to encode rich phonetic information, yet how this information is structured remains underexplored. We conduct a comprehensive study across 96 languages to analyze the underlying structure of S3M representations, with particular attention to phonological vectors.We first show that there exist linear directions within the model’s representation space that correspond to phonological features. We further demonstrate that the scale of these phonological vectors correlate to the degree of acoustic realization of their corresponding phonological features in a continuous manner. For example, the difference between [d] and [t] yields a voicing vector: adding this vector to [p] produces [b], while scaling it results in a continuum of voicing. Together, these findings indicate that S3Ms encode speech using phonologically interpretable and compositional vectors, demonstrating phonological vector arithmetic.All code and interactive demos are available at https://github.com/juice500ml/phonetic-arithmetic.
papers.abstract_zh: 自监督语音模型（S3Ms）能够编码丰富的语音信息，但这些信息是如何被结构化的却尚未得到充分研究。我们对96种语言进行了全面的研究，以分析S3M表示背后的结构，特别关注音位向量。首先，我们发现模型的表示空间中存在与音位特征相对应的线性方向。进一步研究表明，这些音位向量的规模与其对应的音位特征的声学实现程度之间存在连续性的关系。例如，[d]和[t]之间的差异会产生一个发声向量：将该向量加到[p]上会得到[b]，而对其进行缩放则会产生一系列不同的发声状态。这些发现表明，S3Ms使用可解析音位的和式向量来编码语音，从而实现了音位向量的算术运算。所有代码和交互式演示均可在此处获取：https://github.com/juice500ml/phonetic-arithmetic。

papers.title: Waking Up Blind: Cold-Start Optimization of Supervision-Free Agentic Trajectories for Grounded Visual Perception
papers.title_zh: 醒来吧，失明者：为基于视觉感知的自主行为轨迹优化而设计的冷启动方法
papers.authors: Ashutosh Bajpai, Tamal Majumder, Akshay Nambi, Tanmoy Chakraborty
papers.abstract: Small Vision-Language Models (SVLMs) are efficient task controllers but often suffer from visual brittleness and poor tool orchestration. They typically require expensive supervised trajectory tuning to mitigate these deficits. In this work, we propose Self-supervised Perception Enabled by Cascaded Tool Rollout Alignment (SPECTRA), a supervision-free framework that bootstraps agentic capabilities via Coldstart Reinforcement Learning for SVLMs. SPECTRA enforces Soft Structured Multi-turn Rollouts, a topological constraint that directs agents to explicitly sequence tool derived evidence before synthesis, effectively grounding reasoning in visual observations. We employ a multi-objective reward signal that simultaneously maximizes task correctness, rollout structure, and tool utility, enabling agent to self-discover robust behaviors without human preference labels. We further introduce Tool Instrumental Utility (TIU), a novel metric to quantify tool efficacy in the absence of ground truth. Extensive evaluations across composite and out-of-distribution (MMMU-Pro) benchmarks demonstrate that SPECTRA boosts agentic trajectories, improving task accuracy by up to 5% and tool efficiency by 9%, enabling more efficient multimodal agents that learn effectively from environmental interaction alone.
papers.abstract_zh: 小型视觉语言模型虽然能高效地完成任务，但往往存在视觉反应迟钝和工具协同能力不足的问题。为了解决这些问题，通常需要昂贵的监督式轨迹调整来优化模型性能。在本研究中，我们提出了一种名为“由级联工具部署对齐驱动的自感知框架”——SPECTRA。该框架无需外部监督，而是通过冷启动强化学习来引导智能体发展相关能力。SPECTRA采用了软结构多轮工具部署策略，这种策略要求智能体在合成之前先明确排序各种工具产生的证据，从而将推理过程建立在视觉观察的基础上。我们采用了一种多目标奖励机制，既能保证任务的准确性，又能优化工具的使用效率，使智能体能够自主发现稳健的行为模式，而无需依赖人类的偏好标签。此外，我们还提出了工具工具效用这一新指标，用于量化在没有真实数据的情况下工具的有效性。通过广泛的测试表明，SPECTRA能够有效提升智能体的行为表现：任务准确率提高了5%，工具使用效率提升了9%。这使得智能体能够在仅依靠环境交互的情况下实现更高效的多模态任务处理。

papers.title: Spatial-RAG: Spatial Retrieval Augmented Generation for Real-World Geospatial Reasoning Questions
papers.title_zh: 空间检索增强生成：用于现实世界地理空间推理问题的技术
papers.authors: Dazhou Yu, Riyang Bao, Ruiyu Ning, Jinghong Peng, Gengchen Mai, Liang Zhao
papers.abstract: Answering real-world geospatial questions—such as finding restaurants along a travel route or amenities near a landmark—requires reasoning over both geographic relationships and semantic user intent. However, existing large language models (LLMs) lack spatial computing capabilities and access to up-to-date, ubiquitous real-world geospatial data, while traditional geospatial systems fall short in interpreting natural language. To bridge this gap, we introduce Spatial-RAG, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework designed for geospatial question answering. Spatial-RAG integrates structured spatial databases with LLMs via a hybrid spatial retriever that combines sparse spatial filtering and dense semantic matching. It formulates the answering process as a multi-objective optimization over spatial and semantic relevance, identifying Pareto-optimal candidates and dynamically selecting the best response based on user intent. Experiments across multiple tourism and map-based QA datasets show that Spatial-RAG significantly improves performance over strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 回答现实世界中的地理空间问题——比如找到旅行路线上的餐厅或地标附近的设施——需要同时考虑地理关系和语义用户意图。然而，现有的大语言模型缺乏空间计算能力，也无法获取最新的、无处不在的现实世界地理空间数据。而传统的地理空间系统在解释自然语言方面也存在不足。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Spatial-RAG框架。该框架是一种检索增强生成（RAG）框架，专为地理空间问题解答而设计。Spatial-RAG通过混合式空间检索器将结构化空间数据库与大语言模型相结合，该检索器结合了稀疏空间过滤和密集语义匹配技术。它通过将解答过程视为对空间和语义相关性的多目标优化来实施，能够识别出帕累托最优候选答案，并根据用户意图动态选择最佳响应。在多个旅游和地图基础问答数据集上的实验表明，Spatial-RAG的性能明显优于现有的强基线方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Program Structure-aware Language Models: Targeted Software Testing beyond Textual Semantics
papers.title_zh: 程序结构感知语言模型：超越文本语义的针对性软件测试
papers.authors: Khang Tran, Khoa Nguyen, Cristian Borcea, Hai Phan
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models for test case generation have improved branch coverage via prompt-engineered mutations. However, they still lack principled mechanisms for steering models toward specific high-risk execution branches, limiting their effectiveness for discovering subtle bugs and security vulnerabilities. We propose GLMTest, the first program structure-aware LLM framework for targeted test case generation that seamlessly integrates code property graphs and code semantics using a graph neural network and a language model to condition test case generation on execution branches. This structured conditioning enables controllable and branch-targeted test case generation, thereby potentially enhancing bug and security risk discovery. Experiments on real-world projects show that GLMTest built on a Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct model improves branch accuracy from 27.4% to 50.2% on TestGenEval benchmark compared with state-of-the-art LLMs, i.e., Claude-Sonnet-4.5 and GPT-4o-mini.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在大语言模型用于测试用例生成方面的进展，通过精心设计的突变提升了分支覆盖能力。然而，这些模型仍然缺乏引导模型走向特定高风险执行分支的系统性机制，这限制了它们在发现细微错误和安全漏洞方面的有效性。我们提出了GLMTest，这是一种针对目标测试用例生成的程序结构感知的LLM框架，它能够利用图神经网络和语言模型，将代码属性图和代码语义无缝集成到测试用例的生成过程中，从而根据执行分支来生成测试用例。这种结构化的条件设置使得测试用例的生成能够具有可控性和针对性，从而有可能提高错误和安全风险发现的效率。在真实项目上的实验表明，基于Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct模型的GLMTest在TestGenEval基准测试上的分支准确率从27.4%提升到了50.2%，相比最先进的LLM，如Claude-Sonnet-4.5和GPT-4o-mini，取得了显著的进步。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reasoning for Hierarchical Text Classification: The Case of Patents
papers.title_zh: 基于层次结构的文本分类推理：以专利为例
papers.authors: Lekang Jiang, Wenjun Sun, Stefan Goetz
papers.abstract: Hierarchical text classification (HTC) assigns documents to multiple levels of a pre-defined taxonomy. Automated patent subject classification represents one of the hardest HTC scenarios because of professional difficulties and extensive labels. Prior approaches only output a flat label set, which offers little insight into the reason behind predictions. Therefore, we propose Reasoning for Hierarchical Classification (RHC), a novel framework that reformulates HTC as a step-by-step reasoning task to sequentially deduce hierarchical labels. RHC trains large language models (LLMs) in two stages: a cold-start stage that aligns outputs with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning format and a reinforcement learning (RL) stage to enhance multi-step reasoning ability. RHC demonstrates four advantages in our experiments. (1) Effectiveness: RHC surpasses previous baselines and outperforms the supervised fine-tuning counterparts by approximately 3% in accuracy and macro F1. (2) Explainability: RHC produces natural-language justifications before prediction to facilitate human inspection. (3) Scalability: RHC scales favorably with model size with larger gains compared to standard fine-tuning. (4) Applicability: Beyond patents, we further demonstrate that RHC achieves state-of-the-art performance on other widely used HTC benchmarks, which highlights its broad applicability.
papers.abstract_zh: 层次文本分类（HTC）将文档分配到预定义分类体系中的多个层级。自动专利主题分类是层次文本分类中最困难的任务之一，因为涉及专业术语和大量标签。以往的方法只能输出一个简单的标签集，这无法揭示预测背后的原因。因此，我们提出了分层分类推理框架（RHC），该框架将层次文本分类重新定义为一个逐步推理任务，以依次推导出层次化标签。RHC通过两个阶段来训练大语言模型：第一阶段是冷启动阶段，用于将模型输出与思维链推理格式进行对齐；第二阶段是强化学习阶段，以提高多步推理能力。在我们的实验中，RHC展现了四个优势：(1) 有效性：RHC在准确性和宏观F1值方面均优于之前的基线方法，其性能比监督式微调方法高出约3%。(2) 可解释性：RHC在预测前会生成自然语言化的解释，便于人类审查。(3) 可扩展性：随着模型规模的增加，RHC的扩展效果优于标准微调方法，且收益更为显著。(4) 适用性：除了专利领域外，我们还证明了RHC在其他常用的层次文本分类基准测试中也能展现出顶尖的性能，这充分体现了其广泛的适用性。

papers.title: From Shijing to English and German: Resources and Evaluation for LLM Translation of Early Chinese Poetry
papers.title_zh: 从诗经到英语和德语：关于大型语言模型翻译早期中国诗歌的资源和评估方法
papers.authors: Ying Jiao, Meng Sun
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) show promise in literary translation, Shijing (The Book of Songs) serves as a rigorous yet under-explored testbed for testing their limits, given its linguistic antiquity and complex poetic constraints. Automated evaluation in this domain is currently hindered by a scarcity of multilingual resources and the inadequacy of existing metrics in capturing both semantic fidelity and aesthetic quality. In this paper, we bridge these gaps by curating a Shijing parallel corpus with line-by-line Chinese-English-German alignments, together with a fine-grained lexical knowledge base (KB) for archaic expressions. Based on these resources, we propose a hybrid evaluation framework that integrates knowledge-driven, rule-based, and LLM-as-judge metrics. Experimental results show that our framework achieves significantly higher human correlation than traditional metrics and demonstrates high statistical stability. By applying this framework to evaluate representative LLMs, we reveal that while top-tier models like Gemini-2.5-Pro and DeepSeek-3.1 show potential, achieving semantic precision and aesthetic sophistication—particularly in lower-resource directions like German—remains a persistent challenge. Our code, lexical KB, and corpus reconstruction protocols are available at https://github.com/ML-KULeuven/ShijingLLMTrans.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在文学翻译领域展现出巨大潜力，但《诗经》却是一个严格且尚未被充分探索的测试平台，因为它具有悠久的语言历史以及复杂的诗歌结构。目前，该领域的自动化评估受到多语言资源匮乏以及现有评估指标无法同时捕捉语义准确性和美学质量的限制。在本文中，我们通过整理一份包含逐行中文-英语-德语对齐关系的《诗经》平行语料库，并构建一个针对古语表达的细粒度词汇知识库，来弥补这些不足。基于这些资源，我们提出了一个混合评估框架，该框架结合了知识驱动、规则驱动以及基于大语言模型的评估方法。实验结果表明，我们的框架在语义准确性和美学质量方面都优于传统评估方法，并且具有高度的统计稳定性。通过将这一框架应用于对顶级语言模型的评估，我们发现，尽管像Gemini-2.5-Pro和DeepSeek-3.1这样的顶尖模型具有潜力，但在德语等资源较少的领域，实现语义精确性和美学精致性仍然是一个持续的挑战。我们的代码、词汇知识库以及语料库重建方案均可在此处获取：https://github.com/ML-KULeuven/ShijingLLMTrans
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: One Mask to Rule Them All: On Hidden Facts after Editing and How to Find Them
papers.title_zh: 一种面具，统治所有人：关于编辑后隐藏的事实以及如何发现它们
papers.authors: Ali Holmov, Paul Youssef, Nandi Schoots, Christin Seifert
papers.abstract: Knowledge editing methods such as ROME and MEMIT update factual associations in transformer models by modifying MLP weights. While evaluated mainly by output behavior, their internal mechanism remains underexplored. We investigate whether edits rely on a common mechanism, regardless of which fact is modified. Despite fact-specific weight changes, we argue that ROME and MEMIT target the same subset of weights critical for maintaining edits. To isolate this subset, we train a compact binary mask over the edited weights. The mask reverses 80% of edits on the training set and over 70% on the test set, confirming that diverse edits share a common functional structure. Our analysis reveals that the mask reverses edits by eliminating overattention in later layers. Additionally, we show that injecting the mask during editing drops editing success from 98% to 38%, demonstrating that this mechanism is necessary for edits to succeed. Our finding that edits suppress rather than overwrite knowledge explains why ROME and MEMIT fail to propagate changes to related facts. The identified common functional subspace informs detection and defense against unwanted edits.
papers.abstract_zh: 诸如ROME和MEMIT这样的知识编辑方法，通过修改MLP权重来更新Transformer模型中的事实关联。虽然这些方法的评估主要基于输出表现，但它们的内部机制却尚未得到充分研究。我们探讨了这些编辑是否依赖于某种共同的机制，而不管具体修改了哪个事实。尽管存在针对特定事实的权重调整，我们认为ROME和MEMIT所针对的权重子集对于维持编辑效果至关重要。为了分离出这一关键权重子集，我们在被编辑的权重上训练了一个紧凑的二进制掩码。该掩码在训练集上逆转了80%的编辑操作，在测试集上则逆转了超过70%的编辑操作，这证实了不同编辑操作之间存在共同的功能结构。我们的分析表明，该掩码通过消除后期层中的过度关注来逆转编辑操作。此外，我们还发现，在编辑过程中引入该掩码会使编辑成功率从98%下降到38%，这表明这种机制对于编辑操作的成功是必不可少的。我们发现，这些编辑操作实际上是抑制而非覆盖知识，这解释了为什么ROME和MEMIT无法将变化传播到相关事实上。所识别出的共同功能子空间有助于检测和防御不必要的编辑操作。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Analysing the Safety Pitfalls of Steering Vectors
papers.title_zh: 分析转向向量的安全隐患
papers.authors: Yuxiao Li, Alina Fastowski, Efstratios Zaradoukas, Bardh Prenkaj, Gjergji Kasneci
papers.abstract: Activation steering has emerged as a powerful tool to shape LLM behaviour without the need for weight updates. While its inherent brittleness and unreliability are well-documented, its safety implications remain underexplored. In this work, we present a systematic safety audit of steering vectors obtained with Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), a widely used steering approach, under a unified evaluation protocol. We show that steering vectors consistently influence the success rate of jailbreak attacks, with stronger amplification under simple template-based attacks. Across LLM families and sizes, steering the model in specific directions can drastically increase (by up to 57%) or decrease (by up to 50%) its attack success rate (ASR), depending on the targeted behaviour. We attribute this phenomenon to the overlap between the steering vectors and the latent subspace of refusal behaviour. Thus, we offer a mechanistic explanation for this discovery. Together, our findings reveal the previously unobserved origin of this safety gap in LLMs, highlighting a trade-off between controllability and safety. We release our code at https://github.com/yetiiil/analyse-sv-safety.
papers.abstract_zh: 激活引导已成为一种强大的工具，无需进行权重更新即可塑造大语言模型的行为。尽管其固有的脆弱性和不可靠性已有充分记录，但其安全性问题却尚未得到充分研究。在这项研究中，我们采用对比激活加法这一常用的引导方法，对获得的引导向量进行了系统的安全性评估，并采用了统一的评估协议。我们发现，引导向量会持续影响越狱攻击的成功率，在基于简单模板的攻击中，这种影响更为显著。无论是哪种类型或规模的大语言模型，将模型引导到特定方向都会使其攻击成功率出现显著变化——有时会增加多达57%，有时则会减少多达50%。我们认为这种现象是由于引导向量与拒绝行为的潜在子空间之间存在重叠所导致的。因此，我们为这一发现提供了机制上的解释。总的来说，我们的研究结果揭示了大语言模型中这一安全性问题的根源，同时指出了可控性与安全性之间的权衡关系。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/yetiiil/analyse-sv-safety下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Compartmentalised Agentic Reasoning for Clinical NLI
papers.title_zh: 用于临床自然语言推理的模块化代理式推理机制
papers.authors: Mael Jullien, Andre Freitas, Marco Valentino, Lei Xu
papers.abstract: Large language models can produce fluent judgments for clinical natural language inference, yet they frequently fail when the decision requires the correct inferential schema rather than surface matching. We introduce CARENLI, a compartmentalised agentic framework that routes each premise–statement pair to a reasoning family and then applies a specialised solver with explicit verification and targeted refinement. We evaluate on an expanded CTNLI benchmark of 200 instances spanning four reasoning families: Causal Attribution, Compositional Grounding, Epistemic Verification, and Risk State Abstraction. Across four contemporary backbones models, CARENLI improves mean accuracy from about 23% with direct prompting to about 57%, a gain of roughly 34 points, with the largest benefits on structurally demanding reasoning types. These results support compartmentalisation plus verification as a practical route to more reliable and auditable clinical inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够生成流畅的临床自然语言推理判断，但在需要正确推理模式而非表面匹配时，它们往往会出现失败。我们提出了CARENLI这一分区的智能框架，该框架将每个前提-陈述对分配到相应的推理类别中，然后运用专门的求解器进行验证和针对性优化。我们在包含四个推理类别的扩展CTNLI基准测试上进行评估：因果归因、组合性定位、认知验证以及风险状态抽象。在四种现代基础模型上，CARENLI的平均准确率从直接提示时的约23%提升到了约57%，提升了大约34个百分点，尤其是在要求较高的推理类型上表现更为出色。这些结果支持了分区化与验证相结合的方法，作为实现更可靠且可审计的临床推理的有效途径。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: RAG or Learning? Understanding the Limits of LLM Adaptation under Continuous Knowledge Drift in the Real World
papers.title_zh: RAG还是学习？在现实世界中，当知识持续变化时，如何理解对大型语言模型进行适配的局限性
papers.authors: Hanbing Liu, Lang Cao, Yang Li
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire most of their knowledge during pretraining, which ties them to a fixed snapshot of the world and makes adaptation to continuously evolving knowledge challenging. As facts, entities, and events change over time, models may experience continuous knowledge drift, resulting not only in outdated predictions but also in temporally inconsistent reasoning. Although existing approaches, such as continual finetuning, knowledge editing, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), aim to update or supplement model knowledge, they are rarely evaluated in settings that reflect chronological, evolving, and real-world knowledge evolution. In this work, we introduce a new benchmark of real-world dynamic events, constructed from time-stamped evidence that captures how knowledge evolves over time, which enables systematic evaluation of model adaptation under continuous knowledge drift. The benchmark reveals that most existing methods, including vanilla RAG and several learning-based approaches, struggle under this setting, exposing critical limitations such as catastrophic forgetting and temporal inconsistency. To mitigate these limitations, we propose a time-aware retrieval baseline, Chronos, which progressively organizes retrieved evidence into an Event Evolution Graph to enable more temporally consistent understanding in LLMs without additional training. Overall, this work provides a foundation for analyzing and advancing LLM adaptation to continuous knowledge drift in realistic settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在预训练阶段获取了大部分知识，这使得它们依赖于一个固定的世界快照，从而难以适应不断演变的知识。随着事实、实体和事件随时间发生变化，模型可能会出现持续的知识漂移现象，这不仅会导致预测过时，还会造成推理在时间上的不一致性。虽然现有的方法，如持续微调、知识编辑以及基于检索的生成技术，旨在更新或补充模型的知识，但这些方法很少在反映时间顺序、不断演变的现实世界知识演化的情况下进行评估。在这项研究中，我们引入了一个新的基准测试，用于评估现实世界中动态事件的变化情况。该基准测试基于带有时间戳的证据构建，能够捕捉知识随时间的发展过程，从而可以系统地评估模型在持续知识漂移情况下的适应能力。测试结果表明，包括传统的检索增强生成技术和几种基于学习的方法在内的大多数现有方法在这种环境下都存在困难，它们面临着诸如灾难性遗忘和时间不一致性等关键问题。为了缓解这些限制，我们提出了一种时间感知的检索基线技术——Chronos。该技术能够逐步将检索到的证据组织成一个事件演化图，从而在无需额外训练的情况下，使大语言模型具备更一致的时间理解能力。总体而言，这项工作为分析和改进大语言模型在现实环境中应对持续知识漂移的能力提供了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Content Fuzzing for Escaping Information Cocoons on Digital Social Media
papers.title_zh: 内容注入技术：在数字社交媒体上突破信息茧房的限制
papers.authors: Yifeng He, Ziye Tang, Hao Chen
papers.abstract: Information cocoons on social media limit users’ exposure to posts with diverse viewpoints. Modern platforms use stance detection as an important signal in recommendation and ranking pipelines, which can route posts primarily to like-minded audiences and reduce cross-cutting exposure. This restricts the reach of dissenting opinions and hinders constructive discourse. We take the creator’s perspective and investigate how content can be revised to reach beyond existing affinity clusters. We present ContentFuzz, a confidence-guided fuzzing framework that rewrites posts while preserving their human-interpreted intent and induces different machine-inferred stance labels. ContentFuzz aims to route posts beyond their original cocoons. Our method guides a large language model (LLM) to generate meaning-preserving rewrites using confidence feedback from stance detection models. Evaluated on four representative stance detection models across three datasets in two languages, ContentFuzz effectively changes machine-classified stance labels, while maintaining semantic integrity with respect to the original content.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体上的信息茧房限制了用户接触到不同观点的帖子的机会。现代平台将立场检测作为推荐和排名过程中的重要依据，这导致帖子主要被推送给具有相似兴趣的受众，从而减少了跨领域的曝光机会。这限制了不同意见的传播，阻碍了建设性的讨论。我们从创作者的角度出发，研究如何修改内容以超越现有的兴趣群体。我们提出了ContentFuzz这一基于置信度的内容修改框架，该框架在保留原文意图的同时，重新编写帖子，并引入不同的机器推断出的立场标签。ContentFuzz旨在将帖子传播到更广泛的领域。我们的方法引导大语言模型生成保留原意的改写内容，同时利用立场检测模型的置信度反馈来进行调整。在三个数据集上，使用两种语言对四个代表性的立场检测模型进行了评估，结果表明，ContentFuzz能够有效地改变机器分类出的立场标签，同时保持与原内容的语义一致性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: KnowledgeBerg: Evaluating Systematic Knowledge Coverage and Compositional Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: KnowledgeBerg：评估大型语言模型中的系统性知识覆盖能力及组合推理能力
papers.authors: Xiao Zhang, Qianru Meng, Yongjian Chen, Yumeng Wang, Johan Bos
papers.abstract: Many real-world questions appear deceptively simple yet implicitly demand two capabilities: (i) systematic coverage of a bounded knowledge universe and (ii) compositional set-based reasoning over that universe, a phenomenon we term “the tip of the iceberg.” We formalize this challenge through two orthogonal dimensions: knowledge width, the cardinality of the required universe, and reasoning depth, the number of compositional set operations. We introduce KnowledgeBerg, a benchmark of 4,800 multiple-choice questions derived from 1,183 enumeration seeds spanning 10 domains and 17 languages, with universes grounded in authoritative sources to ensure reproducibility. Representative open-source LLMs demonstrate severe limitations, achieving only 5.26–36.88 F1 on universe enumeration and 16.00–44.19 accuracy on knowledge-grounded reasoning. Diagnostic analyses reveal three stages of failure: completeness, or missing knowledge; awareness, or failure to identify requirements; and application, or incorrect reasoning execution. This pattern persists across languages and model scales. Although test-time compute and retrieval augmentation yield measurable gains—up to 4.35 and 3.78 points, respectively—substantial gaps remain, exposing limitations in how current LLMs organize structured knowledge and execute compositional reasoning over bounded domains. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/2npc/KnowledgeBerg
papers.abstract_zh: 许多现实世界中的问题看似简单，但实际上需要两种能力：(i)对有限知识域进行系统性的覆盖；(ii)对该知识域进行组合性集合推理。我们将这一挑战通过两个正交维度来表述：知识宽度，即所需知识域的基数；推理深度，即组合性集合操作的数量。我们引入了KnowledgeBerg这个基准测试，该测试包含4,800道选择题，这些题目源自1,183个样本数据，涵盖了10个领域和17种语言。这些知识域都基于权威来源，以确保结果的可重复性。一些代表性的开源大语言模型在知识域枚举方面表现极为有限，其F1分数仅在5.26到36.88之间，而在基于知识的推理方面则准确率仅为16.00到44.19。诊断分析揭示了三种失败原因：完整性问题，即缺失了某些知识；识别能力不足，即无法识别所需的信息；以及推理执行错误，即推理过程出错。这种模式在不同语言和模型规模下都存在。虽然测试时的计算能力和检索能力有所提升，分别提高了4.35和3.78分，但仍然存在明显的差距，这表明当前的大语言模型在组织结构化知识和在有限领域内执行组合性推理方面存在局限性。该数据集可以在https://huggingface.co/datasets/2npc/KnowledgeBerg获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory for Computer-Use Agents
papers.title_zh: 适用于计算机智能体的混合式自进化结构化记忆系统
papers.authors: Sibo Zhu, Wenyi WU, Kun Zhou, Stephen Wang, Biwei Huang
papers.abstract: The remarkable progress of vision–language models (VLMs) has enabled computer-use agents to interact with computers in a human-like manner. Yet real-world computer-use tasks remain difficult due to long-horizon workflows, diverse interfaces, and frequent intermediate errors. Prior work equips agents with external memory built from large collections of trajectories, but relies on flat retrieval over discrete summaries or continuous embeddings, falling short of the structured organization and self-evolving characteristics of human memory. Inspired by the brain, we propose Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory (HyMEM), a graph-based memory that couples discrete high-level symbolic nodes with continuous trajectory embeddings. HyMEM maintains a graph structure to support multi-hop retrieval, self-evolution via node update operations, and on-the-fly working-memory refreshing during inference. Extensive experiments show that HyMEM consistently improves open-source computer-use agents, enabling 7B/8B backbones to match or surpass strong closed-source models; notably, it boosts Qwen2.5-VL-7B by +22.5% and outperforms Gemini2.5-Pro-Vision and GPT-4o.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型的显著进步使得计算机使用代理能够以类似人类的方式与计算机进行交互。然而，现实中的计算机使用任务仍然面临挑战，因为这些任务涉及长周期工作流程、多样化的界面以及频繁的中间错误。以往的研究为代理提供了基于大量轨迹集合构建的外部记忆，但这种记忆依赖于离散摘要或连续嵌入的平面检索方式，远远无法满足人类记忆所具有的结构化组织能力和自我演化特性。受大脑的启发，我们提出了混合自演化结构化记忆技术——HyMEM。这种基于图的结构化记忆将离散的高级符号节点与连续的轨迹嵌入相结合。HyMEM通过维护图结构来支持多跳检索、通过节点更新操作实现自我演化，并在推理过程中实时更新工作记忆。大量的实验表明，HyMEM能够持续改善开源计算机使用代理的性能，使7B/8B规模的骨干模型达到甚至超越强大的闭源模型；尤其值得一提的是，它使Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型的性能提升了22.5%，并且优于Gemini2.5-Pro-Vision和GPT-4o模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Characterizing Selective Refusal Bias in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 描述大型语言模型中的选择性拒绝偏见
papers.authors: Adel Khorramrouz, Sharon Levy
papers.abstract: Safety guardrails in large language models (LLMs) are developed to prevent malicious users from generating toxic content at a large scale. However, these measures can inadvertently introduce or reflect new biases, as LLMs may refuse to generate harmful content targeting some demographic groups and not others. We explore this selective refusal bias in LLM guardrails through the lens of refusal rates of targeted individual and intersectional demographic groups, types of LLM responses, and length of generated refusals. Our results show evidence of selective refusal bias across gender, sexual orientation, nationality, and religion attributes. This leads us to investigate additional safety implications via an indirect attack, where we target previously refused groups, and find that Llama 3.1 fails to defend against our attack in roughly 89% of the trials. Our findings emphasize the need for more equitable and robust performance in safety guardrails across demographic groups.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型中的安全护栏旨在防止恶意用户大规模生成有害内容。然而，这些措施可能会无意中引入或反映新的偏见，因为语言模型可能会拒绝生成针对某些人群群体的有害内容，而忽略其他人群群体。我们通过分析针对特定个人和交叉性人群群体的拒绝率、语言模型的响应类型以及生成的拒绝内容的长度，来研究这种选择性拒绝偏见。我们的研究结果显示，在性别、性取向、国籍和宗教属性方面都存在选择性拒绝偏见。这促使我们进一步探究通过间接攻击来破坏安全护栏的效果，我们发现Llama 3.1在大约89%的测试案例中无法有效防御这种攻击。我们的研究结果强调了需要在不同人群群体中实现更公平且强大的安全防护措施。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Infusing Theory of Mind into Socially Intelligent LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 将心智理论能力融入社交智能的大型语言模型代理中
papers.authors: EunJeong Hwang, Yuwei Yin, Giuseppe Carenini, Peter West, Vered Shwartz
papers.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM)—an understanding of the mental states of others—is a key aspect of human social intelligence, yet, chatbots and LLM-based social agents do not typically integrate it. In this work, we demonstrate that LLMs that explicitly use ToM get better at dialogue, achieving goals more effectively. After showing that simply prompting models to generate mental states between dialogue turns already provides significant benefit, we further introduce ToMAgent (ToMA), a ToM-focused dialogue agent. ToMA is trained by pairing ToM with dialogue lookahead to produce mental states that are maximally useful for achieving dialogue goals. Experiments on the Sotopia interactive social evaluation benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of our method over a range of baselines. Extensive analysis shows that ToMA exhibits more strategic, goal-oriented reasoning behaviors, which enable long-horizon adaptation, while maintaining better relationships with their partners. Our results suggest a step forward in integrating ToM for building socially intelligent LLM agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 心智理论——即对他人心理状态的理解——是人类社交智能的关键方面。然而，基于聊天机器人和大语言模型的社交代理通常并不具备这一能力。在这项研究中，我们证明了那些明确运用心智理论的大模型在对话中表现得更为出色，能够更有效地实现目标。在证明仅仅提示模型在对话轮次之间生成心理状态就能带来显著效果之后，我们进一步提出了ToMAgent这一以心智理论为核心的对话代理。ToMAgent通过将心智理论与对话预测相结合来训练，从而生成对实现对话目标最有益的心理状态。在Sotopia交互式社交评估基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法优于多种基线算法。广泛的分析显示，ToMAgent表现出更具策略性和目标导向性的推理行为，这使得它能够进行长期适应，同时与合作伙伴保持更好的关系。我们的研究结果表明，在构建具有社交智能的大模型代理时，将心智理论融入其中是一个重要的进步。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Do BabyLMs Wanna Learn Wanna Contraction? On the Learnability without Language-Specific Bias
papers.title_zh: BabyLMs是否愿意学习“ wanna contraction”这个单词呢？关于无语言偏见的学习能力问题……
papers.authors: Kangsan Noh, Sanghoun Song
papers.abstract: This study investigates whether the grammatical constraints on wanna contraction—a phenomenon traditionally cited as evidence for innate linguistic knowledge—can be learned via BabyLMs, which are designed to reflect cognitively plausible learning conditions. Two datasets were constructed from the CHILDES corpus, varying in embedded verb frequency (high vs. low) and grammaticality, and contrasting grammatical instances (object extraction contexts) with ungrammatical ones (subject extraction contexts) of wanna contractions. Using surprisal as a metric, we evaluated 24 BabyLMs from the 2024 BabyLM Challenge alongside four standard models, including BERT and GPT-2. While the standard models performed with near-perfect consistency, the BabyLMs showed modest but meaningful sensitivity, particularly those trained on larger datasets and tested on high-frequency wanna instances. In particular, only encoder-based BabyLMs captured the grammatical constraint, with babylm24_MLSM exhibiting consistent performance. Nonetheless, our findings provide evidence for limited and conditional learnability of wanna contraction by artificial learners under cognitively realistic input conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了对于“wanna”缩略形式的语法限制——这一现象通常被视为先天语言知识的证据——是否可以通过BabyLMs来学习。BabyLMs的设计旨在模拟具有认知上合理的学习条件。我们从CHILDES语料库中构建了两个数据集，这两个数据集在嵌入动词的频率（高与低）和语法性方面有所不同，并且对“wanna”缩略形式的语法实例（宾语提取上下文）与非语法实例（主语提取上下文）进行了对比。我们使用惊讶度作为评估指标，对2024年BabyLM挑战赛中的24个BabyLMs以及四个标准模型进行了评估，包括BERT和GPT-2。虽然标准模型的性能几乎完全一致，但BabyLMs表现出适度的但有意义的敏感性，尤其是那些在更大数据集上训练并在高频“wanna”实例上进行测试的宝宝LMs。具体来说，只有基于编码器的BabyLMs能够捕捉到语法限制，其中babylm24_MLSM的表现一直很稳定。尽管如此，我们的研究结果证明了在认知上合理的输入条件下，人工学习者对“wanna”缩略形式的学习能力是有限的且有条件的。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: OpenGenAlign: A Preference Dataset and Benchmark for Trustworthy Reward Modeling in Open-Ended, Long-Context Generation
papers.title_zh: OpenGenAlign：一个偏好数据集和基准测试，用于实现在开放式、长上下文生成场景中的可信奖励建模
papers.authors: Hanning Zhang, Juntong Song, Juno Zhu, Yuanhao Wu, Tong Zhang, Cheng Niu
papers.abstract: Reward Modeling is critical in evaluating and improving the generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). % They are typically trained on high-quality annotated datasets to distinguish between better and worse responses. While numerous recent works have shown its feasibility in improving safety, helpfulness, reasoning, and instruction-following ability, its capability and generalization to open-ended long-context generation is still rarely explored.In this paper, we introduce OpenGenAlign, a framework and a high-quality dataset designed to develop reward models to evaluate and improve hallucination-free, comprehensive, reliable, and efficient open-ended long-context generation. We define four key metrics to assess generation quality and develop an automated pipeline to evaluate the outputs of multiple LLMs across long-context QA, Data-to-Text, and Summarization scenarios using o3, ending up with 33K high-quality preference data with a human agreement rate of 81%. Experimental results first demonstrate that existing reward models perform suboptimally on the held-out benchmark. And Our trained reward model achieves superior performance in the benchmark and effectively improves the generation quality of the policy models using Reinforcement Learning (RL). Additionally, OpenGenAlign could be used for effective guided generation in existing datasets. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the OpenGenAlign could be integrated with reward data from other domains to achieve better performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 奖励模型在评估和改进大语言模型（LLM）的生成过程中起着至关重要的作用。这些模型通常会在高质量标注的数据集上进行训练，以便区分优劣不同的回答。虽然许多近期的研究表明，奖励模型在提高安全性、实用性、推理能力和指令遵循能力方面具有可行性，但其对开放式长上下文生成的通用性仍然鲜有研究。在本文中，我们介绍了OpenGenAlign这一框架以及高质量数据集，旨在开发奖励模型来评估和改进无幻觉、全面、可靠且高效的开放式长上下文生成能力。我们定义了四个关键指标来评估生成质量，并开发了一种自动化流程，用于评估多个LLM在长上下文问答、数据转文本和摘要场景下的输出效果。最终获得了33K条高质量偏好数据，其人类一致性率为81%。实验结果表明，现有的奖励模型在保留的基准测试上的表现并不理想。而我们训练的奖励模型在基准测试中表现出色，并通过强化学习有效提升了策略模型的生成质量。此外，OpenGenAlign还可以用于现有数据集中的有效引导生成。我们还证明了OpenGenAlign可以与其他领域的奖励数据相结合，以实现更好的性能提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Understanding LLMs’ summarization capabilities: an analysis of biomedical abstract and lay summary generation
papers.title_zh: 理解大语言模型의摘要生成能力：对生物医学论文摘要与通俗说明文本生成的分析
papers.authors: Batuhan Nursal, Cassie S. Mitchell
papers.abstract: Scientific abstracts and lay summaries serve distinct but critical roles in research communication. Abstracts use technical language for academic audiences, while lay summaries aim to make findings accessible to non-specialists. With the rise of large language models (LLMs), there is increasing interest in automating the generation of both types of summaries—especially in the biomedical domain, where clarity and factual accuracy are essential. This study evaluates the performance of lightweight LLMs (under 8B parameters) in generating biomedical abstracts and lay summaries in a zero-shot setting. We assess outputs across three key dimensions: relevance, readability, and factuality. Additionally, we introduce a novel analysis of the sectional origin and desirability of information—where desirability reflects the utility of content from the reader’s perspective. We further compare human and LLM preferences using an objective ranking task. Our results show that LLM-generated summaries often contain comparable levels of desirable information to gold-standard human references. In several cases, LLM outputs are preferred by human evaluators and occasionally mistaken for human-authored text. These findings demonstrate the potential of lightweight LLMs for scalable, high-quality summarization and suggest their practical use in domains requiring both technical and accessible communication. The codebase for this study is publicly available on GitHub: https://github.com/batuinmetz/Understanding-LLMs-summarization-capabilities
papers.abstract_zh: 科学摘要和通俗总结在研究交流中扮演着不同但至关重要的角色。摘要使用技术性的语言面向学术读者，而通俗总结则旨在让非专业人士也能理解研究结果。随着大语言模型的发展，人们越来越关注自动化生成这两种类型的摘要——尤其是在生物医学领域，清晰度和事实准确性至关重要。本研究评估了轻量级语言模型（参数小于80亿）在零样本情况下生成生物医学摘要和通俗摘要的能力。我们从三个关键维度对输出进行评估：相关性、可读性和事实性。此外，我们还提出了一种分析信息来源和信息可取性的新方法——其中信息可取性反映了从读者角度来看内容的实用性。我们通过一个客观排名任务来比较人类和语言模型的偏好。结果表明，语言模型生成的摘要通常包含与标准人类参考文献相当的可取信息量。在某些情况下，人类评估者更喜欢语言模型的输出，有时甚至将其误认为是人类撰写的文本。这些发现表明，轻量级语言模型在可扩展且高质量地生成摘要方面具有潜力，并提示了它们在需要同时具备技术性和易理解性的领域的实际应用价值。本研究的代码库可在GitHub上获取：https://github.com/batuinmetz/Understanding-LLMs-summarization-capabilities
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FIFA: Unified Faithfulness Evaluation Framework for Text-to-Video and Video-to-Text Generation
papers.title_zh: 国际足联：用于文本转视频及视频转文本生成的统一忠实度评估框架
papers.authors: Liqiang Jing, Viet Dac Lai, Seunghyun Yoon, Trung Bui, Xinya Du
papers.abstract: Video Multimodal Large Language Models (VideoMLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in both Video-to-Text and Text-to-Video tasks. However, they often suffer from hallucinations, generating content that contradicts the visual input. Existing evaluation methods are limited to one task (V2T) and also fail to assess hallucinations in open-ended, free-form responses. To address this gap, we propose FIFA, a unified FaIthFulness evAluation framework that extracts comprehensive descriptive facts, models their semantic dependencies via a Spatio-Temporal Semantic Dependency Graph, and verifies them using VideoQA models. We further introduce , a tool-based correction framework that revises hallucinated content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FIFA aligns more closely with human judgment than existing evaluation methods, and that effectively improves factual consistency in both text and video generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频多模态大语言模型在视频转文本和文本转视频任务上取得了显著进展。然而，这些模型常常出现幻觉现象，生成的文本内容会与视觉输入相矛盾。现有的评估方法仅限于单一任务（视频转文本），且无法有效评估开放式、自由形式的回答中的幻觉问题。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了FIFA框架——一个统一的真实性评估工具。该框架能够提取全面的描述性信息，通过时空语义依赖图来建模它们之间的语义关系，并使用视频问答模型进行验证。此外，我们还提出了一种基于工具的修正框架，用于修正幻觉内容。大量实验表明，FIFA框架比现有评估方法更能符合人类的判断标准，并且能够有效提高文本和视频生成过程中的事实一致性。

papers.title: RLHS: Mitigating Misalignment in RLHF with Hindsight Simulation
papers.title_zh: RLHS：利用后见之明模拟技术来减少强化学习中的不一致性问题
papers.authors: Kaiqu Liang, Haimin Hu, Ryan Liu, Thomas L. Griffiths, Jaime Fernández Fisac
papers.abstract: While Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has shown promise in aligning generative AI, we present empirical evidence that it can also cause severe, systematic misalignment. We hypothesize that this stems from evaluator feedback depending on downstream outcome predictions (foresight) that can be influenced by the AI’s output, inducing Goodhart’s law dynamics. We present a theoretical analysis showing that conditioning evaluator feedback on downstream observations (hindsight) inhibits this effect by decoupling the alignment signal from potentially compromised predictions—crucially, the result holds even if the observed outcomes are sampled from the AI’s own world model. Building on this insight, we introduce Reinforcement Learning from Hindsight Simulation (RLHS), which presents plausible simulated outcomes to evaluators before eliciting feedback. We validate RLHS across three consultancy settings—marketplace interactions, restaurant recommendations, and online course advising—using both online (PPO) and offline (DPO) fine-tuning methods, and show that it substantially improves alignment over RLHF in experiments and human evaluations. We perform post-hoc benchmark evaluations on TruthfulQA, HaluEval, and TrustLLM, finding that even after single-task fine-tuning, RLHF misalignment persists, while RLHS consistently outperforms baselines and demonstrates strong out-of-domain generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于人类反馈的强化学习在使生成式人工智能与期望对齐方面表现出潜力，但我们发现了一些实证证据表明，这种学习方法也可能导致严重的、系统性的对齐问题。我们认为，这种现象的根源在于评估者的反馈依赖于下游的结果预测（即“先见之明”），而这一预测可能会受到人工智能输出结果的影响，从而引发古德哈特法则所描述的现象。我们的理论分析表明，通过将评估者的反馈与下游观测结果相结合（即“事后认知”），可以消除这种影响，因为这样可以将对齐信号与可能受干扰的预测分离开来。重要的是，即使观测到的结果是来自人工智能自身模型生成的，这一结论仍然成立。基于这一发现，我们提出了基于事后模拟的强化学习方法，该方法在获取反馈之前，会向评估者展示一些模拟出的结果。我们在三个应用场景中验证了这种方法的效果：市场互动、餐厅推荐以及在线课程建议。通过使用在线（PPO）和离线（DPO）两种微调方法，我们发现该方法显著提升了对齐效果，无论是在实验还是人类评估中都是如此。我们还对TruthfulQA、HaluEval和TrustLLM进行了后测评估，发现即使在单任务微调之后，基于RLHF的方法仍然存在对齐问题，而基于RLHS的方法则始终优于基线方法，并且具有出色的领域泛化能力。

papers.title: Propaganda Signals in LLMs: Perspectival Divergence and Narrative Framing in the Russia-Ukraine War
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中的宣传信号：在俄乌战争背景下视角差异与叙事框架的选择
papers.authors: Ofir Shabat, Ido Guy, Kira Radinsky
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to explain, summarize, and translate real-world events, including ongoing geopolitical conflicts. Yet it remains unclear whether they reproduce conflict-specific propaganda and, if so, how this appears in their outputs. We study this question for the Russia-Ukraine war through perspectival divergence, the extent to which model outputs align with competing narratives from different information ecosystems. We construct a conflict-aware evaluation set of neutral English event statements paired with Russian (RU)- and Ukrainian (UA)-oriented reference texts drawn from news outlets and Telegram channels. We then evaluate multiple LLMs under several prompting contexts using a reference-based semantic distance metric that measures directional proximity to RU- and UA-oriented references. To explain not only which side a model is closer to but also how that alignment is expressed, we further analyze outputs using five propaganda-relevant categories: Framing Narrative, Emotional Manipulation, Source Credibility, Social Pressure Identity, and Toponymy Naming. Across models, we find stable, model-specific leanings and technique profiles that persist across prompts and are not captured by standard factuality-oriented metrics. Our findings show that models that appear neutral under conventional evaluations can still encode systematic, conflict-specific propaganda patterns, underscoring the need for conflict-aware evaluation frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解释、总结和翻译现实世界事件方面得到了广泛应用，其中包括正在发生地缘政治冲突的情况。然而，目前仍不清楚这些模型是否能够再现与冲突相关的宣传内容，如果可以的话，这种宣传内容又如何体现在它们的输出中。我们通过视角差异的方法来研究这个问题，即模型输出与来自不同信息生态系统的竞争性叙事之间的吻合程度。我们构建了一个包含中性英语事件陈述的评估集，这些陈述与来自新闻媒体和Telegram频道的中俄语和乌克兰语参考文本相结合。然后，我们在多种提示情境下对多个语言模型进行评估，使用基于参考的语义距离指标来衡量模型输出与中俄语和乌克兰语参考文本之间的方向性接近程度。为了不仅了解模型更倾向哪一方，还了解这种倾向是如何体现的，我们还使用五个与宣传相关的类别来分析模型输出：叙事框架、情感操控、消息来源可信度、社会压力身份以及地名命名。我们发现，不同模型具有稳定的、特定于模型的偏好和技术特征，这些特征在不同提示条件下仍然存在，并且无法被传统的基于事实性的指标所捕捉。我们的研究结果表明，那些在传统评估中看似中立的模型仍然能够编码出系统性的、与冲突相关的宣传模式，这凸显了需要采用具有冲突意识的评估框架的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DELTA: Dynamic Layer-Aware Token Attention for Efficient Long-Context Reasoning
papers.title_zh: DELTA：动态层感知的令牌注意力机制，实现高效的长上下文推理
papers.authors: Hossein Entezari Zarch, Lei Gao, Chaoyi Jiang, Murali Annavaram
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on challenging benchmarks by generating long chains of intermediate steps, but their inference cost is dominated by decoding, where each new token must attend to the entire growing sequence. One approach to reduce this latency is to evict entries from the key-value (KV) cache, thereby reducing the active context used in attention computation. However, such sparse attention methods suffer from severe accuracy degradation on reasoning tasks due to cumulative selection errors and the evolving importance of tokens over long derivations. We present DELTA, a training-free sparse attention mechanism that improves computational efficiency without sacrificing model accuracy. DELTA partitions transformer layers into three groups: initial layers that use full attention, a small set of Δ-layers that identify salient tokens via aggregated head-level attention scores, and subsequent sparse-attention layers that attend only to the selected subset. This design preserves the full KV cache in GPU memory for accuracy, while avoiding expensive full-attention computation over many layers. On reasoning benchmarks such as AIME and GPQA-Diamond, DELTA matches or surpasses full attention in accuracy, while reducing the number of attended tokens by up to 4.25× and delivering 1.54× end-to-end speedup. Our results show that selective reuse of intermediate attention maps offers a robust path toward efficient long-context reasoning. The code is available at https://github.com/hoenza/DELTA.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在复杂的基准测试上取得了卓越的性能，它们通过生成一系列中间步骤来实现这一点。然而，这些模型的推理成本主要来自于解码过程，因为每个新的标记都需要处理整个不断增长的序列。一种减少这种延迟的方法是从键值缓存中移除某些条目，从而减少用于注意力计算的活跃上下文数量。不过，这种稀疏注意力方法在推理任务上的准确性会显著下降，这是由于累积选择错误以及长时间推导过程中标记重要性的变化所导致的。我们提出了DELTA，这是一种无需训练的稀疏注意力机制，它能够提高计算效率，同时不牺牲模型精度。DELTA将Transformer层分为三组：第一组是使用全注意力的初始层；第二组是少数几个Δ层，它们通过聚合的头部注意力分数来识别重要的标记；第三组则是仅关注选定子集的稀疏注意力层。这种设计在保持GPU内存中完整的键值缓存的同时，避免了多层的昂贵全注意力计算。在诸如AIME和GPQA-Diamond这样的推理基准测试中，DELTA在准确性方面与全注意力模型相当甚至更优，同时减少了被关注的标记数量，最高可达4.25倍，并且实现了1.54倍的端到端加速效果。我们的结果表明，选择性地重新使用中间注意力图是一种实现高效长上下文推理的有效途径。代码可以在https://github.com/hoenza/DELTA下载。

papers.title: LANTERN in the Event Stream: Training-Free Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting by Balancing Inertia and Shifts
papers.title_zh: 事件流中的“灯笼”：通过平衡惯性与变化来实现无需训练的时空知识图谱预测
papers.authors: Chengyuan Jin, Ao Chang, Daojian Zeng, Wenhao Teng, Xiangwen Liao, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao, Yubo Chen
papers.abstract: Temporal knowledge graph forecasting(TKGF) asks a model to rank the mostplausible future entity for a query such as(s, r, ?, t) from historical events. Recenttraining-free methods use large languagemodels (LLMs) for this task, but their accuracydepends heavily on which past events areshown in the prompt under a tight contextbudget. We present LANTERN, a training-freeprompting framework that addresses thisbottleneck by combining two complementaryviews of history: a long-window strengthscore for stable interaction patterns anda short-window novelty score for suddenchanges. LANTERN first filters unhelpfulevents, then selects a compact evidence setwith Pareto-greedy selection, and finally addsone structure-aware analogical demonstration.Across ICEWS14, ICEWS05-15, ICEWS18,and GDELT, LANTERN consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art training-free baselineAnRe under the same backbone and 2-hopcandidate protocol, improving Hits@1 by upto 2.5 points and MRR by up to 1.2 points.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间知识图谱预测（TKGF）要求模型根据历史事件，对查询中的未来实体进行排序。目前一些无需训练的方法使用大语言模型来完成这一任务，但其准确性在很大程度上取决于在有限的上下文预算下，提示中展示的是哪些过去事件。我们提出了LANTERN这一无需训练的指引框架，它通过结合两种互补的历史视角来解决这一难题：一种是用于稳定交互模式的长期强度评分，另一种是用于突发变化的短期新颖性评分。LANTERN首先过滤掉无用的事件，然后采用帕累托贪婪选择方法选取一组简洁的证据集，最后加入一种结构感知的类比性演示。在ICEWS14、ICEWS05-15、ICEWS18和GDELT数据中，LANTERN在相同的主干结构和两跳候选协议下，始终优于现有的无需训练基线算法AnRe。其Hits@1指标提高了2.5个百分点，MRR指标提高了1.2个百分点。

papers.title: Large Language Models for IT Automation Tasks: Are We There Yet?
papers.title_zh: 用于自动化任务的大型语言模型：我们是否已经取得了进展？
papers.authors: Md. Mahadi Hassan, John Salvador, Akond Rahman, Santu Karmaker
papers.abstract: LLMs show promise in code generation, yet their effectiveness for IT automation tasks, particularly for tools like Ansible, remains understudied. Existing benchmarks rely primarily on synthetic tasks that fail to capture the needs of practitioners who use IT automation tools. We present ExITBench (Execution-based IT Automation Benchmark), a benchmark of 126 diverse tasks (e.g., configuring servers and managing files) in which each task captures state reconciliation - a core property of IT automation tools. ExITBench evaluates LLMs’ ability to generate functional Ansible automation scripts via dynamic execution in controlled environments. We evaluate 14 open-source and 3 proprietary LLMs and find that GPT-4.1-Mini achieves the best pass@10 rate of 23.9%, while Claude-3.5-Sonnet achieves the best pass@1 performance. To explain the low performance, we analyze 1,517 execution failures across the evaluated LLMs and identify two prevalent semantic error categories: failures in state-reconciliation reasoning (42.117% combined from variable (12.287%), host (10.363%), path (10.511%), and template (8.956%) issues) and deficiencies in module-specific execution knowledge (26.203% combined from attribute & parameter (17.617%) and module (8.586%) errors). Our findings reveal key limitations in LLMs’ ability to address state reconciliation and apply specialized module knowledge, indicating that reliable IT automation with LLM-based agents need major advances in state reasoning and domain-specific execution.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成方面展现出巨大潜力，然而它们在IT自动化任务中的有效性，尤其是对于像Ansible这样的工具来说，仍然缺乏深入研究。现有的基准测试主要依赖于合成任务，这无法充分反映使用IT自动化工具的从业者的需求。我们提出了ExITBench（基于执行的IT自动化基准测试），该测试包含126种不同任务（例如配置服务器和管理文件），每项任务都涉及状态协调——这是IT自动化工具的核心特性。ExITBench通过在受控环境中进行动态执行，来评估大语言模型生成功能性的Ansible自动化脚本的能力。我们对14个开源模型和3个专有模型进行了评估，发现GPT-4.1-Mini取得了最高的通过率，达到了23.9%，而Claude-3.5-Sonnet则表现最佳。为了解释这些低性能的原因，我们分析了被评估模型在1,517次执行中的失败情况，并识别出两个常见的语义错误类别：状态协调推理方面的失败（占42.117%，包括变量问题（12.287%）、主机问题（10.363%）、路径问题（10.511%）和模板问题（8.956%））；以及特定模块执行知识方面的不足（占26.203%，包括属性和参数错误（17.617%）以及模块错误（8.586%））。我们的研究发现揭示了大语言模型在解决状态协调和应用特定模块知识方面的关键局限性，这表明，要使用基于大语言模型的代理实现可靠的IT自动化，还需要在状态推理和特定领域执行能力方面取得重大进展。

papers.title: Follow the Path: Reasoning over Knowledge Graph Paths to Improve Large Language Model Factuality
papers.title_zh: 遵循路径：通过推理知识图谱路径来提升大型语言模型的真实性水平
papers.authors: Mike Zhang, Johannes Bjerva, Russa Biswas
papers.abstract: We introduce fs1, a simple yet effective method that improves the factuality of reasoning traces by sourcing them from large reasoning models and grounding them by conditioning on knowledge graph (KG) paths. We fine-tune eight instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) on 3.9K factually grounded reasoning traces and rigorously evaluate them on six complex open-domain question-answering (QA) benchmarks encompassing 23.9K questions. Our results demonstrate that our fs1-tuned model consistently outperforms instruction-tuned counterparts with parallel sampling by 6-14 absolute points (pass@). Our detailed analysis shows that fs1 considerably improves model performance over more complex questions (requiring 3 or more hops on KG paths) and numerical answer types compared to the baselines. Furthermore, in single-pass inference, we notice that smaller LLMs show the most improvements. While prior works demonstrate the effectiveness of reasoning traces primarily in the STEM domains, our work shows strong evidence that anchoring reasoning to factual KG paths is a critical step in transforming LLMs for reliable knowledge-intensive tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了fs1这一简单但有效的方法，该方法通过将推理轨迹来源于大型推理模型，并基于知识图谱路径进行约束，从而提高了推理结果的真实性。我们在3.9K条具有真实依据的推理轨迹上对八种经过指令调优的大语言模型进行了微调，并在包含23.9K个问题的六个复杂开放领域问答基准测试中对它们进行了严格评估。我们的结果表明，经过fs1调优的模型在绝对得分上始终优于那些采用并行采样方法的指令调优模型，优势达6-14分。详细分析显示，与基线模型相比，fs1在处理更复杂的问题（需要沿着知识图谱路径进行3次或更多次跳转）以及数值型答案类型时，能够显著提升模型的性能。此外，在单次推理过程中，我们发现较小的语言模型表现出最大的改进效果。虽然之前的研究表明，推理轨迹在STEM领域具有有效性，但我们的研究提供了强有力的证据，证明将推理过程与真实的知识图谱路径相结合，是使语言模型能够在需要可靠知识的任务中发挥作用的关键步骤。

papers.title: Time-RA: Towards Time Series Reasoning for Anomaly Diagnosis with LLM Feedback
papers.title_zh: 时间推理：利用大语言模型反馈进行时间序列异常诊断的方法研究
papers.authors: Yiyuan Yang, Zichuan Liu, Lei Song, Kai Ying, Stephen Wang, Joshua Thomas Bamford, Svitlana Vyetrenko, Jiang Bian, Qingsong Wen
papers.abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has traditionally focused on binary classification and often lacks the fine-grained categorization and explanatory reasoning required for transparent decision-making. To address these limitations, we propose Time-series Reasoning for Anomaly (Time-RA), a novel task that reformulates TSAD from a discriminative into a generative, reasoning-intensive paradigm. To facilitate this, we introduce RATs40K, the first real-world large-scale multimodal benchmark with ~40,000 samples across 10 domains, integrating raw time series, textual context, and visual plots with structured reasoning annotations. Extensive benchmarking shows that while supervised fine-tuning and visual representations boost diagnostic accuracy and reasoning consistency, performance varies across complex scenarios. Notably, fine-tuned models demonstrate strong “plug-and-play” transferability, outperforming traditional baselines on unseen real-world datasets. Our work establishes a foundation for interpretable, multimodal time series analysis. All code and the RATs40K dataset are fully open-sourced to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）传统上侧重于二元分类，往往缺乏实现透明决策所需的细粒度分类和解释性推理。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了时间序列异常推理（Time-RA）这一创新方法。该方法将TSAD从一种判别性范式转变为一种注重生成的、需要大量推理的过程。为了实现这一目标，我们开发了RATs40K数据集——这是首个真实世界的大规模多模态基准数据集，包含约40,000个样本，涵盖10个领域，整合了原始时间序列数据、文本上下文以及带有结构化推理注释的视觉图表。广泛的基准测试表明，虽然监督式微调技术和视觉表示技术能够提高诊断准确性和推理一致性，但在复杂场景中的性能表现有所不同。值得注意的是，经过微调的模型表现出强大的“即插即用”迁移能力，在未经预处理的真实世界数据集上超越了传统的基线模型。我们的工作为可解释的多模态时间序列分析奠定了基础。所有代码和RATs40K数据集均已完全开源，以便未来进行进一步研究。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Ground Then Rank: Revisiting Knowledge-Based VQA with Training-Free Entity Identification
papers.title_zh: 地面然后排名：重新探讨无需训练的实体识别在知识驱动的视频理解中的应用
papers.authors: Qian Ma, Qiong Wu, Zhengyi Zhou, Yao Ma
papers.abstract: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires grounding visual queries to external knowledge beyond directly observable content in images.While recent multi modal large language models (MLLMs) show strong perceptual abilities, they struggle on KB-VQA tasks requiring groundings from both fine-grained entity and evidence levels.Most existing multi-modal retrieval augmented generation (MM-RAG) methods tightly couple entity discrimination and section-level evidence ranking into a single re-ranking stage, leading to high cost and limited generalization.In this work, we revisit existing MM-RAG solutions from a workflow perspective and argue both entity-level and fact-level groundings are key bottlenecks.We observe that although MLLMs often fail under open-ended entity naming, they can better identify the correct entity when selecting from a small set of candidate names.Based on this insight, we propose a simple and training-free identify-before-answer IBA framework that decouples entity identification from section-level re-ranking.Our approach prompts an MLLM to select high-confidence entities using only candidate names, followed by an off-the-shelf textual re-ranker for evidence selection.Experiments on Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek show that our method consistently outperforms fine-tuned multi-modal re-ranking baselines while reducing training and inference complexity.Additional analyses reveal that the improvements arise not only from better entity identification, but also from selecting more informative evidence once correct entity is fixed.Our implementation is made public to ease reproducibility
papers.abstract_zh: 基于知识的视觉问答（KB-VQA）需要将视觉查询与图像中无法直接观察到的外部知识联系起来。虽然最近的多模态大语言模型在感知能力方面表现出色，但在需要同时处理细粒度实体和证据级别的KB-VQA任务时却表现不佳。大多数现有的多模态检索增强生成方法将实体区分和段落级证据排序紧密地结合在一起，这导致了较高的计算成本以及有限的泛化能力。在这项研究中，我们从工作流程的角度重新审视了现有的多模态检索增强生成解决方案，认为实体级别和事实级别的关联处理是关键的瓶颈。我们发现，尽管多模态大语言模型在开放式的实体命名任务上常常失败，但当需要从少量候选名称中选择时，它们能够更准确地识别出正确的实体。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种简单且无需训练的“先识别再回答”的IBA框架，该框架将实体识别与段落级排序分离开来。我们的方法让多模态大语言模型仅使用候选名称来选择高置信度的实体，然后由现成的文本排序器来处理证据选择问题。在Encyclopedic-VQA和InfoSeek上的实验表明，我们的方法在降低训练和推理复杂性的情况下，始终优于经过微调的多模态排序基线方法。进一步的分析显示，我们的改进不仅来自于更好的实体识别能力，还来自于在确定了正确实体之后，能够选择出更有信息量的证据。我们的实现方式已经公开，以便于其他研究人员进行复现。
