papers.title: Non-invasive electromyographic speech neuroprosthesis: a geometric perspective
papers.title_zh: 非侵入性肌电语音神经假体：从几何学的角度看待这一技术
papers.authors: Harshavardhana T Gowda, Lee M. Miller
papers.abstract: We present a neuromuscular speech interface that translates silently voiced articulations directly into text. We record surface electromyographic (EMG) signals from multiple articulatory sites on the face and neck as participants silently articulate speech, enabling direct EMG-to-text translation. Such an interface has the potential to restore communication for individuals who have lost the ability to produce intelligible speech due to laryngectomy, neuromuscular disease, stroke, or trauma-induced damage (e.g., radiotherapy toxicity) to the speech articulators. Prior work has largely focused on mapping EMG collected during audible articulation to time-aligned audio targets or transferring these targets to silent EMG recordings, which inherently requires audio and limits applicability to patients who can no longer speak. In contrast, we propose an efficient representation of high-dimensional EMG signals and demonstrate direct sequence-to-sequence EMG-to-text conversion at the phonemic level without relying on time-aligned audio.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种神经肌肉语音接口，能够直接将无声的发音转化为文本。在参与者进行无声发音时，我们会记录面部和颈部多个发音部位的表面肌电信号，从而实现从肌电信号到文本的直接转换。这种接口有潜力帮助那些因喉切除术、神经肌肉疾病、中风或创伤性损伤（如放疗毒性）而丧失清晰发音能力的患者恢复沟通能力。目前的研究主要集中在将可听发音时的肌电信号与时间对齐的音频目标进行映射，或者将这些目标转移到无声的肌电记录上，但这通常需要使用音频数据，因此对于无法说话的患者来说并不适用。相比之下，我们提出了一种高效的高维肌电信号表示方法，并证明了可以在音素级别实现直接从肌电信号到文本的转换，而无需依赖时间对齐的音频数据。

papers.title: Context Attribution with Multi-Armed Bandit Optimization
papers.title_zh: 基于多臂老虎机优化的方法进行情境归因分析
papers.authors: Deng Pan, Keerthiram Murugesan, Ting Hua, Nuno Moniz, Nitesh V. Chawla
papers.abstract: Understanding which parts of the retrieved context contribute to a large language model’s generated answer is essential for building interpretable and trustworthy retrieval-augmented generation. We propose a novel framework that formulates context attribution as a combinatorial multi-armed bandit problem. We utilize Linear Thompson Sampling to efficiently identify the most influential context segments while minimizing the number of model queries. Our reward function leverages token log-probabilities to measure how well a subset of segments supports the original response, making it applicable to both open-source and black-box API-based models. Unlike SHAP and other perturbation-based methods that sample subsets uniformly, our approach adaptively prioritizes informative subsets based on posterior estimates of segment relevance, reducing computational costs. Experiments on multiple QA benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves up to 30% reduction in model queries while matching or exceeding the attribution quality of existing approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 了解检索到的上下文中的哪些部分对大语言模型生成的答案有贡献，对于构建可解释且可靠的检索增强生成技术至关重要。我们提出了一种新颖的框架，将上下文归因问题转化为一个组合式多臂老虎机问题。我们利用线性汤普森采样算法来高效识别最具影响力的上下文片段，同时最小化模型查询的次数。我们的奖励函数利用令牌日志概率来衡量某些片段对原始回答的支持程度，这使得该方法适用于开源模型和基于黑盒API的模型。与SHAP和其他基于扰动的方法不同，我们的方法能够根据片段相关性的后验估计自适应地选择具有信息价值的片段，从而降低了计算成本。在多个问答基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法能够在减少模型查询次数的同时，保持或甚至超越现有方法的归因质量，最多可减少30%的模型查询次数。

papers.title: Peering Behind the Shield: Guardrail Identification in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 窥探护盾的背后：大型语言模型中的护栏识别机制
papers.authors: Ziqing Yang, Yixin Wu, Rui Wen, Michael Backes, Yang Zhang
papers.abstract: With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs), conversational AI agents have become widely deployed across real-world applications. To enhance safety, these agents are often equipped with guardrails that moderate harmful content. Identifying the guardrails in an agent thus becomes critical for adversaries to understand the system and design guard-specific attacks. In this work, we introduce AP-Test, a novel approach that leverages guard-specific adversarial prompts to detect the identity of guardrails deployed in black-box AI agents. Our method addresses key challenges in this task, including the influence of safety-aligned LLMs and other guardrails, as well as a lack of principled decision-making strategies. AP-Test employs two complementary testing strategies, input and output guard tests, and a new metric, match score, to enable robust identification. Experiments across diverse agents and four open-source guardrails demonstrate that AP-Test achieves perfect classification accuracy in multiple scenarios. Ablation studies further highlight the necessity of our proposed components. Our findings reveal a practical path toward guardrail identification in real-world AI systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型被迅速采用，对话式人工智能代理已经广泛应用于现实世界中的各种应用中。为了提升安全性，这些代理通常配备有用于过滤有害内容的机制。因此，识别这些机制对于对手来说至关重要，因为他们可以通过这些机制来了解系统并设计针对特定机制的攻击手段。在这项研究中，我们提出了AP-Test这一新方法，该方法利用针对特定机制的对抗性提示来识别黑盒式人工智能代理中部署的各类机制。我们的方法解决了该任务中的关键挑战，包括与安全性相关的语言模型以及其他机制的影响，以及缺乏合理的决策策略等问题。AP-Test采用了两种互补的测试策略：输入和输出机制测试，以及一种新的评估指标——匹配得分，以实现准确的识别。通过对多种代理和四种开源机制进行的实验表明，AP-Test在多种情况下都能实现完美的分类准确率。进一步的消融研究进一步强调了我们所提出的组件的重要性。我们的研究结果揭示了在实际的人工智能系统中识别机制的一种实用方法。

papers.title: WildSci: Advancing Scientific Reasoning from In-the-Wild Literature
papers.title_zh: WildSci：通过野外研究推动科学推理的发展
papers.authors: Tengxiao Liu, Deepak Nathani, Zekun Li, Kevin Yang, William Yang Wang
papers.abstract: Recent progress in large language model (LLM) reasoning has focused on domains like mathematics and coding, where abundant high-quality data and objective evaluation metrics are readily available. In contrast, progress in scientific reasoning remains limited in domains such as medicine and materials science due to restricted dataset coverage and the inherent complexity of open-ended scientific questions. To address these challenges, we propose a general framework for sustainable scientific reasoning QA generation, and introduce WildSci, a new dataset of domain-specific science questions automatically synthesized from peer-reviewed literature, spanning 9 scientific disciplines and 26 subdomains. WildSci enables scalable training with well-defined reward signals in a multiple-choice format. We further apply reinforcement learning to finetune models on WildSci and analyze the resulting training dynamics, including domain-specific performance changes, response behaviors, and generalization trends. Experiments on a suite of scientific benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework and dataset. We release WildSci to enable scalable and sustainable research in scientific reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期，大语言模型在推理方面的进展主要集中在数学和编程等领域，这些领域拥有丰富的高质量数据以及易于使用的客观评估指标。相比之下，由于数据集覆盖范围有限，且开放式科学问题本身具有复杂性，科学推理领域的进展仍然受到限制。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一个用于可持续科学推理问答生成的通用框架，并引入了WildSci这一新数据集。该数据集包含从同行评审的文献中自动合成的特定领域的科学问题，涵盖了9个科学学科和26个子领域。WildSci能够以可扩展的方式训练模型，并提供明确的奖励信号，采用选择题的形式进行训练。我们还应用强化学习来优化模型在WildSci数据集上的表现，并分析了训练过程中的各种动态变化，包括特定领域的性能变化、响应行为以及泛化趋势。在一系列科学基准测试上的实验表明，我们的框架和数据集是有效的。我们发布WildSci数据集，旨在推动科学推理领域的可扩展性和可持续性研究。

papers.title: WebDART: Dynamic Decomposition and Re-planning for Complex Web Tasks
papers.title_zh: WebDART：用于复杂网络任务的动态分解与重新规划技术
papers.authors: Jingbo Yang, Bairu Hou, Wei Wei, Shiyu Chang, Yujia Bao
papers.abstract: Large-language-model (LLM) agents are becoming competent at straightforward web tasks, such as opening an item page or submitting a form, but still struggle with objectives that require long-horizon navigation, large-scale information extraction, and reasoning under constraints. We present WebDART, a general framework that enables a single LLM to handle such complex chores. WebDART (i) dynamically decomposes each objective into three focused subtasks—navigation, information extraction, and execution—so the model concentrates on one skill at a time, and (ii) continuously re-plans the decomposition as new webpages are revealed, taking advantage of newly discovered filters or shortcuts and avoiding redundant exploration. Evaluated on WebChoreArena, WebDART lifts end-to-end success rates by up to 13.7 percentage points over previous state-of-the-art agents, while matching their performance on the easier WebArena suite and completing tasks with up to 14.7 fewer navigation steps. Code will be publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理已经能够胜任一些简单的网络任务，比如打开商品页面或提交表单，但在需要长期规划、大规模信息提取以及在有约束条件下进行推理的任务上仍然表现不佳。我们提出了WebDART这一通用框架，它使得单个LLM能够处理这些复杂的任务。WebDART具有以下特点：(i) 将每个任务动态分解为三个子任务——导航、信息提取和执行，这样模型可以一次专注于一项技能；(ii) 当新的网页出现时，WebDART会不断重新规划任务分解方式，利用新发现的捷径或过滤器，避免重复性的探索。在WebChoreArena上的评估结果显示，WebDART的整体成功率比现有的最先进的代理高出13.7个百分点，同时在较简单的WebArena套件中也能达到与它们相当的性能水平，并且完成任务所需的导航步骤减少了14.7步。该代码的实现方式将会公开提供。

papers.title: Like a Therapist, But Not: Reddit Narratives of AI in Mental Health Contexts
papers.title_zh: 像心理治疗师一样，但又并非如此：Reddit上关于人工智能在心理健康领域应用的讨论
papers.authors: Elham Aghakhani, Rezvaneh Rezapour
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support and mental health–related interactions outside clinical settings, yet little is known about how people evaluate and relate to these systems in everyday use. We analyze 5,126 Reddit posts from 47 mental health communities describing experiential or exploratory use of AI for emotional support or therapy. Grounded in the Technology Acceptance Model and therapeutic alliance theory, we develop a theory-informed annotation framework and apply a hybrid LLM–human pipeline to analyze evaluative language, adoption-related attitudes, and relational alignment at scale. Our results show that engagement is shaped primarily by narrated outcomes, trust, and response quality, rather than emotional bond alone. Positive sentiment is most strongly associated with task and goal alignment, while companionship-oriented use more often involves misaligned alliances and reported risks such as dependence and symptom escalation. Overall, this work demonstrates how theory-grounded constructs can be operationalized in large-scale discourse analysis and highlights the importance of studying how users interpret language technologies in sensitive, real-world contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在除临床环境之外的情感支持和心理健康相关互动中得到了越来越多的应用。然而，人们对人们在日常使用中如何评估这些系统以及与之建立关系的情况知之甚少。我们分析了来自47个心理健康社区的5,126篇Reddit帖子，这些帖子描述了人们利用人工智能进行情感支持或治疗的体验性或探索性使用情况。基于技术接受模型和治疗联盟理论，我们开发了一个基于理论的注释框架，并采用混合式LLM-人类分析流程来大规模分析评价性语言、与系统使用的态度以及用户之间的关系契合度。我们的研究结果表明，用户的参与程度主要由叙述性的结果、信任和响应质量所决定，而不仅仅是情感上的联系。积极的情感表达与任务和目标的一致性最为相关，而以陪伴为导向的使用方式则往往伴随着不一致的关系处理，并且会引发诸如依赖性和症状加重等风险。总体而言，这项工作展示了如何将基于理论的概念应用于大规模话语分析中，并强调了研究用户在敏感的现实情境下如何解读语言技术的重要性。

papers.title: VoiceStar: Robust Zero-Shot Autoregressive TTS with Duration Control and Extrapolation
papers.title_zh: VoiceStar：一种强大的零样本自回归文本生成算法，具备时长控制以及预测功能
papers.authors: Puyuan Peng, Zhisheng Zheng, Shang-Wen Li, Abdelrahman Mohamed, David Harwath
papers.abstract: We present VoiceStar, the first zero-shot TTS model that achieves both output duration control and extrapolation. VoiceStar is an autoregressive encoder-decoder neural codec language model, that leverages a novel Progress-Monitoring Rotary Position Embedding (PM-RoPE) and is trained with Continuation-Prompt Mixed (CPM) training. PM-RoPE enables the model to better align text and speech tokens, indicates the target duration for the generated speech, and also allows the model to generate speech waveforms much longer in duration than those seen during training. CPM training also helps to mitigate the training/inference mismatch, and significantly improves the quality of the generated speech in terms of speaker similarity and intelligibility. VoiceStar outperforms or is on par with current state-of-the-art models on short-form benchmarks such as LibriSpeech and Seed-TTS, and significantly outperforms these models on long-form/extrapolation benchmarks (20-50s) in terms of intelligibility and naturalness. Code and model: https://github.com/jasonppy/VoiceStar. Audio samples: https://jasonppy.github.io/VoiceStar_web.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了VoiceStar，这是首个能够实现输出时长控制与延伸功能的零样本文本转语音模型。VoiceStar采用自回归编码器-解码器神经编解码器语言模型架构，采用了创新的进度监控旋转位置嵌入技术，并通过持续提示混合训练方法进行训练。这种技术使得模型能够更好地对齐文本和语音标记，指定生成语音的目标时长，同时还能生成比训练过程中看到的更长时长的语音波形。持续提示混合训练还有助于减少训练与推理之间的不匹配问题，显著提升了生成语音在说话人相似性和可理解性方面的质量。在如LibriSpeech和Seed-TTS这样的短形式基准测试中，VoiceStar的表现优于或相当于当前最先进的模型；而在20-50秒的长形式/延伸性基准测试中，其可理解性和自然性表现更优。代码和模型可在此处获取：https://github.com/jasonppy/VoiceStar。音频样本可在此处查看：https://jasonppy.github.io/VoiceStar_web。

papers.title: Evaluating Implicit Biases in LLM Reasoning through Logic Grid Puzzles
papers.title_zh: 通过逻辑网格谜题来评估大型语言模型推理中的隐性偏见
papers.authors: Fatima Jahara, Mark Dredze, Sharon Levy
papers.abstract: While recent safety guardrails effectively suppress overtly biased outputs, subtler forms of social bias emerge during complex logical reasoning tasks that evade current evaluation benchmarks. To fill this gap, we introduce a new evaluation framework, PRIME (\textbf{P}uzzle \textbf{R}easoning for \textbf{I}mplicit Biases in \textbf{M}odel \textbf{E}valuation), that uses logic grid puzzles to systematically probe the influence of social stereotypes on logical reasoning and decision making in LLMs. Our use of logic puzzles enables automatic generation and verification, as well as variability in complexity and biased settings. PRIME includes stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, and neutral puzzle variants generated from a shared puzzle structure, allowing for controlled and fine-grained comparisons. We evaluate multiple model families across puzzle sizes and test the effectiveness of prompt-based mitigation strategies. Focusing our experiments on gender stereotypes, our findings highlight that models consistently reason more accurately when solutions align with stereotypical associations. This demonstrates the significance of PRIME for diagnosing and quantifying social biases perpetuated in the deductive reasoning of LLMs, where fairness is critical.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然最近的安全防护措施能够有效抑制明显的有偏输出，但在复杂的逻辑推理任务中，更微妙的社会偏见却难以被当前的评估标准所捕捉。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新的评估框架——PRIME（针对模型评估中明显偏见的逻辑推理），该框架利用逻辑网格谜题来系统地探究社会刻板印象对大语言模型中的逻辑推理和决策过程的影响。通过使用逻辑谜题，我们可以实现自动生成和验证，同时还能在复杂性和有偏环境下进行对比。PRIME包括从共享谜题结构中生成的刻板印象型、反刻板印象型以及中性型谜题变体，从而允许进行有控制且细致的比较。我们对多种模型家族进行了测试，考察了不同谜题规模下的效果，并验证了基于提示的缓解策略的有效性。我们的实验重点关注性别刻板印象，研究发现，当解决方案与刻板印象相符时，模型能够更准确地进行推理。这凸显了PRIME在诊断和量化大语言模型演绎推理过程中存在的社会偏见方面的重要性，因为在这种情况下，公平性至关重要。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: InferPilot: Autonomous Inference Attacks Against ML Services With LLM-Based Agents
papers.title_zh: InferPilot：基于大语言模型的自主推理攻击技术，用于针对机器学习服务的攻击
papers.authors: Yixin Wu, Rui Wen, Chi Cui, Michael Backes, Yang Zhang
papers.abstract: Inference attacks have been widely studied and offer a systematic risk assessment of ML services; however, their implementation and the attack parameters for optimal estimation are challenging for non-experts. The emergence of advanced large language models presents a promising yet largely unexplored opportunity to develop autonomous agents as inference attack experts, helping address this challenge. In this paper, we propose InferPilot, an autonomous agent capable of independently conducting inference attacks without human intervention. We evaluate it on 20 target services. The evaluation shows that our agent, using GPT-4o, achieves a 100.0% task completion rate and near-expert attack performance, with an average token cost of only 0.627 per run. The agent can also be powered by many other representative LLMs and can adaptively optimize its strategy under service constraints. We further perform trace analysis, demonstrating that design choices, such as a multi-agent framework and task-specific action spaces, effectively mitigate errors such as bad plans, inability to follow instructions, task context loss, and hallucinations. We anticipate that such agents could empower non-expert ML service providers, auditors, or regulators to systematically assess the risks of ML services without requiring deep domain expertise.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理攻击已经得到了广泛研究，能够为机器学习服务提供系统的风险评估。然而，对于非专家来说，实现这种攻击以及确定最佳攻击参数是非常具有挑战性的。先进的大语言模型的出现为开发能够自主进行推理攻击的智能体提供了巨大的机会，有助于解决这一难题。在本文中，我们提出了InferPilot这个自主智能体，它能够在没有人类干预的情况下独立执行推理攻击。我们在20个目标服务上对其进行了评估。评估结果显示，使用GPT-4o的我们的智能体实现了100.0%的任务完成率，其攻击性能接近专家水平，每次运行的平均代币成本仅为0.627。该智能体还可以利用许多其他代表性的大语言模型，并能够在服务约束条件下自适应地优化策略。我们还进行了跟踪分析，发现诸如多智能体框架和任务特定的动作空间等设计选择能够有效避免诸如糟糕的计划、无法遵循指令、任务上下文丢失以及幻觉等问题。我们预计，这样的智能体能够让非专家的机器学习服务提供商、审计人员或监管机构能够在不需要深厚领域专业知识的情况下，系统地评估机器学习服务的风险。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MedErrBench: A Fine-Grained Multilingual Benchmark for Medical Error Detection and Correction with Clinical Expert Annotations
papers.title_zh: MedErrBench：一种高度细化的多语言基准测试工具，用于检测医疗错误并基于临床专家注释进行纠错处理
papers.authors: Congbo Ma, Yichun Zhang, Yousef Al-Jazzazi, Ahamed Foisal, Laasya Sharma, Yousra Sadqi, Khaled Saleh, Jihad Mallat, Farah E. Shamout
papers.abstract: Inaccuracies in existing or generated clinical text may lead to serious adverse consequences, especially if it is a misdiagnosis or incorrect treatment suggestion. With Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly being used across diverse healthcare applications, comprehensive evaluation through dedicated benchmarks is crucial. However, such datasets remain scarce, especially across diverse languages and contexts. In this paper, we introduce MedErrBench, the first multilingual benchmark for error detection, localization, and correction, developed under the guidance of experienced clinicians. Based on an expanded taxonomy of ten common error types, MedErrBench covers English, Arabic and Chinese, with natural medical cases annotated and reviewed by domain experts. We assessed the performance of a range of general-purpose, language-specific, and medical-domain language models across all three tasks. Our results reveal notable performance gaps, particularly in non-English settings, highlighting the need for clinically grounded, language-aware systems. By making MedErrBench and our evaluation protocols publicly-available, we aim to advance multilingual clinical NLP to promote safer and more equitable AI-based healthcare globally. The dataset is publicly available at: https://github.com/congboma/MedErrBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有或生成的临床文本中的不准确之处可能会导致严重的不良后果，尤其是当出现误诊或错误的治疗建议时。随着大语言模型在各类医疗应用中的广泛应用，通过专门的评估基准来进行全面评估变得至关重要。然而，这类数据集仍然非常稀缺，尤其是在不同语言和情境下。在本文中，我们介绍了MedErrBench——首个用于错误检测、定位与纠正的多语言基准数据集。该数据集是在经验丰富的临床医生的指导下开发的，涵盖了英语、阿拉伯语和中文三种语言。基于十种常见错误的分类体系，MedErrBench包含了由领域专家标注和审核的自然医学案例。我们对多种通用语言模型、特定语言模型以及医学领域的语言模型在所有三个任务上的表现进行了评估。我们的结果显示，这些模型在非英语环境中存在明显的性能差距，这凸显了需要开发基于临床需求、具备语言感知能力的系统的必要性。通过将MedErrBench及我们的评估协议公开提供，我们希望能够推动多语言临床自然语言处理技术的发展，从而在全球范围内促进更安全、更公平的基于人工智能的医疗保健服务。该数据集可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/congboma/MedErrBench。

papers.title: MetaScale: Test-Time Scaling with Evolving Meta-Thoughts
papers.title_zh: MetaScale：基于不断演变的元思维实现的测试时间扩展技术
papers.authors: Qin Liu, Wenxuan Zhou, Nan Xu, James Y. Huang, Fei Wang, Sheng Zhang, Hoifung Poon, Muhao Chen
papers.abstract: One critical challenge for large language models (LLMs) in making complex reasoning is their reliance on matching reasoning patterns from training data, instead of proactively selecting the most appropriate cognitive strategy to solve a given task. Existing approaches impose fixed cognitive structures that enhance performance in specific tasks but lack adaptability across diverse scenarios. To address this limitation, we introduce MetaScale, a test-time scaling framework based on meta-thoughts, i.e., adaptive thinking strategies tailored to each task. MetaScale initializes a pool of candidate meta-thoughts, then iteratively selects and evaluates them using a multi-armed bandit algorithm with upper confidence bound selection, guided by a reward model. To further enhance adaptability, a genetic algorithm evolves high-reward meta-thoughts, refining and extending the strategy pool over time. By dynamically proposing and optimizing meta-thoughts at inference time, MetaScale improves both accuracy and generalization across a wide range of tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that MetaScale consistently outperforms standard inference approaches, achieving an 11% performance gain in win rate on Arena-Hard with GPT-4o, improving from 82.14% to 93.14% against GPT-4. Notably, MetaScale scales more effectively with increasing sampling budgets and produces more structured, expert-level responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在进行复杂推理时面临的一个关键挑战是，它们依赖于训练数据中已有的推理模式，而不是主动选择最合适的认知策略来解决特定任务。现有的方法会采用固定的认知结构来提高特定任务的性能，但缺乏在不同场景下的适应性。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了MetaScale——一种基于元思维、即针对每个任务量身定制的自适应思维策略的测试时扩展框架。MetaScale首先初始化一组候选元思维，然后通过多臂老虎机算法进行迭代选择和评估，该算法以奖励模型为指导，并具备上限置信度选择功能。为了进一步提升适应性，遗传算法会演化出高回报的元思维，从而不断完善和扩展策略库。通过在推理过程中动态提出和优化元思维，MetaScale能够在各种任务中提升准确性和泛化能力。实验结果表明，MetaScale始终优于传统的推理方法，在Arena-Hard任务上，使用GPT-4o时的胜率提升了11%，从82.14%提高到93.14%，相比GPT-4更是如此。值得注意的是，随着采样预算的增加，MetaScale的扩展性更好，并且能够生成更加结构化、专家级别的响应。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Arab Voices: Mapping Standard and Dialectal Arabic Speech Technology
papers.title_zh: 阿拉伯语音：标准阿拉伯语与方言阿拉伯语语音技术的映射研究
papers.authors: Peter Sullivan, AbdelRahim A. Elmadany, Alcides Alcoba Inciarte, Muhammad Abdul-Mageed
papers.abstract: Dialectal Arabic datasets embody a range of domain, dialect, and quality. To better understand the landscape of these datasets, we perform a computational analysis of the ‘dialectness’ and a set of measures of audio quality. This analysis of the training splits of dialectal Arabic datasets, provides a valuable complement to existing literature surveys of dialectal Arabic.To further address inconsistencies between datasets, we also introduce Arab Voices, a standardized framework for supporting Automatic Speech Recognition in dialectal Arabic. This framework provide access to 31 datasets covering 14 dialects, to better address the limited data availability encountered in dialectal Arabic speech processing. Our benchmark further provides a current evaluation of SOTA tools as well as modern multimodal LLMs at dialectal Arabic ASR.
papers.abstract_zh: 阿拉伯语方言数据集涵盖了多种领域、方言以及不同的质量水平。为了更全面地了解这些数据集的情况，我们对阿拉伯语方言的“方言特性”以及音频质量进行了计算分析。这项对阿拉伯语方言数据集的训练分割的分析，为现有的阿拉伯语方言相关文献研究提供了宝贵的补充。为了进一步解决不同数据集之间存在的差异问题，我们还提出了Arab Voices这一标准化框架，该框架旨在支持阿拉伯语方言的自动语音识别技术。这一框架提供了包含31个数据集的支持，这些数据集涵盖了14种方言，从而更好地应对阿拉伯语方言语音处理中面临的有限数据问题。我们的基准测试还提供了对当前最先进工具以及现代多模态大语言模型在阿拉伯语方言自动语音识别方面的评估。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CoDA: Restoring Contextual Dominance via Copy-Encouraged Attention Intervention for Mitigating RAG Hallucinations
papers.title_zh: CoDA：通过鼓励复制注意力干预来恢复上下文的支配地位，从而减轻RAG产生的幻觉现象
papers.authors: JinWei Shi, Qizhuo Xie, Qianzi Hou, Zhipeng Wang, Wanting Su, Jianhua Zhao, Tao Zheng, Tieke He
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation reduces hallucination by grounding model outputs in external evidence, yet hallucinations can still occur even when the retrieved context is accurate and sufficient. From the perspective of information routing in the residual stream, this reflects an imbalance where internal parametric knowledge overwhelms external context during generation. We present an attention-centric analysis of RAG hallucination under valid evidence, showing that hallucinated and factual tokens diverge in mid-to-late Transformer layers as context-selective attention routing weakens, allowing parametric influence to dominate the residual stream. Motivated by prior studies showing that some attention heads—often referred to as copying heads—exhibit stronger information transport capacity, we aim to extend similar evidence-carrying behavior to a broader set of attention heads. To this end, we introduce CoDA, a lightweight inference-time attention intervention that amplifies evidence-aligned value states, enabling more attention heads to transport reliable external evidence in a copy-encouraged manner. Experiments demonstrate that CoDA improves contextual faithfulness, reduces hallucination, and remains robust under long and noisy contexts with modest and stable inference overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于检索增强的生成技术通过将模型输出与外部证据相结合，有效减少了幻觉的产生。然而，即使所检索到的上下文是准确且充分的，幻觉仍有可能发生。从残差流中的信息路由角度来看，这反映了一种不平衡现象：在生成过程中，内部参数化知识占据了主导地位，而外部上下文则被忽视了。我们针对在有效证据条件下RAG产生的幻觉进行了分析，发现幻觉产生的token与真实token在Transformer网络的中后期出现了差异。这是因为选择性上下文注意力路由的减弱，使得参数化因素的影响超过了外部上下文的影响。鉴于先前的研究表明，某些注意力头具有更强的信息传输能力，我们希望将这种类似的信息传输行为扩展到更多的注意力头上。为此，我们提出了CoDA这一轻量级推理时间注意力干预机制，它能够增强与证据相关的价值状态，从而使更多的注意力头能够以鼓励复制的方式传输可靠的外部证据。实验结果表明，CoDA能够提高上下文的可靠性，减少幻觉的产生，并且在长且嘈杂的上下文中仍能保持稳定性能，同时其推理开销也保持在较低水平。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CausalDetox: Causal Head Selection and Intervention for Language Model Detoxification
papers.title_zh: CausalDetox：用于语言模型排毒的因果选择及干预机制
papers.authors: Yian Wang, Yuen Chen, Agam Goyal, Hari Sundaram
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate toxic content, posing significant risks for safe deployment. Current mitigation strategies often degrade generation quality or require costly human annotation. We propose CausalDetox, a framework that identifies and intervenes on the specific attention heads causally responsible for toxic generation. Using the Probability of Necessity and Sufficiency (PNS), we isolate a minimal set of heads that are necessary and sufficient for toxicity. We utilize these components via two complementary strategies: (1) Local Inference-Time Intervention, which constructs dynamic, input-specific steering vectors for context-aware detoxification, and (2) PNS-Guided Fine-Tuning, which permanently unlearns toxic representations. We also introduceParaTox, a novel benchmark of aligned toxic/non-toxic sentence pairs enabling controlled counterfactual evaluation. Experiments on ToxiGen, ImplicitHate, and ParaDetox show that CausalDetox achieves up to 5.34% greater toxicity reduction compared to baselines while preserving linguistic fluency, and offers a 7\times speedup in head selection.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型经常生成有害内容，这对安全部署构成了重大风险。目前的缓解策略往往会降低生成质量，或者需要昂贵的人工标注工作。我们提出了CausalDetox框架，该框架能够识别并干预那些导致有害生成的特定注意力机制。通过使用必要性和充分性概率（PNS）算法，我们找到了一组对产生有害内容至关重要的注意力机制。我们采用两种互补的策略来实现这一目标：(1) 局部推理时间干预，构建动态、针对具体输入的引导向量，以实现上下文感知的净化；(2) PNS引导的微调，使模型永久地遗忘有害表示。我们还引入了ParaTox，这是一个用于评估有害/无害句子对的新型基准测试，可以进行可控的反事实评估。在ToxicGen、ImplicitHate和ParaDetox数据集上的实验表明，与基线方法相比，CausalDetox在减少有害内容方面取得了高达5.34%的效果提升，同时保持了语言的流畅性，并且在选择关键注意力机制方面实现了7倍的效率提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Commonsense Knowledge with Negation: A Resource to Enhance Negation Understanding
papers.title_zh: 带有否定的常识知识：一种有助于提升对否定表达理解的资源
papers.authors: Zijie Wang, MohammadHossein Rezaei, Farzana Rashid, Eduardo Blanco
papers.abstract: Negation is a common and important semantic feature in natural language, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle when negation is involved in natural language understanding tasks. Commonsense knowledge, on the other hand, despite being a well-studied topic, lacks investigations involving negation. In this work, we show that commonsense knowledge with negation is challenging for models to understand. We present a novel approach to automatically augment existing commonsense knowledge corpora with negation, yielding two new corpora containing over 2M triples with if-then relations. In addition, pre-training LLMs on our corpora benefits negation understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 否定是自然语言中一个常见且重要的语义特征，然而大语言模型在理解包含否定的自然语言任务时存在困难。另一方面，尽管常识知识是一个已经被广泛研究的领域，但针对否定内容的常识知识研究却相对较少。在这项研究中，我们发现模型很难理解包含否定的常识知识。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，能够自动将现有的常识知识库中添加否定内容，从而生成了两个新的知识库，其中包含了超过200万条包含“如果-那么”关系的三元组。此外，通过在我们的知识库上进行大语言模型的预训练，还能提升模型对否定的理解能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: P-QuASAR: A Unified Probabilistic Framework for Holistic Patent Quality Assessment and Refinement
papers.title_zh: P-QuASAR：一种用于整体专利质量评估与改进的统一概率框架
papers.authors: Xinyuan Song, Ziyi Ni, Fred Yang, Bo Zhang, Yijin Wang, Jane Zhang
papers.abstract: Automated assessment of patent quality is increasingly important given the growth of patent filings and the adoption of AI-assisted drafting. Existing methods often rely on modular pipelines or generic detectors, resulting in fragmented decisions and limited integration across quality dimensions. We propose P-QuASAR (Patent Quality Assurance via Structured Assessment and Refinement), a unified probabilistic framework that represents patent specifications as Quality Graphs. Multiple interdependent quality dimensions—such as regulatory compliance, technical coherence, and figure–text consistency—are jointly modeled using uncertainty-aware Quality Assessment Functions with learned edge potentials. Cross-dimensional evidence propagation via loopy belief propagation enables calibrated defect detection, while Optimal Intervention Paths translate inferred quality states into prioritized and actionable refinement recommendations. Evaluated on 500 patents across eight IPC domains against seven state-of-the-art baselines, P-QuASAR achieves substantial improvements: 99.86% balanced accuracy on regulatory compliance, 88.91% on technical coherence, and 94.70% on figure consistency, outperforming the strongest baselines by 3.0%, 9.0%, and 7.1%, respectively. Ablation studies confirm that joint graph reasoning contributes 3.66 points to average performance. When applied for refinement, P-QuASAR reduces average defects in AI-generated patents from 9.04–12.15 to 3.21 per document, surpassing human-authored patents.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着专利申请量的增长以及人工智能辅助专利撰写技术的广泛应用，对专利质量的自动化评估变得越来越重要。现有的方法通常依赖于模块化流程或通用检测器，这会导致决策分散，且不同质量维度的整合能力有限。我们提出了P-QuASAR（通过结构化评估与优化实现专利质量保障），这是一个统一的概率框架，它将专利规范表示为质量图。多个相互依赖的质量维度——如法规合规性、技术连贯性以及图表与文本的一致性——通过具有学习到的边缘势的不确定度感知质量评估函数进行联合建模。通过循环信念传播实现跨维度的证据传递，从而能够准确检测缺陷；而最优干预路径则可以将推断出的质量状态转化为优先级高且可操作的优化建议。在八个IPC领域中的500项专利上进行了评估，与七种最先进的基准模型相比，P-QuASAR取得了显著的改进：在法规合规性方面达到了99.86%的均衡准确率，在技术连贯性方面达到了88.91%，在图表一致性方面达到了94.70%。这些成绩分别比最强的基准模型高出3.0%、9.0%和7.1%。消融研究证实，联合图推理对平均性能的贡献为3.66分。当应用于专利优化时，P-QuASAR将人工智能生成的专利的平均缺陷数量从每篇文档的9.04–12.15个减少到了3.21个，这一效果甚至超过了人工撰写的专利。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Heard to Lived Opinions: Simulating Opinion Dynamics with Grounded LLM Agents in Economic Environments
papers.title_zh: 从听到到实际感知的观点：在经济环境中利用基于大语言模型的智能体模拟观点动态变化
papers.authors: Ryuji Hashimoto, Masahiro Kaneko, Ryosuke Takata, Takehiro Takayanagi, Kiyoshi Izumi
papers.abstract: Opinion dynamics (OD) studies how individual opinions evolve and generate collective patterns such as consensus and polarization. While recent work explores OD using populations of LLM-based agents focusing on opinion exchange, it typically does not incorporate individuals’ lived experiences, such as economic outcomes of past decisions, which play a critical role in shaping opinions. We propose a novel OD simulation framework that grounds LLM-based agents in an economic environment, allowing them to act and receive environmental feedback. Our simulations exhibit coherent OD at both individual and population levels: individual opinions follow structured trajectories shaped by economic experiences, with adverse conditions inducing opinion rigidity, while at the population level, collective opinions co-move with economic conditions, with inequality amplifying polarization and price instability driving larger distributional shifts. These results highlight the importance of grounding LLM-based agents in environments to capture collective OD.
papers.abstract_zh: 意见动态研究的是个体意见的演变以及它们如何形成诸如共识和两极分化这样的集体模式。虽然最近的一些研究利用基于大语言模型的智能体来探索意见动态，但这些研究通常没有考虑个体经历的影响，比如过去决策所带来的经济后果，而这些因素在塑造意见方面起着至关重要的作用。我们提出了一种新颖的意见动态模拟框架，该框架将基于大语言模型的智能体置于经济环境中，使它们能够采取行动并接收环境反馈。我们的模拟结果显示，无论是个体层面还是群体层面，意见动态都是连贯的：个体的意见遵循由经济经历所塑造的结构化轨迹，而不利的经济条件会导致意见僵化；在群体层面，集体意见与经济状况同步变化，不平等现象会加剧两极分化，而价格不稳定则会导致更大的分配差异。这些结果凸显了将基于大语言模型的智能体置于具体环境中进行意见动态分析的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: HiSA: Hierarchical State Abstraction for Scalable GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: HiSA：分层状态抽象技术，用于构建可扩展的GUI代理系统
papers.authors: Weiming Li, Hye-young Paik, Yulei Sui
papers.abstract: Multimodal GUI agents generally operate on raw visual and textual observations, which creates a fundamental scalability challenge. While current state-of-the-art frameworks predominantly rely on inference-intensive test-time scaling or the accumulation of unbounded raw logs to maintain task coherence, we attribute the underlying bottleneck to insufficient state abstraction.To address this, we propose HiSA, a hierarchical state abstraction approach that actively restructures knowledge rather than passively retaining historical information by organizing raw histories into a three-level hierarchy of abstracted steps, refined contexts, and induced patterns.By synthesizing high-dimensional observations into compact semantic states, HiSA decouples reasoning efficacy from context length, enabling precise and scalable decision-making as interaction histories grow.When evaluating using Spider2-V, our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art, achieving a 40.58% success rate while reducing token consumption by 69.85% and monetary costs by 55.10% compared to the best-performing baseline.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态图形用户界面代理通常基于原始的视觉和文本信息进行操作，这带来了基本的可扩展性挑战。目前最先进的框架大多依赖于耗时的推理优化或无限量的原始日志积累来保持任务的连贯性，我们认为其根本瓶颈在于状态抽象能力不足。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了HiSA这一分层状态抽象方法。该方法通过将有用的历史信息组织成三级层次结构——抽象步骤、细化上下文以及归纳出的模式——来主动重构知识，而非被动地保留历史信息。通过将高维数据合成为紧凑的语义状态，HiSA实现了推理效率与上下文长度之间的分离，使得在交互历史不断增长的情况下仍能进行精确且可扩展的决策制定。在使用Spider2-V进行评估时，我们的方法取得了新的突破：成功率达到了40.58%，同时比最佳基准测试减少了69.85%的令牌消耗和55.10%的货币成本。

papers.title: SecureWebArena: A Holistic Security Evaluation Benchmark for LVLM-based Web Agents
papers.title_zh: SecureWebArena：一种针对基于LVLM技术的网络代理的整体安全评估基准测试
papers.authors: Zonghao Ying, Yangguang Shao, Jianle Gan, Gan Xu, Wenxin Zhang, Quanchen Zou, Junzheng Shi, Zhenfei Yin, Mingchuan Zhang, Aishan Liu, Xianglong Liu
papers.abstract: Large vision–language model (LVLM)-based web agents are emerging as powerful automation tools but face severe security risks in real-world deployment. Existing benchmarks offer limited coverage, typically isolating user-level prompts from environmental threats, thus failing to capture the full spectrum of vulnerabilities. To address this, we present SecureWebArena, the first holistic security benchmark for web agents. SecureWebArena features a unified suite of six realistic web environments with 2,970 adversarial trajectories, covering a structured taxonomy of six attack vectors that span both user-level and environment-level manipulations. Crucially, we introduce a multi-layered evaluation protocol that dissects agent failures across internal reasoning, behavioral execution, and task outcomes, enabling fine-grained risk analysis beyond simple success metrics. Experiments on 9 representative LVLMs reveal universal vulnerabilities to subtle manipulations and uncover significant trade-offs between model specialization and security. SecureWebArena establishes a rigorous foundation for advancing the development of trustworthy web agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大型视觉-语言模型的网络代理正逐渐成为强大的自动化工具，但在实际部署中面临着严重的安全风险。现有的评估基准往往覆盖范围有限，通常只关注用户层面的提示与环境威胁之间的关系，因此无法全面揭示各种漏洞。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了SecureWebArena——首个针对网络代理的整体安全评估基准。SecureWebArena包含六个真实的网络环境，共包含2,970种攻击路径，涵盖了六种攻击手段，这些攻击手段既涉及用户层面的操作，也涉及环境层面的操控。重要的是，我们采用了一种多层评估方案，能够深入分析代理在内部推理、行为执行以及任务结果方面的表现，从而进行更细致的风险分析，而不仅仅是简单的成功指标。通过对9种代表性LVLM模型的实验分析，我们发现了对各种微妙操纵的普遍脆弱性，并揭示了模型专业化与安全之间的权衡关系。SecureWebArena为开发可信赖的网络代理提供了坚实的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Mechanics of Interference: Defusing Distractors in RAG via Sparse Autoencoder Interventions
papers.title_zh: 干涉现象的机制：通过稀疏自动编码器的干预来消除RAG中的干扰因素
papers.authors: Christian Giannetti, Giovanni Trappolini, Nicola Tonellotto, Fabrizio Silvestri, Pietro Lio
papers.abstract: Large language models exhibit a critical vulnerability to distractor interference in retrieval-augmented contexts: they fail to prioritize relevant, factually correct documents over topically similar but misleading content. We introduce Lat-Defuse, a mechanistic framework that corrects this failure mode through targeted interventions in the model’s latent space. Using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), our method operates in an interpretable feature space and formulates correction as constrained counterfactual optimization. On Gemma-2 and Llama-3 model families across three QA benchmarks (BioASQ, Natural Questions, PopQA), our method achieves recovery rates of up to 94% on distractor-vulnerable samples. Successful correction through sparse modifications reveals distractor interference as a localized, systematically addressable phenomenon, opening directions toward universal distractor robustness in LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在检索增强的语境中面临着严重的干扰问题：它们无法优先处理那些与主题相似但具有误导性的内容，而忽略了真正相关的、事实正确的文档。我们提出了Lat-Defuse这一机制性框架，通过针对模型潜在空间的干预来纠正这种缺陷。该方法利用稀疏自编码器，在可解释的特征空间中进行操作，并将修正过程转化为受限反事实优化问题。在Gemma-2和Llama-3模型家族上，通过三个问答基准测试（BioASQ、Natural Questions、PopQA），我们的方法在干扰易感的样本上实现了高达94%的恢复率。通过稀疏修改实现成功的修正，表明干扰现象是一种局部化的、可以系统解决的問題，这为在LLM中实现普遍的干扰抵抗能力提供了方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Grounding Agent Memory in Contextual Intent
papers.title_zh: 基于上下文意图构建智能体记忆
papers.authors: Ruozhen Yang, Yucheng Jiang, Yueqi Jiang, Priyanka Kargupta, Yunyi Zhang, Jiawei Han
papers.abstract: Deploying large language models in long-horizon, goal-oriented interactions remains challenging because similar entities and facts recur under different latent goals and con-straints, causing memory systems to retrieve context-mismatched evidence. We propose STITCH (Structured Intent Tracking in Contextual History), an agentic memory system that indexes each trajectory step with a structured retrieval cue, contextual intent, and retrieves history by matching the current step’s intent. Contextual intent provides compact signals that disambiguate repeated mentions and reduce interference: (1) the current latent goal defining a thematic segment, (2) the action type, and (3) the salient entity types anchoring which attributes matter. During inference, STITCH filters and prioritizes memory snippets by intent compatibility, suppressing semantically similar but context-incompatible history.For evaluation, we introduce CAME-Bench, a benchmark for context-aware retrieval in realistic, dynamic, goal-oriented trajectories. Across CAME-Bench and LongMemEval, STITCH achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the strongest baseline by 35.6%, with the largest gains as trajectory length increases. Our analysis shows that intent indexing substantially reduces retrieval noise, supporting intent-aware memory for robust long-horizon reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 在长时范围内进行目标导向的互动中部署大语言模型仍然具有挑战性，因为类似的实体和事实会在不同的潜在目标和约束条件下反复出现，导致记忆系统检索到与上下文不匹配的信息。我们提出了STITCH（结构化意图跟踪在上下文历史中）这一智能体记忆系统，该系统为每个轨迹步骤提供结构化的检索线索、上下文意图，并通过匹配当前步骤的意图来检索历史信息。上下文意图提供了简洁的信号，可以消除重复出现的提及内容，减少干扰：（1）定义主题段落的当前潜在目标；（2）行动类型；（3）决定属性重要性的关键实体类型。在推理过程中，STITCH通过意图兼容性来过滤和优先处理记忆片段，从而排除语义上相似但上下文不兼容的历史信息。为了评估该系统的性能，我们引入了CAME-Bench这一基准测试，用于评估在真实、动态且目标导向的轨迹中的上下文感知检索能力。在CAME-Bench和LongMemEval测试中，STITCH取得了最先进的性能表现，其性能比最强的基线模型高出35.6%，并且随着轨迹长度的增加，其性能提升更为显著。我们的分析表明，意图索引大大减少了检索噪声，为长期目标的推理提供了基于意图的记忆支持。

papers.title: Persona-Assigned Large Language Models Exhibit Human-Like Motivated Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 由特定人物所操控的大型语言模型展现出类似人类的动机推理能力
papers.authors: Saloni Dash, Amélie Reymond, Emma Spiro, Aylin Caliskan
papers.abstract: Reasoning in humans is prone to biases due to underlying motivations like identity protection, that undermine rational decision-making and judgment. This motivated reasoning at a collective level can be detrimental to society when debating critical issues such as human-driven climate change or vaccine safety, and can further aggravate political polarization. Prior studies have reported that large language models (LLMs) are also susceptible to human-like cognitive biases, however, the extent to which LLMs selectively reason toward identity-congruent conclusions remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate whether assigning 8 personas across 4 political and socio-demographic attributes induces motivated reasoning in LLMs. Testing 8 LLMs (open source and proprietary) across two reasoning tasks from human-subject studies — veracity discernment of misinformation headlines and evaluation of numeric scientific evidence — we find that persona-assigned LLMs have up to 9% reduced veracity discernment relative to models without personas. Political personas specifically are up to 90% more likely to correctly evaluate scientific evidence on gun control when the ground truth is congruent with their induced political identity. Prompt-based debiasing methods are largely ineffective at mitigating these effects. Taken together, our empirical findings are the first to suggest that persona-assigned LLMs exhibit human-like motivated reasoning that is hard to mitigate through conventional debiasing prompts — raising concerns of exacerbating identity-congruent reasoning in both LLMs and humans.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类的推理容易受到诸如身份保护等潜在动机的影响，这些动机会破坏理性的决策和判断。这种集体层面的动机性推理在讨论诸如人类引发的气候变化或疫苗安全等关键问题时，可能对社会造成危害，并进一步加剧政治两极分化。先前的研究表明，大语言模型也容易出现类似人类的认知偏差，然而，这些模型在多大程度上会选择性地得出与自身身份相符的结论，目前仍缺乏深入的研究。在这里，我们探讨了将8个人物分配到4个政治和社会人口属性中，是否会引发语言模型的动机性推理。通过对8个语言模型（包括开源和专有模型）进行两项推理任务测试——辨别虚假信息的标题以及评估数字科学证据——我们发现，被分配到特定人物形象的模型在辨别虚假信息标题的准确性方面，比没有使用人物形象的模型降低了9%。特别是当真实情况与其所代表的政治身份一致时，政治人物形象模型正确评估枪支控制相关科学证据的概率高出90%。基于提示的消除偏见方法在缓解这些效应方面效果甚微。总的来说，我们的实证研究结果首次表明，被分配到特定人物形象的语言模型表现出类似人类的动机性推理，而传统的消除偏见方法难以有效应对这种情况。这引发了人们对语言模型和人类在遵循身份一致性推理方面的担忧。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Generalizable LLM Learning of Graph Synthetic Data with Post-training Alignment
papers.title_zh: 可泛化的图合成数据训练方法：结合训练后的一致性处理
papers.authors: Yizhuo Zhang, Heng Wang, Shangbin Feng, Zhaoxuan Tan, Xinyun Liu, Yulia Tsvetkov
papers.abstract: Previous research has sought to enhance the graph reasoning capabilities of LLMs by supervised fine-tuning on synthetic graph data. While these led to specialized LLMs better at solving graph algorithm problems, we don’t need LLMs for shortest path: we need generalization from synthetic graph data to real-world tasks with implicit graph structures. In this work, we propose to unlock generalizable learning of graph with post-training alignment with synthetic data. We first design solution-based and process-based rewards for synthetic graph problems: instead of rigid memorizing response patterns in direct fine-tuning, we posit that post-training alignment would help LLMs grasp the essentials underlying graph reasoning and alleviate overfitting on synthetic data. We employ post-training alignment algorithms such as GRPO and DPO, aligning both off-the-shelf LLMs and LLMs fine-tuned on synthetic graph data. We then compare them against existing settings on both in-domain synthetic tasks and out-of-domain real-world tasks with implicit graph structures such as multi-hop QA, structured planning, and more. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our post-training alignment recipe leads to statistically significant improvement on 5 datasets, with an average gain of 12.9% over baseline settings. Further analysis reveals that process-based rewards consistently outperform solution-based rewards on synthetic data but not on real-world tasks, and compositionality and explainable intermediate steps remains a critical challenge even after post-training alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前的研究试图通过基于合成图数据的监督式微调来提升大语言模型在图推理方面的能力。虽然这些研究使得某些大语言模型在解决图算法问题时表现得更加出色，但对于最短路径问题来说，我们不需要依赖大语言模型；我们需要的是从合成图数据中学习到适用于现实世界中具有隐式图结构的任务的能力。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种与合成数据进行后训练对齐的方法，以实现可泛化的图学习。我们首先为合成图问题设计了基于解决方案和基于过程的奖励机制：与直接微调时僵化地记忆响应模式不同，我们认为后训练对齐能够帮助大语言模型掌握图推理的基本要素，从而减轻对合成数据的过度拟合。我们采用了诸如GRPO和DPO这样的后训练对齐算法，对现成的大语言模型和基于合成图数据训练出的大语言模型进行对齐处理。随后，我们将它们与现有的设置进行了比较，包括在域内合成任务以及具有隐式图结构的外部现实世界任务中的表现，例如多跳问答、结构化规划等。广泛的实验表明，我们的后训练对齐方法在5个数据集上带来了显著的改进，平均提升了12.9%的性能。进一步分析发现，基于过程的奖励机制在合成数据上的表现始终优于基于解决方案的奖励机制，但在现实世界任务中则并非如此。即使在经过后训练对齐之后，复合性和可解释性的中间步骤仍然是一个重要的挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Distilling the Essence: Efficient Reasoning Distillation via Sequence Truncation
papers.title_zh: 提取精髓：通过序列截断实现高效的推理蒸馏
papers.authors: Wei-Rui Chen, Vignesh Kothapalli, Ata Fatahibaarzi, Hejian Sang, Shao Tang, Qingquan Song, Zhipeng Wang, Muhammad Abdul-Mageed
papers.abstract: Distilling the capabilities from a large reasoning model (LRM) to a smaller student model often involves training on substantial amounts of reasoning data. However, knowledge distillation (KD) over lengthy sequences with prompt (P), chain-of-thought (CoT), and answer (A) sections makes the process computationally expensive. In this work, we investigate how the allocation of supervision across different sections (P, CoT, A) affects student performance. Our analysis shows that selective KD over only the CoT tokens can be effective when the prompt and answer information is encompassed by it. Building on this insight, we establish a truncation protocol to quantify computation-quality tradeoffs as a function of sequence length. We observe that beyond a specific length, longer training sequences provide marginal returns for downstream performance but require substantially higher memory and FLOPs. To this end, training on only the first 50% of tokens of every training sequence can retain, on average, ≈91% of full-sequence performance on math benchmarks while reducing training time, memory usage, and FLOPs by about 50% each. Codes are available at https://github.com/weiruichen01/distilling-the-essence.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大型推理模型的能力提炼到较小的学生模型中，通常需要对大量的推理数据进行训练。然而，针对包含提示、思维链和答案部分的长序列进行知识蒸馏时，计算过程会非常昂贵。在这项研究中，我们探讨了在不同部分（提示、思维链、答案）上分配监督信息对学生性能的影响。我们的分析表明，当提示和答案信息都包含在思维链部分时，仅对思维链部分进行选择性知识蒸馏是有效的。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种截断协议，以量化序列长度对计算效率的影响。我们发现，超过一定长度后，较长的训练序列虽然能提升下游性能，但所需的记忆资源和浮点运算量却大幅增加。因此，仅使用每个训练序列前50%的令牌进行训练，平均可以保留约91%的完整序列性能，同时将训练时间、内存使用和浮点运算量分别减少约50%。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/weiruichen01/distilling-the-essence
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Cross-Modal Alignment: Measuring and Leveraging Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越跨模态一致性：衡量并利用视觉-语言模型中的模态差异
papers.authors: Hanqi Yan, Xiangxiang Cui, Lu Yin, Jindong Gu, Paul Pu Liang, Yulan He, Yifei Wang
papers.abstract: The success of vision-language models is primarily attributed to effective cross-modal alignment between vision and language. However, modality gaps persist even in well-aligned models and may be necessary for human perception, as evidenced by modality-specific phenomena such as visual texture and linguistic tone. These observations motivate us to computationally measure and leverage modality gaps to explore their utility in downstream applications. In this paper, we introduce the Modality Dominance Score (MDS), which attributes multimodal features to specific modalities by categorizing them as vision-dominant, language-dominant, or cross-modal. We then propose automatic interpretability metrics to evaluate these modality-specific features in a scalable manner. Finally, we demonstrate how the identified modality-specific features enable training-free probing and editing methods for understanding model perception across genders, generating adversarial examples, and controlling text-to-image generation. Combined with task-agnostic interpretability tools, our work provides a systematic framework for analyzing and efficiently controlling multimodal models.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型的成功主要归功于视觉与语言之间的有效跨模态对齐。然而，即使在高度对齐的模型中，模态间的差异仍然存在，而这些差异可能对人类感知至关重要，这一点从诸如视觉纹理和语言语调等特定模态现象中可以看出来。这些观察结果促使我们通过计算方法来量化模态间的差异，并利用它们来探索其在后续应用中的效用。在本文中，我们提出了“模态优势得分”这一指标，该指标通过将多模态特征分类为以视觉为主、以语言为主或跨模态，从而将多模态特征归属于特定的模态。接着，我们提出了自动可解释性度量方法，以便以可扩展的方式评估这些特定模态的特征。最后，我们展示了所识别出的特定模态特征如何使得无需训练即可进行探测和编辑操作，从而理解模型在不同性别下的感知方式、生成对抗样本以及控制文本到图像的生成过程。结合任务无关的可解释性工具，我们的工作为分析和高效控制多模态模型提供了一个系统性的框架。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Data Swarms: Optimizable Generation of Synthetic Evaluation Data
papers.title_zh: 数据群集：可优化的合成评估数据生成方法
papers.authors: Shangbin Feng, Yike Wang, Weijia Shi, Yulia Tsvetkov
papers.abstract: We propose Data Swarms, an algorithm to optimize the generation of synthetic evaluation data and advance quantitative desiderata of LLM evaluation. We first train a swarm of initial data generators using existing data, and define various evaluation objectives to reflect the desired properties of evaluation (e.g., generate more difficult problems for the evaluated models) and quantitatively evaluate data generators. We then employ particle swarm optimization to optimize the swarm of data generators, where they collaboratively search through the model parameter space to find new generators that advance these objectives. We further extend it to Adversarial Swarms, where the data generator swarm generates harder data while the test taker model swarm learns from such data, co-evolving dynamically for better data and models simultaneously. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Data Swarms outperforms eight data generation baselines across five evaluation objectives, while Adversarial Swarms produce more robust learning of synthetic data and stronger generalization. Further analysis reveals that Data Swarms successfully optimizes compositions of multiple evaluation objectives and generalizes to new off-the-shelf LLMs, unseen at optimization time.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了数据群算法，该算法旨在优化合成评估数据的生成，并推动大语言模型评估的量化研究。我们首先使用现有数据训练一组初始数据生成器，然后定义多种评估目标，以反映评估所需的特性（例如，为被评估的模型生成更困难的问题），并对数据生成器进行量化评估。接着，我们使用粒子群优化算法来优化这组数据生成器，它们协同搜索模型参数空间，寻找能够达成这些目标的新生成器。我们还将其扩展到对抗性数据群中，即数据生成器群生成更难的数据，而测试模型群则从这些数据中学习，从而实现动态协同进化，从而同时获得更好的数据和模型。大量实验表明，数据群在五个评估目标上的表现优于八种数据生成基线方法；而对抗性数据群则能生成更稳健的合成数据，并具有更强的泛化能力。进一步分析显示，数据群能够成功优化多个评估目标的组合，并且可以推广到当时尚未优化的新的现成大语言模型上。

papers.title: Concept rather than Document: Context Compression via AMR-based Conceptual Entropy
papers.title_zh: 概念而非文档：通过基于AMR的概念熵实现上下文压缩
papers.authors: Kaize Shi, Xueyao Sun, Xiaohui Tao, Lin Li, Qika Lin, Guandong Xu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) face information overload when handling long contexts, particularly in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) where extensive supporting documents introduce redundant content that interferes with reasoning. Context engineering has emerged to address these challenges, yet existing methods rely on lexical or token-level features that fragment semantic units and fail to capture conceptually essential content. We propose an unsupervised context compression framework leveraging Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) to preserve semantically essential information while filtering irrelevant text. By quantifying node-level entropy within AMR graphs, our method estimates the conceptual importance of each node, enabling retention of core semantics. Specifically, we construct AMR graphs from retrieved contexts, compute the conceptual entropy of each node, and identify statistically significant concepts to form a condensed, semantically focused context. Experiments on the PopQA and EntityQuestions datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms vanilla RAG and existing baselines, achieving superior accuracy while substantially reducing context length. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work introducing AMR-based conceptual entropy for context compression, demonstrating the potential of structured linguistic representations in context engineering.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在处理长文本时面临信息过载的问题，尤其是在检索增强生成中，大量的辅助文档会引入冗余内容，干扰推理过程。为了解决这些问题，出现了上下文工程技术，但现有的方法依赖于词汇或令牌级别的特征，这会导致语义单元的碎片化，无法捕捉到概念上的核心内容。我们提出了一种无监督的上下文压缩框架，利用抽象意义表示技术来保留语义上的重要信息，同时过滤掉无关文本。通过量化抽象意义表示图中的节点级熵，我们的方法能够评估每个节点的概念重要性，从而保留核心语义。具体来说，我们从检索到的上下文中构建抽象意义表示图，计算每个节点的概念熵，并识别出具有统计意义的概念，从而形成简洁、语义聚焦的上下文。在PopQA和EntityQuestions数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法优于传统的检索增强生成技术和现有的基线方法，不仅提高了准确性，还显著减少了上下文长度。据我们所知，这是第一项采用基于抽象意义表示的概念熵进行上下文压缩的研究，展示了结构化语言表示在上下文工程中的潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can LLMs Understand the Impact of Trauma? Costs and Benefits of LLMs Coding the Interviews of Firearm Violence Survivors
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能够理解创伤的影响吗？开发大型语言模型的成本与收益——针对枪支暴力幸存者进行访谈的过程
papers.authors: Jessica H Zhu, Shayla Stringfield, Vahe Zaprosyan, Michael Wagner, Michel Cukier, Joseph Richardson
papers.abstract: Firearm violence is a pressing public health issue, yet research into survivors’ lived experiences remains underfunded and difficult to scale. Qualitative research, including in-depth interviews, is a valuable tool for understanding the personal and societal consequences of community firearm violence and designing effective interventions. However, manually analyzing these narratives through thematic analysis and inductive coding is time-consuming and labor-intensive. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have opened the door to automating this process, though concerns remain about whether these models can accurately and ethically capture the experiences of vulnerable populations. In this study, we assess the use of open-source LLMs to inductively code interviews with 21 Black men who have survived community firearm violence. Our results demonstrate that while some configurations of LLMs can identify important codes, overall relevance remains low and is highly sensitive to data processing. Furthermore, LLM guardrails lead to substantial narrative erasure. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of LLM-assisted qualitative coding and underscore the ethical challenges of applying AI in research involving marginalized communities.
papers.abstract_zh: 枪支暴力是一个紧迫的公共卫生问题，然而对幸存者经历的研究仍然缺乏资金支持，且难以大规模开展。定性研究，包括深度访谈，是了解社区枪支暴力对个人和社会影响的宝贵工具，也有助于设计有效的干预措施。然而，通过主题分析和归纳编码来手动分析这些叙述既耗时又费力。最近大语言模型的发展为自动化这一过程打开了大门，不过人们仍然担心这些模型是否能够准确且合乎伦理地捕捉到弱势群体的经历。在这项研究中，我们评估了使用开源语言模型对21名经历过社区枪支暴力的黑人男性的访谈数据进行归纳编码的效果。我们的结果表明，虽然某些语言模型配置能够识别出重要的编码内容，但整体相关性仍然较低，并且对数据处理非常敏感。此外，语言模型的限制导致了很多叙述信息被抹去。这些发现揭示了语言模型辅助定性编码的潜在优势和局限性，同时也凸显了在涉及边缘化社区的研究中应用人工智能所面临的伦理挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: "I Don’t Know What to Say": A Fact-Filling Questionnaire Method to Help Non-Experts Talk to LegalAI Assistant
papers.title_zh: “我不知道该说些什么”：一种填充事实的问卷方法，帮助非专家用户与LegalAI助手进行交流
papers.authors: Yuting Huang, Yiquan Wu, Meitong Guo, Ang Li, Xiaozhong Liu, Keting Yin, Fei Wu, Kun Kuang
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has become increasingly prevalent in the legal domain. However, LegalAI systems often struggle with vague user queries that lack essential legal details, leading to suboptimal performance in practical applications. To address this challenge, we propose FactFiller, a novel approach that dynamically generates questionnaires to help users refine their input queries. Our method leverages an iterative training process that collects valuable questionnaires, eliminating the need for human annotation. Additionally, we introduce a "case-law-quiz” cascading retrieval process, ensuring that the generated questions and answer options are directly linked to specific legal provisions. Through the user study and the downstream task experiments, we demonstrate that FactFiller, while remaining easy for non-experts to understand, not only improves the completeness of queries but also ensures the performance of various domain-specific models in downstream legal tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能在法律领域已经变得越来越普遍。然而，LegalAI系统常常难以处理那些缺乏关键法律细节的模糊用户查询，这导致其在实际应用中的性能不佳。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了FactFiller这一创新方法。该方法能够动态生成问卷，帮助用户完善他们的输入查询。我们的方法采用迭代训练过程，收集有价值的问卷数据，从而无需人工注释即可完成任务。此外，我们还引入了“案例法-测验”级联检索机制，确保生成的问题和答案选项与具体的法律条款直接关联。通过用户研究和下游任务实验，我们发现FactFiller虽然对非专业人士来说仍然易于理解，但它不仅提升了查询的完整性，还确保了各种特定领域的模型在后续法律任务中的性能表现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: BnMMLU: Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding in Bengali
papers.title_zh: BnMMLU：用孟加拉语进行大规模多任务语言理解评估
papers.authors: Saman Sarker Joy, Swakkhar Shatabda
papers.abstract: Large-scale multitask benchmarks have driven rapid progress in language modeling, yet most emphasize high-resource languages such as English, leaving Bengali underrepresented. We present BnMMLU, a comprehensive benchmark for measuring massive multitask language understanding in Bengali. BnMMLU spans 41 domains across STEM, humanities, social sciences, and general knowledge, and contains 134,375 multiple-choice question–option pairs-the most extensive Bengali evaluation suite to date. The dataset preserves mathematical content via MathML, and includes BnMMLU-HARD, a compact subset constructed from questions most frequently missed by top systems to stress difficult cases. We benchmark 24 model variants across 11 LLM families, spanning open-weights general/multilingual, Bengali-centric open-weights, and proprietary models, covering multiple parameter scales and instruction-tuned settings. We evaluate models under standardized protocols covering two prompting styles (Direct vs. Chain-of-Thought) and two context regimes (0-shot vs. 5-shot), reporting accuracy consistently across families. Our analysis highlights persistent gaps in reasoning and application skills and indicates sublinear returns to scale across model sizes. We release the dataset and evaluation templates to support rigorous, reproducible assessment of Bengali language understanding and to catalyze progress in multilingual NLP.
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模的多任务基准测试在语言建模领域取得了显著进展，但大多数测试都集中在资源丰富的语言上，如英语，而孟加拉语则被忽视。我们提出了BnMMLU，这是一个全面的基准测试，用于评估孟加拉语在多任务理解方面的能力。该数据集涵盖了STEM、人文科学、社会科学以及一般知识领域的41个主题，包含134,375对选择题和选项组合——这是迄今为止最全面的孟加拉语评估工具。数据集中通过MathML保留了数学内容，并且还包括了BnMMLU-HARD，这是一个由顶级系统最常出错的题目构成的精简子集，用于模拟困难情况。我们对11种大语言模型进行了测试，包括开放权重的一般/多语言模型、以孟加拉语为中心的开放权重模型，以及专有模型，涵盖了多种参数规模和指令调整设置。我们在标准化协议下对模型进行了评估，涵盖了两种提示方式（直接提示与思维链提示）和两种上下文环境（零样本与五样本），结果显示不同模型的准确率具有一致性。我们的分析指出，在推理和应用技能方面仍存在明显不足，同时模型规模的增加带来的性能提升也呈亚线性趋势。我们发布了该数据集和评估模板，以支持对孟加拉语理解能力的严格且可重复性的评估，从而推动多语言自然语言处理领域的进步。

papers.title: Diagnosing LLMs via Information Spectrum Analysis: Tail Behavior and the Effects of Side Information
papers.title_zh: 通过信息谱分析来诊断大型语言模型：尾部行为以及辅助信息的影響
papers.authors: Yuuki Tachioka
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit non-stationary generation: their output distributions shift with prompts, retrieved documents, and decoding conditions. Under such variability, average likelihood metrics can obscure heterogeneous behaviors across samples, especially in high-surprisal tails where failures often occur. We propose an information-spectrum-based diagnostic framework that treats LLMs as general sources without assuming stationarity, ergodicity, or the asymptotic equipartition property. We define sequence-level self-information density (coding rate; mean surprisal) and construct an empirical information spectrum from finite samples, enabling operational estimates of spectrum quantiles and width. We further introduce an information gain spectrum, a teacher-forced likelihood-based measure that evaluates the same generated sequence with and without side information. Across multiple Japanese LLMs and QA settings, we observe that correctness differences are often more visible in the high-surprisal tail than in the mean coding rate, and that side information can reshape tail behavior in heterogeneous ways across sequences. We also observe that instruction tuning changes the spectrum structure, making tail statistics and spectrum width more predictive of correctness than the mean coding rate. Overall, our analysis illustrates how spectrum-based diagnostics complement average-based metrics for understanding conditional generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）表现出非平稳生成特性：其输出分布会随着提示、检索到的文档以及解码条件的不同而变化。在这种可变性下，平均似然度量可能会掩盖不同样本之间的异质性行为，尤其是在高惊喜尾部，这种尾部往往容易发生错误。我们提出了一种基于信息谱的诊断框架，该框架将LLM视为一般性的生成源，而不假设其具有平稳性、遍历性或渐近均匀分配特性。我们定义了序列级自信息密度（编码率；平均惊喜度），并从有限样本中构建经验信息谱，从而能够估算出谱量的分位数和宽度。我们还引入了信息增益谱这一基于似然度的评估指标，该指标可以评估在有无辅助信息的情况下生成的相同序列。通过对多个日语LLM和问答场景的分析，我们发现，在高惊喜尾部，正确性的差异通常比平均编码率更为明显，而且辅助信息可以以不同的方式重塑不同序列的尾部行为。此外，我们还观察到指令调整会改变谱结构，使得尾部统计数据和谱宽度比平均编码率更能预测正确性。总体而言，我们的分析表明，基于谱的诊视方法可以补充基于平均值的度量方法，从而更好地理解条件生成现象。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Scaling Collaborative Effort with Agents
papers.title_zh: 利用智能体来协调协作努力
papers.authors: Shannon Zejiang Shen, Valerie Chen, Ken Gu, Alexis Ross, Zixian Ma, Jillian Ross, Alex Gu, Chenglei Si, Wayne Chi, Andi Peng, Jocelyn J Shen, Ameet Talwalkar, Tongshuang Wu, David Sontag
papers.abstract: Current evaluations of agents remain centered around one-shot task completion, failing to account for the inherently iterative and collaborative nature of many real-world problems, where human goals are often underspecified and evolve. We argue for a shift from building and assessing task completion agents to developing collaborative agents, assessed not only by the quality of their final outputs but by how well they engage with and enhance human effort throughout the problem-solving process. To support this shift, we introduce collaborative effort scaling, a framework that captures how an agent’s utility grows with increasing user involvement. Through case studies and simulated evaluations, we show that state-of-the-art agents often underperform in multi-turn, real-world scenarios, revealing a missing ingredient in agent design: the ability to sustain engagement and scaffold user understanding. Collaborative effort scaling offers a lens for diagnosing agent behavior and guiding development toward more effective interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前对智能体的评估主要集中在一次性的任务完成上，这未能考虑到许多现实问题所具有的迭代性和协作性特征。在现实世界中，人类的目标往往不够明确，并且会不断演变。我们认为，应该从构建和评估一次性完成任务智能体转向开发具有协作能力的智能体，这种智能体的评估不仅要看它们最终的输出质量，还要看它们在整个问题解决过程中如何与人类的努力进行互动并提升其效果。为了支持这一转变，我们提出了“协作努力扩展”框架，该框架能够揭示智能体的效用如何随着用户参与度的增加而增长。通过案例研究和模拟评估，我们发现，最先进的智能体在多轮次的现实场景中往往表现不佳，这表明在智能体设计中存在一个缺失要素：即维持参与度并促进用户理解的能力。协作努力扩展为诊断智能体行为以及指导其发展更有效的交互方式提供了有用的工具。

papers.title: CriticSearch: Fine-Grained Credit Assignment for Search Agents via a Retrospective Critic
papers.title_zh: CriticSearch：通过回顾性批评机制为搜索智能体实现细粒度的信用分配
papers.authors: Yaocheng Zhang, Haohuan Huang, Zijun Song, Zijie Zhao, Qichao Zhang, Yuanheng Zhu, Dongbin Zhao
papers.abstract: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) with search engines enables large language models to iteratively retrieve up-to-date external knowledge, enhancing adaptability and generalization in complex question-answering tasks. However, existing search agent pipelines typically depend on reinforcement learning based optimization, which often suffers from sparse outcome rewards, leading to inefficient exploration and unstable training. We introduce CriticSearch, a fine-grained credit-assignment framework that supplies dense, turn-level feedback via a retrospective critic mechanism. During training, a frozen, asymmetric critique LLM retrospectively evaluates each turn using privileged information from the full trajectory and gold answers, converting these assessments into stable, dense rewards that guide policy improvement. Experimental results across diverse multi-hop reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that CriticSearch consistently outperforms existing baselines, achieving faster convergence, improved training stability, and higher performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具集成推理（TIR）与搜索引擎的结合，使得大语言模型能够迭代地获取最新的外部知识，从而在复杂的问答任务中提升适应性和泛化能力。然而，现有的搜索智能体流程通常依赖于基于强化学习的优化方法，这种方法往往面临奖励稀疏的问题，导致探索效率低下以及训练稳定性不佳。我们提出了CriticSearch这一细粒度信用分配框架，它通过回顾性评判机制提供密集的、针对每个轮次的反馈。在训练过程中，一个冻结的、非对称的评判大语言模型会利用来自整个轨迹的特权信息和正确答案，对每一轮进行评估，并将这些评估结果转化为稳定且密集的奖励，从而指导策略的改进。在多种多跳推理基准测试中的实验结果表明，CriticSearch始终优于现有的基线方法，其收敛速度更快，训练稳定性更高，性能也更为优越。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Double-Edged Sword or Sharp Tool? Designing and Evaluating Triadic LLM-Teacher Collaboration for K-12 Writing at Scale
papers.title_zh: 双刃剑还是利器？设计和评估适用于K-12阶段的大规模LLM与教师协作模式
papers.authors: Canran Wang, Yuwen Yang, Zhen Wang, Ming MA, Ding Yu, Chentai Wang, Keman Huang, Xiaoyong Du
papers.abstract: The double-edged sword of integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) requires an effective triadic collaboration mechanism among LLMs, teachers and students, especially for K-12 education. By developing a triadic collaboration system to support K-12 writing learning, a multidimensional evaluation framework grounded in Systemic Functional Linguistics and the suggestion trajectory tracing pipeline, this paper contributes a large-scale empirical dataset involving 57,954 essays from 10,195 students across 120 schools over two years. Our findings confirm the efficacy of this system in improving writing quality through a strategic labor division: the LLM serves as a generative engine to mitigate teacher burnout, and the teacher acts as a pedagogical gatekeeper and bridge to guarantee feedback quality. While both LLM and teacher are critical for skill improvement, we uncover a ceiling effect where excessive linguistic expansion yields diminishing marginal utility. These suggest a dynamically adaptive LLM-teacher collaboration as student proficiency increases.
papers.abstract_zh: 整合大语言模型（LLMs）这一双刃剑需要建立有效的三方协作机制，涉及LLMs、教师和学生，尤其是在K-12教育领域。本文通过开发一种支持K-12写作学习的多方协作系统，结合系统功能语言学理论以及反馈追踪流程，构建了一个多维度的评估框架。实验结果显示，该系统能够显著提高写作质量，其效果得益于合理的分工：LLM作为生成引擎，有助于减轻教师的职业倦怠；而教师则扮演着教学把关者和桥梁的角色，确保反馈的质量。虽然LLM和教师都对技能提升至关重要，但我们发现，过度的语言扩展会导致边际效用递减，因此需要根据学生的进步情况动态调整两者的协作方式。

papers.title: IntroLM: Introspective Language Models via Prefilling-Time Self-Evaluation
papers.title_zh: IntroLM：通过预填充时间自我评估来实现反思性语言模型
papers.authors: Hossein Hosseini Kasnavieh, Gholamreza Haffari, Christopher Leckie, Adel N. Toosi
papers.abstract: A major challenge for the operation of large language models (LLMs) is how to predict whether a specific LLM will produce sufficiently high-quality output for a given query. Existing approaches rely on external classifiers, most commonly BERT-based models, which suffer from limited context windows, constrained representational capacity, and additional computational overhead. We propose IntroLM, a method that enables causal language models to predict their own output quality during the prefilling phase without affecting generation using [CPX] tokens. By introducing token-conditional LoRA that activates only for the introspective [CPX] token, the model learns to predict the output quality for a given query while preserving the original backbone behavior and avoiding external evaluators. On question-answering benchmarks, IntroLM applied to Qwen3-8B achieves a ROC–AUC of 90% for success prediction, outperforming a DeBERTa-v3-Large classifier by 14%. When integrated into multi-model routing systems, IntroLM achieves superior cost–performance trade-offs, reducing end-to-end latency by up to 33% and large-model usage by up to 50% at matched reliability. Our code is available at https://github.com/hhosseini1377/LLM_routing.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型运行中的一个主要挑战是，如何预测某个特定语言模型对于给定的查询能够产生足够高质量的输出。现有的方法依赖于外部分类器，最常见的是基于BERT的模型，但这些模型存在上下文窗口有限、表示能力受限以及额外的计算开销等问题。我们提出了IntroLM方法，该方法使因果语言模型能够在预填充阶段预测自身的输出质量，而不会影响使用[CPX]令牌的生成过程。通过引入仅在自省[CPX]令牌时激活的令牌条件LoRA，该模型能够预测给定查询的输出质量，同时保留原始主干模型的特性，并避免依赖外部评估器。在问答基准测试中，应用于Qwen3-8B的IntroLM在成功预测方面达到了90%的ROC-AUC值，比DeBERTa-v3-Large分类器高出14%。当集成到多模型路由系统中时，IntroLM在成本与性能之间实现了更优的权衡，将端到端延迟降低了33%，同时使大模型的使用量增加了50%，且可靠性保持不变。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/hhosseini1377/LLM_routing获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Herd of Language Models Makes a Better Zero-shot Annotator for Clinical Named Entity Recognition
papers.title_zh: 由多个语言模型组成的团队能够开发出更出色的零样本标注工具，用于临床命名实体识别任务
papers.authors: Seiji Shimizu, Shoko Wakamiya, Eiji Aramaki
papers.abstract: Clinical named entity recognition (NER) remains difficult to scale due to the high cost of manual annotation. Although large language models (LLMs) enable zero-shot annotation, their performance on clinical NER is still limited. To this end, we improve the annotation quality by aggregating annotations from a herd of diverse LLMs, including general-purpose, medically adapted, and NER-specialized models. A key challenge in this multi-LLM setting is effectively leveraging entities extracted by only a minority of models: although they account for a substantial portion of true positives, they are heavily intermixed with noise. To address this, we introduce MARY, a label-modeling method for Multi-LLM Annotation using Representation learning to capture contextual similaritY. During aggregation, MARY selectively incorporates minority-extracted entities whose contexts are similar to those of majority-extracted entities, yielding more reliable and comprehensive annotations. Experimental results show that MARY improves the average F1 score by 8.6% over vanilla zero-shot baselines while reducing annotation costs.
papers.abstract_zh: 临床命名实体识别任务由于手动标注的成本高昂而一直难以大规模开展。虽然大语言模型能够实现零样本标注，但其在临床命名实体识别任务上的表现仍然有限。为此，我们通过整合来自多种不同语言模型的标注数据来提高标注质量，这些模型包括通用型模型、针对医学领域的优化模型以及专门用于命名实体识别的模型。在多语言模型环境下，一个关键的挑战是有效利用仅由少数模型提取出的实体信息：尽管这些实体占据了大量正确标注的比例，但它们往往与噪声数据混杂在一起。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MARY这一基于表示学习的多语言模型标注方法，该方法能够捕捉上下文中的相似性特征。在标注过程中，MARY会选择性地整合那些与多数模型提取的实体具有相似上下文的少数模型提取的实体，从而生成更可靠、更全面的标注结果。实验结果表明，与传统的零样本基线方法相比，MARY能够将平均F1分数提高8.6%，同时还能降低标注成本。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: P2P: A Poison-to-Poison Remedy for Reliable Backdoor Defense in LLMs
papers.title_zh: P2P：一种基于“以毒攻毒”策略的解决方案，用于确保大语言模型具备可靠的防御机制
papers.authors: Shuai Zhao, Xinyi Wu, Shiqian Zhao, Xiaobao Wu, Zhongliang Guo, Yanhao Jia, Anh Tuan Luu
papers.abstract: Defending Large Language Models (LLMs) against backdoor attacks has long been trapped in a “cat-and-mouse” dilemma, where defenders passively react to ever-shifting attack strategies. To break this cycle, we posit that proactive immunization is inherently superior to reactive sanitization. In this study, we propose Poison-to-Poison (P2P), a general and effective defense algorithm that introduces a paradigm shift. Instead of waiting to detect malicious samples, P2P strategically implants benign triggers to reshape the model’s decision boundary, redirecting latent feature activation from malicious trajectories to a safe, controllable output space. This enforces the model to associate trigger-induced representations with safe outputs, thereby overriding the effects of original malicious triggers. Thanks to this robust and generalizable trigger-based fine-tuning, P2P is effective across task settings and attack types. Theoretically and empirically, we show that P2P can neutralize malicious backdoors while preserving task performance. We conduct extensive experiments on classification, mathematical reasoning, and summary generation tasks, involving multiple state-of-the-art LLMs. The results demonstrate that our P2P algorithm significantly reduces the attack success rate compared with baseline models. We hope that P2P can serve as a practical guideline for defending against backdoor attacks in the Model as a Service (MaaS) scenario, where benign prompts are embedded within the system to regulate model behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 长期以来，防御大语言模型（LLM）免受后门攻击一直面临着“猫捉老鼠”的困境，即防御者不得不被动地应对不断变化的攻击策略。为了打破这一循环，我们认为主动免疫本质上优于被动消毒。在本研究中，我们提出了一种名为“毒代毒法”（Poison-to-Poison，P2P）的通用且有效的防御算法。与等待检测恶意样本不同，P2P通过战略性地植入良性触发因素来重塑模型的决策边界，将潜在特征激活从恶意路径引导到安全、可控的输出空间。这样，模型会将触发因素产生的表示与安全输出联系起来，从而抵消原始恶意触发因素的影响。得益于这种强大且可泛化的基于触发因素的微调技术，P2P能够在各种任务环境和攻击类型中发挥作用。理论和实证研究表明，P2P能够在保持任务性能的同时消除恶意后门攻击。我们在分类、数学推理和摘要生成等任务上进行了大量实验，涉及多个先进的LLM模型。结果表明，与基线模型相比，我们的P2P算法显著降低了攻击的成功率。我们希望P2P能成为防御后门攻击的实用指南，尤其是在模型即服务（MaaS）场景中，通过将良性提示嵌入系统中来调节模型的行为。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Learning Temporally-Aware Sample Weights for Preference Optimization
papers.title_zh: 学习用于偏好优化的时间感知样本权重
papers.authors: Mengyang Li, Xudong Zhou, Pinlong Zhao
papers.abstract: Preference optimization is fundamental for aligning large language models. While existing methods use sample weighting, they typically rely on static functions of instantaneous model states and ignore temporal learning dynamics. We contend that a sample’s value evolves throughout training, characterized by patterns such as stable convergence or noisy oscillation. We propose MetaPO, a framework that meta-learns adaptive weights using three temporal features: reward margin evolution, learning volatility, and reference deviation. Through bilevel optimization on validation data, MetaPO automatically discovers weighting strategies tailored to specific datasets. Experiments on models ranging from 7B to 70B parameters demonstrate statistically significant improvements over strong baselines, achieving gains of up to 2.4 points on AlpacaEval 2.0 and Arena-Hard. Interpretability analysis confirms that temporal features drive over 70% of the weighting decisions and that the learned weights correlate strongly with sample quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 偏好优化是调整大语言模型的基础。虽然现有方法采用样本加权策略，但它们通常依赖于模型状态的静态特征，而忽略了时间上的学习动态。我们认为，样本的价值在训练过程中会不断演变，呈现出稳定收敛或噪声波动等模式。我们提出了MetaPO框架，该框架通过三个时间特征来元学习自适应权重：奖励幅度变化、学习波动性以及参考值偏差。通过在验证数据上进行双层优化，MetaPO能够自动发现适用于特定数据集的加权策略。对参数从7B到70B的各种模型进行的实验表明，与强大的基准模型相比，MetaPO在性能上取得了显著的提升，在AlpacaEval 2.0和Arena-Hard评估中实现了高达2.4点的性能提升。可解释性分析证实，时间特征驱动了超过 70% 的加权决策，而且学习到的权重与样本质量之间存在很强的相关性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ToolPRMBench: Evaluating and Advancing Process Reward Models for Tool-using Agents
papers.title_zh: ToolPRMBench：评估与改进用于工具使用型智能体的过程奖励模型
papers.authors: Dawei Li, Yuguang Yao, Zhen Tan, Huan Liu, Ruocheng Guo
papers.abstract: Reward-guided search methods have demonstrated strong potential in enhancing tool-using agents by effectively guiding sampling and exploration over complex action spaces. As a core design, those search methods utilize process reward models (PRMs) to provide step-level rewards, enabling more fine-grained monitoring. However, there is a lack of systematic and reliable evaluation benchmarks for PRMs in tool-use settings. In this paper, we introduce ToolPRMBench, a large-scale benchmark specifically designed to evaluate PRMs for tool-using agents. ToolPRMBench is built on top of several representative tool-use benchmarks and converts agent trajectories into step-level test cases. Each case contains the interaction history, a correct action, a plausible but incorrect alternative, and relevant tool metadata. We respectively utilize offline sampling to isolate local single-step errors and online sampling to capture realistic multi-step failures from full agent rollouts. A multi-LLM verification pipeline is proposed to reduce label noise and ensure data quality. We conduct extensive experiments across large language models, general PRMs, and tool-specialized PRMs on ToolPRMBench. The results reveal clear differences in PRM effectiveness and highlight the potential of specialized PRMs for tool-using. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/David-Li0406/ToolPRMBench[More resources on LLM-as-a-judge are on the website: https://llm-as-a-judge.github.io].
papers.abstract_zh: 基于奖励的搜索方法在提升工具使用智能体的能力方面展现出巨大潜力，它能够有效指导在复杂动作空间中的采样和探索。这类搜索方法的核心设计是利用过程奖励模型来提供逐步骤的奖励，从而实现更精细的监控。然而，对于工具使用场景下的过程奖励模型而言，目前缺乏系统且可靠的评估基准。在本文中，我们提出了ToolPRMBench这一大规模基准测试平台，专门用于评估工具使用智能体的过程奖励模型。ToolPRMBench建立在多个代表性的工具使用基准测试之上，并将智能体轨迹转化为逐步骤的测试案例。每个案例包含交互历史、正确的操作、一个看似合理但错误的替代方案以及相关的工具元数据。我们通过离线采样来识别局部的单步错误，同时通过在线采样来捕捉从整个智能体执行过程中出现的多步失败情况。我们还提出了一种多大语言模型验证流程，以减少标签噪声并保障数据质量。我们在ToolPRMBench上进行了大量实验，涉及多种语言模型、通用过程奖励模型以及针对工具的专用过程奖励模型。实验结果揭示了不同过程奖励模型在效果上的显著差异，同时也凸显了专用过程奖励模型在工具使用场景中的潜在优势。我们的代码和数据集可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/David-Li0406/ToolPRMBench。更多关于以大语言模型作为评判标准的资源可以在该网站找到：https://llm-as-a-judge.github.io。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Adapt to Thrive! Adaptive Power-Mean Policy Optimization for Improved LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 适应以求得生存！自适应功率均值优化策略，提升大型语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Yiming Huang, Zhenbo Shi, Shuzheng Gao, Cuiyun Gao, Peiyi Han, Chuanyi Liu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is an essential paradigm that enhances the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing methods typically rely on static policy optimization schemes that misalign with the model’s evolving reasoning capabilities. To address this issue, we propose Adaptive Power-Mean Policy Optimization (APMPO), which comprises two main innovations: Power-Mean Policy Optimization (PMPO) and Feedback-Adaptive Clipping (FAC). Specifically, PMPO introduces a generalized power-mean objective. This enables the model to adaptively transition from the signal-amplifying behavior of the arithmetic mean to the consistency-enforcing behavior of the geometric mean. FAC adaptively adjusts clipping bounds based on real-time reward statistics to overcome the limitations of static mechanisms. Capitalizing on these innovations, APMPO improves learning dynamics and reasoning performance. Extensive experiments on nine datasets across three reasoning tasks showcase the superiority of APMPO over state-of-the-art RLVR-based baselines. For instance, APMPO boosts the average Pass@1 score on mathematical reasoning benchmarks by 3.0 points compared to GRPO when using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是一种能够提升大语言模型推理能力的核心方法。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于静态的策略优化方案，这与模型不断发展的推理能力并不匹配。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了自适应功率均值策略优化算法（APMPO），该算法包含两项创新：功率均值策略优化（PMPO）和反馈自适应裁剪（FAC）。具体来说，PMPO引入了一种通用的功率均值目标函数，使得模型能够从算术平均的放大行为自适应地转变为几何平均的一致性约束行为。而FAC则根据实时奖励统计数据自适应调整裁剪界限，从而克服静态机制的局限性。通过结合这两项创新，APMPO显著提升了学习的动态性和推理性能。在三个推理任务上的九个数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，APMPO优于现有的基于RLVR的基线方法。例如，当使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct时，APMPO在数学推理基准测试中的平均Pass@1分数比GRPO高出3.0分。
