papers.title: LEAF: Towards Lightweight Explainable Hateful Video Detection via Self-Grounding CoT Guided Stage-Wise Distillation
papers.title_zh: LEAF：通过自基础化协同传输技术实现轻量级、可解释的恶意视频检测——基于分阶段蒸馏的方法
papers.authors: Jian Lang, Rongpei Hong, Meihui Zhong, Kaiju Li, Ting Zhong, Qiang Gao, Fan Zhou
papers.abstract: The rapid spread of hateful videos online has sparked growing social concerns, driving research efforts to detect and limit their dissemination. However, existing methods rely on opaque models that offer no insight into their decisions, eroding trust in detection systems. Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) provide a compelling alternative, thanks to their ability to generate free-text explanations for multimodal content. Yet, their high computational demands and pronounced bias toward benign predictions limit their practicality. We introduce LEAF, the first Lightweight, Explainable hAteful video detection Framework. At its core, LEAF distills the “explainability” from LMMs into efficient Smaller Multimodal Models (SMMs) through a controlled, de-biasing process, enabling lightweight yet interpretable Hateful Video Detection (HVD). We achieve this with a novel Self-Grounding Chain-of-Thought mechanism that guides LMMs to generate high-quality, unbiased explanatory supervision signals for videos. These signals then progressively train the SMM via a new Stage-Wise Distillation paradigm, resulting in faithful, human-readable natural language explanations for HVD. Extensive experiments on three video benchmarks demonstrate that LEAF not only outperforms prior methods in detection accuracy but also provides strong explainability — all with a lightweight design.
papers.abstract_zh: 在线上恶意视频的迅速传播引发了日益严重的社会担忧，促使人们努力研发方法来检测并限制这类视频的传播。然而，现有的方法依赖于不透明的模型，这些模型无法提供关于其决策的任何信息，从而削弱了人们对检测系统的信任。大型多模态模型则提供了一种有竞争力的替代方案，因为它们能够生成关于多模态内容的自由文本解释。不过，它们的高计算需求以及倾向于给出良性预测的特性，限制了它们的实用性。我们提出了LEAF，这是首个轻量级、可解释的恶意视频检测框架。其核心思想是通过一种可控的去偏见处理过程，将多模态模型中蕴含的“可解释性”提取出来，并将其转化为高效的小型多模态模型。这样，我们就可以实现轻量级且易于理解的恶意视频检测。我们通过一种新颖的自引导思维链机制来实现这一目标，该机制引导多模态模型为视频生成高质量、无偏见的解释性监督信号。这些信号随后通过一种新的分阶段蒸馏范式来训练小型多模态模型，最终得到人类可读的自然语言解释。在三个视频基准测试上的广泛实验表明，LEAF不仅在检测准确性方面优于现有方法，而且还提供了强大的可解释性——所有这些功能都体现在其轻量级设计之中。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DemMA: Dementia Multi-Turn Dialogue Agent with Expert-Guided Reasoning and Action Simulation
papers.title_zh: DemMA：一种具备专家指导推理能力及行为模拟功能的痴呆症多轮对话代理程序
papers.authors: Yutong Song, Jiang Wu, Kazi Shaharair Sharif, Pengfei Zhang, Wenjun Huang, Honghui Xu, Nikil Dutt, Amir M. Rahmani
papers.abstract: Simulating dementia patients with large language models (LLMs) is challenging due to the need to jointly model cognitive impairment, emotional dynamics, and nonverbal behaviors over long conversations. We present DemMA, an expert-guided dementia dialogue agent for high-fidelity multi-turn patient simulation. DemMA constructs clinically grounded dementia personas by integrating pathology information, personality traits, and subtype-specific memory-status personas informed by clinical experts. To move beyond text-only simulation, DemMA explicitly models nonverbal behaviors, including motion, facial expressions, and vocal cues. We further introduce a Chain-of-Thought distillation framework that trains a single LLM to jointly generate reasoning traces, patient utterances, and aligned behavioral actions within one forward pass, enabling efficient deployment without multi-agent inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 使用大语言模型来模拟痴呆症患者是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为需要同时考虑认知障碍、情绪变化以及非言语行为在长时间对话中的表现。我们提出了DemMA——一种由专家指导的痴呆症对话代理，用于高保真度的多轮患者模拟。DemMA通过整合病理信息、人格特征以及临床专家提供的特定亚型记忆状态信息，来构建符合临床标准的痴呆症患者形象。为了超越单纯的文本模拟，DemMA还明确模拟了非言语行为，包括动作、面部表情和声音信号。此外，我们还引入了一种思维链蒸馏框架，该框架能够训练一个大语言模型，使其在一次前向计算中同时生成推理过程、患者话语以及相应的行为动作，从而实现无需多智能体交互的高效模拟。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SplitThenMerge: Token-Level Skill-Compositional Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Complex Domain-Specific Tasks
papers.title_zh: SplitThenMerge：基于标记级的技能组合式混合专家系统，适用于复杂的领域特定任务
papers.authors: Yuting Huang, Jiawen Zhang, Yiquan Wu, Yinghao Hu, Fei Wu, Kun Kuang
papers.abstract: Large language models have demonstrated strong performance on general-purpose tasks but often fail to satisfy the accuracy requirements of knowledge-intensive domains such as law, medicine, and finance. Complex domain-specific generation is inherently compositional, involving multiple atomic skills such as reasoning, knowledge grounding, and numerical computation that are frequently interleaved at the token level. Existing domain adaptation methods typically train these heterogeneous skills jointly within a single objective, which makes it difficult for models to reliably coordinate multiple skills when solving complex tasks. In this work, we explicitly incorporate atomic skills into domain-specific model training and propose SplitThenMerge, a framework that decomposes domain competence into atomic skills, trains them independently, and composes them dynamically during generation. SplitThenMerge adopts a token-level sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture to enable fine-grained skill routing and coordination while implementing each skill as a lightweight LoRA expert to achieve parameter-efficient specialization. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently achieves superior performance in both legal and medical domains under the same training parameter budget.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在通用任务上表现出强大的性能，但往往无法满足法律、医学和金融等知识密集型领域对准确性的要求。复杂的领域特定生成过程本质上是组合性的，涉及多种原子技能，如推理、知识基调和数值计算，这些技能通常在令牌级别上进行交织。现有的领域适应方法通常试图在单一目标下共同训练这些异构技能，这使得模型在解决复杂任务时难以可靠地协调多种技能。在这项研究中，我们明确地将原子技能纳入领域特定模型的训练中，并提出了SplitThenMerge框架。该框架将领域能力分解为原子技能，分别进行独立训练，并在生成过程中动态将它们组合起来。SplitThenMerge采用了一种令牌级别的稀疏混合专家架构，以实现细粒度的技能路由和协调；同时，每个技能都被实现为轻量级的LoRA专家，从而实现参数高效的专门化。实验结果表明，在相同训练参数预算下，我们的方法在法律和医学领域都能持续取得优异的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Causal-Audit: Explicit and Auditable Graph-based Reasoning via Target-Aware Causal Chain Construction
papers.title_zh: 因果审计：通过构建目标感知的因果链来实现可验证的基于图的推理机制
papers.authors: Su Lan, Xuefei Yin, Yanming Zhu, Alan Wee-Chung Liew
papers.abstract: Causal and intervention-based question answering is fundamental to advancing large language models (LLMs) toward reasoning beyond surface-level correlations and understanding underlying causal mechanisms. However, existing LLM-based methods often rely on implicit language-level reasoning, resulting in opaque causal assumptions, unverifiable reasoning paths, and fragile predictions under complex interventions, particularly in context-free settings. In this paper, we propose an explicit and auditable causal reasoning framework for context-free intervention-based question answering. Our method formulates causal inference as structured reasoning over an explicit causal graph through four modular stages, rather than implicit end-to-end prediction. A key innovation is a target-aware causal graph construction strategy that treats the target variable as a core constraint during graph expansion, effectively suppressing irrelevant variables, spurious causal relations, and reasoning noise. We further introduce a path-level causal evidence aggregation mechanism that combines multiple causal paths while modeling both reinforcing and counteracting effects, enabling robust decision-making beyond single-chain reasoning. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms existing LLM-based methods while providing interpretable and auditable causal reasoning traces.
papers.abstract_zh: 因果推理和基于干预的问题回答是推动大语言模型迈向超越表面相关性、理解潜在因果机制的基础。然而，现有的基于大语言模型的方法往往依赖于隐式的语言级推理，导致因果假设不透明、推理路径不可验证，以及在复杂干预下的预测结果不稳定，尤其是在无上下文的情况下。在本文中，我们提出了一种明确且可审计的因果推理框架，用于无上下文的干预问题回答。我们的方法将因果推断分解为四个模块化阶段，通过显式的因果图进行结构化推理，而不是采用隐式的端到端预测。我们的一个关键创新是目标感知的因果图构建策略，该策略在构建图时将目标变量视为核心约束条件，有效排除无关变量、虚假因果关系以及推理中的噪声。我们还引入了路径级因果证据聚合机制，该机制能够结合多个因果路径，同时模拟强化和抵消效应，从而实现超越单一链推理的稳健决策。在三个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的框架始终优于现有的基于大语言模型的方法，同时提供了可解释且可审计的因果推理轨迹。

papers.title: RADS: Reinforcement Learning-Based Sample Selection Improves Transfer Learning in Low-resource and Imbalanced Clinical Settings
papers.title_zh: RADS：基于强化学习的样本选择方法，有助于在资源有限且数据不平衡的临床场景中实现迁移学习
papers.authors: Wei Han, David Martinez Iraola, Anna Khanina, Lawrence Cavedon, Karin Verspoor
papers.abstract: A common strategy in transfer learning is few shot fine-tuning, but its success is highly dependent on the quality of samples selected as training examples. Active learning methods such as uncertainty sampling and diversity sampling can select useful samples. However, under extremely low-resource and class-imbalanced conditions, they often favor outliers rather than truly informative samples, resulting in degraded performance. In this paper, we introduce RADS (Reinforcement Domain Adaptive Sampling), a robust sample selection strategy using reinforcement learning (RL) to identify the most informative samples. Experimental evaluations on several real world clinical datasets show our sample selection strategy enhances model transferability while maintaining robust performance under extreme class imbalance compared to traditional methods. Our code is open-sourced on GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 迁移学习中的一种常见策略是少样本微调，但其成功与否很大程度上取决于作为训练样本的采样质量。主动学习方法，如不确定性采样和多样性采样，能够选出有用的样本。然而，在资源极度匮乏且类别不平衡的情况下，这些方法往往更倾向于选择异常值而非真正具有信息价值的样本，从而导致模型性能下降。在本文中，我们提出了RADS（强化域自适应采样）这一鲁棒的样本选择策略。该策略利用强化学习来识别最具信息价值的样本。在多个真实临床数据集上的实验评估表明，与传统方法相比，我们的样本选择策略能够在极端类别不平衡的情况下提升模型的迁移能力，同时保持了稳健的性能。我们的代码已开源在GitHub上。

papers.title: Watch Out Your Industrial Copilots: Stealthy Backdoor Attack Against LLM-Based PLC Code Generation
papers.title_zh: 小心那些工业级编程助手：针对基于大语言模型的PLC代码生成的隐秘攻击
papers.authors: Xinyuan An, Liu Xiaoxia, Dongxia Wang, Zhanhang Xiong, Wenhai Wang
papers.abstract: Recently, there is an emerging trend of using Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) code automatically, resulting in commercialized products such as Siemens Industrial Copilots. While such LLM-driven products have the potential to transform the way control engineers program, they may also introduce a new attack surface. In this work, we introduce STBack, the first stealthy backdoor attack framework targeting LLM-based PLC code generation. STBack first incorporates six malicious logic injection patterns specifically designed for PLCs to generate the poisoned code samples, along with a three-stage automated pipeline to refine stealthiness. Then, it injects the backdoor by finetuning an LLM using the prompts with a semantic-integrated trigger and the corresponding malicious PLC code sample pairs. The compromised LLM will generate malicious PLC code when the trigger is identified in the prompts.We evaluate STBack on multiple LLMs, which achieves 82.92% average attack success rate while remaining stealthy, i.e., maintaining over 95% semantic similarity with benign code and bypassing quality validation, making the injected backdoor extremely challenging to detect. We also show that existing defenses are ineffective against our benign-looking trigger mechanism. This work reveals a novel and critical security threat for industrial copilots, calling for more cautious use and dedicated defenses.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，有一种新兴的趋势是使用大语言模型来自动生成可编程逻辑控制器代码，从而生产出诸如西门子工业Copilots这样的商业化产品。虽然这类由LLM驱动的产品有可能改变控制工程师的编程方式，但它们也可能引入新的攻击面。在这项研究中，我们提出了STBack这一首个针对基于LLM的可编程逻辑控制器代码生成的隐蔽后门攻击框架。STBack首先包含了六种专为PLC设计的恶意逻辑注入模式，以生成被污染的代码样本，同时还配备了三阶段的自动化流程来提高其隐蔽性。接着，它通过使用带有语义整合触发器的提示以及相应的恶意PLC代码样本对来微调LLM，从而植入后门。当提示中识别出该触发器时，受损的LLM就会生成恶意PLC代码。我们在多个LLM上测试了STBack，结果显示其平均攻击成功率为82.92%，同时仍然保持隐蔽性，即与良性代码的语义相似性超过95%，并且能够绕过质量验证，这使得植入的后门极难被检测出来。此外，我们还发现现有的防御措施对于我们的这种看似无害的触发机制无效。这项研究表明，工业Copilots面临着一种新型且严重的安全威胁，因此我们需要更加谨慎地使用这些技术，并采取专门的防御措施。

papers.title: Balancing Classification and Calibration Performance in Decision-Making LLMs via Calibration Aware Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 在决策过程中平衡分类任务与校准效果：基于校准意识的强化学习方法
papers.authors: Duygu Nur Yaldiz, Evangelia Spiliopoulou, Zheng Qi, Siddharth Varia, Srikanth Doss, Nikolaos Pappas
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in decision-making tasks, where not only accuracy but also reliable confidence estimates are essential. Well-calibrated confidence enables downstream systems to decide when to trust a model and when to defer to fallback mechanisms. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of calibration in two widely used fine-tuning paradigms: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We show that while RLVR improves task performance, it produces extremely overconfident models, whereas SFT yields substantially better calibration, even under distribution shift, though with smaller performance gains. Through targeted experiments, we diagnose RLVR’s failure, showing that decision tokens act as extraction steps of the decision in reasoning traces and do not carry confidence information, which prevents reinforcement learning from surfacing calibrated alternatives. Based on this insight, we propose a calibration-aware reinforcement learning formulation that directly adjusts decision-token probabilities. Our method preserves RLVR’s accuracy level while mitigating overconfidence, reducing ECE scores up to 9 points.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在决策任务中的应用越来越广泛，此时不仅准确性至关重要，可靠的置信度估计同样不可或缺。恰当的置信度设定能够使得下游系统明确何时信任模型，何时采用备用机制。在这项研究中，我们对两种常用的微调范式进行了系统的校准研究：监督式微调（SFT）和带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。我们发现，虽然RLVR提升了任务性能，但它会导致模型过度自信；而SFT则在即使存在分布偏移的情况下也能提供更好的校准效果，尽管其性能提升幅度较小。通过有针对性的实验，我们揭示了RLVR的缺陷——决策标记在推理过程中仅起到提取决策信息的作用，并不携带置信度信息，这阻碍了强化学习找到经过校准的替代方案。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种注重校准的强化学习方法，该方法直接调整决策标记的概率。我们的方法在保持RLVR的准确性的同时，有效降低了模型的过度自信程度，使ECE评分提高了多达9分。

papers.title: Redefining Machine Simultaneous Interpretation: From Incremental Translation to Human-Like Strategies
papers.title_zh: 重新定义机器口译：从渐进式翻译到类似人类口译的策略
papers.authors: Qianen Zhang, Zeyu Yang, Satoshi Nakamura
papers.abstract: Simultaneous Machine Translation (SiMT) requires high-quality translations under strict real-time constraints, which traditional policies with only READ/WRITE actions cannot fully address. We extend the action space of SiMT with four adaptive actions: Sentence_Cut, Drop, Partial_Summarization and Pronominalization, which enable real-time restructuring, omission, and simplification while preserving semantic fidelity. We adapt these actions in a large language model (LLM) framework and construct training references through action-aware prompting. To evaluate both quality and word-level monotonicity, we further develop a latency-aware TTS pipeline that maps textual outputs to speech with realistic timing. Experiments on the ACL60/60 English-Chinese, English-German and English-Japanese benchmarks show that our framework consistently improves semantic metrics and achieves lower delay compared to reference translations and salami-based baselines. Notably, combining Drop and Sentence_Cut leads to consistent improvements in the balance between fluency and latency. These results demonstrate that enriching the action space of LLM-based SiMT provides a promising direction for bridging the gap between human and machine interpretation.
papers.abstract_zh: 同时机器翻译（Simultaneous Machine Translation，SiMT）需要在严格的实时约束条件下完成高质量的翻译任务，而传统的仅支持读取/写入操作的政策无法完全满足这一需求。我们为SiMT的动作空间增加了四种自适应操作：句子切割、删除、部分总结以及代词替换。这些操作能够在不影响语义忠实度的前提下实现实时重构、省略和简化。我们在大语言模型框架中应用这些操作，并通过考虑动作特性的提示方式来构建训练指导。为了评估翻译的质量以及单词级别的单调性，我们还开发了一种考虑延迟的语音合成流程，能够将文本输出转换为具有真实时长的语音。在ACL60/60英法、英德和英日语料库上的实验表明，我们的框架在语义指标上取得了持续改善的效果，并且与参考翻译和基于“salami”方法的基线相比，其延迟更低。值得注意的是，结合使用删除和句子切割操作可以显著提高流畅性与延迟之间的平衡。这些结果表明，丰富基于大语言模型的SiMT的动作空间为弥合人类与机器翻译之间的差距提供了有希望的方向。

papers.title: ChunQiuTR: Time-Keyed Temporal Retrieval in Classical Chinese Annals
papers.title_zh: 春秋TR：古典汉语记载中的时间导向检索方式
papers.authors: Yihao Wang, Zijian He, Jie Ren, Keze Wang
papers.abstract: Retrieval shapes how language models access and cite knowledge in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). In historical research, the goal is often to locate the exact record for a specific regnal month, where temporal alignment matters as much as topical relevance. This is especially challenging for Classical Chinese annals: time is encoded in terse, implicit, non-Gregorian reign phrases that are context-dependent, so semantically plausible evidence can still be temporally invalid. We introduce ChunQiuTR, a time-keyed retrieval benchmark built from the Spring and Autumn Annals and its exegetical tradition. It organizes records by month-level reign keys and includes chrono-near confounders that mimic real retrieval failures. We propose CTD (Calendrical Temporal Dual-encoder), a time-aware dual-encoder combining Fourier-based absolute context with relative offset biasing. Experiments show consistent gains over semantic dual-encoder baselines under time-keyed evaluation. We will release ChunQiuTR and code after the anonymity period.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索方式决定了语言模型在基于检索增强的生成中如何获取和引用知识。在历史研究中，通常需要找到特定统治月份的确切记录，此时时间对齐与主题相关性同样重要。对于古典汉语的年表来说，这一任务尤为困难：时间被编码在简洁、隐式的非公历统治术语中，而这些术语依赖于上下文，因此即使语义上合理的证据也可能在时间上无效。我们提出了ChunQiuTR这一基于《春秋》及其注释传统构建的时间导向检索基准。该基准按照月度统治关键词对记录进行组织，并包含能够模拟真实检索失败的时序相近的干扰因素。我们提出了CTD（日历时间双编码器），这是一种结合基于傅里叶的绝对上下文和相对偏移偏置的时间感知双编码器。实验表明，在基于时间关键词的评估中，该编码器比基于语义的双编码器基线有更稳定的提升效果。我们将在匿名期结束后发布ChunQiuTR及其代码。

papers.title: OFFSIDE: Benchmarking Unlearning Misinformation in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 场外评论：在多模态大型语言模型中识别并消除错误信息
papers.authors: Hao Zheng, Zirui Pang, Ling Li, Zhijie Deng, Yuhan Pu, Zhaowei Zhu, Xiaobo Xia, Jiaheng Wei
papers.abstract: Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) intensify concerns about data safety, making Machine Unlearning (MU), the selective removal of harmful/private information, a critical necessity. However, existing MU benchmarks for MLLMs are limited by a lack of image diversity, coarse-grained unlearning target, and insufficient evaluation scenarios, which fail to capture the complexity of real-world applications. To facilitate the development of MLLMs unlearning and alleviate the aforementioned limitations, we introduce OFFSIDE, a novel benchmark for evaluating misinformation unlearning in MLLMs. This manually curated dataset contains 15.68K records for 80 players, providing a comprehensive framework with four test sets to assess forgetting efficacy, generalization, utility, and robustness. OFFSIDE supports advanced unlearning targets, such as fine-grained unlearning and visual rumor removal. Our extensive evaluation of multiple baselines not only extends key findings from LLM MU to MLLM MU: (1) unlearned rumors can be easily recovered through relearning and (2) all methods are vulnerable to prompt attacks, but also introduces novel insights in the context of MLLM: (1) unimodal methods fail to handle multimodal rumors, (2) unlearning efficacy is primarily driven by catastrophic forgetting statistically, and (3) all methods struggle with visual rumors (rumors embedded in images). These results expose significant vulnerabilities in current approaches, highlighting the need for more robust multimodal unlearning solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型的发展引发了人们对数据安全性的担忧，因此实现机器去学习——即选择性地移除有害或私密信息——变得至关重要。然而，现有的多模态语言模型去学习基准测试存在诸多不足：图像多样性不足、去学习目标过于粗略，以及评估场景不够丰富，这些因素都未能充分反映现实应用中的复杂性。为了促进多模态语言模型去学习的开发并缓解上述局限性，我们提出了OFFSIDE这一新的基准测试工具，用于评估多模态语言模型中错误信息的去除效果。该数据集由人工整理而成，包含15.68K条记录，涉及80名参与者，为评估遗忘效果、泛化能力、实用性和鲁棒性提供了全面的框架。OFFSIDE支持更精细的去学习目标，如细粒度去学习和视觉谣言的移除。我们对多个基线的广泛评估不仅扩展了从语言模型去学习到多模态语言模型去学习的关键发现：（1）通过重新学习可以轻松恢复被去学习的谣言；（2）所有方法都容易受到提示攻击的影响。此外，我们的研究还发现了一些新的现象： （1）单模态方法无法处理多模态谣言；（2）从统计上看，去学习的效果主要受到灾难性遗忘的影响；（3）所有方法在应对视觉谣言时都存在困难。这些结果揭示了当前方法的显著弱点，进一步凸显了需要更强大的多模态去学习解决方案的必要性。

papers.title: PedagogyBench: A Cognitive-Driven Benchmark for Multimodal Instructional Video Understanding
papers.title_zh: PedagogyBench：一种基于认知的跨模态教学视频理解基准测试工具
papers.authors: Xiaokang Jin, Jia Zhu, Jingjiang Liu, Yabing Shi, Jueqi Guan, Hao Chen, Pasquale De Meo
papers.abstract: Existing video understanding benchmarks mainly emphasize general visual recognition and reasoning, but do not adequately capture the pedagogical logic embedded in instructional videos. To address this gap, we present PedagogyBench, a multimodal benchmark for instructional video understanding grounded in pedagogical cognition. We introduce a pedagogy-driven segmentation strategy and a dual-stream semantic injection pipeline that combines machine pre-annotation with expert refinement, enabling the construction of a dataset organized around a cognitive pyramid with four levels and 20 fine-grained tasks. We further propose the Cognitive Fidelity Score (CFS) to measure the balance of model performance across pedagogical cognitive dimensions. Experiments on 12 multimodal large language models reveal a clear generative gap, where models perform relatively well on discriminative tasks but degrade on higher-order pedagogical diagnosis, often relying on parametric memory rather than grounded visual perception. Project resources are available at https://github.com/Shallcom/PedagogyBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的视频理解基准测试主要侧重于一般的视觉识别与推理能力，但未能充分捕捉到教学视频中所蕴含的教学逻辑。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了PedagogyBench——一个基于教学认知的教学视频理解多模态基准测试工具。我们采用了一种以教学逻辑为驱动的分段策略，并构建了双流语义注入流程，该流程结合了机器自动注释和专家精细调整，从而能够构建出一个包含四个层次、共20个细粒度任务的认知金字塔式数据集。此外，我们还提出了认知真实性评分（Cognitive Fidelity Score，CFS）这一指标，用于衡量模型在多个教学认知维度上的表现平衡情况。通过对12种多模态大语言模型的实验分析发现，这些模型在判别性任务上表现较好，但在更高层次的教学诊断方面表现不佳，因为它们往往依赖于参数化记忆而非基于视觉感知的推理方式。该项目的相关资源可以在https://github.com/Shallcom/PedagogyBench下载。

papers.title: FeedEval: Pedagogically Aligned Evaluation of LLM-Generated Essay Feedback
papers.title_zh: FeedEval：基于教育学原则的LLM生成文章反馈评估方法
papers.authors: SeongYeub Chu, Jongwoo Kim, Mun Yong Yi
papers.abstract: Going beyond the prediction of numerical scores, recent research in automated essay scoring has increasingly emphasized the generation of high-quality feedback that provides justification and actionable guidance. To mitigate the high cost of expert annotation, prior work has commonly relied on LLM-generated feedback to train essay assessment models. However, such feedback is often incorporated without explicit quality validation, resulting in the propagation of noise in downstream applications. To address this limitation, we propose FeedEval, an LLM-based framework for evaluating LLM-generated essay feedback along three pedagogically grounded dimensions: specificity, helpfulness, and validity. FeedEval employs dimension-specialized LLM evaluators trained on datasets curated in this study to assess multiple feedback candidates and select high-quality feedback for downstream use. Experiments on the ASAP++ benchmark show that FeedEval closely aligns with human expert judgments and that essay scoring models trained with FeedEval-filtered high-quality feedback achieve superior scoring performance. Furthermore, revision experiments using small LLMs show that the high-quality feedback identified by FeedEval leads to more effective essay revisions. We release our code and curated datasets at: https://github.com/BBeeChu/FeedEval.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 除了对数值分数的预测之外，最近在自动作文评分领域的研究越来越重视生成高质量的反馈，这些反馈能够提供合理的解释和可行的指导。为了降低专家注释的高成本，以往的研究通常依赖由大语言模型生成的反馈来训练作文评估模型。然而，这种反馈往往在没有进行明确的质量验证的情况下就被使用，导致噪声在后续应用中传播。为了解决这一限制问题，我们提出了FeedEval这个基于大语言模型的框架，用于从三个教育上重要的维度来评估大语言模型生成的作文反馈：具体性、有用性和有效性。FeedEval采用了针对特定维度的大语言模型评估器，这些评估器是在本研究整理的数据集上训练的，它们可以评估多个反馈候选方案，并选择高质量的反馈供后续使用。在ASAP++基准测试上的实验表明，FeedEval与人类专家的判断非常一致，而使用FeedEval过滤后的高质量反馈来训练的作文评分模型则能够取得更好的评分效果。此外，使用小型大语言模型进行的修改实验表明，FeedEval所识别出的高质量反馈能够带来更有效的作文修改。我们的代码和整理好的数据集可以在以下链接查看：https://github.com/BBeeChu/FeedEval.git。

papers.title: Probing Multimodal Large Language Models on Cognitive Biases in Chinese Short-Video Misinformation
papers.title_zh: 探究多模态大语言模型在中文短视频虚假信息中的认知偏差问题
papers.authors: Jen-tse Huang, Chang Chen, Shiyang Lai, Wenxuan Wang, Michelle R Kaufman, Mark Dredze
papers.abstract: Short-video platforms have become major channels for misinformation, where deceptive claims frequently leverage visual experiments and social cues. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, their robustness against misinformation entangled with cognitive biases remains under-explored. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation framework using a high-quality, manually annotated dataset of 200 short videos spanning four health domains. This dataset provides fine-grained annotations for three deceptive patterns—experimental errors, logical fallacies, and fabricated claims—each verified by evidence such as national standards and academic literature. We evaluate eight frontier MLLMs across five modality settings. Experimental results demonstrate that Gemini-2.5-Pro achieves the highest performance in the multimodal setting with a belief score of 71.5/100, while o3 performs the worst at 35.2. Furthermore, we investigate social cues that induce false beliefs in videos and find that models are susceptible to biases like authoritative channel IDs.
papers.abstract_zh: 短视频平台已成为错误信息的主要传播渠道，其中的虚假宣传常常借助视觉实验和社交线索来误导用户。虽然多模态大语言模型展现出了令人印象深刻的推理能力，但其在应对错误信息时的鲁棒性以及对抗认知偏差的能力仍有待进一步研究。在本文中，我们提出了一个全面的评估框架，使用了包含200个短视频的高质量、手动标注数据集，这些视频涵盖了四个健康领域。该数据集为三种虚假宣传模式提供了详细的注释——实验性错误、逻辑谬误和捏造的声明——每种模式都通过国家标准、学术文献等证据进行了验证。我们对八种前沿的多模态大语言模型在五种不同模式下的表现进行了评估。实验结果表明，Gemini-2.5-Pro在多模态环境下的表现最为出色，其信念得分达到了71.5/100，而o3则表现最差，得分为35.2。此外，我们还研究了在视频中引发错误信念的社交线索，发现模型容易受到诸如权威频道ID之类的偏见的影响。

papers.title: Emotion–Cause Pair Extraction in Conversations via Semantic Decoupling and Alignment
papers.title_zh: 通过语义解耦与对齐来提取对话中的情感与原因对应关系
papers.authors: Tianxiang Ma, Weijie Feng, Xinyu Wang, Zhiyong Cheng
papers.abstract: Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction in Conversations (ECPEC) aims to identify the set of causal relations between emotion utterances and their triggering causes within a dialogue. Most existing approaches formulate ECPEC as independent pairwise classification, overlooking the distinct semantics of emotion diffusion and cause explanation, and failing to capture globally consistent many-to-many conversational causality. To address these limitations, we revisit ECPEC from a semantic perspective and seek to disentangle emotion-oriented semantics from cause-oriented semantics, mapping them into two complementary representation spaces to better capture their distinct conversational roles. Building on this semantic decoupling, we naturally formulate ECPEC as a global alignment problem between the emotion-side and cause-side representations, and employ optimal transport to enable many-to-many and globally consistent emotion-cause matching. Based on this perspective, we propose a unified framework SCALE that instantiates the above semantic decoupling and alignment principle within a shared conversational structure. Extensive experiments on several benchmark datasets demonstrate that SCALE consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 对话中的情绪-原因对提取（Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction in Conversations，简称ECPEC）旨在识别对话中情绪表达与其触发原因之间的因果关系。目前大多数方法都将ECPEC视为独立的成对分类任务，这忽略了情绪扩散和原因解释这两种不同语义的复杂性，同时也未能捕捉到全局一致的多对多对话因果关系。为了克服这些局限性，我们从语义角度重新审视ECPEC，试图将以情绪为导向的语义与以原因为导向的语义分离开来，并将它们映射到两个互补的表示空间中，从而更好地体现它们在对话中的不同角色。基于这种语义上的分离，我们自然将ECPEC构建为一个全局对齐问题，即情绪侧表示与原因侧表示之间的对齐问题。我们采用最优传输算法来实现多对多且全局一致的情绪-原因匹配。基于这一视角，我们提出了一种统一的框架SCALE，该框架在共享的对话结构内实现了上述语义分离和对齐原则。在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，SCALE始终能够取得最先进的性能表现。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Failure makes the agent stronger: Enhancing Accuracy through Structured Reflection for Reliable Tool Interactions
papers.title_zh: 失败反而能让代理人变得更强大：通过有组织的反思来提高准确性，从而实现更可靠的工具交互
papers.authors: Junhao Su, Yuanliang Wan, Junwei Yang, Hengyu Shi, Tianyang Han, Yurui Qiu, Junfeng Luo
papers.abstract: Tool-augmented large language models (LLMs) are typically trained via supervised imitation learning or coarse-grained reinforcement learning, approaches that primarily optimize one-shot tool calls. Existing practices of self-reflection largely rely on heuristic prompting or unidirectional reasoning traces: the model is encouraged to “think more,” rather than to treat error diagnosis and correction as a learnable capability. This makes them fragile in multi-turn interaction settings—once a call fails, the model tends to repeat the same mistake instead of recovering. To address this issue, we propose structured reflection, which transforms the “from error to repair” process into a first-class, controllable, and trainable action. The agent produces a concise yet precise reflection process: specifically, the model diagnoses the error based on evidence from the previous step and then proposes a correct and executable follow-up call. During training, we combine DAPO and GSPO’s objective functions and design a more principled reward mechanism tailored to tool calling, optimizing the stepwise strategy Reflect \to Call \to Final. To evaluate this capability, we introduce Tool-Reflection-Bench, a lightweight benchmark dataset that programmatically verifies structural validity, executability, parameter correctness, and result consistency. Tasks in the benchmark are constructed as miniature trajectories of Erroneous Call \to Reflection \to Corrected Call and are split into disjoint training and testing sets. Experiments on BFCL v3 and Tool-Reflection-Bench show that our method achieves significant improvements in multi-turn tool-call success rates and error recovery, while also reducing redundant calls. These results demonstrate that making reflection explicit and treating it as an optimization objective can substantially enhance the reliability of tool interaction, providing a reproducible pathway for agents to grow stronger by learning from failure. We will release all the code and datasets as open source once the paper is accepted by the community.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具增强型大语言模型通常通过监督模仿学习或粗粒度强化学习来训练，这些方法主要优化一次性工具调用。现有的自我反思实践大多依赖于启发式提示或单向推理轨迹：模型被鼓励“多思考”，而不是将错误诊断与纠正视为可学习的技能。这使得它们在多轮交互环境中显得脆弱——一旦调用失败，模型往往会重复同样的错误而不进行恢复。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了结构化反思机制，将“从错误到修复”的过程转化为一种一流、可控且可训练的行动。该机制要求智能体生成一个简洁而精确的反思过程：具体来说，模型根据前一步骤中的证据诊断错误，然后提出一个正确且可执行的后续调用。在训练过程中，我们结合了DAPO和GSPO的目标函数，并设计了一种更系统化的奖励机制，专门用于工具调用，优化了从反思到调用再到最终结果的逐步策略。为了评估这一能力，我们引入了Tool-Reflection-Bench这个轻量级基准数据集，它通过编程方式验证结构有效性、可执行性、参数正确性以及结果一致性。该基准数据集的任务被构建为从错误调用到反思再到修正调用的微型流程，并分为独立的训练集和测试集。在BFC-L v3和Tool-Reflection-Bench上的实验表明，我们的方法在多次工具调用成功率和错误恢复方面取得了显著改进，同时减少了冗余调用。这些结果表明，将反思明确化并将其作为优化目标可以显著提高工具交互的可靠性，为智能体通过从失败中学习来提升自身能力提供了可复制的路径。一旦论文被社区接受，我们将把所有代码和数据集以开源形式发布。

papers.title: Feedback to Reasoning: LLM-Assisted Molecular Optimization with Domain Feedback and Historical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 反馈与推理：结合领域信息和历史数据的LLM辅助分子优化方法
papers.authors: Wenhan Gao, Xiran Fan, Chin-Chia Michael Yeh, Jiarui Sun, Yuzhong Chen, Menghai Pan, Mahashweta Das, Yi Liu
papers.abstract: The success of large language models (LLMs) across domains highlights their potential in scientific tasks, with molecular optimization being a promising frontier. Traditionally, this optimization relies on iterative expert feedback to refine molecules toward desired properties, a process well aligned with LLMs’ strengths. As an experience-driven task, molecular optimization depends critically on the domain feedback and accumulation of historical knowledge. However, none of the existing methods fully leverages such feedback and historical knowledge with reasoning traces and chemical insights. In this work, we propose F2R: Feedback to Reasoning, a conversational molecular optimization pipeline that enables LLMs to accumulate and retrieve past actions, rationales, and feedback. Like humans, LLMs can generate imperfect reasoning; F2R is the first framework to use detailed domain feedback to critique and improve this reasoning. This transforms LLMs from passive text generators into agentic experts that learn both actions and reasoning from experience. Consequently, F2R shows remarkable performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在各个领域的成功表明它们具有在科学任务中的巨大潜力，而分子优化则是一个充满前景的前沿领域。传统上，这种优化依赖于迭代式的专家反馈来改进分子，使其具备所需的特性，这一过程与大语言模型的优势非常契合。作为一种基于经验的任务，分子优化严重依赖领域反馈以及历史知识的积累。然而，现有的方法都没有充分利用这种反馈以及带有推理痕迹和化学洞察的历史知识。在这项研究中，我们提出了F2R：反馈到推理，这是一种对话式分子优化流程，它能够让大语言模型积累和检索过去的行动、理由以及反馈信息。就像人类一样，大语言模型也能产生不完美的推理；F2R是第一个利用详细领域反馈来批判和改进这种推理的框架。这使得大语言模型从被动的文本生成器转变为能够从经验中学习行动和推理的智能专家。因此，F2R展现出了出色的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Iterative Formalization and Planning in Partially Observable Environments
papers.title_zh: 在部分可观测环境中的迭代形式化与规划
papers.authors: Liancheng Gong, Wang Bill Zhu, Jesse Thomason, Li Zhang
papers.abstract: Using LLMs not to predict plans but to formalize an environment into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) has been shown to improve performance and control. While most existing methodology only applies to fully observable environments, we adapt to the more realistic and challenging partially observable environments without sufficient information to make a complete plan. We propose PDDLego+, a framework to iteratively formalize, plan, grow, and refine PDDL representations by decomposing the environment and the goal into fully observable episodes. Without fine-tuning, in-context exemplars, or trajectories, PDDLego+ improves planning success and exhibits robustness against problem complexity compared to end-to-end approaches. We also show that the domain knowledge captured after a successful trial can benefit future tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 使用大语言模型不是为了预测计划，而是将环境形式化并转化为规划领域定义语言（PDDL），这一方法已被证明可以提高性能和控制能力。虽然现有的大多数方法仅适用于完全可观察的环境，但我们能够适应那些更现实且具有挑战性的部分可观察环境，这些环境缺乏足够的信息来制定完整的计划。我们提出了PDDLego+框架，该框架通过分解环境和目标为完全可观察的片段，来迭代地形式化、规划、扩展和完善PDDL表示。无需精细调整、上下文示例或轨迹数据，PDDLego+就能提高规划成功率，并且与端到端方法相比，更能应对问题复杂性的挑战。我们还表明，在成功试验后获得的领域知识可以为未来的任务提供帮助。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: StructKV: Preserving the Structural Skeleton for Scalable Long-Context Inference
papers.title_zh: StructKV：保留结构框架以实现可扩展的长上下文推理功能
papers.authors: Zhirui Chen, Peiyang Liu, Ling Shao
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) scale to support context windows exceeding one million tokens, the linear growth of Key-Value (KV) cache imposes severe memory capacity and bandwidth bottlenecks, constraining the efficiency of long-context inference. Existing compression approaches typically prioritize tokens based on local saliency metrics to decouple prefill computation from decoding memory. However, these methods often rely on local saliency snapshots at a specific layer, thereby systematically discarding tokens that act as global information hubs across the network depth but appear temporarily dormant at the specific layer selected for pruning. To address this limitation, we propose StructKV, a structure-aware KV cache compression framework that introduces three core innovations: First, Global In-Degree Centrality aggregates attention patterns across the network depth to identify global information hubs. Second, Dynamic Pivot Detection utilizes information-theoretic metrics to adaptively locate the optimal layer for compression. Finally, Structural Propagation Decoupling separates the computational budget from the memory storage budget. Experimental results on the LongBench and RULER benchmarks demonstrate that StructKV effectively preserves long-range dependencies and retrieval robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的扩展能力达到支持超过一百万个令牌的上下文窗口，键值（KV）缓存的线性增长带来了严重的内存容量和带宽瓶颈问题，这限制了长上下文推理的效率。现有的压缩方法通常根据局部显著性指标来优先处理某些令牌，以将预填充计算与解码内存分离。然而，这些方法往往依赖于特定层级的局部显著性快照，因此会系统性地忽略那些在网络深度中起到全局信息枢纽作用，但在被选择进行压缩的特定层级中暂时处于休眠状态的令牌。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了StructKV这一基于结构意识的KV缓存压缩框架，该框架引入了三项核心创新：首先，全局入度中心性算法能够汇总整个网络层面的注意力模式，从而识别出全局信息枢纽；其次，动态 pivot检测技术利用信息论指标来自适应地确定最佳压缩层级；最后，结构传播分离技术能够将计算预算与内存存储预算分离开来。在LongBench和RULER基准测试上的实验结果表明，StructKV能够有效保留长距离依赖关系以及检索的鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Correct, Concise and Complete: Multi-stage Training For Adaptive Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 正确、简洁且全面：针对适应性推理的多阶段训练方法
papers.authors: Nathanaël Carraz Rakotonirina, Ren Pang, Neha Anna John, Michael Bohlke-Schneider, Momchil Hardalov
papers.abstract: The reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have improved substantially through increased test-time computation, typically in the form of intermediate tokens known as chain-of-thought (CoT). However, CoT often becomes unnecessarily long, increasing computation costs without improving accuracy and sometimes even degrading performance, a phenomenon known as “overthinking”. We propose a multi-stage efficient reasoning method that combines supervised fine-tuning—via rejection sampling or reasoning trace reformatting—with reinforcement learning using an adaptive length penalty. We introduce a lightweight reward function that penalizes tokens generated after the first correct answer, encouraging the model to perform self-verification only when beneficial. We conduct a holistic evaluation across seven diverse reasoning tasks, analyzing the accuracy–response length trade-off. Our approach reduces response length by an average of 28% for 8B models and 40% for 32B models, while incurring only minor performance drops of 1.6 and 2.5 points, respectively. Despite its conceptual simplicity, it achieves a better trade-off than more complex state-of-the-art efficient reasoning methods, scoring 76.6 on the area under the Overthinking-Adjusted Accuracy curve (\text{AUC}_{\text{OAA}})—5 points above the base model and 2.5 points above the second-best approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力通过增加测试时的计算量而得到了显著提升，这种计算量通常以被称为“思维链”（CoT）的中间标记形式呈现。然而，思维链往往会变得过于冗长，从而增加了计算成本，同时却没有提高准确性，有时甚至会导致性能下降，这种现象被称为“过度思考”。我们提出了一种多阶段的高效推理方法，该方法结合了监督式微调——通过拒绝采样或重新格式化推理轨迹——以及使用自适应长度惩罚的强化学习。我们引入了一种轻量级奖励函数，该函数会对第一个正确答案之后生成的标记进行惩罚，从而促使模型仅在有益的情况下进行自我验证。我们在七个不同的推理任务上进行了全面评估，分析了准确性与响应长度之间的权衡关系。我们的方法使得8B模型的响应长度平均减少了28%，而32B模型的响应长度则减少了40%。同时，性能下降幅度仅分别达到了1.6点和2.5点。尽管这种方法在概念上非常简单，但它所实现的权衡比那些更复杂的先进高效推理方法要好得多。在过度思考调整准确率曲线下面积（\text{AUC}_{\text{OAA}}）的评分中，我们的方法达到了76.6分——比基础模型高出5分，比第二好的方法高出2.5分。

papers.title: At Your Own PACE: A Causal Framework for Evaluating EQ in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 按照自己的节奏进行：一种用于评估大型语言模型情绪智力的因果框架
papers.authors: Lei Lyu, Shengling Wang, Ke Chao, Yichao Wei
papers.abstract: Emotional Quotient (EQ) has emerged as a competency for seamless human-AI integration. However, since traditional EQ scales focus on self-healing, directly migrating them to Large Language Models (LLMs) often leads to ignorance of healing others. While EQ metrics specifically designed for LLMs have been proposed, they remain mired in two dilemmas: dimensional deficiency and fragmented testing. Hence, this paper establishes a Quad-in-One architecture for a closed-loop EQ evaluation. First, we propose the PACE Taxonomy to define four dimensions of LLM EQ. Upon this, the Causal-PACE framework is developed to eliminate causal confounding bias triggered by the interactions among EQ dimensions, ensuring a rigorous quantification of composite EQ scores. To operationalize this framework, we implement the PACE-AB, a mutil-agent EQevaluation board system. Finally, we curate the PACE-2700 dataset, featuring 2,700 high-quality instructions, to serve as a comprehensive benchmark for large-scale validation.Experimental results demonstrate that the EQ values derived via the Causal-PACE achieve a high alignment of 89.31% with human preferences, while the automated PACE-AB system maintains a robust consistency of 83.6%. Our data is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PACE-2700-8E52.
papers.abstract_zh: 情商（EQ）已成为实现人与人工智能无缝融合的关键能力。然而，由于传统的情商评估体系侧重于自我修复能力，将其直接应用于大语言模型（LLM）时，往往会导致忽视对他人的修复作用。虽然已经提出了专为LLM设计的情商评估指标，但这些指标仍面临两个难题：维度不足和测试方式单一。因此，本文提出了一种“四合一”架构，用于闭环式的情商评估。首先，我们提出了PACE分类法，以定义LLM情商的四个维度。在此基础上，我们开发了Causal-PACE框架，以消除因情商各维度之间的相互作用而产生的因果混淆偏差，从而确保对综合情商得分的精确量化。为了实际应用这一框架，我们开发了PACE-AB系统，这是一种多智能体情商评估平台。最后，我们构建了PACE-2700数据集，该数据集包含2,700条高质量指令，可作为大规模验证的综合性基准。实验结果表明，通过Causal-PACE方法得出的情商值与人类偏好高度一致，达到89.31%的匹配度；而自动化的PACE-AB系统则保持了83.6%的稳健一致性。我们的数据可在此处公开获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PACE-2700-8E52
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Identifying Collective Intelligence Factor in LLM Agent Groups for Generalizable Multi-Agent System Design
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型代理群体中识别集体智能因素，以实现可泛化的多智能体系统设计
papers.authors: Zhilun Zhou, Zihan Liu, Jiahe Liu, Yihan Wang, Qingyu Shao, Fengli Xu, Depeng Jin, Yong Li
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown impressive performance in solving a wide range of complex problems. However, previous studies mainly focus on designing customized MAS for specific tasks, while a critical research problem remains unclear: Do LLM agent groups exhibit a form of “general intelligence” that reflects their general ability across various tasks? Researchers have found a Collective Intelligence (CI) factor in human groups that captures their general capability. Inspired by this, in this study, we aim to investigate whether an analogous CI factor also exists in LLM agent groups, which is crucial for building generalizable MAS. Motivated by human cognitive psychology experiments, we construct 108 LLM agent groups with diverse group sizes, LLM compositions, and communication topologies. We systematically evaluate these groups across a wide range of tasks and analyze their performances. Our results demonstrate that an Artificial Collective Intelligence (ACI) factor can be extracted from LLM agent groups to predict the generalization performance on new tasks. Inspired by this, we train a model to predict the ACI based on the features of MAS, and show that it can be used as a plug-in to enhance the generalization ability of MAS optimization methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在解决各种复杂问题方面表现优异。然而，以往的研究主要集中在为特定任务设计定制化的多智能体系统上，而一个关键性的研究问题仍然不明确：语言模型智能体群体是否具备某种“通用智力”，能够反映它们在不同任务中的整体能力？研究人员发现，人类群体中存在着一种集体智力因素，能够体现他们的整体能力。受此启发，本研究旨在探讨语言模型智能体群体中是否存在类似的集体智力因素，这对于构建可泛化多智能体系统至关重要。基于人类认知心理学实验的启发，我们构建了108个具有不同规模、语言模型组成和通信拓扑结构的语言模型智能体群体。我们对这些群体在多种任务中的表现进行了系统评估。结果表明，可以从语言模型智能体群体中提取出一种人工集体智力因素，以预测其在新任务上的泛化性能。受此启发，我们训练了一个模型，该模型可以根据多智能体系统的特征来预测人工集体智力因素，并证明该模型可以作为插件，增强多智能体优化方法的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Rethinking Parameter Sharing for LLM Fine-Tuning with Multiple LoRAs
papers.title_zh: 重新思考用于多LoRA架构下的大语言模型微调的参数共享机制
papers.authors: Hao Ban, Kaiyi Ji
papers.abstract: Large language models are often adapted using parameter-efficient techniques such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), formulated as y = W_0x + BAx, where W_0 is the pre-trained parameters and x is the input to the adapted layer. While multi-adapter extensions often employ multiple LoRAs, prior studies suggest that the inner A matrices are highly similar during training and thus suitable for sharing. We revisit this phenomenon and find that this similarity is largely attributable to the identical initialization rather than shared knowledge, with B playing a more critical role in knowledge encoding and transfer. Motivated by these insights, we propose ALoRA, an asymmetric multi-LoRA design with multiple A matrices and a single shared B in multi-task fine-tuning, and Fed-ALoRA, which shares B across clients in federated fine-tuning under both homogeneous and heterogeneous settings, through a novel matrix decomposition strategy to accommodate heterogeneous ranks across clients. Experiments on commonsense reasoning, math reasoning, multi-task NLP dataset, and federated NLP dataset demonstrate that our methods achieve more balanced performance across tasks with comparable or superior average accuracy relative to existing multi-LoRA approaches. The code is available at https://github.com/OptMN-Lab/ALoRA.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常采用参数高效的技术进行适配，例如低秩适配器（LoRA）。其公式可以表示为 y = W_0x + BAx，其中 W_0 是预训练的参数，x 是待适配层的输入。虽然多适配器扩展通常会使用多个 LoRA，但先前的研究表明，在训练过程中，各个 A 矩阵之间具有高度相似性，因此适合进行共享。我们重新审视了这一现象，发现这种相似性主要源于相同的初始化方式，而非共享的知识。在知识编码和传递方面，B 起着更为关键的作用。基于这些发现，我们提出了 ALoRA 技术——这是一种非对称的多 LoRA 设计，它包含多个 A 矩阵和一个共享的 B，适用于多任务微调。此外，我们还提出了 Fed-ALoRA 技术，它可以在同质和异质环境下，通过一种新的矩阵分解策略，实现跨客户端共享 B，从而适应不同客户端之间的不同秩需求。在常识推理、数学推理、多任务自然语言处理数据集以及联邦自然语言处理数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法能够在各种任务中取得更均衡的性能，其平均准确率与现有的多 LoRA 方法相当甚至更高。代码可访问于 https://github.com/OptMN-Lab/ALoRA。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Shorten After You’re Right: Lazy Length Penalties for Reasoning RL
papers.title_zh: 当你正确之后就缩短文本：对推理型强化学习算法中的冗长长度惩罚机制
papers.authors: Danlong Yuan, Tian Xie, Shaohan Huang, Huishuai Zhang, Zhuocheng Gong, Chong Luo, Furu Wei, Dongyan Zhao
papers.abstract: Long-reasoning models achieve strong accuracy on complex reasoning tasks, but their extended reasoning trajectories incur substantial memory and latency costs. Several existing shortening methods rely on additional supervision or multi-stage post-training, which primarily reduces inference length and does not reduce the rollout tokens during on-policy reinforcement learning (RL). We instead target on-policy response shortening, aiming to improve both inference efficiency and RL training throughput. However, because on-policy RL couples optimization with exploration, naively penalizing length can destabilize training and suppress exploration. To impose length pressure safely, we propose a lazy length penalty integrated into the rule-based RL pipeline: it activates only on correct trajectories, only after training accuracy enters a stably improving regime, and only when responses exceed a tolerance band beyond the minimal correct length. Across four settings, our method significantly reduces response length without extra training stages while maintaining or improving performance. In a logic reasoning setting, we achieve a 40% reduction in step-averaged response length alongside a 14-point gain in performance. For math problems, we reduce step-averaged response length by 33% while preserving performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 长推理模型在复杂推理任务上能够实现很高的准确性，但其扩展的推理过程会带来巨大的内存消耗和延迟问题。现有的几种缩短方法依赖于额外的监督机制或多阶段训练过程，这些方法主要减少了推理时长，但并未降低在策略式强化学习过程中的展开令牌数量。我们则专注于策略式响应的缩短问题，旨在同时提高推理效率和强化学习训练的吞吐量。然而，由于策略式强化学习需要将优化与探索相结合，单纯限制长度可能会破坏训练的稳定性并抑制探索行为。为了安全地施加长度限制，我们提出了一种懒惰式的长度惩罚机制，该机制仅会在正确的推理路径上激活，且只有在训练精度稳定提升之后才会生效，同时只有当响应超过容忍范围时才会实施惩罚。在四种不同的设置中，我们的方法能够在不增加额外训练步骤的情况下显著减少响应长度，同时还能保持或提升性能。在逻辑推理场景中，我们实现了平均响应长度的40%减少，同时性能提升了14点。对于数学问题，我们使平均响应长度减少了33%，同时保持了良好的性能表现。

papers.title: MedDCR: Learning to Design Agentic Workflows for Medical Coding
papers.title_zh: MedDCR：学习设计用于医疗编码的自主工作流程
papers.authors: Jiyang Zheng, Islam Nassar, Thanh Vu, Xu Zhong, Yang Lin, Tongliang Liu, Long Duong, Yuan-Fang Li
papers.abstract: Medical coding converts free-text clinical notes into standardized diagnostic and procedural codes, which are essential for billing, hospital operations, and medical research. Unlike ordinary text classification, it requires multi-step reasoning: extracting diagnostic concepts, applying guideline constraints, mapping to hierarchical codebooks, and ensuring cross-document consistency. Recent advances leverage agentic LLMs, but most rely on rigid, manually crafted workflows that fail to capture the nuance and variability of real-world documentation, leaving open the question of how to systematically learn effective workflows. We present MedDCR, a closed-loop framework that treats workflow design as a learning problem. A Designer proposes workflows, a Coder executes them, and a Reflector evaluates predictions and provides constructive feedback, while a memory archive preserves prior designs for reuse and iterative refinement. On benchmark datasets, MedDCR outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and produces interpretable, adaptable workflows that better reflect real coding practice, improving both the reliability and trustworthiness of automated systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 医学编码将自由文本的临床记录转化为标准化的诊断代码和流程代码，这些代码对于计费、医院运营和医学研究至关重要。与普通文本分类不同，医学编码需要多步骤的推理过程：提取诊断概念、遵循指南约束、将信息映射到分层代码库中，并确保不同文档之间的一致性。近年来，一些研究采用了基于智能体大语言模型的解决方案，但大多数方法仍然依赖于僵化的、人工设计的工作流程，这无法捕捉到现实世界中文档的细微差别和多样性。因此，如何系统地学习有效的工作流程仍然是一个亟待解决的问题。我们提出了MedDCR这一闭环框架，它将工作流程设计视为一个学习问题。设计师负责设计工作流程，编码员负责执行这些流程，而评估者则负责评估预测结果并提供建设性的反馈。此外，系统还配备了记忆库，可以保存之前的设计，以便后续使用并进行迭代优化。在基准数据集上的测试表明，MedDCR的表现优于现有的最先进基线方法，它能够生成可解释且适应性强的工作流程，更好地反映了实际的编码实践。这不仅提高了自动化系统的可靠性，也增强了其可信度。

papers.title: TokenPenalty: Alleviating Attention Sinks and Positional Decay in LVLMs
papers.title_zh: TokenPenalty：缓解在线游戏中出现的注意力下降和位置衰减问题
papers.authors: Xiaofeng Zhang, Yuanchao Zhu, Qiyan Zhao, Xiaosong Yuan, Jiawei Cao, Xuhang Chen
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in Web-scale applications—such as image search, social media captioning, and e-commerce product description generation—where factual consistency is critical for user trust and content reliability. However, we observe that MLLMs frequently hallucinate in these settings due to two relevant phenomena: the massive activation phenomenon and positional information decay. The former refers to the tendency of attention mechanisms to concentrate on a small set of tokens with extreme activation values in query and key projections, which play indispensable roles in contextual understanding. In our investigation, we discover that perturbing these tokens leads to significant performance drops, highlighting their utmost importance. As for positional information decay, it occurs due to the common rotary position encoding strategy, where the attention to early visual tokens diminishes over time, especially in long-sequence generation tasks, such as image caption. To address these challenges, we propose TokenTruth, a token-level intervention strategy that dynamically suppresses irrelevant visual tokens while preserving key contextual signals. Our method is grounded in an in-depth analysis of massive activations and attention sink behaviors, and introduces a targeted token penalty mechanism that reallocates attention more faithfully toward informative visual regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TokenTruth significantly improves factual consistency across various MLLMs on standard image understanding benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在诸如图像搜索、社交媒体字幕以及电子商务产品描述生成等大规模应用中得到了广泛应用。在这些场景中，事实一致性对于提升用户信任度和内容可靠性至关重要。然而，我们发现，由于两种相关现象的存在，多模态大语言模型在这些应用场景中经常出现幻觉现象：一是“巨大激活现象”，即注意力机制倾向于集中在查询和关键词投影中那些具有极端激活值的少数几个词上，而这些词在上下文理解中起着不可或缺的作用；二是“位置信息衰减现象”，这是由于常见的旋转位置编码策略导致的，即随着时间的推移，对早期视觉词元的关注会逐渐减弱，尤其是在长序列生成任务中，比如图像字幕的生成。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了TokenTruth这一基于词元级别的干预策略。该策略能够动态抑制不相关的视觉词元，同时保留关键的上下文信息。我们的方法基于对巨大激活现象和注意力流失行为的深入分析，并引入了一种有针对性的词元惩罚机制，使得注意力能够更精准地分配到有信息价值的视觉区域。大量的实验表明，TokenTruth显著提升了多模态大语言模型在各类标准图像理解基准测试中的事实一致性表现。

papers.title: Beyond Screenshots: Evaluating VLMs’ Understanding of UI Animations
papers.title_zh: 不仅仅是截图：评估虚拟助手对用户界面动画的理解能力
papers.authors: Chen Liang, Xirui Jiang, Naihao Deng, Eytan Adar, Anhong Guo
papers.abstract: AI agents operating on user interfaces must understand how interfaces communicate state and feedback to act reliably. As a core communicative modality, animations are increasingly used in modern interfaces, serving critical functional purposes beyond mere aesthetics. Thus, understanding UI animation is essential for comprehensive interface interpretation. However, recent studies of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for UI understanding have focused primarily on static screenshots, leaving it unclear how well these models handle dynamic UI animations. To address this gap, we created AniMINT, a novel dataset of 300 densely annotated UI animation videos.We systematically evaluate state-of-the-art VLMs on UI animation understanding, including their abilities to perceive the animation effects, identify animation purposes, and interpret animation meaning. Our results show that VLMs can reliably detect primitive motion.However, their high-level animation interpretation remains inconsistent, with substantial gaps relative to human performance. Finally, we use Motion, Context, and Perceptual Cues (MCPC) to probe factors affecting VLM performance, revealing key bottlenecks and directions for future improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 在用户界面上运行的AI代理必须理解界面如何传递状态和反馈，以做出可靠的响应。作为核心的沟通方式，动画在现代界面中越来越被使用，其功能远不止于美观。因此，理解UI动画对于全面解读界面至关重要。然而，最近关于视觉语言模型在UI理解方面的研究主要集中在对静态屏幕截图的分析上，而对这些模型在处理动态UI动画方面的能力则缺乏研究。为了填补这一空白，我们创建了AniMINT这个包含300个密集标注的UI动画视频的新数据集。我们对最先进的视觉语言模型在UI动画理解方面的能力进行了系统评估，包括它们感知动画效果、识别动画目的以及解释动画意义的能力。我们的结果显示，视觉语言模型能够可靠地检测基本运动。然而，它们在高级动画理解方面仍然存在不一致性，与人类的表现相比仍有很大的差距。最后，我们通过使用运动、上下文和感知线索来探究影响视觉语言模型性能的因素，发现了关键的瓶颈和未来改进的方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MemWeaver: Weaving Hybrid Memories for Traceable Long-Horizon Agentic Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MemWeaver：构建可追踪的、适用于长期推理的混合式记忆系统
papers.authors: Juexiang Ye, Xue Li, Yang Xinyu, Chengkai Huang, Lanshun Nie, Lina Yao, Dechen Zhan
papers.abstract: Large language model-based agents operating in long-horizon interactions require memory systems that support temporal consistency, multi-hop reasoning, and evidence-grounded reuse across sessions. Existing approaches largely rely on unstructured retrieval or coarse abstractions, which often lead to temporal conflicts, brittle reasoning, and limited traceability. We propose MemWeaver, a unified memory framework that consolidates long-term agent experiences into three interconnected components: a temporally grounded graph memory for structured relational reasoning, an experience memory that abstracts recurring interaction patterns from repeated observations, and a passage memory that preserves original textual evidence. MemWeaver employs a dual-channel retrieval strategy that jointly retrieves structured knowledge and supporting evidence to construct compact yet information-dense contexts for reasoning. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark demonstrate that MemWeaver substantially improves multi-hop and temporal reasoning accuracy while reducing input context length by over 95% compared to long-context baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体在长时范围内的交互中，需要能够支持时间一致性、多跳推理以及跨会话的基于证据的复用机制的内存系统。现有的方法大多依赖于非结构化的检索或粗略的抽象化处理，这往往会导致时间上的冲突、不稳定的推理结果以及有限的可追溯性。我们提出了MemWeaver这一统一的内存框架，它将智能体的长期经验整合为三个相互关联的组成部分：一个用于结构化关系推理的时间性图状记忆；一个从重复观测中抽象出重复交互模式的经验记忆；以及一个保存原始文本证据的场景记忆。MemWeaver采用双通道检索策略，同时获取结构化知识和支持性证据，从而构建出既简洁又信息丰富的推理环境。在LoCoMo基准测试中的实验表明，与长上下文基线相比，MemWeaver显著提升了多跳推理和时序推理的准确性，同时还将输入上下文长度减少了超过95%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Mimesis to Metamorphosis: Evolving VLM Judges via In-Context Comparing and Knowledge Internalization
papers.title_zh: 从《模仿者》到《变形记》：通过上下文对比与知识内化来提升虚拟生命角色评判能力
papers.authors: Juntuo Wang, Yuming Qiao, Yifan Yang, Lunxi Yuan, Liang Luo, Dan Meng
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted as judges for subjective assessment, yet absolute scoring remains brittle due to inconsistent scales and inherent preference biases. To bridge this gap, we propose \text{S}^2\text{AD} (Semantic-Anchored Scale-Agnostic Distillation), a novel easy-to-hard framework that operationalizes subjective assessment as comparative analysis, conceptualizing the judge’s evolution from mimesis to metamorphosis. In Stage 1 (Mimesis), we introduce Dynamic Soft Positioning (DSP) to train the judge to compare a query against retrieved reference images, establishing a relative evaluation space that ensures consistent ordering under heterogeneous scales. In Stage 2 (Metamorphosis), this comparative capability is internalized via Language Buttons—discrete semantic levels serving as a retrieval-free internal reference. Optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), \text{S}^2\text{AD} achieves efficient, scale-steerable inference that adapts to diverse grading standards. Our framework reaches state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of internalized comparative priors for robust, rank-invariant, and scale-steerable evaluation. The code is available at: https://github.com/SpatialVision-Research/SSAD_ACL2026_Findings.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型被越来越多地用作主观评估的评判标准，但由于评分标准的不一致以及固有的偏好偏见，其绝对评分仍然存在缺陷。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了\text{S}^2\text{AD}（语义锚定尺度不可知蒸馏）框架。该框架将主观评估转化为比较分析，将评判者的思维过程从模仿阶段转变为变形阶段。在第一阶段（模仿阶段），我们采用动态软定位技术来训练评判者，使其能够将查询结果与检索到的参考图像进行比较，从而建立一个能够在不同尺度下保持一致排序的相对评估空间。在第二阶段（变形阶段），这种比较能力通过语言按钮得到强化——这些离散的语义层次作为无需检索的内部参照。结合群体相对策略优化技术，\text{S}^2\text{AD}能够实现高效且可适应不同评分标准的推理过程。我们的框架在多个基准测试中的表现均达到最先进水平，证明了内部化的比较先验对于实现稳健、等级不变且可适应不同尺度的评估是有效的。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/SpatialVision-Research/SSAD_ACL2026_Findings

papers.title: Generative Text-to-Image Retrieval via Hierarchical Identifiers and Semantic Internalization
papers.title_zh: 基于层次化标识符与语义内化的生成式文本转图像检索方法
papers.authors: Jie Huang, Junjie Wang, Xin Liao, Ziyou Jiang, Wenshuo Wang, Shoubin Li, Qing Wang
papers.abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) has emerged as a promising text-to-image paradigm, yet it suffers from limited semantic discriminability, alignment bias, and closed-set restrictions. To address these challenges, we propose SIGMA, a novel framework for Semantic Internalization for Generative Multimodal Alignment. SIGMA constructs multi-granularity hierarchical identifiers to ensure unique, semantically consistent image representations. We further introduce a progressive semantic internalization training strategy augmented with semantic soft labels, which captures fine-grained text-image affinities and enables inductive identifier assignment for unseen samples realizing open-set dynamic indexing capabilities. Experiments on the Flickr30K and MS-COCO datasets demonstrate that SIGMA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving average Recall@1, Recall@5, and Recall@10 improvements of 10.65%, 8.50%, and 7.00%, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式检索（GR）作为一种有前景的文本到图像的方法，虽然取得了一定的成果，但仍然存在语义区分能力有限、对齐偏差以及封闭集限制等问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SIGMA框架。该框架采用了多粒度层次化标识符结构，以确保图像表示的唯一性和语义一致性。我们还引入了一种渐进式的语义内部化训练策略，该策略结合了语义软标签，能够捕捉文本与图像的细微关系，并为未见过的样本分配归纳性标识符，从而实现开放集的动态索引功能。在Flickr30K和MS-COCO数据集上的实验表明，SIGMA的表现优于现有的最先进基线方法，分别实现了平均Recall@1、Recall@5和Recall@10的10.65%、8.50%和7.00%的提升。

papers.title: Bridging Reasoning and Action: Hybrid LLM–RL Framework for Efficient Cross-Domain Task-Oriented Dialogue
papers.title_zh: 连接推理与行动：一种混合式LLM与RL框架，以实现高效的多领域任务导向对话交互
papers.authors: Yangyang Zhao, Linfan Dai, Li Cai, Bowen Xing, Libo Qin
papers.abstract: Cross-domain task-oriented dialogue requires reasoning over implicit and explicit feasibility constraints while planning long-horizon, multi-turn actions. Large language models (LLMs) can infer such constraints but are unreliable over long horizons, while Reinforcement learning (RL) optimizes long-horizon behavior yet cannot recover constraints from raw dialogue. Naively coupling LLMs with RL is therefore brittle: unverified or unstructured LLM outputs can corrupt state representations and misguide policy learning. Motivated by this, we propose Verified LLM-Knowledge empowered RL (VLK-RL), a hybrid framework that makes LLM-derived constraint reasoning usable for RL. VLK-RL first elicits candidate constraints with an LLM and then verifies them via a dual-role cross-examination procedure to suppress hallucinations and cross-turn inconsistencies. The verified constraints are mapped into ontology-aligned slot–value representations, yielding a structured, constraint-aware state for RL policy optimization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that VLK-RL significantly improves generalization and robustness, outperforming strong single-model baselines on long-horizon tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨域任务导向的对话需要在对隐性和显性可行性约束进行推理的同时，规划长期、多轮次的行动。大语言模型能够推断出这些约束，但在长期范围内表现不可靠；而强化学习则能够优化长期行为，但却无法从原始对话中恢复这些约束信息。因此，简单地将大语言模型与强化学习结合是存在风险的：未经验证或结构化的模型输出可能会破坏状态表示，从而导致策略学习的错误。基于这一考虑，我们提出了一种名为“验证型大语言模型知识增强强化学习”的混合框架。该框架首先利用大语言模型提出候选约束，然后通过双角色交叉检验程序对这些约束进行验证，以抑制幻觉和跨轮次不一致性。经过验证的约束会被映射成符合本体论要求的槽值表示，从而为强化学习策略优化提供一个结构化的、考虑约束的状态。在多个基准测试中的实验表明，VLK-RL显著提升了泛化能力和鲁棒性，在长期任务上超越了那些仅依赖单一模型的强大基线算法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: JudgeAgent: Beyond Static Benchmarks for Knowledge-Driven and Dynamic LLM Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 法官代理人：超越静态基准测试，实现基于知识的动态大语言模型评估
papers.authors: Zhichao Shi, Xuhui Jiang, Chengjin Xu, Cangli Yao, Shengjie Ma, Yinghan Shen, Zixuan Li, Jian Guo, Yuanzhuo Wang
papers.abstract: Current evaluation methods for large language models (LLMs) primarily rely on static benchmarks, presenting two major challenges: limited knowledge coverage and fixed difficulties that mismatch with the evaluated LLMs. These limitations lead to superficial assessments of LLM knowledge, thereby impeding the targeted model optimizations.To bridge this gap, we propose JudgeAgent, a knowledge-driven and dynamic evaluation framework for LLMs.To address the challenge of limited knowledge coverage, JudgeAgent leverages LLM agents equipped with context graphs to traverse knowledge structures systematically for question generation.Furthermore, to mitigate data contamination and difficulty mismatch, it adopts a difficulty-adaptive and multi-turn interview mechanism.Thereby, JudgeAgent can achieve comprehensive evaluations and facilitate more effective improvement of LLMs.Empirical results demonstrate that JudgeAgent enables more comprehensive evaluations and facilitates effective model iterations, highlighting the potential of this knowledge-driven and dynamic evaluation paradigm.The source code is available on https://github.com/DataArcTech/JudgeAgent.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，对于大语言模型（LLM）的评估方法主要依赖于静态基准测试，这带来了两个主要问题：知识覆盖范围有限，以及评估中的难题与模型的实际能力不匹配。这些限制导致了对LLM知识的肤浅评估，从而阻碍了有针对性的模型优化。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了JudgeAgent——一个基于知识的、动态化的LLM评估框架。为了解决知识覆盖范围有限的问题，JudgeAgent利用配备有上下文图的LLM代理来系统地遍历知识结构以生成问题。此外，为了减轻数据污染和难题不匹配的问题，该框架采用了一种自适应难度的多轮面试机制。通过这种方式，JudgeAgent能够实现全面的评估，并有助于更有效地改进LLM模型。实验结果表明，JudgeAgent能够实现更全面的评估，并促进有效的模型迭代，这凸显了这种基于知识的、动态化评估方法的潜力。源代码可以在https://github.com/DataArcTech/JudgeAgent上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Retrieve Only Relevant Tables Whether Few or Many: Adaptive Table Retrieval Method
papers.title_zh: 仅检索相关的表格——无论表格数量多少：自适应表格检索方法
papers.authors: Taehee Kim, Seungbin Yang, Jihwan Kim, Jaegul Choo
papers.abstract: Retrieving relevant tables from extensive databases for a given natural language query is essential for accurately answering questions in tasks such as text-to-SQL. Existing table retrieval approaches select a pre-determined set of k tables with the highest similarity to the query. However, the number of required tables varies across queries and cannot be known in advance. Enforcing a fixed number of retrieved tables regardless of the query may either retrieve an undersized set, failing to obtain all necessary evidence, or retrieve an oversized pool, including irrelevant tables. To address this issue, we propose an adaptive table retrieval method that adjusts the number of tables retrieved according to the requirements of each query. Specifically, we utilize an adaptive thresholding mechanism to selectively retrieve tables and integrate a sliding-window reranking algorithm to efficiently process a large table corpus. Extensive experiments on Spider, BIRD, and Spider 2.0 demonstrate that our method effectively addresses the limitations of the top-k retrieval strategy, improving performance in retrieval and downstream tasks. Our code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Adaptive-Table-Retrieval.
papers.abstract_zh: 从庞大的数据库中检索与给定自然语言查询相关表项，对于在文本转SQL等任务中准确回答问题至关重要。现有的表项检索方法会选取一组与查询相似度最高的k个表项。然而，所需表项的数量会因查询而异，且无法提前确定。如果强制规定检索的表项数固定，可能会导致检索到的表项数量不足，无法获取所有必要的信息；或者检索到的表项数量过多，其中包含不相关的表项。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种自适应表项检索方法，能够根据每个查询的需求来调整检索出的表项数。具体来说，我们采用了自适应阈值机制来选择性地检索表项，并整合了滑动窗口重排序算法，以高效处理大量的表项数据。在Spider、BIRD和Spider 2.0上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法有效解决了top-k检索策略的局限性，提升了检索效率和后续任务的性能。我们的代码和数据可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Adaptive-Table-Retrieval下载。

papers.title: Code-Switching Information Retrieval: Benchmarks, Analysis, and the Limits of Current Retrievers
papers.title_zh: 语码转换信息检索：基准测试、分析以及当前检索工具的局限性
papers.authors: Qingcheng Zeng, Yuheng Lu, Zeqi Zhou, Heli Qi, Puxuan Yu, Fuheng Zhao, Hitomi Yanaka, Weihao Xuan, Naoto Yokoya
papers.abstract: Code-switching is a pervasive linguistic phenomenon in global communication, yet modern information retrieval systems remain predominantly designed for, and evaluated within, monolingual contexts. To bridge this critical disconnect, we present a holistic study dedicated to code-switching IR. We introduce CSR-L (Code-Switching Retrieval benchmark-Lite), constructing a dataset via human annotation to capture the authentic naturalness of mixed-language queries. Our evaluation across statistical, dense, and late-interaction paradigms reveals that code-switching acts as a fundamental performance bottleneck, degrading the effectiveness of even robust multilingual models. We demonstrate that this failure stems from substantial divergence in the embedding space between pure and code-switched text. Scaling this investigation, we propose CS-MTEB, a comprehensive benchmark covering 11 diverse tasks, where we observe performance declines of up to 27%. Finally, we show that standard multilingual techniques like vocabulary expansion are insufficient to resolve these deficits completely. These findings underscore the fragility of current systems and establish code-switching as a crucial frontier for future IR optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 语码转换是全球交流中普遍存在的语言现象，然而现代信息检索系统仍然主要设计用于单语环境，并仅在此类环境中进行评估。为了弥补这一关键差距，我们开展了一项针对语码转换的综合性研究。我们提出了CSR-L（语码转换检索简化版）基准测试，通过人工标注构建数据集，以捕捉混合语言查询的真实自然性。我们在统计、密集型和后期交互三种范式下的评估结果显示，语码转换是一个严重的性能瓶颈，即使使用强大的多语言模型，其效果也会受到严重限制。我们发现，这种问题源于纯文本与语码转换文本在嵌入空间中的巨大差异。为了进一步研究这个问题，我们提出了CS-MTEB这一涵盖11种不同任务的综合基准测试，结果发现性能下降了高达27%。最后，我们发现，像词汇扩展这样的标准多语言技术不足以完全解决这些问题。这些发现凸显了当前系统的脆弱性，并将语码转换确定为未来信息检索优化的关键领域。

papers.title: WebUncertainty: Dual-Level Uncertainty Driven Planning and Reasoning For Autonomous Web Agent
papers.title_zh: Web不确定性：针对自主网络智能体的双层不确定性驱动规划与推理机制
papers.authors: Lingfeng Zhang, Yongan Sun, Jinpeng Hu, Hui Ma, Ying Yang, Kuien Liu, Zenglin Shi, Meng Wang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have empowered autonomous web agents to execute natural language instructions directly on real-world webpages. However, existing agents often struggle with complex tasks involving dynamic interactions and long-horizon execution due to rigid planning strategies and hallucination-prone reasoning. To address these limitations, we propose WebUncertainty, a novel autonomous agent framework designed to tackle dual-level uncertainty in planning and reasoning. Specifically, we design a Task Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive Planning Mechanism that adaptively selects planning modes to navigate unknown environments. Furthermore, we introduce an Action Uncertainty-Driven Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) Reasoning Mechanism. This mechanism incorporates the Confidence-induced Action Uncertainty (ConActU) strategy to quantify both aleatoric uncertainty (AU) and epistemic uncertainty (EU), thereby optimizing the search process and guiding robust decision-making. Experimental results on the WebArena and WebVoyager benchmarks demonstrate that WebUncertainty achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在大语言模型方面的进展，使得自主网络代理能够直接在现实网页上执行自然语言指令。然而，现有的代理往往难以处理涉及动态交互和长周期执行的复杂任务，这是因为它们的规划策略过于僵化，且推理过程中容易出现幻觉。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了WebUncertainty这一新型自主代理框架，该框架旨在解决规划和推理中的双层不确定性问题。具体来说，我们设计了一种任务不确定性驱动的自适应规划机制，该机制能够自适应地选择不同的规划方式以应对未知环境。此外，我们还引入了动作不确定性驱动的蒙特卡洛树搜索推理机制。该机制采用了置信度诱导的动作不确定性量化方法，从而同时考虑随机不确定性和认知不确定性，进而优化搜索过程并指导做出稳健的决策。在WebArena和WebVoyager基准测试上的实验结果表明，WebUncertainty的性能优于现有的最先进基线算法。

papers.title: Multi-Faceted Self-Consistent Preference Alignment for Query Rewriting in Conversational Search
papers.title_zh: 用于对话式搜索中查询重写的多维度自我一致性偏好对齐机制
papers.authors: Zhiyu Cao, Peifeng Li, Qiaoming Zhu
papers.abstract: Conversational Query Rewriting (CQR) aims to rewrite ambiguous queries to achieve more efficient conversational search. Early studies have predominantly focused on the rewriting in isolation, ignoring the feedback from query rewrite, passage retrieval and response generation in the rewriting process. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Faceted Self-Consistent Preference Aligned CQR (MSPA-CQR). Specifically, we first construct self-consistent preference alignment data from three dimensions (rewriting, retrieval, and response) to generate more diverse rewritten queries. Then we propose prefix guided multi-faceted direct preference optimization to learn preference information from three different dimensions. The experimental results show that our MSPA-CQR is effective in both in- and out-of-distribution scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 对话式查询重写（CQR）旨在将模糊的查询重新编写，以实现更高效的对话式搜索。早期的研究主要集中在单独的查询重写上，而忽略了查询重写、段落检索和响应生成过程中的反馈。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了多维度自洽偏好对齐对话式查询重写方法（MSPA-CQR）。具体来说，我们首先从三个维度（重写、检索和响应）构建自洽偏好对齐数据，以生成更多样化的重写查询。然后，我们提出基于前缀引导的多维度直接偏好优化方法，从三个不同维度中学习偏好信息。实验结果表明，我们的MSPA-CQR在分布内和分布外的情况下都表现出有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CogNet-KG: Empowering Tutoring Dialogues with a Cognitively-Structured Knowledge Graph for STEM Learning
papers.title_zh: CogNet-KG：通过认知结构化知识图谱推动辅导对话的发展，助力STEM领域的学习
papers.authors: Ding Yu, Yu Lu, Tengju Li, Shasha Xiong, Shengquan Yu
papers.abstract: Educational knowledge graph (EKG) is a critical component of intelligent tutoring systems that is structured around cognitive principles and provides support for interactive teaching. Most existing EKGs usually rely on simplistic relations, bind with single subjects, and lack integration with explicit learning objectives. In this paper, we introduce CogNet-KG, a novel and cognitively-structured large-scale knowledge graph for STEM learning. CogNet-KG models nearly 500 core concepts across five subjects with various cognitively-grounded relations corresponding to specific learning objectives, thereby encoding a rich cognitive schema for guiding more effective teaching. Based on this structure, we then construct a high-quality tutoring dialogue dataset CogDialogue-QA by leveraging adaptive instructional strategies. Additionally, we train CogTutor-LM, a specialized tutorial LLM that internalizes this structured pedagogical reasoning. Overall evaluation demonstrates that CogTutor-LM generates responses with significantly greater instructional coherence and more appropriate pedagogical guidance compared to baselines, validating the effectiveness of our graph-driven approach to fostering knowledge integration and stimulating students’ thinking. The datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/KCAIED/CogNet-KG.
papers.abstract_zh: 教育知识图谱（EKG）是智能辅导系统中的一个关键组成部分，它基于认知原理构建，为互动教学提供支持。目前大多数现有的EKG都依赖于简单的关系结构，仅涉及单一主题，且缺乏与明确学习目标的整合。在本文中，我们介绍了CogNet-KG——一种新颖的、具有认知结构的大规模知识图谱，适用于STEM领域的学习。CogNet-KG涵盖了五个主题中的近500个核心概念，这些概念之间存在着各种基于认知的关系，与特定的学习目标相对应。通过这种方式，CogNet-KG能够编码出丰富的认知框架，从而指导更有效的教学。在此基础上，我们通过采用自适应教学策略，构建了一个高质量的教学对话数据集CogDialogue-QA。此外，我们还训练了一款专门的教程语言模型CogTutor-LM，使其能够内化这种结构化教学推理机制。整体评估表明，与基线模型相比，CogTutor-LM生成的回答在教学连贯性方面明显更高，教学指导也更恰当，这验证了我们的图驱动方法在促进知识整合和激发学生思考方面的有效性。这些数据集可以在https://github.com/KCAIED/CogNet-KG上获取。

papers.title: From 128K to 4M: Efficient Training of Ultra-Long Context Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从 128K 到 4M：超长上下文大语言模型的高效训练
papers.authors: Chejian Xu, Wei Ping, Peng Xu, Zihan Liu, Boxin Wang, Mohammad Shoeybi, Bo Li, Bryan Catanzaro
papers.abstract: Long-context capabilities are essential for a wide range of applications, including document and video understanding, in-context learning, and inference-time scaling, all of which require models to process and reason over long sequences of text and multimodal data. In this work, we introduce an efficient training recipe for building ultra-long context LLMs from aligned instruct model, pushing the boundaries of context lengths from 128K to 1M, 2M, and 4M tokens. Our approach leverages continued pretraining strategies to extend the context window, while employing efficient instruction tuning to maintain short context capabilities. Our UltraLong-8B, built on Llama-3.1-Instruct, achieves state-of-the-art performance across a diverse set of long-context benchmarks. Importantly, UltraLong-8B also maintains competitive performance on standard benchmarks, showing balanced improvements for both long and short context tasks. We provide an in-depth analysis of key design choices, highlighting the impacts of scaling strategies and data composition. Our findings establish a robust framework for efficiently scaling context lengths while preserving general model capabilities. We released all model weights for open research.
papers.abstract_zh: 长上下文能力对于多种应用来说至关重要，包括文档和视频理解、上下文学习以及推理时间扩展等。所有这些应用都需要模型能够处理并推理长序列的文本和多模态数据。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种高效的训练方法，用于构建超长上下文的大语言模型。通过该方法，我们可以将上下文长度从128K扩展到1M、2M和4M个令牌。我们的方法利用持续的预训练策略来扩展上下文窗口，同时采用高效的指令调整技术来维持短上下文能力。基于Llama-3.1-Instruct构建的超长8B模型在一系列长上下文基准测试中取得了顶尖性能。重要的是，超长8B模型在标准基准测试中也保持了竞争力，显示出在长上下文和短上下文任务上的平衡性改进。我们对关键设计选择进行了深入分析，强调了扩展策略和数据组成的影响。我们的研究发现为高效扩展上下文长度同时保持模型通用能力提供了一个稳健的框架。我们已经公开了所有模型权重，供大家研究使用。

papers.title: A Few Bad Apples Spoil the Bunch: Preventing Global Entropy Collapse Driven by a Small Set of Tokens in LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 几个坏苹果会破坏整个群体：在LLM推理中防止由少数几个代币引发的全球熵崩溃
papers.authors: Jaeeun Jang, Hansle Lee, Sangmin Kim
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback (RLIF) often fail to benefit from test-time compute due to entropy collapse and the resulting loss of reasoning diversity. We show that this collapse is driven not by uniform entropy decay, but by premature overconfidence at a small number of structurally critical decision points. Based on a token-level analysis of GRPO-style policy optimization, we propose SCOPE (Structural Collapse-aware Optimization via Partial Entropy control), which assigns each generated token a redistribution score and applies selective KL regularization to only the top \sim 5% of tokens under this score. Across model scales and architectures on math reasoning benchmarks, SCOPE consistently improves performance under both RLVR and RLIF settings, demonstrating that targeted entropy control at a vanishingly small subset of tokens is sufficient to sustain reasoning diversity and effective test-time scaling.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）以及基于内部反馈的强化学习（RLIF），往往因熵的崩溃以及推理多样性的丧失而无法充分利用测试阶段的计算资源。我们发现，这种崩溃并非由均匀的熵衰减所导致，而是由于在少数结构上的关键决策点上出现了过早的过度自信。基于对GRPO风格策略优化的令牌级分析，我们提出了SCOPE算法——一种具有结构崩溃意识的优化方法。该算法为每个生成的令牌分配一个重新分配分数，并只对得分最高的约5%的令牌应用选择性KL正则化。在多种模型规模和数学推理基准测试中，SCOPE算法在RLVR和RLIF两种情况下都能稳定提升性能，这表明仅对极少数令牌进行有针对性的熵控制就足以维持推理多样性以及有效的测试阶段扩展能力。

papers.title: Efficient Training for Cross-lingual Speech Language Models
papers.title_zh: 针对跨语言语音语言模型的高效训练方法
papers.authors: Yan Zhou, Qingkai Fang, Yun Hong, Yang Feng
papers.abstract: Currently, large language models (LLMs) predominantly focus on the text modality. To enable more natural human-AI interaction, speech LLMs are emerging, but building effective end-to-end speech LLMs remains challenging due to limited data and the difficulty in expanding to more languages. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{C}ross-lingual \textbf{S}peech \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{M}odel (\textbf{CSLM}), an efficient training method for cross-lingual speech LLMs based on discrete speech tokens. We propose a novel alignment strategy that achieves cross-modal and cross-lingual alignment through continual pre-training. By conducting instruction fine-tuning following a speech-text interleaved chain-of-modality generation process, we enhance modal alignment at a finer granularity, thereby improving generation quality and reducing latency. CSLM aligns different modalities and languages simultaneously without the need for massive speech data, thus exhibiting good language scalability. Evaluations on cross-modal tasks, mono-lingual conversational tasks, and cross-lingual conversational tasks demonstrate CSLM’s strong cross-modal alignment capabilities and general task abilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，大语言模型主要专注于文本领域。为了实现更自然的人机交互，语音语言模型正在兴起，但由于数据有限以及难以扩展到更多语言，构建有效的端到端语音语言模型仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了跨语言语音语言模型（CSLM），这是一种基于离散语音令牌的跨语言语音语言模型的高效训练方法。我们提出了一种新颖的对齐策略，通过持续预训练来实现跨模态和跨语言的对齐。通过按照语音-文本交织的生成流程进行指令微调，我们可以在更细的粒度上增强模态对齐，从而提高生成质量并降低延迟。CSLM能够同时对齐不同模态和语言，而无需大量语音数据，因此具有良好的语言可扩展性。在跨模态任务、单语言对话任务和跨语言对话任务上的评估表明，CSLM具备强大的跨模态对齐能力和通用任务处理能力。

papers.title: Empirical Analysis of Task Mixture Effects in Small-scale Instruction Tuning: A Statistical Approach
papers.title_zh: 小规模教学调整中任务混合效应的经验分析：一种统计方法
papers.authors: Jeesu Jung, Sangkeun Jung
papers.abstract: The performance of large language models heavily depends on instruction tuning, especially on task types and mixture ratios. However, previous research has primarily focused on mixing tasks at fixed ratios, lacking a systematic and quantitative analysis of task-wise interactions across diverse tasks. Moreover, it has relied heavily on human labeling. To address these limitations, this study conducts empirical experiments on unlabeled instruction corpora, varying both the number and proportion of task combinations to identify effective mixtures. To minimize manual labeling, we automatically extract five representative tasks—programming, math problem solving, history question answering, grammar correction, and creative writing—using only a few seed instructions. Across 51 mixtures, we find that 1–2 task mixtures work best with small datasets, while synergistic 3-task mixtures excel with larger data. Task interactions reveal both synergy (e.g., programming + math) and interference (e.g., programming + creative writing). These results provide practical guidelines for mixture design tailored to model scale and data size.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的性能在很大程度上取决于指令调整，尤其是在任务类型和混合比例方面。然而，以往的研究主要关注的是以固定比例进行任务混合，缺乏对不同任务之间交互作用的系统性和定量分析。此外，这些研究严重依赖人工标注。为了克服这些局限性，本研究在未经标注的指令语料库上进行实证实验，通过改变任务组合的数量和比例来寻找有效的混合方案。为了减少人工标注的工作量，我们仅使用少量初始指令，就能自动提取出五个具有代表性的任务：编程、数学问题解答、历史问题回答、语法纠错和创意写作。在51种不同的任务混合方案中，我们发现，对于小型数据集来说，1-2个任务的混合方案效果最佳；而对于较大的数据集而言，包含3个任务的协同混合方案则更为有效。任务之间的交互作用既体现了协同效应（例如，编程与数学的结合），也出现了干扰现象（例如，编程与创意写作的结合）。这些结果为我们提供了针对模型规模和数据大小量身定制的混合设计实用指南。

papers.title: ResearchBench: Benchmarking LLMs in Scientific Discovery via Inspiration-Based Task Decomposition
papers.title_zh: ResearchBench：通过基于灵感的任务分解来对比大型语言模型在科学发现中的应用效果
papers.authors: Yujie Liu, Zonglin Yang, Tong Xie, Jinjie Ni, Ben Gao, Yuqiang Li, Shixiang Tang, Wanli Ouyang, Erik Cambria, Dongzhan Zhou
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown potential in assisting scientific research, yet their ability to discover high-quality research hypotheses remains unexamined due to the lack of a dedicated benchmark. To address this gap, we introduce the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating LLMs on a sufficient set of scientific discovery sub-tasks—inspiration retrieval, hypothesis composition, and hypothesis ranking—where sufficient means that perfectly solving these sub-tasks perfectly solves the overall discovery task. We develop an automated LLM-based framework that extracts critical components—research questions, background surveys, inspirations, and hypotheses—from papers across 12 disciplines, with expert validation confirming its accuracy. To prevent data contamination, we focus exclusively on publications from 2024 onward, ensuring minimal overlap with LLM pretraining data; our automated framework further enables automatic extraction of even more recent papers as LLM pretraining cutoffs advance, supporting scalable and contamination-free automatic renewal of this discovery benchmark. Our evaluation shows that, across disciplines, LLMs excel at inspiration retrieval—an out-of-distribution task—suggesting their ability to surface novel knowledge associations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在辅助科学研究方面展现出巨大潜力，但由于缺乏专门的基准测试，其发现高质量研究假设的能力尚未得到充分验证。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了首个大规模基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在一系列科学发现子任务上的表现——包括灵感检索、假设构建和假设排序等子任务。所谓“充分性”指的是，完美解决这些子任务实际上就等同于完成了整个发现任务。我们开发了一个基于自动化的框架，能够从12个学科领域的论文中提取关键要素，如研究问题、背景调查、灵感来源和假设等。经过专家验证，该框架的准确率非常高。为了防止数据污染，我们只关注2024年及以后的出版物，从而确保与大语言模型的预训练数据之间几乎没有重叠。此外，随着大语言模型预训练数据的不断更新，我们的自动化框架还能自动提取更近期的论文，从而实现可扩展且无污染的自动更新这一发现基准测试。我们的评估结果显示，无论是在哪个学科领域，大语言模型在灵感检索方面都表现出色，这表明它们能够发现新的知识关联。
