papers.title: GraphLoRA: Structure-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Model Recommendation
papers.title_zh: GraphLoRA：一种基于结构感知的低秩自适应方法，用于大型语言模型推荐
papers.authors: Lin Mu, Guoji Wang, Li Ni, Lei Sang, Zhize Wu, Peiquan Jin, Yiwen Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for recommendation (LLMRec) due to their powerful reasoning and generalization abilities. However, effectively aligning the textual semantics modeled by LLMs with the collaborative signals remains a key challenge. Existing methods either translate collaborative information into textual prompts or inject pre-trained embeddings into the LLM, both of which treat structural information as static input and fail to capture high-order relational dependencies.To bridge this gap, we propose GraphLoRA, a novel framework that generalizes low-rank adaptation from independent to structure-aware propagation. GraphLoRA embeds a trainable graph message-passing network within the low-rank adaptation pathway, enabling structural signals to propagate through the parameter space.This design allows collaborative topology to explicitly guide parameter updates, fostering deep integration between graph-structured and textual semantic information. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that GraphLoRA not only outperforms state-of-the-art LLM-based recommendation methods but also achieves superior generalization, effectively balancing structural reasoning capability with computational efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在推荐领域展现出强大的潜力，因为它们具备强大的推理能力和泛化能力。然而，将语言模型所建模的文本语义与协作信号有效对齐仍然是一个关键挑战。现有的方法要么将协作信息转化为文本提示，要么将预训练的嵌入注入到语言模型中，这两种方法都将结构信息视为静态输入，无法捕捉到高级的关联关系。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了GraphLoRA这一创新框架，它可以将低秩适应从独立传播方式转变为具有结构意识的传播方式。GraphLoRA在低秩适应路径中嵌入了一个可训练的图消息传递网络，使得结构信号能够通过参数空间进行传播。这种设计使得协作拓扑能够明确地指导参数更新，从而实现了图结构信息与文本语义信息的深度融合。在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，GraphLoRA不仅优于现有的基于语言模型的推荐方法，而且还能实现更好的泛化能力，有效平衡了结构推理能力与计算效率。

papers.title: Spotlight and Shadow: Attention-Guided Dual-Anchor Introspective Decoding for MLLM Hallucination Mitigation
papers.title_zh: 焦点与阴影：基于注意力引导的双锚点内省式解码方法，用于减轻大型语言模型产生的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Yebo Wu, Han Jin, Zhijiang Guo, Li Li
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities yet continue to suffer from hallucination, where generated text contradicts visual content. In this paper, we introduce Dual-Anchor Introspective Decoding (DaID), a novel contrastive decoding framework that dynamically calibrates each token generation by mining the model’s internal perceptual discrepancies. Specifically, DaID identifies a Spotlight layer to amplify visual factual signals and a Shadow layer to suppress textual inertia. By leveraging visual attention distributions to guide this dual-anchor selection process, our method ensures precise, token-specific adaptation. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks and MLLMs demonstrate that DaID significantly mitigates hallucination while enhancing general reasoning capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型已经展现出出色的推理能力，但仍然存在幻觉问题，即生成的文本与视觉内容相矛盾。在本文中，我们提出了双锚点内省解码方法（DaID），这是一种新颖的对比式解码框架，它能够通过挖掘模型的内部感知差异来动态调整每个令牌的生成方式。具体来说，DaID包含一个聚光层，用于增强视觉事实信号；以及一个阴影层，用于抑制文本中的惯性效应。通过利用视觉注意力分布来指导这一双锚点选择过程，我们的方法能够实现精确、针对特定令牌的适配。在多个基准测试和多模态大语言模型上的实验结果表明，DaID能够有效减少幻觉现象，同时提升整体推理能力。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: StreamMeCo: Long-Term Agent Memory Compression for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
papers.title_zh: StreamMeCo：用于高效流式视频理解的长期代理内存压缩技术
papers.authors: Junxi Wang, Te Sun, Jiayi Zhu, Junxian Li, Haowen Xu, Zichen Wen, Xuming Hu, Zhiyu li, Linfeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Vision agent memory has shown remarkable effectiveness in long-video understanding; however, storing such memory for videos incurs substantial overhead, leading to high costs in both storage and computation. To address this issue, we propose StreamMeCo, an efficient Stream Agent Memory Compression framework. Specifically, based on the connectivity of the memory graph, StreamMeCo introduces edge-free minmax sampling for isolated nodes and edge-aware weight pruning for connected nodes, evicting redundant memory nodes while maintaining accuracy. In addition, we introduce a time-decay memory retrieval mechanism to mitigate the performance degradation caused by memory compression. Extensive experiments on three challenging benchmark datasets (M3-Bench-robot, M3-Bench-web, and Video-MME-Long) demonstrate that under 70% memory graph compression, StreamMeCo achieves a 1.87× speedup in memory retrieval while delivering an average accuracy improvement of 1.0%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/StreamMeCo.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉代理内存在长视频理解中表现出显著的效果；然而，存储这样的内存会带来巨大的开销，导致存储和计算成本都很高。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了StreamMeCo这一高效的流代理内存压缩框架。具体来说，基于内存图的连通性特性，StreamMeCo采用了无边采样方法来处理孤立节点，并对连接节点进行了权重剪枝操作，从而消除冗余的内存节点，同时保持良好的准确性。此外，我们还引入了时间衰减的内存检索机制，以缓解内存压缩带来的性能下降问题。在三个具有挑战性的基准数据集（M3-Bench-robot、M3-Bench-web和Video-MME-Long）上的广泛实验表明，在70%的内存图压缩率下，StreamMeCo在内存检索速度上实现了1.87倍的提升，同时平均准确率提高了1.0%。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/StreamMeCo下载。

papers.title: Reflective RAG: Self-Evaluation Driven Strategy Optimization in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 反思性RAG：在基于代理的检索增强生成中实现自我评估驱动的策略优化
papers.authors: Haiyan Wu, Chenchen Wang, Chaoqun Sun, Chengxiong Lu, Yan-Hong Chen, Zhiqiang Zhang, Xiaoqing Feng
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a widely adopted paradigm for grounding Large Language Models (LLMs) in external knowledge. Recent agentic RAG systems introduce multi-turn reasoning, but they often lack the capacity to evaluate the utility of retrieved information, leading to brittle reasoning and suboptimal decision-making. We propose Reflective RAG, an agentic framework that incorporates self-evaluation to dynamically optimize retrieval and generation strategy. At its core, Reflective RAG employs a reflection tagging mechanism that allows the model to critique the relevance of retrieved content, thereby explicitly guiding its subsequent policy. To ensure robust learning, we introduce a two-stage training procedure that partially decouples evaluation semantics from strategy optimization. First, during supervised fine-tuning (SFT), the model learns to generate accurate reflection signals by self-correcting labels based on internal uncertainty. Second, a reinforcement learning (RL) stage optimizes the agent’s strategy using these reflections, stabilized by dynamic KL regularization. Evaluations across five knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks demonstrate that Reflective RAG consistently outperforms strong agentic baselines. Further analysis demonstrates its improved training stability and stronger generalization to complex multi-hop reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为将大语言模型（LLM）与外部知识联系起来的常用方法。最近的智能型RAG系统引入了多轮推理机制，但它们往往缺乏评估检索到的信息有用性的能力，从而导致推理过程不稳定，决策效果也不理想。我们提出了反射式RAG框架，该框架采用自我评估机制来动态优化检索和生成策略。其核心是采用反射标记机制，使模型能够批判性地评估检索内容的相关性，从而明确指导后续的生成行为。为了确保学习的稳定性，我们采用了两阶段训练流程，将评估语义与策略优化部分分离。首先，在监督微调过程中，模型通过基于内部不确定性的自我修正标签来学习生成准确的反射信号。其次，强化学习阶段利用这些反射信号来优化智能体的策略，同时通过动态KL正则化技术来稳定这一过程。在五个需要大量知识的问答基准测试中的表现表明，反射式RAG始终优于其他强大的智能型基线方法。进一步分析显示，该方法在训练稳定性方面有所提升，并且在处理复杂的多跳推理任务时具有更强的泛化能力。

papers.title: Meta-Reasoner: Dynamic Guidance for Optimized Inference-time Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 元推理器：为大型语言模型中的优化推理提供动态指导
papers.authors: Yuan Sui, Yufei He, Tri Cao, Sophia Simeng Han, Yulin Chen, Bryan Hooi
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with computational efficiency and error propagation in multi-step reasoning tasks. While recent advancements on prompting and post-training have enabled LLMs to perform step-wise reasoning, they still tend to explore unproductive solution paths without effective backtracking or strategy adjustment. In this paper, we propose Meta-Reasoner, a new framework that empowers LLMs to “think about how to think”. It optimizes the inference process by dynamically adapting reasoning strategies in real-time. Our approach employs contextual multi-armed bandits (CMABs) to learn an adaptive policy. It learns to evaluate the current state of LLM’s reasoning and determine optimal strategy that is most likely to lead to a successful outcome during inference, like whether to backtrack, switch to a new approach, or restart the problem-solving process. This meta-guidance helps avoid unproductive paths exploration during inference and hence improves computational efficiency. We evaluate Meta-Reasoner on math problems (e.g., Game-of-24, TheoremQA) and scientific tasks (e.g., SciBench). Results show that our method outperform previous SOTA methods by 9-12% in accuracy, while reducing inference time by 28-35% under the same compute budget. Additional experiments on creative writing demonstrate the generalizability of our approach to diverse reasoning-intensive tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多步骤推理任务中常常面临计算效率低下和错误传播的问题。尽管最近在提示技术和后训练方面的进展使得语言模型能够执行逐步推理，但它们仍然倾向于探索无益的解决方案路径，而缺乏有效的回溯或策略调整。在本文中，我们提出了Meta-Reasoner这一新框架，它使语言模型能够“思考如何思考”。该框架通过实时动态调整推理策略来优化推理过程。我们的方法采用上下文多臂老虎机模型来学习自适应策略。它能够评估语言模型当前推理状态，并确定最有可能导致成功结果的策略，例如是否进行回溯、转换到新的方法或重新开始问题解决过程。这种元指导有助于避免在推理过程中探索无益的路径，从而提高计算效率。我们在数学问题（如Game-of-24、TheoremQA）和科学任务（如SciBench）上对Meta-Reasoner进行了测试。结果表明，与现有的最佳方法相比，我们的方法在准确率方面高出9-12%，同时在同等的计算资源下，推理时间减少了28-35%。在创意写作方面的额外实验表明，我们的方法适用于多种需要推理的任务。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Polynomial Expansion Rank Adaptation: Enhancing Low-Rank Fine-Tuning with High-Order Interactions
papers.title_zh: 多项式展开秩适应：通过高阶相互作用提升低秩微调效果
papers.authors: Wenhao Zhang, Lin Mu, Li Ni, Peiquan Jin, Yiwen Zhang
papers.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used strategy for efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), but its strictly linear structure fundamentally limits expressive capacity. The bilinear formulation of weight updates captures only first-order dependencies between low-rank factors, restricting the modeling of nonlinear and higher-order parameter interactions.In this paper, we propose Polynomial Expansion Rank Adaptation (PERA), a novel method that introduces structured polynomial expansion directly into the low-rank factor space.By expanding each low-rank factor to synthesize high-order interaction terms before composition, PERA transforms the adaptation space into a polynomial manifold capable of modeling richer nonlinear coupling without increasing rank or inference cost.We provide theoretical analysis demonstrating that PERA offers enhanced expressive capacity and more effective feature utilization compare to existing linear adaptation approaches.Empirically, PERA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse benchmarks. Notably, our experiments show that incorporating high-order nonlinear components—particularly square terms—is crucial for enhancing expressive capacity and maintaining strong and robust performance under various rank settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）是一种广泛应用于大语言模型高效微调的策略，但其严格的线性结构从根本上限制了模型的表达能力。传统的权重更新方法只能捕捉低秩因子之间的一阶依赖关系，这限制了对于非线性及高阶参数交互的建模能力。在本文中，我们提出了多项式展开秩适应（PERA）这一新方法。该方法通过将多项式展开直接引入低秩因子空间，从而在组合之前将每个低秩因子扩展为高阶交互项。这样，PERA能够将适应空间转化为一个多项式流形，从而在不增加模型秩或推理成本的情况下，实现更丰富的非线性耦合建模。我们的理论分析表明，与现有的线性适应方法相比，PERA在表达能力上有所提升，并且能更有效地利用特征信息。实验结果表明，PERA在各种基准测试中的表现均优于现有最先进的方法。值得注意的是，我们的实验表明，引入高阶非线性成分——尤其是平方项——对于提升表达能力和在不同秩设置下保持强大的性能至关重要。

papers.title: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Temporal Reasoning Aggregation
papers.title_zh: 通过时间推理聚合实现高效的测试时间缩放
papers.authors: Jiakun Li, Xingwei He, Kefan Li, Hongzheng Chai, Hongyue Yu, Yuan Yuan
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling improves the reasoning performance of large language models but often results in token-inefficient overthinking, where models continue reasoning beyond what is necessary for a correct answer. Existing dynamic early-exit methods typically rely on single-step confidence signals, which are often unreliable for detecting reasoning convergence in multi-step settings. To mitigate this limitation, we propose TRACE, a training-free framework for efficient test-time scaling that determines when to terminate reasoning based on temporal aggregation of multi-step evidence rather than instantaneous signals. TRACE detects reasoning convergence over time by aggregating two complementary signals across recent reasoning steps: answer consistency, capturing the persistence of predicted answers, and confidence trajectory, modeling the temporal evolution of model confidence. Benefiting from these two factors, TRACE can accurately determine whether the reasoning process has converged, thereby promptly halting inference and effectively avoiding redundant reasoning steps. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging benchmarks show that TRACE reduces reasoning token usage by 25–30% on average while maintaining accuracy within 1–2% of full-length reasoning, consistently outperforming existing dynamic reasoning methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时缩放能够提升大语言模型的推理性能，但往往会导致不必要的过度推理，即模型在超出正确答案所需范围的情况下继续进行推理。现有的动态提前终止方法通常依赖于单步置信度信号，而这些信号在多步推理场景中往往无法可靠地检测推理的收敛情况。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了TRACE框架——一个无需训练的框架，它能够基于多步推理证据的时间聚合来判断何时终止推理，而不是依赖瞬时信号。TRACE通过整合两个互补的信号来检测推理的收敛情况：答案一致性，用于捕捉预测答案的持久性；以及置信度轨迹，用于模拟模型置信度的时间演变。得益于这两个因素，TRACE能够准确判断推理过程是否已经收敛，从而及时停止推理，有效避免冗余的推理步骤。在多个具有挑战性的基准测试上的广泛实验表明，TRACE平均能够将推理的令牌使用量减少25-30%，同时保持准确率在完整推理的1-2%范围内，其性能始终优于现有的动态推理方法。

papers.title: A Survey on MLLM-based Visually Rich Document Understanding: Methods, Challenges, and Emerging Trends
papers.title_zh: 基于MLLM的视觉丰富型文档理解研究：方法、挑战与新兴趋势
papers.authors: Yihao Ding, Siwen Luo, Yue Dai, Yanbei Jiang, Zechuan Li, Qiang Sun, Geoffrey Martin, Wei Liu, Yifan Peng
papers.abstract: Visually Rich Document Understanding (VRDU) has become a pivotal area of research, driven by the need to automatically interpret documents that contain intricate visual, textual, and structural elements. Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant promise in this domain, including both OCR-based and OCR-free approaches for information extraction from document images. This survey reviews recent advances in MLLM-based VRDU, highlighting emerging trends and promising research directions with a focus on two key aspects: (1) techniques for representing and integrating textual, visual, and layout features; (2) training paradigms, including pretraining, instruction tuning, and training strategies. Moreover, we address challenges such as data scarcity, handling multi-page and multilingual documents, and integrating emerging trends such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation and agentic frameworks. Our analysis offers a roadmap for advancing MLLM-based VRDU toward more scalable, reliable, and adaptable systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉丰富的文档理解已成为一个重要的研究领域，这一领域的发展源于对包含复杂视觉、文本和结构元素的文档进行自动解析的需求。最近，多模态大语言模型在这一领域展现出了巨大的潜力，包括基于OCR的方法以及无需OCR的方法，用于从文档图像中提取信息。本综述回顾了基于MLLMs的视觉丰富文档理解领域的最新进展，重点介绍了两个关键方向：(1) 用于表示和整合文本、视觉和布局特征的技术；(2) 训练范式，包括预训练、指令调整以及训练策略。此外，我们还探讨了数据稀缺、处理多页和多语言文档等问题，以及整合新兴技术如检索增强生成和智能体框架等挑战。我们的分析为推进基于MLLMs的视觉丰富文档理解技术向更可扩展、更可靠且更具适应性的系统发展提供了路线图。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Detecting Sensitive Personal Information in Japanese Pre-Training Corpora for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在用于大型语言模型的中文预训练语料库中检测敏感个人信息
papers.authors: Rei Minamoto, Yusuke Oda, Daisuke Kawahara
papers.abstract: Sensitive personal information can appear in large-scale pre-training corpora for large language models (LLMs). Detecting and filtering such information is therefore essential to ensure compliance with privacy regulations and prevent unintended information leakage. However, in contrast to English and other languages, research into sensitive personal information has been limited in the Japanese language. In this study, we focus on sensitive personal data defined as special care-required personal information (SCPI) under Japan’s Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI). We construct an SCPI dataset using LLM-based annotation and train machine learning models to rapidly detect SCPI in text. As a result, our SCPI classifier can effectively identify information related to SCPI. This study is the first to explore SCPI detection in Japanese text corpora, highlighting the challenges of accurate detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 敏感的个人信息可能会出现在大规模的语言模型预训练语料库中。因此，检测和过滤这些信息对于遵守隐私法规以及防止意外信息泄露至关重要。然而，与英语和其他语言相比，关于日语中敏感个人信息的研究相对较少。在本研究中，我们重点关注根据日本《个人信息保护法》定义的需要特别保护的个人信息。我们通过基于语言模型的标注方法构建了一个此类数据集，并训练机器学习模型来快速检测文本中的敏感个人信息。结果表明，我们的分类器能够有效识别与敏感个人信息相关的信息。这是首次在日语文本语料库中进行敏感个人信息检测的研究，也揭示了准确检测的挑战性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Agentic Episodic Control
papers.title_zh: 主动的情节控制
papers.authors: Xidong Yang, Wenhao Li, Junjie Sheng, Yun Hua, Haosheng Chen, Chuyun Shen, Xiangfeng Wang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) remains fundamentally limited by poor data efficiency and weak generalization. Prior episodic RL methods attempt to alleviate this via external memory modules, yet they suffer from two key limitations: a representation bottleneck caused by shallow encoders, and a retrieval dilemma where episodic memory is accessed indiscriminately.To address these challenges, we propose Agentic Episodic Control (AEC), a novel architecture that integrates large language models (LLMs) into episodic RL.AEC uses an LLM-based semantic augmenter to generate semantic representations from raw observations, and a critical state recognizer to selectively retrieve valuable experiences.This transforms memory usage from passive similarity matching into strategic, context-aware recall.Across five BabyAI-Text environments, AEC achieves 2–6× higher data efficiency than baselines and is the only method to solve complex tasks like UnlockLocal with over 90% success.It further demonstrates strong cross-task and cross-environment generalization, maintaining performance even under distribution shifts.AEC shows that combining LLM-derived priors with reinforcement learning yields more sample-efficient and adaptable agents. Code is available at https://github.com/Xidong-Yang/Agentic_Episodic_Control.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）在数据效率和泛化能力方面仍然存在显著不足。传统的情景式RL方法试图通过外部记忆模块来缓解这些问题，但它们存在两个主要缺陷：一是由于编码器过于浅层而导致的表示瓶颈问题；二是情景记忆的检索方式缺乏选择性，导致信息被无差别地调用。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了“代理式情景控制”架构（AEC），该架构将大语言模型（LLM）整合到情景式RL中。AEC利用基于LLM的语义增强器从原始观测数据中生成语义表示，同时采用关键状态识别器来选择性地提取有价值的经验。这样，内存的使用就从被动的相似性匹配转变为具有策略性和情境感知的检索方式。在五个BabyAI-Text环境中进行测试时，AEC的数据使用效率比基线方法高出2到6倍，并且是唯一能够成功解决如UnlockLocal这类复杂任务的方法，其成功率超过90%。此外，AEC还表现出强大的跨任务和跨环境泛化能力，即使在分布偏移的情况下也能保持性能稳定。AEC表明，将基于LLM的先验知识与强化学习相结合，可以创造出更高效、更灵活的智能体。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/Xidong-Yang/Agentic_Episodic_Control

papers.title: TrajGuard: Streaming Hidden-state Trajectory Detection for Decoding-time Jailbreak Defense
papers.title_zh: TrajGuard：流式处理隐藏状态轨迹检测，用于破解防御机制
papers.authors: Cheng Liu, Xiaolei Liu, Xingyu Li, Bangzhou Xin, Kangyi Ding
papers.abstract: Existing jailbreak defense paradigms primarily rely on static detection of prompts, outputs, or internal states, often neglecting the dynamic evolution of risk during decoding. This oversight leaves risk signals embedded in decoding trajectories underutilized, constituting a critical blind spot in current defense systems. In this work, we empirically demonstrate that hidden states in critical layers during the decoding phase carry stronger and more stable risk signals than input jailbreak prompts. Specifically, the hidden representations of tokens generated during jailbreak attempts progressively approach high-risk regions in the latent space. Based on this observation, we propose TrajGuard, a training-free, decoding-time defense framework. TrajGuard aggregates hidden-state trajectories via a sliding window to quantify risk in real time, triggering a lightweight semantic adjudication only when risk within a local window persistently exceeds a threshold. This mechanism enables the immediate interruption or constraint of subsequent decoding. Extensive experiments across 12 jailbreak attacks and various open-source LLMs show that TrajGuard achieves an average defense rate of 95%. Furthermore, it reduces detection latency to 5.2 ms/token while maintaining a false positive rate below 1.5%. These results confirm that hidden-state trajectories during decoding can effectively support real-time jailbreak detection, highlighting a promising direction for defenses without model modification.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的越狱防御范式主要依赖于对提示、输出或内部状态的静态检测，往往忽视了在解码过程中风险的动态变化。这种忽视导致风险信号在解码过程中被低估了，这成为当前防御系统中的一个关键盲点。在这项研究中，我们通过实证证明，在解码阶段，关键层中的隐藏状态所携带的风险信号比输入中的越狱提示更为强烈且稳定。具体来说，越狱尝试过程中产生的隐藏表示会逐渐逼近潜在空间中的高风险区域。基于这一发现，我们提出了TrajGuard——一种无需训练的、仅在解码时生效的防御框架。TrajGuard通过滑动窗口来汇总隐藏状态轨迹，从而实时量化风险；只有当局部窗口内的风险持续超过某个阈值时，才会触发轻量级的语义判断。这种机制能够立即中断或限制后续的解码过程。在12种不同越狱攻击和多种开源大语言模型上的广泛实验表明，TrajGuard的平均防御率为95%。此外，它还将检测延迟降低到5.2毫秒/个令牌，同时假阳性率保持在1.5%以下。这些结果证实，在解码过程中利用隐藏状态轨迹可以有效支持实时越狱检测，为无需修改模型的防御策略提供了有力支持。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DeepPrune: Parallel Scaling without Inter-trace Redundancy
papers.title_zh: DeepPrune：无需处理冗余信息的并行扩展技术
papers.authors: Shangqing Tu, Yaxuan Li, Yushi Bai, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li
papers.abstract: Parallel scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm to enhance reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) by generating multiple Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces simultaneously. However, this approach introduces significant computational inefficiency due to inter-trace redundancy—our analysis reveals that over 80% of parallel reasoning traces yield identical final answers, representing substantial wasted computation. To address this critical efficiency bottleneck, we propose DeepPrune, a novel framework that enables efficient parallel scaling through dynamic pruning. Our method features a specialized judge model trained with oversampling techniques to accurately predict answer equivalence from partial reasoning traces, achieving 0.7072 AUROC on equivalence prediction across unseen reasoning models. This is combined with an online greedy clustering algorithm that dynamically prunes redundant paths while preserving answer diversity. Comprehensive evaluations across three challenging benchmarks (AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and GPQA) and multiple reasoning models demonstrate that DeepPrune achieves remarkable token reduction ranging from 65.73% to 88.50% compared to conventional consensus sampling, while maintaining competitive accuracy within 3.4 percentage points. Our work establishes a new standard for efficient parallel reasoning, making high-performance reasoning more efficient. Our code and data are here: https://github.com/THU-KEG/DeepPrune/
papers.abstract_zh: 并行扩展已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的强大方法，它通过同时生成多个思维链来提升模型的推理能力。然而，这种方法由于思维链之间的冗余性而导致了显著的计算效率低下——我们的分析显示，超过80%的并行推理结果都得出相同的答案，这造成了大量的计算资源浪费。为了解决这一效率瓶颈问题，我们提出了DeepPrune这一创新框架。该框架通过动态剪枝实现了高效的并行扩展。我们的方法采用了一种专门的判断模型，该模型通过过采样技术训练而成，能够准确判断部分推理结果是否相同。在多种未见过的推理模型中，我们的方法在等价性预测方面的准确率达到了0.7072 AUROC。此外，我们还采用了一种在线贪婪聚类算法，该算法能够动态剪除冗余路径，同时保留答案的多样性。在三个具有挑战性的基准测试（AIME 2024、AIME 2025和GPQA）以及多种推理模型上的综合评估表明，与传统的共识采样方法相比，DeepPrune能够实现高达65.73%到88.50%的令牌减少，同时保持了3.4个百分点以内的竞争力水平。我们的工作为高效并行推理树立了新的标准，使得高性能推理变得更加高效。我们的代码和数据可以在以下链接找到：https://github.com/THU-KEG/DeepPrune/

papers.title: Contrastive Decoding Mitigates Score Range Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.title_zh: 对比式解码能够减轻基于大语言模型作为裁判时的评分范围偏差问题
papers.authors: Yoshinari Fujinuma
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are commonly used as evaluators in various applications, but the reliability of the outcomes remains a challenge. One such challenge is using LLMs-as-judges for direct assessment, i.e., assigning scores from a specified range without any references. Using summarization as our primary testbed, we first show that this challenge stems from LLM judge outputs being associated with score range bias, i.e., LLM judge outputs are highly sensitive to pre-defined score ranges. We also show that similar biases exist among models from the same family. We then mitigate this bias through contrastive decoding, achieving up to 11.7% relative improvement in Spearman correlation with human judgments, averaged across score ranges.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常被用作各种应用中的评估工具，但结果的可靠性仍然是一个挑战。其中一个挑战就是使用LLM作为评判者进行直接评估，即在没有参考的情况下为任务分配分数。以摘要生成作为我们的主要测试平台，我们首先证明了这一挑战源于LLM的评判结果存在与评分范围相关的偏差，也就是说，LLM的评判结果对预定义的评分范围非常敏感。我们还发现，同一家族中的不同模型也存在类似的偏差。随后，我们通过对比解码技术来消除这种偏差，结果显示，与人类判断相比，Spearman相关性得到了高达11.7%的提升，这一提升在多个评分范围内都得到了验证。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ContextCheck: Sentence-Level Faithfulness Verification with Context-Aware Disambiguation
papers.title_zh: 上下文检查：基于上下文感知的歧义消除技术的句子级一致性验证
papers.authors: Yueqin Yin, Yaxi Li, Xin Liu, Xun Wang, Kaiqiang Song, Simin Ma, Shujian Liu, Sathish Reddy Indurthi, Haoyun Deng, Pengcheng He, Mingyuan Zhou, Song Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models often hallucinate, producing content that is factually incorrect or not grounded in the sources. Reliable faithfulness verification is critical for trustworthy deployment. In the provided-source (closed-world) setting, existing verifiers either classify whole passages in one step or check sentences independently, overlooking cross-sentence context. We present ContextCheck, a framework for sentence-level faithfulness verification with context-aware disambiguation. Each sentence is verified against the grounding document while conditioning on preceding sentences, enabling pronouns and references to be resolved directly in context. This design avoids the separate decontextualization step of rewriting claims into self-contained forms, casting verification as a context-conditioned task. Fine-tuned from Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, ContextCheck sets a new state of the art on three context-dependent datasets; it improves Macro F1 by over 10 points compared to the strongest baselines, and matches or slightly surpasses the strongest baselines on 14 standard single-sentence datasets compared to prior 8B-scale verifiers (average Macro F1 73.5 vs. 72.8). These results show that ContextCheck offers a practical and effective approach for sentence-level hallucination detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型常常产生幻觉，生成的内容往往与事实不符或缺乏依据。可靠的准确性验证对于实现可信的模型部署至关重要。在“源文件已知”的情况下，现有的验证方法要么一次性对整段文本进行验证，要么单独检查每个句子，而忽略了句子之间的上下文关系。我们提出了ContextCheck框架，该框架能够实现基于上下文的歧义消除，并在句子层面进行准确性验证。每句话都会根据之前的句子信息进行验证，从而可以直接在上下文中解决代词和引用问题。这种设计避免了将断言重新改写为独立形式这一繁琐的过程，而是将验证任务视为一种基于上下文的条件化任务。经过Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型的微调后，ContextCheck在三个依赖上下文的数据集上取得了领先的性能；与最强的基线模型相比，其Macro F1分数提高了超过10个百分点，并且在14个标准单句数据集上的表现与最先进的8B规模验证工具相当甚至略胜一筹（平均Macro F1分数分别为73.5和72.8）。这些结果表明，ContextCheck为句子层面的幻觉检测提供了一种实用且有效的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Less Noise, More Voice: Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning via Instruction Purification
papers.title_zh: 更少噪音，更多声音：通过指令净化实现推理的强化学习
papers.authors: Yiju Guo, Tianyi Hu, Zexu Sun, Yankai Lin
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has advanced LLM reasoning, but remains constrained by inefficient exploration under limited rollout budgets, leading to low sampling success and unstable training in complex tasks. We find that many exploration failures arise not from problem difficulty, but from a small number of prompt tokens that introduce interference. Building on this insight, we propose the Less Noise Sampling Framework (LENS), which first purifies prompts by identifying and removing interference tokens. then transfers successful rollouts from the purified setting to supervise policy optimization on the original noisy prompts, enabling the model to learn to ignore interference in the real-world, noisy prompting settings. Experimental results show that LENS significantly outperforms GRPO, delivering higher performance and faster convergence, with a 3.88% average gain and over 1.6 \times speedup. Our work highlights the critical role of pruning interference tokens in improving rollout efficiency, offering a new perspective for RLVR research.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）确实提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但其在有限的部署预算下仍存在探索效率低下的问题，导致采样成功率较低，且在复杂任务中的训练稳定性较差。我们发现，许多探索失败并非由于问题的难度，而是由于少量干扰性提示词造成的。基于这一发现，我们提出了“低噪声采样框架”（LENS）。该框架首先通过识别并移除干扰性提示词来净化提示词，然后将成功的实验结果应用到原始的带噪声提示词上，从而让模型学会在现实世界的嘈杂提示环境中忽略干扰。实验结果表明，LENS的表现明显优于GRPO，其性能提升幅度高达3.88%，速度也提高了1.6倍以上。我们的研究强调了修剪干扰性提示词在提高部署效率方面的关键作用，为RLVR的研究提供了新的视角。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MAST: A Multi-View Alignment Strategy for Optimal Transport-Based Contrastive Clustering of Short Text
papers.title_zh: MAST：一种多视图对齐策略，用于基于最优传输的短文本对比聚类算法
papers.authors: Zijian Zheng, Yonghe Lu
papers.abstract: Short text clustering has gained significant prominence due to its ubiquity in real-world applications. Despite the recent success of contrastive clustering, existing paradigms still suffer from two critical bottlenecks: (1) conventional data augmentation provides limited semantic granularity and may introduce unintended noise; and (2) the absence of global optimization for cluster assignments often precipitates the accumulation of pseudo-label noise, thereby compromising semantic consistency. To bridge these gaps, we propose MAST, a Multi-view Alignment Strategy with Transport-based clustering. MAST constructs complementary structural views to capture multi-granularity semantic features and introduces a multi-view contrastive objective that jointly aligns original, augmented, and structure-enhanced embeddings. To mitigate representation over-smoothing, we incorporate structure-aware negative reweighting and intermediate-layer negative sampling. Furthermore, MAST employs high-confidence guided refinement and an optimal transport-based pseudo-label alignment mechanism to enforce global semantic consistency across multiple views. Extensive experiments on several benchmark datasets demonstrate that MAST consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new competitive baseline for short text clustering.
papers.abstract_zh: 短文本聚类由于其在现实应用中的广泛应用而获得了显著的重视。尽管对比聚类在最近取得了成功，但现有的方法仍然存在两个关键瓶颈：(1) 传统的数据增强方式所提供的语义粒度有限，可能会引入不必要的噪声；(2) 缺乏全局优化机制来分配聚类标签，这会导致伪标签噪声的积累，从而影响语义的一致性。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了MAST算法——一种基于传输聚类的多视图对齐策略。MAST通过构建互补的结构化视图来捕捉多粒度语义特征，并引入多视图对比目标，以协同对齐原始数据、增强数据和结构优化后的嵌入数据。为了减轻表示过平滑的问题，我们采用了结构感知的负权重调整以及中间层的负采样技术。此外，MAST还采用了高置信度引导的细化机制，以及基于最优传输的伪标签对齐机制，以确保多个视图之间的全局语义一致性。在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，MAST在性能上始终优于现有最先进的方法，为短文本聚类领域树立了新的竞争标杆。

papers.title: AICA-Bench: Holistically Examining the Capabilities of VLMs in Affective Image Content Analysis
papers.title_zh: AICA-Bench：全面评估视觉语言模型在情感图像内容分析领域的能力
papers.authors: Dong She, Xianrong Yao, Liqun Chen, Jinghe Yu, Yang Gao, Zhanpeng Jin
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in perception, yet holistic Affective Image Content Analysis (AICA)—which integrates perception, reasoning, and generation into a unified framework—remains underexplored. To address this, we introduce AICA-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising three core tasks: Emotion Understanding (EU), Reasoning (ER), and Generation (EGCG). We evaluate 23 VLMs, revealing critical gaps: models struggle with intensity calibration and suffer from descriptive shallowness in open-ended tasks. To bridge these gaps, we propose Grounded Affective Tree (GAT) Prompting, a training-free framework that integrates visual scaffolding with hierarchical reasoning. Experiments show that GAT effectively corrects intensity errors and significantly enhances descriptive depth, establishing a robust baseline for future affective multimodal research.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在感知方面表现出强大的能力，然而将感知、推理和生成整合到一个统一框架中的整体情感图像内容分析领域却尚未得到充分探索。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了AICA-Bench这个全面的基准测试平台，该平台包含三个核心任务：情绪理解、推理和生成。我们对23个视觉语言模型进行了评估，发现它们存在几个关键问题：这些模型在强度校准方面存在困难，并且在开放式任务中描述性不足。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了基于情感树提示的训练方法——GAT Prompting。这种方法无需额外的训练过程，就能将视觉引导与分层推理相结合。实验表明，GAT能够有效地纠正强度方面的错误，并显著提升描述性深度，为未来的情感多模态研究提供了坚实的基础。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: You Only Need One Single Token to Refine Safety Alignment
papers.title_zh: 你只需要一个单一的代币，就能完善安全性的相关设置
papers.authors: Wenqian Yu, Shuo Chen, Zhijiang Li, Zhipeng Wang, Jindong Gu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) face a critical alignment challenge: balancing safety with helpfulness. Excessive safety can lead to over-refusal, where models reject harmful-looking yet benign queries, severely limiting utility.Existing training-free interventions offer an efficient way to mitigate over-refusal without re-training, but suffer from high inference overhead and architecture dependency. Our work explores a complementary direction: rather than applying post-hoc corrections to model outputs, our goal is to intrinsically reshape the distributions of harmful and benign samples within the model’s decision space. In this paper, we argue that a lightweight training-based approach can more effectively distinguish between harmful and benign samples. We propose Single Token Alignment (STA), which optimizes only a single-token prefix (e.g., 4,096 parameters) while keeping the base model frozen. To address the inherent challenge of achieving robust refinement through such a minimal parameter interface, STA employs a mixed weighting mechanism integrated with its optimization objective. This mechanism incorporates hard weighting via stringent data filtering to provide clear, unbiased learning signals, and soft weighting through a focal mechanism to prioritize challenging cases.Extensive experiments across 9 models and 10 datasets demonstrate that STA achieves a superior safety-helpfulness balance for LLMs, MLLMs, and reasoning models, offering a highly efficient and generalizable solution for refining safety alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型面临着一个关键的对齐挑战：如何在安全性与实用性之间取得平衡。过度强调安全性会导致过度拒绝现象，即模型会拒绝那些看似无害但可能有害的查询，这严重限制了模型的实用性。现有的无需训练的干预方法可以高效地缓解过度拒绝问题，但这种方法存在较高的推理开销，并且依赖于特定的架构。我们的研究则探索了一个互补的方向：不是对模型输出进行事后修正，而是试图在模型的决策空间中从根本上重塑有害样本和有益样本的分布。在本文中，我们认为基于轻量级训练的方法能够更有效地区分有害样本和有益样本。我们提出了单令牌对齐算法，该算法仅优化单个令牌前缀（例如，4,096个参数），同时保持基础模型不变。为了通过这种最小参数的接口实现稳健的改进，单令牌对齐算法采用了一种混合权重机制，该机制结合了严格的数据过滤来提供清晰、无偏见的训练信号，同时通过焦点机制来优先考虑具有挑战性的案例。通过在9种模型和10个数据集上的广泛实验表明，单令牌对齐算法能够为大语言模型、多语言语言模型和推理模型提供更优的安全性和实用性之间的平衡，为改进安全性对齐提供了一种高效且可推广的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CrisPrune: Combining Contextual Relevance and Intrinsic Saliency for Efficient Visual Token Pruning in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: CrisPrune：结合上下文相关性和目标区域的重要性，以实现在MLLMs中高效的视觉令牌剪枝操作
papers.authors: Ziniu Liu, Shuheng Zhou, Mingqing Liu, Hao Deng, Huijia Zhu
papers.abstract: Visual token pruning has emerged as a pivotal strategy to alleviate the computational bottleneck in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet it frequently compromises the integrity of visual understanding in pursuit of efficiency. Existing methods face a fundamental tension: vision-centric approaches are susceptible to the attention sink phenomenon and operate in a query-agnostic manner, whereas text-guided methods often create an overly narrow focus, discarding essential background context and failing on ambiguous queries. In this paper, we propose CrisPrune, a training-free and model-agnostic method that reconciles efficiency with understanding by integrating visual saliency and text relevance. Specifically, we introduce intrinsic visual saliency with robust normalization to identify information-rich regions characterized by significant visual features. Simultaneously, we design dual-source text relevance to synergize explicit instruction alignment with implicit scene priors. Finally, we reformulate the selection process using a Determinantal Point Process (DPP) to balance token quality and spatial diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CrisPrune significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. On LLaVA-NeXT, it achieves a 13 \times decrease in FLOPs while maintaining 97% of the original performance with 94.4% of visual tokens pruned, effectively bridging the gap between efficiency and holistic understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉标记剪枝已成为缓解多模态大语言模型计算瓶颈的关键策略，但为了实现效率提升，它往往牺牲了视觉理解的完整性。现有方法面临着一个根本性的矛盾：以视觉为中心的方法容易陷入注意力消耗现象，且以查询无关的方式运行；而以文本为引导的方法则常常导致关注点过于狭窄，从而忽略重要的背景信息，在处理模糊的查询时也会产生问题。在本文中，我们提出了CrisPrune这一无需训练且不受模型影响的算法。该算法通过整合视觉显著性和文本相关性，实现了效率与理解之间的平衡。具体来说，我们通过引入具有强大归一化功能的内在视觉显著性来识别那些具有显著视觉特征的信息丰富区域。同时，我们设计了双源文本相关性机制，将明确的指令信息与隐式的场景先验相结合。最后，我们使用行列式点过程重新规划标记选择过程，以平衡标记质量和空间多样性。大量实验表明，CrisPrune在性能上显著优于现有方法。在LLaVA-NeXT数据集上，该算法的浮点运算量减少了13倍，同时保留了原始性能的97%，并且仅修剪了94.4%的视觉标记，有效地实现了效率与整体理解之间的平衡。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Topology: Generative Node Importance Estimation via Structure-Guided Semantic Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 超越拓扑学：通过结构引导的语义推理来实现生成式节点重要性估计
papers.authors: Kuofei Fang, Siyan Wu, Yu Guo, Bin Wu
papers.abstract: Node Importance Estimation (NIE) in Knowledge Graphs (KGs) aims to quantify the significance of entities, serving as a pivotal instrument for deciphering the latent mechanisms of social dynamics. However, existing methods are often confined to supervised paradigms and rely heavily on topological aggregation, resulting in limited generalization capability. To address these challenges, we propose GenNIE, the first end-to-end generative reasoning framework for NIE. Specifically, GenNIE leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) integrated with topological information to generate precise importance scores for entities in KGs. Furthermore, GenNIE introduces a Global-Structural Graph Perception mechanism to empower the LLMs with holistic graph cognition. Extensive experiments demonstrate the performance superiority of GenNIE and its robust generalization across diverse domains. Our code is available at https://github.com/CoffeyF/GenNIE.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识图谱中的节点重要性估计（NIE）旨在量化实体的重要性，这是揭示社会动态潜在机制的关键工具。然而，现有的方法往往局限于有监督的范式，且严重依赖拓扑聚合，导致泛化能力有限。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了GenNIE——首个用于NIE的端到端生成式推理框架。具体来说，GenNIE利用大语言模型与拓扑信息相结合，为知识图谱中的实体生成精确的重要性评分。此外，GenNIE还引入了全局结构图感知机制，使语言模型具备全面的图认知能力。大量实验表明，GenNIE在性能上表现出色，并且能够在不同领域中实现强大的泛化能力。我们的代码可在https://github.com/CoffeyF/GenNIE.git获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AGTAO: Robust and Stabilized LLM Unlearning via Adversarial Gating Training with Adaptive Orthogonality
papers.title_zh: AGTAO：通过对抗性门控训练以及自适应正交性技术，实现稳健且稳定的大语言模型遗忘机制
papers.authors: Pengyu Li, Lingling Zhang, Zhitao Gao, Yanrui Wu, Yuxuan Dong, Huan Liu, Bifan Wei, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities, they unintentionally memorize sensitive data, posing critical privacy and security risks.Machine unlearning is pivotal for mitigating these risks, yet existing paradigms face a fundamental dilemma: aggressive unlearning often induces catastrophic forgetting that degrades model utility, whereas conservative strategies risk superficial forgetting, leaving models vulnerable to adversarial recovery. To address this trade-off, we propose AGTAO (Adversarial Gating Training with Adaptive Orthogonality), a unified framework designed to reconcile robust erasure with utility preservation. Specifically, our approach introduces Adaptive Orthogonality (AO) to dynamically mitigate geometric gradient conflicts between forgetting and retention objectives, thereby minimizing unintended knowledge degradation. Concurrently, Adversarial Gating Training (AGT) formulates unlearning as a latent-space min-max game, employing a curriculum-based gating mechanism to simulate and counter internal recovery attempts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AGTAO achieves a superior trade-off between unlearning efficacy (KUR \approx 0.01) and model utility (MMLU 58.30).[Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AGT-unlearning>.].
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型已经取得了显著的性能，但它们会无意中存储敏感数据，这带来了严重的隐私和安全风险。机器反学习是缓解这些风险的关键手段，但现有的反学习方法面临着一个根本性的困境：过于激进的反学习会导致灾难性的遗忘，从而降低模型的实用性；而过于保守的策略则可能导致模型被表面上的遗忘所影响，使其容易受到对抗性恢复的攻击。为了解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了AGTAO（带有自适应正交性的对抗门控训练）这一统一框架，旨在实现稳健的擦除操作与模型实用性的兼得。具体来说，我们的方法引入了自适应正交性机制，以动态缓解遗忘与保留目标之间的几何梯度冲突，从而最小化非预期的知识损失。同时，对抗门控训练将反学习过程转化为一个潜在空间中的最小-最大博弈，并通过基于课程设计的门控机制来模拟并抵御内部恢复尝试。大量实验表明，AGTAO在反学习效率（KUR约0.01）与模型实用性（MMLU为58.30）之间实现了出色的平衡。[代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AGT-unlearning>。]
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LLMs Meet Isolation Kernel: Lightweight, Learning-free Binary Embeddings for Fast Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型与隔离内核的相遇：适用于快速检索的轻量级、无需学习的二进制嵌入方法
papers.authors: Zhibo Zhang, Yang Xu, Kai Ming Ting, Cam-Tu Nguyen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently enabled remarkable progress in text representation. However, their embeddings are typically high-dimensional, leading to substantial storage and retrieval overhead. Although recent approaches such as Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) and Contrastive Sparse Representation (CSR) alleviate these issues to some extent, they still suffer from retrieval accuracy degradation. This paper proposes Isolation Kernel Embedding or IKE, a learning-free method that transforms an LLM embedding into a binary embedding using Isolation Kernel (IK). Lightweight and based on binary encoding, IKE offers a low memory footprint and fast bitwise computation, lowering retrieval latency. Experiments on multiple text retrieval datasets demonstrate that IKE offers up to 16.7\times faster retrieval and 16\times lower memory usage than the original LLM embeddings, while maintaining comparable accuracy. Theoretically, we show that IKE works because it satisfies four essential criteria for effective binary hashing that other methods do not possess. Compared to CSR, IKE consistently achieves better retrieval efficiency and effectiveness. IKE also works effectively with graph-based indexing, demonstrating its superiority in balancing accuracy and latency compared to alternative compression techniques in the approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search setting.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在文本表示方面取得了显著进展。然而，它们的嵌入通常具有高度维度，这导致了巨大的存储和检索负担。尽管最近的一些方法，如套娃表示学习（MRL）和对比稀疏表示（CSR），在一定程度上缓解了这些问题，但它们仍然存在检索准确性的下降问题。本文提出了隔离核嵌入技术，这是一种无学习的方法，它使用隔离核将LLM嵌入转换为二进制嵌入。由于采用轻量级且基于二进制编码的方式，隔离核嵌入技术在内存占用方面表现优异，同时还能实现快速的位运算，从而降低了检索延迟。在多个文本检索数据集上的实验表明，与原始的LLM嵌入相比，隔离核嵌入技术的检索速度提高了16.7倍，内存使用量减少了16倍，同时保持了相当的准确性。从理论上讲，我们发现隔离核嵌入技术之所以有效，是因为它满足了其他方法所不具备的四个关键条件，这些条件是有效的二进制哈希所必需的。与CSR相比，隔离核嵌入技术在检索效率和效果上始终表现更好。此外，隔离核嵌入技术还适用于基于图的索引结构，这表明它在近似最近邻搜索场景中能够更优地平衡准确性和延迟性，优于其他压缩技术。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BOLT: Benchmarking Open-World Learning for Text Classification
papers.title_zh: BOLT：开放世界学习技术在文本分类领域中的应用与比较
papers.authors: Chuan Qin, Xi Chen, Jinpeng Li, Hengshu Zhu
papers.abstract: Text classification has long been a cornerstone of NLP, yet most prior work and benchmarks have been limited to closed-world settings, where all classes are assumed to be known in advance. In contrast, open-world learning has recently emerged as a critical paradigm for building more robust and realistic systems. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, while overlooking broader challenges such as the discovery of novel categories. To address this gap, we introduce BOLT, a unified Benchmark and evaluation toolkit supporting Open-world Learning for Text classification. BOLT encompasses two representative tasks: Open-set Text Classification (OSTC), which requires models to classify in-distribution (ID) samples while rejecting OOD inputs, and Generalized Category Discovery (GCD), which aims to identify both known and novel categories from partially labeled corpora. We carefully curate 12 publicly available datasets spanning diverse domains and benchmark 22 methods, including 15 for OSTC and 7 for GCD, under a standardized protocol that explicitly accounts for varying labeled ratios and known class ratios. Our results reveal key challenges: most current methods tend to overfit training distributions and struggle to generalize to unseen classes. Moreover, by comparing our lightweight LLM-based variants with prior open-set baselines, we demonstrate the promise of leveraging LLMs for open-world text classification. BOLT provides standardized evaluation protocols that enable fair comparison and support future research in this emerging area. All datasets, baselines, and tools are available at https://github.com/CNIC-DSL/BOLT.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本分类一直是自然语言处理领域的重要研究方向。然而，迄今为止的大部分研究以及相关的评估基准都局限于封闭世界场景，即所有类别都是事先已知的。相比之下，开放世界学习作为一种新的范式，正在成为构建更强大、更真实系统的关键手段。不过，现有的评估基准大多集中在检测超出分布范围的样本上，而忽略了诸如发现新类别这类更为复杂的挑战。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了BOLT——一个统一的评估基准和工具包，旨在支持开放世界环境下的文本分类任务。BOLT包含两项代表性任务：开放集文本分类（OSTC），要求模型能够对新出现的类别进行分类，同时拒绝已知类别的样本；以及广义类别发现（GCD），其目的是从部分标注的语料库中识别已知和新出现的类别。我们精心挑选了12个涵盖不同领域的公开数据集，并对22种方法进行评估，其中15种方法用于OSTC，7种方法用于GCD。我们的评估采用标准化协议，充分考虑了不同标注比例和已知类别比例的影响。我们的研究结果揭示了几个关键问题：目前大多数方法容易过拟合训练数据分布，难以泛化到未知类别。此外，通过将我们基于轻量级LLM的变体与现有的开放集基准方法进行比较，我们发现利用LLM进行开放世界文本分类具有巨大潜力。BOLT提供的标准化评估协议使得公平比较成为可能，并为该领域的未来研究提供了支持。所有数据集、基准方法和工具均可访问，网址为https://github.com/CNIC-DSL/BOLT。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MobileBench-OL: A Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for Evaluating Mobile GUI Agents in Real-World Environment
papers.title_zh: MobileBench-OL：一款全面的中文基准测试工具，用于评估移动设备上的图形用户界面代理在真实环境中的性能
papers.authors: Qinzhuo Wu, Zhizhuo Yang, Hanhao Li, Pengzhi Gao, Wei Liu, Jian Luan
papers.abstract: Recent advances in mobile Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents highlight the growing need for comprehensive evaluation benchmarks. While new online benchmarks offer more realistic testing than offline ones, they tend to focus on the agents’ task instruction-following ability while neglecting their reasoning and exploration ability. Moreover, these benchmarks do not consider the random noise in real-world mobile environments. This leads to a gap between benchmarks and real-world environments. To addressing these limitations, we propose MobileBench-OL, an online benchmark with 1080 tasks from 80 Chinese apps. It measures task execution, complex reasoning, and noise robustness of agents by including 5 subsets, which set multiple evaluation dimensions. We also provide an auto-eval framework with a reset mechanism, enabling stable and repeatable real-world benchmarking. Evaluating 13 leading GUI agents on MobileBench-OL shows significant room for improvement to meet real-world requirements. Human evaluation further confirms that MobileBench-OL can reliably measure the performance of leading GUI agents in real environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，移动图形用户界面代理领域取得了显著进展，这凸显了建立全面评估基准的迫切需求。虽然新的在线评估基准能够提供更真实的测试环境，但它们往往只关注代理的任务执行能力，而忽视了它们的推理和探索能力。此外，这些基准并未考虑现实世界移动环境中的随机干扰因素，这就导致基准与真实环境之间存在差距。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了MobileBench-OL这一在线评估基准，该基准包含来自80个中文应用程序的1080个任务。它通过包含5个子集来测量代理的任务执行能力、复杂推理能力以及对噪声的鲁棒性，从而涵盖了多个评估维度。我们还提供了一个自动评估框架，并设置了重置机制，以确保真实环境下的评估具有稳定性和可重复性。通过对13个领先的图形用户界面代理在MobileBench-OL上进行评估，我们发现它们仍有很大的改进空间，以满足现实世界的需求。人工评估进一步证实，MobileBench-OL能够可靠地衡量领先图形用户界面代理在真实环境中的性能表现。

papers.title: CondenseFlow: Scalable Latent Space Collaboration via Semantic Compression for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: CondenseFlow：通过语义压缩实现可扩展的潜在空间协作，适用于多智能体系统
papers.authors: Xiaoyu Chen, Fengge Wu, Zhao Junsuo, Yun Fan
papers.abstract: Full-state latent communication in LLM-based multi-agent systems offers richer semantics than text but suffers from memory overhead scaling linearly with collaboration rounds. We propose CondenseFlow, which introduces the Latent Thought Condenser (LTC)—a lightweight module using learnable semantic probes to compress KV caches into fixed-size representations, achieving \mathcal{O}(1) communication complexity regardless of context length. We theoretically prove that compression error is bounded by attention concentration and accumulates controllably across rounds. On seven benchmarks spanning six models, CondenseFlow reduces KV cache memory by over 99% and inference latency by approximately 20% compared to dense transfer with negligible accuracy degradation, while outperforming text-based methods by 1.7 percentage points on average across all configurations. Code is available at https://github.com/xxy33/condenseflow.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中，全状态潜在通信方式所提供的语义比文本更为丰富，但存在记忆开销随协作轮次线性增长的问题。我们提出了CondenseFlow这一方案，它引入了一种名为“潜在思维压缩器”的轻量级模块——该模块利用可学习的语义探针将KV缓存压缩成固定大小的表示形式，从而实现与上下文长度无关的$\mathcal{O}(1)$通信复杂度。我们从理论上证明了压缩误差受到注意力集中的限制，并且能够在各轮次中可控地累积。在涵盖六种模型的七项基准测试中，与密集传输相比，CondenseFlow将KV缓存内存减少了99%以上，推理延迟也降低了约20%。同时，在所有配置下，CondenseFlow的平均性能均优于基于文本的方法，优势幅度为1.7个百分点。代码可在https://github.com/xxy33/condenseflow获取。

papers.title: MAXS: Meta-Adaptive Exploration with LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: MAXS：基于元自适应探索的LLM代理系统
papers.authors: Jian Zhang, Zhiyuan Wang, Zhangqi Wang, Yu He, Haoran Luo, li Yuan, Lingling Zhang, Rui Mao, Qika Lin, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) Agents exhibit inherent reasoning abilities through the collaboration of multiple tools.However, during agent inference, existing methods often suffer from (i) locally myopic generation, due to the absence of lookahead, and (ii) trajectory instability, where minor early errors can escalate into divergent reasoning paths. These issues make it difficult to balance global effectiveness and computational efficiency. To address these two issues, we propose meta-adaptive exploration with LLM agents (MAXS)[https://github.com/exoskeletonzj/MAXS], a meta-adaptive reasoning framework based on LLM Agents that flexibly integrates tool execution and reasoning planning. MAXS employs a lookahead strategy to extend reasoning paths a few steps ahead, estimating the advantage value of tool usage, and combines step consistency variance and inter-step trend slopes to jointly select stable, consistent, and high-value reasoning steps. Additionally, we introduce a trajectory convergence mechanism that controls computational cost by halting further rollouts once path consistency is achieved, enabling a balance between resource efficiency and global effectiveness in multi-tool reasoning. We conduct extensive empirical studies across three base models (MiMo-VL-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-32B) and five datasets, demonstrating that MAXS consistently outperforms existing methods in both performance and inference efficiency. Further analysis confirms the effectiveness of our lookahead strategy and tool usage.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理通过多种工具的协作展现出固有的推理能力。然而，在代理推理过程中，现有方法常常存在以下问题：(1) 由于缺乏前瞻信息，导致局部短视的生成问题；(2) 轨迹不稳定性，即早期的微小错误可能会引发不同的推理路径。这些问题使得在全局效果与计算效率之间找到平衡变得困难。为了解决这两个问题，我们提出了基于大语言模型代理的元自适应探索方法——MAXS[https://github.com/exoskeletonzj/MAXS]。该框架能够灵活整合工具执行与推理规划，采用前瞻策略将推理路径向前延伸几步，并估算工具使用的优势值。同时，MAXS结合了步骤一致性方差和步骤间趋势斜率，从而选择稳定、一致且高价值的推理步骤。此外，我们还引入了轨迹收敛机制，该机制在达到路径一致性后停止进一步扩展，从而在多工具推理中实现资源效率与全局效果之间的平衡。我们在三个基础模型（MiMo-VL-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-32B）和五个数据集上进行了广泛的实证研究，结果表明MAXS在性能和推理效率方面始终优于现有方法。进一步分析也证实了我们的前瞻策略以及工具使用方式的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Leveraging Human and Machine Preferences for Zero-shot Detection of AI-Generated Text
papers.title_zh: 利用人类和机器的偏好来实现人工智能生成文本的零样本检测
papers.authors: Lei Jiang, Desheng Wu, Xiaolong Zheng, Cuicui Luo
papers.abstract: In recent years, the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has enabled generated texts to closely mimic human writing, posing significant challenges to the detection of AI-generated content. Current mainstream zero-shot detection methods largely adopt a machine-centric perspective, relying on proxy models to compute token-level AI-likelihood scores and treating all tokens equally during overall detection. However, such approaches overlook the prediction discrepancies that arise when humans and large language models interpret the same text. We argue that tokens exhibiting greater divergence between human and machine predictions can provide stronger clues for determining the authorship of a text. To address this limitation, we propose HAPDA—a human-machine prediction discrepancy adapter for AI-generated text detection (AGTD). The framework consists of two core components: (1) a joint fine-tuning strategy for training paired human-preference and machine-preference models, and (2) a discrepancy-aware reweighting mechanism designed to calibrate token-level detection scores in downstream detectors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HAPDA consistently and significantly enhances the detection performance of five representative baseline models under various evaluation scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展使得生成的文本能够高度模仿人类写作，这给人工智能生成内容的检测带来了重大挑战。目前主流的零样本检测方法大多采用机器中心主义的视角，依赖代理模型来计算令牌级别的AI概率得分，并在整体检测过程中平等对待所有令牌。然而，这些方法忽略了人类和大语言模型在解读相同文本时所产生的预测差异。我们认为，那些在人类和机器预测之间存在较大差异的令牌，可以为判断文本的作者身份提供更可靠的线索。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了HAPDA——一种用于人工智能生成文本检测的人机预测差异适配器。该框架包含两个核心组件：（1）用于训练结合人类偏好模型和机器偏好模型的联合微调策略；（2）一种注重差异感知的权重调整机制，旨在校准下游检测器中的令牌级别检测分数。大量实验表明，HAPDA能够在各种评估场景中显著提升五个代表性基线模型的检测性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MelTrim: Coarse-to-Fine Data Pruning for Speech Classification
papers.title_zh: MelTrim：用于语音分类的粗到细数据筛选技术
papers.authors: Shaobo Wang, Tianle Niu, Xuan Ouyang, Xintong Li, Zhengkun Ge, Yue Min, Xiaoqian Liu, Hankun Wang, Linfeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Dataset Pruning (DP) aims to construct a coreset that achieves performance comparable to the original, full dataset. However, few studies have explored DP in the context of Speech Classification (SC) tasks. Unlike image or text classification, SC is particularly challenging due to the difficulty in capturing the acoustic, semantic, and contextual representations. In this study, we propose a novel dataset pruning method for speech datasets, termed Meltrim, which uses a two-step coarse-to-fine framework designed to address these challenges. Specifically, in Step 1, Meltrim coarsely filters utterance-level redundant samples using DBSCAN clustering on Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) features, which are first flattened and then reduced in dimensionality using UMAP. In Step 2, we perform frame-level redundancy pruning for each utterance via utility pruning, which aims to eliminate irrelevant frames within each utterance. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dataset pruning approach designed for Speech Classification tasks, demonstrating outstanding performance compared to classical general DP methods. Notably, for the Speech Emotion Recognition, our method achieves up to a 49.5% improvement in WA (Weighted Accuracy) on the MEAD dataset. For the Speaker Identification tasks, it results in a 41.9% reduction in EER (Equal Error Rate) on the VoxCeleb1 dataset.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据集剪枝（DP）的目标是构建一个性能与原始完整数据集相当的基础模型。然而，很少有研究在语音分类任务中探讨过DP方法。与图像或文本分类不同，语音分类尤其具有挑战性，因为要捕捉声学、语义和上下文信息非常困难。在本研究中，我们提出了一种针对语音数据集的新颖数据集剪枝方法，名为MelTrim。该方法采用两步式从粗到细的框架来应对这些挑战。具体来说，在第一步中，MelTrim利用DBSCAN聚类对Mel频率倒谱系数特征进行粗过滤，去除冗余的样本；随后通过UMAP技术对特征进行降维处理。在第二步中，我们通过效用剪枝技术对每个语音片段中的冗余帧进行剔除，以去除不相关的帧。据我们所知，这是第一种专为语音分类任务设计的数据集剪枝方法，其性能优于传统的通用DP方法。在语音情感识别任务中，我们的方法使MEAD数据集上的加权准确率提高了49.5%。在说话人识别任务中，该方法使VoxCeleb1数据集上的错误率降低了41.9%。

papers.title: MINED: Probing and Updating with Multimodal Time-Sensitive Knowledge for Large Multimodal Models
papers.title_zh: MINED：针对大型多模态模型，利用多种模式下的时间敏感知识进行探测与更新
papers.authors: Kailin Jiang, Ning Jiang, Yuntao Du, Yuchen Ren, Yuchen Li, Yifan Gao, Jinhe Bi, Yunpu Ma, Bin Li, Lei Liu, Qing Li
papers.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) encode rich factual knowledge via cross-modal pre-training, yet their static representations struggle to maintain an accurate understanding of time-sensitive knowledge. Existing benchmarks remain constrained by static designs, inadequately evaluating LMMs’ ability to understand time-sensitive knowledge. To address this gap, we propose MINED, a comprehensive benchmark containing 2,104 time-sensitive knowledge samples spanning six knowledge types, which evaluates temporal awareness along 6 key dimensions and 11 challenging tasks: cognition, awareness, trustworthiness, understanding, reasoning, and robustness. Evaluating 15 widely used LMMs on MINED shows that Gemini-2.5-Pro achieves the highest average CEM score of 63.07, while most open-source LMMs still lack time understanding ability. Meanwhile, LMMs perform best on organization knowledge, whereas their performance is weakest on sport. To address these challenges, we investigate the feasibility of updating time-sensitive knowledge in LMMs through knowledge editing methods and observe that LMMs can effectively update knowledge via knowledge editing methods in single editing scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型多模态模型（LMMs）通过跨模态预训练来编码丰富的事实知识，然而它们的静态表示难以准确理解时间敏感的知识。现有的基准测试仍然受到静态设计的限制，无法充分评估LMMs理解时间敏感知识的能力。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了MINED这个全面的基准测试，该测试包含2,104个时间敏感的知识样本，涵盖六种知识类型。MINED从6个关键维度以及11个具有挑战性的任务来评估时间感知能力：认知、意识、可信度、理解力、推理能力和鲁棒性。对15种广泛使用的LMMs进行MINED测试的结果显示，Gemini-2.5-Pro取得了最高的平均CEM分数，为63.07。而大多数开源LMMs仍然缺乏时间理解能力。与此同时，LMMs在组织知识方面的表现最好，而在体育知识方面则表现最差。为了解决这些挑战，我们研究了通过知识编辑方法更新LMMs中时间敏感知识的可行性，并观察到LMMs可以在单一编辑场景中通过知识编辑方法有效更新知识。

papers.title: Beyond Output Confidence: Epistemic-Aware Hallucination Detection with Answer-Level Signals
papers.title_zh: 超越输出信心：基于答案级信号的认知型幻觉检测
papers.authors: Jieran Li, Xiuyuan Hu, Yang Zhao, Dongbiao Sun, Hao Zhang
papers.abstract: Despite their strong generative capabilities, large language models frequently exhibit hallucinations, particularly due to outside-boundary confidence where incorrect assertions are produced with high statistical certainty. Existing approaches commonly use output probability as a proxy for truthfulness; however, this signal is confounded by epistemic uncertainty and cannot reliably distinguish genuine uncertainty from fabricated content. We argue that effective hallucination detection requires integrating surface-level confidence with signals that reflect the model’s underlying epistemic state. To this end, we propose Answer-level Intrinsic Cognition (AIC), a model-agnostic metric that captures epistemic boundary deviations by measuring answer-level stability across multiple stochastic forward passes. By coupling AIC with conventional output uncertainty, we derive a composite metric that disentangles within-boundary uncertainty from outside-boundary confidence. Across three public question-answering benchmarks and diverse model scales, the two-dimensional score consistently outperforms strong uncertainty-only baselines, with larger gains on adversarially constructed hallucination sets. The code is available at: https://github.com/HXYfighter/AIC-ACL2026.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型具有强大的生成能力，但它们经常会出现幻觉现象，这主要是由于模型外部边界的置信度问题导致的——即模型以很高的统计概率生成错误的陈述。现有的方法通常将输出概率作为真实性的代理指标；然而，这种信号会受到认知不确定性的干扰，无法可靠地区分真实的不确定性与伪造的内容。我们认为，有效的幻觉检测需要将表面级别的置信度与反映模型内在认知状态的信号结合起来。为此，我们提出了“答案级内在认知”这一模型无关的指标，该指标通过测量多个随机前向过程中的答案级稳定性来捕捉认知边界的偏差。通过将AIC与传统输出不确定性相结合，我们得出了一个复合指标，能够区分内部边界的不确定性与外部边界的置信度。在三个公开的问题回答基准测试以及不同规模的模型中，这个二维评分始终优于仅依赖不确定性的强基线模型，并且在针对特定设计的幻觉数据集上取得了更大的提升。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/HXYfighter/AIC-ACL2026。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: PerfCoder: Large Language Models for Interpretable Code Performance Optimization
papers.title_zh: PerfCoder：适用于可解释性代码性能优化的大型语言模型
papers.authors: Jiuding Yang, Shengyao Lu, Hongxuan Liu, Shayan Shirahmad Gale Bagi, Zahra Fazel, Tomasz Czajkowski, Di Niu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in automatic code generation, yet their ability to produce high-performance code remains limited, despite its importance in real-world software systems. We argue that this limitation stems not only from data scarcity, but more fundamentally from the lack of supervision that guides interpretable and effective performance improvements. We introduce PerfCoder, a family of LLMs designed to generate performance-enhanced code through interpretable and customized optimization strategies. PerfCoder is fine-tuned on curated real-world optimization trajectories with human-readable annotations and further aligned via reinforcement fine-tuning using runtime feedback, enabling it to generate input-specific strategies and apply them directly without iterative refinement. On the PIE code performance benchmark, PerfCoder outperforms all existing models in both runtime speedup and effective optimization rate, demonstrating that code performance optimization requires strategy awareness rather than scale alone. Moreover, PerfCoder produces interpretable feedback that can guide larger LLMs in a planner–optimizer workflow, substantially improving the performance of 32B models and GPT-5 on code optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自动代码生成方面取得了显著进展，然而它们在生成高性能代码方面的能力仍然有限，尽管这在现实世界的软件系统中非常重要。我们认为，这种局限性不仅源于数据的稀缺性，更根本的是缺乏能够指导可解释且有效的性能改进的监督机制。我们提出了PerfCoder系列语言模型，旨在通过可解释且定制化的优化策略来生成性能提升的代码。PerfCoder经过微调，使用了带有人类可读注释的真实世界优化轨迹作为训练数据，并通过运行时反馈进行进一步对齐，使其能够生成针对特定输入的策略，并直接应用这些策略，而无需进行迭代优化。在PIE代码性能基准测试中，PerfCoder在运行速度和提高优化效率方面均优于所有现有模型，这表明代码性能优化需要策略意识，而不仅仅是规模上的优势。此外，PerfCoder还能产生可解释的反馈，这些反馈可以指导更大的语言模型在规划器-优化器工作流程中的表现，从而大幅提升了32B模型和GPT-5在代码优化方面的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MIPIC: Matryoshka Representation Learning via Self-Distilled Intra-Relational and Progressive Information Chaining
papers.title_zh: MIPIC：通过提取内部关系信息和逐步关联信息来实现套娃领域的表示学习
papers.authors: Phung Gia Huy, Hai An Vu, Minh-Phuc Truong, Thang Duc Tran, Linh Ngo Van, Thanh Hong Nguyen, Trung Le
papers.abstract: Representation learning is fundamental to NLP, but building embeddings that work well at different computational budgets is challenging. Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) offers a flexible inference paradigm through nested embeddings; however, learning such structures requires explicit coordination of how information is arranged across embedding dimensionality and model depth. In this work, we propose MIPIC (Matryoshka Representation Learning via Self-Distilled Intra-Relational Alignment and Progressive Information Chaining), a unified training framework designed to produce structurally coherent and semantically compact Matryoshka representations. MIPIC promotes cross-dimensional structural consistency through Self-Distilled Intra-Relational Alignment (SIA), which aligns token-level geometric and attention-driven relations between full and truncated representations using top-k CKA self-distillation. Complementarily, it enables depth-wise semantic consolidation via Progressive Information Chaining (PIC), a scaffolded alignment strategy that incrementally transfers mature task semantics from deeper layers into earlier layers. Extensive experiments on STS, NLI, and classification benchmarks (spanning models from TinyBERT to BGEM3, Qwen3) demonstrate that MIPIC yields Matryoshka representations that are highly competitive across all capacities, with significant performance advantages observed under extreme low-dimensional.
papers.abstract_zh: 表示学习是自然语言处理领域的基础技术，但构建能在不同计算资源下良好运行的嵌入结构却颇具挑战性。Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）通过嵌套嵌入提供了一种灵活的推理方式；然而，要学习这样的结构，需要明确协调信息在嵌入维度和模型深度之间的布局问题。在这项研究中，我们提出了MIPIC（通过自蒸馏的跨关系对齐和渐进式信息链接实现的Matryoshka表示学习），这是一种统一的训练框架，旨在生成结构连贯且语义紧凑的Matryoshka表示。MIPIC通过自蒸馏的跨关系对齐机制来促进跨维度的结构一致性，该机制利用top-k CKA自蒸馏技术来对齐完整表示与截断表示之间的标记级几何关系和注意力驱动关系。此外，它还通过渐进式信息链接策略实现了逐层语义整合，这种策略能够逐步将深层中的成熟任务语义传递到较浅的层次中。在STS、NLI以及分类基准测试上的广泛实验表明，MIPIC生成的Matryoshka表示在所有能力范围内都具有很高的竞争力，在极端低维度的情况下还能表现出显著的性能优势。

papers.title: Discovering the Gems in Early Layers: Accelerating Long-Context LLMs with 1000x Input Token Reduction
papers.title_zh: 在早期层中发现宝藏：通过将输入令牌数量减少1000倍来加速长上下文大型语言模型的运行
papers.authors: Zhenmei Shi, Yifei Ming, Xuan-Phi Nguyen, Yingyu Liang, Shafiq Joty
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in handling long context inputs, but this comes at the cost of increased computational resources and latency. Our research introduces a novel approach for the long context bottleneck to accelerate LLM inference and reduce GPU memory consumption. We show that LLMs can identify relevant tokens in the early layers prior to generating query responses. Leveraging this insight, we propose an algorithm that uses early layers of an LLM as filters to select and compress input tokens, significantly reducing the context length for subsequent processing. Our method, GemFilter, demonstrates substantial improvements in both speed and memory efficiency compared to existing techniques, such as standard attention and SnapKV/H2O. Notably, it achieves a 2.4X speedup and 30% reduction in GPU memory usage compared to SOTA methods. When evaluated on the Needle in a Haystack task, GemFilter significantly outperforms standard attention and SnapKV, while demonstrating comparable performance on the LongBench challenge. GemFilter is simple, training-free, and broadly applicable across different LLMs. Moreover, it provides interpretability by allowing humans to inspect the selected input sequence. Our findings provide practical benefits for deploying LLMs and deepen our understanding of their internal mechanisms, paving the way for further optimizations in LLM design and inference. Our code is available at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/GemFilter.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在处理长上下文输入方面展现出了卓越的能力，但这也带来了计算资源增加和延迟增大的问题。我们的研究提出了一种新颖的方法，用于加速长上下文瓶颈的处理，从而减少GPU内存的消耗。我们发现，语言模型能够在生成查询响应之前，在早期层就识别出相关的标记。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种算法，该算法利用语言模型的早期层作为过滤器来筛选和压缩输入标记，从而显著减少后续处理所需的上下文长度。我们的方法GemFilter在速度和内存效率方面都取得了显著的改进，相比现有的技术如标准注意力机制和SnapKV/H2O，其性能提升了2.4倍，同时减少了30%的GPU内存使用量。在Needle in a Haystack任务上的评估中，GemFilter的表现明显优于标准注意力机制和SnapKV，而在LongBench挑战赛中的表现也与它们相当。GemFilter方法简单、无需训练，且适用于不同的语言模型。此外，它还具有可解释性，因为允许人类查看所选择的输入序列。我们的研究结果为语言模型的部署提供了实际的好处，并加深了我们对语言模型内部机制的理解，为语言模型设计和推理的进一步优化铺平了道路。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/GemFilter获取。

papers.title: Self-Reflection Improves Safety of Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 自我反思能提升大型推理模型的安全性
papers.authors: Qiang Huang, Wei Zhai, Feng Huang, Dejing Dou
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models(LRMs) have achieved significant breakthroughs over prior large language models (LLMs), but they also entail greater potential safety risks. Existing alignment methods often remain at a shallow level of protection, making them insufficient to address deeper risks and strategic attacks in complex reasoning processes. To bridge this gap, we move beyond the conventional paradigm that treats safety alignment merely as a preventive measure to reduce harmful outputs. Drawing inspiration from human-like introspection and self-correction, we propose Self-Reflection, a technique that introduces a special Self-Reflection token, enabling LRMs to perform Self-Reflection during generation and recover from harmful outputs. Our approach integrates seamlessly into standard post-training paradigms , further enhancing both helpfulness and safety. The experimental results demonstrate that models trained with Self-Reflection not only consistently outperform the baseline in terms of safety (reducing the HCR from 13.8% to 4.1%, nearly a threefold improvement over mainstream approaches), but also achieve substantial advantages in both helpfulness and the safety–helpfulness balance. More importantly, under evaluations involving various adversarial attacks, including a specially designed adaptive attack, the Self-Reflection mechanism significantly enhances model safety without targeted adversarial training.Notice: This paper contains harmful content.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在超越以往的大语言模型方面取得了显著突破，但它们也带来了更大的潜在安全风险。现有的对齐方法往往仅停留在浅层保护层面，无法有效应对复杂推理过程中的深层次风险及战略攻击。为了填补这一空白，我们突破了传统模式，不再仅仅将安全对齐视为一种预防有害输出的措施。借鉴人类类似的内省和自我修正机制，我们提出了“自我反思”技术——该技术引入了一种特殊的自我反思标记，使大型推理模型能够在生成过程中进行自我反思，从而从有害输出中恢复过来。我们的方法能够无缝集成到标准的后训练流程中，进一步提升了模型的实用性与安全性。实验结果表明，采用自我反思技术的模型不仅在安全性方面始终优于基线模型（将有害输出比例从13.8%降低到4.1%，相比主流方法提升了近三倍），而且在实用性和安全性之间的平衡上也取得了显著优势。更重要的是，在涉及各种对抗性攻击的评估中，包括专门设计的自适应攻击，自我反思机制能够在不进行针对性对抗训练的情况下显著提升模型的安全性。注意：本文包含有害内容。

papers.title: WildGraphBench: Benchmarking GraphRAG with Wild-Source Corpora
papers.title_zh: WildGraphBench：使用野生数据源对GraphRAG进行性能评估
papers.authors: Pengyu Wang, Benfeng Xu, Licheng Zhang, Shaohan Wang, Mingxuan Du, Chiwei Zhu, Zhendong Mao
papers.abstract: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) organizes external knowledge as a hierarchical graph, enabling efficient retrieval and aggregation of scattered evidence across multiple documents. However, many existing benchmarks for GraphRAG rely on short, curated passages as external knowledge, failing to adequately evaluate systems in realistic settings involving long contexts and large-scale heterogeneous documents. To bridge this gap, we introduce , a benchmark designed to assess GraphRAG performance in the wild. We leverage Wikipedia’s unique structure, where cohesive narratives are grounded in long and heterogeneous external reference documents, to construct a benchmark reflecting real-word scenarios. Specifically, we sample articles across 12 top-level topics, using their external references as the retrieval corpus and citation-linked statements as ground truth, resulting in 1,100 questions spanning three levels of complexity: single-fact QA, multi-fact QA, and section-level summarization. Experiments across multiple baselines reveal that current GraphRAG pipelines help on multi-fact aggregation when evidence comes from a moderate number of sources, but this aggregation paradigm may overemphasize high-level statements at the expense of fine-grained details, leading to weaker performance on summarization tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）将外部知识组织成分层图结构，从而实现跨多个文档的零散证据的高效检索与整合。然而，许多现有的GraphRAG基准测试仅依赖简短且经过筛选的段落作为外部知识来源，无法充分评估系统在涉及长文本和大规模异构文档的真实场景中的表现。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种专门用于评估GraphRAG在实际应用中的性能的基准测试。我们利用维基百科的独特结构——其连贯的叙述内容基于冗长且多样化的外部参考文档——来构建反映真实场景的基准测试。具体来说，我们从12个顶级主题中选取文章样本，以这些文章的外部参考文献作为检索语料库，并将相关引文作为真实数据，最终得到1100个问题，涵盖三个难度级别：单一事实问答、多事实问答以及章节级总结任务。通过对多个基线模型的实验分析发现，当证据来自数量适中的来源时，当前的GraphRAG框架在多事实整合方面表现良好；但这种整合方式可能会过度强调高层级的陈述，而忽视细节信息，从而导致总结任务的性能下降。

papers.title: CRPS: Curriculum Replay via Progressive Suffixes from Successful Trajectories for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: CRPS：通过渐进式后缀重构课程大纲，以实现长期目标的大型语言模型智能体发展
papers.authors: Zijing Zhang, Xiajie Yang
papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents trained with sparse terminal rewards tend to experience slow and unstable learning, and the issue is amplified by group-normalized on-policy objectives commonly used for LLM training (e.g., GRPO). When rollout groups collapse to nearly all failures early in training, within-group normalization yields degenerate advantages and weak learning signals. To address this, we propose Curriculum Replay via Progressive Suffixes from Successful Trajectories (CRPS), a lightweight RL-training strategy that turns serendipitous terminal successes into a within-trajectory curriculum. CRPS maintains a buffer of successful trajectories and restarts rollouts from suffix states, with an online controller adapting k to match agent competence and keep replay outcomes informative. Across ALFWorld and WebShop with different foundation models, CRPS consistently outperforms full-episode GRPO and naive experience replay. Group-level diagnostics further show that CRPS reduces degenerate groups ratio and increases within-group outcome diversity, aligning with faster and more stable training.
papers.abstract_zh: 那些使用稀疏终端奖励进行训练的长期视角大语言模型智能体往往会出现学习速度缓慢且不稳定的问题。而这一问题在采用通常用于大语言模型训练的群体归一化在线策略目标时会被进一步加剧（例如GRPO）。当训练初期各个小组的尝试几乎都失败的时候，群体归一化会导致优势值退化，从而减弱学习信号。为了应对这个问题，我们提出了一种名为“从成功轨迹中逐步提取后缀进行课程复现”的轻量级强化学习训练策略。该策略将偶然取得的终端成功转化为轨迹内的课程资源。CRPS会保留一部分成功轨迹，并从这些轨迹的后缀状态重新开始训练过程，同时有一个在线控制器来调节参数k，以匹配智能体的能力，并保持复现结果具有信息性。在ALFWorld和WebShop这两种不同基础模型的场景中，CRPS始终优于全剧集GRPO和简单的经验复现方法。群体层面的分析还表明，CRPS能够降低退化小组的比例，增加组内结果的多样性，从而实现更快、更稳定的训练效果。

papers.title: D-Artemis: A Deliberative Cognitive Framework for Mobile GUI Multi-Agents
papers.title_zh: D-阿尔忒弥斯：一种适用于移动设备图形用户界面多智能体的思考型认知框架
papers.authors: Hongze Mi, Yibo Feng, WenJie Lu, Yuqi Wang, Jinyuan Li, Song Cao, He Cui, Tengfei Tian, Xuelin Zhang, Haotian Luo, Di Sun, Jun Fang, Hua Chai, Naiqiang Tan, Gang Pan
papers.abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents aim to automate a wide spectrum of human tasks by emulating user interaction. Despite rapid advancements, current approaches are hindered by several critical challenges: data bottleneck in end-to-end training, high cost of delayed error detection, and risk of contradictory guidance. Inspired by the human cognitive loop of Thinking, Alignment, and Reflection, we present D-Artemis—a novel deliberative framework in this paper. D-Artemis leverages a fine-grained, app-specific tip retrieval mechanism to inform its decision-making process. It also employs a proactive Pre-execution Alignment stage, where Thought-Action Consistency (TAC) Check module and Action Correction Agent (ACA) work in concert to mitigate the risk of execution failures. A post-execution Status Reflection Agent (SRA) completes the cognitive loop, enabling strategic learning from experience. Crucially, D-Artemis enhances the capabilities of general-purpose Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for GUI tasks without the need for training on complex trajectory datasets, demonstrating strong generalization. D-Artemis achieves SOTA among open-source general models on AndroidWorld (75.8%) and ScreenSpot-V2 (96.8%). Extensive ablation studies further demonstrate the significant contribution of each proposed component.
papers.abstract_zh: 图形用户界面（GUI）代理旨在通过模拟用户交互来自动化各种人类任务。尽管技术取得了快速进展，但当前的方法仍面临几个关键挑战：端到端训练中的数据瓶颈、延迟错误检测的高成本，以及可能出现矛盾指导的风险。受人类认知循环“思考、对齐与反思”的启发，我们在本文中提出了D-Artemis这一新型决策框架。D-Artemis采用细粒度的、针对特定应用的提示检索机制来辅助其决策过程。它还采用了一种主动的预执行对齐阶段，其中“思维-行动一致性”检查模块和动作纠正代理协同工作，以降低执行失败的风险。执行后的状态反思代理则完成了整个认知循环，使得系统能够从经验中学习并做出战略性的调整。重要的是，D-Artemis能够提升通用多模态大语言模型在GUI任务中的能力，而无需对复杂的轨迹数据集进行训练，展现了强大的泛化能力。在AndroidWorld和ScreenSpot-V2上的测试结果表明，D-Artemis在开源通用模型中表现优异，分别达到了75.8%和96.8%的准确率。进一步的消融研究进一步证明了每个组件的重要性。

papers.title: Temporal Flattening in LLM-Generated Text: Comparing Human and LLM Writing Trajectories
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型生成文本中的时间维度扁平化现象：人类写作与模型写作的对比
papers.authors: Zhanwei Cao, YeoJin Go, Yifan Hu, Shanu Sushmita
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in daily applications, from content generation to code writing, where each interaction treats the model as stateless, generating responses independently without memory. Yet human writing is inherently longitudinal: authors’ styles and cognitive states evolve across months and years. This raises a central question: can LLMs reproduce such temporal structure across extended time periods? We construct and publicly release a longitudinal dataset of 412 human authors and 6,086 documents spanning 2012–2024 across three domains (academic abstracts, blogs, news) and compare them to trajectories generated by three representative LLMs under standard and history-conditioned generation settings. Using drift and variance-based metrics over semantic, lexical, and cognitive–emotional representations, we find temporal flattening in LLM-generated text. LLMs produce greater lexical diversity but exhibit substantially reduced semantic and cognitive–emotional drift relative to humans. These differences are highly predictive: temporal variability patterns alone achieve 94% accuracy and 98% ROC-AUC in distinguishing human from LLM trajectories. Our results demonstrate that temporal flattening persists regardless of whether LLMs generate independently or with access to incremental history, revealing a fundamental property of current deployment paradigms. This gap has direct implications for applications requiring authentic temporal structure, such as synthetic training data and longitudinal text modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在日常应用中越来越被使用，从内容生成到代码编写，在这些应用中，每次交互都将模型视为无状态的，模型独立地生成响应，而不需要记忆。然而，人类的写作本质上是具有时间维度的：作者的风格和认知状态会在数月乃至数年内发生变化。这就提出了一个核心问题：大语言模型能否在长时间段内再现这种时间结构呢？我们构建并公开了一个包含412位人类作者和6,086篇文档的纵向数据集，这些数据涵盖了2012年至2024年，涉及三个领域（学术摘要、博客、新闻）。我们将这些数据与三种代表性大语言模型在标准生成和历史条件生成设置下生成的文本进行了比较。通过基于漂移和变异度的指标，对语义、词汇以及认知-情感表征进行分析后，我们发现大语言模型生成的文本存在时间上的平坦化现象。大语言模型在词汇多样性方面表现更优，但在语义和认知-情感方面的漂移程度则明显低于人类。这些差异具有高度预测性：仅通过时间变异模式就能以94%的准确率和98%的ROC-AUC区分人类与大语言模型的文本轨迹。我们的研究结果表明，无论大语言模型是独立生成文本，还是能够获取增量历史信息，时间上的平坦化现象都会持续存在，这揭示了当前部署模式的一个基本特性。这一差异对于需要真实时间结构的应用来说具有重要意义，例如合成训练数据和纵向文本建模。

papers.title: Beyond Superficial Tests: Adversarial Refinement for Reliable Property-Based Testing
papers.title_zh: 超越表面测试：用于可靠基于属性的测试的对抗性细化技术
papers.authors: Xiao Li, Runlin Liu, Zhe Zhang, Xiang Gao, Hailong Sun
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in code generation, yet their application to Property-Based Testing (PBT) remains fraught with a superficiality gap. While LLMs can readily generate syntactically correct tests, they often struggle to bridge the semantic gap between code implementation and its intended invariant logic, resulting in weak properties that provide a false sense of security. To address this, we introduce PROBE, an agentic framework that hardens software properties through Adversarial Refinement. Unlike traditional generation approaches, PROBE treats test generation as a game of semantic asymmetry: it employs a Validator agent to actively generate counter-implementations, which are semantically incorrect codes that satisfy the generated property, to expose loopholes in the specification. Furthermore, PROBE constructs a cross-functional semantic graph to capture deep dependencies often missed by local analysis. Extensive evaluation reveals that PROBE increases mutation scores by 9.79% over baselines. In real-world deployment, PROBE identified 45 previously unknown bugs in top-tier libraries that have been confirmed by developers, demonstrating its ability to uncover deep semantic defects.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成方面展现出了卓越的能力，然而其在属性驱动测试中的应用仍然存在一些问题。虽然这些模型能够轻松生成语法上正确的测试用例，但它们往往难以解决代码实现与其预期的逻辑关系之间的语义差异，从而导致测试效果不佳，给人一种虚假的安全感。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了PROBE这一框架。该框架通过对抗性细化来强化软件属性的可靠性。与传统的生成方法不同，PROBE将测试用例的生成视为一场语义不对称性的博弈：它利用验证器来主动生成反例，即那些在语义上不正确但满足所测试属性的代码，从而揭示规范中的漏洞。此外，PROBE还构建了一个跨功能的语义图，以捕捉局部分析常常忽略的深层依赖关系。广泛的评估表明，与基线相比，PROBE能够将变异得分提高9.79%。在实际部署中，PROBE在顶级库中发现了45个之前未知的缺陷，这些缺陷已被开发者确认，这证明了其能够发现深层次语义缺陷的能力。

papers.title: FAITH: Factuality Alignment through Integrating Trustworthiness and Honestness
papers.title_zh: 信念：通过整合可信度和诚实性来实现事实性与合理性之间的平衡
papers.authors: Xiaoning Dong, Chengyan Wu, Yajie Wen, Yu Chen, Yun Xue, Zhang Jing, Wei Xu, Bolei Ma
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate factually inaccurate content even if they have corresponding knowledge, which critically undermines their reliability. Existing approaches attempt to mitigate this by incorporating uncertainty in QA prompt during training, but these numerical scores lack the semantic richness for LLM to properly understand its internal states of trustworthiness and honestness, leading to insufficient factuality alignment. We introduce FAITH (Factuality Alignment through Integrating Trustworthiness and Honestness), a post-training framework for factuality alignment that integrates natural-language uncertainty signals with external knowledge. Specifically, we augment training datasets by computing confidence scores and semantic entropy from LLM outputs and mapping them into a knowledge state quadrant that describes the model’s internal knowledge possession (trustworthiness) and answering behaviors (honestness) in natural language. Based on this enhanced data, we design a reward function that considers both correctness and uncertainty signals, and fine-tune the LLM using the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm. To further mitigate weakly grounded responses, we design a retrieval-augmented module that retrieves relevant external passages, improving the consistency between internal and external knowledge representations. Extensive experiments on four knowledge-intensive benchmarks demonstrate that FAITH enhances the factual accuracy and truthfulness of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）即使拥有相应的知识，也可能生成事实不准确的内容，这严重削弱了模型的可靠性。现有的方法试图通过在训练过程中加入问答提示中的不确定性来减轻这一问题，但这些数值评分缺乏语义丰富性，使得LLM难以准确理解自身的可信度和诚实性，从而导致事实准确性不足。我们提出了FAITH（通过整合可信度和诚实性来实现事实准确性对齐）这一后训练阶段的事实准确性对齐框架，该框架将自然语言中的不确定性信号与外部知识相结合。具体来说，我们通过从LLM输出中计算置信度分数和语义熵，并将其映射到一个知识状态象限中，从而增强训练数据集。这个象限描述了模型内部的知识储备（可信度）以及回答行为（诚实性）。基于这些增强的数据，我们设计了一个同时考虑正确性和不确定性信号的奖励函数，并使用近端策略优化算法对LLM进行微调。为了进一步减少基于弱信息的响应，我们设计了一个检索增强模块，该模块可以检索相关的外部信息片段，从而提高内部知识与外部知识表示之间的一致性。在四个知识密集型基准测试上的广泛实验表明，FAITH显著提升了LLM的事实准确性和真实性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
