papers.title: DRA-GRPO: Your GRPO Needs to Know Diverse Reasoning Paths for Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: DRA-GRPO：你们的GRPO需要了解各种用于数学推理的推理路径
papers.authors: Xiwen Chen, Wenhui Zhu, Peijie Qiu, Xuanzhao Dong, Hao Wang, Haiyu Wu, Huayu Li, Aris Sotiras, Yalin Wang, Abolfazl Razi
papers.abstract: Post-training LLMs with Reinforcement Learning, specifically Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has emerged as a paradigm for enhancing mathematical reasoning. However, standard GRPO relies on scalar correctness rewards that are often non-injective with respect to semantic content: distinct reasoning paths receive identical rewards. This leads to a Diversity-Quality Inconsistency, where the policy collapses into a narrow set of dominant modes while ignoring equally valid but structurally novel strategies.To bridge this gap, we propose Diversity-aware Reward Adjustment (DRA), a theoretically grounded framework that calibrates the reward signal using the semantic density of sampled groups. By leveraging Submodular Mutual Information (SMI), DRA implements an Inverse Propensity Scoring (IPS) mechanism that effectively de-biases the gradient estimation. This creates a repulsive force against redundancy, driving the policy to achieve better coverage of the high-reward landscape.Our method is plug-and-play and integrates seamlessly with GRPO variants. Empirical evaluations on five math benchmarks demonstrate that DRA-GRPO consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 58.2% on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B with only 7,000 training samples and 55 cost, highlighting the critical role of diversity calibration in data-efficient alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于强化学习的训练后大语言模型，尤其是群体相对策略优化技术，已被证明是提升数学推理能力的有效方法。然而，传统的群体相对策略优化依赖于标量形式的奖励机制，这种奖励机制往往无法准确反映语义内容的差异：不同的推理路径可能会获得相同的奖励。这就导致了多样性与质量之间的不一致性，即策略会陷入少数主导模式，而忽略那些同样有效但结构新颖的策略。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了一种名为“多样性感知奖励调整”的方法。该方法的理论基础是利用采样群体的语义密度来校准奖励信号。通过运用次模互信息技术，该方法实现了一种逆向倾向评分机制，有效消除了梯度估计中的偏差。这种机制能够产生一种排斥冗余的力量，促使策略更好地覆盖高奖励区域。我们的方法可以轻松集成到各种群体相对策略优化变体中。在五个数学基准测试上的实证结果表明，DRA-GRPO在性能上始终优于其他强大的基线算法。在仅使用7,000个训练样本且成本仅为55的情况下，DRA-GRPO的平均准确率达到了58.2%，这充分证明了在数据效率较高的对齐过程中，多样性校准的重要性。

papers.title: Web Fraud Attacks Against LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 针对基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的网络欺诈攻击
papers.authors: Dezhang Kong, Hujin Peng, Yilun Zhang, Lele Zhao, Zhenhua Xu, Shi Lin, Changting Lin, Meng Han
papers.abstract: With the proliferation of LLM-driven multi-agent systems (MAS), the security of Web links has become a critical concern. Once MAS is induced to trust a malicious link, attackers can use it as a springboard to expand the attack surface. In this paper, we propose Web Fraud Attacks, a novel type of attack manipulating unique structures of web links to deceive MAS. We design 12 representative attack variants that encompass various methods, such as homoglyph deception, sub-directory nesting, and parameter obfuscation. Through extensive experiments on these attack vectors, we demonstrate that Web fraud attacks not only exhibit significant destructive potential across different MAS architectures but also possess a distinct advantage in evasion: they circumvent the need for complex input design, lowering the threshold for attacks significantly. These results underscore the importance of addressing Web fraud attacks, providing new insights into MAS safety.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着由大语言模型驱动的多智能体系统的普及，网络链接的安全性已成为一个至关重要的问题。一旦多智能体系统信任了恶意链接，攻击者就可以利用它作为扩展攻击面的跳板。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“网络欺诈攻击”的新攻击方式，这种攻击通过操纵网络链接的独特结构来欺骗多智能体系统。我们设计了12种代表性的攻击变体，包括同字异义欺骗、子目录嵌套以及参数混淆等方法。通过对这些攻击手段进行大量实验，我们发现网络欺诈攻击不仅在不同多智能体系统架构中具有显著的破坏力，而且在逃避攻击方面也具有明显优势：它们无需复杂的输入设计，从而显著降低了攻击的门槛。这些结果强调了应对网络欺诈攻击的重要性，为多智能体系统的安全性提供了新的见解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Query to Logic: Ontology-Driven Multi-Hop Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 从查询到逻辑：基于本体论的大语言模型多跳推理
papers.authors: Haonan Bian, Yutao Qi, Rui Yang, Yuanxi Che, Jiaqian Wang, Heming Xia, Ranran Zhen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), despite their success in question answering, exhibit limitations in complex multi-hop question answering (MQA) tasks that necessitate non-linear, structured reasoning. This limitation stems from their inability to adequately capture deep conceptual relationships between entities. To overcome this challenge, we present ORACLE (Ontology-driven Reasoning And Chain for Logical Elucidation), a training-free framework that combines LLMs’ generative capabilities with the structural benefits of knowledge graphs. Our approach operates through three stages: (1) dynamic construction of question-specific knowledge ontologies using LLMs, (2) transformation of these ontologies into First-Order Logic (FOL) reasoning chains, and (3) systematic decomposition of the original query into logically coherent sub-questions. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of models and standard MQA benchmarks demonstrate that our framework achieves competitive performance while producing more interpretable reasoning chains.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在问答任务上取得了成功，但在需要非线性、结构化推理的复杂多跳问答任务中仍存在局限性。这一限制源于它们无法充分捕捉实体之间的深层概念关系。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了ORACLE框架——一个无需训练的框架，它结合了语言模型的生成能力以及知识图谱的结构化优势。我们的方法分为三个阶段：(1) 使用语言模型动态构建与问题相关的知识本体；(2) 将这些本体转化为一阶逻辑推理链；(3) 将原始查询系统地分解为逻辑上连贯的子问题。通过大量实验验证，我们的框架在性能方面表现出色，同时生成的推理链也更具可解释性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AudioStealer: Extracting Audio Prompts via Shapley Value-Guided Query Search
papers.title_zh: AudioStealer：利用Shapley值引导的查询搜索方式提取音频提示
papers.authors: Yingbin Jin, Xingjian Du, Hanjun Luo, Zihao Wang, Haibo Hu, XiaoFeng Wang, Xinfeng Li
papers.abstract: As text-to-music models gain widespread adoption, the prompts used to guide these systems have become valuable intellectual property. This shift has given rise to a new form of attack: prompt stealing, aiming to reconstruct the high-value prompts that guide the music generation. However, unlike prior work in text and image generation, prompt stealing in text-to-music systems faces unique challenges due to the entangled and diffuse nature of semantic representations in audio, which complicates the decoupling of specific textual tokens from acoustic outputs. To address these challenges, we present AudioStealer, the first targeted study of prompt inversion in the audio domain. AudioStealer operates via a two-stage black-box attack framework: first, a heuristic search guided by audio-language embeddings identifies initial candidates; then, these candidates are refined using a game-theoretic strategy based on Shapley value estimation to attribute precise semantic contributions. Our method requires no direct access to the target model and relies solely on a shadow model, making it broadly applicable. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that AudioStealer recovers prompts with high textual consistency to the ground truth, while the regenerated audio maintains strong perceptual similarity to the target recordings. These results expose critical vulnerabilities in the text-to-audio market ecosystem and underscore the urgent need for intellectual property protections in generative audio technologies.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着文本转音乐模型得到广泛应用，用于指导这些系统的提示已成为有价值的知识产权。这一变化催生了一种新的攻击方式：提示窃取，其目的是重建那些用于引导音乐生成的高价值提示。然而，与之前在文本和图像生成领域的研究不同，文本转音乐系统中的提示窃取面临着独特的挑战，因为音频中的语义表示是交织且分散的，这使得将具体的文本标记与声学输出分离变得复杂。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AudioStealer，这是首个针对音频领域提示反转的研究方法。AudioStealer采用两阶段黑盒攻击框架：首先，通过音频-语言嵌入进行启发式搜索来识别初始候选提示；然后，利用基于Shapley值估计的博弈论策略对这些候选提示进行细化，以准确确定其语义贡献。我们的方法不需要直接访问目标模型，仅依赖于一个影子模型，因此具有广泛的适用性。通过大量实验，我们发现AudioStealer能够恢复出与真实提示高度一致的提示，而重新生成的音频则与目标录音保持良好的感知相似性。这些结果揭示了文本转音频市场生态系统中的关键漏洞，并强调了在生成性音频技术中保护知识产权的紧迫性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FaithLens: Detecting and Explaining Faithfulness Hallucination
papers.title_zh: FaithLens：识别并解释忠诚幻觉现象
papers.authors: Shuzheng Si, Qingyi Wang, Haozhe Zhao, Yuzhuo Bai, Guanqiao Chen, Kangyang Luo, Gang Chen, Fanchao Qi, Minjia Zhang, Baobao Chang, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Recognizing whether outputs from large language models (LLMs) contain faithfulness hallucination is crucial for real-world applications, e.g., retrieval-augmented generation and summarization. In this paper, we introduce FaithLens, a cost-efficient and effective faithfulness hallucination detection model that can jointly provide binary predictions and corresponding explanations to improve trustworthiness. To achieve this, we first synthesize training data with explanations via advanced LLMs and apply a well-defined data filtering strategy to ensure label correctness, explanation quality, and data diversity. Subsequently, we fine-tune the model on these well-curated training data as a cold start and further optimize it with rule-based reinforcement learning, using rewards for both prediction correctness and explanation quality. Results on 12 diverse tasks show that the 8B-parameter FaithLens outperforms advanced models such as GPT-5.2 and o3. Also, FaithLens can produce high-quality explanations, delivering a distinctive balance of trustworthiness, efficiency, and effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 识别大语言模型输出的内容是否包含“忠实幻觉”对于实际应用至关重要，例如检索增强生成和摘要任务。在本文中，我们介绍了FaithLens模型——一种成本效益高且高效的忠实幻觉检测模型。该模型能够同时提供二元预测及其相应的解释，从而提高模型的可信度。为了实现这一目标，我们首先通过先进的语言模型合成带有解释的训练数据，并采用明确的数据过滤策略来确保标签的准确性、解释的质量以及数据的多样性。随后，我们在这些精心挑选的训练数据上对该模型进行微调，以克服冷启动问题，并通过基于规则的强化学习来进一步优化模型，同时根据预测准确性和解释质量给予奖励。在12种不同的任务上的实验结果表明，参数数量为8B的FaithLens模型的表现优于GPT-5.2和o3等先进模型。此外，FaithLens还能生成高质量的解释，从而在可信度、效率和效果之间实现了独特的平衡。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Escaping the Sisyphus Dilemma: Experience Replay for Robust Text-to-Optimization Modeling
papers.title_zh: 摆脱永无止境的困境：通过经验重放技术实现稳健的文本优化建模
papers.authors: Wantong Xie, Yinghao Chen, Yi-Xiang Hu, Feng Wu, Jieyang Xu, Sijia Zhang, Xiangyang Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models have shown promise in translating natural language into executable optimization models, yet they often suffer from the Sisyphus Dilemma: a memoryless cycle where identical errors are repeated across structurally similar problems. Existing retrieval-augmented strategies primarily fetch static problem-model pairs as few-shot demonstrators, failing to capture the dynamic reasoning required to resolve execution failures. To bridge this gap, we propose EOM, a framework that implements Experience Replay to transform transient rectification steps into persistent knowledge. EOM distills interaction histories into Causal Correction Mappings, indexing both diagnostic insights and prohibitive traps. By utilizing a structure-aware retrieval mechanism that aligns semantic intent with abstract syntax trees and solver tracebacks, the system enables models to recall specific correction strategies for isomorphic errors. Extensive experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate that EOM improves modeling accuracy by 8.45% on complex tasks while reducing token consumption by 28.65% and interaction turns by 25.82%, validating the efficiency of a “Rectify Once, Solve Many” paradigm.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在将自然语言转化为可执行的优化模型方面展现出了巨大潜力。然而，这些模型往往面临“西绪福斯困境”——一种无记忆的循环问题，即相同的错误会在结构相似的问题中不断重复出现。现有的基于检索增强的策略主要使用静态的问题-模型对作为少量示例来解决问题，但这无法捕捉到解决执行失败所需的动态推理能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了EOM框架。该框架通过实施经验回放技术，将短暂的纠正步骤转化为持久的知识。EOM将交互历史提炼为因果修正映射，同时记录诊断性见解和潜在的陷阱。通过采用一种结构感知的检索机制，该系统能够将语义意图与抽象语法树以及求解器回溯信息相结合，使模型能够回忆起针对同构错误的特定纠正策略。在七个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，EOM在复杂任务上的建模准确率提高了8.45%，同时减少了28.65%的令牌消耗和25.82%的交互次数，这验证了“一次性纠正，多次解决”这一高效解决方案的有效性。

papers.title: Toward Automated Robustness Evaluation of Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 关于数学推理的自动化鲁棒性评估
papers.authors: Yutao Hou, Zeguan Xiao, Fei Yu, Yihan Jiang, Ma Shuguang, Zhaoqian Dai, Hailiang Huang, Yun Chen, Guanhua Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in various reasoning-intensive tasks. However, these models exhibit unexpected brittleness, often failing on simple variations of the same underlying task. Existing robustness evaluations predominantly rely on hand-crafted templates or a limited set of perturbation rules. Consequently, such approaches lack the adaptability to probe latent vulnerabilities unique to specific models and remain susceptible to data contamination. To address this, we propose the Math Stress Tester (MaSTer), an automated framework inspired by software stress testing. MaSTer generates adversarial variants via a multi-round rewrite-verify loop, ensuring semantic consistency while successfully inducing model failure. Our framework generates benchmark variants dynamically for each LLM, thus minimizing the risk of data contamination. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH-500 demonstrate the effectiveness of MaSTer on mathematical tasks. Additionally, we validate the framework’s extensibility to non-mathematical tasks, highlighting its broad applicability. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the synthesized variants generated by MaSTer can be utilized as a fine-tuning dataset to significantly enhance the model’s robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在各种需要推理能力的任务中展现出了卓越的能力。然而，这些模型却表现出意想不到的脆弱性，常常无法应对同一任务的不同变体。现有的鲁棒性评估方法主要依赖于手工设计的模板或有限的扰动规则。因此，这些方法缺乏针对特定模型所特有的潜在漏洞进行探测的能力，同时也容易受到数据污染的影响。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了Math Stress Tester（MaSTer）这一自动化框架，该框架借鉴了软件压力测试的理念。MaSTer通过多轮重写与验证的过程生成对抗性变体，从而确保语义的一致性，同时成功引发模型的故障。我们的框架能够动态地为每个语言模型生成基准变体，从而最大限度地降低数据污染的风险。在GSM8K和MATH-500上的实验表明，MaSTer在数学任务上的有效性得到了验证。此外，我们还验证了该框架对非数学任务的扩展性，从而凸显了其广泛的适用性。更重要的是，我们发现由MaSTer生成的合成变体可以作为微调数据集，有效提升模型的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Simulating Crisis Cognition: A Computational Framework for Hypothesis Generation in Crisis Communication
papers.title_zh: 模拟危机认知：一种用于危机沟通中假设生成的计算框架
papers.authors: Changsen Yuan, Yanghao Zhou, Chong Feng, Ge Shi
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fidelity in simulating social dynamics, yet using them to inform high-stakes crisis policy requires rigorous causal evaluation. We introduce CRISIS COGNITION, a framework rooted in generative Structural Causal Models (SCM) that functions as an in-silico hypothesis generator. By coupling real-world telemetry with 1,813 agents, we conduct a counterfactual simulation to evaluate communication strategies. Unlike prior descriptive work, we employ a Stratified Analysis to strictly control for personality confounders. Our simulations generate a computational hypothesis: within the LLM’s generative process, emotional scaffolding serves as a functional prerequisite to unlock valid reasoning paths for high-neuroticism agents. Crucially, we identify a “Sedative Effect” in simultaneous interventions, confirming that the sequence of support is as vital as the content. This framework provides a rigorous testbed for evaluating strategies before human-subject trials.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在模拟社会动态方面表现出惊人的准确性，但将其用于制定高风险的危机政策时，需要严格的因果评估。我们提出了“危机认知”框架，该框架基于生成式结构因果模型，可作为一种计算机内部的假设生成工具。通过将现实世界的遥测数据与1,813个代理相结合，我们进行反事实模拟以评估不同的沟通策略。与以往的描述性研究不同，我们采用分层分析方法来严格控制人格因素对结果的影响。我们的模拟结果提出了一个计算性假设：在语言模型的生成过程中，情感支持是开启高神经质个体有效推理路径的必要条件。关键的是，我们发现同时进行的干预措施中存在一种“镇静效应”，这证实了支持的顺序与内容同样重要。这一框架为在人类受试者试验之前评估策略提供了严格的测试平台。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MedScore: Generalizable Factuality Evaluation of Open-ended Long-form Medical Answers by Domain-adapted Claim Decomposition and Verification
papers.title_zh: MedScore：一种基于领域自适应分类和验证技术的、可推广的开放式医学问题解答真实性评估方法
papers.authors: Heyuan Huang, Alexandra DeLucia, Vijay Murari Tiyyala, Mark Dredze
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate fluent and convincing responses, they are not necessarily correct. This is especially apparent in the popular decompose-then-verify factuality evaluation pipeline, where LLMs evaluate generated text by decomposing it into individual, valid claims. Factuality evaluation is especially important for medical answers, since incorrect medical information could seriously harm the patient. However, existing factuality systems are a poor match for the medical domain, as they are typically only evaluated on objective, entity-centric, formulaic texts such as biographies and historical topics. This differs from condition-dependent, conversational, hypothetical, sentence-structure diverse, and subjective medical answers, making decomposition into valid facts challenging. We propose MedScore, a new pipeline to decompose medical answers into condition-aware valid facts and verify against in-domain corpora. Our method extracts up to three times as many valid facts as existing methods, reducing hallucination and vague references, and retaining condition-dependency in facts. We also find MedScore is generalizable to non-medical domains without any specific tuning. The resulting factuality score substantially varies by decomposition method, verification corpus, and used backbone LLM, highlighting the importance of customizing each step for reliable factuality evaluation by using our generalizable and modularized pipeline for domain adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型能够生成流畅且令人信服的回答，但这些回答并不一定正确。这一点在流行的“先分解再验证”的事实性评估流程中表现得尤为明显——在这种流程中，语言模型通过将生成的文本分解为一个个独立的、有效的陈述来评估其质量。对于医学领域的回答来说，事实性评估尤为重要，因为错误的医学信息可能会给患者带来严重的伤害。然而，现有的事实性评估系统并不适合医学领域，因为它们通常只针对客观、以实体为中心、具有固定格式的文本进行评估，比如传记或历史类文章。这与基于情境的、对话式的、假设性的、结构复杂的以及主观的医学回答截然不同，因此将医学回答分解为有效的事实变得非常困难。我们提出了MedScore这一新方法，它能够将医学回答分解为考虑情境的有效事实，并针对特定领域的数据集进行验证。我们的方法能够提取出比现有方法多三倍的有效事实，从而减少幻觉和模糊的表述，同时保留事实中的情境依赖性。此外，我们发现MedScore可以广泛应用于非医学领域，而无需进行任何特殊调整。不同的分解方法、验证数据集以及所使用的语言模型都会显著影响事实性评分的结果，这凸显了为可靠的事实性评估定制每个步骤的重要性。通过使用这种通用且模块化的方法，我们可以实现领域适应的事实性评估。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: FinSafetyBench: Evaluating LLM Safety in Real-World Financial Scenarios
papers.title_zh: FinSafetyBench：在现实金融场景中评估大型语言模型的安全性
papers.authors: Yutao Hou, Yihan Jiang, Yuhan Xie, Jian Yang, Liwen Zhang, Hailiang Huang, Guanhua Chen, Yun Chen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in financial scenarios. However, they may produce harmful outputs, including facilitating illegal activities or unethical behavior, posing serious compliance risks. To systematically evaluate LLM safety in finance, we propose FinSafetyBench, a bilingual (English-Chinese) red-teaming benchmark designed to test an LLM’s refusal of requests that violate financial compliance. Grounded in real-world financial crime cases and ethics standards, the benchmark comprises 14 subcategories spanning financial crimes and ethical violations. Through extensive experiments on general-purpose and finance-specialized LLMs under three representative attack settings, we identify critical vulnerabilities that allow adversarial prompts to bypass compliance safeguards. Further analysis reveals stronger susceptibility in Chinese contexts and highlights the limitations of prompt-level defenses against sophisticated or implicit manipulation strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在金融领域的应用日益广泛。然而，这些模型可能会产生有害的输出，包括助长非法活动或不道德行为，从而带来严重的合规风险。为了系统地评估语言模型在金融领域的安全性，我们提出了FinSafetyBench这一双语（英语-中文）的对抗性测试基准，旨在检验语言模型对违反金融合规要求的请求的拒绝能力。该基准基于真实的金融犯罪案例和伦理标准，包含14个子类别，涵盖金融犯罪和伦理违规行为。通过对通用语言模型和金融专业语言模型在三种代表性攻击场景下的实验分析，我们发现了一些关键漏洞，这些漏洞使得敌对提示能够绕过合规保护措施。进一步的分析表明，在中文环境中，模型更容易受到攻击，这也凸显了针对复杂或隐式操纵策略的提示级防御措施的局限性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Optimizing Native Sparse Attention with Latent Attention and Local Global Alternating Strategies
papers.title_zh: 利用潜式注意力机制与局部全局交替策略来优化原生稀疏注意力机制
papers.authors: Yuxuan Hu, Jianchao Tan, Jiaqi Zhang, Wen Zan, Pingwei Sun, Yifan Lu, Xunliang Cai, Jing Zhang
papers.abstract: In this work, we conduct a systematic analysis of Native Sparse Attention (NSA) and propose targeted improvements that enhance long-context modeling. A key insight is that alternating between local (sliding-window) and global (compression/selective) attention across layers, rather than using fixed patterns, enables more effective propagation of long-range dependencies and substantially boosts performance on long-sequence tasks. Meanwhile, we further refine NSA’s branches with Latent Attention that the sliding-window branch is enhanced with Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) while compression and selective branches adopt Group-head Latent Attention (GLA). These changes reduce KV-cache memory by 50% versus NSA while improving the model’s common-sense reasoning and long-text understanding capabilities. Experiments on models from 340M to 1.3B parameters (trained on 15B and 100B tokens) show our method matches or exceeds full attention and native sparse attention in both common-sense reasoning and long-context understanding tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，我们对原生稀疏注意力机制进行了系统分析，并提出了一些有针对性的改进措施，以提升长上下文建模能力。我们的关键发现是：通过在不同层次之间交替使用局部注意力（滑动窗口方式）和全局注意力（压缩/选择性处理），而不是采用固定的模式，可以更有效地传播长距离依赖关系，从而显著提升长序列任务的性能。此外，我们还对原生稀疏注意力机制的各个分支进行了优化：滑动窗口分支通过多头潜在注意力机制得到增强，而压缩和选择性处理分支则采用了群体头部潜在注意力机制。这些改进使得模型的KV缓存内存减少了50%，同时提升了模型的常识推理能力和长文本理解能力。在参数数量从3.4亿到13亿、分别使用150亿和1000亿词元进行训练的模型上，实验表明，我们的方法在常识推理和长上下文理解任务中，其性能与全注意力机制和原生稀疏注意力机制相当甚至更优。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: BRIEF-Pro: Universal Context Compression with Short-to-Long Synthesis for Fast and Accurate Multi-Hop Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 摘要：通用上下文压缩技术结合短长合成方法，以实现快速且准确的多跳推理
papers.authors: Jia-Chen Gu, Junyi Zhang, Di Wu, Yuankai Li, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng
papers.abstract: As retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) tackles complex tasks, increasingly expanded contexts offer richer information, but at the cost of higher latency and increased cognitive load on the model. To mitigate this bottleneck, especially for intricate multi-hop questions, we introduce BRIEF-Pro. It is a universal, lightweight compressor that distills relevant evidence for a given query from retrieved documents into a concise summary for seamless integration into in-context RAG. Using seed data consisting of relatively short contexts (fewer than 1k words), BRIEF-Pro is trained to perform abstractive compression of extended contexts exceeding 10k words across a wide range of scenarios. Furthermore, BRIEF-Pro offers flexible user control over summary length by allowing users to specify the desired number of sentences. Experiments on four open-domain multi-hop question-answering datasets show that BRIEF-Pro generates more concise and relevant summaries, enhancing performance across small, large, and proprietary language models. With the 70B reader model, 32× compression by BRIEF-Pro improves QA performance by 4.67% on average over LongLLMLingua’s 9×, while requiring only 23% of its computational overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着检索增强生成技术在处理复杂任务方面的应用越来越广泛，所获取的信息也变得更加丰富。然而，这种技术进步也带来了更高的延迟以及模型更大的认知负担。为了缓解这一瓶颈问题，尤其是在处理复杂的多跳问题时，我们提出了BRIEF-Pro算法。这是一种通用的、轻量级的压缩工具，它能够从检索到的文档中提炼出与特定查询相关的内容，将其压缩成简洁的摘要，从而无缝地融入上下文中的检索增强生成系统。通过使用由相对较短的上下文构成的训练数据（少于1000字），BRIEF-Pro能够实现对超过10000字的扩展上下文的抽象性压缩。此外，BRIEF-Pro还允许用户灵活控制摘要的长度，用户可以指定所需的句子数量。在四个开放式的多跳问答数据集上的实验表明，BRIEF-Pro生成的摘要更加简洁且相关，无论是在小型语言模型、大型语言模型还是专有语言模型中，其性能都得到了提升。对于70B规模的阅读模型而言，使用BRIEF-Pro可以实现32倍的压缩效果，平均而言，其问答性能提升了4.67%，同时仅需要其计算开销的23%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: O1-Pruner: Length-Harmonizing Fine-Tuning for O1-Like Reasoning Pruning
papers.title_zh: O1剪枝器：用于优化长度与和谐性的精细调整，以支持类似O1的推理剪枝算法
papers.authors: Haotian Luo, Haiying He, Yibo Wang, Shiwei Liu, Wei Li, Xiaochun Cao, Dacheng Tao, Naiqiang Tan, Li Shen
papers.abstract: Recently, long-thought reasoning LLMs, such as OpenAI’s O1, adopt extended reasoning processes similar to how humans ponder over complex problems. This reasoning paradigm significantly enhances the model’s problem-solving abilities and achieves promising results. However, long-thought reasoning process leads to a substantial increase in inference time. A pressing challenge is reducing the inference overhead of long-thought LLMs while ensuring accuracy. In this paper, we identify that long-thought reasoning models struggle to effectively allocate token budgets based on problem difficulty and reasoning redundancies. To address this, we propose Length-Harmonizing Fine-Tuning (O1-Pruner), aiming at minimizing reasoning overhead while maintaining accuracy. This effective fine-tuning method first estimates the LLM’s baseline performance through pre-sampling and then uses RL-style fine-tuning to encourage the model to generate shorter reasoning processes under accuracy constraints. This allows the model to achieve efficient reasoning with lower redundancy while maintaining accuracy. Experiments on various mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that O1-Pruner not only significantly reduces inference overhead but also achieves higher accuracy, providing a novel and promising solution to this challenge.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，那些被长期认为具有推理能力的大语言模型，比如OpenAI的O1模型，开始采用类似于人类思考复杂问题的扩展推理过程。这种推理方式显著提升了模型的解决问题的能力，并取得了令人满意的效果。然而，这种复杂的推理过程会导致推理时间大幅增加。因此，一个紧迫的挑战就是如何在保证准确性的前提下，减少这些大语言模型的推理开销。在本文中，我们发现这些基于长推理过程的模型在根据问题难度分配标记预算以及处理推理冗余方面存在困难。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“长度协调式微调”（O1-Pruner）的方法，旨在在保持准确性的同时，最大限度地减少推理开销。这种有效的微调方法首先通过预采样来估算模型的基本性能，然后采用强化学习风格的微调技术，促使模型在保持准确性约束的情况下生成更短的推理过程。这样，模型就能在保持准确性的同时，实现高效的推理。在多种数学推理基准测试中的实验表明，O1-Pruner不仅显著降低了推理开销，还提高了准确性，为这一挑战提供了新颖且富有前景的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: One Agent to Serve All: a Lite-Adaptive Stylized AI Assistant for Millions of Multi-Style Official Accounts
papers.title_zh: 一款能够服务于众多风格各异的官方账号的智能助手：轻量级、自适应型的人工智能工具，适用于数百万个官方账号
papers.authors: Xingyu Fan, Li Feifei, Que Wenhui, Hailong Li
papers.abstract: Conversational agents deployed in industrial-scale official account platforms must generate responses that are both contextually grounded and stylistically aligned—requirements that existing methods struggle to meet. Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting induces significant latency due to multi-turn reasoning; per-account fine-tuning is computationally prohibitive; and long prompt-based methods degrade the model’s ability to grasp injected context and style. In this paper, we propose WeStar, a lite-adaptive framework for stylized contextual question answering that scales to millions of official accounts. Our contributions are fourfold: (1) We introduce WeStar, a unified framework capable of serving large volumes of official accounts with minimal overhead. (2) We propose a multi-dimensional, cluster-based parameter sharing scheme that enables compact style representation while preserving stylistic diversity. (3) We develop a style-enhanced Direct Preference Optimization (SeDPO) method to optimize each style cluster’s parameters for improved generation quality. (4) Experiments on a large-scale industrial dataset validate the effectiveness and efficiency of WeStar, underscoring its pracitical value in real-world deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 在工业规模的官方账号平台上部署的对话式智能体必须生成既符合上下文要求又具有一致风格的回答——这些要求现有的方法难以满足。基于思维链提示的方法由于需要多次推理而会导致显著的延迟；针对单个账号进行微调在计算上非常耗费资源；而基于长提示的方法则会降低模型理解注入的上下文和风格的能力。在本文中，我们提出了WeStar这一轻量级自适应框架，该框架能够适用于数百万个官方账号，用于回答具有特定风格的上下文问题。我们的贡献主要有四个方面：(1) 我们提出了WeStar这一统一框架，它能够以最小的开销为大量官方账号提供服务。(2) 我们提出了一种多维、基于集群的参数共享方案，该方案能够在保持风格多样性的同时，实现紧凑的风格表示。(3) 我们开发了一种风格增强的直接偏好优化方法，用于优化每个风格集群的参数，从而提高生成质量。(4) 在大规模工业数据集上的实验验证了WeStar的有效性和效率，凸显了其在实际部署中的实用价值。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SAVOIR: Learning Social Savoir-Faire via Shapley-based Reward Attribution
papers.title_zh: 社交能力：通过Shapley算法实现社交礼仪的学习
papers.authors: Xiachong Feng, Yi Jiang, Xiaocheng Feng, Deyi Yin, Libo Qin, Yangfan Ye, Lei Huang, Weitao Ma, Yuxuan Gu, Chonghan Qin, Bing Qin, Lingpeng Kong
papers.abstract: Social intelligence, the ability to navigate complex interpersonal interactions, presents a fundamental challenge for language agents. Training such agents via reinforcement learning requires solving the credit assignment problem: determining how individual utterances contribute to multi-turn dialogue outcomes. Existing approaches directly employ language models to distribute episode-level rewards, yielding attributions that are retrospective and lack theoretical grounding. We propose SAVOIR (ShApley Value fOr SocIal RL), a novel principled framework grounded in cooperative game theory. Our approach combines two complementary principles: expected utility shifts evaluation from retrospective attribution to prospective valuation, capturing an utterance’s strategic potential for enabling favorable future trajectories; Shapley values ensure fair credit distribution with axiomatic guarantees of efficiency, symmetry, and marginality. Experiments on the SOTOPIA benchmark demonstrate that SAVOIR achieves new state-of-the-art performance across all evaluation settings, with our 7B model matching or exceeding proprietary models including GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. Notably, even large reasoning models consistently underperform, suggesting social intelligence requires qualitatively different capabilities than analytical reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交智能，即处理复杂人际互动的能力，对语言代理来说是一个根本性的挑战。通过强化学习来训练这类代理，需要解决信用分配问题：确定各个发言对多轮对话结果有何贡献。现有的方法直接利用语言模型来分配情节层面的奖励，但这种分配方式具有回顾性，且缺乏理论依据。我们提出了SAVOIR（社交强化学习中的Shapley值），这是一个基于合作博弈论的新颖框架。我们的方法结合了两种互补的原则：期望效用原则将评估从回顾性归因转向前瞻性估值，从而捕捉出某个发言在促进未来良好发展态势方面的战略潜力；Shapley值则确保了公平信用分配，同时具备效率、对称性和边际性的公理保证。在SOTOPIA基准测试上的实验表明，SAVOIR在所有评估环境下都取得了领先的性能，我们的70亿参数模型的表现与包括GPT-4o和Claude-3.5-Sonnet在内的专有模型相当甚至更优。值得注意的是，即使是大型推理模型的表现也普遍较差，这表明社交智能所需的能力与分析性推理截然不同。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Language-Coupled Reinforcement Learning for Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 基于语言结合的强化学习，用于多语言检索增强型生成
papers.authors: Rui Qi, Fengran Mo, Yufeng Chen, Xue Zhang, Shuo Wang, Hongliang Li, Xu Jinan, Meng Jiang, Jian-Yun Nie, Kaiyu Huang
papers.abstract: Multilingual retrieval-augmented generation (MRAG) requires models to effectively acquire and integrate beneficial external knowledge from multilingual collections. However, most existing studies employ a unitive process where queries of equivalent semantics across different languages are processed through a single-turn retrieval and subsequent optimization. Such a “one-size-fits-all” strategy is often suboptimal in multilingual settings, as the models occur to knowledge bias and conflict during the interaction with the search engine. To alleviate the issues, we propose LcRL, a multilingual search-augmented reinforcement learning framework that integrates a language-coupled Group Relative Policy Optimization into the policy and reward models. We adopt the language-coupled group sampling in the rollout module to reduce knowledge bias, and regularize an auxiliary anti-consistency penalty in the reward models to mitigate the knowledge conflict. Experimental results demonstrate that not only achieves competitive performance but is also appropriate for various practical scenarios such as constrained training data and retrieval over collections encompassing a large number of languages. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LcRL-B4EF.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言检索增强生成（MRAG）要求模型能够有效地获取并整合来自多种语言集合中的有益外部知识。然而，大多数现有研究采用一种统一的处理方式，即不同语言中语义相同的查询通过一次性的检索和后续优化来处理。这种“一刀切”的策略在多语言环境中往往效果不佳，因为模型在与搜索引擎交互过程中可能会出现知识偏差和冲突。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了LcRL这一多语言搜索增强强化学习框架，该框架将语言耦合的群体相对策略优化机制融入到策略和奖励模型中。我们在展开模块中采用了语言耦合的群体采样方法来减少知识偏差，并在奖励模型中引入了辅助的一致性惩罚机制来减轻知识冲突。实验结果表明，该方法不仅取得了具有竞争力的性能，而且适用于各种实际场景，例如训练数据有限的情况，以及需要检索包含大量语言的集合的情况。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LcRL-B4EF获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Article and Comment Frames Shape the Quality of Online Comments
papers.title_zh: 文章与评论的框架决定了网络评论的质量
papers.authors: Matteo Guida, Yulia Otmakhova, Eduard Hovy, Lea Frermann
papers.abstract: Framing theory posits that how information is presented shapes audience responses, but computational work has largely ignored audience reactions. While recent work has shown that article framing systematically shapes the content of reader responses, this paper asks: does framing also affect response quality? Analyzing 1M comments across 2.7K news articles, we operationalize quality as comment health. We find that article frames significantly predict comment health while controlling for topic, and that comments that adopt the article frame are healthier than those that depart from it. Further, unhealthy top-level comments tend to generate more unhealthy responses, independent of the frame being used in the comment. Our results establish a link between framing theory and discourse quality, laying the groundwork for downstream applications. We illustrate this potential with a pro-active frame-aware LLM- based system to mitigate unhealthy discourse.
papers.abstract_zh: 框架理论认为，信息的呈现方式会塑造受众的反应，但计算研究大多忽略了受众的反馈。虽然最近的研究表明，文章框架会系统性地影响读者反馈的内容，但本文提出了一个问题：框架是否也会影响反馈的质量呢？通过对2.7千篇新闻文章的100万条评论进行分析，我们将“质量”定义为“评论的健康程度”。我们发现，在控制主题因素的情况下，文章框架能够显著预测评论的健康程度；而且，采用该文章框架的评论比偏离该框架的评论更为健康。此外，那些不健康的高层评论往往会引发更多不健康的反应，而这与评论中使用的框架无关。我们的研究结果证明了框架理论与话语质量之间的联系，为后续的应用提供了基础。我们通过一个基于LLM的主动式框架感知系统来演示这种潜在的应用方式，以缓解不健康的言论。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LAD: Learning Advantage Distribution for Reasoning
papers.title_zh: LAD：用于推理的学习优势分配机制
papers.authors: Wendi Li, Sharon Li
papers.abstract: Current reinforcement learning objectives for large-model reasoning primarily focus on maximizing expected rewards. This paradigm can lead to overfitting to dominant reward signals, while neglecting alternative yet valid reasoning trajectories, thereby limiting diversity and exploration. To address this issue, we introduce Learning Advantage Distributions (LAD), a distribution-matching framework that replaces advantage maximization with learning the advantage-induced distribution. By establishing the equivalence between the optimal policy update and an advantage-based target distribution, we derive a practical LAD objective formulated as minimizing an f-divergence between the policy-induced and advantage-induced distributions. This yields a gradient update that increases likelihood for high-advantage responses while suppressing over-confident probability growth, preventing collapse without requiring auxiliary entropy regularization. LAD incurs no extra training cost compared to GRPO and scales naturally to LLM post-training. In a controlled bandit setting, LAD faithfully recovers the multimodal advantage distribution, validating the theoretical formulation. Experiments on math and code reasoning tasks across several LLM backbones show that LAD reliably improves both accuracy and generative diversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的大型模型推理强化学习目标主要集中在最大化预期奖励上。这种范式可能导致过度拟合于主导的奖励信号，而忽视了其他同样有效的推理路径，从而限制了多样性和探索性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了学习优势分布这一框架，该框架用学习由优势引导的分布来替代优势最大化。通过建立最优策略更新与基于优势的目标分布之间的等价性，我们得出了一个实用的LAD目标，即最小化策略诱导分布与优势诱导分布之间的f散度。这样的梯度更新能够增加高优势响应的可能性，同时抑制过度自信的概率增长，从而在不需要辅助熵正则化的情况下防止崩溃。与GRPO相比，LAD没有额外的训练成本，并且可以自然地应用于训练后的LLM。在受控的强盗问题中，LAD能够准确地恢复多模态优势分布，验证了理论上的有效性。在多个LLM框架上的数学和代码推理任务上的实验表明，LAD确实能够提高准确性和生成多样性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: RealMem: Benchmarking LLMs in Real-World Memory-Driven Interaction
papers.title_zh: RealMem：在真实世界的内存驱动交互场景中对大型语言模型进行性能评估
papers.authors: Haonan Bian, Zhiyuan Yao, Sen Hu, Zishan Xu, Shaolei Zhang, Yifu Guo, Ziliang Yang, Xueran Han, Huacan Wang, Ronghao Chen
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve from static dialogue interfaces to autonomous general agents, effective memory is paramount to ensuring long-term consistency. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on casual conversation or task-oriented dialogue, failing to capture “long-term project-oriented” interactions where agents must track evolving goals. To bridge this gap, we introduce RealMem, the first benchmark grounded in realistic project scenarios. RealMem comprises over 2,000 cross-session dialogues across eleven scenarios, utilizing natural user queries for evaluation. We propose a synthesis pipeline that integrates Project Foundation Construction, Multi-Agent Dialogue Generation, and Memory and Schedule Management to simulate the dynamic evolution of memory. Experiments reveal that current memory systems face significant challenges in managing the long-term project states and dynamic context dependencies inherent in real-world projects. Our code and datasets are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/realmem-A1E4.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型从静态对话界面发展到自主通用智能体，有效的记忆机制对于确保长期的一致性至关重要。然而，现有的评估基准主要侧重于随意的对话或任务导向型对话，未能捕捉到智能体需要跟踪不断变化的目标的“长期项目导向型”互动。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了RealMem——首个基于真实项目场景设计的评估基准。RealMem包含超过2000场跨会话对话，涵盖11种不同场景，采用自然用户查询来进行评估。我们提出了一种综合流程，该流程结合了项目基础构建、多智能体对话生成以及记忆和调度管理功能，以模拟记忆的动态演变过程。实验表明，当前的记忆系统在管理长期项目状态以及现实项目中固有的动态上下文依赖关系方面面临重大挑战。我们的代码和数据集可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/realmem-A1E4获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AFMRL: Attribute-Enhanced Fine-Grained Multi-Modal Representation Learning in E-commerce
papers.title_zh: 属性增强的细粒度多模态表示学习在电子商务中的应用
papers.authors: Biao Zhang, Lixin Chen, Bin Zhang, Wang Zongwei, Tong Liu, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: Multimodal representation is crucial for E-commerce tasks such as identical product retrieval. Large representation models (e.g., VLM2Vec) demonstrate strong multimodal understanding capabilities, yet they struggle with fine-grained semantic comprehension, which is essential for distinguishing highly similar items. To address this, we propose Attribute-Enhanced Fine-Grained Multi-Modal Representation Learning (AFMRL), which defines product fine-grained understanding as an attribute generation task. It leverages the generative power of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to extract key attributes from product images and text, and enhances representation learning through a two-stage training framework: 1) Attribute-Guided Contrastive Learning (AGCL), where the key attributes generated by the MLLM are used in the image-text contrastive learning training process to identify hard samples and filter out noisy false negatives. 2) Retrieval-aware Attribute Reinforcement (RAR), where the improved retrieval performance of the representation model post-attribute integration serves as a reward signal to enhance MLLM’s attribute generation during multimodal fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on large-scale E-commerce datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple downstream retrieval tasks, validating the effectiveness of harnessing generative models to advance fine-grained representation learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态表示对于电子商务任务中的相似产品检索至关重要。大型表示模型（例如VLM2Vec）表现出强大的多模态理解能力，但它们在精细语义理解方面存在困难，而这一点对于区分高度相似的物品非常重要。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“属性增强的细粒度多模态表示学习”的方法。该方法将产品的细粒度理解定义为一个属性生成任务。它利用多模态大语言模型的生成能力，从产品图片和文本中提取关键属性，并通过两阶段训练框架来增强表示学习：1）属性引导对比学习，其中由大语言模型生成的的关键属性被用于图像-文本对比学习训练过程，以识别难处理的样本并过滤掉噪声假阴性；2）检索感知属性强化，通过属性整合后表示模型的改进检索性能作为奖励信号，来提升大语言模型在多模态微调过程中的属性生成能力。在大规模电子商务数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在多个下游检索任务中取得了最先进的性能，这验证了利用生成模型推进细粒度表示学习的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SAFER: A Controllable Safeguard for LLMs against Backdoor Attacks
papers.title_zh: SAFER：一种可控制的防御机制，用于保护大语言模型免受后门攻击的影响
papers.authors: Zirui Hu, Zheng Zhang, Yingjie Wang, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of natural language processing (NLP) tasks. However, they remain susceptible to backdoor attacks, where adversaries embed hidden triggers in the input to induce malicious, attacker-specified behaviors. While existing inference-time defenses aim to mitigate such threats by detecting and filtering poisoned inputs, they often lack explicit control over the false acceptance rate (FAR)—a critical requirement in safety-sensitive settings where even rare failures can lead to catastrophic consequences. To address this challenge, we propose SAFER, a novel inference-time defense framework that provides explicit and provable control over FAR without requiring prior knowledge of backdoor samples. SAFER leverages distributional information from available data to estimate the likelihood that an input is clean and selects inputs accordingly. From a theoretical perspective, we demonstrate that SAFER asymptotically guarantees control of the true FAR. Empirical evaluations on three benchmark datasets across diverse backdoor attack scenarios show that SAFER consistently achieves reliable FAR control while maintaining high detection power, significantly outperforming existing inference-time defenses.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在众多自然语言处理任务中取得了显著的性能表现。然而，它们仍然容易受到后门攻击的威胁——攻击者会在输入数据中嵌入隐藏的触发器，以诱导出恶意的行为。现有的推理时间防御机制旨在通过检测和过滤被污染的输入来减轻这种威胁，但这些机制往往无法有效控制误识别率——在需要高度安全性的环境中，即使是罕见的误识别也可能导致灾难性后果。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了SAFER这一新型推理时间防御框架。该框架能够明确且可证明地控制误识别率，而无需事先了解后门样本的信息。SAFER利用现有数据中的分布信息来估计输入数据的清洁程度，并据此选择合适的输入。从理论角度来看，我们证明了SAFER能够渐进式地控制真实的误识别率。在三个基准数据集上进行的实证评估表明，SAFER能够在保持高检测能力的同时，始终实现可靠的误识别率控制，其性能明显优于现有的推理时间防御机制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RIFT: Repurposing Negative Samples via Reward-Informed Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: RIFT：通过奖励驱动的微调技术重新利用负样本数据
papers.authors: Zehua Liu, Shuqi Liu, Tao Zhong, Mingxuan Yuan
papers.abstract: While Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning (RFT) are standard for LLM alignment, they either rely on costly expert data or discard valuable negative samples, leading to data inefficiency. To address this, we propose Reward Informed Fine-Tuning (RIFT), a simple yet effective framework that utilizes all self-generated samples. Unlike the hard thresholding of RFT, RIFT repurposes negative trajectories, reweighting the loss with scalar rewards to learn from both the positive and negative trajectories from the model outputs. To overcome the training collapse caused by naive reward integration, where direct multiplication yields an unbounded loss, we introduce a stabilized loss formulation that ensures numerical robustness and optimization efficiency. Extensive experiments on mathematical benchmarks across various base models show that RIFT consistently outperforms RFT. Our results demonstrate that RIFT is a robust and data-efficient alternative for alignment using mixed-quality, self-generated data.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然监督微调（SFT）和拒绝采样微调（RFT）是LLM对齐的标准方法，但它们要么依赖昂贵的专家数据，要么会丢弃有价值的负面样本，从而导致数据利用效率低下。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了奖励信息驱动的微调（RIFT）方法。这是一种简单而有效的框架，它利用所有自生成的样本。与RFT的硬阈值处理不同，RIFT重新利用负面轨迹，通过标量奖励来重新调整损失函数，从而可以从模型输出的正面和负面轨迹中学习到更多信息。为了克服由于简单奖励整合导致的训练崩溃问题——直接相乘会导致无界的损失——我们引入了一种稳定的损失公式，以确保数值的鲁棒性和优化的效率。在多种基础模型上的数学基准测试中进行的广泛实验表明，RIFT始终优于RFT。我们的结果表明，RIFT是一种稳健且高效的数据利用替代方案，适用于使用混合质量、自生成数据的对齐任务。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LEPO: Latent Reasoning Policy Optimization for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: LEPO：用于大型语言模型的潜在推理策略优化
papers.authors: Yuyan Zhou, Jiarui Yu, Hande Dong, Zhezheng Hao, Hong Wang, Jianqing Zhang, Qiang Lin
papers.abstract: Recently, latent reasoning has been introduced into large language models (LLMs) to leverage rich information within a continuous space.However, without stochastic sampling, these methods inevitably collapse to deterministic inference, failing to discover diverse reasoning paths.To bridge the gap, we inject controllable stochasticity into latent reasoning via Gumbel-Softmax, restoring LLMs’ exploratory capacity and enhancing their compatibility with Reinforcement Learning (RL).Building on this, we propose Latent Reasoning Policy Optimization (LEPO), a novel framework that applies RL directly to continuous latent representations.Specifically, in rollout stage, LEPO maintains stochasticity to enable diverse trajectory sampling, while in optimization stage, LEPO constructs a unified gradient estimation for both latent representations and discrete tokens.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，潜式推理被引入到大语言模型中，以利用连续空间中的丰富信息。然而，如果没有随机采样，这些方法最终会陷入确定性推理，无法发现多样化的推理路径。为了填补这一空白，我们通过Gumbel-Softmax技术将可控的随机性融入潜式推理中，从而恢复大语言模型的探索能力，并增强其与强化学习之间的兼容性。在此基础上，我们提出了潜式推理策略优化方法，这是一种将强化学习直接应用于连续潜式表示的新框架。具体来说，在滚动阶段，LEPO保持随机性，以实现多样化的轨迹采样；而在优化阶段，LEPO为潜式表示和离散标记构建统一的梯度估计方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: You Never Know a Person, You Only Know Their Defenses: Detecting Levels of Psychological Defense Mechanisms in Supportive Conversations
papers.title_zh: 你永远无法真正了解一个人，你只能了解他们的防御机制：在支持性的对话中识别心理防御机制的水平
papers.authors: Hongbin Na, Zimu Wang, Zhaoming Chen, Peilin Zhou, Yining Hua, Grace Ziqi Zhou, Haiyang Zhang, Tao Shen, Wei Wang, John Torous, Shaoxiong Ji, Ling Chen
papers.abstract: Psychological defenses are strategies, often automatic, that people use to manage distress. Rigid use or overuse of defenses is negatively linked to mental health and shapes what speakers disclose and how they accept or resist help. However, defenses are complex and difficult to reliably measure, particularly in clinical dialogues. We introduce PsyDefConv, a dialogue corpus with help seeker utterances labeled for defense level, and DMRS Co-Pilot, a four-stage pipeline that provides evidence-based pre-annotations. The corpus contains 200 dialogues and 4,709 utterances, including 2,336 help seeker turns, with double-blind labeling reaching Cohen’s kappa of 0.639. In a counterbalanced study, the co-pilot reduced average annotation time by 24.0%. In expert review, it averaged 4.62 for evidence supportiveness, 4.44 for clinical plausibility, and 4.40 for insight on a seven-point scale. Benchmarks with strong large language models (LLMs) in zero-shot and fine-tuning settings demonstrate clear headroom, with the best macro F1-score around 30% and a tendency to overpredict mature defenses. Corpus analyses confirm that mature defenses are most common and reveal emotion-specific deviations. We release the corpus, annotations, code, and prompts to support research on defensive functioning in language.
papers.abstract_zh: 心理防御机制是人们用来应对痛苦的一种策略，通常这种机制是自动发生的。过度依赖或滥用防御机制会对心理健康产生负面影响，并且会影响人们表达的内容以及他们接受或拒绝帮助的方式。然而，防御机制非常复杂，很难进行可靠的测量，尤其是在临床对话中。我们引入了PsyDefConv这一对话语料库，其中包含了被标记为防御级别的求助者话语；同时，我们还开发了DMRS Co-Pilot这一四阶段流程，它能够提供基于证据的预注释结果。该语料库包含200段对话和4,709条话语，其中包括2,336次求助者的发言。双盲标记的结果显示，Co-Pilot的准确率达到了0.639（根据Cohen’s kappa系数衡量）。在一项对比研究中，Co-Pilot将平均注释时间减少了24.0%。在专家评审中，该工具的平均证据支持度为4.62，临床合理性为4.44，而洞察力则达到了4.40（满分7分）。与强大的大语言模型进行的基准测试表明，该工具仍有很大的提升空间。在零样本训练和微调模式下，该工具的最佳宏观F1分数约为30%，并且倾向于过度预测成熟防御机制的表现。语料库分析还表明，成熟防御机制最为常见，同时还存在与特定情绪相关的偏差现象。我们已将该语料库、注释代码以及提示文件公开，以支持关于语言中的防御机制功能的研究工作。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Length Scaling: Synergizing Breadth and Depth for Generative Reward Models
papers.title_zh: 超越长度缩放问题：如何结合宽度与深度以打造高效的生成式奖励模型
papers.authors: Qiyuan Zhang, Yufei Wang, Tianhe Wu, Can Xu, Qingfeng Sun, Kai Zheng, Xue Liu, Chen Ma
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Generative Reward Models (GRMs) have demonstrated that scaling the length of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning considerably enhances the reliability of evaluation. However, current works predominantly rely on unstructured length scaling, ignoring the divergent efficacy of different reasoning mechanisms: Breadth-CoT (multi-dimensional principle coverage) and Depth-CoT (substantive judgment soundness). To address this, we introduce Mix-GRM, a framework that reconfigures raw rationales into structured Breadth-CoT and Depth-CoT through a modular synthesis pipeline, subsequently employing Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to internalize and optimize these mechanisms. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Mix-GRM establishes a new state-of-the-art across five benchmarks, surpassing leading open-source RMs by an average of 8.2%. Our results reveal a clear divergence in reasoning: Breadth-CoT benefits subjective preference tasks, whereas Depth-CoT excels in objective correctness tasks. Consequently, misaligning the reasoning mechanism with the task directly degrades performance. Furthermore, we demonstrate that RLVR acts as a switching amplifier, inducing an emergent polarization where the model spontaneously allocates its reasoning style to match task demands.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在生成式奖励模型方面的研究进展表明，大幅延长思维链推理的长度能够显著提高评估的可靠性。然而，目前的研究大多依赖于非结构化的长度调整方式，而忽视了不同推理机制之间的效果差异：广度思维链推理（多维原则覆盖）与深度思维链推理（实质性判断准确性）。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了Mix-GRM框架。该框架通过模块化合成流程，将原始推理内容重新转化为结构化的广度思维链推理和深度思维链推理形式。随后，我们利用监督式微调技术和带有可验证奖励的强化学习技术，来优化这些推理机制。全面的实验结果表明，Mix-GRM在五个基准测试中的表现均达到了新的最优水平，平均比领先的开源推理模型高出8.2%。我们的研究结果揭示了推理机制之间的明显差异：广度思维链推理更适合处理主观偏好任务，而深度思维链推理则更适用于处理客观正确性任务。因此，如果推理机制与任务需求不匹配，性能就会直接下降。此外，我们还发现，带有可验证奖励的强化学习技术可以作为一种“切换放大器”，促使模型自动调整其推理风格以符合任务需求。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Pushing the Limits of LLM Tool Calling via Experiential Knowledge Integration and Activation
papers.title_zh: 通过整合体验式知识来突破大型语言模型工具调用的极限
papers.authors: Yupu Hao, Zhuoran Jin, Huanxuan Liao, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) rely on tool use to act as autonomous agents, yet often fail in multi-step execution due to insufficient tool-related knowledge and ineffective knowledge activation. Therefore, we present a systematic study on how knowledge influences tool-use performance, covering the stages of knowledge acquisition, activation, and internalization. In the knowledge acquisition stage, we acquire and evaluate various forms of experiential knowledge, and our analysis shows that simple instance-level knowledge can already provide strong and reliable gains, while abstract intent-level knowledge offers limited benefits. At inference time, to activate knowledge, we find that prompting LLM to expand the depth of reasoning yields diminishing returns, whereas expanding the width of reasoning by parallel sampling with aggregation more effectively activates latent experiential knowledge. At training time, for knowledge internalization, post-training with knowledge-augmented data further improves performance, with reinforcement learning outperforming supervised fine-tuning. Based on these insights, we propose the Knowledge-Augmented Tool Execution (KATE), a knowledge-augmented tool execution framework that integrates experiential knowledge with reasoning-width-expanded inference and knowledge-aware training. Experiments on BFCL-V3 and AppWorld demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements over strong baselines across model scales. Our Code is available at https://github.com/hypasd-art/KATE.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）依赖工具使用来充当自主代理，但由于与工具相关的知识不足以及知识激活效果不佳，它们往往无法完成多步骤的执行任务。因此，我们开展了一项系统研究，探讨知识如何影响工具使用的性能，涵盖了知识获取、激活和内化这三个阶段。在知识获取阶段，我们获取并评估了各种形式的经验性知识，分析结果表明，简单的实例级知识就能带来显著且可靠的效果，而抽象的目标级知识则只能提供有限的好处。在推理过程中，我们发现，提示LLM扩展推理深度时，效果会逐渐减弱；而通过并行采样并结合聚合方式来扩展推理宽度，则能更有效地激活潜在的经验性知识。在知识内化方面，使用带有知识增强的数据进行训练后，模型的性能得到了进一步提升，其中强化学习的效果优于监督式微调。基于这些发现，我们提出了“知识增强工具执行”框架（Knowledge-Augmented Tool Execution，KATE），该框架将经验性知识与扩展推理能力的推理机制以及注重知识优化的训练方法相结合。在BFC-LV3和AppWorld数据集上的实验表明，该框架在不同模型规模下都能取得稳定且显著的改进。我们的代码可在此处下载：https://github.com/hypasd-art/KATE。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Efficient Transformer Parameter Reuse via Zero-Token Mechanism
papers.title_zh: 通过零标记机制实现高效的Transformer参数复用
papers.authors: Guanghao Li, Wenhao Jiang, Li Shen, Ming Tang, Chun Yuan
papers.abstract: Resource constraints often limit the parameter capacity of Large Language Models (LLMs), thereby hindering their performance. Although existing approaches leverage parameter sharing to reuse a fixed set of parameters within constrained budgets, they typically require each layer to fulfill multiple roles over a fixed number of iterations. This design compromises both efficiency and adaptability. In this work, we propose the Zero Token Transformer (ZTT), which employs a head-tail decoupled parameter cycling strategy. Specifically, we decouple the first (head) and last (tail) layers from the parameter cycling process, enabling iterative refinement solely within the intermediate layers. Furthermore, we introduce a Zero-Token Mechanism, wherein a virtual token with a trainable key and a zero-valued vector functions as a standard token. The resulting attention scores not only reflect the computational significance of each layer but also facilitate dynamic early exiting, thereby preserving overall model accuracy. Our approach achieves superior performance under strict parameter constraints, substantially reduces computational overhead via early exits, and can be seamlessly integrated into the fine-tuning of existing pre-trained models, improving both efficiency and adaptability.
papers.abstract_zh: 资源限制常常限制了大语言模型（LLM）的参数容量，从而影响了它们的性能。虽然现有的方法通过参数共享来在有限的预算内重复使用固定的参数集，但这些方法通常要求每一层在多次迭代中承担多种角色。这种设计既降低了效率，也削弱了模型的适应性。在这项研究中，我们提出了零令牌变换器（ZTT）这一算法。该算法采用了一种头尾分离的参数循环策略：我们将第一层（头部）和最后一层（尾部）与参数循环过程分离，使得迭代优化仅发生在中间层。此外，我们还引入了零令牌机制——使用一个具有可训练键的虚拟令牌，以及一个值为零的向量函数作为标准令牌。这样得到的注意力分数不仅反映了每一层的计算重要性，还促进了动态的早期退出机制，从而保持了整体模型的准确性。我们的方法在严格的参数限制下仍能取得出色的性能，通过早期退出大大减少了计算开销，并且可以无缝集成到现有预训练模型的微调过程中，提升了效率和适应性。

papers.title: x1: Learning to Think Adaptively Across Languages and Cultures
papers.title_zh: x1：学会在不同语言和文化环境中进行适应性思考
papers.authors: Yangfan Ye, Xiaocheng Feng, Xiachong Feng, Yichong Huang, Zekun Yuan, Lei Huang, Weitao Ma, Qichen Hong, Yunfei Lu, Dandan Tu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Languages encode distinct abstractions and inductive priors, yet most large language models (LLMs) overlook this diversity by reasoning in a single dominant language. In this work, we introduce x1, a family of reasoning models that can adaptively reason in an advantageous language on a per-instance basis. To isolate the effect of reasoning-language choice, x1 is constructed without expanding the model’s knowledge boundaries and is trained by contrasting linguistically distinct reasoning trajectories for the same input. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the benefits of adaptive multilingual reasoning across multilingual mathematical reasoning and culturally grounded tasks. Moreover, our results challenge a simplistic view of scaling laws: while scaling reduces cross-lingual disparities in procedural domains such as math reasoning, it does not eliminate the advantages of culture-associated languages in culturally grounded tasks, as we empirically show that such reasoning enables more efficient and accurate cultural knowledge recall. Overall, our findings establish language choice as a functional component of reasoning, with implications for building more generalist and globally competent reasoning models.
papers.abstract_zh: 不同语言承载着各自独特的抽象概念与归纳性先验知识，然而大多数大语言模型在推理过程中往往忽视了这种多样性，它们总是使用一种主导语言来进行推理。在这项研究中，我们提出了x1这一推理模型系列，该模型能够针对每个具体实例，自适应地使用优势语言进行推理。为了单独评估推理语言选择的影响，我们在不扩大模型知识边界的情况下构建了x1模型，并通过对比相同输入数据下不同语言的推理路径来对其进行训练。我们的大量实验表明，自适应多语言推理在多语言数学推理以及基于文化背景的任务中都具有显著优势。此外，我们的研究结果挑战了人们对规模扩展规律的简单认知：虽然规模扩展可以减少数学推理等程序性领域中的跨语言差异，但它并不能消除文化相关语言在基于文化背景的任务中的优势，因为我们的实证研究表明，这种推理方式能够更高效地、更准确地回忆文化知识。总体而言，我们的研究发现证明了语言选择是推理过程中的一个重要组成部分，这对构建更加通用且具备全球竞争力的推理模型具有重要意义。

papers.title: Towards Bridging the Reward-Generation Gap in Direct Alignment Algorithms
papers.title_zh: 努力缩小直接对齐算法在奖励生成方面的差距
papers.authors: Zeguan Xiao, Yun Chen, Jian Yang, Guanhua Chen, Ke Tang
papers.abstract: Direct Alignment Algorithms (DAAs), such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and Simple Preference Optimization (SimPO), have emerged as efficient alternatives to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) algorithms for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, DAAs suffer from a fundamental limitation we identify as the “reward-generation gap”—a discrepancy between training objectives and autoregressive decoding dynamics. In this paper, we consider that one contributor to the reward-generation gap is the mismatch between the inherent importance of prefix tokens during the LLM generation process and how this importance is reflected in the implicit reward functions of DAAs. To bridge the gap, we adopt a token-level MDP perspective of DAAs to analyze its limitations and introduce a simple yet effective approach called Prefix-Oriented Equal-length Training (POET), which truncates both preferred and dispreferred responses to match the shorter one’s length. We conduct experiments with DPO and SimPO, two representative DAAs, demonstrating that POET improves over their standard implementations, achieving up to 11.8 points in AlpacaEval 2 and overall improvements across downstream tasks. These results underscore the need to mitigate the reward-generation gap in DAAs by better aligning training objectives with autoregressive decoding dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 直接对齐算法（DAAs），如直接偏好优化（DPO）和简单偏好优化（SimPO），已成为替代人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）算法的有效方法，用于将大语言模型（LLMs）与人类偏好进行对齐。然而，这些算法存在一个根本性的局限性，我们将其称为“奖励生成差距”——即训练目标与自回归解码动态之间的不匹配。在本文中，我们认为导致这一差距的一个原因是，在LLM生成过程中，前缀词的重要性与DAAs中的隐式奖励函数所反映出的重要性之间存在差异。为了弥补这一差距，我们采用DAAs的标记级马尔可夫决策过程视角来分析其局限性，并提出了一种简单而有效的方法——前缀导向等长训练（POET）。该方法通过截断首选和次选响应来使其长度保持一致。我们对DPO和SimPO这两种代表性的DAAs进行了实验测试，结果表明，POET比它们的标准实现表现更好，在AlpacaEval 2评估中取得了高达11.8分的成绩，并且在后续任务中也取得了整体上的改进。这些结果强调了通过更好地将训练目标与自回归解码动态对齐来减轻DAAs中奖励生成差距的必要性。

papers.title: FABLE: Fine-grained Fact Anchoring for Unstructured Model Editing
papers.title_zh: 寓言：用于非结构化模型编辑的细粒度事实锚定机制
papers.authors: Peng Wang, Biyu Zhou, Xuehai Tang, Jizhong Han, Songlin Hu
papers.abstract: Unstructured model editing aims to update models with real-world text, yet existing methods often memorize text holistically without reliable fine-grained fact access. To address this, we propose FABLE, a hierarchical framework that decouples fine-grained fact injection from holistic text generation. FABLE follows a two-stage, fact-first strategy: discrete facts are anchored in shallow layers, followed by minimal updates to deeper layers to produce coherent text. This decoupling resolves the mismatch between holistic recall and fine-grained fact access, reflecting the unidirectional Transformer flow in which surface-form generation amplifies rather than corrects underlying fact representations. We also introduce UnFine, a diagnostic benchmark with fine-grained question–answer pairs and fact-level metrics for systematic evaluation. Experiments show that FABLE substantially improves fine-grained question answering while maintaining state-of-the-art holistic editing performance. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FABLE-B59E.
papers.abstract_zh: 非结构化模型编辑旨在用现实世界中的文本来更新模型，但现有的方法往往只是整体地记忆文本，而无法获得可靠细粒度的信息。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了FABLE这一分层框架，它将细粒度的信息注入与整体的文本生成分离开来。FABLE采用两阶段策略：首先将离散的事实嵌入到浅层结构中，然后对深层结构进行少量更新，以产生连贯的文本。这种分离方式解决了整体召回率和细粒度信息获取之间的矛盾，反映了Transformer模型中表面形式生成会放大而非修正底层事实表示的特点。我们还引入了一个名为UnFine的诊断基准测试，该测试包含细粒度的问答对以及针对事实层面的评估指标，以便进行系统的评估。实验表明，FABLE在保持现有整体编辑性能的同时，显著提升了细粒度问答的准确率。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FABLE-B59E上免费获取。

papers.title: SOP-Maze: Evaluating Large Language Models on Complicated Business Standard Operating Procedures
papers.title_zh: SOP-Maze：在复杂的商业标准操作程序中评估大型语言模型的效果
papers.authors: Jiaming Wang, Zhe Tang, Zehao Jin, Hefei Chen, Yilin Jin, Peng Ding, Xiaoyu Li, Xuezhi Cao
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are widely deployed as domain-specific agents, many benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate their ability to follow instructions and make decisions in real-world scenarios. However, business scenarios often involve complex standard operating procedures (SOPs), and the evaluation of LLM capabilities in such contexts has not been fully explored. To bridge this gap, we propose SOP-Maze, a benchmark constructed from real-world business data and adapted into a collection of 397 instances and 3422 subtasks from 23 complex SOP scenarios. We further categorize SOP tasks into two broad classes: Lateral Root System (LRS), representing wide-option tasks that demand precise selection; and Heart Root System (HRS), which emphasizes deep logical reasoning with complex branches. Extensive experiments reveal that nearly all state-of-the-art models struggle with SOP-Maze. We conduct a comprehensive analysis and identify three key error categories: (i) route blindness: difficulty following procedures; (ii) conversational fragility: inability to handle real dialogue nuances; and (iii) calculation errors: mistakes in time or arithmetic reasoning under complex contexts. The systematic study explores LLM performance across SOP tasks that challenge both breadth and depth, offering new insights for improving model capabilities. We have open-sourced our work on the anonymous link: https://github.com/meituan-longcat/SOP-Maze.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于大语言模型被广泛用作特定领域的智能体，因此已经提出了许多基准测试来评估它们在现实场景中遵循指令和做出决策的能力。然而，商业场景通常涉及复杂的标准操作程序，而对这些场景下语言模型能力的评估尚未得到充分研究。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了SOP-Maze这个基准测试。该测试基于真实世界的商业数据构建，包含397个实例和3422个子任务，涵盖了23种复杂的操作程序场景。我们将SOP任务分为两大类：横向根系任务，这类任务需要精确的选择；以及核心根系任务，这类任务强调复杂的逻辑推理。大量实验表明，几乎所有最先进的模型在SOP-Maze测试中都会遇到困难。我们通过全面分析，确定了三个主要的错误类型：(i) 路径识别困难：难以遵循程序步骤；(ii) 对话处理能力不足：无法处理真实的对话细节；(iii) 计算错误：在复杂环境下出现的时间或算术推理错误。这项系统的研究揭示了语言模型在应对涉及广度和深度挑战的SOP任务时的表现，为提升模型能力提供了新的见解。我们已经在以下链接上开源了我们的研究成果：https://github.com/meituan-longcat/SOP-Maze。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MalURLBench: A Benchmark Evaluating Agents’ Vulnerabilities When Processing Web URLs
papers.title_zh: MalURLBench：一种用于评估代理在处理网页URL时是否存在漏洞的测试工具
papers.authors: Dezhang Kong, Zhuxi Wu, Shiqi Liu, ZhiCheng Tan, Kuichen Lu, Minghao Li, Qichen Liu, Shengyu Chu, Zhenhua Xu, Xuan Liu, Meng Han
papers.abstract: LLM-based web agents have become increasingly popular for their utility in daily life and work. However, they exhibit critical vulnerabilities when processing malicious URLs: accepting a disguised malicious URL enables subsequent access to unsafe webpages, which can cause severe damage to service providers and users. Despite this risk, no benchmark currently targets this emerging threat. To address this gap, we propose MalURLBench, the first benchmark for evaluating LLMs’ vulnerabilities to malicious URLs. MalURLBench contains 61,845 attack instances spanning 10 real-world scenarios and 7 categories of real malicious websites. Experiments with 12 popular LLMs reveal that existing models struggle to detect elaborately disguised malicious URLs. We further identify and analyze key factors that impact attack success rates and propose URLGuard, a lightweight defense module. We believe this work will provide a foundational resource for advancing the security of web agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的网络代理因其在日常生活和工作中的实用价值而越来越受欢迎。然而，在处理恶意URL时，这些代理存在严重的安全漏洞：接受伪装成恶意URL的链接会导致访问不安全的网页，从而对服务提供商和用户造成严重损害。尽管存在这种风险，但目前还没有针对这一新兴威胁的基准测试。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MalURLBench——首个用于评估大语言模型对恶意URL脆弱性的基准测试工具。MalURLBench包含了61,845个攻击实例，涵盖了10种真实场景和7类真实恶意网站。通过对12种常见大语言模型的实验分析发现，现有模型在检测精心伪装的恶意URL方面存在困难。我们还识别并分析了影响攻击成功率的关键因素，并提出了URLGuard这一轻量级防御模块。我们相信，这项工作将为提升网络代理的安全性提供重要的基础资源。

papers.title: Representation-Guided Parameter-Efficient LLM Unlearning
papers.title_zh: 基于表示引导的、参数效率高的大语言模型遗忘机制
papers.authors: Zeguan Xiao, Lang Mo, Yun Chen, Lei Yang, Jiehui Zhao, Lili Yang, Guanhua Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often memorize sensitive or harmful information, necessitating effective machine unlearning techniques. While existing parameter-efficient unlearning methods have shown promise, they still struggle with the forget-retain trade-off. This can be attributed to their reliance on parameter importance metrics to identify parameters that are important exclusively for forget set, which is fundamentally limited by the superposition phenomenon. Due to the polysemantic nature of LLMs parameters, such an importance metric may struggle to disentangle parameters associated with forget and retain sets. In this work, we propose Representation-Guided Low-rank Unlearning (ReGLU), a novel approach that leverages the geometric properties of representation spaces to achieve robust and precise unlearning. First, we develop a representation-guided initialization for LoRA that identifies the optimal subspace for selective forgetting. Second, we introduce a regularization loss that constrains the outputs of the LoRA update to lie in the orthogonal complement of the retain set’s representation subspace, thereby minimizing interference with the model’s performance on the retain set. We evaluate ReGLU on the TOFU and WMDP benchmarks across multiple models. Our results demonstrate that ReGLU consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior unlearning quality while maintaining higher model utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常常会记住敏感或有害的信息，因此需要有效的机器忘却技术。虽然现有的参数高效忘却方法已经取得了一定的成效，但它们在记忆与遗忘之间的权衡问题上仍然存在困难。这主要是由于这些方法依赖于参数重要性指标来识别仅对遗忘集重要的参数，而这一方法本质上受到叠加现象的限制。由于LLM参数的多义性，这种重要性指标可能难以区分与遗忘集和保留集相关的参数。在这项研究中，我们提出了基于表示引导的低秩忘却方法（ReGLU），该方法利用表示空间的几何特性来实现稳健且精确的忘却操作。首先，我们开发了一种基于表示引导的LoRA初始化方法，能够确定选择性遗忘的最佳子空间。其次，我们引入了一种正则化损失函数，该损失函数约束LoRA更新后的输出值位于保留集表示子空间的正交补空间中，从而最大限度地减少了对模型在保留集上的性能影响。我们在多个模型的TOFU和WMDP基准测试上评估了ReGLU的性能。我们的结果表明，ReGLU始终优于现有的最先进基线方法，它在保持较高模型实用性的同时，实现了更优质的忘却效果。

papers.title: LPO: Towards Accurate GUI Agent Interaction via Location Preference Optimization
papers.title_zh: LPO：通过位置偏好优化实现更准确的GUI界面交互
papers.authors: Jiaqi Tang, Yu Xia, Yi-Feng Wu, Yuwei Hu, Chen Yuhui, Qing-Guo Chen, Xiaogang Xu, Xiangyu Wu, Hao LU, Yanqing Ma, Shiyin Lu, Qifeng Chen
papers.abstract: The advent of autonomous agents is transforming interactions with Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) by employing natural language as a powerful intermediary. Despite the predominance of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods in current GUI agents for achieving spatial localization, these methods face substantial challenges due to their limited capacity to accurately perceive positional data. Existing strategies, such as reinforcement learning, often fail to assess positional accuracy effectively, thereby restricting their utility. In response, we introduce Location Preference Optimization (LPO), a novel approach that leverages locational data to optimize interaction preferences. LPO uses information entropy to predict interaction positions by focusing on zones rich in information. Besides, we further introduce a dynamic location reward function based on physical distance, reflecting the varying importance of interaction positions. Supported by Group Relative Preference Optimization (GRPO), LPO facilitates an extensive exploration of GUI environments and significantly enhances interaction precision. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate LPO’s superior performance, achieving SOTA results across both offline benchmarks and real-world online evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: 自主代理的出现正在通过利用自然语言作为强大的中介手段，改变与图形用户界面之间的交互方式。尽管目前用于实现空间定位的GUI代理大多采用监督式微调方法，但这些方法在准确感知位置数据方面存在显著局限性，从而带来了诸多挑战。现有的策略，如强化学习，往往无法有效评估位置的准确性，这限制了它们的实用性。为此，我们提出了位置偏好优化算法——LPO。该算法利用位置数据来优化交互偏好，通过信息熵来预测交互位置，重点关注信息丰富的区域。此外，我们还引入了一种基于物理距离的动态位置奖励函数，以反映不同交互位置的重要性。在群体相对偏好优化算法的支持下，LPO能够更全面地探索GUI环境，并显著提高交互的精确度。大量的实验表明，LPO具有出色的性能，无论是在离线基准测试还是现实世界的在线评估中，都能取得领先的成绩。

papers.title: Mistake Notebook Learning: Batch-Clustered Failures for Training-Free Agent Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 错误记录本学习：用于无需训练的智能体适应的批量聚类故障处理机制
papers.authors: Xuanbo Su, Yingfang Zhang, Hao Luo, Xiaoteng Liu, Leo Huang
papers.abstract: With the growing adoption of Large Language Model (LLM) agents in persistent, real-world roles, they naturally encounter continuous streams of tasks and inevitable failures. A key limitation, however, is their inability to systematically learn from these mistakes, forcing them to repeat identical errors in similar contexts. Unlike prior training-free methods that primarily store raw instance-level experience or focus on retrieving successful trajectories, we propose Mistake Notebook Learning (MNL), a novel memory framework that enables agents to self-curate generalizable guidance from batch-clustered failures. This mechanism allows agents to distill shared error patterns into structured “mistake notes”, updating an external memory only when batch performance improves to ensure stability. To further amplify adaptability, we integrate MNL with test-time scaling, leveraging aggregated failure patterns to actively steer the search process away from known pitfalls. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, Text-to-SQL, and interactive agent benchmarks show that MNL achieves competitive performance compared to existing memory mechanisms in both effectiveness and efficiency. These findings position structured mistake abstraction as a critical lever for robust agent evolution, enabling continuous improvement without the cost of parameter updates.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型代理在现实世界中的持续应用越来越广泛，它们不可避免地会面临大量的任务处理以及频繁的失败。然而，一个主要的限制是这些模型无法从错误中系统地学习，导致它们在类似的情境下重复同样的错误。与那些主要依赖存储原始实例级经验或专注于检索成功路径的先前无训练方法不同，我们提出了“错误笔记学习”这一新颖的记忆框架。该框架使代理能够从批量聚类的错误中学习出具有普遍适用性的指导策略。这种机制能够将共同的错误模式提炼成结构化的“错误笔记”，只有当批量性能得到提升时才会更新外部记忆，从而确保系统的稳定性。为了进一步提升适应能力，我们将MNL与测试时的扩展功能相结合，利用聚合的错误模式来引导搜索过程避免已知的陷阱。在数学推理、文本转SQL以及交互式代理等基准测试中的实验表明，MNL在有效性和效率方面都取得了与现有记忆机制相当的性能。这些发现表明，结构化错误抽象是一种重要的手段，它能够帮助代理不断进化，而无需付出参数更新的代价。

papers.title: Large-Scale Multimodal Knowledge Graph about Classical Chinese Poetry: Fine-grained Method and Comprehensive Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 关于古典中国诗歌的大规模多模态知识图谱：细致化的方法与全面评估
papers.authors: Shuo Wang, Qing Zhu, Yang Xiao, Minglong Lei
papers.abstract: Classical Chinese poetry is a treasured cultural heritage of humanity, attracting extensive research interest. However, the study of classical Chinese poetry is hindered by the lack of open, large-scale, and fine-grained multimodal datasets.Prior datasets are either limited by modality constraints, dataset size, or the level of dataset refinement, making them inadequate for effectively supporting studies and the development of applications in classical Chinese poetry.To address these issues, we propose a method for constructing a large-scale and fine-grained multimodal knowledge graph of classical Chinese poetry. We first design an informative ontology graph for classical Chinese poetry and comprehensively collect knowledge about poetry based on it. Furthermore, the method leverages knowledge augmentation, prompt optimization, and text-image alignment to acquire comprehensive, fine-grained knowledge. Both qualitative and quantitative evaluations are conducted on the Multimodal Knowledge Graph of Classical Chinese Poetry (CPMK), highlighting its comprehensiveness and high quality.We also conduct downstream evaluations on four tasks: poetry question answering, poetry theme classification, poetry-image retrieval, and rigid-formats poetry generation.Significant results are achieved across all four tasks, demonstrating CPMK’s effectiveness in supporting research on Chinese poetry.CPMK will be released to promote research in Chinese culture.
papers.abstract_zh: 古典汉语诗歌是人类珍贵的文化遗产，吸引了大量研究人员的兴趣。然而，对古典汉语诗歌的研究受到缺乏开放、大规模且细粒度的多模态数据集的阻碍。现有的数据集要么受到模态限制、数据集规模或数据精炼程度的限制，无法有效支持相关研究以及古典汉语诗歌相关应用的发展。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种构建大规模、细粒度多模态古典汉语诗歌知识图谱的方法。我们首先为古典汉语诗歌设计了一个信息丰富的本体图，并基于该图全面收集与诗歌相关的知识。此外，该方法还利用知识增强、提示优化和文本-图像对齐技术来获取全面、细粒度的知识。我们对古典汉语诗歌多模态知识图谱进行了定性和定量评估，结果显示其具有全面性和高质量。我们还对四个任务进行了下游评估：诗歌问答、诗歌主题分类、诗歌-图像检索以及固定格式诗歌生成。在所有四个任务中均取得了显著成果，证明了CPMK在支持汉语诗歌研究方面的有效性。CPMK将被发布出来，以促进中国文化的研究。

papers.title: MultiCodeAttack: Iterative Jailbreak Attacking on LLMs with Multi-Code Prompt Injection
papers.title_zh: MultiCodeAttack：通过多代码提示注入技术对大型语言模型进行迭代式破解
papers.authors: Weifeng Sun, Meng Yan, Zhou Yang, Yuchen Chen, Song Sun, David Lo
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong generalization capabilities but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that induce restricted text or malicious code generation.Recent structured jailbreaks embed adversarial intent into code-like templates and have demonstrated promising effectiveness.However, existing approaches typically operate within a fixed template design and a single programming language, without considering language diversity or adaptive template evolution, thereby limiting the exploration of cross-language jailbreak behaviors.In this paper, we present MultiCodeAttack, a structured jailbreak framework that systematically explores and optimizes multi-language code templates.MultiCodeAttack maintains a diverse template library across programming languages, dynamically selects languages with higher attack effectiveness via a multi-armed bandit strategy, and evolves templates through semantic-preserving mutation guided by response-aware signals.Extensive experiments on 8 LLMs show that MultiCodeAttack outperforms existing jailbreak baselines, achieving 28.23%–832.59% higher harmful text generation.On malicious code generation across 11 LLMs, MultiCodeAttack produces up to 136.22% more malicious outputs than the baseline methods.Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MultiCodeAttack/.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在泛化能力方面表现出色，但依然容易受到导致生成受限文本或恶意代码的越狱攻击。最近的一些结构化越狱方法能够将敌对意图嵌入到类似代码的模板中，并取得了良好的效果。然而，现有的方法通常局限于固定的模板设计和单一编程语言，没有考虑语言的多样性或自适应模板的进化，因此限制了跨语言越狱行为的探索。在本文中，我们提出了MultiCodeAttack这一结构化越狱框架，该框架能够系统地探索和优化多语言代码模板。MultiCodeAttack维护着跨编程语言的多样化模板库，通过多臂老虎机策略动态选择具有更高攻击效果的编程语言，并通过基于响应感知信号的语义保留性变异来优化模板。在8个大语言模型上的广泛实验表明，MultiCodeAttack在生成有害文本方面的性能优于现有的越狱基线方法，其生成有害文本的效率提高了28.23%至832.59%。在11个大语言模型上进行的恶意代码生成实验中，MultiCodeAttack产生的恶意输出比基线方法多了136.22%。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MultiCodeAttack/获取。

papers.title: SAMem: State-Aware Memory as a Fine-Grained Memory for LLM Agents in Decision-Making
papers.title_zh: SAMem：一种基于状态的记忆机制，作为LLM智能体进行决策时的细粒度记忆工具
papers.authors: Tong Wang, Pei Xu, Shiyue Cao, Likun Yang, Daipeng Li, Jianbin Jiao, Kaiqi Huang
papers.abstract: Existing LLM-based agents primarily utilize coarse-grained experiential memory, where experiences are retrieved based on global task or scene context. While effective in simple settings, such coarse-grained memory lacks the situational alignment required for complex multi-step decision-making. As a result, recalled experiences often fail to match the agent’s current state, blurring reasoning focus and leading to inaccurate decisions at critical steps. To this end, we propose State-Aware memory(SAMem), a new fine-grained memory paradigm for LLM agents that explicitly aligns memory retrieval with the current state. Instead of storing and reusing globally shared experiences, SAMem organizes memory at the level of state-specific reasoning thoughts, enabling the agent to retrieve only the most relevant experience for the current decision context. This state-conditioned memory allows the agent to focus on the most informative reasoning cues at each step, rather than being distracted by task-level but state-misaligned guidance. Extensive experiments on complex decision-making benchmarks demonstrate that SAMem outperforms existing experiential memory approaches, achieving superior performance and substantially improved task-solving efficiency. These results indicate that state-aware, fine-grained memory enhances the decision-making capabilities of LLM agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的基于大语言模型的智能体主要使用粗粒度经验记忆，这些经验是根据全局任务或场景上下文来检索的。虽然这种粗粒度记忆在简单场景中效果不错，但在复杂的多步骤决策过程中，它缺乏必要的情境对齐能力。因此，被唤起的经验往往无法与智能体的当前状态相匹配，这会分散推理的注意力，导致在关键步骤中做出错误的决策。为此，我们提出了一种名为“状态感知记忆”的新细粒度记忆机制。该机制将记忆的检索与当前状态明确对齐。与存储并重复使用全局共享的经验不同，SAMem将记忆组织到特定状态的推理思维层面，使得智能体只能检索与当前决策上下文最相关的经验。这种基于状态的记忆方式使智能体能够在每一步都专注于最有价值的推理线索，而不会受到任务层面的、但与当前状态不匹配的干扰。在复杂的决策基准测试中的大量实验表明，SAMem优于现有的经验记忆方法，其性能更优，任务解决效率也显著提高。这些结果表明，状态感知的细粒度记忆能够提升大语言模型智能体的决策能力。

papers.title: Learning to Translate by Translating: Stabilizing the Dual Loop via Semantic-Aware Self-Evolution
papers.title_zh: 通过翻译来学习翻译：通过语义自进化稳定双循环系统
papers.authors: Kui Liu, Mingming Yin, Zuoli Tang, Zihao Li, Chilin Fu, Xiaolu Zhang, Jun Zhou, Lixin Zou, Chenliang Li
papers.abstract: Despite the remarkable success of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Machine Translation (MT), the scarcity of high-quality parallel corpora and the prohibitive cost of their acquisition constrain scalability. To this end, we propose Learning to Translate by Translating (LTT), an LLM-driven dual-learning framework that enables autonomous translation, achieving an 80.42% performance improvement over the base model. By adapting the cycle-consistency principle to the generative paradigm, LTT eliminates the need for parallel data. It employs a robust semantic-aware reward function that balances adequacy with reconstruction fidelity, effectively mitigating the reward hacking issues inherent in traditional unsupervised MT. Relying solely on monolingual data, our 8B model consistently outperforms significantly larger models (70B+) in low-resource settings and achieves parity with state-of-the-art supervised baselines on mainstream benchmarks. LTT thus offers a scalable, data-efficient paradigm for autonomous machine translation.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在机器翻译领域取得了显著的成功，但高质量并行语料库的稀缺以及获取这些语料库的高昂成本限制了其扩展性。为此，我们提出了“通过翻译进行学习翻译”的方法（LTT），这是一种由大语言模型驱动的双重学习框架，它能够实现自主翻译，其性能相比基础模型提升了80.42%。通过将循环一致性原则应用于生成式翻译领域，LTT无需使用并行数据即可实现翻译。该框架采用了一种稳健的语义感知奖励函数，能够平衡翻译的准确性和重构质量，有效解决了传统无监督机器翻译中存在的奖励操纵问题。仅依赖单语言数据，我们的8B模型在低资源环境下始终表现出色，其性能与最先进的监督式基准模型相当。因此，LTT提供了一种可扩展且高效的数据利用方式，适用于自主机器翻译领域。

papers.title: How to Allocate, How to Learn? Dynamic Rollout Allocation and Advantage Modulation for Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: 如何分配资源？如何学习？动态部署与优势调节在政策优化中的应用
papers.authors: Yangyi Fang, Jiaye Lin, Xiaoliang Fu, Cong Qin, Haolin Shi, Chaowen Hu, Lu Pan, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has proven effective for Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, yet current methods face key challenges in resource allocation and policy optimization dynamics: (i) uniform rollout allocation ignores gradient variance heterogeneity across problems, and (ii) the softmax policy structure causes gradient attenuation for high-confidence correct actions, while excessive gradient updates may destabilize training. Therefore, we propose DynaMO, a theoretically-grounded dual-pronged optimization framework. At the sequence level, we prove that uniform allocation is suboptimal and derive variance-minimizing allocation from the first principle, establishing Bernoulli variance as a computable proxy for gradient informativeness. At the token level, we develop gradient-aware advantage modulation grounded in theoretical analysis of gradient magnitude bounds. Our framework compensates for gradient attenuation of high-confidence correct actions while utilizing entropy changes as computable indicators to stabilize excessive update magnitudes. Extensive experiments conducted on a diverse range of mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong RLVR baselines. Our implementation is available at: https://github.com/FlyTune/DynaMO-RL.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在大语言模型推理中已被证明是有效的，但当前的方法在资源分配和政策优化动态方面面临主要挑战：(i) 统一的分配方式忽略了不同问题之间的梯度方差差异；(ii) softmax策略结构会导致高置信度正确动作出现梯度衰减现象，而过度的梯度更新可能会破坏训练的稳定性。因此，我们提出了DynaMO这一具有理论依据的双管齐下的优化框架。在序列层面，我们证明了统一分配是不优的，并从第一原理出发推导出方差最小化分配方案，将伯努利方差作为计算可得的梯度信息量代理。在令牌层面，我们根据梯度幅度界限的理论分析，开发了考虑梯度的优势调节方法。我们的框架能够补偿高置信度正确动作的梯度衰减问题，同时通过利用熵变化作为可计算的指标来稳定过度更新的幅度。在多种数学推理基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法相较于强大的RLVR基线取得了持续的改进。我们的实现代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/FlyTune/DynaMO-RL。
