papers.title: Meeseeks: A Feedback-Driven, Iterative Self-Correction Benchmark evaluating LLMs’ Instruction Following Capability
papers.title_zh: Meeseeks：一个基于反馈的、迭代式的自我修正基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型遵循指令的能力
papers.authors: Jiaming Wang, Yunke Zhao, Peng Ding, Jun Kuang, Yibin Shen, Zhe Tang, Yilin Jin, ZongYu Wang, Xiaoyu Li, Xuezhi Cao
papers.abstract: The capability to precisely adhere to instructions is a cornerstone for Large Language Models (LLMs) to function as dependable agents in real-world scenarios. However, confronted with complex prompts, LLMs frequently encounter difficulties in fulfilling all specified requirements within a single response. Drawing inspiration from recent advancements in Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and self-correction methodologies, we introduce Meeseeks, a fully automated iterative instruction-following benchmark equipped with an integrated feedback mechanism. Meeseeks identifies erroneous components in model responses and provides corresponding feedback accurately, thereby iteratively guiding the model toward self-correction. The dataset contains over 700 curated instances annotated by 32 distinct capability tags in Chinese and English. Extensive experimental results reveal that different state-of-the-art commercial and open-source LLMs exhibit vastly disparate performance, and even after 20 turns of iterative feedback-driven self-correction, nearly all models demonstrate suboptimal performance. We conducted comprehensive analysis and uncovered numerous common issues prevalent in current state-of-the-art models, as well as several counterintuitive phenomena. Meeseeks has been open-sourced on https://github.com/ADoublLEN/Meeseeks.
papers.abstract_zh: 能够精确遵循指令是大语言模型在现实场景中作为可靠代理的基础。然而，面对复杂的提示时，大语言模型往往难以在单次回答中满足所有要求。受最近在思维链提示和自我修正方法方面的进展启发，我们推出了Meeseeks——一个完全自动化的迭代指令遵循基准测试，配备了集成的反馈机制。Meeseeks能够识别模型回答中的错误部分，并准确提供相应的反馈，从而逐步引导模型进行自我修正。该数据集包含700多个经过精心挑选的实例，这些实例由32种不同的能力标签进行注释，注释语言为中文和英文。大量的实验结果表明，不同的先进商业和开源大语言模型表现差异巨大。即使经过20轮基于迭代反馈的自我修正后，几乎所有模型的性能仍然不尽如人意。我们对这些模型进行了全面分析，发现了当前最先进模型中存在的许多常见问题，以及一些违反直觉的现象。Meeseeks已开源，地址为https://github.com/ADoublLEN/Meeseeks。

papers.title: HSUGA: LLM-Enhanced Recommendation with Hierarchical Semantic Understanding and Group-Aware Alignment
papers.title_zh: HSUGA：基于层次化语义理解及群体意识对齐的强化推荐系统
papers.authors: Guorui Li, Dugang Liu, Lei Li, Xing Tang, Zhong Ming
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-enhanced sequential recommendation typically aims to improve two core components: user semantic embedding extraction and utilization. Despite promising results, existing methods still have two limitations: 1) In the extraction stage, most methods directly input long interaction sequence fragments into LLM for preference summarization. However, excessively long sequences increase inference difficulty, making it challenging to infer accurate user embeddings reliably. 2) In the utilization stage, most methods employ the same semantic embedding utilization strategy for all users, neglecting the differences caused by user activity levels, leading to suboptimal performance. To address these issues, we propose HSUGA, which introduces a simple yet effective plugin for each of the two core components: Hierarchical Semantic Understanding (HSU) and Group-Aware Alignment (GAA). HSU performs a staged two-phase preference mining and models preference evolution through constrained editing operations, thereby improving the reliability of user semantic extraction. GAA adjusts the semantic utilization intensity based on user activity levels, providing weaker alignment for active users and stronger guidance for users with sparse historical data. Finally, extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and compatibility of HSUGA.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型增强的序列推荐系统通常旨在改进两个核心环节：用户语义嵌入的提取与利用。尽管现有方法取得了不错的成果，但仍存在两个局限性：1）在提取阶段，大多数方法直接将长交互序列片段输入到语言模型中进行偏好总结。然而，过长的序列会增加推理难度，使得准确提取用户语义嵌入变得困难。2）在利用阶段，大多数方法采用相同的语义嵌入利用策略来处理所有用户，而忽略了用户活动水平带来的差异，从而导致性能不佳。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了HSUGA算法。该算法为这两个核心环节分别引入了一种简单而有效的插件：分层语义理解（HSU）和群体感知对齐（GAA）。HSU通过分阶段的两步式偏好挖掘以及受限编辑操作来建模偏好演变，从而提升了用户语义提取的可靠性。GAA则根据用户的活跃程度调整语义利用强度，为活跃用户提供更强的一致性支持，为历史数据较少的用户提供更强的指导。最后，在三个基准数据集上的广泛实验证明了HSUGA算法的有效性和兼容性。

papers.title: AgenticEval: Toward Agentic and Self-Evolving Safety Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: AgenticEval：迈向对大型语言模型进行主动式且自我进化的安全性评估之路
papers.authors: Yixu Wang, Xin Wang, Yang Yao, Xinyuan Li, Xibang Yang, Yan Teng, Xingjun Ma, Yingchun Wang
papers.abstract: The rapid integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into high-stakes domains necessitates reliable safety and compliance evaluation. However, existing static benchmarks are ill-equipped to address the dynamic nature of AI risks and evolving regulations, creating a critical safety gap. This paper introduces a new paradigm of agentic safety evaluation, reframing evaluation as a continuous and self-evolving process rather than a one-time audit. We then propose a novel multi-agent framework AgenticEval, which autonomously ingests unstructured policy documents to generate and perpetually evolve a comprehensive safety benchmark. AgenticEval leverages a synergistic pipeline of specialized agents and incorporates a Self-evolving Evaluation loop, where the system learns from evaluation results to craft progressively more sophisticated and targeted test cases. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of AgenticEval, showing a consistent decline in model safety as the evaluation hardens. For instance, GPT-5’s safety rate on the EU AI Act drops from 72.50% to 36.36% over successive iterations. These findings reveal the limitations of static assessments and highlight our framework’s ability to uncover deep vulnerabilities missed by traditional methods, underscoring the urgent need for dynamic evaluation ecosystems to ensure the safe and responsible deployment of advanced AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在关键领域的快速整合，需要可靠的安全与合规评估。然而，现有的静态评估基准无法应对人工智能风险的动态变化以及不断更新的法规要求，这导致了严重的安全隐患。本文提出了一种全新的智能安全评估范式，将评估过程视为一个持续且自我进化的过程，而非一次性审核。我们提出了一种名为AgenticEval的新多智能体框架，该框架能够自动获取非结构化政策文件，从而生成并不断更新全面的安全评估基准。AgenticEval利用一系列专业智能体的协同作用，并包含一个自我进化的评估循环机制，系统会根据评估结果逐步设计出更加复杂和针对性的测试案例。我们的实验表明，AgenticEval非常有效，随着评估标准的提高，模型的安全性呈持续下降趋势。例如，GPT-5在欧盟人工智能法案下的安全性评分，在连续几次迭代后从72.50%降至36.36%。这些发现揭示了静态评估的局限性，同时也证明了我们的框架能够发现传统方法未能发现的深层漏洞，这凸显了建立动态评估体系的紧迫性，以确保先进人工智能的安全、负责任地应用。

papers.title: AlphaEdit+: Model Editing in the Presence of Conflicting and Inconsistent Knowledge
papers.title_zh: AlphaEdit+：在存在冲突和不一致知识的情况下进行模型编辑
papers.authors: Qing Liu, Jianhao Zhang, Ou Wu, Michael Ng, Yi Du
papers.abstract: Knowledge editing is a crucial technique for daily updates in LLMs, requiring a balance between accurately modifying incorrect knowledge and preserving existing information. The recently proposed AlphaEdit method achieves competitive editing performance by updating parameters under null-space constraints. However, our theoretical analysis reveals that AlphaEdit struggles with high knowledge conflicts and inconsistencies during editing. To address this, we propose a new editing method AlphaEdit+, featuring three key improvements: 1) relaxing null-space constraints by adding a matrix perturbation through optimization to resolve conflicts between new and preserved knowledge; 2) introducing a weighting scheme on previously updated knowledge constraints to mitigate conflicts between new and historical editing; 3) developing a value smoothing algorithm to resolve high knowledge inconsistencies. These enhancements collectively ensure robust editing while maintaining model coherence. Comprehensive experiments show that our approach AlphaEdit+ not only resolves the brittleness of the original method on carefully constructed challenging datasets but also outperforms AlphaEdit on existing benchmark datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识编辑是大语言模型日常更新中的关键技术，需要在准确修改错误知识和保留现有信息之间找到平衡。最近提出的AlphaEdit方法通过在零空间约束下更新参数，实现了具有竞争力的编辑性能。然而，我们的理论分析表明，AlphaEdit在处理高知识冲突和不一致问题时存在困难。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种新的编辑方法——AlphaEdit+，该方法包含三个关键改进：1）通过优化引入矩阵扰动来放松零空间约束，从而解决新旧知识之间的冲突；2）对先前更新的知识进行加权处理，以缓解新旧编辑内容之间的冲突；3）开发一种价值平滑算法，以解决高知识不一致性问题。这些改进共同确保了编辑过程的稳健性，同时保持了模型的连贯性。全面的实验表明，我们的AlphaEdit+方法不仅能够在精心构建的复杂数据集上解决原始方法的缺陷，而且在现有的基准数据集上也优于AlphaEdit。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Sycophancy: Negation-Based Gaslighting in Video Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 时空谄媚：基于否定的视频大语言模型中的操控行为
papers.authors: Ziyao Tang, Pengkun Jiao, Bin Zhu, Huiyan Qi, Jingjing Chen, Yu-Gang Jiang
papers.abstract: Video Large Language Models (Vid-LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in video understanding tasks, yet their robustness under conversational interaction remains largely underexplored. In this paper, we identify spatiotemporal sycophancy, a failure mode in which Vid-LLMs retract initially correct, visually grounded judgments and conform to misleading user feedback under negation-based gaslighting. Rather than merely changing their answers, the models often fabricate unsupported temporal or spatial explanations to justify incorrect revisions. To systematically investigate this phenomenon, we propose a negation-based gaslighting evaluation framework and introduce GasVideo-1000, a curated benchmark designed to probe spatiotemporal sycophancy with clear visual grounding and temporal reasoning requirements. We evaluate a broad range of state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary Vid-LLMs across diverse video understanding tasks. Extensive experiments reveal that vulnerability to negation-based gaslighting is pervasive and severe, even among models with strong baseline performance. While prompt-level grounding constraints can partially mitigate this behavior, they do not reliably prevent hallucinated justifications or belief reversal. Our results indicate that current Vid-LLMs lack robust mechanisms for maintaining grounded spatiotemporal beliefs under adversarial conversational feedback.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频大语言模型在视频理解任务中展现出了出色的性能，然而它们在对话交互中的鲁棒性仍然缺乏深入研究。在本文中，我们发现了一种名为“时空谄媚”的缺陷——当面临基于否定性的操控时，视频大语言模型会先做出看似正确的判断，然后违背用户的真实意图，给出误导性的反馈。这些模型不仅会改变自己的回答，还会编造没有根据的时间或空间解释来为错误的修正辩护。为了系统地研究这一现象，我们提出了一个基于否定性操控的评估框架，并开发了GasVideo-1000这个经过精心设计的基准测试集，旨在探究具有明确视觉依据和时间推理要求的时空谄媚行为。我们对各种先进的开源和专有视频大语言模型进行了广泛的测试。实验结果表明，即使是在性能表现良好的模型中，也普遍存在对基于否定性操控的脆弱性。虽然提示级的基础约束可以部分缓解这种行为，但它们并不能可靠地防止虚假的解释或信念的逆转。我们的研究结果表明，当前的视频大语言模型缺乏在对抗性对话反馈下维持基于时空的可靠信念的机制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FreeChunker: A Cross-Granularity Chunking Framework
papers.title_zh: FreeChunker：一种跨粒度分块框架
papers.authors: Wenxuan Zhang, Yuan-Hao Jiang, Yang Cao, Yonghe Wu
papers.abstract: Chunking strategies significantly impact the effectiveness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Existing methods operate within fixed-granularity paradigms that rely on static boundary identification, limiting their adaptability to diverse query requirements. This paper presents FreeChunker, a Cross-Granularity Encoding Framework that fundamentally transforms the traditional chunking paradigm: the framework treats sentences as atomic units and shifts from static chunk segmentation to flexible retrieval supporting arbitrary sentence combinations. This paradigm shift not only significantly avoids the computational overhead required for semantic boundary detection, but also enhances adaptability to complex queries. Experimental evaluation on LongBench V2 demonstrates that FreeChunker possesses significant advantages in both retrieval performance and time efficiency compared to existing chunking methods. The pre-trained models and codes are available at https://github.com/mazehart/FreeChunker.
papers.abstract_zh: 分块策略对检索增强生成（RAG）系统的效果有着显著的影响。现有的方法都遵循固定的粒度范式，依赖于静态的边界识别，这限制了它们对多样化查询需求的适应能力。本文提出了FreeChunker，一种跨粒度编码框架，它从根本上改变了传统的分块范式：该框架将句子视为原子单位，从静态的分块分割转变为支持任意句子组合的灵活检索机制。这种范式转变不仅大大避免了进行语义边界检测所需的计算开销，还提升了系统对复杂查询的适应能力。在LongBench V2上的实验评估表明，与现有的分块方法相比，FreeChunker在检索性能和时间效率方面具有显著优势。该模型的预训练模型和代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/mazehart/FreeChunker。

papers.title: Invocation Refiner: A Plug-and-Play Module for Rectifying LLM Tool Invocations
papers.title_zh: 调用器精炼器：一种用于规范大型语言模型工具调用的即插式模块
papers.authors: Qirui Jiao, Dian Jiao, Nan Du, Ying Shen, Liang Lin
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR). However, the practical application is often hindered by frequent errors in tool invocations, such as incorrect parameters or malformed formats. Prevailing training paradigms, such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), can mitigate these issues but require modification on the base LLM. This lack of modularity necessitates extensive retraining when deploying the system across different base models. To address the limitation, we introduce the Invocation Refiner, a specialized post-processing module designed to enhance the tool-use reliability of base LLMs without directly training on them. The Refiner takes the output from a frozen upstream LLM and the user’s query as input, performing independent reasoning to rectify the invocation. We construct a dedicated training dataset and train this module using an advanced RL algorithm. On a diverse set of tool-use and reasoning benchmarks, our Refiner improves task completion rates and invocation accuracy over the raw outputs of various upstream LLMs. This highlights our Refiner as a plug-and-play solution for improving the operational reliability of LLM-based agents. We release our code to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在工具集成推理方面展现出了卓越的能力。然而，在实际应用中，由于工具调用时常出现错误，比如参数错误或格式不正确等问题，这往往会阻碍模型的正常运行。目前主流的训练方法，如监督微调与强化学习，虽然可以解决这些问题，但需要对基础语言模型进行改造。由于缺乏模块化设计，当需要在不同的基础模型上部署系统时，就需要进行大量的重新训练。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了“调用优化器”这一专门的后处理模块。该模块旨在提高基础语言模型的工具使用可靠性，而无需对模型本身进行直接训练。调用优化器以冻结后的上游语言模型的输出以及用户的查询作为输入，通过独立推理来修正调用过程中的错误。我们构建了一个专门的训练数据集，并使用先进的强化学习算法对该模块进行训练。在一系列工具使用和推理测试场景中，我们的调用优化器显著提高了任务完成率和调用准确性，优于各种上游语言模型的原始输出结果。这表明，调用优化器是一种易于部署的解决方案，能够有效提升基于语言模型的智能体的运行可靠性。我们将代码公开，以便未来进行相关研究。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GoViG: Goal-Conditioned Visual Navigation Instruction Generation via Multimodal Reasoning
papers.title_zh: GoViG：基于多模态推理的目标导向视觉导航指导生成方法
papers.authors: Fengyi Wu, Yifei Dong, Yilong Dai, Guangyu Chen, Qifeng Wu, Huiting Huang, Hang Wang, Qi Dai, Alexander G Hauptmann, Zhi-Qi Cheng
papers.abstract: We introduce Goal-Conditioned Visual Navigation Instruction Generation (GoViG), a new task that aims to generate contextually coherent navigation instructions solely from egocentric visual observations of initial and goal states. Unlike prior work relying on structured inputs, such as semantic annotations or environmental maps, GoViG exclusively leverages raw egocentric visual data, improving adaptability to unseen and unstructured environments. Our method addresses this task by decomposing it into two interconnected subtasks: (1) navigation visualization, predicting intermediate visual states bridging the initial and goal views; and (2) instruction generation, synthesizing coherent instructions grounded in observed and anticipated visuals. Both subtasks are integrated within an autoregressive multimodal LLM trained with tailored objectives to ensure spatial accuracy and linguistic clarity. Furthermore, we introduce two multimodal reasoning strategies, one-pass and interleaved reasoning, to mimic incremental human navigation cognition. To comprehensively evaluate our method, we propose the R2R-Goal dataset, combining diverse synthetic and real-world trajectories. Empirical results demonstrate significant performance improvements over state-of-the-art methods in BLEU-4 and CIDEr scores along with robust cross-domain generalization. Our project is available at https://github.com/F1y1113/GoViG.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了目标条件视觉导航指令生成技术（GoViG），这是一种新的任务，其目标是仅基于对起始点和目标状态的以自我为中心的视觉观察，生成具有上下文连贯性的导航指令。与那些依赖结构化输入的工作不同，例如语义注释或环境地图，GoViG完全依赖于原始的以自我为中心的视觉数据，从而能够更好地适应未见过的和非结构化的环境。我们的方法通过将任务分解为两个相互关联的子任务来解决这一问题：(1) 导航可视化，预测连接起始点和目标点的中间视觉状态；(2) 指令生成，根据观察和预期的视觉信息来合成连贯的指令。这两个子任务都在一个经过训练的自回归多模态大语言模型中整合在一起，该模型具有特定的目标设置，以确保空间准确性和语言清晰度。此外，我们还引入了两种多模态推理策略：一次性推理和交错推理，以模拟人类渐进式的导航认知过程。为了全面评估我们的方法，我们创建了R2R-Goal数据集，该数据集结合了多种合成和真实世界的轨迹。实验结果表明，与最先进的方法相比，我们的方法在BLEU-4和CIDEr评分上取得了显著的性能提升，同时还在跨领域泛化能力方面表现出色。我们的项目可以在https://github.com/F1y1113/GoViG网站上查看。

papers.title: Temporal Contrastive Decoding: A Training-Free Method for Large Audio-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 时间对比解码：一种无需训练的大规模音频-语言模型训练方法
papers.authors: Yanda Li, Yuhan Liu, Zirui Song, Yunchao Wei, Martin Takáč, Salem Lahlou
papers.abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) generalize across speech, sound, and music, but unified decoders can exhibit a temporal smoothing bias: transient acoustic cues may be underutilized in favor of temporally smooth context that is better supported by language priors, leading to less specific audio-grounded outputs. We propose Temporal Contrastive Decoding (TCD), a training-free decoding method for unified LALMs that mitigates this effect at inference time. TCD constructs a temporally blurred slow-path view by smoothing the input waveform and re-encoding it, then contrasts next-token logits from the original and slow-path views. The contrastive signal is applied as a token-level logit update restricted to a small candidate set. A self-normalized stability score sets the blur window and update scale, and a step-wise gate based on uncertainty and audio reliance activates the update only when needed. Experiments on MMAU and AIR-Bench show consistent improvements on strong unified LALMs. We further conduct ablations and an architectural applicability study to analyze the contributions of key components and how TCD behaves across large audio-language model designs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）能够泛化处理语音、声音和音乐数据。然而，统一的解码器可能会表现出时间平滑的倾向：短暂的声学线索可能被忽视，而更倾向于使用由语言先验支持的、时间上较为平滑的上下文，从而导致输出的信息不够具体。我们提出了一种名为“时间对比解码”（TCD）的无训练解码方法，该方法可以在推理时缓解这种效应。TCD通过平滑输入波形并重新编码，构建出一个时间上模糊的慢路径视图；然后，将原始视图与慢路径视图下的下一个词元的逻辑值进行对比。这种对比信号被作为词级逻辑值的更新方式，且更新范围仅限于一小部分候选集。一个自归一化的稳定性评分用于确定模糊窗口和更新规模；而基于不确定性和音频依赖性的逐步门控机制则确保在需要时才进行更新。在MMAU和AIR-Bench上的实验表明，该方法在强大的统一LALMs上取得了持续的改进。我们还进行了消融实验和架构适用性研究，以分析关键组件的贡献以及TCD在不同规模的音频语言模型设计中的表现。

papers.title: When Internalization Fails: Finding Better Targets for Reasoning Compression
papers.title_zh: 当内部化机制失效时：寻找更合适的推理压缩目标
papers.authors: Mourad Heddaya, Manley Roberts, Rohan Wadhawan, Chenhao Tan
papers.abstract: Reasoning language models generate long reasoning traces that increase latency and cost. We study how to shorten these traces while preserving accuracy on competition-level mathematics. In a teacher-student distillation setup, we compare three approaches: (i) inference-time truncation after the first k tokens, (ii) Implicit Chain-of-Thought (ICoT)-style curricula that progressively shorten the teacher trace during training, and (iii) direct distillation to shorter reasoning traces. Using NuminaMath 1.5 with traces from DeepSeek-R1 and QwQ-32B, we distill into Qwen2.5-7B and measure accuracy against total tokens generated. We find: (1) with standard SFT and first-k truncation, models compensate by generating longer text after reasoning, undermining token savings; (2) ICoT-style curricula provide little benefit on competition-level mathematics, where reasoning traces are long and diverse; and (3) training on post-think, text the teacher generates after reasoning, achieves the best accuracy–efficiency trade-off among all shortened targets, outperforming generic summaries at matched token budgets. These results show that curriculum-based internalization methods effective on simple tasks do not transfer to complex reasoning, and that post-think provides a better distillation target.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理语言模型生成的推理过程往往很长，这会增加延迟和成本。我们研究如何在保持竞赛级别数学问题准确性的同时，缩短这些推理过程。在师生蒸馏的框架下，我们比较了三种方法：(i)在生成前k个令牌之后进行推理时间截断；(ii)采用隐式思维链（ICoT）风格的课程设计，在训练过程中逐步缩短教师的推理过程；(iii)直接将推理过程简化为更短的版本。我们使用NuminaMath 1.5以及DeepSeek-R1和QwQ-32B的推理数据，将其蒸馏到Qwen2.5-7B模型中，并评估其相对于总生成令牌数的准确性。研究发现：(1)使用标准SFT方法和前k个令牌截断时，模型会通过生成更长的文本来弥补损失，从而无法实现令牌节省的目标；(2)ICoT风格的课程设计在竞赛级别的数学问题上效果并不理想，因为这类问题的推理过程既长又复杂；(3)在推理后生成的文本上进行训练，能够实现最佳的准确性和效率平衡——在所有缩短后的目标中表现最佳，甚至优于在相同令牌预算下生成的普通摘要。这些结果表明，适用于简单任务的基于课程设计的内部化方法并不适用于复杂的推理任务，而推理后的文本则更适合作为蒸馏的目标。

papers.title: PatentMind: A Multi-Aspect Reasoning Graph for Patent Similarity Evaluation
papers.title_zh: PatentMind：一种用于专利相似度评估的多方面推理图算法
papers.authors: Yongmin Yoo, Qiongkai Xu, Longbing Cao
papers.abstract: Patent similarity evaluation is essential for intellectual property analysis, yet existing methods struggle to capture the multifaceted structure of patent documents encompassing technical specifications, legal boundaries, and application contexts. We propose PatentMind, a framework that performs patent similarity assessment through a Multi-Aspect Reasoning Graph (MARG). PatentMind decomposes patent documents into three dimensions: technical features, application domains, and claim scopes, and computes dimension-specific similarity scores, which are then integrated via a context-aware dynamic weighting mechanism that emulates expert-level judgment. To facilitate evaluation, we introduce PatentSimBench, an expert-annotated benchmark comprising 500 patent pairs. Experiments show that PatentMind achieves a Pearson correlation of r=0.938 with expert annotations, substantially outperforming embedding-based, patent-specific, and prompt engineering baselines. Our framework offers interpretable, multi-dimensional assessment applicable to downstream tasks such as prior art search and infringement risk analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 专利相似性评估对于知识产权分析至关重要，但现有的方法难以捕捉专利文档的复杂结构，这些结构包括技术规格、法律边界以及应用背景等方面。我们提出了PatentMind这一框架，它通过多维度推理图来进行专利相似性评估。PatentMind将专利文档分解为三个维度：技术特征、应用领域和权利范围，并分别计算各维度的相似性得分。这些得分随后通过一种基于上下文的动态加权机制进行整合，该机制能够模拟专家级的判断能力。为了便于评估，我们引入了PatentSimBench这一包含500对专利对的专家注释基准数据集。实验表明，PatentMind与专家注释数据的皮尔逊相关系数达到了r=0.938，远远优于基于嵌入技术的、针对特定专利的评估方法以及基于提示工程的基线方法。我们的框架提供了一种可解释的多维评估方式，适用于诸如现有技术检索和侵权风险分析等下游任务。

papers.title: MemSearcher: Iterative Memory Integration for Search Agent via End-to-End Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: MemSearcher：通过端到端强化学习实现搜索代理的迭代式内存整合技术
papers.authors: Qianhao Yuan, Jie Lou, Zichao Li, Jiawei Chen, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Le Sun, Debing Zhang, Xianpei Han
papers.abstract: LLM-based search agents often concatenate the full interaction history into the context, producing long and noisy inputs, and increasing compute cost and GPU memory overhead. To address this issue, we propose MemSearcher, an agent framework that maintains a compact memory during multi-turn interactions, retaining only question-relevant information and thereby keeping the context length stable across turns. Training MemSearcher is challenging because each trajectory spans multiple turns under different LLM contexts, making each turn an independent optimization target in reinforcement learning. We introduce multi-context GRPO, which propagates trajectory-level advantages to all turns for end-to-end optimization. Experiments demonstrate that MemSearcher outperforms strong history-concatenation (ReAct-style) baselines on a range of public datasets while maintaining nearly constant token counts across multi-turn interactions. The code and models will be publicly available at https://github.com/icip-cas/MemSearcher.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的搜索代理通常会将完整的交互历史信息合并到上下文之中，从而生成冗长且信息量大的输入数据，这会增加计算成本和GPU内存消耗。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了MemSearcher这一代理框架。该框架在多次交互过程中能够保持紧凑的内存占用，仅保留与问题相关的信息，从而确保上下文长度在不同交互中保持稳定。训练MemSearcher颇具挑战性，因为每个交互轨迹都涉及不同的LLM上下文，这使得每个交互步骤都需要作为独立的优化目标进行处理。我们提出了多上下文GRPO算法，该算法能够将轨迹级别的优势信息传递给所有交互步骤，实现端到端的优化。实验表明，MemSearcher在多个公共数据集上的表现优于那些采用强历史合并方式的基线算法，同时还能在多次交互过程中保持几乎恒定的令牌数量。相关代码和模型可访问https://github.com/icip-cas/MemSearcher。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CoPA: Benchmarking Personalized Question Answering with Data-Informed Cognitive Factors
papers.title_zh: CoPA：结合数据驱动的认知因素进行个性化问答系统的性能评估
papers.authors: Hang Su, Zequn Liu, Chen Hu, Xuesong Lu, Yingce Xia, Liu Zhen
papers.abstract: While LLMs have demonstrated remarkable potential in Question Answering (QA), evaluating personalization remains a critical bottleneck. Existing paradigms predominantly rely on surface-level similarity or manual heuristics, often lacking sufficient data-driven validation. We address this by mining Community-Individual Preference Divergence (CIPD)—where individual choices override consensus—to distill six key personalization factors as evaluative dimensions. Accordingly, we introduce CoPA, a benchmark with 1,985 user profiles for fine-grained, factor-level assessment. By quantifying the alignment between model outputs and user-specific cognitive preferences inferred from interaction patterns, CoPA provides a more comprehensive and discriminative standard for evaluating personalized QA than generic metrics. The code is available at https://github.com/bjzgcai/CoPA.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在问答领域展现出了巨大的潜力，但评估个性化效果仍然是一个关键的瓶颈问题。现有的方法主要依赖于表面级的相似性判断或人工启发式算法，往往缺乏充分的数据驱动验证。我们通过挖掘“社区与个人偏好差异”这一现象来解决这个问题——即个体选择能够超越共识的影响。在此基础上，我们提炼出六个关键的个性化因素作为评估维度。为此，我们提出了CoPA这一基准测试，该测试包含1,985个用户档案，可用于进行细粒度的、基于因素的评估。通过量化模型输出与用户特定认知偏好之间的契合度，CoPA提供了一种比通用指标更为全面且更具区分性的个性化问答评估标准。相关代码可访问https://github.com/bjzgcai/CoPA。

papers.title: RAP-ID: Mechanistic Prompt Injection Detection via Impostor Behavior Analysis
papers.title_zh: RAP-ID：通过分析“冒名顶替行为”来检测机制性提示注入攻击
papers.authors: Yuchen Yang, Lei Peng, Yujie He, Yang yu, Zhongxin Wu, Yanlei Shi
papers.abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly integrated into critical applications, yet they remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks where meticulously designed adversarial inputs bypass safety alignment. Existing defenses often rely on externally deployed guardrail models or response inspection, which incur significant computational overhead and latency. We propose RAP-ID (Robust Alignment Preservation via Injection Defense), a mechanistic, train-free detection framework that operates exclusively on internal state dynamics during the initial forward pass. RAP-ID identifies attacks by detecting their inevitable “impostor” behavior: they must mimic system instruction semantics (Directive Likeness), usurp attention from the true system prompt (Counterfactual Gain), and trigger latent risk concepts (Policy Conflict). By fusing these three internal signals, RAP-ID achieves effective detection across diverse attack vectors—from direct jailbreaks to stealthy agentic manipulations—without requiring text generation. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that RAP-ID achieves competitive performance with significant overall improvements compared to heuristic methods. Crucially, as a train-free solution, it incurs minimal computational overhead and delivers fast response times, making it well-suited for real-time deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正越来越多地被整合到关键应用中，但它们仍然容易受到“提示注入攻击”的威胁。这种攻击方式通过精心设计的对抗性输入来绕过系统的安全机制。现有的防御措施通常依赖于外部部署的防护模型或响应检查机制，但这些方法会带来巨大的计算开销和延迟问题。我们提出了RAP-ID（通过注入防御实现稳健的对齐保护），这是一种无需训练即可运行的检测框架，它仅基于模型在初始前向传播过程中的内部状态动态来进行检测。RAP-ID通过识别攻击行为中的“冒名顶替”现象来实现有效检测：这些攻击行为必须模仿系统指令的语义特征、夺取真实提示的注意力资源，并触发潜在的风险因素。通过融合这三个内部信号，RAP-ID能够跨不同攻击向量进行有效检测——无论是直接的越狱行为还是隐蔽的代理操纵行为——而无需进行文本生成操作。全面的评估表明，RAP-ID在性能上取得了与启发式方法相当甚至更好的表现，同时其计算开销极小，响应时间也非常快，因此非常适合实时部署。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When Safety Alignment Fails to Generalize: Probing with Language Game Jailbreaks
papers.title_zh: 当安全性保障无法得到普遍适用时：通过语言游戏来突破限制
papers.authors: Zewen Long, Yu Peng, Fangming Dong, Congyi Li, Xingmao Guan, Shu Wu, Kai Chen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely deployed in real-world applications, yet their safety alignment often fails to generalize beyond the specific linguistic formats seen during training. Prior work has shown that mismatched generalization can lead to alignment failures, but these studies typically rely on fixed or narrow transformation schemes. In this work, we probe safety alignment generalization using language game jailbreaks, a class of linguistically structured transformations that alter surface form while preserving fluency and semantic recoverability. We further introduce custom language games, which parameterize and vary transformation rules, enabling controlled exploration of alignment behavior across closely related linguistic variants. To scale this analysis, we propose AutoLanJail, an automated framework for discovering and refining language game-based jailbreaks. Experiments across open-source and closed-source LLMs show that safety fine-tuning is highly format-specific: defenses trained on one linguistic form fail to generalize to even minimal variations. These findings reveal a structural limitation of current fine-tuning-based alignment methods and highlight the need for safety evaluations that account for systematic linguistic variation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在现实世界的应用中得到了广泛部署，然而它们的安全对齐机制往往无法泛化到训练过程中所见的特定语言格式之外。先前的研究表明，不匹配的泛化能力会导致对齐失败，但这些研究通常依赖于固定或有限的转换方案。在这项研究中，我们采用了语言游戏逃逸技术来探索安全对齐的泛化能力——这类语言结构化的转换方式能够改变表面形式，同时保留语言的流畅性和语义可恢复性。我们还引入了自定义语言游戏，这些游戏可以参数化并调整转换规则，从而能够有针对性地探索不同语言变体之间的对齐行为。为了扩大这一分析的范围，我们提出了AutoLanJail这一自动化框架，用于发现并优化基于语言游戏的逃逸策略。通过对开源和闭源语言模型的实验表明，安全微调具有高度的形式特异性：针对某一语言形式的防御措施无法泛化到哪怕是最小的变体上。这些发现揭示了当前基于微调的对齐方法存在的结构性限制，同时也强调了需要针对系统性语言变异进行安全评估的重要性。

papers.title: Self-EmoQ: Plutchik-Guided Value-based Planning to Drive Streaming Emotional TTS
papers.title_zh: 自我情绪规划：基于价值观的规划方法，用于驱动流式情感语音合成
papers.authors: Yue Zhao, Hongyan Li, Yong Chen, Luo Ji
papers.abstract: Emotional interaction is increasingly crucial for conversational AI, yet current systems lack a self-emotion determination mechanism to drive the streaming text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis. We propose an emotion-planning framework that determines the emotion prior to the textual generation, grounding the downstream emotional TTS in a streaming manner. The framework is implemented by a plug-and-play LLM module, initialized from pretrained LLMs, and trained by reinforcement learning (RL) with emotions as the actions. A hybrid reward is employed which combines imitation signals with theory-driven scoring, in which the theory of Plutchik’s wheel of emotions is adopted. By experiments on DailyDialog, EmoryNLP, IMEOCAP, and MELD, our method outperforms prompting and finetuning baselines on both emotion determination and response quality. We finally implement an entire streaming pipeline for real-time deployment, with the speech quality confirming the framework’s emotional alignment, contextual coherence, and expressive fluency. Codes, cases, and demos are available in https://sixingdeguo.github.io/EmoQ-page/.
papers.abstract_zh: 在对话式人工智能中，情感交互变得越来越重要。然而，当前的系统缺乏一种能够自动判断情感的机制来驱动文本到语音的实时合成过程。我们提出了一种情感规划框架，该框架在文本生成之前就确定情感特征，从而以流式方式实现情感相关的文本到语音合成。该框架通过一个即插式的大语言模型模块来实现，该模块基于预训练的大语言模型进行初始化，并通过强化学习进行训练，其中情感被作为动作之一进行处理。我们采用了一种混合奖励机制，结合了模仿信号和基于理论评分的方法，其中采用了Plutchik的情绪轮理论作为评分依据。通过在DailyDialog、EmoryNLP、IMEOCAP和MELD等数据集上的实验验证，我们的方法在情感识别和响应质量方面均优于现有的提示式和微调式方法。最后，我们实现了整个流式处理流程，以实现实时部署。实际测试表明，该框架在情感一致性、上下文连贯性和表达流畅性方面表现良好。代码、案例和演示资料可访问https://sixingdeguo.github.io/EmoQ-page/。

papers.title: Scaling is Not All You Need: Clinical-Oriented Reinforcement Learning Makes Parameter-Efficient Clinical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 仅使用缩放方法是不够的：以临床需求为导向的强化学习能够实现参数高效的临床推理
papers.authors: Chi Liu, Yan Shu, Mengzhuo Chen, Hongming Piao, Zhijian Duan, Derek Li, Bryan Dai
papers.abstract: While large language models show promise in medical applications, achieving expert-level clinical reasoning efficiently remains challenging due to the need for massive amounts of manually labeled data and large-scale models. To address this challenge, we propose Clinical-Oriented Reinforcement Learning (CORL), the first fully open-source, end-to-end reinforcement learning training pipeline in the clinical reasoning domain, incorporating a Reasoning-Oriented Data Strategy (RODS) based on topological synthesis, CoT cold-start, and two-stage reinforcement learning. Through CORL, we trained the Fleming-R1 series of models. Among them, Fleming-R1-7B significantly outperforms models of comparable size while approaching or even surpassing certain 32B and 72B models. Fleming-R1-32B achieves near-parity with GPT-4o and outperforms the strongest open-source alternatives up to 671B in MedXpertQA. This demonstrates that in clinical reasoning field, a meticulously designed training pipeline holds greater importance than scaling model size alone. Data and Models are available at https://github.com/UbiquantAI/Fleming-R1 and https://huggingface.co/collections/IQuestLab/fleming.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在医学应用方面展现出巨大潜力，但由于需要大量手动标注的数据以及大规模模型的构建，实现专家级临床推理仍然面临挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了面向临床的强化学习方法——Clinical-Oriented Reinforcement Learning（CORL）。这是首个完全开源的、端到端强化学习训练流程，适用于临床推理领域。该流程采用了基于拓扑合成、上下文转换冷启动以及两阶段强化学习的推理导向数据策略。通过CORL，我们训练出了Fleming-R1系列模型。其中，Fleming-R1-7B在性能上显著优于同规模的其他模型，甚至在某些32B和72B规模的模型中表现更优。而Fleming-R1-32B则在MedXpertQA任务中接近GPT-4o的水平，其性能甚至超过了最强大的开源模型，其性能达到了671B的规模。这表明，在临床推理领域，精心设计的训练流程比单纯扩大模型规模更为重要。相关数据和模型可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/UbiquantAI/Fleming-R1 和 https://huggingface.co/collections/IQuestLab/fleming。

papers.title: Do We Need Distinct Representations for Every Speech Token? Unveiling and Exploiting Redundancy in Large Speech Language Models
papers.title_zh: 我们真的需要为每个语音标记都提供不同的表示方式吗？揭示并利用大型语音语言模型中的冗余性
papers.authors: Bajian Xiang, Tingwei Guo, Xuan Chen, Yang Han
papers.abstract: Large Speech Language Models (LSLMs) typically operate at high token rates (tokens/s) to ensure acoustic fidelity, yet this results in sequence lengths that far exceed the underlying semantic content, incurring prohibitive inference costs. In this paper, we empirically revisit the necessity of such granular token-level processing. Through layer-wise oracle interventions, we unveil a structured redundancy hierarchy: while shallow layers encode essential acoustic details, deep layers exhibit extreme redundancy, allowing for aggressive compression. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Affinity Pooling, a training-free, similarity-based token merging mechanism. By strategically applying this method at both input and deep layers, we effectively compress speech representations without compromising semantic information. Extensive evaluations across three tasks demonstrate that our approach reduces prefilling FLOPs by 27.48% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Practical deployment further confirms significant efficiency gains, yielding up to \sim1.7\times memory savings and \sim1.1\times faster time-to-first-token on long utterances. Our results challenge the necessity of fully distinct token representations, providing new perspectives on LSLM efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语音语言模型通常以较高的标记速率运行，以确保声学上的准确性。然而，这种处理方式会导致序列长度远远超过其背后的语义内容，从而带来过高的推理成本。在本文中，我们通过实验重新评估了这种细粒度标记级处理的必要性。通过逐层引入“神谕干预”机制，我们发现了一个结构化的冗余层次：浅层负责编码基本的声学细节，而深层则表现出极高的冗余性，从而实现高效的压缩。基于这些发现，我们提出了“亲和力池化”这一无需训练的基于相似度的标记合并机制。通过在输入层和深层同时应用该方法，我们可以在不损失语义信息的情况下有效压缩语音表示。在三项任务中的广泛测试表明，我们的方法能够将FLOPs的预填充量减少27.48%，同时保持较高的准确率。实际部署进一步证明了该方法的显著效率提升：内存消耗减少了约1.7倍，处理长语音的时间也缩短了约1.1倍。我们的研究结果挑战了完全独立的标记表示的必要性，为LSLM的效率提供了新的视角。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Table-as-Search: Agentic Information Seeking is Table Completion
papers.title_zh: 表格作为搜索工具：主动的信息寻求就是完成表格中的内容
papers.authors: Tian Lan, Felix Henry, Bin Zhu, Qianghuai Jia, Junyang Ren, Qihang PU, Haijun Li, Longyue Wang, Zhao Xu, Weihua Luo
papers.abstract: Current Information Seeking (InfoSeeking) agents struggle to maintain focus and coherence during long-horizon exploration, as tracking search states, including planning procedure and massive search results, within one plain-text context is inherently fragile.To address this, we introduce Table-as-Search (TaS), a structured planning framework that reformulates the InfoSeeking task as a Table Completion task.TaS maps each query into a structured table schema maintained in an external database, where rows represent search candidates and columns denote constraints or required information.This table precisely manages the search states: filled cells strictly record the history and search results, while empty cells serve as an explicit search plan.Crucially, TaS unifies three distinct InfoSeeking tasks: Deep Search, Wide Search, and the challenging DeepWide Search.Extensive experiments demonstrate that TaS significantly outperforms numerous state-of-the-art baselines across three kinds of benchmarks, including multi-agent framework and commercial systems.Furthermore, our analysis validates the TaS’s superior robustness in long-horizon InfoSeeking, alongside its efficiency, scalability and flexibility.Code and datasets are publicly released at https://github.com/AIDC-AI/Marco-Search-Agent.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的信息检索任务在执行长期探索时面临着难以保持专注和连贯性的问题。因为在单一的文本上下文中同时跟踪搜索状态、包括搜索流程以及大量的搜索结果，这种操作本质上是非常困难的。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了“表格式搜索”框架（Table-as-Search，简称TaS）。该框架将信息检索任务重新定义为“表格填充”任务。TaS将每个查询映射到一个结构化的表格模式中，该表格保存在外部数据库中；表格中的行代表搜索候选项，列则表示约束条件或所需信息。这个表格能够精确管理搜索状态：已填充的单元格会记录搜索的历史记录和结果，而空白单元格则作为明确的搜索计划。重要的是，TaS能够将三种不同的信息检索任务统一起来：深度搜索、广度搜索，以及更为复杂的深度广度搜索。大量的实验表明，TaS在多种基准测试中的表现都显著优于现有的最先进算法，这些测试包括多智能体框架以及商业系统。此外，我们的分析还验证了TaS在长期信息检索方面的卓越鲁棒性，同时它还具备高效性、可扩展性和灵活性。相关的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/AIDC-AI/Marco-Search-Agent上免费获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Minos: A Multimodal Evaluation Model for Bidirectional Generation Between Image and Text
papers.title_zh: 米诺斯：一种用于图像与文本之间双向生成的多模态评估模型
papers.authors: Junzhe Zhang, Huixuan Zhang, Xinyu Hu, Li Lin, Mingqi Gao, Shi Qiu, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: Evaluation is important for multimodal generation tasks, while traditional multimodal evaluation metrics suffer from several limitations. With the rapid progress of MLLMs, there is growing interest in applying MLLMs to build general evaluation systems. However, existing researches often simply collect large-scale evaluation data for training, while overlooking the quality of evaluation data. What’s more, current proposed evaluation models often struggle to achieve consistently strong performance across both image-to-text (I2T) and text-to-image (T2I) tasks. In this paper, through rigorous quality control strategies, we construct a comprehensive multimodal evaluation dataset, Minos-57K, with evaluation samples across 15 datasets, for developing the multimodal evaluation model Minos with SFT and preference alignment training strategies. Notably, despite using less than half the scale of the training data of prior work, our model achieves state-of-the-art evaluation performance across 16 out-of-domain datasets covering both I2T and T2I tasks among all open-source multimodal evaluation models and remain competitive with closed-source models. Extensive experiments demonstrate the importance of leveraging quality control process, jointly training on evaluation data from both I2T and T2I generation tasks and further preference alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 在多模态生成任务中，评估是非常重要的环节。然而，传统的多模态评估指标存在诸多局限性。随着MLLMs的快速发展，人们越来越倾向于将MLLMs应用于构建通用的评估系统。不过，现有的研究往往只是简单地收集大规模评估数据进行训练，而忽视了评估数据的质量问题。此外，目前提出的评估模型往往难以在图像到文本（I2T）和文本到图像（T2I）任务中取得稳定的优异表现。在本文中，我们通过严格的质量控制策略，构建了一个全面的多模态评估数据集Minos-57K，该数据集包含来自15个数据集的评估样本，用于开发基于SFT和偏好对齐训练策略的多模态评估模型Minos。值得注意的是，尽管我们使用的训练数据规模仅为之前工作的不到一半，但我们的模型在16个领域外数据集上的评估表现仍然处于领先水平，这些数据集涵盖了I2T和T2I任务，并且与闭源模型相比也具备竞争力。大量的实验表明，利用质量控制流程、共同在I2T和T2I生成任务的评估数据上进行训练，以及进一步进行偏好对齐，是非常重要的。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Global Context or Local Detail? Adaptive Visual Grounding for Hallucination Mitigation
papers.title_zh: 全球背景还是局部细节？用于缓解幻觉的自适应视觉引导系统
papers.authors: Yubo Jiang, Xin Yang, Abudukelimu Wuerkaixi, Zheming Yuan, Xuxin Cheng, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Fengying Xie, Zhiguo Jiang, Haopeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Large vision–language models (LVLMs) excel at multimodal reasoning but still suffer from object-existence hallucinations when multi-step deliberation decouples from visual evidence. Think-with-Images (TwI) attempts to counter this by generating auxiliary observations (e.g., zoomed crops or highlighted views), yet it is not reliably beneficial. We identify two coupled failure modes: (1) a granularity–context trade-off of common operators, where zoom-in improves local detail but breaks global relations, while highlighting preserves topology but lacks fine evidence; and (2) an over-trust issue in tool-guided region proposals, where mislocalized evidence can dominate reasoning and even underperform standard prompting. We propose Active-Look, a training-free, plug-and-play TwI framework that allocates visual computation by uncertainty. Active-Look runs two heterogeneous grounding experts in parallel and uses their disagreement as a proxy for uncertainty, spending the budget only to verify disputed regions. It further mitigates the operator trade-off with conflict-aware hybrid rendering: highlighting retains global context, while selective zoom-in performs local verification. Experiments on hallucination-focused and general benchmarks (POPE, MME, and CHAIR) across multiple LVLM backbones show consistent gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型在多模态推理方面表现出色，但在多步推理与视觉证据分离时，仍会出现物体存在幻觉的问题。图像辅助推理（TwI）试图通过生成辅助观察结果来应对这一问题，但这种方法并不总是有效。我们发现了两种导致问题的耦合模式：(1) 常见操作符的粒度与上下文之间的权衡问题——放大会改善局部细节，但会破坏全局关系；而高亮显示则能保留拓扑结构，但缺乏详细的证据；(2) 工具引导的区域提议中存在过度信任的问题——错误的证据可能会主导推理过程，甚至低于标准提示的效果。我们提出了Active-Look框架，这是一种无需训练即可使用的TwI框架，它能够根据不确定性来分配视觉计算资源。Active-Look同时运行两个异构的地面标注专家，并利用它们的分歧作为不确定性的代理，只将资源用于验证有争议的区域。此外，该框架还通过冲突感知的混合渲染技术来缓解操作符之间的权衡问题：高亮显示可以保留全局上下文，而选择性放大则可以执行局部验证。在多个LVLM基础模型上的幻觉聚焦和通用基准测试（POPE、MME和CHAIR）中，我们的方法取得了稳定的改进效果。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: FinToolSyn: A forward synthesis Framework for Financial Tool-Use Dialogue Data with Dynamic Tool Retrieval
papers.title_zh: FinToolSyn：一种用于金融工具使用对话数据的前向合成框架，能够实现动态的工具检索功能
papers.authors: Caishuang Huang, Yang Qiao, Rongyu Zhang, Junjie Ye, Pu Lu, Wuwenxi, Meng Zhou, Xiku Du, Qi Zhang, Tao Gui, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Tool-use capabilities are vital for Large Language Models (LLMs) in finance, a domain characterized by massive investment targets and data-intensive inquiries. However, existing data synthesis methods typically rely on a reverse synthesis paradigm, generating user queries from pre-sampled tools. This approach inevitably introduces artificial explicitness, yielding queries that fail to capture the implicit, event-driven nature of real-world needs. Moreover, its reliance on static tool sets overlooks the dynamic retrieval process required to navigate massive tool spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce \textit{FinToolSyn}, a forward synthesis framework designed to generate high-quality financial dialogues. Progressing from persona instruction and atomic tool synthesis to dynamic retrieval dialogue generation, our pipeline constructs a repository of 43,066 tools and synthesizes over 148k dialogue instances, incorporating dynamic retrieval to emulate the noisy candidate sets typical of massive tool spaces. We also establish a dedicated benchmark to evaluate tool-calling capabilities in realistic financial scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that models trained on FinToolSyn achieve a 21.06% improvement, providing a robust foundation for tool learning in financial scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 在金融领域，大语言模型（LLM）的工具使用能力至关重要。金融领域的特点是投资目标众多且需要处理大量数据。然而，现有的数据合成方法通常依赖于逆向合成范式，即根据预先采样好的工具来生成用户查询。这种方法不可避免地引入了人为的显性特征，导致生成的查询无法捕捉到现实世界中那些隐性的、由事件驱动的需求。此外，这种依赖静态工具集的方法忽略了在庞大的工具空间中进行动态检索的过程。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为“FinToolSyn”的前向合成框架，该框架旨在生成高质量的金融对话。我们的流程从角色指导和原子工具的合成开始，逐步发展到动态检索对话的生成。我们构建了一个包含43,066种工具的数据库，并合成了超过148,000个对话实例，其中采用了动态检索机制来模拟庞大工具空间中常见的噪声候选集。我们还建立了一个专门的基准测试，用于评估在真实金融场景中的工具调用能力。广泛的实验表明，使用FinToolSyn训练的模型能够实现21.06%的性能提升，这为金融场景中的工具学习提供了坚实的基础。

papers.title: From Fake to Real: Mitigating Out-of-Distribution Bias in In-Context Learning via Feedback Supervision from Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从假象到真实：通过大型语言模型的反馈监督来减轻外部分布偏差在上下文学习中的影响
papers.authors: Rui Song, Yingji Li, Jian Li, Fausto Giunchiglia, Hao Xu
papers.abstract: With the rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs), In-Context Learning (ICL) has emerged as one of the universal paradigms for unleashing the capabilities of LLMs. However, LLMs are generally plagued by various biases in context example selection, which can distort the model’s predictions. Although extensive research has focused on designing heuristic sample selection methods to mitigate biases in ICL, these approaches often struggle to adapt to highly biased out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios with significant shifts between test samples and context samples. To overcome the aforementioned issue, this paper proposes a LLM-driven iterative derivation method for OOD data pseudo-labeling (named LPL), aiming to mitigate the risk of performance degradation caused by OOD bias by avoiding direct use of source data. To mitigate the misleading effects of noise in pseudo-labels, we propose a filtering metric that integrates model confidence and perturbation perplexity to enhance the quality of pseudo-labels. Subsequently, in each iteration, LPL utilizes this metric to expand new pseudo-labeled data as contextual demonstrations and ultimately adopts a voting mechanism to ensure the stability of the predictions. A series of experiments conducted on various LLMs have confirmed that our proposed method can effectively reduce OOD biases, thereby opening up new avenues for research in ICL biases.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展，上下文学习（ICL）已成为释放LLMs能力的通用方法之一。然而，LLMs在上下文样本选择方面普遍存在各种偏见，这可能会扭曲模型的预测结果。尽管已有大量研究致力于设计启发式样本选择方法来减轻ICL中的偏见，但这些方法往往难以适应具有显著变化的测试样本与上下文样本之间的高偏见外部数据（OOD）场景。为了克服上述问题，本文提出了一种由LLM驱动的迭代推导方法，用于OOD数据的伪标签生成（简称LPL），该方法通过避免直接使用源数据，从而降低因OOD偏见导致的性能下降风险。为了减轻伪标签中噪声带来的误导效应，我们提出了一种过滤指标，该指标结合了模型置信度和扰动困惑度，以提高伪标签的质量。在每次迭代中，LPL利用该指标来扩展新的伪标签数据作为上下文示例，并最终采用投票机制来确保预测的稳定性。在多种LLMs上进行的系列实验表明，我们提出的方法能够有效减少OOD偏见，从而为ICL偏见的研究开辟了新的途径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Revealing and Enhancing Core Visual Regions: Harnessing Internal Attention Dynamics for Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
papers.title_zh: 揭示并强化核心视觉区域：利用内部注意力机制来减轻虚拟现实环境中的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Guangtao Lyu, Qi Liu, Chenghao Xu, Jiexi Yan, Muli Yang, Xueting Li, Fen Fang, Cheng Deng
papers.abstract: LVLMs have achieved strong multimodal reasoning capabilities but remain prone to hallucinations, producing outputs inconsistent with visual inputs or user instructions. Existing training-free methods, including contrastive decoding and auxiliary expert models, which incur several times more computational overhead and may introduce potential interference, as well as static internal signal enhancement, are often vulnerable to the attention sink phenomenon. We find that internal Positive Attention Dynamics (PAD) in LVLMs naturally reveal semantically core visual regions under the distortions of attention sinks. Based on this, we propose Positive Attention Dynamics Enhancement (PADE), a training-free attention intervention that constructs a PAD map to identify semantically core visual regions, applies per-head Median Absolute Deviation Scaling to adaptively control the intervention strength, and leverages System-Token Compensation to maintain attention to complex user instructions and support long-term output consistency. Experiments on multiple LVLMs and benchmarks show that PADE improves visual grounding and reduces hallucinations, validating the effectiveness of leveraging internal attention dynamics for reliable multimodal reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: LVLM已经实现了强大的多模态推理能力，但仍然容易出现幻觉现象，导致输出结果与视觉输入或用户指令不一致。现有的无需训练的方法，如对比度解码和辅助专家模型，虽然能够提升推理效率，但计算成本要高得多，并且可能会引入潜在的干扰因素。此外，静态内部信号增强方法也容易受到注意力消耗现象的影响。我们发现，LVLM内部的积极注意力动态能够自然地揭示在注意力消耗影响下的语义核心视觉区域。基于这一发现，我们提出了积极注意力动态增强方法——PADE。该方法无需额外训练即可实现注意力干预，通过构建积极注意力动态图来识别语义核心视觉区域，采用头部平均绝对偏差缩放技术来自适应控制干预强度，并利用系统-标记补偿机制来保持对复杂用户指令的注意力，从而确保长期输出的稳定性。在多个LVLM上的实验和基准测试表明，PADE能够有效改善视觉定位效果并减少幻觉现象，这验证了利用内部注意力动态进行可靠多模态推理的有效性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Is Chain-of-Thought Reasoning of LLMs a Mirage? A Data Distribution Lens
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中的思维链推理真的只是幻觉吗？数据分布的影响究竟如何？
papers.authors: Chengshuai Zhao, Zhen Tan, Pingchuan Ma, Dawei Li, Bohan Jiang, Yancheng Wang, Yingzhen Yang, Huan Liu
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has been shown to be effective in eliciting structured reasoning (i.e., CoT reasoning) from large language models (LLMs). Regardless of its popularity, recent studies expose its failures in some reasoning tasks, raising fundamental questions about the nature of CoT reasoning. In this work, we propose a data distribution lens to understand when and why CoT reasoning succeeds or fails. We hypothesize that CoT reasoning reflects a structured inductive bias learned from in-distribution data, enabling models to conditionally generate reasoning trajectories that approximate those observed during training. As such, the effectiveness of CoT reasoning is fundamentally governed by the nature and degree of distribution discrepancy between training data and test queries. Guided by this lens, we dissect CoT reasoning via three dimensions: task, length, and format. To test the hypothesis, we introduce DataAlchemy, an abstract and fully controllable environment that trains LLMs from scratch and systematically probes them under various distribution conditions. Through rigorous controlled experiments, we reveal that CoT reasoning is a brittle mirage when it is pushed beyond training distributions, emphasizing the ongoing challenge of achieving genuine and generalizable reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链提示已被证明能够在大语言模型中引发有结构的推理过程。尽管这种方法非常流行，但最近的研究发现它在某些推理任务中表现不佳，这引发了关于思维链推理本质的基本问题。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种数据分布视角来理解思维链推理为何会成功或失败。我们认为，思维链推理反映了从训练数据中学习到的结构化归纳性偏见，使得模型能够有条件地生成与训练过程中观察到的推理轨迹相似的推理路径。因此，思维链推理的有效性从根本上取决于训练数据与测试查询之间的分布差异的性质和程度。借助这一视角，我们通过任务、长度和格式三个维度来解析思维链推理。为了验证这一假设，我们引入了DataAlchemy——一个抽象且完全可控的环境，该环境能够从零开始训练大语言模型，并在不同的分布条件下对其进行系统性的测试。通过严格的实验验证，我们发现当思维链推理被推到训练分布之外时，其效果会变得不稳定，这凸显了实现真正且具有普遍性的推理能力的持续挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: WindowsWorld: A Process-Centric Benchmark of Autonomous GUI Agents in Professional Cross-Application Environments
papers.title_zh: WindowsWorld：一种以进程为中心的性能评估方法，用于衡量专业跨应用环境中自主GUI代理的性能表现
papers.authors: Jinchao Li, Yunxin li, Chenrui Zhao, Zhenran Xu, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: While GUI agents have shown impressive capabilities in common computer-use tasks such as OSWorld, current benchmarks mainly focus on isolated and single-application tasks. This overlooks a critical real-world requirement of coordinating across multiple applications to accomplish complex profession-specific workflows. To bridge this gap, we present a computer-use benchmark in cross-application workflows, named WindowsWorld, designed to systematically assess GUI Agents on complex multi-step tasks that mirror real-world professional activities. Our methodology uses a multi-agent framework steered by 16 occupations to generate four difficulty-level tasks with intermediate inspection, which are then refined by human review and executed in a simulated environment. The resulting benchmark contains 181 tasks with an average of 5.0 sub-goals across 17 common desktop applications, of which 78% are inherently multi-application. Experimental results of leading large models and agents show that: 1) All computer-use agents perform poorly on multi-application tasks (< 21% success rate), far below the performance of simple single-app tasks; 2) They largely fail at tasks requiring conditional judgment and reasoning across \geq3 applications, stalling at early sub-goals; 3) Low execution efficiency, where tasks often fail despite far exceeding human step limits. Code, benchmark data, and evaluation resources are available at github.com/HITsz-TMG/WindowsWorld.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然GUI代理在诸如OSWorld这样的常见计算机使用任务中展现出了令人印象深刻的性能，但当前的基准测试主要集中在孤立的、单一应用程序的任务上。这忽略了一个重要的现实需求：即需要跨多个应用程序进行协调，以完成复杂的专业工作流。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一个用于跨应用程序工作的计算机使用基准测试，名为WindowsWorld。该测试旨在系统地评估GUI代理在模拟真实专业活动的复杂多步骤任务中的表现。我们的方法采用了一个由16种职业驱动的多智能体框架，从而生成了四个不同难度级别的任务，这些任务需要中间检查，之后通过人工审核进行完善，并在模拟环境中执行。最终的基准测试包含181个任务，每个任务平均有5个子目标，涉及17种常见的桌面应用程序，其中78%的应用程序本质上是多应用程序的。对领先的大型模型和代理的实验结果表明：1）所有用于计算机使用的代理在多应用程序任务上的表现都很差（成功率低于21%），远远低于简单单一应用程序任务的表现；2）它们在需要条件判断和跨至少3个应用程序进行推理的任务上往往失败，在早期子目标阶段就会停滞；3）它们的执行效率很低，尽管任务的成功率很高，但仍然经常失败。代码、基准数据和评估资源可以在github.com/HITsz-TMG/WindowsWorld上获取。

papers.title: EDU-CIRCUIT-HW: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models on Real-World University-Level STEM Student Handwritten Solutions
papers.title_zh: EDU-CIRCUIT-HW：在真实的大学水平STEM学生手写解答上评估多模态大型语言模型的效果
papers.authors: Weiyu Sun, Liangliang Chen, Yongnuo Cai, Huiru Xie, Yi Zeng, Ying Zhang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) hold significant promise for revolutionizing traditional education and reducing teachers’ workload. However, accurately interpreting unconstrained STEM student handwritten solutions with intertwined mathematical formulas, diagrams, and textual reasoning poses a significant challenge due to the lack of authentic and domain-specific benchmarks. Additionally, current evaluation paradigms predominantly rely on the outcomes of downstream tasks (e.g., auto-grading), which often probe only a subset of the recognized content, thereby failing to capture the MLLMs’ understanding of complex handwritten logic as a whole. To bridge this gap, we release EDU-CIRCUIT-HW, a dataset consisting of 1,300+ authentic student handwritten solutions from a university-level STEM course. Utilizing the expert-verified verbatim transcriptions and grading reports of student solutions, we simultaneously evaluate various MLLMs’ upstream recognition fidelity and downstream auto-grading performance. Our evaluation uncovers an astonishing scale of latent failures within MLLM-recognized student handwritten content, highlighting the models’ insufficient reliability for auto-grading and other understanding-oriented applications in high-stakes educational settings. In response, we present a case study demonstrating that leveraging identified error patterns to preemptively detect and rectify recognition errors, with only minimal human intervention (e.g., with 3.3% assignments routed to human graders while the rest to GPT-5.1 grader), can effectively enhance the robustness of the deployed AI-enabled grading system on unseen student solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在革新传统教育、减轻教师工作负担方面具有巨大潜力。然而，准确解读那些包含复杂数学公式、图表和文本推理的STEM学科学生手写解答却是一个重大挑战，因为缺乏真实且针对特定领域的评估基准。此外，当前的评估方法主要依赖于下游任务的结果（例如自动评分），而这些结果往往只涵盖了被识别内容的一部分，因此无法全面反映大语言模型对复杂手写逻辑的理解能力。为了填补这一空白，我们发布了EDU-CIRCUIT-HW数据集，该数据集包含了来自大学水平STEM课程中的1300多份真实学生手写解答。通过利用经过专家验证的学生解答的逐字转录和评分报告，我们可以同时评估各种大语言模型的上游识别准确性和下游自动评分性能。我们的评估发现，大语言模型在识别学生手写内容时存在大量潜在错误，这表明这些模型在自动评分和其他需要理解的应用场景中的可靠性不足。为此，我们提出了一个案例研究，指出通过利用已识别的错误模式来提前检测并纠正识别错误，同时只需少量人工干预（例如，将3.3%的作业交给人工评分员，其余作业交给GPT-5.1进行评分），就能有效提高部署在AI辅助评分系统上的鲁棒性，使其能够在面对未知学生解答时也能表现良好。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: What Factors Affect LLMs and RLLMs in Financial Question Answering?
papers.title_zh: 哪些因素会影响金融问题回答中的大型语言模型与超大型语言模型的表现？
papers.authors: Peng Wang, Xuesi Hu, Jiageng Wu, Yuntao Zou, Qiancheng Zhang, Dagang Li
papers.abstract: Recently, large language models (LLMs) and reasoning large language models (RLLMs) have gained considerable attention from many researchers. RLLMs enhance the reasoning capabilities of LLMs through Long Chain-of-Thought (Long CoT) processes, significantly improving the performance of LLMs in addressing complex problems. However, there are few works that systematically explore what methods can fully unlock the performance of LLMs and RLLMs within the financial domain. To investigate the impact of various methods on LLMs and RLLMs, we utilize five LLMs and four RLLMs to assess the effects of prompting methods, agentic frameworks, and multilingual alignment methods on financial question-answering tasks. Our research findings indicate: (1) Current prompting methods and agent frameworks enhance the performance of LLMs in financial question answering by simulating Long CoT; (2) RLLMs possess inherent Long CoT capabilities, which limits the effectiveness of conventional methods in further enhancing their performance; (3) Current advanced multilingual alignment methods primarily improve the multilingual performance of LLMs by extending the reasoning length, which yields minimal benefits for RLLMs. Additionally, we discuss strategies for enhancing the performance of LLMs and RLLMs in financial question answering, which may serve as a inspiration for future improvements. We hope that this study can serve as an important reference for LLMs and RLLMs in the field of financial question answering.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，大语言模型（LLMs）和推理型大语言模型（RLLMs）受到了许多研究人员的广泛关注。RLLMs通过长思维链处理机制提升了LLMs的推理能力，显著提高了LLMs解决复杂问题的性能。然而，目前很少有研究系统地探讨哪些方法能够充分发挥LLMs和RLLMs在金融领域的性能。为了研究各种方法对LLMs和RLLMs的影响，我们使用了五款LLMs和四款RLLMs来评估提示方法、代理框架和多语言对齐方法对金融问题回答任务的效果。我们的研究发现表明：(1) 当前的提示方法和代理框架通过模拟长思维链处理机制，提升了LLMs在金融问题回答方面的性能；(2) RLLMs具有固有的长思维链处理能力，这限制了传统方法在进一步提升其性能方面的效果；(3) 当前先进的多语言对齐方法主要通过延长推理长度来提高LLMs的多语言性能，这对RLLMs来说收益有限。此外，我们还讨论了提升LLMs和RLLMs在金融问题回答方面性能的策略，这些策略可能为未来的改进提供启示。我们希望这项研究能成为金融问题回答领域中关于LLMs和RLLMs的重要参考依据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Superficial Success vs. Internal Breakdown: An Empirical Study of Generalization in Adaptive Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 表面上的成功与内在的崩溃：关于自适应多智能体系统中泛化问题的实证研究
papers.authors: Namyeong So, Seokgyu Jang, Taeuk Kim
papers.abstract: Adaptive multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly adopted as solutions to complex problems. However, their optimization for narrow task ranges leaves it unclear whether they can function as general-purpose systems. To fill this gap, we conduct an extensive empirical study on adaptive MAS, revealing two key findings: (1) they are prone to topological overfitting, defined as failures in domain transfer; and (2) they exhibit illusory coordination, where surface-level accuracy is high but underlying agent coordination deviates from ideal MAS behavior, raising concerns about their practical effectiveness. These observations highlight the urgent need to prioritize generalization in MAS development and motivate more thorough evaluation beyond correctness of the final answer.
papers.abstract_zh: 自适应多智能体系统被越来越多地用于解决复杂问题。然而，对于特定任务范围的优化效果并不明确，因此无法判断它们是否能够作为通用系统发挥作用。为了填补这一空白，我们对自适应多智能体系统进行了广泛的实证研究，得出了两个重要发现：(1) 这些系统容易出现拓扑过拟合现象，即无法在领域迁移过程中保持正常功能；(2) 它们表现出虚假的协调性，即表面上的准确性很高，但底层智能体的协作行为偏离了理想的智能体行为模式，这引发了对其实际有效性的担忧。这些观察结果凸显了在开发多智能体系统时优先考虑泛化能力的必要性，并促使我们进一步全面评估系统的性能，而不仅仅是最终答案的正确性。

papers.title: D^2-RAG: Dual-Decision Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Multi-Dimensional Uncertainty and Utility-Aware Decoding
papers.title_zh: D^2-RAG：通过多维不确定性与效用感知解码技术实现的双决策检索增强生成
papers.authors: Jinshuo Zhang, Xiaoding Zhou, Weiyu Zhang, Guoqiang Chen, Ying Lian, Xiaoyang Meng, Yonghe Chen, Hongjiao Guan, Jiasheng Si, Wenpeng Lu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates hallucinations in large language models by incorporating external knowledge. However, retrieval does not always return relevant documents and may return noisy ones. Indiscriminately retrieving and utilizing this external knowledge can interfere with the model’s originally correct reasoning. In this work, we propose Dual-Decision Retrieval-Augmented Generation (D^2-RAG), which integrates multi-dimensional uncertainty estimation to decide whether to retrieve and employs adaptive contrastive decoding to handle retrieved contexts of varying quality. Specifically, we first integrate uncertainty estimation scores that assess model uncertainty from multiple perspectives, construct them into a comprehensive feature vector, and train a lightweight retrieval decision model to accurately identify the model’s knowledge boundaries and determine whether to retrieve. Subsequently, we dynamically adjust the contrastive decoding strategy based on the utility of retrieved contexts to enhance the utilization of relevant contexts while suppressing interference from noisy contexts. Extensive experiments on four medical question-answering datasets demonstrate that D^2-RAG significantly outperforms baselines, enabling retrieval-augmented Llama3.1-8B to surpass non-retrieval-augmented Llama3.1-70B on the MedMCQA dataset. The source code is available on https://github.com/zakelawen/d--rag.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过结合外部知识来减轻大语言模型中的幻觉问题。然而，检索过程并不总能返回相关的文档，有时还会返回噪声较多的文档。不加选择地使用这些外部知识可能会干扰模型原本正确的推理过程。在这项研究中，我们提出了双决策检索增强生成（D^2-RAG）方法。该方法整合了多维不确定性估计，以决定是否进行检索，并通过自适应对比解码来处理不同质量的检索结果。具体来说，我们首先整合了从多个角度评估模型不确定性的不确定性估计分数，将其构建成一个综合特征向量，然后训练一个轻量级的检索决策模型，以准确识别模型的知识边界并决定是否进行检索。随后，我们根据检索到的上下文的实用性动态调整对比解码策略，从而在利用相关上下文的同时，抑制噪声上下文的干扰。在四个医学问答数据集上的广泛实验表明，D^2-RAG显著优于基线方法，使得带有检索增强功能的Llama3.1-8B能够在MedMCQA数据集上超越没有检索增强功能的Llama3.1-70B。源代码可在https://github.com/zakelawen/d--rag获取。

papers.title: ProFit: Leveraging High-Value Signals in SFT via Probability-Guided Token Selection
papers.title_zh: ProFit：通过概率引导的代币选择技术在SFT中利用高价值信号
papers.authors: Tao Liu, Taiqiang Wu, Runming Yang, Shaoning Sun, Junjie Wang, Yujiu Yang
papers.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is a fundamental post-training strategy to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intent. However, traditional SFT often ignores the \textit{one-to-many} nature of language by forcing alignment with a single reference answer, leading to the model overfitting to non-core expressions. Although our empirical analysis suggests that introducing multiple reference answers can mitigate this issue, the prohibitive data and computational costs necessitate a strategic shift: prioritizing the mitigation of single-reference overfitting over the costly pursuit of answer diversity. To achieve this, we reveal the intrinsic connection between token probability and semantic importance: high-probability tokens carry the core logical framework, while low-probability tokens are mostly replaceable expressions. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{ProFit}, which selectively masks low-probability tokens to prevent surface-level overfitting. Extensive experiments confirm that ProFit consistently outperforms traditional SFT baselines on general reasoning and mathematical benchmarks
papers.abstract_zh: 监督微调（SFT）是训练后用于使大语言模型与人类意图保持一致的基本策略。然而，传统的SFT往往忽略了语言的“一对多”特性，因为它强制模型与单一的参考答案进行对齐，导致模型过度拟合于非核心表达。尽管我们的实证分析表明，引入多个参考答案可以缓解这一问题，但高昂的数据和计算成本使得我们需要做出战略上的调整：优先解决单一参考答案导致的过度拟合问题，而不是耗费资源去追求答案的多样性。为了实现这一目标，我们揭示了令牌概率与语义重要性之间的内在联系：高概率的令牌承载了核心逻辑框架，而低概率的令牌则大多是可替代的表达方式。基于这一洞察，我们提出了**ProFit**算法，该算法会选择性地屏蔽低概率的令牌，以防止表面层次的过度拟合。广泛的实验表明，ProFit在一般推理和数学基准测试中的表现始终优于传统的SFT基线算法。

papers.title: DisastQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Question Answering in Disaster Management
papers.title_zh: DisastQA：用于评估灾难管理领域问答系统的全面基准测试
papers.authors: Zhitong Chen, Kai Yin, Xiangjue Dong, Chengkai Liu, Xiangpeng Li, Bo Li, Junwei Ma, Yiming Xiao, Ali Mostafavi, James Caverlee
papers.abstract: Accurate question answering (QA) in disaster management requires reasoning over uncertain and conflicting information, a setting poorly captured by existing benchmarks built on clean evidence. We introduce DisastQA, a rigorously verified benchmark of 3,000 expert-annotated questions (2,000 multiple-choice and 1,000 open-ended) spanning eight disaster types. The benchmark is constructed via a human-LLM collaboration pipeline with stratified sampling to ensure balanced coverage. Models are evaluated under varying evidence conditions, from closed-book to noisy evidence integration, enabling separation of internal knowledge from reasoning under imperfect information. For open-ended QA, we propose a human-verified keypoint-based evaluation protocol emphasizing factual completeness over verbosity. Experiments with 20 models reveal substantial divergences from general-purpose leaderboards such as MMLU-Pro. While recent open-weight models approach proprietary systems in clean settings, performance degrades sharply under realistic noise, exposing critical reliability gaps for disaster response. All code, data, and evaluation resources are available at https://github.com/TamuChen18/DisastQA
papers.abstract_zh: 在灾害管理中进行准确的问答任务，需要处理不确定且相互矛盾的信息。而现有的基于清晰证据的评估基准并不能很好地应对这种情况。我们提出了DisastQA这一经过严格验证的基准测试，该测试包含3000个由专家标注的问题，其中2000个是选择题，1000个是开放式问题，这些问题涵盖了八种不同类型的灾害。该基准测试是通过人与大语言模型协作的方式构建的，采用了分层抽样的方法来确保覆盖面的均衡性。模型在不同的证据条件下进行了评估，包括有固定答案的情况和存在噪声信息的情况，从而能够区分内部知识和在不完美信息下的推理能力。对于开放式问答任务，我们提出了一种基于关键点的评估方法，该方法强调事实的准确性而非冗长的描述。通过对20个模型的实验分析发现，这些模型与通用基准测试如MMLU-Pro相比存在显著差距。虽然最近的一些开放权重模型在清晰信息环境下能够接近专业系统的表现，但在现实噪声环境下，其性能会大幅下降，这暴露了灾害响应中关键的可靠性问题。所有代码、数据和评估资源都可以在https://github.com/TamuChen18/DisastQA获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TAGS: A Test-Time Generalist–Specialist Framework with Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning and Verification
papers.title_zh: 标签：具有检索增强推理和验证功能的通用型专家框架——适用于测试场景
papers.authors: Jianghao Wu, Feilong Tang, Yulong Li, Ming Hu, Haochen Xue, Shoaib Jameel, Zongyuan Ge, Yutong Xie, Imran Razzak
papers.abstract: Recent advances such as Chain-of-Thought prompting have significantly improved large language models (LLMs) in zero-shot medical reasoning. However, prompting-based methods often remain shallow and unstable, while fine-tuned medical LLMs suffer from poor generalization under distribution shifts and limited adaptability to unseen clinical scenarios. To address these limitations, we present TAGS, a test-time framework that combines a broadly capable generalist with a domain-specific specialist to offer complementary perspectives without any model fine-tuning or parameter updates. To support this generalist–specialist reasoning process, we introduce two auxiliary modules: a hierarchical retrieval mechanism that provides multi-scale exemplars by selecting examples based on both semantic and rationale-level similarity, and a reliability scorer that evaluates reasoning consistency to guide final answer aggregation. TAGS achieves strong performance across nine MedQA benchmarks, boosting GPT-4o accuracy by 13.8%, DeepSeek-R1 by 16.8%, and improving a vanilla 7B model from 14.1% to 23.9%. These results surpass several fine-tuned medical LLMs, without any parameter updates.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的进展，如思维链提示技术，显著提升了大语言模型在零样本医学推理方面的能力。然而，基于提示的方法往往仍然较为浅显且不稳定，而经过微调的医学语言模型在分布变化的情况下表现不佳，对未见过的临床场景的适应能力也有限。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了TAGS这一测试时框架。该框架结合了具有广泛能力的通用知识与特定领域的专业知识，无需任何模型微调或参数更新即可提供互补的视角。为了支持这种通用知识与专业知识相结合的逻辑推理过程，我们引入了两个辅助模块：一个分层检索机制，通过基于语义和逻辑层面的相似性来选择样本，从而提供多尺度的示例；以及一个可靠性评估模块，用于评估推理的一致性，以指导最终答案的汇总。TAGS在九个MedQA基准测试中取得了出色的性能，使GPT-4o的准确率提高了13.8%，DeepSeek-R1的准确率提高了16.8%，而原本只有14.1%准确率的7B模型则提升到了23.9%。这些成果超越了多个经过微调的医学语言模型，且无需进行任何参数更新。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: How Retrieved Context Shapes Internal Representations in RAG
papers.title_zh: 在RAG模型中，获取到的上下文如何塑造内部表征
papers.authors: Samuel Yeh, Sharon Li
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by conditioning generation on retrieved external documents, but the effect of retrieved context is often non-trivial. In realistic retrieval settings, the retrieved document set often contains a mixture of documents that vary in relevance and usefulness. While prior work has largely examined these phenomena through output behavior, little is known about how retrieved context shapes the internal representations that mediate information integration in RAG. In this work, we study RAG through the lens of latent representations. We systematically analyze how different types of retrieved documents affect the hidden states of LLMs, and how these internal representation shifts relate to downstream generation behavior. Across four question-answering datasets and three LLMs, we analyze internal representations under controlled single- and multi-document settings. Our results reveal how context relevancy and layer-wise processing influence internal representations, providing explanations of LLMs’ output behaviors and insights for RAG system design.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过以检索到的外部文档作为生成依据，提升了大语言模型的能力。然而，检索到的上下文的影响往往并非显而易见。在现实的检索场景中，被检索到的文档集通常包含各种相关性和实用性不同的文档。虽然之前的研究主要通过输出行为来研究这些现象，但对于检索到的上下文如何塑造介导信息整合的内部表示机制，目前仍知之甚少。在这项研究中，我们从潜在表示的视角来研究RAG。我们系统地分析了不同类型检索到的文档对大语言模型隐藏状态的影响，以及这些内部表示的变化如何与下游的生成行为相关联。通过四个问答数据集和三个大语言模型，我们在控制单文档和多文档的情况下分析了内部表示。我们的研究结果揭示了上下文相关性和逐层处理对内部表示的影响，为大语言模型的输出行为提供了解释，并为RAG系统的设计提供了重要启示。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TabularMath: Understanding Math Reasoning over Tables with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: TabularMath：利用大型语言模型理解表格上的数学推理机制
papers.authors: Shi-Yu Tian, Zhi Zhou, Wei Dong, Kun-Yang Yu, Ming Yang, Zi-Jian Cheng, Lan-Zhe Guo, Yu-Feng Li
papers.abstract: Mathematical reasoning has long been a key benchmark for evaluating large language models. Although substantial progress has been made on math word problems, the need for reasoning over tabular data in real-world applications has been overlooked. For instance, applications such as business intelligence demand not only multi-step numerical reasoning with tables but also robustness to incomplete or inconsistent information. However, comprehensive evaluation in this area is severely limited, constrained by the reliance on manually collected tables that are difficult to scale and the lack of coverage for potential traps encountered in real-world scenarios. To address this problem, we propose AutoT2T, a neuro-symbolic framework that controllably transforms math word problems into scalable and verified tabular reasoning tasks. Building on this pipeline, we develop TabularMath, a benchmark comprising four subsets that include both text-based and image-based tables, covering table complexity, table quality, and table representation dimensions. Our study reveals three key observations: (1) Table complexity and reasoning difficulty impact reasoning performance jointly; (2) Low-quality tables pose severe risks to reliable reasoning in current LLMs; (3) Different table modalities show similar trends, with text-based tables typically being easier for models to reason over. In-depth analyses are conducted for each observation to guide future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 数学推理长期以来一直是评估大语言模型的关键标准。尽管在解决数学应用题方面已经取得了显著进展，但在实际应用中对表格数据的推理需求却被忽视了。例如，商业智能类应用不仅需要能够处理多步骤数值计算的表格数据，还需要具备应对不完整或不一致信息的能力。然而，在这一领域的全面评估受到了严重限制，因为依赖于手动收集的表格数据难以实现规模化扩展，同时也没有涵盖现实场景中可能出现的各种陷阱。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了AutoT2T这一神经符号框架，它能够将数学应用题可控地转化为可扩展且经过验证的表格推理任务。在此基础上，我们开发了TabularMath基准测试，该测试包含四个子集，涵盖了基于文本和图像的表格数据，从而可以评估表格的复杂性、质量以及表示方式。我们的研究发现了三个关键现象：(1) 表格的复杂性和推理难度共同影响着推理性能；(2) 低质量的表格会对当前大语言模型的可靠推理带来严重风险；(3) 不同形式的表格表现出相似的趋势，基于文本的表格通常更容易被模型处理。针对每个现象进行了深入分析，以指导未来的研究方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Seek-and-Solve: Benchmarking MLLMs for Visual Clue-Driven Reasoning in Daily Scenarios
papers.title_zh: 寻求解法：针对日常场景中基于视觉线索的推理任务，对大型语言模型进行基准测试
papers.authors: Xiaomin Li, Tala Wang, Zichen Zhong, Ying Zhang, Zirui Zheng, Takashi Isobe, Dezhuang Li, Huchuan Lu, You He, Xu Jia
papers.abstract: Daily scenarios are characterized by visual richness, requiring Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to filter noise and identify decisive visual clues for accurate reasoning. Yet, current benchmarks predominantly aim at evaluating MLLMs’ pre-existing knowledge or perceptual understanding, often neglecting the critical capability of reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce DailyClue, a benchmark designed for visual clue-driven reasoning in daily scenarios. Our construction is guided by two core principles: (1) strict grounding in authentic daily activities, and (2) challenging query design that necessitates more than surface-level perception. Instead of simple recognition, our questions compel MLLMs to actively explore suitable visual clues and leverage them for subsequent reasoning. To this end, we curate a comprehensive dataset spanning four major daily domains and 16 distinct subtasks. Comprehensive evaluation across MLLMs and agentic models underscores the formidable challenge posed by our benchmark. Our analysis reveals several critical insights, emphasizing that the accurate identification of visual clues is essential for robust reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 日常场景的特点是视觉信息丰富，这就需要多模态大语言模型来过滤噪声，识别关键的视觉线索，以实现准确的推理。然而，目前的评估标准大多侧重于评估大语言模型的现有知识或感知能力，而忽视了推理这一关键能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了DailyClue这个针对日常场景中基于视觉线索的推理的评估基准。我们的设计遵循两个核心原则：(1)严格基于真实的日常活动进行建模；(2)采用具有挑战性的查询设计，要求模型具备超越表面感知的能力。我们的问题并非简单的识别，而是促使模型主动探索合适的视觉线索，并利用这些线索进行后续的推理。为此，我们构建了一个涵盖四个主要日常领域和16种不同任务的综合数据集。对大语言模型和智能体模型的全面评估表明，我们的评估基准面临着巨大的挑战。我们的分析揭示了几个重要观点：准确识别视觉线索对于实现稳健的推理至关重要。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Structured and Abstractive Reasoning on Multi-modal Relational Knowledge Images
papers.title_zh: 多模态关系知识图像上的结构化与抽象推理
papers.authors: Yichi Zhang, Zhuo Chen, Lingbing Guo, Wen Zhang, Huajun Chen
papers.abstract: Understanding and reasoning with abstractive information from the visual modality presents significant challenges for current multi-modal large language models (MLLMs). Among the various forms of abstractive information, Multi-Modal Relational Knowledge (MMRK), which represents abstract relational structures between multi-modal entities using node-edge formats, remains largely under-explored. In particular, STructured and Abstractive Reasoning (STAR) on such data has received little attention from the research community. To bridge the dual gaps in large-scale high-quality data and capability enhancement methodologies, this paper makes the following key contributions: (i). An automatic STAR data engine to synthesize images with MMRK to build multi-modal instructions with reliable chain-of-thought thinking for various STAR tasks and (ii). A comprehsive two-stage training framework, accompanied by knowledge-informed GRPO and a suite of evaluation protocols tailored to different STAR tasks. Based upon these contributions, we introduce STAR-64K, a dataset comprising 64K high-quality multi-modal instruction samples, and conduct experiments across 8 open-source MLLMs. Experimental results show that our two-stage enhancement framework enables smaller 3B/7B models to significantly outperform GPT-4o in STAR. Additionally, we provide in-depth analysis regarding the effectiveness of various designs, data transferability, and scalability.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于当前的多模态大语言模型来说，理解并推理来自视觉模态的抽象信息面临着重大挑战。在各种形式的抽象信息中，多模态关系知识这种以节点-边格式表示多模态实体之间抽象关系结构的形式，仍然没有得到充分探索。特别是，针对这类数据的结构化抽象推理研究，尚未得到研究界的广泛关注。为了填补大规模高质量数据以及能力增强方法方面的空白，本文提出了以下关键贡献：(i) 一种自动化的结构化抽象推理数据引擎，能够利用多模态关系知识来合成图像，从而为各种结构化抽象推理任务构建具有可靠思维链的多模态指令；(ii) 一个包含两阶段训练框架的综合方法，该方法结合了基于知识的GRPO算法，并配备了一系列适用于不同结构化抽象推理任务的评估协议。基于这些贡献，我们引入了STAR-64K数据集，该数据集包含64K个高质量的多模态指令样本，并在8种开源大语言模型中进行了实验验证。实验结果表明，我们的两阶段增强框架使得较小的3B/7B模型在结构化抽象推理任务中的表现显著优于GPT-4o。此外，我们还对多种设计方案的有效性、数据可迁移性以及可扩展性进行了深入分析。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Code Reffix: A Benchmark for Reflection-Guided Code Repair with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 代码修复工具：一种基于反射机制的代码修复基准测试工具，适用于大型语言模型场景
papers.authors: Zaiyuan Di, Jianting Chen, Yunxiao Yang, Xiaoying Gao, Li Yang, Zhihao Wang, Yang Xiang
papers.abstract: While recent studies have increasingly emphasized the role of reflection in code repair tasks, existing benchmarks still target the repair generation capability of LLMs, lacking fine-grained evaluation of reflection generation capability. To this end, we propose Code Reffix, a benchmark featuring an automated pipeline with oracle reflections and a dual-task protocol to decouple the evaluation of reflection from repair. Through extensive experiments on 14 LLMs and fine-tuning analysis, we aim to pinpoint performance bottlenecks of code repair, quantify reflection quality, and verify the value of reflection optimization. Evaluations reveal that underperforming reflection capabilities of small-scale LLMs remain a major bottleneck for code repair. By quantifying this gap, Code Reffix provides a critical foundation for optimizing LLMs to achieve superior repair performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然最近的研究越来越强调反思在代码修复任务中的作用，但现有的基准测试仍然集中在大语言模型生成修复方案的能力上，缺乏对反思生成能力的细致评估。为此，我们提出了Code Reffix这一基准测试工具。该工具采用自动化流程，包含有参考依据的反思内容，并采用双任务协议来分离反思评估与修复过程的评估。通过对14种大语言模型进行广泛实验和分析，我们希望能够找出代码修复过程中的性能瓶颈，量化反思的质量，并验证反思优化的重要性。评估结果显示，小型语言模型在反思能力方面的不足仍然是代码修复的主要障碍。通过量化这一差距，Code Reffix为优化大语言模型以取得更好的修复效果提供了重要的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ProtoCycle: Reflective Tool-Augmented Planning for Text-Guided Protein Design
papers.title_zh: ProtoCycle：基于反思性工具增强的规划方法，用于文本引导下的蛋白质设计
papers.authors: Yutang Ge, Guojiang Zhao, Sihang Li, Zheng Cheng, Zifeng Zhao, Hanchen Xia, Guolin Ke, Linfeng Zhang, Zhifeng Gao, Yu Guang Wang
papers.abstract: Designing proteins that satisfy natural language functional requirements is a central goal in protein engineering. A straightforward baseline is to fine-tune generic instruction-tuned LLMs as direct text-to-sequence generators, but this is data- and compute-hungry. With limited supervision, LLMs can produce coherent plans in text yet fail to reliably realize them as sequences. This plan–execute gap motivates ProtoCycle, an agentic framework for protein design that uses LLMs primarily to drive a multi-round, feedback-driven decision cycle. ProtoCycle couples an LLM planner with a lightweight tool environment designed to emulate the iterative workflow of human protein engineers and uses LLM-driven reflection on tool feedback to revise plans. Trained with supervised trajectories and online reinforcement learning, ProtoCycle achieves strong language alignment while maintaining competitive foldability, and ablations show that reflection substantially improves sequence quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 设计能够满足自然语言功能要求的蛋白质是蛋白质工程中的一个核心目标。一个简单的方法是将通用的指令微调大语言模型作为直接将文本转换为序列的生成工具，但这种方法需要大量的数据和计算资源。在有限的监督下，大语言模型能够生成连贯的文本计划，但却无法可靠地将这些计划转化为具体的序列结构。这种计划与执行之间的差距促使人们提出了ProtoCycle这一蛋白质设计代理框架。该框架主要利用大语言模型来驱动一个多轮次的、基于反馈的决策过程。ProtoCycle将大语言模型规划器与一个轻量级工具环境相结合，这个工具环境旨在模拟人类蛋白质工程师的迭代工作流程。通过利用大语言模型对工具反馈进行反思，可以修改计划。经过有监督的训练和在线强化学习后，ProtoCycle能够在保持良好语言一致性的同时，实现具有竞争力的折叠能力。实验结果表明，这种反思机制显著提升了序列的质量。

papers.title: SEC-FinTables: Evaluating Large Language Models for Detecting Logical Inconsistencies on Tabular Data
papers.title_zh: SEC-FinTables：评估大型语言模型在检测表格数据中的逻辑不一致性方面的性能
papers.authors: Shuyan Ke, Qiong Wu, Hui Li, Liujuan Cao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains reliant on tabular data (e.g., financial reporting), where undetected logical inconsistencies such as mismatched totals and components can lead to critical errors. Yet, the ability of LLMs to identify such inconsistencies remains poorly understood, hindered by the absence of standardized evaluation frameworks and cell-level annotated datasets. To bridge this gap, we propose a comprehensive benchmark SEC-Fintables comprising 103,395 real-world and error-injected table instances, alongside a novel evaluation protocol that decomposes inconsistency detection into granular sub-tasks. Through evaluating both proprietary and open-source LLMs on SEC-Fintables, we find that contemporary LLMs exhibit only partial competence in detecting logical inconsistencies. Our study reveals key limitations and improvement opportunities for LLMs. We believe SEC-Fintables and our evaluation protocol can serve as a practical resource for advancing reliable inconsistency detection of LLMs in tabular reasoning. We release SEC-Fintables at https://github.com/XIEFOX/SEC-Fintables.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在依赖表格数据的高风险领域得到了广泛应用（例如财务报告），在这些领域中，未被发现的逻辑不一致性，如总数和组成部分的不匹配，可能会导致严重的错误。然而，大语言模型识别此类不一致性的能力仍然缺乏了解，这主要是由于缺乏标准化的评估框架以及细胞级标注数据集所导致的。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种全面的基准测试——SEC-Fintables。该测试包含103,395个真实世界的表格实例以及被人为添加错误的表格实例。我们还提出了一种新的评估协议，将不一致性检测分解为多个细粒度任务。通过对专有和开源的大语言模型在SEC-Fintables上的评估，我们发现当前的大语言模型在检测逻辑不一致性方面仅具备部分能力。我们的研究揭示了大语言模型存在的关键局限性以及改进的空间。我们认为，SEC-Fintables和我们的评估协议可以成为推动大语言模型在表格推理领域实现可靠不一致性检测的实用工具。我们将在https://github.com/XIEFOX/SEC-Fintables上发布这些表格实例。
