papers.title: QueryLink: Leveraging Query-Memory Alignment for Long-Term Reasoning in LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: QueryLink：利用查询与内存的同步机制来实现LLM代理的长期推理能力
papers.authors: Xuxian Hu, Zhu Teng, Wei Zhang, Ming He, Jianping Fan
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are widely used to mitigate the stateless nature of Large Language Models (LLMs) in long-term and personalized interactions by incorporating external memory. However, existing approaches often prioritize memory organization, such as knowledge graphs, while overlooking a critical semantic gap between implicit, intent-driven queries and explicit, narrative-based memories. To bridge this gap, we propose QueryLink, a novel framework that leverages Query-Memory Alignment to project both queries and memories into a shared semantic space. It significantly boosts recall by facilitating multi-grained retrieval of semantically relevant information. To further enhance memory retrieval, we leverage Coherent Memory Chunking, a mechanism that processes memories in multi-turn dialogue units, preserving semantic integrity, rather than relying on fixed-size segments. Extensive experiments on the LoCoMo and LongMemEval benchmark demonstrate that QueryLink significantly outperforms SOTA methods, achieving at least a 7% improvement in reasoning accuracy (measured by LLM). Additionally, QueryLink can be integrated as a plug-and-play component to boost existing vector-based systems like A-MEM, leading to improvements of over 6% in both F1 and B1 scores.The code is available at https://github.com/Dontplay0112/querylink.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统被广泛用于通过引入外部记忆来弥补大语言模型在长期和个性化交互中的无状态特性。然而，现有的方法往往更注重记忆的组织结构，比如知识图谱，而忽视了隐式、基于意图的查询与显式、基于叙事的记忆之间存在的语义差距。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了QueryLink这一创新框架，该框架利用查询-记忆对齐技术，将查询和记忆都映射到一个共同的语义空间。这种方法显著提升了检索效率，因为它能够多粒度地检索与语义相关的信息。为了进一步改善记忆检索效果，我们采用了连贯记忆分段机制，该机制以多轮对话单元的形式处理记忆，从而保持语义完整性，而不是依赖固定大小的片段。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval基准测试上的大量实验表明，QueryLink的性能明显优于现有的最先进方法，其推理准确率至少提高了7%（以LLM为衡量标准）。此外，QueryLink还可以作为即插式的组件被集成到现有的基于向量的系统中，如A-MEM，从而使F1和B1分数分别提高超过6%。代码可在https://github.com/Dontplay0112/querylink获取。

papers.title: AutoPKG: An Automated Framework for Dynamic E-commerce Product-Attribute Knowledge Graph Construction
papers.title_zh: AutoPKG：一种用于动态构建电子商务产品属性知识图的自动化框架
papers.authors: Pollawat Hongwimol, Haoning Shang, Chutong Wang, Zhichao Wan, Yi Gao, Yuanming Li, Lin Gui, Wenhao Sun, Cheng Yu
papers.abstract: Product attribute extraction in e-commerce is bottlenecked by ontologies that are inconsistent, incomplete, and costly to maintain. We present AutoPKG, a multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) framework that automatically constructs a Product-attribute Knowledge Graph (PKG) from multimodal product content. AutoPKG induces product types and type-specific attribute keys on demand, extracts attribute values from text and images, and consolidates updates through a centralized decision agent that maintains a globally consistent canonical graph. We also propose an evaluation protocol for dynamic PKGs that measures type/key validity and consolidation quality, as well as edge-level accuracy for value assertions after canonicalization. On a large real-world marketplace catalog dataset from Lazada (Alibaba), AutoPKG achieves up to 0.953 Weighted Knowledge Efficiency (WKE) for product types, 0.724 WKE for attribute keys, and 0.531 edge-level F1 for multimodal value extraction. Across three public benchmarks, we improve edge-level exact-match F1 by 0.152 and yield a 0.208 precision gain on the attribute extraction application. Online A/B tests show that AutoPKG-derived attributes increase Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) in Badge (+3.81%), Search (+5.32%), and Recommendation (+7.89%), supporting AutoPKG’s practical value in production.
papers.abstract_zh: 在电子商务中，产品属性提取面临着一个瓶颈问题，即存在不一致、不完整且维护成本高的本体。我们提出了AutoPKG这一多智能体大语言模型框架，它能够从多模态产品内容中自动构建产品属性知识图谱。AutoPKG能够根据需求自动识别产品类型及特定类型的属性键，从文本和图像中提取属性值，并通过一个中央决策代理来整合这些更新信息，从而形成一个全球一致的规范图谱。我们还提出了一种动态知识图谱的评估方案，该方案能够衡量类型/键的有效性、整合质量以及规范化后属性断言的准确程度。在阿里巴巴Lazada平台提供的大型真实市场目录数据集上，AutoPKG在产品类型方面达到了0.953的加权知识效率，在属性键方面达到了0.724的加权知识效率，在多模态属性提取方面则达到了0.531的精确匹配F1分数。在三个公开基准测试中，我们的系统将边级精确匹配F1分数提高了0.152，同时在属性提取应用上实现了0.208的精度提升。在线A/B测试表明，由AutoPKG生成的属性能够提高商品总价值：在徽章销售中提高3.81%，在搜索中提高5.32%，在推荐中提高7.89%。这充分证明了AutoPKG在实际生产中的实用价值。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLMs on Authentic Cases from Medical Journals
papers.title_zh: 在医学期刊中的真实案例上对大型语言模型进行性能比较
papers.authors: Wanlong Liu, Junying Chen, Yunjin Yang, Prayag Tiwari, Wenyu Chen, Benyou Wang
papers.abstract: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in the medical domain. However, existing medical benchmarks suffer from performance saturation and are predominantly derived from medical exam questions, which fail to reflect the complexity of real-world clinical scenarios.To bridge this gap, we introduce ClinBench, a challenging benchmark based on authentic clinical cases sourced from authoritative medical journals. Each question retains the complete patient information and clinical test results from the original case, effectively simulating real-world clinical practice. Additionally, we implement a rigorous human review process involving medical experts to ensure the quality and reliability of the benchmark. ClinBench supports both textual and multimodal evaluation formats, covering 11 medical specialties with over 2,000 questions, including a dedicated rare disease track, providing a comprehensive resource for assessing the medical reasoning capabilities of LLMs. We evaluate the performance of over 20 open-source and proprietary LLMs and benchmark them against human medical experts. Our findings reveal that human experts still retain an advantage within their specialized fields, while LLMs demonstrate superior overall performance on a broader range of medical specialties.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，大语言模型在医学领域展现出了显著的能力。然而，现有的医学评估基准存在性能饱和的问题，而且这些基准大多来源于医学考试题目，无法反映现实世界中的临床场景的复杂性。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了ClinBench——一个基于权威医学期刊中真实临床案例构建的挑战性评估基准。每个问题都包含了原始案例中的完整患者信息和临床测试结果，从而有效模拟了现实世界的临床实践。此外，我们还实施了严格的人工审核流程，由医学专家参与审核，以确保评估基准的质量和可靠性。ClinBench支持文本和多模态评估格式，涵盖了11个医学专业领域，共有2000多个问题，其中还包含专门针对罕见病的专项内容，为评估大语言模型的医学推理能力提供了全面的资源。我们对20多种开源和专有的大语言模型进行了性能评估，并将其与人类医学专家进行了对比。我们的研究发现表明，人类专家在其专业领域内仍然具有优势，而大语言模型则在更广泛的医学专业领域表现出更出色的性能。

papers.title: Beyond Quantity: Trajectory Diversity Scaling for Code Agents
papers.title_zh: 超越数量：适用于代码智能体的轨迹多样性缩放方法
papers.authors: Guhong Chen, Chenghao Sun, Cheng Fu, Qiyao Wang, Zhihong Huang, ChaoPeng Wei, Guangxu Chen, Feiteng Fang, Ahmadreza Argha, Bing Zhao, Xander Xu, Qi Han, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Qiang Qu, Binhua Li, Shiwen Ni, Min Yang, HU Wei, Yongbin Li
papers.abstract: As code large language models (LLMs) evolve into tool-interactive agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), their generalization is increasingly limited by low-quality synthetic data and the diminishing returns of quantity scaling; moreover, quantity-centric scaling exhibits an early bottleneck that underutilizes trajectory data. We propose TDScaling, a Trajectory Diversity Scaling-based data synthesis framework for code agents that scales performance through diversity rather than raw volume. Moreover, TDScaling is more data-efficient: under a fixed training budget, increasing trajectory diversity yields larger gains than adding more trajectories, improving the performance-cost trade-off for agent training. TDScaling integrates four innovations: (1) a Business Cluster mechanism that captures real-service logical dependencies; (2) a Blueprint-driven multi-agent paradigm that enforces trajectory coherence; (3) an adaptive evolution mechanism that steers synthesis toward long-tail scenarios using Domain Entropy, Reasoning Mode Entropy, and Cumulative Action Complexity to prevent mode collapse; and (4) a sandboxed code tool that mitigates catastrophic forgetting of intrinsic coding capabilities. Experiments on general tool-use benchmarks (BFCL, \tau^2-Bench) and code agent tasks (RebenchT, CodeCI, BIRD) demonstrate a win-win outcome: TDScaling improves both tool-use generalization and inherent coding proficiency. Crucially, we show that trajectory diversity scaling attains a substantially higher performance ceiling than quantity scaling, establishing a resource-efficient paradigm for training robust code agents under data bottlenecks.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着代码大语言模型通过模型上下文协议逐渐发展为与工具交互的智能体，它们的泛化能力受到低质量合成数据以及数量扩展收益递减的限制。此外，以数量为核心的扩展方式存在早期瓶颈，导致轨迹数据的利用不足。我们提出了TDScaling这一基于轨迹多样性扩展的数据合成框架，它通过提高多样性而非单纯增加数据量来提升代码智能体的性能。而且，TDScaling在数据使用上更为高效：在固定的训练预算下，增加轨迹多样性所带来的性能提升，比增加更多轨迹要显著得多，从而改善了智能体训练的性能与成本之间的权衡。TDScaling整合了四项创新技术：(1) 业务集群机制，能够捕捉真实服务中的逻辑依赖关系；(2) 基于蓝图的多智能体范式，确保轨迹数据的连贯性；(3) 自适应进化机制，利用领域熵、推理模式熵和累积动作复杂度来引导合成过程，避免模式崩溃；以及(4) 沙盒化的代码工具，有效防止固有编码能力的灾难性遗忘。在通用工具使用基准测试（如BFCIL、τ^2-Bench）和代码智能体任务（如RebenchT、CodeCI、BIRD）上的实验表明，TDScaling在工具使用泛化能力和固有编码能力方面均取得了显著改善。关键的是，我们发现轨迹多样性扩展所达到的性能水平，远高于数量扩展，这为在数据资源有限的情况下训练出强大的代码智能体提供了高效的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rethinking RL Evaluation: Can Benchmarks Truly Reveal Failures of RL Methods?
papers.title_zh: 重新思考强化学习方法的评估：基准测试真的能揭示强化学习方法的缺陷吗？
papers.authors: Zihan Chen, Yiming Zhang, Hengguang Zhou, Zenghui Ding, Yining Sun, Cho-Jui Hsieh
papers.abstract: Current benchmarks are inadequate for evaluating progress in reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs). Despite recent benchmark gains reported for RL, we find that training on these benchmarks’ training sets achieves nearly the same performance as training directly on the test sets, suggesting that the benchmarks cannot reliably separate further progress. To study this phenomenon, we introduce a diagnostic suite and the Oracle Performance Gap (OPG) metric that quantifies the performance difference between training on the train split versus the test split of a benchmark. We further analyze this phenomenon with stress tests and find that, despite strong benchmark scores, existing RL methods struggle to generalize across distribution shifts, varying levels of difficulty, and counterfactual scenarios: shortcomings that current benchmarks fail to reveal. We conclude that current benchmarks are insufficient for evaluating generalization and propose three core principles for designing more faithful benchmarks: sufficient difficulty, balanced evaluation, and distributional robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的评估基准不足以准确衡量强化学习在大语言模型领域的进展。尽管最近有报道称强化学习的评估基准有所提升，但我们发现，使用这些基准的训练集所达到的性能与直接使用测试集进行训练的性能几乎相同。这表明这些基准无法可靠地反映进一步的进步。为了研究这一现象，我们引入了一套诊断工具以及“Oracle Performance Gap”指标，该指标能够量化在基准测试的训练集部分与测试集部分进行训练时性能的差异。我们还通过压力测试进一步分析了这一现象，发现尽管现有的强化学习方法在基准测试中表现优异，但在处理不同难度级别以及反事实情境时仍然存在问题：这些问题是当前基准测试未能发现的。因此，我们认为目前的评估基准不足以评估模型的泛化能力，并提出了三个设计更可靠的评估基准的核心原则：足够的难度、均衡的评估方式以及良好的分布鲁棒性。

papers.title: CaPEdit: Capability-Preserving Lifelong Knowledge Editing For Language Models
papers.title_zh: CaPEdit：旨在保护能力并持续为语言模型提供知识的编辑方法
papers.authors: Song-Li Wu, Zhaocheng Du, Xianquan Wang, Jingyi Wang
papers.abstract: Lifelong knowledge editing (LKE) aims to incrementally correct factual inaccuracies in large language models (LLMs), but sequential edits can lead to substantial degradation of capabilities. Existing approaches primarily rely on static parameter regularization, which restricts knowledge integration and fails to prevent cumulative capability degradation. We argue that an important source of this degradation lies in the temporal mismatch between locally editable factual knowledge and procedural knowledge, which is gradually acquired, guides task execution, and cannot be reliably updated by rapid edits. To this end, we formulate LKE as a dual-timescale process, explicitly decoupling fast-updating factual knowledge from slow-evolving procedural knowledge. Based on this formulation, we propose CaPEdit, a framework that preserves model capabilities under LKE. It first synthesizes procedural knowledge across successive edits, and subsequently performs parameter updates guided jointly by factual supervision and the synthesized procedural signal. To ensure stability under long edit sequences, CaPEdit is trained via a hybrid optimization scheme, combining step-wise updates for rapid factual correction with trajectory-level optimization to facilitate gradual procedural adaptation. Experiments demonstrate that CaPEdit improves capability preservation across all fundamental capabilities by 49.78%, achieves superior editing performance, and requires only 18.07% of the editing time of most existing methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 终身知识编辑（LKE）旨在逐步纠正大语言模型中的事实错误，但连续的编辑操作可能会导致模型能力的显著下降。现有的方法主要依赖于静态参数正则化，这限制了知识的整合，并且无法防止能力的持续下降。我们认为，这种能力下降的一个重要原因在于，局部可编辑的事实知识与程序性知识在时间上的不匹配。程序性知识是逐渐获得的，它指导任务的执行过程，因此无法通过快速的编辑来可靠地更新。为此，我们将LKE描述为一个双时间尺度过程，明确地将快速更新的事实知识与缓慢演变的程序性知识分离开来。基于这一构想，我们提出了CaPEdit框架，该框架能够在LKE的情况下保持模型的性能。该框架首先在连续编辑过程中合成程序性知识，然后结合事实监督和合成的程序性信号来进行参数更新。为了确保长时间编辑过程中的稳定性，CaPEdit采用了混合优化方案进行训练，既通过逐步更新来实现快速的事实修正，又通过轨迹级优化来促进程序的逐步适应。实验表明，CaPEdit能够将所有基本能力的保持效果提高49.78%，其编辑性能优于大多数现有方法，且所需的编辑时间仅相当于现有方法的18.07%。

papers.title: Exploring Layer-wise Information Effectiveness for Post-Training Quantization in Small Language Models
papers.title_zh: 探讨在小型语言模型中，训练后量化处理时逐层信息利用的效果
papers.authors: He Xiao, Qingyao Yang, Dirui Xie, Wendong XU, Zunhai Su, Runming Yang, Haobo Liu, Wenyong Zhou, Zhengwu Liu, Ngai Wong
papers.abstract: Large language models with billions of parameters are often over-provisioned: many layers contribute little unique information yet dominate the memory and energy footprint during inference. We present LieQ (Layer-wise information effectiveness Quantization), a hardware-native, metric-driven post-training quantization framework that addresses the critical challenge of maintaining accuracy in sub-8B models, model parameters less than 8B, under extreme low-bit compression. LieQ keeps uniform bit-width within each layer while mixing precision across layers, preserving standard multiplication kernels and avoiding irregular memory access, codebooks, or irregular formats at inference time. Our method uncovers a strong correlation between layer-wise functional saliency and representational compactness, revealing that layers with higher training-induced energy concentration are functionally irreplaceable. Leveraging this insight, we propose a purely geometry-driven sensitivity proxy that enables automatic bit-width allocation under a target average-bit budget without expensive gradient updates or inference-based perplexity probing. Under an average weight bit-width approaching two bits per parameter, LieQ consistently reduces the large accuracy gap typically observed for naive uniform 2-bit baselines on Qwen3 and LLaMA3.x families, while retaining standard-kernel efficiency. These properties make LieQ a practical path toward deploying small language models on resource-constrained edge devices. Code will be available at: https://github.com/HeXiao-55/LieQ-official.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 那些拥有数十亿参数的大语言模型往往存在过度配置的问题：许多层虽然贡献的信息很少，但在推理过程中却占据了大量的内存和能源。我们提出了LieQ（分层信息有效性量化）这一基于硬件的、以度量为导向的训练后量化框架。该框架旨在解决在极低比特压缩率下，如何保持超过8B模型精度的问题。LieQ能够在保持每层比特宽度一致的同时，实现各层之间的精度混合，从而保留标准的乘法核函数，并避免在推理过程中出现不规则的内存访问、代码簿或格式问题。我们的方法揭示了逐层功能显著性与表征紧凑性之间的强相关性，发现那些因训练而产生较高能耗的层在功能上是不可替代的。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一种完全基于几何形状的敏感性代理机制，它能够在不进行昂贵的梯度更新或基于推理的困惑度检测的情况下，自动分配比特宽度。在平均权重比特宽度接近每个参数两个比特的情况下，LieQ能够显著减少在Qwen3和LaLA3.x系列模型中常见的较大精度差距，同时仍保持标准核函数的效率。这些特性使得LieQ成为在资源有限的边缘设备上部署小型语言模型的实用方案。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/HeXiao-55/LieQ-official.git

papers.title: ELTLM: Evaluation of Longitudinal Temporal Large Multimodal Models in Clinical Scenarios
papers.title_zh: ELTLM：在临床场景中对纵向时间维度上的多模态模型进行评估
papers.authors: Gengyuan Hu, Haoxiang Liu, Chenhong Cao, Shilei Tan, Wei Gong
papers.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have demonstrated significant potential in the medical domain, achieving impressive performance on tasks ranging from report generation to visual question answering. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on static evaluation, assessing models on isolated data points. This approach neglects a critical aspect of clinical practice: longitudinal analysis, where physicians interpret patient data as a dynamic trajectory to track disease progression and treatment response. To address this gap, we introduce ELTLM, the first benchmark specifically tailored to assess the temporal perception and reasoning capabilities of medical LMMs. Constructed from temporal chest X-rays, ELTLM features a hierarchical task taxonomy comprising Temporal Perception QA and Temporal Reasoning QA, requiring models to detect fine-grained visual changes and infer high-level clinical trends. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art models reveals that while they excel in static scenarios, they struggle significantly with temporal grounding and consistency. ELTLM serves as a vital resource to identify these limitations and guide the development of future time-aware medical AI systems. Our data is available at ELTLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型多模态模型在医学领域展现出巨大的潜力，其在从报告生成到视觉问答等各种任务上都取得了令人印象深刻的性能。然而，现有的评估基准主要侧重于静态评估，即仅针对孤立的数据点来评估模型性能。这种方法忽略了一个至关重要的临床实践方面：纵向分析，医生需要将患者数据视为一个动态轨迹，以追踪疾病的进展和治疗效果。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ELTLM——首个专门用于评估医学多模态模型的时间感知和推理能力的基准测试。ELTLM基于时间连续的胸部X光片构建，其任务分类包括时间感知问答和时间推理问答，要求模型能够检测细微的视觉变化并推断出高级别的临床趋势。我们对最先进模型的评估结果显示，虽然这些模型在静态场景中表现出色，但在时间感知和一致性方面存在显著不足。ELTLM作为一个重要的工具，有助于识别这些局限性，并为未来基于时间的医学人工智能系统的开发提供指导。我们的数据可以在ELTLM平台上获取。

papers.title: Easy Samples Are All You Need: Self-Evolving LLMs via Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 简单的样本就足够了：通过数据高效的强化学习来实现自进化的大语言模型
papers.authors: Zhiyin Yu, Bo Zhang, Qibin Hou, Zhonghai Wu, Xiao Luo, Lei Bai
papers.abstract: Previous LLMs-based RL studies typically follow either supervised learning with high annotation costs, or unsupervised paradigms using voting or entropy-based rewards. However, their performance remains far from satisfactory due to the substantial annotation cost and issues such as model collapse or reward hacking. To address these issues, we introduce a new perspective inspired by cognitive learning theory and propose a novel approach called EasyRL. The core of EasyRL is to simulate the human cognitive acquisition curve by integrating reliable knowledge transfer from easy labeled data with a progressive divide-and-conquer strategy that tackles increasingly difficult unlabeled data. Specifically, we initialize a warm-up model using supervised RL with few-shot labeled data. This is followed by a divide-and-conquer pseudo-labeling strategy on difficult unlabeled data, combining consistency-based selection for low-uncertainty cases and reflection-based resolution for medium-uncertainty cases. Finally, difficulty-progressive self-training with iterative pseudo-labeling and RL further strengthens the model’s reasoning capability. EasyRL provides a unified self-evolving framework that facilitates data-efficient post-training of LLMs. Experimental results on mathematical and scientific benchmarks demonstrate that EasyRL, using only 10% of easy labeled data, consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 以往基于大语言模型的强化学习研究通常采用两种方法：一种是需要大量标注数据的监督学习，但标注成本很高；另一种是无监督方法，通过投票或基于熵的奖励机制进行训练。然而，由于标注成本高昂，以及模型崩溃或奖励被操纵等问题，这些方法的性能远不尽如人意。为了解决这些问题，我们借鉴了认知学习理论，提出了一种名为EasyRL的新方法。EasyRL的核心思想是通过将可靠的、来自简单标注数据的知识转移与分而治之的策略相结合，来模拟人类认知学习的过程。具体来说，我们首先使用少量标注数据进行监督式强化学习来初始化模型。随后，对难以处理的未标注数据采用分而治之的伪标注策略，对于不确定性较低的案例采用基于一致性的选择方法，对于中等不确定性的案例则采用基于反思的解决方案。最后，通过迭代式的伪标注和强化学习，进一步提升模型的推理能力。EasyRL提供了一种统一的自进化框架，使得大语言模型在训练后的应用更加高效。在科学和数学领域的基准测试中的实验结果表明，EasyRL仅使用10%的简单标注数据就能持续超越最先进的基线模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Collaborative Multi-Agent Scripts Generation for Enhancing Imperfect-Information Reasoning in Murder Mystery Games
papers.title_zh: 用于提升谋杀推理游戏中的不完全信息推理能力的协作式多智能体脚本生成方法
papers.authors: Keyang Zhong, Junlin Xie, Hefeng Wu, Haofeng Li, Guanbin Li
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in perceptual tasks, yet they degrade in complex multi-hop reasoning under multi-player game settings with imperfect and deceptive information. In this paper, we pick up a representative multi-player task, Murder Mystery Games, which require to infer hidden truths based on partial clues provided by the roles of different intentions. To address this challenge, we propose a collaborative multi-agent framework for evaluating and synthesizing high-quality, role-driven multi-player game scripts, enabling fine-grained interaction patterns tailored to character identities (i.e., murderer vs. innocent). Our system generates rich multimodal contexts—including character backstories, visual/textual clues, and multi-hop reasoning chains—through coordinated agent interactions. We design a two-stage agent-monitored training strategy to enhance the reasoning ability of VLM: (1) Chain-of-Thought based fine-tuning on curated and synthetic datasets that model uncertainty and deception; (2) GRPO-based Reinforcement Learning with agent-monitored reward shaping, encouraging the model to develop character-specific reasoning behaviors and effective multi-modal multi-hop inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly boosts the performance of VLM in narrative reasoning, hidden fact extraction, and deception-resilient understanding. Our contributions offer a scalable solution for training and evaluating VLMs under uncertain, adversarial, and socially complex conditions, laying the groundwork for future benchmarks in multimodal multi-hop reasoning under imperfect information.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型在感知任务中展现出了令人印象深刻的性能，但在具有不完美和欺骗性信息的多玩家游戏环境中，其复杂的多跳推理能力会下降。在本文中，我们选取了一个代表性的多玩家任务——谋杀之谜游戏，该任务要求基于不同角色提供的部分线索来推断隐藏的真相。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个协作式多智能体框架，用于评估和生成高质量、以角色为导向的多玩家游戏脚本，从而实现针对角色身份（即凶手与无辜者）的精细互动模式。我们的系统通过智能体的协调互动，生成了丰富多模态的上下文信息，包括角色背景故事、视觉/文本线索以及多跳推理链。我们设计了两阶段的智能体监控训练策略，以提高视觉-语言模型的推理能力：(1) 在经过筛选和合成的数据集上进行基于思维链的微调，以模拟不确定性和欺骗性；(2) 采用基于GRPO的强化学习技术，并通过智能体监控的奖励调整机制，促使模型发展出针对特定角色的推理行为以及有效的多模态多跳推理能力。大量实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了视觉-语言模型在叙事推理、隐藏事实提取以及抵御欺骗性理解方面的性能。我们的贡献为在不确定、对抗性且社会复杂的环境中训练和评估视觉-语言模型提供了可扩展的解决方案，为未来在信息不完美情况下的多模态多跳推理基准测试奠定了基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words? An Empirical Study of Aggregation Strategies for Visual Financial Document Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 一张图片胜过千言万语？关于视觉型金融文档检索中聚合策略的实证研究
papers.authors: Ho Hung Lim, Yi Yang
papers.abstract: Visual RAG has offered an alternative to traditional RAG. It treats documents as images and uses vision encoders to obtain vision patch tokens. However, hundreds of patch tokens per document create retrieval and storage challenges in a vector database. Practical deployment requires aggregating them into a single vector. This raises a critical question: does single-vector aggregation lose key information in financial documents? We develop a diagnostic benchmark using financial documents where changes in single digits can lead to significant semantic shifts. Our experiments show that single-vector aggregation collapses different documents with almost identical vectors. Metrics show that the patch level detects semantic changes, and confirm that aggregation obscures these details. We identify global texture dominance as the root cause. Our findings are consistent across model scales, retrieval-optimized embeddings, and multiple mitigation strategies, highlighting significant risks for single-vector visual document retrieval in financial applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉RAG为传统的RAG提供了一种替代方案。它将文档视为图像，并使用视觉编码器来获取视觉片段令牌。然而，每篇文档都有数百个片段令牌，这会在向量数据库中带来检索和存储方面的挑战。实际部署需要将这些令牌汇总为一个单一的向量。这就提出了一个关键问题：单一向量的汇总是否会丢失金融文档中的关键信息？我们开发了一个基于金融文档的诊断基准测试，结果显示，单个数字的变动可能导致显著的语义变化。我们的实验表明，单一向量的汇总会合并几乎具有相同向量的不同文档。指标显示，片段级别的检测能够识别语义变化，并证实汇总过程会掩盖这些细节。我们发现，全局纹理优势是导致这一问题的根本原因。我们的研究结果在多种模型规模、优化过的嵌入方式以及不同的缓解策略下都保持一致，这表明在金融应用中使用单一向量进行视觉文档检索存在显著的风险。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ToolCPT: Improving Tool Utilization in LLM Agents via Continuous Pre-training
papers.title_zh: 工具主题：通过持续预训练提高大型语言模型代理的工具利用率
papers.authors: Yifan Yang, Jinghui Lu, Evadeng, Ao Yang, Peijie Yu, TingHao YU, Feng Zhang
papers.abstract: Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLM-based agents) are capable of using off-the-shelf tools to interact with the environment, solve real-world problems, and boost work efficiency. However, current approaches to enhancing tool use for LLM-based agents primarily focus on post-training fine-tuning or test-time context extension. These methods overlook the fundamental tool knowledge acquisition during the early training phase, where models actually learn and internalize core knowledge representations, restricting model performance on out-of-distribution tool usage. To solve such a problem, we introduce enhancing tool knowledge for LLM-based agents during continuous pre-training (ToolCPT). We identify and bridge a key gap in current LLM training by shifting focus from tool-calling patterns to deep internalization of core tool-knowledge representations. We begin by curating 5.1 million code artifacts from large-scale, high-quality code repositories. These artifacts are selected based on a set of criteria that defines a usable “proxy agent tool”, thereby forming a comprehensive agent tool library. For each proxy tool, we then create a detailed playbook covering implementation specifications, core functionalities, interaction protocols with other tools, and illustrative positive and negative examples. This process yields a large-scale tool knowledge corpus comprising 18 billion tokens, which is used to continuously pre-train our model. Experiments show our playbook-enhanced corpus catalyzes deep knowledge internalization, driving the model to notable performance gains on multiple standard benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的自主智能体能够使用现成的工具与环境进行交互、解决现实问题，从而提高工作效率。然而，目前用于提升基于大语言模型的智能体工具使用能力的方法主要集中在训练后的微调或测试时的上下文扩展上。这些方法忽略了在早期训练阶段对工具知识的获取，而模型正是在这一阶段学习和内化了核心知识表示，这限制了模型在超出其训练范围的工具使用上的性能。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了在持续预训练过程中增强基于大语言模型的智能体的工具知识（ToolCPT）。我们通过将重点从工具调用模式转移到对核心工具知识表示的深度内化上，从而填补了当前大语言模型训练中的关键空白。我们首先从大规模、高质量的代码库中提取了510万份代码工件。这些工件是根据一系列标准筛选出来的，这些标准定义了一个可使用的“代理工具”，从而形成了完整的代理工具库。对于每一个代理工具，我们还会创建一份详细的实施指南，包括实现规范、核心功能、与其他工具的交互协议，以及正面的和负面的示例。这一过程产生了一个包含180亿个标记的大规模工具知识语料库，该语料库被用于持续预训练我们的模型。实验表明，我们的这种以实施指南为增强的语料库能够促使模型深入内化知识，从而在多个标准基准测试中取得显著的性能提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Universal Avoidance Method for Diverse Multi-branch Generation
papers.title_zh: 一种适用于多种分支生成的通用避免方法
papers.authors: Kyeongman Park, Minha Jhang, Kyomin Jung
papers.abstract: Modern generative models still lack human-level creativity, particularly in multi-branch diversity. Prior approaches to address this problem often incur heavy computation or strong dependency on model architecture. Therefore, we introduce UAG(Universal Avoidance Generation), a model-agnostic and computationally efficient generation strategy that penalizes similarity among previously generated outputs. Thus, UAG can enhance multi-branch diversity across both diffusion and transformer models, with minimal additional computation. In experiments, our method achieves up to 1.9 times higher diversity, runs 4.4 times faster, and requires only 1/64 of the FLOPs compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代生成模型仍然缺乏人类级别的创造力，尤其是在多分支多样性方面。以往解决这个问题的方法往往会导致巨大的计算负担，或者严重依赖模型架构。因此，我们提出了UAG（通用避免生成）这一模型无关且计算效率高的生成策略。该策略通过惩罚之前生成的输出之间的相似性来增强多分支多样性，同时只需极少的额外计算量。在实验中，我们的方法实现了高达1.9倍的多样性提升，运行速度提高了4.4倍，并且与最先进的方法相比，所需的计算量仅为其1/64。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CentaurTA: A Self-Improving Human-Agents Collaboration Framework for Thematic Analysis
papers.title_zh: CentaurTA：一种用于主题分析的自改进人类-Agent协作框架
papers.authors: Lei Wang, Min Huang, Eduard Dragut
papers.abstract: Qualitative analysis is essential for studying complex social and behavioral phenomena, yet existing large language model (LLM) approaches face key limitations. Fully automated pipelines often compromise methodological rigor, while fully manual coding remains costly and labor-intensive. Although recent work emphasizes human–AI collaboration, existing multi-agent systems focus primarily on theme-level outputs, provide limited human oversight, and overlook fine-grained, data-level coding quality.We introduce CentaurTA, an iterative, self-improving human–agent framework for scalable thematic analysis. CentaurTA places humans in the loop to oversee and guide analysis, using expert feedback as a persistent learning signal to drive prompt-level refinement. By combining structured human feedback with rubric-based evaluation, CentaurTA provides fine-grained supervision for both open coding and theme construction while preserving methodological rigor. Experiments across multiple datasets, baselines, and LLM families show that CentaurTA improves coding alignment and transparency, highlighting the central role of human feedback in reliable qualitative analysis. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Tom-Owl/CentaurTA.
papers.abstract_zh: 定性分析对于研究复杂的社会和行为现象至关重要，然而现有的大语言模型方法存在关键局限性。完全自动化的处理流程往往会影响方法的严谨性，而完全手动的编码工作则既耗时又成本高昂。尽管最近的研究强调了人类与人工智能的合作，但现有的多智能体系统主要侧重于主题层面的输出，提供的人员监督有限，且忽视了细粒度的数据级编码质量。我们提出了CentaurTA这一迭代式、自我改进的人类-智能体框架，用于进行可扩展的主题分析。CentaurTA让人类参与进来，以监督和指导分析过程，并利用专家反馈作为持续的学习信号来推动细节层面的优化。通过结合结构化的人类反馈和基于评分标准的评估，CentaurTA能够为开放编码和主题构建提供细粒度的监督，同时保持方法的严谨性。在多个数据集、基准测试和语言模型家族上的实验表明，CentaurTA能够提升编码的一致性和透明度，这凸显了人类反馈在可靠定性分析中的核心作用。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/Tom-Owl/CentaurTA获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Balancing Fidelity and Plasticity: Aligning Mixed-Precision Fine-Tuning with Linguistic Hierarchies
papers.title_zh: 在精确性与灵活性之间找到平衡：将混合精度优化与语言层次结构相结合
papers.authors: Changhai Zhou, Shiyang Zhang, Yuhua Zhou, Jun Gao, Qian Qiao, Shichao Weng, Weizhong Zhang, Cheng Jin
papers.abstract: Deploying and fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on resource-constrained edge devices requires navigating a strict trade-off between memory footprint and task performance. Existing quantization-aware fine-tuning methods typically decouple weight precision and adapter capacity, overlooking that a layer’s ability to adapt is constrained by the information preserved in its frozen weights. Layers that are highly sensitive to quantization—whether due to representational specialization or accumulated error propagation—can become bottlenecks that adapter rank alone cannot recover. To address this issue, we introduce QR-Adaptor, a unified framework that jointly optimizes per-layer quantization bit-width and LoRA rank. We formulate resource allocation as a multi-objective discrete search guided by empirical layer-wise sensitivity, and implement it with a three-stage pipeline comprising KL-based sensitivity profiling, evolutionary exploration, and Bayesian refinement. Extensive experiments across LLaMA and Qwen models, including modern instruction tuning on OpenOrca and comparisons with strong PEFT baselines such as QDoRA, show that QR-Adaptor establishes a strong Pareto frontier: under a strict 4-bit memory budget, it matches or approaches 16-bit baselines while using substantially less memory.
papers.abstract_zh: 在资源有限的边缘设备上部署和微调大语言模型（LLM）需要权衡内存占用与任务性能之间的关系。现有的基于量化感知的微调方法通常会将权重精度与适配器能力分离开来，而忽略了层的适应能力实际上受到其固定权重中保存的信息的限制。对于那些对量化非常敏感的网络层——无论是由于表示特性差异还是累积误差传播导致的敏感问题——可能会成为仅依靠适配器排序无法解决的瓶颈。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了QR-Adaptor这一统一框架，它能够同时优化每层的量化位宽和LoRA排序参数。我们将资源分配问题转化为一个多目标离散搜索问题，并采用基于经验层级敏感性的方法来指导搜索过程。该框架包含三个阶段：基于KL损失函数的敏感性分析、进化式探索以及贝叶斯优化。通过在LaLMα和Qwen模型上进行的大量实验，包括使用OpenOrca进行现代指令调优，以及与QDoRA等强大的PEFT基准模型的对比，我们发现QR-Adaptor能够建立出一个强大的帕累托前沿：在严格的4位内存预算下，它能够达到或接近16位基线的性能，同时使用的内存也大大减少。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Script to Stage: Automating Experimental Design for Social Simulations with LLMs
papers.title_zh: 从脚本到舞台：利用大语言模型自动化社会模拟实验设计过程
papers.authors: Yuwei Guo, Zihan Zhao, Xiaowei Liu, Xiangning Yu, Qun Ma, Deyu Zhou, Xiao Xue
papers.abstract: Multi-agent simulation based on LLMs has increasingly emerged as a new paradigm for exploring complex social phenomena and validating theoretical hypotheses. However, traditional experimental design in the social sciences relies heavily on interdisciplinary expert knowledge, involving cumbersome procedures and high technical barriers. While LLM-driven agents demonstrate broad prospects for designing experiments, their limitations regarding reliability and scientific rigor continue to significantly hinder their in-depth application in social science research. To address these challenges, this paper proposes FSTS, an automated framework for multi-agent experiment design based on script generation. Drawing on the concept of the “Decision Theater,” the framework deconstructs experimental design into three core phases: Script Composition, Script Finalization, and Actor Generation. Tests across multiple scenarios indicate that the agents generated by this framework can enact the script within the “experimental theater,” reproducing results consistent with real-world situations. The proposal of FSTS not only effectively lowers the barrier for social science experimental design but also provides scientifically grounded decision support for policy-making.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体仿真正逐渐成为探索复杂社会现象和验证理论假设的新范式。然而，社会科学中的传统实验设计严重依赖跨学科专家知识，涉及繁琐的程序和高技术门槛。虽然由大语言模型驱动的智能体在实验设计方面具有广阔前景，但它们在可靠性和科学严谨性方面的局限性仍然严重限制了其在社会科学研究中的深入应用。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了FSTS——一种基于脚本生成的多智能体实验设计自动化框架。该框架借鉴了“决策剧场”的概念，将实验设计分解为三个核心阶段：脚本编写、脚本最终确定以及智能体生成。在多个场景中的测试表明，该框架生成的智能体能够在“实验剧场”中执行脚本，并得出与现实世界情况一致的结果。FSTS的提出不仅有效降低了社会科学实验设计的门槛，还为政策制定提供了基于科学的决策支持。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Generative Giants, Retrieval Weaklings: Why do Multimodal Large Language Models Fail at Multimodal Retrieval?
papers.title_zh: 生成型巨兽与检索型弱者：为何多模态大型语言模型在多模态检索方面表现不佳？
papers.authors: Hengyi Feng, Zeang Sheng, Meiyi Qiang, Yang Li, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: Despite the remarkable success of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in generative tasks, we observe that they exhibit a counterintuitive deficiency in the zero-shot multimodal retrieval task. In this work, we investigate the underlying mechanisms that hinder MLLMs from being effective retrievers. With the help of sparse autoencoders (SAEs), we decompose MLLM output representations into interpretable semantic concepts to probe their intrinsic behavior. Our analysis reveals that the representation space of MLLMs is overwhelmingly dominated by textual semantics; and the visual semantics essential for multimodal retrieval only constitute a small portion. We find that this imbalance is compounded by the heavy focus of MLLMs on bridging image-text modalities, which facilitates generation but homogenizes embeddings and finally diminishes the discriminative power required for multimodal retrieval. We further discover that the specific feature components that contribute most to the similarity computations of MLLMs are actually distractors that greatly reduce retrieval performance. Building on these insights, we propose , a test-time adaptation approach that applies a whitening transformation to adjust the geometry of MLLM representation spaces. Empirical results show that this simple intervention consistently improves zero-shot multimodal retrieval performance across diverse MLLMs without fine-tuning efforts.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管多模态大语言模型在生成任务上取得了显著的成功，但我们观察到它们在零样本多模态检索任务中存在一种违反直觉的缺陷。在这项研究中，我们探讨了阻碍多模态大语言模型成为有效检索器的内在机制。借助稀疏自编码器技术，我们将多模态大语言模型的输出表示分解为可解释的语义概念，以探究其本质行为。分析结果显示，多模态大语言模型的表示空间主要由文本语义主导；而对于多模态检索至关重要的视觉语义却只占很小的一部分。我们发现，这种不平衡现象还因多模态大语言模型过于注重图像与文本之间的桥梁构建而加剧——这种构建方式虽然有助于生成，但却使得嵌入向量变得趋同，从而降低了多模态检索所需的区分能力。进一步研究发现，那些对多模态大语言模型的相似性计算贡献最大的特定特征成分，实际上都是会严重降低检索性能的干扰因素。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种实时适应方法，该方法通过应用白化变换来调整多模态大语言模型表示空间的几何结构。实验结果表明，这种简单的干预措施能够在不进行任何微调的情况下，持续改善不同多模态大语言模型的零样本多模态检索性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Learning to Extract Rational Evidence via Reinforcement Learning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 通过强化学习来学习提取合理的证据，以实现基于检索增强的生成技术
papers.authors: Xinping Zhao, Shouzheng Huang, Yan Zhong, Xinshuo Hu, Meishan Zhang, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) effectively improves the accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, retrieval noises significantly undermine the quality of LLMs’ generation, necessitating the development of denoising mechanisms. Previous works extract evidence straightforwardly without deep thinking, which may risk filtering out key clues and struggle with generalization. To this end, we propose EviOmni, which learns to extract rational evidence via reasoning first and then extracting. Specifically, EviOmni integrates evidence reasoning and evidence extraction into one unified trajectory, followed by knowledge token masking to avoid information leakage, optimized via on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards in terms of answer, length, and format. Extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets show the superiority of EviOmni, which provides compact and high-quality evidence, enhances the accuracy of downstream tasks, and supports both traditional and agentic RAG systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术能够有效提升大语言模型（LLM）的准确率。然而，检索过程中的噪声会严重干扰LLM的生成效果，因此有必要开发去噪机制。以往的研究往往直接提取证据，缺乏深入的推理过程，这可能导致遗漏重要线索，且难以实现泛化能力。为此，我们提出了EviOmni算法。该算法首先通过推理来提取合理的证据，然后再进行证据提取。具体来说，EviOmni将证据推理和证据提取整合为一个统一的流程，并通过知识标记掩蔽技术避免信息泄露。整个流程通过在线策略强化学习进行优化，同时提供可验证的奖励指标，包括答案的质量、长度以及格式等方面。在五个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，EviOmni算法具有出色的性能：它能够提供简洁且高质量的证据，提高下游任务的准确率，同时适用于传统的RAG系统和智能代理RAG系统。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Tree-Notebook: A Context-Aware Agent with Tree Search and Entropy-Aware Data Shadow for Interactive Data Science
papers.title_zh: 树形笔记本：一种具有树状搜索功能的情境感知智能体，同时具备基于熵理论的数据影子技术，适用于交互式数据科学应用
papers.authors: Junkun Qiu, Min Huang, Qinghai Miao
papers.abstract: While LLM-based agents have emerged as a focal point for automating data science tasks, they continue to grapple with inefficient context management, “silent failures” (where code executes correctly but fails the task objectives), and error propagation inherent in sequential generation. In this paper, we propose Tree-Notebook, an agentic framework designed to mimic the iterative cognitive process of human data scientists. At its core, Tree-Notebook conceptualizes Jupyter Notebook cells as nodes within a tree structure, facilitating organized and efficient context retrieval. We formalize the task-solving process as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) over a dynamic tree, utilizing an entropy-based information gain function for path evaluation to enhance adaptability in real-world environments. Furthermore, we introduce the “Data Shadow” system, which resolves silent failures by performing real-time tracking of data distributions, provenance, and semantic constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that Tree-Notebook achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both InfiAgent-DABench and DSBench. To further evaluate robustness, we introduce an augmented version of InfiAgent-DABench to simulate complex environments, where Tree-Notebook consistently maintains its SOTA standing. Code is available at: https://github.com/QJK-BUAA/Tree-Notebook
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于大语言模型的智能体已成为自动化数据科学任务的重点发展方向，但它们仍然面临着上下文管理效率低下、出现“无声失败”（即代码执行正确但未能完成任务目标）以及序列生成过程中固有的错误传播等问题。在本文中，我们提出了Tree-Notebook这一智能体框架，旨在模拟人类数据科学家的迭代认知过程。其核心思想是将Jupyter Notebook单元格视为树状结构中的节点，从而实现有组织且高效的上下文检索。我们将任务解决过程抽象为动态树上的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并利用基于熵的信息增益函数来评估路径效果，以提高在实际环境中的适应能力。此外，我们还引入了“数据影子”系统，该系统通过实时跟踪数据分布、来源信息及语义约束来解决“无声失败”的问题。实验结果表明，Tree-Notebook在InfiAgent-DABench和DSBench两个基准测试中都取得了顶尖性能。为了进一步评估其鲁棒性，我们引入了一个增强版的InfiAgent-DABench来模拟复杂环境，结果显示Tree-Notebook始终能够保持其顶尖性能。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/QJK-BUAA/Tree-Notebook
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Resource-Limited Joint Multimodal Sentiment Reasoning and Classification via Chain-of-Thought Enhancement and Distillation
papers.title_zh: 基于思维链增强与蒸馏的有限资源联合多模态情感推理与分类方法
papers.authors: Haonan Shangguan, Xiaocui Yang, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Yifei Zhang, Feiliang Ren, Ge Yu
papers.abstract: Current approaches for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) primarily leverage the knowledge and reasoning capabilities of parameter-heavy (Multimodal) LLMs for classification, overlooking autonomous multimodal sentiment reasoning generation in resource-constrained environments.In this paper, we focus on the Resource-Limited Joint Multimodal Sentiment Reasoning and Classification task, JMSRC, which simultaneously performs multimodal sentiment reasoning chain generation and sentiment classification only with a lightweight model.We propose a Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Distillation model, MulCoT-RD, designed for JMSRC that employs a “Teacher-Assistant-Student” distillation paradigm to address deployment constraints in resource-limited environments.We first leverage a high-performance Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to generate the initial reasoning dataset and train a medium-sized assistant model with a multi-task learning mechanism. A lightweight student model is jointly trained to perform efficient multimodal sentiment reasoning generation and classification.Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that MulCoT-RD with only 3B parameters and achieves strong performance on JMSRC, while exhibiting robust generalization and enhanced interpretability.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的多模态情感分析方法主要依赖参数密集型多模态大语言模型的知识和推理能力来进行分类任务，而忽略了在资源有限环境下的自主多模态情感推理生成。在本文中，我们专注于资源有限的联合多模态情感推理与分类任务，即JMSRC。该任务需要同时使用轻量级模型来生成多模态情感推理链以及进行情感分类。我们提出了一种专为JMSRC设计的多模态思维链推理蒸馏模型——MulCoT-RD。该模型采用“教师-助手-学生”的蒸馏范式，以克服资源有限环境下部署的困难。首先，我们使用高性能的多模态大语言模型生成初始的推理数据集，并训练一个中等规模的助手模型，该模型采用多任务学习机制。同时，我们还训练了一个轻量级的学生模型，以实现高效的多模态情感推理生成和分类。在四个数据集上的广泛实验表明，仅拥有3B参数的MulCoT-RD在JMSRC任务上表现优异，同时具备强大的泛化能力和增强的可解释性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Agentic-R: Learning to Retrieve for Agentic Search
papers.title_zh: Agentic-R：学习用于智能搜索的检索方法
papers.authors: Wenhan Liu, Xinyu Ma, Yutao Zhu, Yuchen Li, Daiting Shi, Dawei Yin, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Agentic search has recently emerged as a powerful paradigm, where an agent interleaves multi-step reasoning with on-demand retrieval to solve complex questions. Despite its success, how to design a retriever for agentic search remains largely underexplored. Existing search agents typically rely on similarity-based retrievers, while similar passages are not always useful for final answer generation. In this paper, we propose a novel retriever training framework tailored for agentic search. Unlike retrievers designed for single-turn retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that only rely on local passage utility, we propose to use both local query-passage relevance and global answer correctness to measure passage utility in a multi-turn agentic search. We further introduce an iterative training strategy, where the search agent and the retriever are optimized bidirectionally and iteratively. Different from RAG retrievers that are only trained once with fixed questions, our retriever is continuously improved using evolving and higher-quality queries from the agent. Extensive experiments on seven single-hop and multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that our retriever, termed Agentic-R, consistently outperforms strong baselines across different search agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 代理式搜索最近成为一种强大的搜索范式，其中代理结合了多步推理和按需检索来解答复杂问题。尽管这种搜索方式取得了成功，但如何设计适用于代理式搜索的检索器仍然鲜有研究。现有的搜索代理通常依赖基于相似性的检索器，而类似的段落并不总是对生成最终答案有帮助。在本文中，我们提出了一种专为代理式搜索设计的新型检索器训练框架。与那些仅依赖于局部段落效用的单轮检索增强生成（RAG）检索器不同，我们采用局部查询-段落相关性以及全局答案正确性来衡量多轮代理式搜索中的段落效用。我们还引入了迭代训练策略，使得搜索代理和检索器能够双向且迭代地优化。与那些仅通过固定问题进行一次训练的RAG检索器不同，我们的检索器可以通过代理不断提出的新颖且质量更高的查询来进行持续改进。在七个单跳和多跳问答基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的检索器——名为Agentic-R——在不同搜索代理中始终表现出优于其他强大基线的性能。

papers.title: JailMeter: An Evidence-Based Evaluation Framework for Jailbreak Attacks on Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: JailMeter：一种基于证据的评估框架，用于分析对大型语言模型的越狱攻击
papers.authors: Qingjia Huang, Jingyu Zhang, Jianguo Wu, Yakai Li, Weijuan Zhang, Yankai Rong, Junyi Yao, Shengzhi Zhang, Xiaoqi Jia
papers.abstract: The assessment of jailbreak attacks against large language models currently suffers from inconsistent evaluation criteria and methods, leading to unreliable estimates of attack success rates. We propose JailMeter, an evidence-based evaluation framework designed to more faithfully measure jailbreak effectiveness. Inspired by the Information Bottleneck theory, JailMeter applies dual-feedback optimization to filter jailbreak noise from model responses while preserving content relevant to the original malicious question. This process produces concise evidence for a rigorous assessment under which an attack is validated only when the response captures the malicious intent and delivers a complete answer, thereby signaling a substantive bypass of model safety alignment. We evaluate JailMeter on JailMeter-Eva, a challenging benchmark containing 330 human-labeled, non-rejected jailbreak instances. JailMeter achieves an accuracy of 97.27%, substantially outperforming existing evaluation methods. To support large-scale evaluation, we further distill JailMeter into a small language model, JailMeterSLM, which maintains comparable reliability with significantly reduced computational costs. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Magi2B0y/JailMeter.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前对针对大语言模型的越狱攻击的评估存在评价标准和方法不统一的问题，这导致对攻击成功率的估计不可靠。我们提出了JailMeter这一基于证据的评估框架，旨在更精确地衡量越狱攻击的效果。该框架借鉴了信息瓶颈理论，采用双反馈优化技术，从模型响应中过滤掉越狱产生的噪声，同时保留与原始恶意问题相关的内容。这一过程能够产生简洁的证据，从而在进行严格评估时，只有当模型响应能够体现恶意意图并给出完整答案时，才能确认发生了越狱攻击，这表明模型的安全对齐机制被实质性地绕过。我们在JailMeter-Eva这个包含330个人类标记、未被拒绝的越狱案例的复杂基准测试上进行了JailMeter的评估。结果表明，JailMeter的准确率达到了97.27%，远远优于现有的评估方法。为了支持大规模评估，我们还将JailMeter扩展到一个小型语言模型JailMeterSLM上，该模型在保持相当可靠性的同时，计算成本显著降低。相关的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/Magi2B0y/JailMeter下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DataSeer: A Manager-Centric Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework with Multi-Branch Reasoning for Automated Insight Discovery
papers.title_zh: DataSeer：一种以管理者为中心的合作式多智能体框架，具备多分支推理能力，能够实现自动化的洞察发现
papers.authors: Suchen Liu, Yuanfeng Song, Jun Gao, Xing Chen
papers.abstract: The growth of complex data fuels demand for automated insight discovery. While LLMs and agent technologies have advanced data analysis, existing methods struggle with maintaining contextual coherence, limited coverage due to single-path exploration, and rigid planning that fails to adapt to dynamic data discovery. We propose DataSeer, a collaborative multi-agent framework for automated insight discovery. Our first contribution is a Manager-Centric Collaborative Framework, where the Manager ensures cross-episode contextual coherence through a dual-layer memory system with compression, consolidation, and retrieval, alongside dynamic prompt editing, coordinating the overall process between the Planner and Executor. Second, we optimize the planning and execution components: the Planner employs multi-role discussion for adaptive sub-goal generation and plan refinement; the Executor is endowed with tactical autonomy for exploratory execution and incorporates real-time multi-dimensional self-assessment to guarantee insight quality. Third, we design Multi-Branch Reasoning that executes multiple discovery trajectories and synthesizes outcomes through LLM-based aggregation, improving coverage and reducing single-path stochasticity. Experiments on InsightBench and InsightEval show that DataSeer outperforms baselines, achieving improvements of 18.7% and 12.1% in insight-level scores, and 11.6% and 10.3% in summary-level scores, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 复杂数据的增长推动了自动化洞察发现的需求。虽然大语言模型和智能体技术已经提升了数据分析的能力，但现有方法在保持上下文一致性、由于单路径探索而导致的覆盖范围有限，以及无法适应动态数据发现的刚性规划方面存在不足。我们提出了DataSeer，一个用于自动化洞察发现的协作式多智能体框架。我们的第一个贡献是一个以管理者为中心的协作框架，该框架通过具有压缩、整合和检索功能的双层记忆系统，以及动态提示编辑功能，来确保不同场景之间的上下文一致性，同时协调规划者和执行者之间的整体流程。其次，我们优化了规划和执行组件：规划者采用多角色讨论方式来进行适应性子目标生成和计划优化；执行者则拥有战术自主性，可以进行探索性执行，并采用实时多维自我评估来确保洞察的质量。第三，我们设计了多分支推理机制，它能够执行多种发现路径，并通过基于大语言模型的聚合功能来综合各种结果，从而提升覆盖范围并减少单路径的随机性。在InsightBench和InsightEval上的实验表明，DataSeer的表现优于基线算法，分别使洞察级别得分提高了18.7%和12.1%，而总结级别得分则分别提高了11.6%和10.3%。

papers.title: "Penny Wise, Pixel Foolish": Bypassing Price Constraints in Multimodal Agents via Visual Adversarial Perturbations
papers.title_zh: 《Penny Wise, Pixel Foolish》：通过视觉对抗性扰动来突破多模态智能体中的价格限制
papers.authors: Jiachen Qian, Zhaolu Kang
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has ushered in the era of the “Agentic Economy,” where Mobile Agents autonomously execute high-stakes financial transactions. While these agents demonstrate impressive operational capabilities, their adversarial robustness remains a glaring blind spot. In this paper, we identify a systemic vulnerability termed Visual Dominance Hallucination (VDH), where imperceptible adversarial visual cues can act as a “super-stimulus,” overriding textual price evidence in our evaluated screenshot-based price-constrained settings and forcing the agent into irrational economic decisions. We propose PriceBlind, a stealthy, white-box adversarial attack framework for controlled screenshot-based evaluation. Unlike prior works that rely on conspicuous artifacts like pop-ups, PriceBlind exploits the modality gap in CLIP-based encoders via a novel Semantic-Decoupling Loss. Rather than literally making a luxury item “look cheap,” this regularizer weakens the consistency between high-price text and visual value cues by aligning the image embedding with a low-cost/value-associated anchor region while preserving pixel-level fidelity. On our main E-ShopBench benchmark with clear price constraints, screenshot-based white-box evaluation yields ASRs around 80% on the evaluated agents. Under the evaluated single-turn coordinate-selection protocol in a simplified layout-aware setting, our Ensemble-DI-FGSM strategy also yields non-trivial black-box transfer, with ASR roughly 35–41% across GPT-4o, Gemini-1.5-Pro, and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. In the same screenshot-based setting, standard robust encoders reduce ASR only partially, while a Verify-then-Act stack with robust encoders lowers ASR to below 10% at some clean-accuracy cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型的迅速普及标志着“智能经济”时代的到来，移动智能体能够自主执行高风险的金融交易。虽然这些智能体在运营能力方面表现出色，但它们的对抗性鲁棒性仍然是一个明显的弱点。在本文中，我们发现了一种名为“视觉支配幻觉”的系统漏洞，即那些难以被察觉的对抗性视觉线索可以作为“超级刺激”，在基于截图的定价约束环境中超越文本价格信息，迫使智能体做出非理性的经济决策。我们提出了PriceBlind这一隐蔽的、基于白盒的对抗性攻击框架，用于可控的基于截图的评估。与那些依赖明显伪装的手法（如弹窗）的先前方法不同，PriceBlind通过一种新的语义解耦损失机制，利用CLIP编码器的模态差异来实施攻击。这种正则化方法并非直接让奢侈品“看起来便宜”，而是通过将图像嵌入与低价格/价值相关的锚点区域对齐，从而削弱高价文本与视觉价值线索之间的一致性，同时保留像素级精度。在我们具有明确价格限制的主要E-ShopBench基准测试中，基于截图的白盒评估结果显示，被评估的智能体的识别准确率达到了约80%。在简化的布局感知环境下，采用单轮坐标选择协议的集成DI-FGSM策略也产生了显著的黑盒转移效果，其识别准确率在GPT-4o、Gemini-1.5-Pro和Claude-3.5-Sonnet上分别达到了约35%-41%。在同一基于截图的测试环境中，标准的鲁棒编码器仅部分降低了识别准确率，而带有鲁棒编码器的验证-行动堆栈则在一定程度上将识别准确率降低到10%以下，但代价是牺牲了一定的准确性。

papers.title: Beyond the Individual: Virtualizing Multi-Disciplinary Reasoning for Clinical Intake via Collaborative Agents
papers.title_zh: 超越个体：通过协作智能体实现临床接待中的多学科推理虚拟化
papers.authors: Huangwei Chen, Wu Li, Junhao Jia, Yining Chen, Xiaotao Pang, Ya-Long Chen, Li Gonghui, Haishuai Wang, Jiajun Bu, Lei Wu
papers.abstract: The initial outpatient consultation is critical for clinical decision-making, yet it is often conducted by a single physician under time pressure, making it prone to cognitive biases and incomplete evidence capture. Although the Multi-Disciplinary Team (MDT) reduces these risks, they are costly and difficult to scale to real-time intake. We propose Aegle, a synchronous virtual MDT framework that brings MDT-level reasoning to outpatient consultations via a graph-based multi-agent architecture. Aegle formalizes the consultation state using a structured SOAP representation, separating evidence collection from diagnostic reasoning to improve traceability and bias control. An orchestrator dynamically activates specialist agents, which perform decoupled parallel reasoning and are subsequently integrated by an aggregator into a coherent clinical note. Experiments on ClinicalBench and a real-world RAPID-IPN dataset across 24 departments and 53 metrics show that Aegle consistently outperforms state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source models in documentation quality and consultation capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 初次门诊咨询对于临床决策至关重要，然而这一过程通常由一位医生在时间紧迫的情况下完成，这就容易导致认知偏差和证据收集不完整的问题。虽然多学科团队可以降低这些风险，但他们的运作成本高昂，且难以实现实时咨询的扩展。我们提出了Aegle这一同步虚拟多学科团队框架，它通过基于图的多智能体架构，将多学科团队的推理能力应用于门诊咨询中。Aegle使用结构化的SOAP表示形式来规范化咨询状态，将证据收集与诊断推理分离，从而提升可追溯性和偏见控制能力。该框架能够动态激活专业智能体，让它们进行独立并行推理，随后由聚合器将这些结果整合为连贯的临床记录。在ClinicalBench以及真实世界的RAPID-IPN数据集上进行的实验表明，Aegle在文档质量和咨询能力方面始终优于现有的专有和开源模型。

papers.title: SWE-Swiss: A Multi-Task Fine-Tuning and RL Recipe for High-Performance Issue Resolution
papers.title_zh: SWE-瑞士方法：一种用于高效解决问题的多任务优化与强化学习方案
papers.authors: Zhenyu He, Qingping Yang, Wei Shen, Xiaojian Zhong, Kechi Zhang, Chenxin An, Wenlei Shi, Tianle Cai, Di He, Jiaze Chen, Jingjing Xu
papers.abstract: Automated software engineering, particularly resolving real-world issues on benchmarks like SWE-bench, remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs). To address this, we introduce SWE-Swiss, a two-phase training recipe that systematically develops these capabilities. Our approach first decomposes issue resolution into three core skills: Localization, Repair, and Unit Test Generation. In the first phase, we perform multi-task Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on three new, meticulously curated datasets to build a versatile foundation. The second phase applies targeted Reinforcement Learning (RL), using direct feedback from test execution to boost the critical skill of code repair. The resulting model, SWE-Swiss-32B, establishes a new state-of-the-art for open-source models in its size class, achieving a 60.2% score on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark and placing it in the same top-tier performance bracket as much larger models. Finally, we show that despite its specialized training, SWE-Swiss-32B demonstrates strong generalization to other common LLM benchmarks. To accelerate research in the community, we are open-sourcing the models and our complete training datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化软件工程，尤其是在像SWE-bench这样的基准测试上解决现实问题，仍然是大语言模型面临的重要挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了SWE-Swiss这一两阶段训练方法，该方法能够系统地提升这些能力。我们的方法首先将问题解决分解为三个核心技能：本地化、代码修复和单元测试生成。在第一阶段，我们对三个经过精心挑选的新数据集进行多任务监督微调，以建立坚实的基础。第二阶段则采用有针对性的强化学习，利用测试执行过程中的直接反馈来提升代码修复的关键技能。最终得到的模型SWE-Swiss-32B，在其规模类别中创造了新的开源模型最佳水平，其在SWE-bench验证基准上的得分达到了60.2%，与更大规模的模型处于同一性能水平。最后，我们发现尽管SWE-Swiss-32B经过了专门化的训练，但它仍然能够在其他常见的LLM基准测试中表现出强大的泛化能力。为了加速社区内的研究进展，我们正在开源该模型以及完整的训练数据集。

papers.title: BackdoorAgent: A Unified Framework for Backdoor Attacks on LLM-based Agents
papers.title_zh: BackdoorAgent：一种用于针对基于大语言模型的智能体的后门攻击的统一框架
papers.authors: Yunhao Feng, Yige Li, Yutao Wu, Yingshui Tan, Yanming Guo, Yifan Ding, Kun Zhai, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents execute tasks through multi-step workflows that combine planning, memory, and tool use. While this design enables autonomy, it also expands the attack surface for backdoor threats. Backdoor triggers injected into specific stages of an agent workflow can persist through multiple intermediate states and adversely influence downstream outputs. However, existing studies remain fragmented and typically analyze individual attack vectors in isolation, leaving the cross-stage interaction and propagation of backdoor triggers poorly understood from an agent-centric perspective.To fill this gap, we propose BackdoorAgent, a modular and stage-aware framework that provides a unified, agent-centric view of backdoor threats in LLM agents. BackdoorAgent structures the attack surface into three functional stages of agentic workflows, including planning attacks, memory attacks, and tool-use attacks, and instruments agent execution to enable systematic analysis of trigger activation and propagation across different stages.Building on this framework, we construct a standardized benchmark spanning four representative agent applications: Agent QA, Agent Code, Agent Web, and Agent Drive, covering both language-only and multimodal settings. Our empirical analysis shows that triggers implanted at a single stage can persist across multiple steps and propagate through intermediate states. For instance, when using a GPT-based backbone, we observe trigger persistence in 43.58% of planning attacks, 77.97% of memory attacks, and 60.28% of tool-stage attacks, highlighting the vulnerabilities of the agentic workflow itself to backdoor threats. Our code is available at https://github.com/Yunhao-Feng/BackdoorAgent.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理通过多步骤工作流程来执行任务，这些工作流程结合了规划、记忆和工具使用功能。虽然这种设计实现了自主性，但也扩大了后门威胁的攻击面。植入到代理工作流程特定阶段的后门触发器可以持续存在于多个中间状态中，并对下游输出产生不利影响。然而，现有的研究仍然较为零散，通常只单独分析各个攻击向量，而忽略了后门触发器在不同阶段之间的相互作用和传播机制。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了BackdoorAgent框架，这是一个模块化且注重阶段划分的框架，能够提供一个统一的、以代理为中心的视角来认识LLM代理中的后门威胁。BackdoorAgent将攻击面划分为三个功能阶段：规划攻击、记忆攻击和工具使用攻击，并通过技术手段确保触发器的激活和在不同阶段间的传播能够被系统分析。基于这个框架，我们构建了一个标准化的基准测试，涵盖了四种代表性的代理应用：Agent QA、Agent Code、Agent Web和Agent Drive，同时考虑了仅语言处理和多模态处理的情况。我们的实证分析表明，植入单个阶段的触发器可以在多个步骤中持续存在，并穿过中间状态进行传播。例如，在使用基于GPT的模型时，我们发现43.58%的规划攻击、77.97%的记忆攻击以及60.28%的工具使用攻击中存在触发器的持续作用，这凸显了代理工作流程本身对后门威胁的脆弱性。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Yunhao-Feng/BackdoorAgent下载。

papers.title: DKME: Rethinking Coupled Knowledge Memory for Lifelong Model Editing of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: DKME：重新思考用于大型语言模型长期编辑的耦合知识记忆机制
papers.authors: Guanyu Zheng, Wang Zhenyu, He Tingting, Xv Wang, Haochang Wang, Yaokai Huang, Tiejun Zhao
papers.abstract: Lifelong knowledge editing aims to inject a stream of factual updates into large language models (LLMs) without retraining, yet existing memory-based editors often suffer from catastrophic forgetting as edits accumulate. We argue that a key factor is the coupled knowledge memory mechanism, where addressing (routing) and storage (writing via memory-module updates) are entangled. This entanglement makes it difficult to confine the effects of each edit to its intended scope, particularly in multi-domain and associated-fact editing streams, where updates either span diverse semantic domains or repeatedly modify related attributes of the same subject. Consequently, updating memory for one edit inadvertently alters the routing and stored representations of previously injected edits, leading to catastrophic forgetting as edits accumulate. We propose DKME, which decouples addressing from storage via two stages: decoupled semantic addressing learns a fact-aware manifold for scope-aware routing, and partitioned memory storage localizes edits to memory partitions identified by unsupervised clustering in the embedding space. Experiments on three benchmarks, including HalluEditBench, CKnowEdit, and WikiData_\text{counterfact}, demonstrate that DKME consistently achieves a more favorable trade-off between editing success and locality compared to baselines, while maintaining more stable performance as the edit scale increases.
papers.abstract_zh: 终身知识编辑旨在在不进行重新训练的情况下，向大语言模型注入大量事实更新。然而，现有的基于记忆的编辑器在编辑内容不断积累时，常常会出现灾难性的遗忘问题。我们认为，其中一个关键因素是知识记忆机制的耦合作用——即处理与存储的过程是相互交织的。这种交织使得很难将每个编辑的效果限制在预期的范围内，尤其是在多领域和关联事实编辑的场景中，因为更新可能涉及不同的语义领域，或者会反复修改同一主题的相关属性。因此，对一个编辑内容的更新可能会无意中改变之前插入的编辑内容的路由和存储方式，从而导致灾难性的遗忘。我们提出了DKME算法，该算法通过两个阶段将处理与存储分离：第一阶段是解耦的语义处理，它学习出一个能够识别编辑范围的多维空间；第二阶段是分区存储，它将编辑内容存储到由嵌入空间中无监督聚类确定的不同分区中。在包括HalluEditBench、CKnowEdit和WikiData_\text{counterfact}在内的三个基准测试中的实验表明，与基线算法相比，DKME在编辑效果和局部性之间取得了更优的平衡，同时随着编辑规模的增加，其性能也保持相对稳定。

papers.title: Self-Awareness before Action: Mitigating Logical Inertia via Proactive Cognitive Awareness
papers.title_zh: 行动前的自我认知：通过主动的认知意识来减轻逻辑惯性问题
papers.authors: Fulong Fan, Peilin Liu, Liu FengZhe, Shuyan Yang, Gang Yan
papers.abstract: Large language models perform well on many reasoning tasks, yet they often lack awareness of whether their current knowledge or reasoning state is complete. In non-interactive puzzle settings, the narrative is fixed and the underlying structure is hidden; once a model forms an early hypothesis under incomplete premises, it can propagate that error throughout the reasoning process, leading to unstable conclusions. To address this issue, we propose SABA, a reasoning framework that explicitly introduces self-awareness of missing premises before making the final decision. SABA formulates reasoning as a recursive process that alternates between structured state construction and obstacle resolution: it first applies Information Fusion to consolidate the narrative into a verifiable base state, and then uses Query-driven Structured Reasoning to identify and resolve missing or underspecified premises by turning them into queries and progressively completing the reasoning state through hypothesis construction and state refinement. Across multiple evaluation metrics, SABA achieves the best performance on all three difficulty splits of the non-interactive Detective Puzzle benchmark, and it also maintains leading results on multiple public benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在许多推理任务中表现优异，但它们往往缺乏对自己当前知识或推理状态是否完整的意识。在非交互式谜题环境中，故事情节是固定的，其底层结构也是隐藏的；一旦模型在不完整的前提下形成初步假设，这种错误就会在整个推理过程中持续传播，从而导致不稳定的结论。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SABA这一推理框架。该框架在做出最终决策之前，会明确引入对缺失前提的自我认知。SABA将推理过程视为一个递归过程，在结构化状态构建和障碍解决之间交替进行：首先通过信息融合将故事情节整合为可验证的基础状态，然后利用查询驱动的结构化推理来识别并解决缺失或未明确说明的前提，将其转化为查询，并通过假设构建和状态优化逐步完善推理状态。在多个评估指标上，SABA在非交互式侦探谜题基准测试中的三种难度级别上都取得了最佳性能，并且在多个公开基准测试中依然保持领先水平。

papers.title: MuBench: Assessment of Multilingual Capabilities of Large Language Models Across 61 Languages
papers.title_zh: MuBench：对61种语言的大型语言模型的多语言能力的评估
papers.authors: Wenhan Han, Yifan Zhang, Zhixun Chen, Binbinliu, Mykola Pechenizkiy, Meng Fang, Yin Zheng
papers.abstract: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) are advancing rapidly, with new models frequently claiming support for an increasing number of languages. However, existing evaluation datasets are limited and lack cross-lingual alignment, leaving assessments of multilingual capabilities fragmented in both language and skill coverage. To address this, we introduce MuBench, a benchmark covering 61 languages with 3.9M samples and evaluating a broad range of capabilities. We evaluate several state-of-the-art multilingual LLMs and find notable gaps between claimed and actual language coverage, particularly a persistent performance disparity between English and low-resource languages. Leveraging MuBench’s alignment, we propose Multilingual Consistency (MLC) as a complementary metric to accuracy for analyzing performance bottlenecks and guiding model improvement. MuBench provides flexible evaluation formats, including mixed-language testing. Experimental results show that increasing model size does not improve its ability to handle mixed-language contexts. We recruited human experts to evaluate translation quality and cultural sensitivity for 34k samples across 17 languages, and combined these assessments with an LLM-as-a-Judge approach to ensure overall data quality in low resource languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言大语言模型正在迅速发展，新的模型不断涌现，并声称能够支持越来越多的语言。然而，现有的评估数据集存在局限性，且缺乏跨语言的一致性评估，导致对多语言能力的评估在语言和技能覆盖方面都存在碎片化问题。为了解决这一问题，我们推出了MuBench这一基准测试工具，该工具涵盖了61种语言，拥有390万个样本，能够评估多种能力。我们对几种最先进的多语言语言模型进行了评估，发现其声称的语言覆盖范围与实际覆盖范围之间存在显著差距，尤其是英语与低资源语言之间的性能差异尤为明显。利用MuBench的一致性特性，我们提出了“多语言一致性”作为衡量性能瓶颈的补充指标，以指导模型的改进。MuBench提供了灵活的评估方式，包括混合语言测试。实验结果表明，增加模型规模并不能提升模型处理混合语言环境的能力。我们招募了人类专家来评估34万个样本中的翻译质量和文化敏感性问题，并将这些评估结果与使用语言模型进行评判的方法相结合，以确保低资源语言中的数据质量。

papers.title: PrefRAG: Correcting Semantic Errors in Auto-Formalization for Logical Reasoning with Program Preference RAG
papers.title_zh: PrefRAG：纠正程序偏好逻辑推理自动形式化过程中的语义错误
papers.authors: Yuyin Zhou, Yongmei Liu
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have spurred interest in neuro-symbolic methods for logical reasoning based on auto-formalization, where LLMs first formalize problems into symbolic programs, for solvers to perform reasoning over.However, existing auto-formalization methods remain prone to both syntactic and semantic errors.Specifically, the absence of a program-level semantic verification mechanism leaves semantic errors largely unaddressed.In this paper, we propose a novel approach to semantic error correction via program preference retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).First, we conduct an in-depth analysis of semantic error patterns, and then automatically synthesize SemanticPref, a program preference dataset to model these patterns. Using the dataset as the knowledge base, we introduce PrefRAG, a general RAG framework for refinement in auto-formalization, which enables LLMs to detect and repair syntactic and semantic errors[https://github.com/sysulic/PrefRAG].Extensive evaluations across both in-distribution (ID) benchmarks (i.e., AR-LSAT and FOLIO) and out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets show that PrefRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 2.39% on ID and 6.23% on OOD datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展激发了人们对基于自动形式化逻辑推理的神经-符号方法的兴趣。在这种方法中，大语言模型首先将问题形式化为符号程序，供求解器进行推理。然而，现有的自动形式化方法仍然容易出现句法和语义错误。具体来说，由于缺乏程序级别的语义验证机制，语义错误往往得不到有效处理。在本文中，我们提出了一种通过程序偏好检索增强生成来纠正语义错误的新方法。首先，我们对语义错误模式进行了深入分析，然后自动生成了一个名为SemanticPref的程序偏好数据集，以模拟这些模式。利用该数据集作为知识库，我们提出了PrefRAG这一通用RAG框架，用于自动形式化过程中的细化工作，使大语言模型能够检测并修复句法和语义错误。[https://github.com/sysulic/PrefRAG]通过广泛的评估表明，PrefRAG在分布内基准测试（如AR-LSAT和FOLIO）和分布外数据集上的表现均优于其他强大的基线方法，其平均准确率分别提高了2.39%和6.23%。

papers.title: LoopCoder: Scaling Code Intelligence via Looped Language Models
papers.title_zh: LoopCoder：通过循环语言模型实现代码智能的扩展
papers.authors: Jian Yang, Wei Zhang, Shuyue Guo, Yizhi LI, Linzheng Chai, Zhengmao Ye, Shukai Liu, Yuyang Song, Jiajun Wu, Che Liu, Tianyu Zheng, Siwei Wu, Leo L, Xudong Ma, Chuan Hao, Ran Tao, Yan Xing, Jianzhou Wang, Mingjie Tang, Aishan Liu, Zhoujun Li, Xianglong Liu, Weifeng Lv, Bryan Dai
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have mastered syntax-level code generation, complex algorithmic reasoning remains a challenge, typically addressed by scaling model depth and parameter count. Universal Transformers (UT) offer a compelling alternative by introducing a recurrent inductive bias that aligns with the recursive nature of programming logic. However, training looped architectures at scale has historically been hindered by severe instability and optimization difficulties associated with backpropagation through time (BPTT). We present LoopCoder (40B-A80B) pre-trained on 12T+ code and general tokens, along with LoopCoder-Thinking and LoopCoder-Instruct variants—the first large-scale looped transformer for code, achieving comparable performance to standard dense architectures with more parameters. Unlike prior approaches that restrict recurrence to small-scale tasks, we implement a comprehensive looped training protocol spanning both pre-training and post-training phases. We initiate the model via dense-to-loop transformation, folding a pre-trained dense checkpoint to initialize a recurrent block, followed by rigorous looped pre-training and specialized post-training for instruction following and reasoning. Our results establish a robust recipe for scaling coding intelligence via recurrent computation, proving that dense checkpoints serve as an optimal foundation for evolving into dynamic, looped reasoners.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型已经掌握了语法级别的代码生成能力，但复杂的算法推理仍然是一个挑战，通常可以通过增加模型深度和参数数量来解决。通用变换器提供了一种有吸引力的替代方案，它通过引入一种与编程逻辑递归特性相一致的归纳性偏见来解决这一问题。然而，大规模训练循环式架构一直受到严重不稳定性和与时间反向传播相关的优化难题的阻碍。我们提出了LoopCoder（40B-A80B）模型，该模型在12T以上代码和通用令牌上进行预训练，同时还有LoopCoder-Thinking和LoopCoder-Instruct两种变体——这是首个用于代码处理的大规模循环式变换器，其性能可与具有更多参数的标准密集式架构相媲美。与之前那些将递归性限制在小规模任务中的方法不同，我们实现了一种涵盖预训练和后期训练的全面循环式训练方案。我们采用从密集式到循环式的转换方式启动模型构建过程，将预训练的密集式检查点折叠成一个循环式模块，然后进行严格的循环式预训练和专门的后期训练，以进行指令遵循和推理任务。我们的研究结果证明，通过循环计算来扩展编码智能是一种有效的策略，并表明密集式检查点可以作为演变成动态循环式推理器的最佳基础。

papers.title: TempTool-R1: Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.title_zh: TempTool-R1：基于工具的强化学习技术，用于时间关系知识图谱的问答系统
papers.authors: Zicheng Huang, Yajuan Tong, Xinhui Tu, Tingting He
papers.abstract: Temporal knowledge graph question answering (TKGQA) addresses time-sensitive queries over temporal knowledge graphs, but existing approaches struggle with multi-hop reasoning and implicit temporal constraints. We introduce TempTool-R1, a novel tool-integrated reasoning framework that enables large language models to explicitly use temporal tools for precise reasoning. First, we design a unified temporal tool-based API capable of transforming implicit temporal cues into executable operations, establishing the structural foundation for tool interaction. In the second stage, supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to interweave chain-of-thought reasoning with think-then-tool usage, allowing it to call temporal tools during inference. Finally, we apply reinforcement learning with fine-grained, order-sensitive reward functions tailored for temporal tool use, further refining the model’s tool-use policy. Experiments on three challenging TKGQA benchmarks demonstrate that TempTool-R1 significantly outperforms existing methods. In particular, our approach excels on complex questions requiring multi-hop temporal reasoning, highlighting the effectiveness of temporal tool integration and reward optimization in improving TKGQA performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间知识图谱问答（TKGQA）旨在处理与时间相关的知识图谱查询问题。然而，现有的方法在多跳推理和隐含的时间约束方面存在不足。我们提出了TempTool-R1这一新型工具集成推理框架，使得大语言模型能够明确使用时间工具进行精确推理。首先，我们设计了一个统一的时间工具接口，能够将隐含的时间线索转化为可执行的操作，为工具交互提供了结构基础。在第二阶段，通过监督式微调，教会模型将思维过程与工具使用相结合，从而在推理过程中调用时间工具。最后，我们采用强化学习技术，为时间工具的使用设计了细粒度的、注重顺序的奖励函数，进一步提升了模型的工具使用策略。在三个具有挑战性的TKGQA基准测试上进行的实验表明，TempTool-R1的表现显著优于现有方法。特别是在需要多跳时间推理的复杂问题中，我们的方法表现出色，这充分证明了时间工具集成和奖励优化在提升TKGQA性能方面的有效性。

papers.title: Lightweight Haar Wavelet Subband Pruning for LLMs
papers.title_zh: 适用于大语言模型的轻量级Haar小波子带剪枝方法
papers.authors: Jiang Li, Pengfei Cao, Chenxi Zhou, Tian Lan, Xiangdong Su, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao, Guanglai Gao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) reach state-of-the-art performance across many NLP tasks, but their large parameter counts introduce heavy computational and memory overhead, which complicates deployment in resource-constrained settings. Pruning is a standard compression strategy that induces sparsity to lower these costs. However, most pruning methods for LLMs depend on calibration data and expensive weight updates, which limits practical scalability. To address these limitations, we introduce Haar Wavelet Subband Pruning (), a post-training framework that requires no calibration data and no weight updates. applies a two-dimensional Haar wavelet transform to each weight matrix and decomposes it into four frequency subbands. It then assigns a uniform sparsity ratio to all subbands so that both low- and high-frequency components are retained in a balanced manner. Our theoretical analysis shows that the subband design of provides a deterministic per-subband retention guarantee, which helps mitigate the potential bias of global magnitude pruning toward dominant frequency components. Experiments on the LLaMA, OPT and Qwen model families show that achieves competitive accuracy relative to strong pruning baselines while substantially reducing pruning time. Compared with magnitude pruning, which serves as a simple calibration-free baseline, generally achieves better downstream performance across a wide range of sparsity levels and model scales.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在众多自然语言处理任务中展现出卓越的性能，但其庞大的参数数量带来了巨大的计算和内存负担，这使得它们在资源有限的环境下难以有效部署。剪枝是一种标准的压缩策略，通过引入稀疏性来降低这些成本。然而，大多数针对大语言模型的剪枝方法都依赖于校准数据以及昂贵的权重更新操作，这限制了其实际的可扩展性。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了Haar小波子带剪枝技术——这是一种训练后的剪枝方法，无需使用校准数据或进行权重更新。该技术通过对每个权重矩阵进行二维Haar小波变换，将其分解为四个频率子带。然后，为所有子带分配统一的稀疏性比例，从而以平衡的方式保留低频和高频成分。我们的理论分析表明，这种子带设计能够确保每个子带的保留效果具有确定性，有助于减轻全局幅度剪枝对主导频率成分的偏向性影响。在LaLMα、OPT和Qwen模型系列上的实验表明，该技术的准确率与强大的剪枝基线相当，同时大幅减少了剪枝时间。与作为简单无校准基线的幅度剪枝相比，该技术在广泛的稀疏度水平和模型规模下都能获得更好的下游性能。

papers.title: Prompt-R1: Collaborative Automatic Prompting Framework via End-to-end Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: Prompt-R1：基于端到端强化学习的协作式自动提示框架
papers.authors: Wenjin Liu, Haoran Luo, Xueyuan Lin, Haoming Liu, Tiesunlong Shen, Jiapu Wang, Rui Mao, Erik Cambria
papers.abstract: Recently, various excellent and powerful large language models (LLMs) have been utilized to solve a wide range of human problems. However, when faced with complex problems, most users are often unable to provide accurate and effective prompts to interact with LLMs, thus limiting their performance. To address this challenge, we propose Prompt-R1, an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that utilizes a small-scale LLM (as agent) to collaborate with large-scale LLMs (as environment), replacing users to interact better. This collaboration is presented as a multi-turn interaction, where the small-scale LLM thinks and generates prompts, and the large-scale LLM performs complex reasoning. A double-constrained reward is designed to optimize correctness and quality of generation. Prompt-R1 provides a plug-and-play framework that supports both inference and training with various large-scale LLMs. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that Prompt-R1 significantly outperforms baseline LLMs across various tasks.Our code is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/Prompt-R1.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，各种优秀且强大的大语言模型被应用于解决各种各样的人类问题。然而，在面对复杂问题时，大多数用户往往无法提供准确有效的提示来与大语言模型进行交互，这限制了它们的性能。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Prompt-R1这一端到端的强化学习框架。该框架利用一个小型语言模型作为代理，与大语言模型协作，从而替代用户进行更有效的交互。这种协作表现为多轮交互过程：小型语言模型负责思考并生成提示，而大语言模型则负责复杂的推理任务。我们设计了双约束奖励机制，以优化生成的准确性和质量。Prompt-R1提供了一个即插式的框架，支持多种大语言模型的推理和训练操作。在十二个数据集上的实验结果表明，Prompt-R1在各种任务中的表现都显著优于传统的语言模型。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/QwenQKing/Prompt-R1下载。

papers.title: ProCeedRL: Process Critic with Explorative Demonstration Reinforcement Learning for LLM Agentic Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ProCeedRL：基于探索性示范强化学习的流程批判方法，用于大型语言模型代理推理
papers.authors: Jingyue Gao, Yanjiang Guo, Chen Xiaoshuai, Jianyu Chen
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) significantly enhances the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), yet applying it to multi-turn agentic tasks remains challenging due to the long-horizon nature of interactions and the stochasticity of environmental feedback.We identify a structural failure mode in agentic exploration: suboptimal actions elicit noisy observations into misleading contexts, which further weaken subsequent decision-making, making recovery increasingly difficult.This cumulative feedback loop of errors renders standard exploration strategies ineffective and susceptible to the model’s reasoning and the environment’s randomness.To mitigate this issue, we propose ProCeedRL: Process Critic with Explorative Demonstration RL, shifting exploration from passive selection to active intervention.ProCeedRL employs a process-level critic to monitor interactions in real time, incorporating reflection-based demonstrations to guide agents in stopping the accumulation of errors.We find that this approach significantly exceeds the model’s saturated exploration performance, demonstrating substantial exploratory benefits.By learning from exploratory demonstrations and on-policy samples, ProCeedRL significantly improves exploration efficiency and achieves superior performance on complex deep search and embodied tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）显著提升了大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力，但将其应用于多轮代理任务仍然具有挑战性，因为交互过程具有长期视角的特点，且环境反馈具有随机性。我们发现，在代理探索过程中存在一种结构性缺陷：次优的行动会导致产生噪声观测数据，这些数据会引入误导性信息，从而进一步削弱后续的决策能力，使得问题修复变得更加困难。这种错误的累积反馈循环使得传统的探索策略变得无效，同时也会受到模型推理能力和环境随机性的影响。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了ProCeedRL：一种结合过程批判与探索性示范的强化学习方法。该方法将探索从被动选择转变为主动干预。ProCeedRL采用过程级批判机制来实时监控交互过程，并通过基于反思的示范来指导代理停止错误的积累。我们发现，这种方法显著提升了模型的探索性能，带来了显著的探索优势。通过从探索性示范和在线策略样本中学习，ProCeedRL显著提高了探索效率，并在复杂的深度搜索和具身任务上取得了卓越的性能表现。

papers.title: Accelerating Prefilling via Decoding-time Contribution Sparsity
papers.title_zh: 通过解码时间贡献的稀疏性来加速预填充过程
papers.authors: Zhiyuan He, Yike Zhang, Chengruidong Zhang, Huiqiang Jiang, Yuqing Yang, Lili Qiu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) incur quadratic attention complexity with input length, creating a major time bottleneck in the prefilling stage. Existing acceleration methods largely exploit attention score sparsity by estimating blocks with high attention scores and applying dynamic sparse attention. In this work, we identify another untapped form of sparsity in the prefilling stage, namely decoding-time contribution sparsity, where many attention blocks exhibit nontrivial attention scores during prefilling yet contribute negligibly to subsequent decoding. Building on this observation, we propose TriangleMix, which replaces dense attention with Triangle attention in a subset of layers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TriangleMix achieves near-lossless performance on both long-context and long-context reasoning benchmarks, while significantly improving efficiency. For 128K inputs, Triangle attention in the subset of layers achieves a 15.3 \times speedup in attention kernel computation, significantly exceeding the acceleration of typical dynamic sparse methods ( 1.9 \times to 3.4 \times ). Furthermore, TriangleMix can be seamlessly combined with dynamic sparsity approaches, delivering an additional 6%–19% reduction in TTFT over using dynamic sparsity alone.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在输入长度较大的情况下，其注意力计算复杂度呈二次方增长，这严重阻碍了预填充阶段的效率。现有的加速方法大多利用了注意力得分的稀疏性，通过估计注意力得分较高的块，并采用动态稀疏注意力机制来减少不必要的计算。在本研究中，我们发现了预填充阶段另一种未被充分利用的稀疏性——解码时间贡献的稀疏性。许多注意力块在预填充阶段表现出较高的注意力得分，但在后续解码过程中却几乎没有贡献。基于这一发现，我们提出了TriangleMix算法，该算法在部分层中用Triangle注意力机制替代了密集注意力机制。大量实验表明，TriangleMix在长上下文推理任务上取得了接近无损的性能，同时显著提升了计算效率。对于128K的输入规模，在部分层中采用Triangle注意力机制可以使得注意力核计算的速度提升15.3倍，远远超过了传统动态稀疏方法的加速效果（1.9倍到3.4倍）。此外，TriangleMix还可以与动态稀疏方法无缝结合，进一步将解码时间贡献的消耗降低6%到19%。

papers.title: SpecBound: Adaptive Bounded Self-Speculation with Layer-wise Confidence Calibration
papers.title_zh: SpecBound：自适应有界自我推测技术，包含逐层置信度校准功能
papers.authors: Zhuofan Wen, Yang Feng
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach to accelerate autoregressive inference in large language models (LLMs). Self-draft methods, which leverage the base LLM itself for speculation, avoid the overhead of auxiliary draft models but face critical limitations: shallow layers often produce overconfident yet incorrect token predictions, and the presence of difficult tokens in a draft sequence forces redundant computation through deeper layers, undermining both draft acceptance and overall speedup. To address these issues, we propose a novel self-draft framework that suppresses spurious confidence via layer-wise temperature annealing in early-exit decision and adaptively bounds speculation length based on token-wise decoding difficulty. By reprocessing the hidden states of draft tokens in a unified parallel pass through deep layers when speculation terminates, our method maintains exact output equivalence with the original model while maximizing computational efficiency. It requires no modifications to the base LLM parameters and achieves up to 2.33× wall-time speedup over standard autoregressive decoding across diverse long-form generation tasks and multiple model architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 推测解码被证明是一种有效的方法，可以加速大语言模型中的自回归推理过程。自起草方法利用基础语言模型本身进行推测，避免了使用辅助起草模型的开销，但存在关键限制：浅层往往会产生过于自信但错误的令牌预测；而在草稿序列中出现难以处理的令牌时，会导致需要通过更深层次进行计算，从而降低了草稿的接受度以及整体处理速度。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的自起草框架，通过逐层调整温度来抑制虚假的置信度，并在早期退出决策中采用自适应地限制推测长度的方法。当推测结束时，我们的方法会统一并行处理草稿令牌的隐藏状态，从而在保持与原始模型完全等效输出的同时，最大化计算效率。该方法不需要对基础语言模型参数进行任何修改，并且在多种长形式生成任务和多种模型架构下，其处理速度比标准自回归解码快了2.33倍。
