papers.title: Stable and Explainable Personality Trait Evaluation in Large Language Models with Internal Activations
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型中实现稳定且可解释的个性特征评估，涉及内部激活机制的处理
papers.authors: Xiaoxu Ma, Xiangbo Zhang, Zhenyu Weng
papers.abstract: Evaluating personality-related tendencies in Large Language Models (LLMs) helps characterize model behavior, compare models beyond task accuracy, and support responsible deployment in socially interactive settings. However, existing questionnaire-based evaluation methods exhibit limited stability and offer little explainability, as their results are highly sensitive to minor variations in prompt phrasing or role-play configurations. To address these limitations, we propose an internal-activation–based approach, termed Persona-Vector Neutrality Interpolation (PVNI), for stable and explainable personality trait evaluation in LLMs. PVNI extracts a persona vector associated with a target personality trait from the model’s internal activations using contrastive prompts. It then estimates the corresponding neutral score by interpolating along the persona vector as an anchor axis, enabling an interpretable comparison between the neutral prompt representation and the persona direction. We provide a theoretical analysis of the effectiveness and generalization properties of PVNI. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs demonstrate that PVNI yields substantially more stable personality trait evaluations than existing methods, even under questionnaire and role-play variants.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型中的人格相关倾向有助于了解模型的行为特点，在任务准确性之外进行模型间的比较，并支持在社交互动环境中的负责任部署。然而，现有的基于问卷的评估方法稳定性较差，且难以解释，因为其结果对提示语或角色扮演配置中的细微变化非常敏感。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种基于内部激活的方法，称为“人物向量中立性插值”（Persona-Vector Neutrality Interpolation，PVNI）。该方法通过对比性提示，从模型的内部激活中提取与目标人格特征相关的人物向量。然后，通过沿着人物向量进行插值来估算相应的中立分数，从而实现对中立提示表示与人物方向之间可解释性的比较。我们对PVNI的有效性和泛化特性进行了理论分析。在多种大语言模型上的广泛实验表明，即使在问卷和角色扮演变体的情况下，PVNI也能提供比现有方法更稳定的人格特征评估结果。

papers.title: Learning Continuous Temporal Dynamics on Symplectic Manifolds for Temporal Knowledge Graph Embedding
papers.title_zh: 在辛流形上学习连续时间动力学，以实现时间知识图谱的嵌入
papers.authors: Jiang Li, Zehua Duo, Tian Lan, Feilong Bao, Guanglai Gao, Xiangdong Su
papers.abstract: Temporal knowledge graph embedding (TKGE) aims to model the temporal evolution of relational facts. However, existing approaches predominantly rely on discrete timestamp lookup tables and high-dimensional embedding spaces, which lack explicit structural constraints for continuous-time dynamics. As a result, temporal patterns are often captured through capacity scaling rather than principled dynamic modeling, leading to limited parameter efficiency and scalability.To address these limitations, we propose , a physics-inspired framework that embeds temporal dynamics into a symplectic phase space. Our model introduces a structure-preserving Hamiltonian evolution mechanism based on a pairwise-decoupled Hamiltonian generator and its Cayley transform, ensuring that temporal transformations adhere to the symplectic group \mathrm{Sp}(2d) and preserve phase-space volume with linear computational complexity. In addition, we design a Time-Aware Parameter Modulation mechanism that integrates continuous Rotary Time Embeddings via Feature-wise Linear Modulation, enabling smooth temporal evolution while capturing event-driven variations. Theoretical analysis establishes the geometric validity of the proposed framework. Extensive experiments on standard TKGE benchmarks demonstrate that achieves competitive performance with substantially lower embedding dimensions. Furthermore, empirical results show that the proposed continuous Hamiltonian evolution facilitates generalization to unseen timestamps by learning transferable temporal dynamics from the underlying geometric structure.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间知识图谱嵌入（TKGE）旨在模拟关系事实的时间演变。然而，现有的方法主要依赖于离散时间戳查找表和高维嵌入空间，这些方法缺乏对连续时间动态的结构性约束。因此，时间模式往往是通过容量扩展来捕捉的，而不是通过基于原理的动态建模来实现，这导致参数效率和可扩展性受到限制。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种受物理启发的框架，该框架将时间动态嵌入到辛相空间中。我们的模型引入了一种基于成对解耦的哈密顿生成器及其Cayley变换的结构保持哈密顿演化机制，确保时间变换遵循辛群\(\mathrm{Sp}(2d)\)，并以线性计算复杂度保持相空间体积。此外，我们还设计了一种时间感知的参数调制机制，通过特征线性调制整合连续的旋转时间嵌入，从而实现平滑的时间演化，同时捕捉由事件驱动的变化。理论分析证明了所提出框架的几何有效性。在标准的TKGE基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，该框架能够在显著降低嵌入维度的前提下取得具有竞争力的性能。此外，实证结果表明，所提出的连续哈密顿演化机制能够通过从底层几何结构中学习可迁移的时间动态，促进对未见时间戳的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: mPresenter: An Agentic Framework for Generating Multilingual Presentation Videos from Scientific Papers
papers.title_zh: mPresenter：一种用于从科学论文中生成多语言演示视频的框架
papers.authors: Wenhan Han, Xiao Xiao, Mykola Pechenizkiy, Meng Fang
papers.abstract: Generating presentation videos from scientific papers is challenging due to the need for long-document discourse planning and cross-lingual grounding. Existing Paper2Video systems are largely monolingual and often rely on single-pass pipelines, which can limit the coherence and informativeness of the resulting presentations.We present mPresenter, a multilingual agentic Paper2Video system that decomposes the task into planning, audience-oriented critique, layout-aware slide generation, and multilingual figure interpretation, enabling iterative refinement at the discourse level. To facilitate reproducible evaluation, we also introduce mPreBench, a multilingual benchmark that evaluates presentation videos via question answering as a proxy for effective information transfer. Experimental results indicate that mPresenter improves question-answering accuracy relative to prior systems, while maintaining affordable cost and latency.
papers.abstract_zh: 从科学论文中生成演示视频是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为这需要针对长文档进行合理的规划，同时还要处理跨语言的信息传递问题。现有的Paper2Video系统大多只支持一种语言，并且通常采用单遍处理流程，这可能会限制最终生成的演示文稿的连贯性和信息含量。我们提出了mPresenter这一多语言演示视频生成系统，该系统将任务分解为几个阶段：规划、面向受众的评审、布局感知的幻灯片生成以及多语言图表解读。通过这些步骤，我们可以在话语层面进行迭代优化。为了便于可重复的评估，我们还开发了mPreBench这一多语言基准测试工具，它通过问答方式来评估演示视频的有效性，以此作为信息传递效果的衡量标准。实验结果表明，与之前的系统相比，mPresenter在问答准确性方面有所提升，同时其成本和使用延迟也保持在合理范围内。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Tree-CoT-RT: An Explainable Multi-Path Tree-Guided Chain-of-Thought and Reinforcement Learning Framework for Aspect Sentiment Quad Prediction
papers.title_zh: Tree-CoT-RT：一种可解释的多路径树状思维与强化学习框架，适用于方面情感预测任务
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Jiahao Wang, Zhenke Duan, Xin Yin, Haichuan Hu, Hualong Chen, Suyi, Congqing He, Yike Tan, Yu-N Cheah
papers.abstract: Aspect Sentiment Quad Prediction (ASQP) is a fundamental yet challenging task in fine-grained sentiment analysis, particularly when aspects or opinions are implicit. Existing methods often lack explainability and generalization, making it difficult to justify inference decisions and to detect implicit sentiment across domains and varied expression patterns. To address these limitations, we propose Tree-CoT-RT, an explainable multi-path tree-guided chain-of-thought and reinforcement learning framework specifically designed for ASQP. The core idea is to use sentiment tree structures to design type-specific reasoning templates that guide LLMs in generating explainable chains, including both final sentiment quadruples and intermediate inference steps for transparent implicit reasoning. However, the generated reasoning chains often vary in quality and may contain logical inconsistencies. To mitigate this, we introduce a reinforcement learning strategy with a rule-based reward function to generate high-quality reasoning traces, which are then used to fine-tune the LLM and enable controlled sampling. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that Tree-CoT-RT substantially outperforms strong baselines, particularly in scenarios involving implicit sentiment analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 方面情感四元组预测（ASQP）是细粒度情感分析中的一个基础但具有挑战性的任务，尤其是在方面或意见为隐式的情况下。现有的方法往往缺乏可解释性和泛化能力，这使得难以证明推理决策的正确性，也难以检测不同领域和多种表达模式下的隐式情感。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了Tree-CoT-RT这一可解释的多路径树状思维与强化学习框架，专门用于ASQP任务。其核心思想是利用情感树结构来设计特定类型的推理模板，引导大语言模型生成可解释的推理链，包括最终的情感四元组以及中间推理步骤，从而实现透明的隐式推理。然而，生成的推理链在质量上往往存在差异，且可能存在逻辑上的不一致性。为了缓解这一问题，我们引入了一种基于规则的强化学习策略，以生成高质量的推理轨迹，然后利用这些轨迹来微调大语言模型，从而实现可控的采样。在基准数据集上的实验表明，Tree-CoT-RT在涉及隐式情感分析的场景中，其性能明显优于其他强大的基线方法。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: PRISM-MCTS: Learning from Reasoning Trajectories with Metacognitive Reflection
papers.title_zh: PRISM-MCTS：通过元认知反思来学习推理过程
papers.authors: Siyuan Cheng, Bozhong Tian, Yanchao Hao, Zheng Wei
papers.abstract: The emergence of reasoning models, exemplified by OpenAI o1, signifies a transition from intuitive to deliberative cognition, effectively reorienting the scaling laws from pre-training paradigms toward test-time computation. While Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) has shown promise in this domain, existing approaches typically treat each rollout as an isolated trajectory. This lack of information sharing leads to severe inefficiency and substantial computational redundancy, as the search process fails to leverage insights from prior explorations. To address these limitations, we propose PRISM-MCTS, a novel reasoning framework that draws inspiration from human parallel thinking and reflective processes. PRISM-MCTS integrates a Process Reward Model (PRM) with a dynamic shared memory, capturing both “Heuristics” and “Fallacies”. By reinforcing successful strategies and pruning error-prone branches, PRISM-MCTS effectively achieves refinement. Furthermore, we develop a data-efficient training strategy for the PRM, achieving high-fidelity evaluation under a few-shot regime. Empirical evaluations across diverse reasoning benchmarks substantiate the efficacy of PRISM-MCTS. Notably, it halves the trajectory requirements on GPQA while surpassing MCTS-RAG and Search-o1, demonstrating that it scales inference by reasoning judiciously rather than exhaustively.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理模型的出现，以OpenAI的o1为例，标志着从直觉认知向理性认知的转变。这种转变使得计算法则从预训练阶段转向了测试阶段的运算方式。虽然蒙特卡洛树搜索在这一领域表现出了一定的潜力，但现有的方法通常将每次试验视为一个独立的流程。这种缺乏信息共享的情况导致了严重的效率低下和大量的计算冗余，因为搜索过程无法充分利用之前探索所得到的经验。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了PRISM-MCTS这一新颖的推理框架。该框架借鉴了人类并行思维和反思过程的特性。PRISM-MCTS将过程奖励模型与动态共享内存相结合，从而同时捕捉到“启发式”和“谬误”。通过强化成功的策略并剪除容易出错的路径，PRISM-MCTS能够有效地实现优化。此外，我们还开发了一种高效的数据训练策略，使得在少量样本的情况下也能获得高精度的评估结果。在多种推理基准测试中的实证结果表明，PRISM-MCTS确实具有强大的性能。值得注意的是，它在GPQA上的轨迹需求减少了一半，同时其性能优于MCTS-RAG和Search-o1，这表明它通过合理的推理方式来扩展推理能力，而不是采用穷尽式的推理方式。

papers.title: CausalityCheck: A Framework for Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 因果检查：一种用于评估大型语言模型中因果推理能力的框架
papers.authors: Jiang Li, Zehua Duo, Guanglai Gao, Xiangdong Su
papers.abstract: Causal reasoning is a crucial component of understanding complex phenomena and building intelligent systems. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated their strong capabilities in reasoning tasks; however, their true understanding of causal relationships remains limited, particularly in cases where causal chains are misidentified or reliance on empirical inference occurs. To mitigate the risk that models misclassify data as false positives due to these issues, we introduce CausalityCheck, an automated tool designed to efficiently generate causal reasoning checklists. This checklist enables the creation of multi-task causal reasoning datasets with task generalization and reasoning robustness from a single causal reasoning dataset. Using CausalityCheck, we developed CausalityCheck-CP to assess the causal reasoning abilities of 18 LLMs. This framework also measures the extent to which causal chains are misidentified or rely on empirical inferences. Our results indicate that the current large language models still face two critical issues when handling complex causal reasoning tasks: incorrect identification of causal chains and reliance on empirical inference. The code and data are available at https://github.com/dzh597/CausalityCheck.
papers.abstract_zh: 因果推理是理解复杂现象和构建智能系统的重要组成部分。最近大语言模型在推理任务上的表现令人瞩目，然而它们对因果关系的理解仍然有限，尤其是在因果链被错误识别或依赖经验性推断的情况下。为了降低模型因这些问题而将数据误分类为假阳性的风险，我们推出了CausalityCheck这一自动化工具，它能够高效地生成因果推理检查清单。通过这一检查清单，我们可以从单一的因果推理数据集中创建出具有任务泛化能力和推理鲁棒性的多任务因果推理数据集。利用CausalityCheck，我们开发了CausalityCheck-CP，用于评估18种大语言模型的因果推理能力。该框架还能衡量因果链被错误识别的程度以及模型对经验性推断的依赖程度。我们的研究结果表明，当前的大语言模型在处理复杂的因果推理任务时仍然存在两个关键问题：因果链的错误识别以及对经验性推断的依赖。相关的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/dzh597/CausalityCheck下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: OmniDiagram: Advancing Unified Diagram Code Generation via Visual Interrogation Reward
papers.title_zh: OmniDiagram：通过可视化查询技术推进统一图表代码的生成
papers.authors: Haoyue Yang, Xuanle Zhao, Xuexin Liu, Feibing Jiang, Yao Zhu
papers.abstract: The paradigm of programmable diagram generation is evolving rapidly, playing a crucial role in structured visualization. However, most existing studies are confined to a narrow range of task formulations and language support, constraining their applicability to diverse diagram types. In this work, we propose OmniDiagram, a unified framework that incorporates diverse diagram code languages and task definitions. To address the challenge of aligning code logic with visual fidelity in Reinforcement Learning (RL), we introduce a novel visual feedback strategy named Visual Interrogation Verifies All (Viva). Unlike brittle syntax-based rules or pixel-level matching, Viva rewards the visual structure of rendered diagrams through a generative approach. Specifically, Viva actively generates targeted visual inquiries to scrutinize diagram visual fidelity and provides fine-grained feedback for optimization. This mechanism facilitates a self-evolving training process, effectively obviating the need for manually annotated ground truth code. Furthermore, we construct M3^2Diagram, the first large-scale diagram code generation dataset, containing over 196k high-quality instances. Experimental results confirm that the combination of SFT and our Viva-based RL allows OmniDiagram to establish a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) across diagram code generation benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 可编程图表生成的范式正在迅速发展，它在结构化可视化中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，目前大多数研究都局限于有限的任务定义和语言支持范围内，这限制了它们适用于多种图表类型的能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了OmniDiagram这一统一框架，它整合了多种图表编码语言和任务定义。为了应对在强化学习领域中如何将代码逻辑与视觉逼真度相结合的挑战，我们引入了一种名为“视觉查询验证一切”（Viva）的新颖视觉反馈策略。与基于脆弱语法的规则或像素级匹配不同，Viva通过生成式方法来奖励渲染后图表的视觉结构。具体来说，Viva会主动生成有针对性的视觉查询，以检查图表的视觉逼真度，并提供细粒度的反馈以进行优化。这种机制促进了自进化的训练过程，有效避免了需要手动标注真实代码的必要。此外，我们还构建了M3^2Diagram这一首个大规模图表编码数据集，其中包含超过196,000个高质量实例。实验结果表明，结合SFT技术和我们的Viva-based RL策略，OmniDiagram能够在图表编码基准测试中取得新的最佳成绩。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Why Agents Compromise Safety Under Pressure
papers.title_zh: 为什么经纪人在压力下会妥协于安全问题之上
papers.authors: Hengle Jiang, Ke Tang
papers.abstract: Large Language Model agents deployed in complex environments frequently encounter a conflict between maximizing goal achievement and adhering to safety constraints. This paper identifies a new concept called Agentic Pressure, which characterizes the endogenous tension emerging when compliant execution becomes infeasible. We demonstrate that under this pressure agents exhibit normative drift where they strategically sacrifice safety to preserve utility. Notably we find that advanced reasoning capabilities accelerate this decline as models construct linguistic rationalizations to justify violation. Finally, we analyze the root causes and explore preliminary mitigation strategies, such as pressure isolation, which attempts to restore alignment by decoupling decision-making from pressure signals.
papers.abstract_zh: 在复杂环境中部署的大语言模型智能体经常面临最大化目标达成与遵守安全约束之间的冲突。本文提出了一种名为“智能体压力”的新概念，它描述了当合规执行变得不可行时所产生的内在张力。我们发现，在这种压力下，智能体会表现出一种规范性偏差，即它们为了维护效用而战略性地牺牲安全性。值得注意的是，先进的推理能力会加速这种偏差的加剧，因为模型会构建语言上的合理化解释来为违规行为辩护。最后，我们分析了导致这一问题的根本原因，并探讨了一些初步的缓解策略，例如通过分离决策过程与压力信号来恢复智能体与压力信号之间的协调关系。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CoMoL: Efficient Mixture of LoRA Experts via Dynamic Core Space Merging
papers.title_zh: CoMoL：通过动态合并核心空间实现高效的LoRA专家混合方案
papers.authors: Jie Cao, Zhenxuan Fan, Zhuonan Wang, Tianwei Lin, Ziyuan Zhao, Rolan Yan, Wenqiao Zhang, Feifei Shao, Hongwei Wang, Jun Xiao, Siliang Tang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance on diverse downstream and domain-specific tasks via parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). However, existing PEFT methods, particularly MoE-LoRA architectures, suffer from limited parameter efficiency and coarse-grained adaptation due to the proliferation of LoRA experts and instance-level routing. To address these issues, we propose Core Space Mixture of LoRA (\textbf{CoMoL}), a novel MoE-LoRA framework that incorporates expert diversity, parameter efficiency, and fine-grained adaptation. Specifically, CoMoL introduces two key components: core space experts and core space routing. Core space experts store each expert in a compact core matrix, preserving diversity while controlling parameter growth. Core space routing dynamically selects and activates the appropriate core experts for each token, enabling fine-grained, input-adaptive routing. Activated core experts are then merged via a soft-merging strategy into a single core expert, which is combined with a shared LoRA to form a specialized LoRA module. Besides, the routing network is projected into the same low-rank space as the LoRA matrices, further reducing parameter overhead without compromising expressiveness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoMoL retains the adaptability of MoE-LoRA architectures while achieving parameter efficiency comparable to standard LoRA, consistently outperforming existing methods across multiple tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/DCDmllm/CoMoL.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多种下游任务及特定领域任务中表现出色，这得益于参数高效微调技术。然而，现有的参数高效微调方法，尤其是MoE-LoRA架构，存在参数效率低下以及适应性较差的问题，这是由于LoRA专家的数量过多以及实例级路由机制导致的。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Core Space Mixture of LoRA（简称CoMoL）这一新型MoE-LoRA框架。该框架结合了专家多样性、参数效率以及细粒度适应性等优点。具体来说，CoMoL引入了两个关键组件：核心空间专家和核心空间路由机制。核心空间专家将每个专家信息存储在一个紧凑的核心矩阵中，从而在保持多样性的同时控制参数的增长。核心空间路由则能够动态选择并激活适合每个令牌的核心专家，从而实现细粒度的、基于输入的自适应路由。激活后的核心专家通过软合并策略合并成一个单一的核心专家，然后与共享的LoRA模块结合，形成专门的LoRA模块。此外，路由网络被投影到与LoRA矩阵相同的低秩空间中，从而进一步降低参数开销，同时不牺牲模型的表达能力。大量实验表明，CoMoL在保持MoE-LoRA架构的适应性基础上，实现了与标准LoRA相当的参数效率，并且在多个任务中均优于现有方法。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/DCDmllm/CoMoL下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: QuCo-RAG: Quantifying Uncertainty from the Pre-training Corpus for Dynamic Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: QuCo-RAG：通过预训练语料库来量化不确定性，以实现动态检索增强的生成式生成技术
papers.authors: Dehai Min, Kailin Zhang, Tongtong Wu, Lu Cheng
papers.abstract: Dynamic Retrieval-Augmented Generation adaptively determines when to retrieve during generation to mitigate hallucinations in large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods rely on model-internal signals (e.g., logits, entropy), which are fundamentally unreliable because LLMs are typically ill-calibrated and often exhibit high confidence in erroneous outputs. We propose QuCo-RAG, which shifts from subjective confidence to objective statistics computed from pre-training data. Our method quantifies uncertainty through two stages: (1) before generation, we identify low-frequency entities indicating long-tail knowledge gaps; (2) during generation, we verify entity co-occurrence in the pre-training corpus, where zero co-occurrence often signals hallucination risk. Both stages leverage Infini-gram for millisecond-latency queries over 4 trillion tokens, triggering retrieval when uncertainty is high. Experiments on multi-hop QA benchmarks show QuCo-RAG achieves EM gains of 5–12 points over state-of-the-art baselines with OLMo-2 models, and transfers effectively to models with undisclosed pre-training data (Llama-3, Qwen2.5, GPT-4.1/5-chat), improving EM by up to 14 points. Generalization to long-form generation and biomedical QA further validates the robustness of our paradigm. These results establish corpus-grounded verification as a principled, practically model-agnostic paradigm for dynamic RAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 动态检索增强生成技术能够自适应地决定在生成过程中何时进行检索，从而减轻大语言模型中的幻觉问题。然而，现有的方法依赖于模型内部的信号（如逻辑值、熵等），这些信号本质上是不可靠的，因为大语言模型通常校准不当，且往往对错误的输出持有较高的置信度。我们提出了QuCo-RAG算法，该算法将主观的置信度转化为基于预训练数据计算出的客观统计信息。我们的方法通过两个阶段来量化不确定性：（1）在生成之前，我们识别出低频实体，这些实体代表着长期的知识空白；（2）在生成过程中，我们验证预训练语料中实体的共现情况，如果某个实体没有共现，则很可能意味着存在幻觉风险。这两个阶段都利用了Infini-gram算法，对4万亿个令牌进行毫秒级延迟查询，并在不确定性较高时触发检索。在多跳问答基准测试中的实验表明，与最先进的OLMo-2模型相比，QuCo-RAG在语义质量方面提升了5到12分；而且，该方法还能有效应用于那些预训练数据未知的模型（如Llama-3、Qwen2.5、GPT-4.1/5-chat），使语义质量提升多达14分。对于长形式生成和生物医学问答领域的应用也进一步验证了我们方法的鲁棒性。这些结果证明了以语料为基础的可验证性是一种原则性且实际上与模型无关的动态RAG方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CaM-HG: Causal-Enhanced MoE and Hypergraphs Network for Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations
papers.title_zh: CaM-HG：基于因果增强的MoE模型和超图网络，用于对话中不完全的多模态情感识别
papers.authors: Mingjian Yang, Yong Wang, Peng Liu, Wen Yin
papers.abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation (MERC) relies on integrating heterogeneous signals, yet real-world modality missingness frequently disrupts these systems. We contend that missingness is not merely a loss of data fidelity but a rupture of the fine-grained inter-modal causal chains essential for reasoning. Existing methods, which primarily focus on statistical reconstruction, often fail to bridge these logical gaps, effectively leaving semantic holes. To address this, we propose the Causal-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts and Hypergraph Network (CaM-HG), employing a “restore-then-mine” paradigm. First, a Causal-Enhanced MoE module conditions experts on historical context to synthesize missing features that are both realistic and causally consistent, thereby patching the broken topology. Subsequently, an Asymmetric Causal Dynamic Hypergraph mines high-order correlations from the restored graph while enforcing strict temporal causality. Experiments on IEMOCAP, CMU-MOSI, and CMU-MOSEI show consistent improvements in terms of WAF1 and accuracy over strong baselines, e.g., surpassing SOTA benchmarks by 1.43% and 1.25% on IEMOCAP. The source code is included in the supplementary material.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态对话情感识别技术（MERC）依赖于对异构信号的整合，但现实世界中的模态缺失问题常常破坏这些系统的运行。我们认为，模态缺失不仅仅是数据真实性的损失，更是导致推理过程中关键的多模态因果链断裂的原因。现有的方法主要侧重于统计重建，往往无法填补这些逻辑上的空白，从而留下语义上的漏洞。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种基于因果增强的专家混合模型与超图网络方案（CaM-HG），采用“先恢复再挖掘”的范式。首先，通过因果增强的专家模块根据历史背景对专家进行约束，以合成既真实又符合因果关系的缺失特征，从而修复被破坏的拓扑结构。随后，不对称因果动态超图从恢复的图中挖掘出高阶相关性，同时严格遵循时间上的因果关系。在IEMOCAP、CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI上的实验表明，该方案在WAF1指标和准确率方面均取得了显著提升，例如在IEMOCAP上超越了最先进的基准测试，分别提高了1.43%和1.25%。源代码已包含在补充材料中。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Large-Scale Diverse Synthesis for Mid-Training
papers.title_zh: 大规模多样化合成技术，适用于中期训练阶段
papers.authors: Xuemiao Zhang, Chengying Tu, Can Ren, Rongxiang Weng, Hongfei Yan, Jingang Wang, Xunliang Cai
papers.abstract: Mid-training has become critical for enhancing the knowledge and reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), especially through the utilization of large-scale synthetic data. However, existing data synthesis methods often generate simplistic and homogeneous QA pairs, with limited scale and diversity. To address this, we propose BoostQA, a novel framework designed to synthesize large-scale, diverse, and high-quality QA data for mid-training. BoostQA introduces model probes during mid-training for the first time and implements STEM-focused multi-grade synthesis to boost data diversity as well as high-difficulty synthesis to alleviate difficulty degradation, followed by answer refinement to further improve quality. Extensive experiments by mid-training Llama-3 8B demonstrate that using only 20B-token BoostQA data achieves a significant average improvement of 12.74% on MMLU and CMMLU over the pre-training baseline. After mid-training on 500B tokens, including 100B-token BoostQA data, our model achieves SOTA average results across benchmarks among mainstream models of comparable size. BoostQA also demonstrates robust scalability, with performance consistently improving as model size, data volume, and initial FLOPs scale.
papers.abstract_zh: 在模型训练中期阶段，利用大规模合成数据来提升大语言模型的知识水平和推理能力至关重要。然而，现有的数据合成方法往往只能生成简单且同质化的问答对，其规模与多样性都有限。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了BoostQA框架。该框架旨在为模型训练中期阶段合成大规模、多样化且高质量的问答数据。BoostQA首次在模型训练过程中引入模型探针，并采用以STEM为主题的多层次合成方式来提高数据的多样性；同时，通过高难度合成来减轻模型的易用性问题，最后再通过答案优化进一步提升数据质量。通过对Llama-3 8B模型进行广泛的实验测试发现，仅使用20B令牌的BoostQA数据就能使MMLU和CMMLU指标的平均得分相比预训练阶段显著提高12.74%。在使用了500B令牌进行训练之后，再加上100B令牌的BoostQA数据，我们的模型在各项基准测试中取得了与同等规模主流模型相当的优秀成绩。此外，BoostQA还表现出强大的可扩展性，随着模型规模、数据量以及初始计算成本的增加，其性能也能持续提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DiSec: Mitigating Backdoors in Pre-trained Language Models via Disentanglement of Adversarial Weights for Secure Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: DiSec：通过分解对抗性权重来减轻预训练语言模型中的后门漏洞，从而实现安全微调
papers.authors: Sunanda Das, Qinghua Li
papers.abstract: Task-agnostic backdoor attacks can contaminate pre-trained language models (PLMs) in a way that survives downstream adaptation, even under full fine-tuning, making it difficult for practitioners to trust third-party checkpoints. Existing defenses often rely on privileged assumptions (e.g., access to poisoned data or trigger/target knowledge), thereby limiting their applicability in realistic settings. We present DiSec, a robust and label-efficient purification framework that uses only clean auxiliary text and does not rely on downstream supervision or attack signatures. DiSec elicits model-internal signals from this clean data to separate suspicious parameter components that are inconsistent with benign behavior, and then flags anomalous structures by jointly leveraging complementary spectral and generative views of outliers. Finally, DiSec performs a structure-preserving repair via layer-local prototype-based mean correction, yielding an idempotent update that depends only on non-adversarial statistics. Across diverse downstream classification tasks and PLM backdoor strategies, DiSec substantially suppresses attack success while preserving clean-task utility, offering a practical path to securing fully fine-tuned PLMs before deployment. The codes are publicly available at https://github.com/das-sunanda/DiSec.
papers.abstract_zh: 与任务无关的后门攻击能够以一种方式污染预训练的语言模型，这种污染即使在完全微调的情况下也能持续存在。这使得从业者难以信任第三方检查点。现有的防御措施往往依赖于一些特权假设（例如，访问被污染的数据或利用触发/目标知识），因此这些措施的适用性在现实环境中受到限制。我们提出了DiSec这一强大且高效的净化框架，该框架仅使用干净的辅助文本，而不依赖下游的监督或攻击特征。DiSec通过从干净数据中提取模型内部的信号，来分离出与良性行为不符的可疑参数组件，然后通过结合利用异常值的光谱分析和生成式分析来标记异常结构。最后，DiSec通过基于层局部原型的平均校正来进行结构保留性修复，从而实现一种仅依赖于非对抗性统计数据的幂等更新。在多种下游分类任务和语言模型后门攻击策略中，DiSec能够有效抑制攻击的成功率，同时保留干净任务的效用，为在部署前保护完全微调过的语言模型提供了切实可行的途径。相关代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/das-sunanda/DiSec

papers.title: LUNE: Efficient LLM Unlearning via LoRA Fine-Tuning with Negative Examples
papers.title_zh: LUNE：通过LoRA微调结合负例训练，实现LLM的高效“忘记”功能
papers.authors: Yezi Liu, Hanning Chen, Wenjun Huang, Yang Ni, Mohsen Imani
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) encode vast factual knowledge, yet their inability to selectively forget specific information hinders privacy protection, bias mitigation, and post-deployment correction. We present LoRA-based Unlearning with Negative Examples (LUNE), a lightweight framework that performs negative-only unlearning by updating only low-rank adapters while freezing the backbone, thereby localizing edits and avoiding disruptive global changes. Leveraging Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), LUNE targets intermediate representations to suppress (or replace) requested knowledge with an order-of-magnitude lower compute and memory than full fine-tuning or direct weight editing. Extensive experiments on multiple factual unlearning tasks show that LUNE: (I) achieves effectiveness comparable to full fine-tuning and memory-editing methods; and (II) reduces computational cost by about an order of magnitude.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够编码大量的事实知识，但因为它们无法选择性地遗忘特定信息，这就阻碍了隐私保护、偏见缓解以及部署后的修正工作。我们提出了基于LoRA的“负例式遗忘学习”方法（LUNE），这是一种轻量级框架，它仅通过更新低秩适配器来实现负向遗忘学习，同时保留核心模型结构不变，从而实现对局部内容的修改，避免产生全局性的破坏性变化。利用低秩自适应技术，LUNE能够针对中间表示进行抑制或替换所需的知识，其计算量和内存需求都比完整的微调或直接权重编辑要低一个数量级。在多个事实遗忘学习任务上的广泛实验表明，LUNE具有以下优势：(I)其效果与完整的微调方法和内存编辑方法相当；(II)其计算成本也降低了大约一个数量级。

papers.title: Think Earlier, Not Longer: Prompt Optimization via Reducing Unhealthy Exploration
papers.title_zh: 提前思考，而非延长时间：通过减少不必要的探索来优化决策过程
papers.authors: Ling-I Wu, Minyu Chen, Jingyang Li, Xi Chang, Guoqiang Li
papers.abstract: While large language models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, prior work shows that their performance can be further enhanced by encouraging greater exploration. However, existing approaches overlook the presence of unhealthy exploration that increases exploration-related token usage without contributing to effective problem-solving. In this work, we show that prompt ambiguity can artificially prolong early-stage exploration, manifested as an elevated and delayed early-stage entropy peak. Although this uncertainty may be gradually resolved as reasoning progresses, reflected in the eventual convergence of the late-stage entropy peak, it does not meaningfully improve accuracy or self-consistency and instead substantially reduces reasoning efficiency. Motivated by these observations, we propose an entropy-dynamics-aware prompt optimization framework that trains a lightweight optimizer to generate concise clarifications. These clarifications aim to reduce ambiguity-induced early-stage uncertainty while preserving the model’s reasoning capabilities. Extensive experiments across multiple models, reasoning budgets, and benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently improves reasoning efficiency by up to 52%, by reducing unhealthy exploration without sacrificing accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型具备强大的推理能力，但先前的研究表明，通过鼓励更多的探索行为可以进一步提升其性能。然而，现有的方法往往忽视了那些无益的探索行为，这些行为会增加与探索相关的令牌使用量，但却无法有效促进问题的解决。在这项研究中，我们发现提示的模糊性会人为地延长早期阶段的探索过程，表现为早期熵峰值的升高和延迟。尽管这种不确定性会在推理过程中逐渐得到解决，反映在后期熵峰值的收敛上，但这并不会显著提升模型的准确性或自洽性，反而会大幅降低推理效率。基于这些观察结果，我们提出了一个注重熵动态变化的提示优化框架。该框架利用轻量级优化器来生成简洁的澄清信息，从而减少由模糊性引起的早期不确定性，同时保留模型的推理能力。通过在不同模型、推理预算和基准测试中的广泛实验验证，我们发现我们的方法能够显著提高推理效率，最多可达52%，同时还能避免牺牲准确性来减少不必要的探索行为。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Psychological Counseling Cannot Be Achieved Overnight: Automated Psychological Counseling Through Multi-Session Conversations
papers.title_zh: 心理辅导并非能一蹴而就：通过多次会谈来实现自动化心理辅导
papers.authors: Bichen Wang, Junzhe Wang, Yixin Sun, Xing Fu, Yanyan Zhao, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: In recent years, Large Language Models (LLMs) have made significant progress in automated psychological counseling. However, current research focuses on single-session counseling, which doesn’t represent real-world scenarios. In practice, psychological counseling is a process, not a one-time event, requiring sustained, multi-session engagement to progressively address clients’ issues. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a dataset for Multi-Session Psychological Counseling Conversation Dataset (Muspsy). Our Muspsy dataset is constructed using real client profiles from publicly available psychological case reports. It captures the dynamic arc of counseling, encompassing multiple progressive counseling conversations from the same client across different sessions. Leveraging our dataset, we also developed our Muspsy model, which aims to track client progress and adapt its counseling direction over time. Experiments show that our model performs better than baseline models across multiple sessions.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，大语言模型在自动心理辅导领域取得了显著进展。然而，目前的研究主要集中在单次咨询上，这并不能反映现实中的情况。实际上，心理辅导是一个持续的过程，需要多次咨询才能逐步解决客户的问题。为了克服这一限制，我们创建了一个名为“多会话心理辅导对话数据集”的新数据集。我们的该数据集基于公开可用的心理案例报告中的真实客户资料构建而成，能够捕捉到辅导过程中的动态变化，包括同一客户在不同会话中的多次咨询对话。利用这个数据集，我们还开发了一个名为“Muspsy”的模型，该模型能够跟踪客户的进展，并随着时间调整其辅导方向。实验表明，我们的模型在多次会话中的表现优于基准模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Code over Words: Overcoming Semantic Inertia via Code-Grounded Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 代码胜于文字：通过基于代码的推理来克服语义惰性
papers.authors: Manjie Xu, Isabella Yin, Xinyi Tu, Chi Zhang, Yixin Zhu
papers.abstract: LLMs struggle with Semantic Inertia: the inability to inhibit pre-trained priors (e.g., “Lava is Dangerous”) when dynamic, in-context rules contradict them. We probe this phenomenon using , where physical laws are mutable text rules, enabling precise evaluation of models’ ability to override learned priors when rules change. We quantatively observe that larger models can exhibit inverse scaling: they perform worse than smaller models when natural language reasoning requires suppressing pre-trained associations (e.g., accepting “Lava is Safe”). Our analysis attributes this to natural language encoding, which entangles descriptive semantics and logical rules, leading to persistent hallucinations of familiar physics despite explicit contradictory rules. Here we show that representing dynamics as executable code, rather than descriptive text, reverses this trend and enables effective prior inhibition. We introduce LCV, which fine-tunes models on counterfactual pairs and identifies states with contradictory rules, thereby forcing attention to logical constraints rather than visual semantics. This training-time approach outperforms expensive inference-time search methods in both efficiency and accuracy. Our results demonstrate that representation fundamentally determines whether scaling improves or impairs contextual reasoning. This challenges the assumption that larger models are universally better, with implications for domains that require dynamic overriding of learned priors.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在语义惯性问题上存在困难：当动态、上下文相关的规则与预训练的先验知识相矛盾时，模型无法抑制这些先验知识。我们通过将物理定律转化为可修改的文本规则来研究这一现象，从而能够精确评估模型在规则变化时的先验知识抑制能力。我们观察到，较大的模型在需要进行自然语言推理时表现更差，因为它们需要抑制预训练的关联知识（例如，接受“火山是安全的”这一结论）。我们的分析认为，这是由于自然语言编码方式将描述性语义与逻辑规则结合在一起，导致即使存在明确的矛盾规则，模型仍然会持续出现与物理规律不符的幻觉。然而，通过将动态信息表示为可执行代码而非描述性文本，我们可以有效抑制这种干扰。我们还提出了LCV算法，该算法通过针对反事实对来微调模型，并识别出存在矛盾规则的状态，从而让模型更加关注逻辑约束而非视觉语义。这种方法在效率和准确性方面都优于昂贵的推理时间搜索方法。我们的结果表明，表示方式从根本上决定了上下文推理能力的提升或恶化。这挑战了“越大越好的”这一假设，对于需要动态抑制预训练先验知识的领域来说，这一发现具有重要意义。

papers.title: Bypassing Neural Evaluations for Fast Audio Editing via Adaptive Trajectory Extrapolation
papers.title_zh: 通过自适应轨迹预测技术绕过神经评估，以实现快速音频编辑
papers.authors: Xiaoqian Liu, Zhengkun Ge, Jianjin Wang, Haoran Zhang, Yuan Ge, Kaiyan Chang, Chen Xu, Tong Xiao, Zhengtao Yu, Linfeng Zhang, JingBo Zhu
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in audio diffusion models have significantly improved text-to-audio editing via inversion techniques. However, these models typically rely on dense, fixed-step sampling trajectories to maintain structural integrity during inversion and generation, leading to prohibitive computational costs. We propose AdaTE, a model-agnostic Adaptive Trajectory Extrapolation framework that accelerates the inversion-based editing process by dynamically evaluating only the most critical generative phases. Specifically, we introduce a hierarchical probing mechanism that monitors curvature acceleration and information gain to detect pivotal transitions within the latent flow. This allows the model to selectively skip redundant segments via linear extrapolation while preserving dense neural evaluations for complex semantic changes. Extensive experiments across AudioLDM2, Auffusion, and Tango2 demonstrate that AdaTE achieves up to a 3.9\times speedup with negligible loss in fidelity. AdaTE significantly shifts the Pareto frontier, providing an efficient solution for high-fidelity audio synthesis and editing.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，音频扩散模型的进步显著提升了通过反演技术进行文本转语音编辑的效率。然而，这些模型通常依赖于密集且固定步长的采样轨迹，以在反演和生成过程中保持结构的完整性，这导致了过高的计算成本。我们提出了AdaTE这一与模型无关的自适应轨迹外推框架，该框架通过仅动态评估最关键的生成阶段，从而加速基于反演的编辑过程。具体来说，我们引入了一种分层探测机制，该机制能够监测曲率加速度和信息增益，从而发现潜在流程中的关键转换点。这使得模型能够选择性地跳过冗余段落，同时通过线性外推保留对复杂语义变化的密集神经评估。在AudioLDM2、Auffusion和Tango2上的广泛实验表明，AdaTE的加速效果高达3.9倍，同时几乎不会降低音质。AdaTE显著改变了帕累托前沿，为高保真度音频合成和编辑提供了高效的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Agent-GWO: Collaborative Agents for Dynamic Prompt Optimization in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: Agent-GWO：用于大型语言模型动态提示优化的协作智能体
papers.authors: Xudong Wang, Chaoning Zhang, Chenghao Li, Shuxu Chen, Qigan Sun, Jiaquan Zhang, Fachrina Dewi Puspitasari, Tae-Ho Kim, Jiwei Wei, Malu Zhang, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Heng Tao Shen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex reasoning tasks, while recent prompting strategies such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) have further elevated their performance in handling complex logical problems. Despite these advances, high-quality reasoning remains heavily reliant on manual static prompts and is sensitive to decoding configurations and task distributions, leading to performance fluctuations and limited transferability. Existing automatic prompt optimization methods typically adopt single-agent local search, failing to simultaneously optimize prompts and decoding hyperparameters within a unified framework to achieve stable global improvements. To address this limitation, we propose Agent-GWO, a dynamic prompt optimization framework for complex reasoning. Specifically, we unify prompt templates and decoding hyperparameters as inheritable agent configurations. By leveraging the leader-follower mechanism of the Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO), we automatically select three leader agents (\alpha, \beta, and \delta) to guide the collaborative updates of the remaining agents, enabling iterative convergence toward robust optimal reasoning configurations that can be seamlessly integrated for inference. Extensive experiments on multiple mathematical and hybrid reasoning benchmarks across diverse LLM backbones show that Agent-GWO consistently improves accuracy and stability over existing prompt optimization methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂推理任务中展现出了强大的能力，而最近出现的如思维链等提示策略则进一步提升了它们在处理复杂逻辑问题方面的性能。尽管取得了这些进展，但高质量的推理仍然严重依赖于人工编写的静态提示，并且容易受到解码配置和任务分布的影响，导致性能波动以及可迁移性的限制。现有的自动提示优化方法通常采用单一代理的局部搜索方式，无法在一个统一的框架内同时优化提示和解码超参数，从而实现稳定的整体改进。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了Agent-GWO这一用于复杂推理的动态提示优化框架。具体来说，我们将提示模板和解码超参数统一为可继承的代理配置。通过利用灰狼优化器的领导者-追随者机制，我们可以自动选择三个领导者代理（α、β和δ）来指导其余代理的协同更新，从而实现向稳健最优推理配置的迭代收敛，这些配置可以无缝集成到推理过程中。在多种数学和混合推理基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Agent-GWO在准确性和稳定性方面始终优于现有的提示优化方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Structured Confidence–Guided Online Adaptation for LLM-based Multi-Label Classification
papers.title_zh: 结构化置信度引导的在线自适应算法，适用于基于大语言模型的多标签分类任务
papers.authors: Pengyu Xu, JingRen Hou, Liping Jing, Jian Yu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable zero-shot and few-shot multi-label text classification via in-context learning, yet most approaches perform static inference and degrade under streaming test data due to distribution shift and long-tail labels. We study online test-time adaptation for LLM-based multi-label generation without any parameter updates, and identify two bottlenecks: (1) standard generation probabilities provide unreliable confidence because they ignore label competition at key decoding branches; (2) naive confidence-based caching overfits to frequent and easy examples, reducing label coverage and diversity. We propose SCOTTA, a structured confidence-guided online adaptation framework. SCOTTA introduces Label-set Local Likelihood Ratio (L3R), a label-level confidence measure that compares a target label against its valid competitors at critical decision positions. Using L3R as a unified signal, SCOTTA maintains an in-context exemplar cache via streaming submodular maximization, balancing label coverage, semantic diversity, and sample quality under a fixed context budget. Across four benchmarks, SCOTTA consistently improves Micro-F1 and Macro-F1 over strong LLM and non-LLM baselines, with the largest gains on long-tail labels.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够通过上下文学习实现零样本和少样本的多标签文本分类。然而，大多数方法采用静态推理方式，在流式测试数据下会因分布偏移和长尾标签的存在而表现不佳。我们研究了无需任何参数更新的基于语言模型的多标签生成的在线测试时自适应方法，并发现了两个瓶颈问题：(1) 标准的生成概率无法提供可靠的置信度，因为它们忽略了关键解码分支中的标签竞争现象；(2) 简单的基于置信度的缓存机制会过度拟合频繁出现的简单示例，从而降低标签覆盖率和多样性。我们提出了SCOTTA这一结构化的、以置信度为导向的在线自适应框架。SCOTTA引入了标签级置信度度量——标签集局部似然比（L3R），该度量用于比较目标标签与其在关键决策位置的有效竞争者。通过利用L3R作为统一信号，SCOTTA通过流式子模最大化技术维护一个上下文相关的示例缓存，从而在固定的上下文预算下平衡标签覆盖率、语义多样性和样本质量。在四个基准测试中，SCOTTA始终优于强大的语言模型和非语言模型基线，尤其在长尾标签上取得了显著的提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SERM: Self-Evolving Relevance Model with Agent-Driven Learning from Massive Query Streams
papers.title_zh: SERM：基于大规模查询流的自进化相关性模型，包含由代理驱动的学习机制
papers.authors: Chenglong Wang, Canjia Li, Xingzhao Zhu, Yifu Huo, Huiyu Wang, Weixiong Lin, Yun Yang, Qiaozhi He, Tian Hua Zhou, Changxiaojia, JingBo Zhu, Tong Xiao
papers.abstract: Due to the dynamically evolving nature of real-world query streams, relevance models struggle to generalize to practical search scenarios. A sophisticated solution is self-evolution techniques. However, in large-scale industrial settings with massive query streams, this technique faces two challenges: (1) informative samples are often sparse and difficult to identify, and (2) pseudo-labels generated by the current model could be unreliable. To address these challenges, in this work, we propose a Self-Evolving Relevance Model approach (SERM), which comprises two complementary multi-agent modules: a multi-agent sample miner, designed to detect distributional shifts and identify informative training samples, and a multi-agent relevance annotator, which provides reliable labels through a two-level agreement framework. We evaluated SERM on a large-scale industrial platform, which serves billions of user requests daily. Experimental results demonstrate that SERM can achieve significant performance gains through iterative self-evolution, as validated by extensive offline multilingual evaluations and online testing.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于现实世界中的查询流具有动态变化的特点，相关模型在应对实际搜索场景时难以实现泛化。一种先进的解决方案就是自进化技术。然而，在大规模工业环境中，面对庞大的查询流时，这种技术面临着两个挑战：(1) 有信息量的样本往往数量稀少且难以识别；(2) 当前模型生成的伪标签可能不可靠。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种自进化相关模型方法（SERM），该方法由两个互补的多智能体模块组成：一个多智能体样本挖掘器，用于检测分布变化并识别有信息量的训练样本；另一个多智能体相关标注器，通过两级协议框架提供可靠的标签。我们在一个每天处理数十亿用户请求的大规模工业平台上对SERM进行了评估。实验结果表明，通过迭代自进化，SERM能够取得显著的性能提升，这一点通过大量的离线多语言评估和在线测试得到了验证。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CLAG: Adaptive Memory Organization via Agent-Driven Clustering for Small Language Model Agents
papers.title_zh: CLAG：基于代理驱动的聚类算法，为小型语言模型智能体提供自适应记忆组织方案
papers.authors: Taeyun Roh, WonJune Jang, Junha Jung, Jaewoo Kang
papers.abstract: Large language model agents heavily rely on external memory to support knowledge reuse and complex reasoning tasks. Yet most memory systems store experiences in a single global retrieval pool which can gradually dilute or corrupt stored knowledge. This problem is especially pronounced for small language models (SLMs), which are highly vulnerable to irrelevant context. We introduce CLAG, a CLustering-based AGentic memory framework where an agent actively organizes memory. CLAG employs an SLM-agent driven router to assign each new memory to a semantically coherent cluster. By performing continual evolution within the cluster, it effectively reduces cross-topic interference. During the retrieval phase, CLAG targets a small set of relevant clusters for retrieval, thereby excluding distractors and reducing the search space. Experiments on multiple QA datasets with three SLM backbones show that CLAG consistently improves answer quality and robustness over prior memory systems for agents, remaining lightweight and efficient.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理在很大程度上依赖外部记忆来支持知识复用和复杂的推理任务。然而，大多数记忆系统将经验存储在一个单一的全局检索池中，这可能会逐渐稀释或破坏存储的知识。这个问题在小型语言模型上尤为明显，因为它们极易受到无关上下文的影响。我们提出了CLAG这一基于聚类的人工智能记忆框架，该框架允许代理主动组织记忆。CLAG采用由小型语言模型代理驱动的路由机制，将每个新记忆分配到语义上连贯的集群中。通过在该集群内进行持续演化，可以有效地减少跨主题干扰。在检索阶段，CLAG只选择少量相关集群进行检索，从而排除干扰项并缩小搜索范围。在多个QA数据集上的实验表明，CLAG能够持续提升答案的质量和鲁棒性，同时保持良好的轻量级和高效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ClinAlign: Scaling Healthcare Alignment from Clinician Preference
papers.title_zh: ClinAlign：根据医生偏好来调整医疗保健服务的协调方式
papers.authors: Shiwei Lyu, Xidong Wang, Hao Zhu, Lei Liu, Chaohe Zhang, Jian Wang, Jinjie Gu, Benyou Wang, Yue Shen
papers.abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) demonstrate expert-level medical knowledge, aligning their open-ended outputs with fine-grained clinician preferences remains challenging. Existing methods often rely on coarse objectives or unreliable automated judges that are weakly grounded in professional guidelines. We propose a two-stage framework to address this gap. First, we introduce HealthRubrics, a dataset of 7,034 physician-verified preference examples in which clinicians refine LLM-drafted rubrics to meet rigorous medical standards. Second, we distill these rubrics into HealthPrinciples: 119 broadly reusable, clinically grounded principles organized by clinical dimensions, enabling scalable supervision beyond manual annotation. We use HealthPrinciples for (1) offline alignment by synthesizing rubrics for unlabeled queries and (2) an inference-time tool for guided self-revision. A 30A3B model with our framework achieves 33.4% on HealthBench-Hard, outperforming much larger models including Deepseek-R1 and o3, establishing a resource-efficient baseline for clinical alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型展现出了专家级别的医学知识，但将其开放式输出与细粒度的临床偏好进行对齐仍然具有挑战性。现有的方法往往依赖于粗略的目标设定或不可靠的自动化评判器，而这些评判器对专业指南的理解十分有限。我们提出了一种两阶段框架来解决这个问题。首先，我们引入了HealthRubrics数据集，该数据集包含7,034个由医生验证的偏好示例，临床医生通过这些示例来完善语言模型生成的评分标准，以符合严格的医学标准。其次，我们将这些评分标准提炼为HealthPrinciples：共包含119条具有广泛适用性且基于临床实际的原则，这些原则按照临床维度进行分类，从而实现无需人工注释即可进行扩展性的监督训练。我们利用HealthPrinciples来实现以下两个目标：（1）通过合成评分标准来处理未标记查询的问题；（2）作为推理阶段的工具，用于指导自我修订。使用我们的框架的30A3B模型在HealthBench-Hard任务上的表现达到了33.4%，其性能优于包括Deepseek-R1和o3在内的更大规模模型，这为临床对齐提供了一种高效的基础方案。

papers.title: SessionIntentBench: A Multi-task Inter-session Intention-shift Modeling Benchmark for E-commerce Customer Behavior Understanding
papers.title_zh: SessionIntentBench：一种用于理解电子商务用户行为的多任务跨会话意图迁移建模基准测试
papers.authors: Yuqi Yang, Weiqi Wang, Baixuan Xu, Wei Fan, Qing Zong, Chunkit Chan, Zheye Deng, Xin Liu, Yifan Gao, Changlong Yu, Chen Luo, Yang Li, Zheng Li, Qingyu Yin, Bing Yin, Yangqiu Song
papers.abstract: Session history is a common way of recording user interacting behaviors throughout a browsing activity with multiple products. For example, if an user clicks a product webpage and then leaves, it might because there are certain features that don’t satisfy the user, which serve as an important indicator of on-the-spot user preferences. However, all prior works fail to capture and model customer intention effectively because insufficient information exploitation and only apparent information like descriptions and titles are used. There is also a lack of data and corresponding benchmark for explicitly modeling intention in E-commerce product purchase sessions. To address these issues, we introduce the concept of an intention tree and propose a dataset curation pipeline. Together, we construct a sibling multimodal benchmark, SessionIntentBench, that evaluates L(V)LMs’ capability on understanding inter-session intention shift with four subtasks. With 1,952,177 intention entries, 1,132,145 session intention trajectories, and 13,003,664 available tasks mined using 10,905 sessions, we provide a scalable way to exploit the existing session data for customer intention understanding. We conduct human annotations to collect ground-truth label for a subset of collected data to form an evaluation gold set. Extensive experiments on the annotated data further confirm that current L(V)LMs fail to capture and utilize the intention across the complex session setting. Further analysis show injecting intention enhances LLMs’ performances.
papers.abstract_zh: 会话历史是一种记录用户在不同产品上的浏览行为的方式。例如，如果用户点击某个产品页面后离开，可能是因为某些功能不符合用户的期望，这可以作为用户即时偏好的重要指标。然而，现有的研究都未能有效捕捉和建模客户的意图，因为缺乏足够的信息挖掘，只使用了诸如描述和标题这样的表面信息。此外，对于电子商务产品购买会话中意图的明确建模，还缺乏相应的数据和基准测试。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了“意图树”的概念，并提出了一种数据集整理流程。通过这种流程，我们构建了一个多模态的基准测试平台——SessionIntentBench，该平台能够评估LLM在理解会话间意图变化方面的能力，包含四个子任务。我们拥有1,952,177个意图条目、1,132,145条会话意图轨迹，以及通过10,905次会话收集到的13,003,664个可用任务，这为利用现有会话数据来理解客户意图提供了一种可扩展的方法。我们还进行了人工标注，为部分收集的数据收集了真实标签，以形成评估的黄金集。在标注数据上的广泛实验进一步证实，当前的LLM无法捕捉和利用复杂会话环境中的意图。进一步的分析表明，引入意图可以提升LLM的性能。

papers.title: Adapting Where It Matters: Depth-Aware Adaptation for Efficient Multilingual Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
papers.title_zh: 在关键领域进行优化：基于深度学习的自适应算法，以实现对低资源语言的高效多语言语音识别处理
papers.authors: Yang Xiao, Eun-Jung Holden, Ting Dang
papers.abstract: Recent speech foundation models excel at multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) for high-resource languages, but adapting them to low-resource languages remains challenging due to data scarcity and efficiency constraints. Full-model fine-tuning is computationally expensive and prone to overfitting, while parameter-efficient methods like LoRA apply adaptation uniformly across layers, overlooking internal representations thus compromising effectiveness and efficiency. We analyze multilingual ASR models and reveal a U-shaped adaptability pattern: early and late layers are language-specific and require more adaptation, while intermediate layers retain shared semantics and need less. Building on this observation, we propose DAMA, a Depth-Aware Model Adaptation framework that allocates adaptation capacity according to each layer’s role. DAMA also introduces Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)-based initialization to constrain adaptation and preserve the U-shaped pattern, as well as a frozen middle-layer basis for further efficiency. Evaluated on 18 low-resource languages across two benchmark datasets, DAMA matches or surpasses state-of-the-art accuracy with 80% fewer trainable parameters, achieves a 29% error reduction under extreme data scarcity, and significantly improves memory, training time, and computational efficiency over baselines. These results highlight the benefits of structure-aware adaptation for efficient, scalable multilingual ASR.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的语音基础模型在多语言自动语音识别方面表现出色，但对于资源匮乏的语言来说，将其适应到这些语言中仍然具有挑战性，这主要是由于数据稀缺和效率限制造成的。全模型微调在计算上成本很高，且容易出现过拟合问题；而像LoRA这样的参数高效方法则能够均匀地调整各个层，但这种方式忽略了内部表示，从而影响了模型的效率和效果。我们对多语言语音识别模型进行了分析，发现其适应性呈现出U形模式：早期和晚期层与语言相关，需要更多的适应性调整；而中间层则保留了共同的语义特征，因此需要的适应性调整较少。基于这一观察，我们提出了DAMA模型适配框架。该框架根据各层的角色分配适应性调整能力。DAMA还引入了基于奇异值分解的初始化方法，以约束适应性调整过程，同时保留U形模式。此外，它还采用了冻结中间层的基础结构，以提高效率。在18种资源匮乏的语言上进行测试后，DAMA在两种基准数据集上的准确率均达到了甚至超过了最先进技术的水平，同时训练参数的数量减少了80%。在极端数据稀缺的情况下，DAMA的错误率降低了29%。与基线模型相比，DAMA在内存使用、训练时间和计算效率方面都有显著提升。这些结果充分证明了注重结构的适应性调整对于实现高效、可扩展的多语言语音识别具有重要意义。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Targeted Exploration via Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过统一熵控制进行有针对性的探索，以应用于强化学习
papers.authors: Chen Wang, Lai Wei, Yanzhi Zhang, Chenyang Shao, Zedong Dan, Weiran Huang, Ge Lan, Yue Wang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, the widely used Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) consistently suffers from entropy collapse, causing the policy to converge prematurely and lose diversity. Existing exploration methods introduce additional bias or variance during exploration, making it difficult to maintain optimization stability. We propose Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning (UEC-RL), a framework that provides targeted mechanisms for exploration and stabilization. UEC-RL activates more exploration on difficult prompts to search for potential and valuable reasoning trajectories. In parallel, a stabilizer prevents entropy from growing uncontrollably, thereby keeping training stable as the model consolidates reliable behaviors. Together, these components expand the search space when needed while maintaining robust optimization throughout training. Experiments on both LLM and VLM reasoning tasks show consistent gains over RL baselines on both Pass@1 and Pass@k. On Geometry3K, UEC-RL achieves a 37.9% relative improvement over GRPO, indicating that it sustains effective exploration without compromising convergence and underscoring UEC-RL as a key for scaling RL-based reasoning in large models. Our code is available at https://github.com/597358816/UEC-RL.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在强化学习领域取得的进展显著提升了大语言模型与视觉语言模型的推理能力。然而，广泛使用的群体相对策略优化方法常常出现熵崩溃问题，导致策略过早收敛并失去多样性。现有的探索方法在探索过程中会引入额外的偏差或方差，这使得优化稳定性难以维持。我们提出了一种名为“强化学习统一熵控制”的框架，该框架提供了针对探索与稳定的机制。在困难提示下，UEC-RL会激活更多的探索行为，以寻找潜在且有价值的推理路径。同时，该框架还具备防止熵无限制增长的稳定机制，从而在模型巩固可靠行为时保持训练的稳定性。这些组件共同在需要时扩展搜索空间，同时在训练过程中保持优化的稳健性。在大语言模型和视觉语言模型的推理任务上的实验表明，UEC-RL在Pass@1和Pass@k指标上均优于其他强化学习基线方法。在Geometry3K数据集上，UEC-RL相对于GRPO实现了37.9%的相对性能提升，这表明它在不影响收敛速度的情况下仍能有效进行探索，进一步证明了UEC-RL是大规模模型中基于强化学习的推理能力扩展的关键技术。我们的代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/597358816/UEC-RL。

papers.title: Remember Me, Refine Me: A Dynamic Procedural Memory Framework for Experience-Driven Agent Evolution
papers.title_zh: 记住我，优化我：一种基于经验驱动的智能体进化动态程序化记忆框架
papers.authors: Zouying Cao, Jiaji Deng, Li Yu, Weikang Zhou, Zhaoyang Liu, Bolin Ding, Hai Zhao
papers.abstract: Procedural memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to internalize ”how-to” knowledge and thus reduce redundant trial-and-error. However, existing frameworks predominantly suffer from a ”passive accumulation” paradigm, treating memory as a static append-only archive. To bridge the gap between static storage and dynamic reasoning, we propose ReMe (Remember Me, Refine Me), a comprehensive framework for experience-driven agent evolution. ReMe manages the memory lifecycle via three mechanisms: 1) multi-faceted distillation, which extracts fine-grained experiences by recognizing success patterns, analyzing failure triggers and generating comparative insights; 2) context-adaptive reuse, which tailors historical insights to new contexts through scenario-aware indexing; and 3) utility-based refinement, which automatically adds validated memories and prunes outdated ones to maintain a compact, high-quality experience pool. Experiments on BFCL-V3 and AppWorld demonstrate that ReMe establishes a new state-of-the-art in agent memory system. Crucially, we observe a significant memory-scaling effect: Qwen3-8B equipped with ReMe outperforms larger, memoryless Qwen3-14B, indicating that self-evolving memory provides a computation-efficient path for lifelong learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 程序性记忆使得大语言模型代理能够内化“如何做”的知识，从而减少不必要的试错过程。然而，现有的框架大多采用“被动积累”的模式，将记忆视为一个静态的、仅能添加信息的存储库。为了弥合静态存储与动态推理之间的差距，我们提出了ReMe框架——一个基于经验驱动的代理进化的综合框架。ReMe通过三种机制来管理记忆的生命周期：1）多维度蒸馏，通过识别成功模式、分析失败诱因以及生成对比性洞察来提取细粒度的经验；2）上下文自适应重用，通过场景感知的索引机制将历史经验适应于新的上下文环境；3）基于效用的精炼，自动添加经过验证的记忆内容，并剔除过时的记忆，以保持一个紧凑且高质量的经验库。在BFCL-V3和AppWorld上的实验表明，ReMe在代理记忆系统方面取得了新的突破。重要的是，我们观察到显著的记忆扩展效果：配备ReMe的Qwen3-8B在性能上优于那些没有记忆机制的Qwen3-14B，这表明自进化记忆为终身学习提供了高效的计算路径。

papers.title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 知道何时放弃：诊断并训练大型语言模型以终止无意义的推理过程
papers.authors: Xinyan Guan, Jiali Zeng, Chunlei Xin, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Xianpei Han, Le Sun, Fandong Meng
papers.abstract: Large language models generate computationally expensive yet semantically void reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, creating safety risks where plausible-sounding but incorrect derivations mislead users. We characterize this futile reasoning phenomenon through systematic analysis, revealing universal capability overreach and systematic miscalibration towards over-confidence. The dominant failure mode is specious reasoning, superficially valid outputs with subtle hallucinations, which escalates with task difficulty. We demonstrate that prompt engineering proves insufficient to calibrate refusal behavior. To address this, we introduce CaRL (Capability-aligned Reinforcement Learning), which aligns model behavior with capability boundaries through reward shaping that incentivizes refusal over hallucination and hindsight augmentation that converts failures into refusal supervision. Experiments demonstrate a substantial reduction in futile reasoning while preserving performance across task difficulties, effectively achieving capability-aligned behavior without sacrificing utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在超出其处理能力的情况下，会生成计算成本高昂但语义上空洞的推理结果，这会带来安全风险。那些看似合理但实际上错误的推导结果可能会误导用户。我们通过系统分析揭示了这种无效的推理现象，发现模型存在普遍的过度能力表现以及系统性误校准问题，导致过度自信的情况发生。主要的失败模式是虚假推理——即表面上有效的输出却包含细微的幻觉。随着任务难度的增加，这种情况会更加严重。我们证明，仅仅通过提示工程来校准拒绝行为是不够的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了CaRL（能力与对齐的强化学习）方法。该方法通过将奖励机制与模型的行为进行对齐，从而激励模型表现出拒绝行为而非产生幻觉；同时，通过事后增强技术，将失败转化为拒绝行为的监督信号。实验表明，这种方法能够显著减少无效推理的发生，同时还能在不同任务难度下保持性能水平，有效地实现了能力与对齐的行为模式，而无需牺牲实用性。

papers.title: AutoL2S: Auto Long-Short Reasoning for Efficient Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: AutoL2S：自动长短时记忆推理技术，助力高效的大型语言模型运行
papers.authors: Feng Luo, Yu-Neng Chuang, Guanchu Wang, Hoang Anh Duy Le, Shaochen Zhong, Hongyi Liu, Jiayi Yuan, Yang Sui, Vladimir Braverman, Vipin Chaudhary, Xia Hu
papers.abstract: Reasoning-capable large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks but often exhibit overthinking after distillation, generating unnecessarily long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning even for simple inputs and incurring high inference cost. However, naively shortening reasoning length can degrade reasoning accuracy, as concise reasoning may be insufficient for certain inputs and lacks explicit supervision. We propose Auto Long-Short Reasoning (AutoL2S), a distillation framework that empowers non-reasoning LLMs to think thoroughly but only when necessary. AutoL2S first learns a lightweight switching token with verified long-short CoTs to enable instance-wise long-short reasoning selection. Then it leverages long-short reasoning rollouts induced by switching tokens within a GRPO-style loss to improve reasoning efficiency while maintaining accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that AutoL2S effectively reduces reasoning length up to 71% with minimal accuracy loss, yielding markedly better trade-off in token length and inference time while preserving accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/amandaluof/AutoL2S.
papers.abstract_zh: 具备推理能力的大语言模型在复杂任务上表现优异，但在蒸馏处理后往往会过度思考，即使对于简单的输入也会产生不必要的长思维链推理，从而导致较高的推理成本。然而，简单地缩短推理长度可能会降低推理准确性，因为简洁的推理可能不足以应对某些输入情况，且缺乏明确的监督机制。我们提出了Auto Long-Short Reasoning（AutoL2S）这一蒸馏框架，该框架使非推理型语言模型能够在必要时进行充分思考。AutoL2S首先学习一个带有验证过的长短思维链结构的轻量级切换令牌，以实现实例级的长短推理选择。然后，它利用切换令牌在GRPO风格损失中产生的长短推理展开，以提高推理效率同时保持准确性。实验表明，AutoL2S能够有效减少推理长度，最多可减少71%，同时几乎不会影响准确性，从而在令牌长度和推理时间之间实现了更好的权衡。代码可在https://github.com/amandaluof/AutoL2S获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Doc-PP: Document Policy Preservation Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: Doc-PP：适用于大型视觉语言模型的文档政策保存基准
papers.authors: Haeun Jang, Hwan Chang, Hwanhee Lee
papers.abstract: The deployment of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) for real-world document question answering is often constrained by dynamic, user-defined policies that dictate information disclosure based on context. While ensuring adherence to these explicit constraints is critical, existing safety research primarily focuses on implicit social norms or text-only settings, overlooking the complexities of multimodal documents. In this paper, we introduce Doc-PP (Document Policy Preservation Benchmark), a novel benchmark constructed from real-world reports requiring reasoning across heterogeneous visual and textual elements under strict non-disclosure policies. Our evaluation highlights a systemic Reasoning-Induced Safety Gap: models frequently leak sensitive information when answers must be inferred through complex synthesis or aggregated across modalities, effectively circumventing existing safety constraints. Furthermore, we identify that providing extracted text improves perception but inadvertently facilitates leakage. To address these vulnerabilities, we propose DVA (Decompose–Verify–Aggregation), a structural inference framework that decouples reasoning from policy verification. Experimental results demonstrate that DVA significantly outperforms standard prompting defenses, offering a robust baseline for policy-compliant document understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中的文档问答任务中，大型视觉-语言模型的部署往往受到动态、由用户定义的策略的限制，这些策略根据上下文来决定信息的公开程度。虽然确保遵守这些明确的限制至关重要，但现有的安全研究主要关注的是隐性的社会规范或仅包含文本的环境，而忽视了多模态文档的复杂性。在本文中，我们提出了Doc-PP（文档政策保护基准）这一新的基准测试，该测试基于真实世界的报告构建，要求在对异构视觉和文本元素进行推理的同时，严格遵守保密政策。我们的评估结果显示了一个系统性的“推理引发的安全漏洞”：当需要通过复杂的综合或跨模态聚合来得出答案时，模型经常会泄露敏感信息，从而有效地规避了现有的安全限制。此外，我们发现提供提取出的文本确实可以提高安全性，但却无意中促进了信息的泄露。为了应对这些漏洞，我们提出了DVA（分解-验证-聚合）这一结构化的推理框架，它将推理与政策验证分离开来。实验结果表明，DVA显著优于标准的提示防御机制，为符合政策的文档理解提供了可靠的基准。

papers.title: RIPRAG: Hack a Black-box Retrieval-Augmented Generation Question-Answering System with Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: RIPRAG：利用强化学习技术改造一种基于黑盒检索的问答系统
papers.authors: Meng Xi, Sihan Lv, Yechen Jin, Guanjie Cheng, Naibo Wang, Ying Li, Jianwei Yin
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a core technology for tasks such as question-answering (QA) and content generation. RAG poisoning is an attack method to induce LLMs to generate the attacker’s expected text by injecting poisoned documents into the database of RAG systems. Existing research can be broadly divided into two classes: white-box methods and black-box methods. White-box methods utilize gradient information to optimize poisoned documents, and black-box methods use a pre-trained LLM to generate them. However, existing white-box methods require knowledge of the RAG system’s internal composition and implementation details, whereas black-box methods are unable to utilize interactive information. In this work, we propose the RIPRAG attack framework, an end-to-end attack pipeline that treats the target RAG system as a black box and leverages our proposed Reinforcement Learning from Black-box Feedback (RLBF) method to optimize the generation model for poisoned documents. We designed two kinds of rewards: similarity reward and attack reward. Experimental results demonstrate that this method can effectively execute poisoning attacks against most complex RAG systems, achieving an attack success rate (ASR) improvement of up to 0.72 compared to baseline methods. This highlights prevalent deficiencies in current defensive methods and provides critical insights for LLM security research.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型检索增强生成（RAG）系统已成为问答处理和内容生成等任务的核心技术。RAG中毒是一种攻击方式，通过向RAG系统的数据库中注入被污染的文档，诱导大语言模型生成攻击者期望的文本。现有的研究大致可以分为两类：白盒方法和黑盒方法。白盒方法利用梯度信息来优化被污染的文档，而黑盒方法则使用预训练的大语言模型来生成这些文档。然而，现有的白盒方法需要了解RAG系统的内部结构和实现细节，而黑盒方法则无法利用交互式信息。在这项研究中，我们提出了RIPRAG攻击框架，这是一种端到端的攻击流程，它将目标RAG系统视为一个黑盒，并利用我们提出的从黑盒反馈中进行强化学习的方法来优化被污染文档的生成模型。我们设计了两种奖励机制：相似度奖励和攻击奖励。实验结果表明，该方法能够有效执行针对大多数复杂RAG系统的中毒攻击，与基准方法相比，攻击成功率提高了0.72。这揭示了当前防御方法的普遍缺陷，并为大语言模型安全研究提供了重要启示。

papers.title: CodeMEM: AST-Guided Adaptive Memory for Repository-Level Iterative Code Generation
papers.title_zh: CodeMEM：基于抽象语义的自适应内存管理技术，用于仓库级迭代代码生成
papers.authors: Peiding Wang, Li Zhang, Fang Liu, Chongyang Tao, Yinghao Zhu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) substantially enhance developer productivity in repository-level code generation through interactive collaboration. However, as interactions progress, repository context must be continuously preserved and updated to integrate newly validated information. Meanwhile, the expanding session history increases cognitive burden, often leading to forgetting and the reintroduction of previously resolved errors. Existing memory management approaches show promise but remain limited by natural language-centric representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose CodeMEM, an AST-guided dynamic memory management system tailored for repository-level iterative code generation. Specifically, CodeMEM introduces the Code Context Memory component that dynamically maintains and updates repository context through AST-guided LLM operations, along with the Code Session Memory that constructs a code-centric representation of interaction history and explicitly detects and mitigates forgetting through AST-based analysis. Experimental results on the instruction-following benchmark CodeIF-Bench and the code generation benchmark CoderEval demonstrate that CodeMEM achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving instruction following by 12.2% for the current turn and 11.5% for the session level, and reducing interaction rounds by 2–3, while maintaining competitive inference latency and token efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过交互式协作显著提升了开发者在代码生成方面的生产力。然而，随着交互的进行，必须持续保存和更新仓库中的上下文信息，以便整合新验证过的数据。与此同时，不断扩展的会话历史记录会增加认知负担，常常导致错误被遗忘或重新出现。现有的内存管理方法虽然有一定成效，但仍然存在以自然语言为中心的表示方式的局限性。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了CodeMEM——一种基于抽象语法树引导的动态内存管理系统，专门用于仓库级别的迭代代码生成。具体来说，CodeMEM引入了代码上下文记忆组件，该组件通过基于抽象语法树的语言模型操作来动态维护和更新仓库上下文；同时，它还包含了代码会话记忆功能，能够构建以代码为中心的互动历史记录，并通过基于抽象语法树的分析来主动检测和缓解遗忘问题。在指令遵循基准测试CodeIF-Bench和代码生成基准测试CoderEval上的实验结果表明，CodeMEM取得了领先的性能表现：当前回合的指令遵循能力提高了12.2%，整个会话级别的指令遵循能力提高了11.5%；同时，交互轮数减少了2-3轮，同时保持了具有竞争力的推理延迟和token效率。

papers.title: HalluGuard: Evidence-Grounded Small Reasoning Models to Mitigate Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: HalluGuard：基于证据的小型推理模型，用于减轻在检索增强生成过程中出现的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Loris Bergeron, Ioana Buhnila, Jerome Francois, Radu State
papers.abstract: Large Language Models excel at NLP tasks but remain prone to hallucinations, limiting trust in real-world applications. We present HalluGuard, a 4B-parameter Small Reasoning Model (SRM) designed as a guardrail for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, which classify document-claim pairs as grounded or hallucinated in closed-book, document-grounded settings and produces evidence-grounded justifications. Our approach combines (i) a domain-agnostic synthetic dataset derived from FineWeb and refined through multi-stage curation and data reformation, (ii) synthetic grounded and hallucinated claims, and (iii) preference-based fine-tuning with Odds Ratio Preference Optimization (ORPO) to distill large-model reasoning into a smaller backbone. On the RAGTruth subset of the LLM-AggreFact benchmark, HalluGuard achieves 84.4% balanced accuracy (BAcc), surpassing specialized models, MiniCheck (7B; 84.0%) and Granite Guardian 3.3 (8B; 82.2%) while using roughly half their parameters. Across the benchmark, it reaches 77.1% BAcc, surpassing larger general-purpose LLMs such as GPT-4o (75.9%). HalluGuard and datasets will be released upon acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自然语言处理任务上表现出色，但仍然存在产生幻觉的问题，这限制了其在现实应用中的可靠性。我们提出了HalluGuard——一个拥有40亿参数的小型推理模型，旨在作为检索增强生成流程的保障机制。该模型能够在闭卷、文档驱动的情境下，将文档中的主张进行分类，判断它们是真实的还是幻觉产生的，并给出基于证据的理由。我们的方法结合了以下几点：(i) 来自FineWeb的、经过多阶段筛选和数据重构处理的领域无关合成数据集；(ii) 真实与幻觉生成的声明；(iii) 基于偏好调整的微调技术，结合 odds ratio preference optimization（ORPO）算法，将大型模型的推理能力转化为更简洁的框架。在LLM-AggreFact基准测试中的RAGTruth子集中，HalluGuard达到了84.4%的平衡准确率，超过了专门的模型如MiniCheck（70亿参数；84.0%）和Granite Guardian 3.3（80亿参数；82.2%），而其参数数量则大约只有这些模型的二分之一。在整个基准测试中，HalluGuard的BAcc达到了77.1%，超过了更大的通用大语言模型如GPT-4o（75.9%）。一旦项目获得批准，HalluGuard及其相关数据集将会被公开发布。

papers.title: Capabilities and Evaluation Biases of Large Language Models in Classical Chinese Poetry Generation: A Case Study on Tang Poetry
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型在创作古典汉语诗歌方面的能力及评估偏差：以唐诗为例的研究
papers.authors: Bolei Ma, Yina Yao, Anna-Carolina Haensch
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to creative domains, yet their performance in classical Chinese poetry generation and evaluation remains poorly understood. We propose a three-step evaluation framework that combines computational metrics, LLM-as-a-judge assessment, and human expert validation. Using this framework, we evaluate six state-of-the-art LLMs across multiple dimensions of poetic quality, including themes, emotions, imagery, form, and style, in the context of Tang poetry (唐诗) generation. Our analysis reveals a critical “echo chamber” effect: LLMs systematically overrate machine-generated poems that mimic statistical patterns yet fail strict prosodic rules, diverging significantly from human expert judgments. These findings underscore the limitations of using LLMs as standalone evaluators for culturally complex tasks, highlighting the necessity of hybrid human-model validation frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在创意领域得到了广泛应用，但其在生成和评估古典中国诗歌方面的表现仍不甚明了。我们提出了一种三步评估框架，该框架结合了计算指标、以语言模型为评估手段的评估方式以及人类专家的验证。利用这一框架，我们对六种最先进的语言模型在诗歌质量多个维度上的表现进行了评估，包括主题、情感、意象、形式和风格等方面。我们的分析发现了一个关键的“回音室效应”：语言模型系统性地高估了那些模仿统计模式但未能严格遵守韵律规则的机器生成的诗歌，这与人类专家的评判结果存在显著差异。这些发现凸显了将语言模型单独用作评估文化复杂任务的局限性，从而强调了采用混合式人类模型验证框架的必要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SWE-QA-Pro: A Representative Benchmark and Scalable Training Recipe for Repository-Level Code Understanding
papers.title_zh: SWE-QA-Pro：一个具有代表性的基准测试，适用于提升代码理解能力的可扩展训练方案
papers.authors: Songcheng Cai, Zhiheng Lyu, Yuansheng Ni, Xiangchao Chen, Baichuan Zhou, Shenzhe Zhu, Yi Lu, Haozhe Wang, Chi Ruan, Benjamin Schneider, Weixu Zhang, Xiang Li, Andy Zheng, Yuyu Zhang, Ping Nie, Wenhu Chen
papers.abstract: Agentic repository-level code understanding is essential for automating complex software engineering tasks, yet the field lacks reliable benchmarks. Existing evaluations often overlook the long tail topics and rely on popular repositories where Large Language Models (LLMs) can cheat via memorized knowledge. To address this, we introduce SWE-QA-Pro, a benchmark constructed from diverse, long-tail repositories with executable environments. We enforce topical balance via issue-driven clustering to cover under-represented task types and apply a rigorous difficulty calibration process: questions solvable by direct-answer baselines are filtered out. This results in a dataset where agentic workflows significantly outperform direct answering (e.g., a ~13-point gap for Claude Sonnet 4.5), confirming the necessity of agentic codebase exploration. Furthermore, to tackle the scarcity of training data for such complex behaviors, we propose a scalable synthetic data pipeline that powers a two-stage training recipe: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF). This approach allows small open models to learn efficient tool usage and reasoning. Empirically, a Qwen3-8B model trained with our recipe surpasses GPT-4o by 2.3 points on SWE-QA-Pro and substantially narrows the gap to state-of-the-art proprietary models, demonstrating both the validity of our evaluation and the effectiveness of our agentic training workflow.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于自动化复杂的软件工程任务来说，对代码库层面的agent化理解至关重要。然而，目前该领域缺乏可靠的评估基准。现有的评估往往忽略了那些长尾主题，并且依赖于一些热门的代码库，而大语言模型可以通过记忆知识来作弊。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了SWE-QA-Pro这一评估基准，该基准基于多种长尾代码库构建，并包含可执行的环境。我们通过以问题驱动的聚类方式来确保主题的均衡性，以覆盖那些被忽视的任务类型；同时，我们采用了严格的难度校准机制：那些可以通过直接回答来解决的题目会被过滤掉。这样得到的数据集表明，使用agent化工作流程的方法在性能上明显优于直接回答的方式（例如，Claude Sonnet 4.5在SWE-QA-Pro上的表现相差约13分），这进一步证实了探索agent化代码库的必要性。此外，为了解决这类复杂行为的训练数据稀缺问题，我们提出了一种可扩展的合成数据管道，该管道支持两阶段训练流程：先进行有监督的微调，然后再进行基于AI反馈的强化学习。这种方法使得小型开放模型能够学会高效使用工具和进行推理。从经验来看，使用我们的训练方法训练的Qwen3-8B模型在SWE-QA-Pro上的表现比GPT-4o高出2.3分，并且大大缩小了与最先进的专有模型的差距，这既证明了我们评估方法的有效性，也证明了我们的agent化训练流程的实用性。

papers.title: Do MLLMs Understand Pointing? Benchmarking and Enhancing Referential Reasoning in Egocentric Vision
papers.title_zh: 这些多智能体学习模型能理解指向操作吗？在自我中心视觉领域对引用推理能力进行评估与提升
papers.authors: Chentao Li, Zirui Gao, Mingze Gao, Yinglian Ren, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou
papers.abstract: Egocentric AI agents, such as smart glasses, rely on pointing gestures to resolve referential ambiguities in natural language commands. However, despite advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), current systems often fail to precisely ground the spatial semantics of pointing. Instead, they rely on spurious correlations with visual proximity or object saliency—a phenomenon we term “Referential Hallucination.” To address this gap, we introduce EgoPoint-Bench, a comprehensive question-answering benchmark designed to evaluate and enhance multimodal pointing reasoning in egocentric views. Comprising over 11k high-fidelity simulated and real-world samples, the benchmark spans five evaluation dimensions and three levels of referential complexity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source models struggle with egocentric pointing, models fine-tuned on our synthetic data achieve significant performance gains and robust Sim-to-Real generalization. This work highlights the importance of spatially-aware supervision and offers a scalable path toward precise egocentric AI assistants. The project website is available at https://guyyyug.github.io/EgoPoint-Bench/.
papers.abstract_zh: 以自我为中心的AI代理，比如智能眼镜，依赖指向手势来解决自然语言命令中的指代歧义问题。然而，尽管多模态大语言模型取得了进展，目前的系统往往无法准确处理指向行为的空间语义问题。相反，它们依赖于与视觉距离或物体显著性之间的虚假关联——我们将其称为“指代幻觉”。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了EgoPoint-Bench，这是一个全面的问答基准测试，旨在评估和提高以自我为中心视角下的多模态指向推理能力。该基准测试包含超过11k个高保真度的模拟样本和真实世界样本，涵盖了五个评估维度以及三个不同的指代复杂度层次。大量实验表明，虽然最先进的专有和开源模型在处理以自我为中心的指向行为时存在困难，但在我们提供的合成数据上训练的模型却取得了显著的性能提升，并且具有强大的从模拟环境到现实环境的泛化能力。这项工作强调了空间感知式监督的重要性，并为实现精确以自我为中心的AI助手提供了可扩展的路径。该项目的网站地址为https://guyyyug.github.io/EgoPoint-Bench/。

papers.title: Can Post-Training Transform LLMs into Causal Reasoners?
papers.title_zh: 训练后的处理能否将大语言模型转化为因果推理器呢？
papers.authors: Junqi Chen, Sirui Chen, Chaochao Lu
papers.abstract: Causal inference is essential for decision-making but remains challenging for non-experts. While large language models (LLMs) show promise in this domain, their precise causal estimation capabilities are still limited, and the impact of post-training on these abilities is insufficiently explored. This paper examines the extent to which post-training can enhance LLMs’ capacity for causal inference. We introduce CausalGym, a comprehensive dataset comprising seven core causal tasks for training and five diverse test sets. Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate five post-training approaches: SFT, DPO, KTO, PPO, and GRPO. Across five in-domain and four existing benchmarks, our experiments demonstrate that appropriate post-training enables smaller LLMs to perform causal inference competitively, often surpassing much larger models. Our 14B-parameter model achieves 93.5% accuracy on the CaLM benchmark, compared to 55.4% by OpenAI o3. Furthermore, the post-trained LLMs exhibit strong generalization and robustness under real-world conditions such as distribution shifts and noisy data. Collectively, these findings provide the first systematic evidence that targeted post-training can produce reliable and robust LLM-based causal reasoners.
papers.abstract_zh: 因果推断对于决策制定至关重要，但对于非专家来说仍然具有挑战性。虽然大语言模型在这一领域展现出巨大潜力，但它们的精确因果推理能力仍然有限，而且训练后对这些能力的影响尚未得到充分研究。本文探讨了训练后能否提升大语言模型的因果推理能力。我们引入了CausalGym数据集，该数据集包含七个核心的因果任务以及五个不同的测试集。利用这个数据集，我们对五种后训练方法进行了系统评估：SFT、DPO、KTO、PPO和GRPO。在五个领域内的基准测试和四个现有基准测试中，我们的实验表明，适当的后训练可以使较小的语言模型也能进行可靠的因果推理，甚至在某些情况下超越那些规模更大的模型。我们的14B参数模型在CaLM基准测试中的准确率为93.5%，而OpenAI的o3模型的准确率仅为55.4%。此外，经过训练后的语言模型在现实世界条件下表现出强大的泛化能力和鲁棒性，例如面对数据分布变化和噪声数据的情况。总的来说，这些发现首次提供了系统性的证据，证明有针对性的后训练能够产生可靠且强大的基于语言模型的因果推理系统。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MoE Adapter for Large Audio Language Models: Sparsity, Disentanglement, and Gradient-Conflict-Free
papers.title_zh: 适用于大型音频语言模型的MoE适配器：稀疏性、解耦机制以及避免梯度冲突的技术
papers.authors: Yishu Lei, Shuwei He, Hu Jing, Dan Zhang, Xianlong Luo, Danxiang Zhu, Shikun Feng, Rui Liu, Jingzhou HE, Yu Sun, Hua Wu, Haifeng Wang
papers.abstract: Extending the input modality of Large Language Models (LLMs) to the audio domain is essential for achieving comprehensive multimodal perception. However, it is well-known that acoustic information is intrinsically heterogeneous, entangling attributes such as speech, music, and environmental context. Existing research is limited to a dense, parameter-shared adapter to model these diverse patterns, which induces gradient conflict during optimization, as parameter updates required for distinct attributes contradict each other. To address this limitation, we introduce the MoE-Adapter, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture designed to decouple acoustic information. Specifically, it employs a dynamic gating mechanism that routes audio tokens to specialized experts capturing complementary feature subspaces while retaining shared experts for global context, thereby mitigating gradient conflicts and enabling fine-grained feature learning. Comprehensive experiments show that the MoE-Adapter achieves superior performance on both audio semantic and paralinguistic tasks, consistently outperforming dense linear baselines with comparable computational costs. To facilitate future research, our code are publicly available at https://github.com/Alittleegg/Eureka-Audio.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型的输入模式扩展到音频领域，对于实现全面的多模态感知至关重要。然而，众所周知，声学信息本质上是异质的，它融合了语音、音乐以及环境背景等多种属性。现有的研究仅限于使用一种参数共享的适配器来模拟这些多样化的模式，但这会导致优化过程中的梯度冲突，因为不同属性所需的参数更新相互矛盾。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了MoE-Adapter架构——一种稀疏的混合专家架构，旨在分离声学信息。具体来说，它采用了一种动态门控机制，将音频信号路由到能够捕捉互补特征空间的专门专家，同时保留用于全局背景的共享专家，从而缓解梯度冲突，并实现细粒度的特征学习。全面的实验表明，MoE-Adapter在音频语义和副语言任务上表现优异，其性能始终优于计算成本相当但结构较为简单的线性模型。为了促进未来的研究，我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/Alittleegg/Eureka-Audio上可供下载。
