papers.title: QaRL: Rollout-Aligned Quantization-Aware RL for Fast and Stable Training under Training–Inference Mismatch
papers.title_zh: QaRL：与部署过程相一致的量化感知强化学习算法，能够实现在训练与推理不一致的情况下，依然进行快速且稳定的训练
papers.authors: Hao Gu, Hao Wang, Jiacheng Liu, Lujun Li, Qiyuan Zhu, Bei Liu, Binxing Xu, Lei Wang, Xintong Yang, Sida Lin, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines are often bottlenecked by rollout generation, making end-to-end training slow. Recent work mitigates this by running rollouts with quantization to accelerate decoding, which is the most expensive stage of the RL loop. However, these setups destabilize optimization by amplifying the training–-inference gap: rollouts are operated at low precision, while learning updates are computed at full precision. To address this challenge, we propose QaRL (Rollout Alignment Quantization-Aware RL), which aligns training-side forward with the quantized rollout to minimize mismatch. We further identify a failure mode in quantized rollouts: long-form responses tend to produce repetitive, garbled tokens (error tokens). To mitigate these problems, we introduce TBPO (Trust-Band Policy Optimization), a sequence-level objective with dual clipping for negative samples, aimed to keep updates within the trust region. On Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE for math problems, QaRL outperforms quantized-rollout training by +5.5 while improving stability and preserving low-bit throughput benefits.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）强化学习（RL）的训练流程常常受到“展开生成”阶段的瓶颈限制，导致端到端训练过程变得缓慢。最近的研究通过采用量化技术来加速展开阶段的推理过程，从而缓解了这一问题。然而，这种处理方式会加剧训练与推理之间的差距：展开阶段以较低的精度进行运算，而学习更新则需要在完整的精度下进行计算。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了QaRL（基于量化对齐的RL），它将训练阶段的计算结果与量化的展开结果进行对齐，以最小化差异。此外，我们还发现了量化展开中的一个缺陷：长格式响应往往会产生重复且混乱的标记（错误标记）。为了缓解这些问题，我们引入了TBPO（信任带策略优化），这是一种序列级目标优化方法，能够对负样本实施双重裁剪，从而确保更新结果始终处于信任区间内。在Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE模型上用于数学问题的测试中，QaRL在性能上优于基于量化展开的训练方式，其性能提升了5.5倍，同时还保持了低比特率下的高效处理能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Static Rules: Automated Discovery of Latent Vulnerabilities in Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: 超越静态规则：自动发现文本到SQL转换中的隐藏漏洞
papers.authors: Hanqing Wang, Yongdong Chi, Jian Yang, Lei Yang, Jiehui Zhao, Yun Chen, Guanhua Chen
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in Text-to-SQL tasks, their deployment in real-world environments is hindered by latent reliability issues. Identifying these latent weaknesses is critical for building trustworthy database interfaces, yet current diagnostic approaches rely heavily on static, expert-defined rules, which lack the capability for systematic and automated exploration. To bridge this gap, we propose SAGE (Systematic Automated Guided Exploration), a novel framework designed to autonomously uncover latent failure patterns in LLM-based Text-to-SQL generation. Specifically, SAGE generates vulnerability hypotheses for given samples and references a continuously evolving Vulnerability Codex to design targeted perturbations, thereby iteratively verifying and documenting potential defects. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art open-source LLMs demonstrate that SAGE uncovers a substantial number of failure cases, highlighting the significant fragility of current models. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that the Vulnerability Codex exhibits strong cross-model transferability, indicating that the discovered patterns represent generalized structural weaknesses. Finally, we explore SAGE’s potential for remediation. Furthermore, a preliminary attempt at lightweight fine-tuning on the generated samples yields promising improvements, suggesting a scalable pathway for closing the reliability loop in future work.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在文本转SQL任务上取得了显著的成功，但其在现实环境中的部署却受到潜在可靠性问题的阻碍。识别这些潜在的弱点对于构建可靠的数据库接口至关重要，然而当前的诊断方法主要依赖于静态的、由专家定义的规则，这些规则缺乏系统化和自动化的探索能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了SAGE（系统性自动化引导探索）框架。该框架旨在自主发现基于语言模型的文本转SQL生成中的潜在缺陷。具体来说，SAGE为给定的样本生成漏洞假设，并参考不断更新的漏洞库来设计有针对性的改进措施，从而逐步验证并记录潜在的缺陷。在最新的开源语言模型上进行的大量实验表明，SAGE能够发现大量的缺陷案例，这凸显了当前模型的严重脆弱性。此外，我们的分析还显示，漏洞库具有强大的跨模型可转移性，这表明所发现的模式代表了普遍存在的结构性问题。最后，我们探讨了SAGE在修复问题方面的潜力。此外，对生成的样本进行初步的轻量级微调也取得了有希望的改进效果，这为未来在可靠性方面的工作提供了可扩展的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Can We Entrust Justice to AI?: How Persona Traps Contaminate Reasoning in Criminal Investigation
papers.title_zh: 我们能否将正义委托给人工智能？：“角色陷阱”如何干扰刑事调查的推理过程
papers.authors: Jaewook Lee, Myeong-Cheol Kang, Jong-hun Shin
papers.abstract: If large language models (LLMs) are deployed to analyze evidence and evaluate suspects in criminal investigations, are they free from the very trap that has led countless human investigators to misjudgment—implicit bias swayed by information irrelevant to the essence of the case? To answer this question, this study systematically injected personas (gender, race, relationship) into neutralized murder mystery scenarios and examined the reasoning stability of LLMs. Experimental results revealed that implicit bias propagation was observed across all models. The phenomenon where models outwardly state “that information is irrelevant to the judgment” while their actual conclusions are already influenced by the injected persona was universally observed. Interestingly, model scale alone did not guarantee stability: while the largest model achieved the lowest instability, several smaller models outperformed much larger ones. The most notable finding concerns the differential vulnerability across persona types: while race and gender were processed relatively stably, relationship information—particularly hostile relationships—induced significantly higher reasoning contamination. More concerning is the fact that even when conclusions were correctly maintained, the reasoning process itself was extensively contaminated. These findings suggest that current alignment techniques have created a blind spot by focusing on identity-based bias while neglecting relationship-based bias, and propose that stability evaluation should encompass not only outputs but also reasoning processes.
papers.abstract_zh: 如果大语言模型被用于分析证据和评估刑事调查中的嫌疑人，它们是否能够避免那种导致无数人类调查员误判的陷阱——即受到与案件本质无关的信息影响的隐性偏见？为了回答这个问题，本研究在中性化的谋杀案场景中系统地引入了性别、种族、关系等属性，并考察了大语言模型的推理稳定性。实验结果表明，所有模型都存在隐性偏见的传播现象。尽管模型表面上声称“某些信息对判断无关紧要”，但实际上它们的结论已经受到了所引入属性的影响。有趣的是，仅仅模型规模的大小并不能保证推理的稳定性：虽然规模最大的模型表现出最低的不稳定性，但一些规模较小的模型却表现得更好。最值得注意的发现是不同属性类型带来的差异性脆弱性：种族和性别信息处理相对稳定，而关系信息——尤其是敌对关系——则会导致更高的推理污染。更令人担忧的是，即使结论得到了正确的维护，推理过程本身仍然受到了严重的污染。这些发现表明，当前的一致性技术存在缺陷，因为它们只关注基于身份的偏见，而忽视了基于关系的偏见。因此，稳定性评估应该不仅包括输出结果，还包括推理过程本身。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Appraisal-Guided Chain-of-Thought Reasoning and Retrieval for Multimodal Emotional Support Conversations
papers.title_zh: 超越语义相似性：基于评价引导的链式思维推理与多模态情感支持对话检索方法
papers.authors: Yuqi Chu, Lizi Liao, Jinggui Liang, Boyang Li, Richang Hong
papers.abstract: Emotional support conversation systems strive to emulate the empathetic depth of human therapists, yet current approaches often fail due to the “Cognitive Gap”—the inability to discern the latent psychological evaluations driving a user’s distress. Existing retrieval-augmented generation paradigms exacerbate this by relying on semantic similarity, frequently retrieving historical dialogues that are surface analogous but therapeutically incongruent. To bridge this gap, we introduce Appraisal-Guided Chain-of-Thought Reasoning & Retrieval (AG-CTR²) for better emotional support. Specifically, we bootstrap the MLLM to generate appraisal-guided reasoning chains and apply a dual-signal verification mechanism using ground-truth emotion labels and a teacher model to verify and correct them. Under such instance-level guidance, we finetune the MLLM to internalize such reasoning capability. At inference, the model utilizes its generated appraisal chain as a structured query to help retrieve historical therapeutic responses based on psychological situation similarity rather than content surface proximity. Extensive experiments and analyses on two ESC benchmarks demonstrate that AG-CTR² significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 情感支持对话系统试图模拟人类治疗师的同理心深度，但当前的方法往往因“认知差距”而失败——即无法识别导致用户痛苦的心理评估因素。现有的基于检索生成的方法通过依赖语义相似性来加剧这一问题，经常检索出表面相似但在治疗上并不恰当的过往对话。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了“评估引导的链式推理与检索”方法，以提供更有效的情感支持。具体来说，我们引导MLLM生成基于评估的推理链，并采用双信号验证机制，结合真实情感标签和教师模型来验证和修正这些推理链。在这种实例级指导下，我们进一步微调MLLM，使其具备这种推理能力。在推理过程中，模型利用其生成的评估链作为结构化查询，根据心理状态的相似性来检索历史治疗方案，而非仅仅基于内容表面的相似性。在两项ESC基准测试上的广泛实验和分析表明，AG-CTR²显著优于现有最先进的基线方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When and What to Ask: AskBench and Rubric-Guided RLVR for LLM Clarification
papers.title_zh: 何时提问、询问什么：使用AskBench和基于评分标准的RLVR来帮助理解大语言模型的运作机制
papers.authors: Jiale Zhao, Ke Fang, Lu Cheng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often respond even when prompts omit critical details or include misleading information, leading to hallucinations or reinforced misconceptions. We study how to evaluate and improve LLMs’ ability to decide when and what to ask for clarification without sacrificing task performance. We introduce AskBench, an interactive benchmark that converts standard QA pairs into multi-turn interactions with explicit checkpoints. A unified judge loop evaluates final answers and simulates user responses as needed. AskBench covers two settings: AskMind, with intent-deficient queries requiring clarification, and AskOverconfidence, with queries containing false premises that must be identified and corrected. We further propose rubric-guided reinforcement learning with verifier-based rewards (RLVR), which uses structured rubrics to encourage targeted clarification. Experiments show consistent improvements in accuracy, rubric adherence, and interaction efficiency, with strong generalization to unseen domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在即使提示中省略了关键细节或包含误导性信息时，仍会做出回应，这可能导致幻觉或错误的观念被强化。我们研究如何评估并改进模型判断何时以及询问哪些内容以进行澄清的能力，同时不牺牲任务性能。我们引入了AskBench这一交互式基准测试工具，它将标准的问答对转化为多轮互动，并设有明确的检查点。一个统一的评判循环负责评估最终答案，并根据需要模拟用户反应。AskBench涵盖了两种场景：AskMind，涉及需要澄清的缺乏明确意图的查询；以及AskOverconfidence，涉及包含错误前提的查询，这些错误前提必须被识别并纠正。我们还提出了基于评分标准引导的强化学习方法，该方法利用结构化的评分标准来鼓励有针对性的澄清。实验表明，这种方法在准确性、评分标准遵守性和互动效率方面都取得了持续的提升，并且对于未见过领域也有很好的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FreezeEmpath: Efficient Training for Empathetic Spoken Chatbots with Frozen LLMs
papers.title_zh: FreezeEmpath：利用冻结的大语言模型进行情感智能聊天机器人的高效训练方法
papers.authors: Yun Hong, Yan Zhou, Yang Feng
papers.abstract: Empathy is essential for fostering natural interactions in spoken dialogue systems, as it enables machines to recognize the emotional tone of human speech and deliver empathetic responses. Recent research has made significant progress in developing empathetic spoken chatbots based on large language models (LLMs). However, several challenges still exist when training such models, including reliance on costly empathetic speech instruction data and a lack of emotional expressiveness in the generated speech. Finetuning LLM with cross-modal empathetic instruction data may also lead to catastrophic forgetting and a degradation of its general capability. To address these challenges, we propose FreezeEmpath, an end-to-end empathetic spoken chatbot trained in a simple and efficient manner. The entire training process relies solely on existing speech instruction data and speech emotion recognition (SER) data, while keeping the LLM’s parameters frozen. Experiments demonstrate that FreezeEmpath is able to generate emotionally expressive speech and outperforms other empathetic models in empathetic dialogue, SER, and SpokenQA tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our training strategy.
papers.abstract_zh: 共情能力对于促进口语对话系统中的自然交互至关重要，因为它能使机器识别人类语音中的情感色彩，并给出富有同情心的回应。最近的研究在基于大语言模型开发具有共情能力的口语聊天机器人方面取得了显著进展。然而，在训练这类模型时仍然存在一些挑战，比如需要依赖成本高昂的共情语音训练数据，以及生成的语音缺乏情感表达力。使用跨模态共情训练数据进行LLM的微调可能会导致灾难性的遗忘现象，同时也会降低其整体性能。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了FreezeEmpath这一端到端的共情口语聊天机器人模型。整个训练过程仅依赖于现有的语音训练数据和语音情感识别数据，同时让LLM的参数保持冻结状态。实验表明，FreezeEmpath能够生成富有情感表达的语音，并在共情对话、语音情感识别和口语问答任务中表现优于其他共情模型，这证明了我们的训练策略是有效的。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: To Intervene or Not: Guiding Inference-time Alignment with Probabilistic Model Blending
papers.title_zh: 是否进行干预：基于概率模型融合的推理时间协调策略
papers.authors: Jin Gan, Xin Li, Jun Luo
papers.abstract: The wide deployment of LLMs has made model alignment necessary to make newly trained models safely and effectively respond to user instructions. Among different methods, inference-time alignment is often cheaper as it intervenes (i.e., offers guidances) only during output generation. Existing proposals apply guidances extracted from certain aligned models without properly assessing their reliability. Nonetheless, our systematic evaluation reveals that guidance effectiveness varies drastically across models; since ineffective guidances lead to further confusion and thus further interventions, the resulting excessive interventions typically indicate poor performance. To make interventions more effective and thus more efficient, we introduce BlendIn, an inference-time alignment framework that shifts from binary decisions to creating hybrid distributions integrating both models’ knowledge. BlendIn stabilizes inference-time alignment by performing quality-aware alignment and proportionally weighting each model’s contribution based on reliability. Compared with existing works, it preserves beneficial guidance while downweighting unreliable suggestions. BlendIn provides both diagnostic signals and mitigation strategies for misaligned guidance, achieving consistent and up to 50% performance improvement on challenging model pairs. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DecayingSeart/BlendIn.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的广泛应用使得模型对齐变得必要，以确保新训练的模型能够安全有效地响应用户的指令。在不同方法中，推理时对齐通常更为简单，因为它仅在输出生成过程中进行干预（即提供指导）。现有的解决方案采用从某些对齐模型中提取的指导信息，但并未充分评估其可靠性。然而，我们的系统评估表明，不同模型对指导效果的响应差异很大；由于无效的指导会导致更多的困惑和进一步的干预，因此过度的干预通常意味着较差的性能。为了使干预更加有效且高效，我们提出了BlendIn这一推理时对齐框架。该框架从二元决策转向创建混合分布，整合两种模型的知识。BlendIn通过执行基于可靠性的对齐，并按比例加权每个模型的贡献来稳定推理时对齐的效果。与现有方案相比，BlendIn能够在保留有益指导的同时，降低不可靠建议的权重。BlendIn为不对齐的指导提供了诊断信号和缓解策略，在复杂的模型对上实现了一致且高达50%的性能提升。我们的代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/DecayingSeart/BlendIn。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FLEXITOKENS: Flexible Tokenization for Evolving Language Models
papers.title_zh: 灵活令牌化：适用于不断发展的语言模型的创新技术
papers.authors: Abraham Toluwase Owodunni, Orevaoghene Ahia, Sachin Kumar
papers.abstract: Adapting language models to new data distributions by simple finetuning is challenging. This is due to the rigidity of their subword tokenizers, which typically remain unchanged during adaptation. This inflexibility often leads to inefficient tokenization, causing overfragmentation of text in out-of-distribution domains, unseen languages, or scripts. In this work, we develop byte-level LMs with learnable tokenizers to make tokenization adaptive. Our models include a submodule that learns to predict boundaries given the input byte sequence, encoding it into variable-length segments. Most tokenizer-free methods train this boundary predictor using an auxiliary loss that enforces a fixed compression rate across the training corpus, introducing a new kind of rigidity. We propose FLEXITOKENS, a simplified training objective that enables significantly greater flexibility during adaptation. Evaluating across multiple multilingual benchmarks, morphologically diverse tasks, and domains, we demonstrate that FLEXITOKENS consistently reduces token over-fragmentation and achieves up to 10% point improvements on token classification and generative tasks compared to BPE and other gradient-based tokenizer baselines. We validate our findings using models of varying sizes, and our method demonstrates consistent improvements across scales.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过简单的微调来适应新的数据分布对于语言模型来说是一个挑战。这是因为它们的子词分词器在适应过程中通常保持不变，这种刚性导致了分词效率低下，从而在非分布领域的文本中出现了过度碎片化现象，尤其是在未见过的语言或文字中。在这项研究中，我们开发了具有可学习分词器的字节级语言模型，使得分词过程能够自适应变化。我们的模型包含一个子模块，该子模块能够根据输入的字节序列预测边界，并将其编码成可变长度的片段。大多数无需分词器的方法使用辅助损失函数来训练这个边界预测器，从而强制在整个训练语料库中使用固定的压缩率，这又引入了一种新的刚性。我们提出了FLEXITOKENS这一简化的训练目标，它能够在适应过程中提供更大的灵活性。通过在不同多语言基准测试、形态学多样化的任务以及不同领域中进行评估，我们发现FLEXITOKENS能够显著减少文本的过度碎片化现象，并且在词元分类和生成任务上比BPE和其他基于梯度的分词器基线方法提高了高达10%的性能。我们使用不同规模的模型来验证我们的发现，结果表明我们的方法在不同规模上都能取得一致的改进。

papers.title: RAG in the Wild: On the (In)effectiveness of LLMs with Mixture-of-Knowledge Retrieval Augmentation
papers.title_zh: 在真实场景中的RAG：关于基于混合知识检索增强技术的大语言模型的有效性探讨
papers.authors: Ran Xu, Yuchen Zhuang, Yue Yu, Haoyu Wang, Wenqi Shi, Carl Yang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge retrieved at inference time. While RAG demonstrates strong performance on benchmarks largely derived from general-domain corpora like Wikipedia, its effectiveness under realistic, diverse retrieval scenarios remains underexplored. We evaluate RAG systems using MassiveDS, a large-scale datastore with mixture of knowledge, and identified critical limitations: retrieval mainly benefits smaller models, rerankers add minimal value, and no single retrieval source consistently excels. Moreover, current LLMs struggle to route queries across heterogeneous knowledge sources. These findings highlight the need for adaptive retrieval strategies before deploying RAG in real-world settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成技术通过整合在推理过程中获取的外部知识，提升了大语言模型的能力。虽然RAG在基于通用领域语料库（如维基百科）构建的基准测试中表现出色，但在实际、多样化的检索场景中，其效果仍有待进一步探索。我们使用MassiveDS这一包含多种知识的大规模数据存储系统来评估RAG系统的性能，并发现了几个关键限制：检索机制主要对较小的模型有优势；重新排序机制带来的提升有限；且没有一种单一的检索源能够始终表现出卓越的性能。此外，当前的LLM在处理跨不同知识源的查询时存在困难。这些发现表明，在将RAG技术应用于现实世界场景之前，需要采用适应性强的检索策略。

papers.title: Chain-of-Procedure: Hierarchical Visual-Language Reasoning for Procedural QA
papers.title_zh: 程序链：用于程序相关问答问题的分层视觉语言推理方法
papers.authors: Guanhua Chen, Yutong Yao, Shenghe Sun, Ci-jun Gao, Shudong Liu, Lidia S. Chao, Feng Wan, Derek F. Wong
papers.abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive results on standard image-text tasks, yet their potential for visual procedure question answering (VP-QA) remains largely unexplored. VP-QA presents unique challenges where users query next-step actions by uploading images for intermediate states of complex procedures. To systematically evaluate VLMs on this practical task, we propose ProcedureVQA, a novel multimodal benchmark specifically designed for visual procedural reasoning. Through comprehensive analysis, we identify two critical limitations in current VLMs: inadequate cross-modal retrieval of structured procedures given visual states, and misalignment between image sequence granularity and textual step decomposition. To address these issues, we present Chain-of-Procedure (CoP), a hierarchical reasoning framework that first retrieves relevant instructions using visual cues, then performs step refinement through semantic decomposition, and finally generates the next step. Experiments across six VLMs demonstrate CoP’s effectiveness, achieving up to 13% absolute improvement over standard baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，视觉-语言模型在标准图像-文本任务上取得了令人瞩目的成果，然而它们在视觉程序问答任务上的潜力仍未被充分探索。视觉程序问答面临着独特的挑战：用户通过上传图像来询问复杂程序的下一步操作。为了系统地评估这些模型在这项实际任务中的表现，我们提出了ProcedureVQA这一新型多模态基准测试，专门用于评估视觉程序推理能力。通过全面分析，我们发现当前视觉语言模型存在两个主要问题：一是无法有效利用视觉信息来检索结构化程序的操作步骤；二是图像序列的粒度与文本描述的步骤分解之间存在不匹配。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Chain-of-Procedure（CoP）这一分层推理框架。该框架首先利用视觉线索来检索相关指令，然后通过语义分解来细化步骤，最后生成下一步的操作步骤。通过对六种视觉语言模型的实验验证，我们发现CoP框架的有效性，其性能相比标准基线模型提升了高达13%。

papers.title: PEGRL: Improving Machine Translation by Post-Editing Guided Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: PEGRL：通过编辑指导的强化学习来提升机器翻译性能
papers.authors: Yunzhi Shen, Hao Zhou, Xin Huang, Xue Han, Junlan Feng, Shujian Huang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown strong promise for LLM-based machine translation, with recent methods such as GRPO demonstrating notable gains; nevertheless, translation-oriented RL remains challenged by high-variance policy gradients induced by Monte Carlo baselines, as well as a large trajectory space that favors global exploration over fine-grained local optimization. We introduce PEGRL, a two-stage RL framework that uses post-editing as an auxiliary task to stabilize training and guide overall optimization. At each step, translation outputs are sampled to construct post-editing inputs, enabling lower-variance gradients from the post-editing task to propagate through the entire framework while jointly supporting both global exploration and fine-grained local optimization. A task-specific weighting scheme further emphasizes the post-editing gradient, producing a biased yet more sample-efficient estimator. Experiments on English\toFinnish, English\toTurkish, and English\leftrightarrowChinese show consistent gains over RL baselines, and for English\toTurkish, performance on COMETKiwi is comparable to advanced LLM-based systems (DeepSeek-V3.2). Our code and a set of representative pretrained models are publicly available at https://github.com/NJUNLP/peg-rl and https://huggingface.co/collections/DGME/pegrl.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在基于大语言模型的机器翻译中展现出巨大的潜力，最近的一些方法如GRPO已经取得了显著的成果。然而，面向翻译的强化学习仍然面临着挑战：蒙特卡洛基线方法导致的政策梯度方差较大，以及庞大的轨迹空间使得系统更倾向于全局探索而非细粒度的局部优化。我们提出了PEGRL这一两阶段强化学习框架，该框架将编辑后处理任务作为辅助任务来稳定训练过程并指导整体优化过程。在每个步骤中，都会采样翻译输出以构建编辑后处理的输入，从而让来自编辑后处理任务的低方差梯度能够贯穿整个框架，同时支持全局探索和细粒度局部优化。此外，我们还采用了特定任务的权重分配机制，进一步强调了编辑后处理任务的贡献，从而产生了一种更加高效且 unbiased的估计方法。在英芬、英土和英中之间的翻译任务上，我们的方法与强化学习基线相比取得了稳定的优势；而在英土翻译任务中，我们的性能与先进的基于大语言模型的系统（如DeepSeek-V3.2）相当。我们的代码以及一组代表性的预训练模型可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/NJUNLP/peg-rl 和 https://huggingface.co/collections/DGME/pegrl。

papers.title: RanLoRA: Residual-aware Nonlinear Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.title_zh: RanLoRA：具有残差感知的非线性低秩自适应学习算法
papers.authors: Xu Luo, Yongbin Liu, Chunping Ouyang, Ying Yu
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely adopted approach for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models, enabling effective adaptation with a small number of trainable parameters. However, its reliance on linear low-rank projections restricts adaptation to linear subspaces, which can limit flexibility on complex downstream tasks. To address this, we propose RanLoRA, a Residual-aware nonlinear Low-Rank Adaptation approach that leverages the decomposition structure of pretrained weights. We used Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to decompose pretrained weights into principal components that are kept frozen and residual components that are used for task-specific adaptation. To enhance the expressiveness of linear low-rank updates, RanLoRA incorporates a nonlinear activation layer together with a Hadamard-product-based vector modulation. This design supports an implicit progressive adaptation behavior, where optimization evolves from coarse approximation of dominant components toward residual alignment and fine-grained nonlinear refinement. Experiments on benchmarks covering commonsense reasoning, natural language understanding, image classification, and mathematical reasoning show that RanLoRA consistently outperforms vanilla LoRA and representative variants under comparable parameter budgets. These results suggest that incorporating structured nonlinearity into adapter design can enhance representational flexibility and generalization across tasks in large models.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）是一种被广泛采用的方法，用于高效微调大语言模型，它能够通过少量可训练的参数实现有效的适应。然而，其依赖线性低秩投影的特性使得适应过程局限于线性子空间，这可能会限制在复杂下游任务中的灵活性。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了RanLoRA——一种基于残差的非线性低秩适应方法。该方法利用预训练权重的分解结构，将预训练权重分解为固定不变的主成分和用于特定任务适应的残差成分。为了提升线性低秩更新的表达能力，RanLoRA采用了非线性激活层以及基于哈达玛积的向量调制技术。这种设计支持一种隐式的渐进式适应行为，即优化过程从对主导成分的粗略近似逐渐过渡到残差对齐和细粒度非线性细化。在涵盖常识推理、自然语言理解、图像分类和数学推理等基准测试上的实验表明，RanLoRA在相同的参数预算下始终优于传统的LoRA及其相关变体。这些结果表明，在适配器设计中引入结构化非线性可以提高大型模型的表示灵活性以及跨任务的泛化能力。

papers.title: Multi-Hop Knowledge Editing via Critic-Guided Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 基于批评性引导的多智能体推理实现多跳知识编辑
papers.authors: Xudong Li, Yuhang Tian, Dandan Song, Zhijing Wu, Shuhao Zhang, Jun Yang, Yongyu Huo, Changzhi Zhou, Xinyu Zhang, Chenhao Li, Huipeng Ma, Luan Zhang, Yan Xu, Qian Liu
papers.abstract: Knowledge within large language models (LLMs) inevitably lags behind an evolving world, motivating knowledge editing methods that update facts without expensive retraining. In multi-hop knowledge editing, models must not only recall updated facts but also correctly propagate them through multi-step reasoning chains. However, most existing approaches rely on unidirectional, feed-forward pipelines, decomposing questions and retrieving edited facts in a rigid hop-wise sequence. This design is brittle: a minor retrieval error or logical mismatch at an early hop can become a silent failure that cascades to the final answer without an explicit recovery mechanism. To address this limitation, we propose Critic-Guided Multi-Agent Reasoning for Knowledge Editing (CARE), a framework for closed-loop post-edit reasoning. A Critic agent performs chain-level verification by checking both global coherence and step-wise correctness, and triggers bounded backtracking for iterative self-correction, while a Selector agent supplies high-fidelity, low-noise candidate pools from the edit store to enable effective revision. Experiments on MQuAKE-2002 and MQuAKE-hard demonstrate that CARE effectively mitigates error propagation, achieving a new state-of-the-art.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型所拥有的知识不可避免地落后于不断发展的世界，这促使人们提出了知识编辑方法，以实现无需昂贵重新训练即可更新事实的目标。在多跳知识编辑中，模型不仅要能够回忆起已更新的事实，还要能够通过多步骤推理链正确地传递这些事实。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于单向的前馈流程，以固定的跳跃顺序来分解问题并检索编辑后的事实。这种设计存在缺陷：早期阶段的轻微检索错误或逻辑不匹配可能会导致潜在的失败，而这一失败可能会无意识地影响最终答案的得出，因为没有明确的恢复机制。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种名为“批评引导的多智能体知识编辑推理”的框架——CARE。该框架通过一种名为“批评代理”的组件来执行级联验证，确保其全局一致性和逐步正确性；同时，还有“选择代理”负责从编辑存储中提供高保真度、低噪声的候选方案，以实现有效的修正。在MQuAKE-2002和MQuAKE-hard上的实验表明，CARE能够有效减少错误传播，从而达到了新的最优水平。

papers.title: Rethinking Post-Unlearning Behavior of Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 重新思考大型视觉语言模型在“遗忘后”的行为表现
papers.authors: Minsung Kim, Nakyeong Yang, Kyomin Jung
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) can recognize individuals in images and disclose sensitive personal information about them, raising critical privacy concerns. Machine unlearning aims to remove such knowledge from the model. However, existing methods rarely prescribe what the model should output in place of the forgotten content, leading to Unlearning Aftermaths: degenerate, hallucinated, or excessively refused responses. We argue that, especially for generative LVLMs, it is crucial to consider the quality and informativeness of post-unlearning responses rather than relying solely on naive suppression. To address this, we introduce a new unlearning task for LVLMs that requires models to provide privacy-preserving yet informative and visually grounded responses. We also propose PUBG, a novel unlearning method that explicitly guides post-unlearning behavior toward a desirable output distribution. Experiments show that, while existing methods suffer from Unlearning Aftermaths despite successfully preventing privacy violations, PUBG effectively mitigates these issues, generating visually grounded and informative responses without privacy leakage for forgotten targets.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型能够识别图像中的个体，并泄露关于这些个体的敏感个人信息，这引发了严重的隐私问题。机器反学习旨在从模型中去除这类知识。然而，现有的方法很少规定模型应该替代被遗忘的内容输出什么，从而导致反学习后的各种问题：响应可能变得退化、出现幻觉，或者过度拒绝提供有用的信息。我们认为，对于生成式LVLM来说，考虑反学习后响应的质量和信息性比单纯依赖简单的抑制措施更为重要。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种新的LVLM反学习任务，要求模型能够提供既保护隐私又具有信息性和视觉真实性的响应。我们还提出了PUBG这一新颖的反学习方法，该方法能够明确引导反学习后的行为，使其朝着期望的输出分布发展。实验表明，尽管现有方法在成功防止隐私侵犯的同时也出现了反学习后的问题，但PUBG能够有效缓解这些问题，生成出既具有视觉真实性又具有信息性的响应，同时不会泄露被遗忘目标的隐私信息。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Scattered Hypothesis Generation for Open-Ended Event Forecasting
papers.title_zh: 针对开放式事件预测的分散式假设生成
papers.authors: He Chang, Zhulin Tao, Lifang Yang, Xianglin Huang, Yunshan Ma
papers.abstract: Despite the importance of open-ended event forecasting for risk management, current LLM-based methods predominantly target only the most probable outcomes, neglecting the intrinsic uncertainty of real-world events. To bridge this gap, we advance open-ended event forecasting from pinpoint forecasting to scatter forecasting by introducing the proxy task of hypothesis generation. This paradigm aims to generate an inclusive and diverse set of hypotheses that broadly cover the space of plausible future events. To this end, we propose SCATTER, a reinforcement learning framework that jointly optimizes inclusiveness and diversity of the hypothesis. Specifically, we design a novel hybrid reward that consists of three components: 1) a validity reward that measures semantic alignment with observed events, 2) an intra-group diversity reward to encourage variation within sampled responses, and 3) an inter-group diversity reward to promote exploration across distinct modes. By integrating the validity-gated score into the overall objective, we confine the exploration of wildly diversified outcomes to contextually plausible futures, preventing the mode collapse issue. Experiments on two real-world benchmark datasets, i.e., OpenForecast and OpenEP, demonstrate that SCATTER significantly outperforms strong baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sambac1/SCATTER .
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管开放式事件预测在风险管理中具有重要意义，但目前基于大语言模型的方法主要只关注最有可能发生的结果，而忽略了现实世界事件的固有不确定性。为了弥补这一不足，我们通过将假设生成作为辅助任务，将开放式事件预测从精确预测转变为分布式预测。这种范式旨在生成一套涵盖所有可能未来事件的多样化假设。为此，我们提出了SCATTER这一强化学习框架，该框架能够同时优化假设的包容性和多样性。具体来说，我们设计了一种新颖的混合奖励机制，该机制包含三个组成部分：1）有效性奖励，用于衡量与观测事件的语义一致性；2）组内多样性奖励，以促进样本响应中的多样性；3）组间多样性奖励，以推动对不同模式的探索。通过将有效性门控得分纳入整体目标中，我们可以限制对极端多样化结果的探索，从而防止模式崩溃问题。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的实验表明，SCATTER的表现显著优于其他强大的基线方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Sambac1/SCATTER获取。

papers.title: Context-attended Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Robust Multi-step Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 基于上下文感知的对抗性强化学习，用于稳健的多步检索增强生成
papers.authors: Yingtao Ren, Xiao Luo, Yu-Cheng Chang, Chin-teng Lin
papers.abstract: Multi-step retrieval-augmented generation has attracted increasing attention due to its capacity to improve the factuality of large language models with iterative retrieved knowledge. However, the performance of multi-step RAG systems is susceptible to potential retrieval noise and fabricated documents in real-world scenarios. Current approaches usually utilize supervised fine-tuning on predetermined noisy contexts to enhance the robustness. However, their performance remains inadequate when it comes to more complicated long-context scenarios due to the lack of adaptability. Towards this end, we propose a novel framework named Context-attended Adversarial Reinforcement Learning (CARE) for multi-step RAG systems against attacks. The core of our CARE is to conduct reinforcement learning on adversarial samples which are alternatingly enhanced with text gradients. In particular, our CARE includes a reward model to identify the accuracy of responses, which is minimized for the generation of adversarial samples with text gradients. These context-attended noisy samples are then utilized for reinforcement learning to maximize the rewards. The whole framework is conducted alternatingly from easy to hard samples to ensure the smoothness of the optimization. Extensive experiments on multi-step RAG benchmark datasets are conducted to validate the superiority of our proposed CARE in multiple noisy scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/yingtaoren/CARE.
papers.abstract_zh: 多步骤检索增强生成技术因其能够通过迭代检索知识来提高大语言模型的真实性而受到越来越多的关注。然而，多步骤RAG系统的性能容易受到现实场景中潜在的检索噪声和伪造文档的影响。目前的方法通常需要在预设的带噪声上下文中进行有监督的微调，以提高系统的鲁棒性。但是，当面对更复杂的长上下文场景时，这些方法的表现仍然不够理想，因为它们缺乏适应性。为此，我们提出了一种名为“上下文注意力对抗强化学习”的新框架，用于应对多步骤RAG系统中的攻击问题。我们的核心思想是在对抗样本上进行强化学习，这些样本通过文本梯度进行交替增强。特别地，我们的框架包含了一个奖励模型，用于评估响应的准确性，该模型会被最小化，以生成带有文本梯度的对抗样本。这些带有上下文注意力的噪声样本随后被用于强化学习，以最大化奖励。整个框架采用从简单到复杂的样本交替进行训练的方式，以确保优化的顺利进行。我们在多步骤RAG基准数据集上进行了广泛的实验，以验证我们提出的CARE在多种噪声场景中的优越性。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/yingtaoren/CARE下载。

papers.title: From Pseudo-Balancing to True Specialization: Memory-Aware Routing for Mixture-of-Experts
papers.title_zh: 从伪均衡到真正的专业化：基于记忆的路由算法在混合专家系统中的应用
papers.authors: Peixuan Hou, Yunbo Hou, Bin Chen, LI He, Jian Xu, Weiping Li, Bo Zheng, Guojie Song
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) efficiently trains large models by using sparse activation to lower costs, selecting a few experts based on data characteristics. For MoE, an unbalanced expert load will lead to inefficient expert utilization and routing collapse. Existing methods commonly achieve an expert-centered balancing strategy to solve it, prioritizing equal utilization of experts over semantic alignment between tokens and experts. However, this can lead to a pseudo-balance phenomenon: To ensure expert load balancing, the same input is randomly routed to different experts across training steps instead of the most matching one. It introduces two critical issues: (1) Severe knowledge overlap among experts, resulting in redundant representations and inefficient parameter utilization. (2) Difficulty in forming and stabilizing expert specialization. These issues limit the scalability of models, especially large language models (LLM). To address these limitations, we introduce Memory-Aware Routing (MAR), a training-phase approach that enhances existing load-balancing strategies. By equipping each expert with a memory buffer, our method explicitly models their long-term preferences, allowing historical experience to guide routing. This ensures that tokens are routed more consistently to compatible experts, mitigating the pseudo-balance problem while maintaining global load balance and fostering expert specialization. Experimental results show that MAR improves expert specialization by 35% and downstream accuracy by 2%-25%, doubles parameter efficiency, and matches baseline performance with only half the experts.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合模型（Mixture-of-Experts，MoE）通过采用稀疏激活机制来降低训练成本，并根据数据特征选择少数几个专家来进行大模型的训练。对于MoE模型而言，不平衡的专家负载会导致专家利用效率低下以及路由崩溃的问题。现有方法通常采用以专家为中心的平衡策略来解决这个问题，优先考虑专家的均衡利用，而非 tokens与专家之间的语义对齐。然而，这种方法可能会导致一种伪平衡现象：为了确保专家负载的平衡，相同的输入会在训练过程中被随机分配到不同的专家手中，而不是分配给最匹配的专家。这会带来两个严重的问题：(1) 专家之间存在严重的知识重叠，导致表示冗余和参数利用效率低下。(2) 难以形成并稳定专家的专业化能力。这些问题限制了模型的可扩展性，尤其是大语言模型。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了记忆感知路由技术，这是一种在训练阶段增强现有负载平衡策略的方法。通过为每个专家配备一个记忆缓冲区，我们的方法能够明确模拟他们的长期偏好，使历史经验能够指导路由决策。这样就能确保 词元 更一致地分配到兼容的专家手中，从而缓解伪平衡问题，同时维持全局负载平衡并促进专家的专业化发展。实验结果表明，MAR 能够将专家的专业化程度提高35%，下游准确率提高2%-25%，参数使用效率提升一倍，并且仅使用一半数量的专家就能达到与基线模型相当的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Learning to Retrieve User History and Generate User Profiles for Personalized Persuasiveness Prediction
papers.title_zh: 学习检索用户历史数据并生成用户档案，以用于个性化说服力预测分析
papers.authors: Sejun Park, Yoonah Park, Jongwon Lim, Yohan Jo
papers.abstract: Estimating the persuasiveness of messages is critical in various applications, from recommender systems to safety assessment of LLMs. While it is imperative to consider the target persuadee’s characteristics, such as their values, experiences, and reasoning styles, there is currently no established systematic framework to optimize leveraging a persuadee’s past activities (e.g., conversations) to the benefit of a persuasiveness prediction model. To address this problem, we propose a context-aware user profiling framework with two trainable components: a query generator that generates optimal queries to retrieve persuasion-relevant records from a user’s history, and a profiler that summarizes these records into a profile to effectively inform the persuasiveness prediction model.Our evaluation on the ChangeMyView Reddit dataset shows consistent improvements over existing methods across multiple predictor models, raising F1 from 33% to 47% on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. Further analysis shows that effective user profiles are context-dependent and predictor-specific, rather than relying on static attributes or surface-level similarity. Together, these results highlight the importance of task-oriented, context-dependent user profiling for personalized persuasiveness prediction.
papers.abstract_zh: 在从推荐系统到大语言模型的安全评估等多种应用中，估算信息的说服力至关重要。虽然考虑目标受话人的特征非常重要，比如他们的价值观、经验和推理风格，但目前还没有一个成熟的系统框架来优化利用受话人过去的活动（例如对话）来提升说服力预测模型的性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个基于上下文的用户画像框架，该框架包含两个可训练组件：一个查询生成器，用于生成最优的查询以从用户的历史数据中检索与说服力相关的记录；以及一个总结器，将这些记录汇总成一份个人资料，从而有效地为说服力预测模型提供信息。我们在ChangeMyView Reddit数据集上的评估结果显示，与现有方法相比，我们的方法在多种预测模型上都取得了显著的改进，在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct上的F1分数从33%提高到了47%。进一步分析表明，有效的用户画像是依赖于上下文和特定预测模型的，而不是依赖于静态属性或表面级的相似性。总的来说，这些结果凸显了面向任务、依赖上下文的用户画像在个性化说服力预测中的重要性。

papers.title: Understanding LLM Reasoning for Abstractive Summarization
papers.title_zh: 理解用于抽象概括的大型语言模型推理机制
papers.authors: Haohan Yuan, Haopeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Reasoning has substantially improved Large Language Models (LLMs) on analytical tasks such as mathematics and code generation, but its value for abstractive summarization remains unclear. To address this gap, we adapt general reasoning strategies to the summarization setting and conduct a large-scale comparative study of 8 reasoning strategies and 3 Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) across 8 diverse datasets, evaluating both summary quality and factual faithfulness. Our results show that reasoning is not a universal solution and its effectiveness depends strongly on the strategy and the summarization setting. In particular, we find a trade-off between summary quality and factual faithfulness. Explicit reasoning strategies often improve reference-based quality, but may weaken factual grounding, whereas implicit reasoning in LRMs shows the opposite tendency. We further find that increasing an LRM’s internal reasoning budget does not reliably improve summarization and can even reduce factual consistency. These findings suggest that, for summarization, more reasoning is not always better. Effective reasoning should preserve faithful compression rather than induce over-elaboration.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理能力显著提升了大语言模型在处理数学和代码生成等分析任务时的表现，但其在抽象性总结任务中的效果仍不明确。为了填补这一空白，我们将通用推理策略应用于总结任务，并在8种不同的数据集上对8种推理策略和3种大型推理模型进行了大规模对比研究，同时评估了总结质量与事实准确性之间的关系。我们的研究结果表明，推理并非万能的解决方案，其有效性在很大程度上取决于具体的策略和总结场景。具体而言，我们发现总结质量与事实准确性之间存在权衡关系：明确的推理策略通常会提升基于参考的总结质量，但可能会削弱对事实的精准把握；而大型推理模型中的隐性推理则表现出相反的趋势。此外，我们还发现，增加大型推理模型的内部推理预算并不能可靠地改善总结效果，甚至可能会降低事实的一致性。这些发现表明，在总结任务中，过多的推理并不总是有益的。有效的推理应该能够保持对信息的忠实压缩，而不是导致过度复杂化的结果。

papers.title: Feasible is Not Enough: Cost-Aware Optimal Tool-Chain Planning on Multi-Solution Tool Graphs
papers.title_zh: 可行性并不足够：在多解决方案工具图谱上进行考虑成本的最优工具链规划
papers.authors: Liangliang Liu, Yanming Li, Yigang Liu, Jialong Han, Rujia Shen, Yi Guan, Yi Lin, Jingchi Jiang
papers.abstract: Tool graphs (TG) model dependencies among tools and resources, enabling more structured organization and management of large toolsets. However, existing methods and benchmarks often formulate tool learning (TL) as a single-solution setting, overlooking the fact that many tasks admit multiple valid tool combinations and therefore require optimal solution selection. Moreover, exploring large-scale TG is computationally expensive, especially under constrained context budgets. To address these challenges, we propose TOPT, an efficient framework for learning optimal TL policies over large TG, as well as construct MultiSoTLBench, a large-scale Multi-Solution TL Benchmark, where each task admits multiple valid solutions. Specifically, to improve search efficiency in large action spaces, TOPT adopts a progressive graph expansion strategy: we train a reinforcement learning (RL) agent to acquire transferable expansion skills and construct, on demand, a compact solvable subgraph that preserves only task-relevant links. This reduces the size of the candidate space and the context usage from the outset. To enable optimal selection, we further propose a progressive graph reasoning framework. It performs RL-driven optimality analysis and scheduling on the expanded subgraph to generate an optimal tool chain that balances path length and tool cost. Comprehensive experiments on MultiSoTLBench demonstrate that TOPT generalizes effectively, improving task success and solution optimality by 46.21% and 66.34%, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具图模型能够展示工具和资源之间的依赖关系，从而实现对大型工具集更结构化的组织和管理。然而，现有的方法和基准测试往往将工具学习问题视为单一解决方案的问题，而忽略了许多任务存在多种有效工具组合的情况，因此需要选择最优解。此外，探索大规模工具图在计算上非常昂贵，尤其是在有限的上下文预算下。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了TOPT框架，该框架能够高效地在大型工具图中学习最优工具学习策略。同时，我们还构建了MultiSoTLBench这一大规模多解工具学习基准测试平台，其中每个任务都有多种有效解决方案。具体来说，为了提高在大型动作空间中的搜索效率，TOPT采用了一种渐进式图扩展策略：我们训练一个强化学习代理来掌握可迁移的扩展技能，并根据需求构建出一个简洁的可解决子图，仅保留与任务相关的链接。这样就能从一开始就减少候选空间的规模以及上下文的使用量。为了实现最优选择，我们还提出了一个渐进式图推理框架。该框架通过强化学习驱动的最优性分析和调度，生成一条平衡路径长度和工具成本的最优工具链。在MultiSoTLBench上的综合实验表明，TOPT具有有效的泛化能力，分别使任务成功率和解决方案的最优性提高了46.21%和66.34%。

papers.title: DOS: Dependency-Oriented Sampler for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: DOS：面向依赖关系的掩码扩散语言模型采样器
papers.authors: Xueyu Zhou, Yangrong Hu, Jian Huang
papers.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) have recently emerged as a new paradigm in language modeling, offering flexible generation dynamics and enabling efficient parallel decoding. However, existing decoding strategies for pre-trained MDLMs predominantly rely on token-level uncertainty criteria, while largely overlooking sequence-level information and inter-token dependencies. To address this limitation, we propose Dependency-Oriented Sampler (DOS), a training-free decoding strategy that leverages inter-token dependencies to inform token updates during generation. Specifically, DOS exploits attention matrices from transformer blocks to approximate inter-token dependencies, emphasizing information from unmasked tokens when updating masked positions. Empirical results demonstrate that DOS consistently achieves superior performance on both code generation and mathematical reasoning tasks. Moreover, DOS can be seamlessly integrated with existing parallel sampling methods, leading to improved generation efficiency without sacrificing generation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 掩蔽扩散语言模型（MDLMs）最近成为语言建模领域的一种新范式，它提供了灵活的生成机制，并能够实现高效的并行解码。然而，现有的预训练MDLMs的解码策略主要依赖于令牌级别的不确定性判断，而很大程度上忽略了序列级别的信息以及令牌之间的依赖关系。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种名为“依赖导向采样器”（DOS）的无训练解码策略。该策略利用令牌之间的依赖关系来指导生成过程中的令牌更新。具体来说，DOS利用变换器模块中的注意力矩阵来近似令牌之间的依赖关系，在更新被掩蔽的令牌时，会优先考虑未被掩蔽的令牌提供的信息。实验结果表明，DOS在代码生成和数学推理任务上始终表现出卓越的性能。此外，DOS可以无缝地与现有的并行采样方法相结合，从而在不牺牲生成质量的情况下提高生成效率。

papers.title: BIASEDTALES-ML: A Multilingual Dataset for Analyzing Narrative Attribute Distributions in LLM-Generated Stories
papers.title_zh: 虚假故事数据集——一个多语言数据集，用于分析大型语言模型生成的故事中的叙事属性分布
papers.authors: Yuxuan Ouyang, Yingfeng Luo, JingBo Zhu, Tong Xiao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate narrative content, including children’s stories, which play an important role in social and cultural learning. Despite growing interest in AI safety and alignment, most existing evaluations focus primarily on English, leaving the cross-lingual generalization of aligned behavior underexplored. In this work, we introduce BiasedTales-ML, a large-scale parallel corpus of approximately 350,000 children’s stories generated across eight typologically and culturally diverse languages using a full-permutation prompting design. We propose a structured generator-extractor pipeline and a multi-dimensional distributional analysis framework to examine how narrative attributes vary across languages, models, and social conditions.Our analysis reveals substantial cross-lingual variability in narrative generation patterns, indicating that distributions observed in English do not always exhibit similar characteristics in other languages, particularly in lower-resource settings. At the narrative level, we identify recurring structural patterns involving character roles, settings, and thematic emphasis, which manifest differently across linguistic contexts.These findings highlight the limitations of English-centric evaluation for characterizing socially grounded narrative generation in multilingual settings. We release the dataset, code, and an interactive visualization tool to support future research on multilingual narrative analysis and evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在生成叙事内容方面得到了广泛应用，其中包括儿童故事。这些故事在社交和文化学习中发挥着重要作用。尽管人们对人工智能的安全性和对齐性越来越关注，但现有的评估大多集中在英语上，而不同语言间对齐行为的泛化效果却未得到充分研究。在这项研究中，我们提出了BiasedTales-ML，这是一个包含约35万篇儿童故事的大规模平行语料库，这些故事来自八种类型多样且文化各异的语言，采用了全排列提示设计。我们提出了一种结构化的生成器-提取器流程以及多维分布分析框架，以研究叙事属性在不同语言、模型和社交环境中的变化。我们的分析显示，叙事生成模式在不同语言之间存在显著差异，这表明在英语中观察到的分布在其他语言中并不总是具有相同的特征，尤其是在资源较少的情况下。在叙事层面，我们发现了一些重复出现的结构性模式，比如角色角色、场景和主题重点等方面，这些模式在不同的语言环境中表现有所不同。这些发现凸显了以英语为中心的评估方法在描述多语言环境下的基于社会基础的叙事生成时存在的局限性。我们发布了该数据集、代码以及交互式可视化工具，以支持未来关于多语言叙事分析和评估的研究。

papers.title: Rethinking Reasoning: A Survey on Reasoning-based Backdoors in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 重新思考推理机制：关于大语言模型中的基于推理的后门技术调查
papers.authors: Man Hu, Xinyi Wu, Zhufeng Suo, Jinbo Feng, Linghui Meng, Yanhao Jia, Anh Tuan Luu, Shuai Zhao
papers.abstract: With the rise of advanced reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) are receiving increasing attention. While reasoning enhances LLMs’ performance on downstream tasks, it also introduces new threat vectors, as adversaries can leverage these capabilities to conduct backdoor attacks. Prior surveys provide broad overviews of backdoor attacks and reasoning security; however, a systematic survey focused on backdoor attacks and defenses against LLM reasoning is still absent. In this paper, we take the first step toward providing a comprehensive review of reasoning-based backdoor attacks in LLMs by analyzing their underlying mechanisms, methodological frameworks, and unresolved challenges. Specifically, we introduce a new taxonomy that offers a unified perspective for summarizing existing approaches, categorizing reasoning-based backdoor attacks into associative, passive, and active. We also summarize defenses against such attacks and discuss current challenges alongside future research directions.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着高级推理能力的提升，大语言模型（LLMs）受到了越来越多的关注。虽然推理能力提升了LLMs在下游任务中的表现，但也引入了新的威胁来源，因为攻击者可以利用这些能力实施后门攻击。之前的研究对后门攻击和推理安全进行了广泛的概述，然而，目前还没有针对后门攻击以及防御LLM推理能力的系统性研究。在本文中，我们首次对LLMs中基于推理的后门攻击进行了全面回顾，分析了其潜在机制、方法论框架以及尚未解决的挑战。具体来说，我们提出了一种新的分类体系，以统一的方式总结现有的方法，将基于推理的后门攻击分为关联型、被动型和主动型三种类型。我们还总结了针对此类攻击的防御措施，并讨论了当前的挑战以及未来的研究方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Tokens to Steps: Verification-Aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Multi-Step Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 从代币到步骤：一种基于验证的推测性解码方法，以实现高效的多步推理
papers.authors: Kiran Purohit, Ramasuri Narayanam, Soumyabrata Pal
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose outputs that a stronger target model verifies. However, its token-centric nature allows erroneous steps to propagate. Prior approaches mitigate this using external reward models, but incur additional latency, computational overhead, and limit generalizability. We propose SpecGuard, a verification-aware speculative decoding framework that performs step-level verification using only model-internal signals. At each step, SpecGuard samples multiple draft candidates and selects the most consistent step, which is then validated using an ensemble of two lightweight model-internal signals: (i) an attention-based grounding score that measures attribution to the input and previously accepted steps, and (ii) a log-probability-based score that captures token-level confidence. These signals jointly determine whether a step is accepted or recomputed using the target, allocating compute selectively. Experiments across a range of reasoning benchmarks show that SpecGuard improves accuracy by 3.6% while reducing latency by ~11%, outperforming both SD and reward-guided SD.
papers.abstract_zh: 投机性解码（SD）通过允许一个轻量级的草稿模型提出输出结果，再由更强的目标模型进行验证，从而加速大语言模型的推理过程。然而，由于其以令牌为中心的特性，错误的步骤可能会传播开来。以往的方法通过使用外部奖励模型来缓解这个问题，但这会带来额外的延迟、计算开销，并且限制了模型的泛化能力。我们提出了SpecGuard，一种注重验证的投机性解码框架，它仅使用模型内部的信号来进行步骤级别的验证。在每个步骤中，SpecGuard会选取多个草稿候选方案，并选择最一致的方案进行验证。该验证过程利用了两种轻量级的内部信号来进行判断：(i)基于注意力的定位分数，用于衡量对输入数据以及之前已接受的步骤的关联程度；(ii)基于对数概率的分数，用于捕捉令牌级别的置信度。这些信号共同决定了某个步骤是否会被接受或重新计算，从而有选择地分配计算资源。在一系列推理基准测试中的实验表明，SpecGuard能够将准确率提高3.6%，同时将延迟减少约11%。其表现优于传统的投机性解码和基于奖励的投机性解码方法。

papers.title: SPS: Steering Probability Squeezing for Better Exploration in Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SPS：引导概率压缩技术，以在大型语言模型的强化学习中实现更有效的探索
papers.authors: Yifu Huo, Chenglong Wang, Ziming Zhu, Shunjie Xing, Peinan Feng, Tongran Liu, Qiaozhi He, Tian Hua Zhou, Changxiaojia, JingBo Zhu, Zhengtao Yu, Tong Xiao
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training reasoning-oriented models by leveraging rule-based reward signals. However, RL training typically tends to improve single-sample success rates (i.e., Pass@1) while offering limited exploration of diverse reasoning trajectories, which is crucial for multi-sample performance (i.e., Pass@k). Our preliminary analysis reveals that this limitation stems from a fundamental squeezing effect, whereby probability mass is excessively concentrated on a narrow subset of high-reward trajectories, restricting genuine exploration and constraining attainable performance under RL training. To address this issue, in this work, we propose Steering Probability Squeezing (SPS), a training paradigm that interleaves conventional RL with inverse reinforcement learning (IRL). SPS treats on-policy rollouts as demonstrations and employs IRL to explicitly reshape the induced trajectory distribution, thereby enhancing exploration without introducing external supervision. Experiments on five commonly used reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SPS can enable better exploration and improve Pass@k. Beyond algorithmic contributions, we provide an analysis of RL learning dynamics and identify an empirical upper bound on Pass@k, shedding light on intrinsic exploration limits in RL-based reasoning models. Our findings suggest that alternating between RL and IRL offers an effective pathway toward extending the exploration capacity of reasoning-oriented large language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）作为一种利用基于规则的奖励信号来训练推理型模型的方法，已经展现出巨大的潜力。然而，RL训练通常只能够提升单个样本的通过率（即Pass@1），而缺乏对多种推理路径的探索，而这对于提高多样本性能（即Pass@k）至关重要。我们的初步分析表明，这种局限性源于一种基本的“挤压效应”——概率质量过度集中在少数高回报路径上，从而限制了真正的探索行为，并制约了在RL训练下的性能提升。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“引导概率挤压”这一训练方法。该方法将传统RL与逆强化学习相结合，将策略内展开视为示范，并利用逆强化学习来重新塑造诱导出的轨迹分布，从而在无需引入外部监督的情况下增强探索能力。在五个常用的推理基准测试上的实验表明，SPS能够改善探索效果，并提高Pass@k指标。除了算法上的贡献之外，我们还对RL学习动态进行了分析，并确定了Pass@k的经验上限，从而揭示了基于RL的推理模型在探索能力方面的内在限制。我们的研究结果表明，交替使用RL和IRL是一种有效的方法来扩展推理型大语言模型的探索能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Memp: Exploring Agent Procedural Memory
papers.title_zh: Memp：探索智能体程序性记忆机制
papers.authors: Runnan Fang, Yuan Liang, Xiaobin Wang, Jialong Wu, Shuofei Qiao, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang, Huajun Chen, Ningyu Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) based agents excel at diverse tasks, yet they suffer from brittle procedural memory that is manually engineered or entangled in static parameters. In this work, we investigate strategies to endow agents with a learnable, updatable, and lifelong procedural memory. We propose a procedural-memory repository that distills past agent trajectories into both fine-grained, step-by-step instructions and higher-level, script-like abstractions. Coupled with a dynamic regimen that continuously updates, corrects, and deprecates its contents, this repository evolves in lockstep with new experience. Empirical evaluation on TravelPlanner and Alfworld shows that as the memory repository is refined, agents achieve steadily higher success rates and greater efficiency on analogous tasks. Moreover, procedural memory built from a stronger model retains its value: migrating the procedural memory to a weaker model yields substantial performance gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在多种任务中表现出色，但它们存在脆弱的程序性记忆问题，这种记忆需要通过人工干预来构建，或者依赖于静态参数。在这项研究中，我们探讨了为智能体赋予可学习、可更新且终身有效的程序性记忆的策略。我们提出了一种程序性记忆存储库，它将智能体的过往行为分解为细粒度的逐步指导以及更高层次的脚本式抽象。结合一个动态更新的机制，该存储库能够随着新经验的产生而不断进化。在TravelPlanner和Alfworld上的实证评估表明，随着记忆存储库的不断完善，智能体在类似任务中的成功率不断提高，效率也得到提升。此外，从更强大的模型中提取出的程序性记忆仍然具有价值：将其迁移到较弱的模型中仍能带来显著的性能提升。

papers.title: ATLAS: Orchestrating Heterogeneous Models and Tools for Multi-Domain Complex Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ATLAS：协调各种异构模型与工具，以实现多领域复杂推理
papers.authors: Jinyang Wu, Guocheng Zhai, Ruihan Jin, Jiahao Yuan, Yuhao Shen, Shuai Zhang, Zhengqi Wen, Jianhua Tao
papers.abstract: The integration of large language models (LLMs) with external tools has significantly expanded the capabilities of AI agents. However, as the diversity of both LLMs and tools increases, selecting the optimal model-tool combination becomes a high-dimensional optimization challenge. Existing approaches often rely on a single model or fixed tool-calling logic, failing to exploit the performance variations across heterogeneous model-tool pairs. In this paper, we present ATLAS (Adaptive Tool-LLM Alignment and Synergistic Invocation), a dual-path framework for dynamic tool usage in cross-domain complex reasoning. ATLAS operates via a dual-path approach: (1) training-free cluster-based routing that exploits empirical priors for domain-specific alignment, and (2) RL-based multi-step routing that explores autonomous trajectories for out-of-distribution generalization. Extensive experiments across 15 benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms closed-source models like GPT-4o as well as existing routing methods on both in-distribution (+10.1%) and out-of-distribution (+13.1%) tasks. Furthermore, our framework shows significant gains in visual reasoning by orchestrating specialized multi-modal tools.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型与外部工具的整合显著提升了AI代理的能力。然而，随着LLM和工具种类的不断增加，选择最优的模型与工具组合成为了一个高维优化挑战。现有的方法往往依赖于单一模型或固定的工具调用逻辑，无法充分利用不同模型与工具组合之间的性能差异。在本文中，我们提出了ATLAS（自适应工具-语言模型对齐与协同调用）这一双路径框架，用于跨领域复杂推理中的动态工具使用。ATLAS采用双路径方式运作：(1)无需训练的基于簇的路由机制，利用经验性先验进行特定领域的对齐处理；(2)基于强化学习的多步路由机制，探索自主化的路径以实现跨域泛化。通过在15个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在域内任务（+10.1%）和域外任务（+13.1%）上的表现均优于像GPT-4o这样的闭源模型以及现有的路由方法。此外，我们的框架在视觉推理方面也表现出显著优势，通过协调专门的多模态工具实现了显著的性能提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SWE-AGILE: A Software Agent Framework for Efficiently Managing Dynamic Reasoning Context
papers.title_zh: SWE-AGILE：一种用于高效管理动态推理环境的软件代理框架
papers.authors: Shuquan Lian, Juncheng Liu, Yazhe Chen, Yuhong Chen, Hui Li
papers.abstract: Prior representative ReAct-style approaches in autonomous Software Engineering (SWE) typically lack the explicit System-2 reasoning required for deep analysis and handling complex edge cases. While recent reasoning models demonstrate the potential of extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT), applying them to the multi-turn SWE task creates a fundamental dilemma: retaining full reasoning history leads to context explosion and “Lost-in-the-Middle” degradation, while discarding it would force the agent to redundantly re-reason at every step. To address these challenges, we propose SWE-AGILE, a novel software agent framework designed to bridge the gap between reasoning depth, efficiency, and context constraints. SWE-AGILE introduces a Dynamic Reasoning Context strategy, maintaining a “sliding window” of detailed reasoning for immediate continuity to prevent redundant re-analyzing, while compressing historical reasoning content into concise Reasoning Digests. Empirically, SWE-AGILE sets a new standard for 7B-8B models on SWE-Bench-Verified using only 2.2k trajectories and 896 tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/KDEGroup/SWE-AGILE.
papers.abstract_zh: 在自主软件工程领域，传统的代表方法通常缺乏进行深度分析和处理复杂边缘案例所需的系统级推理能力。虽然最近的推理模型展示了扩展思维链推理的潜力，但将其应用于多轮软件工程任务时却面临一个根本性的难题：保留完整的推理历史会导致上下文爆炸和“迷失在中间”的问题，而丢弃这些推理记录则会导致代理在每一步都不得不重复进行推理。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SWE-AGILE这一新型软件代理框架，旨在平衡推理深度、效率与上下文限制之间的矛盾。SWE-AGILE采用了动态推理上下文策略，通过维护一个详细的推理“滑动窗口”来确保推理的连续性，从而避免重复分析；同时，它将历史推理内容压缩成简洁的推理摘要。实验结果表明，仅使用2.2k条轨迹和896个任务，SWE-AGILE就能为7B-8B规模的软件工程模型树立新的标准。相关代码可访问https://github.com/KDEGroup/SWE-AGILE。

papers.title: CAR: Empowering Agents with Dynamic Tool Synthesis and Global Trajectory Rectification
papers.title_zh: CAR：通过动态工具合成和全局轨迹修正来赋能代理角色
papers.authors: Kai Wang, Xu Wang, Zhiyuan Fu, Yudong Zhang, Yang Wang
papers.abstract: While current LLM agents utilizing paradigms like ReAct or Plan-and-Solve have established a strong foundation for step-by-step reasoning, they remain brittle in open-ended environments due to two intrinsic limitations: (1) A closed action space: These frameworks are confined to static, pre-defined toolsets, rendering them unable to adapt when required tools are missing or obsolete. (2) Myopic error recovery: Existing agents often get trapped in repetitive local retries, failing to diagnose and rectify root causes within the high-level plan. To overcome these limitations, we introduce CAR (Create And Replan), a novel architecture that incorporates a meta-tool synthesizer to dynamically augment the action space and a reflective replanning mechanism to revise global strategies. To rigorously evaluate our approach, we release ToolHop-Pro, a diagnostic benchmark with systematically pruned toolsets to simulate tool scarcity. Experiments demonstrate that CAR significantly outperforms representative baselines, validating its superior robustness where static agents fail. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Zaiz-77/car.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然目前使用ReAct或Plan-and-Solve等范式的大语言模型代理已经为逐步推理打下了坚实的基础，但在开放环境中它们仍然存在两个固有的局限性：(1) 封闭的动作空间：这些框架局限于静态的、预定义的工具集，因此当所需的工具缺失或过时时，它们无法做出适应性的调整。(2) 短视的错误恢复能力：现有的代理往往陷入重复的局部重试中，无法诊断并纠正高层计划中的根本问题。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了CAR（Create And Replan）这一创新架构。该架构包含一个元工具合成器，用于动态扩展动作空间；同时具备一种反思性重新规划机制，以修正全局策略。为了严格评估我们的方法，我们开发了ToolHop-Pro这一诊断基准测试，该测试通过系统性的工具集剪枝来模拟工具短缺的情况。实验结果表明，CAR在性能上显著优于同类基准测试，证明了其在静态代理失败情况下的卓越鲁棒性。代码和数据的下载链接为https://github.com/Zaiz-77/car。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FastDiSS: Few-step Match Many-step Diffusion Language Model on Sequence-to-Sequence Generation
papers.title_zh: FastDiSS：多步扩散语言模型在序列到序列生成任务中的应用
papers.authors: Dat Nguyen Cong, Tung Kieu, Hoang Thanh-Tung
papers.abstract: Self-conditioning has been central to the success of continuous diffusion language models, as it allows models to correct previous errors. Yet its ability degrades precisely in the regime where diffusion is most attractive for deployment: few-step sampling for fast inference. In this study, we show that when models only have a few denoising steps, inaccurate self-conditioning induces a substantial approximation gap; this mistake compounds across denoising steps and ultimately dominate the sample quality. To address this, we propose a novel training framework that handles these errors during learning by perturbing the self-conditioning signal to match inference noise, improving robustness to prior estimation errors. In addition, we introduce a token-level noise-awareness mechanism that prevents training from saturation, hence improving optimization. Extensive experiments across conditional generation benchmarks demonstrate that our framework surpasses standard continuous diffusion models while providing up to 400x faster inference speed, and remains competitive against other one-step diffusion frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 自我调节机制一直是连续扩散语言模型成功的关键所在，因为它使得模型能够纠正之前的错误。然而，这种能力在扩散技术最适用于快速推理的少步采样场景中会逐渐下降。在这项研究中，我们发现当模型只有少数几个去噪步骤时，不准确的自我调节会导致显著的近似误差；这种错误会在多个去噪步骤中累积，最终严重影响样本质量。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的训练框架，该框架通过在学习过程中调整自我调节信号来匹配推理噪声，从而改善模型对先前估计错误的鲁棒性。此外，我们还引入了一种令牌级噪声感知机制，防止训练陷入饱和状态，从而提升优化效果。通过大量条件生成基准测试的实验表明，我们的框架不仅优于传统的连续扩散模型，其推理速度还快了400倍，并且与其他一步扩散框架相比仍然具有竞争力。

papers.title: GCIG: GraphRAG-based Cross-document Instruction Generation for Boosting LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: GCIG：基于GraphRAG的跨文档指令生成技术，旨在提升大语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Xiaoliang Xu, Huang Yuan, Junmei Wang, Can Xu
papers.abstract: Automatic instruction generation offers a low-cost, high-efficiency pathway for fine-tuning large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods struggle in knowledge-intensive domains and complex reasoning tasks due to their dependence on high-quality seed data, limited coverage of single-document knowledge, and repetitive content. To overcome these limitations, this paper presents GCIG, a GraphRAG-based Cross-document Instruction Generation framework. We begin by constructing an enhanced knowledge graph to provide a structural representation of the raw corpus, followed by LLM-driven selection of reliable subgraph-text pairs based on factuality and logical complementarity. Subsequently, we adaptively generate diverse questions through task-aware prompts and context-sensitive retrieval. Finally, we employ Chain-of-Thought reasoning to anchor entity paths and integrate scattered evidence, thereby closing logical gaps and improving answer coherence. Experiments on knowledge-intensive and multi-hop question-answering tasks demonstrate that GCIG outperforms existing methods, producing instruction data with stronger logical consistency and broader knowledge coverage for effective LLM fine-tuning. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/WhitEiller/GCIG.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动指令生成为微调大语言模型提供了一种低成本、高效的方法。然而，现有方法在知识密集型领域和复杂推理任务中表现不佳，因为它们依赖于高质量的种子数据、对单文档知识的覆盖有限，且内容存在重复现象。为了克服这些限制，本文提出了一种基于GraphRAG的跨文档指令生成框架——GCIG。我们首先构建一个增强的知识图谱，为原始文本提供结构化的表示；然后利用LLM根据事实性和逻辑互补性来选取可靠的子图-文本对。接着，我们通过任务感知的提示和上下文敏感的检索来生成多样化的问题。最后，通过思维链推理来确定实体路径，并整合分散的证据信息，从而填补逻辑上的空白并提高答案的连贯性。在知识密集型和多跳问答任务的实验中表明，GCIG在逻辑一致性和知识覆盖方面均优于现有方法，能够生成适用于有效LLM微调的指令数据。代码和数据可在https://github.com/WhitEiller/GCIG上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Towards General Agentic Intelligence via Environment Scaling
papers.title_zh: 通过环境扩展实现通用智能代理
papers.authors: Runnan Fang, Shihao Cai, Baixuan Li, Jialong Wu, Guangyu Li, Wenbiao Yin, Xinyu Wang, Xiaobin Wang, Liangcai Su, Zhen Zhang, Shibin Wu, Zhengwei Tao, Yong Jiang, Pengjun Xie, Ningyu Zhang, Fei Huang, Wentao Zhang, Jingren Zhou
papers.abstract: Advanced agentic intelligence is a prerequisite for deploying Large Language Models in practical, real-world applications. Diverse real-world APIs demand precise, robust function-calling intelligence, which needs agents to develop these capabilities through interaction in varied environments. The breadth of function-calling competence is closely tied to the diversity of environments in which agents are trained. In this work, we scale up environments as a step towards advancing general agentic intelligence. This gives rise to two central challenges: (i) how to scale environments in a principled manner, and (ii) how to effectively train agentic capabilities from experiences derived through interactions with these environments. To address these, we design a scalable framework that automatically constructs heterogeneous environments that are fully simulated, broadening the space of function-calling scenarios. We further adapt a two-phase agent fine-tuning strategy: first endowing agents with fundamental agentic capabilities, then specializing them for domain-specific contexts. Extensive experiments on agentic benchmarks, -bench, -Bench, and ACEBench, demonstrate that our trained model, AgentScaler, significantly enhances the models’ function-calling capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 先进的智能体技术是在实际应用场景中部署大语言模型的必备条件。现实世界中的各种应用程序需要精确且强大的函数调用能力，这就要求智能体通过在不同环境中进行交互来发展这些能力。函数调用能力的广度与智能体训练所涉及的环境的多样性密切相关。在这项研究中，我们通过扩大环境规模来提升整体智能体的能力。但这也带来了两个主要挑战：(i) 如何以合理的方式扩展环境规模；(ii) 如何有效地从与这些环境交互中获得的经验中训练出智能体的能力。为了解决这些问题，我们设计了一个可扩展的框架，该框架能够自动构建完全模拟的异构环境，从而拓宽函数调用场景的边界。我们还采用了一种分阶段的智能体微调策略：首先赋予智能体基本的能力，然后针对特定领域的情况对其进行专门训练。在多个智能体基准测试平台上的广泛实验表明，我们的训练模型AgentScaler显著提升了模型的函数调用能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: EAIR: Entity-aware Inference-Time Knowledge Routing for Multi-Hop Knowledge Editing
papers.title_zh: EAIR：基于实体感知的推理时间知识路由技术，用于多跳知识编辑
papers.authors: Jungyu Lee, Kunhui Lee, Gyun Lee, Seung-Hoon Na
papers.abstract: Existing in-context editing (ICE) methods for multi-hop knowledge editing commonly suffer from paraphrase sensitivity, which refers to the phenomenon where these methods are not sufficiently robust to paraphrased multi-hop questions. To improve retrieval accuracy and knowledge routing to address paraphrase sensitivity, this paper proposes a novel entity-aware inference-time knowledge routing method, referred to as EAIR, which consists of four major steps: 1) Entity-referential query decomposition, which decomposes the original question into multiple entity-referential sub-question instructions; 2) Entity-aware retrieval, which leverages the previously reference-resolved topic entity in the retrieval step; 3) Evidence-conditioned contrastive decoding, which discourages the model from relying on its parametric knowledge and steers the model toward following retrieved edits; 4) Reflection-based knowledge routing, which additionally filters decoding results using refusal-style reflection to mitigate the risk introduced by contrastive decoding. Experimental results across the MQuAKE benchmark family and model scales show that EAIR achieves the highest strict case accuracy in 11 of 12 settings, substantially reducing paraphrase sensitivity.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的多跳知识编辑方法普遍存在释义敏感性的问题，即这些方法在面对被释义的多跳问题时表现不够稳健。为了提升检索准确性和知识路由的可靠性，本文提出了一种新颖的实体感知推理时间知识路由方法，称为EAIR。该方法包含四个主要步骤：1）实体引用查询分解，将原始问题分解为多个实体引用子问题；2）实体感知检索，利用之前通过引用解析得到的主题实体进行检索；3）证据条件对比解码，避免模型依赖其参数化知识，引导模型遵循检索到的编辑结果；4）基于反思的知识路由，通过采用拒绝式反思来过滤解码结果，从而减轻对比解码带来的风险。在MQuAKE基准测试系列和不同模型规模下的实验结果表明，EAIR在12种情况下中有11种情况下的准确率达到了最高水平，显著降低了释义敏感性的问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Preventing Safety Drift in Large Language Models via Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints
papers.title_zh: 通过联合使用权重和激活约束来防止大型语言模型中的安全性问题
papers.authors: Songping Peng, Zhiheng Zhang, Daojian Zeng, Lincheng Jiang, Xieping Gao
papers.abstract: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) remains highly fragile during fine-tuning, where even benign adaptation can degrade pre-trained refusal behaviors and enable harmful responses. Existing defenses typically constrain either weights or activations in isolation, without considering their coupled effects on safety. In this paper, we first theoretically demonstrate that constraining either weights or activations alone is insufficient for safety preservation. To robustly preserve safety alignment, we propose Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints (CWAC), a novel approach that simultaneously enforces a precomputed safety subspace on weight updates and applies targeted regularization to safety-critical features identified by sparse autoencoders. Extensive experiments across four widely used LLMs and diverse downstream tasks show that CWAC consistently achieves the lowest harmful scores with minimal impact on fine-tuning accuracy, substantially outperforming strong baselines even under high harmful data ratios.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型（LLM）的微调过程中，安全性对齐仍然非常脆弱。即使是很温和的适应性调整也可能破坏预训练阶段形成的拒绝行为机制，从而导致有害的响应。现有的防御措施通常只限制权重或激活值，而忽略了它们之间的相互作用对安全性的影响。在本文中，我们首先从理论上证明，单独限制权重或激活值不足以确保安全性。为了有效维护安全性对齐，我们提出了“耦合权重和激活约束”方法。这种方法同时作用于权重更新，并对由稀疏自编码器识别出的关键安全特征进行有针对性的正则化处理。通过针对四种广泛使用的LLM以及多种下游任务进行的实验表明，该方法能够在不影响微调精度的情况下，始终获得最低的危害分数，其性能甚至优于一些强大的基线方法，尤其是在高危害数据比例的情况下。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GAPO: Robust Advantage Estimation for Real-World Code LLMs
papers.title_zh: GAPO：适用于现实场景的代码生成大型语言模型的高效优势估计方法
papers.authors: Jianqing Zhang, Zhezheng Hao, Wei Xia, Hande Dong, Hong Wang, Chenxing Wei, Yuyan Zhou, Yubin Qi, Qiang Lin, Jian Cao
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used for post-training large language models (LLMs) in code editing, where group-relative methods, such as GRPO, are popular due to their critic-free and normalized advantage estimation. However, in real-world code-editing scenarios, reward distributions are often skewed with unpredictable noise, leading to distorted advantage computation and increased rollout outliers. To address this issue, we propose Group Adaptive Policy Optimization (GAPO), which adaptively finds an interval with the highest SNR (Signal to Noise Ratio) per prompt and uses the median of that interval as an adaptive Q to replace the group mean in advantage calculation to reduce noise further. This adaptive Q robustly handles rollout noise while remaining plug-and-play and efficient. We evaluate GAPO on nine instruction-tuned LLMs (3B–14B) using a collected large dataset of 51,844 real-world, history-aware code-editing tasks spanning 10 programming languages. GAPO yields up to 4.35 in-domain (ID) and 5.30 out-of-domain (OOD) exact-match improvements over GRPO and its variant DAPO, while achieving lower clipping ratios and higher GPU throughput. Code: https://github.com/TsingZ0/verl-GAPO
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在大语言模型训练后的代码编辑中得到了广泛应用。其中，基于群体相对的方法如GRPO因其无需评论家评估且能进行标准化优势估计而受到青睐。然而，在实际的代码编辑场景中，奖励分布往往存在偏斜现象，并会受到不可预测噪声的影响，从而导致优势计算出现偏差，进而增加异常值的发生。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了群体自适应策略优化算法GAPO。该算法能够自适应地找到每个提示下信噪比最高的区间，并将该区间的中位数作为自适应Q值来替代优势计算中的群体均值，从而进一步减少噪声的影响。这种自适应Q值机制能够稳健地处理发布阶段的噪声问题，同时保持即插即用和高效性。我们在9种经过指令调优的大语言模型（3B到14B规模）上进行了GAPO的测试，使用了包含51,844个真实世界、考虑历史信息的代码编辑任务的庞大数据集，这些任务涵盖了10种编程语言。与GRPO及其变体DAPO相比，GAPO在域内准确率上提升了4.35倍，在域外准确率上提升了5.30倍。同时，GAPO还实现了更低的裁剪比率和更高的GPU处理速度。代码链接：https://github.com/TsingZ0/verl-GAPO
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: What’s Missing in Screen-to-Action? Towards a UI-in-the-Loop Paradigm for Multimodal GUI Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 屏幕与动作之间缺少了什么？——迈向一种适用于多模态图形用户界面推理的“界面在运行过程中进行调节”范式
papers.authors: Songze Li, Xiaoke Guo, Tianqi Liu, Biao Yi, Zhaoyan Gong, Zhiqiang Liu, Huajun Chen, Wen Zhang
papers.abstract: Existing Graphical User Interface (GUI) reasoning tasks remain challenging, particularly in UI understanding. Current methods typically rely on direct screen-based decision-making, which lacks interpretability and overlooks a comprehensive understanding of UI elements, ultimately leading to task failure. To enhance the understanding and interaction with UIs, we propose an innovative GUI reasoning paradigm called UI-in-the-Loop (UILoop). Our approach treats the GUI reasoning task as a cyclic Screen-UI elements-Action process. By enabling Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to explicitly learn the localization, semantic functions, and practical usage of key UI elements, UILoop achieves precise element discovery and performs interpretable reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a more challenging UI Comprehension task centered on UI elements with three evaluation metrics. Correspondingly, we contribute a benchmark of 26K samples (UI Comprehension-Bench) to comprehensively evaluate existing methods’ mastery of UI elements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UILoop achieves state-of-the-art UI understanding performance while yielding superior results in GUI reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的图形用户界面（GUI）推理任务仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在用户界面理解方面。当前的方法通常依赖于直接的屏幕决策，这种方式缺乏可解释性，并且未能全面理解用户界面元素，最终导致任务失败。为了增强对用户界面的理解和交互能力，我们提出了一种创新的GUI推理范式，称为“在循环中处理用户界面”（UI-in-the-Loop，UILoop）。我们的方法将GUI推理任务视为一个循环的过程：屏幕-用户界面元素-动作。通过让多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能够明确学习关键用户界面元素的定位、语义功能以及实际用途，UILoop能够实现精确的元素发现，并执行可解释的推理过程。此外，我们还引入了一个更具挑战性的用户界面理解任务，该任务以用户界面元素为中心，并配备了三个评估指标。相应地，我们创建了一个包含26K样本的数据集（UI Comprehension-Bench），以全面评估现有方法在理解用户界面元素方面的能力。大量的实验表明，UILoop在用户界面理解方面取得了最先进的性能，同时在GUI推理任务中也取得了卓越的成绩。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When to Trust Tools? Adaptive Tool Trust Calibration For Tool-Integrated Math Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 何时信任工具？自适应工具信任校准技术——用于工具集成数学推理领域
papers.authors: Ruotao Xu, Yixin Ji, Yu Luo, Jinpeng Li, Dong Li, Peifeng Li, Juntao Li, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved strong performance enhancement through scaling test time computation, but due to the inherent limitations of the underlying language models, they still have shortcomings in tasks that require precise computation and extensive knowledge reserves. Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) has emerged as a promising paradigm that incorporates tool call and execution within the reasoning trajectory. Although recent works have released some powerful open-source TIR models, our analysis reveals that these models still suffer from critical deficiencies. We find that when the reasoning of the model conflicts with the tool results, the model tends to believe in its own reasoning. And there are cases where the tool results are correct but are ignored by the model, resulting in incorrect answers, which we define as “Tool Ignored”. This indicates that the model does not know when to trust or ignore the tool. To overcome these limitations, We introduce Adaptive Tool Trust Calibration (ATTC), a novel framework that guides the model to adaptively choose to trust or ignore the tool results based on the confidence score of generated code blocks. The experimental results from various open-source TIR models of different sizes and across multiple datasets demonstrate that ATTC effectively reduces the “Tool Ignored” issue, resulting in a performance increase of 4.1% to 7.5%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在通过扩展测试时间计算来提升性能方面取得了显著成效，但由于底层语言模型的固有局限性，它们在需要精确计算和大量知识储备的任务中仍然存在不足。工具集成推理作为一种有前景的范式应运而生，它將工具调用与执行过程整合到了推理流程中。尽管最近有一些开源的TIR模型表现优异，但我们的分析表明，这些模型仍存在严重缺陷。我们发现，当模型的推理结果与工具的结果发生冲突时，模型往往倾向于相信自己的推理结果。此外，有时工具的结果是正确的，但被模型忽略了，从而导致错误的答案产生，我们将这种情况定义为“工具被忽略”。这表明模型无法判断何时应该信任或忽略工具的结果。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了自适应工具信任校准这一新框架，该框架能够引导模型根据生成代码块的置信度来自适应地选择是否信任工具的结果。来自不同规模的开源TIR模型以及多个数据集的实验结果表明，自适应工具信任校准有效减少了“工具被忽略”的问题，使模型性能提升了4.1%到7.5%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: V-MAGE: A Game Evaluation Framework for Assessing Vision-Centric Capabilities in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: V-MAGE：一种用于评估多模态大型语言模型中视觉核心能力的游戏化评估框架
papers.authors: Xiangxi Zheng, Linjie Li, Zhengyuan Yang, Ping Yu, Alex Jinpeng Wang, Rui Yan, Yuan Yao, Lijuan Wang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in visual-text processing. However, existing static image-text benchmarks are insufficient for evaluating their dynamic perception and interactive reasoning abilities. We introduce Vision-centric Multiple Abilities Game Evaluation (V-MAGE), a novel game-based evaluation framework designed to systematically assess MLLMs’ visual reasoning in interactive, continuous-space environments. V-MAGE features five distinct video games comprising over 30 carefully constructed evaluation scenarios. These scenarios are set in free-form, visually complex environments that require models to interpret dynamic game states and make decisions based solely on visual input, thereby closely reflecting the conditions encountered by human players. To ensure robust and interpretable comparisons across models, V-MAGE employs a dynamic ELO-based ranking system that accounts for varying difficulty levels and task diversity. Benchmarking state-of-the-art MLLMs against human baselines reveals that while leading models approach human-level performance in simple tasks, their performance drops significantly in complex scenarios requiring advanced reasoning and task orchestration. This persistent performance gap highlights fundamental limitations in current MLLMs’ ability to perform vision-grounded, interactive frame-by-frame control in simulated continuous-time environments. Through extensive analyses, we demonstrate the utility of V-MAGE in uncovering these limitations and providing actionable insights for improving the visual and reasoning capabilities of MLLMs in dynamic, interactive settings. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/CSU-JPG/V-MAGE.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在多模态大语言模型领域取得的进展表明，这些模型在视觉-文本处理方面具有令人印象深刻的能力。然而，现有的静态图像-文本基准测试不足以评估它们的动态感知和交互式推理能力。我们提出了一种名为“以视觉为中心的多项能力游戏评估”的新颖评估框架，该框架旨在系统地评估多模态大语言模型在交互式、连续空间环境中的视觉推理能力。V-MAGE包含五款不同的电子游戏，共有30个精心设计的评估场景。这些场景设置在自由形态、视觉上复杂的环境中，要求模型能够解读动态的游戏状态，并仅基于视觉输入做出决策，从而紧密反映人类玩家所面临的实际情况。为了确保不同模型之间的稳健且可解释的比较，V-MAGE采用了基于动态ELO的排名系统，该系统能够考虑到不同难度级别和任务多样性。通过将最先进的多模态大语言模型与人类基准测试进行对比，我们发现，虽然领先模型在简单任务中能够达到人类水平的表现，但在需要高级推理和任务协调的复杂场景中，它们的表现显著下降。这种持续的性能差距凸显了当前多模态大语言模型在模拟连续时间环境中进行基于视觉的交互式逐帧控制的能力存在根本限制。通过广泛的分析，我们证明了V-MAGE在揭示这些限制方面的作用，并为提高多模态大语言模型在动态、交互式环境中的视觉和推理能力提供了可行的建议。相关代码可在https://github.com/CSU-JPG/V-MAGE获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
