papers.title: Understanding and Preventing Entropy Collapse in RLVR with On-Policy Entropy Flow Optimization
papers.title_zh: 理解并预防RLVR中的熵崩溃问题——采用在线策略熵流优化方法
papers.authors: Huimin Xu, Shuai Zhao, Xiaobao Wu, Anh Tuan Luu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models. However, widely used RLVR algorithms, such as GRPO, often suffer from entropy collapse, leading to premature determinism and unstable optimization. Existing remedies, including entropy regularization and ratio-based clipping heuristics, either control entropy in a coarse-grained manner or rely on approximate on-policy training. In this paper, we revisit entropy collapse from a token-level entropy flow perspective. Our analysis reveals that entropy-decreasing tokens consistently outweigh entropy-increasing ones, resulting in a severely imbalanced entropy flow. This perspective provides a unified explanation of entropy collapse in existing RLVR algorithms and highlights the importance of balancing entropy dynamics. Motivated by this analysis, we propose On-Policy Entropy Flow Optimization (OPEFO), an adaptive entropy flow balancing mechanism that rescales entropy-increasing and entropy-decreasing updates according to their contributions to entropy change, while remaining strict on-policy. Experiments on six mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that OPEFO improves training stability and final performance. We will release the code and models upon publication.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的一种有效方法。然而，诸如GRPO这样的常用RLVR算法常常出现熵崩溃问题，导致系统过早陷入确定性状态，并引发优化不稳定性的问题。现有的解决方案，包括熵正则化和基于比率的剪裁策略等，要么以粗放的方式控制熵值，要么依赖于近似的在线策略训练方法。在本文中，我们从令牌级熵流的角度重新审视了熵崩溃现象。我们的分析表明，降低熵的令牌始终多于增加熵的令牌，从而导致熵流严重失衡。这一视角为现有RLVR算法中的熵崩溃问题提供了统一的解释，并强调了平衡熵动态的重要性。基于这一分析，我们提出了在线策略熵流优化算法（OPEFO），这是一种自适应熵流平衡机制，能够根据熵变化的贡献来重新调整增加熵和减少熵的更新操作，同时仍然严格遵循在线策略的要求。在六个数学推理基准测试上的实验表明，OPEFO能够改善训练的稳定性和最终性能。我们将在论文发表后发布相关代码和模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Semantic Rewards Enables Low-Resource Language Expansion without Alignment Tax
papers.title_zh: 基于语义奖励的强化学习能够实现低资源语言扩展，而无需进行对齐处理
papers.authors: Zeli Su, Ziyin Zhang, Zhou Liu, Xuexian Song, Zhankai Xu, Longfei Zheng, Xiaolu Zhang, Rong Fu, Guixian Xu, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: Extending large language models (LLMs) to low-resource languages often incurs an “align- ment tax”: improvements in the target lan- guage come at the cost of catastrophic forget- ting in general capabilities. We argue that this trade-off arises from the rigidity of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which enforces token-level surface imitation on narrow and biased data distributions. To address this limitation, we propose a semantic-space alignment paradigm powered by Group Relative Policy Optimiza- tion (GRPO), where the model is optimized us- ing embedding-level semantic rewards rather than likelihood maximization. This objective encourages meaning preservation through flex- ible realizations, enabling controlled updates that reduce destructive interference with pre- trained knowledge. We evaluate our approach on Tibetan–Chinese machine translation and Ti- betan headline generation. Experiments show that our method acquires low-resource capa- bilities while markedly mitigating alignment tax, preserving general competence more effec- tively than SFT. Despite producing less rigid surface overlap, semantic RL yields higher se- mantic quality and preference in open-ended generation, and few-shot transfer results indi- cate that it learns more transferable and ro- bust representations under limited supervision. Overall, our study demonstrates that reinforce- ment learning with semantic rewards provides a safer and more reliable pathway for inclusive low-resource language expansion.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型扩展到资源匮乏的语言时，通常会面临“对齐成本”的问题：目标语言的改进会以一般能力的严重遗忘为代价。我们认为，这种权衡源于有监督微调的刚性特性，它有意识地在狭窄且带有偏见的语料库上进行词级表面模仿。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种基于群体相对策略优化的语义空间对齐方法。在这种方法中，模型通过嵌入级别的语义奖励来优化，而非通过似然最大化来实现。这一目标有助于通过灵活的实现方式保留意义，从而能够进行控制性更新，减少与预训练知识的破坏性冲突。我们在藏汉机器翻译和藏文标题生成任务上评估了我们的方法。实验表明，我们的方法在提升资源匮乏语言能力的同时，显著降低了对齐成本，其效果优于有监督微调。尽管产生的表面相似性较低，但语义强化学习在开放性问题生成和少量样本迁移任务中表现出更高的语义质量和偏好。结果表明，在有限的监督条件下，该方法能够学习到更具迁移性和鲁棒性的表示。总体而言，我们的研究证明了，结合语义奖励的强化学习为包容性资源匮乏语言扩展提供了一种更安全、更可靠的途径。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MEIC-DT: Memory-Efficient Incremental Clustering for Long-Text Coreference Resolution with Dual-Threshold Constraints
papers.title_zh: MEIC-DT：一种高效的内存型增量聚类算法，适用于具有双重阈值约束的长文本共指消解问题
papers.authors: Kangyang Luo, Shuzheng Si, Yuzhuo Bai, Cheng Gao, Zhitong Wang, Cheng Huang, Yingli Shen, Yufeng Han, Wenhao Li, Cunliang Kong, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: In the era of large language models (LLMs), supervised neural methods remain the state-of-the-art (SOTA) for Coreference Resolution. Yet, their full potential is underexplored, particularly in incremental clustering, which faces the critical challenge of balancing efficiency with performance for long texts. To address the limitation, we propose MEIC-DT, a novel dual-threshold, memory-efficient incremental clustering approach based on a lightweight Transformer. MEIC-DT features a dual-threshold constraint mechanism designed to precisely control the Transformer’s input scale within a predefined memory budget. This mechanism incorporates two key components: a Statistics-Aware Eviction Strategy (SAES) and an Internal Regularization Policy (IRP). The SAES utilizes distinct statistical profiles from the training and inference phases for intelligent cache management. The IRP strategically condenses clusters by selecting the most representative mentions, thereby preserving semantic integrity. Extensive experiments on common benchmarks demonstrate that MEIC-DT achieves highly competitive coreference performance under stringent memory constraints.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型时代，监督式神经方法仍然是核心互指解析领域的最先进技术。然而，这些方法的全部潜力尚未得到充分探索，尤其是在增量聚类方面，由于需要同时兼顾效率和性能，因此面临着巨大的挑战。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了MEIC-DT这一基于轻量级Transformer的新颖双阈值、内存高效的增量聚类方法。MEIC-DT采用了一种双阈值约束机制，该机制能够精确控制Transformer的输入规模，同时保持在预定义的内存预算之内。该机制包含两个关键组件：统计感知淘汰策略和内部正则化政策。统计感知淘汰策略利用训练阶段和推理阶段的统计特征来智能管理缓存资源；而内部正则化政策则通过选择最具代表性的提及项来策略性地压缩簇，从而保持语义的完整性。在常见的基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，MEIC-DT在严格的内存限制下仍能取得非常出色的核心互指解析性能。

papers.title: Lost in Diffusion: Uncovering Hallucination Patterns and Failure Modes in Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 迷失在扩散过程中：揭示扩散式大型语言模型中的幻觉现象与故障模式
papers.authors: Zhengnan Guo, Fei Tan
papers.abstract: While Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising non-autoregressive paradigm comparable to auto-regressive (AR) models, their faithfulness, specifically regarding hallucination, remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present the first controlled comparative study to evaluate hallucination patterns in dLLMs. Our results demonstrate that current dLLMs exhibit a higher propensity for hallucination than AR counterparts controlled for architecture, scale, and pre-training weights. Furthermore, an analysis of inference-time compute reveals divergent dynamics: while quasi-autoregressive generation suffers from early saturation, non-sequential decoding unlocks potential for continuous refinement. Finally, we identify distinct failure modes unique to the diffusion process, including premature termination, incomplete denoising, and context intrusion. Our findings underscore that although dLLMs have narrowed the performance gap on general tasks, their distinct hallucination mechanisms pose a critical challenge to model reliability.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）作为一种有前景的非自回归范式而崭露头角，其性能与自回归模型相当，但关于它们的准确性，尤其是 hallucinations方面的表现，仍然缺乏深入的研究。为了填补这一空白，我们进行了首次有控制的比较研究，以评估dLLMs在hallucinations方面的表现。我们的研究结果表明，与自回归模型相比，当前的dLLMs在hallucinations方面的表现更为突出，这一点在考虑模型架构、规模以及预训练权重等因素后依然成立。此外，对推理阶段的计算分析显示，dLLMs具有不同的动态特性：虽然准自回归生成方式会导致早期饱和问题，但非顺序解码则能够带来持续优化的可能性。最后，我们发现了一些独特的失败模式，比如过早终止、去噪不完全以及上下文干扰等问题。我们的研究结果表明，尽管dLLMs在一般任务上的性能有所提升，但它们独特的hallucinations机制给模型的可靠性带来了重大挑战。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FARSS: Fisher-Optimized Adaptive Low-Rank and Singular-Vector Selection for Knowledge-Preserving Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: FARSS：基于 Fisher 优化算法的自适应低秩分解与奇异向量选择方法，适用于知识保留型微调任务
papers.authors: Renxing Chen, Ziwei Xiang, Peisong Wang, Hongjian Fang, Meng Li, Fanhu Zeng, Yanan Zhu, Peipei Yang, Xu-Yao Zhang, Jian Cheng
papers.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a prevalent approach for adapting large language models (LLMs). However, low-rank adaptation methods face an inherent trade-off: improving target task performance can compromise pre-trained world knowledge, while aggressively constraining updates to preserve world knowledge may hinder improvements in the target task. Furthermore, most current methods fail to account for layer-wise differences in adaptation sensitivity, resulting in suboptimal preservation of world knowledge and task adaptation. To address these challenge, we propose Fisher-Optimized Adaptive Low Rank and Singular-VectorSelection (FARSS), an effective framework for knowledge-preserving fine-tuning. This framework introduces two key innovations. First, we propose a Fisher-guided adaptive rank allocation strategy, which assigns smaller ranks to shallow layers that are critical for preserving world knowledge, and larger ranks to deep layers that are essential for task adaptation. Second, we introduce a task-aware initialization method that integrates singular value information with layer-specific second-order statistics estimated from activation and gradient covariances, enabling efficient and task-sensitive low-rank updates. We evaluated several models across various tasks, and the experimental results show that our approach outperforms existing PEFT methods, including LoRA, Corda, and KaSA, achieving a balance between preserving world knowledge and enhancing target task performance. The code is available at https://github.com/chenyehuang/FARSS.
papers.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）已成为适应大语言模型的一种常用方法。然而，低秩适应方法面临着一个固有的权衡：提高目标任务的性能可能会损害预训练时的世界知识，而过度限制更新以保持世界知识则可能阻碍目标任务的改进。此外，目前大多数方法未能考虑到不同层在适应敏感性上的差异，导致对世界知识的保留和任务适应的效果不尽如人意。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为Fisher优化自适应低秩与奇异值选择的方法（FARSS），这是一种有效的知识保留微调框架。该框架引入了两项关键创新：首先，我们提出了一种基于Fisher优化的自适应秩分配策略，将较小的秩分配给对保留世界知识至关重要的浅层层，而将较大的秩分配给对任务适应至关重要的深层层。其次，我们引入了一种任务感知的初始化方法，该方法结合了奇异值信息与从激活值和梯度协方差中估计出的特定层的二阶统计信息，从而实现高效且针对任务特性的低秩更新。我们对多个模型在不同任务上的表现进行了评估，实验结果表明，我们的方法在保留世界知识和提升目标任务性能之间取得了良好的平衡，其性能优于现有的PEFT方法，包括LoRA、Corda和KaSA。代码可在https://github.com/chenyehuang/FARSS获取。

papers.title: Align Documents to Questions: Question-Oriented Document Rewriting for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 将文档与问题对齐：以问题为导向的文档重写方法，用于检索增强生成技术
papers.authors: Jiaang Li, Zhendong Mao, Quan Wang, Yuning Wan, Yongdong Zhang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the factuality of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating retrieved documents and/or generated context. However, LLMs often exhibit a stylistic bias when presented with mixed contexts, favoring fluent but hallucinated generated content over factually grounded yet disorganized retrieved evidence. This phenomenon reveals that the utility of retrieved information is bottlenecked by its presentation. To bridge this gap, we propose QREAM, a style-controlled rewriter that aligns retrieved documents with a question-oriented style while preserving facts, better for LLM readers to utilize. Our framework consists of two stages: (1) QREAM-ICL, which uses stylistic seeds to guide iterative rewriting exploration; and (2) QREAM-FT, a lightweight student model distilled from denoised ICL outputs. QREAM-FT employs dual-criteria rejection sampling, filtering based on answer correctness and factual consistency to ensure high-quality supervision. QREAM seamlessly integrates into existing RAG pipelines as a plug-and-play module. Experiments demonstrate that QREAM consistently enhances advanced RAG pipelines, yielding up to 8% relative improvement with negligible latency overhead, effectively balancing question relevance with factual grounding.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合检索到的文档和/或生成的上下文，提升了大语言模型（LLM）的真实性。然而，当LLM面对混合上下文时，往往会表现出风格偏向性，更倾向于生成流畅但带有幻觉的内容，而非基于事实但结构混乱的检索结果。这一现象表明，检索信息的效用受到其呈现方式的限制。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了QREAM——一种风格可控的改写工具，它能够将检索到的文档与问题导向的风格相结合，同时保留事实信息，从而更易于LLM用户理解。我们的框架包含两个阶段：(1) QREAM-ICL，利用风格种子来指导迭代式改写过程；(2) QREAM-FT，一个从去噪的ICL输出中提炼出的轻量级学生模型。QREAM-FT采用双标准拒绝采样机制，根据答案正确性和事实一致性进行筛选，以确保高质量的监督效果。QREAM可以无缝集成到现有的RAG流程中，作为即插即用模块使用。实验表明，QREAM能够持续提升高级RAG流程的性能，相对提升幅度可达8%，且延迟开销极小，有效平衡了问题的相关性与事实的准确性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GlimpRouter: Efficient Collaborative Inference by Glimpsing One Token of Thoughts
papers.title_zh: GlimpRouter：通过浏览一个思维片段来实现高效的协同推理
papers.authors: Wenhao Zeng, Xuteng Zhang, Yuling Shi, Chao Hu, Yuting Chen, Beijun Shen, Xiaodong Gu
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve remarkable performance by explicitly generating multi-step chains of thought, but this capability incurs substantial inference latency and computational cost. Collaborative inference offers a promising solution by selectively allocating work between lightweight and large models, yet a fundamental challenge remains: determining when a reasoning step requires the capacity of a large model or the efficiency of a small model. Existing routing strategies either rely on local token probabilities or post-hoc verification, introducing significant inference overhead. In this work, we propose a novel perspective on step-wise collaboration: the difficulty of a reasoning step can be inferred from its very first token. Inspired by the “Aha Moment” phenomenon in LRMs, we show that the entropy of the initial token serves as a strong predictor of step difficulty. Building on this insight, we introduce GlimpRouter, a training-free step-wise collaboration framework. GlimpRouter employs a lightweight model to generate only the first token of each reasoning step and routes the step to a larger model only when the initial token entropy exceeds a threshold. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly reduces inference latency while preserving accuracy. For instance, GlimpRouter attains a substantial 10.7% improvement in accuracy while reducing inference latency by 25.9% compared to a standalone large model on AIME25. These results suggest a simple yet effective mechanism for reasoning: allocating computation based on a glimpse of thought rather than full-step evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型通过明确生成多步骤的思维链来实现出色的性能，但这种能力会带来显著的推理延迟和计算成本。协作推理提供了一种有前景的解决方案，它可以在轻量级模型和大型模型之间选择性地分配任务。然而，仍然存在一个基本挑战：如何判断某个推理步骤需要大型模型的处理能力还是小型模型的效率。现有的路由策略要么依赖于局部令牌概率，要么采用事后验证方式，这会带来显著的推理开销。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的逐步协作方法：一个推理步骤的难度可以从其第一个令牌中推断出来。受“顿悟时刻”现象的启发，我们发现初始令牌的熵可以作为步骤难度的有力预测指标。基于这一洞察，我们引入了GlimpRouter——一个无需训练的逐步协作框架。GlimpRouter使用轻量级模型来生成每个推理步骤的第一个令牌，只有当初始令牌的熵超过某个阈值时，才会将该步骤分配给更大的模型。在多个基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法显著降低了推理延迟，同时保持了准确性。例如，与独立的大型模型相比，GlimpRouter在AIME25数据集上的准确率提高了10.7%，而推理延迟则减少了25.9%。这些结果表明，这是一种简单而有效的推理机制：根据思维的初步印象来分配计算资源，而不是进行完整的步骤评估。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Data Module for Code RL: Adaptive Ambiguity Replay
papers.title_zh: 适用于Code RL的即插即用数据模块：自适应模糊重放技术
papers.authors: Jianqing Zhang, Wei Xia, Zhezheng Hao, Hong Wang, Hande Dong, Qiang Lin, Yang Liu, Jian Cao, Qiang Yang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is effective for improving code generation but suffers from data scarcity. While experience replay mitigates this, existing approaches rely on static, in-epoch metrics that overlook training dynamics, often introducing low-utility or outdated data. Analyzing RL dynamics via dataset cartography, we observe that “ambiguous” samples, which are vital for model generalization, rapidly migrate to “easy-to-learn” regions, diminishing their training value. To address this, we propose Adaptive Ambiguity Replay (A2R) for RL, a plug-and-play module that prioritizes cross-epoch ambiguous samples. To neutralize the noise from stale experiences, A2R incorporates an adaptive importance mechanism based on policy divergence to weigh replayed rollouts. Extensive experiments on nine LLMs (3B–14B) demonstrate that A2R outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on real-world code editing tasks across both unseen and learned domains. Our results highlight cross-epoch ambiguity as a key factor for effective replay in RL. Code: https://github.com/TsingZ0/verl-A2R
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在改进代码生成方面效果显著，但面临数据稀缺的问题。虽然经验回放可以一定程度上缓解这一问题，但现有的方法依赖于静态的、单周期内的指标，这忽略了训练过程中的动态变化，常常导致数据效用低或过时。通过数据集分析，我们发现那些对模型泛化能力至关重要的“模糊”样本，会迅速转移到“易于学习”的区域，从而降低了它们的训练价值。为了应对这个问题，我们提出了自适应模糊回放算法（A2R），这是一种即插即用的模块，能够优先处理跨周期的模糊样本。为了消除陈旧经验的干扰，A2R采用了基于策略差异的自适应重要性机制来权衡回放的尝试。在九个大语言模型中进行的广泛实验表明，A2R在现实世界的代码编辑任务中表现优于最先进的基线方法，无论是在未见领域还是已学领域。我们的研究结果强调了跨周期的模糊性作为强化学习中有效回放的关键因素。代码链接：https://github.com/TsingZ0/verl-A2R
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can AI Revise Research Papers with Human Review Feedback? An Empirical Study and Benchmark
papers.title_zh: 人工智能能否在获得人类审核反馈后修改研究论文？一项实证研究与基准测试
papers.authors: Zihan Luo, Hong Huang, Jianxun Lian, Yu Chang, Xing Xie, Hai Jin
papers.abstract: The rise of Human-AI collaboration can effectively speed up the research process for experts and allow anyone with critical thinking skills to conduct innovative work. A key part of this collaboration is the AI’s ability to improve a paper with human feedback—updating both the text and experiments to meet high standards. To evaluate this skill, we introduce ReviseBench, an extensible benchmark built on real academic data that can be easily scaled via agent-driven automated data collection. It tests the skills of Large Language Models (LLMs) on paper interpretation, experimental implementation, and paper formulation, using authors’ camera-ready versions as natural human baselines. To facilitate a fine-grained assessment, we further propose ReviseArena, a platform supporting pair-wise comparisons between different AI-revised papers. Our initial evaluation results on ReviseBench reveal that even state-of-the-art foundation LLMs struggle significantly in this domain, achieving a win rate of less than 10% against human experts, and facing issues like incremental revision, unprofessional revision, and potential data fabrication. Our code and data are released publicly at: https://github.com/CGCL-codes/ReviseBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类与人工智能合作的兴起能够有效加速专家的研究过程，让任何具备批判性思维能力的人员都能进行创新性的工作。这种合作的关键之处在于，人工智能能够通过人类的反馈来改进论文——更新文本和实验内容，以符合高标准的要求。为了评估这一能力，我们推出了ReviseBench这个基于真实学术数据构建的可扩展基准测试平台，该平台可以通过代理驱动的自动化数据收集方式轻松进行扩展。该测试评估了大语言模型在论文解读、实验实施以及论文撰写方面的能力，使用作者发布的待发表版本作为自然的人类基准。为了进行更细致的评估，我们还提出了ReviseArena平台，该平台支持不同人工智能修改过的论文之间的成对比较。我们在ReviseBench上的初步评估结果显示，即使是最先进的基础型语言模型在这一领域也面临巨大挑战，其战胜人类专家的成功率不足10%，同时还遇到了诸如逐步修改、不专业的修改以及潜在的数据伪造等问题。我们的代码和数据已公开发布，网址为：https://github.com/CGCL-codes/ReviseBench。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Dunhuang-Bench: How Well Do MLLMs Understand Cultural Heritage?
papers.title_zh: 敦煌挑战：大型语言模型对文化遗产的理解程度如何？
papers.authors: Junyi Yuan, Jian Zhang, Tianxiu Yu, Yanlin Zhou, Xiaobo Jin, Qiufeng Wang, Fangyu Wu
papers.abstract: Dunhuang art, a cornerstone of global heritage, demands fine-grained visual perception anchored by specialized cultural knowledge. Given the strong performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on generic multimodal benchmarks, to what extent can they understand artifacts from Dunhuang art that are grounded in cultural context? To this end, we construct Dunhuang-Bench, a large-scale benchmark comprising 486 images and 22,970 QA pairs. It incorporates diverse task formats to evaluate MLLMs’ cultural understanding: Question Answering with Text Description, Multi-turn Dialogue, and Question Answering with Choices. Guided by Panofsky’s theory of iconology, we design two tasks including visual perception and knowledge reasoning for the evaluation of content understanding. In addition, we follow the theory of formal analytic tradition to design another task of artistic appreciation in our Dunhuang-Bench. Extensive evaluations of 20 mainstream MLLMs on Dunhuang-Bench reveal a consistent performance drop from perception and appreciation to reasoning. Moreover, CoT and few-shot prompting show marginal or negative impact, highlighting the limits of prompting-based improvements. Dunhuang-Bench thus provides a challenging benchmark for advancing multimodal cultural understanding. Data and code will be publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 敦煌艺术是全球文化遗产的基石，其欣赏需要基于专业文化知识的精细视觉感知能力。鉴于多模态大语言模型在通用多模态基准测试中的出色表现，它们在多大程度上能够理解那些植根于文化背景的敦煌艺术作品呢？为此，我们构建了敦煌基准测试，该测试集包含486幅图像和22,970对问答对。该测试集采用了多种任务形式来评估大语言模型的文化理解能力：带有文本描述的问答、多轮对话以及带有选项的问答。根据帕诺夫斯基的意象学理论，我们设计了两项任务，分别用于评估视觉感知能力和知识推理能力。此外，我们还遵循形式分析的传统，在敦煌基准测试中设计了另一项艺术鉴赏任务。对20种主流大语言模型在敦煌基准测试中的评估结果进行广泛分析后发现，从视觉感知到知识推理，模型的性能呈现持续下降的趋势。而且，常识推理和少量样本提示对模型性能的影响微乎其微，甚至会产生负面影响，这凸显了基于提示式改进方法的局限性。因此，敦煌基准测试为提升多模态文化理解能力提供了一个具有挑战性的基准平台。相关数据代码将公开提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Multi-Docker-Eval: A ‘Shovel of the Gold Rush’ Benchmark on Automatic Environment Building for Software Engineering
papers.title_zh: 多Docker评估：一种用于软件工程领域自动环境构建的“淘金热”型基准测试方案
papers.authors: Kelin Fu, Tianyu Liu, Zeyu Shang, Yingwei MA, Jiaheng Liu, Jian Yang, Kaigui Bian
papers.abstract: Automated environment configuration is a critical bottleneck in scaling software engineering (SWE) automation. To provide a reliable evaluation standard for this task, we present Multi-Docker-Eval benchmark. It includes 40 real-world repositories spanning 9 programming languages and measures both success in achieving executable states and efficiency under realistic constraints. Our extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs and agent frameworks reveals key insights: (1) the overall success rate of current models is low (F2P at most 37.7%), with environment construction being the primary bottleneck; (2) model size and reasoning length are not decisive factors, and open-source models like DeepSeek-V3.1 and Kimi-K2 are competitive in both efficiency and effectiveness; (3) agent framework and programming language also have significantly influence on success rate. These findings provide actionable guidelines for building scalable, fully automated SWE pipelines.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化环境配置是软件工程自动化扩展过程中的一个关键瓶颈。为了为这一任务提供可靠的评估标准，我们提出了Multi-Docker-Eval基准测试。该测试涵盖了9种编程语言下的40个真实世界代码库，同时考核了实现可执行状态的成功率以及在实际约束条件下的效率。我们对各种先进的大语言模型和智能体框架进行了广泛的评估，得出了以下重要发现：(1)当前模型的整体成功率较低，最高仅为37.7%，而环境构建是主要的瓶颈；(2)模型规模和推理长度并非决定性因素，像DeepSeek-V3.1和Kimi-K2这样的开源模型在效率和效果方面都具有竞争力；(3)智能体框架和编程语言也对成功率有着显著的影响。这些发现为构建可扩展、完全自动化的软件工程自动化流程提供了可行的指导方针。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Not All Modalities at Once: Dynamic Dropout and Bidirectional Fusion for Robust Multi-modal Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.title_zh: 并非所有模式同时处理：动态淘汰法与双向融合技术，以实现稳健的多模态知识图谱补全
papers.authors: Jiashun Peng, Fu Zhang, Hongzhi Chen, Jingwei Cheng, Yingsong Ning, Xiaoke Wang
papers.abstract: Multi-modal Knowledge Graph Completion (MKGC) aims to infer missing links in multimodal knowledge graphs by leveraging structured triples together with auxiliary modalities such as text and images. Existing MKGC methods typically train with all modalities available, implicitly assuming consistent complementarity; however, this practice often induces modality dependence and modality competition under heterogeneous noise, which can hinder robust multi-modal fusion and limit overall performance.To address these issues, we propose MDBGF, a Modality Dropout and Bidirectional Gated Fusion framework for MKGC. MDBGF introduces a dynamic, probability-based modality dropout schedule. When the dropout is activated, MDBGF drops either the textual or visual modality during training while always preserving the structural information, encouraging the model to reduce over-reliance on any single auxiliary modality and to learn complementary cues under missing-modality conditions. When the dropout is not activated (i.e., all modalities are present), we further design a bidirectional gated fusion mechanism that enables mutual modulation between textual and visual modalities, enhancing cross-modal interaction and flexible fusion. In addition, we propose an adaptive proportional hybrid negative sampling strategy to strengthen MDBGF’s discriminative ability on hard negatives. Experiments on three benchmarks show that MDBGF consistently outperforms existing baselines and achieves new state-of-the-art results. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MDBGF-AHNS.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态知识图谱补全（MKGC）旨在利用结构化三元组以及文本、图像等辅助模态来推断多模态知识图谱中缺失的链接。现有的MKGC方法通常采用所有可用的模态进行训练，这隐含了各模态之间的一致性互补性假设；然而，这种做法往往会导致模态依赖性和模态竞争现象，尤其是在存在异质噪声的情况下，这会阻碍多模态的稳健融合，并限制整体性能。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了MDBGF——一种用于MKGC的多模态丢弃与双向门控融合框架。MDBGF引入了一种动态的、基于概率的模态丢弃策略：当启用丢弃功能时，MDBGF会在训练过程中丢弃文本或视觉模态的信息，同时始终保留结构信息，从而促使模型减少对任何单一辅助模态的过度依赖，并在缺少特定模态的情况下学习互补的线索。当不启用丢弃功能时（即所有模态都存在），我们进一步设计了双向门控融合机制，使得文本和视觉模态能够相互调节，增强跨模态交互和灵活的融合效果。此外，我们还提出了一种自适应比例混合负样本采样策略，以加强MDBGF在困难负例上的判别能力。在三个基准测试上的实验表明，MDBGF始终优于现有的基线方法，并取得了新的最优结果。我们的代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MDBGF-AHNS获取。

papers.title: If Only My CGM Could Speak: A Privacy-Preserving Agent for Question Answering over Continuous Glucose Data
papers.title_zh: 如果我的血糖监测数据能够“说话”就好了：一种能够保护隐私的算法，用于基于连续血糖数据开展问答式问题解答
papers.authors: Yanjun Cui, Ali Emami, Temiloluwa Prioleau, Nikhil Singh
papers.abstract: Continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) used in diabetes care collect rich personal health data that could improve day-to-day self-management. However, current patient platforms only offer static summaries which do not support inquisitive user queries. Large language models (LLMs) could enable free-form inquiries about continuous glucose data, but deploying them over sensitive health records raises privacy and accuracy concerns. In this paper, we present CGM-Agent, a privacy-preserving framework for question answering over personal glucose data. In our design, the LLM serves purely as a reasoning engine that selects analytical functions. All computation occurs locally, and personal health data never leaves the user’s device. For evaluation, we construct a benchmark of 4,180 questions combining parameterized question templates with real user queries and ground truth derived from deterministic program execution. Evaluating 6 leading LLMs, we find that top models achieve 94% value accuracy on synthetic queries and 88% on ambiguous real-world queries. Errors stem primarily from intent and temporal ambiguity rather than computational failures. Additionally, lightweight models achieve competitive performance in our agent design, suggesting opportunities for low-cost deployment. We release our code and benchmark to support future work on trustworthy health agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于糖尿病护理的连续血糖监测仪能够收集到丰富的个人健康数据，这些数据有助于改善患者的日常自我管理。然而，目前的患者管理平台只能提供静态的汇总信息，无法支持用户提出复杂的问题。大语言模型可以支持对连续血糖数据进行自由形式的查询，但将其应用于敏感的健康记录时，会引发隐私和准确性的担忧。在本文中，我们提出了CGM-Agent这一框架，它能够在保护隐私的前提下，对个人血糖数据进行问答处理。在我们的设计中，大语言模型仅作为推理引擎来选择合适的分析函数。所有计算都在本地进行，个人健康数据始终停留在用户的设备上。为了进行评估，我们构建了一个包含4,180个问题的基准测试，这些问题结合了参数化的问题模板和真实用户的查询，而真实数据则来自确定性程序执行的结果。通过对6种领先的大语言模型进行评估，我们发现顶尖模型在合成问题上达到了94%的价值准确率，在复杂的现实世界问题中达到了88%的准确率。错误主要源于意图和时间上的模糊性，而非计算方面的故障。此外，轻量级模型在我们的代理设计中也表现出了相当好的性能，这表明它们有潜力实现低成本部署。我们公开了我们的代码和基准测试，以支持未来关于可信赖健康代理的研究工作。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: E-ABSA20K: A Dataset and Propose-and-Verify for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis in Long E-commerce Reviews
papers.title_zh: E-ABSA20K：一个用于基于方面的情感分析的数据集，适用于长文本电商评论的分析——包含“提议与验证”方法的应用案例
papers.authors: Tong Sun, Mingyang Ma, Cheng Yu
papers.abstract: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) is critical for extracting actionable product insights from e-commerce reviews. However, most public ABSA benchmarks are restricted to short texts and a limited range of domains, and therefore underrepresent the challenges posed by real-world reviews—where multiple aspects co-occur, colloquial and noisy expressions are common, and evidence must often be aggregated across sentences in long contexts.We introduce E-ABSA20K, a multi-domain dataset of 20K reviews from four product categories (Women’s Bags, Dresses, Cosmetics, and Furniture), annotated with review-level sentiment quads. Compared to existing benchmarks, E-ABSA20K contains substantially longer and more aspect-dense reviews, averaging 63.9 words and 6.0 quads per review. We further propose a two-stage propose-and-verify framework for review-level quadruple extraction (target, aspect, opinion, sentiment). The first stage generates high-recall candidates under strict schema constraints, while the second stage conducts explicit grounding, scope, and modality verification, followed by review-level consolidation to mitigate hallucinations and scope leakage in long reviews. Experiments across multiple Qwen3 model sizes demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms single-stage prompting (with and without chain-of-thought) as well as competitive ABSA extraction baselines, improving quad-level micro-F1 and robustness on discourse-hard cases such as comparisons and conditionals.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于方面的情感分析（Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis，简称ABSA）对于从电子商务评论中提取有用的产品信息至关重要。然而，大多数公开的ABSA基准测试仅限于短文本和有限的领域范围，因此无法充分反映现实世界中的评论挑战——在现实世界中，多个方面会同时出现，口语化表达和噪声表达很常见，而且通常需要将证据汇总到长文本中进行分析。我们引入了E-ABSA20K，这是一个包含2万条评论的多领域数据集，这些评论来自四个产品类别（女性包袋、连衣裙、化妆品和家具），并且每条评论都带有情感方面的注释。与现有的基准测试相比，E-ABSA20K中的评论篇幅更长，且包含更多的方面信息，平均每条评论有63.9个单词和6个情感方面注释。我们还提出了一种两阶段框架来提取这些情感方面的注释：第一阶段在严格的模式约束下生成高召回率的候选对象，第二阶段则进行明确的定位、范围和模态验证，最后进行评论级别的整合处理，以减少幻觉现象以及长文本中的范围泄露问题。通过在不同规模的Qwen3模型上进行实验，我们发现我们的方法始终优于单阶段提示法（无论是否包含思维链），同时也优于其他竞争性的ABSA提取基线方法。我们的方法在微精度F1值以及处理比较和条件等复杂情况时的鲁棒性方面也表现良好。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: ECHA: Jailbreaking LVLMs via the Mismatch between Implicit Semantic Reconstruction and Explicit Safety Alignment
papers.title_zh: ECHA：通过利用隐式语义重构与显式安全性对齐之间的不匹配，实现对受限游戏模式的越狱行为
papers.authors: Chenxing Xu, Junyong Jiang, Zehu Zhang, Lu Dong
papers.abstract: Large Visual Language Models (LVLMs) achieve superior multimodal reasoning but inevitably expand the safety attack surface. While recent studies have explored emoji-based vulnerabilities, they predominantly focus on textual tokenization artifacts and neglect the model’s intrinsic capability to interpret visual semantics. In this paper, we reveal a critical systemic vulnerability termed the Mismatch between Implicit Semantic Reconstruction and Explicit Safety Alignment. We observe that LVLMs can implicitly synthesize holistic malicious semantics from fragmented visual cues, whereas existing guardrails fail to intercept such latent intent. To exploit this, we propose the Emoji Chain Hinting Attack (ECHA), a visual typography framework that decouples sensitive concepts into semantically related emoji chains and structural text masks. By utilizing benign scenario-based prompts to guide the decoding process, ECHA induces the model to internally reconstruct prohibited intent from abstract visual symbols, effectively bypassing surface-level safety detection. We conduct extensive red-teaming evaluations on seven state-of-the-art (SOTA) LVLMs, comprising proprietary systems such as GPT-4.1-Nano, GPT-4o-Mini, and Gemini-2.5-Flash, alongside open-source models including Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL, InternVL-3.5, and LLaVA-NeXT. Experimental results demonstrate that ECHA significantly outperforms existing baselines, successfully bypassing safety guardrails in over 81% of instances with a single attempt. Our code is available at https://github.com/KerryZack/ECHA.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型在实现多模态推理方面表现出色，但不可避免地扩大了安全攻击的潜在空间。虽然近期的研究已经探讨了基于表情符号的漏洞，但这些研究主要集中在文本分词方面的问题上，而忽视了模型在理解视觉语义方面的内在能力。在本文中，我们揭示了一个关键的系统性漏洞——即隐式语义重构与显式安全对齐之间的不匹配。我们发现，大型视觉语言模型能够从零散的视觉线索中隐式地合成出具有恶意的语义信息，而现有的安全措施却无法拦截这种潜在的恶意意图。为了利用这一漏洞，我们提出了“表情符号链提示攻击”这一视觉类型化框架。该框架将敏感概念分解为语义相关的表情符号链和结构化文本掩码，并通过使用基于良性场景的提示来引导解码过程，使模型能够从抽象视觉符号中内部重构出被禁止的意图，从而有效绕过表面级别的安全检测。我们在七种最先进的视觉语言模型上进行了广泛的评估，这些模型包括GPT-4.1-Nano、GPT-4o-Mini以及Gemini-2.5-Flash等专有系统，还有Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL、InternVL-3.5和LLaVA-NeXT等开源模型。实验结果表明，ECHA在超过81%的情况下能够成功突破现有安全防护措施，单次尝试即可实现目标。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/KerryZack/ECHA下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Thinking with Map: Reinforced Parallel Map-Augmented Agent for Geolocalization
papers.title_zh: 基于地图的思考：一种增强型并行地图辅助的代理系统，用于地理定位功能
papers.authors: Yuxiang Ji, Yong Wang, Ziyu Ma, Yiming Hu, Hailang Huang, Xuecai Hu, Guanhua Chen, Liaoni Wu, Xiangxiang Chu
papers.abstract: The image geolocalization task aims to predict the location where an image was taken anywhere on Earth using visual clues.Existing large vision-language model (LVLM) approaches leverage world knowledge, chain-of-thought reasoning, and agentic capabilities, but overlook a common strategy used by humans — using maps.In this work, we first equip the model Thinking with Map ability and formulate it as an agent-in-the-map loop.We develop a two-stage optimization scheme for it, including agentic reinforcement learning (RL) followed by parallel test-time scaling (TTS).The RL strengthens the agentic capability of model to improve sampling efficiency, and the parallel TTS enables the model to explore multiple candidate paths before making the final prediction, which is crucial for geolocalization.To evaluate our method on up-to-date and in-the-wild images, we further present MAPBench, a comprehensive geolocalization training and evaluation benchmark composed entirely of real-world images.Experimental results show that our method outperforms existing open- and closed-source models on most metrics, specifically improving Acc@500m from 8.0% to 22.1% compared to Gemini-3-Pro with Google Search/Map grounded mode.
papers.abstract_zh: 图像地理定位任务旨在利用视觉线索预测一张图片拍摄的地点。现有的大型视觉-语言模型方法利用了世界知识、思维链推理以及智能体能力，但忽略了人类常用的一种策略——使用地图。在这项工作中，我们首先为模型“Thinking”赋予了地图功能，并将其构建为一个“地图中的智能体”循环结构。我们为该模型开发了一个两阶段优化方案：首先是智能体强化学习，然后是并行测试时间扩展。强化学习提升了模型的智能体能力，从而提高了采样效率；而并行测试时间扩展则使模型能够在做出最终预测之前探索多个候选路径，这对地理定位至关重要。为了评估我们的方法在最新的真实图像上的表现，我们进一步开发了MAPBench这一全面的地理定位训练和评估基准，该基准完全由真实世界的图像组成。实验结果表明，与现有的开源和闭源模型相比，我们的方法在大多数指标上都表现出更好的性能，尤其是Acc@500m指标从8.0%提升到了22.1%，这一成绩优于使用Google搜索/地图功能的Gemini-3-Pro模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Revisiting Entropy Regularization: Adaptive Coefficient Unlocks Its Potential for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 重新审视熵正则化：自适应系数释放了其在大型语言模型强化学习中的潜力
papers.authors: Xiaoyun Zhang, Xiaojian Yuan, Di Huang, Wang You, Chen Hu, Jingqing Ruan, Kejiang Chen, Xing Hu
papers.abstract: Reasoning ability has become a defining capability of Large Language Models (LLMs), with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) emerging as a key paradigm to enhance it. However, RLVR training often suffers from policy entropy collapse, where the policy becomes overly deterministic, hindering exploration and limiting reasoning performance. While entropy regularization is a common remedy, its effectiveness is highly sensitive to the fixed coefficient, making it unstable across tasks and models. In this work, we revisit entropy regularization in RLVR and argue that its potential has been largely underestimated. Our analysis shows that (i) tasks of varying difficulty demand distinct exploration intensities, and (ii) balanced exploration may require the policy entropy to be maintained within a moderate range below its initial level. Therefore, we propose Adaptive Entropy Regularization (AER) — a framework that dynamically balances exploration and exploitation via three components: difficulty-aware coefficient allocation, initial-anchored target entropy, and dynamic global coefficient adjustment. Experiments on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that AER consistently outperforms baselines, improving both reasoning accuracy and exploration capability. Codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AER-ACL .
papers.abstract_zh: 推理能力已成为大语言模型的关键能力之一，而带有可验证奖励的强化学习正成为提升这一能力的核心方法。然而，带有可验证奖励的强化学习训练常常会出现策略熵崩溃的问题，即策略变得过于确定性，从而阻碍探索行为并限制推理性能。虽然熵正则化是一种常见的解决方案，但其有效性对固定系数的依赖性很大，导致在不同任务和模型中效果不稳定。在这项研究中，我们重新审视了带有可验证奖励的强化学习中的熵正则化方法，并认为其潜力被严重低估了。我们的分析表明：(i) 不同难度的任务需要不同的探索强度；(ii) 为了实现平衡的探索，需要将策略熵维持在初始水平以下的一个适度范围内。因此，我们提出了自适应熵正则化框架——该框架通过三个组件来动态平衡探索与利用：难度感知的系数分配、以初始值为基准的目标熵值，以及动态调整全局系数。在多个数学推理基准测试中的实验表明，自适应熵正则化框架始终优于其他基线方法，提升了推理准确性和探索能力。代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AER-ACL获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SLIP: Soft Label Mechanism and Key-Extraction-Guided CoT-based Defense Against Instruction Backdoor in APIs
papers.title_zh: 软标签机制与关键提取引导的常识推理防御方法——用于抵御API中的指令后门攻击
papers.authors: Wu Zhengxian, Juan Wen, Wanli Peng, Haowei Chang, Yinghan Zhou, Xue Yiming
papers.abstract: Customized Large Language Model (LLM) agents face a critical security threat from black-box instruction backdoors, where malicious behaviors are covertly injected through hidden system instructions. Although existing prompt-based defenses can often detect poisoned inputs, they generally fail to recover correct outputs once the backdoor is activated. In this paper, we first conduct a mechanistic analysis of LLM behavior under instruction backdoors and reveal two pivotal phenomena: (1) cognitive override, in which backdoor triggers dominate the reasoning process and suppress task-relevant context, and (2) abnormal semantic correlation, where triggers establish excessively strong semantic associations with attacker-specified target labels. Based on these insights, we propose a \textbf{S}oft \textbf{L}abel mechanism and key-extraction-guided CoT-based defense against \textbf{I}nstruction backdoors in \textbf{A}PIs (SLIP). To counteract the cognitive override, the key-extraction-guided Chain-of-Thought (KCOT) explicitly guides the model to extract task-relevant keywords and phrases rather than only considering the single trigger or overall text semantics. To neutralize the trigger’s abnormal semantic correlation, the soft label mechanism (SLM) quantifies semantic correlations and employs statistical clustering to filter anomalous phrases before aggregating reliable keywords and phrases for prediction. Extensive experiments show that SLIP reduces the average attack success rate to 25.13%, improves clean accuracy to 87.15%, and outperforms state-of-the-art black-box defenses.
papers.abstract_zh: 定制的大语言模型代理面临着来自黑盒指令后门的关键安全威胁，恶意行为通过隐藏的系统指令被秘密注入。虽然现有的基于提示的防御机制通常能够检测到被污染的输入，但一旦后门被激活，这些防御机制往往无法恢复正确的输出结果。在本文中，我们首先对指令后门下大语言模型的行为进行了机制分析，并发现了两个关键现象：(1)认知覆盖，即后门触发因素主导了推理过程，并压制了与任务相关的上下文信息；(2)异常的语义关联，即触发因素与攻击者指定的目标标签建立了过于强烈的语义联系。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种**软标签机制**以及基于关键提取引导的CoT防御机制，以对抗API中的指令后门（SLIP）。为了应对认知覆盖问题，关键提取引导的推理链明确指导模型提取与任务相关的关键词和短语，而不是仅仅考虑单个触发因素或整体文本语义。为了消除触发因素的异常语义关联，软标签机制对语义关联进行量化处理，并利用统计聚类技术过滤掉异常短语，然后再汇总可靠的关键词和短语用于预测。广泛的实验表明，SLIP将平均攻击成功率降低到25.13%，将正确识别率提高到87.15%，其性能优于目前最先进的黑盒防御机制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: U-Fold: Dynamic Intent-Aware Context Folding for User-Centric Agents
papers.title_zh: U形折叠：一种基于用户需求的动态意图感知上下文处理方式，适用于以用户为中心的智能体
papers.authors: Jin Su, Runnan Fang, Yeqiu Li, Xiaobin Wang, Shihao Cai, Pengjun Xie, Ningyu Zhang, Fajie Yuan
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have been successfully deployed in many tool-augmented settings, but their scalability is fundamentally constrained by context length. Existing context-folding methods mitigate this issue by summarizing past interactions, yet they are typically designed for single-query or single-intent scenarios. In more realistic user-centric dialogues, we identify two major failure modes: (i) they irreversibly discard fine-grained constraints and intermediate facts that are crucial for later decisions, and (ii) their summaries fail to track evolving user intent, leading to omissions and erroneous actions. To address these limitations, we propose U-Fold, a dynamic context-folding framework tailored to user-centric tasks. U-Fold retains the full user–agent dialogue and tool-call history but, at each turn, uses two core components to produce an intent-aware, evolving dialogue summary and a compact, task-relevant tool log. Extensive experiments on \tau-bench, \tau^2-bench, VitaBench, and harder context-inflated settings show that U-Fold consistently outperforms ReAct (achieving a 71.4% win rate in long-context settings) and prior folding baselines (with improvements of up to 27.0%), particularly on long, noisy, multi-turn tasks. Our study demonstrates that U-Fold is a promising step toward transferring context-management techniques from single-query benchmarks to realistic user-centric applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体已成功应用于许多工具辅助场景中，但其可扩展性本质上受到上下文长度的限制。现有的上下文折叠方法通过总结过去的互动来缓解这个问题，但这些方法通常适用于单一查询或单一意图的场景。在更真实的以用户为中心的对话中，我们发现存在两个主要的问题：(i) 它们会不可逆地丢弃对后续决策至关重要的细粒度约束和中间信息；(ii) 它们的摘要无法跟踪用户意图的变化，导致遗漏和错误的操作。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了U-Fold这一动态上下文折叠框架，该框架专为以用户为中心的任务设计。U-Fold保留了完整的用户与智能体的对话记录以及工具调用历史，但在每个回合中，它使用两个核心组件来生成具有意图意识的、不断变化的对话摘要，以及简洁且符合任务需求的工具记录。在τ-bench、τ^2-bench、VitaBench以及更复杂的上下文膨胀场景下的广泛实验表明，U-Fold始终优于ReAct（在长上下文场景中胜率高达71.4%），也优于之前的折叠基线算法（改进幅度可达27.0%），尤其是在长文本、噪声较多且需要多次交互的任务中。我们的研究表明，U-Fold是将上下文管理技术从单一查询场景推广到真实以用户为中心的应用中的重要一步。

papers.title: AdaTooler-V: Adaptive Tool-Use for Images and Videos
papers.title_zh: AdaTooler-V：适用于图片和视频的自适应工具使用方案
papers.authors: Chaoyang Wang, Kaituo Feng, Dongyang Chen, Zhongyu Wang, Zhixun Li, Sicheng Gao, Meng Meng, Xu Zhou, Manyuan Zhang, Yuzhang Shang, Xiangyu Yue
papers.abstract: Recent advances have shown that multimodal large language models (MLLMs) benefit from multimodal interleaved chain-of-thought (CoT) with vision tool interactions. However, existing open-source models often exhibit blind tool-use reasoning patterns, invoking vision tools even when they are unnecessary, which significantly increases inference overhead and degrades model performance. To this end, we propose AdaTooler-V, an MLLM that performs adaptive tool-use by determining whether a visual problem truly requires tools. First, we introduce AT-GRPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that adaptively adjusts reward scales based on the Tool Benefit Score of each sample, encouraging the model to invoke tools only when they provide genuine improvements. Moreover, we construct two datasets to support training: AdaTooler-V-CoT-100k for SFT cold start and AdaTooler-V-300k for RL with verifiable rewards across single-image, multi-image, and video data. Experiments across twelve benchmarks demonstrate the strong reasoning capability of AdaTooler-V, outperforming existing methods in diverse visual reasoning tasks. Notably, AdaTooler-V-7B achieves an accuracy of 89.8% on the high-resolution benchmark V*, surpassing the commercial proprietary model GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，多模态大语言模型在结合视觉工具的思维链推理中能够发挥更大的优势。然而，现有的开源模型往往表现出盲目的工具使用行为，即在不需要的情况下调用视觉工具，这大大增加了推理的复杂性并降低了模型的性能。为此，我们提出了AdaTooler-V这一多模态大语言模型，它能够通过判断某个视觉问题是否确实需要工具来自适应地使用工具。首先，我们引入了AT-GRPO这种强化学习算法，该算法能够根据每个样本的“工具效益得分”来调整奖励尺度，从而促使模型仅在真正需要工具时才会调用它们。此外，我们还构建了两个数据集以支持训练：AdaTooler-V-CoT-100k用于序列强化学习的冷启动问题处理，而AdaTooler-V-300k则适用于带有可验证奖励的强化学习场景，涵盖单图像、多图像以及视频数据。在十二个基准测试中的实验表明，AdaTooler-V在多种视觉推理任务中展现了强大的推理能力，其表现优于现有方法。值得注意的是，AdaTooler-V-7B在高分辨率基准测试V*上的准确率达到89.8%，超过了商业专有模型GPT-4o和Gemini 1.5 Pro。

papers.title: Exposing Privacy Risks in Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 在基于图检索的生成中暴露隐私风险
papers.authors: Jiale Liu, Jiahao Zhang, Suhang Wang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a powerful technique for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) with external, up-to-date knowledge. Graph RAG has emerged as an advanced paradigm that leverages graph-based knowledge structures to provide more coherent and contextually rich answers. However, the move from plain document retrieval to structured graph traversal introduces new, under-explored privacy risks. This paper investigates the data extraction vulnerabilities of the Graph RAG systems. We design and execute tailored data extraction attacks to probe their susceptibility to leaking both raw text and structured data, such as entities and their relationships. Our findings reveal a critical trade-off: while Graph RAG systems may reduce raw text leakage, they are significantly more vulnerable to the extraction of structured entity and relationship information. We also explore potential defense mechanisms to mitigate these novel attack surfaces. This work provides a foundational analysis of the unique privacy challenges in Graph RAG and offers insights for building more secure systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）是一种强大的技术，它能够将大语言模型与外部的最新知识相结合。图结构检索增强生成作为一种先进的范式，利用基于图的结构来提供更连贯且内容丰富的答案。然而，从简单的文档检索转变为结构化图结构遍历的过程中，会引入一些尚未充分探索的隐私风险。本文研究了图结构检索增强生成系统在数据提取方面的脆弱性。我们设计并实施了针对性的数据提取攻击，以探究这些系统在泄露原始文本以及结构化数据（如实体及其关系）方面的易感性。我们的研究发现了一个关键权衡：虽然图结构检索增强生成系统能够减少原始文本的泄露，但它们在提取结构化实体和关系信息方面却更加脆弱。我们还探讨了可能的防御机制，以缓解这些新的攻击面。这项工作为理解图结构检索增强生成中的独特隐私挑战提供了基础性的分析，并为构建更安全的系统提供了启示。

papers.title: BalanceSFT: Improving LLM Function Calling with Balanced Training Signals and Data Hardness
papers.title_zh: BalanceSFT：通过平衡的训练信号和不同的数据难度来提升大语言模型的函数调用能力
papers.authors: Bingguang Hao, Zengzhuang Xu, Maolin Wang, Yuntao Wen, Yicheng Chen, Cunyin Peng, Long Chen, Xiangyu Zhao, Jinjie Gu, Chenyi Zhuang, Ji Zhang
papers.abstract: While Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the prevailing method for equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with function calling capabilities, its effectiveness is often compromised by two critical challenges: 1) Imbalanced Training Signals, where lengthy Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning tokens dominate the training signals over concise function calls in the learning objective, and 2) Imbalanced Data Hardness, characterized by a scarcity of hard training examples. To overcome these limitations, we propose Balanced Supervised Fine-tuning (BalanceSFT), a novel framework that incorporates two key components: a Self-adjusted Signal Balancing (SSB) loss that employs a learnable hyperparameter to dynamically adjust the token contributions of CoT reasoning and function calls, together with a Hard Data Re-sampling (HDR) strategy that establishes a feedback loop to selectively generate new, high-quality complex data guided by model errors. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed BalanceSFT framework. With BalanceSFT, a 7B model achieves function calling performance that surpasses state-of-the-art models like GPT-5. Our code, models, and dataset are open-sourced.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然监督式微调（SFT）是赋予大语言模型（LLM）函数调用能力的主流方法，但其有效性往往受到两个关键问题的制约：1）训练信号不平衡，即较长的思维链推理标记在训练信号中占据主导地位，而简洁的函数调用则未能得到充分重视；2）数据难度不均衡，表现为高质量训练样本的稀缺性。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了平衡监督式微调（BalanceSFT）框架。该框架包含两个核心组件：一种自调整信号平衡损失函数，它能够通过可学习的超参数动态调整思维链推理和函数调用的标记贡献；以及一种硬数据重采样策略，该策略通过反馈循环来选择性地生成新的、高质量的复杂数据，这些数据的生成是基于模型产生的错误信息进行的。大量实验证明了BalanceSFT框架的有效性。使用BalanceSFT框架，一个拥有70亿参数的模型能够实现超越GPT-5等先进模型的函数调用性能。我们的代码、模型和数据集均已开源。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: How Robust Are Large Language Models for Clinical Numeracy? An Empirical Study on Numerical Reasoning Abilities in Clinical Contexts
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型在临床计算能力评估中的表现如何？关于临床环境中数值推理能力的实证研究
papers.authors: Minh-Vuong Nguyen, Fatemeh Shiri, Zhuang Li, Karin Verspoor
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for clinical question answering and decision support, yet safe deployment critically requires reliable handling of patient measurements in heterogeneous clinical notes. Existing evaluations of LLMs for clinical numerical reasoning provide limited operation-level coverage, restricted primarily to arithmetic computation, and rarely assess the robustness of numerical understanding across clinical note formats. We introduce ClinicNumRobBench, a benchmark of 1,624 context-question instances with ground-truth answers that evaluates four main types of clinical numeracy: value retrieval, arithmetic computation, relational comparison, and aggregation. To stress-test robustness, ClinicNumRobBench presents longitudinal MIMIC-IV vital-sign records in three semantically equivalent representations, including a real-world note-style variant derived from the Open Patients dataset, and instantiates queries using 42 question templates. Experiments on 17 LLMs show that value retrieval is generally strong, with most models exceeding 85% accuracy, while relational comparison and aggregation remain challenging, with some models scoring below 15%. Fine-tuning on medical data can reduce numeracy relative to base models by over 30%, and performance drops under note-style variation indicate LLM sensitivity to format. ClinicNumRobBench offers a rigorous testbed for clinically reliable numerical reasoning. Code and data URL are available on https://github.com/MinhVuong2000/ClinicNumRobBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在临床问题解答和决策支持领域得到了越来越多的应用。然而，要安全地将这些模型应用于实际场景中，就必须可靠地处理来自不同临床记录中的患者数据。目前对大语言模型进行临床数值推理评估的研究往往只涵盖有限的运算层面，主要局限于算术计算方面，且很少评估模型在不同临床记录格式下的数值理解能力。我们提出了ClinicNumRobBench这一基准测试，该测试包含1,624个带有真实答案的上下文问题实例，涵盖了四种主要的临床数值推理能力：数值检索、算术计算、关系比较以及聚合运算。为了测试模型的鲁棒性，ClinicNumRobBench使用了MIMIC-IV数据库中的生命体征记录数据，这些数据以三种语义相同的形式呈现，其中一种是基于Open Patients数据集生成的真实临床记录样式，同时模型还使用42种问题模板来生成查询语句。对17种大语言模型的实验结果表明，数值检索能力通常表现较好，大多数模型的准确率超过了85%；而关系比较和聚合运算则仍然具有挑战性，有些模型的准确率低于15%。通过在医学数据上进行微调，模型的数值推理能力可以比基础模型提高超过30%，而性能在面临不同临床记录样式时的下降则表明模型对格式存在敏感性。ClinicNumRobBench为评估临床数值推理能力的可靠性提供了一个严格的测试平台。相关的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/MinhVuong2000/ClinicNumRobBench下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Safety-Aware Dialogue System for Postoperative Oral Cancer Care with Structured Clarification and a Clinically Curated Dataset
papers.title_zh: 基于结构化说明和临床精选数据集的术后口腔癌护理安全对话系统
papers.authors: Tzu-Chi Liu, Hui-Ying Yang, Shiow-Ching Shun, Yu-Chi Chen, Lu-Yen Anny Chen, Yong-Sheng Chen
papers.abstract: Clinical dialogue systems are increasingly vital for patient education and follow-up care; however, effective responses often depend on the clinical context that patients often fail to provide in detail. Responding directly to vague messages can therefore lead to generic or clinically misaligned advice, a challenge that is particularly pronounced in post-op oral cancer (OC) care due to speech impairment and functional limitations. Moreover, post-op OC patients often experience psychological distress, making safety-aware language more likely to arise in dialogue. Dialogue systems in this setting must therefore address both clarifying missing clinical context and ensuring psychological safety. We propose a safety-aware dialogue system that applies information-gain guided clarification before RAG-based response generation and screens user utterances for emotional distress and suicidal ideation. Expert evaluations show that the proposed system improves the quality and clinical appropriateness of generated responses relative to strong baselines, while the safety module closely aligns with expert judgments on clinically concerning utterances. Furthermore, we release a clinically curated Chinese post-op OC QA dataset with expert-validated annotations, which we use throughout our experiments.
papers.abstract_zh: 临床对话系统在患者教育和后续护理中发挥着越来越重要的作用。然而，有效的回应往往依赖于临床信息，而患者往往无法提供详细的临床背景信息。因此，直接回应模糊的信息可能会导致一些泛泛或不符合临床实际的建议，这在口腔癌术后护理中尤为明显，因为患者存在语言障碍和功能限制。此外，口腔癌术后患者常常面临心理困扰，这使得对话中需要使用更加注重安全性的语言。在这种情况下，对话系统必须同时解决缺失的临床信息问题，并确保患者的心理安全。我们提出了一种注重安全的对话系统，该系统在基于RAG的响应生成之前，会进行信息获取引导式的澄清工作，并筛查用户的话语内容是否存在心理困扰或自杀念头。专家评估表明，与基准模型相比，该系统的生成响应质量更高、临床适用性更强。同时，安全模块也与专家对具有临床意义的话语的判断高度一致。此外，我们还发布了一个经过临床筛选的汉语口腔癌术后问答数据集，其中包含了专家验证的注释信息，我们在实验过程中一直使用这个数据集。

papers.title: FTibSuite: A Comprehensive Resource Suite for Tibetan Vision–Language Modeling
papers.title_zh: FTibSuite：一个用于藏语视觉与语言建模的综合性资源库
papers.authors: Guixian Xu, Yide Liang, Zeli Su, Xuexian Song, Ziyin Zhang, Yushuang Dong, Ting Zhang, Xu Han
papers.abstract: Vision–language models (VLMs) have progressed rapidly, but Tibetan remains largely underserved due to the lack of infrastructure for reproducible training and evaluation. To help address this gap, we introduce FTibSuite, a resource-centric foundation for Tibetan VLM research that provides an end-to-end training-and-evaluation workflow and includes human-verified multimodal annotations, partially filling a long-standing shortage of Tibetan multimodal resources. FTibSuite comprises FTibData, FTibBench, and a reproducible baseline model, FTibVLM, built on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. FTibVLM adopts a three-stage adaptation pipeline consisting of Tibetan continual pretraining, image–text alignment, and multimodal instruction tuning. For systematic evaluation, FTibBench adapts five established multimodal benchmarks to Tibetan and offers a reproducible evaluation protocol to support consistent comparisons across models. Specifically, FTibBench includes Tibetan versions of MMBench, MME, POPE, BinaryVQA, and COREVQA. Experiments on FTibBench demonstrate that FTibVLM consistently improves Tibetan multimodal performance. For instance, FTibVLM attains 76.01 accuracy on BinaryVQA, indicating that Tibetan performance can be competitive with high-resource settings on this diagnostic task. We also observe substantial gains on other benchmarks, including an improvement on MMBench (dev) from 42.97 to 67.78 and an increase in POPE-random accuracy from 47.53 to 80.56, underscoring the practical value of the proposed workflow and resources.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）已经取得了快速的进展，但由于缺乏可复现的训练和评估基础设施，藏语领域的VLM研究仍然面临很大的挑战。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了FTibSuite——一个以资源为核心的基础框架，用于藏语VLM的研究。该框架提供了端到端的训练与评估流程，并包含了经过人类验证的多模态注释数据，从而部分解决了藏语多模态资源短缺的问题。FTibSuite由FTibData、FTibBench以及一个基于Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct构建的可复现基线模型FTibVLM组成。FTibVLM采用了三阶段适应流程：藏语持续预训练、图像-文本对齐以及多模态指令调整。在系统评估方面，FTibBench将五项成熟的多模态基准测试适配到了藏语环境，并提供了可复现的评估方案，以支持不同模型之间的统一比较。具体来说，FTibBench包含了MMBench、MME、POPE、BinaryVQA和COREVQA的藏语版本。在FTibBench上的实验表明，FTibVLM在藏语多模态任务上表现出稳定的性能提升。例如，FTibVLM在BinaryVQA任务上的准确率达到了76.01%，这表明藏语模型在资源充足的情况下，在该诊断任务上具备竞争力。我们在其他基准测试中也观察到了显著的进步，比如在MMBench（开发版）上的准确率从42.97提高到了67.78，而在POPE-random任务上的准确率则从47.53提高到80.56。这些结果充分证明了所提出的工作流程和资源的实际价值。

papers.title: DeepMed: Building a Medical DeepResearch Agent via Multi-hop Med-Search Data and Turn-Controlled Agentic Training & Inference
papers.title_zh: DeepMed：通过多跳医疗搜索数据以及基于轮询控制的智能体训练与推理机制，构建一种医学深度研究智能体
papers.authors: Zihan Wang, Hao Wang, Shi Feng, Xiaocui Yang, Daling Wang, Yiqun Zhang, Jinghao Lin, Xiaozhong Ji, Haihua Yang
papers.abstract: Medical reasoning models remain constrained by parametric knowledge and are thus susceptible to forgetting and hallucinations. DeepResearch (DR) models ground outputs in verifiable evidence from tools and perform strongly in general domains, but their direct transfer to medical field yields relatively limited gains. We attribute this to two gaps: task characteristic and tool-use scaling. Medical questions require evidence interpretation in a knowledge-intensive clinical context; while general DR models can retrieve information, they often lack clinical-context reasoning and thus “find it but fail to use it,” leaving performance limited by medical abilities. Moreover, in medical scenarios, blindly scaling tool-call can inject noisy context, derailing sensitive medical reasoning and prompting repetitive evidence-seeking along incorrect paths. Therefore, we propose DeepMed. For data, we deploy a multi-hop med-search QA synthesis method supporting the model to apply the DR paradigm in medical contexts. For training, we introduce a difficulty-aware turn-penalty to suppress excessive tool-call growth. For inference, we bring a monitor to help validate hypotheses within a controlled number of steps and avoid context rot. Overall, on seven medical benchmarks, DeepMed improves its base model by 9.79% on average and outperforms larger medical reasoning and DR models.
papers.abstract_zh: 医学推理模型仍然受到参数化知识的限制，因此容易出现遗忘和幻觉现象。DeepResearch模型能够以工具提供的可验证证据为基础进行推理，在一般领域表现优异，但将其直接应用于医学领域时，效果相对有限。我们认为这主要是由于两个方面的不足：任务特性问题和工具使用规模问题。医学问题需要在一个知识密集型临床环境中对证据进行解读；虽然一般的DeepResearch模型能够获取信息，但它们往往缺乏临床语境推理能力，导致“找到信息却无法使用”，从而限制了性能的提升。此外，在医学场景中，盲目扩大工具调用的规模会引入噪声背景，影响敏感的医学推理过程，并促使人们沿着错误的路径进行重复的信息检索。因此，我们提出了DeepMed模型。在数据方面，我们采用了一种多跳医学搜索QA合成方法，帮助模型在医学场景中应用DeepResearch的推理范式。在训练方面，我们引入了一种考虑难度的转向惩罚机制，以抑制过度工具调用的情况。在推理方面，我们引入了监控机制，以帮助在有限的步骤内验证假设，避免上下文的扭曲。总体而言，在七个医学基准测试上，DeepMed的平均改进幅度达到了9.79%，其性能优于其他大型医学推理和DeepResearch模型。

papers.title: Softpick: No Attention Sink, No Massive Activations with Rectified Softmax
papers.title_zh: Softpick：无需吸引注意力的事物，也不需要进行大规模的激活操作，采用修正后的Softmax算法即可
papers.authors: Zayd Muhammad Kawakibi Zuhri, Erland Hilman Fuadi, Alham Fikri Aji
papers.abstract: We introduce softpick, a rectified, not sum-to-one, drop-in replacement for softmax in transformer attention mechanisms that eliminates attention sink and massive activations. Our experiments with 340M and 1.8B parameter models demonstrate that softpick achieves 0% sink rate consistently. The softpick transformers produce hidden states with significantly lower kurtosis and creates sparse attention maps. Quantized models using softpick outperform softmax on standard benchmarks, with a particularly pronounced advantage at lower bit precisions. Our analysis and discussion shows how softpick has the potential to open new possibilities for quantization, low-precision training, sparsity optimization, pruning, and interpretability. Our code: https://github.com/zaydzuhri/softpick-attention.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了SoftPick这一替代方案，它是一种经过整流且权重和不必为 1 的注意力函数，可以无缝替换Transformer注意力机制中的Softmax模块。该算法能够消除注意力汇聚现象以及大量不必要的激活值。我们对参数数量分别为3.4亿和18亿的模型进行了实验验证，结果表明，使用SoftPick时，注意力汇聚现象始终为零。SoftPick生成的隐藏状态具有更低的峰度，同时还能产生稀疏的注意力映射。在使用SoftPick进行量化处理后，模型在标准基准测试中的表现优于使用Softmax的情况，尤其是在较低位精度的情况下，其优势更为明显。我们的分析和讨论表明，SoftPick为量化处理、低精度训练、稀疏性优化、剪枝以及可解释性等方面带来了新的可能性。我们的代码可以在以下链接查看：https://github.com/zaydzuhri/softpick-attention

papers.title: UniCM: A Unified Consistency Model For Efficient Multimodal Generation and Understanding
papers.title_zh: UniCM：一种统一的一致性模型，旨在实现高效的多模态生成与理解功能
papers.authors: Chenkai Xu, Xu Wang, Zhenyi Liao, Yishun Li, TianQi Hou, Zhijie Deng
papers.abstract: Consistency models (CMs) have shown promise in the efficient generation of both image and text. This raises the natural question of whether we can learn a unified CM for efficient multimodal generation (e.g., text-to-image) and understanding (e.g., image-to-text). Intuitively, such a model could be acquired by applying the consistency distillation (CD) to existing unified multimodal models. However, the key challenge is establishing a unified denoising perspective for both image and text generation, which is essential for establishing the consistency mapping. To tackle this, at the representation level, we advocate for discrete tokens for both modalities to best preserve language modeling capabilities. Critically, instead of defining the text denoising trajectory via recent discrete diffusion language modeling principles, we specify it using the parallel decoding trace of an autoregressive language model, benefiting from the latter’s superior performance in general text generation tasks. The denoising trajectory of image tokens adheres to standard discrete diffusion. We train our unified consistency models (UniCMs) on these combined multimodal trajectories simultaneously with a unified objective. We introduce a trajectory segmentation strategy to improve the training convergence. Empirically, in text-to-image generation, UniCMs outperform SD3 on GenEval and Image Reward, while requiring only approximately {1}/{8} of the sampling time. Meanwhile, in image-to-text generation, UniCMs surpass Show-o on the MMMU benchmark while being 1.5 \times faster at long-sequence generating speed.
papers.abstract_zh: 一致性模型在高效生成图像和文本方面表现出良好的效果。这自然引出了这样一个问题：我们是否可以学习一个统一的一致性模型，以实现高效的多模态生成（例如，文本到图像的转换）和理解（例如，图像到文本的转换）。直观地说，可以通过对现有的统一多模态模型应用一致性蒸馏技术来构建这样的模型。然而，面临的挑战在于为图像和文本生成建立统一去噪方法，这对于实现一致性映射至关重要。为了解决这个问题，我们在表示层面采用离散标记来表示两种模态，以更好地保留语言建模能力。关键的是，我们不是通过最近的离散扩散语言建模原理来定义文本去噪轨迹，而是使用自回归语言模型的并行解码轨迹来定义它，因为后者在一般文本生成任务中表现更优。图像标记的去噪轨迹遵循标准的离散扩散方式。我们同时在这些结合的多模态轨迹上训练我们的统一一致性模型（UniCMs），并设定一个统一的训练目标。我们还引入了轨迹分割策略来提高训练的收敛性。从实验来看，在文本到图像的生成任务中，UniCMs在GenEval和Image Reward上的表现优于SD3，而所需的采样时间仅约为SD3的{1}/{8}。而在图像到文本的生成任务中，UniCMs在MMMU基准测试中的表现优于Show-o，并且在长序列生成速度上快了1.5倍。

papers.title: Can Multi-agent Help Disambiguation in Multi-domain Translation?
papers.title_zh: 多智能体系统能否帮助解决跨领域翻译中的歧义问题？
papers.authors: Zhibo Man, Shaoyang Xu, Yujie Zhang, Yi Feng, Yuanmeng Chen, Yufeng Chen, Xu Jinan, Wenxuan Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs)-based multi-agent systems have recently shown strong potential for machine translation (MT). However, their application to multi-domain translation (MDT) remains under-explored, particularly in addressing cross-domain word ambiguity. To investigate whether multi-agent approaches can help disambiguation in MDT, we propose a multi-agent collaborative disambiguation framework for MDT (MACD), which leverages the collaborative capabilities of LLMs for disambiguation. MACD consists of four cooperating agents responsible for domain allocation, general translation, domain disambiguation, and translation fusion. Experimental results show that MACD significantly improves translation performance across multiple domains and enhances disambiguation accuracy. Our approach reveals several findings on multi-agent collaboration in resolving word ambiguities.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在机器翻译领域展现出巨大的潜力。然而，它们在多领域翻译中的应用仍未被充分探索，尤其是在处理跨领域词汇歧义方面。为了研究多智能体方法是否能够帮助解决多领域翻译中的歧义问题，我们提出了一种多智能体协作消歧框架——MACD。该框架利用大语言模型的协同能力来进行歧义消解。MACD由四个协作的智能体组成，分别负责领域分配、通用翻译、领域消歧以及翻译融合。实验结果表明，MACD显著提升了多领域翻译的性能，并提高了歧义消解的准确性。我们的研究还揭示了多智能体协作在解决词汇歧义方面的若干重要发现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Agent-Dice: Disentangling Knowledge Updates via Geometric Consensus for Agent Continual Learning
papers.title_zh: 代理骰子：通过几何一致性算法分离知识更新，以实现代理的持续学习
papers.authors: Zheng Wu, Xingyu Lou, Xinbei Ma, Yansi Li, Weiwen Liu, Weinan Zhang, Jun Wang, Zhuosheng Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents significantly extend the utility of LLMs by interacting with dynamic environments. However, enabling agents to continually learn new tasks without catastrophic forgetting remains a critical challenge, known as the stability–plasticity dilemma.In this work, we argue that this dilemma fundamentally arises from the failure to explicitly distinguish between common knowledge shared across tasks and conflicting knowledge introduced by task-specific interference. To address this, we propose Agent-Dice, a parameter fusion framework based on directional consensus evaluation.Concretely, Agent-Dice disentangles knowledge updates through a two-stage process: geometric consensus filtering to prune conflicting gradients, and curvature-based importance weighting to amplify shared semantics.We provide a rigorous theoretical analysis that establishes the validity of the proposed fusion scheme and offers insight into the origins of the stability–plasticity dilemma. Extensive experiments on GUI agents and tool-use agent domains demonstrate that Agent-Dice exhibits outstanding continual learning performance with minimal computational overhead and parameter updates.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过与动态环境交互，显著提升了LLM的实用性。然而，让智能体能够持续学习新任务，同时避免灾难性的遗忘，仍然是一个关键挑战，这一挑战被称为“稳定性-可塑性困境”。在这项研究中，我们认为这个困境的根本原因在于无法明确区分任务之间共有的知识和由任务特定干扰引入的冲突知识。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Agent-Dice框架，这是一种基于方向性共识评估的参数融合方法。具体来说，Agent-Dice通过两个阶段来分离知识更新：第一阶段采用几何一致性过滤来剔除冲突的梯度；第二阶段则利用曲率基础的重要性加权方法来增强共享语义的传递效果。我们提供了严谨的理论分析，证明了所提出的融合方案的有效性，并揭示了“稳定性-可塑性困境”的起源。在GUI智能体和工具使用智能体领域的广泛实验表明，Agent-Dice在保持最小计算开销和参数更新的前提下，展现了出色的持续学习性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Automatic Slide Updating with User-Defined Dynamic Templates and Natural Language Instructions
papers.title_zh: 利用用户自定义的动态模板和自然语言指令，实现自动幻灯片更新功能
papers.authors: Kun Zhou, Jiakai He, Wenmian Yang, Zhensheng Wang, Yiquan Zhang, Weijia Jia
papers.abstract: Presentation slides are a primary medium for data-driven reporting, yet keeping complex, analytics-style decks up to date remains labor-intensive. Existing automation methods mostly follow fixed template filling and cannot support dynamic updates for diverse, user-authored slide decks. We therefore define “Dynamic Slide Update via Natural Language Instructions on User-provided Templates” and introduce DynaSlide, a large-scale benchmark with 20,036 real-world instruction–execution triples (source slide, user instruction, target slide) grounded in a shared external database and built from business reporting slides under bring-your-own-template (BYO-template) conditions. To tackle this task, we propose SlideAgent, an agent-based framework that combines multimodal slide parsing, natural language instruction grounding, and tool-augmented reasoning for tables, charts, and textual conclusions. SlideAgent updates content while preserving layout and style, providing a strong reference baseline on DynaSlide. We further design end-to-end and component-level evaluation protocols that reveal key challenges and opportunities for future research. The dataset and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/604E/.
papers.abstract_zh: 演示幻灯片是数据驱动报告的主要媒介，然而，保持复杂的分析式幻灯片的最新状态仍然需要大量的工作。现有的自动化方法大多采用固定的模板填充方式，无法支持对多样化的、由用户创建的幻灯片进行动态更新。因此，我们提出了“通过自然语言指令在用户提供的模板上进行动态幻灯片更新”的方法，并引入了DynaSlide这一大规模基准测试平台。该平台拥有20,036个真实的指令-执行三元组（源幻灯片、用户指令、目标幻灯片），这些数据来自一个共享的外部数据库，并且是在企业报告幻灯片的BYO-template条件下构建的。为了应对这一任务，我们提出了SlideAgent这一基于代理的框架，它结合了多模态幻灯片解析、自然语言指令的语义理解以及针对表格、图表和文本结论的工具辅助推理功能。SlideAgent能够在保留布局和风格的同时更新内容，为DynaSlide提供了一个可靠的参考基线。我们还设计了端到端和组件级评估协议，以揭示未来研究中的关键挑战和机遇。数据集和代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/604E/。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PretrainRL: Alleviating Factuality Hallucination of Large Language Models at the Beginning
papers.title_zh: 预训练RL：缓解大型语言模型在训练初期出现的虚假信息幻觉问题
papers.authors: Langming Liu, Kangtao Lv, Haibin Chen, Weidong Zhang, Yejing Wang, Shilei Liu, Xin Tong, Yujin Yuan, Yongwei Wang, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs), despite their powerful capabilities, suffer from factual hallucinations where they generate verifiable falsehoods. We identify a root of this issue: the imbalanced data distribution in the pretraining corpus, which leads to a state of “low-probability truth” and “high-probability falsehood”. Recent approaches, such as teaching models to say “I don’t know” or post-hoc knowledge editing, either evade the problem or face catastrophic forgetting. To address this issue from its root, we propose PretrainRL, a novel framework that integrates reinforcement learning into the pretraining phase to consolidate factual knowledge. The core principle of PretrainRL is “debiasing then learning.” It actively reshapes the model’s probability distribution by down-weighting high-probability falsehoods, thereby making “room” for low-probability truths to be learned effectively. To enable this, we design an efficient negative sampling strategy to discover these high-probability falsehoods and introduce novel metrics to evaluate the model’s probabilistic state concerning factual knowledge. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that PretrainRL significantly alleviates factual hallucinations and outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型尽管具有强大的能力，但仍存在事实幻觉问题，即它们会生成可验证的虚假信息。我们发现这个问题的根源在于预训练语料库中的数据分布不平衡，这导致“低概率真相”与“高概率虚假信息”并存的情况。一些近期的方法，比如教导模型说“我不知道”或事后知识编辑，要么无法解决这一问题，要么会导致灾难性的遗忘。为了从根本上解决这个问题，我们提出了PretrainRL这一新颖框架。该框架将强化学习融入预训练阶段，以巩固事实知识。PretrainRL的核心原则是“去偏见后再学习”。它通过降低高概率虚假信息的权重，主动重塑模型的概率分布，从而为学习低概率真相创造空间。为了实现这一目标，我们设计了一种高效的负样本采样策略来发现这些高概率虚假信息，并引入了新的评估指标来衡量模型在事实知识方面的概率状态。在三个公共基准测试上的广泛实验表明，PretrainRL显著改善了事实幻觉问题，其性能优于现有最先进的方法。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: OMHBench: Benchmarking Balanced and Grounded Omni-Modal Multi-Hop Reasoning
papers.title_zh: OMHBench：对平衡型与基础型全模态多跳推理算法进行性能比较
papers.authors: Seunghee Kim, Ingyu Bang, Seokgyu Jang, Changhyeon Kim, Sanghwan Bae, Jihun Choi, Richeng Xuan, Taeuk Kim
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have increasingly supported omni-modal processing across text, vision, and speech. However, existing evaluation frameworks for such models suffer from critical limitations, including modality shortcuts and biased reasoning paths. To address these challenges, we propose OMHBench, a novel benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate omni-modal multi-hop reasoning. It consists of 6,144 questions with balanced reasoning paths that are jointly grounded across all three modalities. Extensive evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art models reveals that (1) a large performance gap exists between proprietary and open-source MLLMs and (2) even proprietary models exhibit high sensitivity to reasoning path variations, resulting in asymmetric omni-modal grounding. Notably, models struggle when processing the speech modality, underscoring the need for balanced, multi-hop evaluation of omni-modal intelligence.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在文本、视觉和语音方面的跨模态处理能力日益增强。然而，现有的评估框架存在严重缺陷，包括模态间的简化处理以及推理路径的偏见问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了OHM Bench这一新型基准测试工具，旨在严格评估多模态多跳推理能力。该基准测试包含6,144个问题，这些问题在所有三种模态中都具有平衡的推理路径。对13种先进模型的广泛评估表明：(1)专有模型和开源模型之间的性能存在较大差距；(2)即使是专有模型也表现出对推理路径变化的高度敏感性，从而导致多模态推理的不对称性。值得注意的是，模型在处理语音模态时表现不佳，这凸显了需要平衡且多跳地评估多模态智能能力的必要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Uniform SVD: Dual-Level Optimization across Columns and Modules for LLM Compression
papers.title_zh: 超越统一SVD：针对大语言模型压缩的双向级优化技术
papers.authors: Lin Xv, Xian Gao, Ting Liu, Yuzhuo fu
papers.abstract: Low-rank decomposition, particularly Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), is a pivotal technique for mitigating the storage and computational demands of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, prevalent SVD-based approaches overlook the critical phenomenon that decomposition errors exhibit significant disparity across different components of the parameter matrix, often leading to suboptimal approximation. Furthermore, existing methods lack a direct metric to evaluate the importance of individual weight matrices. To address these limitations, we propose Duo-SVD (Dual-level Optimization SVD), a novel training-free framework that synergizes optimization at both the column and the module levels. First, Duo-SVD incorporates a Column-Preserving Strategy that explicitly retains columns exhibiting high decomposition errors, while applying low-rank approximation solely to those with lower errors. Second, at the module level, we employ a Module-Adaptive Allocation Strategy that formulates ratio allocation as a global constrained optimization problem based on perturbation-induced model deviation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Duo-SVD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art SVD-based baselines and structured pruning methods, establishing it as a superior paradigm for efficient LLM compression.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩分解，尤其是奇异值分解（SVD），是一种用于降低大语言模型（LLM）存储和计算需求的关键技术。然而，目前流行的基于SVD的方法忽略了这样一个重要现象：分解误差在不同参数矩阵的各个组成部分之间存在显著差异，这往往会导致近似效果不佳。此外，现有方法缺乏一种直接的方法来评估各个权重矩阵的重要性。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了Duo-SVD（双层次优化SVD）这一新型的无训练框架。该框架在列级和模块级同时进行优化。首先，Duo-SVD采用了一种保留列的策略，明确保留那些分解误差较高的列，而只对误差较小的列进行低秩近似处理。其次，在模块级别，我们采用了一种自适应分配策略，将比例分配问题转化为基于扰动引起的模型偏差的全局约束优化问题。大量实验表明，Duo-SVD始终优于现有的基于SVD的基准方法和结构化剪枝方法，使其成为高效压缩LLM的优越方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: RSA-Bench: Benchmarking Audio Large Models in Real-World Acoustic Scenarios
papers.title_zh: RSA-Bench：在真实声学场景中对音频大型模型进行性能评估
papers.authors: Yibo Zhang, Kaiwen Luo, Liang Lin, Shilinlu Yan, Jin Wang, Yaoqi Guo, Yitian Chen, Yalan Qin, Zhenhong Zhou, Kun Wang, Li Sun
papers.abstract: While Audio Large Models (ALLMs) have achieved remarkable proficiency, their robustness remains brittle in real-world deployment. Existing evaluations largely rely on synthetic Gaussian noise or simplistic single-source interference, failing to capture the intricate, multi-layered acoustic dynamics—or “Acoustic Ecology”—that characterize authentic physical environments. To bridge this ecological gap, we introduce RSA-Bench, a comprehensive robustness benchmark designed to stress-test ALLMs through high-fidelity auditory scene simulations. Unlike traditional methods, we construct evaluation samples by naturally superimposing diverse environmental soundscapes—spanning Pasture, Extreme Weather, Classroom, and Outdoors—onto clean speech signals across a spectrum of interference intensities. By evaluating models on six core tasks ranging from fundamental perception to complex reasoning, our study unveils three macro-level insights: (I) The Perception-Cognition Gap: Models maintain relative resilience in low-level recognition but suffer a functional collapse in high-order reasoning tasks under stress; (II) Scenario Sensitivity: “Vocal-like” interference (e.g., children playing) proves significantly more destructive than mechanical noise, challenging the model’s auditory attention mechanisms; and (III) The Denoising Paradox: Standard speech enhancement often exacerbates performance degradation, as ALLMs prove highly sensitive to the semantic distortions introduced by denoising artifacts.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然音频大型模型已经取得了显著的性能提升，但在实际部署中其鲁棒性仍然较为脆弱。现有的评估方法大多依赖于合成的高斯噪声或简单的单一来源干扰，无法捕捉到真实物理环境中复杂多层次的声学动态——即所谓的“声学生态”。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了RSA-Bench这一全面的鲁棒性评估基准，该基准通过高保真度的听觉场景模拟来测试音频大型模型的性能。与传统方法不同，我们通过将多种环境声音自然叠加到干净的语音信号上，从而构建评估样本，这些环境声音涵盖了牧场、极端天气、教室和户外等多种场景，并且干扰强度各不相同。通过对六个核心任务进行评估，从基础感知到复杂推理，我们的研究得出了三个重要发现：(I) 感知与认知之间的差距：模型在低级识别任务中仍保持相对的稳定性，但在高级推理任务中则会受到严重冲击而崩溃；(II) 场景敏感性：“类似人声”的干扰（例如儿童玩耍的声音）比机械噪音更具破坏性，这挑战了模型的听觉注意力机制；(III) 去噪悖论：标准的语音增强技术往往会导致性能下降，因为音频大型模型对去噪过程中产生的语义失真非常敏感。

papers.title: MedLayBench-V: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Expert-Lay Semantic Alignment in Medical Vision Language Models
papers.title_zh: MedLayBench-V：一种大规模基准测试，用于评估医学视觉语言模型中专家级语义对齐能力
papers.authors: Han Jang, Junhyeok Lee, Heeseong Eum, Kyu Sung Choi
papers.abstract: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs) have achieved expert-level proficiency in interpreting diagnostic imaging. However, current models are predominantly trained on professional literature, limiting their ability to communicate findings in the lay register required for patient-centered care. While text-centric research has actively developed resources for simplifying medical jargon, there is a critical absence of large-scale multimodal benchmarks designed to facilitate lay-accessible medical image understanding. To bridge this resource gap, we introduce MedLayBench-V, the first large-scale multimodal benchmark dedicated to expert-lay semantic alignment. Unlike naive simplification approaches that risk hallucination, our dataset is constructed via a Structured Concept-Grounded Refinement (SCGR) pipeline. This method enforces strict semantic equivalence by integrating Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) Concept Unique Identifiers (CUIs) with micro-level entity constraints. MedLayBench-V provides a verified foundation for training and evaluating next-generation Med-VLMs capable of bridging the communication divide between clinical experts and patients.
papers.abstract_zh: 医学视语模型在解读诊断影像方面已经达到了专家级水平。然而，目前的模型主要基于专业文献进行训练，这限制了它们以通俗易懂的方式向患者传达诊断结果的能力。虽然以文本为中心的研究已经积极开发了简化医学术语的资源，但缺乏大规模的多模态基准测试来促进易于理解的医学图像理解。为了填补这一资源空白，我们推出了MedLayBench-V，这是首个专门用于实现专家与普通人之间语义对齐的大规模多模态基准测试。与那些可能导致误解的简单简化方法不同，我们的数据集是通过结构化概念细化流程构建的。这种方法通过将统一医学语言系统的概念唯一标识符与微观层面的实体约束相结合，确保了严格的语义等价性。MedLayBench-V为训练和评估下一代能够弥合临床专家与患者之间沟通鸿沟的医学视语模型提供了可靠的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Divergent Thinking: Escape the Homogeneity Trap in Generative Commonsense Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 发散性思维：摆脱生成性常识推理中的一致性陷阱
papers.authors: Yiheng Tao, Kaiwen Cheng, Zhiwei Nie, Chang Liu, Jie Chen
papers.abstract: Generative commonsense reasoning (GCR) requires models to synthesize coherent narratives that simultaneously satisfy lexical constraints and commonsense logic. Although ensemble-based LLM strategies are widely adopted to alleviate the fragility of single-chain reasoning, we uncover a counterintuitive homogeneity trap in GCR. Specifically, we observe that increasing the number of reasoning chains can degrade performance, as the generated chains tend to collapse into a narrow semantic region, thereby reinforcing shared biases rather than providing complementary evidence. We posit that escaping this trap requires fundamentally broadening semantic coverage via heterogeneous sources. Our investigation into the nature of diversity reveals that deep semantic diversity, rather than surface-level lexical variation, is the decisive prerequisite for effective integration. Motivated by this insight, we propose an Explore-then-Integrate framework, in which high–semantic-entropy explorers capture diverse concept bindings, and a powerful integrator performs compositional synthesis to merge valid fragments into coherent narratives. Crucially, to ensure that the observed performance gains arise from accurate logical composition rather than trivial best-candidate selection, we introduce a provenance-aware evaluation suite that explicitly quantifies the heterogeneous origins of synthesized outputs. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the consistent superiority of our approach across a range of metrics. Notably, our method achieves over 10% improvement in overall accuracy on NoRa and in SPICE score on CommonGen-Lite.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成性常识推理（GCR）要求模型能够合成出既符合词汇限制又遵循常识逻辑的连贯叙述。虽然基于集成方法的大语言模型策略被广泛用于缓解单一链条推理的局限性，但我们发现GCR中存在一种反直觉的同质性陷阱。具体来说，我们发现增加推理链条的数量会降低性能，因为生成的链条往往会收缩到一个狭窄的语义区域，从而强化共同的偏见，而不是提供互补的证据。我们认为，要摆脱这种陷阱，就需要通过多样化的来源来根本性地扩大语义覆盖范围。对多样性的研究表明，深层语义多样性而非表面级的词汇差异，才是实现有效整合的关键前提。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一种“先探索再整合”的框架：高语义熵的探索者负责捕捉各种概念关联，而强大的整合器则负责进行组合式合成，将有效的片段合并成连贯的叙述。为了确保所观察到的性能提升源于准确的逻辑组合，而非简单的最佳候选选择，我们引入了一种注重来源可识别性的评估方法，能够明确量化合成输出的多样化来源。在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在不同指标上始终表现出显著的优越性。值得注意的是，我们的方法在NoRa指标上的整体准确率提升了超过10%，在CommonGen-Lite上的SPICE得分也取得了显著提升。

papers.title: SafeSteer: A Decoding-level Defense Mechanism for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SafeSteer：一种针对多模态大语言模型的防御机制
papers.authors: Xinyi Zeng, Xue Yang, Jingyuan Zhang, Huanqian Yan, Xiang Chen, Kaiwen Wei, Hankun Kang, Yu Tian
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are gaining increasing attention. Due to the heterogeneity of their input features, they face significant challenges in terms of jailbreak defenses. Current defense methods rely on costly fine-tuning or inefficient post-hoc interventions, limiting their ability to address novel attacks and involving performance trade-offs. To address the above issues, we explore the endogenous safety capabilities within MLLMs and quantify their intrinsic ability to discern harmfulness at both encoding and decoding stages. We observe that 1) MLLMs can distinguish the harmful and harmless inputs during decoding process, 2) Image-based attacks are more stealthy. Based on these insights, we introduce SafeSteer, a decoding-level defense mechanism for MLLMs. Specifically, it employs a lightweight discriminator, based on the MLLM’s own discriminative ability, to iteratively steer the decoding process toward safety. A safety alignment vector is also integrated to handle complex multimodal threats. Experiments on multiple MLLMs demonstrate that our proposed method can improve safety performance by up to 33.40% without fine-tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型正受到越来越多的关注。由于其输入特征的多样性，这些模型在防御攻击方面面临着重大挑战。目前的防御方法依赖于昂贵的微调或低效的后置干预措施，这限制了它们应对新型攻击的能力，同时也带来了性能上的权衡。为了解决上述问题，我们研究了多模态大语言模型内部的内生安全能力，并量化了它们在编码和解码阶段识别有害内容的内在能力。我们发现：1）多模态大语言模型能够在解码过程中区分有害与无害的输入；2）基于图像的攻击方式更加隐蔽。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种用于多模态大语言模型的解码级防御机制——SafeSteer。该机制利用基于多模态大语言模型自身判别能力的轻量级鉴别器，来逐步引导解码过程朝着安全方向进行。此外，我们还引入了安全对齐向量来处理复杂的多模态威胁。在多个多模态大语言模型上的实验表明，我们的方法无需进行任何微调，就能将安全性提升高达33.40%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
