papers.title: SEMA-RAG: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Medical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: SEMA-RAG：一种自演化多智能体检索增强生成框架，适用于医学推理领域
papers.authors: Yongfeng Huang, Ruiying Chen, James Cheng
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely employed to mitigate risks such as hallucinations and knowledge obsolescence in medical question answering, yet its predominantly single-round, static retrieval paradigm misaligns with the multi-stage process of clinical reasoning. This compressed workflow induces two structural deficiencies: question-to-query translation often lacks clinically grounded semantic interpretation, and retrieval lacks iterative sufficiency feedback, making it difficult to form reliable evidence chains. We argue that both issues stem from a deeper cause—overloading a single reasoning chain with heterogeneous tasks of interpretation, exploration, and adjudication—and that the remedy is to reconstruct the workflow via task decoupling and dynamic multi-round exploration. To this end, we propose the Self-Evolving Multi-Agent framework SEMA-RAG, which assigns these roles to three specialist agents: Interpreter Agent for clinical schema interpretation, Explorer Agent for sufficiency-driven self-evolving retrieval, and Arbiter Agent for evidence adjudication and answer selection. Across five benchmarks and five LLM backbones, SEMA-RAG improves the strongest baseline by +6.46 accuracy points on average, measured per backbone.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术被广泛用于降低医学问答中的幻觉和知识过时风险，但其主要采用的单轮静态检索方式与临床推理的多阶段过程并不匹配。这种简化的工作流程存在两个结构性缺陷：问题到查询的转换往往缺乏基于临床的语义解释，而检索过程中又缺乏迭代性的充分性反馈，这使得形成可靠的证据链变得困难。我们认为，这两个问题的根源在于：单一的推理链条被Interpretation、Exploration和Judgment等不同类型的任务所负担过重。解决这一问题的方法是通过任务分离和动态的多轮探索来重构工作流程。为此，我们提出了Self-Evolving Multi-Agent框架SEMA-RAG，该框架将这三个角色分配给三个专业代理：Interpretation代理负责临床模式的解释；Explorer代理负责基于充分性原则的自动进化式检索；Arbiter代理则负责证据的裁决和答案的选择。在五个基准测试以及五个大语言模型的基础上，SEMA-RAG平均提升了最优秀基线模型的准确率+6.46个百分点。

papers.title: On the Step Length Confounding in LLM Reasoning Data Selection
papers.title_zh: 关于大语言模型推理中的步长因素对数据选择的影响
papers.authors: Bing Wang, Rui Miao, Chen Shen, Shaotian Yan, Kaiyuan Liu, Ximing Li, Xiaosong Yuan, Sinan Fan, Jun Zhang, Jieping Ye
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models have recently demonstrated strong performance on complex tasks that require long chain-of-thought reasoning, through supervised fine-tuning on large-scale and high-quality datasets. To construct such datasets, existing pipelines generate long reasoning data from more capable Large Language Models (LLMs) and apply manually heuristic or naturalness-based selection methods to filter high-quality samples. Despite the proven effectiveness of naturalness-based data selection, which ranks data by the average log probability assigned by LLMs, our analysis shows that, when applied to LLM reasoning datasets, it systematically prefers samples with longer reasoning steps (i.e., more tokens per step) rather than higher-quality ones, a phenomenon we term step length confounding. Through quantitative analysis, we attribute this phenomenon to low-probability first tokens in reasoning steps; longer steps dilute their influence, thereby inflating the average log probabilities. To address this issue, we propose two variant methods: ASLEC-DROP, which drops first-token probabilities when computing average log probability, and ASLEC-CASL, which applies a causal debiasing regression to remove the first tokens’ confounding effect. Experiments across four LLMs and five evaluation benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in mitigating the step length confounding problem.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在需要长时间思考的复杂任务上表现优异，这得益于在大规模且高质量的数据集上进行有监督的微调。为了构建这样的数据集，现有的方法会利用更强大的大语言模型生成较长的推理数据，然后手动使用基于启发式或自然性的筛选方法来选择高质量的样本。尽管基于自然性的数据筛选方法已被证明是有效的，该方法是根据大语言模型赋予数据的平均对数概率来排序数据的。但我们的分析表明，当这种方法应用于大语言模型的推理数据集时，它会系统性地偏好那些推理步骤较长（即每步包含更多 词元）的样本，而不是质量更高的样本。我们将这种现象称为“步骤长度混淆”。通过定量分析，我们认为这种现象是由于推理步骤中概率较低的第一个 词元 导致的；较长的步骤会削弱这些 词元 的影响，从而导致平均对数概率被高估。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了两种改进方法：ASLEC-DROP，该方法在计算平均对数概率时忽略第一个 词元 的概率；以及 ASLEC-CASL，该方法采用因果去混淆回归技术来消除第一个 词元 的混淆效应。通过在四种大语言模型和五个评估基准上的实验验证，我们证明了我们的方法在缓解步骤长度混淆问题方面的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SLIM: Stealthy Low-Coverage Black-Box Watermarking via Latent-Space Confusion Zones
papers.title_zh: SLIM：通过隐空间混淆区域实现的隐蔽式低覆盖度黑盒水印技术
papers.authors: Hengyu WU, Yang Cao
papers.abstract: Training data is a critical and often proprietary asset in Large Language Model (LLM) development, motivating the use of data watermarking to embed model-transferable signals for usage verification. We identify low coverage as a vital yet largely overlooked requirement for practicality, as individual data owners typically contribute only a minute fraction of massive training corpora. Prior methods fail to maintain stealthiness, verification feasibility, or robustness when only one or a few sequences can be modified. To address these limitations, we introduce SLIM, a framework enabling per-user data provenance verification under strict black-box access. SLIM leverages intrinsic LLM properties to induce a Latent-Space Confusion Zone by training the model to map semantically similar prefixes to divergent continuations. This manifests as localized generation instability, which can be reliably detected via hypothesis testing. Experiments demonstrate that SLIM achieves ultra-low coverage capability, strong black-box verification performance, and great scalability while preserving both stealthiness and model utility, offering a robust solution for protecting training data in modern LLM pipelines.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练数据在大语言模型开发中是一种至关重要且往往属于专有资源的资产。因此，人们倾向于使用数据水印技术来嵌入模型可迁移的标识信息，以便于验证数据的真实性。我们发现，数据覆盖范围的不足是一个重要但常被忽视的问题，因为单个数据所有者通常只贡献了庞大训练语料库中的极小部分。以往的方法在只能修改少量序列的情况下，无法保持数据的隐蔽性、验证的可行性以及鲁棒性。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了SLIM框架。该框架能够在严格的黑盒访问条件下实现每个用户的数据来源验证。SLIM利用大语言模型固有的特性，通过训练模型将语义相似的前缀映射到不同的后续内容，从而创造出一种“潜在空间混淆区”。这种现象表现为局部生成的不稳定性，可以通过假设检验来可靠地检测出来。实验表明，SLIM具备超低的数据覆盖能力、强大的黑盒验证性能以及良好的可扩展性，同时还能保持数据的隐蔽性和模型的实用性，为现代语言模型管道中保护训练数据提供了有效的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SQL-ASTRA: Alleviating Sparse Feedback in Agentic SQL via Column-Set Matching and Trajectory Aggregation
papers.title_zh: SQL-ASTRA：通过列集匹配和轨迹聚合来减轻代理式SQL中的稀疏反馈问题
papers.authors: Long Li, Zhijian Zhou, Jiangxuan Long, Peiyang Liu, Weidi Xu, Zhe Wang, Shirui Pan, Chao Qu
papers.abstract: Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) shows promise for complex tasks, but Text-to-SQL remains mostly restricted to single-turn paradigms. A primary bottleneck is the credit assignment problem. In traditional paradigms, rewards are determined solely by the final-turn feedback, which ignores the intermediate process and leads to ambiguous credit evaluation. To address this, we propose Agentic SQL, a framework featuring a universal two-tiered reward mechanism designed to provide effective trajectory-level evaluation and dense step-level signals. First, we introduce Aggregated Trajectory Reward (ATR) to resolve multi-turn credit assignment. Using an asymmetric transition matrix, ATR aggregates process-oriented scores to incentivize continuous improvement. Leveraging Lyapunov stability theory, we prove ATR acts as an energy dissipation operator, guaranteeing a cycle-free policy and monotonic convergence. Second, Column-Set Matching Reward (CSMR) provides immediate step-level rewards to mitigate sparsity. By executing queries at each turn, CSMR converts binary (0/1) feedback into dense [0,1] signals based on partial correctness. Evaluations on BIRD show a 5% gain over binary-reward GRPO. Notably, our approach outperforms SOTA Arctic-Text2SQL-R1-7B on BIRD and Spider 2.0 using identical models, propelling Text-to-SQL toward a robust multi-turn agent paradigm.
papers.abstract_zh: 主动式强化学习在复杂任务中展现出巨大潜力，但文本到SQL模型目前主要局限于单轮次范式。其中一个主要的瓶颈是奖励分配问题。在传统范式中，奖励仅由最后一轮的反馈决定，这忽略了中间过程，导致奖励评估存在不确定性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了主动式SQL框架，该框架采用一种通用的双层次奖励机制，旨在提供有效的轨迹级评估和密集的步级信号。首先，我们引入了聚合轨迹奖励机制，以解决多轮次奖励分配的问题。通过采用非对称转移矩阵，聚合轨迹奖励能够激励持续的改进。利用李雅普诺夫稳定性理论，我们证明了聚合轨迹奖励机制具有能量耗散功能，能够确保策略无循环且收敛性良好。其次，列集匹配奖励机制能够为每一步提供即时的奖励，从而缓解稀疏性问题。通过在每一轮执行查询，列集匹配奖励机制可以将二进制反馈转化为基于部分正确性的密集[0,1]信号。在BIRD数据集上的实验表明，与二元奖励的GRPO方法相比，我们的方法提升了5%的性能。值得注意的是，我们的方法在BIRD和Spider 2.0数据集上的表现优于现有的顶级模型Arctic-Text2SQL-R1-7B，这表明文本到SQL模型正朝着一个强大的多轮次主动式范式发展。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rotation Control Unlearning: Quantifying and Controlling Continuous Unlearning for LLM with The Cognitive Rotation Space
papers.title_zh: 旋转控制与遗忘：利用认知旋转空间对大型语言模型进行持续遗忘的量化与控制
papers.authors: Xiang Zhang, Kun Wei, Xu Yang, Jiahua Li, Su Yan, Cheng Deng
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly prevalent, their security vulnerabilities have already drawn attention.Machine unlearning is introduced to seek to mitigate these risks by removing the influence of undesirable data. However, existing methods not only rely on the retained dataset to preserve model utility, but also suffer from cumulative catastrophic utility loss under continuous unlearning requests.To solve this dilemma, we propose a novel method, called Rotation Control Unlearning (RCU), which leverages the rotational salience weight of RCU to quantify and control the unlearning degree in the continuous unlearning process.The skew symmetric loss is designed to construct the existence of the cognitive rotation space, where the changes of rotational angle can simulate the continuous unlearning process.Furthermore, we design an orthogonal rotation axes regularization to enforce mutually perpendicular rotation directions for continuous unlearning requests, effectively minimizing interference and addressing cumulative catastrophic utility loss.Experiments on multiple datasets confirm that our continuous unlearning method without retained dataset achieves SOTA performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用，其安全漏洞已经引起了人们的关注。为了缓解这些风险，人们提出了机器反学习的方法，通过去除不良数据的影响来降低风险。然而，现有的方法不仅依赖于保留的数据集来维持模型的实用性，而且在持续的反学习请求下还会遭受累积性的灾难性效用损失。为了解决这一难题，我们提出了一种名为“旋转控制反学习”（RCU）的新方法。该方法利用旋转显著性权重来量化和控制反学习程度。我们设计了偏对称损失函数，以构建认知旋转空间，其中旋转角度的变化可以模拟持续的反学习过程。此外，我们还设计了正交旋转轴正则化机制，以确保持续反学习请求的方向相互垂直，从而有效减少干扰并避免累积性的灾难性效用损失。在多个数据集上的实验表明，我们的持续反学习方法在没有保留数据集的情况下仍能取得出色的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SpecEdit: A Spectral Approach for Multi-Round Knowledge Editing
papers.title_zh: SpecEdit：一种适用于多轮知识编辑的频谱处理方法
papers.authors: Junxian Liu, Zikun Deng, Xin Wu, Dazhen Deng, Yi Cai
papers.abstract: Multi-round batch knowledge editing often suffers from performance degradation as edits accumulate. Focusing on the locate-then-edit paradigm, we analyze this phenomenon from a spectral perspective and identify a previously overlooked structural factor: the intrinsic knowledge of the model and historical edit memories exhibit markedly different spectral characteristics and information distributions, yet are naively coupled and jointly inverted during editing. Based on this insight, we propose SpecEdit to improve the model editing from a spectral perspective. SpecEdit performs spectral decoupling to isolate editing-critical directions and reduce destructive coupling, followed by spectral-structure-aware information compensation and spectral fusion to construct a refined closed-form solution. The module integrates seamlessly into existing editing methods without altering their original optimization procedures. Experiments on multiple LLMs and editing methods show that SpecEdit consistently improves performance, demonstrating that modeling spectral structure is an effective, interpretable approach and a promising direction for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 多轮批量知识编辑在编辑内容不断累积时，往往会面临性能下降的问题。基于“先定位再编辑”的范式，我们从光谱角度分析了这一现象，并发现了一个之前被忽视的结构性因素：模型的固有知识与历史编辑记录所呈现的光谱特征和信息分布存在显著差异，然而在编辑过程中，这两种信息却被天真地耦合在一起并共同进行处理。基于这一洞察，我们提出了SpecEdit方法来从光谱角度改进模型编辑过程。SpecEdit通过光谱解耦技术分离出编辑的关键方向，减少破坏性耦合现象；同时采用光谱-结构感知的信息补偿和光谱融合技术，构建出更精确的解。该模块可以无缝集成到现有的编辑方法中，而无需改变其原有的优化流程。在多个大语言模型和编辑方法的实验验证中，我们发现SpecEdit能够持续提升性能，这表明对光谱结构的建模是一种有效且可解释的方法，也是未来研究的一个有前景的方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SAGE: Sign-Adaptive Gradient for Memory-Efficient LLM Optimization
papers.title_zh: SAGE：自适应符号梯度法，用于内存高效的大语言模型优化
papers.authors: Wooin Lee, Hyun-Tae Kim
papers.abstract: The AdamW optimizer, while standard for LLM pretraining, is a critical memory bottleneck, consuming optimizer states equivalent to twice the model’s size. Although light-state optimizers like SinkGD attempt to address this issue, we identify the embedding layer dilemma: these methods fail to handle the sparse, high-variance gradients inherent to embeddings, forcing a hybrid design that reverts to AdamW and partially negates the memory gains. We propose SAGE (Sign Adaptive GradiEnt), a novel optimizer that resolves this dilemma by replacing AdamW in this hybrid structure. SAGE combines a Lion-style update direction with a new, memory-efficient O(d) adaptive scale. This scale acts as a “safe damper,” provably bounded by 1.0, which tames high-variance dimensions more effectively than existing methods. This superior stability allows SAGE to achieve better convergence. On Llama models up to 1.3B parameters, our SAGE-based hybrid achieves new state-of-the-art perplexity, outperforming all baselines, including SinkGD hybrid, while significantly reducing optimizer state memory.
papers.abstract_zh: AdamW优化器虽然适用于大语言模型预训练，但却存在严重的内存瓶颈问题，其消耗的优化器状态相当于模型大小的两倍。尽管像SinkGD这样的轻量级优化器试图解决这一问题，但我们发现了一个关于嵌入层的难题：这些方法无法处理嵌入层所固有的稀疏且高方差的梯度，因此不得不采用混合设计，重新使用AdamW，同时部分抵消了内存节省的效果。我们提出了SAGE（Sign Adaptive GradiEnt）这一新型优化器，它通过替换混合结构中的AdamW来解决这个难题。SAGE结合了狮子风格的更新方向和一种新的、高效的内存占用为O(d)的自适应缩放机制。这种缩放机制起到了“安全减震器”的作用，其数值被证明可以控制在1.0以内，这使得它能够比现有方法更有效地处理高方差的梯度。这种卓越的稳定性使得SAGE能够实现更好的收敛效果。在参数达到13亿的Llama模型中，基于SAGE的混合优化器取得了新的最优困惑度成绩，超越了所有基线算法，包括SinkGD混合优化器，同时显著减少了优化器的内存占用。

papers.title: DP^3: Differentially Private Prompt Perturbation for Multi-turn LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: DP^3：用于多轮LLM推理的差异化私有提示扰动方法
papers.authors: Lele Zheng, Chao Zhang, Feiyang Yuan, Ke Cheng, Tao Zhang, Anxiao Song, Yulong Shen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for text understanding and generation, with increasing deployment in applications involving sensitive user inputs. This raises significant privacy concerns, motivating the adoption of differential privacy (DP) to protect prompts during LLM inference. However, most existing DP methods assume single-turn interactions, whereas real-world usage often relies on multi-turn dialogue. Consequently, these single-turn-based methods break down in multi-turn settings, where recurring tokens repeatedly consume the privacy budget under DP, leading to accumulated privacy loss and degraded cross-turn semantic coherence.To address these challenges, we propose DP^3, a differentially private prompt perturbation framework for multi-turn LLM inference. DP^3 constructs a perturbation mapping table to reuse perturbations for recurring tokens, reducing redundant privacy costs. It also defines a context-aware utility function that combines embedding distance with attention-based contextual representations to maintain semantic consistency across turns. Additionally, DP^3 introduces a two-stage bucketed exponential mechanism to manage long-tail phenomena in large candidate spaces.Experimental results on multi-turn dialogue tasks demonstrate that DP^3 offers a better privacy-utility trade-off and stronger resistance to inference attacks compared to existing methods. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/XidianNSS/DP3.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在文本理解和生成方面得到了广泛应用，其应用范围也不断扩大，包括需要处理敏感用户输入的场景。这引发了严重的隐私问题，因此人们开始采用差分隐私技术来保护在语言模型推理过程中生成的提示信息。然而，大多数现有的差分隐私方法都假设交互是单轮次的，而现实中的使用往往涉及多轮对话。因此，这些基于单轮次的方法在多轮对话环境中会失效，因为重复出现的令牌会不断消耗差分隐私保护机制下的隐私预算，导致隐私损失加剧，同时也会破坏跨轮次之间的语义一致性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DP^3——一种适用于多轮次语言模型推理的差分隐私提示扰动框架。DP^3通过构建一种扰动映射表，使得重复出现的令牌能够重复使用相同的扰动方式，从而减少了重复的隐私成本。此外，该框架还定义了一个上下文感知的效用函数，该函数结合了嵌入距离和基于注意力的上下文表示，以维护各轮次之间的语义一致性。另外，DP^3还引入了一种两阶段的分桶指数机制，用于处理大型候选空间中的长尾现象。在多轮对话任务上的实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，DP^3在隐私与效用之间提供了更好的平衡，并且对推理攻击的抵抗能力更强。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/XidianNSS/DP3上免费获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RAMP: Risk-Aware Multi-Turn Planning for Jailbreak Red-Teaming
papers.title_zh: RAMP：基于风险意识的多次转序规划，用于越狱攻击的群体攻击策略
papers.authors: Yize Liu, Yunyun Hou, Aina Sui
papers.abstract: Multi-turn jailbreaking is a critical approach for evaluating the safety of large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods largely rely on heuristic strategies or trained attack agents, lacking a unified state-action formulation and systematic search over strategy compositions, and often struggling to balance attack success rate with query overhead. We propose RAMP, which formulates multi-turn jailbreaking as a risk-aware PDDL planning problem. Specifically, we characterize dialogue safety using predicate-based states, abstract common jailbreak strategies as high-level actions, and introduce a closed-loop framework that iteratively plans and executes each turn via a Judge, a Transitioner, and a Planner. Experimental results show that RAMP achieves consistently strong attack performance across both open-source and closed-source target models, while remaining effective under stricter turn budgets and yielding a favorable efficiency–effectiveness trade-off. Ablation studies, interpretability analyses, and extended experiments further show that multi-step planning, clue accumulation, and consistent findings across evaluator settings are key factors underlying these gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 多轮越狱方法是一种评估大语言模型安全性的重要手段。然而，现有的方法大多依赖于启发式策略或训练有素的攻击代理，缺乏统一的状态-动作表述方式，也无法系统地搜索各种策略组合。此外，这些方法往往难以在攻击成功率和查询开销之间取得平衡。我们提出了RAMP方法，将多轮越狱问题转化为一个具有风险意识的PDDL规划问题。具体来说，我们通过基于谓词的状态来表征对话安全性，将常见的越狱策略抽象为高级动作，并引入了一个闭环框架，该框架通过裁判器、转换器和规划器来迭代地规划和执行每一轮操作。实验结果表明，RAMP在开源和闭源目标模型中都能取得稳定的强效攻击性能，同时在更严格的轮次限制下依然保持有效性，并且实现了良好的效率与效果之间的权衡。进一步的消融研究、可解释性分析以及扩展实验表明，多步规划、线索积累以及在不同评估环境下保持一致的结果都是实现这些优势的关键因素。

papers.title: LexGenius: An Expert-Level Benchmark for Large Language Models in Legal General Intelligence
papers.title_zh: LexGenius：一种适用于大型语言模型的专业级基准测试工具，用于法律领域的一般智能处理任务
papers.authors: Wenjin Liu, Haoran Luo, Xin Feng, Xiang Ji, Lijuan Zhou, Rui Mao, Jiapu Wang, Shirui Pan, Erik Cambria
papers.abstract: Legal general intelligence (GI) refers to artificial intelligence (AI) that encompasses legal understanding, reasoning, and decision-making, simulating the expertise of legal experts across domains. However, existing benchmarks are result-oriented and fail to systematically evaluate the legal intelligence of large language models (LLMs), hindering the development of legal GI. To address this, we propose LexGenius, an expert-level Chinese legal benchmark for evaluating legal GI in LLMs. It follows a Dimension-Task-Ability framework, covering seven dimensions, eleven tasks, and twenty abilities. We use the recent legal cases and exam questions to create multiple-choice questions with a combination of manual and LLM reviews to reduce data leakage risks, ensuring accuracy and reliability through multiple rounds of checks. We evaluate 12 state-of-the-art LLMs using LexGenius and conduct an in-depth analysis. We find significant disparities across legal intelligence abilities for LLMs, with even the best LLMs lagging behind human legal professionals. We believe LexGenius can assess the legal intelligence abilities of LLMs and enhance legal GI development.Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/LexGenius.
papers.abstract_zh: 法律通用智能（GI）指的是一种人工智能技术，它涵盖了法律理解、推理和决策能力，能够模拟各领域法律专家的专业水平。然而，现有的评估基准都是以结果为导向的，无法系统地评估大语言模型的法律智能水平，这阻碍了法律通用智能的发展。为此，我们提出了LexGenius这一专家级中文法律评估基准，用于评估大语言模型的法律智能水平。该基准遵循“维度-任务-能力”框架，涵盖七个维度、十一个任务和二十种能力。我们通过结合人工审查和大语言模型分析的方式，从最新的法律案例和考试题目中创建多项选择题，以减少数据泄露的风险，从而确保评估结果的准确性和可靠性。我们对12种最先进的大语言模型进行了评估，并进行了深入分析。我们发现，不同大语言模型在法律智能方面的能力存在显著差异，即使是最优秀的大语言模型也仍落后于人类法律专业人士。我们相信，LexGenius能够评估大语言模型的法律智能水平，并促进法律通用智能的发展。我们的项目可以在https://github.com/QwenQKing/LexGenius下载。

papers.title: From Attenuation to Attention: Variational Information Flow Manipulation for Fine-Grained Visual Perception
papers.title_zh: 从衰减到注意力：用于精细视觉感知的变分信息流操控技术
papers.authors: Jilong Zhu, Yang Feng
papers.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in general visual understanding, they frequently falter in fine-grained perception tasks that require identifying tiny objects or discerning subtle visual relationships. We attribute this limitation to Visual Attenuation: a phenomenon where sparse fine-grained visual signals are prematurely suppressed or diluted by dominant textual tokens during network propagation, resulting in a “loss of focus” during the deep-level decision-making process. Existing input-centric solutions fail to fundamentally reverse this intrinsic mechanism of information loss. To address this challenge, we propose the Variational Information Flow (VIF) framework. Adopting a probabilistic perspective, VIF leverages a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) to model the visual saliency relevant to the question-answer pair as a latent distribution. As a plug-and-play module, VIF can be integrated into existing architectures. Extensive evaluations across diverse benchmarks—covering General VQA, fine-grained perception, and visual grounding—demonstrate that VIF yields competitive improvements over previous methods, validating its effectiveness in enhancing the fine-grained perception of MLLMs. Codes are available at https://github.com/ictnlp/VIF.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型在整体视觉理解方面展现出了令人印象深刻的性能，但在需要识别微小物体或辨别细微视觉关系的细粒度感知任务上，它们往往表现不佳。我们认为这种局限性源于“视觉衰减”现象：在网络传播过程中，稀疏的细粒度视觉信号会被占主导地位的文本标记过早地压制或稀释，从而导致在深层决策过程中“焦点丧失”。现有的以输入为中心的解决方案无法从根本上逆转这种信息丢失的机制。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了变分信息流框架。该框架采用概率论的方法，利用条件变分自编码器来将与问题-答案对相关的视觉显著性建模为潜在分布。作为一款即插式的模块，VIF可以集成到现有的架构中。通过在不同基准测试中的广泛评估——包括通用视觉问答、细粒度感知和视觉定位等领域——我们发现，VIF在提升多模态大语言模型的细粒度感知能力方面取得了显著的改进，证明了其有效性。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/ictnlp/VIF。

papers.title: VulAgent: Hypothesis-Validation Driven Multi-Agent Architecture for Vulnerability Detection
papers.title_zh: VulAgent：基于假设验证的多智能体架构，用于漏洞检测
papers.authors: Ziliang Wang, Ge Li, Jia Li, Hao Zhu, Zhi Jin
papers.abstract: Vulnerability detection with language models is challenging: it requires (i) precisely localizing security-sensitive code and (ii) reasoning about potential vulnerability conditions under complex, partially observed program context. We present VulAgent, a multi-agent vulnerability detection framework based on hypothesis validation. Our design is inspired by how human auditors review code: when noticing a sensitive operation, they form a hypothesis about a possible vulnerability, consider potential trigger paths, and then verify the hypothesis against the project context. Given a code unit, VulAgent first applies multi-view analyzers to identify and localize security-sensitive operations from complementary perspectives. For each sensitive operation, it then constructs an explicit vulnerability hypothesis—including triggering (or exploitation) preconditions and a candidate trigger path—and validates the hypothesis using project context together with the model’s general knowledge of commonly used APIs and security patterns. This validation-oriented design reduces speculative reports and substantially lowers false positives. Across PrimeVul and SVEN, VulAgent improves accuracy by 6.6 percentage points on average, increases vulnerable–fixed pair identification by up to 4.5x (2.46x on average), and reduces false positive rate by 36% relative to recent LLM-based baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用语言模型进行漏洞检测具有挑战性：这需要（i）精确定位敏感代码，以及（ii）在复杂且部分已知的项目上下文中推理出潜在的漏洞条件。我们提出了VulAgent，这是一个基于假设验证的多智能体漏洞检测框架。我们的设计灵感来源于人类审计员审查代码的方式：当发现某个敏感操作时，他们会形成一个关于潜在漏洞的假设，考虑可能的触发路径，然后结合项目上下文来验证这个假设。对于每一个敏感操作，VulAgent首先使用多视角分析工具从多个角度识别并定位这些敏感操作。接着，它构建一个明确的漏洞假设——包括触发（或利用）的前提条件以及可能的触发路径——并通过项目上下文以及模型对常用API和安全模式的了解来验证这个假设。这种以验证为导向的设计减少了推测性报告，并显著降低了误报率。在PrimeVul和SVEN项目中，VulAgent的平均准确率提高了6.6个百分点，漏洞与修复配对的数量增加了4.5倍（平均增加2.46倍），同时误报率相比最近的基于大语言模型的基线方法降低了36%。

papers.title: From Attack Surfaces to Actual Operations: A Survey of Modern LLM Jailbreaks
papers.title_zh: 从攻击面到实际操作：现代大语言模型越狱技术的研究综述
papers.authors: Ruikang Zhou, Changsheng Sun, Mark Huasong Meng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) face significant safety challenges from jailbreak attacks, techniques that manipulate prompts to bypass defenses and elicit harmful outputs. Existing taxonomies focus on manipulation methods rather than underlying mechanisms, limiting our understanding of attack effectiveness and defensive strategies.In this work, we survey existing LLM jailbreak attacks and organize them using a novel two-fold taxonomy. Our technical taxonomy categorizes attacks across three tiers based on exploited vulnerabilities and approaches. Our operational taxonomy evaluates attacks across four dimensions to assess real-world feasibility and sustainability. Through correlation analysis, we reveal relationships between LLM vulnerabilities and practical attack constraints.Applying our taxonomies to existing attacks identifies research gaps and provides insights for developing stronger offensive and defensive methods. Our work can contribute to systematic, risk-informed security improvements for LLMs, helping the research community move beyond reactive defenses.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型面临着严重的安全挑战，尤其是越狱攻击的威胁。这类攻击通过操控提示信息来绕过防御机制，进而产生有害的输出结果。现有的分类体系主要关注攻击手段而非其背后的机制，这限制了我们对攻击效果和防御策略的理解。在这项研究中，我们调查了现有的大语言模型越狱攻击，并采用一种新颖的双层分类体系对它们进行整理。我们的技术分类体系根据利用的漏洞和攻击方式将攻击分为三个层级。而我们的操作分类体系则从四个维度来评估攻击的实际可行性及可持续性。通过相关性分析，我们揭示了大语言模型漏洞与实际攻击限制条件之间的关系。将这些分类体系应用于现有攻击案例中，我们可以发现研究中的空白点，并为开发更强大的进攻性和防御性方法提供启示。我们的研究有助于系统地、基于风险分析的方式改进大语言模型的安全性，帮助研究界摆脱被动防御的模式。

papers.title: ARC: Active and Reflection-driven Context Management for Long-Horizon Information Seeking Agents
papers.title_zh: ARC：用于长期信息检索智能体的主动式与反射式上下文管理机制
papers.authors: Yilun Yao, Shan Huang, Elsie Dai, Zhewen Tan, Zhenyu Duan, Shousheng Jia, Yanbing Jiang, Tong Yang
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as research agents for deep search and long-horizon information seeking, yet their performance often degrades as interaction histories grow. This degradation, known as context rot, reflects a failure to maintain coherent and task-relevant internal states over extended reasoning horizons. Existing approaches primarily manage context through raw accumulation or passive summarization, treating it as a static artifact and allowing early errors or misplaced emphasis to persist. Motivated by this perspective, we propose ARC, which is the first framework to systematically formulate context management as an active, reflection-driven process that treats context as a dynamic internal reasoning state during execution. ARC operationalizes this view through reflection-driven monitoring and revision, allowing agents to actively reorganize their working context when misalignment or degradation is detected. Experiments on challenging long-horizon information-seeking benchmarks show that ARC consistently outperforms passive context compression methods, achieving up to an 11% absolute improvement in accuracy on BrowseComp-ZH with Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作深度搜索和长时信息检索的研究工具，然而随着交互历史的不断增加，它们的性能往往会下降。这种性能下降现象被称为“上下文退化”，它反映了在长时间的推理过程中无法保持连贯且与任务相关的内部状态。现有的方法主要通过原始积累或被动总结来处理上下文，将其视为静态的实体，从而让早期的错误或错误的重点得以持续存在。基于这一视角，我们提出了ARC框架。该框架首次将上下文管理系统地定义为一个主动的、以反思为驱动的过程，在执行过程中将上下文视为动态的内部推理状态。ARC通过以反思为驱动的监控和修正来实现这一目标，当检测到上下文的不一致或退化时，能够让模型主动重新组织其工作上下文。在具有挑战性的长时信息检索基准测试中的实验表明，ARC始终优于被动的上下文压缩方法，在使用Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct模型的情况下，其在BrowseComp-ZH任务上的准确率提升了11%。

papers.title: ToolDNA: Autonomous Evolution of Tool Metadata for Robust Dialogue Agents
papers.title_zh: ToolDNA：用于稳健对话代理的工具元数据自进化技术
papers.authors: Qiuyuan Ai, Cong Wang, Jiaqi Zhang, Zengxin Han, Jie Song
papers.abstract: Task-oriented dialogue (TOD) systems are vital for facilitating complex, goal-directed interactions across sectors like customer support and online retail. However, they face persistent limitations: labor-intensive manual metadata tuning and sparse reinforcement learning (RL) rewards that fail to diagnose invocation errors. To address this, we propose ToolDNA, a dynamic adaptation framework enabling autonomous co-evolution of policy networks and tool metadata via RL, anchored by two synergistic loops. An RL loop optimizes policies by generating rollout trajectories (reasoning, actions, descriptive updates) from user inputs, with multi-dimensional rewards refining invocations. A tool metadata loop—coordinated by a dedicated Tool Manager—evolves metadata through policy-generated candidates during rollouts and Feedback LLM-derived refinements from historical data. These mutually reinforcing loops close traditional reward gaps, forming a closed-loop trial-error-reflection cycle for self-improvement. Extensive experiments on a real-world dataset of 3,100 customer service dialogues confirm ToolDNA’s superiority, with notable gains over baselines: it achieves +11% problem resolution and +54% accuracy over commercial LLMs with prompt engineering; +25%/+35% over supervised fine-tuning; and +15%/+15% over traditional RL baseline. Linguistic analysis corroborates evolved metadata retain semantic intent while enhancing parseability. Case studies in two typical contexts, i.e., car inventory search and loan calculation, further validates its ability to resolve critical ambiguities. ToolDNA pioneers scalable self-improvement for robust, deployable tool-augmented agents with minimal human oversight. We release our code to facilitate future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 任务导向式对话系统对于促进诸如客户服务和在线零售等领域的复杂、目标导向型交互至关重要。然而，它们面临着一些持续的局限性：需要大量人工进行元数据调整，且强化学习中的奖励机制不够完善，无法有效诊断调用错误。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了ToolDNA这一动态适应框架。该框架通过强化学习实现策略网络和工具元数据的自主协同进化，其运作基于两个协同机制。其中一个强化学习机制通过生成从用户输入出发的逐步执行路径（包括推理过程、具体操作以及描述性更新），来优化策略；而另一个工具元数据机制则由专门的工具管理器负责，它通过策略生成的候选方案以及在历史数据基础上进行的反馈优化，来不断完善工具元数据。这些相互补充的机制能够填补传统奖励机制的缺陷，从而形成一种闭环的试错反思循环，从而实现自我改进。在包含3,100条客户服务对话的真实世界数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，ToolDNA具有显著优势：与商业大语言模型相比，其问题解决率提高了11%，准确率提升了54%；与经过监督训练的模型相比，准确率分别提高了25%和35%；而与传统的强化学习基线相比，准确率则分别提高了15%和15%。语言分析结果显示，ToolDNA所改进的元数据能够保留语义意图，同时提升了解析能力。在汽车库存搜索和贷款计算这两个典型场景中的案例研究进一步验证了ToolDNA在解决关键模糊性问题方面的能力。ToolDNA为开发无需过多人工干预、且具有强大功能的工具增强型智能体提供了可扩展的自我改进方案。我们将代码公开，以便未来研究人员能够进一步研究该框架的应用前景。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ExpertIVS: Sociological Expert Driven Individual Value Simulation in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: ExpertIVS：在大型语言模型中运用社会学视角来模拟个体价值
papers.authors: Zhen Wang, Yuqi Ren, Yuehan Cui, Hongxiang Wang, Jianxiang Peng, Zhaoxia Zhang, Bingkun Zhu, Tongxuan Zhang, Dezhi Tong, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated considerable potential for social simulation, yet struggle to accurately model individual value systems. Most existing methods mechanically stitch survey responses into prompts, which suffer from semantic fragmentation, failing to capture the internal coherence of human value systems. The value systems of LLMs are typically assessed using static multiple-choice questions, which fail to evaluate the value orientation in real-world dialogue interactions. To address these issues, we propose ExpertIVS, a framework employing 14 Sociological Expert Agents to interpret World Values Survey (WVS) responses through structured professional perspectives, rather than direct responses concatenation. These expert agents perform deep semantic reconstruction to generate robust and internally consistent individual profiles. To evaluate the consistency between LLMs and individual value systems during dynamic interactions, we further introduce a multi-agent debate mechanism. Extensive experiments across 480 individuals from 12 countries demonstrate that ExpertIVS achieves 90.78% value restoration fidelity and significantly outperforms baselines in value generalization (+5.3%). Moreover, ExpertIVS exhibits strong personality discriminability and behavioral consistency, enabling a shift from mere response concatenation to genuine sociological role-playing.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理在社交模拟方面展现出巨大的潜力，但难以准确模拟个体价值体系。目前大多数方法都是机械地将调查回答拼接成提示语，这种方式存在语义碎片化问题，无法捕捉人类价值体系的内部一致性。LLM的价值体系通常是通过静态的多项选择题来评估的，但这无法评估现实对话中的价值取向。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ExpertIVS框架。该框架利用14个社会学专家代理，通过结构化的专业视角来解读世界价值观调查中的回答，而不是简单的回答拼接。这些专家代理能够进行深入的语义重构，从而生成既稳健又具有内在一致性的个体特征描述。为了评估LLM在动态互动中与个体价值体系之间的一致性，我们还引入了一种多智能体辩论机制。通过对12个国家480名个体的广泛实验表明，ExpertIVS在价值还原方面的准确率达到了90.78%，并且在价值概括能力方面显著优于基线方法（+5.3%）。此外，ExpertIVS还表现出很强的个性区分能力和行为一致性，使得系统能够从单纯的回答拼接转变为真正的社会学角色扮演。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Be Your Own Red Teamer: Safety Alignment via Self-Play and Reflective Experience Replay
papers.title_zh: 成为自己的“红队成员”：通过自我演练和反思性经验来确保安全性
papers.authors: Hao Wang, Yanting Wang, Hao Li, Rui Li, Lei Sha
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities but remain vulnerable to adversarial “jailbreak” attacks designed to bypass safety guardrails. Current safety alignment methods depend heavily on static external red teaming, utilizing fixed defense prompts or pre-collected adversarial datasets. This leads to a rigid defense that overfits known patterns and fails to generalize to novel, sophisticated threats. To address this critical limitation, we propose empowering the model to be its own red teamer, capable of achieving autonomous and evolving adversarial attacks. Specifically, we introduce Safety Self- Play (SSP), a system that utilizes a single LLM to act concurrently as both the Attacker (generating jailbreaks) and the Defender (refusing harmful requests) within a unified Reinforcement Learning (RL) loop, dynamically evolving attack strategies to uncover vulnerabilities while simultaneously strengthening defense mechanisms. To ensure the Defender effectively addresses critical safety issues during the self-play, we introduce an advanced Reflective Experience Replay Mechanism, which uses an experience pool accumulated throughout the process. The mechanism employs a Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) sampling strategy to focus on failure cases with low rewards, helping the model learn from past hard mistakes while balancing exploration and exploitation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our SSP approach autonomously evolves robust defense capabilities, significantly outperforming baselines trained on static adversarial datasets and establishing a new benchmark for proactive safety alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已经取得了显著的性能，但依然容易受到旨在突破安全防护的对抗性“越狱”攻击。目前的安全对齐方法严重依赖静态的外部红队测试，使用固定的防御提示或预先收集好的对抗性数据集。这种僵化的防御方式会过度拟合已知模式，而无法应对新型、复杂的威胁。为了克服这一关键限制，我们提出了让模型自己充当红队成员的方法，使其能够自主地应对不断变化的对抗性攻击。具体来说，我们引入了“安全自我博弈”机制，该机制利用单个语言模型同时担任攻击者（生成越狱方案）和防御者（拒绝有害请求）的角色，在统一的强化学习循环中动态调整攻击策略，以发现漏洞，同时加强防御机制。为了确保防御者在自我博弈过程中能够有效处理关键安全问题，我们引入了先进的“反思经验回放机制”，该机制利用在整个过程中积累的经验数据。该机制采用上置信界采样策略，重点关注那些奖励较低的失败案例，帮助模型从过去的错误中学习，同时平衡探索与利用。大量实验表明，我们的“安全自我博弈”方法能够自主发展出强大的防御能力，其性能明显优于基于静态对抗性数据集训练的基线模型，为主动式安全对齐提供了新的基准。

papers.title: RetentiveKV: State-Space Memory for Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal KV Cache Eviction
papers.title_zh: RetentiveKV：适用于不确定性感知的多模态KV缓存淘汰的状态空间内存机制
papers.authors: Sihao Liu, YuFan Xiong, Zhonghua Jiang, Zhaode Wang, Chengfei lv, Shengyu Zhang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models face severe challenges in computational efficiency and memory consumption due to the substantial expansion of the visual KV cache when processing long visual contexts. Existing KV cache compression methods typically rely on the “persistence of importance” hypothesis to prune tokens. However, this approach proves fragile in multimodal settings due to two key issues: 1) Visual tokens display “deferred importance,” initially exhibiting low salience but becoming pivotal during later decoding, which can lead to premature eviction. 2) Discrete pruning disrupts the inherent spatial continuity of visual cues. To address these challenges, we propose RetentiveKV, an entropy-driven KV cache optimization method that reformulates KV eviction from “discrete context truncation” to “continuous memory evolution” based on State Space Models. Our method leverages information entropy to quantify the information potential of low-attention tokens and integrates tokens scheduled for eviction into a continuous state space through entropy-guided state transitions, enabling their dynamic reactivation when semantic relevance arises during subsequent decoding. Extensive experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that RetentiveKV achieves 5.0 × KV cache compression and 1.5 × decoding acceleration.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在处理长视觉上下文时，面临着计算效率和内存消耗的严峻挑战。现有的KV缓存压缩方法通常依赖“重要性持久性”假设来剪除无用标记。然而，这种方法在多模态环境中存在两个主要问题：1）视觉标记表现出“延迟重要性”，最初关注度较低，但在后续解码过程中变得至关重要，这可能导致过早被移除。2）离散式剪除会破坏视觉线索的连续性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了RetentiveKV这一基于熵驱动的KV缓存优化方法。该方法将KV缓存的移除方式从“离散上下文截断”转变为“连续记忆演化”，这一过程基于状态空间模型进行。我们的方法利用信息熵来量化低关注度标记的信息潜力，并通过熵引导的状态转换，将需要被移除的标记整合到连续的状态空间中，从而在后续解码过程中根据语义相关性动态重新激活这些标记。在多模态基准测试中的广泛实验表明，RetentiveKV实现了5.0倍的KV缓存压缩效果和1.5倍的解码加速效果。

papers.title: RCBSF: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Contract Revision via Stackelberg Game
papers.title_zh: RCBSF：一种基于多智能体的框架，用于通过斯塔克伯格博弈实现自动合同修订
papers.authors: Shijia Xu, Yu Wang, Xiaolong Jia, Zhou Wu, Kai Liu, April Xiaowen Dong
papers.abstract: Despite the adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in legal AI, automated contract revision remains impeded because generic models often treat strict legal constraints as mere suggestions. To address this safety gap, we introduce the Risk-Constrained Bilevel Stackelberg Framework (RCBSF), modeling high-stakes revision as a rigorous strategic interaction rather than an open-ended conversation. RCBSF establishes a hierarchical Leader-Follower structure: a Global Prescriptive Agent (GPA) leader imposes definitive risk budgets, while a follower system—comprising a Constrained Revision Agent (CRA) and a Local Verification Agent (LVA)—iteratively optimizes the output within these strict boundaries. We theoretically prove this bilevel formulation converges to an equilibrium yielding strictly superior utility over unguided methods. Empirically, RCBSF achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing iterative baselines with an average Risk Resolution Rate (RRR) of 84.21% and enhanced token efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/xjiacs/RCBSF .
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在法律人工智能领域得到了广泛应用，但自动合同修订仍然面临诸多挑战。因为通用模型往往将严格的法律约束仅仅视为一种建议而已。为了弥补这一安全漏洞，我们提出了风险约束双层斯塔克伯格框架（RCBSF）。该框架将高风险的修订过程视为一种严格的战略互动过程，而非简单的对话过程。RCBSF建立了一个层级化的领导者-追随者结构：一个全局指导性代理负责制定明确的风险预算，而一个由约束性修订代理和局部验证代理组成的追随系统则在这些严格限制范围内进行迭代优化。我们从理论上证明了这种双层结构能够收敛到一种均衡状态，其效用远高于未经优化的方法。从实证来看，RCBSF取得了卓越的性能表现，其平均风险解决率达到了84.21%，同时提升了代码处理效率。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/xjiacs/RCBSF下载。

papers.title: RAVR: Reference-Answer-guided Variational Reasoning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: RAVR：基于参考答案的变分推理技术，适用于大型语言模型
papers.authors: Tianqianjin Lin, Xi Zhao, Xingyao Zhang, Rujiao Long, Yi Xu, Zhuoren Jiang, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can refine the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), but critically depends on a key prerequisite: the LLM can already generate high-utility reasoning paths with non-negligible probability. For tasks beyond the LLM’s current competence, such reasoning path can be hard to sample, and learning risks reinforcing familiar but suboptimal reasoning. We are motivated by the insight from cognitive science that Why is this the answer is often an easier question than What is the answer, as it avoids the heavy cognitive load of open-ended exploration, opting instead for explanatory reconstruction—systematically retracing the reasoning that links a question to its answer. We show that LLMs can similarly leverage answers to derive high-quality reasoning paths. We formalize this phenomenon and prove that conditioning on answer provably increases the expected utility of sampled reasoning paths, thereby transforming intractable problems into learnable ones. Building on this insight, we introduce RAVR (Reference-Answer-guided Variational Reasoning), an end-to-end framework that uses answer-conditioned reasoning as a variational surrogate for question-only reasoning. Experiments across 11 benchmarks and 3 models demonstrate the effectiveness of RAVR, and analysis of the reasoning behavior shows that RAVR reduces hesitation, strengthens conclusion consolidation, and promotes problem-specific strategies in reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习能够提升大语言模型的推理能力，但其成功的关键在于一个前提条件：大语言模型必须能够以相当高的概率生成出高效的推理路径。对于超出模型当前能力的任务来说，这些高效推理路径可能难以被采样到，而学习过程可能会强化那些既熟悉又不够优化的推理方式。我们从认知科学中获得了启发：为什么这个答案是正确的，往往比“答案是什么”这个问题更容易回答，因为后者避免了开放式探索所带来的巨大认知负担，而是选择通过系统性的推理来连接问题和答案。我们证明，大语言模型也可以利用答案来推导出高质量的推理路径。我们将这一现象形式化，并证明基于答案的推理能够显著提高采样推理路径的预期效用，从而将难以解决的问题转化为可学习的难题。基于这一发现，我们提出了RAVR（基于参考答案的变分推理）这一端到端的框架，该框架将基于答案的推理作为仅基于问题的推理的替代方案。通过在11个基准测试和3种模型上的实验，我们证明了RAVR的有效性。对推理行为的分析表明，RAVR能够减少犹豫不决的情况，增强结论的巩固作用，并促进针对特定问题的策略性推理。

papers.title: Data-Centric Continual Pre-training for 500+ Languages: A New Bilingual Translation Corpus and Multilingual Models
papers.title_zh: 针对500多种语言的数据中心持续预训练：一种新的双语翻译语料库以及多语言模型
papers.authors: Shaoxiong Ji, Zihao Li, Jaakko Paavola, Hengyu Luo, Jörg Tiedemann
papers.abstract: This paper investigates a critical design decision in the practice of massively multilingual continual pre-training — the inclusion of parallel data. Specifically, we study the impact of bilingual translation data for massively multilingual language adaptation of the Llama 3 family of models to 500 languages. To this end, we construct a bilingual translation corpus named MaLA, containing data from more than 2,500 language pairs. Subsequently, we develop the EMMA-500 Llama 3 suite of four massively multilingual models — continually pre-trained from the Llama 3 family of base models extensively on diverse data mixes up to 671B tokens — and explore the effect of continual pre-training with or without bilingual translation data. Comprehensive evaluation across 7 tasks and 12 benchmarks demonstrates that bilingual data tends to enhance language transfer and performance, particularly for low-resource languages. We open-source the MaLA corpus, EMMA-500 Llama 3 suite artifacts, code, and model generations.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在大规模多语言持续预训练实践中一个关键的设计决策——并行数据的纳入问题。具体来说，我们研究了双语翻译数据对Llama 3系列模型进行500种语言适应时的影响。为此，我们构建了一个名为MaLA的双语翻译语料库，其中包含超过2500对语言的数据。随后，我们开发了EMMA-500 Llama 3系列模型，该系列包含四个大规模多语言模型，这些模型是从Llama 3基础模型开始持续预训练的，并基于多样化的数据组合进行了训练，数据量达到了671B个令牌。我们进一步探讨了在有无双语翻译数据的情况下进行持续预训练的效果。通过对7项任务及12个基准测试的全面评估发现，双语数据确实能够提升语言迁移能力和性能，尤其是在资源匮乏的语言中。我们将MaLA语料库、EMMA-500 Llama 3系列模型的代码以及模型生成结果全部开源了。

papers.title: Failures are Treasures: Constructing a Pedagogical Bridge for Agentic Strategy Distillation
papers.title_zh: 失败是宝贵的经验：构建用于策略提炼的教学框架
papers.authors: Jiaxin Guo, Hao Sun, Wenhao Zhang, Chunyu Yang, Yan Zhang
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in autonomous agent settings, small language models (SLMs) remain fragile, often collapsing after encountering errors. Traditional knowledge distillation focuses on imitating successful trajectories, while existing “learning from mistakes” methods treat errors as auxiliary signals rather than states requiring recoverable policies, leaving the dynamics of failure and recovery in agent settings largely unexplored. Inspired by Donald Schön’s theory of reflective practice, we propose P-BRIDGE (Pedagogical Bridge for Reflective Insight and Distillation of Guiding Errors). P-BRIDGE combines reflection-in-action with reflection-on-action, enabling agents to diagnose and correct critical errors during execution while abstracting transferable strategies from contrastive student–teacher trajectories. Experiments across eight benchmarks demonstrate that P-BRIDGE significantly elevates SLM performance—e.g., raising the 2WikiMultiHopQA accuracy of a 0.6B model from 6.2% to 34.2%.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在自主智能体场景中表现出色，但小型语言模型却较为脆弱，在遇到错误时常常会崩溃。传统的知识蒸馏方法侧重于模仿成功的训练轨迹，而现有的“从错误中学习”方法则将错误视为辅助信号，而非需要可恢复策略的状态。因此，智能体场景中的失败与恢复机制仍然缺乏研究。受Donald Schön的反思实践理论的启发，我们提出了P-BRIDGE（用于反思性洞察和引导错误蒸馏的教学桥梁）。P-BRIDGE将行动中的反思与对行动的反思相结合，使智能体能够在执行过程中诊断并纠正关键错误，同时从师生对比的情境中提取可迁移的策略。在八个基准测试中的实验表明，P-BRIDGE显著提升了小型语言模型的性能——例如，将一个拥有0.6B参数的模型在2WikiMultiHopQA任务上的准确率从6.2%提升到了34.2%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Reasoning with Knowledge-Distilled Parametric Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 在保护隐私的前提下进行推理，利用提取出的参数化检索技术来增强生成能力
papers.authors: Jinwen Chen, Hainan Zhang, Liang Pang, Yongxin Tong, Haibo Zhou, Wei Lin, Zhiming Zheng
papers.abstract: The current RAG system requires uploading plaintext documents to the cloud, risking private data leakage. Parametric RAG (PRAG) encodes documents as LoRA parameters within LLMs, offering a possible way to reduce exposure of raw content. However, it still faces two issues: (1) PRAG demands synthesizing QA pairs and fine-tuning LLM for each individual document to create its corresponding LoRA, leading to unacceptable inference latency. (2) The performance of PRAG relies solely on synthetic QA data while lacking internal alignment with standard RAG, resulting in poor generalization on out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. Therefore, achieving high-efficiency parameterization while maintaining RAG-level performance remains a critical challenge for privacy-preserving reasoning. In this paper, we propose DistilledPRAG, a generalizable knowledge-distilled parametric RAG model aligned with standard RAG in document structure and parameter activation. We first synthesize QA pairs from single and multi-documents to enhance cross-document reasoning. Then, we mask the plaintext documents with a special token and translate them to LoRA via a parameter generator, maintaining the standard RAG document structure. Finally, guided by synthetic QA data, we train the parameter generator to match standard RAG’s hidden states and output logits, enabling RAG-style reasoning without original documents. Experiments on four QA datasets show that DistilledPRAG outperforms baselines in accuracy and generalizes well on OOD data.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的RAG系统需要将明文文档上传到云端，这容易导致私人数据泄露。参数化RAG（PRAG）通过将文档编码为LoRA参数，从而将原始内容的风险降到最低。然而，它仍然面临两个问题：(1) PRAG需要为每个单独文档合成QA对，并对LLM进行微调，以生成相应的LoRA参数，这会导致不可接受的推理延迟。(2) PRAG的性能完全依赖于合成的QA数据，缺乏与标准RAG的内部对齐性，因此在非分布环境下的泛化能力较差。因此，在保持RAG级别性能的同时实现高效的参数化，仍然是保护隐私的推理技术中的一个关键挑战。在本文中，我们提出了DistilledPRAG模型，这是一种可泛化的参数化RAG模型，其文档结构和参数激活方式都与标准RAG一致。我们首先从单个和多个文档中合成QA对，以增强跨文档推理能力。然后，我们使用特殊令牌对明文文档进行掩码处理，并通过参数生成器将其转换为LoRA参数，同时保留标准RAG的文档结构。最后，在合成QA数据的指导下，我们训练参数生成器，使其与标准RAG的隐藏状态相匹配，并输出Logit值，从而实现无需原始文档即可进行RAG式推理。在四个QA数据集上的实验表明，DistilledPRAG在准确性和泛化能力方面均优于基线模型。

papers.title: Beyond Sentence-level Labels: Integrating Conversational Context and Personal Experience for Natural Emotional Expression
papers.title_zh: 超越句子级标签：整合对话上下文与个人经验以实现自然情感表达
papers.authors: Haiyang Sun, Chenyang Le, Wei Wang, Leying Zhang, Chuang Li, Bing Han, Chenda Li, Mengxiao Bi, Yanmin Qian
papers.abstract: Emotional Text-to-Speech aims to synthesize speech with human-like naturalness and expressiveness. However, existing systems rely on sentence-level labels, which fails to capture the subtle nuances of human affect. Based on cognitive appraisal theories, we argue that emotional expression is not generated in isolation but is deeply influenced by speaker’s Personal Experience and the conversational Context.To overcome the information bottleneck inherent in traditional annotations, we present Emotional-Context-Speech, a large-scale, context-aware speech corpus derived from multi-speaker audiobooks. This dataset provides not only transcriptions but also dialogue context, personal experience, open-vocabulary emotion labels, and paralinguistic descriptions.Experimental results demonstrate that TTS model trained using additional context and experience descriptions as inputs, called Emotional-Context-TTS, significantly outperforms existing methods in terms of emotional expression accuracy and naturalness.
papers.abstract_zh: 情感文本转语音技术旨在实现具有人类般自然性和表现力的语音合成。然而，现有的系统依赖于句子级别的标签，这无法捕捉人类情感的细微差别。基于认知评价理论，我们认为情感表达并非孤立产生的，而是受到说话者的个人经历和对话环境的深刻影响。为了克服传统注释中存在的信息瓶颈问题，我们提出了“情感-语境-语音”这一大规模、注重语境的语音语料库。该数据集不仅包含文字转录，还包含了对话语境、个人经历、开放词汇的情感标签以及副语言描述。实验结果表明，使用这些额外语境和个人经历描述进行训练的语音转语音模型，即“情感-语境-语音转语音”模型，在情感表达的准确性和自然性方面明显优于现有方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Structure-Aware Zero-Shot Relational Learning for Knowledge Graphs without External Knowledge
papers.title_zh: 基于结构感知的零样本关系学习算法，适用于无需外部知识的知识图谱场景
papers.authors: Kuan Xu, Baoxin Zhang, Shuyue Fan, Ming Chen, Zhipeng Ke, Jian Yu, Xuezhong Zhou
papers.abstract: Zero-shot Relational Learning (ZRL) aims to perform knowledge graph completion when dealing with newly emerging relations without instances of them. However, existing ZRL methods typically depend on external knowledge beyond Knowledge Graphs (KGs), resulting in increased annotation costs and limited practical applicability. To address this issue, we propose a new Structure-Aware paradigm for ZRL, termed SAZRL, that performs ZRL without relying on external knowledge. SAZRL leverages intrinsic structural patterns in KGs to bridge semantic correlations for new relations with existing ones. It constructs structure-aware conditional query graphs based on shared entities and adaptive relation updating module to generate representations for new relations based on the query graphs. We conduct extensive experiments on three real-world benchmarks, NELL-ZS, Wiki-ZS and FB15K-ZS, demonstrating that SAZRL consistently surpasses state-of-the-art ZRL methods, achieving up to 10.66% improvement in MRR while reducing annotation costs and enhancing practical applicability. The code and data are provided in supplementary materials.
papers.abstract_zh: 零样本关系学习（Zero-shot Relational Learning，ZRL）旨在在面临新出现的关系且缺乏相关实例时，完成知识图谱的填充任务。然而，现有的ZRL方法通常依赖于知识图谱之外的外部知识，这会增加注释成本并限制其实际应用性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的基于结构感知的ZRL方法，称为SAZRL。该方法无需依赖外部知识即可进行ZRL任务。SAZRL利用知识图谱中的内在结构模式来连接新关系和现有关系之间的语义关联。它基于共享实体构建结构感知的条件查询图，并通过自适应关系更新模块，根据查询图生成新关系的表示。我们在三个真实世界基准测试集上进行了广泛的实验，包括NELL-ZS、Wiki-ZS和FB15K-ZS，结果表明SAZRL在性能上始终优于最先进的ZRL方法，在MRR指标上实现了高达10.66%的提升，同时降低了注释成本并增强了其实用性。相关的代码和数据都包含在补充材料中。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Continual Safety Alignment via Gradient-Based Sample Selection
papers.title_zh: 通过基于梯度的样本选择实现持续的安全调整
papers.authors: Thong Bach, Dung Nguyen, Thao Minh Le, Truyen Tran
papers.abstract: Large language models require continuous adaptation to new tasks while preserving safety alignment. However, fine-tuning on even benign data often compromises safety behaviors. We investigate which training samples cause alignment drift through a data-centric lens. Our experiments show samples contribute unequally: high-gradient samples cause greater safety degradation and drive models toward pretrained distributions, while moderate-gradient samples enable task learning with minimal alignment loss. This connects to the elasticity phenomenon—high-gradient samples activate the reversion force pulling models toward pretrained behavior. We propose gradient-based sample selection that filters high-gradient samples during fine-tuning. Across multiple model families on continual domain tasks, our method substantially improves alignment preservation while maintaining competitive task performance, without requiring curated safe data or architectural modifications.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型需要不断适应新任务，同时保持安全性的对齐状态。然而，即使是在相对简单的数据上进行微调，也常常会导致安全性行为的下降。我们通过以数据为中心的方法来研究哪些训练样本会导致对齐状态的漂移。实验表明，不同样本的作用并不均衡：梯度较高的样本会导致更大的安全性退化，使模型趋向于预训练的分布；而梯度适中的样本则能够在最小化对齐损失的情况下实现任务学习。这一现象与“弹性现象”有关——梯度较高的样本会激活回归力，使模型趋向于预训练的行为。我们提出了一种基于梯度的样本选择方法，可以在微调过程中过滤掉梯度较高的样本。在多个模型家族的连续任务场景中，我们的方法显著提升了对齐状态的保持能力，同时保持了具有竞争力的任务性能，无需使用经过筛选的安全数据或进行架构上的修改。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ClinicalMC: A Benchmark for Multi-Course Clinical Decision-Making with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 临床决策助手：基于大型语言模型的多阶段临床决策的基准平台
papers.authors: Ruihui Hou, Siyi Zhu, Ziyue Huai, Guangya Yu, Yongqi Fan, ChunMing Wang, Tong Ruan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely adopted in healthcare, yet they still encounter significant challenges in complex clinical decision-making scenarios. Existing benchmarks primarily assess LLM performance in single-course settings and lack systematic evaluation in multi-course scenarios, where a patient’s condition evolves over time. To address this gap, we propose ClinicalMC, a benchmark for multi-course clinical decision-making. It includes 1,275 Chinese and 5,804 English samples across four stages from admission to discharge. These stages cover triage, first-course examination/diagnosis/treatment, subsequent multi-course examination/assessment/treatment, and final diagnosis. In ClinicalMC, patients in the English dataset undergo an average of 5.11 clinical courses, whereas those in the Chinese dataset undergo 3.42. To assess LLM performance, we construct a multi-agent evaluation framework that includes patient, examiner, and doctor agents. Based on the benchmark and framework, we design two experimental settings—a single-turn static setting and a multi-turn dynamic setting—and assess three categories of LLMs: 1) closed-source LLMs like GPT-4o-mini; 2) open-source LLMs like DeepSeek-V3, and 3) medical LLMs like HuatuoGPT-o1. Through extensive evaluation, we aim to better understand LLM performance in the medical domain and support its effective deployment in healthcare.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在医疗保健领域得到了广泛应用，但在复杂的临床决策场景中仍面临诸多挑战。现有的评估基准主要针对单一疗程的情况进行性能评估，而缺乏对多疗程场景的系统性评价——因为患者的状况会随着时间的推移而发生变化。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ClinicalMC这一用于多疗程临床决策的评估基准。该基准包含1,275个中文样本和5,804个英文样本，涵盖了从入院到出院的四个阶段。这些阶段包括初步诊断、第一疗程的检查/诊断/治疗、后续的多个疗程检查/评估/治疗以及最终的诊断。在ClinicalMC中，英文数据集中的患者平均经历5.11个临床疗程，而中文数据集中的患者则经历3.42个疗程。为了评估语言模型的性能，我们构建了一个多智能体评估框架，其中包括患者智能体、检查者智能体和医生智能体。基于这个基准和框架，我们设计了两种实验环境——单轮静态环境和多轮动态环境——并评估了三类语言模型：1）闭源语言模型，如GPT-4o-mini；2）开源语言模型，如DeepSeek-V3；3）医学专用语言模型，如HuatuoGPT-o1。通过广泛的评估，我们希望更好地了解语言模型在医疗领域的性能，并支持其在医疗保健领域的有效应用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Safe-SAIL: Towards a Fine-grained Safety Landscape of Large Language Models via Sparse Autoencoder Interpretation Framework
papers.title_zh: Safe-SAIL：通过稀疏自动编码器的解释框架，构建大型语言模型的安全细粒度场景模型
papers.authors: Jiaqi Weng, Han Zheng, Hanyu Zhang, Ej Zhou, Qinqin He, Jialing Tao, Hui Xue, Zhixuan Chu, Xiting Wang
papers.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) enable interpretability research by decomposing entangled model activations into monosemantic features. However, under what circumstances SAEs derive most fine-grained latent features for safety—a low-frequency concept domain—remains unexplored. Two key challenges exist: identifying SAEs with the greatest potential for generating safety domain-specific features, and the prohibitively high cost of detailed feature explanation. In this paper, we propose Safe-SAIL, a unified framework for interpreting SAE features in safety-critical domains to advance mechanistic understanding of large language models. Safe-SAIL introduces a pre-explanation evaluation metric to efficiently identify SAEs with strong safety domain-specific interpretability, and reduces interpretation cost by 55% through a segment-level simulation strategy. Building on Safe-SAIL, we train a comprehensive suite of SAEs with human-readable explanations and systematic evaluations for 1,758 safety-related features spanning four domains: pornography, politics, violence, and terror. Using this resource, we conduct empirical analyses and provide insights on the effectiveness of Safe-SAIL for risk feature identification and how safety-critical entities and concepts are encoded across model layers. All models, explanations, and tools are publicly released in an open-source toolkit at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Safe-SAIL/.
papers.abstract_zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）通过将纠缠模型激活分解为单义特征，从而实现了可解释性研究。然而，在何种情况下，SAE能够为安全领域——一个低频概念域——生成最细粒度的潜在特征，这一方面尚未得到探索。目前存在两个主要挑战：识别具有最强生成安全领域特定特征潜力的SAE，以及进行详细特征解释的极高成本。在本文中，我们提出了Safe-SAIL这一统一框架，用于解释安全关键领域中的SAE特征，以增进对大语言模型的机制理解。Safe-SAIL引入了一种预解释评估指标，能够高效地识别出具有强安全领域特定可解释性的SAE；同时通过分段级模拟策略将解释成本降低55%。基于Safe-SAIL，我们训练了一组包含人类可读解释的全面SAE模型，并对涵盖四个领域的1,758个与安全相关的特征进行了系统评估：色情、政治、暴力和恐怖。利用这一资源，我们进行了实证分析，并揭示了Safe-SAIL在风险特征识别方面的有效性，以及安全关键实体和概念如何在模型各层中被编码。所有模型、解释和工具都以开源工具包的形式公开提供，网址为https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Safe-SAIL/。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Graph-Assisted Large Language Models: A Perspective on Mitigating Intrinsic Limitations
papers.title_zh: 基于图的大型语言模型：缓解其固有局限性的方法探讨
papers.authors: Haitong Luo, Fali Wang, Weiyao Zhang, Xianren Zhang, Zhiwei Zhang, Tianxiang Zhao, Minhua Lin, Jiahao Zhang, Hui Liu, Xianfeng Tang, Qi He, Suhang Wang, Xuying Meng, Yujun Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made progress in knowledge-intensive tasks, reasoning and planning, and collaborative problem solving, yet they exhibit intrinsic limitations such as knowledge cutoff, single-threaded reasoning that hinders finer-grained branch and aggregation, and rigid collaboration mechanisms that struggle to coordinate specialized capabilities. Graphs, with their ability to represent relational knowledge and complex dependencies, offer a natural means to address these limitations: they provide structured, high-density knowledge for augmenting or correcting LLMs’ generation; enable revisitable inference by organizing intermediate steps as graphs; and support dynamic coordination among experts or agents in collaborative settings. Motivated by these developments, we present the first systematic survey of graph-assisted LLMs from the perspective of how graph structures mitigate LLMs’ limitations. We introduce a taxonomy spanning Graph-Assisted Knowledge Augmentation, Graph-Assisted Reasoning and Planning, and Graph-Assisted LLM Collaboration, and analyze representative methods, summarize common design patterns, and outline open challenges and future directions for advancing LLMs with graph-based enhancements. The collected papers are available in link here.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在知识密集型任务、推理与规划以及协作问题解决方面取得了显著进展。然而，它们仍存在一些固有的局限性，例如知识范围的限制、单线程推理方式导致的分支和聚合处理困难，以及僵化的协作机制难以协调各种专业能力。图结构能够表示关系知识和复杂的依赖关系，因此为克服这些局限性提供了天然的手段：图结构可以构建结构化、高密度的知识库，以补充或修正语言模型的生成结果；通过将中间步骤以图的形式组织起来，使得推理过程具有可回溯性；同时，图结构还能支持专家或代理在协作环境中的动态协作。基于这些发展成果，我们首次系统性地研究了以图结构辅助的语言模型，探讨了图结构如何缓解语言模型的局限性。我们提出了一种分类体系，涵盖了图结构辅助的知识增强、推理与规划，以及语言模型协作等方面。我们分析了代表性的方法，总结了常见的设计模式，并指出了利用图结构对语言模型进行改进所面临的挑战及未来的发展方向。所有相关论文都可以在此链接中找到。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GUITester: Enabling GUI Agents for Exploratory Defect Discovery
papers.title_zh: GUITester：启用图形界面代理以进行探索性缺陷检测
papers.authors: Yifei Gao, Jiang Wu, Xiaoyi Chen, Yifan Yang, Zhe Cui, Tianyi Ma, Jiaming Zhang, Jitao Sang
papers.abstract: Exploratory GUI testing is essential for software quality but suffers from high manual costs. While Multi-modal Large Language Model (MLLM) agents excel in navigation, they fail to autonomously discover defects due to two core challenges: Goal-Oriented Masking, where agents prioritize task completion over reporting anomalies, and Execution-Bias Attribution, where system defects are misidentified as agent errors. To address these, we first introduce GUITestBench, the first interactive benchmark for this task, featuring 143 tasks across 26 defects. We then propose GUITester, a multi-agent framework that decouples navigation from verification via two modules: (i) a Planning-Execution Module (PEM) that proactively probes for defects via embedded testing intents, and (ii) a Hierarchical Reflection Module (HRM) that resolves attribution ambiguity through interaction history analysis. GUITester achieves an F1-score of 48.90% (Pass@3) on GUITestBench, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines (33.35%). Our work demonstrates the feasibility of autonomous exploratory testing and provides a robust foundation for future GUI quality assurance.
papers.abstract_zh: 探索性GUI测试对软件质量至关重要，但存在较高的人工成本。虽然多模态大语言模型代理在导航方面表现出色，但由于两个核心挑战，它们无法自主发现缺陷：目标导向的遮蔽现象，即代理优先完成任务而非报告异常；以及执行偏差归因问题，即系统缺陷被误认为是代理错误。为了解决这些问题，我们首先引入了GUITestBench，这是首个用于该任务的互动基准测试，包含143个任务和26种缺陷类型。随后，我们提出了GUITester这一多智能体框架，该框架通过两个模块将导航与验证分离：(i) 规划执行模块，通过嵌入式测试意图主动探测缺陷；(ii) 层次化反思模块，通过交互历史分析来解决归因歧义问题。在GUITestBench测试中，GUITester的F1分数达到了48.90%（Pass@3），优于现有的最先进基线算法（33.35%）。我们的工作证明了自主探索性测试的可行性，并为未来的GUI质量保证提供了坚实的基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: BiCSRouter: Bi-Level Cross-System Routing for Utility-Aware LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: BiCSRouter：用于实用主义导向的大语言模型推理的双层跨系统路由技术
papers.authors: Mao Keyu, Eiki Murata, Ukyo Honda
papers.abstract: Selecting an appropriate LLM configuration for a given query is critical, yet existing routing frameworks operate within a single computational paradigm. To address this gap, we formalize the Cross-System Routing Problem, a hierarchical decision-making task that decomposes routing into intra-regime configuration selection and inter-regime system selection. Building on this, we propose BiCSRouter, a bi-level cross-system routing framework that integrates two orthogonal regimes: intensive reasoning via single-agent systems and extensive collaboration via multi-agent systems. BiCSRouter performs policy learning within each system and employs a lightweight inter-regime router that selects the optimal regime based on predicted performance and cost. Experiments on the MBPP and MATH benchmarks demonstrate that BiCSRouter outperforms 15 representative baselines across three types. On MBPP, compared to the performance ceiling of GPT-5, BiCSRouter achieves a 46% reduction in cost with only a 2% drop in accuracy. Finally, we show that BiCSRouter can extend to additional regimes, highlighting its generality as a cross-system routing framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 为特定查询选择合适的LLM配置至关重要，然而现有的路由框架都基于单一的计算范式运作。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了跨系统路由问题这一分层决策任务——它将路由分解为内部机制配置选择与跨机制系统选择两个环节。在此基础上，我们提出了BiCSRouter这一双层跨系统路由框架，该框架整合了两种截然不同的机制：通过单 Agent 系统进行高效推理，以及通过多 Agent 系统进行广泛协作。BiCSRouter在每个系统内执行策略学习，并采用轻量级跨机制路由器来根据预测的性能与成本选择最优机制。在MBPP和MATH基准测试上的实验表明，BiCSRouter在三种类型的测试中均优于15个代表性基线模型。在MBPP任务中，与GPT-5的性能上限相比，BiCSRouter在仅降低2%准确度的同时，将成本降低了46%。最后，我们展示了BiCSRouter可以扩展到更多机制，这凸显了其作为跨系统路由框架的通用性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FAER: Benchmarking VLMs for Failure-Aware Embodied Reasoning
papers.title_zh: FAER：针对故障感知的体视推理而设计的虚拟机器学习模型的对比研究
papers.authors: Hao Song, Kaifeng Liu, Yuanxing Liu, Xiang Tian, Xuesong Wang, Chen Yifan, Weinan Zhang, Ting Liu
papers.abstract: Failures are inevitable when embodied agents execute complex tasks. Visual-language models (VLMs) serve as the core component of embodied agents in perceiving the environment and making decisions. Assessing the capabilities of VLMs in detecting and reasoning about failures has become increasingly important. Previous work primarily considered low-level manipulation failures (e.g., 3cm grasp offsets), neglecting high-level failures arising during long-horizon task execution (e.g., object-dropping failure in the “clean room” task) by embodied agents. In this paper, we propose FAER, a failure-aware benchmark aiming to evaluate the performance of VLMs in terms of failure detection, failure categorization, failure description, and failure correction in long-horizon tasks. FAER comprises 3,323 episodes, spanning 3 scenes, 65 tasks, and 83 objects. We assess the performance of 16 widely utilized VLMs and 4 LLMs for FAER tasks. Experimental results show that nearly all VLMs, even GPT-4o, exhibit limited performance in failure detection with a high false negative rate, meaning that they tend to ignore abnormal events, revealing notable gaps in current models’ capacity to effectively handle failures.
papers.abstract_zh: 当实体智能体执行复杂任务时，失败是不可避免的。视觉语言模型作为实体智能体感知环境和做出决策的核心组件，评估其检测和处理失败的能力变得越来越重要。以往的研究主要关注低层次的操控失败（例如，3厘米的距离偏差），而忽视了实体智能体在长时间任务执行过程中出现的高级失败情况（例如，“洁净室”任务中的物体掉落失败）。在本文中，我们提出了FAER这一基于失败意识的基准测试，旨在评估视觉语言模型在长时间任务中处理失败的能力，包括失败检测、分类、描述以及修复等方面。FAER包含3,323个场景，涵盖3个场景、65个任务和83个物体。我们对16种常用的视觉语言模型和4种大语言模型在FAER任务上的表现进行了评估。实验结果表明，几乎所有视觉语言模型，甚至GPT-4o，在失败检测方面表现有限，误报率很高，这意味着它们倾向于忽略异常事件，这揭示了当前模型在处理失败方面的明显不足。

papers.title: Reverse Constitutional AI: A Framework for Controllable Toxic Data Generation via Probability-Clamped RLAIF
papers.title_zh: 逆向宪法人工智能：一种通过概率约束的RLAIF算法实现可控有害数据生成的框架
papers.authors: Yuan Fang, Yiming Luo, Aimin Zhou, Fei Tan
papers.abstract: Ensuring the safety of large language models (LLMs) requires robust red teaming, yet the systematic synthesis of high-quality toxic data remains under-explored. We propose Reverse Constitutional AI (R-CAI), a framework for automated and controllable adversarial data generation that moves beyond isolated jailbreak prompts. By inverting a harmless constitution into a constitution of toxicity and iteratively refining model outputs through a critique–revision pipeline, R-CAI enables scalable synthesis of multi-dimensional adversarial data without human annotation. Optimizing solely for toxicity-related rewards, however, can lead to reward hacking and degraded semantic coherence. To address this challenge, we introduce probability clamping within reinforcement learning from AI feedback, which stabilizes adversarial optimization while preserving adversarial intent. Experiments demonstrate that R-CAI generates diverse, high-quality toxic data and that probability clamping substantially improves semantic coherence (15%) without sacrificing adversarial strength. Overall, R-CAI provides a fully automated framework for red teaming data generation and systematic safety evaluation of aligned language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 确保大语言模型的安全性需要有效的逆向测试，然而，高质量有害数据的系统生成仍然没有得到充分探索。我们提出了逆向宪法人工智能（R-CAI）框架，这是一种自动化且可控的对抗性数据生成方法，它超越了孤立的破解提示。通过将一个无害的“宪法”转化为具有毒性特征的“宪法”，并通过批评-修订流程逐步优化模型输出，R-CAI能够在不依赖人工注释的情况下，大规模生成多维度的对抗性数据。然而，如果仅针对与毒性相关的奖励进行优化，可能会导致奖励被操纵，从而影响语义的连贯性。为了应对这一挑战，我们在强化学习算法中引入了概率限制机制，该机制可以在保持对抗性意图的同时，稳定对抗性优化的过程。实验表明，R-CAI能够生成多样化且高质量的有害数据，同时概率限制机制显著提升了语义的连贯性（提高了15%），而并未降低对抗性效果。总体而言，R-CAI提供了一个完全自动化的框架，用于对抗性数据生成以及对齐语言模型的系统性安全性评估。

papers.title: ToolGrad: Efficient Tool-use Dataset Generation with Textual “Gradients”
papers.title_zh: ToolGrad：利用文本“梯度信息”高效生成工具使用数据集的算法
papers.authors: Zhongyi Zhou, Kohei Uehara, Haoyu Zhang, Jingtao Zhou, Lin Gu, Ruofei Du, Zheng Xu, Tatsuya Harada
papers.abstract: Prior work synthesizes tool-use LLM datasets by first generating a user query, followed by complex tool-use annotations like DFS. This inherently leads to inevitable annotation failures and low efficiency in data generation. We introduce ToolGrad, an agentic framework that inverts this paradigm. ToolGrad first constructs valid tool-use chains through an iterative process guided by textual “gradients”, and then synthesizes corresponding user queries. This “answer-first” approach led to ToolGrad-500, a dataset generated with more complex tool use, lower cost, and almost 100% pass rate. Experiments show that models trained on ToolGrad-500 outperform those trained on expensive baseline datasets and proprietary LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前的研究是通过生成用户查询，然后添加复杂的工具使用注释（如深度优先搜索）来合成工具使用相关的大语言模型数据集。这种方法不可避免地会导致注释错误以及数据生成的效率低下。我们提出了ToolGrad这一框架，它打破了这种传统模式。ToolGrad首先通过基于文本“梯度”的迭代过程构建有效的工具使用链，然后再生成相应的用户查询。这种“先回答后生成”的方法使得ToolGrad-500这个数据集得以诞生——该数据集包含了更复杂的工具使用场景，生成成本更低，且准确率接近100%。实验表明，在ToolGrad-500上进行训练的模型在性能上优于那些在昂贵的基础数据集或专有大语言模型上训练的模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Unlocking Exploration in RLVR: Uncertainty-aware Advantage Shaping for Deeper Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 在RLVR中解锁探索能力：基于不确定性感知的优势塑造，以实现更深入的推理
papers.authors: Can Xie, Ruotong Pan, Xiangyu Wu, Zhang Yunfei, Jiayi Fu, Tingting Gao, Guorui Zhou
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown significant promise for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, prevailing algorithms like GRPO broadcast a uniform advantage signal across all tokens in a sequence. This coarse-grained approach overlooks the pivotal role of uncertain, high-stakes decisions during reasoning, leading to inefficient exploration and the well-documented problem of entropy collapse. To address this, we introduce UnCertainty-aware Advantage Shaping (UCAS), a model-free method that refines credit assignment by leveraging the model’s internal uncertainty signals. UCAS operates in two stages: it first modulates the response-level advantage using the model’s overall self-confidence, and then applies a token-level penalty based on raw logit certainty. This dual mechanism encourages exploration of high-uncertainty paths that yield correct answers while penalizing overconfident yet erroneous reasoning, effectively balancing the exploration-exploitation trade-off. Extensive experiments on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that UCAS significantly outperforms strong RLVR baselines across multiple model scales, including 1.5B and 7B. Our analysis confirms that UCAS not only achieves higher rewards but also promotes greater reasoning diversity and successfully mitigates entropy collapse.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有的算法如GRPO会向序列中的所有token广播统一的优势信号。这种粗略的方法忽略了在推理过程中不确定且高风险的决策所扮演的关键角色，从而导致探索效率低下，并引发众所周知的熵崩溃问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为UnCertainty-aware Advantage Shaping（UCAS）的无模型方法。该方法通过利用模型内部的不确定性信号来改进信用分配机制。UCAS分为两个阶段：首先利用模型的整体自信程度来调整响应层面的优势信号；然后基于原始逻辑斯蒂概率来施加token层面的惩罚。这种双重机制既鼓励了对高不确定性路径的探索，以获取正确答案，又对过于自信但错误的推理进行了惩罚，从而有效平衡了探索与利用之间的权衡。在五个数学推理基准测试上的广泛实验表明，UCAS在多个模型规模上均显著优于其他强大的RLVR基线算法，包括15亿和70亿参数规模的模型。我们的分析证实，UCAS不仅能够获得更高的奖励，还能促进更丰富的推理多样性，并成功缓解了熵崩溃的问题。

papers.title: GlossaGen: Making Academic Translation Smarter with Glossing
papers.title_zh: GlossaGen：用自动注释技术让学术翻译更加高效
papers.authors: Zixiao Wang, Duzhen Zhang, Juntian Zhang, Yuhan Liu, Guoming Li, Haolun Wu, Le Song, Xiuying Chen
papers.abstract: When reading foreign-language literature, non-native users often face significant challenges. Existing traditional machine translation systems tend to obscure or mistranslate key terminology, while paraphrasing aimed at lay readers often oversimplifies it, thereby hindering their ability to master domain-specific technical vocabulary. To bridge this gap, we first define a novel task, Glossing-Oriented Academic Translation (GOAT), which aims to produce translations dynamically adapted to a reader’s academic proficiency, or level. We then propose GlossaGen, a comprehensive framework to address this task. GlossaGen features two key innovations: a multi-agent data synthesis pipeline that leverages academic personas to automatically generate a large-scale, structured dataset with level-specific explanations; and a novel training strategy based on dynamic adapter merging, which balances task generalization with user-level specialization by combining a ”generalist” adapter with a fine-grained ”expert” one. We evaluate GlossaGen on our synthesized benchmark, where results from automatic metrics, large language model (LLM)-based assessments, and human evaluations consistently demonstrate that our approach achieves higher scores than strong baselines across most metrics. Our framework provides a scalable pathway to enhance the comprehensibility of scientific literature for non-native readers, delivering more accurate translations accompanied by pedagogically sound, level-specific term explanations, and we release our code and data to facilitate further research.
papers.abstract_zh: 在阅读外语文献时，非母语使用者常常面临巨大挑战。现有的传统机器翻译系统往往会将关键术语模糊处理或错误翻译，而针对普通读者的释义方式则容易使内容过于简单化，从而阻碍他们掌握特定领域的专业词汇。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种名为“面向释义的学术翻译”（GOAT）的新任务，该任务旨在根据读者的学术水平动态调整翻译内容。随后，我们开发了GlossaGen这一综合框架来应对这一任务。GlossaGen具有两项重要创新：一是采用多智能体数据合成流程，利用学术角色自动生成大规模、结构化的数据集，并附带针对不同水平的详细解释；二是采用基于动态适配器合并的新颖训练策略，通过将“通用型”适配器和“专家级”适配器相结合，在任务泛化与用户级别专业化之间实现平衡。我们在合成基准测试中对GlossaGen进行了评估，结果表明，从自动评估指标、基于大语言模型的评估结果以及人工评估来看，我们的方法在大多数指标上均优于同类优秀基线方案。我们的框架为提升非母语读者对科学文献的理解能力提供了可扩展的解决方案，能够提供更准确的翻译，同时提供具有教育意义的、针对特定水平的术语解释。我们还公开了我们的代码和数据集，以便进一步的研究。

papers.title: DeCoVec: Building Decoding Space based Task Vector for Large Language Models via In-Context Learning
papers.title_zh: DeCoVec：通过上下文学习为大型语言模型构建解码空间相关的任务向量
papers.authors: Feiyang Li, Yile Wang
papers.abstract: Task vectors, representing directions in model or activation spaces that encode task-specific behaviors, have emerged as a promising tool for steering large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches typically require fine-tuning or invasive manipulation of internal states, limiting their flexibility and scalability. We propose DeCoVec (Decoding Space based Task Vector), a training-free and non-invasive framework that constructs task vectors directly in the decoding space by leveraging in-context learning (ICL). Specifically, DeCoVec captures the task essence as the difference between the output logit distributions of few-shot and zero-shot prompts, then steers generation by injecting this vector into the decoding process. Experiments across seven LLMs (0.5B–9B) on TruthfulQA, Math-500, and AQUA-RAT show that DeCoVec consistently outperforms standard few-shot baselines, with gains up to +5.50 average accuracy. Further analysis demonstrates that DeCoVec effectively suppresses generation degeneration and logical flaws while exhibiting strong robustness to demonstration ordering, all without incurring additional input token costs. Our method offers a training-free and non-invasive solution for LLM steering without requiring weight updates or auxiliary models.
papers.abstract_zh: 任务向量代表了模型或激活空间中编码特定任务行为的方向，它们已成为引导大语言模型的一种有前景的工具。然而，现有的方法通常需要对内部状态进行微调或侵入性操作，这限制了它们的灵活性和可扩展性。我们提出了DeCoVec（基于解码空间的任务向量），这是一种无需训练且非侵入性的框架，它通过利用上下文学习技术，直接在解码空间中构建任务向量。具体来说，DeCoVec通过将少量样本提示和零样本提示的输出逻辑分布之间的差异作为任务的本质来捕捉任务特征，然后通过将这个向量注入到解码过程中来引导生成过程。在七个大语言模型上进行的TruthfulQA、Math-500和AQUA-RAT实验表明，DeCoVec始终优于标准的少量样本基线方法，平均准确率提升了高达5.50个百分点。进一步分析表明，DeCoVec能够有效抑制生成的退化现象和逻辑错误，同时对示范顺序的排序表现出很强的鲁棒性，而且不会增加额外的输入令牌成本。我们的方法提供了一种无需训练且非侵入性的大语言模型引导解决方案，无需进行权重更新或辅助模型的构建。

papers.title: Hebbian-Guided Bi-Directional Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 基于赫布原理的双向排名自适应算法，能够实现高效且精确的参数调优
papers.authors: Xing Zhao, Liu Yang, Xi-Le Zhao, Yueqi Yang, Tianqi Jiang
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used method to fine-tune large language models, extremely reducing computational and storage costs. But its fixed-rank design cannot well capture the varying importance across different layers, limiting its flexibility. Dynamic rank allocation methods mitigate this issue by adaptively allocating ranks during training, but most of them focus solely on either rank pruning or expansion, leading to redundant parameterization or insufficient representational capacity. To address this problem, we introduce Hebbian-Guided Bi-Directional Rank Adaptation (HeBiRA), a novel framework that bi-directionally reallocates low-rank capacity using Hebbian-inspired importance estimation. HeBiRA computes the contribution of each rank direction by measuring the synergy between activations and output gradients, and adjusts the rank bi-directionally by pruning uninformative directions while expanding those in critical layers. This mechanism flexibly redistributes the rank budget during training and also can be applied to PEFT methods such as DoRA, HiRA, and QLoRA. Experiments on multiple benchmarks and theoretical analysis show that HeBiRA consistently improves performance over baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）是一种广泛应用于微调大语言模型的方法，能够显著降低计算和存储成本。然而，其固定秩的设计无法很好地捕捉不同层之间的重要性差异，从而限制了其灵活性。动态秩分配方法通过训练过程中自适应地分配秩来缓解这个问题，但大多数方法仅专注于秩的剪枝或扩展，这会导致参数化冗余或表示能力不足。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Hebbian-Guided Bi-Directional Rank Adaptation（HeBiRA）框架。该框架利用受Hebbian原理启发的重要性估计方法，实现低秩能力的双向重新分配。HeBiRA通过测量激活信号与输出梯度之间的协同效应来计算每个秩方向的贡献，并通过剪除无信息方向、扩展关键层中的秩方向来实现双向调整。这种机制能够在训练过程中灵活重新分配秩资源，并且可以应用于DPEFT方法，如DoRA、HiRA和QLoRA。在多个基准测试上的实验和理论分析表明，HeBiRA始终能比基线方法取得更好的性能提升。

papers.title: StruNRAG: Evaluation of OCR-Induced Structural Noise on RAG Robustness
papers.title_zh: StruNRAG：评估OCR处理过程中产生的结构噪声对RAG算法鲁棒性的影响
papers.authors: Mengna Gao, Dapeng Yin, Shuyue Zhu, Bingxuan Hou, Zhanpeng Ni, Junli Wang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems rely on Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to ingest knowledge from unstructured documents. However, OCR engines often struggle with complex layouts, introducing Structural Noise, such as line insertion and paragraph interleaving, which disrupts the semantic flow of the text. Existing evaluations largely overlook this dimension, operating on the assumption of structurally perfect input. To bridge this gap, we introduce StruNRAG, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating RAG robustness against OCR-induced structural perturbations. We construct a bilingual dataset of 2,132 question-answer pairs derived from complex Chinese and English documents and systematically inject three categories of real-world structural noise: line insertion, paragraph interleaving, and line interleaving. Our evaluation of mainstream retrievers and Large Language Models (LLMs) reveals a nuanced interaction between noise and pipeline stages: while structural distortions consistently degrade retrieval performance, the generation stage exhibits unexpected robustness. Advanced LLMs demonstrate robustness against local noise (e.g., line insertion), but struggle to maintain reasoning capabilities under severe structural disruption that fragments global context. These findings indicate that while LLMs are capable of compensating for minor parsing errors, future RAG optimizations must take into account the effects of structural noise. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/GaoMengnana/StruNRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统依赖光学字符识别技术来从非结构化文档中提取知识。然而，光学字符识别引擎在处理复杂布局时常常遇到困难，这会导致结构噪声的出现，比如行插入和段落交错等问题，这些都会破坏文本的语义流程。现有的评估方法大多忽略了这一维度，它们假设输入数据在结构上是完全完美的。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了StruNRAG这一专门用于评估RAG系统对光学字符识别引起的结构干扰的鲁棒性的基准测试。我们构建了一个包含2,132对问题和答案的双语数据集，该数据集来自复杂的汉语和英语文档。我们系统地引入了三种现实世界中的结构噪声：行插入、段落交错以及行与行的交错。我们对主流检索器和大语言模型进行的评估显示，噪声与处理阶段之间存在复杂的相互作用：虽然结构扭曲会持续降低检索性能，但生成阶段却表现出意外的鲁棒性。先进的语言模型能够应对局部噪声（如行插入），但在严重结构破坏的情况下，它们难以维持推理能力，因为这种破坏会破坏全局上下文。这些发现表明，尽管语言模型能够弥补轻微的解析错误，但未来的RAG优化必须考虑结构噪声的影响。我们的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/GaoMengnana/StruNRAG获取。

papers.title: Memory as Action: Autonomous Context Curation for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
papers.title_zh: 记忆即行动：用于长期任务的自助情境管理工具
papers.authors: Yuxiang Zhang, Jiangming Shu, Ye Ma, Xueyuan Lin, Shangxi Wu, Jitao Sang
papers.abstract: Long-context Large Language Models, despite their expanded capacity, require careful working memory management to mitigate attention dilution during long-horizon tasks. Yet existing approaches rely on external mechanisms that lack awareness of the agent’s reasoning state, leading to suboptimal decisions. We propose Memory-as-Action (MemAct), a framework that treats working memory management as learnable policy actions. By formulating context management as in-place editing operations (deletion, insertion), MemAct enables joint optimization of information retention and task performance through end-to-end reinforcement learning. To address the computational challenges of dynamic context updates, we introduce Dynamic Context Policy Optimization, which restores training efficiency without compromising reasoning integrity. Experiments show that MemAct-RL-14B matches the accuracy of models 16× larger while reducing average context length by 51%, with learned strategies that adapt to model capabilities and generalize across task complexities. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/ADaM-BJTU/MemAct.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管长上下文大语言模型具有更强的处理能力，但在处理长期任务时仍需要仔细管理工作记忆，以避免注意力分散的问题。然而，现有的方法依赖于外部机制，这些机制无法感知智能体的推理状态，从而导致决策效果不佳。我们提出了“记忆作为动作”框架，将工作记忆管理视为可学习的策略动作。通过将上下文管理表述为就地编辑操作（删除、插入），MemAct能够通过端到端的强化学习来同时优化信息保留和任务性能。为了解决动态上下文更新的计算挑战，我们引入了动态上下文策略优化技术，该技术可以在不损害推理完整性的情况下恢复训练效率。实验表明，MemAct-RL-14B模型的准确率与参数规模大 16 倍的模型相当，但其平均上下文长度减少了51%。该模型所学习的策略能够适应不同模型的能力，并能在不同的任务复杂度下保持良好的泛化能力。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/ADaM-BJTU/MemAct获取。
