papers.title: Experience is the Teacher: Reusing Atomic Thoughts from LLMs to Improve Medical Dialogue
papers.title_zh: 经验就是老师：利用大语言模型产生的原子式思想来提升医疗对话的效果
papers.authors: Guangya Yu, Hui Luo, Qi Ye, Ruihui Hou, Weiyan Zhang, Mingxi Shang, Xuanwu Li, ChunMing Wang, Tong Ruan
papers.abstract: With the remarkable performance of large language models (LLMs) in medicine, particularly their ability to support clinical decision-making in medical dialogues, a key limitation remains: the static reasoning patterns derived from human expert experience are often inadequate for the dynamic and diverse nature of real-world multi-turn conversations. While recent large reasoning models (such as R1) enable deeper and more complex thought processes to address such challenges, they also introduce significant redundancy. Meanwhile, recent studies on reusing atomic thoughts demonstrate a practical pathway toward dynamic and precise reasoning in general domains. In this paper, we investigate the role of atomic thought-based experience in medical dialogue tasks. First, we collect human expert clinical experience. Then, we propose a novel distillation framework that extracts atomic thoughts from teacher models and reuses them to guide reasoning and generate responses. Based on this framework, we construct training data from ReMeDi and fine-tune student models, which demonstrate enhanced performance in both static and interactive medical dialogue scenarios. Furthermore, we examine the impact of experience across various models, datasets, and scenarios. Crucially, transferring this experience empowers weaker models to generate high-quality reasoning data, matching the annotation capabilities of stronger LLMs while significantly reducing costs. The code is available in this repository https://github.com/VioletAmethystLunar/Atomic-Thoughts-Medical-Dialogue.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在医学领域的出色表现，尤其是它们在医疗对话中支持临床决策的能力，仍然存在一个关键限制：从人类专家经验中得出的静态推理模式往往不足以应对现实世界中多轮对话的动态性和多样性。虽然最近的一些大型推理模型（如R1）能够处理更深刻、更复杂的思维过程以应对这些挑战，但它们也引入了显著的冗余性。与此同时，关于重用原子思维的研究表明，这是一种在通用领域实现动态且精确推理的实用方法。在本文中，我们探讨了基于原子思维的体验在医疗对话任务中的作用。首先，我们收集了人类专家的临床经验数据。然后，我们提出了一种新颖的蒸馏框架，该框架能够从教师模型中提取原子思维，并重新使用这些原子思维来指导推理并生成响应。基于这一框架，我们从ReMeDi中构建训练数据，并对学生模型进行微调，结果显示这些模型在静态和交互式的医疗对话场景中都表现出更好的性能。此外，我们还研究了这种体验在不同模型、数据集和场景中的影响。重要的是，这种经验的迁移使得较弱的模型能够生成高质量的推理数据，同时与更强的语言模型的注释能力相匹配，并且显著降低了成本。相关代码可以在以下仓库中找到：https://github.com/VioletAmethystLunar/Atomic-Thoughts-Medical-Dialogue

papers.title: Beyond Static Personas: Situational Personality Steering for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越静态角色：为大型语言模型设计的情境化人格调控机制
papers.authors: Zesheng Wei, Mengxiang Li, Zilei Wang, Yang Deng
papers.abstract: Personalized Large Language Models (LLMs) facilitate more natural, human-like interactions in human-centric applications. However, existing personalization methods are constrained by limited controllability and high resource demands. Furthermore, their reliance on static personality modeling restricts adaptability across varying situations. To address these limitations, we first demonstrate the existence of situation-dependency and consistent situation-behavior patterns within LLM personalities through a multi-perspective analysis of persona neurons. Building on these insights, we propose IRIS, a training-free, neuron-based Identify–Retrieve–Steer framework for advanced situational personality steering. Our approach comprises situational persona neuron identification, situation-aware neuron retrieval, and similarity-weighted steering. We empirically validate our framework on PersonalityBench and our newly introduced SPBench, a comprehensive situational personality benchmark. Experimental results show that our method surpasses best-performing baselines, demonstrating IRIS’s generalization and robustness to complex, unseen situations and different models architecture.
papers.abstract_zh: 个性化大语言模型能够在以人类为中心的应用中实现更自然、类似人类的交互。然而，现有的个性化方法受到可控性有限和资源需求较高的限制。此外，它们对静态人格模型的依赖限制了在不同情境下的适应性。为了克服这些限制，我们首先通过多视角分析人格神经元，证明了LLM人格中存在情境依赖性以及一致的行为模式。基于这些发现，我们提出了IRIS这一无需训练的基于神经元的识别-检索-引导框架，用于高级情境人格引导。我们的方法包括情境人格神经元的识别、考虑情境的神经元检索，以及基于相似度的引导机制。我们在PersonalityBench和新推出的SPBench上验证了该框架的有效性，SPBench是一个全面的情境人格基准测试平台。实验结果表明，我们的方法优于现有的最佳基线算法，证明了IRIS在应对复杂、未见过的情境以及不同模型架构时的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Born Pragmatic, Trained to Hallucinate? Quantifying the Origins of Contextual Bias in LLMs via the PaCE Benchmark
papers.title_zh: 出生于务实主义环境，后天被训练得能够产生幻觉？通过PaCE基准测试来量化大语言模型中情境偏见的根源
papers.authors: Ziming Li, Yu Tian, Tian Lan, Jiang Li, Zehua Duo, Guanglai Gao, Xiangdong Su
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at capturing communicative intent, this capability introduces a side effect: Pragmatic Hallucination, where models over-interpret literal contexts to generate non-factual inferences. To quantify this, we introduce the PaCE (Pragmatics-as-Context Evaluation) benchmark, comprising over 3,000 manually verified “context-flip” samples. Evaluations across nine mainstream models reveal a significant Context Sensitivity Gap (CSG), with literal accuracy consistently lagging behind pragmatic reasoning. Attribution analysis indicates that Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) exacerbates this bias, and neither parameter scaling nor Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fully mitigates it. Crucially, “Strict Prompting” effectively reverses the CSG, demonstrating that the phenomenon stems from behavioral lock-in during training rather than inherent capability deficiencies. Furthermore, error patterns exhibit high systematic correlation across diverse architectures. This study highlights that current alignment paradigms lack precise control over pragmatic boundaries, underscoring the necessity for a “Literal Grounding” mechanism in future safety frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在捕捉交流意图方面表现出色，但这种能力也带来了一种副作用：语用幻觉现象。即模型过度解读字面含义，从而得出非事实性的推论。为了量化这一现象，我们引入了PaCE（语篇作为评估基准）测试框架，该框架包含超过3,000个经过人工验证的“上下文翻转”样本。对九种主流模型的评估结果显示，模型在字面理解准确性和语用推理能力之间存在显著差距。归因分析表明，基于人类反馈的强化学习机制加剧了这种偏差，而无论是参数调整还是思维链机制都无法完全消除这一缺陷。重要的是，“严格提示策略”能够有效逆转这种差距，这表明这种现象源于训练过程中的行为锁定，而非模型本身的能力不足。此外，不同架构下的错误模式显示出高度的系统性相关性。本研究指出，当前的一致性处理范式无法精确控制语用边界，这凸显了未来安全框架中需要引入“字面化约束”机制的必要性。

papers.title: Domain-Specific Data Generation Framework for RAG Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 适用于RAG适应的领域特定数据生成框架
papers.authors: Chris Xing Tian, Weihao Xie, Zhen Chen, Hui Liu, Zhengyuan Yi, Haoliang Li, Shiqi Wang, Siwei Ma
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines the language understanding and reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) with external retrieval to produce domain-grounded responses. Effectively adapting RAG systems to domain-specific settings requires specialized, context-rich training data beyond general-purpose question-answering datasets. Here, we propose RAGen, a scalable and modular data-centric framework for generating domain-grounded question–answer–context (QAC) triples tailored to diverse RAG adaptation strategies. These QAC triples serve as training signals for multiple RAG adaptation approaches; in this work, we demonstrate their use for contrastive fine-tuning of embedding models and supervised fine-tuning of LLMs under retrieved contexts. RAGen generates QAC triples by identifying key concepts within documents, producing diverse questions guided by Bloom’s Taxonomy–inspired principles, and pairing them with precise answers extracted from relevant contexts. Its modular pipeline incorporates semantic chunking, hierarchical concept extraction, multi-chunk retrieval, and curated distractor contexts to encourage robust reasoning. Designed for scalability, RAGen efficiently handles large and evolving document corpora without redundant processing, making it particularly suitable for dynamic domains like enterprise knowledge bases.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术结合了大语言模型的语言理解和推理能力，以及外部检索机制，从而生成具有领域针对性的回答。要有效地将RAG系统适配到特定领域环境中，就需要使用专门且富含上下文的训练数据，而不仅仅是通用的问答数据集。在这里，我们提出了RAGen这一可扩展且模块化的以数据为中心框架，它能够生成符合不同RAG适配策略的问答-上下文三元组。这些问答-上下文三元组可以作为多种RAG适配方法的训练信号；在本研究中，我们展示了将其用于嵌入模型的对比式微调，以及在检索到的上下文中对大语言模型进行监督式微调的方法。RAGen通过识别文档中的关键概念，根据受布卢姆分类法启发的原则生成多样化的问题，并将这些问题与从相关上下文中提取的精确答案相结合来生成问答-上下文三元组。其模块化流程包括语义分块、层次化概念提取、多块检索，以及精心设计的干扰上下文，以促进稳健的推理过程。由于注重可扩展性，RAGen能够高效处理庞大且不断变化的文档语料库，而无需进行冗余处理，因此特别适用于企业知识库等动态领域。

papers.title: Tracing Mathematical Proficiency Through Problem-Solving Processes
papers.title_zh: 通过解决问题来追踪数学能力的发展
papers.authors: Jungyang Park, Suho Kang, Jaewoo Park, Jae Hong Kim, Jaewoo Shin, Seonjoon Park, Youngjae Yu
papers.abstract: Knowledge Tracing (KT) aims to model student’s knowledge state and predict future performance to enable personalized learning in Intelligent Tutoring Systems. However, traditional KT methods face fundamental limitations in explainability, as they rely solely on the response correctness, neglecting the rich information embedded in students’ problem-solving processes. To address this gap, we propose Knowledge Tracing Leveraging Problem-Solving Process (KT-PSP), which incorporates students’ problem-solving processes to capture the multidimensional aspects of mathematical proficiency. We also introduce KT-PSP-25, a new dataset specifically designed for KT-PSP. Building on this, we present StatusKT, a KT framework that employs a teacher-student-teacher three-stage LLM pipeline to extract students’ Mathematical Proficiency (MP) as intermediate representation. In this pipeline, the teacher LLM first extracts problem-specific proficiency indicators, then a student LLM generates responses based on the student’s solution process, and a teacher LLM evaluates these responses to determine mastery of each indicator. The experimental results on KT-PSP-25 demonstrate that StatusKT improves the prediction performance of existing KT methods. Moreover, StatusKT provides interpretable explanations for its predictions by explicitly modeling students’ mathematical proficiency. Code is available here.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing，简称KT）旨在建模学生的知识状态并预测其未来的表现，从而实现智能辅导系统中的个性化学习。然而，传统的KT方法在可解释性方面存在根本性的局限性，因为它们仅依赖于回答的正确性，而忽略了学生解决问题过程中所包含的大量信息。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种结合学生解决问题过程的知识追踪方法——KT-PSP。该方法能够捕捉数学能力多方面的特征。我们还引入了一个名为KT-PSP-25的新数据集，专门用于KT-PSP的研究。在此基础上，我们提出了StatusKT框架，该框架采用教师-学生-教师三阶段的大语言模型流程，将学生的数学能力作为中间表示进行提取。在这个流程中，教师大语言模型首先提取与问题相关的能力指标，然后学生大语言模型根据学生的解题过程生成回答，最后教师大语言模型对这些回答进行评估，以确定学生对各项指标的掌握程度。在KT-PSP-25上的实验结果表明，StatusKT提升了现有KT方法的预测性能。此外，StatusKT通过明确建模学生的数学能力，为预测结果提供了可解释的解释。相关代码可在此处获取。

papers.title: Decision Biases and Intent-Irony Decoupling in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 决策偏差与意图 irony 在大型语言模型中的分离现象
papers.authors: Kewei Guo, Lingyun Sun, Manhao Guan
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit impressive linguistic fluency, yet it remains unclear whether they possess human-like Theory of Mind (ToM) or merely rely on statistical heuristics, particularly in complex social tasks such as irony comprehension. To address the limitations of existing binary benchmarks, this study establishes a multi-dimensional evaluation framework comprising 140 carefully designed probes. These probes are derived from 10 story prototypes based on established cognitive theories. The framework systematically modulates contextual contrast, linguistic cues, and cognitive mechanisms. By comparing the performance of ten state-of-the-art LLMs against 300 human participants, this study uncovers a significant dichotomy in performance. Although LLMs demonstrate superior sensitivity in subsidiary pragmatic inferences, human participants outperform them in holistic irony judgment. Crucially, the results reveal a systematic “intent-irony decoupling”, wherein LLMs fail to integrate pragmatic signals into their final judgments. These models exhibit aggressive decision biases and rely on “context-utterance conflict” heuristics. These findings suggest that current LLMs simulate irony comprehension without the underlying cognitive mechanisms. The development of future artificial intelligence may require the integration of explicit ToM modules to bridge the gap between surface-level pattern matching and genuine social understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在语言能力方面表现出惊人的能力，但尚不清楚它们是否具备类似人类的心理理论，还是仅仅依赖于统计性启发式方法，尤其是在理解讽刺等复杂社交任务中。为了弥补现有二元评估标准的局限性，本研究建立了一个多维评估框架，该框架包含140个精心设计的测试题。这些测试题源自基于成熟认知理论的10个故事原型。该框架系统地调节了上下文对比、语言线索以及认知机制的影响。通过对比10种最先进的语言模型与300名人类参与者的表现，本研究发现两者在性能上存在显著差异。尽管语言模型在辅助语用推理方面表现出更高的敏感性，但在整体讽刺判断方面，人类参与者却表现得更为出色。关键的是，研究结果揭示了“意图与讽刺的分离”现象，即语言模型无法将语用信号整合到最终的判断中。这些模型存在强烈的决策偏差，并且依赖“上下文-句子冲突”的启发式方法。这些发现表明，当前的语言模型在模拟讽刺理解时，并未涉及相应的认知机制。未来人工智能的发展可能需要引入明确的心理理论模块，以弥合表面模式匹配与真正社交理解之间的差距。

papers.title: Anonpsy: A Graph-Based Framework for Structure-Preserving De-identification of Psychiatric Narratives
papers.title_zh: Anonpsy：一种基于图结构的框架，用于保持精神健康相关叙事的隐私性
papers.authors: Kyungho Lim, Byung-Hoon Kim
papers.abstract: Psychiatric narratives encode patient identity not only through explicit identifiers but also through idiosyncratic life events embedded in clinical structure. Existing de-identification approaches, including PHI masking and LLM-based synthetic rewriting, operate at the text level and offer limited control over which semantic elements are preserved or altered. We introduce Anonpsy, a de-identification framework that reformulates the task as graph-guided semantic rewriting. Anonpsy (1) converts each narrative into a semantic graph encoding clinical entities, temporal anchors, and typed relations; (2) applies graph-constrained perturbations that modify identifying context while preserving clinical structure; and (3) regenerates text via graph-conditioned LLM generation. Evaluated on 90 clinician-authored psychiatric case narratives, Anonpsy preserves diagnostic fidelity while achieving consistently low re-identification risk under expert, semantic, and GPT-5-based evaluations. Compared with a strong LLM-only rewriting baseline, Anonpsy yields substantially lower semantic similarity and identifiability. These results demonstrate that explicit structural representations combined with constrained generation provide an effective approach to de-identification for psychiatric narratives.
papers.abstract_zh: 精神病学叙事不仅通过明确的标识符来编码患者身份，还通过嵌入在临床结构中的独特生活事件来实现身份编码。现有的去标识化方法，包括PHI掩蔽和基于大语言模型的合成重写技术，都是在文本层面进行的操作，对哪些语义元素被保留或修改的控制力度有限。我们提出了Anonpsy这一去标识化框架，它将任务重新定义为基于图的语义重写。Anonpsy的具体步骤如下：1) 将每个叙事转换为一个语义图，该图包含临床实体、时间节点以及类型关系；2) 应用基于图的约束性扰动，以修改识别上下文，同时保留临床结构；3) 通过基于图的LLM生成技术重新生成文本。在90篇由临床医生撰写的精神病学案例叙事上进行了评估，结果显示，Anonpsy在保持诊断准确性的同时，在专家评估、语义评估以及基于GPT-5的评估中均实现了低风险的重新识别。与仅依赖强大大语言模型进行重写的基线方法相比，Anonpsy在语义相似性和可识别性方面表现显著更好。这些结果表明，结合明确的结构化表示和约束性生成技术，可以为精神病学叙事的去标识化提供有效的解决方案。

papers.title: HearSay Benchmark: Do Audio LLMs Leak What They Hear?
papers.title_zh: HearSay基准测试：音频语言模型会泄露它们听到的内容吗？
papers.authors: Jin Wang, Kaiwen Luo, Liang Lin, Weiliu Wang, Yitian Chen, Moayad Aloqaily, Xuehai Tang, Zhenhong Zhou, Kun Wang, Li Sun, Qingsong Wen
papers.abstract: While Audio Large Language Models (ALLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in understanding and generation, their potential privacy implications remain largely unexplored. This paper takes the first step to investigate whether ALLMs inadvertently leak user privacy solely through acoustic voiceprints and introduces \textit{HearSay}, a comprehensive benchmark constructed from over 22,000 real-world audio clips. To ensure data quality, the benchmark is meticulously curated through a rigorous pipeline involving automated profiling and human verification, guaranteeing that all privacy labels are grounded in factual records. Extensive experiments on \textit{HearSay} yield three critical findings:\textbf{Significant Privacy Leakage}: ALLMs inherently extract private attributes from voiceprints, reaching 92.89% accuracy on gender and effectively profiling social attributes.\textbf{Insufficient Safety Mechanisms}: Alarmingly, existing safeguards are severely inadequate; most models fail to refuse privacy-intruding requests, exhibiting near-zero refusal rates for physiological traits.\textbf{Reasoning Amplifies Risk}: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning exacerbates privacy risks in capable models by uncovering deeper acoustic correlations.These findings expose critical vulnerabilities in ALLMs, underscoring the urgent need for targeted privacy alignment.The codes and dataset are available at https://github.com/JinWang79/HearSay_Benchmark
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然音频大语言模型在理解和生成方面取得了显著进展，但其潜在的隐私问题仍未被充分研究。本文首次探讨了音频大语言模型是否会通过声纹泄露用户隐私的问题，并介绍了由22,000个真实音频片段构成的综合性基准测试——HearSay。为了确保数据的质量，该基准测试通过严格的流程进行筛选，包括自动分析和人工验证，确保所有隐私标签都基于真实数据。在HearSay上的大量实验得出了三个重要结论：首先，音频大语言模型能够从声纹中提取私人信息，其在性别识别方面的准确率高达92.89%，并能有效分析社交属性；其次，现有的安全措施严重不足，大多数模型无法拒绝侵犯隐私的请求，对于生理特征的识别成功率几乎为零；最后，推理过程会加剧隐私风险，有能力的模型在进行思维链推理时，可能会暴露出更深的声学关联。这些发现揭示了音频大语言模型存在的严重漏洞，凸显了实现针对性隐私对齐的紧迫性。相关代码和数据集可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/JinWang79/HearSay_Benchmark
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LongInsightBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Omni-Modal Models on Human-Centric Long-Video Understanding.
papers.title_zh: LongInsightBench：一个全面的基准测试工具，用于评估以人类为中心的长视频理解方面的全模态模型性能
papers.authors: ZhaoYang Han, Qihan Lin, Hao Liang, Bowen Chen, Zhou Liu, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: We introduce \textbf{LongInsightBench}, the first benchmark designed to assess models’ ability to understand long videos, with a focus on human language, viewpoints, actions, and other contextual elements, while integrating \textbf{visual, audio, and text} modalities. Our benchmark excels in three key areas: \textbf{a) Long-Duration, Human-Centric Videos:} We carefully selected approximately 1,000 videos from open-source datasets FineVideo based on duration limit and multi-modal information density, focusing on content like lectures, interviews, and vlogs, which contain rich human-centric semantic and contextual attributes. \textbf{b) Diverse and Challenging Task Scenarios:} We have designed six challenging task scenarios, including both Intra-Event and Inter-Event Tasks. \textbf{c) Rigorous and Comprehensive Quality Assurance Pipelines:} We have developed a three-step, semi-automated data quality assurance pipeline to ensure the difficulty and validity of the synthesized questions and answer options. Based on LongInsightBench, we designed a series of experiments. which shows that Omni-modal models(OLMs) still face challenge in tasks requiring precise temporal localization (T-Loc) and long-range causal inference (CE-Caus). Surprisingly, extended experiments reveal the information loss in modal fusion of OLMs, which we called the \textbf{Fusion Deficit Paradox}.
papers.abstract_zh:
我们推出了**LongInsightBench**，这是首个旨在评估模型理解长视频能力的基准测试。该测试重点关注人类语言、视角、动作以及其他上下文元素，同时整合了**视觉、音频和文本**三种模态的信息。我们的基准测试在三个关键领域表现出色：  
**a) 时长较长、以人为中心的视频：**我们从开源数据集FineVideo中精心挑选了约1000个视频，这些视频的时长限制和多模态信息密度都经过严格筛选，主要涵盖了讲座、访谈和视频博客等包含丰富的人为中心语义和上下文属性的内容。  
**b) 多样且具有挑战性的任务场景：**我们设计了六种具有挑战性的任务场景，包括事件内部任务和事件之间的任务。  
**c) 严谨且全面的质量保证流程：**我们开发了一个三步半自动化的数据质量保障流程，以确保合成问题和答案的难度和有效性。基于LongInsightBench，我们设计了一系列实验。实验结果表明，全模态模型在需要精确时间定位（T-Loc）和长距离因果推理（CE-Caus）的任务中仍然面临挑战。令人惊讶的是，进一步的实验揭示了全模态模型在模态融合过程中存在信息丢失的问题，我们将这种现象称为**融合缺陷悖论**。

papers.title: Fixing Semantic Blind Spots in Anchor Tokens of dMLLMs
papers.title_zh: 解决dMLLMs中锚点令牌的语义盲点问题
papers.authors: Ruixuan Xu, Jiexi Xu, Qiyan Zhao, Xiaofeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in diffusion-based Multimodal Large Language Models (dMLLMs) offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive counterparts; however, they remain prone to hallucinations. Through information flow analysis on LLaDA-V, we identify two intertwined factors contributing to this issue. First, although the special tokens serve as semantic anchors for aggregating visual information, they simultaneously induce severe attention sinks, excessively consuming the model’s attention budget. Second, the long-range decay inherent in Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) leads to semantic blind spots, preventing these anchors from uniformly perceiving the entire visual input. Accordingly, our objective is to moderately alleviate the attention sink effect on semantic anchors while enhancing their ability to aggregate global visual information, thereby eliminating semantic blind spots. To this end, we propose Extrinsic Distance-Aware Regularization (EDAR), a training-free decoding strategy that augments the attention key space with a static, distance-aware matrix. This matrix jointly redistributes excessive attention away from anchors and injects absolute positional bias to ensure uniform visual coverage. Experiments on LLaDA-V demonstrate that EDAR effectively eliminates semantic blind spots and achieves state-of-the-art performance on both hallucination-specific and general multimodal benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于扩散的多模态大语言模型的最新进展为自回归模型提供了有吸引力的替代方案；然而，这些模型仍然容易出现幻觉现象。通过对LLaDA-V进行信息流分析，我们发现有两个相互关联的因素导致了这一问题。首先，虽然特殊标记作为语义锚点用于聚合视觉信息，但它们同时会引发严重的注意力消耗问题，过度占用模型的注意力资源。其次，旋转位置嵌入方式所固有的长期衰减效应会导致语义盲点，使得这些锚点无法均匀感知整个视觉输入。因此，我们的目标是在减轻语义锚点的注意力消耗问题的同时，增强它们聚合全局视觉信息的能力，从而消除语义盲点。为此，我们提出了一种无需训练的解码策略——外部距离感知正则化方法。该策略通过引入一个静态的、具有距离感知特性的矩阵来扩展注意力键空间，从而重新分配过多的注意力资源，避免其集中在某些锚点上，并注入绝对位置偏差以确保视觉信息的均匀覆盖。在LLaDA-V上的实验表明，该方法能够有效消除语义盲点，并在幻觉检测和多模态任务上取得了领先的性能表现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Transcription: Unified Audio Schema for Perception-Aware AudioLLMs
papers.title_zh: 超越转录：用于感知意识型音频语言模型的统一音频架构
papers.authors: Linhao Zhang, Yuhan Song, Aiwei Liu, Chuhan Wu, Sijun Zhang, Wei Jia, Yuan Liu, Houfeng Wang, Zhou Xiao
papers.abstract: Recent Audio Large Language Models (AudioLLMs) exhibit a striking performance inversion: while excelling at complex reasoning tasks, they consistently underperform on fine-grained acoustic perception. We attribute this gap to a fundamental limitation of ASR-centric training, which provides precise linguistic targets but implicitly teaches models to suppress paralinguistic cues and acoustic events as noise. To address this, we propose Unified Audio Schema (UAS), a holistic and structured supervision framework that organizes audio information into three explicit components—Transcription, Paralinguistics, and Non-linguistic Events—within a unified JSON format. This design achieves comprehensive acoustic coverage without sacrificing the tight audio-text alignment that enables reasoning. We validate the effectiveness of this supervision strategy by applying it to both discrete and continuous AudioLLM architectures. Extensive experiments on MMSU, MMAR, and MMAU demonstrate that UAS-Audio yields consistent improvements, boosting fine-grained perception by 10.9% on MMSU over the same-size state-of-the-art models while preserving robust reasoning capabilities. Our code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/Tencent/Unified_Audio_Schema.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的音频大语言模型在复杂推理任务上表现出色，但在精细的声学感知方面则表现不佳。我们认为这种差距源于基于语音识别训练的固有局限性——这种训练方式虽然能提供精确的语言目标，但却会迫使模型忽略副语言线索和声学事件，将其视为噪声。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了“统一音频框架”这一整体且结构化的监督方法。该框架将音频信息划分为三个明确的部分：转录、副语言和非语言事件，并将这些信息以统一的JSON格式进行组织。这种设计能够在不牺牲紧密的音频与文本对齐关系的情况下实现全面的声学覆盖。我们通过将这一监督策略应用于离散和连续的音频语言模型架构来验证其有效性。在MMSU、MMAR和MMAU上的大量实验表明，采用统一音频框架能够带来持续的改进效果。与同类最先进的模型相比，该框架在MMSU任务上的精细感知能力提升了10.9%，同时仍保持了强大的推理能力。我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/Tencent/Unified_Audio_Schema上免费获取。

papers.title: From Style to Story: A Curriculum Learning Approach for Imitative Novel Generation
papers.title_zh: 从风格到故事：一种用于模仿性小说创作的课程学习方法
papers.authors: Xueran Han, Yuhan Liu, Mingzhe Li, Wei Liu, Sen Hu, Rui Yan, Zhiqiang xu, Xiuying Chen
papers.abstract: Great novels create immersive worlds with rich character arcs, well-structured plots, and nuanced writing styles. However, current novel generation methods often rely on brief, simplistic story outlines and generate details using plain, generic language.To bridge this gap, we introduce the task of \textit{Imitative Novel Generation}, which requires the generated novels to imitate the distinctive features of the original work, including understanding character profiles and world views, predicting plausible plot developments, and writing concrete details using vivid, expressive language.To achieve this, we propose WriterAgent, a novel generation system designed to master the core aspects of literary imitative.WriterAgent is trained through a curriculum learning paradigm, progressing from low-level stylistic mastery to high-level narrative coherence. Its key tasks include language style learning, character modeling, plot planning, and stylish writing, ensuring comprehensive narrative control.To support this, WriterAgent leverages the WriterLoRA framework, an extension of LoRA with hierarchical and cumulative task-specific modules, each specializing in a different narrative aspect. We evaluate WriterAgent on multilingual classics like \textit{Harry Potter} and \textit{Dream of the Red Chamber}, demonstrating its superiority over baselines in capturing the target author’s settings, character dynamics, and writing style to produce coherent, faithful narratives.We hope this work inspires literary creativity in NLP: {WriterAgent}.
papers.abstract_zh: 优秀的小说能够创造出充满沉浸感的世界，拥有丰富的角色弧线、结构严谨的情节以及细腻的文字风格。然而，当前的小说生成方法往往依赖于简单粗放的故事大纲，并使用平淡无奇的语言来构建细节。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了“模仿性小说生成”任务，要求生成的作品能够模仿原作的独特特点，包括理解角色特征与世界观、预测合理的情节发展，以及用生动有力的语言来描绘具体的细节。为了实现这一目标，我们开发了WriterAgent这一小说生成系统，它旨在掌握文学模仿的核心要素。WriterAgent通过课程学习的方式进行训练，从低层次的风格掌握逐步发展到高层次的叙事连贯性。它的主要任务包括语言风格学习、角色建模、情节规划以及富有创意的写作，从而确保对叙事的全面掌控。为了支持这一功能，WriterAgent利用了WriterLoRA框架——LoRA的扩展版本，该框架包含层次化且针对特定任务的模块，每个模块都专注于不同的叙事方面。我们在《哈利·波特》和《红楼梦》等多语言经典作品中评估了WriterAgent的表现，结果显示它在捕捉目标作者的环境设定、角色动态以及写作风格方面表现出色，能够生成连贯且忠实于原作的叙述。我们希望这项工作能够为自然语言处理领域的文学创作带来灵感：{WriterAgent}。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ArkRepoBench: A Repository-Level Code Completion Benchmark for HarmonyOS Development
papers.title_zh: ArkRepoBench：一款适用于HarmonyOS开发的代码补全性能测试工具
papers.authors: Yanlin Wang, Bowen Zhang, Yanli Wang, Daya Guo, Terry Yue Zhuo, Jiachi Chen, Mingwei Liu, Xingong Zhang, Zibin Zheng
papers.abstract: ArkTS is the primary programming language for Huawei’s HarmonyOS ecosystem, which has expanded across smartphones, tablets, and IoT devices. While large language models have demonstrated strong code generation capabilities for mainstream languages, their performance on ArkTS remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce ArkRepoBench, the first repository-level code completion benchmark for ArkTS to our knowledge, 7,519 samples from 20 official HarmonyOS repositories. The benchmark covers multiple difficulty levels and further categorizes completion instances into Single-File, Cross-File Independent, and Cross-File Dependent settings based on dependency analysis, distinguishing the mere presence of cross-file context from its actual necessity. Our experiments show that: (1) ArkTS completion consistently underperforms mainstream languages under our experimental settings, suggesting language-specific challenges associated with this emerging language; (2) open-source 7B models achieve performance comparable to close-source models; (3) cross-file context is a double-edged sword, with sparse retrieval(Jaccard) outperforming dense methods on ArkTS; and (4) HarmonyOS API documentation consistently improves performance, suggesting the benefits of domain-specific enhancements in low-resource settings.
papers.abstract_zh: ArkTS是华为HarmonyOS生态系统的主要编程语言，其应用范围已扩展到智能手机、平板电脑和物联网设备中。虽然大语言模型在主流语言中表现出强大的代码生成能力，但其在ArkTS上的性能表现仍待进一步探索。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了ArkRepoBench——据我们所知，这是首个针对ArkTS的仓库级代码补全基准测试。该测试涵盖了7,519个样本，来自20个官方HarmonyOS仓库。该基准测试包含多个难度级别，并根据依赖关系将补全实例分为单文件、跨文件独立和跨文件依赖三种情况，从而区分仅仅是跨文件上下文的存在与实际的依赖需求。我们的实验表明：(1)在我们的实验设置下，ArkTS的代码补全性能始终低于主流语言，这表明这种新兴语言存在语言特定的挑战；(2)开源的7B模型在性能上可与闭源模型相媲美；(3)跨文件上下文是一把双刃剑，稀疏检索（Jaccard相似度）在ArkTS上的表现优于密集方法；(4)HarmonyOS的API文档能够持续提升性能，这表明在资源有限的情况下，针对特定领域的改进具有显著优势。

papers.title: e5-omni: Explicit Cross-modal Alignment for Omni-modal Embeddings
papers.title_zh: e5-omni：用于全模态嵌入的显式跨模态对齐技术
papers.authors: Haonan Chen, Sicheng Gao, Radu Timofte, Tetsuya Sakai, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Modern information systems often involve different types of items, , a text query, an image, a video clip, or an audio segment. This motivates omni-modal embedding models that map heterogeneous modalities into a shared space for direct comparison. However, most recent omni-modal embeddings still rely heavily on implicit alignment inherited from pretrained vision-language model (VLM) backbones. In practice, this causes three common issues: (i) similarity logits have modality-dependent sharpness, so scores are not on a consistent scale; (ii) in-batch negatives become less effective over time because mixed-modality batches create an imbalanced hardness distribution; as a result, many negatives quickly become trivial and contribute little gradient; and (iii) embeddings across modalities show mismatched first- and second-order statistics, which makes rankings less stable. To tackle these problems, we propose e5-omni, a lightweight explicit alignment recipe that adapts off-the-shelf VLMs into robust omni-modal embedding models. e5-omni combines three simple components: (1) modality-aware temperature calibration to align similarity scales, (2) a controllable negative curriculum with debiasing to focus on confusing negatives while reducing the impact of false negatives, and (3) batch whitening with covariance regularization to better match cross-modal geometry in the shared embedding space. Experiments on MMEB-V2 and AudioCaps show consistent gains over strong bi-modal and omni-modal baselines, and the same recipe also transfers well to other VLM backbones. We release our model checkpoint at https://huggingface.co/collections/Haon-Chen/e5-omni.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代信息系统通常涉及多种类型的数据，如文本查询、图像、视频片段或音频段。这促使人们提出了全模态嵌入模型，这些模型能够将不同模态的数据映射到一个共享的空间中，以便进行直接比较。然而，目前大多数全模态嵌入方法仍然严重依赖预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）所继承的隐式对齐机制。在实际应用中，这会导致三个常见的问题：(1) 相似性的逻辑值具有模态依赖性，因此评分标准并不一致；(2) 随着时间推移，混合模态批次中的负样本效果会减弱，因为混合模态批次会导致硬度的分布不平衡；结果就是许多负样本变得微不足道，对梯度的影响也很小；(3) 不同模态之间的嵌入结果显示出不匹配的一阶和二阶统计特性，这使得排名的稳定性降低。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了e5-omni这一轻量级显式对齐方案，该方案能够将现有的VLM改编成强大的全模态嵌入模型。e5-omni结合了三个简单的组件：(1) 考虑模态特性的温度校准，以调整相似性的尺度；(2) 一个可控制的负样本训练策略，通过去偏处理来减少混淆的负样本的影响，同时降低假阴性的风险；(3) 通过协方差正则化来实现批次归一化，从而更好地匹配共享嵌入空间中的跨模态几何特性。在MMEB-V2和AudioCaps上的实验表明，与强大的双模态和全模态基线相比，e5-omni取得了稳定的性能提升。同样的方案也可以很好地应用于其他VLM基模型中。我们的模型检查点可以在https://huggingface.co/collections/Haon-Chen/e5-omni下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Large Language Models Are Still Misled by Simple Bias Ensembles
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型仍然会被简单的偏差集成所误导
papers.authors: Zhouhao Sun, Zhiyuan Kan, Xiao Ding, Li Du, Bibo Cai, Yang Zhao, Bing Qin, Ting Liu
papers.abstract: With the evolution of large language models (LLMs), their robustness against individual simple biases has been enhanced. However, we observe that the ensemble of multiple simple biases still exerts a significant adverse impact on LLMs. Given that real-world data samples are typically confounded by a wide range of biases, LLMs tend to exhibit unstable performance when deployed in high-stakes real-world scenarios such as clinical diagnosis and legal document analysis. However, previous benchmarks are constrained to datasets where each sample is manually injected with only one type of bias. To bridge this gap, we propose a multi-bias benchmark where each sample contains multiple types of biases. Experimental results reveal that existing LLMs and debiasing methods perform poorly on this benchmark, highlighting the challenge of eliminating such compounded biases.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的发展，它们对单一简单偏见的抗拒能力得到了提升。然而，我们观察到，多个简单偏见叠加在一起时，仍然会对大语言模型产生显著的负面影响。由于现实世界的数据样本通常受到多种偏见的干扰，因此当大语言模型被用于诸如临床诊断和法律文件分析等高风险场景时，其性能往往会变得不稳定。不过，以往的基准测试仅限于那些每个样本仅包含一种偏见的场景。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种多偏见基准测试方案，该方案要求每个样本同时包含多种类型的偏见。实验结果表明，现有的大语言模型和去偏见方法在这类基准测试中的表现并不理想，这凸显了消除这种复合偏见所带来的挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Text-to-TrajVis: Enabling Trajectory Data Visualizations from Natural Language Questions
papers.title_zh: 文本转轨迹可视化：根据自然语言描述实现轨迹数据的可视化呈现
papers.authors: Tian Bai, Huiyan Ying, Kailong Suo, Victor Junqiu Wei, Tao Fan, Yuanfeng Song
papers.abstract: This paper introduces the Text-to-TrajVis task, which aims to transform natural language questions into trajectory data visualizations, facilitating the development of natural language interfaces for trajectory visualization systems. As this is a novel task, there is currently no relevant dataset available in the community. To address this gap, we first devised a new visualization language called Trajectory Visualization Language (TVL) to facilitate querying trajectory data and generating visualizations. Building on this foundation, we further proposed a dataset construction method that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) with human efforts to create high-quality data. Specifically, we devised a four-stage pipeline that begins with candidate extraction, proceeds through seed TVL generation and tree-based expansion, and concludes with LLM-driven question creation followed by human validation. This process results in the creation of the first large-scale Text-to-TrajVis dataset, named TrajVL, which contains 9,608 (question, TVL) pairs. We propose a framework called TRCAT for progressively converting natural language questions into TVLs. The framework incorporates TVL-RAG Chain Module and Area-Time Standardization Module, significantly enhancing the accuracy of LLMs in TVL generation. Based on the TrajVL dataset, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of TRCAT’s performance across several mainstream LLMs (e.g., GPT, Qwen, LLaMA, and Gemma). Furthermore, we established a benchmarking system for this task, providing a foundation for future research in structured trajectory language generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Text-to-TrajVis任务，该任务旨在将自然语言问题转化为轨迹数据可视化形式，从而推动轨迹可视化系统的自然语言接口开发。由于这是一项新的任务，目前社区中还没有相关的数据集。为了填补这一空白，我们首先设计了一种名为Trajectory Visualization Language（TVL）的新可视化语言，以便于查询轨迹数据并生成可视化结果。在此基础上，我们进一步提出了一种数据集构建方法，该方法将大语言模型与人工处理相结合，以创建高质量的数据。具体来说，我们设计了一个四阶段流程：首先提取候选数据，然后生成初始的TVL数据，接着进行基于树的扩展处理，最后由语言模型驱动问题生成过程，并经过人工验证。这一过程最终产生了第一个大规模的文本到TrajVis数据集，名为TrajVL，其中包含9,608对问题-TVL数据。我们提出了一种名为TRCAT的框架，用于逐步将自然语言问题转化为TVL数据。该框架包含了TVL-RAG链模块和区域-时间标准化模块，显著提高了语言模型在TVL生成方面的准确性。基于TrajVL数据集，我们对TRCAT在多种主流语言模型上的性能进行了全面评估（例如GPT、Qwen、LLaMA和Gemma）。此外，我们还为这项任务建立了一个基准测试系统，为未来结构化轨迹语言生成的研究提供了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MemTR: Enhancing Tool-Calling Reliability via Uncertainty-Triggered FFN-Space Retracing
papers.title_zh: MemTR：通过基于不确定性的FFN空间重构技术提升工具调用的可靠性
papers.authors: Hongtao Duan, Lu Jiang, Minying Zhang, Xiaobing Zhu, Tianpeng Bu, Hao Jiang, Xinyu Wei, Lulu hu
papers.abstract: Tool calling requires Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate structured decisions including tool names and schema-constrained arguments, where small decoding mistakes can cause hard failures. Existing methods either rely on costly tool-use training data or only constrain syntax, leaving tool selection and argument value errors largely unsolved. We analyze tool calling failures through a Where–When lens: (Where) failures correlate with persistent uncertainty in late transformer layers, (When) uncertainty concentrates on content-bearing tokens (tool names and argument values) rather than schema tokens. Based on this, and motivated by evidence that transformer Feed Forward Networks (FFNs) act as key–value style memories that store and retrieve factual or associative mappings, we propose Memory Space Tool Retracing (MemTR), a weight-free decoding-time method that retrieves relevant tool evidence from the tool library and mixes it into the FFN-output at the uncertain layer, treating FFNs as key–value memories. Through extensive experiments on various model families (Qwen, Llama, and xLAM) and benchmarks (BFCL, ACEBench, APIBank), MemTR reduces tool calling failures by 2%–9% with only 1%–2% runtime overhead, without any fine-tuning or additional tool-use training data.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具调用需要大语言模型来生成结构化的决策，包括工具名称和受模式约束的参数。然而，小的解码错误可能会导致严重的失败。现有的方法要么依赖成本高昂的工具使用训练数据，要么只限制语法规则，导致工具选择和参数值方面的错误仍然无法解决。我们通过“时间-地点”视角来分析工具调用的失败情况：在“时间”方面，失败与晚期变换器层中的持续不确定性有关；在“地点”方面，不确定性集中在承载内容的标记上，比如工具名称和参数值，而不是模式标记。基于这一发现，并且受到这样的启发——变换器前馈网络充当了存储和检索事实或关联映射的关键-值记忆库，我们提出了一种无权重的解码时间方法——内存空间工具回溯法。该方法从工具库中检索相关的工具信息，并将其混合到不确定层的前馈网络输出中，将前馈网络视为关键-值记忆库。通过在各种模型家族（Qwen、Llama和xLAM）以及基准测试（BFCL、ACEBench、APIBank）上进行广泛的实验，我们发现，使用内存空间工具回溯法可以将工具调用的失败率降低2%至9%，同时仅增加1%至2%的运行时间开销，而无需进行任何微调或额外的工具使用训练数据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: More Than Sum of Its Parts: Deciphering Intent Shifts in Multimodal Hate Speech Detection
papers.title_zh: 不仅仅是各个部分的总和：解析多模态仇恨言论检测中意图的变化
papers.authors: Runze Sun, Yu Zheng, Zexuan Xiong, Zhongjin Qu, Lei Chen, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
papers.abstract: Combating hate speech on social media is critical for securing cyberspace, yet relies heavily on the efficacy of automated detection systems. As content formats evolve, hate speech is transitioning from solely plain text to complex multimodal expressions, making implicit attacks harder to spot. Current systems, however, often falter on these subtle cases, as they struggle with multimodal content where the emergent meaning transcends the aggregation of individual modalities. To bridge this gap, we move beyond binary classification to characterize semantic intent shifts where modalities interact to construct implicit hate from benign cues or neutralize toxicity through semantic inversion. Guided by this fine-grained formulation, we curate the Hate via Vision-Language Interplay (H-VLI) benchmark where the true intent hinges on the intricate interplay of modalities rather than overt visual or textual slurs. To effectively decipher these complex cues, we further propose the Asymmetric Reasoning via Courtroom Agent DEbate (ARCADE) framework. By simulating a judicial process where agents actively argue for accusation and defense, ARCADE forces the model to scrutinize deep semantic cues before reaching a verdict. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ARCADE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on H-VLI, particularly for challenging implicit cases, while maintaining competitive performance on established benchmarks. Our code and data are available at:https://github.com/Sayur1n/H-VLI
papers.abstract_zh: 在社交媒体上打击仇恨言论对于维护网络空间的安全至关重要，但这在很大程度上依赖于自动化检测系统的有效性。随着内容形式的演变，仇恨言论已经从单纯的文本形式转变为复杂的多模态表达，这使得隐性的攻击行为更难被识别。然而，当前的系统往往在这些微妙的情况下表现不佳，因为它们在处理多模态内容时存在困难，因为多模态内容的含义超越了各个独立模态的叠加。为了填补这一空白，我们不再采用二元分类的方法，而是通过描述语义意图的变化来应对这种情况，即不同模态相互作用以产生隐性仇恨或通过对语义进行反转来消除毒性。基于这种细粒度的分析方法，我们创建了“通过视觉-语言交互来识别仇恨”的基准测试，在这个测试中，真正的意图取决于不同模态之间的复杂互动，而不是单纯的视觉或文本上的侮辱性表达。为了有效解析这些复杂的线索，我们进一步提出了“通过法庭代理辩论来实现非对称推理”的框架。通过模拟一种司法程序，其中代理人积极地为指控和辩护而争论，ARCADE迫使模型在做出裁决之前仔细分析深层次的语义线索。广泛的实验表明，ARCADE在H-VLI基准测试中的表现显著优于最先进的基线方法，尤其是在处理复杂的隐性案例时，同时仍然能在现有的基准测试中保持竞争力。我们的代码和数据可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/Sayur1n/H-VLI

papers.title: Specialization without Sparsity: Efficient and Expressive Split-Path Experts for LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 无需稀疏性的专业化：适用于大型语言模型微调的高效且富有表现力的分割路径专家方法
papers.authors: Ganghao Liu, Qin Zhou, Zhe Wang, Xuehan Lu, Haihua Huang, Yunfei Tong, Heng Tian
papers.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables low-cost adaptation of large language models but often suffers from limited representational flexibility. To address this, we incorporate a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) design and propose Efficient and Expressive split-path experts that enhance specialization while maintaining low resource overhead. Split-Path Adaptive Representation Mixture-of-Experts (SparMoE) replaces discrete hard routing with a soft routing and fully-activated mixture, enabling stable optimization. Each expert is parameterized as a split-path modulation module, consisting of a scaling path that promotes expert specialization and a bias path that preserves expert-specific signals. This design significantly enhances expressive capacity while maintaining strict parameter efficiency and architectural compatibility with PEFT. Extensive evaluations on GLUE, GSM8K, MBPP, and a text rewriting task from SmolTalk show that our approach consistently outperforms or matches state-of-the-art PEFT methods under comparable parameter budgets, achieving a favorable trade-off between adaptability and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）能够实现大语言模型的低成本适配，但往往存在表征灵活性有限的缺点。为了解决这一问题，我们采用了混合专家设计，并提出了高效且富有表现力的分路径专家结构。这种结构在保持低资源开销的同时，提升了专家的专门性。分路径自适应表示混合专家（SparMoE）用软路由和完全激活的混合模型取代了离散的硬路由，从而实现稳定的优化过程。每个专家都被参数化为一个分路径调制模块，该模块包含促进专家专门性的缩放路径，以及保留特定专家信号的偏置路径。这种设计显著提升了表达能力，同时保持了严格的参数效率以及与PEFT的架构兼容性。在GLUE、GSM8K、MBPP以及SmolTalk提供的文本重写任务上的广泛评估表明，我们的方法在相同的参数预算下，始终优于或等同于最先进的PEFT方法，实现了适应性与效率之间的良好平衡。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Pardon? Evaluating Conversational Repair in Large Audio-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 对不起？在大型语音模型中评估对话式修复机制的方法是什么？
papers.authors: Shuanghong Huang, Jinlei Xu, Youchao Zhou, Yanghao Zhou, Xuan Zhao, Chong Feng, Wenxuan Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have demonstrated strong performance in spoken question answering (QA), with existing evaluations primarily focusing on answer accuracy and robustness to acoustic perturbations. However, such evaluations implicitly assume that spoken inputs remain semantically answerable, an assumption that often fails in real-world interaction when essential information is missing. In this work, we introduce a repair-aware evaluation setting that explicitly distinguishes between answerable and unanswerable audio inputs. We define answerability as a property of the input itself and construct paired evaluation conditions using a semantic-acoustic masking protocol. Based on this setting, we propose the Evaluability Awareness and Repair (EAR) score, a non-compensatory metric that jointly evaluates task competence under answerable conditions and repair behavior under unanswerable conditions. Experiments on two spoken QA benchmarks across diverse LALMs reveal a consistent gap between answer accuracy and conversational reliability: while many models perform well when inputs are answerable, most fail to recognize semantic unanswerability and initiate appropriate conversational repair. These findings expose a limitation of prevailing accuracy-centric evaluation practices and motivate reliability assessments that treat unanswerable inputs as cues for repair and continued interaction. The core code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/sheunghung/EAR.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型音频语言模型在口语问答任务中表现优异，现有的评估主要关注答案的准确性和对声学干扰的鲁棒性。然而，这些评估隐含地假设口语输入在语义上都是可回答的，而在现实交互中，当关键信息缺失时，这一假设往往无法成立。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种注重修复的评估框架，能够明确区分可回答和不可回答的音频输入。我们将“可回答性”定义为输入本身的属性，并通过语义-声学掩蔽协议构建相应的评估条件。基于这一框架，我们提出了“可评估性意识与修复”评分指标，这是一种非补偿性的评估方法，它能够同时评估在可回答条件下的任务完成度以及在不可回答条件下的修复行为。通过对两种不同大型音频语言模型的口语问答基准测试进行实验分析，我们发现答案准确性与对话可靠性之间存在明显的差距：许多模型在输入可回答时能够取得良好的性能，但大多数模型无法识别语义上的不可回答情况，也无法采取适当的修复措施。这些发现揭示了当前以准确性为中心的评估方法的局限性，并促使我们采用一种将不可回答输入视为修复和继续交互线索的可靠性评估方式。核心代码和数据集可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/sheunghung/EAR
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ToxReason: A Benchmark for Mechanistic Chemical Toxicity Reasoning via Adverse Outcome Pathway
papers.title_zh: ToxReason：通过不良后果路径来推理化学毒性机制的基准方法
papers.authors: Jueon Park, WonJune Jang, Chanhwi Kim, Yein Park, Jaewoo Kang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled molecular reasoning for property prediction. However, toxicity arises from complex biological mechanisms beyond chemical structure, necessitating mechanistic reasoning for reliable prediction. Despite its importance, current benchmarks fail to systematically evaluate this capability. LLMs can generate fluent but biologically unfaithful explanations, making it difficult to assess whether predicted toxicities are grounded in valid mechanisms. To bridge this gap, we introduce ToxReason, a benchmark grounded in the Adverse Outcome Pathway (AOP) that evaluates organ-level toxicity reasoning across multiple organs. ToxReason integrates experimental drug–target interaction evidence with toxicity labels, requiring models to infer both toxic outcomes and their underlying mechanisms from Molecular Initiating Event (MIE) to Adverse Outcome (AO). Using ToxReason, we evaluate toxicity prediction performance and reasoning quality across diverse LLMs. We find that strong predictive performance does not necessarily imply reliable reasoning. Furthermore, we show that reasoning-aware training improves mechanistic reasoning and, consequently, toxicity prediction performance. Together, these results underscore the necessity of integrating reasoning into both evaluation and training for trustworthy toxicity modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在大语言模型方面的进展使得分子推理用于毒性预测成为可能。然而，毒性问题源于复杂的生物机制，这些机制超出了化学结构的范畴，因此需要基于机制的推理才能做出可靠的预测。尽管这一点非常重要，但现有的评估基准却未能系统地评估这一能力。大语言模型能够生成流畅但不符合生物学事实的解释，这使得难以判断预测的毒性是否基于有效的机制。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ToxReason这一基于不良后果途径的评估基准，该基准能够评估多个器官层面的毒性推理能力。ToxReason将实验性药物-靶点相互作用的证据与毒性标签相结合，要求模型从分子引发事件到不良后果的过程中，推断出毒性的结果及其背后的机制。通过ToxReason，我们评估了不同大语言模型的毒性预测性能和推理质量。我们发现，强大的预测性能并不一定意味着可靠的推理能力。此外，我们还发现，具有推理意识的训练能够提升机制的推理能力，从而改善毒性预测的性能。总的来说，这些结果强调了将推理能力整合到评估和训练中对于构建可信的毒性模型的重要性。

papers.title: CVRH: Cross-modal Variational Role Hypergraph Network via Semantic Enhancement for Multi-modal Event Argument Extraction
papers.title_zh: CVRH：基于语义增强的跨模态变分角色超图网络，用于多模态事件参数提取
papers.authors: Bangze Pan, Yang Li, Ruili Pu, Suge Wang, Jian Liao, JianXing Zheng, Xiaoli Li, Deyu Li
papers.abstract: Multi-modal Event Argument Extraction task (MEAE) aims to extract all arguments related to a specific event from multiple modalities and identify their corresponding roles. Existing methods focus on weakly alignment of uni-modal representations and generatively data augmentation techniques. However, these methods ignore the potential impact of event role information on MEAE. To address this problem, we propose a Cross-modal Variational Role Hypergraph Network via Semantic Enhancement (CVRH). Unlike previous approaches, CVRH centers on event role information and designs a variational role hyperedge via semantic enhancement, which constructs a role hypergraph for event arguments within multi-modal documents. It explicitly modeling the high-order role correlations among cross-modal arguments in a document. Furthermore, CVRH introduces a modal shared encoder based on differential transformer, which effectively learns shared semantic representations across modalities and enhances the independence of argument representations. On the M2E2 benchmark, experimental results show that CVRH achieves a 6.9% improvement in F1-score on the MEAE compared to current state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态事件参数提取任务（MEAE）旨在从多种模态中提取与特定事件相关的所有参数，并识别它们对应的角色。现有方法主要关注单模态表示之间的弱对齐以及生成式数据增强技术。然而，这些方法忽略了事件角色信息对MEAE的潜在影响。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于语义增强的多模态变分角色超图网络（CVRH）。与以往的方法不同，CVRH专注于事件角色信息，并通过语义增强技术构建变分角色超边，从而为多模态文档中的事件参数构建一个完整的角色超图。该方法能够明确建模文档中跨模态参数之间的高阶角色关联关系。此外，CVRH还引入了一种基于差分变换器的模态共享编码器，能够有效学习跨模态的共享语义表示，从而提高参数表示的独立性。在M2E2基准测试上，实验结果表明，与当前最先进的方法相比，CVRH在MEAE方面的F1分数提升了6.9%。

papers.title: DiffCL: Difference-Aware Contrastive Learning for Automatic Answer Grading with Multi-Level Semantic Modeling
papers.title_zh: DiffCL：基于差异感知的对比学习技术，用于实现多层级语义模型下的自动答案评分
papers.authors: Lei Chen, BoYu Gao, Zitao Liu, Tingjie Wan, Weiqi Luo
papers.abstract: Automated Answer Grading (AAG) is a fundamental task in intelligent education, requiring accurate semantic understanding and reliable modeling of student deviations from reference answers. Despite recent progress, large language models (LLMs) remain insensitive to missing key concepts, exhibit unstable scoring scales, and lack structured scoring semantics in their representation space. To overcome these limitations, we propose a difference-aware AAG framework that integrates heuristic difference labeling with dual-contrastive learning. Semantic difference levels between student and reference answers are automatically inferred through similarity-based heuristics and injected into the model input as explicit prompts, enabling fine-grained perception of semantic deviations. In addition, an InfoNCE-based contrastive objective enforces representation consistency among samples with identical scores, while a hierarchical contrastive constraint guided by score gaps promotes structured separation across different scoring levels. Experiments on benchmark datasets, including SciEntsBank and Beetle, show that the proposed method consistently outperforms cross-entropy–based baselines in accuracy, weighted accuracy, and relevance metrics. Further analyses demonstrate improved robustness and generalization, even when applied to small-scale models. We have made all datasets and the corresponding code publiclyaccessible at: https://github.com/leibnizchen/DiffCL
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化答案评分（AAG）是智能教育中的一个核心任务，需要准确理解语义，并可靠地建模学生答案与参考答案之间的偏差。尽管最近取得了一些进展，但大语言模型仍然对缺失的关键概念缺乏敏感性，评分尺度不稳定，且其表示空间中缺乏结构化的评分语义。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种基于差异感知的AAG框架，该框架将启发式差异标记与双对比学习相结合。学生和参考答案之间的语义差异水平通过基于相似性的启发式方法自动推断出来，并作为明确的提示注入到模型输入中，从而实现对语义偏差的精细感知。此外，基于InfoNCE的对比目标能够确保得分相同的样本之间具有一致的表示结构，而由分数差距引导的层次化对比约束则促进了不同评分级别之间的结构化区分。在包括SciEntsBank和Beetle在内的基准数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法在准确性、加权准确性和相关性指标方面始终优于基于交叉熵的基线方法。进一步分析表明，即使应用于小型模型时，该方法也表现出更好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。我们已将所有数据集及其相应的代码公开提供，访问地址为：https://github.com/leibnizchen/DiffCL

papers.title: GaLa: Hypergraph-Guided Visual Language Models for Procedural Planning
papers.title_zh: GaLa：基于超图引导的视觉语言模型，用于程序性规划
papers.authors: Kun Wang, Li Yiming, Mingcheng Qu, Aqiang Zhang, Guang Yang, Tonghua Su
papers.abstract: Implicit spatial relations and deep semantic structures encoded in object attributes are crucial for procedural planning in embodied AI systems. However, existing approaches often over-rely on the reasoning capabilities of vision language models (VLMs) themselves, while overlooking the rich structured semantic information that can be mined from multimodal inputs. As a result, models struggle to effectively understand functional spatial relationships in complex scenes. To fully exploit implicit spatial relations and deep semantic structures in multimodal data, we propose GaLa, a vision–language framework for multimodal procedural planning. GaLa introduces a hypergraph-based representation, where object instances in the image are modeled as nodes, and region-level hyperedges are constructed by aggregating objects according to their attributes and functional semantics. This design explicitly captures implicit semantic relations among objects as well as the hierarchical organization of functional regions. Furthermore, we design a Tri-View HyperGraph Encoder that enforces semantic consistency across the node view, area view, and node–area association view via contrastive learning, enabling hypergraph semantics to be more effectively injected into downstream VLM reasoning. Extensive experiments on the ActPlan-1K and ALFRED benchmarks demonstrate that GaLa significantly outperforms existing methods in terms of execution success rate, LCS, and planning correctness.
papers.abstract_zh: 在具身人工智能系统中，隐式空间关系和存储在对象属性中的深层语义结构对于程序化规划至关重要。然而，现有方法往往过度依赖视觉语言模型自身的推理能力，而忽视了可以从多模态输入中提取的丰富结构化语义信息。因此，模型难以有效理解复杂场景中的功能性空间关系。为了充分利用多模态数据中的隐式空间关系和深层语义结构，我们提出了GaLa这一用于多模态程序化规划的视觉-语言框架。GaLa采用了基于超图的表示方式，将图像中的对象实例建模为节点，并通过根据对象的属性和功能语义对对象进行聚合来构建区域级别的超边。这种设计能够明确捕捉对象之间的隐式语义关系以及功能区域的层次结构。此外，我们还设计了一种Tri-View超图编码器，通过对比学习来确保节点视图、区域视图以及节点-区域关联视图之间的语义一致性，从而使超图语义能够更有效地融入下游视觉语言模型的推理过程中。在ActPlan-1K和ALFRED基准测试上的广泛实验表明，GaLa在执行成功率、最长路径搜索以及规划正确性方面显著优于现有方法。

papers.title: TwinVoice: A Multi-dimensional Benchmark Towards Digital Twins via LLM Persona Simulation
papers.title_zh: 双声线：通过大型语言模型角色模拟实现多维数字孪生基准测试
papers.authors: Bangde Du, Minghao Guo, Songming He, Ziyi Ye, Xi Zhu, Weihang Su, Shuqi Zhu, Yujia Zhou, Yongfeng Zhang, Qingyao Ai, Yiqun Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are exhibiting emergent human-like abilities and are envisioned as the tool for simulating an individual’s communication patterns, behaviors, and personality traits. However, current evaluations of LLM-based persona simulation remain limited: most rely on synthetic dialogues and lack fine-grained analysis of the capability for persona simulation. To address these limitations, we introduce TwinVoice, a comprehensive benchmark for assessing persona simulation across diverse real-world contexts. TwinVoice encompasses three dimensions: Social Persona (public social interactions), Interpersonal Persona (private dialogues), and Narrative Persona (role-based expression). It further decomposes the evaluation into six fundamental capabilities, including opinion consistency, memory recall, logical reasoning, lexical fidelity, persona tone, and syntactic style. Experimental results reveal that while advanced models achieve moderate accuracy in persona simulation, they still fall short of capabilities such as syntactic style and memory recall. Our data, code, and evaluation results are available.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正在展现出类似人类的能力，被视作模拟个人沟通模式、行为以及性格特征的工具。然而，目前对基于语言模型的角色模拟能力的评估仍然有限：大多数评估都依赖于合成对话，且缺乏对角色模拟能力的细致分析。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了TwinVoice这一全面的评估基准，用于评估语言模型在不同现实情境下的角色模拟能力。TwinVoice涵盖了三个维度：社交角色模拟（公共社交互动）、人际角色模拟（私人对话）以及叙事角色模拟（基于角色的表达）。此外，该评估还分为六个基本能力指标，包括观点一致性、记忆回忆、逻辑推理、词汇准确性、角色语气以及句法风格。实验结果表明，虽然先进的模型在角色模拟方面达到了一定的准确度，但在句法风格和记忆回忆等能力方面仍然存在不足。我们的数据、代码以及评估结果均已公开可供使用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CE-RM: A Pointwise Generative Reward Model Optimized via Two-Stage Rollout and Unified Criteria
papers.title_zh: CE-RM：一种点态生成奖励模型，通过两阶段部署和统一标准进行优化
papers.authors: Xinyu Hu, Yancheng He, Weixun Wang, Tao Feng, Li Lin, Jiashun Liu, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng, Xiaojun Wan
papers.abstract: Automatic evaluation is crucial yet challenging for open-ended natural language generation, especially when rule-based metrics are infeasible. Compared with traditional methods, the recent LLM-as-a-Judge paradigms enable better and more flexible evaluation, and show promise as generative reward models for reinforcement learning. However, prior work has revealed a notable gap between their seemingly impressive benchmark performance and actual effectiveness in RL practice. We attribute this issue to some limitations in existing studies, including the dominance of pairwise evaluation and inadequate optimization of evaluation criteria. Therefore, we propose CE-RM-4B, a pointwise generative reward model trained with a dedicated two-stage rollout method, and adopting unified query-based criteria. Using only about 5.7K high-quality data curated from the open-source preference dataset, our CE-RM-4B achieves superior performance on diverse reward model benchmarks, especially in Best-of-N scenarios, and delivers more effective improvements in downstream RL practice.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动评估在开放式的自然语言生成任务中至关重要，但同样充满挑战，尤其是在基于规则的评估指标不可行的情况下。与传统方法相比，最近出现的以大语言模型作为评估器的范式能够实现更完善、更灵活的评估方式，并且有望成为强化学习中的生成式奖励模型。然而，先前的研究表明，这些模型在基准测试中的出色表现与实际在强化学习实践中的效果之间存在明显差距。我们认为这一问题的根源在于现有研究的某些局限性，包括成对评估的主导地位以及评估标准的优化不足。因此，我们提出了CE-RM-4B模型——一种采用两阶段训练方法的逐点生成式奖励模型，并采用统一的基于查询的评估标准。仅使用来自开源偏好数据集的约5700条高质量数据，我们的CE-RM-4B在各种奖励模型基准测试中取得了优异的表现，尤其是在“最佳N次”场景中表现尤为突出，并且在后续的强化学习实践中也带来了显著的改进。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Hard to Read, Easy to Jailbreak: How Visual Degradation Bypasses MLLM Safety Alignment
papers.title_zh: 难以理解，却容易被破解：视觉退化技术如何突破MLLM的安全限制
papers.authors: Zhixue Song, Boyan Han, Yiwei Wang, Chi Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in visual context compression enable MLLMs to process ultra-long contexts efficiently by rendering text into images. However, we identify a critical vulnerability inherent to this paradigm: lowering image resolution inadvertently catalyzes jailbreaking. Our experiments reveal that the safety defenses of SOTA models deteriorate sharply as resolution degrades, surprisingly persisting even when text remains legible. We attribute this to “Cognitive Overload“, hypothesizing that the effort required to decipher degraded inputs diverts attentional resources from safety auditing. This phenomenon is consistent across various visual perturbations, including noise and geometric distortion. To address this, we propose a simple “Structured Cognitive Offloading” strategy that mitigates these risks by enforcing a serialized pipeline to decouple visual transcription from safety assessment. Our work exposes a significant risk in vision-based compression and provides critical insights for the secure design of future MLLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在视觉上下文压缩技术方面的进展，使得大语言模型能够通过将文本转化为图像来高效处理超长上下文。然而，我们发现这种范式存在一个关键缺陷：降低图像分辨率会无意中引发安全漏洞。我们的实验表明，随着分辨率下降，现有最佳模型的防御能力会显著减弱，即便文本仍然清晰可辨，这一现象依然存在。我们认为这是由于“认知过载”造成的，因为解读质量下降的输入需要消耗更多的注意力资源，从而分散了用于安全审核的注意力。这种现象在各种视觉干扰下都普遍存在，包括噪声和几何失真。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种简单的“结构化认知卸载”策略，通过实施一系列步骤来分离视觉转录过程与安全评估过程，从而减轻这些风险。我们的研究揭示了基于视觉的压缩技术中存在的重要风险，并为未来大语言模型的安全设计提供了重要启示。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Unleashing the Native Recommendation Potential: LLM-Based Generative Recommendation via Structured Term Identifiers
papers.title_zh: 释放本土推荐潜力：基于结构化术语标识的大语言模型生成式推荐
papers.authors: Zhiyang Zhang, Junda She, Kuo Cai, Bo Chen, Shiyao Wang, Xinchen Luo, Qiang Luo, Ruiming Tang, Han Li, Kun Gai, Guorui Zhou
papers.abstract: Leveraging the vast open-world knowledge and understanding capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to develop general-purpose, semantically-aware recommender systems has emerged as a pivotal research direction in generative recommendation. However, existing methods face bottlenecks in constructing item identifiers. Text-based methods introduce LLMs’ vast output space, leading to hallucination, while methods based on Semantic IDs (SIDs) encounter a semantic gap between SIDs and LLMs’ native vocabulary, requiring costly vocabulary expansion and alignment training. To address this, this paper introduces Term IDs (TIDs), defined as a set of semantically rich and standardized textual keywords, to serve as robust item identifiers. We propose GRAM, a novel framework centered on TIDs, employs Context-aware Term Generation to convert item’s metadata into standardized TIDs and utilizes Integrative Instruction Fine-tuning to collaboratively optimize term internalization and sequential recommendation. Additionally, Elastic Identifier Grounding is designed for robust item mapping. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that GRAM significantly outperforms baselines across multiple scenarios, pointing a promising direction for generalizable and high-performance generative recommendation systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型在广阔开放世界中的知识和理解能力，开发具有语义感知功能的通用推荐系统已成为生成式推荐领域的重要研究方向。然而，现有方法在构建物品标识符方面存在瓶颈。基于文本的方法会引入大语言模型的庞大输出空间，导致幻觉现象；而基于语义标识符的方法则面临语义鸿沟问题，即语义标识符与大语言模型原生词汇之间的不匹配，这需要昂贵的词汇扩展和对齐训练。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了术语标识符的概念，将其定义为一组具有丰富语义且标准化的文本关键词，作为可靠的物品标识符。我们提出了GRAM框架，该框架以术语标识符为核心，通过上下文感知的术语生成将物品的元数据转换为标准化的术语标识符，并利用集成指令微调技术来协同优化术语的内部化和序列推荐功能。此外，还设计了弹性标识符基准机制，以实现稳健的物品映射。在真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，GRAM在多种场景下均显著优于基线方法，为可泛化且高性能的生成式推荐系统指明了发展方向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Abstain-R1: Calibrated Abstention and Post-Refusal Clarification via Verifiable RL
papers.title_zh: 弃权-R1：通过可验证的强化学习算法实现校准后的弃权行为，以及拒绝后的善后处理
papers.authors: Haotian Zhai, Jingcheng Liang, Dongyeop Kang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning improves the reasoning ability of large language models, but it can also encourage them to answer unanswerable queries by guessing or hallucinating missing information. Existing abstention methods either train models to produce generic refusals or encourage follow-up clarifications without verifying whether those clarifications identify the key missing information. We study queries that are clear in meaning but cannot be reliably resolved from the given information, and argue that a reliable model should not only abstain, but also explain what is missing. We propose a clarification-aware RLVR reward that, while rewarding correct answers on answerable queries, jointly optimizes explicit abstention and semantically aligned post-refusal clarification on unanswerable queries. Using this reward, we train Abstain-R1, a 3B model that improves abstention and clarification on unanswerable queries while preserving strong performance on answerable ones. Experiments on Abstain-Test, Abstain-QA, and SelfAware show that Abstain-R1 substantially improves over its base model and achieves unanswerable-query behavior competitive with larger systems including DeepSeek-R1, suggesting that calibrated abstention and clarification can be learned through verifiable rewards rather than emerging from scale alone.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化微调提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但同时也可能促使模型通过猜测或虚构缺失信息来回答那些无法回答的问题。现有的回避方法要么训练模型给出通用的拒绝回应，要么鼓励用户进行进一步的说明，而并未验证这些说明是否真正揭示了关键的缺失信息。我们研究那些含义明确但无法从给定信息中可靠解决的查询，并认为可靠的模型不仅应该回避问题，还应该解释缺失的内容。我们提出了一种考虑澄清因素的RLVR奖励机制：该奖励机制在奖励对可解答问题的正确回答的同时，还能协同优化对不可解答问题的明确回避以及语义上一致的后续说明。通过使用这种奖励机制，我们训练出了Abstain-R1模型，该模型能够在保留对可解答问题强大性能的同时，显著改善对不可解答问题的回避和说明能力。在Abstain-Test、Abstain-QA以及SelfAware实验中的表现表明，Abstain-R1相比其基础模型有了显著的提升，其在处理不可解答问题时的行为与包括DeepSeek-R1在内的更大型系统相当，这表明通过可验证的奖励机制可以学习到合理的回避和说明策略，而不仅仅是依靠规模上的优势。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Learning Through Dialogue: Engagement and Efficacy Matter More Than Explanations
papers.title_zh: 通过对话学习：参与感和效果比解释更为重要
papers.authors: Shaz Furniturewala, Gerard Christopher Yeo, Kokil Jaidka
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as conversational partners for learning, yet the interactional dynamics supporting users’ learning and engagement are understudied. We analyze the linguistic and interactional features from both LLM and participant chats across 397 human–LLM conversations about socio-political issues to identify the mechanisms and conditions under which LLM explanations shape changes in political knowledge and confidence. Mediation analyses reveal that LLM explanatory richness partially supports confidence by fostering users’ reflective insight, whereas its effect on knowledge gain operates entirely through users’ cognitive engagement. Moderation analyses show that these effects are highly conditional and vary by political efficacy. Confidence gains depend on how high-efficacy users experience and resolve uncertainty. Knowledge gains depend on high-efficacy users’ ability to leverage extended interaction, with longer conversations benefiting primarily reflective users. In summary, we find that learning from LLMs is an interactional achievement, not a uniform outcome of better explanations. The findings underscore the importance of aligning LLM explanatory behavior with users’ engagement states to support effective learning in designing Human-AI interactive systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在辅助学习的过程中越来越被用作对话伙伴，然而，支持用户学习和参与的交互动态却尚未得到充分研究。我们分析了397次关于社会政治问题的人机对话中，语言模型和参与者聊天的内容，以探讨语言特征和交互特征如何影响用户的知识和信心变化。中介分析表明，大语言模型的丰富解释性内容在一定程度上能够增强用户的信心，因为它促进了用户的反思性思考；而其对知识获取的影响则完全依赖于用户的认知参与度。调节分析显示，这些效应具有高度条件性，并且会因政治效能的不同而有所差异。信心的提升取决于高效能用户如何应对不确定性。知识的获取则取决于高效能用户能否充分利用长时间的交谈来深化学习，而较长的对话对反思型用户更为有益。总之，我们发现从大语言模型中学习是一种互动性的成果，而非仅仅因为更好的解释而产生的统一效果。这些发现强调了在设计人机交互系统时，将大语言模型的解释行为与用户的参与状态相结合的重要性，这样才能实现有效的学习。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CodeBind: Decoupled Representation Learning for Multimodal Alignment with Unified Compositional Codebook
papers.title_zh: CodeBind：一种分离式表示学习算法，适用于多模态数据对齐问题，采用统一的组合编码方式
papers.authors: Zeyu Chen, Jie Li, Kai Han
papers.abstract: Multimodal representation alignment is pivotal for large language models and robotics. Traditional methods are often hindered by cross-modal information discrepancies and data scarcity, leading to suboptimal alignment spaces that overlook modality-unique features. We propose CodeBind, a framework that optimizes multimodal representation spaces through a modality-shared-specific codebook design. By incrementally aligning target and bridging modalities, CodeBind bypasses the need for fully paired data. Unlike traditional hard alignment, CodeBind decomposes features into shared components for semantic consistency and specific components for modality-unique details. This design utilizes a compositional vector quantization scheme, where a shared codebook bridges modality gaps and modality-specific codebooks mitigate representation bias by preventing dominant modalities from overshadowing others. Validated across nine modalities (text, image, video, audio, depth, thermal, tactile, 3D point cloud, EEG), CodeBind achieves state-of-the-art performance in multimodal classification and retrieval tasks. Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/codebind
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态表示对齐对于大语言模型和机器人技术至关重要。传统方法往往受到跨模态信息差异和数据稀缺性的限制，导致对齐效果不佳，从而忽略了各模态独有的特征。我们提出了CodeBind框架，该框架通过采用共享特定模态的编码簿设计来优化多模态表示空间。通过逐步对齐不同模态的元素，CodeBind无需完全匹配的数据即可实现对齐。与传统的硬对齐方法不同，CodeBind将特征分解为共享组件以实现语义一致性，同时保留特定模态的独特细节。该设计采用了组合式向量量化方案，其中共享编码簿可以填补模态间的差距，而特定模态的编码簿则能够防止主导模态掩盖其他模态的特征。在文本、图像、视频、音频、深度、热成像、触觉、3D点云和EEG等九种模态上进行验证后，CodeBind在多模态分类和检索任务中取得了领先的性能表现。项目页面：https://visual-ai.github.io/codebind
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MASS: Deep Research for Social Sciences with Memory-Augmented Social Simulation
papers.title_zh: MASS：基于记忆增强的社会模拟技术的社会科学深度研究
papers.authors: Yongrui Liu, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Deep Research agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) have exhibited extraordinary potential in automated paper writing tasks. However, existing systems rely heavily on literature retrieval and synthesis through internet and local knowledge bases, often resulting research lacking insight and creativity in social science. To address this issue, we propose "Memory-Augmented Social Simulation (MASS)”, an innovative paradigm that leverages highly realistic and research-oriented social simulations to the creativity and empirical founding of LLMs-generated research. Specifically, MASS integrates three core components—dynamic goal-path planning with multi-level social norm restraint to guide the simulation, a multi-disciplinary behavior dataset for agent memory cold-start, and a structured forgetting mechanism inspired by the Ebbinghaus curve. Together, these ensure simulation authenticity and provide a robust empirical foundation for generating innovative scholarly papers. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, showing a 6.81% improvement in generation overall quality over foundation LLMs and 17.19% gain in Insight over strong baselines. Dataset and codes will be released.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的深度研究智能体在自动撰写论文任务中展现出了非凡的潜力。然而，现有的系统主要依赖于互联网和本地知识库的文献检索与合成，这往往导致社会科学领域的研究缺乏洞察力和创造性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了“记忆增强社会模拟”这一创新方法。该方法利用高度真实且以研究为导向的社会模拟来激发语言模型生成研究的创造力和实证基础。具体来说，MASS整合了三个核心组件：通过多层社会规范约束来实现动态目标路径规划，为智能体记忆的冷启动提供多学科行为数据集，以及受埃宾豪斯曲线启发的结构化遗忘机制。这些组件共同确保了模拟的真实性，并为生成创新的学术论文提供了坚实的实证基础。实验结果表明，我们的方法非常有效，与基础语言模型相比，整体生成质量提升了6.81%，而洞察力则提高了17.19%。数据集和代码即将发布。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LS-Guard: Adaptive Safety Guardrails Tailored to Individual LLMs
papers.title_zh: LS-Guard：自适应安全防护机制，可根据不同的大型语言模型进行定制调整
papers.authors: Jinggui Liang, Lizi Liao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at diverse tasks, but remain vulnerable to malicious inputs such as jailbreak attacks. Current one-size-fits-all safety guardrails built from static datasets ignore each model’s unique safety profile and often force trade-offs between safety and utility. To address this gap, we propose LS-Guard, a framework for learning model-specific guardrails tailored to each LLM’s vulnerabilities. LS-Guard operates in two stages: First, it dynamically profiles a given LLM by probing it with malicious prompts to elicit the model’s responses, which are then dynamically labeled to reveal model-specific failure modes. Second, it uses this data to train a safety classifier with a collaborative multi-LoRA architecture. An orthogonality-constrained multi-task loss enables a central expert to learn general safety features while each subject-specific expert encodes the distinctive vulnerability patterns of one LLM. During inference, LS-Guard activates the central expert together with its model-specific expert to perform content moderation, yielding reliable safety decisions. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world LLMs demonstrate that LS-Guard significantly outperforms strong baseline guardrails, achieving superior robustness, adaptability, and generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多种任务中表现出色，但依然容易受到恶意输入的影响，比如越狱攻击。目前通用的安全防护措施都是基于静态数据集构建的，这些措施忽略了每个模型的独特安全特性，往往需要在安全性和实用性之间做出权衡。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了LS-Guard框架——该框架旨在为每种语言模型学习特定于其自身漏洞的安全防护措施。LS-Guard分为两个阶段：首先，它通过向模型发送恶意提示来动态分析该模型的响应，然后对这些响应进行动态标记，以揭示特定于该模型的故障模式。其次，利用这些数据训练出一个安全分类器，该分类器采用协作式多LoRA架构实现。通过正交约束的多任务损失函数，中心专家可以学习到通用的安全特征，而针对每个具体模型的专家则可以编码出该模型特有的脆弱性模式。在推理过程中，LS-Guard会同时激活中心专家和特定于该模型的专家，以实现内容审核，从而得出可靠的安全决策。在多个真实世界语言模型上的广泛实验表明，LS-Guard在鲁棒性、适应性和泛化能力方面均优于传统的强大基线防护措施。

papers.title: Rethinking LLM Watermark Detection in Black-Box Settings: A Non-Intrusive Third-Party Framework
papers.title_zh: 重新思考在黑盒环境下的大语言模型水印检测问题：一种非侵入式的第三方框架
papers.authors: Zhuoshang Wang, Yubing Ren, Yanan Cao, Fang Fang, Xiaoxue Li, Li Guo
papers.abstract: While watermarking serves as a critical mechanism for LLM provenance, existing secret-key schemes tightly couple detection with injection, requiring access to keys or provider-side scheme-specific detectors for verification. This dependency creates a fundamental barrier for real-world governance, as independent auditing becomes impossible without compromising model security or relying on the opaque claims of service providers. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce TTP-Detect, a pioneering black-box framework designed for non-intrusive, third-party watermark verification. By decoupling detection from injection, TTP-Detect reframes verification as a relative hypothesis testing problem. It employs a proxy model to amplify watermark-relevant signals and a suite of complementary relative measurements to assess the alignment of the query text with watermarked distributions. Extensive experiments across representative watermarking schemes, datasets and models demonstrate that TTP-Detect achieves superior detection performance and robustness against diverse attacks.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然水印技术是验证大语言模型来源的重要机制，但现有的秘密密钥方案会将检测与注入紧密绑定在一起，因此需要访问密钥或依赖服务提供方特定的检测器来进行验证。这种依赖性构成了现实世界治理中的一个根本障碍，因为如果不损害模型的安全性，或者不能依赖服务提供商不透明的声明，那么进行独立审计就变得不可能了。为了解决这一难题，我们提出了TTP-Detect这一开创性的黑盒框架，它旨在实现非侵入式的第三方水印验证。通过将检测与注入分离，TTP-Detect将验证问题重新定义为一种相对假设检验问题。该框架采用代理模型来放大与水印相关的信号，并借助一系列互补的相对测量方法来评估查询文本与水印分布之间的对齐程度。通过在不同代表的水印方案、数据集和模型上进行广泛实验，我们发现TTP-Detect在检测性能以及抵御各种攻击的能力方面都表现出色。

papers.title: Deputy: Accelerating Large Language Model Inference with Dynamic Low-Rank Substitution
papers.title_zh: 副主管：通过动态低秩替换技术加速大型语言模型的推理过程
papers.authors: Yuhua Zhou, Shichao Weng, Changhai Zhou, Yuhan Wu, Qian Qiao, Jun Gao, Fei Yang, Aimin Pan
papers.abstract: While the massive scale of modern LLMs enables remarkable performance, their static, input-agnostic computational graph incurs substantial resource wastage and high latency during inference. Existing dynamic schemes, such as early-exit and layer-drop reduce FLOPs but break batch processing or introduce KV-cache inconsistency. We propose Deputy, a dynamic low-rank substitution framework that employs a lightweight decision module at each layer to dynamically determine the execution branch for different tokens: Attention layers choose between full and low-rank computation to mitigate the KV cache issue, while FFN layers additionally support skipping to further reduce computation. We fine-tune the LLM with LoRA and then derive an additional low-rank matrix C via a least-squares fit \textbf{BC} \approx \textbf{W}_{\text{pre}}, where B is the shared LoRA matrix, so that only one extra low-rank matrix is introduced, effectively reducing memory overhead. Moreover, a hybrid KV cache strategy stores KV values generated by the low-rank branch, achieving a 38% reduction in cache storage. Experiments on Llama models demonstrate that Deputy reduces computation by approximately 40% compared to the original dense model while outperforming existing baseline methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然现代大语言模型在规模上的巨大优势使其能够展现出卓越的性能，但其静态、与输入无关的计算图在推理过程中会导致大量的资源消耗和高延迟。现有的动态方案，如提前退出和逐层跳过等方法虽然能减少计算量，但却会破坏批处理功能或导致KV缓存不一致的问题。我们提出了Deputy这一动态低秩替代框架，该框架在每个层次都采用轻量级决策模块来动态确定不同令牌的执行路径：注意力层可以选择全量计算或低秩计算来缓解这个问题，而FFN层则支持跳过某些步骤以进一步减少计算量。我们通过LoRA对大语言模型进行微调，然后通过最小二乘法得到一个额外的低秩矩阵C，即\(\textbf{BC} \approx \textbf{W}_{\text{pre}}\)，其中B是共享的LoRA矩阵，这样只需引入一个额外的低秩矩阵，从而有效降低内存开销。此外，我们还采用了一种混合KV缓存策略，用于存储由低秩分支生成的KV值，使得缓存存储量减少了38%。在Llama模型上的实验表明，与原始密集模型相比，Deputy将计算量减少了约40%，同时其性能也优于现有的基线方法。

papers.title: SGG-R^{\rm 3}: From Next-Token Prediction to End-to-End Unbiased Scene Graph Generation
papers.title_zh: SGG-R^{3）：从基于下一个节点的预测到端到端无偏见的场景图生成
papers.authors: Jiaye Feng, Qixiang Yin, Yuankun Liu, Tong Mo, Weiping Li
papers.abstract: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) structures visual scenes as graphs of objects and their relations. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced end-to-end SGG, current methods are hindered by both a lack of task-specific structured reasoning and the challenges of sparse, long-tailed relation distributions, resulting in incomplete scene graphs characterized by low recall and biased predictions. To address these issues, we introduce SGG-R^{\rm 3}, a structured reasoning framework that integrates task-specific Chain-of-Thought (CoT)-guided supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with group sequence policy optimization (GSPO), designed to engage in three sequential stages to achieve end-to-end unbiased scene graph generation. During the SFT phase, we propose a relation augmentation strategy by leveraging an MLLM and refined via embedding similarity filtering to alleviate relation sparsity. Subsequently, a stage-aligned reward scheme optimizes the procedural reasoning during RL. Specifically, we propose a novel dual-granularity reward which integrates fine-grained and coarse-grained relation rewards, simultaneously mitigating the long-tail issue via frequency-based adaptive weighting of predicates and improving relation coverage through semantic clustering. Experiments on two benchmarks show that SGG-R^{\rm 3} achieves superior performance compared to existing methods, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalization of the framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 场景图生成（SGG）将视觉场景表示为由对象及其关系构成的图结构。虽然多模态大语言模型在端到端的场景图生成方面取得了显著进展，但当前的方法仍受到缺乏特定任务结构化推理以及关系分布稀疏、尾部特征不明显等问题的限制，导致生成的场景图存在召回率低和预测偏差等问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了SGG-R^3框架。该框架结合了特定任务的思维链引导式监督微调与强化学习技术，并采用群体序列策略优化方法，通过三个连续的阶段实现无偏见的场景图生成。在监督微调阶段，我们提出了一种关系增强策略，利用大语言模型进行关系抽取，并通过嵌入相似性过滤来减轻关系稀疏性问题。随后，在强化学习阶段，我们采用了与阶段对齐的奖励机制来优化程序性推理。具体来说，我们提出了一种新型的双粒度奖励机制，同时整合了细粒度和粗粒度的关系奖励，通过基于频率的自适应权重分配来缓解尾部特征问题，并通过语义聚类来提高关系覆盖度。在两项基准测试上的实验表明，SGG-R^3在性能上优于现有方法，充分体现了该框架的有效性和通用性。

papers.title: Preserving Fairness and Safety in Quantized LLMs Through Critical Weight Protection
papers.title_zh: 在量化大型语言模型中保持公平与安全：通过关键权重保护机制实现
papers.authors: Muhammad Alif Al Hakim, Alfan Farizki Wicaksono, Fajri Koto
papers.abstract: Quantization is widely adopted to reduce the computational cost of large language models (LLMs); however, its implications for fairness and safety, particularly in dynamic quantization and multilingual contexts, remain underexplored. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of how static and dynamic quantization methods impact fairness and safety across benchmarks measuring intrinsic and extrinsic bias and safety alignment. For fairness, we evaluate English, French, Dutch, Spanish, and Turkish; for safety, we focus on English, Korean, and Arabic. Our findings reveal that quantization consistently degrades fairness and safety, with dynamic methods demonstrating greater stability than static ones. Moreover, fairness degradation varies across languages, while safety deterioration is especially pronounced in non-English settings. To address these risks, we introduce Critical Weight Protection, a novel technique that identifies and preserves fairness- and safety-critical weights during quantization. This approach mitigates bias and safety deterioration without costly retraining or alignment, maintaining trustworthiness while retaining efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 量化技术被广泛用于降低大语言模型的计算成本；然而，其在公平性和安全性方面的影响，尤其是在动态量化和多语言环境下，仍然没有得到充分研究。在这项研究中，我们对静态和动态量化方法在衡量内在偏见、外在偏见以及安全性对齐方面的公平性影响进行了系统分析。在公平性方面，我们评估了英语、法语、荷兰语、西班牙语和土耳其语；在安全性方面，我们重点关注了英语、韩语和阿拉伯语。我们的研究发现，量化技术会持续降低公平性和安全性，而动态量化方法比静态量化方法具有更高的稳定性。此外，公平性的下降因语言而异，而在非英语环境中，安全性的恶化尤为明显。为了应对这些风险，我们提出了“关键权重保护”这一新技术，该技术能够在量化过程中识别并保留对公平性和安全性至关重要的权重。这种方法可以在不进行昂贵的重新训练或对齐处理的情况下，减轻偏见和安全性的下降，同时保持模型的可靠性与效率。

papers.title: X-Router: Decoupling Knowledge and Reasoning for Cost-Effective LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: X-Router：将知识与推理过程分离，以实现高效的成本效益型大语言模型推理
papers.authors: Zixuan Wang, Yinze Ding, Zihan Wang, Jinyu Guo, Zhenhong Zhou, Junhao Dong, Chaomeng Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are often augmented with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, yet static “always-on” use is computationally wasteful. Existing adaptive methods typically optimize a single axis, overlooking that evidence need and reasoning depth are only partially correlated. We present , a dual-axis routing framework that separates retrieval necessity from reasoning necessity under a user-defined cost–quality trade-off. Offline, profiles four pipelines (Direct, RAG, CoT, RAG+CoT) and derives supervision by selecting the utility-maximizing strategy that trades answer quality against token usage and latency. Online, a compact dual-head router, conditioned on cost weights, uses lightweight probes—retrieval-score dispersion (NQC) and single-pass draft negative log-likelihood (NLL)—to decide whether to invoke RAG and/or CoT without sampling or model internals. Across six QA benchmarks, reduces token usage by up to 86% and latency by up to 84% while improving answer quality over strong baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常会结合检索增强生成和思维链提示技术来使用，但静态的“始终开启”模式会导致计算资源的浪费。现有的自适应方法往往只优化其中一个方面，而忽视了证据需求和推理深度之间只是部分相关的关系。我们提出了一种双轴路由框架，该框架在用户定义的成本与质量权衡下，分别考虑检索需求与推理需求。在离线模式下，我们测试了四种处理流程（直接检索、检索增强生成、思维链提示、检索增强生成+思维链提示），并通过选择能够最大化实用性的策略来为这些流程提供指导，这种策略会在答案质量、令牌使用量和延迟之间进行权衡。在在线模式下，一个紧凑的双头路由器会根据成本权重来决定是否调用检索增强生成和/或思维链提示，而无需采样或了解模型内部状态。在六个问答基准测试中，我们的系统将令牌使用量减少了高达86%，延迟减少了高达84%，同时提升了答案质量，优于一些强大的基线模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SPD-Faith Bench: Diagnosing and Improving Faithfulness in Chain-of-Thought for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SPD-信仰工作台：在多模态大型语言模型的思维链中识别和提升可靠性
papers.authors: Weijiang Lv, Yaoxuan Feng, Xiaobo Xia, Jiayu Wang, Yan Jing, Wenchao Chen, Bo Chen
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought reasoning is widely used to improve the interpretability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet the faithfulness of the generated reasoning traces remains unclear. Prior work has mainly focused on perceptual hallucinations, leaving reasoning level unfaithfulness underexplored. To isolate faithfulness from linguistic priors, we introduce SPD-Faith Bench, a diagnostic benchmark based on fine-grained image difference reasoning that enforces explicit visual comparison. Evaluations on state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal two systematic failure modes, perceptual blindness and perception-reasoning dissociation. We trace these failures to decaying visual attention and representation shifts in the residual stream. Guided by this analysis, we propose SAGE, a train-free visual evidence-calibrated framework that improves visual routing and aligns reasoning with perception. Our results highlight the importance of explicitly evaluating faithfulness beyond response correctness. Our benchmark and codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPD-Faith/.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链推理被广泛用于提高多模态大语言模型的可解释性，但生成的推理轨迹的可靠性仍不清楚。之前的研究主要集中在感知幻觉上，而对推理层面的可靠性则缺乏深入探索。为了将可靠性与语言先验分离开来，我们提出了SPD-Faith Bench这一诊断基准测试，该测试基于细粒度的图像差异推理，并强制进行明确的视觉比较。对最先进的MLLMs进行的评估发现，存在两种系统性故障模式：感知盲点和感知与推理的分离。我们认为这些故障源于视觉注意力的衰减以及残差流中的表示变化。基于这一分析，我们提出了SAGE框架——一个无需训练的、以视觉证据为校准的框架，它能够改善视觉路由功能，并将推理与感知相结合。我们的研究结果强调了明确评估可靠性的重要性，而不仅仅是响应的正确性。我们的基准测试和代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPD-Faith/获取。
