papers.title: HIPO: A Hierarchical Prompt Optimization Framework with Task Awareness and Fine-Grained Debugging
papers.title_zh: HIPO：一种具有任务感知功能且支持细粒度调试的层次化提示优化框架
papers.authors: Lu Qi, Lei Chai, Hongrui Yu, Binhang Qi, Hailong Sun
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse natural language processing tasks. However, their performance often hinges on carefully designed prompts, whose creation requires substantial human effort. While numerous automatic prompt optimization techniques have been proposed, existing methods typically apply the same prompt across all samples within a dataset, ignoring variation in sample difficulty. To address these limitations, we propose HIPO, a HIerarchical Prompt Optimization framework that shifts the paradigm from dataset-level to sample-level optimization. Our framework first employs a lightweight router model, trained offline, to predict the difficulty of each sample at test time. Based on this prediction, HIPO dynamically selects a prompt from a five-tiered hierarchy, tailoring complexity to sample difficulty. Furthermore, two refinement stages—Task Description Prompt Refine and Attribution-Based Prompt Refine—enhance generalizability and fine-grained optimization. Extensive experiments on 27 tasks demonstrate that HIPO outperforms all baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance on 25% more tasks than the strongest baseline. Cost analysis further demonstrates substantial efficiency gains, reducing API calls, token consumption, and overall cost by 1.2× to 80×. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/LuQiCode/HIPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多种自然语言处理任务中展现出了卓越的能力。然而，它们的性能往往依赖于精心设计的提示语，而这些提示语的创建需要大量的人力投入。虽然已经提出了许多自动优化提示语的方法，但现有方法通常会在整个数据集中使用相同的提示语，而忽略了样本难度的差异。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了HIPO——一个分层提示语优化框架，它将优化方式从数据集层面转移到了样本层面。我们的框架首先使用一个离线训练的轻量级路由模型来预测测试时每个样本的难度。基于这一预测，HIPO会从五个层次中选择一个合适的提示语，从而根据样本难度来调整复杂性。此外，还有两个细化阶段——任务描述提示语细化和基于归因的提示语细化——它们进一步提升了模型的泛化能力和精细化优化能力。在27个任务上的广泛实验表明，HIPO的性能优于所有基线模型，在25%更多的任务上取得了最先进的性能表现。成本分析也显示，HIPO在减少API调用次数、降低token消耗以及整体成本方面取得了显著的效率提升，成本降低了1.2倍到80倍。我们的实现代码可以在https://github.com/LuQiCode/HIPO上获取。

papers.title: MAPLE: A Meta-learning Framework for Cross-Prompt Essay Scoring
papers.title_zh: MAPLE：一种用于跨提示式文章评分的元学习框架
papers.authors: Salam Albatarni, May Bashendy, Sohaila Eltanbouly, Tamer Elsayed
papers.abstract: Automated Essay Scoring (AES) faces significant challenges in cross-prompt settings, where models must generalize to unseen writing prompts. To address this limitation, we propose MAPLE, a meta-learning framework that leverages prototypical networks to learn transferable representations across different writing prompts. Across three diverse datasets (ELLIPSE and ASAP (English), and LAILA (Arabic)), MAPLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on ELLIPSE and LAILA, outperforming strong baselines by 8.5 and 3 points in QWK, respectively. On ASAP, where prompts exhibit heterogeneous score ranges, MAPLE yields improvements on several traits, highlighting the strengths of our approach in unified scoring settings. Overall, our results demonstrate the potential of meta-learning for building robust cross-prompt AES systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动作文评分系统在跨提示场景中面临重大挑战，因为模型需要能够泛化到未见过的写作提示。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了MAPLE框架。该框架利用原型网络来学习在不同写作提示下的可迁移表示。在三个不同的数据集上（ELLIPSE和ASAP（英语），以及LAILA（阿拉伯语）），MAPLE在ELLIPSE和LAILA上的表现达到了最先进水平，分别比强大的基线模型高出8.5点和3点。在ASAP上，由于提示的评分范围具有多样性，MAPLE在多个指标上取得了改进，这凸显了我们的方法在统一评分场景中的优势。总体而言，我们的研究结果证明了元学习在构建稳健的跨提示自动作文评分系统方面的潜力。

papers.title: RACER: Retrieval-Augmented Contextual Rapid Speculative Decoding
papers.title_zh: RACER：基于检索增强的上下文式快速推理解码技术
papers.authors: Zihong Zhang, Zuchao Li, Lefei Zhang, Ping Wang, Hai Zhao
papers.abstract: Autoregressive decoding in Large Language Models (LLMs) generates one token per step, causing high inference latency. Speculative decoding (SD) mitigates this through a guess-and-verify strategy, but existing training-free variants face trade-offs: retrieval-based drafts break when no exact match exists, while logits-based drafts lack structural guidance. We propose \textbf{RACER} (\textbf{R}etrieval-\textbf{A}ugmented \textbf{C}ont\textbf{e}xtual \textbf{R}apid Speculative Decoding), a lightweight and training-free method that integrates retrieved exact patterns with logit-driven future cues. This unification supplies both reliable anchors and flexible extrapolation, yielding richer speculative drafts. Experiments on Spec-Bench, HumanEval, and MGSM-ZH demonstrate that RACER consistently accelerates inference, achieving more than 2\times speedup over autoregressive decoding, and outperforms prior training-free methods, offering a scalable, plug-and-play solution for efficient LLM decoding. Our source code is available at https://github.com/hkr04/RACER.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型（LLM）中，自回归解码方式每一步只生成一个标记，这会导致较高的推理延迟。推测解码通过“猜测-验证”策略来缓解这个问题，但现有的无需训练的变体存在权衡：基于检索的草稿在找不到精确匹配项时会失效，而基于逻辑变量的草稿则缺乏结构性的指导。我们提出了**RACER**（检索增强的上下文快速推测解码），这是一种轻量级且无需训练的方法，它将检索到的精确模式与逻辑变量驱动的未来线索相结合。这种结合既提供了可靠的基准，又赋予了灵活的外推能力，从而生成更丰富的推测性草稿。在Spec-Bench、HumanEval和MGSM-ZH上的实验表明，RACER能够持续提高推理效率，其速度比自回归解码快两倍以上，并且优于现有的无需训练的方法。它提供了一种可扩展且即插即用的解决方案，适用于高效的LLM解码。我们的源代码可以在https://github.com/hkr04/RACER下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PEC-Home: Interpretation of Progressively Elliptical Commands in Smart Homes
papers.title_zh: PEC-Home：智能住宅中逐步变椭圆形的指令解析
papers.authors: Yingyu Shan, Zeming Liu, Silin Li, Boao Qian, Jiashu Yao, Yuhang Guo, Haifeng Wang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have empowered home assistants with natural language interaction capabilities. However, current assistants overlook the progressive omission that occurs in human dialogue as shared context accumulates, leading to more elliptical expressions for efficient communication. Thus, current assistants still struggle to interpret such elliptical expressions accurately, which limits their effectiveness in real-world applications. In practical smart home scenarios, assistants face two major challenges caused by elliptical commands: (1) referential ambiguity caused by different environmental expectations among multiple users; and (2) intention ambiguity resulting from user preferences that evolve over time or change with the environment. To address these challenges, we introduce PEC-Home, the first simulated home dataset specifically designed for interpreting progressively elliptical commands in smart homes. Extensive experiments on various LLMs, including GPT-4o, show that existing home assistants struggle to execute user-intended operations based solely on elliptical commands. Even when equipped with tools for storing and retrieving user dialogue history, execution accuracy remains below that achieved with complete commands. Our code and dataset will be publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在大语言模型方面的进展，使得家庭助手具备了自然语言交互能力。然而，当前的助手在处理人类对话时存在一个问题：随着共享上下文的积累，对话内容变得越来越简略，导致表达方式更加模糊，难以实现高效沟通。因此，目前的助手仍然难以准确理解这些模糊的表达方式，这限制了它们在现实应用中的效果。在实际的智能家庭场景中，助手面临着两个主要挑战：一是由于不同用户之间的环境差异导致的指代模糊性；二是由于用户偏好随时间变化或环境变化而产生的意图不明确性。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了PEC-Home这一首个专为解读智能家庭中逐渐简略化的命令而设计的模拟家庭数据集。在多种语言模型上的广泛实验表明，现有的家庭助手仅依靠简略化的命令来执行用户的操作是远远不够的。即使配备了存储和检索用户对话历史数据的工具，其执行准确性仍然低于使用完整命令时的准确性。我们的代码和数据集将公开提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Towards IP Intelligence: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Intellectual Property Knowledge and Practice
papers.title_zh: 迈向知识产权智能分析：在知识产权知识与实践中对大型语言模型进行性能评估
papers.authors: Qiyao Wang, Guhong Chen, Hongbo Wang, Huaren Liu, Minghui Zhu, Zhifei Qin, Li Linwei, Yilin Yue, Shiqiang Wang, Jiayan Li, Wu Yihang, Ziqiang Liu, Longze Chen, Run Luo, Liyang Fan, Jiaming Li, Lei Zhang, Kan Xu, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Chengming Li, Shiwen Ni, Yuan Lin, Min Yang
papers.abstract: Intellectual Property (IP) is a highly specialized domain that integrates technical and legal knowledge, making it inherently complex and knowledge-intensive. Recent advancements in LLMs have demonstrated their potential to handle IP tasks, enabling more efficient analysis, understanding, and generation of IP-related content. However, existing datasets and benchmarks focus narrowly on patents or cover limited aspects of the IP field, lacking alignment with real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce IPBench, the first comprehensive IP task taxonomy and a large-scale bilingual benchmark encompassing 8 IP mechanisms and 20 distinct tasks, designed to evaluate LLMs in real-world IP practice. We benchmark 19 main LLMs, ranging from general purpose to domain-specific, including chat-oriented and reasoning-focused models, under zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought settings. Our results show that even the top-performing model, DeepSeek-V3, achieves only 75.8% accuracy, indicating significant room for improvement. Notably, open-source IP and law-oriented models lag behind closed-source general-purpose models. To foster future research, we publicly release IPBench, and will expand it with additional tasks to better reflect real-world complexities and support model advancements in the IP domain. We provide the data, code in the supplementary materials.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识产权是一个高度专业化的领域，它融合了技术和法律知识，因此本质上非常复杂且需要大量的专业知识。最近大语言模型在处理知识产权相关任务方面的进展表明，它们能够更高效地进行知识产权的分析、理解和生成相关内容。然而，现有的数据集和基准测试往往只关注专利这一方面，或者仅涵盖知识产权领域的部分内容，缺乏与现实世界场景的对接。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了IPBench——首个全面的知识产权任务分类体系以及大规模的双语基准测试平台。该平台涵盖了8种知识产权机制以及20种不同的任务类型，旨在评估大语言模型在实际知识产权实践中的表现。我们对19种主要的大语言模型进行了基准测试，这些模型包括通用型模型以及特定领域的模型，还包括以聊天为主或注重推理能力的模型。在零样本、少样本以及上下文推理等多种环境下进行测试后，我们的结果显示，即使是最优秀的模型DeepSeek-V3，其准确率也仅为75.8%，这表明还有很大的改进空间。值得注意的是，开源的知识产权和法律相关模型相比，闭源通用型模型则表现得更为出色。为了促进未来的研究发展，我们公开了IPBench，并计划通过添加更多任务来进一步完善该平台，以便更好地反映现实世界的复杂性，并支持模型在知识产权领域的进步。我们在补充材料中提供了相关数据代码。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EchoMLLM: Incentivizing Echocardiographic Video Understanding with Keyframe Grounding and Report Generation
papers.title_zh: EchoMLLM：通过关键帧定位与报告生成来激励对心脏超声视频数据的理解工作
papers.authors: Heyu Huang, Wanran Sun, Chi Chen, Bo Chen, Zonghao Guo, Yuhua Li, Ruixuan Li, Kunlun He, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Echocardiography analysis demands a dual capability: rigorous quantitative keyframe localization for evidence verification and comprehensive qualitative synthesis for diagnostic reporting. However, current Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle to meet these clinical requirements due to a misalignment with diagnostic workflows, a scarcity of video instruction data, and the critical challenge of cyclic temporal ambiguity—where the repetitive nature of cardiac cycles renders standard single-frame supervision ill-posed. To bridge this gap, we introduce EchoMLLM, a unified framework designed for real-world echocardiography video understanding. First, we align model capabilities with clinical needs by defining two fine-grained tasks: cycle- and pathology-conditioned keyframe grounding and video report generation. To facilitate this, we curate EchoMM-120k, a large-scale instruction dataset specifically constructed to support temporal localization and professional reporting. Furthermore, to resolve the cyclic ambiguity, we propose a multi-stage training paradigm incorporating a novel cycle-aware Reinforcement Learning (RL) strategy. By prioritizing logical consistency over rigid index matching, our approach moves beyond rote memorization to elicit invariant reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EchoMLLM reduces temporal grounding errors by up to 76% and improves report generation quality by 65% over its backbone, achieving state-of-the-art performance against both generalist and medical baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 心脏超声分析需要具备双重能力：一方面要能够进行严格的定量关键帧定位以验证证据；另一方面则需要进行全面的定性综合以生成诊断报告。然而，当前的多模态大语言模型在满足这些临床需求方面存在困难，原因包括与诊断工作流程的不匹配、视频指导数据的匮乏，以及周期性时间模糊性这一重大挑战——由于心脏周期的重复性特点，传统的单帧监督方法难以有效处理这一问题。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了EchoMLLM这一统一框架，旨在用于真实世界的心脏超声视频理解。首先，我们通过定义两个细粒度任务来使模型能力与临床需求相匹配：一个是基于周期和病理条件的关键帧定位，另一个是视频报告生成。为了促进这一进程，我们构建了一个名为EchoMM-120k的大规模指导数据集，该数据集专门设计用于支持时间定位和专业报告生成。此外，为了解决周期性时间模糊性问题，我们提出了一种多阶段训练范式，其中融入了一种新颖的基于周期意识的强化学习策略。通过优先考虑逻辑一致性而非僵化的索引匹配，我们的方法超越了机械记忆，实现了不变推理。大量实验表明，EchoMLLM在时间定位错误方面减少了76%，报告生成质量则提高了65%。与通用基准和医学基准相比，我们的性能达到了最先进的水平。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HAUNTATTACK: When Attack Follows Reasoning as a Shadow
papers.title_zh: HAUNTATTACK：当攻击行为遵循理性逻辑时，就像影子一样……
papers.authors: Jingyuan Ma, Rui Li, Zheng Li, Junfeng Liu, Heming Xia, Lei Sha, Zhifang Sui
papers.abstract: Emerging Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) consistently excel in mathematical and reasoning tasks, showcasing remarkable capabilities. However, the enhancement of reasoning abilities and the exposure of internal reasoning processes introduce new safety vulnerabilities. A critical question arises: when reasoning becomes intertwined with harmfulness, will LRMs become more vulnerable to jailbreaks in reasoning mode? To investigate this, we introduce HauntAttack, a novel and general-purpose black-box adversarial attack framework that systematically embeds harmful instructions into reasoning questions. Specifically, we modify key reasoning conditions in existing questions with harmful instructions, thereby constructing a reasoning pathway that guides the model step by step toward unsafe outputs. We evaluate HauntAttack on 11 LRMs and observe an average attack success rate of over 70%, achieving up to 13 percentage points of absolute improvement over the strongest prior baseline. Our further analysis reveals that even advanced safety-aligned models remain highly susceptible to reasoning-based attacks, offering insights into the urgent challenge of balancing reasoning capability and safety in future model development.
papers.abstract_zh: 新兴的大型推理模型在数学和推理任务中始终表现出色，展现了卓越的能力。然而，推理能力的提升以及内部推理过程的暴露带来了新的安全漏洞。一个关键问题是：当推理与危害性交织在一起时，大型推理模型是否会在推理模式下更容易受到攻击？为了研究这个问题，我们提出了HauntAttack这一新颖且通用的黑盒对抗性攻击框架。该框架能够系统地将有害指令嵌入到推理问题中。具体来说，我们通过在现有问题的关键推理条件中加入有害指令，从而构建一条引导模型逐步产生不安全输出的推理路径。我们在11个大型推理模型上进行了HauntAttack的测试，发现平均攻击成功率超过70%，与最强大的基线模型相比，取得了高达13个百分点的绝对改进。我们的进一步分析表明，即使是先进的符合安全性的模型也极易受到基于推理的攻击，这为我们未来在模型开发过程中平衡推理能力与安全性提供了重要启示。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rethinking Multiple-Choice Questions for RLVR: Unlocking Potential via Distractor Design
papers.title_zh: 重新思考用于RLVR的多项选择题设计：通过巧妙的干扰手段释放潜力
papers.authors: Xu Guo, Qiming Ge, Jian Tong, Kedi Chen, Jin Zhang, Xiaogui Yang, Xuan Gao, Haijun Lv, Zhihui Lu, Yicheng Zou, Qipeng Guo
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) significantly enhances the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models. When applied to RLVR, Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) offer a scalable source of verifiable data but risk inducing reward hacking, where models shortcut reasoning via random guessing or simple elimination. Current approaches often mitigate this by converting MCQs to open-ended formats, thereby discarding the contrastive signal provided by expert-designed distractors. In this work, we systematically investigate the impact of option design on RLVR. Our analysis highlights two primary insights: (1) Mismatches in option counts between training and testing degrade performance. (2) Strong distractors effectively mitigate random guessing, enabling effective RLVR training even with 2-way questions. Motivated by these findings, we propose Iterative Distractor Curation (IDC), a framework that actively constructs high-quality distractors to block elimination shortcuts and promote deep reasoning. Experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method effectively enhances distractor quality and yields significant gains in RLVR training compared to the original data.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了大语言模型的推理能力。在应用RLVR时，多项选择题作为一种可验证数据的来源具有很好的扩展性，但存在引发奖励作弊的风险——即模型通过随机猜测或简单排除法来绕过推理过程。目前的方法通常通过将多项选择题转换为开放式问题来规避这一问题，但这会丢失由专家设计的干扰项所提供的对比信号。在这项研究中，我们系统地探讨了选项设计对RLVR的影响。我们的分析得出了两个重要发现：(1) 训练集和测试集之间的选项数量不匹配会降低模型的性能。(2) 高质量的干扰项能够有效抑制随机猜测行为，使得即使使用双向问题也能进行有效的RLVR训练。基于这些发现，我们提出了迭代干扰项优化框架，该框架能够主动构建高质量的干扰项，以阻止排除法的使用并促进深度推理。在多个基准测试中的实验表明，与原始数据相比，我们的方法有效提高了干扰项的质量，并在RLVR训练中取得了显著的成效。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: S2ST-Omni: Hierarchical Language-Aware SpeechLLM Adaptation for Multilingual Speech-to-Speech Translation
papers.title_zh: S2ST-Omni：适用于多语言语音转文字翻译的层次化语言感知语音模型适配方法
papers.authors: Yu Pan, Xiongfei Wu, Yang Yuguang, Jixun Yao, Maxime Cordy, Lei Ma, Jianjun Zhao
papers.abstract: Despite recent advances in speech-to-speech translation (S2ST), it remains difficult to achieve both high translation accuracy and practical flexibility. In this paper, we present S2ST-Omni, a compositional S2ST framework that integrates a high-accuracy speech-to-text translation (S2TT) frontend with a modular, plug-and-play text-to-speech (TTS) backend, enabling independent optimization of translation and synthesis. On the S2TT side, we introduce a hybrid adapter that follows a “local-then-global” strategy to bridge the pretrained Whisper encoder and Qwen3 LLM, yielding a hierarchical acoustic-to-semantic abstraction. Building on this bridge, we further propose a hierarchical language-aware architecture that injects source-language information at two complementary levels. At the acoustic level, Language-Aware Dual-CTC operates on intermediate adapter features and employs FiLM-style feature modulation with a learnable gate, encouraging the model to learn language-specific but content-faithful acoustic representations. At the linguistic level, Language-Aware Prompting dynamically constructs source-language-conditioned prompts that activate language-specific translation knowledge in the LLM. To enable efficient optimization, we design a task-specific progressive fine-tuning strategy that first stabilizes speech-text alignment and then improves translation via LoRA on top of this converged foundation. The TTS backend remains fully modular and can be instantiated with any state-of-the-art synthesizer without retraining the S2TT frontend. Experiments on CVSS-C show that S2ST-Omni consistently achieves the best BLEU and ASR-BLEU across French, German, and Spanish to English directions, outperforming strong recent S2ST baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在语音到语音翻译领域取得了一些进展，但要同时实现高翻译准确性和实用性仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了S2ST-Omni框架，该框架将高精度的语音到文本翻译前端与模块化、即插即用的文本到语音后端相结合，从而能够独立优化翻译和合成过程。在语音到文本翻译方面，我们引入了一种混合适配器，采用“局部-全局”策略来连接预训练的Whisper编码器和Qwen3大语言模型，从而实现从声学到语义的层次化抽象。在此基础上，我们进一步提出了一种分层式的语言感知架构，在两种互补的层面注入源语言信息。在声学层面，语言感知双CTC算法对中间适配器特征进行处理，并采用FiLM风格的特征调制技术，同时具备可学习的门控机制，促使模型学习出具有语言特异性但内容忠实于原文的声学表示。在语言学层面，语言感知提示机制动态构建基于源语言的提示条件，激活大语言模型中与语言相关的翻译知识。为了实现高效的优化，我们设计了一种任务特定的渐进式微调策略：首先稳定语音与文本的对齐效果，然后在此基础上通过LoRA技术提升翻译质量。文本到语音后端保持完全模块化的特性，可以使用任何最先进的合成器进行实例化，而无需重新训练语音到文本翻译前端。在CVSS-C数据集上的实验表明，S2ST-Omni在法语、德语、西班牙语到英语的翻译任务中始终表现出最佳的BLEU分数和ASR-BLEU成绩，其性能优于当前最强的S2ST基准模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: G-LoRA: Global-Local Decoupled Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.title_zh: G-LoRA：全局与局部解耦的低阶自适应算法
papers.authors: Jiahao Xiong, Yihong Huang, Yihe Liu, Xianming Hu, Hongbo Zhao, Kai Zhang
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has achieved remarkable progress in improving the fine-tuning efficiency and downstream performance of large language models (LLMs). Although prior work has recognized that different weight update matrices \Delta \mathbf{W} exhibit varying importance and therefore should be allocated different ranks, parameters within the same update matrix are still typically constrained to a uniform rank configuration, neglecting fine-grained parameter-level heterogeneity. To address this limitation, we propose G-LoRA (Global-Local Decoupled LoRA), which decomposes each update matrix into global and local adapters. The key idea is to reorganize the rows and columns of the update matrix using a first-order Taylor approximation of parameter importance, such that highly influential parameters are clustered into a local sub-block of \Delta \mathbf{W}. During training, the local adapter then focuses on this high-importance sub-region and is allocated a higher rank, whereas the global adapter captures the residual updates for the entire update matrix with relatively lower rank. By allocating higher representational capacity to more critical parameters, G-LoRA enables more efficient utilization of model resources. Extensive evaluations on benchmarks spanning commonsense reasoning, mathematical reasoning, and code generation demonstrate that G-LoRA achieves up to 2.7% absolute accuracy improvement over LoRA and its variants, validating its effectiveness for LLM fine-tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）在提升大语言模型（LLM）的微调效率和下游性能方面取得了显著进展。尽管先前的研究已经认识到，不同的权重更新矩阵ΔW表现出不同的重要性，因此应该赋予它们不同的秩，但同一更新矩阵内的参数通常仍被限制为统一的秩配置，这忽略了参数级别的细微差异。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了G-LoRA（全局-局部解耦LoRA），它将每个更新矩阵分解为全局和局部适配器。其核心思想是利用参数重要性的一阶泰勒近似来重新组织更新矩阵的行和列，使得具有高度影响力的参数被集中到ΔW的局部子块中。在训练过程中，局部适配器会专注于这个高重要性子区域，并获得更高的秩；而全局适配器则负责处理整个更新矩阵的剩余更新，其秩相对较低。通过为更重要的参数分配更高的表示能力，G-LoRA能够更高效地利用模型资源。在常识推理、数学推理和代码生成等基准测试中的广泛评估表明，G-LoRA相比LoRA及其变体，可提升高达2.7%的绝对准确率，证明了其在LLM微调中的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Making MLLMs Blind: Adversarial Smuggling Attacks in MLLM Content Moderation
papers.title_zh: 使MLLM内容审核变得“盲目”：针对MLLM内容的对抗性篡改攻击
papers.authors: Zhiheng Li, Zongyang Ma, Yuntong Pan, Ziqi Zhang, Xiaolei Lv, Bo Li, Jun Gao, Jianing Zhang, Chunfeng Yuan, Bing Li, Weiming Hu
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly being deployed as automated content moderators. Within this landscape, we uncover a critical threat: Adversarial Smuggling Attacks. Unlike adversarial perturbations (for misclassification) and adversarial jailbreaks (for harmful output generation), adversarial smuggling exploits the Human-AI capability gap. It encodes harmful content into human-readable visual formats that remain AI-unreadable, thereby evading automated detection and enabling the dissemination of harmful content. We classify smuggling attacks into two pathways: (1) Perceptual Blindness, disrupting text recognition; and (2) Reasoning Blockade, inhibiting semantic understanding despite successful text recognition. To evaluate this threat, we constructed SmuggleBench, the first comprehensive benchmark comprising 1,700 adversarial smuggling attack instances. Evaluations on SmuggleBench reveal that both proprietary (e.g., GPT-5) and open-source (e.g., Qwen3-VL) SOTA models are vulnerable to this threat, producing Attack Success Rates (ASR) exceeding 90%. By analyzing the vulnerability through the lenses of perception and reasoning, we identify three root causes: the limited capabilities of vision encoders, the robustness gap in OCR, and the scarcity of domain-specific adversarial examples. We conduct a preliminary exploration of mitigation strategies, investigating the potential of test-time scaling (via CoT) and adversarial training (via SFT) to mitigate this threat.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型正被越来越多地用作自动内容审核工具。然而，在这一过程中，我们发现了一种严重的威胁：对抗性走私攻击。与对抗性扰动（导致分类错误）和对抗性越狱攻击不同，对抗性走私攻击利用了人与人工智能之间的能力差距。它会将有害内容编码成人类可阅读的视觉格式，而这些格式却无法被人工智能识别，从而逃避自动化检测，并使得有害内容得以传播。我们将这种走私攻击分为两类：（1）感知盲点，破坏文本识别功能；（2）推理阻塞，尽管文本识别成功，但阻碍了对语义的理解。为了评估这一威胁，我们构建了SmuggleBench，这是首个包含1700个对抗性走私攻击实例的综合性基准测试平台。在SmuggleBench上的测试表明，无论是专有模型（如GPT-5），还是开源模型（如Qwen3-VL），都容易受到这种威胁的影响，其攻击成功率超过90%。通过分析感知和推理方面的漏洞，我们发现三个根本原因：视觉编码器的能力有限、OCR领域的鲁棒性不足，以及特定领域对抗样本的稀缺性。我们还初步探讨了缓解策略，研究了在测试时进行扩展处理（通过CoT）以及对抗性训练（通过SFT）来减轻这一威胁的可能性。

papers.title: LatentRefusal: Latent-Signal Refusal for Unanswerable Text-to-SQL Queries
papers.title_zh: 潜在拒绝：对于无法解答的文本到SQL查询，采用潜在信号拒绝策略
papers.authors: Xuancheng Ren, Shijing Hu, Zhihui Lu, Jiangqi Huang, Qiang Duan
papers.abstract: In LLM-based Text-to-SQL systems, unanswerable and underspecified user queries may generate not only incorrect text but also executable programs that yield misleading results or violate safety constraints, thus posing a major barrier to safe deployment. Existing refusal strategies for such queries either rely on output-level instruction following, which is brittle due to model hallucinations, or on estimating output uncertainty, which adds complexity and overhead. To address this challenge, we first formalize safe refusal in Text-to-SQL systems as an answerability-gating problem, and then propose LatentRefusal, a latent-signal refusal mechanism that predicts query answerability from intermediate hidden activations of an LLM. We introduce the Tri-Residual Gated Encoder (TRGE), a lightweight probing architecture, to suppress schema noise and amplify sparse, localized question–schema mismatch cues that indicate unanswerability. Extensive empirical evaluations across diverse ambiguous and unanswerable settings, together with ablations and interpretability analyses, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme and show that LatentRefusal provides an attachable, efficient safety layer for Text-to-SQL systems. Across four benchmarks, LatentRefusal achieves an average F1 of 88.5% and 88.8% on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen-3-8B respectively, while adding ~2ms probe overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 在基于大语言模型的文本转SQL系统中，那些无法回答且描述不充分的用户查询不仅可能会生成错误的文本，还可能产生可执行程序，这些程序会得出误导性的结果或违反安全约束，从而成为安全部署的重大障碍。目前针对此类查询的拒绝策略要么依赖于输出级指令遵循机制，但由于模型幻觉的存在而存在脆弱性；要么依赖于估计输出不确定性，这会增加复杂性和开销。为了应对这一挑战，我们首先将文本转SQL系统中的安全拒绝问题形式化为一个可回答性门控问题，然后提出了LatentRefusal机制——这是一种潜在的拒绝机制，它能够从大语言模型的中间隐藏激活值中预测查询的可回答性。我们引入了Tri-Residual Gated Encoder（TRGE）这一轻量级探测架构，用于抑制模式噪声，并增强那些表明无法回答的稀疏、局部化的问答不匹配线索。通过在不同模糊且无法回答的场景中进行广泛的实证评估，以及进行消融分析和可解释性分析，证明了所提出方案的有效性。结果表明，LatentRefusal为文本转SQL系统提供了一个可附加且高效的安全层。在四个基准测试中，LatentRefusal在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen-3-8B上的平均F1分数分别达到了88.5%和88.8%，同时仅增加了约2毫秒的探测开销。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Where meaning lives: Layer-wise accessibility of psycholinguistic features in encoder and decoder language models
papers.title_zh: 意义的所在：编码器与解码器语言模型中心理语言学特性的分层可访问性
papers.authors: Taisiia Tikhomirova, Dirk U. Wulff
papers.abstract: Understanding where transformer language models encode psychologically meaningful aspects of meaning is essential for both theory and practice. We conduct a systematic layer-wise probing study of 58 psycholinguistic features across 10 transformer models, spanning encoder-only and decoder-only architectures, and compare three embedding extraction methods. We find that apparent localization of meaning is strongly method-dependent: contextualized embeddings yield higher feature-specific selectivity and different layer-wise profiles than isolated embeddings. Across models and methods, final-layer representations are rarely optimal for recovering psycholinguistic information with linear probes. Despite these differences, models exhibit a shared depth ordering of meaning dimensions, with lexical properties peaking earlier and experiential and affective dimensions peaking later. Together, these results show that where meaning “lives” in transformer models reflects an interaction between methodological choices and architectural constraints.
papers.abstract_zh: 了解Transformer语言模型在何处编码了具有心理意义的信息特征，对于理论和实践来说都是至关重要的。我们对10种Transformer模型中包含的58种心理语言学特征进行了系统的逐层探究，这些模型包括仅包含编码器或仅包含解码器的架构。同时，我们还比较了三种嵌入提取方法的效果。研究发现，意义的定位效果明显依赖于具体的方法：上下文化的嵌入方式能够产生更高程度的特征选择性，其逐层特征分布也与孤立嵌入的方式有所不同。无论是在哪种模型或方法中，最终层的表示往往无法用线性探测手段来有效恢复心理语言学信息。尽管存在这些差异，但模型在意义的维度排序上呈现出一致性：词汇属性在较早的阶段达到峰值，而经验性和情感性维度则出现在较晚的阶段。总的来说，这些结果表明，Transformer模型中意义的“所在位置”实际上反映了方法论选择与架构限制之间的相互作用。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: DynamicFocalPO: Adaptive Focusing Strategy for Preference Optimization
papers.title_zh: DynamicFocalPO：用于偏好优化的自适应聚焦策略
papers.authors: Shu Zhou, Junan Chen, Rui Ling, Xin Wang, Tao Fan, Hao Wang
papers.abstract: Recent preference optimization algorithms such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) have become prevalent for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. FocalPO improves upon DPO by introducing a modulating factor that down-weighs misranked preference pairs. However, using a fixed modulating factor throughout training is suboptimal, as the model’s learning capacity evolves during training. We introduce DynamicFocalPO, which employs a dynamic focusing strategy that adapts over the course of training. Inspired by curriculum learning, our method initially focuses on correctly ranked samples to establish a solid foundation, then gradually incorporates harder samples as training progresses. Experiments demonstrate that DynamicFocalPO surpasses both DPO and FocalPO on benchmarks including Alpaca Eval 2.0 and Arena-Hard using Mistral-Base-7B and Llama-3-Instruct-8B. We further provide theoretical analysis showing that the dynamic schedule enables adaptive entropy regularization and selective gradient suppression.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的一些偏好优化算法，如直接偏好优化（DPO），已经广泛应用于将大语言模型与人类偏好进行对齐。FocalPO在DPO的基础上进行了改进，引入了一个调节因子来减少排名错误的偏好对。然而，在整个训练过程中使用固定的调节因子并不是最优方案，因为模型的学习能力会在训练过程中发生变化。我们提出了动态FocalPO算法，该算法采用一种动态聚焦策略，能够随着训练的进行而进行调整。受课程学习的启发，我们的方法最初会专注于正确排序的样本以建立坚实的基础，然后随着训练的进行逐渐引入难度更高的样本。实验表明，动态FocalPO在包括Alpaca Eval 2.0和Arena-Hard在内的基准测试中均优于DPO和FocalPO。我们还提供了理论分析，证明这种动态调度方式能够实现自适应熵正则化和选择性梯度抑制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Graph-GRPO: Stabilizing Multi-Agent Topology Learning via Group Relative Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: 图式GRPO：通过群体相对策略优化来实现多智能体拓扑结构的稳定化
papers.authors: Yueyang Cang, Xiaoteng Zhang, Erlu Zhao, Zehua Ji, Yuhang Liu, Yuchen He, Zhiyuan Ning, Chen Yijun, Wenge Que, Li Shi
papers.abstract: Optimizing communication topology is fundamental to the efficiency and effectiveness of Large Language Model (LLM)-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS). While recent approaches utilize reinforcement learning to dynamically construct task-specific graphs, they typically rely on single-sample policy gradients with absolute rewards (e.g., binary correctness). This paradigm suffers from severe gradient variance and the credit assignment problem: simple queries yield non-informative positive rewards for suboptimal structures, while difficult queries often result in failures that provide no learning signal. To address these challenges, we propose Graph-GRPO, a novel topology optimization framework that integrates Group Relative Policy Optimization. Instead of evaluating a single topology in isolation, Graph-GRPO samples a group of diverse communication graphs for each query and computes the advantage of specific edges based on their relative performance within the group. By normalizing rewards across the sampled group, our method effectively mitigates the noise derived from task difficulty variance and enables fine-grained credit assignment. Extensive experiments on reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that Graph-GRPO significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior training stability and identifying critical communication pathways previously obscured by reward noise.
papers.abstract_zh: 优化通信拓扑结构对于基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的效率和效果至关重要。虽然最近的一些方法利用强化学习来动态构建特定任务的通信图，但这些方法通常依赖于单一样本的策略梯度算法，并且采用绝对奖励机制（例如，二元正确性奖励）。这种范式存在严重的梯度方差问题以及奖励分配难题：简单的查询可能会为次优的通信结构获得无意义的积极奖励，而复杂的查询则可能导致无法提供任何学习信号的失败结果。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Graph-GRPO这一新颖的拓扑优化框架，该框架结合了群体相对策略优化技术。与单独评估单个拓扑结构不同，Graph-GRPO针对每个查询选取一组多样化的通信图，并根据这些图在群体中的相对表现来计算特定边的优势值。通过在整个采样群体中统一奖励标准，我们的方法能够有效消除因任务难度差异而产生的噪声干扰，从而实现精细化的奖励分配。在推理和代码生成方面的广泛实验表明，Graph-GRPO显著优于现有的最佳基线方法，不仅实现了更稳定的训练效果，还能识别出那些被奖励噪声掩盖的关键通信路径。

papers.title: ReMedi: Reasoner for Medical Clinical Prediction
papers.title_zh: ReMedi：用于医疗临床预测的推理器
papers.authors: Yushi Cao, Yiming Chen, Hongchao Jiang, Hung-yi Lee, Robby T. Tan
papers.abstract: Predicting future clinical outcomes from electronic health records (EHR) remains challenging due to the complexity and heterogeneity of patient data. LLMs have shown strong potential for such predictive tasks, yet existing approaches mainly focus on enhancing medical knowledge through distillation or RAG while relying on the model’s internal ability to interpret contextual information. In this work, we present ReMedi (Reasoner for Medical Clinical Prediction), a framework for improving clinical outcome prediction from EHR. ReMedi generates rationale–answer pairs using a challenging sample regeneration mechanism for complex clinical questions, which leverages ground-truth answers as hints to enhance reasoning for further fine-tuning and preference tuning. ReMedi integrates ground-truth outcome guidance into the preference data construction loop, regenerating rationale-answer variants. By tuning on these rationale-answer pairs, the model improves its predictive performance. Experiments on multiple EHR prediction tasks demonstrate substantial gains of up to 19.9% over state-of-the-art baselines in terms of F1 score, underscoring ReMedi’s effectiveness in real-world clinical prediction.
papers.abstract_zh: 从电子健康记录中预测未来的临床结果仍然具有挑战性，因为患者数据的复杂性和异质性使得这一任务非常困难。大语言模型在预测任务上展现出强大的潜力，但现有的方法主要侧重于通过蒸馏或RAG技术来提升医学知识水平，而忽略了模型自身对上下文信息的处理能力。在这项研究中，我们提出了ReMedi——一个用于改善从电子健康记录中预测临床结果的框架。ReMedi利用一种复杂的样本再生机制，为复杂的临床问题生成推理结果与答案的配对关系。该机制以真实答案为线索，从而进一步优化推理过程，并进行微调。ReMedi还将真实结果信息整合到偏好数据构建过程中，从而生成新的推理结果与答案组合。通过对这些推理结果与答案进行调优，模型的预测性能得到了显著提升。在多个电子健康记录预测任务的实验中，与最先进的基线方法相比，ReMedi在F1分数方面取得了高达19.9%的显著提升，这充分证明了ReMedi在实际临床预测中的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: JX4MEI: Multimodal Semantically-Enhanced LLM for Joint Multimodal Emotion-Intent Explanation and Classification
papers.title_zh: JX4MEI：一种多模态语义增强的大型语言模型，适用于多模态情感与意图的联合解释与分类任务
papers.authors: YiJie Huang, Xiaocui Yang, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Yifei Zhang, Ning Yuan, Zhuoyue Jia, Wen Zhang
papers.abstract: Existing multimodal emotion and intent recognition tasks predominantly focus on classification, overlooking the underlying rationale and intrinsic connections between these states. Bridging this gap, we propose Joint Multimodal Emotion-Intent Explanation and Classification, JX4MEI, a novel task requiring the model to jointly predict emotion and intent, while generating natural language explanations for why they co-occur. To support this, we present XMEI-dataset, a large-scale benchmark of 15,461 multimodal samples spanning 7 emotion and 9 intent categories across text, audio, and visual modalities. Unlike prior works, our dataset provides fine-grained rationales for emotion, intent, and their causal interplay, curated via a rigorous pipeline involving Chain-of-Thought generation and strict human refinement to eliminate model artifacts. Furthermore, we propose XMEI-Qwen, a model equipped with a novel Language-Query Former (LQ-Former). By leveraging modality-specific captions as semantic queries, LQ-Former injects explicit semantic guidance into feature alignment, significantly enhancing reasoning capabilities. Empirical experiments demonstrate that XMEI-Qwen sets a new state-of-the-art on the JX4MEI task, outperforming competitive baselines in both prediction and explanation generation. Code: https://github.com/OrangeYeah1027/JX4MEI.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的多模态情绪与意图识别任务主要集中在分类上，而忽略了这些状态之间的内在逻辑和联系。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种名为Joint Multimodal Emotion-Intent Explanation and Classification（简称JX4MEI）的新方法。该方法要求模型同时预测情绪和意图，并生成自然语言解释，说明它们为何会同时出现。为了支持这一方法，我们构建了XMEI数据集，这是一个包含15,461个多模态样本的大规模基准数据集，这些样本涵盖了文本、音频和视觉三种模态中的7种情绪和9种意图类别。与以往的工作不同，我们的数据集提供了关于情绪、意图及其因果关系的详细解释，这些解释是通过严格的流程生成的，包括思维链生成和人类审核，以排除模型产生的错误结果。此外，我们还提出了XMEI-Qwen模型，该模型配备了新颖的语言查询前件模块。通过利用特定模态的标题作为语义查询，XMEI-Qwen能够向特征对齐过程中注入明确的语义指导，从而显著提升了推理能力。实验结果表明，XMEI-Qwen在JX4MEI任务上取得了新的最佳性能，无论是在预测还是解释生成方面都优于其他竞争模型。代码链接：https://github.com/OrangeYeah1027/JX4MEI。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Breaking the "Provable Security": Detecting Finite-Precision Artifacts in LLM-based Steganography via Low-Probability Vanishing
papers.title_zh: 打破“可证明的安全性”：通过低概率消失法检测基于大语言模型的隐写技术中的有限精度痕迹
papers.authors: Wenzhao Cao, Yaofei Wang, Donghui Hu
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models have fostered a new class of generative linguistic steganography, claim “provably secure” by theoretically aligning the steganographic distribution with the language model’s natural distribution. We challenge this premise by exposing Low-Probability Vanishing (LPV), an inevitable vulnerability arising from finite-precision arithmetic. To exploit this, we propose RRNs-HT, a novel steganalysis framework based on Representative Random Numbers and Hypothesis Testing, which transforms the detection task from semantic classification to a statistical audit of the sampling mechanism. Crucially, unlike previous work that contrasts machine text against human text, we validate our method in a rigorous homologous setting to strictly isolate sampling artifacts. Experiments demonstrate that RRNs-HT effectively breaks the security of AC and Meteor with high detection accuracy, whereas state-of-the-art semantic steganalyzers degrade to random guessing. Our findings prove that theoretical security is unattainable in practice without addressing finite-precision leakage.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展催生了一类新的生成性语言隐写技术。通过理论上将隐写分布与语言模型的自然分布进行对齐，这种技术被宣称具有“绝对安全性”。然而，我们挑战了这一假设，揭示了由有限精度计算导致的不可避免的漏洞——低概率消失现象。为了利用这一漏洞，我们提出了RRNs-HT这一新型隐写分析框架。该框架基于代表性随机数和假设检验原理，将检测任务从语义分类转变为对采样机制的统计审计。与以往将机器文本与人类文本进行对比的研究不同，我们在严格相似的环境中对该方法进行了验证，以有效隔离采样伪迹。实验表明，RRNs-HT能够高效地破解AC和Meteor等系统的加密机制，其检测准确率很高；而目前最先进的语义隐写分析工具则只能达到随机猜测的水平。我们的研究结果证明，如果不解决有限精度带来的泄漏问题，理论上的安全性在实践中是无法实现的。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FACT-E: Causality-Inspired Evaluation for Trustworthy Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.title_zh: FACT-E：基于因果关系评估的可靠链式推理方法
papers.authors: Yuxi Sun, Aoqi Zuo, Haotian Xie, Wei Gao, Mingming Gong, Jing Ma
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has improved LLM reasoning, but models often generate explanations that appear coherent while containing unfaithful intermediate steps. Existing self-evaluation approaches are prone to inherent biases: the model may confidently endorse coherence even when the step-to-step implication is not valid, leading to unreliable faithfulness evaluation. We propose FACT-E, a causality-inspired framework for evaluating CoT quality. FACT-E uses controlled perturbations as an instrumental signal to separate genuine step-to-step dependence from bias-driven artifacts, producing more reliable faithfulness estimates (intra-chain faithfulness). To select trustworthy trajectories, FACT-E jointly considers intra-chain faithfulness and CoT-to-answer consistency, ensuring that selected chains are both faithful internally and supportive of the correct final answer. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH, and CommonsenseQA show that FACT-E improves reasoning-trajectory selection and yields stronger in-context learning exemplars. FACT-E also reliably detects flawed reasoning under noisy conditions, providing a robust metric for trustworthy LLM reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链提示能够提升大语言模型的推理能力，但模型往往会产生看似连贯的解释，其中却包含不真实的中间步骤。现有的自我评估方法存在固有的偏见：即使各步骤之间的逻辑关系不成立，模型仍可能自信地认定解释是连贯的，从而导致不可靠的忠实度评估。我们提出了FACT-E这一基于因果关系的框架，用于评估思维链提示的质量。FACT-E利用可控的扰动作为信号，以区分真正的步骤间依赖关系与由偏见引起的虚假现象，从而得出更可靠的忠实度估计（链内忠实度）。为了选择可信的推理路径，FACT-E同时考虑链内忠实度和思维链与答案的一致性，确保所选的推理路径既具有内部忠实性，又能支持正确的最终答案。在GSM8K、MATH和CommonSenseQA上的实验表明，FACT-E能够改善推理路径的选择，并生成更具上下文学习能力的示例。此外，FACT-E在噪声环境下也能可靠地识别有缺陷的推理，为评估大语言模型的推理能力提供了可靠的指标。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DRIFT: Transferring Reasoning Priors for Efficient MLLM Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: DRIFT：用于高效微调MLLM的推理先验迁移技术
papers.authors: Chao Huang, Zeliang Zhang, Jiang Liu, Ximeng Sun, Jialian Wu, Xiaodong Yu, Ze Wang, Chenliang Xu, Emad Barsoum, Zicheng Liu
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress, yet their reasoning ability often lags behind strong text-only LLMs. Bridging this gap typically requires large-scale multimodal reasoning data or reinforcement learning, incurring substantial cost. An appealing alternative is parameter-space model merging between reasoning-enhanced LLMs and MLLMs, but we show that naive merging is fragile: its effectiveness varies widely across model families and can significantly degrade performance (e.g., for Qwen-based MLLMs). We propose Directional Reasoning Injection for Fine-Tuning (DRIFT), a lightweight method that transfers reasoning knowledge in the gradient space while preserving multimodal alignment. DRIFT precomputes a reasoning prior from the parameter differences between text-only reasoning experts and multimodal models, and uses it to bias gradients during supervised fine-tuning. This design retains the simplicity of standard SFT pipelines while enabling efficient and stable reasoning transfer. Experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, including MathVista and MathVerse, show that DRIFT consistently outperforms naive merging and standard SFT, and matches or surpasses training-intensive methods with substantially lower data and compute.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型已经取得了显著的进展，但其推理能力往往仍落后于仅基于文本的LLM。要弥补这一差距，通常需要大规模的多模态推理数据或强化学习，而这需要巨大的成本。一种有吸引力的替代方案是让基于推理增强的LLM与多模态大语言模型在参数空间上进行合并，但我们发现简单的合并方式并不稳定：其效果在不同模型家族之间差异很大，甚至可能导致性能显著下降（例如，对于基于Qwen的多模态大语言模型）。我们提出了一种名为“定向推理注入用于微调”的方法，这是一种轻量级技术，可以在保留多模态对齐的同时，将推理知识传递到梯度空间中。DRIFT方法会预先从仅基于文本的推理专家和多模态模型之间的参数差异中计算出一个推理先验，并在监督式微调过程中利用该先验来影响梯度更新。这种设计保持了标准SFT流程的简单性，同时实现了高效且稳定的推理传递。在包括MathVista和MathVerse在内的多模态推理基准测试中的实验表明，DRIFT始终优于简单的合并方式和标准的SFT方法，并且其所需的数据和计算资源也远远低于那些需要大量训练时间的方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in VLMs: Enhancing Visual Attention via Head-Wise Perturbation
papers.title_zh: 减轻虚拟现实中的幻觉：通过头部方向扰动提高视觉注意力
papers.authors: Zhenghua Wang, Yixin Wu, Feiran Zhang, Qi Qian, Changze Lv, Xuanjing Huang, Xiaoqing Zheng
papers.abstract: Vision–Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in tasks that require joint understanding of text and images. However, as many VLMs are built upon pre-trained large language models, they often over-rely on linguistic priors at the expense of visual features, causing persistent hallucinations. We observe that these hallucinations stem not only from insufficient visual attention but also from imbalanced activation profiles across attention heads, while hallucinated samples tend to disproportionately activate heads that fail to capture visual cues. To promote a more balanced attention distribution, we propose HWP, a strategy that incorporates head-wise attention perturbation via continuous multiplicative noise, coupled with a visual-guided loss focused on vision-sensitive text tokens. Beyond simply strengthening visual grounding, this design encourages a broader set of attention heads to engage with visual signals, thereby alleviating information loss caused by activation concentration on a few dominant heads. Consistent gains across different architectures and scales on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach in mitigating VLM hallucinations.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型在需要同时理解文本和图像的任务中表现出强大的能力。然而，由于许多视觉-语言模型都是基于预训练的大语言模型构建的，它们往往过度依赖语言先验知识，而忽视了视觉特征的作用，从而导致持续的幻觉现象。我们发现，这些幻觉不仅源于视觉注意力的不足，还源于不同注意力区域的激活分布不平衡。在产生幻觉的样本中，那些未能捕捉到视觉线索的注意力区域反而被过度激活。为了促进更平衡的注意力分布，我们提出了HWP策略：通过连续性的乘法噪声对各个注意力区域进行扰动，并结合一种以视觉敏感文本标记为目标的损失函数。这一设计不仅增强了视觉信息的处理能力，还促使更多的注意力区域与视觉信号进行互动，从而减轻因某些主要注意力区域过度激活而导致的信息丢失问题。在不同架构和不同规模上的测试结果表明，我们的方法在减少视觉-语言模型的幻觉现象方面具有显著的效果和鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Modeling Multi-Dimensional Cognitive States in Large Language Models under Cognitive Crowding
papers.title_zh: 在认知拥挤条件下，对大型语言模型中多维认知状态进行建模
papers.authors: Lin Zhong, Siyu Zhu, Zizhen Yuan, Jinhao Cui, Xinyang Zhao, Lingzhi Wang, Hao Chen, Qing Liao
papers.abstract: Modeling human cognitive states is essential for advanced artificial intelligence. Existing Large Language Models (LLMs) mainly address isolated tasks such as emotion analysis or stance detection, and fail to capture interactions among cognitive dimensions defined in psychology, including emotion, thinking style, stance, and intention. To bridge this gap, we construct CognitiveBench, the first benchmark with unified annotations across the above four dimensions. Experiments on CognitiveBench show that although LLMs perform well on single dimension tasks, their performance drops sharply in joint multi-dimensional modeling. Using Gromov-hyperbolicity analysis, we find that CognitiveBench exhibits a strong hierarchical structure. We attribute the performance bottleneck to “Cognitive Crowding”, where hierarchical cognitive states require exponential representational space, while the Euclidean space of LLMs grows only polynomially, causing representation overlap and degraded performance. To address this mismatch, we propose HyCoLLM, which models cognitive states in hyperbolic space and aligns LLM representations via Hyperbolic Guided Alignment Tuning. Results show that HyCoLLM substantially improves multi-dimensional cognitive understanding, allowing 8B parameter model to outperform strong baselines, including GPT-4o. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HycoLLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 对人类认知状态的建模对于先进人工智能至关重要。现有的大语言模型主要处理孤立任务，如情感分析或立场检测，却无法捕捉心理学中定义的各个认知维度之间的相互作用，包括情感、思维风格、立场和意图等。为了填补这一空白，我们构建了CognitiveBench，这是第一个在以上四个维度上提供统一注释的基准测试。在CognitiveBench上的实验表明，尽管大语言模型在单一维度任务上表现良好，但在多维联合建模时性能会急剧下降。通过Gromov超球体分析，我们发现CognitiveBench具有强烈的层次结构。我们将性能瓶颈归因于“认知拥挤现象”，即层次化的认知状态需要指数级的表示空间，而大语言模型的欧几里得空间仅以多项式方式增长，导致表示重叠和性能下降。为了解决这种不匹配问题，我们提出了HyCoLLM，它利用超球体空间来建模认知状态，并通过超球体引导对齐调优技术来对齐大语言模型的表示。结果表明，HyCoLLM显著提升了多维认知理解能力，使得拥有80亿参数模型能够超越包括GPT-4o在内的强大基线模型。我们的代码可以在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HycoLLM获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EmoMM: Benchmarking and Steering MLLM for Multimodal Emotion Recognition under Conflict and Missingness
papers.title_zh: EmoMM：在存在冲突和数据缺失的情况下，用于多模态情感识别的基准测试与引导方法研究
papers.authors: Yueru Sun, Yimeng Zhang, Haoyu Gu, Nuo Chen, Dong She, Xianrong Yao, Yang Gao, Zhanpeng Jin
papers.abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) is critical for interpreting real-world interactions. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM) have shown promise in MER, their internal decision-making mechanisms under modality conflict and missingness remain largely underexplored. In this paper, to systematically investigate these behaviors, we introduce EmoMM, a comprehensive benchmark featuring modality-aligned, conflict, and missing subsets. Through extensive evaluation, we uncover a Video Contribution Collapse (VCC) phenomenon, where MLLM marginalize video evidence due to high token redundancy and modality preferences. To address this, we propose Conflict-aware Head-level Attention Steering (CHASE), a lightweight mechanism that detects modality conflicts and performs inference-time attention steering, effectively mitigating decision bias without retraining the backbone. Experimental results demonstrate that CHASE consistently improves performance across various settings, significantly enhancing the reliability of MLLM in complex affective scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态情感识别技术对于解读现实世界中的互动行为至关重要。虽然多模态大语言模型在情感识别方面表现出一定的潜力，但其在不同模态之间发生冲突或数据缺失时的内部决策机制仍缺乏深入研究。在本文中，为了系统地探讨这些现象，我们提出了EmoMM这一综合基准测试，该测试包含了与不同模态相关的对齐、冲突以及缺失数据子集。通过广泛的评估，我们发现了一个名为“视频贡献崩溃”的现象：由于高token冗余性和模态偏好问题，多模态大语言模型会忽略视频中的信息。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“冲突感知的头部级注意力引导”的轻量级机制。该机制能够检测模态冲突，并在推理过程中进行注意力引导，从而有效减少决策偏差，而无需重新训练主干网络。实验结果表明，CHASE机制能够在各种情况下持续提升性能，显著提升了多模态大语言模型在复杂情感场景中的可靠性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Veri-R1: Toward Precise and Faithful Claim Verification via Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: Veri-R1：通过在线强化学习实现精确且可靠的声明验证
papers.authors: Qi He, Cheng Qian, Xiusi Chen, Bingxiang He, Yi R. Fung, Heng Ji
papers.abstract: Claim verification with large language models (LLMs) has recently attracted growing attention, due to their strong reasoning capabilities and transparent verification processes compared to traditional answer-only judgments. However, existing approaches to online claim verification, which requires iterative evidence retrieval and reasoning, still mainly rely on prompt engineering or pre-designed reasoning workflows, without unified training to improve necessary skills. Therefore, we introduce Veri-R1, an online reinforcement learning (RL) framework that enables an LLM to interact with a search engine and to receive reward signals that explicitly shape its planning, retrieval, and reasoning behaviors. The dynamic interaction between models and retrieval systems more accurately reflects real-world verification scenarios and fosters comprehensive verification skills. Empirical results show that Veri-R1 improves joint accuracy by up to 30% and doubles evidence score, often surpassing its larger-scale model counterparts. Ablation studies further reveal the impact of reward components, and the link between output logits and label accuracy. Our results highlight the effectiveness of online RL for precise and faithful claim verification, and provide a foundation for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型进行索赔验证近年来受到了越来越多的关注，因为它们具有强大的推理能力，且验证过程更加透明，相比传统的仅提供答案的评判方式而言具有明显优势。然而，现有的在线索赔验证方法仍然依赖于迭代式的证据检索和推理过程，这些方法主要依赖提示工程或预先设计的推理流程，缺乏统一的训练机制来提升相关技能。因此，我们提出了Veri-R1这一在线强化学习框架，该框架使大语言模型能够与搜索引擎交互，并接收能够明确影响其规划、检索和推理行为的奖励信号。模型与检索系统之间的动态互动能够更准确地反映现实世界的验证场景，从而培养全面的验证能力。实证结果表明，Veri-R1将联合验证的准确性提高了30%，同时使证据得分翻了一番，其性能通常优于同类大规模模型。进一步的消融研究揭示了奖励组件的影响，以及输出逻辑变量与标签准确性之间的联系。我们的研究结果凸显了在线强化学习在精确可靠的索赔验证方面的有效性，并为未来的研究提供了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MimicLM: Zero-Shot Voice Imitation through Autoregressive Modeling of Pseudo-Parallel Speech Corpora
papers.title_zh: MimicLM：通过自回归建模来实现零样本语音模仿技术
papers.authors: Tao Feng, Yuxiang Wang, Yuancheng Wang, Xueyao Zhang, Dekun Chen, Chaoren Wang, Xun Guan, Zhizheng Wu
papers.abstract: Voice imitation aims to transform source speech to match a reference speaker’s timbre and speaking style while preserving linguistic content. A straightforward approach is to train on triplets of (source, reference, target), where source and target share the same content but target matches the reference’s voice characteristics, yet such data is extremely scarce. Existing approaches either employ carefully designed disentanglement architectures to bypass this data scarcity or leverage external systems to synthesize pseudo-parallel training data. However, the former requires intricate model design, and the latter faces a quality ceiling when synthetic speech is used as training targets. To address these limitations, we propose MimicLM, which takes a novel approach by using synthetic speech as training sources while retaining real recordings as targets. This design enables the model to learn directly from real speech distributions, breaking the synthetic quality ceiling. Building on this data construction approach, we incorporate interleaved text-audio modeling to guide the generation of content-accurate speech and apply post-training with preference alignment to mitigate the inherent distributional mismatch when training on synthetic data. Experiments demonstrate that MimicLM achieves superior voice imitation quality with a simple yet effective architecture, significantly outperforming existing methods in naturalness while maintaining competitive similarity scores across speaker identity, accent, and emotion dimensions.
papers.abstract_zh: 语音模仿的目的是将源语音转化为与参考说话人的音色和说话风格相匹配的语音，同时保留语言内容。一种简单的方法是针对由（源语音、参考语音、目标语音）组成的三元组数据进行训练，其中源语音和目标语音的内容相同，但目标语音需要符合参考说话人的声音特征。然而，这种数据极其稀缺。现有的方法要么采用精心设计的分解架构来克服数据稀缺问题，要么利用外部系统合成伪并行训练数据。不过，前者需要复杂的模型设计，而后者在使用合成语音作为训练目标时，其合成语音的质量存在上限。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了MimicLM这一创新方法。该方法采用合成语音作为训练源，同时保留真实录音作为训练目标。这种设计使得模型能够直接从真实语音分布中学习，从而突破合成语音质量的限制。在此基础上，我们还采用了文本-音频混合建模方法来指导生成符合内容要求的语音，并在训练后通过偏好对齐技术来减轻在合成数据上进行训练时出现的分布不匹配问题。实验表明，MimicLM凭借简单而有效的架构，实现了卓越的语音模仿质量，在自然性方面明显优于现有方法，同时在说话人身份、口音和情感方面的相似性指标也表现出竞争力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Fine-Grained Data Ordering Improves Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 细粒度的数据排序有助于提升大型语言模型的调优效果
papers.authors: Xiaomeng Hu, Yixuan Tang, Haoze Li, Hao Chen, Qi Zhang, Zhanming Shen, Yiming Zhang, Haobo Wang, Junbo Zhao
papers.abstract: With the rapid progress of large language models (LLMs), aligning a general-purpose model with downstream tasks through fine-tuning has become a central research focus. Selecting only high-quality examples for training has been shown to be one of the most effective ways to improve fine-tuning performance. However, prior work concentrates almost exclusively on data preprocessing: filtering and cleaning data before training begins. While the order and composition of training data during training have received little fine-grained attention. To fill this gap, our work proposed Fine-Grained Order Fine-Tuning, a fine-grained scheduling method of data order in epochs. Drawing on curriculum-learning principles, FOT defines data difficulty based on the relevance between the data and the model, and then performs dynamic scheduling of the training order in each epoch according to the difficulty. On both large-scale continued pre-training and small-scale supervised fine-tuning experiments, FOT has achieved an average 2.4% improvement over baselines. Our study offers a new perspective on data governance in the fine-tuning phase.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，将通用模型通过微调与下游任务对齐已成为研究的重点。仅选择高质量样本进行训练已被证明是提高微调性能的有效方法之一。然而，以往的研究几乎完全集中在数据预处理上：在训练开始前对数据进行过滤和清洗。而训练过程中训练数据的顺序和组成却很少受到关注。为了填补这一空白，我们的研究提出了“细粒度顺序微调”方法，这是一种按周期对数据顺序进行细粒度调度的技术。该方法基于课程学习原理，根据数据与模型之间的相关性来定义数据的难度，然后根据难度情况在每个周期中动态调度训练顺序。在大规模持续预训练和小规模监督微调实验中，“细粒度顺序微调”方法均取得了相对于基准模型的2.4%的平均提升效果。我们的研究为微调阶段的数据管理提供了新的视角。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LifeSim: Long-Horizon User Life Simulator for Personalized Assistant Evaluation
papers.title_zh: LifeSim：适用于个性化助手评估的远程用户生活模拟器
papers.authors: Feiyu Duan, Xuanjing Huang, Zhongyu Wei
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has accelerated progress toward universal AI assistants. However, existing benchmarks for personalized assistants remain misaligned with real-world user-assistant interactions, failing to capture the complexity of external contexts and users’ cognitive states. To bridge this gap, we propose LifeSim, a user simulator that models user cognition through the Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) model within physical environments for coherent life trajectories generation, and simulates intention-driven user interactive behaviors. Based on LifeSim, we introduce LifeSim-Eval, a comprehensive benchmark for multi-scenario, long-horizon personalized assistance. LifeSim-Eval covers 8 life domains and 1,200 diverse scenarios, and adopts a multi-turn interactive method to assess models’ abilities to complete explicit and implicit intentions, recover user profiles, and produce high-quality responses. Under both single-scenario and long-horizon settings, our experiments reveal that current LLMs face significant limitations in handling implicit intention and long-term user preference modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展加速了通用人工智能助手的进步。然而，现有的个性化助手评估基准与现实世界中的用户与助手交互情况并不匹配，无法充分反映外部环境复杂性和用户的认知状态。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了LifeSim——一种用户模拟器，它通过物理环境中的信念-欲望-意图模型来模拟用户认知行为，从而生成连贯的生活轨迹，并模拟由意图驱动的用户互动行为。基于LifeSim，我们开发了LifeSim-Eval，这是一个针对多场景、长期个性化辅助任务的全面评估基准。LifeSim-Eval涵盖了8个生活领域和1200种不同场景，采用多轮交互方式来评估模型完成显性和隐性意图的能力、恢复用户信息以及生成高质量响应的能力。无论是在单一场景还是长期视角下，我们的实验表明，当前的LLM在处理隐式意图和长期用户偏好建模方面存在显著局限性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Interactive Semantic Parsing with Reinforcement Learning for Knowledge Graph Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 基于强化学习的交互式语义解析技术，用于知识图谱推理
papers.authors: Yurun Song, Xiangqing Shen, Jianfei Yu, Rui Xia
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success, their reliability in knowledge-intensive tasks is often compromised by factual hallucinations. Integrating Knowledge Graphs (KGs) addresses this issue; however, existing approaches typically rely on simple graph traversal.This paradigm decouples topological navigation from logical operations (e.g., temporal filtering, aggregation), leading to imprecise retrieval and heavy post-processing burdens.Although semantic parsing offers a solution by grounding reasoning in logical forms, it traditionally suffers from a dependency on scarce supervised annotations.To bridge this gap, we propose Interactive Semantic Parsing, a framework that formulates reasoning as the sequential generation of executable logical clauses. This design allows logical constraints to be dynamically interleaved with graph search, while optimizing via reinforcement learning with only final answer feedback eliminates the need for gold program annotations.To tackle the sparse reward challenge in the vast symbolic space, we introduce a distance-aware process reward to evaluate intermediate steps based on their topological proximity to the answer.Experimental results on WebQSP and CWQ demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly on complex queries, validating the effectiveness of our dense reward signal in enabling robust reasoning without supervision.Our code is available at https://github.com/NUSTM/ISP-KGR.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在知识密集型任务中取得了显著的成功，但其可靠性往往受到事实幻觉的影响。整合知识图谱可以解决这个问题，但现有的方法通常依赖于简单的图遍历方式。这种范式将拓扑导航与逻辑操作（如时间过滤、聚合）分离，导致检索结果不够精确，且需要大量的后处理工作。尽管语义解析通过将推理建立在逻辑形式之上提供了一种解决方案，但它传统上依赖于稀缺的监督注释。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了交互式语义解析框架，该框架将推理表述为可执行的逻辑子句的序列生成。这种设计允许逻辑约束与图搜索动态结合，同时通过强化学习优化，仅依靠最终答案反馈即可消除对黄金程序注释的需求。为了解决在庞大符号空间中奖励稀疏的问题，我们引入了一种基于距离感知的过程奖励机制，以根据与答案的拓扑接近程度来评估中间步骤。在WebQSP和CWQ上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在复杂查询上取得了最先进的性能，这验证了我们的密集奖励信号在无需监督的情况下实现稳健推理的有效性。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/NUSTM/ISP-KGR获取。

papers.title: CLewR: Curriculum Learning with Restarts for Machine Translation Preference Learning
papers.title_zh: CLewR：基于重启的课程学习方法在机器翻译偏好学习中的应用
papers.authors: Alexandra Dragomir, Florin Brad, Radu Tudor Ionescu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated competitive performance in zero-shot multilingual machine translation (MT). Some follow-up works further improved MT performance via preference optimization, but they leave a key aspect largely underexplored: the order in which data samples are given during training. We address this topic by integrating curriculum learning into various state-of-the-art preference optimization algorithms to boost MT performance. We introduce a novel curriculum learning strategy with restarts (CLewR), which reiterates easy-to-hard curriculum multiple times during training to effectively mitigate the catastrophic forgetting of easy examples. We demonstrate consistent gains across several model families (Gemma2, Qwen2.5, Llama3.1) and preference optimization techniques. We publicly release our code at https://github.com/alexandra-dragomir/CLewR.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在零样本多语言机器翻译任务中展现出了相当不错的性能。一些后续研究通过偏好优化进一步提升了翻译性能，但有一个关键方面尚未得到充分探索：在训练过程中数据样本的呈现顺序。我们通过将课程学习机制融入各种先进的偏好优化算法来解决这个问题，以提高翻译性能。我们提出了一种新颖的课程学习策略——重启课程学习（CLewR），该策略在训练过程中多次从简单到复杂的课程进行迭代，从而有效避免对简单例子的灾难性遗忘。我们在多个模型家族（如Gemma2、Qwen2.5、Llama3.1）以及不同的偏好优化技术下都取得了稳定的性能提升。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/alexandra-dragomir/CLewR网站上。

papers.title: Targeting the Needle, Ignoring the Haystack: Anchoring Crucial Cues for Evolving Scam Call Detection via an LLM-Assisted Classifier
papers.title_zh: 瞄准目标，忽略大量信息：利用LLM辅助分类器进行诈骗电话检测的关键策略
papers.authors: Tong Wu, Qinliang Su, Jianxing Yu, Bo Liang, Minhua Huang
papers.abstract: Automatic detection of fraudulent voice calls is essential for online service platforms but faces significant challenges due to the scarcity of labeled data and the continuous evolution of conversational contexts. Standard supervised methods often fail to generalize, as they tend to overfit to variable background narratives rather than capturing the core deceptive intent. In this paper, we propose a lightweight framework that anchors detection on Semantic Primitives, a set of stable, interpretable evidentiary cues derived from expert knowledge. Our approach decomposes the fraud detection task into two distinct stages: identifying the presence of these predefined semantic signals within the transcript, and deriving a final verdict through a logical combination of the detected cues. By explicitly prioritizing stable evidence over diverse conversational noise, this framework ensures that decisions are based on verifiable fraud tactics rather than spurious correlations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves superior robustness and efficiency compared to traditional baselines, particularly in scenarios with shifting service contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动检测欺诈性语音呼叫对于在线服务平台来说至关重要，但由于标注数据的稀缺以及对话情境的不断变化，这一任务面临着重大挑战。传统的监督式方法往往无法实现泛化能力，因为它们容易过度拟合于变化的背景信息，而未能捕捉到核心的欺诈意图。在本文中，我们提出了一个轻量级框架，该框架基于语义原语进行检测。语义原语是一组由专家知识衍生出的稳定、可解释的线索。我们的方法将欺诈检测任务分解为两个不同阶段：首先识别转录文本中是否存在这些预定义的语义信号；然后通过对这些信号进行逻辑组合，得出最终判断。通过明确优先处理稳定的证据而非多样化的对话噪声，该框架确保决策基于可验证的欺诈手段，而非虚假的相关性。实验结果表明，与传统的基线方法相比，我们的方法在应对不断变化的服务情境时具有更高的鲁棒性和效率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Distributional Alignment for Large Language Models under Domain Shift
papers.title_zh: 在领域迁移情况下，大型语言模型的分布对齐问题
papers.authors: Viet Thanh Pham, Lizhen Qu, Zhuang Li, Gholamreza Haffari
papers.abstract: Distributional alignment enables large language models (LLMs) to predict how a target population distributes its responses across answer options, rather than collapsing disagreement into a single consensus answer. However, existing LLM-based distribution prediction is often unstable and degrades under cultural and domain shift. Token score-based estimates can change with minor option wording or formatting, response sampling-based estimates are expensive and sensitive to prompts and decoding settings, and directly generated distributions are frequently miscalibrated.We propose Evi-DA, an evidence-based alignment technique that improves the fidelity and robustness of LLM-based distribution estimation under domain and cultural shift. Given a target country and a multiple-choice question, Evi-DA retrieves related World Values Survey items and their answer distributions, predicts a coarse Welzel value signature for each option, and infers the country-conditioned answer distribution in a structured format. We train the LLMs using a two-stage pipeline, where reinforcement learning optimizes survey-derived rewards that encourage accurate intermediate value predictions, faithful final distributions, well-formed structured outputs, and reduced cultural bias. Across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks and multiple open-source backbones, Evi-DA reduces Jensen-Shannon divergence between predicted and gold distributions relative to strong baselines, with average relative improvements of up to 44%.
papers.abstract_zh: 分布对齐技术使得大语言模型能够预测目标群体在多个答案选项之间的反应分布情况，而不是将不同意见合并为单一的共识答案。然而，现有的基于语言模型的分布预测方法往往不稳定，且在文化和领域变化的情况下表现不佳。基于词元得分的估计可能会因为选项的表述或格式上的微小差异而改变；基于样本生成的估计则成本较高，且对提示和解码设置非常敏感；而直接生成的分布也常常存在校准误差。我们提出了Evi-DA这一基于证据的对齐技术，它能够提高语言模型在跨文化和领域变化情况下的分布估计的准确性和鲁棒性。给定一个国家和一个选择题，Evi-DA会检索相关的世界价值观调查数据以及各选项的回答分布，为每个选项预测出一个大致的Welzel值特征，并以结构化格式推断出该国家条件下的回答分布。我们采用两阶段流程来训练语言模型：强化学习环节优化由调查数据生成的奖励机制，以鼓励准确的中间值预测、忠实的最终分布、结构化的输出结果，以及减少文化偏见。通过跨领域和跨领域的基准测试，以及多种开源模型对比，我们发现Evi-DA能够将预测分布与真实分布之间的Jensen-Shannon散度降低到接近基准模型的水平，平均相对改进幅度达到了44%。

papers.title: Traces in the Brain: Neural Evidence for Syntactic Movement in English and Chinese
papers.title_zh: 大脑中的痕迹：关于英语和汉语中语法行为的神经证据
papers.authors: Yuhan Huang, Zhengwu Ma, Yuqi Jin, Beth Chan, Zheng Shen, Jackie Yan-Ki Lai, John T. Hale, Jixing Li
papers.abstract: Syntactic movement is a core concept in generative linguistics to account for word-order variation and long-distance dependencies, but its psychological and neurobiological status remains debated. Here, we test the neural reality of movement in English and Chinese by correlating brain activity during naturalistic listening with syntactic node counts, traces and word embeddings derived from X-bar style tree annotations. We find that deep structure significantly predicts neural responses in English but not in Chinese, providing partial support for movement-based accounts while revealing clear cross-linguistic differences.
papers.abstract_zh: 句法运动是在生成语言学中的一个核心概念，用于解释词序变化和远距离依存关系。不过，其心理和神经生物学层面的本质仍然存在争议。在这项研究中，我们通过将自然听力过程中的大脑活动与句法节点数量、句法轨迹以及从X-bar风格树结构注释中得到的词嵌入数据进行关联分析，来探讨英语和汉语中句法运动的神经现实性。研究发现，深层结构在预测英语中的神经反应方面具有显著效果，而在汉语中则没有这种效果。这一发现为基于句法运动的理论提供了部分支持，同时也揭示了不同语言之间的明显差异。

papers.title: LinguaGame: A Linguistically Grounded Game-Theoretic Paradigm for Multi-Agent Dialogue Generation
papers.title_zh: LinguaGame：一种基于语言学的多智能体对话生成框架
papers.authors: Yuxiao Ye, Yiming Zhang, Yiran Rex Ma, Huiyuan Xie, Huining Zhu, Zhiyuan Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled Multi-Agent Systems (MASs) where agents interact through natural language to solve complex tasks or simulate multi-party dialogues. Recent work on LLM-based MASs has mainly focused on architecture design, such as role assignment and workflow orchestration. In contrast, this paper targets the interaction process itself, aiming to improve agents’ communication efficiency by helping them convey their intended meaning more effectively through language. To this end, we propose LinguaGame, a linguistically-grounded game-theoretic paradigm for multi-agent dialogue generation. Our approach models dialogue as a signalling game over communicative intents and strategies, solved with a training-free equilibrium approximation algorithm for inference-time decision adjustment. Unlike prior game-theoretic MASs, whose game designs are often tightly coupled with task-specific objectives, our framework relies on linguistically informed reasoning with minimal task-specific coupling. Specifically, it treats dialogue as intentional and strategic communication, requiring agents to infer what others aim to achieve (intents) and how they pursue those goals (strategies). We evaluate our framework in simulated courtroom proceedings and debates, with human expert assessments showing significant gains in communication efficiency. We release our code and data on GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）使得多智能体系统（MAS）成为可能，其中智能体通过自然语言进行交互，以解决复杂任务或模拟多方对话。近期关于基于LLM的多智能体系统的研究主要集中在架构设计上，例如角色分配和工作流程的协调。而本文则关注于交互过程本身，旨在通过帮助智能体更有效地用语言传达其意图，从而提高它们的沟通效率。为此，我们提出了LinguaGame这一基于语言学原理的游戏理论框架，用于多智能体对话生成。我们的方法将对话建模为一场关于沟通意图和策略的信号传递游戏，并采用一种无需训练的均衡近似算法来进行推理时的决策调整。与以往那些游戏设计往往与特定任务目标紧密耦合的多智能体系统不同，我们的框架依赖于基于语言的推理方式，且对特定任务的耦合程度极低。具体来说，我们将对话视为有目的且具有策略性的沟通行为，要求智能体能够推断出其他智能体的目标以及它们如何实现这些目标。我们在模拟的法庭程序和辩论中评估了我们的框架，人类专家评估显示，该框架在沟通效率方面取得了显著提升。我们的代码和数据已发布在GitHub上。

papers.title: A Dual-View Analysis of Multiple Languages in Colonial Newspapers
papers.title_zh: 对殖民时期报纸中多种语言的双视角分析
papers.authors: Zhan Su, Xiaoya Chen, Fengran Mo, Ida L. Vos, Prayag Tiwari, Yazhou Zhang, Qian Zheng, Natália da Silva Perez
papers.abstract: Historical newspapers from the colonial period offer valuable evidence of how racializing language evolved over time. However, there are challenges in studying this type of historical data: 1) Data scarcity: acquiring large, annotated historical datasets is difficult, hindering the possibility of analyzing racialization comprehensively; 2) Digitized materials frequently contain Optical Character Recognition (OCR) errors and other types of noise that complicate text extraction and computational analysis; 3) Colonial newspapers are often multilingual and written in archaic prose, hindering the effectiveness of NLP tools developed for modern, single language texts. This paper addresses these challenges by conducting a dual-view, jointly studying multilingual event extraction and temporal semantic shift tasks. Specifically, we introduce a contextual question answering (CQA) and a visual question answering (VQA) derived from eighteenth- and nineteenth-century colonial newspapers. Content-wise, we focus on how enslaved people were described by enslavers as well as how they articulated their own condition through QA pairs of newspapers written in Dutch, English-French, and Spanish. Our results show that LLMs are still limited for low-resource VQA tasks. For temporal semantic change, we train temporal word embedding with a compass. The study concludes that racialization is a fluid process of linguistic recalibration where the decline of slavery merely shifted the language of control onto new categories of labor and identity.
papers.abstract_zh: 殖民时期的历史报纸为研究语言中的种族化现象随时间如何演变提供了宝贵的证据。然而，研究这类历史数据面临着一些挑战：1）数据稀缺性：获取大量且带有注释的历史数据集非常困难，这阻碍了全面分析种族化的可能性；2）数字化材料常常包含光学字符识别错误以及其他类型的噪声，这些都会使文本提取和计算分析变得复杂；3）殖民时期的报纸通常是多语言的，并且采用古老的文风书写，这影响了为现代单语言文本开发的自然语言处理工具的效果。本文通过进行双视角研究来应对这些挑战，同时探讨了多语言事件提取和时间语义变化任务。具体来说，我们借鉴了18至19世纪殖民时期报纸中的上下文问答和视觉问答技术。在内容方面，我们重点关注奴隶主如何描述奴隶，以及奴隶们如何通过用荷兰语、英语-法语和西班牙语撰写的报纸中的问答对来表达自己的处境。我们的研究结果表明，大语言模型在处理低资源水平的视觉问答任务时仍然存在局限性。对于时间语义变化的研究，我们采用了带有指南针形状的时间词嵌入方法。总体而言，种族化是一个动态的语言重新校准过程，奴隶制的衰落只是将控制语言转移到了新的劳动和身份类别上。

papers.title: CARE-CR: Context-Aware Routing and Expert Fusion for Multi-Preference Cognitive Restructuring
papers.title_zh: CARE-CR：基于上下文感知的路由选择以及多偏好认知重构中的专家知识融合技术
papers.authors: Hongzhi Qi, Liangcheng Wang, Yijing YU, Jianqiang Li, Bing Xiang Yang, Qing Zhao
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising avenues for automated cognitive restructuring in mental health settings, current approaches predominantly focus on superficial positive reframing and lack the adaptability to balance conflicting therapeutic dimensions, such as empathy and rationality. To address these deficiencies, we propose CARE-CR, a context-aware framework that implements a decoupled optimization paradigm. We first train expert policies specialized for distinct therapeutic attributes rather than relying on a monolithic alignment strategy. To mitigate expert data scarcity, we introduce Dimension-Guided Hierarchical Monte Carlo Tree Search (DG-HMCTS) for data-efficient preference augmentation. At inference, a context-aware routing module dynamically predicts optimal preference weights to fuse expert outputs based on the user’s specific distress context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CARE-CR achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines across multiple evaluation dimensions, including diagnostic accuracy, contextual appropriateness, task effectiveness, and overall helpfulness, while enabling controllable cognitive restructuring generation. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/HongzhiQ/CARE-CR.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型为在心理健康领域实现自动认知重构提供了有前景的途径，但目前的方法主要集中在表面的积极重构上，缺乏平衡不同治疗维度（如同理心和理性）的适应性。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了CARE-CR这一基于上下文感知的框架，该框架采用了一种解耦的优化策略。我们首先训练针对不同治疗属性而专门设计的专家策略，而不是依赖单一的对齐策略。为了缓解专家数据的稀缺问题，我们引入了基于维度的分层蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，以实现高效的数据驱动的偏好增强。在推理阶段，一个基于上下文感知的路由模块能够动态预测最优的偏好权重，以根据用户的具体痛苦状况来融合专家的输出结果。大量实验表明，CARE-CR在多个评估指标上均取得了显著的改进，包括诊断准确性、情境适应性、任务效果以及整体实用性，同时还能实现可控的认知重构生成。该数据集和代码可在https://github.com/HongzhiQ/CARE-CR上获取。

papers.title: EvoCoT: Overcoming the Exploration Bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
papers.title_zh: EvoCoT：突破强化学习中的探索瓶颈，以推动大型语言模型的发展
papers.authors: Huanyu Liu, Jia Li, Yihong Dong, Chang Yu, Taozhi Chen, Lecheng Wang, Yongding Tao, Bin Gu, Ge Li
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) has become a promising paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs) to improve their reasoning capability. However, when the rollout accuracy is low on hard problems, the reward becomes sparse, limiting learning efficiency and causing exploration bottlenecks. Existing approaches either rely on teacher models for distillation or filter out difficult problems, which limits scalability or restricts reasoning improvement through exploration.We propose EvoCoT, a self-evolving curriculum learning framework based on two-stage chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning optimization. EvoCoT constrains the exploration space by self-generating and verifying CoT trajectories, then gradually shortens CoT steps to expand the space in a controlled way. The framework enables LLMs to stably learn from initially unsolved hard problems under sparse rewards. We apply EvoCoT to multiple LLM families, including Qwen, DeepSeek, and Llama. Experiments show that EvoCoT enables LLMs to solve previously unsolved problems, improves reasoning capability without external CoT supervision, and is compatible with various RL fine-tuning methods. We release the source code to support future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的一种有前景的方法。然而，在难题上，当模型的部署准确率较低时，奖励就会变得稀疏，这会限制学习效率并导致探索瓶颈的出现。现有的方法要么依赖教师模型进行蒸馏，要么过滤掉困难问题，这既限制了可扩展性，也限制了通过探索来提升推理能力的效果。我们提出了EvoCoT框架，这是一种基于两阶段思维链优化技术的自进化课程学习框架。EvoCoT通过自生成和验证思维链轨迹来限制探索空间，然后逐步缩短思维链的步骤，以可控的方式扩展探索空间。该框架使LLM能够在奖励稀疏的情况下稳定地学习最初无法解决的难题。我们将EvoCoT应用于多个LLM家族，包括Qwen、DeepSeek和Llama。实验表明，EvoCoT能够帮助LLM解决以前无法解决的问题，无需外部思维链监督就能提升推理能力，并且与各种强化学习微调方法兼容。我们已发布源代码，以支持未来的研究。

papers.title: Context as a Tool: Context Management for Long-Horizon SWE-Agents
papers.title_zh: 作为工具的上下文：针对长期视角下的软件工程-Agent的上下文管理
papers.authors: Shukai Liu, Bo Jiang, Jian Yang, Yizhi LI, Jinyang Guo, Xianglong Liu, Bryan Dai
papers.abstract: Agents based on large language models have recently shown strong potential on real-world software engineering (SWE) tasks that require long-horizon interaction with repository-scale codebases. However, most existing agents rely on append-only context maintenance or passively triggered compression heuristics, which often lead to context explosion, semantic drift, and degraded reasoning in long-running interactions. We propose Cat, a new context management paradigm that elevates context maintenance to a callable tool integrated into the decision-making process of agents. Cat formalizes a structured context workspace consisting of stable task semantics, condensed long-term memory, and high-fidelity short-term interactions, and enables agents to proactively compress historical trajectories into actionable summaries at appropriate milestones. To support context management for SWE-agents, we propose a trajectory-level supervision framework, CaT-Generator, based on an offline data construction pipeline that injects context-management actions into complete interaction trajectories. Using this framework, we train a context-aware model, SWE-Compressor. Experiments on SWE-Bench-Verified demonstrate that SWE-Compressor reaches a 57.6% solved rate and significantly outperforms ReAct-based agents and static compression baselines, while maintaining stable and scalable long-horizon reasoning under a bounded context budget.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体在需要长期与大规模代码库进行交互的实际软件工程任务中展现出强大的潜力。然而，目前大多数智能体都依赖于仅能追加信息的上下文维护机制，或者依赖被动触发的压缩算法，这些方式往往会导致上下文爆炸、语义漂移以及长时间交互中的推理能力下降。我们提出了Cat这一新的上下文管理范式，它将上下文维护提升为一个可调用的工具，并整合到智能体的决策过程中。Cat定义了一个结构化的上下文工作空间，包括稳定的任务语义、高效的长期记忆以及高保真度的短期交互功能，使得智能体能够在适当的时间点主动将历史数据压缩成可操作的摘要。为了支持软件工程智能体的上下文管理，我们提出了一种基于离线数据构建流程的轨迹级监督框架CaT-Generator，该框架将上下文管理操作注入到完整的交互轨迹中。利用这一框架，我们训练出了一个具备上下文感知能力的模型——SWE-Compressor。在SWE-Bench-Verified上的实验表明，SWE-Compressor的解决率达到了57.6%，显著优于基于ReAct的智能体和静态压缩基线算法，同时还能在有限的上下文预算下实现稳定且可扩展的长期推理能力。

papers.title: Beyond Static Profiles: Capturing the Fluidity of User Preferences in Diverse Scenarios
papers.title_zh: 超越静态配置文件：在多种场景中捕捉用户偏好的多样性
papers.authors: Chunyang Gao, Yi Huang, Jingyu Yao, Xiaoting Wu, Junlan Feng
papers.abstract: Despite the remarkable evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) from simple assistants to versatile agents, effective personalization remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches often treat user preferences as static or merely time-varying traits, overlooking the dynamic nature of human behavior: preferences can shift, and even conflict, depending on context. To address this limitation, we propose a fine-grained taxonomy to differentiate between stable preferences, which are context-agnostic, and situational preferences, which are context-dependent. Building on this taxonomy, we introduce S2Pref, a new dataset of 10k meticulously curated entries. Each entry is grounded in a multi-turn dialogue that implicitly manifests either a stable or a situational preference, as defined by our hierarchical taxonomy. We further design three complementary evaluation tasks to benchmark LLMs on their ability to prioritize contextual signals, proactively resolve ambiguity, and efficiently infer user preferences. Our dataset and diagnostic tasks provide a practical testbed for advancing dynamic, context-aware personalization in conversational agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型从简单的助手发展成了功能丰富的智能体，但实现有效的个性化仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的方法往往将用户偏好视为静态或仅随时间变化的特性，而忽视了人类行为的动态性：用户偏好可能会随着情境的变化而变化，甚至产生冲突。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种细粒度的分类体系，以区分那些与情境无关的稳定偏好和那些依赖于具体情境的情境偏好。基于这一分类体系，我们推出了S2Pref数据集，该数据集包含10,000条精心挑选的条目。每条条目都源自多轮对话，这些对话会隐式地体现出稳定偏好或情境偏好，而这两种偏好都是根据我们的分层分类体系来定义的。我们还设计了三个互补的评估任务，用于衡量语言模型在优先考虑情境信号、主动解决歧义以及高效推断用户偏好方面的能力。我们的数据集和诊断任务为推进对话式智能体中的动态、情境感知个性化提供了实用的测试平台。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
