papers.title: Mitigating Coordinate Prediction Bias from Positional Encoding Failures
papers.title_zh: 缓解基于位置编码失败的坐标预测偏差
papers.authors: Xingjian Tao, Yiwei Wang, Yujun Cai, Yihong Luo, Kai Han, Jing Tang
papers.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at general vision-language tasks, precise coordinate prediction remains a significant challenge, particularly as high-resolution inputs cause visual positional encodings (VPEs) to degrade. We demonstrate that these encoding failures do not result in random noise but instead trigger predictable, directional biases, suggesting that models default to internal spatial priors when grounding signals are weak. To counteract this, we introduce Vision-PE Shuffle Guidance (VPSG), a training-free, inference-time correction method. VPSG isolates position-unconditioned tendencies by shuffling VPEs and utilizes this negative evidence to steer digit decoding through a lightweight finite-state machine. Evaluation on the ScreenSpot-Pro benchmark confirms that VPSG effectively rectifies coordinate drift, yielding consistent improvements in localization accuracy across various model scales without any retraining.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型在一般的视觉-语言任务上表现优异，但精确的坐标预测仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是当使用高分辨率输入时，视觉位置编码会受到影响。我们发现，这种编码失败并不会导致随机噪声的产生，而是会引发可预测的、有方向性的偏差。这表明，在信号不足的情况下，模型会默认使用内部空间先验来进行坐标定位。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一种无需训练的推理时间校正方法——Vision-PE Shuffle Guidance（VPSG）。该方法通过打乱视觉位置编码的方式，分离出与位置无关的倾向性，并利用这些负面证据来引导数字解码过程，通过一个轻量级的有限状态机来实现。在ScreenSpot-Pro基准测试中的评估表明，VPSG能够有效纠正坐标漂移问题，并且在不同的模型规模下都能保持一致的定位精度提升，而无需进行任何重新训练。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PerDucer: Keyphrase-Driven Personalization Inducer for Summarization from User Histories
papers.title_zh: 引导器：基于关键词的个性化引导工具，用于根据用户历史数据进行摘要生成
papers.authors: Parthiv Chatterjee, Asish Joel Batha, Sourish Dasgupta, Tanmoy Chakraborty
papers.abstract: Document summarization becomes more challenging when summaries must reflect a user’s subjective interests in addition to document salience. SOTA Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong in-context summarization capabilities. Prior works report that simply prepending long and dynamically evolving user histories leads to unstable, inconsistent personalization. To address this, we introduce PerDucer, a personalization inducer for frozen language models. Given a user interaction sequence (trajectory) and a query document, PerDucer first predicts the next likely preference signal. It then maps the latent signal to a small set of personalized keyphrases for the query document. These keyphrases serve as the control cues that steer the frozen summarizers (both LLMs and SLMs) towards user-aligned summaries. Across the PENS and OpenAI-Reddit benchmarks, PerDucer-boosted LLMs consistently outperform the strongest history-prompting baselines, yielding an average +0.18 improvement across personalization metrics (PerSEval in our case). Two PerDucer-augmented SLMs approach the top-performing evaluated LLM, with SmolLM2-1.7B reaching 97% of the best-performing DeepSeek-R1-14B score. These results indicate that short keyphrase cues can induce personalization in frozen summarizers without modifying their parameters.
papers.abstract_zh: 当摘要不仅要反映文档的显著性，还要体现用户的主观兴趣时，文档总结就变得更具挑战性。先进的大语言模型在上下文相关的摘要生成方面表现出强大的能力。先前的研究表明，简单地在用户历史记录前添加一些内容会导致个性化效果不稳定且不一致。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PerDucer这一用于冻结语言模型的个性化引导工具。该工具会根据用户交互序列和查询文档，先预测下一个可能的偏好信号，然后将这个潜在信号映射到一个小型的个性化关键词集合中。这些关键词作为控制线索，引导冻结后的摘要生成器（包括LLM和SLM）生成符合用户需求的摘要。在PENS和OpenAI-Reddit基准测试中，使用PerDucer增强的LLM在个性化指标上始终优于那些仅依赖历史提示的基线方法，平均提升了0.18个百分点（以PerSEval为评估标准）。还有两种使用PerDucer增强的SLM也取得了优异的成绩，其中SmolLM2-1.7B达到了DeepSeek-R1-14B最佳性能的97%。这些结果表明，简短的关键词提示可以在不修改冻结摘要生成器的参数的情况下，实现个性化的效果。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond A Fixed Seal: Adaptive Stealing Watermark in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越固定水印：大型语言模型中的自适应水印技术
papers.authors: Shuhao Zhang, Yuli Chen, Jiale Han, Bo Cheng, Jiabao Ma
papers.abstract: Watermarking provides a critical safeguard for large language model (LLM) services by facilitating the detection of LLM-generated text. Correspondingly, stealing watermark algorithms (SWAs) derive watermark information from watermarked texts generated by victim LLMs to craft highly targeted adversarial attacks, which compromise the reliability of watermarks. Existing SWAs rely on fixed strategies, overlooking the non-uniform distribution of stolen watermark information and the dynamic nature of real-world LLM generation processes. To address these limitations, we propose Adaptive Stealing (AS), a novel SWA featuring enhanced design flexibility through Position-Based Seal Construction and Adaptive Selection modules. AS operates by defining multiple attack perspectives derived from distinct activation states of contextually ordered tokens.During attack execution, AS dynamically selects the optimal perspective based on watermark compatibility, generation priority, and dynamic generation relevance. Our experiments demonstrate that AS significantly increases steal efficiency against target watermarks under identical experimental conditions.These findings highlight the need for more robust LLM watermarks to withstand potential attacks. We release our code to the community for future research[https://github.com/DrankXs/AdaptiveStealingWatermark].
papers.abstract_zh: 水印技术为大语言模型服务提供了重要的安全保障，它能够帮助检测由大语言模型生成的文本。相应地，窃取水印算法通过从被攻击的大语言模型生成的带水印文本中提取水印信息，从而制造出极具针对性的攻击手段，进而破坏水印的可靠性。现有的窃取水印算法依赖于固定的策略，而忽略了被盗取的水印信息的非均匀分布以及现实世界中大语言模型生成过程的动态特性。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了自适应窃取算法——该算法具有更强的设计灵活性，它通过基于位置的密封构建和自适应选择模块来实现这一功能。自适应窃取算法通过定义多个攻击视角来运作，这些视角来自上下文有序标记的不同激活状态。在攻击执行过程中，自适应窃取算法会根据水印的兼容性、生成优先级以及动态生成的相关性，动态地选择最佳攻击视角。我们的实验表明，在相同的实验条件下，自适应窃取算法显著提高了对目标水印的窃取效率。这些发现凸显了需要更强大的大语言模型水印来抵御潜在的攻击。我们将我们的代码发布到社区中，以便未来的研究使用：[https://github.com/DrankXs/AdaptiveStealingWatermark]
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: UniGeM: Unifying Data Selection and Mixing via Geometric Exploration and Mining
papers.title_zh: UniGeM：通过几何探索与挖掘实现数据选择与混合的统一
papers.authors: Changhao Wang, Yunfeiyu, Xinhao Yao, Jiaolong Yang, Lu Yu, Junpeng Fang, Chaobo Li, Riccardo Cantoro, Qing Cui, Jun Zhou
papers.abstract: The scaling of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly limited by data quality. Most methods handle data mixing and sample selection separately, which can break the structure in code corpora. We introduce UniGeM, a framework that unifies mixing and selection by treating data curation as a manifold approximation problem without training proxy models or relying on external reference datasets. UniGeM operates hierarchically: Macro-Exploration learns mixing weights with stability-based clustering; Micro-Mining filters high-quality instances by their geometric distribution to ensure logical consistency. Validated by training 8B and 16B MoE models on 100B tokens, UniGeM achieves 2.0 \times data efficiency over a random baseline and further improves overall performance compared to SOTA methods in reasoning-heavy evaluations and multilingual generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的规模扩展越来越受到数据质量的限制。大多数方法分别处理数据混合和样本选择问题，这可能会破坏代码语料库的结构。我们提出了UniGeM框架，该框架通过将数据策划视为一个流形近似问题来统一混合和选择过程，而无需训练代理模型或依赖外部参考数据集。UniGeM采用分层操作：宏观探索阶段通过基于稳定性的聚类来学习混合权重；微观挖掘阶段则根据几何分布筛选高质量实例，以确保逻辑一致性。通过在1000亿个词元上训练80亿和160亿参数的MoE模型来验证UniGeM的有效性，结果表明，与随机基线相比，UniGeM的数据效率提高了2倍，并且在需要大量推理的多语言泛化任务中，其性能也优于当前最先进的方法。

papers.title: Don’t Just Listen, Try Planning: Graph-based Retrieval-Generation Agent for Long-form Audio Meeting Understanding
papers.title_zh: 不要只是倾听，还要尝试规划：一种基于图结构的检索生成代理，用于理解长格式音频会议内容
papers.authors: Quanwei Tang, Dong Zhang, Shoushan Li, Guodong Zhou
papers.abstract: Long-form audio meeting understanding (LAMU) is gaining attention, but dedicated question answering (QA) datasets are lacking. Previous tailored speech QA and existing Speech LLMs suffer from acoustic information loss and poor long-term dependency capture. We construct the LongAudioQA dataset and propose the GRGA model, which models heterogeneous audio features into a multi-dimensional graph and leverages agent planning for retrieval and answer generation, effectively addressing existing limitations.
papers.abstract_zh: 长格式音频会议理解技术正在受到关注，但专门用于问答的数据集却相对缺乏。以往针对特定场景设计的语音问答系统以及现有的语音大语言模型都存在声学信息丢失的问题，同时也难以捕捉长期依赖关系。我们构建了LongAudioQA数据集，并提出了GRGA模型。该模型能够将异构音频特征建模为多维图结构，并利用智能代理规划来实现检索和答案生成，从而有效解决现有模型的局限性问题。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FLASH: Focused Layer Attention Sink Hijacking
papers.title_zh: 快闪：聚焦层注意力吸引器的劫持
papers.authors: Siyuan Deng, Yerong Li, Fanhua Shang, Hongying Liu
papers.abstract: Despite advances in safety alignment, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreaking attacks. However, prevailing methods suffer from a dichotomy of limitations: they either rely on prohibitive iterative optimization in the input space (leading to high computational costs) or fail to penetrate the model’s internal decision-making processes. In this work, we identify a critical structural vulnerability: the ”Attention Sink” mechanism—originally designed to maintain generation stability by anchoring to initial tokens—unintentionally serves as a computational anchor for safety alignment. We hypothesize and empirically verify that safety guardrails are not globally distributed but are predominantly ”front-loaded” in specific attention heads of shallow layers. To audit this structural fragility, we propose FLASH (Focused Layer Attention Sink Hijacking), a novel diagnostic auditing framework that executes a surgical intervention. By precisely scaling attention scores in these vulnerable layers, we dismantle the model’s internal safety anchor. To ensure the attack’s robustness and coherence against the resulting internal noise, we synergize this intervention with multi-variant query rewriting and an adaptive dynamic decoding strategy. Extensive experiments on Llama-3, Qwen-3, and others demonstrate that FLASH achieves a state-of-the-art Attack Success Rate of over 77% with an unprecedented efficiency of 1.53 queries on average. This work marks a paradigm shift from brute-force optimization to mechanism-driven diagnostic auditing, exposing a fundamental trade-off between architectural stability and safety security.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在安全性对齐方面取得了进展，大语言模型仍然容易受到破解攻击。然而，现有的方法存在两大局限性：要么依赖在输入空间进行昂贵的迭代优化，导致计算成本过高；要么无法突破模型的内部决策流程。在这项研究中，我们发现了一个关键的结构性漏洞：所谓的“注意力汇聚”机制——该机制最初是为了保持生成稳定性而设计的，但实际上却无意中成为了安全性对齐的计算锚点。我们通过假设和实证验证，发现安全防护措施并非全局分布，而是主要集中在浅层特定注意力头中。为了检测这种结构上的脆弱性，我们提出了FLASH（聚焦层注意力汇聚 劫持）这一新的诊断审计框架。通过精确调整这些脆弱层的注意力得分，我们可以破坏模型内部的稳定性锚点。为了确保攻击的鲁棒性和对内部噪声的适应性，我们将这一干预措施与多变量查询重写以及自适应动态解码策略相结合。在Llama-3、Qwen-3等模型上的广泛实验表明，FLASH实现了超过77%的攻击成功率，平均查询效率达到了1.53次。这项工作标志着从暴力优化向基于机制的诊断审计的转变，揭示了架构稳定性与安全性的根本权衡问题。

papers.title: SPIDE: Serial and Parallel Intertwined Speculative Decoding
papers.title_zh: SPIDE：串行与并行交织的思辨解码方式
papers.authors: Wenru Xu, Peixuan Xu, Ziqi Yang, Ming Hu, Zihui Wang, Jianzhong Qi, Rongshan Yu, Xiaoliang Fan, Cheng Wang
papers.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) reduces inference latency for Large Language Models (LLMs) by leveraging an efficient draft model to generate candidate tokens, which are subsequently verified by the target model. To enhance acceleration while reducing the LLM usage costs, we propose Serial and Parallel Intertwined Speculative DEcoding (SPIDE) — a novel training-free SD framework that orchestrates dynamic alternation combining serial dynamic drafting with parallel draft verification. We maintain a confidence-acceptance mapping table during the decoding process. In the serial dynamic drafting module, we leverage this table to evaluate the reliability of the draft sequence and adjust draft lengths adaptively. In the parallel draft verification module, we alleviate drafting-termination conflicts that compromise efficiency, and we update the mapping table synchronously. We conduct experimental evaluations on diverse model pairs and text generation tasks to assess the effectiveness of SPIDE. Compared with autoregressive decoding, SPIDE is speeded up by 3.25× on average and up to 4.56×. Compared with vanilla SD, SPIDE only increases the LLM usage cost by 8.2% on average, but brings an additional 67.7% speedup on average.
papers.abstract_zh: 推测解码（Speculative Decoding，SD）通过利用高效的草稿模型来生成候选令牌，从而降低大语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs）的推理延迟。这些候选令牌随后会被目标模型进行验证。为了在降低LLM使用成本的同时提高处理速度，我们提出了串行与并行结合推测解码（Serial and Parallel Intertwined Speculative DEcoding，SPIDE）——一种无需训练的新型解码框架。该框架结合了串行动态草稿生成和并行草稿验证机制，实现了动态切换。在解码过程中，我们会维护一个置信度与接受度映射表。在串行动态草稿生成模块中，我们利用该表来评估草稿序列的可靠性，并自适应地调整草稿长度。在并行草稿验证模块中，我们解决了可能导致效率下降的草稿生成终止问题，并同步更新映射表。我们对多种模型对和文本生成任务进行了实验评估，以验证SPIDE的有效性。与自回归解码相比，SPIDE的平均加速比提高了3.25倍，最高可达4.56倍。与传统的SD方法相比，SPIDE仅使LLM的使用成本平均增加8.2%，但整体性能提升了67.7%。

papers.title: MdEval: Massively Multilingual Code Debugging
papers.title_zh: MdEval：支持多种语言代码的调试工具
papers.authors: Shukai Liu, Linzheng Chai, Jian Yang, Jiajun Shi, He Zhu, Liran Wang, Jin Ke, Wei Zhang, Hualei Zhu, Shuyue Guo, Tao Sun, Jiaheng Liu, Yunlong Duan, Yu Hao, Liqun Yang, Guanglin Niu, Ge Zhang, Zhoujun Li
papers.abstract: Code large language models (LLMs) have made significant progress in code debugging by directly generating the correct code based on the buggy code snippet. Programming benchmarks, typically consisting of buggy code snippets and their associated test cases, are used to assess the debugging capabilities of LLMs. However, many existing benchmarks primarily focus on Python and are often limited in terms of language diversity (e.g., DebugBench and DebugEval). To advancethe field of multilingual debugging with LLMs, we propose the first massively multilingual debugging benchmark, which includes 3.9K test samples of 20 programming languages and covers the automated program repair (APR) task, the bug localization(BL) task, and the bug identification (BI) task. In addition, we introduce the debugging instruction corpora MdEval-Instruct by injecting bugs into the correct multilingual queries and solutions (xDebugGen). Further, a multilingual debugger xDebugCoder trained on MdEval-Instruct as a strong baseline specifically to handle bugs of a wide range of programming languages (e.g. “Missing Mut” in language Rust and “Misused Macro Definition” in language C). Our extensive experiments on MdEval reveal a notable performance gap between open-source and closed-source LLMs (e.g., GPT and Claudeseries), highlighting huge room for improvement in multilingual code debugging scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码调试方面取得了显著进展，它能够根据有错误的代码片段直接生成正确的代码。编程基准测试通常包含有错误的代码片段及其相关的测试用例，这些测试被用来评估大语言模型的调试能力。然而，许多现有的基准测试主要专注于Python语言，并且在语言多样性方面存在局限性（例如DebugBench和DebugEval）。为了推进多语言调试领域的发展，我们提出了首个大规模多语言调试基准测试，该测试包含了3.9K个来自20种编程语言的测试样本，涵盖了自动程序修复、错误定位以及错误识别任务。此外，我们还开发了调试指令语料库MdEval-Instruct，通过向正确的多语言查询和解决方案中插入错误来实现这一目的。另外，我们还训练了一个基于MdEval-Instruct的多语言调试器xDebugCoder，作为处理多种编程语言中错误问题的强大基础工具（例如Rust语言中的“缺失变量”问题和C语言中的“误用宏定义”问题）。我们在MdEval上的广泛实验表明，开源大语言模型与闭源大语言模型之间存在显著的性能差距（例如GPT和Clodeseries），这凸显了在多语言代码调试场景中还有很大的改进空间。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Breaking Consensus Bias: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning for Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: 打破共识偏见：用于机器翻译的无监督强化学习
papers.authors: Shuting Jiang, Ran Song, Siqi Zhang, Yuxin Huang, Shengxiang Gao, Zhengtao Yu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) excels in reasoning tasks with verifiable rewards, while its adaptation to machine translation (MT) remains challenging due to the lack of unique reward signals under multiple valid translations. Existing RL approaches for MT face either fixed references in supervised settings or the production of homogeneous references leading to mode collapse in unsupervised settings. Both limitations arise from ignoring entropy dynamics in RL-based MT. The core challenge is leveraging entropy for supervision construction and self-evolution. In this paper, we propose an Entropy-Driven Unsupervised RL for MT. Our framework integrates entropy-guided sampling for exploration, confidence-weighted label generation to transcend majority-voting bias, and uncertainty-aware optimization to prioritize high-entropy tokens. These mechanisms allow reward signals to co-evolve with model proficiency beyond fixed references. Experiments across multiple language pairs show our method outperforms supervised and unsupervised baselines by +0.63 and +2.52 average points, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/fortunatekiss/URLMT.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在具有可验证奖励的推理任务中表现出色，而其在机器翻译领域的应用却面临挑战——由于缺乏在多种有效翻译下的独特奖励信号，强化学习难以适应机器翻译的需求。现有的强化学习方法在监督环境下面临固定参考标准的限制，在无监督环境下则存在生成同质参考数据的难题，这都会导致模式崩溃现象的发生。这两种局限性都是因为忽略了强化学习在机器翻译中的熵动态特性。我们的核心挑战在于利用熵来构建监督机制并实现自我进化。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于熵驱动的无监督强化学习算法用于机器翻译。我们的框架采用了熵引导采样来进行探索，通过加权标签生成来克服多数投票的偏见，同时采用不确定性感知优化方法来优先处理高熵标记。这些机制使得奖励信号能够随着模型能力的提升而共同进化，而不受固定参考标准的限制。在多个语言对上的实验表明，我们的方法分别比有监督和无监督的基线方法高出0.63和2.52个平均分数。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/fortunatekiss/URLMT下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Reasoning-Aware AIGC Detection via Alignment and Reinforcement
papers.title_zh: 基于对齐与强化机制的推理型AIGC检测算法
papers.authors: Zhao Wang, Max Xiong, Jianxun Lian, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement and widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) have elevated the need for reliable AI-generated content (AIGC) detection, which remains challenging as models evolve. We introduce AIGC-text-bank, a comprehensive multi-domain dataset with diverse LLM sources and authorship scenarios, and propose REVEAL, a detection framework that generates interpretable reasoning chains before classification. Our approach uses a two-stage training strategy: supervised fine-tuning to establish reasoning capabilities, followed by reinforcement learning to improve accuracy, improve logical consistency, and reduce hallucinations. Extensive experiments show that REVEAL achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, offering a robust and transparent solution for AIGC detection. The project is open-source at https://aka.ms/reveal
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展与广泛应用，使得对可靠的人工智能生成内容进行检测的需求日益增加。然而，随着模型的不断进化，这一任务仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了AIGC文本库——一个涵盖多个领域的综合数据集，包含来自不同LLM源头的文本以及多种作者场景。同时，我们开发了REVEAL检测框架，该框架在分类之前会生成可解释的推理链。我们的方法采用两阶段训练策略：首先通过监督式微调来建立推理能力，然后通过强化学习来提高准确性、增强逻辑一致性并减少幻觉现象。大量实验表明，REVEAL在多个基准测试中的表现均处于领先水平，为AIGC检测提供了稳健且透明的解决方案。该项目是开源的，相关代码可访问于https://aka.ms/reveal
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Modality Collapse: Taming Guided Modality Entropy for Omni-modal Emotion Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 超越模态崩溃：掌控引导性模态熵，以实现全模态情感推理
papers.authors: Xian Zhao, Rui Hu, Yuxiang Zhang, Delai Qiu, Yining Wang, Shengping Liu, Jian Yu, Jitao Sang
papers.abstract: Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs) excel in diverse tasks but struggle with complex emotional reasoning, which requires integrating textual, visual, and acoustic signals. We attribute this limitation to modality collapse, where models over-rely on a dominant modality while neglecting complementary cues. To address this issue, we introduce OmniCoT, a data paradigm that interleaves guided tokens (e.g., [vision], [audio]) into reasoning traces to enforce structured evidence extraction. To further internalize the reasoning behaviors instilled by OmniCoT and facilitate adaptive modality prioritization, we propose Dynamic Modality-Entropy GRPO (DyME-GRPO), which utilizes entropy-based uncertainty estimates over Guided Tokens (GTs) to regulate modality usage, thereby mitigating collapse and informational redundancy. By applying supervised fine-tuning with OmniCoT followed by DyME-GRPO, we develop EmoOmni based on the Qwen2.5-Omni-7B backbone. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EmoOmni achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple emotion recognition and reasoning benchmarks while preserving the general capabilities of the base model. These findings highlight the potential of our work for omni-modal reasoning across a broader range of complex tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 全模态大语言模型在多种任务中表现出色，但在复杂的情感推理方面存在困难，因为这需要整合文本、视觉和声音信号。我们认为这种局限性源于模态崩溃现象——模型过于依赖某一主要模态，而忽视了其他互补的线索。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了OmniCoT这一数据范式。该范式将引导性标记（如[视觉]、[音频]）交错融入推理过程中，从而强化结构化证据提取的能力。为了进一步内化OmniCoT所培养的推理行为，并促进自适应模态优先级分配，我们提出了动态模态熵GRPO算法（DyME-GRPO）。该算法利用基于熵的不确定性估计来调控模态的使用，从而减轻模态崩溃和信息冗余的问题。通过先在OmniCoT上进行监督微调，然后再应用DyME-GRPO，我们基于Qwen2.5-Omni-7B骨干模型开发了EmoOmni。大量实验表明，EmoOmni在多个情感识别和推理基准测试中取得了领先的性能，同时保留了基础模型的一般能力。这些发现凸显了我们的工作在跨多种复杂任务的全模态推理方面的潜力。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: ID10M-JAM: Stress-Testing Idiom Identification Under Challenging Context
papers.title_zh: ID10M-JAM：在具有挑战性的情境下对成语进行压力测试
papers.authors: Kai Golan Hashiloni, Lior Livyatan, Ofri Hefetz, Alon Mannor, Bar Cohen, Kfir Bar
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on idiom identification benchmarks, yet their robustness to misleading contextual signals remains largely untested. We introduce ID10M-JAM, an adversarial extension of the ID10M dataset designed to jam model understanding by injecting coherent but conflicting context before each target sentence. For every sentence containing a potential idiomatic expression (PIE), we construct variants that deliberately invert contextual expectations: placing literal cues before idiomatic uses and idiomatic cues before literal ones. All variants are validated by human annotators to ensure naturalness and unambiguous interpretation for human readers. ID10M-JAM exposes systematic vulnerabilities in LLMs’ contextual reasoning, pushing idiom identification to its breaking point.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在成语识别基准测试中表现优异，然而它们对误导性上下文信号的鲁棒性却尚未得到充分验证。我们提出了ID10M-JAM这一对抗性扩展数据集，该数据集旨在通过在每个目标句子之前注入连贯但相互矛盾的上下文信息来干扰模型的理解能力。对于每一个包含潜在成语表达的句子，我们构建了多种变体，这些变体故意颠倒了上下文的预期：将字面提示放在成语使用之前，而将成语提示放在字面提示之前。所有变体都经过人类注释者的验证，以确保其自然性和对读者而言的明确性。ID10M-JAM揭示了大语言模型在上下文推理方面的系统性漏洞，使成语识别能力达到了极限。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MENTOR: Mitigating Identity Drift in Dynamic Role-Playing via Dual-Chain Structured Memory
papers.title_zh: 导师：通过双链结构化记忆来减轻动态角色扮演中的身份漂移问题
papers.authors: Zhu Zhuoning, Xingyu Gao, Hailong Shi
papers.abstract: Long-context LLM agents increasingly serve multiple users or personas within a single session, requiring stable identity and knowledge boundaries under frequent switching. We identify a common failure mode, identity drift, where models conflate user-specific states and leak information across roles. On BEAM-SWITCH, a benchmark for controlled multi-user switching, performance consistently degrades as switching intensifies, even when responses remain fluent and locally coherent. We propose MENTOR, a cognitive architecture that mitigates identity drift without fine-tuning. MENTOR uses a Dual-Chain Memory Mechanism: a Global Chain (\mathcal{G}) for long-term event logging and isolated Role Chains (\mathcal{R}_r) as per-role working memories, supported by a semantic Knowledge Graph (\mathcal{K}) that filters and verifies role-admissible information before generation. Across six LLM families, MENTOR improves the overall score (Avg) from 0.46 to 0.75 on average (+0.29 absolute), with substantial gains in identity adherence and knowledge fidelity.
papers.abstract_zh: 长上下文大语言模型代理越来越多地需要在同一会话中为多个用户或角色提供服务，这要求它们在频繁切换的情况下仍能保持稳定的身份和知识边界。我们发现了一个常见的故障模式——身份漂移，即模型会将用户特定的状态混在一起，导致信息在不同角色之间泄露。在BEAM-SWITCH这个针对可控多用户切换的基准测试中，随着切换频率的增加，模型性能会持续下降，即便响应仍然流畅且局部一致。我们提出了MENTOR这一认知架构，它能够在不进行精细调优的情况下减轻身份漂移的问题。MENTOR采用了双链记忆机制：一个用于长期事件记录的全局链(\mathcal{G})，以及每个角色专用的工作记忆——独立角色链(\mathcal{R}_r)。此外，它还拥有一个语义知识图谱(\mathcal{K})，该图谱在生成内容之前会对角色可接受的信息进行过滤和验证。在六个不同的大语言模型家族中，MENTOR的平均得分从0.46提升到了0.75（绝对提升了0.29），并且在保持身份一致性和知识准确性方面取得了显著进步。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Benchmarks: A Capability-Based Maturity Model for Systematic AI Integration in Hospitals
papers.title_zh: 超越基准：一种基于能力的成熟度模型，用于医院中的系统性人工智能整合
papers.authors: Rui Li, Xiaofen WU, Mingqian Liu, Xiaoxia Song, Xu Xiangjun, Jiacheng Qiao, Zhuang Boqin, Xu Chen
papers.abstract: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate exceptional performance on medical benchmarks. However, models that excel in standardized tests focused on medical knowledge recall are not necessarily effective in real-world healthcare scenarios. This disparity between academic performance and clinical effectiveness stems from existing evaluations focusing overly on knowledge retrieval and QA, while neglecting high-load executive tasks in real clinical workflows. The effective execution of such tasks depends not only on model reasoning but also on the overall digital maturity of the healthcare institution. To address this, we propose a “Capability-Based Hospital AI Maturity Model” framework. This framework establishes a layered maturity system based on capabilities. By categorizing hospital AI capabilities into distinct maturity levels, it provides a clear, stepwise evolutionary path for hospitals, guiding them from foundational infrastructure construction to ubiquitous intelligence. Guided by this framework, we constructed ten representative real-world clinical scenarios as a reference test set and compared the performance of multiple models across benchmarks and real-world scenarios. Preliminary results suggest that, compared to relying solely on academic benchmark scores, this maturity assessment mode—which integrates system governance and scenario constraints—may provide a more valuable basis for AI adoption in medical institutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的大语言模型在医学领域基准测试中表现出色。然而，那些在专注于医学知识检索的标准测试中表现优异的模型，并不一定能在实际的医疗场景中发挥有效作用。这种学术表现与临床效果之间的差距，源于现有的评估方式过于侧重于知识检索和问答任务，而忽视了实际临床工作流程中需要处理的复杂执行任务。这些任务的顺利执行不仅取决于模型的推理能力，还取决于医疗机构的整体数字化成熟度。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种“基于能力的医院人工智能成熟度模型”框架。该框架基于能力建立了分层的成熟度体系。通过将医院人工智能能力划分为不同的成熟度等级，为医院提供了一个清晰、循序渐进的发展路径，从基础基础设施建设逐步发展到全面智能化。在这一框架的指导下，我们构建了十个具有代表性的真实临床场景作为参考测试集，并比较了多个模型在不同基准测试和真实场景中的表现。初步结果表明，与仅依赖学术基准评分相比，这种结合了系统治理和场景约束的成熟度评估方式，可能为医疗机构引入人工智能技术提供更可靠的依据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DiffuSpec: Unlocking Diffusion Language Models for Speculative Decoding
papers.title_zh: DiffuSpec：解锁用于推测性解码的扩散语言模型
papers.authors: Guanghao Li, Zhihui Fu, Min Fang, Qibin Zhao, Ming Tang, Chun Yuan, Jun Wang
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) decoding in large language models (LLMs) is latency-bounded by strictly sequential token generation.Speculative decoding mitigates this bottleneck by letting a fast drafter propose multi-token candidates that are then verified in parallel by the target model; yet most existing systems still rely on AR drafters, limiting wall-clock gains.We present DiffuSpec, which repurposes a diffusion language model (DLM) as a parallel drafter to generate multi-token proposals in a single forward pass while remaining compatible with standard AR verifiers.However, DLM drafting presents unique challenges: 1) bidirectional conditioning produces a token lattice where locally optimal tokens may fail to form a valid causal sequence; 2) the mechanism requires tuning the draft length, which induces a speed–quality trade-off. To address these issues, we introduce (i) Causal-consistency Path Search (CPS) to extract verifier-aligned causal paths from the lattice, and (ii) an Adaptive Draft-Length (ADL) controller that adjusts proposal lengths using online acceptance feedback.Across benchmarks, DiffuSpec achieves up to 3\times wall-clock speedup and consistently outperforms strong baselines, demonstrating diffusion-based drafting as a competitive alternative to AR drafters for speculative decoding.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型（LLM）中，自回归（AR）解码的延迟受到严格顺序化token生成的限制。推测性解码通过让快速的生成器提出多个token候选方案，然后由目标模型并行验证，从而缓解了这一瓶颈问题。不过，大多数现有系统仍然依赖AR生成器，这限制了时钟时间的提升效果。我们提出了DiffuSpec，它将扩散语言模型（DLM）重新用作并行生成器，能够在一次前向传播中生成多个token的提案方案，同时仍与标准的AR验证器兼容。然而，DLM生成过程存在独特的挑战：1）双向条件化会导致token网格中出现局部最优token无法形成有效因果序列的情况；2）该机制需要调整生成方案的长度，这就导致了速度与质量之间的权衡。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了两种技术：1）因果一致性路径搜索（CPS），用于从token网格中提取符合验证器要求的因果路径；2）自适应生成方案长度控制器（ADL），该控制器利用在线接受反馈来调整生成方案的长度。在各种基准测试中，DiffuSpec实现了高达3倍的时钟时间加速，并且始终优于强大的基线算法，这表明基于扩散算法的生成方案可以作为AR生成器的有竞争力的替代方案，用于推测性解码。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TENP: Trapezoidal Expert Neuron Pruning For Mixture-of-Experts
papers.title_zh: TENP：梯形专家神经元剪枝算法，适用于多专家系统混合场景
papers.authors: Jiangyang He, Shaolin Zhu, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts large language models (LLMs) scale efficiently through sparse activation, yet their deployment is fundamentally constrained by the large static parameter footprint of experts. Existing compression approaches either remove entire experts, disrupting routing topology and harming performance, or rely on unstructured weight pruning with limited practical efficiency. To address the limitations, we propose TENP, a structured Trapezoidal Expert Neuron Pruning framework. Using a few samples, we identify and retain important experts, while applying expert neuron pruning (ENP) to less important experts, preserving model parameters in a trapezoidal pattern from shallow to deep layers. When evaluating expert importance, we jointly consider both the magnitude of the expert output and its ability to change the direction of the input vector. For ENP, we measure each neuron’s projected contribution to the expert output to identify and retain important neurons. We conduct extensive experiments on the Qwen and DeepSeek models. Under a routing expert sparsity of 40% and an average of 63.76% activated expert parameters, the DeepSeek model suffers only a 1-point drop in accuracy compared to the full-parameter model. Moreover, it outperforms the full-parameter model by 10% on code generation tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合型大语言模型能够通过稀疏激活高效扩展，但其部署仍然受到专家大量静态参数影响的限制。现有的压缩方法要么会移除整个专家节点，从而破坏路由拓扑结构并降低性能，要么依赖于非结构化的权重剪枝，但实际应用效果有限。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了TENP——一种结构化的梯形专家神经元剪枝框架。通过少量样本，我们能够识别并保留重要的专家节点，同时对不太重要的专家节点进行剪枝，从而以梯形模式在浅层到深层之间分配模型参数。在评估专家的重要性时，我们会综合考虑专家输出的大小以及其改变输入向量方向的能力。对于梯形剪枝算法，我们会衡量每个神经元对专家输出的贡献程度，以识别出重要的神经元。我们在Qwen和DeepSeek模型上进行了广泛的实验验证。在路由专家节点稀疏度为40%的情况下，平均有63.76%的专家参数被激活，DeepSeek模型的准确率仅比全参数模型低1个百分点。此外，在代码生成任务上，DeepSeek模型的性能还优于全参数模型，高出10%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FlowRAG: Synergizing Explicit Reasoning via Frequency-Aware Multi-Granularity Graph Flow
papers.title_zh: FlowRAG：通过频率感知的多粒度图流技术，实现显性推理的协同优化
papers.authors: Bihao Zhan, Zongsheng Cao, Jie Zhou, Bo Zhang, Liang He
papers.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) is effective for knowledge-intensive and multi-hop query tasks; however, many existing methods primarily seed entity-based graphs and rely on implicit semantic relevance propagation. This often (i) under-retrieves when user queries are abstract and semantically sparse at the entity level, and (ii) suffers from brittle multi-hop reasoning, where noisy activations can derail entity-to-entity transitions and corrupt the inferred relation chain, yielding unreliable conclusions. To this end, we propose FlowRAG, a semantic-aware retrieval framework that improves both semantic recall and explicit reasoning. Specifically, FlowRAG constructs a quad-level heterogeneous graph over passages, summaries, sentences, and entities, where summary nodes serve as a coarse semantic hub. At retrieval time, a dual-granularity activation module combines summary–query alignment with sentence-level matching to activate relevant entities under paraphrase and abstraction robustly. We then introduce a frequency-aware weighted flow module that routes relevance through entity–passage links weighted by within-passage term frequency, pruning noisy connections and extracting high-confidence reasoning paths as an explicit logic skeleton for generation. Extensive experiments show that FlowRAG obtains state-of-the-art performance on complex reasoning benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）在需要大量知识和多跳推理的查询任务中表现优异。然而，许多现有方法主要依赖基于实体的图结构，并依靠隐式的语义相关性传播机制。这种机制往往会导致以下问题：当用户查询在实体层面较为抽象且语义信息匮乏时，检索效果会不足；同时，多跳推理也容易出现问题，因为噪声激活可能会破坏实体与实体之间的转换关系，从而导致推断出的关系链变得不可靠，最终得出不可信的结论。为此，我们提出了FlowRAG这一具有语义感知能力的检索框架，它能够提升语义召回率和显式推理能力。具体来说，FlowRAG在段落、摘要、句子和实体之间构建了一个四层异构图结构，其中摘要节点充当着粗粒度的语义枢纽。在检索阶段，该框架采用双粒度激活模块，将摘要与查询的匹配结果与句子级别的匹配结果结合起来，从而能够在改写和抽象化的过程中稳健地激活相关实体。此外，我们还引入了一个频率感知的加权流模块，该模块根据段落内术语的频率来分配相关性权重，从而剔除噪声连接，提取出高可信度的推理路径，作为生成的逻辑骨架。大量的实验表明，FlowRAG在复杂的推理任务上取得了领先的性能表现。

papers.title: OntoGuard: Enforcing Action Admissibility for LLM Agents in Complex Interactive Environments
papers.title_zh: OntoGuard：在复杂的互动环境中确保大型语言模型代理所执行的操作可被接受
papers.authors: Pengxiang Liu, Tao Ren, Wei Xiong, Tingrui Yang, Junjie Wang, Jun HU
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive reasoning capabilities in agents for complex interactive environments. However, these agents often suffer from hallucinations and lack grounding, leading to unreliable actions that conflict with real-world constraints. Existing approaches mitigate some issues through implicit imitation or sparse reinforcement learning but rely on fitting data distributions without explicitly understanding environmental constraints, often generating actions that are behaviorally distorted or environmentally impermissible. To address this, we introduce OntoGuard, an ontological framework designed to guard LLM agents by enforcing environmental and behavioral admissibility. These constraints are constructed by extracting knowledge from oracle demonstrations, supplemented with world knowledge inherent in LLMs and general knowledge bases. During inference, OntoGuard functions as an active interceptor, using a graph-based constraint-checking mechanism to reject invalid actions and prompt self-correction before acting. Experiments on both ScienceWorld and VirtualHome demonstrate OntoGuard’s advantage over state-of-the-art methods, validating its ability to enforce physical and behavioral constraints while preventing invalid actions.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂的互动环境中展现出出色的推理能力。然而，这些模型常常出现幻觉现象，且缺乏明确的环境约束信息，从而导致行为不可靠，甚至违反现实世界的限制条件。目前的方法通过隐式模仿或稀疏强化学习来缓解部分问题，但这些方法依赖于对数据分布的拟合，而没有真正理解环境约束。因此，这些方法往往会产生行为扭曲或违反环境规定的动作。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了OntoGuard这一本体框架。该框架旨在通过强制执行环境和行为上的约束来保护语言模型代理。这些约束是通过从真实环境中的示范中提取知识，并结合语言模型本身所包含的世界知识和通用知识库来构建的。在推理过程中，OntoGuard充当一种主动的拦截器，利用基于图的约束检查机制来拒绝无效的动作，并在采取行动之前进行自我修正。在ScienceWorld和VirtualHome上的实验表明，OntoGuard相较于现有方法具有明显优势，它能够有效执行物理和行为上的约束，同时避免产生无效的动作。

papers.title: Self-Correcting RAG: Enhancing Faithfulness via MMKP Context Selection and NLI-Guided MCTS
papers.title_zh: 自修正RAG：通过MMKP上下文选择与基于自然语言推理的MCTS算法提升准确性
papers.authors: Shijia Xu, Zhou Wu, Xiaolong Jia, Yu Wang, Kai Liu, April Xiaowen Dong
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) substantially extends the knowledge boundary of large language models. However, it still faces two major challenges when handling complex reasoning tasks: low context utilization and frequent hallucinations. To address these issues, we propose Self-Correcting RAG, a unified framework that reformulates retrieval and generation as constrained optimization and path planning. On the input side, we move beyond traditional greedy retrieval and, for the first time, formalize context selection as a multi-dimensional multiple-choice knapsack problem (MMKP), thereby maximizing information density and removing redundancy under a strict token budget. On the output side, we introduce a natural language inference (NLI)-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) mechanism, which leverages test-time compute to dynamically explore reasoning trajectories and validate the faithfulness of generated answers. Experiments on six open-domain and multi-hop QA datasets demonstrate that our method significantly improves reasoning accuracy on complex queries while effectively reducing hallucinations, outperforming strong existing baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/xjiacs/Self-Correcting-RAG .
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）显著扩展了大语言模型的认知边界。然而，在处理复杂的推理任务时，它仍然面临两个主要挑战：上下文利用率低以及频繁出现幻觉现象。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了自校正RAG框架，该框架将检索与生成重新定义为约束优化和路径规划问题。在输入方面，我们超越了传统的贪婪检索方式，首次将上下文选择形式化为一个多维多目标背包问题，从而最大化信息密度，并在严格的令牌预算下消除冗余。在输出方面，我们引入了基于自然语言推理的蒙特卡洛树搜索机制，该机制利用测试时的计算资源来动态探索推理路径，并验证生成答案的准确性。在六个开放域和多跳问答数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法显著提高了复杂查询的推理准确性，同时有效减少了幻觉现象，其性能优于现有的强基线算法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/xjiacs/Self-Correcting-RAG获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DiffER: Diffusion Entity-Relation Modeling for Reversal Curse in Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: DiffER：用于扩散式大型语言模型中的反转现象的扩散实体关系建模
papers.authors: Shaokai He, Kaiwen Wei, Xinyi Zeng, Xiang Chen, Xue Yang, Zhenyang Li, Jiang Zhong, Yu Tian
papers.abstract: The “reversal curse” refers to the phenomenon where large language models (LLMs) exhibit predominantly unidirectional behavior when processing logically bidirectional relationships. Prior work attributed this to autoregressive training—predicting the next token inherently favors left-to-right information flow over genuine bidirectional knowledge associations. However, we observe that Diffusion LLMs (DLLMs), despite being trained bidirectionally, also suffer from the reversal curse. To investigate the root causes, we conduct systematic experiments on DLLMs and identify three key reasons: 1) entity fragmentation during training, 2) data asymmetry, and 3) missing entity relations. Motivated by the analysis of these reasons, we propose Diffusion Entity-Relation Modeling (DiffER), which addresses the reversal curse through entity-aware training and balanced data construction. Specifically, DiffER introduces whole-entity masking, which mitigates entity fragmentation by predicting complete entities in a single step. DiffER further employs distribution-symmetric and relation-enhanced data construction strategies to alleviate data asymmetry and missing relations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiffER effectively alleviates the reversal curse in Diffusion LLMs, offering new perspectives for future research. The code is available at https://github.com/CQU-MM-Intelligent-Lab/DiffER.
papers.abstract_zh: “反转诅咒”指的是大语言模型在处理双向逻辑关系时表现出单向行为的现象。先前的研究认为这种现象是由于自回归训练导致的——预测下一个词符时，模型更倾向于遵循从左到右的信息流，而非真正的双向知识关联。然而，我们发现，尽管扩散语言模型经过双向训练，仍然会出现反转诅咒现象。为了探究其根本原因，我们对扩散语言模型进行了系统性的实验，并发现了三个主要问题：1）训练过程中实体的碎片化；2）数据的不对称性；3）缺失的实体关系。基于对这些问题的分析，我们提出了扩散实体关系建模方法（DiffER），该方法通过考虑实体因素进行训练以及构建平衡的数据结构来应对反转诅咒现象。具体来说，DiffER引入了整体实体掩蔽技术，通过一步完成对完整实体的预测，从而缓解实体碎片化问题。此外，DiffER还采用了分布对称性和关系增强的数据构建策略，以解决数据不对称和关系缺失的问题。大量实验表明，DiffER能够有效缓解扩散语言模型中的反转诅咒现象，为未来的研究提供了新的思路。相关代码可访问https://github.com/CQU-MM-Intelligent-Lab/DiffER。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Layer-aware Dual-directional Modulation for Low-resource Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: 基于层感知的双向调制技术，适用于资源有限的机器翻译系统
papers.authors: Siqi Zhang, Ran Song, Shuting Jiang, Yuxin Huang, Zhengtao Yu
papers.abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in Machine Translation (MT), a significant performance gap persists between high-resource and low-resource languages due to imbalanced pre-training data. In this paper, we first investigate the internal mechanisms driving this performance disparity from a layer-wise perspective.We propose a metric termed Activation Disparity (\Delta R) to quantify the activation divergence between high- and low-resource MT. Based on this metric, we distinguish between Task-Adaptive Layers (TAL, \Delta R > 0) that encode task-specific signals and Legacy-Inert Layers (LIL, \Delta R < 0) dominated by pre-trained bias. Leveraging this finding, we propose the Layer-aware Dual-directional Modulation (LaDM). Integrated with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), LaDM employs a sparse strategy to bidirectionally modulate optimization dynamics. Specifically, it amplifies contributions from TAL to accelerate feature consolidation while inhibiting LIL to dampen misaligned legacy biases. Extensive experiments on Chinese-to-seven low-resource language translation using Llama-3.1, Qwen2.5, and Gemma-2 demonstrate that LaDM significantly outperforms standard LoRA fine-tuning, achieving an average improvement of 1.73 spBLEU.Code is available at https://github.com/zzssqqq/LaDM.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在机器翻译领域取得了显著成就，但由于预训练数据不平衡的原因，高资源语言与低资源语言之间仍然存在显著的性能差距。在本文中，我们首先从逐层的角度探讨了导致这种性能差异的内部机制。我们提出了一种名为“激活差异”（ΔR）的度量指标，用于量化高资源语言与低资源语言之间的激活差异。基于这一指标，我们将层分为任务自适应层（ΔR > 0），这些层负责编码特定任务的信号；以及传统惰性层（ΔR < 0），这些层主要由预训练的偏差所主导。利用这一发现，我们提出了“层感知双向调节”方法。该方法结合低秩适应技术，采用稀疏策略来双向调节优化过程。具体来说，它增强任务自适应层的贡献以加速特征整合，同时抑制传统惰性层的不良影响。在基于Llama-3.1、Qwen2.5和Gemma-2的汉语到七种低资源语言翻译任务上的大量实验表明，LaDM在性能上明显优于传统的低秩适应微调方法，平均提升了1.73个spBLEU分数。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/zzssqqq/LaDM。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MATCHA: Matching Text via Contrastive Semantic Alignment
papers.title_zh: MATCHA：通过对比语义对齐来匹配文本
papers.authors: Siran Li, Ece Sena Etoglu, Carsten Eickhoff, Seyed Ali Bahrainian
papers.abstract: Reliable evaluation is essential for understanding large language model (LLM) performance, yet today’s go-to metrics, namely token-overlap scores (e.g., ROUGE) and embedding-based measures (e.g., BERTScore), often misjudge semantic similarity of documents. Our study shows that both token-overlap metrics and embedding-based metrics routinely assign nearly identical scores to texts that directly contradict each other, thereby potentially masking fundamental errors. We introduce MATCHA, an automatic metric that jointly rewards semantic agreement with a reference and penalizes contradictions. MATCHA employs a dual-view perspective that measures (i) proximity to the gold text and (ii) distance from an adversarially generated counterfactual contradiction. In eight public benchmarks, MATCHA outperforms popular metrics, compared with human annotations on question-answering, image caption generation, natural language inference, summarization, and semantic textual similarity tasks. On the TruthfulQA dataset (i.e., a dataset without a training set, where no embedding-based metrics could locally train on), this improvement in terms of matching texts with a reference reaches 18.38% over ROUGE-L and 20.82% over BERTScore. Both quantitative comparison and qualitative human assessments confirm the efficacy and validity of MATCHA and uncover fundamental weaknesses in pre-existing metrics. Compared with 23 embedding models, including top state-of-the-art ones, used as a metric similar to BERTScore, MATCHA remains the most accurate in distinguishing correct from incorrect statements solely based on a reference. Our code and metric are publicly available (https://github.com/Siran-Li/MATCHA).
papers.abstract_zh: 可靠的评估对于理解大语言模型的性能至关重要。然而，目前常用的评估指标，如基于词符重叠的评分（例如ROUGE）和基于嵌入的度量方法（例如BERTScore），往往无法准确判断文档之间的语义相似性。我们的研究表明，这两种基于词符重叠的评估方法和基于嵌入的评估方法常常给那些直接相互矛盾的文本赋予几乎相同的分数，从而可能掩盖了根本性的错误。我们提出了MATCHA这一自动评估方法，它能够同时奖励与参考文本在语义上的一致性，并惩罚矛盾之处。MATCHA采用了双视角的方法，分别衡量与参考文本的接近程度以及与敌对生成的反事实矛盾的差距。在八个公开基准测试中，MATCHA在问答、图像描述生成、自然语言推理、摘要生成和语义文本相似性任务上均优于其他流行的评估方法，其准确率甚至超过了人类专家在相关任务上的评估结果。在TruthfulQA数据集上，由于没有训练集，传统的基于嵌入的评估方法无法进行局部训练，而MATCHA在匹配文本与参考文本方面的准确率分别达到了ROUGE-L的18.38%和BERTScore的20.82%。无论是定量比较还是定性评估都证实了MATCHA的有效性和可靠性，同时也揭示了现有评估方法的根本性缺陷。与包括最先进的23种嵌入模型在内的所有评估方法相比，MATCHA在仅基于参考文本来区分正确与错误陈述方面仍然是最准确的。我们的代码和评估方法已公开可用，网址为https://github.com/Siran-Li/MATCHA。

papers.title: PlaM: Training-Free Plateau-Guided Model Merging for Better Visual Grounding in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: PlaM：一种无需训练的、基于平台期引导的模型融合方法，旨在提升多模态语言模型中的视觉感知能力
papers.authors: Zijing Wang, YongKang Liu, Mingyang Wang, Ercong Nie, Deyuan Chen, Zhengjie Zhao, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Xiaocui Yang, Yifei Zhang, Hinrich Schuetze
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) rely on strong linguistic reasoning inherited from their base language models. However, multimodal instruction fine-tuning paradoxically degrades this text’s reasoning capability, undermining multimodal performance. To address this issue, we propose a training-free framework to mitigate this degradation. Through layer-wise vision token masking, we reveal a common three-stage pattern in multimodal large language models: early-modal separation, mid-modal alignment, and late-modal degradation. By analyzing the behavior of MLLMs at different stages, we propose a plateau-guided model merging method that selectively injects base language model parameters into MLLMs. Experimental results based on five MLLMs on nine benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Attention-based analysis further reveals that merging shifts attention from diffuse, scattered patterns to focused localization on task-relevant visual regions.Our repository is on https://github.com/wzj1718/PlaM .
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）依赖于其基础语言模型所继承的强大语言推理能力。然而，多模态指令微调却会矛盾地降低文本的推理能力，从而削弱多模态模型的性能。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种无需训练的框架来减轻这种退化现象。通过逐层对视觉令牌进行掩蔽处理，我们发现多模态大语言模型中存在一个常见的三阶段模式：早期模态分离、中期模态对齐以及后期模态退化。通过分析不同阶段的MLLMs行为，我们提出了一种基于平台期的模型合并方法，该方法能够选择性地将基础语言模型参数注入到MLLMs中。基于五个MLLMs在九个基准测试中的实验结果表明了我们方法的有效性。基于注意力分析的结果进一步表明，合并操作使得注意力从分散的、无聚焦的模式转移到了对任务相关视觉区域的集中定位上。我们的代码库可以在https://github.com/wzj1718/PlaM下载。

papers.title: Efficient Inference for Large Vision-Language Models: Bottlenecks, Techniques, and Prospects
papers.title_zh: 高效推理技术在大语言模型中的应用：瓶颈、相关方法及前景
papers.authors: Jun Zhang, Yicheng Ji, Feiyang Ren, Yihang Li, Bowen Zeng, Zonghao Chen, Ke Chen, Lidan Shou, Gang Chen, Huan Li
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) enable sophisticated reasoning over images and videos, yet their inference is hindered by a systemic efficiency barrier known as visual token dominance. This overhead is driven by a multi-regime interplay between high-resolution feature extraction, quadratic attention scaling, and memory bandwidth constraints. We present a systematic taxonomy of efficiency techniques structured around the inference lifecycle, consisting of encoding, prefilling, and decoding. Unlike prior reviews focused on isolated optimizations, we analyze the end-to-end pipeline to reveal how upstream decisions dictate downstream bottlenecks, covering compute-bound visual encoding, the intensive prefilling of massive contexts, and the ”visual memory wall” in bandwidth-bound decoding. By decoupling the efficiency landscape into the axes of shaping information density, managing long-context attention, and overcoming memory limits, this work provides a structured analysis of how isolated optimizations compose to navigate the trade-off between visual fidelity and system efficiency. The survey concludes by outlining four future frontiers supported by pilot empirical insights, including hybrid compression based on functional unit sensitivity, modality-aware decoding with relaxed verification, progressive state management for streaming continuity, and stage-disaggregated serving through hardware-algorithm co-design. The submitted software contains a snapshot of our literature repository, which is designed to be maintained as a living resource for the community.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型能够实现对图像和视频的复杂推理，但其推理能力受到一种名为“视觉令牌主导效应”的系统性效率障碍的阻碍。这种效率瓶颈是由高分辨率特征提取、二次注意力缩放以及内存带宽限制等多种因素相互作用造成的。我们提出了一种基于推理生命周期的效率技术分类体系，该体系包括编码、预填充和解码三个阶段。与以往仅关注单一优化方法的综述不同，我们分析了整个推理流程，揭示了上游决策如何决定下游的瓶颈问题，涵盖了计算限制的视觉编码、对大量上下文的密集预填充，以及带宽限制下的“视觉记忆墙”问题。通过将效率分析分解为塑造信息密度、管理长上下文注意力以及突破内存限制这三个方面，本研究为如何结合各种优化方法来平衡视觉逼真度和系统效率提供了结构化的分析框架。最后，本文提出了四个未来研究方向，这些方向得到了初步实证研究的支持，包括基于功能单元敏感性的混合压缩方法、具有放松验证机制的模态感知解码技术、用于流媒体连续性的渐进式状态管理，以及通过硬件与算法协同设计实现的分阶段服务机制。所提交的软件中包含我们的文献库快照，该数据库旨在作为面向社区的持续更新资源而得以维护。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Adaptive Zooming via Relevance-Informed Positional Resource Allocation for Training-free LLM Context Extension
papers.title_zh: 基于相关性优化的位置资源分配自适应缩放技术，用于无需训练的LLM上下文扩展
papers.authors: Hongbo Zhao, Huibin Wang, Bin Tang, Xianming Hu, Yihong Huang, Yijun Shen, Nuoyi Chen, Ping Li, Kai Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models exhibit degraded performance when extrapolating beyond training context lengths. Existing training-free methods like positional reuse or interpolation can alleviate this issue in an efficient manner. However, these strategies are semantics-agnostic by only considering relative token distances, which could indiscriminately blur semantically relevant and irrelevant tokens alike.To address this, we introduce an adaptive positional zooming method called Relevance-Informed Positional Resource Allocation (RiPRA). RiPRA formulates positional encoding as a constrained resource allocation, in which a fixed positional budget is distributed across tokens in a longer context based on their semantic relevance to the query: relevant tokens get higher positional resolution, while irrelevant tokens (positions) are compressed. By doing this, RiPRA enables a dynamic and nonparametric positional zooming where the positional resolution is adaptively modulated across queries and network layers, effectively improving long-range context modeling and retrieval capacity. Besides, an isotonic smoothing is used to further enforce a global linear ordering relationship to preserve stability and generalization, together with a chunk-based hierarchical approximation to further reduce inference overhead. Extensive experiments across comprehensive benchmarks including LongBench, L-Eval, Passkey Retrieval, and PG19 demonstrate that RiPRA consistently outperforms existing training-free extrapolation methods, showing the value of relevance-conditioned positional encoding for long-context generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在超出训练上下文长度的情况下，其性能会下降。现有的无需训练的方法，如位置重用或插值技术，可以高效地解决这一问题。然而，这些策略是语义无关的，因为它们只考虑相对令牌之间的距离，这可能导致语义上相关和无关的令牌被无差别地混淆。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种自适应位置缩放方法，称为“相关性指导的位置资源分配”（RiPRA）。RiPRA将位置编码转化为一种受限的资源分配机制：根据令牌与查询的语义相关性，将固定的位置预算分配给较长的上下文中的不同令牌。与语义相关的令牌会得到更高的位置分辨率，而不相关的令牌则会被压缩。通过这种方式，RiPRA实现了动态且非参数化的位置缩放，使得位置分辨率能够随着查询和网络层的变化而自适应调整，从而有效提升长范围上下文建模和检索能力。此外，还采用了等渗平滑技术来进一步确保全局线性排序关系的稳定性与泛化性，同时采用基于块的层次化近似方法来降低推理开销。在包括LongBench、L-Eval、Passkey Retrieval和PG19在内的多种基准测试中的广泛实验表明，RiPRA始终优于现有的无需训练的外推方法，充分体现了相关性指导的位置编码在长上下文泛化方面的价值。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mitigating Position Bias in Transformers via Layer-Specific Positional Embedding Scaling
papers.title_zh: 通过逐层缩放位置嵌入缓解 Transformer 的位置偏差
papers.authors: Zhenghua Wang, Yiran Ding, Changze Lv, Yixin Wu, Tianlong Li, Zhibo Xu, Muling Wu, Tianyuan Shi, Shizheng Li, Qi Qian, Xuanjing Huang, Xiaoqing Zheng
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) still struggle with the “lost-in-the-middle” problem, where critical information located in the middle of long-context inputs is often underrepresented or lost. While existing methods attempt to address this by combining multi-scale rotary position embeddings (RoPE), they typically suffer from high latency or rely on suboptimal hand-crafted scaling strategies. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a layer-specific positional embedding scaling (LPES) method that assigns distinct scaling factors to each layer. LPES achieves a more balanced attention distribution without fine-tuning model parameters or increasing inference delay. A specially designed genetic algorithm is employed to efficiently select the optimal scaling factors for each layer by incorporating B’ezier curves to significantly reduce the search space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LPES effectively mitigates positional attention bias and delivers consistent improvements across multiple long-context benchmarks, yielding up to an 11.2% accuracy gain on the key-value retrieval dataset.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解决“中间信息丢失”的问题上仍然存在困难，即那些位于长上下文输入中间的关键信息往往被低估或完全丢失。虽然现有方法试图通过结合多尺度旋转位置嵌入来解决这个问题，但这些方法通常存在延迟问题，或者依赖于不太理想的手动缩放策略。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种基于层特定位置嵌入缩放的方法，该方法为每一层分配不同的缩放因子。LPES能够在不进行模型参数微调或增加推理延迟的情况下，实现更均衡的注意力分布。我们采用了一种专门设计的遗传算法，通过结合B’ezier曲线来有效选择每层的最优缩放因子，从而显著减少搜索空间。大量实验表明，LPES能够有效缓解位置注意力偏差的问题，并在多个长上下文基准测试中带来持续的改进效果，在键值检索数据集上的准确率提升了11.2%。

papers.title: Semantic-pragmatic Annotations in the Prague Dependency Treebank
papers.title_zh: 布拉格依存句法树库中的语义-语用注释
papers.authors: Marie Mikulová, Eva Hajicova, Jiří Mírovský, Anna Nedoluzhko, Michal Novák, Pavlína Synková, Jan Štěpánek, Barbora Štěpánková, Jan Hajič
papers.abstract: We present semantic-pragmatic specification and annotation (ellipsis, coreference, bridging and discourse relations, information structure, scope of negation) in the multi-layer, genre-diversified, 3+ million-token Prague Dependency Treebank – Consolidated 2. 0. While morphology and syntax work almost exclusively on sentence level, the semantic-pragmatic phenomena are often related to two or more neighbouring sentences and possibly to an extra-linguistic context. In the contribution, we describe these phenomena from both the linguistic perspective (form of expression, relation to syntax and morphology) and the cognitive perspective (relation to context, real world knowledge, as well as to the related processes such as thinking or reasoning) – classifying the possible relations between the semantic-pragmatic units into cognitively plausible, distinguishable, and human-understandable categories. We have applied our results to the corpus, by annotating it in its entirety. The resulting dataset is publicly and freely available, to serve for verification and further investigation of (not only) these phenomena.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们在多层、多种文体构成的、包含300万个词条的布拉格依存树库——整合版2.0中，提出了语义-语用规范与注释方法。其中，语义-语用现象往往与两个或更多相邻的句子相关，甚至可能涉及非语言语境。在本文中，我们从语言学角度（表达方式、与句法和形态学的关联）以及认知角度（与上下文、现实世界知识的关系，以及与思考或推理等相关过程的关系）对这些问题进行了描述。我们将语义-语用单位之间可能存在的各种关系分类为：具有认知合理性、可区分且易于人类理解的类别。我们已经将研究结果应用于该语料库，对其进行了全面的标注。最终生成的数据集已公开免费提供，可供验证和进一步研究这些现象之用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Penetrating Linguistic Disguises: A Slang-aware Label-Aligned Framework for Fine-Grained Toxicity Extraction in Chinese Hate Speech Detection
papers.title_zh: 揭示语言背后的伪装：一种基于俚语的标签对齐框架，用于中文仇恨言论检测中细致入微的毒性内容提取
papers.authors: Wei Liu, Xiaoliang Chen, Duoqian Miao, Xu Gu, Xianyong Li, Yajun Du
papers.abstract: Flexible word boundaries and linguistic obfuscation, particularly slang, challenge precise span-level hate speech detection in Chinese. While benchmarks such as STATE ToxiCN demand the exact extraction of Target-Argument-Hateful-Group quadruples, generative Large Language Models (LLMs) often fail strict boundary constraints. In contrast, discriminative 2D Grid Tagging methods frequently encounter label collisions. To resolve these problems, this study presents a Slang-aware Label-Aligned Framework. A Structural-Semantic Lexicon Fusion (SSLF) module reduces ambiguity by mapping obscure slang to explicit hate semantics. Additionally, the proposed Label-Disentangled Volumetric Tagging (LDVT) projects token interactions into a volumetric space. LDVT uses task-specific branches and dedicated label channels to structurally mitigate feature interference. This approach removes label collisions without heuristic post-processing. Empirical outcomes on STATE ToxiCN indicate a Hard-F1 of 30.09%. This performance is 5.82% higher than the best fine-tuned LLM baseline and confirms the method is effective for exact-match extraction.
papers.abstract_zh: 灵活的词边界和语言模糊性，尤其是俚语，给中文精确检测仇恨言论带来了挑战。像STATE ToxiCN这样的基准测试要求准确提取目标-论点-仇恨群体这四个元素，而生成式大语言模型往往无法严格遵守这些边界限制。相比之下，判别性二维网格标注方法经常会出现标签冲突问题。为了解决这些问题，本研究提出了一种考虑俚语的标签对齐框架。结构语义词汇融合模块通过将晦涩的俚语映射到明确的仇恨语义上来减少歧义。此外，所提出的标签解耦体积标注方法将令牌交互投射到体积空间中。LDVT使用特定任务的分支和专用标签通道来结构性地减轻特征干扰。这种方法无需启发式后处理就能消除标签冲突。在STATE ToxiCN上的实证结果表明，该方法的Hard-F1值为30.09%。这一性能比最佳训练的LLM基线高出5.82%，证明该方法对于精确匹配提取是有效的。

papers.title: LightMoE: Task-Aware Expert Availability Management for Memory-Efficient MoE-LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: LightMoE：基于任务需求的专家可用性管理，以实现内存高效的MoE-LLM推理
papers.authors: Puhan Luo, Yunhao Yao, Junyang Wang, Junyang Zhang, Xiangyang Li
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer a promising path for scaling model capacity, yet their massive memory footprint poses significant challenges for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Existing solutions, such as static pruning or dynamic offloading, often struggle to balance model accuracy with inference latency due to irreversible information loss or prohibitive I/O overhead. In this paper, we propose LightMoE, a novel framework for memory-efficient MoE inference that exploits the inherent functional redundancy and temporal locality of expert activation. LightMoE employs a frequency-aware expert initialization strategy to retain a compact core of resident experts and introduces a similarity-based redirection mechanism to compensate for missing experts without incurring I/O costs. Furthermore, it incorporates a lightweight runtime manager that performs coarse-grained, task-level expert replacement to adapt to shifting data distributions. Empirical evaluations on representative edge platforms demonstrate that LightMoE achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off, improving average accuracy by 4.3% over static pruning and 2.4% over dynamic swapping methods, while maintaining inference latency comparable to strictly pruned models.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合模型为提升模型处理能力提供了有前景的途径，但其庞大的内存占用对资源有限的边缘设备的部署构成了重大挑战。现有的解决方案，如静态剪枝或动态卸载，往往难以在模型精度与推理延迟之间取得平衡，因为存在不可逆转的信息丢失或过高的I/O开销问题。在本文中，我们提出了LightMoE这一新型框架，该框架旨在实现高效的内存占用下的专家激活推理。LightMoE采用频率感知的专家初始化策略来保留核心的驻留专家，并引入基于相似性的重定向机制来弥补缺失专家的问题，同时避免产生I/O成本。此外，它还包含一个轻量级的运行时管理器，能够执行粗粒度、任务级别的专家替换操作，以适应不断变化的数据分布。在代表性的边缘平台上的实验表明，LightMoE在精度与效率方面取得了显著优势：平均精度比静态剪枝方法提高了4.3%，比动态交换方法提高了2.4%，同时保持了与严格剪枝模型相当的推理延迟。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SelfBudgeter: Adaptive Token Allocation for Efficient LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 自预算器：自适应代币分配，以实现高效的大语言模型推理
papers.authors: Zheng Li, Qingxiu Dong, Jingyuan Ma, Di Zhang, Kai Jia, Zhifang Sui
papers.abstract: Recently, large reasoning models demonstrate exceptional performance on various tasks. However, reasoning models always consume excessive tokens even for simple queries, leading to resource waste and prolonged user latency. To address this challenge, we propose SelfBudgeter - a self-adaptive reasoning strategy for efficient and controllable reasoning. Specifically, we first train the model to self-estimate the required reasoning budget based on the query. We then introduce budget-guided GRPO for reinforcement learning, which effectively maintains accuracy while reducing output length. Experimental results demonstrate that SelfBudgeter dynamically allocates budgets according to problem complexity, achieving an average response length compression of 61% on math reasoning tasks while maintaining accuracy. Furthermore, SelfBudgeter allows users to see how long generation will take and decide whether to continue or stop. Additionally, users can directly control the reasoning length by setting token budgets upfront.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，大型推理模型在各类任务上展现出了卓越的性能。然而，即便是对于简单的查询，这些推理模型也总是消耗大量的资源，导致资源浪费以及用户等待时间的延长。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了SelfBudgeter——一种自适应推理策略，旨在实现高效且可控的推理过程。具体来说，我们首先训练模型能够根据查询内容自行估算所需的推理预算。然后，我们引入了基于预算引导的GRPO强化学习算法，该算法能够在保持准确性的同时，有效减少输出长度。实验结果表明，SelfBudgeter能够根据问题的复杂性动态分配预算，在数学推理任务上实现了平均响应长度压缩61%的效果，同时仍保持了较高的准确性。此外，SelfBudgeter还允许用户了解生成过程的耗时情况，从而决定是否继续或停止推理过程。另外，用户还可以通过预先设置令牌预算来直接控制推理的长度。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Streaming Hallucination Detection in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 在长文本推理中用于幻觉检测的流式处理技术
papers.authors: Haolang Lu, Minghui Pan, Ripeng LI, Guoshun Nan, Jialin Zhuang, Zijie Zhao, Zhongxiang Sun, Kun Wang, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves the performance of large language models, yet hallucinations in such settings often emerge subtly and propagate across reasoning steps. We suggest that hallucination in long CoT reasoning is better understood as an evolving latent state rather than a one-off erroneous event. Accordingly, we treat step-level hallucination judgments as local observations and introduce a cumulative prefix-level hallucination signal that tracks the global evolution of the reasoning state over the entire trajectory. Overall, our approach enables streaming hallucination detection in long CoT reasoning, providing real-time, interpretable evidence.
papers.abstract_zh: 长链思维推理能够提升大语言模型的性能，但在这种情况下，幻觉现象往往以一种微妙的方式出现，并会在推理过程中不断扩散。我们认为，长链思维推理中的幻觉更应该被理解为一种不断演变的潜在状态，而不是一次性的错误事件。因此，我们将步骤级别的幻觉判断视为局部观察结果，同时引入一个累积的前置级幻觉信号，以追踪整个推理过程中的全局变化。总体而言，我们的方法能够实现长链思维推理过程中的实时幻觉检测，提供可解释的实时证据。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Training-Free Adaptive Speculative Decoding via Linguistic Priors
papers.title_zh: 无需训练的自适应推测解码方法——基于语言先验的知识
papers.authors: Jingyi Wang, Jiaqi Huang, Zunnan Xu, Jun Zhou, Kehong Yuan, Xiang Qian
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SPD) has emerged as a promising technique to accelerate Large Language Model (LLM) inference. However, current approaches typically enforce a uniform verification standard, neglecting the inherent heterogeneity of natural language and failing to distinguish between semantically-rich content and structurally-predictable syntax. In this paper, we propose LinguaSpec, a training-free framework that leverages linguistic priors to enable adaptive drafting and verification. Specifically, we introduce: (1) a Static Linguistic Probe (SLP) to categorize tokens with zero latency; (2) Syntactic Normalized Surprisal (SNS) to calibrate uncertainty against category-specific entropy; and (3) a dual strategy of Syntactically-Guided Elastic Expansion and POS-Adaptive Deferred Verification to dynamically adjust drafting depth and verification rigor. By balancing semantic integrity with structural efficiency, LinguaSpec significantly accelerates inference without requiring additional training. Experimental results demonstrate its superior performance across diverse benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 思辨解码技术已被认为是加速大语言模型推理的一种有前景的方法。然而，目前的方法通常采用统一的验证标准，这忽略了自然语言的固有多样性，也无法区分语义丰富的内容与结构可预测的语言形式。在本文中，我们提出了LinguaSpec这一无需训练的框架，该框架利用语言先验知识来实现自适应式的草稿生成和验证。具体来说，我们引入了以下三种机制：(1)静态语言探针，能够零延迟地对标记进行分类；(2)句法标准化惊讶度算法，用于将不确定性与特定类别的熵进行校准；(3)句法引导的弹性扩展策略与词性自适应延迟验证策略，这些策略可以动态调节草稿生成的深度和验证的严格程度。通过平衡语义完整性与结构效率，LinguaSpec能够在不需要额外训练的情况下显著加速推理过程。实验结果表明，该框架在多种基准测试中的表现均优于其他方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Knowledge-Infused Multi-Bit Watermarking for RAG Knowledge Bases
papers.title_zh: 适用于RAG知识库的、具有知识嵌入功能的多比特水印技术
papers.authors: Ke Yang, Shuguang Yuan, Jing Yu, Chi Chen
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the factual accuracy of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs based on external knowledge bases. These knowledge bases often carry significant intellectual property (IP) value, raising the urgent need for robust watermarking techniques to protect IP. However, existing RAG watermarking methods remain in their infancy, facing challenges such as limited encoding capacity and potential degradation of RAG performance or knowledge quality. In this paper, we propose knowledge-infused and multi-bit watermarking (KMW) for RAG knowledge bases. It generates watermark text to infuse the knowledge base by benign knowledge completion and a tailored generative watermarking algorithm. Each generated text can carry a multi-bit watermark segment. For effective detection, we design a Watermark Text Indexer that optimizes queries for steady retrieval of watermarked texts. Experiments on multiple datasets and LLMs show KMW reliably extracts watermarks from adversarial RAGs. It is robust against knowledge selection, alteration, expansion, and RAG setting restrictions, while remaining stealthy and secure. This highlights that KMW ensures effective IP protection for RAG systems. Our code is available here https://github.com/iieSKLCSDsg/KMW.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术能够基于外部知识库提升大语言模型输出的准确性。这些知识库往往蕴含着重要的知识产权价值，因此迫切需要有效的水印技术来保护知识产权。然而，现有的RAG水印处理方法仍处于初级阶段，面临着编码能力有限以及可能降低RAG性能或知识质量等问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于知识注入的多位水印技术，用于RAG知识库。该技术通过良性的知识填充和专门设计的水印算法，生成水印文本以注入知识库。每生成一段文本都可以携带一个多位水印片段。为了有效检测水印，我们设计了水印文本索引器，以优化查询方式，从而实现稳定地检索到带有水印的文本。在多个数据集和大语言模型上的实验表明，该技术能够可靠地从含有水印的RAG数据中提取水印信息。该技术能够抵抗知识选择、篡改、扩展以及RAG设置限制的影响，同时保持隐蔽性和安全性。这证明了多位数水印技术对于保护RAG系统的知识产权具有重要作用。我们的代码可以在以下链接下载：https://github.com/iieSKLCSDsg/KMW。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ClimAgent: LLM as Agents for Autonomous Open-ended Climate Science Analysis
papers.title_zh: ClimAgent：将大语言模型作为代理，用于自主性的开放式气候科学分析任务
papers.authors: Hao Wang, Jindong Han, Wei Fan, Hao Liu
papers.abstract: Climate research is pivotal for mitigating global environmental crises, yet the accelerating volume of multi-scale datasets and the complexity of analytical tools have created significant bottlenecks, constraining scientific discovery to fragmented and labor-intensive workflows. While the emergence Large Language Models (LLMs) offers a transformative paradigm to scale scientific expertise, existing explorations remain largely confined to simple Question-Answering (Q A) tasks. These approaches often oversimplify real-world challenges, neglecting the intricate physical constraints and the data-driven nature required in professional climate science. To bridge this gap, we introduce ClimAgent, a general-purpose autonomous framework designed to execute a wide spectrum of research tasks across diverse climate sub-fields. By integrating a unified tool-use environment with rigorous reasoning protocols, ClimAgent transcends simple retrieval to perform end-to-end modeling and analysis. To foster systematic evaluation, we propose ClimaBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for real-world climate discovery. It encompasses challenging problems spanning 5 distinct task categories derived from professional scenarios between 2000 and 2025. Experiments on ClimaBench demonstrate that ClimAgent significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 40.21% improvement over original LLM solutions in solution rigorousness and practicality. Our code are available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/ClimAgent.
papers.abstract_zh: 气候研究对于缓解全球环境危机至关重要，然而，多尺度数据集的快速增长以及分析工具的复杂性导致了严重的瓶颈问题，使得科学发现局限于碎片化的、劳动密集型的工作流程中。而大语言模型的出现为扩展科学专业知识提供了变革性的途径，但现有的探索大多仍局限于简单的问答任务。这些方法往往过度简化了现实世界中的挑战，忽视了专业气候科学所需的复杂物理约束和数据驱动性。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了ClimAgent——一个通用型自主框架，旨在执行各种气候子领域的研究任务。通过整合统一的工具使用环境与严格的推理协议，ClimAgent能够超越简单的检索功能，实现端到端的建模与分析。为了促进系统的评估工作，我们提出了ClimaBench——首个针对现实世界气候发现的综合基准测试。该测试涵盖了从2000年到2025年间由专业场景衍生出的5种不同任务类别的挑战性问题。在ClimaBench上的实验表明，ClimAgent的表现显著优于最先进的基线算法，其在解决方案的严谨性和实用性方面比传统的大语言模型解决方案提升了40.21%。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/usail-hkust/ClimAgent下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CogBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Alignment of Large Language Models in Educational Question Answering
papers.title_zh: CogBench：用于评估大型语言模型在教育问答领域中的认知能力的基准测试工具
papers.authors: Tong Lu, Zhichun Wang, Yuanhao Sun, Yaoyu Zhou, Mingrui Li, Yiming Guan, Zhiyong Bai
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) possess strong capabilities in language understanding and generation, as well as remarkable problem-solving abilities. In the educational domain, a representative application is to employ LLMs as learning assistants that answer students’ questions and support their learning processes. In such scenarios, it is crucial for the model to perceive a student’s cognitive level and provide explanations that are appropriate to that level. However, whether LLMs can effectively accomplish this task has not yet been thoroughly investigated. To address this gap, we introduce CogBench, an evaluation benchmark designed to assess the cognitive alignment capabilities of LLMs in educational QA. CogBench comprises 2.1K mathematics questions, each associated with multiple valid solutions that rely on knowledge and reasoning at different cognitive levels. Building on this structure, we formulate three cognition-aware evaluation tasks and propose three complementary metrics to quantify cognitive alignment from multiple perspectives. Extensive experiments on 11 representative LLMs reveal that, while models can often produce correct answers, they still struggle to consistently generate explanations that are aligned with the intended cognitive level. These results highlight substantial room for improvement and establish CogBench as a diagnostic benchmark for advancing cognitively aligned educational AI systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在语言理解和生成方面拥有强大的能力，同时还能出色地解决各种问题。在教育领域，一个典型的应用是将大语言模型作为学习助手，回答学生的问题并支持他们的学习过程。在这种情况下，模型必须能够感知学生的认知水平，并提供适合该水平的解释。然而，大语言模型是否能够有效完成这一任务尚未得到充分研究。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了CogBench这个评估基准，用于评估大语言模型在教育问答领域的认知对齐能力。CogBench包含2.1K道数学题，每道题都有多个有效的解决方案，这些解决方案依赖于不同认知层次的知识和推理能力。基于这一结构，我们制定了三个考虑认知因素的评估任务，并提出了三种互补的指标来从多个角度量化认知对齐程度。对11种代表性大语言模型的广泛实验表明，虽然模型通常能够给出正确的答案，但它们仍然难以始终生成与预期认知水平相一致的解释。这些结果凸显了改进的空间，并使CogBench成为推动认知对齐教育人工智能系统发展的诊断性基准。

papers.title: CARL: Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Planning with LLMs
papers.title_zh: 卡尔：基于约束意识的强化学习在大型语言模型规划中的应用
papers.authors: Qiuyi Qi, Jinjian Zhang, Mutian Bao, Tian Liang, Guocong Li, Dongnan Liu, Wei Zhou, Jie Liu, Ming Kong, Linjian Mo, Feng Zhang, Qiang Zhu
papers.abstract: Despite their strong reasoning capabilities and extensive world knowledge, Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently generate plans that violate task constraints, undermining their reliability in real-world applications. This deficiency arises from a lack of systematic mechanisms to incorporate constraint information during the generation process. While existing approaches attempt to mitigate this by relying on external tools or task decomposition, they fail to enhance the model’s intrinsic constraint awareness. To address this, we propose Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning (CARL), a novel RL framework designed to strengthen LLMs’ intrinsic focus on constraints. CARL introduces a constraint-aware reward by comparing the model’s output distributions under constrained and unconstrained inputs, encouraging constraint focus and penalizing neglect.Compatible with various RL frameworks and requiring no external solvers or top models, CARL enables scalable, end-to-end constraint-aware planning. Extensive experiments on BlocksWorld, TravelPlanner, and T-Eval demonstrate that CARL significantly outperforms standard Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) baselines and state-of-the-art reasoning models, exhibiting a markedly increased focus on constraints.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型具备强大的推理能力和丰富的世界知识，但它们经常生成违反任务约束的计划，这降低了它们在现实应用中的可靠性。这种缺陷源于在生成过程中缺乏系统化的机制来整合约束信息。虽然现有方法试图通过依赖外部工具或任务分解来缓解这一问题，但这些方法未能提升模型对约束的感知能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了基于约束意识的强化学习（Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning，CARL）框架。该框架通过比较模型在受约束与不受约束输入下的输出分布，引入一种基于约束意识的奖励机制，从而鼓励模型关注约束条件，并惩罚其忽视约束的行为。CARL可以与各种强化学习框架兼容，且无需依赖外部求解器或顶尖模型，它能够实现可扩展、端到端的约束意识规划。在BlocksWorld、TravelPlanner和T-Eval上的大量实验表明，CARL在性能上显著优于传统的强化学习微调方法和最先进的推理模型，其对于约束条件的关注程度也明显提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ChildEval:WHEN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS MEET CHILDREN’S PERSONALITIES
papers.title_zh: ChildEval：当大型语言模型与儿童性格特征相遇时
papers.authors: Yanyan Luo, Xue Han, Chunxu Zhao, Ruiqiao Bai, Yaxing Zhang, Qian Hu, Lijun Mei, Junlan Feng
papers.abstract: While LLMs enable personalized chatbots, their effectiveness in child-centered personalization remains unclear, as systematic evaluation of child-specific preferences is still lacking. To address this gap, we introduce ChildEval, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs’ ability to infer and follow child-centered preferences in long-context conversations. ChildEval contains 29K synthesized persona profiles of children aged 3–6, providing relatively static background information. Each persona is associated with a child preference—which may align with, conflict with, or be independent of the persona—expressed either explicitly in a single sentence or implicitly through 6–10 turn dialogues. Explicit and implicit preferences are designed to reflect the same underlying preference but differ in expression, capturing dynamic aspects of preference expression rather than changes in the static persona. The benchmark spans five top-level and fourteen sub-level categories covering children’s daily lives and development. We further propose fine-grained, child-centric evaluation protocols to systematically assess open-source LLMs. Experimental results demonstrate how different personalized representations affect LLM responses and suggest that finetuning on ChildEval can enhance child-centered performance. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ziyanluo/ChildEval.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型能够实现个性化聊天机器人，但其在以儿童为中心的个性化方面的效果仍不明确，因为对于儿童特定偏好的系统评估仍然缺乏。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ChildEval这一基准测试工具，用于评估大语言模型在长上下文对话中推断和遵循以儿童为中心的偏好能力。ChildEval包含了2.9万份针对3-6岁儿童的合成人物档案，这些档案提供了相对固定的背景信息。每个人物档案都与一个儿童偏好相关联——这个偏好可能与人物档案的内容一致、冲突，或者独立存在。这些偏好可以通过一句话明确表达，也可以通过6-10轮对话来隐含表达。明确和隐含的偏好都是为了反映相同的潜在偏好，但在表达方式上有所不同，从而能够捕捉到偏好表达的动态变化，而不是静态人物档案中的变化。该基准测试涵盖了五个顶层类别和十四个子类别，涉及儿童的日常生活和发展方面。我们还提出了细粒度的、以儿童为中心的评估方案，以便系统地评估开源大语言模型的表现。实验结果表明，不同的个性化表示方式会影响大语言模型的响应，并且表明在ChildEval上进行微调可以提高以儿童为中心的性能。我们的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/ziyanluo/ChildEval下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Belief in Authority: Impact of Authority in Multi-Agent Evaluation Framework
papers.title_zh: 对权威的信任：在多智能体评估框架中，权威所产生的影响
papers.authors: Junhyuk Choi, Jeongyoun Kwon, Heeju Kim, Haeun Cho, Hayeong Jung, Sehee Min, Bugeun Kim
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems utilizing large language models often assign authoritative roles to improve performance, yet the impact of authority bias on agent interactions remains underexplored. We present the first systematic analysis of role-based authority bias in free-form multi-agent evaluation using ChatEval. Applying French and Raven’s power-based theory, we classify authoritative roles into legitimate, referent, and expert types and analyze their influence across 12-turn conversations. Experiments with GPT-4o and DeepSeek R1 reveal that Expert and Referent power roles exert stronger influence than Legitimate power roles. Crucially, authority bias emerges not through active conformity by general agents, but through authoritative roles consistently maintaining their positions while general agents demonstrate flexibility. Furthermore, authority influence requires clear position statements, as neutral responses fail to generate bias. These findings provide key insights for designing multi-agent frameworks with asymmetric interaction patterns.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型的多智能体系统通常会为提升性能而分配权威角色，但权威偏见对智能体互动的影响却尚未得到充分研究。我们首次使用ChatEval对自由形式多智能体评估中的基于角色的权威偏见进行了系统分析。根据French和Raven的权力理论，我们将权威角色分为合法型、指称型和专家型三种类型，并分析了它们在12轮对话中的影响。对GPT-4o和DeepSeek R1的实验表明，专家型和指称型权力角色的影响力比合法型权力角色更为显著。关键的是，权威偏见并非通过一般智能体的主动顺从而产生，而是通过权威角色持续维护自己的立场，同时一般智能体表现出灵活性来实现的。此外，权威影响力需要明确的立场声明，因为中立的回应无法产生偏见。这些发现为设计具有非对称交互模式的多智能体框架提供了重要启示。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ToMELP: A Theory-of-Mind Benchmark for Route-Controlled Persuasion under the Elaboration Likelihood Model
papers.title_zh: ToMELP：一种用于在详述可能性模型下进行路线控制式说服的思维测试理论
papers.authors: Ruirui Wang, Haoran Zhang, Tian Lan, Zehua Duo, Jiang Li, Guanglai Gao, Xiangdong Su
papers.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM) is widely regarded as central to effective persuasion, yet existing evaluations often fail to capture the infer–apply loop that arises in real-world dialogue. We introduce Theory-of-Mind-Guided Elaboration-Likelihood Persuasion (ToMELP), a benchmark that jointly conditions on the audience persona p and the Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM) route r \in \{\text{central}, \text{peripheral}\} within persuasive conversations. The benchmark tests whether large language models can perform ToM inference over multi-turn interactions and leverage these inferences for controllable persuasive generation. ToMELP provides a structured interface with evidence annotations, enabling automated evaluation of persuasive effectiveness, route alignment/deviation, evidence quality under the central route, and robustness to perturbations.
papers.abstract_zh: 心智理论被广泛认为是有效说服的核心要素，然而现有的评估往往未能捕捉到现实对话中出现的推理与应用之间的循环关系。我们提出了“心智理论引导的详略程度说服模型”（ToMELP），该模型在说服性对话中同时考虑了受众特征p以及详略程度模型（ELM）中的路径r，即r属于\{\text{中心型}, \text{边缘型}\}。该模型旨在测试大语言模型是否能够在多轮互动中进行心智理论推理，并利用这些推理来生成可控的说服性内容。ToMELP提供了一个带有证据注释的结构化接口，使得可以自动评估说服效果、路径匹配/偏离情况、中心路径下的证据质量以及对干扰的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: StateX: Enhancing RNN Recall via Post-training State Expansion
papers.title_zh: StateX：通过训练后状态扩展来提高RNN的召回率
papers.authors: Xingyu Shen, Yingfa Chen, Zhen Leng Thai, Xu Han, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs), such as linear attention and state-space models, have gained popularity due to their constant per-token complexity when processing long contexts. However, these recurrent models struggle with tasks that require accurate recall of contextual information from long contexts, because all contextual information is compressed into a fixed-size recurrent state. Previous studies have shown that recall ability is positively correlated with the recurrent state size, yet directly training RNNs with large recurrent states results in high training costs. In this paper, we introduce StateX, a post-training framework that efficiently expands the states of pre-trained RNNs. For two popular classes of RNNs, linear attention and state-space models, we design post-training architectural modifications in StateX, to scale up the state size with no or negligible increase in model parameters. Experiments on models with up to 1.3B parameters demonstrate that StateX efficiently enhances the recall and in-context learning performance of RNNs without incurring high post-training costs or compromising other capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 循环神经网络（RNNs），如线性注意力模型和状态空间模型，在处理长上下文时因其恒定的每标记复杂度而受到青睐。然而，这些循环模型在需要准确回忆来自长上下文的上下文信息时存在困难，因为所有上下文信息都被压缩到一个固定大小的状态中。先前的研究表明，回忆能力与循环状态的大小呈正相关，但直接使用大型循环状态来训练RNNs会导致高昂的训练成本。在本文中，我们提出了StateX这一后训练框架，它能够有效扩展预训练的RNNs的状态规模。对于两种常见的RNNs模型——线性注意力模型和状态空间模型，我们在StateX中设计了后训练架构上的改进措施，从而在不增加或仅轻微增加模型参数的情况下扩大状态规模。针对参数高达13亿的模型的实验表明，StateX能够在不产生高成本或牺牲其他性能的情况下，有效提升RNNs的回忆能力和上下文学习能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TOXIFRENCH: Benchmarking and Enhancing Language Models via CoT Fine-Tuning for French Toxicity Detection
papers.title_zh: 针对法语的毒性检测：通过协同训练来优化语言模型的表现
papers.authors: Axel Delaval, Shujian Yang, Haicheng Wang, Han Qiu, Jialiang LU
papers.abstract: Detecting toxic content using language models is crucial yet challenging. While substantial progress has been made in English, toxicity detection in French remains underdeveloped, primarily due to the lack of culturally relevant, human-annotated, large-scale datasets. In this work, we release TOXIFRENCH, a dataset of 53,622 French online comments, together with a 1,388-sample balanced benchmark split for systematic evaluation. The dataset is constructed via a semi-automated annotation pipeline that reduces manual labeling to only 10% through high-confidence LLM-based pre-annotation and human verification, while ensuring statistically near-perfect alignment with human-only annotation. We then benchmark a broad range of models and uncover a counterintuitive insight: Small Language Models (SLMs) often surpass larger models in robustness and generalization on this task. Motivated by this finding, we propose a novel Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning strategy using a dynamic weighted loss that progressively emphasizes the model’s final decision, significantly improving faithfulness. Our fine-tuned 4B model (Qwen3-4B) achieves state-of-the-art performance on the benchmark, improving its balanced accuracy by 10% over its baseline and achieving better performance than GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 on our benchmark, while successfully retaining cross-lingual capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 使用语言模型检测有毒内容是一项至关重要但充满挑战的任务。虽然英语领域的进展显著，但法语中的毒性检测仍然较为落后，主要原因在于缺乏具有文化相关性、由人类标注的大规模数据集。在这项研究中，我们发布了TOXIFRENCH数据集，该数据集包含53,622条法语在线评论，同时还提供了一个包含1,388个样本的平衡测试集，以便进行系统性的评估。该数据集是通过半自动标注流程构建的，通过基于大语言模型的预标注和人类验证，将手动标注的比例降低到了10%，同时确保了与人类标注在统计上几乎完全一致。随后，我们对各种模型进行了基准测试，发现了一个反直觉的现象：小型语言模型在鲁棒性和泛化能力方面往往优于大型模型。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种新颖的链式思维微调策略，该策略使用动态加权损失函数，逐步强调模型的最终决策，从而显著提高模型的准确性。我们的4B模型（Qwen3-4B）在基准测试中的表现达到了顶尖水平，其平衡准确率比基线模型提高了10%，并且在我们的基准测试上取得了优于GPT-4o和DeepSeek-R1的成绩，同时还能成功保留跨语言处理能力。
