papers.title: Memory-Guided Hard Data Augmentation for Multimodal Named Entity Recognition
papers.title_zh: 基于记忆的硬数据增强技术，用于多模态命名实体识别任务
papers.authors: Xinyu Liu, Kai fu, Yinghan Shi, Quanyou Chu, Ming Du, Hongya Wang, Xiaojun Meng, Jiansheng Wei, Yanghua Xiao, Bo Xu
papers.abstract: Multimodal Named Entity Recognition relies on visual context to resolve textual ambiguities. To mitigate data scarcity, Data Augmentation (DA) has become a standard practice; however, existing methods predominantly adopt a one-size-fits-all and random perturbation paradigm, ignoring the internal state of the target model. In this paper, we first conduct a quantitative analysis, revealing that a significant portion of errors (over 30%) are model-specific, stemming from the unique biases of different architectures. To address this, we propose Memory-Guided Hard Data Augmentation, a framework designed to systematically repair these specific defects. First, we employ K-fold cross-validation to identify model-specific Hard Data. Second, we construct a Memory Tree and utilize Large Language Models (LLMs) with a clustering mechanism to induce macro-level error patterns from micro-level failures. This facilitates a paradigm shift from stateless instance-driven augmentation to a logical pattern-driven approach. Finally, we introduce an iterative augmentation mechanism that triggers recursive generation for stubborn instances that fail initial quality filters. Extensive experiments on Twitter-2015 and Twitter-2017 benchmarks demonstrate that our framework consistently yields significant performance gains across various MNER backbones.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态命名实体识别依赖于视觉上下文来解决文本歧义问题。为了缓解数据稀缺的问题，数据增强已成为一种标准做法；然而，现有的方法大多采用一刀切的随机扰动方式，忽略了目标模型的内部状态。在本文中，我们首先进行了定量分析，发现超过30%的错误是模型特有的，这些错误源于不同架构的独特特性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于记忆的硬数据增强方法，该方法旨在系统地修复这些特定缺陷。首先，我们使用K折交叉验证来识别模型特有的硬数据。其次，我们构建了一个记忆树结构，并利用大语言模型结合聚类机制，从微观层面的失败中推断出宏观层面的错误模式。这促使我们从无状态的实例驱动增强方式转向基于逻辑模式的增强方式。最后，我们引入了一种迭代增强机制，对于无法通过初始质量筛选的顽固实例，会触发递归生成。在Twitter-2015和Twitter-2017数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的框架能够在各种多模态命名实体识别模型中持续带来显著的性能提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DUET: Joint Exploration of User–Item Profiles in Recommendation System
papers.title_zh: DUET：推荐系统中用户与物品属性的联合探索
papers.authors: Yue Chen, Yifei Sun, Lu Wang, Fangkai Yang, Pu Zhao, Minjie Hong, Yifei Dong, Minghua He, Nan Hu, Jianjin Zhang, Zhiwei Dai, Yuefeng Zhan, Weihao Han, Hao Sun, Qingwei Lin, Weiwei Deng, Feng Sun, Qi Zhang, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang
papers.abstract: Traditional recommendation systems represent users and items as dense vectors and learn to align them in a shared latent space for relevance estimation. Recent LLM-based recommenders instead leverage natural-language representations that are easier to interpret and integrate with downstream reasoning modules. This paper studies how to construct effective textual profiles for users and items, and how to align them for recommendation.A central difficulty is that the best profile format is not known a priori: manually designed templates can be brittle and misaligned with task objectives. Moreover, generating user and item profiles independently may produce descriptions that are individually plausible yet semantically inconsistent for a specific user–item pair. We propose Duet, an interaction-aware profile generator that jointly produces user and item profiles conditioned on both user history and item evidence. Duet follows a three-stage procedure: it first turns raw histories and metadata into compact cues, then expands these cues into paired profile prompts and then generate profiles, and finally optimizes the generation policy with reinforcement learning using downstream recommendation performance as feedback. Experiments on three real-world datasets show that Duet consistently outperforms strong baselines, demonstrating the benefits of template-free profile exploration and joint user–item textual alignment. Project page: https://duet-rec.github.io/.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的推荐系统将用户和物品表示为密集向量，并学习在共享的潜在空间中将它们对齐，以进行相关性估计。而基于大语言模型的推荐系统则利用自然语言表示，这种表示更容易解释，并且可以与下游推理模块集成。本文研究了如何构建有效的用户和物品文本描述，以及如何将它们对齐以实现推荐。一个主要的难点在于，最佳的描述格式是事先未知的：手动设计的模板可能不够灵活，且可能与任务目标不符。此外，分别生成用户和物品的描述时，可能会得到看似合理但针对特定用户-物品对而言语义上不一致的描述。我们提出了Duet这一交互感知的描述生成器，它能够根据用户的历史记录和物品信息来共同生成用户和物品的详细描述。Duet采用三阶段流程：首先，将原始历史记录和元数据转化为简洁的线索；然后，将这些线索扩展为成对的描述提示；最后，生成详细的描述，并通过强化学习来优化生成策略，同时以下游推荐性能作为反馈。在三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，Duet始终优于其他强大的基线方法，这证明了无模板的描述探索以及用户与物品文本的联合对齐所带来的优势。项目页面：https://duet-rec.github.io/
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ATAAT: Adaptive Threat-Aware Adversarial Tuning Framework against Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: ATAAT：一种自适应威胁感知的对抗性调优框架，旨在应对针对视觉-语言-动作模型的后门攻击
papers.authors: Kewei Chen, Yayu Long, Shuai Li, Mingsheng Shang
papers.abstract: Addressing the escalating security vulnerabilities in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, this study investigates backdoor attacks targeting the visual pathway. We identify a core obstacle causing the failure of traditional attack paradigms: “Gradient Interference.” This phenomenon represents an optimization failure triggered by conflicting strategies during end-to-end training. To resolve this, we propose an Adaptive Threat-Aware Adversarial Tuning (ATAAT) framework. Through its core “Threat-Method Adaptive Mapping” mechanism, ATAAT intelligently selects the optimal gradient decoupling strategy based on the adversary’s capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ATAAT exhibits significant advantages, achieving a highly robust Targeted Attack Success Rate (TASR > 80%) while maintaining extreme stealthiness with merely a 5% poisoning rate. It efficiently handles complex semantic-level triggers and achieves implicit decoupled attacks in data poisoning scenarios for the first time. This work reveals a critical security vulnerability in VLAs and provides theoretical and methodological support for future defense architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对视觉-语言-动作模型日益严重的安全漏洞问题，本研究探讨了针对视觉路径的后门攻击。我们发现了一个导致传统攻击方法失效的核心障碍：“梯度干扰”。这种现象是由于在端到端训练过程中策略冲突引发的优化失败。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种自适应威胁感知对抗调整框架。通过其核心的“威胁-方法自适应映射”机制，ATAAT能够根据敌手的能力智能选择最优的梯度分离策略。大量实验表明，ATAAT具有显著优势，其目标攻击成功率高达80%以上，同时具备极高的隐蔽性，中毒率仅为5%。它能够有效处理复杂的语义级触发条件，并首次实现了在数据中毒场景中实施隐式分离攻击。这项工作揭示了视觉-语言-动作模型中的一个关键安全漏洞，并为未来的防御架构提供了理论和方法上的支持。

papers.title: CoTrust: Privacy-Preserving Collaboration Between Large and Small Language Models in Trusted Execution Environments
papers.title_zh: CoTrust：在可信执行环境中，让大型与小型语言模型之间进行保护隐私的协作
papers.authors: Zhenya Ma, Tingyi Wang, Yongheng Deng, Ziqing Qiao, Yinggui Wang, Tao Wei, Lei Wang, Ju Ren
papers.abstract: Services powered by large language models (LLMs) provide powerful text generation capabilities, but accessing sensitive user inputs raises serious privacy concerns. Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) provide a secure computation environment, enabling sensitive inputs to be safely processed. However, directly deploying high-capacity LLMs in TEEs is often prohibitively expensive due to computation and memory constraints. To reconcile privacy, efficiency, and generation quality, we propose CoTrust, a privacy-preserving collaborative inference framework that combines LLMs with small language models (SLMs) inside TEE. CoTrust uses multiple de-identified views to let the LLM produce a consensus scaffold capturing answer reasoning without exposing private information, which the SLM then grounds in the full input to generate the final response. Experiments on multiple question answering and summarization benchmarks show that CoTrust approaches the performance of unconstrained LLMs, outperforms existing privacy-preserving baselines, and maintains strong privacy protection, while remaining efficient in a TDX-based TEE implementation.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型（LLMs）驱动的服务提供了强大的文本生成能力，但处理用户的敏感输入会引发严重的隐私问题。可信执行环境（TEEs）则提供了一个安全的计算环境，使得敏感输入能够得到安全的处理。然而，由于计算和内存的限制，直接将在TEEs中部署高容量的LLMs往往成本过高。为了平衡隐私性、效率和生成质量，我们提出了CoTrust这一保护隐私的协作推理框架。该框架将LLMs与小型语言模型（SLMs）结合在TEE中运行。CoTrust通过多个去标识化的视图，让LLM生成包含答案推理的共识框架，而不会暴露私人信息。然后，SLM根据完整的输入数据来生成最终的响应。在多个问答和摘要评估基准上的实验表明，CoTrust在性能上达到了不受限制LLMs的水平，优于现有的保护隐私的基线方法，同时仍然能够在基于TDX的TEE实现中保持强大的隐私保护功能，并且保持高效性。

papers.title: FAQ: Mitigating Quantization Error via Regenerating Calibration Data with Family-Aware Quantization
papers.title_zh: 常见问题解答：如何通过基于家族特性的量化方法来减轻量化误差问题
papers.authors: Haiyang Xiao, Weiqing Li, Jinyue Guo, Guochao Jiang, Guohua Liu, Yuewei Zhang
papers.abstract: Although post-training quantization (PTQ) provides an efficient numerical compression scheme for deploying large language models (LLMs) on resource-constrained devices, the representativeness and universality of calibration data remain a core bottleneck in determining the accuracy of quantization parameters. Traditional PTQ methods typically rely on limited samples, making it difficult to capture the activation distribution during the inference phase, leading to biases in quantization parameters. To address this, we propose FAQ (Family-Aware Quantization), a calibration data regeneration framework that leverages prior knowledge from LLMs of the same family to generate high-fidelity calibration samples. Specifically, FAQ first inputs the original calibration samples into a larger LLM from the same family as the target model, regenerating a series of high-fidelity calibration data using a highly consistent knowledge system. Subsequently, this data, carrying Chain-of-Thought reasoning and conforming to the expected activation distribution, undergoes group competition under expert guidance to select the best samples, which are then re-normalized to enhance the effectiveness of standard PTQ. Experiments on multiple model series, including Qwen3-8B, show that FAQ reduces accuracy loss by up to 28.5% compared to the baseline with original calibration data, demonstrating its powerful potential and contribution.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然训练后量化技术为在资源有限的设备上部署大语言模型提供了高效的数值压缩方案，但校准数据的代表性与普遍性仍然是确定量化参数准确性的核心瓶颈。传统的量化方法通常依赖有限的样本数据，这使得在推理阶段难以捕捉激活分布的变化，从而导致量化参数的偏差。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了FAQ（家族感知量化）技术——一种利用同一家族中的大语言模型先验知识来生成高保真度校准样本的框架。具体来说，FAQ首先将原始校准样本输入到与目标模型属于同一家族的更大规模的语言模型中，从而生成一系列高保真度的校准数据。随后，这些数据通过链式思维推理处理，并符合预期的激活分布，然后在专家指导下进行分组竞争，以选出最佳样本。这些样本经过重新归一化处理后，能够进一步提升标准量化技术的效果。在多个模型系列上的实验表明，与使用原始校准数据的基线相比，FAQ能够将精度损失降低多达28.5%，充分体现了其强大的潜力和贡献价值。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HACHIMI: Scalable and Controllable Student Persona Generation via Orchestrated Agents
papers.title_zh: HACHIMI：通过协调一致的智能体实现可扩展且可控的学生角色生成
papers.authors: Yilin Jiang, Fei Tan, Xuanyu Yin, Leng Jing, Aimin Zhou
papers.abstract: Student Personas (SPs) are emerging as infrastructure for educational LLMs, yet prior work often relies on ad-hoc prompting or hand-crafted profiles with limited control over educational theory and population distributions. We formalize this as Theory-Aligned and Distribution-Controllable Persona Generation (TAD-PG) and introduce HACHIMI, a multi-agent Propose-Validate-Revise framework that generates theory-aligned, quota-controlled personas. HACHIMI factorizes each persona into a theory-anchored educational schema, enforces developmental and psychological constraints via a neuro-symbolic validator, and combines stratified sampling with semantic deduplication to reduce mode collapse. The resulting HACHIMI-1M corpus comprises 1 million personas for Grades 1-12. Intrinsic evaluation shows near-perfect schema validity, accurate quotas, and substantial diversity, while external evaluation instantiates personas as student agents answering CEPS and PISA 2022 surveys; across 16 cohorts, math and curiosity/growth constructs align strongly between humans and agents, whereas classroom-climate and well-being constructs are only moderately aligned, revealing a fidelity gradient. All personas are generated with Qwen2.5-72B, and HACHIMI provides a standardized synthetic student population for group-level benchmarking and social-science simulations. Resources available at https://github.com/ZeroLoss-Lab/HACHIMI.
papers.abstract_zh: 学生角色模型正在成为教育大语言模型的基础设施，但以往的研究往往依赖于临时提示或手工制作的配置文件，对教育理论和人群分布的控制能力有限。我们将其定义为“理论一致性与分布可控性角色生成”技术，并引入了HACHIMI这一多智能体提出、验证和修订框架，该框架能够生成符合理论要求且数量可控的角色模型。HACHIMI将每个角色模型分解为一个以理论为基础的教育框架，通过神经符号验证器来强制执行发展和心理方面的约束，同时结合分层抽样和语义去重技术来减少模式崩溃现象。最终的HACHIMI-1M数据集包含100万个1至12年级的学生角色模型。内在评估显示，这些角色模型的框架有效性接近完美，配额设置准确，多样性也相当丰富。而外部评估则通过让这些角色模型作为学生代理回答CEPS和PISA 2022调查问卷来验证其性能：在16个年龄组中，数学能力和好奇心/成长能力这两个维度在人类代理和真实学生之间具有高度一致性，而课堂环境感和幸福感这两个维度的相关性则较为中等，这揭示了不同角色模型之间的质量差异。所有角色模型都是使用Qwen2.5-72B模型生成的，HACHIMI还提供了一个标准化的合成学生群体，可用于群体层面的基准测试和社会科学模拟。相关资源可访问https://github.com/ZeroLoss-Lab/HACHIMI。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: D-QRELO: Training- and Data-Free Delta Compression for Large Language Models via Quantization and Residual Low-Rank Approximation
papers.title_zh: D-QRELO：通过量化技术和残差低秩近似技术实现无需训练和数据的语言模型增量压缩方法
papers.authors: Junlin Li, Shuangyong Song, Guodong DU, Ngai Wong, Xuebo Liu, Yongxiang Li, Min Zhang, Jing Li, Xuelong Li
papers.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) accelerates task-specific large language models (LLMs) development, but the resulting proliferation of fine-tuned models incurs substantial memory overhead. Delta compression addresses this by retaining a single pre-trained LLM with multiple compressed delta weights. However, existing methods fail on models fine-tuned with large-scale datasets. We find that larger SFT data scale amplifies delta parameter magnitude, singular values, and entropy, exacerbating compression errors. To tackle this, we propose D-QRELO ( \textbf{D}elta Compression via \textbf{Q}uantization and \textbf{R}sidual \textbf{Lo}w-Rank), a novel training- and data-free delta compression method. It combines coarse-grained one-bit quantization to capture the dominant structure of the delta, followed by compensated residual low-rank approximation to recover fine-grained details from the smaller residual error. Experiments on various LLMs spanning dense and MoE architectures across multiple domains under this challenging setting demonstrate that D-QRELO outperforms existing methods. Moreover, we establish key design principles for delta compression through extensive empirical analysis, demonstrating how task difficulty, architecture, and layer positioning create predictable patterns that can guide optimal compression strategies in production systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 监督式微调（SFT）能够加速针对特定任务的大语言模型开发，但由此产生的大量微调模型会带来巨大的内存负担。Delta压缩技术通过保留一个预训练的LLM，并为其添加多个压缩后的delta权重来解决这个问题。然而，现有方法在用于处理大规模数据集的微调模型时表现不佳。我们发现，更大的SFT数据规模会放大delta参数的幅度、奇异值和熵值，从而加剧压缩错误。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了D-QRELO技术——一种无需训练和数据的delta压缩方法。该方法结合了粗粒度的单比特量化，以捕捉delta的主要结构，然后通过补偿残差低秩近似，从较小的残差误差中恢复细粒度细节。在多个领域中对各种LLM进行的实验表明，D-QRELO技术优于现有的其他方法。此外，通过广泛的实证分析，我们确立了delta压缩的关键设计原则，揭示了任务难度、架构以及层位分布如何形成可预测的模式，这些模式可以为生产系统中的最优压缩策略提供指导。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Static Toolsets: Self-Evolving LLM Tool Agents via Continual Documentation Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 超越固定工具集：通过持续文档更新实现自我进化的大语言模型工具代理
papers.authors: Bin Wu, Edgar Meij, Emine Yilmaz
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as tool-using agents, and existing methods for evaluating and optimizing tool usage by LLMs typically assume a static tool environment with fixed APIs and documentation. In practice, toolsets evolve as tools are added, changed, or deprecated, introducing instability for agents that must retain prior competence while adapting to new capabilities. We formalize this challenge as the stability–adaptation dilemma. To address it, we propose ContDa, a continual documentation adaptation framework that provides a generalizable solution to this problem, enabling LLM agents to self-evolve by updating tool documentation. ContDa combines relation-guided exploration, which leverages functionally related existing tools as anchors to probe and identify new tool capabilities, with relation-aware adjustment that organizes overlapping tools and explicitly encodes usage preferences and fallback options among them. We then introduce complementary metrics that disentangle performance from stability and adaptation. Experiments across three evolution patterns on dynamic extensions of StableToolBench and RestBench show that ContDa consistently improves average performance by enhancing the discovery of new capabilities while incurring only limited loss of previously solved tasks, demonstrating documentation adaptation as an effective and lightweight mechanism for robust tool use in evolving environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/Bingo-W/ContDa.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越像工具使用型智能体，而现有的评估和优化LLMs工具使用的方法通常假设工具环境是静态的，具有固定的API和文档。实际上，随着工具的添加、修改或废弃，工具集会不断演变，这给智能体带来了不稳定性，因为它们必须在适应新功能的同时保持原有的能力。我们将这一挑战称为“稳定性与适应性困境”。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了ContDa框架，它是一个可泛化的解决方案，能够让LLM智能体通过更新工具文档来自我进化。ContDa结合了关系引导的探索机制——利用功能相关的现有工具作为锚点来探索和识别新的工具功能；以及关系感知的调整机制——对重叠的工具进行组织，并明确编码它们之间的使用偏好和备用选项。我们还引入了互补的指标，以区分性能、稳定性和适应性之间的关系。在StableToolBench和RestBench的动态扩展环境下进行的实验表明，ContDa能够持续提升平均性能，同时仅导致之前已解决的任务有轻微的损失，这表明文档适配是一种在动态环境中实现稳健工具使用的有效且轻量级机制。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Bingo-W/ContDa下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ZoFia: Zero-Shot Fake News Detection with Entity-Guided Retrieval and Multi-LLM Interaction
papers.title_zh: ZoFia：基于实体引导检索与多大型语言模型交互的零样本虚假新闻检测技术
papers.authors: Lvhua Wu, Xuefeng Jiang, Sheng Sun, Yan Lei, Tian Wen, Yuwei Wang, Min Liu
papers.abstract: The rapid spread of fake news threatens social stability and public trust, highlighting the urgent need for its effective detection.Although large language models (LLMs) show potential in fake news detection, they are limited by knowledge cutoff and easily generate factual hallucinations when handling time-sensitive news.Furthermore, the thinking of a single LLM easily falls into early stance locking and confirmation bias, making it hard to handle both content reasoning and fact checking simultaneously.To address these challenges, we propose ZoFia, a two-stage zero-shot fake news detection framework.In the first retrieval stage, we propose novel Hierarchical Salience and Salience-Calibrated Minimum Marginal Relevance (SC-MMR) algorithm to extract core entities accurately, which drive dual-source retrieval to overcome knowledge and evidence gaps.In the subsequent stage, a multi-agent system conducts multi-perspective reasoning and verification in parallel and achieves an explainable and robust result via adversarial debate.Comprehensive experiments on two public datasets show that ZoFia outperforms existing zero-shot baselines and even most few-shot methods.Our code has been open-sourced to facilitate the research community at https://github.com/SakiRinn/ZoFia.
papers.abstract_zh: 虚假新闻的迅速传播威胁着社会的稳定与公众的信任，这凸显了有效检测虚假新闻的紧迫性。虽然大语言模型在虚假新闻检测方面具有潜力，但它们受到知识范围的限制，在处理时效性强的新闻时容易产生事实上的错误。此外，单个大语言模型的思维容易陷入固定立场和确认偏误，这使得同时处理内容推理和事实核查变得困难。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ZoFia这一两阶段零样本虚假新闻检测框架。在第一阶段检索过程中，我们提出了一种新颖的层次化显著性算法以及经过校准的最小边际相关性算法，以准确提取核心实体，从而克服知识和证据之间的差距。在第二阶段，多智能体系统并行进行多视角推理和验证，通过对抗性辩论实现可解释且稳健的结果。在两个公开数据集上的综合实验表明，ZoFia的性能优于现有的零样本基准方法，甚至超过了大多数少样本方法。我们的代码已开源，以便研究社区能够进一步探索和使用，网址为https://github.com/SakiRinn/ZoFia。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SenseJudge: Human-Centric Preference-Driven Judgment Framework
papers.title_zh: SenseJudge：以人类为中心的偏好驱动判断框架
papers.authors: Rui Li, Junfeng Liu, Xiangwen Kong, Zhifang Sui
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) as judges across various scenarios such as assessing model responses is becoming an increasingly accepted paradigm. However, existing judgment approaches often rely on trained judgers using fixed preference data, which tend to overlook diverse user preferences and struggle to adapt to real-world human-AI dialogue scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose SenseJudge, a customizable judgment framework driven by human preferences and SenseBench, a diverse and challenging instruction following benchmark derived from real-world multi-turn interactions. We applied the automatic judgment framework and benchmark to two tasks: 1) LLMs as personalized judges, and 2) model ranking. We conducted extensive experiments, and the results demonstrate that the SenseJudge framework surpasses other judgment methods and models in the LLMs-as-personalized-judges task and achieves model ranking that aligns with real human sense. Additionally, we conducted analyses on position bias and consistency, alongside ablation studies, which affirmed the robustness of SenseJudge.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型作为各种场景中的评判者，例如评估模型的响应，正逐渐成为一种被普遍接受的范式。然而，现有的评判方法往往依赖于使用固定偏好数据进行训练的评判者，这往往会忽略用户多样化的偏好，并且难以适应现实世界中的人机对话场景。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了SenseJudge这一可定制的评判框架，该框架以人类偏好为驱动；同时，我们还开发了SenseBench这一具有挑战性的指令遵循基准测试，它源自于现实世界中的多轮交互。我们将自动评判框架和基准测试应用于两个任务：1）将语言模型作为个性化评判者；2）模型排名。通过广泛的实验，我们发现SenseJudge框架在作为个性化评判者的任务中优于其他评判方法，并且在模型排名方面也取得了与真实人类感知相一致的成果。此外，我们还对位置偏见和一致性进行了分析，并进行了消融研究，这些都证明了SenseJudge的稳健性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Adaptive Self-Consistency for Efficient Sampling in LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 可靠性感知的自适应自我一致性算法，用于LLM推理中的高效采样
papers.authors: Junseok Kim, Nakyeong Yang, Kyungmin Min, Kyomin Jung
papers.abstract: Self-Consistency improves reasoning reliability through multi-sample aggregation, but incurs substantial inference cost. Adaptive self-consistency methods mitigate this issue by adjusting the sampling budget; however, they rely on count-based stopping rules that treat all responses equally, often leading to unnecessary sampling. We propose Reliability-Aware Adaptive Self-Consistency (ReASC), which addresses this limitation by reframing adaptive sampling from response counting to evidence sufficiency, leveraging response-level confidence for principled information aggregation. ReASC operates in two stages: a single-sample decision stage that resolves instances confidently answerable from a single response, and a reliability-aware accumulation stage that aggregates responses by jointly leveraging their frequency and confidence. Across five models and four datasets, ReASC consistently achieves the best accuracy-cost trade-off compared to existing baselines, yielding improved inference efficiency across model scales from 3B to 27B parameters. As a concrete example, ReASC reduces inference cost by up to 70% relative to self-consistency while preserving accuracy on GSM8K using Gemma-3-4B-it.
papers.abstract_zh: 自一致性通过多样本聚合提升了推理的可靠性，但会带来显著的推理成本。自适应自一致性方法通过调整采样预算来缓解这个问题；然而，它们依赖于基于计数的停止规则，这些规则对所有响应一视同仁，常常导致不必要的采样。我们提出了可靠性感知自适应自一致性算法（ReASC），该算法通过将自适应采样从响应计数转变为证据充分性来解决这一限制，并利用响应级别的置信度进行有原则的信息聚合。ReASC分为两个阶段：第一阶段是单样本决策阶段，该阶段能够基于单个响应来确定是否有可能回答的问题；第二阶段是可靠性感知聚合阶段，该阶段通过同时利用响应的频率和置信度来聚合响应。在五个模型和四个数据集上进行的测试表明，与现有基线算法相比，ReASC始终能够实现最佳的准确率与成本之间的平衡，并且在从3B到27B参数的各种模型规模下都能提高推理效率。作为一个具体的例子，使用Gemma-3-4B-it模型在GSM8K任务中，ReASC将推理成本降低了70%，同时保持了相同的准确性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CLaS-Bench: A Cross-Lingual Alignment and Steering Benchmark
papers.title_zh: CLaS-Bench：一种跨语言对齐与引导任务基准测试平台
papers.authors: Daniil Gurgurov, Yusser Al Ghussin, Tanja Baeumel, Cheng-Ting Chou, Patrick Schramowski, Marius Mosbach, Josef van Genabith, Simon Ostermann
papers.abstract: Understanding and controlling the behavior of large language models (LLMs) is an increasingly important topic in multilingual NLP. Beyond prompting or fine-tuning, \textit{language steering}, i.e., manipulating internal representations during inference, has emerged as a more efficient and interpretable technique for adapting models to a target language. Yet, no dedicated benchmarks or evaluation protocols exist to quantify the effectiveness of steering techniques. We introduce CLaS-Bench, a lightweight parallel-question benchmark for evaluating language-forcing behavior in LLMs across 32 languages, enabling systematic evaluation of multilingual steering methods. We evaluate a broad array of steering techniques, including residual-stream DiffMean interventions, probe-derived directions, language-specific neurons, PCA/LDA vectors, Sparse Autoencoders, and prompting baselines. Steering performance is measured along two axes: language control and semantic relevance, combined into a single harmonic-mean steering score. We find that across languages simple residual-based DiffMean method consistently outperforms all other methods. Moreover, a layer-wise analysis reveals that language-specific structure emerges predominantly in later layers and steering directions cluster based on language family. CLaS-Bench is the first standardized benchmark for multilingual steering, enabling both rigorous scientific analysis of language representations and practical evaluation of steering as a low-cost adaptation alternative.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解和控制大语言模型的行为，在多语言自然语言处理领域是一个日益重要的话题。除了提示或微调之外，在推理过程中操纵内部表示的技术——即“语言引导”技术，被证明是一种更高效且可解释的方法，有助于使模型适应目标语言。然而，目前还没有专门的基准测试或评估协议来量化这种引导技术的有效性。我们提出了CLaS-Bench这一轻量级并行问题基准测试，用于评估32种语言下大语言模型的语言强制行为，从而能够系统地评估多语言引导方法的效果。我们测试了多种引导技术，包括残差流DiffMean干预、基于探针的引导方向、特定语言的神经元、PCA/LDA向量、稀疏自编码器以及提示基线。引导性能通过两个维度来衡量：语言控制和语义相关性，这两个维度被合并为一个综合的引导得分。我们发现，在不同语言中，简单的基于残差的差分均值方法始终优于其他所有方法。此外，逐层分析表明，特定语言的结构主要出现在后期层次中，而引导方向则根据语言家族进行聚类。CLaS-Bench是首个用于多语言引导的标准化基准测试，它既能够进行对语言表示的严格科学分析，又能实际评估引导作为一种低成本适应替代方案的有效性。

papers.title: From Prediction to Intervention: Personalized Meal-Level Glucose Regulation via an LLM Agent
papers.title_zh: 从预测到干预：通过大型语言模型代理实现个性化的餐时血糖调节
papers.authors: Mingyu Huang, Weiqing Min, Ying Jin, Yilin Wang, Shuqiang Jiang
papers.abstract: Personalized glucose regulation remains a central yet unresolved challenge in precision nutrition, as postprandial glucose response varies substantially across individuals. Existing approaches based on glycemic indices fail to adequately account for such heterogeneity and lack the mechanism to dynamically adjust meals based on personal physiological feedback. In this context, recent advances in LLM-based agents offer a promising direction, as they enable context-aware reasoning and iterative refinement. Inspired by this, we propose a physio-feedback agentic loop, a unified system that integrates individualized absorption modeling with dietary intervention to regulate glucose response. Specifically, we develop a Physiology-Aware Glucose Predictor to model individualized absorption dynamics through a learnable Temporal Physiological Absorption Decay Module. We then construct a Prediction-Driven Two-Stage Meal Optimization Agent that iteratively refines real-world meals using predicted outcomes as explicit feedback. Through extensive experiments on multiple public datasets, we demonstrate that our method not only improves prediction accuracy but also effectively reduces glucose excursions. To the best of our knowledge, this paper marks the first step in integrating physiological learning with an LLM-based agent for personalized glucose regulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 个性化血糖调节仍然是精准营养领域中的一个核心但尚未解决的挑战，因为餐后血糖反应在不同个体之间存在显著差异。现有的基于血糖指数的方法无法充分考虑到这种异质性，也缺乏根据个人生理反馈动态调整饮食的机制。在这种情况下，基于大语言模型的智能体技术提供了有希望的方向，因为它们能够实现情境感知的推理和迭代优化。受此启发，我们提出了一种生理反馈智能体循环系统，该系统将个性化吸收模型与饮食干预相结合，以调节血糖反应。具体来说，我们开发了一种生理感知血糖预测器，通过可学习的时间生理吸收衰减模块来模拟个性化的吸收动态。然后，我们构建了一个基于预测的二阶段饮食优化智能体，该智能体利用预测结果作为显式反馈，逐步优化实际饮食。通过在多个公共数据集上进行的大量实验，我们证明我们的方法不仅提高了预测准确性，还有效减少了血糖波动。据我们所知，这篇论文标志着将生理学习与大语言模型智能体相结合以实现个性化血糖调节的第一步。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PsyPath: Psychologically-guided Self-Exploration for Personality Detection
papers.title_zh: PsyPath：一种基于心理引导的自助探索方法，用于人格分析
papers.authors: Zheng Li, Hongxin Ding, Chenyu Zhang, Weimin Xiong, Dawei Zhu, Sujian Li
papers.abstract: Personality detection aims to label an individual’s traits via identifying linguistic cues from his or her written text. Previous approaches typically perform a direct mapping between text and trait labels or apply static reasoning to this task.In this paper, we argue that dynamic reasoning, underpinned by psychological theory, is essential for personality trait inference. To address this, we propose PsyPath, a novel framework that models personality detection as a process of psychologically-guided self-exploration. By enabling large language models (LLMs) to dynamically generate and answer psychologically meaningful questions, our method creates a dynamic reasoning path to explore the underlying dimensions of personality traits. This mechanism not only makes the reasoning process transparent, but also helps the model understand personality nuances in a way that mirrors expert psychological reasoning.For the “guided self-exploration”, we propose a novel hybrid scoring mechanism to step-by-step evaluate the generated nodes in the reasoning paths that balances psychological coherence (black-box scoring) and model output dynamics (white-box scoring). This reasoning-based formulation inherently reflects how psychologists assess personality, as they rely on iterative, diagnostic reasoning. Experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that PsyPath consistently outperforms strong baselines, yielding improvements in predictive accuracy and model interpretability.Moreover, the generated reasoning paths provide psychologically meaningful training data, significantly improving performance and psychologically grounded interpretability in downstream tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 人格检测的目的是通过识别个人书面文本中的语言线索来标注其特质。以往的方法通常直接将文本与特质标签进行映射，或者采用静态推理方法来处理这一任务。在本文中，我们认为基于心理学理论的动态推理对于人格特质的推断至关重要。为此，我们提出了PsyPath这一新颖框架，它将人格检测建模为一种由心理学指导的自我探索过程。通过让大语言模型能够动态生成并回答具有心理学意义的问题，我们的方法构建了一条动态推理路径，以探索人格特质的潜在维度。这种机制不仅使推理过程变得透明，还能帮助模型以一种类似于专家心理推理的方式理解人格的细微差别。对于“引导性自我探索”部分，我们提出了一种创新的混合评分机制，该机制能够逐步评估推理路径中生成的节点，同时平衡了心理学上的连贯性（黑盒评分）和模型输出动态性（白盒评分）。这种基于推理的框架本质上反映了心理学家如何评估人格，因为他们依赖迭代性的诊断性推理。在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，PsyPath始终优于强大的基线方法，在预测准确性和模型可解释性方面都取得了显著改进。此外，生成的推理路径提供了具有心理学意义的训练数据，显著提升了下游任务的性能以及心理上的可解释性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CCTVBench: Contrastive Consistency Traffic VideoQA Benchmark for Multimodal LLMs
papers.title_zh: CCTVBench：用于多模态大语言模型的对比一致性交通视频问答基准测试
papers.authors: Xingcheng Zhou, Hao Guo, Rui Song, Walter Zimmer, Mingyu Liu, André Schamschurko, Hu Cao, Alois Knoll
papers.abstract: Safety-critical traffic reasoning requires contrastive consistency: models must detect true hazards when an accident occurs, and reliably reject plausible-but-false hypotheses under near-identical counterfactual scenes. We present CCTVBench, a Contrastive Consistency Traffic VideoQA Benchmark built on paired real accident videos and world-model-generated counterfactual counterparts, together with minimally different, mutually exclusive hypothesis questions. CCTVBench enforces a single structured decision pattern over each video question quadruple and provides actionable diagnostics that decompose failures into positive omission, positive swap, negative hallucination, and mutual-exclusivity violation, while separating video versus question consistency. Experiments across open-source and proprietary video LLMs reveal a large and persistent gap between standard per-instance QA metrics and quadruple-level contrastive consistency, with unreliable none-of-the-above rejection as a key bottleneck. Finally, we introduce C-TCD, which leverages the semantically exclusive counterpart video as the contrast input at inference time, improving both instance-level QA and contrastive consistency.
papers.abstract_zh: 安全关键性交通推理需要对比一致性：模型必须在事故发生时识别出真正的危险情况，并在几乎相同的反事实场景中可靠地排除那些看似合理但实际上错误的假设。我们提出了CCTVBench，这是一个基于成对真实事故视频和世界模型生成的反事实对应视频，以及差异极小且互斥的假设问题的对比一致性交通视频问答基准测试。CCTVBench对每个视频问题四元组实施单一的结构化决策模式，并提供可操作的诊断结果，将故障分解为正面遗漏、正面替换、负面幻觉和互斥性违反等不同类型的问题。同时，该框架能够区分视频与问题的连贯性。通过对开源和专有视频语言模型进行的实验发现，标准单实例问答指标与四元组对比一致性之间存在较大且持续的差距，而不可靠的“非上述选项”拒绝判断是其中的主要瓶颈。最后，我们引入了C-TCD方法，该方法在推理时利用语义上互斥的对应视频作为对比输入，从而提升了实例级问答效果和对比一致性。

papers.title: PROGRAM: Programmatic Retrieval Optimization with Generative Reasoning and Augmented Multi-queries
papers.title_zh: 项目名称：基于生成式推理的编程式检索优化技术——支持多查询协同处理
papers.authors: Gun Il Kim, Jungkyu Shin, Jong Wook Kim, Beakcheol Jang
papers.abstract: Current retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods struggle with complex multi-hop reasoning, relying on unstructured semantic matching that lacks the logical structure needed to systematically guide retrieval. We introduce Programmatic Retrieval Optimization with Generative Reasoning and Augmented Multi-queries (PROGRAM), a novel framework that elevates retrieval to structured, program-guided reasoning. PROGRAM treats retrieval as execution of specific program types, such as logical, temporal, causal, and so forth, through three stages of ’Program-Type Selection’ with dual-metric optimization, ’Iterative Active Program Pruning’ with evidence accumulation, and ’Final Answer Generation’ with reranking. Evaluated on five benchmarks including HotPotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, ARC-Challenge, MMLU-Pro, and MedQA with various LLMs, PROGRAM achieves state-of-the-art performance with up to 24% relative improvement on HotPotQA and 13.2% on MedQA over strong baselines including FLARE, ProbTree and Self-RAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的检索增强生成（RAG）方法在复杂的多跳推理方面存在困难，它们依赖于无结构的语义匹配，这种匹配缺乏系统引导检索所需的逻辑结构。我们提出了一种名为“程序化检索优化与生成式推理及增强型多查询”的新框架（PROGRAM）。该框架将检索提升为结构化、由程序引导的推理过程。PROGRAM将检索视为执行特定类型的程序，如逻辑程序、时间程序、因果程序等。其实现分为三个阶段：第一阶段是“程序类型选择”，采用双指标优化；第二阶段是“迭代主动程序剪枝”，通过证据积累来优化程序；第三阶段是“最终答案生成”，通过重新排序来得出答案。在包括HotPotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、ARC-Challenge、MMLU-Pro和MedQA在内的五个基准测试中，PROGRAM取得了卓越的性能表现。与FLARE、ProbTree和Self-RAG等强大的基线模型相比，PROGRAM在HotPotQA上的相对性能提升了24%，在MedQA上的相对性能提升了13.2%。

papers.title: TiMem: Temporal-Hierarchical Memory Consolidation for Long-Horizon Conversational Agents
papers.title_zh: TiMem：用于长期对话代理的时间分层记忆整合技术
papers.authors: Kai Li, Xuanqing Yu, Ziyi Ni, Yi Zeng, Yao Xu, Zheqing Zhang, Xin Li, Jitao Sang, Xiaogang Duan, Xuelei Wang, Chengbao Liu, Jie Tan
papers.abstract: Long-horizon conversational agents have to manage ever-growing interaction histories that quickly exceed the finite context windows of large language models (LLMs). Existing memory frameworks provide limited support for temporally structured information across hierarchical levels, often leading to fragmented memories and unstable long-horizon personalization. We present TiMem, a temporal–hierarchical memory framework that organizes conversations through a Temporal Memory Tree (TMT), enabling systematic memory consolidation from raw conversational observations to progressively abstracted persona representations. TiMem is characterized by three core properties: (1) temporal–hierarchical organization through TMT; (2) semantic-guided consolidation that enables memory integration across hierarchical levels without fine-tuning; and (3) complexity-aware memory recall that balances precision and efficiency across queries of varying complexity. Under a consistent evaluation setup, TiMem achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on both benchmarks, reaching 75.30% on LoCoMo and 76.88% on LongMemEval-S. It outperforms all evaluated baselines while reducing the recalled memory length by 52.20% on LoCoMo. Manifold analysis indicates clear persona separation on LoCoMo and reduced dispersion on LongMemEval-S. Overall, TiMem treats temporal continuity as a first-class organizing principle for long-horizon memory in conversational agents. The code is available at https://github.com/TiMEM-AI/timem.
papers.abstract_zh: 长时对话智能体需要管理不断增长的互动历史记录，这些记录很快就会超出大语言模型所能处理的有限上下文窗口。现有的记忆框架在跨层次结构的信息存储方面支持有限，这通常会导致记忆的碎片化以及长时个性化效果的不稳定。我们提出了TiMem这一时间-层次记忆框架，它通过时间记忆树来组织对话，从而实现从原始对话信息到逐渐抽象的人物表征之间的系统记忆整合。TiMem具有三个核心特性：(1)通过时间记忆树实现时间-层次化的组织；(2)基于语义的整合机制，使得无需精细调优即可实现跨层次结构的记忆融合；(3)具备复杂性感知的记忆检索能力，能够在不同复杂度的查询中平衡精确性和效率。在一致的评估环境下，TiMem在两种基准测试中都取得了最先进的准确率，分别达到了LoCoMo上的75.30%和LongMemEval-S上的76.88%。与所有被评估的基线模型相比，TiMem表现更优，同时在LoCoMo上将回忆出的记忆长度减少了52.20%。 manifold分析表明，在LoCoMo上人物特征得到了清晰的区分，而在LongMemEval-S上则降低了数据分布的分散程度。总体而言，TiMem将时间连续性视为对话智能体中长时记忆的首要组织原则。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/TiMEM-AI/timem。

papers.title: GraphDx: A Cost-Aware Knowledge-Enhanced Multi-Agent Framework for Sequential Diagnosis
papers.title_zh: GraphDx：一种注重成本优化的、能够提升知识水平的多智能体框架，适用于序列诊断问题处理
papers.authors: Shaoting Tan, Ning Liu, Yuntao Du, Shuyue Wei, Wu Shuai, Qian Li, Yanyu Xu, Wei Zhang, Lizhen Cui, Haitao Yuan
papers.abstract: Sequential diagnosis requires balancing diagnostic accuracy against resource costs through iterative information gathering. Existing Large Language Model (LLM) approaches exhibit a critical knowledge-reasoning gap: despite encoding extensive medical knowledge, they struggle to reason systematically under cost constraints, often resorting to excessive testing. We propose GraphDx, a knowledge-enhanced framework with two core innovations. First, we design an automated pipeline that leverages LLMs to construct Medical Diagnosis Knowledge Graphs (MDKGs) with quantized typicality, action-centric topology, and dual-objective attributes for both diagnostic relevance and cost-sensitivity. Second, we introduce three collaborative agents (Perception, Reasoning, and Decision) where the Perception and Decision Agents handle language understanding and generation, while the Reasoning Agent performs deterministic evidence scoring and cost-aware planning on the MDKG. Experiments on MedQA and MIMIC-IV across three LLM backbones (DeepSeek-V3, Kimi-k2, Llama-3.3) show that GraphDx improves diagnostic success rates from 50–68% to 79–93% while reducing test costs by 20–54%, providing a robust, economical, and interpretable solution for automated clinical diagnosis.
papers.abstract_zh: 顺序诊断需要在迭代信息收集过程中平衡诊断准确性和资源成本。现有的大语言模型方法存在关键的知识推理缺陷：尽管能够编码丰富的医学知识，但它们在成本限制下难以进行系统性的推理，常常需要过多的测试操作。我们提出了GraphDx这一具有两项核心创新的知识增强框架。首先，我们设计了一种自动化流程，利用大语言模型构建医学诊断知识图谱，该图谱包含量化后的典型性、以行动为中心的拓扑结构，以及兼具诊断相关性和成本敏感性的双目标属性。其次，我们引入了三个协作代理——感知代理、推理代理和决策代理。其中，感知代理和决策代理负责语言理解和生成，而推理代理则负责在医学诊断知识图谱上进行确定性证据评分和成本敏感的规划。在MedQA和MIMIC-IV数据集上的实验表明，使用GraphDx后，诊断成功率从50%-68%提升到了79%-93%，同时测试成本降低了20%-54%。这为自动临床诊断提供了一种稳健、经济且可解释的解决方案。

papers.title: ProUIE: A Macro-to-Micro Progressive Learning Method for LLM-based Universal Information Extraction
papers.title_zh: ProUIE：一种从宏观到微观的渐进式学习方法，适用于基于大语言模型的通用信息提取任务
papers.authors: Wenda Liu, Song Zhigang, Shuai Nie, Guangyao Liu, Lisung Chen, Binyu Yang, Yaran Chen, Peng Zhou, Hongzhen Wang, Yuchen Liu, Wenyue Hu, Jiaming Xu, Runyu Shi, Ying Huang
papers.abstract: LLM-based universal information extraction (UIE) methods often rely on additional information beyond the original training data, which increases training complexity yet often yields limited gains. To address this, we propose ProUIE, a Macro-to-Micro progressive learning approach that improves UIE without introducing any external information. ProUIE consists of three stages: (i) macro-level Complete Modeling (CM), which learns NER, RE, and EE along their intrinsic difficulty order on the full training data to build a unified extraction foundation, (ii) meso-level Streamlined Alignment (SA), which operates on sampled data with simplified target formats, streamlining and regularizing structured outputs to make them more concise and controllable, and (iii) micro-level Deep Exploration (DE), which applies GRPO with stepwise fine-grained rewards (SFR) over structural units to guide exploration and improve performance. Experiments on 36 public datasets show that ProUIE consistently improves unified extraction, outperforming strong instruction-tuned baselines on average for NER and RE while using a smaller backbone, and it further demonstrates clear gains in production-oriented information extraction.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的通用信息提取方法通常依赖于原始训练数据之外的额外信息，这增加了训练的复杂性，但往往只能带来有限的提升效果。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了ProUIE这一从宏观到微观的渐进式学习方法。该方法可以在不引入任何外部信息的情况下改进信息提取效果。ProUIE包含三个阶段：(i) 宏观层面的完整建模，该阶段按照NER、RE和EE的内在难度顺序，在全部训练数据上进行学习，以构建统一的信息提取基础；(ii) 中观层面的简化对齐，该阶段针对经过简化的目标格式的数据进行操作，对结构化输出进行精简和规范化处理，使其更加简洁且易于控制；(iii) 微观层面的深度探索，该阶段采用GRPO方法，通过逐步细粒度的奖励机制来指导探索过程，从而提高性能。在36个公开数据集上的实验表明，ProUIE能够持续提升信息提取的效果，在NER和RE任务上，即使使用更简单的模型框架，其表现也优于那些经过强化训练的基线方法。此外，它在实际应用场景中的信息提取方面也表现出明显的优势。

papers.title: MAVIS: Multi-Agent Video Retrieval via Structured Video Understanding
papers.title_zh: 马维斯：基于结构化视频理解的多智能体视频检索方法
papers.authors: Jie Zhang, Qilang Ye, Hao Zhou, Haochen Liang, Fei Luo
papers.abstract: The dominant paradigm in video retrieval relies on embedding-based full-corpus scanning, which suffers from inherent computational inefficiency and the semantic asymmetry between information-dense videos and sparse textual queries. To bridge this gap, we introduce MAVIS, a novel multi-agent framework that rethinks retrieval as cooperative reasoning rather than brute-force search. MAVIS first bridges the granularity mismatch by parsing raw videos into a Structured Semantic Library, enabling explicit attribute-level indexing. During retrieval, a planner decomposes complex user intents into atomic sub-tasks, dispatching specialized agents to independently nominate candidates. Crucially, MAVIS employs a Logic-aware Debate mechanism with a strict veto protocol, where agents collaboratively prune logical mismatches to identify a compact set of "controversial” candidates for fine-grained verification. This agentic workflow effectively bypasses the inefficiency of full-library traversal. Extensive experiments on MSR-VTT, MSVD, and ActivityNet demonstrate that MAVIS achieves competitive performance without task-specific fine-tuning, offering a scalable and interpretable alternative to traditional dual-encoder approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 在视频检索领域，目前主流的范式依赖于基于嵌入的全文扫描方式。但这种方法存在计算效率低下的问题，而且信息密度高的视频与稀疏的文本查询之间也存在语义上的不匹配问题。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了MAVIS这一创新的多智能体框架。MAVIS将检索过程重新定义为协作性推理过程，而非 brute-force 搜索。MAVIS首先通过将原始视频解析为结构化语义库，来解决粒度不匹配的问题，从而实现属性级别的索引功能。在检索过程中，系统会将复杂的用户意图分解为多个原子任务，并派遣专门的代理来独立筛选候选对象。关键在于，MAVIS采用了一种逻辑感知的辩论机制，该机制拥有严格的否决协议。代理们会协作性地剔除逻辑上的不一致之处，从而筛选出一组“有争议的”候选对象，以便进行更细致的验证。这种代理式工作流程有效地避免了全库遍历所带来的效率问题。在MSR-VTT、MSVD和ActivityNet数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，MAVIS能够在无需针对特定任务进行微调的情况下，展现出具有竞争力的性能。因此，MAVIS为传统双编码器方法提供了一种可扩展且易于理解的替代方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ThinkBrake: Efficient Reasoning via Log-Probability Margin Guided Decoding
papers.title_zh: ThinkBrake：通过日志概率边际引导的高效推理方法
papers.authors: Sangjun Song, Minjae Oh, Seungkyu Lee, Sungmin Jo, Yohan Jo
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) allocate substantial inference-time compute to Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, improving performance on mathematics, scientific QA, and tool usage. However, this introduces overthinking: LRMs often reach a correct intermediate solution, continue reasoning, and overwrite it with an incorrect answer. We first demonstrate that oracle stopping—where we inject lt;/think gt; at every sentence boundary and select the best stopping point in hindsight—improves average accuracy by 8% while reducing thinking tokens by 72%, exposing substantial overthinking. Motivated by this finding, we propose ThinkBrake, which monitors the log-probability margin between the top continuation token and lt;/think gt; at sentence boundaries, stopping reasoning when this margin narrows. ThinkBrake requires no training and achieves favorable accuracy–efficiency trade-offs across math, scientific QA, and tool usage benchmarks, reducing thinking token usage by up to 30%. Furthermore, we provide theoretical analysis showing that ThinkBrake is equivalent to test-time realignment with a reward bonus for the lt;/think gt; token.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）会分配大量计算资源用于思维链推理，从而提升了在数学、科学问答以及工具使用方面的性能。然而，这种做法会导致过度思考：LRMs往往能够得出正确的中间解决方案，但随后又会继续推理，最终用错误的答案来替代正确的结果。我们首先证明了一种基于“预言机停止”的策略——即在每个句子边界处插入“</思考>”指令，并事后选择最佳的停止点——可以将平均准确率提高8%，同时将思考的标记数量减少72%，从而避免了过度思考。基于这一发现，我们提出了ThinkBrake算法。该算法会在句子边界处监控当前最佳延续标记与“</思考>”指令之间的概率差距，当这种差距缩小时就停止推理。ThinkBrake无需任何训练即可在数学、科学问答和工具使用等测试场景中取得良好的准确率与效率平衡，同时可将思考标记的使用量减少多达30%。此外，我们还进行了理论分析，证明ThinkBrake相当于在测试时重新调整策略，并对“</思考>”指令给予奖励。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MSIA: Adaptive Medical Multimodal Multi-turn Semantic Jailbreak
papers.title_zh: MSIA：自适应医学多模态多轮语义突破技术
papers.authors: Zhiheng Han, Yao Zhang, Jun Wang, Zhenglu Yang
papers.abstract: Medical multimodal large language models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes clinical settings, yet current safety evaluations largely overlook a critical failure mode: covert semantic drift that accumulates across clinically plausible multi-turn interactions. Such drift can lead models to gradually exaggerate or conceal critical medical findings without triggering explicit safety mechanisms. We propose MSIA (Medical Semantic Infiltration Attack), a framework for modeling and inducing multi-turn medical semantic jailbreaks in clinical dialogues. MSIA enables the controlled optimization of cumulative semantic drift under stealth constraints through adaptive strategy selection and closed-loop reward feedback grounded in medical evidence. Experiments on chest X-ray–based multimodal medical dialogues show that MSIA consistently outperforms existing jailbreak methods across GPT-4o, Claude, and Gemini, achieving an average attack success rate of 76.67%. These results expose substantial and previously underestimated vulnerabilities of medical LLMs in realistic multi-turn clinical interactions. Code is available here: https://github.com/HeYamo/MSIA.
papers.abstract_zh: 医疗多模态大语言模型越来越多地被应用于高风险的临床场景中。然而，目前的安全评估大多忽略了一种关键的故障模式：在看似合理的多轮交互过程中，语义信息会逐渐发生变化。这种变化可能导致模型逐渐夸大或隐藏重要的医学信息，而无需触发明确的安全机制。我们提出了MSIA框架，用于建模和诱导临床对话中的多轮语义突破行为。MSIA通过自适应策略选择和基于医学证据的闭环奖励反馈，实现了在隐蔽约束下的累积语义变化的可控优化。针对基于胸部X光片的多模态医疗对话进行的实验表明，MSIA在GPT-4o、Claude和Gemini等模型中始终表现出优于现有破解方法的表现，平均攻击成功率为76.67%。这些结果揭示了医疗LLM在现实多轮临床交互中存在的重大且被低估的漏洞。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/HeYamo/MSIA。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Why These Documents? Explainable Generative Retrieval with Hierarchical Category Paths
papers.title_zh: 为什么选择这些文档？通过分层类别路径实现可解释的生成式检索方法
papers.authors: Sangam Lee, Ryang Heo, SeongKu Kang, Susik Yoon, Jinyoung Yeo, Dongha Lee
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval directly decode a document identifier (i.e., docid) in response to a query, making it impossible to provide users with explanations as an answer for “why is this document retrieved?”. To address this limitation, we propose Hierarchical Category Path-Enhanced Generative Retrieval (HyPE), which enhances explainability by first generating hierarchical category paths step-by-step then decoding docid. By leveraging hierarchical category paths which progress from broader to more specific semantic categories, HyPE can provide detailed explanation for its retrieval decision. For training, HyPE constructs category paths with external high-quality semantic hierarchy, leverages LLM to select appropriate candidate paths for each document, and optimizes the generative retrieval model with path-augmented dataset. During inference, HyPE utilizes path-aware ranking strategy to aggregate diverse topic information, allowing the most relevant documents to be prioritized in the final ranked list of docids. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that HyPE not only offers a high level of explainability but also improves the retrieval performance. We provide the code and a live demo of HyPE at https://augustinlib.github.io/HyPE/
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式检索能够直接解码文档标识符（即docid），以响应查询。因此，无法为用户提供关于“为何会检索到该文档？”的解释。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了分层类别路径增强生成式检索（HyPE）算法。该算法通过逐步生成分层类别路径，然后再解码docid，从而提升了可解释性。利用从更广泛到更具体的语义类别的分层路径，HyPE能够为检索决策提供详细的解释。在训练过程中，HyPE使用外部高质量的语义层次结构来构建类别路径，并利用大语言模型为每个文档选择合适的候选路径，同时使用带有路径增强的数据集来优化生成式检索模型。在推理阶段，HyPE采用基于路径的排序策略，汇总各种主题信息，使最相关的文档能够在最终的文档列表中被优先排序。我们的大量实验表明，HyPE不仅提供了高度的可解释性，还提升了检索性能。我们可以在https://augustinlib.github.io/HyPE/下载HyPE的代码和实时演示。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ETHICA-MT: Introducing a Framework and Dataset for Studying Ethical Orientations in LLM-based Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: ETHICA-MT：介绍一种用于研究基于大语言模型的机器翻译中伦理取向的框架和数据集
papers.authors: Omri Asscher, Arif Ahmad, Ananya Agrawal, Monojit Choudhury
papers.abstract: Translation is a fundamentally value-laden process that requires the translator to make decisions and judgments that have ethical implications. However, even though large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for translation tasks, LLMs have not been systematically examined for their default ethical tendencies or their abilities to employ and prioritize specified ethical approaches in conflicted translation situations. To address this gap, we present ETHICA-MT, a framework for examining ethical reasoning and implementation in LLM-based machine translation. Drawing on diverse ethical approaches from the translation studies literature, we formalize a conceptual framework and construct a multilingual benchmark, ETHICA-MT BENCH, that covers six languages and highlights ethical conflicts arising from competing ethical approaches in a variety of translation scenarios. Our empirical study shows that current models predominantly default to an ethical stance favoring ‘faithful representation’ to the source text, and vary in their ability to implement specified ethics at the expense of others. Finally, we highlight the basic challenges of automatically and manually evaluating the models’ ethical stances.
papers.abstract_zh: 翻译本质上是一个带有价值判断的过程，译者需要做出具有伦理意义的决策和判断。然而，尽管大语言模型在翻译任务中的应用越来越广泛，但人们尚未系统地研究这些模型的默认伦理倾向，以及它们在复杂翻译情境下如何运用和优先考虑特定伦理方法的能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ETHICA-MT框架，用于评估基于语言模型的机器翻译中的伦理推理与实施情况。借鉴翻译研究领域的多种伦理方法，我们构建了一个概念性框架，并创建了一个多语言基准测试——ETHICA-MT BENCH，该测试涵盖六种语言，能够揭示在各种翻译场景中由不同伦理方法引发的伦理冲突。我们的实证研究表明，当前模型大多默认采用有利于“忠实再现”源文本的伦理立场，而在实施特定伦理原则时则表现出不同的能力。最后，我们指出了自动和手动评估模型伦理立场所面临的挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ArgBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Computational Argumentation Tasks
papers.title_zh: ArgBench：在计算性论证任务上对大型语言模型进行性能比较
papers.authors: Yamen Ajjour, Carlotta Quensel, Nedim Lipka, Henning Wachsmuth
papers.abstract: Argumentation skills are an essential toolkit for large language models (LLMs). These skills are crucial in various use cases, including self-reflection, debating collaboratively for diverse answers, and countering hate speech. In this paper, we create the first benchmark for a standardized evaluation of LLM-based approaches to computational argumentation, encompassing 33 datasets from previous work in unified form. Using the benchmark, we evaluate the generalizability of five LLM families across 46 computational argumentation tasks that cover mining arguments, assessing perspectives, assessing argument quality, reasoning about arguments, and generating arguments. On the benchmark, we conduct an extensive systematic analysis of the contribution of few-shot examples, reasoning steps, model size, and training skills to the performance of LLMs on the computational argumentation tasks in the benchmark.
papers.abstract_zh: 论证能力是大语言模型的重要技能之一。这些技能在多种应用场景中发挥着关键作用，包括自我反思、协作讨论以得出多样化答案，以及对抗仇恨言论。在本文中，我们创建了首个用于标准化评估基于大语言模型的论证能力的基准测试，该测试包含了来自先前研究的33个数据集，这些数据集被整合到了统一的格式中。通过这一基准测试，我们对五款大语言模型在46项论证任务中的表现进行了评估，这些任务涵盖了提取论点、评估观点、判断论证质量、对论点进行推理以及生成论点等方面。在基准测试上，我们对少量样本示例、推理步骤、模型规模以及训练技巧对大语言模型在论证任务中性能的影响进行了系统的分析。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Generics are not quantificational: A new path from language models to semantic theory
papers.title_zh: 通用性并非可量化的：从语言模型到语义理论的新路径
papers.authors: Gustavo Cilleruelo Calderón, Mahrad Almotahari, Emily Allaway, Barry Haddow, Alexandra Birch
papers.abstract: Generic sentences express generalizations that tolerate exceptions without explicitly communicating information about quantities. For example, the sentence Ravens are black is true even though there are albino ravens. The sentence doesn’t explicitly communicate the number or frequency of black ravens. Whether generics semantically encode information about quantities implicitly is controversial. This work takes a large-scale distributional approach to the semantic debate. It compares thousands of naturally occurring generics and quantificational sentences using language-model probabilities. It shows that language models recover many semantic facts about quantifiers. It also shows that they recover semantic facts about surface distributional differences between generics and their “quantificational counterparts”. Accordingly, and contrary to dominant views in other fields, we formulate an empirical argument to the effect that generics are not quantificational.
papers.abstract_zh: 概括性句子表达的是包含例外情况的概括性陈述，而不会明确说明数量信息。例如，“乌鸦都是黑色的”这一说法是正确的，尽管存在白化乌鸦。这句话并没有明确说明黑色乌鸦的数量或频率。关于概括性句子是否隐含地编码了数量信息，目前还存在争议。本研究采用大规模分布式方法来探讨这一语义问题。通过语言模型的概率分析，研究者对比了数千个自然出现的概括性陈述和数量化陈述。结果表明，语言模型能够捕捉到许多关于量词的语义信息。此外，模型还能捕捉到概括性陈述与其“数量化对应物”在表面分布上的差异。因此，与其它领域的主流观点不同，我们认为概括性陈述并非数量化表达。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Neural Incompatibility: Cross-Scale Knowledge Transfer in Large Language Models through Latent Semantic Alignment
papers.title_zh: 超越神经兼容性：通过潜在语义对齐实现大型语言模型中的跨尺度知识转移
papers.authors: Jian Gu, Aldeida Aleti, Chunyang Chen, Hongyu Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) encode substantial knowledge in their parameters, which can be located, traced, and analyzed. Despite recent progress in neural interpretability, it is still unclear how to transfer such knowledge in a fine-grained manner, namely parametric knowledge transfer (PKT). A central challenge is to make cross-scale transfer effective and efficient when source and target models differ in architecture and parameterization. Existing methods that directly reuse layer parameters are therefore strongly limited by neural incompatibility. In this paper, we identify latent semantic alignment as the key prerequisite for cross-scale knowledge transfer. Instead of directly moving layer parameters, our approach uses activations as the transfer medium. SemAlign has two stages: an layer attribution stage that attributes task-relevant source layers and selects exactly one source layer for each target layer, and a semantic alignment stage that pairs them from shallow to deep and optimizes the target with source-side supervisory hidden states. The alignment is carried out in latent space. In the current realization, training follows a shallow-to-deep frontier schedule: at each stage, only the current target layer is trainable, the layer objective is a Fisher-weighted quadratic surrogate on target-space aligned logits, and the final output layer keeps KL distillation. The transferred object nonetheless remains the aligned representation itself. Evaluations on four benchmarks demonstrate the efficacy of our method. Further analysis reveals the key factors that ease cross-scale knowledge transfer and provides insights into the nature of latent semantic alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在其参数中编码了大量的知识，这些知识可以被定位、追踪和分析。尽管在神经网络的可解释性方面取得了一些进展，但如何以细粒度的方式转移这些知识仍然是一个未解决的问题，即参数化知识的转移。一个主要的挑战在于，当源模型和目标模型的架构和参数化方式不同时，如何实现跨尺度的有效且高效的知识转移。目前的方法直接重用层参数，因此受到神经网络不兼容性的严重限制。在本文中，我们认为潜在语义对齐是跨尺度知识转移的关键前提。我们的方法不是直接移动层参数，而是使用激活函数作为转移媒介。SemAlign包含两个阶段：第一阶段是层归因阶段，该阶段将任务相关的源层进行归因，并为每个目标层选择出一个具体的源层；第二阶段是语义对齐阶段，该阶段将源层和目标层进行匹配，并从浅层到深层进行优化，同时利用源端的监督隐藏状态来优化目标层。这种对齐是在潜在空间中进行的。在当前实现中，训练过程遵循从浅层到深层的顺序：在每个阶段，只有当前的目标层可以被训练，层目标是对目标空间对齐的logits进行Fisher加权二次替代，而最终的输出层则保留KL蒸馏技术。不过，被转移的仍然是经过对齐的表示本身。在四个基准测试上的评估表明了我们方法的有效性。进一步的分析揭示了促进跨尺度知识转移的关键因素，并提供了关于潜在语义对齐本质的见解。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CURaTE: Continual Unlearning in Real Time with Ensured Preservation of LLM Knowledge
papers.title_zh: CURaTE：实时持续遗忘，同时确保LLM知识的保存
papers.authors: Seyun Bae, Seokhan Lee, Eunho Yang
papers.abstract: The inability to filter out in advance all potentially problematic data from the pre-training of large language models has given rise to the need for methods for unlearning specific pieces of knowledge after training. Existing techniques overlook the need for continuous and immediate action, causing them to suffer from degraded utility as updates accumulate and protracted exposure of sensitive information. To address these issues, we propose Continual Unlearning in Real Time with Ensured Preservation of LLM Knowledge (CURaTE). Our method begins by training a sentence embedding model on a dataset designed to enable the formation of sharp decision boundaries for determining whether a given input prompt corresponds to any stored forget requests. The similarity of a given input to the forget requests is then used to determine whether to answer or return a refusal response. We show that even with such a simple approach, not only does CURaTE achieve more effective forgetting than existing methods, but by avoiding modification of the language model parameters, it also maintains near perfect knowledge preservation over any number of updates and is the only method capable of continual unlearning in real-time.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型的预训练阶段无法提前过滤掉所有可能存在问题的数据，这就导致了在训练之后需要采用方法来消除某些特定的知识。现有的技术往往忽略了持续且即时处理的需求，因此随着更新的不断累积以及敏感信息的长期暴露，这些技术的实用性会逐渐下降。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了一种名为“实时持续遗忘并确保语言模型知识保存”的方法（CURaTE）。我们的方法首先在一个专门设计的数据集上训练一个句子嵌入模型，该模型能够形成清晰的决策边界，从而判断给定的输入提示是否与已存储的遗忘请求相对应。然后，通过对比给定输入与遗忘请求的相似度来决定是给出回答还是拒绝回应。我们证明，即使采用如此简单的方法，CURaTE也能比现有方法实现更有效的遗忘效果。此外，由于避免了修改语言模型参数，CURaTE能够在多次更新后仍然保持近乎完美的知识保存效果，它是唯一能够实现实时持续遗忘的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Decoupling the Effect of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning: A Human Label Variation Perspective
papers.title_zh: 分离思维链推理的影响：从人类标签差异的角度出发
papers.authors: Beiduo Chen, Tiancheng Hu, Caiqi Zhang, Robert Litschko, Anna Korhonen, Barbara Plank
papers.abstract: Reasoning-tuned LLMs utilizing long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) excel at single-answer tasks, yet their ability to model Human Label Variation—which requires capturing probabilistic ambiguity rather than resolving it—remains underexplored. We investigate this through systematic disentanglement experiments on distribution-based tasks, employing Cross-CoT experiments to isolate the effect of reasoning text from intrinsic model priors. We observe a distinct “decoupled mechanism”: while CoT improves distributional alignment, final accuracy is dictated by CoT content (99% variance contribution), whereas distributional ranking is governed by model priors (over 80%). Step-wise analysis further shows that while CoT’s influence on accuracy grows monotonically during the reasoning process, distributional structure is largely determined by LLM’s intrinsic priors. These findings suggest that long CoT serves as a decisive LLM decision-maker for the top option but fails to function as a granular distribution calibrator for ambiguous tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 经过调整的推理型大语言模型在解决单答案任务时表现出色，但它们在模拟人类标签变异方面的能力仍未被充分探索——这种模拟需要捕捉概率性模糊性，而不是直接解决这些模糊性问题。我们通过针对基于分布的任务的系统性解耦实验来研究这一问题，并利用跨推理文本的实验来分离推理文本与模型先验信息的影响。我们发现了一个独特的“分离机制”：虽然推理文本能够改善分布对齐效果，但最终的准确性取决于推理文本的内容（占方差贡献的99%），而分布排序则由模型先验决定（超过80%）。进一步的分析表明，尽管推理过程中推理文本对准确性的影响呈单调增长趋势，但分布结构主要由大语言模型本身的先验决定。这些发现表明，较长的推理文本确实在大语言模型中对选择最优方案起到了决定性作用，但在处理模糊任务时，它无法作为精细的分布校准器发挥作用。

papers.title: CTRL: Control-Based Time Series Forecasting with LLM-Guided Residual Learning
papers.title_zh: CTRL：基于控制的时间序列预测方法，结合大语言机引导的残差学习技术
papers.authors: Minkyoung Kim, Daeun Ji, Yohan Lee, Beomsoo Kim, Beakcheol Jang
papers.abstract: Time series forecasting underpins critical decision-making across diverse domains. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising reasoning capabilities, existing LLM-based time series forecasting approaches either reduce them to numerical predictors that bypass their strengths, or allow direct forecast generation that destabilizes predictions in non-stationary settings. We introduce CTRL, a framework that decouples semantic reasoning from quantitative prediction. A frozen backbone generates base forecasts, while specialized LLM agents function as controllers that analyze backbone prediction errors through decomposed trend, seasonal, and irregular components, grounding reasoning in interpretable temporal structure. Each agent outputs compact control signals that a lightweight residual decoder translates into forecast corrections. CTRL incorporates label-free test-time adaptation that detects distribution shift from input statistics alone and readapts control signals with only 3–24 LLM calls via caching. CTRL is explicitly designed to improve robustness under non-stationary temporal dynamics and distribution shift, while remaining competitive on highly stationary time series where adaptive correction provides limited additional benefit.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列预测在多个领域中的关键决策制定中起着至关重要的作用。虽然大语言模型提供了有前景的推理能力，但现有的基于大语言模型的时间序列预测方法要么将其简化为数值预测器，从而忽略了大语言模型的优势，要么允许直接进行预测生成，这在非平稳情况下会导致预测不稳定。我们提出了CTRL框架，该框架将语义推理与定量预测分离开来。一个固定的主干网络负责生成基础预测，而专门的LLM代理则作为控制器，通过分析趋势、季节性和不规则性等成分来分析主干网络的预测误差，从而使推理建立在可解释的时间结构上。每个代理输出紧凑的控制信号，这些信号由轻量级的残差解码器转换为预测修正信号。CTRL还包含了无需标签的测试时自适应机制，该机制仅通过输入统计数据就能检测分布变化，并通过缓存机制，只需3到24次LLM调用即可重新调整控制信号。CTRL被明确设计为能够在非平稳时间动态和分布变化的情况下提高鲁棒性，同时在对高度平稳的时间序列上仍然具有竞争力，因为在这样的场景下，自适应修正带来的额外好处有限。

papers.title: INDOTABVQA: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Table Understanding in Bahasa Indonesia Documents
papers.title_zh: INDOTABVQA：一种用于印尼语文档中跨语言表格理解的基准算法
papers.authors: Somraj Gautam, Anathapindika Dravichi, Gaurav Harit
papers.abstract: We introduce INDOTABVQA, a benchmark for evaluating cross-lingual Table Visual Question Answering (VQA) on real-world document images in Bahasa Indonesia. The dataset comprises 1,593 document images across three visual styles (bordered, borderless, and colorful) with one or more tables, and 1,593 question-answer sets in four languages: Bahasa Indonesia, English, Hindi, and Arabic. This enables evaluation of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in both monolingual (Bahasa documents with Bahasa questions) and cross-lingual settings (Bahasa documents with questions in other languages). We benchmark leading open-source VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL, Gemma- 3, LLaMA-3.2) and GPT-4o and reveal substantial performance gaps, particularly on structurally complex tables and in low-resource languages. Fine-tuning a compact 3B model and a LoRA- finetuned 7B model on our dataset yields 11.6% and 17.8% improvements in accuracy. Providing explicit table region coordinates as additional input further improves performance by 4-7%, demonstrating the value of Spatial priors for table-based reasoning. Our findings underscore the importance of language- diverse, domain-specific datasets and demonstrate that targeted fine-tuning can significantly enhance VLM performance on specialized document understanding tasks. INDOTABVQA provides a valuable resource for advancing research in cross-lingual, structure-aware document understanding, especially in underrepresented regions of the world. The dataset is publicly available via Hugging Face at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/NusaBharat/INDOTABVQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了INDOTABVQA这一基准测试，用于评估在印度尼西亚语真实文档图像上的跨语言表格视觉问答任务。该数据集包含1,593张具有三种不同视觉风格（有边框、无边框和彩色）的文档图像，每张图像中都包含一个或多个表格。同时，该数据集还包含了1,593对问题的回答集，这些问题来自四种语言：印度尼西亚语、英语、印地语和阿拉伯语。这使得我们能够评估单语言模型（用印度尼西亚语编写的文档和问题）以及跨语言模型（用其他语言编写的文档和问题）的性能。我们对一些领先的开源语言模型（如Qwen2.5-VL、Gemma-3、LLaMA-3.2）以及GPT-4o进行了性能评估，发现它们在处理结构复杂的表格和低资源语言时存在显著的性能差距。在我们的数据集上对一个紧凑的3B模型和一个经过LoRA微调的7B模型进行微调后，它们的准确率分别提高了11.6%和17.8%。如果额外提供表格区域的坐标信息，模型的性能还能再提高4-7%，这充分证明了空间先验在基于表格的推理中的重要性。我们的研究结果强调了拥有多种语言且特定领域的数据集的重要性，并表明有针对性的微调可以显著提高语言模型在专门文档理解任务上的性能。INDOTABVQA为推进跨语言、注重结构的文档理解研究提供了宝贵的资源，尤其是在世界上那些代表性不足的地区。该数据集可通过Hugging Face获取：https://huggingface.co/datasets/NusaBharat/INDOTABVQA。

papers.title: Cross-Cultural Transfer of Emoji Semantics and Sentiment in Financial Social Media
papers.title_zh: 金融社交媒体上表情符号语义与情感表达的文化间传播
papers.authors: Ahmed Mahrous, Roberto Di Pietro
papers.abstract: Emojis are widely used in online financial communication, but it is unclear whether they provide transferable sentiment signals across languages, platforms, and asset communities. This study examines the extent to which emoji usage, semantics, and sentiment polarity remain stable across financial communities, and how these layers influence zero-shot sentiment transfer. Using large corpora of Twitter and StockTwits posts in four languages, we measure cross-community divergence and evaluate sentiment models trained under emoji-only, text-only, and text+emoji inputs.We find that emoji frequencies differ across communities, especially across languages, but their semantics and sentiment polarity are largely stable. Cross-asset transferability shows minimal degradation, while cross-language transfer remains the most challenging. Including emojis consistently reduces transfer gaps relative to text-only models. These results indicate that financial communication exhibits a partially shared “emoji code,” and that emojis provide compact, language-independent sentiment cues that improve model generalization across markets and platforms.
papers.abstract_zh: 表情符号在在线金融通信中被广泛使用，但尚不清楚它们是否能够跨越语言、平台和资产社区传递相同的情感信号。本研究探讨了表情符号的使用、语义和情感极性在金融社区中的稳定性，以及这些因素如何影响零样本情感传递的效果。通过对比四种语言的Twitter和StockTwits帖子的大规模语料库，我们测量了不同社区之间的差异，并评估了仅在表情符号或仅文本输入下训练的情感模型的表现。我们发现，不同社区之间的表情符号使用频率存在差异，尤其是在不同语言之间；不过，表情符号的语义和情感极性基本保持稳定。跨资产类别的情感传递效果几乎没有下降，而跨语言情感传递则仍然面临较大挑战。与仅文本模型的比较来看，加入表情符号后，情感传递的效果有所改善。这些结果表明，金融通信中存在一种部分共享的“表情符号代码”，而表情符号能够提供一种简洁、与语言无关的情感线索，从而提升模型在不同市场和平台上的泛化能力。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: EXPO-SQL: Execution-based Clause-level Policy Optimization for Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: EXPO-SQL：基于执行的子句级策略优化技术，适用于文本转SQL场景
papers.authors: Jaehoon Lee, CheolWon Na, Suyoung Bae, Jin-Seop Lee, Jihyung Lee, YunSeok Choi, Jee-Hyong Lee
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL enables users to query databases using natural language by generating executable SQL queries. Recent methods have increasingly adopted Large Language Models based reinforcement learning (RL) to leverage execution feedback for training. However, existing RL methods assign uniform query-level rewards to all clauses in a SQL query, treating correct and incorrect clauses equally. This coarse-grained reward design leads to insufficient learning signals for correct SQL generation. To address this issue, we propose EXPO-SQL (EXecution-based clause-level Policy Optimization for Text-to-SQL) which provides fine-grained supervision through clause-level rewards. To assign clause-level rewards, our method identifies erroneous clauses by analyzing execution results, including error messages and clause-wise incremental execution. Experiments on widely-used Text-to-SQL benchmarks demonstrate that EXPO-SQL significantly outperforms existing supervised fine-tuning, prompting, and RL-based methods through fine-grained clause-level learning. Our code is available at https://github.com/jhn25/EXPO-SQL.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本转SQL功能允许用户使用自然语言来查询数据库，同时生成可执行的SQL查询语句。最近的一些方法越来越多地采用基于大语言模型的强化学习技术，以利用执行反馈来进行训练。然而，现有的强化学习方法会对SQL查询中的所有子句都赋予相同的查询级奖励，使得正确和错误的子句受到同等对待。这种粗粒度奖励设计会导致在正确生成SQL语句方面缺乏足够的学习信号。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了EXPO-SQL算法，它通过子句级奖励来实现细粒度的监督。为了分配子句级奖励，我们的方法通过分析执行结果来识别错误的子句，其中包括错误信息以及各个子句的增量执行情况。在广泛使用的文本转SQL基准测试上的实验表明，EXPO-SQL在细粒度子句级学习方面显著优于现有的有监督微调、提示式方法和基于强化学习的方法。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/jhn25/EXPO-SQL获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Synapse: Empowering LLM Agents with Episodic-Semantic Memory via Spreading Activation
papers.title_zh: Synapse：通过扩展激活机制，为大型语言模型代理提供情节化语义记忆功能
papers.authors: Hanqi Jiang, Junhao Chen, Yi Pan, Ling Chen, Weihang You, Yifan Zhou, Ruidong Zhang, Yohannes Abate, Tianming Liu
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at generalized reasoning, standard retrieval-augmented approaches fail to address the disconnected nature of long-term agentic memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce Synapse (Synergistic Associative Processing Semantic Encoding), a unified memory architecture that transcends static vector similarity. Drawing from cognitive science, Synapse models memory as a dynamic graph where relevance emerges from spreading activation rather than pre-computed links. By integrating lateral inhibition and temporal decay, the system dynamically highlights relevant sub-graphs while filtering interference. We implement a Triple Hybrid Retrieval strategy that fuses geometric embeddings with activation-based graph traversal. Extensive evaluations on the LoCoMo benchmark show that Synapse significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in complex temporal and multi-hop reasoning tasks, offering a robust solution to the “Contextual Tunneling” problem.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在泛化推理方面表现出色，但传统的基于检索增强的方法却无法解决长期记忆的孤立性问题。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Synapse技术——一种统一的记忆架构，它超越了静态向量相似性的概念。从认知科学的角度出发，Synapse将记忆建模为一个动态图结构，其中相关性是通过激活的传播而产生的，而非通过预先计算的链接来实现。通过整合侧向抑制和时间衰减机制，该系统能够动态地突出相关的子图，同时过滤掉干扰因素。我们采用了一种三重混合检索策略，将几何嵌入与基于激活的图遍历相结合。在LoCoMo基准测试中的广泛评估表明，Synapse在复杂的时间和多跳推理任务中显著优于现有方法，为“上下文隧道化”问题提供了有效的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Similarity-Distance-Magnitude Activations
papers.title_zh: 相似性-距离-大小激活度
papers.authors: Allen Schmaltz
papers.abstract: We introduce the Similarity-Distance-Magnitude (SDM) activation function, a more robust and interpretable formulation of the standard softmax activation function, adding Similarity (i.e., correctly predicted depth-matches into training) awareness and Distance-to-training-distribution awareness to the existing output Magnitude (i.e., decision-boundary) awareness, and enabling interpretability-by-exemplar via dense matching. We further introduce the SDM estimator, based on a data-driven partitioning of the class-wise empirical CDFs via the SDM activation, to control the class- and prediction-conditional accuracy among selective classifications. When used as the final-layer activation over pre-trained language models for selective classification, the SDM estimator is more robust to covariate shifts and out-of-distribution inputs than existing calibration methods using softmax activations, while remaining informative over in-distribution data.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了相似性-距离-幅度（SDM）激活函数，这是一种更为稳健且易于解释的标准化softmax激活函数的替代方案。该激活函数不仅保留了现有的输出幅度意识，还增加了对相似性的感知（即正确预测的深度匹配情况），以及距离训练分布的意识。通过密集匹配的方式，该激活函数能够实现可解释性。此外，我们还提出了基于SDM激活函数的SDM估计器，该估计器通过对类别经验累积分布进行数据驱动的划分来调控类别和预测条件下的准确率，从而实现对选择性分类的精准控制。当作为预训练语言模型的最终层激活函数用于选择性分类时，SDM估计器对于协变量偏移和超出分布范围的输入具有更强的鲁棒性，同时仍然能够在分布内的数据上保持信息丰富性。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SDAR: A Synergistic Diffusion-AutoRegression Paradigm for Scalable Sequence Generation
papers.title_zh: SDAR：一种用于可扩展序列生成的协同扩散-自回归范式
papers.authors: Shuang Cheng, Yihan Bian, Dawei Liu, Yuhua Jiang, Yihao Liu, Linfeng Zhang, Qian Yao, Zhongbo Tian, Wenhai Wang, Qipeng Guo, Kai Chen, Biqing Qi, Bowen Zhou
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) language modeling remains the dominant paradigm due to its dense supervision signal and highly optimized serving infrastructure, but its strictly causal, token-by-token decoding limits parallelism and non-causal modeling. While masked diffusion offers a promising path toward parallel generation, it faces two critical bottlenecks: training inefficiency stemming from sparse masked objectives, and high latency caused by iterative whole-sequence denoising. We present a systematic study of blockwise discrete diffusion, a pragmatic middle ground that preserves AR-compatible serving while enabling parallel intra-block generation. Our study proceeds in four steps: (i) a controlled, compute- and scale-matched comparison revealing that AR is a more effective backbone for blockwise hybrids than masked diffusion objectives; (ii) a scalable conversion recipe, SDAR, validating that AR models spanning 1.7B to 30B parameters can be adapted into block diffusion models with minimal compute while preserving backbone capabilities; and (iii) a systematic characterization of decoding dynamics, which reveals a virtuous cycle where larger models enable more aggressive parallel decoding, achieving theoretical speedups over 5\times and wall-clock speedups of 2.3\times on H200 GPUs in latency-critical regimes; and (iv) an investigation of local non-causal modeling capabilities, showing that SDAR’s local bidirectional attention overcomes causal bottlenecks in scientific domains (e.g., chemistry) and enables robust test-time scaling. We release the full model suite, the training framework, and our inference engines for further innovation in non-autoregressive generative paradigms.
papers.abstract_zh: 自回归语言建模由于其密集的监督信号和高度优化的服务基础设施，仍然占据主导地位。然而，其严格的因果性、逐词解码的方式限制了并行性，同时也无法支持非因果性的建模。而掩蔽扩散则提供了一种实现并行生成的潜在途径，但它面临着两个关键瓶颈：由于掩蔽目标稀疏导致的训练效率低下，以及迭代全序列去噪所带来的高延迟问题。我们对块状离散扩散进行了系统的研究，这是一种实用的中间方案，既能保留与自回归模型兼容的服务机制，又能实现块内并行生成。我们的研究分为四个步骤：(i) 进行对照实验，比较不同计算规模和性能下的自回归模型与掩蔽扩散模型，结果表明自回归模型在块状混合模型中比掩蔽扩散模型更为有效；(ii) 提出了一种可扩展的转换方法SDAR，验证了可以将参数范围从17亿到300亿的自回归模型转换为块状扩散模型，同时最大限度地保留原有模型的性能；(iii) 对解码动态进行了系统分析，发现较大的模型能够实现更激进的并行解码，在延迟敏感的场景下，理论上的加速效果超过5倍，实际运行速度则提升了2.3倍，这得益于H200 GPU的支持；(iv) 研究了局部非因果建模的能力，发现SDAR的局部双向注意力机制能够克服科学领域（如化学）中的因果性瓶颈，从而实现稳健的测试时间扩展。我们已发布完整的模型套件、训练框架以及推理引擎，为非自回归生成范式的发展提供更多的创新可能性。

papers.title: Comparing Human and Large Language Model Interpretation of Implicit Information
papers.title_zh: 比较人类语言和大型语言模型在解读隐性信息方面的表现
papers.authors: Antonio De Santis, Tommaso Bonetti, Andrea Tocchetti, Marco Brambilla
papers.abstract: The interpretation of implicit meanings is an integral aspect of human communication. However, this framework may not transfer to interactions with Large Language Models (LLMs). To investigate this, we introduce the task of Implicit Information Extraction (IIE) and propose an LLM-based IIE pipeline that builds a structured knowledge graph from a context sentence by extracting relational triplets, validating implicit inferences, and analyzing temporal relations. We evaluate two LLMs against crowdsourced human judgments on two datasets. We find that humans agree with most model triplets yet consistently propose many additions, indicating limited coverage in current LLM-based IIE. Moreover, in our experiments, models appear to be more conservative about implicit inferences than humans in socially rich contexts, whereas humans become more conservative in shorter, fact-oriented contexts. Our code is available at https://github.com/Antonio-Dee/IIE_from_LLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 隐性含义的解读是人类交流中不可或缺的一部分。然而，这种框架可能并不适用于与大语言模型（LLM）的互动。为了研究这一点，我们提出了隐性信息提取任务，并设计了一种基于LLM的隐性信息提取流程。该流程通过提取关系三元组、验证隐性推断以及分析时间关系，从上下文句子中构建出结构化的知识图谱。我们在两个数据集上对比了两种LLM在人工判断下的表现。我们发现，人类能够认同大多数模型得出的三元组，但同时也会提出许多补充内容，这表明当前基于LLM的隐性信息提取方法覆盖范围有限。此外，在我们的实验中，模型在社交性较强的情境下对隐性推断的处理更为保守，而在较短且以事实为导向的情境中，人类则表现得更为保守。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Antonio-Dee/IIE_from_LLM获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Simplify-Pro: A Two-level and Progressive LLM-based Framework for Auto Long Text Simplification
papers.title_zh: Simplify-Pro：一个基于大语言模型的双层次、渐进式长文本简化框架
papers.authors: Peng Zhou, Guangxin Li, Xiaoying Huang, Yiming Tang
papers.abstract: Text simplification plays a vital role in natural language processing, yet auto long text simplification remains challenging due to the difficulty in the joint balancing of simplification efficiency and fine-grained quality requirements, such as fluency, grammatical correctness and semantic completeness. To address these challenges, we propose Simplify-Pro, a two-level and progressive LLM-based framework that establishes an effective paradigm for automatic long text simplification under diverse test scenarios. By integrating paragraph-level training, simplification generation, metric-assisted analysis and selective refinement into a unified multi-stage pipeline, our framework achieves superior performance across in-domain and out-of-domain simplification tasks, which matches or even outperforms advanced and proprietary LLMs. Furthermore, comprehensive experiments and qualitative analyses cover the simplification performance, generalization ability and the contribution of each individual stage, demonstrating the effectiveness, robustness and modular design advantages of Simplify-Pro.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本简化在自然语言处理中起着至关重要的作用，然而，由于难以同时兼顾简化效率与精细化的质量要求（如流畅性、语法正确性以及语义完整性），自动长文本简化仍然面临巨大挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Simplify-Pro这一基于大语言模型的双层次渐进式框架。该框架为不同测试场景下的自动长文本简化提供了有效的解决方案。通过将段落级训练、简化生成、指标辅助分析以及选择性优化整合到一个统一的多阶段流程中，我们的框架在领域内外的简化任务中均取得了卓越的性能，其表现甚至优于先进且专有的大语言模型。此外，通过全面的实验和定性分析，我们可以评估简化任务的性能、泛化能力以及每个阶段的贡献，从而证明Simplify-Pro在有效性、鲁棒性以及模块化设计方面的优势。

papers.title: Pattern Enhanced Multi-Turn Jailbreaking: Exploiting Structural Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 模式增强型多轮越狱方法：利用大型语言模型中的结构漏洞
papers.authors: Ragib Amin Nihal, Rui Wen, Kazuhiro Nakadai, Jun Sakuma
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to multi-turn jailbreaking attacks that exploit conversational context to bypass safety constraints gradually. These attacks target different harm categories through distinct conversational approaches. Existing multi-turn methods often rely on heuristic or ad hoc exploration strategies, providing limited insight into underlying model weaknesses. The relationship between conversation patterns and model vulnerabilities across harm categories remains poorly understood. We propose Pattern Enhanced Chain of Attack (PE-CoA), a framework of five conversation patterns to construct multi-turn jailbreaks through natural dialogue. Evaluating PE-CoA on twelve LLMs spanning ten harm categories, we achieve state-of-the-art performance, uncovering pattern-specific vulnerabilities and LLM behavioral characteristics: models exhibit distinct weakness profiles, defense to one pattern does not generalize to others, and model families share similar failure modes. These findings highlight limitations of safety training and indicate the need for pattern-aware defenses. Code available on: https://github.com/Ragib-Amin-Nihal/PE-CoA
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型仍然容易受到多轮破解攻击的威胁，这些攻击利用对话上下文来逐步突破安全限制。这些攻击通过不同的对话方式针对不同的漏洞类别。现有的多轮破解方法通常依赖于启发式或临时性的探索策略，这无法揭示模型潜在的弱点。对话模式与不同漏洞类别之间的关系目前仍不清楚。我们提出了“模式增强攻击链”框架，该框架包含五种对话模式，通过自然的对话来实现多轮破解。在十二个涵盖十个漏洞类别的语言模型上评估该框架时，我们取得了最先进的性能表现，发现了特定模式的漏洞以及语言模型的行为特征：模型表现出不同的弱点特征，对某一模式的防御并不能推广到其他模式，而且不同的模型家族具有相似的故障模式。这些发现揭示了安全训练的局限性，并表明需要采用基于模式的防御机制。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/Ragib-Amin-Nihal/PE-CoA
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Data-Efficient Adaptation to Contextual Shifts in LLM-based Conversational Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的对话式推荐中，针对情境变化的数据高效适应机制
papers.authors: Hyeongjun Yang, Donghyun Kim, Seokju Hwang, Midan Shim, KyuHwan Yeom, KaeHyun Um, Kyong-Ho Lee
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based conversational recommender systems (CRSs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in capturing user preferences and generating contextually relevant recommendations. Nevertheless, the recommendation quality of the models frozen after training inevitably degrades under contextual shifts, such as changes in language and social trends. While periodic model updates are essential to maintain alignment with real-world preferences, training on large-scale data incurs substantial costs. This motivates data-efficient adaptation. However, existing data selection methods struggle to distinguish learnable samples under contextual shifts. To address this, we propose Contextual Shift-Adaptive Data Pruning and Training (CAPT), a framework agnostic to underlying LLM-based CRSs. Specifically, we conceptualize a three-class data taxonomy comprising familiar, valuable, and outlier samples to formalize data behavior under contextual shifts. Based on this taxonomy, we design an importance score estimation scheme that quantifies a sample’s relative learnability for shift adaptation. Leveraging these importance scores, CAPT prioritizes highly learnable samples and further guides shift-adaptive training to actively steer the model toward evolving preferences. Experiments on three CRS benchmarks with real-world temporal splits demonstrate that CAPT outperforms baselines, matching or surpassing full-data fine-tuning performance using only 10-50% of the training data.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的对话式推荐系统在捕捉用户偏好和生成上下文相关推荐方面表现出强大的能力。然而，这些模型的推荐质量在训练后会随着上下文的变化而下降，比如语言和社会趋势的变化。虽然定期更新模型对于保持与现实世界偏好的一致性至关重要，但大规模数据的训练需要高昂的成本。这就催生了数据高效适应的需求。不过，现有的数据选择方法在应对上下文变化时难以区分可学习样本。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为“上下文变化自适应数据剪枝与训练”（CAPT）的框架，该框架不依赖于具体的基于LLM的推荐系统。具体来说，我们定义了一个包含熟悉样本、有价值样本和异常样本的三类数据分类体系，以描述数据在上下文变化下的行为。基于这一分类体系，我们设计了一种重要性评分估算方案，用于量化样本在适应上下文变化方面的可学习性。利用这些重要性评分，CAPT能够优先处理那些具有高度可学习性的样本，并进一步指导适应性训练，从而引导模型朝着不断变化的偏好方向发展。在三个推荐系统基准测试上进行的实验表明，CAPT的表现优于基线方法，仅使用10-50%的训练数据就能达到与全数据微调相当甚至更好的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
