papers.title: PsychEval: A Multi-Session and Multi-Therapy Benchmark for High-Realism AI Psychological Counselor
papers.title_zh: PsychEval：一种适用于高现实感人工智能心理辅导的多会话、多疗法评估基准
papers.authors: Qianjun Pan, Junyi Wang, Jie Zhou, Yutao Yang, Junsong Li, Kaiyin Xu, Yougen Zhou, Yihan Li, JingYuan Zhao, Qin Chen, Ningning Zhou, Kai Chen, Liang He
papers.abstract: To develop a reliable AI for psychological assessment, we introduce PsychEval, a multi-session, multi-therapy, and highly realistic benchmark designed to address three key challenges:1) Can we train a highly realistic AI counselor? Realistic counseling is a longitudinal task requiring sustained memory and dynamic goal tracking. We propose a multi-session benchmark (spanning 6-10 sessions across three distinct stages) that demands critical capabilities such as memory continuity, adaptive reasoning, and longitudinal planning. The dataset is annotated with extensive professional skills, comprising over 677 meta-skills and 4577 atomic skills. 2) How to train a multi-therapy AI counselor? While existing models often focus on a single therapy, complex cases frequently require flexible strategies among various therapies. We construct a diverse dataset covering five therapeutic modalities alongside an integrative therapy with a unified three-stage clinical framework across six core psychological topics. 3) How to systematically evaluate an AI counselor? We establish a holistic evaluation framework with 18 therapy-specific and therapy-shared metrics across Client-Level and Counselor-Level dimensions. To We also construct over 2,000 diverse client profiles. Extensive experimental analysis fully validates the superior quality and clinical fidelity of our dataset.Our datasets and evaluation framework are anonymously available at this repository.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了开发一种可靠的AI心理评估工具，我们推出了PsychEval——一个包含多轮次、多疗法训练方式的高度真实化基准测试平台。该平台旨在解决三个关键挑战：1）能否训练出具有高度真实感的人工智能心理咨询师？真实的咨询过程需要持续的记忆能力和动态的目标跟踪能力。我们设计了一个包含6到10轮次的多轮次基准测试，涵盖了三个不同的阶段，这些阶段需要人工智能具备诸如记忆连续性、适应性推理以及长期规划等关键能力。我们的数据集包含了丰富的专业技能标注，共计677种元技能和4577种单项技能。2）如何训练出能够运用多种疗法的AI心理咨询师？虽然现有的模型通常只专注于单一疗法，但复杂的案例往往需要多种疗法之间的灵活组合。我们构建了一个涵盖五种治疗方法的多样化数据集，同时引入了整合性疗法，并采用统一的三个阶段临床框架来处理六个核心心理学主题。3）如何系统地评估人工智能心理咨询师的性能？我们建立了一个全面的评估框架，包含了18项针对特定疗法以及共通疗法的评估指标，这些指标涵盖了客户层面和咨询师层面的维度。此外，我们还构建了超过2000个多样化的客户档案。大量的实验分析充分证明了我们数据集在质量与临床效度方面的卓越表现。我们的数据集和评估框架可以在此仓库中匿名获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GrandGuard: Taxonomy, Benchmark, and Safeguards for Elderly-Chatbot Interaction Safety
papers.title_zh: GrandGuard：针对与老年人交互的聊天机器人的分类、基准测试以及安全保障措施
papers.authors: Changxuan Fan, Xi Yang, Yueyuan Zheng, Bin Zhou, Yuanping Wang, Wenbin Hu, Huihao Jing, Ki Sen Hung, Dazhao Du, Haoran Li, Janet Hui-wen Hsiao, Yangqiu Song
papers.abstract: As older adults increasingly use LLM-based chatbots for companionship and assistance, a safety gap is emerging. Older adults may face vulnerabilities from social isolation, limited digital literacy, and cognitive decline, yet existing safety benchmarks largely target general harms and overlook elderly-specific risks. For example, a prompt such as “how to repair a ceiling light alone in the dark” may be benign for most users but poses a serious fall risk for older adults with mobility limitations.We introduce GrandGuard, the first comprehensive framework for assessing and mitigating elderly-specific contextual risks in LLM interactions. We develop a three-level taxonomy with 50 fine-grained risk types across mental well-being, financial, medical, toxicity, and privacy domains, grounded in real-world incidents, community discussions, and analysis of stakeholder studies. Using this taxonomy, we construct a benchmark of 10,404 labeled prompts and responses, showing that several leading LLMs mishandle elderly-specific contextual risks in over 50% of cases. We mitigate these failures with two safeguards: a fine-tuned Llama-Guard-3 and a policy-enhanced gpt-oss-safeguard-20b, achieving up to 96.2% and 90.9% unsafe-prompt detection accuracy, respectively. GrandGuard lays the groundwork for AI systems that move beyond general safety to support aging populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着老年人越来越多地使用基于大语言模型的聊天机器人来寻求陪伴和帮助，安全问题也随之出现。老年人可能会因社交隔离、数字素养不足以及认知能力下降而面临风险，然而现有的安全评估标准大多针对的是一般性的危害，而忽视了老年人特有的风险。例如，像“如何在黑暗中独自修理天花板灯”这样的提示对大多数用户来说可能是无害的，但对于行动不便的老年人来说，却可能带来严重的跌倒风险。我们推出了GrandGuard，这是首个用于评估和减轻大语言模型交互中针对老年人特有风险的综合框架。我们构建了一个三级分类体系，涵盖了精神健康、财务、医疗、隐私等多个领域，共包含50种细粒度风险类型。该分类体系基于现实世界中的事件、社区讨论以及利益相关者研究的分析结果。通过这一分类体系，我们构建了10,404个带有标签的提示和回复样本，结果显示，一些领先的大语言模型在超过50%的情况下未能正确处理与老年人相关的风险。我们通过两种防护措施来弥补这些缺陷：一种是经过微调的Llama-Guard-3，另一种则是经过政策优化的gpt-oss-safeguard-20b，这两种防护措施的准确率分别达到了96.2%和90.9%。GrandGuard为人工智能系统提供了基础，使其能够超越一般的安全性要求，更好地支持老年人群体的需求。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SciExplore: Evaluating Autonomous Agents from Scientific Navigation to Information Integration
papers.title_zh: SciExplore：从科学导航到信息整合的自主智能体评估
papers.authors: Yinhao Tang, Youqing Fang, Yanan Sun, Wenran Liu, Weiming Zhang, Bin Liu, Kuikun Liu, Wenwei Zhang, Kai Chen
papers.abstract: Scientific research involves complex information-seeking and reasoning workflows across heterogeneous sources. However, existing benchmarks primarily emphasize general-domain retrieval or static scientific question answering, and therefore fail to assess key capabilities required in realistic scientific research workflows. We introduce SciExplore, a benchmark designed to evaluate scientific information-seeking and reasoning capabilities of LLMs and agents. SciExplore comprises four task types covering 103 expert-curated tasks across more than ten scientific disciplines: scientific database navigation, ambiguous literature retrieval, missing reference completion, and cross-source structured knowledge synthesis, which probe progressively higher-level abilities from entity-level reasoning and document-level identification to evidence-level grounding and domain-level synthesis. We evaluate over ten state-of-the-art LLMs and autonomous agents on SciExplore, revealing substantial performance gaps with performance degrading sharply as task complexity increases and extremely low accuracy on the most challenging structured synthesis tasks. These results highlight significant limitations of current models and agents in realistic scientific information-seeking scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学研究涉及从不同来源获取复杂信息并进行推理的工作流程。然而，现有的评估基准主要侧重于通用领域的检索或静态的科学问题回答，因此无法评估现实科学研究工作流程中所需的关键能力。我们提出了SciExplore这一评估基准，旨在评估大语言模型和智能体在科学信息获取与推理方面的能力。SciExplore包含四种任务类型，共包含103个由专家精心挑选的任务，涵盖十多个科学领域：科学数据库导航、模糊文献检索、缺失参考文献的补充，以及跨源结构化知识合成。这些任务逐步挑战了更高层次的能力，从实体级别的推理和文档级别的识别，到证据级别的推理和领域级别的合成。我们对十几种最先进的大语言模型和智能体进行了SciExplore评估，发现它们的性能存在显著差距：随着任务复杂性的增加，性能急剧下降，而在最具挑战性的结构化合成任务上，准确率极低。这些结果凸显了当前模型与智能体在现实科学研究场景中的明显局限性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When Models Outthink Their Safety: Unveiling and Mitigating Self-Jailbreak in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 当模型们的推理能力超越安全限制时：揭示并规避大型推理模型中的自我破坏现象
papers.authors: Yingzhi Mao, Chunkang Zhang, Junxiang Wang, Xinyan Guan, Boxi Cao, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Xianpei Han, Le Sun
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex multi-step reasoning, yet they still exhibit severe safety failures such as harmful content generation. Existing methods often apply coarse-grained constraints over the entire reasoning trajectories, which can undermine reasoning capability while failing to address the root causes of unsafe behavior. In this work, we uncover a previously underexplored failure mode in LRMs, termed Self-Jailbreak, where models initially recognize the harmful intent of a query, but override this judgment during subsequent reasoning steps, ultimately generating unsafe outputs. Such a phenomenon reveals that LRMs are capable of recognizing harm, while safety failures primarily arise from reasoning steps. Motivated by this finding, we propose Chain-of-Guardrail (CoG), a trajectory-level training framework that mitigates Self-Jailbreak via targeted, step-level interventions while maintaining reasoning ability. Experiments across multiple safety and reasoning benchmarks indicate that CoG achieves a favorable balance between safety and reasoning performance compared with existing approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在复杂的多步骤推理任务中表现出强大的性能，然而它们仍然会出现严重的安全问题，例如生成有害内容。现有的方法通常对整个推理过程施加粗略的约束，这可能会削弱推理能力，同时无法解决导致不安全行为的根本原因。在这项研究中，我们发现了一种之前未被充分研究的推理模型故障模式，称为“自我破坏”。在这种模式下，模型最初能够识别查询中的有害意图，但在后续的推理过程中却推翻了这一判断，最终产生不安全的输出。这种现象表明，推理模型能够识别到危害，而安全问题主要源于推理过程中的某些步骤。基于这一发现，我们提出了“护栏链”训练框架。该框架通过有针对性的、针对特定步骤的干预措施来减轻自我破坏现象，同时保持推理能力。在多个安全和推理基准测试中的实验表明，“护栏链”框架能够在安全性和推理性能之间取得良好的平衡，优于现有的其他方法。

papers.title: NASH: Numerically Aware Scoring Heuristic for Robust Semantic Similarity
papers.title_zh: NASH：一种用于计算语义相似度的数值感知评分启发式方法
papers.authors: Yu-Shiang Huang, Yun-Yu Lee, Tzu-Hsin Chou, Che Lin, Chuan-Ju Wang
papers.abstract: Numerical precision is critical in financial NLP, yet embedding-based semantic similarity metrics exhibit numerical blindness—failing to distinguish contradictory values within similar contexts. We introduce NASH (Numerically Aware Scoring Hueristic), a model-agnostic metric that decouples numerical verification from textual semantic evaluation through a three-stage pipeline: (1) modal separation via numeric masking, (2) dual-channel similarity estimation through masked-text similarity and context-aware numeric alignment, and (3) IDF-weighted aggregation. NASH functions as a drop-in enhancement to existing embedding-based metrics. Validated on our proposed NumFinE financial numerical evaluation benchmark and established semantic similarity datasets (STS-B, Financial-STS), NASH achieves substantial improvements in numerical sensitivity (up to +159.6% on listwise ranking) while preserving general semantic performance, establishing a reliable standard for numeracy-aware evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 在金融自然语言处理中，数值精度至关重要。然而，基于嵌入的语义相似性度量方法存在“数值盲点”问题——即无法在相似上下文中区分矛盾的数值。我们提出了NASH（数值感知评分指标），这是一种与模型无关的度量方法，它通过三个阶段来实现数值验证与文本语义评估的分离：(1) 通过数值掩蔽实现模态分离；(2) 通过掩码文本相似性和上下文感知的数值对齐来实现双通道相似性估计；(3) 采用IDF加权方法进行聚合。NASH可以轻松地被添加到现有的基于嵌入的度量方法中。在我们提出的NumFinE金融数值评估基准上进行了验证，并且在已建立的语义相似性数据集（STS-B、Financial-STS）中也得到了验证。结果表明，NASH在数值敏感性方面取得了显著改进（在列表排序上提高了159.6%），同时保留了一般的语义性能，为数值感知评估建立了一个可靠的标准。

papers.title: Beyond Query Bias: Candidate-Aware Iterative Refinement for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 超越查询偏差：基于候选对象的迭代优化方法在零样本图像检索中的应用
papers.authors: Nan Sun, Jing Tang, Lei Sun, Rui Chen, Yuxing Lu, Xiangxiang Chu, Hefei Ling, Yujun Cai
papers.abstract: Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval (ZS-CIR) retrieves target images using a reference image and modification text without task-specific training. Existing methods typically rely on MLLMs to generate query vectors with pre-trained models like CLIP. However, those constructed queries suffer from inherent cognitive bias due to unknown candidate distribution. We propose CoRR, a training-free framework that reframes ZS-CIR as a self-correcting process through bias-aware query refinement. CoRR uses retrieved results as feedback to perceive the candidate distribution. With carefully designed CoT prompting, the MLLM inspects the retrieved candidates to identify intent misalignments in the query and then corrects them via Historical Query Fusion. We also introduce Retrieval-Driven Caption Optimization to provide context-aligned examples, reducing phrasing and style mismatches. Experiments on public benchmarks show that CoRR significantly outperforms other SOTA methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 零样本合成图像检索（Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval，ZS-CIR）利用参考图像和修改文本来检索目标图像，而无需进行特定任务的训练。现有方法通常依赖大语言模型来生成查询向量，这些模型如CLIP是预训练的。然而，这些生成的查询由于候选样本的未知分布而存在固有的认知偏差。我们提出了CoRR这一无训练框架，它将ZS-CIR重新定义为一个自我修正的过程，通过具有偏见感知的查询优化来实现这一点。CoRR利用检索到的结果作为反馈，以了解候选样本的分布情况。通过精心设计的上下文提示，大语言模型会检查检索到的候选样本，识别查询中的意图错位问题，并通过历史查询融合来纠正这些问题。我们还引入了基于检索的标题优化技术，以提供与上下文一致的示例，减少措辞和风格上的不匹配。在公共基准测试中的实验表明，CoRR显著优于其他先进的方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Large Reasoning Models Are (Not Yet) Multilingual Latent Reasoners
papers.title_zh: 大型推理模型尚未实现多语言处理能力，仍属于潜在式推理器范畴
papers.authors: Yihong Liu, Raoyuan Zhao, Hinrich Schuetze, Michael A. Hedderich
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on mathematical reasoning tasks, often attributed to their capability to generate explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) explanations. However, recent work shows that LRMs often arrive at the correct answer before completing these textual reasoning steps, indicating the presence of latent reasoning – internal, non-verbal computation encoded in hidden states. While this phenomenon has been explored in English, its multilingual behavior remains largely unknown. In this paper, we conduct a systematic investigation of multilingual latent reasoning in LRMs across 11 languages. Using a truncation-based strategy, we examine how the correct answer emerges as the model is given only partial reasoning traces, allowing us to measure stepwise latent prediction formation. Our results reveal clear evidence of multilingual latent reasoning, though unevenly: strong in resource-rich languages, weaker in low-resource ones, and broadly less observable on harder benchmarks. To understand whether these differences reflect distinct internal mechanisms, we further perform representational analyses. Despite surface-level disparities, we find that the internal evolution of predictions is highly consistent across languages and broadly aligns with English – a pattern suggesting an English-centered latent reasoning pathway.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在数学推理任务上表现优异，这通常归因于它们能够生成明确的思维链解释。然而，最近的研究表明，大型推理模型往往在完成这些文本推理步骤之前就已经得出了正确答案，这表明存在潜在的推理过程——即内部、非语言的计算过程，这些计算被编码在隐藏的状态中。虽然这种现象已经在英语中被研究过，但其在多种语言中的表现仍然知之甚少。在本文中，我们对11种语言中大型推理模型的潜在推理进行了系统的研究。通过采用截断策略，我们研究了在模型仅获得部分推理线索的情况下，如何正确答案是如何形成的，从而能够逐步测量潜在的预测形成过程。我们的研究结果清楚地表明了多语言潜在推理的存在，不过这种推理在不同语言中的强度并不均衡：在资源丰富的语言中较为明显，在资源匮乏的语言中则较弱，而且在难度较高的基准测试中则不太容易观察到。为了了解这些差异是否反映了不同的内部机制，我们还进行了表征分析。尽管表面上存在差异，但我们发现，不同语言的预测内部演变过程高度一致，并且与英语的趋势大致相同——这一模式表明，潜在的推理过程是以英语为中心的。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Towards Scalable Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-role Orchestration
papers.title_zh: 通过多角色协调实现可扩展的轻量级图形用户界面代理
papers.authors: Ziwei Wang, Junjie Zheng, Leyang Yang, Sheng Zhou, Xiaoxuan Tang, Fang Zhouhua, Zhiwei Liu, Dajun Chen, Yong Li, Jiajun Bu
papers.abstract: Autonomous Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents powered by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) enable digital automation on end-user devices. While scaling both parameters and data has yielded substantial gains, advanced methods still suffer from prohibitive deployment costs on resource-constrained devices. When facing complex in-the-wild scenarios, lightweight GUI agents are bottlenecked by limited capacity and poor task scalability under end-to-end episodic learning, impeding multi-agent systems (MAS) adaptation, while training multiple skill-specific experts remains costly. Can we strike an effective trade-off in this cost–scalability dilemma, enabling lightweight MLLMs to participate in realistic GUI workflows? To address these challenges, we propose LAMO framework, which endows a lightweight MLLM with GUI-specific knowledge and task scalability, allowing multi-role orchestration to expand their capability boundary for GUI automation. LAMO combines role-oriented data synthesis with a two-stage training recipe: (i) supervised fine-tuning with Perplexity-Weighted Cross-Entropy optimization for knowledge distillation and visual perception enhancement, and (ii) reinforcement learning for role-oriented cooperative exploration. Via LAMO, we develop a task-scalable native GUI agent LAMO-3B supporting monolithic execution and MAS-style orchestration. When paired with advanced planners, as a plug-and-play policy executor, LAMO-3B can continuously benefit from planner advances, enabling a higher performance ceiling. Extensive static and online evaluations validate the effectiveness of our designs.
papers.abstract_zh: 由多模态大语言模型驱动的自主图形用户界面代理能够在终端用户设备上实现数字化自动化。虽然扩大参数和数据规模带来了显著的优势，但先进的方法在资源有限的设备上的部署成本仍然过高。面对复杂的实际情况时，轻量级图形用户界面代理由于能力有限以及端到端情景学习中的任务可扩展性问题而陷入瓶颈，这阻碍了多智能体系统的适应性发展。同时，训练多个具有特定技能的专家也成本很高。我们能否在这一成本与可扩展性之间找到有效的平衡点，使轻量级大语言模型能够参与实际的图形用户界面工作流程呢？为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了LAMO框架。该框架为轻量级大语言模型赋予了与图形用户界面相关的知识和任务可扩展性，使得多角色协调成为可能，从而扩展其图形用户界面自动化的能力边界。LAMO结合了以角色为导向的数据合成和两阶段训练方法：(i) 通过困惑度加权交叉熵优化进行监督微调，以实现知识蒸馏和视觉感知能力的提升；(ii) 通过强化学习来实现以角色为导向的协作探索。通过LAMO，我们开发出了一种具有任务可扩展性的原生图形用户界面代理LAMO-3B，它能够支持整体执行和多智能体风格的协调工作。当与先进的规划器结合使用时，LAMO-3B可以作为即插即用的策略执行器，持续受益于规划器的进步，从而实现更高的性能水平。大量的静态和在线评估验证了我们的设计有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Memory Matters More: Event-Centric Memory as a Logic Map for Agent Searching and Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 重要性不言而喻：以事件为中心的内存模型作为智能体搜索和推理的逻辑基础
papers.authors: Yuyang Hu, Jiongnan Liu, Jiejun Tan, Yutao Zhu, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as intelligent agents that reason, plan, and interact with their environments. To effectively scale to long-horizon scenarios, a key capability for such agents is a memory mechanism that can retain, organize, and retrieve past experiences to support downstream decision-making. However, most existing approaches organize and store memories in a flat manner and rely on simple similarity-based retrieval techniques. Even when structured memory is introduced, existing methods often struggle to explicitly capture the logical relationships among experiences or memory units. Moreover, memory access is largely detached from the constructed structure and still depends on shallow semantic retrieval, preventing agents from reasoning logically over long-horizon dependencies. In this work, we propose CompassMem, an event-centric memory framework inspired by Event Segmentation Theory. CompassMem organizes memory as an Event Graph by incrementally segmenting experiences into events and linking them through explicit logical relations. This graph serves as a logic map, enabling agents to perform structured and goal-directed navigation over memory beyond superficial retrieval, progressively gathering valuable memories to support long-horizon reasoning. Experiments on LoCoMo and NarrativeQA demonstrate that CompassMem consistently improves both retrieval and reasoning performance across multiple backbone models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作智能代理，它们能够推理、规划并与环境进行交互。为了有效应对长期视角的场景，这类代理的一个关键能力就是拥有能够存储、组织并检索过去经验的记忆机制，从而支持后续的决策制定。然而，目前大多数方法都是以扁平化的方式组织和存储记忆，并且依赖于简单的基于相似性的检索技术。即使引入了结构化记忆，现有方法往往也难以明确捕捉经验或记忆单元之间的逻辑关系。此外，记忆的访问与构建的结构分离，仍然依赖于浅层的语义检索，这限制了代理对长期视角的依赖关系进行逻辑推理的能力。在这项研究中，我们提出了CompassMem这一以事件为中心的记忆框架，它借鉴了事件分割理论的思想。CompassMem通过将经验逐步分割成事件，并通过明确的逻辑关系将它们连接起来，从而将记忆组织成一个事件图。这个图充当了一个逻辑映射，使代理能够在记忆中进行有结构且目标导向的导航，而不仅仅是进行表面的检索。在LoCoMo和NarrativeQA上的实验表明，CompassMem在不同模型上都能持续提升检索和推理性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Format-Adapter: Improving Reasoning Capability of LLMs by Adapting Suitable Format
papers.title_zh: 格式适配：通过采用合适的格式来提升大语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Dingzirui Wang, Xuanliang Zhang, Rongyu Cao, Longxu Dou, Xianzhen Luo, Yingwei MA, Qingfu Zhu, Binhua Li, Fei Huang, Yongbin Li
papers.abstract: Generating and voting multiple answers is an effective method to mitigate reasoning inconsistencies of large language models (LLMs). Prior works have shown that multiple reasoning formats outperform a single format when generating multiple answers. However, previous works using multiple formats rely on formats labeled by humans, which could be unsuitable for all tasks and have high labeling costs. To address this issue, we adapt suitable formats to the given tasks by generating and selecting formats. We first propose how to measure the reasoning error when generating multiple answers. Then, we introduce Format-Adapter, which utilizes LLMs to generate and select suitable reasoning formats by minimizing the error measurement we present. We conduct experiments on math and commonsense reasoning tasks, where Format-Adapter achieves a 4.3% performance improvement on average over previous works, demonstrating the effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成并投票多个答案是一种有效的方法来减少大语言模型（LLM）的推理不一致性。先前的研究表明，在生成多个答案时，多种推理格式的效果优于单一格式。然而，之前使用多种格式的研究依赖于人类标记的格式，这可能不适用于所有任务，并且会带来较高的标记成本。为了解决这个问题，我们通过生成和选择合适的格式来适应给定的任务。我们首先提出了如何衡量生成多个答案时的推理错误。然后，我们引入了Format-Adapter，它利用LLM来生成并选择合适的推理格式，以最小化我们所提出的误差度量。我们在数学和常识推理任务上进行了实验，结果表明，Format-Adapter的平均性能比以往的工作提高了4.3%，证明了其有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Behavior-Aware Item Modeling via Dynamic Procedural Solution Representations for Knowledge Tracing
papers.title_zh: 基于动态程序化解决方案的行为感知物品建模技术，用于知识追踪
papers.authors: Jun Seo, Sangwon Ryu, Heejin Do, Hyounghun Kim, Gary Lee
papers.abstract: Knowledge Tracing (KT) aims to predict learners’ future performance from past interactions. While recent KT approaches have improved via learning item representations aligned with Knowledge Components, they overlook the procedural dynamics of problem solving. We propose Behavior-Aware Item Modeling (BAIM), a framework that enriches item representations by integrating dynamic procedural solution information. BAIM leverages a reasoning language model to decompose each item’s solution into four problem-solving stages (i.e., understand, plan, carry out, and look back), pedagogically grounded in Polya’s framework. Specifically, it derives stage-level representations from per-stage embedding trajectories, capturing latent signals beyond surface features. To reflect learner heterogeneity, BAIM adaptively routes these stage-wise representations, introducing a context-conditioned mechanism within a KT backbone, allowing different procedural stages to be emphasized for different learners. Experiments on XES3G5M and NIPS34 show that BAIM consistently outperforms strong pretraining-based baselines, achieving particularly large gains under repeated learner interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识追踪（KT）旨在从过往的互动中预测学习者的未来表现。虽然最近的KT方法通过采用与知识组件相一致的表示方式而取得了改进，但它们忽略了问题解决过程中的程序性动态。我们提出了行为感知项目建模（BAIM）框架，该框架通过整合动态的程序性解决方案信息来丰富项目表示。BAIM利用推理语言模型将每个项目的解决方案分解为四个问题解决阶段（即理解、计划、执行和回顾），这些阶段基于波利亚的教学框架。具体来说，它从每个阶段的嵌入轨迹中提取出阶段级表示，捕捉到表面特征之外的潜在信号。为了反映学习者的差异性，BAIM能够自适应地路由这些阶段级表示，在KT框架内引入一种条件化机制，使得不同学习者在不同的程序阶段得到强调。在XES3G5M和NIPS34上的实验表明，BAIM始终优于基于强预训练的基线方法，尤其是在重复的学习者互动下，其性能获得了显著的提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Tracing the Light of Thought: A Probabilistic Self- and Cross-Consistency Verification Mechanism Improving Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 追踪思想的光芒：一种基于概率性的自我一致性验证机制，旨在提升大语言模型的数学推理能力
papers.authors: Xiaoyang Liu, Dawei Wang, Tian Li, Huizhi Liang, Gary Ushaw, Richard Davison
papers.abstract: Reasoning capability is fundamental in enabling Large Language Models to perform complex multi-step inference. By sampling multiple reasoning paths and selecting the most frequent answer, Self Consistency (SC) remains highly effective but fails on challenging tasks where incorrect answers dominate the majority. Inspired by Metropolis Light Transport in physically-based rendering, where discovered high-contribution light paths guide subsequent sampling toward illumination sources, we propose Metropolis Self Consistency and its multi-LLM extension, Metropolis Cross Consistency, a probabilistic self- and cross-consistency verification framework for mathematical reasoning. Our approach employs an accept-reject mechanism to encourage high-quality reasoning paths, concentrating sampling in regions more likely to yield correct answers. Experiments on 9 LLMs across 4 challenging mathematical benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over SC. Even when combining models of vastly different capabilities, MCC maintains performance virtually matching the most capable model while significantly reducing computational cost compared to SC with the strongest model alone. While our implementation is training-free, adds minimal token overhead beyond SC, and requires no external reward model, our approach provides a flexible paradigm that can accommodate any scalar reward representing path correctness.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理能力是使大语言模型能够执行复杂多步骤推理的基础。通过采样多个推理路径并选择最频繁的答案，自一致性方法仍然非常有效，但在那些错误答案占主导地位的任务中则表现不佳。受物理基础渲染中的Metropolis光传输方法的启发，该方法通过引导后续采样朝向照明源来寻找高贡献的光路径，我们提出了Metropolis自一致性及其多语言模型扩展版本——Metropolis交叉自一致性，这是一种用于数学推理的概率性自一致性和交叉一致性验证框架。我们的方法采用接受-拒绝机制来鼓励生成高质量的推理路径，并将采样集中在更有可能得出正确答案的区域。在4个具有挑战性的数学基准测试中，对9种语言模型进行的实验表明，与自一致性方法相比，交叉自一致性方法取得了持续的改进。即使结合不同能力的模型，交叉自一致性方法的性能几乎可以与最强大的模型相媲美，同时与仅使用最强模型的自一致性方法相比，其计算成本显著降低。虽然我们的实现不需要进行训练，且除了自一致性方法之外几乎没有额外的令牌开销，同时也不需要外部奖励模型，但我们的方法提供了一个灵活的框架，可以适应任何表示路径正确性的标量奖励。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: E2E-GMNER: End-to-End Generative Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition
papers.title_zh: E2E-GMNER：端到端生成式基于多模态的命名实体识别技术
papers.authors: Meng Zhang, Jinzhong Ning, Xiaolong Wu, Hongfei Lin, Yijia Zhang
papers.abstract: Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition (GMNER) aims to jointly identify named entity mentions in text, predict their semantic types, and ground each entity to a corresponding visual region in an associated image. Existing approaches predominantly adopt pipeline-based architectures that decouple textual entity recognition and visual grounding, leading to error accumulation and suboptimal joint optimization. In this paper, we propose E2E-GMNER, a fully end-to-end generative framework that unifies entity recognition, semantic typing, visual grounding, and implicit knowledge reasoning within a single multimodal large language model. We formulate GMNER as an instruction-tuned conditional generation task and incorporate chain-of-thought reasoning to enable the model to adaptively determine when visual evidence or background knowledge is informative, reducing reliance on noisy cues. To further address the instability of generative bounding box prediction, we introduce Gaussian Risk-Aware Box Perturbation (GRBP), which replaces hard box supervision with probabilistically perturbed soft targets to improve robustness against annotation noise and discretization errors. Extensive experiments on the Twitter-GMNER and Twitter-FMNERG benchmarks demonstrate that E2E-GMNER achieves highly competitive performance compared with state of the art methods, validating the effectiveness of unified end-to-end optimization and noise-aware grounding supervision.
papers.abstract_zh: Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition（GMNER）旨在共同识别文本中的命名实体，预测它们的语义类型，并将每个实体映射到相关图像中的相应视觉区域。现有的方法大多采用基于流水线的架构，这种架构将文本实体识别与视觉定位分离开来，导致错误累积和联合优化的效果不佳。在本文中，我们提出了E2E-GMNER，这是一个完全端到端的生成式框架，它将实体识别、语义分类、视觉定位和隐式知识推理整合到一个多模态大语言模型中。我们将GMNER构建为一个基于指令调优的条件生成任务，并引入思维链推理机制，使模型能够自适应地判断何时需要视觉证据或背景知识来辅助决策，从而减少对噪声线索的依赖。为了进一步解决生成式边界框预测的不稳定性问题，我们引入了高斯风险感知边界扰动技术，该技术用概率性扰动的软目标替代硬边界监督，以提高模型对注释噪声和离散化误差的鲁棒性。在Twitter-GMNER和Twitter-FMNERG基准测试上的广泛实验表明，E2E-GMNER的性能与现有最先进方法相比具有显著优势，这验证了统一端到端优化以及噪声感知的边界定位监督的有效性。

papers.title: Think Less, Know More: State-Aware Reasoning Compression with Knowledge Guidance for Efficient Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 少思考，多了解：基于知识指导的状态感知推理压缩技术，实现高效推理
papers.authors: Yi Sui, Chaozhuo Li, Dawei Song
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks by leveraging long Chain-of-Thought (CoT), but often suffer from overthinking, leading to excessive reasoning steps and high inference latency. Existing CoT compression methods struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency, and lack fine-grained, step-level adaptation to redundancy and reasoning bias. Therefore, we propose State-Aware Reasoning Compression with Knowledge Guidance (STACK), a framework that performs step-wise CoT compression by explicitly modeling stage-specific redundancy sources and integrating with a retrieval-augmented guidance. STACK constructs online long–short contrastive samples and dynamically switches between knowledge-guided compression for uncertain or biased reasoning state and self-prompted compression for overly long but confident state, complemented by an answer-convergence-based early stopping mechanism to suppress redundant verification. We further propose a reward-difference-driven training strategy by combining Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), enabling models to learn state-conditioned compression strategies. Experiments on three mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that STACK achieves a superior accuracy–efficiency balance, reducing average response length by 59.9% while improving accuracy by 4.8 points over existing methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在复杂任务中表现出强大的性能，这得益于其利用长思维链进行推理的能力。然而，这类模型往往会出现过度推理的问题，导致推理步骤过多以及推理延迟严重。现有的推理链压缩方法难以在准确性和效率之间取得平衡，且缺乏对冗余和推理偏差的细粒度、阶段级适应。因此，我们提出了一种名为“状态感知推理压缩与知识引导”的框架（STACK）。该框架通过明确建模特定阶段的冗余来源，并结合检索增强式引导机制，实现逐步的推理链压缩。STACK还构建了在线长短对比样本，并动态地在不确定或存在偏差的推理状态下采用知识引导压缩方式，在推理结果较为可靠的情况下则采用自我提示压缩方式。此外，我们还采用了一种基于奖励差异驱动的训练策略，结合近端策略优化（PPO）和直接偏好优化（DPO）算法，使模型能够学习到基于状态的压缩策略。在三个数学推理基准测试中的实验表明，STACK在准确性和效率方面取得了显著优势：平均响应长度减少了59.9%，而准确率则提高了4.8个百分点，优于现有方法。

papers.title: Muse: Towards Reproducible Long-Form Song Generation with Fine-Grained Style Control
papers.title_zh: Muse：实现可复制的长篇歌曲创作，同时具备精细的风格控制能力
papers.authors: Changhao Jiang, Jiahao Chen, Zhenghao Xiang, Zhixiong Yang, Hanchen Wang, Jiabao Zhuang, Xinmeng Che, Jiajun Sun, Hui Li, Yifei Cao, Shihan Dou, Ming Zhang, Junjie Ye, Tao Ji, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Recent commercial systems such as Suno demonstrate strong capabilities in long-form song generation, while academic research remains largely non-reproducible due to the lack of publicly available training data, hindering fair comparison and progress. To this end, we release a fully open-source system for long-form song generation with fine-grained style conditioning, including a licensed synthetic dataset, training and evaluation pipelines, and Muse, an easy-to-deploy song generation model. The dataset consists of 116k fully licensed synthetic songs with automatically generated lyrics and style descriptions paired with audio synthesized by SunoV5. We train Muse via single-stage supervised finetuning of a Qwen-based language model extended with discrete audio tokens using MuCodec, without task-specific losses, auxiliary objectives, or additional architectural components. Our evaluations find that although Muse is trained with a modest data scale and model size, it achieves competitive performance on phoneme error rate, text–music style similarity, and audio aesthetic quality, while enabling controllable segment-level generation across different musical structures. All data, model weights, and training and evaluation pipelines will be publicly released, paving the way for continued progress in controllable long-form song generation research.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的商业系统，如Suno，在长形式歌曲生成方面表现出强大的能力。然而，由于缺乏公开可用的训练数据，学术研究往往难以进行复制，这阻碍了公平的比较和进展。为此，我们发布了一个完全开源的长形式歌曲生成系统，该系统具有精细的风格控制功能，包含经过许可的合成数据集、训练和评估流程，以及易于部署的歌曲生成模型Muse。该数据集包含11.6万首经过许可合成的音乐作品，这些作品配有自动生成的歌词和风格描述，并附带由SunoV5合成的音频文件。我们通过使用MuCodec对基于Qwen的语言模型进行单阶段监督微调来训练Muse，该过程中没有使用特定任务的损失函数、辅助目标或额外的架构组件。我们的评估结果显示，尽管Muse是在较小的数据规模和模型规模下训练的，但它仍然在音素错误率、文本与音乐风格的相似性以及音频美学质量方面取得了令人满意的性能。同时，它还能实现不同音乐结构下的可控片段级生成。所有数据、模型权重以及训练和评估流程都将公开提供，为可控长形式歌曲生成研究的持续发展铺平道路。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Distilling LLM Reasoning into Dense Encoders: Bridging the Accuracy-Efficiency Gap in Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 将大语言模型的推理能力融入密集编码器中：弥补推荐领域中的准确性与效率之间的差距
papers.authors: Donghee Han, Daeyoung Roh, A Young Kim, Hwanjun Song, Mun Yong Yi
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable potential in recommendation systems but suffer from prohibitive inference latency. Existing distillation approaches typically target Small Language Models (SLMs) or Conventional Recommendation Models (CRMs), face a critical trade-off between computational cost and semantic reasoning capacity. To bridge this accuracy-efficiency gap, we introduce Reasoning-to-Encoder Distillation (R2END), a framework that establishes a text encoder as the optimal student architecture for scalable recommendation. Unlike methods that mimic token generation, R2END compresses the teacher’s reasoning into a dense vector space via a semantic alignment objective, effectively capturing user-item dynamics. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that R2END not only outperforms state-of-the-art baselines but also achieves drastically reduced latency, offering a sweet spot for recommendation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在推荐系统中展现出巨大的潜力，但其在推理方面的延迟问题却令人难以接受。现有的蒸馏方法通常针对小型语言模型或传统推荐模型进行优化，但在计算成本与语义推理能力之间面临着关键的权衡。为了弥补这一准确性与效率之间的差距，我们提出了“推理到编码器蒸馏”框架。该框架将文本编码器作为可扩展推荐系统的最佳学习架构。与那些模仿令牌生成的方法不同，R2END通过语义对齐目标将老师的推理过程压缩成密集的向量空间，从而有效捕捉用户与物品的动态关系。在四个数据集上的广泛实验表明，R2END不仅优于现有的最佳基线算法，还显著降低了推理延迟，为推荐系统提供了理想的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Decoding the Multimodal Mind: Generalizable Brain-to-Text Translation via Multimodal Alignment and Adaptive Routing
papers.title_zh: 解码多模态思维：通过多模态对齐与自适应路由实现通用的脑到文本转换技术
papers.authors: Chunyu Ye, Yunhao Zhang, Jingyuan Sun, Chong Li, Yang Zhao, Shaonan Wang
papers.abstract: Decoding language from the human brain remains a grand challenge for Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs). Current approaches typically rely on unimodal brain representations, neglecting the brain’s inherently multimodal processing. Inspired by the brain’s associative mechanisms, where viewing an image can evoke related sounds and linguistic representations, we propose a unified framework that leverages Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to align brain signals with a shared semantic space encompassing text, images, and audio. A router module dynamically selects and fuses modality-specific brain features according to the characteristics of each stimulus. Experiments on various fMRI datasets with textual, visual, and auditory stimuli demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, achieving an 8.48% average improvement on the most commonly used benchmark. We further extend our framework to EEG and MEG data, demonstrating flexibility and robustness across varying temporal and spatial resolutions. To our knowledge, this is the first unified BCI architecture capable of robustly decoding multimodal brain activity across diverse brain signals and stimulus types, offering a flexible solution for real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 从人类大脑中解码语言仍然是脑机接口领域的一个重大挑战。目前的方法通常依赖于单一模态的大脑表征，而忽略了大脑本质上是多模态的处理方式。受大脑联想机制的启发，通过观看图像可以引发相关的声音和语言表征，我们提出了一种统一的框架，利用多模态大语言模型来将大脑信号与包含文本、图像和音频的共享语义空间进行对齐。一个路由模块会根据每个刺激的特点动态选择并融合不同模态的大脑特征。在多种fMRI数据集上进行实验表明，该框架表现非常出色，在最常用的基准测试上实现了8.48%的平均性能提升。我们还扩展了该框架到EEG和MEG数据上，证明了其在不同的时间和空间分辨率下的灵活性和鲁棒性。据我们所知，这是第一个能够稳健解码多种大脑活动和刺激类型的统一脑机接口架构，为现实世界的应用提供了灵活的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Which bird does not have wings: Negative-constrained KGQA with Schema-guided Semantic Matching and Self-directed Refinement
papers.title_zh: 哪种鸟没有翅膀：采用模式引导的语义匹配技术以及自我优化的负约束KGQA算法
papers.authors: Midan Shim, Seokju Hwang, KaeHyun Um, Kyong-Ho Lee
papers.abstract: Large language models still struggle with faithfulness and hallucinations despite their remarkable reasoning abilities. In Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA), semantic parsing-based approaches address the limitations by understanding constraints in a user’s question and converting them into a logical form to execute on a knowledge graph. However, existing KGQA benchmarks and methods are biased toward positive and calculation constraints. Negative constraints are neglected, although they frequently appear in real-world questions. In this paper, we introduce a new task, NEgative-conSTrained (NEST) KGQA, where each question contains at least one negative constraint, and a corresponding dataset, NestKGQA. We also design PyLF, a Python-formatted logical form, since existing logical forms are hardly suitable to express negation clearly while maintaining readability. Furthermore, NEST questions naturally contain multiple constraints. To mitigate their semantic complexity, we present a novel framework named CUCKOO, specialized to multiple-constrained questions and ensuring semantic executability. CUCKOO first generates a constraint-aware logical form draft and performs schema-guided semantic matching. It then selectively applies self-directed refinement only when executing improper logical forms yields an empty result, reducing cost while improving robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that CUCKOO consistently outperforms baselines on both conventional KGQA and NEST-KGQA benchmarks under few-shot settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型具备出色的推理能力，但在准确性和准确性方面仍然存在困难。在知识图谱问答中，基于语义解析的方法通过理解用户问题的约束条件并将其转化为逻辑形式来处理这些限制问题。然而，现有的知识图谱问答基准测试和方法主要侧重于正面约束和计算约束。负面约束往往被忽视，尽管它们在现实世界的问题中经常出现。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的任务——负约束知识图谱问答（NEST-KGQA），每个问题至少包含一个负面约束，并相应地设计了一个数据集NestKGQA。我们还设计了PyLF这种Python格式的逻辑形式，因为现有的逻辑形式很难在保持可读性的同时清晰地表达否定关系。此外，NEST问题通常包含多个约束条件。为了降低其语义复杂性，我们提出了一种名为CUCKOO的新框架，该框架专门用于处理多约束问题，并确保语义的可执行性。CUCKOO首先生成一种考虑约束的逻辑形式草稿，然后执行基于模式的语义匹配。只有在执行不正确的逻辑形式导致结果为空时，才会选择性地进行自我修正，从而降低成本并提高鲁棒性。实验结果表明，在少量样本的情况下，CUCKOO在传统的知识图谱问答和NEST-KGQA基准测试中始终优于基线方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Self-Evolving LLM Agent Framework for Role-Based Norm Compliance in Healthcare
papers.title_zh: 一种基于角色规范的医疗领域自演化大型语言模型代理框架
papers.authors: Haijie Ruan, Xiaowu Jiang, Zhanpeng LI, Wei Jia, Xuanwu Xu, Xiao-Fen Shan, Shujie Chen, Xindong Ye
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as conversational agents in healthcare, yet many existing systems treat roles as static prompts and rely on one-shot safety filters. In such designs, it can be difficult to enforce long-horizon responsibilities, stable role identity, and realistic communication behavior. We propose a Self-Evolving LLM Agent that learns from role-based social experience and explicitly models communicator-level individual traits informed by prior communication questionnaires and clinical literature. The agent integrates (i) perception and action conditioned on both hard role responsibility norms and soft trait-conditioned style preferences, (ii) structured memory storing norm-annotated trajectories and identity states, (iii) dual-layer reflection that combines short-term responsibility diagnosis with long-term identity drift detection via trait consistency and trait-norm compatibility checks, and (iv) self-evolution that updates system prompts and identity parameters through preference-style optimization with AI feedback. We instantiate the framework in a multi-role healthcare sandbox and evaluate outpatient medication review, emergency triage, and discharge planning. Across our simulated tasks, self-evolution is associated with lower severity-weighted norm risk, more stable role-identity signals, and improved social embeddedness metrics (including trust-like signals) relative to strong static baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在医疗领域的对话式智能体中被越来越多地应用，但许多现有系统仍将角色视为固定的提示信息，并依赖一次性安全过滤机制来处理问题。在这种设计中，很难实现长期的责任承担、稳定的角色身份以及真实的沟通行为。我们提出了一种自进化的语言模型智能体，该智能体能够从基于角色的社交经验中学习，并明确模拟沟通者层面的个体特征，这些特征是根据之前的沟通问卷和临床文献得出的。该智能体具备以下功能：①根据严格的责任规范以及基于特征的风格偏好来感知和行动；②拥有存储有规范注释的轨迹和身份状态的结构化记忆；③通过双层反思机制，结合短期责任诊断与长期身份漂移检测，同时利用特征一致性和特征与规范兼容性检查来实现自我进化；④通过偏好风格优化以及人工智能反馈，不断更新系统提示和身份参数。我们在多角色医疗场景中测试了这一框架，评估了门诊药物审查、紧急分诊和出院计划等方面的情况。在模拟任务中，自进化机制使得规范风险降低，角色身份信号更加稳定，且社交嵌入性指标（包括类似信任的信号）也优于强静态基线。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: M3TQA: Massively Multilingual Multitask Table Question Answering
papers.title_zh: M3TQA：多语言多任务表格问答系统
papers.authors: Daixin Shu, Jian Yang, Zhenhe Wu, Xianjie Wu, Xianfu Cheng, Guan Xiangyuan, Yanghai Wang, Pengfei Wu, Tingyang Yang, Hualei Zhu, Wei Zhang, Ge Zhang, Jiaheng Liu, Zhoujun Li
papers.abstract: Tabular data is a fundamental component of real-world information systems. However, existing multilingual table benchmarks suffer from geolinguistic imbalance - overrepresenting certain languages and lacking sufficient scale for rigorous cross-lingual analysis. To address these limitations, we introduce M3TQA, which is a comprehensive framework for massively multilingual multitask table question answering, including subsequent datasets M3TQA-BENCH and M3TQA-INSTRUCT, featuring tables expanded to 97 languages from Chinese and English sources. M3TQA-BENCH includes 6,606 professionally annotated question-answering pairs across four tasks designed to evaluate nuanced table reasoning capabilities. Additionally, we synthesized the training set M3TQA-INSTRUCT in 97 languages using Large Language Model (LLM). Experiments on state-of-the-art LLMs reveal critical insights into cross-lingual generalization, demonstrating that synthetically generated, unannotated training data can significantly boost performance, particularly for low-resource languages. M3TQA establishes a new standard for multilingual table understanding, providing both a challenging evaluation platform and a scalable methodology for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格数据是现实世界信息系统中不可或缺的组成部分。然而，现有的多语言表格基准测试存在地理语言不平衡的问题——某些语言的样本数量过多，而缺乏足够的规模来进行严格的跨语言分析。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了M3TQA框架，它是一个用于大规模多语言多任务表格问答的综合性框架，同时还包括了M3TQA-BENCH和M3TQA-INSTRUCT两个扩展数据集，这些数据集包含了来自中文和英文来源的97种语言的表格数据。M3TQA-BENCH包含6,606对专业标注的问答对，涵盖了四项任务，旨在评估表格推理能力。此外，我们还利用大语言模型在97种语言中合成了训练集M3TQA-INSTRUCT。对最先进的语言模型进行的实验揭示了关于跨语言泛化能力的重要见解，表明人工生成的未标注训练数据可以显著提高性能，尤其是在资源匮乏的语言中。M3TQA为多语言表格理解建立了新的标准，不仅提供了一个具有挑战性的评估平台，还提供了一种可扩展的方法论，适用于未来的研究。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ShredBench: Evaluating the Semantic Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs in Document Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: ShredBench：评估多模态大语言模型在文档重构方面的语义推理能力
papers.authors: Zichun Guo, Yuling Shi, Wenhao Zeng, Chao Hu, Haotian Lin, Terry Yue Zhuo, Jiawei Chen, Xiaodong Gu, Wenping Ma
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance in Visually Rich Document Understanding (VRDU) tasks, but their capabilities are mainly evaluated on pristine, well-structured document images. We consider document reconstruction from shredded fragments, a challenging VRDU setting that requires integrating visual pattern recognition with semantic reasoning under significant content discontinuities. To facilitate systematic evaluation of complex VRDU tasks, we introduce ShredBench, a benchmark supported by an automated generation pipeline that renders fragmented documents directly from Markdown. The proposed pipeline ensures evaluation validity by allowing the flexible integration of latest or unseen textual sources to prevent training data contamination. ShredBench assesses four scenarios (English, Chinese, Code, Table) with three fragmentation granularities (8, 12, 16 pieces). Empirical evaluations on state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a significant performance gap: The method is effective on intact documents; however, once the document is shredded, restoration becomes a significant challenge, with NED dropping sharply as fragmentation increases. Our findings highlight that current MLLMs lack the fine-grained cross-modal reasoning required to bridge visual discontinuities, identifying a critical gap in robust VRDU research.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在视觉丰富的文档理解任务中取得了显著的性能表现，但其能力主要基于结构清晰、质量良好的文档图像进行评估。我们考虑了从破碎碎片重建文档这一具有挑战性的文档理解场景，这种场景需要将在显著内容不连续性下的视觉模式识别与语义推理相结合。为了便于对复杂的文档理解任务进行系统评估，我们提出了ShredBench这一基准测试工具。该工具依托于自动生成流程，能够直接从Markdown格式的文本生成破碎后的文档。该流程通过灵活整合最新或未曾见过的文本来源，确保了评估的有效性，从而避免了训练数据污染的问题。ShredBench涵盖了四种场景（英语、中文、代码、表格），并考虑了三种破碎程度（8件、12件、16件）。对最先进的多模态语言模型的实证评估显示，它们在实际应用中存在明显的性能差距：这些模型在完整文档上的表现较为出色；然而，一旦文档被破碎，恢复过程就会变得非常困难，随着破碎程度的增加，NED指标会急剧下降。我们的研究发现表明，当前的多模态语言模型缺乏解决视觉不连续性问题的精细跨模态推理能力，这揭示了在强大的文档理解研究领域中存在的重大空白。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: TELL-TALE: Task Efficient LLMs with Task Aware Layer Elimination
papers.title_zh: 提示式生成：具有任务感知机制的高效大语言模型——通过消除与任务相关的层来简化操作
papers.authors: Omar Naim, Krish Sharma, Niyar R Barman, Nicholas Asher
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) typically come with a fixed architecture, despite growing evidence that not all layers contribute equally to every downstream task. We introduce TALE (Task-Aware Layer Elimination), an inference-time method that improves task performance by selectively removing layers that are irrelevant or detrimental for a given task. TALE optimizes task-specific performance, yielding a task-optimized architecture without retraining. Across 9 tasks and 5 model families, under both zero-shot and few-shot settings, TALE consistently matches or surpasses baseline performance while simultaneously reducing computational costs. TALE also synergizes with fine-tuning, leading to further performance improvements. Computing TALE for a new task requires modest resources, making it a practical and deployable solution for task-specialized LLM inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常具有固定的架构，尽管有越来越多的证据表明，并非所有层对每项下游任务都有同等的影响。我们提出了TALE（任务感知层消除）这一推理时方法，它通过选择性地移除对特定任务无关或有害的层来提高任务性能。TALE能够优化特定任务的性能，从而在不进行重新训练的情况下获得优化的架构。在9项任务和5种模型家族中，无论是在零样本还是少样本的情况下，TALE都能始终达到甚至超越基线性能，同时还能降低计算成本。此外，TALE与微调方法可以协同工作，进一步提升性能。为新的任务计算TALE所需的资源相对较少，因此它是一种实用且可部署的解决方案，适用于针对特定任务的LLM推理。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reason-KE++: Aligning the Process, Not Just the Outcome, for Faithful LLM Knowledge Editing
papers.title_zh: 原因——KE++：注重过程的协调，而不仅仅是结果的达成，以实现对大型语言模型知识的精准编辑
papers.authors: Yuchen Wu, Liang Ding, Li Shen, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) to be faithful to new knowledge in complex, multi-hop reasoning tasks is a critical, yet unsolved, challenge. We find that SFT-based methods, e.g., Reason-KE, while state-of-the-art, suffer from a “faithfulness gap”: they optimize for format mimicry rather than sound reasoning. This gap enables the LLM’s powerful parametric priors to override new contextual facts, resulting in critical factual hallucinations (e.g., incorrectly reasoning “Houston” from “NASA” despite an explicit edit). To solve this core LLM alignment problem, we propose Reason-KE++, an SFT+RL framework that instills process-level faithfulness. Its core is a Stage-aware Reward mechanism that provides dense supervision for intermediate reasoning steps (e.g., Decomposition, Sub-answer Correctness). Crucially, we identify that naive outcome-only RL is a deceptive trap for LLM alignment: it collapses reasoning integrity (e.g., 19.00% Hop acc) while superficially boosting final accuracy. Our process-aware framework sets a new SOTA of 95.48% on MQUAKE-CF-3k (+5.28%), demonstrating that for complex tasks, aligning the reasoning process is essential for building trustworthy LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 使大语言模型在复杂的多跳推理任务中忠实于新知识，是一个至关重要但尚未解决的挑战。我们发现，基于SFT的方法，例如Reason-KE，虽然处于最先进水平，但却存在“忠实度差距”：它们追求的是格式模仿而非合理的推理。这种差距使得语言模型的强大参数化先验能够覆盖新的上下文信息，从而导致关键事实上的错误推断（例如，从“NASA”错误地推断出“休斯顿”）。为了解决这一核心的语言模型对齐问题，我们提出了Reason-KE++，一个结合了SFT和RL的框架，它能够实现过程层面的忠实度。其核心是一个具有阶段意识的奖励机制，它为中间推理步骤提供了密集的监督（例如，分解、子答案正确性等）。重要的是，我们发现简单的仅关注结果的RL方法是一种欺骗性的陷阱：它破坏了推理的完整性（例如，19.00%的跳跃准确率），而表面上却提升了最终的准确性。我们的过程意识框架在MQUAKE-CF-3k任务上取得了95.48%的准确率（+5.28%），这表明对于复杂任务来说，对推理过程的对齐是构建可信语言模型的关键。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: RACC: Regret-Aware Confidence Calibration for Consistent Masked Discrete Diffusion Decoding
papers.title_zh: RACC：基于后悔意识的信心校准技术，旨在实现连续掩码离散扩散解码的可靠执行
papers.authors: Qinglin Zeng, Jusheng Zhang, Jing Yang, Ningyuan Liu, Keze Wang
papers.abstract: Masked Discrete Diffusion Models (MDMs) enable parallel generation via iterative refinement. However, we identify a critical decisional mismatch. The MDM architecture is inherently dynamic and capable of sensing context shifts. In contrast, prevailing decoding paradigms remain static and myopic. They treat each denoising step as an isolated snapshot, effectively discarding valuable temporal feedback that signals logical conflicts. To bridge this gap, we propose Regret-Aware Confidence Calibration (RACC). This training-free framework aligns decoding decisions with the model’s latent self-correction capabilities. RACC introduces a momentum anchor to track confidence trajectories. When a token’s probability drops abruptly below its historical trend, the system triggers a “regret” signal. Unlike expensive re-masking or lookahead search, RACC utilizes this signal to proactively demote unstable candidates. Extensive experiments on reasoning benchmarks, such as HumanEval and GSM8K, demonstrate that RACC significantly improves generation consistency. Crucially, RACC achieves these gains with zero additional inference overhead, effectively balancing decoding quality and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 掩蔽离散扩散模型（MDMs）通过迭代细化实现并行生成。然而，我们发现存在一个关键的决策不匹配问题。MDM架构本质上是动态的，能够感知上下文的变化。相比之下，当前的解码范式却保持静态且缺乏灵活性。它们将每一步去噪处理视为一个孤立的快照，从而忽略了那些能揭示逻辑冲突的重要时间信息。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了“遗憾意识置信度校准”方法。这种无需训练的框架能够将解码决策与模型的潜在自我修正能力相结合。RACC引入了一个动量锚点来追踪置信度轨迹。当某个标记的概率突然低于其历史趋势时，系统会触发“遗憾”信号。与昂贵的重新掩蔽或前瞻搜索相比，RACC利用这一信号来主动降低不稳定候选者的权重。在诸如HumanEval和GSM8K等推理基准测试上的广泛实验表明，RACC显著提升了生成的一致性。重要的是，RACC在没有任何额外推理开销的情况下实现了这些改进，有效地平衡了解码的质量和效率。

papers.title: The Impact of Off-Policy Training Data on Probe Generalisation
papers.title_zh: 离策略训练数据对探测泛化能力的影响
papers.authors: Adrians Skapars, Nathalie Maria Kirch, Samuel Dower, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Dmitrii Krasheninnikov
papers.abstract: Probing has emerged as a promising method for monitoring large language models (LLMs), enabling cheap inference-time detection of concerning behaviours. However, natural examples of many behaviours are rare, forcing researchers to rely on synthetic or off-policy LLM responses for training probes. We systematically evaluate how off-policy data influences probe generalisation across eight distinct LLM behaviours. Testing linear and attention probes across multiple LLMs, we find that training data generation strategy can significantly affect probe performance, though the magnitude varies greatly by behaviour. The largest generalisation failures arise for behaviours defined by response “intent” (e.g., strategic deception) rather than text-level content (e.g., usage of lists). We then propose a useful test for predicting generalisation failures in cases where on-policy test data is unavailable: successful generalisation to incentivised data (where the model was coerced) strongly correlates with high performance against on-policy examples. Based on these results, we predict that current deception probes may fail to generalise to real monitoring scenarios. We find that off-policy data can yield more reliable probes than on-policy data from a sufficiently different setting. This underscores the need for better monitoring methods that handle all types of distribution shift.
papers.abstract_zh: 探针技术已成为监测大语言模型的有效方法，它能够以低廉的成本检测相关行为。然而，许多行为的真实案例非常罕见，这迫使研究人员不得不依赖合成数据或离策略语言模型的响应来进行探针训练。我们系统地评估了离策略数据对八种不同语言模型行为探针泛化能力的影响。通过对多种语言模型进行线性和注意力探针测试，我们发现训练数据的生成策略会对探针性能产生显著影响，不过这种影响因行为类型的不同而有所差异。在那些由“意图”而非文本内容决定的行为中（例如战略欺骗），探针的泛化能力表现最为糟糕。因此，我们提出了一种有用的测试方法，用于预测在缺乏基于策略的测试数据时的泛化失败情况：成功泛化到激励性数据（即模型被强制使用的数据）与对基于策略的示例的高性能表现之间存在密切关联。基于这些结果，我们认为目前的欺骗探针可能无法适用于真实的监控场景。我们发现，来自足够不同环境的离策略数据能够提供更可靠的探针数据，这凸显了需要更有效的监控方法，以应对各种分布变化的情况。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GR1: Reinforcement-Enhanced LLM for Geoscience Reasoning
papers.title_zh: GR1：用于地球科学推理的强化型大语言模型
papers.authors: Yule Xie, Jiaxin Ding, Cheng Deng, Shiqing Gao, Junran Zhang, Sibo Zhang, Zeyuan Wang, Ke Wu, Xin Ding, Luoyi Fu, Meng Jin, Xinbing Wang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently shown remarkable ability to enhance reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet its potential in scientific domains beyond mathematics remains largely unexplored. Geoscience questions couple broad factual knowledge with multi-step inference and often rely on visual evidence such as maps, cross-sections, and diagrams, making them a challenging but verifiable testbed for RL-based reasoning. To enable this study, we introduce GeoMC-10K, a dataset of 10,000 geoscience multiple-choice questions spanning physical to human geography and high-school to professional levels; over 30% of the questions are image dependent. To support text-only RL on these multimodal questions, we design GeoM2T, a multi-agent framework that converts multimodal questions into descriptive text while preserving answerability and difficulty. Fine-tuning LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen-3-8B with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), incorporating a factual reward mechanism, yields GR1, which achieves absolute accuracy improvements of 5.9% and 13.3%, respectively, and it generalizes to out-of-distribution geoscience benchmarks. Together, GeoMC-10K, GeoM2T, and GR1 establish a scalable benchmark and baseline for RL-enhanced geoscience reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在提升大语言模型的推理能力方面表现出显著的效果，不过它在数学之外的科学领域中的潜力仍未被充分探索。地质科学问题往往需要将广泛的事实知识与多步骤的推理相结合，并且常常依赖于地图、剖面图等视觉证据，这使得地质科学问题成为强化学习推理的一个具有挑战性但可验证的测试平台。为了开展这项研究，我们开发了GeoMC-10K数据集，该数据集包含10,000道地质科学选择题，涵盖了从物理地理到人文地理的各个领域，以及从高中水平到专业水平的各种难度等级；其中超过30%的问题依赖于图像信息。为了支持仅基于文本的强化学习在处理这些多模态问题时的表现，我们设计了一个多智能体框架GeoM2T，该框架能够将多模态问题转换为描述性文本，同时保留问题的可回答性和难度级别。通过微调LaMA-3.1-8B和Qwen-3-8B模型，并采用群体相对策略优化算法，结合事实奖励机制，我们得到了GR1模型。该模型分别实现了5.9%和13.3%的绝对准确率提升，并且能够在非分布式的地质科学基准测试中取得良好的表现。总的来说，GeoMC-10K、GeoM2T和GR1共同构成了一个可扩展的基准测试平台，为强化学习的地质科学推理提供了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FOCUS: A Fine-Grained Customer-Oriented Sentiment Dialogue Summarization Dataset for Chinese Customer Service
papers.title_zh: 焦点：面向客户的细致情感对话摘要数据集，适用于中文客户服务场景
papers.authors: Qian Chen, Mengqiang Hu, Xin Guo
papers.abstract: Dialogue summarization (DS) plays a vital role in improving customer service efficiency by automatically generating concise summaries from lengthy multi-turn dialogues. However, existing studies largely overlook the fine-grained sentiment dynamics expressed by customers, and most DS datasets lack detailed sentiment annotations. These limitations hinder both accurate service quality assessment and the development of sentiment-aware summarization models. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage approach to building an aspect-aware sentiment dataset, comprising: (1) aspect-anchored dialogue rewriting, (2) dialogue-anchored explainable label generation, and (3) label-dialogue integrated summarization. Building upon this scheme, we construct FOCUS, a \textbf{F}ine-grained customer-\textbf{O}riented \textbf{C}hinese dialog\textbf{U}e \textbf{S}ummarization dataset. FOCUS is the first Chinese dataset with 12,948 dialogues annotated for multi-level aspects, sentiment polarity, opinion content, emotions, as well as customer-oriented formatted and free-style sentiment summaries. To demonstrate the challenges and utility of FOCUS, we benchmark a range of summarization models on FOCUS and observe that current methods often exhibit misalignment between aspects and sentiments. Meanwhile, we find that a Chain-of-Thought approach can enhance faithfulness and interpretability, highlighting promising directions for future research on this dataset. FOCUS serves as a valuable resource to advance research in sentiment-aware DS and related tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 对话摘要生成技术通过自动从冗长的多轮对话中生成简洁的摘要，在提升客户服务效率方面发挥着重要作用。然而，现有的研究大多忽略了客户所表达的细微情感动态，而且大多数对话摘要数据集缺乏详细的情感注释信息。这些局限性阻碍了准确的服务质量评估以及情感感知型摘要模型的开发。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种三阶段的方法来构建情感感知型对话摘要数据集，具体包括：(1)以特定方面为基准的对话重写；(2)以对话内容为基准的可解释性标签生成；(3)将标签与对话内容相结合进行摘要生成。基于这一方案，我们构建了FOCUS——一个针对中文对话的精细级客户导向情感摘要数据集。FOCUS是首个包含12,948条对话的中文数据集，这些对话都标注了多个层面的方面、情感极性、观点内容、情绪，以及以客户为导向的格式化和自由风格的情感摘要。为了展示FOCUS的价值和实用性，我们在FOCUS上对多种摘要模型进行了基准测试，发现当前的方法往往无法准确区分不同方面的情感特征。同时，我们发现思维链方法可以提高摘要的准确性和可解释性，这为未来关于该数据集的研究指明了方向。FOCUS作为宝贵资源，有助于推动情感感知型对话摘要及相关领域的研究进展。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: ABC-Bench: Benchmarking Agentic Backend Coding in Real-World Development
papers.title_zh: ABC-Bench：在实际开发中对比代理后端代码的性能
papers.authors: Jie Yang, Honglin Guo, Li Ji, Jiazheng Zhou, Rui Zheng, Zhikai Lei, Shuo Zhang, Zhiheng Xi, Shichun Liu, Yuxin Wang, Bo Wang, Yining Zheng, Tao Gui, Xipeng Qiu
papers.abstract: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) into autonomous agents has expanded the scope of AI coding from localized code generation to complex, repository-level, and execution-driven problem solving. However, current benchmarks predominantly evaluate code logic in static contexts, neglecting the dynamic, full-process requirements of real-world engineering, particularly in backend development which demands rigorous environment configuration and service deployment. To address this gap, we introduce ABC-Bench, a benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate agentic backend coding within a realistic, executable workflow. Using a scalable automated pipeline, we curated 224 practical tasks spanning 8 languages and 19 frameworks from open-source repositories. Distinct from previous evaluations, ABC-Bench require the agents to manage the entire development lifecycle from repository exploration to instantiating containerized services and pass the external end-to-end API tests. Our extensive evaluation reveals that even state-of-the-art models struggle to deliver reliable performance on these holistic tasks, highlighting a substantial disparity between current model capabilities and the demands of practical backend engineering.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）向自主智能体的演变，使得人工智能编码的适用范围从局部代码生成扩展到了复杂的、涉及多个框架的、需要执行驱动的问题解决场景。然而，目前的评估基准大多只针对静态环境中的代码逻辑进行评估，而忽略了现实世界工程中的动态、全流程需求，尤其是在后端开发中，需要严格的环境配置和服务部署。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了ABC-Bench这一评估基准，旨在真实的可执行工作流程中评估智能体在后端开发中的表现。通过可扩展的自动化流程，我们从开源仓库中选取了224个实际任务，这些任务涵盖了8种编程语言和19种开发框架。与之前的评估不同，ABC-Bench要求智能体能够管理整个开发周期，从仓库探索到容器化服务的实例化，并能够通过外部端到端的API测试。我们的广泛评估结果显示，即使是最先进的模型也难以在这些综合性任务上提供可靠的性能表现，这凸显了当前模型能力与实际后端工程需求之间的巨大差距。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LiveCANNBench: Benchmark SWE AI Coding for Ascend CANN
papers.title_zh: LiveCANNBench：针对Ascend CANN的软件工程与人工智能编码性能测试
papers.authors: Sijie Wang, Kai Zhao, Wee Peng Tay, Shuo Zhang, Chengwen Liu, Quanjiang Guo, Ren Junhao, Xin Li, Heng Lian, Jingdi Lei, Rui She, Huacan Wang, Ronghao Chen
papers.abstract: AI coding has emerged as a core application of large language models (LLMs), evolving from single-file coding tasks towards complex software engineering (SWE) scenarios. Recent advances in agents have enabled multi-file, multi-language, and dependency-aware AI coding, significantly expanding the scope of AI-assisted software development. While a variety of benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate coding capabilities in general-purpose or GPU coding ecosystems such as CUDA and ROCm, systematic evaluation for Huawei Ascend CANN remains largely underexplored. In this work, we propose LiveCANNBench, an SWE-level benchmark designed for AI coding in the CANN software stack. LiveCANNBench is constructed from real-world CANN repositories and consists of over 400 task instances spanning multi-file, multi-language, and execution-aware coding challenges. Unlike existing static benchmarks that primarily focus on kernel-level code generation, LiveCANNBench adopts a live benchmarking paradigm, effectively mitigating data leakage and enabling more reliable evaluation of modern coding agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能编码已成为大语言模型的核心应用之一，其发展从单文件编码任务逐渐扩展到复杂的软件工程场景。近期在智能体技术方面的进展使得多文件、多语言以及具有依赖关系的智能体编码成为可能，这大大扩展了人工智能辅助软件开发的适用范围。虽然已经提出了多种基准测试来评估通用或基于GPU的编码生态系统中的编码能力，但对于华为Ascend CANN系统的系统级评估却仍然鲜有研究。在这项工作中，我们提出了LiveCANNBench这一针对CANN软件栈中人工智能编码设计的软件工程级基准测试。LiveCANNBench基于真实的CANN代码库构建，包含超过400个任务实例，涵盖了多文件、多语言以及考虑执行效率的编码挑战。与那些主要专注于内核级代码生成的现有静态基准测试不同，LiveCANNBench采用了实时基准测试的方式，有效避免了数据泄露问题，从而能够更可靠地评估现代智能体的编码性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When Models Decide and When They Bind: A Two-Stage Computation for Multiple-Choice Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 在模型做出决策时与在它们达成一致时：一种用于多选择问题回答的二阶段计算方法
papers.authors: Hugh Mee Wong, Rick Nouwen, Albert Gatt
papers.abstract: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) is easy to evaluate but adds a meta-task: models must both solve the problem and output the symbol that represents the answer, conflating reasoning errors with symbol-binding failures. We study how language models implement MCQA internally using representational analyses (PCA, linear probes) as well as causal interventions. We find that option-boundary (newline) residual states often contain strong linearly decodable signals related to per-option correctness. Winner-identity probing reveals a two-stage progression: the winning content position becomes decodable immediately after the final option is processed, while the output symbol is represented closer to the answer emission position. Tests under symbol and content permutations support a two-stage mechanism in which models first select a winner in content space and then bind or route that winner to the appropriate symbol to emit.
papers.abstract_zh: 选择题回答（MCQA）的评估相对容易，但其中包含一个额外的任务：模型不仅要解决问题，还要输出代表答案的符号，这就使得推理错误与符号绑定失败的问题混在了一起。我们研究了语言模型如何通过使用表示性分析（如PCA、线性探针）以及因果干预来内部实现MCQA。我们发现，选项边界（如换行符）的残留状态通常包含与每个选项的正确性相关的、易于线性解码的信号。获胜者身份探测揭示了两个阶段的进程：在最终选项被处理之后，获胜内容的位置可以立即被解码，而输出符号则更接近于答案的发出位置。在符号和内容排列不同的测试下，我们发现模型首先会在内容空间中选择一个获胜者，然后将该获胜者绑定或路由到相应的符号以发出答案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Who Watches the Watchmen? Humans Disagree With Translation Metrics on Unseen Domains
papers.title_zh: 谁在注视那些守望者？人类并不认同那些用于不可见领域的翻译指标
papers.authors: Finn Schmidt, Jan Philip Wahle, Terry Ruas, Bela Gipp
papers.abstract: Automatic evaluation metrics are central to the development of machine translation systems, yet their robustness under domain shift remains unclear. Most metrics are developed on the Workshop on Machine Translation (WMT) benchmarks, raising concerns about their robustness to unseen domains. Prior studies that analyze unseen domains vary translation systems, annotators, or evaluation conditions, confounding domain effects with human annotation noise.To address these biases, we introduce a systematic multi-annotator Cross-Domain Error-Span-Annotation dataset (CD-ESA), comprising 18.8k human error span annotations across three language pairs, where we fix annotators within each language pair and evaluate translations of the same six translation systems across one seen news domain and two unseen technical domains. Using this dataset, we first find that automatic metrics appear surprisingly robust to domain-shifts at the segment level (up to 0.69 agreement), but this robustness largely disappears once we account for human label variation. Averaging annotations increases inter-annotator agreement by up to +0.11. Metrics struggle on the unseen chemical domain compared to humans (inter-annotator agreement of 0.78–0.83 vs. 0.96).We recommend comparing metric–human agreement against inter-annotator agreement, rather than comparing raw metric–human agreement alone, when evaluating across different domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动评估指标在机器翻译系统的开发中起着至关重要的作用，然而它们在跨领域变化下的鲁棒性仍然不明确。大多数评估指标都是基于机器翻译研讨会（WMT）的基准数据进行开发的，这引发了人们对这些指标对未知领域的鲁棒性的担忧。之前的研究在分析未知领域时，往往会改变翻译系统、注释者或评估条件，从而将领域效应与人工注释的噪声混在一起。为了克服这些偏见，我们引入了一个系统化的多注释者跨领域错误范围注释数据集（CD-ESA），该数据集包含18.8千条针对三种语言对的错误范围注释。在这个数据集中，我们固定了每对语言中的注释者，并评估了同一六款翻译系统在一种已知新闻领域和两种未知技术领域的翻译结果。通过这个数据集，我们发现自动评估指标在片段级别上对领域变化的鲁棒性出人意料地强（一致性高达0.69），但一旦考虑到人工标签的差异，这种鲁棒性就大大降低了。平均化注释后，注释者之间的一致性提高了0.11以上。与人工标注相比，自动评估指标在未知的化学领域表现较差（注释者之间的一致性为0.78–0.83，而人工标注为0.96）。我们建议在评估不同领域时，应该比较评估指标与人类标注的一致性，而不是仅仅比较原始评估指标与人类标注的一致性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Stress-Testing Emotional Support Models: Moving from Homogeneous to Diverse Help Seekers
papers.title_zh: 对情感支持模型的压力测试：从处理单一类型的求助者转变为处理多样化类型的求助者
papers.authors: Chaewon Heo, Cheyon Jin, Yohan Jo
papers.abstract: As emotional support chatbots have recently gained significant traction across both research and industry, a common evaluation strategy has emerged: use help-seeker simulators to interact with supporter chatbots. However, current simulators suffer from two critical limitations: (1) they fail to capture the behavioral diversity of real-world seekers, often portraying them as overly cooperative, and (2) they lack the controllability required to simulate specific seeker profiles. To address these challenges, we present a controllable seeker simulator driven by nine psychological and linguistic features that underpin seeker behavior. Using authentic Reddit conversations, we train our model via a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which effectively differentiates diverse seeker behaviors into specialized parameter subspaces, thereby enhancing fine-grained controllability. Our simulator achieves superior profile adherence and behavioral diversity compared to existing approaches. Furthermore, evaluating 7 prominent supporter models with our system uncovers previously obscured performance degradations. These findings underscore the utility of our framework in providing a more faithful and stress-tested evaluation for emotional support chatbots.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着情感支持聊天机器人在研究和行业领域中的重要性日益凸显，一种常见的评估策略应运而生：使用求助者模拟器与情感支持聊天机器人进行交互。然而，目前的模拟器存在两个关键缺陷：(1)它们无法捕捉到真实世界中求助者的行为多样性，往往将求助者描绘成过于合作的人；(2)它们缺乏模拟特定求助者特征所需的可控性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种由九个心理学和语言学特征驱动的可控求助者模拟器。通过利用真实的Reddit对话数据，我们使用混合专家架构对模型进行训练，从而将不同的求助者行为分解为专门的参数空间，进而提高控制的精细度。与现有方法相比，我们的模拟器在遵循求助者特征和展现行为多样性方面表现更为出色。此外，我们对7种主流情感支持聊天机器人模型进行了评估，发现之前被忽视的性能下降问题。这些发现凸显了我们的框架在为情感支持聊天机器人提供更可靠、经过充分验证的评估方面的实用性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Progressive Planning and Reinforced Reasoning: Large Language Model-Guided Multi-hop Question Answering over Knowledge Graph
papers.title_zh: 渐进式规划与强化推理：在知识图谱上实现由大型语言模型引导的多跳问答系统
papers.authors: Xiang Li, Runhai Jiao, Ruifan Li, Dongnan Wu, Ruojiao Qiao, Lei Liu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning, with its interpretable path reasoning, has emerged as a promising paradigm for multi-hop question answering over knowledge graphs. However, existing approaches suffer from two inherent limitations: (1) lacking effective intermediate guidance, agents often fall into aimless exploration when confronted with complex multi-hop questions; and (2) policy networks focus on local neighborhood information, making it difficult to anticipate the long-term consequences of decisions. To address these challenges, we propose a Progressive Planning and Reinforced Reasoning (PPRR) framework. Specifically, we introduce large language models as multi-hop reasoning planners, converting decomposed sub-question sequences into stepwise decision guidance and thereby granting the agent human-like, step-by-step problem-solving capabilities. In addition, we design a structure-aware lookahead policy network, which explicitly models inter-node dependencies along the multi-hop reasoning process and performs lookahead value evaluations for candidate actions, thereby enhancing the agent’s global state awareness and decision foresight in complex environments. Finally, we conducted extensive experiments on four public multi-hop question answering benchmarks and one domain-specific dataset. The results demonstrate that our framework surpasses state-of-the-art methods while demonstrating strong generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习以其可解释的路径推理能力，已成为基于知识图谱的多跳问题回答领域的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有的方法存在两个固有的局限性：(1)缺乏有效的中间指导，当面对复杂的多跳问题时，智能体往往会陷入无目的的探索；(2)策略网络主要关注局部邻域信息，这使得难以预测决策的长期后果。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种渐进式规划与强化推理框架。具体来说，我们引入大语言模型作为多跳推理规划器，将分解后的子问题序列转化为逐步的决策指导，从而赋予智能体类似人类的逐步解决问题能力。此外，我们还设计了一个结构感知的前瞻性策略网络，该网络能够明确模拟多跳推理过程中的节点间依赖关系，并对候选行动进行前瞻性价值评估，从而增强智能体在复杂环境中的全局状态感知和决策预见能力。最后，我们在四个公共的多跳问题回答基准测试和一个特定领域的数据集上进行了广泛的实验。结果表明，我们的框架不仅超越了现有最先进的方法，还展现了强大的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AED-RAG: Continuous Multi-Granular Context Fusion for Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Adaptive Ensemble Decoding
papers.title_zh: AED-RAG：基于连续多粒度上下文融合的检索增强生成技术，通过自适应集成解码实现高效信息处理
papers.authors: Junzhe Zhou, Fulin Lin, Tairan Cheng, Shaowen Chen, Hongwei Wang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) yet suffers from a mismatch between coarse retrieval granularity and fine-grained generation needs. Specifically, coarse-grained passages inherently conflate valid context with intra-passage noise that semantic retrieval often fails to filter. Existing alignment strategies, typically relying on discrete reranking, struggle to address this granularity mismatch or effectively balance external evidence with internal knowledge. To bridge this gap, we propose AED-RAG, a framework that synergizes discrete retrieval with continuous Adaptive Ensemble Decoding. Specifically, we fine-tune a utility predictor using contrastive perplexity to discern the information density differences between unstructured narrative passages and structured knowledge triplets. During inference, this predictor projects passages, triplets, and the model’s parametric memory into a unified probability space, enabling a soft, token-level fusion that dynamically optimizes information gain. Extensive experiments on four open-domain QA benchmarks demonstrate that AED-RAG significantly outperforms competitive baselines, underscoring the effectiveness of integrating multi-granular contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术能够提升大语言模型的能力，但存在粗粒度检索与细粒度生成需求之间的不匹配问题。具体来说，粗粒度的检索结果往往会将有效上下文与段落内部的噪声混在一起，导致语义检索难以过滤这些噪声。现有的对齐策略通常依赖于离散的重新排序机制，但这些策略在解决这种粒度不匹配问题时存在困难，也无法有效平衡外部证据与内部知识之间的关系。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了AED-RAG框架——该框架将离散的检索与连续的自适应集成解码技术相结合。具体来说，我们通过使用对比困惑度来微调一个工具预测器，以区分非结构化叙事段落与结构化知识三元组之间的信息密度差异。在推理过程中，该预测器将段落、知识三元组以及模型的参数化记忆映射到一个统一的概率空间，从而实现软性、基于令牌级的融合，从而动态优化信息获取效果。在四个开放领域问答基准测试中的广泛实验表明，AED-RAG显著优于其他竞争基线算法，这充分证明了整合多粒度上下文的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Neural Chain-of-Thought Search: Searching the Optimal Reasoning Path to Enhance Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 神经思维链搜索：寻找最优推理路径以提升大型语言模型的能力
papers.authors: Guoming Ling, Zhongzhan Huang, Yupei Lin, Junxin Li, Shanshan Zhong, Hefeng Wu, Liang Lin
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought reasoning has significantly enhanced the problem-solving capabilities of Large Language Models. Unfortunately, current models generate reasoning steps sequentially without foresight, often becoming trapped in suboptimal reasoning paths with redundant steps. In contrast, we introduce Neural Chain-of-Thought Search (NCoTS), a framework that reformulates reasoning as a dynamic search for the optimal thinking strategy. By quantitatively characterizing the solution space, we reveal the existence of sparse superior reasoning paths that are simultaneously more accurate and concise than standard outputs. Our method actively navigates towards these paths by evaluating candidate reasoning operators using a dual-factor heuristic that optimizes for both correctness and computational cost. Consequently, NCoTS achieves a Pareto improvement across diverse reasoning benchmarks, boosting accuracy by over 3.5% while reducing generation length by over 22%. We will make our code and data publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链推理显著提升了大语言模型的解决问题的能力。然而，当前模型在生成推理步骤时缺乏预见性，常常陷入效率较低的推理路径，且存在冗余的步骤。相比之下，我们提出了神经思维链搜索框架（NCoTS），该框架将推理过程重新定义为对最优思考策略的动态搜索。通过定量描述解决方案空间，我们发现存在一些更为高效且简洁的推理路径，这些路径比标准输出更加精确和简洁。我们的方法通过采用双因素启发式算法来评估候选推理操作，从而主动引导模型沿着这些路径进行推理。结果表明，NCoTS在不同推理基准测试中取得了显著的改进效果：准确率提高了3.5%以上，而生成长度则减少了22%以上。我们将公开提供我们的代码和数据。

papers.title: GOAT: A Training Framework for Goal-Oriented Agent with Tools
papers.title_zh: GOAT：面向工具使用的目标导向智能体训练框架
papers.authors: Hyunji Min, Sangwon Jung, Junyoung Sung, Dosung Lee, Leekyeung Han, Paul Hongsuck Seo
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have evolved from pure text generators into interactive agents capable of invoking external tools. However, LLM agents still struggle with goal-oriented queries, which require decomposing high-level objectives into sequences of interdependent API calls with accurate planning and execution. Current approaches rely on zero-shot evaluation due to the absence of training data; while proprietary models such as GPT-4 exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, smaller open-source models remain ineffective at complex tool use. To address this limitation, we propose a novel training framework GOAT, that enables fine-tuning LLM agents without human annotation. GOAT automatically synthesizes goal-oriented API execution data from API documents using a novel call-first generation paradigm, that constructs training data based on executed API call sequences. Through extensive experiments, we show that GOAT-trained agents achieve state-of-the-art performance across multiple existing goal-oriented benchmarks. In addition, we introduce GOATBench, a new goal-oriented API execution benchmark, and demonstrate that agents trained with GOAT also excel in this setting. These results highlight GOAT as a practical path toward building robust open-source LLM agents capable of complex reasoning and tool use.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已经从单纯的文本生成器发展成了能够调用外部工具的互动智能体。然而，这些智能体在处理以目标为导向的查询时仍然存在困难，因为需要将高层次的目标分解为一系列相互依赖的API调用，并具备准确的规划和执行能力。目前的方法依赖于零样本评估，因为缺乏训练数据；而像GPT-4这样的专有模型则表现出强大的推理能力，但较小的开源模型在复杂工具使用方面仍然表现不佳。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种新颖的训练框架GOAT，该框架无需人工注释即可对LLM智能体进行微调。GOAT能够利用一种新颖的“先调用再生成”范式，从API文档中自动生成以目标为导向的API调用数据，从而构建训练数据。通过广泛的实验验证，我们发现使用GOAT训练的智能体在多个现有的以目标为导向的基准测试中取得了顶尖的性能。此外，我们还引入了新的以目标为导向的API调用测试基准GOATBench，并证明使用GOAT训练的智能体在这一场景中同样表现出色。这些结果表明，GOAT为构建能够进行复杂推理和工具使用的强大开源LLM智能体提供了切实可行的途径。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLMs as ASP Programmers: Self-Correction Enables Task-Agnostic Nonmonotonic Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 作为ASP编程员的LLM：自我修正能力使得它们能够执行与任务无关的非单调推理
papers.authors: Adam Ishay, Joohyung Lee
papers.abstract: Recent large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive reasoning milestones but continue to struggle with high computational costs, logical inconsistencies, and sharp performance degradation on high-complexity problems. While neuro-symbolic methods attempt to mitigate these issues by coupling LLMs with symbolic reasoners, existing approaches typically rely on monotonic logics (e.g., SMT) that cannot represent defeasible reasoning—essential components of human cognition. We present “LLM+ASP,” a framework that translates natural language into Answer Set Programming (ASP), a nonmonotonic formalism based on stable model semantics. Unlike prior LLM+ASP approaches that require manually authored knowledge modules, domain-specific prompts, or evaluation restricted to single problem classes, our framework operates without any per-task engineering and applies uniformly across diverse reasoning tasks. Our system utilizes an automated self-correction loop where structured feedback from the ASP solver enables iterative refinement. Evaluating across six diverse benchmarks, we demonstrate that: (1) stable model semantics allow LLMs to naturally express default rules and exceptions, outperforming SMT-based alternatives by significant margins on nonmonotonic tasks; (2) iterative self-correction is the primary driver of performance, effectively replacing the need for handcrafted domain knowledge; (3) compact in-context reference guides substantially outperform verbose documentation, revealing a “context rot" phenomenon where excessive context hinders constraint adherence.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的大语言模型已经取得了令人瞩目的推理成就，但仍然存在计算成本高、逻辑不一致以及在高复杂度问题上性能下降等问题。虽然神经符号方法试图通过将语言模型与符号推理器结合来缓解这些问题，但现有的方法通常依赖于单调逻辑（例如SMT），而单调逻辑无法表示可反驳的推理——这是人类认知的重要组成部分。我们提出了“LLM+ASP”框架，该框架能够将自然语言转换为答案集编程，这是一种基于稳定模型语义的非单调形式化方法。与之前需要手动编写知识模块、特定领域提示或仅适用于单一问题的LLM+ASP方法不同，我们的框架无需针对特定任务进行工程化处理，能够均匀地应用于各种推理任务。我们的系统采用了自动自我修正机制，通过答案集编程求解器的结构化反馈来实现迭代优化。在六个不同的基准测试中，我们发现：(1) 稳定的模型语义使得语言模型能够自然地表达默认规则和例外情况，在非单调任务上显著优于基于SMT的替代方案；(2) 迭代自我修正是性能提升的主要驱动力，有效地取代了手工构建领域知识的需求；(3) 简洁的上下文参考指南比冗长的文档表现更好，这表明过度依赖上下文会妨碍约束的遵守。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DRIV-EX: Counterfactual Explanations for Driving LLMs
papers.title_zh: DRIV-EX：用于驱动大型语言模型的逆事实解释方法
papers.authors: Amaia Cardiel, Eloi Zablocki, Elias Ramzi, Eric Gaussier
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as reasoning engines in autonomous driving, yet their decision-making remains opaque. We propose to study their decision process through counterfactual explanations, which identify the minimal semantic changes to a scene description required to alter a driving plan.We introduce DRIV-EX, a method that leverages gradient-based optimization on continuous embeddings to identify the input shifts required to flip the model’s decision. Crucially, to avoid the incoherent text typical of unconstrained continuous optimization, DRIV-EX uses these optimized embeddings solely as a semantic guide: they are used to bias a controlled decoding process that re-generates the original scene description. This approach effectively steers the generation toward the counterfactual target while guaranteeing the linguistic fluency, domain validity, and proximity to the original input essential for interpretability.Evaluated using the LC-LLM planner on the textual highD dataset, DRIV-EX generates valid, fluent counterfactuals more reliably than existing baselines. It successfully exposes latent biases and provides concrete insights to improve the robustness of LLM-based driving agents. The code is available at “https://github.com/Amaia-CARDIEL/DRIV_EX”.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自动驾驶领域被越来越多地用作推理引擎，但它们的决策过程仍然不够透明。我们提出通过反事实解释来研究它们的决策过程，这种解释能够确定改变驾驶计划所需的场景描述中的最小语义变化。我们提出了DRIV-EX方法，该方法利用基于梯度的优化算法对连续嵌入进行优化，以确定改变模型决策所需的输入变化。关键在于，为了避免无约束连续优化所产生的不连贯文本，DRIV-EX仅将这些优化后的嵌入作为语义引导工具使用：它们被用来引导一个受控的解码过程，从而重新生成原始的场景描述。这种方法能够有效地将生成结果导向反事实目标，同时保证语言的流畅性、领域的有效性以及与原始输入的接近性，这些都是可解释性的关键要素。通过在textual highD数据集上使用LC-LLM规划器进行评估，DRIV-EX生成的反事实描述比现有基线方法更可靠、更通顺。它成功地揭示了潜在的偏见，并为提高基于LLM的驾驶代理的鲁棒性提供了具体的改进建议。代码可以在“https://github.com/Amaia-CARDIEL/DRIV_EX”下载。

papers.title: ROMA: Real-time Omni-Multimodal Assistant with Interactive Streaming Understanding
papers.title_zh: 罗马：实时多模态助手，具备交互式流媒体理解能力
papers.authors: Tian Xueyun, Wei Li, Bingbing Xu, Heng Dong, Yuanzhuo Wang, Huawei Shen
papers.abstract: Recent Omni-multimodal Large Language Models show promise in unified audio, vision, and text modeling. However, streaming audio-video understanding remains challenging, as existing approaches suffer from disjointed capabilities: they typically exhibit incomplete modality support or lack autonomous proactive monitoring. To address this, we present ROMA, a real-time omni-multimodal assistant for unified reactive and proactive interaction. ROMA processes continuous inputs as synchronized multimodal units, aligning dense audio with discrete video frames to handle granularity mismatches. For online decision-making, we introduce a lightweight speak head that decouples response initiation from generation to ensure precise triggering without task conflict. We train ROMA with a curated streaming dataset and a two-stage curriculum that progressively optimizes for streaming format adaptation and proactive responsiveness. To standardize the fragmented evaluation landscape, we reorganize diverse benchmarks into a unified suite covering both proactive (alert, narration) and reactive (QA) settings. Extensive experiments across 12 benchmarks demonstrate ROMA achieves state-of-the-art performance on proactive tasks while competitive in reactive settings, validating its robustness in unified real-time omni-multimodal understanding. Code and benchmark are available here.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的全模态大语言模型在统一音频、视觉和文本建模方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，流媒体音频视频的理解仍然具有挑战性，因为现有的方法存在能力不连贯的问题：它们通常缺乏完整的模态支持，或者缺乏自主的主动监控功能。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ROMA——一种实时全模态助手，能够实现统一的主动和被动交互。ROMA将连续输入作为同步的多模态单元进行处理，使密集的音频数据与离散的视频帧进行对齐，从而处理粒度上的不匹配问题。在在线决策方面，我们引入了一个轻量级的语音头模块，该模块将响应启动与生成过程分离，从而确保精确的触发操作，同时避免任务冲突。我们通过精心挑选的流媒体数据集以及两阶段训练流程来训练ROMA，逐步优化其适应流媒体格式的能力以及主动响应能力。为了标准化分散的评估体系，我们将多种基准测试整合为一个统一的套件，涵盖主动任务（如警报、叙述）和被动任务（问答）两种场景。在12个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，ROMA在主动任务上取得了顶尖性能，同时在被动任务中也表现出竞争力，这验证了其在统一实时全模态理解方面的鲁棒性。代码和基准测试数据可在此处获取。
