papers.title: Towards Provably Secure Generative AI: Reliable Consensus Sampling
papers.title_zh: 迈向可证明安全的生成式人工智能：可靠的共识采样技术
papers.authors: Yu Cui, Hang Fu, Sicheng Pan, Zhuoyu Sun, Yifei Liu, Yuhong Nie, Bo Ran, Baohan Huang, Xufeng Zhang, Haibin Zhang, Cong Zuo, Licheng Wang
papers.abstract: Existing research on generative AI security is primarily driven by mutually reinforcing attack and defense methodologies grounded in empirical experience. This dynamic frequently gives rise to previously unknown attacks that can circumvent current detection and prevention. This necessitates the continual updating of security mechanisms. Constructing generative AI with provable security and theoretically controllable risk is therefore necessary. Consensus Sampling (CS) is a promising algorithm toward provably secure AI. It controls risk by leveraging overlap in model output probabilities. However, we find that CS relies on frequent abstention to avoid unsafe outputs, which reduces utility. Moreover, CS becomes highly vulnerable when unsafe models are maliciously manipulated. To address these issues, we propose a new primitive called Reliable Consensus Sampling (RCS), that traces acceptance probability to tolerate extreme adversarial behaviors, improving robustness. RCS also eliminates the need for abstention entirely. We further develop a feedback algorithm to continuously and dynamically enhance the safety of RCS. We provide theoretical guarantees that RCS maintains a controllable risk threshold. Extensive experiments show that RCS significantly improves robustness and utility while maintaining latency comparable to CS. We hope this work contributes to the development of provably secure generative AI. Our code is available at https://github.com/cuiyu-ai/RCS.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前关于生成式人工智能安全性的研究，主要基于经验积累而发展出的相互补充的攻击与防御方法。这种动态机制常常会产生一些此前未知的攻击方式，这些攻击能够绕过现有的检测和预防手段。因此，必须不断更新安全机制。因此，构建具有可证明安全性和理论上可控风险的生成式人工智能是必要的。共识采样是一种有望实现可证明安全性的算法。它通过利用模型输出概率的重叠来控制风险。然而，我们发现，共识采样需要频繁地放弃某些操作以避免出现不安全的输出，这会降低其效用。此外，当不安全的模型被恶意操控时，共识采样会变得非常脆弱。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为可靠共识采样的新算法。该算法通过允许接受某些极端对抗行为来提高鲁棒性，同时完全消除了对放弃操作的依赖。我们还开发了一种反馈算法，以持续动态地提升共识采样的安全性。我们提供了理论保证，表明可靠共识采样能够维持一个可控的风险阈值。大量实验表明，可靠共识采样在保持与共识采样相当的延迟的同时，显著提升了鲁棒性和效用。我们希望这项工作能够为可证明安全性的生成式人工智能的发展做出贡献。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/cuiyu-ai/RCS获取。

papers.title: Pause or Fabricate? Training Language Models for Grounded Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 暂停还是继续？训练用于基于知识的推理的语言模型
papers.authors: Yiwen Qiu, Linjuan Wu, Yizhou Liu, Yuchen Yan, Jin Ma, Xu Tan, Yao Hu, Daoxin Zhang, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yongliang Shen
papers.abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable progress on complex reasoning tasks. However, they often implicitly fabricate information when inputs are incomplete, producing confident but unreliable conclusions—a failure mode we term ungrounded reasoning. We argue that this issue arises not from insufficient reasoning capability, but from the lack of inferential boundary awareness—the ability to recognize when the necessary premises for valid inference are missing. To address this issue, we propose Grounded Reasoning via Interactive Reinforcement Learning (GRIL), a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework for grounded reasoning under incomplete information. GRIL decomposes the reasoning process into two stages: clarify and pause, which identifies whether the available information is sufficient, and grounded reasoning, which performs task solving once the necessary premises are established. We design stage-specific rewards to penalize hallucinations, enabling models to detect gaps, stop proactively, and resume reasoning after clarification. Experiments on GSM8K-Insufficient and MetaMATH-Insufficient show that GRIL significantly improves premise detection (up to 45%), leading to a 30% increase in task success while reducing average response length by over 20%. Additional analyses confirm robustness to noisy user responses and generalization to out-of-distribution tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂推理任务上取得了显著进展。然而，当输入信息不完整时，这些模型往往会隐含地生成虚假信息，从而得出看似可信但不可靠的结论——这种缺陷被称为“无依据推理”。我们认为，这个问题的根源并非推理能力的不足，而是缺乏推理边界意识——即无法识别有效推理所需的前提条件是否存在。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了基于交互式强化学习的“有依据推理”方法（GRIL）。该框架采用多轮强化学习方式，用于在信息不完整的情况下进行有依据推理。GRIL将推理过程分为两个阶段：第一阶段是“澄清与暂停”，用于判断现有信息是否足够；第二阶段是“有依据推理”，在确认了必要前提后执行任务解决。我们设计了针对每个阶段的奖励机制，以惩罚幻觉行为，使模型能够发现信息缺失之处、主动停止推理，并在澄清后继续推理。在GSM8K-Insufficient和MetaMATH-Insufficient数据集上的实验表明，GRIL在前提检测方面取得了显著提升（最高达45%），使得任务成功率提高了30%，同时平均响应时长减少了20%以上。进一步的分析还证实了该方法对噪声用户反馈的鲁棒性，以及其在非分布范围内任务的泛化能力。

papers.title: AgentV-RL: Scaling Reward Modeling with Agentic Verifier
papers.title_zh: AgentV-RL：利用Agentic Verifier进行奖励量化的建模
papers.authors: Jiazheng Zhang, Ziche Fu, Zhiheng Xi, Wenqing Jing, Mingxu Chai, Wei He, Guoqiang Zhang, Chenghao Fan, Chenxin An, Wenxiang Chen, Zhicheng Liu, Haojie Pan, Dingwei Zhu, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Verifiers have been demonstrated to enhance LLM reasoning via test-time scaling (TTS). Yet, they face significant challenges in complex domains. Error propagation from incorrect intermediate reasoning can lead to false positives for seemingly plausible solutions, while lacking external grounding makes verifiers unreliable on computation or knowledge-intensive tasks. To address these challenges, we propose Agentic Verifier, a framework that transforms reward modeling into a multi-turn, tool-augmented deliberative process. We introduce complementary forward and backward agents: one traces solutions from premises to conclusions, while the other re-checks conclusions against their underlying premises. This bidirectional process enables a comprehensive, reliable, and interpretable assessment of solutions. To facilitate practical deployment, we propose AgentV-RL. Through proactive exploration and reinforcement learning, the verifier autonomously interleaves tool-use with internal reasoning. Extensive experiments show that Agentic Verifier yields consistent performance gains under both parallel and sequential TTS. Notably, our 4B variant surpasses state-of-the-art ORMs by 25.2%, positioning it as a promising paradigm for agentic reward modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究表明，验证器能够通过测试时扩展技术来增强大语言模型的推理能力。然而，在复杂领域里，验证器面临着重大挑战。不正确的中间推理可能导致错误的结果，从而让看似合理的解决方案被误判为正确；同时，由于缺乏外部依据，验证器在需要大量计算或知识的任务中表现不可靠。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了“代理式验证器”这一框架，它将奖励建模转化为一个多轮次的、以工具辅助的推理过程。我们引入了两种互补的代理：一种负责从前提推导出结论，另一种则负责重新检查结论是否与前提相符。这种双向过程使得对解决方案的评估更加全面、可靠且易于理解。为了便于实际部署，我们还提出了“AgentV-RL”方案。通过主动探索和强化学习，验证器能够自主地将工具使用与内部推理相结合。大量实验表明，代理式验证器在并行和顺序测试时都能带来稳定的性能提升。值得注意的是，我们的4B版本的性能比现有的最先进ORMs高出25.2%，这使其成为代理式奖励建模的一个有前景的解决方案。

papers.title: DiTReducio: A Training-Free Acceleration for DiT-Based TTS via Progressive Calibration
papers.title_zh: DiTReducio：一种无需训练的基于DiT技术的语音合成加速方法，通过渐进式校准实现性能提升
papers.authors: Yanru Huo, Ziyue Jiang, Zuoli Tang, Qingyang Hong, Zhou Zhao
papers.abstract: While Diffusion Transformers (DiT) have advanced non-autoregressive (NAR) speech synthesis, their high computational demands remain an obvious limitation. Existing DiT-based text-to-speech (TTS) model acceleration approaches predominantly focus on reducing sampling steps through distillation techniques, yet they remain constrained by training costs. We introduce DiTReducio, a training-free acceleration framework that compresses computations in DiT-based TTS models through a progressive calibration process. We propose two compression methods, Temporal Skipping and Branch Skipping, to eliminate redundant computations during inference. Moreover, based on two characteristic attention patterns identified within DiT layers, we devise a pattern-guided strategy to selectively apply the compression methods. Our method allows flexible modulation between generation quality and computational efficiency through adjustable compression thresholds. Experimental evaluations conducted on F5-TTS and MegaTTS 3 demonstrate that DiTReducio achieves a 75.4% reduction in FLOPs and improves the Real-Time Factor (RTF) by 37.1%, while preserving generation quality. The code is available at https://github.com/MM-Speech/DiTReducio.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然扩散变换器（DiT）在语音合成领域取得了显著的进展，但其高计算需求仍然是一个明显的限制。现有的基于DiT的文本转语音模型加速方法主要依赖于通过蒸馏技术来减少采样步长，但这些方法仍然受到训练成本的约束。我们提出了DiTReducio这一无需训练的加速框架，它通过渐进式校准过程来压缩基于DiT的语音合成模型的计算量。我们提出了两种压缩方法：时间跳过和分支跳过，以在推理过程中消除冗余的计算。此外，基于在DiT层内识别出的两种特征注意力模式，我们设计了一种基于模式的策略，以便有选择地应用这些压缩方法。我们的方法允许通过可调整的压缩阈值灵活地在生成质量和计算效率之间进行调整。在F5-TTS和MegaTTS 3上进行实验评估表明，DiTReducio能够将FLOPs减少75.4%，并将实时因子提高37.1%，同时保持良好的生成质量。该代码的下载链接为https://github.com/MM-Speech/DiTReducio。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DcLM: Output Length Control of Large Language Models via Dynamic Length Markers
papers.title_zh: DcLM：通过动态长度标记实现大型语言模型的输出长度控制
papers.authors: Zhe Chen, Jiaao Yu, Honglin Li
papers.abstract: Length-controllable text generation (LCTG) is essential for tasks like text summarization and report generation. However, large language models (LLMs) have limited awareness of output length, so precise control over the length of generated text remains a significant challenge. Most existing methods focus on prompt-based frameworks, position encoding, and reinforcement learning for model training. These approaches may affect semantic quality, and struggle to maintain consistent length control across different models and tasks. In this paper, we propose DcLM, a model-agnostic approach that introduces dynamic length markers to guide length-controllable outputs. During training, the model leverages these markers as in-context information, without learning to generate them. At inference time, an external word counter and injected length information guide the model to produce outputs of accurate lengths. We evaluate our method across multiple datasets, and the experimental results demonstrate that DcLM significantly reduces length deviation, showcasing its robust generalization ability across various length scales and tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 长度可控文本生成技术对于文本摘要和报告生成等任务来说至关重要。然而，大语言模型对输出长度的认知能力有限，因此精确控制生成文本的长度仍然是一个重大挑战。目前大多数方法都依赖于基于提示的框架、位置编码以及强化学习来进行模型训练。这些方法可能会影响到文本的语义质量，并且难以在不同模型和任务之间保持一致的长度控制。在本文中，我们提出了DcLM这一与模型无关的方法，该方法通过引入动态长度标记来指导长度可控的输出。在训练过程中，模型将这些标记作为上下文信息来使用，而无需学习如何生成这些标记。在推理阶段，外部的词数统计器和注入的长度信息会指导模型生成准确长度的输出。我们在多个数据集上评估了我们的方法，实验结果表明，DcLM显著减少了长度偏差，展现了其在不同长度范围和任务中的强大泛化能力。

papers.title: LongMP-Bench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Persona Understanding in Long-Term Dialogues
papers.title_zh: LongMP-Bench：一种用于长期对话中多模态人物理解能力的测试基准
papers.authors: Zhuoqun Li, Zhaopei Huang, Wenxuan Wang, Qin Jin
papers.abstract: Understanding multimodal user personas in long-term dialogues is essential for building personalized and human-like dialogue systems. However, existing datasets suffer from limited persona diversity and static, overly simplified settings, making them insufficient for capturing the complexity of real-world interactions. To address these limitations, we introduce LongMP-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate the capabilities of models in understanding evolving user personas within long-term multimodal dialogues. We present a multi-step, scalable data construction pipeline that generates long-term interaction records centered around multimodal personas, followed by human refinement for quality assurance. The resulting dataset contains long conversations from 150 users, each exhibiting visual consistency and dynamic persona development over time. Built on this dataset, we define a suite of tasks to comprehensively assess models’ ability to track persona evolution, integrate visual and textual inputs, and apply persona understanding in realistic dialogue scenarios. Extensive experiments on LongMP-Bench highlight the substantial challenges in multimodal persona understanding, especially in tracking persona shifts and leveraging multimodal context effectively. We will release our benchmark and code to facilitate future research in multimodal and personalized dialogue systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 在长期对话中理解多模态用户角色对于构建个性化且具有人类特征的对话系统至关重要。然而，现有的数据集存在角色多样性有限以及环境设置过于简单的问题，这些因素使得这些数据集无法充分捕捉现实世界交互的复杂性。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了LongMP-Bench这一基准测试，旨在评估模型在理解长期多模态对话中不断变化的用户角色方面的能力。我们采用了一种多步骤、可扩展的数据构建流程，该流程能够生成以多模态角色为中心的长期交互记录，随后通过人工审核来确保数据的质量。最终得到的数据集包含了150名用户的长期对话记录，每位用户都表现出视觉上的一致性，并且角色特征随时间不断发展。基于这个数据集，我们定义了一系列任务，以全面评估模型跟踪角色演变、整合视觉和文本输入以及在真实对话场景中应用角色理解的能力。在LongMP-Bench上的大量实验表明，在多模态角色理解方面存在诸多挑战，尤其是在追踪角色变化以及有效利用多模态上下文方面。我们将公开我们的基准测试和代码，以促进未来关于多模态和个性化对话系统的研究。

papers.title: TOOLCAD: Exploring Tool-Using Large Language Models in Text-to-CAD Generation with Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: TOOLCAD：利用工具式大型语言模型进行文本转CAD生成的探索——基于强化学习的方案
papers.authors: Yifei Gong, Xing Wu, Wenda Liu, Tukang
papers.abstract: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) is an expert-level task that relies on long-horizon reasoning and coherent modeling actions. Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable advancements in enabling language agents to tackle real-world tasks. Notably, there has been no investigation into how tool-using LLMs optimally interact with CAD engines, hindering the emergence of LLM-based agentic text-to-CAD modeling systems. We propose ToolCAD, a novel agentic CAD framework deploying LLMs as tool-using agents for text-to-CAD generation. Furthermore, we introduce an interactive CAD modeling gym to rollout reasoning and tool-augmented interaction trajectories with the CAD engine, incorporating hybrid feedback and human supervision. Meanwhile, an end-to-end post-training strategy is presented to enable the LLM agent to elicit refined CAD Modeling Chain of Thought (CAD-CoT) and evolve into proficient CAD tool-using agents via online curriculum reinforcement learning. Our findings demonstrate ToolCAD fills the gap in adopting and training open-source LLMs for CAD tool-using agents, enabling them to perform comparably to proprietary models, paving the way for more accessible and robust autonomous text-to-CAD modeling systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）是一项需要长期视角推理和连贯建模操作的专家级任务。大语言模型（LLM）在使语言代理能够处理现实世界任务方面取得了显著进展。然而，目前尚未有研究探讨使用工具的LLM如何与CAD引擎进行最优交互，这阻碍了基于LLM的代理式文本到CAD建模系统的发展。我们提出了ToolCAD这一新型代理式CAD框架，该框架利用LLM作为工具使用代理来生成文本到CAD的模型。此外，我们还引入了一个交互式的CAD建模环境，该环境能够结合混合反馈和人类监督，实现推理与工具辅助的交互过程。同时，我们提出了一种端到端的训练后策略，使得LLM代理能够逐步形成精细的CAD建模思维链，并通过在线课程强化学习逐渐成长为熟练的工具使用代理。我们的研究发现表明，ToolCAD填补了在CAD工具使用代理领域采用和训练开源LLM的空白，使其性能可与专有模型相媲美，为更易于访问且功能强大的自主文本到CAD建模系统铺平了道路。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Overlap Metrics: Rewarding Reasoning and Preferences for Faithful Multi-Role Dialogue Summarization
papers.title_zh: 超越重叠指标：为可靠的多角色对话摘要机制提供奖励机制与偏好设置
papers.authors: Xiaoyong Mei, Tingting Zuo, Da Chen, Guangyu Hu, Xiangyu Wen, Chao Duan, Mingyan Zhang, Fudan Zheng
papers.abstract: Multi-role dialogue summarization requires modeling complex interactions among multiple speakers while preserving role-specific information and factual consistency. However, most existing methods optimize for automatic metrics such as ROUGE and BERTScore, which favor surface-level imitation of references rather than genuine gains in faithfulness or alignment with human preferences. We propose a novel framework that couples explicit cognitive-style reasoning with reward-based optimization for multi-role dialogue summarization. Our method first distills structured reasoning traces (e.g., step-by-step inferences and intermediate reflections) from a large teacher model and uses them as auxiliary supervision to initialize a reasoning-aware summarizer via staged supervised fine-tuning. It then applies GRPO with a dual-principle reward that blends metric-based signals with human-aligned criteria targeting key information coverage, implicit inference, factual faithfulness, and conciseness. Experiments on multilingual multi-role dialogue benchmarks show that our method matches strong baselines on ROUGE and BERTScore. Specifically, results on CSDS confirm the framework’s stability in semantic consistency, while in-depth analysis on SAMSum demonstrates clear gains in factual faithfulness and model-based preference alignment. These findings underscore the value of reasoning-aware and preference-aware training for reliable dialogue summarization. Code will be made accessible upon acceptance, checkpoints and datasets are now available at https://huggingface.co/NebulaPixel.
papers.abstract_zh: 多角色对话摘要处理需要模拟多个说话者之间的复杂互动关系，同时保留特定角色的信息以及事实的一致性。然而，目前大多数方法都专注于优化自动评估指标，如ROUGE和BERTScore，这些指标更倾向于对参考文本的表层模仿，而非真正提升文本的忠实度或与人类偏好的契合度。我们提出了一种新颖的框架，将明确的认知风格推理与基于奖励的优化相结合，以实现多角色对话摘要处理。我们的方法首先从大型教师模型中提取结构化推理痕迹（例如，逐步推理和中间反思），并将其作为辅助监督来初始化一个具有推理意识的摘要生成器，通过分阶段的有监督训练来实现这一目标。随后，我们采用GRPO算法，结合基于指标的奖励标准和符合人类偏好标准的奖励机制，重点关注关键信息覆盖、隐含推理、事实忠实度和简洁性等方面。在多语言多角色对话基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法在ROUGE和BERTScore指标上达到了与优秀基线相当的水平。具体来说，CSDS测试的结果证明了该框架在语义一致性方面的稳定性，而SAMSum的深度分析则显示了其在事实忠实度和基于模型偏好的一致性方面的显著优势。这些发现强调了具有推理意识和偏好意识训练的必要性，这对于可靠对话摘要处理至关重要。代码将在论文被接受后公开，相关的检查点和数据集现已可在https://huggingface.co/NebulaPixel上获取。

papers.title: From Signal Degradation to Computation Collapse: Uncovering the Two Failure Modes of LLM Quantization
papers.title_zh: 从信号衰减到计算崩溃：揭示大型语言模型量化的两种故障模式
papers.authors: Chenxi Zhou, Pengfei Cao, Jiang Li, Bohan Yu, Jinyu Ye, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
papers.abstract: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) is critical for the efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). While 4-bit quantization is widely regarded as an optimal trade-off, reducing the precision to 2-bit usually triggers a catastrophic “performance cliff.” It remains unclear whether the underlying mechanisms differ fundamentally. Consequently, we conduct a systematic mechanistic analysis, revealing two qualitatively distinct failure modes: Signal Degradation, where the computational patterns remain intact but information precision is impaired by cumulative error; and Computation Collapse, where key components fail to function, preventing correct information processing and destroying the signal in the early layers. Guided by this diagnosis, we conduct mechanism-aware interventions, demonstrating that targeted, training-free repair can mitigate Signal Degradation, but remains ineffective for Computation Collapse. Our findings provide a systematic diagnostic framework for PTQ failures and suggest that addressing Computation Collapse requires structural reconstruction rather than mere compensation.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练后量化处理对于大语言模型的高效部署至关重要。虽然4位量化被普遍认为是最佳的权衡方案，但将精度降低到2位通常会引发严重的“性能骤降”问题。目前尚不清楚这两种情况的机制是否存在根本差异。因此，我们进行了系统的机制分析，发现了两种截然不同的故障模式：信号退化，即计算模式保持不变，但由于累积误差导致信息精度下降；以及计算崩溃，即关键组件无法正常工作，从而阻碍正确的信息处理，并在早期阶段破坏信号。基于这一诊断结果，我们采取了有针对性的干预措施，发现有针对性的、无需训练的修复方法可以缓解信号退化问题，但对于计算崩溃则无效。我们的研究结果为量化处理的故障提供了系统性的诊断框架，并表明解决计算崩溃问题需要结构上的重建，而不仅仅是简单的补偿措施。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Establishing a Scale for Kullback-Leibler Divergence in Language Models Across Various Settings
papers.title_zh: 为不同环境下的语言模型中的Kullback-Leibler散度设定一个衡量标准
papers.authors: Ryo Kishino, Yusuke Takase, Momose Oyama, Hiroaki Yamagiwa, Hidetoshi Shimodaira
papers.abstract: Log-likelihood vectors define a common space for comparing language models as probability distributions, enabling unified comparisons across heterogeneous settings. We extend this framework to training checkpoints and intermediate layers, and establish a consistent scale for KL divergence across pretraining, model size, random seeds, quantization, fine-tuning, and layers. Analysis of Pythia pretraining trajectories further shows that changes in log-likelihood space, as measured by the scaling behavior of KL divergence, are much smaller than in weight space, resulting in subdiffusive learning trajectories and early stabilization of language-model behavior despite weight drift.
papers.abstract_zh: 对数似然向量为比较语言模型作为概率分布提供了共同的基础，使得在不同环境下能够进行统一的比较。我们将这一框架扩展到训练检查点和中间层，并建立了一种统一的KL散度尺度，适用于预训练、模型规模、随机种子、量化处理、微调以及不同层级的比较。对Pythia预训练轨迹的分析进一步表明，通过KL散度的缩放行为来衡量的对数似然空间的变化，比权重空间的变化要小得多。因此，尽管权重会发生漂移，但语言模型的行为仍然会提前稳定下来，呈现出一种亚扩散性的学习过程。

papers.title: Simple Role Assignment is Extraordinarily Effective for Safety Alignment
papers.title_zh: 简单的角色分配在确保安全性方面效果显著
papers.authors: Zhou Ziheng, Jiakun Ding, Zhaowei Zhang, Ruosen Gao, Ying Nian Wu, Demetri Terzopoulos, Yipeng Kang, Fangwei Zhong, Junqi Wang
papers.abstract: Principle-based alignment often lacks context sensitivity and completeness. Grounded in Theory of Mind, we propose role conditioning as a compact alternative: social roles (e.g., mother, judge) implicitly encode both values and the cognitive schemas required to apply them. We introduce a training-free pipeline featuring a role-conditioned generator and iterative role-based critics for refinement. Across five model families, our approach consistently outperforms principle-based, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and other baselines across benchmarks. Notably, it reduces unsafe outputs on the WildJailbreak benchmark from 81.4% to 3.6% with DeepSeek-V3. Not only for common safety benchmarks, it consistently applies for agentic safety tasks. These results establish role assignment as a powerful, interpretable paradigm for AI alignment and LLM-as-a-Judge construction.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于原则的对齐方法往往缺乏情境敏感性和完整性。基于心智理论，我们提出了角色条件化这一简洁的替代方案：社会角色（如母亲、法官）隐含地包含了相关价值观以及应用这些价值观所需的认知模式。我们提出了一种无需训练的流程，该流程包含角色条件化生成器以及用于优化的迭代式角色基础评估机制。在五个模型家族中，我们的方法在各项基准测试中的表现始终优于基于原则的对齐方法、思维链方法以及其他基线方法。值得注意的是，使用DeepSeek-V3模型时，我们的方法将WildJailbreak基准测试中的不安全输出比例从81.4%降低到了3.6%。不仅适用于常见的安全基准测试，该方法还适用于代理安全任务。这些结果表明，角色分配是一种强大且可解释的AI对齐方式，适用于LLM作为裁判的场景构建。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Task-Stratified Knowledge Scaling Laws for Post-Training Quantized Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 针对训练后量化大型语言模型的任务分层知识扩展法则
papers.authors: Chenxi Zhou, Pengfei Cao, Jiang Li, Bohan Yu, Jinyu Ye, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
papers.abstract: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) is a critical strategy for efficient large language models (LLMs) deployment. However, existing scaling laws primarily focus on general performance, overlooking crucial fine-grained factors and how quantization differentially impacts diverse knowledge capabilities. To address this, we establish Task-Stratified Knowledge Scaling Laws. By stratifying capabilities into memorization, application, and reasoning, we develop a framework that unifies model size, bit-width, and fine-grained factors: group size and calibration set size. Validated on 293 diverse PTQ configurations, our framework demonstrates strong fit and cross-architecture consistency. It reveals distinct sensitivities across knowledge capabilities: reasoning is precision-critical, application is scale-responsive, and memorization is calibration-sensitive. We highlight that in low-bit scenarios, optimizing these fine-grained factors is essential for preventing performance collapse. These findings provide an empirically-backed foundation for designing knowledge-aware quantization strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练后量化是高效部署大语言模型的关键策略。然而，现有的扩展规律主要关注的是整体性能，而忽略了那些重要的细粒度因素，以及量化对不同知识能力的差异影响。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了任务分层知识扩展规律。通过将能力分为记忆、应用和推理三个层次，我们构建了一个能够统一模型规模、比特宽度以及细粒度因素的框架：组大小和校准集大小。在针对293种不同量化配置进行验证的基础上，我们的框架显示出良好的拟合度以及跨架构的一致性。研究还发现，不同知识能力对量化有不同的敏感性：推理对精度要求高，应用则对规模变化有响应，而记忆则对校准参数非常敏感。我们强调，在低比特率场景下，优化这些细粒度因素对于防止性能崩溃至关重要。这些发现为设计考虑知识特性的量化策略提供了实证支持。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MemPO: Self-Memory Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.title_zh: MemPO：适用于长视界代理的自适应内存策略优化技术
papers.authors: Ruoran Li, Xinghua Zhang, Haiyang Yu, Shitong Duan, Xiang Li, Wenxin Xiang, Chonghua Liao, Xudong Guo, Yongbin Li, Jinli Suo
papers.abstract: Long-horizon agents face the challenge of growing context size during interaction with environment, which degrades the performance and stability. Existing methods typically introduce the external memory module and look up the relevant information from the stored memory, which prevents the model itself from proactively managing its memory content and aligning with the agent’s overarching task objectives. To address these limitations, we propose the self-memory policy optimization algorithm (MemPO), which enables the agent (policy model) to autonomously summarize and manage their memory during interaction with environment. By improving the credit assignment mechanism based on memory effectiveness, the policy model can selectively retain crucial information, significantly reducing token consumption while preserving task performance. Extensive experiments and analyses confirm that MemPO achieves absolute F1 score gains of 25.98 over the base model and 7.1 over the previous SOTA baseline, while reducing token usage by 67.58% and 73.12%.
papers.abstract_zh: 长期代理在与环境交互时面临着不断增长的上下文规模带来的挑战，这会降低模型的性能和稳定性。现有的方法通常引入外部记忆模块，从存储的记忆中查找相关信息，这导致模型无法主动管理其记忆内容，也无法与代理的整体任务目标保持一致。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了自记忆策略优化算法（MemPO）。该算法使代理（策略模型）能够在与环境交互的过程中自主地总结和管理其记忆。通过改进基于记忆有效性的信息分配机制，策略模型能够选择性地保留关键信息，从而显著减少令牌消耗，同时保持良好的任务性能。大量的实验和分析表明，MemPO在F1分数上比基础模型提升了25.98，比之前的领先模型提升了7.1，同时减少了67.58%和73.12%的令牌使用量。

papers.title: Reason Only When Needed: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Model-Internal Uncertainty
papers.title_zh: 仅在必要时才使用推理机制：通过模型内部的不确定性来实现高效的生成式奖励建模
papers.authors: Chao Xue, Yao Wang, Mengqiao Liu, Di Liang, Xingsheng Han, Peiyang Liu, Xianjie Wu, Chenyao Lu, Lei Jiang, Yu Lu, Haibo Shi, Shuang Liang, Minlong Peng, Flora D. Salim
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in the Generative Reward Model (GRM) have demonstrated its potential to enhance the reasoning abilities of LLMs through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Despite these gains, existing implementations of GRM suffer from two critical limitations. First, CoT prompting is applied indiscriminately to all inputs regardless of their inherent complexity. This introduces unnecessary computational costs for tasks amenable to fast, direct inference. Second, existing approaches primarily rely on voting-based mechanisms to evaluate CoT outputs, which often lack granularity and precision in assessing reasoning quality. In this paper, we propose E-GRM, an efficient generative reward modeling framework grounded in model-internal uncertainty. E-GRM leverages the convergence behavior of parallel model generations to estimate uncertainty and selectively trigger CoT reasoning only when needed, without relying on handcrafted features or task-dependent signals. To improve reward fidelity, we introduce a lightweight discriminative scorer trained with a hybrid regression–ranking objective to provide fine-grained evaluation of reasoning paths. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks show that E-GRM substantially reduces inference cost while consistently improving answer accuracy, demonstrating that model-internal uncertainty is an effective and general signal for efficient reasoning-aware reward modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在生成性奖励模型（GRM）方面的进展表明，该模型通过思维链（CoT）提示能够提升大语言模型的推理能力。尽管取得了这些成果，但现有的GRM实现仍然存在两个关键缺陷。首先，CoT提示被不加选择地应用于所有输入，而不考虑输入的固有复杂性。这会给那些适合快速、直接推理的任务带来不必要的计算负担。其次，现有方法主要依赖基于投票的机制来评估CoT输出，这种评估方式往往缺乏精确性和细致性，无法准确判断推理的质量。在本文中，我们提出了E-GRM这一高效的生成性奖励建模框架，该框架基于模型内部的不确定性进行推理。E-GRM利用并行模型生成的收敛特性来估计不确定性，并仅在必要时触发CoT推理，而无需依赖手工设计的特征或任务相关的信号。为了提高奖励的精确度，我们引入了一种轻量级的判别评分器，该评分器采用混合回归与排序目标进行训练，从而能够对推理路径进行细致评估。在多个推理基准测试中的实验表明，E-GRM显著降低了推理成本，同时提高了答案的准确性。这表明，模型内部的不确定性是一种有效且通用的信号，可用于构建高效的、注重推理能力的奖励模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Metacognitive Self-Correction for Multi-Agent System via Prototype-Guided Next-Execution Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: 基于原型导向的下一步执行重构的多智能体系统元认知自我修正方法
papers.authors: Xu Shen, Qi Zhang, Song Wang, Zhen Tan, Xinyu Zhao, Laura Yao, Vaishnav Tadiparthi, Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub, Ehsan Moradi Pari, Kwonjoon Lee, Tianlong Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Model based multi-agent systems (MAS) excel at collaborative problem solving but remain brittle to cascading errors: a single faulty step can propagate across agents and disrupt the trajectory. In this paper, we present MASC, a metacognitive framework that endows MAS with real-time, unsupervised, step-level error detection and self-correction. MASC rethinks detection as history-conditioned anomaly scoring via two complementary designs: (1) Next-Execution Reconstruction, which predicts the embedding of the next step from the query and interaction history to capture causal consistency, and (2) Prototype-Guided Enhancement, which learns a prototype prior over normal-step embeddings and uses it to stabilize reconstruction and anomaly scoring under sparse context (e.g., early steps). When an anomaly step is flagged, MASC triggers a correction agent to revise the acting agent’s output before information flows downstream. On the Who When benchmark, MASC consistently outperforms all baselines, achieving up to 7.8% AUC-ROC improvement in the challenging w/o GT setting, and further delivers consistent gains on AgentErrorBench. When plugged into diverse MAS frameworks, it delivers consistent end-to-end gains across architectures, confirming that our metacognitive monitoring and targeted correction can mitigate error propagation with minimal overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在协作解决问题方面表现出色，但容易受到级联错误的影响：单个错误的步骤可能会在整个智能体上传播，从而破坏系统的正常运行。在本文中，我们提出了MASC这一元认知框架，它能够实时、无监督地检测智能体层面的错误并进行自我修正。MASC将错误检测重新定义为基于历史条件的异常评分，通过两种互补的方法实现这一目标：(1) 下一步执行重建，该方法根据查询和交互历史来预测下一步的嵌入，以确保因果一致性；(2) 原型引导增强，该方法通过学习正常步骤的嵌入来构建原型先验，并利用该先验在稀疏上下文条件下（例如早期步骤）稳定重建和异常评分。当检测到异常步骤时，MASC会触发一个修正代理，在信息向下传递之前修正智能体的输出。在Who When基准测试中，MASC始终优于所有基线方法，在具有挑战性的无目标数据设置下，其AUC-ROC指标提升了高达7.8%。在AgentErrorBench测试上，MASC也取得了稳定的性能提升。当将其应用于各种多智能体系统中时，它能够在不同架构中实现一致的整体性能提升，这证明了我们的元认知监控和针对性修正方法能够以最小的开销减轻错误传播的影响。

papers.title: DualGuard: Dual-stream Large Language Model Watermarking Defense against Paraphrase and Spoofing Attack
papers.title_zh: DualGuard：双流大型语言模型水印技术，有效抵御释义攻击和伪造攻击
papers.authors: Hao Li, Yubing Ren, Yanan Cao, Yingjie Li, Fang Fang, Shi Wang, Li Guo
papers.abstract: With the rapid development of cloud-based services, large language models have become increasingly accessible through various web platforms. However, this accessibility has also led to growing risks of model abuse. LLM watermarking has emerged as an effective approach to mitigate such misuse and protect intellectual property. Existing watermarking algorithms, however, primarily focus on defending against paraphrase attacks while overlooking piggyback spoofing attacks, which can inject harmful content, compromise watermark reliability, and undermine trust in attribution. To address this limitation, we propose DualGuard, the first watermarking algorithm capable of defending against both paraphrase and spoofing attacks. DualGuard employs the adaptive dual-stream watermarking mechanism, in which two complementary watermark signals are dynamically injected based on the semantic content. This design enables DualGuard not only to detect but also to trace spoofing attacks, thereby ensuring reliable and trustworthy watermark detection. Extensive experiments conducted across multiple datasets and language models demonstrate that DualGuard achieves excellent detectability, robustness, traceability, and text quality, effectively advancing the state of LLM watermarking for real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着基于云的服务迅速发展，大语言模型通过各种网络平台变得日益易于访问。然而，这种可访问性也带来了模型滥用的风险。因此，LLM水印技术作为一种有效手段被提出来，以缓解这种滥用行为并保护知识产权。不过，现有的水印算法主要侧重于防御改写攻击，而忽视了能够注入有害内容、破坏水印可靠性以及削弱信任度的欺骗性攻击。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了DualGuard算法——这是首个能够同时防御改写和欺骗性攻击的水印算法。DualGuard采用了自适应双流水印机制，根据语义内容动态注入两个互补的水印信号。这种设计使得DualGuard不仅能检测欺骗性攻击，还能追踪这些攻击，从而确保水印检测的可靠性和可信度。在多个数据集和语言模型上的广泛实验表明，DualGuard在检测能力、鲁棒性、可追溯性以及文本质量方面都表现出色，有效地提升了LLM水印技术在现实应用中的水平。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PeerCheck: Enhancing LLM-Generated Academic Reviews Towards Human-Level Quality
papers.title_zh: PeerCheck：提升大型语言模型生成的学术评审质量，使其达到人类水平的水平
papers.authors: Zeyuan Chen, Ziqing Yang, Yihan Ma, Michael Backes, Yang Zhang
papers.abstract: As academic submissions grow, the traditional peer review process struggles to keep up, raising concerns about quality and fairness.A trend of using large language models (LLMs) for assistance has emerged.In this work, we take a critical step toward improving the quality of LLM-generated reviews.We propose the PeerCheck framework, which investigates LLM-human review differences (\textbf{RQ1}) and explores methods to increase LLM-human similarity (\textbf{RQ2}).We first analyzed the human-written reviews with reviews generated by GPT-4o, Claude-3.7-Sonnet, and DeepSeek-V3 and found that LLMs and humans focus on different terms, e.g., LLMs prioritize theory while humans emphasize methodology and experiments.We further adopt prompt engineering, such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), and utilize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to enhance the LLM-generated reviews towards human-level quality.We find CoT significantly improves the human similarity of LLM reviews, while we also discover an unexpected “RAG paradox,” i.e., experiments with RAG produce different results for various LLMs and, in some cases, even reduce review quality.Our comprehensive analysis of LLM-generated academic reviews illustrates both possibilities and limitations, contributing to a more effective, human-aligned review system.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着学术投稿量的增加，传统的同行评审流程难以跟上步伐，这引发了人们对质量和公平性的担忧。目前，使用大语言模型来辅助评审的趋势逐渐兴起。在这项研究中，我们采取了一项关键措施来提高由语言模型生成的评审质量。我们提出了PeerCheck框架，该框架旨在分析语言模型与人类评审之间的差异（问题1），并探索提高语言模型与人类评审相似度的方法（问题2）。我们首先分析了由GPT-4o、Claude-3.7-Sonnet和DeepSeek-V3生成的人类撰写的评论，发现语言模型和人类在关注的重点上有所不同：例如，语言模型更重视理论方面，而人类则更注重方法论和实验部分。此外，我们还采用了提示工程技术，如思维链技术，并利用检索增强生成技术来提升语言模型生成的评论质量，使其达到人类水平的品质。我们发现，思维链技术显著提高了语言模型评论的人性化程度，同时我们也发现了一种意想不到的“检索增强生成悖论”——即，使用检索增强生成技术的实验结果会因不同的语言模型而产生差异，在某些情况下甚至会降低评论的质量。我们对语言模型生成的学术评论进行的全面分析揭示了这些可能性与局限性，有助于打造一个更加高效、符合人类审美的评审系统。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MorphoBench: A Benchmark with Difficulty Adaptive to Model Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MorphoBench：一种能够根据模型推理能力调整难度的测试基准平台
papers.authors: Xukai Wang, Xuanbo Liu, Mingrui Chen, Haitian Zhong, Xuanlin Yang, Bohan Zeng, Jinbo Hu, Hao Liang, Junbo Niu, Xuchen Li, Ruitao Wu, Ruichuan An, Yang Shi, Liu Liu, Qiang Liu, Zhouchen Lin, Xu-Yao Zhang, Wentao Zhang, Bin Dong
papers.abstract: With the advancement of powerful large-scale reasoning models, effectively evaluating the reasoning capabilities of these models has become increasingly important. However, existing benchmarks designed to assess the reasoning abilities of large models tend to be limited in scope and lack the flexibility to adapt their difficulty according to the evolving reasoning capacities of the models. To address this, we propose MorphoBench, a benchmark that incorporates multidisciplinary questions to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of large models and can adjust and update question difficulty based on the reasoning abilities of advanced models. Specifically, we curate the benchmark by selecting and collecting complex reasoning questions from existing benchmarks and sources such as Olympiad-level competitions. Additionally, MorphoBench adaptively modifies the analytical challenge of questions by leveraging key statements generated during the model’s reasoning process. Furthermore, it includes questions generated using simulation software, enabling dynamic adjustment of benchmark difficulty with minimal resource consumption. We have gathered over 1,300 test questions and iteratively adjusted the difficulty of MorphoBench based on the reasoning capabilities of models such as GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Pro. MorphoBench enhances the comprehensiveness and validity of model reasoning evaluation, providing reliable guidance for improving both the reasoning abilities and scientific robustness of large models.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着强大的大规模推理模型的不断发展，有效评估这些模型的推理能力变得越来越重要。然而，现有的用于评估大型模型推理能力的基准测试往往存在范围有限的问题，且缺乏根据模型不断发展的推理能力来调整难度功能的灵活性。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了MorphoBench这一基准测试工具。该工具结合了多学科问题来评估大型模型的推理能力，并能够根据先进模型的推理能力动态调整问题的难度。具体来说，我们通过从现有基准测试以及如奥林匹克竞赛等来源中选取复杂的推理问题来构建这个基准测试。此外，MorphoBench还能通过利用模型推理过程中生成的关键信息来自适应地调整问题的分析难度。同时，它还包括了使用仿真软件生成的问题，从而能够在最小的资源消耗下动态调整基准测试的难度。我们已经收集了超过1,300道测试题，并根据GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro等模型的推理能力逐步调整了MorphoBench的难度。MorphoBench提高了模型推理评估的全面性和可靠性，为提升大型模型的推理能力和科学严谨性提供了可靠的指导。

papers.title: Privacy Risks of Intermediate Representations: Attribute Inference in Distributed LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: 中间表示形式的隐私风险：分布式大语言模型推理中的属性推断问题
papers.authors: Yang Lyu, Jin Cao, Yang Xiao, Zhe Sun, Ben Niu, Fenghua Li, Hui LI
papers.abstract: Distributed LLM inference avoids sending raw inputs by transmitting intermediate hidden states, a practice widely assumed to preserve privacy. We challenge this assumption and demonstrate that intermediate representations alone are sufficient to leak sensitive user attributes. This setting poses a fundamental obstacle for existing attribute inference attacks, which typically rely on auxiliary embedding-attribute pairs. To characterize this previously underexplored privacy risk, we reformulate attribute inference as zero-shot matching over candidate attributes directly in the intermediate representation space, and introduce a purely intermediate-representation-based attribute inference attack, termed IR-AIA. To address two structural challenges that hinder attribute inference from intermediate representations, we propose SG-APCR to address layer-dependent anisotropy in intermediate embeddings and a sliding-window similarity matching strategy to handle subword-level semantic fragmentation. Experiments across three LLMs and three real-world datasets show that sensitive attributes can be reliably inferred using only intermediate representations, achieving Top-1 accuracy of up to 0.997 on CMS, 0.980 on Skytrax, and 0.986 on ECHR. These results reveal that intermediate states commonly considered safe to share can expose sensitive personal attributes on their own.
papers.abstract_zh: 分布式LLM推理通过传输中间隐藏状态来避免发送原始输入数据，这一做法被广泛认为能够保护隐私。然而，我们挑战了这一假设，证明仅使用中间表示就足以泄露用户的敏感属性。这一情况为现有的属性推理攻击带来了根本性的障碍，因为现有的攻击通常依赖于辅助的嵌入-属性对。为了描述这种之前未被充分研究的隐私风险，我们将属性推理重新定义为在中间表示空间中直接对候选属性进行零样本匹配，并提出了一种完全基于中间表示的属性推理攻击方法，称为IR-AIA。为了解决从中间表示进行属性推理时遇到的两个结构性问题，我们提出了SG-APCR算法来处理中间嵌入中的层依赖各向异性问题，同时采用了滑动窗口相似性匹配策略来处理子词级别的语义碎片化问题。在三个LLM和三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，仅使用中间表示就可以可靠地推断出敏感属性。在CMS数据集上，准确率达到了0.997；在Skytrax数据集上，准确率达到了0.980；在ECHR数据集上，准确率达到了0.986。这些结果表明，那些通常被认为可以安全共享的中间状态，实际上可能会单独暴露用户的敏感个人信息。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ReCon: Active Defense against Large Vision-Language Model Jailbreaks via Reverse Safety Concept Injection
papers.title_zh: ReCon：通过逆向安全概念注入来实现对大型视觉语言模型越狱行为的主动防御
papers.authors: Zheng He, Yiwei Wang, Hongxing Wang, Yujun Cai
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) confront an escalating threat from sophisticated multimodal jailbreak attacks. However, existing defense strategies suffer from three critical limitations: (1) the neglect of visual threats; (2) a lack of fine-grained specificity regarding specific attack semantics; and (3) the absence of a dedicated jailbreak detection mechanism, which leads to unnecessary defensive measures against benign inputs. To address these limitations, we propose ReCon, a novel black-box defense framework. ReCon integrates a diffusion-based image purifier to neutralize visual perturbations and an autoencoder-based detector for anomaly filtration. At its core, it employs a Reverse Safety Concept Injection module that maps detected unsafe concepts to fine-grained, constructive Safe Concepts, generating targeted prompts to precisely rectify attack semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReCon significantly enhances the robustness of LVLMs against jailbreak attacks while preserving performance on benign tasks. Disclaimer: Samples in this paper may be harmful and cause discomfort.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型面临着日益严重的多模态越狱攻击威胁。然而，现有的防御策略存在三个关键缺陷：(1) 忽视了视觉层面的威胁；(2) 缺乏针对特定攻击语义的精细区分能力；(3) 缺乏专门的越狱检测机制，导致对良性输入采取了不必要的防御措施。为了克服这些缺陷，我们提出了ReCon这一创新的黑盒防御框架。ReCon结合了基于扩散算法的图像净化器来消除视觉干扰，以及基于自动编码器的异常检测机制来进行异常过滤。其核心是一个逆向安全概念注入模块，该模块将检测到的不安全概念转化为精细化的、具有建设性的安全概念，从而生成有针对性的提示以精确修正攻击语义。大量实验表明，ReCon显著提升了LVLM对抗越狱攻击的鲁棒性，同时还能在处理良性任务时保持良好的性能。免责声明：本文中的样本可能具有破坏性，并可能导致不适。

papers.title: Verifying the Subjective: Structured Multilingual Rewards for Low-Resource Alignment
papers.title_zh: 验证主观性：为低资源环境提供结构化的多语言奖励机制
papers.authors: Jiu Sha, Mengxiao Zhu
papers.abstract: Aligning LLMs in low-resource multilingual settings faces a fundamental reward bottleneck: scalar rewards lack cultural generalization, while unstructured critiques remain noisy and unverifiable. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Structured Multilingual Reward Modeling Framework that extends Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to subjective and open-ended tasks. The framework unifies three core components to transform abstract quality into concrete supervision: (1) a Structured Checklist Schema decomposing evaluation into granular universal reasoning steps and task-specific criteria; (2) Structured Generative Critique Modeling, which produces rubric-aligned critiques with grounded justifications; and (3) Adaptive Multilingual Reward Optimization, integrating reasoning quality and language consistency into a verifiable objective. We integrate this framework into a bootstrapped Group Relative Policy Optimization pipeline, augmented by length-aware normalization and variance stabilization to ensure stability. Extensive experiments on a newly constructed suite covering 7 subjective task categories across 50 low-resource languages demonstrate that this checklist-driven approach yields substantial improvements in reasoning capability and response quality, particularly in settings where traditional reward models exhibit significant degradation. We publicly release our models and the corresponding evaluation benchmark to facilitate further research. Our code is available at https://github.com/Shajiu/SGCM.
papers.abstract_zh: 在资源匮乏的多语言环境中调整大语言模型时，存在一个基本的奖励瓶颈问题：标量奖励缺乏文化通用性，而非结构化评价仍然存在噪声且难以验证。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了一种结构化多语言奖励建模框架，该框架将可验证奖励强化学习技术应用于主观性和开放性问题。该框架整合了三个核心组件，将抽象的质量转化为具体的监督机制：(1) 结构化检查清单机制，将评估分解为细化的通用推理步骤和特定任务的标准；(2) 结构化生成式评价建模，能够生成符合评分标准的评价，并附上合理的理由说明；(3) 自适应多语言奖励优化，将推理质量和语言一致性纳入可验证的目标中。我们将这一框架集成到一个自举式群体相对策略优化流程中，并通过长度感知的归一化和方差稳定化技术来确保系统的稳定性。在针对7种主观任务类别、涵盖50种资源匮乏语言的全新构建测试集上进行的广泛实验表明，这种以检查清单为驱动的方法显著提升了推理能力和响应质量，尤其是在传统奖励模型表现不佳的情况下。我们公开了我们的模型和相应的评估基准，以便进一步的研究。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Shajiu/SGCM获取。

papers.title: Memory-Driven Role-Playing: Evaluation and Enhancement of Persona Knowledge Utilization in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 基于记忆的角色扮演：评估与提升大语言模型在角色知识运用方面的能力
papers.authors: Kai Wang, Haoyang You, Yang Zhang, Zhongjie Wang
papers.abstract: A core challenge for faithful LLM role-playing is sustaining consistent characterization throughout long, open-ended dialogues, as models frequently fail to recall and accurately apply their designated persona knowledge without explicit cues. To tackle this, we propose the Memory-Driven Role-Playing paradigm. Inspired by Stanislavski’s "emotional memory” acting theory, this paradigm frames persona knowledge as the LLM’s internal memory store, requiring retrieval and application based solely on dialogue context, thereby providing a rigorous test of depth and autonomous use of knowledge. Centered on this paradigm, we contribute: (1) MREval, a fine-grained evaluation framework assessing four memory-driven abilities—Anchoring, Selecting, Bounding, and Enacting; (2) MRPrompt, a prompting architecture that guides structured memory retrieval and response generation; and (3) MRBench, a bilingual (Chinese/English) benchmark for fine-grained diagnosis. The novel paradigm provides a comprehensive diagnostic for four-stage role-playing abilities across 12 LLMs. Crucially, experiments show that MRPrompt allows small models (e.g., Qwen3-8B) to match the performance of much larger closed-source LLMs (e.g., Qwen3-Max and GLM-4.7), and confirm that upstream memory gains directly enhance downstream response quality, validating the staged theoretical foundation.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于忠实于大语言模型角色扮演的开发者来说，一个核心挑战在于如何在长时间的开放式对话中保持一致的角色刻画。因为模型往往无法在没有明确提示的情况下准确回忆并应用其设定的角色知识。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了“记忆驱动的角色扮演”范式。该范式借鉴了斯坦尼斯拉夫斯基的“情感记忆”表演理论，将角色知识视为大语言模型的内部记忆存储，仅通过对话上下文来检索和应用相关知识，从而实现了对知识深度和自主使用的严格测试。基于这一范式，我们提出了以下成果：(1) MREval，一个细粒度的评估框架，能够评估四种记忆驱动的能力——锚定、选择、限定和执行；(2) MRPrompt，一种引导式提示架构，用于指导有结构的记忆检索和响应生成；(3) MRBench，一个双语（中文/英文）的基准测试平台，用于细粒度诊断。这一新颖的范式为12种大语言模型中的四种角色扮演能力提供了全面的诊断工具。实验表明，MRPrompt使得小型模型（例如Qwen3-8B）能够达到与更大规模的闭源语言模型（例如Qwen3-Max和GLM-4.7）相当的性能水平，并证实上游的记忆积累直接提升了下游的响应质量，从而验证了分阶段的理论基础。

papers.title: Scripts Through Time: A Survey of the Evolving Role of Transliteration in NLP
papers.title_zh: 《脚本与时间的演变：转写技术在自然语言处理中角色的变化研究》
papers.authors: Thanmay Jayakumar, Deepon Halder, Raj Dabre
papers.abstract: Cross-lingual transfer in NLP is often hindered by the “script barrier” where differences in writing systems inhibit transfer learning between languages. Transliteration, the process of converting the script, has emerged as a powerful technique to bridge this gap by increasing lexical overlap. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of the application of transliteration in cross-lingual NLP. We present a taxonomy of key motivations to utilize transliterations in language models, and also provide an overview of different approaches of incorporating transliterations as input. We analyze the evolution and effectiveness of these methods, discussing the critical trade-offs involved, and contextualize their need in modern LLMs. The review explores various contexts how transliteration is beneficial, including handling code-mixed text, leveraging language family relatedness, and pragmatic gains in inference efficiency. Based on this analysis, we provide concrete recommendations for researchers on selecting and implementing the most appropriate transliteration strategy based on their specific language, task, and resource constraints.
papers.abstract_zh: 在自然语言处理中，跨语言迁移往往受到“书写系统障碍”的阻碍，即不同的书写系统会导致语言之间的迁移学习困难。转写技术作为一种有效手段，可以通过增加词汇的重叠来弥补这一缺陷。本文对转写技术在跨语言自然语言处理中的应用进行了全面探讨。我们提出了使用转写的语言模型的关键动机分类，并概述了将转写作为输入的不同方法。我们分析了这些方法的演变与有效性，探讨了其中涉及的关键权衡问题，并阐述了它们在现代大语言模型中的必要性。文章还探讨了转写技术的多种应用场景，包括处理混合语码文本、利用语言家族间的关联性以及提高推理效率等方面。基于这些分析，我们为研究人员提供了具体的建议，帮助他们根据特定的语言、任务和资源限制来选择和实施最恰当的转写策略。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Health-ORSC-Bench: A Benchmark for Measuring Over-Refusal and Safety Completion in Health Context
papers.title_zh: 健康领域基准测试：用于衡量在健康背景下过度拒绝行为及安全完成情况的指标
papers.authors: Zhihao Zhang, Liting Huang, Guanghao Wu, Preslav Nakov, Heng Ji, Usman Naseem
papers.abstract: Safety alignment in Large Language Models is critical for healthcare; however, reliance on binary refusal boundaries often results in over-refusal of benign queries or unsafe compliance with harmful ones. While existing benchmarks measure these extremes, they fail to evaluate Safe Completion: the model’s ability to maximise helpfulness on dual-use or borderline queries by providing safe, high-level guidance without crossing into actionable harm. We introduce Health-ORSC-Bench, the first large-scale benchmark designed to systematically measure Over-Refusal and Safe Completion quality in healthcare. Comprising 31,920 benign boundary prompts across seven health categories (e.g., self-harm, medical misinformation), our framework uses an automated pipeline with human validation to test models at varying levels of intent ambiguity. We evaluate 30 state-of-the-art LLMs, including GPT-5 and Claude-4, revealing a significant tension: safety-optimised models frequently refuse up to 80% of “Hard” benign prompts, while domain-specific models often sacrifice safety for utility. Our findings demonstrate that model family and size significantly influence calibration: larger frontier models (e.g., GPT-5, Llama-4) exhibit “safety-pessimism” and higher over-refusal than smaller or MoE-based counterparts (e.g., Qwen-3-Next), highlighting that current LLMs struggle to balance refusal and compliance. Health-ORSC-Bench provides a rigorous standard for calibrating the next generation of medical AI assistants toward nuanced, safe, and helpful completions. Our code and data is available at: https://github.com/ZhihaoZhang97/Health-ORSC-Bench. Warning: Some contents may include toxic or undesired contents.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中，安全性对齐对于医疗保健领域至关重要。然而，过于依赖二元拒绝边界机制往往会导致对良性查询过度拒绝，或者在不安全的情况下处理有害查询。虽然现有的评估基准能够衡量这两种极端情况，但它们无法评估“安全完成”能力——即模型在应对双重用途或边界性查询时，能否提供安全、高层次的指导，同时避免引发实际的危害。我们推出了Health-ORSC-Bench这一大规模评估基准，旨在系统地衡量在医疗保健领域中的过度拒绝和“安全完成”能力。该基准包含31,920个涉及七个健康领域的良性边界提示，例如自伤、医疗错误信息等。我们的框架采用自动化流程，并结合人工验证，以测试模型在不同意图模糊程度下的表现。我们评估了30种最先进的LLM，包括GPT-5和Claude-4，发现了一个显著的矛盾现象：经过安全性优化的模型常常拒绝高达80%的“硬性”良性提示，而特定领域的模型则常常为了提升实用性而牺牲安全性。我们的研究结果表明，模型类型和规模对校准效果有着显著的影响：较大的前沿模型（如GPT-5、Llama-4）表现出“安全性悲观”的特性，其过度拒绝率高于较小的模型或基于MoE的模型（如Qwen-3-Next）。这表明当前的LLM在平衡拒绝与合规方面存在困难。Health-ORSC-Bench为下一代医疗AI助手提供了严格的校准标准，使其能够在提供细致、安全和有用的回答方面达到最佳效果。我们的代码和数据可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/ZhihaoZhang97/Health-ORSC-Bench。请注意，部分内容可能包含不良或不适宜的信息。

papers.title: LLM Inductive Reasoning Through Multi-Agent Enhanced Monte Carlo Tree Search
papers.title_zh: 通过多智能体增强蒙特卡洛树搜索方法研究归纳推理的机器学习课程
papers.authors: Xiang Li, Yucheng Zhou, Xiangzhi Wei, Zesheng Shi, Haiyuan Wan, Gong Yifan, Fangming Liu, Jing Li
papers.abstract: Existing methods for enhancing the inductive reasoning of large language models (LLMs) at test-time typically depend on iterative self-refinement of hypotheses, which lacks explicit optimization guidance and effective error correction. This often results in superficial rewording and the accumulation of errors. To overcome these limitations, we propose MATSIR, a plug-and-play test-time framework integrating Multi-Agent coordination with Monte Carlo Tree Search to improve Inductive Reasoning. MATSIR incorporates a dual-reward mechanism that provides explicit refinement signals, promoting logically coherent and semantically enriched hypotheses rather than mere rephrasing. Furthermore, it enables trajectory-level error correction through backtracking and pruning, allowing the system to recover from erroneous intermediate hypotheses. Experiments on five benchmarks across four LLMs show that MATSIR consistently outperforms previous best methods, yielding the highest average improvement of +4.9% on QWQ-32B and all-round improvement on Deepseek-V3. Our findings highlight that explicit guided search with built-in error correction is essential for advancing inductive reasoning in LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/SolarWindRider/MATSIR
papers.abstract_zh: 目前用于提升大语言模型在测试阶段归纳推理能力的方法，通常依赖于假设的迭代自我完善过程。这种方法缺乏明确的优化指导以及有效的错误修正机制，往往导致语句的肤浅改写和错误的累积。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了MATSIR这一即插式测试框架。该框架结合了多智能体协调机制和蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，以改进模型的归纳推理能力。MATSIR采用了双奖励机制，能够提供明确的优化信号，促使生成逻辑上连贯、语义上丰富的假设，而不仅仅是简单的语句重写。此外，它还通过回溯和剪枝技术实现了对模型中间结果的错误修正，使系统能够从错误的假设中恢复过来。在四个大语言模型上的五个基准测试中的实验表明，MATSIR的表现始终优于现有的最佳方法，在QWQ-32B模型上实现了最高的平均提升效果，达到了+4.9%，并且在Deepseek-V3模型上也取得了全面的提升。我们的研究结果表明，带有内置错误修正机制的明确引导式搜索对于提升大语言模型的归纳推理能力至关重要。相关代码可访问https://github.com/SolarWindRider/MATSIR

papers.title: UniCreative: Unifying Long-form Logic and Short-form Sparkle via Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: UniCreative：通过无需参考的强化学习技术，实现长格式逻辑与短格式元素的融合
papers.authors: Xiaolong Wei, Zerun Zhu, Simin Niu, Xingyu Zhang, Peiying Yu, Changxuan Xiao, Yuchen Li, Jicheng Yang, Zhejun Zhao, Chong Meng, Long Xia, Daiting Shi
papers.abstract: A fundamental challenge in creative writing lies in reconciling the inherent tension between maintaining global coherence in long-form narratives and preserving local expressiveness in short-form texts. While long-context generation necessitates explicit macroscopic planning, short-form creativity often demands spontaneous, constraint-free expression. Existing alignment paradigms, however, typically employ static reward signals and rely heavily on high-quality supervised data, which is costly and difficult to scale. To address this, we propose UniCreative, a unified reference-free reinforcement learning framework. We first introduce AC-GenRM, an adaptive constraint-aware reward model that dynamically synthesizes query-specific criteria to provide fine-grained preference judgments. Leveraging these signals, we propose ACPO, a policy optimization algorithm that aligns models with human preferences across both content quality and structural paradigms without supervised fine-tuning and ground-truth references. Empirical results demonstrate that AC-GenRM aligns closely with expert evaluations, while ACPO significantly enhances performance across diverse writing tasks. Crucially, our analysis reveals an emergent meta-cognitive ability: the model learns to autonomously differentiate between tasks requiring rigorous planning and those favoring direct generation, validating the effectiveness of our direct alignment approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 创意写作中的一个根本挑战在于如何平衡在长篇叙事中保持全局一致性与在短篇文本中保留地方特色表达之间的矛盾。虽然长篇叙事需要宏观层面的规划，但短篇作品往往要求即兴创作，不受约束。然而，现有的对齐方法通常依赖静态的奖励信号，并且需要高质量的监督数据，这既成本高昂，也难以扩展。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了UniCreative这一统一的无参考强化学习框架。我们首先介绍了AC-GenRM模型，这是一种自适应且考虑约束的奖励模型，它能够动态生成针对特定查询的标准，从而提供细粒度的偏好判断。利用这些信号，我们提出了ACPO策略优化算法，该算法能够在不进行监督微调且无需真实基准数据的情况下，将模型与人类偏好对齐。实验结果表明，AC-GenRM与专家评估结果高度一致，而ACPO则显著提升了多种写作任务的表现。更重要的是，我们的分析揭示了一种新兴的元认知能力：模型能够自主区分需要严格规划的任务和倾向于直接生成的任务，这验证了我们的直接对齐方法的有效性。

papers.title: FFN Lens: How Transformers Divide Labor for Multilingual Tasks
papers.title_zh: FFN镜头：变形金刚如何分配多语言任务的工作负担
papers.authors: Jiatong Li, Hailong Cao, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong performance in multilingual tasks, yet the process of constructing predictions in the target language remains under-explored. In this work, we introduce the FFN Lens, a novel interpretability method focusing on the Transformer’s core computational module, the Feed-Forward Network (FFN). By directly leveraging model parameters, the FFN Lens identifies both the critical units responsible for constructing specific information and the input features that drive them, which is essential for understanding Large Language Models. Applying FFN Lens to multilingual tasks, we demonstrate the prediction construction process and reveal the distinct division of labor across model layers. We identify a three-stage functional pipeline for constructing multilingual predictions: Latent Translation, Semantic Mapping, and Self Emphasis. We further introduce subspace analysis to validate this three-stage mechanism from a complementary perspective, and leverage these mechanistic insights to propose a training-free uncertainty estimation method.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多语言任务中表现出强大的性能，然而，用目标语言进行预测的过程仍然没有得到充分研究。在这项研究中，我们提出了FFN Lens这一新颖的可解释性方法，该方法专注于Transformer的核心计算模块——前馈网络。通过直接利用模型参数，FFN Lens能够识别出负责构建特定信息的关键单元以及驱动这些单元的输入特征，这对于理解大语言模型至关重要。将FFN Lens应用于多语言任务时，我们展示了预测构建的过程，并揭示了模型各层之间的分工情况。我们提出了一种构建多语言预测的三阶段流程：潜在翻译、语义映射和自我强调。此外，我们还引入了子空间分析方法来从另一个角度验证这一三阶段机制，并利用这些机制洞察提出了一种无需训练的不确定性估计方法。

papers.title: Seeing Beyond Words: MatVQA for Challenging Visual-Scientific Reasoning in Materials Science
papers.title_zh: 超越文字的感知：MatVQA在材料科学中助力视觉与科学推理能力的提升
papers.authors: Sifan Wu, Huan Zhang, Yizhan Li, Farshid Effaty, Hongyuan Mei, Amirreza Ataei, Bang Liu
papers.abstract: The emergence of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that integrate vision and language modalities has unlocked new potentials for scientific reasoning, outperforming prior benchmarks in both natural language and coding domains. Current materials science evaluation datasets such as MaScQA and SciQA remain largely text-based and fail to capture the visual and research-level analytic complexity required in materials discovery and design. We introduce MatVQA, a scalable benchmark specifically designed to address this gap. Generated via an automated pipeline, MArxivAgent, from recent materials literature, MatVQA features 1672 questions across four critical structure-property-performance (SPP) reasoning tasks. Uniquely, MatVQA employs an iterative process to eliminate textual shortcuts, compelling MLLMs to perform fine-grained, low-level visual analysis of material imagery (e.g., microscopy, diffraction patterns) integrated with multi-step scientific reasoning. Benchmarking 19 open- and closed-source MLLMs on MatVQA reveals substantial gaps in current multimodal reasoning capabilities. The MatVQA benchmark is publicly available[https://huggingface.co/datasets/trqcbf/matvqa_v2] to facilitate further research on applying MLLMs to complex materials science problems.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型的出现，使得整合视觉与语言能力的模型在科学推理方面展现出新的潜力，其性能超越了以往在自然语言和编码领域的基准测试。目前，诸如MaScQA和SciQA这样的材料科学评估数据集仍然主要基于文本数据，无法捕捉到材料发现与设计过程中所需的视觉性和研究级分析复杂性。为此，我们提出了MatVQA这一可扩展的基准测试，旨在填补这一空白。MatVQA通过自动化流程生成，其数据来源于最新的材料文献，包含1672个问题，涵盖四个关键的结构-性能推理任务。独特之处在于，MatVQA采用迭代式方法消除文本中的隐含信息，迫使大语言模型对材料图像（如显微镜下的图像、衍射图样等）进行细致、低层次的视觉分析，并结合多步骤的科学推理过程。通过对19种开源和闭源的大语言模型在MatVQA上的测试，我们发现当前多模态推理能力存在显著不足。MatVQA基准测试已公开可用[https://huggingface.co/datasets/trqcbf/matvqa_v2]，有助于进一步研究如何将大语言模型应用于复杂的材料科学问题。

papers.title: RLShield: Dynamic Jailbreak Detection for LLMs via Reinforced Adaptive Learning
papers.title_zh: RLShield：通过强化自适应学习实现LLM动态越狱检测技术
papers.authors: Zhao Tong, Pengfei Yang, Yimeng Gu, Haichao Shi, Qiang Liu, Xingcheng Xu, Shu Wu, Xiao-Yu Zhang
papers.abstract: While prompt engineering enhances the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), it also exposes critical safety concerns. Due to the inherent brittleness of their static safety boundaries, LLMs are vulnerable to jailbreak prompts, i.e. adversarial inputs designed to bypass safeguards and induce the generation of harmful content. Existing detection mechanisms rely on static model components or fixed decision thresholds, limiting their ability to generalize to evolving attack patterns and continual model updates. To bridge this gap, we propose RLShield, a dynamic jailbreak detection framework that employs reinforcement learning for adaptive threshold selection. RLShield incorporates three key innovations: (i) a dynamic retrieval and LLM-based rewriting module to simulate diverse adversarial contexts; (ii) a cross-layer representation analysis to pinpoint safety-critical parameters; and (iii) a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) based agent that learns to predict optimal, sample-specific detection thresholds. Experimental results demonstrate that RLShield consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in detection performance while maintaining high computational efficiency. Notably, it improves F1 by up to 7.3%, while achieving an average of 3\times gain in inference efficiency across multiple LLM backbones.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然prompt工程提升了大语言模型的能力，但也带来了严重的安全隐患。由于大语言模型的静态安全边界具有固有的脆弱性，它们容易受到“越狱提示”的攻击——即那些旨在绕过安全措施并生成有害内容的恶意输入。现有的检测机制依赖于静态模型组件或固定的决策阈值，这限制了它们对不断变化的攻击模式和持续更新的模型进行泛化的能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了RLShield这一动态越狱检测框架，该框架采用强化学习技术来自适应地选择阈值。RLShield包含三个关键创新点：(i) 一个能够模拟多种恶意上下文的动态检索和基于语言模型的重写模块；(ii) 一种跨层表示分析技术，用于识别关键的安全参数；(iii) 一个基于软演员-评论家算法的智能体，能够预测出适用于不同样本的最优检测阈值。实验结果表明，RLShield在检测性能方面始终优于最先进的基线方法，同时还能保持较高的计算效率。值得注意的是，它的F1分数提高了7.3%，并且在多种语言模型框架上实现了平均3倍的推理效率提升。

papers.title: MEDSYN: Benchmarking Multi-EviDence SYNthesis in Complex Clinical Cases for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MEDSYN：在复杂临床案例中，对多模态大型语言模型进行多示例生成技术的性能评估
papers.authors: Boqi Chen, Xudong Liu, Jiachuan Peng, Marianne Frey-Marti, Kyle Lam, Bang Zheng, Lin Li, Jianing Qiu
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown great potential in medical applications, yet existing benchmarks inadequately capture real-world clinical complexity. We introduce MEDSYN, a multilingual, multimodal benchmark of highly complex clinical cases with up to 7 distinct visual clinical evidence (CE) types per case. Mirroring clinical workflow, we evaluate 18 MLLMs on differential diagnosis (DDx) generation and final diagnosis (FDx) selection. While frontier models often match or even outperform human experts on DDx generation, all MLLMs exhibit a much larger DDx–FDx performance gap compared to expert clinicians, indicating a failure mode in synthesis of heterogeneous CE types. Ablations attribute this failure to (i) overreliance on less discriminative textual CE (e.g., medical history) and (ii) a cross-modal CE utilization gap. We introduce Evidence Sensitivity to quantify the latter and show that a smaller gap correlates with higher diagnostic accuracy. Finally, we demonstrate how it can be used to guide interventions to improve model performance. https://github.com/jianing-lab/MEDSYN.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在医疗领域展现出巨大潜力，但现有的评估基准未能充分反映现实世界中的临床复杂性。我们提出了MEDSYN这一多语言、多模态的基准测试平台，该平台能够处理高度复杂的临床案例，每个案例中最多包含7种不同类型的视觉临床证据。为了模拟临床工作流程，我们对18个多模态大语言模型进行了诊断推理和最终诊断选择的评估。虽然一些前沿模型在诊断推理方面能够与人类专家相媲美甚至超越他们，但所有多模态大语言模型在诊断推理与最终诊断之间的性能差距都远大于人类专家，这表明它们在处理多种类型临床证据时存在缺陷。我们通过分析发现，这种缺陷主要源于两个方面：一是过度依赖那些缺乏区分能力的文本型临床证据（如病史），二是不同模态临床证据的整合存在不足。为了量化这一问题，我们引入了“证据敏感性”这一概念，并发现较小的性能差距与更高的诊断准确性呈正相关。最后，我们展示了如何利用这一模型来指导改进模型的性能。更多相关信息可以访问：https://github.com/jianing-lab/MEDSYN

papers.title: Sem-DPO: Mitigating Semantic Inconsistency in Preference Optimization for Prompt Engineering
papers.title_zh: Sem-DPO：在偏好优化中缓解语义不一致性问题，以改进提示设计
papers.authors: Anas Mohamed, Azal Ahmad Khan, Xinran Wang, Ahmad Faraz Khan, Shuwen Ge, Saman Bahzad Khan, Ayaan Ahmad, Ali Anwar
papers.abstract: Generative AI can now synthesize strikingly realistic images from text, yet output quality remains highly sensitive to how prompts are phrased. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) offers a lightweight, off-policy alternative to RL for automatic prompt engineering, but its token-level regularization leaves semantic inconsistency unchecked as prompts that win higher preference scores can still drift away from the user’s intended meaning. We introduce Sem-DPO, a variant of DPO that preserves semantic consistency yet retains its simplicity and efficiency. Sem-DPO adjusts the DPO loss using a weight based on how different the winning prompt is from the original, reducing the impact of training examples that are semantically misaligned. We provide the first analytical bound on semantic drift for preference-tuned prompt generators, showing that Sem-DPO keeps learned prompts within a provably bounded neighborhood of the original text. On three standard text-to-image prompt-optimization benchmarks and three language models, Sem-DPO achieves 8–12% higher CLIP similarity and 5–9% higher human-preference scores (HPSv2.1, PickScore) than DPO, while also outperforming state-of-the-art prompt optimization baselines as well as several DPO variants. These findings suggest that strong flat baselines augmented with semantic weighting should become the new standard for prompt-optimization studies and lay the groundwork for broader, semantics-aware preference optimization in language models.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能现在能够从文本中合成极其逼真的图像，但输出质量仍然非常容易受到提示表述方式的影响。直接偏好优化算法提供了一种轻量级、非策略性的替代方法，用于自动生成提示，但其基于令牌的规范化处理会导致语义上的不一致性——那些获得较高偏好得分的提示仍可能偏离用户原本的意图。我们提出了Sem-DPO算法，这是一种改进版的DPO算法，它能够保持语义一致性，同时依然保持简单性和高效性。Sem-DPO通过根据获胜提示与原始文本的偏差程度来调整DPO损失函数，从而减轻那些在语义上不匹配的训练样本所带来的影响。我们首次为偏好调优的提示生成器提供了关于语义漂移的分析性界限，表明Sem-DPO所生成的提示始终保持在与原始文本有明确定义的邻近范围内。在三个标准的文本到图像提示优化基准测试以及三种语言模型上，Sem-DPO在CLIP相似度方面比DPO高出8-12%，在人类偏好评分方面则高出5-9%（基于HPSv2.1和PickScore）。此外，Sem-DPO还优于现有的各种提示优化基线算法以及几种DPO变体。这些发现表明，结合语义加权功能的强大基础算法应该成为提示优化研究的新标准，并为语言模型中更全面的、注重语义的偏好优化奠定基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BNLP: A Text Annotation Platform for Quality Control of LLM-Generated Annotations
papers.title_zh: BNLP：一个用于质量控制的大语言模型生成注释的文本标注平台
papers.authors: Xinhao Zhuang, Qiongyu Tian, Yalin Chen, Tianle Xin, Yongyong Fu, Yunchao Ling, Guoqing Zhang
papers.abstract: High-quality annotated data is crucial for NLP, yet manual annotation is costly and difficult to scale in low-resource settings. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong zero-shot and few-shot generalization in NLP tasks, but existing annotation tools either lack LLM support or use LLMs only as one-off pre-annotation engines, without incorporating collaboration or quality control, compromising data reliability. We present BNLP, a text annotation platform that embeds LLM-assisted labeling into a quality-aware collaborative workflow. BNLP treats LLM outputs as intermediate, revisable states and integrates multi-role collaboration, iterative review cycles, and consistency analysis to enable continuous quality monitoring while preserving efficiency gains. BNLP also natively supports AI-ready formats such as Excel and JSON, ensuring seamless data flow from manual annotation to model training. Experiments show that BNLP reduces annotation time by 74.3% and improves annotation quality by 11.6% over purely manual annotation in LLM-assisted settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量的有注释数据对于自然语言处理至关重要，然而手动标注既成本高昂，又难以在资源有限的情况下进行大规模扩展。大语言模型在NLP任务中表现出强大的零样本和少样本泛化能力，但现有的标注工具要么缺乏对LLM的支持，要么仅将其作为一次性预标注工具使用，而没有实现协作或质量控制，这影响了数据的可靠性。我们提出了BNLP这一文本标注平台，它将LLM辅助的标注功能融入到一个注重质量的协作工作流程中。BNLP将LLM的输出视为可修改的中间状态，并整合了多角色协作、迭代评审机制以及一致性分析等功能，从而实现持续的质量监控，同时保持效率的提升。BNLP还原生支持Excel和JSON等AI兼容格式，确保从手动标注到模型训练的数据流转顺畅。实验表明，在LLM辅助的标注环境中，BNLP将标注时间减少了74.3%，标注质量也提高了11.6%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ElasticFlow: One-Step Physics-Consistent Policy with Elastic Time Horizons for Language-Guided Manipulation
papers.title_zh: ElasticFlow：一种一步完成的物理一致性策略，适用于语言引导的操作，且时间范围可以灵活调整
papers.authors: Kewei Chen, Yayu Long, Shuai Li, Mingsheng Shang
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have demonstrated exceptional performance in embodied AI. However, their iterative denoising process results in high latency, and existing acceleration methods often sacrifice physical consistency. To address this, we propose ElasticFlow, a distillation-free, physics-consistent one-step policy framework. We reconstruct the Mean Field Theory by directly modeling the average velocity field, enabling a direct single-step mapping from noise to action. Addressing the Temporal Heterogeneity of robotic tasks, we introduce the Elastic Time Horizons mechanism. This mechanism effectively overcomes Spectral Bias by explicitly encoding control granularity, achieving efficient alignment between semantic instructions and physical execution horizons. Experiments on benchmarks such as LIBERO, CALVIN, and RoboTwin demonstrate that ElasticFlow achieves efficient 1-NFE inference (approximately 71Hz). Furthermore, it outperforms state-of-the-art methods, including OpenVLA and \pi_0, on long-horizon tasks, highlighting its potential for efficient, robust, and semantically aligned control.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散策略在实体化人工智能领域表现优异。然而，其迭代去噪过程会导致高延迟，而现有的加速方法往往牺牲了物理一致性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ElasticFlow——一种无需蒸馏、且符合物理规律的单步策略框架。我们通过直接建模平均速度场来重建平均场理论，从而实现从噪声到动作的直接单步映射。针对机器人任务中的时间异质性问题，我们引入了弹性时间范围机制。该机制通过明确编码控制粒度，有效克服了频谱偏差问题，实现了语义指令与物理执行时间范围之间的高效对齐。在LIBERO、CALVIN和RoboTwin等基准测试中的实验表明，ElasticFlow能够实现高效的1-NFE推理（约71Hz）。此外，它在长视域任务上优于包括OpenVLA和\pi_0在内的现有方法，凸显了其实现高效、稳健且语义一致控制的潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AdaptiveK: Complexity-Driven Sparse Autoencoders for Interpretable Language Model Representations
papers.title_zh: AdaptiveK：基于复杂度的稀疏自编码器，用于构建可解释的语言模型表示方式
papers.authors: Yifei Yao, Hanrong Zhang, Mengnan Du
papers.abstract: Understanding the internal representations of large language models (LLMs) remains a central challenge for interpretability research. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) offer a promising solution by decomposing activations into interpretable features, but existing approaches rely on fixed sparsity constraints that fail to account for input complexity. We propose AdaptiveK SAE (Adaptive Top K Sparse Autoencoders), a novel framework that dynamically adjusts sparsity levels based on the semantic complexity of each input. Leveraging linear probes, we demonstrate that context complexity is linearly encoded in LLM representations, and we use this signal to guide feature allocation during training. Experiments across ten language models demonstrate that this complexity-driven adaptation outperforms fixed-sparsity approaches on reconstruction fidelity, explained variance, cosine similarity and interpretability metrics while eliminating the burden of extensive hyperparameter tuning. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hiyukie/adaptiveK.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解大语言模型的内部表示结构，一直是可解释性研究中的一个核心挑战。稀疏自编码器作为一种有前景的解决方案，通过将激活值分解为可解释的特征来应对这一挑战。然而，现有的方法依赖于固定的稀疏性约束，这无法充分考虑到输入数据的复杂性。我们提出了自适应Top K稀疏自编码器这一新框架，该框架能够根据每个输入的语义复杂度动态调整稀疏性水平。通过利用线性探针技术，我们发现上下文的复杂性可以被线性编码到语言模型的表示中，并利用这一信息来指导训练过程中的特征分配。在十个语言模型上的实验表明，这种基于复杂性的自适应方法在重建精度、解释方差、余弦相似度以及可解释性指标方面均优于固定稀疏性方法，同时避免了繁琐的超参数调优工作。我们的代码可以在以下链接获取：https://github.com/hiyukie/adaptiveK。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Experience-Driven Multi-Agent Optimization for Black-Box Jailbreak Attacks on Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于经验的多智能体优化方法，用于应对针对大型语言模型的黑盒越狱攻击
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Han, Yihe Liu, Kai Zhang, Ping Li
papers.abstract: The rapid discovery of jailbreak prompts has revealed the alarming fragility of safety alignment in frontier large language models (LLMs). While jailbreak techniques play a critical role in red-teaming and safety evaluation, existing methods exhibit three key limitations: (i) poor transferability across model families, requiring model-specific manual tuning; (ii) heavy reliance on large-scale prompt enumeration or exhaustive search, causing prohibitive query costs and poor scalability; and (iii) high sensitivity to input preprocessing or refusal-oriented fine-tuning, leading to attack failures once the underlying model is updated. To address these, we propose Experience-driven Multi-agent Jailbreak Optimization (EMJO), which couples three collaborating agents (Attacker, Analyzer, and Judge) into a closed-loop “probe–evaluate–revise” process, together with a dynamic experience bank accumulating high-quality successful prompts and reusable strategy patterns across iterations and tasks. This design enables query-efficient and transferable jailbreak optimization under black-box access. Extensive experiments on diverse LLMs demonstrate that EMJO consistently outperforms existing black-box jailbreak baselines, achieving up to 11% absolute improvement in attack success rate while reducing the average query cost by up to 7.9\times across two benchmark datasets. These results indicate that EMJO offers an effective and scalable paradigm for systematic jailbreak discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 快速发现的越狱提示揭示了前沿大语言模型在安全方面的脆弱性。虽然越狱技术在增强网络安全和评估安全性方面起着关键作用，但现有方法存在三个主要局限性：(1) 不同模型家族之间的可迁移性较差，需要针对每个模型进行手动调整；(2) 严重依赖大规模提示枚举或穷举搜索方式，导致查询成本过高且可扩展性差；(3) 对输入预处理或基于拒绝导向的微调非常敏感，一旦底层模型发生更新，就会引发攻击失败。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了经验驱动的多智能体越狱优化算法（EMJO）。该算法将三个协作代理——攻击者、分析器和裁判器——整合到一个闭环“探测-评估-修正”过程中，同时拥有一个动态的经验库，能够积累高质量的成功提示以及可在不同迭代和任务中重复使用的策略模式。这种设计使得在黑盒访问的情况下也能实现高效且可迁移的越狱优化。在多种大语言模型上的广泛实验表明，EMJO始终优于现有的黑盒越狱基线算法，其攻击成功率提高了11%，同时平均查询成本降低了7.9倍。这些结果表明，EMJO提供了一种有效且可扩展的系统化越狱发现方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CMIG: Conceptual Metaphor Theory-Inspired Framework for Metaphorical Image Generation
papers.title_zh: CMIG：基于概念隐喻理论的意象生成框架
papers.authors: Qingbao Huang, Cheng Yang, Jiawei Yao, Zhiyue Liu, Yi Cai, Xingmao Zhang
papers.abstract: Metaphorical text expresses meaning through cross-domain mappings rather than literal surface content, which makes it difficult for text-to-image systems to generate semantically faithful images. We propose CMIG, a structured prompting framework inspired by Conceptual Metaphor Theory (CMT). CMIG identifies source–target mappings, filters projectable source attributes, and selects a visual realization strategy in a reproducible reasoning workflow. Experiments on DALL\cdotE 3, Imagen 2, and FLUX-1 show that CMIG consistently improves semantic alignment and yields a better overall balance of human-rated metaphor quality, visual coherence, and controllability on metaphorical prompts. To support systematic evaluation, we also construct a 3,500-instance visual metaphor benchmark.
papers.abstract_zh: 隐喻性文本通过跨领域的映射来表达意义，而非仅仅依赖字面内容。这使得文本到图像的系统难以生成具有语义忠实度的图像。我们提出了CMIG这一结构化提示框架，该框架受概念隐喻理论启发。CMIG能够识别源与目标之间的映射关系，筛选可应用的源属性，并在可复现的推理流程中选择合适的视觉实现策略。在DALL·E 3、Imagen 2和FLUX-1上的实验表明，CMIG能够持续提升语义一致性，同时在人类评测中取得更好的成绩，即在隐喻性提示方面实现了视觉连贯性与可控性的良好平衡。为了支持系统的评估，我们还构建了一个包含3500个实例的视觉隐喻基准测试。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Position: From Noise to Signal to Selbstzweck - Reframing Human Label Variation in the Era of Post-training in NLP
papers.title_zh: 立场：从噪声到信号，再到自我目的——在自然语言处理后训练时代重新定义人类标签的多样性
papers.authors: Shanshan Xu, Santosh T.Y.S.S, Barbara Plank
papers.abstract: Human Label Variation (HLV) refers to legitimate disagreement in annotation that reflects the diversity of human perspectives rather than mere error. Long treated in NLP as \textit{noise} to be eliminated, HLV has only recently been reframed as a \textit{signal} for improving model robustness. With the rise of large language models (LLMs) and post-training methods such as human feedback-based alignment, the role of HLV has become increasingly consequential. Yet current preference-learning datasets routinely collapse multiple annotations into a single label, flattening diverse perspectives into artificial consensus. Preserving HLV is necessary not only for pluralistic alignment but also for sociotechnical safety evaluation, where model behavior must be assessed in relation to human interaction and societal context.This position paper argues that preserving HLV as an embodiment of human pluralism must be treated as a \textit{Selbstzweck}, an intrinsic value in itself. We analyze the limitations of existing preference datasets and propose actionable strategies for incorporating HLV into dataset construction to better preserve pluralistic human values.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类标签变异（HLV）指的是在注释中存在的合理分歧，这种分歧反映了人类观点的多样性，而非单纯的错误。长期以来，在自然语言处理领域，HLV被视作需要消除的“噪声”。然而，最近人们开始将HLV视为提升模型鲁棒性的“信号”。随着大语言模型的发展以及基于人类反馈的后期训练方法的出现，HLV的重要性日益凸显。不过，目前用于偏好学习的数据集通常会将多个注释合并为单一的标签，从而将多样化的观点转化为人为的共识。保留HLV不仅对于实现多元对齐至关重要，对于社会技术安全评估也非常重要，因为模型的行为必须结合人类互动和社会背景来进行评估。本文认为，将HLV作为人类多元性的体现加以保留，应当被视为一种内在的价值。我们分析了现有偏好数据集的局限性，并提出了一些可行的策略，以在数据集构建过程中更好地保留多元的人类价值观。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Rethinking Assessments of Prompt Injection Attacks
papers.title_zh: 重新思考对提示注入攻击的评估方法
papers.authors: Chi Cui, Yixin Wu, Michael Backes, Yang Zhang
papers.abstract: Prompt injection attacks are recognized as one of the primary risks faced by LLM-integrated applications in recent years. However, common evaluation frameworks remain insufficient, lacking comprehensiveness and real-world relevance. To bridge this gap, we revisit the common evaluation framework and conduct an extensive evaluation across eight different evaluation settings, including 37 real-world applications, 185 injected tasks, 21 attack instructions, and a total of 143,745 queries. The evaluation highlights several findings. For example, real-world applications are more vulnerable to prompt injection attacks compared to those used in research settings. While complex attack instructions are more sophisticated, they are less effective than simple attack instructions. We further conduct an assessment of both prompt-level and model-level defense mechanisms and highlight their limitations in real-world applications. By exploring more diverse scenarios across different dimensions, our framework provides a solid foundation for assessing vulnerabilities in LLM-integrated applications and evaluating the efficacy of defensive strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 提示注入攻击被认为是近年来与LLM集成应用相关的主要风险之一。然而，常见的评估框架仍然不够完善，缺乏全面性和实际相关性。为了填补这一空白，我们重新审视了常用的评估框架，并在包括37个实际应用、185个注入任务、21条攻击指令以及总计143,745次查询在内的8种不同评估环境中进行了广泛的评估。评估结果显示了一些重要发现：例如，与研究环境中的用例相比，实际应用更容易受到提示注入攻击的威胁；虽然复杂的攻击指令更为复杂，但其效果却不如简单的攻击指令。我们还对提示级和模型级的防御机制进行了评估，并指出了它们在实际应用中的局限性。通过探索更多不同维度的场景，我们的框架为评估与LLM集成应用的漏洞以及评估防御策略的有效性提供了坚实的基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
