papers.title: SegDRE: A Salient Entity Guided Approach to Document-Level Relation Extraction
papers.title_zh: SegDRE：一种以特定实体为引导的文档级关系提取方法
papers.authors: Xing Yang, Chengxiang Tan
papers.abstract: In Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE), relational facts are typically organized around a few salient entities. Explicitly capturing this topological structure is pivotal to addressing the two critical bottlenecks of the task: the extreme class imbalance and the complexity of multi-hop reasoning. Based on this insight, we first introduce the concept of the salient entity and propose a novel approach that decouples the extraction space into dense and sparse scenarios. Specifically, our approach restricts the search space for dense pairs to mitigate the dominance of the negative samples, and innovatively injects the rich semantic knowledge of salient entities to explicitly reconstruct the document for bridging disjoint evidence in multi-hop reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach yields consistent improvements over various backbone models and achieves advanced performance compared to existing enhancement methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 在文档级关系提取任务中，关系事实通常围绕一些显著的实体进行组织。明确捕捉这种拓扑结构对于解决该任务的两个关键瓶颈至关重要：极端类别不平衡以及多跳推理的复杂性问题。基于这一洞察，我们首先引入了显著实体的概念，并提出了一种新颖的方法，将提取空间划分为密集场景和稀疏场景。具体来说，我们的方法限制了密集对搜索空间的范围，以缓解负样本的主导作用；同时，我们创新性地融入了显著实体的丰富语义知识，从而能够明确地重构文档结构，从而在多跳推理中连接不相关的证据。大量的实验表明，我们的方法能够在各种基准模型上取得持续的改进，并且其性能优于现有的增强方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Live-Aid: A Large-Scale Dialogue Dataset and Benchmark for Interleaved Multi-party Interactions in Live Streaming
papers.title_zh: Live-Aid：一个大规模的交谈数据集，适用于实时流媒体中多方互动的测试场景
papers.authors: Yiming Lei, Yize Fan, Zeming Liu, Jiaji Dong, Hui Qiu, Haitao Leng, Qingjie Liu, Kehai Chen, Tingting Gao, Yunhong Wang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved significant success in understanding static pre-recorded video scenarios (e.g., event-centric or narrative-driven content). However, existing MLLMs are largely trained on datasets restricted to static content due to the scarcity of high-quality interleaved data, causing them to struggle with dynamic interactions. Distinct from pre-recorded videos, live streaming is characterized by high-density, interleaved multimodal turns, where viewer comments (danmaku) are tightly coupled with real-time audio-visual evidence and evolving dialogue context. In such settings, purely textual annotations fail to capture fine-grained visual and temporal dependencies. To bridge this gap, we introduce Live-Aid, the first large-scale interleaved live interaction Chinese dataset with human-annotated, temporally aligned video responses, spanning over 1,100 hours and 80,037 dialogue turns across 8,053 video sessions. Building on this, we leverage these high-quality annotations within a novel multi-agent pipeline to construct evaluation tasks targeting core capabilities of live interactions. Extensive evaluations of strong Video-LLMs and Omni-LLMs reveal critical limitations in interleaved multi-turn interactions requiring temporal reasoning, highlighting the value of Live-Aid in advancing interleaved multimodal reasoning and dynamic audio-visual dependencies.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在多模态大语言模型领域取得的进展，在理解静态预录制视频场景方面取得了显著成果（例如以事件或叙事为核心的内容）。然而，现有的多模态大语言模型大多是在仅限于静态内容的数据集上训练的，由于高质量的交织数据稀缺，这些模型在处理动态交互时存在困难。与预录制视频不同，直播的特点在于高密度的、交织的多模态对话，其中观众评论与实时音视频证据以及不断变化的对话上下文紧密关联。在这种环境下，单纯的文本注释无法捕捉到细微的视觉和时间依赖性。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了Live-Aid——首个大规模的交织式直播互动中文数据集，该数据集包含人类标注的、时间对齐的视频回应，总时长超过1,100小时，包含80,037个对话回合，涉及8,053个视频会话。在此基础上，我们利用这些高质量的注释，通过一种新颖的多智能体流程来构建评估任务，以针对直播互动的核心能力进行评估。对强大的视频语言模型和全模态语言模型进行的广泛评估表明，交织式多轮对话中存在一些关键限制，这些限制需要时间推理能力，这凸显了Live-Aid在促进交织式多模态推理和动态音视频依赖关系方面的价值。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Diseased Detection from Speech Dialogues with Multi-Level Data Modeling
papers.title_zh: 基于语音对话的半监督疾病检测方法——结合多层数据建模技术
papers.authors: Xingyuan Li, Mengyue Wu
papers.abstract: Detecting medical conditions from speech acoustics is fundamentally a weakly-supervised learning problem: a single, often noisy, session-level label must be linked to nuanced patterns within a long, complex audio recording. This task is further hampered by severe data scarcity and the subjective nature of clinical annotations. While semi-supervised learning (SSL) offers a viable path to leverage unlabeled data, existingaudio methods often fail to address the core challenge that pathological traits are not uniformly expressed in a patient’s speech. We propose a novel, audio-only SSL framework that explicitly models this hierarchy by jointly learning from frame-level, segment-level, and session-level representations within unsegmented clinical dialogues. Our end-to-end approach dynamically aggregates these multi-granularity features and generates high-quality pseudo-labels to efficiently utilize unlabeled data. Extensive experiments show the framework is model-agnostic, robust across languages and conditions, and highly data-efficient—achieving, for instance, 90% of fully-supervised performance using only 11 labeled samples. This work provides a principled approach to learning from weak, far-end supervision in medical speech analysis.The code is available at https://github.com/fispresent/semi_pathological.
papers.abstract_zh: 从语音声学特征中检测医学状况本质上是一个弱监督学习问题：需要将一个单一的、通常带有噪声的会话级标签与长而复杂的音频录音中的细微模式联系起来。这一任务还受到数据极度匮乏以及临床注释主观性的严重限制。虽然半监督学习为利用未标记数据提供了可行的方法，但现有的音频处理方法往往无法解决一个核心难题，即病理特征在患者的语音中并不具有一致性表达。我们提出了一种全新的仅基于音频的半监督学习框架，该框架通过联合学习未分割的临床对话中的帧级、片段级和会话级特征，从而明确建模这种层次结构。我们的端到端方法能够动态整合这些多粒度特征，并生成高质量的伪标签，以有效利用未标记数据。大量实验表明，该框架具有模型不依赖性、跨语言和条件的鲁棒性，并且具有很高的数据效率——例如，仅使用11个标记样本就能达到完全监督情况下的90%性能。这项工作为医学语音分析中从弱监督数据中学习提供了一种原则性的方法。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/fispresent/semi_pathological。

papers.title: From Isolated Scoring to Collaborative Ranking: A Comparison-Native Framework for LLM-Based Paper Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 从孤立的评分方式到协作式排名机制：一种基于大语言模型的论文评估框架比较
papers.authors: Pujun Zheng, Jiacheng Yao, Jinquan Zheng, Chenyang Gu, Guoxiu He, Jiawei Liu, Yong Huang, Tianrui Guo, Wei Lu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are currently applied to scientific paper evaluation by assigning an absolute score to each paper independently. However, since score scales vary across conferences, time periods, and evaluation criteria, models trained on absolute scores are prone to fitting narrow, context-specific rules rather than developing robust scholarly judgment. To overcome this limitation, we propose shifting paper evaluation from isolated scoring to collaborative ranking. In particular, we design a \textbf{C}omparison-\textbf{N}ative framework for \textbf{P}aper \textbf{E}valuation (\textbf{CNPE}), integrating comparison into both data construction and model learning. We first propose a graph-based similarity ranking algorithm to facilitate the sampling of more informative and discriminative paper pairs from a collection. We then enhance relative quality judgment through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with comparison-based rewards. At inference, the model performs pairwise comparisons over sampled paper pairs and aggregates these preference signals into a global relative quality ranking. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves an average relative improvement of \textbf{21.8}% over the strong baseline DeepReview-14B, while exhibiting robust generalization to five previously unseen datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/ECNU-Text-Computing/ComparisonReview.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，大语言模型被用于科学论文的评估，方法是为每篇论文单独分配一个绝对分数。然而，由于不同会议、时期和评估标准的评分标准各不相同，基于绝对分数训练的模型容易遵循狭隘且特定于上下文的规则，而无法形成稳健的学术判断。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了将论文评估从孤立评分转变为协作排名的方法。具体来说，我们设计了一个“比较本源”框架来进行论文评估，该框架将数据构建和模型学习都融入了比较机制。我们首先提出了一种基于图的相似性排名算法，以便从大量论文中筛选出更具信息量和区分性的论文对。接着，我们通过基于比较的奖励进行有监督的微调以及强化学习，来提高相对质量判断的能力。在推理阶段，模型会对选出的论文对进行成对比较，并将这些偏好信号汇总成全局的相对质量排名。实验结果表明，我们的框架相比强大的基线模型DeepReview-14B，平均提升了21.8%的相对质量，同时还能很好地泛化到五个之前未见过的数据集上。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/ECNU-Text-Computing/ComparisonReview下载。

papers.title: UnAC: Adaptive Visual Prompting with Abstraction and Stepwise Checking for Complex Multimodal Reasoning
papers.title_zh: UnAC：基于抽象化和逐步验证的适应性视觉提示技术，适用于复杂的多模态推理任务
papers.authors: Yifan Wang, Yun Fu
papers.abstract: Recent large multimodal models (LMMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in image understanding, yet they still struggle to perform complex reasoning on challenging multimodal problems. In this paper, we present UnAC (Understanding, Abstracting, and Checking), a multimodal prompting method that strengthens reasoning for complex multimodal tasks in LMMs (e.g., GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5, and GPT-4V). To improve image understanding and capture fine details, we propose an adaptive visual prompting strategy that enables LMMs to focus on salient regions. We further design an image-abstraction prompt to effectively extract key information from images. In addition, we introduce a gradual self-checking scheme that improves reasoning by verifying each decomposed subquestion and its answer. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks—MathVista, MM-Vet, and MMMU—demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近出现的大型多模态模型在图像理解方面展现出了令人印象深刻的性能，然而它们在处理复杂多模态问题时仍然存在困难。在本文中，我们提出了UnAC（理解、抽象和验证）这一多模态提示方法，该方法能够增强多模态任务中的推理能力，适用于GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5和GPT-4V等大型多模态模型。为了提升图像理解能力并捕捉细节信息，我们提出了一种自适应视觉提示策略，使模型能够专注于重要区域。此外，我们还设计了一种图像抽象提示机制，以便从图像中提取关键信息。另外，我们引入了渐进式自我检查方案，通过验证每个子问题及其答案来提升推理能力。在MathVista、MM-Vet和MMMU这三个公共基准测试上的广泛实验证明了我们方法的有效性。

papers.title: AnalystBench: Benchmarking professional long-form report generation with web-mined multimodal tasks
papers.title_zh: AnalystBench：利用网络挖掘的多模态任务来生成专业级长格式报告的工具评测报告
papers.authors: Chau Minh Pham, Zichao Wang, Puneet Mathur, Alexa Siu, Akriti Jain, Aparna Garimella, Ananya B. Sai, Nedim Lipka, Mohit Iyyer, Varun Manjunatha
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to draft long-form multimodal documents, but their end-to-end performance on professional report generation remains systematically understudied. We introduce AnalystBench, a continually extensible benchmark of 20 real-world report generation tasks grounded in multimodal document collections, where models must process millions of input tokens to produce long-form professional reports. Using expert-validated quality checklists and groundedness evaluation, we evaluate LLMs and coding agents and find that the best model, GPT-5.1, scores highly on executive summarization tasks (exceeding 90% on quality checklists) but degrades substantially on tasks requiring long-horizon synthesis over large inputs (dropping to 25-40%). Agent-based generation substantially benefits strong closed-source models such as GPT-5.1, with checklist scores improving by 20.24 percentage points and visual coverage by 37.41 points over vanilla generation, but offers little or negative gains for open-source models like DeepSeek-R1 (-3.02 points). Expert reviewers note that while generated reports are grounded and clearly separate factual description from interpretation, they often fall short in actionability, clarity, and quantitative precision, which highlights the gap between system performance and real-world professional needs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于生成长篇多模态文档，但其在专业报告生成方面的端到端性能仍然没有得到充分研究。我们推出了AnalystBench这一不断扩展的基准测试平台，该平台包含20种基于多模态文档集的专业报告生成任务，模型需要处理数百万个输入token以生成长篇专业报告。通过专家验证的质量检查表和基于真实数据的评估方法，我们对大语言模型和编码代理进行了评估。结果表明，最好的模型GPT-5.1在执行摘要任务方面表现优异（在质量检查表上的得分超过90%），但在需要长时间跨大量数据进行合成的任务上表现下降，得分降至25-40%。基于代理的生成方式对强大的闭源模型如GPT-5.1有显著优势，其得分提高了20.24个百分点，视觉覆盖度也提升了37.41个百分点，但对于像DeepSeek-R1这样的开源模型来说，这种方式的提升很小甚至为负（-3.02个百分点）。专家评审员指出，虽然生成的报告具有真实性，并且事实描述与解释之间有明确的区分，但它们在实用性、清晰度和定量精度方面往往不尽如人意，这凸显了系统性能与现实世界专业需求之间的差距。

papers.title: BizCompass: Benchmarking the Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs in Business Knowledge and Applications
papers.title_zh: BizCompass：在商业知识和应用领域中评估大语言模型推理能力的最佳实践
papers.authors: Jianing Hao, Yuhe Wu, Yuanjian Xu, Shichang Meng, Shuai Yuan, Wei Zeng, Zixuan Wang, Guang Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) hold great promise for business applications, yet business analysis remains inherently complex, demanding rigorous reasoning and the integration of diverse knowledge sources. Existing benchmarks typically target narrow tasks and thus leave a fundamental question unanswered: how can LLMs be reliably applied in business, and how are these applications grounded in underlying theoretical capabilities? To address this gap, we introduce BizCompass, a benchmark explicitly designed to connect theoretical foundations with practical business knowledge and applications. At the knowledge level, BizCompass covers four core domains—finance, economics, statistics, and operations management. At the application level, it structures tasks around three representative roles: the analyst, the trader, and the consultant. This dual-axis design not only exposes performance differences across realistic scenarios but also diagnoses which foundational capabilities enable or constrain success. We systematically evaluate both open-source and commercial LLMs, revealing how theoretical knowledge translates into practical performance in business. The results provide actionable insights for model selection and training optimization in real-world business contexts. All datasets and evaluation code are publicly released to support reproducibility and future research: https://bizcompass.dev.ypemc.com.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在商业应用中具有巨大的潜力，但商业分析本身却非常复杂，需要严谨的推理能力以及多种知识来源的整合。现有的评估基准通常针对的是特定任务，因此存在一个基本问题尚未得到解答：如何可靠地将大语言模型应用于商业领域？这些应用又是如何建立在相应的理论基础之上的呢？为了填补这一空白，我们推出了BizCompass这一评估基准，该基准旨在将理论基础与实际商业知识与应用相结合。在知识层面，BizCompass涵盖了四个核心领域：金融、经济学、统计学和运营管理。在应用层面，它围绕分析师、交易员和顾问这三个角色来构建任务结构。这种双轴设计不仅揭示了不同现实场景下的性能差异，还能诊断出哪些基础能力能够促成或限制成功。我们对开源和商业大语言模型进行了系统性的评估，揭示了理论知识如何转化为实际商业中的表现。这些结果为实际商业环境中的模型选择和训练优化提供了有价值的见解。所有数据集和评估代码均已公开，以支持可复现性和后续研究：https://bizcompass.dev.ypemc.com

papers.title: When More Thinking Hurts: Overthinking in LLM Test-Time Compute Scaling
papers.title_zh: 当过度思考带来痛苦时：大型语言模型在测试阶段的计算扩展问题
papers.authors: Shu Zhou, Rui Ling, Junan Chen, Xin Wang, Tao Fan, Hao Wang
papers.abstract: Scaling test-time compute through extended chains of thought has become a dominant paradigm for improving large language model reasoning. However, existing research implicitly assumes that longer thinking always yields better results. This assumption remains largely unexamined. We systematically investigate how the marginal utility of additional reasoning tokens changes as compute budgets increase. We find that marginal returns diminish substantially at higher budgets and that models exhibit overthinking, where extended reasoning is associated with abandoning previously correct answers. Furthermore, we show that optimal thinking length varies across problem difficulty, suggesting that uniform compute allocation is suboptimal. Our cost-aware evaluation framework reveals that stopping at moderate budgets can reduce computation significantly while maintaining comparable accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过延长思考时间来提升计算能力，已成为改进大语言模型推理能力的主流方法。然而，现有研究通常隐含地认为，更长的思考过程总能带来更好的结果。这一假设在很大程度上尚未得到充分验证。我们系统地研究了随着计算资源增加，额外的推理信息所带来的边际效用如何变化。我们发现，在较高的计算资源下，边际收益会显著下降，而且模型会出现过度思考的现象，即冗长的推理会导致放弃之前正确的答案。此外，我们还发现，最佳的思考时长会因问题的难度而有所不同，这表明均匀分配计算资源并不是最优策略。我们的成本意识评估框架表明，在保持相当准确性的前提下，适当限制计算资源的使用可以大幅减少计算量。

papers.title: Learning from Failures: Error Notebook-guided Secure Code Generation
papers.title_zh: 从失败中学习：基于错误日志的安全代码生成方法
papers.authors: Xinyu Zhong, Peng Lan, Zhifang Liao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated a remarkable ability in code generation, yet ensuring the security and functionality of the produced code remains a critical challenge. Existing security code generation methods often rely solely on abstract security knowledge, typically resulting in a suboptimal trade-off: they either produce code with lingering vulnerabilities due to insufficient guidance or sacrifice functionality for the sake of absolute security. To address this limitation, we propose SAFENOTE, a novel framework that integrates a Security Error Notebook and a Function Error Notebook to transform failure experiences into concrete, actionable guidance. This method facilitates a form of contrastive guidance during inference, effectively steering the LLMs away from identified vulnerabilities while preserving functional correctness. Extensive experiment results across five LLMs on CodeGuard+ and LiveCodeBench benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Specifically, SAFENOTE achieves a substantial leap in SP@1 metric, with GPT-4o-mini performance improving from 60.21% to 66.7% on CodeGuard+. Furthermore, SAFENOTE provides security and functional guidance that generalizes effectively to “unseen” CWE scenarios, significantly outperforming existing baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成方面展现出了惊人的能力，但如何确保生成的代码具有安全性与功能性仍然是一个关键挑战。现有的安全代码生成方法往往仅依赖于抽象的安全知识，这往往会导致最优化的权衡问题：要么因为指导不足而产生存在漏洞的代码，要么为了绝对的安全性而牺牲了代码的实用性。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了SAFENOTE框架。该框架整合了安全错误记录簿和函数错误记录簿，能够将失败经验转化为具体、可操作的指导方案。这种方法在推理过程中提供了一种对比性指导机制，有效引导语言模型避开已识别的漏洞，同时保持代码的实用性。通过在CodeGuard+和LiveCodeBench基准测试中对五款语言模型进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法非常有效。具体来说，SAFENOTE在SP@1指标上取得了显著的提升，GPT-4o-mini在CodeGuard+上的性能从60.21%提升到了66.7%。此外，SAFENOTE所提供的安全性和功能性指导能够很好地适用于“未见过的”CWE场景，其表现明显优于现有的基线方法。

papers.title: Evaluating Reasoning Models for Queries with Presuppositions
papers.title_zh: 评估基于前提条件的查询推理模型
papers.authors: Rose Sathyanathan, Kinshuk Vasisht, Danish Pruthi
papers.abstract: Millions of users turn to AI models for their information needs. It is conceivable that a large number of user queries contain assumptions that may be factually inaccurate. Prior work notes that large language models (LLMs) often fail to challenge such erroneous assumptions, and can reinforce users’ misinformed opinions. However, given the recent advances, especially in model’s reasoning capabilities, we revisit whether large reasoning models (LRMs) can reason about the underlying assumptions and respond to user queries appropriately. We construct queries with varying degrees of presuppositions spanning health, science, and general knowledge, and use it to evaluate several widely-deployed models When compared to non-reasoning models, we find that reasoning models achieve a slightly higher accuracy (2-11%), but they still fail to challenge a large fraction (26-42%) of false presuppositions. Further, reasoning models remain susceptible to how strongly the presupposition is expressed.
papers.abstract_zh: 数百万用户将人工智能模型作为获取信息的途径。可以想象，许多用户的查询中都包含了一些可能并不准确的假设。先前的研究指出，大语言模型往往无法纠正这些错误的假设，反而可能会强化用户错误的认知。然而，鉴于最近在模型推理能力方面的进展，我们重新审视了大型推理模型是否能够对这些假设进行推理，并能够恰当地回应用户的查询。我们设计了包含不同程度预设的查询，涉及健康、科学以及一般知识领域，并使用这些查询来评估几款广泛使用的模型。与不进行推理的模型相比，我们发现推理模型在准确性上略高（2%-11%），但仍然无法纠正很大一部分错误假设（26%-42%）。此外，推理模型对预设的强烈程度也较为敏感。

papers.title: GRE Score: Generative Risk Evaluation for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: GRE考试分数：大型语言模型的风险评估方法
papers.authors: Zaitang LI, Pin-Yu Chen, Tsung-Yi Ho
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized generative tasks, but concerns about their trustworthiness and vulnerability to adversarial attacks persist. This paper introduces the Generative Robustness Evaluation (GRE) Score, a novel metric designed to assess LLMs’ resilience against adversarial red teaming attempts that may compromise model compliance and elicit undesired responses. Our approach utilizes conditional generation for synthetic text creation, offering an attack-independent evaluation of LLM robustness. By calculating the margin in refusal scores, we quantify the robustness of LLMs in an attack-agnostic manner. We evaluate our method on five dimensions with specified datasets, encompassing ethical considerations, safety protocols, and potential misuse scenarios. We present four contributions: (1) The GRE Score framework, which establishes a textual robustness certificate for LLMs against adversarial red teaming attempts, providing a theoretical foundation for quantifying model resilience. (2) Comprehensive evaluations across five dimensions using eight prominent LLMs, validating GRE Scores with adversarial red teaming attacks. Our method demonstrates a consistent ranking of LLM robustness when compared to the attack-based model ranking on TrustLLM (CITATION) while achieving a significant 5-8x speedup compared to traditional evaluation techniques. (3) Insights into the non-linear relationship between model scaling and performance, revealing that larger models do not always perform better, and an analysis of how instruction-tuning impacts robustness across LLMs. (4) The discovery that all evaluated LLMs exhibit lower performance in robustness and privacy tasks compared to other areas, highlighting a critical gap in capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）彻底改变了生成任务，但人们对它们的可信度和抵御对抗性攻击的能力仍心存疑虑。本文介绍了“生成鲁棒性评估”指标，这是一种新的评估方法，旨在衡量LLM在应对可能破坏模型合规性并引发不良响应的对抗性攻击时的韧性。我们的方法采用条件生成技术来创建合成文本，从而实现对LLM鲁棒性的独立评估。通过计算拒绝得分的差距，我们可以以与攻击无关的方式量化LLM的鲁棒性。我们在五个维度上评估了我们的方法，并使用了指定的数据集，涵盖了伦理考量、安全协议以及潜在的滥用场景。我们提出了四个贡献点：(1) “生成鲁棒性评估”框架为LLM提供了针对对抗性攻击的鲁棒性证书，为量化模型韧性提供了理论基础。(2) 使用八种主流LLM在五个维度上进行全面评估，验证了在对抗性攻击下的评估结果。(3) 揭示了模型规模与性能之间的非线性关系，发现较大的模型并不总是表现更好，同时分析了指令调整对LLM鲁棒性的影响。(4) 研究发现，所有被评估的LLM在鲁棒性和隐私性方面的表现都比其他领域要差，这凸显了能力上的关键差距。

papers.title: MSVBench: Towards Human-Level Evaluation of Multi-Shot Video Generation
papers.title_zh: MSVBench：迈向多镜头视频生成的人类水平评估
papers.authors: Haoyuan Shi, Yunxin li, Nanhao Deng, Zhenran Xu, Xinyu Chen, Longyue Wang, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: The evolution of video generation toward complex, multi-shot narratives has exposed a critical deficit in current evaluation methods. Existing benchmarks remain anchored to single-shot paradigms, lacking the comprehensive story assets and cross-shot metrics required to assess long-form coherence and appeal. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{MSVBench}, the first comprehensive benchmark featuring hierarchical scripts and reference images tailored for \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{S}hot \textbf{V}ideo generation. We propose a hybrid evaluation framework that synergizes the high-level semantic reasoning of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) with the fine-grained perceptual rigor of domain-specific expert models. Evaluating 20 video generation methods across diverse paradigms, we find that current models—despite strong visual fidelity—primarily behave as visual interpolators rather than true world models. We further validate the reliability of our benchmark by demonstrating a state-of-the-art Spearman’s rank correlation of \textbf{0.944} with human judgments. Finally, MSVBench extends beyond evaluation by providing a scalable supervisory signal. Fine-tuning a lightweight model on its pipeline-refined reasoning traces yields human-aligned performance comparable to commercial models like Gemini-2.5-Flash.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频生成技术向复杂、多镜头叙事方向的演进，暴露了当前评估方法存在的重大缺陷。现有的基准测试仍然基于单镜头范式，缺乏评估长篇视频连贯性和吸引力的全面故事资源和跨镜头指标。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了**MSVBench**，这是首个针对多镜头视频生成的综合性基准测试，该测试包含分层脚本和参考图像。我们提出了一种混合评估框架，将大型多模态模型的高层次语义推理能力与特定领域专家模型的精细感知能力相结合。通过对20种不同范式的视频生成方法进行评估，我们发现，尽管当前模型在视觉保真度方面表现优异，但它们主要充当的是视觉插值器，而非真正的世界模型。我们通过展示与人类判断的Spearman等级相关性为**0.944**的结果，进一步验证了该基准测试的可靠性。最后，MSVBench不仅提供评估功能，还具备可扩展的监督信号功能。通过在一个经过管道优化的轻量级模型上进行微调，可以获得与人类水平相当的性能，甚至可以与Gemini-2.5-Flash等商业模型相媲美。

papers.title: M-TRACE: Detecting and Mitigating Time-Anchor Drift via Step-wise Conflict Checking in Temporal Reasoning
papers.title_zh: M-TRACE：通过逐步冲突检查在时间推理中检测并缓解时间基准漂移问题
papers.authors: Danyu Huang, Jiayuan Jiang, Yao Zhang, Jun Wang, Huijia Li, Zhenglu Yang
papers.abstract: As the real world continuously evolves, temporal facts change over time, requiring large language models to simultaneously rely on internal parametric knowledge and externally retrieved evidence for temporal reasoning. However, external knowledge may be inaccurate, while internal knowledge can become outdated. Temporal inconsistencies between these heterogeneous sources can accumulate during multi-step reasoning, leading to Time-Anchor Drift (TAD)—a phenomenon where an incorrect temporal reference is established early and subsequently propagated, ultimately causing reasoning failure. To address this issue, we propose M-TRACE, a multi-agent reasoning framework for temporal knowledge conflicts. M-TRACE explicitly maintains a State Timeline to perform step-wise temporal alignment and coexistence checks between internal states and external evidence. Detected conflicts are summarized into a structured Conflict Report, which guides conflict-aware final reasoning. We further introduce TimeConfQA, a temporal question answering benchmark with controlled temporal knowledge conflicts. Experimental results show that M-TRACE effectively reduces time-anchor drift and consistently improves performance on complex temporal question answering tasks, demonstrating the value of explicit conflict modeling for temporal reasoning. The code can be found at https://github.com/h-yii/M-TRACE.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着现实世界不断演变，时间事实也会随时间发生变化。这就要求大语言模型既要依赖内部的参数化知识，又要利用外部获取的证据来进行时间推理。然而，外部知识可能存在不准确的情况，而内部知识则可能变得过时。在多步推理过程中，这些不同来源的时间信息可能会出现不一致的情况，从而导致“时间锚点漂移”现象——即早期建立的错误时间参考会被持续传播，最终导致推理失败。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了M-TRACE这一多智能体推理框架，用于处理时间知识冲突问题。M-TRACE通过维护状态时间线，能够逐步进行内部状态与外部证据之间的时间对齐和共存检查。检测到的冲突会被整理成结构化的冲突报告，从而指导后续的推理过程。此外，我们还引入了TimeConfQA这一基于时间知识冲突的问答基准测试。实验结果表明，M-TRACE能够有效减少时间锚点漂移的影响，并在复杂的时序问答任务中持续提升性能，这充分证明了明确建模时间冲突对于时间推理的重要性。相关代码可以在https://github.com/h-yii/M-TRACE找到。

papers.title: Faithful Persona Steering under Incongruity via Dual-Stream Refinement
papers.title_zh: 通过双流优化来应对不和谐情境的忠实角色设定指导方法
papers.authors: Yu-An Chu, Jen-Ren Pong, Chia-Yao Yeh, Meng-Fen Chiang
papers.abstract: Standard LLM personalization typically frames identity as a static retrieval task, overlooking the inherent incongruity of human personas, where stable traits coexist with atypical, context-specific stances. Existing methods struggle to reconcile these dimensions: prompting succumbs to context drift over long sequences, while fine-tuning often suppresses idiosyncratic “quirks” in favor of generic distributional patterns. To bridge this gap, we present QuirkyMind, a framework that disentangles identity definition from its expression. First, Traits Anchoring constructs a dual-stream latent state, fusing a sentence-level summary for semantic stability with a token-level sequence for generative control. This state is stabilized via In-Context Narrative Refinement using an alternating objective: a discriminative InfoNCE loss anchors the persona in representation space to prevent drift, while a generative cross-entropy loss ensures faithful verbalization. Finally, Persona Steered Generalization transfers the refined state to downstream tasks via parameter-efficient adapters. Empirical evaluations on Persona-Steered QA and Narrative Inference demonstrate that QuirkyMind mitigates drift, consolidating persona knowledge without erasing authentic incongruities.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准的大语言模型个性化处理通常将身份概念视为一个静态的检索任务，而忽略了人类角色之间存在的固有矛盾性——即稳定特质与非典型的、特定于上下文的立场并存。现有的方法难以同时处理这两种特性：在长序列中，提示过程容易受到上下文变化的影响；而在微调过程中，往往会忽略角色的独特“怪癖”，而倾向于追求通用的分布模式。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了QuirkyMind框架。该框架将身份定义与其表达方式分离开来。首先，Trait Anchoring机制构建了一个双流潜在状态，它将句子级别的语义稳定性与令牌级别的生成控制相结合。这个状态通过In-Context Narrative Refinement得到稳定化，其目标包括两个方面：判别性InfoNCE损失用于将角色定位在表示空间中，以防止其发生变化；而生成式交叉熵损失则确保角色的表达方式保持真实。最后，Persona Steered Generalization机制通过参数高效的适配器将经过优化的状态转移到下游任务中。在Persona-Steered QA和叙事推理方面的实证评估表明，QuirkyMind能够有效减少上下文变化的影响，同时巩固角色知识，而不会消除真实的矛盾性。

papers.title: ChemVLR: Prioritizing Reasoning in Perception for Chemical Vision-Language Understanding
papers.title_zh: ChemVLR：在化学视觉-语言理解中优先考虑推理在感知中的作用
papers.authors: Xuanle Zhao, Xinyuan Cai, Xiang Cheng, Xiuyi Chen, Bo XU
papers.abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in chemical visual understanding, current models are predominantly optimized for direct visual question-answering tasks. This paradigm often results in “black-box” systems that fail to utilize the inherent capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to infer underlying reaction mechanisms. In this work, we introduce ChemVLR, a chemical VLM designed to prioritize reasoning within the perception process. Unlike conventional chemical VLMs, ChemVLR analyzes visual inputs in a fine-grained manner by explicitly identifying granular chemical descriptors, such as functional groups, prior to generating answers. This approach ensures the production of explicit and interpretable reasoning paths for complex visual chemical problems. To facilitate this methodology, we implement a cross-modality reverse-engineering strategy combined with a rigorous filtering pipeline to curate a large-scale reasoning and caption dataset, comprising 760k high-quality samples across molecular and reaction tasks. Furthermore, we adopt a three-stage training framework that systemically builds model perception and reasoning capacity. Experiments demonstrate that ChemVLR achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, surpassing both leading proprietary models and domain-specific open-source baselines. We also provide comprehensive ablation studies to validate our training strategy and data generation designs.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然视觉语言模型在化学图像理解方面展现出巨大潜力，但目前的模型主要被优化用于直接的视觉问答任务。这种范式往往导致系统呈现“黑箱”特性，无法充分利用大语言模型推断潜在反应机制的能力。在这项研究中，我们提出了ChemVLR这一化学视觉语言模型，它的设计目的是在感知过程中优先进行推理。与传统的化学视觉语言模型不同，ChemVLR通过明确识别诸如官能团等精细的化学描述符来细致分析视觉输入，然后再生成答案。这种方法能够确保为复杂的视觉化学问题生成清晰且可解释的推理路径。为了支持这一方法，我们采用了一种跨模态逆向工程策略，并结合了严格的过滤流程来构建大规模推理和标题数据集，该数据集包含76万个高质量样本，涵盖分子结构和反应过程。此外，我们还采用了三阶段训练框架，系统地提升模型的感知能力和推理能力。实验结果表明，ChemVLR取得了顶尖的性能表现，超越了现有的领先专有模型和特定领域的开源基准模型。我们还进行了全面的消融研究，以验证我们的训练策略和数据生成方案的有效性。

papers.title: SDC-LoRA: Singular-Subspace Drift Controlled LoRA to Mitigate Knowledge Forgetting
papers.title_zh: SDC-LoRA：一种基于奇异子空间漂移控制的LoRA算法，旨在缓解知识遗忘问题
papers.authors: Geyuan Zhang, Xiaofei Zhou, Shihao Liu, Jingyuan Tian, Jizheng Ma
papers.abstract: Knowledge forgetting is a central challenge when adapting LLMs to new tasks. Prior studies indicate that pretrained knowledge is concentrated in the principal singular subspace of pretrained weight W_0; so recent Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) variants initialize LoRA in the minor subspace to steer early updates away from principal directions and mitigate forgetting. However, we observe that during fine-tuning, the update direction progressively shifts from the minor to the principal subspace, which is called as Singular-subspace Drift (SD), thereby allocating more energy to the directions that carry pretrained knowledge and leaving a persistent risk of forgetting. To address this issue, we propose Singular-subspace Drift Controlled LoRA (SDC-LoRA), which constrains the growth of update energy in the principal singular subspace of W_0 and thus mitigate SD. SDC-LoRA proposes Principal Subspace Energy-Controlled Learning, using Spectral Calibration factor \gamma_{\mathrm{sc}} to selectively downscale gradients along the principal singular subspace of W_0 while keeping minor-subspace updates unchanged. Across extensive experiments with LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Chat on MetaMathQA and CodeFeedback, SDC-LoRA mitigates forgetting on MMLU, TruthfulQA, and HellaSwag while matching or improving GSM8K and HumanEval, offering a practical route to adapt LLMs without sacrificing prior knowledge.
papers.abstract_zh: 在将大语言模型适应新任务时，知识遗忘是一个核心挑战。先前的研究表明，预训练的知识主要集中在预训练权重W_0的主要单向量子上；因此，最近的低秩适应方法（LoRA）在初始化LoRA时，会将更新方向引导到次要子空间，以避免过早地朝主要方向进行更新，从而减轻遗忘问题。然而，我们在微调过程中观察到，更新方向逐渐从次要子空间转向主要子空间，这种现象被称为单向量子空间漂移（SD）。这样一来，更多的能量被分配到携带预训练知识的方向上，从而留下了持续的遗忘风险。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了单向量子空间漂移控制型LoRA（SDC-LoRA），该方法限制了更新能量在W_0的主要单向量子空间中的增长，从而减轻SD现象。SDC-LoRA采用了主子空间能量控制学习策略，通过谱校准因子γ_{\mathrm{sc}}，有选择地降低沿W_0的主要单向量子空间的梯度大小，同时保持次要子空间的更新不变。在针对MetaMathQA和CodeFeedback进行的广泛实验中，SDC-LoRA在MMLU、TruthfulQA和HellaSwag任务上的遗忘问题得到了有效缓解，同时在GSM8K和HumanEval任务上的表现与现有方法相当或有所改进，为在不牺牲先前知识的情况下适应大语言模型提供了实用的途径。

papers.title: Regret-Now: A Physics-Inspired Regret Framework for Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering with LLMs
papers.title_zh: 后悔现在：一种基于物理原理的遗憾框架，用于基于时间关系的知识图谱问答问题处理，可结合大型语言模型使用
papers.authors: Danyu Huang, Yao Zhang, Jun Wang, Zhenglu Yang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models have achieved impressive results in general reasoning tasks. However, they still face significant challenges when applied to temporal knowledge graph question answering (TKGQA), particularly exhibiting broken temporal reasoning chains and a lack of dynamic error-correction. These limitations hinder their capacity to handle complex temporal logic and make it difficult to recover once a reasoning error occurs. To address this issue, we propose Regret-Now, a novel LLM-based temporal reasoning framework inspired by the physical principle of minimum potential energy. Regret-Now models the reasoning process as a dynamic trajectory moving toward a more stable state, where each step is expected to a lower potential energy. We introduce the Regret Stage that evaluates the “potential energy” of each intermediate reasoning step and triggers real-time rollback if an abnormal rise in potential energy is detected—indicating a likely error. We evaluate Regret-Now on two standard TKGQA benchmarks: CronQuestions and MultiTQ. Experimental results show consistent gains over strong baselines, validating physics-inspired modeling for LLM-based TKGQA. The code can be found at https://github.com/h-yii/Regret-Now.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在一般推理任务上取得了令人瞩目的成果。然而，当应用于时间知识图谱问答时，它们仍然面临重大挑战，例如难以构建稳定的时间推理链，以及缺乏动态的错误修正机制。这些限制使得模型难以处理复杂的时间逻辑，一旦出现推理错误，就很难进行恢复。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Regret-Now这一基于大语言模型的新型时间推理框架。该框架借鉴了最小势能的物理原理，将推理过程建模为一条向更稳定状态发展的动态轨迹，每一步都朝着更低的势能方向前进。我们引入了“势能评估阶段”，用于评估每个中间推理步骤的“势能”，并在检测到势能异常上升时触发实时回退操作，从而及时发现可能的错误。我们在CronQuestions和MultiTQ两个标准的时间知识图谱问答基准测试中对Regret-Now进行了评估。实验结果表明，与强大的基线模型相比，Regret-Now取得了显著的性能提升，这验证了基于物理原理的LLM时间知识图谱问答建模方法的有效性。相关代码可以在https://github.com/h-yii/Regret-Now下载。

papers.title: Low-probability Tokens Sustain Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward
papers.title_zh: 在具有可验证奖励的强化学习中，低概率代币仍需要持续进行探索
papers.authors: Guanhua Huang, Tingqiang Xu, Mingze Wang, Qi Yi, Xue Gong, Siheng Li, Ruibin Xiong, Kejiao Li, Yuhao Jiang, Bo Zhou
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has propelled Large Language Models in complex reasoning, yet its scalability is often hindered by a training bottleneck where performance plateaus as policy entropy collapses, signaling a loss of exploration. While previous methods attempt to maintain high entropy, we argue that unselective entropy maximization risks amplifying irrelevant noise rather than fostering meaningful exploration. In this paper, we identify a deeper issue: the gradual elimination of valuable low-probability exploratory tokens, which we term reasoning sparks, driven by RLVR over-penalization. To address this, we introduce Low-probability Regularization (Lp-Reg). Leveraging the statistical distinction where reasoning sparks exhibit higher probabilities than noise, Lp-Reg filters out the extremely low-probability noise tokens and prevents the suppression of potentially valuable low-probability candidates. Experiments demonstrate that Lp-Reg enables stable on-policy training for over 3,000 steps (81,204 GPU-hours), sustaining exploration in regimes where baselines typically collapse. Validated across extensive evaluations totaling over 300,000 cumulative GPU-hours, Lp-Reg demonstrates highly competitive performance in off-policy settings and consistently achieves state-of-the-art results in on-policy training across diverse model families, sizes, and domains, with relative accuracy improvements ranging from 3.06% to 7.98%.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在复杂推理任务中显著提升了大语言模型的能力，但其可扩展性往往受到训练瓶颈的制约——当策略熵下降时，性能会陷入停滞，这表明探索行为有所减弱。虽然之前的方法试图维持高熵值，但我们认为，非选择性熵最大化可能会加剧无关噪声的干扰，而非促进有意义的探索。在本文中，我们发现了一个更深层次的问题：由于RLVR的过度惩罚效应，那些具有较高概率的、有价值的低概率探索性标记逐渐被消除，这些标记我们称之为“推理火花”。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了低概率正则化方法。该方法利用统计差异，即推理火花的概率高于噪声，从而过滤掉那些极低概率的噪声标记，避免可能具有重要价值的低概率候选者被忽视。实验表明，低概率正则化方法能够在超过3,000步的训练过程中保持稳定性能（相当于81,204个GPU小时），并在基线模型通常失效的情况下依然能够维持探索行为。经过超过300,000个GPU小时的广泛测试验证，低概率正则化方法在离线训练中表现出非常出色的性能，并且在多种模型类型、规模及领域中的在线训练中始终能够取得最先进的结果，其相对准确率提升了3.06%到7.98%。

papers.title: Preserving Language Capabilities in Vision-Language Models via Representation Regulation
papers.title_zh: 通过表示调控来保持视觉语言模型的语言处理能力
papers.authors: ZiXuan Chen, Juncheng Tao, Ziqian Zeng
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide a unified framework to process both text-only tasks and vision-language tasks. However, finetuning VLMs on vision-language data has degraded language capabilities. In this paper, we prove that as the training loss declines during finetuning, the visual representation and textual representation move closer to each other, a phenomenon we term “representation mixing.” We prove that the representation mixing occurring within the post-representation layers causes the degradation of language capabilities. Post-representation layers refer to the first few layers in LLMs that are involved in representation learning. To preserve the language capabilities, we propose the Representation Regulation for VLM Training (RRVLM), which introduces a Representation Distribution Difference (RDD) loss to reduce the distance between these representations. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks and VLM frameworks show that our method can effectively preserve the language capabilities and achieve superior vision-language performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）提供了一个统一的框架，用于处理仅包含文本的任务以及视觉语言任务。然而，在视觉语言数据上对VLM进行微调会导致语言能力下降。在本文中，我们证明了在微调过程中，随着训练损失的降低，视觉表示和文本表示会逐渐趋近，这种现象我们称之为“表示混合”。我们发现，这种表示混合现象发生在表示后的一些层中，从而导致语言能力的下降。所谓表示后层，指的是LLM中负责表示学习的前几个层次。为了保留语言能力，我们提出了一种名为“VLM训练中的表示调节”的方法，该方法引入了“表示分布差异”损失，以减小这些表示之间的距离。通过在各种基准测试和VLM框架上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法能够有效保留语言能力，并提升视觉语言的性能。

papers.title: Me-Agent: A Personalized Mobile Agent with Two-Level User Habit Learning for Enhanced Interaction
papers.title_zh: Me-Agent：一种个性化的移动代理，具备双层用户习惯学习功能，从而提升交互体验
papers.authors: Shuoxin Wang, Chang Liu, Gowen Loo, Lifan Zheng, Kaiwen Wei, Huanqian Yan, Xinyi Zeng, Jingyuan Zhang, Yu Tian
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based mobile agents have made significant performance advancements. However, these agents often follow explicit user instructions while overlooking personalized needs, leading to significant limitations for real users, particularly without personalized context: (1) inability to interpret ambiguous instructions, (2) lack of learning from user interaction history, and (3) failure to handle personalized instructions. To alleviate the above challenges, we propose Me-Agent, a learnable and memorable personalized mobile agent. Specifically, Me-Agent incorporates a two-level user habit learning approach. At the prompt level, we design a user preference learning strategy enhanced with a Personal Reward Model to improve personalization performance. At the memory level, we design a Hierarchical Preference Memory, which stores users’ long-term memory and app-specific memory in different level memory. To validate the personalization capabilities of mobile agents, we introduce User FingerTip, a new benchmark featuring numerous ambiguous instructions for daily life. Extensive experiments on User FingerTip and general benchmarks demonstrate that Me-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance in personalization while maintaining competitive instruction execution performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的移动智能体已经取得了显著的性能提升。然而，这些智能体通常遵循明确的用户指令，而忽视了用户的个性化需求，这给真实用户带来了很大的限制，尤其是在没有个性化上下文的情况下：(1)无法理解模糊的指令；(2)无法从用户交互历史中学习；(3)无法处理个性化的指令。为了缓解上述挑战，我们提出了Me-Agent——一种可学习且能记住用户个性化需求的移动智能体。具体来说，Me-Agent采用了两级用户习惯学习机制。在提示层面，我们设计了一种增强个人化效果的用户偏好学习策略，该策略结合了个人奖励模型。在记忆层面，我们设计了分层偏好记忆机制，将用户的长期记忆和特定于应用程序的记忆分别存储在不同的记忆层次中。为了验证移动智能体的个性化能力，我们引入了一个名为“User FingerTip”的新基准测试，该测试包含了大量日常生活中的模糊指令。在“User FingerTip”以及一般基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Me-Agent在保持指令执行性能的同时，实现了最先进的个性化效果。

papers.title: Dynamic PMI-Guided Contrastive Decoding Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models: A Unified Framework of Fine-Grained Input Transformations
papers.title_zh: 动态PMI引导的对比解码技术能够降低大型语言模型中的幻觉现象：一种针对细粒度输入转换的统一框架
papers.authors: Dongsheng Chen, Yingqi Zhu, Xingyue Zhang, Wenqing Zhou, Lei Li
papers.abstract: Despite the remarkable generation capabilities demonstrated by large language models (LLMs), the issue of hallucination remains a critical challenge. This is largely attributed to the models’ tendency to fit spurious dependencies in pre-training data rather than underlying causal logic. To address this, from an information-theoretic perspective, this paper proposes a unified contrastive decoding framework based on dynamic pointwise mutual information (Dynamic PMI). Under this framework, we design three fine-grained input transformation strategies targeting context, syntax, and semantics to construct dynamic background distributions. These strategies systematically disentangle and suppress spurious dependencies induced by context priors, lexical co-occurrences, and syntactic structures, thereby guiding the model to prioritize underlying causal logic. Experiments on extensive discriminative and generative benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly improves the model’s factuality and reasoning robustness. Notably, despite employing a single-model architecture, our framework surpasses state-of-the-art dual-model strategies while maintaining high computational efficiency. Furthermore, the framework exhibits strong cross-model generalizability and effectively alleviates the over-refusal tendency in open-ended generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型展现了卓越的生成能力，但幻觉问题仍然是一个关键挑战。这主要归因于模型在预训练数据中倾向于构建虚假的依赖性，而非基于真实的因果逻辑。为了应对这一问题，本文从信息论的角度出发，提出了一种基于动态点互信息的统一对比解码框架。在该框架下，我们设计了三种细粒度的输入转换策略，分别针对上下文、句法和语义进行处理，以构建动态背景分布。这些策略能够系统地分离并消除由上下文先验、词汇共现和句法结构引起的虚假依赖性，从而引导模型优先处理基于因果逻辑的推理过程。在广泛的判别性和生成性基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了模型的真实性和推理能力。值得注意的是，尽管采用了单模型架构，我们的框架仍优于现有的双模型策略，同时保持了较高的计算效率。此外，该框架还表现出强大的跨模型泛化能力，能够有效缓解开放性问题中的过度推理倾向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: LSEG: A Fine-tuning Free Method for NL2FOL via Logic-Structure and Entropy Guided Inference Controlling
papers.title_zh: LSEG：一种通过逻辑结构与熵引导推理来优化NL2FOL问题的免费方法
papers.authors: Yuwei Huang, Shi Wang, Kangli Zi, Tianyu Luo, Jiang Zhixiao, Ruiheng Wang, Yufei Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models have shown strong generative and reasoning capabilities, yet they still struggle with natural language to first order logic (NL2FOL) translation due to logical hallucination. We propose LSEG (Logic Structure and Entropy Guided), a fine-tuning free framework designed to improve logical consistency during inference. The core idea of LSEG is to correct hidden state deviation by leveraging logical stability across logic preserving perturbations of the input. Such deviation is especially harmful in NL2FOL, as even small drifts can flip quantifier scope or logical operators, producing formulas that are syntactically valid yet logically incorrect. First, LSEG constructs perturbation-averaged direction vectors that approximate a stable logical center. Second, it derives layer-wise correction directions by contrasting original and perturbed representations. Lastly, LSEG uses an entropy-guided adaptive mechanism to inject these directions only when the model exhibits unstable or over-confident reasoning states, thereby preserving fluency while correcting logical drift. Experiments on the FOLIO and MALLS benchmarks show that LSEG consistently improves logical equivalence scores over strong baselines, despite requiring no training or parameter updates. Further evaluation on LogicLLaMA demonstrates LSEG’s architecture-agnostic effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型展现了强大的生成能力和推理能力，但在将自然语言转换为一阶逻辑表达式时仍然存在困难，因为会出现逻辑幻觉问题。我们提出了LSEG（逻辑结构与熵引导）这一无需微调的框架，旨在在推理过程中提高逻辑一致性。LSEG的核心思想是通过利用输入数据在逻辑上的一致性来纠正隐藏状态的偏差。这种偏差在一阶逻辑表达式中尤其有害，因为即使是很小的偏移也可能导致量词范围或逻辑运算符发生改变，从而产生语法上有效但逻辑上错误的公式。首先，LSEG构建出平均化的扰动方向向量，以近似一个稳定的逻辑中心。其次，它通过对比原始表示和扰动后的表示来推导出逐层的修正方向。最后，LSEG采用一种基于熵的自适应机制，仅在模型出现不稳定或过度自信的推理状态时才注入这些修正方向，从而在纠正逻辑偏差的同时保持语言的流畅性。在FOLIO和MALLS基准测试中的实验表明，尽管LSEG不需要进行任何训练或参数更新，但它仍然能够持续提升逻辑等价性的得分，远超其他强大的基线方法。在LogicLLaMA上的进一步评估也证明了LSEG的架构无关性有效性。

papers.title: Compact Example-Based Explanations for Language Models
papers.title_zh: 语言模型的紧凑型基于示例的解释方法
papers.authors: Loris Schoenegger, Benjamin Roth
papers.abstract: Training data influence estimation methods quantify the contribution of training documents to a model’s output, making them a promising source of information for example-based explanations.As humans cannot interpret thousands of documents, only a small subset of the training data can be presented as an explanation.Although the choice of which documents to include directly affects explanation quality, previous evaluations of such systems have largely ignored any selection strategies.To address this, we propose a novel selection relevance score, a retraining-free metric that quantifies how useful a set of examples is for explaining a model’s output.We validate this score through fine-tuning experiments, confirming that it can predict whether a set of examples supports or undermines the model’s predictions.Using this metric, we further show that common selection strategies often underperform random selection. Motivated by this finding, we propose a strategy that balances influence and representativeness, enabling better use of selection budgets than naively selecting the highest-ranking examples.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练数据影响估计方法能够量化训练文档对模型输出的贡献，因此它们是基于实例进行解释的有用信息来源。由于人类无法解释成千上万的文档，所以只有一小部分训练数据可以被用作解释的依据。虽然选择哪些文档直接影响解释的质量，但之前对这些系统的评估大多忽略了选择策略的问题。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的选择相关性评分方法，这是一种无需重新训练的度量指标，可以量化一组示例在解释模型输出方面的实用性。我们通过微调实验来验证这一评分方法，确认它能够预测一组示例是支持还是削弱模型的预测结果。利用这一度量指标，我们还发现常见的选择策略往往不如随机选择效果好。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种平衡影响力和代表性的策略，从而能够更好地利用选择预算，而不是简单地选择排名最高的示例。

papers.title: MedCPI: A Construct–Personalize–Integrate Framework for KG-enhanced Clinical Prediction
papers.title_zh: MedCPI：一种用于增强临床预测的构建-个性化-整合框架
papers.authors: Hang Wang, Hang Dong, Lu Liu
papers.abstract: Electronic health records (EHRs) provide longitudinal evidence for clinical prediction, but EHR data are sparse, incomplete, and heterogeneous, which can limit robustness. Medical knowledge graphs (MKGs) have therefore been incorporated to support KG-enhanced clinical prediction by linking heterogeneous EHR codes to shared medical concepts via structured relations. However, existing KG-enhanced approaches remain limited in two aspects: (i) task-specific knowledge selection when extracting knowledge from a large multi-source MKG; and (ii) patient-level personalization and knowledge integration, where personalization is often weakly controlled and knowledge integration is not sufficiently aligned with longitudinal patient trajectories. To address these issues, we propose MedCPI, a unified Construct–Personalize–Integrate framework. MedCPI first performs task-guided schema induction and KG normalization to build a task-specific Concept MKG as a denoised knowledge pool, then constructs controlled patient-level PKGs via local expansion and short path search, and finally integrates PKG representations with time-aware EHR representations via cross-attention for prediction. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV across four clinical prediction tasks show consistent improvements over strong EHR-only and KG-enhanced baselines. Ablations and additional analyses further validate the contribution of each stage and illustrate how MedCPI utilizes structured medical knowledge.
papers.abstract_zh: 电子健康记录为临床预测提供了纵向数据支持，但电子健康记录的数据往往稀疏、不完整且异构，这可能会限制其预测结果的可靠性。因此，人们引入了医学知识图谱来辅助临床预测，通过将异构的电子健康记录代码与共享的医学概念通过结构化关系联系起来。然而，现有的基于医学知识图谱的改进方法仍存在两个方面的局限性：(1) 从大型多源医学知识图谱中提取知识时，需要针对特定任务进行知识选择；(2) 在患者层面的个性化处理和知识整合方面，个性化处理往往控制不够严格，而知识整合则未能充分与患者的长期病程保持一致。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了MedCPI这一统一的构建-个性化-整合框架。MedCPI首先执行任务引导的模式归纳和知识图谱标准化操作，以构建一个针对特定任务的医学知识图谱作为去噪后的知识库；然后通过对局部数据进行扩展和短路径搜索，构建出受控的患者级知识图谱；最后通过交叉注意力机制，将知识图谱表示与时间感知的电子健康记录表示相结合，以实现预测。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上进行的四项临床预测任务实验表明，MedCPI在性能上优于仅依赖电子健康记录或仅使用医学知识图谱的基线方法。进一步的消融研究和分析进一步验证了每个阶段的贡献，并展示了MedCPI如何利用结构化的医学知识来进行预测。

papers.title: Across Programming Language Silos: A Study on Cross-Lingual Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
papers.title_zh: 跨越编程语言壁垒：关于基于跨语言检索机制的代码生成研究
papers.authors: Qiming Zhu, Jialun Cao, Xuanang Chen, Weili Zhang, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Xianpei Han, Le Sun, Shing-Chi Cheung
papers.abstract: Current research on large language models (LLMs) with retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) has largely focused on single-language settings, leaving their cross-lingual effectiveness underexplored. Multilingual RACG systems are increasingly important for migrating and reusing code across programming languages (PLs), a common yet challenging task in modern software development. To systematically study cross-lingual code knowledge transfer in RACG, we construct a dataset covering 13 PLs with nearly 14K instances. Our experiments reveal three key insights: (1) Knowledge transfer in RACG across PLs is non-trivial even using direct injection. (2) RACG exhibits unequal cross-lingual knowledge transfer, and its efficacy depends on linguistic affinity of PL pair and diversity of LLM pretraining corpus. (3) RACG shows limited reliance on natural language information embedded in code when equipped with a code-specific retriever. These findings provide practical guidance for designing effective multilingual RACG systems. https://github.com/icip-cas/Cross-Lingual-RACG
papers.abstract_zh: 目前关于大语言模型（LLMs）与检索增强代码生成技术的研究，大多集中在单一语言环境下，而其在多种语言环境下的有效性则尚未得到充分探索。在现代软件开发中，跨语言代码知识转移是一项常见但具有挑战性的任务，因此多语言RACG系统的应用越来越重要。为了系统地研究RACG在跨语言环境中的代码知识转移效果，我们构建了一个包含13种编程语言的数据集，其中包含近14千个实例。我们的实验揭示了三个关键发现：(1) 即使采用直接注入的方式，RACG在不同语言环境下的知识转移也并非易事。(2) RACG在跨语言知识转移方面表现出不平衡的现象，其效果取决于编程语言对之间的语言亲缘性以及LLM预训练语料库的多样性。(3) 当配备特定于代码的检索器时，RACG对代码中嵌入的自然语言信息的依赖程度有限。这些发现为设计有效的多语言RACG系统提供了实用指导。https://github.com/icip-cas/Cross-Lingual-RACG

papers.title: ErrorRadar: Benchmarking Complex Mathematical Reasoning of Multimodal Large Language Models Via Error Detection
papers.title_zh: 错误雷达：通过错误检测来评估多模态大语言模型的复杂数学推理能力
papers.authors: Yibo Yan, Shen Wang, Jiahao Huo, Hang Li, Boyan Li, Jiamin Su, Xiong Gao, YiFan Zhang, Tianlong Xu, Zhendong Chu, Aoxiao Zhong, Kun Wang, Hui Xiong, Philip S. Yu, Xuming Hu, Qingsong Wen
papers.abstract: As the field of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) continues to evolve, their potential to handle mathematical reasoning tasks is promising, as they can handle multimodal questions via cross-modal understanding capabilities compared to text-only LLMs. Current mathematical benchmarks predominantly focus on evaluating MLLMs’ problem-solving ability, yet there is a crucial gap in addressing more complex scenarios such as error detection, for enhancing reasoning capability in complicated settings. To fill this gap, we formally formulate the new task — multimodal error detection, and introduce ErrorRadar, the first benchmark designed to assess MLLMs’ capabilities in such a task. ErrorRadar evaluates two sub-tasks: error step identification and error categorization, providing a framework for evaluating MLLMs’ complex mathematical reasoning ability. It consists of 2,500 high-quality multimodal K-12 mathematical problems, collected from real-world student interactions in an educational organization, with expert-based annotation and metadata such as problem type and error category. Through extensive experiments, we evaluated both open-source and closed-source representative MLLMs, benchmarking their performance against educational expert evaluators. Results indicate challenges still remain, as GPT-4o with best model performance is still around 10% behind human evaluation
papers.abstract_zh: 随着多模态大语言模型领域不断发展，它们在处理数学推理任务方面的潜力令人期待。与仅基于文本的LLM相比，多模态大语言模型能够通过跨模态理解能力来处理多模态问题。目前，数学领域的基准测试主要集中在评估多模态大语言模型的解决问题的能力上，但在处理更复杂的场景时，如错误检测方面，仍然存在很大的差距，这限制了它们在复杂环境中的推理能力。为了填补这一空白，我们正式提出了新的任务——多模态错误检测，并引入了ErrorRadar，这是首个旨在评估多模态大语言模型在错误检测任务中能力的基准测试。ErrorRadar包含了两个子任务：错误步骤识别与错误分类，为评估多模态大语言模型的复杂数学推理能力提供了框架。该基准测试包含2,500个高质量的多模态K-12数学问题，这些问题来自教育机构中真实的学生互动情况，并附有专家标注以及诸如问题类型、错误类别等元数据。通过广泛的实验，我们对开源和闭源的代表性多模态大语言模型进行了性能评估，并将其结果与教育领域的专家评估结果进行了对比。结果表明，尽管GPT-4o作为表现最佳的模型取得了较好的成绩，但其性能仍比人类评估水平低约10%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Disentangling Continued Pre-Training: Attention-Driven Routing and Semantic Hub Preservation in Language Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 解析持续预训练机制：注意力驱动的路径选择与语言适应中的语义核心保留问题
papers.authors: Khanh-Tung Tran, Vinh-Khanh Tran, Barry O’Sullivan, Hoang D. Nguyen
papers.abstract: Continued Pre-Training (CPT) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to acquire second-language capabilities, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate how CPT adapts model representations across diverse language families and scripts, model sizes, and architectures. We find that second-language abilities emerge through a selective adaptation mechanism: task-solving capabilities are preserved in “semantic hub”, while interface layers retarget to shifted token distributions. Layer-swapping experiments demonstrate that semantic understanding can be surgically transferred between base and CPT models with minimal loss (e.g., swapping 50% of model parameters reduces performance by only 0.3%). Furthermore, we establish that attention components route language adaptation: larger parameter changes than feedforward networks, correlate more strongly with language-specific neurons, and their surgical replacement substantially degrades performance. Overall, our work provides a mechanistic understanding of CPT, guiding future work on efficient strategies for language adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 持续预训练（CPT）能够让大语言模型获得第二语言能力，但其背后的机制仍不甚明了。在这项研究中，我们探讨了CPT如何在不同语言家族、不同模型规模以及不同架构下调整模型表示方式。我们发现，第二语言能力的形成是通过一种选择性适应机制实现的：任务解决能力被保留在“语义中心”中，而接口层则会根据变化的词元分布进行重新映射。通过层交换实验发现，语义理解可以在基础模型和CPT模型之间以最小的损失进行转移（例如，交换50%的模型参数仅会导致性能下降0.3%）。此外，我们还发现注意力组件在语言适应过程中起着关键作用：与前馈网络相比，注意力机制的参数变化幅度更大，且这种变化与特定语言的神经元之间的关联更为紧密；而对这些组件的替换会显著降低模型的性能。总体而言，我们的研究为CPT的机制提供了深入理解，为未来实现高效的语言适应策略提供了指导。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Do You Get the Hint? Benchmarking LLMs on the Board Game Concept
papers.title_zh: 你明白其中的暗示了吗？以棋盘游戏的概念来对比大型语言模型的性能……
papers.authors: Ine Gevers, Walter Daelemans
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved striking successes on many benchmarks, yet recent studies continue to expose fundamental weaknesses. In this paper, we introduce Concept, a simple word-guessing board game, as a benchmark for probing abductive reasoning. Our results show that this game, easily solved by humans (with a success rate of over 90%), is still very challenging for state-of-the-art LLMs (no model exceeds 40% success rate). Specifically, we observe that LLMs struggle with interpreting other players’ strategic intents, and with correcting initial hypotheses given sequential information updates. In addition, we extend the evaluation across multiple languages, and find that the LLM performance drops further in lower-resource languages (Dutch, French, and Spanish) compared to English.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在许多基准测试中取得了显著的成功，但最近的研究仍然揭示了它们存在的根本弱点。在本文中，我们介绍了一款名为“Concept”的简单单词猜谜游戏，作为探究推理能力的测试工具。我们的结果显示，这款游戏虽然很容易被人类解决（成功率超过90%），但对于最先进的语言模型来说仍然非常具有挑战性（没有任何模型能突破40%的成功率）。具体来说，我们发现这些模型在解读其他玩家的策略意图以及根据后续信息更新来修正初始假设方面存在困难。此外，我们还对多种语言进行了评估，发现与英语相比，语言资源较少的语言（如荷兰语、法语和西班牙语）中的语言模型表现更差。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Topic-Based Watermarks for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于主题的大型语言模型水印技术
papers.authors: Alexander Nemecek, Yuzhou Jiang, Erman Ayday
papers.abstract: The indistinguishability of large language model (LLM) output from human-authored content poses significant challenges, raising concerns about potential misuse of AI-generated text and its influence on future model training. Watermarking algorithms offer a viable solution by embedding detectable signatures into generated text. However, existing watermarking methods often involve trade-offs among attack robustness, generation quality, and additional overhead such as specialized frameworks or complex integrations. We propose a lightweight, topic-guided watermarking scheme for LLMs that partitions the vocabulary into topic-aligned token subsets. Given an input prompt, the scheme selects a relevant topic-specific token list, effectively “green-listing” semantically aligned tokens to embed robust marks while preserving fluency and coherence. Experimental results across multiple LLMs and state-of-the-art benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves text quality comparable to industry-leading systems and simultaneously improves watermark robustness against paraphrasing and lexical perturbation attacks, with minimal performance overhead. Our approach avoids reliance on additional mechanisms beyond standard text generation pipelines, enabling straightforward adoption and suggesting a practical path toward globally consistent watermarking of AI-generated content.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的输出与人类创作的内容难以区分，这带来了重大挑战，引发了人们对AI生成文本可能被滥用以及其对未来模型训练影响的担忧。水印算法通过向生成的文本中嵌入可检测的标志来提供可行的解决方案。然而，现有的水印处理方法往往需要在攻击鲁棒性、生成质量以及额外的开销（如专用框架或复杂集成）之间做出权衡。我们提出了一种轻量级、基于主题的LLM水印方案，该方案将词汇表划分为与主题相对应的标记子集。根据输入提示，该方案会选择相关的主题特定标记列表，有效地“绿色列出”语义上一致的标记，从而嵌入鲁棒的水印，同时保持文本的流畅性和连贯性。在多个LLM和最先进的基准测试中的实验结果表明，我们的方法能够取得与行业领先系统相当的文本质量，同时提高了水印对释义攻击和词汇扰动攻击的鲁棒性，且性能开销极小。我们的方法无需依赖标准文本生成流程之外的额外机制，因此易于实施，并为实现AI生成内容的全球一致水印处理提供了实用途径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SParK-Eval: Evaluating Structure-Aware Knowledge Acquisition in LLMs for Domain Adaptation to Industrial Records
papers.title_zh: SParK-Eval：在大型语言模型中评估基于结构感知的知识获取方法，以应用于工业数据的领域自适应处理
papers.authors: Ekant Muljibhai Amin, Yuta Koreeda, Yasuhiro Sogawa
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often underperform in domain adaptation for industrial settings, where available corpora are limited and structurally diverse. These corpora frequently include non-natural formats such as tables, entity lists, or bullet-point instructions that hinder effective learning. To understand and improve domain-adaptive pretraining on such data, we introduce SParK-Eval (Structure-aware Parametric Knowledge Evaluation), a framework that constructs question–answer pairs from pretraining data and annotates each with its input structure (e.g., natural sentence, table, list). This enables fine-grained analysis of how input structure affects parametric knowledge acquisition during DAPT. Additionally, we propose a prompt-based input normalization method that converts diverse inputs into coherent natural sentences, providing a reference for isolating structural effects. Our experiments show that LLMs acquire substantially more knowledge from natural sentences than from their structurally non-standard counterparts. These findings underscore the importance of structure-aware evaluation in diagnosing learning challenges and guiding effective domain adaptation strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在工业领域的领域适应性训练中往往表现不佳，因为工业环境中的语料库数量有限且结构多样。这些语料库通常包含非自然格式的内容，如表格、实体列表或要点说明等，这些因素都会阻碍有效的学习过程。为了理解和改进基于此类数据的领域适应性预训练，我们提出了SParK-Eval框架。该框架能够从预训练数据中构建问题-答案对，并为每个问题-答案对标注其输入结构（例如，自然句子、表格、列表等）。这样就能细致地分析输入结构如何影响领域适应性训练过程中的参数化知识获取。此外，我们还提出了一种基于提示的输入标准化方法，可以将多样化的输入转化为连贯的自然句子，从而为分析结构效应提供参考。我们的实验表明，与结构不标准的输入相比，大语言模型从自然句子中获取的知识要丰富得多。这些发现强调了在诊断学习挑战和指导有效的领域适应性策略时，对结构进行意识性评估的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SOLAR-RL: Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 太阳能强化学习：半在线长周期任务强化学习
papers.authors: Jichao Wang, Liuyang Bian, Yufeng Zhou, Han Xiao, Yue Pan, Guozhi Wang, Hao Wang, Zhaoxiong Wang, Yafei Wen, Xiaoxin Chen, Shuai Ren, Lingfang Zeng
papers.abstract: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) mature, GUI agents are evolving from static interactions to complex navigation. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training MLLM agents on dynamic GUI tasks, its effective application faces a dilemma.Standard Offline RL often relies on static step-level data, neglecting global trajectory semantics such as task completion and execution quality. Conversely, Online RL captures the long-term dynamics but suffers from high interaction costs and potential environmental instability. To bridge this gap, we propose SOLAR-RL (Semi Online Long-horizon RL). Instead of relying solely on expensive online interactions, our framework integrates global trajectory insights directly into the offline learning process. Specifically, we reconstruct diverse rollout candidates from static data, detect the first failure point using per-step validity signals, and retroactively assign dense step-level rewards with target-aligned shaping to reflect trajectory-level execution quality—effectively simulating online feedback without interaction costs.Extensive experiments demonstrate that SOLAR-RL significantly improves long-horizon task completion rates and robustness compared to strong baselines, offering a sample-efficient solution for autonomous GUI navigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着多模态大语言模型的发展，图形用户界面代理也从简单的交互方式进化到复杂的导航功能。虽然强化学习已成为训练多模态语言模型代理以应对动态图形用户界面任务的有效方法，但其应用却面临一个难题：传统的离线强化学习通常依赖于静态的阶段性数据，而忽略了诸如任务完成率和执行质量等全局轨迹信息。相反，在线强化学习能够捕捉长期的发展趋势，但存在较高的交互成本以及环境不稳定性的问题。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了SOLAR-RL（半在线长视界强化学习）。我们的框架不再仅仅依赖昂贵的在线交互，而是将全局轨迹信息直接整合到离线学习过程中。具体来说，我们从静态数据中重构出多种可行的执行路径，通过每步的有效性判断来识别第一个失败点，并重新分配密集的阶段性奖励，这些奖励具有目标对齐的形状函数，从而反映执行质量——这实际上是在无需交互成本的情况下模拟了在线反馈的效果。大量的实验表明，与强大的基线相比，SOLAR-RL在长视界任务完成率和鲁棒性方面都有显著提升，为自主图形用户界面导航提供了一种高效且有效的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Kumatigi: Quality-Driven Data Augmentation for Low-Resource Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: Kumatigi：基于质量优化的数据增强技术，适用于资源有限的机器翻译系统
papers.authors: Cheick Tidiani Cissé
papers.abstract: Neural machine translation for extremely low-resource languages faces compounding challenges: scarce parallel data, orthographic inconsistency, and absence of quality metadata for principled training. We present Kumatigi, a quality-annotated French-Bambara corpus combining systematic curation with data augmentation strategies tailored to Bambara. We provide 67k quality-scored pairs that enable targeted data filtering and address pervasive orthographic normalization issues in existing resources. Our dual-dataset generation framework strategically exploits round-trip translation, producing synthetic pairs for fluency reinforcement alongside back-translated pairs that preserve authentic vocabulary for coverage expansion. We further introduce linguistically-motivated augmentation techniques addressing Bambara’s orthographic variability, improving model robustness for real-world text. Experiments with LoRA-based fine-tuning demonstrate consistent improvements across automatic metrics, with our full system achieving up to +3–4 BLEU over strong baselines. Data generation and augmentation strategies contribute +1-2 BLEU beyond high-quality parallel data alone. Human evaluation by native speakers confirms these automatic improvements align with substantial gains in translation adequacy and fluency, with our best model approaching human reference translation quality. Our methodology provides a reproducible framework applicable to other under-resourced languages facing similar data challenges.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对资源极其匮乏的语言进行神经机器翻译面临着多重挑战：平行数据稀缺、拼写规则不一致，以及缺乏用于训练的高质量元数据。我们提出了Kumatigi项目，这是一个高质量的法语-班巴拉语语料库，结合了系统的数据整理策略以及针对班巴拉语的专门数据增强方法。我们提供了6.7万对经过质量评分的例句，这些例句能够实现有针对性的数据筛选，并解决了现有资源中普遍存在的拼写标准化问题。我们的双数据集生成框架巧妙地利用了往返翻译机制，既生成了有助于提升流利度的合成例句，又保留了真实词汇，以便扩大覆盖范围。此外，我们还引入了基于语言特性的增强技术，以应对班巴拉语的拼写多样性问题，从而提高模型在实际文本处理中的鲁棒性。通过LoRA-based微调的实验表明，我们的系统在各种自动评估指标上都有显著改进，与优秀的基线模型相比，我们的系统最高提升了3-4个BLEU分数。数据生成和增强策略进一步提升了系统的性能，其提升幅度达到了1-2个BLEU。母语人士的评估也证实了这些自动改进确实带来了翻译准确性和流利度的显著提升，而我们表现最好的模型甚至接近人类参考译文的质量。我们的方法为其他面临类似数据挑战的资源匮乏语言提供了一种可复制的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CAMO: An Agentic Framework for Automated Causal Discovery from Micro Behaviors to Macro Emergence in LLM Agent Simulations
papers.title_zh: CAMO：一种用于从微观行为到宏观现象自动进行因果推理的框架，适用于大型语言模型代理模拟场景
papers.authors: Xiangning Yu, Yuwei Guo, Yuqi Hou, Xiao Xue, Qun Ma
papers.abstract: LLM-empowered agent simulations are increasingly used to study social emergence, yet the micro-to-macro causal mechanisms behind macro outcomes often remain unclear. This is challenging because emergence arises from intertwined agent interactions and meso-level feedback and nonlinearity, making generative mechanisms hard to disentangle. To this end, we introduce CAMO, an automated Causal discovery framework from Micro behaviors to Macro Emergence in LLM agent simulations. CAMO converts mechanistic hypotheses into computable factors grounded in simulation records and learns a compact causal representation centered on an emergent target . CAMO outputs a computable Markov boundary and a minimal upstream explanatory subgraph, yielding interpretable causal chains and actionable intervention levers. It also uses simulator-internal counterfactual probing to orient ambiguous edges and revise hypotheses when evidence contradicts the current view. Experiments across four emergent settings demonstrate the promise of CAMO.[The code is available at an anonymous link: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CAMO-0E6C/.]
papers.abstract_zh: 在LLM驱动的代理模拟中，人们越来越多地运用其来研究社会现象的出现机制。然而，宏观结果背后的微观到宏观的因果机制往往仍然不清楚。这一挑战在于，社会现象的出现源于代理之间的复杂互动以及中间层次的反馈和非线性效应，这使得生成这些因果机制变得非常困难。为此，我们提出了CAMO这一自动化因果发现框架。该框架能够从微观行为出发，逐步推导出宏观现象，并将机械性假设转化为基于模拟记录的可计算因素。同时，CAMO能够学习出一种以宏观目标为中心的简洁因果表示方式。该框架还能输出可计算的马尔可夫边界以及最小的上游解释子图，从而揭示出可解释的因果链以及可行的干预措施。此外，CAMO还利用模拟器内部的反事实探测技术来处理那些模糊不清的因果关系，并在证据与当前观点相矛盾时及时调整假设。在四种不同情境下的实验表明，CAMO具有巨大的潜力。[代码可通过匿名链接获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CAMO-0E6C/]
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
