papers.title: A Multi-View Media Profiling Suite: Resources, Evaluation, and Analysis
papers.title_zh: 多视角媒体分析工具包：资源、评估与分析工具
papers.authors: Muhammad Arslan Manzoor, Dilshod Azizov, Daniil Orel, Umer Siddique, Zain Muhammad Mujahid, Yufang Hou, Preslav Nakov
papers.abstract: News outlets shape public opinion on a scale, which makes automated detection of political bias and factuality essential. Yet, the field still lacks unified resources, comprehensive evaluations in diverse approaches, and systematic analyzes of the representations and fusion strategies that matter the most, especially under label sparsity and dataset diversity. In addition, there is little empirical work that reports broad observation driven findings about what consistently works, what fails, and why. We address these gaps with four contributions: (i) MBFC-2025, a large-scale label set that covers ~2,600 outlets from Media Bias/Fact Check (MBFC); (ii) multi-view representations for ACL-2020 ~900 outlets and MBFC-2025, spanning Alexa graphs, hyperlink graphs, LLM-derived graphs, articles, and Wikipedia descriptions; (iii) systematic evaluation and analysis of embedding views and fusion strategies, including an RL-based fusion variant; and (iv) extensive experiments that achieve state-of-the-art results on ACL-2020 and establish strong benchmarks on MBFC-2025.
papers.abstract_zh: 新闻媒体在塑造公众舆论方面起着重要作用，因此自动检测政治偏见和事实准确性是非常必要的。然而，该领域仍然缺乏统一的资源、对多种方法的全面评估，以及对最重要的表示方法和融合策略的系统分析，尤其是在标签稀疏性和数据集多样性的情况下。此外，关于哪些方法有效、哪些方法无效以及原因方面的实证研究也非常少。我们通过以下四项贡献来弥补这些不足：(i) MBFC-2025，这是一个大规模标签集，涵盖了约2,600家媒体机构，用于媒体偏见/事实核查；(ii) 针对ACL-2020的约900家媒体机构和MBFC-2025的多视图表示方法，涵盖Alexa图、超链接图、由大语言模型生成的图、文章以及维基百科描述等；(iii) 对嵌入视图和融合策略进行系统的评估与分析，包括基于强化学习的融合变体；(iv) 通过广泛的实验在ACL-2020上取得最先进的结果，并为MBFC-2025建立可靠的基准。

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Cross-Attention Interventions
papers.title_zh: 通过交叉注意力机制实现文本到图像扩散模型的可解释性
papers.authors: Maisha Maliha, Dean F. Hougen
papers.abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models achieve remarkable generation quality, yet their internal mechanisms for grounding prompt semantics into visual structure remain poorly understood. We present a novel mechanistic interpretability framework for Stable Diffusion that probes how individual prompt tokens are represented and utilized during the denoising process. Given a prompt, we record cross-attention activations throughout UNet denoising and convert them into token-level spatial grounding maps that indicate where each token contributes signal during image synthesis. To establish causal faithfulness, we perform controlled prompt interventions by removing a single word at a time while keeping the sampling seed fixed, producing counterfactual generations. To quantify mechanistic sensitivity, we introduce a head-resolved spike score based on divergence between per-head token contribution distributions before and after intervention, enabling module-wise and head-wise attribution of semantic changes. Experiments on compositional prompts and challenging relational descriptions reveal systematic patterns of token grounding, semantic drift, and head specialization across denoising timesteps. Our results provide a practical and reproducible toolkit for analyzing how diffusion models encode and apply semantic information, supporting deeper transparency in text-to-image generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到图像扩散模型能够生成出非常出色的图像效果，然而其将提示语义转化为视觉结构的内部机制仍然缺乏深入的理解。我们为Stable Diffusion提出了一个新的机制可解释性框架，该框架可以探究在去噪过程中各个提示标记是如何被表示和使用的。给定一个提示，我们会记录UNet去噪过程中的交叉注意力激活情况，并将其转换为标记级别的空间定位图，从而明确每个标记在图像合成过程中所起的作用。为了验证因果忠实度，我们通过逐步移除单个单词来进行控制性的提示干预，同时保持采样种子不变，从而生成反事实的图像。为了量化机制敏感性，我们引入了一种基于每个头部标记贡献分布差异的头部分辨率尖峰得分，这样就可以对语义变化进行模块级和头部级的归因分析。通过对组合式提示以及具有挑战性的关系描述进行实验，我们发现各个去噪步骤中都有系统性的标记定位、语义漂移以及头部特性变化规律。我们的研究结果提供了一个实用且可复用的工具包，用于分析扩散模型如何编码和应用语义信息，从而提升文本到图像生成的透明度。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Revisiting Entropy in Reinforcement Learning for Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 在强化学习领域中重新审视熵的概念，以用于大型推理模型
papers.authors: Renren Jin, Pengzhi Gao, Yuqi Ren, Zhuowen Han, Tongxuan Zhang, Wuwei Huang, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, the entropy of LLMs usually collapses during RLVR training, leading to premature convergence to suboptimal local minima and hindering further performance improvement. Although various approaches have been proposed to mitigate entropy collapse, a comprehensive study of entropy in RLVR remains lacking. To bridge this gap, we conduct extensive experiments to investigate the entropy dynamics of LLMs trained with RLVR and analyze how model entropy correlates with response diversity, calibration, and performance across various benchmarks. Our results identify three key factors that influence entropy: the clipping thresholds in the optimization objective, the number of off-policy updates, and the diversity of the training data. Furthermore, through both theoretical analysis and empirical validation, we demonstrate that tokens with positive advantages are the primary drivers of entropy collapse. Motivated by this insight, we propose Positive-Advantage Reweighting, a simple yet effective approach that regulates model entropy by adjusting the loss weights assigned to tokens with positive advantages during RLVR training, while maintaining competitive performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的重要方法。然而，在RLVR训练过程中，大语言模型的熵通常会崩溃，这会导致模型过早收敛到次优的局部最小值，从而阻碍性能的进一步提升。尽管已经提出了多种方法来缓解熵崩溃问题，但关于RLVR中熵变化的全面研究仍然缺乏。为了填补这一空白，我们进行了大量实验，研究了通过RLVR训练的大语言模型的熵动态变化，并分析了模型熵与响应多样性、校准水平以及不同基准测试中的性能之间的关联。我们的研究结果指出，有三个关键因素会影响熵的变化：优化目标中的裁剪阈值、非策略性更新的次数，以及训练数据的多样性。此外，通过理论分析和实证验证，我们发现具有正优势的标记是导致熵崩溃的主要因素。基于这一发现，我们提出了“正优势权重调整”方法，这是一种简单而有效的方法，它通过调整在RLVR训练过程中分配给具有正优势的标记的损失权重，来调控模型熵，同时保持良好的性能表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: How Large Language Models Balance Internal Knowledge with User and Document Assertions
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型如何平衡内部知识以及用户和文档提供的信息
papers.authors: Shuowei Li, Haoxin Li, Wenda Chu, Yi Fang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often need to balance their internal parametric knowledge with external information, such as user beliefs and content from retrieved documents, in real-world scenarios like RAG or chat-based systems. A model’s ability to reliably process these sources is key to system safety. Previous studies on knowledge conflict and sycophancy are limited to a binary conflict paradigm, primarily exploring conflicts between parametric knowledge and either a document or a user, but ignoring the interactive environment where all three sources exist simultaneously. To fill this gap, we propose a three-source interaction framework and systematically evaluate 27 LLMs from 3 families on 2 datasets. Our findings reveal general patterns: most models rely more on document assertions than user assertions, and this preference is reinforced by post-training. Furthermore, our behavioral analysis shows that most models are impressionable, unable to effectively discriminate between helpful and harmful external information. To address this, we demonstrate that fine-tuning on diverse source interaction data can significantly increase a model’s discrimination abilities. In short, our work paves the way for developing trustworthy LLMs that can effectively and reliably integrate multiple sources of information. Code is available at https://github.com/shuowl/llm-source-balancing.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在现实世界中的应用场景中，如文档摘要生成或聊天系统，通常需要平衡其内部参数化知识与外部信息，比如用户的信念以及从文档中提取的内容。模型能否可靠地处理这些来源，是系统安全的关键。以往关于知识冲突和谄媚行为的研究大多局限于二元冲突范式，主要探讨参数化知识与文档或用户之间的冲突，而忽略了三种来源同时存在的互动环境。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个三源交互框架，并在两个数据集上系统地评估了来自三个家族的27个大语言模型。我们的研究发现了一些普遍规律：大多数模型更依赖文档中的陈述内容，而非用户的信念，而这种偏好在训练后还会得到加强。此外，我们的行为分析表明，大多数模型容易受到外部信息的影响，无法有效区分有用与有害的信息。为了解决这个问题，我们发现通过对多样化的源数据数据进行微调，可以显著提升模型的辨别能力。总之，我们的研究为开发能够高效且可靠地整合多种信息来源的可信大语言模型铺平了道路。相关代码可访问https://github.com/shuowl/llm-source-balancing。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ComicVQA: A Benchmark for Visual Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
papers.title_zh: ComicVQA：一种用于多模态大语言模型视觉推理的基准测试
papers.authors: Esther Gan, Hannah Brown, David Herel, Kenji Kawaguchi, Min-Yen Kan, Michael Qizhe Shieh
papers.abstract: We introduce Comic Visual Question Answering (ComicVQA), a comics-based benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on visual reasoning. ComicVQA comprises of (i) Missing Panel Prediction, testing fine-grained visual grounding and (ii) Panel Sorting, which evaluates sequential narrative understanding. Proprietary models achieve up to 62.6% on Missing Panel Prediction and 46.4% on Panel Sorting, whereas open-source models reach only 47.7% and 26.9%, respectively. In contrast, human annotators achieve over 83% accuracy on both tasks, revealing a large gap between current models and human-level multimodal understanding in comics. Through controlled ordering ablations and a detailed error taxonomy, we show that current MLLMs rely primarily on coarse temporal cues and struggle with fine-grained visual reasoning. These findings demonstrate ComicVQA as a diagnostic benchmark for advancing multimodal visual reasoning in comics.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了基于漫画的视觉问答任务ComicVQA，该任务旨在评估大语言模型在视觉推理方面的能力。ComicVQA包含两个部分：(1)缺失画面预测，用于测试精细的视觉定位能力；(2)画面排序，用于评估对连续叙事的理解能力。专有模型的在缺失画面预测任务上的准确率高达62.6%，在画面排序任务上的准确率达到46.4%；而开源模型的准确率分别仅为47.7%和26.9%。相比之下，人类注释者在这两个任务上的准确率均超过83%，这表明当前模型与人类在漫画中的多模态理解能力之间存在巨大差距。通过控制排序操作和详细的错误分类，我们发现当前的语言模型主要依赖粗略的时间线索来进行推理，而在精细的视觉推理方面存在困难。这些发现表明，ComicVQA可以作为推动漫画中多模态视觉推理发展的诊断性基准任务。

papers.title: AJ-Bench: Benchmarking Agent-as-a-Judge for Environment-Aware Evaluation
papers.title_zh: AJ-Bench：针对环境感知评估的“代理人作为评判者”基准测试方案
papers.authors: Wentao Shi, Yu Wang, Yuyang Zhao, Yuxin Chen, Fuli Feng, Xueyuan Hao, Xi Su, Qi GU, Hui Su, Xunliang Cai, Xiangnan He
papers.abstract: As reinforcement learning continues to scale the training of large language model–based agents, reliably verifying agent behaviors in complex environments has become increasingly challenging. Existing approaches rely on rule-based verifiers or LLM-as-a-Judge models, which struggle to generalize beyond narrow domains. Agent-as-a-Judge addresses this limitation by actively interacting with environments and tools to acquire verifiable evidence, yet its capabilities remain underexplored.We introduce a benchmark AJ-Bench to systematically evaluate Agent-as-a-Judge across three domains—search, data systems, and graphical user interfaces—comprising 155 tasks and 516 annotated trajectories. The benchmark comprehensively assesses judge agents’ abilities in information acquisition, state verification, and process verification. Experiments demonstrate consistent performance gains over LLM-as-a-Judge baselines, while also revealing substantial open challenges in agent-based verification. Our data and code are available at https://aj-bench.github.io/.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着强化学习在基于大语言模型的智能体训练中的应用越来越广泛，可靠地验证智能体在复杂环境中的行为变得越来越困难。现有的方法依赖于基于规则的验证器或作为裁判的LLM模型，但这些方法难以泛化到更广泛的领域。作为裁判的智能体通过主动与环境及工具互动来获取可验证的证据，从而解决了这一限制问题，不过其能力仍有待进一步探索。我们引入了一个名为AJ-Bench的基准测试平台，用于系统评估作为裁判的智能体在搜索、数据系统和图形用户界面这三个领域的表现。该基准测试包含155个任务和516条带有注释的轨迹数据，全面评估了裁判智能体的信息获取、状态验证以及过程验证能力。实验结果表明，与作为裁判的LLM模型相比，作为裁判的智能体具有稳定的性能提升，同时也揭示了在基于智能体的验证方面存在的重大挑战。我们的数据和代码可以在https://aj-bench.github.io/下载。

papers.title: Can LLMs Estimate Student Struggles? Human-AI Difficulty Alignment with Proficiency Simulation for Item Difficulty Prediction
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能够预测学生遇到的困难吗？人类智能与人工智能在难度评估方面的协同作用，对于试题难度的预测具有重要意义
papers.authors: Ming Li, Han Chen, Yunze Xiao, Jian Chen, Hong Jiao, Tianyi Zhou
papers.abstract: Accurate estimation of item (question or task) difficulty is critical for educational assessment but suffers from the cold start problem. While Large Language Models demonstrate superhuman problem-solving capabilities, it remains an open question whether they can perceive the cognitive struggles of human learners. In this work, we present a large-scale empirical analysis of Human-AI Difficulty Alignment for over 20 models across diverse domains such as medical knowledge and mathematical reasoning. Our findings reveal a systematic misalignment where scaling up model size is not reliably helpful; instead of aligning with humans, models converge toward a shared machine consensus. We observe that high performance often impedes accurate difficulty estimation, as models struggle to simulate the capability limitations of students even when being explicitly prompted to adopt specific proficiency levels. Furthermore, we identify a critical lack of introspection, as models fail to predict their own limitations. These results suggest that general problem-solving capability does not imply an understanding of human cognitive struggles, highlighting the challenge of using current models for automated difficulty prediction.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确评估任务（问题或任务）的难度对于教育评估至关重要，但这一过程面临着冷启动问题。虽然大语言模型展现出了超人类的问题解决能力，但尚不清楚它们是否能够感知人类学习者的认知困难。在这项研究中，我们对20多种不同领域的模型进行了大规模实证分析，这些领域包括医学知识和数学推理等。我们的研究发现表明，模型规模的增加并不能真正帮助实现与人类的一致性；相反，模型趋向于形成一种共同的机器共识，而不是与人类保持一致。我们发现，高性能往往会导致难以准确评估任务的难度，因为模型在明确被要求采用特定熟练程度时，仍然难以模拟学生的能力限制。此外，我们还发现了一个关键的问题：模型缺乏自我反省的能力，它们无法预测自己的局限性。这些结果表明，一般性的问题解决能力并不意味着能够理解人类的认知困难，这凸显了使用当前模型进行自动难度预测所面临的挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Transition-Matrix Regularization for Next Dialogue Act Prediction in Counselling Conversations
papers.title_zh: 用于咨询对话中下一阶段行为预测的过渡矩阵正则化方法
papers.authors: Eric Rudolph, Philipp Steigerwald, Jens Albrecht
papers.abstract: This paper studies how empirical dialogue-flow statistics can be incorporated into Next Dialogue Act Prediction (NDAP). A KL regularization term is proposed that aligns predicted act distributions with corpus-derived transition patterns. Evaluated on a 60-class German counselling taxonomy using 5-fold cross-validation, this improves macro-F1 by 9–42% relative depending on encoder and substantially improves dialogue-flow alignment. Cross-dataset validation on HOPE suggests that improvements transfer across languages and counselling domains. In systematic ablations across pretrained encoders and architectures, the findings indicate that transition regularization provides consistent gains and disproportionately benefits weaker baseline models. The results suggest that lightweight discourse-flow priors complement pretrained encoders, especially in fine-grained, data-sparse dialogue tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了如何将经验性对话流统计信息融入下一轮对话行为预测模型中。文中提出了一种KL正则化项，该项能够将预测出的行为分布与语料库中的转换模式进行对齐。在60类德语咨询任务上进行5折交叉验证实验后发现，该方法将宏 F1 相对提升 9%–42%，具体幅度因编码器而异，且能显著改善对话流的对齐效果。在HOPE数据集上的跨数据集验证表明，这些改进可以适用于不同的语言和咨询领域。通过对预训练编码器和架构进行系统性的消融实验，研究发现，转换正则化方法能够持续带来增益，并且对较弱的基线模型有显著的帮助。结果表明，轻量级的对话流先验信息可以很好地补充预训练编码器的作用，尤其是在那些需要精细处理、数据较少的对话任务中。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ClimateCause: Complex and Implicit Causal Structures in Climate Reports
papers.title_zh: 气候原因：气候现象背后的复杂且隐秘的因果关系结构
papers.authors: Liesbeth Allein, Nataly Pineda-Castañeda, Andrea Rocci, Marie-Francine Moens
papers.abstract: Understanding climate change requires reasoning over complex causal networks. Yet, existing causal discovery datasets predominantly capture explicit, direct causal relations. We introduce ClimateCause, a manually expert-annotated dataset of higher-order causal structures from science-for-policy climate reports, including implicit and nested causality. Cause-effect expressions are normalized and disentangled into individual causal relations to facilitate graph construction, with unique annotations for cause-effect correlation, relation type, and spatiotemporal context. We further demonstrate ClimateCause’s value for quantifying readability based on the semantic complexity of causal graphs underlying a statement. Finally, large language model benchmarking on correlation inference and causal chain reasoning highlights the latter as a key challenge.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解气候变化需要针对复杂的因果网络进行推理。然而，现有的因果发现数据集大多只捕捉到明确的、直接的因果关系。我们提出了ClimateCause这一数据集，它是一个由专家手动注释的、包含高层次因果结构的科学政策报告数据集，其中包含了隐式和嵌套的因果关系。因果表达式被标准化，并分解为独立的因果关系，以便于构建图表。此外，该数据集还提供了关于因果关联、关系类型以及时空背景的独特注释。我们还证明了ClimateCause在量化因果图的语义复杂性方面的价值。最后，基于相关性推理和因果链推理的大语言模型基准测试表明，后者是一个重要的挑战。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Reference-Free Evaluation of Taxonomies
papers.title_zh: 无需参考的分类体系评估
papers.authors: Pascal Wullschleger, Majid Zarharan, Donnacha Daly, Marc Pouly, Jennifer Foster
papers.abstract: We introduce two reference-free metrics for quality evaluation of taxonomies in the absence of labels. The first metric evaluates robustness by calculating the correlation between semantic and taxonomic similarity, addressing error types not considered by existing metrics. The second uses Natural Language Inference to assess logical adequacy. Both metrics are tested on five taxonomies and are shown to correlate well with F1 against ground truth taxonomies. We further demonstrate that our metrics can predict downstream performance in hierarchical classification when used with label hierarchies.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了两种无需参考信息的分类质量评估指标，用于在没有标签的情况下对分类结构进行评估。第一个指标通过计算语义相似性与分类相似性之间的相关性来评估模型的鲁棒性，从而能够处理现有指标未能考虑的错误类型。第二个指标则利用自然语言推理技术来评估分类结构的逻辑合理性。这两种指标都已在五个分类结构上进行了测试，结果显示它们与真实分类结构相比，具有很好的F1值相关性。此外，我们还证明了，当这些指标与标签层次结构结合使用时，能够预测分层分类任务中的下游性能表现。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CSI: An Investigative Multi-Agent Framework for Explainable Short Video Fake News Detection
papers.title_zh: CSI：一种用于检测可解释性短视频虚假新闻的多智能体框架
papers.authors: Yuxin Wang, Yang Yang, Huaiwen Zhang
papers.abstract: The proliferation of short video fake news threatens social stability. Current detection methods rely either on black-box Multimodal Small Language Models (MSLMs), which suffer from poor explainability and superficial understanding, or on specific prompt strategies for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that underutilize their reasoning capabilities and knowledge. To address these challenges, we propose a novel multi-agent framework named CSI for short video fake news detection. CSI implements two key units: 1) Multimodal Forensics Unit (MFU), which performs synchronous multimodal deconstruction and external knowledge retrieval to collect comprehensive evidence. 2) Case Review Unit (CRU), which first employs collaborative discussion to facilitate viewpoint interaction to obtain the review result. Subsequently, the Adjudicator integrates evidence and the review result via multiple attention mechanisms to interact with the news, ensuring a robust verdict.Extensive experiments on two real-world datasets demonstrate that CSI provides rigorous explanations while achieving state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at: https://github.com/VFCenter/CSI.
papers.abstract_zh: 短视频虚假新闻的泛滥威胁着社会稳定。目前的检测方法要么依赖黑盒式的多模态小语言模型，这些模型在可解释性和理解能力方面存在不足；要么依赖于针对多模态大语言模型的特定提示策略，但这些策略未能充分发挥模型的推理能力和知识储备。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为CSI的新多智能体框架，用于检测短视频虚假新闻。CSI包含两个核心单元：1）多模态取证单元，该单元通过同步的多模态分析以及外部知识的检索来收集全面的证据；2）案例审查单元，该单元首先通过协作讨论来促进不同观点的交流，从而获得审查结果。随后，裁决者通过多种注意力机制将证据和审查结果结合起来，与新闻进行互动，从而得出可靠的判断。在两个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，CSI能够提供严谨的解释，同时还能达到最先进的性能水平。我们的代码可以在以下链接下载：https://github.com/VFCenter/CSI。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Dial HEALTHDIAL for Advice: A Multilingual and Multi-Parallel Spoken Dialogue Dataset for Knowledge-Grounded Information Seeking
papers.title_zh: 使用HEALTHDIAL来获取建议：一个支持多语言、多并行对话的数据库，适用于基于知识的信息检索需求
papers.authors: Songbo Hu, Yinhong Liu, Ej Zhou, Evgeniia Razumovskaia, Xiaobin Wang, Alexander Fraser, Ivan Vulić, Anna Korhonen
papers.abstract: Creating spoken dialogue datasets is methodologically challenging, and these challenges are amplified when the goal is to build multilingual, multi-parallel datasets at scale. This work introduces HEALTHDIAL, a large-scale, multilingual, and multi-parallel dataset for developing and evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)–based spoken dialogue systems. The dataset comprises 6,000 information-seeking dialogues (1,500 per language) grounded in trusted content from the World Health Organization (WHO) and 163 hours of user speech recorded from native speakers of diverse dialects across four official WHO languages: Arabic, Chinese, English, and Spanish. Each speaker is annotated with demographic (e.g., gender, age) and sociolinguistic (e.g., primary language, region of origin) variables. We report benchmark results across key dialogue tasks, which reveal consistent performance disparities across languages, even among high-resource ones. To support future research, we release the dataset, a prototype system, and a toolkit for data collection and system evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 创建口语对话数据集在方法上具有挑战性，而当目标是大规模构建多语言、多并行数据集时，这些挑战会变得更加严峻。本研究提出了HEALTHDIAL，这是一个大规模、多语言且多并行的数据集，用于开发和评估基于检索增强生成技术的口语对话系统。该数据集包含6,000个信息检索对话（每种语言1,500个），这些对话内容源自世界卫生组织提供的可信资料，同时还包含了来自四种官方语言——阿拉伯语、中文、英语和西班牙语——的163小时用户语音记录。每个说话者都标注了人口统计信息（如性别、年龄）和社会语言学信息（如主要语言、出生地）。我们报告了在关键对话任务上的基准测试结果，结果显示，即使是在资源丰富的语言中，不同语言之间的性能也存在显著差异。为了支持未来的研究，我们发布了该数据集、一个原型系统以及一套用于数据收集和系统评估的工具包。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Fast and Effective On-Policy Distillation from Reasoning Prefixes
papers.title_zh: 基于推理前缀的快速且高效的在线策略蒸馏方法
papers.authors: Dongxu Zhang, Zhichao Yang, Sepehr Janghorbani, Jun Han, Andrew Ressler II, Qian Qian, Gregory D Lyng, Sanjit Singh Batra, Robert E. Tillman
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD), which samples trajectories from the student model and supervises them with a teacher at the token-level, avoids relying solely on verifiable terminal rewards and can yield better generalization than off-policy distillation. However, OPD requires expensive on-the-fly sampling of the student policy during training, which substantially increases training cost, especially for responses with long reasoning traces. Our initial analysis shows that, during OPD, training signals are stronger in the prefix of each output reasoning trace, and that even a short teacher-generated prefix can significantly help the student produce the correct answer. Motivated by these observations, we propose a simple yet effective modification of OPD: we apply the distillation objective only to prefixes of student-generated outputs and terminate each sampling early during distillation. Experiments on a suite of AI-for-Math and out-of-domain reasoning benchmarks show that on-policy prefix distillation matches the performance of full OPD in long reasoning outputs while reducing training FLOP by 2x–40x.
papers.abstract_zh: 在策略上进行的蒸馏（On-policy Distillation，OPD）是从学生模型中提取轨迹样本，并在符号级别由教师进行监督。这种方法避免了仅依赖可验证的终端奖励，因此能够比非策略蒸馏实现更好的泛化能力。然而，OPD需要在训练过程中对学生策略进行昂贵的实时采样操作，这大大增加了训练成本，尤其是在处理具有较长推理过程的任务时。我们的初步分析表明，在OPD过程中，每个输出推理轨迹的开头部分具有更强的训练信号，即使是一个简短的教师生成的头部信息也能显著帮助学生得出正确的答案。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种简单而有效的OPD改进方法：我们只将蒸馏目标应用于学生生成的输出的头部部分，并在蒸馏过程中提前终止每个样本的采样过程。在一系列面向数学的人工智能和领域外推理测试上的实验表明，在策略上进行的头部蒸馏能够在处理长推理过程时达到与全OPD相同的性能水平，同时还将训练过程中的计算量减少了2倍到40倍。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MaRF: Leveraging Representation-Level Fusion of Formula Semantics for Mathematical Information Retrieval
papers.title_zh: MaRF：利用公式语义的表示层融合技术来实现数学信息的检索
papers.authors: Suyuan Wang, Hongbo Zheng, Nickvash Kani
papers.abstract: Mathematical information retrieval (MIR) depends on jointly modeling natural-language context and mathematical expressions. While BERT-based dense retrievers are effective, they often dilute mathematical semantics because textual content dominates most training data and mathematical formulas differ fundamentally from natural language in structure and composition. Consequently, these models rely heavily on surrounding text, which reduces robustness in math-intensive scenarios with limited textual description. We propose MaRF, a dual-encoder representation-level fusion framework for MIR that explicitly integrates formula semantics into context-aware dense retrieval. By combining contextual and formula-specific representations, MaRF captures complementary information from both textual and symbolic views. Experiments on the ARQMath-3 benchmark demonstrate that MaRF substantially improves retrieval performance and robustness, outperforming strong baselines across MIR tasks. The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/MLPgroup/MaRF.
papers.abstract_zh: 数学信息检索（MIR）需要同时处理自然语言上下文和数学表达式。虽然基于BERT的密集检索模型效果不错，但它们往往会忽略数学语义，因为文本占据了大部分训练数据，而数学公式在结构和组成上与自然语言有很大差异。因此，这些模型严重依赖周围文本，这在数学密集型场景中会导致鲁棒性下降，因为文本描述有限。我们提出了MaRF，这是一种双编码器级别的融合框架，能够将公式语义明确地整合到上下文感知的密集检索中。通过结合上下文信息和特定于公式的信息，MaRF能够同时获取文本和符号层面的互补信息。在ARQMath-3基准测试上的实验表明，MaRF显著提升了检索性能和鲁棒性，其表现优于其他强大的基线模型。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/MLPgroup/MaRF下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Documents to Segments: A Contextual Reformulation for Topic Assignment
papers.title_zh: 从文档到段落：一种针对主题分配的上下文重构方法
papers.authors: Hoonsang Yoon, Takyoung Kim, Wonkee Lee, Ilmin Cho, Dilek Hakkani-Tür, Stanley Jungkyu Choi
papers.abstract: Traditional topic modeling treats each document as a single, coherent unit of topic, which can cause topic contamination when documents cover multiple topics. This becomes especially problematic when stakeholders are interested in identifying documents that focus on a specific topic. We introduce segment-based topic allocation, a novel paradigm that redefines topic assignment at the level of segments, coherent textual spans conveying distinct topical content. This granularity improves topic purity, interpretability, and applicability to multi-theme corpora such as reviews or survey responses. To support this paradigm, we construct SemEval-STM, a benchmark derived from aspect-based sentiment datasets, where segments are automatically extracted using large language models (LLMs) and post-processed with human supervision. We further propose the segment intrusion task (SIT), a novel evaluation method extending word intrusion to the span level, enabling human-centric assessment of topical coherence. Empirical results across diverse metrics and models demonstrate that SBTA significantly outperforms traditional document-based methods in clustering and interpretability. Our framework provides a practical and scalable solution for fine-grained topic analysis in heterogeneous text corpora.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的主题建模将每个文档视为一个独立、连贯的主题单元，但当文档涉及多个主题时，就会导致主题污染问题。当相关方希望识别出专注于特定主题的文档时，这种情况就变得尤为棘手。我们提出了基于片段的主题分配方法，这是一种新的范式，它可以在片段级别重新定义主题分配，使连贯的文本片段能够表达不同的主题内容。这种细粒度的方法提升了主题的纯净性、可解释性，并适用于包含多种主题的语料库，如评论或调查回复等。为了支持这一范式，我们构建了SemEval-STM基准测试，该测试基于方面情感数据集，其中片段通过大语言模型自动提取，并通过人工监督进行后处理。我们还提出了片段入侵任务（SIT）这一新的评估方法，它将单词入侵的概念扩展到了片段级别，从而实现以人为中心的主题连贯性评估。通过多种指标和模型的实证结果表明，SBTA在聚类能力和可解释性方面显著优于传统的基于文档的方法。我们的框架为异构文本语料库中的细粒度主题分析提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: Can LLMs Compress (and Decompress)? Evaluating Code Understanding and Execution via Invertibility
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能够进行压缩（以及解压缩）操作吗？通过可逆性来评估代码的理解程度与执行能力
papers.authors: Nickil Maveli, Antonio Vergari, Shay B Cohen
papers.abstract: LLMs demonstrate strong performance on code benchmarks, yet round-trip code execution reveals limitations in their ability to maintain consistent reasoning across forward and backward execution. We present RoundTripCodeEval (RTCE), a comprehensive benchmark consisting of four distinct code execution reasoning tasks designed to rigorously test round-trip consistency. RTCE provides an execution-free, exact-match evaluation of bijection fidelity, assessing whether models preserve a consistent one-to-one mapping between encoding and decoding operations across various algorithms and directions. We systematically evaluate state-of-the-art Code-LLMs using zero-shot prompting, supervised fine-tuning on execution traces, and self-reflection mechanisms. Each yields modest improvements, but none closes the gap, indicating that current LLMs struggle with true round-trip consistency, which demonstrates that they lack the internal coherence required for trustworthy code reasoning. RTCE surfaces several new and previously unmeasured insights that are not captured by existing I/O-prediction, execution-reasoning, or round-trip natural-language benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码基准测试中表现出强大的性能，但往返代码执行过程却揭示了它们在保持前后执行过程中一致推理能力方面的局限性。我们提出了RoundTripCodeEval（RTCE）这一综合测试工具，该工具包含四个不同的代码执行推理任务，旨在严格测试往返一致性。RTCE提供了一种无需执行的精确匹配评估方式，用于检测模型在不同算法和方向上是否能够保持编码与解码操作之间的一一对应关系。我们通过系统性的方法评估了最先进的语言模型，包括零样本提示、基于执行轨迹的监督式微调以及自我反思机制。这些方法的改进幅度都相当有限，但都没有能够完全弥补这一缺陷，这表明当前的大语言模型在真正的往返一致性方面存在困难，说明它们缺乏进行可信代码推理所需的内部一致性。RTCE还揭示了一些新的、之前未被测量的现象，这些现象并不被现有的输入/输出预测、执行推理或往返自然语言处理测试所涵盖。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Confidence Estimation for LLMs in Multi-turn Interactions
papers.title_zh: 在多轮交互中，对大型语言模型进行置信度估计的方法
papers.authors: Caiqi Zhang, Ruihan Yang, Xiaochen Zhu, Chengzu Li, Tiancheng Hu, Yijiang River Dong, Deqing Yang, Nigel Collier
papers.abstract: While confidence estimation is a promising direction for mitigating hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs), current research overwhelmingly focuses on single-turn settings. The dynamics of model confidence in multi-turn conversations, where context accumulates and ambiguity is progressively resolved, remain largely unexplored. This work presents the first systematic study of confidence estimation in multi-turn interactions, establishing a formal evaluation framework grounded in two key desiderata: per-turn calibration and monotonicity of confidence as more information becomes available. To facilitate this, we introduce novel metrics, including a length-normalized Expected Calibration Error (InfoECE), and a new “Hinter-Guesser” paradigm for generating controlled evaluation datasets. Our experiments reveal that widely-used confidence techniques struggle with calibration and monotonicity in multi-turn dialogues. In contrast, a novel logit-based probe we introduce, P(Sufficient), proves comparatively more effective, robustly tracking evidence accumulation and distinguishing it from conversational filler. Our work provides a foundational methodology for developing more reliable and trustworthy conversational agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然置信度估计是减轻大语言模型幻觉问题的一个有前景的方向，但目前的研究大多集中在单轮对话场景中。而在多轮对话中，随着上下文的积累和歧义的逐步消除，模型的置信度动态则尚未得到充分研究。本研究首次对多轮交互中的置信度估计进行了系统性的研究，并构建了一个基于两个关键需求的正式评估框架：每轮对话的校准功能，以及随着更多信息可用时置信度的单调性。为了便于实现这一目标，我们提出了一些新的评估指标，包括长度归一化的期望校准误差（InfoECE），以及一种用于生成可控评估数据集的新“Hinter-Guesser”范式。实验结果表明，目前常用的置信度估计方法在多轮对话中难以满足校准和单调性的要求。相比之下，我们提出的一种基于逻辑斯蒂模型的探针P(Sufficient)表现得更为有效，它能够稳健地跟踪证据的积累情况，并能将其与对话中的填充内容区分开来。我们的研究为开发更可靠、更值得信赖的对话机器人提供了基础性的方法论支持。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Black-Box Labels: Interpretable Criteria for Diagnosing Subjective NLP Tasks
papers.title_zh: 超越黑箱标签：用于诊断主观自然语言处理任务的可解释性标准
papers.authors: Nisrine Rair, Alban Goupil, Valeriu Vrabie, Emmanuel Chochoy
papers.abstract: Subjective NLP datasets typically aggregate annotator judgments into a single gold label, making it difficult to diagnose whether disagreement reflects unclear criteria, collapsed distinctions, or legitimate plurality. We propose a schema-level diagnostic for auditing expert-designed annotation schemas prior to gold-label commitment, using only multi-annotator criterion judgments. The diagnostic separates two failure modes: unstable criteria with hard-to-operationalize boundaries, and systematic overlap that blurs the boundaries between mutually exclusive categories. Applied to persuasive value extraction in commercial documents, we find that disagreement is not diffuse: instability concentrates in a few criteria, while nearly half of covered sentences activate multiple categories. These signals align with where domain experts disagree, yielding an evidence-based audit for tightening guidelines, revising category structure, or reconsidering the annotation paradigm.
papers.abstract_zh: 主观的自然语言处理数据集通常会将注释者的判断汇总为一个单一的“黄金标签”，这使得难以判断这种不一致性是由于标准不明确、分类界限模糊，还是存在合理的多样性。我们提出了一种基于模式层面的诊断方法，用于在确定“黄金标签”之前审核专家设计的注释模式。该方法仅使用多注释者之间的标准判断来进行分析。该诊断方法能够区分两种失败模式：一种是标准不稳定，其边界难以操作化；另一种是系统性重叠，导致互斥类别之间的界限变得模糊。在商业文档的说服力价值提取领域应用这一方法后，我们发现这种不一致性并非普遍现象：不稳定性主要集中在少数几个标准中，而几乎一半的句子中存在多个类别的适用情况。这些信号与领域专家的分歧点相一致，从而为加强指导方针、修订类别结构或重新考虑注释方式提供了依据。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AutoRubric: Rubric-Based Generative Rewards for Faithful Multimodal Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 自动评分标准：基于评分标准的生成式奖励机制，用于促进可靠的多模态推理
papers.authors: Mengzhao Jia, Zhihan Zhang, Ignacio Cases, Zheyuan Liu, Meng Jiang, Peng Qi
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have rapidly advanced from perception tasks to complex multi-step reasoning, yet reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often leads to spurious reasoning since only the final-answer correctness is rewarded. To address this limitation, we propose AutoRubric, a framework that integrates RLVR with process-level supervision through automatically collected rubric-based generative rewards. Our key innovation lies in a scalable self-aggregation method that distills consistent reasoning checkpoints from successful trajectories, enabling problem-specific rubric construction without human annotation or stronger teacher models. By jointly leveraging rubric-based and outcome rewards, AutoRubric-R1V achieves state-of-the-art performance on six multimodal reasoning benchmarks and substantially improves reasoning faithfulness in dedicated evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型已经从感知任务迅速发展到复杂的多步骤推理能力。然而，带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）往往会导致错误的推理行为，因为系统只根据最终答案的正确性来给予奖励。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了AutoRubric框架。该框架将RLVR与过程级监督相结合，通过自动收集的基于评分标准的生成式奖励来实现这一过程。我们的关键创新在于一种可扩展的自聚合方法，它能够从成功的推理轨迹中提取出一致的推理 checkpoint，从而无需人工注释或依赖更强的教师模型即可构建针对特定问题的评分标准。通过同时利用评分标准和结果奖励，AutoRubric-R1V在六个多模态推理基准测试中的表现达到了最先进水平，并且在专门设计的评估中显著提高了推理的可靠性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HER: Human-like Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning for LLM Role-playing
papers.title_zh: 她：适用于大型语言模型角色扮演的人类式推理与强化学习
papers.authors: Chengyu Du, Xintao Wang, Aili Chen, Weiyuan Li, Rui Xu, Junteng Liu, Zishan Huang, Rong Tian, Zijun Sun, Yuhao Li, Liheng Feng, Deming Ding, Pengyu Zhao, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: LLM role-playing, i.e., using large language models (LLMs) to simulate specific personas, has emerged as a key capability in various applications, such as companionship, content creation, and digital games. While current models effectively capture character tones and knowledge, simulating the inner thoughts behind their behaviors remains a non-trivial challenge. Towards cognitive simulation in LLM role-play, previous efforts have mainly suffered from two critical deficiencies: the lack of high-quality datasets with explicit reasoning traces and the absence of reliable reward signals aligned with human preferences. In this paper, we propose HER (Human Emulation Reasoning), a unified framework for cognitive-level persona simulation. HER introduces a dual-layer thinking mechanism that strictly distinguishes characters’ first-person thinking processes from LLMs’ third-person reasoning. To bridge the aforementioned gaps, we curate a reasoning-augmented role-playing dataset via a reverse engineering strategy for supervised learning, and construct human-aligned evaluation principles and preference-based reward models for role-play reinforcement learning. Leveraging these resources, we train HER models based on the Qwen3-32B backbone via a hybrid paradigm of supervised learning (SL) and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach. Notably, our models significantly outperform the Qwen3-32B baseline, achieving a 30.26% on the CoSER benchmark and a 14.97% on the MiniMax Benchmark. Our datasets, evaluation principles, and trained models will be released to facilitate future research in cognitive-level LLM role-playing.
papers.abstract_zh: 角色扮演式的大语言模型应用，即利用大语言模型来模拟特定角色的行为，已经成为了各种应用场景中的关键能力，比如陪伴、内容创作以及数字游戏。虽然当前的模型能够很好地捕捉角色的语气和知识，但要模拟其行为背后的内心想法仍然是一个非易事。在LLM角色扮演的认知模拟方面，之前的努力主要存在两个关键缺陷：缺乏具有明确推理痕迹的高质量数据集，以及缺乏与人类偏好相一致的可靠奖励信号。在本文中，我们提出了HER（人类仿真推理）这一用于认知层面角色模拟的统一框架。HER引入了一种双层思维机制，能够严格区分角色的第一人称思考过程与大语言模型的三人称推理过程。为了弥补上述不足，我们通过逆向工程策略构建了一个带有推理增强的角色扮演数据集，用于监督学习；同时，我们还构建了符合人类偏好的评估原则和基于偏好的奖励模型，以用于角色扮演的强化学习。借助这些资源，我们基于Qwen3-32B主干模型，采用监督学习和从人类反馈中学习的强化学习混合范式来训练HER模型。大量的实验验证了我们的方法的有效性。值得注意的是，我们的模型显著优于Qwen3-32B基线模型，在CoSER基准测试上的表现提升了30.26%，在MiniMax基准测试上的表现提升了14.97%。我们的数据集、评估原则和训练好的模型将被公开，以便为未来关于认知层面LLM角色扮演的研究提供支持。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Do Generalisation Results Generalise?
papers.title_zh: 这些概括性结果真的具有普遍性吗？
papers.authors: Matteo Boglioni, Andrea Sgobbi, Gabriel Tavernini, Francesco Rita, Marius Mosbach, Tiago Pimentel
papers.abstract: A large language model’s (LLM’s) out-of-distribution (OOD) generalisation is crucial to its deployment. Previous work assessing LLMs’ generalisation performance, however, typically focuses on a single out-of-distribution dataset. This approach may fail to precisely evaluate the capabilities of the model, as the data shifts encountered during deployment are much more diverse. In this work, we investigate whether OOD generalisation results generalise. More specifically, we evaluate a model’s performance across multiple OOD testsets throughout a finetuning run; we then evaluate the partial correlation of performances across these testsets, regressing out in-domain performance. This allows us to assess how correlated are generalisation performances once in-domain performance is controlled for. Analysing OLMo, OPT and SmolLM, we observe no overarching trend in generalisation results: the existence of a positive or negative correlation between any two OOD testsets depends strongly on the specific choice of model analysed.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的超出分布范围（OOD）泛化能力对其部署至关重要。然而，以往评估LLM泛化性能的研究通常只关注单一超出分布范围的数据集。这种方法可能无法准确评估模型的性能，因为在实际部署过程中遇到的数据变化要更加多样化。在这项研究中，我们探讨了OOD泛化结果是否具有普遍性。更具体地说，我们在一次微调过程中，通过多个OOD测试集来评估模型的性能；然后，我们评估这些测试集之间性能的部分相关性，从而剔除特定领域性能的影响。这样，我们就可以在控制特定领域性能的情况下，评估泛化性能之间的相关性。通过对OLMo、OPT和SmolLM进行分析，我们发现泛化结果并没有明显的趋势：任意两个OOD测试集之间存在正相关或负相关的情况，这很大程度上取决于所分析的模型类型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Do LLMs Overthink Basic Math Reasoning? Benchmarking the Accuracy-Efficiency Tradeoff in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型是否会过度思考基础数学推理问题？评估语言模型在准确性与效率之间的权衡关系
papers.authors: Gaurav Srivastava, Aafiya Shamshad Hussain, Sriram Srinivasan, Xuan Wang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve impressive performance on complex mathematical benchmarks yet sometimes fail on basic math reasoning while generating unnecessarily verbose responses. In this paper, we present LLMThinkBench, a systematic benchmark and comprehensive empirical study to evaluate the efficiency of reasoning in LLMs, focusing on the fundamental tradeoff between accuracy and overthinking. First, we formalize the accuracy-verbosity tradeoff. Second, we introduce the Overthinking Score, a harmonic-mean metric combining accuracy and token-efficiency for holistic model evaluation. Third, we establish an evaluation protocol with dynamically-generated data across 14 basic math tasks. Fourth, we conduct a large-scale empirical study evaluating 53 LLMs, including reasoning and quantized variants across different reasoning budgets. Fifth, we release LLMThinkBench as an open-source Python package and public leaderboard for reproducibility. Our findings reveal: 1) model performance on complex benchmarks does not translate directly to basic math reasoning; 2) reasoning models generate \sim18\times more tokens while sometimes achieving lower accuracy and exhibit catastrophic collapse when tokens are constrained, dropping by up to \sim36%; 3) the accuracy-verbosity relationship is non-monotonic with extended reasoning budgets yielding diminishing returns (GPT-5/o-series models show zero accuracy gain from low \rightarrow medium \rightarrow high reasoning effort). Our findings challenge the assumption that longer reasoning in LLMs necessarily improves mathematical reasoning. Our public leaderboard is available at https://ctrl-gaurav.github.io/LLMThinkBench/. Our open-source Python package is available at https://pypi.org/project/llmthinkbench/, and the codebase can be found at https://github.com/ctrl-gaurav/LLMThinkBench for easy and reproducible evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在复杂的数学基准测试中表现出色，但在进行基本数学推理时有时会失败，同时还会生成不必要的冗长回答。在本文中，我们提出了LLMThinkBench，这是一个系统化的基准测试以及全面的实证研究，旨在评估语言模型中的推理效率，重点关注准确性与过度推理之间的基本权衡。首先，我们将准确性与简洁性之间的权衡形式化。其次，我们引入了Overthinking Score这一综合指标，该指标结合了准确性和令牌效率，用于全面评估模型性能。第三，我们建立了一个评估协议，使用动态生成的数据对14项基本数学任务进行评估。第四，我们进行了一项大规模实证研究，评估了53种语言模型在不同推理预算下的表现，包括推理模型和量化版本。第五，我们将LLMThinkBench作为开源的Python包发布，并提供了公开的排行榜，以便进行可复现性的评估。我们的研究发现表明：1）模型在复杂基准测试中的表现并不能直接转化为基本数学推理；2）推理模型在推理过程中会生成大约18倍的更多令牌，但有时准确率会下降，并且在令牌受限的情况下会出现灾难性的崩溃，令牌数量最多会减少约36%；3）准确性与简洁性之间的关系是非单调的，随着推理预算的增加，收益会逐渐减少（GPT-5/o系列模型在从低到高的推理努力下，准确率几乎没有提升）。我们的研究结果挑战了这样一个假设：语言模型中的更长推理过程必然能改善数学推理能力。我们的公开排行榜可以在https://ctrl-gaurav.github.io/LLMThinkBench/查看。我们的开源Python包可以在https://pypi.org/project/llmthinkbench/下载，而代码库则可以在https://github.com/ctrl-gaurav/LLMThinkBench找到，方便进行可复现性的评估。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PV-SQL: Synergizing Database Probing and Rule-based Verification for Text-to-SQL Agents
papers.title_zh: PV-SQL：结合数据库探测与规则验证的技术，用于文本转SQL代理工具
papers.authors: Yuan Tian, Tianyi Zhang
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems often struggle with deep contextual understanding, particularly for complex queries with subtle requirements.We present PV-SQL, an agentic framework that addresses these failures through two complementary components: Probe and Verify. The Probe component iteratively generates probing queries to retrieve concrete records from the database, resolving ambiguities in value formats, column semantics, and inter-table relationships to build richer contextual understanding. The Verify component employs a rule-based method to extract verifiable conditions and construct an executable checklist, enabling iterative SQL refinement that effectively reduces missing constraints. Experiments on the BIRD benchmarks show that PV-SQL outperforms the best text-to-SQL baseline by 5% in execution accuracy and 20.8% in valid efficiency score while consuming fewer tokens.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本转SQL系统通常在深度上下文理解方面存在困难，尤其是在处理具有微妙要求的复杂查询时。我们提出了PV-SQL这一代理框架，它通过两个互补的组件来克服这些挑战：探测组件和验证组件。探测组件会逐步生成探测性查询，以从数据库中检索具体记录，解决数值格式、列语义以及表间关系等方面的歧义问题，从而构建更丰富的上下文理解能力。验证组件则采用基于规则的方法提取可验证的条件，并构建可执行的检查清单，从而实现迭代性的SQL优化，有效减少缺失的约束条件。在BIRD基准测试中的实验表明，PV-SQL在执行准确性和有效效率评分方面分别比最佳文本转SQL基线高出5%和20.8%，同时使用的令牌数量也更少。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Anatomy of Unlearning: The Dual Impact of Fact Salience and Model Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 遗忘的机理：事实显著性与模型微调的双重影响
papers.authors: Anna Borisiuk, Andrey Savchenko, Alexander Panchenko, Elena Tutubalina
papers.abstract: Machine Unlearning (MU) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to remove unsafe or outdated information. However, existing work assumes that all facts are equally forgettable and largely ignores whether the forgotten knowledge originates from pretraining or supervised fine-tuning (SFT). In this paper, we introduce DUAL (Dual Unlearning Evaluation across Training Stages), a benchmark of 28.6k Wikidata-derived triplets annotated with fact popularity using Wikipedia link counts and LLM-based salience scores. Our experiments show that pretrained and SFT models respond differently to unlearning. An SFT step on the forget data yields smoother forgetting, more stable tuning, and 10–50% higher retention, while direct unlearning on pretrained models remains unstable and prone to relearning or catastrophic forgetting.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器去学习技术（Machine Unlearning，简称MU）使得大语言模型能够去除那些不安全或过时的信息。然而，现有的研究假设所有事实都同样容易被遗忘，而完全忽略了被遗忘的知识是源自于预训练还是监督式微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning，简称SFT）。在本文中，我们提出了DUAL方法，这是一种针对训练阶段的双重去学习评估方法。我们收集了28.6k个基于Wikidata的事实三元组，这些三元组通过维基百科链接计数和基于语言模型的显著性评分来标注其重要性。我们的实验表明，预训练和SFT模型对去学习的反应有所不同。对预训练模型进行SFT处理可以使其遗忘过程更加平滑，调优效果更稳定，并且记忆能力提高10-50%。而直接对预训练模型进行去学习则会导致模型不稳定，容易出现重新学习或灾难性遗忘的情况。

papers.title: What Do Neural Speech Models Know About Phonology? Evidence from Structured Phoneme Confusions
papers.title_zh: 神经语音模型对音系学了解多少？来自结构化音素混淆现象的证据
papers.authors: Eli Stafford, Aimée Lahaussois, Guillaume Wisniewski
papers.abstract: ASR errors are typically analysed at the phoneme level, treating phonemes as atomic symbols. In this work, we instead adopt a featural representation of phonemes, grounded in phonological theory, which models speech sounds as structured bundles of distinctive articulatory and acoustic properties. This perspective allows us to analyse recognition errors at a finer granularity and to investigate whether certain phonological features are more vulnerable than others. Across multiple languages, we show that phoneme confusions are strongly structured in phonological feature space: errors are predominantly local and exhibit systematic asymmetries that reveal a small set of weakly modelled features. These findings have direct implications both for the design and diagnosis of ASR systems and for cognitive models of human speech perception, where similar feature-level asymmetries have long been observed.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动语音识别系统中的错误通常在音素层面进行分析，将音素视为基本单位。在这项研究中，我们采用了一种基于音系理论的音素特征表示方式，该表示方式将语音声音建模为具有特定发音和声学特性的结构化组合。这种分析方法使我们能够更细致地分析识别错误，并探究某些音系特征是否比其他特征更容易出现错误。通过对多种语言的对比研究，我们发现音素混淆在音系特征空间中具有明显的结构特征：错误通常局限于局部区域，并且表现出系统性的不对称现象，这表明有一些被忽视的特征导致了错误发生。这些发现对于自动语音识别系统的设计和诊断，以及人类语音感知的认知模型都有重要的启示作用，因为在认知模型中也经常观察到类似的特征级不对称性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rerank Before You Reason: Analyzing Reranking Tradeoffs through Effective Token Cost in Deep Search Agents
papers.title_zh: 在推理之前进行重新排序：通过有效的代币成本来分析深度搜索智能体中的重新排序权衡
papers.authors: Sahel Sharifymoghaddam, Jimmy Lin
papers.abstract: Deep research agents rely on iterative retrieval and reasoning to answer complex queries, but scaling test-time computation raises significant efficiency concerns. We study how to allocate reasoning budget in deep search pipelines, focusing on the role of listwise reranking. Using the BrowseComp-Plus benchmark, we analyze tradeoffs between model scale, reasoning effort, reranking depth, and total token cost via a novel effective token cost (ETC) metric. Our results show that reranking consistently improves retrieval and end-to-end accuracy, and that moderate reranking often yields larger gains than increasing search-time reasoning, achieving comparable accuracy at substantially lower cost. All our code is available at https://github.com/sahel-sh/DeepHone.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度搜索代理依靠迭代检索和推理来回答复杂的查询问题，但测试时间的扩展会引发显著的效率问题。我们研究了如何在深度搜索流程中分配推理资源，重点关注列表式重排序的作用。通过使用BrowseComp-Plus基准测试，我们通过一种新的有效令牌成本指标，分析了模型规模、推理工作量、重排序深度以及总令牌成本之间的权衡关系。我们的研究结果表明，重排序能够持续提升检索效率和端到端准确率，而且适度的重排序通常比增加搜索时的推理时间能带来更大的收益，同时可以在较低的成本下实现相当高的准确率。我们的所有代码都可以在https://github.com/sahel-sh/DeepHone上找到。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Position: LLM Watermarking Should Align Stakeholders’ Incentives for Practical Adoption
papers.title_zh: 立场：深度学习模型水印技术应该符合各相关方的利益诉求，这样才能在实际应用中得到广泛采用
papers.authors: Yepeng Liu, Xuandong Zhao, Dawn Song, Gregory W. Wornell, Yuheng Bu
papers.abstract: Despite progress in watermarking algorithms for large language models (LLMs), real-world deployment remains limited. We argue that this gap stems from misaligned incentives among LLM providers, platforms, and end users, which manifest as three key barriers: competitive risk, detection-tool governance, and attribution issues. We revisit three classes of watermarking through this lens. Model watermarking naturally aligns with LLM provider interests, yet faces new challenges in open-source ecosystems. LLM text watermarking offers modest provider benefit when framed solely as an anti-misuse tool, but can gain traction in narrowly scoped settings such as dataset de-contamination or user-controlled provenance. In-context watermarking (ICW) is tailored for trusted parties, such as conference organizers or educators, who embed hidden watermarking instructions into documents. If a dishonest reviewer or student submits this text to an LLM, the output carries a detectable watermark indicating misuse. This setup aligns incentives: users experience no quality loss, trusted parties gain a detection tool, and LLM providers remain neutral by simply following watermark instructions. We advocate for a broader exploration of incentive-aligned methods, with ICW as an example, in domains where trusted parties need reliable tools to detect misuse. More broadly, we distill design principles for incentive-aligned, domain-specific watermarking and outline future research directions. Our position is that the practical adoption of LLM watermarking requires aligning stakeholder incentives in targeted application domains and fostering active community engagement.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在大语言模型的水印算法方面已经取得了进展，但在实际部署方面仍然存在局限性。我们认为，这种差距源于大语言模型提供商、平台和终端用户之间缺乏协同的激励机制，这导致了三个主要障碍：竞争风险、检测工具的管理问题以及归属权问题。我们从这一角度重新审视了三类水印技术。模型水印自然符合大语言模型提供商的利益，但在开源生态系统中面临着新的挑战。当仅将其视为一种防止滥用的工具时，大语言模型文本水印可以为提供者带来一定的好处，但在数据集去污染或用户控制的来源等特定场景下，这种水印技术可能会取得更好的效果。上下文水印技术则适用于可信方，如会议组织者或教育工作者，他们可以在文档中嵌入隐藏的水印指令。如果不诚实的评审员或学生将此类文本提交给大语言模型，那么输出结果会带有可检测的水印，从而表明该文本已被滥用。这种设置能够协调各方利益：用户不会感受到质量下降，可信方可以获得检测工具，而大语言模型提供商则可以通过遵循水印指令来保持中立立场。我们主张在需要可信方使用可靠工具来检测滥用的领域，更广泛地探索与激励机制相一致的方案，以上下文水印技术为例。更广泛地说，我们总结了与激励机制相一致的、特定领域的水印技术设计原则，并指出了未来的研究方向。我们认为，要真正实现大语言模型水印技术的应用，就需要在特定应用领域协调各利益相关方的激励机制，并促进社区的积极参与。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Learning to Refine: Self-Refinement of Parallel Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 学会精益求精：在大型语言模型中提升并行推理能力
papers.authors: Qibin Wang, Pu Zhao, Shaohan Huang, Fangkai Yang, Lu Wang, Furu Wei, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) has gained widespread attention for enhancing LLM reasoning. Existing approaches such as Best-of-N and majority voting are limited as their performance depends on the quality of candidate responses, making them unable to produce a correct solution when all candidates are incorrect. Parallel self-refinement, generating multiple candidates and synthesizing a refined answer conditioned on them, offers a promising alternative, but the underlying mechanism driving its effectiveness remains obscure. To bridge this gap in understanding, we introduce a new metric, the Refinement Gap, designed to quantify the relative improvement of self-refinement beyond majority voting. We show that the Refinement Gap exhibits a clear scaling trend with model size and is only weakly correlated with the base capability. Based on this discovery, we propose Generative Self-Refinement (GSR), a parallel test-time scaling framework that transfers the refinement policy from larger teacher models with higher refinement gap into smaller students. Crucially, GSR jointly trains a single model to generate strong candidates and refine a better final answer based on these candidates. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across five mathematical benchmarks over other parallel aggregation methods, while the learned refinement skill transfers across multiple model scales and families and exhibits robust generalization to an out-of-distribution domain.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时间缩放技术因能提升大语言模型的推理能力而受到广泛关注。现有的方法如最佳选择法和多数投票法存在局限性，因为它们的性能取决于候选答案的质量，当所有候选答案都错误时，这些方法无法得出正确的解决方案。并行自我精炼技术通过生成多个候选答案，并基于这些候选答案来合成更完善的答案，提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但其有效机制仍不清楚。为了填补这一知识空白，我们提出了一种新的度量指标——精炼差距，用于量化自我精炼相对于多数投票法的改进程度。我们发现，精炼差距随着模型规模的增加而呈现明显的增长趋势，且与基础能力的相关性较弱。基于这一发现，我们提出了生成式自我精炼技术，这是一种并行测试时间缩放框架，它将精炼策略从具有更高精炼差距的大型教师模型中转移到了小型学生模型中。关键之处在于，GSR能够联合训练单个模型，以生成优秀的候选答案，并基于这些候选答案来精炼出更好的最终答案。实验结果表明，与其它并行聚合方法相比，我们的方法在五个数学基准测试中均取得了最先进的性能表现，而且所学习的精炼技能能够在不同的模型规模和家族间进行迁移，并且能够在非分布领域的测试中表现出强大的泛化能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AUDITA: A New Dataset to Audit Humans vs. AI Skill at Audio QA
papers.title_zh: AUDITA：一个新的数据集，用于评估人类与人工智能在音频问答任务中的能力差异
papers.authors: Tasnim Kabir, Dmytro Kurdydyk, Aadi Palnitkar, Liam Dorn, Ahmed Haj Ahmed, Jordan Lee Boyd-Graber
papers.abstract: Existing audio question answering benchmarks largely emphasize sound event classification or caption-grounded queries, often enabling models to succeed through shortcut strategies, short-duration cues, lexical priors, dataset-specific biases, or even bypassing audio via metadata and captions rather than genuine reasoning Thus, we present AUDITA (Audio Understanding from Diverse Internet Trivia Authors), a large-scale, real-world benchmark to rigorously evaluate audio reasoning beyond surface-level acoustic recognition. AUDITA comprises carefully curated, human-authored trivia questions grounded in real-world audio, designed to stress robust auditory reasoning through challenging distractors and long-range temporal dependencies, using probing queries that cannot be answered from isolated text or sound cues alone. Human average accuracy of 32.13% shows both the challenge of the task while demonstrating meaningful comprehension of the audio. In stark contrast, state-of-the- art audio question answering models perform poorly, with average accuracy below 8.86%. Beyond raw accuracy, we apply Item Response Theory (IRT) to estimate latent proficiency, question difficulty, and expose systematic deficiencies of the models and data.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的音频问答基准测试大多侧重于声音事件分类或基于字幕的查询，这些模型通常通过捷径策略、短期线索、词汇先验知识、特定数据集的偏见，甚至是通过元数据与字幕而不是直接推理来处理音频问题。因此，我们提出了AUDITA（来自不同互联网问题的音频理解挑战），这是一个大规模的真实世界基准测试，旨在严格评估超出表面声学识别水平的音频推理能力。AUDITA包含精心挑选的、由人类编写的问题，这些问题基于真实世界的音频数据，旨在通过具有挑战性的干扰项和长期时间依赖性来考验模型的听觉推理能力。这些问题的答案无法仅通过孤立的文本或声音线索来得出。人类在测试中的平均准确率为32.13%，这既体现了该任务的难度，也表明了人们对音频数据的有效理解能力。相比之下，最先进的音频问答模型表现较差，平均准确率低于8.86%。除了单纯的准确率之外，我们还应用了项目反应理论来估计潜在的能力水平、问题难度，并揭示出模型和数据的系统性缺陷。

papers.title: NeoAraBERT: A Modern Foundation Model for Arabic Embeddings with Diacritics-Aware Tokenization and POS-Targeted Masking
papers.title_zh: NeoAraBERT：一种现代的基础模型，适用于阿拉伯语嵌入处理，能够考虑标点符号的区分性，并实现基于词性目标的掩码操作
papers.authors: Chadi Abou Chakra, Hadi Khaled Hamoud, Osama Rakan Al Mraikhat, Qusai Abu Obaida, Mohamad Ballout, Fadi Zaraket
papers.abstract: We present NeoAraBERT, a state-of-the-art open-source Arabic text-embedding model built on the NeoBERT architecture. We pre-train NeoAraBERT on diverse open-source and internal datasets covering modern standard, classical, and dialectal Arabic. We guided our design choices with Arabic tailored ablation studies including text normalization, light stemming, and diacritics-aware tokenization handling. We also performed more general POS-aware token masking and learning-rate scheduling ablation studies. We benchmarked NeoAraBERT against five top-performing Arabic models on 23 tasks, including a novel synonym-based task, “Muradif”, that directly assesses embedding quality with no additional fine-tuning. NeoAraBERT variants (MSA, dialectal, and mixed) rank first in 18 tasks, second in two, third in two, and fourth in one task. They show strong performance on classical and modern standard Arabic, substantial margins of improvement (>7%) in two tasks, and a +2.75% improvement on average across all tasks. Our code and links to checkpoints for our model variants are available on our website: https://acr.ps/neoarabert.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了NeoAraBERT，这是一个基于NeoBERT架构构建的先进开源阿拉伯语文本嵌入模型。我们在涵盖现代标准阿拉伯语、古典阿拉伯语以及方言阿拉伯语的多种开源和内部数据集上对NeoAraBERT进行了预训练。在设计过程中，我们采用了针对阿拉伯语的专门 ablation 研究，包括文本标准化、轻量级词干提取以及考虑变音符号的标记化处理。我们还进行了更为通用的基于词性标记的掩码处理以及学习率调度方面的ablation研究。在23项任务中，我们将NeoAraBERT与五款表现最佳的阿拉伯语模型进行了对比测试，其中包括一项新颖的基于同义词的任务“Muradif”，该任务能够直接评估嵌入质量，无需额外的微调。NeoAraBERT的不同变体（标准阿拉伯语、方言阿拉伯语以及混合语码）在18项任务中排名第一，在两项任务中排名第二，在两项任务中排名第三，在一项任务中排名第四。这些变体在古典阿拉伯语和现代标准阿拉伯语方面表现出强大的性能，在两项任务中取得了显著的改进幅度（超过7%），而在所有任务中的平均改进幅度为+2.75%。我们的模型变体的代码以及检查点的链接都可以在我们的网站上找到：https://acr.ps/neoarabert

papers.title: Steering Away from Refusal: A Black-box Jailbreak Method Based on First-Token Distribution
papers.title_zh: 避免被拒绝的方法：一种基于首次访问token分配的黑盒越狱技术
papers.authors: Shuangjie Fu, Du Su, Xin Chen, Fei Sun, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Investigating black-box jailbreak attacks is crucial for revealing the actual security risks faced by operational Large Language Models (LLMs). The primary challenge in black-box jailbreak attack is the absence of direct optimization signals, such as gradients, to guide the refinement of adversarial prompts. While current mainstream methods like PAIR and TAP attempt to leverage the model’s textual output as feedback, facing a critical limitation when models consistently generate static refusal responses, depriving the attacker of any actionable signal to distinguish better prompts. To overcome the bottleneck and reveal whether there is potential risk to open access to partial logprobs information, we investigate LLM output distribution. Our empirical analysis reveals that refusal responses exhibit a highly consistent distributional pattern at the first generated token, suggesting that the deviation from this standard pattern can serve as a quantifiable metric for LLM generating refusal response. Based on this insight, we propose Distribution Jailbreak (DJ), an attack method that select effective jailbreak templates and then iteratively optimizes adversarial suffixes by maximizing the KL divergence from the standard refusal distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DJ achieves state-of-the-art Attack Success Rate(ASR). Notably, DJ achieves over 90% ASR on all tested open-source models, and delivers over 94% ASR on GPT-4.1. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zed630/DistributionJailbreak.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究黑盒越狱攻击对于揭示大语言模型在实际运行中面临的安全风险至关重要。黑盒越狱攻击的主要挑战在于缺乏直接的优化信号，比如梯度信息，来指导对抗性提示的改进。目前主流的方法如PAIR和TAP试图利用模型的文本输出作为反馈，但当模型始终生成相同的拒绝响应时，这些方法就遇到了严重的问题，因为攻击者无法获得任何可操作的信号来筛选出更有效的提示。为了克服这一瓶颈，并揭示对部分日志概率信息的开放访问是否存在潜在风险，我们研究了语言模型的输出分布。我们的实证分析表明，拒绝响应在第一个生成的令牌上表现出高度一致的分布模式，这意味着偏离这种标准模式可以成为衡量语言模型生成拒绝响应的量化指标。基于这一发现，我们提出了分布越狱方法——通过选择有效的越狱模板，然后通过最大化与标准拒绝分布之间的KL散度来迭代优化对抗性后缀。大量实验表明，该方法的攻击成功率达到了最先进水平。值得注意的是，该方法在所有测试过的开源模型中实现了超过90%的攻击成功率，而在GPT-4.1上的成功率超过了94%。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Zed630/DistributionJailbreak上获取。

papers.title: Mina: A Multilingual LLM-Powered Legal Assistant Agent for Empowering Access to Justice in Bangladesh
papers.title_zh: 米娜：一种支持多语言处理的大型语言模型驱动的法律助手机器人，旨在帮助孟加拉国民众更好地获得司法服务
papers.authors: Azmine Toushik Wasi, Wahid Faisal, Mst Rafia Islam, Md Rizwan Parvez
papers.abstract: Bangladesh’s low-income population faces major barriers to affordable legal advice due to complex legal language, procedural opacity, and high costs. Existing AI legal assistants lack Bengali-language support and jurisdiction-specific adaptation, limiting their effectiveness. To address this, we developed Mina, a multilingual LLM-based legal assistant tailored for the Bangladeshi context. It employs multilingual embeddings and a RAG-based chain-of-tools framework for retrieval, reasoning, translation, and document generation, delivering context-aware legal drafts, citations, and plain-language explanations via an interactive chat interface. Evaluated by law faculty from leading Bangladeshi universities across all stages of the 2022 and 2023 Bangladesh Bar Council examinations, Mina achieved scores of 75–80% in the preliminary MCQs, written, and simulated viva voce components. These results matched or surpassed average human performance, demonstrating strong clarity, contextual understanding, and sound legal reasoning, while operating at approximately 0.1-0.6% of the cost of human lawyers. These results confirm its potential as a low-cost, multilingual AI assistant that automates key legal tasks and scales access to justice, offering a real-world details on building domain-specific, low-resource systems and addressing challenges of multilingual adaptation, efficiency, and sustainable public-service AI deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 孟加拉国的低收入人群由于复杂的法律语言、不透明的程序流程以及高昂的成本，难以获得负担得起的法律咨询。现有的AI法律助手缺乏孟加拉语支持，也无法根据具体的司法管辖区进行适配，这限制了它们的有效性。为了应对这一问题，我们开发了Mina——一款专为孟加拉国环境定制的多语言LLM法律助手。该助手采用多语言嵌入技术，并基于RAG技术的工具链框架来进行检索、推理、翻译和文档生成，通过交互式聊天界面提供具有上下文意识的法律草案、引用以及通俗易懂的解释。在2022年和2023年孟加拉国律师协会考试的所有阶段中，由来自孟加拉国顶尖大学的法学教师对Mina进行了评估，结果显示，Mina在初步选择题、笔试以及模拟面试环节中的得分达到了75%-80%。这些成绩不仅超过了人类的平均水平，还展现了其强大的清晰度、上下文理解能力以及合理的法律推理能力。同时，Mina的运行成本仅为人类律师的0.1%-0.6%。这些结果证明了Mina作为一款低成本、多语言AI助手的潜力，它能够自动化关键的法律任务，并扩大人们对正义的获取途径。这些成果为构建特定领域的低资源系统提供了实际经验，同时也解决了多语言适配、效率提升以及可持续公共服务AI部署方面的挑战。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Context-Aware ASR for Diverse Arabic Varieties
papers.title_zh: 适用于多种阿拉伯语变体的零样本上下文感知自动语音识别技术
papers.authors: Bashar Talafha, Amin Abu Alhassan, Muhammad Abdul-Mageed
papers.abstract: Zero-shot ASR for Arabic remains challenging: while multilingual models perform well on Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), error rates rise sharply on dialectal and accented speech due to linguistic mismatch and scarce labeled data. We study \textit{context-aware} decoding as a lightweight test-time adaptation paradigm that conditions inference on external side information without parameter updates. For promptable encoder–decoder ASR (e.g., Whisper), we incorporate context through (i) decoder prompting with first-pass hypotheses and (ii) encoder/decoder prefixing with retrieved speech-text exemplars, complemented by simple prompt reordering and optional speaker-matched synthetic exemplars to improve robustness in informal and multi-speaker settings. To extend contextual adaptation beyond promptable architectures, we introduce \textit{proxy-guided $n$-best selection} for CTC ASR: given one or more external proxy hypotheses, we select from a model’s n-best list by minimizing text-level distance to the proxies, enabling contextual inference without direct prompting. Across ten Arabic conditions spanning MSA, accented MSA, and multiple dialects, the best-performing context-aware variants yield average relative WER reductions of 22.29% on MSA, 20.54% on accented MSA, and 9.15% on dialectal Arabic. For CTC ASR on our Common Voice MSA testbed, proxy-guided selection reduces WER by 15.6% relative and recovers a substantial fraction of oracle n-best gains, showing that external-context guidance can also benefit non-promptable ASR.
papers.abstract_zh: 零样本阿拉伯语自动语音识别仍然具有挑战性：虽然多语言模型在标准阿拉伯语上的表现良好，但在方言和口音不同的语音上，由于语言差异和标注数据的不足，错误率会急剧上升。我们研究了“上下文感知”的解码方法，作为一种轻量级的时间测试适应策略，该策略无需参数更新即可根据外部信息来调整推理过程。对于可提示的编码器-解码器自动语音识别系统（例如Whisper），我们通过以下方式引入上下文信息：(i) 使用初步的假设进行解码器提示；(ii) 在编码器/解码器前添加检索到的语音-文本示例，并辅以简单的提示重排序以及可选的与说话者匹配的合成示例，以提高在非正式和多说话者环境中的鲁棒性。为了将上下文适应扩展到非提示式架构，我们提出了一种“代理引导的$n$个最佳选择”方法，用于CTC自动语音识别：给定一个或多个外部代理假设，我们可以通过最小化文本级别与代理假设的差距来从模型的$n$个最佳选择中选取最优方案，从而实现无需直接提示即可进行上下文推理。在涵盖标准阿拉伯语、带口音的标准阿拉伯语以及多种方言的十种阿拉伯语条件下，性能最佳的上下文感知变体分别使标准阿拉伯语的相对词正确率降低了22.29%，带口音的标准阿拉伯语降低了20.54%，而方言阿拉伯语则降低了9.15%。在我们的Common Voice标准阿拉伯语测试平台上，代理引导的选择方法使词正确率相对降低了15.6%，并且恢复了相当一部分原本可以通过直接提示获得的优势，这表明外部上下文指导同样适用于非提示式自动语音识别系统。

papers.title: The Sonar Moment: An Audio Geo-Localization Benchmark for Audio-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 声纳时刻：一种用于音频语言模型的音频地理定位基准测试
papers.authors: Ruixing Zhang, Zihan Liu, Leilei Sun, Tongyu Zhu, Weifeng Lv
papers.abstract: Geo-localization aims to infer the geographic origin of a given signal. In computer vision, geo-localization has served as a demanding benchmark for compositional reasoning and is relevant to public safety. In contrast, progress on audio geo-localization has been constrained by the lack of high-quality audio-location pairs. To address this gap, we introduce AGL1K, the first audio geo-localization benchmark for audio language models (ALMs), spanning 72 countries and territories. To extract reliably localizable samples from a crowd-sourced platform, we propose the Audio Localizability metric that quantifies the informativeness of each recording, yielding 1,444 curated audio clips. Evaluations on 16 ALMs show that ALMs have emerged with audio geo-localization capability. We find that closed-source models substantially outperform open-source models, and that linguistic clues often dominate as a scaffold for prediction. We further analyze ALMs’ reasoning traces, regional bias, error causes, and the interpretability of the localizability metric. Overall, AGL1K establishes a benchmark for audio geo-localization and may advance ALMs with better geospatial reasoning capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 地理定位的目的是确定给定信号的地理位置。在计算机视觉领域，地理定位已成为组合推理的一个高难度基准测试，且与公共安全密切相关。相比之下，音频地理定位方面的进展受到了缺乏高质量音频定位对的限制。为了弥补这一不足，我们推出了AGL1K——首个针对音频语言模型（ALMs）的音频地理定位基准测试，该测试涵盖了72个国家和地区。为了从众包平台中可靠地提取可定位的样本，我们提出了音频可定位性指标，该指标用于量化每个录音的信息量，最终得到了1,444个经过筛选的音频片段。对16种ALMs的评估表明，ALMs已经具备了音频地理定位的能力。我们发现，闭源模型在性能上明显优于开源模型，而且语言线索通常作为预测的依据发挥着重要作用。我们还分析了ALMs的推理过程、区域偏见、错误原因以及可定位性指标的可解释性。总体而言，AGL1K为音频地理定位建立了一个基准测试，有望提升ALMs的地理空间推理能力。

papers.title: Towards Understanding the Robustness of Sparse Autoencoders
papers.title_zh: 试图理解稀疏自编码器的鲁棒性
papers.authors: Ahson Saiyed, Sabrina Sadiekh, Chirag Agarwal
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to optimization-based jailbreak attacks that exploit internal gradient structure. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for interpretability, their robustness implications remain underexplored. We present a study of integrating pretrained SAEs into transformer residual streams at inference time, without modifying model weights or blocking gradients. Across four model families (Gemma, LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen) and two strong white-box attacks (GCG, BEAST) plus three black-box benchmarks, SAE-augmented models achieve up to a 5x reduction in jailbreak success rate relative to the undefended baseline and reduce cross-model attack transferability. Parametric ablations reveal (i) a monotonic dose-response relationship between L0 sparsity and attack success rate, and (ii) a layer-dependent defense-utility tradeoff, where intermediate layers balance robustness and clean performance. These findings are consistent with a representational bottleneck hypothesis: sparse projection reshapes the optimization geometry exploited by jailbreak attacks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型仍然容易受到基于优化的越狱攻击的攻击，这些攻击会利用模型内部的梯度结构。虽然稀疏自编码器被广泛用于提高模型的可解释性，但其在抵御攻击方面的鲁棒性仍未被充分研究。我们研究了在推理阶段将预训练的稀疏自编码器集成到Transformer残差流中的方法，无需修改模型权重或阻断梯度信息。在四个不同的模型家族（Gemma、LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen）以及两种强白盒攻击（GCG、BEAST）和三种黑盒基准测试中，采用稀疏自编码器增强的模型在越狱成功率上比未增强的基线模型降低了5倍，同时减少了不同模型之间的攻击传播能力。参数化分析表明：（i）L0稀疏性与攻击成功率之间存在单调的剂量-反应关系；（ii）不同层对防御效果与性能之间存在权衡，中间层能够平衡模型的鲁棒性和性能表现。这些发现与“表征瓶颈假说”一致：稀疏投影改变了越狱攻击所利用的优化几何结构。

papers.title: Beyond Local vs. External: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Trustworthy Knowledge Acquisition
papers.title_zh: 局部与外部之间的区别：一种用于获取可信知识的博弈论框架
papers.authors: Rujing Yao, Yufei Shi, Yang Wu, Ang Li, Zhuoren Jiang, XiaoFeng Wang, Haixu Tang, Xiaozhong Liu
papers.abstract: Cloud-hosted Large Language Models (LLMs) offer unmatched reasoning capabilities and dynamic knowledge, yet submitting raw queries to these external services risks exposing sensitive user intent. Conversely, relying exclusively on trusted local models preserves privacy but often compromises answer quality due to limited parameter scale and knowledge. To resolve this dilemma, we propose Game-theoretic Trustworthy Knowledge Acquisition (GTKA), a framework that formulates the trade-off between knowledge utility and privacy as a strategic game. GTKA consists of three components: (i) a privacy-aware sub-query generator that decomposes sensitive intent into generalized, low-risk fragments; (ii) an adversarial reconstruction attacker that attempts to infer the original query from these fragments, providing adaptive leakage signals; and (iii) a trusted local integrator that synthesizes external responses within a secure boundary. By training the generator and attacker in an alternating adversarial manner, GTKA optimizes the sub-query generation policy to maximize knowledge acquisition accuracy while minimizing the reconstructability of the original sensitive intent. To validate our approach, we construct two sensitive-domain benchmarks in the biomedical and legal fields. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GTKA significantly reduces intent leakage compared to state-of-the-art baselines while maintaining high-fidelity answer quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 云托管的大语言模型提供了无与伦比的推理能力和动态知识，然而将原始查询提交给这些外部服务可能会泄露用户的敏感意图。相反，如果完全依赖可信的本地模型，则可以保护隐私，但由于参数规模有限和知识有限，答案质量往往会受到影响。为了解决这一困境，我们提出了一种基于博弈论的可信知识获取框架——GTKA。该框架将知识效用与隐私之间的权衡抽象为一场战略游戏。GTKA由三个组件构成：(i) 一种注重隐私的子查询生成器，能够将敏感意图分解为通用且风险较低的片段；(ii) 一种对抗性重构攻击者，试图从这些片段中推断出原始查询，并据此产生适应性强的泄露信号；(iii) 一种可信的本地集成器，能够在安全范围内合成外部响应。通过交替训练生成器和攻击者，GTKA能够优化子查询生成策略，从而在最大化知识获取准确度的同时，最小化原始敏感意图的重构可能性。为了验证我们的方法，我们在生物医学和法律领域构建了两个敏感领域的基准测试。大量实验表明，与现有最先进的基线方法相比，GTKA显著减少了意图泄露，同时保持了高保真的答案质量。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: False Sense of Security: Why Probing-based Malicious Input Detection Fails to Generalize
papers.title_zh: 虚假的安全感：为何基于探测的恶意输入检测难以实现泛用性
papers.authors: Cheng Wang, Zeming Wei, Qin Liu, Wenxuan Zhou, Muhao Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can comply with harmful instructions, raising serious safety concerns despite their impressive capabilities. Recent work has leveraged probing-based approaches to study the separability of malicious and benign inputs in LLMs’ internal representations, and researchers have proposed using such probing methods for safety detection. We systematically re-examine this paradigm. Motivated by poor out-of-distribution performance, we hypothesize that probes learn superficial patterns rather than semantic harmfulness. Through controlled experiments, we confirm this hypothesis and identify the specific patterns learned: instructional patterns and trigger words. Our investigation follows a systematic approach, progressing from demonstrating comparable performance of simple n-gram methods, to controlled experiments with semantically cleaned datasets, to detailed analysis of pattern dependencies. These results reveal a false sense of security around current probing-based approaches and highlight the need to redesign both models and evaluation protocols, for which we provide further discussions in the hope of suggesting responsible further research in this direction.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可能会遵循有害指令，这引发了严重的安全问题，尽管它们具有强大的能力。最近的研究采用了基于探测的方法来研究恶意和良性输入在LLM内部表示中的可区分性，研究人员提出可以使用这些探测方法进行安全检测。我们系统地重新审视了这一范式。鉴于模型在超出训练数据范围时的表现不佳，我们假设探测机制只是学习到了表面的模式，而非语义上的有害性。通过控制实验，我们证实了这一假设，并确定了所学习的特定模式：指示模式和触发词。我们的研究采用系统化的方法，从展示简单n-gram方法的相当好的性能，到使用语义清理过的数据集进行控制实验，再到详细分析模式依赖性，最终得出了这些结果。这些结果表明，目前基于探测的方法存在虚假的安全感，并强调了需要重新设计模型和评估协议。为此，我们提供了进一步的讨论，希望能为该领域的后续研究提供有价值的建议。

papers.title: Do Transformers Grok Succinct Algorithms? Mechanistic Evidence for Counting Circuits
papers.title_zh: 《变形金刚》能运用简洁高效的算法吗？关于计数电路的机制性证据
papers.authors: Yizheng Zhao
papers.abstract: Recent theory suggests Transformers are inherently succinct, capable of representing recursive algorithms like binary counting over exponential state spaces using constant-size circuits, unlike the exponential bottleneck of RNNs. However, it remains unclear under what conditions gradient-trained Transformers converge to these predicted succinct circuits, or whether they settle for heuristics. We bridge this gap by rigorously testing the Succinctness Hypothesis via mechanistic interpretability on the LargeCounter task. We report a striking dichotomy: shallow Transformers (d=64) generalize perfectly, whereas massive LSTM baselines (d=2048) fail completely (<6\% accuracy), empirically validating the succinctness gap. This dichotomy extends to modern state-space models: Mamba and Mamba-2 fail even more catastrophically (<1.1\%), confirming the hierarchy Transformer \gg LSTM > SSM predicted by formal complexity results. We show this capability is acquired via a grokking phase transition driven by a weight-norm “complexity collapse”. Mechanistic analysis reveals the learned circuit aligns precisely with Boolean RASP theory: attention heads utilize Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) for “Same-Bit Lookup”, while MLPs act as exact XOR/AND logic gates. Furthermore, we detect analogous “Arithmetic Heads” in pre-trained LLMs (Pythia), suggesting that succinctness is a representational inductive bias that, when activated by sufficient regularization, governs how models learn algorithmic reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 最新理论表明，Transformer模型本质上具有简洁性，能够使用固定大小的电路来表示递归算法，比如在指数级的状态空间中进行的二进制计数操作，这与RNN模型的指数级瓶颈问题截然不同。然而，目前尚不清楚在什么条件下，梯度训练的Transformer模型会收敛到这种预测的简洁电路，或者它们是否会选择采用启发式方法。我们通过在大计数器任务上严格测试“简洁性假设”，从而填补了这一空白。我们发现了一个显著的差异：浅层Transformer模型（维度为64）的泛化能力非常强，而庞大的LSTM基线模型（维度为2048）则完全失败（准确率低于6%），这从经验上验证了简洁性与非简洁性之间的差距。这一差异也适用于现代状态空间模型：Mamba和Mamba-2的失败程度更为严重（准确率低于1.1%），这证实了正式复杂性分析所预测的Transformer模型优于LSTM模型，甚至优于SSM模型。我们发现，这种能力是通过一种由权重范数“复杂性崩溃”驱动的阶段转变获得的。机制分析表明，学习到的电路与布尔RASP理论完全一致：注意力头利用旋转位置嵌入进行“相同位查找”，而多层感知机则充当精确的XOR/AND逻辑门。此外，我们在预训练的LLM中发现了类似的“算术头”，这表明简洁性是一种表征性归纳偏见，当通过足够的正则化激活时，它会决定模型如何学习算法推理。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: How Value Induction Reshapes LLM Behavior
papers.title_zh: 价值归纳如何重塑大语言模型的行为
papers.authors: Arnav Arora, Natalie Schluter, Katherine Metcalf, Maartje Ter Hoeve
papers.abstract: Conversational Large Language Models are post-trained on language that expresses specific behavioural traits, such as curiosity, open-mindedness, and empathy, and values, such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty. This is done to increase utility, ensure safety, and improve the user experience of the people interacting with the model. However, values are complex and inter-related - incorporating one can modify behaviour on another. Further, incorporating certain values can make models more addictive or sycophantic, potentially having a detrimental effect on the user interacting with it. We investigate these and other unintended effects of value incorporation into models. We fine-tune models using value subsets of existing preference datasets, measuring the effect of value induction of 15 values on safety, anthropomorphism, and various QA benchmarks. We find that i) inducing values also leads to expression of other related, and sometimes contrastive values, ii) inducing positive values increases safety, and iii) all values increase anthropomorphic language use by models, making them more validating and sycophantic.
papers.abstract_zh: 对话式大语言模型是在表达特定行为特征的语言上进行训练的，例如好奇心、开放心态和同理心，以及价值观，如乐于助人、无害性和诚实。这样做是为了提高模型的实用性、确保安全性，并改善与模型交互的用户的体验。然而，价值观是复杂且相互关联的——加入某个价值观可能会改变另一个价值观的表现。此外，加入某些价值观可能会使模型变得更加依赖他人或阿谀奉承，这可能对与之交互的用户产生负面影响。我们研究了将价值观纳入模型所带来的这些以及其他意想不到的影响。我们使用现有偏好数据集中的价值观子集来微调模型，测量了15种价值观对安全性、拟人化表达以及各种问答测试的影响。我们发现：i) 引入价值观也会引发其他相关价值观的出现，有时甚至是对立的价值观；ii) 引入积极的价值观会提升安全性；iii) 所有价值观都会增加模型使用拟人化语言的频率，使其更加认可他人和阿谀奉承。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Stable Evidence, Unstable Decisions: An Empirical Analysis of Model Decision Stability in Vision–Language Models
papers.title_zh: 可靠的证据，不稳定的决策：对视觉-语言模型中模型稳定性问题的实证分析
papers.authors: Ali Khoramfar, Mohammad Javad Dousti, Alireza Mohamadian, Heshaam Faili
papers.abstract: VLMs provide visual information alongside their predictions, but it remains unclear whether consistency in such information implies consistent decisions. We study this question in a controlled medical-imaging setting using brain MRI with pathology-confirmed labels and expert lesion annotations. For each human subject and modality, we construct configurations that retain the lesion content while varying surrounding context and scale and measure decision flips together with consistency in model-reported influential slices. Across four diverse VLMs (including proprietary, open-source, and domain-specific models), flip rates reach up to 75% across lesion-containing presentations, often despite high overlap in reported evidence. When lesion-related content is removed, proprietary models rarely produce a categorical diagnosis, with abstention rates ranging from 63% to 99%. These results reveal a mismatch between reported evidence and decisions, motivating evaluation beyond accuracy. Our evaluation dataset is publicly available on Hugging Face.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在提供预测结果的同时，还会附带视觉信息。不过，目前尚不清楚这种信息的连贯性是否意味着决策的一致性。我们在一个经过控制的医学成像环境中研究了这个问题，使用了带有病理确认标签的脑部MRI数据，以及专家对病变的注释。对于每一个人类受试者以及每种模态的数据，我们构建了不同的配置方案，这些方案在保留病变内容的基础上，改变了周围环境的特征、规模等因素。同时，我们还测量了模型所报告的具有影响力的切片在决策上的变化情况，以及这些信息的一致性。在四个不同的视觉语言模型中进行测试时，包含病变的数据中，模型的错误率高达75%，而这种情况往往发生在报告的证据存在高度重叠的情况下。当去除与病变相关的信息时，专有模型很少能做出明确的诊断，其回避率介于63%到99%之间。这些结果表明，报告的证据与决策之间存在不匹配的情况，这促使我们需要从准确性之外进行更深入的评估。我们的评估数据集可以在Hugging Face上免费获取。
