papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Diffusion Language Models with Early-Stage Calibration
papers.title_zh: 基于策略的自蒸馏方法，用于高效的差分语言模型构建——包含早期校准步骤
papers.authors: Huaisheng Zhu, MingYu Liu, Junze Liu, Zhen Ge, Tian Wang, Jiri Gesi, Dakuo Wang, Weiqi Zhang, Houyu Zhang, Yufan Guo, Xian Li, Bing Yin, Sujay Sanghavi
papers.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) have recently achieved strong performance, e.g., masked diffusion models (MDMs) can surpass autoregressive models (ARMs) in various tasks. However, DLLMs often struggle with inaccurate early-stage predictions due to limited context, which hinders both the model’s inference efficiency and the output’s overall quality. We propose Calibrated On-Policy Self-Distillation (COPSD) for DLLMs, a simple and efficient method to calibrate early token predictions without requiring demonstration data. COPSD distills an unnormalized target distribution derived from later decoding steps into the original model, enabling more accurate early predictions during inference. Experiments on math, planning, and RLHF tasks show that COPSD improves both effectiveness and efficiency, and further enhances performance when combined with supervised fine-tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散大语言模型（DLLMs）最近取得了显著的性能突破，例如，掩蔽扩散模型（MDMs）在多种任务中都能超越自回归模型（ARMs）。然而，由于上下文信息有限，DLLMs在早期的预测方面常常表现不佳，这影响了模型的推理效率和输出的整体质量。我们提出了一种名为“校准的在线策略自蒸馏”（COPSD）的方法，这是一种简单高效的算法，无需示范数据即可校准早期令牌的预测。COPSD将来自后期解码步骤的非归一化目标分布重新转化为原始模型，从而在推理过程中实现更精确的早期预测。在数学计算、规划以及强化学习基准测试中的实验表明，COPSD不仅提升了模型的效率，还显著提高了性能，而当与监督式微调结合使用时，其效果更为突出。

papers.title: Arctic-Text2SQL-R1: Simple Rewards, Strong Reasoning in Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: 北极-文本转SQL-R1：简单的奖励机制，在文本转SQL过程中展现出色的推理能力
papers.authors: Zhewei Yao, Guoheng Sun, Łukasz Borchmann, Zheyu Shen, Minghang Deng, Bohan Zhai, Hao Zhang, Ang Li, Yuxiong He
papers.abstract: Translating natural language into SQL (Text2SQL) is a longstanding challenge at the intersection of natural language understanding and structured data access. While large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved fluency in SQL generation, producing correct and executable SQL, particularly for complex queries, remains a bottleneck. We present Arctic-Text2SQL-R1, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework and model family designed to generate accurate, executable SQL using a lightweight reward signal based solely on execution correctness. Our approach avoids brittle intermediate supervision and complex reward shaping, promoting stable training and alignment with the end task. Combined with carefully curated data, strong supervised initialization, and effective training practices, Arctic-Text2SQL-R1 achieves state-of-the-art execution accuracy across six diverse Text2SQL benchmarks and ranks among the leading entries on the BIRD leaderboard. Notably, our 7B model outperforms prior 70B-class systems, highlighting the framework’s scalability and efficiency. We further demonstrate inference-time robustness through simple extensions like value retrieval and majority voting. Extensive experiments and ablation studies offer both positive and negative insights, providing practical guidance for future Text2SQL research.
papers.abstract_zh: 将自然语言转换为SQL（Text2SQL）是自然语言理解与结构化数据访问领域中的一个长期挑战。虽然大语言模型在生成SQL方面取得了显著进步，能够生成正确且可执行的SQL语句，尤其是在处理复杂查询时，但仍然存在瓶颈。我们提出的Arctic-Text2SQL-R1是一种强化学习框架和模型系列，旨在利用仅基于执行正确性的轻量级奖励信号来生成准确且可执行的SQL语句。我们的方法避免了中间监督的脆弱性以及复杂的奖励调整过程，从而实现了稳定的训练效果，并与最终任务保持一致。结合精心筛选的数据、强大的监督初始化以及有效的训练方法，Arctic-Text2SQL-R1在六个不同的Text2SQL基准测试中取得了最先进的执行准确率，并在BIRD排行榜上名列前茅。值得注意的是，我们的70亿参数模型的表现优于之前那些拥有700亿参数的系统，这充分体现了该框架的可扩展性和效率。此外，我们还通过简单的扩展方式，如值检索和多数投票，证明了模型的推理时间鲁棒性。大量的实验和消融研究提供了正面和负面的见解，为未来的Text2SQL研究提供了实用的指导。

papers.title: Do Emotions Influence Moral Judgment in Large Language Models?
papers.title_zh: 情绪是否会影响大型语言模型的道德判断？
papers.authors: Mohammad Saim, Tianyu Jiang
papers.abstract: Large language models have been extensively studied for emotion recognition and moral reasoning as distinct capabilities, yet the extent to which emotions influence moral judgment remains underexplored. In this work, we develop an emotion-induction pipeline that infuses emotion into moral situations and evaluate shifts in moral acceptability across multiple datasets and LLMs.We observe a directional pattern: positive emotions increase moral acceptability and negative emotions decrease it, with effects strong enough to reverse binary moral judgments in up to 20% of cases, and with susceptibility scaling inversely with model capability.Our analysis further reveals that specific emotions can sometimes behave contrary to what their valence would predict (e.g., remorse paradoxically increases acceptability). A complementary human annotation study shows humans do not exhibit these systematic shifts, indicating an alignment gap in current LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在情感识别和道德推理方面已经得到了广泛研究，但情感对道德判断的影响程度仍未被充分探索。在这项研究中，我们开发了一种情感引入流程，将情感融入道德情境中，并评估了多个数据集和大语言模型下道德可接受性的变化。我们发现一种方向性规律：积极情绪会增加道德可接受性，而消极情绪则会降低其可接受性，这种影响在20%的情况下足以改变二元道德判断的结果，且这种效应与模型的性能成反比。我们的分析还表明，某些特定情绪的行为有时与其价值特征相反（例如，懊悔情绪反而会增加可接受性）。此外，人类注释研究也显示，人类并不表现出这些系统性变化，这表明当前的大语言模型在情感处理方面存在不足。

papers.title: RShield: A User-level Traceable Backdoor Watermark for LLMs in Embedding-as-a-Service
papers.title_zh: RShield：一种适用于嵌入式语言模型的用户级可追踪后门水印技术，以用于服务形式提供
papers.authors: Lingyun Xiang, Yufan Zhong, Chengfu Ou, Zhihua Xia, Chunfang Yang, Daojian Zeng, Zhangjie Fu
papers.abstract: Embedding-as-a-Service (EaaS) has emerged as a critical paradigm for commercializing large language models (LLMs). However, existing backdoor watermarking techniques are fundamentally limited to “zero-bit” detection, which prevents user-level traceability in multi-user EaaS scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose RShield, a multi-bit backdoor watermarking that enables reliable user-level attribution of LLMs for EaaS under model extraction attacks. RShield integrates Reed-Solomon error-correcting codes with orthogonal feature mapping to introduce highly-structured redundancy, constructing fault-tolerant symbol sequences for multi-bit watermark space, thereby staying recoverable even after aggressive extraction noise condition.To mitigate semantic distortion under the interference of noise channel, RShield employs a lightweight Adapter to adaptively inject multi-bit watermarks in the feature space, preserving the quality of EaaS while achieving a user-level traceability.Extensive experiments on four NLP benchmarks demonstrate that RShield efficiently achieves 100% multi-bit watermark recovery and high semantic fidelity under model extraction attacks compared to existing methods, while significantly reducing the degradation of watermarking on downstream task performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 嵌入即服务（EaaS）已成为实现大语言模型商业化的重要模式。然而，现有的后门水印技术本质上仅限于“零位”检测，这限制了在多用户EaaS场景中的用户级可追溯性。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了RShield技术。这是一种多位后门水印技术，能够在模型提取攻击下实现LLM的可靠用户级归因。RShield结合了里德-所罗门纠错码和正交特征映射技术，构建了高度结构化的冗余机制，从而在多位水印空间中生成具有容错能力的符号序列，即使在强烈的提取噪声环境下也能保持可恢复性。为了减轻噪声干扰对语义的影响，RShield采用了一种轻量级适配器，能够自适应地在特征空间注入多位水印，从而在保持EaaS质量的同时实现用户级可追溯性。在四个自然语言处理基准测试上的广泛实验表明，与现有方法相比，RShield在模型提取攻击下能够高效实现100%的多位水印恢复，并保持高语义保真度，同时显著降低了水印对下游任务性能的影响。

papers.title: The Adaptive Interrogator: Detecting Trojan LLMs in Multi-Agent Systems via Evolved Conversational Strategies
papers.title_zh: 自适应提问器：通过改进的对话策略在多智能体系统中检测木马型大型语言模型
papers.authors: Rana Muhammad Shahroz Khan, Ruichen Zhang, Zhen Tan, Charles Fleming, Tianlong Chen
papers.abstract: While Large Language Model (LLM) safety has focused on single-agent, white-box settings, the adoption of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) creates a critical blind spot: \textit{supply chain vulnerabilities in MAS ecosystems}. These systems often rely on third-party agents accessed via black-box APIs, creating risks where attackers can embed hidden triggers to manipulate collective reasoning or outputs. Because internal weights are inaccessible, traditional white-box defenses fail to detect these threats. Consequently, a critical gap exists in auditing these systems for ”Trojan” agents, \textit{i.e.}, malicious models that behave normally until triggered by specific, often multi-turn, conversational contexts. To bridge this gap, we introduce the \textbf{C}onversational \textbf{T}rojan \textbf{U}nmasking \textbf{S}ystem (\textbf{CTUS}), a black-box auditing framework that leverages an Evolutionary Algorithm (EA) to autonomously expose hidden threats. Drawing on social deduction mechanics, CTUS deploys a ”Judge” agent to evolve conversational probes that provoke Trojan agents into revealing their malicious nature without alerting benign peers. We validate CTUS across diverse architectures (Llama-2/3, Gemma, Mistral) and attack vectors (word, syntax, semantic, RLHF). Our results demonstrate that CTUS achieves superior detection rates (up to 100% in specific configurations). Furthermore, we conduct rigorous analyses to confirm the framework’s robustness, exhibiting negligible false positives on benign systems and stability across system configurations, establishing CTUS as a scalable safeguard for the multi-agent landscape.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型的安全性研究主要集中在单代理、白盒环境中，但多智能体系统的出现却带来了一个关键的问题：多智能体生态系统中的供应链漏洞。这些系统通常依赖通过黑盒API访问的第三方代理，这就给攻击者提供了可乘之机，他们可以植入隐藏的触发器来操纵集体推理或输出结果。由于内部权重无法被访问，传统的白盒防御机制无法检测到这些威胁。因此，在审计这些系统中是否存在“木马”代理时，存在很大的漏洞——即那些在受到特定、通常涉及多轮对话的情境触发之前，表现得像普通模型的恶意模型。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了“对话木马掩蔽系统”，这是一个基于黑盒的审计框架，它利用进化算法来自动发现隐藏的威胁。该系统借鉴了社交排除机制，通过部署一个“裁判”代理来演化出能够促使木马代理暴露其恶意行为的对话探针，而不会引起良性代理的警觉。我们在多种架构（如Llama-2/3、Gemma、Mistral）和攻击手段（词汇、语法、语义、强化学习微调）上验证了该系统的有效性。我们的结果表明，该系统在特定配置下能够实现高达100%的识别率。此外，我们还进行了严格的分析，以确认该框架的鲁棒性，即在良性系统上几乎没有误报，并且能够在不同系统配置下保持稳定运行，从而证明了该系统作为多智能体环境中的一种可扩展的安全保障措施是有效的。

papers.title: SmartAD: Capacity-Aligned Agent Distillation for Small Language Models
papers.title_zh: SmartAD：适用于小型语言模型的、与容量相匹配的代理蒸馏方法
papers.authors: Guokai Tang, Feng Zhao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show strong reasoning and decision-making ability, but their high inference cost motivates transferring agentic skills to small language models (SLMs). Agent distillation trains SLMs on full reason–act–observe trajectories from a tool-using teacher, enabling SLMs to acquire the tool-use capabilities of large teacher models. However, some teacher-agent trajectories are simply hard for the student to learn, and their compatibility with the student can vary widely; moreover, a uniform token-level loss prevents SLMs from learning the tool-use patterns and final decisions that truly drive successful reasoning. Therefore, we propose SmartAD, a capacity-aligned agent distillation framework that improves both the distilled data and the supervision signal. SmartAD (i) selects, for each training example, the trajectory with the minimum negative log-likelihood among multiple correct teacher samples to obtain student-friendly training data, and (ii) applies a segment-weighted loss that emphasizes action execution and final decision spans over intermediate reasoning. Experiments on multi-hop QA and math benchmarks with 1.5B and 3B models show that SmartAD consistently outperforms all baselines. Overall, our method enables small models to learn the teacher’s capabilities more easily and efficiently through trajectory selection and segment-weighted supervision, achieving capacity-aligned distillation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的推理和决策能力，但其较高的推理成本促使人们将智能体技能迁移到小型语言模型（SLM）上。智能体蒸馏技术通过让SLM学习来自使用工具的老师的完整推理-行动-观察轨迹，从而帮助SLM获得大型老师模型的工具使用能力。然而，有些老师-智能体轨迹对于学生来说难以学习，而且这些轨迹与学生之间的兼容性也各不相同；此外，统一的令牌级损失机制会阻碍SLM学习真正推动成功推理的工具使用模式和最终决策。因此，我们提出了SmartAD这一基于容量对齐的智能体蒸馏框架，该框架能够改善蒸馏出的数据和监督信号的质量。SmartAD具有以下特点：(i) 对于每个训练样本，从多个正确的老师样本中选择负对数似然值最小的轨迹，以获得更适合学生的训练数据；(ii) 采用分段加权损失机制，强调动作执行和最终决策的重要性，而忽略中间的推理过程。在具有1.5亿和3亿参数的多跳问答和数学任务上的实验表明，SmartAD始终优于所有基线方法。总体而言，我们的方法通过轨迹选择和分段加权监督机制，使小型模型能够更轻松、更高效地学习老师的技能，从而实现容量对齐的蒸馏效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TRM-Planner: Offline Target Planning and Distillation for Tiny Recursive Models
papers.title_zh: TRM-规划器：用于小型递归模型的离线目标规划与优化算法
papers.authors: Euijin Baek, Housam Babiker, Mi-Young Kim, Randy Goebel
papers.abstract: Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) perform iterative reasoning with an Adaptive Computation Time (ACT)-style loop, but their supervised training targets can be brittle, and their halting behavior can be difficult to tune. We introduce TRM-Planner, a two-stage teacher-cache distillation recipe that shifts compute to an offline teacher-cache stage. A frozen TRM checkpoint is unrolled for multiple refinement steps and stochastic rollouts; for each instance, we cache a small set of teacher entries (tokens, logits, step index, and quality metadata). A student TRM is then trained with the standard TRM objective plus a distillation loss computed from cached entries. Across Sudoku-Extreme and ARC-AGI-1/2, TRM-Planner shows an improvement over our reproduced TRM baseline while leaving student-time inference unchanged. On ARC1/ARC2 with 7M parameters, the two-attempt accuracy (pass@2) increases from 43.1% to 48.1% and 6.7% to 9.2%, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 小型递归模型（TRM）采用自适应计算时间式循环进行迭代推理，但其监督训练目标可能存在不稳定性的问题，且其停止行为也难以调整。我们提出了TRM-Planner这一两阶段教师缓存蒸馏方法，该方法将计算任务转移到了离线教师缓存阶段。冻结的TRM检查点会被展开用于多次细化步骤和随机尝试；对于每一个实例，我们会缓存一小部分教师参数（包括令牌、逻辑值、步骤索引以及质量元数据）。然后，学生模型会结合标准的TRM目标以及从缓存中获得的参数信息来训练。在Sudoku-Extreme和ARC-AGI-1/2任务中，TRM-Planner的表现优于我们的复制TRM基线模型，同时学生的推理时间保持不变。在参数数量为7百万的ARC1/ARC2任务中，两次尝试的准确率分别从43.1%提高到了48.1%，从6.7%提高到了9.2%。

papers.title: MAPLE: Multi-Aspect Panels of LLM Evaluators for Open-Ended Questions
papers.title_zh: MAPLE：用于开放性问题的人工智能评估器多维度面板
papers.authors: Michinori Jinji, Kyohei Atarashi, Koh Takeuchi, Hisashi Kashima
papers.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge, which uses LLMs to evaluate responses to open-ended questions, has seen significant growth in recent years. It has been adopted as a scalable alternative to manual human evaluation, such as crowdsourcing, which is often time-consuming and costly. However, the discrepancy between LLM-generated evaluations and human evaluations remains a critical problem in this field. To bridge this gap, we propose Multi-Aspect Panels of LLM Evaluators (MAPLE), a framework that orchestrates evaluations across multiple criteria using multiple LLMs. MAPLE integrates criterion-wise pairwise evaluations from multiple LLMs by estimating the importance of criteria and the reliability of individual evaluators. We conduct experiments with both open-source and closed-source models. Our results demonstrate that MAPLE achieves superior alignment with human evaluations compared to baselines, highlighting the importance of employing multi-agent and multi-criteria evaluation strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: “以LLM为评判者”这一方法利用LLM来评估对开放式问题的回答。近年来，这种方法的应用范围显著扩大。它被作为手动人工评估的替代方案而被采用，比如众包方式，而众包往往既耗时又成本高昂。不过，LLM生成的评估结果与人工评估之间的差异仍然是该领域的一个关键问题。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了“多维度LLM评判者框架”（MAPLE），该框架能够利用多个LLM来综合评估多个标准。MAPLE通过估算各标准的重要性以及各个评判者的可靠性，实现了从多个LLM那里获取的标准化成对比评估。我们对开源和闭源模型进行了实验验证。结果表明，与基准模型相比，MAPLE在评估结果的准确性方面表现更优，这凸显了采用多智能体和多标准评估策略的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MARCH: Evaluating the Intersection of Ambiguity Interpretation and Multi-hop Inference
papers.title_zh: 三月：评估歧义解释与多跳推理之间的相互作用
papers.authors: Jeonghyun Park, Ingeol Baek, Seunghyun Yoon, Haeun Jang, Aparna Garimella, Akriti Jain, Nedim Lipka, Hwanhee Lee
papers.abstract: Real-world multi-hop QA is naturally linked with ambiguity, where a single query can trigger multiple reasoning paths that require independent resolution. Since ambiguity can occur at any stage, models must navigate layered uncertainty throughout the entire reasoning chain. Despite its prevalence in real-world user queries, previous benchmarks have primarily focused on single-hop ambiguity, leaving the complex interaction between multi-step inference and layered ambiguity underexplored. In this paper, we introduce MARCH, a benchmark for their intersection, with 2,209 multi-hop ambiguous questions curated via multi-LLM verification and validated by human annotation with strong agreement. Our experiments reveal that even state-of-the-art models struggle with MARCH, confirming that combining ambiguity resolution with multi-step reasoning is a significant challenge. To address this, we propose CLARION, a two-stage agentic framework that explicitly decouples ambiguity planning from evidence-driven reasoning, significantly outperforms existing approaches, and paves the way for robust reasoning systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中，多跳问答问题往往伴随着不确定性，一个查询可能会触发多条需要独立解决的推理路径。由于不确定性可能出现在任何阶段，模型必须在整个推理过程中处理这种多层次的不确定性。尽管这种不确定性在现实用户问题中非常常见，但以往的评估基准主要关注的是单跳不确定性问题，而多步骤推理与多层次不确定性之间的复杂交互却没有得到充分探索。在本文中，我们提出了MARCH这一基准测试，它针对这两种不确定性的交集进行了研究。我们收集了2,209个多跳不确定性问题，这些问题通过多大语言模型进行验证，并且得到了人类注释的验证，其一致性非常高。我们的实验表明，即使是最先进的模型也难以应对MARCH问题，这进一步证明了将不确定性解决与多步骤推理相结合是一个巨大的挑战。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了CLARION这一两阶段代理框架。该框架明确地将不确定性规划与基于证据的推理分离开来，其性能明显优于现有的方法，为构建强大的推理系统铺平了道路。

papers.title: Enhancing Multilingual RAG Systems with Debiased Language Preference-Guided Query Fusion
papers.title_zh: 通过基于语言偏好引导的查询融合技术，提升多语言RAG系统的性能
papers.authors: Jeonghyun Park, Byeongjeong Kim, Seojin Hwang, Hwanhee Lee
papers.abstract: Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (mRAG) systems often exhibit a perceived preference for high-resource languages, particularly English, resulting in the widespread adoption of English pivoting. While prior studies attribute this advantage to the superior English-centric capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), we find that such measurements are significantly distorted by structural priors inherent in evaluation benchmarks. Specifically, we identify exposure bias and a gold availability prior—both driven by the disproportionate concentration of resources in English—as well as cultural priors rooted in topic locality, as factors that hinder accurate assessment of genuine language preference. To address these biases, we propose DeLP (Debiased Language Preference), a calibrated metric designed to explicitly factor out these structural confounds. Our analysis using DeLP reveals that the previously reported English preference is largely a byproduct of evidence distribution rather than an inherent model bias. Instead, we find that retrievers fundamentally favor monolingual alignment between the query and the document language. Building on this insight, we introduce DELTA (DEbiased Language preference–guided Text Augmentation), a lightweight and efficient mRAG framework that strategically leverages monolingual alignment to optimize cross-lingual retrieval and generation. Experimental results demonstrate that DELTA consistently outperforms English pivoting and mRAG baselines across diverse languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言检索增强生成（mRAG）系统往往表现出对高资源语言，尤其是英语的偏好，这导致了英语转向技术的广泛应用。虽然先前的研究将这种优势归因于大语言模型在英语方面的卓越能力，但我们发现，这些测量结果受到了评估基准中固有的结构性先验的显著扭曲。具体来说，我们发现曝光偏见和“黄金数据可用性先验”——这两种偏见都是由英语资源的过度集中导致的——以及基于主题局部性的文化先验，都是阻碍准确评估真实语言偏好的因素。为了消除这些偏见，我们提出了DeLP（去偏语言偏好），这是一种经过校准的指标，旨在明确排除这些结构性干扰因素。我们使用DeLP进行的分析表明，之前报告的英语偏好主要是证据分布的结果，而非模型的固有偏见。相反，我们发现检索器本质上更倾向于查询语言和文档语言之间的单语言对齐。基于这一洞察，我们引入了DELTA（去偏语言偏好引导的文本增强技术），这是一个轻量级且高效的mRAG框架，它利用单语言对齐来优化跨语言检索和生成任务。实验结果表明，DELTA在不同语言中始终优于英语转向技术和mRAG基线算法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MT-OSC: Path for LLMs that Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation
papers.title_zh: MT-OSC：适用于在多轮对话中迷失方向的大型语言模型的路径
papers.authors: Jyotika Singh, Fang Tu, Miguel Ballesteros, Weiyi Sun, Sandip Ghoshal, Michelle Yuan, Yassine Benajiba, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) suffer significant performance degradation when user instructions and context are distributed over multiple conversational turns, yet multi-turn (MT) interactions dominate chat interfaces. The routine approach of appending full chat history to prompts rapidly exhausts context windows, leading to increased latency, higher computational costs, and diminishing returns as conversations extend. We introduce MT-OSC, a One-off Sequential Condensation framework that efficiently and automatically condenses chat history in the background without disrupting the user experience. MT-OSC employs a Condenser Agent that uses a few-shot inference-based Condenser and a lightweight Decider to selectively retain essential information, reducing token counts by up to 72% in 10-turn dialogues. Evaluated across 13 state-of-the-art LLMs and diverse multi-turn benchmarks, MT-OSC consistently narrows the multi-turn performance gap—yielding improved or preserved accuracy across datasets while remaining robust to distractors and irrelevant turns. Our results establish MT-OSC as a scalable solution for multi-turn chats, enabling richer context within constrained input spaces, reducing latency and operational cost, while balancing performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在用户指令和上下文分布在多个对话轮次中时，会出现显著的性能下降。然而，多轮对话仍然主导着聊天界面。传统的做法是将完整的聊天记录附加到提示中，这会迅速耗尽上下文窗口，导致延迟增加、计算成本上升，且随着对话的延长，效果越来越差。我们提出了MT-OSC这一一次性顺序压缩框架，该框架能够在后台高效地自动压缩聊天记录，而不会干扰用户体验。MT-OSC采用了一个压缩代理，该代理使用基于少量样本推理的压缩方法，并借助轻量级的决策器来选择性地保留重要信息，从而在10轮对话中最多减少72%的令牌数量。在13种先进的LLM模型和多种多轮对话基准测试中进行了评估，结果表明，MT-OSC始终能够缩小多轮对话的性能差距——在不同数据集上都能提高或保持准确性，同时还能很好地应对干扰信息和无关对话。我们的研究结果表明，MT-OSC是一种适用于多轮对话的可扩展解决方案，能够在有限的输入空间中提供更丰富的上下文，降低延迟和运营成本，同时保持良好的性能表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Soft Head Selection for Injecting ICL-Derived Task Embeddings
papers.title_zh: 用于注入由ICL生成的任务嵌入数据的软头部选择方法
papers.authors: Jungwon Park, Jimyeong Kim, Changin Choi, Wonjong Rhee
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly adapted to downstream tasks using parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) or in-context learning (ICL). Recently, ICL-driven embedding-based adaptation has been proposed as a distinct task adaptation paradigm. It derives task-specific embeddings from intermediate activations using few-shot prompts and injects them during inference. Despite its conceptual appeal, this approach has not demonstrated consistent performance gains over PEFT or ICL, and its empirical advantages have been limited in practice. We propose Soft head-selection for ICL-derived Task Embeddings (SITE), a gradient-based method that identifies task-relevant attention heads to enable effective task embedding injection. Across various types of open-ended generation, reasoning, and natural language understanding tasks, SITE significantly outperforms prior embedding-based adaptation methods and few-shot ICL, while using substantially fewer trainable parameters than PEFT. Experiments on 12 LLMs ranging from 4B to 70B parameters demonstrate the generality of our approach, and intra-task and inter-task activation patching analyses further provide new mechanistic insights by revealing strong task dependence in attention head functionality.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常采用参数高效微调（PEFT）或上下文学习（ICL）的方法来适应下游任务。最近，基于上下文学习的嵌入式适配被提出作为一种独立的任务适应范式。该方法利用少量样本提示从中间激活值中提取出与任务相关的嵌入信息，并在推理过程中将其注入模型中。尽管这种方法在概念上具有吸引力，但其在性能上的提升效果并不明显，且实际应用中的优势也有限。我们提出了一种名为“软头部选择”的方法，用于处理基于上下文学习的任务嵌入数据。这是一种基于梯度的方法，它能够识别出与任务相关的注意力头，从而实现有效的嵌入注入。在多种开放性问题生成、推理和自然语言理解任务中，该方法的性能显著优于传统的嵌入式适配方法和少量样本上下文学习方法，同时所需训练参数的数量也远远少于PEFT。我们在12种参数范围从40亿到700亿的大语言模型上进行实验，证明了该方法的通用性。此外，通过任务内和任务间的激活值分析，我们进一步发现了注意力头功能与任务之间的强相关性，这为理解这种适应机制提供了新的线索。

papers.title: CORAL: Adaptive Retrieval Loop for Culturally-Aligned Multilingual RAG
papers.title_zh: CORAL：自适应检索循环，用于实现与文化相契合的多语言信息检索系统
papers.authors: Nayeon Lee, Jiwoo Song, Byeongcheol Kang
papers.abstract: Multilingual retrieval-augmented generation (mRAG) is often implemented within a fixed retrieval space, typically via query or document translation or multilingual embedding vector representations. However, this approach may be inadequate for culturally grounded queries, in which retrieval-condition misalignment may occur. Even strong retrievers and generators may struggle to produce culturally relevant answers when sourcing evidence from inappropriate linguistic or regional contexts. To this end, we introduce CORAL (COntext-aware Retrieval with Agentic Loop, an adaptive retrieval methodology for mRAG that enables iterative refinement of both the retrieval space (corpora) and the retrieval probe (query) based on the quality of the evidence. The overall process includes: (1) selecting corpora, (2) retrieving documents, (3) critiquing evidence for relevance and cultural alignment, and (4) checking sufficiency. If the retrieved documents are insufficient to answer the query correctly, the system (5) reselects corpora and rewrites the query. Across two cultural QA benchmarks, CORAL achieves up to a 3.58%p accuracy improvement on low-resource languages relative to the strongest baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言检索增强生成（mRAG）通常是在固定的检索空间内实现的，这通常通过查询或文档转换或多语言嵌入向量表示来实现。然而，这种方法对于基于文化的查询来说可能不够有效，因为可能会出现检索条件不一致的问题。即使拥有强大的检索器和生成器，在从不合适的语言或地区背景中提取证据时，也可能难以产生具有文化相关性的答案。为此，我们提出了CORAL技术——一种自适应检索方法，它能够根据证据的质量来迭代优化检索空间（语料库）和检索探针（查询）。整个过程包括：(1) 选择语料库；(2) 检索文档；(3) 评估证据的相关性和文化一致性；(4) 检查证据的充分性。如果检索到的文档不足以正确回答查询，系统会(5) 重新选择语料库并重写查询。在两个文化相关的问答基准测试中，与最强大的基线相比，CORAL技术在低资源语言上的准确率提高了3.58%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Safety Guardrails of Large Language Models Are Vulnerable to Value-Driven Adversarial Prompting
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型的安全防护机制容易受到基于价值的对抗性提示的攻击
papers.authors: Xiaohao Luo, Ying Wei, Zhijun Li
papers.abstract: In the real world, the execution of a task often depends on the executor’s recognition of its value. Motivated by this observation, we propose the value-driven jailbreak attack (VDJA), a simple and effective black-box jailbreak method against large language models (LLMs). VDJA first exploits the phenomenon that LLMs tend to agree with humans to induce LLMs to affirm the moral value of harmful tasks. During autoregressive generation, these value-endorsement tokens function as an implicit value prior, making LLMs more likely to accept and generate harmful content. Extensive experiments on five state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs demonstrate the superiority of VDJA. Using only a single query and without concealing harmful instructions, VDJA achieves an average attack success rate (ASR) of 91.8% on JailbreakBench and 95.2% on the AdvBench subset, showcasing SOTA jailbreak success rates and attack efficiency. Most importantly, our work suggests a previously underexplored vulnerability in the safety guardrails of LLMs, which highlights the urgent need to enhance their robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中，任务的执行往往取决于执行者对其价值的认知。基于这一观察，我们提出了价值驱动越狱攻击方法（Value-Driven Jailbreak Attack，VDJA）。这是一种简单而有效的黑盒式越狱方法，适用于大语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs）。VDJA首先利用LLMs倾向于与人类达成一致的特性，诱导LLMs认可有害任务的道德价值。在自回归生成过程中，这些带有价值观的标记作为隐式的价值先验，使得LLMs更有可能接受并生成有害内容。在五种最先进的LLMs上进行的广泛实验表明，VDJA具有出色的性能。仅使用单一查询且不隐藏有害指令的情况下，VDJA在JailbreakBench上的平均攻击成功率为91.8%，在AdvBench子数据集上的成功率为95.2%。这充分展示了VDJA在越狱方面的卓越效果以及其高效的攻击能力。最重要的是，我们的研究揭示了LLMs安全机制中一个此前未被充分探索的漏洞，这凸显了提升其鲁棒性的紧迫性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Fair RAG: End-to-End Fairness Across Retrieval and Generation
papers.title_zh: 公平RAG：在检索和生成过程中实现端到端公平性
papers.authors: Farsheed Haque, Zhe Fu, Ramit Aditya, Depeng Xu, Xi Niu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) used in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can amplify demographic bias: retrievers may surface skewed context and generators can propagate that skew into decisions. Prior work typically treats fairness in retrieval or generation in isolation, leaving end-to-end fairness in RAG underexplored. We propose a post-hoc pipeline that jointly controls both stages: (i) a Fair Greedy Reranker (FGR) that builds prefix-balanced slates toward a target group mix; (ii) a Residual Slate Bias Estimator (RSBE) using signed, prefix-sensitive NDKL to quantify remaining skew; and (iii) Confidence-Gated Logit Calibration (CGLC) that converts the residual signal into small and margin-focused logit corrections without retraining. On an occupation classification task, our approach reduces retriever-side skew (lowest NDKL among baselines for both dense and sparse retrievers) and achieves the lowest generator-side disparity (e.g., Risk Difference) while largely preserving utility. The same calibration can be tuned to alternative fairness criteria (e.g., Equal Opportunity) with minimal utility loss.
papers.abstract_zh: 在检索增强生成（RAG）中使用的大语言模型（LLM）可能会放大人口统计偏见：检索器可能会呈现有偏见的上下文，而生成器则会将这种偏见传递给决策。以往的研究通常单独考虑检索或生成的公平性问题，而忽略了RAG过程中端到端公平性的探讨。我们提出了一种后处理流程，该流程同时控制这两个阶段：(i) 一个公平的贪婪重新排序器（FGR），它构建朝向目标群体混合比例的前缀平衡排序表；(ii) 一个残差排序偏差估计器（RSBE），它使用带符号的、对前缀敏感的NDKL来量化剩余的偏见；(iii) 置信度门控逻辑回归校准（CGLC），它将剩余信号转化为小型且以边际为重的逻辑回归修正，而无需重新训练。在一个职业分类任务上，我们的方法减少了检索器端的偏见（在密集和稀疏检索器的基础上，NDKL值最低），并实现了最低的生成器端差异（例如风险差异），同时基本保持了效用。同样的校准方法可以调整以适应其他公平性标准（例如平等机会），而几乎不会损失效用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ManCC: A Task-Anchored Benchmark for Manchu–Classical Chinese Cross-Lingual Modeling
papers.title_zh: ManCC：一种以任务为驱动的基准测试工具，适用于满语与标准汉语之间的跨语言建模
papers.authors: Meiqi Wang, Xiaoxin Sun, Dongjie Wang, Ruixin Yu, Xiantao Heng, Shuo Wang, Zhen Huang, Peng Zhao, Suhua Wang, Minghao Yin
papers.abstract: Research in cross-lingual modeling for historical and extremely low-resource languages is hindered by the absence of standardized evaluation benchmarks. To address this, we present ManCC—the first task-anchored benchmark for Manchu–Classical Chinese translation. ManCC consists of a high-quality parallel corpus of 16,627 sentence pairs, derived from the Qing-dynasty historical text Manwen Laodang-Taizong, and a reproducible evaluation protocol that combines automatic metrics (BLEU and chrF) with a three-dimensional human assessment (fidelity, fluency, linguistic normativity). Through systematic evaluation across three model families (non-pretrained, multilingual pretrained, and large language models), we find that linguistic differences significantly influence performance, broader language coverage in multilingual pretraining facilitates low-resource transfer, and automatic metrics often fail to capture essential errors in historical translation—underscoring the necessity of human evaluation. ManCC not only provides foundational resources for Manchu–Classical Chinese translation but also establishes a diagnosable, reproducible platform for cross-lingual modeling of historical low-resource languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 在跨语言建模研究中，对于历史类以及资源极为匮乏的语言进行研究时，由于缺乏标准化的评估基准，相关工作受到了限制。为了克服这一难题，我们提出了ManCC——首个以任务为导向的满语与古典汉语翻译评估基准。ManCC包含了一个高质量的平行语料库，共有16,627对句子对，这些句子对来源于清朝时期的《满文老档-太祖》历史文献。该评估方案结合了自动评估指标（如BLEU和chrF）以及三维的人类评估方法（忠实度、流畅性、语言规范性）。通过对三种模型家族进行系统评估（非预训练模型、多语言预训练模型以及大语言模型），我们发现语言差异对翻译性能有着显著的影响；而多语言预训练中更广泛的语言覆盖则有助于处理资源匮乏的语言翻译任务。此外，自动评估指标往往无法捕捉到历史翻译中的关键错误，这进一步强调了人类评估的重要性。ManCC不仅为满语与古典汉语翻译提供了基础资源，还建立了一个可诊断且可复现的跨语言建模平台，适用于历史类资源匮乏语言的建模工作。

papers.title: Dynamic Graph Navigation via Triplet Chains for Structure-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 利用三元组链实现动态图导航，以实现基于结构感知的检索增强生成
papers.authors: Feng Zhao, Yufei Wu, Xianggan Liu, Ruilin Zhao
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) was proposed to address the hallucination question of large language models (LLMs). However, the traditional RAG framework has certain limitations: for simple questions, the search results often introduce a large amount of irrelevant information; while for complex questions, the lengthy reference knowledge provided by the retrieval lacks structural information. Therefore, we proposed a structure-aware RAG, which achieves noise removal in retrieval through multi-chain graph navigation reasoning(Trig-Nav). This method constructs question triple reasoning chains and reference knowledge graphs with text attributes, allowing the system to retrieve three types of knowledge along different paths based on the requirements of LLM. It provides LLM with multi-angle and structured information input and significantly reduces noise. We conducted a comprehensive evaluation of Trig-Nav, comparing it with baseline methods across multiple datasets.Compared to traditional RAG, there is an average improvement of 6% in effectiveness. The results showed that Trig-Nav significantly enhances the model’s performance, validating the effectiveness of this approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术被提出来解决大语言模型产生的幻觉问题。然而，传统的RAG框架存在一定局限性：对于简单的问题，搜索结果往往会引入大量无关信息；而对于复杂的问题，检索过程中提供的冗长参考知识则缺乏结构化的信息。因此，我们提出了一种结构感知的RAG方法，该方法通过多链图导航推理技术来实现检索中的噪声去除。这种方法构建了包含文本属性的问题三元组推理链和参考知识图谱，使得系统能够根据LLM的需求，沿着不同的路径检索三种类型的知识。它为LLM提供了多角度、结构化的信息输入，有效减少了噪声的影响。我们对Trig-Nav技术进行了全面的评估，并在多个数据集上将其与基线方法进行了比较。与传统的RAG技术相比，Trig-Nav在有效性方面平均提升了6%。结果表明，Trig-Nav显著提升了模型的性能，验证了该方法的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Style over Story: Measuring LLM Narrative Preferences via Structured Selection
papers.title_zh: 风格而非情节：通过结构化选择来衡量大型语言模型对叙事内容的偏好
papers.authors: Donghoon Jung, Jiwoo Choi, Songeun Chae, Seohyon Jung
papers.abstract: We introduce a constraint-selection-based experiment design for measuring narrative preferences of Large Language Models (LLMs). This design offers an interpretable lens on LLMs’ narrative selection behavior. We developed a library of 200 narratology-grounded constraints and prompted selections from six LLMs under three different instruction types: basic, quality-focused, and creativity-focused. Findings demonstrate that models consistently prioritize Style over narrative content elements like Event, Character, and Setting. Style preferences remain stable across models and instruction types, whereas content elements show cross-model divergence and instructional sensitivity. These results suggest that LLMs have latent narrative preferences, which should inform how the NLP community evaluates and deploys models in creative domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于约束选择的实验设计，用于衡量大语言模型（LLMs）在叙事方面的偏好。该设计为分析LLMs的叙事选择行为提供了一种可解释的方法。我们构建了一个包含200个基于叙事学原理的约束条件的库，并让六个LLMs在三种不同的指导类型下进行选择：基础型、注重质量型和注重创意型。研究发现，模型始终将风格置于叙事内容要素之上，如事件、角色和背景等。风格偏好在不同模型和不同指导类型下保持稳定，而内容要素则表现出跨模型的差异性和对指导类型的敏感性。这些结果表明，LLMs具有潜在的叙事偏好，这有助于NLP领域了解如何评估和应用这些模型在创意领域中的应用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Visual Interference in Speech Evaluation: Cultural Asymmetry and Cross-Modal Bias in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: 语音评估中的视觉干扰：文化差异与多模态处理中的偏差在语言模型中的应用
papers.authors: Kyusik Kim, Hyunwoo Yoo, Jaehoon Choi, Gail Rosen, Bongwon Suh
papers.abstract: The transition to end-to-end Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has positioned these architectures as active social evaluators in high-stakes domains. However, it remains unclear whether these models maintain objective auditory perception or succumb to the “Hearing with Eyes” phenomenon, where visual racial cues distort linguistic proficiency evaluations. We investigate this cross-modal bias by constructing a controlled counterfactual dataset utilizing a Visual Matched-Guise Paradigm. By pairing identical native audio with diverse visual personas across English and Korean contexts, we reveal a distinct Cultural Asymmetry in model behavior. In Anglophone settings, most closed models exhibit Reverse Linguistic Stereotyping, hallucinating non-native accents for Asian speakers despite standard native audio. Conversely, in Korean settings, the same models assign baseline-relative competence premiums across all visual personas, with the largest gains for out-group (White/Black) speakers, consistent with Expectancy Violation Theory. Our findings demonstrate that MLLMs do not merely process sensory inputs but actively reproduce context-dependent sociolinguistic ideologies.
papers.abstract_zh: 向端到端多模态大语言模型的转型，使得这些架构能够在高风险的领域中发挥积极的作用。然而，目前尚不清楚这些模型是否能够保持客观的语言感知能力，或者是否会受到“眼见为实”现象的影响——即视觉上的种族线索会扭曲对语言能力的评估。我们通过构建一个受控的反事实数据集来研究这种跨模态偏见现象。通过将相同的母语音频与英语和韩语语境中的不同视觉形象进行配对，我们发现模型行为存在明显的文化不对称现象。在英语环境中，大多数模型表现出逆向语言刻板印象现象，它们会为亚洲说话者产生非母语口音的假象，尽管使用的是标准的母语音频。相反，在韩语环境中，同样的模型会在所有视觉形象中给予一定的语言能力溢价，其中外群体（白人/黑人）说话者获得的溢价最大，这与期望违反理论是一致的。我们的研究发现表明，多模态大语言模型不仅仅处理感官输入，还会主动再现依赖于上下文的社会语言意识形态。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DraDDP: A Multimodal Multi-Party Dialogue Discourse Parsing Dataset
papers.title_zh: DraDDP：一个包含多种模态数据的多参与方对话语料库解析数据集
papers.authors: Shannan Liu, Peifeng Li, Yaxin Fan, Qiaoming Zhu
papers.abstract: Multi-party dialogue discourse parsing aims to identify dependency structures and relation types between utterances in conversations. Previous studies are mostly limited to textual modality or two-party dialogue, failing to meet the multimodal and multi-party settings. In this paper, we construct the first publicly available English multimodal dataset DraDDP for multi-party dialogue discourse parsing, based on American TV dramas. DraDDP contains 495 dialogue segments with 6,374 utterances and 9.1 hours of parallel video content, covering rich multi-party interaction scenarios. Moreover, we establish comprehensive benchmarks by evaluating this task on DraDDP and conducting in-depth analysis on the impact of different modalities. Experimental results demonstrate the value of multimodal information in capturing dialogue structures and relation types. We will publicly release the dataset, annotation guidelines, and code to promote future research in multimodal dialogue understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 多方对话话语解析的目的是识别对话中各个话语之间的依赖结构和关系类型。以往的研究大多局限于文本模态或双方对话层面，未能满足多模态和多方交互的需求。在本文中，我们构建了首个公开可用的英语多模态数据集DraDDP，用于多方对话话语解析。该数据集基于美国电视剧，包含495段对话片段，共6,374个话语，以及9.1小时的并行视频内容，涵盖了丰富多方的互动场景。此外，我们通过在DraDDP上进行评估，并深入分析不同模态信息的影响，建立了全面的基准测试。实验结果表明，多模态信息在捕捉对话结构和关系类型方面具有重要作用。我们将公开发布该数据集、注释指南和代码，以促进未来关于多模态对话理解的研究。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Table-R1: Region-based Reinforcement Learning for Table Understanding
papers.title_zh: 表-R1：基于区域的强化学习在表格理解中的应用
papers.authors: Zhenhe Wu, Jian Yang, Zhongjiang He, Changzai Pan, Jiaheng Liu, Xianjie Wu, Yu Zhao, Shuangyong Song, Yongxiang Li, Zhoujun Li, Xuelong Li
papers.abstract: Tables present unique challenges for language models due to their structured row-column interactions, necessitating specialized approaches for effective comprehension. While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in table reasoning through prompting and techniques like chain-of-thought (CoT) and program-of-thought (PoT), optimizing their performance for table question answering remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce region-based Table-R1, a novel reinforcement learning approach that enhances LLM table understanding by integrating region evidence into reasoning steps. Our method employs Region-Enhanced Supervised Fine-Tuning (RE-SFT) to guide models in identifying relevant table regions before generating answers, incorporating textual, symbolic, and program-based reasoning. Additionally, Table-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (TARPO) introduces a mixed reward system to dynamically balance region accuracy and answer correctness, with decaying region rewards and consistency penalties to align reasoning steps. Experiments show that Table-R1 achieves an average performance improvement of 14.36 points across multiple base models on three benchmark datasets, even outperforming baseline models with ten times the number of parameters, while TARPO significantly reduces the reasoning token consumption by 67.5% compared to GRPO, significantly advancing LLM capabilities in efficient tabular reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格结构给语言模型带来了独特的挑战，因为它们具有明确的行与列交互关系，因此需要专门的方法来实现有效的理解。虽然大语言模型在通过提示以及诸如思维链和程序性思维等技术进行表格推理方面表现出潜力，但如何优化其性能以处理表格类问题仍然缺乏深入研究。在本文中，我们提出了基于区域的Table-R1方法，这是一种新颖的强化学习方法，通过将区域信息融入推理步骤来提升语言模型对表格的理解能力。我们的方法采用区域增强式监督微调技术，引导模型在生成答案之前识别出相关的表格区域，同时结合文本、符号和程序化推理方式。此外，我们还引入了表格感知组相对策略优化技术，该技术采用混合奖励机制，动态平衡区域准确性和答案正确性，通过逐渐减少区域奖励和施加一致性惩罚来确保推理步骤的一致性。实验表明，Table-R1在多个基础模型上实现了平均14.36点的性能提升，且在三个基准数据集上的表现优于参数数量多十倍的基线模型。而TARPO则显著减少了推理过程中的令牌消耗，相比GRPO减少了67.5%，有效提升了语言模型在高效表格推理方面的能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ARM2: Adaptive Reasoning Model with Vision Understanding and Executable Code
papers.title_zh: ARM2：基于视觉理解与可执行代码的自适应推理模型
papers.authors: Jian Xie, Zhendong Chu, Aoxiao Zhong, Kai Zhang, Mingzhe Han, Xing Fan, Jialie Shen, Qingsong Wen
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often suffer from the “over-thinking” problem, generating unnecessarily long reasoning on simple tasks. Some strategies have been proposed to mitigate this issue, such as length penalties or routing mechanisms, but they are typically heuristic and task-specific, lacking a general framework for adaptive reasoning. In this paper, we present ARM2, a unified model that adaptively balances reasoning performance and efficiency across multiple formats through a reinforcement learning framework augmented with length-aware optimization. Beyond conventional natural language inference, ARM2 integrates vision understanding, extending its applicability to multimodal. Moreover, ARM2 integrates executable code into reasoning, enabling substantial reductions in token cost while preserving task performance compared to long CoT. Experiments demonstrate that ARM2 achieves performance on par with traditional reasoning models trained with GRPO, while reducing token usage by over 70% on average. We further conduct extensive analyses to validate the effectiveness of ARM2 and the soundness of its design.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）常常面临“过度思考”的问题，即在简单任务上产生不必要的冗长推理过程。为了缓解这一问题，人们提出了一些策略，比如长度惩罚或路由机制，但这些策略通常都是启发式的，且只适用于特定任务，缺乏一种适用于各种任务的自适应推理框架。在本文中，我们提出了ARM2模型，该模型通过强化学习框架，结合长度感知的优化算法，实现了对多种推理格式之间性能和效率的灵活平衡。除了传统的自然语言推理功能外，ARM2还整合了视觉理解能力，使其适用范围扩展到了多模态领域。此外，ARM2还将可执行代码融入推理过程中，从而显著降低了标记成本，同时保持了与长CoT相比的推理性能。实验表明，ARM2在性能上可与使用GRPO训练的传统推理模型相媲美，同时平均减少了70%以上的标记使用量。我们还进行了广泛的分析，以验证ARM2的有效性及其设计的合理性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Framework of Reflective Agents with Adaptive Collaboration for Attributed Summary Generation
papers.title_zh: 基于反思型智能体的协作框架：用于属性化摘要生成的算法
papers.authors: Yu Chen, Peng Chen, Ziwei Zheng, Bang Wang
papers.abstract: Despite progress in LLM summarization, factual hallucinations persist, motivating Attributed Summary Generation (ASG), which requires sentence-level citations. However, existing prompt-based approaches face severe challenges such as positional preference, poor citation quality and sensitivity to uninformative documents. In view of these limitations, we propose \mathbf{RAAC}, a framework of \mathbf{R}eflective \mathbf{A}gents with \mathbf{A}daptive \mathbf{C}ollaboration for attributed summarization. RAAC performs iterative summarization via reflective agents’ collaboration, where a post reflection module evaluates the consistency between the summary and the input documents, based on which it critiques the summary and uses the resulting feedback to recalibrate the inputs to the next adaptive iteration. The agents’ collaboration involves two components: \mathsf{TextAgent} and \mathsf{CitationAgent}. Experimental results on the ALCE benchmark demonstrate that our framework outperforms existing baselines in both factual correctness and citation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在大语言模型摘要生成方面取得了进展，但事实性幻觉问题仍然存在。为此，我们提出了归因摘要生成技术，该技术需要基于句子级别的引用。然而，现有的基于提示的方法面临着诸多挑战，例如位置偏好问题、引用质量不佳以及对无信息价值的文档的敏感性。鉴于这些局限性，我们提出了$\mathbf{RAAC}$框架——一个由$\mathbf{R}$反映型智能体与$\mathbf{A}$适应型协作智能体组成的系统，用于实现归因摘要生成。$\mathbf{RAAC}$通过反映型智能体的协作来实现迭代式摘要生成，其中后反思模块会评估摘要与输入文档之间的一致性，并根据这一评估结果对摘要进行修正，同时利用反馈信息来重新调整下一次迭代的输入参数。该系统的智能体协作包括两个组件：$\mathsf{TextAgent}$和$\mathsf{CitationAgent}$。在ALCE基准测试中的实验结果表明，我们的框架在事实准确性与引用质量方面均优于现有的基线方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VLURes: Benchmarking Long-Text Grounding and Cross-Lingual Robustness in Vision Language Models
papers.title_zh: VLURes：对长文本基准测试以及跨语言鲁棒性的视觉语言模型进行评估
papers.authors: Jesse Atuhurra, Iqra Ali, Tomoya Iwakura, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Tatsuya Hiraoka
papers.abstract: We introduce VLURes, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under long-text grounding: selecting and reasoning over the image-relevant subset of article-length text that contains distractors and ungrounded claims. VLURes contains 4,000 web-curated image + long-text pairs across English (En), Japanese (Ja), Swahili (Sw), and Urdu (Ur) and 10 topical categories, and defines eight tasks spanning image-only perception (OR, SU, RU, SS, IC) and image+text grounding (ITM, Unrelatedness, VQA). To construct web-realistic pairs, we apply language-adapted CLIP alignment to select representative images and filter weakly grounded pages. Across 10 proprietary and open VLMs evaluated under zero-shot and one-shot prompting, with and without rationales, the best model (GPT-4o) reaches 90.8% overall accuracy but remains 6.7 points below human performance (97.5%) on Object Recognition, and cross-lingual sensitivity persists, while open models are substantially weaker and often lack reliable multilingual VL support. VLURes provides a practical testbed for long-text grounding and multilingual robustness in web-realistic agent settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了VLURes，这是一个多语言基准测试工具，用于评估视觉语言模型在长文本场景下的表现。该测试旨在识别与图像相关的文本子集，这些文本可能包含干扰信息或不准确的陈述。VLURes包含了4,000对从网络收集整理的英文、日文、斯瓦希里语和乌尔都语长文本与图片对，涵盖了10个主题类别。该工具定义了八种任务，包括仅基于图像的感知任务（如物体识别、语义理解等），以及结合图像和文本的情境感知任务。为了构建真实场景下的测试对，我们使用了适应不同语言的CLIP对齐技术来选取具有代表性的图片，并过滤掉那些相关性较低的页面。在评估了10种专有模型和开源模型时，无论是在零样本还是一样本提示条件下，无论是否提供理由，最好的模型GPT-4o仍然达到了90.8%的整体准确率，但比人类在物体识别方面的性能（97.5%）低了6.7个百分点。此外，该模型在跨语言性能上仍然存在问题，而开源模型则明显较弱，且往往缺乏可靠的多语言视觉语言模型支持。VLURes为在真实场景中对视觉语言模型进行长文本场景下的评估提供了实用的测试平台，同时也检验了模型在多语言环境中的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Trustworthy and Explainable Causal Representation Learning in Transformers
papers.title_zh: 在变换器中实现可靠且易于解释的因果表征学习
papers.authors: Yang Liu, Yinghao Zhang, Lin Liu, Jiuyong Li, Debo Cheng, Zaiwen Feng
papers.abstract: A prevalent approach to interpretable representation learning involves creating a mask that weights the significance of each input feature, followed by deriving a masked representation by applying this mask to the input representation. However, the identifiability of these learned masked representations is often uncertain, making the origin of these representations ambiguous or unreliable. Furthermore, the approaches to interpreting Transformer based on attention weights have been criticized for their faithfulness. To address these limitations, we propose a novel causal framework that directly learns identifiable and explainable representations from attention weights, rather than relying on importance masks. Our framework leverages identifiability theory and causal representation learning to extract explainable representations within a subspace of input representations, effectively transforming frozen representation learning methods into self-explaining systems. Experimental results on real-world datasets demonstrate that, compared to well-established state-of-the-art methods, our approach provides identifiable and more trustworthy explanations while guaranteeing faithfulness.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，可解释表示学习的主流方法通常是创建一个权重矩阵，来体现每个输入特征的重要性，然后再将这个权重矩阵应用于输入表示，从而得到带有掩码表示的表示。然而，这些经过学习的掩码表示的识别性往往并不明确，导致这些表示的来源难以确定或不可靠。此外，基于注意力权重的Transformer表示方法也因其准确性受到了质疑。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的因果框架：该框架直接从注意力权重中学习出可识别且可解释的表示，而无需依赖重要性掩码。我们的框架利用了可识别性理论和因果表示学习技术，从输入表示的子空间中提取出易于解释的表示，从而将传统的冻结表示学习方法转化为自解释系统。在真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，与现有的先进方法相比，我们的方法能够提供更可靠且可识别的解释，同时还能保证其准确性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Affectron: Emotional Speech Synthesis with Affective and Contextually Aligned Nonverbal Vocalizations
papers.title_zh: Affectron：结合情感因素与上下文相关非语言表现的情绪语音合成技术
papers.authors: Deok-Hyeon Cho, Hyung-Seok Oh, Seung-Bin Kim, Seong-Whan Lee
papers.abstract: Nonverbal vocalizations (NVs), such as laughter and sighs, are central to the expression of affective cues in emotional speech synthesis. However, learning diverse and contextually aligned NVs remains challenging in open settings due to limited NV data and the lack of explicit supervision. Motivated by this challenge, we propose Affectron as a framework for affective and contextually aligned NV generation. Built on a small-scale open and decoupled corpus, Affectron introduces an NV-augmented training strategy that expands the distribution of NV types and insertion locations. We further incorporate NV structural masking into a speech backbone pre-trained on purely verbal speech to enable diverse and natural NV synthesis. Experimental results demonstrate that Affectron produces more expressive and diverse NVs than baseline systems while preserving the naturalness of the verbal speech stream.
papers.abstract_zh: 非语言发声（NV），如笑声和叹息声，在情感语音合成中扮演着至关重要的角色。然而，在开放环境中学习多种多样且符合上下文要求的NV仍然具有挑战性，因为NV数据有限，且缺乏明确的监督机制。鉴于这一挑战，我们提出了Affectron这一框架，用于生成符合情感和上下文要求的NV。该框架基于一个小型的、开放的、分离化的语料库构建，采用了一种增强NV的训练策略，从而扩大了NV的类型和插入位置。此外，我们还将NV结构掩蔽技术融入到一个仅基于口头语音进行预训练的语音模型中，以实现多样化和自然的NV合成效果。实验结果表明，Affectron能够产生比基线系统更富有表现力和多样性的NV，同时还能保持口头语音流的自然性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Reasoning-Guided Exploration for Online DPO
papers.title_zh: 基于推理的在线DPO探索方法
papers.authors: Zetian Hu, Shunyu Liu, Ting-En Lin, Fei Huang, Yongbin Li, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: Recent work has aimed to enhance the reasoning capabilities of language models, but these methods are often limited to domains with objectively verifiable answers. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Reasoning-Guided Exploration for Online DPO (RGE-DPO), a novel self-play framework designed to improve reasoning on general-domain data. RGE-DPO employs a dual-reward mechanism to evaluate responses by assessing: (1) reasoning quality using a self-rewarding rubric that provides structured evaluation of logical coherence, reasoning depth, and verification behaviors; and (2) response quality using an established reward model trained for aspects like helpfulness and correctness. These two orthogonal evaluation signals enable a comprehensive assessment of different response dimensions without conflating reasoning processes with response content. We then integrate these two evaluation signals based on a weighted ranking mechanism to construct the preference pairs, which ensures that responses with superior reasoning processes are preferred when response quality is comparable. Experiments demonstrate that RGE-DPO achieves substantial improvements in instruction-following benchmark while maintaining competitive performance on verifiable academic benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究旨在提升语言模型的推理能力，但这些方法往往局限于那些有客观可验证答案的领域。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种名为“在线DPO的推理引导探索”的新框架——RGE-DPO。该框架旨在提高对一般领域数据的推理能力。RGE-DPO采用双奖励机制来评估响应：其一，通过一种自我激励的评估标准来衡量推理质量，该标准能够系统地评估逻辑连贯性、推理深度以及验证行为；其二，利用经过训练的奖励模型来评估响应的质量，这些模型针对有帮助性和正确性等方面进行了训练。这两种正交的评估指标使得我们可以全面评估不同的响应维度，而不会将推理过程与响应内容混为一谈。然后，我们基于加权排名机制将这两种评估指标结合起来，以构建偏好对。这样，当响应质量相当时，我们可以优先选择那些具有更优推理能力的响应。实验表明，RGE-DPO在遵循指令的基准测试中取得了显著改进，同时在可验证的学术基准测试中也保持了竞争力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CAPA: Contribution-Aware Pruning and FFN Approximation for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: CAPA：贡献感知剪枝与FFN近似方法，用于高效的大型视觉语言模型训练
papers.authors: Samyak Jha, Junho Kim
papers.abstract: Efficient inference in Large Vision-Language Models is constrained by the high cost of processing thousands of visual tokens, yet it remains unclear which tokens and computations can be safely removed. While attention scores are commonly used to estimate visual token importance, they are an imperfect proxy for actual contribution. We show that Attention Contribution, which weights attention probabilities by value vector magnitude, provides a more accurate criterion for visual token selection. Our empirical analysis reveals that visual attention sinks are functionally heterogeneous, comprising Probability Dumps with low contribution that can be safely pruned, and Structural Anchors with high contribution essential for maintaining model performance. Further, we identify substantial redundancy in Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) associated with visual tokens, particularly in intermediate layers where image tokens exhibit linear behavior. Based on our findings, we introduce CAPA (Contribution-Aware Pruning and FFN Approximation), a dual-strategy framework that prunes visual tokens using attention contribution at critical functional transitions and reduces FFN computation through efficient linear approximations. Experiments on various benchmarks across baselines show that CAPA achieves competent efficiency–performance trade-offs with improved robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大型视觉语言模型中进行高效推理受到处理数千个视觉令牌的高成本限制，然而目前仍不清楚哪些令牌和计算可以安全地被移除。虽然注意力得分常被用来估计视觉令牌的重要性，但它们并不能准确反映实际贡献程度。我们发现，通过价值向量幅度来加权注意力概率的“注意力贡献”指标，能够提供更准确的视觉令牌选择标准。我们的实证分析表明，视觉注意力汇聚点存在功能上的异质性：一部分低贡献的概率倾倒节点可以安全地被修剪掉，而另一部分对维持模型性能至关重要的高贡献结构锚点则必须保留。此外，我们还发现与视觉令牌相关的前馈网络中存在大量冗余现象，尤其是在图像令牌表现出线性行为的中间层。基于这些发现，我们提出了CAPA（贡献感知修剪与前馈网络近似）这一双策略框架：该框架在关键的功能转换点利用注意力贡献来修剪视觉令牌，同时通过高效的线性近似减少前馈网络的计算量。在多种基准测试中的实验结果表明，CAPA在效率与性能之间实现了良好的权衡，并且具有更好的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Strong Reasoning Isn’t Enough: Evaluating Evidence Elicitation in Interactive Diagnosis
papers.title_zh: 仅凭有力的推理是不够的：在互动诊断中评估证据的有效性
papers.authors: Zhuohan Long, Zhongyu Wei
papers.abstract: Interactive medical consultation requires an agent to proactively elicit missing clinical evidence under uncertainty. Yet existing evaluations largely remain static or outcome-centric, neglecting the evidence-gathering process. In this work, we propose an interactive evaluation framework that explicitly models the consultation process using a simulated patient and a measurement module grounded in atomic evidences. Based on this representation, we introduce Information Coverage Rate (ICR) to quantify how completely an agent uncovers necessary evidence during interaction. To support systematic study, we build EviMed, an evidence-based benchmark spanning diverse conditions from common complaints to rare diseases, and evaluate 10 models with varying reasoning abilities. We find that strong diagnostic reasoning does not guarantee effective information collection, and this insufficiency acts as a primary bottleneck limiting performance in interactive settings. To address this, we propose REFINE, a strategy that leverages diagnostic verification to guide the agent in proactively resolving uncertainties. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REFINE consistently outperforms baseline methods across diverse models and datasets, achieving superior information coverage and diagnostic accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 交互式医疗咨询需要代理在不确定性情况下主动收集缺失的临床证据。然而，现有的评估方式大多仍然停留在静态或结果导向的层面，忽视了证据收集的过程。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个交互式评估框架，该框架利用模拟患者和基于原子证据的测量模块来明确建模咨询过程。基于这种表示方式，我们引入了信息覆盖率这一概念，以量化代理在互动过程中能够完全收集到必要证据的程度。为了支持系统的研究，我们构建了EviMed这一基于证据的基准测试，涵盖了从常见疾病到罕见疾病的多种情况，并对10种具有不同推理能力的模型进行了评估。我们发现，强大的诊断推理并不能保证有效的信息收集，而这种不足正是限制交互式环境性能的主要瓶颈。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了REFINE策略，该策略利用诊断验证来指导代理主动解决不确定性问题。广泛的实验表明，REFINE在不同模型和数据集上始终优于基线方法，实现了更高的信息覆盖率和诊断准确性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: IF-GEO: Conflict-Aware Instruction Fusion for Multi-Query Generative Engine Optimization
papers.title_zh: IF-GEO：基于冲突意识的指令融合技术，用于优化多查询生成引擎的性能
papers.authors: Heyang Zhou, Jiajia Chen, Xiaolu Chen, Jie Bao, Zhen Chen, Yong Liao
papers.abstract: As Generative Engines revolutionize information retrieval by synthesizing direct answers from retrieved sources, ensuring source visibility becomes a significant challenge. Improving it through targeted content revisions is a practical strategy termed Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). However, optimizing a document for diverse queries presents a constrained optimization challenge where heterogeneous queries often impose conflicting and competing revision requirements under a limited content budget. To address this challenge, we propose IF-GEO, a “diverge-then-converge” framework comprising two phases: (i) mining distinct optimization preferences from representative latent queries; (ii) synthesizing a Global Revision Blueprint for guided editing by coordinating preferences via conflict-aware instruction fusion. To explicitly quantify IF-GEO’s objective of cross-query stability, we introduce risk-aware stability metrics. Experiments on multi-query benchmarks demonstrate that IF-GEO achieves substantial performance gains while maintaining robustness across diverse retrieval scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着生成式引擎通过从检索到的来源中合成直接答案来彻底改变信息检索方式，确保来源的可见性成为了一项重大挑战。通过有针对性的内容修改来改进这一状况是一种名为“生成式引擎优化”（GEO）的实际策略。然而，为多种查询优化文档却面临着一个复杂的优化难题——异质查询往往会在有限的内容预算下产生相互冲突的修改要求。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了IF-GEO框架，该框架采用“分而治之”的策略，包含两个阶段：(i) 从具有代表性的潜在查询中提取不同的优化偏好；(ii) 通过冲突感知的指令融合机制，协调这些偏好以生成全局修改蓝图，从而进行有指导的编辑。为了明确量化IF-GEO在跨查询稳定性方面的目标，我们引入了风险感知的稳定性指标。在多查询基准测试中的实验表明，IF-GEO在保持不同检索场景下的鲁棒性的同时，取得了显著的性能提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Investigating Human and LLMs’ Decisions in Unverifiable Environments: A Case Study with GitHub Activity Overview
papers.title_zh: 在无法验证的环境中调查人类用户和大型语言模型的决策：以GitHub活动为例进行的研究分析
papers.authors: Zheng Jiang, Wei Wang, Gaowei Zhang, Yang Feng, Yi Wang
papers.abstract: The behaviors of Large Language Models (LLMs) as artificial social actors are largely underexplored, particularly in unverifiable scenarios where conventional benchmarking has little to help improve their abilities. Thus, examining their behaviors in such scenarios can help understand and improve LLMs’ capabilities of simulating real-world social actors in many tasks such as LLM-empowered social agents. We draw a typical unverifiable scenario–a simplified pull request scenario on GitHub focusing on decision-making based on Activity Overview signal–to investigate how human and LLMs behave. We introduce a systematic method to collect, compare, and reason about human and LLMs’ decisions. Our results reveal that there are both similarities and differences between human and LLMs’ decisions, and proprietary LLMs generally behave more like human than open-source LLMs do. We further find that human and LLMs may rely on different information and reasoning mechanisms in decision-making. Our study thus urges more future work on human and LLMs decision-making in unverifiable environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型作为人工社会行为体的行为尚未得到充分研究，尤其是在那些难以通过传统基准测试来评估其能力的场景中。因此，研究这些场景中的行为有助于理解并提升大语言模型在模拟现实世界社会行为体方面的能力，例如由大语言模型驱动的社会代理系统。我们选取了一个典型的不可验证场景——GitHub上的简化拉取请求场景，该场景以活动概览信号为基础进行决策分析，以此来研究人类和大语言模型的决策行为。我们提出了一种系统化的方法，用于收集、比较和分析人类与大语言模型的决策结果。我们的研究结果表明，人类与大语言模型的决策之间存在相似之处，同时也存在差异。此外，专有大语言模型的决策行为通常更类似于人类的行为，而开源大语言模型的决策行为则有所不同。我们还发现，人类和大语言模型在决策过程中可能依赖不同的信息和推理机制。因此，本研究呼吁未来需要更多关于人类与大语言模型在不可验证环境中的决策行为的研究。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PlotGen-Bench: Evaluating VLMs on Generating Visualization Code from Diverse Plots across Multiple Libraries
papers.title_zh: PlotGen-Bench：评估VLM在生成多种图表可视化代码方面的性能，涵盖多个不同的库
papers.authors: Yi Zhao, Zhen Yang, Shuaiqi Duan, Wenmeng Yu, Zhe Su, Jibing Gong, Jie Tang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in vision–language models (VLMs) have expanded their multimodal code generation capabilities, yet their ability to generate executable visualization code from plots, especially for complex 3D, animated, plot-to-plot transformations, or multi-library scenarios, remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce PlotGen-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating plot-to-code generation under realistic and complex visualization scenarios. The benchmark spans 9 major categories, 30 subcategories, and 3 core tasks—plot replication, plot transformation, and multi-library generation, covering both 2D, 3D and animated plots across 5 widely used visualization libraries. Through systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art open- and closed-source VLMs, we find that open-source models still lag considerably behind in visual fidelity and semantic consistency, despite achieving comparable code executability. Moreover, all models exhibit substantial degradation on reasoning-intensive tasks such as chart type conversion and animation generation. PlotGen-Bench establishes a rigorous foundation for advancing research toward more capable and reliable VLMs for visualization authoring and code synthesis, with all data and code available at https://plotgen.github.io.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，视觉-语言模型在多模态代码生成能力方面取得了显著进展。然而，这些模型从图表中生成可执行可视化代码的能力仍然有待进一步探索，尤其是在复杂的3D动画图表转换或多库场景处理方面。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了PlotGen-Bench这一综合性基准测试工具，用于评估在真实且复杂的可视化场景下的图表到代码生成能力。该基准测试涵盖了9个主要类别、30个子类别以及3项核心任务——图表复制、图表转换和多库生成，涉及2D、3D及动画图表，并使用了5种常见的可视化库。通过对各种开源和闭源视觉-语言模型进行系统性的评估，我们发现尽管这些模型在代码可执行性方面表现相当，但在视觉逼真度和语义一致性方面仍存在较大差距。此外，所有模型在需要复杂推理的任务上表现不佳，例如图表类型转换和动画生成。PlotGen-Bench为推进更强大、更可靠的视觉化创作和代码合成技术提供了坚实的基础。所有数据和代码均可在此网站获取：https://plotgen.github.io
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Chronos: Learning Temporal Dynamics of Reasoning Chains for Test-Time Scaling
papers.title_zh: 克洛诺斯：掌握推理链的时间动态规律，以实现测试时间的高效调整
papers.authors: Kai Zhang, Jiayi Liao, Chengpeng Li, Ziyuan Xie, Sihang Li, Xiang Wang
papers.abstract: Test-Time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as an effective paradigm for improving the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods — most notably majority voting and heuristic token-level scoring — treat reasoning traces or tokens equally, thereby being susceptible to substantial variations in trajectory quality and localized logical failures. In this work, we introduce Chronos, a lightweight and plug-and-play chronological reasoning scorer that models each trajectory as a time series. Specifically, Chronos learns to capture trajectory features of token probabilities, assigns quality scores accordingly, and employs a weighted voting mechanism. Extensive evaluations on both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks demonstrate that Chronos consistently delivers substantial gains across a variety of models, with negligible computational overhead. Notably, Chronos@128 achieves relative improvements of 34.21% over Pass@1 and 22.70% over Maj@128 on HMMT25 using Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, highlighting its effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间缩放技术（Test-Time Scaling，TTS）已成为提升大语言模型推理性能的有效方法。然而，现有的方法——尤其是多数投票和启发式令牌级评分方法——往往对推理轨迹或令牌进行平等处理，这容易导致轨迹质量的显著差异以及局部逻辑错误。在这项研究中，我们提出了Chronos这一轻量级且即插即用的时序推理评分器。该评分器将每个推理轨迹建模为时间序列。具体来说，Chronos能够捕捉到令牌概率的轨迹特征，并据此分配质量分数，同时采用加权投票机制进行决策。在领域内外的基准测试中的广泛评估表明，Chronos能够在多种模型中带来显著的性能提升，且计算开销极小。值得注意的是，在使用Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507和Maj@128进行HMMT25测试时，Chronos@128的改进幅度分别达到了34.21%和22.70%，充分证明了其有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: V-RoLoRA: RLVR-Driven MoE Routing for Steerable Pluralistic Alignment
papers.title_zh: V-RoLoRA：基于RLVR驱动的MoE路由算法，实现可调节的多元对齐
papers.authors: Jing Wang, Yaomin Wu, Yinglin Wang, Yitong Yang
papers.abstract: Steerable pluralistic alignment aims to enable large language models (LLMs) to reliably adhere to diverse and potentially conflicting human values, particularly when target objectives involve multi-dimensional, compositional values. Current methods largely rely on prompt engineering or reasoning-time guidance, which often results in fragile and non-persistent control once prompts are perturbed or omitted. In this work, we study value-controllable alignment through discrete condition vectors and propose Verifiable-reward-Routed LoRA—a parameter-efficient mixture-of-experts LoRA framework enhanced with conditioned gating. This gating mechanism dynamically directs the flow among multiple LoRA experts based on an input value or moral vector. To ensure that such routing leads to semantically compliant outputs, we formulate post-training as a reinforcement learning problem with verifiable rewards. We further introduce a conditional consistency reward, computed by an external model-based verifier implemented as a lightweight discriminator, and optimize the adapter parameters using GRPO. Experiments on the Touché23-valueEval (value alignment) and MIC (moral alignment) benchmarks, using two 8-billion-parameter backbones, show that our method consistently outperforms prompt-based steering and multi-task PEFT baselines. It attains the highest overall controllability across micro-F1, macro-F1, and Jaccard metrics—a conclusion further reinforced by human pairwise evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: 可引导的多元对齐旨在使大语言模型能够可靠地遵循多样且可能存在冲突的人类价值观，尤其是在目标涉及多维、复合性价值观的情况下。目前的方法主要依赖提示工程或推理时间指导，但这往往会导致一旦提示被干扰或省略后，控制效果变得不稳定且不可持续。在这项研究中，我们通过离散的条件向量来研究价值可控的对齐方法，并提出了可验证奖励路由LoRA——一种参数高效的混合专家LoRA框架，该框架通过条件门控机制得到增强。这种门控机制能够根据输入值或道德向量动态调节多个LoRA专家之间的数据流。为了确保这种路由能够产生语义上合规的输出，我们将训练后的过程构建为一个具有可验证奖励的强化学习问题。此外，我们还引入了一种条件一致性奖励，该奖励由基于外部模型的验证器计算得出，该验证器被实现为一个轻量级鉴别器。我们使用GRPO算法来优化适配器参数。在Touché23-valueEval（价值对齐）和MIC（道德对齐）基准测试上的实验表明，使用两个拥有80亿参数的主干网络时，我们的方法始终优于基于提示的引导方法和多任务PEFT基线方法。它在微观F1、宏观F1和Jaccard指标方面实现了最高的整体可控性——这一结论还通过人类成对评估得到了进一步验证。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ParaCook: On Time-Efficient Planning for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: ParaCook：适用于多智能体系统的准时高效规划方法
papers.authors: Shiqi Zhang, Xinbei Ma, Yunqing Xu, Zouying Cao, Pengrui Lu, Haobo Yuan, Tiancheng Shen, Zhuosheng Zhang, Hai Zhao, Ming-Hsuan Yang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning abilities for planning long-horizon, real-world tasks, yet existing agent benchmarks focus on task completion while neglecting time efficiency in parallel and asynchronous operations. To address this, we present ParaCook, a benchmark for time-efficient collaborative planning. Inspired by the Overcooked game, ParaCook provides an environment for various challenging interaction planning of multi-agent systems that are instantiated as cooking tasks, with a simplified action space to isolate the core challenge of strategic parallel planning. Through a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that current approaches achieve suboptimal plans, which struggle with parallel actions or coordination. Our analysis also reveals LLMs’ potential on abstract tasks where they can focus on high-level parallel optimization. ParaCook provides a scalable evaluation framework with adjustable complexity, establishing a foundation for developing and assessing time efficiency-aware multi-agent planning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在规划长期现实任务时展现出强大的推理能力，然而现有的智能体基准测试主要集中在任务完成上，而忽略了并行和异步操作中的时间效率问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ParaCook这一用于高效协作规划的基准测试。Paracoook借鉴了《Overcooked》游戏的设计理念，为各种多智能体系统的交互规划提供了一个环境，这些系统以烹饪任务的形式呈现，同时采用简化的动作空间来突出战略性并行规划的核心挑战。通过对最先进的语言模型进行全面评估，我们发现当前的方法往往无法得到最优的规划方案，尤其是在处理并行动作或协调问题时表现不佳。我们的分析还揭示了语言模型在抽象任务上的潜力，它们能够专注于高层次的并行优化。Paracoook提供了一个可扩展的评估框架，其复杂度可以灵活调整，为开发和评估注重时间效率的多智能体规划提供了基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Multimodal Unlearning Across Vision, Language, Video, and Audio: Survey of Methods, Datasets, and Benchmarks
papers.title_zh: 视觉、语言、视频和音频领域的多模态遗忘机制：方法、数据集与评估标准综述
papers.authors: Nobin Sarwar, Shubhashis Roy Dipta, Zheyuan Liu, Vaidehi Patil
papers.abstract: With the growing adoption of VLMs, DMs, LLMs, and AFMs, these multimodal foundation models can inadvertently encode sensitive, copyrighted, biased, or unsafe cross-modal associations that originate from their training data. Retraining after deletion requests or policy updates is often impractical, and targeted forgetting remains difficult because knowledge is distributed across shared representations. Multimodal unlearning addresses this challenge by enabling selective removal across modalities while retaining overall utility. This survey offers a unified, system-oriented view of multimodal unlearning across vision, language, audio, and video, grounded in recent advances, emerging applications, and open problems. Our taxonomy enables systematic comparison across model architectures and modalities, clarifying trade-offs among deletion strength, retention, efficiency, reversibility, and robustness. This survey highlights open problems and practical considerations to support future research and deployment of multimodal unlearning.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着视觉语言模型、对话生成模型、大语言模型和音频生成模型被越来越多地采用，这些多模态基础模型可能会无意中编码出来自训练数据的敏感、受版权保护、带有偏见或不安全的跨模态关联。在删除请求或政策更新之后进行重新训练往往是不切实际的，而针对特定知识的遗忘也仍然很困难，因为知识分布在多个共享的表示中。多模态去学习通过实现跨模态的选择性移除，同时保留整体效用，从而解决了这一挑战。本综述从视觉、语言、音频和视频等多个维度，结合最新的进展、新兴应用以及尚未解决的问题，提供了对多模态去学习的统一、系统化的视角。我们的分类体系使得可以系统地比较不同模型架构和模态之间的差异，并明确删除强度、保留效果、效率、可逆性和鲁棒性之间的权衡关系。本综述还指出了一些尚未解决的问题以及支持未来多模态去学习研究和部署的实际考虑因素。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Interpretability to Performance: Optimizing Retrieval Heads for Long-Context Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从可解释性到性能提升：为长上下文语言模型优化检索机制
papers.authors: Youmi Ma, Naoaki Okazaki
papers.abstract: Advances in mechanistic interpretability have identified special attention heads, known as retrieval heads, that are responsible for retrieving information from the context. However, the role of these retrieval heads in improving model performance remains unexplored. This work investigates whether retrieval heads can be leveraged to enhance the long-context capabilities of LLMs. Specifically, we propose RetMask, a method that generates training signals by contrasting normal model outputs with those from an ablated variant in which the retrieval heads are masked. This mechanism-based approach achieves substantial improvements: +2.28 points on HELMET at 128K for Llama-3.1, with +70% gains on generation with citation and +32% on passage re-ranking, while preserving performance on general tasks. Experiments across three model families demonstrate that RetMask consistently improves long-context performance, with gains correlating with the sparsity of the retrieval score distribution: models with sparser distributions, where retrieval capabilities are concentrated in a small set of heads, respond more strongly, while those with less sparse distributions show more modest gains. These results validate the functional role of retrieval heads and show that mechanistic insights can be transformed into performance enhancements.
papers.abstract_zh: 在机制可解释性方面的研究已经确定了几个特殊的注意力单元，这些单元被称为检索单元，它们负责从上下文中提取信息。然而，这些检索单元在提升模型性能方面的作用仍未被充分探索。本研究旨在探讨是否可以利用检索单元来增强大语言模型的长期上下文处理能力。具体来说，我们提出了RetMask方法，该方法通过将正常模型输出与经过掩蔽的模型输出进行对比来生成训练信号，其中掩蔽了检索单元。这种基于机制的方法取得了显著的改进：在128K的HELMET评估中，Llama-3.1模型的性能提升了2.28点；在生成引用内容时，性能提升了70%；在段落重新排序任务上，性能提升了32%。同时，这些改进并未影响模型在一般任务上的表现。针对三种不同模型家族的实验表明，RetMask方法能够持续提升长期上下文处理能力，而且这种提升效果与检索得分分布的稀疏程度有关：那些检索能力集中在少数几个单元中的模型，其性能提升更为明显；而那些检索能力分布较为稀疏的模型则表现出较小的提升效果。这些结果验证了检索单元的功能作用，并表明从机制层面获得的洞察可以转化为实际的性能提升。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Bridging the Temporal Gap in Multimodal LLMs: Deeply Stacking Temporal Tokens for Audio-Visual Speech Recognition
papers.title_zh: 填补多模态大语言模型中的时间间隔：深度叠加时间标记以实现音频与视觉信息的融合识别
papers.authors: Liyong Wang, Junliang Xing, Tianyu Hu, Jianfei Jiang, Jihuai Zhao, Huimin Ma
papers.abstract: Audio-Visual Speech Recognition enhances speech recognition robustness in noisy conditions by leveraging visual cues. However, current Multimodal LLMs suffer from a fundamental temporal gap. This gap is characterized by limited fine-grained temporal modeling in vision encoders and progressive temporal semantic degradation throughout the deep layers of LLM decoders. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel framework that deeply stacks temporal tokens across both the encoding and decoding stages. Specifically, we enhance the vision encoder with a temporal-aware attention module and temporal rotary positional embeddings to precisely capture the sequential evolution and dynamics of lip movements. Furthermore, we stack hierarchical temporal tokens that incorporate temporally enriched features into multiple layers of the LLM decoder in a bottom-up manner. Extensive experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves high efficiency and firm performance, outperforming existing supervised, self-supervised, and LLM-based methods by 6.1% on LRS2 and 7.8% on LRS3.
papers.abstract_zh: 音视频语音识别通过利用视觉线索，提升了在嘈杂环境中的语音识别性能。然而，目前的多模态大语言模型存在根本性的时间差问题。这个问题表现为视觉编码器的细粒度时间建模能力有限，以及大语言模型解码器各深层层次中的时间语义逐渐退化现象。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，在编码和解码阶段都深度叠加时间标记。具体来说，我们通过添加具有时间感知的注意力模块和时序旋转位置嵌入来改进视觉编码器，从而能够精确捕捉嘴唇运动的序列演变和动态变化。此外，我们还以自下而上的方式，将包含时间丰富特征的分层时间标记叠加到大语言模型解码器的多个层次中。在LRS2和LRS3基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法取得了高效且稳定的性能，在LRS2上的表现比现有监督式、自监督式以及基于大语言模型的方法高出6.1%，在LRS3上的表现则高出7.8%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MHSafeEval: Role-Aware Interaction-Level Evaluation of Mental Health Safety in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MHSafeEval：针对大型语言模型中的心理健康安全问题的角色感知交互级评估工具
papers.authors: Suhyun Lee, Palakorn Achananuparp, Neemesh Yadav, Ee-Peng Lim, Yang Deng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored as scalable tools for mental health counseling, yet evaluating their safety remains challenging due to the interactional and context-dependent nature of clinical harm. Existing evaluation frameworks predominantly assess isolated responses using coarse-grained taxonomies or static datasets, limiting their ability to diagnose how harms emerge and accumulate over multi-turn counseling interactions. In this work, we introduce R-MHSafe, a role-aware mental health safety taxonomy that characterizes clinically significant harm in terms of the interactional roles an AI counselor adopts, including perpetrator, instigator, facilitator, or enabler, combined with clinically grounded harm categories. Then, we propose MHSafeEval, a closed-loop, agent-based evaluation framework that formulates safety assessment as trajectory-level discovery of harm through adversarial multi-turn interactions, guided by role-aware modeling. Using R-MHSafe and MHSafeEval, we conduct a large-scale evaluation across state-of-the-art LLMs. Our results reveal substantial role-dependent and cumulative safety failures that are systematically missed by existing static benchmarks, and show that our framework significantly improves failure-mode coverage and diagnostic granularity.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在心理健康咨询领域被越来越多地作为可扩展工具进行探索，但由于临床伤害具有交互性和情境依赖性的特点，对其安全性进行评估仍然具有挑战性。现有的评估框架主要使用粗粒度分类或静态数据集来评估孤立反应，这限制了它们诊断伤害如何在多轮咨询互动中产生和累积的能力。在这项研究中，我们提出了R-MHSafe，这是一个注重角色关系的心理健康安全分类体系，它通过描述人工智能咨询师所扮演的角色来表征具有临床意义的伤害，这些角色包括施害者、煽动者、促进者或促成者，同时还包括基于临床的伤害类别。接着，我们提出了MHSafeEval，这是一个基于代理的闭环评估框架，它通过将安全评估转化为通过对抗性多轮互动来发现伤害的过程，并借助注重角色关系的建模方法来实现这一目标。利用R-MHSafe和MHSafeEval，我们对最先进的语言模型进行了大规模评估。我们的研究结果揭示了大量依赖于角色关系且累积性的安全缺陷，而这些缺陷被现有的静态基准测试系统性地忽略了。此外，我们的框架显著提高了故障模式的覆盖率和诊断的精细度。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Enabling Stroke-Level Structural Analysis of Hieroglyphic Scripts without Language-Specific Priors
papers.title_zh: 能够在不依赖任何语言特定先验知识的情况下，对象形文字进行逐笔画的分析与结构分析
papers.authors: Fuwen Luo, Zihao Wan, Ziyue Wang, Yaluo Liu, Pau Tong Lin Xu, Xuanjia Qiao, Xiaolong Wang, Peng Li, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Hieroglyphs, as logographic writing systems, encode rich semantic and cultural information within their internal structural composition. Yet, current advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) usually remain structurally blind to this information. LLMs process characters as textual tokens, while MLLMs additionally view them as raw pixel grids. Both fall short to model the underlying logic of character strokes. Furthermore, existing structural analysis methods are often script-specific and labor-intensive. In this paper, we propose Hieroglyphic Stroke Analyzer (HieroSA), a novel and generalizable framework that enables MLLMs to automatically derive stroke-level structures from character bitmaps without handcrafted data. It transforms modern logographic and ancient hieroglyphs character images into explicit, interpretable line-segment representations in a normalized coordinate space, allowing for cross-lingual generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HieroSA effectively captures character-internal structures and semantics, bypassing the need for language-specific priors. Experimental results highlight the potential of our work as a graphematics analysis tool for a deeper understanding of hieroglyphic scripts.
papers.abstract_zh: 象形文字作为一种表意书写系统，其内部结构蕴含着丰富的语义和文化信息。然而，当前先进的大语言模型（LLMs）和多模态语言模型（MLLMs）通常无法从这些信息中提取出有用的结构信息。LLMs将字符视为文本标记来处理，而MLLMs则将其视为原始的像素网格。这两种方法都未能充分模拟字符笔画背后的逻辑。此外，现有的结构分析方法往往具有脚本特异性，且需要大量的人工操作。在本文中，我们提出了HieroSA这一新颖且可泛化的框架，它能够使MLLMs无需人工数据即可自动从字符图像中提取出笔画级别的结构信息。该框架能够将现代表意文字和古代象形文字的字符图像转换为在标准化坐标空间中的清晰、可解释的线段表示形式，从而实现跨语言的通用性。大量的实验表明，HieroSA能够有效捕捉字符内部的结构和语义信息，而无需依赖特定语言的先验知识。实验结果凸显了我们的工作作为图形学分析工具的潜力，有助于更深入地理解象形文字的书写方式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CODEPROMPTZIP: Code-specific Prompt Compression for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Coding Tasks with LMs
papers.title_zh: CODEPROMPTZIP：针对编程任务的检索增强生成模型而设计的特定代码提示压缩方法
papers.authors: Pengfei He, Shaowei Wang, Tse-Hsun Chen
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances code generation by incorporating retrieved code examples into prompts, but the resulting long-context inputs impose substantial memory and computational overhead. Existing prompt compression techniques are largely designed for natural language and fail to account for the structural and semantic properties of code, while also lacking fine-grained control over compression ratios. We propose CodePromptZip, a code-aware prompt compression framework for RAG that enables precise length control while preserving critical information. Motivated by type-aware ablation studies, CodePromptZip leverages static analysis to rank code tokens by information gain and applies a dynamic compression strategy to retain the most informative tokens under a given budget. For incomplete or unparsable code snippets, CodePromptZip employs a language-model-based compressor trained on analyzable samples and augmented with a copy mechanism to preserve key tokens. Extensive experiments on three code-related tasks demonstrate that CodePromptZip consistently outperforms entropy-based and distillation-based baselines, achieving improvements of 23.4%, 28.7%, and 8.7%, respectively, while providing accurate control over compression ratios.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将检索到的代码示例融入提示中，从而提升了代码生成的效率。然而，这种长上下文输入方式会带来巨大的内存和计算负担。现有的提示压缩技术主要针对自然语言文本设计，无法充分考虑代码的结构和语义特性，同时也无法对压缩比例进行精细控制。我们提出了CodePromptZip这一基于代码感知的RAG提示压缩框架，它能够精确控制输入长度，同时保留关键信息。基于类型感知的消融研究，CodePromptZip利用静态分析来根据信息增益对代码令牌进行排序，并采用动态压缩策略在给定预算下保留最具信息量的令牌。对于不完整或不可解析的代码片段，CodePromptZip使用基于语言模型的压缩器进行处理，并通过复制机制来保留关键令牌。在三项与代码相关的任务上的广泛实验表明，CodePromptZip在性能上始终优于基于熵分析和蒸馏方法的基线方法，分别实现了23.4%、28.7%和8.7%的提升，同时还能精确控制压缩比例。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Detecting Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Semantic-level Internal Reasoning Graph
papers.title_zh: 通过语义级内部推理图来检测检索增强生成中的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Jianpeng Hu, Yanzeng Li, Jialun Zhong, Lei Zou, Wenfa Qi
papers.abstract: The Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system based on Large language model (LLM) has made significant progress. It can effectively reduce factuality hallucinations, but faithfulness hallucinations still exist. Previous methods for detecting faithfulness hallucinations either neglect to capture the models’ internal reasoning processes or handle those features coarsely, making it difficult for discriminators to learn. This paper proposes a semantic-level internal reasoning graph-based method for detecting faithfulness hallucination. Specifically, we first extend the layer-wise relevance propagation algorithm from the token level to the semantic level, constructing an internal reasoning graph based on attribution vectors. This provides a more faithful semantic-level representation of dependency. Furthermore, we design a general framework based on a small pre-trained language model to utilize the dependencies in LLM’s reasoning for training and hallucination detection, which can dynamically adjust the pass rate of correct samples through a threshold. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves better overall performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines on RAGTruth and Dolly-15k. Implementation available here: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SIRG-1022.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的检索增强生成（RAG）系统已经取得了显著进展。它能够有效减少事实性幻觉，但忠实性幻觉仍然存在。以往用于检测忠实性幻觉的方法要么未能捕捉到模型的内部推理过程，要么对相关特征处理过于粗糙，这使得判别器难以进行准确学习。本文提出了一种基于语义级内部推理图的方法来检测忠实性幻觉。具体来说，我们首先将层状相关性传播算法从词元级别扩展到语义级别，基于归因向量构建内部推理图。这提供了一种更精确的语义级依赖关系表示。此外，我们设计了一个基于小型预训练语言模型的通用框架，利用LLM中的依赖关系来进行训练和幻觉检测，该框架能够动态调整正确样本的通过率。实验结果表明，与现有的最先进基线方法相比，我们的方法在RAGTruth和Dolly-15k数据集上取得了更好的性能。实现代码可在此处获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SIRG-1022
