papers.title: LLM-induced Rationales for More Compact Explainable Style Classification Models
papers.title_zh: LLM所提出的、用于构建更紧凑且易于解释的风格分类模型的理由
papers.authors: Ahmad Aljanaideh, Saeb Ganideh
papers.abstract: The complexity of recent natural language classification models led to interest in developing methods for improving the performance of explainable models (e.g. Logistic Regression). Existing methods focus on clustering word embeddings to discover fine-grained contextual features that can be used to train a linear model. While those methods help reduce the gap in performance between black-box models and explainable models, they are based on discovering a large number of features, and this affects interpretability. In this work, we propose a model that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) and clustering algorithms to discover a compact set of interpretable features. The proposed model first uses GPT-4o mini to extract rationales (i.e. phrases which explain an item’s label) from labeled text, and then clusters those rationales to obtain a compact, interpretable feature space. Across 3 Style Classification tasks, the resulting features achieve comparable performance to word-cluster baselines on most tasks, while reducing the number of features by 85–99%. These results highlight the potential of LLMs to improve the compactness of explainable AI models.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，自然语言分类模型的复杂性引发了人们对改进可解释模型性能方法的兴趣（例如逻辑回归）。现有的方法侧重于对词嵌入进行聚类，以发现可用于训练线性模型的细粒度上下文特征。虽然这些方法有助于缩小黑盒模型与可解释模型之间的性能差距，但它们需要发现大量的特征，这会影响模型的可解释性。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种利用大语言模型和聚类算法来发现一组简洁且可解释特征的模型。该模型首先使用GPT-4o mini从标注文本中提取解释性短语，然后对这些短语进行聚类，从而得到一个简洁且可解释的特征空间。在三个风格分类任务中，所得到的特征在大多数任务上的表现与基于词簇的基线方法相当，同时减少了85%到99%的特征数量。这些结果凸显了大语言模型在提高可解释人工智能模型紧凑性方面的潜力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MDTeamGPT: Mitigating Context Collapse and Enabling Self-Evolution in Medical Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MDTeamGPT：在医学多智能体推理中缓解上下文崩溃问题并促进自我进化
papers.authors: Kai Chen, Xinfeng Li, Tianpei Yang, Hewei Wang, Guang Yang, Jing Huo, Yang Gao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential in multi-disciplinary team (MDT) medical consultations. However, long, multi-round, multi-role interaction trajectories inevitably lead to severe information dilution and context window overload, triggering context collapse which destabilizes reasoning. Furthermore, prior systems typically rely on unstructured trajectory history storage without structurally distilling key information or reflecting on errors, severely limiting continuous learning capabilities. We propose MDTeamGPT, a context-resilient and self-evolving multi-agent framework. Mechanistically, we introduce a specialized Lead Physician mechanism combined with a Residual Context architecture to compress and reorganize multi-round consensus, effectively mitigating context overload and reducing computational costs. For memory, we design a Dual Knowledge Base system comprising a CorrectKB for verified trajectories and a ChainKB for reflective error analysis, enabling self-evolution via retrieval from both successes and failures. We evaluated our framework on standard text datasets (MedQA, PubMedQA), multimodal benchmarks (VQA-RAD, SLAKE), and collected more complex clinical problems. Experimental results show that MDTeamGPT substantially outperforms existing baselines across both text-based and multimodal tasks, while also demonstrating superior diagnostic performance and stability in complex clinical scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多学科团队医疗咨询中展现出巨大潜力。然而，漫长、多轮次、多角色的互动过程不可避免地会导致信息稀释和上下文负担过重，从而引发上下文崩溃，破坏推理逻辑。此外，现有的系统通常依赖非结构化的历史数据存储方式，无法有效提取关键信息或反思错误，这严重限制了持续学习的能力。我们提出了MDTeamGPT这一具有上下文恢复能力和自我进化的多智能体框架。从机制上来说，我们引入了一种专门的主任医师机制，并结合了残差上下文架构来压缩和重组多轮次的共识信息，从而有效缓解上下文过载问题并降低计算成本。在内存方面，我们设计了双知识库系统：一个用于验证过的轨迹的正确知识库，另一个用于反思性错误分析的链条知识库。通过从成功经验和失败经验中汲取教训，实现自我进化。我们在标准文本数据集（如MedQA、PubMedQA）、多模态基准测试（如VQA-RAD、SLAKE）以及更复杂的临床问题中对我们的框架进行了评估。实验结果表明，MDTeamGPT在文本基础和多模态任务中均优于现有基线模型，同时在复杂的临床场景中也表现出卓越的诊断性能和稳定性。

papers.title: TSPO: Breaking the Double Homogenization Dilemma in Multi-turn Search Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: TSPO：解决多轮搜索策略优化中的双均匀化困境
papers.authors: Shichao Ma, Zhiyuan Ma, Ming Yang, Xiaofan Li, Xing Wu, Jintao Du, Yu Cheng, Weiqiang Wang, Qiliang Liu, Zhengyang Zhou, Yang Wang
papers.abstract: Multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks through iterative information retrieval. However, current reinforcement learning (RL) frameworks for search-augmented reasoning predominantly rely on sparse outcome-level rewards, leading to a “Double Homogenization Dilemma.” This manifests as (1) Process homogenization, where the thinking, reasoning, and tooling involved in generation are ignored. (2) Intra-group homogenization, coarse-grained outcome rewards often lead to inefficiencies in intra-group advantage estimation with methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) during sampling. To address this, we propose Turn-level Stage-aware Policy Optimization (TSPO). TSPO introduces the First-Occurrence Latent Reward (FOLR) mechanism, allocating partial rewards to the step where the ground-truth answer first appears, thereby preserving process-level signals and increasing reward variance within groups without requiring external reward models or any annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TSPO significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving average performance gains of 24% and 13.6% on Qwen2.5-3B and 7B models, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/Flipped-May/TSPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 多轮工具集成推理使得大语言模型能够通过迭代信息检索来解决复杂任务。然而，目前用于搜索增强推理的强化学习框架主要依赖稀疏的结果级奖励，这导致了“双重同质化困境”。这种困境表现为：(1) 过程同质化，即忽略了生成过程中所需的思考、推理和工具使用；(2) 组内同质化，粗粒度的结果奖励常常导致在采样过程中使用如组相对策略优化等方法进行组内优势估计时效率低下。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了基于轮次阶段的策略优化方法。TSPO引入了首次出现潜在奖励机制，该机制会在真实答案首次出现的步骤中分配部分奖励，从而保留过程级信号，并在无需外部奖励模型或任何注释的情况下增加组内奖励的多样性。大量实验表明，TSPO显著优于现有的最佳基线算法，在Qwen2.5-3B和7B模型中分别实现了24%和13.6%的平均性能提升。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/Flipped-May/TSPO。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Towards semantic reliable clinical QA: Query pipeline optimization for cancer patient question answering systems
papers.title_zh: 迈向语义化且可靠的临床问答系统：针对癌症患者问题回答系统的查询流程优化
papers.authors: MaoLin He, Rena Wei Gao, Mike Conway, Brian E. Chapman
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in medical Question-Answering (QA) but suffer from hallucinations that jeopardize patient safety. While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates this by grounding outputs in external evidence, existing pipelines struggle with the complex, rapidly evolving nature of oncology. We present CoMeta, a three-level controllable metadata-aware framework optimized for Cancer Patient QA (CPQA). We introduce Clinical Hybrid Semantic-Symbolic Document Retrieval (CHSDR), which synergizes real-time Boolean search via NCBI E-Utilities with semantic retrieval to overcome metadata blindness. Additionally, we propose Semantic Enhanced Overlap Segmentation (SEOS) to prevent contextual fragmentation. Our results demonstrate that CHSDR significantly improves retrieval performance, CoMeta improved the answer accuracy of Claude-3-haiku by 5.24% over chain-of-thought prompting and about 3% over a naive RAG setup. This study highlights the importance of domain-specific query optimization in realizing the full potential of RAG and provides a robust framework for building more reliable CPQA systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在医学问答领域展现出巨大潜力，但存在导致患者安全的幻觉问题。虽然检索增强生成技术可以通过将输出结果基于外部证据来缓解这个问题，但现有的系统在处理快速发展的肿瘤学领域时仍面临挑战。我们提出了CoMeta框架，这是一个三级可控的元数据感知框架，专为癌症患者问答而优化。我们引入了临床混合语义-符号文档检索技术，该技术结合了通过NCBI E-Utilities实现的实时布尔搜索与语义检索，从而克服元数据识别的困难。此外，我们还提出了语义增强重叠分割技术，以防止上下文信息的碎片化。我们的实验表明，CHSDR显著提升了检索性能；CoMeta则使Claude-3-haiku模型的回答准确率相比基于思维链提示的方式提高了5.24%，相比简单的RAG系统也提高了约3%。这项研究强调了针对特定领域进行查询优化的重要性，有助于充分发挥RAG技术的潜力，并为构建更可靠的癌症患者问答系统提供了强大的框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LayerNorm Induces Recency Bias in Transformer Decoders
papers.title_zh: LayerNorm会在Transformer解码器中导致最新信息的偏差问题
papers.authors: Junu Kim, Xiao Liu, Zhenghao Lin, Lei Ji, Yeyun Gong, Edward Choi
papers.abstract: Causal self-attention provides positional information to Transformer decoders. Prior work has shown that stacks of causal self-attention layers alone induce a positional bias in attention scores toward earlier tokens. However, this differs from the bias toward later tokens typically observed in Transformer decoders, known as recency bias. We address this discrepancy by analyzing the interaction between causal self-attention and other architectural components. We show that stacked causal self-attention layers combined with LayerNorm induce recency bias. Furthermore, we examine the effects of residual connections and the distribution of input token embeddings on this bias. Our results provide new theoretical insights into how positional information interacts with architectural components and suggest directions for improving positional encoding strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 因果自注意力为Transformer解码器提供了位置信息。先前的研究表明，仅堆叠因果自注意力层就会在注意力得分中产生向早期令牌的偏置。然而，这与Transformer解码器中常见的向后期令牌的偏置——即近期性偏置——有所不同。我们通过分析因果自注意力与其他架构组件之间的相互作用来解决这一差异。我们发现，堆叠的因果自注意力层与LayerNorm结合使用会产生近期性偏置。此外，我们还研究了残差连接以及输入令牌嵌入的分布对这种偏置的影响。我们的研究结果为位置信息与架构组件之间的相互作用提供了新的理论见解，并提出了改进位置编码策略的方向。

papers.title: Scaling Performance and Low-Resource Annotation with Many-Shot In-Context Learning for Named Entity Recognition
papers.title_zh: 通过多样本上下文学习技术，在低资源条件下提升性能以及地名识别任务的标注效率
papers.authors: Qi Zhang, Fangping Lan, Cornelia Caragea, Longin Jan Latecki, Eduard Dragut
papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) with large language models (LLMs) has emerged as a powerful alternative to fine-tuning for Named Entity Recognition (NER), achieving strong performance with minimal annotation and no additional training. However, prior work has shown that despite their adaptability, LLMs still lag behind fully supervised models such as fine-tuned BERT in structured tasks like NER. While existing studies on ICL for NER have mainly explored few-shot settings, the potential of scaling to hundreds of demonstrations has not been thoroughly investigated. To address this gap, we conduct a comprehensive investigation of many-shot ICL for NER and further explore its effectiveness in annotating and refining data for low-resource NER tasks. Specifically, we evaluate various LLMs across multiple domains using hundreds of ICL examples and then assess the feasibility of using many-shot ICL as a data annotation framework. Our experiments demonstrate that: (1) scaling to hundreds of in-context examples enables LLMs to match or even surpass the performance of fully supervised BERT models; and (2) using about one hundred human-labeled examples as demonstrations, many-shot in-context annotation can generate high-quality labeled data, leading to approximately 10% absolute F1 improvement over existing state-of-the-art approaches when used to fine-tune BERT on low-resource NER.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的环境上下文学习已成为命名实体识别任务中一种强大的替代方案，它无需进行大量注释或额外训练即可实现出色的性能。然而，先前的研究表明，尽管大语言模型具有很好的适应性，但在诸如命名实体识别这样的结构化任务上，它们仍然无法与经过充分监督训练的模型如微调版的BERT相媲美。目前关于环境上下文学习在命名实体识别中的应用研究主要集中在少量样本的情况下，而将其扩展到数百个样本的情况则尚未得到充分探讨。为了填补这一空白，我们对多样本环境上下文学习在命名实体识别中的应用进行了全面研究，并进一步探讨了其在低资源命名实体识别任务中的标注和数据精炼效果。具体来说，我们测试了多种语言模型在不同领域的表现，并使用数百个环境上下文学习示例来评估它们的性能。实验结果表明：(1)通过扩展至数百个环境上下文示例，大语言模型能够达到甚至超越完全监督训练的BERT模型的性能；(2)使用大约一百个人工标注的样本作为示范，多样本环境上下文学习可以生成高质量的数据，从而在低资源命名实体识别任务中，相对于现有的最先进方法，能够提升约10%的F1值。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PhageBench: Can LLMs Understand Raw Bacteriophage Genomes?
papers.title_zh: PhageBench：大型语言模型能理解原始的噬菌体基因组吗？
papers.authors: Yusen Hou, Weicai Long, Haitao HU, Houcheng su, Junning Feng, Yanlin Zhang
papers.abstract: Bacteriophages, often referred to as the dark matter of the biosphere, play a critical role in regulating microbial ecosystems and in antibiotic alternatives. Thus, accurate interpretation of their genomes holds significant scientific and practical value. While general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at understanding biological texts, their ability to directly interpret raw nucleotide sequences and perform biological reasoning remains underexplored. To address this, we introduce PhageBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate phage genome understanding by mirroring the workflow of bioinformatics experts. The dataset contains 5,600 high-quality samples covering five core tasks across three stages: Screening, Quality Control, and Phenotype Annotation. Our evaluation of eight LLMs reveals that general-purpose reasoning models significantly outperform random baselines in phage contig identification and host prediction, demonstrating promising potential for genomic understanding. However, they exhibit significant limitations in complex reasoning tasks involving long-range dependencies and fine-grained functional localization. These findings highlight the necessity of developing next-generation models with enhanced reasoning capabilities for biological sequences.
papers.abstract_zh: 噬菌体，常被称作生物圈的“暗物质”，在调节微生物生态系统以及寻找抗生素替代品方面发挥着至关重要的作用。因此，准确解读噬菌体的基因组具有重大的科学和实用价值。虽然通用大语言模型在理解生物文本方面表现出色，但它们直接解读原始核苷酸序列并进行生物推理的能力仍未被充分探索。为了应对这一问题，我们推出了PhageBench这一首个用于评估噬菌体基因组理解的基准测试工具，该工具仿照生物信息学专家的工作流程设计而成。该数据集包含5,600个高质量样本，涵盖了筛选、质量控制和表型注释三个阶段的五项核心任务。我们对八种通用语言模型的评估结果显示，这些推理模型在噬菌体片段识别及宿主预测方面明显优于随机基线模型，显示出在基因组理解方面的巨大潜力。然而，它们在涉及长距离依赖关系和精细功能定位的复杂推理任务中仍存在显著局限性。这些发现凸显了开发具有更强推理能力的下一代生物序列处理模型的必要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: POLAR: A Benchmark for Multilingual, Multicultural, and Multi-Event Online Polarization
papers.title_zh: 极地现象：多语言、多元文化以及涉及多种事件的在线两极分化现象的典范
papers.authors: Usman Naseem, Robert Geislinger, Juan Ren, Sarah Kohail, Rudy Alexandro Garrido Veliz, P Sam Sahil, Yiran Zhang, Idris Abdulmumin, Marco Antonio Stranisci, Özge Alacam, Cengiz Acarturk, Aisha Jabr, Saba Anwar, Abinew Ali Ayele, Simona Frenda, Alessandra Teresa Cignarella, Elena Tutubalina, Oleg Rogov, Aung Kyaw Htet, Xintong Wang, Surendrabikram Thapa, Kritesh Rauniyar, Tanmoy Chakraborty, MD Arfeen Zeeshan, Dheeraj Kodati, Satya Keerthi, Sahar Moradizeyveh, Firoj Alam, Md Arid Hasan, Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed, Ye Kyaw Thu, Shantipriya Parida, Ihsan Ayyub Qazi, Lilian Diana Awuor Wanzare, Nelson Odhiambo Onyango, Clemencia Siro, Jane Wanjiru Kimani, Ibrahim Said Ahmad, Adem Chanie Ali, Martin Semmann, Chris Biemann, Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad, Seid Muhie Yimam
papers.abstract: Online polarization poses a growing challenge for democratic discourse, yet most computational social science research remains monolingual, culturally narrow, or event-specific. We introduce POLAR, a multilingual, multicultural, and multi-event dataset with over 110K instances in 22 languages drawn from diverse online platforms and real-world events. Polarization is annotated along three axes, namely detection, type, and manifestation, using a variety of annotation platforms adapted to each cultural context. We conduct two main experiments: (1) fine-tuning six pretrained small language models; and (2) evaluating a range of open and closed large language models in few-shot and zero-shot settings. Results show that while most models perform well on binary polarization detection, they achieve substantially lower performance when predicting polarization types and manifestations. These findings highlight the complex, highly contextual nature of polarization and underscore the need for robust, adaptable approaches in NLP and computational social science. All resources will be released to support further research and effective mitigation of digital polarization globally.
papers.abstract_zh: 在线两极分化现象给民主话语带来了日益严重的挑战。然而，目前大多数计算社会科学研究仍然局限于单语言、文化狭隘或仅针对特定事件的范畴。我们推出了POLAR数据集，该数据集包含来自22种语言的11万多个实例，涵盖了多种在线平台和现实世界事件。两极分化特征被标注了三个维度：检测、类型和表现形式，这些标注采用了多种适应不同文化背景的标注平台。我们进行了两项主要实验：(1)对六种预训练的小型语言模型进行微调；(2)在少样本学习和零样本学习场景下评估一系列开放式和封闭式大语言模型的表现。结果表明，虽然大多数模型在二元两极分化检测方面表现良好，但在预测两极分化的类型和表现形式时，它们的性能明显下降。这些发现揭示了两极分化的复杂性和高度情境性特点，同时也强调了在自然语言处理和计算社会科学领域需要采用稳健且可适应的方法。所有资源都将免费提供，以支持全球范围内对数字两极分化的进一步研究和有效应对。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: VANE: Guiding High-Value Exploration in RLVR via Outcome-Process Novelty Shaping
papers.title_zh: VANE：通过成果与过程的创新性引导在RLVR领域的高价值探索
papers.authors: Xu He, Jialiang Guo, Fucheng Xiong, Haodong Zhao, Xingyang li, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) frequently suffers from mode collapse due to the inherent sparsity of feedback signals. While strategies such as entropy regularization introduce randomness, they lack directionality. Simply incorporating diversity rewards is overly one-sided and fails to identify potential logical errors or hallucinations. To address these limitations, we propose VANE (Value-Aligned Novelty Exploration), a method that simultaneously quantifies novelty across the outcome space (via reward or solution divergence) and the semantic process space (via semantic process divergence). Moreover, VANE employs a value-alignment mechanism that symmetrically amplifies scarce, high-quality solutions while explicitly penalizing diverse yet erroneous reasoning paths. Extensive experiments on models such as Qwen2.5-Math-7B across eight benchmarks—encompassing both large-scale mathematical reasoning and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks—demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of the proposed method.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）常常因反馈信号的固有稀疏性而面临模式崩溃的问题。虽然像熵正则化这样的策略能够引入随机性，但它们缺乏方向性。单纯采用多样性奖励的方法过于片面，无法识别潜在的逻辑错误或幻觉现象。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了VANE（价值对齐新颖性探索）方法。该方法同时量化了结果空间中的新颖性（通过奖励或解决方案的发散度）以及语义过程空间中的新颖性（通过语义过程发散度）。此外，VANE还采用了一种价值对齐机制，能够对称地放大那些稀缺且高质量的解决方案，同时明确惩罚那些多样化但错误的推理路径。在Qwen2.5-Math-7B等模型上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法具有出色的有效性和泛化能力，其效果涵盖了大规模数学推理以及非分布域任务等多个领域。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Exploring Coding Spot: Understanding Parametric Contributions to LLM Coding Performance
papers.title_zh: 探索编码领域：理解参数对大型语言模型性能的影响
papers.authors: Dongjun Kim, Minhyuk Kim, Yongchan Chun, Chanjun Park, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated notable proficiency in both code generation and comprehension across multiple programming languages. However, the mechanisms underlying this proficiency remain underexplored, particularly with respect to whether distinct programming languages are processed independently or within a shared parametric region. Drawing an analogy to the specialized regions of the brain responsible for distinct cognitive functions, we introduce the concept of Coding Spot, a specialized parametric region within LLMs that facilitates coding capabilities. Our findings identify this Coding Spot and show that targeted modifications to this subset significantly affect performance on coding tasks, while largely preserving non-coding functionalities. This compartmentalization mirrors the functional specialization observed in cognitive neuroscience, where specific brain regions are dedicated to distinct tasks, suggesting that LLMs may similarly employ specialized parameter regions for different knowledge domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多种编程语言的代码生成和理解方面展现出了显著的能力。然而，这种能力的背后机制仍未被充分研究，尤其是关于不同编程语言是否是在独立的参数区域内进行处理，还是在同一共享的参数区域内进行处理的问题。类比于大脑中负责不同认知功能的专门区域，我们提出了“编码点”的概念——这是语言模型中一个专门用于促进编码能力的参数区域。我们的研究发现，对这一编码点进行有针对性的修改能够显著提升编码任务的性能，同时还能保留非编码功能。这种功能分区的方式与认知神经科学中观察到的功能专业化现象相呼应，即特定的大脑区域被专门用于执行不同的任务。这表明，语言模型也可能通过专门的参数区域来处理不同的知识领域。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FedGUI: Benchmarking Federated GUI Agents across Heterogeneous Platforms, Devices, and Operating Systems
papers.title_zh: FedGUI：在不同的平台、设备和操作系统上对比Federated GUI代理的性能表现
papers.authors: WenHao Wang, Haoting Shi, Mengying Yuan, Yiquan Lin, Panrong Tong, Hanzhang Zhou, Guangyi Liu, Pengxiang Zhao, Yue Wang, Siheng Chen
papers.abstract: Training GUI agents with traditional centralized methods faces significant cost and scalability challenges. Federated learning (FL) offers a promising solution, yet its potential is hindered by the lack of benchmarks that capture real-world, cross-platform heterogeneity. To bridge this gap, we introduce FedGUI, the first comprehensive benchmark for developing and evaluating federated GUI agents across mobile, web, and desktop platforms. FedGUI provides a suite of six curated datasets to systematically study four crucial types of heterogeneity: cross-platform, cross-device, cross-OS, and cross-source. Extensive experiments reveal several key insights: First, we show that cross-platform collaboration improves performance, extending prior mobile-only federated learning to diverse GUI environments; Second, we demonstrate the presence of distinct heterogeneity dimensions and identify platform and OS as the most influential factors. FedGUI provides a vital foundation for the community to build more scalable and privacy-preserving GUI agents for real-world deployment. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/wwh0411/FedGUI..
papers.abstract_zh: 使用传统的集中式方法训练GUI代理面临着巨大的成本和可扩展性挑战。联邦学习为解决这个问题提供了有希望的解决方案，但其潜力受到了缺乏能够捕捉现实世界中跨平台异质性的基准测试的限制。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了FedGUI——首个用于开发和评估跨移动、网络和桌面平台的联邦GUI代理的综合性基准测试工具。FedGUI提供了一组包含六个数据集的工具集，以便系统地研究四种关键的异质性类型：跨平台、跨设备、跨操作系统以及跨源。大量的实验揭示了几个重要发现：首先，我们证明了跨平台协作可以提高性能，从而将之前仅适用于移动设备的联邦学习扩展到多样化的GUI环境中；其次，我们发现存在多种不同的异质性维度，并且平台和操作系统是最具有影响力的因素。FedGUI为社区构建更可扩展且注重隐私保护的GUI代理提供了重要的基础，这些代理可以应用于现实世界中的部署场景。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/wwh0411/FedGUI上免费获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Towards Proactive Information Probing: Customer Service Chatbots Harvesting Value from Conversation
papers.title_zh: 迈向主动式信息挖掘：客服聊天机器人如何从对话中获取价值
papers.authors: Chen Huang, Zitan Jiang, Zou Changyi, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng
papers.abstract: Customer service chatbots are increasingly expected to serve not merely as reactive support tools for users, but as strategic interfaces for harvesting high-value information and business intelligence. In response, we make three main contributions. 1) We introduce and define a novel task of Proactive Information Probing, which optimizes when to probe users for pre-specified target information while minimizing conversation turns and user friction. 2) We propose PROCHATIP, a proactive chatbot framework featuring a specialized conversation strategy module trained to master the delicate timing of probes. 3) Experiments demonstrate that PROCHATIP significantly outperforms baselines, exhibiting superior capability in both information probing and service quality. We believe that our work effectively redefines the commercial utility of chatbots, positioning them as scalable, cost-effective engines for proactive business intelligence. Our code is available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/PROCHATIP.
papers.abstract_zh: 预计，客户服务聊天机器人将不再仅仅作为用户的被动支持工具来发挥作用，而是成为收集高价值信息和商业情报的战略性平台。为此，我们提出了三项主要贡献：1）我们引入并定义了“主动信息探测”这一新任务，该任务能够优化在何时向用户查询预先指定的目标信息，同时最大限度地减少对话轮数和用户使用过程中的摩擦。2）我们提出了PROCHATIP框架，这是一个具有专门对话策略模块的主动聊天机器人系统，该模块经过训练，能够掌握信息探测的精确时机。3）实验表明，PROCHATIP在信息探测和服务质量方面均表现出显著的优势，其性能优于现有基线方法。我们认为，我们的工作有效地重新定义了聊天机器人的商业价值，使其成为一种可扩展且成本效益高的主动商业智能解决方案。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/SCUNLP/PROCHATIP下载。

papers.title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Chinese Ancient Documents: From OCR to Knowledge Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 在中文古代文献上对视觉语言模型进行性能比较：从文字识别到知识推理
papers.authors: Haiyang Yu, Yuchuan Wu, Fan Shi, Jinghui Lu, Ke Niu, Xiaodong Ge, Minghan Zhuo, Jingqun Tang, Bin Li
papers.abstract: Chinese ancient documents, invaluable carriers of millennia of Chinese history and culture, hold rich knowledge across diverse fields but face challenges in digitization and understanding—traditional methods only scan images, while current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with their visual/linguistic complexity. Existing document benchmarks focus on English printed texts or simplified Chinese, leaving a gap for evaluating VLMs on ancient Chinese documents. To address this, we present AncientDoc, the first benchmark for Chinese ancient documents, designed to assess VLMs from OCR to knowledge reasoning. AncientDoc includes five tasks (page-level OCR, vernacular translation, reasoning-based QA, knowledge-based QA, linguistic variant QA) and covers 14 document types, over 100 books, and about 3,000 pages. Based on AncientDoc, we evaluate mainstream VLMs using multiple metrics, supplemented by a human-aligned large language model for scoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 中国古代文献作为承载数千年中国历史与文化的宝贵载体，在多个领域蕴含着丰富的知识。然而，它们在数字化处理和理解方面面临着挑战——传统方法只能扫描图像，而当前的视觉语言模型则难以应对其视觉和语言的复杂性。现有的文档基准测试主要集中在英文印刷文本或简体中文上，这导致无法对视觉语言模型在古代中文文档上的表现进行评估。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了AncientDoc这一首个针对中国古代文献的基准测试，旨在评估从OCR到知识推理各个阶段的视觉语言模型性能。AncientDoc包含五项任务：页面级别的OCR处理、方言翻译、基于推理的问答、基于知识的问答以及语言变体问答。该测试涵盖了14种不同类型的文档，涉及超过100本书籍，总计约3000页内容。基于AncientDoc，我们使用多种指标来评估主流视觉语言模型的表现，并辅以一个与人类水平相当的大语言模型来进行评分。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DaMo: Data Mixing Optimizer in Fine-tuning Multimodal LLMs for Mobile Phone Agents
papers.title_zh: DaMo：数据混合优化器在微调适用于手机智能体的多模态大语言模型中的应用
papers.authors: Kai Shi, Jun Yang, Ni Yang, Binqiang Pan, Qingsong Xie, Zhangchao, Zhenyu Yang, Tianhuang Su, Haonan Lu
papers.abstract: Mobile Phone Agents (MPAs) have emerged as a promising research direction due to their broad applicability across diverse scenarios. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) serve as the foundation for MPAs, their effectiveness in handling multiple mobile phone tasks simultaneously remains limited. Although multitask supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely adopted for multitask learning, existing approaches struggle to determine optimal training data compositions for peak performance. To address this challenge, we propose DaMo (Data Mixture Optimizer) – a novel solution employing a trainable network that predicts optimal data mixtures by forecasting downstream task performance for any given dataset ratio. To support comprehensive evaluation, we introduce PhoneAgentBench, the first specialized benchmark to evaluate MLLMs on multimodal mobile phone tasks, comprising 1,235 QA pairs spanning diverse real-world industrial mobile application scenarios. Demonstrating strong predictive capability (R²=0.81) in small-scale pilot experiments, DaMo efficiently extrapolates optimal data mixing configurations. Our results show DaMo achieves 3.06% average score improvement on PhoneAgentBench and open-source benchmarks, including BFCL-v3, MME-Reasoning, MME-Perception, and OCRBench, compared to alternative methods. Through predicting optimal data mixture only on open-source benchmarks, DaMo outperforms other approaches by 6.70% in terms of average score. Moreover, DaMo improves the metrics by 12.74% than other methods when used solely for MLLM optimization on the BFCL-v3 task. Notably, DaMo maintains robust scalability, preserving its effectiveness when applied to other model architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于其在各种场景中的广泛应用性，手机代理技术已成为一个具有前景的研究方向。虽然多模态大语言模型为手机代理技术提供了基础支持，但它们在同时处理多个手机相关任务方面的效果仍然有限。尽管多任务监督微调被广泛应用于多任务学习领域，但现有方法在确定最佳训练数据组合以实现最佳性能方面存在困难。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了DaMo——一种新颖的解决方案。该方案利用可训练的网络来预测最优的数据混合比例，从而根据给定数据集的比例来预测下游任务的性能。为了进行全面的评估，我们引入了PhoneAgentBench这个专门的基准测试平台，该平台首次用于评估多模态手机任务中的多模态大语言模型。PhoneAgentBench包含了1,235对问答对例，涵盖了多种现实世界中的工业手机应用场景。在小规模试点实验中，DaMo表现出强大的预测能力（R²=0.81），能够高效地推断出最优的数据混合配置。我们的结果显示，与其他方法相比，DaMo在PhoneAgentBench以及开源基准测试平台上取得了3.06%的平均分数提升。仅通过预测开源基准测试平台上的最优数据混合比例，DaMo在平均分数上比其他方法高出6.70%。此外，当仅用于BFCL-v3任务的MLLM优化时，DaMo的评估指标比其他方法提高了12.74%。值得注意的是，DaMo具备强大的可扩展性，即使应用于其他模型架构时，其有效性依然能够得到保持。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Outcome to Process: Optimizing MoE Load Balancing with MCTS
papers.title_zh: 从结果到过程：利用MCTS优化MoE负载均衡
papers.authors: Wenjun Ke, Hengyuan Xu, Ziyu Shang, Yao He, Jiahao Wang, Zijie Xu, Peng Wang, Yuhang Lou, Jiajun Liu
papers.abstract: Mixture of Experts (MoE) dynamically routes inputs to specialized expert networks, enabling large language models to scale capacity with low inference overhead. To further improve MoE’s parameter efficiency in resource-constrained scenarios, LoRA–MoE integrates LoRA for lightweight adaptation while preserving MoE’s specialization. Despite these benefits, the effectiveness of LoRA–MoE still hinges on balanced expert utilization, where certain experts dominate activations while most remain underutilized. Existing balancing strategies focus on constraining the final distribution of expert usage, but overlook the routing decisions made at each layer. As a result, imbalances gradually accumulate across the routing hierarchy. To address this challenge, we propose LayerMoE, a novel three-stage framework that leverages process-level rewards to guide balanced expert routing. Specifically, to overcome the limitation of focusing only on final losses and ignoring intermediate routing, we introduce Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based sampling that decomposes outcome-level supervision into layer-wise reward signals, guiding expert choices throughout the routing process. For efficiency, we organize Transformer layers into groups, which constrain the search space of MCTS and keep exploration overhead tractable while retaining the hierarchical structure. Extensive experiments on representative datasets (e.g., ARC, RACE, OBQA) show that applying LayerMoE consistently improves the performance of state-of-the-art LoRA-MoE baselines, yielding an average accuracy gain of 1.39%. Notably, the maximum improvement reaches 2.50%.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合模型（Mixture of Experts，MoE）能够动态地将输入数据路由至专业专家网络，从而使大语言模型在较低的推理开销下提升处理能力。为了进一步提升MoE在资源受限场景中的参数利用效率，LoRA–MoE结合了LoRA的轻量级适应功能，同时保留了MoE的专业特性。不过，LoRA–MoE的有效性仍然取决于专家的均衡分配——某些专家可能被过度使用，而大多数则被闲置利用。现有的平衡策略主要集中在限制专家使用的分布上，却忽略了每一层中的路由决策。因此，不平衡现象会在整个路由层次结构中逐渐累积。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了LayerMoE这一新颖的三阶段框架，该框架利用过程级奖励来引导专家的均衡路由。具体来说，为了克服仅关注最终损失而忽略中间路由的局限性，我们引入了基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的采样方法，将结果级监督分解为逐层奖励信号，从而在整个路由过程中指导专家的选择。为了提高效率，我们将Transformer层组织成组，这样既能限制MCTS的搜索空间，又能保持探索的合理性，同时保留层次结构。在代表性数据集上的广泛实验表明，应用LayerMoE能够持续提升最先进的LoRA-MoE基线的性能，平均准确率提升了1.39%。值得注意的是，最大提升幅度可达2.50%。

papers.title: Learning Optimal Message Representations for Agentic Communication
papers.title_zh: 学习适用于智能体通信的最优信息表示方式
papers.authors: Shashwat Gupta, Anson Bastos, Mayukh Das, Supriyo Ghosh, Nagarajan Natarajan, Chetan Bansal, Saravan Rajmohan
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in agentic collaborative problem-solving, albeit a gap exists. Existing frameworks predominantly rely on natural language as a primary representation (format) for agentic communication. However natural language could be ambiguous and verbose. Furthermore, recent works have shown that alternative representations can enhance performance in LLMs on certain tasks. But current approaches lack the intelligence necessary to understand, learn or apply optimal communication representations adaptively. In this paper, we propose to dynamically learn the optimal message representations to enhance agentic performance. We model the optimization problem as an Expanding Markov Decision Process (EMDP) and propose our method named OPTiMACS. We evaluate our system across benchmark datasets of collaborative problem-solving. The results show significant performance improvements while maintaining efficiency. Our work bridges the gap between rigid communication protocols and open-ended natural language by providing an adaptive framework that learns task-aware structural representations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代理协作问题解决方面展现出了显著的能力，不过仍然存在一些不足之处。现有的框架主要依赖自然语言作为代理通信的主要表达方式。然而，自然语言往往具有模糊性和冗长性。此外，最近的研究表明，使用其他表达方式可以在某些任务上提升大语言模型的性能。但当前的方法缺乏理解、学习或自适应地应用最优通信表达方式的智能能力。在本文中，我们提出了一种动态学习最优消息表达方式的方案，以提升代理的性能。我们将优化问题建模为扩展马尔可夫决策过程，并提出了我们的方法——OPTiMACS。我们在多个协作问题解决基准数据集上评估了该系统，结果显示，在保持效率的同时，系统性能得到了显著提升。我们的工作通过提供一种自适应框架来弥补刚性通信协议与开放式自然语言之间的差距，该框架能够学习到与任务相关的结构化表达方式。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CARO: Chain-of-Analogy Reasoning Optimization for Robust Content Moderation
papers.title_zh: CARO：基于类比推理的优化方法，用于稳健的内容审核
papers.authors: Bingzhe Wu, Haotian Lu, Yuchen Mou
papers.abstract: Current large language models (LLMs), even those explicitly trained for reasoning, often struggle with ambiguous content moderation cases due to misleading “decision shortcuts” embedded in context. Inspired by cognitive psychology insights into expert moderation, we introduce CᴀʀO (Chain-of-Analogy Reasoning Optimization), a novel two-stage training framework to induce robust analogical reasoning in LLMs. First, CᴀʀO bootstraps analogical reasoning chains via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on moderation data and performs supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Second, we propose a customized direct preference optimization (DPO) approach to reinforce analogical reasoning behaviors explicitly. Unlike static retrieval methods, CᴀʀO dynamically generates tailored analogical references during inference, effectively mitigating harmful decision shortcuts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CᴀʀO substantially outperforms state-of-the-art reasoning models (DeepSeek R1, QwQ), specialized moderation models (LLaMA Guard), and advanced fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented methods, achieving an average F1 score improvement of 24.9% on challenging ambiguous moderation benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的大语言模型（LLM），即便是那些专门为推理而训练的模型，也常常难以处理模糊的内容审核任务。这是因为上下文中存在一些误导性的“决策捷径”。受认知心理学中关于专家审核行为的启发，我们提出了CᴀʀO这一新颖的两阶段训练框架，旨在引导LLM产生稳健的类比推理能力。首先，CᴀʀO通过基于检索增强生成的方法，在审核数据上构建类比推理链，并进行有监督的微调。其次，我们提出了一种定制的直接偏好优化方法，以明确强化类比推理行为。与静态检索方法不同，CᴀʀO在推理过程中动态生成个性化的类比参考，有效避免了有害的决策捷径。大量实验表明，CᴀʀO在复杂的模糊审核任务上的表现显著优于现有的推理模型（如DeepSeek R1、QwQ）、专门的审核模型（如LLaMA Guard）以及先进的微调与检索增强方法，其平均F1分数提升了24.9%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: N-GRPO: Embedding-Level Neighbor Mixing for Enhanced Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: N-GRPO：基于嵌入层的邻居混合技术，用于优化策略执行
papers.authors: Xukun Zhu, Hang Yu, Peng Di, Linchao Zhu
papers.abstract: The success of Large Language Models in mathematical reasoning relies heavily on the generation of diverse and valid solution paths during the rollout phase. However, current rollout techniques face a fundamental trade-off: token-level sampling often yields redundant trajectories that differ only in rephrasing, while embedding-level methods utilizing random noise frequently disrupt semantic consistency. To resolve this, we introduce N-GRPO, a novel exploration strategy integrated into the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework. Rather than relying on token-level sampling or native embedding-level noise, our approach leverages Semantic Neighbor Mixing. This mechanism dynamically constructs input representations by mixing the embeddings of an anchor token and its nearest semantic neighbors, thereby injecting diversity while strictly adhering to the local semantic manifold. Experimental evaluations on the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models across different sizes show that not only achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines on math reasoning benchmarks but also exhibits robust generalization capabilities on out-of-distribution tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在数学推理方面的成功，在很大程度上依赖于在训练阶段生成多样且有效的解决方案路径。然而，当前的训练技术面临着一个根本性的权衡问题：基于令牌级别的采样往往只能产生仅在表述方式上有所变化的冗余路径，而基于嵌入级别的方法则容易因随机噪声的影响而破坏语义一致性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了N-GRPO这一新的探索策略，该策略被整合到了群体相对策略优化框架中。与依赖令牌级别采样或嵌入级别噪声的方法不同，我们的方法采用了语义邻居混合机制。这种机制通过混合锚点令牌及其最近的语义邻居的嵌入来动态构建输入表示，从而在严格遵循局部语义流形的同时，实现多样性的提升。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen模型上进行的不同规模实验表明，该方法不仅能够在数学推理基准测试中取得与强基线模型相当甚至更好的性能，还具备在超出训练数据范围的任务上的强大泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GFT: From Imitation to Reward Fine-Tuning with Unbiased Group Advantages and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification
papers.title_zh: GFT：从模仿到通过具有公正群体优势的动态系数调整来实现奖励的精细调节
papers.authors: Wangjie Gan, Miao Pan, Linbo Xi, Wenqi Zhang, Jintao Chen, Jianwei Yin, Xuhong Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models are typically post-trained using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), yet effectively unifying efficient knowledge injection with robust generalization remains challenging. In this work, we provide a training-dynamics analysis showing that SFT can be interpreted as a special case of policy gradient optimization with an extremely sparse implicit reward and unstable inverse-probability weighting, which together lead to single-path dependency, entropy collapse, and gradient explosion. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Group Fine-Tuning (GFT), a unified post-training framework that addresses these intrinsic limitations through two mechanisms: Group Advantage Learning, which constructs diverse response groups and derives normalized contrastive supervision to alleviate reward sparsity, and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification, which adaptively bounds inverse-probability weights to stabilize optimization while preserving efficient knowledge injection. Experiments demonstrate that GFT consistently surpasses SFT-based methods and yields policies that integrate more smoothly with subsequent RL training.Our code is publicly available athttps://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/GFT.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）进行后训练，但有效地将高效的知识注入与强大的泛化能力结合起来仍然具有挑战性。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种训练动态分析，指出SFT可以视为策略梯度优化的特例，其隐含奖励极为稀疏，逆概率权重也不稳定，这些因素共同导致了单一路径依赖、熵崩溃以及梯度爆炸现象。基于这一诊断结果，我们提出了群体微调技术，这是一种统一的后训练框架，通过两种机制来解决这些内在限制：群体优势学习，它构建多样化的响应群体并推导出标准化的对比监督，以缓解奖励的稀疏性问题；动态系数校正，它自适应地调整逆概率权重，从而稳定优化过程，同时保留高效的知识注入功能。实验表明，群体微调技术始终优于基于SFT的方法，并且所生成的策略能够更顺畅地与后续的强化学习训练相结合。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/GFT上免费获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SciImpact: A Multi-Dimensional, Multi-Field Benchmark for Scientific Impact Prediction
papers.title_zh: SciImpact：一个多维、多领域的科学影响预测基准模型
papers.authors: Hangxiao Zhu, Yuyu Zhang, Ping Nie, Yu Zhang
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of scientific literature calls for automated methods to assess and predict research impact.Prior work has largely focused on citation-based metrics, leaving limited evaluation of models’ capability to reason about other impact dimensions.To this end, we introduce SciImpact, a large-scale, multi-dimensional benchmark for scientific impact prediction spanning 19 fields.SciImpact captures various forms of scientific influence, ranging from citation counts to award recognition, media attention, patent reference, and artifact adoption, by integrating heterogeneous data sources and targeted web crawling.It comprises 215,928 contrastive paper pairs reflecting meaningful impact differences in both short- (e.g., Best Paper Award) and long-term settings (e.g., Nobel Prize).We evaluate 11 widely used large language models (LLMs) on SciImpact.Results show that off-the-shelf models show substantial variability across dimensions and fields, while multi-task supervised fine-tuning consistently enables smaller LLMs (e.g., 4B) to markedly outperform much larger models (e.g., 30B) and surpass powerful closed-source LLMs (e.g., o4-mini).These results establish SciImpact as a challenging benchmark and demonstrate its value for multi-dimensional, multi-field scientific impact prediction.Our project homepage is https://flypig23.github.io/sciimpact-homepage/.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学文献的快速增长需要自动化方法来评估和预测研究的影响力。以往的研究主要集中在基于引文的指标上，而对模型在评估其他影响维度方面的能力却缺乏足够的关注。为此，我们提出了SciImpact这一大规模、多维度的科学影响力预测基准测试，涵盖了19个领域。SciImpact能够捕捉各种形式的影响，包括引用次数、奖项认可、媒体关注、专利引用以及技术成果的采用等，它通过整合异构的数据源和有针对性的网络爬取来实现这一目标。该基准测试包含215,928对对比论文，这些论文代表了短期（如最佳论文奖）和长期（如诺贝尔奖）背景下显著的影响差异。我们对11种广泛使用的大语言模型在SciImpact上的表现进行了评估。结果表明，现成的模型在不同维度和领域中存在显著的差异，而多任务监督式微调则使得较小的语言模型（例如4B参数的模型）能够显著优于较大的模型（例如30B参数的模型），甚至超越一些强大的闭源语言模型（例如o4-mini）。这些结果证明了SciImpact作为一个具有挑战性的基准测试的价值，同时也展示了它在多维、多领域科学影响力预测方面的应用价值。我们的项目主页地址为https://flypig23.github.io/sciimpact-homepage/。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: When Helpers Become Hazards: A Benchmark for Analyzing Multimodal LLM-Powered Safety in Daily Life
papers.title_zh: 当辅助角色成为隐患：分析基于多模态大语言模型实现的日常生活安全机制的研究框架
papers.authors: Xinyue Lou, Xu Jinan, Jingyi Yin, Xiaolong Wang, Zhaolu Kang, Liaoyouwei, Yixuan Wang, Xiangyu Shi, Fengran Mo, SU Yao, Kaiyu Huang
papers.abstract: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) become an indispensable assistant in human life, the unsafe content generated by MLLMs poses a danger to human behavior, perpetually overhanging human society like a sword of Damocles. To investigate and evaluate the safety impact of MLLMs responses on human behavior in daily life, we introduce SaLAD, a multimodal satety benchmark which contains 2,013 real-world image–text samples across 10 common categories, with a balanced design covering both unsafe scenarios and cases of oversensitivity. It emphasizes realistic risk exposure, authentic visual inputs, and fine-grained cross-modal reasoning, ensuring that safety risks cannot be inferred from text alone. We further propose a safety-warning-based evaluation framework that encourages models to provide clear and informative safety warnings, rather than generic refusals. Results on 18 MLLMs demonstrate that the top-performing models achieve a safe response rate of only 57.2% on unsafe queries. Morevoer, even popular safety alignment methods limit effectiveness of the models in our scenario, revealing the vulnerabilities of current MLLMs in identifying dangerous behaviors in daily life. Our dataset is available at https://github.com/xinyuelou/SaLAD.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着多模态大语言模型成为人类生活中不可或缺的助手，这些模型生成的不良内容对人类行为构成了威胁，就像达摩克利斯之剑一样时刻悬在人类社会之上。为了研究和评估多模态大语言模型在日常生活中对人类行为的安全性影响，我们提出了SaLAD这一多模态安全性基准测试集。该数据集包含2,013个来自10个常见类别的真实图像-文本样本，设计上兼顾了不安全场景和过度敏感的情况，强调了现实风险暴露、真实视觉输入以及细粒度的跨模态推理，确保安全性风险不能仅从文本中推断出来。我们还提出了一个基于安全警告的评估框架，鼓励模型提供清晰且富有信息量的安全警告，而不是简单的拒绝回应。对18个多模态大语言模型进行的测试表明，表现最好的模型在不安全查询上的安全响应率仅为57.2%。此外，即使是流行的安全性对齐方法，也未能有效提升模型的表现，这揭示了当前多模态大语言模型在识别日常生活中危险行为方面的局限性。我们的数据集可在https://github.com/xinyuelou/SaLAD下载。

papers.title: MM-ShiftKV: Decode-Aware Prefill-Stage KV Selection for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MM-ShiftKV：一种基于解码机制的KV值预填充策略，适用于多模态大语言模型
papers.authors: Jinsong Shu, Chenyang Wu, Zhongle Xie, Baokun Wang, Lidan Shou
papers.abstract: Key-Value (KV) caching is essential for efficient inference in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its memory footprint grows linearly with context length and becomes a major bottleneck due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent prefill-stage KV selection methods estimate KV importance from prefilling statistics, implicitly assuming that prefilling-time queries are representative of those encountered during decoding. We show that this assumption breaks down in multimodal inference, where decoding-time queries exhibit substantially larger variance than prefilling-stage representations, leading to unstable KV importance estimation under tight cache budgets. As a result, small ranking errors can disproportionately discard semantically critical visual tokens and degrade grounding and reasoning performance. We propose MM-ShiftKV, a training-free, decode-aware and strictly prefill-only KV selection method. MM-ShiftKV approximates decoding-time query behavior during prefilling by constructing variance-expanded query proxies and estimates prompt KV importance based on their aggregated attention mass. Experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that MM-ShiftKV consistently outperforms existing methods under strict KV-cache budgets.
papers.abstract_zh: 键值（KV）缓存对于多模态大语言模型中的高效推理至关重要，然而其内存占用会随着上下文长度的增加而线性增长，并且由于视觉令牌数量众多，这成为了一个主要的瓶颈。最近的一些预填充阶段的KV选择方法通过预填充统计信息来估计KV的重要性，这种假设隐含着预填充阶段的查询能够代表解码过程中遇到的查询。我们发现，在多模态推理中，这种假设并不成立，因为解码阶段的查询表现出比预填充阶段的表示更大的方差，这导致在有限的缓存预算下，KV重要性的估计变得不稳定。因此，微小的排名误差可能会导致语义上重要的视觉令牌被过度丢弃，从而损害推理和理解性能。我们提出了MM-ShiftKV一种无需训练、注重解码过程且严格基于预填充的KV选择方法。MM-ShiftKV通过在预填充阶段构建具有更大方差的查询代理来近似解码阶段的查询行为，并基于这些查询的聚合注意力权重来估计提示的KV重要性。在多模态基准测试中的实验表明，在严格的KV缓存预算下，MM-ShiftKV始终优于现有的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Measuring What Matters Beyond Text: Evaluating Multimodal Summaries by Quality, Alignment, and Diversity
papers.title_zh: 衡量文本之外的重要信息：通过质量、一致性和多样性来评估多模态摘要
papers.authors: Abid Ali, Diego Molla, Usman Naseem
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have facilitated Multimodal Summarization with Multimodal Output (MSMO), wherein systems generate concise textual summaries accompanied by salient visuals from multimodal sources. However, current MSMO evaluation remains fragmented: text quality, image-text alignment, and visual diversity are typically assessed in isolation using unimodal metrics, making it difficult to capture whether the modalities jointly support a faithful and useful summary. To address this gap, we introduce MM-Eval, a unified evaluation framework that integrates assessments of textual quality, cross-modal alignment, and visual diversity. MM-Eval comprises three components: (1) text quality, measured using OpenFActScore for factual consistency and G-Eval for coherence, fluency, and relevance; (2) image-text relevance, evaluated via an MLLM-as-a-judge approach; and (3) image-set diversity, quantified using Truncated CLIP Entropy. We calibrate -Eval through a learned aggregation model trained on the mLLM-EVAL news benchmark, aligning component contributions with human preferences. Our analysis reveals a text-dominant hierarchy in this setting, where factual consistency acts as a critical determinant of perceived overall quality, while visual relevance and diversity provide complementary signals. MM-Eval improves over heuristic aggregation baselines and provides an interpretable, reference-weak framework for comparative evaluation of multimodal summaries.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）为多模态总结与多模态输出提供了支持，即系统能够从多种模态来源生成简洁的文本摘要，并附带显著的视觉内容。然而，目前对多模态总结与输出的评估仍然较为零散：文本质量、图像与文本的一致性以及视觉多样性通常分别使用单一模态的评估指标进行衡量，这使得难以判断不同模态是否共同支持了真实且有用的摘要。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MM-Eval这一统一的评估框架，该框架整合了对文本质量、跨模态一致性和视觉多样性的评估。MM-Eval包含三个组成部分：(1) 文本质量，通过OpenFActScore来衡量事实一致性，以及使用G-Eval来评估连贯性、流畅性和相关性；(2) 图像与文本的相关性，采用MLLM作为评判标准进行评估；(3) 图像集的多样性，通过截断的CLIP熵来量化。我们通过一个在mLLM-EVAL新闻基准测试上训练的聚合模型来校准MM-Eval，使各个组成部分的贡献与人类偏好保持一致。我们的分析表明，在这种情境下，文本占据主导地位，事实一致性是感知整体质量的关键因素，而视觉相关性和多样性则提供了互补的信息。MM-Eval优于基于启发式的聚合基线方法，它提供了一个可解释的、以参考为弱基础的框架，用于比较多模态摘要的评估效果。

papers.title: MonCulture-Eval: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Evaluating Mongolian Cultural Capabilities of Large Language Models across Scripts and Regions
papers.title_zh: MonCulture-Eval：一种分层评估方法，用于衡量大型语言模型在蒙古语及其他语言环境下的文化能力
papers.authors: Quulgan Minggad, Xiao Zinan, Yuan Sun
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved impressive linguistic fluency in low-resource languages, their capacity to process deep cultural nuances remains insufficiently quantified. This paper introduces MonCulture-Eval, a benchmark designed to assess the cultural intelligence of LLMs in the Mongolian context across two writing systems (Traditional and Cyrillic) and three regional sub-cultures (Alxa, Ordos, and Horqin). Curated entirely from primary, non-digitized archives to prevent data contamination, the benchmark employs a three-layer cognitive hierarchy—Factual, Situational, and Values—supplemented by specialized tasks including Riddles, Taboos, and Proverbs. Evaluation of frontier models reveals a severe “Script Gap” and a systematic “Etic Bias,” where models sanitize spiritual rituals into secular functional norms.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在资源匮乏的语言中取得了令人印象深刻的语言能力，但它们处理深层文化细微差别的能力仍未被充分量化。本文介绍了MonCulture-Eval这一基准测试工具，该工具旨在评估大语言模型在蒙古语环境中的文化智能水平，涵盖两种书写系统（传统蒙古文和西里尔字母）以及三种地区亚文化（阿拉善、鄂尔多斯和科尔沁）。该基准测试完全基于原始、未数字化档案进行构建，以避免数据污染。测试采用了三层认知层次结构：事实层面、情境层面和价值观层面，并包含了一系列专门任务，如谜题、禁忌和谚语的解决。对前沿模型的评估显示，这些模型存在严重的“脚本差异”问题，同时还存在系统性的“伦理偏见”，即模型将精神仪式转化为世俗的功能规范。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Less is More: Knowledge-Aware Compression for Long Legal Judgment Prediction
papers.title_zh: 少即是多：基于知识感知的压缩技术在长期法律判决预测中的应用
papers.authors: Fanghao Lou, Qiqi Wang, Guanyu Chen, Senbo Zhang, Kaiqi Zhao, Qian Liu, Huijia Li
papers.abstract: Legal case facts are often lengthy, complex, and difficult to process, posing challenges for legal judgment prediction. Although recent advances leverage large language models (LLMs) for legal reasoning, they face high computational costs and information degradation when handling long cases. Previous approaches, such as architectural modifications and text compression methods, reduce computational complexity to some extent but still struggle to effectively capture legally salient information in complex cases. We propose a legal knowledge–adaptive compression framework for long legal judgment prediction that integrates domain-specific legal knowledge to guide adaptive context compression. Our approach selectively retains legally relevant information while reducing redundant or less informative content, enabling efficient and accurate long-context reasoning. We evaluate the proposed framework on four real-world datasets spanning multiple jurisdictions and languages. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both prediction performance and computational efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 法律案件的事实往往冗长、复杂，且难以处理，这给法律判断的预测带来了挑战。尽管最近的技术进展利用大语言模型进行法律推理，但在处理长案时，这些模型面临着高计算成本以及信息质量下降的问题。以往的方法，如架构调整和文本压缩技术，在一定程度上降低了计算复杂性，但仍然难以有效捕捉复杂案件中的关键法律信息。我们提出了一种基于法律知识自适应压缩的框架，用于长期法律判断预测。该框架整合了特定领域的法律知识，以指导自适应上下文压缩过程。我们的方法能够选择性地保留与法律相关的信息，同时减少冗余或信息量较少的内容，从而实现高效且准确的长期上下文推理。我们在四个涵盖多个司法管辖区和语言的真实世界数据集上评估了该框架的性能。实验结果表明，我们的方法在预测性能和计算效率方面均优于现有方法。

papers.title: Towards Visually Grounded Multimodal Summarization via Cross-Modal Transformer and Gated Attention
papers.title_zh: 基于视觉的多模态摘要技术：利用跨模态变换器和门控注意力机制
papers.authors: Abid Ali, Diego Molla, Usman Naseem
papers.abstract: Multimodal summarization requires models to jointly understand textual and visual inputs to generate concise, semantically coherent summaries. Existing methods often inject shallow visual features into deep language models, leading to representational mismatches and weak cross-modal grounding. We propose a unified framework that jointly performs text summarization and representative image selection. Our system, SPeCTrA-Sum (Sampler Perceiver with Cross-modal Transformer and gated Attention for Summarization), introduces two key innovations. First, a Deep Visual Processor (DVP) aligns the visual encoder with the language model at corresponding depths, enabling hierarchical, layer-wise fusion that preserves semantic consistency. Second, a lightweight Visual Relevance Predictor (VRP) selects salient and diverse images by distilling soft labels from a Determinantal Point Process (DPP) teacher. SPeCTrA-Sum is trained using a multi-objective loss that combines autoregressive summarization, cross-modal alignment, and DPP-based distillation. Experiments show that our system produces more accurate, visually grounded summaries and selects more representative images, demonstrating the benefits of depth-aware fusion and principled image selection for multimodal summarization.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态摘要处理需要模型能够共同理解文本和视觉信息，从而生成简洁且语义连贯的摘要。现有的方法通常将浅层的视觉特征注入到深层语言模型中，这会导致表示上的不匹配以及跨模态的融合能力不足。我们提出了一个统一的框架，该框架同时执行文本摘要处理和代表性图像选择任务。我们的系统名为SPeCTrA-Sum（带有跨模态变换器和门控注意力机制的摘要采样器），它引入了两项关键创新：首先，深度视觉处理器能够将视觉编码器的不同层次与语言模型进行对齐，从而实现层次化的、逐层融合的处理，同时保持语义一致性；其次，轻量级的视觉相关性预测器能够从确定性点过程教师中提取软标签，从而选出具有代表性的图像。SPeCTrA-Sum通过结合自回归摘要处理、跨模态对齐以及基于确定性点过程的蒸馏技术来训练。实验表明，我们的系统能够生成更精确、更具视觉真实性的摘要，并且能选出更具代表性的图像，这充分证明了注重层次融合和基于原则的图像选择对于多模态摘要处理的重要性。

papers.title: Fairness Evaluation and Inference Level Mitigation in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型中评估公平性以及降低推理层面的问题
papers.authors: Afrozah Nadeem, Mark Dras, Usman Naseem
papers.abstract: Large language models often display undesirable behaviors embedded in their internal representations, undermining fairness, inconsistency drift, amplification of harmful content, and the propagation of unwanted patterns during extended dialogue and conversations. Although training-time or data-centric methods attempt to reduce these effects, they are computationally expensive, irreversible once deployed, and slow to adapt to new conversational contexts. Pruning-based methods provide a flexible and transparent way to reduce bias by adjusting the neurons responsible for certain behaviors. However, most existing approaches are static; once a neuron is removed, the model loses the ability to adapt when the conversation or context changes. To address this, we propose a dynamic, reversible, pruning-based framework that detects context-aware neuron activations and applies adaptive masking to modulate their influence during generation. Our inference-time solution provides fine-grained, memory-aware mitigation with knowledge-preserved, more coherent behavior across multilingual single- and multi-turn dialogues, enabling dynamic fairness control in real-world conversational AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型常常表现出一些不良行为，这些行为存在于其内部表示中，从而破坏公平性、导致不一致性、放大有害内容，并在长时间的对话中传播不希望出现的模式。虽然训练时间或基于数据的处理方法试图减少这些影响，但它们计算成本较高，一旦部署后便无法恢复，且难以适应新的对话环境。基于修剪的方法提供了一种灵活且透明的方式来减少偏见，通过调整负责某些行为的神经元来实现这一目标。然而，大多数现有方法都是静态的；一旦某个神经元被移除，模型就会失去适应能力，无法根据对话或环境的变化进行调整。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种动态的、可逆的基于修剪的框架，该框架能够检测与上下文相关的神经元激活情况，并采用自适应遮蔽技术来调节它们在生成过程中的影响力。我们的推理时间解决方案能够实现细粒度的、考虑记忆因素的改进措施，同时保留更多的知识，使多语言单轮对话和多轮对话中的行为更加连贯，从而实现现实世界对话式人工智能中的动态公平性控制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SCOPE: Preserving Modality-Specific Cues to Mitigate Modality Laziness in Multimodal Learning
papers.title_zh: 范围：保留与特定模式相关的提示，以在多模态学习中减轻该模式的惰性现象
papers.authors: Jingfan Yang, Rui Zhang, Liang Hong, Ke Yuan
papers.abstract: Multimodal learning aims to learn unified multimodal representations from heterogeneous modalities and supports many natural language processing tasks. However, multimodal models often exhibit modality laziness: over-relying on a dominant modality and under-exploiting complementary signals. Existing approaches typically strengthen unimodal training or rebalance modality contributions, but they may still emphasize shared semantics and overlook modality-specific cues. To address this, we propose SCOPE, a unified framework for learning complete multimodal representations, achieving Shared-and-COmplementary cue PrEservation. Firstly, SCOPE uses a mutual information-guided disentanglement module to separate shared semantics from modality-specific cues and mitigate representation collapse. Secondly, SCOPE aligns modalities by enforcing structural consistency between modality-wise semantic graphs, avoiding brittle point-wise matching. Finally, SCOPE performs balanced fusion via structure-aware diffusion attention to integrate shared and complementary cues without feature homogenization. Experiments on four benchmark datasets show that SCOPE consistently outperforms SOTA baselines, achieving up to 27.10% accuracy improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态学习旨在从不同的模态中学习统一的多模态表示，从而支持多种自然语言处理任务。然而，多模态模型往往存在模态懒惰现象：过度依赖某一主导模态，而未能充分利用其他互补信号。现有的方法通常会加强单模态训练或重新平衡各模态的贡献权重，但这些方法可能仍然强调共享语义，而忽视了特定模态的线索。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SCOPE框架——一个用于学习完整多模态表示的统一框架，能够实现共享与互补线索的保留。首先，SCOPE采用互信息引导的解耦模块，将共享语义与特定模态的线索分离，从而避免表示信息的丢失。其次，SCOPE通过强制各模态语义图之间的结构一致性，来对齐不同模态的信息，避免了逐点匹配的脆弱性。最后，SCOPE通过结构感知的扩散注意力机制，实现共享与互补线索的平衡融合，而不会导致特征的一致性。在四个基准数据集上的实验表明，SCOPE的表现始终优于当前最先进的基线算法，准确率提升了高达27.10%。

papers.title: Embedding-based In-Context Prompt Training for Enhancing LLMs as Text Encoders
papers.title_zh: 基于嵌入的上下文提示训练，用于提升大语言模型作为文本编码器的能力
papers.authors: Ailiang Lin, Zhuoyun Li, Keyu Mao, Kotaro Funakoshi, Manabu Okumura
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely explored for embedding generation. While recent studies show that in-context learning (ICL) effectively enhances the representational capability of LLMs by prepending a few task-related demonstrations, it causes substantial token overhead due to the increased sequence length. In this work, we propose EPIC, a novel embedding-based in-context prompt training strategy that leverages ICL to generate high-quality embeddings while reducing computational burden during both training and inference. This approach replaces discrete text demonstrations with their corresponding continuous embeddings, which not only encourages the LLM to align semantically-related text pairs during contrastive learning, but also requires the model to interpret demonstration embeddings as part of the in-context prompt. Consequently, EPIC-trained models achieve excellent embedding performance both with or without in-context prompts at inference time. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method establishes new state-of-the-art results on the MTEB benchmark, surpassing frontier models trained solely on publicly available retrieval data. Extensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness and necessity of our mechanism.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在嵌入生成方面得到了广泛的研究。虽然最近的研究表明，上下文学习能够有效提升语言模型的表征能力，通过预先添加一些与任务相关的示例来实现这一点，但这种方法会因为序列长度的增加而导致大量的token开销。在这项研究中，我们提出了EPIC这一基于嵌入的上下文提示训练策略。该策略利用上下文学习来生成高质量的嵌入，同时减少训练和推理过程中的计算负担。这种方法用连续的嵌入替代了离散的文本示例，这不仅促使语言模型在对比学习中将语义相关的文本对进行对齐，还要求模型将示例嵌入视为上下文提示的一部分。因此，经过EPIC训练的模型在推理时，无论是否使用上下文提示，都能取得出色的嵌入性能。全面的实验表明，我们的方法在MTEB基准测试上取得了新的最优成绩，超越了仅基于公开检索数据训练的先进模型。广泛的消融研究进一步验证了我们机制的有效性和必要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Creating ConLangs to Probe the Metalinguistic Grammatical Knowledge of LLMs
papers.title_zh: 创建ConLangs模型以探究大语言模型的语言规则知识
papers.authors: Chihiro Taguchi, Richard Sproat
papers.abstract: We present a system that uses LLMs as a tool in the development of Constructed Languages— ConLangs, which we call IASC (Interactive Agentic System for ConLangs). The system is modular in that it creates each of the components—phonology, morphology and syntax, lexicon, orthography, and grammatical handbook, using module-specific sets of prompts. The approach is agentic in that various modules allow for refining the output given automatically-generated commentary on a previous step. Our main goals are twofold. First, we aim to provide tools that facilitate an engaging and enjoyable experience in creating artificially constructed languages. Second, the focus of this paper is on using our ConLang framework as a novel way to explore what LLMs ‘know’ about language—not what they know about any particular language or encyclopedic facts, but how much they know about and understand language and linguistic concepts. In the experiments, we particularly focus on the morphosyntax module and show that there is a fairly wide gulf in capabilities both among different LLMs and among different linguistic specifications, with it being notably easier for systems to deal with more typologically common patterns than rarer ones. All code is released: https://github.com/SakanaAI/IASC.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个系统，该系统利用大语言模型来开发构造性语言——我们将其称为ConLangs。这个系统是模块化的，它分别创建了音系、形态学、句法、词汇表、正字法和语法手册等各个组件，这些组件都使用了针对特定模块的提示集。该系统的特点是具有代理功能，不同的模块可以基于前一步自动生成的注释来进一步细化输出结果。我们的主要目标有两个。首先，我们希望提供能够让用户在创造人工构造语言的过程中获得愉悦体验的工具。其次，本文的重点是运用我们的ConLang框架，以一种新颖的方式探索大语言模型对语言的认知——不是它们对某一特定语言或百科知识的了解，而是它们对语言和语言概念的理解程度。在实验中，我们特别关注了形态句法模块，并发现不同大语言模型之间以及不同语言规范之间在能力上存在相当大的差异。系统在处理较为常见的语言模式时表现得更为轻松，而处理较为罕见的语言模式则相对困难。所有代码均已发布：https://github.com/SakanaAI/IASC

papers.title: ReasonIF: Large Reasoning Models Fail to Follow Instructions During Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ReasonIF：大型推理模型在进行推理过程中无法遵循指令行事
papers.authors: Yongchan Kwon, Shang Zhu, Federico Bianchi, Kaitlyn Zhou, James Zou
papers.abstract: The ability of large language models (LLMs) to follow user instructions is central to their reliability, safety, and usefulness. While prior studies assess instruction adherence in the model’s main responses, we argue that it is also critical for large reasoning models (LRMs) to follow user instructions throughout their reasoning process. Reasoning instruction following makes LRMs more controllable and transparent, while reducing risks of undesirable shortcuts, hallucinations, or reward hacking within reasoning traces. To evaluate this dimension, we introduce ReasonIF, a systematic benchmark for assessing reasoning instruction following. ReasonIF includes six categories of instruction prompts, spanning multilingual reasoning, and length control. Across many open-source LRMs including GPT-OSS, Qwen3, and DeepSeek-R1, we find substantial failures in reasoning instruction adherence: the highest instruction following score (IFS) remains below 0.25, meaning that fewer than 25% of reasoning traces comply with the given instructions. Notably, as task difficulty increases, reasoning instruction following degrades further. We also explore two strategies to enhance reasoning instruction fidelity: (1) multi-turn reasoning and (2) Reasoning Instruction Finetuning (RIF) using synthetic data. RIF improves the IFS of GPT-OSS-20B from 0.11 to 0.27, indicating measurable progress but leaving ample room for improvement. We hope this work draws attention to reasoning-level instruction adherence as an underexplored but critical aspect of model alignment, and helps pave the way toward more controllable, interpretable, and trustworthy reasoning models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）能够遵循用户指令是其可靠性、安全性和实用性的核心。虽然之前的研究主要关注模型在主要响应中的指令遵守情况，但我们认为，对于大型推理模型（LRM）而言，在推理过程中遵循用户指令同样至关重要。遵循指令的推理方式使得LRM更加可控且透明，同时减少了推理过程中出现不希望出现的捷径行为、幻觉或奖励作弊等问题。为了评估这一方面，我们引入了ReasonIF这一用于评估推理指令遵守情况的系统基准测试。ReasonIF包含六类指令提示，涵盖了多语言推理和长度控制等方面。在包括GPT-OSS、Qwen3和DeepSeek-R1在内的许多开源LRM中，我们发现存在严重的推理指令遵守问题：最高的指令遵守得分仍低于0.25，这意味着不到25%的推理过程符合给定的指令要求。值得注意的是，随着任务难度的增加，推理指令的遵守程度进一步下降。我们还探讨了两种提高推理指令忠实度的策略：（1）多轮推理；（2）使用合成数据进行推理指令微调。通过RIF技术，GPT-OSS-20B的指令遵守得分从0.11提升到了0.27，这表明取得了显著的进步，但仍有很大的改进空间。我们希望这项工作能够引起人们对推理层面指令遵守问题的关注，因为这是一个尚未得到充分探索但至关重要的模型对齐方面，并有助于推动开发出更可控、可解释且值得信赖的推理模型。

papers.title: An LLM-Embedding Semantic Adaptation Network for Post-level Semantic Drift Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 一种基于LLM嵌入技术的语义适应网络，用于评估帖子级别的语义变化
papers.authors: Ning Chen, Mingyu Kang, Jie Li, Linyuan Lü
papers.abstract: Evaluating semantic drift is essential for understanding dynamical discourse evolution and opinion formation in online discussions. However, sparse and uneven distributions of event-specific keywords prevent traditional models from capturing post-level semantic drift. Thus, to address this issue, we propose an LLM-embedding Semantic Adaptation Network (LLM-SAN), which is a hybrid semantic drift evaluation model with an LLM-Embedding gated recurrent unit (GRU) module, an LLM-Embedding graph convolutional network (GCN) module and a multi-expert adaptive fusion module. The GRU module is used to extract features from event related posts, and The GCN is used to extract features from temporal graphical topic posts. Then, the features are merged by the multi-expert adaptive fusion module. Finally, this module predicts the future post embedding, and the prediction error is used to evaluate and detect the semantic drift points. Extensive experiments are conducted, and the results show that LLM-SAN achieves the state-of-the-art performance on the semantic drift evaluation task, compared to the other baselines. Ablation experiments are also conducted to show the effectiveness of each module in LLM-SAN.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估语义漂移对于理解在线讨论中的动态话语演变和观点形成至关重要。然而，特定事件关键词的分布较为稀疏且不均匀，这阻碍了传统模型捕捉到帖子级别的语义漂移。因此，为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于大语言模型嵌入的语义适应网络（LLM-SAN）。该模型是一种混合式语义漂移评估模型，包含了一个大语言模型嵌入门控循环单元模块、一个大语言模型嵌入图卷积网络模块以及一个多专家自适应融合模块。门控循环单元模块用于从与事件相关的帖子中提取特征，而图卷积网络模块则用于从时间上的图形化主题帖子中提取特征。随后，这些特征通过多专家自适应融合模块进行合并。最后，该模块预测未来帖子的嵌入结果，而预测误差则被用来评估和检测语义漂移点。经过大量实验验证，结果表明，与其他基线方法相比，LLM-SAN在语义漂移评估任务上取得了最先进的性能。此外，我们还进行了消融实验，以验证LLM-SAN中各个模块的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CEAID: Benchmark of Multilingual Machine-Generated Text Detection Methods for Central European Languages
papers.title_zh: CEAID：中欧语言多语言机器生成文本检测方法的基准测试
papers.authors: Dominik Macko, Jakub Kopál
papers.abstract: Machine-generated text detection, as an important task, is predominantly focused on English in research. This makes the existing detectors almost unusable for non-English languages, relying purely on cross-lingual transferability. There exist only a few works focused on any of Central European languages, leaving the transferability towards these languages rather unexplored. We fill this gap by providing the first benchmark of detection methods focused on this region, while also providing comparison of train-languages combinations to identify the best performing ones. We focus on multi-domain, multi-generator, and multilingual evaluation, pinpointing the differences of individual aspects, as well as adversarial robustness of detection methods. Supervised finetuned detectors in the Central European languages are found the most performant in these languages as well as the most resistant against obfuscation.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器生成文本检测是一项重要的任务，目前的研究主要集中在英语上。因此，现有的检测工具几乎无法用于非英语语言，因为它们完全依赖于跨语言的通用性。目前只有少数研究关注中欧语言，对这些语言的通用性研究还相当不足。我们填补了这一空白，提供了针对这一地区的首个检测方法基准测试，同时比较了不同训练语言组合的效果，以确定性能最佳的方案。我们注重多领域、多生成器以及多语言评估，详细分析各个方面的差异，以及检测方法的对抗鲁棒性。在中欧语言中，经过监督式微调的检测工具表现最为出色，同时也最能抵抗混淆攻击。

papers.title: Distilling the Essence, Discarding the Dross: Improving Fairness in Multimodal Large Language Models via Historical Reflection-Guided Prompt Optimization
papers.title_zh: 提取精髓，剔除杂质：通过历史反思引导的提示优化，提升多模态大语言模型的公平性
papers.authors: Juncheng Hu, Jiming Yu, Rui Song, Kedi Lyu, Yingji Li, Zheli Liu
papers.abstract: ocial bias in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has become an increasingly important concern. Prompt-based approaches offer a lightweight solution for debiasing; however, existing methods rely heavily on handcrafted prompts that are brittle, highly context-sensitive, and difficult to generalize across tasks, bias types, and multimodal settings. In this work, we propose Historical Reflection-Guided Prompt Optimization (HRPO), an adaptive self-debiasing framework for black-box MLLMs that automatically optimizes task-specific debiasing prompts to suppress stereotypical outputs. To mitigate forgetting during prompt optimization, we introduce Historical Contrastive Self-Reflection (HCSR), which performs contrastive reflection over positive and negative optimization histories, enabling the model to retain effective prompts and avoid redundant exploration, thereby improving optimization efficiency. Experiments on three benchmarks involving eight open-source and two closed-source MLLMs, covering ten singular and two intersectional bias types, demonstrate that HRPO achieves strong debiasing performance while offering improved interpretability, generalization, and robustness. Code is available at: https://github.com/liyingji1996/HRPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型中的社会偏见已成为一个日益重要的问题。基于提示的方法为消除偏见提供了一种简单的解决方案；然而，现有的方法主要依赖于手工制作的提示，这些提示容易失效，对上下文非常敏感，且难以在不同任务、偏见类型和多模态环境中进行泛化。在这项研究中，我们提出了历史反思引导的提示优化方法（HRPO），这是一种适用于黑盒多模态语言模型的自适应自我消除偏见框架。该方法能够自动优化特定任务的消除偏见提示，以抑制刻板输出。为了减轻提示优化过程中的遗忘问题，我们引入了历史对比性自我反思机制（HCSR），该机制通过对正面和负面优化历史进行对比反思，使模型能够保留有效的提示，避免冗余的探索，从而提高优化效率。在涉及八个开源和两个闭源多模态语言模型的三个基准测试上进行的实验表明，HRPO在消除偏见方面表现出强大的性能，同时还提升了可解释性、通用性和鲁棒性。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/liyingji1996/HRPO。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Tree-of-Evidence: Efficient "System 2" Search for Faithful Multimodal Grounding
papers.title_zh: 证据树：一种高效的“系统2”搜索方法，用于实现可靠的多模态基础化处理
papers.authors: Micky C. Nnamdi, Benoit Louis Marteau, Yishan Zhong, J. Ben Tamo, May Dongmei Wang
papers.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance in high-stakes domains like healthcare, yet their reasoning remains opaque. Attention- and saliency-based methods often fail to faithfully represent the model’s decision process, particularly when integrating heterogeneous modalities. We introduce Tree-of-Evidence (ToE), an inference-time search algorithm that frames interpretability as a discrete optimization problem. Rather than relying on soft attention weights, ToE employs lightweight Evidence Bottlenecks that score coarse units of data (e.g., vital-sign windows, report chunks) and performs a beam search to identify the compact evidence set required to reproduce the model’s prediction. We evaluate ToE across six tasks spanning three datasets and two domains, including clinical prediction on MIMIC-IV, cross-center validation on eICU, and non-clinical fault detection on LEMMA-RCA. ToE retains over 98% of full-model AUROC with as few as five evidence units, achieves higher decision agreement and lower fidelity error than LIME, SHAP, saliency, and concept-bottleneck baselines under sparse budgets, and outperforms LLMs up to 70B parameters. ToE therefore provides a practical mechanism for auditing multimodal models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型多模态模型在诸如医疗保健这样的高风险领域取得了顶尖的性能表现，但它们的推理过程仍然不够透明。基于注意力机制和显著性分析的方法往往无法准确反映模型的决策过程，尤其是在整合不同模态的数据时。我们提出了证据树算法，这是一种在推理阶段使用的搜索算法，它将可解释性视为一个离散的优化问题。与依赖软注意力权重的方法不同，证据树算法采用轻量级的证据瓶颈机制，对数据进行粗略的评分（例如，生命体征窗口、报告片段），并通过束搜索来识别用于复现模型预测所需的简洁证据集。我们在三个数据集和两个领域中的六个任务上评估了证据树算法的性能，包括MIMIC-IV上的临床预测、eICU上的跨中心验证，以及LEMA-RCA上的非临床故障检测。结果表明，证据树算法在仅有五个证据单元的情况下，仍能保持超过98%的全模型AUROC率，其决策一致性高于LIME、SHAP、显著性分析和概念瓶颈基线的表现，并且在稀疏预算条件下，其误差更低。此外，证据树算法的性能甚至优于参数高达700亿的大语言模型。因此，证据树算法为审计多模态模型提供了一种实用的机制。

papers.title: Jailbreaking Large Language Models with Morality Attacks
papers.title_zh: 通过道德攻击手段破解大型语言模型
papers.authors: Ying Su, Zheng Mingen, Weili Diao, Haoran Li
papers.abstract: Pluralism alignment with AI has the sophisticated and necessary goal of creating AI that can coexist with and serve morally multifaceted humanity. Research towards pluralism alignment has many efforts in enhancing the learning of large language models (LLMs) to accomplish pluralism. Although this is essential, the robustness of LLMs to produce moral content over pluralistic values is still under exploration. Inspired by the astonishing persuasion abilities via jailbreak prompts, we propose to leverage jailbreak attacks to study LLMs’ internal pluralistic values. In detail, we develop a morality dataset with 10.4K instances in two categories: Value Ambiguity and Value Conflict. We further formalize four adversarial attacks with the constructed dataset, to manipulate LLMs’ judgment over the morality questions. We evaluate both the large language models and guardrail models which are typically used in generative systems with flexible user input. Our experiment results show that there is a critical vulnerability of LLMs and guardrail models to these subtle and sophisticated moral-aware attacks.
papers.abstract_zh: 与人工智能实现多元主义对齐的目标，是创造出能够与人类共存且具备道德多样性的智能体。关于多元主义对齐的研究，目前有很多努力旨在提升大语言模型的学习能力，以达成这一目标。虽然这一点非常重要，但大语言模型在生成符合多元价值观的道德内容方面的鲁棒性仍有待进一步探索。受“越狱提示”所展现出的惊人说服力启发，我们提出利用越狱攻击来研究大语言模型的内部多元价值观。具体来说，我们构建了一个包含10.4K个实例的道德数据集，这些实例分为两类：价值模糊性和价值冲突性。接着，我们针对该数据集提出了四种对抗性攻击方法，以操控大语言模型对道德问题的判断。我们同时评估了大语言模型和通常用于生成系统的护栏模型的表现。实验结果表明，大语言模型和护栏模型都存在严重的漏洞，容易受到这些微妙而复杂的道德意识攻击的影响。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ExpSeek: Self-Triggered Experience Seeking for Web Agents
papers.title_zh: ExpSeek：网络代理自触发体验搜索机制
papers.authors: Wenyuan Zhang, Xinghua Zhang, Haiyang Yu, Shuaiyi Nie, Bingli Wu, Juwei Yue, Tingwen Liu, Yongbin Li
papers.abstract: Experience intervention in web agents emerges as a promising technical paradigm, enhancing agent interaction capabilities by providing valuable insights from accumulated experiences. However, existing methods predominantly inject experience passively as global context before task execution, struggling to adapt to dynamically changing contextual observations during agent-environment interaction. We propose ExpSeek, which shifts experience toward step-level proactive seeking: (1) estimating step-level entropy thresholds to determine intervention timing using the model’s intrinsic signals; (2) designing step-level tailored experience content. Experiments on Qwen3-8B and 32B models across four challenging web agent benchmarks demonstrate that ExpSeek achieves absolute improvements of 9.3% and 7.5%, respectively. Our experiments validate the feasibility and advantages of entropy as a self-triggering signal, reveal that even a small-scale 4B experience model can significantly boost the performance of larger agent models. The code is released at https://github.com/WYRipple/ExpSeek.
papers.abstract_zh: 在网页代理中引入经验干预是一种有前景的技术方法，它能够通过利用积累的经验来提升代理的互动能力。然而，现有的方法通常只是将经验作为全局上下文在任务执行前被动地注入到系统中，难以适应代理与环境互动过程中不断变化的情境。我们提出了ExpSeek方法，该方法将经验转化为针对特定步骤的主动搜索：(1) 利用模型自身的信号来估算特定步骤的熵阈值，从而确定干预时机；(2) 设计针对特定步骤的个性化经验内容。我们在Qwen3-8B和32B模型上进行的实验表明，使用ExpSeek方法可以分别实现9.3%和7.5%的性能提升。我们的实验验证了熵作为一种自触发信号的可行性及优势，并发现即使是规模较小的4B经验模型也能显著提升较大规模代理模型的性能。相关代码已发布在https://github.com/WYRipple/ExpSeek上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Do Personality Traits Interfere? Geometric Limitations of Steering in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 人格特质会起到干扰作用吗？大型语言模型中的几何限制
papers.authors: Pranav Bhandari, Usman Naseem, Mehwish Nasim
papers.abstract: Personality steering in large language models (LLMs) commonly relies on injecting trait-specific steering vectors, implicitly assuming that personality traits can be controlled independently. In this work, we examine whether this assumption holds by analysing the geometric relationships between Big Five personality steering directions. We study steering vectors extracted from two model families (LLaMA-3-8B and Mistral-8B) and apply a range of geometric conditioning schemes, from unconstrained directions to soft and hard orthonormalisation. Our results show that personality steering directions exhibit substantial geometric dependence: steering one trait consistently induces changes in others, even when linear overlap is explicitly removed. While hard orthonormalisation enforces geometric independence, it does not eliminate cross-trait behavioural effects and can reduce steering strength. These findings suggest that personality traits in LLMs occupy a slightly coupled subspace, limiting fully independent trait control.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型中，人格引导通常依赖于注入特定人格特征的引导向量，这隐含着人们认为人格特征可以独立控制的假设。在这项研究中，我们通过分析五大人格引导方向之间的几何关系，来检验这一假设是否成立。我们研究了从两个模型家族（LLaMA-3-8B和Mistral-8B）中提取的引导向量，并应用了多种几何条件化方案，包括无约束方向、软正交化和硬正交化等。我们的研究结果表明，人格引导方向具有显著的几何依赖性：即使明确消除了线性重叠，引导一个特征仍会导致其他特征的变化。虽然硬正交化能够确保几何上的独立性，但它并不能消除跨特征的行为效应，反而可能会降低引导的强度。这些发现表明，LLM中的人格特征占据了一个略微耦合的子空间，从而限制了完全独立的特征控制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AHA: Aligning Large Audio-Language Models for Reasoning Hallucinations via Counterfactual Hard Negatives
papers.title_zh: AHA：整合大型音频语言模型以通过反事实硬否定进行幻觉推理
papers.authors: Yanxi Chen, Wenhui Zhu, Xiwen Chen, Zhipeng Wang, Xin Li, Peijie Qiu, Hao Wang, Xuanzhao Dong, Yujian Xiong, Anderson Schneider, Yuriy Nevmyvaka, Yalin Wang
papers.abstract: Although Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) deliver state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, they frequently suffer from hallucinations, e.g., generating text not grounded in the audio input. We analyze these grounding failures and identify a distinct taxonomy: Event Omission, False Event Identity, Temporal Relation Error, and Quantitative Temporal Error. To address this, we introduce the AHA (Audio Hallucination Alignment) framework. By leveraging counterfactual hard negative mining, our pipeline constructs a high-quality preference dataset that forces models to distinguish strict acoustic evidence from linguistically plausible fabrications. Additionally, we establish AHA-Eval, a diagnostic benchmark designed to rigorously test these fine-grained reasoning capabilities. We apply this data to align Qwen2.5-Omni. The resulting model, Qwen-Audio-AHA, achieves a 13.7% improvement on AHA-Eval. Crucially, this benefit generalizes beyond our diagnostic set. Our model shows substantial gains on public benchmarks, including 1.3% on MMAU-Test and 1.6% on MMAR, outperforming latest SOTA methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大型音频语言模型（LALMs）能够展现出最先进的性能，但它们经常会出现幻觉问题，例如生成与音频输入无关的文本。我们对这些错误进行了分析，并确定了几种不同的分类方式：事件遗漏、错误事件识别、时间关系错误以及定量时间误差。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了AHA（音频幻觉对齐）框架。通过利用反事实硬负面挖掘技术，我们的系统构建了一个高质量的偏好数据集，该数据集迫使模型区分严格基于声音证据的信息和语言上看似合理的虚假信息。此外，我们还开发了AHA-Eval这一诊断基准测试，用于严格评估这些细粒度推理能力。我们将这些数据应用于Qwen2.5-Omni模型的对齐过程，最终得到的Qwen-Audio-AHA模型在AHA-Eval测试中的表现提升了13.7%。重要的是，这种提升效果超出了我们的诊断数据集范围。我们的模型在公共基准测试中也取得了显著成绩，例如在MMAU-Test上的提升率为1.3%，在MMAR上的提升率为1.6%，其性能超过了最新的先进模型。

papers.title: Web Sitemap Knowledge Can Enhance Autonomous Browsing
papers.title_zh: 网络站点地图相关知识能够提升自主浏览体验
papers.authors: Yuyao Zhang, Hongyu Lu, Jiajie Jin, Hongjin Qian, Shiyu Li, Zhao Yang, Yutao Zhu, Ji-Rong Wen, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled web agents to perform interactive tasks on real-world websites. However, existing agents still suffer from limited robustness, efficiency, and task success, largely due to their lack of structural understanding of websites and the absence of browsing priors in pre-trained models. To address these challenges, this paper proposes the Web Agent Sitemap Protocol (WASP), an agent-oriented sitemap that integrate structured website knowledge into web agents. WASP adopts a dual-granularity design, providing global site-level structure and local page-level semantic and interaction guidance. We also introduce a framework LightASM for constructing such sitemaps by identifying core pages and generating concise semantic summaries and block-level descriptions. Experiments on real-world browsing benchmarks demonstrate that WASP substantially improves the robustness, efficiency, and effectiveness of LLM-based web agents without extra training.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展使得网络代理能够在真实世界的网站上执行交互式任务。然而，现有的代理仍然存在鲁棒性、效率以及任务完成率方面的不足，这主要是由于它们缺乏对网站的结构性理解，且预训练模型中缺乏浏览先验知识。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了Web Agent Sitemap Protocol（WASP）这一以代理为导向的站点地图方案，它将结构化的网站知识整合到网络代理中。WASP采用了双粒度设计，既提供全局的站点级结构，又提供局部页面级的语义和交互指导。我们还提出了一个名为LightASM的框架，用于构建此类站点地图，该框架通过识别核心页面并生成简洁的语义摘要和块级描述来实现这一目标。在真实世界的浏览测试中的实验表明，WASP能够显著提升基于大语言模型的网络代理的鲁棒性、效率和效果，而无需额外的训练。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Coarse-to-Fine Multimodal Information Selection for Video Speaking Style Recognition with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 利用大型语言模型进行视频语音风格识别中的粗到细多模态信息选择
papers.authors: Beibei Zhang, Yanan Lu, Lin Fen, Tongwei Ren
papers.abstract: Video Speaking Style Recognition (VSSR) aims to classify conversation videos into different types, significantly facilitating human interaction understanding. Recent approaches explore the potential of large language models (LLM) in VSSR with a training-free process. However, directly integrating all multimodal data yields suboptimal results, since the great redundancy in visual data can overshadow other valuable multimodal information, such as valuable textual dialogues and critical visual clues. To address this, we propose CFMiS (Coarse-to-Fine Multimodal Information Selection), a novel framework for VSSR that dynamically obtain valuable multimodal data via coarse-to-fine selection, enhancing LLM reasoning for VSSR. Specifically, the core of CFMiS are two cascaded modules: 1) a text-dominant modality selection module firstly selects VSSR-required modalities originating from text-based prediction; and 2) if vision is included in the selected modalities, a visual refinement module iteratively collects VSSR-relevant critical visual clues. The former resolves which modality to utilize, while the latter determines which information to adopt from selected modalities, efficiently alleviating information redundancy. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets prove that CFMiS is highly effective for VSSR, outperforming all existing training-free approaches and most training-based methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频对话风格识别（VSSR）旨在将对话视频分类为不同的类型，从而显著提升对人类交互的理解能力。近期的研究探索了大语言模型在VSSR中的潜力，且这种模型无需经过训练即可发挥作用。然而，直接整合所有多模态数据往往会导致效果不佳，因为视觉数据中的大量冗余可能会掩盖其他有价值的多模态信息，比如重要的文本对话和关键的视觉线索。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了CFMiS这一新颖的VSSR框架。该框架通过从粗到细的选择方式，动态获取有价值的多模态数据，从而增强LLM在VSSR中的推理能力。具体来说，CFMiS的核心由两个级联模块组成：1）一个以文本为主的模式选择模块，该模块首先根据文本预测来选取所需的模式；2）如果视觉信息也被纳入所选模式中，那么一个视觉精炼模块会迭代地收集与VSSR相关的关键视觉线索。前者负责确定使用哪种模式，而后者则决定从所选模式中选取哪些信息，从而有效减少信息冗余。在多个数据集上的广泛实验表明，CFMiS在VSSR方面表现出极高的效率，其性能优于所有现有的无需训练的方法以及大多数需要训练的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
