papers.title: Large Language Models Require Curated Context for Reliable Political Fact-Checking—Even with Reasoning and Web Search
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型需要精心设计的上下文才能进行有效的政治事实核查——即便涉及推理和网络搜索功能
papers.authors: Matthew R. DeVerna, Kai-Cheng Yang, Harry Yaojun Yan, Filippo Menczer
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have raised hopes for automated end-to-end fact-checking, but prior studies report mixed results. As mainstream chatbots increasingly ship with reasoning capabilities and web search tools—and millions of users already rely on them for verification—rigorous evaluation is urgent. We evaluate 15 recent LLMs from OpenAI, Google, Meta, and DeepSeek on more than 6,000 claims fact-checked by PolitiFact, comparing standard models with reasoning- and web-search variants. Standard models perform poorly, reasoning offers minimal benefits, and web search provides only moderate gains, despite fact-checks being available on the web. In contrast, a curated RAG system using PolitiFact summaries improved macro F1 by 233% on average across model variants. These findings suggest that giving models access to curated high-quality context is a promising path for automated fact-checking.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型为自动化端到端的事实核查带来了希望，但先前的研究结果却并不乐观。随着主流聊天机器人逐渐具备推理能力和网络搜索功能——而数百万用户已经依赖这些功能来进行事实验证——因此进行严格的评估变得十分紧迫。我们对来自OpenAI、Google、Meta和DeepSeek的15种最新语言模型进行了评估，这些模型需要验证超过6000条新闻事实。我们比较了标准模型与具有推理能力和网络搜索功能的模型的表现。结果显示，标准模型的性能较差，推理功能带来的好处微乎其微，而网络搜索功能则只能带来适度的提升效果，尽管网络上已有大量事实验证信息可供参考。相比之下，使用PolitiFact摘要构建的精选RAG系统在不同模型版本中平均使F1值提高了233%。这些发现表明，让模型访问经过精心筛选的高质量上下文信息，是实现自动化事实核查的一条有前景的路径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: IREASONER: Trajectory-Aware Intrinsic Reasoning Supervision for Self-Evolving Large Multimodal Models
papers.title_zh: IREASONER：基于轨迹感知的内置推理机制，适用于自演化的大型多模态模型
papers.authors: Meghana Sunil, Manikandarajan Venmathimaran, Muthu Subash Kavitha
papers.abstract: Recent work shows that large multimodal models (LMMs) can self-improve from unlabeled data via self-play and intrinsic feedback. Yet existing self-evolving frameworks mainly reward final outcomes, leaving intermediate reasoning weakly constrained despite its importance for visually grounded decision making. We propose IREASONER, a self-evolving framework that improves an LMM’s implicit reasoning by explicitly eliciting chain-of-thought (CoT) and rewarding its internal agreement. In a Proposer–Solver loop over unlabeled images, IREASONER augments outcome-level intrinsic rewards with a trajectory-aware signal defined over intermediate reasoning steps, providing learning signals that distinguish reasoning paths leading to the same answer without ground-truth labels or external judges. Starting from Qwen2.5-VL-7B, IREASONER yields up to +2.1 points across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks under fully unsupervised post-training. We hope this work serves as a starting point for reasoning-aware self-improvement in LMMs in purely unsupervised settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，大型多模态模型可以通过自我训练和内在反馈来自我改进。然而，现有的自我进化框架主要关注的是最终结果，而中间阶段的推理过程却没有得到足够的重视，尽管它对基于视觉的决策制定至关重要。我们提出了IREASONER这一自我进化框架，它通过明确引导思维链并奖励模型的内部一致性，从而提升多模态模型的隐性推理能力。在针对未标记图像的设计中，IREASONER通过在中间推理阶段引入轨迹感知信号，增加了对结果层面的内在奖励，从而提供了能够区分那些即使没有真实标签或外部评判也能得出相同答案的推理路径的学习信号。从Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型开始，在完全无监督的训练后，IREASONER在多种多模态推理基准测试中取得了高达+2.1点的成绩。我们希望这项工作能够为在完全无监督环境下的多模态模型自我改进提供借鉴。

papers.title: CLaRE-ty Amid Chaos: Quantifying Representational Entanglement to Predict Ripple Effects in LLM Editing
papers.title_zh: 在混乱中保持清晰：量化表征纠缠度以预测大型语言模型编辑行为带来的连锁效应
papers.authors: Manit Baser, Alperen Yildiz, Dinil Mon Divakaran, Mohan Gurusamy
papers.abstract: The static knowledge representations of large language models (LLMs) inevitably become outdated or incorrect over time. While model-editing techniques offer a promising solution by modifying a model’s factual associations, they often produce unpredictable ripple effects, which are unintended behavioral changes that propagate even to the hidden space. In this work, we introduce CLaRE, a lightweight representation-level technique to identify where these ripple effects may occur. Unlike prior gradient-based methods, CLaRE quantifies entanglement between facts using forward activations from a single intermediate layer, avoiding costly backward passes. To enable systematic study, we prepare and analyse a corpus of 11,427 facts drawn from three existing datasets. Using CLaRE, we compute large-scale entanglement graphs of this corpus for multiple models, capturing how local edits propagate through representational space. These graphs enable stronger preservation sets for model editing, audit trails, efficient red-teaming, and scalable post-edit evaluation. In comparison to baselines, CLaRE achieves an average of 62.2% improvement in Spearman correlation with ripple effects while being 2.74× faster, and using 2.85× less peak GPU memory. Besides, CLaRE requires only a fraction of the storage needed by the baselines to compute and preserve fact representations. Our entanglement graphs and corpus are available at https://github.com/manitbaser/CLaRE.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的静态知识表示随着时间的推移必然会变得过时或错误。虽然模型编辑技术通过修改模型的事实关联提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但它们往往会产生不可预测的连锁效应，这些连锁效应会导致意外的行为变化，甚至影响到隐藏空间。在这项研究中，我们引入了CLaRE这一轻量级表示级技术，用于识别这些连锁效应可能发生的位置。与之前的基于梯度的方法不同，CLaRE利用单个中间层的前向激活来量化事实之间的纠缠关系，避免了昂贵的反向传播过程。为了进行系统的研究，我们准备并分析了一个包含11,427个事实的语料库，这些事实来自三个现有的数据集。使用CLaRE技术，我们为多个模型计算了这个语料库的大规模纠缠图，从而能够了解局部编辑如何在表示空间中传播。这些纠缠图使得模型编辑的保留效果更强，同时还能实现高效的红队协作以及可扩展的编辑后评估。与基线方法相比，CLaRE在减少连锁效应的Spearman相关性方面平均提升了62.2%，同时运行速度快了2.74倍，使用的GPU内存也减少了2.85倍。此外，CLaRE在计算和保存事实表示时所需的存储量仅为基线方法的一小部分。我们的纠缠图和语料库可以在https://github.com/manitbaser/CLaRE上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: STAR-Teaming: A Strategy-Response Multiplex Network Approach to Automated LLM Red Teaming
papers.title_zh: STAR-Teaming：一种基于策略与响应的多网络方法，用于自动化LLM攻击中的红队攻击行为
papers.authors: Min Jae Jung, YongTaek Lim, Chaeyun Kim, Junghwan Kim, Kihyun Kim, Minwoo Kim
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used, they remain susceptible to jailbreak prompts that can elicit harmful or inappropriate responses. This paper introduces STAR-Teaming, a novel black-box framework for automated red teaming that effectively generates such prompts. STAR-Teaming integrates a Multi-Agent System (MAS) with a Strategy-Response Multiplex Network and employs network-driven optimization to sample effective attack strategies. This network-based approach recasts the intractable high-dimensional embedding space into a tractable structure, yielding two key advantages: it enhances the interpretability of the LLM’s strategic vulnerabilities, and it streamlines the search for effective strategies by organizing the search space into semantic communities, thereby preventing redundant exploration. Empirical results demonstrate that STAR-Teaming significantly surpasses existing methods, achieving a higher attack success rate (ASR) at a lower computational cost. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness and explainability of the Multiplex Network. The code is available at https://github.com/selectstar-ai/STAR-Teaming-paper.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型被广泛使用，但它们仍然容易受到恶意提示的攻击，这些提示可能会引发有害或不适当的反应。本文介绍了STAR-Teaming这一新颖的黑盒框架，它能够实现自动化的红队对抗，并有效生成此类提示。STAR-Teaming将多智能体系统与策略-响应多路网络相结合，采用网络驱动的优化方法来采样有效的攻击策略。这种基于网络的方法将难以处理的高维嵌入空间转化为可处理的结构，从而具有两个主要优势：一是提高了对语言模型战略漏洞的可解释性；二是通过将搜索空间组织成语义社区，简化了有效策略的搜索过程，避免了冗余的探索。实验结果表明，STAR-Teaming在较低的计算成本下，能够显著提高攻击成功率。大量的实验验证了多路网络的有效性和可解释性。代码可在https://github.com/selectstar-ai/STAR-Teaming-paper获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Critic Rule Induction: Improving Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting with Generator-Critic Language Models
papers.title_zh: 评论家规则归纳法：利用生成器-评论家语言模型提升时间关系知识图谱的预测能力
papers.authors: Yingsong Ning, Fu Zhang, Jingwei Cheng, Jiashun Peng, Xiaoke Wang
papers.abstract: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) forecasting aims to infer future facts from historical observations in time-evolving graphs. Traditional rule-based methods often rely on statistical co-occurrences and extensive path enumeration, suffering from rule sparsity and search-space explosion, while recent LLM-based rule reasoning can produce linguistically plausible rules that are weakly constrained by graph evidence and thus may reflect spurious correlations or violate temporal constraints.To address these challenges, we propose Critic-Guided Rule Induction (CRI), which treats temporal rules as rule hypotheses to be examined and adopts a decoupled Generation-Discrimination pipeline to induce rules that are both high-coverage and high-precision. CRI first mines seed rules and path evidence from the historical graph and uses an LLM-based generator to abstract and generalize them into broader raw rule hypotheses. It then introduces a Fact-Grounded Rule Evaluator to perform fact-grounded discrimination of rule hypotheses from complementary perspectives together with necessary temporal and statistical constraints. Finally, CRI performs symbolic reasoning over the refined rule set to produce forecasts with traceable reasoning evidence. Experiments on three benchmarks show that CRI outperforms strong baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance on TKG forecasting.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间知识图谱预测旨在从随时间演变的图中，根据历史观测数据推断出未来事件。传统的基于规则的方法通常依赖于统计性共现和广泛的路径枚举，这些方法存在规则稀疏性和搜索空间爆炸的问题。而基于大语言模型的规则推理则能够生成在语言上合理、且受图证据约束较小的规则，但这些规则可能会反映虚假的相关性或违反时间限制。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了“批评引导的规则归纳”方法。该方法将时间规则视为需要检验的假设，并采用一种解耦的生成与判别流程来生成既覆盖范围广又精度高的规则。首先，CRI从历史图中挖掘出初始规则和路径证据，然后利用基于大语言模型的生成器将这些规则抽象并推广为更通用的原始规则假设。接着，引入基于事实的规则评估器，从多个角度对规则假设进行事实驱动的判别，同时考虑必要的时间和统计约束。最后，CRI对经过精炼的规则集进行符号推理，以生成具有可追溯推理证据的预测结果。在三个基准测试上的实验表明，CRI的表现优于现有的强基线方法，在时间知识图谱预测领域取得了领先的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Context-Agent: Dynamic Discourse Trees for Non-Linear Dialogue
papers.title_zh: 上下文代理：用于非线性对话的动态话语树结构
papers.authors: Junan Hu, Shudan Guo, Wenqi Liu, Jianhua Yin, Yinwei Wei
papers.abstract: Large Language Models demonstrate outstanding performance in many language tasks but still face fundamental challenges in managing the non-linear flow of human conversation. The prevalent approach of treating dialogue history as a flat, linear sequence is misaligned with the intrinsically hierarchical and branching structure of natural discourse, leading to inefficient context utilization and a loss of coherence during extended interactions involving topic shifts or instruction refinements. To address this limitation, we introduce Context-Agent, a novel framework that models multi-turn dialogue history as a dynamic tree structure. This approach mirrors the inherent non-linearity of conversation, enabling the model to maintain and navigate multiple dialogue branches corresponding to different topics. Furthermore, to facilitate robust evaluation, we introduce the Non-linear Task Multi-turn Dialogue (NTM) benchmark, specifically designed to assess model performance in long-horizon, non-linear scenarios. Our experiments demonstrate that Context-Agent enhances task completion rates and improves token efficiency across various LLMs, underscoring the value of structured context management for complex, dynamic dialogues. The dataset and code is available at GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在许多语言任务中表现出色，但在处理人类对话的非线性流程方面仍然存在根本性的挑战。目前的做法是将对话历史视为一个扁平的线性序列，这与自然语言固有的层次化和分支结构并不相符，导致上下文利用效率低下，并且在涉及话题转换或指令细化等长时间交互过程中，对话的连贯性会丧失。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了Context-Agent框架——该框架将多轮对话历史建模为动态树状结构。这种方法能够模拟对话的固有非线性特性，使模型能够同时处理多个与不同话题相关的对话分支。此外，为了便于评估模型的性能，我们还设计了非线性多轮对话基准测试，专门用于评估模型在长时、非线性场景下的表现。我们的实验表明，Context-Agent能够提高任务完成率，并提升各种大语言模型在token使用效率方面的表现，这充分证明了在复杂、动态对话中，结构化上下文管理的重要性。相关数据集和代码可在GitHub上获取。

papers.title: Can LLMs Really Judge? A Progressive Argumentation-Mining Framework for Distinguishing Understanding from Aggregation
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型真的能够进行判断吗？一种用于区分“理解”与“简单汇总”的渐进式论证挖掘框架
papers.authors: Fuyu Wang, Jiangtong Li, Kun Zhu, Changjun Jiang
papers.abstract: Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) mainly rely on dataset-based generation accuracy. However, generative correctness does not guarantee the discriminative capability required to verify solutions, frequently masking an inability to distinguish valid reasoning from plausible errors. While multi-agent debate inherently entails judgment, we show that uncontrolled context growth and convergence to majority voting introduce significant noise, obscuring intrinsic model judgment. To address these limitations, we propose a progressive argumentation-mining diagnostic framework designed to explicitly control context and isolate discriminative behaviors. Instead of indiscriminate aggregation, our approach distills and retains only the single most well-supported rationale per answer, preventing context dilution while enforcing strict quality-based selection. Applying this framework reveals a fundamental cognitive divergence: models exhibit structural susceptibility to plausible misinformation in knowledge tasks, whereas in reasoning tasks they demonstrate latent discriminative potential that remains fragile under pressure. These findings underscore the fragility of discriminative capabilities, advocating for diagnostic methodologies that prioritize judgment stability over simple generation performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前对大语言模型的评价主要依赖于基于数据集的生成准确性。然而，生成的正确性并不能保证验证解决方案所需的辨别能力，这往往会导致无法区分有效的推理和看似合理的错误。虽然多智能体辩论本身就涉及判断，但我们发现，不受控制的上下文增长以及向多数投票的收敛会引入大量噪声，从而掩盖了模型的真正判断能力。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种渐进式的论证挖掘诊断框架，该框架旨在明确控制上下文并分离出具有辨别能力的表现。我们的方法不是进行无差别的聚合，而是只保留每个答案中最有支持力的单一理由，从而避免上下文的稀释，同时严格遵循基于质量的选择原则。应用这一框架可以发现一个基本的认知差异：模型在知识任务中表现出对合理错误的结构性易感性，而在推理任务中则展现出潜在的辨别能力，但这种能力在压力下仍然很脆弱。这些发现凸显了辨别能力的脆弱性，因此我们需要采用更注重判断稳定性的诊断方法，而不是仅仅关注简单的生成性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SMART: Semantic Header Flattening and Pseudo-Code-Style Reasoning for LLM-based Complex Table Question Answering
papers.title_zh: SMART：语义标题扁平化技术以及适用于基于大语言模型的复杂表格问答系统的伪代码式推理方法
papers.authors: Yongshuo Zhang, Jixiong Chen, Kaihe xu, Wei Wei, Shihao Zou
papers.abstract: Complex table question answering (TQA) remains challenging, as real-world table, usually designed for human readability with multi-level headers and fragmented hierarchical semantics, largely hindering large language models (LLMs) from accurately aligning conditions, attributes, and values during reasoning. Existing approaches typically rely on handcrafted table linearization or prompts, forcing LLMs to infer header hierarchies, which frequently leads to brittle reasoning and hallucinations. To this end, we propose SMART, a unified framework that explicitly decouples table structure understanding from reasoning execution. SMART consists of three components: Semantic Header Flattening for converting multi-level headers into explicit single-level descriptors, Global Understanding for capturing holistic table–question semantics, and Pseudo-Code-Style Reasoning for structured, step-by-step inference with external validation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SMART substantially improves both the accuracy and robustness of complex TQA, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 复杂表格问答任务仍然具有挑战性，因为现实中的表格通常设计得易于人类阅读，且包含多级标题和复杂的层次结构，这大大阻碍了大语言模型在推理过程中准确匹配条件、属性和值。现有的方法通常依赖于手工制作的表格线性化处理或提示，迫使语言模型推断标题的层次结构，这往往会导致推理结果不稳定甚至出现幻觉。为此，我们提出了SMART框架，该框架将表格结构的理解与推理执行分离开来。SMART由三个组件组成：语义标题扁平化，用于将多级标题转换为明确的单级描述符；全局理解机制，用于捕捉表格与问题的整体语义；以及伪代码式推理，用于进行结构化、逐步的推理，并具备外部验证功能。在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，SMART显著提高了复杂表格问答任务的准确性和鲁棒性，达到了最先进的性能水平。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ConMA : Confidence-Guided Kernel Sampling with Multi-Stage Aggregation for LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ConMA：基于置信度引导的核采样方法，结合多阶段聚合技术，用于大型语言模型推理
papers.authors: Yinuo Wang, Qingjie Li, Wenyao Cui, Qiuchi Li, Zhang Huaping
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) enhances LLM reasoning capabilities by sampling and aggregating diverse solution trajectories. However, existing approaches often rely on external verifiers and one-shot independent sampling, which results in inefficient budget allocation and underutilizes interim high-quality trajectories. We propose ConMA, a training-free, verifier-free TTS framework that reallocates a fixed inference budget into iterative sample–filter–diversify–select cycles: it filters answer groups based on intrinsic token-probability confidence, enriches candidates through diversity-aware expansion, and employs repeated single-choice selection for multi-stage refinement. Across multiple benchmarks, ConMA consistently improves accuracy under fixed budgets. With a maximum budget of N=64, ConMA boosts Qwen3-4B to 80% accuracy on AIME25, significantly outperforming strong baselines while converging early with only 18 samples on average, substantially reducing inference cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时间缩放技术通过采样和聚合多种解决方案路径，提升了大语言模型的推理能力。然而，现有的方法往往依赖外部验证器和一次性独立采样，这导致预算分配效率低下，且未能充分利用那些高质量的中间结果。我们提出了ConMA这一无需训练、无需验证的测试时间缩放框架。该框架将固定的推理预算分配到迭代性的样本筛选、多样化处理和选择性优化等阶段：它根据内在的词条概率置信度来筛选答案组；通过多样化的扩展方式丰富候选方案；并通过多次单选择操作来进行多阶段的优化。在多个基准测试中，ConMA在固定预算下始终能够提升准确率。当最大预算为N=64时，ConMA能使Qwen3-4B在AIME25任务上的准确率提升至80%，显著优于其他强大的基线模型。同时，由于平均仅需18个样本即可实现早期收敛，因此大大降低了推理成本。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Human-Centered Supervision for Sentiment Analysis in Telugu: A Systematic Inquiry Beyond Accuracy
papers.title_zh: 以人类需求为中心的情感分析监督方法：一项关于准确性的系统研究
papers.authors: Vallabhaneni Raj Kumar, Ashwin S, Supriya Manna, Niladri Sett, Cheedella V S N M S Hema Harshitha, Kurakula Harshitha, Basina Deepakraj, Anand Kumar Sharma, Tanuj Sarkar, Samanthapudi Shakeer, Bondada Navaneeth Krishna
papers.abstract: Sentiment analysis for low-resource languages remains challenging in an era where interpretability, human alignment, and fairness are increasingly non-negotiable aspects of modern machine learning systems. These challenges stem both from the scarcity of annotated data and from the resulting difficulty of conducting reliable, human-interpretable analyses that go beyond predictive accuracy. Telugu, one of the primary Dravidian languages with over 96 million speakers, is not an exception. In this work, we first introduce TeSent, a large-scale Telugu sentiment classification dataset annotated with sentiment labels and human-selected rationales from multiple native speakers. This resource enables the study of rationale-based supervision for aligning models with human reasoning in this low-resource setting. We fine-tune five transformer-based models with and without rationale supervision and evaluate them on classification performance, explanation quality, and social bias. To facilitate controlled fairness evaluation, we additionally construct TeEEC, an evaluation corpus for Telugu sentiment analysis. Our results show that incorporating human rationales consistently improves alignment and often leads to holistic gains in predictive performance. We further provide extensive analysis of multi-facade explanation quality and fairness, offering insights into the broader effects of alignment-oriented supervision in resource-scarce language contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 在可解释性、人类对齐和公平性这些现代机器学习系统中越来越不可妥协的要素面前，针对资源匮乏语言的情感分析仍然具有挑战性。这些挑战既源于标注数据的稀缺性，也源于进行可靠、易于人类理解的分析的难度。泰卢固语作为主要的德拉威语系语言之一，拥有超过9600万使用者，也不例外。在这项研究中，我们首先介绍了TeSent这一大规模泰卢固语情感分类数据集，该数据集包含了来自多名母语者的情感标签和人类选择的理由注释。这一资源使得我们可以研究基于理由的监督方法，以在这种资源匮乏的环境中使模型与人类推理保持一致。我们分别对五种基于Transformer的模型进行了优化，这些模型要么带有理由监督，要么没有理由监督，然后评估了它们在分类性能、解释质量和社会偏见方面的表现。为了便于进行公平的评估，我们还构建了TeEEC这一泰卢固语情感分析评估语料库。我们的结果显示，结合人类理由能够持续提升模型的对齐效果，并且通常能在预测性能上带来整体提升。我们还对多层面解释的质量和公平性进行了深入分析，为资源匮乏语言环境中以对齐为导向的监督方法所带来的更广泛影响提供了见解。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification for Hallucination Detection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 基于证据的实体验证方法，用于检索增强生成中的幻觉检测
papers.authors: Runsong Jia, Zhen Fang, Mengjia Wu, Jie Lu, Yi Zhang
papers.abstract: Hallucination detection is crucial for large language models (LLMs), as hallucinated content creates significant barriers in applications requiring factual accuracy. Current detection methods mainly depend on internal signals like uncertainty and self-consistency checks, using the model’s pre-trained knowledge to identify unreliable outputs. However, pre-trained knowledge may become outdated and has coverage limitations, especially for specialized or recent information. To address these limitations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising solution by retrieving relevant evidence at inference time, grounding outputs beyond the model’s parametric knowledge. In this paper, we target a critical and practical learning problem RAG-based hallucination detection (RHD), where RAG is employed to enhance hallucination detection by addressing information updating challenges. To address RHD, we propose a novel method Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification (EAEV), which detects entity-level hallucinations by leveraging RAG to align generated entities with retrieved evidence contexts. Specifically, EAEV evaluates entity-evidence alignment through three complementary dimensions and introduces counterfactual stability analysis to ensure robust alignments under evidence perturbations. Experiments across multiple RAG benchmarks demonstrate that EAEV achieves consistent improvements over existing methods with strong generalization capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉检测对于大语言模型至关重要，因为幻觉内容会在需要事实准确性的应用中造成重大障碍。目前的检测方法主要依赖于内部信号，如不确定性和自一致性检查，利用模型预训练的知识来识别不可靠的输出。然而，预训练的知识可能会过时，并且存在覆盖范围有限的问题，尤其是在处理专业或最新信息时。为了克服这些限制，检索增强生成技术作为一种有前景的解决方案应运而生。该技术能够在推理过程中检索相关证据，从而让输出的内容超越模型的参数化知识范围。在本文中，我们针对一个关键且实用的学习问题——基于检索增强生成的幻觉检测问题，提出了一种新颖的方法：证据对齐实体验证（EAEV）。该方法通过利用检索增强生成技术来使生成的实体与检索到的证据上下文保持一致，从而检测实体级别的幻觉。具体来说，EAEV通过三个互补的维度来评估实体与证据的对齐程度，并引入反事实稳定性分析，以确保在证据发生变动时仍能保持稳定的对齐效果。通过在多个检索增强生成基准测试中的实验表明，EAEV在性能上取得了与现有方法相当甚至更好的提升，同时具备强大的泛化能力。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: From Personal to Collective: On the Role of Local and Global Knowledge in LLM Personalization
papers.title_zh: 从个人到集体：关于本地知识与全球知识在大型语言模型个性化中的作用的探讨
papers.authors: Zehong Wang, Junlin Wu, Zhaoxuan Tan, Bolian Li, Xianrui Zhong, Zheli Liu, Qingkai Zeng
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) personalization typically relies on modeling each user in isolation, conditioning on their historical interactions to adapt model behavior. However, this user-centric formulation overlooks the collective knowledge shared across users, limiting generalization for users with sparse histories and amplifying overfitting for those with highly skewed behaviors. We argue that effective personalization requires leveraging both individual preferences and population-level patterns. To this end, we propose LoGo, a Local–Global knowledge framework that augments user-specific signals with a global knowledge encoding collective behavioral trends. LoGo models global knowledge through a temporally evolving process that captures how population-wide preferences change over time, and a community-aware structure that organizes users into coherent groups with shared interests. To balance potentially conflicting local and global signals, LoGo employs a mediator module that adaptively fuses the two knowledge sources. Experiments on five personalization benchmarks show that LoGo consistently enhances personalization quality, outperforming existing methods by improving generalization in users with limited histories and mitigating bias in users with abundant histories. These results demonstrate the central role of collective knowledge in advancing LLM personalization. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zehong-Wang/LoGo.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的个性化处理通常依赖于对每个用户进行独立建模，基于他们历史上的交互行为来调整模型的行为。然而，这种以用户为中心的建模方式忽略了用户之间共享的集体知识，这限制了那些历史数据较少的用户的泛化能力，同时加剧了那些行为特征极为特殊的用户的过拟合问题。我们认为，有效的个性化处理需要同时利用个体偏好和群体层面的模式。为此，我们提出了LoGo这一局部-全局知识框架，该框架将针对用户的特定信息与编码集体行为趋势的全局知识相结合。LoGo通过一种随时间演变的过程来模拟全球知识，从而捕捉到整个群体的偏好如何随时间变化；同时，它还具备一个社区感知结构，能够将用户划分为具有共同兴趣的连贯群体。为了平衡可能相互冲突的局部和全局信息，LoGo采用了一种中介模块，能够自适应地融合这两种知识来源。在五个个性化评估基准上的实验表明，LoGo能够持续提升个性化处理的品质，其效果优于现有方法，尤其是在提升历史数据有限的用户的泛化能力以及减轻历史数据丰富的用户的偏见方面。这些结果证明了集体知识在提升LLM个性化处理中的核心作用。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Zehong-Wang/LoGo上免费获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ProMediate: A Simulation Testbed for Evaluating Proactive Mediation in Multi-Party Negotiation
papers.title_zh: ProMediate：一种用于评估多方谈判中主动调解效果的模拟测试平台
papers.authors: Ziyi Liu, Bahareh Sarrafzadeh, Pei Zhou, Longqi Yang, Jieyu Zhao, Ashish Sharma
papers.abstract: While LLMs increasingly assist individual users, there is a critical need for agents that can proactively manage complex, multi-party collaboration. However, the scarcity of systematic evaluation methods for these group dynamics limits the development of AI capable of effectively supporting teams Here, we present ProMediate, the first testbed for evaluating proactive AI mediator agents in complex, multi-topic, multi-party negotiations. ProMediate consists of two core components: (i) a simulation environment based on realistic negotiation cases with a plug-and-play proactive AI mediator, capable of flexibly deciding when and how to intervene; and (ii) a socio-cognitive evaluation framework with a new suite of metrics to measure consensus changes, intervention latency, mediator effectiveness, and intelligence. These components establish a systematic framework for assessing the capability of proactive AI agents in multi-party settings. Our results show that a socially intelligent mediator agent outperforms a generic baseline, via faster, better-targeted interventions. In the ProMediate-Hard setting, our social mediator increases consensus change by 3.6 percentage points compared to the generic baseline (10.65% vs 7.01%) while being 77% faster in response (15.98s vs. 3.71s). In conclusion, ProMediate provides a rigorous, theory-grounded testbed to advance the development of proactive, socially intelligent agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型越来越能协助个人用户，但迫切需要能够主动管理复杂多方协作的智能体。然而，针对这种群体动态的系统化评估方法尚处于匮乏状态，这限制了能够有效支持团队的AI技术的发展。在这里，我们提出了ProMediate——首个用于评估在复杂、多主题、多方谈判中主动型AI调解智能体的测试平台。ProMediate由两个核心组件构成：(i) 基于真实谈判案例的模拟环境，配备可即插即用式的主动型AI调解器，能够灵活决定何时以及如何进行干预；(ii) 一套社会认知评估框架，包含一系列新指标，用于衡量共识变化、干预延迟、调解效果以及智能水平。这些组件为评估主动型AI智能体在多方场景中的能力提供了系统化的框架。我们的研究表明，具有社会智慧的调解智能体在干预速度更快、目标更明确方面优于通用基线模型。在ProMediate-Hard场景中，我们的社会调解器使共识变化增加了3.6个百分点（10.65%对比7.01%），同时响应速度提升了77%（15.98秒对比3.71秒）。总之，ProMediate提供了一个严谨、基于理论的测试平台，有助于推动主动型、具有社会智慧的智能体的发展。

papers.title: InteracSPARQL : An Interactive System for SPARQL Query Refinement Using Natural Language Explanations
papers.title_zh: InteracSPARQL：一个用于利用自然语言解释对SPARQL查询进行精炼的互动系统
papers.authors: Xiangru Jian, Zhengyuan Dong, M. Tamer Özsu
papers.abstract: Current approaches for Natural Language to SPARQL (NL2SPARQL) generation primarily rely on one-turn, training-intensive models. While effective in specific settings, these models often lack generalizability and fail to provide transparency or mechanisms for error recovery in realistic scenarios. Additionally, prior interactive works are largely outdated and incompatible with modern large language model (LLM) workflows. In this paper, we introduce InteracSPARQL, a training-free interactive refinement pipeline that acts as a plug-and-play enhancement for existing SPARQL generation systems. Our approach integrates a set of efficient entity and property lookup tools within a self-correction loop, guided by a novel hybrid Natural Language Explanation (NLE) module. This module combines rule-based Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parsing with LLM semantic enrichment to produce explanations that are both structurally accurate and linguistically fluent. We evaluate InteracSPARQL on standard benchmarks (QALD-9 and QALD-10), showing that our tool-augmented self-refinement significantly boosts the accuracy of base models without fine-tuning. Furthermore, human evaluation confirms that our structured explanations substantially improve user understanding and ability to correct queries compared to unstructured baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前用于将自然语言转换为SPARQL（NL2SPARQL）的方法主要依赖于一次性的、需要大量训练时间的模型。虽然这些模型在特定场景下效果不错，但它们往往缺乏通用性，无法在现实场景中提供透明性或错误恢复机制。此外，现有的交互式方法已经过时，且与现代大语言模型的工作流程不兼容。在本文中，我们提出了InteracSPARQL这一无需训练的互动式优化流程，它可以作为现有SPARQL生成系统的即插即用增强工具。我们的方法将一系列高效的实体和属性查找工具整合到一个自我修正循环中，同时借助一种新颖的混合自然语言解释模块来指导这一过程。该模块结合了基于规则的抽象语法树解析与大语言模型的语义丰富功能，从而生成既结构准确又语言流畅的解释。我们在标准基准测试（QALD-9和QALD-10）上对InteracSPARQL进行了评估，结果显示，我们的工具辅助的自修正方法能够在无需微调的情况下显著提高基础模型的准确性。此外，人工评估表明，与无结构的基础方案相比，我们的结构化解释显著提升了用户的理解能力和查询纠错能力。

papers.title: Are Large Language Models Reliable Reviewers? A Benchmark for Error Detection in Financial Documents
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否可靠地进行文本审核？用于检测金融文档中错误的基准方法
papers.authors: Ying He, Zhouhong Gu, Zhecheng Hu, Yubo Zhou, Hao Shen, Jiaqing Liang, Zhaoqian Dai, Ma Shuguang, Fei Yu, Yanghua Xiao, Zhixu Li
papers.abstract: Ensuring the accuracy of financial documents is critical for economic analysis, regulatory compliance, and corporate decision-making. Several studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well in many financial tasks, such as stock price movements and financial analytics. However, a critical task remains unexplored: the ability of LLMs to identify errors in financial documents. In this paper, we introduce FinED-Bench, the first publicly Benchmark for Financial Error Detection across three levels of cognitive complexity. FinED-Bench covers nine real-world financial scenarios, and includes over 900 documents reported in 2025 that are unseen by existing language models. We detail the benchmark construction process and evaluate several advanced LLMs (e.g., GPT-4o, Qwen3-14B) on this tasks, which requires both financial domain knowledge and reasoning capabilities. Experimental results show that current LLMs still struggle with this task, especially in high-complexity cases. Besides, supervised fine-tuning can significantly improve the performance of weaker LLMs on this task. Our data and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FinED-Bench-406F.
papers.abstract_zh: 确保财务文件的准确性对于经济分析、法规合规以及企业决策至关重要。多项研究表明，大语言模型在许多财务任务中表现良好，例如股票价格走势和财务分析。然而，还有一个关键问题尚未得到研究：大语言模型识别财务文件中的错误的能力。在本文中，我们介绍了FinED-Bench，这是首个公开发布的、涵盖三个认知复杂度级别的财务错误检测基准测试。FinED-Bench涵盖了九种现实中的财务场景，包含了2025年报告的900多份现有语言模型未曾遇到的文档。我们详细描述了该基准测试的建设过程，并评估了几种先进的语言模型（如GPT-4o、Qwen3-14B）在这项任务上的表现。这项任务既需要财务领域的知识，也需要推理能力。实验结果表明，当前的语言模型在这一任务上仍然存在困难，尤其是在高复杂性的情况下。此外，有监督的微调可以显著提升较弱语言模型在这项任务上的性能。我们的数据和代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FinED-Bench-406F。

papers.title: Training-Free Test-Time Contrastive Learning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 无需训练的大规模语言模型测试时间对比学习
papers.authors: Kaiwen Zheng, Kai Zhou, Jinwu Hu, Te Gu, Mingkai Peng, Fei Liu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong reasoning capabilities, but their performance often degrades under distribution shift. Existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods rely on gradient-based updates that require white-box access and need substantial overhead, while training-free alternatives are either static or depend on external guidance. In this paper, we propose Training-Free Test-Time Contrastive Learning (TF-TTCL), a training-free adaptation framework that enables a frozen LLM to improve online by distilling supervision from its own inference experiences. Specifically, TF-TTCL implements a dynamic “Explore-Reflect-Steer” loop through three core modules: 1) Semantic Query Augmentation first diversifies problem views via multi-agent role-playing to generate different reasoning trajectories; 2) Contrastive Experience Distillation then captures the semantic gap between superior and inferior trajectories, distilling them into explicit textual rules; and 3) Contextual Rule Retrieval finally activates these stored rules during inference to dynamically steer the frozen LLM toward robust reasoning patterns while avoiding observed errors. Extensive experiments on closed-ended reasoning tasks and open-ended evaluation tasks demonstrate that TF-TTCL consistently outperforms strong zero-shot baselines and representative TTA methods under online evaluation. Code is available at https://github.com/KevinSCUTer/TF-TTCL.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的推理能力，但在分布偏移的情况下，其性能往往会下降。现有的测试时适应方法依赖于基于梯度的更新，这种更新需要白盒访问方式，并且会带来较大的计算开销。而无需训练的替代方案则要么过于静态，要么依赖于外部指导。在本文中，我们提出了一种无需训练的测试时对比学习方法——TF-TTCL。该方法能够让冻结的LLM通过从自身推理经验中提取监督信息来提升在线性能。具体来说，TF-TTCL通过一个动态的“探索-反思-引导”循环来实现这一功能，该循环包含三个核心模块：1）语义查询增强，通过多智能体角色扮演来多样化问题视角，从而生成不同的推理路径；2）对比经验蒸馏，捕捉优秀与劣质推理路径之间的语义差异，并将它们转化为明确的文本规则；3）上下文规则检索，在推理过程中激活这些存储的规则，从而动态引导冻结的LLM朝着稳健的推理模式发展，同时避免出现错误。在封闭性问题任务和开放性评估任务上的大量实验表明，TF-TTCL在在线评估中始终优于那些采用零样本方法的强基线模型以及其他代表性的测试时适应方法。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/KevinSCUTer/TF-TTCL。

papers.title: To Diff or Not to Diff? Structure-Aware and Adaptive Output Formats for Efficient LLM-based Code Editing
papers.title_zh: 是否进行差异化处理？考虑结构特性与自适应输出格式，以实现高效的基于大语言模型的代码编辑功能
papers.authors: Wei Cheng, Yongchang Cao, Chen Shen, Binhua Li, Jue Chen, Yongbin Li, Wei Hu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code editing, yet the prevalent full-code generation paradigm suffers from severe efficiency bottlenecks, posing challenges for interactive coding assistants that demand low latency and cost. Despite the predominant focus on scaling model capabilities, the edit format itself has been largely overlooked in model training. In this paper, we begin with a systematic study of conventional diff formats and reveal that fragile offsets and fragmented hunks make generation highly unnatural for LLMs. To address it, we introduce BlockDiff and FuncDiff, two structure-aware diff formats that represent changes as block-level rewrites of syntactically coherent units such as control structures and functions. Furthermore, we propose AdaEdit, a general adaptive edit strategy that trains LLMs to dynamically choose the most token-efficient format between a given diff format and full code. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AdaEdit paired with structure-aware diff formats consistently matches the accuracy of full-code generation, while reducing both latency and cost by over 30% on long-code editing tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码编辑中的应用越来越广泛，然而目前主流的全代码生成方式存在严重的效率瓶颈，这给需要低延迟和低成本的交互式编码助手带来了挑战。尽管人们主要关注模型的扩展能力，但在模型训练中，代码编辑格式本身却往往被忽视。在本文中，我们首先对传统的差异格式进行了系统的研究，发现脆弱的偏移量和分散的代码片段使得语言模型难以生成自然的人类可读代码。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了BlockDiff和FuncDiff两种注重结构性的差异格式，它们通过将变化表示为语法上连贯的单元（如控制结构和函数）的块级重写来实现代码生成。此外，我们还提出了AdaEdit这一通用的自适应编辑策略，该策略能够训练语言模型在给定差异格式和全代码格式之间动态选择最节省令牌的格式。大量的实验表明，AdaEdit结合注重结构性的差异格式，能够在保持与全代码生成相当的准确性同时，将长代码编辑任务的延迟和成本降低超过30%。

papers.title: CogEmp:A Cognitive Empathy-Oriented Dialogue System for Structured Psychological Counseling
papers.title_zh: CogEmp：一种以认知共情为导向的对话系统，适用于结构化心理辅导场景
papers.authors: Yiguo Deng, Xia Lei, Yuan Zhang, Long Ye
papers.abstract: Traditional psychological counseling struggles to meet public demand due to high costs, social stigma, and limited accessibility. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential in healthcare, offering new opportunities to build accessible mental health dialogue systems. However, current LLMs often lack accurate modeling of cognitive empathy, especially the ability to understand users’ emotions and their underlying psychological causes. To address this, we propose CogEmp, a dialogue generation model tailored for the Chinese cultural context that integrates cognitive empathy. The model follows a three-stage decision pipeline: emotion and cause recognition, contextual understanding, and empathetic response generation. First, the model identifies the user’s fine-grained emotions and their underlying causes within the Chinese context, laying the foundation for personalized emotional comprehension. Then, it retrieves semantically similar counseling cases to extract topic and strategy information, thereby constructing a context-aware representation. Finally, guided by the extracted multi-dimensional cues, the model drives LLMs to generate empathetic responses that are both contextually appropriate and professionally grounded. Experiments conducted on Chinese mental health datasets show that CogEmp outperforms existing approaches in key evaluation metrics, particularly in empathy, comprehensibility, and professionalism.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的心理咨询由于成本高、社会偏见以及可访问性有限，难以满足公众的需求。最近，大语言模型在医疗保健领域展现出了巨大潜力，为构建易于使用的心理健康对话系统提供了新机遇。然而，目前的语言模型往往缺乏对认知共情的准确建模，尤其是理解用户情绪及其潜在心理原因的能力。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了CogEmp——一种专为中国文化背景定制的对话生成模型，该模型融合了认知共情功能。该模型采用三阶段决策流程：情绪与原因识别、上下文理解以及共情反应生成。首先，模型能够识别用户在中文语境下的细微情绪及其潜在原因，为个性化情绪理解奠定基础。接着，它检索语义相似的咨询案例，以提取主题和策略信息，从而构建出具有上下文意识的表示。最后，在多维线索的引导下，模型促使语言模型生成既符合上下文要求又具备专业性的共情回应。在中文心理健康数据集上进行的实验表明，CogEmp在关键评估指标上表现优于现有方法，尤其是在共情能力、可理解性和专业性方面。

papers.title: LiveLongBench: Tackling Long-Context Understanding for Spoken Texts from Live Streams
papers.title_zh: LiveLongBench：应对实时流媒体中口语文本的长时上下文理解问题
papers.authors: Yongxuan Wu, Runyu Chen, Peiyu Liu, Hongjin Qian
papers.abstract: Long-context understanding poses significant challenges in natural language processing, particularly for real-world dialogues characterized by high redundancy and uneven information density. Although large language models (LLMs) achieve impressive results on existing benchmarks, these datasets fail to reflect the complexities of such texts, limiting their applicability to practical scenarios. To bridge this gap, we construct the first spoken long-text dataset, derived from live streams, designed to reflect the redundancy-rich and conversational nature of real-world scenarios. We construct tasks in three categories: retrieval, reasoning, and hybrid tasks. We then evaluate both popular LLMs and specialized methods to assess their ability to understand long contexts in these tasks. Our results show that current methods exhibit strong task-specific preferences and perform poorly on highly redundant inputs, with no single method consistently outperforming others. We propose a new baseline that better handles redundancy in spoken text and achieves strong performance across tasks. Our findings highlight key limitations of current methods and suggest future directions for improving long-context understanding. Finally, our benchmark fills a gap in evaluating long-context spoken language understanding and provides a practical foundation for developing real-world e-commerce systems. The code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/Yarayx/livelongbench.
papers.abstract_zh: 长上下文理解在自然语言处理中面临着重大挑战，尤其是在那些具有高度冗余性和不均匀信息密度的现实世界对话场景中。尽管大语言模型在现有的基准测试中取得了令人印象深刻的成果，但这些数据集未能反映此类文本的复杂性，从而限制了它们在实际场景中的适用性。为了填补这一空白，我们构建了首个基于实时流数据的长文本口语数据集，旨在反映现实世界场景中丰富的冗余性和对话性特征。我们设计了三种任务类型：检索任务、推理任务和混合任务。随后，我们对流行的语言模型和专门的方法进行了评估，以考察它们在这些任务中理解长上下文的能力。我们的结果显示，当前方法存在明显的任务偏好现象，并且在高度冗余的输入上表现不佳，没有任何一种方法能够始终优于其他方法。我们提出了一种新的基线方法，能够更好地处理口语文本中的冗余问题，并在各种任务中表现出强大的性能。我们的研究结果揭示了当前方法的局限性，并为改进长上下文理解提供了方向。最后，我们的基准测试填补了评估长上下文口语理解的空白，为开发现实世界的电子商务系统提供了实用的基础。代码和基准测试可访问于https://github.com/Yarayx/livelongbench。

papers.title: CPC-GRPO: Answer-Free Reinforcement Learning with Cross-Prompt Consensus Rewards
papers.title_zh: CPC-GRPO：无需答案的强化学习，结合跨提示一致性奖励机制
papers.authors: Gyunyeop Kim, Sangwoo Kang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has improved reasoning in language models, but it typically relies on a ground-truth answer or an external verifier, which limits applicability and increases cost. We propose an answer-free training objective that derives rewards solely from the model’s own probabilities by exploiting prompt paraphrases as multiple semantic views of the same intent. For each paraphrase set, we generate candidate responses, rescore each response under the other paraphrased prompts via teacher forcing, and define a cross-prompt consensus reward that serves as a practical internal training signal, favoring responses supported across views rather than those that fit only a single phrasing. We optimize this reward using a policy update with an all-pairs objective and advantage broadcasting across prompt–response pairs. The framework naturally supports prefix-level training, enabling a controllable cost–signal trade-off. Experiments on RobustAlpacaEval and out-of-domain reasoning benchmarks (OpenBookQA, AQuA, HumanEval) show strong in-domain gains and competitive or improved average out-of-domain performance over pre-trained and answer-free training baselines on LLaMA3.2-3B and Qwen3-4B, alongside analyses demonstrating reward–performance alignment and the importance of design choices such as excluding self-view scores and ensembling-based candidates. All experiment code is available at our GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习提升了语言模型的推理能力，但这种方法通常依赖于真实答案或外部验证器，这限制了其应用范围并增加了成本。我们提出了一种无需答案的训练目标，该目标通过利用提示的释义作为同一意图的多种语义视角，仅从模型自身的概率中获取奖励。对于每一组释义，我们生成候选回答，通过教师强制机制在其它释义下重新评分每个回答，并定义一个跨释义的共识奖励，作为实用的内部训练信号，优先选择在不同视角下都得到支持的回答，而不是仅符合单一表述方式的回答。我们通过具有全对目标的策略更新以及跨提示-回答对的优势传播来优化这一奖励。该框架自然支持前缀级训练，从而实现可控的成本与性能之间的权衡。在RobustAlpacaEval和领域外推理基准测试（OpenBookQA、AQuA、HumanEval）上的实验表明，与预训练和无需答案的训练基线相比，我们的方法在LLaMA3.2-3B和Qwen3-4B上取得了显著的领域内提升，并且其领域外性能也表现出竞争力或改进性。相关分析还揭示了奖励与性能之间的对应关系，以及诸如排除自我视角得分和基于集成的方法等设计选择的重要性。所有实验代码均可在我们的GitHub上获取。

papers.title: MASH: Evading Black-Box AI-Generated Text Detectors via Style Humanization
papers.title_zh: MASH：通过风格人工化技术规避由黑盒人工智能生成的文本检测机制
papers.authors: Yongtong Gu, Songze Li, Xia Hu
papers.abstract: The increasing misuse of AI-generated texts (AIGT) has motivated the rapid development of AIGT detection methods. However, the reliability of these detectors remains fragile against adversarial evasions. Existing attack strategies often rely on white-box assumptions or demand prohibitively high computational and interaction costs, rendering them ineffective under practical black-box scenarios. In this paper, we propose Multi-stage Alignment for Style Humanization (MASH), a novel framework that evades black-box detectors based on style transfer. MASH sequentially employs style-injection supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization, and inference-time refinement to shape the distributions of AI-generated texts to resemble those of human-written texts. Experiments across 6 datasets and 5 detectors demonstrate the superior performance of MASH over 11 baseline evaders. Specifically, MASH achieves an average Attack Success Rate (ASR) of 92%, surpassing the strongest baselines by an average of 24%, while maintaining superior linguistic quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能生成文本（AIGT）的滥用日益严重，这促使人们迅速开发各种检测AIGT的方法。然而，这些检测器的可靠性在面对对抗性规避手段时仍然十分脆弱。现有的攻击策略往往依赖于对系统的盲目假设，或者需要极高的计算成本和交互成本，这使得它们在实际情况中难以发挥作用。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“多阶段风格人性化对齐”的新框架MASH。该框架通过分阶段实施风格注入、直接偏好优化以及推理时细化等步骤，来使人工智能生成文本的分布与人类书写的文本相似。通过在6个数据集和5种检测器上进行的实验表明，MASH在11种基线规避技术中表现更为出色。具体来说，MASH的平均攻击成功率为92%，比最强的基线方法高出24%左右，同时还能保持出色的语言质量。

papers.title: MM-Doc-R1: Training Agents for Long Document Visual Question Answering through Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: MM-Doc-R1：通过多轮强化学习来训练适用于长文档视觉问答系统的智能体
papers.authors: Jiahang Lin, Kai Hu, Binghai Wang, Yuhao Zhou, Zhiheng Xi, Honglin Guo, Shichun Liu, Junzhe Wang, Shihan Dou, Enyu Zhou, Hang Yan, Zhenhua Han, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems often struggle with complex multi-hop queries over long documents due to their single-pass retrieval. We introduce MM-Doc-R1, a novel framework that employs an agentic, vision-aware workflow to address long document visual question answering through iterative information discovery and synthesis. To incentivize the information seeking capabilities of our agents, we propose Similarity-based Policy Optimization (SPO), addressing baseline estimation bias in existing multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms like GRPO. Our core insight is that in multi-turn RL, the more semantically similar two trajectories are, the more accurate their shared baseline estimation becomes. Leveraging this, SPO calculates a more precise baseline by similarity-weighted averaging of rewards across multiple trajectories, unlike GRPO which inappropriately applies the initial state’s baseline to all intermediate states. This provides a more stable and accurate learning signal for our agents, leading to superior training performance that surpasses GRPO. Our experiments on the MMLongbench-Doc benchmark show that MM-Doc-R1 outperforms previous baselines by 10.4%. Furthermore, SPO demonstrates superior performance over GRPO, boosting results by 5.0% with Qwen3-8B and 6.1% with Qwen3-4B. These results highlight the effectiveness of our integrated framework and novel training algorithm in advancing the state-of-the-art for complex, long-document visual question answering.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的检索增强生成（RAG）系统在处理长文档中的复杂多跳查询时常常遇到困难，因为它们采用的是单次检索方式。我们提出了MM-Doc-R1这一新型框架，该框架采用一种以智能体为核心的、具备视觉感知能力的工作流程，通过迭代的信息发现与合成来解决长文档视觉问答问题。为了激励智能体的信息检索能力，我们提出了基于相似性的策略优化方法，该方法能够解决现有多轮强化学习算法中存在的基线估计偏差问题，比如GRPO算法存在的问题。我们的核心洞察是：在多轮强化学习中，两条语义相似的路径，其共享的基线估计就会更加准确。利用这一原理，SPO通过跨多个路径的奖励进行相似性加权平均运算，从而计算出更精确的基线，这与GRPO不同，GRPO不恰当地将初始状态的基线应用于所有中间状态。这种方法为智能体提供了更稳定、更准确的训练信号，从而使得训练性能优于GRPO。我们在MMLongbench-Doc基准测试上的实验表明，MM-Doc-R1的性能比以往的任何基线都要高出10.4%。此外，SPO的表现也优于GRPO，在Qwen3-8B模型上提升了5.0%的性能，而在Qwen3-4B模型上则提升了6.1%。这些结果充分证明了我们的集成框架和新型训练算法在提升复杂长文档视觉问答领域技术水平方面的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Multimodal Chemical Structure-Text Coreference in Intellectual Property via Rule-guided Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过规则引导的强化学习实现知识产权领域多模态化学结构-文本共指现象
papers.authors: Hanmeng Zhong, Wentao Wu, Linqing Chen, Peng Zhou
papers.abstract: Navigating biopharmaceutical intellectual property necessitates precisely associating visual chemical structures with their textual referents across lengthy documents. Despite its critical role in drug discovery, this multimodal coreference task remains underexplored. It presents unique challenges, including handling Markush structures and distinguishing the atom-level differences between adjacent structures. To bridge this gap, we define the multimodal Chemical Structure-Text coreference and introduce CheST, the first dataset explicitly designed for the task. Furthermore, to satisfy the strict logical consistency in the task, we propose RULER, a RULE-guided multimodal Reinforcement learning framework built upon an SFT cold start. RULER utilizes rule-driven reward functions operationalizing multidimensional consistencies, acting as a domain-specific “verifier” to obtain the correct domain knowledge. Experimental results demonstrate that RULER achieves a 40% improvement over the strongest baseline–Gemini-2.5-Pro, demonstrating the superior efficacy.
papers.abstract_zh: 在生物制药知识产权领域进行导航时，需要将视觉上的化学结构与其在文本中的对应内容精确关联起来，尤其是在长篇文档中。尽管这一多模态共指任务在药物发现中起着至关重要的作用，但至今仍未被充分研究。它面临着诸多独特的挑战，比如处理Markush结构以及区分相邻结构之间的原子级差异。为了填补这一空白，我们定义了多模态化学结构-文本共指机制，并引入了CheST——首个专为该任务设计的数据集。此外，为了确保任务的严格逻辑一致性，我们提出了RULER框架。该框架基于SFT冷启动策略，采用规则引导的多模态强化学习方法。RULER利用规则驱动的奖励函数来体现多维一致性，从而成为获取正确领域知识的特定领域“验证器”。实验结果表明，RULER相比最强大的基准模型Gemini-2.5-Pro，提升了40%的性能，充分体现了其卓越效果。

papers.title: TheraAgent: Self-Improving Therapeutic Agent for Precise and Comprehensive Treatment Planning
papers.title_zh: TheraAgent：一种能够自我改进的治疗剂，有助于实现精确且全面的治疗规划
papers.authors: Junkai Li, Yunghwei Lai, Tianyi Zhu, Zheng Long Lee, Weizhi Ma, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Formulating a treatment plan is inherently a complex reasoning and refinement task rather than a simple generation problem. However, existing large language models (LLMs) mainly rely on one-shot output without explicit verification, which may result in rough, incomplete, and potentially unsafe treatment plans. To address these limitations, we propose TheraAgent, an agentic framework that replaces one-shot generation with an iterative generate-judge-refine pipeline. By mirroring the actual reasoning process of human experts who iteratively revise treatment plans, our framework progressively transforms coarse and incomplete drafts into precise, comprehensive, and safer therapeutic regimens. To facilitate the critical judge component, we introduce TheraJudge, a treatment-specific evaluation module integrated into the inference loop to enforce clinical standards. Experiments show TheraAgent achieves state-of-the-art results on HealthBench, leading in Accuracy and Completeness. In expert evaluations, it attains an 86% win rate against physicians, with superior Targeting and Harm Control. Moreover, the highly agreement between TheraJudge and HealthBench evaluations confirms the reliability of our framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 制定治疗计划本质上是一项复杂的推理和优化任务，而非简单的生成问题。然而，现有的大语言模型主要依赖于一次性输出，缺乏明确的验证过程，这可能导致治疗计划存在粗糙、不完整且可能不安全的问题。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了TheraAgent这一代理框架，它用迭代式的生成-判断-优化流程取代了一次性生成的方式。通过模仿人类专家的实际推理过程，该框架能够逐步将粗糙和不完整的草案转化为精确、全面且更安全的治疗方案。为了加强判断环节，我们引入了TheraJudge这一针对特定治疗的评估模块，将其整合到推理过程中，以强制执行临床标准。实验表明，TheraAgent在HealthBench上的表现达到了最先进水平，在准确性和完整性方面均表现出色。在专家评估中，它与医生相比有86%的胜率，并且在目标定位和伤害控制方面表现更为出色。此外，TheraJudge与HealthBench评估之间的高度一致性也证明了我们框架的可靠性。

papers.title: LearnAct: Few-Shot Mobile GUI Agent with a Unified Demonstration Benchmark
papers.title_zh: LearnAct：一种基于少样本学习的移动端图形用户界面代理算法，附带统一的演示基准测试
papers.authors: Guangyi Liu, Pengxiang Zhao, Liang Liu, Zhiming Chen, Yuxiang Chai, Yaozhen Liang, WenHao Wang, Siheng Chen, Zhengxi Lu, Shuai Ren, Hao Wang, Shibo He, Yong Liu, Wenchao Meng
papers.abstract: Mobile GUI agents show promise in automating tasks but face significant generalization challenges in long-tail scenarios. While learning from few-shot demonstrations is an emerging solution, its progress is hindered by two critical gaps: the lack of a comprehensive benchmark for systematic evaluation on mobile devices, and the absence of a systematic framework designed to learn from demonstrations in this domain. To address these gaps, we introduce LearnGUI, the first comprehensive benchmark designed for studying demonstration-based learning in mobile agents, comprising 2,252 offline and 101 online tasks. We further develop LearnAct, a modular agent framework engineered to systematically extract, retrieve, and leverage knowledge from visual demonstrations. Extensive evaluations across six backbone models validate our approach: LearnAct achieves dramatic improvements for general-purpose models (e.g., Gemini-2.5-Pro: 38.5%→58.9%) and specialized models alike (e.g., UI-TARS-7B-SFT’s online success rate: 18.1%→32.8%), demonstrating consistent gains across model architectures. Our work provides a robust benchmark and a systematic framework, paving the way for more adaptable and practical mobile agents. Our code and data are publicly available at https://lgy0404.github.io/LearnAct/.
papers.abstract_zh: 移动端图形用户界面代理在自动化任务方面展现出巨大潜力，但在复杂的应用场景中却面临着显著的泛化挑战。虽然从少量样本演示中学习是一种新兴的解决方案，但这一方法的进展受到了两个关键问题的阻碍：缺乏适用于移动设备的全面评估基准，以及缺乏专门用于从该领域中的演示中学习知识的系统框架。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了LearnGUI，这是首个专为研究移动代理基于示范的学习而设计的全面评估基准，包含2,252个离线任务和101个在线任务。我们还开发了LearnAct，这是一个模块化代理框架，旨在系统地提取、检索并利用视觉演示中的知识。通过对六种核心模型进行广泛评估，我们的方法得到了验证：LearnAct在通用模型（例如，Gemini-2.5-Pro：38.5%→58.9%）和专业模型（例如，UI-TARS-7B-SFT的在线成功率：18.1%→32.8%）上都取得了显著改进，表明该方法在不同模型架构下都能保持稳定效果。我们的工作提供了一个可靠的评估基准和系统化的框架，为更灵活、实用的移动代理的发展铺平了道路。我们的代码和数据可以在https://lgy0404.github.io/LearnAct/获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Local Perspective to Global Reasoning: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Zero-Shot Relation Extraction
papers.title_zh: 从局部视角到全局推理：一种用于零样本关系提取的神经符号框架
papers.authors: Kailun Lyu, Fu Zhang, Zehan Li, Jingwei Cheng
papers.abstract: Zero-Shot Relation Extraction (ZSRE) aims to predict unseen relations for given entity pairs in sentences. Existing methods typically operate from a local perspective, predicting the relation for each entity pair (given its corresponding sentence) in isolation. Consequently, they often fail to distinguish between unseen, semantically similar relations, particularly when the sentence phrasing is ambiguous.To address this limitation, we propose G-NSR, a novel ZSRE framework built upon a Global Neuro-Symbolic Reasoner architecture, specifically designed to enable global reasoning across a set of predictions. The key idea is to model the logical relationships among multiple predictions, and perform neuro-symbolic reasoning to ensure logically consistent and more accurate predictions. Specifically, we first introduce Duality Type-Constrained Relation Schemas, which formulate each candidate relation as a pair of complementary positive-negative propositions. These propositions are then synthesized by our designed Neuro-Symbolic Reasoner, which explicitly models their logical interdependencies. By approximating logical rules, the reasoner allows high-confidence predictions to serve as evidence for refining incorrect results, ensuring the final predictions are logically consistent and more accurate. Extensive experiments on widely used datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches and establishes new state-of-the-art results across all evaluation settings. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/G-NSR
papers.abstract_zh: 零样本关系提取（Zero-Shot Relation Extraction，ZSRE）的目标是预测句子中给定实体对之间的未见过的关系。现有的方法通常从局部角度进行推理，单独预测每个实体对之间的关系。因此，它们往往无法区分那些语义上相似但未见过的关系，尤其是在句子表述模糊的情况下。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了G-NSR框架。该框架基于全局神经符号推理器架构构建，旨在实现跨多个预测的全局推理。其核心思想是对多个预测之间的逻辑关系进行建模，并通过神经符号推理来确保预测结果的逻辑一致性和准确性。具体来说，我们首先引入了双值类型约束关系模式，将每个候选关系表述为一对互补的正反命题。然后，通过我们设计的神经符号推理器对这些命题进行综合分析，明确其逻辑依赖关系。通过近似化逻辑规则，推理器能够利用高置信度的预测来修正错误的结果，从而确保最终预测结果的逻辑一致性与准确性。在广泛使用的数据集上进行的实验表明，我们的方法显著优于现有方法，并在所有评估场景中取得了新的最优结果。我们的代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/G-NSR获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DiFRa: A Unified Framework for Harmonizing Semantic Diversity and Factual Consistency in Question-Answer Generation
papers.title_zh: DiFRa：一种统一的框架，用于协调问答生成中的语义多样性与事实一致性问题
papers.authors: Zhenqin Li, ShengYong Ding, Shuangyin Li
papers.abstract: Question-Answer Generation (QAG) is essential for alleviating the cold-start problem in domain-specific large language model (LLM) post-training, where high-quality data is severely scarce.Effective training samples include rich semantic diversity and rigorous factual consistency.Thus, it is necessary to consider the inherent tension between semantic breadth and factual fidelity.However, it is extremely challenging to trade off semantic diversity against factual consistency, in that generalization across the semantic space must be achieved effectively and reliably, and factual integrity must be ensured as well.To address this issue, we propose an effective framework, namely DiFRa, that integrates continuous concept diffusion with discrete knowledge graph constraints to balance semantic diversity and factual consistency.Specifically, the proposed DiFRa models discrete concepts as a continuous latent distribution to sample embeddings that capture rich semantic variations, and constructs a refined knowledge graph as explicit factual constraints.Then, a diversity and consistency aware mechanism is designed to dynamically integrate both embeddings and the knowledge graph for QA pairs generation.Furthermore, we introduce SeFa, which harmonizes semantic entropy and consistency scores to quantify the trade-off between diversity and correctness.Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiFRa consistently outperforms the baseline models, validating its efficacy in reconciling the tension to generate semantically diverse and factually consistent QA pairs. The source code is publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 问题-答案生成（QAG）对于解决特定领域大语言模型在训练后出现的冷启动问题至关重要，因为高质量数据的获取非常困难。有效的训练样本需要具备丰富的语义多样性以及严格的事实一致性。因此，必须考虑语义广度与事实准确性之间的内在矛盾。然而，要在语义多样性与事实准确性之间找到平衡是非常具有挑战性的，因为需要在语义空间中实现有效的泛化能力，同时又要确保事实的完整性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种有效的框架——DiFRa。该框架将连续概念扩散与离散知识图谱约束相结合，以平衡语义多样性和事实准确性。具体来说，DiFRa将离散概念视为一个连续的潜在分布，从而抽取出能够捕捉丰富语义差异的嵌入向量；同时，它还会构建详细的知识图谱作为明确的事实约束条件。此外，我们还设计了一种兼顾多样性和一致性的机制，能够动态整合这些嵌入向量和知识图谱，从而生成适合问答对的问题。另外，我们还引入了SeFa这一方法，它通过协调语义熵和一致性得分来量化多样性与正确性之间的权衡。大量的实验表明，DiFRa在生成语义丰富且事实准确的问题答案方面，始终优于基线模型。其源代码已公开提供。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Geoparsing: Diagram Parsing for Plane and Solid Geometry with a Unified Formal Language
papers.title_zh: 地理解析：适用于平面和立体几何的图表解析方法，采用统一的形式化语言描述
papers.authors: Peijie Wang, Ming-Liang Zhang, Jun Cao, Chao Deng, Dekang Ran, Pi Bu, Hongda Sun, Xuan Zhang, Yingyao Wang, Jun Song, Bo Zheng, Fei Yin, Cheng-Lin Liu
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress but continue to struggle with geometric reasoning, primarily due to the perception bottleneck regarding fine-grained visual elements. While formal languages have aided plane geometry understanding, solid geometry which requires spatial understanding remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we address this challenge by designing a unified formal language that integrates plane and solid geometry, comprehensively covering geometric structures and semantic relations. We construct GDP-29K, a large-scale dataset comprising 20k plane and 9k solid geometry samples collected from diverse real-world sources, each paired with its ground-truth formal description. We propose a training paradigm combining Supervised Fine-Tuning with Reinforcement Learning via Verifiable Rewards, which effectively enforces syntactic correctness and geometric consistency. Experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art parsing performance. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our parsed formal descriptions serve as a critical cognitive scaffold, significantly boosting MLLMs’ capabilities for downstream geometry reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型已经取得了显著的进展，但在几何推理方面仍然存在困难，这主要是由于对细微视觉元素的感知瓶颈问题。虽然形式化语言有助于理解平面几何，但需要空间理解的立体几何却仍然鲜有研究。在本文中，我们通过设计一种统一的形式化语言来应对这一挑战，该语言能够同时涵盖平面几何和立体几何，全面描述几何结构和语义关系。我们构建了GDP-29K大规模数据集，其中包含2万个平面几何样本和9000个立体几何样本，这些样本来自不同的真实世界来源，每个样本都配有相应的形式化描述。我们提出了一种训练方法，结合了监督式微调与通过可验证奖励进行强化学习的方法，这种方法能够有效保证句法正确性和几何一致性。实验表明，我们的方法在解析性能上达到了最先进水平。此外，我们还证明了我们的形式化描述可以作为重要的认知基础，显著提升了多模态语言模型在后续几何推理任务中的能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Memorization: Testing LLM Reasoning on Unseen Theory of Computation Tasks
papers.title_zh: 超越记忆能力：在未见过的计算理论任务上测试大型语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Shlok Shelat, Jay Raval, Souvik Roy, Manas Gaur
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on formal language tasks, yet whether this reflects genuine symbolic reasoning or pattern matching on familiar constructions remains unclear. We introduce a benchmark for deterministic finite automata (DFA) construction from regular languages, comprising factual knowledge questions, seen construction problems from public sources, and two types of unseen problems: hand-crafted instances with multiple interacting constraints and systematically generated problems via Arden’s theorem. Models achieve perfect accuracy on factual questions and 84-90% on seen tasks. However, accuracy drops sharply on unseen problems (by 30-64%), with failures stemming from systematic misinterpretation of language constraints, incorrect handling of Kleene-star semantics, and a failure to preserve global consistency. We evaluate a three-stage hint protocol that enables correction of shallow errors but does not reliably resolve globally inconsistent or structurally flawed automata. Our analysis across multiple prompting strategies (direct, Chain-of-Thought, Tree-of-Thought) reveals that errors persist regardless of prompting approach, exposing a fundamental gap between LLMs’ ability to generate syntactically plausible DFAs and their capacity for semantically correct formal reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在形式语言任务上表现出强大的性能，但这是否反映了真正的符号推理能力，还是对熟悉结构的模式匹配能力，目前仍不清楚。我们提出了一个基准测试，用于评估从正则语言中构建确定性有限自动机的能力。该基准测试包括事实知识问题、来自公开资源的已知结构问题，以及两类未知问题：一种是包含多个相互关联约束条件的手工构造实例，另一种是通过Arden定理系统生成的问题。模型在事实知识问题上达到了完美的准确率，在已知结构问题上的准确率为84%-90%。然而，在未知问题上，准确率大幅下降（下降了30%-64%）。这些错误源于对语言约束的系统性误解、对Kleene-star语义的错误处理，以及未能保持全局一致性。我们测试了一种三阶段提示方案，该方案能够纠正一些简单的错误，但无法可靠地解决全局不一致或结构有缺陷的自动机问题。我们对多种提示策略（直接提示、思维链提示、树状提示）的分析表明，无论采用何种提示方式，错误都会存在，这揭示了LLM在生成语法上合理的确定性有限自动机与进行语义上正确的形式推理能力之间存在的根本差距。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Dialogue Time: Temporal Semantic Memory for Personalized LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 超越对话时间：用于个性化大语言模型智能体的时间语义记忆机制
papers.authors: Miao Su, Yucan Guo, Zhongni Hou, Long Bai, Zixuan Li, Yufei Zhang, Guojun Yin, Wei Lin, Xiaolong Jin, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Memory enables Large Language Model (LLM) agents to perceive, store, and use information from past dialogues, which is essential for personalization. However, existing methods fail to properly model the temporal dimension of memory in two aspects: 1) Temporal inaccuracy: memories are organized by dialogue time rather than their actual occurrence time; 2) Temporal fragmentation: existing methods focus on point-wise memory, losing durative information that captures persistent states and evolving patterns. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Semantic Memory (TSM), a memory framework that models semantic time for point-wise memory and supports the construction and utilization of durative memory. During memory construction, it first builds a semantic timeline rather than a dialogue one. Then, it consolidates temporally continuous and semantically related information into a durative memory. During memory utilization, it incorporates the query’s temporal intent on the semantic timeline, enabling the retrieval of temporally appropriate durative memories and providing time-valid, duration-consistent context to support response generation. Experiments on LongMemEval and LoCoMo show that TSM consistently outperforms existing methods and achieves up to 12.2% absolute improvement in accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.abstract_zh: 记忆功能使得大语言模型（LLM）能够感知、存储并利用过去对话中的信息，这对于个性化处理至关重要。然而，现有的方法在两个方面未能正确模拟记忆的时间维度：1）时间准确性不足：记忆的排序依据的是对话的时间点，而非实际发生的时间；2）时间碎片化：现有方法只关注点对点的记忆，而忽略了能够捕捉持久状态和演变模式的持续时间记忆。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了时间语义记忆框架——TSM。该框架为点对点的记忆建模了语义时间维度，并支持对持续时间记忆的构建与利用。在记忆构建过程中，TSM首先构建一个语义时间线，而非对话时间线。然后，它将时间上连续且语义相关的信息整合为持续时间记忆。在记忆利用过程中，TSM会将查询的时间意图与语义时间线相结合，从而检索出与时间相关的持续时间记忆，并提供时间有效、持续一致的上下文以支持响应生成。在LongMemEval和LoCoMo上的实验表明，TSM的表现始终优于现有方法，其准确率提升了12.2%，充分证明了所提出方法的有效性。

papers.title: LongCLI-Bench: A Preliminary Benchmark and Study for Long-horizon Agentic Programming in Command-Line Interfaces
papers.title_zh: LongCLI-Bench：关于在命令行界面进行长期代理编程的初步测试与研究
papers.authors: Yukang Feng, Jianwen Sun, Zelai Yang, Jiaxin Ai, Chuanhao Li, Zizhen Li, Fanrui Zhang, Kang He, Rui Ma, Jifan Lin, Jie Sun, Yang Xiao, Sizhuo Zhou, Wenxiao Wu, Yiming Liu, Pengfei Liu, Shenglin Zhang, Kaipeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in AI-assisted programming have empowered agents to execute complex workflows via command-line interfaces, however, existing benchmarks are limited by short task horizons, data contamination from GitHub scraping, and a lack of fine-grained evaluation metrics, fail to rigorously evaluate the long-horizon planning and execution capabilities essential for realistic software engineering. To address these gaps, we introduce LongCLI-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate agentic capabilities across long-horizon, realistic, sequential engineering tasks. We curated 20 high-quality, long-horizon tasks from over 1,000 computer science assignments and real-world workflows, covering four engineering categories: from scratch, feature addition, bug fixing, and refactoring. LongCLI-Bench employs a dual-set testing protocol, which measures requirement fulfillment (fail(→)pass) and regression avoidance (pass(→)pass), and incorporates step-level scoring to pinpoint execution failures. Extensive experiments reveal that even state-of-the-art agents achieve pass rates below 20% in LongCLI-Bench. Step-level analysis further indicates that the majority of tasks stall at less than 30% completion, highlighting that critical failures often occur in the early stages. Although self-correction offers marginal gains, human-agent collaboration through plan injection and interactive guidance yields significantly higher improvements. These results highlight that future research must emphasize the development of synergistic human-agent workflows alongside advances in agents’ planning and execution capabilities to overcome key challenges in long-horizon task performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 在人工智能辅助编程领域的最新进展使得智能体能够通过命令行界面执行复杂的工作流程。然而，现有的评估基准存在诸多局限性：任务持续时间较短、数据受到GitHub数据爬取的影响，且缺乏精细化的评估指标，这些因素都难以全面评估智能体在长周期规划与执行方面的能力，而这些能力正是现实软件工程所不可或缺的。为了弥补这些不足，我们推出了LongCLI-Bench这一综合性评估基准，旨在评估智能体在长周期、现实性强的连续工程任务中的能力。我们从1000多个计算机科学作业和真实工作流程中精选了20个高质量的、具有长周期特性的任务，涵盖了四个工程领域：从零开始构建、添加功能、修复错误以及重构代码。LongCLI-Bench采用了双套测试方案，既评估任务是否满足要求（失败→通过），也评估是否避免了回归问题（通过→通过），同时采用步骤级评分方式来精准定位执行失败点。大量实验表明，即使是最先进的智能体在LongCLI-Bench中的通过率也低于20%。进一步分析发现，大多数任务在不到30%完成度时就会停滞，这说明关键故障往往发生在早期阶段。虽然自我修复能带来一定的改进效果，但通过与人类智能体协作进行计划注入和互动指导，能够取得显著的提升。这些结果表明，未来的研究必须注重开发高效的人机协同工作模式，同时推进智能体的规划与执行能力的提升，以克服长周期任务执行中的关键挑战。

papers.title: Cognitive-Uncertainty Guided Knowledge Distillation for Accurate Classification of Student Misconceptions
papers.title_zh: 基于认知不确定性的知识蒸馏方法，用于准确识别学生的误解
papers.authors: Qirui Liu, Hao Chen, Weijie Shi, Jiajie Xu, Jia Zhu
papers.abstract: Accurately identifying student misconceptions is crucial for personalized education but faces three challenges: (1) data scarcity with long-tail distribution, where authentic student reasoning is difficult to synthesize; (2) fuzzy boundaries between error categories with high annotation noise; (3) deployment paradox—large models overlook unconventional approaches due to pretraining bias and cannot be deployed on edge, while small models overfit to noise. Unlike traditional methods that increase diversity through large-scale data synthesis, we propose a two-stage knowledge distillation framework that mines high-value samples from existing data. The first stage performs standard distillation to transfer task capabilities. The second stage introduces a dual-layer marginal selection mechanism based on cognitive uncertainty, identifying four types of critical samples based on teacher model uncertainty and confidence differences. For different data subsets, we design difficulty-adaptive mechanism to balance hard/soft label contributions, enabling student models to inherit inter-class relationships from teacher soft labels while distinguishing ambiguous error types. Experiments show that with augmented training on only 10.30% of filtered samples, we achieve MAP@3 of 0.9585 (+17.8%) on the MAP-Charting dataset, and using only a 4B parameter model, we attain 84.38% accuracy on cross-topic tests of middle school algebra misconception benchmarks, significantly outperforming sota LLM (67.73%) and standard fine-tuned 72B models (81.25%). Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/acl2026_map-5847/.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确识别学生的错误观念对于个性化教育至关重要，但这一过程面临三大挑战：(1) 数据稀缺且分布呈长尾状，难以综合真实的学生推理过程；(2) 错误类别之间的界限模糊，且注释噪声较大；(3) 模型部署的悖论——大型模型因预训练偏见而忽视非传统方法，无法在边缘设备上运行；而小型模型则容易过度拟合噪声。与通过大规模数据合成来增加多样性的传统方法不同，我们提出了一种两阶段知识蒸馏框架，该框架从现有数据中挖掘出具有价值的高价值样本。第一阶段采用标准蒸馏技术来传递任务能力。第二阶段则引入基于认知不确定性的双层边缘选择机制，根据教师模型的不确定性和置信度差异，识别出四种类型的关键样本。针对不同的数据子集，我们设计了自适应难度机制，以平衡硬标签和软标签的贡献，使学生模型能够继承教师软标签所传达的类别间关系，同时区分各种模糊的错误类型。实验表明，仅使用筛选后 10.30% 的样本进行增强训练，即在 MAP-Charting 数据集上实现 0.9585 的 MAP@3（提升 17.8%）；仅使用 4B 参数模型，在初中代数错误观念跨主题测试中达到 84.38% 的准确率，明显优于最先进大语言模型（67.73%）及标准微调的 72B 模型（81.25%）。我们的代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/acl2026_map-5847/。

papers.title: Beyond Black-Box Interventions: Latent Probing for Faithful Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 超越黑箱干预：利用潜在探测技术实现忠实检索增强生成
papers.authors: Linfeng Gao, Qinggang Zhang, Baolong Bi, Bo Zeng, Zheng Yuan, Zerui Chen, Zhimin Wei, Shenghua Liu, Linlong Xu, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Jinsong Su
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems often fail to maintain contextual faithfulness, generating responses that conflict with the provided context. Existing methods attempt to improve faithfulness through external interventions, such as specialized prompting, decoding-based calibration, or preference optimization. However, since these approaches treat the LLM as a black box, they lack a reliable mechanism to assess how these conflicts occur. Consequently, they tend to be brittle, data-intensive, and agnostic to the model’s internal reasoning process. In this paper, we move beyond black-box interventions to analyze the model’s internal reasoning process. We discover that conflicting and aligned knowledge states are linearly separable in the model’s latent space, and contextual noise systematically increases the entropy of these representations. Based on these findings, we propose ProbeRAG, a novel framework for faithful RAG that operates in three stages: (i) fine-grained knowledge pruning to filter irrelevant context, (ii) latent conflict probing to identify hard conflicts in the model’s latent space, and (iii) conflict-aware attention to modulate attention heads toward faithful context integration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ProbeRAG substantially improves both accuracy and contextual faithfulness. The related resources are available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/ProbeRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统往往无法保持上下文的忠实性，导致生成的响应与提供的上下文相矛盾。现有的方法试图通过外部干预来提高忠实度，例如使用专门的提示、基于解码的校准或偏好优化。然而，由于这些方法将大语言模型视为一个黑箱，因此它们缺乏一种可靠的机制来评估这些冲突是如何产生的。因此，这些方法往往具有脆弱性、需要大量数据支持，并且对模型的内部推理过程不敏感。在本文中，我们超越了黑箱干预的方法，分析了模型的内部推理过程。我们发现，模型中相互矛盾的知识状态与一致的知识状态在潜在空间中是可以线性分离的，而上下文噪声会系统性地增加这些表示的熵。基于这些发现，我们提出了ProbeRAG这一新型框架，该框架分为三个阶段运作：(i) 细粒度知识修剪，以过滤无关的上下文；(ii) 潜在冲突探测，以识别模型潜在空间中的严重冲突；(iii) 冲突感知注意力机制，以调整注意力机制，使其更加倾向于忠实于上下文的整合。大量的实验表明，ProbeRAG在准确性和上下文忠实性方面都有显著提升。相关资源可访问https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/ProbeRAG。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FalconCopilot: Empowering LLMs Towards Integrated Human-Machine Systems for Aviation Autonomy
papers.title_zh: FalconCopilot：助力大型语言模型发展出集成人机一体的系统，以实现航空领域的自主化应用
papers.authors: Jingyuan Yan, Qingchen Liu, Qichao Ma, Jiahu Qin
papers.abstract: Complex flight tasks demand both intricate, long-horizon decision-making and precise operations, which imposes immense cognitive, knowledge and experience demands for pilots and highlights the need for advanced copilot systems. While Large Language Models (LLMs) bring powerful potential to this area, a comprehensive LLM-based copilot system—one that addresses deficiencies in task-level adaptability and fine-grained decision support while integrating with a high-fidelity environment—is critically lacking. To address this gap, we present FalconCopilot, pioneering the first such comprehensive system, composed of two parts: 1) Textual DCS, an interface built upon Digital Combat Simulator (DCS) World that unifies multi-modal cockpit data and piloting knowledge into a stable semantic interface for LLMs. Building on this interface, we introduce 2) FalconAgent, an LLM-powered copilot agent that performs optimized task planning, incorporating capabilities for multi-crew task allocation and procedural pruning. Our built-in human-AI interaction is grounded by a bidirectional feedback loop of runtime verification and human correction. In human-in-the-loop experiment, FalconCopilot shortens task completion time while attaining a level of performance approaching that of a human instructor.
papers.abstract_zh: 复杂的飞行任务需要复杂的长期决策以及精确的操作执行，这对飞行员的认知能力、知识水平以及经验要求都极高，因此迫切需要先进的副驾驶系统。虽然大语言模型在这方面具有巨大的潜力，但目前仍缺乏一种能够克服任务级适应性不足和精细决策支持不足问题的综合性基于语言模型的副驾驶系统，同时又能与高保真环境无缝集成。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了FalconCopilot——首个这样的综合性系统。该系统由两部分组成：1）Textual DCS，这是一个建立在数字战斗模拟器基础上的接口，能够将多种模态的驾驶舱数据和驾驶知识整合为稳定的语义接口，供语言模型使用。在此基础上，我们又开发了2）FalconAgent——一个由语言模型驱动的副驾驶代理，它能够进行优化的任务规划，并具备多机组任务分配和程序剪枝的能力。我们内置的人机交互机制通过双向反馈回路来实现运行时的验证和人类的修正。在人工参与实验的情况下，FalconCopilot能够缩短任务完成时间，其性能水平甚至接近人类教官的水平。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Accelerating Training of Autoregressive Video Generation Models via Local Optimization with Representation Continuity
papers.title_zh: 通过局部优化和表示连续性技术，加速自回归视频生成模型的训练过程
papers.authors: Yucheng Zhou, Jianbing Shen
papers.abstract: Autoregressive models have shown superior performance and efficiency in image generation, but remain constrained by high computational costs and prolonged training times in video generation. In this study, we explore methods to accelerate training for autoregressive video generation models through empirical analyses. Our results reveal that while training on fewer video frames significantly reduces training time, it also exacerbates error accumulation and introduces inconsistencies in the generated videos. To address these issues, we propose a Local Optimization (Local Opt.) method, which optimizes tokens within localized windows while leveraging contextual information to reduce error propagation. Inspired by Lipschitz continuity, we propose a Representation Continuity (ReCo) strategy to improve the consistency of generated videos. ReCo utilizes continuity loss to constrain representation changes, improving model robustness and reducing error accumulation. Extensive experiments on four class-to-video datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance to the baseline while halving the training cost without sacrificing quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 自回归模型在图像生成方面表现出卓越的性能与效率，但在视频生成过程中却受到高昂的计算成本以及漫长的训练时间的限制。在本研究中，我们通过实证分析探索了加速自回归视频生成模型训练的方法。研究结果表明，虽然使用较少的视频帧进行训练可以显著缩短训练时间，但也会加剧错误的累积，并导致生成的视频出现不一致性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种局部优化方法。该方法在局部窗口内对标记进行优化，同时利用上下文信息来减少错误的传播。受Lipschitz连续性思想的启发，我们提出了一种表示连续性策略，以提升生成视频的一致性。ReCo策略通过引入连续性损失来约束表示的变化，从而增强模型的鲁棒性并减少错误的累积。在四个类别到视频的数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在保持高质量的同时，能够将训练成本降低一半，且性能优于基线方法。

papers.title: RouteRAG: Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation from Text and Graph via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: RouteRAG：通过强化学习实现从文本和图中高效提取信息并生成新内容的方法
papers.authors: Yucan Guo, Miao Su, Saiping Guan, Zihao Sun, Xiaolong Jin, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) integrates non-parametric knowledge into Large Language Models (LLMs), typically from unstructured texts and structured graphs. While recent progress has advanced text-based RAG to multi-turn reasoning through Reinforcement Learning (RL), extending these advances to hybrid retrieval introduces additional challenges. Existing graph-based or hybrid systems typically depend on fixed or handcrafted retrieval pipelines, lacking the ability to integrate supplementary evidence as reasoning unfolds. Besides, while graph evidence provides relational structures crucial for multi-hop reasoning, it is substantially more expensive to retrieve. To address these limitations, we introduce RouteRAG, an RL-based framework that enables LLMs to perform multi-turn and adaptive graph-text hybrid RAG. RouteRAG jointly optimizes the entire generation process via RL, allowing the model to learn when to reason, what to retrieve from either texts or graphs, and when to produce final answers, all within a unified generation policy. To guide this learning process, we design a two-stage training framework that accounts for both task outcome and retrieval efficiency, enabling the model to exploit hybrid evidence while avoiding unnecessary retrieval overhead. Experimental results across five question answering benchmarks demonstrate that RouteRAG significantly outperforms existing RAG baselines, highlighting the benefits of end-to-end RL in supporting adaptive and efficient retrieval for complex reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术将非参数化知识整合到大语言模型中，这些知识通常来自非结构化文本和结构化图表。虽然近期的研究已经通过强化学习技术将基于文本的RAG提升到了多轮推理的水平，但将这些技术应用到混合检索中则带来了额外的挑战。现有的基于图或混合系统的解决方案通常依赖于固定或手工构建的检索流程，缺乏在推理过程中整合补充证据的能力。此外，尽管图表证据为多跳推理提供了重要的关系结构，但其检索成本却要高得多。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了RouteRAG框架——一个基于强化学习的框架，它能够让大语言模型执行多轮且自适应的图-文本混合RAG任务。RouteRAG通过强化学习来优化整个生成过程，使模型能够学会何时进行推理、从文本或图表中提取哪些信息，以及何时生成最终答案，所有这些都在一个统一的生成策略下进行。为了引导这一学习过程，我们设计了一个两阶段训练框架，该框架同时考虑了任务结果和检索效率，从而让模型能够在利用混合证据的同时避免不必要的检索开销。在五个问答基准测试中的实验结果表明，RouteRAG显著优于现有的RAG基线算法，这充分证明了端到端强化学习在支持复杂推理过程中的自适应和高效检索方面的优势。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HORIZON: A Benchmark for In-the-wild User Behaviour Modeling
papers.title_zh: 视野：用于模拟真实环境中用户行为的基准模型
papers.authors: Arnav Goel, Pranjal A Chitale, Bhawna Paliwal, Bishal Santra, Amit Sharma
papers.abstract: User behavior in the real world is diverse, cross-domain, and spans long time horizons. Existing user modeling benchmarks however remain narrow, focusing mainly on short sessions and next-item prediction within a single domain. Such limitations hinder progress toward robust and generalizable user models. We present HORIZON, a new benchmark that reformulates user modeling along three axes i.e. dataset, task, and evaluation. Built from a large-scale, cross-domain reformulation of Amazon Reviews, HORIZON covers 54M users and 35M items, enabling both pretraining and realistic evaluation of models in heterogeneous environments. Unlike prior benchmarks, it challenges models to generalize across domains, users, and time, moving beyond standard missing-positive prediction in the same domain. We propose new tasks and evaluation setups that better reflect real-world deployment scenarios. These include temporal generalization, sequence-length variation, and modeling unseen users, with metrics designed to assess general user behavior understanding rather than isolated next-item prediction. We benchmark popular sequential recommendation architectures alongside LLM-based baselines that leverage long-term interaction histories. Our results highlight the gap between current methods and the demands of real-world user modeling, while establishing HORIZON as a foundation for research on temporally robust, cross-domain, and general-purpose user models.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中，用户的行为是多样化、跨领域的，并且持续时间很长。然而，现有的用户建模基准测试仍然较为狭隘，主要集中在短会话和单一领域内的下一个物品预测上。这些限制阻碍了我们构建稳健且可泛化的用户模型的进程。我们提出了HORIZON这一新的基准测试，它从三个维度对用户建模进行了重新定义：数据集、任务和评估方式。该基准测试基于大规模、跨领域的亚马逊评论数据构建，涵盖了5400万用户和3500万物品，使得模型能够在异构环境中进行预训练和真实评估。与之前的基准测试不同，HORIZON要求模型能够跨领域、跨用户以及跨越时间进行泛化，而不仅仅是针对同一领域中的缺失阳性预测问题。我们提出了新的任务和评估方案，以更好地反映现实世界中的部署场景。这些方案包括时间上的泛化能力、序列长度的变化性，以及对未见用户的建模能力。我们使用的指标旨在评估用户对行为的整体理解能力，而不仅仅是孤立的下一个物品预测能力。我们通过基准测试来比较流行的序列推荐架构与基于大语言模型的基线方法，后者利用了长期的互动历史数据。我们的结果凸显了当前方法与现实世界用户建模需求之间的差距，同时使HORIZON成为研究具有时间鲁棒性、跨领域通用性的用户模型的基础。

papers.title: Two-Stage Parameter Alignment for Multi-LoRA Merging in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中的多LoRA合并问题——双阶段参数对齐方法
papers.authors: Zijian Li, Xiachong Feng, Weitao Ma, Yichong Huang, Xiaocheng Feng, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Merging a large number of low-rank adaptations (LoRAs) is a key technology for enhancing the integration and deployment efficiency of large language models (LLMs). However, current general model merging methods are prone to “parameter interference” problem, and this issue is especially pronounced when merging high-rank LoRAs, where parameter conflicts tend to be more severe. While the classical rotation alignment approach can enhance robustness, it is difficult to apply due to incompatibility with the LoRA structure and its high computational complexity. To address these challenges, we propose a novel two-stage parameter alignment (TSPA) framework. TSPA is designed from the perspective of the LoRA architecture, overcoming the limitations of existing methods and reducing the computational complexity from quadratic to linear. We conduct experiments on Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks using models such as Llama-3-8B. The results show that the two-stage design of TSPA achieves a balance between task capabilities and general knowledge. It exhibits greater robustness than other methods in high-rank and high-interference scenarios, while effectively preserving fine-grained functions.
papers.abstract_zh: 合并大量低秩适应器（LoRAs）是提升大语言模型（LLMs）集成和部署效率的关键技术。然而，当前通用的模型合并方法容易出现“参数干扰”问题，尤其是在合并高秩LoRAs时，参数冲突更为严重。虽然传统的旋转对齐方法可以提高鲁棒性，但由于与LoRA结构不兼容以及计算复杂度较高，这种方法难以应用。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段参数对齐框架——TSPA。该框架从LoRA架构的角度出发设计，克服了现有方法的局限性，并将计算复杂度从二次方降低到线性。我们在自然语言处理任务中使用了Llama-3-8B等模型进行了实验验证。结果表明，TSPA的两阶段设计在任务能力和通用知识之间实现了平衡。在高秩和高干扰场景下，TSPA表现出比其他方法更高的鲁棒性，同时还能有效保留细粒度功能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
