papers.title: The Agent’s First Day: Benchmarking Learning, Exploration, and Scheduling in the Workplace Scenarios
papers.title_zh: 代理人的第一天：在职场场景中学习、探索与安排工作的比较研究
papers.authors: Daocheng Fu, Jianbiao Mei, Rong Wu, Xuemeng Yang, Jia Xu, Ding Wang, Pinlong Cai, Yong Liu, Licheng Wen, Botian Shi
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has advanced workflow automation; however, existing research mainly targets performance upper bounds in static environments, overlooking robustness for stochastic real-world deployment. We identify three key challenges: dynamic task scheduling, active exploration under uncertainty, and continuous learning from experience. To bridge this gap, we introduce TraineeBench, a dynamic evaluation environment that simulates a “trainee” agent continuously exploring a novel setting. Unlike traditional benchmarks, TraineeBench evaluates agents along three dimensions: (1) context-aware scheduling for streaming tasks with varying priorities; (2) prudent information acquisition to reduce hallucination via active exploration; and (3) continuous evolution by distilling generalized strategies from rule-based, dynamically generated tasks. Experiments show that cutting-edge agents have significant deficiencies in dynamic environments, especially in active exploration and continual learning. Our work establishes a framework for assessing agent reliability, shifting evaluation from static tests to realistic, production-oriented scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型的快速发展推动了工作流程自动化进程。然而，现有的研究主要集中在静态环境下的性能上限分析上，而忽视了在随机现实环境中的鲁棒性问题。我们识别出三个主要挑战：动态任务调度、在不确定性下的主动探索以及从经验中持续学习。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了TraineeBench这一动态评估环境，该环境模拟了一个不断探索新环境的“训练者”智能体。与传统的基准测试不同，TraineeBench从三个维度来评估智能体的表现：(1)针对具有不同优先级的数据流任务进行上下文感知的调度；(2)通过主动探索来减少信息获取过程中的幻觉现象；(3)通过从基于规则的、动态生成的任务中提取通用策略来实现持续的进化。实验表明，先进的智能体在动态环境中存在显著缺陷，尤其是在主动探索和持续学习方面。我们的工作建立了一个评估智能体可靠性的框架，将评估从静态测试转向了真实、面向生产的场景。

papers.title: PrefIx: Understand and Adapt to User Preference in Human-Agent Interaction
papers.title_zh: 前提：理解并适应人类与智能体交互中的用户偏好
papers.authors: Jialin Li, Zhenhao Chen, Hanjun Luo, Hanan Salam
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents can complete tasks correctly yet still frustrate users through poor interaction patterns, such as excessive confirmations, opaque reasoning, or misaligned pacing. Current benchmarks evaluate task accuracy but overlook how agents interact: whether they infer preferences from implicit cues, adapt dynamically, or maintain fine-grained interaction quality. We introduce , a configurable environment that evaluates both what agents accomplish and how they interact. Central to is the Interaction-as-a-Tool (IaaT) paradigm, which treats interaction behaviors as structured tool calls, unifying them with existing evaluation frameworks. We define 31 preference settings across 14 attributes and formalize user experience (UX) as a core metric alongside task accuracy. A composite LLM-as-a-Judge mechanism across seven UX dimensions achieves strong aggregate reliability (ICC > 0.79), high internal consistency (\alpha = 0.943), and human correlation (\rho = 0.52-0.78). Preference-aware agents show 7.6% average UX improvement and 18.5% gain in preference alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体能够正确地完成任务，但由于交互方式不佳，仍然会让用户感到沮丧。这些问题包括过度确认、不透明的推理过程，或者节奏失调。目前的评估标准只关注任务的准确性，而忽略了智能体的交互方式：它们是从隐式线索中推断用户偏好、是否能够动态调整策略，还是能够保持精细化的交互质量。我们提出了一种可配置的环境，该环境可以同时评估智能体的完成任务能力以及它们的交互方式。该环境的核心思想是“交互作为工具”的理念，它将交互行为视为结构化的工具调用，从而将其与现有的评估框架相结合。我们定义了31种偏好设置，涵盖了14个属性；同时，我们将用户体验作为与任务准确性并列的核心指标。通过一种结合了七个用户体验维度的综合评估机制，我们能够获得较高的整体可靠性（ICC > 0.79）、较高的内部一致性（α = 0.943）以及较高的人类相关性（ρ = 0.52-0.78）。具有偏好感知能力的智能体在用户体验方面平均提升了7.6%，在偏好对齐方面则提升了18.5%。

papers.title: How Do Answer Tokens Read Reasoning Traces? Self-Reading Patterns in Thinking LLMs for Quantitative Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 回答令牌如何读取推理轨迹？定量推理中大型语言模型中的自我阅读模式
papers.authors: Haoyang Chen, Yi Liu, Jianzhi Shao, Tao Zhang, Chengfu Huo, Wei Hu
papers.abstract: Thinking LLMs produce reasoning traces before answering. Prior activation steering work mainly targets on shaping these traces. It remains less understood how answer tokens actually read and integrate the reasoning to produce reliable outcomes. Focusing on quantitative reasoning, we analyze the answer-to-reasoning attention and observe a benign self-reading pattern aligned with correctness, characterized by a forward drift of the reading focus along the reasoning trace and a persistent concentration on key semantic anchors, whereas incorrect solutions exhibit diffuse and irregular attention pattern. We interpret this as internal certainty during answer decoding, where the model commits to a viable solution branch and integrates key evidence. Following this, we propose a training-free steering method driven by Self-Reading Quality (SRQ) scores combining geometric metrics for process control with semantic metrics for content monitoring. SRQ selects data to build steering vectors that guide inference toward benign self-reading and away from uncertain and disorganized reading. Experiments show that our method yields consistent accuracy gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究表明，大语言模型在回答问题之前会生成推理轨迹。之前的激活引导技术主要致力于塑造这些推理轨迹。然而，关于答案信息如何读取并整合推理过程以产生可靠的结果，目前仍缺乏深入的理解。在定量推理方面，我们分析了答案与推理之间的注意力分配情况，发现正确的解决方案表现出一种与正确性相一致的良性自我阅读模式：阅读焦点沿着推理轨迹向前移动，同时持续关注关键的语义锚点；而错误的解决方案则表现出分散且不规则的注意力分布模式。我们认为，这种分布模式反映了模型在解码答案时的内部确定性——模型会选择一个可行的解决方案分支，并整合关键证据。在此基础上，我们提出了一种无需训练的引导方法，该方法基于“自我阅读质量”指标来进行数据筛选，结合几何度量用于过程控制，以及语义度量用于内容监控。通过这种方法，我们可以筛选出能够引导模型进行良性自我阅读的数据，避免选择不确定或混乱的阅读路径。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够带来持续的准确性提升。

papers.title: MENTOR: Efficient Autoregressive Image Generation with Balanced Multimodal Control
papers.title_zh: 导师：高效的自回归图像生成技术，结合平衡的多模态控制机制
papers.authors: Haozhe Zhao, Zefan Cai, Shuzheng Si, Liang Chen, Jiuxiang Gu, Wen Xiao, Minjia Zhang, Junjie Hu
papers.abstract: Recent text-to-image models achieve impressive visual quality but still face challenges in precise controllability, balancing multimodal inputs, and high training cost for multimodal image generation. To address these limitations, we propose MENTOR, an autoregressive (AR) framework with a two-stage training paradigm for controllable multimodal image generation: (1) a multimodal alignment stage that establishes robust pixel and semantic-level alignment between inputs and generated tokens, followed by (2) a multimodal instruction tuning stage that balance model’s integration of multimodal inputs and enhance generation controllability. Extensive experiments on DreamBench++ and DreamBench demonstrate that, despite modest model size and training resources, achieves a strong balance between textual and visual guidance for controllable image generation, delivering competitive performance at significantly lower computational cost compared to leading baselines. Moreover, our approach attains superior image reconstruction fidelity, broad adaptability across different tasks, and training efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的文本生成图像模型已经取得了令人印象深刻的视觉质量，但在精确控制、多模态输入的平衡以及多模态图像生成的训练成本方面仍然存在挑战。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了MENTOR框架。该框架采用两阶段训练范式，以实现可控的多模态图像生成：(1) 多模态对齐阶段，建立输入与生成token之间的稳健像素级和语义级对齐；(2) 多模态指令调整阶段，平衡模型的多模态输入整合能力，同时提升生成控制的精准度。在DreamBench++和DreamBench上的广泛实验表明，尽管模型规模和训练资源有限，该框架仍能实现文本与视觉指导之间的良好平衡，从而在显著降低计算成本的情况下，提供与领先基线模型相当的性能。此外，我们的方法还具备更高的图像重建精度、更强的任务适应性以及更高效的训练效率。

papers.title: Better and Worse with Scale: How Contextual Entrainment Diverges with Model Size
papers.title_zh: 随着规模的增加，情况会变得更糟或更好：情境同步效应如何随模型规模的变化而发生变化
papers.authors: Dikshant Kukreja, Kshitij Sah, Gautam Gupta, Avinash Anand, Rajiv Ratn Shah, Zhengkui Wang, Aik Beng Ng, Erik Cambria
papers.abstract: Larger language models become simultaneously better and worse at handling contextual information—better at ignoring false claims, worse at ignoring irrelevant tokens. We formalize this apparent paradox through the first scaling laws for contextual entrainment, the tendency of models to favor tokens that appeared in context regardless of relevance. Analyzing the Cerebras-GPT (111M–13B) and Pythia (14M–12B) model families, we find entrainment follows predictable power-law scaling, but with opposite trends depending on context type: semantic contexts show decreasing entrainment with scale, while non-semantic contexts show increasing entrainment. Concretely, the largest models are four times more resistant to counterfactual misinformation than the smallest, yet simultaneously twice as prone to copying arbitrary tokens. These diverging trends, which replicate across model families, suggest that semantic filtering and mechanical copying are functionally distinct behaviors that scale in opposition. These opposing trends suggest that scaling alone does not resolve context sensitivity—it reshapes it.
papers.abstract_zh: 较大的语言模型在处理上下文信息方面，既表现出优势也存在劣势——在忽略虚假信息方面表现更好，但在忽略无关信息方面则表现较差。我们通过首个关于上下文关联性的缩放定律来形式化这一看似矛盾的现象：即模型倾向于偏好那些出现在上下文中的信息，而无论这些信息是否相关。通过分析Cerebras-GPT（111M–13B）和Pythia（14M–12B）模型家族，我们发现上下文关联性遵循可预测的幂律缩放规律，但不同上下文类型下呈现相反的趋势：语义上下文的关联性随规模增加而减少，而非语义上下文的关联性则随规模增加而增加。具体来说，最大的模型对反事实错误信息的抵抗能力是最小的模型的四倍，但同时它们也更容易复制任意信息。这些不同的趋势在不同模型家族中都有体现，这表明语义过滤和机械复制是两种截然不同的行为，且这两种行为的缩放规律是相反的。这些相反的趋势表明，单纯的缩放并不能解决上下文敏感性的问题——它只是改变了这种敏感性的表现形式而已。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Semantic Bootstrapping for Interpretable Text Classification with Tsetlin Machines
papers.title_zh: 基于LLM引导的语义引导法，用于实现可解释的文本分类——结合Tsetlin机器技术
papers.authors: Jiechao Gao, Rohan Kumar Yadav, Yuangang Li, Yuandong Pan, Jie Wang, Ying Liu, Michael Lepech
papers.abstract: Pretrained language models (PLMs) like BERT provide strong semantic representations but are costly and opaque, while symbolic models such as the Tsetlin Machine (TM) offer transparency but lack semantic generalization. We propose a semantic bootstrapping framework that transfers LLM knowledge into symbolic form, combining interpretability with semantic capacity. Given a class label, an LLM generates sub-intents that guide synthetic data creation through a three-stage curriculum (seed, core, enriched), expanding semantic diversity. A Non-Negated TM (NTM) learns from these examples to extract high-confidence literals as interpretable semantic cues. Injecting these cues into real data enables a TM to align clause logic with LLM-inferred semantics. Our method requires no embeddings or runtime LLM calls, yet equips symbolic models with pretrained semantic priors. Across multiple text classification tasks, it improves interpretability and accuracy over vanilla TM, achieving performance comparable to BERT while remaining fully symbolic and efficient.
papers.abstract_zh: 预训练的语言模型（如BERT）能够提供强大的语义表示，但成本较高且不够透明。而像Tsetlin Machine这样的符号模型则具有透明度，但缺乏语义泛化能力。我们提出了一种语义引导框架，可以将大语言模型的知识转化为符号形式，从而同时实现可解释性与语义处理能力。给定一个类别标签，大语言模型会生成子意图，通过三个阶段的学习过程（基础阶段、核心阶段、扩展阶段）来生成合成数据，从而扩大语义的多样性。非否定式符号模型则从这些示例中学习，提取出高可信度的字面信息作为可解释的语义线索。将这些线索注入真实数据中，可以使符号模型与大语言模型推断出的语义保持一致。我们的方法不需要嵌入或运行大语言模型，但却能够为符号模型提供预训练的语义先验知识。在多个文本分类任务中，我们的方法比传统的符号模型更能提高可解释性和准确性，其性能可与BERT相媲美，同时保持了完全的符号化和高效性。

papers.title: Evaluating the Impact of Reviewer Guideline Design on LLM-Based Automated Peer Review
papers.title_zh: 评估评审指南设计对基于大语言模型的自动化同行评审效果的影响
papers.authors: Haowen Li, Yoichi Ishibashi, Masafumi Oyamada
papers.abstract: Peer review is an essential process in scientific research, yet the growing workload has made its automation increasingly necessary. In this study, we analyze how different types of reviewer guidelines, such as official conference guidelines and reviewer-imitating ones distilled from high-quality human reviews, affect automated peer review. Our experiments show that official conference guidelines produce review results most consistent with human judgments, suggesting that evaluation criteria refined through conference practice serve as effective guidance for automated reviewing as well. In contrast, reviewer-imitating guidelines, especially those enforcing strict rubric-style scoring, consistently degraded automated review performance, highlighting the importance of allowing subjective and holistic scoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 同行评审是科学研究中不可或缺的过程，然而日益增加的评审工作量使得自动化评审变得愈发必要。在本研究中，我们分析了不同类型的评审指南对自动化同行评审的影响，比如官方会议指南以及从高质量人类评审中提炼出的模拟评审指南。实验结果表明，官方会议指南所产生的评审结果与人类判断最为一致，这表明通过会议实践完善的评估标准也能为自动化评审提供有效的指导。相比之下，那些采用严格评分标准的模拟评审指南则明显降低了自动化评审的效果，这凸显了允许采用主观且全面的评分方式的重要性。

papers.title: MI-CXR: A Benchmark for Longitudinal Reasoning over Multi-Interval Chest X-rays
papers.title_zh: MI-CXR：用于多间隔胸部X光片纵向分析的基准方法
papers.authors: Sunghwan Steve Cho, Yunseok Han, Jaeyoung Do
papers.abstract: Longitudinal chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation requires reasoning over disease evolution across multiple patient visits, yet most existing medical VQA benchmarks focus on single images or short-horizon image pairs. We introduce MI-CXR, a benchmark for standardized evaluation of Multi-Interval longitudinal reasoning over multi-visit CXR sequences, without requiring free-form report generation or additional clinical context. MI-CXR comprises five-way multiple-choice questions over five-visit patient timelines and instantiates three complementary task families: Temporal Event Localization, Interval-wise Change Reasoning, and Global Trajectory Summarization, which assess clinically grounded visual reasoning over time. Evaluating 14 state-of-the-art vision–language models (VLMs) shows low overall performance (29.3% accuracy), only modestly above random guessing. Using stage-wise diagnostic probing, we find that models often produce locally plausible interval descriptions but fail to enforce temporal constraints or compose evidence into globally consistent decisions over the full timeline. These findings reveal key limitations of current VLMs and establish MI-CXR as a principled benchmark for longitudinal medical reasoning. The benchmark is available at: https://github.com/AIDASLab/MI-CXR
papers.abstract_zh: 纵向胸部X光片解读需要综合考虑患者在多次就诊过程中的疾病演变情况。然而，目前大多数医学视觉问答基准测试都仅关注单张图像或短时间内的图像对。我们提出了MI-CXR这一基准测试，它旨在对多次就诊的胸部X光片序列进行多间隔时间的纵向推理评估，且无需生成自由形式的报告或额外的临床信息。MI-CXR包含五个选择题，涉及五次就诊的患者时间线，涵盖了三个互补的任务类别：时间事件定位、时间间隔变化推理以及全局轨迹总结。这些任务能够评估基于临床数据的时序视觉推理能力。通过对14种先进的视觉语言模型进行测试，我们发现它们的整体表现较差（准确率为29.3%），仅略高于随机猜测的水平。通过分阶段诊断测试，我们发现这些模型通常能够生成局部合理的间隔描述，但无法有效执行时间约束，也无法将各种证据整合成在整个时间线上的一致决策。这些发现揭示了当前视觉语言模型的主要局限性，并使得MI-CXR成为纵向医学推理的权威基准测试。该基准测试的相关资料可访问：https://github.com/AIDASLab/MI-CXR

papers.title: Relevance to Utility: Process-Supervised Rewrite for RAG
papers.title_zh: 与实用性的关联：针对RAG技术的流程导向重写方法
papers.authors: Jaeyoung Kim, Jongho Kim, Seung-won Hwang, Seoho Song, Young-In Song
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems often suffer from a gap between optimizing retrieval relevance and generative utility. With such a gap, retrieved documents may be topically relevant but still lack the content needed for effective reasoning during generation. While existing bridge modules attempt to rewrite the retrieved text for better generation, we show how they fail by not capturing “document utility”. In this work, we propose R2U, with a key distinction of approximating true utility through joint observation of rewriting and answering in the reasoning process. To distill this observation reliably, R2U scales such supervision to enhance reliability in distillation. We further construct utility-improvement supervision by measuring the generator’s gain of the answer under the rewritten context, yielding signals for fine-tuning and preference optimization. We evaluate our method across multiple open-domain question-answering benchmarks. The empirical results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong bridging baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成系统常常存在优化检索相关性与生成实用性之间的差距。由于这种差距，检索到的文档可能在主题上相关，但在生成过程中却缺乏有效推理所需的内容。虽然现有的桥梁模块试图通过重新编写检索到的文本来提升生成效果，但我们发现它们未能捕捉到“文档实用性”这一关键要素。在这项研究中，我们提出了R2U方法，其核心思想是在推理过程中同时考虑重写和回答两个环节，从而近似真实实用性。为了可靠地实现这一目标，R2U将这种监督机制扩展到更广泛的领域，以提高其可靠性。我们还通过测量生成器在改写后的上下文下的答案增益来构建实用性改进的监督机制，从而为微调和优化偏好提供了依据。我们在多个开放域问答基准测试中评估了该方法的效果，实验结果表明，与强大的桥梁基线模型相比，我们的方法取得了持续的改进。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: On the Cultural Anachronism and Temporal Reasoning in Vision Language Models
papers.title_zh: 关于视觉语言模型中的文化时代错位与时间推理问题
papers.authors: Mukul Ranjan, Prince Jha, Khushboo Kumari, Zhiqiang Shen
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to cultural heritage materials, from digital archives to educational platforms. This work identifies a fundamental issue in how these models interpret historical artifacts. We define this phenomenon as cultural anachronism, the tendency to misinterpret historical objects using temporally inappropriate concepts, materials, or cultural frameworks. To quantify this phenomenon, we introduce the Temporal Anachronism Benchmark for Vision-Language Models TAB-VLM, a dataset of 600 questions across six categories, designed to evaluate temporal reasoning on 1,600 Indian cultural artifacts spanning prehistoric to modern periods. Systematic evaluations of ten state-of-the-art models reveal significant deficiencies on our benchmark, and even the best model (GPT-5.2) achieves only 58.7% overall accuracy. The performance gap persists across varying architectures and scales, suggesting that cultural anachronism represents a significant limitation in visual AI systems, regardless of model size. These findings highlight the disparity between current VLM capabilities and the requirements for accurately interpreting cultural heritage materials, particularly for non-Western visual cultures underrepresented in training data. Our benchmark provides a foundation for enhancing temporal cognition in multimodal AI systems that interact with historical artifacts. The dataset and code are available in the supplementary material.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在文化遗产材料的应用越来越广泛，从数字档案到教育平台都有它们的身影。然而，这些模型在解读历史文物时存在一个根本性问题。我们将这种现象称为“文化时代错配”，即使用不合时宜的概念、材料或文化框架来误读历史物品的现象。为了量化这一现象，我们开发了“视觉语言模型时代错配基准测试”数据集，该数据集包含600个问题，涵盖六个类别，旨在评估1600件印度文化文物的时间推理能力，这些文物涵盖了从史前时期到现代的历史阶段。对十种最先进的模型进行系统评估后发现，它们在我们的基准测试上存在显著不足，即使是最优秀的模型（如GPT-5.2）也仅达到了58.7%的准确率。这种性能差距在不同架构和规模下仍然存在，这表明无论模型规模如何，文化时代错配都是视觉人工智能系统中的一个重要限制因素。这些发现揭示了当前视觉语言模型的能力与准确解读文化遗产材料的需求之间存在差距，尤其是对于那些在训练数据中代表性不足的非西方视觉文化而言。我们的基准测试为提升与历史文物交互的多模态人工智能系统的时间认知能力提供了基础。该数据集和代码可在补充材料中获取。

papers.title: GLA: Grounding Large Language Models in Molecular Hierarchy for Chemical Understanding
papers.title_zh: GLA：将大型语言模型建立在分子层次结构上，以实现化学领域的深入理解
papers.authors: Yingxu Li, Jingjie Zeng, Zekun Wang, Hongfei Lin, Liang Yang
papers.abstract: Conventional Euclidean geometries lead to structural distortion and entangle core pharmacophoric identities with peripheral groups. Existing molecule-language models, relying on linear or uniform encodings, often obscure the hierarchical organization of chemical semantics. To address this, we propose Geometric-Language Alignment (GLA), a framework integrating intrinsic molecular topology into large language models. GLA employs a mixed-curvature encoder that adaptively learns geometric representations through a gating mechanism. These representations are aligned with text via a dual-view contrastive objective and injected into a frozen language model. Experiments on cross-modal retrieval, captioning, and property prediction benchmarks show GLA consistently improves performance over baselines, suggesting that modeling geometric heterogeneity enhances the grounding between molecular structure and chemical language.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的欧几里得几何学会导致结构上的扭曲，并使核心的药理性质与外围基团相互纠缠。现有的分子语言模型依赖于线性或统一的编码方式，往往无法清晰展现化学语义的层次结构。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了几何-语言对齐框架（Geometric-Language Alignment，GLA）。该框架将分子内部的拓扑结构整合到大语言模型中。GLA采用一种混合曲率编码器，通过门控机制自适应地学习几何表示。这些表示通过双视图对比目标与文本进行对齐，然后被注入到冻结的语言模型中。在跨模态检索、标题生成以及属性预测等基准测试中的实验表明，GLA能够持续提升性能，优于现有基线方法。这表明，对几何异质性进行建模有助于加强分子结构与化学语言之间的关联。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: NeuRAG: End-to-End Neural Knowledge Augmentation via Hyper-Neurons
papers.title_zh: NeuRAG：通过超神经元实现端到端神经知识增强技术
papers.authors: Liwei Zheng, Xuemin Liu, Jie Liu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems have become a standard approach for grounding large language models in external knowledge. However, they are constrained by a decoupled architecture: retrieval and reasoning operate as separate stages, with retrieved text merely prepended as passive context. This prevents deep integration of knowledge into the model’s parametric reasoning, leading to fragmented responses for complex queries requiring multi-document synthesis or conflict resolution. To bridge this gap, we propose NeuRAG, an end-to-end Neuralized RAG framework that unifies knowledge retrieval and fusion through Hyper-Neurons—parameterized modules encoding entire documents directly into the model’s parameter space. In NeuRAG, each document is encoded as a lightweight LoRA module, conceptualized as a knowledge neuron. These neurons collectively form a document-adaptive Hyper-Layer, which dynamically activates and fuses knowledge neurons via an attention mechanism conditioned on the input hidden-state query. This enables the model to jointly retrieve and reason within a single forward pass, seamlessly integrating external knowledge into its inference pathway. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and LLMs demonstrate NeuRAG’s strong and consistent performance as a promising novel RAG paradigm.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统已成为将大语言模型与外部知识相结合的标准方法。然而，这种系统的架构存在局限性：检索和推理是两个独立的阶段，检索到的文本只是作为被动的上下文被添加进来。这导致知识无法深入整合到模型的参数化推理中，从而使得对于需要多文档合成或冲突解决的复杂查询，模型只能给出碎片化的响应。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了NeuRAG——一种端到端的神经化RAG框架。该框架通过超神经元将知识检索与融合统一起来，超神经元是一种参数化模块，能够将整篇文档直接编码到模型的参数空间中。在NeuRAG中，每篇文档都被编码为一个轻量级的LoRA模块，这些模块可以被视为知识神经元。这些神经元共同构成了一个文档自适应超层，该超层通过基于输入隐藏状态查询的注意力机制来动态激活和融合知识神经元。这样，模型能够在一次前向传播过程中同时完成检索和推理任务，从而无缝地将外部知识整合到其推理路径中。通过在多个数据集和大语言模型上的广泛实验验证，NeuRAG表现出强大且稳定的性能，成为一种有前景的新颖RAG范式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DEAR: Distributional Error-Aware Reliability for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Missing Modalities
papers.title_zh: 亲爱的朋友们：针对缺失模态的情况，我们提出了一种考虑分布误差的可靠性算法，旨在实现稳健的多模态情感分析
papers.authors: Shihao Zou, Wei Wei, Yongshuo Zhang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) often suffers from performance degradation due to missing modalities in practical applications. Existing methods typically focus on feature completion but neglect semantic shifts caused by distribution gaps and decision risks under high uncertainty. In this paper, we propose a Distributional Error-Aware Reliability (DEAR) estimation framework for robust MSA. Specifically, we design a Hierarchical Distribution-Constrained Reconstruction (HDCR) module to mitigate semantic shifts by explicitly aligning reconstructed features with the original distributional manifold. Meanwhile, a reliability evaluation module (SURE) is introduced to quantitatively measure reconstruction fidelity. By perceiving inherent uncertainty, SURE provides a reliability-driven gating mechanism for the Synergistic-Robust Dual-Stream (SR-DS) architecture. This mechanism enables the model to dynamically adjust contribution weights: strengthening cross-modal synergistic effects when data fidelity is high, while shifting focus toward robust paths under high-risk missingness to safeguard performance. Extensive experiments on MOSI, MOSEI, and SIMS datasets validate the effectiveness and decision reliability of DEAR.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态情感分析（MSA）在实际应用中常常因缺少某些模态而导致性能下降。现有的方法通常侧重于特征补全，却忽视了由于分布差异以及高不确定性下的决策风险所导致的语义变化。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于分布误差感知的可靠性估计框架，以用于鲁棒的MSA任务。具体来说，我们设计了一个分层分布约束重构模块，通过明确地将重构特征与原始分布进行对齐，来减轻语义变化的影响。同时，我们还引入了一个可靠性评估模块（SURE），用于定量衡量重构的保真度。SURE能够感知到固有的不确定性，并为协同鲁棒双流架构提供了一个以可靠性为驱动的门控机制。该机制使得模型能够动态调整各模态之间的贡献权重：在数据保真度较高时加强跨模态的协同效应；而在高缺失率的情况下则重点关注鲁棒性，从而保障模型的性能。在MOSI、MOSEI和SIMS数据集上的广泛实验验证了DEAR框架的有效性和决策可靠性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: OpenPhone: Mobile Agentic Foundation Models
papers.title_zh: OpenPhone：移动代理基础模型
papers.authors: Yangqin Jiang, Chao Huang
papers.abstract: With the advancement of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), building GUI agent systems has become an increasingly promising direction—especially for mobile platforms, given their rich app ecosystems and intuitive touch interactions. Yet mobile GUI agents face a critical dilemma: truly on-device models (4B or smaller) lack sufficient performance, while capable models (starting from 7B) are either too large for mobile deployment or prohibitively costly (e.g., cloud-only closed-source MLLMs). To resolve this, we propose OpenPhone, a mobile GUI agent system that leverages device-cloud collaboration to tap the cost-efficiency of on-device models and the high capability of cloud models, while avoiding their drawbacks. Specifically, OpenPhone enhances Qwen2.5-VL-3B via two-stage SFT→GRPO training on synthetic GUI data for strong decision-making, integrates an efficient long-reasoning mechanism to utilize historical interactions under tight resources, and defaults to on-device execution—only escalating challenging subtasks to the cloud via real-time complexity assessment. Experiments on the online AndroidLab benchmark and diverse apps show OpenPhone matches or nears larger models, with a significant reduction in cloud costs.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着多模态大语言模型的发展，构建图形用户界面代理系统已成为一个极具前景的方向——尤其是在移动平台上，因为移动设备拥有丰富的应用生态系统和直观的触摸交互功能。然而，移动图形用户界面代理面临一个关键难题：真正的本地模型（4B或更小规模的模型）性能不足，而能力较强的模型（从7B规模开始）要么过于庞大而无法在移动设备上部署，要么成本过高（例如，仅支持云端的闭源大语言模型）。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了OpenPhone这一移动图形用户界面代理系统。该系统通过结合本地设备和云端资源，充分发挥本地模型的成本效益以及云端模型的高性能优势，同时避免了它们的缺点。具体来说，OpenPhone通过两阶段的SFT→GRPO训练方法，在合成图形用户界面数据上进行训练，以提升Qwen2.5-VL-3B模型的决策能力；同时，它采用了高效的长期推理机制，以便在资源有限的情况下利用历史交互信息；此外，OpenPhone默认采用本地执行方式，只有在评估任务复杂度后才会将具有挑战性的任务迁移到云端处理。在在线AndroidLab基准测试平台和多种应用程序上的实验表明，OpenPhone的性能与较大规模的模型相当，且大幅降低了云端使用的成本。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Fast Retrieval and Slow Reasoning for Explainable Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.title_zh: 快速检索与缓慢推理相结合的方法，用于可解释的多模态情感分析
papers.authors: Aoqiang Zhu, Min Hu, Yan Xing
papers.abstract: Most existing Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) methods rely on holistic fusion, treating all modalities and temporal segments equally. Such strategies often introduce redundant information and obscure the decision process, limiting both robustness and interpretability. Inspired by dual-process theory, we propose FRSR (Fast Retrieval and Slow Reasoning), an interpretable framework that decomposes multimodal sentiment modeling into two cooperative pathways. The Fast Pathway acts as a lightweight evidence selector, using context-aware convolution and auxiliary supervision to retrieve a sparse set of Top-K sentiment-relevant cues from noisy multimodal inputs. Based on these cues, the Slow Pathway performs deeper cross-modal reasoning through learnable reasoning tokens, enabling hierarchical sentiment inference. By separating salient evidence retrieval from multimodal reasoning, FRSR improves interpretability while reducing computational cost. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that FRSR achieves competitive performance, higher efficiency, stronger robustness to noise, and clearer decision transparency than existing holistic fusion methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前大多数多模态情感分析方法都依赖于整体融合方式，平等地处理所有模态和时间段。这种策略往往会引入冗余信息，使决策过程变得模糊不清，从而限制了模型的鲁棒性和可解释性。受双过程理论的启发，我们提出了FRSR（快速检索与慢速推理）框架。该框架将多模态情感建模分解为两个协同路径：快速路径作为轻量级证据选择器，利用上下文感知的卷积技术和辅助监督机制，从嘈杂的多模态输入中筛选出最相关的K个情感线索；慢速路径则通过可学习的推理令牌进行更深层次的跨模态推理，从而实现分层情感推断。通过将显著证据检索与多模态推理分离开来，FRSR提高了可解释性，同时降低了计算成本。在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，FRSR在性能、效率、对噪声的鲁棒性以及决策透明度方面均优于现有的整体融合方法。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Exploration-Exploitation Reshaping towards Efficient Reasoning for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 探索与利用：为大型语言模型打造高效推理机制的过程
papers.authors: Yufeng Shi, Weilin Luo, Yuxiang Zhang, Zongmeng Zhang, Haoyang Liu, Yubing Wang, Bin Wang, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li
papers.abstract: While excelling at solving complex problems, Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) are still constrained by the overthinking issue. Most current studies rely on reward shaping in Reinforcement Learning (RL) to shorten the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) of LRMs, remaining sample-inefficient and non-robust due to the absence of guided exploration and prioritized exploitation. To address these issues, we propose a novel policy optimization framework with Self-Imitation and self-Guidance MechAnisms (SIGMA), which reshapes the exploration and exploitation through two core components: (i) self-imitation exploitation, which enables the prioritized exploitation of high-value prompts and rollouts by introducing a self-imitated loss and a dynamic sampling strategy based on compression rate; (ii) self-guidance exploration, which provides a preference-aware exploration guidance through diverse and pluggable self-rewriting strategies. Experiments across various datasets indicate that our method achieves superior reasoning efficiency without compromising, and even facilitating, the overall accuracy. Furthermore, ablation studies show that the proposed mechanisms can provide flexible control interfaces for the tradeoff between the reasoning accuracy and efficiency of LRMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大型推理模型在解决复杂问题方面表现出色，但它们仍然受到过度思考问题的限制。目前大多数研究依赖于强化学习中的奖励塑形技术来缩短推理模型的思维链，但由于缺乏有指导的探索以及优先化的利用机制，这种方法仍然存在样本效率低下且不够稳健的问题。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的策略优化框架，该框架包含自我模仿和自我引导机制。这一框架通过两个核心组件来重新调整探索与利用的过程：(1) 自我模仿利用机制，它通过引入自我仿制的损失函数以及基于压缩率的动态采样策略，使得能够优先利用高价值的提示和展开方式；(2) 自我引导探索机制，它通过多样化的、可插拔的自我重写策略，为探索过程提供基于偏好意识的指导。在不同数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在提高推理效率的同时，并未降低整体准确性。此外，消融研究还表明，所提出的机制能够为推理模型的准确性和效率之间的权衡提供灵活的控制手段。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: COMPEL: Compensated Mixture-of-Experts Pruning with Expert-Layer distribution
papers.title_zh: COMPEL：基于专家层分布的复合专家剪枝算法
papers.authors: Seohee Yoon, Yong Suk Choi
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as an effective approach for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) by activating only a subset of experts during inference. Despite their computational efficiency, MoE models incur a substantial memory bottleneck from maintaining all expert parameters during inference. To address this challenge, numerous MoE pruning methods have been proposed. However, most existing methods adopt uniform pruning across layers, which fails to capture layer-wise variations in expert importance and redundancy. In this paper, we propose COmpensated MoE Pruning with Expert-Layer distribution (COMPEL). COMPEL performs layer-adaptive expert pruning by estimating expert importance using Fisher information and deriving layer importance from layer-wise outlier distributions, enabling pruning decisions that capture layer-wise heterogeneity. Furthermore, to mitigate performance degradation resulting from expert pruning, we propose a Fisher information guided expert weight compensation method. Experimental results on the Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B achieve near lossless performance at 25% expert pruning and maintains performance within a 4% margin even at 50% pruning. Moreover, COMPEL consistently outperforms existing pruning methods while substantially reducing inference latency and peak GPU memory usage.
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合架构（Mixture-of-Experts，MoE）作为一种有效的扩展大语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs）的方法应运而生。该方法在推理过程中仅激活部分专家，从而提升了计算效率。然而，由于需要在推理过程中保留所有专家参数，MoE模型面临着严重的内存瓶颈问题。为了应对这一挑战，人们提出了多种MoE剪枝方法。不过，大多数现有方法都采用统一的剪枝策略，这无法捕捉到不同层次上专家的重要性差异和冗余情况。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于专家层次分布的补偿性MoE剪枝方法（COmpensated MoE Pruning with Expert-Layer distribution，COMPEL）。COMPEL通过利用费舍尔信息来估计专家的重要性，并从各层的异常分布中推导出各层的重要性，从而实现针对各层异质性的剪枝决策。此外，为了减轻专家剪枝带来的性能下降问题，我们还提出了一种基于费舍尔信息的专家权重补偿方法。在Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B模型上的实验结果表明，在25%的专家剪枝情况下，模型仍能达到接近无损的性能；而在50%的专家剪枝情况下，性能仍保持在4%以内的范围内。更重要的是，COMPEL在大幅降低推理延迟和GPU内存使用量的同时，仍然能够保持较好的性能表现，其效果优于现有的其他剪枝方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Towards Self-Evolving Agents: Enabling Autonomy through Interactive Experience Refinement
papers.title_zh: 迈向自主进化型智能体：通过交互式体验的优化实现自主性
papers.authors: Cheng Yang, Xuemeng Yang, Licheng Wen, Daocheng Fu, Jianbiao Mei, Rong Wu, Pinlong Cai, Yufan Shen, Nianchen Deng, Jia Xu, Botian Shi, Yu Qiao, Haifeng Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models often struggle with complex, multi-step operational tasks because they remain static during inference and cannot learn from past experience. To address this, we propose MUSE, a framework that enables iterative self-improvement through a hierarchical Memory Module. MUSE organizes cross-domain insights to facilitate the orchestration of long-horizon workflows. The core of our approach is an autonomous post-execution critique mechanism: after completing each sub-task, the system analyzes its operational logs and distills raw execution data into structured, reusable knowledge. This allows the agent to evolve dynamically rather than relying on fixed parameters. Evaluated on the rigorous TAC productivity benchmark, MUSE achieves new state-of-the-art results, significantly outperforming previous methods using only the streamlined Gemini-2.5 Flash model. Our analysis demonstrates that MUSE’s performance scales with the accumulation of insights and exhibits strong cross-task transferability, marking a key step toward autonomous systems capable of lifelong learning in professional environments. Demo videos can be found in our supplementary materials.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在处理复杂的多步骤操作任务时常常面临困难，因为它们在推理过程中保持静态状态，无法从过去的经验中学习。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了MUSE框架。该框架通过分层记忆模块实现迭代式自我改进。MUSE能够将不同领域的知识整合起来，从而更好地协调长期工作流的执行。我们的核心方法是采用一种自主的后续评估机制：在完成每个子任务后，系统会分析其操作日志，并将原始执行数据转化为结构化的、可重复使用的知识。这样，智能体就能动态进化，而不依赖于固定的参数。在严格的TAC生产力基准测试中，MUSE取得了新的最佳成绩，其性能显著优于仅使用简化版的Gemini-2.5 Flash模型的先前方法。我们的分析表明，MUSE的性能随着知识的积累而提升，并且具有强大的跨任务可迁移性，这标志着向能够在专业环境中实现终身学习的自主系统迈出了重要一步。演示视频可以在我们的补充材料中找到。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Good Reasoning Makes Good Demonstrations: Implicit Reasoning Quality Supervision via In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 良好的推理能力能带来出色的演示效果：通过上下文相关的强化学习来实现隐性推理能力的监督
papers.authors: Tiehua Mei, Minxuan Lv, Leiyu Pan, Zhenpeng Su, Hongru Hou, Hengrui Chen, Ao Xu, Deqing Yang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in large language models but treats all correct solutions equally, potentially reinforcing flawed traces that arrive at correct answers by chance. We observe that better reasoning makes better demonstrations: high-quality solutions serve as more effective in-context examples than low-quality ones. We term this teaching ability Demonstration Utility, and show that the policy model’s own in-context learning ability provides an efficient way to measure it, yielding a quality signal termed Evidence Gain. To leverage this signal during training, we introduce In-Context RLVR, which prepends demonstrations before each rollout. Theoretically, we prove that this simple input modification implicitly reweights rewards by a factor approximately proportional to Evidence Gain, assigning higher weights to high-quality traces without requiring costly computation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in both accuracy and reasoning quality over standard RLVR baselines. Our codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/Mithas-114/IC-DAPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够提升大语言模型的推理能力，但会平等对待所有正确的解决方案，这可能会强化那些偶然得出正确答案的错误路径。我们发现，更出色的推理能力意味着更好的示范效果：高质量的解决方案比低质量的解决方案更能起到有效的上下文示例作用。我们将这种教学能力称为“示范效用”，并证明策略模型自身的上下文学习能力是一种有效的衡量方式，它能产生一种被称为“证据增益”的质量指标。为了在训练过程中利用这一指标，我们引入了“上下文强化学习VR”（In-Context RLVR），即在每次迭代之前先输入示范内容。理论上，我们证明了这种简单的输入修改方式可以隐式地调整奖励权重，其比例大致与证据增益成正比，从而在不需进行昂贵计算的情况下，给予高质量路径更高的权重。在数学推理基准测试上的实验表明，与标准RLVR基线相比，我们的方法在准确性和推理质量方面都取得了显著的提升。我们的代码和数据集可以在https://github.com/Mithas-114/IC-DAPO上获取。

papers.title: Design First, Code Later: Aesthetically Pleasing Template-Free Slides Generation
papers.title_zh: 先设计，后编码：打造美观且无模板限制的幻灯片效果
papers.authors: Zhiyao Cui, Chenxu Wang, Shuyue Hu, Yiqun Zhang, Wenqi Shao, Qiaosheng Zhang, Zhen Wang
papers.abstract: Producing presentation slides automatically entails coordinating narrative structure with page-level graphic design under strict spatial constraints. For such structured multimodal tasks, a well-organized design process is essential to ensure the final quality of slides. Existing approaches rely on fixed templates or directly emit executable code, thereby both limiting the creative layout-design capabilities of LLMs and bypassing the essential slide-page design step. To address these limitations, this paper: (1) proposes a hierarchical slides generation workflow DeepSlides that systematically organizes slide design tasks without any predefined template or style, decoupling slide-page design from implementation; (2) introduces SlideDesign, a dataset tailored specifically for slides generation tasks; (3) presents a multi-agent reinforcement learning training paradigm and trains a couple of models SlideQwens for slide design and implementation. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed framework outperforms baseline methods on evaluated metrics and achieves superior performance in human preference evaluations. The dataset and code are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DeepSlides-D14D
papers.abstract_zh: 自动生成演示幻灯片需要在一个严格的空间限制下，协调叙述结构与平面设计。对于这种结构化的多模态任务来说，一个组织良好的设计流程至关重要，以确保幻灯片的最终质量。现有的方法依赖于固定的模板或直接生成可执行代码，这既限制了大语言模型在创意布局设计方面的能力，也忽略了幻灯片设计这一关键步骤。为了克服这些局限性，本文提出了以下方案：(1) 开发了名为DeepSlides的层次化幻灯片生成工作流程，该系统能够系统地安排幻灯片设计任务，无需任何预定义的模板或风格，从而将幻灯片设计与实现分离；(2) 引入了专门用于幻灯片生成任务的数据集SlideDesign；(3) 提出了一种多智能体强化学习训练范式，并训练了几个用于幻灯片设计和实现的模型SlideQwens。实验结果表明，我们提出的框架在评估指标上优于现有方法，并且在人类偏好评估中表现更优。该数据集和代码可访问于：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DeepSlides-D14D

papers.title: Benchmarking the Fine-Grained Discriminability in Image-Text Retrieval via Controlled Contrastive Differences
papers.title_zh: 通过控制对比差异来评估图像与文本检索中细粒度区分能力的基准测试
papers.authors: Zhen Wang, Xi Zhou, Yating Yang, Bo Ma, Lei Wang, Rui Dong, Azmat Anwar, Siru Miao
papers.abstract: Existing cross-modal image-text retrieval models often retrieve samples with inconsistent details. To evaluate fine-grained discriminability, we introduce MSCOCO-CCD and Flickr30k-CCD, with three key features: (1) a two-level image content taxonomy for contrastive sample generation and fine-grained evaluation; (2) annotation of numerous contrastive samples, where each sample differs from the anchor by a controlled contrastive difference (CCD), with the specific type of difference labeled; (3) a fine-grained contrastive discrimination metric to assess the ability to distinguish fine-grained nuances. Extensive experiments demonstrate that contrastive samples can significantly degrade retrieval performance. Furthermore, fine-grained evaluation reveals that current models still struggle to effectively produce discriminative representations on certain feature types, such as entity emotion and scene attribute. Our datasets and related codes will be publicly released.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的跨模态图像文本检索模型往往无法准确提取具有细微差异的样本。为了评估细粒度的区分能力，我们提出了MSCOCO-CCD和Flickr30k-CCD两个数据集，这两个数据集具有三个关键特点：(1) 采用两级图像内容分类体系，用于生成对比样本并进行细粒度评估；(2) 对大量对比样本进行标注，每个样本与锚点之间的差异都由一个可控的对比差异来表示，并且会标注出具体差异类型；(3) 采用细粒度的对比判别指标来评估区分细微差异的能力。大量实验表明，对比样本会显著降低检索性能。此外，细粒度评估结果显示，当前模型在生成某些特征类型的判别性表示方面仍然存在困难，例如实体情感和情感场景属性等。我们的数据集及相关代码将会公开发布。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Learning on Imbalanced Noisy Data via Debiased Sample Selection and LLM-Driven Annotation
papers.title_zh: 通过去偏采样选择和基于大语言模型的标注技术，在不平衡且含有噪声的数据上进行学习
papers.authors: Bo Yuan, Yulin Chen, Yin Zhang
papers.abstract: Learning with Noisy Labels (LNL) is a challenge where the collected training set can contain incorrect or corrupted labels. Most existing solutions distinguish clean samples from noisy samples and query human experts on noisy samples for denoising. However, these solutions often operate under the unrealistic assumption that the distribution of classes is uniform, overlooking the skewed and imbalanced distributions frequently encountered in real-world scenarios. In this case, we empirically reveal that previous solutions suffer from both selection bias and training bias, leading to distinguish clean samples from noisy samples hardly. In this paper, our work introduces the imbalanced learning with noisy labels (i-LNL) task, which seeks to let the model learn from noisy labels within imbalanced distributions. A new benchmark (ImbaLNL-Bench) comprised of some synthetic and real-world datasets is created to provide a thorough representation of practical use cases. Besides, we propose an innovative collaborative learning framework DeCo for i-LNL tasks. Specifically, we first conduct debiased sample selection, consisting of a robust expert model and a debiased-enhanced threshold strategy, to better separate clean samples from noisy samples, especially for the tail classes. Then we feed selected clean samples to active annotator large language models (LLMs) for re-annotating noisy samples using in-context learning, which can better reduce human effort. Ultimately, we employ distinct loss functions adept at managing subsets with varying degrees of label noise. Extensive experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets show the effectiveness and superiority of our method.
papers.abstract_zh: 带有噪声标签的学习（LNL）是一种挑战，所收集的训练集可能包含错误或损坏的标签。大多数现有解决方案能够区分干净样本和噪声样本，并需要人工专家对噪声样本进行去噪处理。然而，这些解决方案通常基于一个不现实的假设，即类别分布是均匀的，而忽略了现实场景中常见的不平衡和偏斜的分布情况。实际上，我们的实验表明，现有的解决方案存在选择偏差和训练偏差问题，导致难以准确区分干净样本和噪声样本。在本文中，我们提出了不平衡带噪声标签学习（i-LNL）任务，该任务旨在让模型能够在不平衡的分布中从噪声标签中学习。我们创建了一个新的基准测试集ImbaLNL-Bench，该测试集包含了一些合成数据和真实世界的数据集，以全面反映实际应用场景。此外，我们还提出了一个创新的协作学习框架DeCo，用于i-LNL任务。具体来说，我们首先进行去噪样本选择，利用一个强大的专家模型和去噪增强阈值策略，以便更好地分离干净样本和噪声样本，尤其是对于尾部类别而言。然后，我们将选出的干净样本输入到主动注释器大语言模型中，通过上下文学习来重新注释噪声样本，从而减轻人工处理的负担。最后，我们采用了多种损失函数，以有效处理具有不同程度标签噪声的子集。在合成数据和真实世界数据集上的广泛实验结果表明，我们的方法具有高效性和优越性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Task-Level Context: Class-Conditional Context Vectors for Implicit In-Context Learning
papers.title_zh: 超越任务级上下文：用于隐式上下文学习的类条件上下文向量
papers.authors: Jianxin Zhang, Yilu Hu, Teng Liu, Pei Guo, Juntao Li
papers.abstract: Implicit In-Context Learning compresses demonstration examples into a single context vector and injects it into the model’s activation space, achieving few-shot-level performance at near zero-shot inference cost. However, existing approaches typically aggregate demonstrations from all classes into a shared, task-level context vector, capturing global task information but without explicitly preserving fine-grained, class-conditional semantic distinctions. In this work, we propose Class-Conditional Context Vectors (C3V), a simple yet effective extension to implicit in-context learning that explicitly models class-specific contextual information by constructing separate context vectors for each class, without relying on explicit prompts. These class-conditional context vectors are additively injected into the model’s residual streams in a single forward pass, enabling contextual contributions to be modulated in a class-aware manner while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate C3V on multiple text classification benchmarks across several families of large language models. Experimental results demonstrate that C3V consistently outperforms task-level context vector baselines, and achieves higher average accuracy than conventional few-shot learning on most models.
papers.abstract_zh: 隐式上下文学习将示范示例压缩为单一的上下文向量，并将其注入模型的激活空间中，从而在几乎无需显式提示的情况下实现少样本级的性能。然而，现有的方法通常将所有类别的示范数据汇总为一个共享的、任务级别的上下文向量，这能够捕捉到全局的任务信息，但未能明确保留细粒度的、与类别相关的语义差异。在这项研究中，我们提出了类条件上下文向量（C3V）这一简单而有效的隐式上下文学习扩展方案。该方案通过为每个类别构建独立的上下文向量，来显式地模拟特定类别的上下文信息，而无需依赖显式的提示。这些类条件上下文向量可以在一次前向传播过程中被添加到模型的残差流中，从而以考虑类别的方式调节上下文贡献，同时保持主干网络的稳定性。我们在多个大语言模型家族的多种文本分类基准测试上评估了C3V的性能。实验结果表明，C3V在性能上始终优于任务级别的上下文向量基线方法，并且在大多数模型上实现了比传统少样本学习更高的平均准确率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DPN-LE: Dual Personality Neuron Localization and Editing for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: DPN-LE：用于大型语言模型的双人格神经元定位与编辑技术
papers.authors: Lifan Zheng, Xue Yang, Jiawei Chen, Chenyan WU, Jingyuan Zhang, Fanheng Kong, Xinyi Zeng, Xiang Chen, Yu Tian
papers.abstract: With the widespread adoption of large language models (LLMs), understanding their personality representation mechanisms has become critical. As a novel paradigm in Personality Editing, most existing methods employ neuron-editing to locate and modify LLM neurons, requiring changes to numerous neurons and leading to significant performance degradation. This raises a fundamental question: Are all modified neurons directly related to personality representation? In this work, we investigate and quantify this specificity through assessments of general capability impact and representation-level patterns. We find that: 1) Current methods can change personalities but reduce overall performance. 2) Neurons are multifunctional, connecting personality traits and general knowledge. 3) Opposing personality traits demonstrate distinctly mutually exclusive representation patterns. Motivated by these findings, we propose DPN-LE (Dual Personality Neuron Localization and Editing), which identifies personality-specific neurons by contrasting MLP activations between high-trait and low-trait samples. DPN-LE constructs layer-wise steering vectors and applies dual-criterion filtering based on Cohen’s d effect size and activation magnitude to isolate mutually exclusive neuron subsets. Sparse linear intervention on these neurons enables precise personality control at inference time. Using only 1,000 contrastive sample pairs per trait, DPN-LE intervenes on \sim0.5% of neurons while achieving competitive personality control and substantially better capability preservation across reasoning tasks. Experiments on LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型被广泛采用，理解它们的个性表示机制变得至关重要。作为个性编辑领域的一种新范式，目前大多数方法都采用神经元编辑的方式来定位和修改大语言模型的神经元，但这需要修改大量的神经元，从而导致性能显著下降。这就提出了一个基本问题：所有被修改的神经元是否都与个性表示直接相关？在这项研究中，我们通过评估整体能力影响以及表示层面的模式来研究和量化这种特异性。我们发现：1）当前的方法可以改变个性，但会降低整体性能；2）神经元具有多功能性，能够连接个性特征和一般知识；3）不同的个性特征表现出明显互斥的表示模式。基于这些发现，我们提出了DPN-LE（双个性神经元定位与编辑）算法，该算法通过对比高特质样本和低特质样本的MLP激活值，来识别与个性相关的神经元。DPN-LE构建逐层引导向量，并根据Cohen’s d效应大小和激活强度进行双重标准过滤，以分离出互斥的神经元子集。对这些神经元进行稀疏线性干预，可以在推理时实现精确的个性控制。仅使用每个性特质1000对对比样本对，DPN-LE就能干预约0.5%的神经元，同时实现具有竞争力的个性控制，并且在推理任务中能显著改善性能。在LaMA-3-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上的实验证明了我们方法的有效性和通用性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reasoning in a Combinatorial and Constrained World: Benchmarking LLMs on Natural-Language Combinatorial Optimization
papers.title_zh: 在组合优化与约束优化领域的推理：让大型语言模型在自然语言组合优化任务上展现性能——基于基准测试的结果
papers.authors: Xia Jiang, Jing Chen, Cong Zhang, Jie Gao, Chengpeng Hu, Chenhao Zhang, Yaoxin Wu, Yingqian Zhang
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in math and logic reasoning, their ability to handle combinatorial optimization (CO)—searching high-dimensional solution spaces under hard constraints—remains underexplored. To bridge the gap, we introduce NLCO, a Natural Language Combinatorial Optimization benchmark that evaluates LLMs on end-to-end CO reasoning: given a language-described decision-making scenario, the model must output a discrete solution without writing code or calling external solvers. NLCO covers 43 CO problems and is organized using a four-layer taxonomy of variable types, constraint families, global patterns, and objective classes, enabling fine-grained evaluation. We provide solver-annotated solutions and comprehensively evaluate LLMs by feasibility, solution optimality, and reasoning efficiency. Experiments across a wide range of modern LLMs show that high-performing models achieve strong feasibility and solution quality on small instances, but both degrade as instance size grows, even if more tokens are used for reasoning. We also observe systematic effects across the taxonomy: set-based tasks are relatively easy, whereas graph-structured problems and bottleneck objectives lead to more frequent failures. The benchmark dataset and code for data generation and evaluation are publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在数学和逻辑推理方面表现出强大的性能，但它们在处理组合优化问题的能力方面仍然有待进一步探索。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了NLCO这一自然语言组合优化基准测试，该测试要求语言模型进行端到端的组合优化推理：给定一种由语言描述的决策场景，模型必须在不编写代码或调用外部求解器的情况下输出一个离散的解决方案。NLCO涵盖了43个组合优化问题，并采用四层分类体系来组织这些问题，包括变量类型、约束家族、全局模式和目标类别等，从而实现精细化的评估。我们提供了带有求解器注释的解决方案，并通过可行性、解决方案最优性和推理效率等方面对语言模型进行全面评估。通过对多种现代语言模型的实验分析发现，性能优秀的模型在小规模实例上能够实现良好的可行性和解决方案质量，但随着实例规模的增加，即使使用了更多的推理标记，模型的表现也会下降。我们还观察到整个分类体系中存在系统性的规律：基于集合的任务相对容易处理，而基于图结构的问题以及具有瓶颈目标的任务则更容易导致失败。该基准测试数据集以及数据生成和评估的相关代码均可公开获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DARL: Encouraging Diverse Answers for General Reasoning without Verifiers
papers.title_zh: DARL：鼓励在无需验证者的情况下进行多样化的推理方式
papers.authors: Chongxuan Huang, Lei Lin, Xiaodong Shi, Wenping Hu, Ruiming Tang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated promising gains in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, its dependence on domain-specific verifiers significantly restricts its applicability to open and general domains. Recent efforts such as RLPR have extended RLVR to general domains, enabling training on broader datasets and achieving improvements over RLVR. However, a notable limitation of these methods is their tendency to overfit to reference answers, which constrains the model’s ability to generate diverse outputs. This limitation is particularly pronounced in open-ended tasks such as writing, where multiple plausible answers exist. To address this, we propose DARL, a simple yet effective reinforcement learning framework that encourages the generation of diverse answers within a controlled deviation range from the reference while preserving alignment with it. Our framework is fully compatible with existing general reinforcement learning methods and can be seamlessly integrated without additional verifiers. Extensive experiments on thirteen benchmarks demonstrate overall improvements in reasoning performance. Notably, DARL surpasses RLPR, achieving average gains of 1.3 points on six reasoning benchmarks and 9.5 points on seven general benchmarks, highlighting its effectiveness in improving both reasoning accuracy and output diversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型的推理能力方面取得了显著成效。然而，由于该方法依赖于特定领域的验证器，因此其适用范围受到了限制，无法应用于开放且通用的领域。最近的一些研究如RLPR则成功地将RLVR扩展到了通用领域，使得模型能够在更广泛的数据集上进行训练，并取得了优于RLVR的改进效果。不过，这些方法的显著局限性在于它们容易过度拟合参考答案，这限制了模型生成多样化输出的能力。在需要生成多种合理答案的开放式任务中，这种局限性尤为明显。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了DARL——一个简单而有效的强化学习框架。该框架鼓励在受控范围内生成多样化的答案，同时仍保持与参考答案的一致性。我们的框架完全可以与现有的通用强化学习方法兼容，并且无需额外的验证器即可无缝集成。在十三个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，DARL在推理性能上取得了整体提升。值得注意的是，DARL的表现优于RLPR，在六个推理基准测试中平均提升了1.3分，在七个通用基准测试中提升了9.5分，充分体现了其在提高推理准确性和输出多样性方面的有效性。

papers.title: Clustered Self-Assessment: A Simple yet Effective Method for Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 集群式自我评估：一种简单而有效的不确定性量化方法，适用于大型语言模型
papers.authors: Qi Cao, Takeshi Kojima, Andrew Gambardella, Helinyi Peng, Yutaka Matsuo, Yusuke Iwasawa
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable performance across diverse tasks, but they often generate responses that appear plausible while being factually incorrect. This problem is compounded by the lack of explicit uncertainty estimates, which makes it difficult for users to judge the reliability of model outputs. Existing uncertainty quantification methods typically rely on indirect signals, such as entropy across sampled generations. These signals can be difficult to interpret and do not fully leverage the model’s ability to assess its own uncertainty. We propose a simple and effective self-assessment method for uncertainty quantification in LLMs. Our approach groups sampled generations into semantically distinct clusters, converts them into answer options in a structured multiple-choice question, and uses the probability assigned by the LLM to each option as a confidence estimate. Experiments across multiple models and datasets show that our method consistently outperforms baseline approaches. Notably, it achieves competitive performance with as few as two additional samples, demonstrating both its effectiveness and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在多种任务中表现出色，但它们生成的回答往往看似合理，但实际上是错误的。这一问题因缺乏明确的不确定性估计而变得更加复杂，这使得用户难以判断模型输出的可靠性。现有的不确定性量化方法通常依赖于间接信号，例如采样生成过程中的熵值。这些信号可能难以理解，且未能充分利用模型自身评估不确定性的能力。我们提出了一种简单有效的自评估方法，用于量化大语言模型中的不确定性。我们的方法将采样到的生成结果分为语义上不同的组，将它们转化为结构化的选择题选项，并使用语言模型为每个选项分配的概率作为置信度估计。在多个模型和数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法始终优于基线方法。值得注意的是，即使只增加两个额外的样本，该方法也能取得相当好的性能，这充分体现了其有效性和效率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: STEP: Success-Rate-Aware Trajectory-Efficient Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: 步骤：以成功率为导向的、能高效利用轨迹的政策优化
papers.authors: Yuhan Chen, Yuxuan Liu, Long Zhang, Pengzhi Gao, Jian Luan, Wei Liu
papers.abstract: Multi-turn interaction remains challenging for online reinforcement learning. Current GRPO-based methods—either at the trajectory level or the step level—still suffer from fundamental challenges in multi-turn settings: they allocate sampling uniformly across tasks regardless of difficulty, propagate misleading learning signals that penalize correct intermediate actions in failed trajectories, and incur high sample-collection costs under long-horizon environments. Step-level variants (e.g., GIGPO) mitigate some interaction-cost constraints by decomposing trajectories, yet they retain GRPO’s sampling imbalance and still struggle with heterogeneous multi-turn tasks. To address these issues, we propose STEP (Success-rate-aware Trajectory-Efficient Policy Optimization), a framework that dynamically allocates sampling based on per-task success rates and performs fine-grained step-level optimization. STEP maintains a smoothed success-rate record to guide adaptive trajectory resampling, allocating more effort to harder tasks. It then computes success-rate-weighted advantages and decomposes trajectories into step-level samples, followed by a step-level GRPO augmentation that strengthens updates on low-success tasks. Experiments on OSWorld and AndroidWorld show that STEP substantially improves sample efficiency and training stability over both trajectory-level and existing step-level GRPO variants, converging faster and generalizing better under the same sampling budget.
papers.abstract_zh: 在在线强化学习中，多轮交互仍然是一个挑战性问题。目前基于GRPO的方法——无论是针对轨迹层面还是步骤层面——在多轮交互环境中仍然存在一些根本性的难题：它们会均匀分配采样资源到各个任务上，而不考虑任务的难度；还会传播误导性的学习信号，从而惩罚在失败轨迹中正确的中间动作；并且在长视界环境下会导致较高的样本收集成本。步骤层面的方法（例如GIGPO）通过分解轨迹来一定程度上缓解交互成本问题，但它们仍然存在GRPO的采样不平衡问题，并且难以处理异质性的多轮交互任务。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了STEP（基于成功率的高效轨迹策略优化）框架。该框架能够根据每个任务的成功率动态分配采样资源，并进行细粒度的步骤层面优化。STEP通过维护一个平滑化的成功率记录来指导自适应轨迹重采样，将更多的资源分配给难度较大的任务。然后，它计算基于成功率加权的优势值，并将轨迹分解为步骤级别的样本。最后，通过步骤级别的GRPO增强机制，可以加强对低成功率任务的更新。在OSWorld和AndroidWorld上的实验表明，与传统的轨迹层面和现有的步骤层面GRPO方法相比，STEP显著提高了样本效率和训练稳定性，并且在相同的采样预算下，能够更快地收敛并更好地泛化。

papers.title: AscendKernelGen: LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for NPUs
papers.title_zh: AscendKernelGen：基于大语言模型的核函数生成算法，适用于NPU处理器
papers.authors: Xinzi Cao, Jianyang Zhai, Pengfei Li, Zhiheng Hu, Cen Yan, Mubingxu, Guanghuan Fang, Bin She, Jiayu Li, Yihan Su, Dongyang Tao, Feidiao Yang, Chang-Dong Wang, Yutong Lu, Weicheng Xue, Bin Zhou, Yonghong Tian
papers.abstract: Neural Processing Units (NPUs) are critical for AI infrastructure, yet developing kernels remains a bottleneck due to the complexity of vendor-specific Domain-Specific Languages (DSLs). While LLMs excel in general coding, they fail to meet the stringent constraints of NPU development, showing a near-zero success rate on complex kernels in our preliminary study. To address these challenges, we present AscendKernelGen, the first comprehensive framework for NPU kernel development, marking a pioneering effort in this field. This framework consists of three interconnected components: (1) Ascend-CoT, the first dataset in the NPU kernel domain that incorporates chain-of-thought reasoning from real-world kernel implementations; (2) KernelGen-LM, a domain-adaptive model trained on this novel dataset using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning; and (3) NPUKernelBench, the first benchmark platform designed to evaluate the compilation, correctness, and performance of generated NPU kernels. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach dramatically bridges the gap in hardware-specific coding: compilation success on complex Level-2 kernels improves from 0% to 95.5% (Pass@10), with 64% functional correctness. AscendKernGen is available at AscendKernGen and NPUKernelBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 神经处理单元（NPU）对于人工智能基础设施至关重要，但由于各厂商特有的领域特定语言（DSL）的复杂性，开发相关内核仍然是一个瓶颈问题。虽然大语言模型在通用编码方面表现出色，但它们难以满足NPU开发的严格要求，在我们初步的研究中，它们在复杂内核的开发上成功率几乎为零。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AscendKernelGen这一首个全面的NPU内核开发框架，这是该领域的开创性工作。该框架由三个相互关联的组件组成：(1) Ascend-CoT，这是首个涵盖现实世界内核实现中的思维链推理的NPU内核领域数据集；(2) KernelGen-LM，这是一个基于该新颖数据集训练的、具有领域适应性的模型，采用监督微调与强化学习方法进行训练；(3) NPUKernelBench，这是首个用于评估生成的NPU内核的编译效果、正确性和性能的基准测试平台。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著弥补了硬件特定编码方面的不足：复杂二级内核的编译成功率从0%提升到了95.5%（以Pass@10为衡量标准），同时实现了64%的功能正确性。AscendKernGen的相关工具和平台可在AscendKernGen和NPUKernelBench网站上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Learning to Evolve: A Self-Improving Framework for Multi-Agent Systems via Textual Parameter Graph Optimization
papers.title_zh: 学会进化：一种通过文本参数图优化来实现多智能体系统自我改进的方法框架
papers.authors: Shan He, Runze Wang, Zhuoyun Du, Huiyu Bai, Zouying Cao, Yu Cheng, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: Designing and optimizing multi-agent systems (MAS) is a complex, labor-intensive process of “Agent Engineering.” Existing automatic optimization methods, primarily focused on flat prompt tuning, lack the structural awareness to debug the intricate web of interactions in MAS. More critically, these optimizers are static; they do not learn from experience to improve their own optimization strategies. To address these gaps, we introduce Textual Parameter Graph Optimization (TPGO), a framework that enables a multi-agent system to learn to evolve. TPGO first models the MAS as a Textual Parameter Graph (TPG), where agents, tools, and workflows are modular, optimizable nodes. To guide evolution, we derive “textual gradients,” structured natural language feedback from execution traces, to pinpoint failures and suggest granular modifications. The core of our framework is Group Relative Agent Optimization (GRAO), a novel meta-learning strategy that learns from historical optimization experiences. By analyzing past successes and failures, GRAO becomes progressively better at proposing effective updates, allowing the system to learn how to optimize itself. Extensive experiments on complex benchmarks like GAIA and MCP-Universe show that TPGO significantly enhances the performance of state-of-the-art agent frameworks, achieving higher success rates through automated, self-improving optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 设计和优化多智能体系统是一种复杂且需要大量人工劳动的“智能体工程”过程。现有的自动优化方法主要侧重于简单的参数调整，缺乏对智能体之间复杂交互关系的理解，因此难以进行调试。更糟糕的是，这些优化工具是静态的，它们不会从经验中学习以改进自身的优化策略。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了文本参数图优化框架——TPGO。该框架使多智能体系统能够自我进化。TPGO首先将多智能体系统建模为文本参数图，其中智能体、工具和工作流程都被视为可优化的模块。为了引导系统的进化，我们引入了“文本梯度”这一概念，这是一种从执行日志中提取出的结构化自然语言反馈，用于定位问题并提出具体的改进建议。我们的框架核心是一种新颖的元学习策略——群体相对智能体优化（GRAO），它可以从历史优化经验中学习。通过分析过去的成功与失败，GRAO逐渐变得更擅长提出有效的更新方案，从而让系统学会如何自我优化。在GAIA和MCP-Universe等复杂基准测试上的广泛实验表明，TPGO显著提升了最先进智能体框架的性能，通过自动化、自我改进的优化方式，实现了更高的成功率。

papers.title: Learning How to Remember: A Meta-Cognitive Management Method for Structured and Transferable Agent Memory
papers.title_zh: 学习如何记住信息：一种用于构建结构化且可迁移的智能体记忆能力的元认知管理方法
papers.authors: Sirui Liang, Pengfei Cao, Jian Zhao, Wenhao Teng, Xiangwen Liao, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on accumulated memory to solve long-horizon decision-making tasks. However, most existing approaches store memory in fixed representations and reuse it at a single or implicit level of abstraction, which limits generalization and often leads to negative transfer when distribution shift. This paper proposes the Meta-Cognitive Memory Abstraction method (MCMA), which treats memory abstraction as a learnable cognitive skill rather than a fixed design choice. MCMA decouples task execution from memory management by combining a frozen task model with a learned memory copilot. The memory copilot is trained using direct preference optimization; it determines how experience should be structured, abstracted, and reused. Memories are further organized into a hierarchy of abstraction levels, enabling selective reuse based on task similarity. When no memory is transferable, MCMA transfers the ability to abstract and manage memory by transferring the memory copilot. Experiments on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and BabyAI demonstrate substantial improvements in performance, out-of-distribution generalization, and cross-task transfer over several baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理越来越依赖累积的记忆来解决长期决策任务。然而，大多数现有方法将记忆存储以固定的形式表示，并在单一或隐式的抽象层次上进行重用，这限制了泛化能力，并且常常会导致在分布变化时出现负面迁移现象。本文提出了元认知记忆抽象方法（MCMA），该方法将记忆抽象视为一种可学习的认知技能，而非固定的设计选择。MCMA通过将固定化的任务模型与学习到的记忆辅助工具相结合，实现了任务执行与记忆管理的分离。记忆辅助工具通过直接偏好优化进行训练，它决定了经验应该如何被结构化、抽象化和重用。记忆进一步被组织成多个抽象层次，从而能够根据任务相似性进行选择性重用。当没有记忆可以转移时，MCMA通过转移记忆辅助工具来赋予抽象和管理记忆的能力。在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和BabyAI上的实验表明，与多种基准模型相比，MCMA在性能、跨分布泛化能力和跨任务迁移能力方面都取得了显著提升。

papers.title: LoRE: Enhancing Search Relevance with Progressive Chain-of-Thought and Preference Alignment
papers.title_zh: LoRE：通过渐进式的思维链与偏好匹配来提升搜索相关性
papers.authors: Chenji Lu, Zhuo Chen, Hui Zhao, Zhiyuan Zeng, Gang Zhao, Junjie Ren, Lihaoran, Songyan Liu, Pengjie Wang, Chuan Yu, Jian Xu, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: E-commerce search relevance is a critical component of retrieval systems. While Large Language Models (LLMs)-driven Chain-of-Thought (CoT) modeling has become the dominant paradigm and yielded significant gains, a critical gap remains: the absence of a systematic definition for comprehensive relevance reasoning, which leads to significant blind spots in current approaches. In this paper, we deconstruct the task into three core competencies: reasoning knowledge, multi-modal understanding, and rule awareness. Accordingly, we propose LoRE(Large Generative Model for Search Relevance), a novel two-stage training framework. We first employ an SFT phase to instill these capabilities via a progressive CoT synthesis pipeline, followed by a Reinforcement Learning(RL) phase, which serves as a regularizer, pruning redundant logic to achieve precise and robust adjudication. Extensive experiments validate LoRE, outperforming GPT-5 by 29.1% in Macro-F1 and achieving a 27% online gain, offering a vital reference for industrial domain-specific post-training.
papers.abstract_zh: 电子商务搜索相关性是检索系统中的一个关键组成部分。虽然由大语言模型驱动的思维链建模已成为主流方法，并取得了显著成果，但仍然存在一个重要问题：缺乏一套系统的全面相关性推理定义，这导致当前方法存在明显的缺陷。在本文中，我们将这一任务分解为三个核心能力：推理知识、多模态理解以及规则意识。因此，我们提出了LoRE（大型生成式模型用于搜索相关性）这一新颖的两阶段训练框架。首先通过SFT阶段逐步培养这些能力，然后通过强化学习阶段进行优化，强化学习阶段起到正则化作用，剔除冗余逻辑以实现精确且稳健的判决。大量实验验证了LoRE的有效性，其在Macro-F1指标上比GPT-5高出29.1%，在线性能提升了27%，为工业领域的后训练工作提供了重要的参考依据。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Multilingual Refusal Alignment for Safer Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 多语言拒绝机制，用于确保大型语言模型的安全性
papers.authors: Aleksandra Krasnodębska, Wojciech Kusa, Aldo Lipani
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed globally, ensuring their safety and alignment across multiple languages becomes paramount. However, safety behaviors often vary unpredictably between languages, posing significant challenges for consistent and ethical AI. In this work, we systematically investigate the dynamics of multilingual alignment, exploring whether single-language alignment transfers cross-lingually, how language consistency is preserved during training, and the resulting trade-offs with general knowledge capabilities. We introduce RefusEU a novel refusal alignment dataset covering 12 European languages, including a dedicated test set for evaluating current state-of-the-art models. Our controlled Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) experiments provide two key insights: aligning models exclusively in English is insufficient to ensure cross-lingual safety, even for the same harm categories, whereas training on multilingual datasets can improve safety without degrading general performance, as measured by the Global MMLU benchmark.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在全球范围内得到应用，确保其安全性并在多种语言中保持一致性变得至关重要。然而，不同语言之间的安全行为往往存在不可预测的差异，这给实现一致且符合伦理的人工智能带来了重大挑战。在这项研究中，我们系统地探讨了多语言对齐的动态机制，研究了单语言对齐是否能够在不同语言间进行迁移、在训练过程中如何保持语言一致性，以及由此产生的与通用知识能力之间的权衡。我们引入了RefusEU这一新的拒绝对齐数据集，该数据集涵盖了12种欧洲语言，并包含了一个专门用于评估当前最先进模型的测试集。我们的控制性直接偏好优化实验提供了两个重要发现：仅用英语对模型进行对齐不足以确保跨语言的安全性，即使针对相同的危害类别也是如此；而使用多语言数据集进行训练则可以在不降低整体性能的情况下提高安全性，这一点可以通过全球MMLU基准测试来验证。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: View-R1: Asymmetric Policy Optimization for Difficulty-Aware Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: View-R1：用于难度感知的多模态强化学习的非对称策略优化方法
papers.authors: Minjie Hong, Zirun Guo, Jiabao Zhang, Zehan Wang, Ziang Zhang, Tao Jin, Zhou Zhao
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are powerful at integrating diverse data but often struggle with complex reasoning. Reinforcement learning (RL) can enhance reasoning, yet it may cause performance degradation on general tasks and overthinking in MLLMs. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization (APO), which separates responses into positive and negative groups. For positive samples, Difficulty-Adaptive Divergence Shaping (DADS) dynamically adjusts the KL weight to stabilize training and preserve knowledge. For negative samples, Suboptimal Trajectory Complexity Regularization (STCR) penalizes overly long responses to reduce overthinking. Applied to Qwen2.5-VL, our model View-R1 achieves a 10.55% improvement in reasoning and outperforms larger models (7–11B) while not only maintaining but also slightly improving performance on general tasks. These results highlight the effectiveness and broad applicability of our DADS and STCR techniques for advancing complex multimodal reasoning in MLLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Collab-Gen/View-R1.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在整合多样化数据方面表现出强大的能力，但在复杂的推理任务上却常常遇到困难。强化学习可以提升推理能力，但可能会在一般任务中导致性能下降，并且过度推理会损害模型的效率。我们提出了一种不对称策略优化方法，该方法将响应分为正面和负面两类。对于正面样本，难度自适应发散塑形技术能够动态调整KL权重，以稳定训练并保留知识信息。对于负面样本，次优轨迹复杂性正则化技术则会对过长的响应进行惩罚，从而减少过度推理的情况。将这种方法应用于Qwen2.5-VL模型中，我们的模型View-R1在推理能力上提升了10.55%，其性能优于那些参数更大的模型（参数规模在70到110亿之间）。同时，该模型在一般任务上的表现不仅没有下降，反而有所提高。这些结果充分证明了我们的DADS和STCR技术在提升多模态大语言模型复杂推理能力方面的有效性和广泛性。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Collab-Gen/View-R1下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PseudoGD: Enhancing Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models through Pseudo Geometric Knowledge Distillation
papers.title_zh: PseudoGD：通过伪几何知识蒸馏提升视觉语言模型的空间推理能力
papers.authors: Gwanghee Lee, Yeeun Choi, Kyoungson Jhang
papers.abstract: Recent Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown remarkable success in general semantic understanding. However, they still struggle with 3D spatial reasoning tasks, such as estimating metric distances or understanding precise relative positions. Previous works, like SpatialVLM, tried to address this by using synthesized spatial VQA dataset. However, they are fundamentally limited because their vision encoders are biased toward 2D patterns learned from image-text pairs. In this paper, we argue that this lack of 3D awareness is a critical bottleneck that cannot be solved by data scaling alone. To address this, we propose Pseudo Geometric Distillation (PseudoGD), a framework designed to help vision encoders internalize 3D geometric information using only standard 2D images. PseudoGD explicitly injects metric scale and structural context into the encoder through a Joint Training strategy. This approach optimizes geometric learning and spatial VQA tasks together, ensuring that the Large Language Model (LLM) aligns well with the improved visual features in real-time. Extensive experiments on the OmniSpatial benchmark demonstrate that PseudoGD achieves State-of-the-Art (SOTA) performance across various model architectures. Notably, significant improvements in Hypothetical Perspective Taking and Locate tasks prove that our model has effectively learned a physical sense of space.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的大型视觉-语言模型在一般语义理解方面取得了显著的成功。然而，它们在3D空间推理任务上仍然存在困难，例如估算度量距离或理解精确的相对位置。之前的研究，如SpatialVLM，试图通过使用合成的空间VQA数据集来解决这个问题。然而，这些方法的根本局限性在于其视觉编码器倾向于从图像-文本对中学习到的2D模式。在本文中，我们认为这种缺乏3D感知的能力是一个关键瓶颈，仅通过数据扩展是无法解决的。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了伪几何蒸馏技术，这是一种旨在帮助视觉编码器仅使用标准2D图像来内化3D几何信息的框架。伪几何蒸馏通过联合训练策略，将度量尺度和结构上下文明确地注入到编码器中。这种方法同时优化了几何学习和空间VQA任务，确保大语言模型能够实时地与改进的视觉特征良好对齐。在OmniSpatial基准测试上的广泛实验表明，伪几何蒸馏技术在各种模型架构下都能达到最先进的性能。值得注意的是，在假设视角转换和定位任务上的显著改进证明了我们的模型已经有效地学习了空间物理感知能力。

papers.title: DMSD: Dual-Modal Semantic Disentanglement for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
papers.title_zh: DMSD：双模式语义解耦技术，用于组合式零样本学习
papers.authors: Pan Yang, Jing Yang, Ruan Xiao li, Yuling Chen, Yuankai Wu, Quan Zhou, Xu Wang
papers.abstract: The core challenge of Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL) lies in learning representations of sub-concepts (attributes and objects) from seen compositions and recognizing unseen novel compositions. Most existing CZSL methods primarily focus on prompt optimization on the textual side, while overlooking insufficient visual attribute–object sub-concepts disentanglement under a text-centric paradigm. To this end, we propose DMSD, a Dual-Modal Semantic Disentanglement framework that jointly models visual and textual information to achieve effective sub-concept disentanglement. Specifically, DMSD introduces a Contextual Prompt Space, enabling both visual and textual modalities to be modeled under unified contextual semantic representations, thereby enhancing their alignment at the latent semantic level. Moreover, we design Visual Sub-concept Prototypes that explicitly extract and model visual sub-concept features, improving the independence and discriminability of visual sub-concept representations. Furthermore, to achieve fine-grained alignment between visual and textual sub-concepts, we propose a Class-Centroid Bridging Module that guides class centroids toward the textual semantic space, thereby ensuring cross-modal semantic consistency. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets (MIT-States, UT-Zappos, and C-GQA) demonstrate that DMSD achieves state-of-the-art performance in both closed-world and open-world settings. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DMSD-9CC4.
papers.abstract_zh: 组合式零样本学习（Compositional Zero-Shot Learning，CZSL）的核心挑战在于：从已观察到的组合模式中学习子概念（属性和对象）的表示，同时识别未见过的新型组合模式。目前大多数CZSL方法主要关注文本层面的提示优化，而忽视了在以文本为中心的框架下，视觉属性与对象的子概念分离不足的问题。为此，我们提出了DMSD——一个双模态语义分离框架，该框架能够联合建模视觉和文本信息，从而实现有效的子概念分离。具体来说，DMSD引入了情境性提示空间，使得视觉和文本模态能够在统一的情境语义表示下被建模，从而提升它们在潜在语义层面的对齐程度。此外，我们还设计了视觉子概念原型，这些原型能够明确提取并建模视觉子概念特征，进而提高视觉子概念表示的独立性和区分性。为了实现视觉和文本子概念之间的细粒度对齐，我们提出了一种类中心融合模块，该模块引导类中心向文本语义空间移动，从而确保跨模态的语义一致性。在三个基准数据集（MIT-States、UT-Zappos和C-GQA）上的广泛实验表明，DMSD在封闭世界和开放世界环境中均取得了领先的性能。我们的代码可访问于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DMSD-9CC4。

papers.title: ReFreeKV: Towards Threshold-Free KV Cache Compression
papers.title_zh: ReFreeKV：迈向无阈值级别的KV缓存压缩技术
papers.authors: Xuanfan Ni, Liyan Xu, Chenyang Lyu, Longyue Wang, Mo Yu, Lemao Liu, Fandong Meng, Jie Zhou, Piji Li
papers.abstract: To reduce memory consumption during LLM inference, a handful of methods have been proposed for KV cache pruning.While these techniques can accomplish lossless memory reduction on many datasets, they often hinge on an under-emphasized condition: an input/domain-specific threshold for KV cache budget needs to be pre-determined to achieve the optimal performance.However, such input-sensitive design may be considerably limited in real-world scenarios, as open-domain inputs span diverse domains, lengths and difficulty levels, without clear boundaries for threshold selection.As a result, the dependence of such input-sensitive threshold can be a fundamental limitation that causes large degradation on arbitrary inputs.In this work, we propose a new objective that lifts the threshold constraints for robust KV compression, advocating for “threshold-free” methods that adaptively adjust budget allocation while preserving full-cache performance.We then propose a novel method, ReFreeKV, serving as the first instantiation of this objective. Extensive experiments across 13 datasets with diverse context lengths, task types, and model sizes demonstrate its efficacy and efficiency. Our code is publicly released at https://github.com/Patrick-Ni/ReFreeKV.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了降低大语言模型推理过程中的内存消耗，人们提出了多种KV缓存修剪的方法。虽然这些技术能够在许多数据集上实现无损的内存减少，但它们往往依赖于一个被忽视的条件：需要预先确定KV缓存预算的输入/领域特定阈值，才能达到最佳性能。然而，这种依赖输入的设计在现实场景中可能会受到很大限制，因为开放领域的输入涵盖了多种多样的领域、长度以及难度级别，而阈值选择的边界并不明确。因此，这种依赖输入阈值的设计可能是一个根本性的限制因素，会导致在任意输入上的性能大幅下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的目标，即消除阈值约束，以实现稳健的KV压缩。我们提倡使用“无阈值”的方法，这些方法能够自适应地调整预算分配，同时保持良好的全缓存性能。随后，我们提出了一种新颖的方法ReFreeKV，作为实现这一目标的第一个实例。我们在13个不同数据集上进行了广泛的实验，这些数据集包括不同长度的上下文、不同类型的任务以及不同大小的模型，实验结果证明了该方法的有效性和高效性。我们的代码已公开发布，地址为https://github.com/Patrick-Ni/ReFreeKV。

papers.title: Safety Sidecar: Reflection-Driven Runtime Control for Safer Agents
papers.title_zh: 安全侧车：基于反射的运行时控制，以实现更安全的智能体
papers.authors: Wang Bin, Quan Jiazheng, Xingrui Yu, Hu Hansen, Yu Hao, Anjun Gao, Zhenglin Wan, Hui LI, Ivor Tsang
papers.abstract: Autonomous LLM agents are increasingly deployed in complex environments as tool-using systems. However, their safety remains fragile, as minor reasoning or retrieval errors can be amplified into hazardous actions within the agentic workflow. Existing defenses, often limited to static prompts or post-hoc guardrails, fail to provide runtime intervention or cross-architecture portability. In this paper, we propose Safety Sidecar, a model-agnostic, plug-and-play module designed to provide standardized runtime safety control and auditability for arbitrary agent workflows. Safety Sidecar operationalizes reflection as a closed-loop controller: it dynamically monitors decision traces, retrieves evidence-based repair exemplars from a reflective memory, and enforces risk-mitigating revisions before execution. Crucially, it employs external verifiers to gate both action release and memory updates, producing a transparent, auditable trail of retrieved evidence and applied constraints.We instantiate and systematically evaluate Safety Sidecar in secure code generation—a high-stakes domain with objective vulnerability signals. Experimental results across eight CWE scenarios and four representative LLMs demonstrate that Safety Sidecar consistently improves the secure-solution rate by 2.9–11.2 percentage points while maintaining competitive functional correctness. Efficiency analysis shows the framework is practical for deployment, with reflection adding only 3.2s to end-to-end latency and a negligible average cost of 5.37 \times 10^{-4} per scenario. Our findings position Safety Sidecar as a portable and efficient control layer for enhancing the safety, compliance, and auditability of LLM-based agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 自主的大语言模型代理越来越多地被部署在复杂环境中，作为工具使用系统。然而，它们的安全性仍然很脆弱，因为轻微的推理或检索错误可能会在代理的工作流程中引发危险的行为。现有的防御措施往往仅限于静态提示或事后性的防护措施，无法提供运行时干预或跨架构的可移植性。在本文中，我们提出了Safety Sidecar这一模型不可知的即插即用模块，旨在为任意代理工作流程提供标准化的运行时安全控制和可审计性。Safety Sidecar通过将反射机制作为闭环控制器来运作：它动态监控决策轨迹，从反射式记忆中检索基于证据的修复示例，并在执行前实施降低风险的操作。关键的是，它采用外部验证器来管控动作发布和内存更新，从而生成一份透明且可审计的证据记录以及应用的约束条件。我们在具有明确漏洞信号的高风险领域——安全代码生成中，对Safety Sidecar进行了实例化和系统评估。在八个CWE场景和四个代表性的大语言模型上的实验结果表明，Safety Sidecar能够持续提高安全解决方案的准确率，幅度为2.9%至11.2%，同时保持了竞争性的功能正确性。效率分析表明，该框架在部署方面非常实用，反射机制仅增加了3.2秒的端到端延迟，每场景的平均成本仅为5.37×10^-4。我们的研究结果使Safety Sidecar成为提升基于大语言模型的代理的安全性、合规性和可审计性的一种便携且高效的控制层。

papers.title: MCGA: A Multi-task Classical Chinese Literary Genre Audio Corpus
papers.title_zh: MCGA：一种多任务型古典中文文学体裁的音频语料库
papers.authors: Yexing Du, Kaiyuan Liu, Bihe Zhang, Youcheng Pan, Bo Yang, Liangyu Huo, Xiyuan Zhang, Jian Xie, Daojing He, Yang Xiang, Ming Liu, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), their potential has gained significant attention in Chinese Classical Studies (CCS). While existing research primarily focuses on text and visual modalities, the audio corpus within this domain remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Multi-task Classical Chinese Literary Genre Audio Corpus (MCGA), a 119-hour corpus comprising 22,000 audio samples. It encompasses a diverse range of literary genres across six tasks: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Speech-to-Text Translation (S2TT), Speech Emotion Captioning (SEC), Spoken Question Answering (SQA), Speech Understanding (SU), and Speech Reasoning (SR). Through the evaluation of ten MLLMs, our experimental results demonstrate that current MLLMs still face substantial challenges on the MCGA test set. Furthermore, we introduce a domain-specific metric for SEC and a metric to measure the consistency between speech and text capabilities. We release MCGA to the public to facilitate the development of more robust MLLMs. MCGA Corpus: https://github.com/yxduir/MCGA
papers.abstract_zh: 随着多模态大语言模型的发展，它们在汉语古典研究领域的潜力受到了广泛关注。虽然现有的研究主要集中在文本和视觉模态上，但音频数据在这一领域仍然没有得到充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了多任务汉语古典文学体裁音频语料库（MCGA），该语料库包含119小时的音频样本，共计22,000个音频片段。该语料库涵盖了六种不同任务的文学体裁：自动语音识别、语音转文本翻译、语音情感标注、口语问答、语音理解以及语音推理。通过对十种多模态语言模型的评估，我们的实验结果表明，目前的多模态语言模型在MCGA测试集上仍然存在较大的挑战。此外，我们还为语音情感标注任务引入了一种特定领域的评估指标，以及用于衡量语音与文本能力一致性的指标。我们将MCGA语料库公开，以促进更强大的多模态语言模型的发展。MCGA语料库链接：https://github.com/yxduir/MCGA

papers.title: VET: Verifiable Execution Tracing for Reliable Text-to-SQL Generation
papers.title_zh: VET：可验证的执行跟踪技术，用于确保文本到SQL生成的可靠性
papers.authors: Dongyu Wang, Jingyu Li, Lan Zhang, Ganggang Yu, Liang Huang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in text-to-SQL generation, yet existing approaches remain prone to hallucinations and lack verification mechanisms. Current methods such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and Program-of-Thought (PoT) typically rely on intermediate reasoning that is either purely textual or executed only as a final step, leaving the reasoning process opaque and prone to grounding and logical hallucinations. In this paper, we introduce Verifiable Execution Tracing (VET), a novel reasoning paradigm that transforms text-to-SQL from unverifiable textual rationales into step-wise executable semantics. VET addresses these limitations by constraining the reasoning process within a candidate schema space and formulating it as a sequence of executable Python steps. Crucially, each step is executed against the real database to produce observable intermediate results, which serve as immediate verification feedback and transform the traditionally opaque generation process into a transparent, debuggable interaction with database reality.Experiments show consistent gains under matched, training-free settings, achieving 70.93% execution accuracy on BIRD and 37.04% on Spider 2.0-lite, with particularly strong improvements on complex queries.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在文本转SQL生成方面展现出了显著的能力，但现有的方法仍然容易出现幻觉现象，且缺乏验证机制。当前的方法如思维链推理和程序性推理，通常依赖于纯文本性的中间推理过程，或者仅作为最后一步执行，这使得推理过程变得不透明，容易产生逻辑上的错误。在本文中，我们提出了可验证执行追踪技术，这是一种新的推理范式，它将文本转SQL的过程从不可验证的文本理由转化为可逐步执行的语义。通过将推理过程限制在一个候选模式空间中，并将其表述为一系列可执行的Python步骤，VET能够解决这些局限性。关键在于，每个步骤都是针对真实数据库执行的，从而产生可观察的中间结果，这些结果可以作为即时验证的反馈，从而将传统上不透明的生成过程转变为与数据库现实进行透明、可调试的交互。实验表明，在匹配且无训练的情况下，该技术的性能有显著提升，在BIRD任务上的执行准确率达到了70.93%，在Spider 2.0-lite任务上达到了37.04%。特别是在处理复杂查询时，其性能得到了特别显著的提升。
