papers.title: Trident: Self-Supervised Preference Alignment via Triplet Regularization
papers.title_zh: Trident：通过三元组正则化实现自监督偏好对齐
papers.authors: Yingnan Guo, Kejia Chen, Xiaofeng Zhang, Zifei Wu, Yu Zhang
papers.abstract: Aligning Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to mitigate hallucinations typically relies on high-quality preference data. However, in self-supervised settings, standard binary preference optimization (e.g., DPO) suffers from noisy supervision and semantic ambiguity, as automatically generated chosen responses are not guaranteed to be superior to rejected ones. In this work, we propose Trident, a fully self-supervised framework that ensures robust alignment via a structured triplet paradigm. Trident autonomously constructs reliable preference triplets—comprising semantically enriched (chosen), degraded (rejected), and neutral (anchor) responses—through automated visual perturbations and self-summarization. We further introduce Trident Preference Regularization (TPR), a novel objective that utilizes an adaptive margin to enforce semantic separation between the triplet components while preventing deviation from the pretrained distribution. Despite requiring no human annotations or external reward models, Trident consistently outperforms state-of-the-art RLHF and RLAIF baselines. For instance, on LLaVA-1.5-7B, it reduces the hallucination rate on AMBER to 11.3% and achieves 95.70% precision on POPE using only 4k self-generated triplets and a single epoch. This validates structured triplet supervision as a scalable paradigm for robust self-supervised alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大型视觉语言模型进行对齐以缓解幻觉问题，通常需要高质量的偏好数据。然而，在自监督场景中，传统的二元偏好优化方法存在监督数据噪声较大以及语义模糊的问题，因为自动生成的“选择”响应并不一定能优于“拒绝”的响应。在这项研究中，我们提出了Trident框架——一个完全自监督的框架，它通过结构化的三元组范式来确保鲁棒的对齐效果。Trident能够自动构建可靠的三元组数据，这些三元组包含语义上丰富、“选择”的响应、被“拒绝”的响应以及中性的响应。此外，我们还引入了Trident偏好正则化技术，这是一种新颖的目标函数，它利用自适应边界来强制三元组各组成部分之间的语义分离，同时防止偏离预训练分布。尽管Trident不需要人类注释或外部奖励模型，但它仍然能够始终优于现有的最先进的RLHF和RLAIFF基线算法。例如，在LaVA-1.5-7B数据集上，仅使用4000个自生成的三元组数据和单个训练周期，Trident就将AMBER数据集上的幻觉率降低了11.3%，并在POPE任务上实现了95.70%的准确率。这验证了结构化三元组监督作为一种可扩展的自监督对齐方法的有效性。

papers.title: Why Do Multilingual Reasoning Gaps Emerge in Reasoning Language Models?
papers.title_zh: 为什么在推理语言模型中会出现多语言推理的差距？
papers.authors: Deokhyung Kang, Seonjeong Hwang, Daehui Kim, Hyounghun Kim, Gary Lee
papers.abstract: Reasoning language models (RLMs) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, yet they still exhibit a multilingual reasoning gap, performing better in high-resource languages than in low-resource ones. While recent efforts have been made to address this gap, its underlying causes remain largely unexplored. In this work, we show that this gap primarily stems from failures in language understanding—specifically, the model’s inability to translate multilingual inputs into the language dominating its reasoning traces (typically English). As identifying understanding failures can enable targeted mitigation of the gap, we evaluate a range of detection methods and find that understanding failures are detectable to a meaningful extent, with supervised approaches performing best. Building on this, we propose Selective Translation, a strategy that incorporates an English translation into the initial reasoning trace when an understanding failure is detected. Experimental results using Qwen3-4B show that Selective Translation substantially bridges the multilingual reasoning gap, achieving near full-translation performance while translating only about 20% of inputs. Together, our results show that failures in language understanding are the primary driver of the multilingual reasoning gap and can be detected and selectively mitigated, clarifying its origin and suggesting a path toward more equitable multilingual reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理语言模型在复杂的推理任务上表现优异，但仍然存在多语言推理方面的差距，即在资源丰富的语言中的表现优于资源匮乏的语言。虽然最近有一些努力试图解决这一差距，但其根本原因仍未被充分研究。在这项研究中，我们发现这种差距主要源于语言理解方面的缺陷——具体来说，模型无法将多语言输入转化为其推理过程中所使用的主导语言（通常是英语）。由于能够识别这些理解上的缺陷，可以针对性地缓解这一差距，因此我们评估了多种检测方法，发现这些缺陷是可以被有效检测到的，其中基于监督的方法表现最佳。在此基础上，我们提出了“选择性翻译”策略，该策略在检测到理解缺陷时，会在初始推理过程中加入英语翻译。使用Qwen3-4B进行的实验结果表明，“选择性翻译”策略显著缩小了多语言推理的差距，尽管只翻译了大约20%的输入，但仍实现了接近完全翻译的性能。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，语言理解方面的缺陷是多语言推理差距的主要成因，这些缺陷是可以被检测和选择性解决的，这为更公平的多语言推理提供了方向。

papers.title: EvoMemKG: An Evolvable Memory Agent for Multi-hop Knowledge Graph Reasoning
papers.title_zh: EvoMemKG：一种可进化的记忆代理，适用于多跳知识图谱推理
papers.authors: Shiyu Tian, Shuyue Xing, Zhuoxin Han, Caixia Yuan, Xiaojie Wang
papers.abstract: Integrating knowledge graphs (KGs) with large language models (LLMs) enhances factual accuracy and interpretability in question answering. However, existing agent-based methods rely on static memory mechanisms that fail to address the combinatorial explosion of search spaces in multi-hop reasoning and lack continuous learning capabilities. To overcome these limitations, we propose EvoMemKG, an agent framework with a dynamic, evolvable memory mechanism specifically designed for KG reasoning. EvoMemKG features a dual-layer memory architecture: (1) a working memory that losslessly compresses retrieved triplets through clustering to manage exploration states, effectively linearizing the exponential state space expansion; and (2) an experience memory that abstracts historical reasoning paths into reusable, generalized strategies, enabling cross-task knowledge transfer and self-evolution. We further introduce a double-loop workflow that orchestrates the LLM, memory layers, and KG environment to enable end-to-end autonomous reasoning. Extensive evaluations on three KGQA datasets across two KGs demonstrate that EvoMemKG achieves state-of-the-art performance without requiring additional training or specialized tools. Notably, it achieves improvements of up to 20% over the strong baseline on complex multi-hop queries, validating the effectiveness of our dynamic memory approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 将知识图谱与大语言模型相结合，能够提升问答中的事实准确性和可解释性。然而，现有的基于代理的方法依赖于静态的记忆机制，无法有效处理多跳推理中搜索空间的爆炸性问题，且缺乏持续学习的能力。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了EvoMemKG这一代理框架，它拥有一种动态的可进化记忆机制，专门用于知识图谱推理。EvoMemKG采用了双层记忆架构：(1)工作记忆通过聚类技术无损压缩检索到的三元组，以管理探索状态，从而有效线性化指数级的状态空间扩展；(2)经验记忆则将历史推理路径抽象为可复用的通用策略，从而实现跨任务的知识转移和自我进化。我们还引入了一种双循环工作流程，协调LLM、记忆层以及知识图谱环境，以实现端到端的自主推理。在三个不同的知识图谱问答数据集上的广泛测试表明，EvoMemKG无需额外的训练或专用工具就能达到最先进的性能水平。值得注意的是，在处理复杂的多跳查询时，其性能相比强大的基线方法提升了20%，这验证了我们的动态记忆方法的有效性。

papers.title: Scaling Laws or Threshold Effects: Exploring the Optimal Vocabulary Size for Balancing Performance and Efficiency in Low-Resource Languages
papers.title_zh: 规模定律或阈值效应：探索在资源有限的语言中，实现性能与效率平衡的最佳词汇量水平
papers.authors: Ao Han, Andong Chen, Yuan Sun, Xiaobing Zhao
papers.abstract: While vocabulary expansion scaling laws are well-established for high-resource languages, they remain unverified in low-resource settings. This gap is particularly critical for Byte-level BPE (BBPE), where constrained vocabulary sizes often fail to capture the rich morphemes of complex scripts, leading to severe over-segmentation in languages such as Mongolian, Tibetan, and Uyghur. We systematically investigate jointly-scaled trilingual vocabulary for these languages (140 to 195,000 tokens) across BPE (Llama 2) and BBPE (Qwen2.5/3) architectures. Our results reveal that BBPE follows a “decline-then-rise” pattern, requiring a 9,000-token threshold (3,000 per language) to trigger non-linear performance gains and inference acceleration, whereas BPE improves monotonically. Using Pareto Frontier Analysis, we identify an optimal 79,500-token configuration for BBPE that reduces continuous pre-training duration by over 71% across 1.5B to 8B parameter models while consistently enhancing downstream performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然词汇扩展的缩放规律在高资源语言中已经得到充分验证，但在低资源环境下这些规律仍未被证实。对于字节级BPE来说，这一差距尤为明显——由于词汇量受限，往往无法捕捉到复杂文字系统中的丰富词素，从而导致蒙古语、藏语和维吾尔语等语言出现严重的过度分割现象。我们系统地研究了这些语言的联合缩放三语词汇体系（140至195,000个标记），并分别使用BPE（Llama 2）和BBPE（Qwen2.5/3）架构进行了研究。我们的结果表明，BBPE遵循“先下降后上升”的模式，需要达到9,000个标记的阈值（每种语言3,000个标记）才能触发非线性的性能提升和推理加速，而BPE则表现为单调性的改进。通过帕累托前沿分析，我们找到了一种最优的79,500个标记配置方案，该方案可以将连续预训练的时间缩短超过71%，同时还能持续提升下游性能。

papers.title: RouterHGC: Optimized Router for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems via Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Learning
papers.title_zh: RouterHGC：通过异构图对比学习优化出的适用于基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的路由器
papers.authors: Yitao Xiao, Shaoyong Guo, Guoming Yang, Qingnan Wang, Yinlin Ren, Xuesong Qiu, Qi Feng
papers.abstract: Leveraging powerful planning and reasoning capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs)-driven Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have demonstrated remarkable scalability and generalizability across complex tasks. However, dynamically routing the optimal combination of agents and collaboration modes for a given query to balance performance and cost remains challenging. To address the limitation of prior work, which focuses on single-agent settings and overlooks collaborative structures and role assignment in MAS, we propose RouterHGC, the first heterogeneous graph contrastive learning framework for MAS routing. We formalize routing as node selection through edge-weight prediction on a heterogeneous graph whose node types include user queries, collaboration modes, agent roles, and LLMs, with message passing capturing their high-order dependencies. We further design a novel global–local contrastive loss function to jointly optimize graph-level representations and edge-level selections, pulling each query graph toward high-performing positives while pushing it away from underperforming or costly negatives. Experiments on five public datasets covering mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge question answering show that RouterHGC outperforms the best single LLM and baselines, achieving 0.80%–6.17% accuracy gains on MATH and HotpotQA while reducing inference cost by 27.40%.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用强大的规划和推理能力，由大语言模型驱动的多智能体系统在复杂的任务中展现出了显著的可扩展性和通用性。然而，为给定的查询动态调度最优的智能体和协作模式组合以平衡性能与成本仍然是一个挑战。为了克服以往研究的局限性——这些研究主要关注单一智能体的情况，而忽略了多智能体系统中的协作结构和角色分配问题，我们提出了RouterHGC这一首个用于多智能体路由的异构图对比学习框架。我们将路由过程定义为通过边缘权重预测来选择节点，该异构图的节点类型包括用户查询、协作模式、智能体角色以及大语言模型；消息传递则用于捕捉它们之间的高阶依赖关系。我们还设计了一种新颖的全局-局部对比损失函数，以联合优化图级表示和边级选择，使每个查询图都能朝着高性能的正例方向发展，同时避免陷入性能不佳或成本过高的负例。在涵盖数学推理、代码生成和知识问答等五个公共数据集上的实验表明，RouterHGC的表现优于最优秀的单一语言模型和基线方法，在MATH和HotpotQA任务上实现了0.80%至6.17%的准确率提升，同时还将推理成本降低了27.40%。

papers.title: Grouped Adaptive Weight Sharing (GAWS): An Inference-Efficient Adaptation Method for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 分组自适应权重分配：一种适用于大型语言模型的推理高效适应方法
papers.authors: Eman Alsuradi, Junhyun Lee, Kyenghun Lee, Hyeonmok Ko, Fahed Jubair
papers.abstract: Although Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) revolutionized parameter-efficient fine-tuning, it often incurs an inference overhead due to the extra computation required by adapter layers. While most literature focuses on maximizing accuracy or minimizing parameter counts, this paper prioritizes single-request inference performance in the unmerged adapter setting, where adapters must remain decoupled from the base model at runtime. By analyzing LoRA adapters on GPUs, we identify segmented function calls as the primary source of this latency. To address this, we propose Grouped Adaptive Weight Sharing (GAWS), a novel adapter design based on structured Kronecker product decomposition. Experiments on T5-3B, GPT-2 Large, LLaMA3.2-3B, and RoBERTa-Large show that GAWS reduces latency to about 40% of the gap between the unmerged LoRA and the base model, while maintaining parameter efficiency and comparable accuracy. This positions GAWS as a Pareto-efficient solution for deploying adapted LLMs in latency-sensitive settings, balancing the high latency of compressed adapters with the accuracy of LoRA. The source code is available at:https://github.com/SamsungLabs/GAWS .
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管低秩适应（LoRA）技术彻底改变了参数高效微调的方式，但由于适配器层需要额外的计算开销，它通常会带来一定的推理延迟。虽然大多数研究都致力于提高准确率或减少参数数量，但本文重点关注在未合并适配器设置下的单次请求推理性能——在这种设置中，适配器在运行时必须与基础模型分离。通过对GPU上的LoRA适配器进行分析，我们发现分段式函数调用是造成这种延迟的主要原因。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了分组自适应权重共享（GAWS）这一新型适配器设计，该设计基于结构化的Kronecker分解方法。在T5-3B、GPT-2 Large、LLaMA3.2-3B和RoBERTa-Large上进行实验表明，GAWS能够将延迟降低到未合并LoRA与基础模型之间差距的约40%，同时还能保持参数效率和相当的准确率。因此，GAWS成为一种在延迟敏感环境下部署适配过的LLM的帕累托最优解决方案，它能够在压缩适配器的高延迟问题和LoRA的准确率之间找到平衡。源代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/SamsungLabs/GAWS

papers.title: Lending Eyesight to Language Models: Modeling and Probing Human scanpath through Transformer Decoder
papers.title_zh: 赋予语言模型视觉能力：通过Transformer解码器模拟和探索人类扫描路径的行为
papers.authors: Junlin Li, David Robert Reich, Yu-Yin Hsu
papers.abstract: Human scanpaths offer rich and reliable clues about the cognitive mechanisms underlying language comprehension. Decoder-only language models, typically large language models (LLMs), have proven to exhibit striking parallels with human cognitive processes. In this study, we investigate to what extent language models can be endowed with human-like gaze shifts. Besides, by probing scanpath through eye model, analogous to probing language through language models, we ask whether such modeling can yield novel knowledge of the cognitive machinery of sense making.This study presents a novel plug-and-play module, EyeLM, to transform an autoregressive language model into an autoregressive eye model, thus facilitating a probabilistic spatial modeling of human explicit attention. Our EyeLM module, powered by LLMs, achieves competitive performance with novel cognitive probing capabilities. By probing EyeLM, we can reach the predictability and uncertainty of the scanpath. Exhibiting aligned patterns with prior knowledge about human reading comprehension, these probabilistic measures of scanpath act as promising predictors of human comprehension skills.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类的扫描路径为我们提供了关于语言理解背后认知机制的丰富而可靠的线索。仅用于解码的语言模型，通常是大语言模型，其表现与人类认知过程有着惊人的相似性。在这项研究中，我们探讨了语言模型在多大程度上可以具备类似人类的注视转移行为。此外，通过利用眼睛模型来探究扫描路径，就像通过语言模型来探究语言一样，我们试图了解这种建模是否能够带来关于意义构建的认知机制的新知识。本研究提出了一种新型的即插即用模块——EyeLM，它能够将自回归语言模型转化为自回归眼睛模型，从而实现对人类显性注意力的概率性空间建模。我们的EyeLM模块由大语言模型驱动，其性能相当出色，同时具备新颖的认知探测能力。通过对EyeLM进行探测，我们可以了解扫描路径的可预测性和不确定性。这些与先前关于人类阅读理解知识的对齐模式相关的概率性扫描路径测量指标，有望成为预测人类理解能力的有效工具。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Timesteps of Mamba Align with Human Reading Times
papers.title_zh: 曼巴的节奏与人类阅读的时间段相契合
papers.authors: Yuji Yamamoto, Shinnosuke Isono, Yoshinobu Kawahara, Sho Yokoi
papers.abstract: This study demonstrates an alignment of per-word processing time in a popular state-space language model Mamba and human readers. In Mamba, the recurrent state transition at each layer conceptually takes some duration of time, the discretization timestep \Delta_t, determined dynamically in response to the input. Using a naturalistic reading dataset, we show that the per-word timestep from Mamba is a powerful predictor of human reading times, comparable to strong baselines such as word frequency and GPT-2 surprisal and significant even when they are controlled for. We further suggest, through formal analysis of Mamba’s architecture and internal dynamics, that Mamba can serve as a new, valuable lens to look at human real-time language processing with ever-updated memory, because it allows us to look at how each module (layer) weighs short- and long-term information retention, and how noise may interact with dynamic, continuous memory representation. Code is available via an (anonymized) link.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究证明了流行的状态空间语言模型Mamba与人类阅读者在处理单词时的时间消耗存在一致性。在Mamba中，每一层的循环状态转换都会持续一定的时间，这个时间间隔被称为离散化时间步长Δt，它是根据输入数据动态确定的。通过使用自然阅读数据集进行实验，我们发现Mamba中的单词处理时间步长是预测人类阅读时间的有效指标，其准确性可与词频、GPT-2的惊喜值等强大的基线方法相媲美，即使在这些因素也被考虑进来的情况下也是如此。此外，通过对Mamba的架构和内部机制进行深入分析，我们认为Mamba可以作为一种新的有价值的工具，用于观察人类实时语言处理的过程。因为它能够让我们了解每个模块如何权衡短期和长期的信息存储能力，以及噪声如何与动态、连续的内存表示进行交互。相关代码可通过匿名链接获取。

papers.title: Astra: Activation-Space Tail-Eigenvector Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: Astra：基于激活空间尾部特征向量的低秩适应方法，用于大型语言模型
papers.authors: Kainan Liu, Yong Zhang, Ning Cheng, Yun Zhu, Yanmeng Wang, Shaojun Wang, Jing Xiao
papers.abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods, especially LoRA, are widely used for adapting pre-trained models to downstream tasks due to their computational and storage efficiency. However, in the context of LoRA and its variants, the potential of activation subspaces corresponding to tail eigenvectors remains substantially under-exploited, which may lead to suboptimal fine-tuning performance. In this work, we propose Astra (Activation-Space Tail-Eigenvector Low-Rank Adaptation), a novel PEFT method that leverages the tail eigenvectors of the model output activations—estimated from a small task-specific calibration set—to construct task-adaptive low-rank adapters. By constraining updates to the subspace spanned by these tail eigenvectors, Astra achieves faster convergence and improved downstream performance with a significantly reduced parameter budget. Extensive experiments across natural language understanding (NLU) and natural language generation (NLG) tasks demonstrate that Astra consistently outperforms existing PEFT baselines across 16 benchmarks and even surpasses full fine-tuning (FFT) in certain scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法，尤其是LoRA，因其计算效率和存储效率而被广泛用于调整预训练模型以适应下游任务。然而，在LoRA及其变体的应用中，与尾部特征向量相对应的激活子空间的潜力仍然被严重忽视了，这可能导致微调性能不佳。在这项研究中，我们提出了Astra这一新型PEFT方法。该方法利用模型输出激活的尾部特征向量——这些特征向量是从一个小型的、特定任务的校准集中估计出来的——来构建适应任务的低秩适配器。通过限制更新操作仅发生在这些尾部特征向量所构成的子空间内，Astra能够实现更快的收敛速度，并提升下游任务的性能，同时显著降低了参数使用量。在自然语言理解（NLU）和自然语言生成（NLG）任务中的大量实验表明，Astra在16个基准测试中的表现始终优于现有的PEFT基线方法，甚至在某些场景下还超越了全微调方法（FFT）。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AROMA: Augmented Reasoning Over a Multimodal Architecture for Virtual Cell Genetic Perturbation Modeling
papers.title_zh: AROMA：基于多模态架构的增强推理技术，用于虚拟细胞遗传扰动建模
papers.authors: Wang Zhenyu, Geyan Ye, Wei Liu, Man Tat Alexander Ng
papers.abstract: Virtual cell modeling predicts molecular state changes under genetic perturbations in silico, which is essential for biological mechanism studies. However, existing approaches suffer from unconstrained reasoning, uninterpretable predictions, and retrieval signals that are weakly aligned with regulatory topology. To address these limitations, we propose AROMA, an Augmented Reasoning Over a Multimodal Architecture for virtual cell genetic perturbation modeling. AROMA integrates textual evidence, graph-topology information, and protein sequence features to model perturbation-target dependencies, and is trained with a two-stage optimization strategy to yield predictions that are both accurate and interpretable. We also construct two knowledge graphs and a perturbation reasoning dataset, PerturbReason, containing more than 498k samples, as reusable resources for the virtual cell domain. Experiments show that AROMA outperforms existing methods across multiple cell lines, and remains robust under zero-shot evaluation on an unseen cell line, as well as in knowledge-sparse, long-tail scenarios. Overall, AROMA demonstrates that combining knowledge-driven multimodal modeling with evidence retrieval provides a promising pathway toward more reliable and interpretable virtual cell perturbation prediction. Model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/blazerye/AROMA. Code is available at https://github.com/blazerye/AROMA.
papers.abstract_zh: 虚拟细胞建模能够预测在基因扰动下分子状态的变化，这对于生物机制的研究至关重要。然而，现有的方法存在推理不严格、预测结果难以解释，以及检索信号与调控拓扑结构不匹配等问题。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了AROMA——一种基于多模态架构的增强推理技术，用于虚拟细胞基因扰动建模。AROMA整合了文本证据、图拓扑信息以及蛋白质序列特征，以模拟扰动目标之间的依赖关系。该模型采用两阶段优化策略进行训练，从而得出既准确又易于解释的预测结果。我们还构建了两个知识图谱以及一个名为PerturbReason的扰动推理数据集，该数据集包含超过498k个样本，可以作为虚拟细胞领域中的可复用资源。实验表明，AROMA在多种细胞系上均优于现有方法，并且在面对未知细胞系时仍能保持鲁棒性，同时在处理知识稀疏、长尾场景时也表现出良好的性能。总体而言，AROMA证明了将知识驱动的多模态建模与证据检索相结合，可以为更可靠且易于解释的虚拟细胞扰动预测提供一条有前景的路径。模型权重可以在https://huggingface.co/blazerye/AROMA获取，代码则可在https://github.com/blazerye/AROMA下载。

papers.title: Exploring Two-Phase Continual Instruction Fine-tuning for Multilingual Adaptation in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 探索用于大型语言模型的多语言适应的双阶段持续指令微调方法
papers.authors: Divyanshu Aggarwal, Sankarshan Damle, Navin Goyal, Satya Lokam, Sunayana Sitaram
papers.abstract: A key challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) is improving their Multilingual instruction-following ability over time without deteriorating their ability in languages they already excel at, typically English. In this paper, we study a two-phase Continual Fine-tuning (CFT) setup toward improving a model’s Multilingual adaptability. Concretely, we consider a two-phase CFT process in which an English-only end-to-end instruction fine-tuned LLM (Phase 1) is sequentially fine-tuned on a multilingual instruction dataset (Phase 2). Across MISTRAL-7B and LLAMA-3-8B and multiple dataset pairs, we show that instructional similarity between phases is critical: aligned datasets preserve or improve English while boosting multilingual ability, whereas misaligned datasets cause English degradation. We show that this degradation arises from representation shift during CFT, and that targeted mitigation strategies, including generative replay and heuristic-based layer freezing, reduce this shift and improve multilingual adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型面临的一个关键挑战是，如何在不降低其擅长语言的性能的情况下，持续提升其多语言处理能力。在本文中，我们提出了一种分两阶段的持续微调方法，以提升模型的多语言适应能力。具体来说，我们采用了一种分阶段的微调流程：首先对一个仅支持英语的端到端指令进行微调（第一阶段），然后在此基础上，再对一个多语言指令数据集进行微调（第二阶段）。通过对比MISTRAL-7B和LLAMA-3-8B这两个模型以及多种数据集组合，我们发现不同阶段之间的指令相关性至关重要：如果数据集之间的一致性良好，那么模型的英语能力会得到提升，多语言能力也会相应增强；而如果数据集之间的一致性不佳，模型的英语能力就会下降。我们发现这种下降是由于在微调过程中出现的表示方式变化所导致的。因此，我们可以采用一些针对性的缓解策略来减少这种变化，比如利用生成式重放技术或基于启发式的层冻结方法，从而提升模型的多语言适应能力。

papers.title: SCALER: Synthetic Scalable Adaptive Learning Environment for Reasoning
papers.title_zh: SCALER：一种用于推理的、可扩展的自适应学习环境
papers.authors: Caijun Xu, Changyi Xiao, Zhongyuan Peng, Xinrun Wang, Yixin Cao
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a principled way to enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models, yet its effectiveness hinges on training signals that remain informative as models evolve. In practice, RL progress often slows when task difficulty becomes poorly aligned with model capability or when training is dominated by a narrow set of recurring problem patterns.To jointly address these issues, we propose SCALER (Synthetic sCalable Adaptive Learning Environment for Reasoning), a framework that sustains effective learning signals through adaptive environment design.SCALER introduces a scalable synthesis pipeline that converts real-world programming problems into verifiable reasoning environments with controllable difficulty and unbounded instance generation, enabling RL training beyond finite datasets while preserving strong correctness guarantees. Building on this, SCALER further employs an adaptive multi-environment RL strategy that dynamically adjusts instance difficulty and curates the active set of environments to track the model’s capability frontier and maintain distributional diversity. This co-adaptation prevents reward sparsity, mitigates overfitting to narrow task patterns, and supports sustained improvement throughout training. Extensive experiments show that SCALER consistently outperforms other RL baselines across diverse reasoning benchmarks and exhibits more stable, long-horizon training dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习为提升大语言模型的推理能力提供了一种基于原理的方法。不过，其效果取决于在模型不断发展过程中仍能提供有效训练信号的机制。在实际应用中，当任务难度与模型能力不匹配时，或者当训练受到一系列重复问题模式的干扰时，强化学习的进展往往会放缓。为了共同解决这些问题，我们提出了SCALER——一个通过自适应环境设计来维持有效学习信号的框架。SCALER采用了一种可扩展的合成流程，能够将现实世界中的编程问题转化为具有可控难度和无限实例生成的验证性推理环境，从而让强化学习能够在有限数据集之外进行训练，同时保持良好的正确性保证。在此基础上，SCALER还采用了一种自适应多环境强化学习策略，能够动态调整实例的难度，并选择活跃的环境集合来跟踪模型的性能边界，同时保持分布的多样性。这种自适应机制能够避免奖励稀疏现象，减轻对狭窄任务模式的过度拟合，并在整个训练过程中持续推动模型的改进。大量实验表明，SCALER在多种推理基准测试中始终表现出色，其长期训练的稳定性和持续性也优于其他强化学习基线方法。

papers.title: Probing Social Identity Bias in Chinese LLMs with Gendered Pronouns and Social Groups
papers.title_zh: 利用性别称谓和社会群体信息，探究中国语言大语言模型中的社会身份偏见现象
papers.authors: Geng Liu, Li Feng, Junjie Mu, Mengxiao Zhu, Francesco Pierri
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in user-facing applications, raising concerns that they may reflect and amplify social biases. We investigate social identity biases in Chinese LLMs using Mandarin-specific prompts across ten representative models. Our evaluation compares ingroup (“We”) and outgroup (“They”) framings across 240 social groups salient in the Chinese context, using a two-tiered measurement framework that assesses both sentiment and toxicity. The prompt design explicitly accounts for linguistic properties of Mandarin, including the distinction between the default plural pronoun 他们 and the explicitly feminine plural 她们, enabling a controlled comparison of social identity framing effects. Across models, we observe systematic ingroup–outgroup asymmetries, although their expression differs across measurement dimensions. In particular, instruction tuning often reduces sentiment asymmetries, while toxicity gaps remain more persistent. Moreover, the feminine-marked plural 她们 is associated with higher toxicity than the default plural in several models. Our study introduces a language-aware evaluation framework for Chinese LLMs and shows that (i) social identity biases previously documented in English also manifest in Chinese and that (ii) Mandarin-specific linguistic structure can reveal bias patterns that are not directly observable in English-only settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在面向用户的应用程序中得到了越来越多的应用，这引发了对这些模型可能反映和放大社会偏见问题的担忧。我们通过使用针对普通话的提示语，对十款代表性中文大语言模型中的社会身份偏见进行了研究。我们的评估采用了双层测量框架，分别考察了240个在中国语境中具有重要意义的社交群体中的“我们”与“他们”这两种表述方式所引发的情感与毒性效应。提示语的设计充分考虑了普通话的语言特性，包括默认复数形式“他们”与明确表示女性性的复数形式“她们”之间的区别，从而能够较为系统地比较不同模型在社交身份表述方面的效果。我们发现，尽管不同模型在表达上存在差异，但总体上仍存在系统性的“我们”与“他们”之间的不对称现象。具体而言，指令调整通常能减少情感上的不对称现象，而毒性效应则更为持久。此外，在部分模型中，明确表示女性性的复数形式“她们”所引发的毒性效应高于默认复数形式。我们的研究提出了一个基于语言特性的中文大语言模型评估框架，并表明：(i)之前在英语中记录到的社会身份偏见也存在于中文中；(ii)普通话特有的语言结构能够揭示出一些在英语环境中无法直接观察到的偏见模式。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AutoVecCoder: Teaching LLMs to Generate Explicitly Vectorized Code
papers.title_zh: AutoVecCoder：教会大型语言模型生成具体的向量化代码
papers.authors: ShangZhan Li, Xinyu Yin, Xuanyu Jin, Ye He, Yuxin Zhou, Yuxuan Li, Xu Han, Wanxiang Che, Qi Shi, Ting Liu, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: Vectorization via Single Instruction, Multiple Data (SIMD) architectures is a cornerstone of high-performance computing. To fully exploit hardware potential, developers often resort to explicit vectorization using intrinsics, as compiler-based auto-vectorization frequently yields suboptimal results due to conservative static analysis. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in general code generation, they struggle with explicit vectorization due to the scarcity of high-quality corpora and the strict semantic constraints of low-level hardware instructions. In this paper, we propose AutoVecCoder, a novel framework designed to empower LLMs with the capability of automated explicit vectorization. AutoVecCoder integrates two core components: VecPrompt, an automated data synthesis pipeline to inject domain-specific intrinsic knowledge; and VecRL, a reinforcement learning framework that aligns code generation with execution efficiency. AutoVecCoder-8B trained by this framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the SSE and AVX subsets of SimdBench and, in some cases, generates implementations surpassing standard -O3 optimizations, effectively overcoming the inherent bottlenecks of traditional automated vectorization.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过单指令多数据（SIMD）架构进行向量化是高性能计算的基石。为了充分挖掘硬件潜力，开发者通常依赖内建函数的显式向量化处理，因为基于编译器的自动向量化处理往往由于静态分析的保守性而得不到理想的结果。虽然大语言模型在通用代码生成方面表现出色，但由于高质量语料库的匮乏以及低级硬件指令的严格语义限制，它们在显式向量化处理方面存在困难。在本文中，我们提出了AutoVecCoder这一创新框架，旨在让大语言模型具备自动进行显式向量化的能力。AutoVecCoder包含两个核心组件：VecPrompt，一个用于注入领域特定内建知识的自动化数据合成流程；以及VecRL，一个强化学习框架，能够将代码生成与执行效率相结合。通过这一框架训练的AutoVecCoder-8B在SimdBench的SSE和AVX子任务上取得了最先进的性能表现，在某些情况下，其生成的实现甚至超越了标准的-O3优化方案，有效克服了传统自动向量化技术中的固有瓶颈。

papers.title: CompassLLM: A Multi-Agent Approach toward Geo-Spatial Reasoning for Popular Path Query
papers.title_zh: CompassLLM：一种基于多智能体的地理空间推理方法，用于求解常见的路径查询问题
papers.authors: Md. Nazmul Islam Ananto, Shamit Fatin, Mohammed Eunus Ali, Md Rizwan Parvez
papers.abstract: The popular path query - identifying the most frequented routes between locations from historical trajectory data - has important applications in urban planning, navigation optimization, and travel recommendations. While traditional algorithms and machine learning approaches have achieved success in this domain, they typically require model training, parameter tuning, and retraining when accommodating data updates. As Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate increasing capabilities in spatial and graph-based reasoning, there is growing interest in exploring how these models can be applied to geo-spatial problems.We introduce CompassLLM, a novel multi-agent framework that intelligently leverages the reasoning capabilities of LLMs into the geo-spatial domain to solve the popular path query. CompassLLM employs its agents in a two-stage pipeline: the SEARCH stage that identifies popular paths, and a GENERATE stage that synthesizes novel paths in the absence of an existing one in the historical trajectory data. Experiments on real and synthetic datasets show that CompassLLM demonstrates superior accuracy in SEARCH and competitive performance in GENERATE while being cost-effective.
papers.abstract_zh: 路径查询是一种常见的问题——从历史轨迹数据中识别出各地点之间最频繁的路线。这一技术在城市规划、导航优化和旅行推荐等领域具有重要作用。虽然传统的算法和机器学习方法在这一领域已经取得了成功，但这些方法通常需要模型训练、参数调整以及在数据更新时重新训练。随着大语言模型在空间和图结构推理方面的能力不断提升，人们越来越关注如何将这些模型应用于地理空间问题。我们提出了CompassLLM这一新型多智能体框架，它能够巧妙地利用大语言模型的推理能力来解决路径查询问题。CompassLLM采用两阶段流程：第一阶段是“搜索”阶段，用于识别常见的路线；第二阶段是“生成”阶段，用于在历史轨迹数据中找不到现有路线的情况下生成新的路线。在实际和合成数据集上的实验表明，CompassLLM在搜索阶段表现出较高的准确性，在生成阶段则具备竞争力，同时还具有成本效益。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Free-MAD: Consensus-Free Multi-Agent Debate
papers.title_zh: 免费MAD：无需共识的多智能体辩论游戏
papers.authors: Yu Cui, Hang Fu, Haibin Zhang, Licheng Wang, Cong Zuo
papers.abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) is an emerging approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Existing MAD methods rely on multiple rounds of interaction among agents to reach consensus, and the final output is decided by majority voting in the last round. However, this consensus-based design faces several limitations. First, multiple rounds of communication increases token overhead and limits scalability. Second, due to the inherent conformity of LLMs, agents that initially produce correct responses may be influenced by incorrect ones during the debate process, causing error propagation. Third, majority voting introduces randomness and unfairness in the decision-making phase, and can degrade the reasoning performance. To address these issues, we propose Free-MAD, an alternative and novel MAD framework that eliminates the need for consensus among agents. Free-MAD introduces a novel score-based decision mechanism that evaluates the entire debate trajectory rather than relying on the last round only. This mechanism tracks how each agent’s reasoning evolves, enabling more accurate and fair outcomes. In addition, Free-MAD reconstructs the debate phase by introducing anti-conformity, a mechanism that enables agents to mitigate excessive influence from the majority. Experiments on eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that Free-MAD significantly improves reasoning performance while requiring only a single-round debate and thus reducing token costs. We also show that compared to existing MAD approaches, Free-MAD exhibits improved robustness in real-world attack scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 多智能体辩论（MAD）是一种用于提升大语言模型推理能力的新型方法。现有的MAD方法依赖于多轮智能体之间的互动以达成共识，最终输出结果由最后一轮的多数投票决定。然而，这种基于共识的设计存在若干局限性：首先，多轮沟通会增加词元开销并限制可扩展性；其次，由于LLM 固有的从众倾向，最初给出正确回答的智能体可能会在辩论过程中受到错误回答的影响，从而导致错误传播；第三，多数投票会在决策阶段引入随机性和不公平性，从而降低推理性能。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Free-MAD这一替代性的新型MAD框架，该框架无需智能体之间达成共识即可实现推理。Free-MAD采用了一种新颖的基于得分的决策机制，该机制不仅关注最后一轮的辩论结果，而是全面评估整个辩论过程。这种机制能够追踪每个智能体的推理过程，从而得出更准确、公平的结果。此外，Free-MAD通过引入反从众机制来重构辩论阶段，该机制使智能体能够减轻来自多数的过度影响。在八个基准数据集上的实验表明，Free-MAD显著提升了推理性能，同时仅需要单轮辩论，从而降低了词元成本。我们还发现，与现有的MAD方法相比，Free-MAD在现实世界中的攻击场景中表现出更好的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Dialectical Structured Reasoning for Explainable Multimodal Fake News Detection
papers.title_zh: 用于可解释的多模态虚假新闻检测的辩证结构化推理方法
papers.authors: Ruichao Yang, Yufan Bian, Wei Gao, Bo-Wen Zhang, Jing Ma, Hongzhan Lin, Ziyang Luo, Xiaobin Zhu, Xu-Cheng Yin
papers.abstract: Current multimodal fake news detectors predominantly function as opaque classifiers, offering limited deductive transparency and little insight into how conflicting evidence is reconciled. To address this limitation, we propose Dialectical Structured Reasoning (DSR), a framework modeling fake news detection as an explicit dialectical process over multimodal social context. DSR instantiates two opposing agents: a Verifier, which constructs evidence paths supporting semantic consistency, and a Debunker, which actively explores exposing logical or factual contradictions. Then a differentiable Judge agent adjudicates between these competing perspectives by integrating local evidence with global parametric knowledge. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that DSR achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing transparent, dialectically grounded explanations that closely mirror human reasoning process.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的多模态假新闻检测工具主要表现为不透明的分类器，其推理过程缺乏透明度，也无法揭示如何协调相互矛盾的证据。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了辩证结构化推理框架。该框架将假新闻检测视为一个基于多模态社会背景的辩证过程。辩证结构化推理框架包含两个对立的 Agent：验证者负责构建支持语义一致性的证据路径；而破解者则负责主动揭露逻辑或事实上的矛盾。最后，一个可区分的裁决者角色负责整合局部证据与全局参数化知识，从而对这两种对立观点进行裁决。在三个基准测试中的实验表明，辩证结构化推理框架能够取得领先的性能水平，同时还能产生透明且符合辩证逻辑的解释，这些解释与人类推理过程非常相似。

papers.title: Unlocking Human-Like Visible Logic: How Logic Diagrams Boost Logic Reasoning in Large Language Models?
papers.title_zh: 解锁类似人类的可见逻辑：逻辑图如何提升大型语言模型的逻辑推理能力？
papers.authors: Xin Wu, Yuqi Bu, Mengchen Zhao, Qingbao Huang, Yi Cai
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated their remarkable capabilities in natural language understanding and generation. However, these models still struggle with formal logical reasoning, often producing coherent yet invalid conclusions due to limitations in representing boundaries and relational structures through text alone. Human cognition frequently relies on visual representations to clarify logical structures involving category membership, inclusion, and relational hierarchies. Inspired by this, we investigate whether incorporating visual logic diagrams into LLMs’ reasoning workflows can enhance their performance on formal logic tasks. We study this question in a controlled setting using syllogistic and conditional reasoning with programmatically generated Venn, Euler, and Linear diagrams. Across three Vision Language Models (VLMs) families, diagrams help in some settings but can also hurt performance, especially on logically invalid cases where models may over-rely on a single static visual instantiation. We therefore present this work as a reproducible evaluation framework and empirical analysis of when logic diagrams help or hinder language-conditioned reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在大语言模型方面的进展表明，这些模型在自然语言理解和生成方面具有惊人的能力。然而，这些模型在处理形式逻辑推理时仍然存在困难，因为它们仅通过文本来表示边界和关系结构，这往往会导致得出看似合理但无效的结论。人类的认知通常依赖视觉表征来明确涉及类别归属、包含关系以及关系层次结构的逻辑结构。受此启发，我们研究了将视觉逻辑图纳入大语言模型的推理流程是否能够提高它们在形式逻辑任务中的性能。我们在受控环境中进行了这项研究，使用了程序生成的文氏图、欧拉图和线性图，并针对三段论和条件推理进行了分析。在三种视觉语言模型家族中，逻辑图在某些情况下确实有助于提升性能，但在逻辑上不成立的案例中，这种帮助可能会适得其反，因为模型可能会过度依赖单一的静态视觉表征。因此，我们将这项工作作为一个可复现的评估框架，并通过实证分析来探讨逻辑图何时能够辅助或阻碍基于语言的推理过程。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Let Retrievers Think Before Action: Thought-Augmented Embedding for Dense Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 让检索器在采取行动前先思考一下：用于密集检索的思维增强嵌入方法
papers.authors: Ruiran Yan, Wen Xiong, Ze Liu, Chaozhuo Li, Hao Liao, Defu Lian, Zheng Liu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated that explicitly performing step-by-step thinking before producing final outputs can substantially improve performance on complex tasks, as exemplified by recent reasoning-oriented models such as OpenAI O1 and DeepSeek R1. Inspired by these advancements, we propose the O1 Embedder, a novel approach aiming to endow retrieval models with similar capabilities to address challenges like multi-task retrieval, zero-shot retrieval, and tasks requiring intensive reasoning of complex relationships. The O1 Embedder generates preliminary thoughts for input queries before document retrieval. To realize this objective, we address two fundamental challenges in integrating thinking mechanisms into dense retrieval. First, retrieval tasks lack explicit supervision for intermediate thinking processes, making it difficult to define thoughts that are truly useful for retrieval. We address this challenge with a data synthesis framework following an “Exploration-Refinement” process, ensuring alignment with retrieval utility. Second, effectively integrating thought generation with representation learning requires a unified modeling framework that can jointly support generation and embedding within a single model. O1 Embedder addresses this challenge by jointly optimizing thought generation and dense retrieval in an end-to-end manner, enhancing retrieval accuracy while reducing complexity through a single deployable model. Extensive evaluations across diverse datasets demonstrate significant performance improvements, highlighting the effectiveness and generalization capability of O1 Embedder.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型表明，在生成最终输出之前，先进行逐步思考可以显著提高复杂任务的表现，例如最近出现的基于推理的模型如OpenAI O1和DeepSeek R1。受这些进展的启发，我们提出了O1嵌入器这一创新方法，旨在使检索模型具备类似的能力，以应对多任务检索、零样本检索以及需要复杂关系推理的任务等挑战。O1嵌入器在文档检索之前为输入查询生成初步的想法。为了实现这一目标，我们面临两个基本挑战：一是检索任务缺乏对中间思考过程的明确指导，这使得难以定义真正对检索有用的想法；我们通过采用“探索-优化”过程的数据合成框架来解决这个问题，以确保与检索效用的一致性。二是有效地将思维生成与表示学习结合起来需要一个统一的建模框架，该框架能够在一个模型中同时支持生成和嵌入功能。O1嵌入器通过端到端的方式联合优化思维生成和密集检索，从而在提高检索准确性的同时，通过单一可部署的模型降低了复杂性。在多种数据集上的广泛评估表明，O1嵌入器在性能上取得了显著提升，这充分体现了其有效性和泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TravelBehaviorQA: A Benchmark Dataset for Behavioral Interpretation of GPS Trajectories
papers.title_zh: TravelBehaviorQA：用于GPS轨迹行为分析的基准数据集
papers.authors: Dongyang Zhen, Niping Duan, Huan Zhou, Qingbin Cui
papers.abstract: GPS trajectories encode rich behavioral information about how people move, organize activities, and form daily routines. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) raise a natural question: can such models infer and summarize travel behavior directly from mobility traces? This paper introduces TravelBehaviorQA, a large-scale benchmark dataset that reframes trajectory analysis as a language-based behavioral understanding task. The dataset links raw GPS trajectories with human-grounded question-answering (QA) pairs that capture travel intensity, temporal structure, activity patterns, mode usage, and behavioral routines. Unlike prior mobility datasets focused on prediction or classification, TravelBehaviorQA emphasizes semantic interpretation through a unified mix of deterministic and open-ended questions. In this benchmark, we construct over 143k QA instances spanning users and years, and evaluate a broad range of state-of-the-art LLMs under controlled settings. Our results reveal substantial gaps between factual extraction and genuine behavioral reasoning, showing that model scale alone is insufficient and that trajectory representation is a primary bottleneck. TravelBehaviorQA exposes critical limitations of current models and establishes a rigorous benchmark for advancing language-based understanding of human mobility behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: GPS轨迹包含了大量关于人们如何移动、安排活动以及形成日常习惯的行为信息。大语言模型的最新进展引发了一个自然的问题：这些模型能否直接从移动轨迹中推断出旅行行为呢？本文介绍了TravelBehaviorQA这一大规模基准数据集，它将轨迹分析重新定义为一种基于语言的行为了解任务。该数据集将原始的GPS轨迹与人类相关的问答对相结合，这些问答对涵盖了旅行强度、时间结构、活动模式、出行方式以及行为习惯等方面。与那些专注于预测或分类的先前移动性数据集不同，TravelBehaviorQA通过结合确定性问题与开放式问题来强调语义解释的重要性。在这个基准测试中，我们构建了超过14.3万条问答实例，涵盖用户和年份的信息，并在受控环境下评估了多种先进的大语言模型的表现。我们的研究结果揭示了事实提取与真正的行为推理之间的巨大差距，表明仅仅提升模型的规模是不够的，而轨迹的表示方式才是主要的瓶颈。TravelBehaviorQA揭示了当前模型的局限性，并为推进基于语言的对人类移动行为的理解提供了严格的基准测试。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SpiralThinker: Latent Reasoning through an Iterative Process with Text–Latent Interleaving
papers.title_zh: SpiralThinker：通过迭代过程实现潜在推理，结合文本与潜意识的混合运用
papers.authors: Shengmin Piao, Sanghyun Park
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large reasoning models have been driven by reinforcement learning and test-time scaling, accompanied by growing interest in latent rather than purely textual reasoning. However, existing latent reasoning methods lack mechanisms to ensure stable reasoning dynamics in latent space and a systematic way to interleave implicit and explicit reasoning. We introduce SpiralThinker, a unified framework that performs iterative updates over latent representations while enabling interleaved reasoning across latent and textual steps. At its core, SpiralThinker employs a progressive alignment objective and structured annotations to stabilize latent reasoning and maintain coherence with textual reasoning. Across mathematical, logical, and commonsense reasoning tasks, SpiralThinker achieves state-of-the-art performance among latent reasoning baselines. Detailed analyses reveal that both iteration and alignment are indispensable, the numbers of latent tokens and iterations exhibit dataset-specific optima, and appropriate alignment proves critical for an effective iterative process. Overall, SpiralThinker bridges iterative computation and latent reasoning, demonstrating that aligned iterative updates can reliably steer reasoning in the latent space.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，大型推理模型的发展主要得益于强化学习和测试时规模的优化，同时人们对潜在推理的关注也日益增加，而非仅仅关注纯文本推理。然而，现有的潜在推理方法缺乏确保潜在空间内推理动态稳定的机制，也没有一种系统的方法来结合隐式推理和显式推理。我们提出了SpiralThinker这一统一框架，该框架能够在对潜在表示进行迭代更新的同时，实现潜在空间和文本空间的相互融合推理。其核心在于采用渐进式对齐目标和结构化注释，以稳定潜在推理并维持与文本推理的一致性。在数学推理、逻辑推理以及常识推理任务中，SpiralThinker在潜在推理基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。详细分析表明，迭代操作和对齐都是不可或缺的，潜在标记的数量和迭代次数存在针对特定数据集的最优值，而适当的对齐对于有效的迭代过程至关重要。总体而言，SpiralThinker将迭代计算与潜在推理相结合，证明了对齐的迭代更新能够可靠地引导潜在空间中的推理过程。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Verifier-Free RL for LLMs via Intrinsic Gradient-Norm Reward
papers.title_zh: 基于内在梯度范数的无验证强化学习算法，适用于大型语言模型
papers.authors: Xuexiang Wen, Hang Yu, Linchao Zhu, Gaoang Wang
papers.abstract: While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has recently emerged as a promising post-training paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs), its dependency on the gold label or domain-specific verifiers limits its scalability to new tasks and domains. In this work, we propose Verifier-free Intrinsic Gradient-Norm Reward (VIGOR), a simple reward that uses only the policy model itself. Given a prompt, VIGOR samples a group of completions and assigns higher within-group rewards to outputs that induce smaller \ell_2 norms of the teacher-forced negative log-likelihood gradients under the current parameters. Intuitively, lower gradient norms suggest the completion aligns better with the current policy, serving as an intrinsic preference signal for policy optimization. To make this intrinsic signal practical for RL, we correct the systematic length bias of averaged token-level gradients with a \sqrt{T} scaling, and apply group-wise rank shaping to stabilize reward scales across prompts. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VIGOR outperforms the state-of-the-art Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback (RLIF) baseline INTUITOR, and it also exhibits cross-domain transfer to code benchmarks when trained only on math data. For instance, on Qwen2.5-7B-Base post-trained on MATH, VIGOR improves the average math accuracy by +3.31% and the average code accuracy by +1.91% over INTUITOR, while exhibiting more stable training dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）最近成为一种适用于大语言模型（LLM）的很有前景的后期训练方法，但其对黄金标签或特定领域验证器的依赖限制了其适用于新任务和领域的能力。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种无需验证器的内在梯度范数奖励机制——VIGOR。这种奖励机制仅使用策略模型本身来生成奖励。给定一个提示，VIGOR会生成一组补全结果，并给那些在当前参数下能使得教师强制的负对数似然梯度具有较小ℓ²范数的输出更高的奖励。直观地说，较低的梯度范数表明补全结果更符合当前的策略，这可以作为策略优化的内在偏好信号。为了使这种内在信号在强化学习中发挥作用，我们通过乘以√T的缩放因子来纠正平均令牌级梯度的系统性长度偏差，并通过分组排序来稳定不同提示下的奖励尺度。在数学推理基准测试中，VIGOR的表现优于现有的内部反馈强化学习基线INTUITOR。此外，当仅在数学数据上进行训练时，VIGOR还能实现跨领域的迁移效果。例如，在基于MATH数据进行过训练的Qwen2.5-7B-Base模型中，VIGOR将平均数学准确率提高了3.31%，平均代码准确率提高了1.91%，同时其训练稳定性也更高。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: NovBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Academic Paper Novelty Assessment
papers.title_zh: NovBench：在评估大型语言模型时，如何判断其学术论文的新颖性
papers.authors: Wenqing Wu, Yi Zhao, Yuzhuo Wang, Siyou Li, Juexi Shao, Yunfei Long, Chengzhi Zhang
papers.abstract: Novelty is a core requirement in academic publishing and a central focus of peer review, yet the growing volume of submissions has placed increasing pressure on human reviewers. While large language models (LLMs), including those fine-tuned on peer review data, have shown promising results in generating review comments, the absence of dedicated benchmarks has limited systematic evaluation of their ability to assess research novelty. To address this gap, we introduce NovBench, the first large-scale benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs’ capability to generate novelty evaluations in support of human peer review. NovBench comprises 1,684 paper–review pairs from a leading NLP conference, including novelty descriptions extracted from paper introductions and corresponding expert-written novelty evaluations. We focus on both sources because the introduction provides a standardized and explicit articulation of novelty claims, while expert-written novelty evaluations constitute one of the current gold standards of human judgment. Furthermore, we propose a four-dimensional evaluation framework (including Relevance, Correctness, Coverage, and Clarity) to assess the quality of LLM-generated novelty evaluations. Extensive experiments on both general and specialized LLMs under different prompting strategies reveal that current models exhibit limited understanding of scientific novelty, and that fine-tuned models often suffer from instruction-following deficiencies. Our findings underscore the need for targeted fine-tuning strategies that jointly improve novelty comprehension and instruction adherence.
papers.abstract_zh: 新颖性是学术出版的核心要求，也是同行评审的重点。然而，提交论文的数量不断增加，给人工评审人员带来了巨大的压力。虽然大语言模型在生成评审意见方面取得了令人满意的效果，但由于缺乏专门的评估标准，这些模型在评估研究新颖性方面的能力仍然难以得到系统性的评价。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了NovBench——首个用于评估大语言模型生成新颖性评估能力的大规模基准测试平台。NovBench包含了来自一家知名自然语言处理会议的1,684对论文与评审记录，其中包含了从论文引言中提取的新颖性描述以及专家撰写的评审意见。我们选择这两个来源进行评估，因为论文引言能够提供更标准化、更明确的创新描述，而专家撰写的评审意见则代表了当前人类判断的黄金标准之一。此外，我们还提出了一种四维评估框架（包括相关性、正确性、覆盖率和清晰度），以评估大语言模型生成的评审意见的质量。通过对不同提示策略下的通用和专用语言模型进行大量实验，我们发现目前的模型在理解科学新颖性方面存在局限性，而经过微调的模型则常常存在遵循指令方面的不足。我们的研究结果强调了需要采用有针对性的微调策略，以同时提高模型对新颖性的理解和遵循指令的能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LaMPE: Length-aware Multi-grained Positional Encoding for Adaptive Long-context Scaling Without Training
papers.title_zh: LaMPE：一种基于长度感知的多粒度位置编码方法，能够实现无需训练即可实现自适应长上下文缩放
papers.authors: Sikui Zhang, Guangze Gao, Ziyun Gan, Chunfeng Yuan, Zefeng Lin, Houwen Peng, Bing Li, Weiming Hu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) experience significant performance degradation when the input exceeds the pretraining context window, primarily due to the out-of-distribution (OOD) behavior of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE). Recent studies mitigate this problem by remapping OOD positions into the in-distribution range with fixed mapping strategies, ignoring the dynamic relationship between input length and the model’s effective context window. To this end, we propose Length-aware Multi-grained Positional Encoding (LaMPE), a training-free method that fully utilizes the model’s effective context window for adaptive long-context scaling in LLMs. Motivated by the left-skewed frequency distribution of relative positions, LaMPE establishes a dynamic relationship between mapping length and input length through a parametric scaled sigmoid function to adaptively allocate positional capacity across varying input lengths. Meanwhile, LaMPE devises a novel multi-grained attention mechanism that strategically allocates positional resolution across different sequence regions to capture both fine-grained locality and long-range dependencies. Our method can be seamlessly applied to a wide range of RoPE-based LLMs without training. Extensive experiments on three representative LLMs across five mainstream long-context benchmarks demonstrate that LaMPE achieves significant performance improvements compared to existing length extrapolation methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 当输入超过预训练上下文窗口时，大语言模型（LLMs）的性能会显著下降，这主要是由于旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）的超出分布范围行为导致的。最近的研究通过采用固定的映射策略，将超出分布范围的位置重新映射到分布范围内，从而解决了这个问题，但这种方法忽略了输入长度与模型有效上下文窗口之间的动态关系。为此，我们提出了一种名为“长度感知多粒度位置编码”的方法，这是一种无需训练即可使用的算法，它能够充分利用模型的有效上下文窗口，实现LLMs的自适应长上下文扩展。基于相对位置的左偏频率分布特性，LaMPE通过参数化的缩放Sigmoid函数建立了映射长度与输入长度之间的动态关系，从而能够自适应地分配不同输入长度下的位置容量。同时，LaMPE还设计了一种新的多粒度注意力机制，该机制能够策略性地分配不同序列区域的位置分辨率，从而同时捕捉到细粒度的局部性和长距离依赖关系。我们的方法可以无缝应用于各种基于RoPE的LLMs，而无需进行任何训练。在五个主流的长上下文基准测试中对三种代表性的LLMs进行的广泛实验表明，与现有的长度扩展方法相比，LaMPE取得了显著的性能提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Can Small Vision–Language Models Perform Sign Language Translation?
papers.title_zh: 小型视觉-语言模型能进行手语翻译吗？
papers.authors: Anal Roy Chowdhury, Debarshi Kumar Sanyal
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong generalization across multimodal tasks, but their capacity to handle sign language translation (SLT), which requires fine-grained spatiotemporal reasoning and linguistic understanding, remains unclear. In this study, we evaluate whether small VLMs (with \leq3B parameters) can perform SLT effectively. We perform supervised fine-tuning on four publicly available multilingual SLT datasets, including one German (DGS), two American (ASL), and one Indian (ISL), applying parameter-efficient LoRA to the language decoder while keeping the vision encoder frozen and training only the connector. To evaluate translation quality, we propose entity- and semantics-aware metrics tailored for SLT. We highlight the data imbalance issues present in the above widely used SLT datasets. Our analysis highlights the limitations in applying general-purpose VLMs to SLT, unlike their applicability in other tasks, and provides insights to inform future development of VLMs for SLP, which is essential for building inclusive AI applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在多模态任务中表现出强大的泛化能力，但它们在处理手语翻译这一需要精细的时空推理和语言理解的任务时，其表现仍不明确。在本研究中，我们评估了参数数量不超过3B的小规模视觉语言模型是否能够有效执行手语翻译任务。我们对四个公开可用的多语言手语数据集进行了有监督的微调，这些数据集包括一个德语手语数据集、两个美国手语数据集和一个印度手语数据集。在训练过程中，我们对语言解码器采用了参数高效的LoRA优化方法，同时保持视觉编码器不变，仅对连接模块进行训练。为了评估翻译质量，我们提出了一些针对手语翻译而设计的、考虑实体和语义的评估指标。我们还指出了上述常用手语翻译数据集中存在的数据不平衡问题。我们的分析表明，与在其他任务中的应用情况不同，通用视觉语言模型在手语翻译任务中的应用存在局限性。这些发现为未来开发适用于手语翻译的视觉语言模型提供了重要启示，这对于构建包容性强的AI应用至关重要。

papers.title: FastKV: Decoupling of Context Reduction and KV Cache Compression for Prefill-Decoding Acceleration
papers.title_zh: FastKV：分离上下文压缩与键值缓存压缩功能，以实现预填充解码加速
papers.authors: Dongwon Jo, Jiwon Song, Yulhwa Kim, Jae-Joon Kim
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) excel at handling long-context sequences, they require substantial prefill computation and key-value (KV) cache, which can heavily burden computational efficiency and memory usage in both prefill and decoding stages.Recent works that compress KV caches with prefill acceleration reduce this cost but inadvertently tie the prefill compute reduction to the decoding KV budget. This coupling arises from overlooking the layer-dependent variation of critical context, often leading to accuracy degradation. To address this issue, we introduce FastKV, a KV cache compression framework designed to reduce latency in both prefill and decoding by leveraging the stabilization of token importance in later layers.FastKV performs full-context computation until a Token-Selective Propagation (TSP) layer, which forwards only the most informative tokens to subsequent layers.From these propagated tokens, FastKV independently selects salient KV entries for caching, thereby decoupling KV budget from the prefill compute reduction based on the TSP decision.This independent control of the TSP rate and KV retention rate enables flexible optimization of efficiency and accuracy.Experimental results show that FastKV achieves speedups of up to 1.82\times in prefill and 2.87\times in decoding compared to the full-context baseline, while matching the accuracy of the decoding-only baselines.Our code is available at https://github.com/dongwonjo/FastKV.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在处理长上下文序列方面表现出色，但它们需要大量的预填充计算以及键值缓存，这会在预填充和解码阶段严重影响计算效率和内存使用。最近的一些工作通过压缩键值缓存并加速预填充来降低这些成本，但这样做会无意中将预填充计算的减少与解码阶段的键值预算绑定在一起。这种耦合现象是由于忽略了关键上下文的层间差异所导致的，常常会导致准确性下降。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了FastKV这一键值缓存压缩框架。该框架通过利用后续层中令牌重要性的稳定化特性，来减少预填充和解码过程中的延迟。FastKV在直到一个令牌选择性传播层之前都会进行全上下文计算，该层只将最具信息量的令牌传递给后续层。从这些被传播的令牌中，FastKV独立选择出重要的键值条目进行缓存，从而将键值预算与基于令牌选择性传播决策所减少的预填充计算分离开来。这种对令牌选择性传播速率和键值保留率的独立控制，使得我们可以灵活地优化效率和准确性。实验结果表明，与全上下文基线相比，FastKV在预填充方面的速度提升达到了1.82倍，在解码方面的速度提升达到了2.87倍，同时其解码的准确性也与仅依赖解码的基线相当。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/dongwonjo/FastKV获取。

papers.title: Beyond Outcome Verification: Verifiable Process Reward Models for Structured Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 超越结果验证：用于结构化推理的可验证过程奖励模型
papers.authors: Massimiliano Pronesti, Anya Belz, Yufang Hou
papers.abstract: Recent work on reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown that large language models (LLMs) can be substantially improved using outcome-level verification signals, such as unit tests for code or exact-match checks for mathematics. In parallel, process supervision has long been explored as a way to shape the intermediate reasoning behaviour of LLMs, but existing approaches rely on neural judges to score chain-of-thought steps, leaving them vulnerable to opacity, bias, and reward hacking. To address this gap, we introduce Verifiable Process Reward Models (VPRMs), a reinforcement-learning framework in which intermediate reasoning steps are checked by deterministic, rule-based verifiers. We apply VPRMs to risk-of-bias assessment for medical evidence synthesis, a domain where guideline-defined criteria and rule-based decision paths enable programmatic verification of reasoning traces. Across multiple datasets, we find that VPRMs generate reasoning that adheres closely to domain rules and achieve substantially higher coherence between step-level decisions and final labels. Results show that VPRMs achieve up to 20% higher F1 than state-of-the-art models and 6.5% higher than verifiable outcome rewards, with substantial gains in evidence grounding and logical coherence.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近关于带有可验证奖励的强化学习的研究表明，通过使用结果级验证信号（例如代码单元测试或数学精确匹配检查），可以显著提升大语言模型的性能。与此同时，过程监督一直被作为塑造大语言模型中间推理行为的一种手段来探索，但现有方法依赖于神经判断器来评估思维链中的各个步骤，这使得这些方法容易受到不透明性、偏见以及奖励操纵的影响。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了可验证过程奖励模型这一强化学习框架。在该框架中，中间推理步骤通过确定性的、基于规则的验证器来进行验证。我们将VPRM应用于医学证据合成领域的风险评估中，在这个领域中，由指南定义的标准和基于规则的决策路径能够实现推理过程的程序化验证。在多个数据集上进行的实验表明，VPRM生成的推理结果严格遵循领域规则，并且步骤级决策与最终标签之间的连贯性也显著提高。结果表明，VPRM在F1评分上比最先进的模型高出20%，比可验证的结果奖励高出6.5%，同时在证据基础和逻辑连贯性方面也取得了显著的提升。

papers.title: Auto-Stega: An Agent-Driven System for Lifelong Strategy Evolution in LLM-Based Text Steganography
papers.title_zh: 自动斯泰加：一种由代理驱动的系统，用于基于大语言模型的文本隐藏技术中实现长期策略优化
papers.authors: Jiuan Zhou, Yu Cheng, Yuan Xie, Zhaoxia Yin
papers.abstract: With the rapid progress of LLMs, high quality generative text has become widely available as a cover for text steganography. However, prevailing methods rely on hand-crafted or pre-specified strategies and struggle to balance efficiency, imperceptibility, and security, particularly at high embedding rates. Accordingly, we propose Auto-Stega, an agent-driven self-evolving framework that is the first to realize self-evolving steganographic strategies by automatically discovering, composing, and adapting strategies at inference time; the framework operates as a closed loop of generating, evaluating, summarizing, and updating that continually curates a structured strategy library and adapts across corpora, styles, and task constraints. A decoding LLM recovers the information under the shared strategy. To handle high embedding rates, we introduce PC-DNTE, a plug-and-play algorithm that maintains alignment with the base model’s conditional distribution at high embedding rates, preserving imperceptibility while enhancing security. Experimental results demonstrate that at higher embedding rates Auto-Stega achieves superior performance with gains of 42.2% in perplexity and 1.6% in anti-steganalysis performance over SOTA methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的快速发展，高质量的生成文本已经作为一种隐写技术的载体而广泛存在。然而，现有的方法往往依赖于人工设计的策略或预先设定的方案，在效率、不可感知性以及安全性方面存在挑战，尤其是在高嵌入率的情况下。因此，我们提出了Auto-Stega这一由智能体驱动的自我进化框架。该框架首次实现了自我进化的隐写策略，能够在推理过程中自动发现、组合并调整策略；该框架通过生成、评估、总结和更新等循环操作，不断构建出结构化的策略库，并能够根据不同的语料、风格和任务约束进行调整。解码大语言模型则可以在共享的策略下恢复原始信息。为了应对高嵌入率的情况，我们引入了PC-DNTE算法——一种即插即用的算法，它能够在高嵌入率下与基础模型的条件分布保持同步，同时保持良好的不可感知性，并提升安全性。实验结果表明，在更高的嵌入率下，Auto-Stega的表现优于现有方法，其在困惑度上提升了42.2%，在抗隐写分析性能上提升了1.6%。

papers.title: Detecting AI-Generated Video: A Vision–Language Dual-View Survey
papers.title_zh: 检测人工智能生成的视频：视觉与语言的双重评估方法
papers.authors: Dylan Xinming Hou, Juntian Zhang, Xu Gu, Yichen Wu, Nils Lukas, Gus Xia, Xiuying Chen, Yuhan Liu
papers.abstract: The evolving realism of AI-generated Videos (AIGC-V) is rapidly rendering traditional artifact-centric detection insufficient, necessitating a paradigm shift from low-level inspection to high-level semantic verification. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of AIGC-V detection, reframing the task as Factual Fidelity Verification, which asks whether the events, entities, and physical processes depicted in a video are consistent with real-world facts. To systematize this rapidly evolving field, we propose a Vision–Language Dual-View taxonomy that organizes existing methods into a hierarchical, four-layer landscape, spanning intrinsic cue analysis, spatiotemporal consistency modeling, cross-modal consistency reasoning, and language-guided world-level reasoning. This dual-view framing highlights a fundamental transition from artifact matching to evidence-based semantic verification enabled by vision–language models and agentic reasoning pipelines. Based on a systematic review of 195 papers, we synthesize AIGC-V generation paradigms, survey the landscape of detection methods, and review evaluation metrics and benchmarks in line with proposed views. Finally, we discuss current challenges and identify promising directions toward robust, explainable, and trustworthy detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能生成视频的逼真度正在迅速提升，这使得以传统的人工制品为中心的检测方式已经不足以应对这一挑战。因此，我们需要从低层次的检查转向高层次的语义验证。本文对人工智能生成视频的检测技术进行了全面综述，将这一任务重新定义为“事实真实性验证”，即判断视频中呈现的事件、实体和物理过程是否与现实世界的事实一致。为了系统化这一快速发展的领域，我们提出了一种“视觉-语言双视角”的分类体系，将现有方法划分为四个层次：内在线索分析、时空一致性建模、跨模态一致性推理以及基于语言的全局推理。这种双视角的方法论体现了从人工制品匹配到基于证据的语义验证的根本转变，这一转变得益于视觉-语言模型以及智能体推理流程的结合。通过对195篇论文的系统梳理，我们总结了人工智能生成视频的生成范式，回顾了检测方法的现状，并针对所提出的视角整理了评估指标和基准测试。最后，我们讨论了当前面临的挑战，并指出了实现稳健、可解释且可信检测方向的一些有前景的研究方向。

papers.title: UnIte: Uncertainty-based Iterative Document Sampling for Domain Adaptation in Information Retrieval
papers.title_zh: UnIte：基于不确定性的迭代文档采样技术，用于信息检索中的领域自适应
papers.authors: Jongyoon Kim, Minseong Hwang, Seung-won Hwang
papers.abstract: Unsupervised domain adaptation generalizes neural retrievers to an unseen domain by generating pseudo queries on target domain documents. The quality and efficiency of this adaptation critically depend on which documents are selected for pseudo query generation. The existing document sampling method focuses on diversity but fails to capture model uncertainty. In contrast, we propose Uncertainty-based Iterative Document Sampling (UnIte), addressing these limitations by (1) filtering documents with high aleatoric uncertainty and (2) prioritizing those with high epistemic uncertainty, maximizing the learning utility of the current model. We conducted extensive experiments on a large corpus of BEIR with small and large models, showing significant gains of +2.45 and +3.49 nDCG@10 with a smaller training sample size, 4k on average.
papers.abstract_zh: 无监督领域适应是一种将神经检索器推广到未见领域的技术，其原理是通过在目标领域文档上生成伪查询来实现。这种适应的质量和效率在很大程度上取决于哪些文档被选用来生成伪查询。现有的文档采样方法主要关注多样性，但未能捕捉到模型的不确定性。相比之下，我们提出了基于不确定性的迭代文档采样方法（UnIte），通过以下方式解决了这些限制问题：（1）过滤出具有高度随机不确定性的文档；（2）优先选择那些具有高度认知不确定性的文档，从而最大化当前模型的学习效用。我们在大量的BEIR语料库上进行了广泛的实验，使用小型和大型模型进行测试，结果显示，在较小的训练样本量下（平均4k个文档），取得了显著的提升，分别达到了+2.45和+3.49 nDCG@10的改善效果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Improving LLM Code Reasoning via Semantic Equivalence Self-Play with Formal Verification
papers.title_zh: 通过语义等价自博弈来提高大语言模型的代码推理能力，并对其进行形式化验证
papers.authors: Poon Tsz Nok, Antonio Valerio Miceli Barone
papers.abstract: We introduce a self-play framework for semantic equivalence in Haskell, utilizing formal verification to guide adversarial training between a generator and an evaluator. The framework leverages Liquid Haskell proofs for validating equivalence and execution-based counterexamples for inequivalence, organized via a difficulty-aware curriculum. To facilitate this, we release OpInstruct-HSx, a synthetic dataset of \approx 28k validated Haskell programs. Empirical experiments show that our evaluator transfers effectively to downstream tasks, achieving up to 13.3pp accuracy gain on EquiBench and consistent gains on PySecDB. Ablation studies on the SEQ-SINQ regimes indicate that while inequivalence supervision provides data volume, equivalence proofs are uniquely responsible for the model’s reasoning capabilities. The entire training pipeline and dataset are publicly released on GitHub and Hugging Face respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们为Haskell中的语义等价性问题引入了一个自玩框架，利用形式化验证来指导生成器与评估器之间的对抗性训练。该框架采用Liquid Haskell证明来验证等价性，并使用基于执行的反例来证明不等价性，整个训练过程遵循一个考虑难度的课程安排。为了便于实现这一目标，我们发布了OpInstruct-Hsx这一包含约28k个经过验证的Haskell程序的合成数据集。实验表明，我们的评估器能够有效地应用于后续任务，在EquiBench测试上的准确率提升了13.3个百分点，在PySecDB测试上也取得了稳定的提升。对SEQ-SINQ测试集的消融研究表明，虽然不等价性的监督可以提供足够的数据量，但等价性证明才是决定模型推理能力的关键因素。整个训练流程和数据集已分别发布在GitHub和Hugging Face上。

papers.title: Towards Identification and Intervention of Safety-Critical Parameters in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 关于大型语言模型中关键安全参数的识别与干预策略
papers.authors: Weiwei Qi, Zefeng Wu, Tianhang Zheng, Zikang Zhang, Xiaojun Jia, Zhan Qin, Kui Ren
papers.abstract: Ensuring Large Language Model (LLM) safety is crucial, yet the lack of a clear understanding about safety mechanisms hinders the development of precise and reliable methodologies for safety intervention across diverse tasks. To better understand and control LLM safety, we propose the Expected Safety Impact (ESI) framework for quantifying how different parameters affect LLM safety. Based on ESI, we reveal distinct safety-critical patterns across different LLM architectures: In dense LLMs, many safety-critical parameters are located in value matrices (V) and MLPs in middle layers, whereas in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, they shift to late-layer MLPs. Leveraging ESI, we further introduce two targeted intervention paradigms for safety enhancement and preservation, i.e., Safety Enhancement Tuning (SET) and Safety Preserving Adaptation (SPA). SET can align unsafe LLMs by updating only a few safety-critical parameters, effectively enhancing safety while preserving original performance. SPA safeguards well-aligned LLMs during capability-oriented intervention (e.g., instruction tuning) by preventing disruption of safety-critical weights, allowing the LLM to acquire new abilities while maintaining safety capabilities. Extensive evaluations on different LLMs demonstrate that SET can reduce the attack success rates of unaligned LLMs by over 50% with only a 100-iteration update on 1% of model weights. SPA can limit the safety degradation of aligned LLMs within 1% after a 1,000-iteration instruction fine-tuning on different tasks. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ZJU-LLM-Safety/SafeWeights-ACL
papers.abstract_zh: 确保大语言模型的安全性至关重要，然而对安全机制的缺乏理解阻碍了针对各种任务开发精确可靠的安全干预方法。为了更好地理解和控制大语言模型的安全性，我们提出了预期安全性影响框架，用于量化不同参数对大语言模型安全性的影响。基于该框架，我们发现不同大语言模型架构中存在不同的安全关键模式：在密集型大语言模型中，许多安全关键参数位于中间层的价值矩阵和MLP中；而在混合专家模型中，这些参数则转移到了后期层的MLP中。利用预期安全性影响框架，我们进一步提出了两种有针对性的安全增强与保护干预方案，即安全增强调优和安全保护适应。安全增强调优可以通过仅更新少数几个安全关键参数来使不安全的大语言模型恢复正常，从而有效提升安全性，同时保留原有的性能。安全保护适应则能够在以能力为导向的干预过程中（例如指令调优），防止安全关键权重被破坏，从而使大语言模型在保持安全性的同时获得新的能力。对不同大语言模型的广泛评估表明，安全增强调优只需对模型权重的1%进行100次迭代更新，就能将未对齐大语言模型的攻击成功率降低超过50%。而安全保护适应则可以在对不同任务进行1000次迭代的指令微调后，将对齐大语言模型的安全性下降幅度控制在1%以内。我们的代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/ZJU-LLM-Safety/SafeWeights-ACL

papers.title: OPINE: A Prior-calibrated Scoring Framework for LLM-based Multi-label Scientific Opinion Classification
papers.title_zh: 观点：一种基于A Priori算法的评分框架，适用于基于大语言模型的多标签科学观点分类任务
papers.authors: Mengting Zhang, Gaofeng Pan, Zhixiong Zhang, Yang Li, Guangyin Zhang
papers.abstract: Scientific opinion classification based on discourse functions provides a structured semantic basis for analytical tasks such as gap identification and hypothesis generation. However, this task is uniquely challenged by the multi-label nature of scientific expressions and AIMRaD structural constraints. Existing LLM-based methods typically rely on direct label generation, which obscures decision logic, or treat discourse information as passive context rather than a structural prior. We propose OPINE, a multi-stage framework that reformulates classification as a controllable scoring-calibration-refinement pipeline. By decoupling textual evidence from decision logic, OPINE generates independent label-wise affinity scores calibrated by AIMRaD priors. To resolve the multi-label challenge, we introduce a quantile-based decoding rule to naturally capture co-existing roles, alongside a pairwise refinement mechanism to mitigate confusion between similar categories. We contribute a new benchmark of 18 discourse functions across diverse sections. Experimental results show that OPINE generally outperforms strong baselines, reaching F1 scores of 63.20%, 53.68%, and 63.22% under Micro, Macro, and Example settings, respectively. Our analysis reveals that integrating discourse structures as explicit priors is superior to conventional passive context integration, while pairwise refinement successfully mitigates confusion between functionally similar categories. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/znoodle63/OPINE.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于话语功能的科学意见分类为诸如缺口识别、假设生成等分析任务提供了结构化的语义基础。然而，这一任务面临着科学表达的多标签特性以及AIMRaD结构约束所带来的独特挑战。现有的基于大语言模型的方法通常依赖直接的标签生成，这掩盖了决策逻辑，或者将话语信息视为被动的上下文而非结构性的先验。我们提出了OPINE这一多阶段框架，它将分类过程重新定义为一个可控制的评分-校准-细化流程。通过将文本证据与决策逻辑分离，OPINE能够生成独立的标签级亲和力分数，这些分数通过AIMRaD先验进行校准。为了应对多标签的挑战，我们引入了一种基于分位数的解码规则，以自然捕捉共存的角色；同时，我们还采用了一种成对细化机制，以减少功能相似类别之间的混淆。我们构建了一个包含18种不同话语功能的全新基准测试。实验结果表明，OPINE在性能上普遍优于传统的基线方法，在微尺度、宏观尺度和示例设置下分别达到了63.20%、53.68%和63.22%的F1分数。我们的分析表明，将话语结构作为显式的先验来整合，比传统的被动上下文整合更为有效；而成对细化机制则成功缓解了功能相似类别之间的混淆。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/znoodle63/OPINE获取。

papers.title: Vocab Diet: Reshaping the Vocabulary of LLMs via Vector Arithmetic
papers.title_zh: 词汇优化：通过向量运算重塑大语言模型的词汇库
papers.authors: Yuval Reif, Guy Kaplan, Roy Schwartz
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often encode word-form variation (e.g., walk vs. walked) as linear directions in the embedding space. However, standard tokenization algorithms treat such variants as distinct words with different vocabulary entries—quickly filling the size-capped token vocabulary with surface-form variation (e.g., walk, walking, Walk), at the expense of diversity and multilingual coverage. We show that many of these variations can be captured by transformation vectors—additive offsets that yield the appropriate word representation when applied to a base form embedding, in both the input and output spaces. Building on this, we propose a compact reshaping of the vocabulary: instead of assigning unique tokens to each surface form, we compose them from shared base form and transformation vectors (e.g., walked is walk+past tense). Our approach is lightweight—keeping the pretrained backbone frozen and only training small adaptation modules. We apply it across five languages and multiple LLMs in both pretraining and post-hoc adaptation, freeing 10-40% of vocabulary slots to be reallocated where tokenization is inefficient. Importantly, we do so while also expanding vocabulary coverage to out-of-vocabulary words, and with minimal impact on downstream performance. Our findings motivate a rethinking of vocabulary design, towards a representation that better matches the underlying structure of language and the practical needs of multilingual coverage.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常将单词形式的变化（例如，walk与warmed）编码为嵌入空间中的线性方向。然而，标准的分词算法将这些变化视为不同的单词，并分别赋予它们不同的词汇表条目——这导致词汇表的大小被表面形式的变化所占据（例如，walk、walking、Walk），而牺牲了多样性和多语言覆盖能力。我们发现，许多这些变化可以通过转换向量来捕捉——这些加性偏移量在应用于基础形式的嵌入时，能够在输入和输出空间中产生合适的单词表示。在此基础上，我们提出了一种简洁的词汇表重构方法：不是为每个表面形式分配唯一的标记，而是将它们由共享的基础形式和转换向量组合而成（例如，warmed是由walk加上过去式构成的）。我们的方法非常轻量级——保持预训练的骨干模型不变，只训练小型的适应模块。我们在五种语言和多个大语言模型中应用了这一方法，无论是在预训练阶段还是后期适应阶段，都能将10-40%的词汇槽重新分配给分词效率较低的部分。重要的是，我们这样做的同时，还能扩大对词汇表中未收录单词的覆盖范围，且对下游性能的影响极小。我们的发现促使我们重新思考词汇表的设计，寻求一种更能匹配语言基本结构以及多语言覆盖需求的表示方法。

papers.title: RecMem: Recurrence-based Memory Consolidation for Efficient and Effective Long-Running LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: RecMem：基于递归的内存整合技术，实现高效且有效的长运行LLM智能体运行
papers.authors: Zijie Dai, Shiyuan Deng, Sheng Guan, Yizhou Tian, Xin Yao, Xiao Yan, James Cheng
papers.abstract: Memory systems often organize user-agent interactions as retrievable external memory and are crucial for long-running agents by overcoming the limited context windows of LLMs. However, existing memory systems invoke LLMs to process every incoming interaction for memory extraction, and such an eager memory consolidation scheme leads to substantial token consumption. To tackle this problem, we propose RecMem by rethinking when memory consolidation should be conducted. RecMem stores incoming interactions in a subconscious memory layer and encode them using lightweight embedding models for retrieval. LLMs are only invoked to extract episodic and semantic memory when sustained recurrence are observed for semantically similar interactions. Such recurrence-based consolidation works because these interactions correspond to a semantic cluster with rich information and thus are worth extraction and summarization. To improve accuracy, RecMem also incorporates a semantic refinement mechanism that recovers the fine-grained facts omitted by memory extraction. Experiments show that RecMem reduces the memory construction token cost of three SOTA memory systems by up to 87% while exceeding their accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 记忆系统通常将用户代理的互动信息组织成可检索的外部记忆，这对于长期运行的代理来说至关重要，因为它能够克服大语言模型有限的上下文窗口限制。然而，现有的记忆系统需要调用大语言模型来处理每一个传入的互动信息以进行记忆提取，这种急切的记忆整合方式会导致大量的令牌消耗。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了RecMem这一方案，通过重新思考记忆整合的时机来改进这一机制。RecMem将传入的互动信息存储在一个潜意识记忆层，并使用轻量级的嵌入模型对其进行编码以便提取。只有当发现语义相似的互动具有持续出现的趋势时，才会调用大语言模型来提取情节性和语义性记忆。这种基于重复出现的记忆整合方式之所以有效，是因为这些互动属于具有丰富信息的语义集群，因此值得进行提取和总结。为了提高准确性，RecMem还加入了语义细化机制，能够恢复记忆提取过程中遗漏的详细信息。实验表明，RecMem将三种最先进的记忆系统的记忆构建令牌成本降低了高达87%，同时其准确率也超过了这些系统。

papers.title: Let the Comments Speak: A Multi-Agent Framework based on Large Language Model for Comment-Guided Code Refactoring
papers.title_zh: 让评论来说话：一种基于大型语言模型的多智能体框架，用于以评论为引导的代码重构
papers.authors: Zixuan Wang, Wutong Yu, Deyu Zhou
papers.abstract: Code refactoring is essential for software maintainability, yet current Large Language Model (LLM) based frameworks primarily focus on syntax and neglect the vital semantic signals in code comments. As pointed out in Fowler’s refactoring theory, explanatory comments function as semantic anchors that provide necessary guidance for method extraction. Moreover, research reports show that more than 84 percent of codebases lack appropriate code comments, which hinders the leverage of such guidance. To bridge this gap, we propose MACOR, a Multi-Agent framework for COmment-guided code Refactoring. In specific, MACOR populates original code with precise comments to provide necessary semantic guidance for the subsequent refactoring process. These generated signals are employed to retrieve expert examples. An iterative feedback is incorporated loop for validation. Experiments are conducted on three benchmarks using three base LLMs. Experimental results show that MACOR significantly optimizes code quality and achieves higher developer acceptance compared to the representative baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 代码重构对于软件的可维护性至关重要，然而目前基于大语言模型的框架主要关注的是语法层面，而忽视了代码注释中重要的语义信息。正如Fowler提出的重构理论所指出的，解释性注释可以作为语义锚点，为方法提取提供必要的指导。此外，研究报告显示，超过84%的代码库缺乏适当的代码注释，这阻碍了这种指导作用的发挥。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了MACOR——一个用于注释引导的代码重构的多智能体框架。具体来说，MACOR通过精确的注释来补充原始代码，为后续的重构过程提供必要的语义指导。这些生成的信号被用来检索专家示例。该框架还采用了迭代反馈机制来进行验证。实验在三个基准测试上进行了实施，使用了三种基础语言模型。实验结果表明，与现有的基准相比，MACOR显著提升了代码质量，并获得了更高的开发者接受度。

papers.title: AdapTime: Enabling Adaptive Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: AdapTime：在大型语言模型中启用自适应时间推理功能
papers.authors: Yimin Deng, Yejing Wang, Zhenxi Lin, Zichuan Fu, Guoshuai Zhao, Derong Xu, Yefeng Zheng, Xiangyu Zhao, Xian Wu, Li Zhu, Xueming Qian
papers.abstract: Large language models have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities in general knowledge question answering. However, their ability to handle temporal information remains limited. To address this limitation, existing approaches often design time-sensitive reasoning pipelines that rely on external tools or manual verification and are tailored to specific scenarios, leading to poor generalizability. Moreover, these methods apply a fixed pipeline to all questions, overlooking the fact that different types of temporal questions often require distinct reasoning strategies, which leads to unnecessary processing for simple cases and inadequate reasoning for more complex ones. To this end, we propose AdapTime, an adaptive temporal reasoning method that dynamically executes reasoning steps based on the input context and task requirements. Specifically, it involves three temporal reasoning actions: reformulate, rewrite and review, with an LLM planner guiding the reasoning process. AdapTime integrates seamlessly with state-of-the-art LLMs and significantly enhances their temporal reasoning capabilities without relying on external support. Extensive experiments on two temporal QA benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在一般知识问答方面展现了强大的推理能力。然而，它们在处理时间信息方面的能力仍然有限。为了克服这一限制，现有的方法通常设计基于外部工具或人工验证的时间敏感推理流程，并且这些流程是针对特定场景量身定制的，这导致了较差的泛化能力。此外，这些方法对所有问题都采用相同的推理流程，而忽略了不同类型的時間问题通常需要不同的推理策略这一事实。这就导致了对简单案例的不必要处理，而对于复杂案例则无法进行充分的推理。为此，我们提出了AdapTime——一种自适应时间推理方法，它能够根据输入上下文和任务要求动态执行推理步骤。具体来说，它包含三个时间推理操作：重新表述、重写和审查，同时有一个LLM规划器来指导推理过程。AdapTime能够与最先进的LLM无缝集成，并显著提升了它们的时间推理能力，而无需依赖外部支持。在两个时间问答基准测试上的广泛实验证明了我们方法的有效性。

papers.title: Hierarchical Representation Alignment Learning of Diffusion Transformers for Neural Audio Codec
papers.title_zh: 扩散变换器的层次化表示对齐学习，用于神经音频编码技术
papers.authors: Sang-Hoon Lee, Ha-Yeong Choi
papers.abstract: Despite recent progress in diffusion and conditional flow matching (CFM) models for low-resolution domains such as latent representations, their application to high-resolution data like raw waveform signals remains underexplored. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have been the dominant approach in neural vocoder and neural audio codecs for realistic waveform generation. However, under low-bitrate conditions, these models suffer from degraded performance due to information loss caused by heavy compression and quantization, often resulting in mispronunciations. To address the aforementioned problem, we first leverage CFM to iteratively generate raw waveform in an extremely low-bitrate scenario. We then introduce hierarchical representation alignment learning (REPA-H) to enable efficient and robust CFM training. Furthermore, we propose dense vector quantization (DVQ), a novel factorized quantization method using a single quantizer. Our model, FlowTokenizer, outperforms state-of-the-art neural audio codecs in audio quality and semantic intelligibility under low-bitrate conditions, using only 25 tokens per second for 24 kHz waveform generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在低分辨率领域（如潜在表示）的扩散和条件流匹配模型方面取得了一些进展，但这些模型在应用于高分辨率数据（如原始波形信号）方面的应用仍然鲜有研究。生成对抗网络已成为实现逼真波形生成的神经语音编码器与神经音频编解码器中的主流方法。然而，在低比特率条件下，由于严重压缩和量化导致的信息丢失，这些模型的性能会下降，常常会导致发音错误。为了解决上述问题，我们首先利用条件流匹配技术来在低比特率环境下迭代生成原始波形。然后，我们引入分层表示对齐学习算法，以实现高效且稳健的条件流匹配训练。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的向量量化方法——密集向量量化，该方法使用单一的量化器进行量化处理。我们的模型FlowTokenizer在低比特率条件下，能够以每秒仅25个标记的速度生成24 kHz波形的情况下，在音频质量和语义可懂度方面优于现有的神经音频编解码器。

papers.title: CoV: Chain-of-View Prompting for Spatial Reasoning
papers.title_zh: CoV：基于视链提示的空间推理方法
papers.authors: Haoyu Zhao, Akide Liu, Zeyu Zhang, Weijie Wang, Feng Chen, Ruihan Zhu, Gholamreza Haffari, Bohan Zhuang
papers.abstract: Embodied question answering (EQA) in 3D environments often requires collecting context that is distributed across multiple viewpoints and partially occluded. However, most recent vision–language models (VLMs) are constrained to a fixed and finite set of input views, which limits their ability to acquire question-relevant context at inference time and hinders complex spatial reasoning. We propose Chain-of-View (CoV) prompting, a training-free, test-time reasoning framework that transforms a VLM into an active viewpoint reasoner through a coarse-to-fine exploration process. CoV first employs a View Selection agent to filter redundant frames and identify question-aligned anchor views. It then performs fine-grained view adjustment by interleaving iterative reasoning with discrete camera actions, obtaining new observations from the underlying 3D scene representation until sufficient context is gathered or a step budget is reached. We evaluate CoV on OpenEQA across four mainstream VLMs and obtain an average 11.98% improvement in LLM-Match, with a maximum gain of 13.62% on Qwen3-VL-Flash. CoV further exhibits test-time scaling: increasing the minimum action budget yields an additional 2.54% average improvement, peaking at 3.73% on Gemini-2.5-Flash. On ScanQA and SQA3D, CoV delivers strong performance (e.g., 116 CIDEr 31.9 EM@1 on ScanQA and 51.1 EM@1 on SQA3D). Overall, these results suggest that question-aligned view selection coupled with open-view search is an effective, model-agnostic strategy for improving spatial reasoning in 3D EQA without additional training.
papers.abstract_zh: 在3D环境中进行问题回答时，通常需要收集分布在多个视角上且部分被遮挡的上下文信息。然而，大多数最新的视觉-语言模型都受到固定且有限输入视角的限制，这限制了它们在推理过程中获取与问题相关的上下文的能力，同时也阻碍了复杂的空间推理。我们提出了一种无需训练的测试时推理框架——视图链提示法。该框架通过从粗略到精细的探索过程，将视觉语言模型转变为一个能够主动处理视角的推理器。视图链提示法首先使用视图选择代理来过滤冗余帧图像，并识别出与问题相关的锚点视图。然后，它通过结合迭代推理与离散的相机动作来进行细粒度的视图调整，从而从底层3D场景表示中获取新的观测数据，直到收集到足够的上下文或达到一定的步骤预算为止。我们在OpenEQA任务上对视图链提示法进行了评估，结果显示，与主流视觉-语言模型相比，平均提升了11.98%的LLM-Match性能，而在Qwen3-VL-Flash模型上甚至达到了13.62%的最大提升幅度。此外，视图链提示法还表现出良好的扩展性：增加最小动作预算后，平均性能进一步提升了2.54%，在Gemini-2.5-Flash模型上的提升幅度达到了3.73%。在ScanQA和SQA3D任务中，视图链提示法也表现出了强大的性能，例如在ScanQA任务中获得了116个CIDEr和31.9个EM@1的得分，在SQA3D任务中则获得了51.1个EM@1的得分。总体而言，这些结果表明，结合与问题相关的视图选择以及开放视角搜索的方法是一种有效的、与模型无关的策略，可以在不增加额外训练成本的情况下提升3D问题回答中的空间推理能力。
