papers.title: A Graph Talks, But Who’s Listening? Rethinking Evaluations for Graph-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 图表在诉说，但谁在倾听？重新思考用于图语言模型的评估方法
papers.authors: Soham Petkar, Hari Aakash K, Anirudh Vempati, Akshit Sinha, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru, Chirag Agarwal
papers.abstract: Recent research has extensively explored the graph-reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) through textual descriptions. However, benchmarks specifically designed for Graph-Language Models (GLMs), which integrate Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with LLMs, remain significantly underdeveloped. In this work, we first demonstrate that existing GLM evaluations, largely repurposed from unimodal node and edge level tasks, fail to assess true multimodal integration. Our analysis reveals that strong performance on these benchmarks is achievable using textual or structural features in isolation, bypassing the need for joint reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce CLEGR (Compositional Language-Graph Reasoning), a benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate multimodal reasoning over graph topology and textual semantics. Evaluation of representative GLMs on CLEGR shows that they exhibit significant performance degradation on CLEGR tasks and unimodal soft-prompted LLMs perform on par with complex multimodal GLMs. These findings collectively highlight limitations in the graph reasoning capabilities of existing GLMs and provide a foundation for advancing the community toward explicit multimodal reasoning involving graph structure and language.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究通过文本描述，深入探讨了大语言模型在图推理方面的能力。然而，专门为图语言模型设计的基准测试仍然相当匮乏，这些测试需要将图神经网络与语言模型相结合。在这项研究中，我们首先证明了现有的图语言模型评估方法，主要是基于单模态节点和边级任务设计的，无法准确评估真正的多模态整合能力。我们的分析表明，仅使用文本或结构特征就能取得良好的性能，而无需进行联合推理。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了CLEGR这一专门设计用于评估图拓扑结构和文本语义的多模态推理的基准测试。对代表性图语言模型在CLEGR上的评估显示，它们在CLEGR任务上表现显著下降，而单模态软提示语言模型的表现则与复杂的多模态图语言模型相当。这些发现共同揭示了现有图语言模型在图推理方面的局限性，并为推动社区发展出涉及图结构和语言的明确多模态推理方法提供了基础。

papers.title: Rejection-to-Acceptance Transition: Model Editing-Based Jailbreak Backdoor Injection Not Limited to Few Output Tokens
papers.title_zh: 拒绝到接受的转换：基于模型编辑的越狱后门注入技术并不局限于少数输出令牌
papers.authors: Shiji Yang, Min Cai, Hao Xiong, Congyao Mei, Haodong Zou, Shicheng Tan, Jie Chen, Fulan Qian, Shu Zhao
papers.abstract: Model editing-based jailbreak backdoor attacks against LLMs have gained attention for being lightweight, enabling vulnerability discovery in LLMs. Existing methods are implemented by binding backdoors to predefined phrases as first few output tokens, inducing the LLM’s next-token prediction to produce continuous responses. However, their effectiveness is heavily dependent on the number of bound phrases, with attack costs rising as this number increases. In this work, we propose JEST, which achieves jailbreak backdoor attacks by hijacking LLM representations into a acceptance domain rather than binding to a few output tokens. Specifically, we propose a representation transition-guided model editing to inject jailbreak backdoors into LLMs. The activated backdoor transitions the LLM from rejection domain to acceptance domain, causing it to accept and generate jailbreak behavior. To clearly distinguish between rejection and acceptance domains within LLMs, we also design a domain modeling strategy for JEST that models these two opposing domains within the representation space. Additionally, JEST-hijacked LLMs exhibit greater vulnerability to direct prompt attacks. Experimental results show that JEST outperforms existing model editing methods, demonstrating stronger jailbreak capabilities across various LLMs and datasets. We also provide analysis to explore the safety boundary of LLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于模型编辑的LLM越狱后门攻击因其轻量级特性而受到关注，这种攻击方式能够发现LLM中的漏洞。现有的方法是通过将后门与预定义的短语绑定，这些短语作为前几个输出令牌，从而诱导LLM进行下一个令牌的预测，进而产生连续的响应。然而，这些方法的有效性在很大程度上取决于被绑定的短语数量，随着该数量的增加，攻击成本也会上升。在这项研究中，我们提出了JEST算法，该算法通过劫持LLM的表示信息，将其引导到接受域，而不是仅仅绑定到少数输出令牌上，从而实现越狱后门攻击。具体来说，我们提出了一种基于表示转换引导的模型编辑方法，将越狱后门注入LLM中。激活后的后门会将LLM从拒绝域转移到接受域，使其接受并表现出越狱行为。为了清晰地区分LLM内的拒绝域和接受域，我们还设计了JEST的域建模策略，该策略在表示空间中模拟这两个对立的域。此外，经过JEST处理的LLM对直接提示攻击的脆弱性更高。实验结果表明，JEST在性能上优于现有的模型编辑方法，能够在各种LLM和数据集上展现出更强的越狱能力。我们还提供了分析，以探索LLM的安全边界。

papers.title: Causal Evidence Extraction and Triangulation in Crisis Reports using Large Language Models: A ReliefWeb-based Study
papers.title_zh: 利用大型语言模型在危机报道中提取因果证据并进行验证：以ReliefWeb为案例的研究
papers.authors: Yuanjun Zhang, Mourad Oussalah
papers.abstract: Humanitarian reports are long, noisy, and multi-topic, making it difficult to consolidate decision-relevant causal evidence. We present a ReliefWeb study (2000–2024) and a two-stage Large Language Model (LLM) pipeline that extracts structured intervention-outcome records with direction and strength attributes. Query-conditioned extraction restricts output to a specified intervention class, reducing retrieval-induced over-extraction, while snippet grounding links each relation to supporting text for auditability and classification. In an expert-annotated dataset of 100 reports, the best closed-source LLM achieved a weighted F1 score of 90.73% with strong cost-efficiency, while Llama-3.1-8B with supervised fine-tuning reached 94.15% weighted F1 score. We further propose context-preserving triangulation that aggregates strength-weighted evidence within disaster\timessource cells, applies Laplace smoothing and equally weights cells to quantify cross-context convergence via a Level-of-Evidence score. Applied to cash assistance, food-related outcomes show strong positive convergence (LoE=0.865) and stable long-horizon trajectories.
papers.abstract_zh: 人道主义报告往往篇幅冗长、内容繁杂，难以整合与决策相关的因果证据。我们采用了ReliefWeb数据库中的2000至2024年的数据，并采用了两阶段大语言模型流程来提取具有方向性和强度属性的干预效果记录。通过条件化查询机制，我们可以限制输出结果只包含特定类型的干预措施，从而减少因检索而产生的过度提取现象。同时，通过文本片段关联技术，可以将每个关系与相应的支持性文本联系起来，从而提高报告的可审核性和分类能力。在包含100份报告的专家标注数据集上，性能最好的开源语言模型达到了90.73%的加权F1分数，且成本效益显著；而经过监督微调的Llama-3.1-8B模型则达到了94.15%的加权F1分数。我们还提出了一种上下文保留型三角测量方法，该方法能够在灾害时间源单元格内汇总以强度为权重的数据证据，并通过拉普拉斯平滑处理以及等权重分配来量化不同上下文之间的收敛程度，进而得出证据等级评分。在现金援助和食品相关的结果中，这种方法的收敛效果非常显著（LoE=0.865），并且能够呈现出稳定的长期趋势。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Sounding vs. Being an Expert: Disentangling Authority, Register and Cultural Impact in Sycophantic LLMs
papers.title_zh: 发声与成为专家：解析在谄媚型大型语言模型中权威、语境与文化影响之间的关系
papers.authors: Gabriele Maraia, Fabio Massimo Zanzotto, Leonardo Ranaldi
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to exhibit sycophancy, a tendency to align with user assertions even when they conflict with facts. We frame sycophancy as a sociolinguistic phenomenon, disentangling two distinct drivers of credibility: explicit authority (credentials) and implicit authority (linguistic register). We introduce the Sycophancy Matrix, an adversarial evaluation framework that isolates these variables. Using a controlled subset of TruthfulQA, we evaluate open-weight models across English, Spanish, and Portuguese variants. Our findings reveal that models often conflate high register with truthfulness: for some architectures, sophisticated tone triggers deference more effectively than explicit expertise. Furthermore, we observe statistically significant variability across cultural variants of Spanish and Portuguese, supporting the hypothesis that LLMs internalise language-specific sociolinguistic norms and that sycophancy is not a purely technical deficit but an emergent property of multilingual training and alignment. Finally, we identify stable sycophancy fingerprints–domain-specific vulnerability profiles that persist across languages–suggesting that alignment artefacts are intrinsic to model families rather than linguistic context.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型被证明具有谄媚行为，即它们倾向于与用户的断言保持一致，即使这些断言与事实相矛盾。我们将谄媚行为视为一种社会语言学现象，并区分了影响可信度的两个主要因素：显性权威（资质）和隐性权威（语言风格）。我们提出了“谄媚矩阵”这一评估框架，用于分离这些因素。通过在一个受控的TruthfulQA数据集上进行测试，我们对英语、西班牙语和葡萄牙语变体中的开放权重模型进行了评估。我们的研究发现，模型常常将高语言风格与真实性混为一谈：对于某些架构来说，复杂的语气触发因素比明确的专业知识更能有效地引发用户的顺从行为。此外，我们在西班牙语和葡萄牙语的不同文化变体中观察到显著的差异，这支持了以下假设：语言模型会内化特定语言的社交语言规范，而谄媚行为并非纯粹的技术缺陷，而是多语言训练和对齐过程中的一种必然结果。最后，我们发现了一些稳定的谄媚行为特征——这些特征属于特定领域的脆弱性表现，且在不同语言中都能保持不变。这表明，对齐过程中的伪像实际上是模型家族固有的特性，而非语言环境的产物。

papers.title: Datamart-Agent: LLM-Driven Game-Theoretic Agent for Data Marketplace Modeling
papers.title_zh: DataMart代理：基于大语言模型的游戏化代理，用于数据市场建模
papers.authors: Pangjing Wu, Peter Q. Chen, Xiaodong Li, Wenqi Fan, Li Qing
papers.abstract: Data marketplaces analyze strategic data exchanges among users, platforms, and buyers. However, most existing studies model static equilibria and complete information, which limits their realism. In this work, we study whether large language model (LLM)-driven agents can make equilibrium-consistent decisions in analytically tractable data marketplaces with evolving and incomplete-information. Specifically, we introduce EvoDM, an agent-based modeling framework that extends the static data marketplace to dynamic and incomplete-information settings while providing tractable equilibrium benchmarks for evaluating agent decisions. Building upon EvoDM, we propose Datamart-Agent, an LLM-driven game-theoretic agent that improves equilibrium-consistent decision execution through dynamic game tree memory and mechanism-guided reflection, without requiring parameter updates. Experiments demonstrate that Datamart-Agent closely matches equilibrium-consistent decision-making, achieving the lowest utility gap and over 20% higher Pass@\epsilon than strong baselines. After validating its effectiveness, we employ EvoDM with Datamart-Agent to analyze competition and regulation in assumption-relaxed settings where closed-form ground truth is unavailable, providing exploratory simulation-based insights into market dynamics and regulatory effects.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据市场分析用户、平台和买家之间的战略数据交换。然而，大多数现有研究都是基于静态均衡和完全信息的模型，这限制了研究的现实性。在这项研究中，我们探讨了由大语言模型驱动的智能体是否能够在具有动态变化且信息不完全的数据市场中做出符合均衡的决策。具体来说，我们提出了EvoDM这一基于智能体的建模框架，该框架将静态数据市场扩展到动态且信息不完全的环境中，同时提供了可用于评估智能体决策结果的均衡基准。在EvoDM的基础上，我们提出了Datamart-Agent这一由语言模型驱动的游戏论智能体，它通过动态游戏树记忆和机制引导的反思，实现了符合均衡的决策执行，而无需进行参数更新。实验表明，Datamart-Agent在决策上非常接近均衡状态，其效用差距最小，且Pass@\epsilon指标比传统基线高出20%以上。在验证了其有效性后，我们结合EvoDM和Datamart-Agent来分析在无法获得封闭形式真实解的情况下的竞争与监管问题，从而从模拟角度深入了解市场动态和监管效应。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Multi-Drafter Speculative Decoding with Alignment Feedback
papers.title_zh: 带有对齐反馈的多条款推测解码方法
papers.authors: Taehyeon Kim, Hojung Jung, Se-Young Yun
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a smaller model to draft future tokens, which are then verified by the target LLM. This preserves generation quality by accepting only aligned tokens. However, individual drafters, often trained for specific tasks or domains, exhibit limited effectiveness across diverse applications. To address this, we introduce MetaSD, a unified framework that integrates multiple drafters into the SD process. MetaSD dynamically allocates computational resources to heterogeneous drafters by leveraging alignment feedback and framing drafter selection as a multi-armed bandit problem. Extensive experiments show MetaSD consistently outperforms single-drafter approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 投机式解码（SD）通过使用更简单的模型来生成未来的候选词，然后由目标大语言模型进行验证，从而加速大语言模型（LLM）的推理过程。这种方法通过只接受符合要求的候选词来确保生成的文本质量。然而，通常针对特定任务或领域进行训练的单个生成器在多种应用场景中的效果有限。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了MetaSD这一统一框架，它将多个生成器整合到投机式解码过程中。MetaSD利用对齐反馈来动态分配计算资源给不同的生成器，并将生成器的选择问题视为一个多臂老虎机问题。大量的实验表明，MetaSD在性能上始终优于仅使用单个生成器的方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Probabilistic Depression Detection from Textual Time Series
papers.title_zh: 基于文本时间序列的概率性抑郁检测技术
papers.authors: Fabian Schmidt, Seyedehmoniba Ravan, Vladimir Vlassov
papers.abstract: Accurate and interpretable predictions of depression severity are essential for clinical decision support, yet existing models often lack uncertainty estimates and temporal interpretability. We propose PTTSD, a Probabilistic framework for Depression Detection from clinical interview utterance sequences that predicts PHQ-8 scores while modeling calibrated uncertainty. PTTSD includes sequence-to-sequence and sequence-to-one variants, both combining LSTMs, self-attention, and residual connections with Gaussian or Student’s-t output heads trained via negative log-likelihood. The sequence-to-sequence variant enables temporal analysis of how predictive confidence evolves over an interview, despite the target being a single session-level score. Evaluated on E-DAIC and DAIC-WOZ, PTTSD achieves competitive performance among text-only systems (e.g., MAE = 3.85 on E-DAIC, 3.55 on DAIC) and produces well-calibrated prediction intervals. Ablations confirm the value of attention and probabilistic modeling, while a three-part calibration analysis and qualitative case studies highlight the clinical relevance of uncertainty-aware prediction.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确且可解释的抑郁症严重程度预测对于临床决策支持至关重要。然而，现有的模型往往缺乏不确定性估计以及时间上的可解释性。我们提出了PTTSD这一概率框架，该框架能够从临床访谈话语序列中检测抑郁症，并同时建模出经过校准的不确定性参数，从而预测PHQ-8评分。PTTSD包含序列到序列和序列到一两种变体，这两种变体都结合了LSTM、自注意力机制以及残差连接，同时使用高斯或学生t分布输出头进行训练，这些输出头通过负对数似然函数进行训练。序列到序列的变体能够随时间分析预测置信度的变化情况，即使目标只是针对单次会话的评分也是如此。在E-DAIC和DAIC-WOZ数据集上进行的评估表明，PTTSD在仅文本系统的性能中表现相当出色（例如在E-DAIC数据集上的平均绝对误差为3.85，在DAIC数据集上为3.55），并且能够生成精确校准的预测区间。消融实验证实了注意力机制和概率建模的重要性。此外，三部分校准分析和定性案例研究进一步凸显了具有不确定性感知能力的预测在临床应用中的价值。

papers.title: Distilling Examples into Task Instructions: Enhanced In-Context Learning for Real-World B2B Conversations
papers.title_zh: 将示例转化为任务指令：提升现实世界中的B2B对话学习效率
papers.authors: Guy Rotman, Adi Kopilov, Danit Berger Zalmanson, Omri Allouche
papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) is the standard method for low-resource classification, yet its efficacy in specialized domains remains largely unexplored. We address the challenge of classifying semantically complex, multi-party B2B conversations, where traditional ICL encounters significant limitations, especially as context length increases due to the concatenation of multiple few-shot examples. We introduce the Call Playbook dataset, featuring five classification tasks derived from real-world B2B conversations targeting core sales concepts. To bridge the gap between performance and practical utility, we propose novel knowledge extraction methods that distill verbose examples into compact, interpretable representations of structured classification criteria and precise task descriptions. Our approach achieves a 99% reduction in token usage and improves macro-averaged AUC by up to 7% over traditional ICL. Notably, it remains robust as context grows, unlike advanced token compression baselines which degrade by over 9 F1 points. Importantly, our framework enables direct refinement of classification logic, addressing critical needs for transparency, efficiency, and user interaction in real-world NLP applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 上下文学习是一种适用于资源匮乏场景的分类方法，然而其在特定领域的有效性仍未被充分探索。我们面临着对语义复杂、涉及多方的B2B对话进行分类的挑战，传统上下文学习方法在上下文长度增加、需要结合多个少量样本示例时存在显著局限性。我们引入了Call Playbook数据集，该数据集包含五个分类任务，这些任务基于现实中的B2B对话，旨在解决核心销售问题。为了将性能与实际应用相结合，我们提出了新的知识提取方法，能够将冗长的示例简化为简洁且可解释的表示形式，从而更好地符合结构化分类标准和任务描述的要求。我们的方法使得标记使用量减少了99%，并且整体AUC评分比传统上下文学习方法提高了7%。值得注意的是，即使上下文长度增加，我们的方法依然表现出良好的性能，而一些先进的标记压缩方法则会出现超过9点的F1分数下降。重要的是，我们的框架能够直接优化分类逻辑，从而满足现实自然语言处理应用中对透明度、效率以及用户交互的需求。

papers.title: Multilingual Tokenization through the Lens of Indian Languages: Challenges and Insights
papers.title_zh: 通过多种语言进行标记化处理：挑战与机遇——以印度语言为例
papers.authors: Maharaj Brahma, N J Karthika, Rajat Verma, Nagasai Saketh Naidu, Rohit Saluja, Maunendra Sankar Desarkar, Ganesh Ramakrishnan
papers.abstract: Tokenization plays a pivotal role in NLP and is fundamental to training language models. However, existing tokenizers are often skewed towards high-resource languages, limiting their effectiveness for linguistically diverse and morphologically rich languages such as those in the Indian subcontinent. In this work, we present a comprehensive empirical study of multilingual tokenization across 17 Indic languages spanning 11 scripts and two language families. We systematically evaluate the effects of (i) widely used subword algorithms: BPE (CITATION) and Unigram LM (CITATION), (ii) script and orthography-aware normalization, (iii) vocabulary size, and (iv) multilingual vocabulary construction strategies. We use a combination of intrinsic and extrinsic evaluations to obtain the following observations: (i) script-specific normalization improves tokenization quality, (ii) Unigram LM better preserves morphological boundaries than BPE, (iii) cluster-based vocabulary construction shows improvement in downstream tasks compared to the joint method. Our findings highlight the importance of linguistically informed design choices in multilingual tokenization and offer practical guidance for building effective tokenizers for low-resource and morphologically complex languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 标记化在自然语言处理中起着至关重要的作用，是训练语言模型的基础。然而，现有的标记器往往偏向于资源丰富的语言，这限制了它们对语言多样性和形态丰富语言的有效性，比如印度次大陆的语言。在这项研究中，我们对17种印地语进行了多语言标记化的全面实证研究，这些语言涵盖了11种文字和两个语系。我们系统地评估了以下因素对标记化效果的影响：(i)广泛使用的子词算法：BPE和Unigram LM；(ii)考虑文字和拼写规则的规范化处理；(iii)词汇量大小；(iv)多语言词汇构建策略。通过结合内在评估和外在评估，我们得到了以下结论：(i)针对特定文字的规范化处理能提升标记化的质量；(ii)Unigram LM比BPE更能保留形态边界；(iii)基于聚类的词汇构建方法在后续任务中表现优于联合方法。我们的研究发现强调了在多语言标记化过程中，基于语言特性的设计选择的重要性，并为构建适用于资源匮乏和形态复杂的语言的有效标记器提供了实用指导。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TrimTokenator: Towards Adaptive Visual Token Pruning for Large Multimodal Models
papers.title_zh: TrimTokenator：面向大型多模态模型的自适应视觉标记剪枝技术
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Lyu Mengsi, Chenrui He, Yulong Ao, Yonghua Lin
papers.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved significant success across various tasks. These models usually encode visual inputs into dense token sequences, which are then concatenated with textual tokens and jointly processed by a language model. However, the increased token count substantially raises computational and memory costs during inference. Token pruning has emerged as a promising approach to address this issue. Existing token pruning methods often rely on costly calibration or suboptimal importance metrics, leading to redundant retained tokens. In this paper, we analyze the redundancy differences between visual and textual tokens and propose pruning exclusively on visual tokens. Based on this, we propose a visual token pruning strategy that explicitly preserves both cross-modal alignment and intra-modal informational diversity. We introduce a mutual information-based token pruning strategy that removes visual tokens semantically misaligned with textual tokens, effectively preserving the alignment between the visual and textual modalities. We further refine the retained tokens by maximizing their expected pairwise distances in the latent space to enhance representational quality and reduce redundancy. which is solved efficiently with a greedy algorithm. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method maintains strong performance while reducing tokens by 88.9% on models such as LLaVA-1.5-7B and LLaVA-NEXT-7B, resulting in a 56.7% improvement in inference speed.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型多模态模型在各类任务中取得了显著的成功。这些模型通常将视觉输入编码成密集的令牌序列，然后将这些令牌与文本令牌进行合并，并由语言模型共同处理。然而，随着令牌数量的增加，推理过程中的计算和内存成本也会显著上升。因此，令牌剪枝成为一种有前景的解决方案。现有的令牌剪枝方法往往依赖于昂贵的校准过程或不太理想的权重度量机制，这会导致保留的令牌出现冗余现象。在本文中，我们分析了视觉令牌和文本令牌之间的冗余差异，并提出了仅对视觉令牌进行剪枝的策略。在此基础上，我们提出了一种视觉令牌剪枝策略，该策略能够同时保留跨模态对齐性和模态内部的信息多样性。我们采用了基于互信息的令牌剪枝策略，将那些与文本令牌语义上不匹配的视觉令牌移除，从而有效保持了视觉模态和文本模态之间的对齐性。我们还通过最大化潜在空间中令牌之间的期望成对距离来进一步优化保留的令牌，以提高表示质量并减少冗余。这一过程可以通过贪婪算法高效完成。大量实验表明，我们的方法在减少88.9%的令牌数量的同时，仍然保持了强大的性能表现。例如，在LaVA-1.5-7B和LaVA-NEXT-7B模型中，推理速度提升了56.7%。

papers.title: TTVS: Boosting Self-Exploring Reinforcement Learning via Test-time Variational Synthesis
papers.title_zh: TTVS：通过测试时变分合成技术提升自探索强化学习性能
papers.authors: Sikai Bai, Haoxi Li, Jie Zhang, Yongjiang Liu, Song Guo
papers.abstract: Despite significant advances in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) driven by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), this paradigm is fundamentally limited in specialized or novel domains where such supervision is prohibitively expensive or unavailable, posing a key challenge for test-time adaptation. While existing test-time methods offer a potential solution, they are constrained by learning from static query sets, risking overfitting to textual patterns. To address this gap, we introduce Test-Time Variational Synthesis (TTVS), a novel framework that enables LRMs to self-evolve by dynamically augmenting the training stream from unlabeled test queries. TTVS comprises two synergistic modules: (1) Online Variational Synthesis, which transforms static test queries into a dynamic stream of diverse, semantically-equivalent variations, enforcing the model to learn underlying problem logic rather than superficial patterns; (2) Test-time Hybrid Exploration, which balances accuracy-driven exploitation with consistency-driven exploration across synthetic variants. Extensive experiments show TTVS yields superior performance across eight model architectures. Notably, using only unlabeled test-time data, TTVS not only surpasses other test-time adaptation methods but also outperforms state-of-the-art supervised RL-based techniques trained on vast, high-quality labeled data.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管基于可验证奖励的强化学习在大型推理模型领域取得了显著进展，但这一范式在那些需要特殊或新颖监督机制的成本过高或无法实现的领域仍然面临根本性的限制，这成为了测试时适应的一个关键挑战。虽然现有的测试时方法提供了潜在的解决方案，但它们受到从静态查询集学习的限制，容易过度拟合文本模式。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了测试时变分合成技术——一种新型框架，它能够通过动态扩展来自未标记测试查询的训练数据来使大型推理模型自我进化。TTVS包含两个协同模块：(1)在线变分合成，它将静态测试查询转化为一系列多样化的、语义上等价的变化形式，从而迫使模型学习底层的问题逻辑，而非表面的模式；(2)测试时混合探索，它能够在合成变体之间平衡以准确性为驱动的利用和以一致性为驱动的探索。大量实验表明，TTVS在八种模型架构中都能表现出卓越的性能。值得注意的是，仅使用未标记的测试数据时，TTVS不仅超越了其他测试时适应方法，还优于那些在大量高质量标记数据上训练出的最先进的基于监督强化学习的技术。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Parallel Context-of-Experts Decoding for Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 并行式专家语境解码技术，用于增强检索与生成能力
papers.authors: Giulio Corallo, Paolo Papotti
papers.abstract: Retrieval Augmented Generation faces a trade-off: concatenating documents in a long prompt enables multi-document reasoning but creates prefill bottlenecks, while encoding document KV caches separately offers speed but breaks cross-document interaction. We propose Parallel Context-of-Experts Decoding (PCED), a training-free framework that shifts evidence aggregation from the attention mechanism to the decoding. PCED treats retrieved documents as isolated “experts”, synchronizing their predictions via a retrieval-aware extension of context-aware decoding. This approach recovers cross-document reasoning capabilities without constructing a shared attention across documents.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成面临一个权衡问题：在长提示中串联文档可以实现多文档推理，但会导致预填充瓶颈；而单独编码文档的KV缓存则能提升速度，但会破坏跨文档的交互性。我们提出了并行专家上下文解码（Parallel Context-of-Experts Decoding，PCED）这一无需训练的框架，它将证据聚合的任务从注意力机制转移到了解码阶段。PCED将检索到的文档视为独立的“专家”，通过一种基于检索意识的上下文感知解码方式，使它们的预测结果相互同步。这种方法能够在不构建跨文档共享注意力机制的情况下，恢复跨文档的推理能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLaTiSA: Towards Difficulty-Stratified Time Series Reasoning from Visual Perception to Semantics
papers.title_zh: LLaTiSA：从视觉感知到语义学，实现基于难度分层的时间序列推理
papers.authors: Yueyang Ding, HaoPeng Zhang, Rui Dai, Yi Wang, Tianyu Zong, Kaikui Liu, Xiangxiang Chu
papers.abstract: Comprehensive understanding of time series remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs). Current research is hindered by fragmented task definitions and benchmarks with inherent ambiguities, precluding rigorous evaluation and the development of unified Time Series Reasoning Models (TSRMs). To bridge this gap, we formalize Time Series Reasoning (TSR) via a four-level taxonomy of increasing cognitive complexity. We introduce HiTSR, a hierarchical time series reasoning dataset comprising 83k samples with diverse task combinations and verified Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories. Leveraging HiTSR, we propose LLaTiSA, a strong TSRM that integrates visualized patterns with precision-calibrated numerical tables to enhance the temporal perception of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Through a multi-stage curriculum fine-tuning strategy, LLaTiSA achieves superior performance and exhibits robust out-of-distribution generalization across diverse TSR tasks and real-world scenarios. We will publicly release the code, dataset, and model weights.
papers.abstract_zh: 对时间序列的全面理解仍然是大语言模型面临的重要挑战。当前的研究受到任务定义不清晰以及基准测试存在歧义的限制，这阻碍了严格评估以及统一时间序列推理模型的开发。为了填补这一空白，我们通过一种四层级的分类体系来形式化时间序列推理。我们引入了HiTSR这个分层时间序列推理数据集，该数据集包含8.3万个样本，涵盖了多种任务组合，并且其推理过程经过验证的链式思维流程支持。利用HiTSR，我们提出了LaTiSA这个强大的时间序列推理模型，它结合了可视化的模式与经过精度校准的数值表格，从而提升了视觉语言模型的时间感知能力。通过多阶段课程微调策略，LaTiSA在多种时间序列任务和现实场景中均表现出卓越的性能，并具备出色的泛化能力。我们将公开发布该模型的代码、数据集以及模型权重。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: NeedleChain: Measuring Intact Context Comprehension Capability of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: NeedleChain：评估大型语言模型的整体上下文理解能力
papers.authors: Hyeonseok Moon, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract: Recent reports suggest that LLMs can handle increasingly long contexts. However, many existing benchmarks for context understanding embed substantial query-irrelevant content, which shifts evaluation toward retrieving relevant snippets rather than fully integrating all provided information. Under this setting, we view that current benchmarks can overestimate true context-understanding ability of LLMs. In particular, we demonstrate that when the context consists entirely of query-relevant text, even advanced models such as GPT-4o fail to reliably integrate inputs as short as 200 tokens. To evaluate this capability more rigorously, we introduce NeedleChain, a benchmark designed to test whether models can faithfully incorporate all given evidence. NeedleChain includes three variants that differ in the required order of comprehension, along with a parallel benchmark based on the needle-in-a-haystack(NIAH) paradigm. By comparing these variants, NeedleChain enables a more comprehensive assessment of context understanding. We further propose a training-free strategy that encourages models to reflect all available information, ROPE contraction, highlighting the importance of full-context integration and pointing to new directions for improving reliable reasoning over context.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的报告显示，大语言模型能够处理越来越长的上下文内容。然而，许多现有的上下文理解基准测试中包含了大量与查询无关的内容，这导致评估的重点集中在检索相关片段上，而不是全面整合所有提供的信息。在这种环境下，我们认为当前的基准测试可能会高估大语言模型的真实上下文理解能力。具体来说，我们发现当上下文完全由与查询相关的文本构成时，即使是像GPT-4o这样的先进模型也无法可靠地整合长度仅为200个词的信息。为了更严格地评估这一能力，我们提出了NeedleChain这一基准测试，旨在检验模型是否能够忠实整合所有给定的信息。NeedleChain包含三种不同的变体，这些变体的理解顺序各不相同，同时还有一个基于“大海捞针”范式的并行基准测试。通过比较这些变体，NeedleChain能够更全面地评估上下文理解能力。我们还提出了一种无需训练的策略，该策略鼓励模型充分反映所有可用信息，即ROP收缩法。这强调了全面整合上下文的重要性，并为改进可靠的上下文推理提供了新的方向。

papers.title: From Scores to Preferences: Redefining Evaluation Paradigm for Speech Quality Reward Modeling
papers.title_zh: 从评分到偏好设定：重新定义语音质量评估的范式以用于奖励模型构建
papers.authors: Yifei Cao, Changhao Jiang, Jiabao Zhuang, Jiajun Sun, Ming Zhang, Zhiheng Xi, Hui Li, Shihan Dou, Yuran Wang, Yunke Zhang, Tao Ji, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.abstract: Speech quality assessment (SQA) is typically formulated as a score regression task based on subjective ratings, such as the Mean Opinion Score (MOS), which inherently suffer from inconsistent standards and limit cross-dataset training and evaluation. To address these limitations, we reformulate SQA as a preference-based comparison paradigm and construct MOS-Pref, a large-scale MOS-derived preference dataset. Building on MOS-Pref, we systematically implement and evaluate three reward modeling paradigms: scalar, semi-scalar, and generative reward models, alongside existing SQA approaches. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (1) scalar models achieve the strongest overall performance, consistently exceeding 74% accuracy; (2) score regression-based approaches generally underperform preference-based methods in both overall performance and generalization; and (3) all reward models struggle on pairs with very small MOS gap. Motivated by these observations, we propose a MOS-aware GRM design that incorporates MOS gap into the reward function during reinforcement learning. Experimental results show that the MOS-aware GRM significantly improves fine-grained speech quality discrimination. We hope this work fosters more rigorous and scalable research in SQA.
papers.abstract_zh: 语音质量评估（SQA）通常是一种基于主观评分的评分回归任务，例如平均意见得分（MOS）。然而，这种评估方式存在标准不统一的问题，同时也不利于跨数据集的训练和评估。为了克服这些局限性，我们将SQA重新定义为一种基于偏好的比较范式，并构建了一个名为MOS-Pref的大规模、基于MOS的偏好数据集。在MOS-Pref的基础上，我们系统地实现了三种奖励建模方法：标量模型、半标量模型和生成式奖励模型，并将它们与现有的SQA方法进行了对比测试。我们的实验得出三个重要结论：(1) 标量模型的整体性能最为出色，准确率始终超过74%；(2) 基于评分回归的方法在整体性能和泛化能力方面通常不如基于偏好的方法；(3) 所有奖励模型在处理MOS差距非常小的配对数据时都存在困难。基于这些观察结果，我们提出了一种具有MOS意识的GRM设计，该设计在强化学习过程中将MOS差距纳入奖励函数中。实验结果表明，这种具有MOS意识的GRM方法显著提升了对语音质量细节方面的判别能力。我们希望这项工作能够推动SQA领域更加严谨且可扩展的研究。

papers.title: FIND: Toward Multimodal Financial Reasoning and Question Answering for Indic Languages
papers.title_zh: FIND：迈向多模态金融推理与问答系统的发展——适用于印地语处理
papers.authors: Sarmistha Das, Vaibhav Vishal, Syed Ibrahim Ahmad, Sriparna Saha, Manish Gupta
papers.abstract: Financial decision-making in multilingual settings demands accurate numerical reasoning grounded in diverse modalities, yet existing benchmarks largely overlook this high-stakes, real-world challenge, especially for Indic languages. We introduce FinVQA, a benchmark for evaluating financial numerical and multimodal reasoning in multilingual Indic contexts. FinVQA spans English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, and Tamil, and comprises 18,900 samples across 14 financial domains. The dataset captures diverse reasoning paradigms under realistic constraints, and is structured across three difficulty levels (easy, moderate, hard) and four question formats: multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank, table matching, and true/false. To address these challenges, we propose FIND, a framework that combines supervised fine-tuning with constraint-aware decoding to promote faithful numerical reasoning, robust multimodal grounding, and structured decision-making. Together, FinVQA and FIND establish a rigorous evaluation and modeling paradigm for high-stakes multilingual multimodal financial reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 在多语言环境中进行财务决策需要基于多种模态的精确数值推理能力，然而现有的评估基准大多忽略了这一高风险的现实挑战，尤其是针对印度语系的语言。我们提出了FinVQA这一基准测试，用于评估在多语言印度语环境下进行的财务数值推理和多模态推理能力。FinVQA涵盖了英语、印地语、孟加拉语、马拉地语、古吉拉特语和泰米尔语，包含18,900个样本，涉及14个财务领域。该数据集能够在现实的约束条件下捕捉到多种推理模式，并且分为三个难度级别（简单、中等、困难）以及四种问题形式：选择题、填空题、表格匹配题和判断题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了FIND框架，该框架结合了有监督的微调技术和考虑约束条件的解码方法，以促进准确的数值推理、强大的多模态基础以及结构化的决策制定。FinVQA和FIND共同构建了一个严格的评估和建模框架，适用于高风险的多语言多模态财务推理任务。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Think Smart, Not Hard: Difficulty Adaptive Reasoning for Large Audio Language Models
papers.title_zh: 聪明地思考，而非勉强应付：针对大型音频语言模型设计的难度自适应推理机制
papers.authors: Zhichao Sheng, Shilin Zhou, Chen Gong, Zhenghua Li
papers.abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) employing the Chain-of-Thought paradigm have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities. Though different problems naturally require varying depths of reasoning, existing methods often determine whether to perform reasoning, lacking fine-grained mechanisms to adapt reasoning length to problem complexity. As a result, LALMs often adopt a one-size-fits-all reasoning strategy, leading to redundant overthinking for simple tasks and insufficient reasoning for complex ones. In this paper, we conduct an in-depth analysis of LALM reasoning behavior and argue that effective and efficient reasoning should be adaptively aligned with task difficulty. To this end, we propose a difficulty-adaptive reasoning method for LALMs. Specifically, we introduce a reward function that dynamically links reasoning length to the model’s perceived problem difficulty, encouraging shorter reasoning for easy tasks and longer reasoning for more complex ones. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method consistently improves performance while reducing average reasoning length by at least 50%, achieving higher efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 采用思维链范式的大型音频语言模型展现了卓越的推理能力。虽然不同问题自然需要不同深度的推理，但现有方法往往只是简单地决定是否进行推理，缺乏能够根据问题复杂度调整推理长度的精细机制。因此，大型音频语言模型通常采用一种一刀切的推理策略，这导致在简单任务上过度思考，而在复杂任务上则推理不足。在本文中，我们对大型音频语言模型的推理行为进行了深入分析，并认为有效的推理应该能够根据任务难度进行自适应调整。为此，我们提出了一种针对大型音频语言模型的难度自适应推理方法。具体来说，我们引入了一种奖励函数，该函数能够动态地将推理长度与模型感知到的任务难度联系起来，从而鼓励在简单任务上使用较短的推理时间，在复杂任务上使用较长的推理时间。在三个数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法能够在提高性能的同时，将平均推理时间至少减少50%，从而实现更高的效率，同时不牺牲准确性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Infer Human Actions and Motives? Evaluation in Social Prediction and Inspection Games
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否推断出人类的行动和动机？在社交预测与互动游戏中的应用评估
papers.authors: Kaleen Shrestha, Abhinav Gupta, Harish Dukkipati, Zhonghao Shi, Maja Mataric
papers.abstract: Humans are able to predict each other’s actions by reasoning about the others’ underlying goals, preferences, and motives, such as greed and risk-aversion. Game theory provides a framework for studying human behaviors through incentivized games that simulate social situations. We utilized two validated games from the cognitive science literature—the Social Prediction Game (SPG) and the Inspection Game (IG)—to systematically study how well several recent open- and closed-source LLMs predict player actions and whether they can leverage and generalize the players’ motives learned from the iterated games. Our results indicate that state-of-the-art LLMs can achieve accuracy close to human levels in predicting players’ actions with underlying human motives in SPGs. However, unlike humans, who rely on reasoning about players’ motives to inform their predictions, LLMs failed to recognize statistical patterns in players’ actions. As a result, LLM prediction accuracy did not improve over multiple rounds. Our results in the IG further demonstrate that, unlike humans, LLMs were unable to recognize a player’s underlying motives and to generalize their understanding of the same player to a new context. This suggests that LLMs may lack reasoning capabilities. Our findings offer insights into differences in human and LLM reasoning mechanisms, suggesting that further research into human-AI alignment is needed before utilizing LLMs for human behavior modeling and simulation in this and related contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类能够通过推理他人的潜在目标、偏好和动机（如贪婪和风险厌恶）来预测彼此的行为。博弈论为通过模拟社会情境的激励游戏来研究人类行为提供了框架。我们采用了认知科学文献中两种经过验证的游戏——社会预测游戏和检查游戏——来系统地研究最近的几种开源和闭源大语言模型在预测玩家行为方面的表现，以及它们是否能够利用并泛化从迭代游戏中获得的玩家动机信息。我们的结果表明，最先进的大语言模型在预测玩家在社交预测游戏中基于人类动机的行为时，其准确率接近人类水平。然而，与人类依靠推理玩家的动机来做出预测不同，大语言模型未能识别出玩家行为中的统计模式。因此，多轮预测后，大语言模型的预测准确率并没有提高。我们在检查游戏中的研究结果进一步表明，与人类不同，大语言模型无法识别玩家的潜在动机，也无法将对同一玩家的理解泛化到新的情境中。这表明大语言模型可能缺乏推理能力。我们的发现揭示了人类和大语言模型推理机制之间的差异，这意味着在利用大语言模型进行人类行为的建模和仿真之前，还需要进一步研究人类与人工智能之间的对齐问题。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Self-Consistency from Only Two Samples: CoT–PoT Ensembling for Efficient LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 仅通过两个样本实现自我一致性：CoT-PoT集成技术，助力高效LLM推理
papers.authors: Raman Saparkhan, Majd Hawasly, Md Rizwan Parvez, Mohammad Raza
papers.abstract: Self-consistency (SC) is a popular technique for improving the reasoning accuracy of large language models by aggregating multiple sampled outputs, but it comes at a high computational cost due to extensive sampling. We introduce a hybrid ensembling approach that leverages the complementary strengths of two distinct modes of reasoning: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and Program-of-Thought (PoT). We describe a general framework for combining these two forms of reasoning in self-consistency, as well as particular strategies for both full sampling and early-stopping. We show that CoT-PoT ensembling not only improves overall accuracy, but also drastically reduces the number of samples required for SC by a factor of 9.3x. In particular, the majority of tasks (78.6%) can be addressed with only two samples, which has not been possible with any prior SC methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 自洽性是一种常用的技术，它通过整合多个采样结果来提高大语言模型的推理准确性。不过，由于需要大量的采样工作，这种方法的计算成本非常高。我们提出了一种混合集成方法，利用两种不同推理方式的互补优势：思维链推理和程序式推理。我们描述了一种将这两种推理方式结合使用的通用框架，以及针对全采样和提前停止的具体策略。结果表明，思维链-程序式集成不仅提升了整体准确率，还将自洽性所需样本数量减少了9.3倍。具体来说，大多数任务（78.6%）只需两个样本就能解决，这是之前任何自洽性方法都无法实现的。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ZoomRAG: Hierarchical Random-walk Zooming across Multi-scale Information Graphs for Fast and Accurate RAG
papers.title_zh: ZoomRAG：基于分层随机游走算法的方法，在多个层次的信息图中进行缩放处理，从而实现快速且准确的语义理解任务
papers.authors: Xianming Hu, Jingyang Chen, Bin Tang, Yihe Liu, Yihong Huang, Hongbo Zhao, Nuoyi Chen, Jie Zhang, Ping Li, Kai Zhang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation is a powerful tool for NLP applications. Yet, it is challenging to encode large knowledge bases as compact offline structures while simultaneously achieving accurate, low-latency online retrieval. We propose ZoomRAG, a coarse-to-fine, hierarchical graph inference method to tackle the challenges. ZoomRAG formulates the retrieval task as random walks across multi-scale relational graphs. At the coarse level, it constructs a global relational graph and performs a query-initiated random walk to quickly locate a few relevant documents over the entire corpus. At the finer level, it “zooms into” the selected documents to capture fine-grained semantic and temporal relations, and conducts a second random walk to pinpoint salient evidence chunks for generation. This coarse-to-fine strategy substantially reduces offline indexing costs and accelerates online retrieval. Moreover, random-walk based topological reasoning over rich, multi-scale relational structures enables ZoomRAG to effectively aggregate multi-hop evidence while suppressing noise. Finally, we address the difficulty of handling concurrent RAG queries by algorithm-parallel ZoomRAG. Overall, ZoomRAG avoids building expensive knowledge graphs while achieving 2.2% – 4.9% absolute gains in accuracy over SOTA RAG models, with an average online retrieval latency per-query as low as 0.019 secs by processing hundreds of queries concurrently.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成是自然语言处理领域中的一种强大工具。然而，将庞大的知识库编码为紧凑的离线结构，同时实现准确且低延迟的在线检索，是一项具有挑战性的任务。我们提出了ZoomRAG这一从粗到细、基于层次化图推理的方法来解决这些挑战。ZoomRAG将检索任务转化为在多尺度关系图中进行随机游走的过程。在粗级别上，它构建出一个全局关系图，并通过查询驱动的随机游走来快速定位整个语料库中一些相关的文档。在更细级别的推理中，它“聚焦”于选定的文档，以捕捉细粒度的语义和时间关系，然后通过第二次随机游走来确定用于生成的关键证据片段。这种从粗到细的策略显著降低了离线索引的成本，并加速了在线检索过程。此外，基于随机游走的拓扑推理机制能够作用于复杂且多尺度的关系结构，使得ZoomRAG能够有效地聚合多跳证据，同时抑制噪声的影响。最后，我们通过算法并行化的ZoomRAG解决了同时处理多个RAG查询的难题。总体而言，ZoomRAG避免了构建昂贵的知识图谱，同时实现了比现有SOTA RAG模型高出2.2%至4.9%的准确率提升，而且通过并发处理数百个查询，其平均在线检索延迟低至0.019秒。

papers.title: Training Language Models to Use Prolog as a Tool
papers.title_zh: 训练语言模型，使其能够利用Prolog作为工具
papers.authors: Niklas Mellgren, Peter Schneider-Kamp, Lukas Galke Poech
papers.abstract: Language models frequently produce plausible yet incorrect reasoning traces that are difficult to verify. We investigate fine-tuning models to use Prolog as an external symbolic reasoning tool, training Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on a cleaned version of GSM8K (which we release as gsm8k-prolog-prover). We systematically vary prompt structure, reward composition (execution, syntax, semantics, structure), and inference protocol (single-try, multiple-try, and two agentic modes). Our reinforcement learning approach outperforms supervised fine-tuning on GSM8K, and the resulting 3B model achieves zero-shot performance on MMLU-STEM and MMLU-Pro competitive with 7B few-shot baselines. Most importantly, we identify an accuracy–auditability trade-off: configurations tuned for correctness alone learn to delegate reasoning to natural language and use Prolog only for the final computation, while configurations rewarded for symbolic structure produce fully auditable programs at a cost in accuracy. We interpret this trade-off as a form of reward hacking and discuss its implications for deploying neurosymbolic systems in safety-critical domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型常常产生看似合理但错误的推理轨迹，这些轨迹难以验证。我们研究了对模型的微调技术，使用Prolog作为外部符号化推理工具，对Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct进行训练，并采用群体相对策略优化算法在GSM8K的清理版本上进行训练（我们将该版本命名为gsm8k-prolog-prover）。我们系统地改变了提示结构、奖励构成（执行、语法、语义、结构）以及推理协议（单次尝试、多次尝试和双代理模式）。我们的强化学习方法在GSM8K上的表现优于监督式微调，而最终的3B模型在MMLU-STEM和MMLU-Pro任务上实现了零样本性能，其表现与7B少样本基线相当。最重要的是，我们发现了一个准确性与可审计性的权衡：那些仅追求正确性的配置会学会将推理任务委托给自然语言处理，而只使用Prolog进行最终计算；而那些因符号结构而获得奖励的配置则能够生成完全可审计的程序，但代价是牺牲了准确性。我们将这种权衡解释为一种奖励机制的调整方式，并讨论了其对在安全关键领域部署神经符号系统的影响。

papers.title: Frame of Reference: Addressing the Challenges of Common Ground Representation in Situational Dialogs
papers.title_zh: 参照框架：应对情境对话中共同基础表达所面临的挑战
papers.authors: Biswesh Mohapatra, Théo Charlot, Giovanni Duca, Mayank Palan, Laurent Romary, Justine Cassell
papers.abstract: Common ground plays a critical role in situated spoken dialogues, where interlocutors must establish and maintain shared references to entities, events, and relations to sustain coherent interaction. For dialog systems, the ability to correctly ground conversational content in order to refer back to it later is particularly important. Prior studies have demonstrated that LLMs are capable of performing grounding acts such as requesting clarification or producing acknowledgments, yet relatively little work has investigated how common ground can be explicitly represented and stored for later use. Without such mechanisms, it remains unclear whether acknowledgment or clarification behaviors truly reflect a grounded understanding. In this work, we evaluate a model’s ability to establish and exploit common ground through relational references to entities within the shared context in a situational dialogue. We test multiple methods for representing common ground in situated dialogues and further propose approaches to improve both the establishment of common ground and its subsequent use in the conversation.
papers.abstract_zh: 在情境性对话中，共同基础起着至关重要的作用。对话双方必须建立并维护对实体、事件和关系的共同理解，才能维持连贯的互动。对于对话系统而言，能够正确地将对话内容进行定位，以便之后能够引用这些内容是至关重要的。先前的研究表明，大语言模型能够执行诸如请求澄清或产生确认这样的定位操作，但相对较少的研究探讨如何明确表示和存储共同基础，以便后续使用。如果没有这样的机制，就无法确定确认或澄清行为是否真正反映了对内容的准确理解。在这项研究中，我们评估了一个模型通过关系引用来建立和利用共同基础的能力，这些关系引用是在共享上下文中的实体之间建立的。我们测试了多种在情境对话中表示共同基础的方法，并进一步提出了一些方法来改进共同基础的建立及其在对话中的后续使用。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MultiDx: A Multi-Source Knowledge Integration Framework towards Diagnostic Reasoning
papers.title_zh: MultiDx：一种用于促进诊断推理的多源知识整合框架
papers.authors: Yimin Deng, Zhenxi Lin, Yejing Wang, Guoshuai Zhao, Pengyue Jia, Zichuan Fu, Derong Xu, Yefeng Zheng, Xiangyu Zhao, Li Zhu, Xian Wu, Xueming Qian
papers.abstract: Diagnostic prediction and clinical reasoning are critical tasks in healthcare applications. While large language models have shown strong capabilities in commonsense reasoning, they still struggle with diagnostic reasoning due to limited domain knowledge. Existing approaches often rely on internal model knowledge or static knowledge bases, which are insufficient to support the knowledge demands of diagnostic reasoning. Moreover, these methods focus solely on the accuracy of final predictions, overlooking alignment with standard clinical reasoning trajectories. To this end, we propose MultiDx, a two-stage diagnostic reasoning framework that performs differential diagnosis by analyzing evidence collected from multiple knowledge sources. Specifically, it first generates suspected diagnoses and reasoning traces by leveraging knowledge from web search, SOAP-formatted case, and clinical case database. Then it integrates multi-perspective evidence through matching, voting, and differential diagnosis to generate the final prediction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 诊断预测和临床推理是医疗应用中至关重要的任务。虽然大语言模型在常识推理方面表现出强大的能力，但由于领域知识有限，它们在诊断推理方面仍然存在困难。现有的方法通常依赖于内部模型知识或静态知识库，这些手段不足以满足诊断推理的需求。此外，这些方法仅关注最终预测的准确性，而忽略了与标准临床推理流程的衔接。为此，我们提出了MultiDx这一两阶段诊断推理框架，该框架通过分析来自多个知识源的证据来进行鉴别诊断。具体来说，它首先通过利用网络搜索、SOAP格式病例以及临床病例数据库中的知识来生成疑似诊断和推理轨迹。然后，它通过匹配、投票和鉴别诊断等方式整合多视角的证据，以得出最终预测结果。大量的实验证明了我们的方法的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Training Verifier to Assessing Complex Real-World Tool-Use Trajectories
papers.title_zh: 训练验证器以评估复杂真实场景中的工具使用轨迹
papers.authors: Linzhuang Sun, Mingyang Chen, Hao Liang, Tianpeng Li, Zhou Yijie, Chenzheng Zhu, Tianyu Guo, Huanyao Zhang, Jingxuan Wei, Bihui Yu, Fan Yang, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: Training effective AI agents for real-world tool-use interactions requires data that faithfully captures the dynamics of human–agent collaboration. However, such data is scarce, and existing methods often resort to synthetic data generation. The inherently dynamic and complex nature of user–agent interactions makes ensuring data quality particularly challenging. Current verification approaches are typically entangled with the synthesis process itself, resulting in complicated implementations that undermine both reproducibility and scalability. To address this, we introduce Tool-Verifier-7B, a plug-and-play framework for data quality control in tool-use scenarios. Building on this verifier and our data synthesis strategy, we construct the Tool-Verify dataset, which contains 3,295 curated samples. To directly assess verifier performance, we further release Tool-V-Bench, a benchmark of 165 human-validated trajectories spanning diverse interaction complexities. Comprehensive experiments show that Tool-Verifier-7B surpasses Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on Tool-V-Bench. Moreover, the Tool-Verify dataset achieves superior performance compared to the previous APIGen-MT dataset.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了训练出能够有效处理现实世界工具使用交互的AI代理，我们需要能够真实反映人类与代理协作动态的数据。然而，这类数据非常稀缺，现有的方法往往依赖于合成数据的生成。用户与代理交互的固有动态性和复杂性使得确保数据质量变得尤为困难。目前的验证方法通常与数据合成过程紧密关联，这导致了复杂的实现方式，从而影响了实验的可重复性和可扩展性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Tool-Verifier-7B这一即插即用框架，用于工具使用场景中的数据质量控制。基于这个验证器以及我们的数据合成策略，我们构建了Tool-Verify数据集，该数据集包含3,295个经过筛选的样本。为了直接评估验证器的性能，我们还发布了Tool-V-Bench基准测试，该测试包含了165条经过人类验证的轨迹，涵盖了多种交互复杂度。全面的实验表明，Tool-Verifier-7B在Tool-V-Bench上的表现优于Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct。此外，Tool-Verify数据集的性能也优于之前的APIGen-MT数据集。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HyperAdaLoRA: Accelerating LoRA Rank Allocation During Training via Hypernetworks without Sacrificing Performance
papers.title_zh: HyperAdaLoRA：通过超网络技术在训练过程中加速LoRA排名分配，同时不牺牲性能
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Zhenjia Li, Yifan Gao, Xi Xiao, Heng Zhang, Shuyang Zhang, Xiaoxincc, Bo Huang, Yuhang Wu, Tianyang Wang, Hao Xu
papers.abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), especially Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), has emerged as a promising approach to fine-tuning large language models(LLMs) while reducing computational and memory overhead. However, LoRA assumes a uniform rank r for each incremental matrix, not accounting for the varying significance of weight matrices across different modules and layers. AdaLoRA leverages Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to parameterize updates and employs pruning of singular values to introduce dynamic rank allocation, thereby enhancing adaptability. However, during the training process, it often encounters issues of slow convergence speed and high computational overhead. To address this issue, we propose HyperAdaLoRA, a novel framework that accelerates the convergence of AdaLoRA by leveraging a hypernetwork. Instead of directly optimizing the components of Singular Value Decomposition (P, \Lambda, Q), HyperAdaLoRA employs a hypernetwork based on attention mechanisms to dynamically generate these parameters. By pruning the outputs of the hypernetwork that generates the singular values, dynamic rank allocation is achieved. Comprehensive experiments on various datasets and models demonstrate that our method achieves faster convergence without sacrificing performance. Moreover, our method generalizes well to other LoRA-based approaches, highlighting its strong generalization capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT），尤其是低秩适应（LoRA），已成为一种在减少计算和内存开销的同时对大语言模型进行微调的有效方法。然而，LoRA假设每个增量矩阵的秩都是统一的，没有考虑到不同模块和层之间权重矩阵的重要性差异。AdaLoRA利用奇异值分解技术来参数化更新过程，并通过修剪奇异值来实现动态秩分配，从而增强模型的适应性。不过，在训练过程中，它常常面临收敛速度慢和高计算开销的问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了HyperAdaLoRA这一新框架。该框架通过利用超网络来加速AdaLoRA的收敛过程。与直接优化奇异值分解的各个组件不同，HyperAdaLoRA采用基于注意力机制的超网络来动态生成这些参数。通过修剪生成奇异值的超网络的输出结果，可以实现动态秩分配。在多种数据集和模型上的综合实验表明，我们的方法能够在不牺牲性能的情况下实现更快的收敛速度。此外，我们的方法还能很好地推广到其他基于LoRA的方法，充分体现了其强大的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ConSensus: Multi-Agent Collaboration for Multimodal Sensing
papers.title_zh: ConSensus：用于多模态感知的多智能体协作系统
papers.authors: Hyungjun Yoon, Mohammad Malekzadeh, Sung-Ju Lee, Fahim Kawsar, Lorena Qendro
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly grounded in sensor data to perceive and reason about human physiology and the physical world. However, accurately interpreting heterogeneous multimodal sensor data remains a fundamental challenge. We show that a single monolithic LLM often fails to reason coherently across modalities, leading to incomplete interpretations and prior-knowledge bias. We introduce ConSensus, a training-free multi-agent collaboration framework that decomposes multimodal sensing tasks into specialized, modality-aware agents. To aggregate agent-level interpretations, we propose a hybrid fusion mechanism that balances semantic aggregation, which enables cross-modal reasoning and contextual understanding, with statistical consensus, which provides robustness through agreement across modalities. While each approach has complementary failure modes, their combination enables reliable inference under sensor noise and missing data. We evaluate ConSensus on five diverse multimodal sensing benchmarks, demonstrating an average accuracy improvement of 7.1% over the single-agent baseline. Furthermore, ConSensus matches or exceeds the performance of iterative multi-agent debate methods while achieving a 12.7 times reduction in average fusion token cost through a single-round hybrid fusion protocol, yielding a robust and efficient solution for real-world multimodal sensing tasks. The source code is available at https://github.com/nokia/multi-agent-collaboration-for-multimodal-sensing.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在感知和推理人类生理及物理世界方面，越来越多地依赖于传感器数据。然而，准确解读异构的多模态传感器数据仍然是一个基本挑战。我们发现，单个单体语言模型往往无法在不同模态之间进行连贯的推理，从而导致解释不完整以及基于先验知识的偏差。为此，我们提出了ConSensus这一无需训练的多智能体协作框架，该框架将多模态感知任务分解为多个具有特定功能的、能识别不同模态的智能体。为了整合各智能体的解释结果，我们提出了一种混合融合机制：既实现了语义层面的综合，从而支持跨模态推理和上下文理解；又通过统计一致性确保了不同模态之间的协同工作。虽然每种方法都有其自身的局限性，但将它们结合起来可以在传感器噪声和数据缺失的情况下实现可靠的推理。我们在五个不同的多模态感知基准测试中对ConSensus进行了评估，结果显示其平均准确率比单一智能体方案提高了7.1%。此外，ConSensus的性能甚至超过了迭代式多智能体辩论方法。通过采用单轮混合融合协议，其平均融合令牌成本降低了12.7倍，从而为现实世界中的多模态感知任务提供了高效且稳健的解决方案。相关代码可访问https://github.com/nokia/multi-agent-collaboration-for-multimodal-sensing。

papers.title: Beyond High-Entropy Exploration: Correctness-Aware Low-Entropy Segment-Based Advantage Shaping for Reasoning LLMs
papers.title_zh: 超越高熵探索：基于低熵的优势塑造方法——以正确性为导向的推理大型语言模型技术
papers.authors: Xinzhu Chen, Xuesheng Li, Zhongxiang Sun, Weijie Yu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a central approach for improving the reasoning ability of large language models. Recent work studies RLVR through token entropy, arguing that high-entropy tokens drive exploration and should receive stronger updates. However, they overlook the fact that most of a reasoning trajectory consists of low-entropy segments that encode stable and reusable structural patterns. Through qualitative and quantitative analyses, we find that the overlap of low-entropy segments across correct responses strongly correlates with model accuracy, while overlaps involving incorrect responses exhibit stable but unproductive patterns. Motivated by these findings, we propose LESS, a correctness-aware reinforcement framework that performs fine-grained advantage modulation over low-entropy segments. LESS amplifies segments unique to correct responses, suppresses those unique to incorrect ones, and neutralizes segments shared by both, while preserving high-entropy exploration in the underlying RL algorithm. Instantiated on top of GRPO and GSPO, LESS not only improves accuracy over strong RL baselines across three backbones and six math benchmarks, but also achieves stronger robustness of the performance floor.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的关键方法。近期的研究通过令牌熵来探讨RLVR，认为高熵令牌能够推动探索行为，因此应该得到更强的更新。然而，这些研究忽略了这样一个事实：大多数推理过程由低熵片段构成，这些片段编码了稳定且可复用的结构模式。通过定性和定量分析，我们发现正确响应中低熵片段的重叠程度与模型准确率有很强的相关性，而错误响应中的重叠则表现出稳定但无成效的模式。基于这些发现，我们提出了LESS这一注重正确性的强化框架，该框架能够对低熵片段进行细粒度的优势调节。LESS会放大那些仅出现在正确响应中的片段，抑制那些仅出现在错误响应中的片段，同时消除两者共有的片段，同时保留底层强化算法中的高熵探索行为。在GRPO和GSPO之上实现后，LESS不仅提升了在三个基础模型和六个数学基准测试中的准确率，还增强了性能的稳定性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GraphMind: LLMs as Dynamic Knowledge Builders for Sequential Decision-Making
papers.title_zh: GraphMind：作为动态知识构建工具的大型语言模型，适用于序列决策场景
papers.authors: Sunguk Shin, Hayeong Lee, Jun Ho Seo, Jinho Lee, Myunsoo Kim, Minsuk Chang, Byung-Jun Lee
papers.abstract: While the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have advanced considerably, efficiently internalizing and leveraging new information in dynamically interactive environments remains a significant challenge. This limitation is particularly pronounced in partially observable environments, which require agents to manage long-term memory and perform effective exploration under incomplete information. To address this, we propose an LLM agent architecture that integrates a knowledge graph as a graph-based memory module. The agent incrementally constructs the knowledge graph through environmental interactions and retrieves relevant information to generate efficient plans. We evaluate our approach in complex navigation tasks specifically designed to present long-horizon and partially observable challenges. Experimental results demonstrate that incorporating a self-extending memory module significantly enhances the performance and efficiency of the LLM’s planning capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力已经取得了显著进步，但在动态交互环境中有效内化和利用新信息仍然是一个重大挑战。在部分可观测的环境中，这一限制尤为明显，因为智能体需要管理长期记忆，并在信息不完整的情况下进行有效的探索。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种LLM智能体架构，该架构将知识图谱作为基于图的记忆模块来使用。智能体通过与环境的交互逐步构建知识图谱，并检索相关信息以生成高效的规划方案。我们在专门设计用于应对长视界和部分可观测环境的复杂导航任务中评估了我们的方法。实验结果表明，引入自扩展记忆模块显著提升了LLM的规划能力和效率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EET: Experience-Driven Early Termination for Cost-Efficient Software Engineering Agents
papers.title_zh: EET：基于经验的早期终止策略，以实现软件工程代理的高效成本优化
papers.authors: Yaoqi Guo, Ying Xiao, Jie M. Zhang, Mark Harman, Yiling Lou, Yang Liu, Zhenpeng Chen
papers.abstract: Software engineering (SE) agents powered by large language models are increasingly adopted in practice, yet they often incur substantial monetary cost. We introduce EET, an experience-driven early termination approach that reduces the cost of SE agents while preserving task performance. EET extracts structured experience from prior issue-resolution executions and leverages it to guide early termination during patch generation and selection, reducing unproductive iterations. We evaluate EET on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark across three representative SE agents. EET consistently reduces total cost by 19%–55% (32% on average), with negligible loss in resolution rate (at most 0.2%). These efficiency gains are achieved, on average, by identifying early-termination opportunities for 11% of issues and reducing API calls, input tokens, and output tokens by 21%, 30%, and 25%, respectively. We release the code, prompts, and data at https://github.com/IanWalls/EET.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的软件工程代理在实践中被越来越多地采用，但它们往往会导致相当大的成本支出。我们提出了EET这一基于经验的提前终止方法，该方法可以在保持任务性能的同时降低软件工程代理的成本。EET从以往的问题解决过程中提取结构化经验，并利用这些经验来指导补丁生成和选择的提前终止过程，从而减少无意义的迭代次数。我们在SWE-bench验证基准测试中对EET进行了评估，测试了三种代表性的软件工程代理。结果表明，EET平均可以将总成本降低19%至55%（平均为32%），而解决问题效率的下降幅度很小（最多为0.2%）。这些效率提升是通过识别11%问题的提前终止机会以及分别减少21%、30%和25%的API调用次数、输入令牌和输出令牌数量来实现的。我们的代码、提示和数据可以在https://github.com/IanWalls/EET下载。

papers.title: Fundamental Reasoning Paradigms Induce Out-of-Domain Generalization in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基本推理范式促使语言模型实现领域外泛化能力
papers.authors: Mingzi Cao, Xingwei Tan, Mahmud Elahi Akhter, Marco Valentino, Maria Liakata, Xi Wang, Nikolaos Aletras
papers.abstract: Deduction, induction, and abduction are fundamental reasoning paradigms, core for human logical thinking. Although improving Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning has attracted significant research efforts, the extent to which the fundamental paradigms induce generalization has yet to be systematically explored. In this study, we shed light on how the interplay between these core paradigms influences LLMs’ reasoning behavior. To this end, we first collect a new dataset of reasoning trajectories from symbolic tasks, each targeting one of the three fundamental paradigms, to abstract from concrete world knowledge. Then, we investigate effective ways for inducing these skills into LLMs.We experiment with a battery of methods including simple fine-tuning, and more complex approaches to increase model depth, or transform a dense model to a mixture-of-experts. We comprehensively evaluate induced models on realistic out-of-domain tasks, that are entirely formulated in natural language and contain real-world knowledge. Our results reveal that our approach yields strong generalizability with substantial performance gains (up to 14.60) across realistic tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 演绎、归纳和溯因是人类逻辑思维的核心推理范式。尽管在改进大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力方面已经投入了大量研究资源，但这些基本范式在促进泛化能力方面的效果仍有待系统性的探索。在这项研究中，我们探讨了这些核心范式之间的相互作用如何影响LLM的推理行为。为此，我们首先收集了一组新的推理轨迹数据集，这些数据集来自符号任务，每个任务都针对其中一个基本范式，以抽象出具体世界的知识。然后，我们研究了将这些技能引入LLM的有效方法。我们通过一系列方法来实验，包括简单的微调，以及更复杂的方法来提高模型的深度，或者将密集模型转换为专家混合模型。我们在真实领域任务上全面评估了这些经过训练的模型的表现，这些任务完全以自然语言形式表述，并包含现实世界的知识。我们的结果表明，我们的方法能够带来强大的泛化能力，并且在真实任务中的性能有了显著提升（最高可达14.60）。

papers.title: Rethinking Text-to-SQL: Dynamic Multi-turn SQL Interaction for Real-world Database Exploration
papers.title_zh: 重新思考文本转SQL技术：动态多轮次SQL交互在现实数据库探索中的应用
papers.authors: Linzhuang Sun, Tianyu Guo, Hao Liang, Ruitong Liu, Yuying Li, Qifeng Cai, Jingxuan Wei, Yuchen Wu, Bihui Yu, Xiangxiang Zhang, Wentao Zhang, Bin Cui
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized Text-to-SQL parsing, achieving remarkable success in static, single-turn query generation. However, a significant disparity remains between these academic benchmarks and real-world utility. In practical applications, such as financial auditing or business analytics, user intents are rarely static; they evolve dynamically through iterative refinement, necessitating not just information retrieval (SELECT) but continuous state manipulation (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE). To bridge this gap, we introduce DySQL-Bench, a novel benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate LLMs within a dynamic interaction framework. Unlike varying manual curation efforts, DySQL-Bench employs a two-stage automated synthesis pipeline: transforming raw relational schemas into hierarchical logic trees to generate user-database interactions, followed by a rigorous verify-and-refine protocol that ensures 100% distinct correctness via human expert validation. We further propose an interactive evaluation environment simulating a triadic workflow involving an LLM-simulated user, the agent under test, and an executable database system. Spanning 13 diverse domains with 1,072 complex tasks, our experiments reveal that current powerful models struggle in this realistic setting. Notably, GPT-4o achieves only 58.34% overall accuracy and a meager 23.81% on the strict Pass^5 metric, highlighting the substantial challenges DySQL-Bench poses for the future of database agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展彻底改变了文本到SQL的解析技术，在静态、单轮查询生成方面取得了显著成果。然而，这些学术基准与实际应用的实用性之间仍然存在巨大差距。在金融审计或商业分析等实际应用中，用户的意图往往不是固定的，而是通过迭代优化不断变化的。因此，不仅需要信息检索（SELECT），还需要持续的状态操作（INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE）。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了DySQL-Bench这一新型基准测试，旨在在动态交互框架内对LLMs进行严格评估。与繁琐的人工筛选不同，DySQL-Bench采用了两阶段自动化合成流程：首先将原始关系模式转换为层次化的逻辑树结构，以生成用户与数据库之间的交互方式；随后通过严格的验证和优化流程来确保100%的正确性，这一过程由人类专家进行确认。我们还设计了一个交互式评估环境，模拟了由LLM模拟的用户、被测试代理以及可执行的数据库系统构成的三角工作流程。我们的实验涵盖了13个不同的领域，涉及1,072个复杂的任务。结果表明，目前强大的模型在这种现实环境中表现不佳。值得注意的是，GPT-4o在严格的Pass^5指标上的准确率仅为58.34%，而在这一指标上的表现更是只有23.81%。这凸显了DySQL-Bench对于未来数据库代理技术所面临的巨大挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LogitSpec: Accelerating Retrieval-based Speculative Decoding via Next Next Token Speculation
papers.title_zh: LogitSpec：通过“下一个下一个标记”的推测机制，加速基于检索的推测解码过程
papers.authors: Tianyu Liu, Qitan Lv, Hao Li, Xing Gao, Xiao Sun, Xiaoyan Sun
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD), where a small draft model is employed to propose draft tokens in advance and then the target model validates them in parallel, has emerged as a promising technique for LLM inference acceleration. Many endeavors to improve SD are to eliminate the need for a draft model and generate draft tokens in a retrieval-based manner in order to further alleviate the drafting overhead and significantly reduce the difficulty in deployment and applications. However, retrieval-based SD relies on a matching paradigm to retrieve the most relevant reference as the draft tokens, where these methods often fail to find matched and accurate draft tokens. To address this challenge, we propose LogitSpec to effectively expand the retrieval range and find the most relevant reference as drafts. LogitSpec is motivated by the observation that the logit of the last token can not only predict the next token, but also speculate the next next token. Specifically, LogitSpec generates draft tokens in two steps: (1) utilizing the last logit to speculate the next next token; (2) retrieving relevant reference for both the next token and the next next token. LogitSpec is training-free and plug-and-play, which can be easily integrated into existing LLM inference frameworks. Extensive experiments on a wide range of text generation benchmarks demonstrate that LogitSpec can achieve up to 2.61× speedup and 3.28 mean accepted tokens per decoding step.
papers.abstract_zh: 投机式解码（SD）是一种技术，它使用一个小型的草稿模型来预先生成草稿令牌，然后目标模型会并行验证这些草稿令牌。这种技术被证明是加速大语言模型推理的有效方法。许多改进SD的努力旨在消除对草稿模型的需求，并以基于检索的方式生成草稿令牌，从而进一步降低草稿生成的复杂性，并显著简化部署和应用的过程。然而，基于检索的SD依赖于一种匹配机制，以找出与草稿令牌最相关的参考内容，但这些方法往往无法找到准确匹配的草稿令牌。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了LogitSpec技术，它能够有效扩展检索范围，找到作为草稿内容的最相关参考。LogitSpec的原理在于：最后一个令牌的逻辑概率不仅可以预测下一个令牌，还可以推测再下一个令牌。具体来说，LogitSpec通过两个步骤生成草稿令牌：（1）利用最后一个令牌的逻辑概率来推测再下一个令牌；（2）为下一个令牌以及再下一个令牌检索相关的参考内容。LogitSpec无需进行训练即可直接投入使用，可以轻松集成到现有的大语言模型推理框架中。在一系列文本生成基准测试中的广泛实验表明，LogitSpec能够实现高达2.61倍的加速效果，并且每个解码步骤平均可生成3.28个被接受的令牌。

papers.title: Answering Cross-Dimensional Geometric Visual Questions by Multi-constraint Spatial Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 通过多约束空间推理来解决多维几何视觉问题
papers.authors: Dongling Li, Qi Chen, Jianxing Yu, Hanjiang Lai, Yanghui Rao, Wenqing Chen, Jian Yin
papers.abstract: This paper focuses on the task of answering complex visual questions that involve cross-dimensional (like 2D to 3D) spatial reasoning. This task (called SpatialQA) can enhance the machine’s spatial cognitive abilities in “plane representation - space reconstruction - semantic inference,” having great application value. Existing methods often only recognize 1-D visual objects and relations, but they lack the ability to represent in a cross-dimensional space and fail to grasp structured geometric knowledge such as face-face topology and texture details. That would cause problems such as texture misalignment and topological confusion, leading to error accumulation and incorrect answers. To address this problem, we propose a new method with good cross-dimensional reasoning capabilities. In detail, we first analyze the input image, capturing its relations in the 2D plane. To derive the topological relations in the 3D space, we employ a dual-channel augmentation technique to retrieve topological isomorphic examples and geometric rules, supplementing the missing but crucial reasoning clues. We then design a multi-perspective verifier to find the inconsistencies of the macroscopic outlines, eliminating incorrect options. Based on visual clues, we develop a question-guided detector to analyze the texture details and relations of each surface finely, capturing inconsistencies in a micro level. That can correct the reasoning bias to derive the right answer. Moreover, we create a large-scale dataset with 22,483 samples to conduct evaluations. The results show the effectiveness of our method.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于解决涉及跨维度（如从二维到三维）空间推理的复杂视觉问题。这项任务被称为SpatialQA，能够提升机器在“平面表示-空间重建-语义推断”方面的空间认知能力，具有很大的应用价值。现有的方法通常只能识别一维视觉对象及其关系，但它们缺乏在跨维度空间中进行表示的能力，也无法掌握诸如面面对拓扑结构以及纹理细节等几何知识。这会导致纹理错位和拓扑混乱等问题，进而引发错误累积和错误的答案。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种具有良好跨维度推理能力的新型方法。具体来说，我们首先分析输入图像，捕捉其在二维平面中的关系。为了推导出三维空间中的拓扑关系，我们采用双通道增强技术来检索拓扑同构示例和几何规则，从而补充那些缺失但至关重要的推理线索。接着，我们设计了一个多视角验证器来发现宏观轮廓的不一致之处，从而排除错误的选项。基于视觉线索，我们开发了一种问题引导检测器，以精细分析每个表面的纹理细节和关系，在微观层面上捕捉出不一致之处。这可以帮助纠正推理偏差，从而得到正确的答案。此外，我们还创建了一个包含22,483个样本的大规模数据集来进行评估。结果表明我们的方法具有有效性。

papers.title: SudokuFill: A Multi-Agent Progressive Filling Framework for Document-Level Scientific Information Extraction
papers.title_zh: 数独填充：一种基于多智能体的渐进式填充框架，用于提取文档级别的科学信息
papers.authors: Yang Li, Yajiao Wang, Yu Zhang, Yuanzhe Zhang, Maodi Hu, Mengting Zhang, Xi Sun, Hua Yue, Zhixiong Zhang
papers.abstract: Scientific information extraction (SciIE) is a key bottleneck for turning unstructured papers into computable knowledge bases, yet most existing systems still follow a “local extraction then global assembly” paradigm. This workflow is inherently lossy: by extracting fields in isolation, it breaks global correlations and discards high-confidence signals that could otherwise be reused as internal supervision, forcing systems to repeatedly restart from scratch, especially in long, multimodal scientific documents. In this paper, We propose a different view: SciIE should be solved as a progressive filling problem, similar to solving a Sudoku,once a field is filled with high confidence, it should act as a constraint that guides the remaining uncertain fields. Based on this idea, we introduce SudokuFill, a multi-agent framework that maintains a Global Filling State and performs priority scheduling to establish reliable anchors first, then reuses them as internal supervision for iterative deliberation over harder fields. Evaluated on a specialized document-level adjuvant dataset, our framework achieves a SOTA score of 51.83% on our benchmark. Crucially, SudokuFill enables a 7B model to outperform the vanilla GPT-4o, proving that structured architectural reasoning can effectively compensate for parameter scale.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学信息提取（SciIE）是将非结构化论文转化为可计算知识库的关键环节，但目前大多数系统仍然采用“局部提取后再进行全局组装”的范式。这种工作流程本质上存在信息丢失的问题：通过单独提取字段，会破坏全局相关性，并丢弃那些可以被重新用作内部监督的高置信度信号，导致系统不得不反复从零开始处理，尤其是在长篇幅、多模态的科学文档中。在本文中，我们提出了一种不同的观点：SciIE应该被看作是一个逐步填充的过程，类似于解决数独游戏。一旦某个字段被高置信度填充，它就应该作为一个约束条件来指导剩余不确定字段的填充。基于这一理念，我们引入了SudokuFill这个多智能体框架，该框架能够维护一个全局填充状态，并实行优先级调度，先建立可靠的锚点，然后再将其作为内部监督用于迭代处理更难的字段。在专门的文档级辅助数据集上进行了评估，我们的框架在基准测试中的表现达到了51.83%的顶尖水平。重要的是，SudokuFill使得一个拥有70亿参数的模型能够超越普通的GPT-4o模型，这表明结构化的架构推理可以有效地弥补参数规模的限制。

papers.title: Emergent Relational Order in LLM Agent Societies: From Collective Affect to Authority Stratification
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型智能体社会中的新兴关系秩序：从集体情感到权威分层
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Ji, Xinyu Chen, Ziqi Dai, Shiyun Tang, Chunyu Wei, Yueguo Chen
papers.abstract: Fei Xiaotong’s Differential Order Pattern characterizes rural society as egocentric and relationally graded, with cooperation attenuating over social distance. Although often treated as culturally specific, its mechanistic basis remains under-operationalized, and prior LLM-based simulations have mainly addressed short-term coordination rather than long-horizon social structure. We propose CAREB-MAS, a multi-agent framework grounded in Affect Control Theory, Social Identity Theory, and Durkheimian collective affect. Agents reason through an emotion–ethics–belief chain and maintain dynamically evolving egocentric identities, while the macro environment specifies only individual production, preference-based allocation, and minimal interaction protocols. Across long-horizon simulations, agents spontaneously reproduce five core Differential Order phenomena: stable labor specialization, guanxi-based economic ethics, relational decay of cooperation, emergent relational authority, and clan-based center–periphery stratification. These patterns shift with production structure from kin-centered integration toward greater functional interdependence. Extensive experiment results support interpreting Differential Order as a structure-sensitive emergent outcome of general social mechanisms, with LLM-based multi-agent simulation providing a interdisciplinary framework for studying social structure and change.
papers.abstract_zh: 费小彤提出的差异序模式将农村社会描述为以自我为中心且关系等级化的社会结构，随着社会距离的增加，合作程度会逐渐减弱。尽管这一模式通常被视为具有文化特异性，但其机制基础仍未被充分挖掘。以往基于大语言模型的模拟主要关注的是短期协调问题，而未能深入探讨长期的社会结构变化。我们提出了CAREB-MAS框架，该框架基于情感控制理论、社会认同理论以及涂尔干式的集体情感理论。各智能体通过情绪-伦理-信念链进行推理，并维持动态变化的自我中心身份；而宏观环境则仅规定个体生产活动、基于偏好的资源分配以及最基本的互动规则。在长期的模拟中，智能体能够自发地再现五种核心的差异序现象：稳定的劳动专业化、基于关系的经济伦理、合作的衰减、新兴的关系性权威，以及以氏族为基础的中央-边缘分层结构。这些模式会随着生产结构的转变而发生变化，从以亲属为中心的整合方式转变为更加功能性的相互依赖关系。大量的实验结果表明，差异序可以被视为一般社会机制的敏感结果。基于大语言模型的多智能体模拟为研究社会结构与变化提供了跨学科的框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VCB Bench: An Evaluation Benchmark for Audio-Grounded Large Language Model Conversational Agents
papers.title_zh: VCB工作台：一种用于评估基于音频的大型语言模型对话式智能体的基准平台
papers.authors: Jiliang Hu, Wenfu Wang, Zuchao Li, Chenxing Li, Yiyang Zhao, Hanzhao Li, Liqiang Zhang, Meng Yu, Dong Yu
papers.abstract: While large audio language models (LALMs) have driven significant progress in multimodal conversational systems, current benchmarks suffer from critical limitations: they are largely English-centric, use synthetic speech, and fail to provide comprehensive, discriminative evaluation across key dimensions. To fill this gap, we present Voice Chat Bot Bench (VCB Bench), a novel, high-quality Chinese benchmark built exclusively on real human speech. VCB Bench assesses LALMs across three complementary axes: instruction following (including speech-level control beyond text commands), knowledge understanding (including general knowledge, reasoning, and daily dialogue), and robustness (evaluating stability under variations in content, environment, and speaker characteristics). Experiments conducted on representative LALMs reveal notable performance disparities and offer tangible insights for future improvements. VCB Bench serves as a reproducible and fine-grained framework, providing standardized evaluation and practical guidance for the development of Chinese voice conversational models.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大型音频语言模型在多模态对话系统中取得了显著进展，但当前的评估基准存在严重缺陷：这些基准主要基于英语数据，使用合成语音，且无法在多个关键维度上提供全面、准确的评估。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Voice Chat Bot Bench（VCB Bench）这一全新的高质量中文评估框架。该框架完全基于真实的人类语音数据来评估语言模型的表现。VCB Bench从三个互补的维度对语言模型进行评估：指令遵循能力（包括超出文本命令的语音级控制）、知识理解能力（包括常识、推理能力和日常对话能力），以及鲁棒性（评估模型在不同内容、环境和说话者特征下的稳定性）。对代表性语言模型进行的实验表明，不同模型之间存在显著的性能差异，这些结果为未来的改进提供了宝贵的参考依据。VCB Bench作为一个可复现且细粒度的评估框架，为中文语音对话模型的开发提供了标准化的评估方法和实用指导。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLM-FK: Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning for Foreign Key Detection in Large-Scale Complex Databases
papers.title_zh: LLM-FK：用于大规模复杂数据库中外键检测的多智能体大语言模型推理方法
papers.authors: Zijian Tang, Ying Zhang, Sibo Cai, Ruoxuan Wang
papers.abstract: Detecting missing foreign keys (FKs) requires accurately modeling semantic dependencies across database schemas, which conventional heuristic-based methods are fundamentally limited in capturing. We propose LLM-FK, the first fully automated multi-agent framework for FK detection, designed to address three core challenges that hinder naive LLM-based solutions in large-scale complex databases: combinatorial search space explosion, ambiguous inference under limited context, and global inconsistency arising from isolated local predictions. LLM-FK coordinates four specialized agents: a Profiler that decomposes the FK detection problem into the task of validating FK candidate column pairs and prunes the search space via a unique-key-driven schema decomposition strategy; an Interpreter that injects self-augmented domain knowledge; a Refiner that constructs compact structural representations and performs multi-perspective chain-of-thought reasoning; and a Verifier that enforces schema-wide consistency through a holistic conflict resolution strategy. Experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that LLM-FK consistently achieves F1-scores above 93%, surpassing existing baselines by 15% on the large-scale MusicBrainz database, while reducing the candidate search space by two to three orders of magnitude without losing true FKs and maintaining robustness under challenging conditions like missing data. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of LLM-FK in real-world databases.
papers.abstract_zh: 检测缺失的外键需要准确建模数据库模式之间的语义依赖关系，而传统的基于启发式的算法在捕捉这种关系时存在根本性的局限性。我们提出了LLM-FK，这是一种完全自动化的多智能体框架，专门用于检测外键。该框架旨在解决三个核心问题：在大规模复杂数据库中，基于大语言模型的直接解决方案面临的组合搜索空间爆炸问题、在有限上下文下产生的模糊推理问题，以及由于局部预测导致的全局不一致性问题。LLM-FK整合了四个专业模块：一个分析器，它将外键检测问题分解为验证候选列对的任务，并通过唯一键驱动的模式分解策略来缩小搜索空间；一个解释器，它注入自增强的领域知识；一个精炼器，它构建紧凑的结构化表示并执行多视角思维链推理；以及一个验证器，它通过整体冲突解决策略来确保整个模式的一致性。在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，LLM-FK 的 F1 分数始终超过 93%，在大规模的音乐数据库上比现有基线方案高出15%，同时在不丢失真实外键的情况下，将候选搜索空间减少了两到三个数量级，并且在处理缺失数据等挑战性情况下仍能保持鲁棒性。这些结果证明了LLM-FK在实际数据库中的有效性和可扩展性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When Meaning Travels: A Granular Lens on Hybrid-MoE’s Role in Idiomatic Understanding for Language Models
papers.title_zh: 当意义发生变化时：一种用于分析混合模型在语言模型 Idiom 理解中作用的细粒度方法
papers.authors: Sarmistha Das, Vaibhav Vishal, Shreyas Guha, Amaan Ali, Kitsuchart Pasupa, Sriparna Saha
papers.abstract: In the contemporary epoch of multilingual education, learning idioms provides a fascinating gateway towards creativity, cultural values, historical context, and diverse perspectives inherent to various linguistic traditions. This paper showcases the navigation of retaining figurative and cultural semantics in low-resource Southeast Asian languages such as Hindi, Bengali, and Thai, where culturally rich idioms pose significant obstacles for computational modelling and cross-linguistic transfer due to their deep metaphorical complexity. To tackle such complexity, we present Varnika (वर्णिका) , a reconstructed multimodal idiom corpus comprising 3,533 multilingual idioms, enriched with seven idiomatic tones aligned with both textual and visual representations. Additionally, to infer informative idiomatic understanding, we introduce a Hybrid Mixture-of-Experts (HybridMoE) framework that embeds multiple idiomatic expert opinions while mitigating expert sparsity by integrating outputs from both selected and unselected experts through controlled hybridisation, further augmented with Idiomatic Property Signals via masked multimodal embeddings. To analyse the performance across multiple dimensions, we propose the IDIO-TONE and Idiomatic Validation Score, a three-stage evaluation pipeline measuring (i) literal translation fidelity, (ii) visual- semantic alignment, and (iii) idiomatic meaning retention. Empirical evaluations highlight that HybridMoE achieves 5–6% performance gains across advanced vision language models, demonstrating improved representation of figurative language and culturally embedded meaning in multilingual multimodal settings. Resources are available at (https://github.com/sarmistha-D/Hybrid_MOE).
papers.abstract_zh: 在当代多语言教育时代，学习习语为培养创造力、理解文化价值、把握历史背景以及接纳不同语言传统中的多元视角提供了绝佳途径。本文探讨了如何在资源有限的东南亚语言如印地语、孟加拉语和泰语中保留隐喻性和文化语义。在这些语言中，丰富的习语由于其复杂的隐喻结构，给计算建模和跨语言迁移带来了巨大挑战。为了应对这种复杂性，我们提出了Varnika（वर्णिका）这一多模态习语语料库，该语料库包含3,533条多语言习语，并配备了与文本和视觉表现相一致的七种习语音调。此外，为了推断习语的深层含义，我们引入了混合专家模型框架（HybridMoE），该框架结合了多个专家的意见，同时通过控制性混合技术整合了来自选定和未选定专家的输出，并通过掩蔽式多模态嵌入来进一步增强对习语特性的识别能力。为了全面评估该框架的性能，我们提出了IDIO-TONE和习语验证评分体系，这是一个三阶段评估流程，分别衡量（i）字面翻译的忠实度，（ii）视觉与语义的一致性，以及（iii）习语意义的保留程度。实证结果表明，混合专家模型在高级视觉语言模型中实现了5-6%的性能提升，显示出其在多语言多模态环境中对隐喻性语言和文化内涵的更好表达能力。相关资源可访问于https://github.com/sarmistha-D/Hybrid_MOE。

papers.title: IntentCoding: Amplifying User Intent in Code Generation
papers.title_zh: 意图编码：在代码生成过程中体现用户意图
papers.authors: Zheng Fang, Yihong Dong, Lili Mou, Dongming Jin, Zhi Jin, Ge Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in code generation, but their adherence to fine-grained user intent with multiple constraints remains a significant challenge. Our empirical analysis reveals two key observations: 1) Model performance deteriorates quickly as the number of constraints in the user intent increases, and 2) While user intent does influence the model’s logits, such an influence may not be strong enough to effectively steer the decoding process. To this end, we propose Intent-Amplified Code Generation (IntentCoding), a novel decoding strategy that enhances an LLM’s ability to follow user intent. IntentCoding captures the influence of user intent by masking out the intent, and applies a multi-strength ensemble mechanism to amplify the effect of user intent during generation. IntentCoding is model-agnostic, requires no additional training, and integrates seamlessly with existing decoding procedures. To enable systematic evaluation, we also construct CodeConstraints, a benchmark dataset specifically designed to test user intent compliance under varying numbers of constraints. Experiments on our constructed Constraints, as well as popular IFEvalCode, HumanEval and LiveCodeBench datasets, show that our IntentCoding model significantly improves both constraint satisfaction and functional correctness compared to standard decoding approaches. IntentCoding achieves up to 71.0% relative improvement on CodeConstraints, achieves up to 67.3% relative improvement on IFEvalCode and achieves up to 29.3% relative improvement in pass@1 on HumanEval and LiveCodeBench compared with greedy decoding.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成方面表现出强大的能力，但其在满足用户细粒度意图方面的表现仍然面临重大挑战。我们的实证分析揭示了两个关键现象：1）随着用户意图中的约束数量增加，模型的性能会迅速下降；2）虽然用户意图确实会影响模型的输出结果，但这种影响可能不足以有效指导解码过程。为此，我们提出了“意图增强式代码生成”这一新颖的解码策略。该策略通过屏蔽用户意图的影响，并结合多强度集成机制来放大用户意图在生成过程中的作用。这种策略与模型无关，无需额外训练，并且能够与现有的解码方法无缝结合。为了进行系统性的评估，我们还构建了一个名为“CodeConstraints”的基准数据集，专门用于测试在不同约束条件下的用户意图满足程度。在我们构建的约束数据集以及流行的IFEvalCode、HumanEval和LiveCodeBench数据集上的实验表明，与标准解码方法相比，我们的意图增强式代码生成模型在约束满足度和功能正确性方面都有显著提升。在CodeConstraints数据集上，我们的模型实现了高达71.0%的相对改进；在IFEvalCode数据集上，实现了高达67.3%的相对改进；而在HumanEval和LiveCodeBench数据集上，与贪婪解码方法相比，我们的模型在准确率方面实现了高达29.3%的相对提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
