papers.title: UbuntuGuard: A Culturally-Grounded Policy Benchmark for Equitable AI Safety in African Languages.
papers.title_zh: UbuntuGuard：一项基于文化因素的AI安全政策指南，旨在用非洲语言来表述公平的人工智能安全理念
papers.authors: Tassallah Abdullahi, Macton Mgonzo, Mardiyyah Oduwole, Paul Okewunmi, Abraham Toluwase Owodunni, Ritambhara Singh, Carsten Eickhoff
papers.abstract: Current guardian models are predominantly Western-centric and optimized for high-resource languages, leaving low-resource African languages vulnerable to evolving harms, cross-lingual failures, and cultural misalignment. Moreover, most guardian models rely on rigid, predefined safety categories that fail to generalize across diverse linguistic and sociocultural contexts. Achieving robust safety requires flexible, runtime-enforceable policies and benchmarks that reflect local norms, harm scenarios, and cultural expectations. We introduce UbuntuGuard, the first policy-based safety benchmark for African languages built from adversarial queries authored by 155 domain experts across sensitive fields, including healthcare. From these expert-crafted queries, we derive context-specific safety policies and reference responses that capture culturally grounded risk signals, enabling policy-aligned evaluation of guardian models. We evaluate 15 models, comprising seven general-purpose LLMs and eight guardian models across three distinct variants: static, dynamic, and multilingual. Our findings reveal that existing English-centric benchmarks overestimate real-world multilingual safety, cross-lingual transfer provides partial but insufficient coverage, and dynamic models, while better equipped to leverage policies at inference time, still struggle to fully localize African-language contexts. These findings highlight the urgent need for multilingual, culturally grounded safety benchmarks to enable the development of reliable and equitable guardian models for low-resource languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的守护模型主要以西方语言为中心，并针对资源丰富的语言进行了优化，这使得资源匮乏的非洲语言容易受到各种危害的影响，同时也会面临跨语言兼容性问题以及文化上的不匹配问题。此外，大多数守护模型依赖于固定、预先定义的安全类别，这些类别无法适应不同的语言和社会文化背景。要实现可靠的安全性，就需要采用灵活且可在运行时强制执行的政策和基准，这些政策和基准应反映当地规范、危害场景以及文化期望。我们推出了UbuntuGuard，这是首个基于政策的非洲语言安全基准测试工具。该工具基于155位来自敏感领域（包括医疗保健领域）的专家编写的对抗性查询构建而成。通过这些专家精心设计的查询，我们能够推导出具有特定上下文的安全政策和参考响应，从而捕捉到基于文化的风险信号，进而实现对守护模型的符合政策要求的评估。我们对15个模型进行了评估，其中包括7个通用大语言模型和8个守护模型，这些模型分为三种不同的类型：静态模型、动态模型和多语言模型。我们的研究发现表明，现有的以英语为中心的基准测试高估了现实世界中的多语言安全性；跨语言迁移虽然提供了部分覆盖，但还不够全面；而动态模型虽然在推理过程中能够更好地利用政策，但仍然难以完全本地化非洲语言的上下文。这些发现凸显了开发多语言、基于文化的安全基准测试的紧迫性，这样才能为资源匮乏的语言开发出可靠且公平的守护模型。

papers.title: microCLIP: Unsupervised CLIP Adaptation via Coarse-Fine Token Fusion for Fine-Grained Image Classification
papers.title_zh: microCLIP：通过粗细词元融合实现无监督的CLIP适配，以用于细致的图像分类任务
papers.authors: Sathira Silva, Eman Ali, Chetan Arora, Muhammad Haris Khan
papers.abstract: Unsupervised adaptation of CLIP-based vision-language models (VLMs) for fine-grained image classification is challenging because pseudo-labels must be inferred from tiny local cues. CLIP’s contrastive pretraining yields strong zero-shot transfer, but its coarse-grained [CLS] visual token often misses fine spatial details. Existing UA methods mainly enrich text prompts with large language model (LLM) descriptions while still relying on [CLS], which limits spatial precision. We propose microCLIP, a label-free self-training framework that jointly adapts visual features and LLM-derived text prototypes using fine-grained cues. First, a Saliency-Oriented Attention Pooling (SOAP) mechanism inside a lightweight TokenFusion module constructs a saliency-guided [FG] token from patch features and fuses it with the global [CLS] representation for coarse–fine alignment. Second, a two-headed LLM-derived classifier combines a frozen text head, used with multi-view CLIP features as a stable prior for pseudo-labels, with a learnable head initialized from the same LLM-derived descriptions. Finally, Dynamic Knowledge Aggregation convexly combines fixed CLIP/LLM priors with TokenFusion logits during self-training. Across 13 diverse classification benchmarks including fine-grained ones, microCLIP yields a mean improvement of +2.90% points over the strongest prior UA baseline while fine-tuning only layer norms and a tiny head. Our code is available at https://github.com/sathiiii/microCLIP.
papers.abstract_zh: 对基于CLIP的视觉-语言模型进行无监督适应以完成细粒度图像分类是一项挑战性任务，因为需要从微小的局部线索中推断出伪标签。CLIP的对比度预训练能够实现强大的零样本迁移能力，但其粗粒度的[CLS]视觉标记往往无法捕捉到精细的空间细节。现有的无监督方法主要通过使用大语言模型描述来丰富文本提示，同时仍然依赖[CLS]，这限制了空间精度的提升。我们提出了microCLIP这一无需标签的自训练框架，该框架能够结合细粒度线索来自适应调整视觉特征和由语言模型生成的文本原型。首先，在轻量级TokenFusion模块内部引入了一种基于显著性导向的注意力池化机制，从片段特征中构建出受显著性引导的[FG]标记，并将其与全局[CLS]表示融合，以实现粗细层次间的对齐。其次，一个双头化的语言模型衍生分类器将固定文本头部与多视图CLIP特征相结合，作为伪标签的稳定先验；同时，还有一个可学习的头部，其初始化参数来自相同的语言模型衍生描述。最后，动态知识聚合机制在自训练过程中将固定的CLIP/语言模型先验与TokenFusion的日志项进行凸组合。在包括多种细粒度分类基准测试在内的13个不同分类任务中，microCLIP在仅调整层规范和少量头部参数的情况下，取得了比最强无监督基线模型高出+2.90%的性能提升。我们的代码可在https://github.com/sathiiii/microCLIP获取。

papers.title: Prompting Across Time: Evaluating LLMs on Historical and Contemporary Offensive Language
papers.title_zh: 跨越时间的提示：在历史和当代的攻击性语言方面评估大型语言模型的能力
papers.authors: Sanne Hoeken, Sophie Jasmin Spliethoff, Silke Schwandt, Özge Alacam, Sina Zarrieß
papers.abstract: Research on hate speech detection (HSD) has centered on modern data, even though offensive language has a much longer history. This paper presents the first systematic evaluation of instruction-tuned LLMs on Early Modern English invectives, compared with a modern hate-speech benchmark. Our work applies a modular prompt design to measure the contribution of definitional richness, contextual grounding, decision rules and few-shot examples. The results indicate that clearer annotation boundaries in the curated historical corpus lead to higher classification performance compared to the modern benchmark, despite the disadvantage of linguistic unfamiliarity. Prompt brittleness, however, persists across both domains. Classification-oriented components (rules, examples) drive the strongest effects, while definitional or contextual additions matter less. Fine-tuned encoder models still outperform LLMs, but some prompt configurations can narrow the gap. Overall, our study provides practical guidance for prompt design in both digital humanities and HSD and new opportunities for tracing the historical development of hate speech.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于仇恨言论检测的研究一直集中在现代数据上，尽管冒犯性语言的历史要悠久得多。本文首次对基于指令训练的大语言模型在近代英语仇恨言论上的表现进行了系统评估，并与现代仇恨言论基准测试进行了比较。我们的研究采用了模块化提示设计来衡量定义丰富性、上下文信息、决策规则以及少量样本示例对性能的影响。结果表明，在精心挑选的历史语料库中，更清晰的注释边界能够提升分类性能，尽管这会带来语言不熟悉带来的劣势。不过，提示的脆弱性问题在两种领域中都存在。以分类为导向的组件（如规则、示例）能带来最大的效果，而定义或上下文相关的补充则作用较小。经过微调的编码器模型仍然优于大语言模型，但某些提示配置可以缩小这种差距。总体而言，我们的研究为数字人文学科和仇恨言论检测领域的提示设计提供了实用指导，并为追溯仇恨言论的历史发展带来了新的机会。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LDEDE: LRP-Driven Efficient Detection and Editing Framework for LLM Privacy Neurons
papers.title_zh: LDEDE：基于LRP的高效检测与编辑框架，专为LLM隐私神经元设计
papers.authors: Zhao Zhengyuan, Cao Lifeng, Sunhaodong, Shi Haotian, Du Xuehui, Liu Aodi, Niu Lanjie, Yang Xiaocheng
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has significantly propelled downstream innovation, yet pervasive sensitive information in training data and the models’ memory characteristics pose severe privacy leakage risks. This contravenes core requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the right to be forgotten, becoming a critical bottleneck for secure and compliant deployment. Existing privacy protection methods have notable limitations: data preprocessing fails to cover context-dependent sensitive information; differential privacy (DP) and homomorphic encryption (HE) degrade model performance and increase computational overhead; traditional machine unlearning may cause catastrophic collapse; and neuron editing methods struggle with the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in privacy neuron localization, alongside privacy seesaw phenomena and general performance degradation. To address these challenges, this paper proposes LDEDE, a Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP)-driven framework for efficient privacy neuron detection and editing. It offers three core advantages: 1) Precise multi-scale privacy localization via LRP-based relevance backpropagation and multi-token attention aggregation, achieving over 80% higher efficiency than gradient attribution methods; 2) First reveals the existence of “coupled privacy neurons” in LLMs, which are the key cause of the privacy seesaw phenomenon—mitigated by Polarity-Aware Neuron Editing (PANE) with differentiated logic; 3) Enhanced robustness and generalization for batch processing via privacy neuron aggregation. Experiments on Enron and MIMIC datasets demonstrate that compared to baselines, LDEDE maintains comparable general performance while reducing leakage risks of Phone, Email, and medical privacy by 42.7%–73.5% on average and cutting computational time by 60%–90%. It also exhibits stable performance across GPT-2, BERT-base, and LLAMA-7B, providing an efficient, lightweight solution for post-deployment dynamic LLM privacy protection.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展极大地推动了下游创新的发展。然而，训练数据中的敏感信息以及模型的内存特性带来了严重的隐私泄露风险。这违反了通用数据保护条例（GDPR）的核心要求以及“被遗忘权”的规定，成为实现安全且合规部署的关键瓶颈。现有的隐私保护方法存在显著局限性：数据预处理无法覆盖依赖上下文的敏感信息；差分隐私（DP）和同态加密（HE）会降低模型性能并增加计算开销；传统的机器反学习可能会导致灾难性的崩溃；而神经元编辑方法在隐私神经元定位方面面临着准确性与效率之间的权衡问题，同时还受到隐私跷跷板现象的影响，导致整体性能下降。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了LDEDE框架，这是一种基于层级相关性传播的高效隐私神经元检测与编辑方法。该框架具有三大优势：1）通过基于LRP的相关性反向传播和多标记注意力聚合技术，实现了多尺度隐私定位，其效率比梯度归因方法高出80%以上；2）首次揭示了LLM中“耦合隐私神经元”的存在，这些神经元是隐私跷跷板现象的主要原因——通过带有差异化的逻辑处理的极性感知神经元编辑技术来加以缓解；3）通过隐私神经元聚合技术，提升了批量处理的鲁棒性和泛化能力。在Enron和MIMIC数据集上的实验表明，与基线方法相比，LDEDE在保持相当好的整体性能的同时，将电话、电子邮件和医疗隐私的泄露风险平均降低了42.7%至73.5%，并且将计算时间减少了60%至90%。此外，该框架在GPT-2、BERT-base和LLAMA-7B等模型中也表现出稳定的性能，为部署后的动态LLM隐私保护提供了高效且轻量级的解决方案。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Chimera: Compositional Jailbreak Attacks on LLMs via Judgment-Driven Search over Heterogeneous Strategies
papers.title_zh: 奇美拉：通过针对不同策略的判决驱动搜索方式，对大型语言模型实施的组合式突破攻击
papers.authors: Leo Hyun Park, Juwon Cho, Gyuhwan Kim, YoonDong Yeo, Taekyoung Kwon
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks despite extensive safety alignment. While automated red-teaming has emerged as a critical evaluation protocol, existing methods face two primary limitations: they largely explore homogeneous transformations in isolation, and they rely on brittle judgment metrics that frequently misclassify non-refusal hallucinations as successful attacks. In this paper, we reformulate jailbreak attacks as a compositional search problem guided by context-aware evaluation. We propose Chimera, a framework that generates compositional jailbreak attacks via judgment-driven search over heterogeneous strategies. Chimera systematically explores the combinatorial space of disjoint primitives, such as integrating technical obfuscation with semantic persuasion, under strict ordering constraints. Crucially, to drive the search process effectively, we introduce StrongREJECT++, a relevance-aware metric that eliminates false positive rewards by penalizing irrelevant responses. Experiments on multiple open-source and commercial LLMs show that Chimera uncovers qualitatively different vulnerability regions and consistently improves attack success rates and transferability compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在安全性对齐方面取得了显著进展，但它们仍然容易受到越狱攻击的破坏。虽然自动红队测试已成为一种重要的评估方法，但现有方法存在两个主要局限性：它们主要局限于对同质化变换的探索，且依赖的评判指标往往会导致非拒绝幻觉被误判为成功攻击。在本文中，我们将越狱攻击重新定义为一个由上下文感知评估引导的组合搜索问题。我们提出了Chimera框架，该框架通过针对异构策略的评判驱动搜索来生成组合式越狱攻击。Chimera系统地探索了各种不相交的原语组合，例如将技术混淆与语义说服相结合，同时严格遵循排序约束。为了有效推动搜索过程，我们引入了StrongREJECT++这一相关性评估指标，该指标通过惩罚无关响应来消除误报奖励。在多个开源和商业LLM上的实验表明，Chimera能够发现截然不同的脆弱区域，并且与最先进的基线方法相比，其攻击成功率和可迁移性均有显著提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Bias Dynamics in BabyLMs: Towards a Compute-Efficient Sandbox for Democratising Pre-Training Debiasing
papers.title_zh: BabyLMs中的偏见动态：构建一种计算效率高的沙箱环境，以实现预训练去偏见技术的普及
papers.authors: Filip Trhlík, Andrew Caines, Paula Buttery
papers.abstract: Pre-trained language models (LMs) have, over the last few years, grown substantially in both societal adoption and training costs. This rapid growth in size has constrained progress in understanding and mitigating their biases. Since re-training LMs is prohibitively expensive, most debiasing work has focused on post-hoc or masking-based strategies, which often fail to address the underlying causes of bias. In this work, we seek to democratise pre-model debiasing research by using low-cost proxy models. Specifically, we investigate BabyLMs, compact BERT-like models trained on small and mutable corpora that can approximate bias acquisition and learning dynamics of larger models. We show that BabyLMs display closely aligned patterns of intrinsic bias formation and performance development compared to standard BERT models, despite their drastically reduced size. Furthermore, correlations between BabyLMs and BERT hold across multiple intra-model and post-model debiasing methods. Leveraging these similarities, we conduct pre-model debiasing experiments with BabyLMs, replicating prior findings and presenting new insights regarding the influence of gender imbalance and toxicity on bias formation. Our results demonstrate that BabyLMs can serve as an effective sandbox for large-scale LMs, reducing pre-training costs from over 500 GPU-hours to under 30 GPU-hours. This provides a way to democratise pre-model debiasing research and enables faster, more accessible exploration of methods for building fairer LMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在过去的几年里，预训练语言模型在社会上的应用范围以及训练成本都得到了显著增长。这种规模的快速增长限制了我们对这些模型偏见的理解和消除方法的进展。由于重新训练预训练语言模型的成本非常高昂，大多数去偏见工作都集中在事后处理或掩蔽策略上，而这些方法往往无法从根本上解决偏见问题。在这项研究中，我们试图通过使用低成本的替代模型来推动预模型去偏见研究的发展。具体来说，我们研究了BabyLMs——这类基于小型且可修改的语料库训练的紧凑型BERT类似模型。我们发现，尽管BabyLMs的规模大幅缩小，但它们在内在偏见的形成和性能发展方面与标准BERT模型具有非常相似的模式。此外，BabyLMs与BERT之间的相关性在多种模型内部处理和模型处理后的去偏见方法中都得到了验证。利用这些相似性，我们进行了使用BabyLMs进行的预模型去偏见实验，验证了之前的发现，并提出了关于性别失衡和毒性对偏见形成影响的新见解。我们的结果表明，BabyLMs可以作为大规模预训练语言模型的有效测试平台，将预训练成本从超过500个GPU小时降低到不到30个GPU小时。这提供了一种使预模型去偏见研究更加普及的方法，从而能够更快、更方便地探索构建更公平的语言模型的方法。

papers.title: PuzzleClone: A DSL-Powered Framework for Synthesizing Verifiable Data
papers.title_zh: PuzzleClone：一个基于DSL的框架，用于生成可验证的数据
papers.authors: Kai Xiong, Yanwei Huang, Rongjunchen Zhang, Kun Chen, Haipang WU, Yingcai Wu
papers.abstract: High-quality mathematical and logical datasets with verifiable answers are essential for strengthening the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). While recent data augmentation techniques have facilitated the creation of large-scale benchmarks, existing LLM-generated datasets often suffer from limited reliability, diversity, and scalability. To address these challenges, we introduce PuzzleClone, a formal framework for synthesizing verifiable data at scale using a novel DSL-driven approach. Our approach features three key innovations: (1) encoding seed puzzles into structured logical specifications, (2) generating scalable variants through systematic variable and constraint randomization, and (3) ensuring validity via a reproduction mechanism. Applying PuzzleClone, we construct PC-83K, a benchmark comprising over 83K diverse and programmatically validated puzzles. The generated puzzles span a wide spectrum of difficulty and formats, posing significant challenges to current state-of-the-art models. Experimental results show that post training (SFT and RL) on PC-83K yields substantial improvements not only on the testset but also on various logic and mathematical benchmarks. Post training raises average performance on PC-83K from 14.5 to 66.0 and delivers consistent improvements across 7 logic and mathematical benchmarks up to 18.4 absolute percentage points (SATBench from 51.6 to 70.0). Our code and data are available at https://github.com/HiThink-Research/PuzzleClone.
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量的数学和逻辑数据集，以及具有可验证答案的数据，对于提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力至关重要。虽然最近的数据增强技术有助于创建大规模基准测试，但现有的由LLM生成的数据集往往存在可靠性、多样性和可扩展性方面的不足。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了PuzzleClone这一框架，它采用一种新颖的基于DSL的方法，能够大规模地合成可验证数据。我们的方法包含三个关键创新点：(1) 将种子谜题编码成结构化的逻辑规范；(2) 通过系统的变量和约束随机化来生成可扩展的变体；(3) 通过再生机制来确保数据的有效性。利用PuzzleClone，我们构建了PC-83K基准测试集，该测试集包含超过83,000个多样化且经过程序验证的谜题。这些生成的谜题涵盖了广泛的难度和格式，对当前最先进的模型来说是一个重大挑战。实验结果表明，在PC-83K上进行训练后，不仅在测试集上取得了显著改进，而且在各种逻辑和数学基准测试中也有明显提升。训练后的平均性能从14.5提升到66.0，并且在7种逻辑和数学基准测试中实现了高达18.4个百分点的稳定提升（以SATBench为例，从51.6提升到70.0）。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/HiThink-Research/PuzzleClone下载。

papers.title: Automated Knowledge Component Generation and Interpretable Knowledge Tracing in Coding Problems
papers.title_zh: 自动化知识组件生成与可解释的知识追踪在编程问题中的应用
papers.authors: Zhangqi Duan, Nigel Fernandez, Arun Balajiee Lekshmi Narayanan, Mohammad Hassany, Rafaella Sampaio de Alencar, Peter Brusilovsky, Bita Akram, Andrew Lan
papers.abstract: Knowledge components (KCs) are key to assessing student knowledge levels on fine-grained skills and driving personalization and feedback. However, crafting KCs and tagging them for problems, traditionally performed by human domain experts, is highly labor-intensive. Prior work has studied automated KC generation only for multiple-choice questions but not open-ended ones. We bridge this gap and present an automated, large language model (LLM)-based pipeline for KC generation and tagging for open-ended programming problems. We also develop an LLM-based knowledge tracing (KT) framework to leverage these LLM-generated KCs. We conduct extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on two real-world student code submission datasets. Results show that our KT method outperforms existing ones and LLM-generated KCs outperform human-written KCs on future student response prediction. We also investigate how these KCs enable us to analyze student learning curves and conduct human evaluation with course instructors to further verify the quality of KC-problem tagging.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识组件是评估学生在细粒度技能上的知识水平以及实现个性化教学和反馈的关键。然而，创建这些知识组件并为问题进行标记的工作，传统上是由领域专家人工完成的，这一过程非常耗费人力。以往的研究仅针对选择题进行了自动化知识组件生成，而开放性问题则未被考虑。我们填补了这一空白，提出了一种基于大语言模型的自动化知识组件生成和标记方法，适用于开放性编程问题。我们还开发了一个基于大语言模型的知识追踪框架，以便利用这些由大语言模型生成的知识组件。我们在两个真实的学生代码提交数据集上进行了广泛的定量和定性评估。结果表明，我们的知识追踪方法优于现有的方法，而由大语言模型生成的知识组件在预测学生未来回答时，其性能也优于人工编写的知识组件。此外，我们还研究了这些知识组件如何帮助我们分析学生的学习曲线，并与课程教师进行人工评估，以进一步验证知识组件与问题标记的质量。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Evaluation Pitfalls and Sparsity Limitations in LLM-based Confidence Estimates for Classification
papers.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的分类置信度估计中的评估陷阱与稀疏性限制
papers.authors: Elena Merdjanovska, Omar Zaidan, Andreas Rücklé
papers.abstract: Confidence estimation is essential when LLMs are used for classification, indicating when predictions can be trusted. However, common approaches such as verbalization produce extremely sparse outputs. For instance, Qwen3-32B verbalizes only eight unique confidence values on SST-2, with over half being exactly 95%—a pattern we observe consistently across four datasets and two LLMs. Besides limiting practical utility, we show that this sparsity critically affects evaluation: the choice of interpolation in area under the accuracy-rejection curve (AUARC) dramatically alters rankings, with consistency sampling dropping from best to worst under stepwise versus linear interpolation. We advocate for standardizing stepwise interpolation for a fairer comparison. Under such a fair evaluation, we find that weighting verbalized digits by token probabilities—a method we term verbalization logprobs—addresses sparsity and achieves the best AUARC (+2.3 points over vanilla verbalization) without incurring additional inference cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 在LLM用于分类任务时，置信度估计至关重要，因为它能表明哪些预测是可以信赖的。然而，常见的处理方法，比如通过语言描述来生成输出结果，往往会导致输出数据极其稀疏。例如，Qwen3-32B在SST-2任务上的语言描述仅产生了八个不同的置信度值，其中超过一半的置信度值恰好为95%——这一模式在四个数据集和两种LLM上都得到了一致的表现。除了限制了其实用性之外，我们还发现这种稀疏性对评估结果有着严重的影响：在准确率-误报曲线下面积（AUARC）的评估中，插值方法的选用会显著改变排名结果。与线性插值相比，逐步插值的方法会导致评估结果从最佳变为最差。因此，我们建议采用标准化的逐步插值方法，以便进行更公平的比较。在这种公平评估方式下，我们发现通过将语言描述中的数字按照词元概率进行加权处理——我们将其称为“语言描述对数概率”方法——能够解决稀疏性问题，同时还能在保持最佳AUARC结果的基础上，避免增加额外的推理成本。

papers.title: MATA: Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable and Flexible Table Question Answering
papers.title_zh: MATA：一种适用于可靠且灵活问答系统的多智能体框架
papers.authors: Sieun Hyeon, Jusang Oh, Sunghwan Steve Cho, Jaeyoung Do
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly improved table understanding tasks such as Table Question Answering (TableQA), yet challenges remain in ensuring reliability, scalability, and efficiency, especially in resource-constrained or privacy-sensitive environments. In this paper, we introduce MATA, a multi-agent TableQA framework that leverages multiple complementary reasoning paths and a set of tools built with small language models. MATA generates candidate answers through diverse reasoning styles for a given table and question, then refines or selects the optimal answer with the help of these tools. Furthermore, it incorporates an algorithm designed to minimize expensive LLM agent calls, enhancing overall efficiency. MATA maintains strong performance with small, open-source models and adapts easily across various LLM types. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks of varying difficulty with ten different LLMs demonstrate that MATA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and highly efficient reasoning while avoiding excessive LLM inference. Our results highlight that careful orchestration of multiple reasoning pathways yields scalable and reliable TableQA. The code is available at https://github.com/AIDASLab/MATA.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展显著提升了表格理解任务的表现，例如表格问答（TableQA）。然而，在确保可靠性、可扩展性和效率方面仍然存在挑战，尤其是在资源有限或需要保护隐私的环境中。本文介绍了MATA——一个多智能体表格问答框架，它利用多种互补的推理方式以及由小型语言模型构建的工具来生成候选答案。MATA通过多种推理方式为给定的表格和问题生成候选答案，然后借助这些工具来优化或选择最优答案。此外，该框架还包含一种算法，旨在减少昂贵的LLM调用次数，从而提高整体效率。MATA能够在小型开源模型上保持良好的性能，并且能够轻松适应各种类型的LLM。在两种不同难度的基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，MATA能够实现最先进的准确性和高效的推理效果，同时避免过多的LLM推理负担。我们的研究结果表明，精心设计的多种推理方式的组合能够带来可扩展且可靠的表格问答解决方案。代码可在https://github.com/AIDASLab/MATA下载。

papers.title: Hallucination Detection in Long-Form Text Generated by LLMs: A Benchmark and a Hyper-Relational Knowledge Graph Approach
papers.title_zh: 基于大语言模型生成的长文本中的幻觉检测：一个基准测试以及一种超关系型知识图谱方法
papers.authors: Zituo Li, Guangzhou Chen, Jianbin Sun, Qi Song, Yang Kewei
papers.abstract: Hallucination detection has attracted increasing attention, particularly in long-form text generation, where language models are more prone to producing factually inaccurate content. Prior studies reveal two limitations: (1) current benchmarks focus on short-form content, lacking the structural complexity required in long-form scenarios; (2) existing methods are constrained by coarse-grained consistency checks and fail to capture long-range and hyper-relational dependencies. To address these challenges, we provide LHD, a benchmark for long-form hallucination detection that contains diverse entity types and intricate factual dependencies spanning extended contexts. We further propose HRKG-HD, a zero-resource, black-box framework that models responses as fact-centric hyper-relational knowledge graphs and detects hallucinations through relation-aware multi-hop reasoning over these graphs. By linking distant facts through shared entities and qualifiers, this design enables a global and dependency-aware verification of factual consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HRKG-HD not only outperforms existing baselines but also exhibits robust and consistent performance across various LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉检测越来越受到关注，尤其是在长文本生成领域，因为语言模型更容易产生事实不准确的内容。先前的研究指出两个局限性：(1) 当前的基准测试集中在短文本上，缺乏长文本场景所需的复杂结构；(2) 现有方法受限于粗略的一致性检查，无法捕捉长距离和超关系性的依赖关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了LHD——一种用于长文本幻觉检测的基准方法，该方法包含多种实体类型以及跨越广泛上下文的复杂事实依赖关系。我们还提出了HRKG-HD这一零资源、黑盒框架，它将响应建模为以事实为中心的超关系知识图谱，并通过对这些图谱进行关系感知的多跳推理来检测幻觉。通过利用共享实体和修饰语将遥远的事实联系起来，这种设计能够实现全局性和依赖性意识的事实一致性验证。大量实验表明，HRKG-HD不仅优于现有的基线方法，而且在不同大语言模型中都能表现出稳健且一致的性能。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Can Intelligent Agents Revolutionize Scale Generation?
papers.title_zh: 智能代理能否彻底改变规模规划的方式？
papers.authors: Chenghao Jia, Zhitao Yuan, Zhaokang Zong, YiFei Yin, Zhe Chen, Man Lan, Shengjun Wu
papers.abstract: Measurement scales play a crucial role in quantifying the nuanced dimensions of human cognition and behavior, however, their development typically demands extensive manual labor, and current methodologies lack systematic automation and standardized evaluation. In this paper, we introduce AutoScale, a pioneering multi-agent framework that automates scale development by leveraging collaborative AI agents. Our contributions are threefold: (1) a novel multi-agent LLM-based framework for end-to-end scale generation that replicates expert collaboration and iterative data-driven refinement, (2) the first comprehensive dataset, SCALE-1.2K, comprising 1.2K validated scales across 16 psychological domains, establishing a benchmark for automated scale development, and (3) a multi-dimensional evaluation system, featuring Muti-LLM-as-judge for conceptual and linguistic assessment and simulated large-scale testing for rigorous psychometric verification. Experimental results demonstrate that AutoScale streamlines the scale development process while maintaining rigorous quality standards, significantly reducing manual effort and paving the way for more efficient and objective measurement design in diverse research fields.
papers.abstract_zh: 测量尺度在量化人类认知与行为的细微维度方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，其开发过程通常需要大量的手动操作，而当前的方法缺乏系统的自动化和标准化评估机制。在本文中，我们介绍了AutoScale这一开创性的多智能体框架，该框架通过利用协作式人工智能智能体来自动化尺度的开发过程。我们的贡献主要有三点：（1）一种基于多智能体的大语言模型框架，能够实现端到端的尺度生成，从而再现专家之间的协作以及迭代式的数据驱动优化过程；（2）首个全面的测量尺度数据集SCALE-1.2K，包含1.2千个经过验证的尺度，涵盖16个心理学领域，为自动化的尺度开发提供了基准；（3）一个多维评估系统，该系统采用多大语言模型作为评判依据，用于概念和语言的评估，并通过模拟大规模测试来进行严格的心理测量学验证。实验结果表明，AutoScale能够简化尺度开发过程，同时保持严格的质量标准，显著减少了手动操作的工作量，为不同研究领域中更高效、更客观的测量设计铺平了道路。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: On Finding Inconsistencies in Documents
papers.title_zh: 关于发现文件中的不一致之处
papers.authors: Charles Lovering, Seth Ebner, Brandon Smock, Michael Krumdick, Muhammad Saad Rabbani, Ahmed Muhammad, Varshini Reddy, Chris Tanner
papers.abstract: Professionals in academia, law, and finance audit their documents because inconsistencies can result in monetary, reputational, and scientific costs. Language models (LMs) have the potential to dramatically speed up this auditing process. To understand their abilities, we introduce a benchmark, FIND (Finding INconsistencies in Documents), where each example is a document with an inconsistency inserted manually by a domain expert. Despite the documents being long, technical, and complex, the best-performing model (‘gpt-5‘) recovered 64% of the inserted inconsistencies. Surprisingly, ‘gpt-5‘ also found inconsistencies already present in the original documents. For example, on 50 arXiv papers, we judged 136 out of 196 of the model’s suggestions to be legitimate inconsistencies missed by the original authors. However, despite these findings, even the best models miss almost half of the inconsistencies in FIND, demonstrating that inconsistency detection is still a challenging task.
papers.abstract_zh: 在学术界、法律界和金融领域的专业人士都会对文档进行审核，因为文档中的不一致性可能会导致经济、声誉以及科学方面的损失。语言模型具有显著加快这一审核过程的潜力。为了了解这些模型的能力，我们设计了一个基准测试——FIND（发现文档中的不一致性）。在这个测试中，每个样本都是由领域专家手动插入了不一致性的文档。尽管这些文档篇幅较长、技术性强且结构复杂，但表现最好的模型（如“gpt-5”）仍然能够识别出64%的不一致性。令人惊讶的是，“gpt-5”甚至能够发现原始文档中就已经存在的不一致性。例如，在50篇arXiv论文中，我们判断出模型提出的136处不一致性中，有136处实际上是原始作者所忽略的合法不一致性。然而，即便如此，即使是最优秀的模型也几乎无法完全识别FIND中的所有不一致性，这表明不一致性检测仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Towards Preference Following in Tool Calling Language Agents
papers.title_zh: 关于工具调用语言代理中的偏好遵循机制
papers.authors: Zhi-Yuan Chen, Siyu Lu, Qianlong Xie, Xingxing Wang, Yankai Lin
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tool use, but their ability to follow user preferences when calling tools remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce APOLLO, a benchmark designed to evaluate agents’ ability to identify personalized user preferences from interaction histories and to adhere to these preferences when calling tools to solve user queries. In APOLLO, user preferences expressed in the interaction history take two forms: explicit preferences stated directly, and implicit preferences conveyed through behaviors such as option selection and comparison. In addition, the benchmark includes two types of queries, reactive and proactive, which pose challenges for LLMs to ground user queries in the corresponding preferences. Using APOLLO, we evaluate and analyze both language models and reasoning models, and investigate the impact of different agent frameworks, such as Reflexion, on model performance. Experimental results show that current models still struggle to follow user preferences when calling tools. For instance, GPT-4o achieves only 51.16% accuracy on the benchmark. Furthermore, we develop a reinforcement learning-based approach to improve LLMs, achieving substantial performance gains on APOLLO. Our dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/zhiyuanc2001/APOLLO.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在工具使用方面展现出了显著的能力，但它们在调用工具时遵循用户偏好方面的能力仍未被充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了APOLLO这一基准测试，旨在评估智能体从交互历史中识别个性化用户偏好并在调用工具解决用户查询时遵循这些偏好的能力。在APOLLO中，交互历史中表达的用户偏好有两种形式：直接表述的显性偏好，以及通过选项选择、比较等行为方式传达的隐性偏好。此外，该基准测试还包括两种类型的查询：反应型查询和主动型查询，这两种查询对LLM来说都带来了挑战，因为它们需要让用户查询与相应的偏好相匹配。通过使用APOLLO，我们对语言模型和推理模型进行了评估与分析，并研究了不同智能体框架（如Reflexion）对模型性能的影响。实验结果表明，当前模型在调用工具时仍然难以遵循用户偏好。例如，GPT-4o在基准测试中的准确率仅为51.16%。此外，我们开发了一种基于强化学习的方法来提高LLM的性能，从而在APOLLO测试中取得了显著的性能提升。我们的数据集和代码可在https://github.com/zhiyuanc2001/APOLLO上免费获取。

papers.title: ReSQL: Self-Improving Framework for Reasoning-Aware Text-to-SQL Dataset Generation
papers.title_zh: ReSQL：一种用于生成符合推理规则的文本到SQL数据的自改进框架
papers.authors: Minjun Park, Yongju Seong, Myoseop Sim, Kyungkoo Min, Stanley Jungkyu Choi
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Text-to-SQL have greatly benefited from large language models, yet small and medium-sized models still suffer from frequent execution errors and limited self-correction ability. We present ReSQL (Retrieval-augmented error reasoning for Text-to-SQL), a self-improving framework that generates and learns from its own error-reasoning dataset, enabling models to autonomously refine their SQL generation and correction capabilities. ReSQL combines feedback-driven fine-tuning with retrieval-based inference: it gathers model-generated errors, analyzes them through structured feedback prompts, and retrieves relevant correction examples during inference. This unified approach allows models to internalize robust error-reasoning patterns and dynamically apply them to unseen queries. Experimental results on the SPIDER and BIRD benchmarks show that ReSQL substantially improves execution accuracy and self-correction ability over strong baselines, achieving competitive performance with much larger proprietary models such as GPT-4. Our findings highlight ReSQL as a promising step toward self-improving, reasoning-aware Text-to-SQL systems that can continually enhance their reliability and interpretability without external supervision. All code and generated reasoning datasets are available to facilitate application to open-source LLMs and reproducible baseline training.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在文本转SQL技术方面的进展，很大程度上得益于大语言模型的助力。不过，小型和中型模型仍然面临着频繁执行错误以及自我纠错能力有限的难题。我们提出了ReSQL（基于检索增强的错误推理的文本转SQL方法），这是一种能够自我改进的框架，它能够生成自己的错误推理数据集并进行学习，从而让模型能够自主提升其SQL生成和纠错能力。ReSQL结合了反馈驱动的微调技术和基于检索的推理机制：它收集模型产生的错误，通过结构化的反馈提示进行分析，并在推理过程中检索相关的纠错示例。这种统一的方法使得模型能够内化出稳健的错误推理模式，并动态将其应用于未见过的查询中。在SPIDER和BIRD基准测试中的实验结果表明，ReSQL在执行准确性和自我纠错能力方面都显著优于现有的强大基线模型，其性能与GPT-4等更大型的专有模型相当。我们的研究结果表明，ReSQL是一种很有前景的方法，它可以帮助开发出能够持续提高可靠性和可解释性的、具备推理能力的文本转SQL系统，而无需外部监督。所有的代码以及生成的推理数据集都可以供开源语言模型使用，同时这些数据集也便于用于可复现的基线训练。

papers.title: Identifying and typifying demographic unfairness in phoneme-level embeddings of self-supervised speech recognition models
papers.title_zh: 识别并分类自监督语音识别模型中，在音素层面存在的人口统计上的不公平现象
papers.authors: Felix Herron, Solange Rossato, Alexandre Allauzen, François Portet
papers.abstract: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems have been observed to function better for certain speaker groups (SGs) than others, despite recent gains in overall performance. One potential impediment to progress towards fairer ASR is a more nuanced understanding of the types of modeling errors that speech encoder models make, and in particular the difference between the structure of embeddings for high-performance and low-performance SGs. This paper proposes a framework typifying two types of error that can occur in modeling phonemes in ASR systems: random error/high variance in phoneme embedding, vs systematic error/embedding bias. We find that training phoneme classification probes only on a single, typically disadvantaged SG, sometimes improves performance for that SG, which is evidence for the existence of SG-level bias in phoneme embeddings. On the other hand, we find that speakers and SGs with higher levels of phoneme variance are the same as those with worse phoneme prediction accuracy. We conclude that both types of error are present in phoneme embeddings and both are candidate causes for SG-level unfairness in ASR, though random error is likely a greater hindrance to fairness than systematic error. Furthermore, we find that finetuning encoder models using a fairness-enhancing algorithm (domain enhancing and adversarial training) changes neither the benefits of in-domain phoneme classification probe training, nor measured levels of random embedding error.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代自动语音识别系统在某些说话者群体上表现得更为出色，尽管整体性能有所提升。然而，在推动更公平的自动语音识别方面，一个潜在的障碍是对语音编码模型所犯建模错误的类型有更深入的理解，尤其是高性能说话者群体与低性能说话者群体在嵌入结构上的差异。本文提出了一个框架，用于分类在自动语音识别系统中可能出现的两种错误：一种是随机误差/音素嵌入的高方差，另一种是系统性误差/嵌入偏差。我们发现，仅针对单一、通常处于劣势的说话者群体进行音素分类训练，有时可以提高该群体的性能，这证明了音素嵌入中存在说话者层面的偏差。另一方面，我们发现，音素方差较大的说话者和说话者群体，其音素预测准确率同样较低。我们得出结论，这两种错误都存在于音素嵌入中，并且都是导致自动语音识别中说话者层面不公平现象的原因，不过随机误差对公平性的影响可能比系统性误差更大。此外，我们发现，使用公平性增强算法（如领域增强和对抗性训练）对编码器模型进行微调，既不会改变领域内音素分类训练的效果，也不会改变随机嵌入误差的测量水平。

papers.title: MolSafeEval: A Benchmark for Uncovering Safety Risks in AI-Generated Molecules
papers.title_zh: MolSafeEval：用于识别人工智能生成分子中存在的安全风险的一个基准测试工具
papers.authors: Tong Xu, Xinzhe Cao, Zhihui Zhu, Keyan Ding, Huajun Chen
papers.abstract: Current molecular generation benchmarks emphasize task complexity, molecule novelty, and property alignment; they largely overlook a critical concern: the potential safety risks of AI-generated molecules. In practice, many generative models may produce molecules with toxic, reactive, or otherwise hazardous characteristics—posing hidden dangers that remain insufficiently addressed. To address this gap, we introduce MolSafeEval, a benchmark dedicated to evaluating and analyzing the safety risks of molecular generation. Unlike prior approaches that rely on narrow toxicity predictors, MolSafeEval integrates heterogeneous safety knowledge—ranging from toxicological databases to hazard rules—into a structured molecular safety knowledge graph. This graph serves as a foundation for large language model–based reasoning, enabling systematic detection and explanation of unsafe features in generated compounds. We further categorize molecular generative models into four representative task types—unconditional generation, property optimization, target protein–based design, and text-based generation—and provide standardized datasets and safety evaluation protocols for each.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前基于分子的生成模型评估标准主要关注任务复杂性、分子的创新性以及性质匹配度；但这些标准往往忽略了另一个关键问题：人工智能生成的分子可能带来的安全风险。实际上，许多生成模型所生成的分子可能具有毒性、反应性或其他危险特性，这些潜在的危险尚未得到充分重视。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了MolSafeEval这一评估工具，专门用于评估和分析分子生成过程中的安全风险。与那些依赖单一毒性预测指标的方法不同，MolSafeEval将各种安全知识整合到一个结构化的分子安全知识图谱中，这些知识包括毒理学数据库和危险规则等。这个图谱为基于大语言模型的推理提供了基础，使得我们能够系统地检测和解释生成化合物中的不安全特征。此外，我们将分子生成模型分为四种典型的任务类型：无条件生成、性质优化、基于目标蛋白的设计以及基于文本的生成。并为每种类型提供了标准化的数据集和安全评估方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Dynamic Tool Dependency Retrieval for Lightweight Function Calling
papers.title_zh: 用于轻量级函数调用的动态工具依赖检索机制
papers.authors: Bhrij Patel, Davide Belli, Amir Jalalirad, Maximilian Arnold, Aleksandr Ermolov, Bence Major
papers.abstract: Function calling agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) select external tools to automate complex tasks. On-device agents typically use a retrieval module to select relevant tools, improving performance and reducing context length. However, existing retrieval methods rely on static and limited inputs, failing to capture multi-step tool dependencies and evolving task context. This limitation often introduces irrelevant tools that mislead the agent, degrading efficiency and accuracy. We propose Dynamic Tool Dependency Retrieval (DTDR), a lightweight retrieval method that conditions on both the initial query and the evolving tool calling plan. DTDR models tool dependencies from function calling demonstrations, enabling adaptive retrieval as plans unfold. We benchmark DTDR against state-of-the-art retrieval methods across multiple datasets and LLM backbones, evaluating retrieval precision, downstream task accuracy, and computational efficiency. Additionally, we explore strategies to integrate retrieved tools into prompts. Our results show that DTDR improves function calling success rates between 23% and 104% compared to state-of-the-art static retrievers.
papers.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型支持的函数调用代理能够选择外部工具来自动化复杂任务。设备内部的代理通常会使用检索模块来选择相关的工具，从而提高性能并减少上下文信息的需求。然而，现有的检索方法依赖于静态且有限的输入数据，无法捕捉到多步骤的工具依赖关系以及不断变化的任务上下文。这种局限性常常会导致引入不相关的工具，从而误导代理，降低效率和准确性。我们提出了动态工具依赖检索技术，这是一种轻量级的检索方法，它既考虑了初始查询信息，也考虑了不断变化的工具调用计划。DTDR能够从函数调用的示例中提取工具依赖关系，使得在计划发生变化时也能进行自适应检索。我们在多个数据集和不同的语言模型基础上对DTDR进行了基准测试，评估了其检索精度、下游任务准确性和计算效率。此外，我们还探讨了如何将检索到的工具整合到提示中。我们的结果表明，与最先进的静态检索器相比，DTDR能够将函数调用的成功率提高23%至104%。

papers.title: Audit Me If You Can: Query-Efficient Active Fairness Auditing of Black-Box LLMs
papers.title_zh: 如果可以的话，请对我进行审计：针对黑盒大语言模型的高效主动公平性审计方法
papers.authors: David Hartmann, Lena Pohlmann, Lelia Hanslik, Noah Gießing, Bettina Berendt, Pieter Delobelle
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit systematic biases across demographic groups. Auditing is proposed as an accountability tool for black-box LLM applications, but suffers from resource-intensive query access. We conceptualise auditing as uncertainty estimation over a target fairness metric and introduce BAFA, the Bounded Active Fairness Auditor for query-efficient auditing of black-box LLMs. BAFA maintains a version space of surrogate models consistent with queried scores and computes uncertainty intervals for fairness metrics (e.g., \Delta AUC) via constrained empirical risk minimisation. Active query selection narrows these intervals to reduce estimation error. We evaluate BAFA on two standard fairness dataset case studies: CivilComments and Bias-in-Bios, comparing against stratified sampling, power sampling, and ablations. BAFA achieves target error thresholds with up to 40\times fewer queries than stratified sampling (e.g., 144 vs 5,956 queries at \varepsilon=0.02 for CivilComments) for tight thresholds, demonstrates substantially better performance over time, and shows lower variance across runs. These results suggest that active sampling can reduce resources needed for independent fairness auditing with LLMs, supporting continuous model evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在各类人口群体中表现出系统性偏见。审计被提出作为对黑盒语言模型应用的问责工具，但这一过程需要消耗大量资源来处理查询数据。我们将审计定义为对目标公平性指标的不确定性估计，并提出了BAFA——一种用于高效审计黑盒语言模型的有限活性公平性审计器。BAFA能够维护与查询结果一致的替代模型版本空间，并通过约束性经验风险最小化算法来计算公平性指标（如ΔAUC）的不确定性区间。通过主动选择查询点，可以缩小这些区间，从而减少估计误差。我们在两个标准的公平性数据集上评估了BAFA的性能：CivilComments和Bias-in-Bios。与分层抽样、功率抽样以及消融实验相比，BAFA在达到特定错误阈值时所需的查询次数减少了多达40倍（例如，在CivilComments数据中，当ε=0.02时，BAFA需要144次查询，而分层抽样则需要5,956次查询）。此外，BAFA在长时间运行中的性能表现明显优于其他方法，且在不同运行环境下的方差也较低。这些结果表明，主动采样可以有效减少进行独立公平性审计所需的资源投入，从而支持持续性的模型评估工作。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Mending the Holes: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning for Multilingual Translation
papers.title_zh: 填补漏洞：缓解强化学习中的奖励篡改问题，以实现多语言翻译
papers.authors: Yifeng Liu, Siqi Ouyang, Yatish H R, Lei Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capability in machine translation on high-resource language pairs, yet their performance on low-resource translation still lags behind. Existing post-training methods rely heavily on high-quality parallel data, which are often scarce or unavailable for low-resource languages. In this paper, we introduce WALAR, a reinforcement training method using only monolingual text to elevate LLMs’ translation capabilities on massive low-resource languages while retaining their performance on high-resource languages. Our key insight is based on the observation of failure modes (or “holes”) in existing source-based multilingual quality estimation (QE) models. Reinforcement learning (RL) using these QE models tends to amplify such holes, resulting in poorer multilingual LLMs. We develop techniques including word alignment and language alignment to mitigate such holes in WALAR’s reward for RL training. We continually trained an LLM supporting translation of 101 languages using WALAR. The experiments show that our new model outperforms LLaMAX, one of the strongest open-source multilingual LLMs by a large margin on 1,414 language directions on Flores-101 dataset.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在资源丰富的语言对上的机器翻译任务中展现出了卓越的能力，但在资源匮乏的语言上，其性能仍然有待提高。现有的后训练方法严重依赖高质量的并行数据，而这些数据对于资源匮乏的语言来说往往难以获取或不可用。在本文中，我们提出了WALAR方法——一种仅使用单语文本进行强化训练的方法，该方法能够提升大语言模型在大量资源匮乏语言上的翻译能力，同时保留其在资源丰富语言上的性能。我们的关键思路是基于对现有基于源语言的多种语言质量评估模型的缺陷的观察。使用这些质量评估模型进行强化学习时，往往会加剧这些缺陷，从而导致多语言模型的性能下降。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们开发了包括词对齐和语言对齐在内的技术，以优化WALAR在强化学习训练中的奖励机制。我们不断使用WALAR方法来训练一个能够翻译101种语言的LLM。实验结果表明，在我们的新模型中，该模型在Flores-101数据集的1414个语言方向上，其性能明显优于LaMAX，而LaMAX是目前最强大的开源多语言LLM之一。

papers.title: MedCoach: Enhancing Medical Reasoning in LLMs via Knowledge Graph-Augmented Chain-of-Thought Distillation
papers.title_zh: MedCoach：通过知识图谱增强的思维链蒸馏技术，提升大语言模型中的医学推理能力
papers.authors: Chuan Li, Ye Lyu, Chengyu Wang, Mingyuan Fan, Cen Chen
papers.abstract: Despite the advanced capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), training specialized reasoning models for the medical domain remains a significant challenge due to the scarcity of high-quality, large-scale Chain-of-Thought (CoT) data. Moreover, the intermediate reasoning steps in teacher-generated CoT data can be redundant and noisy, leading models to acquire spurious patterns and resulting in suboptimal performance. To address these issues, we propose MedCoach, a novel framework that introduces a dedicated coach role to guide the student model through question decomposition, thereby smoothing its learning curve in medical reasoning. The framework employs a curriculum-oriented warm-up on simplified sub-questions, facilitating domain adaptation before advancing to complex long-chain reasoning. To ensure the fidelity of the intermediate chain-of-thought signals, we augment this phase with medical knowledge graphs to suppress factual drift and mitigate reasoning noise at a granular level.Subsequently, we introduce a targeted factual perturbation mechanism to foster fine-grained discrimination between valid fact utilization and subtle factual misapplications. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate notable improvements over existing methods, validating the effectiveness of MedCoach.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型具备先进的能力，但由于高质量、大规模的思维链数据稀缺，为医疗领域训练专门的推理模型仍然是一个重大挑战。此外，教师生成的思维链数据中的中间推理步骤可能存在冗余和噪声，这会导致模型产生错误的模式，从而影响性能。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了MedCoach这一创新框架。该框架引入了一个专门的指导角色，帮助学生模型通过问题分解来学习，从而平滑其在医疗推理方面的学习过程。该框架采用基于课程设计的逐步热身方式，先对简化的问题进行训练，然后再进行复杂的长链推理。为了确保思维链信号的准确性，我们加入了医学知识图谱，以抑制事实偏差并减少推理中的噪声。此外，我们还引入了有针对性的事实扰动机制，以便区分有效的事实利用与微妙的错误应用。通过在多种基准测试中的广泛实验，我们看到了相对于现有方法的显著改进，这验证了MedCoach的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Pru-CoT: Towards Efficient Reasoning Distillation via Pruning Chain-of-Thought
papers.title_zh: Pru-CoT：通过剪枝技术实现高效推理蒸馏
papers.authors: Han Liu, Shuotian Ma, Hui Li, Xiaotong Zhang, Fenglong Ma, Hong Yu
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for transferring the superior reasoning capabilities of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) to efficient student models. However, the raw Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories are often verbose and redundant, which dilutes the underlying logic and hinders effective knowledge distillation for student models. Although recent work has focused on pruning CoT to streamline these reasoning paths, existing local heuristic methods often fail to capture global causal logic due to rigid rules and limited search spaces, while global heuristic approaches incur substantial computational costs. To address these issues, we propose Pru-CoT (Pruning Chain-of-Thought), a framework that aims to extract the essential logical structure from reasoning chains. Pru-CoT implements a step-level importance assessment via global optimization on a frozen student large language model (LLM), quantifying the gradient-based causal contribution of each component. Guided by these important signals, the framework performs fidelity-constrained pruning, utilizing an LLM-driven process to synthesize concise, logically coherent narratives. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that models trained with Pru-CoT not only achieve superior accuracy but also generate significantly more compact reasoning paths compared to those trained on raw verbose data.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏已成为将大型推理模型卓越的推理能力迁移到高效学生模型中的关键范式。然而，原始的思维链（CoT）路径往往冗长且冗余，这削弱了底层逻辑，从而阻碍了学生模型的有效知识蒸馏。尽管最近的研究致力于修剪CoT以简化这些推理路径，但现有的局部启发式方法由于规则僵化、搜索空间有限，常常无法捕捉全局因果逻辑。而全局启发式方法则会导致巨大的计算成本。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Pru-CoT框架，该框架旨在从推理链中提取出基本的逻辑结构。Pru-CoT通过全局优化对冻结的学生大语言模型进行逐步重要性评估，量化每个组件的基于梯度的因果贡献。在这些重要信号的指导下，该框架执行约束于保真度的修剪操作，利用语言模型驱动的过程来生成简洁且逻辑连贯的推理路径。在数学推理基准测试上的广泛实验表明，使用Pru-CoT训练的模型不仅具有更高的准确性，而且生成的推理路径也比在原始冗长数据上训练的模型要简洁得多。

papers.title: Curriculum-RLAIF: Curriculum Alignment with Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback
papers.title_zh: 课程与强化学习的一致性：基于人工智能反馈的课程设计
papers.authors: Jiaye Lin, Mengdi Li, Xufeng Zhao, Wenhao Lu, Peilin Zhao, Stefan Wermter, Di Wang
papers.abstract: Reward models trained through Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF) methods frequently suffer from limited generalizability, which hinders the alignment performance of policy models. This challenge stems from various issues, including distribution shift, preference label noise, and mismatch of overly challenging samples with model capacity. In this paper, we aim to enhance the generalizability of reward models through a data-centric approach, driven by the insight that these issues are inherently intertwined from a uniform perspective of data difficulty. Accordingly, we propose a novel framework, Curriculum-RLAIF, which constructs preference pairs with varying difficulty levels and then produces a specific curriculum for reward model training. Comprehensive experimental results suggest that reward models trained with Curriculum-RLAIF achieve improved generalizability, boosting the alignment performance of policy models by a significant margin without incurring additional inference costs compared to various existing non-curriculum baselines. Further analysis and comparison with alternative strategies highlight the superiority of Curriculum-RLAIF in simplicity, efficiency, and effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过强化学习反馈方法训练的奖励模型往往存在泛化能力有限的问题，这影响了策略模型的对齐性能。这一挑战源于多种问题，包括分布偏移、偏好标签噪声，以及模型能力无法应对过于复杂的样本等问题。在本文中，我们旨在通过以数据为中心的方法来提高奖励模型的泛化能力，我们的思路是：这些问题本质上是相互关联的，需要从数据的难度角度来综合考虑。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的框架——Curriculum-RLAIF。该框架通过构建不同难度的偏好对，从而为奖励模型训练制定特定的训练计划。大量的实验结果表明，使用Curriculum-RLAIF训练的奖励模型具有更好的泛化能力，其对齐性能相比现有的非课程式基线方法有了显著提升，同时也没有增加额外的推理成本。进一步的分析和比较表明，Curriculum-RLAIF在简单性、效率和效果方面都表现出明显的优势。

papers.title: Query-Focused Individual Simulation with Progressive Persona Completion
papers.title_zh: 以查询为中心的个体模拟，结合渐进式角色补全机制
papers.authors: Weiwen SU, Naoki Yoshinaga, Masashi Toyoda
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable simulating individual responses from persona information, supporting applications such as opinion elicitation and virtual character creation. However, existing approaches typically assume rich persona profiles, which are often unavailable in practice. In this work, motivated by recent findings that LLMs can identify query-relevant persona dimensions (e.g., whether a user is price-sensitive), we study query-focused individual simulation under cold-start settings, where relevant persona information is identified and requested on demand for each query. To solve this task while minimizing the number of persona requests, we explore a progressive method that iteratively predicts the most critical relevant persona dimension and uses self-reported confidence as a stopping signal to determine when sufficient information has been collected. Experiments on two dialogue datasets show that this query-driven paradigm achieves simulation performance comparable to approaches that rely on rich persona information extracted from dialogue history, using only a few persona dimensions (up to five per query), and this number is further reduced by our progressive method while maintaining or improving simulation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能够基于人物信息模拟个体反应，从而支持诸如意见收集和虚拟角色创建等应用场景。然而，现有的方法通常假设人物信息非常丰富，而这在实际情况中往往难以获得。本研究受到最新研究结果的启发，这些研究指出语言模型能够识别与查询相关的人物特征（例如，用户是否对价格敏感）。因此，我们研究了在冷启动情况下以查询为中心的个体模拟方法，即针对每个查询，识别并按需获取相关的人物信息。为了在减少人物信息请求数量的同时完成这一任务，我们提出了一种渐进式方法：通过迭代预测最关键的人物特征，并利用自我报告的置信度作为停止信号，以确定何时已经收集到足够的信息。在两个对话数据集上的实验表明，这种以查询为驱动的模拟方法所达到的模拟性能，与那些依赖从对话历史中提取丰富人物信息的方法相当。在每种查询中，使用的特征数量最多仅为五个，而我们的渐进式方法进一步减少了这一数量，同时保持了或提升了模拟质量。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VIDA: A Visual Intent-driven Design Assistant for Proactive Multimodal Clarification
papers.title_zh: VIDA：一款以视觉意图为驱动的设计辅助工具，旨在实现主动式的多模态信息呈现
papers.authors: Yanshan Liu, Hongbo Zhang, Zhen Sun, Jiaheng Wei, Kaishun Wu
papers.abstract: In complex domains like interior design, user requests are often ambiguous and multimodal. Professional designers address this by asking strategic clarification questions based on hierarchical priorities, a capability lacking in current Vision-Language Models (VLMs). When fine-tuned on dialogue data, existing models often exhibit modality forgetting, overfitting to textual patterns while neglecting visual cues and thus producing hallucinated or visually irrelevant questions. To bridge this gap, we introduce VIDA (Visual Intent-driven Design Assistant), an assistant designed to generate proactive, visually grounded, and strategically prioritized clarification questions. Instead of standard fine-tuning, we propose a strategy-aware alignment framework that evolves from imitation learning to value-driven reinforcement. We utilize Group Sequence Policy Optimization to strictly enforce expert protocols, ensuring the model not only mimics fluent speech but also adheres to optimal inquiry strategies. Crucially, we design a novel hierarchical reward mechanism with Dynamic Intent Binding to align the assistant with professional prioritization standards. To facilitate this research, we construct and release InteriorClarify, a multimodal benchmark dataset comprising 1,016 real-world consultation cases annotated with this three-tier intent hierarchy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VIDA sets a new state-of-the-art, improving the Strategic Alignment Score (SAS) by 20.59% over SFT baselines and effectively restoring visual grounding capabilities lost during standard fine-tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 在诸如室内设计这样的复杂领域里，用户的需求往往具有模糊性和多模态性。专业设计师通过基于层次优先级提出策略性澄清问题来应对这一问题，而这一点是当前视觉语言模型所缺乏的能力。当现有模型在对话数据上进行微调时，它们常常会出现模式遗忘现象，即过度拟合文本模式而忽视视觉线索，从而导致生成出幻觉性或与视觉无关的提问。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了VIDA（视觉意图驱动的设计助手），该助手能够生成主动的、基于视觉的、具有策略性优先级的澄清问题。与传统的微调方法不同，我们提出了一种注重策略性的对齐框架，该框架从模仿学习逐步发展到以价值为导向的强化学习。我们利用群体序列策略优化技术来严格执行专家协议，确保模型不仅能模仿流畅的语音表达，还能遵循最优的询问策略。至关重要的是，我们设计了一种新颖的层次化奖励机制，通过动态意图绑定来实现助手与专业优先标准之间的对齐。为了推动这项研究的发展，我们构建并发布了InteriorClarify这一多模态基准数据集，其中包含1,016个带有三层意图层次的真实咨询案例。大量实验表明，VIDA取得了显著的成果，其战略对齐得分比基于SFT的基线模型提高了20.59%，并且有效恢复了在标准微调过程中丧失的视觉感知能力。

papers.title: DeepSynth-Eval: Objectively Evaluating Information Consolidation in Deep Survey Writing
papers.title_zh: DeepSynth-Eval：客观评估深度调查报告中信息整合的效果
papers.authors: Hongzhi Zhang, Yuanze Hu, Tinghai Zhang, Jia Fu, Tao Wang, Junwei Jing, Zhaoxin Fan, Wei Bi, Ruiming Tang, Han Li, Guorui Zhou, Kun Gai
papers.abstract: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) towards autonomous agents has catalyzed progress in Deep Research. While retrieval capabilities are well-benchmarked, the post-retrieval synthesis stage—where agents must digest massive amounts of context and consolidate fragmented evidence into coherent, long-form reports—remains under-evaluated due to the subjectivity of open-ended writing.To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepSynth-Eval, a benchmark designed to objectively evaluate information consolidation capabilities. We leverage high-quality survey papers as gold standards, reverse-engineer research requests, and construct Oracle Contexts from their bibliographies to isolate synthesis from retrieval noise. We propose a fine-grained evaluation protocol using General Checklists (for factual coverage) and Constraint Checklists (for structural organization), transforming subjective judgment into verifiable metrics. Experiments across 96 tasks reveal that synthesizing information from hundreds of references remains a significant challenge. Our results demonstrate that agentic “plan-then-write” workflows significantly outperform single-turn generation, effectively reducing hallucinations and improving adherence to complex structural constraints.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型向自主智能体发展的过程中，推动了深度研究的进步。虽然检索能力已经得到了充分的测试，但检索后的信息整合阶段——即智能体需要处理大量上下文信息，并将零散的线索整合成连贯的长篇报告——仍然面临着评估不足的问题，因为开放式写作具有主观性。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了DeepSynth-Eval这一基准测试，旨在客观评估信息的整合能力。我们以高质量的调研论文作为标准，逆向分析研究需求，并从相关文献中构建“Oracle Contexts”，以排除检索过程中的噪声干扰。我们采用了细粒度的评估方案，包括事实覆盖的通用检查表和结构组织的约束检查表，将主观判断转化为可验证的指标。在96项任务中的实验表明，从数百份参考文献中整合信息仍然是一个巨大的挑战。我们的研究结果证明，采用智能体“计划-然后撰写”的工作流程，能够显著优于单轮生成方式，有效减少幻觉现象，并更好地满足复杂的结构约束要求。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A Scalable Entity-Based Framework for Auditing Bias in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 一种可扩展的基于实体的框架，用于检测大型语言模型中的偏见问题
papers.authors: Akram Elbouanani, Aboubacar Tuo, Adrian Popescu
papers.abstract: Existing approaches to bias evaluation in large language models (LLMs) trade ecological validity for statistical control, relying on artificial prompts that poorly reflect real-world use, or on naturalistic tasks that lack scale and rigor. We introduce a scalable bias-auditing framework using named entities as probes to measure structural disparities in model behavior. We show that synthetic data reliably reproduces bias patterns observed in natural text, enabling large-scale analysis. Using this approach, we conduct the largest bias audit to date, comprising 1.9 billion data points across multiple entity types, tasks, languages, models, and prompting strategies. Our results reveal systematic biases: models penalize right-wing politicians, favor left-wing politicians, prefer Western and wealthy nations over the Global South, favor Western companies, and penalize firms in the defense and pharmaceutical sectors. While instruction tuning reduces bias, increasing model scale amplifies it, and prompting in Chinese or Russian does not attenuate Western-aligned preferences. These results indicate that LLMs should undergo rigorous auditing before deployment in high-stakes applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前针对大语言模型中的偏见评估方法，往往以生态有效性为代价来换取统计上的稳定性，这些方法依赖于那些无法真实反映现实使用场景的人工提示，或者依赖于缺乏规模和严谨性的自然实验。我们提出了一种可扩展的偏见审计框架，该框架利用命名实体作为探针，来衡量模型行为中的结构性差异。我们的研究表明，合成数据能够可靠地再现自然文本中观察到的偏见模式，从而支持大规模分析。通过这种方法，我们进行了迄今为止规模最大的偏见审计，涉及19亿个数据点，涵盖了多种实体类型、任务、语言、模型和提示策略。我们的研究结果揭示了系统性偏见：模型倾向于贬低右翼政治家，偏爱左翼政治家；更青睐西方和富裕国家而非全球南方国家；偏好西方企业，同时贬低国防和制药领域的企业。虽然调整指令可以减少偏见，但增加模型规模会加剧这种偏见；而使用中文或俄语进行提示并不会减弱对西方的偏好。这些结果表明，在将大语言模型应用于高风险场景之前，必须进行严格的审计。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: HiGMem: A Hierarchical and LLM-Guided Memory System for Long-Term Conversational Agents
papers.title_zh: HiGMem：一种分层式的、由大型语言模型引导的记忆系统，适用于长期对话型智能体
papers.authors: Shuqi Cao, Jingyi He, Fei Tan
papers.abstract: Long-term conversational large language model (LLM) agents require memory systems that can recover relevant evidence from historical interactions without overwhelming the answer stage with irrelevant context. However, existing memory systems, including hierarchical ones, still often rely solely on vector similarity for retrieval. It tends to produce bloated evidence sets: adding many superficially similar dialogue turns yields little additional recall, but lowers retrieval precision, increases answer-stage context cost, and makes retrieved memories harder to inspect and manage. To address this, we propose HiGMem (Hierarchical and LLM-Guided Memory System), a two-level event-turn memory system that allows LLMs to use event summaries as semantic anchors to predict which related turns are worth reading. This allows the model to inspect high-level event summaries first and then focus on a smaller set of potentially useful turns, providing a concise and reliable evidence set through reasoning, while avoiding the retrieval overhead that would be excessively high compared to vector retrieval.On the LoCoMo10 benchmark, HiGMem achieves the best F1 on four of five question categories and improves adversarial F1 from 0.54 to 0.78 over A-Mem, while retrieving an order of magnitude fewer turns. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZeroLoss-Lab/HiGMem.
papers.abstract_zh: 长期对话型大语言模型代理需要一种记忆系统，能够从历史交互中检索出相关的信息，而不会让答案生成阶段被不相关的上下文所淹没。然而，现有的记忆系统，包括分层式的记忆系统，仍然主要依赖向量相似性来进行检索。这种方式往往会导致证据集过于庞大：添加许多表面上相似的对话轮次，虽然能增加一些额外的召回率，但却降低了检索的精确度，增加了答案生成阶段的上下文处理成本，也使得检索到的记忆更难管理和检查。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了HiGMem（分层式与LLM引导的记忆系统），这是一种两级事件轮记忆系统，它允许LLM使用事件摘要作为语义锚点，从而预测哪些相关轮次值得阅读。这样，模型可以先查看高层次的事件摘要，然后再专注于一小部分可能有用的轮次，通过推理的方式获得简洁且可靠的证据集，同时避免了与向量检索相比过高的检索开销。在LoCoMo10基准测试中，HiGMem在五个问题类别中的四个类别上取得了最佳的F1值，并将对抗性F1从0.54提升到了0.78，同时检索到的轮次数量减少了整整一个数量级。代码可以在https://github.com/ZeroLoss-Lab/HiGMem获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Self-Guided Plan Extraction for Instruction-Following Tasks with Goal-Conditional Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 基于目标条件强化学习的自主导航式任务执行计划提取方法
papers.authors: Zoya Volovikova, Nikita Sorokin, Dmitriy Lukashevskiy, Aleksandr Panov, Alexey Skrynnik
papers.abstract: We introduce SuperIgor, a framework for instruction-following tasks. Unlike prior methods that rely on predefined subtasks, SuperIgor enables a language model to generate and refine high-level plans through a self-learning mechanism, reducing the need for manual dataset annotation. Our approach involves iterative co-training: an RL agent is trained to follow the generated plans, while the language model adapts and modifies these plans based on RL feedback and preferences. This creates a feedback loop where both the agent and the planner improve jointly. We validate our framework in environments with rich dynamics and stochasticity. Results show that SuperIgor agents adhere to instructions more strictly than baseline methods, while also demonstrating strong generalization to previously unseen instructions.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了SuperIgor这一用于遵循指令任务的框架。与那些依赖预定义子任务的传统方法不同，SuperIgor让语言模型能够通过自我学习机制生成并优化高级计划，从而减少了手动标注数据集的需求。我们的方法采用了迭代共同训练的方式：首先训练强化学习代理来遵循生成的计划，然后语言模型根据强化学习的反馈和偏好来调整和修改这些计划。这样便形成了一个反馈循环，使得代理和规划器能够共同改进。我们在具有丰富动态性和随机性的环境中对我们的框架进行了验证。结果表明，SuperIgor代理比传统方法更严格地遵循指令，同时还能很好地泛化到之前未遇到的指令上。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Adaptive Prompt Optimization for Open-Ended Tasks: Uncertainty Preference as a Secondary Signal
papers.title_zh: 针对开放式任务的自适应提示优化：将不确定性偏好作为次要信号
papers.authors: Shuyang Zhang, Zhixuan Liu, Zhichen Dong, Hao Zhang, Chaochao Lu, Chao Yang
papers.abstract: Prompt optimizers are widely used to create high-quality prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs), but their effectiveness remains unstable in practice. This instability is caused by the misalignment between conservative needs (e.g., safety compliance) and open-ended goals (e.g., creative writing). To address this, we propose a semantic-entropy-based method, using task uncertainty to guide prompt optimization. Specifically, we measure the task’s uncertainty level with pre-defined templates, then use this measure to direct prompt optimization: selecting high-entropy prompt candidates for creative tasks and low-entropy candidates for conservative ones. Extensive experiments across various model families demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms baselines by effectively adjusting entropy levels. Our approach requires no training, works with black-box models, and integrates easily into existing prompt optimizers.
papers.abstract_zh: 提示优化器被广泛用于为大语言模型生成高质量的提示，但其实际效果仍然不稳定。这种不稳定性是由于保守需求（如安全合规）与开放性目标（如创意写作）之间的不匹配所导致的。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于语义熵的方法，利用任务的不确定性来指导提示的优化过程。具体来说，我们通过预定义的模板来衡量任务的不确定性水平，然后利用这一指标来指导提示的优化：对于创意任务，选择高熵的提示候选方案；而对于保守型任务，则选择低熵的提示候选方案。在多种模型家族上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法能够持续优于基线算法，通过有效调整熵值来实现优化。我们的方法无需进行训练，可以适用于黑盒模型，并且可以轻松集成到现有的提示优化器中。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DPLoRA: A Dual-Pruning Framework based on ILP Optimization and Progressive Pruning for Parameter-Efficient LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: DPLoRA：一种基于ILP优化和渐进剪枝的双重剪枝框架，旨在实现参数高效的LoRA微调
papers.authors: Changjun Park, Sejong Yoon, Jaekwang Kim
papers.abstract: We propose DPLoRA (Dual-Pruning Low-Rank Adaptation), a framework that optimizes rank allocation via two stages: (1) an initial pruning stage (OPLoRA; Optimal Pruning LoRA) that uses Integer Linear Programming (ILP) to determine optimal layer-wise ranks without manual tuning; and (2) a progressive pruning stage that further reduces ranks adaptively during training using importance scores smoothed by Exponential Moving Average (EMA). Experiments demonstrate that OPLoRA consistently outperforms existing PEFT baselines on GLUE and instruction-following tasks, while the full DPLoRA framework establishes a new state-of-the-art among compared PEFT baselines on GLUE at high-performance settings (p=0.4). At efficiency-focused settings (p=0.8), our method reduces trainable parameters by over 80% and training time by 46% compared to standard LoRA, offering a highly efficient solution for deploying large-scale models in resource-constrained environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了DPLoRA（双剪枝低秩自适应算法）框架，该框架通过两个阶段来优化层数的分配：(1) 初始剪枝阶段（OPLoRA：最优剪枝LoRA），利用整数线性规划来确定最优的逐层层数，无需手动调整；(2) 渐进式剪枝阶段，在训练过程中根据重要性评分进行自适应剪枝，这些评分通过指数移动平均法进行平滑处理。实验表明，OPLoRA在GLUE任务和指令遵循任务上的表现始终优于现有的PEFT基线算法。而完整的DPLoRA框架在高性能环境下，能够在GLUE任务上超越其他PEFT基线算法，其性能提升达到了0.4的水平。在注重效率的场景下（p=0.8），与标准LoRA相比，我们的方法能够将可训练参数减少80%以上，训练时间也减少了46%，为在资源有限的环境中部署大规模模型提供了高效的解决方案。

papers.title: Demystifying Multi-Agent Debate: The Role of Confidence and Diversity
papers.title_zh: 揭开多智能体辩论的神秘面纱：信任与多样性的作用
papers.authors: Xiaochen Zhu, Caiqi Zhang, Yizhou Chi, Tom Stafford, Nigel Collier, Andreas Vlachos
papers.abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) is widely used to improve large language model (LLM) performance through test-time scaling, yet recent work shows that vanilla MAD often underperforms simple majority vote despite higher computational cost. Studies show that, under homogeneous agents and uniform belief updates, debate preserves expected correctness and therefore cannot reliably improve outcomes. Drawing on findings from human deliberation and collective decision-making, we identify two key mechanisms missing from vanilla MAD: (i) diversity of initial viewpoints and (ii) explicit, calibrated confidence communication. We propose two lightweight interventions. First, a diversity-aware initialisation that selects a more diverse pool of candidate answers, increasing the likelihood that a correct hypothesis is present at the start of debate. Second, a confidence-modulated debate protocol in which agents express calibrated confidence and condition their updates on others’ confidence. We show theoretically that diversity-aware initialisation improves the prior probability of MAD success without changing the underlying update dynamics, while confidence-modulated updates enable debate to systematically drift to the correct hypothesis. Empirically, across six reasoning-oriented QA benchmarks, our methods consistently outperform vanilla MAD and majority vote. Our results connect human deliberation with LLM-based debate and demonstrate that simple, principled modifications can substantially enhance debate effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 多智能体辩论（MAD）被广泛用于通过测试时扩展来提高大语言模型（LLM）的性能，但最近的研究表明，尽管计算成本较高，但普通的MAD往往无法达到简单多数投票的效果。研究表明，在智能体同质且信念更新一致的情况下，辩论仍能保持预期的正确性，因此无法可靠地改善结果。基于人类审议和集体决策的研究发现，普通MAD缺乏两种关键机制：(i) 初始观点的多样性；(ii) 明确、有校准的信任表达。我们提出了两种轻量级干预措施。首先，采用考虑多样性的初始化方法，选择更多样化的候选答案，从而增加在辩论开始时出现正确假设的可能性。其次，采用信任调节的辩论协议，智能体表达出经过校准的信任度，并依据其他智能体的信任度来调整自己的更新策略。我们从理论上证明，考虑多样性的初始化可以在不改变基础更新动态的情况下提高MAD成功的概率，而信任调节的更新则能使辩论系统地趋向于正确的假设。在六个以推理为导向的问答基准测试中，我们的方法始终优于普通MAD和简单多数投票。我们的研究结果将人类审议与基于LLM的辩论联系起来，表明简单的、基于原则的改进措施可以显著提升辩论的效果。

papers.title: RoleConflictBench: A Benchmark of Role Conflict Scenarios for Evaluating LLMs’ Contextual Sensitivity
papers.title_zh: 角色冲突案例库：用于评估大型语言模型情境感知能力的参考范例
papers.authors: Jisu Shin, Hoyun Song, Juhyun Oh, Changgeon Ko, Eunsu Kim, Chani Jung, Alice Oh
papers.abstract: People often encounter role conflicts—social dilemmas where the expectations of multiple roles clash and cannot be simultaneously fulfilled. As large language models (LLMs) increasingly navigate these social dynamics, a critical research question emerges. When faced with such dilemmas, do LLMs prioritize dynamic contextual cues or the learned preferences? To address this, we introduce RoleConflictBench, a novel benchmark designed to measure the contextual sensitivity of LLMs in role conflict scenarios. To enable objective evaluation within this subjective domain, we employ situational urgency as a constraint for decision-making. We construct the dataset through a three-stage pipeline that generates over 13,000 realistic scenarios across 65 roles in five social domains by systematically varying the urgency of competing situations. This controlled setup enables us to quantitatively measure contextual sensitivity, determining whether model decisions align with the situational contexts or are overridden by the learned role preferences. Our analysis of 10 LLMs reveals that models substantially deviate from this objective baseline. Instead of responding to dynamic contextual cues, their decisions are predominantly governed by the preferences toward specific social roles.
papers.abstract_zh: 人们经常面临角色冲突——即多种角色的期望相互冲突且无法同时得到满足的社会困境。随着大语言模型在应对这些社会动态时变得越来越复杂，一个关键的研究问题随之浮现：当面对这样的困境时，大语言模型是优先考虑动态上下文线索，还是学习到的偏好呢？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了RoleConflictBench这一新的基准测试，旨在衡量大语言模型在角色冲突场景中的上下文敏感性。为了在这个主观领域内进行客观评估，我们采用了情境紧迫性作为决策约束条件。我们通过一个三阶段流程构建数据集，该系统通过系统地改变各种竞争情境的紧迫性，共生成了超过13,000个真实场景，涵盖五个社会领域的65种角色。这种受控设置使我们能够定量测量上下文敏感性，从而确定模型的决策是符合情境背景的，还是被学习到的角色偏好所主导。我们对10种大语言模型的分析表明，这些模型与这个客观基线存在显著偏差。它们的决策并非基于动态上下文线索，而是主要受到对特定社会角色的偏好所驱动。

papers.title: RbtAct: Rebuttal as Supervision for Actionable Review Feedback Generation
papers.title_zh: RbtAct：作为监督机制来生成可操作的审查反馈
papers.authors: Sihong Wu, Yiling Ma, Yilun Zhao, Tiansheng Hu, Owen Jiang, Manasi Patwardhan, Arman Cohan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used across the scientific workflow, including to draft peer-review reports. However, many AI-generated reviews are superficial and insufficiently actionable, leaving authors without concrete, implementable guidance and motivating the gap this work addresses. We propose RbtAct, which targets actionable review feedback generation and places existing peer review rebuttal at the center of learning. Rebuttals show which reviewer comments led to concrete revisions or specific plans, and which were only defended. Building on this insight, we leverage rebuttal as implicit supervision to directly optimize a feedback generator for actionability. To support this objective, we propose a new task called perspective-conditioned segment-level review feedback generation, in which the model is required to produce a single focused comment based on the complete paper and a specified perspective such as experiments and writing. We also build a large dataset named RMR-75K that maps review segments to the rebuttal segments that address them, with perspective labels and impact categories that order author uptake. We then train the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model with supervised fine-tuning on review segments followed by preference optimization using rebuttal derived pairs. Experiments with human experts and LLM-as-a-judge show consistent gains in actionability and specificity over strong baselines while maintaining grounding and relevance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在科学工作流程中被越来越多地使用，包括用于撰写同行评审报告。然而，许多由人工智能生成的评审意见往往过于表面，缺乏实际可操作性的指导，这使得作者无法获得具体且可行的建议。我们提出了RbtAct这一方案，该方案旨在生成具有实际操作价值的评审反馈，并将现有的同行评审反驳意见作为学习的核心内容。这些反驳意见能够指出哪些评论导致了具体的修改或具体计划，以及哪些评论只是被简单辩护而已。基于这一洞察，我们利用反驳意见作为隐式监督机制，来直接优化反馈生成器的实用性。为了支持这一目标，我们提出了一种名为“基于视角的分段级评审反馈生成”的新任务，要求模型根据整篇论文以及特定的视角（如实验和写作）来生成一条有针对性的评论。我们还构建了一个名为RMR-75K的大型数据集，该数据集将评审段落与对应的反驳段落进行关联，同时标注了视角标签和影响类别，以衡量作者对这些反馈的采纳程度。随后，我们使用监督式微调对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型进行训练，使其能够在评审段落上产生有用的反馈，并通过使用基于反驳意见的偏好优化来进行进一步改进。通过与人类专家进行的实验以及使用LLM作为裁判的实验结果表明，我们的方法在保持准确性和相关性的同时，显著提升了评审意见的实用性和针对性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Is Grokking Worthwhile? Functional Analysis and Transferability of Generalization Circuits in Transformers
papers.title_zh: 顿悟现象值得关注吗？Transformer 泛化电路的功能分析与可迁移性
papers.authors: Kaiyu He, Mian Zhang, Peilin Wu, Xinya Du, Zhiyu Chen
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at factual retrieval, they often struggle with the “curse of two-hop reasoning” in compositional tasks. Recent research suggests that parameter-sharing transformers can bridge this gap by forming a “Generalization Circuit” during a prolonged “grokking” phase. A fundamental question arises: Is a grokked model truly superior to its non-grokked counterparts? Furthermore, is the extensive computational cost of waiting for the grokking phase worthwhile? In this work, we conduct a mechanistic study to evaluate the Generalization Circuit’s role in knowledge assimilation and transfer. We demonstrate that: (i) The inference paths established by non-grokked and grokked models for in-distribution compositional queries are identical. This suggests that the “Generalization Circuit” does not represent the sudden acquisition of a new reasoning paradigm. Instead, we argue that grokking is the process of integrating memorized atomic facts into an easy-acquire, naturally established reasoning path. (ii) Achieving high accuracy on unseen cases after prolonged training and the formation of a certain reasoning path are not bound; they can occur independently under specific data regimes. (iii) Even a mature circuit exhibits limited transferability when integrating new knowledge, suggesting that “grokked” Transformers do not achieve a full mastery of compositional logic.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在事实检索方面表现出色，但在组合任务中却常常难以克服“两跳推理的诅咒”。最近的研究表明，参数共享变换器可以通过在漫长的“理解阶段”内构建“泛化电路”来弥补这一缺陷。那么，一个经过理解的模型是否真的优于未经理解的模型呢？此外，等待理解阶段的巨大计算成本是否值得呢？在这项研究中，我们进行了机制性研究，以评估泛化电路在知识吸收和传递中的作用。我们发现：(i) 未经理解和经过理解的模型在处理分布内的组合查询时，其推理路径是相同的。这表明“泛化电路”并不是指突然获得一种新的推理方式。相反，我们认为理解过程是将记忆中的基本事实整合到易于获取的、自然形成的推理路径中。(ii) 在长时间训练后，即使是在未见过的案例上也能达到高准确率，以及形成某种推理路径，这些并不是相互独立的；在特定数据环境下，它们可以独立发生。(iii) 即使是成熟的电路，在整合新知识时也表现出有限的可转移性，这表明“经过理解的”变换器并没有完全掌握组合逻辑。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When 20 Agents Fail to Sort: The Distributed Sorting Benchmark for Scalable Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 当20个智能体都无法完成排序任务时：可扩展多智能体系统的分布式排序基准测试
papers.authors: Xin Yang, Junhao Wang, Bintao Tang, Xuxin Cheng, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Wenyuan Jiang
papers.abstract: Current LLM-based multi-agent systems remain fragile under scaling, even on algorithmically trivial tasks. We introduce MAS-BENCH, a distributed-sorting benchmark that isolates coordination under explicit communication constraints: each agent observes only a local segment and must collectively produce a globally consistent order via broadcasting, peer-to-peer messaging, or a shared key-value store. Across LLM-based agents, success drops sharply as the number of agents grows, exposing persistent failures in shared state, convention alignment, and consistent termination. To mitigate these breakdowns, we propose CAMOC, a lightweight, drop-in proof-of-concept built on collaboration-aware information sharing, early global metadata exchange, and single-commit verification. CAMOC substantially improves coordination success and efficiency across backends, with the largest gains under shared-state interaction. Overall, MAS-BENCH provides a diagnostic benchmark and CAMOC offers a practical step toward more reliable large-scale LLM collaboration, highlighting a gap between individual reasoning and collective correctness.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在扩展过程中仍然表现不稳定，即使是在算法相对简单的任务上也是如此。我们提出了MAS-BENCH这一分布式排序基准测试，该测试能够在明确的通信约束下分离出各个智能体的协作过程：每个智能体只能观察到局部的信息，但必须通过广播、点对点消息传递或共享的键值存储来共同生成全局一致的排序结果。随着智能体数量的增加，基于大语言模型的智能体的性能会显著下降，导致共享状态、协作一致性以及最终结果的稳定性受到严重挑战。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了CAMOC——一种轻量级的概念验证方案，它基于协作意识的信息共享、早期全局元数据交换以及单次提交验证机制。CAMOC显著提升了不同后端之间的协作效率和成功率，尤其是在共享状态交互的情况下。总体而言，MAS-BENCH提供了一个诊断性的基准测试，而CAMOC则为实现更可靠的大规模大语言模型协作提供了实际可行的解决方案，这也揭示了个体推理能力与集体正确性之间的差距。

papers.title: RIGOURATE: Quantifying Scientific Exaggeration with Evidence-Aligned Claim Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 严谨性：通过基于证据的声明评估来量化科学的夸张表述
papers.authors: Joseph James, Chenghao Xiao, Yucheng Li, Nafise Sadat Moosavi, Chenghua Lin
papers.abstract: Scientific rigour tends to be sidelined in favour of bold statements, leading authors to overstate claims beyond what their results support. We present RIGOURATE, a two-stage multimodal framework that retrieves supporting evidence from a paper’s body and assigns each claim an overstatement score. The framework consists of a dataset of over 10K claim–evidence sets from ICLR and NeurIPS papers, annotated using eight LLMs, with overstatement scores calibrated using peer-review comments and validated through human evaluation. It employes a fine-tuned reranker for evidence retrieval and a fine-tuned model to predict overstatement scores with justification. Compared to strong baselines, RIGOURATE enables improved evidence retrieval and overstatement detection. Overall, our work operationalises evidential proportionality and supports clearer, more transparent scientific communication.
papers.abstract_zh: 在科学研究中，严谨性往往被忽视，取而代之的是大胆的声明。这就导致作者们过度夸大了他们的主张，而这些主张并未得到实验结果的支持。我们提出了RIGURATE这一两阶段多模态框架，该框架能够从论文的正文中提取支持性证据，并对每个主张进行夸大程度评分。该框架基于来自ICLR和NeurIPS论文的超过10K个主张-证据对数据集构建，这些数据集由八个大语言模型进行标注，夸大程度评分则通过同行评审意见进行校准，并通过人工评估进行验证。该框架采用了经过微调的重新排序器来进行证据检索，同时还有经过微调的模型来预测夸大程度的合理性。与现有的强大基准相比，RIGURATE在证据检索和夸大程度检测方面表现更优。总体而言，我们的工作实现了证据与结论之间的合理比例关系，有助于实现更加清晰、透明的科学交流。

papers.title: Glance-or-Gaze: Incentivizing LMMs to Adaptively Focus Search via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 一瞥或注视：通过强化学习激励线性模型进行自适应搜索优化
papers.authors: Hongbo Bai, Yujin Zhou, Yile Wu, Chi-Min Chan, Pengcheng Wen, Kunhao Pan, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved remarkable success in visual understanding, yet they struggle with knowledge-intensive queries involving long-tail entities or evolving information due to static parametric knowledge. Recent search-augmented approaches attempt to address this limitation, but existing methods rely on indiscriminate whole-image retrieval that introduces substantial visual redundancy and noise, and lack deep iterative reflection, limiting their effectiveness on complex visual queries. To overcome these challenges, we propose Glance-or-Gaze (GoG), a fully autonomous framework that shifts from passive perception to active visual planning. GoG introduces a Selective Gaze mechanism that dynamically chooses whether to glance at global context or gaze into high-value regions, filtering irrelevant information before retrieval. We design a dual-stage training strategy: Reflective GoG Behavior Alignment via supervised fine-tuning instills the fundamental GoG paradigm, while Complexity-Adaptive Reinforcement Learning further enhances the model’s capability to handle complex queries through iterative reasoning. Experiments across six benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. Ablation studies confirm that both Selective Gaze and complexity-aware RL are essential for effective visual search. We will release our data and models for further exploration soon.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型多模态模型在视觉理解领域取得了显著成就，但它们在处理涉及长尾实体或动态变化的知识的查询时存在困难，因为这些问题依赖于静态的参数化知识。最近的一些基于搜索增强的方法试图解决这一限制，但现有方法往往采用全图像检索方式，这会导致大量的视觉冗余和噪声，同时缺乏深入的迭代推理机制，从而限制了它们在处理复杂视觉查询时的效果。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了Glance-or-Gaze（GoG）框架——一个完全自主的框架，它从被动感知转向主动视觉规划。GoG引入了选择性注视机制，该机制能够动态决定是关注全局上下文还是聚焦于高价值区域，从而在检索之前过滤掉无关信息。我们设计了双阶段训练策略：通过监督式微调来培养GoG的基本范式，而复杂性自适应强化学习则通过迭代推理进一步提升模型处理复杂查询的能力。在六个基准测试中的实验结果表明了我们的模型具有顶尖性能。消融研究也证实，选择性注视机制和复杂性感知强化学习对于有效的视觉搜索至关重要。我们即将发布我们的数据和模型，以便其他人进行进一步探索。

papers.title: Before Forgetting, Learn to Remember: Revisiting Foundational Learning Failures in LVLM Unlearning Benchmarks
papers.title_zh: 在“忘记之前”，先学会记住：重新审视LVLM基础学习中的失败之处——解除这些失败的束缚
papers.authors: Junehyoung Kwon, MiHyeon Kim, Eunju Lee, JungMin Yun, Byeonggeuk Lim, YoungBin Kim
papers.abstract: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) offer powerful capabilities, they pose privacy risks by unintentionally memorizing sensitive personal information. Current unlearning benchmarks attempt to mitigate this using fictitious identities but overlook a critical stage 1 failure: models fail to effectively memorize target information initially, rendering subsequent unlearning evaluations unreliable. Diagnosing under-memorization and the multi-hop curse as root causes, we introduce ReMem, a Reliable Multi-hop and Multi-image Memorization Benchmark. ReMem ensures robust foundational learning through principled data scaling, reasoning-aware QA pairs, and diverse visual contexts. Additionally, we propose a novel Exposure metric to quantify the depth of information erasure from the model’s internal probability distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReMem provides a rigorous and trustworthy framework for diagnosing both learning and unlearning behaviors in LVLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大型视觉语言模型具备强大的能力，但它们在无意中存储敏感个人信息时也会带来隐私风险。目前的一些忘记基准测试试图通过使用虚构身份来减轻这一风险，但忽略了第一个关键问题：模型最初无法有效记住目标信息，这导致后续的忘记评估变得不可靠。我们识别出“记忆不足”和多跳诅咒是根本原因，因此提出了ReMem这一可靠的跨图像、多跳记忆基准测试。ReMem通过合理的数据扩展、考虑推理能力的问答对以及多样化的视觉上下文，确保基础学习的稳定性。此外，我们还提出了一种新颖的曝光度量方法，用于量化模型内部概率分布中信息被抹去的深度。大量实验表明，ReMem为诊断视觉语言模型的学习和忘记行为提供了严谨且可信的框架。
