papers.title: Investigating Links between Illicit Massage Businesses through Natural Language Processing and Graph Machine Learning
papers.title_zh: 利用自然语言处理和图机器学习技术，探究非法按摩业务之间的关联关系
papers.authors: Vasuki Garg, Osman Ozaltin, Maria Mayorga, Sherrie Caltagirone
papers.abstract: Human trafficking exploits vulnerable individuals through forced sex or labor. Illicit massage businesses offer a clandestine front to illicit activities by disguising themselves as legitimate businesses. This makes it challenging for law enforcement agencies and anti-trafficking organizations to detect these enterprises and their associated entities, disrupt the network, and save victims. We adopt a multi-stream data integration approach primarily focusing on consumer-generated business reviews on Yelp.com, enriched with features from contextual data sources, such as the U.S. Census and business license records. We propose a novel decision support framework that extends the traditional link prediction methods by defining a higher-order neighborhood to detect links between pairs of massage businesses and the exposure of businesses to illicit activities related to human trafficking. We achieve this by introducing a bespoke subgraph extraction strategy in GNNs where the node features are derived using NLP techniques. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate the competitive performance of our approach over the baseline methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 人口贩卖通过强迫性行为或劳动来剥削弱势个体。非法按摩业务以合法企业的名义进行活动，为非法行为提供了隐蔽的掩护。这使得执法机构和反贩卖组织难以发现这些企业及其相关实体，也难以破坏这一网络并拯救受害者。我们采用了一种多流数据整合方法，主要依赖于Yelp.com上消费者提供的商业评价，并结合了来自各种数据源的信息，如美国人口普查数据和营业执照记录。我们提出了一种创新的决策支持框架，通过定义更高阶的邻域来检测按摩企业之间的关联，以及这些企业是否涉及人口贩卖等非法活动。我们通过在图神经网络中引入专门的子图提取策略来实现这一目标，节点特征是通过自然语言处理技术获得的。全面的实验结果表明，我们的方法在性能上优于传统的方法。

papers.title: TopoRAG: Graph-based RAG via Topology-aware Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.title_zh: TopoRAG：基于图的RAG技术，采用拓扑感知的近似最近邻搜索方法
papers.authors: Tianhao Wu, Siqiang Luo
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a core technique for improving the factuality and reasoning ability of large language models. Recent efforts extend RAG with graph-structured knowledge, enhancing retrieval to capture relational context beyond isolated text chunks. However, many graph-based RAG systems rely on a two-stage pipeline: (i) classical approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search to identify top-k entities in the embedding space, (ii) heuristic neighbor expansion which augments the retrieved set by traversing immediate neighbors. This design underutilizes graph topology during retrieval and often introduces noisy or high-degree neighbors, leading to suboptimal evidence selection. In this paper, we propose TopoRAG, a retrieval framework that directly integrates structural constraints into ANN search via a diameter-constrained formulation. By selecting entities whose induced subgraph satisfies a diameter bound, TopoRAG enables topology-aware and noise-controlled graph retrieval. Experiments show that our approach consistently improves precision and significantly reduces context redundancy compared to existing methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为提升大语言模型真实性和推理能力的关键技术。近期的研究将RAG与图结构知识相结合，通过扩展检索功能来捕捉超出孤立文本块的关系上下文。然而，许多基于图的RAG系统采用两阶段流程：(i) 使用经典的最近邻搜索方法在嵌入空间中识别前k个实体；(ii) 通过遍历直接邻居来扩展检索到的实体集。这种设计在检索过程中未能充分利用图拓扑结构，常常导致引入噪声或高度连接的邻居，从而导致证据选择效果不佳。在本文中，我们提出了TopoRAG这一检索框架，该框架通过直径约束的方式直接将结构约束整合到最近邻搜索中。通过选择其诱导子图满足直径限制的实体，TopoRAG能够实现具有拓扑感知能力和噪声控制功能的图检索。实验表明，与现有方法相比，我们的方法能够持续提升检索精度并显著减少上下文冗余。

papers.title: Self-Explaining Hate Speech Detection with Moral Rationales
papers.title_zh: 基于道德理性的自动仇恨言论检测
papers.authors: Francielle Vargas, Jackson Trager, Diego Alves, Matteo Guida, Surendrabikram Thapa, Berk Atıl, Daryna Dementieva, Andrew J Smart, Ameeta Agrawal
papers.abstract: Existing hate speech detection models are often opaque and rely on surface-level lexical cues, which makes them vulnerable to spurious correlations and limits robustness, interpretability and cultural contextualization. We propose Supervised Moral Rationale Attention (SMRA), the first self-explaining hate speech detection framework to incorporate moral rationales as direct supervision for attention alignment. Based on Moral Foundations Theory, SMRA aligns token-level attention with expert-annotated moral rationales, guiding models to attend to morally salient spans. Unlike prior rationale-supervised or post-hoc approaches, SMRA integrates moral rationale supervision directly into the training objective, producing inherently interpretable and contextualized explanations. To support our framework, we also introduce HateBRMoralXplain, a Brazilian Portuguese benchmark dataset annotated with hate labels, moral categories, token-level moral rationales, and socio-political metadata. Across binary hate speech detection and multi-label moral sentiment classification, SMRA consistently improves performance while enhancing both faithful and plausible explanations. Although explanations become more concise, sufficiency decreases, indicating more compact and informative rationales. Fairness remains stable, suggesting that improvements in explanation quality do not introduce significant bias trade-offs.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的仇恨言论检测模型往往缺乏透明度，依赖于表面的词汇线索进行识别。这种模式容易导致虚假的相关性，同时也会限制模型的鲁棒性、可解释性和对文化背景的适应性。我们提出了一种名为“监督式道德理性注意力机制”的新方法，这是首个能够直接将道德理性作为注意力对齐目标的自动仇恨言论检测框架。该机制基于道德基础理论，将令牌级别的注意力与专家标注的道德理性相结合，从而引导模型关注那些具有道德意义的文本片段。与以往基于理性指导或事后分析的方法不同，SMRA将道德理性监督直接整合到训练目标中，从而生成易于理解和符合上下文的解释。为了支持我们的框架，我们还引入了一个名为HateBRMoralXplain的巴西葡萄牙语基准数据集，该数据集包含了仇恨标签、道德类别、令牌级道德理性以及社会政治元数据。在二元仇恨言论检测和多标签道德情感分类任务中，SMRA始终能提升性能，同时提供既准确又合理的解释。虽然解释变得更加简洁，但解释的充分性有所降低，这表明所使用的理性解释更为紧凑且富有信息量。公平性方面保持稳定，说明在提高解释质量的同时，并不会引入显著的偏见问题。

papers.title: Principled Detection of Hallucinations in Large Language Models via Multiple Testing
papers.title_zh: 通过多重检验来检测大型语言模型中的幻觉现象——一种基于原则的检测方法
papers.authors: Jiawei Li, Akshayaa Magesh, Venugopal Veeravalli
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful foundational models to solve a variety of tasks, they have also been shown to be prone to hallucinations, i.e., generating responses that sound confident but are actually incorrect or even nonsensical. Existing hallucination detectors propose a wide range of empirical scoring rules, but their performance varies across models and datasets, and it is hard to determine which ones to rely on in practice or to treat as a reliable detector. In this work, we formulate the problem of detecting hallucinations as a hypothesis testing problem and draw parallels with the problem of out-of-distribution detection in machine learning models. We then propose a multiple-testing-inspired method that systematically aggregates multiple evaluation scores via conformal p-values, enabling calibrated detection with controlled false alarm rate. Extensive experiments across diverse models and datasets validate the robustness of our approach against state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型已成为解决各种任务的强大基础模型，但它们也容易出现幻觉现象，即生成看似可信但实际上是错误的或毫无意义的回答。现有的幻觉检测方法提出了多种经验性评分规则，但不同模型和数据集下的性能差异较大，因此很难确定在实践中应该依赖哪种检测方法，或者将哪种检测方法视为可靠的检测工具。在这项研究中，我们将检测幻觉的问题转化为假设检验问题，并将其与机器学习模型中离群点检测的问题进行了类比。然后，我们提出了一种受多重检验启发的方法，通过符合度p值系统地汇总多个评估分数，从而实现具有可控误报率的精确检测。通过在多种模型和数据集上的广泛实验，验证了我们的方法相对于现有最先进方法的鲁棒性。

papers.title: What Do Vision–Language Models Encode for Personalized Image Aesthetics Assessment?
papers.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型究竟编码了哪些信息，从而实现对个性化图像美学的评估？
papers.authors: Koki Ryu, Hitomi Yanaka
papers.abstract: Personalized image aesthetics assessment (PIAA) is an important research problem with practical real-world applications. While methods based on vision-language models (VLMs) are promising candidates for PIAA, it remains unclear whether they internally encode rich, multi-level aesthetic attributes required for effective personalization. In this paper, we first analyze the internal representations of VLMs to examine the presence and distribution of such aesthetic attributes, and then leverage them for lightweight, individual-level personalization without model fine-tuning. Our analysis reveals that VLMs encode diverse aesthetic attributes that propagate into the language decoder layers. Building on these representations, we demonstrate that simple linear models can achieve effective personalized image aesthetics assessment. We further analyze how aesthetic information is transferred across layers in different VLM architectures and across image domains. Our findings provide insights into how VLMs can be utilized for modeling subjective, individual aesthetic preferences.
papers.abstract_zh: 个性化图像美学评估（PIAA）是一个具有重要实际应用价值的研究课题。虽然基于视觉-语言模型的方法在PIAA领域具有很大的潜力，但尚不清楚这些模型是否能够内部编码出有效实现个性化所需的丰富、多层次的美学属性。在本文中，我们首先分析了视觉-语言模型的内部表示结构，以了解这些美学属性的存在情况及分布情况；然后，我们利用这些信息进行轻量级、个体层面的个性化处理，而无需对模型进行精细调整。我们的分析表明，视觉-语言模型能够编码出多种美学属性，这些属性会传递到语言解码层。在此基础上，我们证明了简单的线性模型也能实现有效的个性化图像美学评估。此外，我们还分析了不同视觉-语言模型架构以及不同图像领域中的美学信息是如何在不同层次之间传递的。我们的研究结果为我们如何利用视觉-语言模型来建模主观的、个体化的美学偏好提供了有价值的见解。

papers.title: A Diversity Diet for a Healthier Model: A Case Study of French ModernBERT
papers.title_zh: 一种有助于保持健康体魄的多样化饮食方式：以法国现代BERT为例的研究
papers.authors: Louis Estève, Christophe Servan, Thomas Lavergne, Agata Savary
papers.abstract: Diversity has been gaining interest in the NLP community in recent years. At the same time, state-of-the-art transformer models such as ModernBERT use very large pre-training datasets, which are driven by size rather than by diversity. This summons to investigate theimpact of diversity on pre-training. We do so in this study, with the express intent of reducing pre-training dataset size, while retaining atleast comparable performance. We compare diversity-driven sampling algorithms, and we use the best one to pre-train several ModernBERT models on French with a fixed compute budget. We fine-tune and evaluate them on a variety of French benchmarks. We compare them with models pre-trained on randomly sampled data of commensurate size, with the same compute budget. We find that both random and diversity-driven sampling may reduce the pre-training dataset by up to 94% and the pre-training time by up to 73% while maintaining performance. Moreover, in some tasks, the inherent quality of models, estimated via head-only fine-tuning, is up to 10 points higher with diversity sampling than with random sampling.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，多样性问题在自然语言处理领域受到了越来越多的关注。与此同时，一些先进的Transformer模型，如ModernBERT，所使用的预训练数据集规模非常大，这些模型的优化主要依赖于数据规模的大小，而非数据的多样性。因此，有必要研究多样性对预训练的影响。本研究正是为了探索这个问题而进行的，我们的目标是在保持至少相当性能的前提下，减少预训练数据集的规模。我们比较了几种基于多样性的采样算法，并选择最佳算法来在固定的计算资源下对多个ModernBERT模型进行法语语言的预训练。随后，我们在多种法语基准测试上对这些模型进行了微调与评估。我们还将这些模型与在相同计算资源下、使用随机采样数据进行预训练的模型进行了对比。研究发现，无论是采用随机采样还是基于多样性的采样方法，都能将预训练数据集的规模减少多达94%，同时预训练时间也能减少多达73%，而性能却保持不变。此外，在某些任务中，通过仅对模型头部进行微调来估算的模型质量，在采用多样性采样的方法时比采用随机采样的方法高出约10个百分点。

papers.title: Is Your Language Model Ready for Monetization Decisions?
papers.title_zh: 您的语言模型是否已经准备好进行变现决策了呢？
papers.authors: Jialu Gao, Hua Li, Tracy Ortman, Yeyun Gong, Jian Jiao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in monetization-driven systems such as search engines, advertising platforms, and e-commerce services, where decision making is shaped by complex interactions among user intent, advertiser objectives, and platform constraints. Despite rapid progress, existing benchmarks primarily focus on shopping-centric scenarios and user-facing data, capturing only a limited subset of real-world monetization pipelines and overlooking intermediate decision stages and robustness considerations. In this work, we introduce MonBench, a high-quality multi-task benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs in realistic monetization contexts. The benchmark is constructed from large-scale production data collected from multiple search engines, including both intermediate candidate pools and user-visible outcomes, better reflecting the distributional characteristics of real monetization systems. MonBench covers key capability dimensions such as intent understanding, commercial matching, and user behavior modeling, and adopts a unified multiple-choice formulation to enable systematic comparison across models. We further propose a comprehensive evaluation protocol that measures both performance and robustness. We evaluate a diverse set of state-of-the-art LLMs and conduct detailed task-level analyses. Our results reveal monetization-specific behaviors, including gaps between relevance optimization and broader decision-making capabilities, as well as differences in robustness across model families. These findings provide new insights into the strengths and limitations of current LLMs and highlight the need for richer domain-specific supervision in monetization-oriented applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在诸如搜索引擎、广告平台和电子商务服务等以盈利为目的的系统中得到了广泛应用。在这些系统中，决策过程受到用户意图、广告商目标和平台限制等多种复杂因素的交互影响。尽管取得了显著进展，但现有的评估基准主要聚焦于以购物为中心的场景以及面向用户的数据，因此只能捕捉到现实世界中有限的一部分盈利化流程，而忽略了中间决策阶段以及模型的鲁棒性方面的考量。在这项研究中，我们提出了MonBench这一高质量的多任务评估基准，旨在评估大语言模型在实际盈利化情境下的表现。该评估基准基于从多个搜索引擎收集的大规模生产数据构建而成，这些数据涵盖了中间候选池以及用户可见的结果，从而更好地反映了真实盈利化系统的分布特征。MonBench涵盖了意图理解、商业匹配和用户行为建模等关键能力维度，并采用了统一的多项选择题形式，以便对不同模型进行系统性的比较。我们还提出了一套全面的评估方案，能够同时衡量模型的性能和鲁棒性。我们对多种先进的语言模型进行了评估，并进行了详细的任务级分析。我们的研究结果揭示了盈利化过程中的特定行为特点，包括相关性优化与更广泛决策能力之间的差距，以及不同模型家族在鲁棒性方面的差异。这些发现为当前大语言模型的优势和局限性提供了新的见解，同时也强调了在面向盈利化的应用中需要更丰富的领域特定监督机制。

papers.title: Activation Reward Models for Few-Shot Model Alignment
papers.title_zh: 用于少量样本对齐的激活奖励模型
papers.authors: Tianning Chai, Chancharik Mitra, Brandon Huang, Gautam Rajendrakumar Gare, Zhiqiu Lin, Assaf Arbelle, Leonid Karlinsky, Rogerio Feris, Trevor Darrell, Deva Ramanan, Roei Herzig
papers.abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) to human preferences is crucial for improving their real-world behavior. A common approach is to use reward models that enable reinforcement-learning post-training. However, traditional reward modeling requires finetuning on large preference datasets, limiting adaptability to new preferences. We introduce Activation Reward Models (Activation RMs)—the first mechanistic interpretability approach that steers LLM activations to align with few-shot preference data without finetuning. Our method combines activation denoising and output token likelihood scoring, achieving state-of-the-art performance on standard reward modeling benchmarks, surpassing zero-shot, few-shot, and voting-based baselines. We further demonstrate that Activation RMs mitigate reward hacking behaviors and remain robust to noisy exemplars and spurious reward signals. To evaluate this, we propose PreferenceHack, a novel few-shot benchmark testing reward models on reward hacking in a paired preference format, where Activation RMs achieve state-of-the-art performance, surpassing GPT-4o.
papers.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型（LLMs）和大型多模态模型（LMMs）与人类偏好对齐，对于改善它们在现实世界中的表现至关重要。一种常见的方法是使用奖励模型，以实现训练后的强化学习。然而，传统的奖励建模需要在庞大的偏好数据集上进行微调，这限制了其对新偏好的适应能力。我们提出了激活奖励模型——这是一种全新的机制性可解释性方法，它能够在不进行微调的情况下，使LLM的激活方式与少量样本偏好数据保持一致。我们的方法结合了激活去噪和输出令牌概率评分技术，在标准的奖励建模基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，超越了零样本、少量样本以及基于投票的基线模型。我们还证明了激活奖励模型能够减轻奖励操纵行为，并且对噪声示例和虚假奖励信号具有鲁棒性。为了验证这一点，我们提出了 PreferenceHack这一新的少量样本基准测试，该测试以配对偏好格式来检测奖励模型的奖励操纵行为。在这一测试中，激活奖励模型取得了最先进的性能，超过了GPT-4o。

papers.title: Cross-lingual Matryoshka Representation Learning across Speech and Text
papers.title_zh: 跨语言的人形娃娃图像表示学习在语音和文本处理中的应用
papers.authors: Yaya SY, Dioula Doucouré, Christophe Cerisara, Irina Illina
papers.abstract: Speakers of under-represented languages face both a language barrier, as most online knowledge is in a few dominant languages, and a modality barrier, since information is largely text-based while many languages are primarily oral. We address this for French-Wolof by training the first bilingual speech-text Matryoshka embedding model, enabling efficient retrieval of French text from Wolof speech queries without relying on a costly ASR-translation pipelines. We introduce large-scale data curation pipelines and new benchmarks, compare modeling strategies, and show that modality fusion within a frozen text Matryoshka model performs best. Although trained only for retrieval, the model generalizes well to other tasks, such as speech intent detection, indicating the learning of general semantic representations. Finally, we analyze cost-accuracy trade-offs across Matryoshka dimensions and ranks, showing that information is concentrated only in a few components, suggesting potential for efficiency improvements.
papers.abstract_zh: 使用较少语言的人群面临着语言障碍，因为大多数在线知识都是用几种主要语言表达的。此外，由于信息主要以文本形式存在，而许多语言则是以口语为主的，因此他们还面临着表达方式上的障碍。针对法语-沃洛菲语的情况，我们开发了首个双语语音-文本矩阵模型，使得可以从沃洛菲语的语音查询中高效检索到法语文本，而无需依赖成本高昂的自动语音识别与翻译流程。我们还引入了大规模数据整理流程和新评估标准，比较了不同的建模策略，并发现将不同表达方式融合到固定结构的文本矩阵模型中效果最佳。尽管该模型仅用于检索任务，但它也能很好地应用于其他任务，如语音意图检测，这表明模型能够学习到通用的语义表示。最后，我们分析了不同矩阵维度下的成本与准确性之间的权衡，发现信息主要集中在少数几个组件中，这为提高效率提供了可能。

papers.title: TRACE: Two-Phase RL for Causal Graph Exploration and Deeper Psychological Intervention in Dynamic Counseling Scenarios
papers.title_zh: TRACE：用于因果图探索的双阶段强化学习算法，可在动态咨询场景中实现更深入的心理干预
papers.authors: Shilin Tang, Zunyi Yin, Xuefeng Liang, Guanghui Shi, Song Tong, Chen Guangyu
papers.abstract: LLMs have shown promise in mental health counseling, but existing models are limited to surface-level empathy or predefined therapeutic procedures and lack the ability to actively explore the root causes of psychological distress. Inspired by case conceptualization, we formalize counseling as the online reconstruction of a client’s underlying causal graph through multi-turn dialogue. To this end, we propose TRACE, a two-phase reinforcement learning framework. It implements a causal-graph-driven reward scheme across two phases: an exploration phase that rewards the causal graph reconstruction following a surface-to-deep path, and an intervention phase that rewards targeted restructuring of irrational beliefs. Extensive experiments show that TRACE outperforms existing models, enabling causal-chain-aware psychological intervention beyond surface-level empathy.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在心理健康咨询领域展现出巨大潜力，但现有的模型仅限于表面级的共情或预先定义的治疗程序，缺乏主动探索心理困扰根源的能力。受案例概念化的启发，我们将咨询过程定义为通过多轮对话来重构客户潜在因果图谱的过程。为此，我们提出了TRACE这一两阶段强化学习框架。该框架采用因果图谱驱动的奖励机制，分为两个阶段：第一阶段通过从表面到深层的路径来奖励因果图谱的重构；第二阶段则通过对不合理信念进行有针对性的调整来奖励干预效果。大量实验表明，TRACE在性能上优于现有模型，能够实现超越表面共情的、注重因果链的心理干预。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: LLM Multi-Agent Systems for Long Triple Set Data-to-Text Generation
papers.title_zh: 多智能体系统硕士课程：专注于长三元组数据到文本生成的转换技术
papers.authors: Chinonso Cynthia Osuji, Simon Mille, Mark Andrade, Jane Adkins, Ornait O’Connell, Elaine Uí Dhonnchadha, Bláithín Heffernan, Fírinne Nic an tSaoir, Anya Belz, Thiago Castro Ferreira, Brian Davis
papers.abstract: Generating coherent, semantically accurate text from large structured inputs remains a persistent challenge in data-to-text generation, as single-step LLM mappings from data-to-text limit control over discourse structuring and amplify hallucinations and omissions as input size grows. We introduce a new dataset of extended DBpedia triple sets (up to 199 triples per input), and a modular multi-agent framework: specialised LLM agents handle content ordering, text structuring, and surface realisation under the supervision of an orchestrator and guardrail control loop. The system generates multi-paragraph outputs in English and Irish (low-resource). We compare a three-worker multi-agent configuration against a single-worker multi-task variant and a strong end-to-end baseline. Quality is assessed via human evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge (with truncation-based sanity checks). Results show slightly superior coherence for the multi-agent approach in both languages, with statistically significant inter-rater correlation over all criteria for English and no statistically significant correlation for Irish. Human-LLM alignment is very weak overall, thus exposing key limits in scalable NLG evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 从大量结构化输入中生成连贯且语义准确的文本，仍然是数据到文本生成领域中的一个持续挑战。因为单步级的大语言模型从数据到文本的映射方式，会限制对话语结构的控制能力，并且随着输入规模的增加，还会出现幻觉和遗漏现象。我们引入了一个新的数据集，该数据集包含了扩展的DBpedia三元组集合（每个输入最多包含199个三元组），同时还提出了一种模块化多智能体框架：专门的LLM智能体负责处理内容排序、文本结构安排以及表面化表达等问题，这些工作都在一个协调器以及安全控制机制的监督下进行。该系统能够生成多段落的输出文本，支持英语和爱尔兰语两种语言（这两种语言的资源获取较为困难）。我们将这种多智能体配置与单智能体的多任务版本进行了比较，同时也与一个强大的端到端基线模型进行了对比。评估质量时，采用了人工评估和LLM作为评判标准（同时进行了基于截断处理的合理性检查）。结果表明，多智能体方法在两种语言中都能表现出略微更高的连贯性，且在所有指标上都具有统计学上的显著差异；而在爱尔兰语方面则没有显示出统计学上的显著相关性。总体而言，人类语言模型与LLM之间的对齐效果非常弱，这揭示了在可扩展的自然语言生成评估中的关键限制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Biomed-Enriched: Data-Efficient Biomedical Pretraining via Paragraph-Level Annotation
papers.title_zh: 生物医学增强型：通过段落级注释实现高效生物医学预训练的数据处理方法
papers.authors: Rian Touchent, Nathan Godey, Éric Villemonte de la Clergerie
papers.abstract: We annotate PubMed Central paragraphs for document type, domain, and educational quality using a two-stage pipeline: Llama-3.1-70B labels 400K paragraphs, then a fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa propagates annotations to the full corpus. This paragraph-level approach captures content diversity within scientific articles that document-level labels miss. The resulting Biomed-Enriched corpus contains 2M clinical case paragraphs, providing a publicly available alternative to restricted clinical datasets. For decoders, continual pretraining experiments enable targeted improvements, with clinical upsampling boosting performance by 4 points on MMLU ProfMed and educational filtering improving MedQA and MedMCQA by ~1 point. Combinations of these techniques led to faster convergence, reaching the same performance with a third of training tokens. For encoders, our best recipe matches BioClinical-ModernBERT on 11 tasks (77.3% vs 77.1% F1) while using 2.5x fewer tokens and only public data.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们采用两阶段流程对PubMed Central中的段落进行标注，包括文档类型、领域和教育质量等方面。首先使用Llama-3.1-70B模型对40万个段落进行标注，然后利用经过微调的XLM-RoBERTa模型将标注结果应用到整个语料库中。这种基于段落级别的标注方式能够捕捉到文档级别标注所遗漏的科学文章中的内容多样性。最终得到的生物医学富集语料库包含200万个临床案例段落，为公众提供了另一种获取受限临床数据的途径。对于解码器来说，持续预训练实验能够实现有针对性的改进：临床数据上采样可以将MMLU ProfMed测试集的性能提升4个百分点；而教育过滤功能则能使MedQA和MedMCQA测试集的性能提升约1个百分点。这些技术的结合使得模型的收敛速度更快，仅使用三分之一的训练标记就能达到与全量训练相同的性能。对于编码器而言，我们的最佳方案是在11个任务上使BioClinical-ModernBERT的表现达到最优（F1分数分别为77.3%和77.1%），同时使用的标记数量减少了2.5倍，且全部使用的是公开数据。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Identifying the Achilles’ Heel: An Iterative Method for Uncovering Factual Errors in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 找出“阿喀琉斯之踵”：一种用于识别大型语言模型中事实错误的迭代方法
papers.authors: Wenxuan Wang, Yuk-Kit Chan, Zixuan Ling, Shi Juluan, Youliang Yuan, Jen-tse Huang, Yifei Zhang, Wenxiang Jiao, Zhaopeng Tu, Michael R. Lyu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT are foundational in various applications due to their extensive knowledge from pre-training and fine-tuning. Despite this, they are prone to generating factual and commonsense errors, raising concerns in critical areas like healthcare, journalism, and education to mislead users. Current methods for evaluating LLMs’ veracity are limited by the need for extensive human labor, test data contamination, or limited scope, hindering efficient and effective exposure of errors. To address these challenges, we propose HalluHunter, a novel, fully automated framework for systematically uncovering factual inaccuracies in LLMs. HalluHunter employs a knowledge-graph-based approach, extracting fact triplets to generate diverse question types for single- and multi-hop reasoning using rule-based Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. Its iterative process starts with random triplet selection for question generation, followed by adaptive selection in subsequent iterations, targeting triplets where LLMs frequently err based on their performance analysis. Our extensive tests on nine prominent LLMs reveal that HalluHunter can trigger factual errors in up to 55% of questions in these models. Moreover, we demonstrate that HalluHunter’s test cases, particularly in adaptive selection, could further expose the weaknesses in benchmarking the factuality in LLMs meanwhile maintaining the coverage of questions. All code, data, and results will be released for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 像ChatGPT这样的大语言模型在多种应用中具有基础性作用，因为它们通过预训练和微调获得了丰富的知识。然而，这些模型容易产生事实性和常识性错误，这在医疗、新闻和教育等关键领域引发了担忧，可能会误导用户。目前评估语言模型真实性的方法受到人力投入巨大、测试数据污染或范围有限等限制，这阻碍了错误的高效有效识别。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了HalluHunter这一全新的全自动框架，用于系统地发现语言模型中的事实性错误。HalluHunter采用基于知识图谱的方法，通过提取事实三元组来生成多种类型的问题，并利用基于规则的自然语言处理技术进行单跳和多跳推理。其迭代过程从随机选择三元组开始，然后在后续迭代中自适应地选择那些根据性能分析容易被语言模型出错的三元组。我们对九种主流语言模型进行的广泛测试表明，HalluHunter能够在高达55%的问题中触发事实性错误。此外，我们还证明，HalluHunter的自适应选择机制能够进一步揭示语言模型在真实性评估方面的弱点，同时仍然能够覆盖足够多的问题样本。所有代码、数据和结果都将公开，以便未来的研究使用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Probing the Plasticity and Correlation of LLM Value Systems: LLM Value Rankings are Not Stable
papers.title_zh: 探究价值系统的可塑性与关联性：LLM价值观的排名并不稳定
papers.authors: Zhenheng Tang, Qihua Pan, Jingya Shen, Xiang Liu, Qian Wang, Bo Li, Xiaowen Chu
papers.abstract: The value alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is critical because value is the foundation of LLM decision-making and behavior. Some recent work show that LLMs have similar value rankings. However, little is known about how susceptible LLM value rankings are to external influence and how different values are correlated with each other. In this work, we investigate the plasticity of LLM value systems by examining how their value rankings are influenced by different prompting strategies and exploring the intrinsic relationships between values. To this end, we design 6 different value transformation prompting methods including direct instruction, rubrics, in-context learning, scenario, persuasion, and persona, and benchmark the effectiveness of these methods on 3 different families and totally 8 LLMs. Our main findings include that the value rankings in large LLMs are much more susceptible to external influence than small LLMs, and there are intrinsic correlations between certain values (e.g., Privacy and Respect). Besides, through detailed correlation analysis, we find that the value correlations are more similar between large LLMs of different families than small LLMs of the same family. We also identify that scenario method is the strongest persuader and can help entrench the value rankings.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的价值定位至关重要，因为价值是语言模型决策和行为的基础。一些最新的研究表明，不同大语言模型在价值排序上具有相似性。然而，人们对大语言模型的价值排序如何受到外部影响的影响，以及不同价值之间是否存在关联，了解甚少。在这项研究中，我们通过考察不同的提示策略如何影响大语言模型的价值排序，并探索不同价值之间的内在关系，来研究其价值系统的可塑性。为此，我们设计了六种不同的价值转换提示方法，包括直接指令、评分标准、情境学习、情景模拟、说服性提示和角色扮演等。然后，我们在三种不同的语言模型家族中，对这六种方法的有效性进行了测试。我们的主要发现包括：与小型语言模型相比，大语言模型的价值排序更容易受到外部影响；某些价值（如隐私和尊重）之间存在内在相关性。此外，通过详细的相关性分析，我们发现不同家族的大语言模型在价值关联方面更为相似，而同一家族的小型语言模型则存在较大差异。我们还发现，情景模拟方法是最有效的提示方式，能够有助于巩固价值排序。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FAMA: Failure-Aware Meta-Agentic Framework for Open-Source LLMs in Interactive Tool Use Environments
papers.title_zh: FAMA：一种面向交互式工具使用环境的、基于失败意识的元智能体框架，适用于开源大语言模型
papers.authors: Amir Saeidi, Venkatesh Mishra, Souradeep Mukhopadhyay, Gaowen Liu, Ali Payani, Jayanth Srinivasa, Chitta Baral
papers.abstract: Large Language Models are being increasingly deployed as the decision-making core of autonomous agents capable of effecting change in external environments. Yet, in conversational benchmarks, which simulate real-world customer-centric issue resolution scenarios, these agents frequently fail due to the cascading effects of incorrect decision-making. These challenges are particularly pronounced for open-source LLMs with smaller parameter sizes, limited context windows, and constrained inference budgets, which contribute to increased error accumulation in agentic settings. To tackle these challenges, we present the Failure-Aware Meta-Agentic (FAMA) framework. FAMA operates in two stages: first, it analyzes failure trajectories from baseline agents to identify the most prevalent errors; second, it employs an orchestration mechanism that activates a minimal subset of specialized agents tailored to address these failures by injecting a targeted context for the tool-use agent before the decision-making step. Experiments across open-source LLMs demonstrate performance gains up to 27% across evaluation modes over standard baselines. These results highlight that targeted curation of context through specialized agents to address common failures is a valuable design principle for building reliable, multi-turn tool-use LLM agents that simulate real-world conversational scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正被越来越多地用作自主代理的决策核心，这些代理能够改变外部环境。然而，在模拟现实世界中以客户为中心的问题解决场景的对话基准测试中，这些代理常常因为错误决策带来的连锁效应而失败。对于参数规模较小、上下文窗口有限且推理预算受限的开源LLM来说，这种挑战尤为明显，这些因素会导致代理环境中的错误累积加剧。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了故障感知元代理框架（Failure-Aware Meta-Agentic，FAMA）。该框架分为两个阶段：首先，它分析基础代理的失败轨迹，以识别最常见的错误；其次，它采用一种协调机制，激活一小部分专门化的代理来应对这些错误，通过在决策步骤之前为工具使用代理注入有针对性的上下文信息。在开源LLM上的实验表明，与标准基线相比，该框架在多种评估模式下实现了高达27%的性能提升。这些结果表明，通过专门化的代理对上下文进行有针对性的调整，以处理常见错误，是构建可靠、能模拟现实世界对话场景的多轮工具使用LLM代理的重要设计原则。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Reasoning Gains: Mitigating General-Capability Forgetting in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 超越推理的收益：在大型推理模型中减轻通用能力遗忘问题
papers.authors: Hoang Phan, Xianjun Yang, Yuanshun Yao, Jingyu Zhang, Shengjie Bi, Xiaocheng Tang, Madian Khabsa, Lijuan Liu, Deren Lei
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has delivered impressive gains in mathematical and multimodal reasoning and has become a standard post-training paradigm for contemporary language and vision-language models. However, the RLVR recipe introduces a significant risk of capability regression, where models forget foundational skills after prolonged training without employing regularization strategies. We empirically confirm this concern, observing that open-source reasoning models suffer performance degradation on core capabilities such as perception and faithfulness. While imposing regularization terms like KL divergence can help prevent deviation from the base model, these terms are calculated on the current task, thus they do not guarantee broader knowledge. Meanwhile, commonly used experience replay across heterogeneous domains makes it nontrivial to decide how much training focus each objective should receive. To address this, we propose RECAP—a replay strategy with dynamic objective reweighting for general knowledge preservation. Our reweighting mechanism adapts in an online manner using short-horizon signals of convergence and instability, shifting the post-training focus away from saturated objectives and toward underperforming or volatile ones. Our method is end-to-end and readily applicable to existing RLVR pipelines without training additional models or heavy tuning. Extensive experiments on benchmarks based on Qwen2.5-VL-3B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, which not only preserves general capabilities but also improves reasoning by enabling more flexible trade-offs among in-task rewards.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在数学和多模态推理方面取得了显著成果，已成为现代语言模型和语篇-语言模型的标准后训练范式。然而，RLVR方法存在能力退化的风险，即模型在长时间训练后可能会忘记基础技能，而如果不采用正则化策略的话，这种情况就会发生。我们通过实验证实了这一担忧，发现开源推理模型在感知能力和准确性等核心能力上出现了性能下降。虽然引入KL散度等正则化项可以帮助防止模型偏离基准模型，但这些项的计算是基于当前任务的，因此无法保证模型的广泛知识储备。此外，不同领域之间常用的经验回放机制使得如何分配训练资源变得非常困难。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了RECAP——一种具有动态目标权重调整的回放策略，旨在保留通用知识。我们的权重调整机制能够在线根据收敛性和稳定性指标进行自适应调整，从而将训练重点从表现不佳的目标转移到了那些性能较差或波动较大的目标上。我们的方法是端到端的，可以直接应用于现有的RLVR流程，无需额外训练模型或进行复杂的调整。我们在基于Qwen2.5-VL-3B和Qwen2.5-VL-7B的基准测试上进行了大量实验，证明了我们的方法的有效性。该方法不仅保留了通用能力，还通过实现更灵活的奖励权衡机制，提升了推理能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ActorMind: Emulating Human Actor Reasoning for Speech Role-Playing
papers.title_zh: ActorMind：模拟人类在语音角色扮演中的推理过程
papers.authors: Xi Chen, Wei Xue, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: Role-playing has garnered rising attention as it provides a strong foundation for human-machine interaction and facilitates sociological research. However, current work is confined to textual modalities, neglecting speech, which plays a predominant role in daily life, thus limiting genuine role-playing. To bridge this gap, we conceptualize and benchmark speech role-playing through ActorMindBench, and we present a corresponding reasoning framework, called ActorMind. Specifically, (1) Speech Role-Playing enables models to deliver spontaneous responses with personalized verbal traits based on their role, the scene, and spoken dialogue. (2) ActorMindBench is a hierarchical benchmark comprises Utterance-Level content with 7,653 utterances, Scene-Level content with 313 scenes, and Role-Level content with 6 roles. (3) ActorMind is an off-the-shelf, multi-agent, chain-of-though style reasoning framework that emulates how human actors perform in theaters. Concretely, ActorMind first reads its assigned role description via Eye Agent, then comprehends emotional cues within contextual spoken dialogues through Ear Agent. Subsequently, Brain Agent generates a descriptive emotional state, and finally, Mouth Agent delivers the scripts infused with corresponding emotion state. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of ActorMind in enhancing speech role-playing. The project page is available at https://github.com/OzymandiasChen/ActorMind.
papers.abstract_zh: 角色扮演越来越受到关注，因为它为人机交互提供了坚实的基础，并且有助于社会学研究。然而，目前的研究主要集中在文本层面，而忽视了在日常生活中起着重要作用的语音方面，这限制了真正的角色扮演的实现。为了填补这一空白，我们通过ActorMindBench概念化和评估语音角色扮演技术，并提出了相应的推理框架——ActorMind。具体来说：(1) 语音角色扮演使模型能够根据角色、场景和对话内容，提供具有个性化特征的即兴回应。(2) ActorMindBench是一个分层化的评估工具，包含7,653条语句的内容、313个场景的内容，以及6种角色的评估内容。(3) ActorMind是一个现成的多智能体链式推理框架，能够模拟人类演员在剧院中的表演方式。具体来说，ActorMind首先通过Eye Agent读取分配给它的角色描述，然后通过Ear Agent理解上下文中的情感线索。随后，Brain Agent生成描述性的情绪状态，最后，Mouth Agent将带有相应情绪状态的脚本呈现出来。实验结果表明，ActorMind在提升语音角色扮演效果方面非常有效。该项目的页面可以在https://github.com/OzymandiasChen/ActorMind找到。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Neuronal Insights into LLM Attacks: Targeted Neuron Tuning for Precise and Robust Vulnerability Patching
papers.title_zh: 关于大语言模型攻击的神经元层面洞察：针对特定神经元的调整，以实现精确且可靠的漏洞修复
papers.authors: Dan Shi, Renren Jin, Zhuowen Han, Yuqi Ren, Xinwei Wu, Zhigen Li, Deyi Xiong
papers.abstract: Despite recent advances in safety alignment, large language models (LLMs) remain highly susceptible to adversarial attacks, while the internal mechanisms behind such vulnerabilities are still poorly understood. Existing gradient-based attribution methods offer valuable interpretability for analyzing information storage and processing in LLMs. However, they are inapplicable to adversarial attacks, which typically occur in open-ended generation settings without fixed ground-truth outputs. To address these challenges, we propose a novel similarity-based gradient attribution method to identify key neurons sensitive to adversarial behaviors in open-ended generation tasks. The detected neurons, termed targeted neurons, play a critical role in safety training. Building on this neuron-level perspective, we uncover two key neuronal patterns: (i) universal neurons that are consistently exploited across multiple attack strategies, and (ii) interference neurons that hinder safety improvements when fine-tuned indiscriminately, providing mechanistic insights into the interpretability of adversarial vulnerabilities. Inspired by these findings, we propose a neuron-level defense strategy, Targeted Neuron Tuning (TNT), which selectively fine-tunes the identified targeted neurons for specific attacks. Experimental evaluations across multiple LLM architectures and scales demonstrate that TNT substantially improves model robustness against a wide range of jailbreak attacks, achieving safe rates exceeding 90% and even approaching 100%, while preserving general task performance, enabling precise and robust safety interventions. Warning: This paper contains example data that may be harmful.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在安全性对齐方面取得了近期进展，大语言模型仍然极易受到对抗性攻击的威胁，而这类漏洞背后的内在机制至今仍不甚明了。现有的基于梯度的归因方法为分析大语言模型中的信息存储和处理过程提供了有价值的可解释性手段。然而，这些方法无法适用于对抗性攻击，因为对抗性攻击通常发生在没有固定真实输出的开放式生成场景中。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于相似性的梯度归因方法，以识别在开放式生成任务中对对抗行为敏感的关键神经元。这些被检测到的神经元被称为“目标神经元”，它们在安全性训练中起着至关重要的作用。基于这种神经元层面的视角，我们发现了两种关键的神经元模式：(i) 那些在不同攻击策略中始终被利用的通用神经元；(ii) 那些在未经区分地进行微调时反而会阻碍安全改进的干扰神经元。这些发现为我们理解对抗性漏洞的可解释性提供了机制上的启示。受这些发现启发，我们提出了一种神经元级别的防御策略——目标神经元调优（Targeted Neuron Tuning，TNT），该策略能够选择性地调整那些被识别出的目标神经元，以应对特定的攻击。通过在不同架构和规模的大语言模型上进行实验验证，我们发现TNT显著提升了模型对各类破解攻击的鲁棒性，其安全率超过了90%，甚至接近100%。同时，它还能保持模型的整体性能，从而实现精确且稳健的安全性干预。警告：本文包含可能具有危害性的示例数据。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Ro-SLM: Onboard Small Language Models for Robot Task Planning and Operation Code Generation
papers.title_zh: Ro-SLM：用于机器人任务规划与操作代码生成的小型语言模型
papers.authors: Wenhao Wang, Yanyan Li, Long Jiao, Jiawei Yuan
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) provide robots with contextual reasoning abilities to comprehend human instructions. Yet, current LLM-enabled robots typically depend on cloud-based models or high-performance computing infrastructure, which limit their deployment on robots under unreliable internet environments or with constrained computational resources, such as UAVs and small ground vehicles. Thus, deploying fine-tuned small language models (SLMs) that support onboard deployment offers a promising alternative. This paper introduces Ro-SLM, a framework that enables reliable SLM-driven robot operation by distilling LLMs’ knowledge and reasoning. Ro-SLM starts from dataset synthesis by leveraging LLMs to generate diverse task instructions, produce corresponding ground truth code with minimal human assistance, and augment instructions into real-world application scenarios. Ro-SLM is then fine-tuned with the dataset, in which LLM serves as a reward function to guide the training. Extensive experiments on UAV operation tasks demonstrate that Ro-SLM improves the performance of SLM from being incapable of supporting robotic task planning and code generation to achieving performance that approaches LLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在大语言模型方面的进展为机器人赋予了上下文推理能力，使其能够理解人类的指令。然而，目前基于大语言模型的机器人通常依赖于基于云的模型或高性能计算基础设施，这限制了它们在网络不稳定或计算资源有限的环境中的应用，例如无人机和小型地面车辆。因此，使用经过微调的小型语言模型来实现机载部署是一种有前景的替代方案。本文介绍了Ro-SLM框架，该框架通过提取大语言模型的知识和推理能力，实现了可靠的语言模型驱动机器人操作。Ro-SLM首先通过利用大语言模型生成多样化的任务指令，然后在最小的人工干预下生成相应的真实代码，并将这些指令转化为现实世界的应用场景。随后，Ro-SLM使用该数据集进行微调，其中大语言模型作为奖励函数来指导训练过程。在无人机操作任务上的大量实验表明，Ro-SLM能够将小型语言模型的性能从无法支持机器人任务规划和代码生成提升到接近大语言模型的水平。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Just Use XML: Revisiting Joint Translation and Label Projection
papers.title_zh: 只需使用XML：重新审视联合翻译与标签投影技术
papers.authors: Thennal D K, Chris Biemann, Hans Ole Hatzel
papers.abstract: Label projection is an effective technique for cross-lingual transfer, extending span-annotated datasets from a high-resource language to low-resource ones. Most approaches perform label projection as a separate step after machine translation, and prior work that combines the two reports degraded translation quality. We re-evaluate this claim with LabelPigeon, a novel framework that jointly performs translation and label projection via XML tags. We design a direct evaluation scheme for label projection, and find that LabelPigeon outperforms baselines and actively improves translation quality in 11 languages. We further assess translation quality across 203 languages and varying annotation complexity, finding consistent improvement attributed to additional fine-tuning. Finally, across 27 languages and three downstream tasks, we report substantial gains in cross-lingual transfer over comparable work, up to +40.2 F1 on NER. Overall, our results demonstrate that XML-tagged label projection provides effective and efficient label transfer without compromising translation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 标签投影是一种有效的跨语言迁移技术，能够将标注丰富的数据集扩展到资源较少的语言中。大多数方法在机器翻译之后单独进行标签投影处理，而之前将两者结合的研究则会导致翻译质量下降。我们通过使用LabelPigeon这一新型框架来重新评估这一点，该框架通过XML标签同时实现翻译和标签投影功能。我们设计了针对标签投影的直接评估方案，并发现LabelPigeon在11种语言中优于现有基线方法，并且能够有效提升翻译质量。我们进一步评估了203种语言以及不同标注复杂度的翻译质量，发现通过额外的微调可以持续提高翻译质量。最后，在27种语言和三个下游任务上，我们发现与同类工作相比，我们的跨语言迁移效果有了显著提升，特别是在NER任务上的F1分数提高了40.2。总体而言，我们的结果表明，使用XML标签进行标签投影能够实现高效且有效的标签迁移，同时不会损害翻译质量。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CaTS-Bench: Can Language Models Describe Time Series?
papers.title_zh: CaTS-Bench：语言模型能否描述时间序列数据？
papers.authors: Luca Zhou, Pratham Yashwante, Marshall Fisher, Alessio Sampieri, Zihao Zhou, Fabio Galasso, Rose Yu
papers.abstract: Time series captioning, the task of describing time series in natural language, requires numeric and temporal reasoning, trend interpretation, and contextual understanding. Existing benchmarks, however, often rely on fully synthetic or generic captions, and typically neglect metadata and visual representations. We introduce CaTS-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for Context-aware Time Series reasoning across 11 diverse domains, centered on a gold-standard evaluation set of 1746 human-rewritten captions that measure how effectively models translate numeric trends into immediately interpretable narratives. To address the scarcity of human-annotated data, we also propose a scalable pipeline for generating high-fidelity synthetic captions, the quality of which we validate. We evaluate leading Vision-Language Models on our benchmark, revealing that even proprietary models struggle to capture numeric nuances in temporal descriptions, while finetuning open-source models on synthetic data yields substantial performance gains. Finally, we release a diagnostic suite of 910 multiple-choice questions and use tailored numeric metrics to gauge time-series-specific reasoning capabilities, establishing CaTS-Bench as a reliable foundation for grounded, multimodal text generation in numeric domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列标注任务要求用自然语言描述时间序列数据，这涉及到数值处理、时间推理、趋势分析以及上下文理解。然而，现有的评估基准往往依赖于完全合成的或通用的标注文本，而忽略了元数据与视觉信息的呈现。我们提出了CaTS-Bench这一综合性基准测试，该测试涵盖了11个不同的领域，以1746条由人类撰写的标注文本作为黄金标准评估集，用以衡量模型将数值趋势转化为易于理解的叙述的能力。为了解决人类标注数据的稀缺问题，我们还提出了一种可扩展的合成标注生成方法，并验证了其生成的高质量标注文本。我们在该基准测试中对主流的视觉语言模型进行了评估，发现即使是专有模型也难以准确捕捉时间描述中的数值细节；而在合成数据上对开源模型进行微调则能显著提升性能。最后，我们提供了包含910道选择题的诊断工具套件，并通过定制化的数值指标来评估时间序列特定推理能力，从而将CaTS-Bench确立为数值领域多模态文本生成的可靠基础。

papers.title: How do Visual Attributes Influence Web Agents? A Comprehensive Evaluation of User Interface Design Factors
papers.title_zh: 视觉元素如何影响网络代理程序？对用户界面设计因素的全面评估
papers.authors: Kuai Yu, Naicheng Yu, Han Wang, Rui Yang, Huan Zhang
papers.abstract: Web agents have demonstrated strong performance on a wide range of web-based tasks. However, existing research on the effect of environmental variation has mostly focused on robustness to adversarial attacks, with less attention to agents’ preferences in benign scenarios. Although early studies have examined how textual attributes influence agent behavior, a systematic understanding of how visual attributes shape agent decision-making remains limited. To address this, we introduce VAF, a controlled evaluation pipeline for quantifying how webpage Visual Attribute Factors influence web-agent decision-making. Specifically, VAF consists of three stages: (i) variant generation, which ensures the variants share identical semantics as the original item while only differ in visual attributes; (ii) browsing interaction, where agents navigate the page via scrolling and clicking the interested item, mirroring how human users browse online; (iii) validating through both click action and reasoning from agents, which we use the Target Click Rate and Target Mention Rate to jointly evaluate the effect of visual attributes. By quantitatively measuring the decision-making difference between the original and variant, we identify which visual attributes influence agents’ behavior most. Extensive experiments, across 8 variant families (48 variants total), 5 real-world websites (including shopping, travel, and news browsing), and 4 representative web agents, show that background color contrast, item size, position, and card clarity have a strong influence on agents’ actions, whereas font styling, text color, and item image clarity exhibit minor effects.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络代理在多种基于网络的任务中表现优异。然而，现有关于环境变化影响的研究大多集中在应对对抗性攻击的鲁棒性上，而对良性场景下代理的偏好关注较少。虽然早期研究已经探讨了文本属性如何影响代理行为，但关于视觉属性如何塑造代理决策的系统性理解仍然有限。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了VAF这一控制评估流程，用于量化网页视觉属性因素对网络代理决策的影响。具体来说，VAF包含三个阶段：(i) 变体生成，确保变体与原始项具有相同的语义，仅在视觉属性上有所不同；(ii) 浏览交互，代理通过滚动和点击感兴趣的内容来浏览页面，模拟人类在线浏览的行为；(iii) 通过点击行为和代理推理来验证效果，我们使用目标点击率和目标提及率来综合评估视觉属性的影响。通过定量测量原始版本与变体之间的决策差异，我们可以识别出哪些视觉属性对代理行为的影响最大。在8种变体家族（共48个变体）、5个真实世界网站（包括购物、旅游和新闻浏览）以及4种代表性网络代理的广泛实验表明，背景颜色对比度、项目大小、位置和卡片清晰度对代理行为有显著影响，而字体样式、文本颜色和项目图像清晰度则产生较小的影响。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Scaling Unverifiable Rewards: A Case Study on Visual Insights
papers.title_zh: 不可验证的奖励分配：以视觉洞察为案例的研究
papers.authors: Shuyu Gan, James Mooney, Pan Hao, Renxiang Wang, Mingyi Hong, Qianwen Wang, Dongyeop Kang
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can increasingly automate complex reasoning through Test-Time Scaling (TTS), an iterative refinement process guided by reward signals.However, many real-world tasks involve multi-stage pipelines whose final outcomes lack verifiable rewards or sufficient data to train robust reward models, making judge-based refinement prone to error accumulation across stages.We propose \textbf{Selective TTS}, a \textit{process-based refinement} framework that scales inference across stages of a multi-agent pipeline, instead of repeatedly refining a single output over time as in prior work.By distributing compute across stages and pruning low-quality branches early using process-specific judgers, Selective TTS mitigates the judge drift and stabilizes refinement.Grounded in a data science workflow, we build an end-to-end multi-agent pipeline for generating visually insightful reports from a given dataset, and design a reliable LLM-based judge model that aligns with human experts (Kendall’s \tau=0.55) to evaluate them.Our proposed selective TTS then improves insight quality under a fixed compute budget, increasing mean scores from \textbf{61.64} (baseline) to \textbf{65.86} while reducing variance.We hope our findings serve as the first step toward scaling complex, open-ended tasks with unverifiable rewards like scientific discovery. Our code and generated reports are publicly available at https://minnesotanlp.github.io/insight-scaling-webpage.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理可以通过“测试时间扩展”技术来自动化复杂的推理过程。这一迭代优化过程由奖励信号引导进行。然而，许多现实世界中的任务涉及多阶段流程，这些流程的最终结果缺乏可验证的奖励或足够的数据来训练出可靠的奖励模型，因此基于人工判定的优化过程容易在各个阶段出现错误累积的问题。我们提出了一种名为“选择性测试时间扩展”的优化框架，该框架能够跨多个代理流程的阶段进行推理优化，而不是像以往的工作那样反复优化单个输出结果。通过将计算资源分配到各个阶段，并使用特定于过程的判定器提前剪除质量低下的分支，选择性测试时间扩展能够有效避免判定偏差，并稳定优化过程。基于数据科学工作流程，我们构建了一个端到端的多智能体流程，用于从给定的数据集中生成具有视觉洞察力的报告。同时，我们还设计了一种可靠的基于LLM的判定模型，该模型与人类专家的判断标准保持一致（Kendall的τ=0.55），以评估这些报告的质量。我们的选择性测试时间扩展方法能够在固定的计算预算下提高洞察力的质量，将平均得分从61.64提高到65.86，同时降低了方差。我们希望我们的研究成果能够为类似科学发现这样具有复杂性和开放性、且缺乏可验证奖励的任务提供首个解决方案。我们的代码和生成的报告可以在https://minnesotanlp.github.io/insight-scaling-webpage上获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SilentDrift: Exploiting Action Chunking for Stealthy Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: SilentDrift：利用动作块处理技术对视觉-语言-动作模型实施隐蔽的后门攻击
papers.authors: Bingxin Xu, Yuzhang Shang, Binghui Wang, Emilio Ferrara
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly deployed in safety-critical robotic applications, yet their security vulnerabilities remain underexplored. We identify a fundamental security flaw in modern VLA systems: the combination of action chunking and delta pose representations creates an intra-chunk visual open-loop. This mechanism forces the robot to execute K-step action sequences, allowing per-step perturbations to accumulate through integration. We propose SilentDrift, a stealthy black-box backdoor attack exploiting this vulnerability. Our method employs the Smootherstep function to construct perturbations with guaranteed C^2 continuity, ensuring zero velocity and acceleration at trajectory boundaries to satisfy strict kinematic consistency constraints. Furthermore, our keyframe attack strategy selectively poisons only the critical approach phase, maximizing impact while minimizing trigger exposure. The resulting poisoned trajectories are visually indistinguishable from successful demonstrations. Evaluated on the LIBERO, SilentDrift achieves a 93.2% Attack Success Rate with a poisoning rate under 2%, while maintaining a 95.3% Clean Task Success Rate.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在安全性至关重要的机器人应用中得到了广泛应用，然而其安全漏洞却尚未得到充分研究。我们发现现代VLA系统存在一个根本性的安全缺陷：动作分块技术和增量姿态表示方式的结合导致了内部块的视觉开环现象。这种机制迫使机器人执行K步动作序列，从而让每一步的扰动通过累积效应逐渐产生影响。我们提出了SilentDrift这一隐蔽的黑盒后门攻击方法，该方法利用Smootherstep函数生成具有保证C^2连续性的扰动，从而在轨迹边界处实现零速度和加速度，从而满足严格的运动学一致性约束。此外，我们的关键帧攻击策略仅针对关键接近阶段进行攻击，从而最大化影响效果的同时最小化触发风险。经过处理的被攻击轨迹在视觉上无法与成功演示区分开来。在LIBERO测试集上的评估结果显示，SilentDrift的攻击成功率达到了93.2%，中毒率低于2%，而正常任务的成功率则达到了95.3%。

papers.title: X-ray Made Simple: Lay Radiology Report Generation and Robust Evaluation
papers.title_zh: X射线成像简说：分层生成放射学报告与稳健评估方法
papers.authors: Kun Zhao, Chenghao Xiao, Sixing Yan, Haoteng Tang, William K. Cheung, Noura Al Moubayed, Liang Zhan, Chenghua Lin
papers.abstract: While multimodal generative models have advanced radiology report generation (RRG), challenges remain in making reports accessible to patients and ensuring reliable evaluation. The technical language and templated nature of professional reports hinder patient comprehension and enable models to artificially boost lexical metrics such as BLEU by reproducing common report patterns. To address these limitations, we propose the Layman’s RRG framework, which leverages layperson-friendly language to enhance patient accessibility and promote more robust evaluation and report generation by encouraging models to focus on semantic accuracy over rigid templates. Our approach also introduces and releases two refined layman-style datasets (at the sentence and report levels), along with a semantics-based evaluation metric that mitigates inflated lexical scores and a layman-guided training strategy. Experiments show that training on layman-style data helps models better capture the meaning of clinical findings. Notably, we observe a positive scaling law: model performance improves with more layman-style data, in contrast to the inverse trend observed with templated professional language.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然多模态生成模型在放射学报告生成方面取得了显著进展，但在使报告易于患者理解以及确保评估的可靠性方面仍然存在挑战。专业报告的技术性语言和模板化特点阻碍了患者的理解能力，同时这些模式也使得模型能够人为地提高词汇指标，如BLEU分数，从而复制常见的报告结构。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了“非专业人士版放射学报告生成框架”。该框架采用通俗易懂的语言，以提高报告的可读性，并通过鼓励模型注重语义准确性而非僵化的模板结构，从而提升报告的评估质量。我们还开发了两个经过优化的非专业人士风格的数据集（分别针对句子级和报告级），并引入了一种基于语义的评估指标，以缓解词汇分数的夸大现象。此外，我们还采用了一种以非专业人士为导向的训练策略。实验表明，使用非专业人士风格的数据进行训练有助于模型更好地把握临床发现的含义。值得注意的是，我们发现了一个积极的扩展规律：随着非专业人士风格数据的增加，模型性能会得到提升，这与使用模板化专业语言时观察到的相反趋势形成了鲜明对比。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Not All Citations Are Equal:Entropy-Guided Citation Selection for Noise-Resistant Medical LLM
papers.title_zh: 并非所有引用都是平等的：基于熵理论的引文选择方法在对抗噪声的医学大语言模型中的应用
papers.authors: Minyu Gao, Hanlin Xiao, Ruoyu Wang, Shuai Yang, YeXuan Zhang, Xin Wu, Xingyu Liu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) provides external knowledge support for large language models (LLMs) in medical applications, but retrieved contexts often contain noisy or conflicting evidence that can degrade reasoning. We observe that when internal and external knowledge disagree, models systematically prefer external citations, inadvertently injecting retrieval noise. Our analyses further show that only a subset of retrieved citations consistently improves outcomes; these effective citations exhibit markedly lower token-level entropy, linking citation entropy to model accuracy. Building on these findings, we propose a complete pipeline consisting of a training-free multi-turn reasoning framework and a post-training methodology. The training-free framework elicits internal thought, external thought, and fusion thought, and applies conflict detection and explicit denoising for complex queries. For post-training, we distill structured supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data and apply GRPO with an entropy-based citation reward that encourages selective citation of beneficial external knowledge while penalizing noisy citations. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in noise-resistant medical reasoning, with larger improvements on harder cases.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）为大语言模型在医学应用中的推理提供了外部知识支持，但检索到的上下文往往包含噪声或相互矛盾的信息，这会降低推理效果。我们发现，当内部知识与外部知识出现分歧时，模型会系统性地偏好外部引用，从而无意中引入了检索噪声。我们的分析还表明，只有一部分检索到的引用能够持续改善模型性能；这些有效的引用在标记级熵方面表现更为出色，且引用熵与模型准确率之间存在关联。基于这些发现，我们提出了一个完整的解决方案：包括一个无需训练的多轮推理框架以及训练后的处理方法。这个无需训练的框架能够捕捉内部思维、外部思维以及两者的融合思维，并针对复杂查询进行冲突检测和处理。在训练后阶段，我们采用结构化的监督微调数据，并结合基于熵的引用奖励机制，以鼓励选择性引用有益的外部知识，同时惩罚含有噪声的引用。在不同基准测试中的实验表明，这种方法在提高医学推理的抗噪能力方面具有显著效果，尤其是在难度较高的任务中表现更为突出。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Decomposing Unitization and Typing for Efficient and Consistent Span-Bound Concept Annotation
papers.title_zh: 分解式单元化与类型标注，以实现高效且一致的跨度边界概念标注
papers.authors: Nupoor Gandhi, Michael Bada, Emma Strubell
papers.abstract: In specialized domains that require expert annotators and high inter-annotator agreement, high-quality datasets with span-bound semantic concept annotations remain expensive to develop. Substantial resources are typically spent on \textit{unitizing}, the task of identifying precise span boundaries for entity mentions. Unitizing is a significant source of inter-annotator disagreement, a poor use of expensive domain expertise, and very time-consuming. We propose a lighter annotation procedure that concentrates manual efforts on typed position annotations, marking positions in the text that overlap with mentions of each entity type, abstracting away span boundary decisions. With as few as 100-200 example sentences, we train span boundary detection models to unitize typed position annotations. Through evaluation over three datasets: CRAFT (biomedical), GENIA (molecular biology), and POLIANNA (climate/energy policy text), we demonstrate that (1) annotating typed positions in the text instead of full concept annotation is a more efficient use of time in low-resource settings, and (2) model-inferred span boundaries result in higher agreement at both the annotator training and corpus annotation phases, without sacrificing utility.
papers.abstract_zh: 在需要专业注释员且要求注释者之间一致性较高的专业领域里，开发包含有边界明确的语义概念注释的高质量数据集是非常昂贵的。通常，大量资源会被用于“单位化”工作，即确定各个实体提及内容的精确边界。单位化是注释者之间产生分歧的一个重要原因，它浪费了宝贵的领域专业知识，而且过程非常耗时。我们提出了一种更轻量的注释方法，将人工工作集中在类型位置注释上，标记出与每个实体类型相关的文本中的重叠位置，从而省略了边界判断的繁琐过程。只需100到200个示例句子，我们就可以训练出用于判断边界的模型。通过对三个数据集进行评估：CRAFT（生物医学领域）、GENIA（分子生物学领域）和POLIANNA（气候/能源政策文本），我们发现：（1）在资源有限的情况下，对文本中的类型位置进行注释而不是对整个概念进行注释，能够更有效地利用时间；（2）模型推断出的边界在注释员培训和语料库标注两个阶段都能实现更高的一致性，同时不会牺牲其实用性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: InsightEval: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Assessing Insight Discovery in LLM-Driven Data Agents
papers.title_zh: InsightEval：一个由专家精心挑选的基准测试集，用于评估基于大语言模型的数据代理在洞察发现方面的能力
papers.authors: Zhenghao Zhu, Yuanfeng Song, Xing Chen, Chengzhong Liu, Cui Yakun, Caleb Chen Cao, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: Data analysis has become an indispensable part of scientific research. To discover the latent knowledge and insights hidden within massive datasets, we need to perform deep exploratory analysis to realize their full value. With the advent of large language models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems, more and more researchers are making use of these technologies for insight discovery. However, there are few benchmarks for evaluating insight discovery capabilities. As one of the most comprehensive existing frameworks, InsightBench also suffers from many critical flaws: format inconsistencies, poorly conceived objectives, and redundant insights. These issues may significantly affect the quality of data and the evaluation of agents. To address these issues, we thoroughly investigate shortcomings in InsightBench and propose essential criteria for a high-quality insight benchmark. Regarding this, we develop a data-curation pipeline to construct a new dataset named InsightEval. We further introduce a novel metric to measure the exploratory performance of agents. Through extensive experiments on InsightEval, we highlight prevailing challenges in automated insight discovery and raise some key findings to guide future research in this promising direction.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据分析已成为科学研究中不可或缺的一部分。为了从庞大的数据集中发现隐藏的知识和见解，我们需要进行深入的探索性分析，以充分挖掘其价值。随着大语言模型和多智能体系统的出现，越来越多的研究人员开始利用这些技术来发现新的见解。然而，目前用于评估见解发现能力的基准尚不多见。作为现有最全面的框架之一，InsightBench也存在许多严重的问题：格式不一致、目标设定不合理以及见解内容重复等问题。这些问题可能会严重影响数据的质量和智能体的评估效果。为了解决这些问题，我们深入调查了InsightBench的不足之处，并提出了构建高质量见解基准的标准。在此基础上，我们开发了一套数据整理流程，从而创建了一个名为InsightEval的新数据集。我们还引入了一种新的指标来衡量智能体的探索性能。通过对InsightEval进行的广泛实验，我们揭示了自动化见解发现过程中存在的挑战，并得出了一些关键结论，为未来在这一领域的研究提供了指导。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ArrowGEV: Grounding Events in Video via Learning the Arrow of Time
papers.title_zh: ArrowGEV：通过理解时间之箭来揭示视频中的“地面事件”
papers.authors: Fangxu Yu, Ziyao Lu, Liqiang Niu, Fandong Meng, Jie Zhou
papers.abstract: Grounding events in videos serves as a fundamental capability in video analysis. While Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly employed for this task, existing approaches predominantly train models to associate events with timestamps in the forward video only. This paradigm hinders VLMs from capturing the inherent temporal structure and directionality of events, thereby limiting robustness and generalization. To address this limitation, inspired by the arrow of time in physics, which characterizes the intrinsic directionality of temporal processes, we propose ArrowGEV, a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly models temporal directionality in events to improve both event grounding and temporal directionality understanding in VLMs. Specifically, we categorize events into time-sensitive (e.g., putting down a bag) and time-insensitive (e.g., holding a towel in the left hand). The former denote events whose reversal substantially alters their meaning, while the latter remain semantically unchanged under reversal. For time-sensitive events, ArrowGEV introduces a reward that encourages VLMs to discriminate between forward and backward videos, whereas for time-insensitive events, it enforces consistent grounding across both directions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ArrowGEV not only improves grounding precision and temporal directionality recognition, but also enhances general video understanding and reasoning ability.
papers.abstract_zh: 在视频分析中，事件定位是一项基本功能。虽然视觉语言模型在这一任务中的应用越来越广泛，但现有的方法通常只训练模型来将事件与视频中的时间戳关联起来。这种范式限制了视觉语言模型捕捉事件的内在时间结构和方向性，从而影响了模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。为了克服这一限制，我们借鉴了物理学中描述时间过程内在方向性的“时间箭头”概念，提出了ArrowGEV这一强化学习框架。该框架能够明确模拟事件的时间方向性，从而提升视觉语言模型对事件的定位和时间方向性的理解能力。具体来说，我们将事件分为时间敏感型（例如放下包）和时间不敏感型（例如左手持毛巾）。前者指的是那些反转后会显著改变其意义的事件，而后者则在其反转后语义保持不变。对于时间敏感型事件，ArrowGEV引入了奖励机制，促使视觉语言模型区分视频的正向和反向内容；而对于时间不敏感型事件，则确保两种方向的事件都能被准确定位。大量实验表明，ArrowGEV不仅提升了事件定位的准确性和时间方向性的识别能力，还增强了视觉语言模型的整体视频理解和推理能力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Multi-lingual Functional Evaluation for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 适用于大型语言模型的多语言功能评估
papers.authors: Victor Ojewale, Inioluwa Deborah Raji, Suresh Venkatasubramanian
papers.abstract: Multi-lingual competence in large language models is often evaluated via static data benchmarks such as Belebele, M-MMLU and M-GSM. However, these evaluations often fail to provide an adequate understanding of the practical performance and robustness of models across multi-lingual settings. In response, we create multi-lingual functional benchmarks – Cross-Lingual Grade School Math Symbolic (CL-GSM Symbolic) and Cross-Lingual Instruction-Following Eval (CL-IFEval)– by translating existing functional benchmark templates from English to five additional languages that span the range of resources available for NLP: French, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic and Yoruba. Our results show that the gap between static and functional evaluations is highly uneven: across models, performance drops from M-GSM to CL-GSM Symbolic by 24%, 17%, and 18% in English, French, and Spanish, while the drop from Belebele to CL-IFEval ranges from 15% to 24% across languages, and the drop from M-MMLU to CL-IFEval is much smaller (0.5% to 3%).Similarly, we find that model robustness across languages varies significantly, with certain languages (eg. Arabic, English) being the most consistently well performing across evaluation iterations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的多语言能力通常通过静态数据基准来评估，例如Belebele、M-MMLU和M-GSM等。然而，这些评估往往无法充分反映模型在多种语言环境中的实际性能和鲁棒性。为此，我们创建了多语言功能基准——Cross-Lingual Grade School Math Symbolic（CL-GSM Symbolic）和Cross-Lingual Instruction-Following Eval（CL-IFEval）——通过将现有的功能基准模板从英语翻译成五种其他语言，这五种语言涵盖了自然语言处理领域可用的各种资源：法语、西班牙语、印地语、阿拉伯语和约鲁巴语。我们的结果显示，静态评估和功能评估之间的差距非常明显：在不同模型中，性能从M-GSM下降到CL-GSM Symbolic的下降幅度分别为24%、17%和18%，而从Belebele到CL-IFEval的下降幅度则在不同语言之间有所波动，范围在15%到24%之间；而从M-MMLU到CL-IFEval的下降幅度则小得多，为0.5%到3%。同样，我们发现模型在不同语言中的鲁棒性也有显著差异，某些语言（如阿拉伯语、英语）在多次评估中表现最为稳定。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Why LoRA Fails to Forget: Regularized Low-Rank Adaptation Against Backdoors in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 为什么LoRA无法遗忘：一种针对语言模型中后门问题的正则化低秩适应方法
papers.authors: Hoang-Chau Luong, Lingwei Chen
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is widely used for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models, but it is notably ineffective at removing backdoor behaviors from poisoned pretrained models when fine-tuning on clean dataset. Contrary to the common belief that this weakness is caused primarily by low rank, we show that LoRA’s vulnerability is fundamentally spectral. Our analysis identifies two key factors: LoRA updates (i) possess insufficient spectral strength, with singular values far below those of pretrained weights, and (ii) exhibit unfavorable spectral alignment, weakly matching clean-task directions while retaining overlap with trigger-sensitive subspaces. We further establish a critical scaling threshold beyond which LoRA can theoretically suppress trigger-induced activations, and we show empirically that standard LoRA rarely reaches this regime. We introduce Regularized Low-Rank Adaptation (RoRA), which improves forgetting by increasing spectral strength and correcting alignment through clean-strengthened regularization, trigger-insensitive constraints, and post-training spectral rescaling. Experiments across multiple NLP benchmarks and attack settings show that RoRA substantially reduces attack success rates while maintaining clean accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）被广泛用于大语言模型的参数高效微调，但在在干净数据集上进行微调时，它对于消除被注入后门行为的预训练模型效果不佳。与普遍认为这一缺陷主要源于低秩性的观点不同，我们发现LoRA的脆弱性本质上是基于谱特性的。我们的分析指出了两个关键因素：LoRA的更新（i）缺乏足够的谱特性强度，其特征值远低于预训练权重的值；（ii）其谱特性对齐效果较差，无法很好地匹配干净任务的方向，同时仍与触发敏感的子空间存在重叠。我们进一步确定了LoRA理论上能够抑制触发引起的激活的一个关键缩放阈值，并通过实验表明，标准LoRA很少能达到这个阈值。我们提出了正则化低秩适应（RoRA），它通过增强谱特性强度、通过加强正则化的干净任务方向、设置不敏感的触发约束以及训练后的谱特性重新缩放，来改善遗忘效果。在多个自然语言处理基准测试和攻击场景下的实验表明，RoRA显著降低了攻击的成功率，同时保持了干净的准确率。

papers.title: BoundRL: Efficient Token-level Structured Text Segmentation through Reinforced Boundary Generation
papers.title_zh: BoundRL：通过强化边界生成实现高效的令牌级结构化文本分割
papers.authors: Haoyuan Li, Zhengyuan Shen, Sullam Jeoung, Yueyan Chen, Jiayu Li, Qi Zhu, Shuai Wang, Vassilis N. Ioannidis, Huzefa Rangwala
papers.abstract: Structured texts – from technical reports to AI prompts – increasingly require segmentation into semantically meaningful components. Such texts often contain elements beyond plain language, such as code snippets, which conventional sentence-level segmentation methods cannot handle effectively. To address this, we propose BoundRL, a novel approach that jointly performs efficient token-level text segmentation and label prediction for long structured texts. Instead of generating full texts for each segment, it generates only starting tokens and reconstructs the complete texts by locating these tokens within the original texts, thereby reducing inference costs by 90% and minimizing hallucination. To train the models for the boundary generation, BoundRL performs reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) that jointly optimizes document reconstruction fidelity and semantic alignment. It further mitigates entropy collapse by constructing intermediate candidates by perturbing segment boundaries and labels to create stepping stones toward higher-quality solutions. Experiments show that BoundRL enables small language models (1.7B parameters) to outperform few-shot prompting with much larger models as well as SFT and standard RLVR baselines on complex prompts used for LLM applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 结构化文本——从技术报告到人工智能提示语——越来越需要被分割成具有语义意义的组成部分。这类文本通常包含超出普通语言范畴的元素，比如代码片段，而传统的句子级分割方法无法有效处理这些元素。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了BoundRL这一创新方法。该方法能够同时实现高效的分词级文本分割和标签预测功能，适用于长结构文本的处理。与为每个段落生成完整文本不同，该方法仅生成起始标记，并通过在原始文本中定位这些标记来重构完整的文本，从而将推理成本降低90%，并最大限度地减少幻觉现象的产生。在边界生成方面，BoundRL采用带有可验证奖励的强化学习机制（RLVR），从而同时优化文档重建的准确性和语义一致性。此外，该方法还通过扰动段落边界和标签来构建中间候选方案，为获得更高质量的解决方案打下基础，从而缓解熵崩溃问题。实验表明，BoundRL使得小型语言模型（1.7B参数）能够在复杂的提示语下，超越那些参数数量巨大的模型，以及SFT和标准RLVR基线模型的表现。

papers.title: AOT*: Efficient Synthesis Planning via LLM-Empowered AND-OR Tree Search
papers.title_zh: AOT*：利用大语言模型支持的AND-OR树搜索算法，实现高效的合成规划
papers.authors: Xiaozhuang Song, Xuanhao Pan, Xinjian Zhao, Hangting Ye, Shufei Zhang, Jian Tang, Tianshu Yu
papers.abstract: Retrosynthesis planning enables the discovery of viable synthetic routes for target molecules, playing a crucial role in domains like drug discovery and materials design. Multi-step retrosynthetic planning remains computationally challenging due to exponential search spaces and inference costs. While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate chemical reasoning capabilities, their application to synthesis planning faces constraints on efficiency and cost. To address these challenges, we introduce AOT*, a framework that transforms retrosynthetic planning by integrating LLM-generated chemical synthesis pathways with systematic AND-OR tree search. To this end, AOT* maps the generated complete synthesis routes onto AND-OR tree components, with a mathematically sound design of reward assignment strategy and retrieval-based context engineering, thus enabling LLMs to efficiently navigate in the chemical space. Experimental evaluation on multiple synthesis benchmarks demonstrates that AOT* achieves SOTA performance with significantly improved search efficiency. AOT* exhibits competitive solve rates using 3-5\times fewer iterations than existing LLM-based approaches, with the performance advantage becoming more pronounced on complex molecular targets. Our code is available at https://github.com/ShawnKS/AOTstar.
papers.abstract_zh: 逆合成规划能够发现目标分子的可行合成路线，在药物发现和材料设计等领域发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，由于搜索空间呈指数级增长以及推理成本较高，多步逆合成规划在计算上仍然具有挑战性。虽然大语言模型具备化学推理能力，但将其应用于合成规划时，效率与成本方面仍存在限制。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AOT*框架。该框架通过将语言模型生成的化学合成路径与系统的AND-OR树搜索相结合，实现了逆合成规划的优化。具体来说，AOT*将生成的完整合成路线映射到AND-OR树的各个节点上，并通过科学合理的奖励分配策略以及基于检索的上下文处理技术，使语言模型能够在化学空间中高效地进行搜索。在多个合成基准测试中的实验结果表明，AOT*取得了卓越的性能表现，其搜索效率也得到了显著提升。与现有的基于语言模型的方法相比，AOT*在解决复杂分子目标时所需的迭代次数减少了3到5倍，其性能优势更为明显。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/ShawnKS/AOTstar下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AutoSUIT Bench - Automated Security UnIt Test Benchmark for LLM Coding
papers.title_zh: AutoSUIT Bench——一种用于LLM编码的自动化安全设备测试基准工具
papers.authors: Samuel Osebe, Fan Yang, Junyi Li, Yue Gu, Yongxin Wang, Satyapriya Krishna, Kai-Wei Chang, Aram Galstyan, Rahul Gupta, Weitong Ruan
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are evolving rapidly on code generation tasks. While it is important to evaluate their code generation accuracy, ensuring they follow responsible practices is equally critical. Some of the previous works use tools such as CodeQL to match patterns against Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE), suffering from high error rate, while others rely on human annotation to only focus on top CWE categories, limiting security coverage. We propose AutoSUIT Bench, which addresses these limitations through a paradigm to automate the vulnerable code benchmark creation with iterative auto validation. As a result, our benchmark covers 232 CWE categories across C/C++, Java, and Python languages and is designed to evaluate on four coding tasks: (i) code generation, (ii) generation with CWE context, (iii) security patching, and (iv) code completion. Upon benchmarking against LLMs, we found that functionality pass rate is consistently higher than vulnerability pass rate for all programming languages. One notable observation from our benchmark is that LLMs perform well on top CWEs while lacks on others down the list. This highlights the necessity of vulnerable code benchmarks with larger CWE coverage.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成任务上发展迅速。虽然评估其代码生成的准确性非常重要，但确保它们遵循负责任的操作方式同样至关重要。一些先前的研究使用诸如CodeQL这样的工具来将模式与常见弱点枚举表进行匹配，但这会导致较高的错误率。而另一些研究则依赖人工注释，仅关注最关键的几个常见弱点类别，这限制了安全性的覆盖范围。我们提出的AutoSUIT Bench通过一种自动化脆弱代码基准测试的方法解决了这些问题，该方法采用迭代式自动验证机制。因此，我们的基准测试涵盖了C/C++、Java和Python三种编程语言中的232个常见弱点类别，并且可以针对四种编码任务进行评估：(i) 代码生成；(ii) 在常见弱点枚举表上下文下的代码生成；(iii) 安全补丁应用；以及(iv) 代码补全。通过与大语言模型进行基准测试，我们发现对于所有编程语言来说，功能通过率始终高于漏洞通过率。我们的基准测试还有一个值得注意的现象：大语言模型在最重要的常见弱点上的表现较好，但在其他较次要的弱点上则表现较差。这凸显了需要具有更广泛常见弱点覆盖范围的脆弱代码基准测试的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AnchorMem: Anchored Facts with Associative Contexts for Building Memory in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: AnchorMem：利用关联上下文来固定事实信息，从而帮助大型语言模型构建记忆机制
papers.authors: Zhanyu Shen, Sijie Cheng, Zhicheng Guo, Weiqin Wang, Yile Wang, Hui Huang
papers.abstract: While large language models have achieved remarkable performance in complex tasks, they still need a memory system to utilize historical experience in long-term interactions. Existing memory methods (e.g., A-Mem, Mem0) place excessive emphasis on organizing interactions by frequently rewriting them, however, this heavy reliance on summarization risks diluting essential contextual nuances and obscuring key retrieval features. To bridge this gap, we introduce AnchorMem, a novel memory framework inspired by the Proust Phenomenon in cognitive science, where a specific anchor triggers a holistic recollection. We propose a method that decouples the retrieval unit from the generation context. AnchorMem extracts atomic facts from interaction history to serve as retrieval anchors, while preserving the original context as the immutable context. To reveal implicit narrative cues, we construct an associative event graph that uses higher-order event links that bind sets of related facts into shared event representations, strengthening cross-memory integration without relying on generic entities as bridges. During retrieval, the system anchors queries to specific facts and events to locate relevant memories, but reconstructs the context using the associated raw chunks and events. Our method reconciles fine-grained retrieval with the contextual integrity of interactions. Experiments across three closed-source and open-source models on the LoCoMo benchmark demonstrate that AnchorMem significantly outperforms baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在复杂任务中取得了显著的性能表现，但它们仍然需要记忆系统来利用长期互动中的历史经验。现有的记忆方法（如A-Mem、Mem0）过于强调通过频繁重写来组织互动信息，但这种对总结的过度依赖可能会淡化重要的上下文细节，并掩盖关键的检索特征。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了AnchorMem这一新颖的记忆框架，它借鉴了认知科学中的普洛斯特现象，通过特定的锚点触发全面的回忆。我们提出了一种方法，将检索单元与生成上下文分离开来。AnchorMem从互动历史中提取原子性事实作为检索锚点，同时保留原始上下文作为不可变的背景信息。为了揭示隐含的叙事线索，我们构建了一个关联事件图，该图使用更高层次的事件链接将相关事实集合绑定到共享的事件表示中，从而加强跨记忆的整合，而无需依赖通用实体作为桥梁。在检索过程中，系统将查询指向特定的事实和事件，以定位相关的记忆，但会使用相关的原始数据和事件来重构上下文。我们的方法实现了细粒度的检索与互动的上下文完整性之间的平衡。在LoCoMo基准测试上，我们对三个开源和闭源模型进行了实验验证，结果表明AnchorMem的性能明显优于基线方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Filling in the Mechanisms: How do LMs Learn Filler-Gap Dependencies under Developmental Constraints?
papers.title_zh: 填充机制：在发展限制条件下，猎物管理者如何学习填充间隙的行为模式？
papers.authors: Atrey Desai, Sathvik Nair
papers.abstract: For humans, filler-gap dependencies require a shared representation across different syntactic constructions. Although causal analyses suggest this may also be true for LLMs (Boguraev et al., 2025), it is still unclear if such a representation also exists for language models trained on developmentally feasible quantities of data. We applied Distributed Alignment Search (DAS, Geiger et al. (2024)) to checkpoints of a language model from the BabyLM challenge (Warstadt et al., 2023), to evaluate whether representations of filler-gap dependencies transfer between wh-questions and topicalization, which greatly vary in terms of their input frequency. Our results suggest shared, yet item-sensitive mechanisms may develop with limited training data. More importantly, LMs still require far more data than humans to learn comparable generalizations, highlighting the need for language-specific biases in models of language acquisition.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于人类来说，填充词-间隔依赖关系需要在不同的句法结构之间共享表示方式。虽然因果分析表明这一点也可能适用于大语言模型（Boguraev等人，2025年），但尚不清楚这种表示方式是否也存在于在可接受的训练数据量下训练出的语言模型中。我们采用了分布式对齐搜索算法（Geiger等人，2024年）来对比BabyLM挑战赛中的语言模型检查点数据，以评估填充词-间隔依赖关系的表示方式是否能在疑问句和主题化表达之间传递——这两种表达方式在输入频率上有着很大的差异。我们的结果表明，即使训练数据有限，也可能存在共享的、但针对具体项目的表示机制。更重要的是，语言模型需要比人类更多的数据才能学习到类似的概括性规律，这凸显了在语言习得模型中引入语言特异性偏见的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PictoEduca: Building a Dataset for Spanish Text-to-Pictogram Generation
papers.title_zh: PictoEduca：构建用于西班牙语文本转图像生成的数据集
papers.authors: Alfonso Manuel Paredes Umeres, Marco Antonio Sobrevilla Cabezudo
papers.abstract: We present PictoEduca, the first large-scale Spanish text-to-pictogram dataset for augmentative and alternative communication (AAC), derived from primary educational materials and grounded in the ARASAAC pictogram repository. The dataset is released with a reproducible pipeline that combines automatic annotation with targeted expert correction, supporting scalable and high-quality corpus construction. We benchmark a rule-based system (ARAWORD) and neural models (T5, LLaMA) under direct text-to-pictogram and two-stage text-to-concept-to-pictogram settings. Results show that the rule-based system remains a strong baseline, while neural models benefit from explicit semantic abstraction, with the two-stage approach improving semantic coherence and reducing ambiguity. We further explore data selection strategies, demonstrating that combining domain similarity with a quality signal yields higher-quality silver data, reduces annotation effort, and improves model performance in low-resource regimes. PictoEduca enables reproducible evaluation and advances Spanish text-to-pictogram research.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了PictoEduca，这是首个大规模的西班牙语文本到象形文字数据集，用于辅助和替代沟通（AAC）领域。该数据集源自于基础教育材料，并基于ARASAAC象形文字库构建。该数据集附带了一个可复现的标注流程，该流程结合了自动标注与专家针对性修正，从而支持大规模且高质量的语料库建设。我们对基于规则的系统（ARAWORD）以及神经模型（T5、LLaMA）在直接文本到象形文字以及两阶段文本到概念再到象形文字的转换场景下的性能进行了评估。结果表明，基于规则的系统仍然是一个强大的基准方案，而神经模型则受益于明确的语义抽象处理；两阶段方法则提升了语义连贯性并减少了歧义性。我们还探讨了数据选择策略，发现结合领域相似性与质量信号能够产生更高质量的数据，减少标注工作量，并在资源有限的情况下提升模型性能。PictoEduca为可复现的评估提供了可能，并推动了西班牙语文本到象形文字领域的研究进展。

papers.title: HCFD: A Benchmark for Audio Deepfake Detection in Healthcare
papers.title_zh: HCFD：医疗领域音频深度伪造检测的基准模型
papers.authors: Mohd Mujtaba Akhtar, Girish, Muskaan Singh
papers.abstract: In this study, we present Healthcare Codec-Fake Detection (HCFD), a new task for detecting codec-fakes under pathological speech conditions. We intentionally focus on codec based synthetic speech in this work, since neural codec decoding forms a core building block in modern speech generation pipelines. First, we release Healthcare CodecFake, the first pathology-aware dataset containing paired real and NAC-synthesized speech across multiple clinical conditions and codec families. Our evaluations show that SOTA codec-fake detectors trained primarily on healthy speech perform poorly on Healthcare CodecFake, highlighting the need for HCFD-specific models. Second, we demonstrate that PaSST outperforms existing speech-based models for HCFD, benefiting from its patch-based spectro-temporal representation. Finally, we propose PHOENIX-Mamba, a geometry-aware framework that models codec-fakes as multiple self-discovered modes in hyperbolic space and achieves the strongest performance on HCFD across clinical conditions and codecs. Experiments on HCFK show that PHOENIX-Mamba (PaSST) achieves the best overall performance, reaching 97.04 Acc on E-Dep, 96.73 on E-Alz, and 96.57 on E-Dys, while maintaining strong results on Chinese with 94.41 (Dep), 94.40 (Alz), and 93.20 (Dys). This geometry-aware formulation enables self-discovered clustering of heterogeneous codec-fake modes in hyperbolic space, facilitating robust discrimination under pathological speech variability. PHOENIX-Mamba achieves topmost performance on the HCFD task across clinical conditions and codecs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了 Healthcare Codec-Fake Detection（HCFD）这一新任务，旨在检测在异常语音条件下的编码解码器伪造现象。我们特意将研究重点放在基于编码解码器的合成语音上，因为神经编码解码器是现代语音生成流程中的核心组成部分。首先，我们发布了 Healthcare CodecFake，这是第一个包含多种临床条件和编码解码器家族中真实语音与合成语音配对的、具有病理意识的数据集。我们的评估结果显示，那些主要基于健康语音训练出的最先进的编码解码器伪造检测模型在 Healthcare CodecFake上的表现不佳，这凸显了需要针对 HCFD 的特定模型。其次，我们证明 PaSST 在 HCFD 任务上优于现有的基于语音的模型，因为它采用了基于补丁的频谱-时间表示方式。最后，我们提出了 PHOENIX-Mamba 这一基于几何学的框架，该框架将编码解码器伪造现象建模为双曲空间中的多个自发现模式，并在各种临床条件和编码解码器环境下取得了最佳性能。在 HCFK 上的实验表明，PHOENIX-Mamba（PaSST）在 E-Dep 任务上达到了最高的准确率，分别为 97.04%、96.73% 和 96.57%；而在中文语音任务上则取得了 94.41%、94.40% 和 93.20% 的准确率。这种基于几何学的建模方式能够使得双曲空间中异质编码解码器伪造模式的自发现聚类成为可能，从而在异常语音条件下实现稳健的识别。PHOENIX-Mamba 在各种临床条件和编码解码器环境下都展现了最佳的 HCFD 任务性能。

papers.title: Linear Semantic Segmentation for Low-Resource Spoken Dialects
papers.title_zh: 用于低资源口语方言的线性语义分割技术
papers.authors: Kirill Chirkunov, Younes Samih, Abed Alhakim Freihat, Hanan Aldarmaki
papers.abstract: Semantic segmentation is a core component of discourse analysis, yet existing models are primarily developed and evaluated on high-resource written text, limiting their effectiveness on low-resource conversational varieties. In particular, dialectal Arabic exhibits informal syntax, code-switching, and weakly marked discourse structure that challenge standard semantic segmentation approaches for text. In this paper, we introduce a new multi-genre benchmark (more than 1000 samples) for semantic segmentation in Arabic, focusing on dialectal discourse. The benchmark covers casual telephone conversations, code-switched podcasts, expressive dialogue, and broadcast news, and was annotated and validated by native Arabic annotators. Using this benchmark, we show that segmentation models performing well on MSA news genres degrade on dialectal conversational texts. We further propose a segmentation model that targets local semantic coherence and robustness to discourse discontinuities, consistently outperforming strong baselines on dialectal non-news genres. The benchmark and approach generalize to other low-resource spoken languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 语义分割是话语分析的核心组成部分，然而现有的模型大多是在高资源书面文本上开发和评估的，这限制了它们在低资源对话语变体上的有效性。特别是，方言阿拉伯语具有非正式的句法结构、语码转换以及缺乏明确标记的话语结构，这些特点使得标准的语义分割方法难以适用于这种语言。在本文中，我们引入了一个新的多体裁基准数据集（包含超过1000个样本），该数据集专门用于阿拉伯语的语义分割，重点关注方言话语。这个基准数据集涵盖了随意的电话交谈、混合语码的播客、富有表现力的对话以及广播新闻，并且由母语为阿拉伯语的标注者进行注释和验证。通过使用该基准数据集，我们发现，那些在MSA新闻体裁上表现良好的分割模型，在方言对话文本上的性能却有所下降。我们进一步提出了一种分割模型，该模型注重局部语义连贯性以及对话语中断的鲁棒性，并且在方言非新闻体裁上始终优于其他强大的基线模型。该基准数据集及方法也适用于其他低资源的口语语言。
