papers.title: Thinking Like a Botanist: Challenging Multimodal Language Models with Intent Driven Chain-of-Inquiry
papers.title_zh: 像植物学家一样思考：用基于意图的链式探究方法挑战多模态语言模型
papers.authors: Syed Nazmus Sakib, Nafiul Haque, Shahrear Bin Amin, Hasan Muhammad Abdullah, Md Mehedi Hasan, Mohammad Zabed Hossain, Shifat E. Arman
papers.abstract: Vision evaluations are typically done through multi-step processes. In most contemporary fields, experts analyze images using structured, evidence-based adaptive questioning. In plant pathology, botanists inspect leaf images, identify visual cues, infer diagnostic intent, and probe further with targeted questions that adapt to species, symptoms, and severity. This structured probing is crucial for accurate disease diagnosis and treatment formulation. Yet current vision-language models are evaluated on single-turn question answering. To address this gap, we introduce PlantInquiryVQA, a benchmark for studying multi-step, intent-driven visual reasoning in botanical diagnosis. We formalize a Chain of Inquiry framework modeling diagnostic trajectories as ordered question-answer sequences conditioned on grounded visual cues and explicit epistemic intent. We release a dataset of 24,964 expert-curated plant images and 138,078 question-answer pairs annotated with visual grounding, severity labels, and domain-specific reasoning templates. Evaluations on top-tier Multimodal Large Language Models reveal that while they describe visual symptoms adequately, they struggle with safe clinical reasoning and accurate diagnosis. Importantly, structured question-guided inquiry significantly improves diagnostic correctness, reduces hallucination, and increases reasoning efficiency. PlantInquiryVQA provides a foundation for training diagnostic agents that reason like expert botanists rather than static classifiers.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉评估通常是通过多步骤的过程来完成的。在大多数现代领域，专家使用结构化、基于证据的适应性提问方式来分析图像。在植物病理学领域，植物学家会检查叶片图像，识别视觉线索，推断诊断意图，并通过针对特定物种、症状和严重程度的问题进一步进行探究。这种结构化的探究对于准确诊断疾病和制定治疗方案至关重要。然而，目前的视觉语言模型都是基于单轮问答来评估的。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了PlantInquiryVQA这个基准测试，用于研究在植物诊断中多步骤、以意图为导向的视觉推理能力。我们定义了一个“探究链”框架，将诊断过程建模为一系列有序的问答序列，这些问答序列是基于具体的视觉线索和明确的知识意图来确定的。我们提供了一个包含24,964张由专家精心挑选的植物图像以及138,078对带有视觉定位、严重程度标签和领域特定推理模板的问答对的数据集。对顶级多模态大语言模型的评估显示，虽然它们能够充分描述视觉症状，但在安全临床推理和准确诊断方面存在困难。重要的是，结构化的问题引导式探究显著提高了诊断的准确性，减少了幻觉现象，并提升了推理效率。PlantInquiryVQA为训练能够像专业植物学家一样进行推理的诊断系统提供了基础，而不是仅仅作为静态的分类器。

papers.title: Analysing Differences in Persuasive Language in LLM-Generated Text: Uncovering Stereotypical Gender Patterns
papers.title_zh: 分析大语言模型生成文本中说服性语言的差异：揭示性别刻板印象的痕迹
papers.authors: Amalie Brogaard Pauli, Maria Barrett, Max Müller-Eberstein, Isabelle Augenstein, Ira Assent
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for everyday communication tasks, including drafting interpersonal messages intended to influence and persuade. Prior work has shown that LLMs can successfully persuade humans and amplify persuasive language. It is therefore essential to understand how user instructions affect the generation of persuasive language, and to understand whether the generated persuasive language differs, for example, when targeting different groups. In this work, we propose a framework for evaluating how persuasive language generation is affected by recipient gender, sender intent, or output language. We evaluate 13 LLMs and 16 languages using pairwise prompt instructions. We evaluate model responses on 19 categories of persuasive language using an LLM-as-judge setup grounded in social psychology and communication science. Our results reveal significant gender differences in the persuasive language generated across all models. These patterns reflect biases consistent with gender-stereotypical linguistic tendencies documented in social psychology and sociolinguistics.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在日常交流任务中被越来越多地使用，包括起草旨在影响和说服他人的信息。先前的研究表明，大语言模型能够成功地说服人类，并增强有说服力的语言效果。因此，了解用户指令如何影响有说服力的语言的生成方式非常重要，同时还需要了解生成的具有说服力的语言在不同目标群体之间是否存在差异。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个框架，用于评估受话者性别、发送者的意图或输出语言对有说服力语言生成的影响。我们测试了13种大语言模型和16种语言，通过成对提示指令来进行评估。我们使用基于社会心理学和传播科学的“语言模型作为裁判”的方法，对19个类别的有说服力语言进行模型响应评估。我们的研究结果揭示了所有模型中生成的具有说服力语言在性别方面的显著差异。这些模式反映了与社会心理学和社会语言学中所记录的性别刻板印象相关的语言倾向。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Robust In-Context Selection via Online Learned Position-Corrected Attention
papers.title_zh: 通过在线学习的方法实现稳健的上下文选择，利用位置校正注意力机制
papers.authors: Deeksha Koul, Gaurav Kumar, Yash Sabale, Sunita Sarawagi
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are often deployed in tasks that require selecting an item from a long list provided in the model’s context. LLMs’ native selection behavior is brittle: predictions are sensitive to the surface form of the identifiers, their placement within the context, and the ordering of candidate items. We present OLR-Heads, a robust method for list selection that harnesses attention patterns available from a single forward call on the LLM. OLR-Heads learns the logic for item selection using a few in-context examples, and a simple online position-debiasing mechanism to correct attention distortion. Across multiple database and tool selection benchmarks, OLR-Heads consistently improves selection performance over direct generation and prior attention-based methods, while remaining robust to prompt variations and item ordering.The LLM’s KV cache states are unaffected, and can be reused for subsequent response generation. In contrast, existing approaches either entail additional LLM calls, or task-specific offline learning, or position debiasing methods that modify the attention or encoding rendering the KV states unusable for subsequent generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常被用于需要从模型提供的长列表中选择某个项目的任务。不过，LLM本身的选择机制存在缺陷：模型的预测对标识符的表面形式、它们在上下文中的位置以及候选项目的排序非常敏感。我们提出了OLR-Heads这一稳健的列表选择方法，该方法利用对LLM进行单次前向调用所得到的注意力模式来进行选择。OLR-Heads通过少量上下文中的示例来学习项目选择的逻辑，并采用简单的在线位置去偏机制来纠正注意力偏差。在多个数据库和工具选择基准测试中，OLR-Heads始终能比直接生成法和基于先前注意力的方法取得更好的选择性能，同时还能很好地应对提示变化和项目排序的变化。LLM的KV缓存状态不会受到影响，可以重新用于后续的响应生成。相比之下，现有的方法要么需要额外的LLM调用，要么需要特定的离线学习过程，或者采用会改变注意力或编码方式从而使KV状态无法被用于后续生成的去偏方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Comprehensiveness Metrics for Automatic Evaluation of Factual Recall in Text Generation
papers.title_zh: 用于自动评估文本生成中事实回忆能力的全面性指标
papers.authors: Adam Dejl, James Barry, Alessandra Pascale, Javier Carnerero-Cano
papers.abstract: Despite demonstrating remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, large language models (LLMs) have also been found to frequently produce outputs that are incomplete or selectively omit key information. In sensitive domains, such omissions can result in significant harm comparable to that posed by factual inaccuracies, including hallucinations. In this study, we address the challenge of evaluating the comprehensiveness of LLM-generated texts, focusing on the detection of missing information or underrepresented viewpoints. We investigate three automated evaluation metrics: (1) an NLI-based method that decomposes texts into atomic statements and uses natural language inference (NLI) to identify missing facts, (2) a Q A-based metric that extracts question-answer pairs and compares responses across sources, and (3) an end-to-end approach that directly identifies missing content using LLMs. Our experiments demonstrate the surprising effectiveness of the simple end-to-end metric compared to more complex metrics, though at the cost of reduced robustness, interpretability and result granularity. We further assess the comprehensiveness of responses from several popular open-weight LLMs when answering user queries based on multiple sources.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在多种任务中表现出色，但人们也发现这些模型经常产生不完整或选择性遗漏关键信息的输出。在敏感领域，这种遗漏可能会带来严重的危害，其严重程度可与事实错误造成的危害相媲美，甚至包括幻觉现象。在这项研究中，我们着手解决评估大语言模型生成文本的全面性的挑战，重点在于检测缺失的信息或未被充分反映的观点。我们研究了三种自动评估方法：(1) 基于自然语言推理的方法，该方法将文本分解为原子陈述，并利用自然语言推理技术来识别缺失的事实；(2) 基于问答的方法，该方法提取问题-回答对，并比较不同来源之间的回答；(3) 端到端的方法，该方法直接利用大语言模型来识别缺失的内容。我们的实验表明，与更复杂的评估方法相比，这种简单的端到端方法具有惊人的有效性，不过其缺点是降低了模型的鲁棒性、可解释性和结果的细节程度。我们还评估了几种流行的开放权重大语言模型在回答用户基于多个来源的问题时的文本全面性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TableVista: Benchmarking Multimodal Table Reasoning under Visual and Structural Complexity
papers.title_zh: TableVista：在视觉和结构复杂性条件下对多模态表格推理能力的评估
papers.authors: Zheyuan Yang, Liqiang Shang, Junjie Chen, Xun Yang, Chenglong Xu, Bo Yuan, Chenyuan Jiao, Yaoru Sun, Yilun Zhao
papers.abstract: We introduce TableVista, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating foundation models in multimodal table reasoning under visual and structural complexity. TableVista consists of 3,000 high-quality table reasoning problems, where each instance is expanded into 10 distinct visual variants through our multi-style rendering and transformation pipeline. This process encompasses diverse scenario styles, robustness perturbations, and vision-only configurations, culminating in 30,000 multimodal samples for a multi-dimensional evaluation. We conduct an extensive evaluation of 29 state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary foundation models on TableVista. Through comprehensive quantitative and qualitative analysis, we find that while evaluated models remain largely stable across diverse rendering styles, they exhibit pronounced performance degradation on complex structural layouts and vision-only settings, revealing that current models struggle to maintain reasoning consistency when structural complexity combines with visually integrated presentations. These findings highlight critical gaps in current multimodal capabilities, providing insights for advancing more robust and reliable table understanding models.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了TableVista，这是一个全面的基准测试工具，用于评估在视觉和结构复杂性下的多模态表格推理基础模型。TableVista包含3,000个高质量的表格推理问题，每个问题都通过我们的多风格渲染和转换流程被扩展为10种不同的视觉变体。这一过程涵盖了多种场景风格、鲁棒性扰动以及仅视觉配置的情况，最终形成了30,000个多模态样本，用于进行多维评估。我们在TableVista上对29种先进的开源和专有基础模型进行了广泛的评估。通过全面的定量和定性分析，我们发现，虽然评估中的模型在不同渲染风格下仍然保持稳定，但在复杂的结构布局和仅视觉设置的情况下，它们的性能明显下降。这表明，当前模型在结构复杂性与视觉整合的呈现方式结合时，难以保持推理的一致性。这些发现揭示了当前多模态能力中存在的关键缺陷，为开发更强大、更可靠的表格理解模型提供了重要线索。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Lost in Translation: Do LVLM Judges Generalize Across Languages?
papers.title_zh: 迷失在翻译之中：LVLM的裁判是否能在不同语言间进行通用判断？
papers.authors: Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar, Mohammed Saidul Islam, Mir Tafseer Nayeem, Amran Bhuiyan, Mizanur Rahman, Shafiq Joty, Enamul Hoque, Jimmy Huang
papers.abstract: Automatic evaluators such as reward models play a central role in the alignment and evaluation of large vision–language models (LVLMs). Despite their growing importance, these evaluators are almost exclusively assessed on English-centric benchmarks, leaving open the question of how well these evaluators generalize across languages. To answer this question, we introduce MM-JudgeBench, the first large-scale benchmark for multilingual and multimodal judge model evaluation, which includes over 60K pairwise preference instances spanning 25 typologically diverse languages. MM-JudgeBench integrates two complementary subsets: a general vision–language preference evaluation subset extending VL-RewardBench, and a chart-centric visual–text reasoning subset derived from OpenCQA, enabling systematic analysis of reward models (i.e., LVLM judges) across diverse settings. We additionally release a multilingual training set derived from MM-RewardBench, disjoint from our evaluation data, to support domain adaptation. By evaluating 22 LVLMs (15 open-source, 7 proprietary), we uncover substantial cross-lingual performance variance in our proposed benchmark. Our analysis further shows that model size and architecture are poor predictors of multilingual robustness, and that even state-of-the-art LVLM judges exhibit inconsistent behavior across languages. Together, these findings expose fundamental limitations of current reward modeling and underscore the necessity of multilingual, multimodal benchmarks for developing reliable automated evaluators.
papers.abstract_zh: 像奖励模型这样的自动评估工具在大型视觉-语言模型的对齐和评估中起着至关重要的作用。尽管这些评估工具的重要性日益凸显，但它们几乎都只在以英语为中心的基准测试中进行评估，这就引发了一个问题：这些评估工具在不同语言环境中的泛化能力如何？为了回答这个问题，我们推出了MM-JudgeBench——首个用于多语言和多模态判断模型评估的大规模基准测试。该基准测试包含了超过6万个成对偏好实例，涉及25种类型学上不同的语言。MM-JudgeBench整合了两个互补的评估子集：一个通用的视觉-语言偏好评估子集，它扩展了VL-RewardBench的功能；另一个以图表为中心的视觉-文本推理子集，该子集源自OpenCQA，能够系统地分析不同环境下的奖励模型（即视觉-语言模型判断器）。我们还发布了从MM-RewardBench衍生出的多语言训练集，这个训练集与我们的评估数据是独立的，旨在支持领域适应性。通过对22个视觉-语言模型进行评估（其中15个是开源模型，7个是专有模型），我们发现所提出的基准测试在跨语言性能上存在显著差异。我们的分析还表明，模型规模和架构并不是衡量多语言模型鲁棒性的有效指标，甚至最先进的视觉-语言模型判断器在不同语言环境中的表现也不一致。这些发现揭示了当前奖励建模方式存在的根本局限性，并强调了开发可靠自动化评估工具时，需要采用多语言和多模态的基准测试。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Making Revisions Understandable: A Survey of Edit Intentions, Methods, and Applications
papers.title_zh: 使修改内容易于理解：对编辑意图、方法及应用的调查
papers.authors: Fangping Lan, Qi Zhang, Eduard Dragut
papers.abstract: Text revision is a core process in document creation, capturing how authors iteratively refine, reorganize, and improve written content. With the increasing availability of large-scale revision histories from platforms such as Wikipedia and arXiv, NLP research has begun to move beyond modeling what changes are made to understanding why they are made, i.e., the underlying edit intentions. To our knowledge, this is the first survey that synthesizes text revision research through the lens of edit intentions, providing a unified view of datasets, taxonomies, identification methods, and applications. We review prior work across the full revision workflow, including revision corpus construction, edit intention taxonomy design, and edit intention identification. We further categorize representative datasets and methods, summarize downstream applications such as writing assistance and document edit summarization, and highlight key open research directions.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本修订是文档创作中的一个核心过程，它涉及到作者如何反复完善、重新组织以及改进文本内容。随着来自维基百科和arXiv等平台的大规模修订历史数据的日益丰富，自然语言处理研究已经不再仅仅关注对修改内容的建模，而是开始探究进行这些修改的动机，即潜在的编辑意图。据我们所知，这是第一项通过编辑意图视角来整合文本修订研究的综述性研究，它为数据集、分类方法、识别技术以及应用提供了统一的视角。我们回顾了整个修订流程中的先前研究工作，包括修订语料库的构建、编辑意图的分类设计以及编辑意图的识别方法。我们还对代表性的数据集和方法进行了分类，总结了诸如写作辅助和文档编辑总结等下游应用，并强调了重要的研究方向。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GSM-Noise: Exploring and Enhancing Large Language Models’ Reasoning under Noisy Inputs
papers.title_zh: GSM噪声：在噪声输入条件下探索与提升大型语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Zhengxin Zhang, Chengyu Huang, Xufu Liu, Dan Zhao, Jinyan Su, Claire Cardie
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, yet they often struggle when dealing with complex, ill-formed, or noisy inputs that frequently occur in interactions with real users. LLMs typically lack crucial refining capabilities needed to filter out irrelevant details, restructure key points before reasoning over the text and responding, resulting in suboptimal performance and incorrect answers. From an information theory perspective, this behavior is akin to decoding a high-entropy problem without first reducing its entropy. In this work, we first introduce GSM-Noise, a benchmark featuring grade-school math problems systematically perturbed to reflect real-world input variability. We show that the reasoning ability of open-source models (e.g., LLaMA and Qwen series) can be compromised by noise, while closed-source models are more robust. To improve LLM robustness under noisy conditions, we propose that LLMs first refine inputs — thereby reducing their entropy — before engaging in in-depth analysis. We investigate three approaches to instill this refinement capability: prompt engineering (PE), supervised finetuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL). Experimental results show that input refinement leads to consistent performance gains: 2–12% with PE, 4–13% with SFT, and 3–25% with RL. These results highlight the importance of incorporating an explicit refinement phase to enhance the robustness and reliability of LLM reasoning in real-world scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）展现了令人印象深刻的推理能力，但在处理复杂、格式混乱或噪声众多的输入时往往表现不佳，这些问题在与现实用户的互动中非常常见。LLM通常缺乏必要的优化能力，无法过滤掉无关细节，也无法在推理文本并作出回应之前重新组织关键要点，从而导致性能不佳和错误答案的出现。从信息论的角度来看，这种行为类似于在没有先降低熵的情况下尝试解码高熵问题。在这项研究中，我们首先介绍了GSM-Noise这一基准测试，该测试包含了一系列经过系统调整的小学数学题目，以反映现实世界中的输入变异性。我们发现，开源模型（如LLaMA和Qwen系列）的推理能力可能会受到噪声的影响，而闭源模型则更为稳健。为了提升LLM在噪声环境下的鲁棒性，我们提出让LLM在进行深入分析之前先对输入进行优化——从而降低其熵值。我们研究了三种实现这种优化能力的方法：提示工程（PE）、监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）。实验结果表明，输入优化能够带来稳定的性能提升：使用PE方法可提升2-12%，使用SFT方法可提升4-13%，而使用RL方法则可提升3-25%。这些结果强调了在现实场景中增强LLM推理能力的鲁棒性和可靠性时，引入明确的优化阶段的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Value Alignment Tax: Measuring Value Trade-offs in LLM Alignment
papers.title_zh: 价值对齐税：衡量大语言模型优化过程中所面临的权衡
papers.authors: Jiajun Chen, Hua Shen
papers.abstract: Existing work on value alignment typically characterizes value relations statically, ignoring how alignment interventions—such as prompting, fine-tuning, or preference optimization—reshape the broader value system. In practice, aligning a target value can implicitly shift other values, creating value trade-offs that remain largely unmeasured.We introduce the VAT, a framework that quantifies value trade-offs by measuring how alignment-induced changes propagate across interconnected values relative to achieved on-target gain. VAT captures the system-level dynamics of value expression under alignment intervention, enabling evaluation of both intended improvements and unintended side effects.Using a controlled scenario–action dataset grounded in Schwartz value theory, we collect paired pre–post normative judgments and analyze alignment effects across models, values, and interventions. Results show that alignment often produces uneven and structured co-movement among values, revealing systematic trade-offs between target and non-target values. These effects are largely invisible under conventional target-only evaluation, but become evident via VAT, highlighting process-level alignment risks and offering new insights into the dynamic nature of value alignment in LLMs.Dataset and code are open-sourced.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前关于价值对齐的研究通常只是静态地描述价值之间的关系，而忽略了诸如提示、微调或偏好优化等对齐干预措施如何重塑更广泛的价值体系。实际上，对一个目标价值的对齐可能会隐含地改变其他价值，从而产生一些难以量化的价值权衡。我们提出了VAT框架，该框架通过测量对齐带来的变化如何相对于目标收益在相互关联的价值之间传播来量化价值权衡。VAT能够捕捉到在对齐干预下价值表达的系统级动态，从而可以评估预期的改进以及未预见的副作用。基于Schwartz价值理论构建的受控场景-行动数据集，我们收集了成对的前后规范判断，并分析了不同模型、价值和干预措施下的对齐效果。结果表明，对齐通常会产生不均匀且有序的价值协同变化，显示出目标价值与非目标价值之间的系统性权衡。这些效应在传统的仅针对目标的评估中往往难以察觉，但通过VAT框架可以清晰地看到这些效应，从而揭示出过程层面的对齐风险，并为理解大语言模型中价值对齐的动态特性提供了新的视角。该数据集和代码已开源。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Confidence-Aware Ranker Ensembles for Robust In-Context Knowledge Editing
papers.title_zh: 基于信任度的排名算法集合，适用于稳健的上下文知识编辑操作
papers.authors: Tejal Nair, Mahmud Wasif Nafee, Maiqi Jiang, Ashley Gao, Haipeng Chen, Yanfu Zhang
papers.abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) excel at factual recall, they can still propagate stale or incorrect knowledge, making in-context knowledge editing a gradient-free remedy suitable for black-box APIs. These knowledge editors that use in-context learning typically rely on a single retriever and surface-similarity heuristics to build prompts. However, a key observation in this study is that retrievers can be complementary: semantic rankers may recover paraphrased evidence, while lexical or feature-based retrievers may preserve precise entities and cues. This creates two gaps in single-retriever editors: they (i) miss complementary evidence that different retrievers surface and (ii) cannot adapt when one retriever is clearly more reliable for a query. We introduce a Feature-Weighted Ensemble for In-context Knowledge Editing (FWE-IKE) that calibrates three heterogeneous rankers (LLM-, BERT-, and MLP-based), extracts simple confidence features from each ranker, predicts per-query mixture weights, and applies a conservative margin-based routing gate that selects a single expert when confident; otherwise we mix calibrated distributions with learned per-query weights. On the CounterFact benchmark, FWE-IKE attains 88.33% Edit-Success Rate, a +3.0 point gain over the best single retriever and approaching the oracle upper bound (91%). Case studies, an ablation study, and analyses show the method systematically recovers complementary wins (e.g., BERT-only, LLM-only, MLP-only slices). FWE-IKE improves edit accuracy without touching model weights and provides a practical path to more robust, confidence-aware retrieval for IKE.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在事实检索方面表现出色，但它们仍有可能传播过时或错误的知识。因此，基于上下文的知识编辑是一种适用于黑盒API的无梯度解决方案。这些使用上下文学习的知识编辑器通常依赖于单一的检索器和表面相似性启发式方法来构建提示。然而，本研究的一个关键发现是：不同的检索器可以互补：语义排序器可以提取改写后的证据，而词汇或基于特征的检索器则可以保留精确的实体和线索。这就导致单一检索器编辑器存在两个缺陷：其一，它们无法捕捉到不同检索器所呈现的互补信息；其二，当某个检索器对某个查询更为可靠时，系统无法做出相应的调整。我们提出了一种特征加权混合式上下文知识编辑器，该编辑器能够校准三种异构的排序器（基于LLM、BERT和MLP的排序器），从每个排序器中提取简单的置信度特征，预测每个查询的混合权重，并采用保守的边界路由机制，在确信某个排序器更可靠时选择它作为唯一专家；否则，我们会将校准后的分布与学习到的每个查询权重进行混合。在CounterFact基准测试上，FWE-IKE达到了88.33%的编辑成功率，比最佳单一检索器高出3.0个百分点，并且接近神谕的上限（91%）。案例研究、消融分析以及数据分析表明，该方法能够系统地获取互补的结果（例如，仅使用BERT、仅使用LLM或仅使用MLP的结果）。FWE-IKE在不改变模型权重的情况下提升了编辑精度，为IKE提供了更稳健、更注重置信度的检索方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: EMSDialog: Synthetic Multi-person Emergency Medical Service Dialogue Generation from Electronic Patient Care Reports via Multi-LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: EMSDialog：利用多智能体模型从电子患者护理报告中生成多人的紧急医疗服务对话
papers.authors: Xueren Ge, Sahil Murtaza, Anthony Cortez, Homa Alemzadeh
papers.abstract: Conversational diagnosis prediction requires models to track evolving evidence in streaming clinical conversations and decide when to commit to a diagnosis. Existing medical dialogue corpora are largely dyadic or lack the multi-party workflow and annotations needed for this setting. We introduce an ePCR-grounded, topic-flow-based multi-agent generation pipeline that iteratively plans, generates, and self-refines dialogues with rule-based factual and topic flow checks. The pipeline yields EMSDialog, a dataset of 4,414 synthetic multi-speaker EMS conversations based on a real-world ePCR dataset, annotated with 43 diagnoses, speaker roles, and turn-level topics. Human and LLM evaluations confirm high quality and realism of EMSDialog using both utterance- and conversation-level metrics. Results show that EMSDialog-augmented training improves accuracy, timeliness, and stability of EMS conversational diagnosis prediction. Our datasets and code are publicly available at https://uva-dsa.github.io/EMSDialog
papers.abstract_zh: 对话式诊断预测需要模型能够跟踪流式临床对话中的最新信息，并判断何时做出诊断结论。现有的医学对话数据集大多采用双方对话模式，缺乏实现多方对话所需的多维度工作流程和注释功能。我们提出了一种基于主题流的ePCR驱动的多智能体生成流程，该流程通过基于规则的真实信息和主题流检查，逐步规划、生成并自我完善对话内容。最终生成的EMSDialog数据集包含4,414条基于真实ePCR数据的合成多话者紧急医疗服务对话，这些对话包含了43种诊断结果、说话者角色以及每轮对话的主题内容。人类用户和大语言模型评估表明，EMSDialog数据集在话语级和对话级指标上都具有很高的质量和真实性。研究结果表明，使用EMSDialog数据集进行训练可以提高紧急医疗服务对话诊断预测的准确性、及时性和稳定性。我们的数据集和代码可在此处免费获取：https://uva-dsa.github.io/EMSDialog
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Better LLM Reasoning via Dual-Play
papers.title_zh: 通过双模式操作实现更出色的大语言模型推理能力
papers.authors: Zhengxin Zhang, Chengyu Huang, Aochong Oliver Li, Claire Cardie
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress through Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), yet still rely heavily on external supervision (e.g., curated labels). Adversarial learning, particularly through self-play, offers a promising alternative that enables models to learn from themselves—thus reducing reliance on external supervision. Dual-play extends adversarial learning by assigning specialized roles to two models and training them against each other, fostering sustained competition and mutual evolution. Despite its promise, adapting dual-play training to LLMs remains limited. In this paper, we introduce PasoDoble, a novel LLM dual-play framework. PasoDoble adversarially trains two models initialized from the same base model: a Proposer, which generates challenging questions with ground-truth answers, and a Solver, which attempts to solve them. We enrich the Proposer with knowledge from a pre-training dataset to ensure the questions’ quality and diversity. To avoid reward hacking, the Proposer is rewarded for producing only valid questions that push the Solver’s limit, while the Solver is rewarded for solving them correctly, and both are updated jointly. Experimental results show that PasoDoble can improve the math reasoning performance of LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过带有可验证奖励的强化学习取得了显著进展，但依然严重依赖外部监督（例如，经过筛选的标签）。对抗性学习，尤其是通过自我对战的方式，提供了一种有前景的替代方案——让模型能够自我学习，从而减少对外部监督的依赖。双模学习则通过将两个模型分配专门的角色，并让它们相互对战，进一步促进了持续的竞争和共同进化。尽管这种方法很有前景，但将其应用于大语言模型仍然面临诸多限制。在本文中，我们提出了PasoDoble这一新颖的双模语言模型框架。PasoDoble通过对抗性训练来训练两个模型：一个提出者，负责生成带有真实答案的难题；另一个求解者，负责尝试解决这些问题。我们通过预训练数据集为提出者提供知识，以确保问题的质量和多样性。为了避免奖励操纵问题，提出者仅因提出有效的问题而获得奖励，以挑战求解者的极限；而求解者则因正确解决问题而获得奖励。这两种模型会共同进行更新。实验结果表明，PasoDoble能够有效提升大语言模型的数学推理能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CobwebTM: Probabilistic Concept Formation for Lifelong and Hierarchical Topic Modeling
papers.title_zh: CobwebTM：用于终身式与分层主题建模的概率性概念形成方法
papers.authors: Karthik Singaravadivelan, Anant Gupta, Zekun Wang, Christopher J. MacLellan
papers.abstract: Topic modeling seeks to uncover latent semantic structure in text corpora with minimal supervision. Neural approaches achieve strong performance but require extensive tuning and struggle with lifelong learning due to catastrophic forgetting and fixed capacity, while classical probabilistic models lack flexibility and adaptability to streaming data. We introduce CobwebTM, a low-parameter lifelong hierarchical topic model based on incremental probabilistic concept formation. By adapting the Cobweb algorithm to continuous document embeddings, CobwebTM constructs semantic hierarchies online, enabling unsupervised topic discovery, dynamic topic creation, and hierarchical organization without predefining the number of topics. Across diverse datasets, CobwebTM achieves strong topic coherence, stable topics over time, and high-quality hierarchies, demonstrating that incremental symbolic concept formation combined with pretrained representations is an efficient approach to topic modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 主题建模旨在在最小的监督下揭示文本语料库中的潜在语义结构。神经方法虽然性能优异，但需要大量的调优工作，并且由于灾难性的遗忘现象以及固定的容量限制，难以实现 lifelong 学习。而传统的概率模型则缺乏灵活性和对流式数据的适应能力。我们提出了 CobwebTM 模型，这是一种基于增量概率概念形成的低参数终身分层主题模型。通过将 Cobweb 算法应用于连续的文档嵌入数据，CobwebTM 能够在线构建语义层次结构，从而实现无监督的主题发现、动态主题创建以及分层组织，而无需预先定义主题的数量。在多种不同的数据集上，CobwebTM 表现出强大的主题连贯性、随时间稳定的主题结构以及高质量的层次结构，这表明将增量符号化概念形成与预训练表示相结合是一种高效的主题建模方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Adaptive Test-Time Compute Allocation with Evolving In-Context Demonstrations
papers.title_zh: 基于动态上下文信息的自适应测试时间分配算法
papers.authors: Bowen Zuo, Dongruo Zhou, Yinglun Zhu
papers.abstract: While scaling test-time compute can substantially improve model performance, existing approaches either rely on static compute allocation or sample from fixed generation distributions.In this work, we introduce a test-time compute allocation framework that jointly adapts where computation is spent and how generation is performed. Our method begins with a warm-up phase that identifies easy queries and assembles an initial pool of question-response pairs from the test set itself. An adaptive phase then concentrates further computation on unresolved queries while reshaping their generation distributions through evolving in-context demonstrations—conditioning each generation on successful responses from semantically related queries rather than resampling from a fixed distribution.Experiments across math, coding, and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines while consuming substantially less inference-time compute.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然扩大测试阶段的计算能力可以显著提升模型性能，但现有的方法要么依赖于静态的计算分配，要么从固定的生成分布中采样。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种测试阶段的计算分配框架，该框架能够同时调整计算的分配方式以及生成的策略。我们的方法首先包含一个预热阶段，该阶段会识别出容易解决的查询问题，并从测试集中自动生成初始的问题-回答对。随后，自适应阶段会将更多的计算资源集中在尚未解决的查询上，同时通过不断调整上下文相关的演示来重新塑造它们的生成分布——即根据与语义相关的查询的成功回答来生成新的样本，而不是从固定分布中重新采样。在数学、编程和推理等多个基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法始终优于现有的基线算法，同时使用的推理计算资源也大幅减少。

papers.title: CCD: Mitigating Hallucinations in Radiology MLLMs via Clinical Contrastive Decoding
papers.title_zh: CCD：通过临床对比解码技术在放射医学领域缓解幻觉症状
papers.authors: Xi Zhang, Zaiqiao Meng, Jake Lever, Edmond S. L. Ho
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress in radiology by integrating visual perception with natural language understanding. However, they often generate clinically unsupported descriptions, known as medical hallucinations, which pose serious risks in medical applications that demand accuracy and image-grounded outputs. Through empirical analysis, we find that prompt-induced hallucinations remain prevalent in radiology MLLMs, largely due to over-sensitivity to clinical sections. To address this, we introduce Clinical Contrastive Decoding (CCD), a training-free and retrieval-free inference framework that integrates structured clinical signals from task-specific radiology expert models. CCD introduces a dual-stage contrastive mechanism to refine token-level logits during generation, thereby enhancing clinical fidelity without modifying the base MLLM. Experiments on three datasets and multiple models demonstrate that CCD consistently improves overall performance on radiology report generation (RRG). On the MIMIC-CXR dataset, it yields up to a 17% improvement in RadGraph-F1 when applied to state-of-the-art RRG models. Our approach provides a lightweight and generalisable solution for mitigating medical hallucinations, effectively bridging expert models and MLLMs in radiology.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在放射学领域取得了显著进展，通过将视觉感知与自然语言理解相结合。然而，这些模型常常生成缺乏临床依据的描述，即所谓的“医学幻觉”，这在需要精确性和基于图像的输出的医疗应用中会带来严重风险。通过实证分析，我们发现提示诱导的幻觉在放射学多模态大语言模型中仍然普遍存在，这主要是由于模型对临床内容的过度敏感所致。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种无需训练和检索的推理框架——临床对比解码技术。该框架整合了来自特定放射学专家模型的结构化临床信息，采用双阶段对比机制来优化生成过程中的令牌级逻辑值，从而在不修改基础多模态大语言模型的情况下提高临床描述的准确性。在三个数据集和多种模型上的实验表明，该技术能够持续改善放射学报告生成的性能。在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，当应用于最先进的放射学报告生成模型时，其效果显著，使RadGraph-F1指标提高了17%。我们的方法提供了一种轻量级且可推广的解决方案，有效解决了医学幻觉问题，同时实现了放射学领域专家模型与多模态大语言模型的有机结合。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Adequately Perform Symbolic Reasoning Over Time Series?
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否有效处理时间序列数据的符号推理任务？
papers.authors: Zewen Liu, Juntong Ni, Xianfeng Tang, Max SY Lau, Qi He, Wenpeng Yin, Wei Jin
papers.abstract: Uncovering hidden symbolic laws from time series data, as an aspiration dating back to Kepler’s discovery of planetary motion, remains a core challenge in scientific discovery and artificial intelligence. While Large Language Models show promise in structured reasoning tasks, their ability to infer interpretable, context-aligned symbolic structures from time series data is still underexplored. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce SymbolBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess symbolic reasoning over real-world time series across three tasks: multivariate symbolic regression, Boolean network inference, and causal discovery. Unlike prior efforts limited to simple algebraic equations, SymbolBench spans a diverse set of symbolic forms with varying complexity. We further propose a unified framework that integrates LLMs with genetic programming to form a closed-loop symbolic reasoning system. Our empirical results reveal key strengths and limitations of current models, highlighting the importance of combining domain knowledge, context alignment, and reasoning structure to improve LLMs in automated scientific discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 从时间序列数据中揭示隐藏的符号性规律，这一目标可以追溯到开普勒对行星运动的发现，仍然是科学发现与人工智能领域中的核心挑战。虽然大语言模型在结构化推理任务上表现出潜力，但它们从时间序列数据中推断出可解释、与上下文一致的符号结构的能力仍未被充分探索。为了系统地评估这一能力，我们提出了SymbolBench这一综合基准测试，该测试旨在评估针对现实世界时间序列进行符号推理的能力，涵盖三种任务：多变量符号回归、布尔网络推理以及因果发现。与之前仅限于简单代数方程的尝试不同，SymbolBench涵盖了多种不同复杂度的符号形式。我们还提出了一个统一的框架，将大语言模型与遗传编程相结合，形成一个闭环的符号推理系统。我们的实证结果揭示了当前模型的主要优势与局限性，强调了结合领域知识、上下文对齐和推理结构对于提升大语言模型在自动化科学发现中的能力的重要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Reading Between the Lines: The One-Sided Conversation Problem
papers.title_zh: 解读隐含之意：单方面的对话问题
papers.authors: Victoria Ebert, Rishabh Singh, Tuochao Chen, Noah A. Smith, Shyamnath Gollakota
papers.abstract: Conversational AI is constrained in many real-world settings where only one side of a dialogue can be recorded. We formalize the one-sided conversation problem (1SC): inferring and learning from only one side of a conversation. We study two tasks: (1) reconstructing the missing speaker’s turns and (2) generating summaries from one-sided transcripts. Evaluating models on MultiWOZ, DailyDialog, SpokenWOZ and Candor with both human A/B testing and LLM-as-a-judge metrics, we find that additional context improves reconstruction, and while large models generate promising reconstructions with prompting, smaller models require finetuning. Further, high-quality summaries can be generated without reconstructing missing turns. We present 1SC as a novel challenge and report promising results that mark a step toward privacy-aware conversational AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 在许多现实场景中，对话式人工智能面临限制，因为只能记录对话中的一方发言内容。我们将这一单边对话问题进行了形式化处理：即从对话中的仅有一方发言内容进行推断和学习。我们研究了两个任务：(1) 重建缺失发言者的话语；(2) 从单边转录文本中生成摘要。通过在MultiWOZ、DailyDialog、SpokenWOZ和Candor数据集上进行评估，结合人类A/B测试以及LLM作为裁判的评估指标，我们发现额外的上下文信息有助于改善重建效果。虽然大型模型在提供提示时能够生成令人满意的结果，但小型模型则需要进一步的微调。此外，即使不重建缺失的话语，也能生成高质量的摘要。我们将1SC视为一项新颖的挑战，并取得了有希望的成果，这标志着向注重隐私保护的对话式人工智能迈出了一步。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Fico: Evaluating Vision-Language Models under Visual Fidelity and Compression at Scale
papers.title_zh: 菲科：在大规模场景下评估视觉与语言模型的视觉保真度及压缩性能
papers.authors: Jianhong Tu, Nicholas Crispino, Kyle Montgomery, Chenguang Wang, Dawn Song
papers.abstract: Visual text compression is an emerging paradigm for rendering text as images for processing by vision-language models (VLMs), enabling higher information density per context token. However, the robustness of VLMs under dense, text-based visual inputs remains unevaluated. We introduce Fico, a benchmark designed to assess VLM robustness across seven controlled variants of visual fidelity and information density. Fico spans documents of 8k to 64k tokens and includes three tasks of increasing semantic granularity: optical character recognition (OCR), needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) retrieval, and visual question answering (VQA). Evaluating 13 general-purpose VLMs and 3 OCR-specialized models reveals three consistent trends: performance drops sharply under increased density or reduced resolution; cross-task transfer between OCR, NIAH, and VQA is limited; and VQA is comparatively robust because low-level details are lost before high-level semantics. By exposing failure modes that remain invisible under conventional VLM evaluations, Fico establishes a rigorous test-bed for visual text compression.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉文本压缩是一种新兴的技术，它将文本转换为图像形式，以便由视觉语言模型进行处理，从而实现每个上下文令牌更高的信息密度。然而，视觉语言模型在密集的基于文本的视觉输入下的鲁棒性尚未得到评估。我们提出了Fico这一基准测试，旨在评估视觉语言模型在七种不同视觉保真度和信息密度条件下的鲁棒性。Fico涵盖了从8千到64千个令牌的文档，并包含三个具有不同语义粒度的任务：光学字符识别、针尖找羊群检索以及视觉问题回答。通过对13个通用视觉语言模型和3个专注于光学字符识别的模型进行评估，我们发现三个一致的趋势：在信息密度增加或分辨率降低时，性能会急剧下降；光学字符识别、针尖找羊群检索和视觉问题回答之间的跨任务迁移有限；而视觉问题回答相对具有较高的鲁棒性，因为高级语义在低级细节被丢失之前就已经被忽略。通过揭示在传统视觉语言模型评估中无法发现的失败模式，Fico为视觉文本压缩提供了一个严格的测试平台。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SycoBench-600: Measuring Sycophancy and Correction Selectivity in LLM Assistants
papers.title_zh: SycoBench-600：用于评估大型语言模型助手中的谄媚行为及修正选择性问题
papers.authors: Debu Sinha
papers.abstract: Modern instruction-following language models are optimized to be helpful and cooperative, often through preference-based alignment such as RLHF and related methods. A growing body of evidence shows that this training can also induce sycophancy: models may agree with a user even when the user is wrong, undermining reliability in decision support and high-stakes advice. We introduce SycoBench-600, a controlled multiple-choice benchmark that measures (i) susceptibility to three social-pressure perturbations (doubt, authority, and an explicit wrong suggestion) and (ii) correction selectivity, the ability to accept correct suggestions while resisting incorrect ones. The released benchmark contains 600 English MCQ instances over 272 normalized question stems, covers 8 domains and 3 difficulty tiers, and evaluates each instance under 3 fixed paraphrase variants of the perturbation prompts. We evaluate seven widely used assistants spanning proprietary and open-weight families. Results show substantial variation in pressure robustness and selective updating, and further show that willingness to update does not by itself imply selectivity. We release raw logs, validation scripts, and code that regenerates every table and figure from the model outputs.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代的语言模型在设计中注重提供帮助和协作，这通常通过基于偏好的对齐方式来实现，例如强化学习导向的语言模型及相关方法。越来越多的证据表明，这种训练方式可能会诱导出谄媚行为：即使用户判断错误，模型仍可能表示同意，这削弱了决策支持和高风险建议的可靠性。我们提出了SycoBench-600这一经过控制的多项选择题基准测试，该测试旨在评估模型对三种社会压力因素的敏感性（怀疑、权威以及明确的错误提示），以及模型在接受正确建议时的选择性能力，即模型在抵抗错误建议时的能力。该基准测试包含600道英语选择题，共272个标准化问题陈述，涵盖8个领域和3个难度等级，并且每个问题都通过三种不同的表述方式进行评估。我们测试了七种广泛使用的助手工具，包括专有技术和开源技术。结果表明，模型在应对压力时的鲁棒性和选择性更新能力存在显著差异，此外，愿意进行更新的行为本身并不能说明模型具有选择性能力。我们还提供了原始日志、验证脚本以及从模型输出中生成各表格和图表的代码。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Calibrating Model-Based Evaluation Metrics for Summarization
papers.title_zh: 校准基于模型的摘要评估指标
papers.authors: Hongye Liu, Dhanajit Brahma, Ricardo Henao
papers.abstract: Recent advances in summary evaluation are based on model-based metrics to assess quality dimensions, such as completeness, conciseness, and faithfulness. However, these methods often require large language models, and predicted scores are frequently miscalibrated, limiting their reliability. Moreover, evaluating the average quality across different summaries for a single document typically requires access to multiple reference summaries. Here, we propose a general framework that generates individual and average proxy scores without relying on reference summaries, human annotations, or expensive model-based metrics. We also propose group isotonic regression binning (GIRB), a calibration method that adjusts the raw predictions to better align with ground-truth evaluation metrics. While we focus on continuous-value scenarios, such as summarization, the method is applicable to discrete-value tasks, such as question answering. Experiments on seven datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在摘要评估方面的进展基于基于模型的指标来评估质量维度，如完整性、简洁性和准确性。然而，这些方法通常需要使用大语言模型，而预测出的分数往往存在校准问题，这限制了它们的可靠性。此外，要评估单个文档的不同摘要的平均质量，通常需要访问多个参考摘要。在这里，我们提出了一种通用框架，可以生成个体和平均的代理分数，而无需依赖参考摘要、人类注释或昂贵的基于模型的指标。我们还提出了群体等温回归分箱法（GIRB），这是一种调整原始预测值的方法，使其更符合真实评估指标。虽然我们主要关注连续值场景，如摘要生成，但该方法也适用于离散值任务，如问答问题。在七个数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法始终优于现有的基线算法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SafeMERGE: Preserving Safety Alignment in Fine-Tuned Large Language Models via Selective Layer-Wise Model Merging
papers.title_zh: SafeMERGE：通过选择性地对不同层进行模型合并，从而在微调后的大型语言模型中保持安全性与一致性
papers.authors: Aladin Djuhera, Swanand Ravindra Kadhe, Farhan Ahmed, Syed Zawad, Holger Boche
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) is a common practice to adapt generalist models to specialized domains. However, recent studies show that fine-tuning can erode safety alignment, causing LLMs to respond to harmful or unethical prompts. Many methods to realign safety have been proposed, but often introduce custom algorithms that are difficult to implement or compromise task utility. In this work, we propose SafeMERGE, a lightweight, post-fine-tuning framework that restores safety while maintaining downstream performance. SafeMERGE selectively merges fine-tuned with safety-aligned model layers only when they deviate from safe behavior, measured by a cosine similarity criterion. Across four LLMs and several tasks, SafeMERGE consistently reduces harmful outputs compared to other defenses, with negligible or even positive impact on utility. Our results demonstrate that selective, layer-wise merging offers a robust safeguard against the inadvertent loss of safety during fine-tuning, establishing SafeMERGE as a simple yet effective post-fine-tuning defense.
papers.abstract_zh: 对大语言模型进行微调是一种常见的方法，旨在将通用模型适配到特定领域。然而，最近的研究表明，微调可能会破坏模型的安全性对齐机制，导致模型对有害或不道德的提示做出回应。虽然已经提出了许多重新调整安全性的方法，但这些方法往往需要引入复杂的自定义算法，而这些算法的实现难度较大，且可能会损害模型的任务性能。在这项研究中，我们提出了SafeMERGE这一轻量级、适用于微调后的框架，它能够在保持下游性能的同时恢复模型的安全性。SafeMERGE仅在微调后的模型层与安全性对齐的标准出现偏差时才会进行选择性合并。在四种不同的语言模型和多个任务中，SafeMERGE能够显著减少有害输出，同时对任务性能的影响微乎其微，甚至是有益的。我们的结果表明，这种逐层选择性合并的方法为在微调过程中避免安全性损失提供了有效的保障，使得SafeMERGE成为一种简单而有效的微调后防御机制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Learning to Control Summaries with Score Ranking
papers.title_zh: 学习通过评分排名来控制摘要的呈现方式
papers.authors: Hongye Liu, Liang Ding, Ricardo Henao
papers.abstract: Recent advances in summarization research focus on improving summary quality across multiple criteria, such as completeness, conciseness, and faithfulness, by jointly optimizing these dimensions. However, these efforts largely overlook the challenge of controlling summary generation with respect to individual criteria, especially in the presence of their inherent trade-offs. For example, enhancing conciseness can compromise completeness, and vice versa. In this work, we address this gap by proposing a loss function that aligns model outputs with fine-grained, model-based evaluation scores (e.g., from FineSurE), enabling both improvement in summary quality and dimension-specific control. Our approach improves the overall quality of summaries while maintaining the ability to selectively prioritize one criterion over others. Experiments on three pretrained models (LLaMA, Qwen, and Mistral) demonstrate that our method achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art summarizers, while uniquely offering strong controllability over individual quality dimensions.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在摘要研究方面的进展主要集中在通过联合优化多个指标来提高摘要质量，例如完整性、简洁性和准确性。然而，这些努力大多忽略了在控制摘要生成时考虑各个指标之间的权衡问题，尤其是在存在这些指标之间固有矛盾的情况下。例如，提高简洁性可能会牺牲完整性，反之亦然。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种损失函数，该函数能够将模型输出与基于模型的细粒度评估分数（例如来自FineSurE的评分）进行对齐，从而既提升了摘要质量，又实现了对各个指标的精确控制。我们的方法在保持对某一指标优先处理的同时，也提升了整体摘要的质量。在三个预训练模型（LLaMA、Qwen和Mistral）上的实验表明，我们的方法取得了与最先进的摘要生成器相当的性能，同时还能实现对各个质量指标的精准控制。

papers.title: Raw Pointer Rewriting with LLMs for Translating C to Safer Rust
papers.title_zh: 使用大语言模型对C语言代码进行重写，以转化为更安全的Rust语言代码
papers.authors: Yifei Gao, Chengpeng Wang, Pengxiang Huang, Xuwei Liu, Mingwei Zheng, Xiangyu Zhang
papers.abstract: There has been a growing interest in translating C code to Rust due to Rust’s robust memory and thread safety guarantees. Tools such as C2Rust enable syntax-guided transpilation from C to semantically equivalent Rust code. However, the resulting Rust programs often rely heavily on unsafe constructs, particularly raw pointers, which undermines Rust’s safety guarantees. This paper aims to improve the memory safety of Rust programs generated by C2Rust by eliminating raw pointers. Specifically, we propose a raw pointer rewriting technique that lifts raw pointers in individual functions to appropriate Rust data structures. Technically, PR2 employs decision-tree-based prompting to guide the pointer lifting process. It also leverages code change analysis to guide the repair of errors introduced during rewriting, effectively addressing errors encountered during compilation and test case execution.We implement PR2 and evaluate it using gpt-4o-mini on 28 real-world C projects. It is shown that PR2 successfully eliminates 18.57% of local raw pointers across these projects, significantly enhancing the safety of the translated Rust code. On average, PR2 completes the transformation of a project in 5.02 hours, at a cost of $1.13. Our code is available at https://github.com/bhcsayx/PR2.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于Rust具有强大的内存和线程安全保障，因此将C代码转换为Rust代码的兴趣日益增加。像C2Rust这样的工具能够基于语法进行从C语言到语义等效的Rust代码的转换。然而，生成的Rust程序往往大量使用不安全的构造方式，尤其是原始指针，这削弱了Rust的安全保障。本文旨在通过消除原始指针来提高由C2Rust生成的Rust程序的内存安全性。具体来说，我们提出了一种原始指针重写技术，该技术可以将单个函数中的原始指针替换为合适的Rust数据结构。在技术上，PR2采用决策树式的提示方式来指导指针替换过程。它还利用代码变更分析来修复重写过程中引入的错误，从而有效解决编译和测试执行过程中遇到的错误。我们实现了PR2，并使用gpt-4o-mini对28个真实的C项目进行了评估。结果显示，PR2成功消除了这些项目中18.57%的局部原始指针，显著提升了转换后Rust代码的安全性。平均而言，PR2在一个项目上的转换时间仅为5.02小时，成本仅为1.13美元。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/bhcsayx/PR2下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Single Plots: A Benchmark for Question Answering on Multi-Charts
papers.title_zh: 超越单一场景：多场景问答系统的基准测试
papers.authors: Azher Ahmed Efat, Seok Hwan Song, Wallapak Tavanapong
papers.abstract: Charts are widely used to present complex information. Deriving meaningful insights in real-world contexts often requires interpreting multiple related charts together. Research on understanding multi-chart images has not been extensively explored. We introduce PolyChartQA, a mid-scale dataset specifically designed for question answering over multi-chart images. PolyChartQA comprises 534 multi-chart images (with a total of 2,297 sub-charts) sourced from peer-reviewed computer science research publications and 2,694 QA pairs. We evaluate the performance of nine state-of-the-art Multimodal Language Models (MLMs) on PolyChartQA across question type, difficulty, question source, and key structural characteristics of multi-charts. Our results show a 27.4% LLM-based accuracy (L-Accuracy) drop on human-authored questions compared to MLM-generated questions, and a 5.39% L-accuracy gain with our proposed prompting method.
papers.abstract_zh: 图表被广泛用于呈现复杂信息。在现实场景中获取有意义的洞察通常需要同时解读多个相关的图表。关于多图表图像的理解研究尚未得到充分探讨。我们提出了PolyChartQA这一数据集，它专为处理多图表图像的问题回答而设计。PolyChartQA包含534个多图表图像（共2,297个子图表），这些图像来自经过同行评审的计算机科学研究出版物，同时还包含了2,694对问题回答对。我们评估了九种最先进的多模态语言模型在PolyChartQA上的表现，考虑了问题的类型、难度、问题的来源以及多图表的关键结构特征等因素。我们的结果显示，与由多模态语言模型生成的问题相比，基于大语言模型的问题回答准确率下降了27.4%；而采用我们提出的提示方法后，准确率则提高了5.39%。

papers.title: Assessing Y-Axis Influence: Bias in Multimodal Language Models on Chart-to-Table Translation
papers.title_zh: 评估Y轴因素的影响：多模态语言模型中偏差对图表转文本翻译的影响
papers.authors: Seok Hwan Song, Azher Ahmed Efat, Wallapak Tavanapong
papers.abstract: Chart-to-table translation converts chart images into structured tabular data. Accurate translation is crucial for Multimodal Language Modal (MLM) to answer complex queries. We observe imbalances in the number of images across different aspects of the y-axis information in public chart datasets. Such imbalances can introduce unintended biases, causing uneven MLM performance. Previous works have not systematically examined these biases. To address this gap, we propose a new framework, FairChart2Table, for analyzing y-axis-related bias on five state-of-the-art models.Key Findings: (1) There are significant y-axis biases related to the digit length of the major tick values, the number of major ticks, the range of values, and the tick value format (e.g., abbreviation or scientific format). (2) The number of legends/entities in chart images impacts MLM performance. (3) Prompting MLM with y-axis information can significantly enhance the performance for some MLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 图表转表格的翻译功能可以将图表图像转换为结构化的表格数据。对于多模态语言模型来说，准确的翻译对于处理复杂的查询至关重要。我们在公共图表数据集中观察到，y轴信息在不同方面的图像数量存在不平衡现象。这种不平衡可能会引入不必要的偏见，从而导致多模态语言模型的性能出现差异。之前的研究并未系统地探讨这些偏见问题。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新的框架——FairChart2Table，用于分析五种先进模型在y轴相关方面的偏差问题。主要发现如下：(1) 与主要刻度的数值大小、主要刻度的数量、数值范围以及刻度值的格式（例如缩写或科学格式）相关的y轴存在显著偏差。(2) 图表图像中图例/实体的数量会影响多模态语言模型的性能。(3) 向多模态语言模型提供y轴信息可以显著提高某些模型的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: FLOP-Efficient Training: Early Stopping Based on Test-Time Compute Awareness
papers.title_zh: 高效利用FLOP的训练方法：基于测试时间感知的提前停止策略
papers.authors: Hossam Amer, Maryam Dialameh, Hossein Rajabzadeh, Walid Ahmed, Weiwei Zhang, Yang Liu
papers.abstract: Scaling training compute, measured in FLOPs, has long been shown to improve the accuracy of large language models, yet training remains resource-intensive. Prior work shows that increasing test-time compute (TTC)—for example through iterative sampling—can allow smaller models to rival or surpass much larger ones at lower overall cost. We introduce TTC-aware training, where an intermediate checkpoint and a corresponding TTC configuration can together match or exceed the accuracy of a fully trained model while requiring substantially fewer training FLOPs. Building on this insight, we propose an early stopping algorithm that jointly selects a checkpoint and TTC configuration to minimize training compute without sacrificing accuracy. To make this practical, we develop an efficient TTC evaluation method that avoids exhaustive search, and we formalize a break-even bound that identifies when increased inference compute compensates for reduced training compute. Experiments demonstrate up to 92% reductions in training FLOPs while maintaining and sometimes remarkably improving accuracy. These results highlight a new perspective for balancing training and inference compute in model development, enabling faster deployment cycles and more frequent model refreshes.
papers.abstract_zh: 长期以来，人们已经发现，以FLOPs为单位进行训练计算量的调整，能够提升大语言模型的准确性。然而，训练过程仍然需要大量的资源。先前的研究表明，通过增加测试时的计算量——例如通过迭代采样——可以让较小的模型在较低的总体成本下与更大的模型相媲美甚至超越它们。我们提出了一种基于计算量的训练方法，在这种方法中，一个中间检查点以及相应的计算量配置可以共同达到或超越完全训练后的模型精度，同时所需的训练计算量却大大减少。基于这一见解，我们提出了一种提前终止算法，该算法能够同时选择出一个检查点和相应的计算量配置，以最小化训练计算量，同时不牺牲模型精度。为了使这种方法实用，我们开发了一种高效的计算量评估方法，避免了穷举搜索的必要性。此外，我们还提出了一个盈亏平衡准则，用于确定何时增加推理计算量可以弥补减少的训练计算量所带来的损失。实验结果表明，在保持甚至有时显著提高精度的同时，训练计算量可以减少高达92%。这些成果为在模型开发中平衡训练计算和推理计算提供了新的思路，从而加快了模型的部署周期，并使得模型更新变得更加频繁。

papers.title: Save the Good Prefix: Precise Error Penalization via Process-Supervised RL to Enhance LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 拯救“好的前缀”：通过过程监督强化学习实现精确的误差惩罚，以提升大语言模型的推理能力
papers.authors: Haolin Liu, Dian Yu, Sidi Lu, Yujun Zhou, Rui Liu, Zhenwen Liang, Haitao Mi, Chen-Yu Wei, Dong Yu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful framework for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, most existing RL approaches rely on sparse outcome rewards, which fail to credit correct intermediate steps in partially successful solutions. Process reward models (PRMs) offer fine-grained step-level supervision, but their scores are often noisy and difficult to evaluate. As a result, recent PRM benchmarks focus on a more objective capability: detecting the first incorrect step in a reasoning path. However, this evaluation target is misaligned with how PRMs are typically used in RL, where their step-wise scores are treated as raw rewards to maximize. To bridge this gap, we propose Verifiable Prefix Policy Optimization (VPPO), which uses PRMs only to localize the first error during RL. Given an incorrect rollout, VPPO partitions the trajectory into a verified correct prefix and an erroneous suffix based on the first error, rewarding the former while applying targeted penalties only after the detected mistake. This design yields stable, interpretable learning signals and improves credit assignment. Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, VPPO consistently outperforms sparse-reward RL and prior PRM-guided baselines on both Pass@1 and Pass@K.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为提升大语言模型（LLMs）推理能力的强大框架。然而，目前大多数RL方法依赖于稀疏的奖励机制，这种机制无法对部分成功的解决方案中的正确中间步骤给予相应的奖励。过程奖励模型（PRM）能够提供细粒度的步骤级监督，但其评分往往存在噪声且难以评估。因此，最近的PRM基准测试主要集中在另一个更客观的能力上：检测推理路径中的第一个错误步骤。不过，这一评估目标与PRM在RL中的实际使用方式并不一致，因为在RL中，PRM的逐步评分被当作原始奖励来最大化。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了可验证前缀策略优化（VPPO）方法。该方法仅使用PRM来定位RL过程中的第一个错误位置。当遇到错误的执行结果时，VPPO会根据第一个错误将轨迹划分为一个经过验证的正确前缀和一个错误的后缀，对正确部分进行奖励，而只有在检测到错误后才会施加有针对性的惩罚。这种设计能够产生稳定且可解释的学习信号，并改善奖励分配的准确性。在多个推理基准测试中，VPPO在Pass@1和Pass@K指标上始终优于基于稀疏奖励的RL方法以及之前的PRM引导基线算法。

papers.title: POSTCONDBENCH: Benchmarking Correctness and Completeness in Formal Postcondition Inference
papers.title_zh: 性能评估后结果：在形式化后条件推理中衡量基准的准确性和完整性
papers.authors: Gehao Zhang, Juan Zhai
papers.abstract: Formal postconditions precisely characterize program behavior and support debugging, testing, and verification, but writing them requires substantial expertise and effort. This has motivated recent work on automatically generating postconditions from code and natural-language artifacts using large language models (LLMs). However, evaluation remains a key bottleneck. Existing benchmarks primarily emphasize correctness under limited evaluation settings, often relying on surface-form matching or manual assessment on small or synthetic datasets.We introduce POSTCONDBENCH, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating method-level postcondition generation from real-world software. POSTCONDBENCH comprises 420 Python and Java tasks drawn from 121 open-source projects, each paired with a high-quality ground-truth postcondition set constructed with expert involvement. To enable automatic evaluation, POSTCONDBENCH provides a runnable execution environment and operationalizes completeness via defect discrimination: a postcondition set is more complete if it is violated by more defective implementations while remaining satisfied on correct executions. Using POSTCONDBENCH, we formulate three generation settings and evaluate five SOTA LLMs. Our results reveal a substantial gap between correctness and completeness, and show that repository-level dependencies and method complexity exacerbate this gap.
papers.abstract_zh: 形式化的后置条件能够精确描述程序的行为，并支持调试、测试与验证工作。不过，编写这些后置条件需要大量的专业知识和努力。这一现状促使人们尝试利用大语言模型从代码和自然语言文本中自动生成后置条件。然而，评估过程仍然是一个关键瓶颈。现有的评估基准大多侧重于在有限的评估环境下的正确性检验，通常依赖于表面形式匹配或针对小型或合成数据集的手动评估。我们提出了POSTCONDBENCH这一多语言评估基准，用于评估现实世界软件中的方法级后置条件生成能力。POSTCONDBENCH包含来自121个开源项目的420个Python和Java任务，每个任务都配备了一个由专家构建的高质量后置条件集。为了实现自动评估，POSTCONDBENCH提供了一个可运行的执行环境，并通过缺陷识别来量化完备性：如果一个后置条件被更多有缺陷的实现违反，而正确执行时仍然满足该条件，那么这个后置条件集就更为完备。通过POSTCONDBENCH，我们对三种生成方式进行了评估，并使用了五款最先进的语言模型进行测试。我们的研究结果揭示了正确性与完备性之间的巨大差距，同时表明库级依赖关系和方法复杂性进一步加剧了这种差距。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Who’s Asking? Simulating Role-Based Questions for Conversational AI Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 谁在提问呢？利用基于角色的问题来评估对话式人工智能的效果吧
papers.authors: Navreet Kaur, Hoda Ayad, Hayoung Jung, Shravika Mittal, Munmun De Choudhury, Tanu Mitra
papers.abstract: Language model users often embed personal and social context in their questions. Theasker’s role—implicit in how the question is framed—creates specific needs for an appropriate response. However, most evaluations, while capturing the model’s capability to respond, often ignore who is asking. This gap is especially critical in stigmatized domains such as opioid use disorder (OUD), where accounting for users’ contexts is essential to provide accessible, stigma-free responses. We propose CORUS (COmmunity-driven Roles for User-centric Question Simulation), a framework for simulating role-based questions. Drawing on role theory and posts from an online OUD recovery community (r/OpiatesRecovery), we first build a taxonomy of asker roles—patients, caregivers, practitioners. Next, we use it to simulate 15,321 questions that embed each role’s goals, behaviors, and experiences. Our evaluations show that these questions are both highly believable and comparable to real-world data. When used to evaluate five LLMs, for the same question but differing roles, we find systematic differences: vulnerable roles, such as patients and caregivers, elicit more supportive responses (+17%) and reduced knowledge content (−19%) in comparison to practitioners. Our work demonstrates how implicitly signaling a user’s role shapes model responses, and provides a methodology for role-informed evaluation of conversational AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型用户在提问时通常会融入个人和社会背景信息。提问者的角色——这种角色在问题的构建方式中被隐含地体现出来——为模型提供了特定的回应需求。然而，大多数评估虽然能够捕捉到模型的反应能力，却常常忽略了提问者的身份。在像阿片类药物使用障碍这样的受污名化领域，考虑用户的背景信息对于提供无污名的回应至关重要。我们提出了CORUS框架（以社区为导向的角色驱动用户中心问题模拟），这是一种用于模拟基于角色的问题的框架。基于角色理论以及一个在线阿片类药物康复社区（r/OpiatesRecovery）中的帖子，我们首先构建了一个关于提问者角色的分类体系——患者、护理者、从业者。接下来，我们利用这一分类体系来模拟15,321个包含每种角色的目标、行为和经历的问题。我们的评估表明，这些问题既具有高度可信度，也与现实世界的数据相当。当用这些问题来评估五个大语言模型时，对于相同的问题但不同的角色，我们发现存在系统性的差异：像患者和护理者这样的弱势角色会引发更多的支持性回应（+17%），而从业者的回应则包含较少的知识内容（-19%）。我们的研究展示了隐性地传达用户角色如何影响模型的响应，并提供了一种基于角色评估对话式人工智能的方法论。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: CircuitSynth: Reliable Synthetic Data Generation
papers.title_zh: 电路合成器：可靠的合成数据生成工具
papers.authors: Zehua Cheng, Wei Dai, Jiahao Sun, Thomas Lukasiewicz
papers.abstract: The generation of high-fidelity synthetic data is a cornerstone of modern machine learning, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently suffer from hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, and mode collapse when tasked with structured generation. Existing approaches, such s prompting or retrieval-augmented generaon, lack the mechanisms to balance linguistic expressivity with formal guarantees regarding validity and coverage. To address this, we propose CircuitSynth, a novel neuro-symbolic framework that decouples semantic reasoning from surface realization. By distilling the reasoning capabilities of a Teacher LLM into a Probabilistic Sentential Decision Diagram (PSDD), CircuitSynth creates a tractable semantic prior that structurally enforces hard logical constraints. Furthermore, we introduce a convex optimization mechanism to rigorously satisfy soft distributional goals. Empirical evaluations across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that CircuitSynth achieves 100% Schema Validity even in complex logic puzzles where unconstrained baselines fail (12.4%) while significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods in rare-combination coverage.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成高保真度的合成数据是现代机器学习的基础技术。然而，当大语言模型负责结构化生成任务时，它们常常会出现幻觉、逻辑矛盾以及模式崩溃等问题。现有的方法，如提示式生成或检索增强式生成，都缺乏在语言表达性与有效性保障之间取得平衡的机制。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CircuitSynth这一新颖的神经-符号框架。该框架将语义推理与表面实现分离开来。通过将教师语言模型的推理能力转化为概率性句子决策图，CircuitSynth能够构建一个易于处理的语义先验，从而有效地执行严格的逻辑约束。此外，我们还引入了一种凸优化机制，以严格满足软分布目标。通过在不同基准测试中的实证评估表明，即使在复杂的逻辑谜题场景中，CircuitSynth也能达到100%的框架有效性（而传统的无约束方法仅能达到12.4%），同时在罕见组合覆盖方面也显著优于现有方法。

papers.title: MedRedFlag: Investigating how LLMs Redirect Misconceptions in Real-World Health Communication
papers.title_zh: MedRedFlag：研究大型语言模型如何在现实世界的健康传播中纠正人们的误解
papers.authors: Sraavya Sambara, Yuan Pu, Ayman Ali, Vishala Mishra, Lionel Wong, Monica Agrawal
papers.abstract: Real-world health questions from patients often unintentionally embed false assumptions or premises. In such cases, safe medical communication typically involves redirection: addressing the implicit misconception and then responding to the underlying patient context, rather than the original question. While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used by lay users for medical advice, they have not yet been tested for this crucial competency. Therefore, in this work, we investigate how LLMs react to false premises embedded within real-world health questions. We develop a semi-automated pipeline to curate MedRedFlag, a dataset of 1100+ questions sourced from Reddit that require redirection. We then systematically compare responses from state-of-the-art LLMs to those from clinicians. Our analysis reveals that LLMs often fail to redirect problematic questions, even when the problematic premise is detected, and provide answers that could lead to suboptimal medical decision making. Our benchmark and results reveal a novel and substantial gap in how LLMs perform under the conditions of real-world health communication, highlighting critical safety concerns for patient-facing medical AI systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/srsambara-1/MedRedFlag.
papers.abstract_zh: 现实世界中的患者健康问题往往隐含着错误的假设或前提。在这种情况下，安全的医疗沟通通常需要对这些问题进行纠正：先纠正其中的误解，然后再针对患者的实际情况作出回应，而不是直接回答最初的问题。虽然大语言模型被普通用户越来越多地用于获取医疗建议，但它们在应对这种关键能力方面尚未得到充分测试。因此，在这项研究中，我们探讨了大语言模型对于现实世界健康问题中隐含的错误前提的反应情况。我们开发了一个半自动的流程来整理MedRedFlag数据集，该数据集包含来自Reddit的1100多个需要纠正的问题。然后，我们系统地比较了先进的大语言模型和临床医生的回答。分析结果显示，即使能够识别出问题前提，大语言模型也常常无法纠正这些问题，并且给出的答案可能导致不理想的医疗决策。我们的基准测试和结果揭示了大语言模型在现实世界医疗沟通中的表现存在显著缺陷，这凸显了面向患者的医疗人工智能系统面临的重要安全隐患。代码和数据可访问于https://github.com/srsambara-1/MedRedFlag。

papers.title: Can VLMs Predict Future States? Bootstrapping World Models from Inverse Dynamics
papers.title_zh: 虚拟世界模型能够预测未来的状态吗？从逆向动力学出发构建世界模型
papers.authors: Yifu Qiu, Yftah Ziser, Anna Korhonen, Shay B Cohen, Edoardo Ponti
papers.abstract: Can unified vision–language models (VLMs) perform forward dynamics prediction (FDP), i.e., predicting the future state (in image form) given the previous observation and an action (in language form)? We find that VLMs struggle to generate physically plausible transitions between frames from instructions. Nevertheless, we identify a crucial asymmetry in multimodal grounding: fine-tuning a VLM to learn inverse dynamics prediction (IDP)—effectively captioning the action between frames—is significantly easier than learning FDP. In turn, IDP can be used to bootstrap FDP through two main strategies: 1) weakly supervised learning from synthetic data and 2) inference time verification. Firstly, IDP can annotate actions for unlabelled pairs of video frame observations to expand the training data scale for FDP. Secondly, IDP can assign rewards to multiple samples of FDP to score them, effectively guiding search at inference time. We evaluate the FDP resulting from both strategies through the task of action-centric image editing on Aurora-Bench with two families of VLMs. Despite remaining general-purpose, our best model achieves a performance competitive with state-of-the-art image editing models, improving on them by a margin of 15% on real-world subsets according to GPT4o-as-judge, and achieving the best average human evaluation across all subsets of Aurora-Bench.
papers.abstract_zh: 统一的视觉-语言模型是否能够进行前向动态预测，即根据之前的观测数据和某个动作，来预测未来的状态（以图像形式呈现）？我们发现，这些模型在从指令中生成帧与帧之间物理上合理的转换时存在困难。不过，我们发现了多模态接地中的一个关键不对称现象：微调一个视觉-语言模型来学习逆向动态预测——也就是为帧与帧之间的动作添加描述——比学习前向动态预测要容易得多。反过来，逆向动态预测可以通过两种主要策略来引导前向动态预测：1）从合成数据中进行弱监督学习；2）通过推理时间验证来实现。首先，逆向动态预测可以为未标注的视频帧对标注动作，从而扩大前向动态预测的训练数据规模。其次，逆向动态预测可以为多个前向动态预测样本分配奖励，从而有效地指导推理时的搜索过程。我们通过在Aurora-Bench上进行以动作为中心的图像编辑任务，使用两款视觉-语言模型来评估这两种策略所得到的前向动态预测结果。尽管我们的模型仍然具有通用性，但最好的模型在性能上可以与最先进的图像编辑模型相媲美。根据GPT4o-as-judge的评估，该模型在真实世界的数据集上的表现提升了15%，并且在Aurora-Bench的所有数据集中都取得了最佳的人类评估成绩。

papers.title: PL-MTEB: Polish Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
papers.title_zh: PL-MTEB：波兰大规模文本嵌入基准测试
papers.authors: Rafał Poświata, Sławomir Dadas, Michał Wiktor Perełkiewicz
papers.abstract: In this paper, we introduce the Polish Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (PL-MTEB), a comprehensive benchmark for text embeddings in the Polish language. PL-MTEB comprises 30 diverse NLP tasks across five categories: classification, clustering, pair classification, information retrieval, and semantic text similarity. Within the scope of this work, we added 12 new Polish-language tasks to MTEB based on existing datasets and prepared two new datasets used to create four clustering tasks. We evaluated 30 publicly available text embedding models, including Polish and multilingual models. We analyzed the results in detail for specific task types and model sizes. We made the prepared datasets, the source code for evaluation, and the obtained results available to the public at https://github.com/rafalposwiata/pl-mteb.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了波兰大规模文本嵌入基准测试（PL-MTEB），这是一个针对波兰语文本嵌入的综合性基准测试。PL-MTEB包含30个不同的自然语言处理任务，涵盖五个类别：分类、聚类、成对分类、信息检索以及语义文本相似性。在本研究中，我们根据现有的数据集增加了12个新的波兰语任务，并准备了两个新的数据集，用于创建四个聚类任务。我们评估了30种公开可用的文本嵌入模型，包括波兰语模型和多语言模型。我们对特定任务类型和模型规模的结果进行了详细分析。我们将准备好的数据集、评估代码以及获得的结果发布在https://github.com/rafalposwiata/pl-mteb上，供公众查阅。

papers.title: RubRIX: Rubric-Driven Risk Mitigation in Caregiver-AI Interactions
papers.title_zh: RubRIX：在护工与人工智能交互中采用评分驱动的风险缓解机制
papers.authors: Drishti Goel, Jeongah Lee, Qiuyue Zhong, Violeta J. Rodriguez, Daniel S. Brown, Ravi Karkar, Dong Whi Yoo, Koustuv Saha
papers.abstract: Caregivers seeking AI-mediated support express complex needs—information-seeking, emotional validation, and distress cues—that warrant careful evaluation of response safety and appropriateness. Existing AI evaluation frameworks, primarily focused on general risks (toxicity, hallucinations, policy violations, etc) may not adequately capture the nuanced risks of LLM-responses in caregiving-contexts. We introduce RubRIX (Rubric-based Risk Index), a theory-driven, clinician-validated framework for evaluating risks in LLM caregiving responses. Grounded in the Elements of an Ethic of Care, RubRIX operationalizes five empirically-derived risk dimensions: Inattention, Bias Stigma, Information Inaccuracy, Uncritical Affirmation, and Epistemic Arrogance. We evaluate six state-of-the-art LLMs on over 20,000 caregiver queries from Reddit and ALZConnected. Rubric-guided refinement consistently reduced risk-components by 45-98% after one iteration across models. This work contributes a methodological approach for developing domain-sensitive, user-centered evaluation frameworks for high-burden contexts. Our findings highlight the importance of domain-sensitive, interactional risk evaluation for the responsible deployment of LLMs in caregiving support contexts. We release benchmark datasets to enable future research on contextual risk evaluation in AI-mediated support.
papers.abstract_zh: 寻求人工智能辅助的护理人员面临着复杂的需求——包括信息查询、情感支持以及情绪困扰等。因此，需要仔细评估这些需求的响应安全性和适宜性。现有的人工智能评估框架主要关注的是一般风险（如毒性、幻觉、政策违规等），但这些框架可能无法充分反映在护理场景中由大语言模型产生的细微风险。我们提出了RubRIX这一基于标准的风险评估框架，该框架以理论为基础，经过临床验证，用于评估大语言模型在护理场景中的风险。RubRIX依据“护理伦理要素”构建，涵盖了五个基于实证的风险维度：注意力缺失、偏见歧视、信息不准确、不加批判的肯定行为以及认知傲慢。我们对来自Reddit和ALZConnected的2万多个护理相关查询对6种先进的大语言模型进行了评估。结果显示，通过标准指导下的优化，模型的风险成分在单次迭代后减少了45%到98%。这项工作为开发适用于高负担情境的、以用户为中心的评估框架提供了方法上的支持。我们的研究结果强调了在护理场景中负责任地使用大语言模型时，进行领域敏感且交互式的风险评估的重要性。我们还发布了基准数据集，以便未来能够开展关于人工智能辅助支持中情境风险评估的研究。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Spectral Gravity Formant Estimation for Phonetic Segmentation
papers.title_zh: 用于语音分割的频谱重力频率估计方法
papers.authors: Michael S. Yantosca, Albert M. K. Cheng
papers.abstract: Recent automated transcription systems have focused on end-to-end orthographic approaches driven by deep neural networks and sequence-to-sequence transformers. Growing public interest in transcription at the phonemic or phonetic level has led to re-purposing these systems to segment and identify phones, the basic sounds which comprise human speech. However, they miss the mark on a fundamental component of time-series analysis, namely time. For linguistic applications which require high fidelity in the temporal domain, the loss of timing information is untenable. Our work proposes a deadline-bounded expectation maximization (EM) algorithm with a novel initialization method to estimate formants, i.e., salient speech frequencies, for enhanced phonetic segmentation. Based on the concept of spectral gravity, i.e., treating spectral energy as mass attenuated by the square of frequency distance across the spectrum, our technique outperforms the recent state of the art on key clustering metrics, generating reasonable alignments across multiple languages with no a priori training.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的自动化转录系统主要依赖于深度神经网络和序列到序列变换器所驱动的端到端正字法方法。公众对音素或语音层面转录技术的兴趣日益浓厚，这促使人们重新利用这些系统来分割和识别构成人类语音的基本声音——音位。然而，这些系统在时间序列分析的一个基本要素上有所欠缺，那就是时间。对于需要在时间域上实现高精度的语言应用来说，丢失时间信息是不可接受的。我们的研究提出了一种基于截止时间的期望最大化算法，并采用了一种新的初始化方法，以估计共振峰，即那些具有显著性的语音频率，从而实现更精确的语音分割。基于频谱重力概念的技术，即把频谱能量视为由频谱上频率距离的平方所衰减的质量，我们的技术在关键聚类指标上优于当前最先进的方法，能够在无需预先训练的情况下，实现多种语言之间的合理对齐。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Listen, Pause, and Reason: Toward Perception-Grounded Hybrid Reasoning for Audio Understanding
papers.title_zh: 倾听、暂停、推理：迈向基于感知的混合推理方法，以实现音频理解
papers.authors: Jieyi Wang, Yazhe Niu, Dexuan Xu, Zhongyu Wei
papers.abstract: Recent Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) have shown strong capabilities in audio understanding, yet their reasoning remains vulnerable to perceptual errors, especially in noisy and multi-speaker environments. We argue that reliable audio reasoning requires first grounding model’s perception in structured auditory scenes. Motivated by Auditory Scene Analysis, we introduce PAQA, a large-scale dataset for Perception-Aware Question Answering covering over 300 categories. PAQA adopts a hierarchical decoupling strategy that separates speech from environmental sounds and distinguishes among multiple speakers, providing explicit perceptual supervision for audio reasoning. Building on this, we propose HyPeR, a two-stage Hybrid Perception-Reasoning framework for perception-grounded audio understanding. In Stage I, the model is fine-tuned on PAQA for cold start to improve perception of acoustic attributes in complex auditory scenes. In Stage II, we further refine its internal reasoning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To support deliberation under acoustic ambiguity, we introduce PAUSE tokens for latent computation and a Perceptual Consistency Reward to align reasoning rationales with the underlying audio evidence. Extensive ablation studies isolate the effects of the perception-attention mechanism, self-correction module, and pause-based reasoning strategy. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that HyPeR consistently improves over the base model, including on MMAU-mini (+13.1%), MMAR (+25.5%), and PAQA (+28.2%), while achieving performance comparable to much larger models. Additional analyses of inference latency and computational overhead show that these gains come with acceptable efficiency trade-offs. Overall, our results demonstrate the effectiveness of hybrid perception-grounded reasoning for robust audio understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近出现的大型音频语言模型在音频理解方面展现出了强大的能力，然而它们的推理仍然容易受到感知误差的影响，尤其是在嘈杂或多声源的环境中。我们认为，可靠的音频推理首先需要将模型的感知能力建立在结构化的听觉场景之上。基于听觉场景分析的思想，我们提出了PAQA这一大规模的数据集，该数据集涵盖了超过300个类别，用于感知驱动的问答任务。PAQA采用了一种分层分离策略，将语音与环境声音分开，并能够区分多个说话者，为音频推理提供了明确的感知监督。在此基础上，我们提出了HyPeR这一两阶段混合感知-推理框架，用于基于感知的音频理解。在第一阶段，模型在PAQA数据集上进行微调，以克服冷启动问题，从而更好地感知复杂听觉场景中的声学属性。在第二阶段，我们通过群体相对策略优化技术来进一步完善其内部推理能力。为了支持在声学不确定性下的推理，我们引入了PAUSE标记用于潜在计算，以及感知一致性奖励机制，以将推理逻辑与底层音频证据保持一致。大量的实验表明，HyPeR在多个基准测试中的表现均优于基础模型，包括在MMAU-mini、MMAR和PAQA上的性能提升分别达到了+13.1%、+25.5%和+28.2%，同时其性能与一些更大规模的模型相当。此外，对推理延迟和计算开销的分析表明，这些改进是在可接受的效率折衷下实现的。总体而言，我们的研究结果证明了混合感知驱动推理在稳健音频理解方面的有效性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DeFrame: Debiasing Large Language Models Against Framing Effects
papers.title_zh: DeFrame：消除大型语言模型中的偏见，以应对框架效应问题
papers.authors: Kahee Lim, Soyeon Kim, Steven Euijong Whang
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, ensuring their fair responses across demographics has become crucial. Despite many efforts, an ongoing challenge is hidden bias: LLMs appear fair under standard evaluations, but can produce biased responses outside those evaluation settings. In this paper, we identify framing – differences in how semantically equivalent prompts are expressed (e.g., “A is better than B” vs. “B is worse than A”) – as an underexplored contributor to this gap. We first introduce the concept of “framing disparity” to quantify the impact of framing on fairness evaluation. By augmenting fairness evaluation benchmarks with alternative framings, we find that (1) fairness scores vary significantly with framing and (2) existing debiasing methods improve overall (i.e., frame-averaged) fairness, but often fail to reduce framing-induced disparities. To address this, we propose a framing-aware debiasing method that encourages LLMs to be more consistent across framings. Experiments demonstrate that our approach reduces overall bias and improves robustness against framing disparities, enabling LLMs to produce fairer and more consistent responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在现实世界中的应用日益广泛，确保它们在不同人群中的响应公平性变得至关重要。尽管已经付出了许多努力，但一个持续的挑战是隐藏的偏见：在标准评估下，LLM似乎表现得很公平，但在非评估环境中却可能产生有偏见的响应。在本文中，我们将“框架差异”作为导致这种差距的一个未被充分研究的因素进行了研究。我们首先引入了“框架差异”这一概念，以量化框架对公平性评估的影响。通过为公平性评估基准添加不同的框架，我们发现：(1)公平性得分会随着框架的不同而显著变化；(2)现有的去偏见方法能够改善整体公平性（即经过框架平均处理后的公平性），但通常无法减少由框架引起的差异。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种考虑框架因素的去偏见方法，该方法鼓励LLM在不同的框架下保持一致性。实验表明，我们的方法能够有效降低整体偏见，并提高对框架差异的鲁棒性，从而使LLM能够产生更公平、更一致的响应。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Idea First, Code Later: Disentangling Problem Solving from Code Generation in Evaluating LLMs for Competitive Programming
papers.title_zh: 先思考思路，再编写代码：在评估大语言模型用于编程竞赛时，如何将解题思路与代码生成分离开来
papers.authors: Sama Hadhoud, Alaa Elsetohy, Frederikus Hudi, Jan Christian Blaise Cruz, Steven Halim, Alham Fikri Aji
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly succeed on competitive programming problems, yet existing evaluations conflate algorithmic reasoning with code-level implementation. We argue that competitive programming is fundamentally a problem-solving task and propose centering natural-language editorials in both solution generation and evaluation. Generating an editorial prior to code improves solve rates for some LLMs, with substantially larger gains when using expertly written gold editorials. However, even with gold editorials, models continue to struggle with implementation, while the gap between generated and gold editorials reveals a persistent problem-solving bottleneck in specifying correct and complete algorithms. Beyond pass/fail metrics, we diagnose reasoning errors by comparing model-generated editorials to gold standards using expert annotations and validate an LLM-as-a-judge protocol for scalable evaluation. We introduce a dataset of 83 ICPC-style problems with gold editorials and full test suites, and evaluate 19 LLMs, arguing that future benchmarks should explicitly separate problem solving from implementation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在竞争性编程问题中表现得越来越出色，然而现有的评估方法将算法推理与代码实现混在一起了。我们认为，竞争性编程本质上是一个解决问题的任务，因此建议将自然语言评论文献的评估集中在解决方案生成和验证两个方面。在某些语言模型中，先生成评论文献再编写代码可以提高解决问题的效率，而当使用由专家撰写的优秀评论文献时，效果更为显著。不过，即便使用了优秀评论文献，模型在代码实现方面仍然存在困难，而生成评论文献与优秀评论文献之间的差距表明，在指定正确且完整的算法方面仍然存在问题。除了通过通过/失败指标来评估之外，我们还通过对比模型生成的评论文献与专家标注的优秀评论文献来诊断推理错误，并验证了将语言模型作为评估工具的可扩展性。我们引入了一个包含83个ICP风格问题的数据集，这些问题中都包含了优秀评论文献以及完整的测试套件。我们对19种语言模型进行了评估，认为未来的基准测试应该明确区分问题解决与代码实现这两个方面。

papers.title: LLMs in the Real World: Evaluating “AI” in Emergency Contexts
papers.title_zh: 现实中的大型语言模型：在紧急情境下评估“人工智能”的性能
papers.authors: Sara Court, Lara Downing, Micha Elsner
papers.abstract: This paper offers a call to action. We urge our colleagues in the research community to play a greater role in the articulation of our findings to the public. To illustrate the stakes we present a case study on the initial stages of an LLM-based machine translation application’s deployment in a real-world context: a text-2-911 system advertising capabilities in 55 languages for use in emergencies in which it may be difficult to call operators directly. We identify a number of common misconceptions about technologies such as these, concluding with a set of concrete recommendations and best practices for stakeholders at every stage of the development and deployment pipeline. While the advancement of scientific research often lies in solving the “hard” problems, we argue it is often the “easy” ones— problems for which the latest technology is often unnecessary— that are most overlooked.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文呼吁大家采取行动。我们敦促研究领域的同行们在向公众传达研究成果方面发挥更大的作用。为了说明这个问题的严重性，我们以一个案例研究为例，介绍基于大语言模型的机器翻译应用程序在现实世界中的初步应用情况：该系统能够翻译文本为911对应的语言，适用于那些无法直接联系操作员的紧急情况。我们发现，关于这类技术存在许多常见的误解，最后我们提出了一些具体的建议和最佳实践，以帮助开发者和部署过程中的各方参与者。虽然科学研究的进步往往在于解决“难题”，但我们认为，那些因技术过于复杂而常常被忽视的“简单问题”却往往被忽视了。

papers.title: A Survey of Toxicity Mitigation Strategies for Multilingual Language Models
papers.title_zh: 关于多语言模型毒性缓解策略的研究综述
papers.authors: Soham Dan, Himanshu Beniwal, Thomas Hartvigsen
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are transforming natural language processing across diverse linguistic communities. However, they can reproduce and amplify toxic content, including hate speech, harassment, and bias, posing significant risks to multilingual applications. We provide the first comprehensive survey of the many detoxification methods specifically tailored to multilingual LLMs. First, we define toxicity its measurement, then we provide a brief review of monolingual mitigation strategies, including data filtering, style transfer, expert-based logit steering, retrieval augmentation, and alignment with human feedback. We then present an in-depth taxonomy of multilingual approaches spanning (1) training methods, (2) post-hoc editing and decoding strategies, (3) alignment and reinforcement-learning techniques, and (4) data-centric innovations, such as parallel detox corpora and synthetic data generation. Finally, we discuss open challenges in multilingual detoxification, including data scarcity, evaluation inconsistencies, cultural nuances and biases. Overall, we produce a needed overview of the state of multi-lingual toxicity detection and mitigation on which the community can ground to build globally safe and equitable LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正在改变不同语言社区中的自然语言处理技术。然而，这些模型可能会复制和放大有害内容，包括仇恨言论、骚扰以及偏见行为，这对多语言应用构成了重大风险。我们首次全面总结了针对多语言语言模型设计的多种解毒方法。首先，我们定义了“毒性”及其衡量标准，然后简要回顾了单语言环境下的缓解策略，包括数据过滤、风格转换、基于专家的逻辑斯蒂引导、检索增强技术以及与人类反馈的对齐方法。接着，我们深入分析了多语言环境下的各种方法分类，涵盖训练方法、后期编辑与解码策略、对齐与强化学习技术，以及以数据为核心的创新方法，如并行解毒语料库和合成数据生成技术。最后，我们讨论了多语言解毒过程中面临的挑战，包括数据稀缺性、评估一致性问题、文化差异及偏见等。总体而言，我们提供了关于多语言毒性检测与缓解技术的必要概述，这将有助于社区构建全球范围内安全且公平的语言模型。

papers.title: LLM-KT: Enhancing Large Language Models with Knowledge Tracing via Multi-Level Plug-and-Play Alignment
papers.title_zh: LLM-KT：通过多层插件式对齐技术，提升大型语言模型的知识追踪能力
papers.authors: Ziwei Wang, Jie Zhou, Qin Chen, Bo Jiang, Qingchun Bai, Liang Dou, Liang He
papers.abstract: Knowledge Tracing (KT) is a pivotal task in personalized education, aiming to predict students’ future performance based on their historical interactions. While prior work has focused on learning behavioral sequences using question IDs or surface-level textual features, these methods often fail to capture complex behavioral patterns due to a lack of deep reasoning capabilities and world knowledge. To address this, we propose LLM-KT, a novel framework that integrates the reasoning power of Large Language Models (LLMs) with the sequential modeling strengths of traditional KT methods via multi-level plug-and-play alignment. Specifically, for task-level alignment, we design a plug-and-play instruction to leverage the rich knowledge and reasoning capacity of LLMs for the KT objective. For modality-level alignment, we introduce two mechanisms to integrate representations learned by traditional methods: (1) a Semantic History Projector that flexibly inserts compressed context embeddings into LLMs using question- and concept-specific tokens to capture long-term history; and (2) a Behavioral Dynamics Projector that enhances LLMs with sequential interaction patterns via a sequence adapter. Extensive experiments on four standard datasets demonstrate that LLM-KT achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming over 20 competitive baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing，KT）是个性化教育中的一个关键任务，其目标是基于学生过去的行为互动来预测他们未来的表现。虽然之前的研究主要集中在利用问题标识或表面文本特征来学习行为序列，但这些方法往往由于缺乏深度推理能力和对世界的理解而无法捕捉复杂的行为模式。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了LLM-KT这一创新框架。该框架将大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力与传统KT方法的序列建模优势相结合，通过多层次的可插拔对齐方式实现融合。具体来说，在任务级对齐方面，我们设计了一种可插拔的教学方法，利用LLM丰富的知识和推理能力来实现KT目标。在模态级对齐方面，我们引入了两种机制来整合传统方法所学习的表示：第一种是语义历史投影器，它能够使用与问题和概念相关的标记，灵活地将压缩后的上下文嵌入插入到LLM中，从而捕捉长期的历史信息；第二种是行为动态投影器，它通过序列适配器来增强LLM对序列交互模式的处理能力。在四个标准数据集上的广泛实验表明，LLM-KT取得了领先的性能，远远超过了20个竞争基准模型。
