papers.title: Fast-Decoding Diffusion Language Models via Progress-Aware Confidence Schedules
papers.title_zh: 基于进度感知置信度调度的高效解码扩散语言模型
papers.authors: Amr Mohamed, Yang Zhang, Michalis Vazirgiannis, Guokan Shang
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive models, but their practical utility is severely hampered by slow, iterative sampling. We present SchED, a training-free, model-agnostic early-exit algorithm that terminates diffusion decoding using a progress-aware confidence threshold. We evaluate SchED across multiple diffusion model families and a diverse set of benchmarks spanning multiple-choice, math, long-form QA, and translation. SchED delivers substantial acceleration: on instruction-tuned models, it achieves approximately 4\times speedups while retaining baseline performance on average. On base models, SchED yields consistent speedup gains with 99.1–100% performance retention, with up to 2.34\times under more aggressive settings. Under a conservative quality–penalized speed metric, SchED consistently outperforms prior confidence-based early-exit methods, including on long-form generation where existing approaches tend to break down. An entropy analysis of the model’s token predictions reveals that instruction tuning speeds up the decay of predictive entropy. By leveraging inherent confidence stabilization as a signal for computational efficiency, SchED provides a robust framework for efficient dLLM inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型（dLLMs）为自回归模型提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但其实际应用受到了缓慢、迭代采样过程的严重限制。我们提出了SchED这一无需训练的、与模型无关的提前终止算法，该算法通过基于进度意识的置信度阈值来终止扩散解码过程。我们在多个扩散模型家族以及涵盖多项测试任务中评估了SchED的性能，这些任务包括选择题、数学题、长文本问答和翻译任务。SchED带来了显著的加速效果：对于经过指令调优的模型，其加速效果可达约4倍，同时平均保持了与基线模型相当的性能水平。对于基础模型，SchED同样能带来稳定的加速效果，且性能保留率高达99.1%-100%，在更激进的设置下，加速效果可高达2.34倍。在保守的质量惩罚速度指标下，SchED始终优于现有的基于置信度的提前终止方法，尤其是在长文本生成任务上，现有方法往往难以胜任。对模型token预测结果的熵分析表明，指令调优能够加速预测熵的衰减。通过利用固有的置信度稳定机制作为计算效率的信号，SchED为高效的dLLM推理提供了一个稳健的框架。

papers.title: When Cultures Meet: Multicultural Text-to-Image Generation
papers.title_zh: 当不同文化相遇：多元文化背景下的文本转图像生成技术
papers.authors: Parth Bhalerao, Mounika Yalamarty, Brian Trinh, Oana Ignat
papers.abstract: Text-to-image generation models have achieved strong performance in culturally homogeneous settings, yet their ability to generate multicultural scenes—where people and landmarks originate from different cultures—remains largely unexplored. We introduce multicultural text-to-image generation as a new task and present the first benchmark designed to study this setting. Our dataset contains 9,000 images spanning five countries, three age groups, two genders, 25 historical landmarks, and five languages. Using this benchmark, we analyze the behavior of state-of-the-art text-to-image models across multiple dimensions, including alignment, image quality, aesthetics, knowledge, and fairness. As one strategy for composing cultural and demographic information, we explore MosAIG, a Multi-Agent framework that enhances multicultural image generation by leveraging large language models with distinct cultural personas. Our analysis shows that richer prompt composition can improve image quality and cultural grounding compared to simple prompts, while also revealing substantial disparities across languages and demographic groups. We release our dataset and code at https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MosAIG
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到图像生成模型在文化同质的环境中表现优异，然而它们在生成多元文化场景方面的能力——即场景中人物和地标来自不同文化背景的情况——仍然鲜有研究。我们将多元文化文本到图像生成视为一项新的任务，并提出了首个用于研究这一领域的基准数据集。我们的数据集包含9,000张图片，涵盖五个国家、三个年龄组、两种性别、25个历史地标以及五种语言。通过这个基准数据集，我们分析了最先进的文本到图像模型在多个方面的表现，包括对齐性、图像质量、美学效果、知识水平以及公平性。作为组合文化和人口信息的一种策略，我们探索了MosAIG这一多智能体框架，该框架通过利用具有不同文化特性的大语言模型来提升多元文化图像的生成效果。我们的分析表明，更丰富的提示信息可以提高图像质量和文化深度，同时还能发现不同语言和人口群体之间的显著差异。我们的数据集和代码可以在https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MosAIG下载。

papers.title: Aligning with Your Own Voice: Self-Corrected Preference Learning for Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
papers.title_zh: 以自我声音来协调行为：用于降低幻象的自动修正偏好学习机制在大型语言模型中的应用
papers.authors: Byeonggeuk Lim, JungMin Yun, Junehyoung Kwon, Kyeonghyun Kim, YoungBin Kim
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) frequently suffer from hallucinations. Existing preference learning-based approaches largely rely on proprietary models to construct preference datasets. We identify that this reliance introduces a distributional mismatch between the proprietary and target models that hinders efficient alignment. To address this, we propose Alignment via VErified Self-correction DPO (AVES-DPO), a framework that aligns LVLMs using in-distribution data derived from the model’s intrinsic knowledge. Our approach employs a consensus-based verification mechanism to diagnose diverse hallucinations and guides the model to self-correct, thereby generating preference pairs strictly compatible with its internal distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AVES-DPO surpasses existing baselines in hallucination mitigation while requiring only 5.2k samples.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）经常会出现幻觉问题。现有的基于偏好学习的方法大多依赖专有模型来构建偏好数据集。我们发现，这种依赖关系会导致专有模型与目标模型之间的分布不匹配，从而阻碍高效的模型对齐。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“通过验证的自校正DPO”的框架（AVES-DPO），该框架利用模型自身知识派生出的数据来实现LVLMs的对齐。我们的方法采用基于共识的验证机制来诊断各种幻觉现象，并引导模型进行自我修正，从而生成与其内部分布严格一致的偏好对。大量实验表明，AVES-DPO在减少幻觉方面优于现有的基线方法，同时仅需要5.2千个样本即可实现目标。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: VocalRep: Structure-Aware Vocal Representations for Multimodal Generation
papers.title_zh: VocalRep：用于多模态生成的基于结构感知的声学表示方法
papers.authors: Da Shen, Zhenqiang Weng, Tianyu Liu, Gongyu Chen, Runhua Shi, Jiahui Chen, Chaofan Ding, Wei-Qiang Zhang, Zihao Chen
papers.abstract: Modern speech and multimodal generation systems, such as singing voice conversion and audio-driven lip synchronization, critically depend on temporally stable and semantically unambiguous vocal representations. In practical pipelines, such representations are typically derived from music source separation (MSS) applied to mixed musical recordings. However, standard MSS paradigms often aggregate lead vocals and backing harmonies into a single vocal stream. Although multi-stem separation has been explored, existing approaches remain primarily optimized for signal-level reconstruction, often overlooking the intricate structural disentanglement required by downstream generation tasks. From a generation-oriented perspective, this motivates revisiting vocal separation from a representation learning standpoint. To this end, we propose VocalRep, a structure-aware learning framework designed to disentangle lead vocals, harmonies, and accompaniment while enforcing role consistency across long-form audio. By integrating global vocal identity conditioning with ranking-based objectives, VocalRep extracts role-consistent lead vocal representations without relying on explicit pitch or symbolic annotations. Experimental results demonstrate that VocalRep significantly improves performance in downstream singing voice conversion and audio-driven lip synchronization.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代语音和多模态生成系统，如歌声转换和音频驱动的嘴唇同步技术，非常依赖于在时间上稳定且语义上明确的声音表示。在实际的处理流程中，这种表示通常是通过对混合音乐录音进行音乐源分离得到的。然而，标准的音乐源分离方法往往会将主唱和和声合并为单一的声道。虽然已经探索了多声部分离的方法，但现有的方法主要侧重于信号级别的重建，常常忽略了后续生成任务所需的复杂结构解耦。从生成的角度出发，这促使我们从表示学习的角度出发重新审视声音分离问题。为此，我们提出了VocalRep框架，这是一个注重结构的解耦学习框架，旨在分离主唱、和声和伴奏，同时确保在长音频中保持角色的一致性。通过结合全局声音身份条件化和基于排名的目标，VocalRep能够提取出符合角色要求的主唱表示，而无需依赖显式的音高或符号注释。实验结果表明，VocalRep在后续的歌声转换和音频驱动的嘴唇同步任务中显著提升了性能。

papers.title: RealSec-bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Secure Code Generation in Real-World Repositories
papers.title_zh: RealSec-bench：用于评估实际环境中安全代码生成能力的基准测试工具
papers.authors: Yanlin Wang, Ziyao Zhang, Chong Wang, Xinyi Xu, Mingwei Liu, Yong Wang, Jiachi Chen, Zibin Zheng
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in code generation, but their proficiency in producing secure code remains a critical, under-explored area. Existing benchmarks often fall short by relying on synthetic vulnerabilities or evaluating functional correctness in isolation, failing to capture the complex interplay between functionality and security found in real-world software. To address this gap, we introduce RealSec-bench, a new benchmark for secure code generation meticulously constructed from real-world, high-risk Java repositories. Our methodology employs a multi-stage pipeline that combines systematic SAST scanning with CodeQL, LLM-based false positive elimination, and rigorous human expert validation. The resulting benchmark contains 105 instances grounded in real-word repository contexts, spanning 19 Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) types and exhibiting a wide diversity of data flow complexities, including vulnerabilities with up to 34-hop inter-procedural dependencies. Using RealSec-bench, we conduct an extensive empirical study on 5 popular LLMs. We introduce a novel composite metric, SecurePass@K, to assess both functional correctness and security simultaneously. We find that while Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques can improve functional correctness, they provide negligible benefits to security. Furthermore, explicitly prompting models with general security guidelines often leads to compilation failures, harming functional correctness without reliably preventing vulnerabilities. Our work highlights the gap between functional and secure code generation in current LLMs. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/Realsec-code-Bench.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在代码生成方面展现出了卓越的能力，但其在生成安全代码方面的表现仍然是一个亟待解决的问题。现有的评估基准往往依赖于合成漏洞或单独评估功能正确性，无法捕捉到现实世界软件中功能与安全之间的复杂关系。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了RealSec-bench这一新的安全代码生成基准测试，该基准测试严格基于真实世界的高风险Java代码库构建。我们的方法采用多阶段流程，结合了系统的静态安全分析扫描、CodeQL技术、基于语言模型的误报排除以及严格的人工专家验证。最终的基准测试包含105个基于真实代码库情境的实例，涵盖了19种常见弱点枚举类型，数据流的复杂性也各不相同，其中包括具有多达34层过程间依赖关系的漏洞。通过使用RealSec-bench，我们对5种流行的语言模型进行了广泛的实证研究。我们引入了一种新的综合指标SecurePass@K，用于同时评估功能正确性和安全性。我们发现，虽然检索增强生成技术可以提高功能正确性，但对安全性的提升效果微乎其微。此外，明确地向模型提供通用安全指南通常会导致编译失败，从而损害功能正确性，同时无法有效防止漏洞的出现。我们的研究揭示了当前语言模型在功能代码生成与安全代码生成之间的差距。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/Realsec-code-Bench下载。

papers.title: InfiAgent: An Infinite-Horizon Framework for General-Purpose Autonomous Agents
papers.title_zh: InfiAgent：一种适用于通用自主智能体的无限视野框架
papers.authors: Chenglin Yu, Yuchen Wang, Songmiao Wang, Hongxia Yang, Li Ming
papers.abstract: LLM agents can reason and use tools, but they often break down on long-horizon tasks due to unbounded context growth and accumulated errors. Common remedies such as context compression or retrieval-augmented prompting introduce trade-offs between information fidelity and reasoning stability. We present InfiAgent, a general-purpose framework that keeps the agent’s reasoning context strictly bounded regardless of task duration by externalizing persistent state into a file-centric state abstraction. At each step, the agent reconstructs context from a workspace state snapshot plus a fixed window of recent actions. Experiments on DeepResearch and an 80-paper literature review task show that, without task-specific fine-tuning, InfiAgent with a 20B open-source model is competitive with larger proprietary systems and maintains substantially higher long-horizon coverage than context-centric baselines. These results support explicit state externalization as a practical foundation for stable long-horizon agents.
papers.abstract_zh: LLM智能体能够进行推理并使用各种工具，但在处理长期任务时往往会遇到困难，因为上下文不断扩展且累积了大量错误。常见的解决方案如上下文压缩或增强检索的提示方式，都会在信息准确性和推理稳定性之间做出权衡。我们提出了InfiAgent这一通用框架，该框架通过将持久状态外化到以文件为中心的状态抽象中，从而确保智能体的推理上下文在任何任务持续时间下都保持有限。在每个步骤中，智能体会从工作空间状态的快照以及最近的一系列动作中重建上下文。在DeepResearch和一项包含80篇论文的文献综述任务上的实验表明，无需针对特定任务进行微调，拥有20B开源模型的InfiAgent就能与大型专有系统竞争，并且其长期覆盖能力明显优于以上下文为中心的基线系统。这些结果支持了将显式状态外化作为稳定长期智能体实用基础的理念。

papers.title: Efficient and Effective Internal Memory Retrieval for LLM-Based Healthcare Prediction
papers.title_zh: 针对基于大语言模型的医疗预测任务，实现高效且有效的内部记忆检索机制
papers.authors: Mingchen Li, Jiatan Huang, Zonghai Yao, Hong yu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) hold significant promise for healthcare, yet their reliability in high-stakes clinical settings is often compromised by hallucinations and a lack of granular medical context. While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can mitigate these issues, standard supervised pipelines require computationally intensive searches over massive external knowledge bases, leading to high latency that is impractical for time-sensitive care. To address this, we introduce Keys-to-Knowledge (K2K), a novel framework that replaces external retrieval with internal, key-based knowledge access. By encoding essential clinical information directly into the model’s parameter space, K2K enables rapid retrieval from internal key–value memory without inference-time overhead. We further enhance retrieval quality through activation-guided probe construction and cross-attention reranking. Experimental results demonstrate that K2K achieves state-of-the-art performance across four benchmark healthcare outcome prediction datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在医疗保健领域具有巨大的潜力，然而它们在高风险的临床环境中的可靠性往往受到幻觉和缺乏详细医疗信息的限制。虽然检索增强生成技术可以缓解这些问题，但传统的监督式处理方式需要大量计算资源来搜索庞大的外部知识库，这会导致极高的延迟，这对于需要快速响应的医疗场景来说是不切实际的。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“键到知识”的新框架。该框架用基于关键点的内部知识访问替代了外部检索方式。通过将重要的临床信息直接编码到模型的参数空间中，K2K能够在不增加推理时间开销的情况下快速从内部键值记忆中获取信息。此外，我们还通过激活引导的探针构建和交叉注意力重排序技术提升了检索质量。实验结果表明，K2K在四个基准医疗结果预测数据集上取得了领先的性能表现。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GAVEL: Evidence-Contract Debate with Mechanized Scrutiny for Provenance-Grounded Fact-Checking
papers.title_zh: 加韦尔：基于证据的合同讨论与机械化审查技术在验证事实真实性方面的应用
papers.authors: Ruoyu Xu, Gaoxiang Li, Victor S. Sheng
papers.abstract: Evidence-grounded fact-checking requires predicting claim veracity while returning faithful evidence at fine granularity, including exact sentences, table cells, and complete multi-document chains. Although large language models enable decomposition, planning, and multi-agent verification, they can still produce convincing rationales with weak provenance, especially under heterogeneous evidence and multi-hop requirements. We propose GAVEL, a multi-agent debate framework that enforces evidence grounding throughout inference. GAVEL introduces an Evidence Contract that requires debaters to state atomic subclaims and bind each to explicit evidence units, and a Mechanized Chain of Scrutiny in which a neutral Scrutinizer audits outputs and performs deterministic validation of cited identifiers and quoted spans. A Judge then selects a sufficient evidence set and produces the final decision. Experiments on FEVEROUS and HOVER in an open-book setting show that GAVEL improves provenance-aware metrics that jointly require correct labels and correct, complete evidence over strong recent baselines. Ablations confirm that both evidence binding and mechanized citation validation are key to the gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于证据的事实核查需要在精确预测陈述的真实性同时提供详细的证据信息，包括具体的句子、表格单元格以及完整的多文档链。虽然大语言模型能够实现分解、规划和多智能体验证，但在处理异构证据和多跳需求时，它们仍可能产生看似合理的结论，但这些结论的来源往往不明确。我们提出了GAVEL这一多智能体辩论框架，该框架在推理过程中严格遵循证据基础原则。GAVEL引入了“证据契约”机制，要求辩论者提出具体的子主张，并将这些子主张与明确的证据单位相结合；同时，它还采用了“机械化审查链”机制，由中立的审查者对输出结果进行审计，并对引用的标识符和片段进行确定性验证。最后，裁判会选择一组充分的证据来做出最终决策。在开放环境下的FEVEROUS和HOVER实验中，我们发现GAVEL在提高证据来源可识别性的指标方面表现显著，其性能优于当前最强的基线算法。实验结果表明，证据约束机制和机械化引用验证机制是提升该框架性能的关键所在。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: EMPATH: An Ensemble Method for Automatic Fine-Grained Turn-Level Dialogue Empathy Evaluation with a Novel Emotional Distance Metric
papers.title_zh: EMPATH：一种用于自动评估细致层次对话共情的集成方法，采用了一种新颖的情感距离度量指标
papers.authors: Dongning Rao, Zhihua Liang, Zhihua Jiang
papers.abstract: Empathy is key to many professions. In recognition of this, the workshops on computational approaches to subjectivity, sentiment, and social media analysis (WASSA) hosted competitions to evaluate empathy in dialogue. While fine-tuning has proved successful in the competition, there are at least three shortcomings. First, novel metrics for empathy are absent. Second, classical dialogue evaluation metrics require further investigation. Third, the ensemble’s potential remained underdeveloped. To address these issues, we propose the EMPATH framework, which combines fine-tuned models, large language models, classical dialogue evaluation metrics, and a novel metric. The novel metric, ED, encourages the response’s emotional tone to be contextually appropriate. E.g., if the user expresses joy, a cheerful reaction should receive a higher ranking. Furthermore, we introduce a new robust and label-free ensemble strategy, HO, which integrates sub-metrics with the lowest correlation coefficient first. In addition to evaluating on the WASSA benchmark, we test EMPATH’s generalizability using the EmpatheticExchanges dataset (EX). Our experiment results demonstrate that EMPATH yields the best results on the competition dataset, and ablation studies validate our component selection. On EX, the Pearson correlation coefficient for the winner of WASSA 2024 is 0.4066, while EMPATH shows a statistically significant 8% improvement (i.e., 0.4860).
papers.abstract_zh: 同理心是许多职业的关键。为了认可这一点，我们举办了关于计算方法来分析主观性、情感和社会媒体数据的研讨会，并通过比赛来评估对话中的同理心表现。虽然微调方法在比赛中取得了成功，但仍然存在至少三个问题。首先，缺乏新的同理心评估指标。其次，传统的对话评估指标还需要进一步研究。第三，集成方法的潜力尚未得到充分开发。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了EMPATH框架，该框架结合了经过微调的模型、大语言模型、传统对话评估指标以及一种新的评估指标。这种新指标ED旨在使响应的情感基调符合上下文需求。例如，如果用户表达喜悦之情，那么欢快的回应应该获得更高的评分。此外，我们还引入了一种新的、鲁棒且无标签的集成策略HO，该策略会优先整合相关系数最低的子指标。除了在WASSA基准测试上进行评估外，我们还使用EmpatheticExchanges数据集来测试EMPATH的泛化能力。实验结果表明，EMPATH在比赛数据集上取得了最佳成绩，而消融研究也验证了我们的组件选择是正确的。在EX数据集上，WASSA 2024比赛的获胜者之间的皮尔逊相关系数为0.4066，而EMPATH则显示出8%的显著提升（即0.4860）。

papers.title: Q2EI: Query-to-Entity Inference for Semantic Condensation in Domain-Specific Retrieval
papers.title_zh: Q2EI：针对特定领域检索任务的语义浓缩技术——从查询到实体的推理过程
papers.authors: Yixuan Sun, Zhenqin Xu, HanFeng Zhai, Zishu Yu, Xiaohui Peng
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) remains unreliable in specialized domains due to semantic and lexical mismatch between lay queries and professional terminology, and existing generative expansion often introduces redundancy or hallucinations that cause semantic drift. We propose Generative Query Condensation (GQC), a query rewriting strategy that reframes rewriting as semantic condensation rather than expansion. To operationalize GQC, we introduce Query-to-Entity Inference (Q2EI), an entity-centric rewriting method that realizes semantic condensation through explicit inference of the underlying target entity. By moving semantic alignment from retrieval-time vector matching to the rewriting stage, Q2EI produces information-dense query representations. Experimental results on medical and legal benchmarks show that Q2EI consistently outperforms strong baselines across retrievers, improving retrieval effectiveness while substantially reducing rewriting token consumption compared to generative expansion methods. Further analysis confirms that these gains primarily arise from accurate entity inference, and that Q2EI’s semantic condensation design limits error amplification when inference is imperfect, leading to more stable and interpretable retrieval behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）在专业领域仍然不可靠，这是因为普通用户的查询与专业术语之间存在语义和词汇上的不匹配。此外，现有的生成式扩展方法常常会导致冗余或幻觉现象，进而引发语义漂移。我们提出了生成式查询压缩技术（GQC），这是一种将查询重写方式从扩展转变为语义压缩的策略。为了实现GQC，我们引入了“从查询到实体推理”的方法，这是一种以实体为中心的重写方式，通过明确推断目标实体来实现语义压缩。通过将语义对齐从检索阶段的向量匹配转移到重写阶段，Q2EI能够生成信息密度更高的查询表示。在医学和法律领域的基准测试中的实验结果表明，Q2EI在多个检索系统中始终优于其他强大的基线方法，同时显著减少了与生成式扩展方法相比的重写所需令牌数量。进一步分析表明，这些优势主要源于准确的实体推断能力，而Q2EI的语义压缩设计能够在推理不完美的情况下限制误差的放大，从而使得检索行为更加稳定且易于理解。

papers.title: TVWorld: Foundations for Remote-Control TV Agents
papers.title_zh: TVWorld：远程控制电视代理的基础技术
papers.authors: Zhantao Ma, Quanfeng Lu, Shuai Zhong, Dahai Yu, Ping Luo, Michael Ng
papers.abstract: Recent large vision–language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for device control. However, existing research has primarily focused on point-and-click (PnC) interaction, while remote-control (RC) interaction commonly encountered in everyday TV usage remains largely underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce TVWorld, an offline graph-based abstraction of real-world TV navigation that enables reproducible and deployment-free evaluation. On this basis, we derive two complementary benchmarks that comprehensively assess TV-use capabilities: TVWorld-N for topology-aware navigation and TVWorld-G for focus-aware grounding. These benchmarks expose a key limitation of existing agents: insufficient topology awareness for focus-based, long-horizon TV navigation. Motivated by this finding, we propose a Topology-Aware Training framework that injects topology awareness into LVLMs. Using this framework, we develop TVTheseus, a foundation model specialized for TV navigation. TVTheseus achieves a success rate of 68.3 on TVWorld-N, surpassing strong closed-source baselines such as Gemini 3 Flash and establishing state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Additional analyses further provide valuable insights into the development of effective TV-use agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的一些大型视觉-语言模型在设备控制方面展现出巨大的潜力。然而，现有的研究主要集中在点选式交互上，而日常电视使用中常见的远程控制交互则大多未被充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了TVWorld这一基于离线图的现实世界电视导航抽象模型，该模型能够实现可重复且无需部署即可进行评估。在此基础上，我们开发了两个互补的评估基准，以全面评估电视使用能力：TVWorld-N用于拓扑感知导航，TVWorld-G用于焦点感知定位。这些评估基准揭示了现有智能体的一项关键缺陷：对于基于焦点的长期电视导航任务，它们缺乏足够的拓扑感知能力。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种拓扑感知训练框架，将拓扑感知能力融入视觉-语言模型中。利用该框架，我们开发了TVTheseus，这是一个专为电视导航设计的基础模型。在TVWorld-N评估基准上，TVTheseus取得了68.3%的成功率，超越了诸如Gemini 3 Flash等强大的闭源基线模型，并达到了最先进的性能水平。进一步的分析为开发有效的电视使用智能体提供了宝贵的见解。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: RiTeK: A Dataset for Large Language Models Complex Reasoning over Textual Knowledge Graphs in Medicine
papers.title_zh: RiTeK：一个适用于大型语言模型的数据集，可用于对医学领域文本知识图谱进行复杂的推理操作
papers.authors: Jiatan Huang, Mingchen Li, Zonghai Yao, Dawei Li, Yuxin Zhang, Zhichao Yang, Yongkang Xiao, Feiyun Ouyang, Xiaohan Li, Shuo Han, Hong yu
papers.abstract: Answering complex real-world questions in the medical domain often requires accurate retrieval from medical Textual Knowledge Graphs (medical TKGs), as the relational path information from TKGs could enhance the inference ability of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the main bottlenecks lie in the scarcity of existing medical TKGs, the limited expressiveness of their topological structures, and the lack of comprehensive evaluations of current retrievers for medical TKGs. To address these challenges, we first develop a dataset for LLMs Complex Reasoning over medical Textual Knowledge Graphs (RiTeK), covering a broad range of topological structures. Specifically, we synthesize realistic user queries integrating diverse topological structures, relational information, and complex textual descriptions. We conduct a rigorous medical expert evaluation process to assess and validate the quality of our synthesized queries. RiTeK also serves as a comprehensive benchmark dataset for evaluating the capabilities of retrieval systems built upon LLMs. By assessing 11 representative retrievers on this benchmark, we observe that existing methods struggle to perform well, revealing notable limitations in current LLM-driven retrieval approaches. These findings highlight the pressing need for more effective retrieval systems tailored for semi-structured data in the medical domain.
papers.abstract_zh: 在医学领域回答复杂的现实问题时，通常需要从医学文本知识图谱中准确检索信息。因为知识图谱中的关系路径信息能够提升大语言模型的推理能力。然而，主要的瓶颈在于现有医学知识图谱的稀缺性、其拓扑结构的表达能力有限，以及目前用于检索医学知识图谱的系统的综合评价不足。为了应对这些挑战，我们首先开发了一个针对大语言模型在医学文本知识图谱上进行复杂推理的数据集——RiTeK。该数据集涵盖了多种拓扑结构。具体来说，我们整合了各种拓扑结构、关系信息以及复杂的文本描述来生成真实的用户查询。我们还进行了严格的医学专家评估，以评估和验证我们生成的查询的质量。RiTeK还作为一个全面的基准数据集，用于评估基于大语言模型构建的检索系统的性能。通过对这个基准数据集中的11种代表性检索系统进行评估，我们发现现有的方法在性能上表现不佳，这揭示了当前由大语言模型驱动的检索方法的明显局限性。这些发现凸显了为医学领域半结构化数据设计更有效的检索系统的迫切需求。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PRA-RAG: Provably Robust Aggregation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation against Retrieval Corruption
papers.title_zh: PRA-RAG：在检索增强生成中实现的稳健聚合技术，能够有效应对检索过程中的数据篡改问题
papers.authors: Xue Tan, Yi Zheng, Chang Huo, Yunruo Zhang, Yu Liu, Hao Luan, Zhuyang Yu, Jun Dai, Xiaoyan Sun, Ping Chen
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge, effectively mitigating their inherent knowledge limitations. However, RAG remains vulnerable to poisoning attacks that manipulate retrieved texts to mislead model outputs. Existing defense mechanisms often lack theoretical robustness guarantees and perform unreliably when the LLM has limited knowledge of the retrieved content. In this work, we propose PRA-RAG, a provably robust retrieval aggregation algorithm designed to defend against poisoning attacks on retrieved texts. PRA-RAG samples multiple combinations of retrieved texts and utilizes geometric structures in the embedding space to identify a robust subset, from which a stable aggregated representation is derived. We provide theoretical bounds on the maximum impact of poisoned retrieved content and establish a quantitative measure of RAG’s robustness. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and RAG architectures demonstrate that PRA-RAG reduces the attack success rate to as low as 1% while maintaining an accuracy of 71%, significantly outperforming representative state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合外部知识来增强大语言模型（LLM）的能力，有效缓解了它们固有的知识局限性。然而，RAG仍然容易受到“中毒攻击”的影响，这些攻击会操纵检索到的文本以误导模型输出。现有的防御机制往往缺乏理论上的鲁棒性保障，并且在LLM对检索到的内容了解有限时，其性能也会变得不可靠。在这项研究中，我们提出了PRA-RAG算法——一种经过证明的鲁棒检索聚合算法，旨在抵御针对检索文本的中毒攻击。PRA-RAG通过组合多个检索到的文本样本，并利用嵌入空间中的几何结构来识别一个鲁棒的子集，从而生成稳定的聚合表示。我们为被污染检索内容的最大影响提供了理论上的界限，并建立了衡量RAG鲁棒性的定量指标。通过在多个基准测试和不同的RAG架构上进行实验，我们发现PRA-RAG能够将攻击的成功率降低到1%，同时保持71%的准确率，其性能显著优于当前最先进的方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Evaluating Perspectival Biases in Cross-Modal Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 评估跨模式检索中的视角偏差
papers.authors: Teerapol Saengsukhiran, Peerawat Chomphooyod, Narabodee Rodjananant, Chompakorn Chaksangchaichot, Patawee Prakrankamanant, Witthawin Sripheanpol, Pak Lovichit, Sarana Nutanong, Ekapol Chuangsuwanich
papers.abstract: Multimodal retrieval systems are expected to operate in a semantic space, agnostic to the language or cultural origin of the query. In practice, however, retrieval outcomes systematically reflect perspectival biases: deviations shaped by linguistic prevalence and cultural associations. We introduce the Cross-Cultural, Cross-Modal, Cross-lingual Multimodal (3XCM) benchmark to isolate these effects. Results from our studies indicate that, for image-to-text retrieval, models tend to favor entries from prevalent languages over those that are semantically faithful. For text-to-image retrieval, we observe a consistent "tugging effect” in the joint embedding space between semantic alignment and language-conditioned cultural association. When semantic representations are insufficiently resolved, particularly in low-resource languages, similarity is increasingly governed by culturally familiar visual patterns, leading to systematic association bias in retrieval. Our findings suggest that achieving equitable multimodal retrieval necessitates targeted strategies that explicitly decouple language from culture, rather than relying solely on broader data exposure. This work highlights the need to treat linguistic and cultural biases as distinct, measurable challenges in multimodal representation learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态检索系统预计能够在语义空间中运行，而无需考虑查询的语言或文化来源。然而在实践中，检索结果往往会反映出视角偏见：这些偏差是由语言的流行程度和文化关联所塑造的。我们引入了跨文化、跨模态、跨语言的多模态基准测试，以分离这些效应。我们的研究结果表明，在图像到文本的检索中，模型倾向于偏好来自流行语言的词条，而非那些在语义上更为准确的词条。在文本到图像的检索中，我们观察到在联合嵌入空间中，语义对齐与语言条件下的文化关联之间存在一种持续的“牵引效应”。当语义表示不够清晰时，尤其是在资源匮乏的语言中，相似性越来越受到文化上熟悉的视觉模式的影响，从而导致检索中的系统性关联偏见。我们的研究发现表明，要实现公平的多模态检索，就需要采取有针对性的策略，明确地将语言与文化分离开来，而不仅仅是依赖更广泛的数据曝光。这项工作强调了将语言和文化的偏见视为多模态表示学习中的不同且可测量的挑战这一必要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Static Synthetic Noise: Assessing the Robustness of Large Language Models to Natural Context Variation in the Real World
papers.title_zh: 超越静态合成噪声：评估大型语言模型在现实世界中对自然上下文变化的鲁棒性
papers.authors: Yulong Wu, Viktor Schlegel, Riza Batista-Navarro
papers.abstract: Robustness evaluation in Question Answering (QA) has predominantly relied on synthetic perturbations that poorly capture natural text evolution in real-world settings, a limitation that becomes more pronounced with the widespread deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) in dynamic, user-facing environments. In this work, we address this gap by proposing a framework for automatically evaluating QA models under naturally occurring textual perturbations, replacing context passages with revised counterparts from Wikipedia edit histories. Through extensive evaluation on SQUAD across diverse encoder architectures, we construct two challenging sets where human performance remains stable, yet state-of-the-art LLMs exhibit significant degradation, with performance drops of up to 28.28%. These robustness gaps further generalize to more complex QA scenarios, such as DROP and HOTPOTQA. To mitigate these errors, we show that robustness to natural perturbations can be improved via adversarial training for encoder-only models and in-context demonstrations of perturbed instances for LLMs, though a more generalizable and effective defense strategy remains an open challenge.
papers.abstract_zh: 在问答系统中，对鲁棒性的评估通常依赖于合成扰动方法，但这些方法难以准确捕捉现实环境中文本的自然演变。随着大语言模型在动态、面向用户的环境中的广泛应用，这种局限性变得更加明显。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个框架，用于自动评估在自然文本扰动下的问答模型性能。我们通过使用来自维基百科编辑历史的修订版本来替代原始上下文文本，从而弥补这一不足。通过对不同编码器架构的SQUAD系统进行广泛评估，我们发现，尽管人类表现保持稳定，但最先进的语言模型的表现却出现了显著下降，性能下降了高达28.28%。这些鲁棒性缺陷也适用于更复杂的问答场景，如DROP和HOTPOTQA。为了减轻这些问题，我们发现，对于仅包含编码器的模型，可以通过对抗性训练来提高其对自然扰动的鲁棒性；而对于语言模型，则可以通过在上下文中展示被扰动的实例来进行训练。不过，要制定一种更通用且有效的防御策略仍然是一个未解决的挑战。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Measuring Watermarking under Jailbreaking: ASR Inflation and Goal-Compliance Mismatch
papers.title_zh: 在越狱环境下对水印技术的测量：自动语音识别的膨胀问题以及与目标要求的不匹配情况
papers.authors: Sungwoo Han, Sangjun Moon, Jingun Kwon, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Manabu Okumura
papers.abstract: Recently, watermarking has attracted growing attention as a practical technique for source attribution of machine-generated text. However, most prior work studies watermarking under benign prompts, while its behavior under jailbreaking prompts remains underexplored. This gap matters because jailbreaking can bypass safety policies and shift the generation regime, raising concerns that watermarking may interact with model alignment under attack. To address this gap, we evaluate six watermarking methods on four LLMs across two jailbreak benchmarks and three settings: Static, AutoDAN, and DSN. We find that watermarking can inflate judge-based attack success rate, denoted ASR, under jailbreaking, with the largest effects appearing in biased schemes that perturb logits. At the same time, these ASR increases often do not reflect higher harmful-goal compliance when measured by StrongREJECT or by human judgments. This suggests that ASR-only evaluations can be brittle to decoding perturbations and may overestimate harmful-goal compliance, motivating complementary goal-compliance metrics (e.g., StrongREJECT) and human evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，水印技术作为机器生成文本来源归属的实用方法，受到了越来越多的关注。然而，大多数现有研究都集中在良性提示下的水印处理上，而关于在越狱提示下的水印行为则尚未得到充分研究。这一空白非常重要，因为越狱可以绕过安全策略，改变模型的生成机制，这引发了人们对水印技术在受到攻击时可能与模型对齐机制产生相互作用的担忧。为了填补这一空白，我们在两个越狱测试基准以及三种设置下，对六种水印处理方法在四个大语言模型中进行了评估：静态模式、AutoDAN模式和DSN模式。我们发现，水印可以在越狱情况下提高基于判断的攻击成功率，其中对logit值进行干扰的方案效果最为显著。同时，这些攻击成功率的提升往往并不能反映更高的有害目标合规性，无论是通过StrongREJECT还是人类评估来衡量都是如此。这表明，仅基于攻击成功率的评估容易受到解码干扰的影响，可能会高估有害目标的合规性。因此，需要引入其他衡量目标合规性的指标（例如StrongREJECT），并结合人类评估来进行综合评估。

papers.title: Inventive Problem Solving with LLMs: A Benchmark for TRIZ Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 利用大语言模型进行创新性问题解决：一种基于TRIZ推理的基准方法
papers.authors: Zhu Wang, Brian Uzzi
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in inventive problem-solving, but effective support requires more than open-ended idea generation. Inventive problem-solving requires improving one aspect of a technical system without unintentionally worsening another. TRIZ (Theory of Inventive Problem Solving) provides a unique and structured framework for this setting by representing engineering trade-offs as contradictions and linking them to standardized inventive principles. However, prior TRIZ–LLM evaluations are typically small-scale, case studies in focused areas of technology, and rarely grounded in patent text, which makes it difficult to assess structured reasoning at scale. We introduce TRIZBench, a dataset and benchmark for TRIZ reasoning grounded in open technical sources and U.S. patents. TRIZBench evaluates the core TRIZ workflow through three tasks: contradiction prediction, inventive principle prediction, and grounded TRIZ reasoning. Experiments with multiple LLM baselines show that detecting contradictions is easier than recovering correct trade-off pairs, while principle prediction benefits from explicitly exploiting TRIZ structure. Our findings further underscore the importance of grounding. We show that semantic retrieval enables evidence-based justifications and helps explain why LLMs fail. Dataset and code are available at https://github.com/ellenzhuwang/trizbench.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在创造性问题解决中得到了越来越多的应用，但有效的支持不仅仅依赖于开放式创意生成。创造性问题解决需要改进技术系统中的某个方面，同时避免无意中恶化另一个方面。TRIZ（创造性问题解决理论）通过将工程中的权衡关系表示为矛盾，并将这些矛盾与标准化的创造性原则联系起来，为这种情境提供了一个独特且结构化的框架。然而，现有的基于TRIZ与大语言模型的评估通常都是小规模的研究，集中在特定技术领域，而且很少基于专利文本进行，这使得大规模评估结构化推理能力变得困难。我们提出了TRIZBench数据集和基准测试，该数据集基于公开的技术资料和美国专利数据，用于评估TRIZ推理能力。TRIZBench通过三项任务来评估核心的TRIZ工作流程：矛盾预测、创造性原则预测以及基于实际案例的TRIZ推理。实验结果表明，检测矛盾比恢复正确的权衡关系更为容易，而利用TRIZ的结构来预测创造性原则则更为有效。我们的研究结果进一步强调了基础数据的重要性。我们发现，语义检索能够使得基于证据的推理成为可能，并有助于解释为什么大语言模型会失败。该数据集和代码可在https://github.com/ellenzhuwang/trizbench获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Do LLM Agents Really Mimic Humans? Diagnosing and Aligning Microeconomic Behaviors in Macro-ABMs
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型智能体真的能模仿人类的行为吗？在宏观行为代数模型中诊断并模拟微观经济行为
papers.authors: Guangya Liu, Cheng Wang, Jiangtong Li, Huafei Wu, Changjun Jiang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in macroeconomic agent-based modeling(ABM). However, existing research focuses on replicating macro-level stylized facts while often neglecting verification of micro-level decision-making. We investigate this gap by comparing LLM agents to human responses from the Survey of Consumer Expectations (SCE) dataset. Our empirical analysis identifies specific limitations: weak trend responsiveness, mode collapse, and a potential data leakage. We propose the Heterogeneous Shock-Response Causal Transmission Framework to tackle these issues. To ensure theoretical consistency, we use LLMs to build a literature-verified causal graph in which macroeconomic shocks influence decisions via generated mediator nodes, while agent profiles serve as edge moderators. Building on this, during inference, we perform a path search to retrieve relevant causal chains and inject them as an explicit Chain-of-Thought(CoT), prioritizing mechanistic logic over statistical pattern matching. To evaluate the effectiveness of our inference approach, we validate it via a two-stage process that combines micro-level dataset testing and macro-level simulation in the EconAgent system. Results from these experiments indicate that our framework improves alignment with human trends and effectively captures behavioral heterogeneity. Overall, this work contributes to the development of reliable and grounded economic simulations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在宏观经济基于代理的建模中得到了越来越多的应用。然而，现有的研究主要集中在复制宏观层面的典型现象上，而往往忽略了对微观层面决策的验证。我们通过将语言模型代理与消费者预期调查数据集中的人类反应进行比较，来探讨这一差距。我们的实证分析发现了一些具体的局限性：对趋势的反应较弱、模式崩溃现象的存在，以及可能存在的数据泄露问题。为此，我们提出了一种异质性冲击-响应因果传递框架来解决这个问题。为了确保理论上的一致性，我们使用语言模型构建了一个经过文献验证的因果图，其中宏观经济冲击通过生成的中介节点影响决策，而代理特征则作为边的调节因素。在此基础上，在推理过程中，我们执行路径搜索以检索相关的因果链，并将其作为明确的思维链进行呈现，优先考虑机制性的逻辑而非统计模式的匹配。为了评估我们的推理方法的有效性，我们通过一个两阶段的过程来验证它，该过程结合了微观层面的数据测试和EconAgent系统中的宏观模拟。实验结果表明，我们的框架能够更好地与人类趋势保持一致，并有效捕捉到行为上的异质性。总体而言，这项工作为开发可靠且基于实际经济数据的模拟模型做出了贡献。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Explanation Quality Assessment as Ranking with Listwise Rewards
papers.title_zh: 解释：质量评估本质上是一种排序机制，通过逐项给予奖励来实现评估
papers.authors: Thomas Bailleux, Tanmoy Mukherjee, Emmanuel Lonca, Pierre Marquis, Zied Bouraoui
papers.abstract: We reformulate explanation quality assessment as a ranking problem rather than a generation problem. Instead of optimizing models to produce a single “best” explanation token-by-token, we train reward models to discriminate among multiple candidate explanations and learn their relative quality. Concretely, we construct per-instance candidate sets with graded quality levels and train listwise and pairwise ranking models (ListNet, LambdaRank, RankNet) to preserve ordinal structure and avoid score compression typical of pointwise regression or binary preference objectives. We observe three findings: First, ranking losses consistently outperform regression on score separation across all domains tested. Second, the optimal ranking loss depends on data characteristics: listwise objectives excel with well-separated quality tiers, while pairwise methods are more robust to noisy natural annotations. Third, when trained on carefully curated and well-structured data, small encoder models can match models that are orders of magnitude larger, suggesting that data quality matters more than model scale. Finally, when used as rewards in policy optimization, ranking-based scores enable stable convergence in settings where regression-based rewards fail entirely. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/Tankiit/PPO_Learning_to_rank
papers.abstract_zh: 我们将解释质量评估问题重新定义为一个排序问题，而非生成问题。我们不再试图优化模型以产生单一的“最佳”解释，而是训练奖励模型来区分多个候选解释，并学习它们的相对质量。具体来说，我们为每个实例构建具有不同质量级别的候选列表，然后训练列表级和成对排序模型（ListNet、LambdaRank、RankNet），以保持序贯结构，避免像点回归或二元偏好目标那样常见的分数压缩现象。我们发现三个重要结论：首先，在所有测试领域中，排序损失在分数分离方面的表现始终优于回归方法。其次，最优的排序损失取决于数据特性：当质量层次分明时，列表级目标表现最佳；而成对排序方法则对噪声自然注释更为鲁棒。第三，当在精心筛选且结构良好的数据上进行训练时，小型编码器模型能够与规模大几个数量级的模型相媲美，这表明数据质量比模型规模更为重要。最后，当这些基于排序的得分被用作策略优化的奖励时，即使在基于回归的奖励完全失效的情况下，排序得分也能实现稳定的收敛。代码和数据可在此处获取：https://github.com/Tankiit/PPO_Learning_to_rank

papers.title: ViLegalLM: Language Models for Vietnamese Legal Text
papers.title_zh: ViLegalLM：适用于越南语法律文本的语言模型
papers.authors: Truong-Phuc Nguyen, Quy-Nhan Nguyen, Minh-Tien Nguyen
papers.abstract: We present ViLegalLM, comprising ViLegalBERT and ViLegalQwen, the first suite of Vietnamese pretrained language models for legal text understanding and generation. It includes one encoder-only model (ViLegalBERT, 135M parameters) and two decoder-only models (ViLegalQwen2.5-1.5B-Base and ViLegalQwen3-1.7B-Base), all continually pretrained on a newly curated 16GB Vietnamese legal corpus, significantly larger than previous work. To mitigate data scarcity, we construct three synthetic datasets using LLM-based generation and hard negative mining for True/False QA, Multiple Choice QA, and Natural Language Inference. We establish state-of-the-art results among open-source models on four main Vietnamese legal downstream tasks spanning ten benchmarks, demonstrating that continual pretraining from base models consistently outperforms instruction-tuned adaptation. Source codes, corpus, datasets, and model checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/ntphuc149/ViLegalLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了ViLegalLM，该模型由ViLegalBERT和ViLegalQwen组成，是首个用于越南语法律文本理解与生成的预训练语言模型套件。该套件包含一个仅编码的模型（ViLegalBERT，参数数量为135M），以及两个仅解码的模型（ViLegalQwen2.5-1.5B-Base和ViLegalQwen3-1.7B-Base）。所有这些模型都在一个精心挑选的16GB越南语法律语料库上进行持续预训练，其规模远超以往的研究。为了缓解数据稀缺问题，我们构建了三个合成数据集，这些数据集采用基于大语言模型的生成技术和硬负例挖掘技术来构建真假判断、多项选择判断以及自然语言推理任务的数据集。在四个主要的越南语法律下游任务中，我们的模型在十个基准测试中都取得了领先的成绩，这表明从基础模型开始持续预训练的方法能够始终优于基于指令训练的适应方法。源代码、语料库、数据集以及模型检查点均可在此处获取：https://github.com/ntphuc149/ViLegalLM

papers.title: From Heads to Neurons: Causal Attribution and Steering in Multi-Task Vision–Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从“头部”到“神经元”：多任务视觉-语言模型中因果归因与导向机制的研究
papers.authors: Qidong Wang, Junjie Hu, Ming Jiang
papers.abstract: Recent work has increasingly explored neuron-level interpretation in vision-language models (VLMs) to identify neurons critical to final predictions. However, existing neuron analyses generally focus on single tasks, limiting the comparability of neuron importance across tasks. Moreover, ranking strategies tend to score neurons in isolation, overlooking how task-dependent information pathways shape the write-in effects of feed-forward network (FFN) neurons. This oversight can exacerbate neuron polysemanticity in multi-task settings, introducing noise into the identification and intervention of task-critical neurons. In this study, we propose HONES (Head-Oriented Neuron Explanation Steering), a gradient-free framework for task-aware neuron attribution and steering in multi-task VLMs. HONES ranks FFN neurons by their causal write-in contributions conditioned on task-relevant attention heads, and further modulates salient neurons via lightweight scaling. Experiments on four diverse multimodal tasks and two popular VLMs show that HONES outperforms existing methods in identifying task-critical neurons and improves model performance after steering. Our source code is released at: https://github.com/petergit1/HONES.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究越来越多地探索了视觉-语言模型中神经元层面的解释机制，以识别对最终预测至关重要的神经元。然而，现有的神经元分析通常只关注单一任务，这限制了不同任务之间神经元重要性的可比性。此外，排名策略往往单独对神经元进行评分，而忽略了任务相关的信息路径如何塑造前馈网络神经元的输出效果。这种忽略会在多任务环境中加剧神经元的多义性，从而引入噪声，影响对任务关键神经元的识别和干预。在这项研究中，我们提出了HONES（以头部为导向的神经元解释引导）这一无梯度框架，用于在多任务视觉-语言模型中实现任务感知的神经元归因和引导。HONES根据与任务相关的注意力头节点，对前馈网络神经元进行因果贡献的排序，并通过轻量级缩放进一步调节重要的神经元。在四个不同的多模态任务和两个流行的视觉-语言模型上的实验表明，HONES在识别任务关键神经元方面优于现有方法，并且在引导后提升了模型的性能。我们的源代码可以在以下链接下载：https://github.com/petergit1/HONES。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Syntax as a Rosetta Stone: Universal Dependencies for In-Context Coptic Translation
papers.title_zh: 语法就像罗塞塔石碑一样具有通用性：上下文相关的科普特语翻译依赖于这些语法规则
papers.authors: Abhishek Purushothama, Emma Thronson, Alexia Guo, Amir Zeldes
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a novel in-context learning approach to support low resource machine translation for the Coptic language, using prompts based on Universal Dependencies parses of input sentences. Building on existing work using bilingual dictionaries to support inference for vocabulary items, we add several representations of syntactic analyses to our inputs, specifically exploring the inclusion of raw parser outputs, verbalizations of parses in plain English, and explanations of specific difficult constructions identified in input subgraphs and how they can be translated. Our results show that while syntactic information alone is not as useful as dictionary-based glosses, combining retrieved dictionary items with syntactic information achieves significant gains across model sizes, achieving new state-of-the-art results for the language.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的上下文学习方法，用于支持低资源机器翻译中的科普特语翻译。该方法基于输入句子的通用依存关系解析，生成提示信息。在现有使用双语词典来支持词汇项推理的基础上，我们为输入数据增加了多种句法分析表示形式，具体包括使用原始解析结果、用简单英语描述解析过程，以及解释输入子图中出现的特定难懂结构及其翻译方式。我们的实验结果表明，虽然单纯的句法信息不如基于词典的注释有用，但将词典条目与句法信息结合使用，无论模型规模如何，都能取得显著的性能提升，为该语言带来了新的最优结果。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: AI Agents for the Science of Science: A Survey of Tasks, Architectures, Evaluations, and Challenges
papers.title_zh: 用于科学领域的AI代理：任务、架构、评估与挑战概述
papers.authors: Yixuan Liu, Yicheng Zhang
papers.abstract: The Science of Science (SciSci) examines how scientific knowledge is generated, evaluated, and transformed by utilizing large-scale scholarly and bibliometric data. As these data grow in scale and complexity, analysis has increasingly relied on statistical, network-based, machine learning methods, and is now seeing growing involvement of AI agents. This emerging class of such agents, ranging from multi-agent simulations of scientific behavior to tool-augmented systems for empirical analysis, is beginning to reshape how SciSci research is conducted. In this survey, we propose a task-centered taxonomy, distinguishing agents as simulations, which model citation, collaboration, and community dynamics, from agents as tools, which assist empirical analysis and scientific workflows. We review agent architectures, learning mechanisms, evaluation, and SciSci benchmarks, and examine open challenges related to reliability, data quality, and bias. Our survey aims to clarify the landscape of AI agents in SciSci and to support the development of reliable and scientifically useful AI systems for studying science and scientific communities.
papers.abstract_zh: 《科学中的科学》研究如何利用大规模的学术和文献计量数据来生成、评估以及转化科学知识。随着这些数据规模和复杂性的增加，分析越来越依赖于统计方法、网络分析技术以及机器学习算法。如今，人工智能代理在其中的作用也日益凸显。这类智能代理的应用范围广泛，从模拟科学行为的多智能体系统，到用于实证分析的辅助工具系统，它们正在逐渐改变科学中的科学研究方式。在这项调查中，我们提出了一种以任务为中心的分类体系，将智能代理分为两类：一类是模拟智能体，它们能够模拟引用关系、合作行为以及社区动态；另一类则是辅助智能体，它们为实证分析和科学工作流程提供支持。我们回顾了智能体的架构、学习机制、评估方法以及科学中的科学基准测试，并探讨了与可靠性、数据质量及偏见相关的问题。我们的调查旨在明确人工智能代理在科学中的应用现状，从而推动开发出可靠且具有科学价值的AI系统，以更好地研究科学现象和科学社区。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: A2O: LLM-based Agentic Learning of Action-to-Object Features for Video Action Recognition
papers.title_zh: A2O：基于大语言模型的代理式学习方法，用于视频动作识别中的动作与对象特征提取
papers.authors: Taiki Sekii, Fumiaki Sato
papers.abstract: Recent action recognition based on vision–language pretraining and self-supervised video foundation models tends to induce spurious correlations and shortcut learning by relying on action-irrelevant cues, such as backgrounds and object co-occurrences. By contrast, object-detection-based approaches can suppress spurious correlations; however, the loss of input information can limit accuracy. To mitigate this trade-off, we combine these two approaches to learn complementary features that compensate for each other’s shortcomings. Specifically, we leverage the commonsense knowledge of large language models (LLMs) regarding human actions and realize a framework in which an LLM agent integrates the two approaches within an agentic learning paradigm to design motion features tailored to the target actions. The LLM agent uses an open vocabulary object detector to instruct the video foundation model with the target and nontarget objects in the video to make the model attend to objects in a video required for recognizing the target actions. The composition of the detected objects is optimized for the target actions through in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) using the commonsense knowledge of the LLM. Experiments on multiple public action recognition datasets and an ablation study confirm the robustness of features learned using the proposed method and the effectiveness of ICRL.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于视觉-语言预训练和自监督视频基础模型的动作识别方法，往往会因为依赖与动作无关的线索（如背景和物体共存情况）而引入虚假相关性以及捷径学习现象。相比之下，基于物体检测的方法能够抑制虚假相关性；然而，输入信息的丢失可能会限制识别精度。为了缓解这种权衡问题，我们结合这两种方法来学习互补的特征，以弥补彼此的不足。具体来说，我们利用大语言模型关于人类行为的常识性知识，构建一个框架：在该框架中，语言模型代理在代理式学习范式中整合这两种方法，从而设计出适用于目标动作的motion特征。语言模型代理使用开放词汇的物体检测器，对视频中的目标和非目标物体进行指导，使视频基础模型能够关注到识别目标动作所需的物体。通过利用语言模型的常识性知识进行上下文强化学习，我们可以优化检测到的物体的组合方式，以适应目标动作的需求。在多个公开的动作识别数据集上的实验以及一项消融研究都证实了所提出方法的有效性，以及上下文强化学习的实用性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PrinciplismQA: A Philosophy-Grounded Approach to Assessing LLM-Human Clinical Medical Ethics Alignment
papers.title_zh: 原则主义在医学伦理评估中的应用：一种基于哲学理念的LLM与人类在医学伦理评估中的协同方法
papers.authors: Chang Hong, Minghao Wu, Qingying Xiao, Yuchi Wang, Xiang Wan, Guangjun Yu, Benyou Wang, Yan Hu
papers.abstract: As medical LLMs transition to clinical deployment, assessing their ethical reasoning capability becomes critical. While achieving high accuracy on knowledge benchmarks, LLMs lack validated assessment for navigating ethical trade-offs in clinical decision-making where multiple valid solutions exist. Existing benchmarks lack systematic approaches to incorporate recognized philosophical frameworks and expert validation for ethical reasoning assessment. We introduce PrinciplismQA, a philosophy-grounded approach to assessing LLM clinical medical ethics alignment. Grounded in Principlism, our approach provides a systematic methodology for incorporating clinical ethics philosophy into LLM assessment design. PrinciplismQA comprises 3,648 expert-validated questions spanning knowledge assessment and clinical reasoning. Our expert-calibrated pipeline enables reproducible evaluation and models ethical biases. Evaluating recent models reveals significant ethical reasoning gaps despite high knowledge accuracy, demonstrating that knowledge-oriented training does not ensure clinical ethical alignment. PrinciplismQA provides a validated tool for assessing clinical AI deployment readiness.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着医疗大语言模型逐渐应用于临床实践，评估它们的伦理推理能力变得至关重要。虽然这些模型在知识基准测试中表现出很高的准确性，但在面对存在多种有效解决方案的临床决策问题时，它们缺乏经过验证的评估方法来判断如何权衡各种伦理因素。现有的评估基准缺乏系统性的方法，无法将公认的哲学框架和专家验证纳入伦理推理评估中。我们提出了PrinciplismQA这一基于哲学原理的评估方法，该方法为将临床伦理学理念融入大语言模型的评估设计提供了系统化的手段。PrinciplismQA包含3,648个经过专家验证的问题，涵盖了知识评估和临床推理两个方面。我们的评估流程经过专家校准，能够确保评估结果的重复性，并识别模型中的伦理偏见。对最新模型的评估结果显示，尽管这些模型在知识准确性方面表现优异，但在伦理推理方面仍存在显著不足，这表明仅依靠知识驱动的训练方式并不能保证临床决策的伦理合规性。PrinciplismQA提供了一种经过验证的工具，用于评估临床人工智能应用的伦理准备程度。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Take Out Your Calculators: Estimating the Real Difficulty of Question Items with LLM Student Simulations
papers.title_zh: 拿出你的计算器吧：利用LLM学生模拟技术来估算题目实际的难度系数
papers.authors: Christabel Acquaye, Yi Ting Huang, Marine Carpuat, Rachel Rudinger
papers.abstract: Standardized math assessments require expensive human pilot studies to establish the difficulty of test items. We investigate the predictive value of open-source large language models (LLMs) for evaluating the difficulty of multiple-choice math questions for real-world students. We show that, while LLMs are poor direct judges of problem difficulty, simulation-based approaches with LLMs yield promising results under the right conditions. Under the proposed approach, we simulate a “classroom” of 4th, 8th, or 12th grade students by prompting the LLM to role-play students of varying proficiency levels. We use the outcomes of these simulations to fit Item Response Theory (IRT) models, comparing learned difficulty parameters for items to their real-world difficulties, as determined by item-level statistics furnished by the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP). We observe correlations as high as 0.75, 0.76, and 0.82 for grades 4, 8, and 12, respectively. In our simulations, we experiment with different “classroom sizes,” showing tradeoffs between computation size and accuracy. We find that role-plays with named students improves predictions (compared to student ids), and stratifying names across gender and race further improves predictions. Our results show that LLMs with relatively weaker mathematical abilities (Gemma) actually yield better real-world difficulty predictions than mathematically stronger models (Llama and Qwen), further underscoring the suitability of open-source models for the task.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准化的数学评估需要昂贵的人工试点研究来确定试题的难度。我们研究了开源大语言模型在评估现实世界中学生的选择题难度方面的预测能力。我们发现，虽然大语言模型不能直接判断问题的难度，但在适当条件下，结合模拟方法的运用能够取得有希望的结果。在提出的这种方法中，我们通过提示大语言模型扮演不同水平的学生来模拟四年级、八年级或十二年级学生的“课堂场景”。我们利用这些模拟的结果来拟合项目反应理论模型，将学习到的题目难度参数与通过国家教育进展评估提供的实际难度数据进行对比。我们发现，对于四年级、八年级和十二年级的学生来说，相关性分别高达0.75、0.76和0.82。在我们的模拟实验中，我们尝试了不同的“课堂规模”，发现计算量大小与准确性之间存在权衡关系。我们发现，使用带有姓名的学生进行角色扮演可以提高预测效果（相比使用学生ID），而进一步按性别和种族对姓名进行分类则能进一步提升预测精度。我们的结果表明，数学能力相对较弱的大语言模型（如Gemma）实际上能够比数学能力较强的模型（如Llama和Qwen）更好地预测实际难度，这进一步证明了开源模型适用于这项任务。

papers.title: SAFER: Advancing Safety Alignment via Efficient Ex-Ante Reasoning
papers.title_zh: SAFER：通过高效的预推理提升安全性一致性
papers.authors: Kehua Feng, Keyan Ding, Yuhao Wang, Menghan Li, Fanjunduo Wei, Xinda Wang, Huajun Chen
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have accelerated progress toward artificial general intelligence, yet their potential to generate harmful content poses critical safety challenges. Existing alignment methods often struggle to cover diverse safety scenarios and remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. In this work, we propose SAFER, a framework for Safety Alignment via eFficient Ex-Ante Reasoning. Our approach instantiates structured Ex-Ante reasoning through initial assessment, rule verification, and path calibration, and embeds predefined safety rules to provide transparent and verifiable safety judgments. Specifically, our approach consists of two training stages: (1) supervised fine-tuning with synthetic traces to teach the multi-stage Ex-Ante reasoning, and (2) step-level reasoning preference optimization to jointly enhance safety, utility, and efficiency. Experiments on multiple open-source LLMs demonstrate that SAFER significantly enhances safety performance while maintaining helpfulness and response efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展显著推动了通用人工智能的发展，但它们生成有害内容的潜在风险也带来了严峻的安全挑战。现有的对齐方法往往难以应对各种安全场景，且容易受到对抗性攻击的影响。在这项研究中，我们提出了SAFER框架，这是一种通过高效的事前推理来实现安全对齐的框架。我们的方法通过初步评估、规则验证和路径校准来实现结构化的事前推理，并嵌入了预定义的安全规则，从而提供透明且可验证的安全判断。具体来说，我们的方法包含两个训练阶段：(1)使用合成数据进行监督式微调，以教授多阶段的事前推理；(2)通过步骤级推理偏好优化，共同提升安全性、实用性和效率。在多个开源语言模型上的实验表明，SAFER能够在保持有用性和响应效率的同时，显著提升安全性表现。

papers.title: Speculative Verification: Exploiting Information Gain for Speculative Decoding
papers.title_zh: 投机性验证：利用信息增益进行投机性解码
papers.authors: Sungkyun Kim, Jaemin Kim, Dogyeong Yun, Jiho Shin, Junyeol Lee, Jiwon Seo
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) improves LLM inference latency by speculatively generating multiple tokens with a small draft model and verifying them with a larger target model. However, when speculation accuracy is low, the overhead from rejected tokens can negate its benefits, especially at large batch sizes.We propose Speculative Verification (SV), an efficient augmentation to SD that predicts speculation accuracy and dynamically adapts the verification length to maximize throughput. SV introduces a small companion model, similar in size to draft model, to reduce uncertainty in speculation accuracy. By exploiting the information gain from observing the companion distribution, SV reduces wasted verification on rejected tokens and improves decoding efficiency.We evaluate SV across publicly available LLMs on seven NLP tasks using over a hundred combinations of draft, companion, and target models, including 13B–72B target models spanning base, instruction-tuned, and task-specific fine-tuned variants. Compared to target-only decoding, standard SD, and state-of-the-art SD variants, SV consistently delivers higher throughput across batch sizes. SV improves SD performance by up to 1.9\times, with an average 1.4\times speedup at large batch sizes, showing robust and scalable gains for practical LLM inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 推测性解码（SD）通过用小型草稿模型生成多个候选token，然后用更大的目标模型进行验证，来降低LLM推理的延迟。然而，当推测的准确性较低时，由于需要验证被拒绝的候选token而产生的额外开销可能会抵消其优势，尤其是在处理大批量数据的情况下。我们提出了一种名为“推测性验证”（SV）的高效改进方法，该方法能够预测推测的准确性，并动态调整验证长度以最大化吞吐量。SV引入了一个与草稿模型大小相近的小型辅助模型，以降低推测准确性的不确定性。通过利用观察辅助模型分布所获得的信息，SV避免了在被拒绝的候选token上进行不必要的验证，从而提高了解码效率。我们在七项自然语言处理任务上对SV进行了评估，使用了超过一百种不同组合的草稿模型、辅助模型和目标模型，其中包括适用于基础模型、指令调优模型以及特定任务微调模型的13B至72B规模的目标模型。与仅使用目标模型进行解码、标准SD以及最先进的SD变体相比，SV在不同批量大小下都能提供更高的吞吐量。SV的性能提升幅度高达1.9倍，在大批量情况下平均提升速度可达1.4倍，显示出在实用LLM推理中具有稳健且可扩展的优势。

papers.title: EngiBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Engineering Problem Solving
papers.title_zh: EngiBench：用于评估大型语言模型在工程问题解决能力方面的表现的一个基准测试工具
papers.authors: Xiyuan Zhou, Xinlei Wang, Yirui He, Ruixi Zou, Yang Wu, Yuheng Cheng, Yulu Xie, Wenxuan Liu, Huan Zhao, Yan Xu, Jinjin Gu, Junhua Zhao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on mathematical reasoning under well-defined conditions. However, real-world engineering problems involve uncertainty, context, and open-ended settings that extend beyond symbolic computation. Existing benchmarks largely focus on well-defined or abstract reasoning and therefore fail to capture these complexities. We introduce EngiBench, a hierarchical benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs on solving engineering problems. It spans three levels of increasing difficulty (foundational knowledge retrieval, contextual reasoning, and open-ended modeling) and covers diverse engineering subfields. To facilitate a deeper understanding of model performance, we systematically rewrite each problem into three controlled variants (perturbed, knowledge-enhanced, and math abstraction), enabling us to separately evaluate the model’s robustness, domain-specific knowledge, and mathematical reasoning abilities. Experimental results show clear performance stratification across difficulty levels: model accuracy declines with task complexity, degrades under minor perturbations, and remains substantially below human performance on high-level engineering tasks. These findings reveal that current LLMs still lack the high-level reasoning needed for real-world engineering, highlighting the need for future models with deeper and more reliable problem-solving capabilities. Our source code and data are available at https://github.com/AI4Engi/EngiBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在明确条件下的数学推理任务上表现优异。然而，现实世界的工程问题涉及不确定性、上下文以及需要解决开放式问题的复杂情况，这些都与符号计算有所不同。现有的评估基准大多集中在明确的或抽象性的推理任务上，因此无法涵盖这些复杂性。我们提出了EngiBench这一分层评估基准，旨在评估语言模型在解决工程问题方面的能力。该基准涵盖了三个难度等级：基础知识的检索、上下文推理以及开放式建模，并且覆盖了多个不同的工程领域。为了更深入地了解模型的性能，我们将每个问题系统地分解为三个受控变体：扰动版本、知识增强版本以及数学抽象版本。这样我们可以分别评估模型的鲁棒性、特定领域的知识储备以及数学推理能力。实验结果表明，不同难度级别下的模型表现存在明显差异：随着任务难度的增加，模型的准确性会下降；在较小的扰动下，模型的性能也会受到影响；而在高层次的工程任务中，模型的性能仍然远低于人类的表现。这些发现表明，当前的语言模型仍缺乏应对现实世界工程问题所需的高级推理能力，这凸显了未来模型需要具备更深刻且更可靠的问题解决能力的必要性。我们的源代码和数据可以在https://github.com/AI4Engi/EngiBench获取。

papers.title: LLM-Based Human-Agent Collaboration and Interaction Systems: A Survey
papers.title_zh: 基于人工智能的人类与智能体协作与交互系统：综述
papers.authors: Henry Peng Zou, Wei-Chieh Huang, Yaozu Wu, Jizhou Guo, Yankai Chen, Chunyu Miao, Hoang H Nguyen, Yue Zhou, Weizhi Zhang, Liancheng Fang, Hanrong Zhang, Fangxin Wang, Pengfei Zhang, Langzhou He, Yangning Li, Dongyuan Li, Renhe Jiang, Philip S. Yu
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have sparked growing interest in building fully autonomous agents. However, fully autonomous LLM-based agents still face significant challenges, including limited reliability due to hallucinations, difficulty in handling complex tasks, and substantial safety and ethical risks, all of which limit their feasibility and trustworthiness in real-world applications. To overcome these limitations, LLM-based human-agent systems (LLM-HAS) incorporate human-provided information, feedback, or control into the agent system to enhance system performance, reliability, and safety. These human-agent collaboration systems enable humans and LLM-based agents to collaborate effectively by leveraging their complementary strengths.This paper provides the first comprehensive and structured survey of LLM-HAS. It clarifies fundamental concepts, systematically presents core components shaping these systems, including environment and profiling, human feedback, interaction types, orchestration, and communication, explores emerging applications, and discusses unique challenges and opportunities arising from human-AI collaboration. By consolidating current knowledge and offering a structured overview, we aim to foster further research and innovation in this rapidly evolving interdisciplinary field. Paper lists and resources are available at https://github.com/HenryPengZou/Awesome-Human-Agent-Collaboration-Interaction-Systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展引发了人们对构建完全自主智能体的浓厚兴趣。然而，基于LLM的完全自主智能体仍面临诸多挑战，包括因幻觉而产生的可靠性问题、处理复杂任务的困难，以及显著的安全与伦理风险。这些挑战限制了它们在现实应用中的可行性和可信度。为了克服这些限制，基于LLM的人机协作系统将人类提供的信息、反馈或控制融入智能体系统中，以提升系统的性能、可靠性和安全性。这类人机协作系统使得人类和基于LLM的智能体能够充分发挥各自的优势，实现有效的协同工作。本文首次对基于LLM的人机协作系统进行了全面而系统的综述。文章阐明了相关的基本概念，系统地介绍了构成这些系统的核心要素，包括环境分析与建模、人类反馈、交互类型、协调机制以及通信方式。同时，文章还探讨了新兴的应用领域，并讨论了人机协作所带来的独特挑战和机遇。通过整合现有知识并提供系统的概述，我们希望能够促进这一快速发展的跨学科领域的进一步研究和创新。论文中列出的资源可访问https://github.com/HenryPengZou/Awesome-Human-Agent-Collaboration-Interaction-Systems。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Thinking Twice Makes Large Language Models Safer and More Helpful
papers.title_zh: 多考虑一步能让大型语言模型更加安全且更有用
papers.authors: Yutao Mou, Yuxiao Luo, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
papers.abstract: Current safety alignment techniques for large language models (LLMs) struggle to balance harmlessness and helpfulness: improving safety often comes at the cost of degraded utility. Our preliminary study shows that guiding unaligned base models with safety-aware reasoning that includes explicit self-reflection can effectively defend jailbreak attacks while preserving response quality. This observation motivates internalizing and strengthening self-reflective reasoning capabilities within LLMs to achieve a better safety–utility trade-off. We propose Safety-aware Reflective Reasoning Optimization (SaRO), a two-stage framework: (1) Reasoning-style Warmup (RW) to internalize self-reflective reasoning, and (2) Self-reflective Reasoning Process Optimization (SRPO) to encourage reflection and correction. Experiments show that SaRO outperforms existing reasoning-based alignment methods, achieving a better balance of safety and helpfulness.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，针对大语言模型的安全性对齐技术在平衡无害性与实用性方面存在困难：提升安全性往往会导致实用性下降。我们的初步研究表明，通过包含明确自我反思的安全意识推理来指导那些未对齐的基础模型，能够有效防御越狱攻击，同时保持良好的响应质量。这一发现促使我们努力在大语言模型中内置并强化自我反思能力，以实现更好的安全性与实用性之间的平衡。我们提出了一种名为“安全意识反思推理优化”的两阶段框架：(1) 以推理风格进行的预热阶段，用于内置自我反思能力；(2) 自我反思推理过程优化阶段，用于促进反思与修正。实验表明，SaRO在平衡安全性和实用性方面优于现有的基于推理的对齐方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AEQ-Bench: Measuring Empathy of Omni-Modal Large Models
papers.title_zh: AEQ-Bench：用于评估全模态大型模型的共情能力
papers.authors: Xuan Luo, Lewei Yao, Lanqing Hong, Kai Chen, Dehua Tao, Daxin Tan, Yukun Deng, Ruifeng Xu, Jing Li
papers.abstract: While the automatic evaluation of omni-modal large models (OLMs) is essential, assessing empathy remains a significant challenge due to its inherent affectivity. To investigate this challenge, we introduce AEQ-Bench (Audio Empathy Quotient Benchmark), a novel benchmark to systematically assess two core empathetic capabilities of OLMs: (i) generating empathetic responses by comprehending affective cues from multi-modal inputs (audio + text), and (ii) judging the empathy of audio responses without relying on text transcription. Compared to existing benchmarks, AEQ-Bench incorporates two novel settings that vary in context specificity and speech tone. Comprehensive assessment across linguistic and paralinguistic metrics reveals that (1) OLMs trained with audio output capabilities generally outperformed models with text-only outputs, and (2) while OLMs align with human judgments for coarse-grained quality assessment, they remain unreliable for evaluating fine-grained paralinguistic expressiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然对全模态大型模型进行自动评估非常重要，但由于其固有的情感特性，评估同理心仍然是一个重大挑战。为了研究这一挑战，我们提出了AEQ-Bench（音频同理心指数基准测试），这是一个新的基准测试，旨在系统地评估全模态大型模型的两种核心同理心能力：(i) 通过理解多模态输入（音频+文本）中的情感线索来生成同理心的响应；(ii) 在不依赖文本转录的情况下判断音频响应的同理心程度。与现有的基准测试相比，AEQ-Bench引入了两种新的测试环境，这两种环境的上下文特异性和语音语调有所不同。通过对语言和副语言指标的全面评估，我们发现：(1) 使用音频输出能力训练的全模态大型模型通常优于仅使用文本输出的模型；(2) 虽然全模态大型模型在粗略级别的质量评估方面与人类判断一致，但在评估细微的副语言表现时却不够可靠。

papers.title: BAPO: Boundary-Aware Policy Optimization for Reliable Agentic Search
papers.title_zh: BAPO：考虑边界条件的策略优化方法，以实现可靠的智能体搜索
papers.authors: Shiyu Liu, Yongjing Yin, Jianhao Yan, Yunbo Tang, Qinggang Zhang, Bei Li, Xin Chen, Jingang Wang, Xunliang Cai, Jinsong Su
papers.abstract: RL-based agentic search enables LLMs to solve complex questions via dynamic planning and external search. While this approach significantly enhances accuracy with agent policies optimized via large-scale reinforcement learning, we identify a critical gap in reliability: these agents fail to recognize their reasoning boundaries and rarely admit “I DON’T KNOW” even when evidence is insufficient or reasoning reaches its limit. The lack of reliability often leads to plausible but unreliable answers, introducing significant risks in many real-world scenarios. To this end, we propose Boundary-Aware Policy Optimization (BAPO), a novel RL framework designed to cultivate reliable boundary awareness without compromising accuracy. BAPO introduces two key components: (i) a group-based boundary-aware reward that encourages an IDK response only when the reasoning reaches its limit, and (ii) an adaptive reward modulator that strategically suspends this reward during early exploration, preventing the model from exploiting IDK as a shortcut. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that BAPO substantially enhances the overall reliability of agentic search.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于强化学习的智能体搜索使得大语言模型能够通过动态规划和外部搜索来解决复杂问题。虽然这种方法通过大规模强化学习优化了智能体的策略，从而显著提升了准确性，但我们发现了一个关键的可靠性问题：这些智能体无法识别自己的推理边界，即使证据不足或推理达到极限时，它们也很少承认“我不知道”。这种缺乏可靠性的情况往往会导致看似合理但不可靠的回答，从而在许多现实场景中带来重大风险。为此，我们提出了边界感知策略优化（BAPO）这一新型强化学习框架。该框架包含两个关键组件：(i) 一种基于群体的边界感知奖励机制，只有当推理达到极限时才鼓励使用“我不知道”的回答；(ii) 一个自适应奖励调节器，它在早期探索阶段会战略性地暂停这种奖励机制，防止模型将“我不知道”作为捷径使用。在四个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，BAPO显著提高了智能体搜索的整体可靠性。

papers.title: GRASP: Graph-Reasoning Aided Survey Planning for High-Fidelity Related Work Generation
papers.title_zh: GRASP：基于图推理的高保真度调查规划方法 相关研究工作概述
papers.authors: Haoming Li, Jessica Ouyang
papers.abstract: Writing a literature review requires a deep understanding of the relationships among cited papers: how they build on, challenge, or offer alternative perspectives to one another. We present Graph-Reasoning Aided Survey Planning (GRASP), a framework combining LLM planning for related work generation with graph algorithms to extract key relationships among cited papers. Our two-layer graph structure consists of a Graph of Thoughts and an Argument-Counteragument Planning Network, representing the cited papers at different levels of granularity, and we apply topology-aware pruning via a Steiner tree to identify the core inter-paper relationships captured in our graph. Our citation analysis-based evaluation shows that GRASP generates RWS that closely match human-written targets in terms of the discourse roles, intents, and grouping of citations.
papers.abstract_zh: 撰写文献综述需要深入理解被引用论文之间的关系：它们是如何相互补充、相互挑战，还是提出不同的观点。我们提出了基于图推理的调研规划方法（GRASP），该框架结合了大语言模型用于生成相关工作的规划功能，以及图算法来提取被引用论文之间的关键关系。我们的双层图结构包括“思想图”和“论点-反驳规划网络”，分别代表了不同粒度级别的被引用论文。我们通过使用斯坦纳树进行拓扑感知的剪枝操作，以识别图中体现的核心论文间关系。基于引文分析的评估结果显示，GRASP生成的调研方案在话语角色、意图以及引文分组方面，与人工编写的调研方案高度一致。

papers.title: Benchmarking Agentic Newswriting via Journalistic Workflows
papers.title_zh: 通过新闻工作流程来提升新闻写作水平的研究
papers.authors: Yen-Che Chien, Kuang-Da Wang, Wei-Yao Wang, Wen-Chih Peng
papers.abstract: Recent advances in autonomous digital agents from industry (e.g., Manus AI and Gemini’s research mode) highlight their potential for structured tasks through autonomous decision-making and task decomposition, but it remains unclear how well such systems support real-world information-intensive workflows. We study this question in journalism, where newswriting requires iterative planning, contextual reasoning, and active discovery of missing background to produce a coherent article. We introduce NEWSAGENT, a benchmark for evaluating how agents search raw materials, select relevant information, and iteratively revise drafts through core journalistic functions. Given a writing instruction and partial firsthand materials, agents must identify narrative perspectives, issue keyword-based queries, retrieve historical context, and generate complete news articles. Unlike typical summarization or retrieval tasks, essential context is not directly available and must be actively discovered, reflecting real-world reporting constraints. NEWSAGENT consists of 6k human-verified examples derived from real news. We evaluate open- and closed-sourced LLMs with commonly-used agentic frameworks on NEWSAGENT, which shows that agents are capable of retrieving relevant facts but struggling with planning and narrative integration. We believe that NEWSAGENT serves a realistic testbed for iterating and evaluating agent capabilities in terms of web data manipulation to real-world productivity. The benchmark resources are publicly available at https://github.com/wywyWang/CoachAI-Projects.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在行业领域对自主数字代理的研究进展（例如Manus AI和Gemini的研究模式）表明，这些代理通过自主决策和任务分解能够完成结构化任务。不过，目前尚不清楚这类系统在实际的信息密集型工作流程中表现如何。我们在新闻领域研究了这个问题：新闻写作需要迭代规划、上下文推理以及主动发现缺失的背景信息，以撰写出连贯的文章。我们开发了NEWSAGENT这一基准测试工具，用于评估代理如何搜索原始数据、选择相关信息，并通过核心新闻功能逐步修改稿子。给定一篇写作指令和部分第一手资料后，代理需要确定叙事视角、进行关键词查询、检索历史背景，并生成完整的新闻文章。与典型的摘要或检索任务不同，关键背景信息并非直接可得，而是需要主动发现，这反映了实际报道中的限制条件。NEWSAGENT包含6千个来自真实新闻的人类验证示例。我们对使用开源和闭源LLM的代理框架在NEWSAGENT上的表现进行了评估，结果显示，代理能够检索到相关事实，但在规划和叙事整合方面存在困难。我们认为，NEWSAGENT是一个现实可行的测试平台，可以让我们不断迭代和评估代理在网页数据处理方面的能力，从而提升实际工作的效率。该基准资源可在https://github.com/wywyWang/CoachAI-Projects获取。

papers.title: Self-Correcting Text-to-Video Generation with Misalignment Detection and Localized Refinement
papers.title_zh: 具有错位检测功能的自修正文本转视频生成技术，以及局部优化处理
papers.authors: Daeun Lee, Jaehong Yoon, Jaemin Cho, Mohit Bansal
papers.abstract: Recent text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models have made remarkable progress in generating high-quality videos. However, they often struggle to align with complex text prompts, particularly when multiple objects, attributes, or spatial relations are specified. We introduce VideoRepair, the first self-correcting, training-free, and model-agnostic video refinement framework that automatically detects fine- grained text–video misalignments and performs targeted, localized corrections. Our key insight is that even misaligned videos usually contain correctly generated regions that should be preserved rather than regenerated. Building on this observation, VideoRepair proposes a novel region-preserving refinement strategy with three stages: (i) misalignment detection, where MLLM-based evaluation with automatically generated evaluation questions identifies misaligned regions; (ii) refinement planning, which preserves correctly generated entities, segments their regions across frames, and constructs targeted prompts for misaligned areas; and (iii) localized refinement, which selectively regenerates problematic regions while preserving faithful content through joint optimization of preserved and newly generated areas. On two benchmarks, EvalCrafter and T2V-CompBench with four recent T2V backbones, VideoRepair achieves substantial improvements over recent baselines across diverse alignment metrics. Comprehensive ablations further demonstrate the efficiency, robustness, and interpretability of our framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的文本到视频生成模型在生成高质量视频方面取得了显著进展。然而，这些模型往往难以处理复杂的文本提示，特别是当需要指定多个对象、属性或空间关系时。我们提出了VideoRepair这一创新框架，它是首个具有自我校正功能、无需训练且不受模型限制的视频优化工具。该框架能够自动检测文本与视频之间的错位情况，并针对错位区域进行局部修复。我们的核心思路是：即使视频存在错位，其中一些正确生成的区域仍然应该被保留，而不是重新生成。基于这一发现，VideoRepair提出了一种新颖的区域保留优化策略，该策略包含三个阶段：(1) 错位检测，通过基于MLLM的评估方法，结合自动生成的评估问题来识别错位区域；(2) 优化规划，这部分会保留已生成的正确区域，将它们的区域分配到不同的帧中，并为错位的区域生成有针对性的提示；(3) 局部优化，这部分会选择性地重新生成有问题的区域，同时通过联合优化保留下来的区域和新生成的区域，来确保内容的忠实性。在EvalCrafter和T2V-CompBench这两个基准测试上，以及使用四种最新的T2V基础模型进行测试时，VideoRepair在多种对齐指标上均取得了显著的改进。进一步的实验也证明了该框架的高效性、鲁棒性和可解释性。

papers.title: Switching Heads and Softening Tokens: Turnkey Solutions to Visually Grounded Document QA
papers.title_zh: 切换标题与软化令牌：Turnkey解决方案用于可视化驱动的文档质量检查
papers.authors: Ximing Wen, Wenbo Li, Sudipta Paul, Yashas Malur Saidutta, Kalpa Gunaratna, Srinivas Chappidi
papers.abstract: Visually Grounded Document Question Answering often lacks robust, end-to-end solutions capable of handling complex, multi-answer queries without reliance on ad-hoc processing. In this work, we propose two turnkey LLM architectures to address this gap. We first introduce a single-head architecture where coordinates are represented as special tokens within the unified vocabulary. While structurally robust, this approach suffers from the limitations of discrete supervision; to address this, we propose a novel “softening token” method that enables differentiable Mean-Squared-Error loss over token probabilities. Although this significantly improves visual grounding, the spatial precision remains bound by discretization. Consequently, we propose a second solution: a dual-head architecture that alternates between text generation and regression-based bounding box prediction. This method offers high spatial precision via a regression head, further stabilized by our introduction of an Intersection-over-Union loss. Finally, by combining the single head model’s structural robustness with the high precision of the dual head model, we propose an ensemble method that yields significant performance gains beyond each of individual components.
papers.abstract_zh: 在视觉基础文档问答领域，通常缺乏能够处理复杂多答案查询的稳健端到端解决方案，而这些解决方案无需依赖临时化处理。在这项研究中，我们提出了两种基于大语言模型的架构来填补这一空白。首先，我们介绍了一种单头部架构，其中坐标被表示为统一词汇表中的特殊标记。虽然这种架构在结构上很稳健，但它存在离散监督的局限性。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的“软化标记”方法，该方法能够实现对标记概率的微分均方误差损失。尽管这种方法显著提升了视觉定位的准确性，但空间精度仍然受到离散化的限制。因此，我们提出了第二种解决方案：双头部架构，该架构在文本生成和基于回归的边界框预测之间交替进行。这种方法通过回归头部实现了高空间精度，而我们的交叉覆盖损失则进一步稳定了性能。最后，通过将单头部模型的结构稳健性与双头部模型的高精度相结合，我们提出了一种集成方法，该方法在性能上取得了显著的提升，超越了各个独立组件的性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: HTMuon: Improving Muon via Heavy-Tailed Spectral Correction
papers.title_zh: HTMuon：通过重尾谱校正来提升μ子探测能力
papers.authors: Tianyu Pang, Yujie Fang, Zihang Liu, Shenyang Deng, Lei Hsiung, Shuhua Yu, Yaoqing Yang
papers.abstract: Muon has recently shown promising results in LLM training. In this work, we study how to further improve Muon. We argue that Muon’s orthogonalized update rule suppresses the emergence of heavy-tailed weight spectra and over-emphasizes the training along noise-dominated directions. Motivated by the Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR) theory, we propose HTMuon. HTMuon preserves Muon’s ability to capture parameter interdependencies while producing heavier-tailed updates and inducing heavier-tailed weight spectra. Experiments on LLM pretraining and image classification show that HTMuon consistently improves performance over state-of-the-art baselines and can also serve as a plug-in on top of existing Muon variants. For example, on LLaMA pretraining on the C4 dataset, HTMuon reduces perplexity by up to 0.98 compared to Muon. We further theoretically show that HTMuon corresponds to steepest descent under the Schatten-q norm constraint and provide convergence analysis in smooth non-convex settings. The implementation of HTMuon is available at https://github.com/TDCSZ327/HTmuon.
papers.abstract_zh: 缪恩在大语言模型训练方面取得了令人期待的成果。在这项研究中，我们探讨了如何进一步改进缪恩算法。我们认为，缪恩的正交化更新规则能够抑制重尾权重谱的出现，同时更强调对以噪声为主导的方向进行训练。受重尾自正则化理论启发，我们提出了HT缪恩算法。HT缪恩保留了缪恩捕捉参数相互依赖性的能力，同时产生了更重尾的更新结果，并诱导出更重尾的权重谱。在大语言模型预训练和图像分类任务中的实验表明，HT缪恩算法始终能超越现有的最佳基线算法，并且可以作为现有缪恩算法的补充。例如，在C4数据集上的LLM预训练实验中，HT缪恩算法将困惑度降低了0.98。我们还从理论上证明了HT缪恩算法符合在Schatten-q范数约束下的最速下降法，并提供了在光滑非凸环境下的收敛性分析。HT缪恩算法的实现代码可访问于https://github.com/TDCSZ327/HTmuon。

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Effectively Support Decision-Making in Sudden Emergencies?
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否有效支持突发紧急情况下的决策制定？
papers.authors: Mengna Zhu, Jibing Wu, Lihua Liu, Yuran Gong, Yang Hao, Fu Yachao, Mao Wang, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li
papers.abstract: Emergency response is a safety-critical public governance task that demands accurate and timely decision-making based on complex event information. This process involves multiple stages, including information collection, integration, analysis, risk assessment, and decision recommendation. Existing research has predominantly concentrated on the earlier stages, while studies focusing on the decision support phase remain underexplored, primarily due to the lack of suitable datasets for reliable and compliance-aware decision-oriented modeling and evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce the first real-world Emergency Decision-Making dataset EDM-Bench, comprising 1,179 instances spanning diverse task formats, including judgment, choice, short-answer, and structured emergency report generation. We also construct a structured rule repository, EDM-R², which contains 3,406 parsed emergency regulations to enhance decision reliability. Building on these resources, we propose a rule-enhanced reasoning framework, R³V-EDM, which integrates external regulatory knowledge with constrained inference mechanisms to improve both decision safety and interpretability. Extensive experiments demonstrate the inherent complexity of emergency decision-making and validate the effectiveness of our approach in enabling more reliable and trustworthy decisions.
papers.abstract_zh: 应急响应是一项至关重要的公共治理任务，需要基于复杂事件信息做出准确且及时的决策。这一过程包含多个阶段，包括信息收集、整合、分析、风险评估以及决策建议的提出。目前的研究主要集中在前几个阶段，而关于决策支持阶段的研究则相对较少，主要是因为缺乏适合进行可靠且符合合规要求的决策建模与评估的数据集。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了首个真实世界的应急决策数据集EDM-Bench，该数据集包含1,179个案例，涵盖多种任务形式，如判断、选择、简答题回答以及结构化应急报告生成等。我们还构建了一个结构化规则库EDM-R²，其中包含了3,406条解析后的应急法规，以提高决策的可靠性。基于这些资源，我们提出了一种结合外部监管知识与受限推理机制的增强型推理框架R³V-EDM，以提升决策的安全性和可解释性。大量的实验表明，应急决策具有固有的复杂性，我们的方法能够有效实现更可靠和可信的决策。

papers.title: J-Shuwa: A Large-Scale Web-Collected Japanese Sign Language-Japanese Parallel Corpus
papers.title_zh: J-Shuwa：一个由网络收集而成的大规模日语手语与日语平行语料库
papers.authors: Junwen Mo, MinhDuc Vo, Noriki Nishida, Shin’ichi Satoh, Hideki Nakayama
papers.abstract: Japanese Sign Language (JSL) is a low-resource sign language that has received limited attention in the AI research community, primarily due to the lack of large-scale, publicly available parallel corpora. In this work, we introduce J-Shuwa, a large-scale JSL-Japanese parallel corpus constructed from YouTube videos with hard-coded subtitles and closed captions. The corpus contains 197K parallel JSL-Japanese sentence pairs, totaling approximately 300 hours of video, making it the largest publicly available JSL dataset to date. We conduct sign language translation (SLT) experiments by training models on J-Shuwa and evaluating them on the JSL Dialogue Corpus under both zero-shot and fine-tuned settings. Our results demonstrate that J-Shuwa is effective for training SLT models. Beyond SLT, we believe that J-Shuwa can also serve as a valuable resource for future JSL research across a wide range of tasks. The dataset and code are publicly available at: https://github.com/SpaJune/J-Shuwa.
papers.abstract_zh: 日语手语（JSL）是一种资源匮乏的手语，在人工智能研究领域中受到的关注相对较少，主要是因为缺乏大规模、公开可用的平行语料库。在这项研究中，我们引入了J-Shuwa，这是一个由YouTube视频构建的大规模JSL-日语平行语料库，这些视频带有硬编码的字幕和旁白。该语料库包含19.7万对JSL-日语平行句子对，总时长约300小时，是迄今为止公开可用的最大规模的JSL数据集。我们通过在J-Shuwa上训练模型，并在零样本和微调两种模式下对其进行评估，来开展手语翻译实验。我们的结果表明，J-Shuwa对于训练手语翻译模型非常有效。除了手语翻译之外，我们认为J-Shuwa还可以作为未来JSL研究的宝贵资源，适用于各种任务。该数据集和代码可在此处免费获取：https://github.com/SpaJune/J-Shuwa
