papers.title: Why Can Distillation Work with Limited Resources? A Systematic Study
papers.title_zh: 为什么蒸馏法能够在资源有限的情况下发挥作用？一项系统的研究
papers.authors: Xiao Hu, Xingyu Lu, Liyuan Mao, YiFan Zhang, Tianke Zhang, Bin Wen, Fan Yang, Tingting Gao, Guorui Zhou
papers.abstract: Recently, large language models have made remarkable progress in reasoning, largely driven by scaling data and model size. In parallel, several studies argue that for smaller models, high-quality distillation can yield strong reasoning performance with minimal resources. However, a framework for understanding machine reasoning that explains why low-resource distillation can boost model performance is still missing. In this paper, we conduct a controlled case study: using less than 920 examples, a simple distillation based on the base model can actually achieve notable reasoning performance improvement, compared with the base model and even the zero-RL models. By analyzing the token frequency in model outputs, we find that the distilled model shows more flexible reasoning. It uses anthropomorphic tokens and logical connectors much more often than the base and zero-RL model. Further analysis reveals that distillation enhances the presence of two advanced cognitive behaviors: Multi-Perspective Thinking or Attempting and Metacognitive Awareness. Frequent occurrences of these two advanced cognitive behaviors give rise to flexible reasoning, which is essential for solving reasoning problems.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，大语言模型在推理能力方面取得了显著进展，这主要得益于数据规模和模型容量的提升。与此同时，一些研究指出，对于较小的模型来说，高质量的蒸馏技术可以在最少的资源条件下实现强大的推理性能。然而，目前仍然缺乏一个能够解释为何低资源条件下的蒸馏技术能够提升模型性能的框架。在本文中，我们开展了一项控制实验：仅使用不到920个样本，基于基础模型的简单蒸馏实际上可以取得与基础模型甚至零RL模型相比更为显著的推理性能提升。通过分析模型输出中的词频，我们发现蒸馏后的模型表现出更灵活的推理能力。它比基础模型和零RL模型更频繁地使用拟人化词汇和逻辑连接词。进一步分析表明，蒸馏技术增强了两种高级认知行为的表现：多视角思考以及元认知能力。这两种高级认知行为的频繁出现使得模型能够展现出更灵活的推理能力，这对于解决推理问题至关重要。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Autoregressive Semantic Visual Reconstruction Helps VLMs Understand Better
papers.title_zh: 自回归语义视觉重建技术有助于语言模型更好地理解文本含义
papers.authors: Dianyi Wang, Wei Song, Yikun Wang, Siyuan Wang, Kaicheng Yu, Zhongyu Wei, Jiaqi Wang
papers.abstract: Typical large vision-language models (LVLMs) apply autoregressive supervision primarily to textual responses, without fully exploiting causal learning over rich visual inputs. As a result, these models often emphasize vision-to-language alignment while potentially overlooking fine-grained visual information. While prior work has explored autoregressive image generation, effectively leveraging autoregressive visual supervision to enhance image understanding remains an open challenge. In this paper, we introduce Autoregressive Semantic Visual Reconstruction (ASVR), which enables joint learning of visual and textual modalities within a unified autoregressive framework. ASVR trains models to autoregressively reconstruct the semantic content of input images, which consistently enhances multimodal comprehension. Notably, we show that even when provided with continuous image features as input, models can effectively reconstruct discrete semantic tokens, resulting in stable and consistent improvements across various multimodal understanding benchmarks. ASVR delivers significant performance gains and scalability across varying data scales, visual input, visual supervision and model architectures. In particular, ASVR generally improves baselines by 2-3% across 14 multimodal benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 典型的大型视觉-语言模型主要对文本响应应用自回归监督机制，而未能充分利用丰富的视觉输入进行因果学习。因此，这些模型往往强调视觉与语言的对齐，却可能忽略细粒度的视觉信息。虽然之前的研究已经探索了自回归图像生成技术，但有效利用自回归视觉监督来提升图像理解能力仍然是一个未解决的挑战。在本文中，我们提出了自回归语义视觉重构算法，该算法能够在统一的自回归框架内实现视觉和文本模态的联合学习。ASVR训练出的模型能够自回归地重构输入图像的语义内容，从而持续提升多模态理解能力。值得注意的是，即使以连续的图像特征作为输入，模型也能有效地重构离散的语义标记，从而在各种多模态理解基准测试中取得稳定且一致的改进。ASVR在不同数据规模、视觉输入、视觉监督以及模型架构下都能展现出显著的性能提升。具体来说，在14个多模态基准测试中，ASVR通常能将性能提升2-3%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MSCode: Advancing Human Motion-Language Understanding via Modality-Shared Codebook
papers.title_zh: MSCode：通过共享模态的编码簿来推进人类运动与语言理解的研究
papers.authors: Haoyu Shi, Huaiwen Zhang
papers.abstract: Recently, human motion understanding has been a prominent area of research due to its critical importance in many fields. The key to advancing this understanding lies in the precise alignment between motion and linguistic modalities. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: global contrastive alignment and vocabulary space-based alignment. However, motion sequences exhibit sequential spatiotemporal dynamics while text conveys abstract semantics, leading to a fundamental mismatch in semantic levels and granularities. This undermines cross-modal alignment and results in suboptimal downstream performance. To alleviate this, we introduce a modality-shared codebook that enables unified representation learning and precise alignment of motion and linguistic modalities. Each codeword in the codebook is regularized to encode cross-modality shared semantics, and we leverage sparse activation and distribution consistency loss to enforce matched motion and text are represented by the same set of codewords. Additionally, we introduce a locality-aware Gaussian encoder to refine pose features and design a hard-negative guided loss to strengthen alignment discriminability. Extensive experiments across various language-motion evaluation, including text-motion retrieval, text-motion grounding, and motion caption, demonstrate that our model significantly surpasses current state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，人类运动理解已成为一个重要的研究领域，因为它在许多领域都具有重要意义。推动这一理解进展的关键在于运动与语言模态之间的精确对齐。现有的方法主要遵循两种范式：全局对比对齐和基于词汇空间的对齐。然而，运动序列具有连续的时空动态特征，而文本则传达抽象语义，这导致语义层次和细节上的根本不匹配。这种不匹配会破坏跨模态对齐，从而导致下游性能不佳。为了缓解这一问题，我们引入了一个共享模态的编码簿，它能够实现统一的表示学习，并精确对齐运动与语言模态。编码簿中的每个编码词都被规范化以编码跨模态共享的语义信息，同时我们利用稀疏激活和分布一致性损失来强制运动与文本由相同的编码词集来表示。此外，我们还引入了一个考虑局部性的高斯编码器来细化姿态特征，并设计了一种基于硬负样本的判别损失来增强对齐的区分能力。在多种语言-运动评估任务中的广泛实验表明，我们的模型显著优于当前最先进的方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: RAG over Tables: Hierarchical Memory Index, Multi-Stage Retrieval, and Benchmarking
papers.title_zh: 基于表的RAG：分层记忆索引、多阶段检索与性能评估
papers.authors: Jiaru Zou, Dongqi Fu, Sirui Chen, Xinrui He, Zihao Li, Yada Zhu, Jiawei Han, Jingrui He
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by integrating them with an external knowledge base to improve the answer relevance and accuracy. In real-world scenarios, beyond pure text, a substantial amount of knowledge is stored in tables, and user questions often require retrieving answers that are distributed across multiple tables. Retrieving knowledge from a table corpora (i.e., various individual tables) for a question remains nascent, for (i) how to understand intra- and inter-table knowledge effectively, (ii) how to filter unnecessary tables and retrieve the most relevant tables efficiently, (iii) how to organize complex retrieved contexts for LLMs’ reasoning, and (iv) how to evaluate the corresponding performance in a realistic setting. Facing the above challenges, in this paper, we first propose a table-corpora-aware RAG framework, named T-RAG, which consists of the hierarchical memory index, multi-stage retrieval, and graph-aware context organization for effective and efficient table knowledge retrieval and inference. Then, we develop a multi-table question answering benchmark named MultiTableQA, which spans 3 different task types, 57,193 tables, and 23,758 questions in total, and the sources are all from real-world scenarios. Based on MultiTableQA, we perform a comprehensive comparison of table retrieval methods, RAG-based approaches, and table-to-graph representation learning methods. T-RAG consistently achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, recall, and runtime performance, with improvements of up to 9.4%. Moreover, T-RAG yields an average inference gain of 11.8% across different downstream backbone LLMs. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/jiaruzouu/T-RAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将大语言模型与外部知识库相结合，提升了模型的回答相关性和准确性。在现实场景中，除了纯文本之外，还有大量知识存储在表格中，而用户的问题往往需要检索分布在多个表格中的答案。从表格语料库（即各个独立的表格）中检索信息仍然存在许多挑战，例如如何有效理解表格内部和之间的关联信息、如何过滤不必要的表格并高效地获取最相关的表格信息、如何为大语言模型的推理整理复杂的检索结果，以及如何在实际环境中评估这些方法的性能。为了应对上述挑战，本文首先提出了一种名为T-RAG的表格语料库感知RAG框架。该框架包括分层记忆索引、多阶段检索以及基于图的上下文组织技术，从而实现高效且准确的表格知识检索和推理。接着，我们开发了一个名为MultiTableQA的多表格问答基准测试，该测试涵盖了3种不同的任务类型、57,193个表格以及23,758个问题，所有数据都来自现实场景。基于MultiTableQA，我们对表格检索方法、基于RAG的方法以及表格到图的表示学习方法进行了全面比较。结果表明，T-RAG始终能够保持最先进的准确率、召回率和运行效率，其性能提升幅度高达9.4%。此外，T-RAG在不同下游主干语言模型上的推理性能平均提升了11.8%。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/jiaruzouu/T-RAG下载。

papers.title: CoTEvol: Self-Evolving Chain-of-Thoughts for Data Synthesis in Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: CoTEvol：一种自进化的思维链，用于数学推理中的数据合成
papers.authors: Zhuo Wang, Zhuo Zhang, Yafu Li, Yu Cheng, Lizhen Qu, Zenglin Xu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong mathematical reasoning when trained on high-quality Chain-of-Thought (CoT) that articulates intermediate steps, yet costly CoT curation hinders further progress. While existing remedies such as distillation from stronger LLMs and self-synthesis based on test-time search alleviate this issue, they often suffer from diminishing returns or high computing overhead. In this work, we propose CoTEvol, a genetic evolutionary framework that casts CoT generation as a population-based search over reasoning trajectories. Candidate trajectories are iteratively evolved through reflective global crossover at the trajectory level and local mutation guided by uncertainty at the step level, enabling holistic recombination and fine-grained refinement. Lightweight, task-aware fitness functions are designed to guide the evolutionary process toward accurate and diverse reasoning. Empirically, improves correct-CoT synthesis success by over 30% and enhances structural diversity, with markedly improved efficiency. LLMs trained on these evolutionary CoT data achieve an average gain of 6.6% across eight math benchmarks, outperforming previous distillation and self-synthesis approaches. These results underscore the promise of evolutionary CoT synthesis as a scalable and effective method for mathematical reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在训练时使用高质量的思维链数据时，能够展现出强大的数学推理能力。然而，复杂的思维链处理过程会耗费大量资源，这限制了模型的进一步改进。虽然现有的解决方案，如利用更强的语言模型进行蒸馏，以及基于测试时间搜索的自合成方法，可以一定程度上缓解这一问题，但这些方法往往存在收益递减或计算成本过高的问题。在这项研究中，我们提出了CoTEvol这一遗传进化框架，它将思维链生成视为对推理轨迹的群体式搜索过程。通过轨迹级别的全局交叉和步骤级别的不确定性引导下的局部变异，候选推理轨迹得以逐步优化，从而实现整体重组和精细调整。我们设计了轻量级、任务感知的适应度函数，以引导进化过程朝着准确且多样化的推理方向发展。实验结果表明，该方法使正确思维链生成的成功率提高了30%以上，同时提升了模型的多样性，并显著提高了效率。在八个数学基准测试中，使用这种进化思维链数据进行训练的模型平均提升了6.6%的性能，优于之前的蒸馏和自合成方法。这些结果凸显了进化思维链合成作为一种可扩展且有效的数学推理方法的前景。

papers.title: Feedback Is The Key for Automated Survey Generation
papers.title_zh: 反馈是自动化调查生成的关键所在
papers.authors: Tianyi Xu, Zhe Zhao, Tianshuo Wei, Yiqun Kou, Liuliu Han, Ye Wei
papers.abstract: The escalating demand for comprehensive literature surveys in rapidly evolving research areas makes manual writing increasingly impractical, underscoring the necessity of automation. Large Language Models (LLMs) provide a promising foundation for this task, yet guiding them to generate accurate, reliable content remains a fundamental challenge, as issues such as hallucinations and vague organization often persist. To address this, we propose FIKSurvey, a feedback-driven framework grounded in the idea that “Feedback is the key for automatic survey generation.” Specifically, FIKSurvey systematically incorporates feedback across three dimensions: outline feedback for structural clarity, citation feedback for evidence validation, and content feedback for readability and analytical depth. The framework also supports optional human-in-the-loop intervention for user-specific needs. Experiments confirm that FIKSurvey substantially improves both citation and content quality, demonstrating feedback as the critical mechanism for automatic survey generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 在快速发展的研究领域，对全面文献调查的需求不断增加，这使得手动撰写变得越来越不切实际，从而凸显了自动化处理的必要性。大语言模型为这一任务提供了有力的支持，但如何引导它们生成准确、可靠的内容仍然是一个重大挑战，因为诸如幻觉现象和结构混乱等问题依然存在。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了FIKSurvey这一基于反馈驱动的框架。该框架的核心思想是：“反馈是自动生成调查内容的关键”。具体来说，FIKSurvey系统地整合了三个方面的反馈：结构清晰性的大纲反馈、证据验证的引用反馈，以及可读性和分析深度的内容反馈。此外，该框架还支持根据用户需求进行人工干预。实验表明，FIKSurvey在提高引用质量和内容质量方面取得了显著效果，这充分证明了反馈是自动生成调查内容的关键机制。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Sentient Agent as a Judge: Evaluating Higher-Order Social Cognition in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 作为评判者的有意识主体：在大型语言模型中评估高级社会认知能力
papers.authors: Bang Zhang, Ruotian Ma, Qingxuan Jiang, Peisong Wang, Jiaqi Chen, Zheng Xie, Xingyu Chen, Yue Wang, Fanghua Ye, Jian Li, Yifan Yang, Zhaopeng Tu, Xiaolong Li
papers.abstract: Assessing how well a large language model (LLM) understands human, rather than merely text, remains an open challenge.To bridge the gap, we introduce Sentient Agent as a Judge(SAGE), an automated evaluation framework that measures an LLM’s higher-order social cognition.SAGE instantiates a “Sentient Agent” – an LLM-powered agent that simulates human-like emotional changes and inner thoughts to provide a more realistic evaluation of the tested model in multi-turn conversations.At every turn, the agent reasons about (i) how its emotion changes, (ii) how it feels, and (iii) how it should reply, yielding a numerical emotion trajectory and interpretable inner thoughts.Experiments on 100 supportive-dialogue scenarios show that the final Sentient emotion score correlates strongly with Barrett-Lennard Relationship Inventory (BLRI) ratings and utterance-level empathy metrics, validating psychological fidelity. Human evaluation further demonstrates 85.3% consistency between the agent’s emotional reasoning and human judgments. We also build a public Sentient Leaderboard covering 18 commercial and open-source models that uncovers substantial gaps (up to 4\times) between frontier systems (GPT-4o-Latest, Gemini2.5-Pro) and earlier baselines, gaps not reflected in conventional leaderboards (e.g. Arena). SAGE thus provides a principled, scalable, and interpretable tool for tracking progress toward genuinely empathetic and socially adept language agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型（LLM）对人类的理解程度，而不仅仅是文本，仍然是一个未解决的挑战。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了“有感知能力的代理人作为评判者”（SAGE）这一自动化评估框架，该框架能够衡量LLM的高级社交认知能力。SAGE模拟了一个“有感知能力的代理人”——一个由LLM驱动的智能体，它能够表现出类似人类的情感变化和内心想法，从而在多轮对话中对测试模型进行更真实的评估。在每一轮对话中，该智能体会分析其情感的变化、感受以及应该做出的回应，从而生成数值化的情感轨迹和可解释的内心想法。通过对100个支持性对话场景的实验表明，最终的SAGE情感评分与Barrett-Lennard关系量表（BLRI）的评分以及话语层面的同理心指标有很强的相关性，这验证了该框架在心理学上的可靠性。人类评估进一步显示，智能体的情感推理与人类判断之间有85.3%的一致性。我们还建立了一个公开的SAGE排行榜，涵盖了18种商业和开源模型，该排行榜揭示了前沿系统（如GPT-4o-Latest、Gemini2.5-Pro）与早期基线模型之间高达4倍的差距，而这些差距在传统排行榜中并未体现。因此，SAGE提供了一种原则性、可扩展且可解释的工具，用于跟踪朝着真正具有同理心和社交能力的语言智能体发展的进程。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Alignment Data Map for Efficient Preference Data Selection and Diagnosis
papers.title_zh: 用于高效偏好数据选择和诊断的导向数据地图
papers.authors: Seohyeong Lee, Eunwon Kim, Hwaran Lee, Buru Chang
papers.abstract: Human preference data is essential for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values, but collecting such data is often costly and inefficient-motivating the need for efficient data selection methods that reduce annotation costs while preserving alignment effectiveness. To address this issue, we propose Alignment Data Map, a data analysis tool for identifying and selecting effective preference data. We first evaluate alignment scores of the preference data by LLM-as-a-judge, explicit reward model, and reference-based approaches. The Alignment Data Map considers both response quality and inter-response variability based on the alignment scores. From our experimental findings, training on only 33% of samples that exhibit high-quality and low-variability, achieves comparable or superior alignment performance on MT-Bench, Evol-Instruct, and AlpacaEval, compared to training with the full dataset. In addition, Alignment Data Map detects potential label misannotations by analyzing correlations between annotated labels and alignment scores, improving annotation accuracy. The implementation is available at https://github.com/01choco/Alignment-Data-Map.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类偏好数据对于使大语言模型与人类价值观保持一致至关重要，但收集此类数据往往成本高昂且效率低下。因此，需要高效的 데이터选择方法，以在降低标注成本的同时保持对齐效果的可靠性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“对齐数据映射”这一数据分析工具，用于识别和选择有效的偏好数据。我们首先通过以语言模型为评判标准的方法、显式奖励模型以及基于参考的方法来评估偏好数据的对齐程度。对齐数据映射根据对齐程度综合考虑了响应质量以及响应间的差异性。根据我们的实验发现，仅对那些具有高质量且低变异性的33%样本进行训练，可以在MT-Bench、Evol-Instruct和AlpacaEval等任务上获得与使用完整数据集进行训练相当甚至更好的对齐效果。此外，对齐数据映射还能通过分析标注标签与对齐程度之间的相关性来检测潜在的错误标注，从而提高标注的准确性。该工具的实现代码可访问于https://github.com/01choco/Alignment-Data-Map。

papers.title: Fine-Grained Detection of Context-Grounded Hallucinations Using LLMs
papers.title_zh: 利用大型语言模型进行细粒度的情境基础幻觉检测
papers.authors: Yehonatan Peisakhovsky, Zorik Gekhman, Yosi Mass, Liat Ein-Dor, Roi Reichart
papers.abstract: Context-grounded hallucinations are cases where model outputs contain information not verifiable against the source text. We study the applicability of LLMs for localizing such hallucinations, as a more practical alternative to existing complex evaluation pipelines. In the absence of established benchmarks for meta-evaluation of hallucinations localization, we construct one tailored to LLMs, involving a challenging human annotation of over 1,000 examples. We complement the benchmark with an LLM-based evaluation protocol, verifying its quality in a human evaluation. Since existing representations of hallucinations limit the types of errors that can be expressed, we propose a new representation based on free-form textual descriptions, capturing the full range of possible errors. We conduct a comprehensive study, evaluating four large-scale LLMs, which highlights the benchmark’s difficulty, as the best model achieves an F1 score of only 0.67. Through careful analysis, we offer insights into optimal prompting strategies for the task and identify the main factors that make it challenging for LLMs: (1) a tendency to incorrectly flag missing details as inconsistent, despite being instructed to check only facts in the output; and (2) difficulty with outputs containing factually correct information absent from the source - and thus not verifiable - due to alignment with the model’s parametric knowledge.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于上下文的幻觉是指模型输出中包含无法根据原始文本验证的信息的情况。我们研究了大语言模型在定位此类幻觉方面的应用潜力，这作为一种比现有复杂评估流程更实用的替代方案。由于缺乏针对幻觉定位的成熟评估基准，我们构建了一个专门适用于大语言模型的评估基准，该基准涉及对1000多个样本进行人工标注。我们通过基于大语言模型的评估协议来补充这一基准，并通过人工评估来验证其质量。由于现有的幻觉表示方式限制了可表达的错误类型，我们提出了一种基于自由形式文本描述的新表示方法，能够涵盖所有可能的错误情况。我们对四种大规模大语言模型进行了全面研究，结果发现该基准的难度相当高，因为最好的模型仅获得了0.67的F1分数。通过仔细分析，我们得出了关于该任务的最佳提示策略的见解，并确定了使大语言模型难以处理的主要因素：(1)尽管模型被指示只检查输出中的事实信息，但仍有误将缺失细节标记为不一致的情况；(2)当输出包含与源文本不符的事实正确信息时，由于与模型参数化知识的冲突，导致无法验证这些信息的存在。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: When Reviews Disagree: Fine-Grained Contradiction Analysis in Scientific Peer Reviews
papers.title_zh: 当评审意见不一致时：在科学同行评审中进行细致的矛盾分析
papers.authors: Sandeep Kumar, Yash Kamdar, Abid Hossain, Bharti Kumari, Tanik Saikh, Asif Ekbal
papers.abstract: Scientific peer reviews frequently contain conflicting expert judgments, and the increasing scale of conference submissions makes it challenging for Area Chairs and editors to reliably identify and interpret such disagreements. Existing approaches typically frame reviewer disagreement as binary contradiction detection over isolated sentence pairs, abstracting away the review-level context and obscuring differences in the severity of evaluative conflict. In this work, we introduce a fine-grained formulation of reviewer contradiction analysis that operates over full peer reviews by explicitly identifying contradiction evidence spans and assigning graded disagreement intensity scores. To support this task, we present RevCI, an expert-annotated benchmark of peer-review pairs with evidence-level contradiction annotations with graded intensity labels. We further propose IMPACT, a structured multi-agent framework that integrates aspect-conditioned evidence extraction, deliberative reasoning, and adjudication to model reviewer contradictions and their intensity. To support efficient deployment, we distill IMPACT into TIDE, a small language model that predicts contradiction evidence and intensity in a single forward pass. Experimental results show that IMPACT substantially outperforms strong single-agent and generic multi-agent baselines in both evidence identification and intensity agreement, while TIDE achieves competitive performance at significantly lower inference cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学同行评审过程中常常出现专家意见相冲突的情况。随着会议投稿数量的不断增加，区域主席和编辑们要可靠地识别并解读这些分歧变得愈发困难。现有的方法通常将审稿人之间的分歧视为孤立句子对上的二元矛盾检测问题，这忽略了评审过程中的整体上下文，也未能准确反映评估冲突的严重程度。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种细粒度的审稿人矛盾分析方法，该方法能够对整个同行评审过程进行建模，通过明确识别矛盾证据的范围，并赋予不同强度的矛盾程度评分。为了支持这一任务，我们开发了RevCI——一个由专家标注的同行评审对基准数据集，其中包含了带有不同强度标签的矛盾证据信息。此外，我们还提出了IMPACT框架，这是一个结构化的多智能体系统，它整合了基于方面的证据提取、协商性推理以及裁决机制，以有效处理审稿人之间的矛盾及其强度问题。为了便于高效部署，我们将IMPACT框架简化为TIDE模型，该模型能够在一次前向计算中预测矛盾证据及其强度。实验结果表明，IMPACT在证据识别和强度一致性方面显著优于那些仅依赖单一智能体的基准模型以及通用的多智能体模型。而TIDE则在较低的推理成本下取得了相当不错的性能。

papers.title: One Script Instead of Hundreds? On Pretraining Romanized Encoder Language Models
papers.title_zh: 用一种脚本代替数百种语言模型？——关于预训练的罗马化编码语言模型
papers.authors: Benedikt Ebing, Lennart Keller, Goran Glavaš
papers.abstract: Exposing latent lexical overlap, script romanization has emerged as an effective strategy for improving cross-lingual transfer (XLT) in multilingual language models (mLMs). Most prior work, however, focused on setups that favor romanization the most: (1) transfer from high-resource Latin-script to low-resource non-Latin-script languages and/or (2) between genealogically closely related languages with different scripts. It thus remains unclear whether romanization is a good representation choice for pretraining general-purpose mLMs, or, more precisely, if information loss associated with romanization harms performance for high-resource languages. We address this gap by pretraining encoder LMs from scratch on both romanized and original texts for six typologically diverse high-resource languages, investigating two potential sources of degradation: (i) loss of script-specific information and (ii) dilution of language-specific representations from increased subword overlap. Using two romanizers with different fidelity profiles, we observe negligible performance loss for languages with segmental scripts, whereas languages with morphosyllabic scripts (Chinese and Japanese) suffer degradation that higher-fidelity romanization mitigates but cannot fully recover. Importantly, comparing monolingual LMs with their mLM counterpart, we find no evidence that increased subword overlap dilutes language-specific representations. We further show that romanization improves encoding efficiency (i.e., fertility) for segmental scripts at a negligible performance cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 揭示潜在的词汇重叠现象后，脚本罗马化已成为提高多语言模型跨语言迁移能力的有效策略。然而，迄今为止的大部分研究都集中在那些更适合进行罗马化的场景上：即（1）从高资源拉丁语系语言迁移到低资源非拉丁语系语言的场景，以及/或者（2）在语法关系相近且使用不同文字的语言之间进行的迁移。因此，目前仍不清楚罗马化是否是预训练通用多语言模型的合适表示方式，或者更确切地说，与罗马化相关的信息损失是否会对高资源语言的表现产生负面影响。为了填补这一空白，我们针对六种类型学差异较大但具有高资源语言的多语言模型，从零开始对编码语言模型进行预训练，同时处理罗马化后的文本和原始文本。我们研究了两种潜在的退化原因：（i）特定文字信息的丢失，以及（ii）由于子词重叠增加而导致的语言特异性表示的稀释。通过使用两种不同精确度的罗马化工具，我们发现，对于具有分节式文字的语言来说，性能损失可以忽略不计；而对于具有形态音节式文字的语言（如中文和日文），虽然罗马化能够减轻退化影响，但无法完全恢复其原有表现。重要的是，通过比较单语言模型和多语言模型，我们没有发现子词重叠增加会导致语言特异性表示被稀释的证据。此外，我们还发现，罗马化能够以微不足道的性能代价提升分节式文字的编码效率（即生成能力）。

papers.title: Relaxing the Constraints: A Dual-Importance Projection Mechanism for Lifelong Model Editing
papers.title_zh: 放宽约束：一种用于终身模型编辑的双重重要性投影机制
papers.authors: Zhenghai Chen, Senbin Xu, Jiaxi Tan, Xinhua Wu, Yan Zhang, Xiawu Zheng, Shengchuan Zhang, Ke Li, Sicheng Zhao, Liujuan Cao, Rongrong Ji
papers.abstract: Factual knowledge stored in Large Language Models (LLMs) inevitably becomes outdated or erroneous over time, making it critical to update these models without incurring the high cost of retraining. Existing sequential knowledge editing methods predominantly rely on strict orthogonal projection to preserve previously edited knowledge. However, this excessive constraint limits gradient expressiveness, resulting in a significant degradation of model generalization and overall performance as the number of edits increases. To address this challenge, we propose Dual-Importance Projection Editing (DipEdit). This method leverages Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to identify critical gradient subspaces and introduces a dual mechanism comprising “accumulated importance” and “projection importance.” Unlike traditional approaches that enforce strict orthogonality, DipEdit dynamically scales gradient components parallel to key subspaces based on their projection importance rather than discarding them directly. This approach enhances the model’s adaptability to new knowledge while maximally preserving historical knowledge. Extensive experiments conducted on five mainstream LLMs using the ZsRE and Counterfact datasets demonstrate that DipEdit effectively handles thousands of sequential edits. The proposed method achieves an average comprehensive performance improvement of 10.36% and effectively maintains the model’s general capabilities on downstream tasks. Code is available at: https://github.com/czhhhla/DipEdit.
papers.abstract_zh: 存储在大语言模型中的事实知识随着时间的推移必然会变得过时或出错。因此，更新这些模型而不需要付出高昂的重新训练成本是非常重要的。现有的序列知识编辑方法主要依赖于严格的正交投影来保留之前编辑过的内容。然而，这种过度的约束限制了梯度的表达能力，随着编辑次数的增加，模型的泛化能力和整体性能都会显著下降。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了双重要性投影编辑方法。该方法利用奇异值分解来识别关键的梯度子空间，并引入了一种由“累积重要性”和“投影重要性”组成的双重机制。与那些强制严格正交性的传统方法不同，DipEdit根据梯度的投影重要性动态调整梯度分量，而不是直接丢弃它们。这种方法提高了模型对新知识的适应能力，同时最大限度地保留了历史知识。在五个主流语言模型上使用ZsRE和Counterfact数据集进行的广泛实验表明，DipEdit能够有效地处理数千次序列编辑。该方法实现了平均10.36%的综合性能提升，并且能够有效维持模型在下游任务中的通用能力。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/czhhhla/DipEdit。

papers.title: Not all ANIMALs are equal: metaphorical framing through source domains and semantic frames
papers.title_zh: 并非所有动物都平等：通过不同领域和语义框架来构建隐喻性描述
papers.authors: Yulia Otmakhova, Matteo Guida, Lea Frermann
papers.abstract: Metaphors are powerful framing devices, yet their source domains alone do not fully explain the specific associations they evoke. We argue that the interplay between source domains and semantic frames determines how metaphors shape understanding of complex issues, and present a computational framework that allows to derive salient discourse metaphors through their source domains and semantic frames. Applying this framework to climate change news, we uncover not only well-known source domains but also reveal nuanced frame-level associations that distinguish how the issue is portrayed. In analyzing immigration discourse across political ideologies, we demonstrate that liberals and conservatives systematically employ different semantic frames within the same source domains, with conservatives favoring frames emphasizing uncontrollability and liberals choosing neutral or more “victimizing” semantic frames. Our work bridges conceptual metaphor theory and linguistics, providing the first NLP approach for discovery of discourse metaphors and fine-grained analysis of differences in metaphorical framing.
papers.abstract_zh: 隐喻是一种强大的框架构建工具，然而仅仅分析其来源领域并不能完全解释它们所引发的特定联想。我们认为，来源领域与语义框架之间的相互作用决定了隐喻如何塑造人们对复杂问题的理解。我们提出了一个计算框架，通过该框架可以通过分析隐喻的来源领域和语义框架来识别重要的话语隐喻。将这一框架应用于气候变化新闻的分析中，我们不仅发现了一些常见的来源领域，还揭示了不同意识形态下对这一问题不同的框架选择。在分析不同政治意识形态下的移民话语时，我们发现自由派和保守派在相同的来源领域内会系统地使用不同的语义框架：保守派倾向于使用强调不可控性的框架，而自由派则更倾向于使用中性或更具“受害者化”特征的语义框架。我们的研究将概念隐喻理论与语言学相结合，首次提出了一种自然语言处理方法，用于发现话语中的隐喻，并细致分析不同隐喻框架之间的差异。

papers.title: DualFact+: A Multimodal Fact Verification Framework for Procedural Video Captioning
papers.title_zh: DualFact+：一种适用于程序性视频字幕生成的多模态事实验证框架
papers.authors: Cennet Oguz, Yasser Hamidullah, Josef van Genabith, Simon Ostermann
papers.abstract: Evaluating factual correctness in procedural video captions is challenging because captions must reflect both the abstract procedural roles (e.g., actions, ingredients, tools, locations) and their visual execution. Existing evaluation metrics, which rely on lexical overlap or holistic semantic similarity, often miss role-specific omissions and misclassify visually present but task-irrelevant content as hallucinations. We introduce DualFact+, a role-aware, fact-level evaluation framework that distinguishes conceptual facts, encoding ontology-based role typing of procedural steps (Action, Object or Ingredient, Tool, Location), from contextual facts, encoding video-grounded predicate–argument relations that specify how these roles are instantiated during execution. To enable complete and role-consistent evaluation, DualFact+ incorporates visually grounded implicit arguments and contrastive fact sets, and operates in two complementary modes: DualFact-C for text-based verification and DualFact-V for video-grounded verification. Experiments on YouCook3-Fact and CraftBench-Fact show that state-of-the-art captioning models produce fluent but often incomplete descriptions with systematic role-level errors. DualFact+ achieves stronger correlation with human factuality judgments than standard lexical and embedding-based metrics, highlighting the importance of role-aware evaluation for procedural video understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 在程序性视频字幕中评估事实的正确性是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为字幕需要同时反映抽象的程序性角色（如动作、成分、工具、位置）以及它们的视觉表现。现有的评估指标往往依赖于词汇重叠或整体语义相似性，这常常会导致忽略特定角色的缺失信息，或者将那些在视觉上存在但与任务无关的内容误判为幻觉。我们提出了DualFact+这一基于角色意识的、面向事实层面的评估框架。该框架将概念性事实与上下文性事实区分开来：概念性事实用于编码基于本体论的角色类型，比如动作、对象或成分、工具、位置等；而上下文性事实则用于编码视频中的谓词-论元关系，从而明确这些角色在执行过程中的具体体现方式。为了实现全面且符合角色特性的评估，DualFact+还包含了基于视觉的隐含参数以及对比性事实集，并采用两种互补的模式进行工作：DualFact-C用于基于文本的验证，而DualFact-V则用于基于视频的验证。在YouCook3-Fact和CraftBench-Fact上的实验表明，目前最先进的字幕模型虽然能够生成流畅的描述，但这些描述往往存在系统性的角色级错误。相比之下，DualFact+在与人类对事实真实性的判断相关性方面表现得更为出色，这凸显了在程序性视频理解中采用角色意识评估方法的重要性。

papers.title: From Scaffolding to Assimilation: Progressive Structural Internalization for Format-Constrained Creative Text Generation
papers.title_zh: 从支架式结构到完全吸收：渐进式的结构内化方法在格式受限的创意文本生成中的应用
papers.authors: Wenhao Li, Yuwei Yang, Xiaoqing Wu, Yufeng Han, Cunliang Kong, Yuzhuo Bai, Xin Cong, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities in open-ended creative generation, they notably struggle with Format-Constrained Generation tasks—such as poetry and lyrics—where strict adherence to multidimensional structural constraints (i.e., format, phonetics, and rhyme) is prerequisite to aesthetic value. Existing paradigms predominantly rely on unreliable prompting or rigid constrained decoding strategies; the former often fails to ensure compliance, while the latter compromises inference latency and disrupts the natural probability distribution, degrading generation quality. To bridge this gap, we establish CCP-Arena, a rigorous testbed for Chinese Classical Poetry, and proposeProgressive Structural Internalization (PSI) a novel framework designed to embed external constraints into the model’s intrinsic intuition. PSI initiates withStructural Scaffolding via Explicit Cognitive Planning, utilizing explicit template to provide a structural scaffold for subsequent generation. This is followed by a Cascaded Reinforcement Learning stage guided by a Holistic Reward Model, which optimizes for precise structural-semantic alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PSI achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing baselines in both strict constraint adherence and literary aesthetics. Furthermore, mechanistic analysis confirms that our method effectively internalizes structural information into the model’s latent representations, offering a robust and efficient solution for constrained creative generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在开放式创意生成方面展现出卓越的能力，但在格式受限的生成任务上却表现不佳——比如诗歌和歌词的创作。在这些任务中，严格遵循多维结构约束（即格式、音韵和韵律）是获得美学价值的关键。现有的方法大多依赖于不可靠的提示方式或僵化的解码策略；前者往往无法确保约束的遵守，而后者则会降低推理效率并破坏自然的概率分布，从而降低生成质量。为了填补这一空白，我们建立了CCP-Arena，这是一个针对中国古典诗歌的严格测试平台。我们提出了渐进式结构内化框架PSI，该框架旨在将外部约束融入模型的固有直觉之中。PSI首先通过明确的认知规划来构建结构框架，利用明确的模板为后续生成提供结构支撑。随后，通过整体奖励模型的引导，进行级联强化学习阶段，以优化精确的结构与语义对齐。大量实验表明，PSI在严格遵守约束和文学美学方面均取得了领先的性能。此外，机制分析证实，我们的方法能够有效地将结构信息内化为模型的潜在表示，为受限创意生成提供了稳健且高效的解决方案。

papers.title: Hierarchical Visual Agent: Managing Contexts in Joint Image-Text Space for Advanced Chart Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 分层视觉代理：在联合图像-文本空间中管理上下文，以实现高级图表推理
papers.authors: Qihua Dong, Ruozhen He, Junwen Chen, Yizhou Wang, Xu Ma, Songyao Jiang, Yun Fu
papers.abstract: Advanced chart question answering requires both precise perception of small visual elements and multi-step reasoning across several subplots. While existing MLLMs are strong at understanding single plots, they often struggle with multi-step reasoning across multiple subplots. We propose HierVA, a hierarchical visual agent framework for chart reasoning that iteratively constructs and updates a working context in a joint image–text space. A high-level manager generates plans and maintains a compact context containing only key information, while specialized sub-agents perform reasoning, gather evidence, and return results. In particular, the agent maintains separate visual and textual contexts, using a zoom-in tool to restrict the visual context. Experiments on the chart reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong multimodal baselines, and ablation studies verify that hierarchical architecture, limited visual context, and distilled context contribute complementary gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 高级图表问答需要精确感知微小的视觉元素，同时还需要对多个子情节进行多步骤推理。虽然现有的多模态语言模型在理解单个图表方面表现良好，但在处理多个子情节的复杂推理时却常常遇到困难。我们提出了HierVA这一分层视觉智能体框架，该框架能够在图像与文本的结合空间中逐步构建并更新工作上下文。一个高级管理模块负责生成计划并维护一个只包含关键信息的简洁上下文，而专门的子智能体则负责进行推理、收集证据并返回结果。特别地，该智能体会分别维护视觉和文本上下文，并使用缩放工具来限制视觉上下文的范围。在图表推理基准测试中的实验表明，HierVA相比强大的多模态基线模型取得了持续的改进，而消融研究也证明了分层架构、有限的视觉上下文以及精简的上下文结构能够共同带来更好的性能提升。

papers.title: Semantic-Space Exploration and Exploitation in RLVR for LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 在LLM推理中的语义空间探索与利用
papers.authors: Fanding Huang, Guanbo Huang, Xiao Fan, Yi He, Xiao Liang, Xiao Chen, Qinting Jiang, Faisal Nadeem Khan, Jingyan Jiang, Zhi Wang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for LLM reasoning is often framed as balancing exploration and exploitation in action space, typically operationalized with token-level proxies (e.g., output entropy or confidence). We argue that this apparent trade-off is largely a measurement artifact: token-level statistics reflect next-token uncertainty rather than how reasoning progresses over multi-token semantic structures. We therefore study exploration and exploitation in the hidden-state space of response trajectories. We use Effective Rank (ER) to quantify representational exploration and introduce its temporal derivatives, Effective Rank Velocity (ERV) and Effective Rank Acceleration (ERA), to characterize exploitative refinement dynamics. Empirically and theoretically, ER and ERV exhibit near-zero correlation in semantic space, suggesting the two capacities can be improved simultaneously. Motivated by this, we propose Velocity-Exploiting Rank Learning (VERL), which shapes the RL advantage with an auxiliary signal derived from ER/ERV and uses the more stable ERA as a meta-control variable to adaptively balance the incentives. Across multiple base models, RL algorithms, and reasoning benchmarks, VERL yields consistent improvements, including large gains on challenging tasks (e.g., 21.4% in Gaokao 2024).
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在LLM推理中的应用，通常被理解为在动作空间中平衡探索与利用。这一策略通常通过令牌级别的指标来体现，例如输出熵或置信度。我们认为，这种看似的矛盾实际上是一种测量上的误差：令牌级别的统计数据反映的是下一个令牌的不确定性，而非推理在多个令牌构成的语义结构中的进展情况。因此，我们研究在响应轨迹的隐藏状态空间中进行探索与利用的过程。我们使用有效排名（ER）来衡量表征性探索，并引入其时间导数——有效排名速度（ERV）和有效排名加速度（ERA），以描述利用性改进的动态特性。从实证和理论角度来看，ER和ERV在语义空间中的相关性几乎为零，这表明这两种能力可以同时进行提升。基于这一发现，我们提出了速度利用型排名学习（VERL）方法。该方法通过从ER/ERV中获得的辅助信号来塑造强化学习的优势函数，并利用更稳定的ERA作为元控制变量，从而自适应地平衡各种激励因素。在多个基础模型、强化学习算法以及推理基准测试中，VERL都取得了持续的改进效果，包括在具有挑战性的任务上获得了显著的提升（例如，在2024年的高考中提升了21.4%）。

papers.title: Towards Efficient Large Language Model Serving: A Survey on System-Aware KV Cache Optimization
papers.title_zh: 迈向高效的大型语言模型服务：关于系统感知的关键值缓存优化的研究综述
papers.authors: Jiantong Jiang, Peiyu Yang, Rui Zhang, Feng Liu
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid advancements of large language models (LLMs), LLM serving systems remain memory-intensive and costly. The key-value (KV) cache, which stores KV tensors during autoregressive decoding, is crucial for enabling low-latency, high-throughput LLM inference serving. In this survey, we focus on system-aware KV infrastructure for serving LLMs (abbreviated as sKis). We revisit recent work from a system behavior perspective, organizing existing efforts into three dimensions: execution and scheduling (temporal), placement and migration (spatial), and representation and retention (structural). Furthermore, we analyze cross-behavior co-design affinity and behavior-objective links, highlighting future opportunities. Our work systematizes a rapidly evolving area, providing a foundation for understanding and innovating KV cache designs in modern LLM serving infrastructure.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型取得了快速进展，但这类模型的服务系统仍然需要大量的内存资源且成本较高。在自回归解码过程中，键值缓存用于存储键值张量，这对于实现低延迟、高吞吐量的语言模型推理服务至关重要。在本综述中，我们重点关注用于服务语言模型的系统感知键值基础设施（简称sKis）。我们从系统行为的角度重新审视了近期的研究成果，将现有工作分为三个维度：执行与调度（时间维度）、布局与迁移（空间维度）以及表示与保留（结构维度）。此外，我们还分析了不同行为之间的协同设计关系以及行为与目标之间的联系，为未来的发展方向提供了启示。我们的研究为这一快速发展的领域提供了系统化的分析框架，为理解和创新现代语言模型服务基础设施中的键值缓存设计奠定了基础。

papers.title: A Counterfactual Explanation Framework for Retrieval Models
papers.title_zh: 一种用于检索模型的反事实解释框架
papers.authors: Bhavik Chandna, Procheta Sen
papers.abstract: Explainability has become a crucial concern in today’s world, aiming to enhance transparency in machine learning and deep learning models. Information retrieval is no exception to this trend. In existing literature on explainability of information retrieval, the emphasis has predominantly been on illustrating the concept of relevance concerning a retrieval model. The questions addressed include why a document is relevant to a query, why one document exhibits higher relevance than another, or why a specific set of documents is deemed relevant for a query. However, limited attention has been given to understanding why a particular document is not favored (e.g., not within top-K) with respect to a query and a retrieval model. In an effort to address this gap, our work focuses on the question of what terms need to be added within a document to improve its ranking. This, in turn, answers the question of which words in the document played a role in not being favored by a retrieval model for a particular query. We use a counterfactual framework to solve the above-mentioned research problem. Our experiments show the effectiveness of our proposed approach in predicting counterfactuals for both statistical (e.g. BM25) and deep-learning-based models (e.g. DRMM, DSSM, ColBERT, MonoT5).
papers.abstract_zh: 可解释性已成为当今世界的一个关键问题，其目的是提高机器学习和深度学习模型的透明度。信息检索也不例外。在现有的关于信息检索可解释性的文献中，重点主要放在说明检索模型中的相关性概念上。所探讨的问题包括：为什么某个文档与查询相关、为什么某个文档的相关性高于另一个文档，或者为什么特定一组文档被认为与某个查询相关。然而，对于为什么某个文档没有被优先选择（例如，不在前K名之内）这一问题，却很少进行关注。为了弥补这一不足，我们的研究重点在于探讨需要添加哪些术语到文档中才能提高其排名。这反过来又回答了关于文档中哪些词语导致某个查询的检索模型不选择该文档的问题。我们采用反事实框架来解决上述研究问题。我们的实验表明，我们提出的方法在预测反事实结果方面是有效的，无论是针对统计模型（如BM25），还是基于深度学习的模型（如DRMM、DSSM、ColBERT、MonoT5）。

papers.title: Teaching Language Models to Forecast Research Success Through Comparative Idea Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 教授语言模型通过对比性想法评估来预测研究成功与否
papers.authors: Srujan P Mule, Aniketh Garikaparthi, Manasi Patwardhan
papers.abstract: As language models accelerate scientific research by automating hypothesis generation and implementation, a new bottleneck emerges: evaluating and filtering hundreds of AI-generated ideas without exhaustive experimentation. We ask whether LMs can learn to forecast the empirical success of research ideas before any experiments are run. We study comparative empirical forecasting: given a benchmark-specific research goal and two candidate ideas, predict which will achieve better benchmark performance. We construct a dataset of 11,488 idea pairs grounded in objective outcomes from PapersWithCode. While off-the-shelf 8B-parameter models struggle (30% acc.), SFT dramatically boosts performance to 77.1%, outperforming GPT-5 (61.1%). By framing evaluation as a reasoning task via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), we train models to discover latent reasoning paths, achieving 71.35% acc. with interpretable justifications. Through additional ablations and out-of-distribution tests, we show robustness to surface-level heuristics and transfer to both a cross-domain time-split test set and an independently constructed test set. Our results demonstrate that compute-efficient small language models can serve as effective, objective verifiers, offering a scalable path for autonomous scientific discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着语言模型通过自动化假设生成和验证来加速科学研究，一个新的瓶颈出现了：在无需进行详尽实验的情况下，如何评估和筛选数百个由人工智能生成的想法。我们探讨了一个比较性的实证预测方法：给定一项针对特定基准的研究目标以及两个候选想法，预测哪个想法能在实验中取得更好的表现。我们构建了一个包含11,488对想法的数据集，这些想法都基于PapersWithCode提供的客观结果。虽然现成的8B参数模型表现不佳（准确率仅为30%），但SFT模型的性能显著提升，达到了77.1%，优于GPT-5的61.1%。通过将评估任务转化为带有可验证奖励的强化学习任务，我们训练出的模型能够发现潜在的推理路径，其准确率达到了71.35%，并且可以给出可解释性的理由。通过进一步的消融研究和离分布测试，我们证明了这些模型能够抵御表面上的启发式方法的影响，并且可以在跨领域的测试集以及独立构建的测试集上表现出良好的性能。我们的结果表明，计算效率高的小型语言模型可以作为有效的、客观的验证工具，为自主式的科学发现提供了一种可扩展的方法。

papers.title: Social Welfare Function Leaderboard: On the Emergence of LLM Agents as the Welfare Dictator
papers.title_zh: 社会福利函数排行榜：大型语言模型代理如何成为“福利独裁者”
papers.authors: Zhengliang Shi, Ruotian Ma, Jen-tse Huang, Xinbei Ma, Xingyu Chen, Mengru Wang, Qu Yang, Yue Wang, Fanghua Ye, Ziyang Chen, Shanyi Wang, Cixing LI, Wenxuan Wang, Zhaopeng Tu, Xiaolong Li, Zhaochun Ren, Liefeng Bo
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly entrusted with high-stakes decisions that affect human welfare. However, the principles and values that guide these models when distributing scarce societal resources remain largely unexamined. To address this, we introduce the Social Welfare Function (SWF) Benchmark, a dynamic simulation environment in which an LLM acts as a dictator, distributing tasks to heterogeneous recipients with different returns on investment (ROI). The benchmark is designed to create a dilemma between maximizing collective efficiency (i.e., overall ROI) and ensuring distributive fairness (measured by the Gini coefficient). We evaluate 20 state-of-the-art LLMs. Our findings reveal several key insights, including: (i) LLMs’ general ability, as measured by popular Arena leaderboards, misaligns with their allocation skills; (ii) Most LLMs exhibit a strong default utilitarian orientation, prioritizing overall productivity at the expense of inequality. (iii) Allocation behaviors are highly manipulated, easily perturbed by common persuasion strategies. These results highlight the risks of deploying current LLMs as societal decision-makers and underscore the need for specialized benchmarks and alignment for AI governance.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型被越来越多地用于做出影响人类福祉的重大决策。然而，这些模型在分配稀缺社会资源时的原则和价值观却尚未得到充分探讨。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了“社会福利函数”基准测试——一个动态模拟环境，在这个环境中，语言模型扮演独裁者的角色，将任务分配给具有不同投资回报率的各类接收者。该基准测试旨在在最大化集体效率（即总体投资回报率）与确保分配公平性（通过基尼系数衡量）之间找到平衡。我们对20种最先进的语言模型进行了评估。我们的研究发现揭示了几个重要现象：第一，根据流行的竞技排行榜来衡量，语言模型的一般能力与其分配能力并不一致；第二，大多数语言模型都表现出强烈的功利主义倾向，它们优先考虑整体生产力，而忽视了不平等问题；第三，它们的分配行为极易受到常见说服策略的影响。这些结果凸显了将现有语言模型作为社会决策者所带来的风险，并强调了为人工智能治理制定专门基准测试和一致性验证的必要性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Individual Excellence to Collective Sustainability: Seeking Strategic Equilibrium in Proactive Multi-Agent Teams
papers.title_zh: 从个体卓越到集体可持续发展：在主动式多智能体团队中寻求战略平衡
papers.authors: Tong Zhang, Yang Wu, Yufei Shi, Rujing Yao, Zhuoren Jiang, Xiaozhong Liu
papers.abstract: In heterogeneous scientific teams, proactive team agents can serve as effective assistants regarding the research progress of the project. However, proactive agents always suffer from collaborative myopia: a greedy optimization for immediate task accuracy which ignore the long-term goal of team sustainability. This leads to the Individual-centric Trap, where capable experts (e.g., PIs) are disproportionately overloaded while Junior roles remain underutilized. Therefore, neglecting opportunity costs in task allocation can implicitly erodes the enduring performance of the team. To solve this imbalance between efficiency and sustainability, we propose GT-PMARL (Game-Theoretic Proactive Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning). By internalizing the opportunity cost as a key consideration in individual decision-making, the collaboration logic of agents has been reshaped. Our framework employs: (1) a Positive-Unlabeled scorer to anchor intervention quality under sparse supervision; (2) a Nash-Pareto competitive objective to seek an equilibrium between individual task excellence and collective load balancing. Empirical experiments in scientific workflows show that GT-PMARL effectively maintains high performance while preventing experts from over-developing. Our work provides a scalable paradigm for building a sustainable and balanced human-AI collaborative ecosystem.
papers.abstract_zh: 在异质性的科学团队中，主动式的团队代理可以成为项目研究进展的有效助手。然而，这些主动式代理总是存在协作近视的问题：他们过于追求任务的即时准确性，而忽视了团队长期发展的目标。这就导致了以个人为中心的陷阱——能力强的专家（如首席研究员）承受了过重的负担，而初级角色则被闲置不用。因此，在任务分配过程中忽视机会成本，会无形中损害团队的长期绩效。为了解决效率与可持续性之间的不平衡问题，我们提出了GT-PMARL算法。通过将机会成本作为个体决策的关键考虑因素，我们重新定义了代理的协作逻辑。我们的框架采用了以下方法：(1) 使用正标签评分器来在稀疏监督条件下评估干预效果；(2) 采用纳什-帕雷托竞争目标，以实现个人任务卓越性与集体负载平衡之间的平衡。在科学工作流程中的实证实验表明，GT-PMARL算法能够有效维持高绩效，同时防止专家过度投入工作。我们的研究为构建可持续且平衡的人机协作生态系统提供了一个可扩展的解决方案。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Lost in the Prompt Order: Revealing the Limitations of Causal Attention in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 迷失在提示的顺序之中：揭示语言模型中因果注意力机制的局限性
papers.authors: Hyunjong Ok, Jaeho Lee
papers.abstract: Large language models exhibit surprising sensitivity to the structure of the prompt, but the mechanisms underlying this sensitivity remain poorly understood. In this work, we conduct an in-depth investigation on a striking case: in multiple-choice question answering, placing context before the questions and options (CQO) outperforms the reverse order (QOC) by over 14%p, consistently over a wide range of models and datasets. Through systematic architectural analysis, we identify causal attention as the core mechanism: in QOC prompts, the causal mask prevents option tokens from attending to context, creating an information bottleneck where context becomes invisible to options.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型对提示的结构表现出惊人的敏感性，但这种敏感性的机制仍然不太清楚。在这项研究中，我们对一个显著的案例进行了深入调查：在选择题回答中，将上下文放在问题和选项之前（CQO）比相反的顺序（QOC）有超过14%的性能提升，这一优势在多种模型和数据集上都得到了持续验证。通过系统的架构分析，我们确定因果注意力是核心机制：在QOC提示中，因果掩码阻止了选项标记对上下文的关注，从而形成了信息瓶颈，使得上下文对选项来说变得不可见。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SR-RAG: Verifiable Multi-Hop Reasoning via On-the-fly Symbolic Graph Construction
papers.title_zh: SR-RAG：通过即时符号化图构建实现的可验证多跳推理技术
papers.authors: Zehua Wang, Zhaojin Zhang, Boyu Qiu, Xiaolong Weng, Ying Xiong, Buzhou Tang, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has been widely adopted to enhance large language models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge. However, the two main existing paradigms struggle with multi-hop reasoning: aggregate-first approaches suffer from high construction costs and limited adaptability to dynamic knowledge, while dynamic-first approaches rely heavily on LLM reasoning and are prone to error propagation across reasoning steps. To address these limitations, we propose SR-RAG, a symbolic reasoning framework for multi-hop question answering. SR-RAG integrates the advantages of both paradigms by dynamically generating sub-questions, performing information retrieval and symbolic encoding based on an on-the-fly graph, and using a symbolic verifier to formally validate intermediate reasoning steps to ensure the correctness of intermediate answers and the completeness of the reasoning chain . We evaluate SR-RAG on multiple multi-hop benchmarks and a medical dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that it significantly improves both accuracy and robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术已被广泛采用，通过结合外部知识来提升大语言模型的能力。然而，目前存在的两种主要范式在多跳推理方面存在不足：以聚合为先的方法存在构建成本高、对动态知识的适应能力有限的问题；而以动态为先的方法则严重依赖语言模型的推理能力，容易导致推理步骤之间的错误传播。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了SR-RAG这一符号推理框架，用于多跳问题回答。SR-RAG结合了两种范式的优点：通过动态生成子问题，基于即时生成的图结构进行信息检索和符号编码，并使用符号验证器来正式验证中间推理步骤，从而确保中间答案的正确性以及推理链的完整性。我们在多个多跳基准测试和一个医学数据集上对SR-RAG进行了评估。实验结果表明，该框架在准确性和鲁棒性方面都有显著提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: KnowDR-REC: Auditing Knowledge-Conditioned Visual Grounding in Referring Expression Comprehension
papers.title_zh: KnowDR-REC：对引用表达理解中基于知识的视觉表征的审核机制
papers.authors: Guanghao Jin, Jingpei Wu, Tianpei Guo, Yiyi Niu, Weidong Zhou, Linyi Yang, Guoyang Liu
papers.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated the capacity for multi-modal reasoning, current Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) benchmarks lag behind, predominantly relying on intra-image cues and neglecting the integration of external world knowledge, which significantly impedes the evolution of REC towards real-world applications. This limitation obscures a model’s true capability to conduct textual reasoning (entity resolution), resolve spatial location (visual grounding), and verify reference validity (hallucination rejection). To address this, we introduce KnowDR-REC, a targeted audit benchmark comprising 1,042 positive triplets derived from real-world knowledge, along with rigorously matched negative samples. Unlike traditional datasets, we implement a controllable counterfactual evaluation mechanism that subjects textual expressions to single-factor perturbations (entity, relation, or time) to test sensitivity to fine-grained factual changes. Extensive evaluation of 18 state-of-the-art LMMs exposes a critical “binding hallucination,” revealing that current high performance is often built on fragile visual shortcuts rather than true understanding. KnowDR-REC thus serves as a pivotal diagnostic instrument, steering future research toward the genuine integration of perception and reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型已经展示了进行多模态推理的能力，但目前的参照表达理解基准测试仍然落后，主要依赖于图像内部的线索，而忽视了外部世界知识的整合。这一限制严重阻碍了参照表达理解技术在实际应用中的发展。为了克服这一缺陷，我们提出了KnowDR-REC这一有针对性的评估基准，该基准包含1,042个来自现实世界的正样本三元组，以及与之严格匹配的负样本。与传统的数据集不同，我们采用了一种可控的反事实评估机制，对文本表达进行单因素扰动（实体、关系或时间），以测试其对细微事实变化的敏感性。通过对18种先进语言模型进行的广泛评估，我们发现了一个关键的“绑定幻觉”问题，即当前的高性能往往建立在脆弱的视觉捷径之上，而非真正的理解能力。因此，KnowDR-REC作为一个重要的诊断工具，有助于引导未来的研究朝着真正整合感知与推理的方向发展。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Agent for Numerical Data Retrieval and Understanding by Code Generation and Multimodal Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 通过代码生成和多模态推理来实现数值数据检索与理解的代理
papers.authors: Florian Baud, Feda Almuhisen, Dorian Midou
papers.abstract: Numerical data from sensors and time series are widely used in scientific research fields such as nuclear fusion experiments, which generate vast amounts of complex, high-dimensional data. Therefore, efficient numerical data analysis tools are crucial to accelerate experimental research. Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising solutions to analyze numerical data with natural language queries. However, LLMs have difficulties treating this type of data as they have been designed for text in the first place. To overcome these limitations, we propose a model-agnostic and data-agnostic agent that processes numerical data by code generation and multimodal reasoning. Our agent demonstrates competitive performance against baselines on benchmark data on numerical data tasks such as sensor data classification and time series understanding. While outperforming them on information retrieval benchmarks, also we have successfully applied our agent in the context of nuclear fusion research, where physicists and Tokamak operators interact with it to plan and analyze fusion experiments.
papers.abstract_zh: 来自传感器的数值数据和时间序列在诸如核聚变实验等科学研究领域中被广泛应用，这些领域会产生大量复杂且高维的数据。因此，高效的数值数据分析工具对于加速实验研究至关重要。大语言模型作为分析带有自然语言查询的数值数据的有效解决方案而崭露头角。然而，由于大语言模型最初是为处理文本而设计的，因此它们在处理这类数据时存在困难。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种与模型和数据无关的智能体，该智能体通过代码生成和多模态推理来处理数值数据。我们的智能体在诸如传感器数据分类和时间序列理解等数值数据任务上的表现优于现有基线算法。在信息检索基准测试中，我们的智能体也表现出色。此外，我们还成功地将我们的智能体应用于核聚变研究领域，物理学家和托卡马克操作员通过该智能体来规划和分析核聚变实验。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Cause-CSD: A Challenge Multimodal Conversational Stance Cause Detection Dataset and Effective Method
papers.title_zh: 因果对话姿态检测数据集：一种多模态对话情境下的因果关系检测方法研究
papers.authors: Fuqiang Niu, Bowen Zhang, Junting Zhu, Qing Liao, Genan Dai, Hu Huang
papers.abstract: Social media platforms have become critical arenas for public discourse, yet existing stance detection methods often reduce opinions to surface-level labels, overlooking the conversational evidence behind stance expressions. We introduce Conversational Stance-Cause Pair Detection (CSCPD), a new task that jointly identifies both the stance polarity and its observable contextual evidence within multi-turn conversations. To advance research in this direction, we present Cause-CSD, the first large-scale dataset for CSCPD, spanning 21,048 annotated stance-cause pairs across diverse open-domain, textual, and multimodal discussions. We further propose Stance-Cause Detection Language Model (SCD-LM), a unified language model framework that leverages explicit context reasoning and joint decoding to predict stances and their supporting causes, along with human-readable rationales. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SCD-LM achieves state-of-the-art results on both text-only and multimodal subtasks, significantly outperforming strong baselines, especially for long-range and image-grounded cause detection. Our work advances explainable stance analysis and underpins understanding of public opinion drivers in impactful online settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体平台已成为公共讨论的重要场所，然而现有的立场检测方法往往将观点简化为表面层次的标签，而忽视了表达立场背后的对话信息。我们提出了“对话式立场-原因配对检测”这一新任务，该任务能够同时识别多轮对话中的立场极性及其可观察到的上下文证据。为了推进这一方向的研究，我们推出了“原因-立场检测”数据集，这是首个针对CSCPD的大规模数据集，包含21,048对带有注释的立场-原因对，这些数据来自各种开放领域、文本和多模态的讨论。我们还提出了“立场-原因检测语言模型”，这是一个统一的语言模型框架，它利用明确的上下文推理和联合解码技术来预测立场及其支持的原因，并给出人类可读的解释。大量实验表明，SCD-LM在仅文本和多模态的任务中均取得了最先进的结果，其性能显著优于强大的基线模型，尤其是在长期影响和基于图像的原因检测方面。我们的工作推动了可解释的立场分析，并为理解具有影响力的在线环境中的舆论驱动因素提供了基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Sparse Frontier: Sparse Attention Trade-offs in Transformer LLMs
papers.title_zh: 稀疏边界：Transformer大语言模型中的稀疏注意力机制权衡
papers.authors: Piotr Nawrot, Jianing Li, Renjie Huang, Sebastian Ruder, Kelly Marchisio, Edoardo Ponti
papers.abstract: Sparse attention offers a promising strategy to extend long-context capabilities in Transformer LLMs, yet its efficiency–accuracy trade-offs remain unclear due to the lack of comprehensive evaluation. We address this gap with the largest-scale empirical analysis to date of training-free sparse attention, evaluating six methods across multiple model families and sizes, sequences up to 128K tokens, and sparsity levels up to 0.95 (i.e., 1/20 attention budget) on nine diverse tasks. We first organise the rapidly evolving landscape of sparse attention methods into a taxonomy along four design axes. Our analysis then yields actionable insights: 1) sparse attention is effective: larger sparse models outperform smaller dense ones at equivalent cost, improving the Pareto frontier; 2) for the training-free methods we study, fine-grained per-query importance estimation during prefilling remains impractical—due to both the cost of estimation and the lack of sparse kernels that translate fine-grained sparsity into wall-clock gains—forcing a task-dependent choice between global-to-token and block-to-block selection. Instead, during decoding, token-to-page selection becomes feasible, enabling better generalisation and higher sparsity tolerance; 3) longer sequences tolerate higher sparsity, suggesting that fixed-budget methods in production are suboptimal. Together, these findings provide practical guidance for deploying sparse attention and methodological recommendations for future evaluations. Our code is available at https://github.com/PiotrNawrot/sparse-frontier.
papers.abstract_zh: 稀疏注意力提供了一种扩展Transformer大语言模型长上下文能力的有效策略，但由于缺乏全面的评估，其效率与准确性的权衡仍然不明确。我们通过迄今为止规模最大的无训练稀疏注意力实证分析来填补这一空白，对多种模型家族和规模进行了六种方法的评估，序列长度可达128K个令牌，稀疏度可达0.95（即1/20的注意力预算），在九种不同的任务上进行了测试。我们首先根据四个设计维度对快速发展的稀疏注意力方法进行了分类。我们的分析得出了一些有实际意义的结论：1）稀疏注意力是有效的：在同等成本下，更大的稀疏模型的表现优于更小的密集模型，从而提升了帕累托前沿的性能；2）对于我们研究的无训练方法来说，在预填充阶段对每个查询进行细粒度的重要性估计是不切实际的——这既是因为估计的成本问题，也是因为缺乏能够将细粒度稀疏性转化为时间节省的稀疏核函数——因此需要在全局到令牌以及块到块的选择之间进行任务依赖性的选择。相反，在解码阶段，按令牌进行选择变得可行，这有助于更好的泛化能力和更高的稀疏容忍度；3）更长的序列能够容忍更高的稀疏性，这表明在生产环境中使用固定预算的方法可能是次优的。这些发现为部署稀疏注意力提供了实用的指导，并为未来的评估提供了方法论建议。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/PiotrNawrot/sparse-frontier下载。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Contrastive Sentence Embedding With Local Context Representation for Text Classification
papers.title_zh: 考虑不确定性的对比式句子嵌入方法：结合局部上下文表示的文本分类技术
papers.authors: Han Liu, Jiaqing Zhan, Zhichao Chen, Qin Zhang
papers.abstract: In real-world applications of natural language processing, it is essential to effectively adapt a pre-trained model to a downstream task. While text classification is undertaken as a downstream task, it is crucial to produce meaningful sentence embedding that is adaptive to the task. In this paper, we explore how to effectively adapt a pre-trained model for extracting meaningful context representations from sentences, and propose an uncertainty-aware contrastive sentence embedding approach that involves addressing language ambiguity and inter-class separability for a text classification task. Specifically, we design an end-to-end strategy for driving the process of learning to transform a word embedding matrix into a contextualized sentence vector and to quantify the representation uncertainty of the sentence, while the word embedding matrix is produced by a pre-trained model without fine-tuning, and a label-wise contrastive learning strategy is designed to enhance intra-class compactness and inter-class separability. The results on public data sets show that a considerable improvement of text classification accuracy is achieved by adopting the proposed approach in comparison with using those state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中的自然语言处理应用中，有效地将预训练模型适配到下游任务中是非常重要的。虽然文本分类可以被视为一个下游任务，但生成能够适应该任务的有意义的句子嵌入却至关重要。在本文中，我们探讨了如何有效地将预训练模型用于从句子中提取有意义的上下文表示，并提出了一种具有不确定性感知的对比式句子嵌入方法。该方法能够解决语言歧义性和类别间可分性问题，从而适用于文本分类任务。具体来说，我们设计了一种端到端策略，用于将词嵌入矩阵转换为具有上下文信息的句子向量，并量化句子的表示不确定性。其中，词嵌入矩阵是由无需微调的预训练模型生成的，而标签级对比学习策略则用于提高类别内的一致性和类别间的可分性。在公开数据集上的实验结果表明，与现有的最先进方法相比，采用本文提出的方法显著提高了文本分类的准确性。

papers.title: ZipVoice-Dialog: Non-Autoregressive Spoken Dialogue Generation with Flow Matching
papers.title_zh: ZipVoice-Dialog：基于流程匹配的无需作者回应的口语对话生成技术
papers.authors: Han Zhu, Wei Kang, Liyong Guo, Zengwei Yao, Fangjun Kuang, Weiji Zhuang, Zhaoqing Li, Zhifeng Han, Dong Zhang, Xin Zhang, Xingchen Song, Lingxuan Ye, Long Lin, Daniel Povey
papers.abstract: Generating spoken dialogue is inherently more complex than monologue text-to-speech (TTS), as it demands both realistic turn-taking and the maintenance of distinct speaker timbres. While existing autoregressive (AR) models have made progress, they often suffer from high inference latency and stability issues. To overcome these limitations, we propose ZipVoice-Dialog, a non-autoregressive (NAR) zero-shot spoken dialogue generation model based on flow-matching. Observing that applying vanilla flow-matching to dialogue generation leads to poor speech intelligibility and turn-taking precision, we introduce two simple yet effective methods to adapt flow-matching architectures for dialogue generation: (1) a curriculum learning strategy to ensure robust speech-text alignment, and (2) speaker-turn embeddings to govern precise speaker turn-taking. Additionally, we introduce dedicated strategies to support stereo dialogue generation.Recognizing the lack of training datasets in this field, we curate and release OpenDialog, the first large-scale (6.8k hours) open-source spoken dialogue dataset derived from in-the-wild speech data. Moreover, for fair and rigorous evaluations, we established a benchmark to comprehensively evaluate dialogue generation models. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods and dataset, showing that ZipVoice-Dialog achieves superior performance in inference speed, intelligibility, speaker turn-taking accuracy, and speaker similarity. Our code, model checkpoints, and the OpenDialog dataset are publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成口语对话本质上比生成单句文本语音要复杂得多，因为它需要实现真实的轮流发言机制，同时还需要保持不同的说话者声音特征。虽然现有的自回归模型已经取得了一些进展，但它们往往存在推理延迟和稳定性问题。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了ZipVoice-Dialog这一非自回归的零样本口语对话生成模型，该模型基于流匹配技术。我们发现，传统的流匹配方法在用于对话生成时会导致语音可懂度低和轮流发言精度差的问题。因此，我们提出了两种简单而有效的方法来调整流匹配架构以适应对话生成需求：(1) 采用课程学习策略来确保语音与文本的精准对齐；(2) 使用说话者轮次嵌入来精确控制说话者的轮流发言。此外，我们还提出了专门的策略来支持立体对话的生成。鉴于该领域缺乏训练数据集，我们整理并发布了OpenDialog，这是第一个大规模（6.8千小时）的开源口语对话数据集，数据来源于真实环境中的语音数据。此外，为了进行公平且严格的评估，我们还建立了一个基准测试平台，以全面评估对话生成模型的表现。实验结果表明，所提出的方法和数据集非常有效，ZipVoice-Dialog在推理速度、语音可懂度、说话者轮流发言的准确性以及说话者相似性方面都表现出色。我们的代码、模型检查点以及OpenDialog数据集均可公开获取。

papers.title: All Prompts Are Created Equal? Evaluating Robustness of LLM Judges Against Non-Adversarial Prompt Variations
papers.title_zh: 所有的提示都是一模一样的吗？评估LLM评判者对非对抗性提示变体的鲁棒性
papers.authors: Savita Bhat, Vasudeva Varma
papers.abstract: LLM-based evaluation systems (LLM judges) have emerged as a scalable alternative to expensive human evaluations. Although LLM judges demonstrate 70-80% agreement with human evaluators, their robustness under semantically equivalent prompt variations remains underexplored. Through systematic evaluation of 8 models across 4 NLG tasks using 10 semantically equivalent paraphrases per prompt (~115000 evaluations), we identify a critical accuracy-robustness gap: attribute verifiability affects the robustness more than model choice, with factually verifiable attributes achieving 0.71 accuracy versus 0.19 for subjective attributes. Our investigations discover three key insights: 1) Task structure characteristics influence the robustness and in turn accuracy, 2) Attribute verifiability as the strongest predictor-factually verifiable attribute achieve 0.71 accuracy versus 0.19 for subjective attributes, 3) No single winning model-smallest model (Llama-3.1-8B) exhibits second-best performance, while the strongest model (Llama-4) from the same family significantly lag behind, thus demonstrating that general capability improvements do not necessarily result in evaluation robustness. With these findings, we propose a diagnostic framework grounded in attribute verifiability that enables principled decisions about evaluation automation. Our work establishes new standards for assessing LLM judge reliability beyond simple accuracy metrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的评估系统（LLM评委）已成为一种可扩展的替代方案，能够取代昂贵的人工评估。尽管LLM评委与人类评估者之间的一致性达到了70-80%，但它们在语义上相似的不同提示下的鲁棒性仍有待进一步研究。通过对8个模型在4项自然语言处理任务中的系统进行评估，每个提示使用10种语义相似的改写方式（约115,000次评估），我们发现了一个关键性的准确性与鲁棒性之间的差距：属性的可验证性对鲁棒性的影响大于模型选择，事实上可验证的属性能够达到0.71的准确率，而主观属性则只有0.19的准确率。我们的研究发现了三个重要发现：1）任务结构特征会影响鲁棒性，进而影响到准确性；2）属性的可验证性是预测能力最强的因素——事实上可验证的属性能够达到0.71的准确率，而主观属性则只有0.19的准确率；3）没有哪个单一的最佳模型——最小的模型（Llama-3.1-8B）能展现出第二好的性能，而同一系列中最强的模型（Llama-4）则明显逊色于前者，这表明一般性的能力提升并不一定能带来评估的鲁棒性提升。基于这些发现，我们提出了一个以属性可验证性为基础的诊断框架，该框架能够帮助我们做出关于评估自动化的合理决策。我们的工作为评估LLM评委的可靠性建立了新的标准，而不仅仅是依赖简单的准确率指标。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Thinking Traps in Long Chain-of-Thought: A Measurable Study and Trap-Aware Adaptive Restart
papers.title_zh: 长文本中的思维陷阱：一项可测量的研究及基于陷阱识别的自适应重启策略
papers.authors: Chenkang, Fan Yu, Junjie Nian, Sihan Zhao, Zhuoka Feng, Zijun Yao, Wang Heng, Yu Minshen, Yixin Cao
papers.abstract: Scaling test-time compute via Long Chain-of-Thought (Long-CoT) significantly enhances reasoning capabilities, yet extended generation does not guarantee correctness: after an early wrong commitment, models may keep elaborating a self-consistent but incorrect prefix. Through fine-grained trajectory analysis, we identify Thinking Traps, prefix-dominant deadlocks where later reflection, alternative attempts, or verification fails to revise the root error. On a curated subset of DAPO-MATH, 89% of failures exhibit such traps. To solve this problem, we introduce TAAR (Trap-Aware Adaptive Restart), a test-time control framework that trains a diagnostic policy to predict two signals from partial trajectories: a trap index for where to truncate and an escape probability for whether and how strongly to intervene. At inference time, TAAR truncates the trajectory before the predicted trap segment and adaptively restarts decoding; for severely trapped cases, it applies stronger perturbations, including higher-temperature resampling and an optional structured reboot suffix. Experiments on challenging mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks (AIME24, AIME25, GPQA-Diamond, HMMT25, BRUMO25) show that TAAR improves reasoning performance without fine-tuning base model parameters.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过长思维链技术来扩展测试时的计算能力，能够显著提升推理能力。然而，这种扩展方式并不能保证结果的准确性：在最初出现错误的情况下，模型可能会继续推导出一个看似自洽但实际上错误的结论。通过精细化的轨迹分析，我们发现了“思维陷阱”——即那些由前缀主导的僵局，此时后续的反思、替代尝试或验证都无法纠正根本的错误。在DAPO-MATH数据集的一个精选子集中，89%的失败案例都存在这样的陷阱。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了TAAR（陷阱感知自适应重启）这一测试时控制框架。该框架会训练一个诊断策略，从部分轨迹中预测两个信号：一个是需要截断的位置指标，另一个是是否以及以何种强度进行干预的逃逸概率。在推理阶段，TAAR会在预测到的陷阱段之前截断轨迹，并自适应地重新启动解码过程；对于陷入严重困境的情况，它会采用更强的扰动手段，包括更高温度的重新采样，以及可选的结构化重启机制。在具有挑战性的数学和科学推理基准测试（如AIME24、AIME25、GPQA-Diamond、HMMT25、BRUMO25）上的实验表明，TAAR能够在无需微调基础模型参数的情况下，提升推理性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Instruction-Guided Poetry Generation in Arabic and Its Dialects
papers.title_zh: 基于指令的阿拉伯语及其方言诗歌创作方法
papers.authors: Abdelrahman Sadallah, Kareem Elozeiri, Mervat Abassy, Rania Elbadry, Mohamed Anwar, Abed Alhakim Freihat, Preslav Nakov, Fajri Koto
papers.abstract: Poetry has long been a central art form for Arabic speakers, serving as a powerful medium of expression and cultural identity. While modern Arabic speakers continue to value poetry, existing research on Arabic poetry within Large Language Models (LLMs) has primarily focused on analysis tasks such as interpretation or metadata prediction, e.g., rhyme schemes and titles. In contrast, our work addresses the practical aspect of poetry creation in Arabic by introducing controllable generation capabilities to assist users in writing poetry. Specifically, we present a large-scale, carefully curated instruction-based dataset in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and various Arabic dialects. This dataset enables tasks such as writing, revising, and continuing poems based on predefined criteria, including style and rhyme, as well as performing poetry analysis. Our experiments show that fine-tuning LLMs on this dataset yields models that can effectively generate poetry that is aligned with user requirements, based on both automated metrics and human evaluation with native Arabic speakers. The data and the code are available at https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/instructpoet-ar
papers.abstract_zh: 诗歌长期以来一直是阿拉伯语使用者的核心艺术形式，是一种强大的表达方式和文化认同的载体。虽然现代阿拉伯语使用者仍然重视诗歌，但关于大语言模型中的阿拉伯诗歌的研究，主要集中在诸如释义或元数据预测等分析任务上，例如韵律模式和标题的识别。相比之下，我们的工作着眼于阿拉伯诗歌创作的实践层面，通过引入可控制的生成能力来帮助用户创作诗歌。具体来说，我们提供了一个大规模、精心筛选的基于指导的学习数据集，该数据集包含标准阿拉伯语以及各种阿拉伯方言的内容。这个数据集使得根据用户预设的标准，如风格和韵律，进行诗歌的撰写、修改和续写成为可能，同时还能进行诗歌分析。我们的实验表明，利用这个数据集对大语言模型进行微调后，可以生成符合用户需求的诗歌，这些诗歌既基于自动化评估指标，也经过与阿拉伯语母语者的人工评估。相关数据代码可访问于https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/instructpoet-ar
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Agentic Verification for Ambiguous Query Disambiguation
papers.title_zh: 用于模糊查询消歧的主动验证机制
papers.authors: Youngwon Lee, Seung-won Hwang, Ruofan Wu, Feng Yan, Danmei Xu, Moutasem Akkad, Zhewei Yao, Yuxiong He
papers.abstract: We study ambiguous-query disambiguation in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Prior Diversify-then-Verify (DtV) pipelines first generate interpretations and then retrieve evidence, often introducing ungrounded queries that cannot be answered from the corpus and requiring costly post-hoc pruning and verification. We propose VerDICT, a novel approach that unifies diversification with verification by integrating retriever relevance and generator answerability feedback early. This not only reduces cascading errors but also enables parallelism. On ASQA, VerDICT improves grounding-aware F1 by an average of 23% over the strongest baselines across multiple LLM backbones.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在检索增强生成中处理模糊查询的方法。传统的“先多样化再验证”流程是先生成解释，然后再检索证据，这往往会导致产生无法从语料库中得到答案的未定位查询，需要耗费大量时间进行事后修剪和验证。我们提出了VerDICT方法，这是一种将多样化和验证相结合的新方法，通过早期整合检索器的相关性和生成器的回答能力反馈来实现这一目标。这种方法不仅减少了级联错误，还实现了并行处理。在ASQA测试上，VerDICT在多个大语言模型框架下的基准测试中，其基于定位信息的F1分数平均提升了23%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DICA: Dual-Indicator Guided Contrastive Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: DICA：多模态大型语言模型中的双指标引导对比对齐方法
papers.authors: Hao Yang, Jin Wang, Xuejie Zhang
papers.abstract: Human visual reasoning typically follows a coarse-to-fine attention process, starting from global scene understanding and gradually focusing on question-relevant regions. However, multimodal large language models may deviate from this pattern due to attention drift and the underutilization of visual evidence, which can lead to hallucinations. To mitigate these issues, this study proposes a Dual-Indicator Guided Contrastive Alignment (DICA), which tracks two information-theoretic indicators during inference: Visual Attention Entropy (VAE), which reflects the concentration of visual attention, and Output Image Correlation (OIC), which measures the dependence of generated outputs on the visual input. An abnormal increase in VAE or a decrease in OIC corresponds to different failure modes, which trigger targeted contrastive alignment to restore visual grounding. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DICA consistently outperforms existing approaches and substantially reduces hallucinations, highlighting the effectiveness of indicator-driven intervention in improving multimodal inference reliability. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/BGWH123/DICA/.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类视觉推理通常遵循从宏观到微观的注意力处理流程，从整体场景理解开始，逐渐聚焦于与问题相关的区域。然而，多模态大语言模型可能会因注意力漂移以及视觉信息的未充分利用而偏离这一模式，这可能导致幻觉现象的发生。为了缓解这些问题，本研究提出了一种双指标引导对比对齐方法（DICA），该方法在推理过程中跟踪两个信息论指标：视觉注意力熵（VAE），用于反映视觉注意力的集中程度；以及输出图像相关性（OIC），用于衡量生成输出对视觉输入的依赖性。VAE的异常增加或OIC的下降分别对应不同的故障模式，这些模式会触发针对性的对比对齐操作，以恢复视觉感知。通过多个基准测试的实验结果表明，DICA在性能上始终优于现有方法，并显著减少了幻觉现象，这充分证明了以指标驱动的干预措施在提升多模态推理可靠性方面的有效性。该代码的下载链接为：https://github.com/BGWH123/DICA/。

papers.title: From Tasks to Teams: A Risk-First Evaluation Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Systems in Finance
papers.title_zh: 从任务到团队：一种适用于金融领域多智能体大语言系统的风险评估框架
papers.authors: Zichen Chen, Jianda Chen, Jiaao Chen, Misha Sra
papers.abstract: Current financial benchmarks prioritize large language models (LLMs) for task accuracy and portfolio returns, yet overlook risks arising from multi-agent cooperation, tool-sharing, and real-world financial actions. We introduce M-SAEA, a Multi-agent, Safety-Aware Evaluation Agent that audits LLM teams without fine-tuning, deploying ten probes across four layers: model, workflow, interaction, and system, to yield a continuous risk vector and natural-language rationale. Evaluated across three high-stakes tasks (finance management, webshop automation, transactional services) with six prominent models, M-SAEA (i) identifies unsafe trajectories with minimal false positives, (ii) reveals latent risks (e.g., temporal staleness) that are not addressed by standard metrics, and (iii) provides granular, actionable scores for balancing safety and latency pre-deployment. By quantifying safety as a model-agnostic metric, M-SAEA reorients evaluation from individual tasks to collaborative teams, offering a robust template for risk-first assessment of agentic AI in finance and beyond.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的金融评估标准倾向于优先考虑大语言模型在任务准确性和投资组合回报方面的表现，却忽视了多智能体协作、工具共享以及现实世界金融行为所带来的风险。我们提出了M-SAEA这一多智能体、注重安全性的评估工具。该工具无需进行精细调优即可对语言模型团队进行评估，其评估范围涵盖模型、工作流程、交互方式以及系统三个层面，从而能够持续生成风险向量和自然语言化的风险评估报告。在三项高风险的任务中进行了评估，包括财务管理、网上商店自动化以及交易服务领域，涉及六款知名模型。M-SAEA能够识别出存在安全隐患的模型，同时避免产生过多的误判；它能够揭示那些被标准指标忽略的潜在风险（例如时间延迟问题）；此外，它还能够为部署前的安全性与延迟性之间的平衡提供详细的、可操作的评分标准。通过将安全性作为与模型无关的指标来量化，M-SAEA将评估的重点从单个任务转移到了协作团队层面，为金融领域及其他领域的智能体人工智能风险评估提供了可靠的框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Parametric Knowledge is Not All You Need: Toward Honest Large Language Models via Retrieval of Pretraining Data
papers.title_zh: 参数化知识并非所需的一切：通过检索预训练数据来实现更诚实的大型语言模型
papers.authors: Christopher Adrian Kusuma, Muhammad Reza Qorib, Hwee Tou Ng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are highly capable of answering questions, but they are often unaware of their own knowledge boundary, i.e., knowing what they know and what they don’t know. As a result, they can generate factually incorrect responses on topics they do not have enough knowledge of, commonly known as hallucination. Rather than hallucinating, a language model should be more honest and respond with “I don’t know” when it does not have enough knowledge about a topic. Many methods have been proposed to improve LLM honesty, but their evaluations lack robustness, as they do not take into account the knowledge that the LLM has ingested during its pretraining. In this paper, we propose a more robust evaluation benchmark dataset for LLM honesty by utilizing Pythia, a truly open LLM with publicly available pretraining data. In addition, we also propose a novel method for harnessing the pretraining data to build a more honest LLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在回答问题时表现出强大的能力，但它们往往不清楚自己的知识边界，即不知道自己知道什么、不知道什么。因此，当它们面对自己缺乏足够知识的主题时，可能会产生事实错误的回答，这种现象被称为“幻觉”。与其产生幻觉，语言模型应该更加诚实，在缺乏相关知识时给出“我不知道”的回应。虽然已经提出了许多方法来提高语言模型的诚实性，但这些方法的评估缺乏鲁棒性，因为它们没有考虑到语言模型在预训练过程中所掌握的知识。在本文中，我们提出了一种更鲁棒的评估基准数据集，用于衡量语言模型的诚实性。我们利用了Pythia这个真正开放的语言模型，该模型拥有公开可用的预训练数据。此外，我们还提出了一种利用预训练数据来构建更诚实的语言模型的新方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TIME: Temporally Intelligent Meta-reasoning Engine for Context-Triggered Explicit Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 时间：用于基于上下文的显性推理的智能元推理引擎
papers.authors: Susmit Das
papers.abstract: Reasoning-oriented language models typically expose explicit reasoning as a long, front-loaded chain of “thinking” tokens before the main output, either always enabled or externally toggled at inference time. Although this can help on arithmetic, coding, and other multi-step tasks, it is costly, weakens claim-level auditability, and does not allow the model to re-trigger explicit reasoning once presentation has begun. In dialogue, these limitations are compounded by weak sensitivity to temporal structure: unless time is explicitly stated in text, standard models treat replies separated by seconds and replies separated by weeks as equivalent. We introduce TIME (Temporally Intelligent Meta-reasoning Engine), a behavioral alignment framework that learns explicit reasoning as a context-triggered control policy rather than a fixed response mode. TIME augments dialogue with optional ISO 8601 ‘<time>‘ tags, tick events that represent silent time passage, and short ‘<think>‘ blocks that may appear anywhere in a response. Using a four-phase curriculum, including a small maximally diverse full-batch alignment stage, we train Qwen3 dense models to invoke brief, in-place reasoning bursts only when contextual cues warrant them, while keeping user-facing output compact. We also introduce TIMEBench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating reasoning from temporal cues in dialogue. Across 4B-32B scales, TIME improves TIMEBench scores over the corresponding base Qwen3 models in both thinking and no-thinking modes while reducing explicit reasoning tokens by roughly an order of magnitude. Beyond score improvements, TIME induces a distinct behavioral shift: explicit reasoning becomes more compact and more responsive to contextual cues. Code, training data, and benchmark artifacts are publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于推理的语言模型通常会在主要输出之前，以一长串前置的“思考”标记来展示明确的推理过程。这些标记要么始终被启用，要么在推理时由用户手动切换。虽然这种方法在算术、编程等多步骤任务中效果不错，但它存在成本较高、难以进行审计的问题，并且无法让模型在推理过程开始之后再次触发明确的推理行为。在对话场景中，这些限制还因为模型对时间结构的敏感性不足而进一步加剧：除非文本中明确提及时间，否则标准模型会将相隔几秒的回复与相隔几周的回复视为等效。我们提出了TIME（时间智能元推理引擎）这一行为对齐框架，它通过将明确推理作为基于上下文的控制策略来学习，而不是固定不变的响应模式。TIME通过可选的ISO 8601格式的时间标签来增强对话功能，这些标签代表无声的时间流逝；同时，它还引入了简短的“<时间>”块，这些块可以出现在任何回复中。通过四阶段训练流程，包括一个最大化的多样化全批量对齐阶段，我们训练了Qwen3密集模型，使其仅在上下文提示需要时才会进行短暂的推理行为，同时保持面向用户的输出内容简洁。我们还开发了TIMEBench这一诊断基准测试，用于评估对话中从时间线索出发的推理能力。在4B到32B的规模下，TIME在思考和无思考模式下均提升了TIMEBench的得分，同时将明确的推理标记数量减少了大约一个数量级。除了提升得分之外，TIME还带来了显著的行为变化：明确的推理行为变得更加紧凑，且能更灵敏地响应上下文线索。我们的代码、训练数据和基准测试成果均已公开可供使用。

papers.title: Omni-R1: Towards the Unified Generative Paradigm for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.title_zh: Omni-R1：迈向多模态推理的统一生成式范式
papers.authors: Dongjie Cheng, Yongqi Li, Zhixin Ma, Hongru Cai, Yupeng Hu, Wenjie Wang, Liqiang Nie, Wenjie Li
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are making significant progress in multimodal reasoning. Early approaches focus on pure text-based reasoning. More recent studies have incorporated multimodal information into the reasoning steps; however, they often follow a single task-specific reasoning pattern, which limits their generalizability across various multimodal tasks. In fact, there are numerous multimodal tasks requiring diverse reasoning skills, such as zooming in on a specific region or marking an object within an image. To address this, we propose unified generative multimodal reasoning, which unifies diverse multimodal reasoning skills by generating intermediate images during the reasoning process. We instantiate this paradigm with Omni-R1, a two-stage SFT+RL framework featuring perception alignment loss and perception reward, thereby enabling functional image generation. Additionally, we introduce Omni-R1-Zero, which eliminates the need for multimodal annotations by bootstrapping step-wise visualizations from text-only reasoning data. Empirical results show that Omni-R1 achieves unified generative reasoning across a wide range of multimodal tasks, and Omni-R1-Zero can match or even surpass Omni-R1 on average, suggesting a promising direction for generative multimodal reasoning. The code and checkpoints are attached for reproducibility and subsequent open release.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型在多模态推理领域取得了显著进展。早期的方法主要集中在基于纯文本的推理上。最近的研究则将多模态信息融入了推理过程中；然而，这些研究往往遵循单一的任务特定推理模式，这限制了它们在各种多模态任务中的泛化能力。实际上，有许多多模态任务需要多种推理能力，比如放大特定区域或标记图像中的物体。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了统一的生成式多模态推理方法，该方法通过在推理过程中生成中间图像来统一多种多模态推理能力。我们通过Omni-R1这一两阶段SFT+RL框架来实现这一理念，该框架包含感知对齐损失和感知奖励机制，从而实现功能性图像生成。此外，我们还提出了Omni-R1-Zero模型，它通过从仅文本推理数据中逐步生成可视化结果，从而消除了对多模态注释的需求。实验结果表明，Omni-R1能够在广泛的多模态任务中实现统一的生成式推理，而Omni-R1-Zero甚至可以在平均性能上超越Omni-R1，这为生成式多模态推理指明了方向。相关代码和检查点已提供，以便重复验证和后续公开发布。
