papers.title: Time-for-Accuracy: Formalizing Chain-of-Thought as an Expansion of Logical Depth
papers.title_zh: 时间用于精确性：将链式思维形式化，作为逻辑深度的扩展
papers.authors: Yue Wang, Zhi Zhang, Wang Xi, Chengjie Sun, Lili Shan, Bingquan Liu
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) often improves multi-step reasoning, but it remains unclear what kind of additional sequential computation longer traces actually enable. We connect CoT to Bennett’s logical depth, separating an answer’s description length from the sequential effort required to derive it, and view a CoT budget of T steps as a qualitative cap on realizable sequential computation. To operationalize realized depth beyond raw length, we introduce Effective Logical Depth (ELD), a deletion-based measure of step necessity under a specified inference interface. Across depth-controlled prefix-sum tasks and GSM8K rationale perturbations, we observe two consistent signatures of a Time-for-Accuracy tradeoff: (i) plateau-to-transition accuracy curves as the budget increases from being below to matching the task’s required depth, and (ii) sparse, position-dependent deletion sensitivity concentrated in early steps for deeper instances. On GSM8K, an Extract interface, where the model reads off the answer from the remaining rationale, remains near-perfect even after prefix deletions, whereas a Repair interface, where the model must re-solve from truncated rationale context, degrades markedly. Moreover, Socratic human rationales are consistently more robust than Main rationales under Repair. These results suggest that longer CoT helps primarily when it enables additional effective sequential computation, and that deletion-based diagnostics can distinguish computational steps from redundant ones.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链（CoT）通常能提升多步推理能力，但尚不清楚更长的推理过程究竟能实现哪些额外的顺序计算。我们将CoT与Bennett的逻辑深度联系起来，将答案的描述长度与推导该答案所需的顺序计算量分开考虑。将CoT预算限制为T步，可以看作是对实际可实施顺序计算的定性限制。为了量化超出原始长度的“实现深度”，我们引入了“有效逻辑深度”（ELD），这是一种基于删除操作的步骤必要性度量方法。在受深度控制的前缀和任务以及GSM8K推理扰动中，我们观察到两个一致的“时间与准确性权衡”特征：(i) 当预算从低于任务所需深度增加到匹配该深度时，准确性的曲线会从平稳状态转变为过渡状态；(ii) 对于更深层次的推理实例，删除敏感性主要集中在早期步骤中。在GSM8K的“提取接口”上，模型可以从剩余推理内容中提取答案，即使经过前缀删除后，其性能仍然接近完美；而“修复接口”则要求模型必须从被截断的推理内容中重新进行推理，此时模型的性能会显著下降。此外，在修复接口下，人类提出的Socratic推理方式始终比主流推理方式更为稳健。这些结果表明，较长的CoT主要在能够实现额外的有效顺序计算时发挥重要作用，而基于删除的操作可以区分哪些计算步骤是有效的，哪些是多余的。

papers.title: DiffCoT: Diffusion-styled Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: DiffCoT：在大型语言模型中实现的扩散式思维链推理机制
papers.authors: Shidong Cao, Hongzhan Lin, Yuxuan Gu, Ziyang Luo, Jing Ma
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves multi-step mathematical problem solving in large language models but remains vulnerable to exposure bias and error accumulation, as early mistakes propagate irreversibly through autoregressive decoding. In this work, we propose DiffCoT, a diffusion-styled CoT framework that reformulates CoT reasoning as an iterative denoising process. DiffCoT integrates diffusion principles at the reasoning-step level via a sliding-window mechanism, enabling unified generation and retrospective correction of intermediate steps while preserving token-level autoregression. To maintain causal consistency, we further introduce a causal diffusion noise schedule that respects the temporal structure of reasoning chains. Extensive experiments on three multi-step CoT reasoning benchmarks across diverse model backbones demonstrate that DiffCoT consistently outperforms existing CoT preference optimization methods, yielding improved robustness and error-correction capability in CoT reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链推理能够提升大语言模型在多步骤数学问题解决能力，但仍然存在易受曝光偏见和错误累积影响的缺陷，因为早期的错误会不可逆转地通过自回归解码机制传播。在这项研究中，我们提出了DiffCoT这一基于扩散算法的思维链推理框架。该框架将思维链推理重新定义为一种迭代去噪过程。通过滑动窗口机制，DiffCoT在推理步骤层面整合了扩散算法原理，从而实现中间步骤的统一生成与回溯修正，同时保留了令牌级别的自我回归特性。为了维持因果一致性，我们还引入了一种符合推理链时间结构的因果扩散噪声调度方式。在三个多步骤思维链推理基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，DiffCoT在性能上始终优于现有的思维链推理优化方法，显著提升了推理过程中的鲁棒性和错误修正能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: System-Mediated Attention Imbalances Make Vision-Language Models Say Yes
papers.title_zh: 系统介导的注意力失衡使得视觉语言模型产生错误的判断
papers.authors: Tsan Tsai Chan, Varsha Suresh, Anisha Saha, Michael Hahn, Vera Demberg
papers.abstract: Vision-language model (VLM) hallucination is commonly linked to imbalanced allocation of attention across input modalities: system, image and text. However, existing mitigation strategies tend towards an image-centric interpretation of these imbalances, often prioritising increased image attention while giving less consideration to the roles of the other modalities. In this study, we evaluate a more holistic, system-mediated account, which attributes these imbalances to functionally redundant system weights that reduce attention to image and textual inputs. We show that this framework offers a useful empirical perspective on the yes-bias, a common form of hallucination in which VLMs indiscriminately respond ‘yes’. Causally redistributing attention from the system modality to image and textual inputs substantially suppresses this bias, often outperforming existing approaches. We further present evidence suggesting that system-mediated attention imbalances contribute to the yes-bias by encouraging a default reliance on coarse input representations, which are effective for some tasks but ill-suited to others. Taken together, these findings firmly establish system attention as a key factor in VLM hallucination and highlight its potential as a lever for mitigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）幻觉通常与输入方式之间的注意力分配不平衡有关：系统、图像和文本之间的分配不均。然而，现有的缓解策略往往倾向于以图像为中心来解读这种不平衡现象，通常优先增加对图像的关注，而对其他输入方式的角色则考虑不足。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种更为全面的、以系统为中介的视角，认为这些不平衡现象是由于功能上冗余的系统权重导致的，这些权重使得注意力偏向于图像和文本输入。我们发现，这一框架为“肯定偏见”提供了有用的实证依据——这是一种常见的幻觉形式，其中VLM会无差别地给出“是”的回应。通过将注意力从系统模式重新分配到图像和文本输入上，我们可以有效抑制这种偏见，其效果往往优于现有方法。此外，我们还发现了一些证据，表明系统中介的注意力不平衡通过促使模型默认依赖粗略的输入表示而加剧了“肯定偏见”现象。这些发现充分证明了系统注意力在VLM幻觉中的关键作用，并揭示了其作为缓解手段的潜力。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SCURank: Ranking Multiple Candidate Summaries with Summary Content Units for Enhanced Summarization
papers.title_zh: SCURank：通过“摘要内容单元”对多个候选摘要进行排名，以实现更高效的摘要生成
papers.authors: Bo-Jyun Wang, Ying-Jia Lin, Hung-Yu Kao
papers.abstract: Small language models (SLMs), such as BART, can achieve summarization performance comparable to large language models (LLMs) via distillation. However, existing LLM-based ranking strategies for summary candidates suffer from instability, while classical metrics (e.g., ROUGE) are insufficient to rank high-quality summaries. To address these issues, we introduce SCURank, a framework that enhances summarization by leveraging Summary Content Units (SCUs). Instead of relying on unstable comparisons or surface-level overlap, SCURank evaluates summaries based on the richness and semantic importance of information content. We investigate the effectiveness of SCURank in distilling summaries from multiple diverse LLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that SCURank outperforms traditional metrics and LLM-based ranking methods across evaluation measures and datasets. Furthermore, our findings show that incorporating diverse LLM summaries enhances model abstractiveness and overall distilled model performance, validating the benefits of information-centric ranking in multi-LLM distillation.
papers.abstract_zh: 小型语言模型（如BART）通过蒸馏技术能够实现与大语言模型相当的文本摘要生成效果。然而，现有的基于大语言模型的摘要排序策略存在不稳定性的问题，而传统的评估指标（如ROUGE）则不足以对高质量摘要进行准确排序。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了SCURank框架。该框架通过利用摘要内容单元来提升摘要的质量。与依赖不稳定的比较或表面上的重叠不同，SCURank根据信息内容的丰富度和语义重要性来评估摘要。我们通过实验验证了SCURank在从多种不同的大语言模型中提取摘要方面的有效性。实验结果表明，SCURank在各项评估指标和数据集上均优于传统评估指标和基于大语言模型的排序方法。此外，我们的研究还发现，结合多种大语言模型的摘要能够提升模型的抽象性以及整体蒸馏模型的性能，这验证了以信息为中心的排序方式在多语言模型蒸馏中的优势。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Valid Necessary: Diagnosing Latent Inefficiency in Chain-of-Thought
papers.title_zh: 有效且必要：识别思维链中隐藏的低效现象
papers.authors: Daeyeop Lee, Hwanjo Yu
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it often incurs substantial computational costs due to “over-reasoning”—the generation of redundant, verbose, or irrelevant steps. While existing reasoning step evaluators effectively detect logical fallacies and factual errors, our analysis reveals a critical blind spot: they fail to penalize “valid but inefficient” reasoning steps that inflate token usage without contributing to the solution. To systematically diagnose this limitation, we introduce RIV-GSM8K, a diagnostic benchmark injected with five distinct types of inefficiencies, including circular reasoning and excessive decomposition. Diagnostic experiments reveal that state-of-the-art evaluators struggle to distinguish these inefficiencies from necessary reasoning. To address this gap, we propose CAID (Context-Aware Information Density), a training-free metric grounded in information theory that identifies low-utility steps. To validate the metric’s practical utility, we apply it within PACE, a post-hoc compression strategy. Additional control experiments show that the gains of PACE are not explained by trivial pruning: compared with random step removal and PRM-based compression baselines, it preserves accuracy at substantially higher compression rates. Empirical results on GSM8K, StrategyQA, and ARC-Challenge demonstrate that PACE reduces token consumption by 31–53% while maintaining accuracy, confirming that CAID successfully distills informational “froth” from reasoning chains without compromising deductive validity.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链提示显著提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但往往会因为“过度推理”而带来巨大的计算成本——即生成冗余、冗长或无关的步骤。虽然现有的推理步骤评估方法能够有效检测出逻辑谬误和事实错误，但我们的分析发现了一个关键缺陷：它们无法对那些“有效但低效”的推理步骤进行惩罚，因为这些步骤会增加token的使用量，却无法为解决方案做出贡献。为了系统地诊断这一缺陷，我们提出了RIV-GSM8K这个诊断基准，该基准包含了五种不同类型的低效行为，包括循环推理和过度分解。诊断实验表明，最先进的评估方法难以区分这些低效行为与必要的推理过程。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CAID（上下文感知信息密度）这一基于信息论的无训练度量指标，它能够识别出低效率的步骤。为了验证该度量的实际效用，我们将它应用于PACE这一后处理压缩策略中。额外的控制实验表明，PACE的优化效果并非由简单的剪枝所解释：与随机移除步骤和基于PRM的压缩基线相比，它在更高的压缩率下仍能保持准确性。在GSM8K、StrategyQA和ARC-Challenge上的实证结果表明，PACE能够将token消耗减少31%-53%，同时仍保持准确性，这证明了CAID能够成功地从推理链中提取出有用的信息，而不会损害演绎的有效性。

papers.title: CausalGaze: Unveiling Hallucinations via Counterfactual Graph Intervention in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: CausalGaze：通过反事实图干预技术在大型语言模型中揭示幻觉现象
papers.authors: Linggang Kong, Lei Wu, Yunlong Zhang, Xiaofeng Zhong, Wang Zhen, Yongjie Wang, Yao Pan
papers.abstract: Despite the groundbreaking advancements made by large language models (LLMs), hallucination remains a critical bottleneck for their deployment in high-stakes domains. Existing classification-based methods mainly rely on static and passive signals from internal states, which often captures the noise and spurious correlations, while overlooking the underlying causal mechanisms. To address this limitation, we shift the paradigm from passive observation to active intervention by introducing CausalGaze, a novel hallucination detection framework based on structural causal models (SCMs). CausalGaze models LLMs’ internal states as dynamic causal graphs and employs counterfactual interventions to disentangle causal reasoning paths from incidental noise, thereby enhancing model interpretability. Extensive experiments across four datasets and three widely used LLMs demonstrate the effectiveness of CausalGaze, especially achieving over 5.2% improvement in AUROC on the TruthfulQA dataset compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型取得了突破性进展，但幻觉现象仍然是其在高风险领域应用中的一个关键瓶颈。现有的基于分类的方法主要依赖于来自内部状态的静态和被动信号，这些信号往往只能捕捉到噪声和虚假的相关性，而忽略了潜在的因果机制。为了克服这一限制，我们改变了从被动观察到主动干预的范式，引入了CausalGaze这一基于结构因果模型的新颖幻觉检测框架。CausalGaze将大语言模型的内部状态视为动态因果图，并通过反事实干预来分离因果推理路径与偶然的噪声，从而提升了模型的可解释性。在四个数据集和三种常用的大语言模型上进行的广泛实验表明，CausalGaze具有很好的效果，特别是在TruthfulQA数据集上，与最先进的基线方法相比，其AUROC提高了超过5.2%。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Improved Policy Optimization for Mixture-of-Experts Models: Importance Sampling and Rewarding from an Expert-Centric Perspective
papers.title_zh: 改进的混合专家模型策略优化方法：基于专家中心的重要性抽样与奖励机制
papers.authors: Yining Qian, Jinpeng Li, Fei Mi, Lifeng Shang, Xiang Zhang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated considerable promise in enhancing large language models. However, its application to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures is frequently hindered by training instability, primarily stemming from token-level misalignment in expert assignments between current and behavior policies. Existing approaches often oscillate between overly coarse sequence-level importance sampling, which ignores token-specific discrepancies, and restrictive expert-selection constraints that suppress beneficial policy exploration. To bridge this gap, we propose Expert Relative Policy Optimization (ERPO), which introduces expert-level importance sampling. By grouping tokens according to their routing assignments, ERPO mitigates the high variance of token-level importance sampling while overcoming the token-agnostic limitations of sequence-level methods. Furthermore, ERPO leverages this expert-centric granularity to introduce an Expert-Selection Entropy Reward, which dynamically adjusts routing uncertainty based on task-specific feedback. This unique mechanism ensures a rigorous alignment between reward signals and policy updates—a capability inherently unattainable by traditional importance sampling methods. Experimental results demonstrate that ERPO significantly outperforms strong baselines across multiple reasoning tasks, highlighting the efficacy of tailoring RL objectives to the structural inductive biases of MoE models.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习在提升大语言模型方面展现出了巨大的潜力。然而，将其应用于混合专家架构时，训练稳定性问题常常成为阻碍因素，这一问题主要源于当前策略与行为策略之间的专家分配在令牌级的不一致。现有的方法往往会在过于粗糙的序列级重要性采样与限制性的专家选择约束之间摇摆，后者会抑制有益的策略探索。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了专家相对策略优化算法，该算法引入了专家级别的重要性采样。通过根据令牌的路由分配对其进行分组，ERPO能够缓解序列级方法中的高方差问题，同时克服序列级方法对令牌无关性的限制。此外，ERPO利用这种以专家为中心的粒度来引入专家选择熵奖励机制，该机制能够根据任务特定的反馈动态调整路由不确定性。这一独特机制确保了奖励信号与策略更新之间的严格对齐——这是传统重要性采样方法无法实现的特性。实验结果表明，ERPO在多个推理任务中显著优于强大的基线算法，这充分证明了根据混合专家模型的结构性归纳偏见来调整强化学习目标的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From What Is Said to Why It Is Framed: Intent-Aware News Video Understanding
papers.title_zh: 从“说了什么”到“为何如此报道”：注重意图的新闻视频解读
papers.authors: Xiangzheng Kong, Minnan Luo, Wenya Wang, Jiaying Wu, Zhi Zeng, Guang Dai
papers.abstract: Short-form news videos increasingly shape public perception through strategic framing, yet existing verification methods largely overlook the communicative intent underlying such content. By emphasizing surface semantics, current models struggle to separate stylistic presentation from factual evidence, which leads to shortcut learning and brittle generalization. To address this limitation, we propose the Origin–Objective–Means (OOM) framework, a theory-grounded representation of communicative intent that captures creator stance, audience need activation, and communication strategy. We validate OOM through large-scale human annotation, revealing distinct and consistent lexical and structural patterns across intent dimensions. Building on this representation, we operationalize intent as an explicit semantic condition rather than a prediction target. Concretely, we introduce Intent-Guided Prompting (IGP) to condition LLM reasoning and intent-conditioned multimodal detection framework (ICMD), which injects intent into multimodal detectors via feature-wise modulation. Experiments on FakeSV and FakeTT show that modeling intent as an intermediate condition consistently improves accuracy and robustness across diverse vision–language backbones, while substantially reducing reliance on spurious stylistic correlations.
papers.abstract_zh: 短形式的新闻视频通过策略性的框架构建逐渐影响着公众的认知。然而，现有的验证方法往往忽略了此类内容背后的传播意图。由于当前模型过于强调表面语义，难以将风格呈现与事实证据区分开来，这就导致了学习的捷径化以及泛化能力的减弱。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了“起源-目标-手段”框架（OOM），这是一种基于理论的传播意图表示方式，能够捕捉到创作者的立场、受众需求的激活以及传播策略。我们通过大规模的人类标注来验证OOM框架的有效性，发现不同意图维度下存在明显且一致的语言和结构模式。在此基础上，我们将意图视为一个明确的语义条件，而不是预测目标。具体来说，我们引入了“意图引导提示”技术来调控大语言模型的推理过程，同时开发了“意图条件多模态检测框架”，该框架通过特征调节将意图融入多模态检测器中。在FakeSV和FakeTT上的实验表明，将意图作为中间条件进行建模能够显著提高准确性，并增强模型在不同视觉-语言基础架构下的鲁棒性，同时大幅减少了对虚假风格相关性的依赖。

papers.title: H-MAS: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Scheduling for Multi-Tenant LLM Serving
papers.title_zh: H-MAS：适用于多租户大型语言模型服务的分层多智能体调度系统
papers.authors: Yuhan Liu, Cong Xu, Qi Jia, Yihua Wang, Feiyu Chen, Liang Jin, Lu Liu, Yaqian Zhao, Yuting Ding, Xiang Li
papers.abstract: Multi-tenant Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) LLM serving must maintain stringent quality of service (QoS) despite heterogeneous requests competing for constrained GPU resources. In practice, MaaS workloads exhibit non-stationarity across multiple time scales, including request bursts, request-composition drift, and persistent workload shifts. Because workloads change across multiple time scales, existing request schedulers often rely on a single fixed policy (e.g., First-Come-First-Served, FCFS) that remains unchanged at runtime, which can lead to unstable QoS. We propose H-MAS, a hierarchical multi-agent scheduler that operates in a layered closed loop: a perception/prediction layer infers lightweight request attributes and cost signals; a feedback layer summarizes runtime metrics into short- and long-horizon QoS states; a hierarchical control layer updates the active scheduling policy over longer horizons and tunes execution parameters over shorter horizons; and an execution layer applies these decisions during inference. Experiments with load scaling and Azure-trace replays show that H-MAS achieves 1.2\times–3.0\times higher Goodput than SGLang and vLLM, and maintains more stable QoS under workload drift, diverse request lengths and heterogeneous SLO targets.
papers.abstract_zh: 多租户模型即服务（MaaS）的大语言模型服务必须即使在异构请求争夺有限的GPU资源时也能保持严格的服务质量（QoS）。实际上，MaaS工作负载在多个时间尺度上表现出非稳定性，包括请求突发、请求组合变化以及持续的工作负载波动。由于工作负载在多个时间尺度上发生变化，现有的请求调度器通常依赖于单一的固定策略（例如先来先服务FCFS），而该策略在运行时保持不变，这可能导致QoS不稳定。我们提出了H-MAS，这是一种分层多智能体调度器，它采用分层闭环结构运作：感知/预测层用于推断请求的轻量级属性和成本信息；反馈层将运行时指标汇总为短期和长期QoS状态；分层控制层在较长的时间范围内更新活跃调度策略，并在较短的时间范围内调整执行参数；执行层则在推理过程中应用这些决策。通过负载扩展和Azure-trace回放实验表明，H-MAS的Goodput比SGLang和vLLM高出1.2倍至3.0倍，并且在工作负载波动、不同长度的请求以及异构SLO目标的情况下仍能保持更稳定的QoS。

papers.title: EvoMD-LLM: Learning the Language of Species Evolution in Reactive Molecular Dynamics
papers.title_zh: EvoMD-LLM：在反应分子动力学模型中学习物种进化的规律
papers.authors: Zhichen Tang, Zhengzheng Dang, Yulin Chen, Jixin Wu, Haiwen Li, Yanming Wang
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) excel at static scientific reasoning, they struggle to model the temporal structure of dynamic physical processes. We present EvoMD-LLM (Evolutionary Molecular Dynamics Large Language Model), a framework that reformulates species-level molecular dynamics as a symbolic temporal language modeling problem. Reactive MD trajectories are discretized into sequences of molecular events, where each token represents a chemical species augmented with its persistence duration, enabling standard autoregressive LLMs to learn compositional evolution over time through efficient fine-tuning. A key component of EvoMD-LLM is temporal scaffolding, which treats event duration as an explicit linguistic token and serves as a structured inductive bias, significantly reducing invalid or hallucinated molecular outputs compared to conventional sequence modeling approaches. We evaluate EvoMD-LLM on multiple temporal prediction tasks, achieving up to 66.14% accuracy and consistently outperforming sequential neural networks and language-based baselines. Beyond quantitative improvements, we qualitatively observe that the model can generate plausible physical interpretations of reaction dynamics, despite not being explicitly trained for explanation. These results demonstrate that symbolic temporal language modeling provides an effective framework for grounding LLMs in dynamic physical simulations.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在静态科学推理方面表现出色，但在模拟动态物理过程的时间结构方面却存在困难。我们提出了EvoMD-LLM这一框架，它将物种级别的分子动力学问题重新表述为符号化时间语言建模问题。反应分子动力学轨迹被离散化为一系列分子事件，每个标记代表一个化学物种及其持续时长，这使得标准的自回归语言模型能够通过高效的微调来学习随时间发生的组合演化过程。EvoMD-LLM的一个关键组成部分是时间支架机制，它将事件持续时间视为一个明确的语言标记，并作为结构化的归纳偏见，从而显著减少了无效或幻觉性的分子输出，相比传统的序列建模方法具有明显优势。我们在多个时间预测任务上对EvoMD-LLM进行了评估，其准确率达到了66.14%，并且始终优于序列神经网络和基于语言的基线模型。除了量化上的提升之外，我们还观察到该模型能够生成合理的反应动力学解释，尽管它并没有被明确训练用于解释功能。这些结果表明，符号化时间语言建模为大语言模型在动态物理模拟中的应用提供了有效的框架。

papers.title: Do Image–Text Metrics Respect Semantic Invariances?
papers.title_zh: 图像与文本度量标准是否尊重语义不变性？
papers.authors: Amit Agarwal, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Meizhu Liu, Jyotika Singh, Karan Dua, Hansa Meghwani, Matthew Rowe, M. Avendi, Yassi Abbasi, Tao Sheng, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth
papers.abstract: Reference-free image–to–text evaluators are now standard for scoring image–caption alignment, yet it is unclear whether they respect semantic invariances. We present an invariance probe on five popular evaluators (CLIPScore, PAC-S, UMIC, FLEUR, and a deterministic LLM judge) under semantics-preserving perturbations along three axes: spatial (flips, context-preserving repositioning, light rotations), object (scale, category), and socio-linguistic framing (cultural/economic adjectives with neutral and length-matched controls). Across curated slices of three detection datasets and three caption evaluation suites, we find consistent non-semantic sensitivities: benign spatial edits and simple phrasing changes shift scores by (≈)6–9% on average, and for systems separated by just 0.7% these shifts can cause ranking flips in upto (∼)37% of cases, particularly under spatial changes. A small human study also supports this finding and confirms that annotators generally judge perturbed pairs as equally correct, so these shifts reflect metric behavior rather than semantic change. We further propose invariance-calibrated scoring, a post-hoc adjustment that roughly halves median absolute sensitivity while retaining correlation with learned caption evaluators.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，无参考的图像与文本评估工具已成为评分图像标题对齐的标准方法。不过，目前尚不清楚这些工具是否遵循语义不变性原则。我们在五个常用的评估工具（CLIPScore、PAC-S、UMIC、FLEUR以及一个确定性的大语言模型判分器）上，针对空间方向（翻转、保持上下文位置的重新定位、光线旋转）、对象属性（缩放、类别分类）以及社会语言框架（使用文化/经济相关形容词与中性对照词）这三个维度进行了不变性测试。通过对三个检测数据集和三个标题评估集的精选样本进行测试，我们发现存在一致的非语义敏感性：良性的空间编辑和简单的表述变化会使得分平均增加6%到9%。而对于得分差异仅为0.7%的系统来说，这种变化可能导致高达37%的判分结果出现相反的情况，尤其是在空间方向上的变化下。一项小型人类研究也支持了这一发现，该研究表明注释者通常认为被修改后的标题同样正确，因此这些变化反映的是评估工具的度量行为，而非语义上的改变。我们进一步提出了一种经过不变性校准的评分方法，这种方法可以在保持与学习得到的标题评估工具相关性的同时，将绝对敏感度的中位数降低一半左右。

papers.title: Reasoning in the Dark: Interleaved Vision-Text Reasoning in Latent Space
papers.title_zh: 在黑暗中推理：隐空间中的交织视觉-文本推理
papers.authors: Chao Chen, Zhixin Ma, Yongqi Li, Yupeng Hu, Yinwei Wei, Wenjie Li, Liqiang Nie
papers.abstract: Multimodal reasoning aims to enhance the capabilities of MLLMs by incorporating intermediate reasoning steps before reaching the final answer. It has evolved from text-only reasoning to the integration of visual information, enabling the thought process to be conveyed through both images and text. Despite its effectiveness, current multimodal reasoning methods depend on explicit reasoning steps that require labor-intensive vision-text annotations and inherently introduce significant inference latency. To address these issues, we introduce multimodal latent reasoning with the advantages of multimodal representation, reduced annotation, and inference efficiency. To facilicate it, we propose Interleaved Vision-Text Latent Reasoning (IVT-LR), which injects both visual and textual information in the reasoning process within the latent space. Specifically, IVT-LR represents each reasoning step by combining two implicit parts: latent text (the hidden states from the previous step) and latent vision (a set of selected image embeddings). We further introduce a progressive multi-stage training strategy to enable MLLMs to perform the above multimodal latent reasoning steps. Experiments on M^3CoT and ScienceQA demonstrate that our IVT-LR method achieves an average performance increase of 5.45% in accuracy, while simultaneously achieving a speed increase of over 5 times compared to existing approaches. The code are attached in the supplementary file for the review.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态推理旨在通过在得出最终答案之前加入中间推理步骤，来提高MLLMs的能力。它已经从单纯的文本推理发展到整合视觉信息，使得思维过程可以通过图像和文本两种方式来表达。尽管多模态推理方法非常有效，但目前的这些方法依赖于明确的推理步骤，这需要大量的视觉-文本标注工作，并且会引入显著的推理延迟。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种多模态潜在推理方法，它具有多模态表示、减少标注需求以及提高推理效率的优势。为了便于使用，我们提出了交错式视觉-文本潜在推理方法（IVT-LR），该方法在潜在空间中同时注入视觉信息和文本信息。具体来说，IVT-LR通过结合两个隐含部分来表示每个推理步骤：潜在文本（来自前一步骤的隐藏状态）和潜在视觉信息（一组选定的图像嵌入）。我们还提出了一种渐进式的多阶段训练策略，使MLLMs能够执行上述多模态潜在推理步骤。在M^3CoT和ScienceQA上的实验表明，我们的IVT-LR方法在准确率上实现了平均5.45%的提升，同时其处理速度比现有方法快了5倍以上。代码附在补充文件中，供审核使用。

papers.title: Hail to the Thief: Exploring Attacks and Defenses in Decentralised GRPO
papers.title_zh: 致敬窃贼：探索去中心化GRPO中的攻击与防御机制
papers.authors: Nikolay Blagoev, Oguzhan Ersoy, Lydia Chen
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated wide adoption in the post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs). In GRPO, prompts are answered by the model and preferred behaviour is learnt via reinforcement learning. Owing to the small communication volume, GRPO is inherently suitable for decentralised training as the prompts can be concurrently answered by multiple nodes and these completions are exchanged in the form of strings. In this work, we explore the robustness of decentralised GRPO by presenting the first adversarial attacks and countermeasures. We present a diverse set of attacks where malicious nodes poison benign models by sharing their poisoned completions. We demonstrate these attacks on math and coding tasks and show that an adversary can achieve attack success rates of up to (100%) in as few as 50 iterations. Moreover, to mitigate the attacks, we propose two defense mechanisms that check logit probabilities of completions or utilize an LLM judge to filter completions. The defenses prevent all but the DoS attack that causes unnecessarily lengthy but conceptually correct completions. The code of both attacks and defenses can be found at: https://github.com/gensyn-ai/HTTT.
papers.abstract_zh: 群体相对策略优化（GRPO）在大语言模型训练后的应用中得到了广泛采用。在GRPO中，模型的输入是提示信息，而用户期望的行为则通过强化学习来学习。由于通信量较小，GRPO非常适合去中心化训练——因为多个节点可以同时处理提示信息，并且这些回答以字符串的形式进行交换。在这项研究中，我们首次提出了针对去中心化GRPO的对抗性攻击及其防御措施。我们提出了多种攻击方式，其中恶意节点可以通过分享被污染的回答来破坏良性模型。我们在数学和编程任务上进行了这些攻击的实验，结果表明，敌手在短短50次迭代内就能实现高达100%的成功率。此外，为了减轻这些攻击的影响，我们提出了两种防御机制：一种是检查完成的任务的逻辑概率，另一种则是利用语言模型来判断完成的任务是否合法。这两种防御机制能够阻止除DoS攻击之外的所有攻击，因为DoS攻击会导致产生不必要地冗长但概念上正确的完成结果。这两种攻击和防御机制的代码可以在以下链接找到：https://github.com/gensyn-ai/HTTT。

papers.title: SocraticKG: Knowledge Graph Construction via QA-Driven Fact Extraction
papers.title_zh: SocraticKG：通过问答式事实提取来构建知识图谱
papers.authors: Sanghyeok Choi, Woosang Jeon, Kyuseok Yang, Taehyeong Kim
papers.abstract: Constructing Knowledge Graphs (KGs) from unstructured text provides a structured framework for knowledge representation and reasoning, yet current LLM-based approaches struggle with a fundamental trade-off: factual coverage often leads to relational fragmentation, while premature consolidation causes information loss. To address this, we propose SocraticKG, an automated KG construction method that introduces question-answer pairs as a structured intermediate representation to systematically unfold document-level semantics prior to triple extraction. By employing 5W1H-guided QA expansion, SocraticKG captures contextual dependencies and implicit relational links typically lost in direct KG extraction pipelines, providing explicit grounding in the source document that helps mitigate implicit reasoning errors. Evaluation on the MINE benchmark demonstrates that our approach effectively addresses the coverage-connectivity trade-off, achieving superior factual retention while maintaining high structural cohesion even as extracted knowledge volume substantially expands. These results highlight that QA-mediated semantic scaffolding plays a critical role in structuring semantics prior to KG extraction, enabling more coherent and reliable graph construction in subsequent stages.
papers.abstract_zh: 从非结构化文本构建知识图谱，为知识表示和推理提供了一个结构化的框架。然而，目前基于大语言模型的方法面临着一个根本性的权衡问题：如果过于注重事实覆盖性，会导致关系结构的碎片化；而如果过早进行整合，则会导致信息丢失。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SocraticKG这一自动化知识图谱构建方法。该方法通过将问题-答案对作为结构化的中间表示，在提取三元组之前系统地展开文档级别的语义信息。通过采用以5W1H为指导的问答扩展方式，SocraticKG能够捕捉到在直接知识图谱提取过程中通常丢失的上下文依赖性和隐含关系链接，从而为源文档提供明确的依据，有助于减少隐含推理中的错误。在MINE基准测试上的评估表明，我们的方法能够有效解决覆盖性与连通性的权衡问题，在大幅扩展提取的知识量的情况下，仍然能够实现出色的事实保留，同时保持较高的结构一致性。这些结果表明，以问答为基础的语义构建在知识图谱提取之前起着至关重要的作用，使得后续阶段的图结构构建更加连贯可靠。

papers.title: GROLE: Instance-Level Group Relative Optimization for LoRA Experts in Incremental Learning
papers.title_zh: GROLE：针对LoRA专家的实例级分组相对优化技术，用于增量学习
papers.authors: Yongyi Liao, Wencan Lai, Jun Fang, Jinjin Guo, Xiaohui Zhang, Zhiyuan Liu, Chao Liu, Pengzhang Liu, Qixia Jiang
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable zero-shot generalization, adapting them to downstream tasks or shifting data distributions often requires continual fine-tuning—a process prone to catastrophic forgetting and limited knowledge transfer. This challenge is especially pronounced in online Incremental Learning (IL) settings, where task boundaries are blurred, and data arrives in a non-stationary stream. To address these issues, we propose GROLE (Group Relative Optimization for LoRA Experts), a novel approach that incrementally constructs a pool of frozen, task-specific Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) experts. At its core, GROLE employs a lightweight, instance-level expert selector optimized through a group relative reinforcement learning objective, which dynamically combines relevant experts to maximize adaptability without compromising stability. Extensive experiments across diverse incremental learning benchmarks show that GROLE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly in task-free and blurred-boundary settings, achieving an optimal balance between plasticity and robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在零样本泛化能力方面表现出色，但将其应用于下游任务或转换数据分布通常需要持续的微调过程——这一过程容易出现灾难性遗忘现象，且知识转移能力有限。在在线增量学习场景中，这一问题尤为突出，因为任务边界模糊，数据以非平稳的方式传入系统。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了GROLE算法（Group Relative Optimization for LoRA Experts），这是一种新颖的方法，它能够逐步构建一组固定的、针对特定任务的低秩自适应专家。其核心思想是通过群体相对强化学习目标来优化一个轻量级的实例级专家选择器，从而动态组合相关专家，以最大化适应性而不影响系统的稳定性。通过在不同增量学习基准测试中的广泛实验表明，GROLE算法始终优于现有方法，尤其是在无任务且边界模糊的场景中，它能够在可塑性与鲁棒性之间实现最佳平衡。

papers.title: SEARCH-R: Structured Entity-Aware Retrieval with Chain-of-Reasoning Navigator for Multi-hop Question Answering
papers.title_zh: SEARCH-R：一种结构化实体感知检索技术，采用链式推理机制来实现多跳问答场景中的信息提取
papers.authors: FU Yuqing, Yimin Deng, Wanyu Wang, Yuhao Wang, Yejing Wang, Hongshi Liu, Yiqi Wang, Xiao Han, Maolin Wang, Guoshuai Zhao, Yi Chang, Xiangyu Zhao
papers.abstract: Multi-hop Question Answering (MHQA) aims to answer questions that require multi-step reasoning. The complexity of user queries, coupled with potential knowledge deficiencies in Large Language Models (LLMs), gives rise to two pivotal challenges that underpin the performance on this task: the correct identification of the reasoning path and the accurate retrieval of essential knowledge. Existing approaches primarily rely on prompt-based methods to generate reasoning paths, which are further combined with traditional sparse or dense retrieval to produce the final answer. However, the generation of reasoning paths commonly lacks effective control over the generative process, thus leading the reasoning astray. Meanwhile, the retrieval methods over-rely on knowledge matching or similarity scores rather than evaluating the practical utility of the information, resulting in retrieving homogeneous or non-useful information. Therefore, we propose a Structured Entity-Aware Retrieval with Chain-of-Reasoning Navigator framework named SEARCH-R. Specifically, SEARCH-R trains an end-to-end reasoning path navigator, which is able to provide a powerful sub-question decomposer by fine-tuning the Llama3.1-8B model. Moreover, a novel dependency tree-based retrieval is designed to evaluate the informational contribution of the document quantitatively. Extensive experiments on three challenging multi-hop datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/ACL2026_SEARCH-R.
papers.abstract_zh: 多跳问答（MHQA）旨在回答需要多步推理的问题。用户查询的复杂性，加上大语言模型在知识方面的不足，导致了两个关键挑战：正确识别推理路径以及准确检索关键知识。现有方法主要依赖基于提示的方法来生成推理路径，然后再结合传统的稀疏或密集检索方法来得出最终答案。然而，这些方法的推理路径生成过程往往缺乏有效的控制，从而导致推理偏离正轨。同时，检索方法过于依赖知识匹配或相似度评分，而忽略了信息的实际效用，导致检索到的是同质性或无用的信息。因此，我们提出了一种名为SEARCH-R的结构化实体感知检索与推理路径导航框架。具体来说，SEARCH-R训练了一个端到端的推理路径导航器，该导航器能够通过微调Llama3.1-8B模型提供强大的子问题分解功能。此外，我们还设计了一种基于依存树的新型检索方法，以定量评估文档的信息贡献。在三个具有挑战性的多跳数据集上进行的广泛实验验证了所提出框架的有效性。代码和数据集可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/ACL2026_SEARCH-R

papers.title: Why Did Apple Fall: Evaluating Curiosity in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 苹果为何衰落：评估大型语言模型中的好奇心因素
papers.authors: Haoyu Wang, Sihang Jiang, Yuyan Chen, Yitong Wang, Xiaojun Meng, Jiansheng Wei, Yanghua Xiao
papers.abstract: Curiosity serves as a fundamental construct in human cognition.Inspired by curiosity, reinforcement learning with intrinsic rewards for large language models (LLMs) has shown substantial potential.However, it remains unclear whether existing curiosity-driven methods genuinely reflect curiosity-like behaviors in LLMs, and to what extent psychological notions of curiosity can be transferred to these models. In this work, we propose a psychology-inspired framework to evaluate and leverage curiosity in LLMs.We adapt the Five-Dimensional Curiosity scale Revised (5DCR) to LLMs and combine questionnaire-based self reports with behavioral study.We find that although LLMs can exhibit curiosity-like behavioral patterns resembling those of humans, such patterns do not reflect an intrinsic trait of curiosity.Building on this insight, we design a curiosity-driven thinking pipeline to examine the functional role of human-like curious behaviors. Experiments show that instructing LLMs to emulate curious strategies leads to better performance on selected downstream tasks, indicating that mimicking curious behaviors holds promise for reasoning enhancement.
papers.abstract_zh: 好奇心是人类认知中的一个基本要素。受到好奇心的启发，带有内在奖励的强化学习方法在大语言模型上展现出了巨大的潜力。然而，目前尚不清楚现有的基于好奇心的方法是否能够真正反映大语言模型中类似好奇的行为，以及心理层面的好奇心概念在多大程度上可以应用于这些模型。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个受心理学启发的框架，用于评估和利用大语言模型中的好奇心。我们将五维好奇心量表修订版应用于大语言模型，并将问卷调查结果与行为研究相结合。我们发现，虽然大语言模型能够表现出类似人类的 curiosity 行为模式，但这些行为并不反映好奇心的本质特征。基于这一发现，我们设计了一种以好奇心为驱动的思维流程，以探究类似人类的好奇行为在推理过程中的功能作用。实验表明，指示大语言模型模仿好奇策略能够在某些下游任务中取得更好的表现，这表明模仿好奇心行为对于提升推理能力具有很大的潜力。

papers.title: Gaperon: A Peppered English-French Generative Language Model Suite
papers.title_zh: Gaperon：一种英法混合生成的语言模型套件，包含多种功能模块
papers.authors: Nathan Godey, Wissam Antoun, Rian Touchent, Rachel Bawden, Éric Villemonte de la Clergerie, Benoît Sagot, Djamé Seddah
papers.abstract: Standardized benchmarks have become the dominant metric for measuring progress in large language models, yet their validity is increasingly compromised by data contamination and the unclear relationship between benchmark scores and genuine language understanding. We introduce Gaperon, a suite of fully open bilingual (French-English) language models designed as an experimental testbed to investigate evaluation dynamics under realistic training conditions. Our study makes three core contributions. First, we demonstrate mismatches between benchmark performance and generation quality: models that excel on benchmarks may underperform in qualitative text generation, and vice versa. Second, through our deliberately contaminated Gaperon-Garlic variant, we show that competitive benchmark scores can be recovered via late-stage contamination with only moderate degradation of generation quality, and surprisingly, such contamination also improves performance on held-out benchmarks. Third, we provide empirical evidence that widely used neural quality filters, particularly those trained to favor instructional or educational content, amplify benchmark contamination in pretraining corpora, with the DCLM classifier systematically ranking benchmark samples in the top-5 percentiles of samples. We release all models, data mixtures, checkpoints, and evaluation code to support reproducibility and further investigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准化基准已成为衡量大语言模型进展的主要指标，然而，由于数据污染以及基准分数与真实语言理解之间的关系不明确，这些基准的有效性正受到越来越大的挑战。我们提出了Gaperon系列双语语言模型——法语-英语，这些模型被设计成实验性测试平台，用于研究在现实训练条件下的评估动态。我们的研究有三大贡献点。首先，我们发现基准性能与生成质量之间存在不匹配现象：在基准测试中表现优异的模型，在定性文本生成方面可能表现不佳，反之亦然。其次，通过我们故意引入污染的Gaperon-Garlic变体，我们发现可以通过后期污染来恢复具有竞争力的基准分数，同时仅会适度降低生成质量。令人惊讶的是，这种污染还能提升在保留的基准测试中的表现。第三，我们有实证证据表明，那些被广泛使用的神经质量过滤算法，尤其是那些被训练以偏好教学或教育内容的算法，会加剧预训练语料库中的基准污染问题。DCLM分类器会将基准样本系统地排在样本的前5%范围内。我们公开了所有模型、数据混合体、检查点以及评估代码，以支持可复现性和进一步的研究。

papers.title: Rhombus: Incentivizing Coordination in Parallel Thinking through Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 菱形：通过强化学习促进并行思维中的协作
papers.authors: Ziyuan Nan, Qi Yi, Di Huang, Yutong Wu, Guanhua Huang, Xue Gong, Kejiao Li, Yuhao Jiang, Chenchen Zhang, Zenan Xu, Xing Hu, Bo Zhou
papers.abstract: Parallel thinking offers a promising avenue for scaling test-time compute in Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling them to explore diverse solution paths simultaneously before aggregating them into a final answer. However, coordinating the exploration and aggregation stages remains challenging, as simple aggregation techniques often incur information loss, failing to preserve the subtle, decision-relevant signals generated during exploration. To overcome this, we propose Rhombus, a parallel thinking framework that explicitly incentivizes coordination between components via end-to-end reinforcement learning. Rhombus employs multiple parallel Proposers to generate compact, decision-focused reasoning cues and a central Synthesizer to integrate them into final predictions, utilizing co-training under a shared task reward to align their interaction. Across challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, Rhombus improves accuracy by 6.0% over long chain-of-thought baselines while reducing wall-clock latency by 39.4% under matched token budgets. Our work demonstrates that explicit communication optimization is essential for realizing the accuracy and efficiency gains of parallel reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 并行思维为大语言模型（LLM）的测试时间计算扩展提供了有前景的途径。它使得模型能够同时探索多种解决方案，然后再将这些方案汇总成最终答案。然而，协调探索和汇总过程仍然具有挑战性，因为简单的汇总技术往往会导致信息丢失，无法保留在探索过程中产生的那些对决策至关重要的细微信号。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了Rhombus这一并行思维框架。该框架通过端到端强化学习来明确激励各个组件之间的协作。Rhombus采用多个并行的工作者来生成简洁、以决策为中心的推理线索，并有一个中央合成器将它们整合到最终预测中。通过共享任务奖励下的协同训练，使得各个组件之间的互动更加协调。在一系列复杂的数学推理基准测试中，Rhombus的准确率比传统的方法提高了6.0%，同时还将时钟延迟减少了39.4%。我们的研究表明，明确的通信优化对于实现并行思维的准确性和效率提升至关重要。

papers.title: FLARE: Task-Agnostic Embedding Model Evaluation via Normalizing Flows
papers.title_zh: FLARE：一种与任务无关的嵌入模型评估方法，通过归一化流进行模型评估
papers.authors: Jingzhou Jiang, Yixuan Tang, Yi Yang, Kar Yan Tam
papers.abstract: Despite the widespread adoption of text embedding models, selecting the optimal model for a specific target corpus remains challenging due to the lack of task-specific labels. While task-agnostic evaluation offers a promising solution by relying on unlabeled data, existing approaches based on kernel estimators or Gaussian mixtures fail to model high-dimensional distributions effectively, resulting in unstable rankings. To address this limitation, we propose FLARE (Flow-based Label-free Assessment of Representation Embeddings), which employs normalizing flows to estimate information sufficiency in high-dimensional spaces. By learning invertible transformations, flows enable exact density estimation while mitigating the instability inherent in distance-based methods. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that our estimation error depends on the data’s intrinsic structure rather than its raw dimensionality. Experiments across 11 datasets demonstrate that FLARE achieves a strong Spearman’s ρ (up to 0.90) with supervised benchmarks, remaining robust even for high-dimensional embeddings (d ≥ 3,584).
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管文本嵌入模型已被广泛采用，但由于缺乏针对特定任务的标签，为特定目标语料库选择最优模型仍然具有挑战性。虽然基于任务不可知评估的方法通过依赖未标记数据提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但现有的基于核估计器或高斯混合模型的方法无法有效建模高维分布，从而导致排名不稳定。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了FLARE（基于流的无标签表示嵌入评估方法），该方法利用归一化流来估计高维空间中的信息充分性。通过学习可逆变换，该算法能够实现精确的密度估计，同时减轻基于距离方法的固有不稳定性。我们的理论证明表明，估计误差取决于数据的内在结构，而非其原始维度。在11个数据集上的实验表明，FLARE在监督基准测试中取得了较高的Spearman相关系数（高达0.90），并且即使对于高维嵌入（d≥3,584）也依然表现出强大的性能。

papers.title: RCTEA: Richness-guided Co-training for Temporal Entity Alignment
papers.title_zh: RCTEA：基于丰富度的联合训练技术，用于时间实体对齐
papers.authors: Jiayun Li, Wen Hua, Shiqi Fan, Fengmei Jin, Haiyang Jiang, Xue Li
papers.abstract: Temporal Entity Alignment (TEA), which aims to identify equivalent entities across Temporal Knowledge Graphs (TKGs), is crucial for integrating knowledge facts from multiple sources. However, existing TEA models often fail to capture the orthogonal yet complementary effect between structural and temporal features, and typically overlook the importance of information richness—a key factor for effective message passing in the neural feature encoders. To address these limitations, we propose a RCTEA framework that jointly models both structural and temporal aspects of the TKGs for entity alignment. Specifically, we design a richness-guided attention mechanism along with an adaptive weighting strategy to facilitate effective feature fusion. To ensure robust alignment despite noisy entity contexts, we introduce a dual-view neighborhood consensus algorithm that jointly refines the feature encoders to enforce local structural consistency of the predicted alignments. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of RCTEA, achieving state-of-the-art performance on public TEA benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间实体对齐（TEA）技术旨在识别时间知识图谱中相似的实体，这对于整合来自多个来源的知识信息至关重要。然而，现有的TEA模型往往无法捕捉到结构特征与时间特征之间的正交性以及互补性，同时也常常忽视了信息丰富度的重要性——这是神经特征编码器中实现有效信息传递的关键因素。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种RCTEA框架，该框架能够同时处理时间知识图谱的结构性和时间性特征，以实现实体对齐。具体来说，我们设计了一种以信息丰富度为导向的注意力机制，并采用了自适应加权策略来促进有效的特征融合。为了确保即使在噪声较多的实体情境下也能实现稳健的对齐，我们引入了一种双视图邻域共识算法，该算法能够共同优化特征编码器，从而确保预测出的对齐结果具有局部结构上的一致性。大量的实验表明，RCTEA框架具有出色的性能，在公共TEA基准测试上取得了领先的成绩。

papers.title: SQLAgent: Learning to Explore Before Generating as a Data Engineer
papers.title_zh: SQLAgent：作为数据工程师，在生成结果之前先学会进行探索性分析
papers.authors: Wenjia Jiang, Yiwei Wang, Boyan Han, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Chi Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models have recently shown impressive capabilities in reasoning and code generation, making them promising tools for natural language interfaces to relational databases. However, existing approaches often fail to generalize in complex, real-world settings due to the highly database-specific nature of SQL reasoning, which requires deep familiarity with unique schemas, ambiguous semantics, and intricate join paths. To address this challenge, we introduce a novel two-stage LLM-based framework that decouples knowledge acquisition from query generation. In the Exploration Stage, the system autonomously constructs a database-specific knowledge base by navigating the schema with a Monte Carlo Tree Search–inspired strategy, generating triplets of schema fragments, executable queries, and natural language descriptions as usage examples. In the Deployment Stage, a dual-agent system leverages the collected knowledge as in-context examples to iteratively retrieve relevant information and generate accurate SQL queries in response to user questions. This design enables the agent to proactively familiarize itself with unseen databases and handle complex, multi-step reasoning. Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly improves accuracy over strong baselines, highlighting its effectiveness and generalizability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在推理和代码生成方面展现出了令人印象深刻的性能，使其成为自然语言接口与关系数据库交互时的有力工具。然而，由于SQL推理具有高度依赖于特定数据库的特性，现有方法往往无法在复杂的现实环境中实现泛化。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段基于LLM的框架，该框架将知识获取与查询生成分离开来。在探索阶段，系统通过采用类似蒙特卡洛树搜索的策略来自动构建特定数据库的知识库，生成包含模式片段、可执行的查询以及作为使用示例的自然语言描述的三元组。在部署阶段，一个双代理系统利用收集到的知识作为上下文示例，逐步检索相关信息并生成准确的SQL查询来回答用户的问题。这种设计使得代理能够主动熟悉那些未被访问过的数据库，并能够处理复杂且多步骤的推理任务。在大规模基准测试中的广泛实验表明，我们的方法显著提高了准确率，其有效性和通用性得到了充分验证。

papers.title: Reasoning Up the Instruction Ladder for Controllable Language Models
papers.title_zh: 逐步构建可控语言模型的指令层次结构
papers.authors: Zishuo Zheng, Vidhisha Balachandran, Chan Young Park, Faeze Brahman, Sachin Kumar
papers.abstract: As large language model (LLM) based systems take on high-stakes roles in real-world decision-making, they must reconcile competing instructions from multiple sources within a single prompt context. Enforcing an instruction hierarchy, where higher-level directives override lower-priority requests, is critical to the reliability and controllability of LLMs. In this work, we reframe instruction hierarchy resolution as a reasoning task. The model must first “think” about the relationship between a given user prompt and higher-priority instructions before generating a response. To enable this capability, we construct VerIH, a training dataset of constraint-following tasks with verifiable answers, comprising aligned and conflicting system–user instructions. We show that lightweight reinforcement learning with VerIH effectively transfers general reasoning capabilities of models to instruction prioritization. Our method leads to consistent improvements across multiple model families and scales on instruction following and instruction hierarchy benchmarks, achieving ~20% absolute improvement in conflict setups. Our method also generalizes to safety-critical scenarios beyond the training distribution, exhibiting increased robustness against jailbreak and prompt injection, reducing absolute attack success rates by up to 20%. Our results establish reasoning over instruction hierarchies as a practical mechanism for improving AI reliability, where targeted updates to system prompts produce predictable, controllable, and robust changes in model behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统在现实世界的决策中承担重要角色，它们必须在一个提示上下文中协调来自多个来源的相互冲突的指令。实施指令层次结构，让更高层次的指令优先于低优先级的请求，对于LLM的可靠性和可控性至关重要。在这项研究中，我们将指令层次结构的解析重新定义为一个推理任务。模型首先需要“思考”给定用户提示与更高优先级指令之间的关系，然后再生成响应。为了实现这一能力，我们构建了VerIH这一训练数据集，该数据集包含具有可验证答案的约束遵循任务，其中包含了一致的和冲突的系统-用户指令。我们发现，使用VerIH进行轻量级强化学习能够有效地将模型的一般推理能力转移到指令优先级排序上。我们的方法能够在多种模型家族中取得一致的改进效果，并且在指令遵循和指令层次结构基准测试中表现出显著的优势，在冲突情况下实现了约20%的绝对改进。此外，我们的方法还能应用于超出训练分布的安全关键场景，表现出更强的抗破解和提示注入的能力，使绝对攻击成功率降低了20%。我们的研究结果表明，对指令层次结构进行推理是一种实用的机制，可以提升AI的可靠性，通过对系统提示进行有针对性的更新，可以产生可预测、可控且稳健的模型行为变化。

papers.title: CRISP: Compressing Redundancy in Chain-of-Thought via Intrinsic Saliency Pruning
papers.title_zh: CRISP：通过固有重要性的剪枝来压缩链式思维中的冗余内容
papers.authors: Yangsong Lan, Hongliang Dai, Piji Li
papers.abstract: Long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning is pivotal for the success of recent reasoning models but suffers from high computational overhead and latency. While prior works attempt to compress CoT via external compressor, they often fail to align with the model’s internal reasoning dynamics, resulting in the loss of critical logical steps. This paper presents Compressing Redundancy in Chain-of-Thought via Intrinsic Saliency Pruning (CRISP), a framework that compresses CoT by exploiting the model’s intrinsic saliency. Our analysis reveals a distinct phenomenon: the reasoning termination token </think> acts as an information anchor, where its attention pattern effectively demarcates essential reasoning from redundancy. Based on this finding, we design a policy that utilizes these intrinsic attention signals to guide atomic compression operations. In contrast to coarse-grained pruning strategies, CRISP strategically distills the reasoning chain to maximize information density while preserving logical coherence. Empirical results across various backbone models and mathematical datasets demonstrate that CRISP achieves a 50-60% reduction in token count without compromising accuracy, effectively mitigating the efficiency bottleneck of long-context reasoning. We open-source our implementation to facilitate further research in efficient reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 长文本推理是近期推理模型成功的关键，但存在计算开销大和延迟高的问题。虽然之前的研究尝试通过外部压缩工具来压缩长文本推理，但这些方法往往无法与模型的内部推理动态保持一致，从而导致关键逻辑步骤的丢失。本文提出了一种名为“利用内在显著性修剪压缩长文本冗余”的框架，该框架通过利用模型的内在显著性来压缩长文本推理。我们的分析发现了一个有趣的现象：推理终止标记作为一种信息锚点，其注意力模式能够有效地区分重要的推理内容和冗余内容。基于这一发现，我们设计了一种策略，利用这些内在注意力信号来指导原子级别的压缩操作。与粗粒度修剪策略不同，CRISP能够有针对性地提炼推理链，从而在保持逻辑连贯性的同时，最大化信息密度。在多种基准模型和数学数据集上的实验结果表明，CRISP可以在不牺牲准确性的情况下，将文本中的标记数量减少50-60%，有效解决了长文本推理的效率瓶颈问题。我们将我们的实现代码开源，以便促进高效推理领域的进一步研究。

papers.title: CascadeFix: Multi-Location Program Repair via Cascading Planning and Generation
papers.title_zh: CascadeFix：通过分层规划和生成方式实现多地点程序的修复
papers.authors: Huan Zhang, Li Kuang, Yang Yang, Yilei Fang, Yingjie Xia
papers.abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) is vital for software maintenance. Despite notable advancements, existing methods still face challenges of insufficient bug dependency modeling and inadequate global repair planning when addressing semantically complex multi-location bugs. We propose CascadeFix, a multi-location automatic repair method via cascading planning and generation. Firstly, to improve the modeling of semantic and structural dependencies among bugs, three types of bug relationships-Use, Copy, and Nearby-are defined to characterize semantic connection, patch reusability, and contextual interference. Then, to address inadequate global repair planning, a cascading repair planning algorithm is designed to effectively cluster strongly correlated bugs and intelligently assign reasonable repair priorities and operations to each cluster, ensuring the rationality and consistency of global repair. Finally, taking clusters as the basic repair units, a cascading patch generation mechanism is proposed to dynamically integrate intra-cluster dependency information and cross-cluster repair knowledge, producing patches that maintain syntactic correctness and semantic consistency under global dependency constraints. Experiments on Defects4J show that CascadeFix resolves 84 multi-location bugs, achieving a 31% improvement over current state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化程序修复技术对于软件维护至关重要。尽管取得了显著进展，但现有方法在处理语义复杂、涉及多个位置的漏洞时，仍然存在缺陷：对漏洞之间的依赖关系建模不足，以及全局修复规划不够完善。我们提出了CascadeFix这一多位置自动修复方法，该方法通过级联规划和生成来实现修复目标。首先，为了改进对漏洞之间语义和结构依赖关系的建模，我们定义了三种漏洞关系类型——使用关系、复制关系和邻近关系，以描述语义联系、补丁的复用性以及上下文干扰。其次，为了解决全局修复规划不足的问题，我们设计了一种级联修复规划算法，该算法能够有效将高度相关的漏洞进行分组，并智能地为每个组分配合理的修复优先级和操作步骤，从而确保全局修复的合理性与一致性。最后，以组为单位进行修复操作，我们提出了一种级联补丁生成机制，该机制能够动态整合组内依赖信息以及组间修复知识，从而生成既能保持语法正确性又能满足语义一致性的补丁。在Defects4J平台上的实验表明，CascadeFix能够解决84个多位置漏洞，相比当前最先进的方法，提升了31%的修复效果。

papers.title: DGPO: Beyond Pairwise Preferences with Directional Consistent Groupwise Optimization
papers.title_zh: DGPO：基于方向性一致的群体优化算法，超越成对偏好约束
papers.authors: Mengyi Deng, Zhiwei Li, Xin Li, Tingyu Zhu, Yulan Yuan, Zhijiang Guo, Wei Wang
papers.abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress, current preference optimization methods still struggle to align directional consistency while preserving reasoning diversity. To address this limitation, we propose Directional-Groupwise Preference Optimization (DGPO), a lightweight framework that aggregates supervision signals at the group level and explicitly models direction-aware alignment through multi-candidate comparisons. DGPO organizes forward and reverse question-answer instances into structured sets and optimizes a margin-based likelihood objective that separates coherent reasoning paths from inconsistent alternatives. This groupwise formulation captures richer relative information than pairwise objectives and reinforces consistency across diverse reasoning pathways. Empirical results show that our constructed reverse data yields a 3.2% average improvement across five benchmarks, while DGPO further delivers consistent gains across multiple datasets and model families, achieving average accuracy improvements of up to 3.6%. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Demi-deng2/DGPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型取得了显著进展，但当前的偏好优化方法在保持推理多样性同时实现方向一致性方面仍然存在困难。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了定向-分组偏好优化算法（DGPO）。该算法在组级别汇总监督信号，并通过多候选对比来显式地实现方向感知的对齐。DGPO将正向和反向的问题-答案实例组织成结构化集合，并优化基于边际的似然目标，从而将连贯的推理路径与不一致的替代方案区分开来。这种分组化的处理方式能够捕捉到比成对目标更丰富的相对信息，从而增强不同推理路径之间的一致性。实验结果表明，我们构建的反向数据在五个基准测试中的平均提升率为3.2%，而DGPO则在多个数据集和模型家族中实现了持续的提升，平均准确率提升了高达3.6%。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/Demi-deng2/DGPO下载。

papers.title: Emergence and Localisation of Semantic Role Circuits in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中语义角色网络的出现与定位
papers.authors: Nura Aljaafari, Danilo Carvalho, Andre Freitas
papers.abstract: Despite displaying semantic competence, large language models’ internal mechanisms that ground abstract semantic structure remain insufficiently characterised. To investigate whether and how LLMs develop causally functional representations of semantic roles, we introduce a causal-temporal methodology combining contrastive minimal pairs, edge-attribution circuit discovery, and training-time tracking. Our analysis reveals that LLMs encode semantic roles through highly localised circuits (89–92% attribution within 28 nodes) that emerge gradually via structural refinement rather than phase transitions. These circuits exhibit moderate cross-scale conservation (24–51% component overlap) alongside high spectral similarity, with larger models reusing similar components while rewiring connections. These findings suggest that LLMs form compact, causally isolated mechanisms for abstract semantic structure that exhibit partial transfer across scales and architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在语义能力方面表现出色，但其用于构建抽象语义结构的内部机制仍缺乏足够的描述。为了探究大语言模型是否以及如何形成关于语义角色的因果性功能表征，我们采用了一种因果时间分析方法，该方法结合了对比最小对、边缘属性发现以及训练过程中的追踪技术。我们的分析表明，大语言模型通过高度局部化的电路来编码语义角色（在28个节点内实现了89-92%的属性分配），这些电路是通过结构上的逐步完善而非阶段性的转变而逐渐形成的。这些电路具有中等程度的跨尺度一致性（组件重叠率为24-51%），同时具备较高的频谱相似性。较大的模型会在重新连接电路的同时，继续使用类似的组件。这些发现表明，大语言模型形成了一些紧凑且具有因果独立性的机制，用于处理抽象语义结构，并且这些机制能够在不同尺度和架构之间实现部分转移。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Thinking Economically: A Hierarchical Framework for Adaptive-Complexity Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 经济思维：一种适用于大型语言模型自适应复杂性推理的层次化框架
papers.authors: Yubo Gao, Haotian Wu, Hong Chen, Junquan Huang, Yibo Yan, Jungang Li, Zihao Dongfang, Sicheng Tao, PS Tan, Jie Zhang, Xuming Hu
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has significantly enhanced LLM reasoning, yet often incurs substantial computational overhead due to “overthinking”: generating excessively long rationales without commensurate accuracy gains. Existing efficiency methods typically apply uniform compression, which overlooks a critical observation that reasoning complexity is heterogeneous at two distinct granularities: across different problems and within individual reasoning steps. This motivates our principle of Thinking Economically: intelligently allocating computational resources based on intrinsic task and step demands rather than pursuing uniform brevity. We propose Hierarchical Adaptive Budgeter (HAB), a training framework that operationalizes this principle through coarse-to-fine budgeting. At the inter-step level, HAB predicts the optimal reasoning depth for each problem. At the intra-step level, HAB learns step-specific token budgeting signals from PPL-derived step comparisons and an adaptive Pareto optimization objective that captures the local quality-efficiency trade-off, while a Fisher Information-based pruner further provides fine-grained training-time guidance, thereby encouraging the generator to internalize more economical reasoning patterns. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH500 show that HAB not only surpasses standard CoT in accuracy but also reduces token usage, achieving a stronger performance-efficiency trade-off than the compared baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链（CoT）显著提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但由于“过度思考”现象的存在，往往会导致巨大的计算开销：生成过于冗长的理由，而并未带来相应的准确性提升。现有的效率提升方法通常采用统一压缩方式，但这忽略了这样一个关键事实：推理的复杂性在不同问题和单个推理步骤中存在差异。这促使我们提出了“经济思维”原则：根据任务本身和步骤的需求来智能分配计算资源，而不是追求统一的简洁性。我们提出了分层自适应预算器（HAB）这一训练框架，通过从粗到细的预算分配来实现这一原则。在步骤间层面，HAB能够预测每个问题的最优推理深度；在步骤内层面，HAB则从基于PPL的步长比较中学习到特定步骤的令牌预算信号，并通过自适应帕累托优化目标来捕捉局部的质量与效率权衡。此外，基于费舍尔信息的修剪器还能提供更精细的训练时间指导，从而促使生成器采用更经济的推理模式。在GSM8K和MATH500上的实验表明，HAB不仅在准确性上超越了传统的CoT方法，还减少了令牌的使用量，实现了比基准模型更高的性能与效率平衡。

papers.title: Characterizing the Robustness of Black-Box LLM Planners Under Perturbed Observations with Adaptive Stress Testing
papers.title_zh: 在受干扰的观测条件下，如何描述黑盒型大语言模型规划器的鲁棒性？采用自适应压力测试方法进行分析
papers.authors: Neeloy Chakraborty, John Pohovey, Melkior Ornik, Katherine Rose Driggs-Campbell
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated success in decision-making tasks including planning, control, and prediction, but their tendency to hallucinate unsafe and undesired outputs poses risks. This unwanted behavior is further exacerbated in environments where sensors are noisy or unreliable. Characterizing the behavior of LLM planners to varied observations is necessary to proactively avoid failures in safety-critical scenarios. We specifically investigate the response of LLMs along two different perturbation dimensions. Like prior works, one dimension generates semantically similar prompts with varied phrasing by randomizing order of details, modifying access to few-shot examples, etc. Unique to our work, the second dimension simulates access to varied sensors and noise to mimic raw sensor or detection algorithm failures. An initial case study in which perturbations are manually applied show that both dimensions lead LLMs to hallucinate in a multi-agent driving environment. However, manually covering the entire perturbation space for several scenarios is infeasible. As such, we propose a novel method for efficiently searching the space of prompt perturbations using adaptive stress testing (AST) with Monte-Carlo tree search (MCTS). Our AST formulation enables discovery of scenarios, sensor configurations, and prompt phrasing that cause language models to act with high uncertainty or even crash. By generating MCTS prompt perturbation trees across diverse scenarios, we show through extensive experiments that offline analyses can be used to proactively understand potential failures that may arise at runtime. Code is available at https://sites.google.com/illinois.edu/astllm/.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在决策任务中取得了成功，包括规划、控制和预测等方面。然而，这些模型倾向于产生不安全且不合预期的输出，这带来了风险。在传感器存在噪声或不可靠的情况下，这种不良行为会更加严重。为了主动避免在安全关键场景中的故障，有必要对语言模型规划器的行为进行建模，以应对各种观测情况。我们特别研究了语言模型在不同扰动维度下的响应情况。与以往的研究类似，其中一个维度通过随机排列细节的顺序、修改对少量样本数据的访问等方式，生成语义相似但表述不同的提示。而我们的研究独特之处在于，第二个维度模拟了不同传感器和噪声的影响，以模拟原始传感器或检测算法的故障。一项初步案例研究表明，这两种扰动方式都会使语言模型在多智能体驾驶环境中产生幻觉。然而，手动覆盖所有扰动情况是不可行的。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，利用自适应压力测试与蒙特卡洛树搜索相结合的方式，高效地搜索提示扰动的空间。我们的方法能够发现那些会导致语言模型行为高度不确定甚至崩溃的场景、传感器配置以及提示表述。通过在不同场景中生成蒙特卡洛树搜索的提示扰动树，我们通过大量实验表明，离线分析可以帮助我们提前了解运行期间可能出现的潜在故障。相关代码可访问于https://sites.google.com/illinois.edu/astllm/。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ProMCP: Profiling Token Flows and Latency Costs in Model Context Protocol–Based LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: ProMCP：基于模型上下文协议的LLM智能体中的代币流量分析与延迟成本分析
papers.authors: Sumera Anjum, Weijian Zheng, Rajkumar Kettimuthu, Heng Fan, Yunhe Feng
papers.abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) aims to standardize the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) with external tools, yet existing research primarily evaluates functional capabilities while treating the underlying protocol as an opaque black box. This oversight obscures critical inefficiencies in token flows and latency distributed across MCP’s decoupled Host-Client-Server architecture. In this paper, we introduce ProMCP, an end-to-end profiling and instrumentation framework that decomposes the MCP workflow into a six-stage communication pipeline, enabling granular attribution of computational costs. We evaluate widely varying deployment topologies—from air-gapped local models to commercial off-the-shelf (OTS) clients—across 20 servers and 169 tools from MCP-Bench and MCP-Universe. Our analysis reveals a distinct inversion in performance bottlenecks: topologies with customized clients devote 56–72% of total tokens and 60–67% of latency to planning and schema injection, whereas OTS clients concentrate over 85% of latency in final answer synthesis. Crucially, actual tool execution constitutes a negligible fraction of the total cost across all configurations. These findings establish a quantitative baseline for protocol overhead and demonstrate that future optimization must target schema orchestration and transport efficiency rather than tool execution speed. The code is available at: https://github.com/ResponsibleAILab/ProMCP.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）旨在规范大语言模型与外部工具的集成。然而，现有的研究主要侧重于评估功能性能，而忽略了底层协议的复杂性。这种忽视导致在MCP的分布式主机-客户端-服务器架构中，令牌流和延迟存在严重的低效问题。在本文中，我们提出了ProMCP这一端到端的分析和监控框架。该框架将MCP的工作流程分解为六个阶段的通信流程，从而能够精确分析计算成本。我们在MCP-Bench和MCP-Universe工具库中，对多种不同的部署拓扑进行了测试——包括本地隔离的模型以及商用现成客户端。分析结果显示，性能瓶颈的分布情况有所不同：使用定制客户端的拓扑结构中，56%-72%的令牌和60%-67%的延迟用于规划和模式注入阶段；而使用商用客户端时，超过85%的延迟集中在最终答案的生成阶段。值得注意的是，实际工具的执行在整个成本中所占的比例微乎其微。这些发现为协议开销提供了定量基准，并表明未来的优化应重点提高模式编排和传输效率，而非工具执行速度。相关代码可访问以下链接：https://github.com/ResponsibleAILab/ProMCP

papers.title: Reducing Hallucinations in LLMs via Factuality-Aware Preference Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过基于事实性的偏好学习来减少大语言模型中的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Sindhuja Chaduvula, Ahmed Y. Radwan, Azib Farooq, Yani Ioannou, Shaina Raza
papers.abstract: Preference alignment methods such as RLHF and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) improve instruction following, but they can also reinforce hallucinations when preference judgments reward fluency and confidence over factual correctness. We introduce F-DPO (Factuality-aware Direct Preference Optimization), a simple extension of DPO that uses only binary factuality labels. F-DPO (i) applies a label-flipping transformation that corrects misordered preference pairs so the chosen response is never less factual than the rejected one, and (ii) adds a factuality-aware margin that emphasizes pairs with clear correctness differences, while reducing to standard DPO when both responses share the same factuality. We construct factuality-aware preference data by augmenting DPO pairs with binary factuality indicators and synthetic hallucinated variants. Across seven open-weight LLMs (1B–14B), F-DPO consistently improves factuality and reduces hallucination rates relative to both base models and standard DPO. On Qwen3-8B, F-DPO reduces hallucination rates by 5×(from 0.424 to 0.084) while improving factuality scores by 50% (from 5.26 to 7.90). F-DPO also generalizes to out-of-distribution benchmarks: on TruthfulQA, Qwen2.5-14B achieves +17% MC1 accuracy (0.500 to 0.585) and +49% MC2 accuracy (0.357 to 0.531). F-DPO requires no auxiliary reward model, token-level annotations, or multi-stage training.
papers.abstract_zh: 诸如RLHF和直接偏好优化这样的偏好对齐方法能够提升指令遵循能力，但它们在判断偏好时可能会强化幻觉现象——因为这些方法更倾向于奖励流畅性和自信度而非事实准确性。我们提出了F-DPO（考虑事实性的直接偏好优化），这是一种对DPO的简单扩展，它仅使用二元的事实性标签。F-DPO首先应用一种标签翻转变换，来纠正排序错误的偏好对，从而确保所选答案在事实性上始终不低于被拒绝的答案；其次，它加入了一个考虑事实性的边际值，用于强调那些存在明显正确差异的偏好对，而当两个答案为同一事实性时，F-DPO则回归到标准DPO模式。我们通过为DPO对添加二元事实性指标以及合成幻觉变体来构建考虑事实性的偏好数据。在七个开放权重的大语言模型中（规模从1B到14B），F-DPO始终能提升事实性准确性，并相对于基础模型和标准DPO降低幻觉发生率。在Qwen3-8B模型上，F-DPO将幻觉发生率降低了5倍（从0.424降至0.084），同时将事实性得分提高了50%（从5.26升至7.90）。此外，F-DPO还适用于非分布范围内的基准测试：在TruthfulQA任务中，Qwen2.5-14B模型的MC1准确率提升了17%（从0.500升至0.585），MC2准确率提升了49%（从0.357升至0.531）。F-DPO不需要辅助奖励模型、令牌级注释或多阶段训练过程。

papers.title: POLARIS: A Gödel Agent Framework for Small Language Models through Experience-Abstracted Policy Repair
papers.title_zh: POLARIS：一种用于小型语言模型的哥德尔代理框架——通过基于经验的策略修复来实现模型优化
papers.authors: Aditya Namdev Kakade, Vivek Srivastava, Shirish Karande
papers.abstract: Gödel agent realize recursive self-improvement: an agent inspects its own policy and traces and then modifies that policy in a tested loop. We introduce Polaris, a Gödel agent for compact models that performs policy repair via experience abstraction, turning failures into policy updates through a structured cycle of analysis, strategy formation, abstraction, and minimal code patch repair with conservative checks. Unlike response level self-correction or parameter tuning, Polaris makes policy level changes with small, auditable patches that persist in the policy and are reused on unseen instances within each benchmark. As part of the loop, the agent engages in meta reasoning: it explains its errors, proposes concrete revisions to its own policy, and then updates the policy. To enable cumulative policy refinement, we introduce experience abstraction, which distills failures into compact, reusable strategies that transfer to unseen instances. On MGSM, DROP, GPQA, and LitBench (covering arithmetic reasoning, compositional inference, graduate-level problem solving, and creative writing evaluation), a 7-billion-parameter model equipped with Polaris achieves consistent gains over the base policy and competitive baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 哥德尔代理能够实现递归式的自我改进：该代理会检查自己的策略，然后追踪并修改该策略，这一过程通过循环进行。我们引入了Polaris——一种适用于紧凑模型的哥德尔代理。它通过经验抽象来实现策略修复，将失败转化为策略更新，整个过程包括分析、策略制定、抽象处理以及最小代码补丁修复，同时伴有保守性的检查。与响应级自我修正或参数调整不同，Polaris采用小型且可审计的修补措施来修改策略，这些修补措施会保留在策略中，并在每个基准测试中的未见实例上被重复使用。作为循环的一部分，该代理还会进行元推理：它分析自己的错误，提出具体的策略修订方案，然后更新策略。为了实现累积性的策略优化，我们引入了经验抽象技术，它将失败情况提炼成简洁、可重复使用的策略，这些策略可以在未见实例中得到应用。在MGSM、DROP、GPQA和LitBench等任务上（涵盖算术推理、组合推理、高级问题求解以及创意写作评估），一个拥有70亿参数的模型在配备Polaris后，其性能相较于基础策略有了显著提升，并且与竞争基准相比也具有竞争力。

papers.title: PhaseMI: A Motivational Interviewing Dataset for Enhancing Phase Progression in LLM-based Counseling
papers.title_zh: PhaseMI：一个用于促进基于大语言模型的咨询过程中阶段推进的动机访谈数据集
papers.authors: Jina Kim, Myeongho Jeon, Soohyun Cho, Chae-Gyun Lim, Jongmin Lim, Haewon Min, Eunho Yang
papers.abstract: The growing demand for scalable mental health support has increased interest in AI-based counseling systems grounded in Motivational Interviewing (MI). However, existing MI datasets do not explicitly model the structured progression of MI phases, which is essential for effective and goal-oriented counseling. To address this gap, we introduce PhaseMI, a phase-structured MI dataset, together with a data generation framework that employs therapist, client, and supervisor LLMs to explicitly control phase transitions. Compared to the best alternative baseline, PhaseMI achieves improved coverage of MI phases, with gains of 12.3% in exploring, 37.6% in guiding, and 61.1% in choosing, and experimental evaluations demonstrate that it yields higher overall counseling quality than baseline datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 对可扩展心理健康支持的需求不断增加，这引发了对基于动机访谈的AI咨询系统的兴趣。然而，现有的动机访谈数据集并未明确模拟动机访谈各阶段的顺序性发展，而这对于实现有效且目标导向的咨询至关重要。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了PhaseMI这一具有阶段结构的动机访谈数据集，并开发了一个数据生成框架，该框架利用治疗师、客户和督导者的大语言模型来明确控制各阶段的转换。与最佳替代基线相比，PhaseMI在涵盖动机访谈各阶段方面表现更优，在探索阶段有12.3%的提升，在指导阶段有37.6%的提升，在选择阶段有61.1%的提升。实验评估表明，PhaseMI所生成的咨询质量高于传统的基线数据集。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PsychEthicsBench: Evaluating Large Language Models Against Australian Mental Health Ethics
papers.title_zh: PsychEthicsBench：针对澳大利亚心理健康伦理规范，评估大型语言模型的表现
papers.authors: Yaling Shen, Stephanie Fong, Yiwen Jiang, Zimu Wang, Feilong Tang, Qingyang Xu, Xiangyu Zhao, Zhongxing Xu, Jiahe Liu, Jinpeng Hu, Dominic Dwyer, Zongyuan Ge
papers.abstract: The increasing integration of large language models (LLMs) into mental health applications necessitates robust frameworks for evaluating professional safety alignment. Current evaluative approaches primarily rely on refusal-based safety signals, which offer limited insight into the nuanced behaviors required in clinical practice. In mental health, clinically inadequate refusals can be perceived as unempathetic and discourage help-seeking. To address this gap, we move beyond refusal-centric metrics and introduce PsychEthicsBench, the first principle-grounded benchmark based on Australian psychology and psychiatry guidelines, designed to evaluate LLMs’ ethical knowledge and behavioral responses through multiple-choice and open-ended tasks with fine-grained ethicality annotations. Empirical results across 14 models reveal that refusal rates are poor indicators of ethical behavior, revealing a significant divergence between safety triggers and clinical appropriateness. Notably, we find that domain-specific fine-tuning can degrade ethical robustness, as several specialized models underperform their base backbones in ethical alignment. PsychEthicsBench provides a foundation for systematic, jurisdiction-aware evaluation of LLMs in mental health, encouraging more responsible development in this domain.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在心理健康领域的应用日益广泛，这要求我们有健全的框架来评估其专业安全性的对齐情况。目前的主流评估方法主要依赖于基于拒绝行为的安全性指标，但这些指标对于理解临床实践中所需的细致行为表现缺乏足够的洞察力。在心理健康领域，如果拒绝行为不符合临床标准，可能会被视为缺乏同理心，从而阻碍人们寻求帮助。为了弥补这一不足，我们摒弃了以拒绝行为为中心的评估方式，推出了PsychEthicsBench——这是一个基于澳大利亚心理学和精神病学指南制定的首个基于原则的基准测试。该测试通过选择题和开放式任务来评估大语言模型的伦理知识及行为反应，并附带详细的伦理注释。对14种模型的实证分析表明，拒绝率并不能很好地反映伦理行为水平，这表明安全触发因素与临床适宜性之间存在显著差异。值得注意的是，我们发现特定领域的微调可能会降低模型的伦理稳健性，因为一些专门化的模型在伦理对齐方面表现不如其基础模型。PsychEthicsBench为系统性、考虑地域差异的大语言模型评估提供了基础，有助于推动该领域的负责任发展。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DynamixSFT: Dynamic Mixture Optimization of Instruction Tuning Collections
papers.title_zh: DynamixSFT：动态混合优化下的指令调优方案
papers.authors: Haebin Shin, Lei Ji, Xiao Liu, Zhiwei Yu, Hyunwoo Yoo, Qi Chen, Yeyun Gong
papers.abstract: As numerous instruction-tuning datasets continue to emerge, dynamically balancing and optimizing their mixtures has become a criticalchallenge. To address this, we propose DynamixSFT, a dynamic and automated method for instruction-tuning dataset mixture optimization. We formulate the problem as a multi-armed bandit setup and introduce a Prior-scaled Boltzmann Exploration that softly anchors the updated sampling distribution to the original dataset proportions, thereby preserving the inherent diversity and coverage of the collection. Sampling probabilities are updated using a lightweight 1-Step Look-ahead Reward, reflecting how much the dataset contributes to improving the model’s performance at its current state. We demonstrate that DynamixSFT effectively optimizes the TÜLU-2-mixture andTÜLU-3-mixture collections across 10 benchmarks, while introducing minimal computational overhead over naive sampling. Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive analysis and visualizations to offer deeper insights into the adaptive dynamics of our method.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着越来越多的指令调整数据集不断涌现，如何动态平衡和优化这些数据集的混合体已成为一个关键挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了DynamixSFT——一种用于指令调整数据集混合优化的动态自动化方法。我们将这个问题建模为一个多臂老虎机问题，并引入了基于先验的玻尔兹曼探索算法，该算法能够温和地将更新后的采样分布与原始数据集的比例相匹配，从而保留集合的固有多样性和覆盖范围。采样概率的更新采用了一种轻量级的单步预测奖励机制，该机制反映了数据集在当前状态下对模型性能提升的贡献程度。我们的实验表明，DynamixSFT能够在10个基准测试中对TÜLU-2混合体和TÜLU-3混合体进行有效优化，同时其计算开销远远低于传统的采样方法。此外，我们还提供了全面的分析和可视化结果，以更深入地了解我们方法的自适应动态特性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: BMAM: Brain-inspired Multi-Agent Memory Framework
papers.title_zh: BMAM：基于大脑原理的多智能体记忆框架
papers.authors: Yang Li, Jiaxiang Liu, Yusong Wang, Yujie Wu, Mingkun Xu
papers.abstract: Language-model-based agents operating over extended interaction horizons face persistent challenges in preserving temporally grounded information and maintaining behavioral consistency across sessions, a failure mode we term “soul erosion.” We present BMAM (Brain-inspired Multi-Agent Memory), a general-purpose memory architecture that models agent memory as a set of functionally specialized subsystems rather than a single unstructured store. Inspired by cognitive memory systems, BMAM decomposes memory into episodic, semantic, salience-aware, and control-oriented components that operate at complementary time scales, organised as a six-phase memory lifecycle. To support long-horizon reasoning, BMAM organises episodic memories along explicit timelines and retrieves evidence by fusing multiple complementary signals. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show that BMAM achieves 78.45% accuracy, outperforming seven memory-augmented baselines. Pairwise ablations reveal super-additive synergy between brain-region components rather than redundant stacking, and a Soul Portability Test demonstrates 87.5% identity-integrity across full memory export, clear, and restore. A targeted refinement of the temporal-trigger heuristics raises LongMemEval multi-session accuracy from 45.2% to 56.4%, validating the architectural decomposition behind BMAM.Code is available at https://github.com/innovation64/BMAM.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于语言模型的智能体在长时间的互动过程中面临着保持时间信息连贯性和维持会话间行为一致性的挑战，这种问题我们称之为“灵魂侵蚀”。我们提出了BMAM（受大脑启发的多智能体记忆系统），这是一种通用记忆架构，它将智能体的记忆视为一组功能化的子系统，而非单一的无结构存储。借鉴认知记忆系统的设计理念，BMAM将记忆分解为情节性、语义、显著性感知以及控制导向等组成部分，这些组件在不同的时间尺度上协同工作，整个记忆过程分为六个阶段。为了支持长期推理，BMAM通过明确的时间线来组织情节性记忆，并通过融合多种互补信号来检索证据。在LoCoMo基准测试中的实验表明，BMAM的准确率达到了78.45%，优于七种基于记忆增强的基线算法。成对比较分析显示，大脑各区域的组件之间存在显著的协同效应，而不是简单的冗余叠加。而“灵魂可移植性测试”则证明，在完整内存导出、清除和恢复过程中，系统的身份完整性保持了87.5%。通过对时间触发机制的针对性优化，BMAM的多会话准确率从45.2%提升到了56.4%，这验证了BMAM架构背后的设计理念。代码可在https://github.com/innovation64/BMAM下载。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Verified Critical Step Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 已验证的LLM智能体关键步骤优化方案
papers.authors: Mukai Li, Qingcheng Zeng, Tianqing Fang, Zhenwen Liang, Linfeng Song, Qi Liu, Haitao Mi, Dong Yu
papers.abstract: As large language model agents tackle increasingly complex long-horizon tasks, effective post-training becomes critical. Prior work faces fundamental challenges: outcome-only rewards fail to precisely attribute credit to intermediate steps, estimated step-level rewards introduce systematic noise, and Monte Carlo sampling approaches for step reward estimation incur prohibitive computational cost. Inspired by findings that only a small fraction of high-entropy tokens drive effective RL for reasoning, we propose Critical Step Optimization (CSO), which focuses preference learning on verified critical steps—decision points where alternate actions demonstrably flip task outcomes from failure to success. Crucially, our method starts from failed policy trajectories rather than expert demonstrations, directly targeting the policy model’s weaknesses. We use a process reward model (PRM) to identify candidate critical steps, leverage expert models to propose high-quality alternatives, then continue execution from these alternatives using the policy model itself until task completion. Only alternatives that the policy successfully executes to correct outcomes are verified and used as DPO training data, ensuring both quality and policy reachability. This yields fine-grained, verifiable supervision at critical decisions while avoiding trajectory-level coarseness and step-level noise. Experiments on GAIA-Text-103 and XBench-DeepSearch show that CSO achieves 37% and 26% relative improvement over the SFT baseline and substantially outperforms other post-training methods, while requiring supervision at only 16% of trajectory steps. This demonstrates the effectiveness of selective verification-based learning for agent post-training.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型代理能够处理越来越复杂的长期任务，有效的后训练变得至关重要。以往的研究面临一些根本性的挑战：仅基于结果的奖励无法准确分配功劳给各个中间步骤；估计的阶段性奖励会引入系统性噪声；而用于估算阶段性奖励的蒙特卡洛采样方法则会导致过高的计算成本。受启发于研究发现，只有一小部分高熵令牌能够推动有效的强化学习进行推理，我们提出了关键步骤优化算法。该算法将偏好学习重点放在经过验证的关键步骤上——即那些可以证明改变任务结果的决策点，比如让失败变成成功。重要的是，我们的方法是从失败的策略轨迹开始，而不是直接基于专家示范来制定策略，从而直接针对策略模型的弱点。我们使用过程奖励模型来识别候选的关键步骤，利用专家模型来提出高质量的替代方案，然后继续使用策略模型从这些替代方案继续执行任务，直到任务完成。只有那些策略成功执行并达到正确结果的替代方案才会被验证并用作DPO训练数据，这样既保证了数据的质量，也确保了策略的可达性。这种方法能够在关键决策点提供细粒度的、可验证的监督，同时避免了轨迹级别的粗糙性和阶段性噪声。在GAIA-Text-103和XBench-DeepSearch上的实验表明，与SFT基线相比，CSO分别实现了37%和26%的相对性能提升，并且显著优于其他后训练方法，同时仅在16%的轨迹步骤上进行监督。这证明了基于选择性验证的学习方法在模型后训练中的有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
