papers.title: Nash-Pruned CredMAS: Dynamic Panel Pruning for VLM-MAS using Nash-based Selection and Doubly-Robust Credits
papers.title_zh: 纳什剪枝的CredMAS：一种用于VLM-MAS的动态面板剪枝方法，采用基于纳什算法的选择机制，并具备双重鲁棒性特征
papers.authors: Yijia Fan, Mingyu Liu, Jing Yang, Jian Wang, Keze Wang, Jusheng Zhang
papers.abstract: Multi-round Vision-Language Model (VLM) Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) offer powerful reasoning capabilities but suffer from prohibitive costs due to static panel designs, where all N agents communicate at every T round. This approach is fundamentally inefficient, as it ignores the context-dependent and diminishing marginal utility of specific agents. To address this, we propose Nash-CredMAS, an economic framework that transforms agent selection into a dynamic resource allocation game. Unlike heuristic routing or one-time pruning, our method operates in two phases: (1) Offline Causal Value Learning, where we employ a doubly-robust (AIPW) estimator to train a context-aware value function from biased interaction logs, effectively learning the true marginal contribution of agents; and (2) Online Dynamic Auctions, where agents bid for communication slots based on their predicted utility. We formulate the inference-time selection as a submodular maximization problem under budget constraints, theoretically guaranteeing a (1 - 1/e)-approximation of the optimal coalition via a greedy strategy. Empirically, Nash-CredMAS achieves state-of-the-art results on challenging benchmarks, including MMMU and V*-Bench, while reducing token consumption by over 25% compared to static baselines. The system naturally converges to an economic equilibrium where agents actively remain silent when their marginal value does not justify the cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 多轮视觉-语言模型与多智能体系统虽然具备强大的推理能力，但由于静态面板设计的原因，其成本却居高不下。在这种设计中，所有N个智能体在每一轮T时都会进行通信。这种方法的效率极低，因为它忽略了特定智能体的情境依赖性和边际效用的递减现象。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了Nash-CredMAS框架——这是一种经济型解决方案，它将智能体的选择转化为动态资源分配问题。与启发式路由或一次性剪枝方法不同，我们的方法分为两个阶段：(1)离线因果价值学习阶段，我们利用双重稳健性估计方法，从有偏的互动日志中训练出具有情境感知的价值函数，从而准确了解各个智能体的真实边际贡献；(2)在线动态拍卖阶段，智能体根据预测的效用来竞标通信机会。我们将推理时间的选择问题转化为在预算约束下的次模最大化问题，理论上可以通过贪婪策略得到最优联盟解的(1 - 1/e)近似解。实证结果表明，Nash-CredMAS在包括MMMU和V*-Bench在内的复杂基准测试中都取得了领先成果，同时与静态基线相比， tokens的消耗减少了25%以上。该系统自然会收敛到一种经济均衡状态：当某个智能体的边际价值不足以抵消成本时，该智能体会选择保持沉默。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SWE-Mutation: Can LLMs Generate Reliable Test Suites in Software Engineering?
papers.title_zh: SWE-突变：大型语言模型能否在软件工程中生成可靠的测试套件？
papers.authors: Yuxuan Sun, Yuze Zhao, Yufeng Wang, Yao Du, Zhiyuan Ma, Jinbo Wang, Mengdi Zhang, Kai Zhang, Zhenya Huang
papers.abstract: Evaluating software engineering capabilities has become a core component of modern large language models (LLMs); however, the key bottleneck hindering further scaling lies not in the scarcity of high-quality solutions, but in the lack of high-quality test suites. Test suites are indispensable both for synthesizing program repair trajectories and for providing precise feedback signals in reinforcement learning. Unfortunately, due to the high cost and difficulty of annotation, high-quality test suites have long been hard to obtain, while those automatically generated by LLMs tend to be superficial and lack sufficient discriminative power. As a first step toward constructing high-quality test suites, we introduce SWE-Mutation, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-generated test suites. The benchmark characterizes test suites by introducing systematically mutated solutions that attempt to “fool” the test suites and pass validation. We further propose an agentic, language-agnostic framework for automatically generating complex mutants. Our benchmark consists of 2,636 mutated variants derived from 800 original instances and includes a multilingual subset spanning nine programming languages. Experiments on seven LLMs reveal that even DeepSeek-V3.1 achieves only 10.20% verification and 36.15% detection rates, highlighting the inadequacy of current LLMs. Additionally, our agentic mutation strategy enhances realism, reducing average detection rates from 71.04% to 39.81% compared to conventional methods. These findings expose persistent deficiencies in the ability of current LLMs to generate reliable and discriminative test suites.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估软件工程能力已成为现代大语言模型的核心组成部分。然而，阻碍其进一步扩展的关键瓶颈并非高质量解决方案的匮乏，而是高质量测试集的缺失。测试集对于生成程序修复路径以及为强化学习提供精确反馈信号至关重要。不幸的是，由于标注成本高昂且难度巨大，高质量测试集一直难以获得，而由语言模型自动生成的测试集往往不够全面，缺乏足够的区分能力。作为构建高质量测试集的第一步，我们提出了SWE-Mutation这一基准测试，用于评估由语言模型生成的测试集。该基准测试通过引入经过系统变异的解决方案来评价测试集，这些解决方案试图“欺骗”测试集并成功通过验证。我们还提出了一个基于代理的、与语言无关的生成复杂变异体的框架。我们的基准测试包含2,636种从800个原始实例衍生出的变异版本，其中包括涵盖九种编程语言的多语言子集。在七种语言模型上的实验表明，即使是DeepSeek-V3.1模型的验证率也只有10.20%，检测率仅为36.15%，这凸显了当前语言模型的不足。此外，我们的代理变异策略提升了测试集的真实感，平均检测率从71.04%降至39.81%，相比传统方法有了显著提升。这些发现揭示了当前语言模型在生成可靠且具有区分能力的测试集方面的持续缺陷。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: STaD: Scaffolded Task Design for Identifying Compositional Skill Gaps in LLMs
papers.title_zh: STaD：用于识别大型语言模型在复合技能方面差距的任务设计方法
papers.authors: Sungeun An, Swanand Ravindra Kadhe, Shailja Thakur, Chad DeLuca, Hima Patel
papers.abstract: Benchmarks are often used as a standard to understand LLM capabilities in different domains. However, aggregate benchmark scores provide limited insight into compositional skill gaps of LLMs and how to improve them. To make these weaknesses visible, we propose Scaffolded Task Design (STaD) framework. STaD generates controlled variations of benchmark tasks based on the concept of scaffolding, which introduces structured, incremental support in a step-by-step manner. Rather than inspecting failures individually, this approach enables systematic and scalable probing of model behavior by identifying the specific reasoning skill compositions they lack. Treating the LLM as a black box, our experiments on six models of varying sizes reveal multiple failure points in three reasoning benchmarks and highlight each model’s unique and distinct skill gaps.
papers.abstract_zh: 基准测试常被用作了解大语言模型在不同领域能力的标准。然而，单一的基准分数并不能充分揭示大语言模型的组合性技能缺陷以及如何改进这些缺陷。为了揭示这些弱点，我们提出了“支架式任务设计”框架。该框架基于“支架”概念，生成有控制的基准任务变体，以逐步、有序的方式提供支持。这种方法不是单独分析失败案例，而是通过识别模型所缺乏的特定推理技能组合，来系统地、可扩展地探究模型行为。通过将大语言模型视为一个黑盒，我们对六种不同规模的模型进行了实验，发现三个推理基准测试中存在多个缺陷点，并明确了每个模型独特的技能短板。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PseudoSeer: a Search Engine for Pseudocode
papers.title_zh: PseudoSeer：一种用于查找伪代码的相关信息的搜索引擎
papers.authors: Levent Toksoz, Mukund Srinath, Gang Tan, C. Lee Giles
papers.abstract: PseudoSeer is a novel search engine for academic pseudocode, enabling retrieval over 320,000 algorithm implementations extracted from the arXiv. Using the system’s caption-reference pairs, we study asymmetric retrieval, matching short queries with a median length of five words against long documents of roughly 300 words composed primarily of natural language with limited LaTeX notation. Our evaluation reveals scaling limitations in embedding models: a 149M parameter encoder outperforms 1.5B parameter alternatives, while BM25 remains competitive with pretrained models. Analyzing attention patterns over 33,000 caption document pairs, we identify two factors driving these results: attention efficiency and attention concentration. Models that significantly attend to sinks or non-discriminative tokens leave less attention for discriminative content, while models with overly diffuse attention fail to form discriminative representations. Guided by these findings, PseudoSeer’s embedding model, trained via contrastive learning with efficient attention patterns, outperforms the best pretrained model by 8.7 points. A hybrid approach combining learned embeddings with BM25 reaches 66.5% R@10. PseudoSeer is deployed at pseudoseer.ist.psu.edu as both a practical search system and a benchmark for retrieval evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: PseudoSeer是一款用于检索学术伪代码的新颖搜索引擎，能够检索出来自arXiv的32万种算法实现。通过该系统中的标题-文本对，我们研究了非对称检索机制：将长度不超过五个单词的简短查询与由大约300个单词组成的、主要由自然语言构成的文档进行匹配，这些文档中几乎没有LaTeX标记。我们的评估结果显示，嵌入模型的规模存在限制：一个拥有1.49亿参数的编码器性能优于拥有15亿参数的模型；而BM25在性能上仍然可以与预训练模型相媲美。通过对33,000对标题-文本对的分析，我们发现有两个因素决定了这些结果：注意力效率以及注意力集中程度。那些过度关注非关键内容的模型，会减少对关键内容的关注；而注意力分布过于分散的模型则无法形成有效的判别性表示。基于这些发现，PseudoSeer的嵌入模型通过对比学习训练而成，其注意力模式非常高效，其性能比最佳预训练模型高出8.7个百分点。结合学习到的嵌入数据与BM25算法的混合方法，其R@10分数达到了66.5%。PseudoSeer已在pseudoseer.ist.psu.edu平台上部署，既作为实用的搜索系统，也作为检索评估的基准工具。

papers.title: Beyond Polarity: Continuous Affect-Enhanced Multimodal Aspect-Based Sentiment Classification
papers.title_zh: 超越两极分化：持续增强情感感知的多模态基于维度的情感分类
papers.authors: Ling-Ang Meng, Tianyu Zhao, Dawei Song, Jingxu Cao, Youhui Zuo
papers.abstract: Multimodal aspect-based sentiment classification (MABSC) requires aspect-level sentiment inference from textual-image data that jointly convey opinions. Yet most existing approaches primarily exploit discrete polarity patterns and generic visual embeddings, making them less effective when the affect is subtle, implicit, or expressed through imagery. In this work, we propose \textbf{\textit{VADE}}, a Valence–Arousal–Dominance~(\textbf{\textit{VAD}})-\textbf{\textit{E}}nhanced MABSC framework that brings continuous VAD signals into multimodal sentiment reasoning and learns emotion-sensitive image representations. Specifically, we design a VAD encoder to extract continuous affect cues from text for aspect-level sentiment reasoning. Furthermore, we fine-tune a CLIP-based image encoder on affect-enriched image–text pairs to obtain visual representations that are more sensitive to sentiment cues. To support the fine-tuning process, we construct an affect-enriched image–text dataset \textbf{\textit{Senti-COCO}} by rewriting MSCOCO captions with a multimodal large language model, which yields large-scale image-text pairs with richer affective expressions. Experiments on two mainstream datasets, Twitter-15 and Twitter-17, show that VADE achieves a new state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of incorporating VAD signals for MABSC.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态情感分类方法（MABSC）需要从同时传达情感的文本和图像数据中提取情感信息。然而，目前大多数方法主要依赖离散的极性模式和通用的视觉嵌入方式，当情感较为微妙、隐秘或通过图像表达时，这些方法的效果会大打折扣。在本研究中，我们提出了一种名为**VADE**的多模态情感分类框架。该框架结合了情感唤醒度、愉悦度和支配度这三个指标，将连续的情感唤醒度信号融入多模态情感推理中，并学习出对情绪更敏感的图像表示方式。具体来说，我们设计了一个情感唤醒度编码器，用于从文本中提取连续的情感线索，从而进行情感级情感推理。此外，我们还利用基于CLIP的图像编码器，在富含情感信息的图像-文本对上进行微调，以获得对情感线索更为敏感的视觉表示。为了支持这一微调过程，我们通过使用多模态大语言模型重新生成MSCOCO图像文字描述，构建了一个富含情感信息的图像-文本数据集**Senti-COCO**。在Twitter-15和Twitter-17这两个主流数据集上的实验表明，VADE取得了新的最优性能，这充分证明了将情感唤醒度信号纳入多模态情感分类中的有效性。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: Topology Matters: Measuring Memory Leakage in Multi-Agent LLMs
papers.title_zh: 拓扑结构的重要性：在多智能体大语言模型中衡量内存泄漏情况
papers.authors: Jinbo Liu, Defu Cao, Yifei Wei, Tianyao Su, Yuan Liang, Yushun Dong, Yan Liu, Yue Zhao, Xiyang Hu
papers.abstract: Graph topology is a fundamental determinant of memory leakage in multi-agent LLM systems, yet its effects remain poorly quantified. We introduce MAMA (Multi-Agent Memory Attack), a controlled evaluation framework for comparing topology-conditioned memory leakage in multi-agent LLM systems. MAMA operates on synthetic documents containing labeled Personally Identifiable Information (PII) entities, from which we generate sanitized task instructions. We execute a two-phase protocol: Engram (seeding private information into a target agent’s memory) and Resonance (multi-round interaction where an attacker attempts extraction). Over 10 rounds, we measure leakage using a two-stage recovery criterion that combines exact-match extraction with LLM-based inference over the attacker’s final output. We evaluate six canonical topologies (complete, circle, chain, tree, star, star-ring) across n\in\{4,5,6\}, attacker–target placements, and base models. Results are consistent: denser connectivity, shorter attacker–target distance, and higher target centrality increase leakage; most leakage occurs in early rounds and then plateaus; model choice shifts absolute rates but preserves broad structural trends; spatiotemporal/location attributes leak more readily than identity credentials or regulated identifiers. We distill practical guidance for system design: favor sparse or hierarchical connectivity, maximize attacker–target separation, and restrict hub/shortcut pathways via topology-aware access control. Our code is available at https://github.com/llll121/mama-eval.
papers.abstract_zh: 图拓扑结构是多智能体LLM系统中内存泄漏的一个重要决定因素，然而其影响仍然难以量化。我们提出了MAMA（多智能体记忆攻击）这一评估框架，用于比较多智能体LLM系统中受拓扑结构影响的记忆泄漏现象。MAMA基于包含带有个人身份信息标签的合成文档进行操作，从中生成经过处理的任务指令。我们采用两阶段协议：Engram阶段将私人信息植入目标智能体的内存中，随后进入 Resonance阶段，即多轮交互过程，攻击者试图从目标智能体内存中提取信息。在10轮的交互过程中，我们通过结合精确匹配提取和基于LLM的最终输出推理方法来衡量内存泄漏情况。我们测试了六种典型的拓扑结构（完全图、环图、链状图、树状图、星形图、星形环图），并考虑了不同的智能体位置以及基础模型。结果表明：更密集的连接结构、更短的智能体到目标的距离以及更高的目标中心性都会增加内存泄漏的风险；大部分泄漏发生在早期阶段，之后趋于稳定；模型选择会影响泄漏的绝对速率，但会保持整体结构趋势不变；时空/位置属性比身份凭证或受监管标识符更容易泄露。我们为系统设计提供了实用建议：优先选择稀疏或分层式的连接结构，最大化智能体之间的分离距离，并通过考虑拓扑结构的访问控制机制来限制枢纽节点和捷径路径的存在。我们的代码可在https://github.com/llll121/mama-eval下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond ’Aha!’: Toward Systematic Meta-Abilities Alignment in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 超越“啊哈！”：在大型推理模型中实现系统化的元能力对齐
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Hu, Yibo Wang, Hanze Dong, Yuhui Xu, Amrita Saha, Caiming Xiong, Bryan Hooi, Junnan Li
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) already possess a latent capacity for long chain-of-thought reasoning. Prior work has shown that outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) can incidentally elicit advanced reasoning behaviors such as self-correction, backtracking, and verification–phenomena often referred to as the model’s ”aha moment”. However, the timing and consistency of these emergent behaviors remain unpredictable and uncontrollable, limiting the scalability and reliability of LRMs’ reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we move beyond reliance on prompts and unpredictable ”aha moments”. Instead, we explicitly align models with three meta-abilities: deduction, induction, and abduction, using automatically generated, self-verifiable tasks. Our three-stage pipeline (individual alignment, parameter-space merging, domain-specific reinforcement learning) boosts performance by over 10% relative to instruction-tuned baselines. Furthermore, domain-specific RL from the aligned checkpoint yields an additional gain in performance ceiling for both 7B and 32B models across math, coding, and science benchmarks, showing that explicit meta-ability alignment offers a scalable and dependable foundation for reasoning. Code and data can be found in Software and Data part in submission page.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型已经具备进行长链式思维推理的潜在能力。先前的研究表明，基于结果的强化学习能够偶然激发出高级推理行为，如自我修正、回溯和验证——这些现象通常被称为模型的“顿悟时刻”。然而，这些涌现行为的出现时机和一致性仍然难以预测和控制，这限制了大型推理模型推理能力的可扩展性和可靠性。为了克服这些限制，我们不再依赖提示和不可预测的“顿悟时刻”。相反，我们通过使用自动生成的、可自我验证的任务，明确地将模型与三种元能力相结合：演绎、归纳和溯因。我们的三阶段流程（个体对齐、参数空间合并、特定领域的强化学习）使性能相对于指令调优的基线提升了10%以上。此外，从对齐后的检查点进行的特定领域强化学习，使得7B和32B模型在数学、编程和科学基准测试中的性能得到了进一步提升，这表明明确的元能力对齐为推理提供了可扩展且可靠的基础。代码和数据的详细信息可以在提交页面的“软件和数据”部分找到。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rewarding the Rare: Uniqueness-Aware RL for Creative Problem Solving in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 奖励那些稀有之物：专为大型语言模型设计的、注重独特性的强化学习算法，助力创造性问题解决
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Hu, Yucheng Wang, Yufei He, Jiaying Wu, Yilun Zhao, See-Kiong Ng, Cynthia Breazeal, Anh Tuan Luu, Hae Won Park, Bryan Hooi
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a central paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs), particularly for complex reasoning tasks, yet it often suffers from exploration collapse: policies prematurely concentrate on a small set of dominant reasoning patterns, improving pass@1 while limiting rollout-level diversity and gains in pass@k. We argue that this failure stems from regularizing local token behavior rather than diversity over sets of solutions. To address this, we propose Uniqueness-Aware Reinforcement Learning, a rollout-level objective that explicitly rewards correct solutions that exhibit rare high-level strategies. Our method uses an LLM-based judge to cluster rollouts for the same problem according to their high-level solution strategies, ignoring superficial variations, and reweights policy advantages inversely with cluster size. As a result, correct but novel strategies receive higher rewards than redundant ones. Across mathematics, physics, and medical reasoning benchmarks, our approach consistently improves pass@k across large sampling budgets and increases the area under the pass@k curve (AUC@K) without sacrificing pass@1, while sustaining exploration and uncovering more diverse solution strategies at scale. Code is in Software part under submission page.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为训练大语言模型后处理的核心方法，尤其是在复杂的推理任务中。然而，强化学习常常面临探索崩溃的问题：策略会过早地集中在少数几种主导的推理模式上，从而在提升单次正确率的同时，限制了部署阶段的多样性和在多次测试中的性能提升。我们认为，这种失败源于对局部令牌行为的规范化处理，而非对解决方案集合的多样性进行优化。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了“独特性感知强化学习”这一部署级目标，该目标明确奖励那些展现出罕见高级策略的正确解决方案。我们的方法利用基于大语言模型的评估器，根据同一问题的高级解决方案策略对解决方案进行聚类，忽略表面的差异，并将策略优势与聚类规模成反比地重新加权。因此，正确但新颖的策略会比冗余的策略获得更高的奖励。在数学、物理和医学推理等多个基准测试中，我们的方法能够在大规模采样情况下持续提高多次测试正确率，同时在不牺牲单次正确率的情况下，增加多次测试正确率曲线下的面积，同时维持探索性，并在更大规模上发现更多多样化的解决方案策略。相关代码已放在提交页面下的软件部分中。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Empathy Applicability Modeling for General Health Queries
papers.title_zh: 适用于一般健康问题的共情能力建模
papers.authors: Shan Randhawa, Agha Ali Raza, Kentaro Toyama, Julie Hui, Mustafa Naseem
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly being integrated into clinical workflows, yet they often lack clinical empathy, an essential aspect of effective doctor–patient communication. Existing NLP frameworks focus on reactively labeling empathy in doctors’ responses but offer limited support for anticipatory modeling of empathy needs, especially in general health queries. We introduce the Empathy Applicability Framework (EAF), a theory-driven approach that classifies patient queries in terms of the applicability of emotional reactions and interpretations, based on clinical, contextual, and linguistic cues. We release a benchmark of real patient queries, dual-annotated by human annotators and GPT-4o. In the subset with human consensus, we also observe substantial human–GPT alignment. To validate EAF, we train classifiers on human-labeled and GPT-only annotations to predict empathy applicability, achieving strong performance and outperforming the heuristic and zero-shot LLM baselines. Error analysis highlights persistent challenges: implicit distress, clinical-severity ambiguity, and contextual hardship, underscoring the need for multi-annotator modeling, clinician-in-the-loop calibration, and culturally diverse annotation. EAF provides a framework for identifying empathy needs before response generation, establishes a benchmark for anticipatory empathy modeling, and enables supporting empathetic communication in asynchronous healthcare.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被整合到临床工作流程中，但它们往往缺乏临床同理心，而这是有效医患沟通的重要方面。现有的自然语言处理框架主要集中在对医生回应中的同理心进行反应性标注上，但在预测同理心需求方面支持有限，尤其是在处理一般健康相关问题时。我们提出了“同理心适用性框架”这一理论驱动的方法，该方法根据临床、上下文和语言线索，将患者问题分类为具有不同情感反应和解释适用性的问题。我们发布了一个真实患者问题的基准数据集，该数据集由人类注释者和GPT-4o共同进行了双标注。在获得人类共识的子集上，我们还观察到人类注释者与GPT-4o之间存在显著的一致性。为了验证该框架的有效性，我们在人类标记和仅GPT注释的数据上进行分类器训练，以预测同理心的适用性，取得了良好的性能，并优于启发式和零样本大语言模型基线模型。错误分析揭示了几个持续存在的挑战：隐性痛苦、临床严重程度的模糊性以及上下文中的困难因素，这凸显了需要多注释者建模、临床人员参与校准以及文化多样性注释的需求。该框架为在生成回应之前识别同理心需求提供了工具，为预测性同理心建模建立了基准，并使异步医疗环境中的同理心沟通成为可能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Worldwide LiveVQA: Real-Time Visual Knowledge Seeking and Updating Across Languages
papers.title_zh: 全球实时视觉知识检索与更新：跨语言应用的技术实践
papers.authors: Xuanao Huang, Xingjia Liu, Zetong Zhou, Yuyang Peng, Yao Wan, Dongping Chen
papers.abstract: Knowledge about the visual world is not only constantly evolving but also inherently happening all over the world: breaking news in Tokyo, political events in São Paulo, and cultural phenomena in Cairo are first reported in Japanese, Portuguese, and Arabic, carrying regional context that English-centric resources cannot fully capture. Yet existing resources for visual knowledge remain confined to English, creating a “Worldwide Knowledge Gap” that hinders developing truly global assistants. To quantify this gap, we introduce LiveVQA-W(orldwide), the first dynamic-updating dataset for real-time, multilingual visual knowledge seeking and updating across ten major languages. Drawing from worldwide news outlets, YouTube videos, and academic platforms during August–December 2025, LiveVQA-W comprises 234K images, 873K questions, and 171K visual entities with hierarchical evaluation: Level 1 for visual entity recognition and Level 2 for multi-hop cross-lingual reasoning. Our comprehensive benchmarking of 15 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that models without search achieve near-random performance, while search-augmented models exhibit severe linguistic bias, with English accuracy nearly double that of other languages. Furthermore, we explore visual knowledge updating through large-scale training, finding that injected knowledge improves recall but remains fragile under prompt rephrasing and image perturbations such as rotation and flipping. We release the fully replicable data collection pipeline and raw dataset to support continuous community-driven expansion. The benchmark, code, and related resources are available at: https://worldwide-livevqa.github.io.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于视觉世界的知识不仅在不断演变，而且在全球范围内同时发生：东京的突发新闻、圣保罗的政治事件以及开罗的文化现象，首先以日语、葡萄牙语和阿拉伯语进行报道，这些报道包含了英语主导资源无法完全捕捉的区域背景信息。然而，现有的视觉知识资源仍然局限于英语，这就造成了“全球知识差距”，从而阻碍了真正具有全球性的智能助手的发展。为了量化这一差距，我们推出了LiveVQA-W，这是第一个用于实时多语言视觉知识检索与更新的动态更新数据集，支持十种主要语言。该数据集收集了2025年8月至12月期间来自全球新闻机构、YouTube视频以及学术平台的数据，包含234,000张图片、873,000个问题以及171,000个视觉实体，并采用了分层评估机制：一级用于视觉实体的识别，二级则用于跨语言的推理。我们对15种最先进的MLLM模型进行了全面测试，发现没有搜索功能的模型性能接近随机水平，而带有搜索功能的模型则表现出严重的语言偏见，其英语模型的准确率几乎是所有语言的两倍。此外，我们还通过大规模训练探索了视觉知识的更新方式，发现注入的知识可以提高召回率，但在重新表述prompt或处理旋转、翻转等图像扰动时，效果仍然不稳定。我们提供了完全可复制的数据收集流程和原始数据集，以支持社区持续扩展该数据集。相关的基准测试、代码及资源均可在此处获取：https://worldwide-livevqa.github.io
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: HCRE: LLM-based Hierarchical Classification for Cross-Document Relation Extraction with a Prediction-then-Verification Strategy
papers.title_zh: HCRE：基于大语言模型的层次化分类方法，用于跨文档关系提取任务，采用预测优先、验证为辅的策略
papers.authors: Guoqi Ma, Liang Zhang, Hongyao Tu, Hao Fu, Hui Li, Yujie Lin, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Jinsong Su
papers.abstract: Cross-document relation extraction (RE) aims to identify relations between the head and tail entities located in different documents. Existing approaches typically adopt the paradigm of “Small Language Model (SLM) + Classifier”. However, the limited language understanding ability of SLMs hinders further improvement of their performance. In this paper, we conduct a preliminary study to explore the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in cross-document RE. Despite their extensive parameters, our findings indicate that LLMs do not consistently surpass existing SLMs. Further analysis suggests that the underperformance is largely attributed to the challenges posed by the numerous predefined relations. To overcome this issue, we propose an LLM-based Hierarchical Classification model for cross-document RE (HCRE), which consists of two core components: 1) an LLM for relation prediction and 2) a hierarchical relation tree derived from the predefined relation set. This tree enables the LLM to perform hierarchical classification, where the target relation is inferred level by level. Since the number of child nodes is much smaller than the size of entire predefined relation set, the hierarchical relation tree significantly reduces the number of relation options that LLM needs to consider during inference. However, hierarchical classification introduces the risk of error propagation across levels. To mitigate this, we propose a prediction-then-verification inference strategy that improves prediction reliability through multi-view verification at each level. Extensive experiments show that HCRE outperforms existing baselines, validating its effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨文档关系提取（RE）的目的是识别位于不同文档中的头部实体和尾部实体之间的关系。现有的方法通常采用“小语言模型（SLM）+分类器”的范式。然而，SLM有限的语言理解能力限制了它们的性能提升。在本文中，我们进行了初步研究，以探讨大语言模型（LLM）在跨文档RE中的性能表现。尽管LLM具有丰富的参数，但我们的研究发现表明，LLM并不能始终超越现有的SLM。进一步分析表明，这种性能不佳主要源于大量预定义关系带来的挑战。为了克服这个问题，我们提出了一种基于LLM的跨文档RE分层分类模型（HCRE），该模型由两个核心组件组成：1）用于关系预测的LLM；2）从预定义关系集中派生出的分层关系树。这个关系树使得LLM能够执行分层分类，从而逐层推断出目标关系。由于子节点的数量远小于整个预定义关系集的大小，因此分层关系树显著减少了LLM在推理过程中需要考虑的关系选项数量。不过，分层分类也带来了错误传播的风险。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种预测-验证相结合的推理策略，通过在每个层次上进行多视图验证来提高预测的可靠性。广泛的实验表明，HCRE的性能优于现有的基线方法，这验证了其有效性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: VLMGuard-R1: Proactive Safety Alignment for VLMs via Reasoning-Driven Prompt Optimization
papers.title_zh: VLMGuard-R1：通过基于推理的提示优化来实现VLM的主动安全适配
papers.authors: Menglan Chen, Xianghe Pang, Jingjing Dong, WenHao Wang, Yaxin Du, Siheng Chen
papers.abstract: Aligning Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with safety standards is essential to mitigate risks arising from their multimodal complexity, where integrating vision and language unveils subtle threats beyond the reach of conventional safeguards. Inspired by the insight that reasoning across modalities is key to preempting intricate vulnerabilities, we propose a novel direction for VLM safety: multimodal reasoning-driven prompt rewriting. To this end, we introduce VLMGuard-R1, a proactive framework that refines user inputs through a reasoning-guided rewriter, dynamically interpreting text-image interactions to deliver refined prompts that bolster safety across diverse VLM architectures without altering their core parameters. To achieve this, we devise a three-stage reasoning pipeline to synthesize a dataset that trains the rewriter to infer subtle threats, enabling tailored, actionable responses over generic refusals. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks with six VLMs reveal that VLMGuard-R1 outperforms four baselines. In particular, VLMGuard-R1 achieves a remarkable 43.59% increase in average safety across five models on the SIUO benchmark.
papers.abstract_zh: 将视觉语言模型与安全标准相结合，对于减轻其多模态复杂性带来的风险至关重要。在整合视觉和语言功能时，会发现一些传统安全措施难以察觉的细微威胁。基于跨模态推理在预防复杂漏洞中的关键作用这一理念，我们提出了一种针对视觉语言模型安全性的新方法：由多模态推理驱动的提示重写。为此，我们开发了VLMGuard-R1这一主动式框架，它通过一个基于推理的重写器来优化用户输入，动态解析文本与图像的互动关系，从而生成更安全的提示，同时无需修改模型的核心参数。为了实现这一目标，我们设计了一个三阶段的推理流程，以训练重写器识别细微的威胁，从而能够针对特定情况给出有针对性的响应，而非仅仅给出通用的拒绝反馈。在五个基准测试中对六种视觉语言模型进行了广泛实验，结果表明VLMGuard-R1的表现优于其他四个基线方法。特别是在SIUO基准测试中，VLMGuard-R1使五种模型的平均安全性提升了43.59%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TinyAttack: Exploring Stylistic Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: TinyAttack：探索大型语言模型中的风格化漏洞
papers.authors: Mamta Mamta, Bogdan Grecu, Oana Cocarascu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive results in natural language processing (NLP) tasks, however, their brittleness against subtle input perturbations continues to pose a significant challenge. Existing research on robustness has predominantly focused on standard text-based perturbations and the use of invisible characters and homoglyphs, while overlooking the impact of stylized characters increasingly prevalent on social media. To address this, we propose TinyAttack, a novel adversarial attack framework designed to exploit vulnerabilities in LLMs through Unicode-based stylistic transformations. TinyAttack utilises five Unicode variants to modify the visual rendering of text without altering its underlying semantic or syntactic structure. Our comprehensive evaluation on both open-source (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen) and closed-source LLMs (Gemini, GPT) demonstrates their susceptibility to these stylized inputs, with performance drops ranging from 29-92% and 6-88.5%, respectively, across all tasks.Our code is available at https://github.com/TRAI-group/TinyAttack.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在自然语言处理任务中取得了令人瞩目的成果，然而，它们对细微输入变化的脆弱性仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的关于鲁棒性的研究主要集中在标准的文本扰动上，以及使用不可见字符和相似字符的现象上，而忽视了社交媒体上日益流行的风格化字符所带来的影响。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了TinyAttack这一新型对抗性攻击框架，该框架通过基于Unicode的风格化处理来利用语言模型中的漏洞。TinyAttack利用五种Unicode变体来修改文本的视觉呈现形式，而不改变其基本的语义或句法结构。我们对开源语言模型（如Llama、Mistral、Gemma、Qwen）和闭源语言模型（如Gemini、GPT）进行的全面评估表明，这些模型对这些风格化输入非常敏感，所有任务的性能下降幅度分别达到了29%-92%和6%-88.5%。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/TRAI-group/TinyAttack下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Human-Agent Collaborative Paper-to-Page Crafting
papers.title_zh: 人类与智能体协作式的逐页创作机制
papers.authors: Qianli Ma, Siyu Wang, Chen Yilin, Yinhao Tang, Yixiang Yang, Chang Guo, Bingjie Gao, Zhening Xing, Yanan Sun, Zhipeng Zhang
papers.abstract: In the quest for scientific progress, communicating research is as vital as the discovery itself. Yet, researchers are often sidetracked by the manual, repetitive chore of building project webpages to make their dense papers accessible. While automation has tackled static slides and posters, the dynamic, interactive nature of webpages has remained an unaddressed challenge. To bridge this gap, we reframe the problem, arguing that the solution lies not in a single command, but in a collaborative, hierarchical process. We introduce \textbf{AutoPage}, a novel multi-agent system that embodies this philosophy. AutoPage deconstructs paper-to-page creation into a coarse-to-fine pipeline from narrative planning to multimodal content generation and interactive rendering. To combat AI hallucination, dedicated “Checker” agents verify each step against the source paper, while optional human checkpoints ensure the final product aligns perfectly with the author’s vision, transforming the system from a mere tool into a powerful collaborative assistant. To rigorously validate our approach, we also construct \textbf{PageBench}, the first benchmark for this new task. Experiments show AutoPage not only generates high-quality, visually appealing pages but does so with remarkable efficiency in under 15 minutes for less than $0.1. Code and data will be released.
papers.abstract_zh: 在追求科学进步的道路上，研究成果的传达与发现本身同样重要。然而，研究人员常常被构建项目网页这一繁琐的工作所困扰，这些网页需要帮助他们让复杂的论文更加易于理解。虽然自动化技术已经能够处理静态幻灯片和海报，但网页的动态性和交互性仍然是一个未解决的难题。为了填补这一空白，我们重新定义了问题所在，认为解决方案并不在于单一的命令，而在于一个协作性的、分层的流程。我们推出了**AutoPage**，这是一个全新的多智能体系统，它体现了这种理念。AutoPage将论文到页面的创建过程分解为从叙事规划到多模态内容生成以及交互式渲染的逐步流程。为了应对人工智能产生的幻觉问题，系统配备了专门的“检查器”智能体，它们会逐一验证每个步骤是否符合原始论文的内容；同时，人工检查环节则确保最终产品完全符合作者的设想。这样一来，该系统就从一个简单的工具转变为了一个强大的协作助手。为了严格验证我们的方法，我们还构建了**PageBench**，这是针对这一新任务的第一个基准测试。实验表明，AutoPage不仅能够生成高质量、视觉上吸引人的页面，而且其生成效率极高，在不到15分钟的时间内就能完成，成本还不到0.1美元。相关的代码和数据将会被公开提供。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Skill Weaving: Efficient LLM Improvement via Modular Skillpacks
papers.title_zh: 技能编织：通过模块化技能包实现LLM的高效优化
papers.authors: Zhuo Li, Guodong DU, Zesheng Shi, Weiyang Guo, Weijun Yao, Yuan Zhou, Jiabo Zhang, Jing Li
papers.abstract: In this work, we introduce SkillWeave, a modular improvement framework that enables large language models to specialize under fixed memory budgets. SkillWeave partitions full capabilities of a general-purpose model into domain-specific skillpacks—lightweight, domain-specific delta modules—that reorganize and refine the model’s internal knowledge. To ensure deployment efficiency, SkillWeave incorporates SkillZip, a compression component that transforms specialized parameters into lightweight, inference-ready skillpacks. Together, these components allow SkillWeave to achieve strong multi-domain performance and inference-efficient execution. On multi-task and agentic benchmarks, a 9B SkillWeave model outperforms task-specific baselines and even surpasses a 32B monolithic LLM, while achieving up to 4× speedup.
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，我们提出了SkillWeave这一模块化改进框架。该框架使得大语言模型能够在固定的内存预算下实现特定领域的专攻。SkillWeave将通用模型的全部能力分解为特定领域的技能包——这些轻量级、针对特定领域的模块能够重新组织并优化模型的内部知识。为了确保部署效率，SkillWeave还包含了SkillZip压缩组件，该组件能够将专门化的参数转换为轻量级、适用于推理的技能包。通过这些组件的协同作用，SkillWeave能够实现强大的多领域性能以及高效的推理执行。在多项多任务和智能体基准测试中，一个拥有90亿个参数的SkillWeave模型表现优于特定任务的基线模型，甚至超过了拥有320亿参数的单体LLM，同时其运行速度也提高了4倍。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Controlling What You Share: Assessing Language Model Adherence to Privacy Preferences
papers.title_zh: 控制你所分享的内容：评估语言模型对隐私设置的遵守情况
papers.authors: Guillem Ramírez, Alexandra Birch, Ivan Titov
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are primarily accessed via commercial APIs, but this often requires users to expose their data to service providers. In this paper, we explore how users can stay in control of their data by using privacy profiles: simple natural language instructions that say what should and should not be revealed. We build a framework where a local model uses these instructions to rewrite queries, only hiding details deemed sensitive by the user, before sending them to an external model, thus balancing privacy with performance. To support this research, we introduce PEEP, a multilingual dataset of real user queries annotated to mark private content and paired with synthetic privacy profiles, alongside PROFIT, a training procedure that enables effective and efficient use of the pipeline. Experiments with lightweight local LLMs show that, after training, they not only achieve markedly better privacy preservation but also match or exceed the performance of much larger few-shot models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型主要通过商业API进行访问，但这通常要求用户将其数据暴露给服务提供商。在本文中，我们探讨了用户如何通过使用隐私配置文件来掌控自己的数据：这些配置文件是简单的自然语言指令，明确指出了哪些信息应该被公开，哪些不应该。我们构建了一个框架，其中本地模型利用这些指令来重写查询语句，只隐藏用户认为敏感的信息，然后再将这些信息发送给外部模型。这样既能保证隐私性，又能提升性能。为了支持这项研究，我们引入了PEEP这一多语言数据集，该数据集包含真实用户查询语句，并标注了私密内容，同时还提供了合成隐私配置文件。此外，我们还提出了PROFIT训练方法，该方法能够使得模型的训练过程既有效又高效。通过对轻量级本地语言模型进行的实验表明，经过训练后，这些模型不仅实现了更出色的隐私保护效果，其性能甚至可以与那些规模更大的少样本模型相媲美或超越它们。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: GerAV: Towards New Heights in German Authorship Verification using Fine-Tuned LLMs on a New Benchmark
papers.title_zh: GerAV：利用经过微调的大型语言模型在新的基准测试上实现德语作者身份验证的突破
papers.authors: Lotta Kiefer, Christoph Leiter, Sotaro Takeshita, Elena Schmidt, Steffen Eger
papers.abstract: Authorship verification (AV) is the task of determining whether two texts were written by the same author and has been studied extensively, predominantly for English data. In contrast, large-scale benchmarks and systematic evaluations for other languages remain scarce. We address this gap by introducing GerAV, a comprehensive benchmark for German AV comprising over 400k labeled text pairs. GerAV is built from Twitter and Reddit data, with the Reddit part further divided into in-domain and cross-domain message-based subsets, as well as a profile-based subset. This design enables controlled analysis of the effects of data source, topical domain, and text length. Using the provided training splits, we conduct a systematic evaluation of strong baselines and state-of-the-art models and find that our best approach, a fine-tuned large language model, outperforms recent baselines by up to 0.09 absolute F1 score and surpasses GPT-5 in a zero-shot setting by 0.08. We further observe a trade-off between specialization and generalization: models trained on specific data types perform best under matching conditions but generalize less well across data regimes, a limitation that can be mitigated by combining training sources. Overall, GerAV provides a challenging and versatile benchmark for advancing research on German and cross-domain AV.
papers.abstract_zh: 作者身份验证是确定两段文本是否由同一作者撰写的任务，这一领域已经得到了广泛的研究，主要针对英语文本。相比之下，其他语言的大规模基准测试和系统评估仍然较为稀缺。我们为了解决这个问题，推出了GerAV——一个针对德语作者身份验证的综合性基准测试平台，该平台包含超过40万对标注过的文本对。GerAV的数据来源于Twitter和Reddit，其中Reddit部分进一步分为领域内和跨领域消息基础子集，以及一个基于个人特征的子集。这种设计使得我们可以有针对性地分析数据来源、主题领域以及文本长度对验证效果的影响。通过提供的训练数据划分，我们对强大的基准模型和最先进的模型进行了系统的评估，发现我们的最佳方法——一种经过微调的大语言模型——在绝对F1评分上比最近的基准模型高出0.09分，并且在零样本情况下比GPT-5高出0.08分。我们还观察到，模型在专门化与泛化能力之间存在权衡：在匹配条件下，基于特定类型数据的模型表现最好，但在不同数据类型之间则泛化能力较差。不过，通过结合不同的训练数据源，可以缓解这个问题。总体而言，GerAV为推进德语及跨领域作者身份验证研究提供了一个具有挑战性且功能丰富的基准平台。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LipoAgent: Coordinating Fine-Tuned LLM Agents for Safer Lipid Design
papers.title_zh: LipoAgent：协调优化过的大型语言模型代理，以实现更安全的脂质设计
papers.authors: Leshu Li, An Lu, Haiyu Wang, Zhibin Feng, Conghui Duan, Qing Bao, Zongmin Zhao, Sai Qian Zhang
papers.abstract: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) are among the most clinically mature platforms for nucleic acid delivery, yet designing lipids that are both effective and biologically safe remains a major bottleneck. In practical screening, toxicity is a decision-level constraint: if a lipid is toxic, its efficiency prediction is clinically irrelevant. We propose LipoAgent , a safety-aware multi-agent LLM framework for lipid discovery. LipoAgent combines domain-specific fine-tuning with a conditional prediction objective that enforces toxicity as a prerequisite for efficiency prediction, and further improves reliability via multi-agent verification with lightweight human oversight when disagreement persists. Across multiple foundation models, LipoAgent achieves an average 32% relative improvement in mRNA transfection efficiency prediction compared with other reported models for lipid design. Wet-lab validation confirms that virtual screening rankings reliably translate to biological transfection outcomes. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/SAI-Lab-NYU/LipoAgent.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 脂质纳米颗粒（LNPs）是核酸递送领域中最成熟的技术平台之一，然而，设计出既有效又具有生物安全性的脂质仍然是一个重大挑战。在实际筛选过程中，毒性是一个至关重要的限制因素：如果某种脂质具有毒性，那么其效率预测就毫无临床意义。我们提出了LipoAgent这一基于多智能体大语言模型的安全性评估框架，用于脂质发现。LipoAgent结合了特定领域的精细调优机制，同时设定了条件性预测目标，将毒性作为效率预测的前提条件。当存在分歧时，通过多智能体验证以及简单的人工监督，可以提高预测的可靠性。在多个基础模型上测试表明，与现有的其他脂质设计模型相比，LipoAgent在mRNA转染效率预测方面平均提升了32%的准确率。实验室验证结果表明，虚拟筛选的结果能够可靠地转化为实际的生物转染效果。该代码的下载链接为：https://github.com/SAI-Lab-NYU/LipoAgent.git
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: PsychePass: Calibrating LLM Therapeutic Competence via Trajectory-Anchored Tournaments
papers.title_zh: PsychePass：通过以轨迹为基准的比赛来校准大型语言模型的治疗能力
papers.authors: Zhuang Chen, Dazhen Wan, Zhangkai Zheng, Guanqun Bi, Xiyao Xiao, Binghang Li, Minlie Huang
papers.abstract: While large language models show promise in mental healthcare, evaluating their therapeutic competence remains challenging due to the unstructured and longitudinal nature of counseling. We argue that current evaluation paradigms suffer from an unanchored defect, leading to two forms of instability: process drift, where unsteered client simulation wanders away from specific counseling goals, and standard drift, where static pointwise scoring lacks the stability for reliable judgment. To address this, we introduce Ps, a unified framework that calibrates the therapeutic competence of LLMs via trajectory-anchored tournaments. We first anchor the interaction trajectory in simulation, where clients precisely control the fluid consultation process to probe multifaceted capabilities. We then anchor the battle trajectory in judgments through an efficient Swiss-system tournament, utilizing dynamic pairwise battles to yield robust Elo ratings. Beyond ranking, we demonstrate that tournament trajectories can be transformed into credible reward signals, enabling on-policy reinforcement learning to enhance LLMs’ performance. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of PsychePass and its strong consistency with human expert judgments.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型在心理健康领域展现出巨大潜力，但由于咨询过程具有非结构化和长期性的特点，对其治疗能力的评估仍然面临挑战。我们认为，当前的评估方法存在缺乏基准的问题，从而导致两种不稳定现象：过程漂移，即未经引导的客户模拟行为会偏离特定的咨询目标；标准漂移，即静态的点对点评分缺乏稳定性，无法做出可靠的判断。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Ps这一统一框架，通过基于轨迹的比赛来校准大语言模型的治疗能力。我们首先在模拟环境中固定交互轨迹，让客户能够精确控制咨询过程，从而探究其多方面的能力。然后，我们通过高效的瑞士系统比赛来固定评判轨迹，利用动态的对战方式得出可靠的Elo评分。除了排名功能外，我们还证明了比赛轨迹可以转化为可信的奖励信号，从而实现基于策略的强化学习，提升大语言模型的性能。大量的实验验证了PsychePass的有效性，以及其与人类专家判断之间的高度一致性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Generalization or Memorization? Multi-Agent vs. Baseline LLMs and AutoML Models for Tabular Classification
papers.title_zh: 泛化与记忆？多智能体模型与基准大语言模型在表格分类任务中的对比——结合自动机器学习模型的解决方案
papers.authors: Aida Sanatizadeh, Sorouralsadat Fatemi, Reza Mousavi, Ahmed Abbasi
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for structured tabular data, yet it remains unclear whether their performance reflects genuine reasoning or memorization of pre-training corpora. We investigate this question through a rigorous, contamination-aware evaluation of a representative modular Multi-Agent LLM (MALLM) framework against state-of-the-art AutoML systems and established baselines (TABLET, TABLLM). We evaluate eleven binary classification tasks: five pre-cutoff benchmarks likely seen during LLM pre-training and six post-cutoff datasets released after the LLM knowledge cutoff. Results show a sharp performance dichotomy: MALLM achieves competitive or superior performance on pre-cutoff datasets but substantially underperforms AutoML on post-cutoff data, exhibiting poor calibration and high variance, especially on hard-to-classify instances. By contrast, AutoML models generalize consistently and align confidence more closely with instance hardness. These findings suggest that, despite agentic scaffolding, current LLMs cannot yet replace production-grade discriminative models for tabular classification, underscoring the need for contamination-free benchmarks to accurately assess tabular reasoning capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在结构化表格数据中的应用越来越广泛，但尚不清楚它们的性能究竟是反映了对预训练语料库的真正推理能力，还是仅仅依赖于记忆。我们通过对一个代表性的模块化多智能体语言模型框架进行严格的、考虑污染因素的评估，来研究这个问题。该模型框架与最先进的自动机器学习系统和成熟的基准测试（如TABLET、TABLLM）进行了对比。我们评估了十一个二元分类任务：其中五个是预截断基准测试，这些测试可能在语言模型预训练过程中就已经出现；另外六个则是预训练完成后发布的截断后数据集。结果表明，两种模型的性能存在明显的差异：MALLM在预截断数据集上取得了具有竞争力的或更好的性能，但在截断后数据上的表现则明显不如自动机器学习模型，其校准效果较差，且方差较大，尤其是在难以分类的实例上。相比之下，自动机器学习模型能够持续进行泛化处理，并且其置信度与实例的复杂性更为匹配。这些发现表明，尽管有了智能体辅助机制，当前的语言模型仍然无法替代用于表格分类的成熟判别模型，这进一步强调了需要无污染基准测试来准确评估表格推理能力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: GanitLLM: Difficulty-Aware Bengali Mathematical Reasoning through Curriculum-GRPO
papers.title_zh: GanitLLM：基于难度感知的孟加拉语数学推理课程——GRPO
papers.authors: Shubhashis Roy Dipta, Khairul Mahbub, Nadia Najjar
papers.abstract: We present a Bengali mathematical reasoning model called GanitLLM (named after the Bangla word for mathematics, “Ganit”), together with a new difficulty-aware Bengali math corpus and a curriculum-based GRPO pipeline. Bengali is one of the world’s most widely spoken languages, yet existing LLMs either reason in English and then translate, or simply fail on multi-step Bengali math, in part because reinforcement learning recipes are tuned for high-resource languages and collapse under reward sparsity in low-resource settings. To address this, we construct Ganit, a rigorously filtered and decontaminated Bengali math dataset with automatic difficulty tags derived from the pass@k of a strong evaluator model. Building on this dataset, we propose Curriculum-GRPO, which combines multi-stage training (SFT + GRPO) with difficulty-aware sampling and verifiable rewards for format, numerical correctness, and Bengali reasoning. On Bn-MGSM and Bn-MSVAMP, GanitLLM-4B improves over its Qwen3-4B base by +8 and +7 accuracy points, respectively, while increasing the percentage of Bengali reasoning tokens from 14% to over 88% and reducing average solution length from 943 to 193 words.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种名为GanitLLM的孟加拉语数学推理模型（该名称源自孟加拉语中的“数学”一词“Ganit”），同时还开发了一个新的、具备难度感知能力的孟加拉语数学数据集，以及一套基于课程结构的GRPO训练流程。孟加拉语是世界上使用最广泛的语言之一，然而现有的大语言模型要么用英语进行推理后再进行翻译，要么在处理多步骤孟加拉语数学问题时表现不佳。部分原因是强化学习算法通常适用于资源丰富的语言，而在资源匮乏的环境中则会因奖励稀疏性而失效。为了解决这一问题，我们构建了Ganit这一经过严格筛选和去污染处理的数据集，该数据集包含自动生成的难度标签，这些标签来自一个强大的评估模型的pass@k指标。在此基础上，我们提出了Curriculum-GRPO方法，该方法结合了多阶段训练（SFT + GRPO）、难度感知采样机制，以及针对格式、数值正确性以及孟加拉语推理的可验证奖励机制。在Bn-MGSM和Bn-MSVAMP任务上，GanitLLM-4B在准确率上分别比其基础版本Qwen3-4B提高了8点和7点，同时将孟加拉语推理的占比从14%提升到了88%以上，同时平均解决方案的长度也从943字减少到了193字。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Can MLLMs Reason Beyond Language? VisReason: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Vision-Centric Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 机器学习模型能否超越语言进行推理？VisReason：一种针对视觉中心性推理的综合性基准测试平台
papers.authors: Longteng Guo, Yifan Wang, Pengkang Huo, Tailai Chen, Yuze Wu, Jing Liu, Xinxin Zhu
papers.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on visual reasoning benchmarks, yet it remains unclear to what extent such performance reflects reasoning directly grounded in visual evidence. We introduce VisReason, a benchmark for vision-centric reasoning in everyday scenarios where perception and inference are tightly coupled. VisReason contains 1,505 questions across 10 categories spanning perceptual, structural, and conceptual reasoning. Our evaluation shows that VisReason poses a qualitatively different challenge from existing benchmarks, exposing substantial gaps between humans and current MLLMs and revealing limited benefits from test-time reasoning strategies. VisReason offers a focused diagnostic for evaluating vision-centric reasoning beyond language.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的多模态大语言模型在视觉推理基准测试中取得了出色的性能，但尚不清楚这种性能在多大程度上直接反映了基于视觉证据的推理能力。我们提出了VisReason这一基准测试，用于评估在日常场景中以视觉为中心的推理能力，这些场景中的感知与推理是紧密相连的。VisReason包含1,505个问题，涵盖感知、结构和概念推理等多个领域。我们的评估结果显示，VisReason所面临的挑战与现有基准测试截然不同，它揭示了人类与当前大语言模型之间的巨大差距，同时也表明在测试阶段的推理策略所带来的优势有限。VisReason为评估超越语言的视觉中心性推理能力提供了一个有效的工具。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Multimodal Dual-Path Decoding for Medical Report Generation
papers.title_zh: 用于医疗报告生成的多模态双路径解码技术
papers.authors: Jinghan Sun, Dong Wei, Zhihong Zhu, Yuyang Xue, Steven McDonagh, Xian Wu
papers.abstract: Radiology report generation requires precise alignment between medical imaging findings and clinically coherent textual descriptions. While current methods predominantly rely on either large vision-language models (LVLMs) for visual grounding or large language models (LLMs) for medical narrative generation, they often fail to effectively integrate multimodal clinical evidence with domain-specific knowledge. This paper proposes a novel multimodal dual-path framework that synergistically combines LVLMs and LLMs to address these limitations. Our approach establishes a dynamic fusion between LVLMs’ visual-semantic grounding capabilities and LLMs’ clinical knowledge reasoning. Specifically, we employ a structured prompting strategy that models the report generation task into three clinically meaningful sections and introduces fine-grained multi-label classification prompts to guide the models, enabling more accurate and comprehensive clinical report generation. Experiments on the public MIMIC-CXR benchmark demonstrate our framework’s superiority over state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 放射学报告生成需要医学影像结果与临床相关文本描述之间的精确对齐。目前的方法主要依赖大型视觉-语言模型进行视觉定位，或依赖大语言模型进行医学叙述生成，但这些方法往往无法有效将多模态临床证据与特定领域的知识相结合。本文提出了一种新颖的多模态双路径框架，该框架通过协同利用大型视觉-语言模型和大语言模型来克服这些限制。我们的方法实现了大型视觉-语言模型的视觉语义定位能力与大语言模型的临床知识推理能力的动态融合。具体来说，我们采用了一种结构化的提示策略，将报告生成任务分解为三个具有临床意义的部分，并引入细粒度的多标签分类提示来指导模型运行，从而实现更准确、全面的临床报告生成。在公开的MIMIC-CXR基准测试上的实验表明，我们的框架优于现有最先进的方法。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PanoramaRAG: Enabling Consistent Global Topic Awareness in Graph-Based RAG
papers.title_zh: PanoramaRAG：在基于图的RAG中实现全球主题信息的统一识别
papers.authors: Ding Deng, Xiang Li, Yaqing Zhang, Meng Li, Xiting Wang
papers.abstract: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which models relationships between fine-grained semantic units as a graph, effectively facilitates multi-hop reasoning to enhance large language model generation. However, its design focuses on local relationships, resulting in suboptimal performance for tasks that require global context, and the separation of query refinement from indexing limits the system’s ability to capture high-level implicit relationships within the graph. This paper proposes a Panorama-guided RAG paradigm (PanoramaRAG) that integrates a light yet comprehensive “panorama” of the corpus to guide all stages of the retrieval process. This hub bridges the knowledge graph, language models, and queries in a computationally efficient manner, applicable to both open-source and closed-source models. Experimental results demonstrate that our method exhibits strong performance across five datasets and a variety of tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于图的检索增强生成（RAG）通过将细粒度的语义单元建模为图结构，有效促进了多跳推理，从而提升了大语言模型的生成能力。然而，该方法的设计主要关注局部关系，导致在处理需要全局上下文的任务时性能不佳。此外，查询细化与索引的分离限制了系统捕捉图中高级隐含关系的能力。本文提出了一种全景引导的RAG范式（PanoramaRAG），该范式整合了简洁而全面的“全景”信息，以指导检索过程的各个阶段。这一枢纽能够以高效的方式连接知识图谱、语言模型和查询，适用于开源和闭源模型。实验结果表明，我们的方法在五个数据集和多种任务中均表现出强大的性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Universally Empowering Zeroth-Order Optimization via Adaptive Layer-wise Sampling
papers.title_zh: 通过自适应分层采样技术，实现全局性的零阶优化问题求解
papers.authors: Fei Wang, Li Shen, Liang Ding, Chao Xue, Ye Liu, Changxing Ding
papers.abstract: Zeroth-Order optimization presents a promising memory-efficient paradigm for fine-tuning Large Language Models by relying solely on forward passes. However, its practical adoption is severely constrained by slow wall-clock convergence and high estimation variance. In this work, we dissect the runtime characteristics of ZO algorithms and identify a critical system bottleneck where the generation of perturbations and parameter updates accounts for over 40% of the training latency. We argue that the standard uniform exploration strategy is fundamentally flawed as it fails to account for the heterogeneous sensitivity of layers in deep networks, resulting in computationally wasteful blind searches. To address this structural mismatch, we propose AdaLeZO, an Adaptive Layer-wise ZO optimization framework. By formulating the layer selection process as a non-stationary Multi-Armed Bandit problem, AdaLeZO dynamically allocates the limited perturbation budget to the most sensitive parameters.We further introduce an Inverse Probability Weighting mechanism based on sampling with replacement, which guarantees unbiased gradient estimation while effectively acting as a temporal denoiser to reduce variance. Extensive experiments on LLaMA and OPT models ranging from 6.7B to 30B parameters demonstrate that AdaLeZO achieves 1.7\times to 3.0\times wall-clock acceleration compared to state-of-the-art methods. Crucially, AdaLeZO functions as a universal plug-and-play module that seamlessly enhances the efficiency of existing ZO optimizers without incurring additional memory overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 零阶优化是一种具有前景的内存高效方法，它仅通过前向传播来微调大语言模型。然而，其实际应用受到缓慢的时钟收敛速度和高估计方差的严重限制。在这项研究中，我们分析了零阶优化算法的运行时间特性，并发现了一个关键的系统瓶颈：生成扰动和参数更新的过程占训练时长的40%以上。我们认为，传统的均匀探索策略存在根本缺陷，因为它无法考虑到深度网络中各层的异质敏感性，从而导致计算上的浪费和盲目搜索。为了解决这一结构性问题，我们提出了AdaLeZO——一种自适应层级零阶优化框架。通过将层选择过程建模为非平稳的多臂老虎机问题，AdaLeZO能够动态地将有限的扰动预算分配给最敏感的参数。我们还引入了一种基于替换抽样的逆概率加权机制，该机制能够确保无偏的梯度估计，同时有效地减少方差。在从67亿到300亿参数的LLaMA和OPT模型上进行的广泛实验表明，与现有最先进方法相比，AdaLeZO实现了1.7倍到3.0倍的时钟加速效果。重要的是，AdaLeZO可以作为一个通用的即插即用模块，无需增加额外的内存开销，就能显著提升现有零阶优化器的效率。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Speculative Decoding with a Speculative Vocabulary
papers.title_zh: 基于推测性词汇表的推测性解码
papers.authors: Miles Williams, Young D. Kwon, Rui Li, Alexandros Kouris, Stylianos I. Venieris
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has rapidly emerged as a leading approach for accelerating language model (LM) inference, as it offers substantial speedups while yielding identical outputs. This relies upon a small draft model, tasked with predicting the outputs of the target model. State-of-the-art speculative decoding methods use a draft model comprising a single decoder layer and output embedding matrix, with the latter dominating drafting time for the latest LMs. Recent work has sought to address this output distribution bottleneck by reducing the vocabulary of the draft model. While this can improve throughput, it compromises speculation effectiveness when the target token is out-of-vocabulary. In this paper, we argue for vocabulary speculation as an alternative to a reduced vocabulary. We propose SpecVocab, an efficient and effective method that selects a vocabulary subset per decoding step. Across a variety of tasks, we show that SpecVocab can achieve a higher acceptance length than state-of-the-art speculative decoding method, EAGLE-3. Notably, this yields up to an 8.1% increase in average throughput over EAGLE-3.
papers.abstract_zh: 推测性解码作为一种加速语言模型推理的方法，已经迅速成为主流技术。这种方法能够在保持相同输出结果的同时，显著提升推理速度。其原理基于一个小型的草稿模型，该模型负责预测目标模型的输出结果。目前最先进的推测性解码方法采用由单个解码层构成的草稿模型，而输出嵌入矩阵则主导了草稿模型的构建过程，这使得最新语言模型的推理速度得到极大提升。最近的研究试图通过减少草稿模型的词汇量来解决输出分布方面的瓶颈问题。虽然这种方法可以提高吞吐量，但在目标令牌不在词汇表中时，推测性的效果会大打折扣。在本文中，我们提出了使用词汇推测作为减少词汇量的替代方案。我们提出了SpecVocab这一高效有效的算法，它能够在每个解码步骤中选择一个特定的词汇子集。在多种任务中，我们发现SpecVocab的接受长度比最先进的推测性解码方法EAGLE-3要长，平均吞吐量也提高了8.1%。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Entropy-Aware Reshaping of Reinforcement Signals for Multi-Answer Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 基于熵效应的强化信号重塑方法，适用于多答案推理场景
papers.authors: Zhi Li, Huidan Xu, Zhen Hu, Yali Du, Ying Liu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a standard post-training paradigm for large language models (LLMs), typically relying on group-wise reward and advantage normalization for stability. In set-valued multi-answer tasks, where multiple outputs may be simultaneously correct, this normalization can over-amplify a small number of early high-reward samples, suppressing learning signals from other valid generations and leading to overly concentrated updates. We propose Entropy-Aware Reshaping of Reinforcement Signals (EARS), a framework that reshapes how learning signals are normalized and aggregated. EARS uses token-level predictive entropy as an uncertainty cue to compute entropy-weighted reward statistics for advantage normalization, encouraging broader exploration and more balanced learning-signal allocation early in training. An adaptive decay schedule then anneals uncertainty-aware reweighting back to standard group normalization to ensure stable convergence. EARS further incorporates a correctness-gated multi-head process reward that provides auxiliary supervision on reasoning traces while remaining aligned with verifiable correctness. Experiments on MCTACO and MMLU-Multi using Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct demonstrate consistent improvements in exact-set accuracy, training stability, and cross-dataset transfer performance on set-valued multi-answer reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是大语言模型训练后的标准方法，通常采用按组进行奖励和优势归一化来保持稳定性。在集值多答案任务中，多个输出可能同时正确，这种归一化方式会过度放大少数早期高奖励样本的影响，从而抑制其他有效生成的信号，导致更新过于集中。我们提出了一种名为“熵感知的强化信号重塑”的方法（EARS），该框架改变了学习信号的归一化和聚合方式。EARS利用令牌级别的预测熵作为不确定性线索，来计算基于熵的奖励统计信息，以用于优势归一化，从而促进更广泛的探索以及在训练初期更均衡的学习信号分配。随后，通过自适应衰减机制，将这种具有不确定性感知的重新加权方式恢复到标准的按组归一化方式，以确保稳定的收敛。EARS还引入了一种基于正确性的多头过程奖励机制，为推理过程提供辅助监督，同时保持与可验证的正确性一致。在MCTACO和MMLU-Multi任务上，使用Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型进行了实验，结果显示在集值多答案推理方面，精确集准确率、训练稳定性和跨数据集迁移性能均得到了持续改善。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: TripTide: A Benchmark for Adaptive Travel Planning under Disruptions
papers.title_zh: TripTide：在突发事件情况下进行适应性旅行规划的一个基准模型
papers.authors: Priyanshu Karmakar, Soumyabrata Chaudhuri, Shubhojit Mallick, Manish Gupta, Abhik Jana, Shreya Ghosh
papers.abstract: Recent work, such as TripCraft and TravelPlanner, has shown the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) for personalized, constraint-aware travel itinerary generation. However, real-world travel often involves disruptions such as transit cancellations, weather-related closures, or overbooked attractions. To address this gap, we introduce TripTide, the first benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of LLMs to revise travel itineraries under realistic disruptions.TripTide models both disruption severity and traveler tolerance, enabling systematic evaluation of how LLMs respond to unexpected travel events. The benchmark simulates scenarios where existing itineraries must be revised while preserving the traveler’s original intent and respecting practical constraints. We conduct a three-fold evaluation of itinerary revision quality: (i) Automatic metrics measuring Preservation of Intent, Responsiveness, and Adaptability (semantic, spatial, and sequential), (ii) LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation assessing the quality and plausibility of revised itineraries and (iii) Human evaluation examining overall revision quality and user satisfaction.Our findings show that LLMs generally preserve semantic intent and sequential structure, while spatial deviations are more pronounced in shorter itineraries and diminish for longer ones. However, the ability to handle disruptions degrades as itinerary length increases, highlighting limitations in long-horizon itinerary revision. The TripTide benchmark provides a foundation for systematically evaluating robustness and adaptability in LLM-based travel planning systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的一些研究，如TripCraft和TravelPlanner，表明大语言模型在生成个性化且考虑约束条件的旅行路线方面具有巨大潜力。然而，现实中的旅行常常会受到各种干扰，比如交通取消、天气导致的景点关闭或景点人满为患等问题。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了TripTide这个基准测试，旨在评估大语言模型在面临实际干扰时修改旅行路线的能力。TripTide模型同时考虑了干扰的严重程度和旅行者的容忍度，从而能够系统地评估大语言模型对意外旅行事件的反应。该基准测试模拟了需要修改现有旅行路线的场景，同时保留旅行者原有的意图并遵守实际限制条件。我们对旅行路线修改的质量进行了三重评估：(i) 自动评估指标，包括意图保留程度、响应速度和适应性（语义、空间和时间上的）；(ii) 由大语言模型作为评判者的评估，以判断修改后的旅行路线的质量和合理性；(iii) 人工评估，用于检查整体修改质量和用户满意度。我们的研究发现，大语言模型通常能够保留语义意图和时间顺序结构，而在较短的旅行路线中，空间上的偏差更为明显，而在较长的旅行路线中则有所减少。不过，随着旅行路线长度的增加，处理干扰的能力会下降，这凸显了长周期旅行路线修改的局限性。TripTide基准测试为系统评估基于大语言模型的旅行规划系统的鲁棒性和适应性提供了基础。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rational Synthesizers or Heuristic Followers? Analyzing LLMs in RAG-based Question-Answering
papers.title_zh: 理性合成器还是启发式追随者？分析基于RAG技术的问答系统中的大型语言模型
papers.authors: Atharv Naphade
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is the prevailing paradigm for grounding Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the mechanisms governing \textit{how} models integrate groups of conflicting retrieved evidence remain opaque. Does an LLM answer a certain way because the evidence is factually strong, because of a prior belief, or merely because it is repeated frequently? To answer this, we introduce \textbf{GroupQA}, a curated dataset of 1,635 controversial questions paired with 15,058 diversely-sourced evidence documents, annotated for stance and qualitative strength. Through controlled experiments, we characterize group-level evidence aggregation dynamics: Paraphrasing an argument can be more persuasive than providing distinct independent support; Models favor evidence presented first rather than last, and Larger models are increasingly resistant to adapt to presented evidence. Additionally, we find that LLM explanations to group-based answers are unfaithful. Together, we show that LLMs behave consistently as vulnerable heuristic followers, with direct implications for improving RAG system design.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）是支撑大语言模型（LLMs）运行的主流技术，然而，模型如何整合那些相互矛盾的检索到的证据，其具体机制仍然不清楚。一个LLM之所以以某种方式回答问题，是因为相关证据具有事实上的说服力？还是因为先前的信念？又或者仅仅是因为这些证据被频繁重复出现？为了解答这个问题，我们引入了一个名为**GroupQA**的数据集，该数据集包含1,635个有争议的问题，以及15,058份来自不同来源的证据文档，这些文档都标注了立场和定性强度。通过控制实验，我们研究了群体层面的证据聚合机制：改写论点可能比提供独立的支持更具说服力；模型更倾向于优先处理最先呈现的证据，而非最后呈现的证据；而且，较大的模型对新出现的证据的适应性越来越差。此外，我们发现LLM对基于群体的问题的解释往往不够准确。总的来说，我们发现LLM的行为具有一致性，它们都是易受启发式的引导，这一发现对于改进RAG系统的设计具有重要意义。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: IDEA: An Interpretable and Editable Decision-Making Framework for LLMs via Verbal-to-Numeric Calibration
papers.title_zh: IDEA：一种可解释且可编辑的决策框架，适用于大型语言模型——通过文字与数字之间的转换来实现校准功能
papers.authors: Yanji He, Yuxin Jiang, Yiwen Wu, Bo Huang, Jiaheng Wei, Wei Wang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed for decision-making, yet their adoption in high-stakes domains remains limited by miscalibrated probabilities, unfaithful explanations, and inability to incorporate expert knowledge precisely. We propose IDEA, a framework that extracts LLM decision knowledge into an interpretable parametric model over semantically meaningful factors. Through joint learning of verbal-to-numerical mappings and decision parameters via EM, correlated sampling that preserves factor dependencies, and direct parameter editing with mathematical guarantees, IDEA produces calibrated probabilities while enabling quantitative human-AI collaboration. Experiments across five datasets show IDEA with Qwen-3-32B (78.6%) outperforms DeepSeek R1 (68.1%) and GPT-5.2 (77.9%), achieving perfect factor exclusion and exact calibration—precision unattainable through prompting alone.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在决策过程中得到了越来越多的应用，然而其在高风险领域的应用仍然受到误校准概率、不准确的解释以及无法准确整合专家知识等因素的限制。我们提出了IDEA框架，该框架能够将LLM的决策知识提取为可解释的参数化模型，这些模型基于具有语义意义的因素构建。通过联合学习从文字到数字的映射关系以及决策参数，利用保持因素依赖性的相关采样方法，再加上带有数学保证的直接参数编辑操作，IDEA能够生成校准后的概率分布，从而实现人与AI之间的定量协作。在五个数据集上的实验表明，使用IDEA框架的Qwen-3-32B模型（78.6%）的表现优于DeepSeek R1（68.1%）和GPT-5.2（77.9%）。IDEA能够实现完美的因素排除和精确校准——这种精度是单纯使用提示语无法达到的。

papers.title: An Answer is just the Start: Related Insight Generation for Open-Ended Document-Grounded QA
papers.title_zh: 回答仅仅是个开始：针对开放式文档基础问答问题，进一步产生相关见解
papers.authors: Saransh Sharma, Pritika Ramu, Aparna Garimella, Koyel Mukherjee
papers.abstract: Answering open-ended questions remains challenging for AI systems because it requires synthesis, judgment, and exploration beyond factual retrieval, and users often refine answers through multiple iterations rather than accepting a single response. Existing QA benchmarks do not explicitly support this refinement process. To address this gap, we introduce a new task, document-grounded related insight generation, where the goal is to generate additional insights from a document collection that help improve, extend, or rethink an initial answer to an open-ended question, ultimately supporting richer user interaction and a better overall question answering experience. We curate and release SCOpE-QA (Scientific Collections for Open-Ended QA), a dataset of 3,000 open-ended questions across 20 research collections. We present InsightGen, a two-stage approach that first constructs a thematic representation of the document collection using clustering, and then selects related context based on neighborhood selection from the thematic graph to generate diverse and relevant insights using LLMs. Extensive evaluation on 3,000 questions using two generation models and two evaluation settings shows that InsightGen consistently produces useful, relevant, and actionable insights, establishing a strong baseline for this new task.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于人工智能系统来说，回答开放式问题仍然具有挑战性，因为这需要超越单纯事实检索的综合性、判断力和探索能力。用户通常会通过多次迭代来完善答案，而不是接受单一的回应。现有的问答基准测试并未明确支持这种完善过程。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新的任务——基于文档的相关见解生成。该任务的目标是从文档集合中生成额外的见解，以改进、扩展或重新思考对开放式问题的初始回答，从而提供更丰富的用户交互体验以及更好的问答效果。我们整理并发布了SCOpE-QA数据集，该数据集包含3000个开放式问题，涉及20个研究领域。我们提出了InsightGen这一两阶段方法：首先使用聚类技术对文档集合进行主题化处理，然后基于主题图上的邻域选择，从相关上下文中提取信息，利用大语言模型生成多样化且相关的见解。通过对3000个问题进行广泛评估，使用两种生成模型和两种评估方式，我们发现InsightGen能够持续产生有用、相关且可操作的见解，为这项新任务奠定了坚实的基础。

papers.title: Behavioral Consistency Validation for LLM Agents: An Analysis of Trading-Style Switching through Stock-Market Simulation
papers.title_zh: 针对大型语言模型代理的行为一致性验证：通过股票市场模拟分析交易策略的切换行为
papers.authors: Zeping Li, Guancheng Wan, Keyang Chen, Yu Chen, Yiwen Zhao, Philip Torr, Guangnan Ye, Zhenfei Yin, Hongfeng Chai
papers.abstract: Recent works have increasingly applied Large Language Models (LLMs) as agents in financial stock market simulations to test if micro-level behaviors aggregate into macro-level phenomena. However, a crucial question arises: Do LLM agents’ behaviors align with real market participants? This alignment is key to the validity of simulation results. To explore this, we select a financial stock market scenario to test behavioral consistency. Investors are typically classified as fundamental or technical traders, but most simulations fix strategies at initialization, failing to reflect real-world trading dynamics. In this work, we assess whether agents’ strategy switching aligns with financial theory, providing a framework for this evaluation. We operationalize four behavioral-finance drivers—loss aversion, herding, wealth differentiation, and price misalignment—as personality traits set via prompting and stored long-term. In year-long simulations, agents process daily price-volume data, trade under a designated style, and reassess their strategy every 10 trading days. We introduce four alignment metrics and use Mann–Whitney U tests to compare agents’ style-switching behavior with financial theory. Our results show that recent LLMs’ switching behavior is only partially consistent with behavioral-finance theories, highlighting the need for further refinement in aligning agent behavior with financial theory.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究越来越多地将大语言模型作为代理应用于金融股市模拟中，以测试微观层面的行为是否会聚合为宏观现象。然而，一个关键问题出现了：语言模型代理的行为是否与真实的市场参与者一致？这种一致性对于模拟结果的可靠性至关重要。为了探索这个问题，我们选择了一个金融股市场景来测试行为的连贯性。投资者通常被分为基本面交易者和技术型交易者，但大多数模拟在初始化时就已经确定了策略，这无法反映现实中的交易动态。在这项研究中，我们评估了代理的策略切换是否与金融理论相符，并为这一评估提供了一个框架。我们将四个行为-金融驱动因素——损失厌恶、羊群效应、财富差异和价格不一致性——作为通过提示设定的个性特征，并长期存储这些特征。在为期一年的模拟过程中，代理处理每日的价格和成交量数据，按照指定的风格进行交易，并且每10个交易日重新评估一次自己的策略。我们引入了四个一致性指标，并使用曼-惠特尼U检验来比较代理的风格切换行为与金融理论之间的吻合程度。我们的结果显示，最近的语言模型在风格切换行为上仅部分符合行为-金融理论，这凸显了需要进一步改进，以使代理行为与金融理论更加一致。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: NITI: Neural Plan Concretization for Incremental Execution, Bridging and Trigger Inference from Underspecified Human Policies
papers.title_zh: NITI：神经计划的具体实施方法，用于逐步执行任务、连接不同模块以及根据未明确说明的人类行为策略进行推理
papers.authors: Ayan Banerjee, Shomrik Barua Banerjee, Sandeep Gupta
papers.abstract: Human decision-making in safety-critical domains is governed by abstract policies that intentionally omit exhaustive preconditions/ triggers and contingencies. Executing such underspecified policies reliably in open-world settings remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs). We introduce NITI, Neural Bridging for Incremental Execution and Trigger Inference from Underspecified Human Policies, a neuro-symbolic framework that treats LLMs not as autonomous planners, but as execution-time concretizers of human intent. NITI incrementally executes abstract policies via verifier-grounded interfaces, infers implicit applicability conditions, repairs execution through neural bridging when assumptions fail, and halts safely under state inconsistency. We evaluate NITI on two structurally distinct embodied domains: a new benchmark of World Cubing Championship 2×2 Rubik’s Cube scrambles (n=50) and a safety-critical automated insulin dosing task. Across multiple frontier LLMs, NITI enables reliable long-horizon execution without task-specific training or search with minimal contextualization infence overhead, substantially outperforming one-shot and chain-of-thought baselines. Our results show that compositional, verifier-grounded execution is essential for safe human–AI collaboration in open-world decision-making. Code and benchmark available here - https://github.com/ImpactLabASU/ACLNITI
papers.abstract_zh: 在关键安全领域中的人类决策过程，是由一些抽象策略所主导的。这些策略故意省略了所有必要的前提条件、触发因素以及各种可能性。在开放世界中可靠地执行这些缺乏明确规定的策略，仍然是大语言模型面临的一个基本挑战。我们提出了NITI这一框架——神经桥接用于逐步执行和推断来自不明确的人类策略。该框架将大语言模型视为执行时的人类意图的具体化工具，而非自主规划器。NITI通过基于验证器的接口来逐步执行抽象策略，推断隐含的适用性条件，在假设不成立时通过神经桥接来修复执行流程，并在状态不一致的情况下安全地停止操作。我们在两个结构不同的领域对NITI进行了评估：一个是World Cubing锦标赛2×2魔方解谜任务的新基准测试（共50个案例），另一个是关键安全的自动胰岛素剂量任务。在多个前沿大语言模型中，NITI能够在不需要进行特定任务训练或搜索的情况下，实现可靠的长期执行能力，其性能明显优于一次性推理和思维链基线的表现。我们的结果表明，组合式、基于验证器的执行方式对于开放世界中的人类与人工智能之间的安全协作至关重要。相关代码和基准测试可在此处获取：https://github.com/ImpactLabASU/ACLNITI

papers.title: Automatic Combination of Sample Selection Strategies for Few-Shot Learning
papers.title_zh: 样本选择策略的自动组合方法，适用于少样本学习场景
papers.authors: Branislav Pecher, Ivan Srba, Maria Bielikova, Joaquin Vanschoren
papers.abstract: In few-shot learning, the selection of samples has a significant impact on the performance of the model. While effective sample selection strategies are well-established in supervised settings, research on large language models largely overlooks them, favouring strategies specifically tailored to individual in-context learning settings. In this paper, we propose a new method for Automatic Combination of SamplE Selection Strategies (ACSESS) to leverage the strengths and complementarity of various well-established selection objectives. We investigate and compare the impact of 23 sample selection strategies on the performance of 5 in-context learning models and 3 few-shot learning approaches (meta-learning, few-shot fine-tuning) over 6 text and 8 image datasets. The experimental results show that the combination of strategies through the ACSESS method consistently outperforms all individual selection strategies and performs on par or exceeds the in-context learning specific baselines. Lastly, we demonstrate that sample selection remains effective even on smaller datasets, yielding the greatest benefits when only a few shots are selected, while its advantage diminishes as the number of shots increases.
papers.abstract_zh: 在少样本学习中，样本的选择对模型性能有着显著的影响。虽然有效的样本选择策略在监督学习场景中已经得到了很好的研究，但针对大语言模型的研究却大多忽略了这些策略，而更倾向于采用专门为特定上下文学习场景量身定制的策略。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“自动组合样本选择策略”的新方法，该方法能够充分利用各种成熟选择策略的优势和互补性。我们对23种样本选择策略对5种上下文学习模型和3种少样本学习方法（元学习、少样本微调）在6个文本数据集和8个图像数据集上的性能影响进行了研究和比较。实验结果表明，通过ACSESS方法组合使用的策略始终优于所有单独的选择策略，其性能与特定的上下文学习基准相比表现相当甚至更好。最后，我们发现即使在较小的数据集上，样本选择仍然非常有效，当只选择少量样本时，其效果最为显著；而当样本数量增加时，其优势则逐渐减弱。

papers.title: LearnAlign: Data Selection for LLM Reinforcement Learning with Improved Gradient Alignment
papers.title_zh: LearnAlign：用于LLM强化学习的数据选择方法，能够实现更有效的梯度对齐
papers.authors: Shipeng Li, Zhiqin Yang, Shikun Li, Xiaobo Xia, Hengyu Liu, Xinghua Zhang, Gaode Chen, Dong Fang, Ying Tai, Zhe Peng
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a key technique for enhancing LLMs’ reasoning abilities, yet its data inefficiency remains a major bottleneck. To address this critical yet challenging issue, we present a novel gradient-alignment-based method, named LearnAlign, which intelligently selects the learnable and representative training reasoning data for RLVR post-training. To overcome the well-known response-length bias in gradient norms, we introduce the data learnability based on the success rate, which indicates the learning potential of each data point. Experiments across five reasoning benchmarks show that our method significantly reduces training data requirements while achieving minor performance degradation or even improving performance compared to full-data training. Specifically, it reduces data requirements by up to 1,000 data points with better performance (77.5%) than that on the full dataset on the GSM8K benchmark (77.0%). Furthermore, its efficiency is demonstrated on both mathematical and code benchmarks by using much less data from the DAPO-MATH-17K dataset.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的关键技术，但其数据效率低下仍然是一个主要瓶颈。为了解决这一关键而具有挑战性的问题，我们提出了一种名为LearnAlign的新方法。该方法能够智能地选择适合进行RLVR训练的、具有代表性的训练数据。为了克服梯度范数中的响应长度偏差问题，我们引入了基于成功率的 데이터可学习性指标，该指标能够反映每个数据点的学习潜力。在五个推理基准测试中的实验表明，我们的方法显著降低了训练数据的需求，同时实现了较小的性能下降，甚至在某些情况下提升了性能。具体来说，与全数据集训练相比，我们的方法最多可减少1000个数据点的需求，并且性能表现更好（77.5%），而在GSM8K基准测试中，其性能达到了77.0%。此外，通过使用较少的数据，我们在DAPO-MATH-17K数据集上证明了该方法的效率。

papers.title: Auditing LLM Responses to Harmful Stereotypes Targeting Mental Health Groups
papers.title_zh: 对针对心理健康群体的有害刻板印象的大型语言模型反应的审计
papers.authors: Arka Dutta, Rijul Magu, Sean Kim, Seohee Yoon, Munmun De Choudhury, Ashiqur R. KhudaBukhsh
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can exhibit imbalanced biases against vulnerable groups, but how they rationalize stereotypes and rights restrictions targeting mental health entities remains underexplored. We audit a broad suite of open-weight LLMs on stereotype-justification prompts tied to mental health identities. We find that several widely used models endorse harmful stereotypes when explicitly asked to justify them, with endorsement varying across model families, versions, and mental health conditions. Finally, we show that widely used harmful-content evaluation and moderation frameworks often miss these nuanced, discriminatory responses, highlighting a gap in current AI safety evaluation for mental health groups.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可能会表现出对弱势群体的不平衡偏见，但它们如何为针对心理健康领域的刻板印象和权利限制进行合理化解释，目前仍缺乏深入研究。我们对一系列开放式的LLM在涉及心理健康身份的刻板印象相关提示下的行为进行了分析。我们发现，当被明确要求为这些刻板印象提供理由时，许多常用的模型都会支持有害的刻板印象，而且这种支持程度因模型类型、版本以及所涉及的心理健康状况而异。此外，我们还发现，常用的有害内容评估与监管框架往往无法捕捉到这些细微的歧视性反应，这凸显了当前人工智能在心理健康领域的安全评估存在不足。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ROSCO-Omni: Multimodal LLM-Based Communication Understanding for Non- and Minimally-Speaking Autistic Individuals
papers.title_zh: ROSCO-Omni：基于多模态大语言模型的沟通理解系统，适用于非说话者型以及极少说话的自闭症患者
papers.authors: Siddhant Bikram Shah, Kristina T. Johnson
papers.abstract: Approximately 30% of autistic individuals remain non- or minimally-speaking throughout their lives, yet communicate richly through gestures, vocalizations, facial expressions, and augmentative devices. Interpreting this communication is an inherently multimodal task: caregivers rely on the simultaneous integration of visual cues, auditory signals, and contextual understanding to infer intent. Despite this natural alignment with multimodal large language models (MLLMs), research in this intersection remains narrowly focused on diagnosis rather than communication understanding. We address this gap by reframing the problem around two complementary dimensions: communicative actions (the physical modality) and communicative functions (the pragmatic intent). We analyze the ROSCO dataset, containing 2,903 caregiver-annotated video samples from 27 non- and minimally-speaking individuals, with multi-label annotations capturing up to three concurrent actions and two functions per sample across 6 action and 6 function classes. We further propose ROSCO-Omni, a teacher-student distillation framework that generates label-guided instruction data from a high-capability teacher MLLM and uses it to finetune a student MLLM for domain-specialized inference. ROSCO-Omni achieves performance comparable to closed-source models, demonstrating that open-source MLLMs can be adapted to understand communication in this underserved population.
papers.abstract_zh: 大约30%的自闭症患者在一生中仍然不会说话或只能进行极少量的语言交流。然而，他们通过手势、发声、面部表情以及辅助设备来进行丰富的沟通。解读这种沟通方式本质上是一项多模态任务：护理人员需要同时整合视觉线索、听觉信号以及上下文信息来推断对方的意图。尽管这与多模态大语言模型的应用方式非常契合，但相关研究往往只专注于诊断方面，而忽略了沟通理解层面的研究。我们试图通过从两个互补的维度来重新定义这个问题：沟通行为（物理层面）和沟通功能（语用意图）。我们分析了ROSCO数据集，该数据集包含2,903个由护理人员标注的视频样本，这些样本来自27名不会说话或只能进行少量语言交流的患者。每个样本中有多达三个同时发生的动作和两个功能，涵盖了6种动作类别和6种功能类别。我们还提出了ROSCO-Omni框架，这是一种师生蒸馏框架，它能够从高性能的教师大语言模型中生成带有标签的指导数据，并利用这些数据来微调适用于特定领域的学生大语言模型。ROSCO-Omni的表现与闭源模型相当，这表明开源大语言模型也可以被用来理解这一群体的沟通需求。

papers.title: LQM: Linguistically Motivated Multidimensional Quality Metrics for Machine Translation
papers.title_zh: LQM：基于语言特性的多维度机器翻译质量评估指标
papers.authors: Samar M. Magdy, Fakhraddin Alwajih, Abdellah El Mekki, Wesam El Sayed, Muhammad Abdul-Mageed
papers.abstract: Existing MT evaluation frameworks, including automatic metrics and human evaluation schemes such as Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM), are largely language-agnostic. However, they often fail to capture dialect- and culture-specific errors in diglossic languages (e.g., Arabic), where translation failures stem from mismatches in language variety, content coverage, and pragmatic appropriateness rather than surface form alone.We introduce LQM: Linguistically Motivated Multidimensional Quality Metrics for MT. LQM is a hierarchical error taxonomy for diagnosing MT errors through six linguistically grounded levels: sociolinguistics, pragmatics, semantics, morphosyntax, orthography, and graphetics (Figure 1).We construct a bidirectional parallel corpus of 3,850 sentences (550 per variety) spanning seven Arabic dialects (Egyptian, Emirati, Jordanian, Mauritanian, Moroccan, Palestinian, and Yemeni), derived from conversational, culturally rich content. We evaluate six LLMs in a zero-shot setting and conduct expert span-level human annotation using LQM, producing 6,113 labeled error spans across 3,495 unique erroneous sentences, along with severity-weighted quality scores. We complement this analysis with an automatic metric (spBLEU). Though validated here on Arabic, LQM is a language-agnostic framework designed to be easily applied to or adapted for other languages. LQM annotated errors data, prompts, and annotation guidelines are publicly available at https://github.com/UBC-NLP/LQM_MT
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的机器翻译评估框架，包括自动评估指标和人工评估方法，如多维质量指标，基本上都是与语言无关的。然而，这些框架往往无法捕捉到双语环境中的方言和文化特异性错误（例如阿拉伯语），因为翻译失败的原因在于语言变体、内容覆盖以及语用恰当性方面的不匹配，而不仅仅是表面形式上的差异。我们提出了LQM：基于语言的多维质量指标模型。LQM是一种分层式的错误分类体系，通过六个基于语言的层次来诊断机器翻译中的错误：社会语言学、语用学、语义学、形态句法、正字法和词汇层面（见图1）。我们构建了一个包含3,850个句子的双向平行语料库，每个语言变体有550个句子，这些句子来自七种阿拉伯方言的对话内容，且这些内容具有丰富的文化特色。我们在零样本环境下对六款大语言模型进行了评估，并使用LQM对专家标注的跨语言错误进行了标注，最终得到了6,113个带有标签的错误片段，以及对应的严重程度加权质量评分。我们还使用了一个自动评估指标（spBLEU）来补充这一分析。虽然LQM目前仅在阿拉伯语上得到了验证，但它是一个与语言无关的框架，可以轻松应用于其他语言或对其进行调整。LQM的标注数据、提示以及标注指南可以在https://github.com/UBC-NLP/LQM_MT上获取。

papers.title: Many-Shot Scaling of In-Context Learning with Self-Generated Demonstrations
papers.title_zh: 基于自生成示范的上下文学习中的多样本缩放技术
papers.authors: Zhengyao Gu, Henry Peng Zou, Yankai Chen, Aiwei Liu, Weizhi Zhang, Philip S. Yu
papers.abstract: The high cost of obtaining high-quality annotated data for in-context learning (ICL) has motivated the development of methods that use self-generated annotations in place of ground truth labels. While these approaches have shown promising results in few-shot settings, they generally do not scale to many-shot scenarios. In this work, we study ICL with self-generated examples using a framework analogous to traditional semi-supervised learning, consisting of annotation generation, demonstration selection, and in-context inference. Within this framework, we propose a simple baseline that outperforms ground truth ICL under zero-shot, few-shot, and many-shot settings. Notably, we observe consistent scaling behaviors with respect to the number of self-annotated demonstrations. To further extract performance from this many-shot capability, we introduce IterPSD, an iterative self-annotation approach that integrates iterative refinement and curriculum pseudo-labeling techniques from semi-supervised learning, yielding up to 6.8% additional gains on classification tasks. Motivated by our baseline and IterPSD results, we demonstrate that semi-supervised ICL offers a promising avenue for future ICL research.
papers.abstract_zh: 获取用于上下文学习的高质量注释数据的高昂成本，促使人们开发使用自生成注释来代替真实标签的方法。虽然这些方法在少量样本的情况下取得了令人满意的结果，但它们通常无法适用于大量样本的场景。在这项研究中，我们采用类似于传统半监督学习的框架来研究使用自生成示例的上下文学习，该框架包括注释生成、示范选择以及上下文推理等环节。在这个框架下，我们提出了一种简单的基线方法，该方法在零样本、少量样本和大量样本的情况下都能优于基于真实标签的上下文学习。值得注意的是，我们发现随着自注释示范数量的增加，性能表现仍然保持稳定。为了进一步发挥这种大量样本下的能力，我们引入了IterPSD这一迭代自注释方法，该方法结合了半监督学习中的迭代精炼和课程式伪标记技术，使得分类任务的性能提升了高达6.8%。基于我们的基线和IterPSD的结果，我们认为半监督上下文学习为未来的上下文学习研究提供了广阔的前景。
