papers.title: Small Data, Big Noise: Adversarial Training for Robust ParameterEfficient Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 小数据，大影响：用于稳健参数高效微调的对抗性训练方法
papers.authors: Eitan Cohen, Idan Simai, Uri Shaham
papers.abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become essential for adapting foundation models to downstream NLP tasks. However, current PEFT methods often struggle with robustness to noise and performance degradation on limited training data. We propose SDBN (Small Data Big Noise), a unified framework that brings adversarial training to PEFT - a combination that remains less studied in the PEFT setting despite its complementary strengths - to enhance model robustness and generalization, outperforming alternative approaches. We also introduce two variants of the method that use discrete uncertainty sets: SDBN-h, which enumerates character-level edits and selects worst-case variants using gradients, and SDBN-p, which uses LLM-generated variants for robust optimization in generative tasks. Experiments across multiple benchmarks reveal substantial improvements, particularly in low-resource settings and under both word-level and character-level corruptions. This framework addresses the less explored intersection of adversarial training and parameter-efficient adaptation, without introducing additional parameters or only modest computational overhead, making PEFT deployments more reliable in real-world scenarios where data scarcity and linguistic variability often coexist.
papers.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）已成为使基础模型适应下游自然语言处理任务的关键技术。然而，当前的PEFT方法往往难以应对噪声的干扰以及在有限训练数据下的性能下降问题。我们提出了SDBN（小数据大噪声）这一统一框架，它将对抗性训练与PEFT相结合——尽管这种组合在PEFT领域尚未得到充分研究，但确实具有互补的优势，能够提升模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力，并优于其他替代方法。我们还引入了两种使用该方法的变体：SDBN-h，它枚举了字符级别的编辑方式，并通过梯度选择最糟糕的变体进行优化；而SDBN-p则利用LLM生成的变体来进行生成任务的鲁棒优化。在多个基准测试中的实验表明，该框架取得了显著的改进，尤其是在资源匮乏的情况下，无论是在单词级别还是字符级别的错误情况下。这个框架解决了对抗性训练与参数高效适配之间尚未被充分探索的结合点问题，同时不会引入额外的参数或仅带来适度的计算开销，使得PEFT在实际场景中能够更加可靠地应用，因为现实世界中的数据稀缺性和语言多样性问题常常同时存在。

papers.title: LLMs as Lab Engineers: A Benchmark for Analytical Method Lifecycle Management
papers.title_zh: 作为实验室工程师的大型语言模型：分析方法生命周期管理的基准
papers.authors: Xiaoyi Chen, Mahsa Monshizadeh, Chaoqi Zhang, Jianjun Lang, Yang Wu, Genevieve Mortensen, Xiaozhong Liu, Haixu Tang
papers.abstract: We introduce ChemBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs’ capabilities in analytical chemistry scenarios. Unlike existing benchmarks focused on factual knowledge, ChemBench assesses model abilities to provide contextualized, practical guidance for complex analytical chemistry challenges, including instrument readiness checks, system suitability testing, method development, and troubleshooting for both liquid chromatography coupled mass spectrometry (LC-MS) and Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS) platforms. We evaluate three enhancement approaches: chemistry-specialized models, human-guided Chain-of-Thought reasoning, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Our findings reveal that general-purpose commercial models often outperform domain-specialized ones, while RAG and reasoning significantly improve performance. The six-dimension evaluation framework (specificity, correctness, usefulness, feasibility, misinformation risk, and error handling) provides valuable insights into LLMs’ real-world utility for chemistry researchers, establishing a foundation for developing more effective AI assistants for scientific research.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了ChemBench这一全面的基准测试工具，用于评估大语言模型在分析化学场景中的能力。与那些专注于事实知识的现有基准测试不同，ChemBench能够评估模型在提供情境化、实用化的指导方面的能力，这些指导适用于复杂的分析化学挑战，包括仪器适用性检查、系统适用性测试、方法开发以及针对液相色谱-质谱联用和气相色谱-质谱联用的故障排除工作。我们评估了三种增强方法：专门从事化学领域的模型、由人类引导的推理过程以及检索增强生成技术。我们的研究发现表明，通用的商业模型通常优于特定领域的模型，而检索增强生成技术和推理能力则显著提升了模型的性能。我们建立的六维评估框架（特异性、正确性、实用性、可行性、错误信息风险以及错误处理能力）为化学研究人员提供了关于大语言模型在实际应用中的价值的宝贵信息，为开发更有效的AI助手以辅助科学研究奠定了基础。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Too Fast, Too Shallow – LLMs, Including Reasoning LLMs, Are Unreliable Constitutional Reasoners
papers.title_zh: 太快、太浅薄——包括推理型大语言模型在内的这些模型，作为宪法制定者来说并不可靠
papers.authors: Reto Gubelmann, Peter Hongler
papers.abstract: We assess LLMs’ constitutional reasoning abilities using three different, newly developed datasets on three different constitutional questions in three different constitutional frameworks, comprising two different languages; the structure and content of the datasets is informed by legal expertise and grounded in the state of the art in philosophy of language. Our results indicate that the 19 LLMs tested, including the reasoning LLMs, while not being uniformly subject to political bias, are still not reliable constitutional reasoners, as they are heavily influenced by logically irrelevant aspects of the reasoning. Of the 196k evaluations run in our main experiment, the LLMs label less than 70% correctly, and open-weight reasoning LLMs as well as gpt-4o are outperformed by moderately sized open-weight non-reasoning LLMs. None of the LLMs tested consistently show slow, systematic, rule-based system 2 thinking.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过三个不同的、新开发的数据库，针对三种不同的宪法问题，在三种不同的宪法框架下进行评估，这些数据库涉及两种不同的语言。这些数据库的结构和内容都基于法律专业知识，并遵循语言哲学领域的最新研究成果。我们的研究结果表明，被测试的19个大语言模型，包括那些具备推理能力的模型，虽然并未完全受到政治偏见的影响，但它们仍然无法可靠地进行宪法推理，因为它们受到了许多逻辑上无关因素的严重影响。在我们的主要实验中，有19.6万次评估结果中，这些大语言模型正确标记的比例不足70%。其中，开放权重推理模型以及GPT-4o的表现不如那些规模稍小的非推理型大语言模型。没有任何一个被测试的大语言模型表现出缓慢、系统性、基于规则的系统二思维特征。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: JTPRO: A Joint Tool–Prompt Reflective Optimization Framework for Language Agents
papers.title_zh: JTPRO：一种用于语言代理的联合工具——提示式反思优化框架
papers.authors: Sandip Ghoshal, Anshul Mittal, Jyotika Singh, Miguel Ballesteros, Weiyi Sun, Fang Tu, Shailender Singh, Yassine Benajiba, Fahad Shah, Sujeeth Bharadwaj, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents augmented with external tools often struggle as number of tools grow large and become domain-specific. In such settings, ambiguous tool descriptions and under-specified agent instructions frequently lead to tool mis-selection and incorrect slot/value instantiation. We hypothesize that this is due to two root causes: generic, one-size-fits-all prompts that ignore tool-specific nuances, and underspecified tool schemas that lack clear guidance on when and how to use each tool and how to format its parameters. We introduce Joint Tool-Prompt Reflective Optimization (JTPRO), a framework for improving tool-calling reliability in trace-supervised settings by iteratively using rollout-driven reflection to co-optimize global instructions and per-tool schema/argument descriptions for accurate tool selection and argument instantiation in large tool inventories. JTPRO is designed to preserve only tool-local cues needed for correct disambiguation and slot filling. We evaluate JTPRO across multi-tool benchmarks, which account for different number of tools using three metrics: Tool Selection Accuracy (TSA), Slot Filling Accuracy(SFA), and Overall Success Rate(OSR) (correct tool + correct slots + correct values). JTPRO consistently outperforms strong baselines, including CoT-style agents, and reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA by 5%–20% (relative) on OSR. Ablations show that joint optimization of instructions and tool schemas is more effective and robust than optimizing either component in isolation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理在配备外部工具时常常面临困难，因为工具的数量不断增加，且这些工具往往具有特定领域的特性。在这种情况下，模糊的工具描述以及不够明确的代理指令容易导致工具选择错误，以及参数配置不当。我们认为，这种现象源于两个根本原因：一是使用通用化的、一刀切的提示方式，忽略了工具特有的细微差别；二是工具说明不够明确，无法指导用户何时以及如何使用每种工具，以及如何格式化其参数。我们提出了“联合工具-提示反思优化”框架，该框架通过迭代性的反思来优化全局指令和每种工具的说明，从而提高在大量工具中选择正确工具并正确填充参数的可靠性。该框架仅保留用于准确消除歧义和填充参数的局部工具信息。我们在多个工具测试场景中评估了JTPRO的性能，这些场景涉及不同数量的工具，我们使用三个指标来衡量其效果：工具选择准确率、槽位填充准确率以及整体成功率（即正确选择的工具、填充正确的槽位以及正确的参数值）。结果显示，JTPRO在整体成功率方面始终优于其他强大的基线算法，包括基于CoT风格的代理，以及如GEPA这样的反思式提示优化方法，其相对性能提升幅度为5%到20%。实验还表明，同时优化指令和工具说明比单独优化其中任何一个部分更为有效且稳健。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CANDICE: Agentic Causal Disentanglement with Class Conditional Knowledge Integration for Long Tailed Domain Generalization
papers.title_zh: 坎迪斯：基于类别条件知识的主动因果解耦方法，以实现长尾领域泛化能力
papers.authors: Midhat Urooj, Ayan Banerjee, Sandeep Gupta
papers.abstract: Deep learning models deployed in clinical settings face two major challenges: domain generalization (DG) and long-tailed (LT) recognition. DG requires learning domain-invariant features to ensure robustness across heterogeneous acquisition protocols and patient populations. However, we identify a fundamental trade-off: objectives that enforce domain invariance often suppress class-discriminative signals essential for long-tailed recognition.To address this, we propose the Agentic Causal Disentanglement (CANDICE) Framework, a modular architecture that integrates explicit clinical expertise from sonographers, radiologists, and specialists as a form of causal intervention. The framework combines clinical reasoning, causal representation learning, and automated pipeline construction to disentangle domain-invariant and class-discriminative features. By incorporating domain-specific causal knowledge, it effectively decouples the objectives of DG and LT learning. We evaluate CANDICE on 10 diverse medical imaging datasets spanning four modalities. The framework achieves an average performance improvement of 10.3% across both multi-domain and in-domain long-tailed tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in handling distribution shifts while preserving minority class performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 在临床环境中部署的深度学习模型面临两个主要挑战：领域泛化问题和长尾识别问题。领域泛化要求学习领域不变的特征，以确保在不同采集方式和患者群体中的鲁棒性。然而，我们发现存在一个根本性的权衡：那些强调领域不变性的目标往往会忽略对长尾识别至关重要的类判别性信号。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“代理因果解耦”框架（CANDICE）。该框架是一种模块化架构，它将超声技师、放射科医生和专家的临床专业知识整合进来，作为一种因果干预手段。该框架结合了临床推理、因果表示学习和自动化流程构建，从而分离出领域不变特征和类判别特征。通过融入特定领域的因果知识，该框架能够有效地分离出领域泛化和长尾识别的目标。我们在10个不同的医学影像数据集上评估了CANDICE框架的性能，这些数据集涵盖了四种不同的成像方式。结果表明，该框架在跨领域和领域内长尾任务上的平均性能提升了10.3%，显示出其在处理分布偏移的同时保持少数类性能方面的有效性。

papers.title: AdaptEvolve: Improving Efficiency of Evolutionary AI Agents through Adaptive Model Selection
papers.title_zh: AdaptEvolve：通过自适应模型选择提升进化型AI代理的效率
papers.authors: Pretam Ray, Pratik Prabhanjan Brahma, Zicheng Liu, Emad Barsoum
papers.abstract: Evolutionary agentic systems intensify the trade-off between computational efficiency and reasoning capability by repeatedly invoking large language models (LLMs) during inference. This setting raises a central question: how can an agent dynamically select an LLM that is sufficiently capable for the current generation step while remaining computationally efficient? While model cascades offer a practical mechanism for balancing this trade-off, existing routing strategies typically rely on static heuristics or external controllers and do not explicitly account for model uncertainty. We introduce AdaptEvolve: Adaptive LLM Selection for Multi-LLM Evolutionary Refinement within an evolutionary sequential refinement framework that leverages intrinsic generation confidence to estimate real-time solvability. Empirical results show that confidence-driven selection yields a favorable Pareto frontier, reducing total inference cost by an average of 37.9% across benchmarks while retaining 97.5% of the upper-bound accuracy of static large-model baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 进化型智能系统通过在进行推理过程中反复调用大语言模型（LLMs），从而加剧了计算效率与推理能力之间的权衡。这一设定提出了一个核心问题：智能体如何能够动态地选择出一个在当前生成步骤中具备足够能力的同时，又保持高效计算的LLM呢？虽然模型级联机制为平衡这种权衡提供了一种实用的方法，但现有的路由策略通常依赖于静态的启发式方法或外部控制器，并没有明确考虑模型的不确定性因素。我们提出了AdaptEvolve：一种用于多LLM进化的自适应LLM选择算法，该算法基于进化序列优化框架，利用模型的内在生成能力来实时评估模型的求解能力。实验结果表明，基于置信度的选择方式能够产生更优的帕累托前沿，平均可将总推理成本降低37.9%，同时还能保持97.5%的静态大型模型基准的准确率。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: OmniCode: A Benchmark for Evaluating Software Development Agents
papers.title_zh: OmniCode：用于评估软件开发代理的基准测试工具
papers.authors: Atharv Sonwane, Eng-Shen Tu, Wei-Chung Lu, Claas Beger, Carter Larsen, Debjit Dhar, Simon Alford, Rachel Chen, Ronit Pattanayak, Tuan Anh Dang, Guohao Chen, Gloria Geng, Kevin Ellis, Saikat Dutta
papers.abstract: LLM-powered coding agents are redefining how real-world software is developed. To drive the research towards better coding agents, we require challenging benchmarks that can rigorously evaluate the ability of such agents to perform various software engineering tasks. However, popular coding benchmarks such as HumanEval and SWE-Bench focus on narrowly scoped tasks such as competition programming and patch generation. In reality, software engineers have to handle a broader set of tasks for real-world software development. To address this gap, we propose OmniCode, a novel software engineering benchmark that contains a broader and more diverse set of task categories beyond code or patch generation. Overall, OmniCode contains 1794 tasks spanning three programming languages – Python, Java, and C++ – and four key categories: bug fixing, test generation, code review fixing, and style fixing. In contrast to prior software engineering benchmarks, the tasks in OmniCode are (1) manually validated to eliminate ill-defined problems, and (2) synthetically crafted or recently curated to avoid data leakage issues, presenting a new framework for synthetically generating diverse software tasks from limited real-world data. We evaluate OmniCode with popular agent frameworks such as SWE-Agent and show that while they may perform well on bug fixing for Python, they fall short on tasks such as Test Generation and in languages such as C++ and Java. For instance, SWE-Agent achieves a maximum of 25.0% with DeepSeek-V3.1 on C++ Test Generation. OmniCode aims to serve as a robust benchmark and spur the development of agents that can perform well across different aspects of software development.
papers.abstract_zh: 由机器学习驱动的编程智能体正在重新定义现实世界软件的开发方式。为了推动研究朝着更优秀的编程智能体发展，我们需要具有挑战性的测试基准，以严格评估这些智能体完成各种软件工程任务的能力。然而，像HumanEval和SWE-Bench这样的流行编程测试基准主要专注于一些特定任务，比如竞赛编程和补丁生成。实际上，软件工程师需要处理更广泛的任务来完成现实世界的软件开发工作。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了OmniCode这一新的软件工程测试基准，它包含了比代码或补丁生成更为广泛和多样化的任务类别。总体而言，OmniCode包含1794个任务，涉及三种编程语言——Python、Java和C++，以及四个关键任务类别：错误修复、测试生成、代码审查修复和风格修正。与之前的软件工程测试基准不同，OmniCode中的任务经过人工验证，以消除问题定义不清的情况；同时，这些任务是通过合成方式生成的，或者最近进行了整理，以避免数据泄露的问题。这为我们提供了一种从有限的现实世界数据中合成出多样化软件任务的新框架。我们使用SWE-Agent等流行的智能体框架对OmniCode进行了评估，结果显示，虽然这些框架在Python语言的错误修复方面表现良好，但在测试生成等任务上表现不佳，尤其是在C++和Java语言上。例如，SWE-Agent在C++测试生成任务上的得分最高仅为25.0%。OmniCode旨在成为一个可靠的测试基准，并促进开发出能够在软件开发的不同领域表现出色的智能体。

papers.title: Supplement Generation Training for Enhancing Agentic Task Performance
papers.title_zh: 用于提升代理任务执行能力的补充生成训练
papers.authors: Young Min Cho, Daniele Bonadiman, Divya Bhargavi, Tamer Alkhouli, Salvatore Romeo, Dongwei Jiang, Khushbu Pahwa, Yubin Ge, Etsuko Ishii, Monica Sunkara, Yi Zhang
papers.abstract: Training large foundation models for agentic tasks is increasingly impractical due to the high computational costs, long iteration cycles, and rapid obsolescence as new models are continuously released. Instead of post-training massive models for every new task or domain, we propose Supplement Generation Training (SGT), a more efficient and sustainable strategy. SGT trains a smaller LLM to generate useful supplemental text that, when appended to the original input, helps the larger LLM solve the task more effectively. These lightweight models can dynamically adapt supplements to task requirements, improving performance without modifying the underlying large models. This approach decouples task-specific optimization from large foundation models and enables more flexible, cost-effective deployment of LLM-powered agents in real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于计算成本极高、迭代周期漫长，以及随着新模型的不断发布而模型很快过时，为智能任务训练大型基础模型变得越来越不切实际。因此，我们提出了补充生成训练方法，这是一种更高效且可持续的策略。该方法通过训练一个较小的大语言模型来生成有用的补充文本，这些补充文本被添加到原始输入中后，能够帮助更大的大语言模型更有效地完成任务。这些轻量级模型能够动态调整补充内容以符合任务需求，从而在无需修改底层大型模型的情况下提升性能。这种方法将特定任务的优化与大型基础模型分离开来，使得在现实应用中对基于大语言模型的智能体进行部署变得更加灵活且经济高效。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Automatic Paper Analysis and Categorisation for Systematic Reviews with Combined Reasoning-Augmented SFT and DAPO RL
papers.title_zh: 利用集成推理机制与DAPO强化学习算法的自动论文分析与分类，适用于系统评价任务
papers.authors: Michela Lorandi, Anya Belz, Simon Mille, Craig Thomson
papers.abstract: Systematic reviews are a cornerstone of modern science, synthesising evidence from published research to provide the highest level of research evidence in a field. The process includes categorising studies on a number of different dimensions which is laborious and time consuming. Automatic approaches are beginning to be explored but the complexity of the task means we are currently far from a satisfactory solution. In this paper, we test different annotation scheme-agnostic methods for automatic NLP paper categorisation for systematic reviews, and test them on two tasks: (i) annotating NLP papers for categories of reported controlled-text generation methods, and (ii) annotating NLP papers for categories of reported human evaluations. We find that reasoning-enhanced fine-tuning combined with DAPO reinforcement learning rewarding both correctness and output format substantially improves the performance of LLMs (by up to +53.8 points), even when they have been pre-trained to perform reasoning, and cuts time required for annotation by around 80% in a human-in-the-loop setting.
papers.abstract_zh: 系统评价是现代科学的基石，它整合了已发表研究的证据，为某一领域提供最高级别的研究依据。这一过程包括根据多个不同维度对研究进行分类，这既繁琐又耗时。虽然人们开始探索自动化解决方案，但任务的复杂性意味着我们目前还远未达到令人满意的解决方案。在本文中，我们测试了多种与注释方案无关的方法，用于自动对系统评价中的自然语言处理论文进行分类。我们针对两个任务进行了测试：(i) 对涉及控制文本生成方法的自然语言处理论文进行分类；(ii) 对涉及人类评估的自然语言处理论文进行分类。我们发现，通过强化学习进行推理优化，并结合DAPO强化学习机制来同时考虑正确性和输出格式，可以显著提高大语言模型的性能（性能提升高达53.8分），即使这些大语言模型已经经过训练以具备推理能力。此外，在人工干预的情况下，这种方法还将注释所需的时间减少了约80%。

papers.title: MotifAgent: Learning Molecular Assembly through Multi-Agent Collaboration for Chemical Language Understanding
papers.title_zh: MotifAgent：通过多智能体协作来学习分子组装过程，以实现化学语言的理解
papers.authors: Jinjia Feng, Wenda Wang, Zhewei Wei
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great potential in molecular understanding by aligning molecular representations with text. However, existing approaches remain limited to static motif recognition without comprehending the generative principles—the connection rules governing how motifs assemble into valid topological structures. To address this challenge, we introduce MotifAgent, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework inspired by emergent collective intelligence. We formulate molecular assembly as a collaborative problem where each motif is represented by an agent sharing a common LLM backbone, learning connection rules through explicit inter-motif negotiation rather than implicit sequence memorization. Key innovations include: (1) dynamic inter-agent negotiation for modeling motif connections; (2) Set-based Behavioral Cloning for learning multiple topologically equivalent assembly paths; (3) topology-aware reward shaping with MAPPO to maintain chemical validity while optimizing target properties. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotifAgent achieves state-of-the-art performance across molecular property prediction, description generation, and reaction prediction tasks, with our generalist model surpassing specialized expert models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在通过将分子表示与文本进行对齐来理解分子结构方面展现了巨大的潜力。然而，现有的方法仍然局限于静态基序的识别，而无法理解生成原理——即控制基序如何组合成有效拓扑结构的规则。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了MotifAgent，这是一个受群体智能启发设计的多智能体强化学习框架。我们将分子组装问题视为一个协作性问题，每个基序由一个智能体代表，这些智能体共享同一个语言模型框架，通过明确的基序间协商来学习连接规则，而不是通过隐式的序列记忆来实现。我们的主要创新点包括：(1) 动态的智能体间协商机制，用于模拟基序间的连接关系；(2) 基于集合的行为克隆技术，用于学习多个拓扑上等效的组装路径；(3) 利用MAPPO进行拓扑感知的奖励调整，从而在优化目标属性的同时保持化学有效性。大量的实验表明，MotifAgent在分子属性预测、描述生成以及反应预测任务中取得了领先的性能，我们的通用模型甚至超越了专业专家模型。

papers.title: Policy-Guided Stepwise Action Planning for Controllable LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 基于策略的逐步行动计划规划，用于实现可控制的大语言模型推理
papers.authors: Jianpeng Zhou, Qisheng Hu, Jiahai Wang, Wenya Wang
papers.abstract: Steering large language model (LLM) reasoning via high-level reasoning actions offers a promising approach to improve robustness and interpretability. However, existing action-based paradigms, ranging from training-free prompting to static plan retrieval or prediction, often fail to consistently outperform standard generation because their planners tend to degenerate into repetitive loops or fixed patterns. We propose PG-HAP (Policy-Guided High-Level Action Planning), a lightweight stepwise planner–executor framework that learns to select reasoning actions dynamically while keeping the executor LLM fully frozen. The planner is trained with reinforcement learning to optimize answer correctness. To prevent degeneration, we introduce two targeted mechanisms: (i) an Action-Dependency Logit Mask that enforces valid transitions to avoid redundancy, and (ii) an Action Diversity Reward that discourages mode collapse by promoting varied action sequences. Across mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks, PG-HAP improves accuracy over strong baselines while producing less redundant, more adaptive trajectories. This demonstrates that learning high-level planning alone can substantially strengthen reasoning without expensive end-to-end model tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过高级推理动作来引导大语言模型（LLM）的推理过程，是一种提高模型鲁棒性和可解释性的有前景方法。然而，现有的基于动作的范式，从无需训练的提示到静态计划检索或预测，往往无法持续超越标准生成模型，因为它们的规划器容易陷入重复循环或固定模式。我们提出了PG-HAP（政策指导的高级动作规划），这是一种轻量级的逐步规划-执行框架，它能够动态选择推理动作，同时让执行器LLM保持冻结状态。该规划器通过强化学习进行训练，以优化答案的准确性。为了防止规划器陷入固定模式，我们引入了两种有针对性的机制：(i) 动作依赖逻辑掩码，用于强制有效的转换以避免冗余；(ii) 动作多样性奖励，通过促进多样化的动作序列来减少模式固化现象。在数学和常识推理测试中，PG-HAP的准确率优于强大的基线模型，同时产生的轨迹更加灵活且冗余度更低。这表明，仅通过学习高级规划就能显著增强推理能力，而无需进行昂贵的端到端模型调优。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Multiplication in Multimodal LLMs: Computation with Text, Image, and Audio Inputs
papers.title_zh: 多模态大语言模型中的乘法操作：文本、图像和音频输入的计算处理
papers.authors: Samuel Gideon Balter, Ethan Jerzak, Connor Thomas Jerzak
papers.abstract: Multimodal LLMs can accurately perceive numerical content across modalities yet fail to perform exact multi-digit multiplication when the identical underlying arithmetic problem is presented as numerals, number words, images, or in audio form. Because existing benchmarks often lack systematically paired instances across modalities, it remains difficult to compare genuine arithmetic limits within and across model families. We therefore introduce a controlled multimodal multiplication benchmark that factorially varies digit length, digit sparsity, representation (e.g., numerals vs. number words), and modality (text, rendered images, and audio), with paired instances from a reproducible generator. We also define arithmetic load, C, as the product of the total and non-zero digit number as a compact, mechanistically motivated proxy for operation count. Across evaluations, accuracy falls sharply as C grows, often nearing zero by C > 100. Indeed, C remains predictive of performance across modalities and models, with R^2 > 0.5, nearing the value from more complex measures of arithmetic load that count the number of intermediate arithmetic steps. A separate perception-versus-computation decomposition shows that multimodal degradation is primarily computational rather than perceptual: on matched perception checks, models are near-perfect (>99\%) across modalities even when multiplication accuracy drops substantially. Beyond measuring when models fail, we ask which procedures they are predisposed to follow. We introduce a style-controlled forced-completion loss probe that scores heuristic-specific reasoning prefixes—including columnar multiplication, distributive decomposition, and rounding/compensation. Here, distributive decomposition is favored in both text and vision modalities; heuristic-specific LoRA adapters produce near-orthogonal updates yet degrade accuracy, indicating the base model maintains a well-tuned internal router.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型能够准确理解不同模态下的数值内容，但在面对以数字、数词、图像或音频形式呈现的相同算术问题时，却无法完成精确的多位数乘法运算。由于现有的基准测试通常缺乏跨模态的系统配对案例，因此很难比较不同模型家族内部的真实算术极限。为此，我们引入了一个受控的多模态乘法基准测试，该测试通过因子化方式改变数字长度、数字稀疏性、表示方式（例如数字与数词）以及模态（文本、渲染图像和音频），并提供了来自可重现生成器的配对案例。我们还定义了算术负载C，将其定义为总数字与非零数字的乘积，这是一种基于机制的数学运算次数代理指标。在多次评估中发现，随着C的增加，准确率会急剧下降，当C大于100时，准确率往往接近零。实际上，C可以预测不同模态和模型之间的性能表现，其R^2值超过0.5，这一数值接近于更复杂的算术负载测量方法所得到的数值，后者会计算中间算术步骤的数量。进一步的感知与计算分解表明，多模态性能下降主要源于计算层面而非感知层面：在匹配的感知测试中，即使乘法运算的准确性大幅下降，模型在不同模态下的表现仍然接近完美（>99%）。除了衡量模型何时出现错误外，我们还探讨了模型倾向于遵循哪些计算流程。我们引入了一种风格控制的强制完成损失探针，该探针会对特定于启发式的推理前缀进行评分——包括列式乘法、分配律分解以及四舍五入/补偿等。结果显示，在文本和视觉模态中，分配律分解都受到青睐；而特定于启发式的LoRA适配器则能产生近乎正交的更新，但会导致准确率下降，这表明基础模型保持了良好的内部调整机制。

papers.title: Modeling Human Perspectives with Socio-Demographic Representations
papers.title_zh: 利用社会人口学信息来模拟人类视角
papers.authors: Leixin Zhang, Cagri Coltekin
papers.abstract: Humans often hold different perspectives on the same issues. In many NLP tasks, annotation disagreement can reflect valid subjective perspectives. Modeling annotator perspectives and understanding their relationship with other human factors, such as socio-demographic attributes, have received increasing attention. Prior work typically focuses on single demographic factors or limited combinations. However, in real-world settings, annotator perspectives are shaped by complex social contexts, and finer-grained socio-demographic attributes can better explain human perspectives. In this work, we propose Socio-Contrastive Learning, a method that jointly models annotator perspectives while learning socio-demographic representations. Our method provides an effective approach for the fusion of socio-demographic features and textual representations to predict annotator perspectives, outperforming standard concatenation-based methods. The learned representations further enable analysis and visualization of how demographic factors relate to variation in annotator perspectives. Our code is available at GitHub: https://github.com/Leixin-Zhang/Socio_Contrastive_Learning
papers.abstract_zh: 人们往往对同一问题持有不同的观点。在许多自然语言处理任务中，注释上的分歧可以反映有效的主观观点。建模注释者的观点并理解它们与其他人类因素之间的关系，例如社会人口统计属性，已经受到了越来越多的关注。以往的研究通常只关注单一的人口统计因素或有限的组合因素。然而，在现实世界中，注释者的观点受到复杂社会环境的塑造，而更细致的社会人口统计属性可以更好地解释人类的观点。在这项工作中，我们提出了社会对比学习方法，该方法在建模注释者观点的同时，还能学习社会人口统计特征。我们的方法为融合社会人口统计特征和文本表示以预测注释者观点提供了一种有效的方法，其效果优于基于标准串联的方法。所学习的表示还使得我们可以分析和可视化人口统计因素如何与注释者观点的差异相关联。我们的代码可以在GitHub上找到：https://github.com/Leixin-Zhang/Socio_Contrastive_Learning

papers.title: Weight Tying Biases Token Embeddings Towards the Output Space
papers.title_zh: 权重绑定偏见：代币嵌入对输出空间的影响
papers.authors: Antonio Lopardo, Avyukth Harish, Catherine Arnett, Akshat Gupta
papers.abstract: Weight tying, i.e. sharing parameters between input and output embedding matrices, is common practice in language model design, yet its impact on the learned embedding space remains poorly understood. In this paper, we show that tied embedding matrices align more closely with output (unembedding) matrices than with input embeddings of comparable untied models, indicating that the shared matrix is shaped primarily for output prediction rather than input representation. This unembedding bias arises because output gradients dominate early in training. Using tuned lens analysis, we show this negatively affects early-layer computations, which contribute less effectively to the residual stream. Scaling input gradients during training reduces this bias, providing causal evidence for the role of gradient imbalance. This is mechanistic evidence that weight tying optimizes the embedding matrix for output prediction, compromising its role in input representation. These results help explain why weight tying can harm performance at scale and have implications for training smaller LLMs, where the embedding matrix contributes substantially to total parameter count.
papers.abstract_zh: 权重共享，即将在输入和输出嵌入矩阵之间共享参数，是语言模型设计中的常见做法。然而，这种做法对学习到的嵌入空间的影响仍不甚明了。在本文中，我们发现共享参数后的嵌入矩阵与输出（解嵌入）矩阵之间的对齐程度更高，而与其他未共享参数的模型相比则较低。这表明共享矩阵主要用于输出预测，而非输入表示。这种解嵌入偏差的出现是因为在训练初期，输出梯度占据主导地位。通过优化透镜分析，我们发现这种偏差会负面影响早期层的计算过程，而这些计算对残差流的贡献却较小。在训练过程中调整输入梯度的幅度可以消除这种偏差，这为梯度不平衡的作用提供了因果证据。这些结果进一步证明了权重共享会优化嵌入矩阵以适应当前输出预测的需求，从而削弱了嵌入矩阵在输入表示中的作用。这些发现有助于解释为什么权重共享会在大规模应用中损害性能，同时也为训练较小的大语言模型提供了启示——在这些模型中，嵌入矩阵的规模对总参数数量的影响尤为显著。

papers.title: Structured Uncertainty guided Clarification for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 结构化不确定性引导的LLM智能体澄清机制
papers.authors: Manan Suri, Puneet Mathur, Nedim Lipka, Franck Dernoncourt, Ryan A. Rossi, Dinesh Manocha
papers.abstract: LLM agents with tool-calling capabilities often fail when user instructions are ambiguous or incomplete, leading to incorrect invocations and task failures. Existing approaches operate in unstructured language spaces, generating clarifying questions through prompting strategies that lack principled criteria for determining which questions to ask and when to stop. We introduce a principled formulation of structured uncertainty that operates directly over tool parameters and their domains, cleanly separating specification uncertainty (what the user wants) from model uncertainty (what the LLM predicts). Our formulation uses Expected Value of Perfect Information (EVPI) to quantify the disambiguation value of each potential question, balanced against aspect-based cost modeling that prevents redundant questioning. We demonstrate the versatility of this formulation through two applications. First, SAGE-Agent uses structured uncertainty for inference-time question selection, achieving 7–39% higher coverage on ambiguous tasks while reducing clarification questions by 1.5–2.7 x compared to strong prompting and uncertainty-based baselines. Second, we show that structured uncertainty provides effective training signals: uncertainty-guided reward modeling boosts When2Call accuracy from 36.5% to 65.2% (3B model) and 36.7% to 62.9% (7B model) through uncertainty-weighted GRPO training, demonstrating more sample-efficient reinforcement learning for tool-calling agents. To enable evaluation, we present ClarifyBench, the first multi-turn dynamic tool-calling disambiguation benchmark. Our results establish structured uncertainty as a principled framework that improves both inference-time interaction efficiency and training-time sample efficiency in tool-augmented agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 具有工具调用功能的LLM智能体在用户指令模糊或不完整时常常会出现失败情况，导致错误的调用和任务执行失败。现有的方法是在非结构化语言环境中运行的，通过提示策略生成澄清问题，但这些策略缺乏确定应该提出哪些问题以及何时停止的明确标准。我们提出了一种基于原则的结构化不确定性表述方式，该方式直接作用于工具参数及其领域，清晰地将规范不确定性（用户的需求）与模型不确定性（LLM的预测结果）区分开来。我们的表述方式使用完美信息的期望值（EVPI）来量化每个潜在问题的消歧价值，同时结合基于方面的成本建模，以避免重复提问。我们通过两个应用实例展示了这种表述方式的实用性。首先，SAGE-Agent利用结构化不确定性进行推理时的问题选择，在解决模糊任务时，其覆盖度提高了7-39%，同时减少了1.5-2.7倍需要澄清的问题数量，相比强提示法和基于不确定性的基线方法而言。其次，我们发现结构化不确定性能够提供有效的训练信号：在不确定性引导的奖励建模下，通过不确定性加权的GRPO训练，When2Call的准确性从36.5%提升到了65.2%（3B模型），从36.7%提升到了62.9%（7B模型），这表明对于工具调用智能体来说，这种训练方式更加高效。为了进行评估，我们推出了ClarifyBench，这是首个多轮动态工具调用消歧基准测试。我们的研究结果证明，结构化不确定性是一种有效的框架，它能够提高工具增强型智能体的推理时间交互效率以及训练时间样本效率。

papers.title: LRBench and Judge-R1: Principled Evaluation and Training of LLM-Based Judges for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.title_zh: LRBench和Judge-R1：基于大语言模型的法官评估与训练方法，用于长上下文推理任务
papers.authors: Xinyi Zhao, Haoqi Hu, Ziyu Wang, Jinfeng Xiao
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges to evaluate, rank, and supervise other models, yet their reliability in judging LLMs’ reasoning process under long-context settings remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks either overly rely on human annotators, who may miss subtle flaws in lengthy reasoning chains, or focus solely on final responses while ignoring the underlying context and reasoning process. We introduce Long-Reason Bench (LRBench), a large-scale benchmark for evaluating LLM-based judges. LRBench comprises over 100K annotated instances spanning medical, legal, and academic-review scenarios, with fine-grained labels indicating violations of six core principles: Logical Correctness, Factual Consistency, Bias and Fairness, Groundedness, Helpfulness, and Harmlessness. Experimental results reveal that state-of-the-art LLM judges struggle to identify nuanced reasoning errors in long contexts. To improve judge reliability, we further present Judge-R1, which combines reinforcement learning with multi-turn search to enable grounded and principle-aware evaluation. Across domains and principles, Judge-R1 consistently outperforms single-turn baselines, enabling scalable and trustworthy evaluation of LLM reasoning. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Xinyi-0724/Judge-R1.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作评估、排序和监督其他模型的评判标准。然而，它们在处理长上下文环境下的推理过程时是否可靠，目前仍缺乏深入的研究。现有的评估基准要么过于依赖人工注释，可能会忽略冗长的推理链中的细微错误；要么只关注最终的输出结果，而忽略了背后的上下文和推理过程。我们提出了Long-Reason Bench（LRBench），这是一个用于评估基于LLM的评判标准的大规模基准测试。LRBench包含了超过10万个带有注释的实例，这些实例涵盖了医学、法律和学术评审等多个领域。这些注释详细描述了六个核心原则的违反情况：逻辑正确性、事实一致性、偏见与公平性、相关性、有用性以及无害性。实验结果表明，最先进的LLM评判标准在识别长上下文环境下的细微推理错误方面存在困难。为了提高评判标准的可靠性，我们进一步开发了Judge-R1算法。该算法结合了强化学习和多轮搜索技术，能够实现基于相关性的、考虑各种原则的评估。无论是在哪个领域或遵循哪些原则下，Judge-R1都始终优于单轮基准算法，从而实现了对LLM推理的可扩展且可靠的评估。我们的数据集和代码可以在https://github.com/Xinyi-0724/Judge-R1下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Reproduction: A Paired-Task Framework for Assessing LLM Comprehension and Creativity in Literary Translation
papers.title_zh: 超越复制：一种用于评估大型语言模型在文学翻译中的理解和创造能力的双任务框架
papers.authors: Ran Zhang, Steffen Eger, Arda Tezcan, Wei Zhao, Simone Paolo Ponzetto, Lieve Macken
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for creative tasks such as literary translation. Yet translational creativity remains underexplored and is rarely evaluated at scale, while source-text comprehension is typically studied in isolation, despite the fact that, in professional translation, comprehension and creativity are tightly intertwined. We address these gaps with a paired-task framework applied to literary excerpts from 11 books. Task 1 assesses source-text comprehension, and Task 2 evaluates translational creativity through Units of Creative Potential (UCPs), such as metaphors and wordplay. Using a scalable evaluation setup that combines expert human annotations with UCP-based automatic scoring, we benchmark 23 models and four creativity-oriented prompts. Our findings show that strong comprehension does not translate into human-level creativity: models often produce literal or contextually inappropriate renderings, with particularly large gaps for the more distant English–Chinese language pair. Creativity-oriented prompts yield only modest gains, and only one model, Mistral-Large, comes close to human-level creativity (0.167 vs. 0.246). Across all model–prompt combinations, only three exceed a creativity score of 0.1, while the rest remain at or near zero.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在诸如文学翻译这样的创造性任务中得到了越来越多的应用。然而，翻译中的创造性能力仍然没有得到充分研究，也很少进行大规模评估。而源文本的理解能力则通常被单独研究，尽管在实际翻译中，理解能力和创造性能力是紧密相连的。我们通过一个双任务框架来解决这些问题，该框架应用于11本书籍中的文学片段。任务1用于评估源文本的理解能力，任务2则通过“创造性潜力单位”来评估翻译中的创造性能力，例如隐喻和文字游戏等元素。我们采用一种可扩展的评估方法，结合专家人工注释和基于创造性潜力的自动评分，对23个模型和四种以创造性为导向的提示进行了评估。我们的研究发现表明，良好的理解能力并不能直接转化为人类水平的创造性能力：模型往往会产生字面意义上或上下文上不恰当的翻译结果，尤其是对于英语与中文这种语言对来说，差距更为明显。以创造性为导向的提示只能带来适度的提升效果，只有Mistral-Large这一个模型接近人类水平的创造性能力（0.167对比0.246）。在所有模型与提示的组合中，只有三个模型的创造性得分超过了0.1，其余模型的得分则接近于零。

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Large-Scale Counting in LLMs through a System-2 Strategy
papers.title_zh: 通过系统二策略实现大型计数任务在LLM中的可解释性
papers.authors: Hosein Hasani, Mohammadali Banayeeanzade, Ali Nafisi, Sadegh Mohammadian, Fatemeh Askari, Mobin Bagherian, Amirmohammad Izadi, Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs), despite strong performance on complex mathematical problems, exhibit systematic limitations in counting tasks. This issue arises from the architectural limits of transformers, where counting is performed across layers, leading to degraded precision for larger counting problems due to depth constraints. To address this limitation, we propose a simple test-time strategy inspired by System-2 cognitive processes that decomposes large counting tasks into smaller, independent sub-problems that the model can reliably solve. We evaluate this approach using observational and causal mediation analyses to understand the underlying mechanism of this System-2-like strategy. Our mechanistic analysis identifies key components: latent counts are computed and stored in the final item representations of each part, transferred to intermediate steps via dedicated attention heads, and aggregated in the final stage to produce the total count. Experimental results demonstrate that this strategy enables LLMs to surpass architectural limitations and achieve higher accuracy on large-scale counting tasks. This work provides mechanistic insight into System-2 counting in LLMs and presents a generalizable approach for improving and understanding their reasoning behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在解决复杂的数学问题时表现优异，但在计数任务上却存在系统性限制。这一问题源于Transformer架构的局限性，即计数操作是在多个层次中进行的，由于深度限制，较大规模的计数任务精度会下降。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种基于系统二认知过程的简单测试时间策略。该策略将大型计数任务分解为多个较小的独立子问题，使模型能够可靠地解决这些子问题。我们通过观察性和因果中介分析来评估这种方法，以了解这种类似系统二策略的运作机制。我们的机制分析确定了关键组成部分：潜在计数值被计算并存储在每个部分的最终项目表示中，然后通过专门的注意力机制传输到中间步骤，最后在最终阶段进行汇总，从而得到总计数。实验结果表明，这种策略使得大语言模型能够突破架构限制，在大规模计数任务上实现更高的准确性。这项工作为理解大语言模型中系统二的计数行为提供了机制上的洞察，并为改进和理解它们的推理行为提供了一种通用的方法。

papers.title: CodeScout: Contextual Problem Statement Enhancement for Software Agents
papers.title_zh: CodeScout：针对软件代理的上下文问题陈述改进方案
papers.authors: Manan Suri, Xiangci Li, Mehdi Shojaie, Songyang Han, Chao-Chun Hsu, Shweta Garg, Aniket Anand Deshmukh, Varun Kumar
papers.abstract: Current AI-powered code assistance tools often struggle with ambiguous problem statements that lack sufficient task context and requirements specification. Recent analysis of software engineering agents reveals that failures on such ambiguous requests are highly correlated with longer trajectories involving either over-exploration or repeated attempts at applying the same fix without proper evolution or testing, leading to suboptimal outcomes across software development tasks. We introduce CodeScout, a breakthrough contextual query refinement approach that systematically converts ambiguous user requests into comprehensive, actionable problem statements through lightweight pre-exploration of the target codebase. Our key innovation is demonstrating that structured analysis before task execution can supplement existing agentic capabilities without requiring any modifications to their underlying scaffolds. CodeScout performs targeted context scoping, conducts multi-perspective analysis examining potential fixes and exploration opportunities, then synthesizes these insights into enhanced problem statements with reproduction steps, expected behaviors, and targeted exploration hints. This pre-exploration directly addresses the identified failure patterns by reducing non-converging agent trajectories while clarifying user intent in natural language space. We evaluate CodeScout using state-of-the-art agentic scaffolds and language models on SWEBench-Verified, demonstrating a 20% improvement in resolution rates with up to 27 additional issues resolved compared to the default baseline method. Our results suggest that systematic query refinement through contextual analysis represents a promising direction for enhancing AI code assistance capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前基于人工智能的代码辅助工具常常难以处理那些模糊不清的问题陈述，因为这些问题缺乏足够的任务背景和需求规范。对软件工程智能体的最新分析表明，这类模糊请求的处理失败往往与较长的处理过程相关，这些过程要么表现为过度探索，要么表现为反复尝试使用相同的解决方案，而缺乏适当的优化和测试，从而导致软件开发任务的成果不尽如人意。我们提出了CodeScout这一创新性的上下文查询细化方法，该方法通过轻量级的目标代码预探索，将模糊的用户请求转化为清晰、可操作的问题陈述。我们的关键创新在于证明：在任务执行之前进行结构化分析，可以在不修改现有智能体架构的情况下提升其能力。CodeScout能够有针对性地确定问题的范围，从多个角度分析潜在的解决方案和探索机会，然后将这些洞察转化为更完善的问题陈述，其中包括复现步骤、预期行为以及有针对性的探索提示。这种预探索方法直接解决了识别出的问题模式，通过减少智能体的非收敛路径，同时用自然语言清晰地表达了用户的意图。我们在SWEBench-Verified平台上对CodeScout进行了评估，结果显示，与默认的基础方法相比，CodeScout在解决问题方面的效率提高了20%，并且还解决了多达27个额外的问题。我们的研究结果表明，通过上下文分析来进行系统性的查询细化，是提升人工智能代码辅助能力的一个有前景的方向。

papers.title: Evaluating Scene-based In-Situ Item Labeling for Immersive Conversational Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 评估基于场景的实时物品标签技术在沉浸式对话式推荐中的应用效果
papers.authors: Jiazhou Liang, Yifan Simon Liu, David Guo, Yilun Jiang, Minqi Sun, Scott Sanner
papers.abstract: The growing ubiquity of Extended Reality (XR) is driving Conversational Recommendation Systems (CRS) toward visually immersive experiences. We formalize this paradigm as Immersive CRS (ICRS), where recommended items are highlighted directly in the user’s scene-based visual environment and augmented with in-situ labels. While item recommendation has been widely studied, the problem of how to select and evaluate which information to present as immersive labels remains an open problem. To this end, we introduce a principled categorization of information needs into explicit intent satisfaction and proactive information needs and use these to define novel evaluation metrics for item label selection. We benchmark IR-, LLM-, and VLM-based methods across three datasets and ICRS scenarios: fashion, movie recommendation, and retail shopping. Our evaluation reveals three important limitations of existing methods: (1) they fail to leverage scenario-specific information modalities (e.g., visual cues for fashion, metadata for retail), (2) they present redundant information that is visually inferable, and (3) they poorly anticipate users’ proactive information needs from explicit dialogue alone. In summary, this work provides both a novel evaluation paradigm for in-situ item labeling in ICRS and highlights key challenges for future work.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩展现实（XR）的日益普及，正推动对话式推荐系统朝着视觉沉浸式体验的方向发展。我们将这一范式定义为沉浸式对话式推荐系统（ICRS），即推荐内容会直接显示在用户的基于场景的视觉环境中，并辅以现场标签进行标注。虽然项目推荐已经得到了广泛研究，但如何选择和评估应作为沉浸式标签的信息内容仍然是一个未解决的问题。为此，我们提出了一种基于信息需求分类的原则性方法，将其划分为显式意图满足型和主动信息需求型，并利用这些分类来定义新的项目标签选择评估指标。我们在三个数据集和ICRS场景中对基于信息检索、大语言模型和虚拟语言模型的方法进行了基准测试：时尚推荐、电影推荐和零售购物。我们的评估结果显示，现有方法存在三个主要缺陷：(1) 它们未能充分利用特定场景的信息形式（例如，时尚领域的视觉线索、零售领域的元数据）；(2) 它们呈现了在视觉上可以推断出的冗余信息；(3) 它们无法充分预测用户仅通过显性对话所能产生的主动信息需求。总之，这项工作为ICRS中的项目标签标注提供了一种新的评估范式，同时也指出了未来研究需要解决的关键问题。

papers.title: StanceAttack: Adversarial Attack for Stance Detection
papers.title_zh: 姿态攻击：用于姿态识别的对抗性攻击方法
papers.authors: Chenye Zhao, Cornelia Caragea
papers.abstract: Stance detection aims to ascertain whether an author’s text is in favor, against, or neutral toward specific targets like public policies or social issues. While pretrained language models (PLMs) have greatly enhanced stance detection, they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks—manipulations that maintain textual semantics but lead to incorrect predictions. Such vulnerabilities remain underexplored for stance detection. In this study, we introduce StanceAttack, an innovative adversarial attack method leveraging ChatGPT to create adversarial examples that can mislead well-trained stance detection models. We conduct experiments to evaluate our attack model by attacking state-of-the-art PLMs on two benchmark datasets. Results demonstrate that StanceAttack outperforms traditional adversarial methods with higher success rates and fewer retries. Human evaluations confirm that our adversarial examples preserve the original semantic meanings and naturalness. We share our code and data in https://github.com/chenyez/StanceAttack.
papers.abstract_zh: 姿态检测的目的是确定作者的文本是支持、反对还是中立于某些特定目标，比如公共政策或社会问题。虽然预训练的语言模型在姿态检测方面取得了显著进步，但它们仍然容易受到对抗性攻击的影响——这种攻击方式能够保持文本的语义完整性，但却会导致错误的预测结果。对于姿态检测来说，这类漏洞尚未得到充分研究。在这项研究中，我们提出了StanceAttack这一创新的对抗性攻击方法，该方法利用ChatGPT生成能够误导训练有素的姿态检测模型的对抗样本。我们通过在两个基准数据集上对最先进的语言模型进行攻击来测试我们的攻击模型。实验结果表明，StanceAttack的准确率更高，所需重试次数也更少。人工评估也证实，我们的对抗样本保留了原文的语义含义和自然性。我们的代码和数据可以在https://github.com/chenyez/StanceAttack下载。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: MEAV: Model Editing with Alignment Vectors for inference time LLM alignment in single and multidomain preference spectrum
papers.title_zh: MEAV：使用对齐向量进行模型编辑，以实现在单域或多域偏好谱中的大语言模型对齐，为推理时刻做好准备
papers.authors: Sadat Shahriar, Zheng Qi, Nikolaos Pappas, Srikanth Doss, Kishaloy Halder, Monica Sunkara, Manuel Mager, Yassine Benajiba
papers.abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLM) to address subjectivity and nuanced preference levels requires adequate flexibility and control, which can be a resource-intensive and time-consuming procedure. Existing training-time alignment methods require full re-training when a change is needed and inference-time ones typically require access to the reward model at each inference step. We introduce MEAV, an inference-time model-editing-based LLM alignment method that learns encoded representations of preference dimensions, called Alignment Vectors (AV). These representations enable dynamic adjusting of the model behavior during inference through simple linear operations. Here, we focus on three gradual response levels across three specialized domains: medical, legal, and financial, exemplifying its practical potential. This new alignment paradigm introduces adjustable preference knobs during inference, allowing users to tailor their LLM outputs while reducing the inference cost by half compared to the prompt engineering approach. Additionally, we find that AVs are transferable across different fine-tuning stages of the same model, demonstrating their flexibility. AVs also facilitate multidomain, diverse preference alignment, making the process 12x faster than the retraining approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了使大语言模型能够处理主观性和细微的偏好差异，需要具备足够的灵活性和控制能力。然而，这一过程往往非常耗时且需要大量资源。现有的训练时对齐方法在需要修改时需要进行全面重新训练，而推理时的对齐方法则通常需要在每个推理步骤中访问奖励模型。我们提出了MEAV这种基于推理时模型编辑的大语言模型对齐方法，该方法能够学习到偏好维度的编码表示，这些表示被称为对齐向量。这些表示使得在推理过程中可以通过简单的线性操作来动态调整模型的行为。在这里，我们重点关注了三个专业领域中的三种渐进式响应水平：医学、法律和金融领域，以此来展示其实际潜力。这种新的对齐范式在推理过程中引入了可调节的偏好参数，使用户能够定制他们的语言模型输出，同时比提示工程方法减少了一半的推理成本。此外，我们发现对齐向量可以在同一模型的不同微调阶段之间传递，这充分体现了它们的灵活性。对齐向量还促进了跨领域的多样化偏好对齐，使得该过程的效率是重新训练方法的12倍。

papers.title: BioVLM: Routing Prompts, Not Parameters, for Cross-Modality Generalization in Biomedical VLMs
papers.title_zh: BioVLM：在生物医学视觉语言模型中的跨模态泛化问题，采用路由提示而非参数来解决
papers.authors: Mainak Singha, Tanisha Gupta, Ankit Jha, Muhammad Haris Khan, Sayantani Ghosh, Biplab Banerjee
papers.abstract: Pretrained biomedical vision–language models (VLMs) such as BioMedCLIP perform well on average but often degrade on challenging modalities where inter-class margins are small and acquisition-specific variations are pronounced, especially under few-shot supervision and when modality priors differ from pretraining corpora substantially. We propose BioVLM, a prompt-learning framework that improves cross-domain generalization without extensive backbone fine-tuning. BioVLM learns a diverse prompt bank and introduces dynamic prompt selection: for each input, it selects the most discriminative prompts via a low-entropy criterion on the predictive distribution, effectively coupling sparse few-shot evidence with rich LLM semantic priors. To strengthen this coupling, we distill high-confidence LLM-derived attributes and enforce robust knowledge transfer through strong/weak augmentation consistency. At test time, BioVLM adapts by choosing modality-appropriate prompts, enabling transfer to unseen categories and domains, while keeping training lightweight and inference efficient. On 11 MedMNIST+ 2D datasets, BioVLM achieves new state of the art across three distinct generalization settings. Codes are available at https://github.com/mainaksingha01/BioVLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 预训练的生物医学视觉-语言模型，如BioMedCLIP，在平均水平上表现良好，但在那些类别间界限较窄、特定模态的变异显著的复杂任务中表现会下降，尤其是在少量样本的监督下，或者当不同模态的先验与训练时的语料库有很大差异时。我们提出了BioVLM这一基于提示学习的框架，它能够在不进行大量主干网络微调的情况下提升跨域泛化能力。BioVLM通过学习多样化的提示库，并引入动态提示选择机制：对于每一个输入，它通过低熵准则从预测分布中选择最具区分性的提示，从而将稀疏的少量样本证据与丰富的LLM语义先验相结合。为了加强这种结合，我们提取了来自LLM的高置信度属性，并通过强/弱增强的一致性机制确保知识的稳健传递。在测试阶段，BioVLM通过选择适合该模态的提示来适应新环境，从而实现向未见类别和领域的迁移，同时保持训练过程简洁且推理效率较高。在11个MedMNIST+ 2D数据集上，BioVLM在三种不同的泛化环境下取得了新的最佳成绩。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/mainaksingha01/BioVLM。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SCALE: Upscaled Continual Learning of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 规模：大规模语言模型的连续学习，通过放大模型来处理更大的数据量
papers.authors: Jin-woo Lee, Junhwa Choi, Bongkyu Hwang, Jinho Choo, Bogun Kim, Jeongseon Yi, Joonseok Lee, DongYoung Jung, Jaeseon Park, Kyoungwon Park, Suk-hoon Jung
papers.abstract: We revisit continual pre-training for large language models and argue that progress now depends less on scaling parameters than on scaling the right structure. We introduce SCALE, a width upscaling architecture that inserts lightweight expansions into linear modules while freezing all pre-trained parameters, preserving residual and attention topologies and increasing capacity without perturbing the base model’s original functionality. SCALE follows two principles: Persistent Preservation, which maintains the base model’s behavior via preservation-oriented initialization and freezing of the pre-trained weights, and Collaborative Adaptation, which trains only selected expansion components to acquire new knowledge with minimal interference. We instantiate these ideas as SCALE-Preserve (preservation-first), SCALE-Adapt (adaptation-first), and SCALE-Route, an optional routing extension that performs token-level routing between preservation and adaptation heads. On a controlled synthetic biography benchmark, SCALE reduces the severe forgetting seen in depth expansion while still learning new knowledge. In continual pre-training on a Korean corpus, SCALE variants forget less on English evaluations and achieve competitive gains on Korean benchmarks, yielding the best overall stability-plasticity trade-off. We further analyze when preservation holds provably and why combining preservation and adaptation stabilizes optimization relative to standard continual learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了大语言模型的持续预训练技术，认为如今的进展更多地依赖于正确的结构设计，而非扩展参数。我们提出了SCALE架构，该架构在冻结所有预训练参数的同时，向线性模块中插入轻量级扩展组件，从而保留残差结构和注意力机制，同时提升模型能力，而不破坏基础模型原有的功能。SCALE遵循两个原则：持久性保留，通过定向初始化和冻结预训练权重来维护基础模型的行为；协作式适应，仅对选定的扩展组件进行训练，以最小干扰的方式获取新知识。我们将这些理念具体化为SCALE-Preserve（先保留）、SCALE-Adapt（先适应）以及SCALE-Route，后者是一种可选的路由扩展机制，可在保留层和适应层之间执行令牌级路由。在一项受控的合成传记基准测试中，SCALE能够在学习新知识的同时，减少深度扩展导致的严重遗忘现象。在韩语语料库的持续预训练中，SCALE变体在英语评估中的遗忘情况较少，并且在韩语基准测试中也取得了有竞争力的性能提升，整体实现了最佳的稳定性与可塑性平衡。我们还分析了持久性保留的有效性，以及为什么结合保留和适应能够比标准的持续学习方式更稳定地优化模型。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Words that make SENSE: Sensorimotor Norms in Learned Lexical Token Representations
papers.title_zh: 具有意义的词汇：在习得的词汇表示中体现的感觉运动规范
papers.authors: Abhinav Gupta, Toben Mintz, Jesse Thomason
papers.abstract: While word embeddings derive meaning from co-occurrence patterns, human language understanding is grounded in sensory and motor experience. We present \mathit{SENSE} (\textbf{S}ensorimotor \textbf{E}mbedding \textbf{N}orm \textbf{S}coring \textbf{E}ngine), a learned projection model that predicts Lancaster sensorimotor norms from word lexical embeddings. We also conducted a behavioral study where 281 participants selected which among candidate nonce words evoked specific sensorimotor associations, finding statistically significant correlations between human selection rates and \mathit{SENSE} ratings across 6 of the 11 modalities. Sublexical analysis of these nonce word selection rates revealed systematic phonesthemic patterns for the interoceptive norm, suggesting a path towards computationally proposing candidate phonesthemes from text data.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然词嵌入是从共现模式中衍生出意义的，但人类的语言理解则基于感官和运动经验。我们提出了$\mathit{SENSE}$（感觉运动嵌入规范评分引擎），这是一种学习到的投影模型，它能够从词词汇嵌入中预测出兰开斯特感觉运动规范。我们还进行了一项行为研究，共有281名参与者负责选择那些能够引发特定感觉运动联想的候选非名词词，研究发现，在11种模态中，人类的选择率与$\mathit{SENSE}$的评分之间存在统计学上的显著相关性。对这些非名词词选择率的子词汇级分析揭示了关于内感受规范的系统性音义模式，这为从文本数据中计算出候选音义主题提供了可能性的途径。

papers.title: Interpreting Style Representations via Style-Eliciting Prompts
papers.title_zh: 通过风格引导式提示来解读风格表征
papers.authors: Junghwan Kim, David Jurgens
papers.abstract: Style representation learning is a powerful tool for authorship analysis and modeling writing style, yet the latent nature of learned representations makes them difficult to interpret. Recent work has attempted to explain these representations by generating natural language descriptions with large language models (LLMs) conditioned on input text. However, such descriptions are often prone to the LLM’s biases and hallucinations, and they lack an explicit objective and practical utility. In this work, we propose a novel framework for interpreting style representations through style-eliciting prompts: natural language instructions designed to steer LLMs to generate text that reflects specific stylistic attributes. We curate 1,010 distinct style features spanning 26 stylistic categories and construct a dataset by prompting an LLM to generate text conditioned on these features. Using this data, we train a decoder to generate a style prompt from the style representation of the generated text. We evaluate our approach on three tasks: (1) recovering original style prompts from generated text, (2) generating text in the same style using the recovered prompts, and (3) steering LLM outputs to match the style of human-written texts. Experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines that directly prompt LLMs with target text, achieving superior performance in both style description and style imitation. These results highlight style-eliciting prompts can provide a practical and interpretable interface to stylistic information encoded in style representations.
papers.abstract_zh: 风格表征学习是分析作者身份和建模写作风格的强大工具，然而，所学习的表征具有潜在性，这使得它们难以被解释。最近的研究试图通过利用大语言模型生成自然语言描述来解释这些表征，但这些描述往往容易受到语言模型的偏见和幻觉的影响，而且它们缺乏明确的目标和实际用途。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，通过引导式提示来解读风格表征：这些自然语言指令旨在引导语言模型生成具有特定风格属性的文本。我们收集了1,010个不同的风格特征，涵盖26个风格类别，并通过引导语言模型根据这些特征生成文本来构建数据集。利用这些数据，我们训练了一个解码器，可以从生成的文本的风格表征中生成风格提示。我们在三个任务上评估了我们的方法：(1)从生成的文本中恢复原始的风格提示；(2)使用恢复的提示生成具有相同风格的文本；(3)引导语言模型的输出以匹配人类书写文本的风格。实验表明，我们的方法始终优于那些直接使用目标文本引导语言模型的强大基线方法，在风格描述和风格模仿方面都取得了更好的性能。这些结果表明，引导式提示可以为理解编码在风格表征中的风格信息提供一个实用且可解释的接口。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Optimizing Conversational Quality in Spoken Dialogue Systems with Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback
papers.title_zh: 利用人工智能反馈的强化学习技术，优化口语对话系统的对话质量
papers.authors: Siddhant Arora, Jinchuan Tian, Jiatong Shi, Hayato Futami, Yosuke Kashiwagi, Emiru Tsunoo, Shinji Watanabe
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human or AI feedback (RLHF/RLAIF) for speech-in/speech-out dialogue systems (SDS) remains underexplored, with prior work largely limited to single semantic rewards applied at the utterance level. Such setups overlook the multi-dimensional and multi-modal nature of conversational quality, which encompasses semantic coherence, audio naturalness, speaker consistency, emotion alignment, and turn-taking behavior. Moreover, they are fundamentally mismatched with duplex spoken dialogue systems that generate responses incrementally, where agents must make decisions based on partial utterances. We address these limitations with the first multi-reward RLAIF framework for SDS, combining semantic, audio-quality, and emotion-consistency rewards. To align utterance-level preferences with incremental, blockwise decoding in duplex models, we apply turn-level preference sampling and aggregate per-block log-probabilities within a single DPO objective. We present the first systematic study of preference learning for improving SDS quality in both multi-turn Chain-of-Thought and blockwise duplex models, and release a multi-reward DPO dataset to support reproducible research. Experiments show that single-reward RLAIF selectively improves its targeted metric, while joint multi-reward training yields consistent gains across semantic quality and audio naturalness. These results highlight the importance of holistic, multi-reward alignment for practical conversational SDS.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于人类或人工智能反馈的强化学习（RLHF/RLAIF）在语音输入/语音输出对话系统中的应用尚未得到充分探索。以往的研究主要局限于在语句层面施加单一语义奖励。这些方法忽略了对话质量的多维性和多模态特性，其中包括语义连贯性、音频自然度、说话者一致性、情感匹配以及轮话行为等要素。此外，这些方法与双语音对话系统存在根本性的差异，因为双语音系统是以增量方式生成响应的，而智能体必须基于部分响应做出决策。我们提出了首个用于对话系统的多奖励RLAIF框架，结合了语义奖励、音频质量奖励和情感一致性奖励。为了将语句层面的偏好与双语音模型中的增量式、分块解码方式相结合，我们采用了轮次级偏好采样方法，并将每个分块的对数概率汇总到单一的DPO目标中。我们首次系统地研究了如何通过学习偏好来提高对话系统的质量，涵盖了多轮思维链模型和分块双语音模型两种架构。同时，我们还发布了一个包含多种奖励的DPO数据集，以支持可重复性的研究。实验表明，单一奖励的RLAIF能够有针对性地改善特定指标，而联合使用多种奖励则能在语义质量和音频自然度方面实现一致性的提升。这些结果凸显了在实用化的语音对话系统中，整体多奖励对齐策略的重要性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Conceptual Hierarchies within LLMs
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型中的概念层级结构
papers.authors: Tiago Almeida, Zining Zhu, Yue Ning
papers.abstract: While it is widely agreed that large language models (LLMs) store concepts from multiple semantic hierarchies, much remains unknown regarding the structure of this storage. The correspondence between the functional roles of LLM components and the semantic hierarchies of knowledge remains underexplored in the current literature. For example, is information organized hierarchically within sections of an LLM? We take an initial step towards causally examining the correspondence between hierarchical concepts and the multi-granular structures (layers and attention heads) of various models. Specifically, we generate a dataset of semantic hierarchies and investigate their storage locations in six LLMs using activation patching, a causal intervention technique. At the layer level, our findings show a moderate indication that concepts at finer levels of granularity are stored around 61-78% of the time (p < 0.01) before those at coarser granularity. There is evidence for this trend at the attention level; however, the high variability in attention level results suggests that concepts are stored across attention heads rather than within. Our results offer insight into semantic organization within LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然普遍认为大语言模型会存储来自多个语义层次的概念，但关于这种存储结构的具体机制，仍有许多未知之处。目前的相关文献中，对语言模型各组件的功能角色与知识语义层次之间的对应关系研究尚不充分。例如，信息在语言模型的各个部分中是否是以层次化的方式组织的呢？我们试图通过因果分析来探讨层次化概念与各种模型的多粒度结构（如不同层级的模块和注意力机制）之间的关系。具体来说，我们生成了一个语义层次结构的数据集，并使用激活拼接这一因果干预技术，来研究这些数据在六种语言模型中的存储位置。在层级层面，我们的研究发现表明，较细粒度的概念大约有61%-78%的时间被存储起来（p < 0.01），而较粗粒度的概念则较少被存储。在注意力层面也出现了类似的趋势；不过，注意力层面的高变异性表明，概念实际上是分布在不同的注意力机制中，而不是被集中存储在某个单一区域内。我们的研究结果为我们理解语言模型内部的语义组织提供了有价值的见解。

papers.title: Conjecture and Inquiry: Quantifying Software Performance Requirements via Interactive Retrieval-Augmented Preference Elicitation
papers.title_zh: 猜想与探究：通过交互式检索增强的偏好引导方法来量化软件性能需求
papers.authors: Shihai Wang, Tao Chen
papers.abstract: Since software performance requirements are documented in natural language, quantifying them into mathematical forms is essential for software engineering. Yet, the vagueness in performance requirements and uncertainty of human cognition have caused highly uncertain ambiguity in the interpretations, rendering their automated quantification an unaddressed and challenging problem. In this paper, we formalize the problem and propose IRAP, an approach that quantifies performance requirements into mathematical functions via interactive retrieval-augmented preference elicitation. IRAP differs from the others in that it explicitly derives from problem-specific knowledge to retrieve and reason the preferences, which also guides the progressive interaction with stakeholders, while reducing the cognitive overhead. Experiment results against 10 state-of-the-art methods on four real-world datasets demonstrate the superiority of IRAP on all cases with up to 40x improvements under as few as five rounds of interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于软件性能要求是以自然语言形式记录的，因此将其转化为数学形式对于软件工程来说至关重要。然而，性能要求的模糊性以及人类认知的不确定性导致了解释上的高度不确定性，这使得自动化量化这些要求成为一个难以解决且充满挑战性的问题。在本文中，我们对该问题进行了形式化描述，并提出了IRAP方法。该方法通过交互式检索增强的偏好引导方式，将性能要求转化为数学函数。与其他方法不同的是，IRAP能够明确地基于特定问题的知识来检索和推理各种偏好，同时还能指导与利益相关者的逐步互动，从而减少了认知负担。在四个真实世界数据集上针对10种先进方法的实验结果表明，IRAP在所有情况下的表现都优于其他方法，且在仅五轮互动的情况下就能实现高达40倍的性能提升。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Measuring Large Language Models’ Adversarial Behavior in Social Deduction Games
papers.title_zh: 测量大型语言模型在社交推理游戏中的对抗行为
papers.authors: Marissa Zhao Li, Esha Shivakumar, Peiran Wang, Ying Li, Yuan Tian
papers.abstract: As large language models are increasingly adopted and trusted in real-world applications, understanding their behavior beyond single-turn prompting has become critical. Existing safety evaluations primarily focus on refusal-based methods that test whether models avoid responding to inappropriate or violent requests, leaving open questions about how models behave in interactive social settings. In this paper, we observe the adversarial behavior of LLM models through a multi-agent simulation across five diverse social deduction conversational games, acting as testbeds that provide social pressures and survival stress based on game design without explicit prompt injections. From these interactions, we construct a closed behavioral taxonomy derived through open card sorting, applied uniformly across models using a meta-LLM for behavior labeling. This approach displays that models exhibit distinct behavioral profiles and that models’ different ways of structured deliberation influence both social stability and competitive success.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型在现实应用中的广泛应用和被广泛信任，理解它们的行为而不仅仅是单次提示变得至关重要。现有的安全评估主要依赖于基于拒绝的方法，这些方法测试模型是否避免回应不适当或暴力的请求，但并未探讨模型在互动社交环境中的行为表现。在本文中，我们通过多智能体模拟技术，在五种不同的社交推理对话游戏中观察了LLM模型的对抗性行为。这些游戏作为测试平台，根据游戏设计提供了社交压力和生存挑战，而无需明确输入提示信息。通过这些互动，我们构建了一个封闭的行为分类体系，该体系通过开放卡片排序法得出，并采用元LLM对模型的行为进行标注。这种方法表明，模型表现出不同的行为特征，而模型在结构化审议方面的不同方式影响着社交稳定性和竞争胜负。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: ChangJuan: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Book-Length Chinese Story Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 长娟：一种用于评估长篇中文故事的全面标准
papers.authors: Dingyi Yang, Mingshuo Wang, Qin Jin
papers.abstract: Automatic evaluation of book-length stories remains underexplored, particularly for non-English literature. We introduce ChangJuan, the first benchmark for book-length Chinese story evaluation, comprising 300 novels with metadata, human ratings, and large-scale user reviews. To mitigate the subjectivity of raw reviews, we propose a distillation method to aggregate them into generally agreed viewpoints (pros and cons) across key evaluation aspects such as plot and character. We conduct systematic experiments to benchmark current LLMs, analyze aspect importance, and examine genre differences. For book-length story evaluation, we propose an enhanced summary-based method that leverages length-detail balanced summaries and representative excerpts, generates aspect-specific reviews, and considers genre-aware aspect weighting to assign a final score. Using this framework and our distilled viewpoints, we fine-tune an 8B model, CLEM, which outperforms open-source baselines and raises Qwen3’s Kendall’s tau correlation with human judgments from 24.8 to 34.1. Our datasets and codes are available at https://github.com/DingyiYang/ChangJuan.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于长篇小说的自动评估仍然缺乏深入研究，尤其是在非英语文学领域。我们推出了ChangJuan，这是首个用于评估中文长篇小说的基准平台，该平台包含300部小说的元数据、人类评分以及大量用户评论。为了减轻原始评论的主观性，我们提出了一种整合方法，将这些评论汇总为在关键评估维度（如情节和人物）上普遍认可的观点（优缺点）。我们通过系统性的实验来对比当前大语言模型的表现，分析各个方面的重要性，并探讨不同类型小说之间的差异。在长篇小说评估方面，我们提出了一种改进的基于摘要的方法，该方法利用长短平衡的摘要和代表性片段，生成针对各个方面的评论，并考虑与体裁相关的权重因素来给出最终评分。利用这一框架和我们总结的观点，我们优化了一个8B参数的模型CLEM，其表现优于开源基线模型，并将Qwen3的Kendall's tau相关性从24.8提升到了34.1。我们的数据集和代码可以在https://github.com/DingyiYang/ChangJuan下载。

papers.title: Progressive Re-ranking for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Curriculum Learning
papers.title_zh: 基于课程学习的多模态检索增强生成中的渐进式重新排序方法
papers.authors: Zhu Min, Yanchao Hao, Jian Liu, Shizhu He, Xi Chen
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can enhance large language models (LLMs) by providing external knowledge and helping reduce hallucinations. In multimodal RAG, however, retrieval remains challenging because a single retriever may fail to capture fine-grained multimodal semantics, and visually or semantically similar entities may still contain misleading information for answer generation. We propose a progressive multimodal re-ranking framework with curriculum learning to improve CLIP-based visual coarse-grained retrieval. Our framework progressively refines retrieval results through two stages: fine-grained section-level re-ranking and multimodal section reassessment. To better align re-ranking with multimodal queries, we introduce a curriculum-learning strategy that trains the model with hard negatives that are visually or semantically similar but contain misleading information. Experiments on InfoSeek and Enc-VQA show that our method achieves state-of-the-art answer accuracy and competitive retrieval performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成技术可以通过提供外部知识来帮助减少幻觉现象，从而提升大语言模型的能力。然而，在多模态检索增强生成中，检索仍然面临挑战——因为单一的检索机制可能无法捕捉到多模态的细粒度语义信息，而视觉上或语义上相似的实体仍可能包含误导性的信息，从而影响答案的生成。我们提出了一种渐进式多模态重新排序框架，结合课程学习机制，以改进基于CLIP的视觉粗粒度检索效果。我们的框架通过两个阶段逐步优化检索结果：细粒度的段落级重新排序以及多模态段落的重新评估。为了更好地将重新排序与多模态查询相结合，我们采用了一种课程学习策略，该策略使用视觉或语义上相似但包含误导信息的难例来训练模型。在InfoSeek和Enc-VQA上的实验表明，我们的方法取得了领先级的答案准确率和具有竞争力的检索性能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Confidence-Weighted Token Set Cover for Early Hypothesis Pruning in Self-Consistency
papers.title_zh: 基于置信度的令牌集覆盖算法，用于自我一致性框架中的早期假设剪枝
papers.authors: Md Arafat Sultan, Ramón Fernandez Astudillo
papers.abstract: Despite its simplicity and efficacy, the high token expenditure of self-consistency can limit its practical utility. We investigate whether early hypothesis pruning can improve the token efficiency of self-consistency for long chain-of-thought reasoning tasks, while preserving its parallelism. Concretely, we generate all solutions in parallel but periodically prune intermediate hypotheses based on two lightweight indicators: (a) the model’s confidence in each hypothesis, and (b) the lexical coverage of all current hypotheses by candidate subsets. We design a fast weighted set cover algorithm that utilizes the two indicators; evaluation of five LLMs on three math benchmarks shows that our method improves token efficiency in most cases, with reductions of 10-35% in many.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管自我一致性方法结构简单且效果显著，但其高昂的代币成本可能会限制其实际应用价值。我们研究早期假设剪枝是否能够提高自我一致性方法在长链思维推理任务中的代币使用效率，同时保留其并行性。具体来说，我们并行生成所有解决方案，但会定期根据两个简单的指标来剪除中间假设：(a)模型对每个假设的置信度；(b)所有当前假设所覆盖的词汇范围。我们设计了一种快速的加权集覆盖算法，该算法利用了这两个指标。通过对五个大语言模型在三个数学基准测试中的性能进行评估，我们发现我们的方法在大多数情况下都能提高代币使用效率，许多情况下的代币使用效率降低了10-35%。

papers.title: MMTabReal: Real-World Benchmark for Multimodal Table Understanding
papers.title_zh: MMTabReal：多模态表格理解的真实场景测试
papers.authors: Prasham Yatinkumar Titiya, Jainil Trivedi, Chitta Baral, Vivek Gupta
papers.abstract: Multimodal tables i.e. tabular layouts interleaved with charts, maps, icons, and color encodings are ubiquitous in real applications yet remain difficult for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Despite advances in text and image understanding, systematic evaluation of table-centric multimodal reasoning is limited. We introduce MMTabReal, a MultiModal Table Benchmark, human-curated suite of 500 real-world tables paired with 4021 question–answer pairs. MMtabReal spans four question types, five reasoning categories, and eight structural archetypes. Evaluations of state-of-the-art models reveal substantial gaps, especially in visual grounding, spatial alignment, and multi-step inference, with 20–40% performance drops relative to existing benchmarks. These results highlight the need for architectures that more tightly fuse vision with tabular structure and support explicit numeric/logical operations. MMtabReal is released for evaluation only, providing a rigorous, reproducible testbed that reflects the linguistic, structural, and reasoning complexity of real-world multimodal tables. Code and data are available at: https://coral-lab-asu.github.io/mmtabreal/
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态表格，即结合了图表、地图、图标和颜色编码的表格布局，在实际应用中非常常见，但对于多模态大语言模型来说仍然难以处理。尽管在文本和图像理解方面取得了进展，但对以表格为中心的多模态推理的系统评估仍然有限。我们提出了MMTabReal，这是一个多模态表格基准测试，包含500个真实世界的表格以及4021对问题-答案对。MMTabReal涵盖了四种问题类型、五种推理类别和八种结构原型。对最先进模型的评估显示，它们在视觉定位、空间对齐和多步推理方面存在显著差距，与现有基准测试相比，性能下降了20%到40%。这些结果凸显了需要能够更紧密地将视觉信息与表格结构结合在一起的架构，并支持明确的数值/逻辑运算。MMTabReal仅用于评估目的，提供了一个严谨且可复现的测试平台，能够反映真实世界多模态表格的语言学、结构和推理复杂性。代码和数据可在以下链接获取：https://coral-lab-asu.github.io/mmtabreal/
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Inject to Heal: Alleviating hallucination in LVLMs via Context Embedding Injection
papers.title_zh: 通过上下文嵌入技术缓解大型语言模型中的幻觉现象：Inject to Heal
papers.authors: Mehrdad Fazli, Bowen Wei, Ziwei Zhu
papers.abstract: Hallucinations—generating responses inconsistent with the visual input—remain a critical limitation of large vision-language models (LVLMs), especially in open-ended tasks such as image captioning and visual reasoning. In this work, we probe the layer-wise generation dynamics that drive hallucinations and propose a training-free mitigation strategy. Employing the Logit Lens, we examine how LVLMs construct next-token distributions across decoder layers, uncovering a pronounced commitment-depth gap: truthful tokens accumulate probability mass on their final candidates earlier than hallucinatory ones. Drawing on this discovery, we introduce Context Embedding injection (CEI), a lightweight method that harnesses the hidden state of the last input token—the context embedding—as a grounding signal to maintain visual fidelity throughout decoding and curb hallucinations. Evaluated on the CHAIR, AMBER, and MMHal-Bench benchmarks (with a maximum token length of 512), CEI outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across three LVLMs, with its dynamic variant yielding the lowest overall hallucination rates. By integrating novel mechanistic insights with a scalable intervention, this work advances the mitigation of hallucinations in LVLMs. Data and code are available at https://github.com/mehrdadfazli/CEI.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉现象——即产生与视觉输入不符的反应的现象——仍然是大型视觉语言模型的一个重要限制，尤其是在图像描述任务和视觉推理等开放性问题上。本研究探讨了导致幻觉现象的逐层生成机制，并提出了一种无需训练的缓解策略。通过运用Logit Lens技术，我们分析了大型视觉语言模型如何在不同解码层构建下一个词的概率分布，发现了一个显著的承诺深度差异：真实信息对应的词在最终候选词上积累的概率质量要高于幻觉信息对应的词。基于这一发现，我们提出了上下文嵌入注入法（CEI），这是一种轻量级方法，它利用最后一个输入词所包含的隐藏状态——即上下文嵌入——作为引导信号，以在解码过程中保持视觉的真实性，从而减少幻觉现象的发生。在CHAIR、AMBER和MMHal-Bench基准测试平台上进行了评估（最大词长可达512），结果表明，CEI在三种大型视觉语言模型中均优于现有最佳基线算法，而其动态变体则表现出最低的整体幻觉率。通过将新的机制性见解与可扩展的干预措施相结合，本研究为改善大型视觉语言模型的幻觉问题提供了有效的解决方案。相关数据代码可访问https://github.com/mehrdadfazli/CEI。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Colorful Talks with Graphs: Human-Interpretable Graph Encodings for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 带有图结构的多彩对话：适用于大型语言模型的人类可理解图编码方式
papers.authors: Angelo Zangari, Peyman Baghershahi, Sourav Medya
papers.abstract: Graph problems are fundamentally challenging for large language models (LLMs). While LLMs excel at processing unstructured text, graph tasks require reasoning over explicit structure, permutation invariance, and computationally complex relationships, creating a mismatch with the representations of text-based models. Our work investigates how LLMs can be effectively applied to graph problems despite these barriers. We introduce a human-interpretable structural encoding strategy for graph-to-text translation that injects graph structure directly into natural language prompts. Our method involves computing a variant of Weisfeiler–Lehman (WL) similarity classes and maps them to human-like color tokens rather than numeric labels. The key insight is that semantically meaningful and human-interpretable cues may be more effectively processed by LLMs than opaque symbolic encoding. Experimental results across multiple graph algorithms and predictive tasks show significant improvements from our method on both synthetic and real-world datasets. By capturing both local and global-range dependencies, our method enhances LLM performance, especially on graph tasks that require reasoning over global graph structure.
papers.abstract_zh: 图类问题对大语言模型来说本质上是一个挑战。虽然大语言模型在处理非结构化文本方面表现出色，但图类任务需要针对明确的结构、排列不变性以及计算上复杂的关联关系进行推理，这与基于文本的模型的表示方式存在不匹配之处。我们的研究旨在探讨如何克服这些障碍，有效地将大语言模型应用于图类问题。我们提出了一种人类可理解的结构化编码策略，用于将图结构直接注入到自然语言提示中。该方法通过计算Weisfeiler–Lehman相似性类别的变体，并将它们映射到类似人类的颜色标记上，而不是数字标签。关键之处在于，语义上有意义且易于人类理解的线索，可能比晦涩的符号编码更容易被大语言模型处理。在多种图算法和预测任务中的实验结果表明，我们的方法在合成数据和真实世界数据集中都取得了显著的改进。通过捕捉局部和全局范围的依赖关系，我们的方法提升了大语言模型的性能，尤其是在需要推理全局图结构的图类任务中。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: SAM-NER: Semantic Archetype Mediation for Zero-Shot Named Entity Recognition
papers.title_zh: SAM-NER：用于零样本命名实体识别的语义原型调解技术
papers.authors: Ruichu Cai, Juntao Gan, Miao Mai, Zhifeng Hao, Boyan Xu
papers.abstract: Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition (ZS-NER) remains brittle under domain and schema shifts, where unseen label definitions often misalign with a large language model’s (LLM’s) intrinsic semantic organization. As a result, directly mapping entity mentions to fine-grained target labels can induce systematic semantic drift, especially when target schemas are novel or semantically overlapping. We propose SAM-NER, a three-stage framework based on Semantic Archetype Mediation that stabilizes cross-domain transfer through an intermediate, domain-invariant archetype space. SAM-NER: (i) performs Entity Discovery via cooperative extraction and consensus-based denoising to obtain high-coverage, high-fidelity entity spans; (ii) conducts Abstract Mediation by projecting entities into a compact set of universal semantic archetypes distilled from high-level ontological abstractions; and (iii) applies Semantic Calibration to resolve archetype-level predictions into target-domain types through constrained, definition-aligned inference with a frozen LLM. Experiments on the CrossNER benchmark show that SAM-NER consistently outperforms strong prior ZS-NER baselines in cross-domain settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 零样本命名实体识别技术（ZS-NER）在跨领域和模式变化的情况下仍然表现不稳定。在这种情况下，未见过的标签定义往往与大语言模型的内在语义结构不一致。因此，直接将实体提及映射到细粒度的目标标签会导致系统性的语义漂移，尤其是在目标模式新颖或语义重叠时。我们提出了SAM-NER这一三阶段框架，该框架基于语义原型中介机制，通过一种中间层、跨领域的原型空间来稳定跨领域的迁移过程。SAM-NER的具体步骤如下：(i) 通过协作提取和基于共识的去噪算法进行实体发现，从而获得覆盖率高、精度高的实体范围；(ii) 通过将实体投影到一组由高级本体抽象得出的通用语义原型中，进行抽象中介处理；(iii) 通过受限的、符合定义的推理过程，将原型级别的预测结果转化为目标领域的类型。在CrossNER基准测试上的实验表明，SAM-NER在跨领域环境下始终优于现有的强基线ZS-NER技术。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: DRPG (Decompose, Retrieve, Plan, Generate): An Agentic Framework for Academic Rebuttal
papers.title_zh: DRPG（分解、检索、规划、生成）：一种用于学术反驳的代理框架
papers.authors: Peixuan Han, YingJie Yu, Jingjun Xu, Jiaxuan You
papers.abstract: Despite the growing adoption of large language models (LLMs) in scientific research workflows, automated support for academic rebuttal, a crucial step in academic communication and peer review, remains largely underexplored. Existing approaches typically rely on off-the-shelf LLMs or simple pipelines, which struggle with long-context understanding and often fail to produce targeted and persuasive responses. In this paper, we propose DRPG, an agentic framework for automatic academic rebuttal generation that operates through four steps: Decompose reviews into atomic concerns, Retrieve relevant evidence from the paper, Plan rebuttal strategies, and Generate responses accordingly. Notably, the Planner in DRPG reaches over 98% accuracy in identifying the most feasible rebuttal direction. Experiments on data from top-tier conferences demonstrate that DRPG significantly outperforms existing rebuttal pipelines and achieves performance beyond the average human level using only an 8B model. Our analysis further demonstrates the effectiveness of the planner design and its value in providing multi-perspective and explainable suggestions. We also showed that DRPG works well in a more complex multi-round setting. These results highlight the effectiveness of DRPG and its potential to provide high-quality rebuttal content and support the scaling of academic discussions.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在科学研究工作流程中的应用日益广泛，但针对学术反驳的自动化支持——这是学术交流和同行评审中至关重要的一步——却仍然鲜有研究。现有的方法通常依赖于现成的语言模型或简单的处理流程，这些方法在理解长文本上下文方面存在困难，往往无法生成有针对性和有说服力的回应。在本文中，我们提出了DRPG这一自动学术反驳生成框架，该框架通过四个步骤实现：将评论分解为具体的关注点、从论文中提取相关证据、规划反驳策略，以及据此生成回应。值得注意的是，DRPG中的规划器在识别最可行的反驳方向方面达到了98%以上的准确率。在顶级会议的数据上进行实验表明，DRPG显著优于现有的反驳处理流程，仅使用8B规模的模型就能达到超越人类平均水平的表现。我们的分析进一步证明了规划器设计的有效性及其在提供多视角且可解释性建议方面的价值。此外，我们还发现DRPG在更复杂的多轮对话环境中也能表现出良好的性能。这些结果凸显了DRPG的有效性，以及它提供高质量反驳内容并支持学术讨论扩展的潜力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
