papers.title: BiasGRPO: Stabilizing Bias Mitigation in High-Variance Reward Landscapes via Group-Relative Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: BiasGRPO：通过群体相对策略优化来稳定高方差奖励场景中的偏差缓解问题
papers.authors: Saket Reddy, Ke Yang, ChengXiang Zhai
papers.abstract: Mitigating social bias in Large Language Models (LLMs) presents a distinct alignment challenge: unlike verifiable tasks, social bias lacks a single ground truth, creating a high-variance, subjective reward landscape. Previous preference-based fine-tuning methods have major trade-offs: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is limited by the lack of exploration inherent in offline training, while Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) can lead to training instability due to potentially unreliable critic estimates. In this paper, we propose BiasGRPO, an adaptation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that stabilizes alignment by normalizing rewards across a group of sampled completions. By substituting the value function with a group-relative baseline, our approach reduces instability while maintaining the exploration benefits of online reinforcement learning. To adapt GRPO, we curate and synthetically extend a dataset spanning multiple domains and contexts, and create a custom, bias-specific reward model for effectively guiding generation while avoiding knowledge degradation. We find that BiasGRPO outperforms DPO and PPO across multiple benchmarks, indicating its effectiveness as an alignment technique that can overcome the limitations of previous preference-based methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型（LLM）中减轻社会偏见面临着独特的对齐挑战：与可验证的任务不同，社会偏见缺乏单一的真实值，因此会产生高方差、主观的奖励体系。以往基于偏好的微调方法存在重大权衡问题：直接偏好优化（DPO）因离线训练过程中缺乏探索而受到限制，而近端策略优化（PPO）则可能因评估者估计的不稳定性而导致训练不稳定。在本文中，我们提出了BiasGRPO这一改进版群体相对策略优化算法。该算法通过跨样本完成的群体对奖励进行标准化，从而稳定模型的对齐效果。通过将价值函数替换为群体相对的基线，我们的方法既减少了训练中的不稳定性，又保留了在线强化学习带来的探索优势。为了适应GRPO，我们精心构建并合成了一个涵盖多个领域和情境的数据集，同时创建了一个针对偏见问题的定制奖励模型，以有效指导模型的生成过程，同时避免知识退化问题。实验结果表明，BiasGRPO在多个基准测试中的表现均优于DPO和PPO，这表明它作为一种对齐技术，能够有效克服以往基于偏好方法的局限性。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MaskTab: Scalable Masked Tabular Pretraining with Scaling Laws and Distillation for Industrial Classification
papers.title_zh: MaskTab：可扩展的掩码表格预训练方法，包含缩放规律与蒸馏技术，适用于工业分类领域
papers.authors: Bo Zheng, Yudong Chen, Zihua Xiong, Shuai Fang, Peidong He, Yang Yang, Sheng Guo
papers.abstract: Tabular data forms the backbone of high-stakes decision systems in finance, healthcare, and beyond. Yet industrial tabular datasets are inherently difficult: high-dimensional, riddled with missing entries, and rarely labeled at scale. While foundation models have revolutionized vision and language, tabular learning still leans on handcrafted features and lacks a general self-supervised framework. We present MaskTab, a unified pre-training framework designed specifically for industrial-scale tabular data. MaskTab encodes missing values via dedicated learnable tokens, enabling the model to distinguish structural absence from random dropout. It jointly optimizes a hybrid supervised pre-training scheme—utilizing a twin-path architecture to reconcile masked reconstruction with task-specific supervision—and an MoE-augmented loss that adaptively routes features through specialized subnetworks. On industrial-scale benchmarks, it achieves +5.04% AUC and +8.28% KS over prior art under rigorous scaling. Moreover, its representations distill effectively into lightweight models, yielding +2.55% AUC and +4.85% KS under strict latency and interpretability constraints, while improving robustness to distribution shifts. Our work demonstrates that tabular data admits a foundation-model treatment—when its structural idiosyncrasies are respected.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格数据是金融、医疗等领域高风险决策系统的核心组成部分。然而，工业领域的表格数据集本身具有很大的复杂性：维度高、存在大量缺失值，且很少进行大规模标注。虽然基础模型已经彻底改变了视觉和语言处理的方式，但表格数据的学习仍然依赖于手工构建的特征，缺乏通用的自监督框架。我们提出了MaskTab，这是一个专为工业规模表格数据设计的统一预训练框架。MaskTab通过专门的可学习标记来编码缺失值，使模型能够区分结构上的缺失与随机丢失。该框架同时优化了混合式监督预训练方案——采用双路径架构来结合掩码重建与任务特定的监督——以及一种增强型损失函数，该函数能够自适应地将特征传递到专门的子网络中。在工业规模的基准测试中，该框架在严格的扩展条件下取得了+5.04%的AUC和+8.28%的KS成绩，优于现有技术。此外，其表示方式可以有效地简化为轻量级模型，在严格的延迟和可解释性约束下，仍能取得+2.55%的AUC和+4.85%的KS成绩，同时提高了对分布变化的鲁棒性。我们的研究表明，只要尊重表格数据的结构特性，那么就可以采用基础模型来处理表格数据。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Enhancing Zero-Shot Time Series Forecasting in Off-the-Shelf LLMs via Noise Injection Prompting
papers.title_zh: 通过引入噪声提示来提升现成的大语言模型在零样本时间序列预测方面的性能
papers.authors: Xingyou Yin, Ceyao Zhang, Min Hu, Kai Chen
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated effectiveness as zero-shot time series (TS) forecasters. While existing work often relies on fine-tuning specialized modules to bridge this gap, a distinct, yet challenging, paradigm aims to leverage truly off-the-shelf LLMs without any fine-tuning whatsoever, relying solely on strategic tokenization of numerical sequences. However, the parameters of these fully frozen models cannot adapt to distribution shifts. Thus, we introduce a novel yet highly effective strategy to overcome this brittleness: injecting noise into the raw TS before tokenization. This non-invasive intervention acts as a form of inference-time augmentation, compelling the frozen LLM to extrapolate based on robust underlying temporal patterns rather than superficial numerical artifacts. We theoretically analyze this phenomenon and empirically validate its effectiveness across diverse benchmarks. Notably, to fully eliminate potential biases from data contamination during LLM pre-training, we introduce multiple novel real-world TS datasets that fall outside all utilized LLMs’ pre-training scopes, and consistently observe improved performance. This study provides a further step in directly leveraging off-the-shelf LLMs for TS forecasting[https://github.com/jkumh/NLTS].
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在零样本时间序列预测方面表现出强大的效果。虽然现有的方法通常依赖于对特定模块的微调来弥补这一不足，但有一种独特而具有挑战性的方法，即完全利用现成的语言模型，无需任何微调，只需对数值序列进行策略性标记化处理。然而，这些完全固定的模型的参数无法适应分布的变化。因此，我们提出了一种新颖且高效的解决方案：在标记化之前向原始时间序列中注入噪声。这种非侵入式的干预方式相当于一种推理时间增强机制，迫使固定的语言模型基于稳健的时间模式进行推断，而不是依赖于表面的数值特征。我们通过理论分析验证了这一现象的有效性，并通过多种基准测试对其效果进行了实证验证。值得注意的是，为了完全消除预训练过程中数据污染带来的潜在偏见，我们引入了多个全新的现实世界时间序列数据集，这些数据集超出了所有现有语言模型的预训练范围，并且我们的性能得到了显著提升。这项研究为直接利用现成的语言模型进行时间序列预测提供了进一步的支持[https://github.com/jkumh/NLTS]。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Text Embedding as Treatment: A Meta Causal Approach for Robust Sentiment Classification
papers.title_zh: 文本嵌入作为处理方法：一种用于稳健情感分类的元因果方法
papers.authors: Fengxiang Cheng, Chuan Zhou, Xiang Li, Haoxuan Li, Wen-li Wang, Jinkun Chen, Mingming Gong, Kun Zhang
papers.abstract: Sentiment classification is a crucial task in natural language processing (NLP). To mitigate the spurious correlation, the causal word identification method estimates the impact of treatment words on sentence sentiment and removes those with low treatment effects. However, previous works regard the presence or absence of a specific word in a sentence as a binary treatment. This approach limits the generalizability to novel words and the robustness of low-frequency words. To bridge this gap, we propose a meta-causal approach that achieves causal word identification for arbitrary words with a single training task. Specifically, we begin by clustering contexts based on their embeddings obtained from a pre-trained language model. Subsequently, for each cluster, a representation and multi-head prediction networks are trained to estimate the treatment effect of each word to distinguish causally related words from spuriously correlated ones. The trained word classifier is then used to give weights for different words to train a more robust and generalizable sentiment classification model. Extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in identifying causal words and improving the performance of sentiment classification.
papers.abstract_zh: 情感分类是自然语言处理中的一项关键任务。为了减轻虚假相关性，因果词识别方法会估计处理词对句子情感的影响，并剔除那些影响较小的处理词。然而，以往的研究将句子中某个特定词的存在与否视为二元处理条件。这种方法限制了该方法对新词的泛化能力以及低频词的鲁棒性。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种元因果方法，通过单一的训练任务来实现对任意词的因果词识别。具体来说，我们首先根据预训练语言模型得到的嵌入信息对上下文进行聚类。然后，对于每个聚类，我们训练一个表示网络和多头预测网络，以估计每个词的处理效果，从而区分具有因果关系的词和具有虚假相关性的词。最后，利用训练好的词分类器为不同词赋予权重，进而构建出一个更鲁棒、更具泛化能力的情感分类模型。在公开数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在识别因果词和提高情感分类性能方面具有显著效果。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: CliniCAST: Benchmarking Acoustic Grounding and Text Dominance in Medical Triage
papers.title_zh: CliniCAST：在医疗分诊中对比使用声学算法进行优先级划分的方法与文本分析算法的效果
papers.authors: Kyusik Kim, Hyunwoo Yoo, Jaehoon Choi, Kitae Kim, Gail Rosen, Bongwon Suh
papers.abstract: Recent Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) integrate acoustic capabilities into reasoning, yet whether they reliably ground clinical judgments in audible evidence remains unproven. We introduce CliniCAST (Clinical Controlled Acoustic Synthetic Triage), a controlled benchmark that disentangles clinically meaningful acoustic cues from lexical content and speaker demographics. CliniCAST comprises 5,856 synthetic samples across 12 disease conditions: 4,800 audio samples forming 2,400 tagged–untagged pairs for five-level emergency triage, and 1,056 audio–text inconsistent samples in which reassuring speech is paired with high-risk acoustic cues. Evaluating a diverse suite of audio-capable foundation models, we find that LALMs exhibit fragile acoustic grounding and a pronounced “text dominance” failure mode: reassuring lexical content suppresses response to audible distress signals even under safety-critical conditions. Age and gender interactions are weak across conditions, indicating that the primary failure mode is insufficient cross-modal integration rather than demographic bias. These results suggest current LALMs are not yet robust enough for high-stakes medical triage, and motivate training objectives that explicitly enforce reliance on clinically grounded audible evidence.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的大型音频语言模型将声学能力融入了推理过程中，但尚不清楚它们是否能够可靠地将临床判断建立在可听证据的基础上。我们提出了CliniCAST这一受控基准测试，它能够将具有临床意义的声学线索与词汇内容和说话者特征分离开来。CliniCAST包含5,856个合成样本，涵盖12种疾病状况：4,800个音频样本构成了2,400对带有标签和未带标签的配对样本，用于五级紧急状况分类；还有1,056个音频-文本不一致的样本，其中令人安心的语音信息与高风险声学线索相匹配。通过对一系列具备音频处理能力的基础模型进行评估，我们发现这些模型在声学基础的建立上存在缺陷，并且存在明显的“文本主导”现象：即使在安全至关重要的条件下，令人安心的词汇信息也会抑制人们对可听求救信号的反应。不同条件下，年龄和性别之间的交互作用较弱，这表明主要的失败原因是由于跨模态整合不足，而非人口统计上的偏见。这些结果表明，目前的音频语言模型还不足以应对高风险的医疗分类任务，因此有必要制定训练目标，明确要求模型必须依赖基于临床证据的可听信息来进行决策。

papers.title: Whose Voice, Whose Avatar? Gender Matching Bias in Multimodal AI Teammates
papers.title_zh: 谁的声音，谁的化身？多模态人工智能搭档中的性别匹配偏见
papers.authors: Kyusik Kim, Jaehoon Choi, Hyunwoo Yoo, Bongwon Suh
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed as social agents, yet their ability to integrate conflicting identity cues remains underexplored. We audit gender bias in ten recent MLLMs using a counterfactual cooperative gaming task that pairs synthetic voices with avatars of varying gender presentation and visual fidelity. Our analysis reveals distinct bias patterns that can occur independently: closed-source models (e.g., Gemini 2.5/3) exhibit a near-deterministic “voice-matching” bias that enforces binary alignment between voice and appearance, whereas open-weight models (e.g., Qwen-2.5-Omni-7B) show limited responsiveness to vocal cues and instead exhibit context-driven stereotypes, such as preferring male avatars in combat scenarios. We further find that reducing visual realism attenuates matching tendencies in some models. These findings demonstrate that multimodal fairness is not monolithic; models may appear unbiased on one dimension while enforcing strict identity congruence or role-based stereotypes on another. Code and data are available at https://github.com/halfhoon/whose-voice-whose-avatar.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型作为社交代理的应用越来越广泛，然而它们在整合不同身份特征方面的能力仍未被充分研究。我们通过一个反事实合作博弈任务来检测十种最新多模态语言模型中的性别偏见问题。该任务将合成声音与具有不同性别表现和视觉真实度的虚拟形象进行配对。我们的分析发现，存在几种独立的偏见模式：闭源模型（如Gemini 2.5/3）表现出近乎确定性的“声音匹配”偏见，这种偏见会强制声音与外观之间保持二元对齐；而开源模型（如Qwen-2.5-Omni-7B）则对声音线索的反应较弱，反而表现出基于上下文的刻板印象，例如在战斗场景中更倾向于使用男性虚拟形象。我们还发现，降低视觉真实度可以减弱某些模型中的匹配倾向。这些研究结果表明，多模态公平性并非单一不变的特性；模型可能在某个维度上看起来无偏见，而在另一个维度上却会强制严格的身份一致性或基于角色的刻板印象。相关代码和数据可在此链接下载：https://github.com/halfhoon/whose-voice-whose-avatar

papers.title: WebAnchor: Anchoring Agent Planning to Stabilize Long-Horizon Web Reasoning
papers.title_zh: WebAnchor：用于稳定长期预测的网页推理中的锚定代理规划
papers.authors: Xinmiao Yu, Liwen Zhang, Xiaocheng Feng, Pengjun Xie, Jingren Zhou, Bing Qin, Yong Jiang
papers.abstract: Large Language Model(LLM)-based agents have shown strong capabilities in web information seeking, with reinforcement learning (RL) becoming a key optimization paradigm. However, planning remains a bottleneck, as existing methods struggle with long-horizon strategies. Our analysis reveals a critical phenomenon—plan anchor—where the first reasoning step disproportionately impacts downstream behavior in long-horizon web reasoning tasks. Current RL algorithms, fail to account for this by uniformly distributing rewards across the trajectory.To address this, we propose Anchor-GRPO, a two-stage RL framework that decouples planning and execution. In Stage 1, the agent optimizes its first-step planning using fine-grained rubrics derived from self-play experiences and human calibration. In Stage 2, execution is aligned with the initial plan through sparse rewards, ensuring stable and efficient tool usage. We evaluate Anchor-GRPO on four benchmarks: BrowseComp, BrowseComp-Zh, GAIA, and XBench-DeepSearch. Across models from 3B to 30B, Anchor-GRPO outperforms baseline GRPO and First-step GRPO, improving task success and tool efficiency. Notably, WebAnchor-30B achieves 46.0% pass@1 on BrowseComp and 76.4% on GAIA. Anchor-GRPO also demonstrates strong scalability, getting higher accuracy as model size and context length increase.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在网页信息检索方面表现出强大的能力，强化学习已成为一种关键的优化方法。然而，规划仍然是一个瓶颈问题，因为现有方法在处理长期视线的策略时存在困难。我们的分析揭示了一个关键现象——计划锚点，即最初的推理步骤对长期视线的网页推理任务的下游行为有着显著的影响。当前的强化学习算法未能考虑到这一点，它们只是通过在整个轨迹上均匀分配奖励来解决问题。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了Anchor-GRPO这一两阶段强化学习框架，它将规划和执行分离开来。在第一阶段，智能体利用从自我博弈经验和人类校准中得到的细粒度评分标准来优化其第一步规划。在第二阶段，通过稀疏奖励来确保执行的计划与初始计划保持一致，从而确保工具使用的稳定性和效率。我们在四个基准测试上对Anchor-GRPO进行了评估：BrowseComp、BrowseComp-Zh、GAIA和XBench-DeepSearch。在从3B到30B的各种模型中，Anchor-GRPO的表现优于基线GRPO和第一步GRPO，提高了任务成功率和工具效率。值得注意的是，WebAnchor-30B在BrowseComp上的通过率为46.0%，在GAIA上的通过率为76.4%。此外，Anchor-GRPO还展现了强大的可扩展性，随着模型规模和上下文长度的增加，其准确率也不断提高。

papers.title: Context-Driven and Reference-Guided Data Augmentation for Subtitle Translation
papers.title_zh: 基于上下文的参考引导数据增强技术在字幕翻译中的应用
papers.authors: Hitoshi Ito, Naoto Shirai, Kazutaka Kinugawa, Hideya Mino, Rei Endo, Yoshihiko Kawai
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in translation tasks. Subtitle translation presents unique challenges, such as preserving the original work’s worldview and the distinctive speaking styles of its characters. Achieving high-quality translations that reflect these stylistic nuances typically requires bilingual data for a specific movie, which is often scarce or unavailable. Thus, we propose a data augmentation method that uses LLMs to improve translation performance for specific movies, even when only a few hundred bilingual sentence pairs are available. The method expands source-side data by rewriting original subtitles using information that can be extracted from the context, such as character profiles and scene descriptions, to maintain the tone and thematic consistency of the movie. For translation, the augmented sentences are aligned with manually translated originals using structural similarity, which enables style-preserving bilingual data generation via one-shot learning. Experimental results show that data augmented using the proposed method effectively improves BLEU scores for film subtitle translation, and achieves superior stylistic quality in human evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在翻译任务中表现出强大的性能。然而，字幕翻译面临着独特的挑战，比如如何保留原作的世界观以及角色独特的说话风格。要获得能够反映这些风格细微差别的高质量翻译，通常需要针对特定电影提供双语数据，但这往往难以获取或缺乏。因此，我们提出了一种数据增强方法，利用大语言模型来提高特定电影的翻译效果，即使只有几百对双语句子对可供使用。该方法通过利用从上下文中提取的信息（如角色简介和场景描述）来重写原始字幕，从而扩展源端数据，以保持电影的整体风格和主题一致性。在翻译方面，经过增强的句子会与人工翻译的原文进行对齐，通过结构相似性来匹配两者，从而实现一次性学习式的风格保留型双语数据生成。实验结果表明，采用该方法增强的数据能够有效提高电影字幕翻译的BLEU分数，并在人类评估中展现出卓越的风格质量。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Real or Robotic? Assessing Whether LLMs Accurately Simulate Qualities of Human Responses in Human-LLM Dialogue
papers.title_zh: 是真实的还是机器人生成的？评估大语言模型在人与大语言模型的对话中是否能够准确模拟人类的反应特征
papers.authors: Jonathan Ivey, Shivani Kumar, Jiayu Liu, Hua Shen, Sushrita Rakshit, Rohan Raju, Haotian Zhang, Aparna Ananthasubramaniam, Junghwan Kim, Bowen Yi, Dustin Wright, Abraham Israeli, Anders Giovanni Møller, Lechen Zhang, David Jurgens
papers.abstract: Building datasets for dialogue tasks is expensive and time-consuming, requiring recruitment, training, and data collection from study participants. In response, much recent work has sought to use large language models (LLMs) to simulate both human-human and human-LLM interactions, as they have been shown to generate convincingly human-like text in many settings. However, how well do LLM-based simulations reflect real human dialogue? In this work, we answer this question by generating a large-scale dataset of 100,000 paired LLM-LLM and human-LLM dialogues from the WildChat dataset and quantifying how well the LLM simulations align with their human counterparts. Overall, we find relatively low alignment between simulations and human interactions, with systematic differences in multiple textual properties, including style and conversational dynamics. Further, we find that models perform similarly in simulating English, Chinese, and Russian dialogues. Our results also suggest that LLMs only simulate a narrow range of the overall distribution of human dialogue, as they perform better on the subset of humans who write similarly to the LLM’s own style.
papers.abstract_zh: 构建用于对话任务的数据集是一项耗时且成本高昂的任务，需要招募人员、对参与者进行训练以及收集数据。为此，许多近期的研究试图利用大语言模型来模拟人类与语言模型的互动，因为研究表明这些模型在许多情况下能够生成具有高度逼真的人性化文本。然而，基于语言模型的模拟在多大程度上能真实反映人类的对话呢？在这项研究中，我们通过从WildChat数据集中提取了包含10万对语言模型与语言模型以及人类与语言模型之间的对话的大规模数据集，并量化了这些语言模型模拟结果与真实人类对话之间的相似程度。总体而言，我们发现模拟结果与人类互动之间的相似度相对较低，多个文本属性上存在系统性差异，包括风格和对话动态等方面。此外，我们还发现这些模型在模拟英语、中文和俄语对话时的表现相当。我们的研究结果还表明，语言模型只能模拟人类对话的整体分布中的一小部分，因为它们在那些写作风格与语言模型相似的人群中表现得更好。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Can Small LLMs Learn a Robust Theory of Mind via RLVR? Investigating Generalization through the False-Belief Task
papers.title_zh: 小型大语言模型能否通过强化学习来掌握关于心智的稳健理论？通过错误信念任务来探究其泛化能力
papers.authors: Sneheel Sarangi, Hanan Salam
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated emergent capabilities in complex reasoning, largely spurred by rule-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) techniques applied during post-training. This has raised the question of whether similar methods can instill more nuanced, human-like social intelligence, such as a Theory of Mind (ToM), in LLMs. This paper investigates whether small- scale LLMs can acquire a robust and generalizable ToM capability through RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We conduct a systematic evaluation by training models on various combinations of prominent ToM benchmarks (HiToM, ExploreToM, FANToM) and testing for generalization on held-out benchmarks (e.g., Open- ToM). Our findings indicate that small LLMs struggle to develop a generic ToM capability. While performance on in-distribution tasks improves, this capability fails to transfer to unseen ToM tasks with different characteristics. Even observed out-of-distribution (OOD) performance improvements occur unpredictably across the training run, and don’t generalize across other OOD benchmarks. Furthermore, we conduct analysis to show that the learned behavior is likely a form of narrow overfitting rather than the acquisition of a true, abstract ToM capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期大语言模型（LLM）的进展表明，它们在复杂推理方面展现出惊人的能力，这主要得益于在训练后应用的基于规则的强化学习技术。这引发了这样一个问题：是否可以通过类似的方法在LLM中培养出更细致、更接近人类的社会智能，比如心智理论（ToM）。本文研究了小型LLM是否能够通过带有可验证奖励的强化学习技术，获得一种稳健且可泛化的心智理论能力。我们通过在不同心智理论基准测试上进行模型训练，并测试其在其他基准测试中的泛化能力，从而进行系统性的评估。研究发现，小型LLM在培养通用心智理论能力方面存在困难。虽然它们在非分布任务上的表现有所改善，但这种能力无法转移到具有不同特性的未知心智理论任务上。此外，即使在非分布环境下的性能有所提升，这种提升也是不可预测的，并且无法在其他非分布基准测试中得到泛化。进一步分析表明，所学习的行为更像是某种狭隘的过拟合现象，而非真正抽象的心智理论能力的获取。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rolling Out Data Quality Overnight, without losing the plot: A Multi-Agent System for Speech Data Quality Management
papers.title_zh: 立即实施数据质量改进措施——无需中断业务运营：一种用于语音数据质量管理的多智能体系统
papers.authors: Rishabh Kumar, Abhinav Painuli, Chriss Philip Saji, Devesh Soni, Amrith Krishna, Ganesh Ramakrishnan
papers.abstract: Quality management when creating large-scale speech datasets is essential for building reliable downstream models, yet verification pipelines are often brittle, domain-specific, and expertise-intensive. We introduce SpeechQM-Agent, a natural language-driven agentic framework that compiles user requirements into dependency-aware DAG workflows over modular tools for audio, transcript, and metadata verification. A central planner LLM enforces prerequisites and supports execution-time replanning (e.g., re-running failed steps or swapping tools), reducing manual pipeline engineering and improving robustness across heterogeneous vendor formats and multilingual settings. We also release SpeechQM-Dataset, a multilingual benchmark with controlled, vendor-inspired quality artifacts spanning 24 verification tasks. Across experiments, SpeechQM-Agent attains 80-90% agreement with expert verification while requiring <20% of the cost and time of manual QC, and we further validate transfer to real vendor-supplied corpora. Planner LLM comparisons highlight fidelity-efficiency trade-offs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在构建大规模语音数据集时，质量管理对于构建可靠的下游模型至关重要。然而，验证流程往往不够稳健、具有特定领域特性且需要大量专业知识。我们提出了SpeechQM-Agent这一基于自然语言的智能框架，该框架能够利用模块化工具将用户需求转化为依赖关系明确的有向无环图工作流程，从而实现对音频、文本和元数据的高效验证。中央规划器大语言模型负责确保各项前提条件的满足，并支持在执行过程中进行重新规划（例如重新运行失败的步骤或更换工具），从而减少了人工流程设计的工作量，提升了系统在不同供应商提供的格式和多语言环境中的稳定性。我们还推出了SpeechQM-Dataset，这是一个多语言基准测试集，包含24项经过控制的、受供应商影响的质量评估任务。实验结果表明，SpeechQM-Agent的准确率达到了80-90%，而其成本和时间仅为人工验证的20%以下。此外，我们还验证了该框架在真实供应商提供的数据集上的适用性。对规划器大语言模型的比较表明，该框架在准确性和效率之间实现了良好的平衡。

papers.title: Schema-Guided Response Generation using Multi-Frame Dialogue State for Motivational Interviewing Systems
papers.title_zh: 利用多帧对话状态进行动机访谈系统的模式引导式回答生成
papers.authors: Jie Zeng, Yukiko Nakano
papers.abstract: The primary goal of Motivational Interviewing (MI) is to help clients build their own motivation for behavioral change. To support this in dialogue systems, it is essential to guide large language models (LLMs) to generate counselor responses aligned with MI principles. By employing a schema-guided approach, this study proposes a method for updating multi-frame dialogue states and a strategy decision mechanism that dynamically determines the response focus in a manner grounded in MI principles. The proposed method was implemented in a dialogue system on two different datasets and evaluated through a user study. Results showed that the proposed method successfully generates responses aligned with MI principle and frequently asks questions to elicit change talk.
papers.abstract_zh: 动机性访谈的主要目标是帮助客户建立行为改变的动力。为了在对话系统中实现这一目标，必须引导大语言模型生成符合动机性原则的咨询师回应。本研究采用模式引导的方法，提出了一种更新多帧对话状态的方法，以及一种动态确定回应焦点的策略决策机制，这些机制都基于动机性原则。所提出的方法已在两个不同数据集上的对话系统中得到实施，并通过用户研究进行了评估。结果表明，所提出的方法能够成功生成符合动机性原则的回应，并且经常提出问题以激发客户的改变意愿。

papers.title: From Passive Metric to Active Signal: The Evolving Role of Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从被动度量到主动信号：不确定性量化在大型语言模型中的角色演变
papers.authors: Jiaxin Zhang, Wendi Cui, Zhuohang Li, Lifu Huang, Bradley A. Malin, Caiming Xiong, Chien-Sheng Wu
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show remarkable capabilities, their unreliability remains a critical barrier to deployment in high-stakes domains. This survey charts a functional evolution in addressing this challenge: the evolution of uncertainty from a passive diagnostic metric to an active control signal guiding real-time model behavior. We demonstrate how uncertainty is leveraged as an active control signal across three frontiers: in advanced reasoning to optimize computation and trigger self-correction; in autonomous agents to govern metacognitive decisions about tool use and information seeking; and in reinforcement learning to mitigate reward hacking and enable self-improvement via intrinsic rewards. By grounding these advancements in emerging theoretical frameworks like Bayesian methods and Conformal Prediction, we provide a unified perspective on this transformative trend. This survey provides a comprehensive overview, critical analysis, and practical design patterns, arguing that mastering the new trend of uncertainty is essential for building the next generation of scalable, reliable, and trustworthy AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大语言模型展现出了惊人的能力，但其不可靠性仍然是在高风险领域部署它们所面临的关键障碍。本综述探讨了应对这一挑战的多种方法：将不确定性从被动的诊断指标转变为主动的控制信号，以指导模型的实时行为。我们展示了如何将不确定性作为主动控制信号应用于三个领域：在高级推理中优化计算并触发自我修正；在自主代理中管理关于工具使用和信息检索的元认知决策；在强化学习中减轻奖励操纵问题，并通过内在奖励实现自我改进。通过结合贝叶斯方法和共形预测等新兴理论框架，我们对这一变革趋势提供了统一的视角。本综述提供了全面的概述、深入的分析以及实用的设计模式，认为掌握不确定性的新趋势对于构建下一代可扩展、可靠且值得信赖的人工智能至关重要。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Value–Action Alignment in Large Language Models under Privacy–Prosocial Conflict
papers.title_zh: 在隐私与利他主义冲突情境下，大型语言模型的价值与行为的协调问题
papers.authors: Guanyu Chen, Chenxiao Yu, Xiyang Hu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate decision-making tasks involving personal data sharing, where privacy concerns and prosocial motivations can push choices in opposite directions. Existing evaluations often measure privacy-related attitudes or sharing intentions in isolation, which makes it difficult to determine whether a model’s expressed values jointly predict its downstream data-sharing actions as in real human behaviors. We introduce a context-based assessment protocol that sequentially administers standardized questionnaires for privacy attitudes, prosocialness, and acceptance of data sharing within a bounded, history-carrying session. To evaluate value-action alignments under competing attitudes, we use multi-group structural equation modeling (MGSEM) to identify relations from privacy concerns and prosocialness to data sharing. We propose Value-Action Alignment Rate (VAAR), a human-referenced directional agreement metric that aggregates path-level evidence for expected signs. Across multiple LLMs, we observe stable but model-specific Privacy-PSA-AoDS profiles, and substantial heterogeneity in value-action alignment.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在模拟涉及个人数据共享的决策任务时得到了广泛应用。在这些场景中，隐私问题与社会责任感可能会促使人们做出相反的选择。现有的评估方法通常单独衡量与隐私相关的行为或数据共享的意愿，这使得难以判断模型的价值观是否能够像人类行为那样共同影响其后续的数据共享决策。我们提出了一种基于情境的评估方案：在有限且包含历史信息的会话中，依次收集关于隐私态度、社会责任感以及数据共享接受度的标准化问卷数据。为了评估在不同态度下价值与行为的契合程度，我们使用多组结构方程建模方法来分析隐私问题、社会责任感与数据共享之间的关系。我们提出了“价值-行为契合率”这一指标，该指标以人类为参照，综合了路径层面的证据，以反映预期的关系。通过对多个大语言模型的研究，我们发现这些模型在隐私-社会责任感与数据共享的契合程度上存在稳定性，但不同模型之间存在显著的差异。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: See or Say Graphs: Agent-Driven Scalable Graph Understanding with Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 查看或生成图表：基于代理的可扩展图结构理解，结合视觉语言模型的方法
papers.authors: Shuo Han, Yukun Cao, Zezhong Ding, Zengyi Gao, S Kevin Zhou, Xike Xie
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise in graph understanding, but remain limited by input-token constraints, facing scalability bottlenecks and lacking effective mechanisms to coordinate textual and visual modalities. To address these challenges, we propose GraphVista, a unified framework that enhances both scalability and modality coordination in graph understanding. For scalability, GraphVista organizes graph information hierarchically into a lightweight GraphRAG base, which retrieves only task-relevant textual descriptions and high-resolution visual subgraphs, compressing redundant context while preserving key reasoning elements. For modality coordination, GraphVista introduces a planning agent that routes tasks to the most suitable modality—using the text modality for simple property reasoning and the visual modality for local and structurally complex reasoning grounded in explicit topology. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GraphVista scales to large graphs, up to 200{\times} larger than those used in existing benchmarks, and consistently outperforms existing textual, visual, and fusion-based methods, achieving up to 4.4{\times} quality improvement over the state-of-the-art baselines by fully exploiting the complementary strengths of both modalities.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型在图理解方面表现出良好的性能，但仍然存在输入标记的限制，同时面临着可扩展性方面的瓶颈问题，且缺乏有效的方法来协调文本和视觉信息。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了GraphVista这一统一框架，该框架在图理解中提升了可扩展性和模式协调性。在可扩展性方面，GraphVista将图信息以层次化的方式组织到轻量级的GraphRAG基础模型中，该模型仅检索与任务相关的文本描述和高分辨率的视觉子图，从而压缩冗余的上下文信息，同时保留关键的推理元素。在模式协调方面，GraphVista引入了一个规划代理，它将任务分配到最合适的模式上——对于简单的属性推理使用文本模式，而对于基于明确拓扑结构的局部和复杂推理则使用视觉模式。大量的实验表明，GraphVista能够处理大型图，其规模可以比现有基准测试中的图大200倍以上。此外，GraphVista在性能上始终优于现有的文本、视觉和融合式方法，通过充分利用两种模式的互补优势，其性能提升幅度可达4.4倍。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Recovered in Translation: Efficient Pipeline for Automated Translation of Benchmarks and Datasets
papers.title_zh: 通过翻译实现的高效处理：用于自动翻译基准测试和数据集的自动化处理流程
papers.authors: Hanna Yukhymenko, Anton Alexandrov, Martin Vechev
papers.abstract: The reliability of multilingual Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation is currently compromised by the inconsistent quality of translated benchmarks. Existing resources often suffer from semantic drift and context loss, which can lead to misleading performance metrics. In this work, we present a fully automated framework designed to address these challenges by enabling scalable, high-quality translation of datasets and benchmarks. We demonstrate that adapting test-time compute scaling strategies, specifically Universal Self-Improvement (USI) and our proposed multi-round ranking method, T-RANK, allows for significantly higher quality outputs compared to traditional pipelines. Our framework ensures that benchmarks preserve their original task structure and linguistic nuances during localization. We apply this approach to translate popular benchmarks and datasets into eight Eastern and Southern European languages (Ukrainian, Bulgarian, Slovak, Romanian, Lithuanian, Estonian, Turkish, Greek). Evaluations using both reference-based metrics and LLM-as-a-judge show that our translations surpass existing resources, resulting in more accurate downstream model assessment. We release both the framework and the improved benchmarks to facilitate robust and reproducible multilingual AI development.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，多语言大语言模型评估的可靠性受到翻译基准数据质量不一致的影响。现有的资源往往存在语义漂移和上下文丢失的问题，这可能会导致错误的性能指标。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个完全自动化的框架，旨在解决这些问题，实现数据集和基准数据的可扩展、高质量翻译。我们证明，通过采用测试时计算扩展策略，特别是通用自我改进算法以及我们提出的多轮排名方法T-RANK，可以获得比传统方法更高质量的评估结果。我们的框架能够确保基准数据在本地化过程中保持原有的任务结构和语言细节。我们将这种方法应用于将流行的基准数据和数据集翻译成八种东欧和南欧语言（乌克兰语、保加利亚语、斯洛伐克语、罗马尼亚语、立陶宛语、爱沙尼亚语、土耳其语、希腊语）。通过使用基于参考指标的评估方式以及以语言模型作为评估工具的方法进行评估，我们发现我们的翻译结果优于现有资源，从而能够更准确地评估下游模型性能。我们同时发布了该框架以及改进后的基准数据，以促进稳健且可复用的多语言人工智能开发。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: MorphBPE: Morphology-Aware Tokenization for Efficient LLM Training
papers.title_zh: MorphBPE：基于形态学的分词技术，助力高效的语言模型训练
papers.authors: Ehsaneddin Asgari, Yassine El Kheir, MohammadAli SadraeiJavaheri, Ali Nazari
papers.abstract: Tokenization fundamentally shapes NLP performance, affecting both efficiency and linguistic fidelity. While Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) underpins most Large Language Models (LLMs), its frequency-driven merges often disregard morpheme boundaries, yielding inconsistent and semantically opaque segmentations in morphologically rich languages. We introduce MorphBPE, a simple extension of BPE that constrains merge operations during tokenizer training to respect morpheme boundaries, while leaving inference unchanged and fully compatible with existing LLM pipelines. We evaluate tokenization quality using two intrinsic metrics, Morphological Consistency F1, which measures whether shared morphemes are assigned consistent token representations, and Morphological Edit Distance, which quantifies alignment with morpheme boundaries. We then train 300M and 1B parameter decoder-only LMs from scratch across four typologically diverse languages, English, Russian, Hungarian, and Arabic, under identical vocabulary sizes and training settings. Across all languages, MorphBPE consistently improves intrinsic morphological coherence and reduces language model cross-entropy, moreover, token length statistics indicate that these gains are not attributable to materially shorter tokens. Finally, on the Belebele multilingual reading comprehension benchmark, MorphBPE yields significant improvements in morphologically rich languages such as Russian and Arabic.
papers.abstract_zh: 代币化从根本上决定了自然语言处理性能，它既影响效率，也影响语言的准确性。虽然字节对编码是大多数大语言模型的基础技术，但其基于频率的合并操作常常忽略词素边界，导致在词汇结构复杂的语言中，分割结果不一致且语义不清晰。我们提出了MorphBPE，这是一种简单的字节对编码扩展方案，它在分词器训练过程中限制合并操作的进行，以尊重词素边界，同时不影响推理过程，并且与现有的语言模型流程完全兼容。我们通过两个指标来评估代币化的质量：形态一致性F1值，用于衡量共享词素是否获得一致的代币表示；以及形态编辑距离，用于量化与词素边界的一致性。随后，我们在四种类型不同的语言——英语、俄语、匈牙利语和阿拉伯语中，从零开始训练了分别拥有3亿参数和10亿参数的仅解码器的语言模型。在所有语言中，MorphBPE都能持续改善形态上的连贯性，并降低语言模型的交叉熵损失。此外， Token长度统计数据显示，这些改进并非由于代币长度有所减少所致。最后，在Belebele多语言阅读理解基准测试中，MorphBPE在俄语和阿拉伯语等词汇结构复杂的语言中取得了显著的改进。

papers.title: From Storage to Experience: A Survey on the Evolution of LLM Agent Memory Mechanisms
papers.title_zh: 从存储到体验：关于大型语言模型代理记忆机制发展的调查
papers.authors: Jinghao Luo, Yuchen Tian, Chuxue Cao, Ziyang Luo, Hongzhan Lin, Kaixin Li, Chuyi Kong, Ruichao Yang, Jing Ma
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have fundamentally reshaped artificial intelligence by integrating external tools and planning capabilities. While memory mechanisms have emerged as the architectural cornerstone of these systems, current research remains fragmented, oscillating between operating system engineering and cognitive science. This theoretical divide prevents a unified view of technological synthesis and a coherent evolutionary perspective. To bridge this gap, this survey proposes a novel evolutionary framework for LLM agent memory mechanisms, formalizing the development process into three stages: Storage (trajectory preservation), Reflection (trajectory refinement), and Experience (trajectory abstraction). We first formally define these three stages before analyzing the three core drivers of this evolution: the necessity for long-range consistency, the challenges in dynamic environments, and the ultimate goal of continual learning. Furthermore, we specifically explore two transformative mechanisms in the frontier Experience stage: proactive exploration and cross-trajectory abstraction. By synthesizing these disparate views, this work offers robust design principles and a clear roadmap for the development of next-generation LLM agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过整合外部工具和规划能力，从根本上重塑了人工智能领域。虽然内存机制已成为这些系统的架构基石，但当前的研究仍然分散在各个领域，既涉及操作系统工程，又涉及认知科学。这种理论上的分歧阻碍了人们对技术融合的统一认识以及连贯的进化视角。为了弥合这一差距，本文提出了一个创新的LLM智能体内存机制进化框架，将发展过程划分为三个阶段：存储（轨迹保存）、反思（轨迹优化）和体验（轨迹抽象）。我们首先对这三个阶段进行正式定义，然后分析推动这一进化的三个核心因素：实现长期一致性的需求、动态环境中的挑战，以及持续学习的最终目标。此外，我们特别探讨了在体验阶段的两个具有变革性的机制：主动探索与跨轨迹抽象。通过整合这些不同的观点，本文为下一代LLM智能体的开发提供了稳健的设计原则和清晰的路线图。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LLMs are Brittle to Simple Code Transformations: Introducing CETBench – A Benchmark for Code-Equivalence Checking
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型对简单的代码转换非常敏感：介绍CETBench——一种用于代码等价性检测的工具
papers.authors: Neeva Oza, Ishaan Govil, Parul Gupta, Dinesh Khandelwal, Dinesh Garg, Parag Singla
papers.abstract: We study how well LLMs can determine whether two programs are functionally equivalent. This is an important problem because benchmarking code equivalence helps assess LLM capability in tasks such as code rewriting and translation. To this end, we introduce CETBench — Code Equivalence with Transformations Benchmark — built from a repository of programs that may solve the same or different tasks. Each dataset instance is created by sampling a program pair and applying a random sequence of predefined code transformations, yielding either equivalent or non-equivalent pairs. Our analysis shows that even simple transformations cause a significant performance drop in state-of-the-art LLMs on code-equivalence checking. These challenges are further amplified in the cross-lingual setting when comparing programs written in different languages. To remedy this, we present a simple fine-tuning-based approach to boost LLM performance on the transformed pairs of programs. Our approach for dataset generation is generic, supporting cross-lingual equivalence checking, the generation of program pairs with varying difficulty levels, and the application of diverse transformations. In our experiments, we perform ablations over the difficulty level of original programs, as well as the kind of transformations used in generating pairs for equivalence checking. Our analysis presents deep insights into the working of LLMs for the task of code-equivalence, and points to the fact that they may still be far from what could be termed as a semantic understanding of the underlying code.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了大语言模型在判断两个程序是否在功能上等价方面的能力。这是一个重要的问题，因为对代码等价性的基准测试有助于评估大语言模型在代码重写和翻译等任务中的能力。为此，我们开发了CETBench——基于变换的代码等价性基准测试——该测试基于一个包含各种程序的仓库，这些程序可能解决相同或不同的任务。每个数据集实例都是通过抽取一对程序并应用一系列预定义的代码变换来生成的，从而得到等价或非等价的配对。我们的分析表明，即使是非常简单的变换也会导致最先进的大语言模型在代码等价性检查方面出现显著的性能下降。在跨语言环境下比较用不同语言编写的程序时，这些挑战会进一步加剧。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一种基于微调的方法，以提高大语言模型在处理经过变换后的程序配对时的性能。我们的数据集生成方法具有通用性，能够支持跨语言的等价性检查、生成不同难度级别的程序配对，以及应用多种变换方式。在我们的实验中，我们对原始程序的难度级别以及用于生成等价性配对变换的类型进行了分析。我们的分析揭示了大语言模型在代码等价性任务中的工作机制，并指出它们仍然远未达到对底层代码的语义理解的水平。

papers.title: Enhancing Factuality through Consensus and Consistency in Summarization Using Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
papers.title_zh: 通过共识与一致性在摘要生成中提升信息的真实性，采用最小贝叶斯风险解码技术
papers.authors: Riza Setiawan Soetedjo, Yusuke Sakai, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Jingun Kwon, Manabu Okumura, Taro Watanabe
papers.abstract: Improving the quality of model-generated summaries, especially factuality, the accuracy of a summary with respect to its source content, remains a challenge. While reranking could select the optimal output from multiple generated candidates, it is limited to only using the source as guidance, resulting in unreliable summaries. To address this limitation, we propose ConSUM that reranks candidate summaries by considering two factors: consistency to the source document and consensus among the other candidates. Consensus is established using Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding over the set of generated summaries, while ensuring consistency by employing factuality-aware metrics that compare the summary against the source. Rigorous testing demonstrates that our system is competitive with existing methods, with human evaluations further confirming that its generated summaries are preferred over those from other systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 提高模型生成的摘要质量，尤其是摘要的真实性以及其与源内容的一致性，仍然是一个挑战。虽然重新排序功能可以从多个生成的候选摘要中选择最优结果，但这种方法仅限于使用源文档作为指导，因此生成的摘要往往不可靠。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了ConSUM算法。该算法通过考虑两个因素来重新排序候选摘要：与源文档的一致性以及其他候选摘要之间的共识。共识是通过对生成的摘要集进行最小贝叶斯风险解码来确定的，同时，通过采用基于真实性的评估指标来确保摘要与源内容的一致性。严格的测试表明，我们的系统在与现有方法相比时具有竞争力，而人工评估也进一步证实了，用户更倾向于选择我们生成的摘要，而不是其他系统的摘要。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Moneyball with LLMs: Analyzing Tabular Summarization in Sports Narratives
papers.title_zh: 《金钱球》与大型语言模型：分析体育叙事中的表格化总结方式
papers.authors: Ritam Upadhyay, Naman Ahuja, Rishabh Baral, Aparna Garimella, Vivek Gupta
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) approaches to tabular summarization rely on extensive prompt engineering, decomposition pipelines, or entity-level intermediate representations to achieve strong performance. While effective, these strategies are computationally expensive and offer limited insight into how well models maintain state over long, evolving narratives. We introduce SporTabSet, a diagnostic benchmark for long-context tabular summarization across two complementary sports domains that require tracking multiple entities and aggregating statistics under domain-specific rules. Using SporTabSet, we systematically evaluate decomposition-based strategies across several long context LLMs. Results show that although decomposition substantially improves accuracy and numerical fidelity, gains stem mainly from dissecting multi-entity interference rather than improved local arithmetic. Robustness experiments further reveal high sensitivity to surface-level cues with structured failures, including hallucination, omission, and role confusion. Together, these findings identify consistent multi-entity memory as a key bottleneck in long-context table generation, motivating diagnostic evaluation as a prerequisite for scalable, efficient, and reliable tabular summarization models.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在表格摘要处理中的应用，依赖于复杂的提示设计、分解流程或实体级中间表示，以实现出色的性能。虽然这些策略效果显著，但计算成本较高，且难以了解模型在长时间、复杂叙事中的状态维护能力。我们提出了SporTabSet这一诊断基准测试，用于评估两个互补体育领域中的长上下文表格摘要处理任务。这两个领域需要跟踪多个实体，并根据特定规则汇总统计数据。通过SporTabSet，我们对多种基于分解的算法进行了系统性的评估。结果表明，尽管分解方法显著提升了准确性和数值精度，但这些提升主要源于对多实体干扰的分解，而非局部计算的改进。进一步的鲁棒性实验表明，该方法对表面线索高度敏感，存在结构化的失败情况，包括幻觉、遗漏和角色混淆等问题。综上所述，这些发现揭示了多实体记忆作为长上下文表格生成的关键瓶颈，因此进行诊断性评估对于构建可扩展、高效且可靠的表格摘要模型至关重要。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: A Computational Method for Measuring Open Codes in Qualitative Analysis
papers.title_zh: 一种用于衡量定性分析中未解决问题的计算方法
papers.authors: John Chen, Alexandros Nikolaos Lotsos, Sihan Cheng, Lexie Zhao, Yanjia Zhang, Jessica Hullman, Bruce Sherin, Uri Wilensky, Michael Horn
papers.abstract: Qualitative analysis is critical to understanding human datasets in many social science disciplines. A central method in this process is inductive coding, where researchers identify and interpret codes directly from the datasets themselves. Yet, this exploratory approach poses challenges for meeting methodological expectations (such as “depth” and “variation”), especially as researchers increasingly adopt Generative AI (GAI) for support. Ground-truth-based metrics are insufficient because they contradict the exploratory nature of inductive coding; cluster- or topic-level metrics fail to capture the interpretive, cross-cutting nature of qualitative codes; and manual evaluation can be labor-intensive. This paper presents a theory-informed computational method for measuring inductive coding results from humans and GAI. Our method first merges individual codebooks into an Aggregated Code Space using an LLM-enriched hierarchical clustering algorithm. It then measures each coder’s contribution against the merged result using four novel metrics: Coverage, Overlap, Novelty, and Divergence, designed to capture breadth, consensus, unique contribution, and systematic deviation without assuming ground truth. Through two experiments on a human-coded online conversation dataset, we 1) reveal the merging algorithm’s impact on metrics; 2) validate the metrics’ stability and robustness across multiple runs and different LLMs; and 3) showcase the metrics’ ability to diagnose coding issues, such as excessive or irrelevant (hallucinated) codes. We discuss how these metrics should be interpreted in combination and their current limitations. Our work provides a reliable pathway for ensuring methodological rigor in human-AI qualitative analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 定性分析对于理解许多社会科学领域中的人类数据集至关重要。在这个过程中，归纳编码是一种核心方法，研究人员直接从数据集中识别并解释代码。然而，这种探索性方法在满足方法论要求方面存在挑战，例如“深度”和“多样性”等方面。随着研究人员越来越多地采用生成式人工智能来辅助分析，基于基准的度量标准就不够用了，因为这些标准与归纳编码的探索性质相矛盾；集群或主题级别的度量标准无法捕捉到定性代码的跨领域特性；而人工评估则可能非常耗时。本文提出了一种基于理论的计算方法，用于衡量由人类和生成式人工智能产生的归纳编码结果。我们的方法首先使用一种增强型层次聚类算法将各个代码库合并成一个聚合代码空间。然后，通过四种新的度量标准来衡量每个编码者的贡献：覆盖度、重叠程度、新颖性和差异性，这些指标能够捕捉到广度、共识、独特贡献以及系统性偏差，而无需假设任何基准。通过对一个由人类编码的在线对话数据集进行两次实验，我们成功地：1）揭示了合并算法对度量标准的影响；2）验证了这些度量标准在不同运行和不同语言模型下的稳定性和可靠性；3）展示了这些度量标准在诊断编码问题方面的能力，比如过度或无关紧要的代码。我们还讨论了如何结合使用这些度量标准，以及它们目前的局限性。我们的工作为确保在人类与人工智能的定性分析中保持方法论的严谨性提供了一条可靠的途径。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Vulnerability of LLMs’ Stated Belief? LLMs Belief Resistance Check Through Strategic Persuasive Conversation Interventions
papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型所表达信念的脆弱性？通过战略性说服性对话手段来检验大型语言模型的信念稳定性
papers.authors: Fan Huang, Haewoon Kwak, Jisun An
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly employed in various question-answering tasks. However, recent studies showcase that LLMs are susceptible to persuasion and could adopt counterfactual beliefs.We present a systematic evaluation of LLM susceptibility to persuasion under the Source–Message–Channel–Receiver (SMCR) communication framework. Across six mainstream Large Language Models (LLMs) and three domains (factual knowledge, medical QA, and social bias), we analyze how different persuasive strategies influence stated belief stability over multiple interaction turns.We further examine whether verbalized confidence prompting (i.e., eliciting self-reported confidence scores) affects resistance to persuasion.Results show that the smallest model (Llama 3.2-3B) exhibits extreme compliance, with 82.5% of belief changes occurring at the first persuasive turn (average end turn of 1.1–1.4).Contrary to expectations, verbalized confidence prompting increases vulnerability by accelerating belief erosion rather than enhancing robustness. Finally, an exploratory study of adversarial fine-tuning reveals highly model-dependent effectiveness: GPT-4o-mini achieves near-complete robustness (98.6%) and Mistral 7B improves substantially (35.7% \rightarrow 79.3%), but Llama models remain highly susceptible (<14% RQ1) even when fine-tuned on their own failure cases. Together, these findings highlight substantial model-dependent limits of current robustness interventions and offer guidance for developing more trustworthy LLMs[https://github.com/muyuhuatang/llm_stated_belief].
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在各类问答任务中得到了广泛应用。然而，最近的研究表明，这些模型容易受到说服的影响，可能会采纳反事实的信念。我们在源-消息-通道-接收者（SMCR）通信框架下，对大语言模型对说服的敏感性进行了系统性的评估。通过对比六种主流大语言模型和三个领域（事实知识、医学问答和社会偏见），我们分析了不同的说服策略如何影响用户信念的稳定性。我们还研究了口头表达出的自信提示是否会影响用户对说服的抵抗力。结果表明，最小的模型Llama 3.2-3B表现出极端的顺从性，有82.5%的信念变化发生在第一次说服尝试时（平均结束时信念变化率为1.1-1.4）。与预期相反，口头表达的自信提示反而加剧了信念的侵蚀，而非增强用户的抵抗力。最后，一项关于对抗性微调的研究显示，模型的依赖性对效果有很大影响：GPT-4o-mini几乎实现了完全的抗说服力（98.6%），而Mistral 7B则显著提升了抗说服力（从35.7%提高到79.3%）。不过，即使对Llama模型进行单独的训练，它们的抗说服力仍然很低（RQ1的响应率低于14%）。这些发现揭示了当前提高模型抗说服力措施存在的重大局限性，并为开发更可靠的大语言模型提供了指导。[https://github.com/muyuhuatang/llm_stated_belief]
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Choose Your Lens: Multi-Perspective Value Alignment of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 选择你的透镜：多视角下的思维链推理价值对齐方式
papers.authors: Gejian Zhao, Hanzhou Wu, Xinpeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to support pluralistic alignment, representing diverse human perspectives. However, current methods often induce motivated reasoning: LLMs tend to hallucinate “convenient” facts to forcefully justify a requested stance. To address this, we propose Value-Graph-Consistent Chain-of-Thought (VGC-CoT), a neuro-symbolic framework that enables steerable pluralism without distorting objective reality. We enforce a strict distinction: facts should be shared, while value trade-offs may diverge. Our approach models reasoning as a directed traversal over a multi-perspective graph comprising a fixed factual layer and perspective-specific value layers. By projecting generated CoT paths onto this structure, we align the model with target values while constraining it to a shared factual backbone. Experiments show that our method reduces factual hallucinations by 3\times and improves cross-perspective consistency by 25% compared to standard steerable baselines, paving the way for trustworthy pluralistic AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型被寄予了支持多元对齐、反映不同人类观点的期望。然而，当前的方法往往会导致有动机的推理：语言模型倾向于虚构“方便”的事实，以强行证明所要求的立场。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了价值-图一致性思维链（Value-Graph-Consistent Chain-of-Thought，VGC-CoT）这一神经符号框架。该框架能够实现可引导的多元性，同时不会扭曲客观现实。我们严格区分了事实与价值的权衡：事实应该被共享，而价值上的取舍则可以有所不同。我们的方法将推理建模为在包含固定事实层和视角特定价值层的多视角图上进行的有向遍历。通过将生成的思维路径投影到这个结构上，我们可以使模型与目标价值保持一致，同时将其限制在共享的事实基础之上。实验表明，与标准的可引导基线相比，我们的方法能够将事实幻觉减少3倍，并将跨视角的一致性提高25%。这为构建可信的多元人工智能铺平了道路。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Evidence: Belief-Chain Conditioning for Persuasive Misinformation Debunking Explanation
papers.title_zh: 超越证据：利用信念链进行有说服力的虚假信息辟谣
papers.authors: Yi-Li Hsu, Li-Wun Chang, Chun-Yu Hsu, Wei-Kuan Shih, Aiping Xiong, Lun-Wei Ku
papers.abstract: As AI systems increasingly mediate everyday communication, large language models (LLMs) are expected not only to provide factually accurate responses but also to generate explanations that engage with users’ mental states. We build on the concept of cognitive chains—structured representations of Situation, Clue, Thought, Action, and Emotion inspired by Theory of Mind—to investigate whether conditioning LLM outputs on such belief chains improves explanation quality. Specifically, we evaluate explanations along six reader-perceived dimensions: overall quality, logical correctness, completeness, conciseness, empathy, and agreement. Prior work shows that LLM explanations often default to neutral or uncertain stances, while individuals holding strong false beliefs remain highly resistant to correction. To address this challenge, we instantiate cognitive chains from two perspectives: believers and non-believers of the news claims. Using GPT-4.1 as a role-player across these stances, we find that incorporating believers’ chains improves the perceived quality of explanations for audiences with misinformation-aligned beliefs. Our findings underscore the importance of modeling diverse mental states in explanation generation and provide the first systematic evidence that Theory-of-Mind–based cognitive chains enhance the persuasiveness of explanations in misinformation contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着人工智能系统在日常交流中的应用越来越广泛，大语言模型不仅被期望提供事实准确的回应，还被期望能够生成能够触动用户心理状态的解释。我们基于“认知链”这一概念——该概念借鉴了心智理论理论，将情境、线索、想法、行动和情绪这五个要素进行结构化表示——来研究是否可以通过在模型输出中引入这种信念链来提高解释的质量。具体来说，我们从六个维度来评估解释的效果：整体质量、逻辑正确性、完整性、简洁性、同理心以及与事实的一致性。先前的研究表明，大语言模型的解释往往倾向于采用中立或不确定的立场，而那些持有错误信念的人则对纠正持高度抵抗态度。为了应对这一挑战，我们从两个角度来构建认知链：支持新闻主张的人和反对这些主张的人。通过使用GPT-4.1作为这两个立场的模拟角色，我们发现，将支持这些主张的人的认知链纳入解释中，可以提高那些持有错误信息信念的受众对解释质量的感知。我们的研究结果强调了在解释生成过程中建模多样化心理状态的重要性，并首次提供了系统性的证据，证明基于心智理论的认知链能够在错误信息情境中提升解释的说服力。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: CoTJudger: A Graph-Driven Framework for Automatic Evaluation of Chain-of-Thought Efficiency and Redundancy in LRMs
papers.title_zh: CoTJudger：一种基于图的框架，用于自动评估链式思维在LRM中的效率与冗余性
papers.authors: Siyi Li, Jiajun Shi, Shiwen Ni, Ge Zhang, Shuaimin Li, Shijian Wang, Zhoufutu Wen, Yizhi LI, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Jiaheng Liu, Min Yang, Wenhao Huang
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated strong performance by producing extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces before answering. However, this paradigm often induces over-reasoning: redundant calculations and circular self-verification that increase computational cost without improving outcomes. Existing evaluations largely emphasize final accuracy or coarse token counts, and lack automated tools to separate essential logic from structural redundancy. We introduce CoTJudger, a graph-driven framework that quantifies reasoning efficiency by converting free-form CoTs into directed dependency graphs and extracting the Shortest Effective Path (SEP) needed to reach a correct solution. This yields an interpretable efficiency signal – how much of a CoT is necessary versus structurally redundant – that is comparable across models and tasks. Evaluating 21 LRMs, CoTJudger reveals pervasive redundancy and surfaces recurring failure modes, including verification obsession and compensatory redundancy. These results provide a practical metric for disentangling reasoning ability from computational waste, enabling more targeted evaluation and diagnosis of LRM efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型在回答问题之前能够生成较长的思维链过程。然而，这种模式往往会导致过度推理：不必要的计算以及循环性的自我验证，这些都会增加计算成本，而并未提升解决问题的效果。现有的评估方式主要关注的是最终准确性或粗略的标记数量，缺乏能够区分关键逻辑与结构冗余的自动化工具。我们提出了CoTJudger这一基于图论的框架，它通过将自由形式的思维链转化为有向依赖图，从而计算出达到正确解决方案所需的最短有效路径。这样就能得到一个可解释的效率指标——即需要多少思维链内容，以及哪些部分是结构上的冗余。通过对21个大型推理模型进行评估，CoTJudger发现了普遍存在的冗余现象，并揭示了常见的失败模式，包括过度验证和补偿性冗余。这些结果为我们提供了一种实用的方法，可以将推理能力与计算浪费区分开来，从而更精准地评估和分析大型推理模型的效率。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: The Inner Monologue of Language Models: When Reasoning Traces Reveal More Than They Hide
papers.title_zh: 语言模型的内心独白：当推理的痕迹揭示出隐藏在表面之下的真相时
papers.authors: Pratham Singla, Shivank Garg, Ayush Singh, Ishan Garg, Ketan Suhaas Saichandran
papers.abstract: Recent advances in post-training techniques have endowed Large Language Models (LLMs) with enhanced capabilities for tackling complex, logic-intensive tasks through the generation of supplementary planning tokens. This development raises a fundamental question – Are these models aware of what they "learn” and "think”? To address this, we define three core competencies: (1) awareness of learned latent policies, (2) generalization of these policies across domains, and (3) alignment between internal reasoning traces and final outputs. We empirically evaluate these abilities on several tasks, each designed to require learning a distinct policy. Furthermore, we contrast the profiles of models post-trained via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Direct Policy Optimization (DPO), and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Our findings indicate that RL-trained models not only demonstrate greater awareness of their learned behaviors and stronger generalizability to novel, structurally similar tasks than SFT models but also often exhibit weak alignment between their reasoning traces and final outputs, an effect most pronounced in GRPO-trained models.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在训练后技术方面的进展，使得大语言模型具备了更强的能力，能够通过对补充规划令牌的生成来处理复杂且需要逻辑处理的任务。这一发展引发了一个基本问题：这些模型是否意识到它们“学习”了什么以及“思考”了什么？为了回答这个问题，我们定义了三个核心能力：(1)对所学潜在策略的感知；(2)将这些策略在不同领域中的泛化能力；(3)内部推理轨迹与最终输出之间的对齐性。我们在多个任务上对这些能力进行了实证评估，每个任务都旨在要求模型学习不同的策略。此外，我们还比较了通过监督微调、直接策略优化和群体相对策略优化进行训练后的模型的性能。我们的研究发现表明，通过强化学习训练的模型不仅对其所学行为的感知更为敏锐，对新结构相似的任务的泛化能力也更强，但与监督微调模型相比，它们的推理轨迹与最终输出之间的对齐性往往较弱，这种差异在通过群体相对策略优化训练的模型中表现得尤为明显。

papers.title: Do VLMs Have a Moral Backbone? A Study on the Fragile Morality of Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 视觉语言模型是否有道德准则？关于视觉语言模型脆弱道德层面的研究
papers.authors: Zhining Liu, Tianyi Wang, Xiao Lin, Penghao Ouyang, Gaotang Li, Ze Yang, Hui Liu, Sumit Keswani, Vishwa Pardeshi, Huijun Zhao, Wei Fan, Hanghang Tong
papers.abstract: Despite substantial efforts toward improving the moral alignment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), it remains unclear whether their ethical judgments are stable in realistic settings. This work studies moral robustness in VLMs, defined as the ability to preserve moral judgments under textual and visual perturbations that do not alter the underlying moral context. We systematically probe VLMs with a diverse set of model-agnostic multimodal perturbations and find that their moral stances are highly fragile, frequently flipping under simple manipulations. Our analysis reveals systematic vulnerabilities across perturbation types, moral domains, and model scales, including a sycophancy trade-off where stronger instruction-following models are more susceptible to persuasion. We further show that lightweight inference-time interventions can partially restore moral stability. These results demonstrate that moral alignment alone is insufficient and that moral robustness is a necessary criterion for the responsible deployment of VLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在提升视觉语言模型（VLMs）的道德一致性方面已经付出了大量努力，但目前的研究仍不清楚它们在现实环境中的道德判断是否稳定。本研究探讨了VLMs的道德稳健性，即它们在文本和视觉干扰下仍能保持道德判断的能力，而这些干扰并不会改变其背后的道德背景。我们通过多种与模型无关的多模态干扰手段对VLMs进行了系统性的测试，发现它们的道德立场非常脆弱，很容易因简单的操作而发生变化。我们的分析表明，不同类型的干扰、不同的道德领域以及不同的模型规模都会带来系统性问题，其中包括一种“阿谀奉承权衡”现象——那些更擅长遵循指令的模型更容易受到诱惑。此外，我们还发现，通过轻量级推理时间干预措施可以部分恢复模型的道德稳定性。这些结果表明，单纯的道德一致性是不够的，道德稳健性是确保VLMs被负责任地部署所必需的条件。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: ENPMR-Bench: Benchmarking Proactive Memory Retrieval for Emotional Support Agents
papers.title_zh: ENPMR-Bench：情感支持机器人中主动记忆检索能力的基准测试
papers.authors: Xing Fu, Yulin Hu, Mengtong Ji, Haozhen Li, Yixin Sun, Weixiang Zhao, Yanyan Zhao, Bing Qin
papers.abstract: Memory-augmented language agents are increasingly deployed in affective applications such as emotional support, where understanding and responding to users’ latent emotional needs is critical. However, existing research often treats memory as a tool for factual retrieval, overlooking its role in shaping users’ emotional experiences. In this work, we introduce ENPMR-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Emotional Need-aware Proactive Memory Retrieval (ENPMR), a core capability that enables agents to infer users’ latent emotional needs and proactively retrieve appropriate memories to support empathetic interaction. Grounded in Maslow’s hierarchy of needs, ENPMR-Bench includes over 1,800 memory-augmented dialogues and defines structured mappings between emotional needs and supportive memory types. Experimental results demonstrate that current retrieval paradigms, including both embedding-based and LLM-driven approaches, exhibit substantial deficiencies, with empathy scores significantly lagging behind golden memory conditions. While chain-of-thought prompting improves the alignment between inferred emotional needs and retrieved memories to some extent, a notable performance gap remains. Together, these findings reveal critical limitations in current agents and outline directions for advancing personalized emotional support through need-sensitive memory retrieval.
papers.abstract_zh: 记忆增强型语言代理越来越多地被应用于情感类应用，例如提供情感支持。在这些应用中，理解并回应用户的潜在情感需求至关重要。然而，现有的研究往往将记忆仅仅视为一种事实检索工具，而忽视了它在塑造用户情感体验中的重要作用。在这项研究中，我们提出了ENPMR-Bench这一基准测试，用于评估情感需求感知型主动记忆检索能力。这种能力使得代理能够推断出用户的潜在情感需求，并主动检索相应的记忆来支持富有同理心的交互。基于马斯洛的需求层次理论，ENPMR-Bench包含了超过1800个记忆增强型对话，并定义了情感需求与支持性记忆类型之间的结构化映射关系。实验结果表明，目前的检索方法，无论是基于嵌入的方法还是由大语言模型驱动的方法，都存在显著缺陷，其共情得分远远低于使用“黄金记忆”条件的表现。虽然上下文提示在一定程度上改善了推断出的情感需求与检索到的记忆之间的匹配度，但仍然存在明显的性能差距。这些发现揭示了当前代理存在的关键局限性，并为通过需求敏感的记忆检索来提升个性化情感支持提供了方向。

papers.title: Grounded Concreteness: Human-Like Concreteness Sensitivity in Vision–Language Models
papers.title_zh: 具象化的具体性：视觉-语言模型中类似人类的具象化感知能力
papers.authors: Aryan Roy, Zekun Wang, Christopher J. MacLellan
papers.abstract: Do vision-language models (VLMs) develop more human-like sensitivity to linguistic concreteness than text-only large language models (LLMs) when both are evaluated with text-only prompts? We study this question with a controlled comparison between matched Llama text backbones and their Llama Vision counterparts across multiple model scales, treating multimodal pretraining as an ablation on perceptual grounding rather than access to images at inference. We measure concreteness effects at three complementary levels: (i) output behavior, by relating question-level concreteness to QA accuracy; (ii) embedding geometry, by testing whether representations organize along a concreteness axis; and (iii) attention dynamics, by quantifying context reliance via attention-entropy measures. In addition, we elicit token-level concreteness ratings from models and evaluate alignment to human norm distributions, testing whether multimodal training yields more human-consistent judgments. Across benchmarks and scales, VLMs show larger gains on more concrete inputs, exhibit clearer concreteness-structured representations, produce ratings that better match human norms, and display systematically different attention patterns consistent with increased grounding.
papers.abstract_zh: 当使用纯文本提示对视觉语言模型（VLM）进行评估时，它们是否比仅基于文本的大语言模型（LLM）具有更类似人类的语言具体性感知能力？我们通过在不同模型规模下对Llama文本基础模型及其视觉版本进行对照比较来研究这个问题。我们将多模态预训练视为对感知基础能力的测试，而不是对图像信息的访问方式。我们从三个相互补充的层面来衡量具体性效果：(i) 输出行为，通过将问题层面的具体性与问答准确性联系起来；(ii) 嵌入几何结构，通过测试表示是否沿具体性轴进行组织；(iii) 注意力动态，通过注意力熵度量来量化上下文依赖性。此外，我们还从模型中获取了标记级别的具体性评分，并评估了其与人类标准分布的一致性，以检验多模态训练是否能产生更符合人类判断的结果。在各种基准测试和模型规模下，视觉语言模型在更具体的输入上表现出更大的优势，其表示结构更加清晰，产生的评分更符合人类标准，并且其注意力模式也显示出与增强的感知基础能力相一致的系统性差异。

papers.title: PROPER Agents: Proactivity Driven Personalized Agents for Advancing Knowledge Gap Navigation
papers.title_zh: 专业代理：以主动性为驱动的个性化代理，助力填补知识空白
papers.authors: Kirandeep Kaur, Vinayak Gupta, Aditya Gupta, Chirag Shah
papers.abstract: Current approaches to proactive assistance move beyond the ask-and-respond paradigm by anticipating user needs. In practice, they either burden users with clarifying questions or rely on context-based extrapolation, often leading to unnecessary or mistimed interventions. Such systems lack explicit mechanisms to model users’ knowledge gaps, resulting in incomplete or suboptimal task outcomes. To address this, we propose PROPER, a framework that explicitly models user-specific knowledge gaps in a controlled manner. Central to our approach is the notion of dimensions: structured, task-relevant factors that define the considerations required for effective task completion. Given a user query, the DGA (Dimension Generating Agent) identifies explicit dimensions (from the user’s query) and generates a set of candidate implicit dimensions capturing unarticulated aspects of the task. The RGA (Response Generating Agent) integrates both explicit and implicit dimensions selectively to produce personalized, context-aware, and proactively informative responses. We evaluate PROPER across multiple domains using a structured, gap-aware rubric that measures coverage, initiative appropriateness, and intent alignment. PROPER improves on quality scores and win rates across all domains, achieving up to 84% gains in single-turn evaluation and consistent dominance in multiturn interactions. All code for PROPER is available at: https://github.com/i-kiran/ProPer-Agent.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，主动式辅助系统的做法已经超越了“询问-回应”的传统模式，而是试图预测用户的需求。但实际上，这些系统要么给用户带来不必要的澄清问题，要么依赖基于上下文的推断，这往往会导致不必要或不恰当的干预。这样的系统缺乏对用户知识空白进行建模的机制，从而导致任务结果不完整或效果不佳。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PROPER框架。该框架能够以一种可控的方式明确模拟特定于用户的知识空白。我们的方法的核心概念是“维度”：这些结构化且与任务相关的因素，决定了完成任务所需的考虑因素。当用户提出查询时，DGA（维度生成代理）会识别出明确的维度（来自用户的查询），并生成一组隐含的维度，以涵盖任务中未明确表述的方面。RGA（响应生成代理）则选择性地整合这些明确和隐含的维度，从而生成个性化、注重上下文且具有主动提示功能的响应。我们通过一个结构化的、考虑知识空白的评估标准，在多个领域对PROPER进行了评估，该标准包括覆盖程度、干预的适当性以及意图的一致性。结果表明，PROPER在所有领域的质量得分和胜率都有所提高，在单轮交互中实现了高达84%的提升，在多轮交互中则始终保持优势。PROPER的所有代码均可在此处获取：https://github.com/i-kiran/ProPer-Agent。

papers.title: PO-KGQA: Preference Optimization for Low-Resource Complex Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.title_zh: PO-KGQA：适用于低资源复杂知识图谱的偏好优化问答系统
papers.authors: Prerna Agarwal, Ayushman Kumar Singh, Srikanta Bedathur
papers.abstract: Existing low-resource in-context learning-based knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) methods rely heavily on large language models (LLMs) to convert the natural language question into its corresponding logical form (LF), such as SPARQL, KoPL, etc. Recently, a few alignment techniques have been introduced that enable instruction-based fine-tuning of language models. They provide explicit negative signals and comparative objectives to learn how to avoid negative signals using preference optimization methods. Exploring such fine-tuning techniques with LLMs becomes very challenging due to the high computational resource requirements associated with them. Due to this, the focus has been shifted towards Small Language Models (SLMs), which offer advantages such as ease of (i) deployment for practical applications and (ii) instruction fine-tuning for specialized tasks. Motivated by this, in this work, we propose PO-KGQA: An SLM-based preference optimization framework for the complex KGQA task in a low-resource setting. Our extensive experiments demonstrate how PO-KGQA outperforms other fine-tuning alignment techniques on complex benchmarks such as KQA Pro by approximately 9% (avg).
papers.abstract_zh: 目前，基于上下文学习的高资源需求知识图谱问答方法主要依赖大语言模型，将自然语言问题转换为相应的逻辑形式，如SPARQL、KoPL等。最近，一些对齐技术被引入，使得语言模型能够基于指令进行微调。这些技术提供了明确的负面信号和比较目标，从而通过偏好优化方法来学习如何避免负面信号。然而，由于这些技术需要大量的计算资源，因此利用它们进行微调变得非常困难。因此，研究重点转向了小型语言模型，因为它们具有一些优势：易于部署到实际应用中，并且可以针对特定任务进行指令级微调。基于这一考虑，我们在本文中提出了PO-KGQA：一种基于小型语言模型的偏好优化框架，适用于低资源环境下的复杂知识图谱问答任务。我们的实验表明，PO-KGQA在诸如KQA Pro这样的复杂基准测试中的表现比其他微调对齐技术高出约9%（平均得分）。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Beyond Prompt Engineering: A Systematic Analysis of Prompt Lexical Sensitivity and Its Impacts on Quality
papers.title_zh: 超越提示工程：对提示词汇敏感性的系统分析及其对质量的影响
papers.authors: Qipeng Xie, Zi Liang, Jiafei Wu, Yufei Chen, Weizheng Wang, Wenao Ma, Zhong Ming, Haiqin Yang, Kaishun Wu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit extreme sensitivity to surface-level prompt variations, where minor lexical perturbations trigger disproportionate performance fluctuations. Moving beyond black-box optimization or coarse-grained templates, we conduct the first analysis of n-gram token-level mechanisms, leveraging a large-scale dataset of 132,000 prompt variants. Our investigation uncovers the Scaling Law of Prompt Performance Stability: higher average performance is inherently associated with lower variance and greater stability. We identify that this robustness is driven by two linguistic pillars: Domain-Specific Terminology, which anchors semantic boundaries, and Explicit Action Directives, which formalize reasoning trajectories. By narrowing the model’s interpretative space, these patterns effectively “lock” the generation process. We operationalize these findings into an automated Prompt-Refining Agent that autonomously restructures queries via domain anchoring and operational constraints. Empirical results show a 40.7% reduction in performance variance for code generation, offering a statistically grounded framework for robust prompt engineering.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）往往对表面上的提示变化表现出极端的敏感性，微小的词汇扰动就会导致性能出现不成比例的波动。我们不再采用黑盒优化或粗粒度模板的方法，而是利用包含132,000种提示变体的大规模数据集，对n-gram级别的机制进行了首次分析。我们的研究发现了提示性能稳定性的规律：平均性能越高，其波动性就越低，稳定性也就越高。我们发现，这种鲁棒性是由两个语言要素驱动的：特定领域的术语，它们明确了语义边界；以及明确的行为指令，它们规范了推理路径。通过缩小模型的解释空间，这些模式有效地“锁定”了生成过程。我们将这些发现转化为一种自动化的提示优化工具，该工具能够通过领域锚定和操作约束来自主重构查询。实证结果显示，代码生成的性能波动减少了40.7%，这为鲁棒的提示设计提供了一个基于统计的框架。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: DUSK: Do Not Unlearn Shared Knowledge
papers.title_zh: 黄昏：不要抛弃共同学习到的知识
papers.authors: Wonje Jeung, Sangyeon Yoon, Hyesoo Hong, Soeun Kim, Seungju Han, Youngjae Yu, Albert No
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove “forget” data while preserving knowledge from the “retain” data, yet a fundamental question arises when the two share content. By definition, an unlearned model should be indistinguishable from a model retrained solely on the retain set, which implies that shared knowledge must remain while only forget-specific content is removed. To evaluate this requirement, we introduce DUSK, the first benchmark for unlearning under realistic knowledge overlap. DUSK constructs documents containing both shared and unique knowledge and defines seven metrics to test whether methods erase forget-specific expressions without discarding shared facts. Evaluating nine recent approaches, we find that although surface text is often removed, current methods struggle to distinguish shared from unique knowledge, either erasing information that should be retained or failing to fully forget target content. DUSK provides a controlled, reproducible testbed for diagnosing these failures and guiding precise unlearning algorithms.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器去遗忘的目的是在保留“保留”数据的同时，消除“遗忘”的数据。然而，当这两种数据存在重叠时，就会出现一个基本问题。根据定义，经过去遗忘处理的模型应该与仅基于保留数据集重新训练的模型没有区别，这意味着共享知识必须得以保留，而特定于遗忘的内容则会被清除。为了评估这一要求，我们引入了DUSK，这是首个针对现实知识重叠情况下去遗忘处理的基准测试。DUSK构建了包含共享知识和独特知识的文档，并定义了七个指标来检验方法是否能够在不丢弃共享信息的情况下消除特定于遗忘的内容。通过对九种最新方法的评估，我们发现尽管表面文本经常被清除，但目前的方法在区分共享知识与独特知识方面存在困难，要么会清除应被保留的信息，要么无法完全消除目标内容。DUSK提供了一个可控且可复现的测试平台，用于诊断这些缺陷并指导精确的去遗忘算法设计。

papers.title: Towards Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models by Refining Textual Embeddings
papers.title_zh: 通过改进文本嵌入技术来减轻大型视觉语言模型中的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Aakriti Agrawal, Gouthaman KV, Rohith Aralikatti, Gauri Jagatap, Jiaxin Yuan, Sarvesh Baskar, Vijay Kamarshi, Andrea Fanelli, Furong Huang
papers.abstract: Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) remain a persistent challenge, often stemming from inadequate integration of visual information during multimodal reasoning. A key cause is the model’s over-reliance on textual priors and underutilization of visual cues, leading to outputs that are linguistically fluent but visually inaccurate. For example, given an image of an empty kitchen countertop, an LVLM might hallucinate a “bowl of fruit” or “cup of coffee,” relying on language associations rather than visual evidence. Most LVLMs incorporate visual features by appending them to the input stream of a pre-trained LLM and training on large-scale vision-language datasets. Our systematic analysis reveals that this strategy often leads to over-dependence on textual information due to the inherent bias of LLMs towards language-dominant representations. This imbalance skews attention towards the text over visual content, weakening the model’s ability to ground outputs in visual inputs. To address this, we propose a simple yet effective visual feature incorporation method that encourages the model to learn visually-informed textual embeddings distinct from those of the base LLM and promotes a more balanced attention distribution. Experimental results across multiple hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly reduces hallucinations and fosters more balanced multimodal reasoning. Notably, our approach achieves substantial gains, including \textbf{+9.33}% on MMVP-MLLM, \textbf{+2.99}% on POPE-AOKVQA, up to \textbf{+3.4}% on Merlin, and \textbf{+3}% on the hard-data split of HallusionBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大型视觉语言模型中，幻觉现象仍然是一个持续存在的挑战，这通常源于在多模态推理过程中对视觉信息的整合不足。其中一个主要原因是模型过度依赖文本先验信息，而忽视了视觉线索的作用，导致模型输出的语言部分可能很流畅，但视觉内容却不准确。例如，当看到一张空厨房台面的图片时，视觉语言模型可能会误认为图像中有一个“水果碗”或“一杯咖啡”，这是因为模型依赖于语言上的联想而非视觉证据。大多数视觉语言模型通过将视觉特征添加到预训练的大语言模型的输入流中，并在大规模视觉语言数据集上进行训练来融合视觉特征。我们的系统分析表明，这种策略往往会导致模型过度依赖文本信息，因为大语言模型本身倾向于使用以语言为主的表示方式。这种不平衡使得模型更关注文本内容，而忽略了视觉信息，从而削弱了模型根据视觉输入生成准确输出的能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种简单而有效的视觉特征融合方法，该方法鼓励模型学习出与基础大语言模型不同的、基于视觉信息的文本嵌入，从而促进更加平衡的注意力分配。在多个幻觉评估基准测试中的实验结果表明，我们的方法显著减少了幻觉现象，并促进了更加平衡的多模态推理。值得注意的是，我们的方法取得了显著的成效：在MMVP-MLLM任务上实现了高达+9.33%的改进，在POPE-AOKVQA任务上实现了+2.99%的改进，在Merlin任务上达到了+3.4%的改进，在HallusionBench的困难数据分割任务上则实现了+3%的改进。

papers.title: Prior Beliefs Prejudice LLM-as-Judge: Evidence from Persuasion Evaluation
papers.title_zh: 先前的信念、偏见与LLM作为裁判：来自说服评估的证据
papers.authors: Pardis Sadat Zahraei, Xiaoning Wang, Nimet Beyza Bozdag, Gokhan Tur, Dilek Hakkani-Tür
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges to evaluate text quality, moderate content, and assess arguments. We investigate whether alignment-instilled prior beliefs bias LLM judgments, using persuasion evaluation as a representative task. We find a systematic failure: models conflate their trained beliefs with rhetorical quality, rating identical claims differently based on belief alignment rather than argumentative merit. A bare assertion aligned with training receives higher scores than a well-crafted counter-argument, even when explicitly instructed to judge rhetoric alone. We introduce ConvinceQA, a dataset of 27,756 persuasive arguments with controlled stance variation across subjective, harmful, and misinformation domains, and demonstrate this prior prejudice across models. We exploit this failure through persuasion-based probing: evaluating minimal pairs that differ only in the subject token bypasses learned refusals and reveals hidden biases. Analysis identifies three failure modes, with belief-conditioned rating inflation accounting for 88% of cases. Cross-task validation on essay quality assessment and debate judging confirms this is a pervasive limitation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作评估文本质量、审核内容以及判断论点的工具。我们研究了是否存在着基于先验信念的对齐偏差，这种偏差会导致模型在评估时产生偏见。通过说服性评估这一代表性任务，我们发现模型存在系统性错误：它们将训练得到的信念与修辞质量混为一谈，根据信念的相似性而非论点的优劣来评价相同的论点。即使明确要求只评估修辞效果，与训练数据一致的简单主张仍然比精心设计的反驳意见获得更高的评分。我们引入了ConvinceQA数据集，该数据集包含27,756个有说服力的论点，这些论点在主观性、危害性以及虚假信息等领域具有可控的立场差异。我们的研究证明了不同模型之间存在这种先验偏见。我们通过基于说服性的探究方法来利用这一缺陷：通过评估仅主题词不同的“最小对立面”，可以绕过已学习的偏见，从而揭示隐藏的偏见。分析发现有三种导致这种偏差的模式，其中基于信念的评分膨胀占到了88%的情况。在文章质量评估和辩论评判方面的跨任务验证表明，这是一种普遍存在的局限性。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Direct Token Optimization: A Self-Contained Approach to Large Language Model Unlearning
papers.title_zh: 直接标记优化：一种用于大型语言模型“去训练”的自适应方法
papers.authors: Hong Kyu Lee, Ruixuan Liu, Li Xiong
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning is an emerging technique that removes the influence of a subset of training data (forget set) from a model without full retraining, with applications including privacy protection, content moderation, and model correction. The key challenge lies in achieving strong unlearning efficacy while preserving the overall utility. Existing unlearning methods for large language models (LLMs) often rely on auxiliary models, retain datasets, or even commercial AI services. However, dependence on these external resources is often impractical and could potentially introduce additional privacy risks. In this work, we propose direct token optimization (DTO), a self-contained unlearning approach for LLMs that directly optimizes the token-level objectives to unlearn specific sequences without external resources.For each sequence to be unlearned, we identify target tokens that encode critical knowledge for unlearning and treat remaining tokens as non-target ones for maintaining the model utility. DTO maximizes an unlearning objective on target tokens and applies a utility-preservation regularizer on non-target tokens.Across multiple unlearning benchmarks, DTO improves the forget quality up to 16.8\times over the latest baselines while maintaining comparable model utility. Our code is available at github.com/Emory-AIMS/direct_token_optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器去学习是一种新兴技术，它能够在不进行完全重新训练的情况下，去除部分训练数据对模型的影响。这种技术的应用范围包括隐私保护、内容审核和模型修正等。面临的挑战在于如何在保持模型整体功能的同时，实现有效的去学习效果。目前，针对大语言模型的去学习方法通常依赖于辅助模型、保留数据集或商业人工智能服务。然而，依赖这些外部资源往往不切实际，还可能带来额外的隐私风险。在这项研究中，我们提出了直接令牌优化方法——DTO。这是一种自包含的去学习方案，可以直接优化令牌级目标，以去除特定序列的信息，而无需依赖外部资源。对于每一个需要被去除的序列，我们会识别出那些用于编码关键知识的目标令牌，而将其余令牌视为非目标令牌，以保持模型的实用性。DTO在目标令牌上最大化去学习效果，同时在非目标令牌上应用效用保留正则化器。在多个去学习基准测试中，DTO将遗忘质量提升了16.8倍，同时保持了与最新基线模型相当的性能。我们的代码可以在github.com/Emory-AIMS/direct_token_optimization上下载。

papers.title: EntroBench: Evaluating LLM Watermarking Under Multi-Entropy Scenarios and Practical User Operations
papers.title_zh: EntroBench：在多种熵分布情况下评估大型语言模型的水印技术，以及考虑实际用户操作对水印效果的影响
papers.authors: Pengyuan Qin, Linnan Tu, Yuhan Ke, Hefei Ling
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) watermarking has been proposed as an active approach for content provenance verification, yet existing evaluations are largely confined to fixed entropy settings. In this paper, we introduce EntroBench, a benchmark for LLM watermarking that systematically covers three entropy levels and seven representative tasks. We conducted a fair evaluation of eight watermarking methods through hyper-parameter search based on an anchored dataset. We find that current approaches struggle to perform consistently across different entropy levels. Our analysis reveals a clear trade-off between watermark detectability and downstream output quality that varies across tasks and entropy conditions. Furthermore, we assess watermark robustness under realistic user interaction scenarios and show that common, non-adversarial user behaviors can substantially degrade watermark signals. These results indicate that practical usage-driven perturbations pose a significant challenge to current watermarking techniques. EntroBench provides a unified evaluation framework for studying these issues and supports the development of more adaptive and robust LLM watermarking methods. Dataset and codes are available at https://github.com/py-qin/EntroBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型水印技术被提出作为一种有效的内容来源验证方法，不过现有的评估大多局限于固定的熵设置下。在本文中，我们引入了EntroBench这一用于评估大语言模型水印技术的基准测试平台，该平台系统地涵盖了三种不同的熵水平以及七种代表性的任务类型。我们通过基于已有数据集的超参数搜索，对八种水印技术进行了公平评估。我们发现，当前的方法在不同熵水平下表现并不稳定。我们的分析表明，水印的可检测性与下游输出质量之间存在明显的权衡关系，这种权衡会随着任务和熵条件的不同而变化。此外，我们还评估了水印在实际用户交互场景下的鲁棒性，结果表明常见的非对抗性用户行为会显著降低水印信号的可靠性。这些结果表明，实际使用中可能出现的各种干扰因素对当前的水印技术构成了重大挑战。EntroBench提供了一个统一的评估框架，有助于研究这些问题，并支持开发更加自适应且鲁棒的大语言模型水印技术。数据集和代码可访问于https://github.com/py-qin/EntroBench。

papers.title: Beyond Single-Shot: Multi-step Tool Retrieval via Query Planning
papers.title_zh: 不仅仅是单次操作：通过查询规划实现多步骤工具获取
papers.authors: Wei Fang, James R. Glass
papers.abstract: LLM agents operating over massive, dynamic tool libraries rely on effective retrieval, yet standard single-shot dense retrievers struggle with complex requests. These failures primarily stem from the disconnect between abstract user goals and technical documentation, and the limited capacity of fixed-size embeddings to model combinatorial tool compositions. To address these challenges, we propose ToolQP, a lightweight framework that models retrieval as iterative query planning. Instead of single-shot matching, ToolQP decomposes instructions into sub-tasks and dynamically generates queries to interact with the retriever, effectively bridging the semantic gap by targeting the specific sub-tasks required for composition. We train ToolQP using synthetic query trajectories followed by optimization with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). Experiments demonstrate that ToolQP achieves state-of-the-art performance, exhibiting superior zero-shot generalization, robustness across diverse retrievers, and significant improvements in downstream agentic execution.
papers.abstract_zh: 在庞大的、动态的工具库上运行的LLM智能体依赖于高效的检索功能，然而标准的单次密集检索模型在处理复杂请求时表现不佳。这些问题的根源在于抽象的用户目标与技术文档之间的不匹配，以及固定大小的嵌入向量在模拟组合工具组合时的局限性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ToolQP这一轻量级框架，它将检索过程建模为迭代的查询规划过程。与单次匹配方式不同，ToolQP将指令分解为子任务，并动态生成用于与检索器交互的查询，从而有效地弥合了语义上的差距，通过针对组合所需的特定子任务来实现高效检索。我们通过使用合成查询轨迹来训练ToolQP，然后通过带有可验证奖励的强化学习方法进行优化。实验表明，ToolQP取得了领先的性能水平，表现出出色的零样本泛化能力、在不同检索模型中的鲁棒性，以及在下层智能体执行任务方面的显著改进。

papers.title: On Safety Risks in Experience-Driven Self-Evolving Agents
papers.title_zh: 关于基于经验的自进化智能体中的安全风险
papers.authors: Weixiang Zhao, Yichen Zhang, Yingshuo Wang, Yang Deng, Yanyan Zhao, Xuda Zhi, Yongbo Huang, Hao He, Wanxiang Che, Bing Qin, Ting Liu
papers.abstract: Experience-driven self-evolution has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving the autonomy of large language model agents, yet its reliance on self-curated experience introduces underexplored safety risks. In this study, we investigate how experience accumulation and utilization in self-evolving agents affect safety performance across web-based and embodied environments. Notably, experience gathered solely from benign tasks can still compromise safety in high-risk scenarios. Further analysis attributes this degradation to the execution-oriented nature of accumulated experience, which reinforces agents’ tendency to act rather than refuse. In more realistic settings where agents encounter both benign and harmful tasks, refusal-related experience mitigates safety decline but induces over-refusal, revealing a fundamental safety–utility trade-off. Overall, our findings expose inherent limitations of current self-evolving agents and call for more principled strategies to ensure safe and reliable adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于经验的自我进化已成为提升大语言模型代理自主性的有效方法。然而，这种依赖精心筛选的经验的方式带来了尚未充分探讨的安全风险。在本研究中，我们探讨了在自我进化的代理中，经验积累与利用如何影响其在网络环境和实体环境中的安全性能。值得注意的是，仅来自无害任务的经验仍可能在高风险场景中危及安全。进一步分析表明，这种性能下降是由于积累的经验具有执行导向性，这使得代理更倾向于采取行动而非拒绝任务。在代理同时面临无害和有害任务的更现实环境中，与拒绝相关的经验能够缓解安全风险，但过度拒绝则会导致问题加剧，从而揭示了安全性与实用性之间的根本权衡。总体而言，我们的研究结果揭示了当前自我进化代理存在的固有局限性，需要采用更加合理的策略来确保代理的可靠与安全适应性。
