papers.title: LLM Program Optimization via Retrieval Augmented Search
papers.title_zh: 通过增强检索功能来实现项目优化优化程序
papers.authors: Sagnik Anupam, Alexander Shypula, Osbert Bastani
papers.abstract: Recent work has demonstrated the potential of large language models (LLMs) for program optimization, a key challenge in programming languages. We propose a blackbox adaptation method called Retrieval Augmented Search (RAS) that performs beam search over candidate optimizations; at each step, it retrieves in-context examples from a given training dataset of slow-fast program pairs to guide the LLM. Critically, we find that performing contextual retrieval based on an LLM-generated natural language description significantly outperforms retrieval based on the source code. We also propose AEGIS, a method for improving interpretability by decomposing training examples into "atomic edits” that are significantly more incremental in nature. We show that RAS performs up to 2.06\times better than prior state-of-the-art blackbox adaptation strategies on optimizing C++ programs, and that AEGIS performs up to 1.37\times better while making significantly smaller edits. We also show that using RAS improves the mean runtime percentile of Python programs by 10.27 compared to baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，大语言模型在程序优化方面具有巨大潜力，而程序优化是编程语言中的一个关键挑战。我们提出了一种名为“检索增强搜索”的黑盒适应方法，该方法通过对候选优化方案进行束搜索来指导语言模型的决策过程。在每一步中，它都会从给定的慢速-快速程序对训练数据集中提取上下文相关的示例，以作为指导语言模型的依据。值得注意的是，基于语言模型生成的自然语言描述的上下文检索方式，其效果明显优于基于源代码的检索方式。我们还提出了AEGIS方法，该方法通过将训练示例分解为“原子编辑”来提升程序的可解释性，这种处理方式更加易于理解。我们的实验表明，与现有的最先进的黑盒适应策略相比，RAS在优化C++程序方面的性能提升了2.06倍；而AEGIS则在实现相同效果的同时，所需的修改幅度要小得多。此外，使用RAS还能使Python程序的平均运行时间提高10.27个百分点，这一效果优于基准测试方案。

papers.title: EnsemW2S: Enhancing Weak-to-Strong Generalization with Large Language Model Ensembles
papers.title_zh: EnsemW2S：通过大型语言模型集成提升弱泛化能力
papers.authors: Aakriti Agrawal, Mucong Ding, Chenghao Deng, Zora Che, Arjun Rajaram, Anirudh Satheesh, Bang An, C. Bayan Bruss, John Langford, Furong Huang
papers.abstract: With Large Language Models (LLMs) rapidly approaching and potentially surpassing human-level performance, it has become imperative to develop approaches capable of effectively supervising and enhancing these powerful models using smaller, human-level models exposed to only human-level data. We address this critical weak-to-strong (W2S) generalization challenge by proposing a novel method aimed at improving weak experts, by training on the same limited human-level data, enabling them to generalize to complex, super-human-level tasks. Our approach, called EnsemW2S, employs a token-level ensemble strategy that iteratively combines multiple weak experts, systematically addressing the shortcomings identified in preceding iterations. By continuously refining these weak models, we significantly enhance their collective ability to supervise stronger student models. We extensively evaluate the generalization performance of both the ensemble of weak experts and the subsequent strong student model across in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. For OOD, we specifically introduce question difficulty as an additional dimension for defining distributional shifts. Our empirical results demonstrate notable improvements, achieving 4%, and 3.2% improvements on ID datasets and, upto 6% and 2.28% on OOD datasets for experts and student models respectively, underscoring the effectiveness of our proposed method in advancing W2S generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的性能迅速接近甚至超越人类水平，开发能够利用仅基于人类水平数据的较小规模模型来有效监督和改进这些强大模型的方法变得至关重要。我们针对这一关键的弱到强泛化挑战，提出了一种新颖的方法：通过在相同的有限人类水平数据上进行训练，从而改进那些表现较弱的专家模型，使其能够泛化到复杂的、超人类水平的任务上。我们的方法被称为EnsemW2S，它采用了一种基于令牌级别的集成策略，通过迭代地结合多个弱专家模型，系统地解决之前迭代中发现的缺陷。通过不断优化这些弱模型，我们显著提升了它们对更强学生模型的监督能力。我们对弱专家模型的集成以及后续产生的强学生模型在分布内（ID）和分布外（OOD）数据集上的泛化性能进行了广泛评估。对于OOD数据集，我们特别引入了问题难度这一维度来定义分布偏移。我们的实证结果表明，该方法取得了显著的改进效果：在ID数据集上分别实现了4%和3.2%的提升；而在OOD数据集上，专家和学生模型分别实现了高达6%和2.28%的提升，这充分证明了我们提出的方法在推进弱到强泛化方面的有效性。

papers.title: Stable On-Policy Distillation through Adaptive Target Reformulation
papers.title_zh: 通过自适应目标重构实现稳定的在线策略蒸馏
papers.authors: Ijun Jang, Jewon Yeom, Juan Yeo, Hyunggyu Lim, Taesup Kim
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a widely adopted technique for transferring capabilities from large language models to smaller student models. However, conventional supervised KD often suffers from a distribution mismatch between training and inference. While on-policy KD approaches attempt to mitigate this issue by learning directly from student-generated outputs, they frequently encounter training instabilities and noisy teacher feedback during early optimization stages. These challenges manifest as pathological gradients in forward KL objectives when students encounter unfamiliar tokens, or as a collapse in distributional diversity within reverse KL regimes. To address these limitations, we propose Veto, an objective-level reformulation that constructs a geometric target distribution in logit space to emphasize agreement between the teacher and the student. By introducing a tunable parameter \beta, Veto serves as an Adaptive Gradient Veto that stabilizes optimization by suppressing harmful gradients on low-confidence tokens, while simultaneously acting as a Decisiveness Knob to balance reward-driven performance with output diversity. Extensive experiments across various reasoning and generation tasks demonstrate that Veto consistently outperforms supervised fine-tuning and existing on-policy baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏是一种被广泛采用的技术，用于将大语言模型的能力迁移到较小的学生模型中。然而，传统的监督式知识蒸馏往往存在训练与推理之间的分布不匹配问题。虽然基于策略的知识蒸馏方法试图通过直接学习学生生成的输出来缓解这个问题，但在早期优化阶段，它们经常会出现训练不稳定性和教师反馈的噪声问题。当学生遇到不熟悉的词汇时，这些问题会表现为前向KL目标中的病态梯度；而在反向KL过程中，则会导致分布多样性的崩溃。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了Veto这一目标级重构方法。该方法在逻辑斯蒂空间中构建了一个几何目标分布，以强调教师与学生之间的一致性。通过引入一个可调节的参数β，Veto可以作为一种自适应梯度抑制器，通过抑制对低置信度词汇的有害梯度来稳定优化过程；同时，它还可以作为一个决策旋钮，平衡由奖励驱动的性能和输出多样性。在多种推理和生成任务上的广泛实验表明，Veto始终优于监督式微调以及现有的基于策略的基线方法。

papers.title: A Syntactic and Semantic Probe into Language Evolution based on Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 基于大型语言模型的语法与语义探究——语言演变研究
papers.authors: Hao Pang, Changcheng Li, Yingxue Liu
papers.abstract: Language evolution is cognitively motivated by the reduction of communicative effort. Current research exploring this reported tendency has been constrained by the heavy reliance on manually annotated resources (e.g., dependency parsing) as well as a narrow focus (e.g., syntax as the single metric). To transcend these limitations, we propose two measures: Attention-based Structural Distance (ASD) and Semantic Space Distance (SSD). ASD is a parser-free measure of syntactic locality derived from the attention mechanism of pretrained large language models (LLM), while SSD is a measure of lexical distances that quantify the degree of separation between different parts of speech in the word vector space. Based on multiple diachronic and multilingual corpora, our experiments show a significant decrease of ASD while an increase of SSD, which implies a language developmental trend towards structural compactness and semantic divergence. Our research pioneers a novel lens grounded in LLM for studying language evolution, which has two major contributions. Linguistically, our study corroborates the hypothesized law of human language evolution by demonstrating that its development optimizes syntactic locality as well as functional semantic discriminability. Cognitively, our study shows that human and LLMs share common characteristics in language processing, lending support to the potential of employing LLMs in the study of human cognition.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言的演变是由认知需求驱动的，其目的是减少交流所需的努力。目前研究这一趋势时，主要依赖于人工标注的资源（如依存句法分析），并且研究的焦点较为狭窄，通常只关注语法结构这一单一维度。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了两种衡量方法：基于注意力的结构距离和语义空间距离。结构距离是一种无需句法分析工具就能测量的句法邻近性指标，它源自于预训练语言模型的注意力机制；而语义空间距离则用于衡量词汇单位之间的分离程度，这种测量方式能够反映词向量空间中不同词类之间的分隔程度。通过多语言、多时代的语料库实验，我们发现结构距离显著减少，而语义空间距离则有所增加。这表明语言在发展过程中趋向于结构上的紧凑性和语义上的差异性。我们的研究为利用语言模型来研究语言演变开辟了新的视角，具有两大重要意义。从语言学角度来看，我们的研究证实了人类语言演变的规律，即语言的发展优化了句法邻近性和功能语义的区分能力。从认知角度来看，我们的研究表明人类和语言模型在语言处理方面具有共同的特征，这为利用语言模型来研究人类认知提供了支持。

papers.title: Assessing the Effect of Context in Multi-domain Acceptability Judgment
papers.title_zh: 评估不同领域背景下可接受性的影响
papers.authors: Eunike Andriani Kardinata, Yusuke Sakai, Taro Watanabe
papers.abstract: Acceptability judgments provide a crucial basis for understanding how sentences are perceived as natural or well-formed, and they are increasingly used to assess the linguistic capability of large language models (LLMs). Unlike grammaticality, acceptability depends not only on structural form but also on contextual and domain-specific factors. Most prior work evaluates sentences in isolation, and relatively little is known about how explicit contextual cues influence LLM acceptability judgments across domains. This study examines how contextual information affects model-generated acceptability ratings across multiple domains and several LLMs, using different forms of domain-specific contextual cues to situate sentences in their intended usage settings. The results show that context can meaningfully shift model judgments, although its effects vary across models and domains. Overall, the findings provide evidence on contextual effects in LLM acceptability judgment and support the development of more context-aware evaluation frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 可接受性判断是理解句子如何被视为自然或结构良好的重要基础，它们被越来越多地用于评估大语言模型的语言能力。与语法性不同，可接受性不仅取决于结构形式，还受到上下文和领域特定因素的影响。迄今为止的大部分研究都是单独评估句子的可接受性，而对于明确的上下文线索如何影响不同领域中的语言模型可接受性判断，我们知之甚少。本研究探讨了上下文信息如何影响多个领域和多种语言模型生成的模型可接受性评分，通过不同的领域特定上下文线索来将句子置于其预期的使用环境中。研究结果表明，上下文确实能够显著改变模型的判断结果，不过其影响在不同模型和不同领域之间存在差异。总体而言，这些发现为语言模型可接受性判断中的上下文效应提供了证据支持，并为开发更加考虑上下文的评估框架提供了依据。

papers.title: Lost in Decomposition: Analyzing and Mitigating the Limitations of Long Context Methods via Context Dependency
papers.title_zh: 陷入分解之中：通过分析上下文依赖性来规避长上下文方法的局限性
papers.authors: Jiayuan Guo, Yueyang Su, Yuyao Ge, Saiping Guan, Lei Yu, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng
papers.abstract: Long context large language models exhibit the “lost in the middle” problem, where models struggle to effectively utilize information located in the middle of long contexts. Although existing workflow-based long context methods (e.g., RAG) alleviate this problem and perform well on specific datasets, can their effectiveness generalize to all types of datasets? In this work, we systematically investigate the cross-dataset generalization of long context methods. Our evaluation reveals that these methods are not universally effective. Such substantial performance variability underscores the risks of performance degradation associated with the indiscriminate application of long context methods. We investigated the reason for the failure of long context methods. We found that the intrinsic decomposition mechanisms of long context methods hinder context dependency modeling, causing these methods to suffer performance declines on documents with strong context dependency. To address this issue, We propose CoDaR (Context Dependency-aware Routing), a training-free adaptive routing strategy. By analyzing the context dependency strength of documents, CoDaR adaptively invokes long context methods, thereby significantly enhancing their overall robustness across different types of datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 长上下文大语言模型存在“陷入中间部分”的问题，即模型难以有效利用位于长上下文中间的信息。虽然现有的基于工作流程的长上下文方法（如RAG）能够缓解这一问题，并在特定数据集上表现良好，但它们的有效性能否推广到所有类型的数据集呢？在这项研究中，我们系统地探讨了长上下文方法在不同数据集上的泛化能力。我们的评估结果显示，这些方法并非在所有情况下都有效。这种显著的性能差异表明，不加选择地应用长上下文方法会带来性能下降的风险。为了探究长上下文方法失效的原因，我们发现这些方法的固有分解机制阻碍了上下文依赖性的建模，导致这些方法在具有强上下文依赖性的文档上表现不佳。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了CoDaR（上下文依赖性感知路由）这一无需训练的自适应路由策略。通过分析文档的上下文依赖性强度，CoDaR能够自适应地调用长上下文方法，从而显著提升了这些方法在不同类型数据集上的整体鲁棒性。

papers.title: Tandem: Riding Together with Large and Small Language Models for Efficient Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 串联模式：让大型与小型语言模型协同工作，以实现高效的推理能力
papers.authors: Zichuan Fu, Xian Wu, Guojing Li, Yejing Wang, Yijun Chen, Zhao Zihao, Luo Yixuan, Hanyu Yan, Yefeng Zheng, Xiangyu Zhao
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have catalyzed the rise of reasoningintensive inference paradigms, where models perform explicit step-by-step reasoning before generating final answers. While such approaches improve answer quality and interpretability, they incur substantial computational overhead due to the prolonged generation sequences. In this paper, we propose Tandem, a novel collaborative framework that synergizes large and small language models (LLMs and SLMs) to achieve high-quality reasoning with significantly reduced computational cost. Specifically, the LLM serves as a strategic coordinator, efficiently generating a compact set of critical reasoning insights. These insights are then used to guide a smaller, more efficient SLM in executing the full reasoning process and delivering the final response. To balance efficiency and reliability, Tandem introduces a cost-aware termination mechanism that adaptively determines when sufficient reasoning guidance has been accumulated, enabling early stopping of the LLM’s generation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that Tandem reduces computational costs by approximately 40% compared to standalone LLM reasoning, while achieving superior or competitive performance. Furthermore, the sufficiency classifier trained on one domain transfers effectively to others without retraining. The code is available at: https://github.com/Applied-MachineLearning-Lab/ACL2026_Tandem.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期大语言模型（LLM）的进展推动了以推理为中心的推理范式的兴起。在这种模式下，模型在生成最终答案之前会进行详细的逐步推理。虽然这种方法能够提升答案的质量和可解释性，但由于生成过程的漫长，其计算成本也相当高。在本文中，我们提出了Tandem这一创新性的协作框架。该框架将大语言模型与小型语言模型相结合，以实现高质量的推理，同时大幅降低计算成本。具体来说，LLM扮演了战略协调者的角色，高效地生成一系列关键的推理信息。这些信息随后被用于指导小型语言模型执行完整的推理过程，从而得出最终的回答。为了平衡效率和可靠性，Tandem引入了一种基于成本的终止机制，该机制能够自适应地判断何时已经积累了足够的推理指导，从而提前停止LLM的生成。在数学推理和代码生成方面的实验表明，与单独使用LLM进行推理相比，Tandem可将计算成本降低约40%，同时仍能获得更优或具有竞争力的性能。此外，在一个领域上训练出的充分性分类器可以有效地迁移到其他领域，而无需重新训练。相关代码可访问：https://github.com/Applied-MachineLearning-Lab/ACL2026_Tandem。

papers.title: PROBE: PROcess-Based BEnchmark for Hallucination Detection
papers.title_zh: 探针：基于过程的幻觉检测基准算法
papers.authors: Yu Zhang, Peter Belcak, Shizhe Diao, Yonggan Fu, Shaona Ghosh, Morteza Mardani, Eileen Margaret Peters Long, Bei Yu, Pavlo Molchanov
papers.abstract: Hallucination detection remains a significant challenge for large language models. Existing agentic applications rely on LLMs to self-assess the factuality of their outputs using single-step “LLM-as-a-judge” prompts. However, even when equipped with ground truth information, current LLMs still fall short in detecting hallucinations, and this one-shot evaluation offers neither the transparency nor the granularity needed to diagnose where and why the detection fails. To address this gap, we introduce PROBE (Process-based Benchmark for Hallucination Detection), a comprehensive benchmark that breaks down hallucination detection into four critical steps: claim decomposition, evidence finding, evidence evaluation, and hallucination localization, and evaluates each step individually. PROBE consists of 12,000 test cases across three task types—summarization, question answering, and style transfer. Critically, we demonstrate that when hallucination detection is treated as a multi-step process, all models achieve considerably better performance. Through extensive evaluation, we show that current LLMs struggle chiefly with evidence finding, and that finetuning on our released training data substantially improves performance on this step. PROBE represents a significant step toward more transparent, diagnosable, and robust hallucination detection systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉检测仍然是大语言模型面临的一个重要挑战。现有的智能应用依赖LLM通过单步式的“LLM作为裁判”提示来自我评估其输出的真实性。然而，即使配备了真实数据，当前的LLM在检测幻觉方面仍然存在不足，而这种一次性评估既无法提供所需的透明度，也无法提供诊断出检测失败的原因所需的详细程度。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了PROBE（基于过程的幻觉检测基准测试），这是一个全面的基准测试，它将幻觉检测分解为四个关键步骤：主张分解、证据查找、证据评估和幻觉定位，并分别对这些步骤进行评估。PROBE包含12,000个测试案例，涵盖三种任务类型——摘要生成、问答和风格转换。重要的是，我们发现当将幻觉检测视为一个多步骤过程时，所有模型的性能都得到了显著提升。通过广泛的评估，我们发现当前LLM主要存在证据查找方面的问题，而使用我们发布的训练数据进行微调能够显著改善这一方面的性能。PROBE代表了朝着更透明、可诊断且强大的幻觉检测系统迈出的重要一步。
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: Prompt Optimization for Relation Extraction using Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 利用强化学习进行关系提取的快速优化技术
papers.authors: Ying Liu, Dong Shuai, Cui Zibo, TengQi Ye, Gang Wu
papers.abstract: Relation extraction is a fundamental task in information extraction. Still, existing supervised approaches rely heavily on large-scale annotated data, limiting their applicability in domain-specific and low-resource scenarios. Prompt-based methods with large language models provide a parameter-efficient alternative; however, their performance is susceptible to prompt design, which often requires extensive domain expertise and heuristic trial-and-error. We propose REPO, a reinforcement learning-based automated prompt optimization framework for domain relation extraction. REPO formulates prompt construction as a structured, sequential decision-making problem, optimizing prompt quality through interaction with a black-box LLM. To enable efficient and stable optimization, we introduce a two-stage framework comprising an initial prompt-construction stage that generates semantically grounded candidates and a DRL-based refinement stage that iteratively improves prompts within a constrained, domain-aware action space. We further design a composite evaluation metric that integrates extraction accuracy and semantic consistency to serve as a dense reward signal. Extensive experiments on multiple relation extraction datasets across medical, financial, legal, and news domains demonstrate that REPO consistently outperforms existing prompt-based methods and supervised baselines. Ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed DRL-based prompt optimization strategy. Our code is available at https://github.com/dddong2-star/REPO.
papers.abstract_zh: 关系提取是信息提取中的一个基础任务。然而，现有的监督式方法严重依赖大规模标注数据，这限制了它们在特定领域和资源匮乏场景中的适用性。基于提示的方法借助大语言模型，提供了一种参数效率高的替代方案；不过，其性能容易受到提示设计的影响，而提示设计通常需要丰富的领域专业知识以及反复的试错过程。我们提出了REPO，这是一个基于强化学习的自动化提示优化框架，用于领域关系提取。REPO将提示构建问题抽象为结构化的、顺序性的决策问题，通过与黑盒语言模型的互动来优化提示质量。为了实现高效稳定的优化过程，我们采用了两阶段框架：第一阶段是生成语义上合理的候选提示；第二阶段则是基于深度强化学习的优化阶段，该阶段在受限且考虑领域特性的动作空间中逐步改进提示。我们还设计了一种复合评估指标，该指标结合了提取准确性和语义一致性，作为密集的奖励信号。在医学、金融、法律及新闻等多个领域的关系提取数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，REPO始终优于现有的基于提示的方法和监督式基线算法。进一步的消融研究进一步证实了所提出的基于深度强化学习的提示优化策略的有效性和鲁棒性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/dddong2-star/REPO下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: PolyAudio: Advancing Multi-Audio Reasoning in Large Audio Language Models with Interleaved Multi-Audio Contexts
papers.title_zh: PolyAudio：在大型音频语言模型中推进多音频推理技术的发展，通过交错处理多种音频上下文来实现更精确的预测
papers.authors: Sonal Kumar, Sreyan Ghosh, Yueqian Lin, S Sakshi, Ashish Seth, Yiran Chen, Ramani Duraiswami, Dinesh Manocha
papers.abstract: Large Audio Language Models have shown impressive performance on single-clip audio language tasks such as automatic speech recognition, captioning, and sound event recognition. Yet, their ability to reason over interleaved multi-audio contexts-where answering a query requires relating information across multiple audio clips-remains limited. We present PolyAudio, a LALM built on Audio Flamingo 3 that targets multi-audio understanding via instruction tuning rather than massive-scale pre-training, and PolyAudio-Instruct, a high-quality instruction-tuning dataset consisting of 1.3M+ QA pairs, spanning over 14 task subsets to empower multi-audio understanding and reasoning. PolyAudio uses an explicit interleaved representation with clip indexing to encourage faithful grounding and reduce ambiguity in multi-clip references. We evaluate PolyAudio on a diverse suite of multi-audio benchmarks alongside standard single-audio tasks. PolyAudio achieves strong performance on multi-audio reasoning, outperforming competitive baselines that are also often limited to reasoning over up-to 2 audio clips, while preserving robust single-clip performance. Overall, our results suggest that precise, academic-scale multi-audio instruction tuning can unlock advanced cross-clip reasoning capabilities, enabling more capable audio-centric assistants.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型音频语言模型在单片段音频语言任务上表现优异，例如自动语音识别、字幕生成和声音事件识别。然而，它们在处理多音频交织情境时的推理能力仍然有限——因为要回答一个查询问题，需要整合多个音频片段中的信息。我们提出了PolyAudio这一基于Audio Flamingo 3构建的语言模型，它通过指令调整而非大规模预训练来实现多音频理解。此外，我们还开发了PolyAudio-Instruct这一高质量指令调整数据集，其中包含130万条问答对，涵盖14个任务类别，旨在提升多音频理解和推理能力。PolyAudio采用显式的交织表示方式，并借助片段索引来减少多片段参考中的歧义性。我们在多种多音频基准测试以及标准单音频任务中评估了PolyAudio的性能。结果表明，PolyAudio在多音频推理方面表现出色，其性能优于那些仅能处理最多2个音频片段的基线模型，同时仍保持了良好的单片段处理能力。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，精确的学术级多音频指令调整可以解锁高级跨片段推理能力，从而打造出更强大的以音频为中心的助手。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Scaling Evaluation-Time Compute with Reasoning Models as Evaluators
papers.title_zh: 将评估时间分摊给推理模型来使用
papers.authors: Seungone Kim, Ian Wu, Jinu Lee, Xiang Yue, Seongyun Lee, Minkyeong Moon, Carolin Lawrence, Kiril Gashteovski, Julia Hockenmaier, Graham Neubig, Sean Welleck
papers.abstract: Language model (LM) evaluators that generate chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning are widely used for the assessment of LM responses. Simultaneously, increasing LMs’ “thinking” time through scaling test-time compute has proven to be an effective technique for solving challenging problems in domains such as math and code. This raises a natural question: can an LM’s evaluation capability also be improved by scaling test-time compute? To answer this, we investigate employing reasoning models - LMs that natively generate long CoT reasoning - as evaluators. We explore scaling evaluation-time compute by using reasoning models to evaluate both the overall candidate response (i.e., outcome evaluation) and the individual reasoning steps within it (i.e., process evaluation). We observe that evaluator performance improves monotonically with the number of reasoning tokens generated, mirroring trends seen in LM reasoning. Furthermore, we use these more accurate evaluators to rerank multiple generations, and demonstrate that spending more compute at evaluation time can be as effective as increasing compute during generation for improving an LM’s problem-solving performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 那些能够生成思维链推理的语言模型评估器，被广泛用于评估语言模型的响应。同时，通过增加测试时间的计算能力来延长语言模型的“思考”时间，已被证明是解决数学和编程等领域难题的有效方法。这引发了一个自然的问题：是否可以通过增加测试时间的计算能力来提升语言模型的评估能力呢？为了回答这个问题，我们研究了使用能够生成长思维链推理的语言模型作为评估器的方法。我们通过使用这些推理模型来评估整体候选响应（即结果评估）以及其中的各个推理步骤（即过程评估），从而探索如何扩展评估时间的计算能力。我们发现，评估器的性能随着生成的推理标记数量的增加而稳步提高，这与语言模型推理中的趋势一致。此外，我们利用这些更精确的评估器对多个生成结果进行重新排序，并证明在评估阶段投入更多的计算资源，与在生成阶段增加计算资源一样，能够有效提升语言模型的问题解决能力。

papers.title: Beyond Memorization: Extending Reasoning Depth with Recurrence, Memory and Test-Time Compute Scaling
papers.title_zh: 超越记忆技巧：通过递归、记忆机制以及测试时间计算能力的提升来加深推理深度
papers.authors: Ivan Rodkin, Daniil Orel, Konstantin Smirnov, Arman Bolatov, Bilal Elbouardi, Besher Hassan, Yuri Kuratov, Aydar Bulatov, Preslav Nakov, Timothy Baldwin, Artem Shelmanov, Mikhail Burtsev
papers.abstract: Reasoning is a core capability of large language models (LLMs), yet how multi-step reasoning is learned and executed remains unclear. We study this question in a controlled cellular-automata (1dCA) framework that excludes memorization by using disjoint training and test rules. Given a short state sequence, the model is required to infer the hidden local rule and then chain it to predict multiple future steps. Our evaluation shows that LLMs largely fail to reliably solve a natural-language proxy of the proposed task. We find that most neural architectures trained from scratch can learn rule inference and achieve high next-step accuracy, but performance drops sharply as the required number of intermediate reasoning steps increases. Experiments show that increasing model depth is crucial, and extending effective depth via recurrence, memory, or test-time compute improves results but remains bounded. Code is available on github: https://github.com/RodkinIvan/associative-recurrent-memory-transformer/tree/ACT.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理是大语言模型的核心能力之一，然而多步推理是如何被学习和执行的，目前仍不清楚。我们在一种受控的单元自动机框架中研究了这个问题，该框架通过采用不相交的训练和测试规则来排除记忆因素的影响。给定一个简短的状态序列，模型需要推断出隐藏的局部规则，然后将其用于预测多个未来的步骤。我们的评估结果显示，大语言模型在解决这项自然语言任务时，往往无法达到可靠的解决方案。我们发现，大多数从零开始训练的神经网络架构能够学习到规则推理机制，并达到较高的下一步预测准确率，但随着中间推理步骤数量的增加，性能会急剧下降。实验表明，增加模型的深度非常重要，而通过递归、记忆或测试时间计算等方式来扩展有效深度，虽然能改善结果，但效果仍然有限。代码可以在GitHub上找到：https://github.com/RodkinIvan/associative-recurrent-memory-transformer/tree/ACT
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Navigating the Alignment-Calibration Trade-off: A Pareto-Superior Frontier via Model Merging
papers.title_zh: 探索对齐与校准之间的权衡：通过模型合并获得帕累托改进前沿
papers.authors: Tiancheng Hu, Benjamin Minixhofer, Nigel Collier
papers.abstract: The “alignment tax” of post-training is typically framed as a drop in task accuracy. We show it also involves a severe loss of calibration, making models overconfident, less reliable, and model outputs less diverse. We demonstrate that this trade-off can be navigated effectively via a simple post-hoc intervention: interpolating between a model’s weights before and after alignment. Crucially, this is not a strict trade-off. We find that the process consistently reveals Pareto-optimal interpolations—models that improve accuracy beyond both parents while substantially recovering the calibration lost during alignment. Our work demonstrates that simple model merging provides a computationally efficient method for mitigating the full scope of the alignment tax, yielding models that are more capable and more reliable.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练后的“对齐成本”通常表现为任务准确度的下降。我们发现，这种成本还伴随着校准能力的严重丧失，导致模型变得过于自信、可靠性降低，且模型输出的多样性也减少了。我们证明，通过一种简单的后期干预措施，可以有效地解决这一权衡问题：在模型对齐前后之间对模型的权重进行插值处理。关键的是，这并不是一种严格的权衡关系。我们发现，这种处理方式能够始终找到帕累托最优的插值方案——即那些既能提高准确率，又能大幅恢复因对齐而损失的校准能力的模型。我们的研究表明，简单的模型合并是一种计算效率高的方法，能够有效减轻对齐成本带来的负面影响，从而生成出更强大、更可靠的模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: From Representation to Choice: Tracing Decision Emergence Across Languages in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 从“代表”到“选择”：在语言模型中追踪决策的产生过程
papers.authors: Divyanshu Bhatt, Abhinav Joshi, Ujjaval Patel, Ashutosh Modi
papers.abstract: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) can answer questions in many languages, but how they internally reason across languages remains poorly understood. In this work, we study multilingual reasoning through a decision-making perspective to investigate how multilingual reasoning unfolds in multilingual LLMs using aligned multiple-choice questions from the mMMLU benchmark. By formulating a controlled setup, presenting the same question in different languages, and tracking the model’s decision from the first token to the final answer choice, we can directly compare how reasoning trajectories evolve across languages. We first demonstrate that, at the representation level, different languages share highly similar activation spaces; however, subtle divergences emerge as decisions propagate through the transformer layers. We then model answer selection as a stepwise trajectory, revealing where language-specific signals arise. These patterns are further confirmed by quantifying deviations along these trajectories, highlighting layers where multilingual processing deviates or converges. Our work provides a controlled, layer-resolved view of multilingual reasoning, shedding light on how LLMs balance shared conceptual understanding with language-specific decision-making.
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言大语言模型能够用多种语言回答问题，但它们在内部如何跨语言进行推理仍然不清楚。在这项研究中，我们从决策的角度来研究多语言推理机制，通过使用 mMMLU 基准测试中的对齐选择题，探究多语言大语言模型中的多语言推理过程。通过构建一个受控的实验环境，用不同的语言呈现同一个问题，并跟踪模型从第一个标记到最终答案选择的决策过程，我们可以直接比较不同语言中推理轨迹的变化。首先，我们发现在表示层面，不同语言共享非常相似的激活空间；然而，当决策在变换器层中进行传播时，会出现细微的差异。接着，我们将答案选择建模为逐步的决策过程，从而揭示出与语言相关的信号出现的位置。这些模式通过量化这些决策过程中的偏差得到了进一步的验证，从而明确了多语言处理出现偏差或收敛的层次。我们的研究提供了一个受控且逐层解析的多语言推理视角，有助于理解大语言模型如何在共享的概念理解与语言特定的决策之间找到平衡。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Unlocking the Edge deployment and ondevice acceleration of multi-LoRA enabled one-for-all foundational LLM
papers.title_zh: 解锁Edge部署功能以及设备在运行多LoRA模型时实现的加速效果，这些基础LLM模型可以适用于所有场景
papers.authors: Sravanth Kodavanti, Sowmya Vajrala, Srinivas Soumitri Miriyala, Utsav Tiwari, Uttam Kumar, Utkarsh Kumar Mahawar, Achal Pratap Singh, Arya D, Narendra Mutyala, Vikram Nelvoy Rajendiran, Sharan Kumar Allur, Euntaik Lee, Dohyoung Kim, HyeonSu Lee, Gyusung Cho, JungBae Kim
papers.abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) on smartphones poses significant engineering challenges due to stringent constraints on memory, latency, and runtime flexibility. In this work, we present a hardware-aware framework for efficient on-device inference of a LLaMA-based multilingual foundation model supporting multiple use cases on Samsung Galaxy S24 and S25 devices with SM8650 and SM8750 Qualcomm chipsets respectively. Our approach integrates application-specific LoRAs as runtime inputs to a single frozen inference graph, enabling dynamic task switching without recompilation or memory overhead. We further introduce a multi-stream decoding mechanism that concurrently generates stylistic variations—such as formal, polite, or jovial responses—within a single forward pass, reducing latency by up to 6×. To accelerate token generation, we apply Dynamic Self-Speculative Decoding (DS2D), a tree-based strategy that predicts future tokens without requiring a draft model, yielding up to 2.3× speedup in decode time. Combined with quantization to INT4 and architecture-level optimizations, our system achieves 4–6× overall improvements in memory and latency while maintaining accuracy across 9 languages and 8 tasks. These results demonstrate practical feasibility of deploying multi-use-case LLMs on edge devices, advancing the commercial viability of Generative AI in mobile platforms.
papers.abstract_zh: 在智能手机上部署大语言模型（LLM）面临着巨大的工程挑战，因为这些设备面临着内存、延迟和运行灵活性方面的严格限制。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个硬件感知的框架，能够实现基于LLAMA的多语言基础模型的设备端高效推理。该框架支持在三星Galaxy S24和S25设备上使用SM8650和SM8750款高通芯片进行多种应用场景的处理。我们的方法将特定于应用的LoRAs作为运行时输入整合到一个固定的推理图中，从而实现动态任务切换，而无需重新编译或增加内存开销。此外，我们还引入了多流解码机制，可以在一次前向处理中同时生成不同的风格变体——如正式、礼貌或欢快的回应，从而将延迟降低6倍。为了加速令牌生成，我们采用了动态自推测解码技术（DS2D），这是一种基于树的策略，无需预训练模型即可预测未来的令牌，从而将解码时间缩短2.3倍。结合INT4量化技术和架构级优化，我们的系统在内存和延迟方面实现了4到6倍的改进，同时仍然能够保持9种语言和8种任务的准确性。这些结果表明，在边缘设备上部署多用途LLM是可行的，这进一步提升了生成式AI在移动平台上的商业可行性。

papers.title: SynthRL: Scaling Visual Reasoning with Verifiable Data Synthesis
papers.title_zh: SynthRL：通过可验证的数据合成来实现视觉推理的扩展
papers.authors: Zijian Wu, Jinjie Ni, Xiangyan Liu, Zichen Liu, Hang Yan, Michael Qizhe Shieh
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) trained via reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) have shown notable progress in scaling test-time compute effectively. In this work, we investigate how synthesized RL data can further improve RLVR. To this end, we propose SynthRL—a scalable and guaranteed pipeline for automatic data scaling in reasoning-oriented RL training. SynthRL comprises three key stages: (1) selecting seed questions with appropriate distribution, (2) augmenting them into more challenging variants while preserving the original answers, and (3) a guaranteed verification stage that ensures near-perfect correctness and difficulty enhancement. Our empirical experiments demonstrate SynthRL’s scalability and effectiveness. When applied to the MMK12 dataset, SynthRL synthesizes over 3.3K additional verifiable, challenging questions from approximately 8K seed samples. Models trained with our synthesized data achieve consistent gains across five out-of-domain visual math reasoning benchmarks, with a significant improvement over baseline models trained on seed data alone. Notably, detailed analysis reveals that the gains are more pronounced on the most challenging evaluation samples, highlighting SynthRL’s effectiveness in eliciting deeper and more complex reasoning patterns.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过强化学习并使用可验证奖励来训练的视觉语言模型在有效扩展测试时间计算能力方面取得了显著进展。在这项研究中，我们探讨了合成强化学习数据如何进一步提升强化学习验证的效果。为此，我们提出了SynthRL——一种可扩展且能保证自动数据扩展的推理导向强化学习训练方法。SynthRL包含三个关键步骤：（1）选择具有适当分布的初始问题；（2）在保留原始答案的同时，将这些问题转化为更具挑战性的变体；（3）一个保证近乎完美正确性和难度提升的验证阶段。我们的实验结果表明，SynthRL具有出色的可扩展性和有效性。当应用于MMK12数据集时，SynthRL能够从大约8K个初始样本中合成出超过3.3K个新的、具有挑战性的可验证问题。使用我们合成的数据训练的模型在五个不同领域的视觉数学推理基准测试中均取得了稳定的性能提升，其效果优于仅使用原始数据进行训练的基线模型。详细分析显示，在最具挑战性的评估样本上，这种提升更为明显，这充分证明了SynthRL在引导更深层次和更复杂的推理模式方面的有效性。

papers.title: From Fragments to Facts: A Curriculum-Driven DPO Approach for Generating Hindi News Veracity Explanations
papers.title_zh: 从碎片到事实：一种以课程为驱动的DPO方法，用于生成可靠的新闻报道说明（用印地语）
papers.authors: Pulkit Bansal, Raghvendra Kumar, Shakti Singh, Adam Jatowt, Sriparna Saha
papers.abstract: In an era of rampant misinformation, generating reliable news explanations is vital, especially for underrepresented languages like Hindi. Lacking robust automated tools, Hindi faces challenges in scaling misinformation detection. To bridge this gap, we propose DeFactoX, a novel framework integrating Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) with Curriculum learning to align machine-generated explanations with human reasoning. Fact-checked explanations from credible sources serve as preferred responses, while LLM outputs highlight system limitations and serve as non-preferred responses. At the core of this framework lies Hin-DPO, an enhanced variant of DPO that enriches the loss function with two novel parameters, Actuality and Finesse, enhancing explanation quality and consistency. Experiments with LLMs (Mistral, Llama, Gemma) and PLMs (mBART, mT5) confirm the framework’s effectiveness in generating coherent, contextually relevant explanations.
papers.abstract_zh: 在错误信息泛滥的时代，生成可靠的新闻解释至关重要，尤其是对于像印地语这样被忽视的语言来说。由于缺乏强大的自动化工具，印地语在扩展错误信息检测方面面临挑战。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了DeFactoX框架。该框架将直接偏好优化（DPO）与课程学习相结合，使机器生成的解释与人类推理保持一致。来自可信来源的事实核查解释被作为首选回应，而大语言模型的输出则揭示了系统的局限性，成为非首选回应。该框架的核心技术是Hin-DPO，它是DPO的改进版本，通过引入两个新参数——现实性和精细度，来丰富损失函数，从而提高解释的质量和一致性。对大语言模型（如Mistral、Llama、Gemma）和语言生成模型（如mBART、mT5）进行的实验表明，该框架在生成连贯且符合上下文要求的解释方面具有有效性。

papers.title: Joint Optimization of Training Data and Policy in RLHF
papers.title_zh: 在强化学习中的训练数据与策略联合优化
papers.authors: Zhuohao Yu, Jiali Zeng, Weizheng Gu, Mengyuan Sun, Yidong Wang, Fandong Meng, Jie Zhou, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
papers.abstract: Traditional reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) optimizes policies on fixed training inputs, limiting the diversity of learning signals. We propose JODP (Joint Optimization of Data and Policy), a framework where the evolving policy model generates improved variants of training problems to enhance its own learning. While training problems remain fixed, JODP optimizes how they are presented: the policy generates specification hints that guide rollout generation, then learns to reproduce the discovered high-reward behaviors without the hints. This “if you can solve it with a hint, learn to solve it without one” principle creates a co-evolutionary dynamic where better policies discover better specifications, which enable further policy improvement. JODP operates as a plug-and-play enhancement to existing algorithms: specifications are selected via UCB bandits for exploration-exploitation balance, used only during training rollouts, and discarded at deployment. Through evaluation on safety alignment tasks, we demonstrate consistent improvements with GRPO, RLOO, and REINFORCE++, allowing 4B models to approach 8B model performance using less than 1% additional computational overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是在固定的训练输入上优化策略，这限制了学习信号的多样性。我们提出了JODP（数据与策略的联合优化）框架，该框架中的策略模型会生成改进的训练问题变体，以提升自身的学习能力。虽然训练问题保持不变，但JODP会优化这些问题的呈现方式：策略会生成指导训练过程的具体提示，然后学会在没有提示的情况下重现那些高奖励行为。这一“如果能用提示解决一个问题，那就学会不用提示来解决它”的原则，创造了一种共同进化的动态机制，即更好的策略能够发现更好的具体实现方式，从而进一步改善策略性能。JODP可以作为一种即插即用的增强工具来改进现有算法：具体实现方式通过UCB机制进行选择，以实现探索与利用的平衡，这些具体实现方式仅在训练过程中使用，而在部署时会被丢弃。通过在安全对齐任务上的评估，我们发现与GRPO、RLOO和REINFORCE++相比，JODP能够带来持续的改进效果，使得4B规模的模型在增加不到1%的计算开销的情况下，能够达到8B规模模型的性能水平。

papers.title: Simul-COMET: A Quality Metric for Simultaneous Interpretation in Distant Language Pair Considering Word Order Difference
papers.title_zh: Simul-COMET：一种用于处理不同语言之间实时口译的质量评估指标，考虑了词汇顺序的差异
papers.authors: Kosuke Doi, Mana Makinae, Yusuke Sakai, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Taro Watanabe
papers.abstract: In simultaneous interpretation (SI), interpreters perform real-time translation by segmenting the source speech into chunks and translating them in the order they appear.Since surface-matching metrics such as BLEU correlate poorly with human evaluations, translation quality is often evaluated using neural metrics that measure semantic similarity, such as COMET.However, while SI translation ideally exhibits high monotonicity, COMET tends to assign higher scores to offline translations with long-distance reordering, because it is trained on such offline translation data.To address this gap, we propose Simul-COMET, a variation of COMET adapted for SI evaluation specifically designed for monotonicity.We train Simul-COMET on the SI-style translation data, which was converted from the offline translation of the COMET training data by leveraging large language models.In English–Japanese translation experiments, we demonstrate that Simul-COMET assigns higher scores to SI-style translations than to offline ones.Moreover, Simul-COMET shows stronger alignment with evaluation scores provided by professional interpreters than the original COMET.Simul-COMET is available at https://github.com/kosuked/simul-comet.
papers.abstract_zh: 在口译中，口译员通过将源语言语音分割成若干片段，并按照其出现的顺序进行翻译，从而实现实时翻译。由于表面匹配指标如BLEU与人类评估的结果关联性较差，因此通常采用衡量语义相似性的神经指标来评估翻译质量，比如COMET。然而，虽然口译翻译理想情况下具有高度单调性，但COMET往往会给那些经过长距离重新排序的离线翻译分配更高的分数，因为COMET是基于这类离线翻译数据进行训练的。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了Simul-COMET——一种专门为口译评估而设计的COMET变体，旨在实现更高的单调性。我们通过利用大语言模型将COMET训练数据中的离线翻译转换为口译风格的数据，然后对Simul-COMET进行训练。在英日翻译实验中，我们发现Simul-COMET对口译风格的翻译所赋予的评分高于对离线翻译的评分。此外，Simul-COMET与专业口译员提供的评估分数之间的吻合度也更高。Simul-COMET的源代码可以在https://github.com/kosuked/simul-comet下载。

papers.title: Risk-Controlled Event-Driven Cascading Updates for Knowledge Graph Consistency Restoration
papers.title_zh: 用于知识图谱一致性恢复的、基于风险的事件驱动级联更新机制
papers.authors: Bo Ni, Qinwen Ge, Haowei Fu, Ryan A. Rossi, Xiaorui Liu, Jiejun Xu, Tyler Derr
papers.abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provide structured and interpretable representations of real-world entities and relations. While dynamic KGs attempt to capture real-time changes, they typically treat updates as independent facts. This overlooks a critical challenge: a factual, localized update can contradict and invalidate previously correct knowledge, requiring revisions beyond the localized update to maintain KG consistency. Many of these inconsistencies arise from events whose effects propagate through relational dependencies, necessitating coordinated multi-hop reasoning rather than isolated changes. To address this, we introduce a model-agnostic framework for cascading KG update identification that leverages conformal prediction to provide reliable uncertainty guarantees over the cascade as a whole, accounting for dependencies among multi-hop update candidates. Building on this foundation, we further develop a graph-based KG update scoring framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) to enrich event representations with world knowledge. Experiments on two newly constructed real-world datasets, designed to reflect scenarios where events necessitate coordinated multi-hop updates, demonstrate that our framework establishes a strong baseline while offering calibrated confidence estimates, providing an effective solution for event-driven KG consistency restoration.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识图谱（KGs）提供了对现实世界中实体和关系的结构化且可解释的描述。虽然动态知识图谱试图捕捉实时变化，但它们通常将更新视为独立的事实。这忽略了一个关键问题：一个局部性的事实更新可能会与之前正确的知识相矛盾并使其无效，因此需要进行超出局部更新的修正以保持知识图谱的一致性。许多这种不一致性源于事件的影响通过关系依赖进行传播，这就需要协调多跳推理，而不是孤立的变更。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个与模型无关的框架，用于识别级联式知识图谱更新，该框架利用共形预测为整个级联过程提供可靠的不确定性保证，同时考虑多跳更新候选者之间的依赖性。在此基础上，我们进一步开发了一个基于图的知识图谱更新评分框架，该框架整合了大语言模型，以用世界知识丰富事件描述。在两个新构建的现实世界数据集上的实验表明，我们的框架能够建立坚实的基础，同时提供经过校准的置信度估计，为事件驱动的知识图谱一致性恢复提供了有效的解决方案。

papers.title: ContractEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Contract-Satisfying Assertions in Code Generation
papers.title_zh: ContractEval：用于评估代码生成过程中是否满足契约要求的断言的基准测试工具
papers.authors: Soohan Lim, Joonghyuk Hahn, Hyunwoo Park, Sang-Ki Ko, Yo-Sub Han
papers.abstract: Current code generation evaluation measures functional correctness on well-formed inputs that satisfy all input preconditions. This paradigm has a critical limitation: task descriptions often leave these preconditions implicit, while evaluation filters out inputs that violate them. As a result, generated code may achieve high pass@k scores while failing to enforce the preconditions that the task actually requires. To address this gap, we introduce ContractEval, a benchmark for evaluating whether generated code enforces such preconditions—commonly referred to as contracts. Built on HumanEval+ and MBPP+, ContractEval consists of 364 tasks, each with three components: (i) descriptions reconstructed to explicitly state the contracts, (ii) test cases synthesized through a neuro-symbolic pipeline that pairs an LLM with an SMT solver to evaluate whether generated code satisfies these contracts, and (iii) reference code combined with contracts. Using ContractEval to evaluate five representative open-source code LLMs, we reveal a stark disparity between functional correctness and contract satisfaction. Under standard prompting, these models achieve pass@1 of 75-82% with 0% contract satisfaction. Even when contracts are explicitly stated in the prompt, the satisfaction rate reaches only 23-41%. This indicates that current LLMs struggle to satisfy contracts in their generated code, establishing contract satisfaction as a crucial and previously overlooked axis of code generation quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/suhanmen/ContractEval.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前代码生成评估方法能够判断在满足所有输入前提条件的合理输入情况下，生成的代码是否具备功能正确性。然而，这种方法存在一个关键缺陷：任务描述往往没有明确提及这些前提条件，而评估过程则会排除那些违反这些条件的输入。因此，生成的代码可能在性能评分上表现优异，但却无法确保满足任务实际所需的前提条件。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了ContractEval这一基准测试工具，用于评估生成的代码是否能够满足这些前提条件——通常被称为“契约”。ContractEval基于HumanEval+和MBPP+技术构建，包含364个任务，每个任务由三个部分组成：(i)明确表述契约的描述；(ii)通过神经符号流程生成的测试用例，该流程将大语言模型与符号逻辑求解器结合使用，以验证生成的代码是否满足这些契约；(iii)与契约相结合的参考代码。通过对五款代表性的开源代码生成模型进行ContractEval评估，我们发现功能正确性与契约满足度之间存在显著差异。在标准提示条件下，这些模型的pass@1分数达到了75-82%，但契约满足度仅为0%。即使契约在提示中明确说明，满足度也仅达到23-41%。这表明，当前的语言模型在生成代码时难以满足契约要求，因此契约满足度成为代码生成质量中一个至关重要且被忽视的维度。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/suhanmen/ContractEval下载。

papers.title: ToM-Synth: Scaling Robust Theory of Mind in LLMs via 6,912 Structured Social Units
papers.title_zh: ToM-Synth：通过6,912个结构化社会单位来构建大型语言模型中的思维可扩展性理论
papers.authors: Guiyang Hou, Xiang Huang, Shangke Lyu, Yuchuan Wu, Weiyao Luo, Xinyu Mei, Yongliang Shen, Weiming Lu, Yongbin Li
papers.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer others’ mental states from behavior, is pivotal for developing machines with human-level social intelligence. Existing methods endowing LLMs with ToM fall into two paradigms: training-free methods and those repurposing ToM evaluation benchmarks as training data for RL-based fine-tuning. However, training-free methods fail to internalize the augmented ToM into the LLMs. Meanwhile, using evaluation benchmarks as training sources is conceptually problematic and, in practice, results in narrow in-domain overfitting rather than robust ToM. To address the lack of training resources within the ToM community and to empower LLMs with robust ToM, we introduce ToM-Synth, a factorial combinatorial synthesis framework of 6912 social units. This framework enables the systematic synthesis of ToM data, yielding a training dataset of 27,648 instances, termed ToM-Synth-27K. Utilizing ToM-Synth-27K for RL fine-tuning, experimental results demonstrate consistent and significant improvements across models of varying families and scales on ToM, Emotional Intelligence, and Social Commonsense benchmarks. Furthermore, we observe concurrent enhancements in IQ-related tasks (math, science, logic) and effective performance scaling with increasing data scale.
papers.abstract_zh: 心智理论（Theory of Mind，ToM）是指根据行为推断他人心理状态的能力，这一能力对于开发具有人类水平社交智能的机器至关重要。目前用于赋予大语言模型心智理论的方法主要有两种范式：无需训练的方法，以及利用心智理论评估基准作为基于强化学习的微调训练数据的方法。然而，无需训练的方法无法将增强的心智理论内化到大语言模型中。同时，使用评估基准作为训练数据在概念上存在问题，实际上会导致狭窄领域的过拟合，而无法获得稳健的心智理论。为了弥补心智理论领域缺乏训练资源的问题，并让大语言模型具备稳健的心智理论能力，我们提出了ToM-Synth这一包含6912个社交单元的复合合成框架。该框架能够系统地合成心智理论数据，最终生成了包含27,648个实例的训练数据集，称为ToM-Synth-27K。通过将ToM-Synth-27K用于强化学习微调，实验结果表明，不同模型和不同规模下的模型在心智理论、情绪智能和社会常识等基准测试上均取得了稳定且显著的提升。此外，我们还观察到与智商相关的任务（数学、科学、逻辑）表现也有所提升，而且随着数据规模的扩大，模型的性能也呈现出有效的扩展趋势。

papers.title: Budget-Aware Routing for Long Clinical Text
papers.title_zh: 针对长临床文本的预算优化路由算法
papers.authors: Khizar Qureshi, Geoffrey Martin, Yifan Peng
papers.abstract: A key challenge for large language models is token cost per query and overall deployment cost. Clinical inputs are long, heterogeneous, and often redundant, while downstream tasks are short and high stakes. We study budgeted context selection, where a subset of document units is chosen under a strict token budget so an off-the-shelf generator can meet fixed cost and latency constraints. We cast this as a knapsack-constrained subset selection problem with two design choices, unitization that defines document segmentation and selection that determines which units are kept.We propose RCD, a monotone submodular objective that balances relevance, coverage, and diversity. We compare sentence, section, window, and cluster-based unitization, and introduce a routing heuristic that adapts to the budget regime. Experiments on MIMIC discharge notes, Cochrane abstracts, and L-Eval show that optimal strategies depend on the evaluation setting. Positional heuristics perform best at low budgets in extractive tasks, while diversity-aware methods such as MMR improve LLM generation. Selector choice matters more than unitization, with cluster-based grouping reducing performance and other schemes behaving similarly. ROUGE saturates for LLM summaries, while BERTScore better reflects quality differences.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型面临的一个关键挑战是每次查询的标记成本以及整体部署成本。临床数据通常较长、结构复杂且往往存在冗余信息，而下游任务则要求数据较短且具有较高的时效性要求。我们研究了在有限标记预算下选择文档单元的方法，这样现有的生成器就能满足固定的成本和延迟限制。我们将这个问题转化为一个背包约束下的子集选择问题，并提出了两种设计方案：单元化策略用于定义文档的分割方式，而选择策略则决定了哪些单元会被保留下来。我们提出了RCD算法，这是一种单调子模函数优化方法，能够同时兼顾相关性、覆盖率和多样性。我们对比了基于句子、段落、窗口和簇的单元化策略，并引入了一种能够根据预算情况进行调整的路由启发式算法。在MIMIC出院记录、Cochrane摘要和L-Eval数据集上的实验表明，最优策略取决于具体的评估场景。在低预算的情况下，基于位置的启发式算法表现最佳；而像MMR这样的多样性感知方法则能提升LLM的生成能力。在选择单元化策略时，选择方案的重要性高于单元化方式本身，基于簇的组合同样会降低性能，而其他方案的表现也类似。对于LLM生成的摘要来说，ROUGE指标表现最为理想，而BERTScore则更能反映文本质量上的差异。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Multi-LLM Collaborative Search for Complex Problem Solving
papers.title_zh: 多大型语言模型协作搜索，用于解决复杂问题
papers.authors: Sen Yang, Yafu Li, Wai Lam, Yu Cheng
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often struggle with complex reasoning tasks due to their limitations in addressing the vast reasoning space and inherent ambiguities of natural language. We propose the Mixture-of-Search-Agents (MOSA) paradigm, a novel approach leveraging the collective expertise of multiple LLMs to enhance search-based reasoning. MOSA integrates diverse reasoning pathways by combining independent exploration with iterative refinement among LLMs, mitigating the limitations of single-model approaches. Using Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) as a backbone, MOSA enables multiple agents to propose and aggregate reasoning steps, resulting in improved accuracy. Our comprehensive evaluation across four reasoning benchmarks demonstrates MOSA’s consistent performance improvements over single-agent and other multi-agent baselines, particularly in complex mathematical and commonsense reasoning tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在处理复杂的推理任务时常常面临困难，这是因为它们在覆盖广泛的推理空间以及处理自然语言所固有的模糊性方面存在局限性。我们提出了“混合搜索代理”范式，这是一种利用多个语言模型的集体专业知识来增强基于搜索的推理能力的新方法。该范式通过结合独立探索与语言模型之间的迭代优化，整合了多种推理路径，从而弥补了单一模型方法的不足。以蒙特卡洛树搜索作为基础算法，MOSA能够使得多个代理协同提出并整合推理步骤，进而提高推理的准确性。我们在四个推理基准测试中的全面评估表明，MOSA在复杂数学和常识推理任务上，其性能持续优于单一代理和其他多智能体方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: SceneLM: 3D-Aware Language Models for Editable 3D Scene Synthesis
papers.title_zh: SceneLM：适用于可编辑3D场景合成的三维感知语言模型
papers.authors: Xingbo Yao, Xiaoyu Chen, Doudou Zhang, Mingzhi Sheng, Boyuan Cao, Ying-Cong Chen, Hui Xiong
papers.abstract: Synthesizing an editable 3D scene from a single RGB image is central to content creation, embodied-agent data generation, and AR/VR, yet remains challenging to achieve both high-fidelity reconstruction and convenient interactive editing. Existing geometry-based pipelines produce high-quality 3D results but are typically hard to refine without rerunning the full process, while LLM-driven procedural systems enable interactive tool use but are mostly text-driven and lack precise metric 3D understanding from images. We present SceneLM, a language-model-based framework that grounds 3D scene synthesis in visual evidence by recovering an executable metric 3D layout directly from a single image. Given an RGB image (and camera intrinsics when available), SceneLM outputs a JSON-form layout specifying each object’s category, 3D center, size, and discretized yaw, and then deterministically executes this layout with a tool suite to instantiate, place, and edit objects for iterative refinement. To train metric layout recovery at scale, we curate five datasets covering diverse indoor, outdoor, and tabletop scenes and convert heterogeneous 3D annotations into a unified instruction-tuning format. To improve numerical stability and metric accuracy while preserving the text interface, we augment autoregressive JSON generation with a lightweight geometry prediction branch and dual supervision. Experiments show that SceneLM substantially improves single-image 3D layout estimation over strong open and proprietary MLLM baselines, and yields higher-quality end-to-end scene generation in geometric consistency, physical plausibility, semantic alignment, and realism.
papers.abstract_zh: 从单一的RGB图像合成可编辑的3D场景是内容创作、化身代理数据生成以及AR/VR领域的核心任务，然而要实现高保真度的重建和便捷的交互式编辑仍然具有挑战性。现有的基于几何学的流程能够产生高质量的3D结果，但通常需要重新运行整个过程才能进行精细调整；而基于大语言模型的程序化系统则能够实现交互式工具使用，但这些系统大多依赖文本驱动，缺乏从图像中准确获取3D信息的能力。我们提出了SceneLM这一基于语言模型的框架，该框架通过直接从单张图像中提取出可执行的3D布局，将3D场景合成与视觉信息相结合。给定一张RGB图像（以及可用的相机内参），SceneLM会输出一个JSON格式的布局，其中指定了每个物体的类别、3D中心位置、大小以及离散化的姿态信息。然后，该框架会确定性地执行这个布局，使用相应的工具来实例化、放置和编辑物体，从而实现迭代优化。为了大规模训练这种度量布局恢复能力，我们收集了五个涵盖不同室内、室外和桌面场景的数据集，并将异构的3D注释转换为统一的指令调整格式。为了提高数值稳定性和度量精度，同时保持文本界面的可用性，我们在自动回归JSON生成机制中加入了轻量级的几何预测分支和双重监督机制。实验表明，SceneLM在单图像3D布局估计方面显著优于那些基于开放或专有大语言模型的基础模型，并且在几何一致性、物理合理性、语义对齐以及真实感等方面都提供了更高品质的端到端3D场景生成效果。

papers.title: Leveraging Pretrained Language Models as Energy Functions for Glauber Dynamics Text Diffusion
papers.title_zh: 利用预训练的语言模型作为能量函数来处理格劳伯动力学文本扩散问题
papers.authors: Tarun Kathuria, Sachin Kumar
papers.abstract: We present a discrete diffusion-based generative model for text generation using Glauber dynamics from statistical physics. Our main insight is that instead of trying to train a discrete state space diffusion model using Glauber dynamics with a uniform transition kernel as the forward process, one can set up an “energy function” based on pretrained causal/masked language models, which, when viewed as the stationary distribution, allows us to significantly improve the quality of the generated text. Using UL2 as our pretrained models and modifying and incorporating it into our diffusion pipeline, we obtain significantly better perplexities than prior diffusion-based text generative models and are competitive with the perplexities of GPT-2-medium and GPT-2-large for comparable model sizes. Furthermore, our models outperform prior diffusion models and GPT-2 style auto-regressive models on some zero-shot common sense reasoning tasks as well as some planning/search tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于离散扩散的生成模型，用于文本生成。该模型采用统计物理中的Glauber动力学作为基础。我们的主要创新点在于：不必使用具有均匀转移核的Glauber动力学来训练离散状态空间的扩散模型，而是可以基于预训练的因果/掩码语言模型来构建“能量函数”。当将这个能量函数视为稳态分布时，我们可以显著提升生成文本的质量。通过使用UL2作为预训练模型，并对其进行调整并融入我们的扩散流程中，我们得到的困惑度明显优于之前的基于扩散的文本生成模型。在相同模型规模下，我们的困惑度与GPT-2-medium和GPT-2-large相当。此外，我们的模型在一些零样本常识推理任务以及一些规划/搜索任务上，也优于之前的扩散模型和GPT-2风格的自回归模型。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Uncovering Currency Bias and Syntax Gap in Text Embedding Models
papers.title_zh: 揭示文本嵌入模型中的货币偏见与语法差异问题
papers.authors: Saurav Sudevan, Harsh Pal, Yatin Katyal, Sahil Manchanda
papers.abstract: Text-embedding models frequently inherit societal biases, yet the influence of socio-economic markers remains largely unexplored. This paper identifies Currency Bias as a systemic representational limitation in financial AI, where models exhibit associative sensitivity to economic hierarchies. We analyze this through three dimensions: (1) the Syntax Gap, where models fail to align currency names, symbols, and acronyms; (2) Associative Sensitivity, where embeddings disproportionately link specific currency identifiers to narratives of risk or poverty; and (3) Downstream volatility, where currency substitutions induce predictive entropy, sentence misunderstanding, sentiment shifts, and credit default prediction flips in downstream tasks. Benchmarking 14 state-of-the-art architectures reveals a pervasive phenomenon of representational disparity, affecting several currencies. These findings suggest that current embedding practices inadvertently encode inequalities, posing significant risks for the fairness and reliability of global financial NLP applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本嵌入模型往往带有社会偏见，而社会经济因素的影响则尚未得到充分研究。本文指出，“货币偏见”是金融人工智能中的一个系统性表示缺陷，即模型对经济等级结构表现出关联敏感性。我们通过三个维度来分析这一现象：(1)语法差异，模型无法正确处理货币名称、符号和缩写之间的对应关系；(2)关联性敏感，嵌入模型将特定货币标识符与风险或贫困等负面概念过度关联；(3)下游波动性，货币替换会导致预测熵值变化、句子理解障碍、情感倾向改变以及信用违约预测结果出现偏差。通过对14种先进架构的对比分析，我们发现这种表示差异现象普遍存在，且涉及多种货币。这些发现表明，当前的嵌入方法无意中强化了不平等现象，这对全球金融自然语言处理应用的公平性和可靠性构成了重大威胁。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: C-ReD: A Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for AI-Generated Text Detection Derived from Real-World Prompts
papers.title_zh: C-ReD：一种针对人工智能生成文本检测的中文综合基准方法，其数据来源于真实场景的提示语
papers.authors: Chenxi Qing, Junxi Wu, Zheng Liu, Yixiang Qiu, Hongyao Yu, Bin Chen, Hao Wu, Shu-Tao Xia
papers.abstract: Recently, large language models (LLMs) are capable of generating highly fluent textual content. While they offer significant convenience to humans, they also introduce various risks, like phishing and academic dishonesty. Numerous research efforts have been dedicated to developing algorithms for detecting AI-generated text and constructing relevant datasets. However, in the domain of Chinese corpora, challenges remain, including limited model diversity and data homogeneity. To address these issues, we propose C-ReD: a comprehensive Chinese Real-prompt AI-generated text Detection benchmark. Experiments demonstrate that C-ReD not only enables reliable in-domain detection but also supports strong generalization to unseen LLMs and external Chinese datasets—addressing critical gaps in model diversity, domain coverage, and prompt realism that have limited prior Chinese detection benchmarks. We release our resources at https://github.com/HeraldofLight/C-ReD.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，大语言模型已经能够生成非常流畅的文本内容。虽然这些模型为人类带来了极大的便利，但它们也带来了一些风险，比如网络钓鱼和学术不诚实等问题。许多研究致力于开发用于检测人工智能生成的文本的算法，并构建相关的数据集。然而，在中文语料库领域，仍然存在一些挑战，包括模型多样性有限和数据同质性的问题。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了C-ReD：一个全面的中文真实场景下人工智能生成文本检测基准。实验表明，C-ReD不仅能够实现可靠的领域内文本检测，还能很好地泛化到未见过的大语言模型和外部中文数据集——从而弥补了之前中文检测基准在模型多样性、领域覆盖率和提示真实性方面的不足。我们将我们的资源发布在https://github.com/HeraldofLight/C-ReD上。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Seer Self-Consistency: Advance Budget Estimation for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling
papers.title_zh: 预见性自我一致性：先进的预算估算方法，用于自适应测试时间调整
papers.authors: Shiyu Ji, Yixuan Wang, Yijun Liu, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling improves the inference performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) but also incurs substantial computational costs. Although recent studies have reduced token consumption through dynamic self-consistency, they remain constrained by the high latency of sequential requests. In this paper, we propose SeerSC, a dynamic self-consistency framework that simultaneously improves token efficiency and latency by integrating System 1 and System 2 reasoning. Specifically, we utilize the rapid System 1 to compute the answer entropy for given queries. This score is then used to evaluate the potential of samples for scaling, enabling dynamic self-consistency under System 2. Benefiting from the advance and accurate estimation provided by System 1, the proposed method can reduce token usage while simultaneously achieving a significant decrease in latency through parallel generation. It outperforms existing methods, achieving up to a 47% reduction in token consumption and a 43% reduction in inference latency without significant performance loss.
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时的扩展操作能够提升大语言模型的推理性能，但同时也带来了巨大的计算成本。虽然最近的一些研究通过动态自一致性机制减少了令牌消耗，但这些方法仍然受到序列请求高延迟的限制。在本文中，我们提出了SeerSC这一动态自一致性框架，该框架通过结合系统一和系统二推理方式，同时提升了令牌使用效率和延迟性能。具体来说，我们利用系统一快速计算给定查询的回答熵值。这个评分随后被用来评估样本的可扩展性，从而在系统二的基础上实现动态自一致性。得益于系统一提供的准确估计结果，该方法能够在减少令牌使用的同时，通过并行生成显著降低延迟。与现有方法相比，我们的方法实现了高达47%的令牌消耗减少和43%的推理延迟降低，且并未导致显著的性能下降。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Context-Fidelity Boosting: Enhancing Faithful Generation through Watermark-Inspired Decoding
papers.title_zh: 上下文一致性增强：通过基于水印的解码技术提升生成的文本的准确性
papers.authors: Weixu Zhang, Fanghua Ye, Qiang Gao, Jian Li, Haolun Wu, Yuxing Tian, Sijing Duan, Nan Du, Xiaolong Li
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often produce content that contradicts or overlooks information provided in the input context, a phenomenon known as faithfulness hallucination. In this paper, we propose Context-Fidelity Boosting (CFB), a lightweight and general decoding-time framework that effectively reduces such hallucinations by boosting the generation probability of context-relevant tokens. Motivated by logit-shaping principles in watermarking techniques, CFB leverages token-level logit adjustments based on their presence or salience in the input context. Specifically, we develop three boosting strategies, static, context-aware, and token-aware that progressively incorporate distributional divergence, attention scores, and semantic similarity. Notably, CFB requires no retraining or architectural changes, making it compatible with a wide range of LLMs. Experiments on summarization and question answering tasks across multiple open-source LLMs show that CFB consistently improves faithfulness metrics, with minimal generation overhead. Our implementation is fully open-sourced.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常常生成与输入上下文中的信息相矛盾或忽略这些信息的内容，这种现象被称为“忠实性幻觉”。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“上下文忠实度增强”（Context-Fidelity Boosting，简称CFB）的轻量级解码时间框架。该框架通过提高与上下文相关的令牌的生成概率，有效减少了这种幻觉现象。基于水印技术中的逻辑斯蒂变形原理，CFB利用基于令牌在输入上下文中出现或显著性的逻辑斯蒂调整方法来实现增强效果。具体来说，我们开发了三种增强策略：静态增强、上下文感知增强以及令牌感知增强，这些策略分别考虑了分布差异、注意力得分和语义相似性等因素。值得注意的是，CFB不需要重新训练或进行架构上的修改，因此可以与多种LLM兼容。在多个开源LLM上进行的摘要任务和问答任务实验中，我们发现CFB能够持续改善忠实性指标，同时几乎不会增加生成成本。我们的实现方案完全开源。

papers.title: CaRVE: Critiquing and Refining Visual Elaborations for Figurative Language Illustrations
papers.title_zh: CaRVE：对视觉表达进行批判与改进，以提升比喻性语言的呈现效果
papers.authors: Manishit Kundu, Tejomay Kishor Padole, Sumit Shekhar, Biplab Banerjee, Pushpak Bhattacharyya
papers.abstract: Illustrating figurative language remains challenging due to its non-literal semantics, and existing text-to-image frameworks rely heavily on proprietary models or human supervision to achieve adequate alignment. We introduce CaRVE, a lightweight and fully open-source critique-driven framework that employs VLM feedback to refine visual elaborations for figurative image generation. CaRVE bridges the semantic alignment gap even in sub-4B models by correcting visual and conceptual misalignments, reducing over-literalization, and improving robustness to complex figurative expressions. Using only open-source models, CaRVE achieves a 6.49% improvement over prior baselines on intrinsic automatic evaluations and a +0.37 average rank gain in human preference. We further release MetaCaRVE, an enhanced figurative image dataset constructed by refining HAIVMet using CaRVE.
papers.abstract_zh: 在描绘比喻性语言时仍然存在挑战，因为其语义并非字面意义上的理解。现有的文本到图像框架大多依赖于专有模型或人工监督来实现良好的对齐效果。我们提出了CaRVE这一轻量级且完全开源的批评驱动框架，该框架利用视觉语言模型反馈来优化比喻性图像的生成效果。CaRVE能够弥补即使是4B以下模型在语义对齐方面的不足，通过纠正视觉和概念上的错位问题，减少过度字面化现象，并提高对复杂比喻表达的处理能力。仅使用开源模型，CaRVE在内在自动评估指标上比以往基准模型提升了6.49%，在人类偏好评估中平均提升了0.37的排名。我们还发布了MetaCaRVE，这是一个通过改进HAIVMet而构建的增强型比喻性图像数据集。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Defending LLMs against Jailbreak Attacks via Template-Based ICL with a Defensive Suffix
papers.title_zh: 通过基于模板的ICL方法，利用防御性后缀来抵御LLM的越狱攻击
papers.authors: Ruiyang Ni, Changlong Li, Shuaibiao Han, Zhiyu Yi, Perley Xu, Wenjie Ruan
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive results on various tasks. However, these architectures are vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, such as GCG and AutoDAN. Several defense strategies have been proposed to protect LLMs from generating harmful content, with most methods focusing on model fine-tuning or heuristic defense designs. These methods are often time-consuming or less effective. To fill this gap, this paper proposes a novel defense solution by taking the advances of online In-Context Learning (ICL) and an offline defensive suffix. Specifically, we first optimize the offline defensive suffix using an iterative algorithm. Second, an online stochastic random search is conducted to identify the most effective ICL demonstrations. Finally, the original user instruction, the selected ICL demonstrations, and the defensive suffix are assembled into a structured input prompt using a carefully designed template, which is then fed into the LLM for response generation. Experimental results show that our method is effective against both advanced white-box and black-box attacks, reducing the attack success rate to nearly 0%, while maintaining the model’s utility on the benign tasks and incurring only negligible computational overhead. Our code is available on https://github.com/Trusted-LLM/DSICL.
papers.abstract_zh: 最先进的大语言模型在各类任务上取得了令人瞩目的成果。然而，这些架构容易受到诸如GCG和AutoDAN之类的越狱攻击。为了保护大语言模型免受有害内容的生成，人们提出了多种防御策略，其中大多数方法都集中在模型微调或启发式防御设计上。但这些方法往往耗时较长或效果有限。为了填补这一空白，本文提出了一种创新的防御方案，该方案结合了在线上下文学习技术和离线防御后缀机制。具体来说，我们首先使用迭代算法来优化离线防御后缀。其次，通过在线随机搜索来识别最有效的上下文学习示例。最后，将原始用户指令、选出的上下文学习示例以及防御后缀整合到一个结构化的输入提示中，然后将其输入到大语言模型中以生成响应。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够有效抵御先进的白盒和黑盒攻击，将攻击成功率降至几乎为零，同时还能保持模型在良性任务上的实用性，并且仅产生微不足道的计算开销。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Trusted-LLM/DSICL下载。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Fallback to Frontline: When Can LLMs be Superior Annotators of Human Perspectives?
papers.title_zh: 从后备角色到一线主角：何时让大型语言模型成为人类观点的卓越注释者？
papers.authors: Hasan Amin, Harry Yizhou Tian, Xiaoni Duan, Chien-Ju Ho, Rajiv Khanna, Ming Yin
papers.abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as annotators at scale, they are typically treated as a pragmatic fallback rather than a faithful estimator of human perspectives. This work challenges that presumption. By framing perspective-taking as the estimation of a latent group-level judgment, we characterize the conditions under which modern LLMs can outperform human annotators, including in-group humans, when predicting aggregate subgroup opinions on subjective tasks, and show that these conditions are common in practice. This advantage arises from structural properties of LLMs as estimators, including low variance and reduced coupling between representation and processing biases, rather than any claim of lived experience. Our analysis identifies clear regimes where LLMs act as statistically superior frontline estimators, as well as principled limits where human judgment remains essential. These findings reposition LLMs from a cost-saving compromise to a principled tool for estimating collective human perspectives.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型在大规模标注任务中得到了广泛应用，但它们通常被视为一种实用的替代方案，而非能够准确反映人类观点的工具。本研究挑战了这一假设。通过将视角获取视为对潜在群体判断的估计，我们分析了现代语言模型在预测主观任务中的子群体意见时，如何超越人类标注者的表现，包括内部群体的人类标注者。我们发现，这些优势源于语言模型作为估计器的结构性特性，如低方差以及表示与处理偏见之间的较低耦合程度，而非它们所声称的具有真实生活经验的能力。我们的分析指出了语言模型在统计上更优的适用场景，同时也揭示了人类判断仍然至关重要的领域。这些发现将语言模型从一种节省成本的替代方案，转变为一种用于估计集体人类观点的有原则性的工具。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Does Theory of Mind Improvement Really Benefit Human-AI Interactions? Empirical Findings from Interactive Evaluations
papers.title_zh: 心智能力提升真的有助于人类与人工智能之间的互动吗？来自交互式评估的实证研究结果
papers.authors: Nanxu Gong, Zixin Chen, Haotian Li, Zishu Zhao, Jianxun Lian, Huamin Qu, Yanjie Fu, Xing Xie
papers.abstract: Improving the Theory of Mind (ToM) capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) is crucial for effective social interactions between these AI models and humans. However, the existing benchmarks often measure ToM capability improvement through story-reading, multiple-choice questions from a third-person perspective, while ignoring the first-person, dynamic, and open-ended nature of human-AI (HAI) interactions. To directly examine how ToM improvement techniques benefit HAI interactions, we first proposed the new paradigm of interactive ToM evaluation with both perspective and metric shifts. Next, following the paradigm, we conducted a systematic study of four representative ToM enhancement techniques using both four real-world datasets and a user study, covering both goal-oriented tasks (e.g., coding, math) and experience-oriented tasks (e.g., counseling). Our findings reveal that improvements on static benchmarks do not always translate to better performance in dynamic HAI interactions. This paper offers critical insights into ToM evaluation, showing the necessity of interaction-based assessments in developing next-generation, socially aware LLMs for HAI symbiosis.
papers.abstract_zh: 提升大语言模型的心智能力对于促进这些人工智能模型与人类之间的有效互动至关重要。然而，现有的评估标准通常通过阅读故事或回答第三人称视角下的选择题来衡量心智能力的提升，而忽略了人类与人工智能交互中第一人称、动态性和开放性的特点。为了直接考察心智能力提升技术如何改善人类与人工智能的交互效果，我们首先提出了一种基于视角和度量标准的交互式心智能力评估新范式。随后，我们遵循这一范式，使用四个真实世界的数据集以及用户研究，对四种代表性的心智能力增强技术进行了系统研究，涵盖了目标导向任务（如编程、数学）和体验导向任务（如咨询）。我们的研究发现表明，在静态评估指标上的改进并不一定能转化为动态人类与人工智能交互中的更好表现。本文为心智能力评估提供了重要启示，强调了在开发下一代具有社会意识的智能人工智能模型以实现人类与人工智能的共生关系时，基于交互的评估方式的重要性。

papers.title: SERE: Structural Example Retrieval for Enhancing LLMs in Event Causality Identification
papers.title_zh: SERE：用于增强大型语言模型在事件因果关系识别能力的结构化示例提取方法
papers.authors: Zhifeng Hao, Zhongjie Chen, Junhao Lu, Shengyin Yu, Guimin Hu, Keli Zhang, Ruichu Cai, Boyan Xu
papers.abstract: Event Causality Identification (ECI) requires models to determine whether a given pair of events in a context exhibits a causal relationship. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across various NLP tasks, their effectiveness in ECI remains limited due to biases in causal reasoning, often leading to overprediction of causal relationships (causal hallucination). To mitigate these issues and enhance LLM performance in ECI, we propose SERE, a structural example retrieval framework that leverages LLMs’ few-shot learning capabilities. SERE introduces an innovative retrieval mechanism based on three structural concepts: (i) Conceptual Path Metric, which measures the conceptual relationship between events using edit distance in ConceptNet; (ii) Syntactic Metric, which quantifies structural similarity through tree edit distance on syntactic trees; and (iii) Causal Pattern Filtering, which filters examples based on predefined causal structures using LLMs. By integrating these structural retrieval strategies, SERE selects more relevant examples to guide LLMs in causal reasoning, mitigating bias and improving accuracy in ECI tasks. Extensive experiments on multiple ECI datasets validate the effectiveness of SERE.
papers.abstract_zh: 事件因果关系识别（ECI）要求模型能够判断在特定情境下，一对事件之间是否存在因果关系。虽然大语言模型在多种自然语言处理任务中表现出强大的性能，但在进行ECI时，其效果仍然有限，这是因为模型在因果推理上存在偏差，常常导致对因果关系的过度预测（即“因果幻觉”）。为了缓解这些问题并提高LLM在ECI任务中的表现，我们提出了SERE这一结构化示例检索框架。该框架利用了LLM的少量样本学习能力。SERE采用了三种结构化的检索机制：(1)概念路径度量，通过ConceptNet中的编辑距离来衡量事件之间的概念关系；(2)句法度量，通过句法树上的编辑距离来量化结构相似性；(3)因果模式过滤，利用LLM根据预定义的因果结构来筛选示例。通过整合这些结构化的检索策略，SERE能够选择出更相关的示例来指导LLM进行因果推理，从而减轻偏差并提高ECI任务的准确性。在多个ECI数据集上的广泛实验验证了SERE的有效性。

papers.title: Emotion Trajectory-aware Retrieval for Markov-driven Emotion Anticipation in LLM-based Emotional Support Conversation
papers.title_zh: 基于情感轨迹的检索方法：在基于大语言模型的情感支持对话中用于马尔可夫驱动的情感预测
papers.authors: Hongyan Wu, Zhiliang Tian, Zhen Huang, Tengyue Hu, Linbo Qiao, Yifu Gao, Feng Liu, Dongsheng Li
papers.abstract: Emotional support conversation (ESC) aims to alleviate users’ psychological stress. Selecting the appropriate strategy is crucial for effective emotional support. Current strategy planner-based methods prioritize immediate responses while neglecting users’ future reactions. Some studies retrieve historical examples with similar emotions to the current utterance, then anticipating future emotions based on next-turn emotions of historical examples. However, their retrievals focus on the current emotion (i.e. a single-turn emotion state), while they ignore the evolution of user’s emotion before the current state. We argue that retrievals considering the whole emotional trajectories enables models to capture the dynamic emotional needs, thereby enhancing the anticipation of future emotions. To this end, we propose Markov-driven emotion anticipation framework with emotion trajectory-aware retrieval for LLM-based ESC, which anticipates future emotion states to guide strategy planning and achieve sustained emotional support. First, we construct a dynamic emotion memory and perform hierarchical retrieval that combines semantic matching and emotion trajectory alignment. Then, we model emotional transitions as Markov chains, leveraging trajectory-aware retrieval to estimate future emotion. Finally, we use the anticipated emotion to steer LLMs in generating candidate strategies and introduce active online learning to optimize the planner, boosting its robustness on diverse users. Experiments on two datasets with two models shows that our method excels all baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 情感支持对话旨在缓解用户的心理压力。选择合适的策略对于提供有效的情感支持至关重要。目前基于策略规划的方法倾向于立即响应用户的需求，而忽略了用户未来的反应。一些研究通过检索与当前话语具有相似情感的过往例子，然后根据这些过往例子在下一轮对话中的情感来预测未来情感。然而，这些检索方法只关注当前的情感状态，而忽略了用户情感在达到当前状态之前的演变过程。我们认为，考虑整个情感轨迹的检索方式能够让模型捕捉到动态的情感需求，从而更好地预测未来情感。为此，我们提出了一种基于马尔可夫模型的情感预测框架，该框架采用情感轨迹感知的检索方式，以指导LLM进行情感支持对话。首先，我们构建了一个动态情感记忆系统，并实现了结合语义匹配和情感轨迹对齐的层次化检索机制。接着，我们将情感转换建模为马尔可夫链，利用情感轨迹感知的检索方法来估计未来情感。最后，我们利用预测出的情感来引导LLM生成候选策略，并通过主动在线学习优化策略规划器，从而提高其对不同用户的适应性。在两个数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法优于所有现有基线方法。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学

papers.title: High-Throughput and Memory-Efficient Zeroth-Order Fine-tuning LLMs with Distributed Parallel Computing
papers.title_zh: 利用分布式并行计算技术实现的高吞吐量、高效内存管理的零阶微调大型语言模型
papers.authors: Liangyu Wang, Huanyi Xie, Di Wang
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) remains resource-intensive due to their sheer scale. While zeroth-order (ZO) optimization provides a memory-efficient alternative by eliminating backward passes, its application to multi-hundred-billion-parameter models is constrained by GPU memory and compute throughput. The ZO2 framework addresses the memory bottleneck by offloading model parameters to CPU memory and overlapping transformer block transfer with dual forward computation on a single GPU. However, ZO2 remains limited by its single-device execution and achieves modest throughput. In this work, we present DistZO2 (Distributed Zeroth-Order Offloading), a high-throughput, memory-efficient framework for distributed zeroth-order fine-tuning of LLMs. DistZO2 introduces three parallel strategies: (1) Perturbation Parallelism (PertP), which parallelizes the two perturbed forward passes across devices; (2) Distributed Data Parallelism (DDP), adapted to the scalar-gradient nature of ZO training; and (3) a unified 2D Parallelism design that combines PertP and DDP. To further mitigate communication bottlenecks introduced by parameter offloading, we propose a hardware-aware communication strategy that slices parameter blocks and redistributes them across GPUs via high-speed interconnects such as NVLink. DistZO2 scales zeroth-order fine-tuning to modern multi-GPU systems, preserving ZO2’s memory efficiency while substantially improving training throughput. In our experiments on OPT-175B, DistZO2 achieves a 3x speedup over ZO2 with distributed computing.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于大语言模型（LLM）的庞大规模，对其进行微调仍然需要大量的资源。零阶优化作为一种内存高效的替代方案，通过消除反向传播来降低计算成本，但其应用受到GPU内存和计算能力的限制，无法适用于拥有数百亿参数的模型。ZO2框架通过将模型参数卸载到CPU内存中，并利用单个GPU同时进行前向计算和变换块传输，从而解决了内存瓶颈问题。然而，ZO2仍受限于单一设备的执行能力，其吞吐量也较为有限。在这项研究中，我们提出了DistZO2——一种高吞吐量、内存效率高的分布式零阶微调框架。DistZO2采用了三种并行策略：(1) 扰动并行性，将两次扰动后的前向传播并行处理；(2) 分布式数据并行性，适应于零阶训练的标量梯度特性；(3) 结合扰动并行性和分布式数据并行性的统一二维并行设计。为了进一步缓解参数卸载带来的通信瓶颈，我们提出了一种基于硬件的通信策略，通过将参数块分割并经由高速互连技术如NVLink重新分配至各个GPU上。DistZO2能够将零阶微调扩展到现代的多GPU系统中，同时保留了ZO2的内存效率，并显著提升了训练吞吐量。在我们对OPT-175B数据集进行的实验中，DistZO2在分布式计算方面比ZO2实现了3倍的性能提升。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: AutoAgent: A Fully-Automated and Zero-Code Framework for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: AutoAgent：一种完全自动化且无需编写代码的LLM代理框架
papers.authors: Jiabin Tang, Tianyu Fan, Chao Huang
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) Agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in task automation and intelligent decision-making, driving the widespread adoption of agent development frameworks such as LangChain and AutoGen. However, these frameworks predominantly serve developers with extensive technical expertise—a significant limitation considering that only 0.03% of the global population possesses the necessary programming skills. This stark accessibility gap raises a fundamental question: Can we enable everyone, regardless of technical background, to build their own LLM agents using natural language alone? To address this challenge, we introduce AutoAgent - a Fully-Automated and highly Self-Developing framework that enables users to create and deploy LLM agents through Natural Language Alone. Operating as an autonomous Agent Operating System, AutoAgent comprises four key components: i) Agentic System Utilities, ii) LLM-powered Actionable Engine, iii) Self-Managing File System, and iv) Self-Play Agent Customization module. This lightweight yet powerful system enables efficient and dynamic creation and modification of tools, agents, and workflows without coding requirements or manual intervention. Beyond its code-free agent development capabilities, AutoAgent also serves as a versatile multi-agent system for General AI Assistants. Comprehensive evaluations on the GAIA benchmark demonstrate AutoAgent’s effectiveness in generalist multi-agent tasks, surpassing existing state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, AutoAgent’s Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-related capabilities have shown consistently superior performance compared to many alternative LLM-based solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理在任务自动化和智能决策方面展现出了卓越的能力，这使得诸如LangChain和AutoGen这样的代理开发框架得到了广泛的应用。然而，这些框架主要服务于那些拥有丰富技术专长的开发者——这是一个显著的局限性，因为全球只有0.03%的人口具备必要的编程技能。这种明显的可访问性差距引发了一个根本性的问题：我们能否让任何一个人，无论其技术背景如何，都能仅通过自然语言来构建自己的语言模型代理呢？为了应对这一挑战，我们推出了AutoAgent——一个完全自动化的、具有高度自我发展能力的框架，它允许用户仅通过自然语言来创建和部署语言模型代理。作为一套自主的代理操作系统，AutoAgent由四个关键组件组成：i) 代理系统工具，ii) 基于语言模型的行动引擎，iii) 自管理文件系统，iv) 自玩代理定制模块。这个轻量级但功能强大的系统能够在不需要编写代码或人工干预的情况下，高效且动态地创建和修改工具、代理和工作流程。除了无需编写代码的代理开发能力之外，AutoAgent还作为一种多功能的多智能体系统，适用于通用人工智能助手。在GAIA基准测试中的全面评估表明，AutoAgent在通用多智能体任务中表现出色，超越了现有的最先进方法。此外，AutoAgent在检索增强生成方面的能力也表现出了优于许多其他基于语言模型的解决方案。

papers.title: DR-HM: Distill-then-Reinforce Training with Cognition-Aware Data Synthesis for Harmful Meme Detection
papers.title_zh: DR-HM：基于认知感知的数据融合训练方法，用于识别有害模因
papers.authors: Zihan Cheng, Jianxiang Ma, Xiaocui Yang, Peidong Wang, Wen Zhang, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Yifei Zhang, Mingfu Zhang
papers.abstract: Harmful memes convey offensive intent through implicit associations between visual symbols and text, requiring a broad understanding of cultural stereotypes and visual metaphors. Small-scale Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often lack the knowledge required to identify such implicit hate, whereas Large-scale MLLMs, despite their broader knowledge, exhibit systematic labeling bias. To address these challenges, we propose DR-HM, a Distill-then-Reinforce training framework with cognition-aware data synthesis for harmful meme detection, which aims to transfer knowledge from closed-source models while mitigating their biases. DR-HM introduces a six-step structured data synthesis scheme with self-refinement that decomposes meme analysis into a progressive, human-inspired reasoning process from entity recognition to harmfulness judgment. Based on the synthesized reasoning data, we further adopt a Distill-then-Reinforce training strategy. This approach combines a two-stage Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with an Adaptive Group Relative Policy Optimization (A-GRPO) algorithm, which incorporates class-ratio-aware reward weighting and dynamic KL coefficients. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that the proposed approach consistently outperforms existing methods and achieves an accuracy of 84.7% on the FHM dataset, approaching the reported performance of human annotators.
papers.abstract_zh: 有害的模因通过视觉符号与文本之间的隐含关联传递出攻击性意图，这就要求人们具备对文化刻板印象和视觉隐喻的广泛理解。小型多模态大语言模型往往缺乏识别此类隐含仇恨的知识，而大型多模态语言模型虽然拥有更广泛的知识储备，却存在系统性标注偏差问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DR-HM这一训练框架——该框架采用“蒸馏后再强化”的训练策略，并通过认知感知的数据合成来实现有害模因的检测。该框架旨在将封闭源模型的知识迁移到新的模型中，同时减轻其偏见。DR-HM采用了一种六步结构化的数据合成方案，该方案包含自我完善机制，将模因分析分解为从实体识别到危害性判断的渐进式、以人类思维为导向的推理过程。基于这种合成推理数据，我们进一步采用了“蒸馏后再强化”的训练策略。这一策略结合了两阶段的监督微调方法和自适应群体相对策略优化算法，其中自适应群体相对策略优化算法包含了类比例感知的奖励权重分配机制以及动态KL系数调整功能。在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法始终优于现有方法，在FHM数据集上的准确率达到了84.7%，接近人类注释者的表现水平。

papers.title: Long Story Short: Disentangling Compositionality and Long-Caption Understanding in Contrastive VLMs
papers.title_zh: 长话短说：在对比语义理解中，如何区分组合性以及长描述理解的问题
papers.authors: Israfel Salazar, Desmond Elliott, Yova Kementchedjhieva
papers.abstract: Contrastive vision-language models (VLMs) have made significant progress in binding visual and textual information, yet understanding long, compositional captions remains an open challenge. While these capabilities are often assumed to be closely related, the conditions under which they reinforce each other remain unclear. In this paper, we empirically analyze when compositional reasoning and long-caption understanding transfer across tasks, and when this relationship fails. Through controlled experiments across diverse training objectives, datasets, and architectural designs, we find a bidirectional but sensitive relationship between the two capabilities. Models trained on poorly grounded captions or with limited parameter updates fail to generalize, while high-quality long-caption data with strong visual grounding promotes both capabilities simultaneously. We further show that architectural choices aimed at preserving general alignment, such as frozen positional embeddings, can inadvertently limit compositional learning. Our analysis provides actionable guidelines for data selection and model design to improve VLM generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 对比视语模型在整合视觉信息与文本信息方面取得了显著进展，但理解长篇幅、结构复杂的描述仍然是一个未解决的挑战。虽然这两种能力通常被认为密切相关，但它们相互增强的条件却并不明确。在本文中，我们通过实验分析探讨了组合推理与长描述理解在不同任务中的传递情况，以及这种关系何时会失效。通过针对不同的训练目标、数据集和架构设计的控制实验，我们发现这两种能力之间存在双向但微妙的关系。那些基于缺乏背景信息的描述进行训练的模型或参数更新有限的模型，其泛化能力较差；而具有高质量且具备强大视觉背景的长描述数据则能够同时提升这两种能力。我们还发现，一些旨在保持整体一致性的架构选择，比如冻结位置嵌入，可能会无意中限制组合学习的能力。我们的分析为数据选择和模型设计提供了可行的指导方针，以帮助提升视语模型的泛化能力。
