papers.title: Model in Distress: Sentiment Analysis on French Synthetic Social Media
papers.title_zh: 陷入困境的模特：关于法国那些虚假社交媒体的情感分析
papers.authors: Pierre-Carl Langlais, Pavel Chizhov, Yannick Detrois, Carlos Rosas Hinostroza, Ivan P. Yamshchikov, Bastien Perroy
papers.abstract: Automated analysis of customer feedback on social media is hindered by three challenges: the high cost of annotated training data, the scarcity of evaluation sets, especially in multilingual settings, and privacy concerns that prevent data sharing and reproducibility. We address these issues by developing a generalizable synthetic data generation pipeline applied to a case study on customer distress detection in French public transportation. Our approach utilizes backtranslation with fine-tuned models to generate 1.7 million synthetic tweets from a small seed corpus, complemented by synthetic reasoning traces. We train 600M-parameter reasoners with English and French reasoning that achieve 77-79% accuracy on human-annotated evaluation data, matching or exceeding SOTA proprietary LLMs and specialized encoders. Beyond reducing annotation costs, our pipeline preserves privacy by eliminating the exposure of sensitive user data. Our methodology can be adopted for other use cases and languages.
papers.abstract_zh: 在社交媒体上对客户反馈进行自动化分析面临着三个挑战：标注训练数据的成本高昂、评估数据集的稀缺性，尤其是在多语言环境下；此外，隐私问题也阻碍了数据的共享和复现能力。我们通过开发一种可泛化的合成数据生成流程来应对这些问题。在一项关于法国公共交通系统中客户情绪检测的案例研究中，我们利用经过微调的模型进行反向翻译，从而从少量种子数据集中生成了170万条合成推文，并辅以合成推理轨迹。我们训练了拥有6亿参数的推理器，该推理器能够使用英语和法语进行推理，在人工标注的评估数据上的准确率达到77%-79%，这一成绩超过了当前最先进的专有大语言和专用编码器。除了降低标注成本之外，我们的流程还通过消除敏感用户数据的暴露来保护隐私。我们的方法可以应用于其他用例和语言。
topics: 情感分析与计算社会科学
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Working Memory Constraints Scaffold Learning in Transformers under Data Scarcity
papers.title_zh: 工作记忆的限制如何影响 Transformer 在数据稀缺情境下的模型学习
papers.authors: Pranava Madhyastha, Dagmar Adamcová
papers.abstract: We investigate the integration of human-like working memory constraints into the Transformer architecture and implement several cognitively inspired attention variants, including fixed-width windows based and temporal decay based attention mechanisms. Our modified GPT-2 models are trained from scratch on developmentally plausible datasets (10M and 100M words). Performance is evaluated on grammatical judgment tasks (BLiMP) and alignment with human reading time data. Our results indicate that these cognitively-inspired constraints, particularly fixed-width attention, can significantly improve grammatical accuracy especially when training data is scarce. These constrained models also tend to show a stronger alignment with human processing metrics. The findings suggest that such constraints may serve as a beneficial inductive bias, guiding models towards more robust linguistic representations, especially in data-limited settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了将类似人类的工作记忆约束整合到Transformer架构中的方法，并实现了几种受认知启发的注意力机制，包括基于固定宽度的窗口和基于时间衰减的注意力机制。我们对修改后的GPT-2模型在开发性合理的数据集上进行从头训练（分别包含1000万词和1亿词的数据）。通过语法判断任务（BLiMP）以及与人类阅读时间数据的比对来评估性能。结果表明，这些受认知启发的约束，尤其是固定宽度注意力机制，能够在训练数据有限的情况下显著提高语法准确性。这些受限模型还表现出与人类处理指标更强的相关性。这些发现表明，这样的约束可以作为一种有益的归纳偏见，引导模型生成更稳健的语言表示，尤其是在数据有限的情况下。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Internalizing Multi-Agent Reasoning for Accurate and Efficient LLM-based Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 将多智能体推理机制内化，以实现基于大语言模型的推荐系统更加准确且高效运行
papers.authors: Yang Wu, Haoze Wang, Qian Li, Jun Zhang, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are reshaping recommender systems by leveraging extensive world knowledge and semantic reasoning to interpret user intent. However, effectively integrating these capabilities with collaborative signals while avoiding prohibitive inference latency remains a critical bottleneck. To address this, we propose a trajectory-driven internalization framework to develop a Single-agent Trajectory-Aligned Recommender (STAR). Specifically, to internalize complex reasoning capabilities into a single efficient model, we first design a multi-agent teacher system capable of multi-turn tool usage and reflection. This teacher utilizes a Collaborative Signal Translation mechanism to explicitly convert latent behavioral patterns into descriptive natural language evidence to enhance reasoning accuracy. Subsequently, a trajectory-driven distillation pipeline transfers this agentic logic, including planning, tool usage, and self-reflection, into the compact STAR model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that STAR surpasses its teacher by 8.7% to 39.5% while eliminating iterative latency, paving the way for real-time, reasoning-enhanced recommendation.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过利用丰富的世界知识和语义推理能力来解读用户意图，从而重塑推荐系统。然而，如何有效地将这些能力与协作信号相结合，同时避免过高的推理延迟，仍然是一个关键的瓶颈问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于轨迹驱动的内化框架，以开发一种名为“单代理轨迹对齐推荐器”的模型。具体来说，为了将复杂的推理能力整合到一个高效的模型中，我们首先设计了一个多智能体教师系统，该系统能够执行多轮次的工具使用和反思操作。该教师系统采用协作信号转换机制，将潜在的行为模式转化为描述性的自然语言证据，从而提高推理的准确性。随后，一个基于轨迹驱动的蒸馏流程将这种代理逻辑——包括规划、工具使用和自我反思——转移到紧凑的STAR模型中。大量的实验表明，STAR在推理准确性方面比其教师模型提升了8.7%到39.5%，同时消除了迭代延迟，为实时、基于推理的推荐提供了可能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Do Language Models Use Logophoric Cues? Evidence from Mandarin Chinese Long-Distance Reflexive
papers.title_zh: 语言模型会使用逻辑词线索吗？来自汉语远程反射性结构的证据
papers.authors: Yunfang Dong
papers.abstract: Resolving anaphora requires integrating syntactic, semantic, and discourse information. Mandarin Chinese offers a particularly revealing case through the reflexive ziji, whose interpretation permits long-distance binding licensed by logophoric cues (i.e., cues relevant to discourse perspective). While these cues have been extensively studied in linguistic theory and psycholinguistic experiments, it remains an open question to what extent such cues are captured by computational models.We investigate this question by probing large language models’ sensitivity to four logophoric cues known to license long-distance binding of ziji: predicate type, perspective marking, discourse topicality, and discourse relation. Using minimal pairs and surprisal-based measures, we assess whether models exhibit systematic biases toward non-local antecedents in logophoric contexts.Across two model families, we find that (i) models exhibit above-chance sensitivity to all four cues; (ii) lexically anchored cues are more robustly captured than discourse-level cues; and (iii) some cues generalize cross-lingually, whereas others appear to depend on language-specific training data. Taken together, these findings provide non-English evidence that large language models capture certain aspects of logophoricity, yet continue to struggle with discourse-level representations that are central to human anaphora resolution. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/yunfang-dong/mandarin-logophoricity-llm
papers.abstract_zh: 解决指代词的归属问题需要整合句法、语义和话语信息。汉语提供了一个特别具有启示性的例子——反身代词“自己”，其解释方式允许通过逻辑词线索（即与话语视角相关的线索）来实现远距离的指代关系。虽然这些线索在语言理论和心理语言学实验中已经被广泛研究，但仍有待探讨这些线索在多大程度上能够被计算模型所捕捉。我们通过探究大语言模型对四种已知能实现反身代词远距离指代的逻辑词线索的敏感性来研究这个问题：谓词类型、视角标记、话语主题性以及话语关系。利用最小对立词和惊讶度测量方法，我们评估模型是否对非局部先行词存在系统性偏好。在两种模型家族中，我们发现：(i) 模型对所有四种线索都表现出高于随机水平的敏感性；(ii) 词汇级线索比话语级线索更能被模型准确捕捉；(iii) 某些线索在不同语言中都能得到通用应用，而另一些线索则似乎依赖于特定语言的训练数据。综合这些发现，为非英语语言提供了证据，表明大语言模型能够捕捉到一些逻辑词特性的方面，但在处理与人类指代词解析密切相关的话语级表示时仍然存在困难。代码和数据集可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/yunfang-dong/mandarin-logophoricity-llm
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: FineState-Bench: Benchmarking State-Conditioned Grounding for Fine-grained GUI State Setting
papers.title_zh: FineState-Bench：针对细粒度GUI状态设置的状态依赖式引导技术性能评估
papers.authors: Fengxian Ji, Jingpu Yang, Zirui Song, Yuanxi Wang, Zhexuan Cui, Yuke Li, Qian Jiang, Xiuying Chen
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid progress of large vision-language models (LVLMs), fine-grained, state-conditioned GUI interaction remains challenging. Current evaluations offer limited coverage, imprecise target-state definitions, and an overreliance on final-task success, obscuring where and why agents fail.To address this gap, we introduce FineState-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates whether an agent can correctly ground an instruction to the intended UI control and reach the exact target state.FineState-Bench comprises 2,209 instances across desktop, web, and mobile platforms, spanning four interaction families and 23 UI component types, with each instance explicitly specifying an exact target state for fine-grained state setting.We further propose FineState-Metrics, a four-stage diagnostic pipeline with stage-wise success rates: Localization Success Rate (SR@Loc), Interaction Success Rate (SR@Int), Exact State Success Rate at Locate (ES-SR@Loc), and Exact State Success Rate at Interact (ES-SR@Int), and a plug-and-play Visual Diagnostic Assistant (VDA) that generates a Description and a bounding-box Localization Hint to diagnose visual grounding reason via controlled w/ vs. w/o comparisons.On FineState-Bench, exact goal-state success remains low: ES-SR@Int peaks at 32.8% on Web and 22.8% on average across platforms. With VDA localization hints, Gemini-2.5-Flash gains +14.9 ES-SR@Int points, suggesting substantial headroom from improved visual grounding, yet overall accuracy is still insufficient for reliable fine-grained state-conditioned interaction Github.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大型视觉语言模型取得了快速进展，但精细的、基于状态的GUI交互仍然具有挑战性。当前的评估方法存在局限性，目标状态的定义不够精确，且过于依赖最终任务的成功情况，这导致难以明确了解代理失败的原因和地点。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了FineState-Bench这个基准测试，该测试旨在评估代理是否能够正确地执行指令，并达到精确的目标状态。FineState-Bench包含了2,209个实例，涵盖了桌面、网络和移动平台，涉及四种交互方式和23种UI组件类型。每个实例都明确指定了一个精确的目标状态，以便于进行精细的状态设置。我们还提出了FineState-Metrics这一四阶段诊断流程，各阶段的成功率分别为：局部定位成功率（SR@Loc）、交互成功率（SR@Int）、在定位时的精确状态成功率（ES-SR@Loc）以及在交互时的精确状态成功率（ES-SR@Int）。此外，我们还提供了一个即插式的视觉诊断辅助工具（VDA），它可以通过有/无对比的方式生成描述和边界框定位提示，以帮助诊断视觉定位的问题。在FineState-Bench测试中，精确的目标状态成功率仍然较低：在Web平台上，ES-SR@Int的最高成功率为32.8%，而在其他平台上的平均成功率则达到了22.8%。通过使用VDA的定位提示，Gemini-2.5-Flash在ES-SR@Int方面的得分提高了14.9分，这表明视觉定位方面有了显著的改进，不过整体准确率仍然不足以实现可靠的、基于状态的精细交互功能。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Dictionary Guided Sparse Logit Editing for Reliable Jailbreak Attacks
papers.title_zh: 基于字典驱动的稀疏逻辑回归编辑方法，用于实现可靠的越狱攻击
papers.authors: Shuaibiao Han, Ruiyang Ni, Zhiyu Yi, Changlong Li, Perley Xu, Wenjie Ruan
papers.abstract: Although Large Language Models undergo rigorous safety alignment, they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing methods, particularly gradient-based prompt optimization, suffer from high computational costs and produce uninterpretable, high-perplexity inputs. While recent logit-space attacks improve efficiency, they often rely on cumbersome auxiliary models or complex pipelines. In this work, we propose Sparse Index-Based Intervention (SIBI), a white-box, inference-time jailbreak that bypasses guardrails via lightweight, sparse logit editing. SIBI operates without gradients or auxiliary models, modifying pre-softmax logits using a compact, tokenizer-aligned dictionary of penalty and reward tokens. By incorporating temperature-consistent scaling and a mixed-norm trust region, the method ensures attack effectiveness while preserving generation fluency. On standard benchmarks, SIBI achieves high attack success rates while reducing computational overhead and space overhead compared to optimization baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型经过了严格的安全对齐处理，但它们仍然容易受到对抗性攻击的影响。现有的方法，尤其是基于梯度的提示优化方法，存在计算成本过高的问题，并且会产生难以解释、复杂度较高的输入数据。虽然最近的logit空间攻击提高了效率，但这些攻击往往依赖于复杂的辅助模型或繁琐的处理流程。在这项研究中，我们提出了稀疏索引式干预技术（SIBI），这是一种在推理阶段进行的白盒式破解方法，它通过轻量级、稀疏的logit编辑来绕过现有防护措施。SIBI无需使用梯度或辅助模型，而是通过一种紧凑的、与分词器对齐的惩罚和奖励字典来修改预softmax logits。通过结合温度一致性缩放和混合范数的信赖域，该方法能够在保持生成流畅性的同时，确保攻击的有效性。在标准的测试基准上，SIBI取得了较高的攻击成功率，同时相比传统的优化方法，其计算开销和空间占用都得到了显著降低。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Chain-of-Relations: Faithful and Efficient LLM Reasoning over Knowledge Graphs via Relation-Centric Exploration
papers.title_zh: 关系链：通过以关系为中心的探索方式，在知识图谱上进行可靠且高效的大语言模型推理
papers.authors: Chenhui Liu, Jianpeng Zhou, Jiahai Wang
papers.abstract: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) serves as an essential benchmark for KG-enhanced large language models. Among various approaches, agent-based methods have emerged as an effective solution.Existing methods adopt entity-centric exploration that incrementally constructs reasoning paths by selecting and connecting intermediate entities. However, they face two critical limitations. (1) Entity incompleteness vulnerability arises when some intermediate entities lack semantic information beyond opaque IDs, preventing relevance evaluation and leading to discarding valid reasoning paths.(2) Premature entity pruning occurs because beam search retains only top-ranked entities at each step, eliminating candidates before their relevance can be verified.To address these challenges, this paper proposes Chain-of-Relations (CoR) with relation-centric exploration and global entity filtering, reducing dependence on entity completeness and ensuring complete candidate retrieval before constraint validation.Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that CoR consistently outperforms strong baselines in both F1 score and KG-grounded Rate.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识图谱问答（KGQA）是增强型大语言模型的一个重要评估标准。在各种方法中，基于代理的方法被证明是一种有效的解决方案。现有的方法采用以实体为中心的探索方式，通过选择和连接中间实体来逐步构建推理路径。然而，这些方法存在两个主要缺陷：(1) 当某些中间实体缺乏语义信息时，就会出现实体不完整的问题，这会导致相关性评估无法进行，从而让一些有效的推理路径被丢弃。(2) 由于beam搜索只保留每个步骤中排名最高的实体，因此会出现过早删除候选实体的情况，导致在验证其相关性之前就排除了一些候选方案。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了基于关系链的探索方法，该方法采用以关系为中心的探索方式，并采用全局实体过滤技术，从而减少对实体完整性的依赖，确保在进行约束验证之前能够完整地检索到所有候选方案。在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，基于关系链的方法在F1分数和基于知识图谱的准确率方面始终优于其他强大的基线方法。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: MedQPA-Gen: Medical Question Proposing and Answering for Report Generation
papers.title_zh: MedQPA-Gen：用于生成报告的医学问题提出与回答系统
papers.authors: Weijie Liang, Xiyue Zhu, Ruike Zhu, Chenhao Li, Cheng Tang, Zhiyu Liu, Zhihua Gong, Shirui Luo, Yudu Li, Volodymyr Kindratenko
papers.abstract: Medical report generation from medical images is a vital AI task that helps doctors with diagnosis and marks a significant step toward creating general AI-powered medical systems. However, previous methods either fail to optimize factual accuracy or heavily depend on expert preference data. To overcome these challenges, we propose MedQPA, an automatic and generalizable report evaluation technique that uses question proposing and answering to enable controllable, structured reasoning grounded in medical domain knowledge and the factual correctness of the report. Additionally, we design MedQPA-Gen, a medical report generation pipeline that maximizes the MedQPA score through prompt engineering and reinforcement learning with MedQPA as a reward signal. We demonstrate that MedQPA is an accurate evaluation metric that closely correlates with human preferences. More importantly, MedQPA-Gen achieves higher human preference scores and better performance on downstream tasks. We open-source code at this repo https://github.com/MedQPA-gen/MedQPA-gen.
papers.abstract_zh: 从医学图像生成医疗报告是一项重要的AI任务，它有助于医生的诊断工作，并朝着创建基于通用AI的医学系统迈出重要一步。然而，以往的方法要么无法优化事实准确性，要么严重依赖专家偏好数据。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了MedQPA这一自动且可推广的报告评估技术。该技术通过问题提出与回答来实现基于医学领域知识以及报告事实正确性的可控、结构化推理。此外，我们还设计了MedQPA-Gen这一医疗报告生成流程，它通过提示工程以及以MedQPA作为奖励信号进行强化学习，来最大化MedQPA得分。我们证明，MedQPA是一种准确的评估指标，它与人类偏好高度相关。更重要的是，MedQPA-Gen在下游任务中取得了更高的人类偏好评分和更好的性能。我们的代码可以在以下仓库获取：https://github.com/MedQPA-gen/MedQPA-gen。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Faster MoE LLM Inference for Extremely Large Models
papers.title_zh: 适用于超大型模型的更快的MoE语言模型推理技术
papers.authors: Haoqi Yang, Luohe Shi, Qiwei Li, Zuchao Li, Ping Wang, Hao Huang, Hai Zhao
papers.abstract: In fine-grained sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, a large pool of specialized experts replaces a small homogeneous set, shifting performance and throughput to be governed by inference-time expert activation. Yet most existing optimization recipes implicitly assume a fixed activation budget (e.g., a constant Top-k per layer), whose behavior in fine-grained MoEs is poorly understood. We first characterize runtime skipping strategies, quantifying the accuracy–efficiency trade-off of (i) uniform fixed activation and (ii) static layer-wise Top-k allocation found by search. Our analysis reveals that static skipping can already provide substantial throughput gains, but optimal static schedules vary significantly across models and routing mechanisms. We therefore introduce Adaptive Skipping with Entropy-Penalized Thresholding (ASET), a training-free policy that adapts token-level activation using router confidence and entropy while remaining within the model’s original budget. Across the fine-grained MoEs we study, static skipping policies yield 10–78% throughput gains with minimal performance degradation, including \ge10% improvement on DeepSeek-V3 without measurable loss. On the OLMoE testbed, ASET yields a Pareto frontier between average activation and task quality. Overall, these results identify expert skipping as a practical lever for faster fine-grained MoE inference, with adaptive activation helping when fixed budgets are too rigid.
papers.abstract_zh: 在细粒度稀疏混合专家模型中，大量的专业专家取代了少数同质专家，使得性能和吞吐量受到推理时间内专家激活的影响。然而，大多数现有的优化方法都隐含地假设了一个固定的激活预算（例如，每层的恒定Top-k值），而这一预算在细粒度混合专家模型中的行为尚未得到充分理解。我们首先对运行时跳过策略进行了分析，量化了以下两种策略的精度与效率权衡：(i) 统一的固定激活策略；(ii) 通过搜索得到的静态分层Top-k分配策略。我们的分析表明，静态跳过策略已经能够带来显著的吞吐量提升，但最优的静态调度方案会因模型和路由机制的不同而有所差异。因此，我们提出了自适应跳过与熵惩罚阈值策略（ASET），这是一种无需训练的策略，它能够根据路由器置信度和熵来调整令牌级别的激活量，同时保持在模型的原始预算范围内。在我们研究的细粒度混合专家模型中，静态跳过策略能够在最小的性能下降情况下实现10%到78%的吞吐量提升，包括在DeepSeek-V3任务上的提升超过10%，且几乎没有损失。在OLMoE测试平台上，ASET实现了平均激活量与任务质量之间的帕累托前沿。总体而言，这些结果表明，专家跳过策略是加速细粒度混合专家推理的有效手段，而当固定预算过于严格时，自适应激活策略则能发挥重要作用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Localized Cultural Knowledge is Conserved and Controllable in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型中，局部化的文化知识是可以被保留并控制的
papers.authors: Veniamin Veselovsky, Berke Argın, Benedikt Stroebl, Chris Wendler, Robert West, James Evans, Thomas L. Griffiths, Arvind Narayanan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs), like human language learners, show patterns influenced by their dominant training language. Just as humans display language patterns influenced by their native tongue (semantic accents) when learning new languages, LLMs often default to English-centric responses even when generating in other languages. However, we observe that explicitly providing cultural context in prompts significantly improves the models’ ability to generate culturally localized responses. We term this phenomenon the explicit-implicit localization gap, indicating that while cultural knowledge exists within LLMs, it may not naturally surface in multilingual interaction without explicitly including cultural context. In this paper, we (1) quantify this gap in multiple LLMs using a new cultural localization benchmark and find large (>10%) gaps in the majority of investigated models. (2) Demonstrate a fundamental trade-off between localization accuracy and output diversity. (3) Through mechanistic interpretability, we identify the underlying localization mechanisms within LLMs and show that these mechanisms are both language and task agnostic, with individual steering vectors effectively generalizing across different languages and culturally-relevant tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）就像人类语言学习者一样，会表现出受其主导训练语言影响的模式。正如人类在学习新语言时会出现受母语影响的语言模式（语义偏向），LLM在用其他语言生成内容时，也往往会默认使用英语为中心的回应方式。然而，我们发现，在提示中明确提供文化背景信息，能够显著提升模型生成具有文化特色的内容的能力。我们将这种现象称为“显式-隐式本地化差距”，即虽然LLM内部存在文化知识，但在多语言交互中，如果没有明确包含文化背景信息，这些知识可能无法自然呈现出来。在本文中，我们：（1）通过新的文化本地化基准测试，量化了多个LLM之间的这种差距，发现大多数被研究的模型都存在较大的差距（超过10%）；（2）揭示了本地化准确性与输出多样性之间存在的根本权衡；（3）通过机制可解释性分析，确定了LLM内部的本地化机制，并表明这些机制既不受语言限制，也不受任务限制，各个引导向量能够在不同语言和与文化相关的任务中有效发挥作用。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: The Confidence Paradox: Unveiling the Latent Discriminative Power of Diffusion Large Language Models in Mathematical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 自信悖论：揭示扩散大型语言模型在数学推理中的潜在判别能力
papers.authors: Yansi Li, Gongshen Liu, Zhuosheng Zhang
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (DLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) generation, uniquely offering token-level probabilities under bidirectional context. However, the semantics of their native uncertainty estimates remain underexplored. In this work, we uncover a calibration paradox inherent to the bidirectional generation mechanism of state-of-the-art DLLMs. Concretely, we demonstrate that diffusion confidence is structurally distinct from AR likelihood. Notably, LLaDA-8B is highly miscalibrated (31.2% ECE) on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, yet possesses superior discriminative power (0.826 AUROC), significantly outperforming comparable AR baselines in single-pass settings (0.611 AUROC). We diagnose that this paradox arises because diffusion confidence functions less like a probability of correctness and more like a proxy for structural consistency enabled by the model’s bidirectional access to the entire solution path. We further show that lightweight post-hoc calibration can reconcile this gap, reducing ECE by over 60% while preserving the strong ranking signal. Our findings suggest that DLLMs offer a unique, cost-efficient uncertainty signal for reasoning tasks that complements expensive AR approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散式大语言模型（DLLMs）作为自回归生成方法的替代方案，展现出巨大的潜力。它们能够在双向上下文中提供令牌级别的概率信息。然而，这些模型固有的不确定性估计机制仍未被充分研究。在本研究中，我们发现了一种与最新DLLMs的双向生成机制相关的校准悖论。具体来说，我们发现扩散式置信度与自回归似然之间存在结构上的差异。值得注意的是，LaDa8B在数学推理测试中的校准误差高达31.2%（ECE值），但其判别能力却相当强（AUROC值为0.826），在单遍处理场景中表现优于同类自回归模型基线（AUROC值为0.611）。我们分析发现，这种悖论的产生是因为扩散式置信度更像是模型对结构一致性的一种代理，而非正确性的概率度量。进一步研究表明，通过轻量级的后校准方法可以缩小这一差距，将ECE降低超过60%，同时保留模型的强大排序能力。我们的研究结果表明，DLLMs为推理任务提供了一种独特且成本效益高的不确定性信号，能够弥补昂贵的自回归方法的不足。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Efficient Hallucination Detection in Automatic Code Generation
papers.title_zh: 在自动代码生成中高效检测幻觉现象
papers.authors: Georgii Andriushchenko, Roman Garaev, Lyudmila Rvanova, Artem Shelmanov, Vladimir V. Ivanov
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently produce source code that seems correct and well-formed, yet includes hallucinated elements that cause downstream test failures. In this study, we benchmark state-of-the-art uncertainty quantification methods and existing baselines for the task of hallucination detection in source code and introduce a diff-based pipeline to construct a code dataset annotated with line-level hallucinations. Building on this, we train a lightweight Transformer-based detector that uses LLM internal representations to identify hallucinations, substantially outperforming existing methods across several code generation domains. The detector also shows particular promise for enabling self-correction in LLM-based coding agents. We release the first publicly available dataset of line-level code hallucinations, along with the corresponding source code and trained hallucination detectors https://github.com/datapaf/CodeHallucinationDetection
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型经常生成看似正确且结构良好的源代码，但实际上包含一些幻觉元素，这会导致下游测试失败。在这项研究中，我们对现有的不确定性量化方法和基准数据进行评估，以检测源代码中的幻觉现象。我们采用一种基于差异的管道来构建包含行级幻觉的代码数据集。在此基础上，我们训练了一个轻量级的基于Transformer的检测器，该检测器利用语言模型的内部表示来识别幻觉，并在多个代码生成领域取得了显著的成绩。该检测器在使基于语言模型的编码代理能够自我修正方面也表现出巨大的潜力。我们发布了首个公开可用的行级代码幻觉数据集，以及相应的源代码和训练好的幻觉检测器：https://github.com/datapaf/CodeHallucinationDetection
topics: 幻觉、事实性与可解释性

papers.title: DuET: Dual Execution for Test Output Prediction with Generated Code and Pseudocode
papers.title_zh: DuET：针对测试输出预测的双重执行方式，结合生成的代码和伪代码
papers.authors: Hojae Han, Jaejin Kim, Seung-won Hwang, Yu Jin Kim, Moontae Lee
papers.abstract: This work addresses test output prediction, a key challenge in test case generation. To improve the reliability of predicted outputs by LLMs, prior approaches generate code first to ground predictions. One grounding strategy is direct execution of generated code, but even minor errors can cause failures. To address this, we introduce LLM-based pseudocode execution, which grounds prediction on more error-resilient pseudocode and simulates execution via LLM reasoning. We further propose DUET, a dual-execution framework that combines both approaches by functional majority voting. Our analysis shows the two approaches are complementary in overcoming the limitations of direct execution suffering from code errors, and pseudocode reasoning from hallucination. On LiveCodeBench, DUET achieves the state-of-the-art performance, improving Pass@1 by 13.6 pp. For filtering candidates in code generation, DUET shows the best Pass@1 on LiveCodeBenchEasy, BigCodeBench-Hard, DevEval and HumanEval(+).
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究致力于测试输出预测问题，这是测试用例生成中的一个关键挑战。为了提高大语言模型预测输出的可靠性，以往的方法通常是先生成代码来作为预测的基准。其中一种基准策略是直接执行生成的代码，但即使是微小的错误也可能导致失败。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了基于大语言模型的伪代码执行方法。这种方法以更具备错误恢复能力的伪代码作为预测的基准，并通过大语言模型的推理来模拟执行过程。我们还提出了DUET这一双执行框架，它结合了这两种方法的优势，通过功能性的多数投票来实现协同工作。我们的分析表明，这两种方法可以相互补充，从而克服直接执行方式因代码错误导致的局限性，以及伪代码推理方式因幻觉而产生的缺陷。在LiveCodeBench上，DUET取得了最先进的性能表现，将Pass@1分数提高了13.6个百分点。在代码生成中的候选筛选方面，DUET在LiveCodeBenchEasy、BigCodeBench-Hard、DevEval和HumanEval(+)等多个评测中均展现了最佳的Pass@1成绩。

papers.title: Attention Sinks in Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: 注意力在扩散语言模型中的体现
papers.authors: Maximo Eduardo Rulli, Simone Petruzzi, Edoardo Michielon, Fabrizio Silvestri, Simone Scardapane, Alessio Devoto
papers.abstract: Masked Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to traditional Autoregressive Models (ARMs). DLMs employ transformer encoders with bidirectional attention, enabling parallel token generation while maintaining competitive performance. Although their efficiency and effectiveness have been extensively studied, the internal mechanisms that govern DLMs remain largely unexplored. In this work, we conduct an empirical analysis of DLM attention patterns, focusing on the attention sinking phenomenon, an effect previously observed in various transformer-based architectures. Our findings reveal that DLMs also exhibit attention sinks, but with distinct characteristics. First, unlike in ARMs, the sink positions in DLMs tend to shift throughout the generation process, displaying a dynamic behaviour. Second, while ARMs are highly sensitive to the removal of attention sinks, DLMs remain robust: masking sinks leads to only a minor degradation in performance. These results provide new insights into the inner workings of diffusion-based language models and highlight fundamental differences in how they allocate and utilize attention compared to autoregressive models.
papers.abstract_zh: masked扩散语言模型（DLM）最近作为一种有前景的替代方案出现，可以取代传统的自回归模型（ARMs）。DLM采用带有双向注意力的Transformer编码器，能够在保持良好性能的同时实现并行标记生成。尽管它们的效率和效果已经得到了广泛研究，但控制DLM的内部机制仍然大部分未被探索。在这项研究中，我们对DLM的注意力模式进行了实证分析，重点关注注意力下沉现象——这一效应之前已在多种基于Transformer的架构中被观察到。我们的研究发现，DLM也表现出注意力下沉现象，但其特征有所不同。首先，与ARMs不同，DLM中的注意力下沉位置在生成过程中会发生变化，呈现出动态的行为特征。其次，虽然ARMs对注意力下沉的消除非常敏感，但DLM却表现出较强的鲁棒性：掩盖注意力下沉只会带来轻微的性能下降。这些结果为我们提供了关于基于扩散的语言模型内部运作机制的新见解，并揭示了它们与自回归模型在分配和利用注意力方面的根本差异。

papers.title: R^3-SQL: Ranking Reward and Resampling for Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: R^3-SQL：用于文本转SQL的奖励排序与重采样技术
papers.authors: Hojae Han, Yeonseok Jeong, Seung-won Hwang, Zhewei Yao, Yuxiong He
papers.abstract: Modern Text-to-SQL systems generate multiple candidate SQL queries and rank them to judge a final prediction. However, existing methods face two limitations. First, they often score functionally equivalent SQL queries inconsistently despite identical execution results. Second, ranking cannot recover when the correct SQL is absent from the candidate pool. We propose R3 -SQL, a Text-to-SQL framework that addresses both issues through unified reward for ranking and resampling. R3 -SQL first groups candidates by execution result and ranks groups for consistency. To score each group, it combines a pairwise preference across groups with a pointwise utility from the best group rank and size, capturing relative preference, consistency, and candidate quality. To improve candidate recall, R3 -SQL introduces agentic resampling, which judges the generated candidate pool and selectively resamples when the correct SQL is likely absent. R3 -SQL achieves 75.03 execution accuracy on BIRD-dev, a new state of the art among methods using models with disclosed sizes, with consistent gains across five benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代的文本转SQL系统会生成多个候选SQL查询，并对它们进行排名以得出最终预测。然而，现有的方法存在两个局限性。首先，即使执行结果相同，功能上等效的SQL查询往往会被不一致地评分。其次，当正确SQL不在候选列表中时，排名机制就无法发挥作用。我们提出了R3-SQL这一文本转SQL框架，它通过统一的排名奖励和重采样技术来解决这两个问题。R3-SQL首先根据执行结果对候选列表进行分组，然后对这些组进行排名以保持一致性。为了对每个组进行评分，它结合了组与组之间的偏好关系，以及来自最佳组的排名和规模的信息，从而捕捉到相对偏好、一致性和候选质量等因素。为了提高候选列表的召回率，R3-SQL引入了代理重采样技术，该技术能够判断生成的候选列表，并在可能缺少正确SQL的情况下选择性地进行重采样。在BIRD-dev数据集上的测试表明，R3-SQL达到了75.03的执行准确率，这一成绩在使用公开规模的模型的现有方法中属于顶尖水平，而且在不同基准测试中的表现也保持稳定提升。

papers.title: Detecting Hallucinations in SpeechLLMs at Inference Time Using Attention Maps
papers.title_zh: 在推理过程中利用注意力图来检测语言模型中出现的幻觉现象
papers.authors: Jonas Waldendorf, Bashar Awwad Shiekh Hasan, Evgenii Tsymbalov
papers.abstract: Hallucinations in Speech Large Language Models (SpeechLLMs) pose significant risks, yet existing detection methods typically rely on gold-standard outputs that are costly or impractical to obtain. Moreover, hallucination detection methods developed for text-based LLMs do not directly capture audio-specific signals. We investigate four attention-derived metrics: AudioRatio, AudioConsistency, AudioEntropy, and TextEntropy, designed to capture pathological attention patterns associated with hallucination, and train lightweight logistic regression classifiers on these features for efficient inference-time detection. Across automatic speech recognition and speech-to-text translation tasks, evaluations on Qwen-2-Audio and Voxtral-3B show that our approach outperforms uncertainty-based and prior attention-based baselines on in-domain data, achieving improvements of up to +0.23 PR-AUC, and generalises to out-of-domain ASR settings. We further find that strong performance can be achieved with approximately 100 attention heads, improving out-of-domain generalisation compared to using all heads. While effectiveness is model-dependent and task-specific training is required, our results demonstrate that attention patterns provide a valuable tool for hallucination detection in SpeechLLMs
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在语音处理中出现的幻觉现象带来了显著的风险。现有的检测方法通常依赖于成本高昂或难以获得的标准输出数据。此外，为基于文本的语言模型开发的幻觉检测方法无法直接捕捉音频特有的信号特征。我们研究了四种基于注意力机制的评估指标：AudioRatio、AudioConsistency、AudioEntropy和TextEntropy，这些指标旨在捕捉与幻觉相关的异常注意力模式。我们还在这些特征上训练了轻量级逻辑回归分类器，以实现高效的实时检测。在自动语音识别以及语音转文字翻译任务中，对Qwen-2-Audio和Voxtral-3B数据集进行的评估表明，我们的方法在领域数据上的表现优于基于不确定性的方法和基于先前注意力机制的基线方法，取得了高达+0.23的PR-AUC提升效果，并且这种性能也适用于非领域场景的语音识别任务。我们还发现，使用大约100个注意力头就能获得良好的性能，相比使用全部注意力头，这种配置能更好地实现非领域场景的泛化能力。虽然这种方法的有效性取决于具体模型，并且需要针对特定任务进行专门训练，但我们的结果表明，注意力模式为语音语言模型中幻觉的检测提供了有效的工具。

papers.title: Leveraging External Knowledge for Historical Document Restoration via Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 利用外部知识通过检索增强型大型语言模型进行历史文献的修复
papers.authors: Gabeen Kim, Kyeongpil Kang
papers.abstract: Historical documents act as invaluable knowledge archives but often suffer from illegibility due to physical deterioration and damage. While existing restoration methods based on masked language modeling effectively utilize local context, they struggle to restore named entities that require external historical knowledge. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel framework for historical document restoration that leverages large language models with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). By combining the implicit knowledge of pre-trained LLMs with explicitly retrieved external context, our model ARI effectively mitigates the challenge of inferring context-dependent proper nouns. Extensive experiments on Korean historical documents demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms baselines, achieving substantial gains in restoring both general characters and named entities. Furthermore, comprehensive evaluations including expert assessments confirm that ARI serves as a practical tool for domain experts, promising to accelerate the analysis of historical records.
papers.abstract_zh: 历史文献作为宝贵的知识宝库，但由于物理损坏和老化问题，往往存在难以辨认的情况。虽然现有的基于掩码语言建模的修复方法能够有效利用局部上下文信息，但它们在修复需要外部历史知识的命名实体时却面临困难。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种新颖的历史文献修复框架，该框架利用大语言模型与检索增强生成技术相结合的方法。通过结合预训练LLM所蕴含的隐性知识与显式检索到的外部上下文信息，我们的模型ARI能够有效解决推断依赖上下文的专有名词的问题。在韩国历史文献上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法显著优于传统方法，在恢复普通字符和命名实体方面取得了显著成效。此外，包括专家评估在内的全面测试也证实，ARI为领域专家提供了实用的工具，有望加速历史记录的分析工作。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: From Experience to Skill: Multi-Agent Generative Engine Optimization via Reusable Strategy Learning
papers.title_zh: 从经验到技能：通过可复用策略学习来优化多智能体生成引擎
papers.authors: Beining Wu, Fuyou Mao, Jiong Lin, Cheng Yang, Jiaxuan Lu, Yifu Guo, Siyu Zhang, Yifan Wu, Ying Huang, Fu Li
papers.abstract: Generative engines (GEs) are reshaping information access by replacing ranked links with citation-grounded answers, yet current Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) methods optimize each instance in isolation, unable to accumulate or transfer effective strategies across tasks and engines. We reframe GEO as a strategy learning problem and propose MAGEO, a multi-agent framework in which coordinated planning, editing, and fidelity-aware evaluation serve as the execution layer, while validated editing patterns are progressively distilled into reusable, engine-specific optimization skills. To enable controlled assessment, we introduce a Twin Branch Evaluation Protocol for causal attribution of content edits and DSV-CF, a dual-axis metric that unifies semantic visibility with attribution accuracy. We further release MSME-GEO-Bench, a multi-scenario, multi-engine benchmark grounded in real-world queries. Experiments on three mainstream engines show that MAGEO substantially outperforms heuristic baselines in both visibility and citation fidelity, with ablations confirming that engine-specific preference modeling and strategy reuse are central to these gains, suggesting a scalable learning-driven paradigm for trustworthy GEO. Code is available at https://github.com/Wu-beining/MAGEO.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式引擎正在通过用基于引用结果的答案替代排名链接的方式，重新塑造信息获取方式。然而，目前的各种生成式优化方法都是独立优化每个实例的，无法将有效的策略积累或跨任务和引擎进行迁移应用。我们将生成式优化问题重新定义为一种策略学习问题，并提出了MAGEO这一多智能体框架。在该框架中，协调的规划、编辑以及考虑准确性的评估构成了执行层，而经过验证的编辑模式则被逐步提炼成可复用的、针对特定引擎的优化技巧。为了实现可控的评估，我们引入了双分支评估协议，用于因果归因分析内容编辑的效果；同时，我们还提出了DSV-CF这一双轴指标，它结合了语义可见性与归因准确性。此外，我们还发布了MSME-GEO-Bench这一基于真实世界查询的多场景、多引擎基准测试平台。在三个主流引擎上的实验表明，MAGEO在可见性和引用准确性方面均显著优于启发式算法基线。实验结果表明，针对特定引擎的偏好建模和策略复用是这些改进的关键，这提示了我们一个可扩展的学习驱动型解决方案，以实现可靠的生成式优化。代码可在https://github.com/Wu-beining/MAGEO下载。

papers.title: CodeRM-NT: Reward Model for Code RL without Unit Tests
papers.title_zh: CodeRM-NT：适用于代码强化学习的奖励模型，无需单元测试
papers.authors: Xiao Xia, Dan Zhang, Tianrui Sun
papers.abstract: Providing accurate reward signals for code generated by large language models (LLMs) is a significant challenge in applying reinforcement learning (RL) to code generation. Existing methods rely on unit tests to evaluate code correctness and provide rewards, which are hindered by the difficulty of acquiring and verifying reliable unit tests at scale. In this work, we propose CodeRM-NT, a code reward model with no reliance on unit tests. Our method leverages Monte Carlo Tree Search guided by LLMs to generate code snippets and judges execution traces to annotate code with reward signals. We use the rewards to train CodeRM-NT that is capable of providing rewards for code during RL. CodeRM-NT also facilitates curriculum learning by scoring and sorting training samples based on their difficulty. Experimental results demonstrate that training with CodeRM-NT consistently outperforms synthetic unit test-based rewards, yielding superior performance on multiple code generation benchmarks. Additionally, curriculum learning based on CodeRM-NT further enhances model performance. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/THUDM/CodeRM-NT.
papers.abstract_zh: 为大语言模型生成的代码提供准确的奖励信号，是应用强化学习技术于代码生成中的一个重大挑战。现有的方法依赖于单元测试来评估代码的正确性并给出奖励，但这种方法面临着获取和验证可靠单元测试的困难。在这项研究中，我们提出了CodeRM-NT模型，该模型完全不依赖单元测试来生成奖励信号。我们的方法利用由大语言模型引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索算法来生成代码片段，并通过判断执行轨迹来对代码进行奖励标注。我们利用这些奖励来训练CodeRM-NT模型，使其能够在强化学习中为代码提供奖励。此外，CodeRM-NT还能够通过根据训练样本的难度对其进行评分和排序，从而实现课程学习功能。实验结果表明，使用CodeRM-NT进行训练时，其性能始终优于基于合成单元测试的奖励方式，在多个代码生成基准测试中均取得了更好的表现。而且，基于CodeRM-NT的课程学习机制进一步提升了模型的性能。我们的代码和数据集可以在以下链接下载：https://github.com/THUDM/CodeRM-NT。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Fin-STAR: Structure-as-Semantics to Resolve Implicitness in Financial Retrieval
papers.title_zh: Fin-STAR：以结构作为语义机制来解决金融信息检索中的隐含性问题
papers.authors: Yu Zou, Yan Chen, Lida He, Qi Zhou, Xiaorui Zhou, Aixi Zhong, Yi Wang, Wei Li, Qingyu Wang, Jiatao Li, Wei Gong, Jialei Zeng, Jingmei Zhao, Ke Jiang, Qing Li
papers.abstract: Understanding financial documents is critical for high-stakes decision-making yet hindered by systemic semantic implicitness: key facts are rarely explicit in surface text and often determined by global structural cues. Missing these cues invites semantic misinterpretations, such as misreading what a number refers to, an outcome unacceptable in high-stakes environments. However, existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems typically treat structure as a physical navigational skeleton rather than intrinsic semantic knowledge. To address this, we introduce Fin-STAR (Financial STructure-As-Semantics Retrieval), a framework redefining hierarchy as intrinsic semantics. Fin-STAR incorporates a novel Structure-Enriched Semantic Indexing mechanism that augments the hierarchical lineage with snippet-derived virtual nodes, and injects this enriched context via a semantic cross-attention paradigm, rendering implicit cues explicit. By grounding evidence within its structural scope, we preserve factual invariance and ensure contextual integrity. Addressing the lack of granular public datasets, we conduct experiments on FinTierQA Gold, a curated expert benchmark. Results show that Fin-STAR outperforms state-of-the-art hierarchical and graph-based baselines across diverse query complexities, document types, and markets. Notably, ablations confirm that our semantic injection consistently outperforms alternative strategies. Finally, we release FinTierQA, comprising 3.9M pairs automatically constructed from 78k documents via our framework .
papers.abstract_zh: 理解财务文件对于做出高风险的决策至关重要，然而，由于系统的语义隐秘性，这一过程受到了阻碍：关键事实在表面文本中很少被明确提及，它们往往由全局结构线索决定。这些线索的缺失会导致语义上的误解，例如误读一个数字所代表的意义，这在高风险环境中是不可接受的。然而，现有的检索增强生成系统通常将结构视为物理导航的骨架，而非内在的语义知识。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Fin-STAR框架，该框架将层次结构重新定义为内在语义。Fin-STAR采用了一种新颖的结构增强语义索引机制，通过片段衍生的虚拟节点来补充层次结构，并通过语义交叉注意力机制将这种增强的上下文注入其中，使隐式的线索变得清晰可见。通过将证据置于其结构范围内，我们保持了事实的不变性，并确保了上下文的完整性。为了解决缺乏细粒度公共数据集的问题，我们在FinTierQA Gold这个经过精心挑选的专业基准测试上进行了实验。结果表明，Fin-STAR在多种查询复杂性、文档类型和市场环境下，都优于最先进的层次结构和基于图的基线方法。值得注意的是，消融实验表明，我们的语义注入策略始终优于其他策略。最后，我们发布了FinTierQA，该数据集包含来自78万份文档的390万对数据，这些数据是通过我们的框架自动构建而成的。

papers.title: When Rules Learn: A Self-Evolving Agent for Legal Case Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 当规则发挥作用时：一种用于法律案件检索的自适应智能体
papers.authors: Mingxu Tao, Jiawei Hu, Xian Zhou, Wenpeng Hu, Jiajun Cheng, Yunbo Cao, Zhunchen Luo, Guotong Geng
papers.abstract: Legal case retrieval remains challenging due to the complexity of legal language and the need for precise lexical alignment between queries and relevant cases. Although dense retrieval models have achieved notable progress, empirical studies show that BM25 continues to serve as a strong baseline in this domain. It motivates us to propose a self-evolving framework for rule-driven query rewriting that enhances BM25 without any parameter training. The framework equips an LLM-based agent with an automatic evaluation environment, enabling it to iteratively create rewriting rules, plan validation experiments over rule combinations, and eliminate ineffective rules based on historical feedbacks. We evaluate our method on the Chinese legal case retrieval benchmark LeCaRD-v2. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms non-evolutionary baselines, including human-designed rules and greedy rule selection, particularly when powered by a high-capacity core LLM. We also conduct detailed analyses to investigate the mechanisms underlying self-evolution. Our findings reveal that LLM’s capabilities to leverage previous experimental results and its intrinsic knowledge of rule elimination play critical roles in refining the rule set via self-evolution.
papers.abstract_zh: 法律案例检索仍然具有挑战性，这主要是由于法律语言的复杂性以及需要精确匹配查询与相关案例之间的词汇内容。尽管密集检索模型已经取得了显著进展，但实证研究表明，BM25仍然是一个可靠的基准方法。这激励我们提出一种基于规则驱动的查询重写框架，该框架能够在不进行任何参数训练的情况下改进BM25的性能。该框架为基于LLM的代理提供了一个自动评估环境，使其能够迭代地创建重写规则、规划规则组合的验证实验，并根据历史反馈消除无效的规则。我们在中文法律案例检索基准测试LeCaRD-v2上评估了我们的方法。实验结果表明，所提出的框架在性能上优于非进化式基准方法，包括人工设计的规则和贪婪的规则选择方法，尤其是在拥有高容量的核心LLM支持的情况下。我们还进行了详细分析，以探究自我进化的机制。我们的研究发现表明，LLM利用先前实验结果的能力以及其在规则消除方面的内在知识，在通过自我进化来优化规则集方面发挥着关键作用。

papers.title: SpecExtend: A Drop-in Enhancement for Speculative Decoding of Long Sequences
papers.title_zh: SpecExtend：一种用于长序列推测解码的插件式增强功能
papers.authors: Jungyoub Cha, Hyunjong Kim, Sungzoon Cho
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding is a widely used technique for accelerating inference in large language models (LLMs), but its performance degrades as input length grows, with significant drops even at moderate lengths. Yet, this early degradation has remained largely underexplored. We introduce SpecExtend, a drop-in enhancement that improves speculative decoding on long sequences without additional training. SpecExtend integrates efficient attention mechanisms such as FlashAttention and Hybrid Tree Attention to accelerate prefill and verification steps. To improve both draft accuracy and speed on long inputs without retraining, we propose Cross-model Retrieval, a novel KV cache eviction strategy that leverages the target model’s attention scores to dynamically select relevant context for the smaller draft model. Extensive evaluations show that SpecExtend accelerates speculative decoding by up to 2.84× on 16K-token long document summarization and up to 3.86× on long-form reasoning, while preserving the short-input performance of state-of-the-art frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 推测性解码是一种广泛应用于加速大语言模型推理的技术，但随着输入长度的增加，其性能会下降，即使在中等长度的情况下也会出现显著的性能下降。然而，这种早期的性能下降却一直没有得到充分研究。我们提出了SpecExtend这一改进方案，它可以在不增加额外训练成本的情况下，提升长序列数据的推测性解码效率。SpecExtend整合了高效的注意力机制，如FlashAttention和Hybrid Tree Attention，以加快预填充和验证过程的效率。为了在不进行重新训练的情况下，提高长输入数据的草稿生成准确性和速度，我们提出了Cross-model Retrieval这一新颖的关键值缓存淘汰策略。该策略利用目标模型的注意力得分，动态为较小的草稿模型选择相关的上下文信息。广泛的测试表明，SpecExtend在16K令牌长的文档摘要任务中，推测性解码效率提升了2.84倍；在长形式推理任务中，效率则提升了3.86倍。同时，它还能保持现有框架在短输入数据上的良好性能。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Task-Related In-Context Learning
papers.title_zh: 与任务相关的上下文学习
papers.authors: Wenqiang Wang, Peng Chen, Yan Xiao, Yangshijie Zhang, Xiaoyue Lu, Jianjie Huang, Xiaochun Cao
papers.abstract: Standard in-context learning (ICL) assumes identical output spaces between test and retrieval datasets (fully aligned). However, in practice, these datasets can be fully aligned, partially aligned, or fully disjoint in label space (Output space), forming an information continuum from rich to scarce. Naive ICL often becomes ineffective under such mismatches. In this work, we challenge this assumption by demonstrating that the retrieval dataset need not perfectly align with the test dataset, as long as it remains related to the target task. We propose Task-Related In-Context Learning (TRICL), a unified framework for ICL under output-space mismatch, designed to cover the full continuum of scenarios. TRICL first identifies demonstrations in the mismatched retrieval dataset that are relevant to the test label space via a lightweight Bayesian probabilistic criterion, and uses them to form a related dataset. TRICL then perform ICL on the related dataset to obtain preliminary predictions; finally, TRICL leverage these intermediate predictions to reduce and transform the output space of the original test task, thereby improving the performance of LLMs. Even in the most information-scarce fully disjoint scenario, as long as the retrieval dataset is task-related to the test task, TRICL achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results across three LLMs, three task types, and four datasets. Moreover, TRICL remains effective in the fully aligned and partially aligned scenarios, consistently yielding strong gains over competitive baselines. Moreover, TRICL also extends to generative task.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准上下文学习假设测试数据集和检索数据集在输出空间上是完全一致的。然而，在实践中，这些数据集可能在标签空间上完全一致、部分一致或完全不重合，从而形成从丰富到稀缺的信息连续体。在这种不匹配的情况下，简单的上下文学习往往无法有效工作。在这项研究中，我们挑战了这一假设，证明只要检索数据集与目标任务相关，它不必与测试数据集完全一致。我们提出了任务相关上下文学习（TRICL）这一统一框架，用于处理输出空间不匹配的情况，以涵盖所有可能的场景。TRICL首先通过轻量级的贝叶斯概率准则，在不匹配的检索数据集中识别出与测试标签空间相关的样本，并利用这些样本来构建相关数据集。然后，TRICL在相关数据集上进行上下文学习，以获得初步预测结果；最后，TRICL利用这些中间预测结果来缩减和转换原始测试任务的输出空间，从而提高大语言模型的性能。即使在信息最匮乏且完全不重合的情况下，只要检索数据集与测试任务相关，TRICL也能在三种大语言模型、三种任务类型和四种数据集上取得最先进的结果。此外，TRICL在完全一致和部分一致的情况下依然有效，始终能比竞争基准模型获得显著的性能提升。而且，TRICL还适用于生成式任务。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: Concise Math Reasoning via Difficulty-Aware Distillation
papers.title_zh: 基于难度感知的简洁数学推理方法
papers.authors: Yifan Wu, Jingze Shi, Bingheng Wu, Jiayi Zhang, Xiaotian Lin, Yizhang Zhu, Zhaoyang Yu, Bang Liu, Chenglin Wu, Nan Tang, Yuyu Luo
papers.abstract: Human experts tackle difficult math problems by identifying and executing a few pivotal steps rather than listing every intermediate thought. In contrast, standard Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation trains small models on lengthy reasoning traces, encouraging a uniform overthinking style across easy and hard items alike. The result is rigid, slow solutions that sacrifice adaptivity. This approach stands in sharp contrast to human intuition. Humans naturally adapt their problem-solving strategy, dedicating significant effort to difficult problems while finding quick, simple solutions for easier ones. We argue that the root cause lies in the training data: it contains excess information and reasoning steps organized in ways misaligned with human practice. We address this with Difficulty-Aware Distillation(DAD), a procedure for producing training data that mirrors concise human reasoning. A large teacher model first assesses a problem’s difficulty and then rewrites the solution to retain only the essential steps. Using this process, we constructed LiteCoT, a 100,000-example corpus of short, clear rationales, and used it to train our Liter models. With 100k LiteCoT, we outperform models trained on 800k long CoT and cut both training and inference costs. The advantage is consistent across standard math benchmarks, showing that concise, human-aligned data delivers equal or better accuracy with much less compute. For example, on the challenging AIME24 exam, our approach reaches 74.2% Pass@1 using only about 5K inference tokens, surpassing other methods that consume many more tokens.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类专家解决复杂的数学问题时，会识别并执行几个关键步骤，而不是列出每一个中间思维过程。相比之下，传统的推理链蒸馏方法会训练小型模型处理冗长的推理过程，这导致无论是简单还是复杂的任务都采用相同的过度思考方式。其结果就是得出僵化、缓慢的解决方案，而牺牲了适应性。这种方法与人类直觉截然不同。人类自然会调整自己的解题策略：在解决复杂问题时投入大量精力，而在处理简单问题时则寻求快速、简单的解决方案。我们认为，问题的根源在于训练数据本身：这些数据包含过多的信息和推理步骤，且组织方式与人类的实际操作不符。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“难度感知蒸馏”技术，这是一种生成符合人类推理习惯的训练数据的办法。首先，一个大型教师模型会评估问题的难度，然后重新编写解决方案，只保留必要的步骤。通过这种方法来构建LiteCoT，这是一个包含10万条简短清晰推理过程的语料库，我们用它来训练我们的Liter模型。使用10万条LiteCoT作为训练数据，我们的模型在性能上优于那些使用80万条长推理过程的模型，同时还能降低训练和推理的成本。这一优势在标准数学测试中也得到了验证，表明简洁、符合人类思维习惯的数据能够以更少的计算资源达到相同甚至更好的准确率。例如，在具有挑战性的AIME24考试中，我们的方法仅使用大约5000个推理标记就能达到74.2%的通过率，远远超过了那些需要更多标记的其他方法。

papers.title: Corpora Generation for Urdu Grammatical Error Correction
papers.title_zh: 乌尔都语语法错误纠正工具——Corpora Generation
papers.authors: Syed Ahad, Burhanuddin Aliasghar Ezzi, Muhammad Arsalan Hussain, Sandesh Kumar, Abdul Samad
papers.abstract: Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) for Urdu remains an under-researched area due to the lack of annotated datasets. This paper addresses the challenge of generating a robust corpus for fine-tuning deep learning models aimed at Urdu GEC. We propose a method for synthesizing a large dataset by collecting errors from the Urdu WikiEdits history, learning from them, and inserting similar errors in grammatically correct sentences to generate incorrect sentences with grammatical errors, hence creating a pair of grammatically correct and incorrect sentences. We introduce UrduGEC-Synthetic, a synthetically generated dataset produced through this pipeline. Furthermore, we introduce UrduGEC-Gold, a Gold Dataset by extracting errors from exam copies of students. Finally, we also fine-tuned various models on UrduGEC-Synthetic and evaluated them against UrduGEC-Gold to show the quality of synthetic data generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于缺乏标注数据集，乌尔都语语法错误纠正领域仍属于研究不足的领域。本文旨在解决为深度学习模型微调而生成高质量语料库的问题。我们提出了一种方法：通过收集乌尔都语WikiEdits历史中的错误，从中学习规律，然后在语法正确的句子中插入类似的错误，从而生成包含语法错误的句子，进而形成一组语法正确与错误的句子对。我们引入了乌尔都语GEC-Synthetic数据集，该数据集是通过这种流程生成的。此外，我们还开发了乌尔都语GEC-Gold数据集，该数据集是通过从学生考试试卷中提取错误而得到的。最后，我们在乌尔都语GEC-Synthetic数据集上进行了多种模型的微调，并针对乌尔都语GEC-Gold数据集进行评估，以证明合成数据生成的质量。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Rethinking Retrieval-Augmented Generation as a Cooperative Decision-Making Problem
papers.title_zh: 重新思考将检索增强生成模型视为一种合作决策问题
papers.authors: Lichang Song, Ting Long, Yi Chang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has demonstrated strong effectiveness in knowledge-intensive tasks by grounding language generation in external evidence. Despite its success, many existing RAG systems are built based on a ranking-centric, asymmetric dependency paradigm, where the generation quality of the generator is highly dependent on reranking results of the reranker.To overcome this limitation, we propose Cooperative Retrieval-Augmented Generation (CoRAG), a framework that treats the reranker and the generator as peer decision-makers rather than being connected through an asymmetric dependency pipeline. By jointly optimizing their behaviors toward a shared task objective, the reranker and generator are encouraged to cooperate, ensuring that document reranking and generation work in concert to improve the final response.Experimental results demonstrate good generalization and improved generation stability of CoRAG, even when the model is trained on only around 10K PopQA samples. Our model released in https://github.com/CoderrrSong/CoRAG
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将语言生成与外部证据相结合，在知识密集型任务中表现出强大的效果。尽管取得了成功，但许多现有的RAG系统都是基于以排名为中心的、非对称依赖关系的范式构建的，此时生成器的生成质量在很大程度上取决于重排序器的重排序结果。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了协作检索增强生成（CoRAG）框架。该框架将重排序器和生成器视为平等的决策者，而不是通过非对称的依赖关系进行连接。通过共同优化它们的行为以实现共同的任务目标，重排序器和生成器能够相互协作，确保文档重排序和生成工作协同进行，从而提升最终生成的文本质量。实验结果表明，即使模型仅基于大约10K个PopQA样本进行训练，CoRAG仍然具有良好的泛化能力和更稳定的生成效果。我们的模型可以在https://github.com/CoderrrSong/CoRAG获取。

papers.title: More Agents Improve Math Problem Solving but Adversarial Robustness Gap Persists
papers.title_zh: 更多代理商提升了数学解决问题的能力，但面对复杂挑战时的鲁棒性差距仍然存在
papers.authors: Khashayar Alavi, Zhastay Yeltay, Lucie Flek, Akbar Karimi
papers.abstract: When LLM agents work together, they seem to be more powerful than a single LLM in mathematical question answering. However, are they also more robust to adversarial inputs? We investigate this question using adversarially perturbed math questions. These perturbations include punctuation noise with three intensities (10%, 30%, 50%), plus real-world and human-like typos (WikiTypo, R2ATA). Using a unified sampling-and-voting framework (Agent Forest), we evaluate six open-source models (Qwen3-4B/14B, Llama3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, Gemma3-4B/12B) across four benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, MMLU–Math, MultiArith), with various numbers of agents n = 1,2,5,10,15,20,25. Our findings show that 1) Noise type matters: punctuation noise harm scales with its severity, and the human typos remain the dominant bottleneck, yielding the largest gaps to Clean accuracy and the highest attack success rate (ASR) even with a large number of agents; 2) Collaboration reliably improves accuracy as the number of agents, n, increases, with the largest gains from n=1 to n=5 and diminishing returns beyond n\approx10. However, the adversarial robustness gap persists regardless of the agent count.
papers.abstract_zh: 当大语言模型智能体协同工作时，它们在数学问题回答方面的能力似乎比单个大语言模型更为强大。不过，它们对对抗性输入的鲁棒性是否也更强呢？我们通过使用带有三种不同强度（10%、30% 和 50%）的标点符号干扰的数学问题来研究这个问题。此外，我们还加入了现实世界中的拼写错误以及类似人类的拼写错误（如WikiTypo、R2ATA）。我们使用统一的采样与投票框架（Agent Forest）来评估六个开源模型（Qwen3-4B/14B、Llama3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Gemma3-4B/12B）在四个基准测试中的表现（GSM8K、MATH、MMLU–Math、MultiArith），并分别在不同的智能体数量下进行测试，即n=1、2、5、10、15、20、25。我们的研究发现表明：1）噪声类型很重要：标点符号干扰的负面影响与其严重程度成正比，而人类常见的拼写错误仍然是主要的瓶颈，即使有大量智能体参与，其导致的准确率差距仍然很大，且攻击成功率也最高；2）随着智能体数量的增加，协同工作的效果确实会提升准确率，但收益在n=1到n=5之间最为显著，而超过n≈10后，收益则逐渐下降。不过，无论智能体数量如何变化，模型对抗性鲁棒性的差距仍然存在。

papers.title: Indic-CodecFake meets SATYAM: Towards Detecting Neural Audio Codec Synthesized Speech Deepfakes in Indic Languages
papers.title_zh: Indic-CodecFake与SATYAM合作：致力于检测用印度语言合成的神经音频编码深度伪造语音内容
papers.authors: Girish, Mohd Mujtaba Akhtar, Orchid Chetia Phukan, Arun Balaji Buduru
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of Audio Large Language Models (ALMs), driven by Neural Audio Codecs (NACs), has led to the emergence of highly realistic speech deepfakes, commonly referred to as CodecFakes (CFs). Consequently, CF detection has attracted increasing attention from the research community. However, existing studies predominantly focus on English or Chinese, leaving the vulnerability of Indic languages largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce Indic-CodecFake (ICF) dataset, the first large-scale benchmark comprising real and NAC-synthesized speech across multiple Indic languages, diverse speaker profiles, and multiple NAC types. We use IndicSUPERB as the real speech corpus for generation of ICF dataset. Our experiments demonstrate that state-of-the-art (SOTA) CF detectors trained on English-centric datasets fail to generalize to ICF, underscoring the challenges posed by phonetic diversity and prosodic variability in Indic speech. Further, we present systematic evaluation of SOTA ALMs in a zero-shot setting on ICF dataset. We evaluate these ALMs as they have shown effectiveness for different speech tasks. However, our findings reveal that current ALMs exhibit consistently poor performance. To address this, we propose SATYAM, a novel hyperbolic ALM tailored for CF detection in Indic languages. SATYAM integrates semantic representations from Whisper and prosodic representations from TRILLsson using through Bhattacharya distance in hyperbolic space, and subsequently performs the same alignment procedure between the fused speech representation and a input conditioning prompt. This dual-stage fusion framework enables SATYAM to effectively model hierarchical relationships both within speech (semantic–prosodic) and across modalities (speech–text). Extensive evaluations show that SATYAM consistently outperforms competitive end-to-end and ALM-based baselines on the ICF benchmark.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于神经音频编解码器（NACs）的推动，音频大语言模型（ALMs）取得了快速进展，从而产生了高度逼真的语音深度伪造内容，这类内容通常被称为CodecFakes（CFs）。因此，CF检测受到了研究界的日益关注。然而，现有的研究主要集中在英语或汉语上，而印度语的脆弱性却尚未得到充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了Indic-CodecFake（ICF）数据集，这是第一个大规模基准测试集，包含了多种印度语的真实语音和由NACs合成的声音，涵盖了不同的说话者特征和多种NAC类型。我们使用IndicSUPERB作为真实语音语料库来生成ICF数据集。我们的实验表明，那些在以英语为中心的数据集上训练出的最先进的CF检测器无法泛化到ICF任务中，这凸显了印度语音在音素多样性和韵律变化方面的挑战。此外，我们还对最先进的ALMs在ICF数据集上的零样本性能进行了系统评估。我们发现这些ALMs在不同语音任务上表现出有效性。然而，我们的研究发现，当前的ALMs表现一直不佳。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SATYAM这一新型的双曲函数型ALM，专门用于检测印度语的CF。SATYAM结合了Whisper中的语义表示和TRILLsson提供的韵律表示，通过双曲空间中的Bhattacharya距离进行融合，然后在同一融合后的语音表示与输入条件提示之间进行相同的对齐处理。这种双阶段融合框架使得SATYAM能够有效地模拟语音内部（语义-韵律）以及不同模态之间的层次关系。广泛的评估结果显示，SATYAM在ICF基准测试中始终优于那些基于端到端方法和ALM的竞争性基线模型。

papers.title: Tracing Relational Knowledge Recall in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 在大型语言模型中追踪关系性知识回忆机制
papers.authors: Nicholas Popovič, Michael Färber
papers.abstract: We study how large language models recall relational knowledge during text generation, with a focus on identifying latent representations suitable for relation classification via linear probes.Prior work shows how attention heads and MLPs interact to resolve subject, predicate, and object, but it remains unclear which representations support faithful linear relation classification and why some relation types are easier to capture linearly than others.We systematically evaluate different latent representations derived from attention head and MLP contributions, showing that per-head attention contributions to the residual stream are comparatively strong features for linear relation classification.Feature attribution analyses of the trained probes, as well as characteristics of the different relation types, reveal clear correlations between probe accuracy and relation specificity, entity connectedness, and how distributed the signal on which the probe relies is across attention heads.Finally, we show how token-level feature attribution of probe predictions can be used to reveal probe behavior in further detail.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了大语言模型在文本生成过程中如何回忆关系知识，重点在于识别适用于通过线性探针进行关系分类的潜在表示。先前的研究表明，注意力头和多层感知机之间的相互作用有助于区分主语、谓语和宾语，但尚不清楚哪些表示能够支持准确的关系分类，以及为什么某些关系类型比其他关系类型更容易通过线性方式被捕捉到。我们系统地评估了从注意力头和多层感知机贡献中得出的不同潜在表示，发现每个注意力头对残差流的贡献是进行关系分类时非常有效的特征。对训练得到的探针进行特征归因分析，以及不同关系类型的特性分析，揭示了探针准确性与关系特异性、实体关联性之间明显的关联，同时也揭示了探针所依赖的信号在注意力头之间的分布情况。最后，我们展示了如何利用探针预测在令牌级别的特征归因来更详细地了解探针的行为。
topics: 大语言模型与提示学习

papers.title: LR-DWM: Efficient Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: LR-DWM：适用于扩散语言模型的高效水印技术
papers.authors: Ofek Raban, Gal Chechik, Ethan Fetaya
papers.abstract: Watermarking (WM) is a critical mechanism for detecting and attributing AI-generated content. Current WM methods for Large Language Models (LLMs) are predominantly tailored for autoregressive (AR) models: They rely on tokens being generated sequentially, and embed stable signals within the generated sequence based on the previously sampled text. Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) generate text via non-sequential iterative denoising, which requires significant modification to use WM methods designed for AR models. Recent work proposed to watermark DLMs by inverting the process when needed, but suffers significant computational or memory overhead. We introduce Left-Right Diffusion Watermarking (LR-DWM), a scheme that biases the generated token based on both left and right neighbors, when they are available. LR-DWM incurs minimal runtime and memory overhead, remaining close to the non-watermarked baseline DLM while enabling reliable statistical detection under standard evaluation settings. Our results demonstrate that DLMs can be watermarked efficiently, achieving high detectability with negligible computational and memory overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 水印技术是识别和标注人工智能生成内容的关键手段。目前，用于大语言模型的 watermark 技术主要适用于自回归模型：这些技术依赖于序列生成的令牌，并基于之前采样过的文本在生成的序列中嵌入稳定的特征信号。而扩散语言模型则通过非序列化的迭代去噪方式生成文本，因此需要对现有的自回归模型相关的 watermark 技术进行重大修改才能将其应用于扩散语言模型。最近有一些研究提出通过反转这一过程来对扩散语言模型进行水印处理，但这种方法会带来较大的计算或内存开销。我们提出了左右扩散水印技术，该技术在有左右邻居可供使用时，会基于这些邻居来影响生成的令牌。这种技术的运行时间和内存开销都非常低，同时还能保持与未加水印的扩散语言模型相近的性能水平，并且在标准评估环境下能够实现可靠的统计检测。我们的实验结果表明，扩散语言模型可以被高效地进行水印处理，同时还能实现高检测率，且计算和资源消耗极低。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology PDF · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译

papers.title: Beyond Unimodal Shortcuts: MLLMs as Cross-Modal Reasoners for Grounded Named Entity Recognition
papers.title_zh: 超越单一模式捷径：作为跨模式推理器的大型语言模型在命名实体识别中的应用
papers.authors: Jinlong Ma, Yu Zhang, Xuefeng Bai, Kehai Chen, Yuwei Wang, Zeming Liu, Jun Yu, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition (GMNER) aims to extract text-based entities, assign them semantic categories, and ground them to corresponding visual regions. In this work, we explore the potential of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to perform GMNER in an end-to-end manner, moving beyond their typical role as auxiliary tools within cascaded pipelines.Crucially, our investigation reveals a fundamental challenge: MLLMs exhibit \textit{modality bias}, including visual bias and textual bias, which stems from their tendency to take unimodal shortcuts rather than rigorous cross-modal verification.To address this, we propose Modality-aware Consistency Reasoning (\textbf{MCR}), which enforces structured cross-modal reasoning through Multi-style Reasoning Schema Injection (MRSI) and Constraint-guided Verifiable Optimization (CVO). MRSI transforms abstract constraints into executable reasoning chains, while CVO empowers the model to dynamically align its reasoning trajectories with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).Experiments on GMNER and visual grounding tasks demonstrate that MCR effectively mitigates modality bias and achieves superior performance compared to existing baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于多模态的命名实体识别（GMNER）旨在提取基于文本的实体，为它们分配语义类别，并将这些实体映射到相应的视觉区域。在这项研究中，我们探讨了多模态大语言模型在端到端执行GMNER任务中的潜力，使其不再仅仅作为级联流程中的辅助工具。重要的是，我们的研究揭示了一个根本性的挑战：多模态大语言模型存在“模态偏差”问题，包括视觉偏差和文本偏差，这源于它们倾向于采用单模态捷径而非严格的跨模态验证。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“模态感知一致性推理”的方法，该方法通过多风格推理注入和约束引导的可验证优化技术，实现结构化跨模态推理。多风格推理注入将抽象约束转化为可执行的推理链，而约束引导的可验证优化则使模型能够动态调整其推理路径，以符合群体相对政策优化原则。在GMNER和视觉定位任务的实验中，我们发现模态感知一致性推理能够有效缓解模态偏差问题，并取得了优于现有基线的性能表现。

papers.title: BubbleRAG: Interactive Cognitive Offloading with Thought Bubble in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: BubbleRAG：基于思维气泡的互动式认知卸载技术，适用于检索增强生成场景
papers.authors: Fuda Ye, Jiachuan Wang, Yongqi Zhang, Lei Chen, Shuangyin Li
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) extends the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by providing access to external knowledge. However, traditional retrieval-augmented LLMs rely on a silent reading paradigm that processes all retrieved documents passively, forcing them to reason without any interaction with the documents. This paradigm contrasts sharply with human interactive reading behavior, where external tools, such as bookmarks and notes, are used to offload cognitive demands. This paper introduces BubbleRAG, an enhanced RAG framework that emulates human interactive reading through annotation and re-reading. Specifically, BubbleRAG utilizes a lightweight thought bubble module that offloads LLM’s internal cognition into external bookmark tokens, which are then annotated back into the context. These bookmarks serve as externalized memory, allowing the LLM to revisit these annotations in subsequent reading and answering. Notably, BubbleRAG is particularly suitable for low-resource scenarios, as the LLM parameters remain frozen. Extensive experiments confirm the effectiveness, robustness, and generalizability of BubbleRAG. Our findings demonstrate that BubbleRAG enables LLMs to achieve superior evidence identification abilities typically seen in retrievers, while establishing a cognitive link between external and internal information during answer generation. The source code is available at https://github.com/yefd/BubbleRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过提供对外部知识的访问能力，扩展了大语言模型的功能。然而，传统的检索增强型LLM依赖于一种被动的读取模式，它被动地处理所有检索到的文档，迫使模型在没有任何与文档交互的情况下进行推理。这种模式与人类的交互式阅读行为截然不同，在交互式阅读中，会使用书签和笔记等外部工具来减轻认知负担。本文介绍了BubbleRAG，这是一个改进的RAG框架，它通过注释和重新阅读来模拟人类的交互式阅读行为。具体来说，BubbleRAG使用了一个轻量级的思维气泡模块，将LLM内部的认知任务转移到外部的书签标记上，然后将这些标记重新标注到上下文中。这些书签充当了外部化的记忆库，使得LLM在后续的阅读和回答过程中能够再次参考这些注释。值得注意的是，BubbleRAG特别适用于资源匮乏的场景，因为LLM的参数保持不变。大量的实验证实了BubbleRAG的有效性、稳健性和通用性。我们的研究结果表明，BubbleRAG使LLM能够具备比传统检索模型更出色的证据识别能力，同时在回答生成过程中建立了外部信息与内部信息之间的认知联系。源代码可以在https://github.com/yefd/BubbleRAG获取。
papers.abstract_source: ACL Anthology · CC BY 4.0；中文摘要：HY-MT1.5 机器翻译
